dag: Di saha maa Saimɔn Pita daa ʒiɛmi wuɣisiri buɣim. Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba pala o nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka o daa chihi yɛli, M pala o nyaandola.
en: Simon Peter was standing at the fire, keeping himself warm. The other people said to Peter, Arent you one of the followers of that man? Peter denied it. He said, No, I am not.

dag: Ka Ibizan daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Then Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem.

dag: Di saha maa ka n ni tɔɣis a wuntitali yɛla, ka tɔɣis a paɣibu yɛla dabisi muni zaa puuni.
en: So, Lord, I will tell people how good you are. I will praise you all day long.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pahi bɛ zuɣu; ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: He got into the boat, and the wind settled down. His disciples were so baffled they were beside themselves.

dag: ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka palo pɔri ni bɛ zaa tooi laɣim be nimaani; dama bɛ ni daa su binshɛŋa daa galisiya pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi laɣim be luɣ yini.
en: Abram and Lot had so many animals that the land could not support both of them together.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Kiburɔtihataava, bɛ ni daa sɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiri kɔre pam nimaani la zuɣu.
en: So the people named that place Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried those who had the strong desire for meat.

dag: Bɛna n-daa kana ti zani Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba ni salo zaa tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni yɛli.
en: They went and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and the whole community at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence and said.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Suɣa Tibu Chuɣu puhibu daa ti mirina.
en: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Jɛhɔiada kum maa nyaaŋa ka Juda kpamba daa kana ti jɛm naa, ka naa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa. N ni yili yila paɣ a wuna sani.
en: Lord , I praise you with all my heart. I sing songs of praise to you before the gods.

dag: Ka Naa Amɔn kpambalib daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: Amon's officials plotted against him and assassinated him in the palace.

dag: Yisahaku daa yurila Iso, dama o daa yuri mɔɣu ni nimdi pam, ka Ribɛka mi daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: Isaac preferred Esau, because he enjoyed eating the animals Esau killed, but Rebecca preferred Jacob.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛlimi, To! Yawɛ shiri niŋmi lala. Yawɛ chɛ ka a ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ niŋ pali, ka o zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa mini ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛ ni daa gbahi n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wurim maa daa chani gindi luɣilikam n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: They were scattered everywhere, and in every place they went, they told people the Good News.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Nahɔr.
en: When Serug was years old, he became the father of Nahor.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba bɛn daa nyɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu daa yi Kɛila maa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa naan tooi chaŋ. Ka Sool daa wum ni Dauda yi Kɛila maa zo, ka o chɛ o naba karibu.
en: So David and his men left Keilah. There were about men who went with David. They kept moving from place to place. Saul learned that David had escaped from Keilah, so he did not go to that city.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, Fom a noli ka wara.
en: Silence! Jesus said, speaking harshly to the demon. Come out of him.

dag: Pu shɛli daa do m-miri bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa, ka sil pal shɛli bɛ ni daa na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni do puu maa ni.
en: In the place where Jesus was killed on the cross, there was a garden. In the garden there was a new tomb. No one had ever been buried there before.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ tarili nyɛla o niriba. Yaakubu n-nyɛ o tarili.
en: Surely the LORDs property was his people; Jacob was his part of the inheritance.

dag: Yɛndan nyɛla ŋun tumdi din tuhi, amaa ka jɛrigu mi nyɛ ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi.
en: Sensible thoughts lead you to do right; foolish thoughts lead you to do wrong.

dag: Niriba maa mini farigudeeriba ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni, dama bɛn daa pun deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani;.
en: When the people heard this, they all agreed that Gods teaching was good. Even the tax collectors agreed. These were the people who were baptized by John.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kuhiri niŋdi ma? Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ cham tooni.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Why are you crying out for help? Tell the people to move forward.

dag: M mabiyurisi n suhiri ya, yi ni nyɛ saamba be tinzun tinsi ni la zuɣu, zomiya niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma din mini yi biɛhigu tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋub o zaɣ kpiŋ maa ŋun paɣim o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam gba kpuɣi zaɣ kpiŋ maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you eat meat from this animals body, you must wash your clothes. You will be unclean until evening. If you pick up the dead body of the animal, you must wash your clothes. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka o daa bahi niriba maa dabisi shɛli din pahi daba anii dali. Ka bɛ daa paɣi naa, ka kuli bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛŋa niŋ o dabili Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: On the eighth day Solomon sent the people home. They all praised him and went home happy because of all the blessings that the Lord had given his servant David and his people Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka m mali suhupiɛlli; ka n niŋgbuŋ gba tiligi;.
en: And so I am thankful and glad, and I feel completely secure.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Nyin Daniɛl, pumpɔŋɔ kpabimi litaafi maa, ka zaŋ bintabinda n-dihi tabili li sɔŋ hal ti paai saha tariga. Amaa niriba pam ni ti zɔri ginda, ka baŋsim ti yɛligiri pahira.
en: But you, Daniel, keep this message a secret. You must close the book and keep this secret until the time of the end. Many people will go here and there looking for true knowledge, and the true knowledge will increase.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o nuu pa teeku zuɣu; ka chɛ ka o zaŋ o nudirigu pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: I will set his hand on the sea. I will set his strong hand on the rivers.

dag: Ninsal soya zaa ni tooi nyɛla din viɛl o sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi ninsal suhu.
en: All the ways of people are pure in their eyes, but the LORD tests the motives.

dag: ka Iddo ŋun daa nyɛ Zakaria bia la mi nyɛ Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn daa be Giliad la kpɛma, ka Jaasiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Abinɛr bia la nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni kpɛma.
en: Iddo son of Zechariah, leader of East Manasseh; Jaasiel son of Abner, leader of the tribe of Benjamin;.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ti mali taɣitaɣi mini mɔri, ka palo beni ka yi ni gbe.
en: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Sool, ka o daa tim ti bol o na.
en: The things David had said were overheard and reported to Saul, who sent for him.

dag: N yaa paai kuɣili yaa? Bee n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla daanya?.
en: I am not strong as stone or bronze.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim daa pirigila buyi; bɛ pirigili daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Ginat bia Tibini leei naa, ka pirigili mi bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Omri leei naa.
en: The people of Israel were divided: some of them wanted to make Tibni son of Ginath king, and the others were in favor of Omri.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi kaman o ni daa kpi shɛm, dindina ti shiri ni pah o zuɣu neei kum ni kaman o ni daa neei kum ni shɛm la.
en: If we were united together in a death like his, we will also be united together in a resurrection like his.

dag: Amaa ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim ʒe siliga maa gbini kumda. O ni daa kumdi maa ka o ti vɔbisi lihi siliga maa puuni.
en: Mary stood crying outside the tomb. While she was still crying, she bent over and looked in the tomb.

dag: Ti daa wum di yɛla la Bɛtilihɛm; ti daa nya li la Jiarim mɔɣu ni.
en: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani miri Gibia.
en: The next morning the Israelites got up. They made a camp near the city of Gibeah.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni ka ti a nama, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi; ka a leei zuliya pam yaba.
en: May Almighty God bless your marriage and give you many children, so that you will become the father of many nations!.

dag: N ni darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Samarianim mini Ɛhab daŋ niriba tibili shɛm la. N ni kpimsi Jɛrusalɛm niriba birili, ka chɛ ka di puuni neei kaman nir ni yi paɣi laa n-nyahi neei di puuni ka zaŋ li pili shɛm la.
en: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the same line that I used to measure Samaria and the same masons level that I used on Ahabs family. I will wipe Jerusalem clean the same way someone wipes a plate clean, wiping it clean then turning it facedown.

dag: A ni yɛli ti yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ yuli ni ŋɔ, ti ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: We will not listen to the message from the Lord that you spoke to us.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tuma ni chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la, ka n chɛ ka yi chaŋ ti tumdi tuma tiri yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni. Dama n suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka di kul ni diri sahakam.
en: You will lose the inheritance that I gave you. I will make you slaves of your enemies in a land you dont know, for my anger blazes like a fire that wont go out.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: This is his commandment, that we believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love each other as he commanded us.

dag: Pa wuuni m-bɔŋɔ? N yɛn suhila Yawɛ ka o chɛ ka saa kum ka mi, ka yi nya ka baŋ ni yi tum taali din galisi Yawɛ sani, yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔr naa maa zuɣu.
en: Isn't this the dry season? I'm going to ask the Lord to send a thunderstorm. When you see it, you will realize how wrong you were to ask for a king.

dag: Ka kurim n-zaŋ o nubila n-lan sabiri tiŋa.
en: Then Jesus stooped down again and wrote on the ground.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Mɔsɛrɔt maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Bɛnijaakan.
en: They left Moseroth and camped at Bene Jaakan.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kanna maa zaa daa yi ʒirila bɛ pina din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni kpariti ni mɛɛr ni tulaale ni yuri ni buntaansi na ti tir o yuuni kam.
en: Year after year people came and brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, or mules.

dag: Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa yi bɛn na kpalim, ka tiligi yi niriba pam nyɛviya tin ya.
en: God sent me ahead of you to rescue you in this amazing way and to make sure that you and your descendants survive.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa paɣir o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ.
en: Let my whole being bless the LORD! Let everything inside me bless his holy name!.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ni bari ma zana shɛl la ni; dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Save me from the traps my enemy has set. You are my place of safety.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka binshɛɣukam zaa lee niŋdi dɛde ka doli soli.
en: Everything must be done in a proper and orderly way.

dag: ka Sulemaana daa lab me Gɛza mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din be tiŋli polo la.
en: Solomon built Gezer, Lower Beth-horon.

dag: Ka Pasɛa bia Joyada mini Bɛsɔdɛya bia Mɛshulam daa mali me Dunɔdal Kurili la. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Joiada, Paseahs son, and Meshullam, Besodeiahs son, repaired the Mishneh Gate; they laid its beams and set up its doors, bolts, and bars.

dag: Di daa niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nya Ibrahimma ni daa nya alibarika shɛl la Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka ti zaa tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi so o ni daa lo ti alikauli la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit.

dag: Ninsalinim suhuyiɣisili ni ŋmaligi paɣ a, a yi ti chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din bahindi nyaaŋa la biɛla gil a.
en: Human anger only results in more praise for you; those who survive the wars will keep your festivals.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ba ba bandi, ka bɛ be wahala mia ni.
en: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *.

dag: O yuli n-daa du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa, ka o leei bɛ kpɛma. Amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: He was the most famous of The Thirty and became their leader, but he was not as famous as The Three.

dag: A kpaʒiɛrima nyom viɛla; a yuli ŋmanila tulaale. Dinzuɣu ka paɣiba yur a maa.
en: Your fragrance is sweet; your very name is perfume. Thats why the young women love you.

dag: Wummiya, kuhigu din yiri Babilɔn na! Ninvuɣ kubo pam lu Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: We can hear people crying in Babylon. We hear the sound of people destroying things in the land of Babylon.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb yi nya filiŋ, a yɛrimi ni bɛ malila karimbaani, dama o tiligiri tarimba.
en: God brings down the proud and saves the humble.

dag: Yi yi doli n noli, ka gbibi n zaligunima ka tumdi di tuma.
en: Remember my laws and commands, and obey them.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa dɔɣi Jarɛd maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and then lived another years. He had other children.

dag: ka o yɛli ma, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu, nyin chɛ ka ŋuna n-nyɛ nyin Yawɛ ni bɔri ni so leei n-dan bia paɣa maa.
en: The right woman will answer in a special way. She will say, Drink this water, and I will also get water for your camels. That way I will know that she is the one the Lord has chosen for my masters son.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu ka lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti guhi pɔi nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana nti siɣis o na bee o ku kana.
en: One of them ran up with a sponge, soaked it in cheap wine, and put it on the end of a stick. Then he held it up to Jesus' lips and said, Wait! Let us see if Elijah is coming to bring him down from the cross.

dag: Amaa dalinli maa yi piɛl o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, ka bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔbiri din be dalinli maa ni bi paligi, maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi dɔro maa lana niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the shiny spot on the skin is white and does not appear to be deeper than the skin and the hair has not turned white, the priest will quarantine the infected person for seven days.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba mini Midian kpamba maa daa zaŋ baɣibuɣiri liɣiri chaŋ Balaam sani ti yɛl o Balak ni yɛli shɛm.
en: So the Moabite and Midianite leaders took with them the payment for the curse, went to Balaam, and gave him Balak's message.

dag: Ka bɛ tintariga daa zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Tabo mini Shahazuma ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-zaŋ ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: The border touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh. Their border ended at the Jordan; in total: sixteen cities with their surrounding areas.

dag: Ŋunkam kpuɣi paɣa nya binsuŋ, ka nya nirilim niŋbu Yawɛ sani.
en: He who finds a wife finds what is good, gaining favor from the LORD.

dag: Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahinahi, ka binshɛli din ŋmani ninsal nuhi be bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔna ni.
en: Each of them had four faces, four wings, and what looked like a human hand under each wing.

dag: chaŋ Ofiri nti zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanahi na nti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: Solomons ships went to Ophir and brought back about tons of gold for him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Niriba bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: The total number of the people of Israel enrolled in the divisions, group by group, was .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be nyam va naɣisaa maa tampiligim n-zaŋ li ti zali tiŋ tariga luɣ shɛli din be nyam, ka di nyɛ Izraɛlnim dini; ka bɛ mal li niŋdi kom din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la ni. Di nyɛla daɣiri yihibu sara.
en: A person who is clean will gather the ashes of the cow and place them outside the camp in a clean place. They will be kept for the water of purification for the Israelite community as a purification offering.

dag: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti, ka bɛ kana ti paai teeku ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim daa yiɣisi zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba n-kari bɛ naba na hal ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, and you came to the sea. The Egyptians chased your ancestors with chariots and horses to the Reed Sea.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli, M pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, I promise to the Lord , the God Most High, the one who made heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o o ni pa ti ni yino maa zuɣu.
en: John replied, Master, we saw someone throwing demons out in your name, and we tried to stop him because he isnt in our group of followers.

dag: bɛ na ʒi n-di ka guui binshɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daazichi ku zani yuui.
en: When they eat, there is nothing left over, but now their prosperity comes to an end.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali ninkur shɛb bɛn daa pun ʒiini o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba maa la wula.
en: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, What should I tell these people.

dag: ka bɛ mini Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal ni Shiina Naa Amirafɛl ni Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ti gbaai tab tuhibu. Nanima anahi mini nanima anu n-daa lu tab zuɣu maa.
en: against King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Shinar, and King Arioch of Ellasar, four kings against five.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu shɛli din bɔri ni a niŋ din tuhi ti ma ŋɔ. Wummi n kuhigu ŋɔ; gbilisim a tibili wum man ŋun nyɛ ʒiri ni ka so nol ni ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ.
en: Lord , hear my prayer for justice. I am calling loudly to you. I am being honest in what I say, so please listen to my prayer.

dag: Ŋuna n-fuɣiri maligumaaniba situra ka mali ba chana, ka luhiri wɔɣira.
en: he humbles priests and men of power.

dag: Bɛna n-daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni din la n-leei ti dini.
en: those who said, Lets take Gods pastures for ourselves.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu n-da Samaria daboli Shɛmɛr sani m-me tiŋ tam di zuɣu, ka boli di yuli Samaria ŋ-ŋmahindi Shɛmɛr ŋun daa su daboli maa yuli.
en: Then Omri bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for about pounds of silver. Omri built a city on that hill. He named the city Samaria after the name of its owner, Shemer.

dag: ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pahi zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo. Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa kul nyɛ Sool dima di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: then Saul was even more afraid of David. Saul was Davids enemy for the rest of his life.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ o yɛligu n-yɛli Pɛtuɛl bia Joɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa garita n-nya ka fiig tia la kuumi zaa nti tabili di tiŋ wula.
en: Early next morning, as they walked along the road, they saw the fig tree. It was dead all the way down to its roots.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lab o naɣikɔra maa sani nti zaŋ ba kɔrigi, ka zaŋ bɛ dapuhi m-mali buɣim duɣi ba n-zaŋ ti niriba ka bɛ ŋubi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti doli Ilaija n-sɔŋd o.
en: Elisha turned back from following Elijah, took the pair of oxen, and slaughtered them. Then with equipment from the oxen, Elisha boiled the meat, gave it to the people, and they ate it. Then he got up, followed Elijah, and served him.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa. Doo maa ni daa gbibi bimbuɣisirigu shɛli o nuu ni maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li buɣisi gooni maa barilim mini di dubu. Di dubu daa nyɛla mita ata, ka di barilim gba nyɛ mita ata.
en: Now there was an outer wall that went all the way around the temple compound. The measuring rod in the mans hand was ten and a half feet . When he measured the walls height and width it was ten and a half feet high and ten and a half feet wide.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan yi nti yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ o mi yina nti wuhi ya ka yi baŋ ni m bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: Again Pilate came out and said to the Jewish leaders, Look! I am bringing Jesus out to you. I want you to know that I find nothing I can charge him with.

dag: Ka o mi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba, dama o nyɛla ŋun mi shɛlikam. O bi yɛri ka labiri nyaaŋa. O ni darigi tuumbiɛtumdiba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa tibili.
en: He knows what he is doing! He sends disaster. He carries out his threats to punish evil people and those who protect them.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni tim o ni o ti yɛli Aduna shɛm yɛl o, ka wuh o o ni yɛl o ni o tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa.
en: Moses told Aaron what God had sent him to say; he also told him about the miracles God had given him the power to perform.

dag: Dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zaa niŋ pali la yɛtɔɣ yini puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: But that night God said to Nathan.

dag: Yawɛ daa booni ya la olivi ti mahali din mali wal viɛla, amaa sanʒiɛ titali puuni o ni niŋ buɣim dab li, ka di di di wula.
en: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tum Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: The people kept on sinning like Jeroboam.

dag: Bɛ boonila niriba duri zoya zuɣu; nimaani ka bɛ maani sara din tuhi. Dama teeku puuni ka bɛ nyari bɛ daazichi, ka nyari azichi sɔɣira bihigu ni.
en: They will call the people to their mountain. There they will offer good sacrifices. They will take riches from the sea and treasures from the shore.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn chɛ ka yi ʒiʒiinitab nyuri yi suhuyiɣisili dam, ka yi kul boori yi lɔɣu pahiri hal ka bɛ ti nyu m-buɣi ni di chɛ ka yi nya bɛ zaɣim la zuɣu.
en: You are doomed! In your fury you humiliated and disgraced your neighbors; you made them stagger as though they were drunk.

dag: Yɛlim ba, N nyɛla shihirili yi sani, n ni niŋ shɛm maa, lala nti yɛn niŋ ya. Bɛ ni ti gbahi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tinzun tiŋ ti niŋ dabitim ni.
en: Say: Im your sign. Just as I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into captivity in exile.

dag: Pɛriʒia mini Lidia ni Libia tɔbbihi daa nyɛla bɛn be a tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ a tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi mini bɛ kuriti zuɣupila sɔŋ a ni. Bɛ daa tir a jilima.
en: Men from Persia, Lud, and Put were in your army. They were your men of war who hung their shields and helmets on your walls. They brought honor and glory to your city.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti ku yi yuri, ka saɣim yi chɛchɛbunsi.
en: The Lord says, At that time I will take away your horses, and I will destroy your chariots.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni vuhi pɔhim shɛli bahi. Bɛ dabisa ŋmanila shilinshia din garita.
en: Humans are like a puff of air; their days go by like a shadow.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa taali, ka yɛra, Tim ti kom ka ti nyu. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Wula ka yi zaŋ ma taali? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi Yawɛ.
en: The people argued with Moses and said, Give us water to drink. Moses said to them, Why are you arguing with me? Why are you testing the LORD.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Lɛvi zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Isaka zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand.

dag: Ka sagban daantaliga din daa be niriba maa tooni wuntaŋ ni la mini buɣim daantaliga din daa be bɛ tooni yuŋ la daa na ʒi n-zo bɛ sani.
en: The column of cloud during the day and the column of lightning at night never left its place in front of the people.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi ni ŋun mal liɣiri kolibila, ŋun kpuɣim li; lala n-nyɛ ŋun mal adiiku gba. Ka ŋun mi ka takɔbi, ŋun zaŋm o binyɛrigu kɔhi da li.
en: Jesus told them, But now, if you have a moneybag, take it with you. Also take a traveling bag, and if you don't have a sword, sell some of your clothes and buy one.

dag: Bɛ daa kulila Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya daŋ ni dɔbba, ka bɛ fali tarili daa kpalim bɛ yaannim daŋ puuni.
en: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.

dag: Amaa mani ŋuna, Yawɛ yiko min o shia ni zaligu ni yaa be n ni, ka n yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛ biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.

dag: Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni o zuɣulaantab bɛn daa nyɛ tuumba, ka be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili ni la daa sabi gbaŋ tim Naa Darius sani.
en: Tattenai the governor of the area west of the Euphrates River, Shethar Bozenai, and the important people with them sent a letter to King Darius.

dag: Mɛriba kom la gbini bɛ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, ka yɛla daa paai Musa bɛ zuɣu.
en: At Meribah the people made the Lord angry and created trouble for Moses.

dag: Tuuli, n daa wumya ni yi yi mali cheechi laɣiŋgu, woligibu be yi sunsuuni, ka n tɛhiri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: First, I hear that when you meet together as a church you are divided. And this is not hard to believe.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa ti be Tɛsalɔnaika la yi daa tim sɔŋsim na ti ti ma, ka daa lan niŋ lala di nyaaŋa zaŋ chana.
en: Several times you sent me things I needed when I was in Thessalonica.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa ti zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilalantaba ni naɣibihi pol kpaba n-kɔri ba Wahu Kuɣili din daa do m-baɣi Ɛnrɔgɛl la, ka boli nabihi bɛn nyɛ o mabihi zaa mini Juda nabihi zaa na.
en: One day Adonijah offered a sacrifice of sheep, bulls, and fattened calves at Snake Rock, near the spring of Enrogel. He invited the other sons of King David and the king's officials who were from Judah to come to this sacrificial feast.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Zarɛfat din be Sidɔn tiŋgban ni la nti be ni. Nyama, n yɛli pako so ŋun be nimaani ni o tim a bindirigu.
en: Go to Zarephath in Sidon and stay there. There is a widow there that I commanded to take care of you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa tim ti boli Jɔab ni o kana ka o tim o naa sani, amaa ka Jɔab daa zaɣisi kandina. Ka o lan tim pahi buyi, amaa ka Jɔab kul bahi zaɣisi kandina.
en: Absalom sent a message to Joab, asking for permission to see the king, but Joab refused to come see him. So Absalom sent a second message to Joab. Again, Joab refused to come see him.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Tuun shɛli Naawuni ni bɔri ni yi tum nyɛla ni yi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: Jesus answered, What God wants you to do is to believe in the one he sent.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ. O chɛ ka n naba bemi kaman woliga naba la, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana. Di nyɛla kaman baansi toondana ni zaŋ biŋkumda din mali mihi n-yil li shɛm.
en: The Sovereign Lord gives me strength. He makes me sure-footed as a deer and keeps me safe on the mountains.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ma la, chɛ ka bɛ noya ni yɛli yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa la lab ʒini bɛ zuɣu.
en: Don't let my enemies be victorious; make their threats against me fall back on them.

dag: N wumiya ni wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni, ka a mali ninneesim mini baŋsim ni yɛm.
en: I have heard that the breath of the gods is in you and that you possess illumination, insight, and extraordinary wisdom.

dag: Ka o daa pir o tɔbbihi ʒii buta zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ mɔɣu maa ni ti sɔɣi do n-gu ba. Ka Abimilɛk daa ti lihi nya ba ka bɛ yi tiŋ maa ni kanna, ka o yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: so he took his men, divided them into three groups, and hid in the fields, waiting. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he came out of hiding to kill them.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ma na, ka n ŋubi m bia mɔɣu ni nimdi, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni. Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li ti o ka o di, ka o zaŋ wain pah o ka o nyu.
en: So Isaac told him, Serve me the wild meat, and I can give you my blessing. Jacob gave him some meat, and he ate it. He also gave him some wine, and he drank it.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Anabi Joɛl ni daa yɛli shɛm la. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Instead, this is what the prophet Joel spoke about:.

dag: Ka Ahitɔfɛl daa ti lan yɛli Absalom yaha, Chɛ ka m pii niriba tuhi pinaayi n-zaŋ ba biɛhi Dauda naba yuŋ ŋɔ.
en: Ahithophel also said to Absalom, Now, let me choose , men to chase David tonight.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me omaŋmaŋ ya o tiŋ maa ni, ka daa mali luɣ shɛli n-ti suɣili nimaani zali Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: After he had built houses for himself in Davids City, David prepared a place for Gods chest and pitched a tent for it.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ ni ka yaa yɛla pam ni zuɣu, o ni tooi di suɣilo o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ʒilinsi ni mini bɛn chirindi polo.
en: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ŋarima ni n-labisi Ijipti; n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni yi nini ku lan nya luɣ shɛl la. Ka yi ti zaŋ yimaŋ ni yi kɔhi yi dimnim maa zuɣu nimaani n-leei bɛ dabidɔbba mini bɛ dabipaɣiba, amaa ka ŋun ni dan ya ku beni.
en: The Lord will send you back to Egypt in ships, even though he said that you would never have to go there again. There you will try to sell yourselves to your enemies as slaves, but no one will want to buy you.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, Yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nir ni ni ti niŋ shɛli naani ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Ka ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun zaŋd o Shia n-niŋd o daanabinim ni daa tim o malaika na ni o ti wuh o jɛmdiba din yɛn niŋ ka di ku yuui.
en: Then the angel said to me, These words are true and can be trusted. And the Lord God, who gives his Spirit to the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Again the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Di daa bi lan kpa ni so wuh o ninsal biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, dama omaŋmaŋ pun mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni.
en: He did not need anyone to tell him what a person was like. He already knew.

dag: m-pahi Yawɛ vuhim dabisa la mini yi pina ni yi ni po pɔri shɛŋa sara ni yi suhuyubu sara shɛŋa yi ni maani tiri Yawɛ la zaa zuɣu.
en: These festivals are in addition to the regular Sabbaths, and these offerings are in addition to your regular gifts, your offerings as fulfillment of vows, and your freewill offerings that you give to the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka chaŋ ti kpe do so ŋun yuli daa booni Taitius Justus la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka o yiŋ daa baɣi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: Paul then moved into the house of a man named Titius Justus, who worshiped God and lived next door to the synagogue.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa; chɛliya ka daadamnim zo dabiɛm! O ʒila o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu. Chɛliya ka tiŋgbani dam!.
en: The LORD rules— the nations shake! He sits enthroned on the winged heavenly creatures— the earth quakes!.

dag: Yi zaŋla yi wuna ŋmahima n-zali baɣili yi duri puuni dunoya. Yi zaɣisi ma, ka mali yi gariti ka di yɛlim pam, ka ti yi mamanim liɣiri, ka pirigiri yi situra ka mali ba dooni nyari bɛ zaɣim.
en: You hide the things that help you remember me behind the doors and doorframes. You were with me, but you got up to go to them. You spread out your bed and gave yourself to them. You love their beds and enjoy looking at their naked bodies.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛli bidibis ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: Hophni and Phinehas were killed, and the sacred chest was captured.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, zuŋɔ ka bɛ mali bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, amaa di zaa yoli ka yɛla ŋ-ŋɔ ti paai ma! N yi di di alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ Yawɛ naan saɣi lala.
en: Look, Aaron said to Moses, today they offered their purification offerings and their entirely burned offerings before the LORD, but these things still happened to me! Would the LORD have approved if I had eaten a purification offering today.

dag: Ŋuna m-booi booli pa teeku kom zuɣu luɣ shɛli neesim mini zibisim ni chirigi taba.
en: He drew the horizon on the ocean, like a circle where light and darkness meet.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ ti suhi Naawuni.
en: They came to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, Sit here while I pray.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yinim bɛn mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi ŋɔ, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ:.
en: Pay attention, you foolish and stupid people, who have eyes, but cannot see, and have ears, but cannot hear.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be yi sani tumd o tuma la, ti suhiri ya ni yi lum ba sizuura. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn wuhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande la.
en: We beg you, our friends, to pay proper respect to those who work among you, who guide and instruct you in the Christian life.

dag: Ka o tizo daa gbib o napɔŋkpaa n-dol o yina; ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Yaakubu. Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihiyɔbu nira saha shɛli Ribɛka ni daa dɔɣi jahi maa.
en: When the second baby was born, he was holding tightly to Esaus heel. So that baby was named Jacob. Isaac was years old when Jacob and Esau were born.

dag: Huram daa lan me duɣuri ka mali soobuya mini taha. Lala ka Huram daa niŋ tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa zaa ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: Hiram made the basins, shovels, and bowls. And so Hiram finished his work on the LORDs temple for King Solomon.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ti yaag o noli yɛli ni Yisa Masia nyɛla Duuma, ka di chɛ ka o Ba Naawuni nya jilima.
en: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, Jesus Christ is Lord.

dag: M Ba, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n nya jilima a sani, jilima shɛli n ni daa pun mal a sani ka dunia na bi nam la.
en: Now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I shared with you before the world was created.

dag: Ka Juda bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla ni Pɛrɛz ni Zɛra, amaa ka Ɛr mini Onan daa kpi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Pɛrɛz bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Judah and his sons: Shelah, Perez, and Zerah. Perez' sons were Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tuhi nyaŋ Judanim maa, ka sokam zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: Israel defeated Judah. Every man of Judah ran away to his home.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bɔhi ba, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa? Yi bi mi ni nir kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ tooi nyari ashilɔni yɛla.
en: Joseph said to them, Why have you done this? Didnt you know that I have a special way of learning secrets? No one is better at this than I am.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa.
en: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. So they came up to him and asked if it was right for a man to divorce his wife.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ya, Ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda ansarisi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri soli ni ti beni.
en: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Sɛraya, A yi ti paai Babilɔn, nyin karimmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa.
en: Jeremiah said to Seraiah: When you get to Babylon, see to it that you read all these words.

dag: N Naawuni, n tampiŋ, n ni sɔɣiri so sani. N nyɔtaɣirigu mini kpiɔŋlana ŋun tiligi ma. M birini mini n sɔɣisili shee, nyini n-nyɛ n tiligira ŋun tiligiri ma barina ni.
en: He is my God, the Rock I run to for protection. He is my shield; by his power I am saved. He is my hiding place, my place of safety, high in the hills. He is my savior, the one who rescues me from the cruel enemy.

dag: Amaa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa biŋkɔbigu kpam min o binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla, o daa zaŋ li nyola buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: He completely burned on the altar the fat, kidneys, and lobe of the liver from the purification offering, just as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni, ka ŋmaligi kpa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa polo ti bo o, bɛ daa nya o.
en: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.

dag: N ni yɛl a jilima din galisi ŋɔ min a tibiginsim yɛla, ka tɛh a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi deeri din simdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, wula ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini alahichinim bɛn ku deeri din simdi ba?.
en: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the wicked and sinners?.

dag: N dabisa gariya, n ni daa lo nia shɛŋa ka di nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛŋa la saɣimya.
en: My life is passing away, and my plans are destroyed. My hope is gone.

dag: Amaa yi ni naɣ niŋdi zaɣ viɛl shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Yi je Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba tuma kaman man gba ni je li shɛm.
en: But this is what you have in your favor: you hate what the Nicolaitans do, as much as I do.

dag: Zom ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka tummila din viɛla; bom suhudoo n-gbibi li.
en: Turn away from evil and do good; strive for peace with all your heart.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma yaha, N nyaya ka niriba maa nyɛla tipawumlinim ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Lord also said to me, I know how stubborn these people are.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino kpiŋkpan yini wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni chɛrubi kpiŋkpan yini nyol ni zaŋ ti kpa o kpiŋkpan din la nyol ni wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: Both were of the same size and shape. Each had two wings, each wing 1⁄2 feet long, so that the distance from one wing tip to the other was feet.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o ma Mariama, Nyama, Izraɛlnim pam ni ti lula bia ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɛ pam mi ti yiɣisila o zuɣu. O lan nyɛla shihir shɛli niriba ni ni ti tɔɣisi jɛndi.
en: Then he blessed them and told Mary, This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko pam nam zuɣusaa mini dunia. Binshɛli kani din kpɛm nyaŋ a.
en: Sovereign Lord , you made the earth and the sky by your great power and might; nothing is too difficult for you.

dag: Ka pako so ŋun nyɛ pako maŋli nyɛla ŋun kpalim o ko, ka zaŋ o tahima niŋla Naawuni ni, ka kul mali wunsuhigu suhiri Naawuni o ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: A widow who really needs help is one who has been left all alone. She trusts God to take care of her. She prays all the time, night and day, and asks God for help.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paya ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi Tɛlimɛla mini Tɛliharisha ni Kɛrub ni Addɔn ni Imɛr n-lab kuli na la, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi tooi wuhi bɛ yaannim ni nyɛ shɛba bee bɛ ni yi shɛli na din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya.
en: There were who returned from the families of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda, though they could not prove they were Israelites. They had lived in the Babylonian towns of Tel-Melah, Tel-Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer.

dag: Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa ni a kpiɔŋ tariga.
en: You must love him with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength.

dag: Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli vuri yi Jɛrusalɛm na; ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani sɔhira. Amaa Yawɛ sani n-nyɛ o niriba sɔɣibu shee; Izraɛlnim sɔɣibu viɛlli shee m-bala.
en: The LORD roars from Zion, and utters his voice from Jerusalem; the heavens and the earth quake. But the LORD is a refuge for his people, a shelter for the people of Israel.

dag: Bɔ ka a su kpe? Ŋuni ka a lee mi kpe hal ka ti gbir amaŋmaŋ gballi kpe n-chibiri daboli zuɣu tampiŋ ni?.
en: What do you have here—and whom do you have here— that you have hewed out a tomb for yourself, you who cuts his grave on high and carves himself a home in the cliff?.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn kum o.
en: There are six other days in the week for working. But the seventh day is a very special day of rest. That is the special day to honor the Lord . Anyone who works during the Sabbath must be killed.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka o ku duh omaŋ yaɣ o mabihi maa sani, ka mi ku birigi fukumsi zaligu maa n-kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo din ni chɛ ka o min o zuliya ti di nam yuui Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord 's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.

dag: A sujee naai ti mi zaa; ka a suhuyiɣisili nyaŋ ti zaa.
en: Yes, we are wasting away because of your wrath; we are paralyzed with fear on account of your rage.

dag: N yɛn dolila dunianim zaa ni doli so shɛl la. Mali yaa.
en: I am about to die, like all men must. But you are growing stronger and becoming a man.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa Firawuna min o kpamba ninni, O daa yaag o jaaŋgbee maa n-fiɛbi kom din daa be Nail Mɔɣili maa ni, ka di zaa daa shiri leei ʒim.
en: Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord . Aaron held out his stick, then struck the Nile, as the king and his officials watched. The river turned into blood.

dag: Yɔbuhi bela zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka sisirisi sɔɣiri di kuɣa lɔna ni.
en: The wild goats live in the high mountains, and the rock badgers hide in the cliffs.

dag: A zuɣu ŋmanila Kamɛl Zoli. A zabiri nyɛlisirimi kaman ago la. Di viɛlim ni tooi chɛ ka naa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu.
en: Your head is like Carmel, and the hair on your head is like silk. Your long flowing hair captures even a king.

dag: nti zaŋ li da yi suhu ni bɔri shɛli; yi ni tooi da niɣi bee piɛri bee wain bee dam din mali kpiɔŋ bee yi suhu ni kul bɔri shɛli, ka yi mini yi yinsinim ti di li nimaani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Use the money to buy anything you want—cattle, sheep, wine or beer or any other food. Then you and your family should eat and enjoy yourselves there in that place with the Lord your God.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisa lan lab Kapɛrinium ka di mol gili ni o lab yiŋ na.
en: A few days later, Jesus came back to Capernaum. The news spread that he was back home.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Ti ni yɛn woligi tab ŋɔ, n suhiri Yawɛ ni o gul ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa lan boli nimaani yuli Mizipa.
en: Then Laban said, Let the Lord watch over us while we are separated from each other. So that place was also named Mizpah.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim ti polo na! Be alizanda ni ka lihina nya; tiligim wain tia ŋɔ.
en: God All-Powerful, come back. Look down from heaven at your vine and protect it.

dag: Yawɛ yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je alahichi; o gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim; o fari ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahira.
en: Those of you who love the LORD, hate evil! God guards the lives of his faithful ones, delivering them from the power of the wicked.

dag: Di lan doliya yimaŋmaŋ suhu yubu n-niŋdi kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ: Kɔr biɛri tuma mini niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni tab laɣim nyuri dam ni buɣijɛmbo din chihiri zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la.
en: You have wasted enough time doing what unbelievers desire—living in their unrestrained immorality and lust, their drunkenness and excessive feasting and wild parties, and their forbidden worship of idols.

dag: Yawɛ bela zuɣusaa o luɣ kasi shee ka lihirina. O bela alizanda ni ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ na.
en: The Lord looked down from his holy place on high, he looked down from heaven to earth.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka daadam ku tooi nyu bara Naawuni sani.
en: This means that no one can boast in God's presence.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a mi, dama a nyɛla ŋun ni garigiri ma, lala zuɣu ka n suhir a maa; dinzuɣu gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu maa.
en: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!.

dag: Wummi alikauli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Jeremiah, listen to the words of this agreement and tell them to the people living in Jerusalem and the rest of Judah.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dagɔn tindaannim mini Ashidɔdnim bɛn zaa yɛn kpe Dagɔn duu maa ni bi lan tamdi di dunɔbia zuɣu kpɛri hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Thats why to this day Dagons priests or anyone else who enters his temple in Ashdod doesnt step on the threshold.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba du n-tam ti zuɣu; ti kpe buɣim mini kom ni gari yi, amaa a zaŋ ti tahi luɣ shɛli din galisi na.
en: let other people run right over our heads— weve been through fire and water. But you brought us out to freedom!.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ka tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, paɣ maa ni yɛn dɔɣi bi so ti a maa ni kpi.
en: However, because you have utterly disrespected the LORD by doing this, the son born to you will definitely die.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Punɔn maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Obɔt.
en: They marched from Punon and camped at Oboth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa ti yɛn zahim Ibrahimma ka bol o, Ibrahimma! Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: After these things God decided to test Abrahams faith. God said to him, Abraham! And he said, Yes.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sool min o bidibis ata ni o gbaɣinɔʒira ni o niriba zaa ni daa laɣim kpi dahin yini shɛm m-bala.
en: So Saul, his three sons, his armor-bearer, and all his soldiers died together that day.

dag: Di niŋya niriba bina fabu naani; yi mi di zaŋya tahima yoli niŋ ŋmɛnditoli tuma ni. Hal yi daazichi yi zoori pahira, yin di niŋya li naani.
en: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛhudia nira n-nyɛ ma? Amaŋmaŋ niriba mini maligumaaniba kpamba n-zaŋ a tahi n sanna! Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka a lee tum.
en: You know I'm not a Jew! Pilate said. Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba; ka yɔbahi ŋub ba.
en: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.

dag: O daa ku tiŋgbana pam niriba, ka ku nanim bɛn mali yaa.
en: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings:.

dag: ka zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbin la sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.

dag: Shɛb yɛra, Pool gbana puuni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛl kpɛma ni din mali yiko, amaa o yi ti be ti sani o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ni, o nyɛla ninvuɣ gbariŋ ka o yɛtɔɣa bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: Someone will say, Paul's letters are severe and strong, but when he is with us in person, he is weak, and his words are nothing.

dag: n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani Kiriatijiarim Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ boli nimaani yuli, Mahanɛdan hal ni zuŋɔ. Di mi bela Kiriatijiarim wulinluhili polo.
en: One night they camped near Kiriath-Jearim in the territory of Judah, and that's why the place just west of Kiriath-Jearim is still known as Dan's Camp.

dag: Doliy o dunoya kpe ni wumpaɣibo, ka kpe o dundɔŋ ni ni paɣibu! Puhimiy o, ka paɣ o yuli!.
en: Enter the Temple gates with thanksgiving; go into its courts with praise. Give thanks to him and praise him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They came to the people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh in the land of Gilead and spoke with them.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ a gula. O nyɛla a nudirigu polo mahim.
en: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.

dag: N daa deei sɔŋsim cheechi shɛŋa ni n-ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ ya. Di bemi kaman n daa fa ba mi n-sɔŋ ya maa.
en: While I was working among you, I was paid by other churches. I was robbing them, so to speak, in order to help you.

dag: Ka o daa dii gbaai nachimbil maa m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka lih o ninni ka bi zɔri vi ka yɛl o.
en: She grabbed the young man and kissed him. Without shame, she looked him in the eye and said.

dag: Ka niriba maa yɛl o, Alizin biɛɣu n-naɣ ʒi a zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee bɔri ni o ku a.
en: The crowd replied, You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela mɔɣu ni yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: John the Baptist was in the wilderness calling for people to be baptized to show that they were changing their hearts and lives and wanted God to forgive their sins.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni bɔhim baŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni waawaayil la ni bɔri ni bɛ nya wuhibu, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Many of these people did not understand, so they did what was wrong. They complained, but now they will learn their lesson.

dag: A me dunia tamla di tanzaa zuɣu, ka shɛli kul ku tooi dam li sahakam.
en: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu, ka nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri bidibbini. Nyin ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim zuliya kam, nyini ka n zaŋ ku nanima.
en: The Lord says, Babylon, you are my club. I used you to smash nations. I used you to destroy kingdoms.

dag: hal ka a ninvuɣ biɛtali ti yi palo? Pumpɔŋɔ a nyɛla Ɛdomnim mini Filistianim ni bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba ni maani ninvuɣ so ansarisi, ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: and before the evil you did had been exposed? Now you are just like her—a joke to the Edomites, the Philistines, and your other neighbors who hate you.

dag: A daag o tiŋ gooni luhi, ka wurim o birininima.
en: Youve broken through all his walls. Youve made his strongholds a pile of ruins.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Chamiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa gbini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti pii kuɣ yiniyini m-pa yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu, ka di kalinli saɣisi yi Izraɛlnim zuliya pinaayi ŋɔ kalinli.
en: and he told them, Go into the Jordan ahead of the Covenant Box of the Lord your God. Each one of you take a stone on your shoulder, one for each of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ; ka biasani maa gba daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: So that night they got him drunk, and the younger daughter had intercourse with him. Again he was so drunk that he didn't know it.

dag: Pita ni daa ti ka Antiɔk na, n daa galim o o ninni, dama o ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla din simdi galimbu.
en: When Peter came to Antioch, he did something that was not right. I stood against him, because he was wrong.

dag: N ni darig o tibili o ni daa tam n yɛla Baalnim chuɣu dabisa saha, ka tuɣindi ba tulaale zim, ka pir o nintua, ka ye salima n-zo n-dol o mamanim la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mini niriba bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa daa chaŋ jɛmbu shee din daa be Gibiɔn la, dama Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa mali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣ shɛli tiŋgban nɛl ni la daa bela nimaani.
en: commanding them to go with him to the place of worship at Gibeon. They went there because that was where the Tent of the Lord 's presence was located, which Moses, the Lord 's servant, had made in the wilderness. .

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ lan zaŋm daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa yaha. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the whole congregation agreed to celebrate another seven days, which they joyfully did.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa ŋun biriti bee ŋun mihiri kom maa n-nyɛ shɛli, amaa Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka di zoori maa n-nyɛ shɛli.
en: Because of this, neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but the only one who is anything is God who makes it grow.

dag: ka o lu tiŋa, ka wum ka kukol shɛli boon o na yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul! Why do you persecute me.

dag: Bɛ mi baɣa daa ka maligumaaniba tuma ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ niriba maa sani. So daa yi kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mali sara n-zaŋ di nimdi maa duɣira, maligumaana yiŋbia zaŋdila dirigu din mali jɛba ata kana.
en: This was how the priest was supposed to act with the people: Whenever anyone made a sacrifice, while the meat was boiling, the priests assistant would come with a three-pronged fork in hand.

dag: Bɛ yi shiri nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa be bɛ sani, dindina bɛn suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni o di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ la shɛŋa din kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini Juda nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm la kuli Babilɔn.
en: If they are really prophets and have the LORDs word, let them intercede with the LORD of heavenly forces not to let the equipment left in the LORDs temple and in the royal palace of Judah and Jerusalem be carted off to Babylon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: But the farmers grabbed the servant and beat him. They sent him away with nothing.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia, ka di puhi vari ʒiɛya ha, ka o chaŋ di gbini ni o ti nya o ni nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu di; o ni daa paai di gbini o daa bi nya binshɛɣu naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko, dama fiig tihi walibu saha daa na bi paai.
en: He saw in the distance a fig tree covered with leaves, so he went to see if he could find any figs on it. But when he came to it, he found only leaves, because it was not the right time for figs.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Bia maa kum la zuɣu chɛ ka yi leela Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛba n-naag omaŋa ni di chɛ ka yi be kasi ka ka daɣiri ka mi ku mali galimi, ka o zaŋ ya labis omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: But now, by means of the physical death of his Son, God has made you his friends, in order to bring you, holy, pure, and faultless, into his presence.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣirina, ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As Jesus and his disciples were coming down the mountain, he told them not to say a word about what they had seen, until the Son of Man had been raised from death.

dag: Ka a ti lan yɛli ba yaha ni Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bee sara maligu.
en: Remember! No one in Israel, including foreigners, is to offer a sacrifice anywhere.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Itam maa ŋ-ŋmaligi labi Pihahirɔt din be Baalizɛfɔn wulimpuhili polo la nti dɔni miri Migidol.
en: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.

dag: Dinzuɣu shɛhiranim pam ŋɔ ni gili ti ŋɔ zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti yihi bin tibisili kam mini din nyɛ alahichi ni zaŋ shɛli tabili ti, ka chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo zo tizɔbo shɛli din ʒe n-gul ti ŋɔ.
en: So then, with endurance, lets also run the race that is laid out in front of us, since we have such a great cloud of witnesses surrounding us. Lets throw off any extra baggage, get rid of the sin that trips us up.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nini daa kul kpa Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ daa bi tooi chɛ ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu hal ka di lahibali daa ti ti nti to Darius ka o daa sab o zilinkom gbaŋ ti na.
en: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.

dag: Zaŋna hal ni zuŋɔ, kum mini kɔnyuri n-kul mali ti, ka ti chani gbinfini, ka nyari buri, ka ka biɛhigu shee.
en: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.

dag: Ka Samsin ba daa chaŋ paɣisarili maa yiŋa, ka Samsin ti chɛ ka bɛ puhi chuɣu nimaani; dama lala ka nachimba daa yi niŋda.
en: His father went to the woman's house, and Samson gave a banquet there. This was a custom among the young men.

dag: Yɛnnim bɛn sani, nyɛvili soli durila zuɣusaa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku siɣi tiŋgban ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: What wise people do leads to life here on earth and stops them from going down to the place of death.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim zaŋ laɣiŋgu suɣili la be suɣa maa sunsuuni doli kaman bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa maa zali shɛm, ka sokam ʒe o zaashee o tuuta gbini.
en: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.

dag: ka yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam, Piim di ni zaɣ tolima pia, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyama, n dari tɔhila Izraɛl nam Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: and said to Jeroboam, Take ten pieces for yourself, because the Lord , the God of Israel, says to you, I am going to take the kingdom away from Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes.

dag: Maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi kuli do so ŋun pa maligumaana, ŋun miri ka o lan di sara maligu kasinim maa.
en: If a priests daughter marries a layman, she is not allowed to eat the holy offerings.

dag: ka a ku a dan Ɛhab daŋ niriba, ka di chɛ ka m bɔhi Jɛzibɛl biɛri o ni daa ku n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim mini n dab shɛb zaa bɛn pahi la zuɣu.
en: I want you to wipe out the family of Ahab, so Jezebel will be punished for killing the prophets and my other servants.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun diri ni ka bɛ ni diri shɛli yina; Ŋum mali kpiɔŋ ni ka din nyaɣisi yina. Ka di daa mali ti paai daba ata, ka bɛ na bi tooi baŋ ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: Samson said: Once so strong and mighty— now so sweet and tasty! Three days went by, and the Philistine young men had not come up with the right answer.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti yiɣisi yimaŋmaŋ gba ni n-tɔɣisi ya chirimbu yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ lɛbigi nyaandoliba maa suhuri n-zu ba chaŋ.
en: Some of your own people will distort the word in order to lure followers after them.

dag: ŋun be chɛchɛbuŋ ni zuɣusaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Wummiya o kukoli din mali kpiɔŋ la tahigu.
en: to him who rides in the sky, the ancient sky. Listen to him shout with a mighty roar.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔh o, Ka daɣila ti gba nyɛla zoomba.
en: When the Pharisees heard Jesus say this, they asked, Are we blind.

dag: Tiŋgbani dina, bindirigu n-yiri di ni na, amaa tiŋgbani puuni din ŋmanila buɣim din diri binyara.
en: Food grows on the ground above. But underground it is different, as if everything were melted by fire.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la n daa saɣisi ba ni nimmoo, ka kul saɣisiri ba waawaayili hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-yɛra, Deemiya n noli.
en: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka naŋgbammalisimnim maa yɛtɔɣa zan tariga. Chɛ ka barinyuriba fo bɛ noya.
en: Silence those flattering tongues, O Lord ! Close those boastful mouths that say.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu labisi. Guhimi Yawɛ, o ni sɔŋ a.
en: Dont say, Ill repay the evildoer! Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo na, ka bɛ mini Ibrahimma ni Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ti laɣim ʒini alizanda nam ni ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: I assure you that many will come from the east and the west and sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob at the feast in the Kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Nyin Sintani, man Yawɛ kpahir a zuɣu ni! Man Yawɛ ŋun pii Jɛrusalɛm la kpahir a zuɣu ni! Doo ŋɔ ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni.
en: Then the angel of the Lord said, The Lord says that you are wrong, and he will continue to correct you! The Lord has chosen Jerusalem to be his special city. He saved that city—it was like a burning stick pulled from the fire.

dag: n daa ŋmanila jɛrigu ni ŋun ʒi shɛli; ka be kaman biŋkɔbigu la a sani.
en: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.

dag: Ka Dan bidibiga daa nyɛ Hushim.
en: Jacob and Bilhah, the servant woman Laban had given his daughter Rachel, had seven children and grandchildren. Their son Dan took his son Hushim. Their son Naphtali took his sons Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab maa daa ti yɛl o, Ti nya ti Duuma. Amaa ka o yɛli ba, Ka pa ni man ti nya o nuhi ni kpahi bɔba la, ka zaŋ n nubil bɔbili kpahi maa bɔba maa ni, ka zaŋ n nuu tim o puluɣili la bɔbili la ni, n ku niŋ yɛda.
en: So the other disciples told him, We have seen the Lord! Thomas said to them, Unless I see the scars of the nails in his hands and put my finger on those scars and my hand in his side, I will not believe.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka o paɣ Ɛlizabɛt daa niŋ pua, ka sɔɣir omaŋa hal ti paai chira anu ka yɛra.
en: Afterward, his wife Elizabeth became pregnant. She kept to herself for five months, saying.

dag: Ka Juda daa bo paɣ ti o bituuli Ɛr. Paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Tama.
en: For his first son Er, Judah got a wife whose name was Tamar.

dag: ka Kɔra nyɛ Izar bia, ka Izar nyɛ Kɔhat bia, ka Kɔhat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi mi daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia.
en: son of Izhar son of Kohath son of Levi son of Israel.

dag: Hazɔr ni ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam, ka yɔbahi ti gɔri di ni. So ti ku lan be nimaani bee ka so ti lan ʒini di ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Hazor will become a home for wild dogs, an empty desert forever. No one will live there. No one will stay in that place.

dag: Tikuba kul chani moonila ashili yɛtɔɣa, amaa niriba ni dihi so tabili ŋun gbibila ashili.
en: No one who gossips can be trusted with a secret, but you can put confidence in someone who is trustworthy.

dag: A daa pirigi teeku buyi ka chɛ ka a niriba doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du, amaa ka a daai bɛn daa doli ba maa niŋ teeku maa bulli ni, kaman kuɣili ni lu kɔtitali ni shɛm la.
en: Through the sea you made a path for your people and led them through on dry ground. Those who pursued them drowned in deep water, as a stone sinks in the raging sea.

dag: Ka di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋubi o ni mali suhudoo sara maligu shɛli, ka di nyɛ o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa nimdi zaa o ni mal li dahin shɛli maa. O di ti chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba.
en: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti liri Midiannim maa, dama n zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: During the night the Lord spoke to Gideon and said, Get up. I will let you defeat the Midianite army. Go down to their camp.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi ba, ka o min o nyaandoliba dii kpe ŋariŋ m-baai du teeku duli chaŋ Dalimanuta tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then he went in a boat with his followers to the area of Dalmanutha.

dag: Ŋun yuri liɣiri, ku nya liɣiri tiɣi; ka ŋun yuri buni mi ku nya buni tiɣi. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Those who love money will never be satisfied with the money they have. Those who love wealth will not be satisfied when they get more and more. This is also senseless.

dag: Ŋun daa pah awɛi n-su chira awɛi ni n-daa nyɛ Abiɛza ŋun daa yi Anatɔt na ka nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the ninth month, Abiezer from Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin;.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaa lee tumdila din ni tiɣi ti kpee nini o zaɣ viɛlli nyabu min o kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: Each of us should please our neighbors for their good in order to build them up.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli, ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim a yurilim maŋli zuɣu. Dama a nya n ni diri wahala shɛli; ka mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni.
en: Your kindness makes me so happy. You have seen my suffering. You know about the troubles I have.

dag: Ti daa tum alahichi, ka daa tum tuumbiɛri mini tuun shɛŋa din bi tuhi. Ti daa zaɣis a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛli, ka daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ a ni wuhi ti din tuhi shɛli tumbu.
en: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku shini n noli, N ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni biɛrim pam n shia ni. N ni fabili ni naŋgbantom n suhu ni.
en: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.

dag: amaa Masia ŋun daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba san la o ni nyɛ Naawuni Bia la zuɣu. Ka ti gba nyɛla o niriba, tinim dee yi kul mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ ti ni mali tahima shɛl la naani hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: But Christ is faithful as the Son in charge of God's house. We are his house if we keep up our courage and our confidence in what we hope for.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa maag o paɣa Batishiiba suhu, ka o min o daa lan dɔni ka o dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Sulemaana. Ka Yawɛ daa yur o pam.
en: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba. He went to her and had sex with her. She gave birth to a son and named him Solomon. The LORD loved him.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Naawuni ni ti kari niriba saria yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni tɔɣisi zuɣu;.
en: You can be sure that on the Judgment Day you will have to give account of every useless word you have ever spoken.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi bihi mini yi puu atam ni yi niɣi bɛn yɛligi ni yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi.
en: He will curse you, and you will not have many children. He will curse your land, and you will not have good crops. He will curse your animals, and they will not have many babies. He will curse your calves and lambs.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni naai ma zaa, o ku m mini bɛn be zaa.
en: God, you surely took away my strength. You destroyed my whole family.

dag: Iso zuliya ni nanim yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla kaman bɛ malibu mini bɛ biɛhigu shee ni daa nyɛ shɛm doli bɛ yuya. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: Esau was the ancestor of the following Edomite tribes: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, and Iram. The area where each of these tribes lived was known by the name of the tribe.

dag: Ka tumo so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ Mikaya maa na yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa naala noli n-yɛli naa ni yu shɛm, a gba kul yɛlimila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ŋmani bɛ ni yino dini, ka nyɛ o yubu.
en: Meanwhile, the official who had gone to get Micaiah said to him, All the other prophets have prophesied success for the king, and you had better do the same.

dag: ka n suhu paligi pam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ ni.
en: I am very happy because God is my Savior.

dag: ka o ti niŋ ni biɛɣ pihinahi; ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa daa bi di shɛli di dabisa maa ni, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: There the devil tempted Jesus for days. Jesus ate nothing during this time, and when it was finished, he was very hungry.

dag: Paɣ yi zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu kam ka o gol o, bɛn kum paɣa maa mini biŋkɔbigu maa, kumiya ba, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a woman approaches any kind of animal to mate with it, you must kill the woman and the animal. They must be executed; their blood is on their own heads.

dag: Timiya ni yi suhu zaa, ka yi yi yɛn niŋ li yin di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma mini yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.

dag: O daa yɛli ma mi, A bia Sulemaana n-ni ti me n yili maa mini n dundɔna, dama mani m-piig o leei m bia, ka m mi leeg o ba.
en: The Lord said to me, Your son Solomon is the one who will build my Temple. I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Raba gooni n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa. Di saha tɔbu tuhibu tahigu ni ti tahiri dindali maa, ka zabili ti be kaman sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa daa bɔri ni bɛ ka Sulemaana sanna nti wum Naawuni ni ti o yɛm shɛli maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: and so the whole earth wanted an audience with Solomon in order to hear his God-given wisdom.

dag: N suhu ni yuri so, yɛlim ma, Ya polo ka a zaŋd a piɛri chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri? Ya polo ka a chɛ ka bɛ dooni vuhiri wuntaŋ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka m be kaman paɣ so ŋun pa sariga dol a tab biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: Tell me, you whom I love with all my heart— where do you pasture your flock, where do you rest them at noon?— so I dont wander around with the flocks of your companions.

dag: M bɔri ni n yɛli ya n ni mɔri mɔ shɛli yi mini Laodisianim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi ma ni nini la zuɣu yɛla.
en: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi niŋ fawɔɣili zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa ku tum naa barina.
en: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.

dag: m-pahi maligumaaniba, Ɛliakim mini Maasɛya ni Miniamin ni Mikaya ni Ɛliɔnai ni Zakaria ni Hanania bɛn daa piɛbiri kikahi la.
en: Then these priests stood in their places: Eliakim, Maaseiah, Mijamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah. These priests had their trumpets with them.

dag: Ka Adam min o paɣ daa lan laɣim ka o dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Sɛt, dama O daa yɛlimi, Naawuni zaŋla bidib so ti ma ka o zani Ɛbɛl zaani, Keen ni daa ku Ɛbɛl la zuɣu.
en: Adam and his wife had another son. She said, God has given me a son to replace Abel, whom Cain killed. So she named him Seth.

dag: Pukpara maa daa yaɣindila Naawuni yɛligu.
en: What the farmer is spreading is really the message about the kingdom.

dag: Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi zaa ka o zaŋ niŋ teeku ni, ka o sapashin kpɛma zaa shim Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: He threw Pharaohs chariots and soldiers into the sea. Pharaohs very best soldiers drowned in the Red Sea.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli daadamnima, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zɔbo n-nyɛ yɛm ka tuumbiɛri chɛbu mi nyɛ baŋsim.
en: and said to humankind: Look, the fear of the LORD is wisdom; turning from evil is understanding.

dag: Ka bɛ kul maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bɛ ni nyɔr li buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la n-tiri Yawɛ asiba mini zaawuni sahakam kaman di ni sabi Yawɛ fukumsi zaligu shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim la puuni shɛm.
en: They were to offer continually, both morning and evening, entirely burned offerings to the LORD on the altar for entirely burned offerings, following the written requirements in the LORDs Instruction, which he had given Israel.

dag: Sidɔnnima, yi ku lan mali suhupiɛlli, ka yi niriba ni nya nahiŋgu. Hal bɛ yi zo n-kuli Saipurus, bɛ na kul bi yi.
en: City of Sidon, your happiness has ended, and your people are oppressed. Even if they escape to Cyprus, they will still not be safe.

dag: Yi yi di niŋ Anabi Musa yɛda, yi naan niŋ n gba yɛda, dama o daa sabi n yɛla zali.
en: If you had really believed Moses, you would have believed me, because he wrote about me.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka n paɣir a dahin yini, a wuntia zaligunim la zuɣu.
en: Seven times a day I praise you because your laws are fair.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum ka o tahi pam yɛli, Yinim bɛn yɛn darigi tiŋ ŋɔ tibili, vumiya mirina. Sokam zaŋm o bidibbini gbib o nuu ni.
en: After that, I heard the Lord shout, Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons.

dag: Yidana n-su o paɣ fukumsi kaman Masia ni su cheechi fukumsi shɛm la; Masia maŋmaŋ mi n-lan nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la tiligira.
en: A husband is the head of his wife like Christ is head of the church, that is, the savior of the body.

dag: Di saha Yisahaku daa yila Bɛrilahairoi na nti be Nɛgɛb.
en: Now Isaac had come from the region of Beer-lahai-roi and had settled in the arid southern plain.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu.
en: Lord , you are my God. Lord , listen to my prayer.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tim o dabili Musa mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ o ni daa pii so la.
en: God sent Moses his servant and the one he chose, Aaron.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N na kul bɔri ni n yɛli n Duuma shɛli pahi. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pisi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pisi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham said, Since Ive already decided to speak with my Lord, what if twenty are there? The LORD said, I wont do it, for the sake of twenty.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Taiatira Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni Naawuni Bia ŋun nina ŋmani buɣim zilinli ka o napɔnvari nyɛlisiri kaman daanya viɛlli la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: These are the words of Gods Son, whose eyes are like a fiery flame, and whose feet are like fine brass.

dag: Manaasa zuliya tiŋgbani maa wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Ifriim zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Manasseh from the eastern border to the western border: Ephraim, one portion.

dag: O ni daa baŋ Pita kukoli, suhupiɛlli zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi yooi dunol maa, amaa ka naɣ zomi kpe nti yɛli ni Pita ʒe dunol ni.
en: She recognized Peters voice, and she was very happy. She even forgot to open the door. She ran inside and told the group, Peter is at the door.

dag: Ka Pita gbaag o nuu ni n-yiɣis o zali; ka boli Yisa nyaandoliba maa mini pakoya maa na nti zaŋ Dɔɔkas ŋun lan niŋ nyɛvililan maa ti ba.
en: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.

dag: Ŋunkam kpuɣi paɣa nya binsuŋ, ka nya nirilim niŋbu Yawɛ sani.
en: Find a wife and you find a good thing; it shows that the Lord is good to you.

dag: Yuun pisopɔin maa saha yi ti paai, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Taai tiŋgbɔŋ maa lan lab di tuun kura ni yaha n-lan zaŋ dimaŋ kɔhi dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa zuɣu kaman pagɔrili la.
en: At the end of seventy years, the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her trade and will prostitute herself with all the kingdoms on the earth.

dag: Yi ku tooi nyu ti Duuma pipia ni binnyurigu, ka lan nyu alizin biɛri pipia ni binnyurigu. Yi mi ku tooi di ti Duuma bindirigu, ka lan di alizin biɛri bindirigu.
en: You cannot drink from the Lord's cup and also from the cup of demons; you cannot eat at the Lord's table and also at the table of demons.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, pa mani ka o niŋ yɛda, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa ka o niŋ yɛda maa.
en: Jesus shouted, Whoever believes in me doesnt believe in me but in the one who sent me.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o bi yɛn yɛli zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu kɔŋko.
en: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, I told you he would bring me bad news.

dag: Amaa Hɛfa bia Zɛlɔfɛhad ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi. Bipuɣinsi kɔŋko ka o daa dɔɣi. Bipuɣinsi maa yuya n-daa booni, Mahila ni Nɔa ni Hɔgila ni Milika ni Tiriza.
en: Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters; their names were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka na biɛri yiko zan tariga.
en: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the rod of tyrants.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-nyɛ ŋun biri alikama biɛlin suma la.
en: Jesus answered, The man who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man;.

dag: Naa daa lan bahi noli ni o tim ba nayili bindira mini wain shɛli o ni nyura n-dihi ba lala yuma ata. Ka yuma ata maa ti paai ka o zaŋ ba tahi ŋun naa sanna.
en: The king assigned these young men daily allotments from his own food and from the royal wine. Ashpenaz was to teach them for three years so that at the end of that time they could serve before the king.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla anabi.
en: The woman said, Sir, I see that you are a prophet.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan tim tuumba Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋmi m paɣ Mikal ŋun nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ Filistianim yokol gbana kɔbiga yo so zuɣu la ti ma na.
en: David sent a few of his officials to Ishbosheth to give him this message: Give me back my wife Michal! I killed Philistines so I could marry her.

dag: Bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba. Yi na mi n-nya ka goo wali gaya bee ka pirinkpaŋ wali fiig tia wala?.
en: You will know them by what they do. Thorn bushes do not bear grapes, and briers do not bear figs.

dag: M bi bɔri mmaŋ jilima tibu, amaa yino n-naɣ beni m-bɔri ni n nya jilima, ŋun mi n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: I am not seeking honor for myself. But there is one who is seeking it and who judges in my favor.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n yɛligu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n soli mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.

dag: Dama ni o nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka o mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. Ka o ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka mi ni tooi yɛl o dabili ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, Go! and he goes. I can say to another, Come! and he comes. I can say to my servant, Do this! and he will do it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Sabimiya ni doo ŋɔ bi dɔɣi bihi, do so ŋun kul ku di nasara o nyɛvili ni. Dama o bihi ni so ti ku nya soli n-ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee n-lan su Judanim yaha.
en: The LORD proclaims: Mark this man as childless; he will not prosper during his lifetime. None of his children will sit on Davids throne and rule again in Judah.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanim na ʒi n-tum shɛli n-naɣi pahila tuumbiɛri ka bɛ tumdi n sani bɛ bilim ni hal ni pɔŋɔ. Izraɛlnim na ʒi n-tum shɛli n-naɣi pahila bɛ zaŋla bɛ nuhi tumdi tuun shɛŋa din chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisira. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: From the very beginning of their history the people of Israel and the people of Judah have displeased me and made me angry by what they have done.

dag: Yi yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpan shɛlikam n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛmd o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: So then, obey the commands that I have given you today; love the Lord your God and serve him with all your heart.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa nimdi duɣi luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Cook the meat from the ram that was used to make Aaron the high priest. Cook that meat in a holy place.

dag: O daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; ka bɛ daa nya o ka o bela pɔhim ni chana.
en: He flew across the sky, riding on a Cherub angel, gliding on the wings of the wind.

dag: Ka n daa kahigi n daalahichi wuh a; ka bi sɔɣi n ni tum taal shɛŋa. N daa yɛliya, Yawɛ, n ni kahigi n daalahichi maa wuh a, ka a daa chɛ n daalahichi maa zaa.
en: Then I confessed my sins to you; I did not conceal my wrongdoings. I decided to confess them to you, and you forgave all my sins.

dag: Di yihi yɛlimaŋli n nol ni hal biɛla gba, dama n tahima bela a zaligunim ni.
en: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.

dag: Bɛ yi kuhi boli ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni saɣi. Bɛ yi suhiri ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
