dag: Ka o ni yuri ya shɛm o suhu ni kul pahirimi, di bahi bamdi o yi teei yi zaa nɔdeebo mini yi ni daa deeg o ni sizuura lubu la yɛla.
en: His devotion to you is growing even more as he remembers how all of you were obedient when you welcomed him with fear and trembling.

dag: Dama biɛhiŋ kani, m mi ni n kum nyaaŋa, yi ni tum tuumbiɛri, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zali ya ni yi doli so shɛli ŋɔ, di nyaaŋa zaɣ biɛɣu ni ti lu yi zuɣu, dama yi ni ti tum zaɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ ninni, ka chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam yi nuhi tuma zuɣu.
en: because I know that after Im dead, you will ruin everything, departing from the path Ive commanded you. Terrible things will happen to you in the future because you will do evil in the LORDs eyes, aggravating him with the things your hands have made.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tim Shilo nti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka maa na. O nam ʒiishee daa bela chɛrubinim sunsuuni. Ka Ɛli bihi ayi Hofini mini Finɛhas daa doli Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: So they sent messengers to Shiloh and got the Covenant Box of the Lord Almighty, who is enthroned above the winged creatures. And Eli's two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, came along with the Covenant Box.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti labi me tiŋ maa ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi li la Hananɛl Du wɔɣinli la shee hal ti paai Gooŋgɔŋ Dunɔdal la shee.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when the city will be rebuilt for the LORD from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan deei Filistianim ni daa tuhi fa tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ sani zaa. Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti kpa Gaat, bɛ daa fa bɛ tiŋgbana zaa Filistianim sani. Ka suhudoo daa lan niŋ bɛn Izraɛlnim maa mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: The towns the Philistines had captured from Israel, from Ekron to Gath, were returned to Israel. Israel also recovered the territory around those two cities from the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.

dag: Di yuuni maa siɣili saha ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa timna ti gbaag o kuli Babilɔn ka daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu neen viɛla pahi kuli, ka zaŋ Jɛhoyakin mabia Zɛdɛkia leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa zal o zaani.
en: In the springtime, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him to be brought to Babylon, along with valuable equipment from the LORDs temple. Then he made Zedekiah his uncle the next king of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ n-yihi ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali yi sunsuuni. Dama di simdi ni yi niŋ din tuhi Yawɛ sani.
en: In this way you will remove that guilt from your group by doing what the Lord said.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuun shɛŋa din pahi fukumsi.
en: Their relatives the Levites were dedicated to all the services of the dwelling for Gods house.

dag: N wum lahibali Yawɛ sani. O tim tumo zuliya kam sani ti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya taba n kana ti lir o. Yiɣisimiya tuhi tɔbu.
en: I have heard a report from the LORD that a messenger is sent among the nations: Join forces and come against her; prepare for war!.

dag: Malimiya zoligo! Dama ninvuɣ kubo kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka damli dambu pali tiŋ puuni.
en: Make chains for the prisoners, because many people will be punished for killing other people. There will be violence every place in the city.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.

dag: Ti Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ wula ka ti lee yɛn yɛli dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa? Dama ti lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands.

dag: Harim daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisi.
en: of Harim.

dag: Nyam ti bɔrɔbɔro, di daa na kul tulimi ka ti zaŋ li yi yiŋ na ti ni daa yiɣisina dahin shɛli ni ti ti diri sol ni, amaa nyam di ni kuui ka kpe yue shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: This is our bread. On the day we left to come to you we took it warm from our houses as supplies. But now here it is, dried up and crumbly.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu shili zaa dindali maa. Bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu kaman Naa Jɔsia ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: So on that day, Passover was celebrated to honor the Lord , and sacrifices were offered on the altar to him, just as Josiah had commanded.

dag: n teei n nuu jɛndi ya, ka zaŋ ya ti zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di ninvuɣ shɛba, ka n ti kun ya niriba maa sani n-kpihim yi birili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. N ni ti kun ya, di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Im about to overpower you. Nations will plunder you. I will cut you off from the peoples, remove you from the lands, and utterly destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Afɛk la, ka Izraɛlnim mi laɣim biliga din be Jɛziriil tiŋgban ni la gbini.
en: The Philistines brought all their troops together at Aphek, while the Israelites camped at the spring in Jezreel Valley.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti nya doo maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu yɛl o, Nyama, a kpaŋya zaa! Di lan tum alahichi din ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu din gari din la ti paag a yaha.
en: Afterward, Jesus found him in the Temple and said, Listen, you are well now; so stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.

dag: O ni daa woligi Izraɛlnim bahi ka chɛ Juda zuliya saha shɛli maa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam leei bɛ naa. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yihi Izraɛlnim Yawɛ jɛmbu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi pam.
en: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord .

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tahima la ni zal li shɛm la puuni n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, who is an apostle of Jesus Christ by the command of God our savior and of Christ Jesus our hope.

dag: Di saha ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni dindali maa ka yɛli, Izraɛlnim yi ti yɛn suhi alibarika, bɛ ni zaŋla yi yuya suhi li. Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Naawuni chɛ ka yi be kaman Ifriim mini Manaasa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-zaŋ Ifriim leei toondana ka chɛ Manaasa.
en: So he blessed them that day, saying, The Israelites will use your names when they pronounce blessings. They will say, May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh. In this way Jacob put Ephraim before Manasseh.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya din niŋ maa ka paɣi Naawuni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla ŋun ka taali.
en: When the Roman officer saw what had happened, he praised God and said, Jesus must really have been a good man.

dag: Laligim ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la; di nyɛla din kariti niriba Naawuni sani tahiri katiŋa.
en: Keep away from profane and foolish discussions, which only drive people farther away from God.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam neesim titaŋa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who made the great lights— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Yaansi nyɛla ninkura jilima zuɣupiligu; ka bihi mi jilima nyɛ bɛ laamba.
en: Grandchildren are the pride and joy of old age, and children take great pride in their parents.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnim yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnima, ka zaŋ biŋkumda kumsi paɣ o.
en: Praise the Lord with harps. Yes, praise him with music from the harps.

dag: Yawɛ, tim naa maa nasara; ka garigi ti saha shɛli ti yi ti kuhi bol a.
en: Lord , save the king! Answer us when we call to you for help.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kpe Yaakubu suɣili ni n-yi nimaani kpe Liya suɣili ni, ka yi nimaani kpe dabipaɣiba ayi la suɣa ni, amaa ka bi nya shɛli di ni. Ka o daa yi Liya suɣili ni chaŋ ti kpe Reechɛl suɣili ni.
en: Laban went into Jacobs tent, Leahs tent, and her two servants tent and didnt find them. So he left Leahs tent and went into Rachels.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna Pailɛt yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: The soldiers led Jesus inside the courtyard of the fortress and called together the rest of the troops.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o wuni Nisirok jɛmbu duu jɛmd o, ka o bidibisi Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Later, while he was worshipping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with a sword. Then they escaped to the land of Ararat. His son Esarhaddon ruled after him.

dag: ka a kɔrigi piɛlaa maa, ka zaŋ o ʒim shɛli n-laɣi Aduna min o bidibisi maa nudiriti tib nyaɣa mini bɛ nudiriti nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti napombihilɔri, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Slaughter the ram. Take some of its blood and smear it on the right earlobes of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Throw the rest of the blood against all the altars sides.

dag: Amaa bia maa ŋun daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛm, kulla Jɔnatan mini Dauda n-daa mi di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: but he had no idea about what was going on. Only Jonathan and David knew.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋdila yi zuɣu; ka Naawuni daalibarika yi paari niriba pam n-kul pahira, di ni chɛ ka bɛ wumpaɣibo din tibigiri Naawuni gba kul pahira.
en: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: They made a screen for the entrance to the tent of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and fine twisted linen, decorated with needlework.

dag: n-nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ ti Naawuni ni ti Tiligira ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu mini nam jilima ni yiko ni fukumsi subu, dunia ŋɔ ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la mini pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: He is the only God, the one who saves us. To him be glory, greatness, power, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord for all time past, now, and forever. Amen.

dag: ka di chɛ ka so ku tooi lan da shɛli bee n-kɔhi shɛli, shee o malila dalinli din nyɛ biŋkɔbigu maa yuli bee namba din ʒe o yuli zaani la.
en: No one could buy or sell without this mark, that is, the beast's name or the number that stands for the name.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yaannim daa yi tin shɛŋa din dolina ŋɔ ni gba daa lab kuli: Bɛtilihɛm — kɔbiga ni pisinaata.
en: of Bethlehem.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo kpara m-mali shili zani Yawɛ tooni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pihinahi laasabu n-chaŋ Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: In the presence of the Lord about forty thousand men ready for war crossed over to the plain near Jericho.

dag: Amaa yinim ka la Ziɔn Zoli mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ tiŋ din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm m-be alizanda ni la ni malaikanim bɛn ka kalinli suhupiɛlli laɣiŋgu ni na;.
en: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ kurugu tahipɔŋ zali, ka di leei kurugu gooni a mini tiŋ maa sunsuuni. Ka a zaŋ a ninni kpa li, ka chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni teei gili shɛli, ka di nyɛ nyini n-teei gil li. Ka dimbɔŋɔ maa leei shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: Take an iron plate and set it up as an iron wall between you and the city. Face it directly. When it is under siege like this, press hard against it. This is a sign for the house of Israel.

dag: Ka Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Amaŋmaŋ yiɣisim ku ti. Dama doo ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ gba. Ka Gidiɔn daa yiɣisi ku Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka yihi bɛ laakumnim nyiŋgoya ni nachiinsi binyara.
en: What's the matter, Gideon? Zebah and Zalmunna asked. Do it yourself, if you're not too much of a coward! Gideon jumped up and killed them both. Then he took the gold ornaments from the necks of their camels.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Dauda Jɔab ni daa yɛl o ni o ti yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: The messenger went to David and reported everything Joab had told him.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ man yɛn maan pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi fiɛb ya! .
en: Tell them, My father placed heavy burdens on you; I will make them even heavier. He beat you with whips; I'll flog you with bullwhips.

dag: Ka bɛ biriginsim zuɣu yi chɛ ka dunianim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, ka bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli nyabu zuɣu mi yi chɛ ka bɛn pa Izraɛlnim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, dindina Izraɛlnim yi pahi bɛ zuɣu Naawuni daalibarika maa ni gari lala.
en: But if their failure brings riches to the world, and their defeat brings riches to the Gentiles, how much more will come from the completion of their number!.

dag: Dama Anabi Jona ni daa be zahim pul ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba ti yɛn be tiŋgban ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata.
en: Jonah was in the stomach of the big fish for three days and three nights. In the same way, the Son of Man will be in the grave three days and three nights.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnani zali bee m-mali binshɛli ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom puuni.
en: You must not make any idols. Dont make any statues or pictures of anything up in the sky or of anything on the earth or of anything down in the water.

dag: M-pahi Ogi ka diri Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi nam ni daa su luɣ shɛli zaa Bashan la. Bɛna ka Musa daa tuhi nyaŋ ka kari ba bahi la.
en: All the kingdom of King Og was in that land. King Og ruled in Bashan. In the past he ruled in Ashtaroth and Edrei. Og was from the Rephaites. In the past Moses had defeated those people and had taken their land.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ka boli ninvuɣ shɛb o ni bɔra, ka bɛ daa ka o sanna.
en: Jesus decided to ask some of his disciples to go up on a mountain with him, and they went.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka o ti miri kpibu. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Malim shili, dama a ku kpaŋ, a ni kpi. .
en: At that time Hezekiah became sick and almost died. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to see him and told him, The Lord says, You will die soon, so you should tell your family what they should do when you die. You will not get well.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun gba nyɛ yi ni yino ka nyɛ Yisa Masia tumtumda la puhiri ya. O kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo n-tiri ya ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani n-niŋ naani zaa Naawuni yubu tumbu puuni.
en: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.

dag: O bela nimaani lihiri bɔr o ni yɛn gbaai binshɛli di, di yi be haliya o nina ni nya li.
en: where they can look down to spot their next meal?.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔbil nin shɛli ni ti puhigi, ka Dauda daŋ ni niriba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaŋ di kom su n-yi alahichi mini buɣijɛmbo daɣiri ni.
en: When that time comes, says the Lord Almighty, a fountain will be opened to purify the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem from their sin and idolatry.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la min o tɔɣima la daa ʒiɛla kpaŋ ha tuhi siliga maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were there, sitting in front of the tomb.

dag: Shia Kasi maa n-nyɛ Shi so o ni daa zaŋ niŋ ti ni pam Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la zuɣu.
en: which God poured out upon us generously through Jesus Christ our savior.

dag: N yɛlila n suhu ni, Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so. Dinzuɣu n ni mali tahima o sani.
en: The Lord is all I have, and so in him I put my hope.

dag: N naɣ ni niŋla ŋ-ŋɔ: N ni wurim n kambɔna ŋɔ, ka taɣi me zaɣ kara n-zaŋ m bindira mini m binkparisi zaa niŋ di ni;.
en: Later, he said, Now I know what I'll do. I'll tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I can store all my grain and other goods.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: Do not worship any god except me.

dag: Ka o daa shiri kpi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o tizo Jɔram daa di nam zan o zaani, Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la nam dibu yuma ayi saha, dama Ahazia daa ka bidibiga.
en: Ahaziah died, just as the Lord had said. But since Ahaziah had no sons, Joram his brother then became king. This happened in the second year that Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ yaɣ shɛli polo katiŋa nti du n-tam zoli zuɣu ka o mini ba daa danigi tab pam.
en: David and Abishai crossed the valley and went to the top of the next hill, where they were at a safe distance.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋm o nina lihi ya, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: The LORD make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.

dag: Wummiya n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu la kuhigu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam, Yawɛ lan kala Ziɔn? Di Naa maa lan ka di ni.
en: Listen to the weeping of my people all across the land: Isnt the LORD in Zion? Is her king no longer there? Why then did they anger me with their images, with pointless foreign gods?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba alaka nyɛla bɛn turi ŋun nam ba, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nandaamba nirilim tir o la jilima.
en: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.

dag: Bɛ yi ti sibigi li sa, di ni baai? Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di ku kuui zaa, di ku kuui bɛ ni daa biri li luɣ shɛli maa? .
en: Will the plant grow where it is planted? No, the hot east wind will blow, and the plant will become dry and die. It will die there where it was planted.

dag: Ka Dauda yɛl o, Yɛlim ma din niŋ. Ka o yɛl o, Tɔbbihi maa ŋmaligimi guui, ka bɛ pam lu tɔb maa ni, ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan gba lu tɔb maa ni.
en: David asked him, Please tell me, who won the battle? The man answered, Our people ran away from the battle. Many of them were killed in the battle. Even Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.

dag: Ka sokam zaa nya li ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-niŋ li. Bɛ ni baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di niŋ maa.
en: so that they will see and know and observe and comprehend that the LORDs hand has done this, and the holy one of Israel has created it.

dag: Yawɛ n-sɔŋdi ba, ka fari ba bahira; ŋuna n-fari ba ka tiligiri ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; bɛ ni zɔrina nti sɔɣir o sani zuɣu.
en: He helps them and rescues them; he saves them from the wicked, because they go to him for protection.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa garigi yɛli, Ti ku nyu wain, dama ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛkab bia la daa yɛli ti ni ti mini ti bihi di nyu wain.
en: But they refused: We dont drink wine because our ancestor Jonadab, Rechabs son, commanded us, You and your children are never to drink wine.

dag: Dama ŋun nam a ni be a kaman paɣ yidan ni be o shɛm la. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ a tiligira ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la. O yuli n-lan nyɛ, dunia zaa Naawuni.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.

dag: Gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili ka chɛ ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: You must keep the Sabbath a special day like the Lord your God commanded.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ʒiri chi mini wɔrimɔri na nti tiri yuri mini tɔb wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam nayili maa kaman bɛ ni daa zali bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o niŋm shɛm.
en: Each brought their share of barley and straw for the horses and for the chariot horses, bringing it to its proper place.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Niriba bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled .

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I assure you, whoever believes has eternal life.

dag: Pɛrɛz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Perezs family: Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Ninvuɣ pia n-yi kpalim be yili yin ni, bɛ ni kpi.
en: At that time ten people in one house might survive, but they too will die.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Naa n-tim ma ni n ti niŋ shɛli ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka so baŋ timsim maa yɛla bee n ni tim a ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Amaa m mini nachimba bɛn chani maa, n wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn paai ma luɣ shɛli.
en: David answered Ahimelech the priest, The king has given me orders, but he instructed me, Dont let anyone know anything about the mission Im sending you on or about your orders. As for my troops, I told them to meet me at an undisclosed location.

dag: Kum yi mal a dimnima, nyin tim ba bindirigu ka bɛ di, ka kɔnyuri yi mali ba, nyin tim ba kom ka bɛ nyu;.
en: If your enemies are hungry, feed them; if they are thirsty, give them a drink.

dag: Ka o di yɛl a baŋsim ashili yɛtɔɣa! Dama baŋsim mali yaɣa pam. Baŋmi ni Naawuni ni darig a tibili shɛm ŋɔ bi paag a ni tum taali shɛm.
en: He would tell you there are many sides to wisdom; there are things too deep for human knowledge. God is punishing you less than you deserve.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa chaŋ Kɛila nti tuhi Filistianim maa n-ku ba pam, ka fa bɛ niɣi. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ fa Kɛilanim maa bahi.
en: David and his men went there and fiercely attacked the Philistines. They killed many of them, then led away their cattle, and rescued the people of Keilah.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Do so n-daa mal o bidibis ayi.
en: Jesus said, A certain man had two sons.

dag: Ka Rut daa chaŋ kabɔɣili maa ni nti shiri niŋ kaman o yidan ma maa ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So she went down to the threshing floor, and she did everything just as her mother-in-law had ordered.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli, paɣimiy o! Saŋmarisi bɛn nyaɣisiri zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sun and moon, praise God! All of you bright stars, praise God!.

dag: Yi niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ la shɛb zaa, yin zaŋmiya ba ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Di zaŋya yi naɣilabihi tuulinim tum tuma, yi mi di chɛnya yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb kɔbiri.
en: Set aside for the Lord your God all the first-born males of your cattle and sheep; don't use any of these cattle for work and don't shear any of these sheep.

dag: Naa, mani Aruna zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa ti a. Ka Aruna daa lan yɛli naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa.
en: All this, Your Majesty, Araunah gives to the king. Then he added, May the LORD your God respond favorably to you.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa gbaai piɛbil ŋun na mɔɣiri kɔrigi n-zaŋ o zaɣ muni nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ. Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa deei Samuɛl suhigu maa.
en: Samuel killed a young lamb and burned it whole as a sacrifice to the Lord . Then he prayed to the Lord to help Israel, and the Lord answered his prayer.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ nabihi naani.
en: Its far better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust any human leader.

dag: Ka Jɛshua bia Ɛzɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Mizipa naa la daa mali me gooni din be bɛ ni duri luɣ shɛli chani tɔb nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli gooni maa gɔŋbu shee tooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Next to him, Ezer, Jeshuas son, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section opposite the ascent to the armory at the Angle.

dag: n-zaŋ suɣilo gbib ba mɔɣu ni kaman yuun pihinahi;.
en: For about forty years, God put up with them in the wilderness.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n lee ni kuhi ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a ku wum? Bee ka n ni kuhi yɛl a Damli damiya! ka a ku tiligi ti?.
en: LORD, how long will I call for help and you not listen? I cry out to you, Violence! but you dont deliver us.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, N ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani ni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim alikauli shɛli maa shihirili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: As a sign of this everlasting covenant which I am making with you and with all living beings.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni nya suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli maa paai ma la n sɔŋsim zuɣu. A tiligi n nyɛvili barina kam ni; ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: Look, he indeed exchanged my bitterness for wholeness. You yourself have spared my whole being from the pit of destruction, because you have cast all my sins behind your back.

dag: Naa ni daa wum zaligu kundi yɛtɔɣa maa, o daa darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: When the king heard the book being read, he tore his clothes in dismay.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛri yɛlimaŋli dirila shɛhira maŋli, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralana ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: Good people speak the truth and can be trusted in court, but liars make bad witnesses.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka n yɛri pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. N ni nyɛ Naawuni ni tim tuun so bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani zuɣu ka m mali n tuma maa kuuna.
en: Now I am speaking to you people who are not Jews. I am an apostle to the non-Jewish people. So while I have that work, I will do the best I can.

dag: Ka Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana ka lan nyɛ Musa deemba la daa wum Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ti Musa mini Izraɛlnima ni Yawɛ ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti shɛm la yɛla.
en: Jethro, Moses father-in-law, was a priest in Midian. He heard about the many ways that God helped Moses and the Israelites. He heard about the Lord leading the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi nimaani m-bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra.
en: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were sitting there. They started wondering.

dag: N niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ alahichinima ka yɛra, Zaɣ biɛɣu ku niŋ ti shɛli bee m-paai ti la, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: All the sinners of my people will die by the sword, those who say, Evil wont overtake or meet us.

dag: Niriba ni yɛli a yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka n gba yɛli a ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: People will speak of your mighty deeds, and I will proclaim your greatness.

dag: Binshɛɣukam mali saha, ka yɛl shɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni malila di niŋbu saha.
en: Everything that happens in this world happens at the time God chooses.

dag: Dabisili din pah anii dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: The eighth day of this festival is a very special meeting for you. You must not do any work on that day.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Miriam shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: Remember, after all, what the LORD your God did to Miriam on your departure from Egypt!.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa neei, ka nya ka di nyɛla zahindi ka o zahim maa. Ka o daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti zani Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la tooni m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara, ka laɣim o kpambaliba zaa na ka bɛ ti puhi chuɣu.
en: Solomon awoke and realized it was a dream. He went to Jerusalem and stood before the chest containing the LORDs covenant. Then he offered entirely burned offerings and well-being sacrifices, and held a celebration for all his servants.

dag: Pa so n-yɛn yihi n nyɛvili maa, amaa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n yɛn zaŋ li sɔŋ. M mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ li sɔŋ, ka lan mali yiko din ni ti lan kpuɣ li yaha. M Ba ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: No one takes it from me, but I give it up because I want to. I have the right to give it up, and I have the right to take it up again. I received this commandment from my Father.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, Ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm maa. Ka yi ni doo kam daa zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ omaŋa, ka daa tɛhi ni zoya ni tiŋ maa ni chandi yɛn nyɛla asama.
en: Then you said, Moses, we sinned against the Lord , but now we will do what the Lord our God commanded us before—we will go and fight. Then each of you put on your weapons. You thought it would be easy to go and take the hill country.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛli Tama, Zaŋmi bindirigu maa kpɛhi n dugbɛrili puuni nti gbib li a nuu ni ka n di. Ka Tama daa zaŋ o ni mali mahi shɛŋa maa kpɛh o tizɔdoo Amnɔn dugbɛrili maa ni.
en: he said to Tamar, Serve the food in my bedroom. Tamar picked up the bread that she had made and brought it into Amnon's bedroom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbanbiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: They made two gold rings, and they attached them to the two edges of the chest pendant, on its inside edge facing the vest.

dag: M mabihi, lala n-nyɛ li. Yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu polo, yi ni nyɛ Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛl la zuɣu ni di chɛ ka yi tooi leei Masia ŋun daa neei kum ni la ni su shɛba din ni chɛ ka ti tum tuun suma ti Naawuni.
en: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, you also died with respect to the Law through the body of Christ, so that you could be united with someone else. You are united with the one who was raised from the dead so that we can bear fruit for God.

dag: Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni nimaani, ka salo maa zaa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it, while the crowd stood on the shore.

dag: Ka naa daa zaɣisi ninkura la yɛligu la, ka zaŋla halibiɛɣu yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi niriba maa.
en: The king ignored the advice of the older men and spoke harshly to the people.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, o kul kumdila pampam, ka nintam zo n-tiɛl o kparima. O mamanim la zaa so lan kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. O zɔnim zaa yila o nyaaŋa; bɛ leela o dimnima.
en: She weeps bitterly in the night, her tears on her cheek. None of her lovers comfort her. All her friends lied to her; they have become her enemies.

dag: Ka yi ti di bindir kura hal ni saha shɛli, ka yi ni ti kɔrigila bindir kura ka su zaɣ pala.
en: You will still be eating the previous years harvest when the time will come to clear it out to make room for the new!.

dag: dama o daa niŋ yɛda ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Naawuni ni tooi niŋ o ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛl la.
en: He was absolutely sure that God would be able to do what he had promised.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-chani zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi ni ka yɛra, Tinima m-be kpe ŋɔ, ti ni kuli Yawɛ ni lo ti alikauli ni ti kuli tin shɛl maa ni, ti tum alahichi.
en: Early the next morning the people started to go up to the high hill country. They said, We have sinned. We are sorry that we did not trust the Lord. We will go to the place that the Lord promised.

dag: O daa lan mali kpa shɛli din be kasi shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni, ka lan mali tulaale zim alali din nyom viɛla kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure sweet-smelling incense, mixed like perfume.

dag: Dindali maa Sool tumtumdib ni do so daa bela nimaani ni o mali maligu shɛli Yawɛ tooni, o daa nyɛla Ɛdom nira ka o yuli booni Doɛg, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Sool piɛgul kpɛma.
en: Now one of Sauls servants was there that day, detained in the LORDs presence. His name was Doeg. He was an Edomite and Sauls head shepherd.

dag: Manaasa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asiriɛl, o mam ŋun daa nyɛ Aram paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so, ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la.
en: Manassehs family: Asriel, to whom his Aramean secondary wife gave birth. She gave birth to Machir, Gileads father.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Shaaf ŋun daa nyɛ Madimanna ba la mini Shɛva ŋun daa nyɛ Makibɛna mini Gibia ba la. Kalɛb bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Akisa.
en: Maacah was also the mother of Shaaph and Sheva. Shaaph was Madmannahs father. Sheva was the father of Macbenah and Gibea. Calebs daughter was Acsah.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa n ni daa lihi ni di mali nyɔri la, n yipa lihi li ka di nyɛla yoli n sani Masia zuɣu.
en: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.

dag: Kaman chɛulɔnim ni kul gbibi punu ka di viini gindi shɛm la, lala ka vinnyaɣilan gba be o garo zuɣu.
en: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.

dag: Doo zabiri yi guhi, o nyɛla ŋun mali zuɣupalo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: If you lose your hair at the back or the front of your head, this does not make you unclean.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nya lala ka o suhu yiɣisi, ka o tabig o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi bahi.
en: You were the Lord 's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ guhirimi ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu. O bɔri ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul niŋdi din tuhi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani mal alibarika.
en: Nonetheless, the LORD is waiting to be merciful to you, and will rise up to show you compassion. The LORD is a God of justice; happy are all who wait for him.

dag: Dama n shiri ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ takɔbi ku a, amaa a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili zo n-tiligi, a ni niŋ ma naani la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will save you, Ebed Melech. You will not die from a sword, but you will escape and live. That will happen because you have trusted in me. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Yisifu o zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm. O daa yɛl o mi, Zahindi maa ni n sa nyami ka wain tia ʒe n tooni.
en: So the wine server told Joseph his dream. The server said, I dreamed I saw a vine.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei dari mali buɣim, ka yi ʒim ti kpe tiŋgban ni, ka so ku lan teei yi yɛla. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Fire will consume you, your blood will sink into the earth, and you will no longer be remembered. I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: dama o yuri ti zuliya ŋɔ hal ka me jɛmbu duu ti ti.
en: He loves our people and he built the synagogue for us.

dag: Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni o zuɣulaantab bɛn daa nyɛ tuumba, ka be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili ni la daa sabi gbaŋ tim Naa Darius sani.
en: This is the report that they sent to the emperor:.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Rɛfidim maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sinai tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: They marched from Rephidim and camped in the Sinai desert.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋ maa nim daa yɛli Jɔash, Yihim a bia maa na ka ti ku o. O ni wurim Baal bimbini, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi la zuɣu.
en: Then they said to Joash, Bring your son out here, so that we can kill him! He tore down the altar to Baal and cut down the symbol of Asherah beside it.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira pam paai ma, ka m mini kum bi lan wɔɣ ni taba.
en: My soul has had enough of this pain! I am ready to die.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima, o noli ni ka yɛm yɛtɔɣa yirina. Amaa ŋun ka yɛm yaaŋa deerila fiɛbiga.
en: Intelligent people talk sense, but stupid people need to be punished.

dag: ni Uzia ŋun daa nyɛ Ashitɛrat nir la ni Shama mini Jɛiɛl bɛn daa nyɛ Hɔtam Aroa nir la bihi la.
en: Uzzia the Ashterathite; Shama and Jeiel sons of Hotham from Aroer;.

dag: Ka Ozini daŋ niriba nyɛ Ozininima; ka Ɛri daŋ niriba nyɛ Ɛrinima;.
en: Ozni, Eri.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Gɔg ŋun be Magɔg tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ polo tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:.

dag: nti nya o yɛl o, Sokam kul lihiri bɔrila a shee.
en: They found him and said, Everyone is looking for you.

dag: Ti wum vuri zoya zuɣu. Di nyɛla Izraɛlnim fabila kuhigu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu. Bɛ tamla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.

dag: Lahibali suŋ din yi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni katiŋ na ŋmanila kɔnyuri ni yi wum nir ka o ti nya komahili la.
en: Finally hearing good news from a distant land is like a drink of cold water when you are dry and thirsty.

dag: O zuɣu nyɛla salima alali. O zabikpila kul gahirimi, ka sabigi kaman kahiŋkɔɣu la.
en: His face is bronzed and smooth; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.

dag: Bɛ ninani ni daa be shɛm m-bala. Bɛ kpiŋkpama daa yirigila zuɣusaa. Binneen yino kam daa malila kpiŋkpama ayiyi, ka di zaɣ yini chaŋ ti shih o kpee dini. Ka kpiŋkpama ayi din la pɔbi bɛ niŋgbuna.
en: Their wings were spread out over them. With two of the wings each living being reached out to touch the one near it, and with the other two wings it covered its body.

dag: Dama Naawunitali biɛhigu zaa be Masia daadamtali niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: I say this because all of God lives in Christ fully, even in his life on earth.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ mi bɛ yudua mini bɛ barikuma nyubu ni bɛ ʒiri tuma yɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, I know Moab gets angry quickly and brags about himself, but his boasts are lies. He cannot do what he says.

dag: Di kul shɛbisila tab ni hal ka pɔhim ku tooi kpe di sunsuuni gba.
en: They are so close to each other that no air can pass between them.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa galisi pam Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi pam kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi dari la.
en: King Solomon had so much silver that it was as common as rocks in Jerusalem. And he had so much cedar wood that it was as common as sycamore trees in the hill country.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa zuɣu ka ku kpihim bɛ taali maa. Dama Man Yawɛ bela Ziɔn.
en: I, the Lord , live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.

dag: ka dɔbba gba chɛ paɣiba golibu ka ŋmaligi doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri n-gɔndila bɛ dɔtaba, ka bɛ kɔr biɛri tuma maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari tibidarigibo din simdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: In the same way the men give up natural sexual relations with women and burn with passion for each other. Men do shameful things with each other, and as a result they bring upon themselves the punishment they deserve for their wrongdoing.

dag: A zali di tariga ni di di chaŋ yaɣi di zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka di ku lan tooi zo n-tiɛli dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.

dag: N ni ti kul yɛn niŋ niriba maa shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ maligumaaniba maa gba. N ni ti darigi bɛ tibili yo bɛ tuumbiɛri maa samli.
en: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋdi mahili niŋdi sagban tibisa ni, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri yiri sagbana maa ni na.
en: Lightning flashes from the clouds.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ku yɛligu maa o suhu ni, ka di bi dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim.
en: The seeds that fell among thorn bushes stand for those who hear the message; but the worries about this life and the love for riches choke the message, and they don't bear fruit.

dag: ka o daa tim o bia Hadɔram Naa Dauda sani ni o ti puh o ni o zuɣusuŋ, o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza maa zuɣu. Dama ŋun Tɔi mini Hadadɛza daa kul tuhirila taba waawaayili. Ka Tɔi daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya ti ti Dauda.
en: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to wish him well and to congratulate him over his battle and defeat of Hadadezer, because Tou was an enemy of Hadadezer. Hadoram brought with him all kinds of gold, silver, and bronze objects.

dag: Lɛvinim mi, Shɛmaya daa nyɛla Hashub bia, ka Hashub nyɛ Azirikam bia, ka Azirikam nyɛ Hashabia bia, ka Hashabia daa nyɛ Mɛrari bia.
en: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah, from Meraris family.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ni nyɛ daba ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni zaa daa zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Other nations took them as prisoners, but the Lord caused them to be kind to his people.

dag: N ni yo ba bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ tuumbiɛri maa samli ʒiibuyi zuɣu, dama bɛ zaŋ buɣa maligu nimdi na ti saɣim n tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka tum din chihira n ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni zaa.
en: I will make them pay double for their sin and wickedness, because they have defiled my land with idols that are as lifeless as corpses, and have filled it with their false gods.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: where the Lord said to them.

dag: Amaa zaligu palli ka n zaani ya ŋɔ; dina n-nyɛ, Yumiya taba! N ni yuri ya shɛm, yi gba yumiya tab lala.
en: I give you a new command: Love each other. You must love each other just as I loved you.

dag: Ka n ni ti be yi sani, ka ku lan zaɣisi ya.
en: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.

dag: Salo maa ni daa baŋ ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nir maa ka bɛ zaŋ kaman awa mun ayi n-duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: But when the people saw that Alexander was a Jew, they all began shouting the same thing. For two hours they continued shouting, Great is Artemis of Ephesus! Great is Artemis of Ephesus! Great is Artemis ....

dag: di yi pa lala a ni daa yihi ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na maa nim ni yɛli, Yawɛ ni kɔŋ ba zaŋ tahi o ni daa lo ba alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la zuɣu min o ni je ba zuɣu ka o yihi ba tahi tiŋgban nɛl ni ni o ti chɛ ka bɛ kpi.
en: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.

dag: ka kana ni nti chɛ ka a baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ a niriba dahin shɛli ha. Dahin shɛli ha yɛla ʒii m-bala.
en: But Ive come to help you understand what will happen to your people in the future, because there is another vision concerning that time.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣa; ka chɛ ka a ni daa kabisi n kɔb shɛŋa la mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Let me hear the sounds of joy and gladness; and though you have crushed me and broken me, I will be happy once again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti shiri nya ka buŋ maa lo so yiŋ samban ni sokpaŋa, ka bɛ lɔrig o.
en: They went and found a colt tied to a gate outside on the street, and they untied it.

dag: M bi yɛn pahi so zuɣu bee n-niŋ so naŋgban malisim.
en: I wont be partial to anyone, wont flatter a person.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini?.
en: Can worry make you live longer?.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali suhupiɛlli n zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ n san la nya filiŋ ka di vi.
en: Let all those who celebrate my misfortune be disgraced and put to shame! Let those who exalt themselves over me be dressed up in shame and dishonor!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me omaŋmaŋ ya o tiŋ maa ni, ka daa mali luɣ shɛli n-ti suɣili nimaani zali Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: David built houses for himself in the City of David. Then he built a place to put Gods Holy Box. He set up a tent for it.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔra kpahi n zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka ŋun ʒe yim saɣisi ma. Di chɛ ka m bo jilima ninvuɣ biɛɣu sani, dama n kul galindila bɛ tuumbiɛri maa n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba. Naawuni mi daa bi yɛli malaika so: Man Naawuni ni leeg a Ba, ka a mi leegi m Bia.
en: God never said this to any of the angels: You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. Psalm : God also never said about an angel, I will be his Father, and he will be my son. Samuel :.

dag: Amaa niriba maa galisiya pam ka saa mi miri pampam, ka ti ku tooi ʒe palo ŋɔ ni lala. Di mi pala dahin yini bee daba ayi tuuni n-nyɛ li, dama ti pam n-tum birigi yɛlli maa ni.
en: But there are many people, and its the rainy season; we cant continue to stand outside. Nor can this task be completed in a day or two because many of us have sinned in this matter.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ ti du Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka Abimilɛk ti zaŋ lɛhu ŋ-ŋma dabɔbili n-zaŋ li buɣi; ka yɛli bɛn be o sani, Yi ni nya ka n niŋ shɛm maa, yi gba niŋmiya lala yomyom.
en: so he went up to Mount Zalmon with his men. There he took an ax, cut a limb off a tree, and put it on his shoulder. He told his men to hurry and do the same thing.

dag: Ti mabihi, di gbarigiya tuun suma tumbu ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, dont get discouraged in doing what is right.

dag: N ni nyaŋ o dimnim ti o, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je o.
en: I will crush his foes and kill everyone who hates him.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila wɔhu chɛmi; ka piɛgul yɛtɔɣ ŋaha mi ŋmani kuriti kpa shɛŋa bɛ ni kpahi ka di kpaŋ zani.
en: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.

dag: Naawuni, fam ma ʒim yihibu taali ni bahi; nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ n zilinli yili yila pam yɛl a fa m-bahi maa yɛla.
en: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.

dag: O daa me li la goonda kpɛma, ka zali sapashin kpamba tinsi maa ni, ka daa me bindira kambɔna mini kpam ni wain ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni tinsi maa ni.
en: He made the fortifications stronger, placed commanders in them, and supplied them with food, oil, and wine.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ gunibu zaligu tin ya, amaa pa Anabi Musa sani ka di daa yina, yi yaannim sani ka di daa yina, hal ka yi gundi yi bidibbihi Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Moses ordered you to circumcise your sons , and so you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.

dag: La shɛli daa ʒe nimaani ka komihigu pali li, ka bɛ daa zaŋ gumdi tim di ni n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro gbab li n-zaŋ tiri ha n-niŋ o nol ni.
en: There was a jar full of sour wine there, so the soldiers soaked a sponge in it. They put the sponge on a branch of a hyssop plant and lifted it to Jesus mouth.

dag: Sabimi binshɛŋa a nini ni nya maa: Binshɛŋa din be mini binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: So write what you see. Write the things that happen now and the things that will happen later.

dag: Ka sala buɣimniɛm yiri neesim shɛli din be o sani maa ni na.
en: Out of the brightness before him, flashes of lightning came down.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ tan tolima anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: They joined five of the curtains to each other and joined the other five curtains to each other.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa teei Yisa yɛligu maa.
en: Then the women remembered his words.

dag: Ŋunkam bo n-nya yɛm nyɛla ŋun bɔri omaŋa, ka ŋunkam nyɛ tɛhi zilimalana nyɛla ŋun tɔŋda.
en: Be a friend to yourself; do all you can to be wise. Try hard to understand, and you will be rewarded.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu lomiya ania n-chɛ ka zaɣisuntali pahi yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka baŋsim pahi yi zaɣisuntali zuɣu.
en: Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding.

dag: Ka n daa wum bɛ ni tabili ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli, ka bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi bɛn nyɛ bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na:.
en: And I was told that the number of those who were marked with God's seal on their foreheads was . They were from the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina, ka chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: You must wash the internal organs and the hind legs, and the priest will present the sacrifice to the Lord and burn all of it on the altar. The odor of this food offering is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni daalibarika n-tim bɛn niŋdi ya alaka; chɛliya ba turi, ka kul suhimiyala Naawuni daalibarika tim ba.
en: Bless people who harass you—bless and dont curse them.

dag: Yawɛ yɛn zaŋla buɣim min o takɔbi n-darigi dunia ŋɔ niriba bɛn zaa mali taali tibili. O ni ti chɛ ka niriba pam kpi.
en: With fire and with sword the LORD will judge all humanity; many will be slain by the LORD.

dag: O daa suhi Naawuni, ka Naawuni daa wum o fabila ka deeg o suhigu maa, ka daa lan zaŋ o labisi Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ o nam maa ni yaha. Di saha ka Manaasa daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: The Lord listened to Manasseh's prayer and saw how sorry he was, and so he let him go back to Jerusalem and rule as king. Manasseh knew from then on that the Lord was God.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ kana ka kikaa na bi daai. Yubulus mini Pudɛns ni Linus ni Klɔdia zaŋ tabili ti mabihi bɛn kpalim la zaa puhir a.
en: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send their greetings, and so do all the other Christians.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, N ku leei yi naa; ka m bidibiga gba ku leei yi naa sun ya; Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi naa ŋun sun ya.
en: But Gideon told the Israelites, The Lord will be your ruler. I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni balind o ni o kam o yiŋ na.
en: Then a man named Jairus arrived; he was an official in the local synagogue. He threw himself down at Jesus' feet and begged him to go to his home.

dag: Amaa alahichinim ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din bi doya baalim, ka kul puɣiri lura n-ʒiri daɣiri mini yaɣiri kpɛhiri teeku ni la.
en: But evil people are like the restless sea, whose waves never stop rolling in, bringing filth and muck.

dag: N ni yihi ya zuliyanim maa ni mini tiŋgbɔna maa zaa ni n-zaŋ ya labisi yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: I will take you from the nations, I will gather you from all the countries, and I will bring you to your own fertile land.

dag: Di saɣimya Naawuni Shia Kasi suhu, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ so dalim ya n-wuhi ni dahin shɛli kanna ka o ni ti fan ya bahi zaa.
en: And dont make the Holy Spirit sad. God gave you his Spirit as proof that you belong to him and that he will keep you safe until the day he makes you free.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ba zalila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bɛ zoori ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: They are planted in the house of the Lord . They grow strong there in the courtyards of our God.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi ŋma nti ʒe sochira zuɣu n-gu ni yi gbahi bɛ ni shɛb bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la. Di mi daa bi simdi ni yi gbahi bɛn kpalim ti bɛ dimnima bɛ nandahima dabisili dali.
en: You should not have stood where the roads cross and destroyed those who were trying to escape. You should not have captured those who escaped alive.

dag: Pa ti min o tizɔpaɣiba zaa n-laɣim be ya ŋɔ ŋɔ? Ka ya polo ka doo ŋɔ lee bɔhim yɛla ŋɔ zaa.
en: Aren't all his sisters living here? Where did he get all this.

dag: Bɛ bi muɣiri taba, bɛ zaa dolila bɛ soya. Bɛ tooi gariti bɛ ni gu ba soli luɣ shɛli, ka binshɛli ku tooi taɣ ba zali.
en: They dont trip each other. Each soldier walks in his own path. If one of the soldiers is hit and falls down, the others keep right on marching.

dag: Daadam, dim a bindirigu ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira ka nyu kom ni dabiɛm, ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: Mortal man, he said, tremble when you eat, and shake with fear when you drink.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ti yi n-zani ni o zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii maligumaana so bee sariakarita so zali nimaani yɛligu maa, bɛn kum dilana. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: And whoever acts rashly by not listening to the priest who is in office serving the LORD your God or to the head judge will die. Remove such evil from Israel!.

dag: Bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la ni daa wum di gbinni ka di viɛl maa, ka o daa yɛli Yisifu, N gba sa zahimla zahindi. Bɔrɔbɔro piɛr ata n-sa tam n zuɣu ni.
en: When the chief cook saw that Joseph had given a good meaning to the dream, he told Joseph, I also had a dream. In it I was carrying three breadbaskets stacked on top of my head.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Abishai daa chaŋ tɔbbihi maa sani yuŋ, ka Sool ti dola sansani maa sunsuuni gbihiri ka o kpani sa o zuɣusaa, ka Abinɛr mini tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: That same night, David and Abishai crept into the camp. Saul was sleeping, and his spear was stuck in the ground not far from his head. Abner and the soldiers were sound asleep all around him.

dag: Tim ma baŋsim, ka n gbib a zaligu, ka dol li ni n suhu zaa.
en: Help me understand so I can guard your Instruction and keep it with all my heart.

dag: M mi Ifriim, ka Izraɛlnim pala bɛn ni sɔɣi ka n ku nya ba. Dama Ifriimnima, pumpɔŋɔ yi tum yolimyolim. Ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.

dag: o yi baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛl maa, ŋun bom bunyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli m-mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: once the sin they committed is made known to them—they must bring as their offering a flawless female goat because of the sin that was committed.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn lola yi mini yi zuliya.
en: I now make my promise to you and to your people who will live after you.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, N ni va m biɛli val shɛli din kpɛm pam la zuɣu ka n di nasara ŋɔ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Naftali.
en: Rachel said, I have fought hard to compete with my sister, and I have won. So she named that son Naphtali.

dag: Hal ka bia maa daa ti bɔri ni o dirila kuruchunim maa bindira maa shɛli, dama so daa bi tir o bindirigu.
en: He longed to eat his fill from what the pigs ate, but no one gave him anything.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa chaŋ Giliad mini Kadɛshi din be Hitinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti yi nimaani chaŋ Dan n-yi Dan zaŋ goligi Sidɔn polo.
en: Then they went east to Gilead, all the way to Tahtim Hodshi. Then they went north to Dan Jaan and around to Sidon.

dag: Di saha maa Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ anabi, ka nyɛ Lapidɔt paɣ la n-daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: There was a woman prophet named Deborah. She was the wife of a man named Lappidoth. She was judge of Israel at that time.

dag: Ka Midiannim maa daa zaŋ Yisifu chaŋ Ijipti nti kɔhi Pɔtifa ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm zuɣu.
en: Meanwhile, in Egypt the Midianites had sold Joseph to Potiphar, one of the king's officers, who was the captain of the palace guard.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yi Paran mɔɣu ni chaŋ. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: So Moses sent them out from the Paran desert according to the LORDs command. All the men were leaders among the Israelites.

dag: Gban shɛli Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa sabi ti Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni gbansabira ni baŋda so ŋun daa mi Yawɛ zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ o ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Ezra was a priest and teacher. He knew much about the commands and laws the Lord gave Israel. This is a copy of the letter King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the teacher:.

dag: Ka paɣ bundan maa daa ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni do so ŋun doli yiri ti sanna waawaayili ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: Some time later the woman said to her husband, I'm sure the man who comes here so often is a prophet of God.

dag: fɔntiŋ kara mini fɔndi zaa din baɣi Ashidɔd la m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: and all the cities and towns near Ashdod, from Ekron to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Tinzunnim kanna ti damdiri ma la tiŋa. Bɛ yi kul wum ka n yɛli shɛlikam, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: They obey and come crawling.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul yɛri lala maa, ka sagbani dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam bɛ ni kpe sagbani maa ni maa zuɣu.
en: While Peter was still speaking, a shadow from a cloud passed over, and they were frightened as the cloud covered them.

dag: Ka Jɔn garigi yɛli, Kom ni ka man baptaiziri niriba; amaa so ʒe yi sani kpe, ka yi bi mi o.
en: John told them, I use water to baptize people. But here with you is someone you don't know.

dag: Ka tɔb shɛli daa ti lan lu bɛ sunsuuni Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni. O daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka di zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim maa zuliya ni na.
en: In another battle at Gath, there was a huge man who had six fingers on his hands and six toes on his feet, twenty-four in all. He too was descended from the Raphah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulinluhili polo na nti ʒe toli maa ti niŋ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi lan kpalim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the Lord sent a strong west wind that swept the locusts into the Red Sea. Not one locust was left anywhere in Egypt.

dag: Piligu ni, Naawuni daa namla zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

dag: Jɔab n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya la mi daa su Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim fukumsi.
en: Joab was in command of the army of Israel; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was in charge of David's bodyguards;.

dag: Nyam n wahala ŋɔ, ka tiligi ma, dama m bi tam a zaligu yɛla.
en: Look at my suffering and rescue me. I have not forgotten your teachings.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti wum li, dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan tum zaɣ biɛɣu lala tatabo yaha.
en: All Israel will hear about this and be afraid. They wont do that sort of evil thing among you again.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣisi ninvuɣ so mali suhupiɛlli. Dinzuɣu miri ka a ʒiɛm Kpiɔŋlan Naa saɣisigu.
en: Happy is the person whom God corrects! Do not resent it when he rebukes you.

dag: Nir yi bɔri ni o mali binshɛli n-zaŋ ti pini, o bɔrila da shɛli din bi dura n-zaŋ ti tuumbaŋda ka o mal li zali ka di ku lu.
en: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face.

dag: Chɛ ka teeku mini di puuni binshɛɣukam zaa ŋum; ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, ka so daa kani n-nyɛ dabili bee bilichina ka bi nya nahiŋgu ŋɔ; ka so mi daa kani din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord saw that all the Israelites, both slaves and free men, had many troubles. No one was left who could help Israel.

dag: dindina niriba bɛn zaŋm zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm kpe ninvuɣ kura maa mini ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kubo biɛri maa sunsuuni m-mal li.
en: then the community must come to a verdict between the killer and the close relative in accordance with these case laws.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee n-zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: But some seeds fell in good soil, and the plants bore grain: some had one hundred grains, others sixty, and others thirty.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ti ku lan beni, ka sagbana ti kpabikpabi kaman sɔŋ la; ka saŋmarisi ti luna kaman wain tia vari la bee kaman fiig tia wala ni suuri luri shɛm la.
en: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti laɣim o tɔbbihi m-pahi nanim pihitanaayi bɛn ʒe o nyaaŋa ni bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi n-kana ti liri Samarianima n-teei gili ba ni bɛ tuhi ba.
en: King Ben-Hadad of Aram gathered his army together. There were kings with him and many horses and chariots. They surrounded Samaria and attacked it.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni, ka ti yi yuri taba Naawuni ni be ti ni ka o yurilim ni niŋ dɛde ti ni.
en: No one has ever seen God. If we love each other, God remains in us and his love is made perfect in us.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka tin yin nim bee yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ tiŋ maa bee bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: Jesus knew what the Pharisees were thinking. So he said to them, Every kingdom that fights against itself will be destroyed. And every city or family that is divided against itself will not survive.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ka nimaani na, bɛ ni yihi binyoya mini binshɛŋa din chihiri la zaa di ni.
en: They will enter the land, and they will remove from it all its disgusting and detestable things.

dag: O daa bi baŋ ni mani n-tir o kawana mini wain ni kpam ni anzinfa ni salin shɛli bɛ ni mali jɛmdi Baal la.
en: She would never acknowledge that I am the one who gave her the grain, the wine, the olive oil, and all the silver and gold that she used in the worship of Baal.

dag: Yi kul ni kpalim bela Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol maa ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ tumdi Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm hal ni daba ayopɔin, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama Yawɛ n-zali ma lala.
en: You must stay at the entrance of the Tent day and night for seven days, doing what the Lord has commanded. If you don't, you will die. This is what the Lord has commanded me.

dag: Dimiya binnɛɔŋ kam. N ni zaŋ ʒiɛvari tin ya shɛm lala ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa tin ya.
en: In the past, I gave you the green plants to eat. Now every animal will also be food for you. I give you everything on earth—it is yours.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya: Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: All of these were Caleb's descendants. Hur, the oldest son of Caleb and Ephrath, had three sons: Shobal, Salma, and Hareph, who settled the town of Beth-Gader.

dag: Dama nyini ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni a ni chɛ ka n zuliya yɛligi. Dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a ŋɔ.
en: My God, you spoke to me, your servant. You made it clear that you would make my family a family of kings. That is why I am being so bold—that is why I am asking you to do these things.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋariti taba, amaa zomiya yi Naawuni, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not cheat an Israelite, but obey the Lord your God.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋ zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim la tiŋgbana tin ya ni di leei yi dini m-pahi n ni pun nyaŋ zuliya shɛba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku wulinluhili polo la.
en: I have assigned as the possession of your tribes the land of the nations that are still left, as well as of all the nations that I have already conquered, from the Jordan River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ noya ni; bɛ suhuri kul yula saɣiŋgu. Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbal kaba, ka bɛ lan mali naŋgban malisim.
en: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.

dag: Naawuni n-nam zuɣusaa n-teei li pa. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Ŋuna n-ti ninsalinim zaa nyɛvili ni vuhim. Ka pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa yɛl o dabili.
en: God created the heavens and stretched them out; he fashioned the earth and all that lives there; he gave life and breath to all its people. And now the Lord God says to his servant.

dag: O suhu kpɛmmi kaman kuɣili la, di kpɛmmi kaman nɛli la.
en: and its heart is stone.

dag: Ka Aduna zaŋ Lɛvinim maa zali Yawɛ tooni kaman Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahi zuɣusaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi tum Yawɛ tuma.
en: and then Aaron shall dedicate the Levites to me as a special gift from the Israelites, so that they may do my work.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Naa. Di yi niŋ nyin Naa nyaɣisim, ka a yu ni a niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim, n suhir a ni a timmi ma Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛli ni la ka n ti lab me li zali.
en: Then I answered the king, If it would please the king, and if I have been good to you, please send me to Jerusalem, the city in Judah where my ancestors are buried. I want to go there and rebuild that city.

dag: Bee a ʒiɛmla Naawuni nirilim din galisi min o nambɔzɔbo ni o suɣilɔdibo la? A bi mi ni din chɛ ka Naawuni niŋd a nirilim maa nyɛla o bɔrimi ni a niŋ tuuba?.
en: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tin ya ko mahim biɛla yi ni nyɛ Masia nyaandoliba la zuɣu, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: I assure you that anyone who gives you a drink of water because you belong to me will certainly receive a reward.

dag: Bashan Zoli din galisi, Bashan Zoli din mali chunchuna pam.
en: Mighty mountain, Mount Bashan; many-peaked mountain, Mount Bashan!.

dag: Luk . Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anab kura la ni yino ŋun neei kum ni na.
en: They answered, John the Baptist, others Elijah, and still others that one of the ancient prophets has come back to life.

dag: Nandaamba yi kuhira ka a baɣa kani, a gba ni ti kuhira ka so ku wum.
en: Those who close their ears to the cries of the poor will themselves call out but receive no answer.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ninvuɣ biɛri yɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri gba je wuntizɔriba yɛlli.
en: The righteous hate the wicked, and the wicked hate the righteous.

dag: Bɛ ni niŋ shɛli naani ka yaa, di ŋmanila kpatinariga yili.
en: They have put their trust in something weak. It is like a spiders web.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, bɛ nyarila vuhim bɛ kum maa puuni.
en: but in death they find peace for obeying God.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Jɔab, dama Jɔab daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe Adɔnija nyaaŋa hal o ni daa bi ʒe Absalom ŋun nyaaŋa la zaa yoli. Ka ŋun Jɔab daa zo n-chaŋ Yawɛ Jɛmbu Duu nti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Now the news reached Joab because he had supported Adonijah, though he hadnt supported Absalom. Joab ran to the LORDs tent and grabbed the horns of the altar.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Nyamiya, Yawɛ bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: Then Moses said to the Israelites: Look, the LORD has chosen Bezalel, Uris son and Hurs grandson from the tribe of Judah.

dag: N ni ti yihi n jilima palo ni zuliya kam sani, ka zuliya kam ti nya n ni kari saria shɛli ŋɔ mini n ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm maa.
en: The Lord said, I will let the nations see my glory and show them how I use my power to carry out my just decisions.

dag: Dauda ʒiɛman maa ni kum daa ti lu yuma ata doli taba. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ din tahi li. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Ninsalinim ʒim yihibu taali n-ʒi Naa Sool min o daŋ zuɣu, dama o daa ku Gibiɔnnima.
en: There was a famine for three years in a row during Davids rule. David asked the LORD about this, and the LORD said, It is caused by Saul and his household, who are guilty of bloodshed because he killed the people of Gibeon.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ŋmaai palo shɛli din dolisi luɣ kasi yaɣili la ti Izraɛlnima ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntiŋa. Di wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili. Di ni ti nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni su shɛli.
en: Next to the holy area, another section, miles long and miles wide, is to be set aside for a city where any of the people of Israel may live.

dag: Di ni ti leei dabari m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din pun leei dabari sunsuuni, ka di fɔntinsi ni ti pahi fɔntin shɛŋa din pun lu n-dahim ni.
en: Your nation of Egypt will be the most deserted place on earth, and its cities will lie in complete ruin.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul zɔrimi hal so yi bi kariti doli ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la.
en: The wicked are afraid of everything, but those who live right are as brave as lions.

dag: O chɛ ka n niŋgbuŋ nya wahala, ka kabi n kɔba.
en: He wore out my flesh and skin. He broke my bones.

dag: ka yɛl o, Cham Sailom biaŋ ni ti paɣ a nina maa. Ka o chaŋ ti paɣ o nina maa, ka di dii neei, ka o labina.
en: Jesus told him, Go and wash in Siloam pool. So the man went to the pool, washed and came back. He was now able to see.

dag: Yuun pisi zaa ka m be a yiŋa. N tum tuma ti a la yuun pinaanahi a bipuɣins ayi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka gul a biŋkɔbiri mi yuma ayɔbu; ka a taɣi n yɔri siɣimsiɣim bupia.
en: It was like that for the whole twenty years I was with you. For fourteen years I worked to win your two daughters—and six years for your flocks. And even then, you changed my wages ten times.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na. Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to receive from them his share of the harvest. But the tenants beat the slave and sent him back without a thing.

dag: Dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita.
en: A little yeast works through the whole lump of dough.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Baruk, Bɛ bi lan saɣi ni n kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then I gave Baruch the following instructions: I am no longer allowed to go into the Temple.

dag: O daa gbimi vuɣi kuɣa nimaani, ka bo ti viɛla na ti sa nimaani; ka sa gara zali puu maa sunsuuni, ka mali wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili sɔŋ di ni. O daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, amaa ka di ti walila wal biɛri.
en: He dug and cleared the field and planted the best grapevines there. He built a tower in the middle and cut a winepress into the stone. He expected good grapes to grow there, but there were only rotten ones.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam! A viɛlim maa yaɣimi gba! A nina bemi kaman ŋmana la a sariga ni. A zabiri kul yɛbisirimi kaman bu bɔbigu ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli shɛm la.
en: Look at you—so beautiful, my dearest! Look at you—so beautiful! Your eyes are doves behind the veil of your hair! Your hair is like a flock of goats as they stream down Mount Gilead.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiya n dan naa ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla pali, mmaŋmaŋ zaŋ tabili n ni mali shɛlikam nyɛla o dini.
en: Your Majesty, Ahab replied, everything I have is yours, including me.

dag: Dama a Duuma saɣisirila o ni yuri so, ka fiɛbiri o ni zaŋ so leeg o bia.
en: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shihi bia maa bee n-niŋ o shɛli; dama pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni a shiri zɔri Naawuni hal ka bi mɔŋ o a bigaŋ ŋɔ.
en: The angel said, Dont kill your son or hurt him in any way. Now I can see that you do respect and obey God. I see that you are ready to kill your son, your only son, for me.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, Mani ŋun nyɛ taŋkpaɣu ni tampiligim ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni tɔɣisiri n Duuma yɛtɔɣa.
en: Abraham spoke again: Please forgive my boldness in continuing to speak to you, Lord. I am only a man and have no right to say anything.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Anabi Musa litaafinima, chinchini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha;.
en: Even today, whenever Moses is read, a veil lies over their hearts.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Filistianim poli pɔi ka Firawuna daa naanyi ti liri Gazanima m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Before the king of Egypt attacked Gaza, the Lord spoke to me about Philistia.

dag: Bɛ yihiri waazu yɛra ma, Di yihiri waazu. Di yihiri waazu yɛri binyara ŋɔ yɛla; vi ku di ti.
en: They mustnt preach! so they preach. They mustnt preach of such things! Disgrace wont overtake us.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord s message to me also said.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa chaŋ ti gbahi ŋɔri kɔbisita n-zaŋ bɛ zuya gbin taba ka zaŋ buɣim mokpala shɛbisishɛbisi di gbina maa ni.
en: So he went and caught three hundred foxes. Two at a time, he tied their tails together and put torches in the knots.

dag: N ni yi be bɛ sani maa, n yi gbib ba la a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu. N kul gbib ba viɛnyɛliŋga hal ka bɛ ni yino bi bɔrigi naɣila bahi yoli bia la ni di chɛ ka nyin Naawuni yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power of your name—the name you gave me. I protected them. And only one of them was lost—the one who was sure to be lost. This was to show the truth of what the Scriptures said would happen.

dag: Bɛ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu lu o zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun yɛn fiɣis o zan o nudirigu polo.
en: My enemies said, Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayɔbu yuya ni pa kuɣ yini zuɣu, ka niriba ayɔbu la mi yuya pa kuɣ din la zuɣu, ka a ti chɛ ka di ti doli bɛ kpamli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: in the order of their birth, with six on one stone and six on the other.

dag: Ka o bidibiga Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam n-zan o zaani, ka daa mali shili gu Izraɛlnima.
en: Jehoshaphat succeeded his father Asa as king and strengthened his position against Israel.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o kpe salo maa ni, amaa ka nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba daa bi saɣi.
en: Paul himself wanted to go before the crowd, but the believers would not let him.

dag: yɛra, Yawɛ yi di daa chɛ ka ti kpi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di daa naan so, dama ti daa nyari nimdi ŋubira, ka diri bindira ti yubu, amaa yi zaŋ ti mi na ti bahi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ni yi chɛ ka kum ku ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: and said to them, We wish that the Lord had killed us in Egypt. There we could at least sit down and eat meat and as much other food as we wanted. But you have brought us out into this desert to starve us all to death.

dag: Tinzunnima, Laɣimmiya, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Tin shɛŋa din be katinsinima, wummiya. Lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Iin, lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm shiri mali ya.
en: Unite yourselves, peoples, and be shattered! Listen, all distant places of the earth! Prepare to be shattered! Prepare to be shattered!.

dag: N ni tum jɛrilim zuɣu chɛ ka n dansi maa yuma niŋla yu biɛri, ka nyo pam.
en: I did a foolish thing, and now I have infected sores that stink.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ka n naɣ zaŋ niŋ n suhu ni, dinzuɣu ka m mali tahima:.
en: I call all this to mind—therefore, I will wait.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka mahim tirisi yaɣi dunɔdura shɛŋa Ahaz ni daa me la dura pia zuɣu lab nyaaŋa. Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri tirisi lab nyaaŋa dunɔdura pia maa.
en: On the stairway built by King Ahaz, the Lord will make the shadow go back ten steps. And the shadow moved back ten steps.

dag: Nyini n-su zuɣusaa, ka su tiŋgbani gba; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, nyini n-daa nam li.
en: Heaven is yours! The earth too! The world and all that fills it— you made all of it! North and south—you created them!.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi la daa zani nam ʒiishee la mini binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la tooni n-yili yil palli. Ka so daa naan ku tooi bɔhim yilli maa m-pahila bɛn bɛn daa tiligi dunia ni la kɔŋko.
en: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the , who had been rescued from the earth.

dag: Ka Hilikia daa yɛli Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la, N nyala zaligu kundi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni; ka o daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan.
en: He said to Shaphan, I have found the book of the Law here in the Temple. He gave Shaphan the book.

dag: Bɛ yaala bɛ noya gu ma. Bɛ bemi kaman gbuɣinli ŋun bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma, ka ŋumdi la.
en: They open their mouths at me like a lion ripping and roaring!.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim maa jilima la ni ti kpaai kaman fiig tihi walibu saha tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu ni yi luna ka bɛ pihi li, ka di nuu ni paabu n-to ka bɛ pun di li la.
en: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tim Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ puuni gari chaŋ Pamfilia.
en: Paul and Barnabas went through the country of Pisidia. Then they came to the country of Pamphylia.

dag: Ka Musa daa silim o zuɣu tiŋ yomyom n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: At once Moses bowed to the ground and worshipped.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bahiyoli bina anahi lu bɛ zuɣu. Tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba, ka bahi vu ba chaŋ, ka juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri tɔhi ba vali.
en: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ gili Ifriim zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya tiŋgban ni tinsi zaa n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni, amaa ka niriba maa daa lari ba, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: So the runners went from town to town in Ephraim and Manasseh, all the way to Zebulun. But they were laughed at and made fun of.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ mi ni daa nyu tibidarigibo binnyur shɛli zoli din be kasi zuɣu shɛm la, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya la zaa gba ni nyu li. Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti chani jeena, ka leei bɛn be kaman bɛn kani.
en: You spilled blood on my holy mountain, so other nations will spill your blood. You will be finished. It will be as if you never existed.

dag: bɛ kpiŋkpama maa daa shihirila taba. Bɛ daa yi ti chana, bɛ zaɣ yino kam kul tuhimi chani tooni ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: their wings touched each others wings. When they moved, they each went straight ahead without turning.

dag: ni Jɛdiayɛl min o mabia Jɔha bɛn daa nyɛ Shimri Tizi nir bihi la.
en: Jediael son of Shimri and his brother Joha the Tizite;.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa kaman Naa Ahaz ni daa be Damaskus ka tim ti wuh o shɛm zaa la. Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa naai pɔi ka Naa Ahaz naanyi yi Damaskus kuna.
en: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.

dag: O daa nyɛla Pɛrɛz yaaŋa, ka daa nyɛ ŋun su tɔbbi kpamba zaa fukumsi goli tuuli maa ni.
en: He was a Perezite and the head of all the army officers for the first month.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ o, ka daa tim anabi o sani ka o ti yɛl o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a jɛmdi tinzun buɣ shɛŋa din daa bi tooi tiligi dimaŋmaŋ niriba a nuu ni la.
en: This made the Lord angry, so he sent a prophet to Amaziah. The prophet demanded, Why have you worshiped foreign gods that could not even save their own people from your power.

dag: Yisa daa ti be soli n-chani Jɛrusalɛm ka daa ti zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi la yi kpaŋa nti yɛli ba.
en: As Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem, he took his twelve disciples aside and told them in private:.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so leei niriba maa toondana.
en: Lord , you are the God who knows what people are thinking. I pray that you will choose a leader for these people.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali yi sara maa ti yi Naawuni maa yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then the king called for Moses and Aaron and said, Go and offer sacrifices to your God here in this country.

dag: Ka o neei tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa zuɣu ka yɛli teeku maa, Fom baalim! Ka sanʒiɛɣu maa daa chɛ ʒɛbu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: Jesus stood up and gave a command to the wind and the water. He said, Quiet! Be still! Then the wind stopped, and the lake became calm.

dag: A yi zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali Yawɛ tooni, Izraɛlnim bɛn zaŋm bɛ nuhi pa Lɛvinim maa zuɣu.
en: Bring the Levites before the Lord . The Israelites will put their hands on them.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba dabisi shɛŋa din kanna puuni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ tɛha ni. .
en: When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn chaŋ, bɛ ni tooi chaŋ luɣa anahi maa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi. Amaa tooni kalinli maa daa yi kul kpa shɛli polo, kalima maa zaa doli li mi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: They could go in any direction when they moved, but the Cherub angels did not turn around when they moved. They went in the direction that the head was looking. They did not turn around when they moved.

dag: Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni su zuliya shɛb chana. Di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ nimaani.
en: This is where the tribes come, the tribes of Israel, to give thanks to the Lord according to his command.

dag: A ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim neesim din ni kahig a soli wuhi ba, ka duh a niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: He is a light to show your way to the other nations. And he will bring honor to your people Israel.
