dag: Bɛ gbinni nyaɣa kuuya, ka bɛ zuɣusaa wula kpi.
en: Their roots and branches are withered and dry.

dag: Amaa binneembihi bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali naba anahi chana, ka lan tom mali gbaya pahi m-mal li tɔri tiŋ yiɣira.
en: But you may eat insects if they have legs with joints above their feet so that they can jump.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, M min a ku labi, dama a zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu, ka Yawɛ gba zaɣisi ni a ku lan nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: But Samuel said to Saul, I wont go back with you. You rejected the Lord s command, and now the Lord rejects you as king of Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zaɣ biɛɣu ni lu lala nir zuɣu libig o n-tum o barina saha biɛla puuni ka di ka yɛtɔɣa.
en: Therefore, sudden disaster will come upon them; they will be quickly broken beyond healing.

dag: N ni zaŋ a kuli m ma yiŋa, n ni zaŋ a ti kpɛhi ŋun daa dɔɣi ma du gbɛrili ni. N ni ti a wain viɛlli mini m pumpɔrinchihi wala kom ka a nyu.
en: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim Izraɛlnim bɛ wahala zaa ni.
en: Please, God, save Israel from all its troubles!.

dag: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba ni Lɛvinima ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi tinsi ni ti puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Enjoy yourselves at this festival—you, your sons, your daughters, all your servants, and the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows living in your towns.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zuɣu. Chɛliya ka dunia zaa baŋ di yɛla.
en: Sing to the Lord because of the great things he has done. Let the whole world hear the news.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A nya Izraɛlnim bɛn ka ba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm, bɛ ni daa chaŋ daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini ti niŋ zina shɛm bebɔ?.
en: When Josiah was king, the Lord said to me, Have you seen what Israel, that unfaithful woman, has done? She has turned away from me, and on every high hill and under every green tree she has acted like a prostitute.

dag: Zomiya ti soli zuɣu, ka di guriya ti soli. Di lan tɔɣisiriya ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa yɛla.
en: Get out of our way and stop blocking our path. We don't want to hear about your holy God of Israel.

dag: n-ti Gibiɔnnim maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ti ku ba zoli maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa laɣim kpi. Puu atam kpuɣibu saha, kachɛɣu piligu ni ka bɛ daa ku ba maa.
en: and he handed them over to the Gibeonites. They hanged them on the mountain before the LORD. The seven of them died at the same time. They were executed in the first days of the harvest, at the beginning of the barley harvest.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka Jɔn Baptaizira sanna ka Jɔn ti baptaiz o Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: About that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee, and John baptized him in the Jordan River.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye yurilim zuɣu, ka bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina, di bahi bamdi anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini.
en: Pursue love, and use your ambition to try to get spiritual gifts but especially so that you might prophesy.

dag: Niriba maa zaa ni, ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka nyɛ gɔbisinima daa be bɛ ni. Bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino kam daa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi zaŋ kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni n-lab ninsal zabigu gba ka ku nyahigi li.
en: There were also trained soldiers who were trained to fight with their left hand. Each one of them could use a sling with great skill. They all could use a sling to throw a stone at a hair and not miss!.

dag: N fabili yi zuɣu gari n ni fabindi Jazanim zuɣu shɛm. Yinim Sibimanima, yi ŋmanila wain tia din wula baai du teeku n-zo hal ti paai Jaza. Ŋun saɣindi la lu yi siɣili saha tiwala mini yi wain tiwala zuɣu.
en: I will cry for the people of Sibmah, even more than for the people of Jazer. City of Sibmah, you are like a vine whose branches reach across the Dead Sea and go as far as Jazer. But now your summer fruits and your grapes have been destroyed.

dag: Ti mabihi, di kpala talahi ni ti kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam. Di tuhiya ni ti niŋ lala, dama yi yɛda kul zoorimi, ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab sani gba kul zoori pahira.
en: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.

dag: Salima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtilihɛm ŋun daa lan nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la mini Atirɔtibɛtijɔab ni Manahatinim pirigili ni Zɔrinima.
en: Salma, the founder of Bethlehem, was the ancestor of the people of Netophath, of Atroth Beth Joab, and of the Zorites, who were one of the two clans in Manahath. .

dag: Yawɛ tooni, dama o kanna. O kanimina ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O mi yɛn zaŋla wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli kari niriba saria.
en: before the LORD because he is coming! He is coming to establish justice on the earth! He will establish justice in the world rightly. He will establish justice among all people fairly.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ dabindi niŋ n sara maligu ʒim ni, yi mi di chɛ ka Yaɣigari chuɣu sara nimdi zani kaai biɛɣu.
en: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.

dag: Naŋgbankpeeni maa ni daa mali ti mooi nini saha shɛli ka sapashin kpɛm maa zɔri ni bɛ ti bu Pool n-chɛrisi o nimdi gari taŋkpaɣu ni zuɣu daa chɛ ka o yɛli tɔbbihi ni bɛ cham ti fa Pool bɛ sani n-zaŋ o tahi bɛn tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee.
en: The argument became fierce, and the commander was afraid that Paul would be pulled apart. So he ordered the soldiers to go in and rescue Paul. Then they took him back into the fortress.

dag: nti yi ŋariŋ ni nimaani chaŋ Filipai din daa nyɛ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinzuɣu ka Romnim su li la. Ka ti daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: From there we went to Philippi, which is a Roman colony in the first district of Macedonia. We spent several days in Philippi.

dag: Piligu ni, zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini n-daa be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛ yɛtɔɣ yinsi.
en: There was a time when the whole world spoke one language. Everyone used the same words.

dag: Di yi pa lala ŋuni n-lee ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ʒirilana, ka wuhi ni n ni yɛli shɛm maa kani.
en: Can anyone deny that this is so? Can anyone prove that my words are not true?.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa darigi toog o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu so o shee ni n-kum o bia maa kuli dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put a simple mourning cloth around his waist, and mourned for his son for many days.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la yɛliya: N wum a kumsi maa, ka deeg a suhigu maa. N ni pah a yuun pinaanu.
en: to go back to Hezekiah and say to him, I, the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will let you live fifteen years longer.

dag: Ka o daa tim Abimilɛk sani Aruma nti yɛl o, Nyama, Ɛbɛd bia Gaal la min o dɔɣiriba kala Shɛkɛm na nti wuhiri Shɛkɛmnim yikombiɛlim soya zaŋ kpa a polo.
en: Zebul sent messengers to Abimelech in the city of Arumah. This is the message: Gaal son of Ebed and Gaals brothers have come to the city of Shechem. They are making trouble for you. Gaal is turning the whole city against you.

dag: Bɛ ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣili Baal ka chɛ ma; bɛ ŋmanila tɔb shɛli din ka naani niŋbu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ kpamba zaa bɛ yɛtɔɣ yoya zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ ti leei bɛ daansarisi malibo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Like a boomerang, they changed directions, but they did not come back to me. Their leaders bragged about their strength, but they will be killed with swords. And the people in Egypt will laugh at them.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yi, bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma ka bɛ kpi n-doya, ka zunzuya bɛn yɛn di ba bi kpira; ka buɣim din yɛn di ba gba bi kpira. Ka bɛ dooshee maa ni mali dabiɛm pam sokam zaa sani.
en: Whoever goes out of the city will see the dead bodies of those who sinned against me. The worms eating those bodies will never die, and the fires burning them will never go out. It will be horrible to anyone who sees it.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa, bilimiya. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then he commanded, Let the earth produce all kinds of plants, those that bear grain and those that bear fruit—and it was done.

dag: O yurilim maŋli la naala zaa? O daalikaulinim la zanila tariga sahakam maa?.
en: Is this the end of your love and your promises?.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa tim Baanabas Antiɔk.
en: The news about this reached the church in Jerusalem, so they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa kul maag o ni n-lihir o ni o nya Yawɛ chɛ ka o dila nasara o chandi maa ni maa bee.
en: The servant quietly watched her. He wanted to be sure that the Lord had given him an answer and had made his trip successful.

dag: ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa. Ka dɔbba ayi maa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ kpiimba ni?.
en: Full of fear, the women bowed down to the ground, as the men said to them, Why are you looking among the dead for one who is alive?.

dag: Dama ti ka tin shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ti lihiri bɔrila tin shɛli din ti yɛn kana la.
en: For there is no permanent city for us here on earth; we are looking for the city which is to come.

dag: Ŋunkam kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di nyaaŋa o ni nya yurilim dilan sani n-gari ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o.
en: Those who correct someone will, in the end, find more favor than those with flattering tongues.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o na. O ni daa ti mirina ka Yisa bɔh o.
en: Jesus stopped and told some people to bring the blind man over to him. When the blind man was getting near, Jesus asked.

dag: suhir a n ni leei bi so ba sarika ŋɔ ni la zuɣu. Bia maa n-nyɛ Onɛsimus.
en: I am asking you for my son Onesimus. He became my son while I was in prison.

dag: Nira ni tooi kabigi kurigu mini tahiʒiɛɣu din gabi taba, ka nyɛ din yi nuzaa polo na?.
en: Can a person shatter iron, iron from the north, or bronze?.

dag: Amaa ka o sɔŋda maa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ tari ninvuɣ kɔbiga? Ka Ilaisha daa lan garigi yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ba ka bɛ ŋubi, dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ŋub li tiɣi ka guui. .
en: His servant said, How can I feed one hundred men with this? Elisha said, Give it to the people so they can eat! This is what the LORD says: Eat and there will be leftovers.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal bɛ ni ti fa tɔbbihi daba, ka fa na biɛɣu ni di neen shɛŋa. N ni tuhi yi mini bɛn tuhira, ka fa yi bihi bahi.
en: The LORD says: Even the captives of warriors will be taken, and the tyrants loot will escape. I myself will oppose those who oppose you, and I myself will save your children.

dag: nti zaŋ li da yi suhu ni bɔri shɛli; yi ni tooi da niɣi bee piɛri bee wain bee dam din mali kpiɔŋ bee yi suhu ni kul bɔri shɛli, ka yi mini yi yinsinim ti di li nimaani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Then you can use the money for anything you want: cattle, sheep, wine, beer, or whatever else you might like. Then you should feast there and celebrate in the presence of the LORD your God, along with your entire household.

dag: Ti ni zaŋ alikama din bi viɛli kɔhi shaara, ka zaŋ liɣiri da tarimba, ka zaŋ namda diba ayiyi n-taɣi nandaamba.
en: We can sell worthless wheat at a high price. We'll find someone poor who can't pay his debts, not even the price of a pair of sandals, and we'll buy him as a slave.

dag: Dilaila ni daa baŋ ni Samsin yipa yɛl o yɛlimaŋli zaa maa, ka o tim ti yɛli Filistianim nanim la, O yipa yɛl ma yɛlimaŋli zaa, dinzuɣu kamiyana pumpɔŋɔ. Ka Filistianim nanim maa daa bɔ liɣiri ka o sanna.
en: When Delilah realized that he had told her his whole secret, she sent word to the rulers of the Philistines, Come one more time, for he has told me his whole secret. The rulers of the Philistines came up to her and brought the silver with them.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nyɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna la zuɣu, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun kɔhiri bindira maa tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa zuɣu. Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa kana ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa.
en: Since Joseph was governor of Egypt and in charge of selling grain, his brothers came to him and bowed with their faces to the ground.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o ba, Mani a bituuli Iso. M pun niŋ a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Yiɣisim ʒini di m mɔɣu ni nimdi maa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob answered, I am your older son Esau; I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of the meat that I have brought you, so that you can give me your blessing.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la zaa m-pirigi li tinti Izraɛlnima kaman bɛ zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm ni di nyɛ bɛ fali. Ka tɔb tuhibu daa chɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi.
en: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.

dag: Ka bikpɛm maa daa je suli zaɣisi duu kpɛbu; ka o ba daa yina ti balim o.
en: The older brother got so angry that he would not even go into the house. His father came out and begged him to go in.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhiri booni tab yɛra, Kasi, kasi, kasi! N-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. O jilima palila dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They were calling out to each other: Holy, holy, holy! The Lord Almighty is holy! His glory fills the world.

dag: Yi daa lo ma la zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li leei zaɣ suŋ ni di chɛ ka niriba pam ti tiligi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You planned something bad for me, but God produced something good from it, in order to save the lives of many people, just as hes doing today.

dag: Isaka zuliya ni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa mi di ni simdi ni Izraɛlnim niŋ shɛm ni saha shɛli di ni simdi ni bɛ niŋ li daa nyɛla zuɣulaannim kɔbisiyi mini bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn daa be bɛ sulinsi ni.
en: from Issachar, those who understood the times and what Israel should do, chiefs, with all their relatives under their command.

dag: Ŋunkam zu ninsal ti kɔhi bee n-na gbib o ka bɛ gbaag o, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever kidnaps someone, either to sell him or to keep him as a slave, is to be put to death.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa dol o nyaaŋa paana ti kpe siliga maa ni n-nya ka bimpiɛlli maa doya.
en: Following him, Simon Peter entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ sunsuuni, ka lan me binwɔɣinli zali bɛ tintariga ka di teeri ba Yawɛ yɛla.
en: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord ; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.

dag: Amiram bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Aduna mini Musa. Ka bɛ daa pii Aduna min o bidibisi ni bɛ su jɛmbu duu puuni neen kasi la fukumsi sahakam, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri Yawɛ, ka tumd o tuma, ka lan zaŋd o yuli suhiri alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam.
en: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.

dag: Ɛdomnima mini Ishimail zuliya ni Mɔabnima ni Hagirinima ni.
en: Their army includes the Edomites, Ishmaelites, Moabites, and Hagars descendants, the people of Byblos, Ammon, and Amalek, the Philistines, and the people of Tyre.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nira daa chaŋ naa maa sani ti yɛl o, N dan naa, di chɛ ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi ŋɔ pahi dol a chaŋ, dama Yawɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ŋɔ zaa so sani.
en: One of God's prophets said, Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel.

dag: Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim.
en: A kingdom involved in civil war will collapse.

dag: Ka dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi maa, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini na ti mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O di ti niŋ kpam bee firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: If you cannot afford two doves or two pigeons, you must bring cups of fine flour as your sin offering. You must not put oil or frankincense on the flour because it is a sin offering.

dag: Ka yi yi ni zɔr Yawɛ ka jɛmd o, ka deer o noli ka ku zaɣisi ŋun Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka yi mini yi na so ŋun sun ya maa zaa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, dindina shɛlikam ni niŋ viɛnyɛla yi sani.
en: You must fear and respect the Lord . You must serve him and obey his commands. You must not turn against him. You and the king ruling over you must follow the Lord your God. If you do, God will save you.

dag: Ka Nɛria bia Baruk daa niŋ anabi Jɛrimia ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu gbaŋ maa karimbu polo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni maa.
en: So Baruch read the Lord 's words in the Temple exactly as I had told him to do.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ piɛbiri piɛla yila kikahi maa ka di kumdi yuui, yinim bɛn nyɛ tɔbbihi maa zaa yin duhimi yi yee n-kul tahiri pampam, di saha tiŋ maa goondaa maa ni kab lu, ka yi zaa kab ti kpe di ni.
en: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.

dag: Miri ka a leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛ nɛma pari talima la ni yino bee n-zani ti so ni o di samli.
en: Dont promise to pay someone elses debt.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ba daa chaŋ ti kpe fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus and his disciples came to the town of Capernaum, and on the next Sabbath Jesus went to the synagogue and began to teach.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa zaŋ yi Kadɛshibarinia hal ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa daa nyɛla yuun pihinahaayika hal ka di ʒiɛman maa ni bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba zaa daa ti kpi sansani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri po pɔri yɛli ba shɛm la.
en: This was thirty-eight years after we had left Kadesh Barnea. All the fighting men of that generation had died, as the Lord had said they would.

dag: A yurilim din ka bahigu puuni ka a daa zaŋ a ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa chaŋ. A yiko ka a daa zaŋ wuhi ba soli ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ kasi la ni.
en: Faithful to your promise, you led the people you had rescued; by your strength you guided them to your sacred land.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, jɛra kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. So bi mi din yɛn niŋ, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛl o kpee din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha?.
en: A fool talks on and on. No one knows what is going to happen next, and no one can tell us what will happen after we die.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba binshɛɣukam.
en: You have been given the secret of the Kingdom of God, Jesus answered. But the others, who are on the outside, hear all things by means of parables.

dag: Bee nir ni tooi no buɣimsal nɛɔŋ ka di ku nyoog o napɔŋ?.
en: If you step on one, your feet will be burned.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka yɛli Yisa, Nyam a nyaandoliba maa ni tumdi din chihiri ni bɛ tum Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to Jesus, Look, it is against our Law for your disciples to do this on the Sabbath.

dag: Asha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣa Sɛra.
en: Ashers family: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.

dag: Paɣisarili mi daa yi yɛn yi paɣiba yili maa ni kpe nayili maa, o ni yɛli ni o bɔri shɛlikam, dina ka bɛ tir o ka o zaŋdi mali kpɛra.
en: When her time came to go in to the king, she could choose to wear or take whatever she wanted from the womens living area.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu Dɛɛbi ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda, ka bɛ daa yi ni n-lab Listra mini Aikɔnium ni Antiɔk.
en: Paul and Barnabas preached the good news in Derbe and won some people to the Lord. Then they went back to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch in Pisidia.

dag: Ka naa daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina m-mali nam ʒiishee zaɣ titali, ka chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaa m-pa di zuɣu.
en: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.

dag: Ŋunkam daŋdi yiɣisibu asiba n-duhi o yee puhi o ʒiʒiinikpee, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli ka o yɛr maa.
en: Greeting a neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning will be viewed as a curse.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: Everyone will hate you on account of my name. But whoever stands firm until the end will be saved.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka sanʒiɛ tital shɛli bɛ ni booni pɔhim tilli la daa yiɣisi wulimpuhili duli polo ʒiɛrina.
en: But soon a very strong wind—the one called Northeaster—blew down from the island.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ nudirigu gbali ti maligumaana, ka di leeg o tarili a suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: The right hind leg of the animal shall be given as a special contribution.

dag: ka Naomi yɛli ba, Labimiya kuli yi manim sani. Yawɛ ŋɔ niŋmi ya nirilim kaman yi ni niŋ m mini yi yidaannim bɛn kpi la nirilim shɛm la.
en: Then Naomi told her daughters-in-law, Each of you should go back home to your mother. You have been very kind to me and my sons who are now dead. So I pray that the Lord will be just as kind to you.

dag: O ni daa yi zahira tumd o pagɔrisigu tuma, ka yihir omaŋ fini shɛm maa daa chɛ ka n ŋmalig o sani ni suhuyiɣisili kaman n ni daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o biɛli shɛm la.
en: She exposed herself publicly and let everyone know she was a whore. I was as disgusted with her as I had been with her sister.

dag: N ni tum jɛrilim zuɣu chɛ ka n dansi maa yuma niŋla yu biɛri, ka nyo pam.
en: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.

dag: Amaa man tɛha ni, o yi kpalim ʒiya o ni mali suhupiɛlli gar o yi kuli doo, ka n tɛhi ni Naawuni Shia Kasi be n ni zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo.
en: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.

dag: Ka Uziɛl bidibisi mi nyɛ Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan ni Sitiri.
en: The Uzzielites: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani, o pun zaŋ li ti Naawuni, ka di bi lan kpa ni o lu o ba sizuura gba.
en: But you teach that if people have something they could use to help their father or mother, but say, This belongs to God.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Zoya tiŋgbani maa ku saɣ ti, ka Keenannim mi ʒi tintan ni, ka mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi. Bɛ ni shɛb bɛn be Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni bɛn be Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni la zaa mal li mi.
en: Even if we do that, they answered, there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa kpuɣi Dauda bia Jɛrimɔt bipuɣiŋga, Mahalat ŋun ma daa nyɛ Abiheel ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia Ɛliab bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Rehoboam married Mahalath daughter of Jerimoth, Davids son, and Abihail daughter of Eliab, Jesses son.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa wum lala ka bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o, amaa ka daa lee zɔr o, dama o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa pam.
en: The chief priests and legal experts heard this and tried to find a way to destroy him. They regarded him as dangerous because the whole crowd was enthralled at his teaching.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nina neei, ka o nya ka kɔbiliga doya, ka o daa chaŋ di ni nti tooi kom pal o kom koligu maa na nti booi li ti bia maa ka o nyu.
en: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well. She went and filled the leather bag with water and gave some to the boy.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibisi ni daa nyɛ kpamba gari Itama bidibisi zuɣu ka bɛ daa piri ba la ʒiibupinaayɔbu zuɣu kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm, ka daa piri Itama bidibisi mi ʒiibunii zuɣu.
en: There were more leaders from Eleazars family than from Ithamars. There were leaders from Eleazars family and there were eight leaders from Ithamars family.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o yiŋ tumtumdiba kpɛma, Niŋm bindira su niriba maa kpalansi ni ka di saɣi bɛ ʒibu tariga, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi noya ni;.
en: Then Joseph gave a command to his servant. He said, Fill the mens sacks with as much grain as they can carry. Then put each mans money into his sack with the grain.

dag: Ɛzɛr n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu nyɛ Obadia, ka ŋun pahi ata nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: Ezer the leader, Obadiah second, Eliab third.

dag: Ka firila ti ku lan ne a ni; ka so mi ti ku lan wum amiliya aŋgo min o daamiliya kukoya a ni, dama a kɔhigɔriba daa nyɛla dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira, ka a daa zaŋ a baɣibuɣibo yɔhim zuliya kam.
en: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri, ŋun mi viɛnyɛliŋga be n sani.
en: My words are certainly truthful; one with total knowledge is present with you.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun gba nyɛ yi ni yino ka nyɛ Yisa Masia tumtumda la puhiri ya. O kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo n-tiri ya ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani n-niŋ naani zaa Naawuni yubu tumbu puuni.
en: Greetings from Epaphras, another member of your group and a servant of Christ Jesus. He always prays fervently for you, asking God to make you stand firm, as mature and fully convinced Christians, in complete obedience to God's will.

dag: Ka Leeban mini Bɛtuɛl daa yɛl o, Yɛlli ŋɔ ni yila Yawɛ sani ŋɔ na, dindina ti ku tooi yɛl a din bie bee din viɛl zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: Laban and Bethuel answered, Since this matter comes from the Lord , it is not for us to make a decision.

dag: Ka yi nya ka wum ka di pala Ɛfɛsus ŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ka Pool ŋɔ kul yɛri niriba ni salinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali buɣ shɛŋa pala shɛli; lala ka o niŋdi lɛbigiri niriba pam suhuri.
en: And you can see and hear that this Paul has convinced and misled a lot of people, not only in Ephesus but also throughout most of the province of Asia. He says that gods made by human hands arent really gods.

dag: ni Afɛk naa ni Laasharɔn naa.
en: the king of Aphek, the king of Sharon.

dag: So yi bol a ni a ka o daamiliya lɔbu ni na, nyin miri ka a chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti boli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yuli gar a;.
en: When someone invites you to a wedding celebration, dont take your seat in the place of honor. Someone more highly regarded than you could have been invited by your host.

dag: Naa Dauda daa tum Naawuni yubu o ʒiɛman ni, ka daa ti paɣi Naawuni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni ka o pooi;.
en: David served Gods purpose in his own generation, then he died and was buried with his ancestors. He experienced deaths decay.

dag: ka Samuɛl mi daa do Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ni daa be la, ka bɛ daa na bi kpihi Naawuni firila.
en: Gods lamp hadnt gone out yet, and Samuel was lying down in the LORDs temple, where Gods chest was.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him.

dag: N Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan chɛ ka n nya binshɛli ʒii. Nyama ŋuna n Duuma NAAWUNI daa zaŋla buɣim ni o darig o niriba tibili. Buɣim maa daa dila teeku, ka lan diri tiŋgbani gba.
en: I had another vision from the Sovereign Lord . In it I saw him preparing to punish his people with fire. The fire burned up the great ocean under the earth and started to burn up the land.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Go and tell the king of Egypt that he must let the Israelites leave his land.

dag: Tan yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Tan tolima piniyini maa zaa buɣisibu daa nyɛla yim.
en: All the curtains were the same size— cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: ka zaŋ n daanzinfa pipia la niŋ ŋun nyɛ bɛ zaa biasan la kpalaŋ nol ni m-pah o kawana liɣiri zuɣu. Ka o daa niŋ kaman Yisifu ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Put the youngest brothers money in his sack too. But also put my special silver cup in his sack. So the servant obeyed Joseph.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Nyama, a yi ti paai Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, nyin tummi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa n ni niŋ a yiko ni a tum maa Firawuna tooni, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ pam, ka o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: The LORD said to Moses, When you go back to Egypt, make sure that you appear before Pharaoh and do all the amazing acts that Ive given you the power to do. But Ill make him stubborn so that he wont let the people go.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋla ʒiri gabisi vɔri tuumbiɛri, ka vɔri alahichi kaman tɔroko din mali gabisi la.
en: Look at those people! They pull their guilt and sins behind them like people pulling wagons with ropes.

dag: Zuliya kam ni zo Yawɛ yuli, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu.
en: The nations will honor the LORDs name; all the earths rulers will honor your glory.

dag: dama ŋun puh o gba leela ŋun pah o zuɣu tum o tuumbiɛri maa.
en: If you do, you are helping them with their evil work.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun daa pii Ibram ka yih o Ur din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka daa taɣ o yuli m-bol o Ibrahimma.
en: LORD God, you are the one who chose Abram. You brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave him the name Abraham.

dag: Di saha Dauda daa bela bɛ ni me birini gili luɣ shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa shɛb daa be Bɛtilihɛm.
en: At that time David was on a fortified hill, and a group of Philistines had occupied Bethlehem.

dag: ni yi paɣiba ni yi bihi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani, ka nyɛ bɛn wɔriti yi dari bee bɛn ŋɔŋdi kom tiri ya.
en: your children, your wives, and the immigrants who live with you in your camp, the ones who chop your wood and those who draw your water.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi ni bɛ malibu.
en: Gershon had two sons: Libni and Shimei, and they had many descendants.

dag: Ti yiɣisibu dali ni daa ti paai ka ti yiɣisi ni ti chaŋ; ka bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi zaa daa biɛl ti ti yi tiŋ maa tariga, ka ti gbani teeku noli n-suhi Naawuni.
en: When our time had come to an end, we departed. All of them, including women and children, accompanied us out of town where we knelt on the beach and prayed.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli ba ni bɛ labimi ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai:.
en: Esther sent back this word to Mordecai.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari ti paai Sool min o bidibisi n-ku o bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

dag: Naawuni zom ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n ni wuhi so shɛli ŋɔ min o niriba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima alali la zaa nambɔɣu, ka ti ba suhudoo!.
en: May peace and mercy be on whoever follows this rule and on Gods Israel.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla yi situra varimla nandaamba bɛn ka taali ʒim, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa zaa yoli. Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa puuni.
en: You have blood on your hands! It is the blood of poor, innocent people. You did not catch them breaking into your house. You killed them for no reason!.

dag: A daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi a biɛhigu ni a nambu dali hal ka bɛ ti nya alahichi a ni.
en: You were good and honest when I created you, but then you became evil.

dag: Hal ti ni daa paai Masidɔnia ti niŋgbuna daa bi nya vuhim baabiɛla. Ti daa nya wahala shɛlikam ni: Zabili daa yiri kpaŋ na, ka dabiɛm be ti suhuri ni.
en: Even after we arrived in Macedonia, we couldnt rest physically. We were surrounded by problems. There was external conflict, and there were internal fears.

dag: O daa mali di gbaya maa ka di ŋmanila chɛchɛbuŋ gbaya. Di spindilinim mini di fiilinim ni di sipuɣisinim ni di duɣuri zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: The construction of the wheels resembled chariot wheels. The axles, rims, spokes, and hubs were all made of cast metal.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: Then the whole community of Israelites began complaining again. They complained to Moses and Aaron in the desert.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa. Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa.
en: LORD, the world is full of your faithful love! Teach me your statutes!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ kulipalinima bɛn labiri ziŋgɔhi mini bɛn mali yilima bee nɛri gbahiri zahim Nail Mɔɣili maa ni ni ti fabili.
en: Those who fish in the Nile will be discouraged and mourn.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Bɛnaaya, Niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ŋmɛm ku o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi. Ka di chɛ ka ŋun Jɔab ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka di ka sol la ʒim yihibu taali ku lan ʒi m mini m ba yiŋnim zuɣu.
en: The king said to him, Do as he said. Attack him and then bury him. In doing this, you will remove from me and from my fathers royal house the guilt over the innocent blood that Joab shed.

dag: Chuɣu maa puhi naai dali n-daa nyɛ chuɣu maa dabisi tital dali, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi zani kuhi yɛli, Kɔnyuri yi wum so, ŋun kam n sanna ti nyu.
en: The last day of the festival came. It was the most important day. On that day Jesus stood up and said loudly, Whoever is thirsty may come to me and drink.

dag: Ka o daa va Naawuni jɛmbu duu duɣuri mini lahi, zaɣ kara mini zaɣ bihi zaa ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni azichi mini nayili azichi ni kpambaliba yinsi azichi zaa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The king of Babylonia looted the Temple, the Temple treasury, and the wealth of the king and his officials, and took everything back to Babylon.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ka tumdi n yubu hal nti paai di bahigu, n ni ti o yiko ka o su zuliya paai shɛm fukumsi.
en: I will give power over the nations to all those who win the victory and continue until the end to do what I want.

dag: Di tiɣi Yawɛ nini o wuntitali zuɣu ni o tibig o zaligunima, ka chɛ ka di mali jilima.
en: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi kanna daa ʒirila pina din nyɛ anzinfa nɛma bee salima nɛma bee kpariti bee bidibbina bee tulaale zim bee yuri bee buntaansi na yuuni kam.
en: Each of them brought Solomon gifts—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules. This continued year after year.

dag: A zaligunim viɛli pam, dinzuɣu ka n dol li n suhu ni.
en: Your laws are wonderful! Thats why I guard them.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim gil o; sagban tibisa din sabigi ka kom be di ni n-nyɛ o sampaa.
en: He wrapped himself in darkness that covered him like a tent. He was hidden by dark clouds heavy with water.

dag: Amaa nyini malimi shili n-yiɣisi zani yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa. Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, di yi pa lala n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaag a pam bɛ sani.
en: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bidib kpɛm kam ti kpi. Firawuna bikpɛm ŋun ti yɛn di nam o kalinsi nyaaŋa gba ni kpi hal zaŋ tabili dab paɣ ŋun gba nɛli zuɣu niɛmdi bikpɛm ni kpi ni bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb zaa.
en: and wherever he goes, the first-born son in every family will die. Your own son will die, and so will the son of the lowest slave woman. Even the first-born males of your cattle will die.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu maa. Ka ŋunkam ka n sanna, kum ku lan gbaag o; ka ŋunkam mi niŋ ma yɛda, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada.
en: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.

dag: Ti zaa yinoyino deerila pin gahinda kaman Masia ni buɣisiri li shɛm tiri ti.
en: Christ gave each one of us a special gift. Everyone received what he wanted to give them.

dag: din yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni la: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn ni di chɛ ka niriba tuui li; di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Amaa ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: As it is written: Look! Im putting a stumbling block in Zion, which is a rock that offends people. And the one who has faith in him will not be put to shame. .

dag: N kuhimi hal ti gbarigi, ka n kukoli biɛra, ka n nina niŋ liti, ka n kul guhirila n Naawuni.
en: I am worn out from calling for help, and my throat is aching. I have strained my eyes, looking for your help.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa boli Musa mini Aduna labisi Firawuna sanna, ka o ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa; amaa ka banima n-lee yɛn chaŋ maa.
en: So Pharaoh told his officials to bring Moses and Aaron back to him. Pharaoh said to them, Go and worship the Lord your God. But tell me, just who is going.

dag: Yiliyiiniba m-be tooni, ka biŋkumdiŋmɛriba doli nyaaŋa, ka paɣisara be bɛ sunsuuni n-chaɣisiri sayɛya.
en: First came the singers, then the musicians; between them the young women were playing hand drums.

dag: Niriba ni ʒe teeku noli n-gbahiri zahim zaŋ Ɛngɛdi hal ni Ɛnɛglaim. Di ni ti nyɛla lansi labbu shee. Ka zahim balibu pam ni ti be di ni kaman bɛ ni be Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni shɛm la.
en: People will stand fishing beside it, from En-gedi to En-eglayim, and it will become a place for spreading nets. It will be like the Mediterranean Sea, having all kinds of fish in it.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni yi Shɛfam maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ribila din be Ain wulimpuhili polo la, ka tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku din be wulimpuhili polo la naɣiliŋga ni.
en: From Shepham the border will go east of Ain to Riblah. The border will continue along the hills by Lake Galilee.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi wuntizɔriba ni bɛ di tum alahichi, ka bɛ bi tum alahichi maa, bɛ shiri ni be bɛ ni deei saɣisigu maa zuɣu, ka a mi tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa Zin mɔɣu ni zaŋ hal ti paai Rɛhɔb din daa miri Lɛbohamat la.
en: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.

dag: Dinzuɣu n labila Jɛrusalɛm na nti zo li nambɔɣu, bɛ ni lab me n jɛmbu duu la yaha, ka n chɛ ka bɛ teei bimbuɣisirigu m-buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion. My house will be built in it, says the LORD of heavenly forces. Let a measuring line be stretched over Jerusalem.

dag: Wummiya, kuhigu din yiri Babilɔn na! Ninvuɣ kubo pam lu Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Listen to the cries for help from Babylon, signs of massive devastation in the land, declares the LORD.

dag: Yi yi wali wala viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka m Ba nya jilima pam, di mi n-ni lan wuhi ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba.
en: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒiya nyuri wain, ka naa lan yɛli Ɛsta, Bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: and while they were drinking wine, the king asked her, What can I do for you? Just ask, and I will give you as much as half of my kingdom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n wuhi tuumbiɛrinima a soya, ka alahichinim ŋmaligi lab a sanna.
en: Then I will teach wrongdoers your ways, and sinners will come back to you.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋɔŋ kom tiliginsim kɔbilisi puuni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: You people will get your water from the spring of salvation. Then you will be happy.

dag: ka yuri puhigu dahi ni, ka lan yuri ni niriba booni ba bɛ karimbanima.
en: They love for people to show respect to them in the marketplaces and to call them Teacher.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa yɛl o, A ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: But Moses father-in-law said to him, This isnt the right way to do this.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa zaŋ takɔbi din yir o nol ni na ku bɛn kpalim, ka noonsi zaa daa di nimdi tiɣi.
en: Their armies were killed by the sword that comes out of the mouth of the one who was riding the horse; and all the birds ate all they could of their flesh.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni n-nyɛ bɛn paɣir a kaman n ni paɣir a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bihi banim yɛri bɛ bihi a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla.
en: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.

dag: Bɛnkam maani nandaamba ansarisi turila ŋun nam ba. Ka bɛnkam mali suhupiɛlli bɛ tab daashaara zuɣu ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.

dag: Dama Ahaz daa zaŋla Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni salima mini kpambaliba yinsi salima zaa chaŋ ti yo farigu Asiria naa sani, amaa ka di daa bi sɔŋ o.
en: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord 's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz.

dag: Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ ni bɛ mini Ɛsta ti laɣim di.
en: And so the king and Haman went to eat with Esther.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni sa nya Nabɔt min o bihi ʒim sɔhila shɛm la, n ni bɔh a di biɛri puu ŋɔ ni labisi. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm o bahi puu maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I saw the murder of Naboth and his sons yesterday. And I promise that I will punish you here in this same field. So take Joram's body, Jehu ordered his aide, and throw it in the field that belonged to Naboth, so as to fulfill the Lord 's promise.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm leei tampuli, ka leei kunduna biɛhigu shee. N ni chɛ ka Juda fɔndi zan dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: I will reduce Jerusalem to ruins, a den for wild dogs. I will make the towns of Judah a wasteland, without inhabitant.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Reehab, Ti yɛn zaŋla ti nyɛviya n-taɣ a dini. A yi bi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla yɛli so, ka Yawɛ ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, ti ni niŋ a nirilim.
en: The men agreed and said, We will trade our lives for yours. Dont tell anyone what we are doing. Then, when the Lord gives us the land, we will be kind to you. You can trust us.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan zaŋ nimaani kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti du Bɛtihɔgila kuŋkuni, ka di tintariga maa daa zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Yalim Teeku duli nuzaa polo zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili nudirigu polo. Di nudirigu polo tintariga n-daa bala.
en: passing north of the ridge of Beth Hoglah, and ended at the northern inlet on the Dead Sea, where the Jordan River empties into it. This was the southern border.

dag: N zahimya ni ti ni diri wahala shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ bi saɣi shɛli ni ti zaŋ li buɣisi jilima shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn ti ti la.
en: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi ni jɛm ma, di zaa ni leeg a dini.
en: Just worship me, and you can have it all.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Kush nir maa daa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka din niŋ nachimbil maa niŋ nyini n dan naa dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu ni bɛ niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: Is my son Absalom all right? David asked. The Ethiopian replied, I wish that all Your Majesty's enemies and everyone who tries to harm you would end up like him.

dag: O daa wuhi Musa o soya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o tuma.
en: He revealed his plans to Moses and let the people of Israel see his mighty deeds.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni ti yaai bɛ noli yɛl a, A gba gbarigimi kaman ti ni gbarigi shɛm. Ti min a zaa niŋla yim.
en: Each one of them will say, Now you are just as weak as any of us!.

dag: N di yuya ni n niriba maa wum n yɛligu; n di yuya ni Izraɛlnim doli n soya!.
en: How I wish my people would listen to me; how I wish they would obey me!.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm pahi ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pia nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pia maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Finally, Abraham said, Please don't get angry, Lord , if I speak just once more. Suppose you find only good people there. For the sake of good people, the Lord told him, I still won't destroy the city.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zali ba zaligu yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim bɛn ti ka tuma ni na Vuhim Dabisili dali pirigibu buta zuɣu yim n-yɛn guli nayili.
en: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.

dag: Ka yi tɛhiya ni tibidarigibo bɔ n-lee simdi ninvuɣ so ŋun no n-taai Naawuni Bia, ka lihi ʒiɛm alikauli ʒi shɛli din daa mal o ka o be kasi, ka niŋdi din dihiri Naawuni daalibarika Shia la vi la?.
en: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi; o daalahiziba tuma la zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: But the people continued to sin! They did not trust in the amazing things God could do.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛri Naawuni mini Musa finafina, Bɔzuɣu ka yi yihi ti Ijipti na ni ti ti kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni? Dama bindirigu mini kom ka kpe, ka ti nyee nyɔni bindir chɔɣima ŋɔ.
en: and spoke against God and Moses. They complained, Why did you bring us out of Egypt to die in this desert, where there is no food or water? We can't stand any more of this miserable food.

dag: A bi saɣi n-chɛ ka n dimnim gbaai ma; a zaŋ ma zali palo ni.
en: You will not let my enemies take me. You will free me from their traps.

dag: Kpalimmi be n sani, ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o ku ma m-bɔri ni o ku a gba maa; a yi be n sani shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Stay with me, and dont be afraid. The one who seeks my life now seeks yours too. But youll be safe with me.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali yaa daa yi ti duri taba, Yaakubu zaŋdila dari maa sɔŋ bɛ tooni kɔbɔɣili maa gbini ni bɛ be dari maa gbini duri taba.
en: When the healthy animals were mating, Jacob put the branches in front of them at the drinking troughs, so that they would breed among the branches.

dag: Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛbat bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha ka Abijam daa leei Juda naa.
en: Abijam became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka o daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa ka dunianim ti bi baŋ o.
en: The Word was already in the world. The world was made through him, but the world did not know him.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla, di daa chɛ ka alahichi tumbu galisi; amaa alahichi tumbu ni galisi shɛm maa Naawuni daalibarika galisiya gari lala.
en: The law was brought in so that more people would sin the way Adam did. But where sin increased, there was even more of Gods grace.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ku tooi ba nir zali, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa kul ku vuɣi.
en: Evil people are never safe, but good people remain safe and secure.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa, dama ŋunkam be ya ŋɔ mi ni a nyɛla paɣ so ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ.
en: Now don't worry, Ruth. I will do everything you ask; as everyone in town knows, you are a fine woman.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka po pɔri yɛli ma ni n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ, ni n ku kpe tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su la ni.
en: The Lord was angry with me because of you. He swore that I could not go across the Jordan River into the good land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Nyini n-ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu; ka a sɔŋsim chɛ ka n lee wɔɣirili.
en: O Lord , you protect me and save me; your help has made me great.

dag: Lɛvinim tiŋgbani ni ti do m-baɣi maligumaaniba tiŋgbani maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu. Di wɔɣilim zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: I will give the other half of my sacred land to the Levites. Their share will also be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nyari tibigibu o yiko puuni. Karimba ŋuni n-lee paag o?.
en: Look, God is inaccessible due to his power; who is a teacher like him?.

dag: Itiɔpianim mini Libianim daa mali tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba, amaa a ni daa niŋ Yawɛ naani la zuɣu, o daa zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Werent the Cushites and the Libyans a vast army with chariots and horsemen to spare? Still, when you relied on the LORD, he delivered them into your power.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli nachin kpɛm maa, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ daalibarika nir ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim ʒe sambani ŋɔ ni? Kpɛmina, dama m pun mali duu zal a, ka mali laakumnim ŋɔ gba biɛhigu shee zali.
en: Then Laban said, The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa ka di leei bɛ dini naai, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tin shɛli ti Nan bia Jɔshua ka di leeg o dini.
en: So the leaders finished dividing the land and giving it to the different tribes. After they finished, all the Israelites decided to give Joshua son of Nun some land too. This was land that was promised to him.

dag: Bahigu maa paana. Di bahigu saha paaya. Di nyɛla din yiɣisi lu yi zuɣu. Nyama, di kanna.
en: The end is coming, and it will come quickly!.

dag: n-wurim di bimbina la, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma buɣili Ashɛrim min o binnana la zaa m-baɣisibaɣisi li ka di be kaman taŋkpa zim, ka daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbina din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Josiah broke down the altars and the Asherah poles. He beat the idols into powder. He cut down all the incense altars used for Baal worship in all the country of Israel. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali gadama ni bɛ ba, ka kariti bɛ ma bahira nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tahiri vi mini turi na.
en: Those who assault their father and drive out their mother are disgraceful children, worthy of reproach.

dag: Ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa ŋun be, ka daa pun be, ka ni ti kana la yɛliya: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega. Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: The Lord God says, I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful.

dag: Ka binfalafala daa be binnɛma maa zuɣusaa ka nyaɣisira kaman bɛ ni booni shɛli kirisital la.
en: There was an amazing thing over the heads of the living beings. It was like a bowl turned upside down, and the bowl was clear like crystal.

dag: Ka n lu tiŋa ka wum kukol shɛli damli ka di booni ma yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, Saul, Saul! Why do you persecute me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna ti bɔh o, Banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ.
en: During the night, God asked Balaam, Who are these people at your house.

dag: ni Yuria ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ pihitanaayopɔin.
en: and Uriah the Hittite— thirty-seven in all.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti leei shihirili be yi nuhi ni mini yi gbɛri zuɣu, dama Yawɛ daa zaŋla o yiko nuu yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: This observance will be a reminder, like something tied on our hands or on our foreheads; it will remind us that the Lord brought us out of Egypt by his great power.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Viligim a baŋtabiga, ka piligi a nam zuɣupiligu. Binyara bi la yɛn be kaman di ni daa be shɛm. Duhimiya tarimba, ka siɣisi bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Take off the turban! Take off the crown! The time has come to change. The important leaders will be brought low, and those who are not important now will become important leaders.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ nim kul kuri ma la suli ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisira saha shɛli bɛ ni daa me li hal ni zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu n ni wurim li;.
en: The people of this city have made me angry and furious from the day it was built. I have decided to destroy it.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu n-chaŋ ti zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa.
en: Then the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence left the entrance of the Temple and moved to a place above the creatures.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kulim ni suhudoo. Naaman ni daa chaŋ, o daa na bi paai shɛli.
en: Go in peace, Elisha said. And Naaman left. He had gone only a short distance.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Siɣim yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses: Hurry up and go down! Your people, whom you brought up out of the land of Egypt, are ruining everything!.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a zaligunim wuhiri Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ a zalikpana wuhiri Izraɛlnima. Bɛ ni ti tuɣili tulaale zim a tooni, ka maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la a sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di di buɣim zaa.
en: They will teach your rules to Jacob and your Law to Israel. They will burn incense before you. They will offer burnt offerings on your altar.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi nyuri bara yi suhuri ni yi yab ni nyɛ Ibrahimma la zuɣu; dama n yɛri ya mi ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi zaŋ kuɣa ŋɔ nam ninsalinima, ka bɛ leei Ibrahimma zuliya.
en: I know what you are thinking. You want to say, but Abraham is our father! That means nothing. I tell you, God could make children for Abraham from these rocks.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says: I will break the yoke that the king of Babylon has put on the people of Judah.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli paɣ maa, N ni chɛ ka a nya biɛrim pam bihi dɔɣibu ni; a shiri ni nya biɛrim bihi dɔɣibu ni; amaa di zaa yoli, a kɔre kul ni be a yidan ni, ka o ni su a.
en: And he said to the woman, I will increase your trouble in pregnancy and your pain in giving birth. In spite of this, you will still have desire for your husband, yet you will be subject to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu zanimiya baalim pumpɔŋɔ n-nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tuun kar shɛli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: Now stand still and see the great thing the Lord will do before your eyes.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛlnim zaa lala.
en: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni o pin shɛli yɛla ninsal maŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa ni ku tooi kahigi wuhi ŋɔ zuɣu!.
en: Thanks be to God for his gift that is too wonderful to describe.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul ʒila o nam ʒiishee sahakam, ka zal o nam ʒiishee ni o kari saria.
en: The Lord set up his throne to bring justice, and he will rule forever.

dag: Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Iru mini Ɛla ni Naam; ka Ɛla mi bidibiga daa nyɛ Kɛnaz.
en: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. And Elah was the father of Kenaz.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi, Laɣimmiya na ti wum. Wummiya yi ba Izraɛl ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Come, gather around, as I tell your future.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ŋunkam yuli bi sabi nyɛvili litaafi la ni gba bahi buɣim teeku maa ni.
en: And anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri naa nam dibu yuma ayopɔin la ni gol so ŋun pahir anu ni ka o daa paai Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: They left Babylonia on the first day of the first month, and with God's help they arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leela dabiɛm shee, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li sahakam. Bɛnkam zaa gari nimaani, dabiɛm gbahi ba mi ka bɛ viini bɛ zuɣuri.
en: So their land will become an empty desert, a place for people from now on to make fun of. All who pass by there will be shocked by what has happened. They will just shake their heads at what they see.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba shɛb mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba daa be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: These are the people from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem:.

dag: Ka n daa gari a sani n-nya a ni be a ʒim ni talinda, a ni daa do a ʒim ni maa, ka n yɛl a, Niŋmi nyɛvili.
en: When I happened to come by, I saw you flailing about in your blood. I said to you while you were still bloody, Live.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bɔrila dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba, yi ni tooi da dabidɔbba mini dabipaɣiba zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya sani.
en: If you need slaves, you may buy them from the nations around you.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dagɔn tindaannim mini Ashidɔdnim bɛn zaa yɛn kpe Dagɔn duu maa ni bi lan tamdi di dunɔbia zuɣu kpɛri hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: That is why even today the priests of Dagon and all his worshipers in Ashdod step over that place and do not walk on it.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wuni ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni m-be ka nyini. Dama nyini n-gbib a alikauli ni yurilim din bi naara zaŋ chaŋ a daba bɛn dol a ni bɛ suhuri zaa sani.
en: He prayed, Lord God of Israel, in all heaven and earth there is no god like you. You keep your covenant with your people and show them your love when they live in wholehearted obedience to you.

dag: O ni daa niŋ Rubin bia Ɛliab bidibisi Datan mini Abiram shɛm la, tiŋgbani ni daa bɔɣi n-vali bɛ mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ suɣa ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun daa be bɛ sani Izraɛlnim zaa sunsuuni la.
en: You saw what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab from Reubens family. All the Israelites watched as the ground opened up like a mouth and swallowed them, their families, their tents, and all of their servants and animals.

dag: A zaɣis a ni daa lo a dabili alikauli shɛl la; ka zaŋ o nam zuɣupiligu bahi tiŋa.
en: You have broken your covenant with your servant and thrown his crown in the dirt.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yi tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun wuhiri ya din ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli, ka lan wuhiri ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: The LORD your redeemer, the holy one of Israel, proclaims: I am the LORD your God who teaches you for your own good, who leads you in the way you should go.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli jilima nyabu zuɣu. Fam ti bahi, ka chɛ ti daalahichi a yuli zuɣu.
en: Help us, O God, and save us; rescue us and forgive our sins for the sake of your own honor.

dag: Ka ninsal yi zaɣisi tuuba niŋbu, Naawuni ni sah o takɔbi; ka gur o tɔbu.
en: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi darigiri bɛ bihi tibili je ba mi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri bɛ bihi saɣisiri ba mi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Those who withhold the rod hate their children, but the one who loves them applies discipline.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, N wuhirila niriba palɔni, ka kul wuhiri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛŋa Yɛhudianim ni laɣindi la. N na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni.
en: But Jesus told him, I have spoken freely in front of everyone. And I have always taught in our synagogues and in the temple, where all of our people come together. I have not said anything in secret.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka niriba maa kul be yiriŋ maa.
en: Moses saw that the people were out of control because Aaron had let them get out of control, making them an easy target for their enemies.

dag: Yawɛ ʒin o nam ʒiishee kokpɛɣu zuɣu. Yawɛ n-ʒi o nam ʒiishee n-nyɛ naa ŋun kul beni sahakam.
en: The Lord ruled as king at the time of the flood, and the Lord will rule as king forever.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ni ti ye binyɛr piɛla ŋɔ tatabo, ka n ku kpihim o yuli nyɛvili litaafi ni; amaa ka ni ti zan o nyaaŋa m-bol o yuli m Ba Naawuni min o malaikanim sani.
en: Everyone who wins the victory will be dressed in white clothes like them. I will not remove their names from the book of life. I will say that they belong to me before my Father and before his angels.

dag: Di saha ka Ishibibɛnɔb ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumya zuliya, ka o kpani tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata ni pirigili, ka takɔb palli lo o sheeni la daa tɛhi ni o ni tooi ku Dauda.
en: Ishbi-benob, a descendant of the Raphah, planned on killing David. The weight of his spear was three hundred shekels of bronze, and he was wearing new armor.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim ni daa tuui lu la, di wuhiri ni bɛ daa lumi zaa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Amaa bɛ biriginsim zuɣu ka tiliginsim paai bɛn pa Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zab nyuli.
en: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba bɛn laɣim maa zaa, M bia Sulemaana n-nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so, ka o mi na nyɛ bi polli, ka bi mi tuma looloochi, ka tuma maa mi zooi; dama pa ninsal duu ka ti yɛn me, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ka ti yɛn me maa.
en: David told the crowd: God chose my son Solomon to build the temple, but Solomon is young and has no experience. This is not just any building—this is the temple for the Lord God!.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ ninkura, wummiya; yinim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na min niŋ yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni bee yi yaannim ʒiɛmana la ni?.
en: Pay attention, you older people; everyone in Judah, listen. Has anything like this ever happened in your time or the time of your ancestors?.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya malaika so ka o yi wulimpuhili polo na m-mali Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bintabindili; ka daa kuhi pam bahi malaikanima anahi shɛba Naawuni ni daa niŋ yiko ni bɛ saɣim dunia ŋɔ mini teeku la.
en: And I saw another angel coming up from the east with the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels to whom God had given the power to damage the earth and the sea.

dag: Jarɛd daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihiyɔbunaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Jared lived years, and he died.

dag: ka gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛri suŋ, ka nyɛ bɛn gbib bɛ yinsi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi nirilim, ka nyɛ bɛn wumdi n-tiri bɛ yidaannima, ka di chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yɛligu.
en: to be self-controlled and pure, and to be good housewives who submit themselves to their husbands, so that no one will speak evil of the message that comes from God.

dag: Bɛ bari ma la zana n soli zuɣu. N nandahima maa yaɣiya. Bɛ gbila bɔɣili sɔŋ n soli zuɣu, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee lan ŋmaligi lu di ni.
en: My enemies have spread a net to catch me; I am overcome with distress. They dug a pit in my path, but fell into it themselves.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, bɔ ka n lee niŋ ya? Bimbɔ ka n zaŋ muɣisi ya? Garigimiya ma!.
en: He says, My people, tell me what I did! Did I do something wrong against you? Did I make life too hard for you?.

dag: n-zaŋ a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a ka nyɛ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm la nuu ni. Hal n naan zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mini Kalidianim nuu ni.
en: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba na yoli niŋla tuuba, ka tum din tuhi n sani din nyɛ yi ni daa ti tab yolisim ka daa lo alikauli n sani n jɛmbu duu puuni la.
en: Recently you turned about and did what was right in my sight; each of you proclaimed liberty for the other and made a covenant before me in the temple that bears my name.

dag: Gbibiy o zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi mini yi bihi biɛrisuŋ zuɣu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: And you must obey his laws and commands that I give you today. Then everything will go well with you and your children who live after you. And you will live a long time in the land the Lord your God is giving you—it will be yours forever.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, N ku tooi niŋ shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; n ni wum shɛm, dina ka m mali kariti saria, ka n sariakaribo maa mi nyɛla din tuhi, dama m bi bɔri mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka m bɔra.
en: I cant do anything by myself. Whatever I hear, I judge, and my judgment is just. I dont seek my own will but the will of the one who sent me.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli? Amaa tinim nyɛla bɛn mali Masia tɛha.
en: Who has known the mind of the Lord, who will advise him? But we have the mind of Christ.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛtɔɣili ti yɛn yi n nol ni na, ka a pun mi li zaa.
en: Even before I speak, you already know what I will say.

dag: Di ni lan tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn soya golim ka bɛ biɛhigu bi tuhi nuu ni.
en: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o jaaŋgbee maa tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani maa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim yi wulimpuhili polo na n-ʒe dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka pɔhim maa ʒi toli na.
en: So Moses raised his stick, and the Lord caused a wind from the east to blow on the land all that day and all that night. By morning it had brought the locusts.

dag: do so ŋun zaŋ o dɔni maa ŋun bom anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu ti paɣisarili maa ba, ka paɣisarili maa leeg o paɣa, o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔni o maa zuɣu, o ka soli ni o yih o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: they will be forced to get married. He must give her father pieces of silver as a bride-price and can never divorce her.

dag: Musa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishom mini Ɛliɛza.
en: Moses had two sons, Gershom and Eliezer.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛda niŋbu yirila bɛ ni wum shɛl ni na, ka bɛ ni wum shɛli maa mi yirila Masia yɛla waazu yihibu ni na.
en: So then, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message comes through preaching Christ.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la kalinsi nyaaŋa, Juda Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu pahi dunia yili.
en: King Amaziah of Judah outlived King Jehoash of Israel by fifteen years.

dag: O ni daa niŋ lala maa ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli ni yi gbib la shɛhira ʒim.
en: Then he said, This is the blood that makes the agreement good—the agreement that God commanded you to follow.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi bimbin ni na yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa, a saria karibu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi.
en: And I heard the altar say, Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and just.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Mɔabnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi tiligi.
en: That day they killed about ten thousand of the best Moabite soldiers; none of them escaped.

dag: Hal maligumaaniba mini anabinim gba nyurila wain n-chani laana. Bɛ nyula wain maa mini binnyur kpɛma n-chani laani ka birim. Bɛ bi lan baŋdi ʒii nyabu gbinni, bɛ mi bi lan kariti saria din tuhi.
en: These also stagger from wine and stumble from beer: priest and prophet stagger from beer; they are confused by wine; they stray on account of beer; they err when receiving visions; they stumble when making judgments.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eleven years in Jerusalem.

dag: Shia Kasi yino m-beni, amaa ka o pina lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but the same Spirit gives them.

dag: ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo na la.
en: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.

dag: Gol so ŋun daa pahir ata ni ka bɛ daa piligi li gbilligbilli sɔŋbu, zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka bɛ daa sɔŋ li gbilligbilli maa naai.
en: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra;.
en: Then he said to his disciples, The size of the harvest is bigger than you can imagine, but there are few workers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali binshɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ binzahindigu zahim li, ka daa sabi binshɛɣukam tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ di saha maa.
en: Everything was counted and weighed, and a complete record was made at the same time.

dag: Nyin ka n vili gbibi, ka a nudirigu kul gbib ma ka n ku lu.
en: I stay close to you, and you hold me with your powerful arm.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa daa gbaai Firawuna kpamba maa shɛb dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zo n-kuli yiŋ yomyom.
en: Some of Pharaohs officials who took the LORDs word seriously rushed to bring their servants and livestock inside for shelter.

dag: Ka Juda daa nyɛ o paɣ Tɛma bihi Pɛrɛz mini Zɛra ba, ka Pɛrɛz nyɛ Hɛzirɔn ba, ka Hɛzirɔn mi nyɛ Ram ba.
en: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar. Perez was the father of Hezron. Hezron was the father of Aram.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ tiliginsim liɣiri maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ka zal o shɛm.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord s command and gave the silver to Aaron and his sons. He did it just as the Lord had told him.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi zaŋ viɛlim ŋɔ tatabo ti mɔri din be mɔɣu ni zuŋɔ n-kaai biɛɣu ka buɣim diri li ŋɔ, di chaŋ wula ka o ku ti yinim situra? Laabira, yi yɛda shiri pɔra!.
en: If God dresses grass in the field so beautifully, even though its alive today and tomorrow its thrown into the furnace, how much more will God do for you, you people of weak faith!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka yi nimaani; ka niriba pam daa dol o, ka o chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni zaa kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus heard about the plot against him, he went away from that place; and large crowds followed him. He healed all the sick.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Di yi nyɛla saha biɛla bee pam puuni, pa a kɔŋko gba, amaa bɛn zaa be kpe n-wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, n di bi zaɣisi ni yi zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ kul gbaai yihila zoligɔnim din lo ma ŋɔ.
en: Whether a short time or a long time, Paul answered, my prayer to God is that you and all the rest of you who are listening to me today might become what I am—except, of course, for these chains.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli Pita, Malim shili ka zaŋ a namda piri. Ka o niŋ lala. Ka o lan yɛl o, Zaŋm a binyɛrigu ye n-doli ma.
en: The angel continued, Get dressed. Put on your sandals. Peter did as he was told. The angel said, Put on your coat and follow me.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa zo nti kpe Afɛk, ka tiŋ maa gooni daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayopɔin bɛn kpalim. Ka Bɛnhadad gba daa zo nti kpe tiŋ maa ni sɔɣi.
en: The rest of the Syrian army ran back to Aphek, but the town wall fell and crushed , of them. Benhadad also escaped to Aphek and hid in the back room of a house.

dag: Ŋun chɛ soli bahi ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam, ka ŋunkam mi je ni bɛ kpah o zuɣu ni ni kpi.
en: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.

dag: n-zaŋ a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a ka nyɛ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm la nuu ni. Hal n naan zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mini Kalidianim nuu ni.
en: and give you to people you are afraid of, people who want to kill you. I will give you to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his soldiers.

dag: Ka Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm tuma maa zaa min o ni daa me yil shɛl la.
en: When the queen of Sheba saw how wise Solomon was, the palace he had built.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnhur ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la.
en: These were the twelve officers: The son of Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba;.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Nations will fight against other nations. Kingdoms will fight against other kingdoms.

dag: Salo maa ni daa ti wurim naai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim o sani bɔh o yɛtɔɣ ŋaha la yɛla.
en: When they were alone, the people around Jesus, along with the Twelve, asked him about the parables.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒini n-diri bindirigu maa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, m mini yinim bɛn laɣim diri ŋɔ ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: While they were at the table eating, Jesus said, I tell you that one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria. Ka o bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehu lay down with his ancestors. He was buried in Samaria. His son Jehoahaz succeeded him as king.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti du zuɣusaa m-pobilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirig o kpiŋkpama to Bɔziranima. Dindali maa Ɛdom tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi suhu ni be shɛm la.
en: Look! One who mounts up and soars like an eagle, who swoops down and spreads his wings over Bozrah. On that day, the heart of every soldier from Edom will be like that of a woman in the throes of labor.

dag: M mabihi n yɛri ya mi, Ʒim ni be niŋgbun shɛl ni ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni, ka din poori mi ku tooi be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: I tell you this, brothers and sisters: Our bodies of flesh and blood cannot have a part in Gods kingdom. Something that will ruin cannot have a part in something that never ruins.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla n-yɛli so, dindina ti yi ti bi niŋ a ni chɛ ka ti po ni ti niŋ shɛli maa, ti ku mali taali zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: We are making this agreement with you. But if you tell anyone about what we are doing, we will be free from this agreement.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yili yilli ŋɔ: Yilimiya yila yɛli di yɛla; Kɔbiliga, chɛ ka kom yi a ni na;.
en: Then the Israelites sang this song: Well, flow with water! Sing about it!.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi. Yi yi ʒi yi yinsi puuni, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla, ka yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo bee yi yi ti dɔni bee yi yi ti yiɣisi, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla.
en: Teach them to your children. Talk about them when you are at home and when you are away, when you are resting and when you are working.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina nti teei zani tiŋ maa dunol ni, ka Siria tɔbbihi bɛn daa yi Zɔba mini Rɛhɔb ni Tɔb ni Maaka na la mi laɣim ʒe mɔɣu ni mɔɣu ni.
en: The Ammonite troops came out and got ready to fight in front of the gate to their city. The Arameans from Zobah and Rehob and the soldiers from Tob and Maacah formed a separate group in the nearby fields.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim bɛn daa birigi chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa ka chɛ ma saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: In the past, the Levites left me when Israel turned away from me. Israel left me to follow their idols. The Levites will be punished for their sin.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti nya sagani sagbana ni, n ni teei alikauli shɛli din be man Yawɛ mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni, ka nyɛ din ku yiɣisi la yɛla.
en: When I see the rainbow in the sky, I will always remember the promise that I have made to every living creature.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tuumbiɛri taali ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu. Yi nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri. Yi nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ, ka lɛb yi nyaaŋa bir o!.
en: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord , the holy God of Israel.

dag: Ka Akishi daa yi bɔh o, Banim ka a lee liri zuŋɔ? Dauda yɛr o mi, Nɛgɛb din be Juda tiŋgban ni la nim ka n liri. Bee ŋun yɛli, Nɛgɛb din be Jɛramiil polo la nim ka n liri bee Nɛgɛb din be Kɛn tiŋgban ni la nim ka n liri.
en: When Achish asked, Where did you raid today? David would say, The southern plain of Judah, or The southern plain of the Jerahmeelites, or The southern plain of the Kenites.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o ba Izraɛl, Chɛ ka bia maa doli ma ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ, ka di chɛ ka ti mini ya ni ti bihi ŋɔ ku kpi.
en: Judah said to his father, Send the boy with me, and we will leave at once. Then none of us will starve to death.

dag: Yi zaŋdi bindir shɛŋa din saɣim maani sara n sara maligu bimbina zuɣu. Yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee saɣim li? Yi tɛhiya ni nira ni tooi ʒiɛm Yawɛ bindira dibu shee.
en: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, How have we embarrassed you? You have done it by saying, What's so great about the Lord 's altar.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi bɛ zɔnima laara nyabu zuɣu, bɛ bihi ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, saha shɛli Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib min o tɔbbihi zaa ni daa do Lakishi la ka o daa tim o tuumba Jɛrusalɛm Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Judanim zaa bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la sani nti yɛli ba.
en: Some time later, while Sennacherib and his army were still at Lachish, he sent the following message to Hezekiah and the people of Judah who were with him in Jerusalem:.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Naawuni, Ti tum alahichi, amaa ti suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, fam ti bahi; ka niŋ ti a ni bɔri ni a niŋ ti shɛm.
en: We have been unfaithful to you, the Israelites admitted. If we must be punished, do it yourself, but please rescue us from the Ammonites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zuɣulaan yino kam zaŋm o pina na ti malimi sara dahin yini kam, sara maligu bimbini maa zaŋ ti Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: The Lord told Moses, Each day one leader must bring his gift for the dedication of the altar.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka jɛra gbibi liɣiri ni bɛ da yɛm, ka lee nyɛ bɛn ka yɛm din ni tooi bɔhim?.
en: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?.

dag: Amaa ni a ni chaŋla n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Go back to my country, to my own people, to find a wife for my son Isaac. Bring her here to him.

dag: dama a yi dee li niŋ a kɔbili ni, ka di zaa be a noli ni, di viɛla.
en: and you will be glad if you remember them and can quote them.

dag: Chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana dol a fukumsi zaligunim min a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa, ka tumdi di tuma din ni chɛ ka o tooi me a jɛmbu du shɛli n ni pun bo nɛma zali ni di me ŋɔ.
en: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.

dag: Yisa daa piligi ŋahi niriba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa wain tihi n-zaŋ li niŋ padiriba nuu ni ni bɛ lihiri li hal ti kpuɣi puu maa atam ti o ka deei bɛ yɔri, ka daa go n-chaŋ tinshee ti yuui.
en: Jesus told the people this story: A man once planted a vineyard and rented it out. Then he left the country for a long time.

dag: Kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni fɔntin shɛŋa din baɣi li ni daa wurim shɛm la, lala ka di gba ni wurim; ka so ti ku lan be nimaani, ka so mi ti ku lan ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Edom will be destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them. No one will live there. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Ibram min o paɣa daa zaŋ bɛ ni su binshɛlikam zaa n-yi Ijipti chaŋ Nɛgɛb, ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ.
en: Abram and Sarai took everything they owned and went to the Southern Desert. Lot went with them.

dag: Dama a nyɛla tarimba ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be nandahima ni ni sɔɣiri so sani. A sani ka bɛ ni be ka sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli, ka wuntaŋ tulim gba ku paai ba. Putɔɣunim ni daa liriti niriba kaman kikaa saha sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: The poor and the helpless have fled to you and have been safe in times of trouble. You give them shelter from storms and shade from the burning heat. Cruel enemies attack like a winter storm.
