dag: Ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika n-niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya li nyu ka ti taba.
en: Then Jesus took a cup of wine. He gave thanks to God for it and said, Take this cup and give it to everyone here.

dag: Ka o ti ŋmahiŋmahi biŋkɔbigu maa n-tabil o zuɣu min o biŋkpam, ka maligumaana zaŋ li pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: After you cut it up, the officiating priest shall put on the fire all the parts, including the head and the fat.

dag: timiya binshɛɣukam din viɛla, ka yi tooi tum o yubu; ka lan chɛ ka yi tum din ni tiɣ o nini yi bebu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami.
en: equip you with every good thing to do his will, by developing in us what pleases him through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory forever and always. Amen.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Abimilɛk o tumtumdiba ni daa fa ŋun Ibrahimma kɔbil shɛl la yɛla.
en: Then Abraham complained to Abimelech because Abimelechs servants had captured a well of water.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ o na, ka o ni daa kana nti zani niriba maa sani, o daa wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: They ran and retrieved Saul from there, and when he stood up in the middle of the people, he was head and shoulders taller than anyone else.

dag: O ni darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. O suhu ni yiɣisi bah o dimnim zuɣu pam, ka o bɔhi ba biɛri. Hal o ni bɔhi bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ gba biɛri kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.

dag: Ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: Then Peter went outside and cried bitterly.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: No one was brave enough to ask him another question.

dag: Ka Ɛhab bɔh o, Ka banima n-lee yɛn gari tooni chaŋ ti liri ba? Ka anab maa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi la n-yɛn gari tooni. Ka Ɛhab lan bɔh o, Ka ŋuni nti lee yɛn piligi tɔb maa? Ka o yɛl o, Nyini.
en: Ahab said, Who will you use to defeat them? The prophet answered, The Lord says, The young men who carry the weapons for the government officials. Then the king asked, Who should command the main army? The prophet answered, You will.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa.
en: The workers made two chains from pure gold for the judgment pouch. The chains were braided like a rope.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu, ka nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri bidibbini. Nyin ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim zuliya kam, nyini ka n zaŋ ku nanima.
en: Babylonia, you were my hammer; I used you to pound nations and break kingdoms.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti yi Jɛrusalɛm chana, ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la chirig o sol ni. Anabi Ahija daa yɛla binyɛr palli; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kɔŋko daa be mɔɣu maa ni chana.
en: One day as Jeroboam was leaving Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh met him on the road. They were alone out in the country, and Ahijah was wearing a new coat.

dag: ka Hilikia nyɛ Shallum bia, ka Shallum nyɛ Zadok bia, ka Zadok nyɛ Ahitub bia.
en: son of Shallum, son of Zadok, son of Ahitub.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ʒim m-bala. Nanim maa ŋ-ŋmaligi zabi n-ku tab maa! Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, chamiya ti di nɛma.
en: They said, Its blood! The kings must have fought each other and killed themselves! Now get the plunder, Moab.

dag: Ka nahu kam mini piɛɣu kam ŋun pahiri pia ka nyɛ biŋkɔbigul ni guli so nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: All tenth-part gifts from a herd or flock—every tenth animal that passes under the shepherds staff—will be holy to the LORD.

dag: Ŋunkam nini nya ma ku lan nya ma yaha. A nina kul yɛn lihiri ma mi, ka n chaŋ.
en: The eye that sees me now will no longer look on me; your eyes will be on me, and I wont exist.

dag: Ka so yi paŋ biŋkɔbigu o kpee sani, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa, ka bindana maa kani, di simdi ka ŋun paŋ o maa yo o samli zaa;.
en: If anyone borrows an animal from someone else and it is injured or dies when its owner is not present, he must pay for it.

dag: O ni yɛn doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o ti lan yɛn ŋmaligi dol labi ka ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will go back the way he came, and he will not come into this city. The Lord says this.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a liɣiri paŋ o ka bɔri ni a niŋ nyɔri bee n-kɔhi bindirigu ti o ka niŋ nyɔri.
en: Do not make them pay interest on the money you lend them, and do not make a profit on the food you sell them.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ka ti kul ni jɛm, ka deeg o noli.
en: The people said, The Lord is our God, and we will worship and obey only him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, deem n suhigu. Yaakubu Naawuni, gbilisim tibili wum!.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbani n-wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim neesim mi wuhiri ba soli yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: God led them with the cloud by day; by the lightning all through the night.

dag: Dama cheechi toondana ni su Naawuni tuma fukumsi la zuɣu, di simdi ni o malila biɛrisuŋ; di bi simdi ni o nyɛla barinyura bee suhuyiɣisililana bee ŋun nyuri dam kuuna bee vubɔra bee ŋun suhu ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Nira ŋun bɔbi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nyamiya, bɛn bɔbiri bela nanim yinsi.
en: Really, what did you expect to see? Someone dressed in fine clothes? Of course not. People who wear fine clothes are all in kings palaces.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn turila binshɛŋa bɛ ni bi mi; ka binshɛŋa bɛ ni baŋ kaman biŋkɔbiri ni baŋdi shɛm mi nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: But these people criticize things they dont understand. They do understand some things. But they understand these things not by thinking, but by feeling, the way dumb animals understand things. And these are the things that destroy them.

dag: Shɛhiralan ŋun ʒe yim bi ŋmari ʒiri, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralan ŋun kul tuhirila ʒiri bahira.
en: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ so daa tuhir o soli na. O daa yɛla nɛma kaman pagɔrili la, ka o lihibu mali kɔre ni kukolimahim.
en: Suddenly, there she was in front of him, dressed like a prostitute. She had plans for him.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri. Bɛ ti ku wum amiliya mini aŋgo kukoya Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm solɔri zuɣu. Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti zani dabari.
en: The land will become a desert. In the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem I will put an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the happy sounds of wedding feasts.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋla sida dapaɣa n-kpahi tabili duu maa puuni dukpina gbinni zaŋ hal ti gbaai siiliŋ yɔɣira, ka zaŋ dari mali di puuni; ka zaŋ sipirɛs dapaɣa mi m-mali di puuni tiŋa.
en: The inside walls were covered with cedar panels from the floor to the ceiling, and the floor was made of pine.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli Ayuba sanʒiɛɣu puuni.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Job again from the storm:.

dag: Ka yi yi gbaai do so ka o zaŋ o kpee paɣ doya, yin kumiya bɛ niriba ayi maa; doo maa min o ni zaŋ paɣ so doya maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If a man is found having sexual relations with another mans wife, both of them must die—the woman and the man who had sexual relations with her. You must remove this evil from Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ammɔnnim naa daa ti kpi ka o bia Hanun daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Later King Nahash of the Ammonites died. His son Hanun became the new king after him.

dag: Babilɔn ni ti leela daboli doya, ka leei yɔbahi biɛhigu shee; di ni ti leela dabiɛm zɔbu mini ansarisi malibu tiŋa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Babylon will become a heap of ruins, a den of wild dogs, a wasteland with no one left in it.

dag: Teemiya bin shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ piligu ni ha la yɛla; dama mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani ŋmani ma.
en: Remember what happened long ago. Remember, I am God and there is no other God. There is no other like me.

dag: Naftali zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jaziil daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jaziilnima; ka Guni daŋ niriba nyɛ Guninima;.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Naphtali; they were from the clans of Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

dag: Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a yɛla tɔɣisi m mabihi maa; n ni paɣ a salo laɣiŋgu ni.
en: He even said to God, I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti yi o nyaandoliba piniyini bɛn daa kpalim la zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒimi diri bindirigu. Ka o daa galim ba bɛ ni nyɛ suhutunanim mini bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la yɛligu yɛda.
en: Later, Jesus appeared to the eleven followers while they were eating. He criticized them because they had so little faith. They were stubborn and refused to believe the people who said Jesus had risen from death.

dag: Zuŋɔ yi dim maa be Nɔb; o ni kpilim o nuu gahi Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm zol la gbini.
en: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di yi ti simdi ni n gba chaŋ, n ni pahi bɛ zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: If you think I should go along, they can go with me.

dag: Babilɔn ni ti leela daboli doya, ka leei yɔbahi biɛhigu shee; di ni ti leela dabiɛm zɔbu mini ansarisi malibu tiŋa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: That country will become a pile of ruins where wild animals live. It will be a horrible sight; no one will live there, and all who see it will be terrified.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn min o nyaandoliba ayi ʒiɛya;.
en: The next day, John was there again, and two of his followers were with him.

dag: Yawɛ ti ma bidibisi pam, ka m bidibisi maa zaa ni, Sulemaana ka Naawuni pii ni o ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee n-su Izraɛlnima.
en: He gave me many sons, and out of them all he chose Solomon to rule over Israel, the Lord 's kingdom.

dag: Amaa yiya din be tiŋkpan shɛŋa bɛ ni bi me goma gili ni, din mini puri din be mɔɣu ni ni ti nyɛla yim, bɛ ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, ka ni ti tooi lan deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: But houses in settlements that are unwalled will be considered as if they were country fields. They can be bought back, and they must be released at the Jubilee.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali maa nyɛla din muɣisir a ninsal taba, ka a wuntitali nyɛ din sɔŋd a ninsal taba.
en: The evil or good you do only affects other humans.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti chɛ ba ka leei dabari dɔni n-di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim saha shɛli bɛ ni ti lan ka di ni maa, dama bɛ ʒiɛm n zaligunima ka zaɣisi n zaligunim maa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: The land will be absent of them and will be enjoying its sabbaths while it lies devastated, free of them. They will be making up for their guilty deeds for no other reason than the fact that they rejected my regulations and despised my rules.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan kpi yaha; bɛ biɛhigu mini malaikanim biɛhigu ti kul yɛn nyɛla yim. Bɛ ti yɛn nyɛla Naawuni bihi bɛ ni nyɛ kum ni neebu bihi maa zuɣu.
en: or die. They will be like the angels and will be God's children, because they have been raised to life.

dag: Hal bɛ yi zaŋ takɔbi bee piɛma bee kpana bee baasali sua lir o bɛ ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: No sword or spear can harm it.

dag: kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm kurimbuni la.
en: He promised through his holy prophets long ago.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ binshɛɣukam ka yiɣisi dol o.
en: Levi got up, left everything, and followed Jesus.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋdila suɣili maa nti tiri zaani kpaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ sansani maa. O daa booni li la Yawɛ chirigibu shee, ka ŋunkam daa yi bɔri ni o bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ shɛli, o chanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini sansani maa kpaŋ maa ha.
en: Moses used to take a tent a short way outside the camp. He called it the meeting tent. Anyone who wanted to ask something from the Lord would go to the meeting tent outside the camp.

dag: Ka n daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu n-lihi nya binyila anahi ʒii shɛl ni yaha.
en: Then I looked up and saw four horns.

dag: Chɛli n ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bipalital ni la taali. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli min a nirilim zuɣu, teemi n yɛla!.
en: But dont remember the sins of my youth or my wrongdoing. Remember me only according to your faithful love for the sake of your goodness, LORD.

dag: Wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ. N kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim; ka kpuɣiri n nuhi zuɣusaa tiriti a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.

dag: ka lan wum o ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim nanima ayi la shɛlikam zaa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Nanima ayi maa n-nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa be Ashitarɔt la.
en: And we heard that he defeated the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan River. This was King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan in the land of Ashtaroth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ʒili naa dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn guli Lɛvinim yaɣili polo dunɔdal la gbini.
en: and for a long time they had been the guards at the King's Gate on the east side of the city. Before that, their ancestors guarded the entrance to the Levite camp.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma jilima. N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi leei m bia, ka n chɛ ka o nam mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam.
en: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.

dag: Fabila maa m-bala. Zaŋmiya li yili yila. Zuliya kam paɣiba ni zaŋ li yili yila. Bɛ ni zaŋ li yili yila Ijipti mini di tɔbbihi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is a sad song that people will sing for Egypt. The daughters in other nations will sing this sad song. They will sing it as a sad song about Egypt and all its people. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ishimail daa lan ku Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Gɛdalia sani mini Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Ishmael also killed all the Israelites who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah and the Babylonian soldiers who happened to be there.

dag: Di ŋmanila Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu maligim din zɔri luri Ziɔn Zoya zuɣu na. Dama nimaani ka Yawɛ lo alibarika alikauli din nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: It is like the dew on Mount Hermon streaming down onto the mountains of Zion, because it is there that the LORD has commanded the blessing: everlasting life.

dag: Ka o daa bi tooi baŋ o, dama o nuhi daa malila kɔbiri ŋ-ŋman o biɛli Iso nuhi. Ka o daa yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Isaac didnt recognize him because his arms were hairy like Esaus arms, so he blessed him.

dag: Yawɛ miri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri saɣim, ka tiligiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima.
en: The Lord is near to those who are discouraged; he saves those who have lost all hope.

dag: Ka Alikizanda mini Rufus ba ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini nira, ka o yuli booni Saimɔn la daa yi tinshee garita; ka bɛ daa bol o na nti muɣis o ni o ʒim Yisa dapulli maa.
en: Simon, a man from Cyrene, Alexander and Rufus father, was coming in from the countryside. They forced him to carry his cross.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinina ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li sani, amaa jɛrilim nyɛla din darigiri jɛra tibili.
en: Wisdom is a fountain of life to the wise, but trying to educate stupid people is a waste of time.

dag: Amaa n nyɛla ŋun be biɛrim mini nandahima ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka a tiliginsim yiko gbibi ma.
en: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔzuɣu ka a fiɛbi buŋ maa buta ŋɔ zaa? N kamina ni n ti gu a soli, dama m bi yu a ni chani chandi shɛli maa.
en: Then the Lord s angel asked Balaam, Why did you hit your donkey three times? I am the one who came to stop you. But just in time.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wulimpuhili polo tintariga daa kpuɣi chaŋ. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini maa, ka tintarisi ŋɔ zaa daa gili niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The Jordan was the eastern border. These were the borders of the land which the families of the tribe of Benjamin received as their possession.

dag: Mɔabnim zaa ni daa wum ni nanim shɛb kana ni bɛ ti tuhi ba, bɛ daa laɣimla bipola zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa bɛn ni tooi ye gbaɣinɔnim na nti sɔŋ bɛ tintariga.
en: Meanwhile, the people of Moab had heard that the three kings were coming to attack them. They had called together all of their fighting men, from the youngest to the oldest, and these troops were now standing at their border, ready for battle.

dag: A tɛhiya ni zuŋɔ ka m piligi bɔhiri Naawuni n-nyar o yɛla tir o? Naa, di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini n daŋ zaa so taali, dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa yɛla hal baabiɛla gba.
en: This isn't the first time I've talked with God for David, and it's never made you angry before! Please don't accuse me or my family like this. I have no idea what's going on.

dag: ni Ɛba ni Pɛlɛg ni Riu.
en: Eber, Peleg, Reu.

dag: Ka Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee. Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ lala.
en: The commander of the LORDs heavenly force said to Joshua, Take your sandals off your feet because the place where you are standing is holy. So Joshua did this.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ a dabili min o daŋ polo la niŋ pali ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: And now, Lord God, please do what you have promised me and my descendants.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu paag a sanna ka a tiligi ma kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ niŋgbuna ni paɣibu kal la m-paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.

dag: ni di chɛ ka alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na baŋ ŋun Naawuni yɛm soya balibubalibu ni nyɛ shɛm cheechi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: His purpose was that all the rulers and powers in the heavenly places will now know the many different ways he shows his wisdom. They will know this because of the church.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ni naa yuri ba, amaa Yawɛ sani ka nir nyari din niŋ kamaata.
en: Many people want the friendship of a ruler, but the Lord is the only one who judges people fairly.

dag: Ka sokam daa kpuɣ o laa m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu. Ka bɛ mini Musa ni Aduna daa zani Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: O daa yihi ti ti dimnim nuu ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He saved us from our enemies. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka di buɣisibu chɛriga ni ti yi nyaaŋa chaŋ katiŋa n-tuhi hal ni Garɛb daboli gbini, di nyaaŋa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ Gɔa.
en: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.

dag: O ni nyɛ ŋun be kasi la zuɣu, o ŋmanila kuɣ shɛli Juda zuliya mini Izraɛl zuliya ni tuuri lura; ka ŋmani tɔn shɛli din gbahiri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: God will become a sanctuary— but he will be a stone to trip over and a rock to stumble on for the two houses of Israel; a trap and a snare for those living in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa zaŋ o bia Ibram min o yaaŋa Lɔt ni Ibram paɣa Zarai m-pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ yi Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Haran n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot , and his son Abrams wife, Sarai his daughter-in-law. They left Ur of the Chaldeans for the land of Canaan, and arriving at Haran, they settled there.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yi ku nya pɔhim bee saa, amaa kom ni tɛli baa ŋɔ ni ka yi mini yi niɣi ni yi biŋkɔbiri nyu. .
en: You won't feel any wind or see any rain, but there will be plenty of water for you and your animals.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali buɣilimbuɣilimbihi n-zaŋ li yiliyili pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi din daa be alichɛbba maa tiŋli la sunsuuni ti tuui ka di daa be pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi maa sunsuuni.
en: They also made pure gold bells and sewed the bells between the pomegranates, all around the robes lower hem.

dag: Sulemaana daa tum din nyɛ alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi lan doli Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga kaman o ba Dauda la.
en: Solomon did what was evil in the LORDs eyes and wasnt completely devoted to the LORD like his father David.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihir shɛli Yisa ni daa wuhi pahi buyi, o ni daa yi Judia ka Galili na la.
en: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla jɛlinsi yɛtɔɣa m-muɣisiri ma, ka lu n zuɣu ka di ka daliri.
en: and hateful things are said for no reason.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti zaŋ nyin Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ n-zali zaashe tital ni ka a be kaman n nintu shɛli din dihiri gbana la, dama mani m-piig a. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, my servant, I have chosen you. I, the Lord , tell you that at that time I will use you like a signet ring to represent my authority! This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ li leei vuhim dabisili, ka piɛbi kikahi n-laɣim jɛm Naawuni.
en: to say to the people of Israel: The first day of the seventh month must be a day of complete rest. Then at the sound of the trumpets, you will come together to worship and to offer sacrifices on the altar.

dag: Dama yi kpimi ka yi nyɛviya pahi Masia zuɣu n-sɔɣi Naawuni ni.
en: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N suhu zaa kul yɛmi ni m mini ya laɣim di Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ bindirigu ka n naanyi di wahala.
en: He said to them, I have wanted so much to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer!.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiri ni ti yɛda niŋbu ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri: Yi yɛda ni kpaŋsi n suhu, ka n gba yɛda kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri.
en: What I mean is that we can mutually encourage each other while I am with you. We can be encouraged by the faithfulness we find in each other, both your faithfulness and mine.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni maar a suhu shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din pɔr a sani, bee zilimballi yɛtɔɣa maa m-pa shɛli a sani?.
en: Are Gods comforts not enough for you, a word spoken gently with you?.

dag: O zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba nambɔɣu; ka tiligiri nandaamba nyɛviya.
en: He has pity on the weak and poor; he saves the lives of those in need.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihinahi, ka mali yaansi bɛn nyɛ bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ daa bari bunsi pisopɔin. Abidɔn daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma anii.
en: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. Abdon led Israel for eight years.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni doo be o ko, n ni nam sɔŋda ŋun simd o ti o.
en: The Lord God said, It isn't good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable partner for him.

dag: Shɛma daa nyɛla Raham ba, ka Raham nyɛ Jokiam ba, ka Rɛkɛm mi daa nyɛ Shammai ba.
en: Shema was Rahams father. Raham was Jorkeams father. Rekem was Shammais father.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pinaayi, ka bɛ min o chaŋ Yaɣigari Chuɣu ni kaman bɛ daadiini kali soli ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: And when Jesus was twelve years old, they all went there as usual for the celebration.

dag: Bɛ nam maa ni ti gbarigi gari nam kam, ka bɛ ti ku lan duhi bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛba, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ kpalim biɛla din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan su zuliya shɛba yaha.
en: Out of all the kingdoms, it will be the lowliest. It will never again exalt itself over the nations, and I will make it small to keep it from ruling the nations.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhu yubu puuni bɛ tɔhiri kaman sokam ni o nyaŋbu tariga hal n-gari lala zuɣu gba.
en: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni zali zaligu, ka dam Izraɛlnim bɛn be zuliya kam tinsi ni. M mi yɛn niŋ ba mi kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la, hal ka kabiɛl yini gba ku lu tiŋa.
en: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.

dag: ka Sulemaana daa lab me Gɛza mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din be tiŋli polo la.
en: So Solomon had the town rebuilt. Solomon ordered his workers to rebuild Lower Beth-Horon.

dag: Yi ni ti biri, amaa ka ku kpuɣi atam. Yi ni ti kahim olivi kpam, amaa ka ku zaŋ kpam maa ʒe yimaŋa. Yi ni ti tɔɣi wain, amaa ka ku nyu wain maa.
en: You will sow grain, but not harvest the crop. You will press oil from olives, but never get to use it. You will make wine, but never drink it.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa chaŋ ti neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti; tiligim ti.
en: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan chɛ ka o shia siɣi ti zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban shɛli din kpi la leei tiŋgban shɛli din vuhira; ka puri atam niŋ pam.
en: But once more God will send us his spirit. The wasteland will become fertile, and fields will produce rich crops.

dag: Ka man Jɔn daa wum ka kukoli maa lan yɛli, Yinim alizanda ni nim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni Yisa tuumba ni anabinima, maliya suhupiɛlli o dahimbu maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni m-bɔh o biɛri tin ya maa.
en: Be glad, heaven, because of her destruction! Be glad, God's people and the apostles and prophets! For God has condemned her for what she did to you!.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ba kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni chana, o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ kpi kɔnyuri. O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na ka bɛ nyu.
en: They werent thirsty when he led them through the deserts. God made water flow from the rock for them; split the rock, and water flowed out.

dag: Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bituuli maa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi.
en: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: N Naawuni, n ni ŋme mɔɣilo paɣ a a ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; N ni ŋme mɔɣilo n-yili yila paɣi nyin Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: I will play the harp and praise you. My God, I will sing about your faithfulness. I will play songs on my lyre for the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ye bɛ ni zaŋ piɛkɔbiri mini gali piɛlli gari tab wuɣi situr shɛŋa.
en: Dont wear clothes that mix wool and linen together.

dag: lala ka a gba bi yi a pagɔrisigu tuma daɣiri ni. A ku lan yi a daɣiri maa ni hal ka n ti tum a n suhuyiɣisili tuma.
en: Jerusalem, your immoral actions have defiled you. Although I tried to purify you, you remained defiled. You will not be pure again until you have felt the full force of my anger.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu n ni bɔr a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God I pray for your prosperity.

dag: Ka naa daa ti chaŋ Gibiɔn ni o ti mali sara shɛli nimaani, dama nimaani n-daa nyɛ sara maligu shee din galisi pam. Sulemaana daa yi zaŋdila bɛ ni mali sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bin tuhili m-maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: The king went to the great shrine at Gibeon in order to sacrifice there. He used to offer a thousand entirely burned offerings on that altar.

dag: Ti ni daa lu soli chani Bashan saha shɛli ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa daa yina ti liri ti ni bɛ tuhi ti tɔbu Ɛdirɛi.
en: We turned and went on the road to Bashan. King Og of Bashan and all his men came out to fight against us at Edrei.

dag: N yɛm puuni ka n zaŋ baŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa. N daa yɛliya, N ni niŋ yɛndana, amaa ka m mini di shee ti wɔɣa.
en: I used my wisdom and thought about all these things. I wanted to be wise, but I couldnt do it.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ gbansabira.
en: Ahitubs son Zadok and Ahimelechs son Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka o mini ba naai noli, ka o lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ku ku ba. Ka Izraɛl kpamba gba daa lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ni ʒe alikauli maa nyaaŋa.
en: Joshua agreed to make peace with them. He agreed to let them live. The leaders of Israel agreed with this promise of Joshua.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun do teeku sunsuuni, ka ŋmani ŋun do ŋariŋ puuni daantaliga zuɣu.
en: You will be like one who lies down while out on the sea or one who lies on top of a mast.

dag: Teem ŋun nam a yɛla a bipolitali saha, ka wahala saha na bi paai, ka yuun shɛŋa ni a ni ti yɛn yɛli, M baɣa lan ka shɛl ni la gba saha na bi paai.
en: Keep your Creator in mind while you are young! In years to come, you will be burdened down with troubles and say, I don't enjoy life anymore.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ku tooi ba nir zali, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa kul ku vuɣi.
en: Wickedness does not give security, but righteous people stand firm.

dag: Teebuya anahi n-daa ʒe di puuni, ka diba anahi ʒe samban ni dunɔdali yaɣili. Teebuya anii n-daa nyɛ li, ka bɛ kɔriti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri di zuɣu.
en: So there were four tables on the inside wall and four tables on the outside wall—eight tables that the priests used when they killed the animals for sacrifices.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba na kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛri mini piɛlahi ni buhi tahiri nakɔha sani shɛm la.
en: Babylon will be like sheep, rams, and goats waiting to be killed. I will lead them to the slaughter.

dag: Di yi ti wali yuuni na di viɛla; ka di mi yi ti bi wali, man naanyi ŋmaa li luhi. .
en: Maybe the tree will have fruit on it next year. If it still does not produce, then you can cut it down.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ niŋ daɣiri yihibu kom niŋ bɛmaŋa daba ata dali mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka leei bɛn be nyam. Amaa bɛ yi bi niŋ lala daba ata mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa dali, bɛ ku leei bɛn be nyam.
en: But if you wash with the water mixed with the cow's ashes on the third day and again on the seventh day, you will be clean and acceptable for worship. You must wash yourself on those days; if you don't, you will remain unclean.

dag: Juda bidibisi daa nyɛla Ɛr mini Onan, bɛ zaa daa kpila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Judahs descendants: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti sɔ yi dini.
en: You can be sure that on the Judgment Day God will show more mercy to Sodom than to you.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ kpe Pɛɔr buɣili Baal jɛmbu ni. Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Baal of Peor. So the Lord was angry with them.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri pa o pumpɔŋɔ yɛra, N daa bi nya paɣipalitali shihirili yi bia maa sani. Amaa n-nyɛ m bipuɣiŋga maa paɣipalitali shihira. Di saha ka bɛ zaŋ tani yɛrigi sɔŋ tiŋ maa kpamba maa tooni.
en: Thats why he has spread false claims about her, saying, I couldnt find any proof that your daughter was a virgin. But look! Heres proof of my daughters virginity. At that point they will spread out the blanket in front of the citys elders.

dag: Ka ŋun yur o ba bee o ma gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma; ka ŋun yur o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: Those who love their father or mother more than me are not fit to be my disciples; those who love their son or daughter more than me are not fit to be my disciples.

dag: Ti Duuma pala ŋun bi niŋdi yomyom zaŋ chaŋ o daalikauli palibu polo kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni tɛhiri shɛm la, amaa o lee nyɛla ŋun mali suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama o bi yu ni so ti bahi yoli, amaa o bɔri ni sokam zaa lee niŋla tuuba.
en: The Lord is not being slow in doing what he promised—the way some people understand slowness. But God is being patient with you. He doesnt want anyone to be lost. He wants everyone to change their ways and stop sinning.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpalim be mɔɣu ni sɔɣisili shee din be Zif mɔɣu ni zoya tiŋgbɔŋ la ni. Ka Sool daa kul lihiri bɔr o dabisili kam, amaa ka Naawuni daa bi zaŋ o niŋ o nuu ni.
en: David stayed in hideouts in the hill country of Ziph Desert. Saul kept searching, but God never let Saul catch him.

dag: M bia, gbaam amaŋa ka chɛ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa.
en: My son, dont follow them. Dont even take the first step along that path.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la gba daa maan o ansarisi, ka zaŋ komihigu ti o ni o nyu.
en: The soldiers also mocked him. They came up to him, offering him sour wine.

dag: ka zaŋ o zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini niriba maa zaa tooni n-zaŋ o leei bɛ toondana bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Then go with him and tell him to stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the Israelites. Appoint Joshua as their new leader.

dag: Yi nyuri bari yɛra, Ti nyɛla tiŋ kasi la tiŋbihi, ka zaŋ timaŋ dalim Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: Yes, you call yourselves citizens of the holy city, those who depend on the God of Israel. The Lord All-Powerful is his name.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Dama sokam kul yɛri ma la yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa yɛla.
en: Why are you doing these awful things? he asked them. I've been hearing nothing but complaints about you from all of the Lord 's people.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Iin, Alaafee; N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, malimiya yimaŋa n-kana ti pahi n zuɣu sara maligu maa shee. Ka o daa chɛ ka Jɛsi min o bidibisi gba mali bɛmaŋa, ka o boli ba ni bɛ ka sara maligu maa shee na.
en: Yes, it is! Samuel answered. I've come to offer a sacrifice to the Lord . Get yourselves ready to take part in the sacrifice and come with me. Samuel also invited Jesse and his sons to come to the sacrifice, and he got them ready to take part.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du nti guhiri mɔɣu ni hal ka yi ti tim na ti yɛli ma lahibali din beni.
en: Meanwhile, I will wait at the river crossings in the wilderness until I receive news from you.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-zaŋ n noli tum alahichi din nyɛ n yɛli noli ni bɛ kpi.
en: I have never let my mouth sin by cursing my enemies and wishing for them to die.

dag: Siliga maa bela Makipɛla pu shɛli din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ibrahimma n-daa da siliga maa Ɛfurɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la sani n-leeg o dini ni di nyɛ o ni yɛn sɔɣir o kpiimba luɣ shɛli.
en: That cave is in the field of Machpelah near Mamre in the land of Canaan. Abraham bought that field from Ephron so that he could have a burying place.

dag: Daadam, chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm baŋ di ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Mortal man, he said, point out to Jerusalem what disgusting things she has done.

dag: Barinim pam bɛn gbarigi n-daa kul do lunfanim maa ni: Zoomba mini gbariti ni bɔɣukpimanima ni gbalikpimanima. Bɛ daa doya gulila kom maa dambu.
en: Many sick, blind, lame, and paralyzed people were lying close to the pool.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ, ka di nyom viɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will present an entirely burned offering to the LORD as a soothing smell: one bull from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old. They will be flawless.

dag: Dama o daa maanila Damaskusnim bɛn daa tuhi nyaŋ o la buɣa, ka yɛli, Siria buɣa maa n-daa sɔŋ Siria nanim maa ka bɛ tuhi nyaŋ ma maa, n gba ni maani ba ka bɛ sɔŋ ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ daa lee tahila mbusim na ti luhi o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: He offered sacrifices to the gods of the Syrians, who had defeated him. He said, The Syrian gods helped the kings of Syria, so if I sacrifice to them, they may help me too. This brought disaster on him and on his nation.

dag: Ka maligumaana ŋun yɛn yih o daɣiri ni maa ni zaŋ dilan mini binyɛra maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: The priest performing the purification will place these and the person needing purification before the LORD at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Solomon and the people dedicated the temple to the Lord by offering , cattle and , sheep as sacrifices to ask the Lord 's blessing.

dag: Ti yi saɣi ka bɛ be ti sani, bɛ niɣi mini bɛ binshɛɣukam ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa ku leei ti dini.
en: Just think! We'll get their property, as well as their flocks and herds. All we have to do is to agree, and they will live here with us.

dag: Ka tuumba ayi maa yɛli Reehab, Biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni niŋ a ni chɛ ka ti po ni ti niŋ shɛli maa.
en: The men said to her, We made a promise to you. But you must do one thing, or we will not be responsible for our promise.

dag: Ka Ahija daa ti gbaag o ni ye binyɛr shɛli maa n-dari tɔhi li zaɣ tolima pinaayi.
en: Ahijah tore his new garment into twelve pieces.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Baɣisimiya fiig tia wala na nti ʒe o bintɔrigu maa ka o nya alaafee.
en: Then Isaiah said, Prepare a bandage made of figs. They did so and put it on the swelling, at which point Hezekiah started getting better.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn be a tooni, o ni be a sani, o ku chɛ ka a kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛ a bahi. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies.

dag: Bɛ yi wum bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi be bɛ sani. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: They are people who refuse to obey, so they may not listen to you. But even if they dont stop sinning, at least they will know that there is a prophet living among them.

dag: Niriba ni nya a zaɣim, ka a di vi bɛ sani. N ni bɔhi biɛri, m mi ku tiligi so.
en: Your nakedness will be exposed, and your disgrace will be seen. I will take vengeance; no one will intervene.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi ka di daa lu o suhu ni ni o lab ti kaag o zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim la.
en: When Moses was years old, he wanted to help the Israelites because they were his own people.

dag: Baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo mali ma alahiziba pam. Di galisiya yaɣi ka n ku tooi baŋ li.
en: Your knowledge of me is too deep; it is beyond my understanding.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ʒiri pina kani Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiri Yawɛ, ka tiri Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia neen viɛla ka di daa chɛ ka zuliya kam tibig o di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: Many people brought gifts for the Lord to Jerusalem. They brought valuable things to King Hezekiah of Judah. From that time on, all the nations respected Hezekiah.

dag: dindina o ni tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha dɛde, saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini saa ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa, ka yi puri atam niŋ pam, ka yi nya wain mini kpam.
en: he will send rain at the right seasons, so you will have more than enough food, wine, and olive oil, and there will be plenty of grass for your cattle.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Dauda bia Sulemaana dabili ŋɔ ti zaɣis a duuma.
en: Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against Solomon, his king.

dag: Naawuni, a pun buɣisi ti nya. A nyahi ti zaa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi anzinfa shɛri buɣim ni m-maani li shɛm la.
en: But you, God, have tested us— youve refined us like silver.

dag: Dama n shiri ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ takɔbi ku a, amaa a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili zo n-tiligi, a ni niŋ ma naani la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will keep you safe, and you will not be put to death. You will escape with your life because you have put your trust in me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla neen yinsi din nyɛ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tum tuun yinsi maa n wuɣi shɛlɔrigu niŋ di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: They wove the cloth belt and fastened it to the ephod. It was made the same way as the ephod—they used gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa puuni, so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi ya soli. So mi ka yi ni wumsi bi shɛb maa zaa puuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi vɔn ya.
en: There is no one to lead you, no one among your people to take you by the hand.

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Jaakan. Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Uzi mini Aran.
en: Ezers sons were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan. Dishans sons were Uz and Aran.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini fukumsi zaligu dolibu gbib o niriba zaa.
en: David ruled over all Israel and maintained justice and righteousness for all his people.

dag: Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a yɛra, Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A kɔŋko n-nyɛ n ni bɔri so dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Lord , I cry to you for help; you, Lord , are my protector; you are all I want in this life.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma daa zani n nyaaŋa, ka ti ma yaa ka m mol lahibal suŋ molo zaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa wum li. Ti Duuma daa yihi ma gbuɣinli nol ni.
en: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.

dag: Dama Jɛrɔbɔam min o bidibisi daa kari ba mi ni bɛ di lan tum Yawɛ maligumaaniba tuma. Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ tiŋgbana ni n-chɛ bɛ binshɛɣukam ka kuli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: And since Jeroboam and the kings of Israel that followed him would not allow any Levites to serve as priests, most Levites left their towns and pasturelands in Israel and moved to Jerusalem and other towns in Judah.

dag: Bɛna n-daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba, ka sokam min o tizo daa pihi kuɣu sɔŋ lihi nya jɛmbu duu tuma maa kaman bɛ mabihi Aduna bihi la gba ni daa niŋ shɛm Dauda mini Zadok ni Ahimɛlɛk ni bɛ daŋ ni kpamba ni maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim zaa ninni la.
en: Both the household head and his youngest brother cast lots, just as their relatives, Aarons descendants, had done in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the priestly and levitical households.

dag: A yi yɛli niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ bɔh a, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ kara ŋɔ zaa jɛndi ti? Ti taali lee nyɛla dini? Alahichi bɔ ka ti lee tum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: When you proclaim all these things to the people, and they ask you, Why has the LORD pronounced such massive devastation against us? What have we done wrong? How have we sinned against the LORD our God.

dag: Nir yi zaɣisi zaligu dolibu, hal dilan wunsuhigu nyɛla din chihira.
en: If you do not obey the law, God will find your prayers too hateful to hear.

dag: N ni yɛn niŋ kpe ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kpe ŋɔ shɛm m-bala. N ni niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ka di be kaman Tɔfɛt la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will do this to these people and to this place. I will make this city like Topheth. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Filistianim ni daa ti wum ni Dauda ka bɛ zaŋ leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka bɛ zaa daa yi n-gbaai Dauda shee bɔbu, amaa ka Dauda daa wum di yɛla ka chaŋ ti be birini la ni.
en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they all marched up to find him, but David heard of it and went down to the fortress.

dag: Nyum amaŋmaŋ kɔduɣu ni kom din yi amaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga puuni na.
en: Now, about sex and marriage: Drink only the water that comes from your own well.

dag: Ka n daa lan yɛli ba n Naawuni nuu ni pa n zuɣu shɛm mini naa ni daa yɛli ma shɛm yɛla. Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, Chɛliya ka ti yiɣisi piligi di mɛbu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kpalanzuya gbini taba.
en: I told them that my God had taken care of me, and also told them what the king had said to me. Lets start rebuilding! they said, and they eagerly began the work.

dag: Ka Judanim daa yɛli, Ʒiʒiriba gbarigiya; ka saɣiri pam mi beni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti kɔŋ gooni maa mɛbu.
en: And so at that time the people of Judah said, The workers are becoming tired. There is too much dirt and trash in the way. We cannot continue to build the wall.

dag: Ka niriba daa tumdi alahichi nimaani, ka chɛ dabisili kam sara maligu maŋli malibu, ka bɛ daa daai yɛlimaŋli luhi. Ka yilli maa daa kul diri nasara di ni tumdi shɛlikam ni.
en: Because of this sin, the daily sacrifices were stopped. Truth was thrown down to the ground. The little horn did these things and was very successful.

dag: Di saha bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya; ka bɛn ti be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, bɛn ti yim di ni, ka tiŋkpannim mi di ti ka di ni na.
en: If you are living in Judea at this time, run to the mountains. If you are in the city, leave it. And if you are out in the country, don't go back into the city.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisinahi.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Zebulun were .

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ninvuɣ biɛri biɛhigu shee ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, lala n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: This is what will happen to the homes of those who are evil. This is the place of those who dont know God.

dag: Nir yi na bi wum yɛtɔɣili bahigu ka daŋ garigibu, di nyɛla jɛrilim mini vi.
en: Listen before you answer. If you don't, you are being stupid and insulting.

dag: Tiŋgbɔna ŋɔ buɣa zaa banim, na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔna bahi, ka Yawɛ ti fari Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahira? .
en: None of the gods of these other places were able to save their land from me! So why do you think the Lord can save Jerusalem from me?.

dag: Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa. Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa.
en: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.

dag: Nyaandol maa n-nyɛ ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira ni ŋun sabi dimbɔŋɔnim ŋɔ, ka ti mi ni o shɛhira maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: That follower is the one who is telling these things. He is the one who has now written them all down. We know that what he says is true.

dag: ni o ni daa chɛ ka Musa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa ni o ni daa wuhi yiko din mali dabiɛm Izraɛlnim zaa ninni shɛm la.
en: as well as all the extraordinary power that Moses displayed before Israels own eyes!.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bɔri ni bɛ ku o ka di lahibali ti nti to Rom sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa su nimaani ni Jɛrusalɛm zaa damya.
en: The people were about to kill Paul when the Roman army commander heard that all Jerusalem was starting to riot.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul bela luɣilikam, ka o yuuni ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma.
en: The Lord sees what happens everywhere; he is watching us, whether we do good or evil.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba laɣiŋgunim daa laɣim yi luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Nɛtɔfa tiŋkpansi.
en: The singers also gathered together both from the region around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa ti giri zaŋ chaŋ Amnɔn kum maa polo, o ni daa nya ka o lan kani maa zuɣu, ka o suhu lan yu ni o kari Absalom naba.
en: but when he got over Amnon's death, he was filled with longing for his son Absalom.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti faai siɣ o o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yiŋa, ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: So Manasseh died and was buried with his ancestors. The people buried Manasseh in his own palace. Manassehs son Amon became the new king in his place.

dag: A ni yiɣisi zo Ziɔn nambɔɣu, dama saha paaya ni a niŋ li nirilim; di saha maa mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: You will rise and take pity on Zion; the time has come to have mercy on her; this is the right time.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka lan zaŋ tana ayɔbu la she n-tuɣi taba di ko.
en: These eleven sections were joined to make two panels, one with five and the other with six sections.

dag: Ka daliri din chɛ ka o daa leei Naa Sulemaana dim maa m-bɔŋɔ: Sulemaana daa mɛla Millo gooni ŋari foliŋga din daa be o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni la.
en: This is the story of why Jeroboam fought against the king: Solomon had built the stepped structure and repaired the broken wall in his father Davids City.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim maa zaa zaŋ Shihɔr din daa be Ijipti la hal ti kpa garibu shee din be Lɛbohamat la ni bɛ chaŋ Kiriatijiarim ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: So David assembled the people of Israel from all over the country, from the Egyptian border in the south to Hamath Pass in the north, in order to bring the Covenant Box from Kiriath Jearim to Jerusalem.

dag: O yiko ka o zaŋ su nam sahakam, ka pa o nina lihiri zuliya kam. Duŋtaariba miri ka bɛ taai duŋ niŋ o.
en: God rules with power forever; keeps a good eye on the nations. So dont let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka jahi m-be o puli ni.
en: The time came for Tamar to give birth. She was going to have twins.

dag: ka zaŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla n-tuɣili di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: He burned sweet-smelling incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ ti ku nyɛ yi duɣu, ka yi mi ti ku nyɛ nimdi be di ni. N ni kari ya saria la Izraɛl tintariga.
en: The city wont be your cooking pot, and you wont be the meat in it. At Israels borders, I will judge you.

dag: Bɛ leela ninvuɣ diɣilima bɛn bi zɔri vi. Bɛ tumdila kɔr biɛri tuma, ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla daɣiri tuma balibu kam tumbu zuɣu.
en: They are people who lack all sense of right and wrong, and who have turned themselves over to doing whatever feels good and to practicing every sort of corruption along with greed.

dag: O ni ti nyɛla suhudoolana. Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti liri ti, ti ni chɛ ka piɛguliba ayopɔin mini niriba anii shɛb ti ni zaŋ leei nanima la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: He will bring a time of peace. Yes, the Assyrian army will come into our country and march through our land. But we have plenty of leaders we can send against them.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnima, Pɔhim tulli ni ti yi n sani daboya zuɣusaa n-ʒe n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti ʒe n-kpa n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ polo, di pala pɔhim shɛli din ni yɛli binyara bee din ni pɔbisi binyara saɣiri chaŋ.
en: The time is coming when the people of Jerusalem will be told that a scorching wind is blowing in from the desert toward them. It will not be a gentle wind that only blows away the chaff—.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa teei bɛ nuhi tirina n-vooi Lɔt kpɛhi duu bɛ sani, ka yo dunoli.
en: The men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house with them and slammed the door.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun tum zina, o ka yɛm. Ŋun tum lala o saɣim omaŋa.
en: He who commits adultery is senseless. Doing so, he destroys himself.

dag: Ka zuliya gari ni kana ti be Ashidɔd. Ka n siɣisi Filistianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la.
en: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun niŋdi nirilim nyari jilima, amaa do so ŋun vari gindi ni leei bundana.
en: A gracious woman gains honor; violent men gain only wealth.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binzahi maa diba anu n-zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ diba anu zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nuzaa polo; ka zaŋ kɔniŋdi bin la mi zali nudirigu polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo.
en: He placed five of the carts on the south side of the Temple, and the other five on the north side; the tank he placed at the southeast corner.

dag: ka Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Hivi nira, ka lan nyɛ tiŋ maa ni naa la bia Shɛkɛm daa nya o gbaag o ti zaŋ o saɣim dih o vi.
en: When Shechem the son of the Hivite Hamor and the countrys prince saw her, he took her, slept with her, and humiliated her.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣim yuma ayopɔin maa bindira zaa din daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-sɔŋ fɔntinsi ni, ka laɣim fɔntiŋ kam ni puri ni bindira n-sɔŋ lala tinsi maa ni.
en: all of which Joseph collected and stored in the cities. In each city he stored the food from the fields around it.

dag: Yɛm shee wɔɣa, ka di biɛhigu shee zilim pam; ka di bo n-nya to pam.
en: The truth is beyond us. It's far too deep.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, yin puhimiya di chuɣu maa.
en: When you enter the land that the LORD has promised to give you, be sure that you observe this ritual.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi nayili pu shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried in Uzza Garden near his palace, and his son Amon became king.

dag: Yawɛ moli molo gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yɛli: Yɛlimiya Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, nyama, a tiligira kana, ka laara mini yɔri be o sani.
en: That the Lord is announcing to all the earth: Tell the people of Jerusalem That the Lord is coming to save you, Bringing with him the people he has rescued.

dag: Dauda daa nyɛla Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Ɛfirat daŋ ni nira, ka be Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgban ni la. O daa malila bidibis anii. Sool ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛsi daa kurigiya pam.
en: David was the son of Jesse, who was an Ephrathite from Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons, and at the time Saul was king, he was already a very old man.

dag: dama ŋunkam bi galindi ti bela ti polo.
en: Anyone who isn't against us is for us.

dag: Nyama, niriba yi nuzaa polo kanna. Zuliya din mali kpiɔŋ mini nanim pam yi dunia yaɣa din be katiŋa n-damdi li kanna.
en: Look! An army is on the move from the northern regions. A powerful nation and many kings are coming from the ends of the earth.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ banim paɣiba doon a ni. Bɛ muɣisiri paɣ shɛb bɛn nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai m-mali ba doon a ni.
en: In you a fathers nakedness is uncovered. In you menstruating women are violated.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi bɛn Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim maa nɛma mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ.
en: So Kedorlaomer and his armies took everything that the people of Sodom and Gomorrah owned. They took all their food and clothing and left.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi ba, Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ ti paag o lua saha pala awa pinaayi? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam chani wuntaŋ ni bi tuura, ka di nyɛla o ni nyari dunia ŋɔ neesim la zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, A day has twelve hours, doesn't it? So those who walk in broad daylight do not stumble, for they see the light of this world.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li mali sara maa Yawɛ tooni n-yo paɣa maa daalahichi samli, di nyaaŋa ka paɣa maa ni yi o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri maa ni. Zaligu ŋɔ gbibila paɣ so ŋunkam dɔɣi bia di yi nyɛla bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga.
en: The priest shall present her offering to the Lord and perform the ritual to take away her impurity, and she will be ritually clean. This, then, is what a woman must do after giving birth.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli din zaŋ di nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni n-jɛmd o, n ni chɛ di zuliya maa ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ be nimaani kɔra. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But any nation that puts its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will let stay in its land to till it and live on it, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa kpaai kom maa n-niŋ laakumnim maa kɔnyuribin ni yomyom, ka lan guui lab kɔbiliga maa ni ni o ti ŋɔŋ na yaha n-daa ŋɔŋ kom ti o laakumnim maa zaa.
en: She quickly emptied her jar into the animals' drinking trough and ran to the well to get more water, until she had watered all his camels.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ, Nyin Yawɛ, a daa yɛli ma, Labim a ya min a dɔɣiriba sani ka n niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Jacob said, LORD, God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, who said to me, Go back to your country and your relatives, and Ill make sure things go well for you.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini ni ŋun fari ma bahira.
en: The Lord is my protector; he is my strong fortress.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara, n ni ti chɛ ka o di nyɛvili ti shɛli din be Naawuni yil la wala.
en: If you have ears, then, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches! To those who win the victory I will give the right to eat the fruit of the tree of life that grows in the Garden of God.

dag: Naawuni n-daa mali bimparilana maa, ka sabbu maa nyɛ Naawuni sabbu, ka o daa chirigi li pa bimparilana maa zuɣu.
en: God himself made the stones, and God himself wrote the commandments on them.

dag: N daa kuhi boli n zɔnima, amaa ka bɛ yɔhim ma. M maligumaaniba mini n kpamba daa kpila tiŋ maa ni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bɔri bindirigu ni bɛ di n-nya yaa la.
en: I called to my lovers, but they deceived me. My priests and my elders have perished in the city; they were looking for food to survive.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa vuhim yuuni maa ni ti niŋ bindira tin ya, yi mini yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba mini dɔbba ni yi ni bu shɛb paa ni san kam ŋun be yi sani.
en: The land will have a year of rest, but you will still have enough food. There will be enough food for your men and women servants. There will be food for your hired workers and for the foreigners living in your country.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Yɛhudianim jɛmbu du shɛl ni wuhiri niriba Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so mini bɛn daa pah o zuɣu ʒiɛya guli Yisa maa ni daa nya tiŋgbani dambu maa mini din niŋ maa, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and what had just happened, they were filled with awe and said, This was certainly Gods Son.

dag: Dama bɛ tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa nyɛla diribarilimnima bɛn suhuri kul yɛla zalinsi dibu zuɣu. Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: All the people of Israel want more and more money. All of them, from the least important to the most important, are like that. Even the prophets and priests tell lies.

dag: ni Nibishan ni Yalim Tiŋ la ni Ɛngɛdi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara ayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Nibshan , and En-gedi. In total: six cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: A chɛ ka kɔbil nina kom puhiri yiri vinvama ni na n-zɔri gariti daboya sunsuuni.
en: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Zadok mini Itama bia Ahimɛlɛk daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o piripiri Aduna bidibisi maa kaman bɛ talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: King David organized the descendants of Aaron into groups according to their duties. He was assisted in this by Zadok, a descendant of Eleazar, and by Ahimelech, a descendant of Ithamar.

dag: Man Yisa n-tim m malaika ni o zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ na nti ti cheechinima. N nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa ni biɛŋmariga ŋun ne.
en: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to bear witness to all of you about these things for the churches. Im the root and descendant of David, the bright morning star.

dag: M puhiri Andurɔnikus mini Junias bɛn nyɛ n zuliya mini n sarikakpɛritab la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali jilima tuumba ni, ka nyɛ bɛn daŋ ma Masia yɛda niŋbu.
en: Say hello to Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners. They are prominent among the apostles, and they were in Christ before me.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa zaa ni daa yiri tiŋ maa ni, bɛ daa zanila yili shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: So the king left, with all his people following him, and they stopped at the last house.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yinim yidaannima, benya yɛm biɛhigu ni yi paɣiba, ka mi ni bɛ kpiɔŋ bi paai yi dini, ka timiya ba jilima yi mini ba zaa ni ti yɛn laɣim deei pin suŋ din nyɛ nyɛvil la zuɣu. Niŋmiya lala ka shɛli ku gu yi wunsuhigu soli.
en: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi piɛlabil ŋun la zuɣu mali sara zaawuni kaman asiba din la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: The second lamb you will offer at twilight like the grain offering and the drink offering in the morning. You will offer a food gift that is a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Di lan yɛli: Kuɣili maa nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka niriba tuui; di lan nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Din chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu maa nyɛla bɛ ni bi niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda la zuɣu, ka di mi nyɛla Naawuni ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: For them he is also a stone that makes people stumble, a rock that makes people fall. Isaiah : People stumble because they dont obey what God says. This is what God planned to happen to those people.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb yila katinsi na, dinzuɣu n yi chɛ ka bɛ kuli ni kum bɛ ni ti tarigi sol ni.
en: If I send them away hungry to their homes, they wont have enough strength to travel, for some have come a long distance.

dag: Ka o nyamma daa yɛligi ka o leei bundana.
en: Isaac grew richer and richer until he was extremely wealthy.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya malaika so ka o tam teeku kom zuɣu mini dul la daa kpuɣ o nudirigu zuɣusaa.
en: Then the angel that I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

dag: Dama bɛ zo n-kpɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka niŋ yomyom ni bɛ ku niriba.
en: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.

dag: Harim — kɔbisita ni pisi.
en: from the town of Harim:.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ yɔhindiba pam be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣi ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na. Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛl lala nyɛla ninvuɣ yɔhinda ni Masiachihira.
en: Many false teachers are in the world now. They refuse to say that Jesus Christ came to earth and became a man. Anyone who refuses to accept this fact is a false teacher and the enemy of Christ.

dag: Nyini n-su zuɣusaa, ka su tiŋgbani gba; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, nyini n-daa nam li.
en: Heaven is yours, the earth also; you made the world and everything in it.

dag: N kul nɛla yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka m bɔhim a daalikaulinim yɛla.
en: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di ku lan yuui ka a dɔni pah a yaannim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa niriba ŋɔ ni ti saɣim bɛmaŋa n-jɛmdi tinzun buɣa din be bɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni chani tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni buɣa. Bɛ ni ti zaɣisi ma ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl la.
en: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya do so ŋun yɛli ma binshɛɣukam zaa n ni pun niŋ. Pa ŋuna n-ni nyɛ Masia la.
en: Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah.

dag: N daa jɛmdi ti Duuma ni maŋsiɣisibu mini nintam m-pahi muɣisigu shɛŋa n ni daa nyari Yɛhudianim ni daa dooni guri ma sol la zuɣu.
en: With all humility and many tears I did my work as the Lord's servant during the hard times that came to me because of the plots of some Jews.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo wuhiri ni di bi tuhi ni nir kpuɣ paɣa bee n-diri bindira balibu shɛŋa Naawuni ni nam ti salinima ni bɛn niŋ yɛda ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli la diri li ka paɣiri ŋun Naawuni di zuɣu la.
en: Such people teach that it is wrong to marry and to eat certain foods. But God created those foods to be eaten, after a prayer of thanks, by those who are believers and have come to know the truth.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛl o, Doli ma kuli Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti gbib a.
en: David said to him, Cross the river and go to Jerusalem with me. I will take care of you.

dag: Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni la zaa daa ka Gɛdalia sanna Mizipa.
en: After this, Johanan and the leaders of the soldiers who had not surrendered came to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ paɣi dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa, ka o lan kpari li niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyakim daa ti kani ka o bia Jɛhoyachin di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoiakim died and was buried with his ancestors. His son Jehoiachin became the new king after him.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka niriba pam bɛn daa ka chuɣu maa ni na wum ni Yisa kani Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The next day the large crowd that had come to the Passover Festival heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan po pɔri tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ni wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: So I made another promise to those people in the desert. I promised to scatter them among the nations, to send them to many different countries.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu hal ti tarigi; amaa m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.

dag: dama o daa yɛli o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shihi o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She had said to herself, If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.

dag: Adiini alali din nyɛ din ka galimi ti Ba Naawuni sani nyɛla kpibisi mini pakoya lihibu bɛ wahala ni mini maŋgbaabu zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gabisiri niriba la polo.
en: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuna n-tiri nandaamba pina pam luɣilikam. O nirilim niŋbu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Scriptures say, God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ yaɣ shɛli polo katiŋa nti du n-tam zoli zuɣu ka o mini ba daa danigi tab pam.
en: David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of a hill with considerable distance between them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam o ni yɛn leei naa deemba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ni zali saha shɛli maa daa ti yɛn paai.
en: The officials told David, and David wanted to marry the princess. King Saul had set a time limit, and before it ran out.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla anzinfa viɛlli yi Speen na, ka zaŋ salima yi Ufaz na. Di nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba mini salindooriba nuhi tuma. Di situra nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa mini zaɣ ʒiɛhi. Di zaa nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba ni mali binshɛŋa.
en: Their idols are covered with silver from Spain and with gold from Uphaz, all the work of artists; they are dressed in violet and purple cloth woven by skilled weavers.

dag: N nyaya ka daba bari yuri, ka chɛ ka nabihi chani tiŋa kaman daba la.
en: they let slaves ride on horses, but force slave owners to walk.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi ŋmaligi kpa bɛ Naawuni polo. Dama yolimyolim maa pun kpe bɛ kɔbili ni, ka bɛ bi lan mi Yawɛ.
en: The evil that the people have done keeps them from returning to their God. Idolatry has a powerful hold on them, and they do not acknowledge the Lord .

dag: Ka di yi kahigi wuhi bɛn ʒiya maa ni so ni o wuhi shɛli, yin chɛliya ka ŋun tuui tɔɣisirila fo;.
en: And if some revelation comes to someone else who is sitting down, the first one should be quiet.

dag: Di teeri ya binshɛŋa din daa niŋ ka di yuui yɛla bee n-lihiri binshɛŋa din daa pun niŋ kurimbuni ha la.
en: But the Lord says, Do not cling to events of the past or dwell on what happened long ago.

dag: Amaa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Naa Amɔn nyaaŋa maa zaa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia leei naa zal o zaani.
en: But the people of Judah killed the murderers of Amon and made his son Josiah king.

dag: Bɛ kul ku tam nandaamba yɛla sahakam; ka faranim tahima niŋbu mi kul ku kpalim yoli sahakam.
en: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.

dag: Di saha ka Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar maa daa lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma. Di nyaaŋa ka Shafan daa karim li wuhi naa.
en: But there's something else, Your Majesty. The priest Hilkiah gave me this book. Then Shaphan read it aloud.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka a tuma ti ma suhupiɛlli; a ni tum tuun shɛŋa chɛ ka n yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.

dag: Kaman piɛguliba ni vihiri bɔri bɛ piɛri shee shɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti wurim kpe yɔɣu la, lala ka n yɛn bo m piɛri maa shee. Sagbani mini zibisim titali dali, n ni lihi bo ba bɛ ni daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-tiligi ba.
en: As a shepherd seeks out the flock when some in the flock have been scattered, so will I seek out my flock. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered during the time of clouds and thick darkness.

dag: Yi yi ti lo noli n-nahim yimaŋa, lala nolɔbo ka n zali? Di nyɛla yi silim yi zuɣuri tiŋa kaman gbiŋgbama la, ka pili buri n-teei do tampiligim ni? Dina ka yi booni nolɔbo? Yi tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ni saɣi deei di dabisili maa?.
en: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabinim mini wuntizɔriba pam suhuri daa yɛmi ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bi nya li; ka bɛ suhuri daa lan ye ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka daa bi wum li.
en: I assure you that many prophets and righteous people wanted to see what you see and hear what you hear, but they didnt.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣ ti la Yɛhudianima, ka ti pala bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ.
en: Indeed, we are Jews by birth and not Gentile sinners, as they are called.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋumbɔŋɔ amiliya dakulo ŋɔ naai pɔi, ka ti zaŋ ŋuni maa gba ti a, ka a tum tuma o zuɣu ti ma yuma ayopɔin pahi.
en: After you spend this week with Leah, you may also marry Rachel. But you will have to work for me another seven years.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa be Yisifu sani ka niŋ o nirilim, ka chɛ ka dansarika gul maa suhu yu o.
en: The Lord was with Joseph and continued to show his kindness to him, so the commander of the prison guards began to like Joseph.

dag: Yɛlim Nɛgɛb nyɔŋ maa, Wummi Yawɛ yɛligu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: N ni niŋ buɣim juug a ka di di ti mahili kam mini ti kuŋ kam din be a ni. Ka di buɣim zilima ti ku kpi, ka di ni ti wɔbi nudirigu polo mini nuzaa polo nim zaa nina ni.
en: that I, the Lord God, will start a fire that will burn up every tree, whether green or dry. Nothing will be able to put out the blaze of that fire as it spreads to the north and burns everything in its path.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam maa, bɛ zaŋm daɣiri ni yibu sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim tampiligim niŋ tahili ni, ka booi kɔzɔrim kom niŋ di ni;.
en: For the unclean person, they will take some of the ashes of the purification offering and place fresh water with it in a jar.

dag: ka bɛ suhuri ti lɛbigi bɛ ni gbahi ba daba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba ka fabili niŋ a bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, ka birigi, ka tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: listen to your people's prayers. If there in that land they repent and pray to you, confessing how sinful and wicked they have been, hear their prayers, O Lord .

dag: Kaman ninvuɣ fariba ni sɔɣi doya guli so shɛm, lala ka bɛ maligumaaniba gba laɣim doya. Bɛ kula niriba sol ni hal ni Shɛkɛm. Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: The priests are like gangs of robbers hiding and waiting on the road to attack someone. They murder people before they reach safety in Shechem. They do such evil things.

dag: Ka timanim gba daa niŋ bɛ tabibi ni bɛ chɛ ka pɔri yina, ka wolim je. Ka pɔri maa daa kul dimdi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: The religious experts tried to produce lice by their secret knowledge, but they werent able to do it. There were lice on people and animals.

dag: Di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di simdi ni yi baŋ lala. Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya ka vi gbahi ya, ka yi kɔba ni chɔɣisi yi tuma maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord GOD says, I want you to remember this: I am not doing these things for your good! I am doing them for my good name. Family of Israel, you should be ashamed and embarrassed about the way you lived.

dag: amaa chamiyala Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la sani.
en: Instead, you are to go to the lost sheep of the people of Israel.

dag: ni o ni daa tum Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Ijipti la;.
en: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa yi nya o saha shɛlikam, bɛ lurila o tooni ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: And whenever any evil spirits saw Jesus, they would fall to the ground and shout, You are the Son of God.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda!.
en: Jesus responded to them, Have faith in God!.

dag: Dauda daa laɣimla Izraɛl kpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima zaa.
en: King David brought together all the Israelite leaders and all the priests and Levites.

dag: Pita daa kul gɔrimi gindi luɣilikam kaari Yisa nyaandoliba, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Lida la gba sani.
en: Peter was traveling through all the areas around Jerusalem, and he stopped to visit the believers who lived in Lydda.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa kuhi pam suhi Naawuni yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah, Amozs son, prayed about this, crying out to heaven.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti fiɛb o gba n-dih o vi, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: So the owner sent another servant. The renters also beat him up. They insulted him terribly and sent him away without a thing.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, Di pala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kali ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun nyɛ biasani daŋ o biɛli doo kulibu.
en: Laban answered, It is not the custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu wummi n saɣisigu ŋɔ. Chɛl alahichi tumbu ka tumdila din tuhi, ka zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nambɔɣu. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a nya suhudoo ka di yuui.
en: Therefore, Your Majesty, please accept my advice: remove your sins by doing what is right; remove your wrongdoing by showing mercy to the poor. Then your safety will be long lasting.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔn sani ti yɛl o, Karimba, ŋun daa be a sani Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili yaɣili ka a di o shɛhira la baptaizirila niriba pumpɔŋɔ, ka sokam zaa kabiri chani o sani.
en: Then they came to John and said, Teacher, remember the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan River? He is the one you were telling everyone about. He is also baptizing people, and many are going to him.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ma bahi kɔbulli ŋɔ ni, ka m mali hal ti paai teeku ŋɔ puuni kɔtiŋa. Ka kokpɛɣu kul gili n luɣilikam, ka a kɔgban kara la zaa zɔri duri ma garita.
en: You threw me down into the depths, to the very bottom of the sea, where the waters were all around me, and all your mighty waves rolled over me.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu kam nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, o nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe o yuli.
en: You can trust this: Every word that God speaks is true. God is a safe place for those who go to him.

dag: Faralan tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa ni sizuura lubu, amaa bundan ŋun kul tuhirimi bahira.
en: When the poor speak, they have to be polite, but when the rich answer, they are rude.

dag: Imɛr daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni pihinunaayi.
en: the descendants of Immer:.

dag: Ka o daa ti nyu tihi maa wain kuli n-do o zaɣim o suɣili ni.
en: One day he got drunk and was lying naked in his tent.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim zaŋ laɣiŋgu suɣili la be suɣa maa sunsuuni doli kaman bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa maa zali shɛm, ka sokam ʒe o zaashee o tuuta gbini.
en: When the people travel, Levis camp will move next. The Meeting Tent will be with them between the other camps. The people will make their camps in the same order that they move.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn puh o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni tim a suhudoo, ka ti a malibu suhudoo, ka chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni su shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: He instructed them to say to Nabal: David sends you greetings, my friend, with his best wishes for you, your family, and all that is yours.

dag: Hal a ni daa mali shɛm piligu ni la, a ni ti mali gari lala dahin shɛli.
en: All the wealth you lost will be nothing compared with what God will give you then.

dag: Ti ba maa ni ka bidibisi maa zuɣu ka o yuli yɛn kpi o daŋ ni maa? Timiya ti ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ba maa mabihi sani.
en: Just because he had no sons, why should our father's name disappear from Israel? Give us property among our father's relatives.

dag: Birapu tibu ŋmanila tim bɛn tiri li sani, bɛ yi kul chaŋ luɣilikam bɛ dirila nasara.
en: Some people think a bribe works like magic; they believe it can do anything.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni nya tibiginsim din tuhi niŋbu ni, ka Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ wuh o kasitali maa wuntitali puuni.
en: The Lord All-Powerful will judge fairly, and people will honor him. They will respect the Holy God when he brings justice.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara naɣilaa la mini alahichi sanyoo sara bua la, bɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee la n-yi bɛ sansani maa ni kpaŋa nti nyo bɛ gbana mini bɛ nimdi ni bɛ bina buɣim.
en: The bull and the goat for the purification offerings, whose blood was brought in to make reconciliation in the inner holy area, will be taken outside the camp. Their hides, flesh, and dung will be burned with fire.

dag: Amaa ka a niriba maa yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Ka di mi nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi shɛm n-lee bi doli zaligu soli.
en: Ezekiel, your people accuse me of being unfair. But they are the ones who are unfair.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti liri Izraɛlnim fɔntinsi n-tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Kinɛrɔt zaa zaŋ tabili Naftali tiŋgbani zaa.
en: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, and Abel-Bethmaacah, and the territories of Chinneroth and Naphtali.

dag: Yawɛ niŋ o ni daa lo ni o niŋ shɛl la; o niŋ o ni daa yɛli kurimbuni ha ni o ni niŋ shɛl la. O wurim a ka bi lan zo a nambɔɣu. O chɛ ka a dimnim mali suhupiɛlli a zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a dimnim maa nya yaa.
en: The Lord has finally done what he threatened to do: He has destroyed us without mercy, as he warned us long ago. He gave our enemies victory, gave them joy at our downfall.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa nya lala ka bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi tiri niriba maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ʒiya ka niriba maa zaa ʒe n-gil a asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: Jethro saw Moses judging the people. He asked, Why are you doing this? Why are you the only judge? And why do people come to you all day.

dag: O daa bi bo sɔŋsim maa Yawɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ku o, ka zaŋ o nam maa ti Jɛsi bia Dauda.
en: He didnt consult the LORD, so the LORD killed him and gave the kingdom to David, Jesses son.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neeg asiba ka dam maa yi o ninni, ka o paɣ maa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka o suhu kabi, ka o be kaman kuɣili la.
en: Then, after he had sobered up, she told him everything. He suffered a stroke and was completely paralyzed.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zali ni bɛ ni mol li gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ni Dan ni sokam kana ka bɛ ti puhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ daa na bi laɣim pam puhi li kaman di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: they made arrangements to circulate an announcement throughout all Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan, to come to Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover of the LORD God of Israel, because they hadnt often kept it as written.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Musa zali ya la. Dina n-nyɛ: Yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka tumm o yubu, ka dol o zaligunima, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, ka kul jɛmm o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa.
