en: Make sure you obey the law that Moses commanded you: love the Lord your God, do his will, obey his commandments, be faithful to him, and serve him with all your heart and soul.

dag: Ka n lan zaŋ Dauda zuliya saafe ti o, ka o ti yooi, ka so ku tooi yo bee ka o ti yo, ka so ku tooi yooi.
en: I will place the key to Davids house on his shoulder; what he opens no one will close, and what he closes no one will open.

dag: Bɛn daa kari doli ti maa daa guuri gari tɔrili ni yiɣiri zuɣusaa shɛm la. Bɛ daa kari doli ti la zoya zuɣu, bɛ daa gu ti la soli mɔɣu ni.
en: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.

dag: Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn turi jilima yu shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ boli ya la?.
en: They are the ones who speak evil of that good name which has been given to you.

dag: Ka Kɔniilius yɛl o, Daantal la kurig ata saha ka n daa suhiri Naawuni n yili ŋɔ nti nya ka do so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒe n tooni.
en: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti di yi tuma nyɔri, ka di yi nia biɛri tiɣi.
en: So then, you will get what you deserve, and your own actions will make you sick.

dag: ka chɛ ka dɔro gbaag a nyɔri, ka dɔro maa ni nyɛla din kul yɛn pahiri dabisili kam hal ka a nyɔri ti yirina.
en: You will have a painful sickness in your intestines that will get worse and worse. Your intestines will finally come out.

dag: Di tiŋli duu dunoli daa bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka nir ni tooi doli di dunɔdura ti kpe sunsuuni duu la puuni n-yi ni ti kpe du shɛli din pah ata ni.
en: The entrance to the lowest story of the annex was on the south side of the Temple, with stairs leading up to the second and third stories.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ti gbahi tab zuɣuri, ka zaŋ takɔbiri kuhi tab puluɣa ni, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu n-kpi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Hɛlikatihazurim, ka di be Gibiɔn.
en: Each man caught his opponent by the head and plunged his sword into his opponent's side, so that all twenty-four of them fell down dead together. And so that place in Gibeon is called Field of Swords.

dag: yɛl o, Kpɛm Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni nti zaŋ binshɛli dalim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa siɣinda ka ŋuhira bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa zaa di ni la gbɛri zuɣu.
en: Go through the city, through Jerusalem, and mark the foreheads of those who sigh and groan because of all the detestable practices that have been conducted in it.

dag: Amaa di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛ ni daa na bi yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb o yɛla nini ni nya o; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-wum o yɛla ni baŋ o.
en: Instead, as its written, Those who hadnt been told about him will see, and those who hadnt heard will understand .

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Use pounds of pure gold to make the lampstand and the things to be used with it.

dag: Ka biasani ti yɛl o ba, M ba, tim ma fal shɛli n ni ti yɛn di a kalinsi nyaaŋa pumpɔŋɔ. Ka doo maa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛli m-pirigi ti o bihi maa.
en: The younger son said to his father, Father, give me my share of the inheritance. Then the father divided his estate between them.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di karitiy o, dama ŋunkam bi galindi ya bela yi polo.
en: Jesus said to him, Dont stop him. Whoever is not against you is for you.

dag: Dunia ni ti zaɣi n-kuui zaa; ka sagbana mini dunia zaa zaɣi.
en: The country will be empty and sad. The world will be empty and weak. The great leaders of the people in this land will become weak.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim ni bɛn nyu wain buɣi la, bɛ ni ti no n-taai ba.
en: The majestic garland of Ephraims drunks will be trampled underfoot.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yuri Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn pam.
en: and the angel told me to proclaim what the Lord Almighty had said: I have a deep love and concern for Jerusalem, my holy city.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan zaŋ o nuu tim saɣ ŋman ni, ka wumsim mal o pam ni o zaŋ li ti kpar o noli ni.
en: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.

dag: Ka bidibbihi mini bipuɣimbihi ni doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri diɛmda.
en: And the city will be filled with children playing in the streets.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam min o daŋ niriba ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, ka kul dolila di soli maa; ka daa na kul chɛ ka buɣili Ashɛra kpalim be Samaria.
en: But the Israelites still did not stop committing the sins of the family of Jeroboam that caused Israel to sin. The Israelites continued committing the sins of Jeroboam. They also kept the Asherah poles in Samaria.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima, dama ninsal sɔŋsim nyɛla yoli.
en: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.

dag: N ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ pala din yi n Duuma sanna, amaa m barinyubo ŋɔ puuni n tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu la.
en: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm zo saha shɛli Firawuna tɔbbihi ni daa kanna la.
en: When the Babylonian army left Jerusalem to fight the army of the Pharaoh of Egypt.

dag: n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. Yi ni ti teei dɔni ka bɛ kun ya. Dama n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu; amaa ka tumdila tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka dolila n ni je shɛli.
en: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.

dag: O ni daa leei ŋun be tibi maa zuɣu, ka o leei bɛnkam zaa deer o noli tiliginsim din ka bahigu ni yiri so sanna.
en: After he had been made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for everyone who obeys him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ din tari ninsal daɣiri, amaa nir yi bi doli ni paɣibu kali soli m-paɣir o nuhi ka diri bindirigu, din bi tar o daɣiri.
en: These are the things that make you unclean. But to eat without washing your hands as they say you should—this doesn't make you unclean.

dag: Ka niriba daa paɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gba daa saɣi zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ ni chaŋ ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: The people praised anyone else who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

dag: yin doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.

dag: Amaa so yi kani ŋun ni wuhi di gbinni, yin chɛliya ka bɛ shini baalim cheechi puuni, ka naɣ mal li tɔɣisiri li mi ni Naawuni mini bɛmaŋmaŋa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: But if there is no interpreter, then anyone who speaks in a different language should be quiet in the church meeting. They should speak only to themselves and to God.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka ninvuɣ so labisi ya nyaaŋa o ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa zuɣu bee o ni kpaŋsiri ʒiri maŋsiɣisibu soli dolibu mini malaikanim jɛmbu yɛla zuɣu. Lala nir nyɛla ŋun duhir omaŋa o ninsalitali tɛha puuni ka di ka daliri.
en: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya, dama Masia daa di wahala yi zuɣu, ka o niŋsim maa nyɛ di ni simdi ni yi zaa dol shɛli.
en: You were called to this kind of endurance, because Christ suffered on your behalf. He left you an example so that you might follow in his footsteps.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛlnim daa ka naa, dinzuɣu sokam daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: In those days there was no king in Israel; each person did what they thought to be right.

dag: Naawuni Bia Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The beginning of the good news about Jesus Christ, Gods Son.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tiliginsim yirila Yawɛ sanna, ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani bɛ wahala saha.
en: The Lord saves the righteous and protects them in times of trouble.

dag: O daa boli nimaani yul la Bɛtɛl. Amaa nimaani yuli daa pun boonila Luz.
en: and he named the place Bethel. Before that it had been named Luz.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Mɔdɛkai Ɛsta ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then Esthers message was given to Mordecai. When he got her message, Mordecai sent his answer back: Esther, dont think that just because you live in the kings palace you will be the only Jew to escape.

dag: Ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir maa mini Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la ni Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ayuba suhigu.
en: So Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah obeyed the Lord . Then the Lord answered Jobs prayer.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɛfita daa tim tuumba Ammɔnnim naa sani ti bɔh o, Taal bɔ n-lee be m min a sunsuuni, ka a ti kana ni a ti tuhi ma n tiŋgbani zuɣu.
en: After the ceremony, Jephthah sent messengers to say to the king of Ammon, Are you trying to start a war? You have invaded my country, and I want to know why.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia maa ni daa tum tuun shɛli n-zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu m-bala.
en: These were the exploits of Benaiah, Jehoiadas son; he wasnt considered one of the three warriors.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim niriba maa, N yi chɛ ka tɔbu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino leei bɛ gula.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, warn your people by saying: Someday, I, the Lord , may send an enemy to invade a country. And suppose its people choose someone to stand watch.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ bɔhir o, A yɛn mɛla duu ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: Go to my servant David and tell him: This is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build the temple for me to live in.

dag: Ka daa gbaai gbarigu maa nudirigu n-yiɣis o zali, ka o naba min o napɔŋkpuɣila dii teei n-kpaŋ zaa.
en: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong.

dag: Ka yi ni diri biŋkɔb so kam yi kpi, ŋunkam shihi zaɣ kpiŋ maa ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Also, if an animal which you use for food dies, whoever touches its dead body will be unclean until evening.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni na be ŋɔ, biribu saha mini chɛbu saha ni maasim saha ni tulim saha ni shɛɣu saha ni kikaa saha ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kul ni beni.
en: As long as the earth remains, there will be planting and harvest, cold and heat; winter and summer, day and night.

dag: Bɛ yi yiɣiri luri zoya zuɣu, di vurimi kaman chɛchɛbunsi vubu la; ka lan vuri kaman buɣim n-diri mokuma ka di tahiri la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila tɔbbi gbaliŋ n-teei zani ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb la.
en: As they leap on the tops of the mountains, they rattle like chariots; they crackle like dry grass on fire. They are lined up like a great army ready for battle.

dag: Yi gba mali suhusaɣiŋgu pumpɔŋɔ, amaa n ni ti lan nyan ya yaha, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli, ka so ti ku tooi yihi yi suhupiɛlli maa yi suhuri ni.
en: It is the same with you. Now you are sad, but I will see you again, and you will be happy. You will have a joy that no one can take away.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo mi di daa chaŋmi ti ŋmaligi kpa Hannatɔn polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Ɛfitahɛl Vinvamli ni.
en: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.

dag: dama nyuli zabbu chɛ ka yidan suhu yiɣisir pam, ka o yi yɛn bɔhi biɛri, o ku lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: The womans husband will be jealous and angry and do everything he can to get revenge.

dag: Naa, ka di yi luhi a sani pumpɔŋɔ, nyin bahim noli ka bɛ vihi Babilɔn nam litaafinim ni n-nya Naa Sairus daa shiri bahi noli ni bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali Jɛrusalɛm, ka labisi a ni yu shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo zilinli ti ti na.
en: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N shia kul ku kpalim be ninsal ni sahakam, o nyɛla ŋun ni kpi, ka o yuma ni nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi.
en: Then the Lord said, I won't let my life-giving breath remain in anyone forever. No one will live for more than years.

dag: A bela alizanda ni ha ka kari saria; ka dabiɛm kpe dunianima, ka bɛ fo baalim.
en: You stood as judge and announced your decision. You saved the humble people of the land. From heaven you gave the decision, and the whole earth was silent and afraid.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba pam daa kul niŋdi ti Duuma yɛda pahira.
en: More and more people believed in the Lord, and many men and women were added to the group of believers.

dag: Chɛ ka ti laɣ tab zɔri m-be kaman m ba min a ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, n zaŋla anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ ti a pini. Saɣimm a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔtal la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Lets make a covenant similar to the one between our fathers. Since I have already sent you a gift of silver and gold, break your covenant with Israels King Baasha so that he will leave me alone.

dag: O chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa be viɛnyɛliŋga yi ʒiɛman ni. Tiliginsim mini yɛm ni baŋsim din galisi bela o sani. Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ Ziɔn azichi.
en: He will provide security during a lifetime: a source of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge— fear of the LORD will be Zions treasure.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi maligumaani zuɣulaantali tuma Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din be tanti jɛmbu du maŋli la ni, ka di nyɛ ti Duuma ni zali shɛli, ka pa ni ninsal ni zali shɛl la.
en: He serves as high priest in the Most Holy Place, that is, in the real tent which was put up by the Lord, not by human hands.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ka salo pam kul kabiri dol o;.
en: When Jesus came down from the hill, large crowds followed him.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara pam; dinzuɣu timiya Naawuni jilima yi niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: God paid a very high price to make you his. So honor God with your body.

dag: Jɔpa mini Lida ni daa bi wɔɣ ni tab zuɣu ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa wum ni Pita be Lida ka tim niriba ayi o sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni bɛ bɔri ni o ka bɛ sanna yomyom.
en: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, Please come with us as quickly as you can.

dag: Bomiya bua mini naɣilaa ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara hal ti paai daba ayopɔin.
en: Daily, for seven days, you will present a male goat for a purification offering. You will also present a bull from the herd and a ram from the flock, both flawless.

dag: A bia paɣ maa yur a, ka tum din gari bidibis ayopɔin tuma ti a. O dɔɣi yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga ti a, ka o ni ti nyɛla ŋun ni kpaŋsir a ni ŋun ni ti gbib a a kuriginsim saha.
en: Your daughter-in-law loves you, and has done more for you than seven sons. And now she has given you a grandson, who will bring new life to you and give you security in your old age.

dag: Sida tihi din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa bi paai li. Gɔhi tihi bi paai di wulikpana. Nira ku tooi zaŋ ti shɛŋa din be polipoli buɣisi di wula. Tia daa ka Naawuni tihi puu la ni din viɛl paai li.
en: No cedar in God's garden could compare with it. No fir tree ever had such branches, And no plane tree such limbs. No tree in God's own garden was so beautiful.

dag: Lihimiya yi yab Ibrahimma mini Zaratu bɛn dɔɣi ya la. N daa piig o ka o nyɛla o ko, amaa ka n daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka o tuŋ teei.
en: Think of your ancestor, Abraham, and of Sarah, from whom you are descended. When I called Abraham, he was childless, but I blessed him and gave him children; I made his descendants numerous.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Naawuni ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di kari doli bɛ gbini, amaa ŋmam bɛ noli nti liri ba balisam tihi la tooni.
en: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o shiri nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa. O nyɛla m ba bipuɣiŋga, amaa ka lee pa m ma puuni bia, ka n zaŋ o leei m paɣa.
en: She really is my sister. She is the daughter of my father, but not of my mother, and I married her.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa kuhi yɛli, Molimi molo! Ka m bɔhi, M molimi molo bɔ? Ka o yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli ni ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri; bɛ bi yuuri gari tipum.
en: A voice said, Speak! So the man said, What should I say? The voice said, People are like grass. Any glory they enjoy is like a wildflower.

dag: Ka Rut lan yɛli Naomi, Ka din gari dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla, o yɛli ma ni n kul dol o kachɛriba yihimi kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ n-naai.
en: Then Ruth said, Boaz also told me to come back and continue working. He said that I should work closely with his servants until the harvest is finished.

dag: Bɛ daa tum bɛ Naawuni tuma mini binyɛra mali ka di be kasi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka yiliyiiniba mini dunɔguliba gba daa tum bɛ tuma kaman Dauda min o bia Sulemaana ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: The priests and Levites did their work for their God. They did the ceremonies that made people pure, and the singers and gatekeepers did their part. They did everything that David and Solomon had commanded.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yi chɛ ka so ni na ʒi n-nya yɛl shɛli niŋ ba, ka tiŋgbani yaai di noli vali ba tabili bɛ ni su binshɛɣukam zaa, ka bɛ kpe kpiimba biɛhigu shee zaɣ nɛma, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni bɛ ʒiɛm Yawɛ.
en: But if the LORD performs an act of creation, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them and everything that belongs to them, so that they descend alive to their graves, then youll know that these men disrespected the LORD.

dag: O ni daa wum lala maa ka o dii yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: When Mary heard this, she got up and hurried out to meet him. .

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi tɛha ni.
en: Remember this, you sinners; consider what I have done.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm hal ti kpi, ka shɛb di bɛ nɛma fali.
en: Isnt their tent cord pulled up? They die without wisdom.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali ni nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka di ni ti nyɛla yi laɣiŋgu kasi saha, ka di simdi ni yi ti lo noli, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: The Day of Atonement will be on the tenth day of the seventh month. There will be a holy meeting. You must not eat food, and you must bring an offering as a gift to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ zali zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo. Yi yuli ku lan beni. N ni wurim yi ni kpe binnan shɛŋa mini yi ni mali binnan shɛŋa zali yi buɣa duu puuni la. N ni gbi yi gbala, dama yi ka buchi.
en: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.

dag: Nyin paɣa, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a yidana? Ka nyin doo mi, wula ka a ni tooi baŋ ni a zuɣu ku tilig a paɣa?.
en: Wives, maybe you will save your husband; and husbands, maybe you will save your wife. You dont know now what will happen later.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi be fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ŋɔ, yi bi wum fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm? Yɛlimiya ma!.
en: Some of you people want to be under the law. Tell me, do you know what the law says?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa pahi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni.
en: Some of the groups from the family of Levi moved to the land of Benjamin.

dag: Kulla naa kɔŋko m-mali soli ni o ʒini di puuni n-di bindirigu Yawɛ tooni. O ni dolila dunɔdali maa polo zɔntua kpe, ka lan doli nimaani yi.
en: As for the prince, he may sit in it to eat bread in the LORDs presence. He may come in and go out by way of the gates porch.

dag: O ni daa woligi Izraɛlnim bahi ka chɛ Juda zuliya saha shɛli maa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam leei bɛ naa. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa yihi Izraɛlnim Yawɛ jɛmbu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi pam.
en: After the Lord had separated Israel from Judah, the Israelites made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam caused them to abandon the Lord and led them into terrible sins.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisiri Jɛrusalɛmnim Naawuni maa yɛla mi kaman dunianim buɣ shɛŋa niriba ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali la.
en: They spoke about the God of Jerusalem as though he were the work of human hands, like the gods of the other peoples of the earth.

dag: Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: Jehoash did what was right in the LORDs eyes as long as Jehoiada the priest was alive.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti di biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ n-filim yimaŋa, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ saɣim ya, di yi pa lala yi ni leei bɛn be daɣiri ni.
en: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya takɔbi ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb na nti ti naa.
en: Someone bring me a sword. A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ Ɛziɔngɛba mini Ɛlat tin shɛŋa din daa be teeku noli Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Then Solomon went to Eziongeber and Elath, ports on the shore of the Gulf of Aqaba, in the land of Edom.

dag: Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa ʒini tuhi Yisifu. Ŋun nyɛ bɛ kpɛma n-daa daŋ ʒinibu, ka bɛn paya ʒini tuɣi hal ti paai bɛ biasani, ka di daa gari niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba.
en: The brothers had been seated at the table, facing Joseph, in the order of their age from the oldest to the youngest. When they saw how they had been seated, they looked at one another in amazement.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi dimnim kana ka yi ti jɛmdi ba, ka kum mini kɔnyuri mali ya, ka gbinfini gba mali ya, ka yi kɔŋ binshɛlikam. O ni ti zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua din nyɛ kurugu pa yi nyiŋgoya zuɣu hal ti kun ya.
en: you will serve your enemies—the ones the LORD will send against you—during famine, drought, nakedness, and total deprivation. God will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has wiped you out.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tuma nyɔri labisi ti ka ku di li, bɛ ni wolim nya nyɔ shɛl la, bɛ ku di di nyaɣisim.
en: Their hard work will result in nothing gained.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a zaligunim wuhiri Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ a zalikpana wuhiri Izraɛlnima. Bɛ ni ti tuɣili tulaale zim a tooni, ka maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la a sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di di buɣim zaa.
en: They will teach your people to obey your Law; They will offer sacrifices on your altar.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wum lala ka yɛli, Kulla alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: When the Pharisees heard, they said, This man throws out demons only by the authority of Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Isaiah then told the king, The Lord Almighty says that.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti tiligi saɣi bɛ daalahichi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa tum ma bɛ yɔhiŋ puuni la mini bɛ ni zaɣisi ma dolibu.
en: But your descendants will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors, who resisted me and rebelled against me.

dag: Ka a zaŋ o ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o yi tintariga ti kɔrig o o ninni.
en: Moses will give it to Eleazar the priest, then it will be led outside the camp and killed while Eleazar watches.

dag: Amaa o ni ti ti wun so ŋun guli sansana la jilima. O ni ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni kuɣ viɛla binyara ni pin suma n-ti wun so ŋun nyɛ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm.
en: Instead, he will honor the god who protects fortresses. He will offer gold, silver, jewels, and other rich gifts to a god his ancestors never worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yolitim zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni maa polo.
en: I thought about all my hard work, and I felt depressed.

dag: ni o guhiri hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ o dimnim leeg o napɔntamdigu.
en: Since then, hes waiting until his enemies are made into a footstool for his feet.

dag: A ni tooi gbahi binnɛma ti gbuɣinli bee n-dihi gbuɣimbihi ka bɛ tiɣi.
en: Do you find food for lions to eat, and satisfy hungry young lions.

dag: Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin, ka di zɔntua be di puuni. Bɛ daa ŋmɛla abie tihi pa di pilanim maa zaa zuɣu. Yaɣili kam daa malila zaɣ yiniyini.
en: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.

dag: O mɛla gooni ŋari n soli, ka di chɛ ka n kɔŋ garibu, ka chɛ ka n soli leei liɣa.
en: God has blocked the way, and I can't get through; he has hidden my path in darkness.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Hiburu paɣiba bɛn bi be kaman Ijipti paɣiba ni be shɛm, bɛ mali yaa pam. Paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda ti yɛn paai ka bɛ pun dɔɣi.
en: They answered, The Hebrew women are not like Egyptian women; they give birth easily, and their babies are born before either of us gets there.

dag: ni o ni daa tum Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Ijipti la;.
en: the signs and the acts that he performed in the heart of Egyptian territory, against Egypts King Pharaoh and all his land.

dag: M mi ni yi ni be luɣ shɛli nimaani ka Sintani nam ʒiishee be. Hal ka bɛ daa ti gbaai n shɛhiralana Antipas ŋun daa ʒe ma yim yi ni la n-ku o Sintani biɛhigu shee, amaa ka yi na kul ʒe ma yim ka bi chɛ ma dolibu.
en: I know where you live, there where Satan has his throne. You are true to me, and you did not abandon your faith in me even during the time when Antipas, my faithful witness, was killed there where Satan lives.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi nyaŋ o, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar from Babylon attacked Judah. He made Jehoiakim a prisoner and put bronze chains on him. Then Nebuchadnezzar took King Jehoiakim to Babylon.

dag: di saha ka yi ti puhi dakulɔdakulo chuɣu, ka zaŋ yi suhuyubu pina kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya shɛlikam na.
en: Then celebrate the Festival of Harvest for the Lord your God. Do this by bringing him some special gift you want to bring. Decide how much to give by thinking about how much the Lord your God has blessed you.

dag: Bɛnkam doli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ba so shɛli, bɛna n-nyɛ Naawuni bihi.
en: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa wuna.
en: Dont follow other gods, those gods of the people around you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti Sulemaana yɛm mini baŋsim din ka buɣisibu ni tɛhi wɔɣila ka di galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu la.
en: God made Solomon very wise. Solomon could understand more than you can imagine.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm yɛtɔɣa tir ba la jilima, amaa jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din diri ba.
en: What the wise say brings them honor, but fools are destroyed by their own words.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb suhuri daa kpɛm pam ka bɛ zaɣisi yɛda niŋbu, ka tari Yisa soli maa daɣiri salo maa ni. Di saha ka Pool daa chɛ ba, ka woligi Yisa nyaandoliba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ Tairanus kariŋ duu nti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla dabisili kam.
en: Some people had closed their minds, though. They refused to believe and publicly slandered the Way. As a result, Paul left them, took the disciples with him, and continued his daily interactions in Tyrannus lecture hall.

dag: Ka n daa zahim anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ mɛtiriki tɔn pisinaayi min anzinfa lahi kɔbiga ni salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ti ba.
en: I weighed out into their keeping six hundred fifty kikkars of silver, one hundred silver containers weighing a certain number of kikkars, one hundred kikkars of gold.

dag: ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ ti yi mɔɣu polo na yim nti ʒe n-daai yili maa zaa luhi bipola maa zuɣu, ka bɛ kpi. N kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: A strong wind suddenly came in from across the desert and blew the house down. It fell on your sons and daughters, and they are all dead. I am the only one who escaped to come and tell you the news.

dag: N ni suhi m Ba ka o tin ya Sɔŋda so na ka o ti be yi sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Helper to be with you forever.

dag: A daa tahi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu zuɣu ka di kom vuui; ka chɛ ka bɛ no tiŋkuŋ zuɣu kaman tiŋgban nɛl la du.
en: You said to the Red Sea, Dry up! Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ayi.
en: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for two years.

dag: Yawɛ guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o, amaa o ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: The Lord protects everyone who loves him, but he destroys all who do evil.

dag: Gaad bihi n-daa ʒini bɛ nyaaŋa baɣili ba Bashan tiŋgban ni zaŋ lala hal ni Salɛka.
en: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.

dag: Amaa yiya din be tiŋkpan shɛŋa bɛ ni bi me goma gili ni, din mini puri din be mɔɣu ni ni ti nyɛla yim, bɛ ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, ka ni ti tooi lan deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.

dag: nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa ni.
en: They confessed the bad things they had done, and John baptized them in the Jordan.

dag: Ka o daa kpah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ miri ka bɛ yɛli so ni ŋun Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Then he ordered the disciples not to tell anybody that he was the Christ.

dag: Teem niriba maa ni bɛ doli zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi yɛligu ka deeri bɛ noli, ka mali shili n-tum tuun suŋ kam zaa.
en: Remind them to submit to rulers and authorities. They should be obedient and ready to do every good thing.

dag: Ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛli yɛli, Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab Naa la n-zaŋ ma Siria wulimpuhili polo zoya ni tiŋ la ni na nti yɛli ma: Kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu ti ma. Wuhim ni Izraɛlnim simdi tibidarigibo.
en: Then Balaam spoke, and this was his message: Balak, the king of Moab, brought me here from the eastern mountains of Aram. Balak said to me, Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, speak against the Israelites.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o mi o ka bi dol o zaligunima, o ŋmarila ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ka o ni.
en: If we say that we know him, but do not obey his commands, we are liars and there is no truth in us.

dag: Dama ʒiri ʒiinim ti ku lan beni, ka ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa gba ti ku lan be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Never again will there be any worthless vision or deceptive divination in the house of Israel.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikah ayi maa saha shɛli, niriba maa zaa bɛn laɣimm a sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: When both are blown, the entire community will meet you at the entrance of the meeting tent.

dag: Di chɛ ka karimbaannim zaŋ bɛ naba du n-tam n zuɣu nɔra bee n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaŋ bɛ nuhi kari ma.
en: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi bi paɣ o nuhi ka shihi ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba maa na ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: Then Jesus called them to him and said, Allow the children to come to me. Dont forbid them, because Gods kingdom belongs to people like these children.

dag: Wahala mini nandahima m-mali ma, amaa a zaligunima n-nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Sidɔn polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Human one, face Sidon, prophesy against it.

dag: Di simdi ni ti mabi so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka Naawuni duh o mali suhupiɛlli;.
en: Those Christians who are poor must be glad when God lifts them up.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ma n dimnim nuu ni. Nyini n-daa duhi ma gari n dimnima. Nyini n-daa fa ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taai duŋ nuu ni bahi.
en: and saves me from my foes. O Lord , you give me victory over my enemies and protect me from violent men.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl.
en: He built an altar there to honor God. He named the place El, the God of Israel.

dag: Binnɛma maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana. Ka binnɛma maa daa yi wuɣi du zuɣusaa, kalima maa gba wuɣirimi du zuɣusaa.
en: When the creatures moved, the wheels moved next to them. Whenever the creatures rose above the earth, the wheels also rose up.

dag: Ka o daa mali salima bans anahi n-niŋ di naŋgbaŋkuɣila anahi. Bans ayi yaɣ yini, bans ayi yaɣ din la gba.
en: He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.

dag: ni Ahilud bia Baana ŋun daa su Taanak mini Mɛgido ni bɔb shɛli zaa din zaŋ ti miri Bɛtishɛan din baɣi Zarɛtan ka be Jɛziriil tooni n-yi Bɛtishɛan n-zaŋ ti paai Ɛbɛlimɛhola n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jokimiam yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana, Ahiluds son, in Taanach, Megiddo, and all Beth-shean beside Zarethan and below Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah and over to the region opposite Jokmeam.

dag: Miri ka a tu naa, hal di sɔɣi tu o; a mi miri ka a tu bundana, hal di tu o a duu puuni gba, dama di pa shɛli ka nooŋa bee binyiɣirigu kam ti zaŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa chaŋ ti yɛli.
en: Don't let yourself think about cursing the king; don't curse the rich, not even in secret. A little bird might hear and tell everything.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Do so paɣ yi birigi, ka bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o yidan sani.
en: Tell the Israelites this: A mans wife might be unfaithful to him.

dag: Hal bɛ yi kul lo noli, n ku wum bɛ kuhigu. Hal bɛ yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara, n ku deei li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku ba.
en: When they fast, I wont pay attention to their pleas, and when they offer entirely burned offerings and grain offerings, I wont accept them. Instead, I will devour them with war, famine, and disease.

dag: Amaa o ba yi bi saɣ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa shɛli ku zani; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali o ba ni bi saɣi maa zuɣu.
en: But if her father hears about the promise and does not agree, she is free from her promise. She does not have to do what she promised. Her father stopped her, so the Lord will forgive her.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn garigi yɛl o, Ndana, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi fa Izraɛlnim bahi? Nyama, n daŋ niriba nyɛla bɛn ka yaa Manaasa zuliya ni, ka m mi nyɛ ŋun pɔri n yiŋnim ni.
en: Gideon replied, But Lord, how can I rescue Israel? My clan is the weakest in the tribe of Manasseh, and I am the least important member of my family.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana maa zaŋ sida dari mini taaŋkɔro wulli ni mi ʒee bahi buɣim din diri nahu maa ni.
en: A priest is to throw a stick of cedar wood, a hyssop branch, and a piece of red yarn into the fire.

dag: Yi yi ti di n-tiɣi, ka me yiya viɛla be di ni.
en: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba zaa kalinli pirigibu buta puuni ʒii buyi kpi.
en: Two-thirds of the people in the land will be struck down and die, says the Lord , but one-third will survive.

dag: N na mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa yi na ku tooi deei li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: I have so much more to tell you, but it is too much for you to accept now.

dag: N wuhiya ni a yurilim maŋli maa kul yɛn benimi sahakam; a ʒiɛyimtali mi kul bami ʒiɛya kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: I will say, Your faithful love will last forever. Your loyalty is like the sky—there is no end to it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ chinchin ʒee pil li, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: Then you must put a red cloth over all these things, cover everything with fine leather, and put the poles in the rings of the table.

dag: Mani n-daa zaŋ sagbana pil li, ka zaŋ zibisim titali vil li.
en: when I made the clouds its garment, the dense clouds its wrap.

dag: Amaa man sani, di viɛli ni n vu m-miri Naawuni. N zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ leei n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n zaŋ a tuma zaa yɛla moli gili!.
en: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.

dag: Kaman niriba ni kul zaŋdi anzinfa mini daanya ni kuriti ni samafuu ni dalima n-niŋdi binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara ni, ka vibiri buɣim niŋdi li ni di nyɛligi shɛm la, lala ka n ti yɛn zaŋ ya niŋ n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili puuni n-nyɛligi ya.
en: Just as silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin are collected and placed in a furnace to fan the flames under them and melt them down, so in my anger and rage I will collect you, put you in, and melt you down.

dag: Joɛl n-daa nyɛ zuɣulana ka Shafam nyɛ ŋun pa o zuɣu, ka Janai mini Shafat mi doli bɛ nyaaŋa Bashan tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Joel was the founder of the leading clan, and Shapham of the second most important clan. Janai and Shaphat were founders of other clans in Bashan.

dag: M mabihi n yi ka yi sanna ti tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa, buchi bɔ ka di yɛn kun ya, ka pa ni n zaŋla yɛla kahigibu bee baŋsim yɛtɔɣa bee anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee wuhibu yɛla tɔɣisi ya.
en: After all, brothers and sisters, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I help you unless I speak to you with a revelation, some knowledge, a prophecy, or a teaching?.

dag: ka lab o mabihi maa sani ti yɛli ba, Bia maa kani, ka ya ka n lee yɛn kpe.
en: Then he returned to his brothers and said, The boys gone! And I—where can I go now.

dag: Bɛ ni kɔhiri nin shɛli zaa nakɔhi duu, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya.
en: Eat everything that is sold in the marketplace, without asking questions about it because of your conscience.

dag: Ka binneen shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban ni ka nyɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri n-nyɛ: nantariga mini jɛŋgbariga ni wua min o balibu zaa.
en: These small animals are unclean for you: moles, mice, all kinds of great lizards.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ninsalinim zɔr o; o bi lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ yɛnnim la.
en: That is why people fear and respect him. He shows no respect for those who think they are wise.

dag: Yawɛ tiligi Yaakubu zuliya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o yiko. Alizanda, yilimi yila. Tiŋgbani, yɛrimi saɣi. Zoya mini nyɔŋ puuni tia kam, yɛrimiya saɣi.
en: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him.

dag: Shallum daa nyɛla Jɛkamia ba, ka Jɛkamia mi daa nyɛ Ɛlishama ba.
en: Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa kula ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi Juda tiŋgbani maa ni dahin yini, ka o ni daa ku shɛb maa mi zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: In Judah, Pekah, Remaliahs son, killed one hundred twenty thousand warriors in the course of a single day because they had abandoned the LORD, God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, N dana, ka bɔ ka chɛchɛbunsi ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: I responded and said to the messenger speaking with me, What are these, sir.

dag: Ti mi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, dama Naawuni Bia la n-gbib o ka ŋun nyɛ Tuumbiɛrilan la ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o dɔɣiriba, Pihimiya kuɣa na, ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa maa na nti kahi li duhi, ka daa ʒini kuɣ duli maa gbini di bindirigu.
en: He told his men to gather some rocks and pile them up. Then they ate a meal beside the pile of rocks.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Di bi to ni mahim chaŋ tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia, dinzuɣu chɛ ka di labila nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Its easy for the shadow to go forward ten steps, Hezekiah said, but not for the shadow to go back ten steps.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ yɔhim o? Ka shia maa garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti leei ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Cham ti niŋ lala n-yɔhim o; a ni di nasara.
en: I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets, he said. The LORD agreed, You will succeed in persuading him! Go ahead.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha na kul bi bahi tiɣi n nini, ka di daliri nyɛla n ni na kul nyari Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la ka o ʒiini nayili dunol ni la.
en: But none of this means a thing to me as long as I see that Jew Mordecai sitting at the entrance of the palace.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye yurilim zuɣu, ka bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina, di bahi bamdi anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini.
en: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N nyɛla Ibrahimma nachin kpɛma.
en: The man said, I am Abrahams servant.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi kambɔna mini yi tuma zaa ni; o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: The Lord will bless you and fill your barns. He will bless everything you do. The Lord your God will bless you in the land that he is giving you.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: These are the sons of Esaus wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, Zibeons son: she gave birth to Esau, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Dama o ni na pɔri maa zuɣu ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni yuun o, ka maan o yɛla tir o hal ti paag o ba ni zali dabisi shɛli dali.
en: While they are children, they must obey those who are chosen to care for them. But when they reach the age the father set, they are free.

dag: Lala ka a yɛn niŋ woligi Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ takɔbiri maa ni ŋmaligi ku ba; ka Naawuni kabisi bɛ tɔbiri maa.
en: But their bows will break, and their swords will pierce their own hearts.

dag: Bɛ daa ʒiɛhira ka jeeni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyu dam kuli, ka bɛ yɛm zaa daa naai la.
en: they stumbled and staggered like drunks— all their skill was useless.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnima, yi nyee daa nyɔni ma mi, ka yi daa bi lan jɛmdi ma.
en: I, the Lord , said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li girimgirim li, ka di bi niŋ.
en: Some other seed fell among thorny weeds. The weeds grew and stopped the good plants from growing. So they did not make grain.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl zoya anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: The Lord said, Mortal man, speak to the mountains of Israel and tell them to listen to the message which I.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ Bia maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka ŋunkam mi bi deei Bia maa noli ku nya nyɛvili, amaa ka Naawuni suhu kul ni yiɣisiri bahir o zuɣu.
en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. But those who do not obey the Son will never have that life. They cannot get away from Gods anger.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣu daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: The next day, which was a Sabbath, the chief priests and the Pharisees met with Pilate.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbal shɛŋa niriba ni nɔri gariti ka bi mi ni gbala m-bala.
en: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam n niŋgbuŋ luɣilikam zaa; nyini n-daa zaŋ ma tuɣi taba m ma pul ni.
en: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body.

dag: Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu piligu saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ma.
en: This message came from the Lord during the first year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni bo binshɛŋa zaa ni bɛ me du kasi maa, n lan mali mmaŋmaŋ daazichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa, ka n ni zaŋ n zaŋsim zaa niŋ n Naawuni duu ŋɔ mɛbu ni maa zuɣu, n zaŋ li ti ni bɛ tum n Naawuni duu maa tuma.
en: Besides doing all that, I have promised to give part of my own gold and silver as a way of showing my love for God's temple.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ naa sani, ka naa ti zali zaligu, ka chɛ ka bɛ sab li sɔŋ ni Haman ni lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo maa simdi ni di ŋmaligi dila ŋuna. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman maa min o bidibisi yili gar dari.
en: But Esther went to the king, and the king issued written orders with the result that Haman suffered the fate he had planned for the Jews—he and his sons were hanged from the gallows.

dag: Dama Judanima, yi wuna kul galisimi kaman yi fɔntinsi ni galisi shɛm, ka yi sara maligu bimbin shɛŋa yi ni me n-zali m maani maligu tiri Baal ka di nyɛ vi la mi galisi kaman Jɛrusalɛm pala ni galisi shɛm.
en: People of Judah, you have many idols—there are as many idols as there are towns in Judah. You have built many altars for worshiping that disgusting god Baal—there are as many altars as there are streets in Jerusalem.

dag: Dauda daa lan bo kuriti pam ni bɛ mali kpahi din ni kpahi dunɔdaya pundi mini chɛulɔnima. O daa lan bo daanya pam, hal nir daa naan ku tooi zaŋ li pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: He supplied a large amount of iron for making nails and clamps for the wooden gates, and so much bronze that no one could weigh it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi sara maligu gbaliŋ la pa shɛli n sani. Yi ni zaŋdi piɛla bihi shɛb mini biŋkɔb suma kpa shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la, n nyee nyɔni li. N kɔre ka naɣilahi mini piɛla bihi ni buhi ʒim ni.
en: What should I think about all your sacrifices? says the LORD. Im fed up with entirely burned offerings of rams and the fat of well-fed beasts. I dont want the blood of bulls, lambs, and goats.

dag: Yihim ma yɔhiŋgu ni, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Remove all false ways from me; show mercy to me by means of your Instruction.

dag: Yi dim nahu bee o buŋ yi chihi chani ka yi nya o, yin taɣim o labisi ti ti o.
en: If you see a lost bull or donkey, then you must return it to its owner—even if the owner is your enemy.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔŋ ma, bɛmaŋ ka bɛ tum barina maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je ma nyɛla bɛn yuri kum.
en: But those who do not find me put their lives in danger. Whoever hates me loves death.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wuni ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni m-be ka nyini. Dama nyini n-gbib a alikauli ni yurilim din bi naara zaŋ chaŋ a daba bɛn dol a ni bɛ suhuri zaa sani.
en: he said: LORD God of Israel, there is no god like you in heaven or on the earth. You keep the covenant and show loyalty to your servants who walk before you with all their heart.

dag: Yi yi ti tuui ŋɔri yi bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli yin zaŋmiya di bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini ti pini kaman yi ni zaŋdi kabɔɣili ni chi tiri pini shɛm la.
en: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.

dag: amaa sagbani maa daa yi bi vuui, bɛ bi chani shɛli naɣila di yi ti vuui chana ka bɛ chana.
en: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.

dag: Sool ni daa kuli ti tuhi Filistianim maa ka labina ka bɛ yɛl o, Nyama Dauda be Ɛngɛdi.
en: Even as Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was informed that David was in the En-gedi wilderness.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna. Niriba maa zaa daa yɛlimi, Ti yi di daa kpi Ijipti, di di so! Bee ti yi di kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, di di so!.
en: and complained to Moses and Aaron, We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka o yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: Then they replied, We dont know. Jesus also said to them, Neither will I tell you what kind of authority I have to do these things.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: So the evil spirits begged Jesus, Send us into those pigs! Let us go into them.

dag: Amaa zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: God will show more mercy on the Judgment Day to Tyre and Sidon than to you.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim mi nyɛ o ni pii zuliya shɛli. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: The God of Jacob is not like them; he is the one who made everything, and he has chosen Israel to be his very own people. The Lord Almighty is his name.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di suhi ma niriba ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to me: Dont pray for the safety of these people.

dag: Ka piɛguliba shɛb daa kana ti kari ba, amaa ka Musa daa yiɣisi zab bɛ zuɣu ka niŋ kom ti bɛ piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: But there were some shepherds there who chased the girls away and would not let them get water. So Moses helped the girls and gave water to their animals.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ nimaani n-kpe duu maa ni ni o ti vuhi.
en: One day Elisha came to the womans house. He went to this room and rested there.

dag: Naawuni daa kahig o daanfaani wuhi palɔni ni di chɛ ka sokam tooi nya tiliginsim.
en: For God has revealed his grace for the salvation of all people.

dag: O lan bom bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pali mini bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛlli shɛli maha ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam pa shɛli zuɣu ni chi sara, ni binnyura sara.
en: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.

dag: m mali zuɣusuŋ yi sani, ka yi niŋ ma nirilim pam tiligi n nyɛvili, amaa n ku tooi zo nti du zoya ŋɔ, dama di pa shɛli ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli ti paai ma nimaani ka n kpi.
en: You have been very kind to me, your servant. You have been very kind to save me, but I cannot run all the way to the mountains. What if I am too slow and something happens? I will be killed!.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmahim do so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai do so yoli, o bi simdi ni bɛ deeg o niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No man who has been castrated or whose penis has been cut off may be included among the Lord 's people.

dag: A biha ayi ŋɔ ŋmanila muli bɛba ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi bɛn ʒe paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni ŋubira.
en: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle doe, that graze among the lilies.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi daa daŋ tooni nti zaŋ jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni, amaa ka vuhim bee nyɛvili shɛhirili kani. Dinzuɣu ka o daa ŋmaligi labina ti tuhi Ilaisha soli n-yɛl o, Bia maa bi neei.
en: Gehazi ran on ahead and laid Elisha's walking stick on the boy's face, but the boy didn't move or make a sound. Gehazi ran back to Elisha and said, The boy didn't wake up.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa yɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣ yini maa, ka yɛra, Chamiya Ramɔtigiliad ti di nasara. Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ naa nuu ni.
en: All the other prophets agreed with Zedekiah and said, Your army should march now to go fight against the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead. You will win the battle. The Lord will let you defeat them.

dag: Ka ti kul ŋuhirimi ti dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ puuni, dama ti suhuri kul yɛmi ni ti zaŋ alizanda ni yili maa ye kaman binyɛrigu la m-pa ti dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili maa zuɣu;.
en: But now we are tired of this body. We want God to give us our heavenly home.

dag: Sulemaana daa dari yuri la Ijipti mini Silisia. O kɔhigɔriba n-daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomon brought horses from Egypt and Kue. His traders bought them in Kue and brought them to Israel.

dag: Ka o daa mali salima bans anahi n-niŋ di naŋgbaŋkuɣila anahi. Bans ayi yaɣ yini, bans ayi yaɣ din la gba.
en: He cast four gold rings for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bia paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o bia paɣa, di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: Do not have intercourse with your daughter-in-law.

dag: Pa ninsal ka n fabindi niŋdi maa, ka bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn niŋ suɣilo?.
en: My complaint is not against people. There is a good reason why I am not patient.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm ka ti mabihi la zaŋ ti nti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When we arrived in Jerusalem, the brothers and sisters welcomed us warmly.

dag: Ŋunkam deei liɣiri ka ku ŋun ka taali, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who accepts money to murder an innocent person. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yisahaku Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni. Di saha ka Musa daa pɔb o nina, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yuuni Naawuni.
en: I am the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. So Moses covered his face, because he was afraid to look at God.

dag: Ka Sool daa yiɣisi zani n-neeg o nina ka bi lan ne; ka bɛ daa gbaag o nuu ni n-vo o hal ni Damaskus.
en: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim maa ni yu shɛm zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Pool, A bɔri ni a chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar a saria nimaani.
en: But Festus wanted to please the Jews. So he asked Paul, Do you want to go to Jerusalem for me to judge you there on these charges.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be palli zuɣu la, pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be daa ni la. O daa kul dola lɔriga kam ni guhira.
en: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.

dag: Ti ni yɛri shɛli maa yɛlikpani m-bɔŋɔ: Ti mali maligumaani titali ŋɔ tatabo ka o ʒi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa nam ʒiishee nudirigu polo alizanda ni.
en: The whole point of what we are saying is that we have such a High Priest, who sits at the right of the throne of the Divine Majesty in heaven.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita, ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi ŋmɛmdi bɛ nuhi ni ŋubira.
en: One time on a Sabbath day, Jesus was walking through some grain fields. His followers picked the grain, rubbed it in their hands, and ate it.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛl o, Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka n yɛl a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: Ahab shouted, Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say.

dag: Buɣim mini sakuɣa ni gulisigu ni sanʒiɛɣu din deer o noli, paɣimiy o!.
en: Do the same, fire and hail, snow and smoke, stormy wind that does what God says!.

dag: Ka nahu kam mini piɛɣu kam ŋun pahiri pia ka nyɛ biŋkɔbigul ni guli so nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o nyari bin viɛla, ka o nuhi tuma mi mali di nyɔri.
en: Your reward depends on what you say and what you do; you will get what you deserve.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi ya saha shɛl la, yi mini Masia ka bɛ daa laɣim sɔɣi maa, ka yi mini Masia laɣim n-neei kum ni yi ni daa niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neei Masia kum ni yiko tuma yɛda la zuɣu.
en: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, A ba min a biɛyanim kul a sanna.
en: The king said to Joseph, Now that your father and your brothers have arrived.

dag: Naŋgban shɛli din ŋmari ʒiri je di ni ŋmari ʒiri pari shɛb maa, ka naŋgbammalisim tahiri saɣiŋgu na.
en: Liars hate the people they hurt, and false praise can hurt people.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yidaampaɣ maŋli? O gari salima.
en: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali din be dundɔn titali ni zaŋ labi nuzaa polo la ziliŋ mini di yɛliŋ.
en: Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni garigi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti ni gbibila ti ni lo nia shɛŋa, ka sokam tumd o tipawumli tuumbiɛri.
en: They will answer, No, why should we? We will all be just as stubborn and evil as we want to be.

dag: Chɛ ka zuliya kam suhuri paligi, chɛ ka bɛ yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama a kariti niriba saria ka di tuhi, ka wuhiri zuliya kam soli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: May all nations rejoice and be happy because you judge people fairly. You rule over every nation.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi dindali maa n-zo Sool sani kuli Gaat Naa Akishi sani.
en: That day David ran away from Saul and went to King Achish of Gath.

dag: Bɛ ni daa karim gbaŋ maa, di yɛligu maa daa paligi bɛ suhuri pam.
en: When the people read it, they were filled with joy by the message of encouragement.

dag: Chɛliya ba! Bɛ nyɛla zoomba bɛn vɔri bɛ taba, Ka zom yi vɔri zoma, bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ni ti lula bɔɣili ni.
en: Stay away from the Pharisees. They lead the people, but they are like blind men leading other blind men. And if a blind man leads another blind man, both of them will fall into a ditch.

dag: pa yi suhu ni tɛha yɛla ka n yɛri maa, amaa dilan maa suhu ni tɛha. So ni bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka so ni tooi zaŋ o suhu ni tɛha yɛla gu n ni mali yolisim shɛli soli?.
en: I dont mean that you think it is wrong. But the other person might think it is wrong. Thats the only reason not to eat it. My own freedom should not be judged by what another person thinks.

dag: Amaa yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka gbibiya yi maŋ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi ku tam yi nina ni daa nya binshɛŋa la bee n-chɛ ka di yi yi suhuri ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni be yi nyɛviya ni ŋɔ; zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi.
en: But be on guard and watch yourselves closely so that you dont forget the things your eyes saw and so they never leave your mind as long as you live. Teach them to your children and your grandchildren.

dag: Amaa anabi so ŋun ti zaŋ wuna yuya tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bee anab so ŋun zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni bi zal o ni o tɔɣisi, di daanab maa ni kpi.
en: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunima wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la.
en: It is no use for them to worship me, because they teach human rules as though they were my laws.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Galili do so ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la gba daa ti yiɣisi daadam biɛligu yuya sabbu saha la n-laɣim niriba pah omaŋ zuɣu, amaa o gba ni daa ti kani, bɛn dol o maa zaa daa wurimmi.
en: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.

dag: Dama Naawuni ŋun daa yɛli ni neesim neem zibisim ni la, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka o neesim neei ti suhuri ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ Naawuni jilima neesim din neeri yiri Masia ninni na la.
en: The God who said, Out of darkness the light shall shine! is the same God who made his light shine in our hearts, to bring us the knowledge of God's glory shining in the face of Christ.

dag: Ka Ahija daa ti gbaag o ni ye binyɛr shɛli maa n-dari tɔhi li zaɣ tolima pinaayi.
en: Ahijah took off the new robe he was wearing, tore it into twelve pieces.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, yi ni zaɣisi so zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi dolibu, amaa ka dolila zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya niŋ sunsuuni la zaligunim la zuɣu. .
en: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord !.

dag: Gbuɣim pola mi n-ti kɔŋ bindirigu dira, ka kum mali ba; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn kul ku kɔŋ binsuma.
en: Even strong young lions go without and get hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

dag: Daba ata maa dali asiba, ka saa daa gbaai tahibu, ka nyaɣisira, ka sagban tibisili daa be zoli maa zuɣu, ka kika titali din yo vuri pam kum, ka niriba bɛn daa be sansani maa ni zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning. A thick cloud covered the mountain, a loud trumpet blast was heard, and everyone in camp trembled with fear.

dag: Yɛm be Yawɛ sizuura lubu ni. Yawɛ kukoli tahiri yɛri tiŋ maa: Wummiya, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn laɣim be tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord shouts to the city: A wise person respects the Lords name. So pay attention to the punishing rod and to the one who uses it!.

dag: dama bɛ daa wum ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa paɣiri Naawuni. Di saha ka Pita bɔhi.
en: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said.

dag: Ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ kuriti mali binyila ka yɛli, Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Binyila ŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe Sirianim ŋɔ hal ti naai bɛ balibu. .
en: One of the prophets was named Zedekiah son of Kenaanah. Zedekiah made some iron horns and said to Ahab, The Lord says, You will use these iron horns to fight against the army of Aram. You will defeat them and destroy them.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka Naa Hɛrɔd ti kpi. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka n yihi m Bia maa na.
en: where he stayed until Herod died. This was done to make come true what the Lord had said through the prophet, I called my Son out of Egypt.

dag: ni n yi yuui kandina, di ni chɛ ka a mi a ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm Naawuni niriba bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ cheechi la ni, ka nyɛ daantaliga mini tanzaa Naawuni yɛlimaŋli ni tam shɛli zuɣu la.
en: But if I delay, this letter will let you know how we should conduct ourselves in God's household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and support of the truth.

dag: Amaa di ŋmɛriya tab naŋgbankpeeni, so mi di galim o kpee. Yinim maligumaaniba ŋɔ ka n galim.
en: No one should argue or blame another person. Priests, my argument is with you!.

dag: Amaa a ti ma kpiɔŋ ka di be kaman yɔnaɣilaa kpiɔŋ la. A booi kpa viɛlli bahi n zuɣu ni.
en: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.

dag: Ka bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: What did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: They discussed this among themselves and said, We didnt bring any bread.

dag: Ka bɛ ba bɔhi ba, So dini ka o lee doli? Ka o bidibisi maa daa wuh o anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa ni doli so shɛli. Ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa.
en: Show me which way he went, the old prophet said, and his sons pointed out the road.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima naɣibil yino zali Bɛtɛl, ka zaŋ yino mi zali Dan.
en: He placed one of the gold bull-calves in Bethel and the other in Dan.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir maa daa wum Izraɛl naa ni darigi toog o binyɛrigu shɛm maa yɛla, ka tim ti bɔhi naa maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a darigi toog a binyɛrigu? Chɛ ka doo maa ka n sanna nti baŋ ni anabi be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: When the prophet Elisha heard what had happened, he sent word to the king: Why are you so upset? Send the man to me, and I'll show him that there is a prophet in Israel.

dag: Di saha maa Yisa ma Mariama min o tizo Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Klɔpas paɣa la ni Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa ʒiɛla Yisa dapulli maa gbini.
en: Jesus mother and his mothers sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene stood near the cross.

dag: Yisa nyaandol so daa be Damaskus maa ka o yuli booni Ananias. Ka o daa ti nya ʒii, ka ti Duuma bol o di ni, Ananias! Ka o saɣi n-yɛli, N-nyɛ ma, n Duuma.
en: There was a follower of Jesus in Damascus named Ananias. In a vision the Lord said to him, Ananias! Ananias answered, Here I am, Lord.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni galisiya, ka ti ku tooi baŋ o yuma tariga.
en: Yes, God is great, but we cannot understand his greatness. We dont know how long he has lived.

dag: Jɛhoyakin yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata ni biɛɣu pia. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Jehoiachin was years old when he became king, and he ruled for three months in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa, ka zaŋ li niŋ o baɣaka.
en: Then he went back to his palace and never gave it a second thought.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla yi situra varimla nandaamba bɛn ka taali ʒim, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa zaa yoli. Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa puuni.
en: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes.

dag: A yiŋ bindira din galisi la ka bɛ dira; ka a tiri ba bin suma din be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔra ka bɛ nyura.
en: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.

dag: O yiŋ nyɛla so shɛli din kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka nyɛ din kuni kum shee.
en: Her house is the place of death. The road to it leads straight to the grave.

dag: So yi tahir a sariakarita sani ka a min o be soli chani yɛtɔɣa maa ni, nyin chɛ ka yi naai noli m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa maa; di yi pa lala o ni zaŋ a chaŋ sariakarita maa sani, ka sariakarita maa ti zaŋ a ti dansarika gula, ka o mi kpɛh a duu.
en: As you are going to court with your accuser, make your best effort to reach a settlement along the way. Otherwise, your accuser may bring you before the judge, and the judge hand you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

dag: Kuhimiya boli ma yi muɣisigu dali, ka n tiligi ya, ka yi ti ma jilima.
en: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa paai yili maa ni nti nya ka bia maa kpi n-dola o garo zuɣu.
en: Elisha came into the house and saw the boy lying dead on his bed.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zo n-chaŋ o biŋkɔbiri sani nti gbaai naɣilabil polli ŋun viɛla n-ti o tumtumda, ka o kɔrig o mal o yomyom.
en: Abraham ran to the cattle, took a healthy young calf, and gave it to a young servant, who prepared it quickly.

dag: A ni yu zaɣ viɛlli la zuɣu, niŋm Ziɔn zaɣ viɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm goma zali yaha.
en: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.

dag: Ka Atai daa nyɛ Neetan ba, ka Neetan mi daa nyɛ Zabad ba.
en: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti zaŋ li mir o na ni o di ka o dii gɔh o nuu ni ka yɛl o, N tizɔpaɣa, chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: When she served him the food, he grabbed her and said, Come have sex with me, my sister.

dag: O bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla, o mi bi tamd o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zali ʒiɛmana tuhili niriba yɛla.
en: God remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded to a thousand generations.

dag: faashee m bo biɛhigu shee ti Yawɛ; biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ dini.
en: until I find a home for the Lord , a tent for the Mighty God of Jacob.

dag: N ni daai li luhi kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa m-pahi bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa zuɣu. Tiŋgbana ni ti sɔhigi di lubu vuri zuɣu, ka Idɛn tihi zaa din nyɛ Lɛbanɔn ti gahinda ka nyari kom viɛnyɛliŋga la suhuri ni ti maai kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa.
en: When I send it down to the world of the dead, the noise of its downfall will shake the nations. All the trees of Eden and all the choice, well-watered trees of Lebanon who have gone to the world below will be pleased at its downfall.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So kul ku kɔŋ Dauda daŋ ni ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee.
en: The Lord says, Someone from Davids family will always sit on the throne and rule the family of Israel.

dag: Kaman sagbana ni yi wurim naai shɛm la, lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ku lan labina.
en: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.

dag: Nyama, n ni pii n dab so m-bɔŋɔ; n ni yuri so ni n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala. N ni zaŋ n Shia niŋ o ni, ka o zaŋ yɛlimaŋli kari saria ti zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: Here is my servant, the one I have chosen. He is the one I love, and I am very pleased with him. I will fill him with my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.

dag: Ka ti zaa daa lu tiŋa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri ma Hiburuli ni, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka? Di to ni a tabigi gɔhi.
en: We all fell to the ground. Then I heard a voice say to me in Aramaic, Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me? It's foolish to fight against me.

dag: dama dina n-ni chɛ ka ti Duuma niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tim Yisa Masia so o ni daa pun lo ni o ni tim yi sanna la.
en: times of spiritual strength will come from the Lord, and he will send Jesus, who is the Messiah he has already chosen for you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A yi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba, dindina a ni tiligi, ka bɛ ku nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim, ka a mini a yiŋnim ku kpi.
en: Then I told Zedekiah that the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, had said, If you surrender to the king of Babylonia's officers, your life will be spared, and this city will not be burned down. Both you and your family will be spared.

dag: O ni daa ti saɣim o buni maa zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka kum titali daa lu tiŋ maa ni; ka kum wum o pam.
en: He had spent everything, when a bad famine spread through that whole land. Soon he had nothing to eat.

dag: N tim ya mi ni yi ti kpuɣi yi ni bi di puu atam shɛli wahala. Shɛba m-pun di di wahala ka yinim ti lee yɛn di di nyɔri.
en: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.

dag: Suhim ma ka n zaŋ zuliya kam zaa ti a ka a su ba; ka dunia ŋɔ zaa leeg a ni su shɛli.
en: If you ask, I will give you the nations. Everyone on earth will be yours.

dag: di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi Izraɛlnim zuliya shɛb zaa sani bɛ ni be na, ka yihi ba luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.

dag: Di yi pa lala a yi paɣiri Naawuni la a shia ni kɔŋko, wula ka ŋun ka yi kalinli ni ka lan ʒi a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni ni tooi yɛli, Ami, a Naawuni paɣibu maa zuɣu?.
en: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, Amen?.

dag: Pako so yi mali bihi bee yaansi, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ daadiini fukumsi ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ dɔɣiriba polo din ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi niŋ bɛ laamba mini bɛ yabipaɣiba din simdi labisi, dama lala niŋbu n-nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn first to carry out their religious duties toward their own family and in this way repay their parents and grandparents, because that is what pleases God.

dag: Di ni ti leei teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni deeni lansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di ni leei niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri diri nɛma luɣ shɛli.
en: a place for drying nets in the middle of the sea. I have spoken! This is what the LORD God says. It will become prey for the nations.

dag: Ka Sool daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ; dina n-daa nyɛ o ni tuui me sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Yawɛ.
en: It was the first altar Saul had built for offering sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa biligi kuɣili maa bahi. Ka Yisa duh o zuɣu zuɣusaa ka yɛli, M Ba, m paɣir a a ni deeri n suhigu zuɣu.
en: After the stone had been rolled aside, Jesus looked up toward heaven and prayed, Father, I thank you for answering my prayer.

dag: Fiig tihi gbaai wolibu, ka wain tihi daai pum, ka di pum maa nyo kaman tulaale la. N yura ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so pam, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: Young figs are growing on the fig trees. Smell the vines in bloom. Get up, my darling, my beautiful one. Lets go away.

dag: Shɛlini bɛ daa turi ya ka muɣisiri ya palɔni, ka shɛlini mi yi daa nyɛla bɛn pahi bɛ ni niŋdi yi tab shɛb lala zuɣu.
en: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.

dag: ka di me yiya m-be di ni la. Ti ka wain tihi bee puri bee bimbira.
en: And we havent built houses to live in or had vineyards, fields, or crops.

dag: ka zaŋ kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛbih ayopɔin maa zaɣ yini kam zuɣu;.
en: and pounds with each lamb.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa yihi ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ puuni binyara n-lan bahi kom maa ni.
en: A day later they threw out the ships equipment.

dag: N naan shiri yiɣi chaŋ katiŋa nti be mɔɣu ni.
en: Id run so far away! Id live in the desert. Selah.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi yum maa, di yi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di ni kɔbiri niŋ zaɣ dɔzim ka balisibalisi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni; di nyɛla dɔr shɛli din loora, ka nyɛ zuɣu ni bee teeŋa ni dɔr biɛɣu.
en: the priest shall examine it. If it seems to be deeper than the surrounding skin and the hairs in it are yellowish and thin, it is a dreaded skin disease, and he shall pronounce you unclean.

dag: Ka Aiya bipuɣiŋga Rizipa maa daa zaŋ kuntu chaŋ ti yɛrigi sɔŋ zoli maa zuɣu n-do nimaani kariti juri wuntaŋ ni, ka kariti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mi yuŋ m-mali lala hal ka saa daa ti mi m-bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Rizpah spread out some sackcloth on a nearby rock. She wouldn't let the birds land on the bodies during the day, and she kept the wild animals away at night. She stayed there from the beginning of the harvest until it started to rain.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zɔri vi ni a di ti Duuma bee man ŋun nyɛ o dansarika ŋɔ shɛhira, amaa Naawuni yiko ni, chɛ ka m min a laɣim di wahala lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.

dag: Yisahaku daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihinii dunia yili.
en: Isaac lived years.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Naa Hɛziɛl yiŋa, ka chɛ ka buɣim di n-saɣim Naa Bɛnhadad ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: I will send down fire on the house of Hazael; it will devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti deei litaafi maa ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni.
en: The Lamb came and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.

dag: Ti Duuma Shia Kasi be n zuɣu, dama o pii ma ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti tarimba. O tim ma na ni n ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ daba la yi dabitim ni, ka chɛ ka zoomba nina neei, ka fa bɛn be muɣisigu ni la bahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord is on me. He has chosen me to tell good news to the poor. He sent me to tell prisoners that they are free and to tell the blind that they can see again. He sent me to free those who have been treated badly.

dag: Chɛ ka naa maa yuli ku kpi, ka chɛ ka o yul kul beni kaman wuntaŋ ni beni shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa nya alibarika o zuɣu. Ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa bol o alibarika naa.
en: May the king's name never be forgotten; may his fame last as long as the sun. May all nations ask God to bless them as he has blessed the king.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni paai Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ni ti yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, ka bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni suhugarigu naai.
en: Those whom you have rescued will reach Jerusalem with gladness, singing and shouting for joy. They will be happy forever, forever free from sorrow and grief.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi sabbu shɛli sɔŋ. Sabimi li bachibihi kara n yɛli, Mahɛshalalihashibaz dini.
en: The Lord said to me, Take a large piece of writing material and write on it in large letters: Quick Loot, Fast Plunder.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Yaamiya yi noya ka n dihi ya.
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up from Egypts land. Open your mouth wide—I will fill it up!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi Taai doli yi Sidɔn mini tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia la ni mali ti paai Galili Teeku ni.
en: Jesus left the region around Tyre and went by way of Sidon toward Lake Galilee. He went through the land near the ten cities known as Decapolis.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niriba taari duŋ, di malila zuɣulaan bɔbigu, amaa zuɣulaan so ŋun mali yɛm yi dira, binshɛlikam niŋdila viɛnyɛliŋga yuui.
en: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka o kɔrigi niriba maa daalahichi sanyoo sara bulaa la, ka zaŋ o ʒim maa kpe pateesa maa puuni na nti niŋ kaman o ni niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛm maa, ka zaŋ li mihi adaka pindigu la zuɣusaa mini adaka maa tooni.
en: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa vu m-miri Dauda, ka o nyɔtaɣiriʒira be o tooni.
en: The Philistine started walking toward David, with his shield bearer walking in front of him. He kept coming closer.

dag: Hal o ni daa ŋme tampiŋ ka kom tɔhi yi di ni na zɔri maa, o ni tooi ti bindira gba bee n-ti o niriba nimdi.
en: It is true that he struck the rock, and water flowed out in a torrent; but can he also provide us with bread and give his people meat.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Ka bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many people will come in my name, saying, Im the one! They will deceive many people.

dag: N daa mooi n nini n-yɛri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ niŋm tuuba Naawuni sani ka niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda.
en: You know I have testified to both Jews and Greeks that they must change their hearts and lives as they turn to God and have faith in our Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka o daa mal litaafi bil shɛli ka di kpabigi be o nuu ni, ka o zaŋ o nudirigu napɔŋ zali teeku ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa napɔŋ mi zali duli.
en: He had a small scroll open in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

dag: Ka o ye binyɛr shɛl din ŋam ʒim, ka o yuli daa booni Naawuni Yɛligu.
en: He was dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and he was called the Word of God.

dag: Ka Jɔda daa nyɛ Jɔanan bia, ka Jɔanan nyɛ Riisa bia, ka Riisa nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl bia, ka Zɛrubabɛl nyɛ Shialtiɛl bia, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Nɛri bia.
en: son of Joanan son of Rhesa son of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel son of Neri.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka bɛ nini baligi ka o deei Mɛtɛgama bɛ nuu ni.
en: Later, David attacked and badly defeated the Philistines. Israel was now free from their control.

dag: Bɛ chaŋ Ijipti nti bɔri sɔŋsim, ka bi niŋ ma saawara. Bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Firawuna yuli ni bɛ nya sɔɣibu shee Ijipti.
en: setting out to go down to Egypt without consulting me, taking refuge in Pharaohs refuge and hiding in Egypts shadow.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Haribɔna la yɛli, Hal Haman sala gar dari o yiŋa ni o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Mɔdɛkai so ŋun daa tiligi nyin naa nyɛvil la yil li. Ka di dubu nyɛ mita pisinaayi. Ka naa yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya Haman ti yil li.
