en: Then one of them, who was named Harbonah, said, Haman even went so far as to build a gallows at his house so that he could hang Mordecai, who saved Your Majesty's life. And it's seventy-five feet tall! Hang Haman on it! the king commanded.

dag: N lihila a tiliginsim min a ni lo ma alikauli maŋli shɛl la soli hal ka n nina ti fulim.
en: My eyes are tired from watching for your saving help, for the deliverance you promised.

dag: Dama n nyari bɛ ni kul niŋdi shɛlikam zaa; di shɛli bi sɔɣi n sani, ka bɛ daalahichi bi sɔɣi n sani.
en: I see everything they do. The people of Judah cannot hide the things they do. Their sin is not hidden from me.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi li buyopɔin n-yihi li Izraɛlnim daɣiri maa ni.
en: With his finger he must sprinkle some of the blood on the altar seven times. In this way he is to purify it from the sins of the people of Israel and make it holy.

dag: Ka naa daa pirig o nintu shɛli zuɣu o dalinli ni daa dihi tabili, ka nyɛ o ni daa deei shɛli Haman san la ti Mɔdɛkai. Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ Haman yili maa ti Mɔdɛkai ni o su di fukumsi.
en: The king took off his royal ring, the one he had removed from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther put Mordecai in charge of what Haman had owned.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe du titali puuni nti buɣisi di pilanima. Yaɣa maa zaa pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita ata.
en: Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was meters wide.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: But Peter said, Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.

dag: Bɛ bari ma la zana n soli zuɣu. N nandahima maa yaɣiya. Bɛ gbila bɔɣili sɔŋ n soli zuɣu, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee lan ŋmaligi lu di ni.
en: They laid a net for my feet to bring me down; they dug a pit for me, but they fell into it instead! Selah.

dag: N naa daa dola o bindoo zuɣu, ka n tulaale nyom deei nimaani zaa.
en: My king was lying on his couch, and my perfume filled the air with fragrance.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha?.
en: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, Why do we need any more witnesses?.

dag: Di nyɛla din ni tooi sɔŋ nira kaman liɣiri ni sɔŋdi nir shɛm. Baŋsim daanfaani nyɛla yɛm tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li nyɛvili.
en: Wisdom and money can protect you. But knowledge gained through wisdom is even better—it can save your life.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi: O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino n-jɛm o, ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: You cannot be a slave of two masters; you will hate one and love the other; you will be loyal to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tiɛriŋ zuɣu m-bilina, ka mahili ni daa bi yuuri tiŋ nimaani zuɣu chɛ ka di zaɣi kpi.
en: Other seeds fell on rocky ground and started growing. But the plants did not have enough water and soon dried up.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ kpahi din wɔɣilim nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu n-kpahi gili di puuni zaa. Teebuya maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛn zaŋdi sara maligu nimdi para.
en: Ledges inches wide ran around the edge of the tables. All the meat to be offered in sacrifice was placed on the tables.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, Doo maa ka kpe na? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl ba, Nyamiya, o sɔɣ be kpalansi ŋɔ nyaaŋa.
en: they asked the Lord , Is there still someone else? The Lord answered, Saul is over there, hiding behind the supplies.

dag: A daa pahi gili di zaashee ka di nyaɣa ba tiŋa, ka di zooi yɛligi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: You prepared the ground for it, and it sent its roots down deep and spread throughout the land.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kom puhigi zɔri tiŋgban nɛl ni, ka chɛ ka kom puhiri yiri tiŋgban kuŋ ni na.
en: He changed deserts into pools of water and dry land into flowing springs.

dag: ka doli soli din tuhi ka di chɛ ka napɔn barinim naba ku ŋmirigi, amaa ka lee ni malila alaafee.
en: Live in the right way so that you will be saved and your weakness will not cause you to be lost.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ; nyamiya, ŋun yi n nyaaŋa maa paana.
en: Get up, let us go. Look, here is the man who is betraying me.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab maani ti la ansarisi, ka ti dimnim laɣindi lara.
en: You let the surrounding nations fight over our land; our enemies insult us.

dag: N ni chɛ ba n-zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni doli man Yawɛ soli kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: I will use them to test the Israelites. I will see if the Israelites can keep the Lord s commands as their ancestors did.

dag: ni Abishua ni Naaman ni Ahɔa.
en: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah.

dag: dama tibili zahindi yɛtɔɣa kaman zilinli ni zahindi bindira shɛm la.
en: Think about my words, as you would taste food.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ti o ni daa nya malaika o yiŋ shɛm, ka o yɛl o ni o timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: He reported to us how he had seen an angel standing in his house and saying, Send to Joppa and summon Simon, who is known as Peter.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi nab pam pahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ŋɔ ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: Listen to them, people of Israel, and obey them! Then all will go well with you, and you will become a mighty nation and live in that rich and fertile land, just as the Lord , the God of our ancestors, has promised.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai mɔɣu ni bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la nyaaŋa yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni la ni n-yɛli.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses in the desert of Sinai. This was during the first month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said to Moses.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni dunia ŋɔ ni, n ku lan nya Yawɛ bee ninsala yaha.
en: I thought, I wont see the LORD. The LORD is in the land of the living. I wont look upon humans again or be with the inhabitants of the world.

dag: ka din pah anu nyɛ oniɣisi, ka din pah ayɔbu nyɛ kanɛlian, ka din pah ayopɔin nyɛ kirisolait, ka din pah anii nyɛ bɛril, ka din pah awɛi nyɛ tɔpaz, ka din pahi pia nyɛ kirisɔpirɛz, ka din pahi piniyini nyɛ jɛsint ka din pahi pinaayi mi nyɛ amɛtisit.
en: the fifth onyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh yellow quartz, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chalcedony, the eleventh turquoise, the twelfth amethyst.

dag: N ni ti kul yɛn niŋ niriba maa shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ maligumaaniba maa gba. N ni ti darigi bɛ tibili yo bɛ tuumbiɛri maa samli.
en: So the priests are no different from the people. I will punish them for the things they did. I will pay them back for the wrong things they did.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi. .
en: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved. .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zahim maa m-mali chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: So the priests and the Levites took charge of the silver, the gold, and the utensils, to take them to the Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa Naawuni shiri ni tooi be ninsalinim sani dunia ŋɔ ni? Dama zuɣusaa zaa ku tooi deeg a bɛ ti yɛri n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?.

dag: Bɛnhadad min o natab bɛn daa ʒe o nyaaŋa la daa bela bɛ suɣa ni nyuri dam, ka bɛ zaŋ o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa na ti yɛli Bɛnhadad. Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi ni bɛ malim shili n-chaŋ ti liri Samarianim maa, ka bɛ daa teei zani.
en: Benhadad received Ahab's answer as he and his allies, the other rulers, were drinking in their tents. He ordered his men to get ready to attack the city, and so they moved into position.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ni leeg o daba din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ man Naawuni jɛmbu mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nanim jɛmbu ni pa yim shɛm.
en: But the people of Jerusalem will become Shishaks servants. This will happen so that they may learn that serving me is different from serving the kings of other nations.

dag: Ka a yi ti kanna, nyin zaŋmi m binyɛr tibisi shɛli n ni daa chɛ n-sɔŋ Kaapus sani Troas la m-mali ma na; ka zaŋ litaafinim la gba pahi na, di bahi bamdi gbandi la.
en: When you come, bring along the coat I left with Carpus in Troas. Also bring the scrolls and especially the parchments.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha.
en: As surely as I am the living God, says the Sovereign Lord , you will not repeat this proverb in Israel any more.

dag: O ku yihi tahima bee n-gbarigi, hal ka o ti wuhi zaligu soli ni nyɛ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tin shɛŋa din be katinsi nim ti ʒiya guhir o wuhibu.
en: He will not grow weak or give up until he has brought justice to the world. And people in faraway places will hope to receive his teachings.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ yi ni mali naɣibil so ka di nyɛ alahichi bini maa nyo buɣim wurim li, ka baɣisi li zaa hal ka di ti be kaman zim la, ka n daa zaŋ di zim maa bahi kulibɔn shɛli din kom zɔri yiri zoli zuɣu sirigirina la ni.
en: I took that sinful thing that you had made—that metal bull-calf—and threw it into the fire. Then I broke it in pieces, ground it to dust, and threw the dust into the stream that flowed down the mountain.

dag: N daa chɛ a Kriit ni a niŋla binshɛŋa din simdi niŋbu la, ka pii cheechi toondaannima n-zali tiŋ kam ni kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm la.
en: The reason I left you behind in Crete was to organize whatever needs to be done and to appoint elders in each city, as I told you.

dag: Ti yi nyɛla bɛn zuɣuri lɛbigi, di nyɛla Naawuni zuɣu; ka ti yi nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, di nyɛla yi zuɣu.
en: If we are crazy, it is for God. If we have our right mind, it is for you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaŋ bɛ ni kɔriti binneen shɛb maani sara mɔɣu ni la ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o zaŋ ba mali suhudoo sara maligu.
en: This will make the Israelites bring the communal sacrifices, which they are sacrificing in the countryside, to the LORD, to the priest at the meeting tents entrance, and sacrifice them as communal sacrifices of well-being to the LORD.

dag: ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ Akasia fɔŋ ni. Amaa n ni fiɛb bɛ zaa.
en: In their wicked condition, they have sunk deep into corruption; I will correct them through judgment.

dag: ka Jɔhanan nyɛ Azaria ba. Azaria maa n-daa nyɛ maligumaana m-be Sulemaana ni daa me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛli din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la puuni.
en: Johanan was Azariahs father.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔb chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka nya bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam gari yi tɔbbihi, yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la be yi sani.
en: When you march out to battle your enemies and you see horses, chariots, and a fighting force larger than yours, dont be afraid of them, because the LORD your God, the one who brought you up from Egypt, is with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa ŋun biriti bee ŋun mihiri kom maa n-nyɛ shɛli, amaa Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka di zoori maa n-nyɛ shɛli.
en: The one who plants and the one who waters really do not matter. It is God who matters, because he makes the plant grow.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla ŋmanila shigbaŋ, di nyaɣisi niriba sani ka nyɛ din tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: Kind words are like honey; they are easy to accept and good for your health.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ o bituuli Iso binyɛr suma din be o sani yiŋa n-yɛl o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa;.
en: Then Rebekah took the clothes that her older son Esau loved to wear. She put these clothes on the younger son Jacob.

dag: Jaadai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Rɛgɛm mini Jɔtam ni Gɛshan ni Pɛlɛt ni Ɛfa ni Shaaf.
en: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.

dag: Sool ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa, ka Naawuni shia siɣ o zuɣu na ni kpiɔŋ pam, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Saul listened to their story. Then Gods Spirit came on him with great power. Saul became very angry.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl neesim ni leei buɣim zilinli. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni leei buɣim zilinli n-di o gɔhi mini suligunyinyari dahin yini.
en: The Light of Israel will be like a fire. The Holy One will be like a flame. He will be like a fire that first begins to burn the weeds and thorns.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti nya ka liɣiri din be adaka maa ni zooi, naa gbaŋsabira mini maligumaaniba zuɣulana kanimina nti kal li, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nya laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-niŋ kpalansi ni lo.
en: Whenever the kings secretary and the high priest saw that the box was full, they counted all the money that had been given for the Lord s Temple and put it in bags.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa lihirila a ninni ni a ti ba bɛ bindirigu di tibu saha.
en: All your creations wait for you to give them their food on time.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa kum nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nan bia Jɔshua, ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda la.
en: After the death of the Lord 's servant Moses, the Lord spoke to Moses' helper, Joshua son of Nun.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a jɛmbu duu n-kul yiini yila paɣir a sahakam mal alibarika.
en: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yɛligu din kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yɛligu maa nyɛla lahibal suŋ molomooniba ni tahi shɛl na ti tin ya.
en: But what the Lord has said will stand forever. Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan yɛli, Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina. Ka ŋun kani maa na mi chandi ŋmanila Jɛhu, Nimshi yaaŋa la, dama o chandi maa ŋmanila yinyaa.
en: The guard told Joram, The second messenger went to the group, but he has not come back yet. There is a man driving his chariot like a mad man. He is driving like Jehu son of Nimshi.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni n-nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ daa gbarigila Izraɛlnima ni bɛ di chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa.
en: They went up to the Cluster ravine, saw the land, and destroyed the Israelites resolve to enter the land that the LORD had given them.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa daa yaai di noli n-vali bɛ mini bɛ yiŋnima ni Kɔra ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: It was as if the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them. All of Korahs men, their families, and everything they owned went down into the earth.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa chaŋ bɛn bi gundi sani, ka a mini ba ti laɣindi timdi dira.
en: they said, You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them.

dag: O darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili. Yawɛ ku niŋ zinchili zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis o tibili darigibu polo.
en: He is the God who personally repays anyone who hates him, ultimately destroying that kind of person. The LORD does not waste time with anyone who hates him; he repays them personally.

dag: O nuu din mali kpiɔŋ min o bɔɣu ka o daa teei yihi ba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: with his strong hand, his powerful arm; his love is eternal.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa bahi nimaani, ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa kahi di zaa chaŋ.
en: The Philistines left their divine images behind, and David and his men carried them off.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: The Lord changed his mind again and said, This will not take place either.

dag: Amaa ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa zɔri Naawuni ka bi niŋdi Ijipti naa ni daa yɛli ni bɛ niŋm shɛm maa, bɛ daa bi kuri bidibbihi maa.
en: Now the two midwives respected God so they didnt obey the Egyptian kings order. Instead, they let the baby boys live.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn bahiri yoli.
en: Be careful what you say and protect your life. A careless talker destroys himself.

dag: O ni ti liri nuzaa polɔnima, ka wurim Asiria. O ni ti chɛ ka Ninive kpalim dabari n kuui doya kaman tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: Then the Lord will turn north and punish Assyria. He will destroy Nineveh—that city will be like an empty, dry desert.

dag: Asiria naa maa daa timla Rabishake, ka o yi Lakishi n-zaŋ tɔbbihi pam pa omaŋ zuɣu ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm. O daa zanila kɔso titali din be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ solɔɣu din labiri kpaluhi ʒiishee polo la.
en: Assyrias king sent his field commander from Lachish, together with a large army, to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. He stood at the water channel of the Upper Pool, which is on the road to the field where clothes are washed.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu, ka bɔhira, Ya polo ka di lee be? Bɛ mi ni zibisim dabisili shee bi lan waɣa.
en: They wander about for bread. Where is it? They know that their day of darkness is fixed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛra vinvamli ni.
en: So Isaac left and set up his camp in Gerar Valley, where he stayed for some time.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli paɣ maa, Lab kuli, ka n lihi a yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: Go on home, David told her. I'll take care of this matter for you.

dag: Yawɛ di tam o ba tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka di kpihim o ma daalahichi.
en: May the Lord remember the sins of his father, and may his mothers sins never be erased.

dag: Dama n yidana ka yiŋa. O go n-chaŋla katiŋa.
en: My husband has gone on a business trip.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi lee tɛhi? Do so n-daa mali bidibis ayi nti chaŋ o bikpɛm sani ti yɛl o, M bia, cham m puu ni ti tum tuma zuŋɔ.
en: Jesus said: I will tell you a story about a man who had two sons. Then you can tell me what you think. The father went to the older son and said, Go work in the vineyard today.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kahiri tandi nɛma n-tiri daa zaŋla bɛ nu yiniyini tumdi tuma, ka zaŋ nu yiniyini mi gbib bidibbina.
en: The builders and their helpers had their tools in one hand and a weapon in the other hand.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuri niriba maa, ka di daa ti kpalim n ko, ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nina kpa tiŋ kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ! A yɛn kula Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: While the killing was going on, I was there alone. I threw myself face downward on the ground and shouted, Sovereign Lord , are you so angry with Jerusalem that you are going to kill everyone left in Israel.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum a niriba Izraɛlnim maa suhigu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi ka lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni na.
en: then listen from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel. Return them to the land you gave their ancestors.

dag: Ti luya zaa; ti kul teei dola taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: We have been pushed down into the dirt. We are lying face down in the dust.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli pahi, Yisa ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa neei kum ni ka ti zaa leei di shɛhiranima.
en: God has raised this very Jesus from death, and we are all witnesses to this fact.

dag: N ni daa kul be Izraɛlnim zaa sani n-chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa la, n daa mi n-bɔhi Izraɛl zuɣulaannim shɛb n ni daa pii ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la ni so, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me yili ti ma? .
en: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?.

dag: Dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumda, ka yi mi nyɛ Naawuni puu. Yi lan nyɛla Naawuni duu.
en: For we are partners working together for God, and you are God's field. You are also God's building.

dag: Dama ti ni daa birigi maa nyaaŋa ti daa niŋ tuuba, ti ni daa ti baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka ti daa zaŋ ti zuɣuri ba tiŋa. Vi daa gbahi ti, ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisi, ti ni daa nya filiŋ ti bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: We turned away from you, but soon we wanted to return. After you had punished us, we hung our heads in grief. We were ashamed and disgraced because we sinned when we were young.

dag: Yawɛ ku saɣi chɛ bɛ taali, dama Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili nyɔhi ni lu bɛ zuɣu. Noli yɛlibu zaa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ni di ba, ka Yawɛ kpihim bɛ yuli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord will not forgive such a man. Instead, the Lord 's burning anger will flame up against him, and all the disasters written in this book will fall on him until the Lord has destroyed him completely.

dag: Paɣimi n tuumbiɛri zaa bahi, ka nyahi n daalahichi.
en: Scrub away my guilt. Wash me clean from my sin.

dag: ka Yawɛ bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɔhim Ɛhab ka o chaŋ ti lu Ramɔtigiliad? Ka yino yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋun la mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The LORD said, Who will persuade Ahab so that he attacks Ramoth-gilead and dies there? There were many suggestions.

dag: Anabi Musa zaligu daa zalila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be tibi ni bɛ nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima, amaa Naawuni pɔri din daa doli fukumsi zaligu nyaaŋa la daa zalila ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ Bia ŋun be tibi hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.

dag: Pa a ninvuɣ biɛtali ni galisi zuɣu? A tuumbiɛri ka tariga.
en: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.

dag: Ka Baruk garigi yɛli ba, Ŋuna n-daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa, ka m mi zaŋ tadabo sab li niŋ gbaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Yes, Jeremiah did, Baruch replied. I wrote down just what he told me.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti deei litaafi maa ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni.
en: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.

dag: bahim ba yoli a suhuyiɣisili puuni; bahim ba yoli zaa. Ka dunianim zaa baŋ ni Naawuni n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.

dag: O nina daa ŋmanila buɣim zilinli, ka nam zuɣupila pam pil o zuɣu ni; ka yu shɛli sabi tab o, ka so ʒi li pah o zuɣu.
en: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.

dag: ni Avim ni Para ni Ofira.
en: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah.

dag: Ka Keenannim Naa Arad ŋun daa be Nɛgɛb din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa wum Izraɛlnim kandina damli.
en: Arad was a town in the Negev, in the land of Canaan. The Canaanite king in that place heard that the Israelites were coming.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Di ku niŋ lala. So yi ku nyin Keen, bɛn kum niriba ayopɔin yo a kubu maa samli. Ka Yawɛ daa dalim Keen ni di chɛ ka so ti nya o, ka ku ku o.
en: Then the Lord said to Cain, No, if anyone kills you, I will punish that person much, much more. Then the Lord put a mark on Cain to show that no one should kill him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa chaŋ Giliad mini Kadɛshi din be Hitinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti yi nimaani chaŋ Dan n-yi Dan zaŋ goligi Sidɔn polo.
en: They continued to Gilead and on to Kadesh in Hittite territory. They came to Dan and went around to Sidon.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n sɔɣi n kpim maa kpe, yin wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Balimmiya Zɔhar bia Ɛfurɔn.
en: and replied, If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o mini ba zaa gban tiŋa ka o suhi Naawuni.
en: After Paul had finished speaking, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛriko naa maa daa tim ti yɛli Reehab, Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe a yili ŋɔ na la yina; dama bɛ kamina ni bɛ ti puɣisi baŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa daashili.
en: so he sent word to Rahab: The men in your house have come to spy out the whole country! Bring them out.

dag: Ijipti naa ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim maa zoya maa, ka o min o kpamba zaa suhuri daa lan taɣi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka ti daa niŋ lala? Bɔzuɣu ka ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ka chɛ ti tuma.
en: When the king of Egypt heard that the Israelites had finally left, he and his officials changed their minds and said, Look what we have done! We let them get away, and they will no longer be our slaves.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, amaa n naɣi yumi ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni ka be.
en: I, the Lord God, don't like to see wicked people die. I had much rather see them turn back from their sins and live.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka yi ni shɛb pam gbarigi ka ka alaafee, ka shɛb mi kpi.
en: That is why many in your group are sick and weak, and many have died.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa yi Damaskus kuna, o daa chaŋmi ti nya bimbini maa. Di saha ka o daa vu m-miri bimbini maa nti du n-tam di zuɣu.
en: When the king arrived from Damascus, he saw the altar. He offered sacrifices on the altar.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Faashee Daadam Bia nya wahala pam, ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa ti zaɣis o, ka chɛ ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: Jesus told his disciples, The nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make the Son of Man suffer terribly. They will reject him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.

dag: Ara daŋ — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: of Arah.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Maika bidibisi ni, Shamir n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Uzziels son was Micah. Micahs son was Shamir.

dag: Ka piɛguliba shɛb daa kana ti kari ba, amaa ka Musa daa yiɣisi zab bɛ zuɣu ka niŋ kom ti bɛ piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: But some shepherds came along and rudely chased them away. Moses got up, rescued the women, and gave their flock water to drink.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni ti Yisa jilima yu shɛli maa zuɣu la ni chɛ ka sokam bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛn be tiŋgbani puuni ha ni ti gbani o tooni.
en: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.

dag: Amaa ni a ni chaŋla n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.

dag: O ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa puuni, o miri ka o pini o zuɣu hal ka o ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ saha shɛli maa ti gari. Di simdi ka o be kasi, ka chɛ ka o zabiri zooi wɔɣawɔɣa.
en: As long as you are under the nazirite vow, you must not cut your hair or shave. You are bound by the vow for the full time that you are dedicated to the Lord , and you shall let your hair grow.

dag: A yi tahi kom maa zuɣu, di guurimi, ka a yi chɛ ka saa tahi, kom maa zɔrimi chana.
en: When you rebuked the waters, they fled; they rushed away when they heard your shout of command.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti yɛligu yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka ti Duuma lee kahig o yiko wuhi.
en: This happened so that what the prophet Isaiah had said would come true, Lord, who has believed our message? And who has seen your mighty strength.

dag: ka bo wain lita ayi din nyɛ binnyura sara la ni sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: Also bring quarts of wine as a drink offering as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: So yi chɛ ka o biŋkɔbiri ŋub so puu ni binyɛra bee o wain tihi puu bee n-chɛ o biŋkɔbigu bahi ka o chaŋ so puu ni nti ŋub o bindira, di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o puu ni bindira din niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bee o wain tihi din wali viɛnyɛliŋga yo di samli.
en: If someone lets his animals graze in a field or a vineyard and they stray away and eat up the crops growing in someone else's field, he must make good the loss with the crops from his own fields or vineyards.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ti yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Salo pam yi Ɛdom kanna ni bɛ ti lir a, bɛ yila teekubil duli yaɣ din la polo kanna, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela Hazazɔntarima.
en: Some messengers came and announced to King Jehoshaphat: A large army from Edom has come from the other side of the Dead Sea to attack you. They have already captured Hazazon Tamar.

dag: A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣim gil a maa zaa niŋmiya shili gu ka a leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Tell him to get ready and have all his troops ready at his command.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa boli doo maa m-bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee be.
en: The Lord God called out to the man and asked, Where are you.

dag: nya ka Pita ʒiya wuɣisiri buɣim, ka o lih o ka yɛli, A gba yi bela Yisa Nazarɛt doo ŋɔ sani.
en: and saw Peter warming himself by the fire. She stared at him and said, You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus.

dag: Bɛ nam maa ni ti gbarigi gari nam kam, ka bɛ ti ku lan duhi bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛba, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ kpalim biɛla din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan su zuliya shɛba yaha.
en: and won't ever be strong enough to rule nations, as they did in the past.

dag: Ti Duuma daa yi Sinai Zoli zuɣu n-ka luɣ kasi shee la na ni chɛchɛbunsi din mali kpiɔŋ pam tusatusa din ka kalinli.
en: With his many thousands of mighty chariots the Lord comes from Sinai into the holy place.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ʒe yim hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihitanaanu la tariga mal alibarika!.
en: The one who waits for and comes to the end of the days will be very happy.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Malimiya shili, ka nyo yi firilanim zali ka di dira;.
en: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps lit.

dag: Dama m mi yi tipawumli mini yi noli zaɣisibu yɛla. Yi yi pun nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ noli saha shɛli n ni na be n nyɛvili ni m-be yi sani ŋɔ, wula nti yɛn nyɛ li n kum nyaaŋa?.
en: I know how stubborn and rebellious they are. They have rebelled against the Lord during my lifetime, and they will rebel even more after I am dead.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi bɛ kanimina ti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.

dag: ka o shih o nuu, ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ o saani.
en: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served them.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la so nyɛvili. N ni yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: My lips praise you because your faithful love is better than life itself!.

dag: N suhu dammi, ka bi lan doya; ka wahala dabisa kul paari ma.
en: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.

dag: Neesim neeri wuntizɔriba sani, ka bɛn biɛhigu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Light and happiness shine on those who want to do right.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a fɔntinsi wurim, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will destroy your cities, and you will become empty. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Mɛmukan daa yɛli naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa, Pa naa kɔŋko ka Napaɣ Vashiti lihi ʒiɛm maa, amaa o tuma zuɣulaannim gba hal zaŋ tabili doo kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa!.
en: Then Memucan spoke up in front of the king and the officials. Queen Vashti, he said, has done something wrong not just to the king himself. She has also done wrong to all the officials and the peoples in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus.

dag: Leeban ni daa wum o tizɔpaɣ bia Yaakubu yɛla maa, ka o guui ka o sanna nti bɔb gbaag o m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka zaŋ o kul o yiŋa. Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban binshɛlikam zaa.
en: and when he heard the news about his nephew Jacob, he ran to meet him, hugged him and kissed him, and brought him into the house. When Jacob told Laban everything that had happened.

dag: Amaa n ni saɣi ni shɛli nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛl a ŋɔ: Adiini so shɛli bɛ ni booni adiini soli din bi tuhi la, dina ka n doli n-jɛmdi n yaannim Naawuni, ka niŋ dinkam be zaligu puuni min anabinim sabbu yɛda.
en: But I will tell you this: I worship the God of our fathers as a follower of the Way, which these Jews say is not the right way, and I believe everything that is taught in the Law of Moses and all that is written in the books of the prophets.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha: N ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ biriginsim tuma yɛla hal abada.
en: Then he says, I will forget their sins and never again remember the evil they have done. Jeremiah :.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei.
en: How is it that you can now see? they asked him.

dag: Ka sagbana mi yi ti mɔhi ka sabigi asiba, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi zuŋɔ. Yi baŋdi sagbana shihira, ka lee bi tooi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ shihira.
en: And early in the morning you say, It is going to rain, because the sky is red and dark. You can predict the weather by looking at the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs concerning these times!.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o bia maa ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But when the tenant farmers saw the son, they said to each other, This is the heir. Come on, lets kill him and well have his inheritance.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka n yihi ya yi dimnim zaa nuu ni.
en: No, you must respect only the Lord your God. Then he will save you from all your enemies.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka o mini niriba maa zaa ni naa lo alikauli ni bɛn yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ niriba.
en: Then Jehoiada made an agreement with all the people and the king. They all agreed that they all would be the Lord s people.

dag: Amaa mani n-daa wuhi Ifriimnim chandi. Mani n-daa kpuɣi ba gbibi n nuhi ni. Amaa bɛ daa bi baŋ ni mani n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ maa.
en: Yet it was I who taught Ephraim to walk; I took them up in my arms, but they did not know that I healed them.

dag: ka daa ti yi Matana maa chaŋ Nahaliɛl n-daa ti lan yiɣisi Nahaliɛl maa chaŋ Bamɔt.
en: The people traveled from Mattanah to Nahaliel. Then they traveled from Nahaliel to Bamoth.

dag: Ka o pirig o chinchini sɔŋ, ka vaai yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: Throwing his coat to the side, he jumped up and came to Jesus.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋub o zaɣ kpiŋ maa ŋun paɣim o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam gba kpuɣi zaɣ kpiŋ maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.

dag: ka daa zaŋ maha tari Izraɛl salo bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba maa zaa, ka sokam daa deei mahi yiniyini mini nim kpillikpilli ni bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa zaɣ yiniyini pahi. Di nyaaŋa ka sokam daa wurim kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: and distributed food to them all. He gave each man and woman in Israel a loaf of bread, a piece of roasted meat, and some raisins. Then everyone went home.

dag: Ŋuni n-na mi n-zaŋ o nuu tooi teeku kom m-buɣisi di ni nyɛ shɛm bee n-zaŋ o nutali buɣisi sagbana yɛliŋ, bee n-va tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu niŋ bini puuni, bee n-zaŋ zoya mini kuŋkuna pa sania zuɣu buɣisi li?.
en: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?.

dag: Ti ni nyuri bara binshɛli zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ: Ti suhuri ni tɛha diri ti shɛhira ni ti biɛhigu doli biɛrikasitali mini wuntia soli dunia ŋɔ ni, di bahi bamdi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani, ka di pala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu.
en: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni ka Jɛziriil mini Chɛsulɔt ni Shunɛm.
en: This is the land that was given to that tribe: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem.

dag: Bɔhimmiya zaɣ viɛlli tumbu. Niŋmiya din tuhi, ka sɔŋdi bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka niŋdi kpibisi di ni simdi ni yi niŋ ba shɛm, ka sɔŋmiya pakoya.
en: and learn to do right. See that justice is done—help those who are oppressed, give orphans their rights, and defend widows.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋmi kpani din be a nuu ni ŋɔ tiri Ai; n ni zaŋ li niŋ a nuu ni. Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ kpani din be o nuu ni maa tiri.
en: Finally, the Lord told Joshua, Point your sword at the town of Ai, because now I am going to help you defeat it! As soon as Joshua pointed his sword at the town.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ Naawuni ni daa lo o niriba alikauli ni bɛ ti yɛn nya shɛl la shihirili, hal ka tinim bɛn nyɛ omaŋmaŋ niriba nya yolisim maŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, o mali buchi; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda la sani, o nyɛla bɛ ni booni so: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi, ka di yipa leei kuɣ gahindili la.
en: So, that stone brings honor for you who believe. But for those who dont believe he is the stone that the builders refused to accept, which became the most important stone. Psalm :.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dinzuɣu zaŋm a yɛlimaŋli maa m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Make them holy in the truth; your word is truth.

dag: Nimrim kulibɔŋ nyuuya zaa, ka di duli mɔri kuui, ka momahili lan ka nimaani yaha.
en: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.

dag: n ni daa mali bihim paɣiri n naba, ka doori kpam tampima zuɣu la.
en: My cows and goats gave plenty of milk, and my olive trees grew in the rockiest soil.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa su bi nɛɔŋ maa puu daa biɛr o bia maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli naa, N dana, zaŋm bia maa ti o ka di ku o. Amaa ka paɣ ŋun la yɛli, Pirigim o buyi, ka o lan pa n dini bee o dini.
en: The second woman said, Yes, cut him in two. Then neither of us will have him. But the first woman, the real mother, loved her son and said to the king, Please, sir, dont kill the baby! Give him to her.

dag: Amaa ka o daa fɔh o nuu maa kpɛhi, ka o mabia maa daŋ o yibuna; ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda maa yɛli, A niŋla kpaɣikpaɣi nya soli yina maa! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Pɛrɛz.
en: As soon as he pulled his hand back, his brother came out, and she said, Youve burst out on your own. So he was named Perez.

dag: M biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka yi mali dapaɣa ayɔbu niŋ li.
en: For the back wall along the west side use six frames.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa dolila ʒiri, ka doli yɔhiŋ soli yomyom.
en: I have not lied to anyone. I never tried to cheat people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la nimdi pahi yi sara maligunim nimdi zuɣu ŋubi.
en: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.

dag: Ka Saimɔn kuhi yɛli, Suhim ti Duuma ti ma, ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa miligi n zuɣu.
en: Simon answered, Both of you pray to the Lord for me, so that what you have said will not happen to me.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Wummiya n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ: Anabinim yi be yi ni, man Yawɛ ni kahigi mmaŋ wuhi ba ʒii puuni, ka tɔɣis ba yɛtɔɣa zahindi ni.
en: and the Lord said, Now hear what I have to say! When there are prophets among you, I reveal myself to them in visions and speak to them in dreams.

dag: Ka Pita daa bɔh o, Ananias, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka Sintani kpe a suhu ni ka a pii liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka ŋmari Naawuni Shia Kasi ʒiri?.
en: Peter asked, Ananias, how is it that Satan has influenced you to lie to the Holy Spirit by withholding some of the proceeds from the sale of your land?.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ n dɔɣiriba, yi nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yinim ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa n-zaŋ man naa labisi.
en: You are my relatives, my own flesh and blood; why should you be the last to bring me back.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka Yawɛ daa wum ti kuhigu maa, ka nya ti wahala mini ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ti muɣisigu maa.
en: Then we prayed to the Lord , the God of our ancestors, and complained about them. And the Lord heard us. He saw our trouble, our hard work, and our suffering.

dag: Naa, di gbinni m-bala. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm m-bala.
en: Your Majesty, God Most High has sent you this message, and it means.

dag: Dinzuɣu nir yi nya biɛla diri ka mali suhudoo, di so ni o niŋ wahala nya pam. Di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Maybe that is true. But I say it is better to be satisfied with the few things you have than to always be struggling to get more.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa lan tɛhimi ni nyin naa yɛligu nyɛla din ni ti ma vuhim, dama nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika ŋun mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni be a sani.
en: I can rest easy now that you have given your decision. You know the difference between right and wrong just like an angel of God, and I pray that the Lord your God will be with you.

dag: M bi zɔri ninvuɣ tuhi piapia bɛn ʒe n-gili n luɣilikam la.
en: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.

dag: Samarianim naa ni ti bahi yoli kaman tipɔɣu din pa kom zuɣu la.
en: Samaria will be cut off; her king is like a chip of wood on the surface of the water.

dag: ka ti daai yi dikiya luhi n-dahimdahim li pa yi mini yi bihi zuɣu; hal ka tandaɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu, yi ni bi baŋ saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa kana ni o ti tiligi ya la zuɣu.
en: They will completely destroy you and the people within your walls; not a single stone will they leave in its place, because you did not recognize the time when God came to save you.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o ma Ribɛka, Nyama, m biɛli Iso niŋgbuna mali kɔbiri pam, ka m mi niŋgbuna be polipoli.
en: But Jacob told his mother Rebekah, My brother Esau is a hairy man. I am not hairy like him.

dag: ka n ti sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa wurim la zuɣu m-pa kuɣ parilana ayi maa zuɣu, ka a zaŋ li niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: I will write on the stone tablets the same words that were on the first stones—the stones you broke. Then you must put these new stones in the Box.

dag: ka Yisa mabihi yɛl o, Yim kpe chaŋ Judia ka di chɛ ka a nyaandoliba nya tuun shɛŋa a ni tumdi ŋɔ.
en: So his brothers said to him, You should leave here and go to the festival in Judea. Then your followers there can see the miracles you do.

dag: N niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ni n di di daanfaani.
en: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔana ni Jeemsi ma Mariama ni paɣ shɛb bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Yisa tuumba maa di yɛla maa.
en: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told these things to the apostles.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wuhi ma di gbinni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la wuhirila nam din pah anahi nti yɛn yiɣisi zani. Di ni ti be di ko ni nama zaa. Di ni ti dari chahi dunia ŋɔ zaa chɛrachɛra, ka no li sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: This is what he said: The fourth beast means that there will be a fourth kingship on the earth. It will be different from all the other kingships. It will devour the entire earth, trample it, crush it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-kahigiri wuhiri Naawuni bihi ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan wuhiri Sintani gba bihi ni nyɛ shɛba: Ŋunkam bi tumdi din tuhi bee n-yur o mabia pala Naawuni bia.
en: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other.

dag: Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: The Lord has done this, and its amazing in our eyes? .

dag: O mabia Shɛmɛr mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahi mini Rɔga ni Jɛhuba ni Aram.
en: Shemers family: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi Firawuna min o kpambaliba yinsi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Ka zɔhi maa daa chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa saɣim.
en: The LORD did this. Great swarms of insects came into the houses of Pharaoh and his officials and into the whole land of Egypt. The land was ruined by the insects.

dag: Bɛ suhuri yɛla niriba puri zuɣu, ka bɛ far li, ka ye niriba yinsi zuɣu, ka bɛ far li. Bɛ nahim yililana n-tabil o yiŋnima, ka nahim niriba n-tabili bɛ fali.
en: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali, dama n zani m ba Dauda zaani n-di nam ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: The Lord has done what he promised. I am now the king of Israel, and I've built a temple for the Lord our God.

dag: Ka o daa shiri taɣi doli so shɛli, ka bi lan dol o ni daa pun doli so shɛli ka Bɛtɛl na maa.
en: So the man of God went by a different way. He didnt return by the way he came to Bethel.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmaai tiŋgban shɛli ti Yisifu bituuli Manaasa zuliya niriba shɛba. Makiri daa nyɛla Manaasa bidib kpɛma; ka Makiri mi bidib kpɛm yuli n-daa booni Giliad; Makiri daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Giliad mini Bashan ti o.
en: Then land was given to the tribe of Manasseh. Manasseh was Josephs first son. Manassehs first son was Makir, the father of Gilead. Makir was a great soldier, so the areas of Gilead and Bashan were given to his family.

dag: Daba ata maa dali, ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ ka tiligi, dama n zɔri Naawuni.
en: before saying to them: Since I respect God, I'll give you a chance to save your lives.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna! Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: God All-Powerful, accept us again. Smile down on us and save us!.

dag: Amaa Hanna ŋun daa bi chaŋ, dama o daa yɛlila o yidana, Faashee bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili ka n zaŋ o tahi Yawɛ sani ka o ti kpalim be nimaani hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Hannah didnt go. Ill bring the boy when he is weaned, she told her husband, so he can be presented to the LORD and stay there permanently. I will offer him as a nazirite forever.

dag: Bɛ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiri gba be di ni; ka bɛ je ni bɛ tum yɛm tuma ni din viɛla.
en: Their speech is wicked and full of lies; they no longer do what is wise and good.

dag: Kamiyana nti dinya nanim mini sapashinnim ni kpiɔŋlaannim ni yuri mini bɛn bari ba zaŋ tabili daadam kam bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba ni wɔɣira mini tarimba nimdi.
en: Come together so that you can eat the bodies of rulers and army commanders and famous men. Come to eat the bodies of the horses and their riders and the bodies of all people—free, slave, small, and great.

dag: Ka di tiri mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kom, ka mɔɣu ni bunsi nyuri li kuri kɔnyuri.
en: The streams provide water for all the wild animals. Even the wild donkeys come there to drink.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a zaligunim soya, ka n dol li hal ni di tariga.
en: Point out your rules, Lord , and I won't disobey even one of them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛhu, A ni tum din tuhi n sani, ka niŋ Ɛhab daŋ niriba kaman n suhu ni daa yu shɛm zaa la zuɣu, a daŋ ni bidibisi kul ni diri Izraɛl nam hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni.
en: The LORD said to Jehu: Because youve done well by doing what is right in my eyes, treating Ahabs family as I wished, your descendants will sit on Israels throne for four generations.

dag: Mani n-daa zaŋ sagbana pil li, ka zaŋ zibisim titali vil li.
en: Who covered it with clouds and wrapped it in darkness?.

dag: Ka n daa lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya ka yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni tinvura ni yiŋ biŋgbamda ni noonsi m-be di ni.
en: I looked closely inside and saw domesticated and wild animals, reptiles, and wild birds.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali mabihi ni bidibisi bɛn daa mali yiko din ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Meshelemiahs family and relatives, valiant men, numbered .

dag: A mi ni m ba Dauda min o dimnim bɛn gil o daa kul tuhirila taba hal ka Yawɛ daa ti chɛ ka o nyaŋ ba. Lala zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka o bi tooi me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu.
en: You know that because of the constant wars my father David had to fight against the enemy countries all around him, he could not build a temple for the worship of the Lord his God until the Lord had given him victory over all his enemies.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: God's glory has left Israel, she said, because God's Covenant Box has been captured.

dag: Ifriimnim tum tuun shɛli din tahi suhuyiɣisili pam na, dinzuɣu Yawɛ chɛ ka ninvuɣ kubo taali la ʒi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ni ti darigi bɛ tibili bɛ ni daa tur o la zuɣu.
en: But Ephraim made the Lord very angry. Ephraim killed many people, so he will be punished for his crimes. His Lord will make him bear his shame.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba soli tum alahichi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi.
en: He did evil in the LORDs eyes by walking in the way of his father Jeroboam and the sin Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn tiri yimaŋ yɛlimaŋli niriba san la, amaa Naawuni mi din be yi suhuri ni. Ninsalinim ni tibigiri binshɛli pam nyɛla Naawuni ni chihiri shɛli.
en: He said to them, You are the ones who justify yourselves before other people, but God knows your hearts. What is highly valued by people is deeply offensive to God.

dag: Amaa chamiya ti yɛl o nyaandoliba mini Pita ni Yisa daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: Now go and tell his disciples, and especially Peter, that he will go ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi ni be n yurilim maa ni kaman n gba ni doli m Ba zaligu ka be o yurilim ni shɛm.
en: If you obey my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have obeyed my Father's commands and remain in his love.

dag: Sana daa ʒi n-gbe samban ni, n daa kul yoola n dunoya ti sochandiba.
en: and travelers were always welcome.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Ka bɔzuɣu ka yinim zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus answered, And why do you disobey God's command and follow your own teaching?.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa, ka ti a a ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Eli responded, Then go in peace. And may the God of Israel give you what youve asked from him.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda nayili polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ŋmanila Giliad n sani, ka ŋmani Lɛbanɔn zoya, amaa m poya ni n ni zaŋ a leei tiŋgban nɛli, ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli.
en: The LORD proclaims concerning the palace of the king of Judah: Though you are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will turn you into a desert—uninhabited cities.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla bɛn lihiri Naa Dauda daazichi.
en: in charge of the flocks of sheep and goats—Jaziz the Hagrite. All these were stewards of King Davids property.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa wolig o piɛsah ayopɔin zali bɛ ko.
en: Abraham separated seven lambs from his flock.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Abib goli ŋɔ ni ka yi yɛn yi.
en: You are leaving Egypt on this day in the first month, the month of Abib.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi ninvuɣ so daadamnim puuni? Bee bɛ daa dɔɣ a mi pɔi ka daboya naanyi pili?.
en: Were you born the first Adam, brought forth before the hills?.

dag: N ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam zaa Masia ni tiri ma yaa la zuɣu.
en: I have the strength to face all conditions by the power that Christ gives me.

dag: Amaa a zuɣu, bɛ kul kuri ti mi dabisili kam, ka niŋdi ti kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: No, God, its because of you that we are getting killed every day— its because of you that we are considered sheep ready for slaughter.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa bo niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi do zoya zuɣu gu Abimilɛk, ka daa kul fari bɛnkam zaa doli nimaani gariti nɛma. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: The leaders of the city of Shechem did not like Abimelech anymore. They put men on the hilltops to attack and rob everyone who went by. Abimelech found out about the attacks.

dag: Ka bɛn daa doli Sool daa zaŋ o niŋ piɛɣu ni yuŋ du gooni n-zaŋ o siɣisi ti zali tiŋa.
en: But his disciples took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the city wall.

dag: Di ti ku ŋmani n ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Yi Duuma lan yɛli, Bɛ daa bi gbibi alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo ba la, dinzuɣu ka m mi baɣa daa ka bɛ ni.
en: It will not be like the covenant that I made with their ancestors on the day I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt, because they did not continue to keep my covenant, and I lost interest in them, says the Lord. .

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ kum kuyila bahi ti zuɣu yomyom, ka nintam yi ti nina ni na, ka nintam ti tɛli ti niŋkari zaa.
en: The people said, Tell them to hurry and sing a funeral song for us, until our eyes fill with tears, and our eyelids are wet from crying.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: But I say to you that Tyre and Sidon will be better off on Judgment Day than you.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu.
en: the chest containing the covenant with its poles and the cover.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: The followers were amazed to hear this. They asked, Then who can be saved.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Izraɛl fɔntinsi ni ni ti yina m-mali buɣim nyo bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti va nyɔtaɣiri bihi mini zaɣ kara ni tɔbiri ni piɛma ni kpana n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim yuma ayopɔin.
en: The people who live in the cities of Israel will go out and collect the abandoned weapons for firewood. They will build fires with the shields, bows, arrows, spears, and clubs, and have enough to last for seven years.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Jɛriko chaŋ Ai din daa miri Bɛtavɛn, ka be Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo la. O daa yɛli ba mi, Chamiya ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa. Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kaai Ai;.
en: After they defeated Jericho, Joshua sent some men to Ai. Ai was near Beth Aven, east of Bethel. He told them, Go to Ai and look for weaknesses in that area. So the men went to spy on that land.

dag: Bɛ daa lab bɛ shɛb kuɣa ku ba, ka daa zaŋ sua m-pirigi bɛ shɛb buyiyi; ka daa zahim bɛ shɛba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba. Bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛrila piɛri mini buhi gbana chani ginda. Bɛ daa nyɛla nandaamba ni bɛn nyari muɣisigu mini nahiŋgu.
en: They were stoned, they were sawed in two, they were killed by the sword. They went around clothed in skins of sheep or goats—poor, persecuted, and mistreated.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga yɛn nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli. Yi wulinluhili polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: The western border will be the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ammɔnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba ŋmaligi Jɔab mabia Abishai sani guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni, ka chɛ Abishai Jɔab mabia maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonite troops saw that the Syrians had run away, they ran from Abishai's soldiers and went back into their own city. Joab then returned to Jerusalem.

dag: O bidibisi maa daa yi chanila tab yinsi ti puhiri churi sokam dabisili dali, ka daa yi timdi booni bɛ tizɔpaɣiba maa na ka bɛ mini ba ti diri ka nyura.
en: Job's sons took turns having feasts in their homes, and they always invited their three sisters to join in the eating and drinking.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi sabilifaa niŋ li ni bɛ zaŋ li lɔri pari bantabiga maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: They tied it to the front of the turban with a blue cord, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋ yimaŋ barina titali ŋɔ ni yi ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bibihi ni biliɛri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka so ku lan kpalim?.
en: Now the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Why are you committing this huge mistake that will cost you your lives? Every man, woman, child, and infant will be eliminated from the midst of Judah, and no one will be left.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niŋ wain n-ti ti ba maa ka o nyu, ka ti chɛ ka o zaŋ ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: Let's get our father drunk! Then we can sleep with him and have children.

dag: Hal ti nyari ka yɛnnim kpira, ka jɛra mini bɛn ka laasabu gba kpira. Bɛ zaa mi kpirimi n-chani ka chɛri bɛ daazichi tiri shɛba.
en: Everyone knows that the wise die too, just like foolish and stupid people do, all of them leaving their fortunes to others.

dag: Man Jɔn kpahiri ŋunkam wum anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni zuɣu ni: Ŋunkam pahi shɛli di ni, Naawuni ni zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam din sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la m-pah o tibidarigibo zuɣu;.
en: Now I bear witness to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy contained in this scroll: If anyone adds to them, God will add to that person the plagues that are written in this scroll.

dag: Zaŋm li lo n-niŋ a suhu ni sahakam, ka zaŋ li lo a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Remember their words always. Tie them around your neck and keep them over your heart.

dag: Di dunoli yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka o daa buɣisi du titali maa puuni wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: and feet wide, with walls feet thick on either side. He measured the room itself: it was feet long and feet wide.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi wɔribariba noli, ka bɛ ba nayili yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zaŋ gbana maa tahi yomyom. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm moli Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa puuni.
en: The messengers hurried out, riding on the kings horses. The king commanded them to hurry. And the command was also put in the capital city of Susa.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi maa n-wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tum din ni tiɣ o nini. Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnim bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la, ka lan woligi yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzun paɣiba.
en: But now, make a confession to the LORD God of your ancestors and do his will. Separate yourselves from the neighboring peoples and from the foreign wives.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum li maa zaŋ li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni ka bɔhira, Bɔtaa nira n-lee ti yɛn nyɛ bia ŋɔ? Dama sokam daa baŋya ni ti Duuma zaɣa be o ni.
en: Everyone who heard about these things wondered about them. They thought, What will this child be? They could see that the Lord was with him.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, a kul yɛn dola nimaani hal ni saha dini? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn neei a gom ni?.
en: How long is the lazy man going to lie around? When is he ever going to get up?.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kubiɛlima n-kuri takɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi su kara mi kuri kpana. Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ gbarima gba yɛli, Ti nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba.
en: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim suhuri daa paligi pam, bɛ ni daa yi n-chaŋ maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa kpalim zɔri ba mi.
en: Egypt was happy to see his people go, because they were afraid of them.

dag: Ka n ni ti zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim labisi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti lab me tin shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la m-be di ni. Bɛ ni ti ko tiwala puri ka nyu di wala kom. Bɛ ni ti ko tihi puri ka di di wala.
en: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai tiŋgbɔna nam kam zaa dabiɛm, bɛ ni daa wum Yawɛ ni tuhi Izraɛlnim dimnim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The fear of God came on all the surrounding kingdoms when they heard how the LORD had fought against Israels enemies.

dag: lala zuɣu ka man daa zo a dabiɛm, ka zaŋ a pɔŋ tuhili maa ti pi tiŋgban ni; dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a bini.
en: I was frightened and went out and hid your money in the ground. Here is every single coin.

dag: Nyin daadam, bom tandaɣili sɔŋ a tooni, ka ŋme Jɛrusalɛm kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: You, human one, take a brick. Put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti ʒe Gɛnɛsarɛt Teeku noli, ka niriba pam kpaɣiri chan o sani ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: As Jesus stood beside Lake Galilee, a crowd of people pushed to get closer to him and to hear the teachings of God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn kabisila Ɛlamnim tɔbiri din nyɛ bɛ yaa la.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Im going to break the bow of Elam, the backbone of its military might.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa pii kuɣ pinaayi shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la na n-sɔŋ Giligal maa.
en: There Joshua set up the twelve stones taken from the Jordan.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba, ka chɛla Juda zuliya kɔŋko.
en: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left.

dag: A ni ti lula palɔni, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will not enter the city. You will be killed out in the open fields. I have spoken! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim din nyɛ ti daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ la.
en: The Son paid the price to make us free. In him we have forgiveness of our sins.

dag: ka yi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Yi yi zaŋ li ti ti maligumaana, o mi ni zaŋ li chaŋ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: Bring it as an offering to the Lord and present it to the priest, who will take it to the altar.

dag: Dama yi ni ti bemi kaman oki ti shɛli din vari suui, ka be kaman mahili ni ka pu shɛl ni.
en: You will wither like a dying oak, like a garden that no one waters.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti duhiri timaŋa ka tumdi din yiɣisiri tab suhuri bee n-zabiri tab nyuli.
en: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam Naa ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ku lu a sizuura? Dama lala n-simd a. Zuliya kam yɛnnim mini bɛ nanim zaa so m-bi ŋman a.
en: Who wouldnt fear you, king of the nations? That is your due; among all the wise of the nations and in all their countries, there is no one like you!.

dag: Miri ka a pahi shɛli o yɛligu zuɣu, di yi pa lala o ni kpah a zuɣu ni, ka di wuhi ni a nyɛla ʒirilana.
en: Dont add to his words, or he will correct you and show you to be a liar.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Duhimiya Yawɛ tuuta maa zuɣusaa, Yawɛ kul ni tuhiri Amalɛknim maa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: He said, Hold high the banner of the Lord ! The Lord will continue to fight against the Amalekites forever.

dag: Amaa ka Nabɔt yɛli Ɛhab, Yawɛ di wuhi gba, ka n zaŋ n yaannim fali ti a.
en: I inherited this vineyard from my ancestors, Naboth replied. The Lord forbid that I should let you have it.

dag: Pa ŋun daa nam ma niŋ m ma puli ni n-daa nam bɛ gba? Pa ŋuna n-daa nam ti zaa niŋ ti manim puya ni?.
en: The same God who created me created my servants also.

dag: Hal n ni kul ka taali maa zaa yoli n ku tooi garig o. N naɣ ni suhila ŋun zaŋ ma taali maa, ka o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: Even though I am innocent, I can only beg for mercy.

dag: O kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam zoori kpɛri tab ni, ka niŋgbuŋ maa zaa kpe n-saɣisi tab ni di tuɣili kam shee. Ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam yi tumdi di tuma viɛnyɛliŋga kaman di ni simdi ni di tumdi shɛm, niŋgbuŋ maa zaa zoorimi yurilim puuni.
en: who is the head. The whole body grows from him, as it is joined and held together by all the supporting ligaments. The body makes itself grow in that it builds itself up with love as each one does its part.

dag: Ka kum daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na. Ka kɔnyuri daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba kom din yi tampiŋ ni na. Ka a daa yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni zaŋ ti ba fali la su.
en: When they were hungry, you gave them bread from heaven; when they were thirsty, you brought water out of the rock for them. You told them to go in to possess the land that you had sworn to give them.

dag: Ka Juda daa bo paɣ ti o bituuli Ɛr. Paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Tama.
en: Later, Judah chose Tamar as a wife for Er, his oldest son.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-sula Izraɛlnim yuma ayi.
en: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu lihi binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka yuŋ ni daa zibira ka o min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi ni lab Bɛtani.
en: After Jesus had gone to Jerusalem, he went into the temple and looked around at everything. But since it was already late in the day, he went back to Bethany with the twelve disciples.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ Sool takɔbi nyaɣi pa gbaɣino maa zuɣu, ka yɛn chaŋ ka di nyaŋ o, dama o daa na ʒi n-zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa. Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, N ku tooi zaŋ nɛma ŋɔ niŋ mmaŋ chaŋ; dama m bi mil li. Ka daa yihi di zaa sɔŋ.
en: David strapped Saul's sword over the armor and tried to walk, but he couldn't, because he wasn't used to wearing them. I can't fight with all this, he said to Saul. I'm not used to it. So he took it all off.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n na zaŋdila pini tahiri Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti sɔŋ Yisa nyaandoliba.
en: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.

dag: Tiŋ maa gooni maa daa me n-tamla di gbinni kuɣa pinaayi zuɣu, ka Piɛbil la tuumba pinaayi la yuya sab pa kuɣa pinaayi maa zuɣu.
en: The walls of the city were built on twelve foundation stones. On the stones were written the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

dag: Ka di simdi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam ni bɛ yɔri Izraɛlnim daalahichi zaa samli tiri ba yim yuuni puuni. Ka Musa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa.
en: These regulations are to be observed for all time to come. This ritual must be performed once a year to purify the people of Israel from all their sins. So Moses did as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yɛli ni alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But the Pharisees said, He throws out demons with the authority of the ruler of demons.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, man mini m mabihi ni n tumtumdiba zaŋla ti liɣiri mini chi m-paŋ ba. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chɛ ti ni bɔri ni bɛ labisi nyɔri shɛli n-yo ti la ti ba.
en: I myself, along with my family and my servants, am lending them money and grain. But lets stop charging this interest!.

dag: Fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Yɛla ŋɔ yipa niŋ pali yi sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then Jesus said to them, What you have just heard me read has come true today.

dag: Ka yi ti ŋmahiŋmahi li ka booi kpam niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.

dag: O na ʒi n-zaɣisi bee n-siŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari nahiŋgu; bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa ka n ni. O mi bi lɛbir o nyaaŋa biriti ma, amaa n yi kuhi niŋ o bɔri sɔŋsim, o wumda.
en: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii wɔribariba ayi, ka naa maa tim ba Siria tɔbbihi maa sani ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya.
en: They found two chariots, and the king commanded the men to find out what had happened to the Syrian troops.

dag: Di saha bɛ mini Sool ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa daa bela Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-tuhiri Filistianima.
en: Your brothers are with Saul and all the Israelite soldiers in the Valley of Elah. They are there to fight against the Philistines.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa ti tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ka ti ku kpi; dama ti bo naa ti timaŋa n-lan tum alahichi pahi ti ni pun tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: They told Samuel, Please, pray to the Lord your God for us! We don't want to die. We have sinned many times in the past, and we were very wrong to ask for a king.

dag: dama di kɔŋko n-nyɛ o ni mali shɛli pinda, ka bɔ ka o ti yɛn zaŋ pili gbihi? O yi fabili niŋ ma, n ni wum o fabila maa, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: That cloak might be their only protection against the cold when they lie down to sleep. If they call to me for help, I will listen because I am kind.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o paɣ Zara nti sɔɣi sil shɛli din daa be Makipɛla palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of that field near Mamre in the land of Canaan.

dag: A bɔhiya, Ŋuni n-lee beni n-sɔɣiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, mani n-daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni. N daa tɔɣisila binshɛŋa yɛla ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam, ka m bi baŋ li.
en: You ask how I dare question your wisdom when I am so very ignorant. I talked about things I did not understand, about marvels too great for me to know.

dag: Dama ti wum kuhigu damli Ziɔn. Ti bahi yoli. Ti di vi zaa! Di simdi ni ti yi ti tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ daai ti yinsi luhi.
en: Now those of us on Zion cry, We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam, ka o biɛhigu zaa mali kɔre pam. Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n yura ni n zo maa ni be shɛm m-bala.
en: His mouth is sweet to kiss; everything about him enchants me. This is what my lover is like, women of Jerusalem.

dag: Masia yɛlimaŋli din be n ni la zuɣu, binshɛli kani din ni tooi yihi barinyubo shɛli din be n ni ŋɔ Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinsi ni.
en: No one there in Achaia will stop me from boasting about that. I say this with the truth of Christ in me.

dag: Dama n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla bindir maŋli, ka n ʒim mi nyɛ binnyur maŋli.
en: My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi daania niŋbu maa niŋ pali, ka di chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani shɛlikam zaa puuni, ka ku kɔŋ shɛli.
en: Let this endurance complete its work so that you may be fully mature, complete, and lacking in nothing.

dag: A bahiri ʒiŋmariba yoli, nyin Yawɛ je ninvuɣ kuriba mini ninvuɣ yɔhindiba.
en: You destroy all liars and despise violent, deceitful people.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be kaman yɛndana? Ka ŋuni n-lee baŋdi yɛla gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm? Yɛm chɛmi ka nir ninni ne zaa, ka chɛ ka o ninni lihibu biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Who is wise? And who knows the meaning of anything? A persons wisdom brightens the expression; it changes the hardness of someones face.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o dɔɣiriba, Pihimiya kuɣa na, ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa maa na nti kahi li duhi, ka daa ʒini kuɣ duli maa gbini di bindirigu.
en: he told his men to get some more rocks and pile them up next to it. Then Jacob and Laban ate a meal together beside the rocks.

dag: n-chaŋ ti moli o nasara dibu molo shihi bɛn be sarika ni la sani.
en: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.

dag: ka bɛ moli Yawɛ yuli Ziɔn, ka paɣ o Jɛrusalɛm.
en: that the LORDs name may be declared in Zion and his praise declared in Jerusalem.

dag: Bee o yi shihi daadam daɣiri, din dee yi kul nyɛ daɣ shɛlikam din chɛ ka ninsal bi be kasi ka bi baŋ li, o yi ti baŋ li o mali taali.
en: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.

dag: Ka tɔb shɛli daa ti lan lu bɛ sunsuuni Gaat, ka wɔɣiri tital so daa beni. O daa malila nubih ayɔbuyɔbu ni napombih ayɔbuyɔbu. Ka di zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi pisinaanahi. O gba daa yila tiyaawumyanim maa zuliya ni na.
en: Then there was another battle at Gath, where there was a giant who loved to fight. He had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot.

dag: Hal di wumdi bipala ka bɛ gbarigira, ka di wumdi nachimba ka bɛ lura.
en: Young men get tired and need to rest. Even young boys stumble and fall.

dag: Niriba maa zaa ni daa du duli naai saha shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa mi naanyi du duli na n-gari niriba maa tooni.
en: After the people finished crossing the river, the priests carried the Lord s Holy Box to the front of the people.

dag: n yɛn zaŋ ya mi ti wulimpuhili polo nima ka bɛ sun ya. Ka bɛ ti ti bɛ suɣa yi sani n-ʒini yi sunsuuni. Bɛ ni ti di yi tiwala, ka nyu yi bihim.
en: So I will give you to the people from the east. They will get your land. Their armies will set up their camps in your country and will live among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Kɛdar mini Nɛbaiɔt piɛri na nti tin ya. Yi ni ti tooi zaŋ ba mali sara n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu; ka n tibigi n jɛmbu duu din mali jilima maa.
en: All Kedars sheep will be gathered for you; rams from Nebaioth will be your offerings; they will be accepted on my altar, and I will glorify my splendid house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba nti kpari duu ni biɛɣ neei, dama di daa nyɛla zaawun yuŋ.
en: So they arrested them and put them in jail until the next day, since it was already late.

dag: Yi mi dɔɣimiya bihi pam, ka bɛ nabi pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: I want you and your descendants to have many children, so people will live everywhere on earth.

dag: O daa kamina ni o ti di neesim maa shɛhira, ka bɛnkam zaa wum o yɛligu niŋ yɛda o zuɣu.
en: He came to tell people about the light. Through him all people could hear about the light and believe.

dag: Daamiya maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim bɛ buɣa bin wɔɣila la, ka nyo bɛ wuni Ashɛra binnana la buɣim, ka lala chɛ ka yi kpihim bɛ yuli nimaani.
en: You must smash their altars and break their memorial stones into pieces. You must burn their Asherah poles and cut down the statues of their gods. Wipe out everything that would remind you of those gods.

dag: Ka m mali tahima ti Duuma sani ni di ku yuui ka mmaŋmaŋ gba tooi ka yi sanna.
en: I trust in the Lord that I also will visit you soon.

dag: ka zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbin la sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Put the bowl between the Meeting Tent and the altar. Put water in the bowl.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal min o mabihi daa ti ka Shɛkɛm na, Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa niŋ o naani.
en: One day, Gaal son of Ebed went to live in Shechem. His brothers moved there too, and soon the leaders of Shechem started trusting him.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o teei dɔni Balaam jɔɣu ni, ka Balaam suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zaŋ o jaaŋgbe bil fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: This time, when the donkey saw the angel, it lay down. Balaam lost his temper and began to beat the donkey with his stick.

dag: Ka o ni yuri ya shɛm o suhu ni kul pahirimi, di bahi bamdi o yi teei yi zaa nɔdeebo mini yi ni daa deeg o ni sizuura lubu la yɛla.
en: And his love for you is stronger when he remembers that you were all ready to obey. You welcomed him with respect and fear.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti di bɛ ni daa ʒi kawaan shɛli Ijipti na maa naai saha shɛli ka bɛ ba yɛli ba, Labimiya ti da bindirigu biɛla na nti ti ti yaha.
en: until finally, Jacob's family had eaten all the grain they had bought in Egypt. So Jacob said to his sons, Go back and buy some more grain.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl.
en: When Kenan was , he had a son named Mahalalel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe du titali puuni nti buɣisi di pilanima. Yaɣa maa zaa pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita ata.
en: Next, the man took me into the central room, the Holy Place. He measured the passageway into it: it was feet deep.

dag: Tinzunnim ni ti yiɣisi guui kaman tɔhinima n-kari doli ba la bee kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni mini bɛ niriba sani.
en: Then the people from Babylon will run away like wounded deer or sheep that have no shepherd. Everyone will turn and run back to their own country and people.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala, kola maa ni chɛhichɛhi, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli n-lɛrila kol pala ni, ka di bina ayi maa zaa shɛli ku saɣim.
en: Nor does anyone pour new wine into used wineskins, for the skins will burst, the wine will pour out, and the skins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into fresh wineskins, and both will keep in good condition.

dag: Dama di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛl; di nyɛla Yaakubu Naawuni zaligu.
en: This is the law for the people of Israel. The God of Jacob gave the command.

dag: Yawɛ, wun ŋuni n-lee lan ŋman a? Ŋun nam dariza min o kasitali n-lee ŋman a, ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm ni jilima, ka o tumd alahiziba tuma?.
en: Who is like you among the gods, LORD? Who is like you, foremost in holiness, worthy of highest praise, doing awesome deeds?.

dag: Ka yi ti mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di li nimaani, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord 's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura, ka dol o soli mali alibarika.
en: Everyone who honors the LORD, who walks in Gods ways, is truly happy!.

dag: O daa tuɣindila tulaale zim Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka doli Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔn maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la ni daa tumdi din chihiri shɛl la soli n-zaŋd o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani buɣa.
en: and burning incense in the Ben-hinnom Valley. He even burned his own sons alive, imitating the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

dag: A viɛli pam, ka a viɛlim maa mali kɔre, n yura ŋun nyɛ paɣ viɛlli.
en: How pretty you are, how beautiful; how complete the delights of your love.

dag: Amaa m mi a ni ʒiini shɛm min a ni yiri shɛm ni a ni labiri kpɛri shɛm ni a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu shɛm yɛla.
en: I know all about your battles; I know when you rested, when you went out to war, and when you came home. I also know when you got upset at me.

dag: Kpahimmiya Izraɛlnim ni niŋdi shɛm: Bɛn diri sara maligu bindira la nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni mali dolintabitali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu tuma ni.
en: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?.

dag: Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: All together, there were , people in the group who came back. This is not counting their men and women slaves. They also had men and women singers with them.

dag: Kaman kurimbuni ha yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ni yɛli shɛm la, Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kɔbili ni ka ninvuɣ biɛtali yirina. Amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: An old proverb says, Only evil people do evil things, and so I won't harm you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: Jesus called them over and said, You know that the ones who are considered the rulers by the Gentiles show off their authority over them and their high-ranking officials order them around.

dag: Filistianim ni daa zaŋ bintɔra kɔtomsi salima din nyɛ alahichi sanyoo pini m-pahi ti ti Yawɛ la zaɣ yini daa nyɛla Ashidɔdnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gazanim dini, ka yini nyɛ Ashikɛlɔnnim dini, ka yini nyɛ Gaatinim dini, ka yini mi nyɛ Ɛkurɔn nim dini.
en: These are the gold tumors that the Philistines returned as a compensation offering to the LORD: one for Ashdod, one for Gaza, one for Ashkelon, one for Gath, and one for Ekron.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ban yini ga di zuɣusaa polo tabili taba, amaa ka di zaŋ siɣi tiŋ na lee woligi taba. Lala ka bɛ daa mali diba ayi maa niŋ lɔris ayi maa ni.
