en: These corner frames were joined at the bottom and connected all the way to the top. The two frames that formed the two corners were made in this way.

dag: Ka sabi Aduna yuli pa Lɛvi jaaŋgbee zuɣu. Di simdi ni dunoli kam kpɛm malila jaaŋgbe yini.
en: and then write Aaron's name on the stick representing Levi. There will be one stick for each tribal leader.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun guli ma kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la, ka binshɛli bi poori ma.
en: The Lord is my shepherd. I will always have everything I need.

dag: M bia, wumm a ba ni wuhir a shɛli, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: Listen, my son, to your fathers instruction; dont neglect your mothers teaching.

dag: Yuun tuhili maa tariga yi ti paai, Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ yooi Sintani o sarika maa ni bahi.
en: At the end of the , years, Satan will be set free.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: The rest of the army Joab placed under the command of his brother Abishai. When they took up their positions to meet the Ammonites, Joab said.

dag: Ka siliga guliba maa daa deei liɣiri maa, ka chaŋ ti shiri niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm maa, ka Yɛhudianim daa deei yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ yɛlimaŋli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: So the soldiers kept the money and obeyed the priests. And that story is still spread among the Jews even today.

dag: So yi mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla o yɛn yola o ni po pɔr shɛli samli bee o kul yɛn malila o suhu yubu sara, ka di nyɛla o piila o niɣi ni bee o piɛri ni na, n yi ni deei li, di simdi ka o nyɛla ŋun viɛl zaa. Di bi simdi ka o mali daŋa.
en: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Nyamiya, o boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, He is calling for Elijah.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa shɛm m-bala.
en: So you will divide this land among you for the tribes of Israel.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka zaŋ jɛlinsi yo ma yurilim samli.
en: I did good things to them, but they are doing bad things to me. I loved them, but they hated me.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-ni tooi wuhi n daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n yi tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda?.
en: Which one of you can prove that I am guilty of sin? If I tell the truth, then why do you not believe me?.

dag: dama di bemi kaman so ni daa yɛli la: O zuɣu ka ti be ka damda, ka kul be ŋɔ. Di lan bemi kaman yi baŋdib shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la, Ti gba shiri yila Naawuni ni na.
en: It is through him that we are able to live, to do what we do, and to be who we are. As your own poets have said, We all come from him.

dag: Ka Naa maa mi ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa niŋdi m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi maa.
en: The King will reply, I tell you, whenever you did this for one of the least important of these followers of mine, you did it for me.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa naai saha shɛli ka o daa yɛli ba.
en: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yihi nandaamba bɛ nandahima ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ malibu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: But he rescued the needy from their misery and made their families increase like flocks.

dag: Bɛ pala dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm.
en: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pa ʒii buyopɔin kɔŋko, amaa pisopɔin mi ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Jesus answered, I tell you, you must forgive them more than seven times. You must continue to forgive them even if they do wrong to you seventy-seven times.

dag: Amaa Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, di zaa yoli, a nini na kul bi tiɣi li, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, a lan yɛli man a dabili ŋɔ n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha yɛla, ka wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: and yet you have promised to do even more. Is this the way you usually treat people?.

dag: Ka n daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka yi gbɛri gooni maa gbini? Yi yi lan pahi lala, n ni gbahi ya. Ka di saha maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa bi lan labina Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha.
en: But I warned them, Dont stay the night in front of the wall. If you do that again, I will arrest you. So from that time on they didnt come on the Sabbath day to sell their things.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Ishia pa.
en: Uzziels family: Micah the first and Isshiah the second.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ka naabu? Bee bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya ka yi na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will windy talk ever cease; what bothers you that you must argue?.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a daba niŋgbuna ti juri bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ bɛn ʒe a yim niŋgbuna ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be tiŋgban ni.
en: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Reechɛl zuɣu pam, ka bɔh o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ŋar a dɔɣim soli.
en: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, I can't take the place of God. He is the one who keeps you from having children.

dag: Hal yi ni ninvuɣ zuɣu ŋun nyɛ bilichina ni ti mɔŋ o mabia bindirigu, o ni ti mɔŋ o paɣiyurigu hal zaŋ tabili o bi shɛb bɛn kpalim puuni ŋun nyɛ bia.
en: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.

dag: bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya ba ni ti bɔhira, Bɛ lee be ya ni.
en: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.

dag: Tuun kpɛma tumbu tiri nir yiko, amaa vinnyaɣili chɛ ka nir leerila dabili.
en: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zaŋmiya yi yɛtɔɣa na, ka zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi yɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo na.
en: I am the Lord , the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba; ka ti gbahi bɛn kpalim ti leei daba zuliya kam ni; ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ti deei Jɛrusalɛm n-yɔɣiri gindi hal ti paai Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ su li yuma shɛm tariga.
en: Some of them will be killed by swords. Others will be carried off to foreign countries. Jerusalem will be overrun by foreign nations until their time comes to an end.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Yawɛ lan yɛli ma, Cham Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti yihi n ni daa yɛl a ni a zaŋ jinjɛŋŋma shɛli ti sɔɣi nimaani la na.
en: Some time later the Lord told me to go back to the Euphrates and get the shorts.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu Dɛɛbi ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda, ka bɛ daa yi ni n-lab Listra mini Aikɔnium ni Antiɔk.
en: They also told the Good News in the city of Derbe, and many people became followers of Jesus. Then Paul and Barnabas returned to the cities of Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni Sinai Zoli gbin la, yi daa bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: When the Lord spoke to you from the fire on Mount Sinai, you did not see any form. For your own good, then, make certain.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ma pul ni na? M paɣiya ka n daa kpi ka so nini na bi nya ma.
en: Why did you let me emerge from the womb? I wish I had died without any eye seeing me.

dag: O ni daa yaɣindi li maa ka shɛŋa lu sol zuɣu, ka noonsi kana nti gahim li di.
en: While the farmer was scattering the seed, some of it fell along the road and was eaten by birds.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi bɔh o.
en: Job, will you be annoyed if I speak? I can't keep quiet any longer.

dag: ka bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka yi lee sɔɣ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kamina ti nya ti ni sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: He asked, Where have you laid him? They replied, Lord, come and see.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋna nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani.
en: Elijah is indeed coming first, answered Jesus, and he will get everything ready.

dag: nti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, ka nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni lee nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ bee bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima ka nya bɛ nyɛla bɛn galisi bee bɛn pɔra.
en: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are.

dag: Ti yaannim daa jɛmdila Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka yinim Yɛhudianim ti yɛri ni Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu shee.
en: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain. But you Jews say that Jerusalem is the place where people must worship.

dag: Hal yi ni ninvuɣ zuɣu ŋun nyɛ bilichina ni ti mɔŋ o mabia bindirigu, o ni ti mɔŋ o paɣiyurigu hal zaŋ tabili o bi shɛb bɛn kpalim puuni ŋun nyɛ bia.
en: Even the most gentle and refined man among you will scowl at his brother or his own dear wife, or the last of his surviving children.

dag: Ka o daa be bɛ sani hal ni yuma ayɔbu n-kul sɔɣila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka Atalia daa leei naa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: Joash was hidden with the priests in Gods Temple for six years. During that time Athaliah ruled over the land as queen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Pa doo ŋɔ ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi. Barabas ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi! Barabas daa nyɛla ŋmɛnditoli.
en: They shouted, No, not him! We want Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a terrorist.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ nachimba, ka kum ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.

dag: O tiri paɣiŋoo bihi, ka zaŋd o leeri bihi ma ŋun mali suhupiɛlli. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He honors the childless wife in her home; he makes her happy by giving her children. Praise the Lord !.

dag: ni Shammɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Harɔd nir la ni Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛlɔn nir la.
en: Shammoth the Harodite; Helez the Pelonite;.

dag: amaa Nɛria bia Baruk n-wuhir a yikombiɛlim zaŋ chaŋ ti polo ni yi zaŋ ti niŋ Babilɔnnim nuu ni, ka bɛ ku ti bee n-gbahi ti daba zaŋ ti kuli Babilɔn.
en: Baruch son of Neriah has stirred you up against us, so that the Babylonians will gain power over us and can either kill us or take us away to Babylonia.

dag: Yi ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, amaa yi ti ku su ba, dama bɛ ni ti gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ.
en: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.

dag: Shimɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amnɔn mini Rina ni Bɛnhanan ni Tilɔn. Ishi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔhɛt mini Bɛnzɔhɛt.
en: Shimon had four sons: Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi had two sons: Zoheth and Benzoheth.

dag: A yi yɛn goog o, di ŋmanila pɔhim ka a yɛn gooi bee kpa kom ka a yɛn zaŋ kpib a nudirigu ni.
en: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.

dag: M pun yɛl o ni n ni darig o yiŋnim tibili hal ni saha din ka bahigu, tuumbiɛ shɛli yɛla o ni pun mila zuɣu, dama o bihi mɔri man Naawuni ka o bi yihi ba di ni.
en: I have already told him that I am going to punish his family forever because his sons have spoken evil things against me. Eli knew they were doing this, but he did not stop them.

dag: Yi nini na kul bi neei? N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu n-dihi niriba tusaanu la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi li pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: Dont you understand yet? Dont you remember the five loaves that fed the five thousand and how many baskets of leftovers you gathered?.

dag: Sɔŋmiya Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be wahala ni, ka niŋmiya saani.
en: Share your belongings with your needy fellow Christians, and open your homes to strangers.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka bɛ be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim ŋɔ ni ka lur a sizuura hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: Do this so that they may revere you all the days they live on the land that you gave to our ancestors.

dag: ka yɛra, Aai, ti ni kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli ti ni ku lan nya tɔbu tuhibu bee n-wum kikahi kumsi bee ka kum ti lan gbahi ti, nimaani ka ti yɛn be.
en: We are going to Egypt, where there is plenty of food and no danger of war.

dag: ni Adina ŋun daa nyɛ Shiza ŋun nyɛ Rubin zuliya nir la bia ni ŋun lan nyɛ Rubin zuliya maa toondana ka su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi la.
en: Adina who was the son of Shiza from the tribe of Reuben and was the leader of the tribe and one of the Thirty Heroes;.

dag: Zahimmiya yimaŋa n-nya yi shiri doli yi yɛda niŋbu soli. Buɣisimiya yimaŋa! Yi bi mi ni Masia be yi ni? Di yi pa lala yi daa naɣ bi nyaŋla yimaŋ buɣisibu la.
en: Look closely at yourselves. Test yourselves to see if you are living in the faith. Dont you realize that Christ Jesus is in you? Of course, if you fail the test, he is not in you.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paag a n-kpims a zaa. N ni ku a daŋ ni doo kam ŋun nyɛ bilichina bee dabili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Now you will be punished. You and every man and boy in your family will die, whether slave or free.

dag: Ti wum ti dimnim yuri napɔnchichiba Dan tiŋgban ni. Ka bɛ wɔridibisi kumsi chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zaa sɔhigi. Bɛ kana ni bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka saɣim tiŋ maa n-tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni.
en: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.

dag: Yawɛ tiligi Yaakubu zuliya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o yiko. Alizanda, yilimi yila. Tiŋgbani, yɛrimi saɣi. Zoya mini nyɔŋ puuni tia kam, yɛrimiya saɣi.
en: Sing, heavens, for the LORD has acted; shout, depths of the earth! Burst out with a ringing cry, you mountains, forest, and every tree in it. The LORD has redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself through Israel.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ saawaralana n-nya o ka wum o yɛligu? Ŋuni n-lee wum o yɛligu ka nyɛ ŋun ni tooi mol li?.
en: But none of these prophets has stood in the heavenly council. None of them has seen or heard the message from the Lord . None of them has paid close attention to his message.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila kpambaliba kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ su niriba fukumsi.
en: And Solomon had two hundred fifty chief officers who were in charge of the people.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni fa n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni bahi, dama o ni deei ma.
en: But God will rescue me; he will save me from the power of death.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la, Yi gba ni chɛ ma dolibu.
en: So he asked the twelve disciples, And you—would you also like to leave.

dag: Yɛm viɛla, ka ŋmanila fali, ka niŋdi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni anfaani.
en: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance— an advantage for those who see the sun.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim, mali alibarika.
en: The one whose wrongdoing is forgiven, whose sin is covered over, is truly happy!.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soya nyɛla din viɛl zaa! Yawɛ daalikauli nyɛla zaɣ maŋli. O nyɛla bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: Your way is perfect, Lord , and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nya daliri jɛndi ma, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: But God found an excuse to attack me. He treats me like an enemy.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: After that, the Lord 's servant Joshua son of Nun died at the age of a hundred and ten.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: However, the shrines werent removed. People kept sacrificing and burning incense at them.

dag: Amaa Siria naa ŋɔ bihi ni ti laɣim tɔbbihi pam lo tɔbu. Bɛ ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam chaŋ kaman kokpɛɣu la n-tuhi tɔb maa hal ti paai bɛ dimnim sansan ni.
en: His sons will get ready for war, gathering massive forces. Their attack will be like an overwhelming flood. And they will attack again, taking the battle as far as his walled fortress.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ daa kul timd anabinim bɛ sani waawaayili, dama o niriba maa mini ŋun Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la yɛla daa mal o nambɔɣu.
en: But the Lord God felt sorry for his people, and instead of destroying the temple, he sent prophets who warned the people over and over about their sins.

dag: N ŋmanila dikili, ka m biha ŋmani gaɣibihi. N nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka o nyari suhudoo.
en: Im a city wall, and my breasts are the towers. So now Im in his eyes as one who brings peace.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul mihirila bɛ nina ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛ soya yɛla.
en: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka ka kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbibi n nuu ni du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So I made a Box of acacia wood and cut two stone tablets like the first ones and took them up the mountain.

dag: Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Naawuni, Ka ŋun daŋ niriba n-lee yɛn daŋ tooni chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim ŋɔ ti ti.
en: After Joshua's death the people of Israel asked the Lord , Which of our tribes should be the first to go and attack the Canaanites.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ni nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm, ka ninvuɣ suma nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: Rebellious hearts receive satisfaction from their ways; the good receive the due reward for their deeds.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya n ni lo nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo mini n ni yɛn niŋ Tɛmannim shɛm. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ niriba dabiɛm.
en: Listen to my plans for you, people of Edom. Your children will be dragged off and your country destroyed.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu ŋ-ŋman li mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: The second most important commandment is like this one. And it is, Love others as much as you love yourself.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti duhi do so ŋun yuli booni Haman n-zaŋ o leei zuɣulaampaa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: Some time later King Xerxes promoted a man named Haman to the position of prime minister. Haman was the son of Hammedatha, a descendant of Agag.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam.
en: I will keep my solemn promise to you and give you more descendants than can be counted.

dag: Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛnkam daa wum yɛligu maa zuɣu na.
en: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit came down on all those who were listening to his message.

dag: Ka o dɔbilim maa yi shihi situra kam mini biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ kam, bɛn paɣimi li, ka di ni nyɛ din be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anything made of cloth or leather on which the semen falls must be washed, and it remains unclean until evening.

dag: Ti mi ni ti pun yi kum ni n-kpe nyɛvil ni ti ni yuri ti mabihi la zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia bela kum ni.
en: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan bol a labisina kaman paɣ so bɛ ni zaɣisi ka o mali suhugarigu la. Naawuni yɛliya, A ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun kuli dooyili o paɣisarilim ni ka bɛ ti zaɣis o.
en: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, I am taking you back!.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa be bɛ sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , will be their God, and a king like my servant David will be their ruler. I have spoken.

dag: ka ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la mini bɛnkam pahi bɛ zuɣu binshɛlikam din daa niŋ maa zaa yɛla.
en: The women left the tomb and went to the eleven apostles and the other followers. They told them everything that happened at the tomb.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a be kaman daanya gooni la niriba maa sani. Bɛ ni tuh a, amaa bɛ ku tooi nyaŋ a; dama n ni be a sani n-tilig a ka fa a bahi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make you a sturdy bronze wall against these people. They will attack you, but they wont triumph, because I am with you to protect and rescue you, declares the LORD.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhiri n niriba maa binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: They must teach my people the difference between the holy and the ordinary, and show them the difference between clean and unclean.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr piɛlli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi tɔbu, ka bɛ ti o nam zuɣupiligu, ka o chani gindi n-tuhiri diri nasara.
en: I looked, and there was a white horse. Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown. He rode out as a conqueror to conquer.

dag: Bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa yinoyino baɣa kul bela bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka pa ni Yisa Masia yɛla ni.
en: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa pii Joɛl bia Hɛman min o mabia Asaf ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɛkia bia la ni Mɛrari bidibisi ni bɛ daŋ ni mabia Ɛtan, ka o nyɛ Kushaya bia la.
en: So the Levites appointed Heman, Joels son; and from his relatives, Asaph, Berechiahs son; and from their Merarite relatives, Ethan, Kushaiahs son.

dag: Ka Yisa daa do ŋariŋ maa nyol ni difiɛli zuɣu gbihira; ka bɛ neeg o m-bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ n-niŋ ka kom diri ti ka a baɣa kani.
en: But Jesus was in the rear of the boat, sleeping on a pillow. They woke him up and said, Teacher, dont you care that were drowning.

dag: So yi niŋ lala, o yi ti yi daɣiri maa ni, bɛn zalim o daba ayopɔin.
en: Once the priest is clean again, he must count off seven days.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaai Sintani ŋun yɔhindi ba maa n-zaŋ o bahi buɣim teeku din nyɛ chilibi buɣim ni, luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbigu la min o daanabi ʒirilan la ni pun be, ka bɛ ni nyari nahiŋgu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever.

dag: Yi niŋgbuna ni ti leei noombil kam mini dunia ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu, ka so ti ku beni ŋun ni kari ba.
en: Your dead bodies will be food for the wild birds and animals. There will be no one to scare them away from your dead bodies.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa daa nyɛla ti gula hal ka Masia ti kana ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: so that the Law became our custodian until Christ so that we might be made righteous by faith.

dag: So yi kpi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni, di mi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam be suɣili maa ni mini ŋunkam kpe di ni na ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: If someone dies in a tent while you are there, you will be unclean for seven days. And anyone who later enters the tent will also be unclean.

dag: A ŋariŋduhiriba n-zaŋ a chaŋ teeku bulli ni. Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒe n-saɣim a teeku bulli maa ni.
en: Your oarsmen brought you out onto the high seas; an east wind sank you into the seas depths.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Amaa dabisa din ti yɛn doli wahala ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla.
en: In those days, after the suffering of that time, the sun will become dark, and the moon wont give its light.

dag: Ŋuna n-filim kurimbuni ha wuna la, ka o nuhi din ka bahigu ŋɔ gbibi ya. O ni kari yi dimnim bɛn be yi tooni la bahi ka yɛli, Kumiya ba.
en: God has always been your defense; his eternal arms are your support. He drove out your enemies as you advanced, and told you to destroy them all.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa, Malimiya yimaŋ kasi gu biɛɣuni. Yi sa ni ŋubi nimdi, dama yi kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛra, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi. Ti ni daa be Ijipti la daa so. Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni tin ya nimdi ka yi ŋubi.
en: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nina ti ku ne, ka bɛ ti ku mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛŋa zo n-tiligi, ka bɛ tahima ti yɛn nyɛla bɛ vuhim ŋmaabu.
en: Evil people might look for help, but they will not escape their troubles. Their hope leads only to death.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o daa chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: God finished speaking to Abraham and then left.

dag: Ka Kɛnan maa daa nyɛ Ɛnɔs bia, ka Ɛnɔs nyɛ Sɛt bia, ka Sɛt mi nyɛ Adam bia, ka Adam mi nyɛ Naawuni bia.
en: Enosh, and Seth. The family of Jesus went all the way back to Adam and then to God.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti niŋdi ti putɔɣu, ka muɣisiri ti n-chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai bɛ ba Yaakubu sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ daa yɛl o la dinkam zaa niŋ ba, ka lan yɛl o.
en: When they returned to the land of Canaan, they told their father Jacob everything that had happened to them:.

dag: A yi ʒini tiŋa, a ku zɔri dabiɛm; ka a yi dɔni tiŋa, a ni gbihi go nyaɣisili.
en: If you lie down, you wont be terrified. When you lie down, your sleep will be pleasant.

dag: N zaligu maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yumiya taba kaman n ni yuri ya shɛm.
en: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.

dag: Bɛ na mi m-be kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri mɔ shɛŋa ka be kaman wurigu ka pɔhim ʒe n-chaŋ la?.
en: Let them be like straw in the wind, like dry grass stolen by a storm.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni tiligi shɛba. Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni ti bol a la, Tiŋ gahindili, ka lan bol a, Tin shɛli din be kasi, ka Naawuni bi zaɣis a.
en: His people will be called The Holy People, The Saved People of the Lord . And you, Jerusalem, will be called The City God Wants, The City God Is With.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ Naa Dauda kpana la min o nyɔtaɣiri kara ni zaɣibihi zaa din daa be Naawuni duu la ni n-ti sapashin kpamba bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga maa.
en: Jehoiada the priest gave the spears and the large and small shields that belonged to King David to the officers. The weapons were kept in Gods Temple.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛrɔta ni Sibiraim . N-zaŋ hal ni Hazɛrihatikɔn fɔntiŋ din be Hauran tintariga la.
en: to the cities of Berothah and Sibraim , and to the city of Ticon .

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchunima, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa bɛ bi gbuɣiri ŋubira, dinzuɣu bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani. Miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ nimdi, yi mi di ti shihi bɛ zaɣ kpima.
en: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!.

dag: Ka kum yi ti lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee alɔbo bee bimbilima dɔriti yi ti lu bee toli bee zunzuya yi ti saɣindi bindira, ka bɛ dimnim yi ti kana ti teei gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tin shɛli nima bee muɣisigu shɛlikam bee dɔro balibu kam yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu;.
en: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaa daa niŋ nia ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa. Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi polo Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: All the people began talking about killing Joshua and Caleb with stones. But the Glory of the Lord appeared over the Meeting Tent where all the people could see it.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli wuhibu daa be o nol ni, ka galimi yɛtɔɣa daa ka o nol ni. O daa kul doli ma mi ni nimmaŋtali mini biɛrisuntali, ka daa yihi niriba pam tuumbiɛri tumbu ni.
en: True Instruction was in his mouth; injustice wasnt found on his lips. He walked with me in peace and did the right thing; he made many turn from iniquity.

dag: Bɛ daa mali salima naɣibila n-zali Sinai Zoli gbini; ka daa jɛm salima binnani.
en: The people made a golden calf at Mount Horeb. They worshiped a statue!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ayuba.
en: Then the Lord said to Job.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, nyin ŋun su alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ, m paɣir a, dama a zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-sɔɣi yɛnnim mini baŋdiba, ka lee kahigi li wuhila biliɛri;.
en: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti mali jɛma shili, di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zani bɛ zaashɛhi, ka Lɛvinim mi daa piripiri taba zani kaman naa ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: When everything was ready for the Passover service to begin, the priests and Levites went to their places. This is what the king commanded.

dag: N kpahimya nya ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri yɛm pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhuyiɣisili. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɔri baŋsim pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhugarigu.
en: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ oniɣisi kuɣ ayi n-sabi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu.
en: Take two gemstones and engrave on them the names of Israels sons.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn kpi daa suhi alibarika niŋ n ni, ka n daa chɛ ka pakoya yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: People who were dying asked God to bless me. My help brought joy to widows in need.

dag: O ni wum ka n duhi n yee kuhi pam maa, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: When he heard me raise my voice and scream, he left his garment with me and ran outside.

dag: Ti mabihi, zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna mini ti ni ti yɛn laɣim tuh o sol la yɛla polo, ti suhiri ya.
en: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends.

dag: n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N Duuma Yawɛ, di ku a niriba bɛn nyɛ a dahalali ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa fa m-bahi a yiko ni, ka zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ yihi ba Ijipti maa na.
en: I prayed to the Lord . I said, Lord GOD, dont destroy your people. They belong to you. You freed them and brought them out of Egypt with your great power and strength.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la jɛmbu duu ni kpɛbu, ka jɛmdila buɣili Ashɛra binyɛra mini binnana. Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu bɛ taali tumbu maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa zaŋ sarikanim bɛn zaa be sarika maa ni niŋ Yisifu nuu ni, ka Yisifu daa nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa nimaani.
en: The jails commander put all of the prisoners in the jail under Josephs supervision, and he was the one who determined everything that happened there.

dag: N yi yɛli ni n ku lan bol a bee n-zaŋ a yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di saha a yɛligu maa ŋmanila buɣim be n kɔba ni dira, ka di gbibbu ti wum ma, ka n ku lan tooi gbib li.
en: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord , or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.

dag: Ka tulaale zim shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni kasia nyom be a situra ni; ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali a nam yil shɛl la ni biŋkumda chɛ ka a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: From your clothes comes the wonderful smell of myrrh, aloes, and cassia. In palaces decorated with ivory, you enjoy the music of stringed instruments.

dag: Ka Musa daa siɣina, ka boli Izraɛl kpamba na nti yɛli ba Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o yɛli ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: After Moses went back, he reported to the leaders what the Lord had said.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ni o pin o zuɣu min o teeŋkɔbiri ni o ninkari ni o niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o paɣ o situra ka su kom n-leei ŋun yi daɣiri ni.
en: On the seventh day, they must shave off all their hair. They must shave their head, their beard, and their eyebrows—yes, all their hair. Then they must wash their clothes and bathe their bodies in water. Then they will be clean.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti teei yi biɛhigu mini yi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-saɣim yimaŋ la yɛla, ka galim yimaŋa yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: There you will remember how your ways and all your wicked deeds defiled you, and you will loathe yourselves for all the wicked things that youve done.

dag: Dama bɛ zo n-kpɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka niŋ yomyom ni bɛ ku niriba.
en: They can't wait to do something bad. They're always ready to kill.

dag: Masia Shia ŋun daa be anabinim maa ni n-daa kahigiri wuhiri ba ka bɛ yɛri Masia ni ti yɛn di wahala shɛŋa mini jilima shɛli din ti yɛn dol di nyaaŋa yɛla; ka bɛ daa kpaŋ bɛmaŋ ni bɛ baŋ di saha mini di ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm yɛla.
en: They tried to find out when the time would be and how it would come. This was the time to which Christ's Spirit in them was pointing, in predicting the sufferings that Christ would have to endure and the glory that would follow.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa na kpalim be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka be luɣ shɛlikam, nimaani niriba bɛn sɔŋmi ba n-ti ba anzinfa mini salima ni nɛma m-pahi biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ suhuyubu pina, ka bɛ zaŋ ti tum Naawuni duu maa tuma Jɛrusalɛm.
en: And as for all those who remain in the various places where they are living, let the people of those places supply them with silver and gold, and with goods and livestock, together with spontaneous gifts for Gods house in Jerusalem.

dag: O teeg o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla Izraɛlnim sani. Dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa nim nya ti Naawuni nasara dibu maa.
en: He kept his promise to the people of Israel with loyalty and constant love for them. All people everywhere have seen the victory of our God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ Yisifu yiŋ tumtumda maa sani yili maa dunol ni.
en: So at the door of the house, they said to the servant in charge.

dag: Iso bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Iso paɣ Ada bidibiga la mini Riuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Iso paɣ Basɛmat bidibiga la.
en: These are the names of Edoms sons: Eliphaz son of Esaus wife Adah, and Reuel son of Esaus wife Basemath.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ninsal maa, Dim tihi din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: The LORD God commanded the human, Eat your fill from all of the gardens trees.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so yi kɔrigi nahu bee piɛɣu bee bua yi sansani ŋɔ ni bee kpaŋa.
en: Anyone from the house of Israel who slaughters an ox, sheep, or goat inside or outside the camp.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuui pam, di simdi ni bɛ mali suhupiɛlli di yuma zaa puuni, amaa di simdi ni bɛ teei ni zibisim saha dabisa ni ti galisi pam. Dinkam zaa niŋdi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: You should enjoy every day of your life, no matter how long you live. But remember that you will die, and you will be dead much longer than you were alive. And after you are dead, you cannot do anything.

dag: Bee miri ka a di ʒiri shɛhira jɛndi a kpee.
en: Do not tell lies about others.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛhab bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anu saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la daa di nam.
en: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat became king of Judah in Joram's fifth year as king of Israel, while Jehoshaphat was still king of Judah.

dag: Tuuli binnɛɔŋ daa ŋmanila gbuɣinli, ka ŋun pah ayi ŋmani naɣilaa, ka ŋun pah ata ninni mi ŋmani ninsal ninni, ka ŋun pah anahi mi ŋmani tɔrili ŋun yiɣira.
en: The first living being was like a lion. The second was like a bull. The third had a face like a man. The fourth was like a flying eagle.

dag: Ka ti mabiyurigu Onɛsimus ŋun ʒe yim ka nyɛ yi ni yino la ni pahi o zuɣu kana. Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya binshɛɣukam zaa din niŋdi kpe ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.

dag: Wuhibu maa bela lahibal sun shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalana mini alibarikalan ŋɔ ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni ni m mol li la puuni.
en: Sound teaching agrees with the glorious gospel of the blessed God that has been trusted to me.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul tɔŋdi pahiri Naa Darius nam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ tabili Naa Sairus ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia nir la gba nam ʒiɛman ni.
en: Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

dag: ka booi kom niŋ tahili ni n-gbaag o nyaandoliba maa naba paɣibu, ka mali bɔdu shɛli din mil o shee ni maa nyɛhiri bɛ naba maa.
en: Then he poured water into a washbasin and began to wash the disciples feet, drying them with the towel he was wearing.

dag: Wɛi, yɛl biɛɣu ni paai Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbini, ka nyɛ Dauda ni daa be tin shɛli ni la. Chɛ ka churi ŋɔ kul puhiri yuuni kam.
en: God says, Look at Ariel, the city where David camped. Keep on having your festivals, year after year.

dag: ni Mizipa ni Chɛfira ni Mɔza.
en: Mizpah, Chephirah, Mozah.

dag: Teemiya saha shɛli din gari la ha, yi ni daa bɔhim baŋ Naawuni yɛla la nyaaŋa, yi daa niŋ ania di wahala bina pam ni, amaa yi mɔbu puuni di daa bi nyaŋ ya.
en: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.

dag: A yɛm min a baŋsim maa ka a zaŋ bo buni ti amaŋa, ka laɣisi salima min anzinfa niŋ a daazichi duri ni.
en: By your wisdom and discernment, you made yourself rich, and you filled your storehouses with silver and gold.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa ti Izraɛlnim vuhim ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gili ba niŋ sunsuuni bi tooi niŋ ba shɛli ka di yuui pam la nyaaŋa, Jɔshua gba daa kurigiya pam di saha maa.
en: Much later the Lord gave Israel security from their enemies around them. By that time Joshua was very old.

dag: ka niŋmi paɣikura kaman a manim la; ka niŋmi paɣisara mi kaman a tizɔpaɣiba la biɛr kasi zaa puuni.
en: the older women as mothers, and the younger women as sisters, with all purity.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa tɔɣisi bɛ zuɣulaannim maa yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu maa hal ka yi ti me li naai.
en: We asked their leaders some questions about the work they are doing. We asked them, Who gave you permission to rebuild this temple and repair it like new.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni yeei n nam nɛma ŋɔ ka taɣi nɛma ye n-chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam nɛma. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa taɣi nɛma ye, ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Israels king said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself when we go into battle, but you should wear your royal attire. When the king of Israel had disguised himself, they entered the battle.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun kariti saria ni wuntia; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, dama n zaŋla di binshɛɣukam niŋ a nuu ni.
en: I prayed, Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.

dag: Babilɔn ni ti leela daboli doya, ka leei yɔbahi biɛhigu shee; di ni ti leela dabiɛm zɔbu mini ansarisi malibu tiŋa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Babylon will become a pile of ruined buildings, a place fit only for wild dogs. People will be shocked and shake their heads at what is left there. It will be a place where no one lives.

dag: dama yi ni kariti tab saria shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti kari yi gba saria, ka yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti buɣisi ti yi gba.
en: Youll receive the same judgment you give. Whatever you deal out will be dealt out to you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim lan ka yɛm yɔɣo? Yɛnnim la bi lan tiri niriba yɛm saɣisigu? Bɛ yɛm maa naami?.
en: Concerning Edom, the LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Is wisdom no longer in Teman? Has good sense vanished from the perceptive? Are they no longer wise?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni omaŋmaŋ n-yɛn nyɛ buɣim gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm n-gul li, ka be di ni ni o jilima zaa.
en: The Lord says, I will be a wall of fire around her, to protect her, and to bring glory to that city, I will live there. The Lord says.

dag: Dama so ku tooi lan zali tanza shɛli pahila din pun zali maa, dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia.
en: because Christ is the only foundation.

dag: Yɛlim naa min o ma, Ʒinimiya tariŋ ʒiishee, dama yi nam zuɣupila din viɛl la yi yi zuɣu ni lu tiŋa.
en: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi nyɛla bi biɛɣu, ka yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundina.
en: But suppose one of the servants thinks the master won't return until late.

dag: daa zaŋ bindɔhi mini taha ni yaɣiri duɣuri ni alikama ni chi ni zim ni kawaan chimda ni tuya balibu kam.
en: brought couches, basins, and pottery, along with wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils.

dag: Ka Sool daa nya Dauda ni diri nasara shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pam pahi.
en: Saul saw how successful David was and became even more afraid of him.

dag: chaŋ Ofiri nti zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanahi na nti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: They went to Ophir for four hundred twenty kikkars of gold, which they brought back to King Solomon.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli naa, Di yi niŋ nyin naa nyaɣisim, nyin tim ma gbana ka n ti ti gomnanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti ma soli ka n gari hal ti paai Juda.
en: Then I asked, Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?.

dag: N ni zaŋ a niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ wurim a ni ko pin shɛli la min a ni daa me binshɛŋa din dundu zali luɣ shɛŋa zaa la. Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra zaa, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa, ka chɛ a zal a zaɣim.
en: I will hand you over to them, and they will tear down your pavilion and destroy your platforms. They will strip you of your garments, take your beautiful jewels, and they will leave you completely naked.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai ba, yɛtɔɣa maa ka o daa shiri zaŋ yɛli ba.
en: When the servant caught up with them, he said exactly what Joseph had told him to say.

dag: Ka o ni daa tim shɛb maa chaŋ ti shiri nya o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: The two followers went into town. They found the donkey exactly like Jesus told them.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ, ka yi na kul zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka kul kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma.
en: If, despite all this, you still do not obey me and continue to oppose me.

dag: N ni yih a a tuma ni, ka yih a a zaashee maa. .
en: The Lord is going to take away your job!.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ bi zaŋ o ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee na, di di kul simdi ni yi ŋub li luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee kaman n ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: Since its blood was not brought into the sacred Tent, you should have eaten the sacrifice there, as I commanded.

dag: Bɛ daa lo nanim nuhi n-zaŋ ba yili zuɣusaa. Bɛ bi tiri kpamba jilima.
en: Our leaders have been taken and hanged; our elders are shown no respect.

dag: ka bindana maa yi beni, dindina samli yɔbu kani; ka di yi nyɛla o haayila biŋkɔbigu maa, dindina haayibu liɣiri maa ni zani biŋkɔbigu maa zaani.
en: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi mini di kpam din zaa be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: He must take the two kidneys and the fat covering them near the lower back muscle. He must also take the fat part of the liver. He must remove it with the kidneys.

dag: Ti ni daa lu soli chani Bashan saha shɛli ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa daa yina ti liri ti ni bɛ tuhi ti tɔbu Ɛdirɛi.
en: When we turned onto the road that leads to Bashan, King Og of Bashan led out his whole army to fight us at Edrei.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ kul wummi ka ninvuɣ shɛb yɛra, Ŋun daa niŋdi ti alaka la yipa yihirila o ni daa kpaŋd omaŋ ni o saɣim adiini so shɛl la waazu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: They knew only what others were saying: The man who used to persecute us is now preaching the faith that he once tried to destroy.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ li vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la naba zaashee.
en: Then the priest will take some of the goats blood on his finger and put it on the corners of the altar of burnt offering. He will pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli gbalikpimalan maa.
en: I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth. So Jesus said to the man.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yi o mabihi maa sani chaŋ Adulam nti be do so ŋun yuli daa booni Hira la sani.
en: At that time, Judah moved away from his brothers and settled near an Adullamite named Hirah.

dag: Ka Judanim maa ninvuɣ tusaata daa chaŋ Ɛtam tampiŋ lɔŋ maa ni ti bɔhi Samsin, A bi mi ni Filistianima n-su ti? Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti ŋɔ? Ka Samsin garigi yɛli ba, N niŋ ba la bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm labisi.
en: So these three thousand men of Judah went to the cave in the cliff at Etam and said to Samson, Don't you know that the Philistines are our rulers? What have you done to us? He answered, I did to them just what they did to me.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: This is a list of Calebs descendants: Hur was Calebs first son. He was born to Ephrathah. Hurs sons were Shobal, the founder of Kiriath Jearim.

dag: O ni daa deei litaafi maa naai, ka binnɛma anahi la mini kpamba pisinaanahi la gbani Piɛbil maa tooni. Bɛ zaa daa malila mɔɣilɔnim mini salima lahi, ka tulaale zim din nyɛ Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu pal lahi maa.
en: When he took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each held a harp and gold bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

dag: Ka n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ m muɣisigu maa puuni; n daa kuhimi boli n Naawuni ni o sɔŋ ma. Ka n kuhigu maa daa chaŋ ti lu o tibili ni; ka o daa wum n kuhigu maa o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: In my distress I cried out to the LORD; I called to my God for help. God heard my voice from his temple; I called to him for help, and my call reached his ears.

dag: Ka n daa galim zuɣulaannim la pam ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa bahi? Ka n daa laɣim ba na nti zaŋ ba zali bɛ zaashɛhi.
en: I reprimanded the officials for letting the Temple be neglected. And I brought the Levites and musicians back to the Temple and put them to work again.

dag: Kum mini kɔnyuri n-daa yɛn ku ba, hal ka bɛ daa ti yihi tahima.
en: They were hungry and thirsty and growing weak.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan liri vinvamli ni nim maa n-lan tuhi ba, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: so I encourage you to follow my example.

dag: O ni daa ka ti sanna maa o daa zaŋla Pool shɛlɔrigu lo omaŋmaŋ nuhi min o naba ka yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, Lala ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ti yɛn lo ninvuɣ so ŋun su shɛlɔrigu ŋɔ n-zaŋ o niŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He came to us, took Pauls belt, tied his own feet and hands, and said, This is what the Holy Spirit says: In Jerusalem the Jews will bind the man who owns this belt, and they will hand him over to the Gentiles.

dag: Bɛn lihi ʒiɛm bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba nyɛla alahichinima, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ nandana nirilim mali alibarika.
en: If you want to be happy, be kind to the poor; it is a sin to despise anyone.

dag: Dama n nyari bɛ ni kul niŋdi shɛlikam zaa; di shɛli bi sɔɣi n sani, ka bɛ daalahichi bi sɔɣi n sani.
en: I see everything they do. Nothing is hidden from me; their sins do not escape my sight.

dag: Amaa m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni doo kam zuɣulana nyɛla Masia; ka paɣ zuɣulana nyɛ o yidana; ka Masia mi zuɣulana nyɛ Naawuni.
en: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua la.
en: he told me that the Lord had said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I will smash the yoke that Nebuchadnezzar put on the necks of the nations to make them his slaves.

dag: Ka yi ni daa tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di yipa nyɛ vi yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, nyɔ bɔ ka yi daa lee nya di ni? Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahigu nyɛla kum.
en: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kulim ni suhudoo. Naaman ni daa chaŋ, o daa na bi paai shɛli.
en: Go on home, and don't worry about that, Elisha replied. Then Naaman left. After Naaman had gone only a short distance.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa na be n sani, ka m bihi na be n san la.
en: when the Almighty was with me, my children around me.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: But nobody knows when that day or hour will come, not the angels in heaven and not the Son. Only the Father knows.

dag: N ni vo zoomba doli bɛ ni na ʒi n-doli so shɛŋa, ka wuhi ba bɛ ni ʒi so shɛŋa. N ni chɛ ka zibisim din be bɛ tooni leei neesim, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli. Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ n ni yɛn niŋ shɛli, ka m mi ku bahi ba.
en: Then I will lead the blind along a path they never knew to places where they have never been before. I will change darkness into light for them. I will make the rough ground smooth. I will do these things for them; I will not abandon my people.

dag: Ulam bidibisi daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ peentɔriba ni yɛlimaŋli. O daa mali bidibisi mini yaansi pam. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: Ulams sons were strong soldiers who were very good with bows and arrows. They had many sons and grandsons. In all, there were sons and grandsons. All these men were descendants of Benjamin.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni maa, dama bɛ lihiri ka bi nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka bi baŋdi bɛ ni wumdi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: This is why I use these stories to teach the people: They see, but they dont really see. They hear, but they dont really hear or understand.

dag: Ka Omri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa wuhi kpiɔŋ shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Omri did and all his accomplishments are recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Dinzuɣu yi nyɛla bɛ shɛhiranim mini bɛ nyaanzaaniba, dama bɛna n-daa shiri ku ba, ka yi mi ti mɛri duri gindi bɛ gbala maa.
en: And now you show all people that you agree with what your ancestors did. They killed the prophets, and you build tombs for the prophets!.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o tee li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa m-be kaman o nu din la.
en: Then Jesus said to the man, Stretch out your hand. So he did and it was made healthy, just like the other one.

dag: Karimbaannim kul ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma, amaa n dolila a zaligunim ni n suhu zaa.
en: People full of pride made up lies about me. But I keep obeying your instructions with all my heart.

dag: Ka Sool ba Kish bunsi daa ti bɔrigi dahin shɛli ka o yɛl o bia Sool, Zaŋmi tumtumdiba ŋɔ ni yino pah amaŋ zuɣu ka yi chaŋ ti bo bunsi maa shee.
en: Kish owned some donkeys, but they had run off. So he told Saul, Take one of the servants and go look for the donkeys.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni Yisa nyɛla Naa Hɛrɔd sulinsi ni nira, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Hɛrɔd sani, dama Naa Hɛrɔd gba daa kala Jɛrusalɛm na di saha maa.
en: He learned that Jesus was under Herods authority. Herod was in Jerusalem at that time, so Pilate sent Jesus to him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya polo ka niriba maa lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ yila Babilɔn din nyɛ tin shɛli din be katiŋ la n-ka n sanna.
en: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked him, What did these men say? Where did they come from? Hezekiah said, These men came all the way from Babylon just to see me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nyaŋ tin shɛŋa din daa gili Gɛra maa nim zaa, dama Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm. Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ʒe fɔntinsi maa zaa nɛma chaŋ, dama nɛma daa be tinsi maa ni.
en: Then they were able to destroy the cities in the area around Gerar, because the people there were terrified of the Lord . The army plundered all those cities and captured large amounts of loot.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa pundi dari mini kur wɔɣila ni dasara ni daantalisi ni di binzahi ni di neen kparisi zaa zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: The people from the Merari family were given the job of caring for the frames of the Holy Tent. They cared for all the braces, posts, bases, and everything that was used with the frames of the Holy Tent.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, dindali maa yuŋ niriba ayi ni ti do bindo yini zuɣu, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: On that night two people will be sleeping in the same bed, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.

dag: Amaa yinim yiɣisimi lu n niriba zuɣu kaman yi dimnim la. Yi darigi fuɣi suhudoolan binyɛrigu, ka darigi fuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn garita ka bi lan tɛhiri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla binyɛra.
en: But you attack my people like enemies. You steal the clothes off the backs of people walking by. They think they are safe, but you are there to treat them like prisoners of war.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa viɛla, amaa di mi ku sɔŋ ya.
en: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.

dag: Yawɛ ni bi maani ninvuɣ shɛb taali laasabu mini yɔhiŋgu ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: You bless them by saying, You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro maa na zuɣu? Yi nini na kul bi neei bee yi na kul bi baŋ? Yi nyɛla suhutunanima?.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, Why are you talking about not having any bread? Don't you understand? Are your minds still closed?.

dag: Dama mani m-piig o ni o wuh o bihi min o yiŋnim zaa ka bɛ doli man Yawɛ soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma ni din tuhi; ka di zuɣu chɛ ka man Yawɛ zaŋ n ni lo Ibrahimma binshɛli alikauli la ti o.
en: I have chosen him to teach his family to obey me forever and to do what is right and fair. If they do, I will give Abraham many descendants, just as I promised.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ m piɛri ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti kari saria wuhi din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni, ka wuhi din be piɛlahi mini buhi sunsuuni.
en: The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel: I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi ya yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa, ka laɣim ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa na nti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya.
en: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.

dag: Yi zaŋla yi wuna ŋmahima n-zali baɣili yi duri puuni dunoya. Yi zaɣisi ma, ka mali yi gariti ka di yɛlim pam, ka ti yi mamanim liɣiri, ka pirigiri yi situra ka mali ba dooni nyari bɛ zaɣim.
en: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.

dag: Dama m mi yi tipawumli mini yi noli zaɣisibu yɛla. Yi yi pun nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ noli saha shɛli n ni na be n nyɛvili ni m-be yi sani ŋɔ, wula nti yɛn nyɛ li n kum nyaaŋa?.
en: I know you are very stubborn. I know you want to live your own way. Look, you refused to obey the Lord while I was with you. So I know you will refuse to obey him after I die.

dag: Yi yi mi ni o nyɛla wuntialana, yin baŋmiya ni ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ʒe yim hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihitanaanu la tariga mal alibarika!.
en: Happy is the one who waits and reaches one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

dag: Chɛ ka o doli wuntia soli kariti a niriba saria, ka doli zaligu kariti a tarimba saria.
en: Let him judge your people with righteousness and your poor ones with justice.

dag: Yinim Aduna zuliya, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Aarons family, trust in the Lord ! He is your strength and shield.

dag: hal niriba ata maa yi di beni, hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko n-naan tiligi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If these three men lived there, as surely as I live, proclaims the LORD God, they wouldnt be able to rescue even their sons or daughters. They alone would be rescued.

dag: Yɛlim Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Sulemaana bia ka nyɛ Juda naa la mini Juda zuliya niriba ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba zaa ni man Yawɛ yɛliya.
en: Talk to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to men of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: So mi ni yɛli, Bindirigu nyɛla puli dini, ka puli gba nyɛ bindirigu dini. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa Naawuni ni ti saɣim di zaa yim. Niŋgbuŋ bi bela kɔr biɛri tuma tumbu zuɣu; amaa di nyɛla ti Duuma dini, ka ti Duuma gba nyɛ niŋgbuŋ dini.
en: Someone else will say, Food is for the stomach, and the stomach is for food. Yes; but God will put an end to both. The body is not to be used for sexual immorality, but to serve the Lord; and the Lord provides for the body.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, bɛ ni shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim beni ni bemi kaman dachɔhira la yi nina ni, ka be kaman gɔhi n-kuhiri yi luɣa ni, ka ni muɣisi ya pam yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa.
en: But if you dont drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, then those you allow to remain will prick your eyes and be thorns in your side. They will harass you in the land in which you are living.

dag: amaa ka di chɛ ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ti kpe nti lihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi maa hal biɛla gba, di yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni kpi.
en: But they may not enter to look at the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa tim Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat sani ti yɛl o, Mɔab naa zaɣisi ma jɛmbu. A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuh o? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N ni chaŋ. A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: He sent this message to King Jehoshaphat of Judah, The king of Moab has rebelled. Will you go with me to attack him? Yes, I will, Jehoshaphat answered. I'm on your side, and my soldiers and horses are at your command.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli, A bihi yi ni doli n zaligunim kaman a ni dol li shɛm, a kul ku kɔŋ ŋun ni zan a zaani n sani ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: Now, Lord , God of Israel, keep the other promises you made to your servant David, my father. You said, David, if your sons carefully obey me as you did, you will always have someone from your family ruling the people of Israel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti dɔni o yaannim tooni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: Then David died and was buried in the City of David.

dag: N ni darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna, ka wuna maa nyɛ din galisi gari wuna din be Jɛrusalɛm mini Samaria la tibili.
en: I defeated those evil kingdoms and now I control them. The idols those people worship are better than the idols of Jerusalem and Samaria.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim din zaa kpalim min anabinim yɛligu zaa tamla zaligunima ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: All of the law and the writings of the prophets take their meaning from these two commands.

dag: Ka Baruk garigi yɛli ba, Ŋuna n-daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa, ka m mi zaŋ tadabo sab li niŋ gbaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Yes, Baruch answered. Jeremiah spoke, and I wrote down all the messages with ink on this scroll.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan sabilifaa n-she alichɛbba shɛli zuɣu o ni yɛn yɛri binyɛribila la para.
en: Make a blue robe for the ephod.

dag: ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri maa ku o, ŋun bɔh o biɛri maa ku mali ninvuɣ kubo taali.
en: and the close relative finds him outside the boundary of his refuge city and kills him, he will not be responsible for his blood.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ yɛm mini baŋsim azichi zaa ni sɔɣi so ni.
en: In him all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are kept safe.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda, o ni nya alaafee.
en: When Jesus heard this, he told Jairus, Don't worry! Have faith, and your daughter will get well.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu ni ka bol o, Bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisima.
en: But Jesus took her by the hand and called out, Get up, child.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi tum din ni tiɣila omaŋmaŋ nini, amaa di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, zilim biɛ shɛŋa zaa niriba ni daa yɛr a la ʒinila n zuɣu.
en: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, The people who insulted you also insulted me.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim niriba maa, N yi chɛ ka tɔbu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino leei bɛ gula.
en: Human one, speak to your people and say to them: Suppose I bring a sword against a country, and the people of the land take a certain person from their assembly and make him their lookout.

dag: Ka bɛ daa labi nti yɛli bɛ nyaandol tab la, amaa ka bɛ daa bi niŋ bɛ gba yɛda.
en: When they returned, they reported it to the others, but they didnt believe them.

dag: ka bɛ nyu li ka tam bɛ fara yɛla, ka ku lan teei bɛ suhugarigu yɛla.
en: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa yi ninvuɣ yino so o ni daa nam la ni na, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka zali ʒiɛmana balibu kɔŋkɔba mini tiŋgbana tarisi.
en: God began by making one man, and from him he made all the different people who live everywhere in the world. He decided exactly when and where they would live.

dag: N wumla galimi shɛli din tu ma, m milinsi puuni ka n nya garigibu.
en: What you have said is an insult, but I know how to reply to you.

dag: Ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni tiligi, amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli ni ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.

dag: ka Izraɛl daa yɛli, Di saɣiya! M bia Yisifu na shiri be o nyɛvil ni. N ni chaŋ ti nya o pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Then Israel said, This is too much! My son Joseph is still alive! Let me go and see him before I die.

dag: M min a ni chaŋ Ijipti, ka n ti lan zaŋ a labisi kpe na yaha; ka Yisifu maŋmaŋ nuu ni ti daag a nina pɔbi.
en: I will go to Egypt with you, and I will bring you out of Egypt again. You will die there, but Joseph will be with you. His own hands will close your eyes when you die.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yo Babilɔn mini di niriba zaa bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la samli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord says, You will see me repay Babylonia and its people for all the evil they did to Jerusalem.

dag: Maliya biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi mali yolisim, amaa lee di zaŋya yi yolisim maa tumdi tuumbiɛri; kul maliyala biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi nyɛla Naawuni daba.
en: Live as free people; do not, however, use your freedom to cover up any evil, but live as God's slaves.

dag: amaa di sabiya ni ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma sani, chinchini maa piligirimi.
en: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.

dag: So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi yi ni yɛn chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa nim zaa dabiɛm kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: Wherever you go in that land, the Lord your God will make the people fear you, as he has promised, and no one will be able to stop you.

dag: N kuhi niŋ a m-bɔri sɔŋsim ka a bi garigi ma, ka n ʒiɛya ka a baɣa ka n ni.
en: I call to you, O God, but you never answer; and when I pray, you pay no attention.

dag: Naa Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu du shɛli maa puuni wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin; ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili.
en: Inside it was feet long, feet wide, and feet high.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛri yɛlimaŋli dirila shɛhira maŋli, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralana ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: Those who state the truth speak justly, but a false witness deceives.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya suhudoo.
en: There is no safety for sinners, says the Lord .

dag: Ka Uziɛl bidibisi mi nyɛ Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan ni Sitiri.
en: Uzziels sons were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi daa daŋ tooni nti zaŋ jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni, amaa ka vuhim bee nyɛvili shɛhirili kani. Dinzuɣu ka o daa ŋmaligi labina ti tuhi Ilaisha soli n-yɛl o, Bia maa bi neei.
en: Gehazi went on ahead of them. He set the staff on the young boys face, but there was no sound or response. So he went back to meet Elisha and told him, The boy didnt wake up.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa kari doli Jɛrɔbɔam nti ŋme n-deeg o tinsi; Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛshana mini di tiŋkpansi ni Ɛfurɔn mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: Abijahs army chased Jeroboams army, and they captured the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron from Jeroboam. They captured the towns and the small villages near them.

dag: ka yi Sintani ŋun gbahi ba n-chɛ ka bɛ dol o nol la zana ni.
en: And then they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the Devil, who had caught them and made them obey his will.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o ku o nimaani sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa luɣili ni o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: The LORD became angry at Uzzah, and God struck him there because of his mistake, and he died there next to Gods chest.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti kpaŋ ka o zaŋ o tahi ti ti nabipuɣiŋga maa, ka o zaŋ o leeg o bia, ka bol o yuli Musa, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kom ni ka n yih o na.
en: The baby grew, and after some time, the woman gave the baby to the kings daughter. The kings daughter accepted the baby as her own son. She named him Moses because she had pulled him from the water.

dag: ka yɛl o tumo, Cham ti lihi teeku polo. Ka o daa chaŋ ti lihi ka yɛli, M bi nya shɛli. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labimi yaha n-niŋ lala hal ti paai siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: He said to his servant, Go and look toward the sea. The servant went and returned, saying, I didn't see a thing. Seven times in all Elijah told him to go and look.

dag: Di ku ba, a yi niŋ lala, n niriba maa ni ti tam, amaa nyin ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti nyɔtaɣirigu ŋɔ, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ wurim ba, ka bɛ lu.
en: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.

dag: A yi nya noombil tiɛɣu tia kam zuɣu bee tiŋa, ka o bihi bee o gala be di ni, ka o ŋuni noombihi maa zuɣu bee gala maa zuɣu, nyin di gbaai nooŋa maa min o bihi maa.
en: You might be walking along a path and find a birds nest in a tree or on the ground. If the mother bird is sitting with her baby birds or on the eggs, you must not take the mother bird with the babies.

dag: Puu atam kpuɣibu saha naaya, ka wuuni du, ka ti na bi tiligi.
en: The people cry out, The summer is gone, the harvest is over, but we have not been saved.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la n-chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: We have been made right with God because of our faith. So we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Pita ni daa baŋ lala maa, ka o chaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Maak la ma Mariama yiŋa. Niriba pam n-daa laɣim be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: When Peter realized this, he went to the home of Mary, the mother of John, who was also called Mark. Many people were gathered there and were praying.

dag: Ti jɛmbu duu maa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee din mali jilima, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa pun duhi shɛli piligu ni ha.
en: Our Temple is like a glorious throne, standing on a high mountain from the beginning.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni lahibal sun shɛli waazu n ni daa yihi la pala din yi daadam tɛha ni na.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that the gospel I preached isnt human in origin.

dag: Ka yi mi yi ti nya ka pɔhim ʒiɛri yiri nudirigu polo na, yi yɛrimi ni woligu ni niŋ, ka di ti shiri niŋ.
en: And when you feel the south wind blowing, you say that it is going to get hot—and it does.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ sɔɣisili shee tinsi la ti Aduna bidibisi. Dina n-daa nyɛ: Hiburɔn mini Libina zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana ni Jatir ni Ɛshitɛmɔa zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: To Aarons family they gave the refuge cities: Hebron, Libnah with its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasturelands.

dag: o chanimi nti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani; ka dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam n-gari di ni daa pun be shɛm; lala nti yɛn niŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ nim gba.
en: Then it goes out and brings along seven other spirits even worse than itself, and they come and live there. So when it is all over, that person is in worse shape than at the beginning. This is what will happen to the evil people of this day.

dag: Di ka buchi, di nyɛla yɔhiŋ tuma. Di tibidarigibo saha, di ni bahi yoli.
en: These idols are worth nothing. They are something to make fun of. In the time of judgment they will be destroyed.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti tam Taai yɛla yuun pisopɔin din nyɛ naa yuusim tariga la. Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti paai, Taai ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ pagɔr so yɛla yili yilli.
en: People will forget about Tyre for years—that is, about the length of a kings rule. After years, Tyre will be like the prostitute in this song:.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ niŋgbuna ni paɣibu kal la m-paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: Why is it that your disciples disobey the teaching handed down by our ancestors? They don't wash their hands in the proper way before they eat.

dag: A du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ gbiŋgbaŋ jaaŋgbe kabili din ni tooi kuhi nir ŋun zaŋ omaŋ dalim li nuu ŋɔ. Lala n-nyɛ Firawuna zaŋ chaŋ ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ dalim o polo.
en: It appears that you are trusting in a staff—Egypt—thats nothing but a broken reed! It will stab the hand of anyone who leans on it! Thats all that Pharaoh, Egypts king, is to anyone who trusts in him.

dag: Ka o daa lan yihi Ashɛra binnani din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la na nti zaŋ li yi Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ tariga n-chaŋ Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti nyo li buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmɛnŋme m-burisi li n-va li ti bahi tiŋ maa gbala ni.
en: He removed from the Temple the symbol of the goddess Asherah, took it out of the city to Kidron Valley, burned it, pounded its ashes to dust, and scattered it over the public burying ground.

dag: O daa zaŋla daanya mali sara maligu bimbini maa kurupooti n-zaŋ li zali di naŋgbaŋkuɣila lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai di pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: He made a grate for the altar of copper mesh underneath its bottom edge and extending halfway up to the middle of the altar.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, nyama, n niriba Izraɛlnim maa fabila maa paai ma, ka n nya Ijiptinim maa ni tiri ba wahala shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: My people have begged for my help, and I have seen how cruel the Egyptians are to them.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa yɛli niriba maa, Yi tum alahichi titali. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n ni chaŋ Yawɛ sani nti suh o, di pa shɛli o ni chɛ yi daalahichi maa.
en: The next day Moses said to the people, You have committed a terrible sin. But now I will again go up the mountain to the Lord ; perhaps I can obtain forgiveness for your sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi nyɛla bɛ shɛhiranim mini bɛ nyaanzaaniba, dama bɛna n-daa shiri ku ba, ka yi mi ti mɛri duri gindi bɛ gbala maa.
en: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din be Nail Mɔɣili maa duli ni ti kuui, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛlikam dolisi mɔɣili maa ti kuui zaa, ka pɔhim ʒe li chaŋ.
en: and all the crops planted along the banks of the Nile will dry up and be blown away.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha, ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim.
en: Why am I so sad? Why am I so troubled? I will put my hope in God, and once again I will praise him, my savior and my God.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, di chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛli yi ni nyaŋ alizin biɛri maa zuɣu; amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛlila yi yuya ni sab alizanda ni la zuɣu.
en: Yes, even the spirits obey you. And you can be happy, not because you have this power, but because your names are written in heaven.

dag: Ka Ɛlizabɛt dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka o dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a boy.

dag: Ka o daa be bɛ sani hal ni yuma ayɔbu n-kul sɔɣila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka Atalia daa leei naa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: For six years he remained there in hiding, while Athaliah ruled as queen.

dag: dama ti yɛn saɣimla yaŋɔ. Bɛ ni yɛri di niriba tuumbiɛri yɛla shɛm galisiya pam Yawɛ sani; dinzuɣu ka o tim ti na ni ti ti saɣim li.
en: We are going to destroy this city. The Lord heard how evil this city is, so he sent us to destroy it.

dag: Soli din kuni neesim biɛhigu shee lee be ya, bee zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli lee be ya.
en: Where does light come from? Where does darkness come from?.

dag: N ni daa nya binneen shɛba ka bɛ be Izraɛl Naawuni naba tiŋli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la m-bala. Ka n daa baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla chɛrubinima.
en: These were the same living creatures that I saw underneath Israels God at the Chebar River, and I realized that they were winged creatures.

dag: Ka buɣim daa doli tiŋgbani dambu maa nyaaŋa na, amaa ka Yawɛ daa ka buɣim maa gba ni. Ka kukol balli zaɣ bilifu daa ti doli buɣim maa dibu nyaaŋa na.
en: After the earthquake, there was a fire. But that fire was not the Lord . After the fire, there was a quiet, gentle voice.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, m ba Sool nuu ku shih a. Nyini nti yɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka m mi nyɛ wulana. M ba Sool gba mi lala.
en: Don't be afraid, Jonathan said. My father Saul will never get his hands on you. In fact, you're going to be the next king of Israel, and I'll be your highest official. Even my father knows it's true.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni; yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Stay awake and pray that you won't be tested. You want to do what is right, but you are weak.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka anabinim shɛb daa ti yɛli Ilaisha, Nyama, luɣ shɛli ti ni be ka a wuhiri ti ŋɔ pɔri pam.
en: The members of the group of prophets said to Elisha, Look, the place where we now live under your authority is too small for us.

dag: To, lala zuɣu m bi zɔrila yiriŋ; m mi bi be kaman chɔriŋmɛra ŋun ŋmɛri pɔhim.
en: So now this is how I run—not without a clear goal in sight. I fight like a boxer in the ring, not like someone who is shadowboxing.

dag: anabi Jɛrimia sani ti yɛl o, Niŋmi ania wummi ti fabila ŋɔ ka suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti. Suhim o ti tinim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa, dama ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ gbaliŋ, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, kulla ti niriba biɛla ŋɔ n-kpalim kaman a nini ni nya ti shɛm ŋɔ.
en: and said, Please, Jeremiah, pray to the Lord your God for us. Judah used to have many people, but as you can see, only a few of us are left.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti bo ʒiɛvari na nti nya mɔɣu ni yɔɣili m-pɔhi li buɣi na nti ŋmahiŋmahi li niŋ ʒɛduɣu maa ni, ka bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: One of them went out into the woods to gather some herbs. He found a wild vine and picked as much of its fruit as he could carry, but he didn't know that the fruit was very sour. When he got back, he cut up the fruit and put it in the stew.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa piligi galindi tin shɛŋa nim bɛn daa nya o daalahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa o ni daa tum bɛ tinsi ni ka bɛ bi niŋ tuuba la.
en: The people in the towns where Jesus had performed most of his miracles did not turn from their sins, so he reproached those towns.

dag: Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Naawuni, Ka ŋun daŋ niriba n-lee yɛn daŋ tooni chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim ŋɔ ti ti.
en: After Joshua died, the Israelites prayed to the Lord , Which of our tribes should be the first to go and fight for us against the Canaanites.

dag: Bɛ pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒii buyopɔin. Juda zuliya niriba la kul ni be o tiŋgbani din be nudirigu polo la ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba mi kul be o tiŋgbani din be nuzaa polo la ni.
en: They will divide up the land among themselves into seven portions. Judah will stay on its territory to the south. The house of Joseph will stay on their territory to the north.

dag: Wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka bi wandi wala, o ŋmari li mi bahi, amaa wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka wandi wala, o wahirila di wulli maa nyoya ni bahiri ni di maan wali pam pahi.
en: He breaks off every branch in me that does not bear fruit, and he prunes every branch that does bear fruit, so that it will be clean and bear more fruit.

dag: Bɛ noya ni alahichi mini bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛ ka bɛ karimbaani gbahi ba! Bɛ ninvuɣ tubo mini bɛ ʒiŋmabo zuɣu.
en: Sin is on their lips; all their words are sinful; may they be caught in their pride! Because they curse and lie.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa zaŋ o gɔbiga tim o nudirigu gbalipini maa polo darigi ŋoog o sua maa n-zaŋ kuhi naa maa puli;.
en: As the king was getting up from his throne, Ehud reached with his left hand and took out the sword that was tied to his right thigh. Then he pushed the sword into the kings belly.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisa; di kul chanimi ti dooni niŋgbina ni.
en: People love to hear gossip. It is like tasty food on its way to the stomach.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpe Dauda suhu ni pam, ka dabiɛm gbaag o zaŋ chaŋ Gaat Naa Akishi maa polo.
en: Their words made a deep impression on David, and he became very much afraid of King Achish.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, N dana, a tiligi ti nyɛviya; ka di yi niŋ a nyaɣisim, ti ni leei Firawuna daba.
en: The people said, Youve saved our lives. If you wish, we will be Pharaohs slaves.

dag: Wuhibunim ŋɔ yirila ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn nyɛ ʒirinima, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha diɣilim kaman kur tulli n-tabili li n-di li la sanna.
en: They will be controlled by the pretense of lying, and their own consciences will be seared.

dag: Ka nabipuɣiŋga maa be o duu n-zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ salima gali wuɣi situr shɛli binyɛrigu di nachiinsi.
en: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.

dag: ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ŋmani la ti tam o zuɣu. Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: and the Holy Spirit came down on him in bodily form like a dove. And there was a voice from heaven: You are my Son, whom I dearly love; in you I find happiness.

dag: Dama o nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bɛn kuhi bol o bahira; ka fari nandaamba mini bɛn ka bɛn sɔŋdi ba bahira.
en: Let it be so, because he delivers the needy who cry out, the poor, and those who have no helper.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ mali suhupiɛlli; dama nyini ka n kul suhira.
