en: Make your servants life happy again because, my Lord, I offer my life to you.

dag: Naawuni pun tin ya dahima ni yi doli Masia, ka di pala ni yi niŋ o yɛda kɔŋko, amaa ni yi di wahala gba o zuɣu.
en: God has blessed you in ways that serve Christ. He allowed you to believe in Christ. But that is not all. He has also given you the honor of suffering for Christ. Both of these bring glory to Christ.

dag: Nintam kul yɛn zɔrila n ninni ka ku ŋmaai, di mi ku chɛ zɔbu.
en: My eyes flow and dont stop. There is no relief.

dag: a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni leei zana bar a, ka a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni gbaag a.
en: If you do, your words will trap you.

dag: Dauda ni daa yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Sool bɔhi, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Sool daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: When David finished speaking, Saul asked, Is that your voice, David my son? Then Saul lifted his voice and began to cry.

dag: N nuu ka n daa zaŋ nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ n nudirigu teei sagbana pa zuɣusaa. N yi yɛli ni di niŋ shɛli, di tiɣisirimi zani niŋ li.
en: My hand founded the earth; my strong hand spread out the heavens. When I call to them, they all stand up.

dag: Izraɛlnim nyɛla daba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛb niŋ dabitim ni? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka niriba fari ba?.
en: Israel is not a slave, is he? He was not born a slave, was he? Then why did the enemy carry him away as a captive?.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa guui ti tuh o soli yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ka n nyu.
en: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, Please let me have a drink of water.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti kpe ŋariŋ ni ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du teeku ŋɔ duli ha. Ka bɛ dii gbaai chandi.
en: One day Jesus got into a boat with his disciples and said to them, Let us go across to the other side of the lake. So they started out.

dag: Zaŋm Aduna min o bia Ɛliɛza du Hɔr Zoli zuɣu na;.
en: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar up Mount Hor.

dag: man Yawɛ ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a biŋkɔbiri bɛn be mɔɣu ni min a yuri ni a bunsi ni laakuma ni a niɣi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu zaa zuɣu.
en: the LORD will send a very deadly disease on your livestock in the field: on horses, donkeys, camels, cattle, and flocks.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yili yidana yi di mi tayiɣ ni yɛn ka o yiŋ na yuŋ saha shɛli, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o, ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: Homeowners never know when a thief is coming, and they are always on guard to keep one from breaking in.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ man Yawɛ ninni? Nyini n-ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka Ammɔnnim zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka a kpuɣ o paɣa n-leeg a paɣa.
en: Why, then, have you disobeyed my commands? Why did you do this evil thing? You had Uriah killed in battle; you let the Ammonites kill him, and then you took his wife!.

dag: Tiliginsim mi lan ka so sani yaha, dama Naawuni bi lan zaŋ so yuli ti ti dunia ŋɔ ni ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Salvation can be found in no one else. Throughout the whole world, no other name has been given among humans through which we must be saved.

dag: Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni yɛra, N Duuma, Naawuni tiligim ti! Di ku niŋ a lala.
en: Then Peter took hold of Jesus and, scolding him, began to correct him: God forbid, Lord! This wont happen to you.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa bɔhi Naa Zɛdɛkia, Taali bɔ ka n lee tum a bee a kpambaliba bee niriba ŋɔ ka yi chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ma duu maa?.
en: Then Jeremiah asked King Zedekiah, What have I done wrong to you or your attendants or this people that you should throw me into prison?.

dag: Awa yini puuni ka di bun la zaa zani bahi yoli! Ka ŋariŋduhiriba zuɣulaannim mini ŋariŋkpɛriba ni ŋariŋduhiriba ni bɛn zaa wolima yiri teeku ni na kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: And in one hour she has lost all this wealth! All the ships' captains and passengers, the sailors and all others who earn their living on the sea, stood a long way off.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa yɛl o paɣiba, Ada mini Zilla, wummiya: Yinim Lamɛk paɣiba, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ: N kula do so ŋun ti ma daŋa. N kula nachimbil so ŋun ŋme ma.
en: Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, hear my voice! You wives of Lamech, listen to me. A man hurt me, so I killed him. I even killed a child for hitting me.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi tooi pii din tuhi gari shɛlikam, ka chɛ ka yi yi daɣiri tuma zaa mini galimi ni Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day.

dag: Ti yi bi ʒe yim, ŋun kul ni ʒe yim, dama o ku tooi yi omaŋ nyaaŋa.
en: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful, because he cannot be false to himself.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Gɛshur nti zaŋ Absalom kuli Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Joab went to Geshur to get Absalom. But when they came back to Jerusalem.

dag: ka a ti yeei Aduna kpariti n-zaŋ li yɛl o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna kpi nimaani n-chaŋ o yaannim sani.
en: Take Aarons special clothes from him and put these clothes on his son Eleazar. Aaron will die there on the mountain. And he will go to be with his ancestors.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ti bahi sahakam lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli niŋ tinim bɛn nyɛ a piɛ shɛb a ni dihiri ŋɔ?.
en: God, why have you turned away from us for so long? Why are you still angry with us, your own flock?.

dag: Dama o ni ti ti sokam o tuma ni simdi shɛli:.
en: God will reward each of us for what we have done.

dag: Dinzuɣu Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, bɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lee bɔri yi sani? Lumiyala ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka dol o soya zaa ka yur o ka jɛmdi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Now, people of Israel, listen to what the Lord your God demands of you: Worship the Lord and do all that he commands. Love him, serve him with all your heart.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Jesus spoke to the group that came to arrest him. They were the leading priests, the older Jewish leaders, and the Jewish soldiers. He said to them, Why did you come out here with swords and clubs? Do you think I am a criminal?.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: Aaron and his sons are to use the water to wash their hands and feet.

dag: Di saha bɛ yi ti wum kikaa maa kumsi ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka, ka tɔbu maa kana ti di ba, bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If people hear the warning but ignore it, the enemy will capture them and take them away as prisoners. They will be responsible for their own death.

dag: Shihir shɛŋa Naawuni ni wuhiri ti mal alahiziba! Alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa o ni tumdi mali yiko pam. Naawuni nam nyɛla nam din ka bahigu, ka o kul ni nyɛ Naa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: His signs are superb! His miracles so powerful! His kingdom is everlasting. His rule is for all time.

dag: Ka Abishai daa yɛli Dauda, Naawuni zaŋ a dim maa niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ; dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n kul zaŋ kpani ŋɔ kuh o yim tabili tiŋa, m bi yɛn kuh o buyi.
en: Abishai said to David, God has put your enemy in your power tonight. Now let me plunge his own spear through him and pin him to the ground with just one blow—I won't have to strike twice.

dag: Di ni ti leei dabari m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din pun leei dabari sunsuuni, ka di fɔntinsi ni ti pahi fɔntin shɛŋa din pun lu n-dahim ni.
en: The land will be the most desolate in the world, and its cities will be left totally in ruins.

dag: Ka fiig tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wal viɛla din nyaɣisi la wolibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the fig tree answered, Should I stop making my good, sweet fruit just to go and sway over the other trees.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: I want you to find out how many Israelites are in each family. Then make a list of every man years and older who is able to serve in Israel's army.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛli Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Nyama, a mini Abiata zaŋmiya yi bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ a bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan n-labi tiŋ maa puuni ni suhudoo.
en: Zadok, you are a good judge of things, so return to the city and don't cause any trouble. Take your son Ahimaaz with you. Abiathar and his son Jonathan will also go back.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the God of all gods— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Hal n yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli, dama m mi n ni yi shɛl na, ka lan mi n ni chani shɛli, amaa yinim ʒi n ni yi shɛl na bee n ni chani shɛli.
en: Jesus answered, Yes, I am saying these things about myself. But people can believe what I say, because I know where I came from. And I know where I am going. But you dont know where I came from or where I am going.

dag: O ba min o ma ni daa ti nya o, di daa gari ba pam, ka o ma bɔh o, M bia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? A bi nya m min a ba ni lihiri bɔr a shee ni suhusaɣiŋgu shɛm.
en: When his parents saw him, they were shocked. His mother said, Child, why have you treated us like this? Listen! Your father and I have been worried. Weve been looking for you.

dag: Ka yi ni su tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zalimiya nir ni yɛn kɔh o tiŋgbani ka ti lan yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛli.
en: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.

dag: Amaa n ku vuui n yurilim maŋli la ka chɛ o bee n-yi n ʒiɛyimtali nyaaŋa.
en: But I will not stop loving David or fail to keep my promise to him.

dag: n-kari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya, ka zaŋ ya na ti zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya, ka yi su li kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: As you advanced, he drove out nations greater and more powerful than you, so that he might bring you in and give you their land, the land which still belongs to you.

dag: Ka Jɔn nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Jɔn ti sɔɣi, ka chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: John's disciples came, carried away his body, and buried it; then they went and told Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di ka nyu. Ka paɣ maa ba maa daa yɛli doo maa, Niŋm ania kpalim gbe m-pahi, ka chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: So the two men sat down and ate and drank together. Then the woman's father told him, Please spend the night and enjoy yourself.

dag: Dama nyamiya, ŋuna n-nam zoya, ka nam pɔhim. O kahigi din be o suhu ni n-wuhi ninsala. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka yuŋ zibira. O nyɛla ŋun chani gindi dunia ŋɔ ni. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ, Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa!.
en: God is the one who made the mountains and created the winds. He makes his thoughts known to people; he changes day into night. He walks on the heights of the earth. This is his name: the Lord God Almighty!.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu nyaaŋa nyɛla vi dibu, amaa bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm.
en: When pride comes, so does shame, but wisdom brings humility.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be kasi. Mani n-nam yinim Izraɛlnima, ka nyɛ yi naa.
en: I am the LORD, your holy one, Israels creator, your king!.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Magdol mini Tapanhɛs ni Mɛmfisi zaŋ tabili Patrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord told me to speak with the Jews who were living in the towns of Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis in northern Egypt, and also to those living in southern Egypt. He told me to tell them:.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Yisahaku, ka sheei laakum zuɣu zani.
en: Rebekah stared at Isaac. She got down from the camel.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni yiɣisi n suhu darigi bɛ tibili, n ku chɛ ba bee n-zo ba nambɔɣu, hal bɛ yi kuhiri pampam niŋdi ma ni n wum, n ku wum.
en: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka yi nyamma tɔŋ pam. Zuliya shɛb azichi ni zo na kaman mɔɣili kom la nti kpɛn ya; ka yi be kaman bi so ŋun ma kpuɣ o ʒili o naba zuɣu, n gbib o ni yurilim m-mɔɣisir o bihim la.
en: The Lord has promised: I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Naa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ niŋ sarika ni, ka tir o bɔrɔbɔro biɛlabiɛla mini kom hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them to throw him in prison and to put him on bread and water until I return safely.

dag: Bɛn ti be katiŋa, alɔbo ni di ba, bɛn be yoma, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, bɛn mi ti kpalim, kum ni ku ba. Lala ka n ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!.

dag: Lala zuɣu bɛn bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm la ni wuhi ni yinim bɛn guni ka mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din sabi doya ka yi bi dol li ŋɔ mali taali.
en: And so you Jews will be condemned by the Gentiles because you break the Law, even though you have it written down and are circumcised; but they obey the Law, even though they are not physically circumcised.

dag: N ni ti a niriba bɛn yɛn ŋma dakuɣiri maa alikama biɛlim din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi ni wain lita tuhi kɔbisinahi ni olivi kpam lita tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: I will pay your woodcutters , tons of wheat, the same amount of barley, , liters of wine, and that same amount of olive oil.

dag: ni Jɛhud ni Bɛnɛbɛrak ni Gatirimɔn.
en: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka n ti lan zaŋ n zaɣa labis o polo. Hal yi yi tuhi Babilɔnnim maa, yi ku di nasara. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.?.
en: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sab yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ niŋ Naawuni zaligu litaafi ni; ka bo kuɣ titali sɔŋ oki tia gbini nimaani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Joshua wrote these things in the Book of the Law of God . Then he found a large stone to be the proof of this agreement. He put the stone under the oak tree near the Lord s Holy Tent.

dag: Wuhim ma a nirilim shihirili, ka lala chɛ ka bɛnkam je ma la nya li ka di vi; dama nyini Yawɛ pun sɔŋ ma ka maai n suhu.
en: Lord , show me a sign that you care for me. My enemies will see it and be disappointed, because you helped and comforted me.

dag: ka o ti niŋ ni biɛɣ pihinahi; ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa daa bi di shɛli di dabisa maa ni, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: There he was tempted for forty days by the devil. He ate nothing during those days and afterward Jesus was starving.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ti baŋ lala ka yi Judia labiri Galili.
en: So when Jesus heard what was being said, he left Judea and went back to Galilee;.

dag: Jɔshua daa karim Musa ni daa zali zaligu shɛŋa maa zaa wuhi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu maa zaa zaŋ tabili paɣiba ni bihi ni tinzunnim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: All the Israelites were gathered together there. All the women and children and all the foreigners who lived with the Israelites were there. And Joshua read every command that Moses had given.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Naawuni. Ka Aduna mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka bɛ mini Musa deemba maa ti laɣim di bindirigu Naawuni tooni.
en: Then Jethro brought an offering to be burned whole and other sacrifices to be offered to God; and Aaron and all the leaders of Israel went with him to eat the sacred meal as an act of worship.

dag: Amaa o yi bi paɣ o situra bee n-su kom, o taali maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If they do not wash or bathe their body, they will be liable to punishment.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la kɔŋko zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus replied, Ive been sent only to the lost sheep, the people of Israel.

dag: N ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim o mamanim maa ninni, ka so ti ku tooi fa o n nuu ni bahi.
en: Now I will strip her. She will be naked, so all her lovers can see her. No one will be able to save her from my power.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kul be Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim maa ni.
en: So the Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu ŋmanila mɔri. Bɛ zoorimi kaman mɔɣu ni tipum la;.
en: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔnyuri ni ti wum gbarigi nachimbihi kpɛma mini paɣisaribihi kpɛma, ka bɛ tarigi.
en: On that day even healthy young men and women will collapse from thirst.

dag: Safaya kuɣa be tiŋgbani puuni, ka salima be di taŋkpazim ni.
en: that have jewels or gold.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti ba; ka o suhu daa paligi pam o min o yiŋnim zaa ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda maa zuɣu.
en: After this the jailer took Paul and Silas home and gave them some food. All the people were very happy because they now believed in God.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ n-su di fukumsi; ka su teeku puuni zahim mini noonsi ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: blessed them, and said, Have many children, so that your descendants will live all over the earth and bring it under their control. I am putting you in charge of the fish, the birds, and all the wild animals.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi Izraɛl kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb a ni mi ka bɛ nyɛ niriba maa kpamba ni zuɣulaannim bɛn su ba n-zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbinna, ka bɛ ti zani nimaani pah a zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Gather before me seventy men from Israels elders, whom you know as elders and officers of the people. Take them to the meeting tent, and let them stand there with you.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima min anzinfa neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn na la n-labisi li ti zali di zaashe kura ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In addition, the gold and silver equipment from Gods house, which Nebuchadnezzar took out of the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, is to be restored, that is, brought back to Jerusalem and put in their proper place in Gods house.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be tiŋ maa ni mini bɛn daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza la ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn zaa pahi kuli.
en: Nebuzaradan captured all the people who were still left in the city. He took all the people as prisoners, even those who had tried to surrender.

dag: Daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa pa shɛli o sani; ŋuna n-su malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi. Ka so ku tooi goog o ka o chɛ o ni bɔri shɛli niŋbu bee m-bɔh o, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala?.
en: To him the nations are far less than nothing; God controls the stars in the sky and everyone on this earth. When God does something, we cannot change it or even ask why.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋdi yi ni tuui ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini tiri Yawɛ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: You and all your descendants must give part of the first dough you make from that flour as a gift to the Lord .

dag: N ni ti lan zaŋ nyin Izraɛl leei m paɣa sahakam ni wuntizɔbo mini yɛlimaŋli ni yurilim pam ni nambɔzɔbo.
en: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni gba ku chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: But if you dont forgive others, then your Father in heaven will not forgive the wrongs you do.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai bia maa nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili, ka o yiɣisi zani.
en: But Jesus took the boy by the hand and helped him rise, and he stood up.

dag: Naawuni n-daa mali bimparilana maa, ka sabbu maa nyɛ Naawuni sabbu, ka o daa chirigi li pa bimparilana maa zuɣu.
en: The tablets were Gods own work. What was written there was Gods own writing inscribed on the tablets.

dag: Naawuni, wuhimi n ni ka taali shɛm, ka zabi n zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri sani, ka fa ma ʒiŋmariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu soli nuu ni bahi.
en: O God, declare me innocent, and defend my cause against the ungodly; deliver me from lying and evil people!.

dag: Hal nandaamba ʒiʒiinitab je ba, amaa bundaannim bɛn mali zɔnim pam.
en: No one likes the poor, not even their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.

dag: A daa wuhi ba a Vuhim Dabisili din be kasi yɛla, ka daa zaŋ a zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-ti a dabili Musa ka o ti ba.
en: You made known to them your holy Sabbath, and gave them commandments, statutes, and Instruction through your servant Moses.

dag: Nyama, karimbaannima! Bɛ suhuri ni tɛha bi tuhi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni bela bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Some peoples desires are truly audacious; they dont do the right thing. But the righteous person will live honestly.

dag: Saha shɛli di ni daa wum ya ka gbarigi ya, ka bɛ liri ya n-ku yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nyaaŋa la. Bɛ daa bi zo Naawuni.
en: how he met up with you on the way, striking from behind those who were lagging back because you were weak and tired, and because he didnt fear God.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka a zilinli tabili a noli puuni, ka a leei birigu, ka ku lan kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth—you will not be able to talk. So they will not have anyone to teach them that they are doing wrong, because they are always turning against me.

dag: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, dama Lɛvinim maa ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: Be joyful there in his presence, together with your children, your servants, and the Levites who live in your towns; remember that the Levites will have no land of their own.

dag: O zuɣu nyɛla salima alali. O zabikpila kul gahirimi, ka sabigi kaman kahiŋkɔɣu la.
en: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy, black as a raven.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋsim yiri Yaakubu Naawuni sanna mal alibarika. Bɛ tahima bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Happy are those who have the God of Jacob to help them and who depend on the Lord their God.

dag: Ka niriba nya teeku puuni kɔsoya, ka dunia ni tam tanza shɛŋa zuɣu yi zahira Yawɛ tahigu mini pɔhim shɛli din yiri o nyɛvoya ni na vuri zuɣu.
en: The floor of the ocean was laid bare, and the foundations of the earth were uncovered when the Lord rebuked his enemies and roared at them in anger.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ ni yino, ka nyɛ ŋun daa pun chaŋ Yisa san la bɔhi ba.
en: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman giŋgalanyɔri ni yi chaŋ gari ka bɛ jolijoli doya shɛm la; ka chɛ ka bɛ be kaman bɛ ni zaŋ bi so bahi ka o nini bi nya wuntaŋ la.
en: Like the snail that dissolves into slime, like a womans stillborn child, let them never see the sun.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa zaa kalinli nyɛla tinsi pihinuayika ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: All the cities that you give to the Levites will total forty-eight, along with their pastures.

dag: O daa kul bela gbala maa shee, ka so daa naan ku tooi zaŋ hal bandi m-ba o ʒili luɣ yini gba.
en: and lived among the tombs. Nobody could keep him tied with chains any more;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zani bɛ zaashɛhi n-zaŋ awa muna ata karim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ litaafi dabisili maa puuni, ka zaŋ awa muna ata kahigi bɛ daalahichi wuhi, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: They stood in their place and read the Instruction scroll from the LORD their God for a quarter of the day. For another quarter of the day, they confessed and worshipped the LORD their God.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku li m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam samli dol o ʒiʒiinikpee, ŋun kum li, ka di lan yɛli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee maa yom li, dama bɛ moli Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum sama saha shɛli molo.
en: This is the way you must do this: Everyone who has lent money to another Israelite must cancel the debt. He should not ask a fellow Israelite to repay the debt, because the Lord said to cancel debts during that year.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Ɛdomnim zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka chɛ ka di kpalim zani dabari, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba Tɛman hal ni Dɛdan.
en: So I will punish Edom by killing all its people and livestock. It will be an empty wasteland all the way from Teman to Dedan.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba tizɔpaɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Do not have intercourse with an aunt, whether she is your father's sister or your mother's sister.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala dab paɣ maa bihi, amaa ti nyɛla bilichin paɣ la bihi.
en: So, my brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman. We are children of the free woman.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tɔɣisiri niriba maa la yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Jesus' disciples came to him and asked, Why do you use stories to speak to the people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Gidiɔn daa bɔhi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, Ninvuɣ banim ka yi daa lee ku Tabo la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Bɛ zaa daa bela a ni be shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ daa ŋmanila nabihi.
en: Then Gideon asked Zebah and Zalmunna, What about the men you killed at Tabor? They answered, They looked like you—every one of them like the son of a king.

dag: Cham ti yɛli ba ka bɛ labi bɛ suɣa ni.
en: Now, tell them to return to their tents.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋ n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli yi ni niŋ naani ŋɔ mini n ni daa zaŋ luɣ shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim la kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm maa.
en: And so, what I did to Shiloh I will do to this Temple of mine, in which you trust. Here in this place that I gave to your ancestors and you, I will do the same thing that I did to Shiloh.

dag: Dama wuhibu din viɛla ka n zaŋ tiri ya maa, miriya ka yi zaɣisi n wuhibu.
en: What I am teaching you is good, so remember it all.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni, ka be kasi ŋɔ, a pala ŋun daa pun be kurimbuni ha? Ti ku kpi. Yawɛ, nyini n-zali ba ni bɛ kari saria; nyini ŋun nyɛ ti tampiŋ ŋɔ n-zali ba ni bɛ darigiri niriba tibili.
en: Lord , you are the one who lives forever! You are my holy God who never dies! Lord , you created the Babylonians to do what must be done. Our Rock, you created them to punish people.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chaŋ Samuɛl sani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni nti yɛl o, Wuhim ma ŋun nyari niriba yɛla la yiŋa.
en: Saul went over to Samuel in the gateway and said, A man who can see visions lives here in town. Could you tell me the way to his house.

dag: Ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: If anyone kills another person, they must be executed.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti zaŋ naɣilaa ni yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la bee alikauli palibu sara bee suhudoo biɛrisuŋ sara ti Yawɛ.
en: You might prepare a young bull as a burnt offering, a sacrifice, a fellowship offering, or to keep a special promise to the Lord .

dag: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina. Ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: You must wash the legs and inner parts of the animal with water. Then the priest will bring all these parts to the altar to be offered as a burnt offering, a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Amaa Yuria daa bi kul o yiŋa, ka daa yi nti dɔnila nayili samban dunol ni tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli nayili maa sani.
en: But Uriah did not go home; instead he slept at the palace gate with the king's guards.

dag: Ka n yura maa daa zaŋ o nuu daai dunoli, ka n suhu dii kpe o ni.
en: Then my darling's hand reached to open the latch, and my heart stood still.

dag: N daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka n lee bi baŋ di gbinni. Di zuɣu ka n daa bɔh o, Ndana, ka wula ka di zaa ti yɛn bahindi.
en: I heard the answer, but I really didnt understand. So I asked, Sir, what will happen after all this comes true.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai naa bia Abija.
en: At that time Jeroboams son Abijah became very sick.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ lab mali Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin la, ka o daa mali suhudoo mini wumpaɣibo sara di zuɣu, ka daa zali Judanima ni bɛ jɛmmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa.
en: He also repaired the altar where the Lord was worshiped, and he sacrificed fellowship offerings and thanksgiving offerings on it. He commanded all the people of Judah to worship the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bia paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o bia paɣa, di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: You must not have sexual contact with your daughter-in-law; she is your sons wife. You must not have sexual contact with her.

dag: Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpuɣi Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir ŋun daa yi Mɛsopoteemia la na bipuɣiŋga la. Ribɛka daa nyɛla Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir la tizɔpaɣa.
en: and he was years old when he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel. She was also the sister of Laban, the Aramean from northern Syria. Almost years later.

dag: O vuhim pɔhim daa ʒe n-neei zuɣusaa, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu kuhi wahu ŋun zɔri ni o tiligi.
en: It is his breath that made the sky clear, and his hand that killed the escaping monster.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa piig o Bia n-tuui tim o la yi sanna ni o ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka taɣi yi zaa biɛhigu n-yihi ya yi tuumbiɛri ni.
en: And so God chose his Servant and sent him to you first, to bless you by making every one of you turn away from your wicked ways.

dag: Ninsalinim bi mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli paai li. Di ka ninvuɣ nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: People dont know where wisdom is. It cannot be found by anyone on earth.

dag: O ʒiɛla luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu mini so naŋgban kpansi ni sochira zuɣu.
en: On the hilltops near the road and at the crossroads she stands.

dag: Rubin daa yɛli ba, Di yihiya o ʒim, zaŋmiy o niŋ bɔɣili ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka di niŋy o shɛli. O daa yɛlila lala ni o fa o bɛ nuu ni bahi n-zaŋ o kulisi ti ti bɛ ba.
en: Don't murder him or even harm him. Just throw him into a well out here in the desert. Reuben planned to rescue Joseph later and take him back to his father.

dag: Nir ni tooi yɛli ni Lɛvi ŋun daa deeri zaka la gba daa be ti yab Ibrahimma ni n-yihi zaka ti Mɛlikizɛdɛk;.
en: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.

dag: N ni yɛri shɛm zabiri mmaŋ zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When people criticize me, this is how I defend myself:.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn be afua ni la zuɣu. N suhu daa yiɣisila biɛla bahi n niriba maa zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ kpe di ni n-dihi ba wahala biɛri pahi.
en: And I am very angry at the nations that feel so safe. I was only a little angry, and I used them to punish my people. But they caused too much damage.

dag: Yawɛ, n teeg a tuun kara la yɛla; ka teeg a ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la gba yɛla.
en: But I will remember the LORDs deeds; yes, I will remember your wondrous acts from times long past.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla bɛ ni pun zali shɛli, ka ninsalinim biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm bi sɔɣi. Ka bɛ mi ku tooi ŋme ŋun gari ba kpiɔŋ naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Whatever happens has already been designated, and human beings are fully known. They cant contend with the one who is stronger than they are.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa lan kpahi ŋarima din zɔri pam zali Ɛziɔngɛba din miri Ɛlat, ka be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kulinol ni la.
en: King Solomon built a fleet near Eloth in Ezion-geber, on the coast of the Reed Sea in the land of Edom.

dag: Ka di ni di zibiri ka bɛ yɛn yo dunoli saha shɛli ka bɛ di yi, ka m mi bi mi bɛ ni kpa shɛli polo; biɛhimiya bɛ naba yomyom; di pa shɛli yi ni paai ba.
en: In the evening, when it was time to close the city gate, the men left. I dont know where they went. But if you go quickly, maybe you can catch them.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ti tam o daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla. Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra.
en: God is famous for his wondrous works. The LORD is full of mercy and compassion.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa suhuri daa kpaŋ ka bɛ gba zaŋ bindirigu di.
en: All the men felt better and started eating too.

dag: Mani m-mi o, amaa yinim kul ʒi o. Ka n yi yɛli ni n ʒi o, n ni leei ʒirilana kaman yinim la. M mi o, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: But you dont really know him. I know him. If I said I did not know him, I would be a liar like you. But I do know him, and I obey what he says.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔri ni o bahi Yisa, dinzuɣu ka o daa lan lab tɔɣisi ba di yɛla maa;.
en: Pilate wanted to let Jesus go free. So again Pilate told them that he would let him go.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, N suhir a, wuhim ma a yuli. Amaa ka doo maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a baŋ n yuli? Di nyaaŋa ka doo maa daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni nimaani.
en: Jacob said, Now tell me your name. Don't you know who I am? he asked. And he blessed Jacob.

dag: Ka o gba daa duɣi o ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti o ba. O daa yɛlila o ba, M ba, yiɣisim ŋub a bia mɔɣu ni nimdi ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: He cooked the tasty food, brought it to his father, and said, Father, please sit up and eat the meat I have brought you, so you can give me your blessing.

dag: Yi kul tɛhirimi ni ti zabirila timaŋ zuɣu yi sani? M mabiyurisi, Naawuni sani, Masia zuɣu ka ti kul tɔɣisira, ka di zaa nyɛla yi kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: Do you think that we have been defending ourselves to you all this time? No, we say these things in Christ and before God. You are our dear friends, and everything we do is to make you stronger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ chibi sil shɛli ka di be Dauda tiŋ la ni la puuni. Bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔŋla garibil zuɣu, ka daa chɛ ka tulaale duɣiriba zaŋ tulaale mih o, ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣi, ka mali buɣim titali sɔŋ ti o kuli maa jilima.
en: The people buried Asa in his own tomb that he made for himself in the City of David. They laid him in a bed that was filled with spices and different kinds of mixed perfumes, and they burned a large fire for him.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛya, ka naa ŋmalig o nini bahi bɛ polo n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ bɛ zaa ni.
en: Solomon turned toward the people standing there. Then he blessed them.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni wuh a Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ʒii maa wuhirila di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yɛla maa naabu saha.
en: He said, Now, I will explain the vision to you. I will tell you what will happen in the future. Your vision was about the end times.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba mini m ma ti chɛ ma bahi, amaa Yawɛ ŋun kul ni gbib ma.
en: Even if my father and mother left me all alone, the LORD would take me in.

dag: Do so daa lan beni ŋun mali Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa. O yuli n-daa booni Yuria. O daa nyɛla Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim nir la bia. O daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi tiŋ ŋɔ mini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kaman Jɛrimia ni kul tɔɣisiri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: In the past there was another man who spoke the Lord s message. His name was Uriah son of Shemaiah from the city of Kiriath Jearim. Uriah said the same things against this city and this land that Jeremiah did.

dag: O gbaai ma n soli zuɣu chaŋ ti dari tɔhi ma. O chɛ ka m bahi yoli.
en: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.

dag: Doo yi mali paɣiba ayi ka yuri yino ka bi yuri ŋun la, ka o ni yuri paɣ so maa min o ni bi yuri paɣ so maa zaa dɔɣ o bidibisi, ka o ni bi yuri paɣ so maa bidibiga n-nyɛ o bituuli.
en: Now suppose a man has two wives—one of them loved and the other unloved. Both wives bear children, but the oldest male is the unloved wifes child.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee be ya.
en: Where are the kings of the cities of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni niriba maa zaa daa bi deei Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ ʒinimi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa.
en: Johanan, the other army officers, and everyone else refused to stay in Judah in spite of the Lord 's command.

dag: Nimrim kulibɔŋ nyuuya zaa, ka di duli mɔri kuui, ka momahili lan ka nimaani yaha.
en: The waters of Nimrim are used up. Grass has withered; vegetation is dead; greenery is gone.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Kpe ka maligumaaniba yɛn duɣiri taali sanyoo sara min alahichi sanyoo sara binyara, di lan nyɛla luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn shɛri chi sara binyara din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ li yi dundɔntitali ni, ka zaŋ kasitali chaŋ niriba maa sani.
en: and said, This is the place where the priests are to boil the meat offered as sacrifices for sin or as repayment offerings, and to bake the offerings of flour, so that nothing holy is carried to the outer courtyard, where it might harm the people.

dag: Daadam Bia mi kamina ni o ti bo n-nya bɛn bɔrigi la n-tiligi ba.
en: The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti lan yɛli Hiburunim maa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba bɛn yuya daa booni Shifira mini Pua.
en: Then the king of Egypt spoke to Shiphrah and Puah, the two midwives who helped the Hebrew women.

dag: O ni daa ka ti sanna maa o daa zaŋla Pool shɛlɔrigu lo omaŋmaŋ nuhi min o naba ka yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, Lala ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ti yɛn lo ninvuɣ so ŋun su shɛlɔrigu ŋɔ n-zaŋ o niŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He took Paul's belt, and with it he tied up his own hands and feet. Then he told us, The Holy Spirit says that some of the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem will tie up the man who owns this belt. They will also hand him over to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka Adam min o paɣ daa lan laɣim ka o dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Sɛt, dama O daa yɛlimi, Naawuni zaŋla bidib so ti ma ka o zani Ɛbɛl zaani, Keen ni daa ku Ɛbɛl la zuɣu.
en: Adam again had sexual relations with his wife, and she gave birth to another son. She named him Seth. Eve said, God has given me another son. Cain killed Abel, but now I have Seth.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni a ni mali yurilim shɛli din yi a yɛda niŋbu ni na maa ni kpaŋs a ka a baŋ bin sun shɛŋa zaa ti ni mali Masia ni la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: My prayer is that our fellowship with you as believers will bring about a deeper understanding of every blessing which we have in our life in union with Christ.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya pɔi ka naanyi piri ba. Bɛ daa niŋla bɛ zaa lala, dama luɣ kasi shee tumtumdiba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni tuma daa be Ɛliɛza mini Itama bidibisi maa zaa ni.
en: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn yɛra, Zuŋɔ bee biɛɣuni ti ni chaŋ tiŋ yaakaza nti be nimaani yuun muni n-wolindi nyari nyɔri la.
en: Some of you say, Today or tomorrow we will go to some city. We will stay there a year, do business, and make money. Listen, think about this:.

dag: Bɛ zaa kala damli dambu na. Ka bɛ nina kul lihiri tooni; ka laɣisiri daba kaman taŋkpaɣu la.
en: They are eager to destroy, and they gather captives like handfuls of sand.

dag: Nyama di daba ata dali ka do so daa ti yi Sool sansan ni n-zo m-paana ka o binyɛra chahi, ka taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu. O ni daa ti paai Dauda sani, o daa lumi gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura.
en: On the third day, a man showed up from Sauls camp with his clothes torn and dirt on his head. When he reached David, he fell to the ground, bowing low out of respect.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Jafɛt tɔŋ! Naawuni chɛ ka o zuliya mini Shɛm zuliya laɣim be; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: May God cause Japheth to increase! May his descendants live with the people of Shem! Canaan will be the slave of Japheth.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa yoobu maa ni, bɛ daa zaŋla naɣilahi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi kɔbisiyi ni piɛbihi kɔbisinahi mali sara, ka lan zaŋ bulahi pinaayi mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi zuɣu; kaman bɛ zuliya maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: dama o daa yɛli o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shihi o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She was thinking, If I can just touch his clothes, Ill be healed.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi fa piɛri mini niɣi, ka o niriba maa daa taɣiri niɣi maa be tooni ka yɛra, Dauda ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: David also captured all the sheep and cattle, which were driven in front of the other livestock. The troops said, This is Davids plunder.

dag: Ka bia maa ba daa kuhi ni nintam yɛli, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda; ka n yɛda niŋbu ni pooi shɛli ni, nyin sɔŋm ma di puuni.
en: Immediately the father shouted, I do believe. Help me to believe more.

dag: ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣis o Naawuni malaikanim sani.
en: But if you reject me, you will be rejected in front of them.

dag: Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Naawuni, Ka ŋun daŋ niriba n-lee yɛn daŋ tooni chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim ŋɔ ti ti.
en: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord , Which of our tribes should attack the Canaanites first.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli Absalom, Aai, m bia, di chɛ ka ti zaa kana, di yi nyɛ lala, ti yɛla ni ti muɣis a pam. Ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋa ni o chɛ ka o chaŋ, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi, ka naɣ suhila alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: David answered, No, my son, we won't go. It would be too expensive for you. Absalom tried to get him to change his mind, but David did not want to go. He only said that he hoped they would have a good time.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni, dama m mali tahima o sani.
en: Oh, I must find rest in God only, because my hope comes from him!.

dag: A chɛ ka pɔhim kpuɣi ma, ka chɛ ka m ba pɔhim maa, ka a tɔri ma gindi sanʒiɛɣu ni.
en: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.

dag: Timiya pini, ka Naawuni ti yi gba; ka yi ni yɛn deei shɛli maa ni pali yi nuhi hal ti puuri bahira; dama yi ni zahindi binyara shɛm tiri yi taba, lala ka Naawuni ni ti zahim ti yi gba.
en: If you give to others, you will be given a full amount in return. It will be packed down, shaken together, and spilling over into your lap. The way you treat others is the way you will be treated.

dag: Lɛmuɛl, wumma, di bi simdi ni nanim nyuri wain bee ka nanim chɛ ka bɛ kɔre be dam din kpɛm nyubu ni.
en: Lemuel, it is not wise for kings to drink wine. It is not wise for rulers to want beer.

dag: Bɛ pakoya zooya gari teeku noli bihigu. N ku nachimba wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ bɛ manima, ka chɛ ka biɛrim mini dabiɛm lu bɛ zuɣu libigi ba.
en: There are more widows in your land than grains of sand by the sea. I killed your young men in their prime and made their mothers suffer. I suddenly struck them with anguish and terror.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirigi bɛ ni yɛn kpa tiŋgbani maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo ti taba. Ɛhab kɔŋko daa kpala yaɣ yini polo; ka Obadia mi kɔŋko kpa yaɣ din la polo.
en: They agreed on which part of the land each one would explore, and set off in different directions.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, n yi yɔhi yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord .

dag: Dama n daa yi zabirila karimbaannim nyuli. N daa nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni tɔŋdi shɛm.
en: because I envied the arrogant; I observed how the wicked are well off.

dag: Lala ka Ɛdomnim daa niŋ n-zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan su ba, o ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Duuma Naawuni jɛmbu la zuɣu.
en: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord , the God his ancestors had worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka n ni daa pun wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na la lan yɛli ma yaha, Cham ti deei litaafi bil shɛli din bɔɣi be malaika so ŋun tam teeku kom zuɣu mini duli zuɣu ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Then the voice that I had heard speaking from heaven spoke to me again, saying, Go and take the open scroll which is in the hand of the angel standing on the sea and on the land.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛli ni o paɣ Zara nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa. Ka Gɛra Naa Abimilɛk daa tim ti zaŋ Zara na.
en: he said that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛligu din daa kul maan chanila tooni pahira.
en: The message of God was spreading, reaching more and more people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du mɔɣili maa ni bɛ ti zaŋ naa malibu duhi na, ka niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm. Naa ni daa ti yɛn du mɔɣili maa saha shɛli, ka Shimɛi Gɛra bia maa daa kana ti damdi naa tooni.
en: The people went across the Jordan River to help bring the kings family back to Judah. They did whatever the king wanted. While the king was crossing the river, Shimei son of Gera came to meet him. He bowed down to the ground in front of the king.

dag: Din chɛ ka ti yɛl lala nyɛla ti ni niŋ Naawuni naani Masia zuɣu la.
en: We say this because we have confidence in God through Christ.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli;.
en: The soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes.

dag: So be yi ni n-nyari wahala? O suhimi Naawuni. So be yi ni m-mali suhupiɛlli? O yilimi yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: Are you having troubles? You should pray. Are you happy? You should sing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: The disciples discussed this among themselves, He said this because we have no bread.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpe Dauda suhu ni pam, ka dabiɛm gbaag o zaŋ chaŋ Gaat Naa Akishi maa polo.
en: David took these words very seriously and became very frightened of Achish, Gaths king.

dag: Dama bɛ chaŋ Asiria kaman yɔɣuni buntaaŋa ŋun gɔr o ko la. I friimnim darila niriba ni bɛ sɔŋdi ba.
en: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o soya, ka bi tum taali gba mali alibarika.
en: and who never do wrong or turn from you.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli Izraɛlnim ni labisiri nɛma tiri tab la saha yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm bɛ tarili maa pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni, ka bɛ tarili maa ku lan be ti yaannim tarili ni.
en: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa chaŋ teeku ni.
en: When evening came, Jesus disciples went down to the lake.

dag: Di lan chɛliya ka so biri bimbira bee ka so kpuɣi atam di kpuɣibu saha Babilɔn. Bɛ zaa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba sani tɔb shɛli din yɛn di ba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ zaa ti zo n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: There is no one in Babylonia to plant or harvest crops. Even foreigners who lived there have left for their homelands, afraid of the enemy armies.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam zaa niŋ Yisifu nuu ni. Yisifu ni daa be o sani maa zuɣu, o baɣa daa lan ka shɛl ni n-naɣ pahila bindir shɛl o ni daa diri ni. Yisifu daa yi nachimbil viɛlli pam, ka o lihibu viɛla.
en: So he handed over everything he had to Joseph and didnt pay attention to anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome.

dag: ni Jɔa ni Iddo ni Zɛra ni Jiatɛrai.
en: Joah, Iddo, Zerah, Jeatherai.

dag: Ka di yi ti simdi ni n gba chaŋ, n ni pahi bɛ zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: If it seems worthwhile for me to go, then they can go along with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun daa tiligi Ibrahimma o muɣisigu puuni la yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, Yi ku lan di vi, yi mi ninni biɛhigu ku lan taɣi.
en: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi Gibia na ti tuhi ku Izraɛlnim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayi dindali maa.
en: Benjamin's soldiers came out of Gibeah and attacked, and when the day was over, , Israelite soldiers lay dead on the ground.

dag: Naawuni, nyam ti nyɔtaɣirigu, lihim a ni pii na so ŋɔ ninni!.
en: Look at our shield, God; pay close attention to the face of your anointed one!.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku bia maa kpiya.
en: Get up, the angel said, and take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel. Those who were trying to kill the child are dead.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na nti pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ pinaayi m-boli ba tuumba.
en: When day came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he named apostles:.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban daa gahim bula shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ni sabilimsabilim mini bunyama bɛn zaa liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn zaa mali piɛlimpiɛlim ni piɛbihi shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ zaɣ sabila n-zaŋ ba ti o bihi ni bɛ guli ba.
en: Before the end of the day, Laban had separated his spotted and speckled animals and the black lambs from the others and had put his sons in charge of them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bela fɔntiŋ shɛŋa din kpalim dabari ni, ka be yiya shɛŋa din nyɛ nir ni ku be yiya shɛŋa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ wurim shɛŋa la.
en: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.

dag: Ka a daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, m bela a sani, ka nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a, ka duh a yuli kaman dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ kara yuya ni du shɛm.
en: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and I have defeated all your enemies as you advanced. I will make you as famous as the greatest leaders in the world.

dag: Jair daa malila bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn bari bunsi pihita. Ka o bihi maa daa mali tinsi pihita Giliad tiŋgban ni; ka bɛ na kul booni li Havɔtijairi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He had thirty sons who were mounted on thirty donkeys and controlled thirty towns in the land of Gilead—these are still known as Havvoth-jair today.

dag: Di saha maa ka ti Duuma daa niŋ anfaani din galisi pam niŋ n ni, ka ti ma yɛda mini yurilim din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: And our Lord poured out his abundant grace on me and gave me the faith and love which are ours in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: O yoom ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ o polo ka ti dol o soya, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zali ti yaannim la.
en: may he make us obedient to him, so that we will always live as he wants us to live, keeping all the laws and commands he gave our ancestors.

dag: O saa nyaɣisibu neesim neeri dunia ŋɔ ni; ka dunianim nyari li ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees it and trembles.

dag: N ku bɔri ni n yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ninsal na mi m-bɔri ni binshɛli val o?.
en: I won't ask to speak with God; why should I give him a chance to destroy me?.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lura, ka sokam zaŋ bɛ bar shɛb dɔro balibu kam ni mali tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: When the sun went down, the people brought their sick friends to Jesus. They had many different kinds of sicknesses. Jesus laid his hands on each sick person and healed them all.

dag: ka nya ka do so ŋun yuli booni Ananias kpe o sanna nti zaŋ o nuu pa o zuɣu ni o nina neei.
en: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias enter and put his hands on him to restore his sight.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya sani. Wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm ka kana ti tiligi ti!.
en: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.

dag: Ka Pita lan bɔh o, N Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka n ku tooi dol a pumpɔŋɔ? Hal n ni saɣi kpi a zuɣu.
en: Lord, why can't I follow you now? asked Peter. I am ready to die for you.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa naai ka o yiɣisi n-zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo.
en: After Jesus said these things, he continued traveling toward Jerusalem.

dag: Dama o chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-kabisi ma, ka kul chɛ ka n dansi pahira, ka di ka daliri.
en: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.

dag: ka leei yi Ba, ka yi mi leei m bidibisi mini m bipuɣinsi. Ti Duuma Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-yɛl lala maa.
en: I will be a father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty .

dag: amaa ka Ammɔn nabihi daa yɛli bɛ dan Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim tuumba na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ka o be a maa? Dauda timla niriba ŋɔ na ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ yaŋɔ daashili zaa ka tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: But Hanun's officials told him, Do you really believe David is honoring your father by sending these people to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our city, so he can destroy it.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ li gari taba kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm la, ka di leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni.
en: and make a sacred anointing oil, mixed like perfume.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, a ni ti bela tiŋgbani puuni ha tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka a yɛtɔɣa yiri tiŋgban ni na. A kukoli ni ti ŋmanila kpim kukoli n-yiri tiŋgban ni na. A ti yɛn sɔɣirimi yɛri ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: You will be brought down; from the ground you will speak; from low in the dust your speech will come. Your voice will be like a ghosts from the earth; from the dust your words will whisper.

dag: Ka Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira bini ti mini ya sunsuuni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka bɛ daa boli sara maligu bimbini maa yuli, Shɛhira.
en: The people of Reuben and Gad named the altar A Reminder to Us All That the Lord Is Our God.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti paai Sidɔn, ka sapashini Julius daa niŋ Pool nirilim wɔɣis o ka o chaŋ o zɔnim sani ka bɛ ti niŋ o saani.
en: The next day we came to shore at Sidon. Captain Julius was very kind to Paul. He even let him visit his friends, so they could give him whatever he needed.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dol o chana. Ka salo daa muɣ o sani kabiri dol o.
en: So Jesus went with Jairus. Many people followed Jesus. They were pushing very close around him.

dag: Ka kɔŋlan so daa ka Yisa sanna nti damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, A yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: A man with a skin disease approached Jesus, fell to his knees, and begged, If you want, you can make me clean.

dag: Ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa ti kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: The Lord 's servant Joshua son of Nun died at the age of a hundred and ten.

dag: So ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa kul nyɛla din wuhiri ti alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: because no one can be made right with God by following the law. The law only shows us our sin.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa bela Giligal. Nimaani ka n nyee daa piligi ba nyɔnibu. Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu n ni kari ba yihi n yiŋa. N ku lan yuri ba yaha; bɛ kpamba zaa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi ma.
en: All their evil is in Gilgal; I began hating them there. I will force them to leave my house because of the evil things they do. I will not love them anymore. Their leaders are rebels who turned against me.

dag: M bia, gbibi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka n ni zal a shɛm be a suhu ni.
en: My son, remember my words. Dont forget what I have told you.

dag: Lihimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibi li hal ti zahim li maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba tooni Jɛrusalɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la puuni duri ni.
en: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu tuhi; o nyɛla n tampiŋ, ka dinkam pa wuntia tuuni ka o ni.
en: This shows that the Lord is just, that there is no wrong in my protector.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Alizanda nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka dunia ŋɔ nyɛ n naba zaashee. Ka yili bɔ ka yi yɛn me n-ti ma? Ka bee luɣ dini n-lee yɛn nyɛ n vuhibu shee?.
en: This is what the Lord says: Heaven is my throne, and the earth is where I rest my feet. So do you think you can build a house for me? Do I need a place to rest?.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli wumbu ka zaŋ bɛ zaɣa niŋla kurimbuni ha lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: They will turn their back on the truth and turn to myths.

dag: dama pako shɛb pun birigi doli Sintani.
en: For some widows have already turned away to follow Satan.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl kpamba maa zaa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti pun pola Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka lo ba alikauli maa, dinzuɣu ti ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then all the leaders said to the whole community, We have made a solemn pledge to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. So we cant touch them now.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛri ni bari ma zana la zaa yoli, n ku tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: The wicked have laid a trap for me, but I do not forget your law.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru la lo o shee ni n-wa waa ni o yaa zaa Yawɛ tooni.
en: He was dancing for the Lord with all his might, but he wore only a linen cloth.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ takɔbi chaŋ ti lu Nɔb din daa nyɛ maligumaaniba tiŋ la nim zuɣu n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi ni biliɛri ni naɣilahi ni bunsi ni piɛri. O daa zaŋla takɔbi ku bɛ zaa.
en: Then he attacked the town of Nob, where the priests had lived, and he killed everyone there—men, women, children, and babies. He even killed their cattle, donkeys, and sheep.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ti o ni daa nya malaika o yiŋ shɛm, ka o yɛl o ni o timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: He told us about the angel he had seen standing in his house. The angel said, Send some men to Joppa to get Simon, the one who is also called Peter.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli nyin Baruk shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the LORD the God of Israel proclaims about you, Baruch.

dag: din nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zali ya alizanda ni, ka di nyɛ din ku tooi pooi bee n-saɣim bee n-kpaai la.
en: You have a pure and enduring inheritance that cannot perish—an inheritance that is presently kept safe in heaven for you.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a yurilim yɛla yɛli cheechi din be kpe ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania sɔŋ ba ka bɛ bahi chaŋ bɛ chandi maa, dama lala niŋbu nyɛla din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ dunɔdali din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: Then he led me to the east gate.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhuri ye Naawuni zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ Naawuni bɔbu milinsi maa lee bi doli soli.
en: I know they love God, but they don't understand.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daai Taai goma luhi, ka wurim di binwɔɣila, ka n ti yihi di taŋkpaɣu ka chɛ ka di kpalim tampin nɛli doya.
en: They will destroy your city walls and tear down your towers. Then I will sweep away all the dust and leave only a bare rock.

dag: Amaa a yi birigi n-chɛ ka do so zaŋ a dɔni, ka a ta amaŋ daɣiri a ni be a yidan fukumsi ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: But if you have committed adultery.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wuhirila n ʒiɛyimtali n suhu ni, ka n ni mi shɛli dina, ka n yɛn yɛli ni n suhu zaa.
en: My heart is honest, so my words are sincere. I will speak the truth about what I know.

dag: Ka Nahɔr daa nyɛ Sɛrug bia ka Sɛrug nyɛ Riu bia, ka Riu nyɛ Pɛlɛg bia, ka Pɛlɛg nyɛ Ɛba bia, ka Ɛba mi nyɛ Shɛla bia.
en: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah.

dag: Chɛ ka o be n-yuui kaman wuntaŋ mini goli ni be shɛm ŋɔ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: May people always fear and respect you, God, as long as the sun shines and the moon is in the sky.

dag: Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ ni, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o kpe.
en: Jesus got into a boat, and his disciples went with him.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, ka bi deei n yɛligu mali sariakarita. Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni pun tɔɣisi la nti yɛn kar o saria zaadali.
en: Those who reject me and do not accept my message have one who will judge them. The words I have spoken will be their judge on the last day!.

dag: Lala ka Jɔshua daa niŋ tiligi Gibiɔnnim maa Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ bi ku ba.
en: So Joshua treated them in this way. He spared them from the power of the Israelites, and they didnt kill them.

dag: dama ŋun nyɛ yikolana ka o yuli nyɛ kasi ŋɔ tum ma tuun kara.
en: Yes, the Powerful One has done great things for me. His name is very holy.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di wɔɣ zuɣusaa gari mɔɣu ni tihi zaa. Di wulikpani daa bara, ka di wula wɔɣa, di ni daa nyari kom pam zoori la zuɣu.
en: So that tree was taller than all the other trees of the field, and it grew many branches. There was plenty of water, so the tree branches spread out.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee wain tihi puu ni chana, a ni tooi pɔhi di wala maa a suhu ni bɔri shɛm tariga di, amaa miri ka a pɔhi shɛli niŋ a nɛma ni.
en: If you go into your neighbors vineyard, you can eat as many grapes as you like, until full, but dont carry any away in a basket.

dag: Ka do so daa ti nya o ka o be mɔɣu ni chani ginda, ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra.
en: a man found him wandering in the field and asked him, What are you looking for.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm ti ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ. Ti mali niriba anahi bɛn po pɔri.
en: You must therefore do what we tell you. Four men among us have made a solemn promise.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi pa wɔhu gali n-gu tɔbu tuhibu dali, amaa nasara dibu bela Yawɛ sani.
en: You can get horses ready for battle, but it is the Lord who gives victory.

dag: Man Pool n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so shɛb ni yɛli ni n siɣisiri mmaŋa n yi ti be yi sani, amaa ka lee ti ka yi sani ka wuhiri dɔbilim la. N suhiri ya Masia tarimtali min o baalimtali puuni.
en: I, Paul, make a personal appeal to you—I who am said to be meek and mild when I am with you, but harsh with you when I am away. By the gentleness and kindness of Christ.

dag: Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: There were , who returned, in addition to , servants and musicians, counting both men and women. Altogether, they brought with them horses, mules, camels, and , donkeys.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka Manaasa daa zaŋ niriba maa m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ birigi n-tum tuumbiɛri hal gari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka Naawuni ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa ʒin nimaani la.
en: But the people of Judah did not obey the Lord , and Manasseh led them to commit even greater sins than those committed by the nations whom the Lord had driven out of the land as his people advanced.

dag: N yi baŋ a wuntia zaligunim maa, n ni paɣ a ni suhu yini.
en: I will give thanks to you with a heart that does right as I learn your righteous rules.

dag: ni Hɔrinim bɛn be Ɛdom zoya ni la n-doli ba hal ni Ɛliparan din be mɔɣu ni tintariga la shee.
en: and the Horites in the mountains of Edom, pursuing them as far as Elparan on the edge of the desert.

dag: Yisa ni daa du Galili Teeku duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu yi gbala polo n-tuhir o sol na. Bɛ nini daa tuli pam hal ka so ku tooi gari bɛ ni be shɛli polo maa.
en: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ti nyari binyara mi kaman diɣi liti ni ka ti lihira; amaa saha yi ti paai, ti nini yipa ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Pumpɔŋɔ m bi mi binshɛɣukam zaa, amaa saha kanna ka n ni ti mi zaa kaman Naawuni ni mi ma zaa shɛm la.
en: What we see now is like a dim image in a mirror; then we shall see face-to-face. What I know now is only partial; then it will be complete—as complete as God's knowledge of me.

dag: Ka Ɛhab bɔh o, Ka banima n-lee yɛn gari tooni chaŋ ti liri ba? Ka anab maa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi la n-yɛn gari tooni. Ka Ɛhab lan bɔh o, Ka ŋuni nti lee yɛn piligi tɔb maa? Ka o yɛl o, Nyini.
en: Who will lead the attack? Ahab asked. The prophet answered, The Lord says that the young soldiers under the command of the district governors are to do it. Who will command the main force? the king asked. You, the prophet answered.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilai, Ilai, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: Then about that time Jesus shouted, Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani? which means, My God, my God, why have you deserted me.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa yi tum din chihi Anabi Musa zaligu, bɛ kur o mi niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira zuɣu ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Whoever refused to obey the Law of Moses was found guilty from the testimony given by two or three witnesses. Such people were not forgiven. They were killed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yi tiŋ maa ni n-chaŋ biɛla ha saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, Yiɣisim kari niriba maa naba, a yi ti paai ba, nyin bɔhim ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zu n daanzinfa pipia?.
en: But they had not gone far from the city when Joseph told the servant, Go after those men! When you catch them, say, My master has been good to you. So why have you stolen his silver cup?.

dag: A nyɛla Naawuni suŋ, ka tumdi din viɛla; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: How good you are—how kind! Teach me your commands.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali din be dundɔn titali ni zaŋ labi nuzaa polo la ziliŋ mini di yɛliŋ.
en: Then the man measured the length and width of the north gate that was in the wall surrounding the outer courtyard.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili dali miriya. Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu na dabisi shɛli dali maa miriya. Fabilimiya!.
en: The Lord s special day is near. So cry and be sad for yourselves. A time is coming when the enemy will steal your wealth. God All-Powerful will make that happen.

dag: O ti o niriba faako. O lo o daalikauli ni di kul ʒiɛya sahakam. O yuli be kasi ka mali dabiɛm.
en: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.

dag: Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi ka paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, o ni zaŋ tiŋgban viɛli shɛli tin ya maa zuɣu.
en: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka niriba maa daa kar o naba nti bo n-nya o, ka bi saɣi ni o lan woligi ba;.
en: The next day Jesus went to a place to be alone. The people looked for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ ninkura, wummiya; yinim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na min niŋ yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni bee yi yaannim ʒiɛmana la ni?.
en: Hear this, elders; pay attention, everyone in the land! Has anything like this ever happened in your days, or in the days of your ancestors?.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti kaman o ni lo shɛm o suhu ni, ka pa ni yolitim bee muɣisigu zuɣu, dama Naawuni yurila ŋun tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Each one of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give. You should not give if it makes you unhappy or if you feel forced to give. God loves those who are happy to give.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin daa ʒe bɛ tooni, ka Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan bidibiga la be bɛ ni. Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa gbibila o tulaale zim tuɣilibu daaŋa o nuu ni, ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: The seventy elders of the house of Israel were standing in front of them, and all of them were holding censers in their hands. Jaazaniah, Shaphans son, was standing right there with them, and the scent of the incense cloud rose up.

dag: Daadam, fabilim Taai naa zuɣu ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini n-daa nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri din ka galimi ka mali baŋsim pam, ka viɛl zaa.
en: Mortal man, he said, grieve for the fate that is waiting for the king of Tyre. Tell him what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: You were once an example of perfection. How wise and handsome you were!.

dag: Izraɛlnim nyɛla daba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛb niŋ dabitim ni? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka niriba fari ba?.
en: Israel is not a slave; he was not born into slavery. Why then do his enemies hunt him down?.

dag: Ka doo maa kɔŋ maa daa dii naai, ka o niŋgbuŋ lan lab di bebu ni zaa.
en: At once the disease left the man, and he was clean.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumdiba ni ti gbani ninvuɣ suma tooni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri ti baɣi wuntizɔriba dunɔdaya.
en: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.

dag: Dama o daa bi niŋ so nirilim, amaa ka daa naɣ lula faranim mini nandaamba ni suhugarigunim zuɣu n-ku ba.
en: He never did anything good. He never loved anyone. He made life hard for the poor and the helpless.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Babɛl , dama nimaani ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woligiwoligi; nimaani ka o daa lan wurim ba kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: The city was called Babylon, because there the Lord mixed up the language of all the people, and from there he scattered them all over the earth.

dag: Amaa ka yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Pumpɔŋɔ yinim Izraɛlnima wummiya, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yinima ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: But you say, My Lords way doesnt measure up. Listen, house of Israel, is it my ways that dont measure up? Isnt it your ways that dont measure up?.

dag: Dunia ni ti zaɣi n-kuui zaa; ka sagbana mini dunia zaa zaɣi.
en: The earth dries up and withers; the whole world grows weak; both earth and sky decay.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zoya ŋɔ nim zaa zaŋ takɔbiri ti lu Gɔg zuɣu. O tɔbbihi ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: I will terrify Gog with all sorts of calamities. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken. His men will turn their swords against one another.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa ni bɛ yinsinim zaŋ tabili ŋun Dauda paɣiba ayi la, Ahinɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la mini Nabal pakoli Abigeel ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la zaa daa be Gaat Akishi sani.
en: David and his men settled there in Gath with their families. David had his two wives with him, Ahinoam from Jezreel, and Abigail, Nabal's widow, from Carmel.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa zuɣu ka ti lɔri alikauli ŋɔ, ka sabi li sɔŋ, ka ti zuɣulaannim mini ti Lɛvinim ni ti maligumaaniba yuya sabi pa bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa tabili alikauli gbaŋ maa zuɣu.
en: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.

dag: dinzuɣu nol lɔbu dali amaŋmaŋ chama nti karim n ni yɛl a Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka a sabi niŋ gbaŋ ni ŋɔ ka bɛn be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni wum. Karimi li ka Judanim bɛn zaa yi bɛ fɔntinsi ni na la gba wum.
en: So you go to the temple on the next day of fasting, and read the LORDs words from the scroll that I have dictated to you. Read them so that all the people in the temple can hear them, as well as all the Judeans who have come from their towns.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi.
en: Jesus answered, Not one of you knows what you are asking. Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from? James and John said, Yes, we are.

dag: Ti Duuma chɛ ka ti niŋ ya naani, ka mi ni yi niŋdi ti ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka kul ni niŋdi ti ni wuhi shɛm maa.
en: We are confident about you in the Lord—that you are doing and will keep doing what we tell you to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya, alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa, ninsalinim ni tooi nya di taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani, amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: Therefore, I tell you that people will be forgiven for every sin and insult to God. But insulting the Holy Spirit wont be forgiven.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: I beg you, then, to follow my example.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni gbiri binyara ŋubira;.
en: A large herd of pigs was eating on a hill near there.

dag: Ka niriba daa paɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gba daa saɣi zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ ni chaŋ ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla kum, amaa nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla nyɛvili mini suhudoo.
en: The attitude that comes from selfishness leads to death, but the attitude that comes from the Spirit leads to life and peace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani baabiɛla gba.
en: So they called them back in and told them that under no condition were they to speak or to teach in the name of Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛlishaaza daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ago kparibu na ti yɛli Daniɛl, ka bo salima dolibi din mali jilima na ti yɛl o pahi, ka chɛ ka o leei naa ŋun pah ata o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: Immediately Belshazzar ordered his servants to dress Daniel in a robe of royal purple and to hang a gold chain of honor around his neck. And he made him the third in power in the kingdom.

dag: Amaa n lihiya nya ka so kani. So ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira, ka n ni bɔh o bɔhigu ka o garigi.
en: I looked at those false gods. Not one of them said anything. They had no advice to offer. I asked them questions, but they didnt say a word.

dag: Di saha ka Amalɛknim mini Keenannim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi maa ni daa yina ti lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba n-kari ba hal ni Hɔrima.
en: The Amalekites and the Canaanites living in the hill country came down and attacked the Israelites and easily defeated them and chased them all the way to Hormah.

dag: Naa, ka n daa ti deei yiko maligumaaniba kpamba sani m-be soli chani Damaskus;.
en: It was for this purpose that I went to Damascus with authority and orders from the chief priests.

dag: Naawuni ni ti lu tiŋ maa zuɣu m-me bindura tabili di gooni gili.
en: I will put armies all around you, Ariel. I will raise war towers against you.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ, ka daa piig o biŋkɔbiri maa ni shɛb ni o ti o biɛli Iso.
en: After spending the night there, Jacob chose from his livestock as a present for his brother Esau: female goats and males, female sheep and males, milk camels with their young, cows and bulls, female donkeys and males.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: They filled twelve baskets with the leftover pieces of bread and fish.

dag: A mini bɛn zɔri bɛ naba zuɣu yi zɔri ka di wum a, wula ka a mini yuri ni tooi kpaɣi zo? Ka a yi ku zani viɛnyɛliŋga palo ni, wula ka a lee yɛn tooi zani viɛnyɛliŋga Jɔɔdɛn nyɔŋ puuni?.
en: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?.

dag: Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri pam kaman bɛ ni daa be Gibia la. Naawuni ni ti teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: They have corrupted themselves terribly as in the days of Gibeah; he will remember their wickedness; he will punish their sins.

dag: Amaa Rubin ni daa wum li, ka o fa o bɛ nuu ni ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka ti di o nyɛvili.
en: Reuben heard this and tried to protect Joseph from them. Let's not kill him, he said.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yihimi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zaɣ yiha kaman bɛ ni yihiri wain tia wala yiha shɛm la, ka lan zaŋ a nuhi doli di wula kaman wain tiwalipɔhira la.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: From top to bottom, let them harvest the remaining few in Israel. Pick clean every last grape on the vine!.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, N yilikpɛrinima, yi nya zahim? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai.
en: Then he said to them, Friends, have you caught any fish? They answered, No.

dag: Dindali maa yuntisuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti ku Ijipti bikpamba zaa. Firawuna ŋun daa ʒi o nam ni la bidib kpɛm daa kpiya, hal dansarika so ŋun daa be vol ni sarika ni bidibituuli gba daa kpiya zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi biŋkɔb dib shɛb zaa.
en: At midnight the Lord killed the first-born son of every Egyptian family, from the son of the king to the son of every prisoner in jail. He also killed the first-born male of every animal that belonged to the Egyptians.

dag: Ka yi yi bi pal alikauli ni so bini, ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ yimaŋmaŋ dini ni nyɛ shɛli tin ya?.
en: And if you have not been faithful with what belongs to someone else, who will give you what belongs to you?.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a so Tɛbis din baɣi Nail ka kom gil li, ka teeku nyɛ din taɣiri li ka kom nyɛ di gooni la?.
en: Nineveh, are you any better than Thebes, the capital of Egypt? She too had a river to protect her like a wall—the Nile was her defense.

dag: Dama Ahaz daa zaŋla Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni salima mini kpambaliba yinsi salima zaa chaŋ ti yo farigu Asiria naa sani, amaa ka di daa bi sɔŋ o.
en: Ahaz took some valuable things from the Lord s Temple and from the kings palace and from the princes house. Ahaz gave them to the king of Assyria, but that didnt help him.

dag: Ka Hilikia daa yɛli Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la, N nyala zaligu kundi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni; ka o daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan.
en: Hilkiah told the secretary Shaphan, I have found the Instruction scroll in the LORDs temple. Then Hilkiah turned the scroll over to Shaphan.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka o yɛri bɛn bala la mi, Timmiya tiŋ puuni dol o nyaaŋa ku niriba. Di yuliya yaɣi so zuɣu bee n-zo so nambɔɣu.
en: To the others he said in my hearing: Go through the city after him, and attack. Spare no one! Be merciless!.

dag: Nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuntialana, ka mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni ŋɔ, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri zan tariga, ka niŋ wuntizɔriba zaɣ viɛlli.
en: You are a righteous God and judge our thoughts and desires. Stop the wickedness of evildoers and reward those who are good.

dag: Ara daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinunaayi.
en: the descendants of Arah:.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ni bɛ boli ya karimbanima, dama karimba yino ka yi mali, ka yinim bɛn zaa kpalim nyɛla mabihi ni taba.
en: But you shouldnt be called Rabbi , because you have one teacher, and all of you are brothers and sisters.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia ni paɣ a, ka ku shini. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi kpi, bɛ tahima naaya; ka bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: When the wicked die, their hope dies with them. Confidence placed in riches comes to nothing.

dag: paɣimiy o cheechi ni.
en: to God be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus for all time, forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Shɔbal bia Reeya n-daa nyɛ Jahat ba, ka Jahat daa nyɛ Ahumai mini Lahad ba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Zɔranim zuliya.
en: Shobals son Reaiah was Jahaths father, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the Zorathite clans.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai tiŋ maa ni n-nya ka bɛ nyo li la buɣim, ka gbahi bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: When David and his men came to Ziklag, they saw the burned-out ruins and learned that their families had been taken captive.
