dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi na nti ti ba bidibbina ni bɛ yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba. Bɛ daa pirigila buyi dɔni kaman buhi biɛla la, amaa ka Siria tɔbbihi maa bɛn kul yɛrigila luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Israelites were called up and equipped; they marched out and camped in two groups facing the Syrians. The Israelites looked like two small flocks of goats compared to the Syrians, who spread out over the countryside.

dag: Ti ni daa yuui soli maa ni zuɣu ka barina daa ti yɛn paai ti, ka nolɔbo saha mi pun gari, ka Pool daa saɣisi ba yɛli.
en: By now we had already lost a lot of time, and sailing was no longer safe. In fact, even the Great Day of Forgiveness was past.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi niŋ Yawɛ ni ti ti binshɛŋa maa lala, dama ŋuna n-daa gul ti ka zaŋ ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa kana ti liri ti maa niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: David answered, No, my brothers. Dont do that! Think about what the Lord gave us. He let us defeat the enemy that attacked us.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kahigi yɛli Simiɔn ni o ku kpi faashee ka o nini ti nya ti Duuma ni daa lo ni o ni ti ba Masia so la.
en: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ba so shɛli din kuni tiŋ maa ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba maa daa kpe tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima. Amaa ka daa chɛ do so ŋun wuhi ba tiŋ maa soli maa min o malibu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So he showed them, and the people of Ephraim and Manasseh killed everyone in the city, except this man and his family.

dag: N nya mbusim ni be Izraɛl tiŋgban ni; Ifriimnim tum yolimyolim, ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma bi wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛna n-nyɛ laakuma mini soonsi ni ŋɔŋa, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa bɛ ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: But no animals may be eaten unless they have divided hoofs and also chew the cud. You may not eat camels, rabbits, or rock badgers. They must be considered unclean; they chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs.

dag: Teemiya n dabili Musa wuhibu la yɛla; n ni daa zal o zali kpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi Sinai Zoli gbini ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim zaa la.
en: Remember and obey the law of my servant Moses. I gave those laws and rules to him at Mount Horeb. They are for all the people of Israel.

dag: Di daba anahi dali ka bɛ daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-mali shili ni bɛ kuli, amaa ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛl o deemba maa, Ʒinimi suug a noli n-nya kpiɔŋ ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: When everyone got up on the fourth day, the Levite started getting ready to go home. But his father-in-law said, Don't leave until you have a bite to eat. You'll need strength for your journey.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yaha, Naawuni nam ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun chaŋ o puu ni nti ko m-biri bimbira.
en: Again Jesus said: God's kingdom is like what happens when a farmer scatters seed in a field.

dag: M mabihi, yi ni so yi ti birigi ka chɛ yɛlimaŋli la, ka so ŋmalig o labisi di ni.
en: My friends, if any of you wander away from the truth and another one brings you back again.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li mali sara maa Yawɛ tooni n-yo paɣa maa daalahichi samli, di nyaaŋa ka paɣa maa ni yi o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri maa ni. Zaligu ŋɔ gbibila paɣ so ŋunkam dɔɣi bia di yi nyɛla bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga.
en: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlila Sulemaana, M bia, m pun lo n suhu ni ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jilima.
en: David said to Solomon, My son, I wanted to build a temple for the name of the Lord my God.

dag: A ni ti baŋ ni n wum a turi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa a ni tɔɣisiri turi Izraɛl zoya yɛra, Di kpalimla dabari doya. Bɛ zaŋ li ti ti ni ti va li.
en: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa chaŋ ti to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm puɣisi gbaai Yisa o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: The Pharisees got together and planned how they could trick Jesus into saying something wrong.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa tiligi ya nimaani; dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ maa.
en: Remember, you were poor slaves in Egypt. And the Lord your God took you from that place and set you free. That is why I tell you to do these things for the poor.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni suhukpeeni yɛli, Di di simdi ni Naawuni yɛligu ŋɔ daŋ tɔɣisila yi sani, amaa yi ni daa li bahi ka tɛhi ni yi bi simdi nyɛvili din ka bahigu zuɣu, nyamiya, ti ni chɛn ya ka chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: But Paul and Barnabas spoke very boldly. They said, We had to tell Gods message to you Jews first, but you refuse to listen. You have made it clear that you are not worthy of having eternal life. So we will now go to those who are not Jews.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dabili bi gar o duuma; tumo mi bi gari ŋun tim o.
en: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.

dag: Dama mɔɣu ni ka o daa nya o, ka bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti doo maa daa naan tooi kuhi ni bɛ sɔŋ o, amaa so daa kani ŋun ni fa o bahi.
en: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.

dag: ka nyo bɛ naawuna buɣim, bɛn dee pala naawun maŋa, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpe da shɛŋa ni kuɣ shɛŋa, dina n-chɛ ka o daa saɣim ba maa.
en: The Assyrians burned the gods of those nations with fire because they arent real gods. They are only man-made creations of wood and stone. Thats how the Assyrians could destroy them.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilis a tibili wum n kuhigu. Di nya n kumsi nintam ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu. N leela saan garito a sani, ka nyɛ sochanda kaman n yaannim la.
en: Hear my prayer, Lord , and listen to my cry; come to my aid when I weep. Like all my ancestors I am only your guest for a little while.

dag: N yɛr a mi, Yiɣisim zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be teeku puuni daa sɔhigimi a ni daa lu dahin shɛli maa, ka di gari ba a ni daa naai shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Now the wastelands tremble on the day of your fall. Your expulsion horrifies the islands of the sea.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa: Bɛnya kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bela kasi.
en: to say to the community of Israel, Be holy, because I, the Lord your God, am holy.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn pa lala, bɛ ŋmanila wurigu shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri bahira.
en: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.

dag: Yi ni ti tuuri wuntaŋ ni, ka anabinim pahi yi zuɣu ka yi tuuri yuŋ. N ni saɣim yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Night and day you blunder on, and the prophets do no better than you. I am going to destroy Israel, your mother.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ daba la, deemiya yi duumanim noya ka luri ba sizuura zaa, ka di pala bɛn niŋdi nirilim ka mali biɛribaalimtali la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili bɛn mali hal biɛɣu la gba.
en: You servants must submit yourselves to your masters and show them complete respect, not only to those who are kind and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hiram daa ti Sulemaana sida mini Sipirɛs dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa o ni daa bɔra.
en: So Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar and pinewood that he wanted.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Bɛtani dahin shɛli ka o wum ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Lazarɔs daba anahi dali m-bala.
en: Jesus arrived in Bethany and found that Lazarus had already been dead and in the tomb for four days.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ba Yaakubu sani.
en: They left Egypt and went back home to their father Jacob in Canaan.

dag: Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni kpiimba bi neeri kum ni, dindina Naawuni daa bi neei Masia kum ni m-bala, ka ti gba leei bɛn ŋma ʒiri pa Naawuni, dama ti pun di Naawuni shɛhira ni o daa neei Masia kum ni.
en: More than that, we are shown to be lying about God, because we said that he raised Christ from death—but if it is true that the dead are not raised to life, then he did not raise Christ.

dag: ni Giliad ni Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tiŋgban la ni Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ ti paai Salɛka.
en: It also included Gilead and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan as far as Salecah.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna, ka Balaam daa yɛl o, M me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaa zuɣu.
en: God came to Balaam at that place, and Balaam said, I have prepared seven altars. And I have killed a bull and a ram as a sacrifice on each altar.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa daa niŋ ba mi n-leei yɛliŋmahima, ka di sabi zali tinim bɛn be ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ni wuhibu zuɣu.
en: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma ni yɛlimaŋli ni ʒiɛyimtali a suhu ni kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpana la ni n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zaa.
en: As for you, if you walk before me just as your father David did, with complete dedication and honesty, and if you do all that I have commanded, and keep my regulations and case laws.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim kari ninvuɣ biɛri zibisim bahi, ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ bɔɣu shɛli duhi zuɣusaa kabi.
en: The light of day is too bright for the wicked and restrains them from doing violence.

dag: O bela tampima shee, ka zaŋ tampin choya zuɣusaa leeg o yiŋa.
en: It lives high on a peak at the top of a cliff. That is its fortress.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama n niŋ ya naani zaa.
en: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.

dag: Amaa ka Zimiri ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin so ŋun su o chɛchɛbunsi pirigili fukumsi la daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo. Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛla daa ti chaŋ Tiriza, do so ŋun yuli booni Ariza ka o su nayili fukumsi la yiŋa nti nyu dam kuli.
en: Zimri commanded half of Elah's chariots, and he made plans to kill Elah. One day, Elah was in Tirzah, getting drunk at the home of Arza, his prime minister.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Mariama sani m-maar o suhu la ni daa nya ka o yiɣisi yomyom yiri maa ka bɛ gba yiɣisi dol o, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o chanila gballi maa gbini ni o ti kum.
en: The Jews who were in the house comforting Mary saw her get up and leave quickly. They thought she was going to the tomb to cry there. So they followed her.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, To, cham a chandi! A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa. Ka o nina maa daa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chana.
en: Go, Jesus told him, your faith has made you well. At once he was able to see and followed Jesus on the road.

dag: O chanila kum shee, o ni doli so shɛli kunila kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.

dag: N kul ni niŋdi n ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka bɛn yɛli ni ti mini ba dolila so yini n-tumdi la ku nya daliri nyu bara.
en: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.

dag: Dina ka n dan mali nyuri kom, ka lan mal li nyar ashilɔni yɛla. Yi ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi tum taali. .
en: My master drinks from that cup, and he uses it to learn secret things. What you did was wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Anabi Neetan be kpe. Ka Neetan daa kpe naa sani nti damd o tooni n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa;.
en: The king was told that the prophet was there, and Nathan went in and bowed low before the king.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa wumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: It isnt the ones who hear the Law who are righteous in Gods eyes. It is the ones who do what the Law says who will be treated as righteous.

dag: Ka n yi chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti kuri ba, ka di leei dabari, ka so ku lan gari nimaani biŋkɔb biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Or suppose I allow wild animals to roam through the land, and it becomes so wild that no one can live there or even travel through it on account of the wild animals.

dag: Yɛm ŋɔ tatabo bi yirila alizanda ni na, amaa di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ mini daadamtali biɛhigu ni Sintani dini.
en: Such wisdom does not come down from heaven; it belongs to the world, it is unspiritual and demonic.

dag: A biɛli n-nyɛ Samaria ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nuzaa polo la, ka a tizo nyɛ Sɔdom ŋun min o bipuɣinsi be a nudirigu polo la.
en: Your older sister was Samaria. She lived to the north of you with her daughters. Your younger sister was Sodom. She lived to the south of you with her daughters.

dag: Bɛ yi daai bɛ zuɣulaannim tampima zuɣu luhina, di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli.
en: Their leaders will fall from jagged cliffs, but my words will be heard because they are pleasing.

dag: Di simdi ka yi dɔbba zaa laɣindi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ tooni buta yuuni puuni.
en: Every year at these three festivals all your men must come to worship me, the Lord your God.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛli din nyɛ Saimɔn din ni, ka balim o ni o tirisim li zal o tooni biɛla. Ka o daa ʒini ŋariŋ maa ni wuhiri niriba maa.
en: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon. He asked Simon to push off a little from the shore. Then he sat down in the boat and taught the people on the shore.

dag: Yisa ni daa be Jɛrusalɛm Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha maa, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda bɛ nini ni daa nya shihir shɛŋa o ni wuhi la zuɣu.
en: In Jerusalem during Passover many people put their faith in Jesus, because they saw him work miracles.

dag: Amaa Azazɛl kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la ŋuna o ni ti zaŋ o la zaɣ nɛɔŋ ti Yawɛ n-yo bɛ daalahichi samli, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi mɔɣu ni nti ti Azazɛl.
en: But the goat selected by Azazels lot will be left standing alive before the LORD in order to make reconciliation upon it by sending it away into the wilderness to Azazel.

dag: A ni daa wum shɛli n sani shɛhiranim pam ninni la, zaŋm li tom wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ka nyɛ bɛn gba ni tooi zaŋ li wuhi bɛ tab la.
en: Take the teachings that you heard me proclaim in the presence of many witnesses, and entrust them to reliable people, who will be able to teach others also.

dag: Bɛ muɣisigu maa saha, bɛ ni ti nya sɔŋsim biɛla, hal ka niriba pam ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali bɛ ni la yɔhiŋgu zuɣu.
en: When those wise people are punished, they will receive some help, but many people who join them will be hypocrites.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbaai nyin Pashihur mini bɛn be a yiŋ zaa daba n-zaŋ ya kuli Babilɔn, ka a min a zɔnim zaa ti kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣi ya nimaani. A zɔnim shɛba a ni yi tɔɣisiri ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la.
en: And you, Pashhur, and all those in your household, will go into captivity. You will be deported to Babylon where you will die. There you will be buried with all your friends to whom you prophesied falsely.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ɛhud daa yi zɔntua maa ni na ka vooi di dunoya yo n-kpari li pa o zuɣu.
en: Then Ehud went out of the private room, closed the doors to the upper room, and locked the king inside.

dag: N kul tɔɣisirimi kaman yinyaa n-nyɛ ma la. Bɛ nyɛla Masia tumtumdiba? N nyɛla Masia tumtumda gari ba: N tum pam gari ba gba; bɛ kpɛhi ma sarika n-gari ba: n nya buri din ka kalinli; ka be kum barina ni waawaayili.
en: Are they ministers of Christ? Im speaking like a crazy person. What Ive done goes well beyond what theyve done. Ive worked much harder. Ive been imprisoned much more often. Ive been beaten more times than I can count. Ive faced death many times.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali salima bintaɣindisi ayi mini salima bans ayi, ka zaŋ salima bans ayi maa goli gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya.
en: They made two gold settings and two gold rings and attached the two rings to the upper corners of the breastpiece.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa daadambiɛligu nabi, ka niriba ʒini yi fɔntinsi ni, ka yi lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: I will populate you with human beings, the whole house of Israel, all of them. The cities will be inhabited, the ruins rebuilt.

dag: yi yi ni po Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ ni yi ni gbibi yɛlimaŋli, ka doli zaligu ni wuntitali, dindina o ni niŋ alibarika niŋ zuliya shɛb ni yi zuɣu, ka bɛ ti mal o nyuri bara.
en: and if you swear by the living God in truth, justice, and righteousness, then the nations will enjoy Gods blessings; they will boast about him.

dag: Bɛ kali ma pahila kpiimba ni; n ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka sɔŋsim.
en: People already treat me like a dead man, like someone too weak to live.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yisa m-bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o.
en: So Joseph took it, wrapped it in a new linen sheet.

dag: Ka so yi yɛli ni o yuri Naawuni ka je o mabia, o nyɛla ʒirilana; dama ŋunkam bi yur o mabi so o nini ni nyari ku tooi yuri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o ni bi nyari so la.
en: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri, n mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jesus told him: You can be sure that anyone who gives up home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or land for me and for the good news.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili pam puuni n ni ti bɔhi zuliya shɛb bɛn bi deei n noli biɛri.
en: And in my great anger I will take revenge on all nations that have not obeyed me.

dag: Hiburu paɣ yi lan yɛn dɔɣi ka yi chaŋ ni yi ti deei bia, ka nya ka bia maa nyɛla bidibiga, yin kumiy o, amaa di yi nyɛ bipuɣiŋga, yin chɛliy o.
en: You will continue to help the Hebrew women give birth to their children. If a girl baby is born, let the baby live. But if the baby is a boy, you must kill him.

dag: O chɛ ka suhudoo be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka zaŋ alikama viɛlli dihiri ya.
en: God establishes your borders peacefully. God fills you full with the very best wheat.

dag: Mɔabnim mbusim nyabu saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha paari yomyom.
en: Moabs destruction is near; its downfall approaches rapidly.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman kuɣ tibisili la, ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti bɔri ni bɛ kpuɣ li ni nya yɛlli. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini kana ni bɛ ti liri li.
en: On that day I will make Jerusalem into a heavy stone for all the peoples. All who carry it will hurt themselves; nevertheless, the nations of the earth will conspire against it.

dag: Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ka ka binshɛli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di saha maa o daa ti ba wain tihi puri mini pu shɛŋa pahi.
en: Only the poorest people who owned no land were left behind in Judah, and Nebuzaradan gave them fields and vineyards.

dag: M puhiri cheechi shɛli din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ la gba. M puhiri n zo suŋ Ɛpainɛtus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa daŋ niŋ Masia yɛda Ɛsha la.
en: Greetings also to the church that meets in their house. Greetings to my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first in the province of Asia to believe in Christ.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n daa zaŋla n kpiɔŋ zaa niŋ gooni maa mɛbu tuma ni. Ka n tumtumdiba zaa daa laɣim nimaani tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma. N daa bi gbaai mmaŋmaŋ palo.
en: Instead, I devoted myself to the work on this wall. We acquired no land, and all my servants were gathered there for the work.

dag: Dindali maa yi zaa ni ti zaŋ yi daanzinfa buɣa mini salima buɣa din nyɛ yi nuhi ni tum alahichi m-malila labi.
en: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.

dag: Di ŋmanila yu biɛɣu m-be n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n dimnim maani ma ansarisi, ka kul bɔhiri ma, ka a Naawuni maa lee be ya?.
en: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, Where is your God.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa be nimaani maa ka anab so ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa yi Judia na.
en: After we had been there for several days, a prophet named Agabus came from Judea.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli, kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya, amaa ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma, hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi; ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi mini buɣim baptaizi ya.
en: John said, I am just baptizing with water. But someone more powerful is going to come, and I am not good enough even to untie his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

dag: Bɛ ni laɣindi piriŋkpana nyɔri buɣim shɛm la, lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali.
en: Just as people gather weeds and burn them in the fire, so it will be at the end of the present age.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la mini bɛnkam zaa je ma la nuu ni bahi; dama bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari ma.
en: God saved me from my powerful enemy, saved me from my foes, who were too much for me.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi teeku la tula yuŋ maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim n-chɛ ka Lɛviatan suhu yiɣisir la.
en: Tell the sorcerers to curse that day, those who know how to control Leviathan.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣiri bihi maa buɣira, ka zaŋd o nuhi pari bɛ zuɣu niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni.
en: Then Jesus held the children in his arms. He laid his hands on them and blessed them.

dag: N ni ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro zaɣa, ka paɣiba pia ni ti mali yi bɔrɔbɔro dubil yini puuni, ka ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro maa tibisim, ka yi ti ŋub li ka bi tiɣi.
en: I will give you a share of the grain left in that city. But there will be very little food to eat. Ten women will be able to cook all their bread in one oven. They will measure each piece of bread. You will eat, but you will still be hungry.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa nya o ŋahiba Leeban bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl mini ŋun Leeban piɛri maa, o daa chaŋmi ti paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli ka ŋɔŋ kom ti o ŋahiba Leeban piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: Rachel was Labans daughter. Laban was the brother of Rebekah, Jacobs mother. When Jacob saw Rachel, he went and moved the rock and gave water to the sheep.

dag: N zaŋla n nina kpa a jɛmbu duu la, ka gbani paɣ a yuli a yurilim maŋli la min a ʒiɛyimtali la zuɣu, dama a duh a yuli min a yɛligu gari shɛlikam.
en: I bow down toward your holy Temple, and I praise your name for your love and loyalty. You are famous, and doing what you promised will make you even more famous!.

dag: Ka o daa lan nya ka Yaakubu deeg o ba min o ma noli ka shiri kuli Mɛsopoteemia.
en: and that Jacob had listened to his father and mother and gone to Paddan-aram.

dag: Wula ka ti lee ni yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma so zuliya ni ti ni yila na yɛla?.
en: Well then, what can we say about our ancestor Abraham?.

dag: N ni niŋ Ɛhab yiŋnim kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim mini Ahija bia Baasha yiŋnim shɛm la.
en: I will make Ahabs dynasty like the dynasty of Jeroboam, Nebats son, and like the dynasty of Baasha, Ahijahs son.

dag: ka yɛli, N dana, a nini yi tiɣi ma, yin zanim mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani.
en: He said, Sirs, if you would be so kind, dont just pass by your servant.

dag: Di kul simdi ni ti chaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi nti mali sara maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa kaman o ni zali ti shɛm maa.
en: We need to go for a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God as he has ordered us.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a labi tiŋgban ni; palɔni ka n ti yɛn zaŋ a bahi, ka chɛ ka noonsi zaa kana ti lu a zuɣu, ka dunia zaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dari tɔh a ŋubi.
en: I will cast you out on the earth and throw you on the open ground. I will cause all the birds in the sky to settle on you, and all the beasts of the earth to devour you.

dag: Ka yi ti mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di li nimaani, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: And you must sacrifice and eat fellowship offerings there. Eat and enjoy yourselves there together with the Lord your God.

dag: Teemiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla, ka teei o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni daa kari saria shɛm yɛla.
en: Remember the wondrous works he has done, all his marvelous works, and the justice he declared.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-kari alizin biɛri maa, ka tib ŋunkam daa biɛra.
en: That evening people brought to Jesus many people who had demons inside them. He spoke and the demons left the people. He healed all those who were sick.

dag: ni Tiriza naa, ka bɛ zaa kalinli yiɣisi nanim pihita ni yini.
en: the king of Tirzah one.

dag: Ka bɛ daa neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti! Ka o neei n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: So they went and woke Jesus, shouting, Master, Master, were going to drown! But he got up and gave orders to the wind and the violent waves. The storm died down and it was calm.

dag: Ka Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia nira, ka nyɛ yuun pihiyɔbunaayi nir la daa deei nam maa di.
en: A man named Darius the Mede became the new king. Darius was about years old.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, ka pumpɔŋɔ man na yɛn pahi ya la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi leei barazim saɣisiri ya.
en: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal.

dag: Yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Tiligim ti a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu!.
en: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.

dag: O daa bi bo sɔŋsim maa Yawɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ku o, ka zaŋ o nam maa ti Jɛsi bia Dauda.
en: instead of consulting the Lord . So the Lord killed him and gave control of the kingdom to David son of Jesse.

dag: Naawuni daa yɛl o, A yuli Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ku lan boli Yaakubu; a yuli yɛn boonila Izraɛl. Dinzuɣu ka o yuli booni Izraɛl maa.
en: and said to him, Your name is Jacob, but I will change that name. You will no longer be called Jacob. Your new name will be Israel. So God named him Israel.

dag: Di ni tilig a zaɣ biɛɣu ni, ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: and prevent you from doing the wrong thing. They will keep you away from people who stir up trouble by what they say—.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tɔbbihi tuhi pinaayi n-lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa ŋɔ sa niŋ bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ biɛɣuni yaha; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ sa zaŋ Haman bidibisi pia la ti yili dari.
en: Esther answered, If it please Your Majesty, let the Jews in Susa do again tomorrow what they were allowed to do today. And have the bodies of Haman's ten sons hung from the gallows.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina zaashee ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuma zuɣu la n-ka yi sanna.
en: These men have risked their lives for our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛtɛl. M bɔri ni m mɛla bimbini nimaani zali Naawuni so ŋun daa deei n suhigu n nandahima nyabu dali, ka be n sani n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam la.
en: Afterwards, we'll go to Bethel. I will build an altar there for God, who answered my prayers when I was in trouble and who has always been at my side.

dag: dama n ni ti tin ya yɛm ni noli ka yi dimnim ti ku tooi tɔɣisi luhi ya bee n-tooi garigi yi bɔhigu.
en: I will give you the wisdom to say things that none of your enemies can answer.

dag: Dama a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ, biɛɣuni n sa ni tahi toli a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na.
en: If you refuse to let my people go, then tomorrow I will bring locusts into your country.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab maa daa ti yɛl o, Ti nya ti Duuma. Amaa ka o yɛli ba, Ka pa ni man ti nya o nuhi ni kpahi bɔba la, ka zaŋ n nubil bɔbili kpahi maa bɔba maa ni, ka zaŋ n nuu tim o puluɣili la bɔbili la ni, n ku niŋ yɛda.
en: They told him, We saw the Lord. Thomas said, Thats hard to believe. I will have to see the nail holes in his hands, put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side. Only then will I believe it.

dag: N timd a la bɛ sani ni a ti neei bɛ nina ka bɛ yi zibisim ni kpe neesim ni, ka yi Sintani nuu ni kpe Naawuni nuu ni n-nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka nya zaashee Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sunsuuni bɛ ni niŋ man Yisa yɛda zuɣu. .
en: You are to open their eyes and turn them from the darkness to the light and from the power of Satan to God, so that through their faith in me they will have their sins forgiven and receive their place among God's chosen people.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ata, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ata yɛli, Kamina! Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr sabinli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi sania o nuu ni.
en: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, Come out! Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn nyu shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo. Nyɛvili bi gari bindirigu ka niŋgbuŋ mi bi gari situra?.
en: Therefore, I say to you, dont worry about your life, what youll eat or what youll drink, or about your body, what youll wear. Isnt life more than food and the body more than clothes?.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi chɛ ka m mɔɣisi n yaansi maa mini m bipuɣinsi maa kparima n-chɛbisi ba? A tum gala.
en: You did not even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters good-bye. That was a foolish thing to do!.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya nia nyɛla nia biɛri, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila buɣim nyoori niriba.
en: Evil people look for ways to harm others; even their words burn with evil.

dag: O daa nya o la tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka lan nya o tiŋgban nɛli din ka buchi ni. O leei bintaɣirigu taɣ o. O gul o mi kaman o nimbil biɛlim la.
en: The Lord found them in the desert, in an empty, windy land. He surrounded them and watched over them. He protected them like the pupil of his eye.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋmi bia ŋɔ kuli ti wubis o ti ma ka n yo a. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa kuli ti wubis o.
en: Pharaohs daughter said to her, Take this child and nurse it for me, and Ill pay you for your work. So the woman took the child and nursed it.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o bɔh o nyaandoliba, Niriba lee yɛri ni Daadam Bia nyɛla ŋuni.
en: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, What do people say about the Son of Man.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya n-daa pah ata n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Sarid.
en: The next tribe to get their land was Zebulun. Each family in Zebulun got the land that was promised to them. The border of Zebulun went as far as Sarid.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ti tooi biŋkuma sara maligu maa zim viɛlli nukurigu pali mini di kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim din be biŋkuma sara maligu maa ni nti nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu n-yihi di chihili maa, ka di leei din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: There must be some oil and frankincense on the grain offering. The priest will take a handful of fine flour from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as a sweet-smelling memorial offering to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Zarai daa yɛli Ibram, N ʒiɛmbu ŋɔ taali ʒi a zuɣu. Mani n-zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti a, ka o ti nya ka o mali pua, ka lihi ʒiɛm ma. Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a.
en: Then Sarai said to Abram, It's all your fault! I gave you my slave woman, but she has been hateful to me ever since she found out she was pregnant. You have done me wrong, and you will have to answer to the Lord for this.

dag: A sani ka n ni paɣir a shɛm yirina a niriba laɣiŋgu tital ni; ka n ni mali n ni pun po pɔri ni m mali sara shɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura sani la.
en: I offer praise in the great congregation because of you; I will fulfill my promises in the presence of those who honor God.

dag: Di yuuni maa puuni, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni, ka anabi Hanania daa shiri kpi.
en: Two months later, Hananiah died.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya, ka wain dii bi lan nyara, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli liɣi ʒini.
en: The grapevines wither, and wine is becoming scarce. Everyone who was once happy is now sad.

dag: Ka Naomi daa kpuɣi bia maa ʒil o naba zuɣu m-mal o.
en: Naomi took the child and held him to her breast, and she became his guardian.

dag: ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni yɛli ni yi daa dɔɣi yi bi so zom la m-bɔŋɔ? Di yi nyɛla ŋuna, ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: and asked them, Is this your son? You say that he was born blind; how is it, then, that he can now see.

dag: N labirila a sanna pumpɔŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n ni na be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ, ni n suhupiɛlli pali bɛ suhuri ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: And now I am coming to you, and I say these things in the world so that they might have my joy in their hearts in all its fullness.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m piɛma varim ʒim. N ni chɛ ka n takɔbi ŋmahi n ni ku shɛba mini n ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb nimdi mini ʒim din yi n dimnim bɛn nyɛ zab wɔɣilanim la ni na.
en: My arrows will drip with their blood, and my sword will kill all who oppose me. I will spare no one who fights against me; even the wounded and prisoners will die.

dag: Di saha ka o kuhi yɛli, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda nyaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: He cried out, Jesus! Son of David! Have mercy on me.

dag: N dabisa pala biɛla? Chɛli ma ka n suhu maai biɛla.
en: My life is almost finished. So leave me alone! Let me enjoy the little time I have left.

dag: Ka bɛn la mi bi yihiri Masia yɛla waazu ni tɛhi suma, amaa ka niŋdi li mi ni nyuli zabbu tɛha, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yi niŋdi lala di ni chɛ ka n wahaladibo maan pahi n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: The others do not proclaim Christ sincerely, but from a spirit of selfish ambition; they think that they will make more trouble for me while I am in prison.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli Chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ nya zuɣusuŋ a sani. Di saha ka Hanna daa kuli ti di ka nyu, ka daa bi lan mali suhugarigu.
en: May you always think kindly of me, she replied. Then she went away, ate some food, and was no longer sad.

dag: Ka Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir maa daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Aijalɔn Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni.
en: before he died and was buried in Aijalon that belonged to the Zebulun tribe.

dag: A yi ka binshɛli din ni zaŋ yo, bɛ ni kpuɣi a bindoo chaŋ ka chɛ a.
en: If you cant repay, why should they be able to take your bed from you?.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya guŋgombihi n-wa waa paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi yuhi paɣ o.
en: Praise him with tambourines and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flutes!.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, chɛ ka n sɔŋsim bɔbu kuhigu ŋɔ paag a.
en: I pray to you, Lord ! Please listen.

dag: Ti chamiya ʒiishee ka yi ti wuhi ma yi ni zaŋ ma taali shɛli zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi tɔɣisi wuhi ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli na.
en: But you should remember me. Lets meet together and decide what is right. Tell your story and prove that you are innocent.

dag: A daa zaŋ a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi shɛba a ni daa dɔɣi ti ma la m-mal a buɣa maa ni bɛ ŋubi, ka di be kaman a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli maa nyɛla yɛlibil la.
en: But you did something even worse than that—you sacrificed your own children to those idols!.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, M bihi, n ku lan yuui yi sani. Yi ni ti bo ma kɔŋ; n ni daa yɛli Yɛhudianim shɛm la, lala ka n yɛri yi gba maa, n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: My children, I shall not be with you very much longer. You will look for me; but I tell you now what I told the Jewish authorities, You cannot go where I am going.

dag: Sool ni daa nya Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o suhu fuŋ pam.
en: Saul saw the Philistine army, and he was afraid. His heart pounded with fear.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba. Ti yab Ibrahimma ʒi ti, ka Yaakubu gba bi mi ti. Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti ba, ka a yuli nyɛ ti Tiligira kurimbuni ha.
en: Look, you are our father! Abraham does not know us. Israel does not recognize us. Lord , you are our father! You are the one who has always saved us!.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses did as the Lord commanded.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ jintɔriba la daa laɣim n-zaŋ Yisa tahi bɛ jina tɔbu shee ti yɛl o.
en: When day came, the elders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law met together, and Jesus was brought before the Council.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmahim do so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai do so yoli, o bi simdi ni bɛ deeg o niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No man whose testicles are crushed or whose penis is cut off can belong to the LORDs assembly.

dag: m-booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti chani bɛ chandi shee.
en: She shouts to everyone who passes by.

dag: Musa daa sabi bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini yuya sɔŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:.

dag: Gaad zuliya mini bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zɛfɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛfɔnnima; ka Hagi daŋ niriba nyɛ Haginima; ka Shuni daŋ niriba nyɛ Shuninima.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Gad; they were from the clans of Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ozni, Eri, Arod, and Areli.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-daa zali ni Izraɛlnim zaŋm li tiri ba dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni la. Di nyɛla zaligu din kul yɛn beni bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: On that day the Lord commanded the people of Israel to give them this part of the offering. It is a regulation that the people of Israel must obey for all time to come.

dag: Ka Musa daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani, ka boli di yuli, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nasara tuuta.
en: Moses built an altar and named it The Lord Gives Me Victory.

dag: nti gbaag o nuu ka yɛl o, Talita kumi! Di gbinni nyɛla, Bipuɣiŋga, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: He took her by the hand and said to her, Talitha, koum, which means, Little girl, I tell you to get up.

dag: Laabira salo ŋɔ ʒi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, lala zuɣu Naawuni noli ni di ba.
en: No, only this crowd, which doesnt know the Law. And they are under Gods curse.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔshua sani Giligal sansani la ni nti yɛl o mini Izraɛlnima. Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na ni ti mini ya ti lo tab alikauli.
en: Then they went to the camp of the Israelites. This camp was near Gilgal. The men went to Joshua and said to him, We have traveled from a faraway country. We want to make a peace agreement with you.

dag: N ni daa be yi sani ka ti lan ka shɛl la, n daa bi zaŋ n yɛla doli yi ni so, dama m mabi shɛb bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na la daa ti ma n ni kɔŋ shɛli maa. Dinzuɣu n daa bi zaŋ n yɛla doli yi ni so, ka na kul ku zaŋ n yɛla doli ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: If I needed something when I was with you, I did not trouble any of you. The brothers who came from Macedonia gave me all that I needed. I did not allow myself to be a burden to you in any way. And I will never be a burden to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Ribɛka na nti bɔh o, A ni doli doo ŋɔ chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni dol o chaŋ.
en: They called Rebekah and said to her, Will you go with this man? She said, I will go.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: But Pharaoh again became stubborn and did not let the people go.

dag: Ka pirigibu buyi zuɣu bɛn bi kanna tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali la mi ni guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya niriba maa ka bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: The Lord said to Moses, I have seen these people, and I know that they are very stubborn. They will always turn against me.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm Chɛdolaoma la yuun pinaayi, amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pinaata la ni ka bɛ daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku lan jɛm o.
en: They had been under the control of Chedorlaomer for twelve years, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled against him.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, benya kaman mani, dama n gba bemi kaman yinima. Yi bi tum ma taali.
en: I beg you, my friends, be like me. After all, I am like you. You have not done me any wrong.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni zaligu bela bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi sarigiri bɛ napɔna yaabu ni.
en: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa ni labina ti tuhi tiŋ ŋɔ nima. Bɛ ni tuhi deei li, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: Then the Babylonians will return and attack Jerusalem, and this time they will capture the city and set it on fire.

dag: A me a yili tamla zuɣusaa kom zuɣu, ka zaŋ sagbana leeg a chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ba pɔhim kpiŋkpama.
en: You built your home above them. You use the thick clouds like a chariot and ride across the sky on the wings of the wind.

dag: ka di pa ni yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli kaman bɛn bi doli Naawuni zaligu ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi bɛn nyɛ n suhu ni kul ye shɛb nyabu zuɣu la, yinima n-nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka m mali suhupiɛlli, ka nyuri bara yi zuɣu. M mabiyurisi, bamiya zani viɛnyɛliŋga ti Duuma ni!.
en: Therefore, my brothers and sisters whom I love and miss, who are my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord. Loved ones.

dag: Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ Aduna daŋ ni toondan la min o nyaaŋa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaata ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: also Jehoiada, leader of Aarons line, and with him .

dag: Bɛ yi kuhi boli ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni saɣi. Bɛ yi suhiri ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: Even before they finish praying to me, I will answer their prayers.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali mali di buɣim saligbabirisi mini di buɣim moorisi.
en: Make its tongs and trays of pure gold.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi Ɛlamnim bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba sani. N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yɛlibiɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni chɛ ka tɔbu lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n ti kpihim bɛ birili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their armies will crush and kill you, and you will face the disaster that my anger brings.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ mi bɛ yudua mini bɛ barikuma nyubu ni bɛ ʒiri tuma yɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , know of their arrogance. Their boasts amount to nothing, and the things they do will not last.

dag: Jɛshua min o bidibisi ni o dɔɣiriba ni Kadimiɛl min o bidibisi ni Binnui mini Hɔdavia nti pahi Hɛnadad bidibisi ni Lɛvinim mini bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa laɣim su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tumtumdiba fukumsi.
en: These were the men who supervised the work of building the Lord s Temple: Jeshua and his sons, Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Henadad and their brothers, the Levites.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom bɛ ni dooi olivi kpa shɛli din nyɛ alali na nti niŋdi firilanim maa puuni din ni chɛ ka firilanim maa diri saha shɛlikam.
en: Command the Israelites to bring to you pure oil from crushed olives. That oil is for the lamps that must burn without stopping.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Zaŋm a kabɔɣili ŋɔ palo ŋɔ ti ma ka m me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, kɔhimi li ti ma kaman di daa ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ miligi ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: David said to him, Sell me your threshing place, so that I can build an altar to the Lord , to stop the epidemic. I'll give you the full price.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni booni do so Yisa la n-gari taŋkpaɣu n-zaŋ ʒe n nina maa, ka yɛli ma ni n cham Sailom biaŋ la ni nti paɣi n nina maa. Ka n chaŋ ti paɣi, ka n nina maa dii neei.
en: He answered, The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. Then he told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went there and washed. And then I could see.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya n-daa pah ayi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa bela Juda zuliya tiŋgban ni.
en: The second lot fell to Simeon. The legacy of the clans of the Simeonite tribe lay inside the legacy of the people of Judah.

dag: Yi nyuri bari yɛra, Ti nyɛla tiŋ kasi la tiŋbihi, ka zaŋ timaŋ dalim Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: And yet you are proud to say that you are citizens of the holy city and that you depend on Israel's God, whose name is the Lord Almighty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani n-nya luɣ shɛli ʒini ni bɛ gbe Gibia, dama so daa bi zaŋ ba ti kpɛh o yiŋa ni bɛ gbe.
en: They left the road and went into Gibeah. But the Levite couldn't find a house where anyone would let them spend the night, and they sat down in the open area just inside the town gates.

dag: Ka naa daa kpuɣ o salima jaaŋgbee la tir o.
en: Then the king held out the gold scepter to Esther. Esther got up and stood in front of the king.

dag: Naa Dauda maa zuliya ni ka Naawuni daa ti Izraɛlnim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ Yisa kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la.
en: As he promised, God has brought one of Davids descendants to Israel to be their Savior. That descendant is Jesus.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam. Di simdi ni ti lur o sizuura gari wuna zaa.
en: The Lord is great and is to be highly praised; he is to be honored more than all the gods.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai naa maa n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn naa sani Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka o ti di o saria.
en: They arrested the king and brought him before the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath. And he pronounced sentence on him.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi bi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ gbinni? Ka wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahi shɛŋa din kpalim la gbinni?.
en: Then Jesus said to the followers, Do you understand this story? If you dont, how will you understand any story?.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn sabi alikauli shɛli ti a la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ di yɔrigu maa yo di noli.
en: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.

dag: Yawɛ, di yi nyɛla a dimnima, a dimnim maa ni ti kpi; ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa ti wurim.
en: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi nimaani m-bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra.
en: Some teachers of the Law who were sitting there thought to themselves.

dag: faashee n ni daa ti chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka n naanyi baŋ bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: until I entered Gods sanctuary and understood what would happen to the wicked.

dag: Amaa ka kɔnyuri daa wum ba pam nimaani, ka bɛ ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka a yihi ti Ijipti na ni kɔnyuri ti ku ti mini ti bihi ni ti biŋkɔbiri.
en: But the people were very thirsty for water there, and they complained to Moses, Why did you bring us out of Egypt to kill us, our children, and our livestock with thirst.

dag: Yawɛ kpihim a saria karibu la, ka kar a dimnima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, di lan zɔriya barina shɛli dabiɛm yaha.
en: The Lord has stopped your punishment; he has removed all your enemies. The Lord , the king of Israel, is with you; there is no reason now to be afraid.

dag: Anabinim bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni yi ka yi sanna ti wuhi ya shihirili bee alahiziba tuun shɛli.
en: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu ti ku nya nambɔzɔbo saria karibu puuni; amaa ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ti di nasara saria karibu puuni.
en: For God will not show mercy when he judges the person who has not been merciful; but mercy triumphs over judgment.

dag: Yɛlim do kura la ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali yɛm, ka doli wuhibu maŋli, ka mali yurilim, ka nyɛ bɛn mal ania yɛda niŋbu ni.
en: Tell the older men to be sober, dignified, sensible, and healthy in respect to their faith, love, and patience.

dag: Ka sagbana din be yi zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni ti leei daanya, ka tiŋgbani din be yi tiŋli ŋɔ ti leei kurugu.
en: There will be no clouds in the sky—the sky will look like polished brass. And the ground under you will be hard like iron.

dag: Bɛ mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pisinaayi. Jɛrɔham bia Adaya daa nyɛla Pɛlalia yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Amizi mini Zakaria so mi ni Pashihur ni Malikija.
en: Altogether, there were from his clan who served in the temple. The third priest to settle there was Adaiah son of Jeroham. His ancestors were Pelaliah, Amzi, Zechariah, Pashhur, and Malchijah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ dunɔdali din daa kpa wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: The man took me back to the east gate of the temple.

dag: Ti Duuma daa yi Sinai Zoli zuɣu n-ka luɣ kasi shee la na ni chɛchɛbunsi din mali kpiɔŋ pam tusatusa din ka kalinli.
en: With his millions of chariots, the Lord came from Sinai into the holy place.

dag: Ka tiŋ ŋɔ yuli ti ma suhupiɛlli mini paɣibu ni jilima dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam bɛn wum n ni tum tuun suŋ shɛŋa ti ba maa yɛla sani, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa mini tɔŋsim shɛli zaa n ni ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: Jerusalem will be a source of joy, honor, and pride to me; and every nation in the world will fear and tremble when they hear about the good things that I do for the people of Jerusalem and about the prosperity that I bring to the city.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wɔbi yi olivi tiwala, yin di lan labi ti yihi din kpalim; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a fɔntinsi wurim, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will turn your cities into ruins, and you will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o.
en: Any of your relatives who die in the city will be eaten by dogs, and any who die in the open country will be eaten by vultures. .

dag: Ŋun pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ni lan pal alikauli ni bin din galisi. Ŋun mi bi pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ku pal alikauli ni bin din galisi.
en: Whoever is faithful with little is also faithful with much, and the one who is dishonest with little is also dishonest with much.

dag: Man Pool ŋun zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba puhiri ya.
en: Here is my greeting in my own handwriting—Paul.

dag: Doo maa ni daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi Yisifu yiŋa, ka ti ba kom ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka bo mɔri ti bɛ bunsi naai.
en: The manager brought the men into Josephs house and gave them water to wash their feet and feed for their donkeys.

dag: Bɛ yihi suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim Mɔab tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niŋdi bindira pam la ni. N chɛ ka wain tɔɣibu ŋmaai wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ni. So bi lan tɔɣiri wain ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni yɔri vu shɛli maa pala suhupiɛlli vuri.
en: Harvest celebrations are gone from the orchards and farms of Moab. I have silenced the shouts of people making wine.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Izraɛlnim maa zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka wula ka Firawuna ŋun lee ni wum mani ŋun bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: But Moses answered, Lord , the Israelites refuse to listen to me. So surely Pharaoh will also refuse to listen. I am a very bad speaker.

dag: O neen ʒira maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi.
en: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also impaled himself on his sword and died with Saul.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka alahichi yirina, amaa yɛndana nyɛla ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni yɛtɔɣa pam tɔɣisibu.
en: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shih o ni mali shɛlikam maa zaa pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: But now suppose you take away everything he has—he will curse you to your face.

dag: Naawuni tiŋa, bɛ yɛli binshɛŋa din mali jilima zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛla.
en: Glorious things are said about you, the city of God! Selah.

dag: Bɛ daa liri bɛn mali biŋkɔbiri n-taɣi piɛri mini buhi ni laakuma chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: They also attacked the herdsmens camps, taking many sheep and camels before returning to Jerusalem.

dag: Bom tulaale viɛla, mɛɛr kom din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mini tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla ka bɛ booni li sinnamɔn la kilɔgiram ata ni kaɣa tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla kilɔgiram ata.
en: Now take for yourself high-quality spices: five hundred weight of solid myrrh; half as much of sweet-smelling cinnamon, that is, two hundred fifty; two hundred fifty weight of sweet-smelling cane.

dag: Dama Naa mi yɛla ŋɔ zaa, di zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri li bahiri mmaŋa o sani maa; yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli bi sɔɣi o sani, dama di daa bi niŋla ashilɔni.
en: King Agrippa! I can speak to you with all boldness, because you know about these things. I am sure that you have taken notice of every one of them, for this thing has not happened hidden away in a corner.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti piɛbi zaɣ yini kɔŋko, di saha zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba la bɛn laɣimm a sanna.
en: But if you blow long blasts on only one trumpet, only the leaders will come to meet with you.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ Samaria nti yihiri waazu yɛri ba ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Philip went to the principal city in Samaria and preached the Messiah to the people there.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi maa dihili ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ka Izraɛlnim yi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, di simdi ni bɛ yihi li ti ba.
en: It is my unchanging decision that when my people make their fellowship offerings, the breast and the thigh of the animal belong to the priests. This is the people's gift to me, the Lord .

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, dama di gbaari ma! A zabiri yirigirimi kaman buhi ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Turn your eyes away from me, for they overwhelm me! Your hair is like a flock of goats as they stream down from Gilead.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ wurim kpe yɔɣu maa, bɛ leela mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa bindirigu.
en: They strayed in every direction, and because there was no shepherd to watch them, they were attacked and eaten by wild animals.

dag: N daa bi tim anabinim maa, amaa ka bɛ yiɣisi guui chaŋ. N daa bi zaŋ n yɛligu ti ba, amaa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti vuhi ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣ o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaashee.
en: he died and was buried there in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.

dag: N ni kul di tiŋgban shɛli fali maa biɛhigu shee viɛla; n ni di fali shɛli maa viɛla.
en: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba; ka daa pii so n-leei bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.

dag: O daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He took Israel out of Egypt. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tabilakpihi daŋ yi tooni nti dim kari Hivinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinima ka chɛ soli tin ya.
en: I will throw your enemies into panic; I will drive out the Hivites, the Canaanites, and the Hittites as you advance.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa darig a tibili, ka filim a tarili, ka chɛ ka a tumd a dimnim bɛn nyɛ Filistianim yubu, bɛn nyɛ vi ni gbahi shɛba a biɛriyoli tuma maa zuɣu la.
en: So I punished you! I took away part of your land. I let your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, do what they wanted to you. Even they were shocked at the evil things you did.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, N ni jɛmdi Yawɛ so ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di yi di pala n ni ti Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat jilima zuɣu, n naan ku ŋmaligi lih a bee nti nya a.
en: Elisha answered, By the living Lord , whom I serve, I swear that I would have nothing to do with you if I didn't respect your ally, King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa n-yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛrishiiba nti mali sara o ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Jacob packed up everything he owned and left for Egypt. On the way he stopped near the town of Beersheba and offered sacrifices to the God his father Isaac had worshiped.

dag: Mbusim be dunia ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛŋa din be di ni n-chɛri ka niriba birigiri tumd alahichi zuɣu! Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nira alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi zuɣu.
en: How terrible it is for the world because of the things that cause people to trip and fall into sin! Such things have to happen, but how terrible it is for the person who causes those things to happen!.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ka o zaŋ omaŋ leei kaman o yidan la o niriba sunsuuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim omaŋa.
en: He shall not make himself unclean at the death of those related to him by marriage.

dag: Pɛriʒia mini Lidia ni Libia tɔbbihi daa nyɛla bɛn be a tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ a tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi mini bɛ kuriti zuɣupila sɔŋ a ni. Bɛ daa tir a jilima.
en: Paras, Lud, and Put were the warriors in your army. By hanging their shields and helmets on you, they made you radiant.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: The Lord explained:.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli ŋɔ kul be ti sani, ti ni mali tahima a san la zuɣu.
en: LORD, let your faithful love surround us because we wait for you.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa suug o koyuli maa na yomyom gbibi ka yɛl o, N dana, nyuma.
en: Rebekah quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and gave him a drink. She said, Drink this, sir.

dag: Yisa daa pun mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa, dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni yino maa.
en: He knew who would betray him. Thats why he said, Not every one of you is clean.

dag: Amaa a min a bidibisi n-yɛn su maligumaanitali tuma ni sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tuma zaa ni chinchin tibisili la puuni tuma n-tumda. N zaŋ yi maligumaanitali maa tin ya pini, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bi kpin li yi zaŋ omaŋ bali yi ni, bɛn kum o.
en: But only you and your sons can serve as priests at the altar and in the most holy place. Your work as priests is a gift from me, and anyone else who tries to do that work must be put to death.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: At Etham the Lord said to Moses:.

dag: M mabihi, so yi yɛli ni o mali yɛda, amaa ka di bi tumdi tuma, di buchi lee nyɛla dini? Yɛda niŋbu ŋɔ tatabo ni tooi tilig o?.
en: My brothers and sisters, what good is it if people say they have faith but do nothing to show it? Claiming to have faith cant save anyone, can it?.

dag: Ka a ni yɛn mali tulaale zim maa shɛm maa, miri ka a ti mali di tatabo n-leeg amaŋmaŋ dini. Zaŋm li leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: When you make incense according to this formula, you shouldnt make any of it for your own use. You should regard it as holy to the LORD.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaɣisi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kpɛh o kpee maa duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o yo samli maa zaa.
en: But he refused. Instead, he threw him into prison until he paid back his debt.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa tiligi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: They were in trouble, so they called to the Lord for help, and he saved them from their troubles.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri piniyini ka bɛ boon o Shɛbat la biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti man Anabi Zakaria Bɛrɛkia bia ŋun nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la.
en: In the second year that Darius was emperor, on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month , the Lord gave me a message in a vision at night.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka Ijipti zani dabari, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa zaa din daa be di ni vuui, n yi ti ku binshɛɣukam din be di ni, di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will make the land of Egypt empty. That land will lose everything. I will punish all the people living in Egypt. Then they will know that I am the Lord !.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla zali, ka kahigi li wuhi, ka di daa bi yuui, ka n chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: Long ago I told you what would happen. I told you about these things. And suddenly I made them happen.

dag: Jafɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Goma mini Magɔg ni Madai ni Javan ni Tubal ni Mɛshɛk ni Tiras.
en: Japheth was the father of Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, and they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ka yi su li yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua.
en: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti yi Jɛrusalɛm chana, ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la chirig o sol ni. Anabi Ahija daa yɛla binyɛr palli; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kɔŋko daa be mɔɣu maa ni chana.
en: One day when Jeroboam was leaving Jerusalem, he met Ahijah, a prophet from Shiloh. No one else was anywhere around. Suddenly, Ahijah took off his new coat and ripped it into twelve pieces.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone about him.

dag: Amaa ka Samsin zabiri maa daa ti lan bilina gbaai zoobu o pinibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But they didn't cut his hair any more, so it started growing back.

dag: Ŋuna ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Juda naa Amɔn bia Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pinaata saha la.
en: The Lord began to speak to Jeremiah in the th year that Josiah, son of Amon, was king of the nation of Judah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko maa:.
en: There in the plains of Moab across the Jordan from Jericho the Lord gave Moses.

dag: ka pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di kpahirimi lu, ka so ku lan tooi baŋ di ni di be shɛli.
en: but when the hot wind blows, it dies. Soon, you cannot even see where the flower was.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o nuhi ni o naba n-gbam du, ka o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa dol o nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔnatan daa ti ŋmɛri ba luhiri ka o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa mi dol o nyaaŋa kuri ba.
en: Jonathan climbed up out of the pass on his hands and knees, and the young man followed him. Jonathan attacked the Philistines and knocked them down, and the young man killed them.

dag: Amaa a na kul duhirila amaŋa n niriba sani, ka zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: You are still abusing your power against my people, and you refuse to let them go.

dag: Ka ti mabiyurigu Onɛsimus ŋun ʒe yim ka nyɛ yi ni yino la ni pahi o zuɣu kana. Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya binshɛɣukam zaa din niŋdi kpe ŋɔ yɛla.
en: I am sending him with Onesimus, the faithful and dear brother from your group. They will tell you everything that has happened here.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi chaŋ Rama m-mali lala hal ti paai Taai fɔŋ din nyɛ bɛ ni me birini gili shɛl la. Ka lan ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ hal ni Hɔsa m-mali lala hal ti paai di tariga Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Ka Mahalab mini Akizib.
en: The border then turned to Ramah, reaching the fortified city of Tyre; then it turned to Hosah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. It included Mahalab, Achzib.

dag: N ni zaŋ piɛbihi pola mali sara n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim ti a, ka zaŋ piɛlahi sara nyɔhi ti a, ka zaŋ naɣilahi mini buhi mali sara.
en: I bring my best sheep as burnt offerings. I offer the smoke from them up to you. I give you sacrifices of bulls and goats. Selah.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni nira yi yi tin shɛl ni o ni pun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ka Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli na .
en: Any Levite living in any town anywhere in Israel may leave his home and come to the Lord s special place. He may do this anytime he wants.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina asibaasi, ka Ilaisha sɔŋda yina nti nya ka tɔbbihi mini yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi n-kul teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa zaa. Ka Ilaisha sɔŋda maa kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: When Elisha's servant got up the next morning, he saw that Syrian troops had the town surrounded. Sir, what are we going to do? he asked.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni na be ŋɔ, biribu saha mini chɛbu saha ni maasim saha ni tulim saha ni shɛɣu saha ni kikaa saha ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kul ni beni.
en: As long as the earth continues, there will always be a time for planting and a time for harvest. There will always be cold and hot, summer and winter, day and night on earth.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, bɛ chani kabirila yiya kpɛra, ka biɛɣu neei, ka bɛ kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ duri; bɛ bi mi neesim.
en: When it is dark, evil people go out and break into houses. But during the day they lock themselves in their homes to avoid the light.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Diblaim bipuɣiŋga Goma ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So Hosea married Gomer daughter of Diblaim. She became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Hosea.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli noli ti tikpiralana bee n-zaŋ kuɣili sɔŋ zom tooni ni o tuui li, amaa zom a Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not curse anyone who is deaf. You must not do anything to make a blind person fall. But you must respect your God. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka amiliya yilinim maa wain daa ti pooi ba, ka Yisa ma yɛl o, Bɛ lan ka wain din nyura.
en: When the wine had given out, Jesus' mother said to him, They are out of wine.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o kpamba bɛn be o sani zaa, Yiɣisimiya ka ti zo, di yi pa lala ti ti ku tooi lan zo n-yi Absalom nuu ni. Ti zomiya yomyom, di yi pa lala o ni gbahi ti pumpɔŋɔ n-niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku ya ŋɔ nima.
en: Then David told all the servants who were with him in Jerusalem, Come on! We have to run for it, or we wont be able to escape Absalom. Hurry, or he will catch up with us in no time, destroy us, and attack the city with the sword.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka o gba vuhi, faashee ka o me Jɛrusalɛm zali, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa paɣi li.
en: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n zaŋla duu tanzaa kuɣili sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din viɛli ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka ni chɛ ka duu tanzaa mali yaa. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku zo dabiɛm.
en: Therefore, the LORD God says: Look! Im laying in Zion a stone, a tested stone, a valuable cornerstone, a sure foundation: the one who trusts wont tremble.

dag: Asaf n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa nyɛ Zakaria mini Jɛiɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhiɛl ni Matitia ni Ɛliab ni Bɛnaaya ni Obɛdɛdom ni Jɛiɛl bɛn daa nyɛ mɔɣilo mini goonjɛŋmɛriba la. Asaf n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa la.
en: Asaph was appointed leader, with Zechariah as his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed Edom, and Jeiel were to play harps. Asaph was to sound the cymbals.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yi tiŋ maa ni n-chaŋ biɛla ha saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, Yiɣisim kari niriba maa naba, a yi ti paai ba, nyin bɔhim ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zu n daanzinfa pipia?.
en: When they had gone only a short distance from the city, Joseph said to the servant in charge of his house, Hurry after those men. When you catch up with them, ask them, Why have you paid back evil for good?.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zuliya n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒini baɣili teeku. Bɛna n-nyɛ Jafɛt zuliya bɛn daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni, ka mali bɛmaŋmaŋ zuliyazuliya yɛtɔɣ kɔŋkɔba bɛ tiŋgban ni.
en: From these the island-nations were divided into their own countries, each according to their languages and their clans within their nations.

dag: N ni lan zaŋ Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Juda n-zaŋ ba kul Babilɔn la labisi kpe na; dama n ni kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kpɛma tusaayopɔin mini tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim tuhili bɛn zaa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu kuli Babilɔn.
en: Nebuchadnezzar deported all the important men to Babylonia, seven thousand in all, and one thousand skilled workers, including the blacksmiths, all of them able-bodied men fit for military duty.

dag: Musa daa lan zali niriba maa zaligu dindali maa yɛli:.
en: Then Moses said to the people of Israel.

dag: Sokam kul kpalimmi be kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni bol o.
en: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.

dag: Amaa nyin min a niriba ŋɔ na bi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: But I am certain that neither you nor your officials really fear the Lord God.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu n-sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus said, Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't have a place to call his own.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum Pool yɛtɔɣa maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai o ni yoli yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o! Dama nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo bi simdi ni o be.
en: The people stopped listening when Paul said this last thing. They all shouted, Get rid of this man! He doesnt deserve to live.

dag: O daa yɛl o tab mini Samaria tɔbbihi sani, Bɔ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ chɔɣima ŋɔ lee niŋdi maa? Bɛ ni tooi lab me tiŋ maa zali yaha? Bɛ ni lan maani sara? Bɛ ni zaŋ dahin yini naai li? Bɛ ni yihi kuɣa din daa di buɣim tampuya saɣiri la ni me.
en: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛdaniŋdib shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Farisiinim la yiɣisi zani yɛli, Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka niŋ Yisa yɛda maa guni, ka lan niŋ kamaata ni ti yɛli ba ni bɛ doli Anabi Musa zaligu.
en: Some believers from among the Pharisees stood up and claimed, The Gentiles must be circumcised. They must be required to keep the Law from Moses.

dag: Ka Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir maa daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Aijalɔn Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni.
en: Then he died and was buried at Aijalon in the territory of Zebulun.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun daa zali ya ŋɔ yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛli la zuɣu. Bɛ maanila maligu tiri Baal n-yiɣisiri n suhu.
en: I, the Lord Almighty, planted Israel and Judah; but now I threaten them with disaster. They have brought this on themselves because they have done wrong; they have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal.

dag: N daa niŋ bɛn doli soli ŋɔ alaka, hal ka chɛ ka bɛ ku bɛ shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lo bɛ shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba mihi kpɛhi duu.
en: I persecuted the people who followed the Way. Some of them were killed because of me. I arrested men and women and put them in jail.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Risa maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Kɛhɛlata.
en: They marched from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

dag: Zaŋmi bɛ zaa laɣim sɔɣi tiŋgban ni, ka lo ba niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Bury them all in the ground; bind them in the world of the dead.

dag: dama ti bidibbina pala dunia ŋɔ bidibbina, amaa di nyɛla din mali Naawuni yiko di ni, ka daari tinsi goon kara luhira.
en: The weapons we use are not human ones. Our weapons have power from God and can destroy the enemys strong places. We destroy peoples arguments.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi so zuɣu maa dii kahi nti kpe bɛ ni n-nyaŋ bɛ zaa m-bu n-ti ba dansi, ka bɛ zo ni bɛ zaɣim n-yi yili maa ni.
en: The person who had an evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all with such force that they ran out of that house naked and wounded.

dag: Teemiya n ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la, Ye dabili bi gar o duuma. Bɛ yi daa niŋ ma wahala, lala ka bɛ ni niŋ yi gba wahala; bɛ mi yi daa deei n noli, bɛ ni deei yi gba dini.
en: Remember the lesson I told you: Servants are not greater than their master. If people treated me badly, they will treat you badly too. And if they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours too.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o yiŋnim dɔbba yinoyino zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Karimi bia Ɛkan ŋun daa nyɛ Zabidi mini Zɛra yaaŋa ka yi Juda zuliya ni na la.
en: He then brought Zabdi's family forward, one by one, and Achan, the son of Carmi and grandson of Zabdi, was picked out.

dag: Ti daa wolisirimi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu, amaa ka ti lee bi dɔɣi shɛli. Ti bi di nasara; ti mi bi dɔɣi so ni o zani ti zaani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: We were in pain and agony, but we gave birth to nothing. We have won no victory for our land; we have accomplished nothing.

dag: M mi a ni ʒiini shɛm ni a ni yiɣisiri shɛm, ka mi a ni yiri chani ka labirina shɛm. N lan mi a ni je suli niŋ ma shɛm.
en: I know all about your battles; I know when you rested, when you went out to war, and when you came home. I also know when you got upset at me.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Naa Amɔn polo maa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: The common people killed all the officers who made plans against King Amon. Then the people made Amons son Josiah the new king after him.

dag: A zaligu zuɣu ka binshɛɣukam beni zuŋɔ, dama binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a daba.
en: All things remain to this day because of your command, because they are all your servants.

dag: n di bi zaɣisi ni m be yi sani pumpɔŋɔ n-taɣ zilinli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama n suhu zɔhiri yi zuɣu.
en: I wish I could be with you now. Then maybe I could change the way I am talking to you. Now I dont know what to do about you.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a mi ma; a nyari ma, ka buɣisiri ma, ka n suhu bela a ni. Vom ba yihina kaman piɛri ka bɛ vɔri ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la. Woligim ba zali gu kɔrigibu dali.
en: But, Lord , you know me; you see what I do and how I love you. Drag these evil people away like sheep to be butchered; guard them until it is time for them to be slaughtered.

dag: Ti suhupiɛlli la naaya. Ti wahi wabu la leela kuyila.
en: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.

dag: yɛra, Yawɛ yi di daa chɛ ka ti kpi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di daa naan so, dama ti daa nyari nimdi ŋubira, ka diri bindira ti yubu, amaa yi zaŋ ti mi na ti bahi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ni yi chɛ ka kum ku ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: They said, It would have been better if the Lord had just killed us in the land of Egypt. At least there we had plenty to eat. We had all the food we needed. But now you have brought us out here into this desert to make us all die from hunger.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi ni zaŋ Abimilɛk n-leei yi naa la, yɛlimaŋli soli ka yi doli maa? Yi teei Gidiɔn yɛla, ka niŋ o malibu viɛnyɛla kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm?.
en: So now, if you acted faithfully and innocently when you made Abimelech king, and if youve done right by Jerubbaal and his household, and have treated him as his actions deserve.

dag: ka Kɔra nyɛ Izar bia, ka Izar nyɛ Kɔhat bia, ka Kɔhat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi mi daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia.
en: Izhar, Kohath, Levi, Jacob.

dag: Ka yi nimaani hal ti gari Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni zaŋ lab Jɛbusi nudirigu polo, Jɛrusalɛm m-bala n-lan kpuɣi nimaani hal ti du zo shɛli din do Hinnom Vinvamli wulinluhili polo la zaŋ lab Rɛfaim Vinvamli tariga nuzaa polo.
en: and up through Hinnom Valley on the south side of the hill where the Jebusite city of Jerusalem was located. The border then proceeded up to the top of the hill on the west side of Hinnom Valley, at the northern end of Rephaim Valley.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka tɔbu mini kum ku ba maa bahi Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu, so ti ku beni ŋun ni sɔɣi bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi. Dama n ni ti zaŋ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba.
en: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yil shɛl ni o ni daa yɛn be, ka di ʒe saria karibu zɔŋ nyaaŋa la, lala ka bɛ daa me di gba. Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me yil shɛli ka di be kaman o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ me zɔn shɛl la n-ti o ni daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣin so la.
en: Behind the Judgment Hall was a courtyard. The palace where Solomon lived was built around that courtyard and looked like the Judgment Hall. He also built the same kind of palace for his wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ŋubirila binkpima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka kuri niriba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa?.
en: So, Ezekiel, tell them I am saying: How can you think the land is still yours? You eat meat with blood in it and worship idols. You commit murder.

dag: Di saha maa ti ti ku lan be kaman bihi, ka ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn zaŋ yɛŋkiŋkabina soli birigi niriba la ni zaŋ yɔhiŋgu wuhibu din be kaman pɔhim la n-chɛ ka di ʒiɛri ti laani ginda.
en: As a result, we arent supposed to be infants any longer who can be tossed and blown around by every wind that comes from teaching with deceitful scheming and the tricks people play to deliberately mislead others.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini di kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: the kidneys and the fat on them, and the best part of the liver.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: The total number of descendants of the Temple workers and of Solomon's servants who returned from exile was .

dag: O ni daa yuri yi yaannim la zuɣu ka o daa pii bɛ bihi bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka daa be yi sani n-yihi ya Ijipti na. O daa zaŋ o yiko.
en: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli: N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor made a sign for Paul to speak. So Paul answered, Governor Felix, I know that you have been a judge over this nation for a long time. So I am happy to defend myself before you.

dag: Dama bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ku tooi puh a, bɛ mi ku tooi paɣ a. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be gbala ni ku tooi mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ a ʒiɛyimtali polo.
en: The underworld cant thank you, nor can death praise you; those who go down to the pit cant hope for your faithfulness.

dag: Yihim Naawuni yɛligu waazu: kul yirigim di zuɣu saha shɛlikam zaa; saɣisim niriba; kpahimi niriba zuɣu ni; kpammi niriba jaande; wuhimi niriba suɣilɔdibo pam puuni.
en: to preach the message, to insist upon proclaiming it , to convince, reproach, and encourage, as you teach with all patience.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o niriba, Gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma! Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba zaɣ nɛma n-ku ba Bɛtɛkɛd bɔɣili gbini. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinahinaayi. Ka bɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ ni zaɣ yino gba.
en: Then Jehu said, Take them alive! Jehus men captured Ahaziahs relatives alive. There were of them. Jehu killed them at the well near Beth Eked. He did not leave anyone alive.

dag: Abana mini Faaripa mɔɣa din be Damaskus la bi so koma zaa din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni? N naan dii ku chaŋ nimaani nti mim ka nya alaafee? Dinzuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: Besides, aren't the rivers Abana and Pharpar, back in Damascus, better than any river in Israel? I could have washed in them and been cured.
