dag: Dama a tiligi ma kum ni, ka chɛ ka m bi lu ni di chɛ ka m be a tooni n-chani nyɛvili neesim puuni.
en: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ karimbaani, ka bi wuh o wumpaɣibo ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni daa niŋ shɛm ti o maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o mini Judanim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu.
en: But Hezekiahs heart was proud, so he did not give God thanks for his kindness. This is why God was angry with Hezekiah and with the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka tummi din viɛla; ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka a be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.

dag: Nyam salima la ni daɣi shɛm. Nyam salima alali la ni daɣi shɛm. Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu kuɣ viɛla la wurim do soya zuɣu luɣilikam.
en: Oh, no! Gold is tarnished; even the purest gold is changed. Sacred jewels are scattered on every street corner.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi doli n zalikpana maa, amaa ka zaɣisi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la dolibu, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nini kul moola bɛ yaannim buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu la.
en: I did this because they had rejected my commands, broken my laws, profaned the Sabbath, and worshiped the same idols their ancestors had served.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam daa chɛ o dolibu.
en: After Jesus said these things, many of his followers left and stopped following him.

dag: Yɛlim Ammɔnnim maa, Wummiya ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: N jɛmbu duu ni daa saɣim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli la mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni kpalim dabari ni bɛ ni daa gbahi Judanim chaŋ ka yi mali suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: Say to the Ammonites: Hear the LORD Gods word! The LORD God proclaims: You laughed when my sanctuary was degraded, when Israels fertile land was laid waste, and when the house of Judah went into exile.

dag: Naa ni daa wum Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbini maa shɛm maa, ka o zani bimbini maa gbini ka teeg o nuu tiri ka yɛli, Gbaamiy o! Ka o ni daa teeg o nu shɛli tir o ka yɛl lala maa dii kpaŋ dilinli ka o kɔŋ li pɔribu.
en: Jeroboam pointed at the prophet and shouted, Grab him! But at once, Jeroboam's hand became stiff, and he could not move it.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yi ku tooi jɛm Yawɛ dama o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be kasi; ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri nyuli; ka ku chɛ yi tuumbiɛri bee yi daalahichi.
en: Joshua said to the people, But you may not be able to serve the Lord . He is a holy God and will not forgive your sins. He will tolerate no rivals.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be kasi. Mani n-nam yinim Izraɛlnima, ka nyɛ yi naa.
en: I am the Lord , your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.

dag: Ka ŋmana maa zaa daa ti pali; ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa ni yino, Zaŋm ŋman shɛl na. Ka o yɛl o, Ŋman shɛl lan kani. Ka kpam maa mi dii ŋmaai, ka bi lan yirina.
en: At last, she said to one of her sons, Bring me another jar. We don't have any more, he answered, and the oil stopped flowing from the small bottle.

dag: Yurilim bi chɛ ka nir tumd o ʒiʒiinikpee zaɣ biɛɣu, dinzuɣu yurilim nyɛla din paani Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Love doesnt hurt others. So loving is the same as obeying all the law.

dag: A bi kpahim nya niriba maa ni yɛra, Yawɛ zaɣisila o ni daa pii zuliya ayi shɛb la? Lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lihi ʒiɛmla n niriba maa, ka bi lan lihi ba ka bɛ ŋmani zuliya yaha. .
en: Have you noticed how people are saying that I have rejected Israel and Judah, the two families that I chose? And so they look with contempt on my people and no longer consider them a nation.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka n suhu kul yɛya ni n yihi Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-ti yinim bɛn be Rom ŋɔ gba.
en: That is why I want so much to tell the Good News to you there in Rome.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ daa bi niŋ o daalikauli yɛda, ka daa ʒiɛm tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa.
en: They would not trust you, Lord , and they did not like the promised land.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mal ʒiishee ti a maa.
en: They said to him, Where do you want us to prepare it.

dag: A ŋmanila abie tia, ka a biha be kaman di wala yila la.
en: You are as graceful as a palm tree, and your breasts are clusters of dates.

dag: A ni ti baŋ ni n wum a turi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa a ni tɔɣisiri turi Izraɛl zoya yɛra, Di kpalimla dabari doya. Bɛ zaŋ li ti ti ni ti va li.
en: Then you will know that I, the Lord , heard you say with contempt that the mountains of Israel were desolate and that they were yours to devour.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan sabilifaa n-she alichɛbba shɛli zuɣu o ni yɛn yɛri binyɛribila la para.
en: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu yuŋ. Nyini ka n suhu zaa kul bɔra. Dama a yi kari dunia mini niriba bɛn be di ni saria, di chɛmi ka bɛ baŋdi din tuhi.
en: At night I long for you with all my heart; when you judge the earth and its people, they will all learn what justice is.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn daa yi Damaskus na ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: When the Syrians of Damascus sent an army to help King Hadadezer, David attacked it and killed twenty-two thousand men.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Adam la alahichi tumbu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka alahichi kpe dunia ŋɔ ni, ka alahichi maa tahi kum na. Dina n-chɛ ka kum paari sokam, dama sokam zaa tum alahichi.
en: Just as through one human being sin came into the world, and death came through sin, so death has come to everyone, since everyone has sinned.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka bɛ sanna sagban wɔɣinli puuni. Sagban wɔɣinli maa daa zanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: The Lord appeared at the Tent in a tall cloud. The tall cloud stood over the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ shɛb ni tumdi shɛm polo, n nyɛla ŋun dol a zaligu, m mi bi zaŋ mmaŋ bali duŋtaariba ni.
en: But these other peoples deeds? I have avoided such violent ways by the command from your lips.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa niŋ yɛda maa laɣim be, ka laɣim su bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa.
en: All the believers stayed together and shared everything.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino mi ti yɛl o, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Another man, who was a disciple, said, Sir, first let me go back and bury my father.

dag: ni Oholibama ni Ɛla ni Pinɔn.
en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lo ti Naawuni maa alikauli, ka yihi tinzun paɣiba mini bɛ bihi n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ kaman n dana mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum ti Naawuni zaligu ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la ni daa wuhi shɛm, ka chɛ ka di niŋ kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.

dag: Bɛnjamin bihi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Ashibɛl ŋun daa pa o zuɣu ni Ahara ŋun daa pah ata.
en: Benjamin was the father of Bela his oldest son, Ashbel his second son, Aharah the third.

dag: ka Inan bia Ahira mi nyɛ Naftali zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.

dag: Dama noli zaɣisibu mini baɣibuɣibo zaa alahichi nyɛla yim. Ka tipawumli mini buɣijɛmbo mi nyɛ alahichi yini. Ka a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu ŋɔ zuɣu, o gba zaɣisiya ni a ku lan nyɛ naa.
en: Rebellion against him is as bad as witchcraft, and arrogance is as sinful as idolatry. Because you rejected the Lord 's command, he has rejected you as king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani ti pihiri li asiba kam sokam dibu tariga, amaa wuntaŋ daa yi ti bii, di nyɛligirimi.
en: Each morning everyone gathered as much as they needed, and in the heat of the day the rest melted.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la kul be n sani wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka a yilli mi be n sani yuŋ. Di nyɛla n suhigu zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n nyɛvil la sani.
en: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.

dag: Ka Midiannim daa nyaŋ Izraɛlnima; ka Izraɛlnim maa zo nti sɔɣi bɔɣa din daa be zoya zuɣu puuni mini tampima voya ni ni luɣ shɛŋa bɛ n-ni tooi sɔɣi zani tuhi tɔbu.
en: The power of the Midianites prevailed over Israel, and because of the Midianites, the Israelites used crevices and caves in the mountains as hidden strongholds.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim niriba maa, N yi chɛ ka tɔbu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino leei bɛ gula.
en: Mortal man, he said, tell your people what happens when I bring war to a land. The people of that country choose one of their number to be a lookout.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron these regulations.

dag: ka Samuɛl nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Jɛrɔham bia, ka Jɛrɔham nyɛ Ɛliɛl bia, ka Ɛliɛl nyɛ Tɔa bia.
en: Elkanah, Jeroham, Eliel, Toah.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa bɔhi Ahitɔfɛl, Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, Give your advice then. What should we do.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kumdi olivi tihi puri ni, dama n ni ka yi sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yi o pɔri maa nyaaŋa m-mɔŋ bipuɣiŋga maa o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Herod was very sorry for what he had said. But he did not want to break the promise he had made in front of his guests.

dag: Sapashin kpamba maa ni lan yɛli tɔbbihi maa yaha, Dabiɛm yi gbaai so bee so suhu yi fuŋ, dilana ŋun labimi kul o yiŋa, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka o tab suhuri fuŋ kaman o suhu ni fuŋ shɛm maa.
en: The officers will also say to the men, Is there any man here who has lost his nerve and is afraid? If so, he is to go home. Otherwise, he will destroy the morale of the others.

dag: Bɛ daa wuh o shihira bɛ sani, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They put Gods signs on Egypt, his marvelous works on the land of Ham.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zo n-kuli Hitinim tiŋgban ni n-daa ti me omaŋmaŋ tiŋa m-boli di yuli Luz; ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The man went to the land of the Hittites and built a city. He named it Luz, which is still its name today.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o me du titali, ka ku ʒini mali laasabu nya o mal liɣiri din ni tooi me li naai?.
en: If one of you is planning to build a tower, you sit down first and figure out what it will cost, to see if you have enough money to finish the job.

dag: Di saha maa ka teeku puuni daa yi palɔni, ka tiŋgbani tanzaa daa yi palɔni. Yawɛ, a tahigu min a suhuyiɣisili tuma m-bala.
en: The seabeds were exposed; the earths foundations were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the angry blast of air coming from your nostrils.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa wum ni o neei kum ni, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la nya o maa, bɛ daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: But Mary told them that Jesus was alive. She said that she had seen Jesus, but they did not believe her.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa pii Kɛdɛshi din be Galili Naftali zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la mini Shɛkɛm din daa be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la ni Kiriatariba din be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la.
en: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the highlands of Naphtali, Shechem in the highlands of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba in the highlands of Judah.

dag: N nya Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti sokam ni o tum.
en: I saw all the hard work God gave us to do.

dag: A zaŋla ti tuumbiɛri zal a tooni, ka ti ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa ashilɔni yi n-do palɔni a ninni.
en: You place our sins before you, our secret sins where you can see them.

dag: Hal o daa mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee Juda zoya tinsi ni, ka daa chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛmnim bi lan ʒe yim, ka lan chɛ ka Judanim birigi.
en: As if that wasnt enough, Jehoram constructed shrines throughout Judahs highlands, encouraged Jerusalems citizens to be unfaithful, and led Judah astray.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti kul mali suhukpeeni. Ti mi ni ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni, ti na ka ti Duuma yiŋa m-bala.
en: So we always have confidence. We know that while we live in this body, we are away from the Lord.

dag: Naa, a dooshee ka tɛha daa ti ka a sanna zaŋ chaŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla polo; ka Naawuni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba ŋɔ daa wuh a din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: While Your Majesty was sleeping, you dreamed about the future; and God, who reveals mysteries, showed you what is going to happen.

dag: ka o yɛl o mabihi maa, Bɛ zaŋla n liɣiri labisi niŋ ma, dina m-be n kpalaŋ ni ŋɔ. Ka bɛ suhuri daa fuŋ di zuɣu, ka bɛ ni sɔhiri ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka tuun bɔ ka Naawuni lee tum ti ŋɔ.
en: Here's my money! he told his brothers. Right here in my sack. They were trembling with fear as they stared at one another and asked themselves, What has God done to us.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa kuhi yɛli, Molimi molo! Ka m bɔhi, M molimi molo bɔ? Ka o yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli ni ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri; bɛ bi yuuri gari tipum.
en: A voice cries out, Proclaim a message! What message shall I proclaim? I ask. Proclaim that all human beings are like grass; they last no longer than wild flowers.

dag: nti nya ka di nyɛla bɛ zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka bɛ daa fiɣis o, amaa ka o mi bi tum taal shɛli din simdi ni bɛ ku o bee n-kpɛh o duu.
en: and learned that the charges concern only their religious laws. This man isn't guilty of anything for which he should die or even be put in jail.

dag: N Duuma n-teegi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma ŋ-ŋɔ ni o yihi ma vi ni niriba sani maa.
en: Look what the Lord has done for me! He decided to help me. Now people will stop thinking there is something wrong with me.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o chɛ ka mahim maa lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia kaman Ahaz ni daa buɣisi wuntaŋ chandi yɛla zali shɛm la.
en: So the prophet Isaiah called on the LORD, who made the shadow go back ten steps, down the flight of stairs built by Ahaz.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri chaŋ luɣ shɛli din miri Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: Josephs brothers went to tend their fathers flocks near Shechem.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya o katiŋa, bɛ daa bi baŋ o, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum pam; ka dari chahi bɛ binyɛra, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu chɛri zuɣusaa ka di puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri.
en: While they were still a long way off they saw Job, but did not recognize him. When they did, they began to weep and wail, tearing their clothes in grief and throwing dust into the air and on their heads.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim zaa: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin m-puhi Naawuni chuɣu din nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu la.
en: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, M bia, chɛ ka n nyih a, di lan chaŋ so puu ni nti yihi kayiha ka pa ni m puu ŋɔ ni. Kul be paɣiba ŋɔ sani kpe n-tumm a tuma.
en: Boaz said to Ruth, Havent you understood, my daughter? Dont go glean in another field; dont go anywhere else. Instead, stay here with my young women.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ka o ti ŋme n-di di nɛma, ka ʒe di nɛma n-zaŋ di daazichi chaŋ, ka di ti leeg o tɔbbihi yɔri.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: Im going to give the land of Egypt to Babylons King Nebuchadrezzar. He will carry off its wealth, he will plunder and loot it, and it will be the wages for his army.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Molimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu n-yɛra, Wummiya alikauli ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka gbibi li.
en: The Lord said to me, Jeremiah, tell this message in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: Listen to the words of this agreement, and then obey these laws.

dag: A chɛ a niriba tuumbiɛri paŋ ba; ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa paŋ ba.
en: You have forgiven your people's sins and pardoned all their wrongs.

dag: Tibidarigibo biɛɣu neeya, sanyoo biɛɣu neeya. Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ lala. Anabi maa nyɛla jɛrigu, shia ni be ninvuɣ so ni maa nyɛla yinyaa, dama yi tuumbiɛri mini yi jɛlinsi galisiya pam.
en: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. Prophets are fools, you say. And God's messengers are crazy. Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.

dag: N nyaya ka daadamnim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.

dag: Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Yisa.
en: Listen! You will become pregnant and have a baby boy. You will name him Jesus.

dag: Di pala m bɔrimi ni n ʒili ya ʒitibisa ka suui shɛb dini;.
en: We dont want you to have troubles while others are comforted. We want everything to be equal.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu. O ni ti bahi dunia ŋɔ ni wuna zaa yoli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be teeku noli mini kom ni gili zuliya shɛba ti gban o tooni jɛm o bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔna ni.
en: The Lord will terrify them. He will reduce the gods of the earth to nothing, and then every nation will worship him, each in its own land.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: and the Lord answered:.

dag: Zaŋna hal ni zuŋɔ, kum mini kɔnyuri n-kul mali ti, ka ti chani gbinfini, ka nyari buri, ka ka biɛhigu shee.
en: Up to this very moment we are hungry, thirsty, wearing rags, abused, and homeless.

dag: Di wumya bɛ yɛtɔɣa. Jɛmmiya Babilɔn Naa ka be. Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ zani dabari?.
en: Don't listen to them! Submit to the king of Babylonia and you will live! Why should this city become a pile of ruins?.

dag: Nyini n-wuhiri niriba tusatusa a yurilim din bi taɣira, amaa ka lee darigiri bihi tibili bɛ laamba taali zuɣu. Nyini Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka mali yiko, ka a yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: You are loyal and kind to thousands of people, but you also bring punishment to children for their fathers sins. Great and powerful God, your name is the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Jɛta bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛfune ni Pisipa ni Ara.
en: Jethers family: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

dag: N ku chɛn ya, n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm saha shɛli yi ni tum din chihiri shɛli maa ni na be yi kɔbili ni maa. Di saha yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun darigiri niriba tibili.
en: I will not show you any mercy or feel sorry for you. I am punishing you for the evil things you did. You have done such terrible things. Now, you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tum tuma ti yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, dama n suhu yiɣisiya, ka n dabi buɣim din kul ni diri sahakam.
en: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land.

dag: Ka n daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka yi gbɛri gooni maa gbini? Yi yi lan pahi lala, n ni gbahi ya. Ka di saha maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa bi lan labina Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha.
en: But I warned them: Why are you spending the night by the wall? If you do that again, I will lay hands on you! At that point, they stopped coming on the Sabbath.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihinahi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After the birth of Mahalalel, Kenan lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Nyama, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli vinvamli ni la.
en: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.

dag: di simdi ni yi bo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga.
en: you will receive five shekels each. You will receive them according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs to the shekel.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam nyuri bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.

dag: O zahindila puu pɔi ka naanyi da li. O zaŋdila o ni tum tuma nya laɣ shɛli n-ko wain tihi puu.
en: She looks at land and buys it. She uses the money she has earned and plants a vineyard.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom biŋkɔb so yo o samli; nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: Someone who kills an animal may make amends for it: a life for a life.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa Naawuni ʒii nyabu maa puuni n-zaŋ ma chaŋ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani. Di saha ka n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli maa daa chɛ ma.
en: And a wind lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Chaldea, through a vision with a divine wind. When the vision I had seen left me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N niriba m-bala, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku yɔhim ma. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba.
en: God said, Truly, they are my people, children who wont do what is wrong. God became their savior.

dag: M mali tahima Naawuni sani ni wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ni neei kum ni, kaman bɛ gba ni mali di tahima shɛm.
en: I have the same hope in God that these themselves have, namely, that all people, both the good and the bad, will rise from death.

dag: Bɛ bi lan tiri ti mɔri, amaa ka na kul yɛra, Ŋmamiya bilichiisi maa! Nyam bɛ ni buri a tumtumdiba shɛm, amaŋmaŋ niriba maa tum din bi tuhi.
en: No one brings us any straw, but we are still ordered to make the same number of bricks. We are beaten with whips, and your own people are to blame.

dag: Ka Liya dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: Leahs servant Zilpah gave birth to a son for Jacob.

dag: Dam yɛlimaŋli mini yɛm ni wuhibu ni baŋsim, ka miri ka a zaŋ li kɔhi.
en: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai, ka o teeg o nuhi min o naba wuhi ba.
en: As he said this, he showed them his hands and feet.

dag: ti nyari alaka, amaa ti na ʒi n-kpalim ti ko; bɛ ŋmɛri ti luhira, amaa ti bi kpira.
en: We are persecuted, but God does not leave us. We are hurt sometimes, but we are not destroyed.

dag: A ni ti ma suhupiɛl shɛli n suhu ni gari bɛ ni yi ŋahi kawana pam, ka tɔɣi wain pam, ka mali suhupiɛl shɛl la.
en: But the joy that you have given me is more than they will ever have with all their grain and wine.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti di ka nyu n-naai, ka o suhu dɔni luɣ yini, ka o chaŋ kaʒee gbini ti dɔni ni o gbihi. Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Rut ti puɣisi chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli.
en: Boaz ate and drank, and he was in a good mood. He went over to lie down by the edge of the grain pile. Then she quietly approached, uncovered his legs, and lay down.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi dol li n-tum di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.

dag: Ka Ammɔn kpamba daa bɔhi Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni jilima ka o ti a ba maa? O tuumba maa kamina ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ ya ŋɔ daashili zaa, ka o kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: But the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, Dont be fooled. David didnt really send these men to comfort you or to honor your dead father! No, David sent his servants to spy on you and your land. He really wants to destroy your country.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o wuhibu maa gari ba pam.
en: Now when the crowd heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni so ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba n-niŋ o di yiko.
en: Jesus said, That is why I said, Anyone the Father does not help to come to me cannot come.

dag: ni Hadid ni Zɛboim ni Nɛbalat.
en: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat.

dag: Ti Duuma wurim Yaakubu zuliya ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa, ka bi zo ba nambɔɣu. O suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka o daa wurim Juda bipuɣiŋga yaa ni be luɣ shɛli polo la. O chɛ ka nama mini di nanim lu tiŋa n-nya filiŋ.
en: The Lord destroyed without mercy every village in Judah And tore down the forts that defended the land. He brought disgrace on the kingdom and its rulers.

dag: Jona ni daa piligi chani gindi tiŋ maa, o daa chanimi ka kuhiri yɛra, Di kpalim biɛɣ pihinahi ka Naawuni chɛ ka Ninive lɛb pili. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ti paai dahin yini chandi tariga.
en: Jonah started through the city, and after walking a whole day, he proclaimed, In forty days Nineveh will be destroyed.

dag: O yiko ka o zaŋ su nam sahakam, ka pa o nina lihiri zuliya kam. Duŋtaariba miri ka bɛ taai duŋ niŋ o.
en: He rules the world with his great power. He watches people everywhere. No one can rebel against him. Selah.

dag: Nimaani ka sapashini maa daa nya Alikizandria ŋariŋ din chani Itali, ka o daa zaŋ ti kpɛhi di ni.
en: There the centurion found an Alexandrian ship headed for Italy and put us on board.

dag: Ti yab Naa Dauda nam din kanna ti Duuma yuli ni ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: God bless the coming kingdom of our ancestor David. Hooray for God in heaven above.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni bi so ŋun nyɛ falidira yi na nyɛ bia, hal o ni kul su binshɛɣukam maa zaa yoli, o bi gari dabili.
en: This is what I am saying: When young children inherit all that their father owned, they are still no different from his slaves. It doesnt matter that they own everything.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka ti mali yɛri ya maa. Dina n-nyɛ ni ti ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn mali nyɛviya hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha ti ku daŋ bɛn pun gbihiri kum ni la tooni.
en: What we are saying is a message from the Lord: we who are alive and still around at the Lords coming definitely wont go ahead of those who have died.

dag: O ʒila o nam ʒiishee, ka lihirina n-nyari ninsalinim zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: From where he rules, he looks down on all who live on earth.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ayi yuli booni Gihɔn. Dina n-nyɛ din zɔri gindi Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The name of the second river is the Gihon. It flows around the entire land of Cush.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinima, o ni ti siɣisi ba; ka ŋunkam mi mali karimbaani ni ti nya filiŋ; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: Human pride will be ended, and human arrogance will be destroyed. Idols will completely disappear, and the Lord alone will be exalted on that day.

dag: N di mmaŋ shɛhira, ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba di ma shɛhira pahi.
en: I testify on my own behalf, and the Father who sent me also testifies on my behalf.

dag: Ka o daa lan lu Dauda sizuura ka yɛli, Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka a ti lihi nya mani ŋun nyɛ ba kpiŋ ŋɔ lala.
en: Mephibosheth bowed again and said, I am no better than a dead dog, sir! Why should you be so good to me.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ daa malila bidibis ayi, ka bɛ daa ti chaŋ puu ni ti zabi, ka so kani ŋun ni goo ba, ka yino daa ŋme n-ku ŋun la.
en: I had two sons, but they got into a fight out in a field where there was no one to pull them apart, and one of them killed the other.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa o zuɣu dɛde. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: They put a sign above his head with the charge against him written on it: this is jesus, the king of the jews .

dag: Sokam kul kpalimmi be kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni bol o.
en: Each of you should remain as you were when you accepted God's call.

dag: Naawuni, zuliya shɛb kana ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ta a jɛmbu du kasi la daɣiri, ka ŋme n-wurim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: God, some people from other nations came to fight your people. They ruined your holy Temple. They left Jerusalem in ruins.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo, ka niŋdi nirilim; yurilim bi zabiri nyuli, di bi nyuri bara, di mi bi duhiri dimaŋa.
en: Love is patient and kind; it is not jealous or conceited or proud;.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka Naa min o saawaranim ni o tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn mali yiko pam la niŋ ma nirilim. N daa niŋ suhukpeeni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka n daa laɣim Izraɛl zuɣulaannima ni m mini ba lab kuli.
en: and who has demonstrated his graciousness for me before the king and his counselors and all the kings mighty officers. I took courage because the LORD my Gods power was with me. I gathered leaders from Israel to go up with me.

dag: Ti yaannim daa jɛmdila Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka yinim Yɛhudianim ti yɛri ni Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu shee.
en: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa garigi yɛl o, Pa tuun sun shɛli zuɣu ka ti yɛn lab a kuɣa maa, amaa a ni mɔri Naawuni la zuɣu, dama a nyɛla daadam, amaa ka zaŋ amaŋ leei Naawuni.
en: They answered, We do not want to stone you because of any good deeds, but because of your blasphemy! You are only a man, but you are trying to make yourself God.

dag: Wain tiwal pɔhiriba yi ka yi sanna, bɛ ku pɔhi ka guui zaɣ yiha niŋ? Tayiɣisi yi kana yuŋ, bɛ ni kpuɣila bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko.
en: When people pick grapes, they leave a few on the vines, and when robbers come at night, they take only what they want.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi, ti niŋ yɛda ni ti min o ni lan laɣim mali nyɛvili.
en: If we died with Christ, we know that we will also live with him.

dag: Dama n nyari ba zoya zuɣu, ka nyari ba daboya zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ ko; ka bi tɛhi ni bɛ mini zuliya shɛli nyɛla yim. Bɛ wuhiya ni bɛ be bɛ ko ka chɛ zuliya kam.
en: From the top of the rocks I see him; from the hills I gaze on him. Here is a people living alone; it doesnt consider itself among the nations.

dag: Amaa ka Rabishake bɔhi ba, Yi mini naa kɔŋko ka n dan tim ti na ni ti ti yɛli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka pa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu maa gba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛn pahi yi zuɣu di bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi ka nyu bɛmaŋmaŋ dulim.
en: The Assyrian army commander answered, My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim daa ti chɛ Naawuni maŋli jɛmbu ka di yuui pam, ka mi ka maligumaana ŋun ni wuhiri ba; ka daa bi lan doli zaligu yaha.
en: For a long time Israel was without the true God. And they were without a teaching priest, and without the law.

dag: Niriba daa mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa gba la Rɛfaim, dama Rɛfaimnima n-daa pun be nimaani, amaa Ammɔnnim daa yi booni ba la Zamzumimnima.
en: Now people thought that land was Rephaim territory as well. The Rephaim had lived there previously. But the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti tam Taai yɛla yuun pisopɔin din nyɛ naa yuusim tariga la. Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti paai, Taai ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ pagɔr so yɛla yili yilli.
en: A time is coming when Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the lifetime of a king. When those years are over, Tyre will be like the prostitute in the song:.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N dana, ka yuri ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka malaika so ŋun daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa garigi yɛli ma, N ni wuh a bɛ yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka do so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa daa garigi yɛli.
en: I said, What are these, sir? The messenger speaking with me said, I will show you what they are.

dag: N zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu mi kaman Naawuni ni zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu shɛm, dama n zaŋ ya tila Masia kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi paɣipiɛliga tiri do yino shɛm la.
en: I am jealous for you with a jealousy that comes from God. I promised to give you to Christ. He must be your only husband. I want to give you to Christ to be his pure bride.

dag: Ka di varanda wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita awɛi, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di mini jɛmbu duu maa puuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛla yim, ka di dubu mi daa nyɛ mita pihinunaanahi, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima alali pa di puuni dukpina zuɣu.
en: Across the front of the temple was a porch as long as the temple was and thirty feet wide, and thirty feet high. He covered the inside walls with pure gold.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma sani, paɣ ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ doo, ka doo gba ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ paɣa;.
en: In our life in the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

dag: Wummiya! Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn zo n-tiligi yi Babilɔn kanna ni bɛ ti yɛli Ziɔnnima Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu zuɣu shɛm.
en: The Babylonian army destroyed my temple, but soon I will take revenge. Then refugees from Babylon will tell about it in Zion.

dag: ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Hɔrinim nanima kaman bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the Horite tribal chiefs, listed according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

dag: Di saha maa kpariba daa chɛla bɛ tuma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ka nyin Dɛbɔra ti yiɣisi. O daa yiɣisiya m-bemi kaman Izraɛlnim ma la.
en: There were no soldiers in Israel until you came, Deborah, until you came to be a mother to Israel.

dag: Nashɔn daa nyɛla Salima ba, ka Salima daa nyɛ Bɔaz ba.
en: Salmon, Boaz.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Ti kulimi n yiŋa ka n ti niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di, ka n ti a yɔri.
en: Then the king said to the prophet, Come home with me and have something to eat. I will reward you for what you have done.

dag: ka daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya so ka o ye binyɛr piɛlli din mali shaara, ka lo salima din nyɛ alali shɛlɔrigu.
en: I looked up and suddenly saw a man clothed in linen in front of me. He had a brilliant gold belt around his waist.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Vuri mɔni Rama, di nyɛla fabila mini kuhigu pam. Reechɛl n-kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni so di maag o suhu o bihi maa zuɣu, dama bɛ lan kani.
en: This is what the Lord says: A sound is heard in Ramah— bitter crying and great sadness. Rachel cries for her children, and she refuses to be comforted, because her children are gone.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim yi ti niŋ ka yi bi deei n noli, di saha n ni darigi yi tibili ʒiibuyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: If, despite all that, you still do not obey me, I will punish you for your sins seven more times.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ti ku lan tum tuumbiɛri, bɛ mi ti ku ŋma ʒiri, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa mi ti ku be bɛ noya ni. Di saha bɛ ni ti di ka dɔni, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ wuntizɔriba ka lihi ʒiɛm bɛ tab la ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni.
en: Jesus told this parable to certain people who had convinced themselves that they were righteous and who looked on everyone else with disgust.

dag: Di saha maa kpariba daa chɛla bɛ tuma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ka nyin Dɛbɔra ti yiɣisi. O daa yiɣisiya m-bemi kaman Izraɛlnim ma la.
en: Villagers disappeared; they disappeared in Israel, until you, Deborah, arose, until you arose as a mother in Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali, ka chani gind a sara maligu bimbini.
en: Lord , I wash my hands to show that I am innocent and march in worship around your altar.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi ni daa na ʒi Naawuni la, yi daa bela dunia ŋɔ binshɛŋa din pa bin jɛmda dabitim ni.
en: In the past you did not know God. You were slaves to gods that were not real.

dag: Shɛm ni daa dɔɣi Aripakishad maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Arpachshad was born, Shem lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ti ni daa be bɛ sani n-guli ti piɛri ŋɔ saha shɛli maa zaa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ gooni gili ti yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: They protected us day and night the whole time we were with them looking after our flocks.

dag: Ka o yɛli, O tɔhira. O ni daa paai yiŋ na ka Yisa daŋ o di yɛla tɔɣisibu ka bɔh o, Saimɔn, wula ka a lee tɛhiri di yɛla? Ka lan bɔh o pahi, Banim sani ka dunia ŋɔ nanim lee deeri farigu: Bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋbihi sani bee saamba sani.
en: Yes, he said. But when they came into the house, Jesus spoke to Peter first.What do you think, Simon? From whom do earthly kings collect taxes, from their children or from strangers.

dag: ka o ti su Yaakubu zuliya sahakam, ka o nam ti ku mali bahigu.
en: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.

dag: Ansarisimaana bɔrila yɛm kɔŋda, amaa baŋsim yɛla bi to ŋun mali tɛhi zilima sani.
en: Conceited people can never become wise, but intelligent people learn easily.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu naai, ka o daa zaŋ alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi ti o. Naawuni daa zaŋla o nubila n-sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu.
en: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb yihiri Masia yɛla waazu la nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zuɣu, amaa ka shɛb mi yihiri li la dalir suŋ zuɣu.
en: Some certainly preach Christ with jealous and competitive motives, but others preach with good motives.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra, ka Mɛmfisi nabihi nyɛ bɛn yɔhindi niriba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri birigi Ijiptinima.
en: The officials of Tanis have become fools; the princes of Memphis are deluded; the tribal chiefs have led Egypt astray.

dag: Naawuni ni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛm m-bala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ mini zuɣusaa dahin shɛli.
en: And that is how the universe was created. When the Lord God made the universe.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa teei di ni daa sab yɛli shɛm la yɛla. Di ni daa sab shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni.
en: His disciples remembered that the scripture says, My devotion to your house, O God, burns in me like a fire.

dag: Mani n-zal a ni a kul mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul be a sani luɣ shɛlikam a ni chana.
en: Remember, I commanded you to be strong and brave. Dont be afraid, because the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

dag: Ka Tama daa niŋ tampiligim buɣ o zuɣu ka darigi cheeg o ni daa ye saalo shɛli maa, ka kah o nuhi pa o zuɣu ni n-kuhiri pampam chana.
en: She sprinkled ashes on her head, tore her robe, and with her face buried in her hands went away crying.

dag: Ka wula ka man Dauda ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lee lan yɛn yɛli yaha zaŋ chaŋ a ni tibigi ma shɛm ŋɔ polo? A mi a dabili.
en: What more can I say to you! You know me well, and yet you honor me, your servant.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ ni mali wun shɛŋa la be ya? Bɛ yi ni tooi tiligi ya, yin chɛliya ka bɛ kana ti tiligi ya yi muɣisigu saha, dama yinim Judanima, yi fɔntinsi ni kul galisi shɛm, lala ka yi wuna gba galisi.
en: But where are the idols you made for yourselves? Lets see if they come and save you when you are in trouble! People of Judah, you have as many idols as you have cities!.

dag: Wɛi, yɛl biɛɣu ni paai Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbini, ka nyɛ Dauda ni daa be tin shɛli ni la. Chɛ ka churi ŋɔ kul puhiri yuuni kam.
en: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ m bia duɣi ŋubi n-kaai biɛɣu, ka n yɛl o, Zaŋm a bidibiga la na ka ti duɣi ŋub, ka ŋun zaŋ o bidibiga maa ti sɔɣi. .
en: So we cooked and ate my son. The next day I said to her, Hand over your son so we can eat him. But she had hidden her son.

dag: Ahi daa nyɛla Abidiɛl bia, ka Abidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Guni bia la daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: Ahi was Abdiels son. Abdiel was Gunis son. Ahi was the leader of their family.

dag: Yi paɣiba mini yi bihi ni yi biŋkɔbiri bɛn ni kpalim be n ni zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa tin ya maa ni.
en: Your wives, your little children, and your cattle will stay here in the cities I have given you.

dag: n-ti bahi ku Amalɛknim bɛn daa zo n-tiligi la, ka ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: There they killed the surviving Amalekites, and they have lived there ever since.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa na kul kpalim bela teeku maa sunsuuni, ka Yisa kɔŋko mi kpalim be duli.
en: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the lake, while Jesus was alone on land.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Bɔhimiya Juda kpamba, Bɔzuɣu ka yinim nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa naa zaŋ kulis o yiŋa, hal ka Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ti paai man naa?.
en: King David sent a message to Zadok and Abiathar the priests. David said, Speak to the leaders of Judah and tell them, Why are you the last tribe to bring King David back home? See, all the Israelites are talking about bringing the king back home.

dag: Lee baŋmiya ni yi yi ku ma, ŋun ka taali ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi mini ya ŋɔ tiŋgbani ni ya ŋɔ nim zuɣu, dama yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ n-tim ma yi sanna ni n ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli ya ka yi wum.
en: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord .

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka bɛ bahi ba ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: At dawn, the men and their donkeys were sent off.

dag: a yi zaŋ a salima bahi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zaŋ salima din yi Ofiri na ti bahi kulibɔŋ kuŋ ni kuɣa zuɣu.
en: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.

dag: Aduna zuliya, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let the priests of God say, His love is eternal.

dag: N ni lan labi ti be m biɛhigu shee hal ka bɛ ti saɣi ni bɛ tum taali, ka bo n shee. Bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, bɛ ni bo n shee.
en: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.

dag: Ka Samsin ba daa chaŋ paɣisarili maa yiŋa, ka Samsin ti chɛ ka bɛ puhi chuɣu nimaani; dama lala ka nachimba daa yi niŋda.
en: His father traveled down to the woman, and Samson put on a feast there, as was the custom for young men.

dag: Pita ni daa baŋ lala maa, ka o chaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Maak la ma Mariama yiŋa. Niriba pam n-daa laɣim be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: Realizing this, he made his way to Marys house. Many believers had gathered there and were praying.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa ti yɛli Yisifu, N zahimla zahindi ka bi nya so ŋun ni wuhi ma di gbinni; ka n wum ka bɛ yɛli ma ni bɛ yi yɛl a zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm, a ni tooi wuhi di gbinni.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, I had a dream, and no one can explain it for me. I heard that you can explain dreams when someone tells you about them.

dag: Ka Jɔda daa nyɛ Jɔanan bia, ka Jɔanan nyɛ Riisa bia, ka Riisa nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl bia, ka Zɛrubabɛl nyɛ Shialtiɛl bia, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Nɛri bia.
en: Joanan, Rhesa, Zerubbabel, Shealtiel, Neri.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa ti be Tɛsalɔnaika la yi daa tim sɔŋsim na ti ti ma, ka daa lan niŋ lala di nyaaŋa zaŋ chana.
en: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn je ninvuɣ so ŋun galindi din bi tuhi, ka zaɣisiri ŋun yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: You hate those prophets, who go to public places and speak against evil, even though they teach good, simple truths.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam yirila o tab sunsuuni na ni o ʒe bɛ zaani n-zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu niriba daalahichi zuɣu Naawuni sani.
en: Every high priest is chosen from his fellow-men and appointed to serve God on their behalf, to offer sacrifices and offerings for sins.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Kamiyana ka ti chaŋ Giligal nti lan leei ti nam maa.
en: Come on! Samuel said. Let's go to Gilgal and make an agreement that Saul will continue to be our king.

dag: Jɛra tuma nyɛla din gbarigiri ba, hal ka bɛ bi lan mi yiŋ soli gba.
en: Fools wear themselves out— they don't know enough to find their way home.

dag: Ka n ni daa du zoli zuɣu ni n ti deei kuɣ parilana ayi din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli kuɣ parilana la, n daa kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi. N daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom.
en: I went up the mountain to get the stone tablets. The agreement that the Lord made with you was written on those stones. I stayed on the mountain days and nights. I did not eat any food or drink any water.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool, Yawɛ n-daa tim ma na ka n ti booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leeg o niriba naa; dinzuɣu wummi ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Samuel said to Saul, I am the one whom the Lord sent to anoint you king of his people Israel. Now listen to what the Lord Almighty says.

dag: N suhu je yi goli pala churi mini yi ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu la. Di leela ʒitibisili n sani, di ʒibu wum ma pam.
en: I hate your new moons and your festivals. Theyve become a burden that Im tired of bearing.

dag: Amaa ka a daa lan pɔbisi a pɔhim, ka teeku kom lim ba, ka bɛ shim ko tiŋa kaman kurigu n-lu kopurim ni la.
en: But when you got furious, they sank like lead, swallowed by ocean waves.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila wɔridib shɛba bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kɔre be wɔrinyama ni la; sokam kɔre daa bela o kpee paɣa bɔbu ni.
en: They are lusty stallions roving about, snorting for anothers wife.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam Naawuni tiŋ la ni, o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: In the city belonging to our God, the LORD is great and so worthy of praise! His holy mountain.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bom yuma ata naɣilaa mini yuma ata bunyaŋ ni yuma ata piɛlaa ni ŋmanʒee ni yiŋ ŋmani ti ma.
en: He answered, Bring me a cow, a goat, and a ram, each of them three years old, and a dove and a pigeon.

dag: Ka o mi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba, dama o nyɛla ŋun mi shɛlikam. O bi yɛri ka labiri nyaaŋa. O ni darigi tuumbiɛtumdiba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa tibili.
en: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.

dag: Niriba yɛla bɛ noya gu ma, bɛ lab ma tapaɣisi din ku dɔni, ka laɣim tab liri ma.
en: People have crowded around me. They make fun of me and slap my face.

dag: ka zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu neen shɛŋa din nyɛ buɣim moori binyara mini gbabɔnima ni soobuya ni taha ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu nɛma zaa pa di zuɣu, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They will place on it all the equipment used for servicing it, the censers, the meat fork, the shovels, the bowls, all the equipment of the altar. They will spread a covering of fine leather over it and then set its poles in place.

dag: ka Nan bia Hɔshia daa yi Ifriim zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Ephraim—Hoshea son of Nun;.

dag: Ka Musa yɛl o, A yi ku doli ti chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka ti yiɣisi kpe.
en: Moses replied, If you do not go with us, don't make us leave this place.

dag: Ka o ʒim maa yi na yir o, ka o dɔni bindo shɛlikam zuɣu, di ni bemi kaman o ni yi pun nyari sɔrilim ka dooni bindo shɛli zuɣu ka di nyɛ shɛm la. Ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim la.
en: Any bed she lies on during the time of her discharge will be like her bed during the time of her monthly bleeding. Everything she sits on will be unclean, just as it is during the time she is unclean from her monthly bleeding.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: About that time the followers came to Jesus and asked, Who is the greatest in Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam dindali maa ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli n yiŋa.
en: Then David was afraid of the Lord and said, How can I take the Covenant Box with me now.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Nyin Ahitub bia ŋɔ wumma. Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, n wumda.
en: Saul said to Ahimelech, Listen, Ahimelech! At your service, sir, he answered.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa yu ni bɛ niŋ lala, ka di mi shiri simdi ni bɛ niŋ lala ti ba, dama bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi daa nya Naawuni alibarika Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zuɣu, dindina di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba zaŋ dunia ŋɔ binyara sɔŋ ba.
en: They were happy to do this, and they are actually in debt to Gods people in Jerusalem. If the Gentiles got a share of the Jewish peoples spiritual resources, they ought to minister to them with material resources.

dag: Naa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka nyɛ ŋun yuri zaligu soli, a nyɛla ŋun zali yɛlimaŋli soli. A nyɛla ŋun doli zaligu mini wuntia soli din be Yaakubu zuliya ni kari saria.
en: You are the powerful King who loves justice. You have made things right. You have brought goodness and fairness to Jacob.

dag: Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Bɔ ka yi lee du m-ba ka na kul be ti ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛli ŋɔ puuni maa.
en: I, Sennacherib, Emperor of Assyria, ask what gives you people the confidence to remain in Jerusalem under siege.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni ni ti mali bindir suma. O ni ti mali bindir shɛŋa di ni simdi ni naa di.
en: Asher's land will produce rich food. He will provide food fit for a king.

dag: Dama a Duuma saɣisirila o ni yuri so, ka fiɛbiri o ni zaŋ so leeg o bia.
en: The Lord disciplines everyone he loves; he punishes everyone he accepts as a child. Proverbs :-.

dag: N yɛli noli tin ya, dama yi zuliya maa zaa fari ma mi.
en: You are being cursed with a curse, and you, the entire nation, are robbing me.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, n kamina ni n ti ti a yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: Gabriel helped me understand the things I wanted to know. He said, Daniel, I have come to give you wisdom and to help you understand.

dag: Mia pi tiŋgban ni guli ba, ka tɔŋ do sol ni guli ba.
en: hidden along the path.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa zaŋ takɔbi din yir o nol ni na ku bɛn kpalim, ka noonsi zaa daa di nimdi tiɣi.
en: The rest were killed by the sword that comes from the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds ate their fill of their flesh.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ nti ʒini tin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la ni di chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Bɛ daa yɛliya ni bɛ ni ti bol o Nazarɛt nira.
en: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, He will be called a Nazarene.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pini zuɣukpina, ka so buri a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum a zuɣu ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini fabila pam.
en: they shave their heads and dress in sackcloth as they cry in despair.

dag: ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Rɛfaimnim.
en: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti ʒini maa, yin zaŋmiya alibarika ŋɔ ti tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu, ka zaŋya noli dibu ŋɔ mi ti tam Ɛbal Zoli zuɣu.
en: Now when the LORD your God brings you into the land that you are entering to take possession of, put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal. .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a yihi li bɛ nuhi maa ni n-zaŋ li pahi sara shɛli din yɛn nyo buɣim maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Then take it from them and burn it on the altar, on top of the burnt offering, as a food offering to me. The odor of this offering pleases me.

dag: Ka n daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti yɛli ba, N tumdila tuun shɛli din niŋ kamaata, n ku tooi kana. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ tuma maa ka di kpalim zani, ka ka yi sanna.
en: So I sent messengers to tell them, My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dapuhi maa n-tuntu ban shɛŋa din daa be sara maligu bimbini maa luɣa zuɣu la ni, ka bɛ mal li kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa. O daa zaŋla taabo dari mal li, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu.
en: and put them in the rings on each side of the altar. The altar was made of boards and was hollow.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa biŋkpam ni zugbini kpam ni kpam din pili namanama ni binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla.
en: and the fat pieces of the ox and ram—the fat tail, the covering fat, the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pia puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pinaayi dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the twelfth day of the tenth month of the tenth year of exile, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒini Naawuni jɛmbu duu miri bɛ liɣiri tɔhibu shee n-yuuni niriba ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm; ka bundaannim tɔhiri pampam.
en: As Jesus sat near the Temple treasury, he watched the people as they dropped in their money. Many rich men dropped in a lot of money;.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa siɣi teeku maa ni n-doli tiŋ kuŋ maa chana, ka koma maa be kaman goma la n-ʒe bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: The Israelites went through the sea on dry land. The water was like a wall on their right and on their left.

dag: Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya. Timiya ba bɛ tarili bɛ ba mabihi maa sani, ka bɛ ba tarili leei bɛ dini.
en: What the daughters of Zelophehad request is right; give them property among their father's relatives. Let his inheritance pass on to them.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Do so n-daa mal o bidibis ayi.
en: Then Jesus said, There was a man who had two sons.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali suhupiɛlli n zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ n san la nya filiŋ ka di vi.
en: Let my enemies be ashamed and embarrassed— all those who were happy about my troubles. Proud of themselves, they treated me as worthless. So let them be covered with shame and disgrace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ban yini ga di zuɣusaa polo tabili taba, amaa ka di zaŋ siɣi tiŋ na lee woligi taba. Lala ka bɛ daa mali diba ayi maa niŋ lɔris ayi maa ni.
en: These frames were joined together at the bottom. And at the top a ring held the corner frames together. They did the same for both corners.

dag: Shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhi ni o ni niŋ o ni lo a alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: A bɔri ni mahim chaŋla tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia bee di lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Isaiah replied, The Lord will prove to you that he will keep his promise. Will the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway go forward ten steps or back ten steps.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Bashan oki tihi m-mali a ŋariŋ duhirisi. Bɛ zaŋla Saipurus teeku duli wolifahi dari mali a puuni ka niŋ wɔbinyina pa di zuɣu.
en: For your oars, they used the oaks of Bashan. They made your hull, inlaid with ivory, of boxwood from the coasts of Cyprus.

dag: Teebuya ayi n-daa ʒe zɔntua maa samban ni dunɔdali nuzaa polo, ka teebuya ayi ʒe zɔntua maa dunɔdali yaɣ din la polo.
en: There were also two tables on each side of the door on the outside wall of this porch.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋ biɛhigu pal shɛli Naawuni ni daa nam ka di ŋmani ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ biɛhigu ka nyɛ din tuhi ka be kasi n-ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: and clothe yourself with the new person created according to Gods image in justice and true holiness.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Kamiya Bɛtɛl na nti tum tuumbiɛri; ka chaŋya Giligal nti tum tuumbiɛri. Zaŋmiya yi asiba kam sara maligu na, ka zaŋ yi bini pii puuni zaɣ yini na daba ata dali kam.
en: Come to Bethel—and commit a crime; multiply crimes at Gilgal. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tenth-part gifts every three days.

dag: Wuntizɔra ni mali shɛli ka di pɔra so ninvuɣ biɛri daazichi pam.
en: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa lee chani Filistianim maa sani nti tɛhiri bɛ naɣikɔra kubiɛlima mini bɛ lɛbiɛlima ni kpanbiɛlima ni gɔriti zaa.
en: So every Israelite had to go down to the Philistines to sharpen their plowshares, mattocks, axes, and sickles.

dag: Dama mani n-yihi bɛ ni zaŋ bimbihili shɛli gahigahi la mini bɛ ni zaŋ nudirigu gbali shɛli mali Izraɛlnim suhudoo sara la Izraɛlnim sani n-zaŋ li ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli ʒiɛman kam ni.
en: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ mini Speen ŋarima ʒirila Naawuni niriba kulisirina. Bɛ zaŋla salima mini anzinfa pahi bɛ zuɣu na ni bɛ ti tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yuli, dama o chɛ ka yi nya jilima.
en: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord . Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala yihi nanima anu maa vol maa ni na ti ti o. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa.
en: So the cave was opened, and the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon were brought out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋubi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni vamahili kam, ka saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: they ate all the plants in the land; they ate all the crops.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Jɛhɔzabad, o mi daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinu bɛn daa gbibi bidibbina m-mali shili gu tɔbu.
en: Jehozabad was second in command, with , soldiers under him.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima n-chɛ ka a neesim neei; dama a neesim kana. Yawɛ jilima neeg a sani.
en: Arise! Shine! Your light has come; the LORDs glory has shone upon you.

dag: Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Aran.
en: Dishan's sons were Uz and Aran.

dag: Di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam nti yaɣi ka bɛ yɛra, O niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, hal o chɛ ka tikpiranim wumda, ka chɛ ka biriti gba tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: They were completely amazed and said, Everything he does is good! He even heals people who cannot hear or talk.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka wum n dimnim ni yɛri shɛm.
en: Lord , listen to me! Listen to what my enemies are saying.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a dimnim zaa kpi lala, amaa ka chɛ ka a zɔnim mi ne kaman wuntaŋ ni puhirina ni yaa n-ne shɛm la. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: May all your enemies perish like this, LORD! But may your allies be like the sun, rising in its strength. And the land was peaceful for forty years.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi fiɛb o bupihinahi, amaa di bi simdi ni di gari lala. Bɛ yi fiɛb o gari lala dindina yi ʒiʒiinikpee maa ni nya filiŋ yi ninni.
en: Give no more than forty blows. If more than that is given, your fellow Israelite would be completely disgraced in your eyes.

dag: Nol lɔbu maa daba ata dali ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o nam binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe n-ʒe nayili zɔŋ ni tuhi nam ʒiishee duu. Naa maa daa ʒila o nam ʒiishee tuhi dunoli.
en: Three days later, Esther dressed in her royal robes and went to the inner court of the palace in front of the throne. The king was sitting there, facing the open doorway.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa lihi paɣiba maa yɛligu maa kaman lahibal kpɛma, ka daa bi dihi li tabili. .
en: Their words struck the apostles as nonsense, and they didnt believe the women.

dag: N kul nɛmi doya; n ŋmanila noombil ŋun be mɔpilli zuɣu o ko.
en: I lie awake all night. Im all alone like a bird on a roof.

dag: Siria Naa daa pun bahila o sapashinnim pihitanaayi bɛn su o chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi noli yɛli, Di ti tuhiya wɔɣiri so bee tarim so, naɣila Izraɛl naa kɔŋko.
en: The king of Aram had chariot commanders. He gave them this command, Dont go after anyone except the king of Israel, no matter how important they are.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N lan yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, Daadam Bia gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa Naawuni malaikanim sani;.
en: If you tell others that you belong to me, the Son of Man will tell God's angels that you are my followers.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu, ka yi yi di baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni, yi naan ku zaŋ bɛn ka galimi taali.
en: The Scriptures say, I dont want animal sacrifices; I want you to show kindness to people. You dont really know what that means. If you understood it, you would not judge those who have done nothing wrong.

dag: Nyin ka n kuhiri niŋda. Tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.

dag: n-ti Gibiɔnnim maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ti ku ba zoli maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa laɣim kpi. Puu atam kpuɣibu saha, kachɛɣu piligu ni ka bɛ daa ku ba maa.
en: turned them over to the Gibeonites, who hanged all seven of them on the mountain near the place where the Lord was worshiped. This happened right at the beginning of the barley harvest.

dag: Dauda bapira Jɔnatan n-daa nyɛ saawaralana ŋun mi niriba yɛlimuɣisira, ka lan nyɛ gbansabira karimba. O mini Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔni bia la n-daa nyɛ bɛn lihiri naa bidibisi.
en: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.

dag: Dindali maa Izraɛlnim daa zanila Mikimash n-ku Filistianim maa lala hal ti paai Aijalɔn. Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam.
en: That day, after they had fought the Philistines from Michmash to Aijalon, the troops were completely exhausted.

dag: Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni nimaani, ka salo maa zaa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: Such large crowds gathered around him that he climbed into a boat and sat down. The whole crowd was standing on the shore.

dag: Yɛlim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni o wuhim a shihirili; di ni tooi nyɛ din zilima kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee din du kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.

dag: N ni yɛl a o naba min o bɔɣiri ni o yaa ni o biɛhigu ni viɛl shɛm yɛla.
en: Let me tell you about Leviathan's legs and describe how great and strong he is.

dag: Niriba soya yi tiɣi Yawɛ nini, hal o ni chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ dimnim be ni suhudoo.
en: When people live to please the Lord , even their enemies will be at peace with them.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, n kul ʒiɛla n zaashee wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: Then a guard said, I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-tahi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ duu na. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbaligu bihim duɣi bɛ bihi.
en: Give the Lord the very first crops that you harvest. Bring them to the house of the Lord your God. Never cook a young goat in its mothers milk.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima dooi naɣibil kɔtomsi zali, ka kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mal li; ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi pam bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa ni noonsi balibu kam ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛn chani gindi dunia ni balibu kam zaa daa dol taba yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: All the animals and birds went out of the boat in groups of their own kind.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililana tumdila jɛrilim, ka yɛndan mi nyɛ ŋun be baalim.
en: People with a hot temper do foolish things; wiser people remain calm.

dag: Bɛ valila azichi, ka lan ti li bahina, Naawuni n-yihi li bɛ puya ni bahina.
en: The wicked vomit up the wealth they stole; God takes it back, even out of their stomachs.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka baansi yiini yila yɛra, Kamiya Hɛshibɔn na, mɛmiya li. Chɛliya ka Sihɔn tiŋ maa zani.
en: That is why the poets sing, Come to Heshbon, to King Sihon's city! We want to see it rebuilt and restored.

dag: Nir yi chaŋ kumsi ni be yil shɛli, di so ni o chaŋ dimma ni nyubu ni be yil shɛli. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni baŋ ni kum nyɛla din yɛn paai sokam zaa.
en: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.

dag: O daa lan zali Lɛvinim maa shɛba ni bɛ nyɛ bɛn yɛn su Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa tuma, ka suhiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka puhir o ka paɣir o.
en: Then David chose some of the Levites to serve before the Lord s Holy Box. They had the job of celebrating and giving thanks and praise to the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a zaligunim soya, ka n dol li hal ni di tariga.
en: Lord , teach me your laws, and I will always follow them.

dag: Yisa daa bi be kaman o wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naɣ yɛlila Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda.
en: But Jesus overheard their report and said to the synagogue leader, Dont be afraid; just keep trusting.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi binyɛra maa ni be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni dilan paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Any who touch them are unclean and must wash their clothes and take a bath; they remain unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaɣisi kpamba la ni daa wuh o shɛm la, ka zaŋla yɛtɔɣ yoli yɛli niriba maa.
en: The king then answered the people harshly. He ignored the elders advice.

dag: Neemiya n-kpaŋsi din kpalim be yi ni n-yɛn kpi maa, dama n nya ka yi tuma bi be dɛde n Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Wake up! Make yourselves stronger before what little strength you have left is completely gone. I find that what you do is not good enough for my God.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o deemba maa Yawɛ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim shɛm zaa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnima. Ka lan yɛl o muɣisigu shɛŋa zaa din paai ba soli maa ni yɛla ni Yawɛ ni yihi ba muɣisigu maa ni shɛm.
en: Moses then told his father-in-law everything that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians on Israels behalf, all the difficulty they had on their journey, and how the LORD had rescued them.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri beni hal ti kurigi ka kul mali yiko pam?.
en: Why does God let evil people live, let them grow old and prosper?.

dag: Yi zaŋ yimaŋ niŋ alaha n-chani ginda, ka taɣiri jɛmbu soya. Ijiptinim ni ti dihi ya vi kaman Asirianim ni daa dihi ya vi shɛm la.
en: You have cheapened yourself by turning to the gods of other nations. You will be disappointed by Egypt, just as you were by Assyria.

dag: dama nyini n Duuma Naawuni, a ku chɛ ma ka n kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee; ka a mi ku chɛ ka a Ninvuɣ suŋ niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: because you wont abandon me to the grave, nor permit your holy one to experience decay. .

dag: Di saha ka Mɛmukan daa yɛli naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa, Pa naa kɔŋko ka Napaɣ Vashiti lihi ʒiɛm maa, amaa o tuma zuɣulaannim gba hal zaŋ tabili doo kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa!.
en: Then Memucan told the king and the officials: Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.

dag: N yi ti teeg a nintam la yɛla, n suhu kul yɛla a nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli.
en: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.

dag: Yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm, lala ka yi ni ti ŋub ba, bɛn ka kasi mini bɛn be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub li.
en: But be sure to eat it as if it were gazelle or deer. People who are polluted and people who are purified can feast on it together.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli ka n wum: Yiya pam ni ti zani dabari, ka so ti ku be yiya din galisi mini yiya din viɛl ni.
en: I heard the LORD of heavenly forces say this: Many houses will become total ruins, large, fine houses, with no one living in them.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yiko puuni o kuri wɔɣira. O yi tum o tuma, ninvuɣ biɛri kpirimi.
en: They drag away the strong by force; they may get up but without guarantee of survival.

dag: Gbibiya Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin kaman n ni daa zali ya shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni zal li saha shɛli Abib gol ni, dama Abib goli maa ni ka yi daa yi Ijipti na.
en: Observe the Festival of Unleavened Bread. You should eat unleavened bread for seven days, as I commanded you, at the set time in the month of Abib, because it was in the month of Abib that you came out of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa ni daa zaŋ gban shɛli ti Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomnanim mini zuɣulaannim la ti ba, ka bɛ daa zani bɛ nyaaŋa ka sɔŋ ba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma ni.
en: They also delivered the kings orders to the royal chief administrators and governors of the province Beyond the River, who supported the people and Gods house.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ti nyari binyara mi kaman diɣi liti ni ka ti lihira; amaa saha yi ti paai, ti nini yipa ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Pumpɔŋɔ m bi mi binshɛɣukam zaa, amaa saha kanna ka n ni ti mi zaa kaman Naawuni ni mi ma zaa shɛm la.
en: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.

dag: Sokam zaa ni daa pun niŋdi tiliginsim nyabu tahima maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra, Amii Masia la m-bala bee so mi.
en: The people were filled with expectation, and everyone wondered whether John might be the Christ.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi lan yɛli yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna yɛla, dama yɛlimuɣisirili maa nyɛla sokam maŋmaŋ yɛligu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi taɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka nyɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: But you will never again use the expression, The announcement of the Lord . That is because his message should not be a heavy load for anyone. But you changed the words of our God. He is the living God, the Lord All-Powerful!.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teei yi ni daa nyɛ bipola ka ʒe yim shɛm la yɛla. Yi yurilim daa ŋmanila amiliya yurilim, yi daa doli ma la tiŋgban nɛl ni, din nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli ni so ni na ʒi m-biri binshɛli.
en: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu yi yi bi chɛri yi mabihi taali paŋdi ba yi suhuri ni, lala ka m Ba Naawuni gba ti yɛn niŋ yi zaa yinoyino.
en: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.

dag: Nyam biŋkɔbiri ni bamdi shɛm. Niɣi kul chanimi gindi mɔri ni kani ka bɛ ni ŋubi zuɣu; ka piɛri mini buhi gba kul diri wahala.
en: The cattle are bellowing in distress because there is no pasture for them; the flocks of sheep also suffer.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni wɔɣ ni tab shɛm, lala ka n soya be di ko ka chɛ yi soya, ka n tɛha gba be di ko ka chɛ yi tɛha.
en: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, so my ways are higher than your ways, and my thoughts are higher than your thoughts.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpambaliba nini daa tiɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The king and his officials liked this plan.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binnɛma balibu kam, bɛnya tiŋgbani zuɣu; niɣi mini binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam. Ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: God said, I command the earth to give life to all kinds of tame animals, wild animals, and reptiles. And that's what happened.

dag: ni Bɛtinimira ni Bɛtiharan, ka me buzɔna zali bɛ piɛri mini buhi, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.

dag: Ka ti paɣ li sahakam mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka puhir a pam.
en: Always and everywhere, most honorable Felix, we acknowledge this with deep gratitude.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ buŋ nyaampara pa buŋa, ka o yɛl o tumtumda, Niŋm buŋ maa ka o chani yomyom, ka di chɛ ka o baligi chandi naɣila mani nti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o baligi chandi.
en: She saddled the donkey, then said to her young servant, Drive the donkey hard. Dont let me slow down unless I tell you.

dag: O yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn chɛ saria karibu din bi doli zaligu soli mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyaaŋa zanibu?.
en: How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?.

dag: Naawuni, a chandi mali jiri pam ka niriba nyari li. N Naawuni ni n Naa maa chanimi ni o ti kpe o jɛmbu duu.
en: God, everyone can see your victory parade— the victory march of my God and King into his holy place!.

dag: Taibɛrius Siiza ni daa diri nam, ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu saha shɛl la, ka Pɔntius Pailɛt daa nyɛ Judia Gomna, ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa diri Galili, ka o tizo Filip daa su Ituria mini Trakɔnaitis, ka Naa Laisanias diri Abiliin.
en: In the fifteenth year of the rule of the emperor Tiberius—when Pontius Pilate was governor over Judea and Herod was ruler over Galilee, his brother Philip was ruler over Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias was ruler over Abilene.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ni bɛ boli ya karimbanima, dama karimba yino ka yi mali, ka yinim bɛn zaa kpalim nyɛla mabihi ni taba.
en: But you must not be called Teacher. You are all equal as brothers and sisters. You have only one Teacher.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti bi nya Yisa tuumba maa sarika maa ni ka labina ti yɛli.
en: But when the officials arrived, they did not find the apostles in prison, so they returned to the Council and reported.

dag: Ka Samsin paɣ maa daa chaŋ Samsin sani ti kumdi niŋd o yɛra, A bi yuri ma. A ŋahi n niriba ŋahili, ka bi wuhi ma ŋahili maa gbinni. Ka Samsin yɛl o, Nyama, hal m bi wuhi m ba bee m ma di gbinni, ka ti wuhiri nyini.
en: So Samsons wife cried on his shoulder and said, You hate me! You dont love me! You told a riddle to my people but didnt tell me the answer. He replied to her, Look, I havent even told the answer to my father and mother. Why should I tell it to you.

dag: Di kumdiya ŋun kpi zuɣu bee n-fabindi o zuɣu. Amaa lee kummiyala bɛ ni gbaai so chaŋ zuɣu, dama o ku lan labina ka o nini ti nya o tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Dont cry for the king who has died. Dont cry for him. But cry very hard for the king who must leave this place. Cry for him because he will never return or see his homeland again.

dag: Di saha maa ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ bɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini din daa nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpa viɛlli na ti niŋdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri maa ni.
en: Then all Judah brought the tenth-part gifts of the grain, wine, and oil into the storehouses.

dag: Ka bɛ zaani zuɣusaa asiba mini zaawuni kam m-paɣiri ka tibigiri Yawɛ.
en: They were to be present every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and to do the same every evening.

dag: Ka niriba ni ʒini nimaani ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri ku lan zɔhiri mbusim shɛli ti paai ba m-bahi ba yoli zuɣu.
en: The people will live there in safety, no longer threatened by destruction.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋub li ni nya tibidarigibo. Dama o saɣim Yawɛ binshɛli din be kasi, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi lala nir maa o niriba ni.
en: Anyone who eats it will be liable to punishment, because they defiled what is holy to the LORD. That person will be cut off from their people.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yi Sulemaana zuɣu yuŋ yɛl o, N wum a suhigu maa, ka pii kpe ŋɔ ni di nyɛ n sara maligu duu.
en: the Lord appeared to him at night. He said to him, I have heard your prayer, and I accept this Temple as the place where sacrifices are to be offered to me.

dag: ni Hɛziro ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la ni Naarai ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛzibai bia la.
en: Hezro the Carmelite; Naarai son of Ezbai;.

dag: Kalima anahi maa zaa kɔtomsi daa nyɛla yim, ka be kaman kalinli yini kpe n-gabila di kpee ni.
en: There were four wheels, and they all looked the same. They looked like there was a wheel in a wheel.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini yaɣ shɛli din gili n zoli ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka saa miri ba saa mibu saha. Di ni ti nyɛla alibarika saa.
en: I will bless them and let them live around my sacred hill. There I will bless them with showers of rain when they need it.

dag: Di zɔntua daa kpala dundɔntitali polo. Ka bɛ daa ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣili kam. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini.
en: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard. Palm trees were carved on the walls along the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.

dag: Amaa o yi yɛli ma, N nini bi lan tiɣ a. Nyama, mani m-bɔŋɔ, O niŋmi ma kaman o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: But if God says, Im not pleased with you, then I am ready. Let him do to me whatever pleases him.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la gba daa maan o ansarisi, ka zaŋ komihigu ti o ni o nyu.
en: Even the soldiers laughed at Jesus and made fun of him. They came and offered him some sour wine.

dag: Bɛtɛl mini Ai — kɔbisiyi ni pisinaata.
en: of Bethel and Ai.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi piɛguliba maa, M mabihi, ka tiŋkani ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila Haran na.
en: Jacob said to the shepherds there, Brothers, where are you from? They answered, We are from Haran.

dag: Pa lala ka yi daa bɔhim Masia yɛla.
en: But you didnt learn that sort of thing from Christ.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Mahili bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza mini Kish.
en: Meraris family: Mahli and Mushi. Mahlis family: Eleazar and Kish.

dag: Ka Pool daa be yil shɛl ni o ni daa haayi duu la yuun muna ayi. Ka o daa kul tiri sokam bɛn kan o sanna soli ka bɛ nyar o.
en: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yili yidana yi di mi tayiɣ ni yɛn ka o yiŋ na yuŋ saha shɛli, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o, ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: If the owner of a house knew the time when the thief would come, you can be sure that he would stay awake and not let the thief break into his house.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Hivinim maa, Wula ka ti mini ya ni tooi lo tab alikauli? Dama di pa shɛli ka yi kul bela yomayoma kpe.
en: The men of Israel said to these Hivite men, Maybe you are trying to trick us. Maybe you live near us. We cannot make a peace agreement with you until we know where you are from.

dag: Yawɛ daa ti ma laara n wuntitali zuɣu; o yo ma samli n ni ka galimi zuɣu.
en: You are good to me, Lord , because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.

dag: Ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ku di. Amaa ka o tumtumdiba la mini paɣ maa daa kpaŋ bɛmaŋa m-balim o hal ka o ti saɣi, ka daa yiɣisi tiŋa n-ʒini garo zuɣu.
en: No, I won't eat! But his officers and the woman kept on urging Saul, until he finally agreed. He got up off the floor and sat on the bed.

dag: Yɛhudianim daa mal adiini jɛmbu du shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Bilichinnim jɛmbu duu. Di ni niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-yi Sairiini mini Alikizandria ni bɛn daa yi Kilikia ni Ɛsha na n-daa laɣim ŋmɛri Stiivin naŋgbankpeeni;.
en: Opposition arose from some who belonged to the so-called Synagogue of Former Slaves. Members from Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, and Asia entered into debate with Stephen.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: But I said, Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tiri ma kpiɔŋ, ka mali n soli ka di tuhi.
en: He is the God who makes me strong, who makes my pathway safe.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli sahakam n ni nam shɛli zuɣu. Suhupiɛlli ni be n ni nam Jɛrusalɛm shɛli maa ni, ka di niriba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Celebrate and be glad forever! I am creating a Jerusalem, full of happy people.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai ba, yɛtɔɣa maa ka o daa shiri zaŋ yɛli ba.
en: When he caught up to them, he repeated these words.

dag: Yi birila ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka kpuɣi atam din bi doli yɛlimaŋli. Yi dila ʒiri tiwala. Yi ni niŋ yi chɛchɛbunsi mini yi tɔbbihi bɛn galisi ŋɔ naani la zuɣu.
en: But you planted evil, and you harvested trouble. You ate the fruit of your lies, because you had trusted in your power and your soldiers.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ bidibilim n-tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknima, ka daa fa Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi liriti ba fari bɛ nɛma la nuu ni bahi.
en: He acted heroically, defeating the Amalekites and rescuing Israel from the power of any who had plundered them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa daa niŋ ba mi n-leei yɛliŋmahima, ka di sabi zali tinim bɛn be ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ni wuhibu zuɣu.
