en: All these things happened to them as examples for others, and they were written down as a warning for us. For we live at a time when the end is about to come.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei zaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ tiŋgban shɛli din bala, amaa ka bɛ lee nya kulinol shɛli ka di duli viɛla, ka bɛ daa lɔri nia ni di yi ni nani bɛ ni zaŋ ŋariŋ maa du ni.
en: In the morning light they saw a bay with a sandy beach. They didnt know what land it was, but they thought they might possibly be able to run the ship aground.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o ba maa, Nyama, man ŋun kul be a sani nahindi yuun bɔbili ŋɔ zaa ka na ʒi n-zaɣis a noli ŋɔ, a na ʒi n-gbaai hal bubil gba ti ma ni n kɔrigi ka m mini n zɔnim laɣim di ka diɛm.
en: But he said to his father, Look, for all these years I have worked like a slave for you. I have always done what you told me to do, and you never gave me even a young goat for a party with my friends.

dag: Amaa zaligu ŋɔ ka n daa naɣ zali ba, Deemiya n noli, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi mi nyɛ n niriba, ka yi tumdi n ni zali ya ni yi tummi shɛm, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: I only gave them this command: Obey me and I will be your God, and you will be my people. Do all that I command, and good things will happen to you.

dag: Ka n yi tumdi n ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa yɛr o bia Iso maa, ka Ribɛka beni wumda. Dinzuɣu saha shɛli Iso ni daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti ku nimdi maa na, ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o bia Yaakubu.
en: While Isaac was talking to Esau, Rebecca was listening. So when Esau went out to hunt.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Sulemaana tuma fukumsi m-bɔŋɔ, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinu ni pihinu bɛn lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumd o tuma.
en: There were officials in charge of the forced labor working on Solomon's various building projects.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa gbaŋ min o nimdi zaa ni o zuɣu ni o biɛhi ni o namanama ni o bindi.
en: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa tuumba la sani nti kahigi Sool ni daa nya ti Duuma sol ni ka o yɛl o shɛm wuhi ba, ka lan yɛli ba Sool ni daa zaŋ Yisa yuli yihi waazu ni suhukpeeni shɛm Damaskus.
en: But Barnabas accepted Saul and took him to the apostles. He told them how Saul had seen the Lord on the road and how the Lord had spoken to Saul. Then he told them how boldly Saul had spoken for the Lord in Damascus.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla bɛ biɛhigu puuni zaa, bɛ bela zibisim ni n-dira ni suhuyiɣisili mini sujee, ka dɔriti gbaari ba.
en: Whats more, they constantly eat in darkness, with much aggravation, grief, and anger.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bundaannim mini karimbaannim mali ti ansarisi ti yaɣi.
en: We have been mocked too long by the rich and scorned by proud oppressors.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka yi yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo.
en: Yet the Human Onecame eating and drinking, and you say, Look, a glutton and a drunk, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.

dag: Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni gunya soli n-zaŋ takɔbiri kun ya; yi ni chɛ Yawɛ dolibu maa zuɣu, Yawɛ ku be yi sani.
en: When you face the Amalekites and the Canaanites, you will die in battle; the Lord will not be with you, because you have refused to follow him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli;.
en: After they crucified him, they divided up his clothes among them by drawing lots.

dag: Di takɔriti mini di zɔntua ni di abie tihi kɔtomsi daa bemi kaman dunɔdali din be wulimpuhili polo la dina ni daa be shɛm. Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini, ka di zɔŋ be di puuni.
en: The entrance room, the windows, and the carved palm trees were like those in the east gate. Here seven steps led up to the gate, and the entrance room was at the end facing the courtyard.

dag: Ti daa wum di yɛla la Bɛtilihɛm; ti daa nya li la Jiarim mɔɣu ni.
en: In Bethlehem we heard about the Covenant Box, and we found it in the fields of Jearim.

dag: N dana, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, n zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din be di ni maa zaa ti a n niriba ŋɔ ninni ni a sɔɣ a kpim maa nimaani.
en: Listen, sir; I will give you the whole field and the cave that is in it. Here in the presence of my own people, I will give it to you, so that you can bury your wife.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti lu teeku ni ha, ka bi biɛhim o suhu ni, amaa ka niŋ yɛda ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa ni niŋ pali, o ni nya ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: I assure you that whoever tells this hill to get up and throw itself in the sea and does not doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says will happen, it will be done for him.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Naawuni, N na doli Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni? Amaa ka o bi garig o dindali maa.
en: So Saul asked God, Should I go chase the Philistines? Will you let us defeat the Philistines? But God did not answer Saul that day.

dag: ti nyari alaka, amaa ti na ʒi n-kpalim ti ko; bɛ ŋmɛri ti luhira, amaa ti bi kpira.
en: there are many enemies, but we are never without a friend; and though badly hurt at times, we are not destroyed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N niriba m-bala, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku yɔhim ma. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba.
en: He said, These are my people. These are my real children. So he saved them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda ka bɔhira, Masia yi ti kana, o ni wuhi shihira n-lan gari doo ŋɔ ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: But many of the people believed in Jesus. They said, We are waiting for the Messiah to come. When he comes, will he do more miraculous signs than this man has done.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla Naawuni yɛla, amaa man kul nyɛla ŋun mali ninsalitali biɛhigu ka nyɛ alahichi dabili.
en: We know that the law is spiritual, but I am not. I am so human. Sin rules me as if I were its slave.

dag: O ti o naa nasara pam, ka wuh o yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili Dauda min o zuliya sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You help your king win battle after battle. You show your faithful love to your chosen one, to David and his descendants forever!.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila kɔhigɔr so ŋun gɔri bɔri waya zaɣ suma.
en: Also, Gods kingdom is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.

dag: Di simdi ka o wurim yili maa ka va di kuɣa mini di yɔɣira ni di tari zaa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: It must be torn down, and its stones, its wood, and all its plaster must be carried out of the city to an unclean place.

dag: Ka Izraɛl paɣisara chani yuuni kam ti zaŋdi daba anahi fabindi Jɛfita Giliad nir la bipuɣiŋga maa zuɣu.
en: that the Israelite women would go out for four days every year to grieve for the daughter of Jephthah of Gilead.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maa naai, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni.
en: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

dag: N daa darigi deei nam maa la Dauda daŋ ni ti a, amaa ka a ti bi be kaman n dabili Dauda ŋun daa doli n zalikpana, ka doli ma ni o suhu zaa ka tumdi din tuhi n san la.
en: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ Gibianim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka chaŋ ti liri ba.
en: Now this is what we will do to the city of Gibeah. We will throw lots to let God show us who will lead the attack.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa mini nabihi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pia ni tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim zaa kul o ya; ka so daa bi kpalim naɣila bɛn nyɛ nandaamba kɔŋko n-daa kpalim be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Nebuchadnezzar captured all the people of Jerusalem, including the leaders and other wealthy people. He took , people and made them prisoners. He took all the skilled workers and craftsmen. No one was left, except the poorest of the common people.

dag: N lan kpahim baŋ yɛm mini jɛrilim ni yinyatali ni nyɛ shɛm; ka nya ka di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I decided to learn how wisdom and knowledge are better than thinking foolish thoughts. But I learned that trying to become wise is like trying to catch the wind.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Anɛr mini Biliam ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti Kɔhat ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim la mi.
en: In the territory of West Manasseh they were assigned the towns of Aner and Bileam with the surrounding pasture lands.

dag: ka yɛl o, M ba, pa lala; dama ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kpɛma. Zaŋm a nudirigu maa pala o zuɣu ni.
en: Joseph said to his father, No, my father! This is the oldest son. Put your right hand on his head.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa ti bahi di nam maa labina, ka daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bolim o ni daa zaŋ liɣiri ti o yiŋbi shɛb ka chaŋ la na ka o ti nya bɛ ni go kɔhigu maa nya nyɔri shɛm tariga.
en: After the prince had been made king, he returned and called in his servants. He asked them how much they had earned with the money they had been given.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna nti ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni m-bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: Some Pharisees came to Jesus and started to argue with him. They wanted to trap him, so they asked him to perform a miracle to show that God approved of him.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa pun chaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ duli, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri li, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: By this time the boat was a long way from the shore. It was going against the wind and was being tossed around by the waves.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ku be barina ni, bɛ ni be ni alaafee ka ku zɔri dabiɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo.
en: Those who obey me will dwell securely, untroubled by the dread of harm.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa, ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, so Caleb let him marry Achsah. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.

dag: N nyɛla sana m-be yi sani, timiya ma luɣ shɛli ka n zaŋ li leei n kpiimba sɔɣibu shee n-zaŋ n kpim ŋɔ ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.

dag: Nyam dabisili maa! Nyama, di kanna, yi bahiyoli biɛɣu neeya. Tibidarigibo jaaŋgbee yirigi puma, ka karimbaani tiri.
en: Look, the day! Look, it comes! Doom has arrived! The staff blossoms, and pride springs up!.

dag: Di daa kul wum ma la yoli, buɣim maa ni daa bi yihi di ni din zahimzahim maa shɛm.
en: Jerusalem might work hard to scrub away her stains. But that rust will not go away! Only the fire of punishment will remove it.

dag: O dimnima n-leei bɛn su o; o dimnim maa kul tɔŋdimi, dama Yawɛ chɛ ka o nya wahala. O biriginsim din galisi zuɣu; o dimnim gbah o bihi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.

dag: M bɔri ni Izraɛlnim nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Yawɛ yi chɛ ka o niriba lan tɔŋ, di ni niŋ Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim nyaɣisim, ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord , when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa nyɛ Jaara ba, ka Jaara nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba, ka Zimiri nyɛ Mɔza ba.
en: Ahaz was the father of Jarah, who was the father of three sons: Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was the father of Moza.

dag: N yi ti do m bindoo zuɣu n teerila a yɛla; ka kul tɛhir a yɛla yuntisuɣu saha;.
en: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa wahala dabisa ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, di ku yuui ka wuntaŋ dii zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla, ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: Right after those days of suffering, The sun will become dark, and the moon will no longer shine. The stars will fall, and the powers in the sky will be shaken.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Saamba sani. O ni daa yɛli ni saamba sani maa, ka Yisa yɛli, Ka dindina tiŋbihi bɛn nuu kani.
en: Peter answered, From foreigners. Jesus replied, Then their own people don't have to pay.

dag: Babilɔnnim daa mɛla Sukɔtibɛnɔt buɣili zali, ka Kutinim me Nɛrigal buɣili zali, ka Hamatinim me Ashima buɣili zali.
en: The Babylonian people made the god Succoth-benoth, the Cuthean people made Nergal, and the people from Hamath made Ashima.

dag: Gibiɔn maa ka Yawɛ daa ti ka Sulemaana sanna zahindi ni yuŋ nti yɛl o, Suhim a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: While Solomon was at Gibeon, the Lord came to him at night in a dream. God said, Solomon, ask me what you want me to give you.

dag: Ka bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka baŋ di gbinni, ka di ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: And the seeds sown in the good soil stand for those who hear the message and understand it: they bear fruit, some as much as one hundred, others sixty, and others thirty.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ naa daanab maa bidibisi, ka di daa doli Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni tibig o la. Dama Naawuni daa ti o la bidibisi pinaanahi ni bipuɣins ata.
en: All these men were Hemans sons. Heman was Davids seer. God promised to make Heman strong. So Heman had many sons. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: the Temple servants and descendants of Solomons servants:.

dag: O zaŋ yɛm din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yɛm zali wuntizɔriba, ka leei nyɔtaɣirigu gu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi.
en: He gives good advice to honest people and shields those who do what is right.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli wuntia soli, ka tɔɣisiri din tuhi, ka bi zaŋdi bɛ kpiɔŋ fari niriba, ka bi diri birapu, ka je ni bɛ wum ninvuɣ kubo yɛla, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nina ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu;.
en: Good, honest people who refuse to hurt others for money will live through that fire . They refuse to take bribes or listen to plans to murder other people. They refuse to look at plans for doing bad things.

dag: Wuntizɔra ni mali shɛli ka di pɔra so ninvuɣ biɛri daazichi pam.
en: A few good people are better than a large crowd of those who are evil.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni yi kul ŋmari bilichiisi shɛm maa, lala ka bɛ na kul yɛn ŋmari li, di filimya li; bɛ nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm ti Naawuni.
en: But they must still make the same number of bricks as they did before. They have gotten lazy. That is why they are asking me to let them go. They dont have enough work to do. That is why they asked me to let them make sacrifices to their God.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda Naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba tɔbu ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: But Amaziah wouldnt listen, so Israels King Joash moved against him, and he and Judahs King Amaziah went head-to-head in battle at Beth-shemesh in Judah.

dag: Ka Sintani daa yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣili ŋɔ leei bindirigu.
en: The Devil said to him, If you are God's Son, order this stone to turn into bread.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli soli din tuhi nyɛla bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛriyoli ʒiɛmd o mi.
en: Those who live right respect the Lord , but dishonest people hate him.

dag: Ka n zaŋ o tah a nyaandoliba ŋɔ sanna, ka bɛ bi tooi tib o.
en: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul ni su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka kul ni be di ni sahakam.
en: The righteous will possess the land and live in it forever.

dag: Di yi ti wum o ka o suhu zɔhira saha shɛli, ka n dii lir o n-kpɛh o dabiɛm ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa zo ka chɛ o, ka n ku ŋun naa maa kɔŋko.
en: I will catch him while he is tired and weak. I will frighten him, and all his people will run away. But I will kill only King David.

dag: Ti daa yulila sɔŋsim soli hal ka ti nini ti sabi, ti daa yuunila zuliya shɛb soli ni bɛ tiligi ti, ka bɛ daa bi tooi tiligi ti.
en: We have worn out our eyes looking for help, but no help comes. We kept on looking for a nation to save us. We kept watch from our watchtower, but no nation came to us.

dag: Mira! Di lan tum tuumbiɛri; di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ wahala zahim a maa.
en: Be careful not to turn to evil; your suffering was sent to keep you from it.

dag: O chɛ ka m bela zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi ka di yuui la.
en: He made me live in dark places like those whove been dead a long time.

dag: Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni su zuliya shɛb chana. Di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ nimaani.
en: This is where the tribes come, the tribes who belong to the Lord . The people of Israel come here to praise the Lord s name.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o mini Yɛhudianim ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn daa jɛmdi Naawuni tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla bɛ jɛmbu duu; ka o daa yi lan yiri daa ni nti tɔɣisiri ŋunkam yɛn gar o sani Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: So he held discussions in the synagogue with the Jews and with the Gentiles who worshiped God, and also in the public square every day with the people who happened to come by.

dag: Gibiɔn ba Jɛiɛl daa bela Gibiɔn. O paɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel had settled the town of Gibeon, where he and his wife Maacah lived.

dag: Fitiina pam maa zuɣu, niriba kul kuhirimi, wɔɣira ni muɣisiri ba shɛm zuɣu, bɛ bɔrila sɔŋsim.
en: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Nail Mɔɣili kom nyuui, ka n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni. N ni ti chɛ ka tinzunnim saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make the Nile River become dry land. Then I will sell the dry land to evil people. I will use strangers to make that land empty. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: O daa yi chɛ o zabiri o zaŋdila nayili sania zahim li ka di tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi.
en: At the end of every year, Absalom cut the hair from his head and weighed it. The hair weighed about five pounds.

dag: Filistianim ni daa ti wum ni Dauda ka bɛ zaŋ leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka bɛ zaa daa yi n-gbaai Dauda shee bɔbu, amaa ka Dauda daa wum di yɛla ka chaŋ ti be birini la ni.
en: The Philistines heard that David was now king of Israel, and they came into the hill country to try and capture him. But David found out and went into his fortress.

dag: Naɣ kul miriya ka yi ti ŋubila binʒim, dama ʒim nyɛla nyɛvili, ka di bi simdi ni yi ti ŋubi nimdi mini di nyɛvili.
en: Only do not eat meat with blood still in it, for the life is in the blood, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

dag: Ka ŋunkam po Naawuni jɛmbu duu pola di mini Naawuni ŋun be di ni maa.
en: And anyone who swears by the temple also swears by God, who lives there.

dag: Tiŋ maa daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa nyɛ yim; ka o daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa buɣisi tiŋ maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi; ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni di dubu zaa nyɛ yim.
en: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about , kilometers high and , kilometers wide.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi bina chɛrisichɛrisi bɛ ninni, ka ʒe bɛ yinsi nɛma, ka bili bɛ paɣiba.
en: Their infants will be crushed before their eyes; their houses plundered, their women raped.

dag: A nina ni nya alahiziba binyara, ka a tɛha yɛtɔɣa gabi.
en: Weird sights will appear before your eyes, and you will not be able to think or speak clearly.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti pii din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, chɛliya ka ti maŋmaŋ lihi n-nya din viɛla.
en: Lets choose for us whats right; lets determine among ourselves whats good.

dag: Ka Samsin min o ba ni o ma daa yiɣisi chani Timna, ka Samsin daa ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puu ni; ka gbuɣim polli nya o ŋumda.
en: So Samson went down to Timnah with his father and mother. As they were going through the vineyards there, he heard a young lion roaring.

dag: Zilinli ŋmanila buɣim. Zilinli lan ŋmanila dunia ŋɔ yɛl biɛri m-be ti niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-tari ti niŋgbuna maa zaa daɣiri, ka zaŋdi buɣim n-juuri ti dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu, ka buɣim din bi kpiri la mi taari li.
en: The tongue is like a fire. It is a world of evil among the parts of our body. It spreads its evil through our whole body and starts a fire that influences all of life. It gets this fire from hell.

dag: O ni daa baŋ Pita kukoli, suhupiɛlli zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi yooi dunol maa, amaa ka naɣ zomi kpe nti yɛli ni Pita ʒe dunol ni.
en: She recognized Peter's voice and was so happy that she ran back in without opening the door, and announced that Peter was standing outside.

dag: Bɛ daa lan sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba yɛla n-niŋ nanim yɛlikura litaafinim ni hal ti paai Ɛliashib bia Jɔhanan saha la.
en: The family leaders among the descendants of the Levites and up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were written in the history book.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anabinim sabbu niŋ pali. Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But all this has happened in order to make come true what the prophets wrote in the Scriptures. Then all the disciples left him and ran away.

dag: Dama m baŋ n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli, ka n daalahichi kul ʒe n tooni.
en: I know I have done wrong. I remember that sin all the time.

dag: Nyama, niriba yi nuzaa polo kanna. Zuliya din mali kpiɔŋ mini nanim pam yi dunia yaɣa din be katiŋa n-damdi li kanna.
en: Far to the north, a nation and its allies have been awakened. They are powerful and ready for war.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim ka tarili bee fali bɛ mabihi maa sani. Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm maa.
en: That is why the people from the tribe of Levi did not get any share of land like the other tribes did. They have the Lord for their share. That is what the Lord your God promised them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti niŋ nyini n dana zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam zaa o ni yɛli ni o ni niŋ a la, ka chɛ ka a leei Izraɛl naa.
en: The Lord promised to do many good things for you, and he will keep his promises. He will make you leader over Israel.

dag: Ni o bɔhim o nachimba maa, bɛ ni yɛl o. Dinzuɣu n suhir o mi ni o niŋmi n nachimba ŋɔ nirilim, dama chuɣu dali ka ti kana maa. N suhir o mi, din kul be o nuu ni, ŋun zaŋ ti yinim bɛn nyɛ o tumtumdiba ŋɔ ka yi zaŋ na ti ti o bia Dauda.
en: Ask your servants; they will tell you the same. So please receive these young men favorably, because weve come on a special day. Please give whatever you have on hand to your servants and to your son David.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pihinahi gol so ŋun pahiri piniyini dahin yini dali ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛm.
en: It was in the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, that Moses spoke to the Israelites precisely what the LORD had commanded him for them. .

dag: Tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa yi ti sɔhira, mani n-nyɛ ŋun gbib di daantalisi.
en: The earth and all its people may shake, but I am the one who keeps it steady. Selah.

dag: Ka zoya ti nyɛligi do o naba ni ka vinvama tahi bɔɣi kaman shigbaŋ m-miri buɣim la, bee kaman kom din kpaai bahi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ sirigili la.
en: Then the mountains will melt under him; the valleys will split apart, like wax yielding to the fire, like waters poured down a slope.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu sahakam; n lan yɛri ya mi yaha, kul maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: May you always be joyful in your union with the Lord. I say it again: rejoice!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛl kpamba.
en: So Joshua gave orders to the leaders of the people:.

dag: ka ŋun mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli m-buɣi doli ma gba bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: Those who will not accept the cross that is given to them when they follow me are not worthy of me.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: Then all the disciples left him and ran away.

dag: Ka hal bɛn daa lu maa yi chɛ biɛhiŋ, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba labisi tuɣi, dama o mali yiko din ni tooi lan labisi ba tuɣi yaha.
en: And if the Jews abandon their unbelief, they will be put back in the place where they were; for God is able to do that.

dag: Bɛ yiinila yila saɣisiri guŋgombihi mini mɔɣilo, ka kalambua kumsi niŋdi ba nyaɣisim.
en: They sing and dance to the sound of harps and flutes.

dag: N dabisa maa zɔrimi gariti kaman ŋariŋ shɛli din zɔri pam la, di chanimi kaman tɔrili ni yi silim na ni o ti to binnɛɔŋ shɛm la.
en: They go by as quickly as papyrus boats, as fast as an eagle swooping down on its prey.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni gba ku chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: But if you do not forgive others, then your Father will not forgive the wrongs you have done.

dag: A nyɛvoya ni pɔhim daa kahi kom duhi, ka kɔgbana daa yiɣisi zani zuɣusaa, ka teeku bulli maa sunsuuni daa kpaŋ diɣinli.
en: With the breath of your nostrils the waters swelled up, the floods surged up in a great wave; the deep waters foamed in the depths of the sea.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di shihi ma; dama n na bi chaŋ m Ba sani. Amaa cham m mabihi la sani nti yɛli ba ni n chanila m Ba ŋun nyɛ yi gba Ba la ni n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi gba Naawuni la sani.
en: Do not hold on to me, Jesus told her, because I have not yet gone back up to the Father. But go to my brothers and tell them that I am returning to him who is my Father and their Father, my God and their God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaŋ bɛ ni kɔriti binneen shɛb maani sara mɔɣu ni la ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o zaŋ ba mali suhudoo sara maligu.
en: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field.

dag: Dama n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa biɛrim nyabu chɛ ka n gba nyala biɛrim. N fabiliya ka di niŋ ma yoli.
en: My heart has been crushed because my people are crushed; I mourn; I am completely dismayed.

dag: amaa sara maligu maa nimdi yi zani hal ni daba ata, bɛn zaŋm li nyo buɣim.
en: If any meat from this sacrifice is still left over on the third day, it must be burned in the fire.

dag: N daa nya n suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam. N daa bi zaɣisi n suhu ni kul bɔri nyaɣisim shɛlikam. N daa nyu bara n ni tum nya shɛli zuɣu. N tuma laara zaa ni daa nyɛ shɛli m-bala.
en: I refrained from nothing that my eyes desired. I refused my heart no pleasure. Indeed, my heart found pleasure from the results of my hard work; that was the reward from all my hard work.

dag: Amaa niriba kul ni be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam, ka niriba kul ni be Jɛrusalɛm ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: I will avenge those who were killed; I will not spare the guilty. But Judah and Jerusalem will be inhabited forever, and I, the Lord , will live on Mount Zion.

dag: Dindali maa niriba ni ti yi Asiria zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tinsi ni n-ka yi sanna, ka shɛb mi yi Ijipti zaŋ hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni na, ka shɛb yi teeku shɛl ni zaŋ ti kpa teeku shɛl ni na, ka shɛb mi yi zo shɛli gbini zaŋ ti kpa zo shɛli gbini na.
en: Your people will return to you from everywhere—from Assyria in the east, from Egypt in the south, from the region of the Euphrates River, from distant seas and far-off mountains.

dag: Wuhimiya ma yi paɣ bɔbo puhigu liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yi yi ni saɣi ka n kpuɣ o, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni n tin ya shɛm zaa.
en: Make the bride price and marriage gifts as large as you like, and I will pay whatever you tell me. Then let me marry the young woman.

dag: Ka o pii ninvuɣ pinaayi ni bɛ be o sani, ka o timdi ba ka bɛ ti yihiri waazu.
en: Then he chose twelve of them to be his apostles, so they could be with him. He also wanted to send them out to preach.

dag: ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali. Ka di daa niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life. All of this made the disciples very sad.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ma leei dunia ŋɔ zaa naa, ka zali ma ni m me duu ti o Jɛrusalɛm, Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Persias King Cyrus says: The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth. He has commanded me to build him a house at Jerusalem in Judah.

dag: Hal bɛ yi zaŋ takɔbi bee piɛma bee kpana bee baasali sua lir o bɛ ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: Swords, spears, and darts only bounce off when they hit him. These weapons dont hurt him at all!.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋariti taba, amaa zomiya yi Naawuni, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.

dag: Yi mi ni n tum tuma ni n yaa zaa ti yi ba.
en: You both know that I have worked for your father with all my strength.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, chɛliya ka ti be Yawɛ neesim ni chana.
en: Come, house of Jacob, lets walk by the LORDs light.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, N ni va m biɛli val shɛli din kpɛm pam la zuɣu ka n di nasara ŋɔ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Naftali.
en: Rachel said, I've struggled hard with my sister, and I've won! So she named the boy Naphtali.

dag: Dama di naan tibisi gari teeku bihigu. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri yiriŋ maa.
en: They would be heavier than all the sand of the sea! That is why my words are so crazy.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam dol o yɛligu, dilana n-nyɛ Naawuni yurilim ni niŋ dɛde so ni. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ ni ti be Naawuni ni.
en: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.

dag: Dama bɛ yi ti kpi, bɛ ku tooi zaŋ li mali chaŋ. Bɛ daazichi maa ku doli ba siɣi gballi ni.
en: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.

dag: Ka di tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo pateesanim wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisinaayi.
en: The east side of the courtyard was cubits wide. The entrance to the courtyard was on this side.

dag: A zuɣu, n ni tooi nyaŋ n dimnima. N Naawuni maa zuɣu, n ni tooi yiɣi yaɣi gooni.
en: You give me strength to attack my enemies and power to overcome their defenses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni o kpalim n-niŋ daba ayi bɛ sani, ka o daa bi saɣi.
en: The people asked him to stay longer, but he would not consent.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yihi yɛli ni o bela neesim ni ka je o mabia, o na kul bela zibisim ni.
en: If we say that we are in the light, yet hate others, we are in the darkness to this very hour.

dag: Goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali nyɛla chuɣu, yi yɛn ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: The Festival of Unleavened Bread begins on the th day of that month. This festival lasts for seven days. The only bread you can eat is bread made without yeast.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ ya doli tiŋgban nɛli ni so wɔɣinli yuun pihinahi ni o chɛ ka yi leei tarimba, ka o zahim ya nya yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpana la bee yi ku dol li la yɛla.
en: And you must remember the entire trip that the Lord your God has led you through these years in the desert. He was testing you. He wanted to make you humble. He wanted to know what is in your heart. He wanted to know if you would obey his commands.

dag: Ti yaannim daa di bindiri shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la. Di sabiya: O daa ti ba bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na ka bɛ di. .
en: Our ancestors ate manna in the wilderness, just as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat .

dag: Wɔr sabila ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la daa zaŋ kpala nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la, ka wɔr piɛla ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka wɔr fufuhisi ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la mi zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: The black horses will go north, the red horses will go east, the white horses will go west, and the horses with red spots will go south.

dag: Zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila kpaŋsiri taba, ka yilimiya yila paɣimi ti Duuma ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.

dag: N yuri a zaligu pam! N kul tɛhirila di yɛla dabisili kam.
en: I love your Instruction! I think about it constantly.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yu Ɛsta gari paɣiba maa zaa. Hal o nini daa tiɣ o ka o yur o gari paɣisar bɛn la zaa. Dinzuɣu ka o daa dii zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee.
en: The king loved Esther more than any of the other young women, and she became his favorite. He approved of her more than any of the others. So King Xerxes put a crown on Esthers head and made her the new queen in place of Vashti.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa bahi noli ka bɛ mali duri maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka n daa labisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lahi mini chi ni kawana sara ni tulaale zim la niŋ di ni.
en: I gave orders for the rooms to be ritually purified and for the Temple equipment, grain offerings, and incense to be put back.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses to say:.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim, dama n niŋ a zaligunim yɛda.
en: Give me the knowledge to make wise decisions. I trust your commands.

dag: Ka Pool daa laɣisi dagansi na ti pa buɣim maa ni, ka gariŋga yi dari maa ni na buɣim maa tulim zuɣu n-kaai vil o nuu.
en: Paul gathered a bunch of dry sticks and put them on the fire. As he did, a poisonous snake, driven out by the heat, latched on to his hand.

dag: Amaa Ɛlihu ni daa nya ka niriba ata maa ni so bi yaag o noli garigi maa zuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi.
en: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia A min a bia Shiajashub cham Ahaz sani. O be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ la polo kpaluhi solɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.

dag: Ka ti ba maa daa ti lan yɛli ti, Labimiya ti da bindira biɛla ti ti na.
en: Then he told us to return and buy a little food.

dag: Nimaani ka Masia be ka su binshɛɣukam zaa zaŋ tabili alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yikolaannim ni bɛn nyɛ duumanima, ka o yuli tibisi gari yuli kam ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni mini ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna ni.
en: Christ rules there above all heavenly rulers, authorities, powers, and lords; he has a title superior to all titles of authority in this world and in the next.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye Jɛrusalɛmnima, zuŋɔ yi yi di baŋ din di naan tin ya suhudoo di di so; amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi bela zibisim ni zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: saying, If you only knew today what is needed for peace! But now you cannot see it!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tɔb nɛma maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣ shɛli jɛmbu duu, ka daa zaŋ o zuɣu maa ti yili bɛ buɣili Dagɔn jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: They put his weapons in one of their temples and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin daa kpi.
en: So the Lord sent an epidemic on the people of Israel, and seventy thousand of them died.

dag: ka a dabisa yi ti pali ka a dɔni a yaannim tooni, n ni piig a bihi ni yino ŋun nyɛ a dahalali bia n-chɛ ka o nam nya zaashee zani.
en: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried in the tomb of your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler.

dag: Ka Gaad daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm bɔŋɔ, piim a ni bɔri shɛli.
en: Gad went to David and told him: You must choose how the Lord will punish you:.

dag: Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ, dama o tum alahiziba tuma. O nudirigu min o bɔɣu dim be kasi ŋɔ ti o nasara.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ; he has done wonderful things! By his own power and holy strength he has won the victory.

dag: Bihi maa ni daa ti zooi, Iso daa niŋla tɔha biiŋa ŋun daa kul be mɔɣu ni; ka Yaakubu mi be baalim m-be yiŋa.
en: When the young men grew up, Esau became an outdoorsman who knew how to hunt, and Jacob became a quiet man who stayed at home.

dag: Amaa miriya! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranim bɛ sani.
en: Watch out for yourselves. People will hand you over to the councils. You will be beaten in the synagogues. You will stand before governors and kings because of me so that you can testify before them.

dag: Judanim bi ʒe yim, ka din chihiri kul tumdi Izraɛl mini Jɛrusalɛm puuni. Dama Judanim saɣim Yawɛ ni yuri o jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka kpuɣi tinzunnim bɛn jɛmdi buɣa bipuɣinsi.
en: The people of Judah cheated other people. People in Jerusalem and Israel did terrible things. God loves the Temple, but the people in Judah didnt respect the Lord s holy Temple. The people of Judah began to worship a foreign goddess.

dag: Nir yi bi tuɣ ma, o ŋmanila wul shɛli bɛ ni wooi bahi ka di kuui, ka bɛ laɣisi di dari niŋ buɣim ni ka di di li.
en: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pina yɛla polo, m bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I dont want you to be ignorant about spiritual gifts.

dag: Bɛ ni mali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu soli ti wuntizɔriba, ka ŋunkam zaa be tibi o suhu ni ni dol li.
en: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.

dag: nti yɛl o, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kali ti ni su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi n-nya ka ti zaa beni.
en: and said to Moses, Your servants have counted the warriors in our charge and not one of us is missing.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba napɔna vubu balisam tihi maa zuɣu, di saha nyin lirim ba, dama man Naawuni n-daŋ a tooni ni n ti nyaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa.
en: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, go out to battle because that is the sign that God has gone out in front of you to defeat the Philistines.

dag: hal ti yi tuui, ti ku lu n-doya, dama Yawɛ nuu n-gbib ti.
en: If they fall, they will not stay down, because the Lord will help them up.

dag: Amaa bomiya n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa tɔŋsim, ka suhimiya Yawɛ tim li, dama di tɔŋsim puuni ka yi gba ni tɔŋ.
en: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiri ni ti yɛda niŋbu ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri: Yi yɛda ni kpaŋsi n suhu, ka n gba yɛda kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri.
en: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.

dag: Hal bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ zaa. N yi zo ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni nya mbusim.
en: But even if they did bring up children, I would take them away and not leave one alive. When I abandon these people, terrible things will happen to them.

dag: Giliad zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Iiza daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Iizanima, ka Hɛlɛki daŋ niriba nyɛ Hɛlɛkinima.
en: the clans of Iezer, Helek.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa, Darimiya chahi yi situra, ka zaŋ buri so n-kum Abinɛr kuli. Ka Naa Dauda daa doli kum adaka maa nyaaŋa.
en: David told Joab and everyone with him, Show your sorrow by tearing your clothes and wearing sackcloth! Walk in front of Abner's body and cry! David walked behind the stretcher on which Abner's body was being carried.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili tiŋ maa ni tiŋbi so, ka o timd o o puu ni ka o ti dihir o kuruchunima.
en: He went to work for a man in that country, and the man sent him out to take care of his pigs.

dag: Kpahimmiya noonsi bɛn yiɣiri ŋɔ: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna; amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-dihiri ba. Ka yi bi mali bukaata pam gari ba?.
en: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: As it was in the time of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Human One.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku labi nyaaŋa alakanim ŋɔ nyabu zuɣu. Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ti nya alakanim ŋɔ tatabo.
en: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun kul be, ka nyɛ ninsalinim nini ni ku tooi nya so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka simdi tibigibu mini jilima tibu ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Now to the king of the ages, to the immortal, invisible, and only God, may honor and glory be given to him forever and always! Amen.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu zaa saɣimla Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman bɛ ni zaŋ mɔɣilo ŋmɛri nandahima yil shɛli.
en: So I will hum a sad song for Moab and Kir Heres, like a harp playing a funeral song.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi pili suɣili maa, ka zaŋ teeku ni biŋkɔbbal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: Two other coverings were made—one with fine leather and the other with ram skins dyed red.

dag: Amaa ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, a ni kariti ma shɛm ŋɔ n-lee bie n-gari a ni niŋ ma shɛm maa gba. Amaa ka Amnɔn daa zaɣis o yɛligu maa wumbu;.
en: She said, Don't send me away! That would be worse than what you have already done. But Amnon would not listen.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Wummiya, m mabihi mini n niriba; n lo n suhu ni ni m me yili n-zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka din nyɛ ti Naawuni napɔntamdigu ŋɔ zali di puuni; m pun mali di mɛbu shili zaa.
en: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka bɛ nyuri bara la bɛ ni baŋ ma, ka mi n ni nyɛ so la zuɣu. Bɛ baŋya ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka m mali yurilim din galisi mini zaligu soli ni nimmaŋtali tumdi tuma dunia ni. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m mali suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If any want to boast, they should boast that they know and understand me, because my love is constant, and I do what is just and right. These are the things that please me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya ni kpamba anahi daa beni, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Jɔhanan bia Azaria mini Mɛshilɛmɔt bia Bɛrɛkia ni Shallum bia Jɛhizikia ni Hadilai bia Amasa; bɛna n-daa yiɣisi zani galim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi tɔb tuhibu yɔɣu kuli maa na.
en: Four of the leading men of the Northern Kingdom, Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai also opposed the actions of the army.

dag: Yawɛ mali yaa gari kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ vubu. O mali yaa gari teeku kɔgbana. Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa zuɣusaa!.
en: The crashing waves of the sea are loud and powerful, but the Lord above is even more powerful.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, yin miriya ka yi ti tumdi zuliya shɛb bɛn be nimaani tuun shɛŋa din tumbu chihiri la.
en: Once you enter the land that the LORD your God is giving you, dont try to imitate the detestable things those nations do.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ min o kpiɔŋ; ka suhimiy o sahakam.
en: Go to the Lord for help, and worship him continually.

dag: N suhu kul bɔrila binshɛli nyabu, amaa ka na bi nya li. N nya do yino niriba tuhili puuni, amaa ka bi nya paɣ yino niriba tuhili maa puuni.
en: I have looked for other answers but have found none. I found one man in a thousand that I could respect, but not one woman.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo, bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa piligila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-zaŋ hal ti du Jɛriko nuzaa polo kuŋkuni n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo ti du zoya zuɣu m-mali hal ti paai di tariga Bɛtavɛn yɔɣu ni.
en: The northern border started at the Jordan River. It went along the northern edge of Jericho. Then the border went west into the hill country. It continued until it was just east of Beth Aven.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi fɔntiŋ kam ni. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: We captured all the cities that belonged to King Sihon at that time. We completely destroyed the people in every city—the men, women, and children. We did not leave anyone alive!.

dag: Naawuni ʒin o ʒiishee saria karibu ni; o kari saria wuna sunsuuni.
en: God stands in the assembly of the gods. He stands as judge among the judges.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa di bi wumda. Bɛ mali nyɛhi, amaa di bi wumdi nyom.
en: They have ears, but cannot hear. They have noses, but cannot smell.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bidibiga kam ni tooi ŋub li, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Any male priest can eat it; it is most holy.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn pun tiɣi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama kum ni ti wum ya. Mbusim be yinim bɛn lari pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi ni ti kum ka fabili.
en: How terrible for you who are full now; you will go hungry! How terrible for you who laugh now; you will mourn and weep!.

dag: ka zaŋ o kuli a yiŋa, di simdi ka o pini o zuɣu, ka ŋmah o nyinyɛhi.
en: You must then bring her into your house where she will shave her head and cut her nails.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na. Bɛ daa kul tahirimi ka piɛbiri kikahi ni piɛlahi yila, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka daa lan ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim pampam.
en: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.

dag: Dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: At the time the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fiɣisi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda? Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ni bɛ ka taali.
en: Who will accuse God's chosen people? God himself declares them not guilty!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka deei kaɣili maa fiɛbir o zuɣu ni.
en: Then they spit on him. They took the stick from him and beat him on the head with it.

dag: ka Matɛnai daa nyɛ Joyarib daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Uzi daa nyɛ Jɛdaya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Joiaribs family was Mattenai. The leader of Jedaiahs family was Uzzi.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yi fa Lɔdɛba. Ka lan nyuri bara yɛri ni yi kpiɔŋ ka yi zaŋ fa Karinaim.
en: You brag about capturing the town of Lodebar. You boast, We were strong enough to take Karnaim.

dag: Ka Shɛva daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara. Ka Zadok mini Abiata daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ŋun nyɛ ŋun niŋdi zina bee ŋun tumdi daɣiri tuma bee ŋun kɔre kpɛri binyara ni ti ku nya shɛli Masia mini Naawuni nam ni, dama binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God.

dag: Ka n daa nya litaafi shɛli ka di be ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni, ka sabbu be di puuni mini di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ bintabinda ayopɔin n-dihi tabili di noli.
en: Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one seated on the throne. It had writing on the front and the back, and it was sealed with seven seals.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zani naŋgban yini yɛli, Ti ni so ku lab kul o tanti ni bee o yiŋa.
en: All the people stood up together and said, None of us, whether he lives in a tent or in a house, will go home.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti nya Dauda, ka lan yɛli ba Ʒimiy o min o garo maa zaa na ka n ti ku o.
en: But Saul sent them back to see David for themselves. He ordered them, Carry him here in his bed, and I will kill him.

dag: Ka zama bɛn yɔri vuri yiriŋ gil a. Ka duŋtaariba pam daa zaŋ dɔbba bɛn nyɛ danyuriba n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ bansi piri paɣiba maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupili viɛla pili ba.
en: The sound of a noisy crowd was around her. Men from the common multitude, drinkers of wine, were brought from the desert. They put bracelets on their wrists and beautiful crowns on their heads.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka di puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini diribarilim.
en: You Pharisees and teachers are show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You wash the outside of your cups and dishes, while inside there is nothing but greed and selfishness.

dag: Hal bɛ yi du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti sɔɣi, n ni bo n-nya ba gbahi ba. Ka bɛ yi zomi kpe teeku ni nti sɔɣi di bulli ni, n ni chɛ ka teeku ni wahu dim ba.
en: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.

dag: Ka n daa lo nia ni n niŋ din ni ti ma nyaɣisim. Amaa ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I decided to enjoy myself and find out what happiness is. But I found that this is useless, too.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, A ni nya ka salo daar a ŋ-ŋɔ, ka a ti bɔhi ni ŋuni n-lee shih a.
en: His disciples said to him, Look at all these people crowding around you! How can you ask who touched you.

dag: Ka chira ayi maa daa ti naai ka o lab o ba sanna, ka o ti zaŋ o niŋ kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli ni o zaŋ o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa nyɛla paɣipiɛliga. Ka di daa leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: At the end of two months, Jephthahs daughter returned to her father, and Jephthah did what he had promised. His daughter never had sexual relations with anyone. So this became a custom in Israel.

dag: ni Aijalɔn ni Gatirimɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: Aijalon, and Gath Rimmon.

dag: nya ka Pita ʒiya wuɣisiri buɣim, ka o lih o ka yɛli, A gba yi bela Yisa Nazarɛt doo ŋɔ sani.
en: and saw Peter warming himself by the fire. She stared at him and said, You were with Jesus from Nazareth.

dag: Ka dansarika gula daa neei gom ni n-nya ka dunoya maa zaa yoomi, ka o ŋoog o takɔbi ni o kuhi ku omaŋa, dama o daa tɛhiya ni dansarikanim maa zaa yimi zo.
en: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he thought that the prisoners had escaped; so he pulled out his sword and was about to kill himself.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, A na ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba balibu pam mini zuliya pam ni tinzun yɛligu pam nima ni nanim pam polo.
en: I was told, You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu lahi mini di nɛma zaa na nti ŋmaŋŋma Naawuni duu nɛma maa, ka kpari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka me maligu bimbina zali Jɛrusalɛm lɔrigi kam ni.
en: In addition, he took all the Temple equipment and broke it in pieces. He closed the Temple and set up altars in every part of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee mi ma? Ka Yisa garigi n-yɛl o, A ni di be fiig tia gbini ka Filip na bi nya a la, ka n di nya a.
en: Nathanael asked, How do you know me? Jesus answered, I saw you when you were under the fig tree, before Philip told you about me.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ niŋ daɣiri yihibu kom niŋ bɛmaŋa daba ata dali mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka leei bɛn be nyam. Amaa bɛ yi bi niŋ lala daba ata mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa dali, bɛ ku leei bɛn be nyam.
en: They must purify themselves with the water for purification on the third day and on the seventh day, and then they will be clean. But if they do not purify themselves on both the third and the seventh day, they will not be clean.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa n-garigi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: The Lord 's answer was kind and comforting.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda, Nyini n-nyɛ lala nir maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa piig a leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka daa fa a Sool nuu ni bahi.
en: You are that man, Nathan said to David. And this is what the Lord God of Israel says: I made you king of Israel and rescued you from Saul.

dag: O yi ti dɔni, nyin kpahimmi baŋ o ni dɔni luɣ shɛli maa, ka o ti ʒeei gom bahi ka a chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli. O ni ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: After he eats, he will lie down to rest. Watch him so that you will know where he lies down. Go there and lift the cover off his feet. Then lie down there with Boaz. He will tell you what you should do about marriage.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi, Ka di chaŋ wula ka n wumdi piɛri kumsi mini niɣi ŋumbu.
en: Then what, Samuel asked, is this bleating of sheep in my ears and mooing of cattle I hear.

dag: Zaŋm taaŋkɔro paɣi ma ka n yi daɣiri ni, ka paligi laɣilaɣi gari gumbɔrigu.
en: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ naa nini daa galimi, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm niriba tuma yɛla teebu ni be yɛlikura litaafi shɛl ni la na, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li na.
en: That same night the king could not get to sleep, so he had the official records of the empire brought and read to him.

dag: Ka daŋ shɛŋa din kpalim zaa puuni niriba dɔbba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba gba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: and all the remaining clans, each clan by itself, and their women by themselves.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ biasan la zuliya m-be tooni, ka Juda zuliya kpamba paya, ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya kpamba doli nyaaŋa.
en: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa tin ya ni yi be di ni la tin yin ni.
en: When you are living in the towns that the Lord your God gives you, you may hear.

dag: Chɛ ka di nyɛla a kɔŋko dini, ka miri ka a niŋdi li tiri saamba.
en: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti paɣ Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni. O ma ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn paɣ la yuli n-daa booni Naama. Ka o bia Abijam daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Rehoboam died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City and his son Abijah succeeded him as king.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Pool kpe tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee saha shɛli ka o daa bɔhi sapashin kpɛm maa, A ni ti ma noli ka n yɛl a shɛli? Ka sapashin maa bɔh o, A wumdi Giriikili.
en: As the soldiers were about to take Paul into the fort, he spoke to the commander: May I say something to you? You speak Greek, do you? the commander asked.

dag: Ka m mi nya ka o bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum; amaa omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ni o bɔri ni o zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani zuɣu ka n gba lɔri nia ni n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tah o sani.
en: Ive found that he has done nothing deserving death. When he appealed to His Majesty, I decided to send him to Rome.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa piɛb o kikaa, ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zo titali ka buɣim diri di zuɣu la yiɣ ti lu teeku ni.
en: Then the second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain burning with fire was thrown down into the sea. A third of the sea became blood.

dag: Miri ka a kpuɣi paɣa bee n-dɔɣi bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi kpe.
en: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba; ka daa pii so n-leei bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: During Jehorams rule Edom rebelled against Judahs power and appointed their own king.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim, dama n niŋ a zaligunim yɛda.
en: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.

dag: Bidib bil so n-naɣ be kpe m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi, amaa ka bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ salo ŋɔ zaa.
en: Here is a boy with five loaves of barley bread and two little fish. But that is not enough for so many people.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣa daa wum Sulemaana yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu polo, ka kana nti bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa din kpɛma ni o buɣis o nya.
en: The Queen of Sheba heard how famous Solomon was, so she went to Jerusalem to test him with difficult questions.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn gbaag omaŋmaŋ naɣikpahi ni naɣinyaŋ bee naɣilaa m-mali suhudoo sara maligu, di simdi ka o zaŋla naɣ so ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa ti Yawɛ.
en: If you offer one of your cattle as a fellowship offering, it can be a bull or a cow. But the animal you offer to the Lord must have nothing wrong with it.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da yaɣimɛr yaɣiri duɣu, ka zaŋ niriba kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba pahi amaŋ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to me, Jeremiah, go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take some of the elders of the people and some priests with you.

dag: ka yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu nabi, ka yi daazinfa mini yi salima nabi, ka yi binshɛɣukam nabi.
en: and when your cattle and sheep, your silver and gold, and all your other possessions have increased.

dag: Farisiinima n-daa tim tuumba maa Jɔn sani maa.
en: These Jews were sent from the Pharisees.

dag: yɛra, Saha paaya, ka Naawuni nam gba mirina; dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka niŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛda.
en: saying, Now is the time! Here comes Gods kingdom! Change your hearts and lives, and trust this good news.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ka tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ jilima. Ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib bɛ ni po pɔ shɛŋa, hal di yi ni ti ba wahala shɛlikam.
en: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord . And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.

dag: Lee miriya ka yi ŋubi nimdi din ʒim bi yi di ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: However, you must not eat meat with its life, its blood, in it.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Taai goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: So I will send fire upon the city walls of Tyre and burn down its fortresses.

dag: Pirigim a ni mali shɛlikam ʒii buyopɔin bee bunii zuɣu, dama a ku tooi baŋ barina shɛli din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Give a portion to seven people, even to eight: you dont know what disaster may come upon the land.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔhimi zuliya kam, ŋuni n-lee na mi n-wum yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo? Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ tum zaɣ biɛ titali.
en: The Lord says, Ask every nation if such a thing has ever happened before. The people of Israel have done a terrible thing!.

dag: Dinzuɣu di ni ti nyɛla yuŋ yi sani, ka yi ku lan nya ʒii, ka liɣa ti be yi sani, ka binshɛli ku kahigi wuhi ya. Wuntaŋ ni ti lu anabinim maa sani, ka biɛkaali nyaaŋa ti nyɛ zibisim bɛ sani.
en: You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.

dag: Ka m mɔŋ ya saa saha shɛli yi bindira ni bɔri saa pam. N chɛ ka saa miri tin shɛlinima, ka bi miri tin shɛlinima; ka chɛ ka saa miri pu shɛl ni, ka chɛ ka o bi miri pu shɛl ni ka di bindira kpira.
en: I also withheld rain from you when there were still three months to the harvest. I allowed rain to fall on one city, no rain to fall on another city. One field was rained on, and the field dried up where it didnt rain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na nti ti ti. Bɛ daa lan ʒi lahibali na ti yɛli, Tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ti ti maa.
en: They took some of the fruit from that land and brought it back to us. They told us about the land and said, The Lord our God is giving us a good land.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Ka bɛ yi ti bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka yɛli ni a bi yi n zuɣu.
en: Moses asked the Lord , Suppose everyone refuses to listen to my message, and no one believes that you really appeared to me.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: M Ba, a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma la, m bi chɛ ka bɛ ni yino bɔrigi.
en: This was to show the truth of what Jesus said earlier: I have not lost anyone you gave me.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi kaman ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu pahi, ka chɛ ka n dan naa nini nya li, ka bɔzuɣu ka nyin n dan naa lan bɔr ni a niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha.
en: Joab said to the king, May the LORD your God increase the number of people a hundred times while the eyes of my master the king can still see it! But why does my master the king want to do this.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa, zomiya Yawɛ! Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, lumiy o sizuura!.
en: Worship the Lord , all the earth! Honor him, all peoples of the world!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi naɣilaa maa, ka zaŋ bia maa mi chaŋ ti ti Ɛli.
en: They went before the Lord. Elkanah killed the bull as a sacrifice to the Lord as he usually did. Then Hannah gave the boy to Eli.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli pam daa be Jɛrusalɛm; dama Naa Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman nyaaŋa, bɛ daa bi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu maa tatabo Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: So there was much joy in Jerusalem. There had not been a celebration like this since the time of Solomon son of King David of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka di pala ti yɛn zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee m-maani sara shɛli di zuɣu.
en: That's why we decided to build the altar. It isn't for offering sacrifices, not even sacrifices to please the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa gbaai chandi hal ti paai Bɛtilihɛm. Bɛ ni daa paai maa, di daa garila tiŋ maa nim zaa ka bɛ damna, ka paɣiba ti bɔhira, Naomi m-bala.
en: Naomi and Ruth traveled until they came to the town of Bethlehem. When the two women entered Bethlehem, all the people were very excited. They said, Is this Naomi.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni be kɔŋkɔba zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yisa leeg alikauli din so nyaanzaana.
en: As a result, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

dag: Ti wuhiri ti yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm, Naawuni ni daŋ n-yu ti la zuɣu.
en: We love because God first loved us.

dag: N ni zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa zaa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be ka nabi, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri lo alikauli n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni.
en: You must obey all the commands that I give you today, because then you will live and grow to become a great nation. You will get the land that the Lord promised to your ancestors.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka o daa ŋoli bɛ ni yi.
en: Again, they wanted to arrest him, but he escaped from them.

dag: N yi tam a yɛla, bee n yi bi lihi nyin Jɛrusalɛm ka a gari shɛlikam m bebu ni, n zilinli din leemi zilin tabinli.
en: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.

dag: Ka ŋun Ahazia daa pahi Ɛhab bia Jɔram la zuɣu, ka bɛ lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Siria Naa Hazaɛl Ramɔtigiliad, ka Sirianim daa ti ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: King Ahaziah joined King Joram of Israel in a war against King Hazael of Syria. The armies clashed at Ramoth in Gilead, and Joram was wounded in battle.

dag: N dimnim maa kul bɔrila soli dabisili kam ni bɛ saɣim m bukaata; bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla bɛ loya ni bɛ niŋ ma la zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt puu maa chira ayɔbu ni ka Naawuni daa tim malaika Gabirɛl Galili fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la.
en: During Elizabeths sixth month of pregnancy, God sent the angel Gabriel to a virgin girl who lived in Nazareth, a town in Galilee. She was engaged to marry a man named Joseph from the family of David. Her name was Mary.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti lan dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Shɛla. Chɛzib ka o daa be ka dɔɣ o.
en: The third one was born when Judah was in Chezib, and she named him Shelah.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni tilig o niriba, ka zo o daba nambɔɣu, o yi ti nya ka bɛ lan ka yiko, ka bɛ ni lo so bee bɛ ni bi lo so ti ku lan kpalim.
en: When only a few of the Lord 's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu; wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Listen, Lord , to my prayer; hear my cries for help.

dag: Yi dimnim tɔbbi yino ni ti kari yi ninvuɣ tuhili ka yi ŋmaligi guui, ka bɛ tɔbbih anu ni tooi kari ya ka yi zaa ŋmaligi guui, ka yi tɔbbi yino gba ti ku kpalim zani naɣila binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili din be zoli zuɣu la n-ni ti kpalim beni.
en: One thousand will flee at the threat of one, and at the threat of five you will flee, until you are left like a flagstaff on a mountaintop, like a flag on a hill.

dag: A ti ba pam, ka chɛ ka vuhirigu kam di n-tiɣi.
en: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli ba, N kul yɛn be yi san la daba ayi kɔŋko ka lan labi ŋun tim ma na maa sani.
en: Then Jesus said, I will be with you a little while longer. Then I will go back to the one who sent me.

dag: Dama n ku tɔɣisi shɛli yɛla n-naɣ pahila Masia ni zaŋ ma tum tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim deeg o noli n yɛligu mini n tuma ni.
en: I will not talk about anything I did myself. I will talk only about what Christ has done with me in leading the non-Jewish people to obey God. They have obeyed him because of what I have said and done.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb leei daba n-ʒi n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la ni yino. Di saha maa, Jɛhoyachin n-daa nyɛ Juda naa.
en: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon took King Jehoiachin of Judah into exile from Jerusalem, along with a group of captives, Mordecai was among them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pini zuɣukpina, ka so buri a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum a zuɣu ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini fabila pam.
en: They cut off all their hair and put on mourning clothes. In despair they weep for you, and bitterly perform the mourning rites.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kun ya tɔbu ni, ka gbahi yi ni shɛba ti leei daba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa na ku zan tariga. O daa loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: You will have to bow down like a prisoner. You will fall down like a dead man, but that will not help you. God will still be angry and ready to punish you.

dag: Di saha zoomba nina ni ti neei, ka tikpiranim wum.
en: The blind will be able to see, and the deaf will hear.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, doo bee paɣ yi bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka tum o kpee taali, dilan maa leei ŋun tum alahichi.
en: the following instructions for the people of Israel. When any of you are unfaithful to the Lord and commit a wrong against someone.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool ka o lu n-teei dɔni tiŋa, Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zuɣu. O daa lan ka yaa, dama o daa bi di binshɛli dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa.
en: Saul immediately fell full length on the ground, utterly terrified at what Samuel had said. He was weak because he hadnt eaten anything all day or night.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba o wuhibu maa ni, Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la.
en: As Jesus was teaching, he said: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes and be greeted in the market.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb yaha, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni m pun mali bindirigu dibu shili; ka pun ku naɣilahi mini naɣipol kpaba, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, dinzuɣu ni bɛ kam amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na.
en: So he sent other servants with this message for the guests: My feast is ready now; my steers and prize calves have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding feast.

dag: Sanbalat ni daa wum ni ti lan piligi mɛri gooni maa, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o puuni zaa diri buɣim ka o piligi maani Yɛhudianim ansarisi.
en: When Sanballat heard that we Jews had begun rebuilding the wall, he became furious and began to ridicule us.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ paɣila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o yurilim maŋli la naani.
en: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.

dag: Ashili pini nyɛla din maari suhuyiɣisili, ka ashilɔni birapu tibu gba nyɛ din maari suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ.
en: People walking by insulted him, shaking their heads and saying, Ha! So you were going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, were you?.

dag: Ka ŋun Yisahaku daa ti yi nti be samban ni zaawuni n-tɛhir o suhu ni, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka laakumnim kanna.
en: He went out in the early evening to take a walk in the fields and saw camels coming.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Ka a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela neesim ni; amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela zibisim ni.
en: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eye is healthy, your whole body is full of light. But when your eye is bad, your whole body is full of darkness.

dag: Amaa wuhim Jɔshua ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama ŋuna n-yɛn leei niriba ŋɔ zuɣulana n-zaŋ ba du nti deei a ni yɛn nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ti ba.
en: You must give instructions to Joshua. Encourage him. Make him strong, because Joshua must lead the people across the Jordan River. You can see the land, but Joshua will lead them into that land. He will help them take the land and live in it.

dag: dama Naawuni pala ŋun tumdi chirachira, amaa o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun tumdi din doli soli. Zaŋ chaŋ di ni be Yisa nyaandoliba cheechinim zaa ni shɛm la polo.
en: God isnt a God of disorder but of peace. Like in all the churches of Gods people.

dag: Di piligu dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, daba ayopɔin maa dali gba, di simdi ka yi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di bi simdi ka yi tum tuma di dabisa maa ni, amaa yi ni tooi duɣi yi bindira dina.
en: The first day and the seventh day will be a holy occasion for you. No work at all should be done on those days, except for preparing the food that everyone is going to eat. That is the only work you may do.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: But Peter said, I cant do that, Lord! I have never eaten anything that is not pure or fit to be used for food.

dag: Amaa o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋmahinli la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa.
en: But the temple Jesus was talking about was his body.

dag: Yi ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli mali yimaŋa ka yi biɛhigu be kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi yuri yi mabihi yurilim maŋli ni la zuɣu, kul yumiya taba yi suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Now that by your obedience to the truth you have purified yourselves and have come to have a sincere love for other believers, love one another earnestly with all your heart.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa ti leei Naawuni dini, ka bɛ sɔɣ pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Ahazia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoram died and was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Ahaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: O mi ku kabigi gbiŋgban dalim bee n-kpihim firila mia buɣim hal nti tahi yɛlimaŋli nasara dibu na.
en: He will not break off a bent reed, nor put out a flickering lamp. He will persist until he causes justice to triumph.

dag: O tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya nahiŋgu mini duŋtaariba nuu ni; bɛ nyɛviya nyɛla din viɛl pam o sani.
en: He saves them from the cruel people who try to hurt them. Their lives are important to him.

dag: Ziɔn nachimbihi daa ŋmanila salima ti sani. Nyam bɛ ni niŋ ba shɛm kaman yaɣiri duɣ shɛŋa yaɣimɛra ni zaŋ o nuhi me la.
en: Zions precious children, once valued as pure gold— oh no!—now they are worth no more than clay pots made by a potter.

dag: Ka pirigibu buyi zuɣu bɛn bi kanna tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali la mi ni guli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: You who are in the first two groups that usually go off duty on the Sabbath should also guard the LORDs temple to protect the king.

dag: N ni ti a alizanda nam saafɛbihi, ka a yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni; ka a yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, di mi ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: I will give you the keys to Gods kingdom. When you speak judgment here on earth, that judgment will be Gods judgment. When you promise forgiveness here on earth, that forgiveness will be Gods forgiveness.

dag: Ka ŋun Firawuna daa pirig o nuu ni nintu shɛli o ni mali dalindi binyara n-zaŋ li piri Yisifu, ka zaŋ bimpiɛl viɛlli kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ salima dolibi yɛl o;.
en: Then Pharaoh gave his special ring to Joseph. The royal seal was on this ring. Pharaoh also gave Joseph a fine linen robe and put a gold chain around his neck.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini. .
en: When the farmers saw the son, they said to each other, This is the owners son. This vineyard will be his. If we kill him, it will be ours.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila zuɣupil shɛli din mali jilima be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka lan be kaman nam zuɣupiligu la be a Naawuni nuu ni.
en: You will be a splendid garland in the LORDs hand, a royal turban in the palm of Gods hand.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi maani yɛla ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi zaŋdi yi yɛla tahiri cheechi ni bi dihi ninvuɣ shɛb bebu tabili sani?.
en: So then if you have ordinary lawsuits, do you appoint people as judges who arent respected by the church?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo ti di, amaa ka kum na kul mali ba. Bɛ ni ti lan zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Hal bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bihi gba leei bindirigu.
en: they consumed on the right, but remained hungry; devoured on the left, and werent satisfied. They devoured the flesh of their own children.

dag: Sulemaana daa nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuun yini puuni.
en: Solomon received an annual income of six hundred sixty-six kikkars of gold.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya o maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ dii zɔri chan o sani ti puhir o.
en: The crowd was really surprised to see Jesus, and everyone hurried over to greet him.

dag: Tɛkɔa paɣ maa ni daa ti paai naa tooni, o daa lumi gbani zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naa, fam ma bahi.
en: The woman went to the king, bowed down to the ground in respect, and said, Help me, Your Majesty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni tuhi tɔbu n-di biŋkɔb shɛb la naɣilahi kɔbisiyopɔin mini piɛri tusaayopɔin m-mali sara ti Yawɛ dindali maa.
en: At that time they sacrificed bulls and sheep and goats to the Lord . Asas army had taken the animals and other valuable things from their enemies.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa baŋ nɛma maa ka yɛli, Paɣ maa nyɛla wuntizɔra n-gari ma, n ni bi zaŋ o ti m bia Shɛla la zuɣu. Ka o daa bi saɣi ka o mini paɣ maa lan dɔni yaha.
en: Those are mine! Judah admitted. She's a better person than I am, because I broke my promise to let her marry my son Shelah. After this, Judah never slept with her again.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti ʒini saria karibu ʒiya n-fa o yiko maa, ka bah o yoli kahikahi.
en: But he will finally be judged, and his kingdom completely destroyed.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa ni barinyuriba, amaa bɛ barinyubo maa nyɛla yoli.
en: We have heard of Moabs pride, his great pride, his outrageous pride and arrogance, his empty boasting.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lab Ilaisha sanna Jɛriko o ni daa be luɣ shɛli, ka o bɔhi ba, N daa pun bi yɛli ya ni yi di chaŋ.
en: When these men returned to Elisha, who was staying in Jericho, he said to them, Didnt I tell you not to go.

dag: Kpahim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be gbiŋgbaŋ ni la zuɣu ni; ka kpahi zuliya kam naɣilahi mini bɛ naɣibihi la zuɣu ni. Nom taai ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yu farigu deebu pam la. Wurimmi zuliya shɛb bɛn yuri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla pam la.
en: Punish the people in Egypt. They are like cattle in the marshes, like bulls among the calves. You humiliated them. You scattered them in war. Now let them come crawling to you, bringing their pieces of silver.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa kul be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam. O daa nyɛla gbarigu.
en: Mephibosheth lived in Jerusalem. He was crippled in both feet, and every day he ate at the kings table.

dag: N di yuya ni yi ni so kpari Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka yi ku lan mali buɣim pa n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ka di ka buchi. N nini bi lan tiɣi ya, ka n ku lan deei yi ni maani sara shɛli tiri ma. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Who among you will shut the doors of the temple so that you dont burn something on my altar in vain? I take no delight in you, says the LORD of heavenly forces. I wont accept a grain offering from your hand.

dag: ka ŋun pa o zuɣu mini.
en: Then the second one married the woman.

dag: Ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb diri bɛ puri bindira, hal ka kpɛri gɔhi ni ti yihiri li; ka kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri ye bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: The hungry devour their crops; its taken even from the thorns, and the thirsty pant after their yield.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan zaŋ n vuhim dabisa ti ba ka di leei shihirili m mini ba sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-maani ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: I also told them about all the special days of rest, which were a special sign between us. They showed that I am the Lord and that I was making them special to me.

dag: M-pahi, ŋuni ka n lan yɛn jɛm ka pa ni n dan Dauda bia? N ni daa kul jɛmd a ba shɛm, lala ka n yɛn jɛm a gba.
en: Besides, it seems right for me to serve you, just as I served your father.

dag: O suhu zaa daa kul yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu zuɣu, ka din pahi nyɛla o daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini Ashɛrim ŋmahima zaa din be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: His heart found pleasure in the ways of the Lord . He removed the high places and the Asherah poles from the country of Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa pii kuɣili sa nimaani ni di nyɛ din teeri ba.
en: So Jacob took a stone, set it up as a sacred pillar.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim ti ba bɛ ni kul suhi shɛlikam zaa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ijiptinim maa daazichi pam pahi chaŋ.
en: The Lord had made the Egyptians friendly toward the people of Israel, and they gave them whatever they asked for. In this way they carried away the wealth of the Egyptians when they left Egypt.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti liri Dɛbirinima. Bɛ daa tuui booni li la Kiriatisɛfa.
en: From there the men of Judah marched against the city of Debir, at that time called Kiriath Sepher.

dag: Dama bɛ daa chɛ ka o suhu miligi, ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi simdi.
en: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.

dag: Gɛra pisi n-yɛn nyɛ shɛkal yini. Shɛkal pihiyɔbu n-yɛn nyɛ mina zaɣ yini yi sani.
en: A shekel must equal gerahs. A mina must equal shekels. It must be equal to shekels plus shekels plus shekels.

dag: A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, a ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ ku chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: As a matter of fact, it may save their lives.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛl o, Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka n yɛl a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: But Ahab replied, When you speak to me in the name of the Lord , tell the truth! How many times do I have to tell you that.

dag: dindina yin niŋmiya ʒiri shɛhiralan maa kaman o ni di lo ni o niŋ o kpee maa shɛm maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
