en: you must punish them with the same punishment the other person would have received. In this way you will remove this evil from your group.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihitaayika.
en: the descendants of Bebai:.

dag: Yil anahi din daa bili yina n-zani tuuli yilli din daa kab la zaashee la wuhiri ni nama anahi ni ti yiɣisi n-zani nam zaɣ yini maa zaashee, ka di mi ti ku mali kpiɔŋ kaman tuuli nam maa.
en: After this horn is broken, four other kingdoms will appear, but they won't be as strong.

dag: Ka Huram daa mali daanya daantalis ayi sɔŋ. Zaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii. Ka booi booli pa di naŋgbanyɛhi zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anii. Ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla, ka daantaliga din pah ayi gba be lala.
en: Huram made two bronze columns for the porch. Each column was cubits tall and cubits around. The columns were hollow and their metal walls were inches thick.

dag: Ulam bidibisi daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ peentɔriba ni yɛlimaŋli. O daa mali bidibisi mini yaansi pam. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: Ulam's sons were outstanding soldiers and archers. He had a hundred and fifty sons and grandsons in all. All those named above were members of the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa ni daa tuui ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisi, kaman nakpaa pirigili palo puuni.
en: Before they had gone meters, they had killed about Philistines.

dag: A zaŋ ʒim ti bɛn daa yih a wuntizɔriba mini anabinim ʒim la ni bɛ nyu. Di ni simdi ni a niŋ ba shɛm m-bala.
en: The people have spilled the blood of your holy people and your prophets. Now you have given those people blood to drink. This is what they deserve.

dag: Ka binneen shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban ni ka nyɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri n-nyɛ: nantariga mini jɛŋgbariga ni wua min o balibu zaa.
en: The following are unclean for you among the small creatures that move about on the ground: the rat, the mouse, any kind of large lizard.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni tiligi ya. M bolila yi yuli, mani n-sun ya.
en: Israel, the Lord who created you says, Do not be afraid—I will save you. I have called you by name—you are mine.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, N ni be Hanun Nahash bia ŋɔ yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu kaman o ba ni daa be ma yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi Nahash kuli maa ti o. Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa ti paai Ammɔnnim maa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: David said, Ill be loyal to Nahashs son Hanun, just as his father was loyal to me. So David sent his servants with condolences concerning Hanuns father. But when Davids servants arrived in Ammonite territory.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ ba niŋ Yisifu nuu ni ka o sɔŋdi ba. Ka bɛ daa be duu maa ni n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: The commander put the two prisoners under Josephs care. The two men continued to stay in prison for some time.

dag: o yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka bi niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka bi zaŋdi o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tuma ni, ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli m-maani niriba bɛn zabi yɛtɔɣa.
en: They dont impose interest or take profit. They refrain from evil and settle cases between people fairly.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi gba di li shɛhira ti sani. Tuuli o daa yɛlimi:.
en: The Holy Spirit affirms this when saying.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛb ni. Ifriimnim nyɛla bɛn dɔni yaɣ yini tabili, ka bɛ lɛbigi.
en: The Lord says, The people of Israel are like a half-baked loaf of bread. They rely on the nations around them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu shili zaa dindali maa. Bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu kaman Naa Jɔsia ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: So, as King Josiah had commanded, everything was done that day for the worship of the Lord , the keeping of the Passover Festival, and the offering of burnt offerings on the altar.

dag: Anzinfa mini salima palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daazichi ka tariga. Yuri palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ka tariga.
en: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bara maa, M bia, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the paralyzed man, Young man, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Ka bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi daa yi kani bɛ sanna sahasaha nti sɔŋdi ba daba ayopɔinpɔin.
en: Their relatives came in from their settlements, from time to time, to assist them for a period of seven days.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn je ninvuɣ so ŋun galindi din bi tuhi, ka zaɣisiri ŋun yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: They hate the one who judges at the city gate, and they reject the one who speaks the truth.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni naa yɛliya, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ kpɛhi duu ka tir o bindirigu biɛlabiɛla mini kom biɛlabiɛla hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ kpalimmi be yi zaa sani. Ami!.
en: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.

dag: Bɛ daa yihila tinsi pinaayi Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba kaman bɛ daŋ maa niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The tribes that were the descendants of Merari got cities. They got the cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun. They got them by throwing lots.

dag: m-bol o yuli Nuhu ka yɛli, Bia ŋɔ ni sɔŋ ti ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni, Yawɛ ni yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: Lamech said, I'll name him Noah because he will give us comfort, as we struggle hard to make a living on this land that the Lord has put under a curse.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ di vi, ka dabiɛm mali ba sahakam; ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi ni vi.
en: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa yiɣisi zaŋ bɛ tuuta doli tab gbilligbilli pa bɛ zuɣu. Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe.

dag: ka o ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi, ka kum ku lan beni bee fabila bee kumsi, ka biɛrim gba ku lan beni yaha, dama bin kura la zaa vuuya.
en: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, sadness, crying, or pain. All the old ways are gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu teemiya ka doli n zaligunim maa zaa, ka be kasi yi Naawuni sani.
en: The tassels will remind you to keep all my commands, and you will belong completely to me.

dag: M puhiri Filolɔgus mini Julia ni Nɛrius min o tizɔpaɣa ni Olimpas ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn zaa be bɛ san la gba.
en: Greetings to Philologus and Julia, to Nereus and his sister, to Olympas and to all of God's people who are with them.

dag: Amaa o naɣ ni yɛlimi, M pala anabi, n nyɛla pukpara. Tiŋgbani zuɣu ka man kul kuriya nahindi m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Each will say, Im not a prophet. Im a man who works the ground, for the soil has been my occupation since I was young.

dag: Jɛhudi daa yi karim kulis ata bee kulis anahi, naa zaŋdila subila ŋ-ŋmaai o ni karim shɛli maa bahi buɣim ni kurupooti maa ni hal ka buɣim ti di gbaŋ maa zaa kurupooti maa ni.
en: And whenever Jehudi read three or four columns of the scroll, the king would cut them off with a scribes knife and throw them into the firepot until the whole scroll was burned up.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a boli ma ninvuɣ suŋ? Ninvuɣ suŋ kani n-naɣ pahila Naawuni.
en: Jesus answered, Why do you call me good? Only God is good.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ so n ni doli ŋɔ ni chɛ ka a min o malaika doli chaŋ, ka ti a nasara ka a kpuɣi paɣa n yaannim ya ni n dɔɣiriba sanna ti ti m bia maa.
en: He answered, The Lord , whom I have always obeyed, will send his angel with you and give you success. You will get for my son a wife from my own people, from my father's family.

dag: Ka pako so ŋun nyɛ pako maŋli nyɛla ŋun kpalim o ko, ka zaŋ o tahima niŋla Naawuni ni, ka kul mali wunsuhigu suhiri Naawuni o ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: A widow who is truly needy and all alone puts her hope in God and keeps on going with requests and prayers, night and day.

dag: ni Aijalɔn ni Gatirimɔn ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Aijalon, and Gathrimmon, with their pasture lands.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ diba anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: and sew them together into two panels with five sections each.

dag: Ŋuna n-fa ti zibisim yiko ni bahi, ka zaŋ ti ni alaafee nti kpɛhi o Biyurigu la nam ni.
en: He rescued us from the power of darkness and brought us safe into the kingdom of his dear Son.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ .
en: and I am the God you worshiped at Bethel, when you poured olive oil on a rock and made a promise to me. Leave here at once and return to the land where you were born.

dag: Di bemi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm o litaafi ni la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi.
en: This is just as it was written in the scroll of the words of Isaiah the prophet, A voice crying out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight.

dag: O bi nya ka zuɣubiɛɣu be Yaakubu zuliya ni; bee n-nya ka muɣisigu shɛli be Izraɛlnim sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa be bɛ sani. Ka bɛ yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ naa m-be bɛ sani.
en: God saw no wrong in Jacobs people. He saw no sin in the Israelites. The Lord is their God, and he is with them. The Great King is with them!.

dag: Di simdi ni tiŋgbani dam dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, ka ŋunkam be di ni fabili. Di simdi ni di kpuɣi du zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la n-lalilali gili nti lab ti fim; ka lan kpuɣi zuɣusaa n-lab lu tiŋa kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: Will not the land tremble on this account, and all who live in it mourn, as it rises and overflows like the Nile, and then falls again, like the River of Egypt?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni zaŋ yi binyoya mini yi ni tum tuumbiɛri din chihiri shɛŋa zaa n-ta n-jɛmbu duu daɣiri la zuɣu, n ni kun ya, n ku yuli yaɣi so zuɣu, m mi ku zo so nambɔɣu.
en: Therefore, as I am the living God—this is the word of the Sovereign Lord —because you defiled my Temple with all the evil, disgusting things you did, I will cut you down without mercy.

dag: N niŋdi lala ni di chɛ ka bɛ malila suhukpeeni ka laɣim zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili taba yurilim puuni, ka lan mali yɛlimaŋli baŋsim din tahiri tahima zaa din ŋmani azichi na. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ baŋ Naawuni ashili din nyɛ Masia maŋmaŋ la.
en: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery.

dag: nti kul be Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: And they were continuously in the temple praising God.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri kpalim zani luɣ yini, ka goli gba kpalim zani hal ka Izraɛlnim ti bɔhi bɛ dimnim maa biɛri naai. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛla sab be Jashar Litaafi ni. Wuntaŋ daa kpalim zani zuɣusaa dɛde ka bi bɔri yomyom ni o lu hal ti paai dabisi muni.
en: So the sun did not move, and the moon stopped until the people defeated their enemies. This story is written in the Book of Jashar . The sun stopped in the middle of the sky. It did not move for a full day.

dag: Ka salo maa daa nya Yisa ni chaŋ ti kpe Zakius yiŋ maa ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, O chaŋ ti kpe alahichilan la yiŋa.
en: Everyone saw this. They began to complain, Look at the kind of man Jesus is staying with. Zacchaeus is a sinner.

dag: Shamga Anat bia saha la mini Jaɛl saha la, sochandiba bɛn daari doli taba daa bi lan chana, ka bɛn gɔri mi kpalim baɣisirila sokpansi.
en: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, caravans no longer went through the land, and travelers used the back roads.

dag: Amaa yinima nina mal alibarika, dama di nyara; ka yi tiba gba mal alibarika, dama di wumda.
en: But God has blessed you. You understand what you see with your eyes. And you understand what you hear with your ears.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka zaŋ o leei ti yɛm mini ti wuntia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali ti ka ti be kasi ni ŋun yihi ti alahichi ni.
en: But God has brought you into union with Christ Jesus, and God has made Christ to be our wisdom. By him we are put right with God; we become God's holy people and are set free.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi baŋ din yɛn niŋ ma kpe ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli, n ni lo nia tim o yi sanna.
en: So I hope to send him to you as soon as I know how things are going to turn out for me.

dag: Jair daa malila bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn bari bunsi pihita. Ka o bihi maa daa mali tinsi pihita Giliad tiŋgban ni; ka bɛ na kul booni li Havɔtijairi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He had sons, and each son had his own mule and was in charge of one town in Gilead. Those towns are still called The Settlements of Jair.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zaliya ni Jɔram kaabu maa n-yɛn nyɛ Ahazia bahigu. Dama o ni daa yi nimaani ka o mini Jɔram doli tab chana, ka bɛ daa chirigi Nimshi bia Jɛhu, Yawɛ ni daa zali so ni o kum Ɛhab daŋ ni niriba zaa la.
en: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family.

dag: Mɛrari daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim, bɛ daa zaŋla Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni tinsi kaman Rimɔno mini Tabo ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The remaining families of the clan of Merari were assigned the following towns with the surrounding pasture lands: In the territory of Zebulun: Rimmono and Tabor.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka mali biɛri suŋ, di so jɛrigu ŋun ŋmari ʒiri.
en: It is better to be poor and honest than to be a liar and a fool.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka nyɛ na titali ŋun gari wuna zaa.
en: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa, ka zaŋ dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: The priest shall examine it and put the object away for seven days.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yuli ka n zaŋ kana, ka yi ti bi deei ma, amaa so yi ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli kana, ŋuna ka yi ni deei.
en: I have come from my Father and speak for him, but you dont accept me. But when other people come speaking only for themselves, you accept them.

dag: O yi ti nya wɔribariba ayiyi bee bumbariba bee laakumbariba ka bɛ kanna, ŋun gbilisim o tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: When he sees chariots, pairs of horsemen, donkey riders, camel riders, he should listen carefully, carefully, very carefully.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, Judanim ni ti chaŋ ti pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka bɛ laɣim taba n-yi nuzaa polo tiŋgban ni n-ka n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yaannim ni bɛ su li la ni na.
en: Israel will join with Judah, and together they will come from exile in the country in the north and will return to the land that I gave your ancestors as a permanent possession.

dag: Ka Pita min o nyaandolitab piniyin la daa yiɣisi zani ka Pita duh o yee pam yɛli, Yinim Judianim mini yi zaa bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ ka baŋ yɛlli ŋɔ gbinni.
en: Then Peter stood up with the other eleven apostles and in a loud voice began to speak to the crowd: Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, listen to me and let me tell you what this means.

dag: Dama a mini mɔɣu ni kuɣa ni ti lo tab alikauli. Ka a mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti be ni suhudoo.
en: The fields you plow will be free of rocks; wild animals will never attack you.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna ti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Some Pharisees came to him and tried to trap him by asking, Does our Law allow a man to divorce his wife for whatever reason he wishes.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka daai Gaat mini Jamnia ni Ashidɔd goondahi zaa luhi, ka me fɔntinsi miri Ashidɔd mini Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: Uzziah went to war against the Philistines. He tore down the walls of the cities of Gath, Jamnia, and Ashdod, and built fortified cities near Ashdod and in the rest of Philistia.

dag: A yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, ka na kul gbib ba.
en: If you again refuse to let them go.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni n-kul tɛhiri di yɛla.
en: Mary continued to think about these things, trying to understand them.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla naa kpambaliba kana ni bɛ ti puhi ti dan Naa Dauda ni o zuɣusuŋ ka yɛra, A Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka Sulemaana yuli du n-gar a yuli, ka chɛ ka o nam gar a nam. Ka Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa o bindoo zuɣu;.
en: And listen to this! David's officials told him, We pray that your God will help Solomon to be an even greater king! David was in his bed at the time, but he bowed.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa yɛl o ma, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a suhirila Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili maa n-tiri Adɔnija? Dindina suhim ma nam ŋɔ gba ti o; dama o nyɛla m biɛli, ka maligumaana Abiata mini Zɛruya bia Jɔab la be o polo.
en: Solomon said: What? Let my older brother marry Abishag? You may as well ask me to let him rule the kingdom! And why don't you ask such favors for Abiathar and Joab?.

dag: N kul ku tam a zaligunim maa yɛla; dama di zuɣu ka a ti ma nyɛvili.
en: I will never neglect your instructions, because by them you have kept me alive.

dag: ka chɛ ka noombil nɛɔŋ maa yiɣi yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣu ni, ka maligumaana maa yo yili maa alahichi samli, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: He will go to an open field outside the city and let the living bird go free. In this way the priest will make the house pure. The house will be clean.

dag: di saha yin bɔhimiya ka vihi di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga; di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni bɛ tum din chihiri ŋɔ yi sunsuuni.
en: If you hear such a rumor, investigate it thoroughly; and if it is true that this evil thing did happen.

dag: bee binyara din be zuɣusaa bee binyara din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛŋa din be binnamda puuni zaa shɛli ku tooi yihi ti Naawuni yurilim din be ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la ni.
en: or height or depth, or any other thing that is created.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi di mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi naan tooi yɛli sinsabiga ŋɔ ni di vuɣim di zaashee ŋɔ chaŋ ti zani teeku ni, ka di di niŋ lala.
en: The Lord said, If your faith is as big as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, Dig yourself up and plant yourself in the ocean! And the tree will obey you.

dag: Miri ka a bo a piriba bee a mapira, dama nir yi niŋ lala o dɔɣira ka o bo maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your mothers sister or your fathers sister. That is a sin of incest. You must be punished for your sins.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la nira n-nyɛ ma: N nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun be mɔɣu ni m-mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma soli ka di tuhi. .
en: John told them the words of the prophet Isaiah: I am the voice of someone shouting in the desert: Make a straight road ready for the Lord. Isaiah :.

dag: ka o lu tiŋa, ka wum ka kukol shɛli boon o na yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice asking him, Saul, Saul, why are you harassing me.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Karimba, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Teacher, what is the most important commandment in the Law.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, bɔɣilɔ titali n-do ti mini ya sunsuuni, ka so ku tooi yi ti sani m-baai yaɣ li ka yi sanna; ka so mi ku tooi yi yi sani ka ti sanna.
en: Also, there is a big pit between you and us. No one can cross over to help you, and no one can come here from there.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi, bɛ yi fo, kuɣa ni deei kuhi yɛli.
en: Jesus answered, I tell you that if they keep quiet, the stones themselves will start shouting.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, amaa ka lee tumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, dindina hal bɛ ni bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa zaa yoli, bɛ kul mali fukumsi zaligu bɛ suhuri ni m-bala.
en: Gentiles dont have the Law. But when they instinctively do what the Law requires they are a Law in themselves, though they dont have the Law.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni Sinai Zoli gbin la, yi daa bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: On the day the Lord spoke to you from the fire at Mount Horeb, you did not see him—there was no shape for God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samsin daa ti bɔri paɣ so ŋun be Sɔrɛk Vinvamli ni ka o yuli booni Dilaila.
en: Some time after this, in the Sorek Valley, Samson fell in love with a woman whose name was Delilah.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila Yawɛ suhu yula bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ mini sara pina n-gar o noli deebu? Nyama, noli deebu gari sara maligu, ka o yɛligu wumbu mi gari piɛla kara.
en: Tell me, Samuel said. Does the Lord really want sacrifices and offerings? No! He doesn't want your sacrifices. He wants you to obey him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Ayuba ni dabisa shɛŋa din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni n-gari o ni daa pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm piligu ni la. O daa malila piɛri tuhi pinaanahi mini laakumnim tusaayɔbu ni naɣilahi tusaayi ni bunnyama tuhili.
en: The Lord blessed the last part of Job's life even more than he had blessed the first. Job owned fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, two thousand head of cattle, and one thousand donkeys.

dag: Di chɛ ka m mali galimi n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a zaligunim maa polo, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka n ku di vi.
en: May I perfectly obey your commandments and be spared the shame of defeat.

dag: Amaa ka o tab maa yɛli, Guhim pɔi! Chɛ ka ti nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana ti tilig o bee o ku kana.
en: But the others said, Wait, let us see if Elijah is coming to save him.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a ni daa pun yɛli ni a ni niŋ ti mini ti kpamba shɛm. A darigi Jɛrusalɛm tibili pam gari tiŋ kam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.

dag: Samarianim maa ni daa wum Filip yɛligu ka nya o ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa ni suhu yini.
en: The crowds paid close attention to what Philip said, as they listened to him and saw the miracles that he performed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinim mini Jɛturinim ni Nafishinim ni Nɔdabinima.
en: When they waged war on the Hagrites.

dag: Buɣim ni ti din ya nimaani, ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ŋmahi ya. Di ni ti din ya kaman toli la. Nabimiya kaman toli la, ka nabiya kaman sakɔri la.
en: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!.

dag: Manaasa zuliya ni niriba pirigili la daa bolila ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika yuya n-tim ba na ni bɛ ti zaŋ Dauda leei naa.
en: From half the tribe of Manasseh there were , men. They were called by name to come and make David king.

dag: Ka toli daa yi nyɔhi maa ni lu tiŋgban ni na, ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nɔnsi yiko tatabo ti ba.
en: Then locusts came out of the smoke and went down to the earth. They were given the power to sting like scorpions.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba la daa tɔɣisiri ti Duuma Yisa kum ni neebu yɛla ni yiko pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika pam daa be bɛ zaa ni.
en: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers.

dag: Ka o dii ŋmaligi zo n-lab Naa maa sani ti yɛl o, M bɔri ni a zaŋla Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu niŋ pɔŋ ni ti ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Hurrying back to the ruler, she made her request: I want you to give me John the Baptists head on a plate, right this minute.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni malaika daa yɛli ma zahindi maa ni, Yaakubu, ka n saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: Then God's angel called me by name. I answered.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: Esaus third wife was Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah. Esau and Oholibamahs children were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro maa m-paɣi Naawuni di zuɣu, ka zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka lan niŋ zahim la gba lala hal ka bɛ zaa ti nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛm tariga.
en: Then Jesus took the bread. When he had given thanks, he distributed it to those who were sitting there. He did the same with the fish, each getting as much as they wanted.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha ka Juda Naa Jɔash bia Naa Amazia daa di Juda nam.
en: In the second year of the reign of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz as king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah.

dag: ni kpa shɛli din yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni yi ni yɛn zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛl tuɣindi luɣ kasi shee la. Di simdi ka bɛ tum n ni zal a ni a tum shɛlikam zaa.
en: the sweet-smelling anointing oil; the sweet-smelling incense for the Holy Place. These workers must make everything the way that I have commanded you.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Samsin, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo a mihi n-zaŋ a ti ti Filistianim maa. Ka Samsin yɛli ba, Pomiya ni yimaŋmaŋ ku ku ma.
en: They told him, We have come here to tie you up, so we can hand you over to them. Samson said, Give me your word that you won't kill me yourselves.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛli shɛm maa bi wuhirila chɛfirinim bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma ka nyɛ kɔrɛnim mini ninvuɣ fariba ni buɣijɛmdiba la; di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi naɣ ni yila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But I did not mean the people of this world. You would have to leave the world to get away from all the people who sin sexually, or who are greedy and cheat each other, or who worship idols.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, pom Naawuni kpe ni a ku yɔhim m mini m bihi ni n zuliya; amaa n ni ʒe a yim shɛm, a gba zanimi m mini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni kana ti beni ŋɔ yim.
en: So make a promise to me here before God. Promise that you will be fair with me and with my children. Promise that you will be kind to me and this country where you have lived. Promise that you will be as kind to me as I have been to you.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kpe Yaakubu suɣili ni n-yi nimaani kpe Liya suɣili ni, ka yi nimaani kpe dabipaɣiba ayi la suɣa ni, amaa ka bi nya shɛli di ni. Ka o daa yi Liya suɣili ni chaŋ ti kpe Reechɛl suɣili ni.
en: Laban searched the tents of Jacob, Leah, and the two servant women, but did not find the idols. Then he went to Rachel's tent.

dag: Ka a noli mɔɣisibu ŋmani wain viɛlli din chani viɛnyɛliŋga. Dindina, n yuya ni wain maa paagi n yura maa n-zo n-tiɛli o naŋgbampiba min o nyina.
en: May your mouth be like the best wine, flowing straight to my love, flowing gently to the sleepers lips.

dag: So tuma yi ti kpalim be o ni zaŋ shɛli me n-tam duu gbinni tanzaa maa zuɣu, o ni deei di laara.
en: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.

dag: Jɛdiayɛl bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan, ka Bilihan mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Bɛnjamin ni Ɛhud ni Chɛnaana ni Zɛtan ni Tarishish ni Ahishahar.
en: Jediael had one son, Bilhan, and Bilhan had seven sons: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

dag: Kpeen so daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A certain ruler asked Jesus, Good Teacher, what must I do to obtain eternal life.

dag: Alahichi daa pun bela dunia ŋɔ ni hal ka Naawuni ti naanyi zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa fukumsi zaligu ni daa na kani la, shɛli daa kani din ni wuhi ni alahichi tumbu chihira.
en: Although sin was in the world, since there was no Law, it wasnt taken into account until the Law came.

dag: Di nyɛla din ni tooi sɔŋ nira kaman liɣiri ni sɔŋdi nir shɛm. Baŋsim daanfaani nyɛla yɛm tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li nyɛvili.
en: Wisdoms protection is like the protection of money; the advantage of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the lives of its possessors.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga nti yɛn nyɛ Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli zaŋ hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din be Lɛbɔhamat samban ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ wulinluhili polo yaɣili.
en: The western boundary is formed by the Mediterranean and runs north to a point west of Hamath Pass.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin maa daa ti gari, ka paɣ maa yi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-lab o ya nti chaŋ ni o ti yɛli naa ka o zaŋ o yili min o tiŋgbani labisi ti o.
en: When seven years had passed, the woman returned from Philistia. She went to appeal to the king for her house and her farmland.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛra daa ti tum birigi bɛ dan Ijipti naa maa.
en: While Joseph was in prison, both the king's personal servant and his chief cook made the king angry. So he had them thrown into the same prison with Joseph.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla mini Yisa so ŋun daa kpi ka Pool yɛli ni o ne la yɛla tɔɣisi.
en: Instead, they argued with him about some of their beliefs and about a dead man named Jesus, who Paul said was alive.

dag: Bɛn daa pun nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa bi leei maligumaaniba maa la pɔri zuɣu, amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun daa leei maligumaana la Naawuni ni daa po pɔri yɛl o: Ti Duuma ku lan taɣ o tɛha ka po, A nyɛla maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: But Jesus became a priest by means of a vow when God said to him, The Lord has made a solemn promise and will not take it back: You will be a priest forever.

dag: Di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisiri yomyom, dama jɛra suhuri ni ka suhuyiɣisili be.
en: Keep your temper under control; it is foolish to harbor a grudge.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa yiɣisi zani n-darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka pini o zuɣu, ka gbani tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: When Job heard this, he got up, tore his clothes, and shaved his head to show his sadness. Then he fell to the ground to bow down before God.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: I assure you that this generation wont pass away until all these things happen.

dag: ansarisimaaniba mini ninvuɣ turiba ni yɛri ti shɛm ti dimnim mini bɛn bɔri ni bɛ bɔhi ti biɛri ninni la zuɣu.
en: All I can hear are the jokes and insults of my enemies, as I watch them take their revenge.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom vuui ka chɛ soli tin ya hal ka yi ti gbaai li du. Di daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom vuui ka chɛ soli ti ti hal ka ti ti gbaai li du shɛm la.
en: The Lord your God caused the water in the Jordan River to stop flowing so that you could cross it on dry land—just as the Lord had stopped the water at the Red Sea so that we could cross it on dry land.

dag: Ka Musa daa saɣi m-be bɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Zipɔra ti Musa.
en: Moses agreed to come and live with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses as his wife.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la ni yɛn su tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm.
en: As the Lord had commanded Moses, the territories of the nine and one-half tribes west of the Jordan were determined by drawing lots.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti she di nimdi maa dindali yuŋ maa ŋ-ŋubi di mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to.
en: That night the meat is to be roasted, and eaten with bitter herbs and with bread made without yeast.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri karimbaani puuni bɛ niŋdi nandaamba alaka. Chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka sapashinnim maa mini bɛ tɔbbihi ni niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ tarimba ni wɔɣira daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Babilɔnnima.
en: After that, the army officers and all the people in Mizpah, whether important or not, were afraid of what the Babylonians might do. So they left Judah and went to Egypt.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu daa ti zahim zahindi ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani maan pahi.
en: One day, Joseph told his brothers what he had dreamed, and they hated him even more.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa gari tooni zaŋ Izraɛlnima ka bɛ yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni chani kaman tɔbbihi la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: As Israel traveled from Egypt under the command of Moses and Aaron.

dag: Naawuni bi dih o malaikanim tabili, ka sagbana pala din be kasi o sani.
en: If he doesnt trust his holy ones and the heavens arent pure in his eyes.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣil o lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: Jesus said, Leave her alone. Why are you giving her such trouble? She did a very good thing for me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa din daa be bɛ sani ka bɛ booni li Baalnim la mini buɣili Ashitarɔt labi, ka jɛmdila Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: So the Israelites got rid of their idols of Baal and Astarte, and worshiped only the Lord .

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka kayeeniba kpe Babilɔn nti yɛl li. Bɛ ni ti yi luɣilikam na nti naai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali.
en: I will send mercenaries to Babylon who will sift her and clear out her land. They will surround her on the day of disaster.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋm nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa pa tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kpaai ʒiɛri maa pol li. Ka Gidiɔn daa niŋ lala.
en: The angel of God said to Gideon, Put the meat and the bread on that rock over there. Then pour the broth on it. Gideon did as he was told.

dag: Ka o yi ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yaai zaligu ŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ninni ti o.
en: When the king begins to rule, he must write a copy of the law for himself in a book. He must make that copy from the books that the priests from the tribe of Levi keep.

dag: N ni bo bɛn bɔrigi la shee, ka taɣi bɛn yirigi la labisina, ka zaŋ tana lo bɛn nya dansi la, ka kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi la. Amaa bɛn bara, ka mali yaa la, n ni ku ba. N ni zaŋ din tuhi dihi ba.
en: I will look for those that are lost, bring back those that wander off, bandage those that are hurt, and heal those that are sick; but those that are fat and strong I will destroy, because I am a shepherd who does what is right.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man kul suhira. Naawuni, garigim ma a ni zali saha shɛli a yurilim maŋli din galisi la puuni min a ʒiɛyimtali sɔŋsim la puuni.
en: But as for me, I will pray to you, Lord ; answer me, God, at a time you choose. Answer me because of your great love, because you keep your promise to save.

dag: Yili maa ni bihi mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa malila sala buɣim zali ʒiɛya wuɣisira, dama wari n-daa be; ka Pita gba daa ʒe bɛ sani n-wuɣisiri buɣim maa.
en: The servants and the guards had made a fire because it was cold. They were standing around it, warming themselves. Peter joined them there, standing by the fire and warming himself.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Baal anabinim maa, Yi ni galisi maa zuɣu, daŋmiya pii yi naɣilaa kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa, ka suhi yi buɣili maa; amaa ka lee di niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: Elijah said to Baal's prophets, There are more of you, so you go first. Pick out a bull and get it ready, but don't light the fire. Then pray to your god.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa ni, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: At the resurrection, which of the seven brothers will be her husband? They were all married to her.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Filistianim ni doli dimdi din bi naara mini nia biɛri din be bɛ suhuri ni n-ku niriba la zuɣu.
en: The LORD God proclaims: When the Philistines set out to right the wrongs done to them, they enacted revenge with utter contempt and old hatreds.

dag: Jaadai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Rɛgɛm mini Jɔtam ni Gɛshan ni Pɛlɛt ni Ɛfa ni Shaaf.
en: Jahdais family: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela n sani kaman tɔbbia ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm la. Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka maa ni tuui lu. Bɛ ku nyaŋ ma. Bɛ ni di vi kara, dama bɛ ku di nasara. Bɛ ni nya filiŋ sahakam, ka di yɛla ka tambu.
en: But you, Lord , are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka bimmɔrim biɛri mɔri yi duna mini yi biɛhi, ka yi ku tooi tibi li. Di ni ti zaŋ yi napɔnvari ni hal ni yi zuɣutalisi ni.
en: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.

dag: Dama bɛn be ʒilinsi ni biriginsim n-kuri ba, ka jɛra mi nini ni tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ shɛm kuri ba.
en: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.

dag: Di saha ka Balak suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Balaam zuɣu, ka o zaŋ o nuhi kpahi taba ka yɛli Balaam, N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri bahi n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka a ti niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: When Balak heard this, he angrily struck his fist against his hand and said to Balaam, I called you to come and curse my enemies. But you have blessed them. You have blessed them three times.

dag: Gɛmaria bia Mikaya ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la ni daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa gbaŋ maa puuni.
en: A man named Micaiah heard all the messages from the Lord that Baruch read from the scroll. Micaiah was the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan.

dag: O ni daa ti saɣim o buni maa zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka kum titali daa lu tiŋ maa ni; ka kum wum o pam.
en: He spent everything he had. Then a severe famine spread over that country, and he was left without a thing.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di karitiy o; dama so kani ŋun ni tooi zaŋ n yuli tum alahiziba tuma ka dii lan ŋmaligi galim ma.
en: Do not try to stop him, Jesus told them, because no one who performs a miracle in my name will be able soon afterward to say evil things about me.

dag: Ka yɛnnim maa daa garigi yɛli ba, Di pa shɛli di ku saɣ ti mini ya zaa; dinzuɣu chamiya kpakɔhiriba sani nti da yi dintol dini na.
en: The wise girls answered, No! The oil we have might not be enough for all of us. But go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.

dag: N dabiɛm zɔbu puuni, n daa yɛliya ni so ku tooi niŋ so naani.
en: even when I said, out of fear, Everyone is a liar.

dag: O daa bi chɛ o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa. Dama o bilim ni ka dɔbba daa pun niŋ o kɔre n-zaŋ o saɣim.
en: Besides that, she never stopped her love affair with Egypt. Egypt made love to her when she was a young girl. Egypt was the first lover to touch her young breasts. Egypt poured his untrue love on her.

dag: Yinim Aroanima, zanimiya palli noli lihira! Doo bee paɣa yi ti zɔri garita, ka yi bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee niŋ.
en: You people of Aroer, go wait beside the road, and when refugees run by, ask them, What happened.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti boli paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bi kuri bidibbihi maa ka chɛ ba.
en: So the king sent for the midwives and asked them, Why are you doing this? Why are you letting the boys live.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ teebul la zali pateesa maa nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la zali tuhi teebuli maa zaŋ labi nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ teebuli maa zali nuzaa polo.
en: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.

dag: dama bɛ yi yɛl a, Dum zuɣusaa ŋɔ na, di so ni bɛ filim a ninvuɣ titali tooni.
en: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right.

dag: N daa yi Ibrahimma zuɣu, ka yi Yisahaku zuɣu, ka lan yi Yaakubu gba zuɣu n-wuhi ba ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa, amaa n daa bi kahigi n yuli Yawɛ wuhi ba.
en: I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob as God Almighty, but I didnt reveal myself to them by my name The LORD.

dag: Lala ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa, ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa nyɛ din viɛla ni din tuhi ka lan wuh o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: This is what Hezekiah did throughout all Judah, doing what the LORD his God considered good, right, and true.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛli m ba, A paɣa dɔɣi bidibiga ka o suhu paligi la zuɣu.
en: Curse the man who told my father the news that I was born. Its a boy! he said. You have a son. He made my father very happy when he told him the news.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: Always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.

dag: Daadam ni tooi lo nianim pam o suhu ni, amaa Yawɛ ni yu shɛli n-niŋda.
en: People may plan all kinds of things, but the Lord 's will is going to be done.

dag: Dahin shɛli a yi ti yɛn tuhi a dimnima, a tɔbbihi ni ti saɣi ti a. A nachimba ni ti ŋmanila asiba maligim n-laɣimna ti gil a sheeni zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: Your people will gladly join you when you gather your army together. You will wear your special clothes and meet together early in the morning. Your young men will be all around you like dew on the ground.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Kuɣ duli ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira m min a sunsuuni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban said to Jacob, This pile of rocks will remind us of our agreement. That's why the place was named Galeed.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun viɛla kaman saŋkpaliŋ la, ka simdi ni a yu o. Chɛ ka o biha tiɣ a nini sahakam, ka chɛ ka o ni yur a shɛm ku a zuɣu.
en: She is a lovely deer, a graceful doe. Let her breasts intoxicate you all the time; always be drunk on her love.

dag: M mabihi, di daa kpami ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Naa Dauda yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judas ŋun daa zaŋ niriba chaŋ ka bɛ ti gbaai Yisa la polo la niŋ pali.
en: My friends, he said, the scripture had to come true in which the Holy Spirit, speaking through David, made a prediction about Judas, who was the guide for those who arrested Jesus.

dag: nti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni miri ma. Zaŋm a bihi min a yaansi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu ni a niɣi ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa na;.
en: You can live in the region of Goshen, where you can be near me—you, your children, your grandchildren, your sheep, your goats, your cattle, and everything else that you have.

dag: Di simdi ka a chibi di nyiŋgoli ka o zuɣu ni tooi kpe di ni, ka a ti niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili kaman bɛ ni niŋdi kur tolinli niŋdi gbaɣino nyiŋgoli shɛm la ni kaman teela ni niŋdi shɛm la din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.

dag: Ka bɛn ti nya a ni ti kpaai bɛ nina kpa a ka di gari ba ka bɛ bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-daa dam dunia zaa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe zuliya kam zaa la?.
en: People will come to look at your dead body. They will think about you and say, Is this the same man who caused great fear in all the kingdoms on earth.

dag: Naad mini safurɔn ni kalamɔsi ni sinnamɔn ni firanki tulaale zim tihi zaa ni mɛɛr ni aloosi ni tulaale suma zaa be di ni.
en: saffron, calamus, cinnamon, frankincense, myrrh, and aloes —all the finest spices.

dag: Zaŋmiya ʒilinsi biɛhigu bahi ka be, ka doliya tɛhi zilima soli.
en: Leave your old, foolish ways and live! Advance along the path of understanding.

dag: Hal di yi niŋ lala ŋun di laɣim yuri pam lo bee n-chɛ ka niriba maa labi Ijipti ni bɛ ti laɣim yuri pam na ti pahi; dama Yawɛ daa yɛliya, Di lan labiya nimaani yaha.
en: The king is not to have a large number of horses for his army, and he is not to send people to Egypt to buy horses, because the Lord has said that his people are never to return there.

dag: Nyama, n ni pii n dab so m-bɔŋɔ; n ni yuri so ni n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala. N ni zaŋ n Shia niŋ o ni, ka o zaŋ yɛlimaŋli kari saria ti zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: Here is my servant, whom I have chosen, the one I love, and with whom I am pleased. I will send my Spirit upon him, and he will announce my judgment to the nations.

dag: Hagab ni Shamlai ni Hanan ni.
en: Hagab, Shalmai, Hanan.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka yi nyamma tɔŋ pam. Zuliya shɛb azichi ni zo na kaman mɔɣili kom la nti kpɛn ya; ka yi be kaman bi so ŋun ma kpuɣ o ʒili o naba zuɣu, n gbib o ni yurilim m-mɔɣisir o bihim la.
en: The LORD says: Look, Im extending prosperity to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like an overflowing stream. You will nurse and be carried on the hip and bounced upon the knee.

dag: Fomiya ti Duuma Yawɛ tooni, d amaa Yawɛ dabisili la miriya. Yawɛ niŋla sara maligu shili, o mal o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Be silent before the Lord GOD, because the Lord s day for judging the people is coming soon. The Lord has prepared his sacrifice, and he has told his invited guests to get ready.

dag: Niriba zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa yi Babilɔn doli ma n-lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu ʒiɛman ni la yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the list of the heads of the clans who had been in exile in Babylonia and who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem when Artaxerxes was emperor:.

dag: Wuhibunim ŋɔ yirila ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn nyɛ ʒirinima, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha diɣilim kaman kur tulli n-tabili li n-di li la sanna.
en: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars.

dag: N daa pun mi a mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam a a ma puli ni. N daa pun piig a mi zali pɔi ka bɛ ti naanyi dɔɣ a; ka n zaŋ a leei zuliya kam anabi.
en: Before I made you in your mothers womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I chose you for a special work. I chose you to be a prophet to the nations.

dag: Yi yi ti wum kikaa kumsi luɣ shɛli polo, yin laɣimmiya ti sanna. Ti Naawuni maa ni tuhi ti ti.
en: So if you hear the trumpet, run to that place. We will all meet together there, and our God will fight for us.

dag: Mɔɣa kom zɔri ti lurila teeku ni, amaa ka di bi paana. Kɔzɔrima maa ni zɔri yiri luɣ shɛŋa na, nimaani ka di na kul zɔri yirina.
en: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la ni ka di nyɛ kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali teeri Izraɛl bidibisi maa yɛla kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm.
en: Then they put these jewels on the shoulder pieces of the ephod. These jewels were to help God to remember the Israelites. This was done as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yihi wuntizɔriba bɛ zahimbu nyabu ni, ka lan mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka tuumbiɛrinim be tibidarigibo shee guli saria karibu dali.
en: So you see that the Lord God knows how to save those who are devoted to him. He will save them when troubles come. And the Lord will hold evil people to punish them on the day of judgment.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti niŋ yɛda ka deei baptaizibu ni tiligi, amaa ŋun ti bi niŋ yɛda ni mali taali.
en: Anyone who believes me and is baptized will be saved. But anyone who refuses to believe me will be condemned.

dag: Yi ni deei Yisa Masia n-leei yi Duuma la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi min o laɣim be.
en: Since you have accepted Christ Jesus as Lord, live in union with him.

dag: Kɛnan daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pia ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Kenan lived years, and he died.

dag: Juda bidibisi daa nyɛla Ɛr mini Onan, bɛ zaa daa kpila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The tribe of Judah: the clans of Shelah, Perez, Zerah, Hezron, and Hamul.

dag: ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la gba bahi yoli.
en: And those in Christ who have already died are lost.

dag: Ka nyamiya o ni ʒe palɔni shɛm tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka so bi niŋ o shɛli! Di ni bɔŋɔ ti zuɣulaannim baŋya ni doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Masia yɔɣɔ?.
en: But he is teaching where everyone can see and hear him. And no one is trying to stop him from teaching. Maybe the leaders have decided that he really is the Messiah.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa asiba, zaŋ chani zaawuni ka m paɣa kpi. Dindali maa yi biɛɣu asiba ka n daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni zali ma shɛm maa.
en: The next morning I told the people what God had said. That evening, my wife died. The next morning I did what God commanded.

dag: Ti mabihi, di bi kpa talahi ni ti lan sab dabisa mini saha yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli polo;.
en: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.

dag: O ni yih a muɣisigu ni, ka barina shɛli ku shih a saha shɛlikam.
en: He will save you again and again. No evil will harm you.

dag: N di yuya ni yi ni so kpari Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka yi ku lan mali buɣim pa n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ka di ka buchi. N nini bi lan tiɣi ya, ka n ku lan deei yi ni maani sara shɛli tiri ma. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:.

dag: Bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla dɔb tusaanahi m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: There were , men who ate, not counting the women and children.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni gbibi ya hal ni di bahigu ni, ka yi ti ku mali galimi ŋun ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabisili maa dali.
en: He will also keep you firm to the end, so that you will be faultless on the Day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Yɛlima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni baai? O ku darigi vuɣi di mini di nyaɣa, ka di wala pooi ka kuui ka chɛ ka di va maha paligi? Di pala nuu din mali kpiɔŋ bee tɔbbihi pam ka bɛ yɛn bona ka bɛ ti sibigi di mini di nyaɣa.
en: So I, the Sovereign Lord , ask: Will this vine live and grow? Won't the first eagle pull it up by its roots, pull off the grapes, and break off the branches and let them wither? It will not take much strength or a mighty nation to pull it up.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka sapashin kpɛm maa bɔri ni o baŋ daliri din chɛ ka Yɛhudianim zaŋ o taali n-fiɣis o maa, ka daa lɔrig o ka tim ti boli maligumaaniba kpamba mini jintɔriba zaa ni bɛ laɣimna. Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Pool ti zali bɛ tooni.
en: The commander wanted to find out for sure what the Jews were accusing Paul of; so the next day he had Paul's chains taken off and ordered the chief priests and the whole Council to meet. Then he took Paul and made him stand before them.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ ninsalinim naani.
en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to depend on people.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli la ni ti mali jilima n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboli kam. Zuliya kam ni ti zo n-ka di gbinna.
en: In the last days the mountain of the Lord s Temple will be the highest of all mountains. It will be raised higher than the hills. There will be a steady stream of people from all nations going there.

dag: Dama di ni leei jilima zuɣupiligu a zuɣu ni, ka leei dolibi a nyiŋgol ni.
en: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.

dag: Ka di mali goon titali din du pam ka mali dunoya pinaayi, ka malaikanim pinaayi ʒe dunoya maa ni, ka Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la yuya sab pa dunoya maa zuɣu;.
en: It had a great, high wall with twelve gates and with twelve angels in charge of the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of the people of Israel.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his father, he did what was pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Ka o ti ŋmahiŋmahi biŋkɔbigu maa n-tabil o zuɣu min o biŋkpam, ka maligumaana zaŋ li pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: A bapir Shallum bia Hanamɛl ni ka a sanna ti yɛl a, Dam m puu din be Anatɔt la, dama nyini m-mali soli ni a da li.
en: that Hanamel, my uncle Shallum's son, would come to me with the request to buy his field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin, because I was his nearest relative and had the right to buy it for myself.

dag: Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili! Naawuni chɛ ka bɛ ʒi salima yi Shiiba na ti ti o. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni tir o sahakam. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni daalibarika niŋd o ni dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Let the king live long! Let Shebas gold be given to him! Let him be prayed for always! Let him be blessed all day long!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool ni Dauda zo n-kuli Gaat, ka o daa chɛ o shee bɔbu.
en: People told Saul that David had run away to Gath, so Saul stopped looking for him.

dag: Ka Nahɔr daa nyɛ Sɛrug bia ka Sɛrug nyɛ Riu bia, ka Riu nyɛ Pɛlɛg bia, ka Pɛlɛg nyɛ Ɛba bia, ka Ɛba mi nyɛ Shɛla bia.
en: Nahor was the son of Serug. Serug was the son of Reu. Reu was the son of Peleg. Peleg was the son of Eber. Eber was the son of Shelah.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi ni doli Galili tiŋgbɔŋ polo. Ka o bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o be nimaani.
en: From there Jesus and his followers went through Galilee, but he didnt want anyone to know it.

dag: N ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri fo bɛ sani. Ka nir ku lan wum aŋgo kukoli bee amiliya kukoli bee n-wum nɛya niɛmbu vuri bee n-nya firila neesim.
en: I will silence their shouts of joy and gladness and the happy sounds of wedding feasts. They will have no oil for their lamps, and there will be no more grain.

dag: Ka Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta daa lan chaŋ ti teei dɔni naa naba ni n-kuhiri ka suhir o ni o yiɣisim Haman ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la.
en: Esther again spoke before the king. She bowed at his feet, wept, and begged him to treat her kindly. She wanted him to overturn the evil plot of Haman the Agagite—his secret plan directed against the Jews.

dag: Mɔabnim suhuri kul ʒimi bɛ piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ wain shɛli le duɣu ni, ka bi kpaari li loori duɣu shɛl ni; ka so mi na bi gbahi ba daba chaŋ luɣ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ na kul mali binshɛlikam, ka bɛ binshɛli bi saɣim maa.
en: The Lord said, Moab has always lived secure and has never been taken into exile. Moab is like wine left to settle undisturbed and never poured from jar to jar. Its flavor has never been ruined, and it tastes as good as ever.

dag: ni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni teeku ni zahim ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku ni.
en: the birds and the fish and the creatures in the seas.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla mani bee bɛna, lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri tiri ya, ka lahibal suŋ maa mi nyɛ yi ni daa niŋ shɛli yɛda la.
en: So then, whether it came from me or from them, this is what we all preach, and this is what you believe.

dag: nti zaŋ li shihi n noli ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ni shihi a noli maa, di yih a galimi, ka kpihim a daalahichi.
en: Then he touched my mouth with the hot coal and said, When this hot coal touched your lips, your guilt was taken away, and your sins were erased. .

dag: Di nanim deerila birapu ka kariti saria, ka di maligumaaniba deeri liɣiri ka wuhiri niriba, ka di daanabinim tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka deeri liɣiri, amaa bɛ zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ be ti sani; zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti.
en: The city's rulers govern for bribes, the priests interpret the Law for pay, the prophets give their revelations for money—and they all claim that the Lord is with them. No harm will come to us, they say. The Lord is with us.

dag: A yiko ni ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima. A yuli zuɣu ka ti no n-taai bɛn kana ti lir ti la.
en: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.

dag: O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ sariakaritiba doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ti bɛn ʒe dunɔdali gbini kariti bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti liri ba la suhukpeeni.
en: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities.

dag: Bɛ dimi ŋmɛlim, ka bɛ niŋgbuna be polipoli. Bɛ tuumbiɛri ka tariga. Bɛ bi doli zaligu soli n-kariti kpibisi saria tiri ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔŋ, bɛ mi bi zabiri nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: They have grown big and fat from the evil they have done . There is no end to the evil they do. They will not plead the case of children who have no parents. They will not help these orphans. They will not let the poor be judged fairly.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti a tɛhi zilima mini baŋsim, ka o yi ti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni, a ni doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa lee bi baŋ o, ka daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm. Lala ka Daadam bia gba yɛn di wahala bɛ nuu ni.
en: In fact, I tell you that Elijah has already come, and they didnt know him. But they did to him whatever they wanted. In the same way the Human One is also going to suffer at their hands.

dag: Yawɛ buɣisiri wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa biɛhigu, ka o suhu je bɛn yuri duŋ taabu.
en: The LORD examines both the righteous and the wicked; his very being hates anyone who loves violence.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa tim ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb la daa ti labina ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛl o, Ti Duuma, hal ti nyaŋ alizin biɛri gba a yuli zuɣu.
en: When the followers returned, they were excited and said, Lord, even the demons obeyed when we spoke in your name.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin daa mali ti gari, Yawɛ ni daa fiɛbi Nail Mɔɣili maa nyaaŋa.
en: Seven days passed after the Lord changed the Nile River.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. N ni lan chɛ ka yi be suɣa ni yaha kaman yi ni daa pun be di ni shɛm yi chuɣu puhibu dabisa saha la.
en: But I am still the Lord your God, as I was when you left the land of Egypt. I will make you live in tents, as you do during the Festival of Shelters.

dag: o yi ti nya alaafee n-yiɣisi kpuɣi jaaŋgbee chana, di saha ŋun daa ŋme o maa lan ka taali, amaa di lee simdi ka ŋun daa ŋme o maa yo o ni saɣim o saha shɛli maa samli, ka lih o hal ka o ti kpaŋ zaa.
en: If the man was hurt and must stay in bed for some time, the man who hurt him must support him. The man who hurt him must pay for the loss of his time. He must support him until he is completely healed.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya! Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: Show me a coin. Then he asked, Whose picture and name are on it? The Emperor's, they answered.

dag: Naawuni, bambua suhu ni ye kulibɔŋ ni kɔzɔrim zuɣu shɛm la, lala ka n gba suhu kul ye a zuɣu.
en: Just like a deer that craves streams of water, my whole being craves you, God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba, ka guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdaya. Bɛ ni ti kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb nyɔri buɣim maani sara la mini niriba ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti mali sara la. Bɛ ni ti tumdi tuma tiri niriba maa.
en: The Levites were chosen to serve in my holy place. They guarded the gates of the Temple. They served in the Temple. They killed the animals for the sacrifices and burnt offerings for the people. They were chosen to help the people and to serve them.

dag: Tiŋbunsi nyɛla bɛn ka yiko, amaa bɛ maani bɛ biɛhigu shee la kuɣa ni.
en: badgers are small animals, but they make their homes in the rocks;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi nya ma ka m mini so ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni bee ka n tuɣindi niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bee Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni bee tiŋ maa puuni.
en: Never once did the Jews find me arguing with anyone in the temple. I didn't cause trouble in the synagogues or in the city itself.

dag: Ka Pita gbaag o nuu ni n-yiɣis o zali; ka boli Yisa nyaandoliba maa mini pakoya maa na nti zaŋ Dɔɔkas ŋun lan niŋ nyɛvililan maa ti ba.
en: Peter reached over and helped her get up. Then he called all the believers, including the widows, and presented her alive to them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: They carried him back on horses, and he was buried in Jerusalem with his ancestors in Davids City.

dag: Kalidianim kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi ba, ka chɛ ka n suhu ni yiɣisi ka n ku ninvuɣ shɛb ti galisi pam pali yiya maa zaa. Dama n zaŋla n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ tiŋ ŋɔ nima bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali la zaa zuɣu.
en: Some will fight against the Babylonians, who will fill the houses with the corpses of those whom I am going to strike down in my anger and fury. I have turned away from this city because of the evil things that its people have done.

dag: M mabihi, di daa kpami ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Naa Dauda yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judas ŋun daa zaŋ niriba chaŋ ka bɛ ti gbaai Yisa la polo la niŋ pali.
en: Brothers and sisters, in the Scriptures the Holy Spirit said through David that something must happen. He was talking about Judas, one of our own group. Judas served together with us. The Spirit said that Judas would lead men to arrest Jesus.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ku vuui bɛ zaashee; bɛ kul ni teeri bɛ yɛla sahakam.
en: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi li bahi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni la zuɣu m-mali di zaa.
en: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi bɛn daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-daa nyɛ: Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt. Ham daa nyɛla Keenan ba.
en: Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, left the boat. Ham later had a son named Canaan.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa boli Nɛria bia Baruk na nti yɛl o Yawɛ ni yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka Baruk daa sabi li niŋ gbaŋ ni.
en: So Jeremiah called a man named Baruch son of Neriah. Jeremiah spoke the messages the Lord had given him. While he spoke, Baruch wrote the messages on the scroll.

dag: Laɣimmiya yi zuliya ni kpamba mini yi sapashin kpamba zaa n sanna, ka n ti yɛli ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ wum, ka n chɛ ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani di shɛhira jɛndi ba.
en: Assemble all of your tribes elders and your officials in front of me, so I can speak these words in their hearing, and so I can call heaven and earth as my witnesses against them.

dag: Yurilim bi mali dimaŋ kuuna bee n-ʒiɛmdi so. Yurilim bi zabiri dimaŋ yubu zuɣu; di bi mali suhuyiɣisili; di mi bi zaŋdi yɛla niŋdi suhu ni.
en: love is not ill-mannered or selfish or irritable; love does not keep a record of wrongs;.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa malila anzinfa bee daanya daa zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Ka doo kam ŋun daa mali gɔpiɛliga dari din ni tooi tum tuma daa zaŋ li na.
en: Everyone who could make a gift offering of silver or copper brought it as the LORDs gift offering. Everyone who had acacia wood that could be used in any kind of building work brought it.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi nyɛla Sintani nira, dama piligu ni ha ka Sintani pun tumd alahichi. Ka daliri din chɛ ka Naawuni Bia daa kana nyɛla ni o ti saɣim Sintani tuma.
en: The devil has been sinning since the beginning. Anyone who continues to sin belongs to the devil. The Son of God came for this: to destroy the devils work.

dag: Yɛlim Sulemaana bia Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Juda mini Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni la.
en: Talk to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to men of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: ka Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Hivi nira, ka lan nyɛ tiŋ maa ni naa la bia Shɛkɛm daa nya o gbaag o ti zaŋ o saɣim dih o vi.
en: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, who was chief of that region, saw her, he took her and raped her.

dag: Di tam a dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛl la yɛla; a mi di tam bɛ ni na kul tahiri yɔri vu shɛŋa sahakam la gba yɛla.
en: Don't forget the loud shouts of your enemies.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbiga bɛn daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai sansani maa shee yuntisuɣu saha tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛli n-dii piɛb bɛ kikahi ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ ni gbib duɣubihi shɛŋa maa.
en: Gideon and one hundred of his men moved to the outpost of the camp at the middle watch of the night, when they had just changed the guards. Then they blew the trumpets and smashed the jars that were in their hands.

dag: hal ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi bi kɔŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli yi ni guhiri saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: The result is that you arent missing any spiritual gift while you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa kul bɔbimi ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi m-miri Samaria dunoli kabɔɣili shee ka anabinim maa zaa be bɛ tooni tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: The two kings, dressed in their royal robes, were sitting on their thrones at the threshing place just outside the gate of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying in front of them.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba n-tum kaman Ɛhab min o daŋ ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o paɣ daa nyɛla Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: He walked in the ways of Israels kings, just as Ahabs dynasty had done, because he married Ahabs daughter. He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Ka banima n-daa lee ku Naawuni suli yuun pihinahi puuni la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa tum alahichi ka kpi n-do yɔɣu ni la?.
en: With whom was God angry for forty years? With the people who sinned, who fell down dead in the desert.

dag: yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima ka saɣim tiŋ maa zaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni hal ka zaŋ takɔb ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: you must completely strike down the inhabitants of that city with the sword. Place it and all that is in it under the ban. Put its animals to the sword.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam kpalim bo ti Duuma, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn zaa kpe n yuli gba bo ma.
en: Then other nations will turn to me and be my chosen ones. I, the Lord, say this.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣili na nti yo bɔɣili maa noli, ka naa maa daa zaŋ o min o kpambaliba dalinli n-dalim kuɣili maa ni di chɛ ka shɛli ku taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: A stone was put over the mouth of the pit, and the king placed his own royal seal and the seal of his noblemen on the stone, so that no one could rescue Daniel.

dag: Chɛ ka o zabi niriba bɛn nyɛ tarimba zuɣu; ka fa nandaamba bahi ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ba tibili.
en: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Shilo n-lihi nya, ka daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnim kaman di ni daa simdi ni bɛ zuliya kam deei shɛm.
en: Then Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before the LORD. There Joshua divided up the shares of the land for the Israelites.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei gunibu maŋli, dama ti jɛmdila Naawuni o Shia Kasi zuɣu ka mali suhupiɛlli ti bebu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ti ka tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni.
en: But we are the ones who have the true circumcision —we who worship God through his Spirit. We dont trust in ourselves or anything we can do. We take pride only in Christ Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa boli doo maa m-bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee be.
en: The Lord God called to the man and said, Where are you.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka anabi Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi Nɛria bia Baruk yɛtɔɣa, ka Baruk daa sabi yɛtɔɣa maa niŋ gbaŋ ni saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisiri maa.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, Baruch wrote down what I had dictated to him. Then I told him.

dag: Di ni lu yi zuɣu n-din ya; di ni lu yi zuɣu asiba n-gari yim, ka lu yi zuɣu wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ. Ka yɛl biɛɣu kam ni chɛ ka yi baŋ Naawuni yɛligu gbinni!.
en: He will come and take you away. Your punishment will be terrible. Your punishment will come early in the morning, and it will continue late into the night. Then you will understand this story:.

dag: Yi yi ti di n-tiɣi, ka me yiya viɛla be di ni.
en: Then you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses and live in them.

dag: ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi ni di mihi.
en: the pegs and ropes for the tent and the courtyard;.

dag: Ka Zɛbul ŋun daa nyɛ tiŋ maa naa ni daa wum Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Zebul was the governor of the city of Shechem. Zebul heard what Gaal son of Ebed said, and he became very angry.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni wum dimbɔŋɔ bee n-ni ti bɔri ni o zaŋ o zaɣa niŋ di ni dahin shɛli ha?.
en: Which of you will listen to this, will pay attention and respond from now on?.

dag: m mali zuɣusuŋ yi sani, ka yi niŋ ma nirilim pam tiligi n nyɛvili, amaa n ku tooi zo nti du zoya ŋɔ, dama di pa shɛli ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli ti paai ma nimaani ka n kpi.
en: Youve done me a favor and have been so kind to save my life. But I cant escape to the mountains since the catastrophe might overtake me there and Id die.

dag: Dama n nyari bɛ ni kul niŋdi shɛlikam zaa; di shɛli bi sɔɣi n sani, ka bɛ daalahichi bi sɔɣi n sani.
en: I am watching their every move; not one is hidden from me. Nor is their sin concealed from my sight.

dag: Ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam, n ni niŋ li ka m Ba nya jilima n zuɣu.
en: And I will do whatever you ask for in my name, so that the Father's glory will be shown through the Son.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, Karimba, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini.
en: Peter said to Jesus, Teacher, it is good that we are here. We will put three tents here—one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra; dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: He said to them, There is such a big harvest of people to bring in. But there are only a few workers to help harvest them. God owns the harvest. Ask him to send more workers to help bring in his harvest.

dag: Di saha o ni suhi Naawuni ka o deeg o suhigu, ka o ni tooi chaŋ Naawuni tooni ni suhupiɛlli, ka Naawuni ti o wuntia tuma maa laara.
en: He will pray and God will answer. He will worship God and shout with joy. He will again stand as right before God.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni niŋ di shɛli nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la shihirili.
en: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Di simdi ni ti zaŋ ti niɣi zaa chaŋ, hal naɣ takarifeeni ku kpalim. Di simdi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa, dama ti bi mi ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ shɛli mali sara ti Yawɛ naɣila ti paala nimaani.
en: and we won't know which animals we will need until we get there. That's why we can't leave even one of them here.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti zaŋ ti nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deem ti suhigu. Iin, nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka deei ti suhigu, ka a yi deei ti suhigu maa, nyin chɛl ti taali.
en: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ chɛ tin shɛli din yuli daa du pam ŋɔ bahi? Di nyɛla n suhu ni piɛli tiŋ shɛli zuɣu.
en: Forsaken is the renowned city, city of my delight.

dag: Amaa n ŋmanila zunzuli, ka pa ni ninsala; ka n tab ʒiɛm ma, ka niriba maani ma ansarisi!.
en: But I feel like a worm, less than human! People insult me and look down on me.

dag: ni m mali suhugarigu pam, ka nandahima din bi naari kul mali ma.
en: I have great sadness and constant pain in my heart.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ ti baŋya ni alizin biɛɣu n-shiri ʒi a zuɣu, dama ti yab Ibrahimma min anabinim zaa kpiya, ka nyin ti yɛli ni nir yi dol a yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: They said to him, Now we know for sure that you have a demon! Abraham died, and the prophets died, yet you say that whoever obeys your teaching will never die.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa labi Giligal sansani maa ni.
en: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ŋmanila azichi wain ti shɛli din wali wala. Bɛ zuliya ni kul galisiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul mɛri maligu bimbina pahira. Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ dariza ni kul pahiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul pahiri bɛ ni jɛmdi binwɔɣil shɛŋa la gba dariza.
en: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayopɔin gol so ŋun pahi chir pia ka bɛ boon o Tɛbɛt la ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ɛsta kpɛh o sani nayili maa.
en: Esther was taken to King Ahasuerus, to his own palace, in the tenth month in the seventh year of his rule.

dag: Shallum ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛl la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the things Shallum did, including his plans against Zechariah, are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai palo shɛli din wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu n-ti Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la ka di nyɛ bɛ ni su shɛli, ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntinsi be di ni.
en: The area . miles long and . miles wide will be for the Levites who minister in the temple. Twenty chambers are theirs as their property.

dag: Adam n-daa nyɛ Shɛt ba, ka Shɛt nyɛ Ɛnɔsh ba.
en: The first generations of people were Adam, Seth, Enosh, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, and Noah.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka mali Nazari nir maa daalahichi sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: The priest will come close to the LORD and offer the purification and entirely burned offerings.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba ni ʒirinim maa kpi n-kpe gbala ni, ka bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni yuusim pirigili na bi paai gba. Amaa nyini ka man kul ni niŋ naani.
en: But, God, you will send those liars and murderers to the grave. They will die before their life is half finished! As for me, I will put my trust in you.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la min o maligumaanitab la mi su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee din daa be Gibiɔn Jɛmbu shee la fukumsi.
en: David left Zadok the priest and the other priests who served with him in front of the Lord s Tent at the high place in Gibeon.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti ti o yaa tariga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm.
en: Each man should give as much as he can. He should decide how much to give by thinking about how much the Lord your God has given him.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Yisa nyaandoliba maa ansarisi yɛra, Bɛ nyula dam kuli.
en: Others jeered at them, saying, Theyre full of new wine.

dag: Ti ni daa wum lala maa ka ti mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani balim Pool ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: After Agabus said this, we and the followers living there begged Paul not to go to Jerusalem.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka piɛgula yino ŋun nyɛ n dabili Dauda guli ba ka dihiri ba. O ni ti dihiri ba ka nyɛ bɛ piɛgula.
en: I will give them a king like my servant David to be their one shepherd, and he will take care of them.

dag: Amaa niriba kul ni be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam, ka niriba kul ni be Jɛrusalɛm ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But there will always be people living in Judah. People will live in Jerusalem through many generations.

dag: Ka sokam daa kul omaŋmaŋ ya ni bɛ ti sab o yuli.
en: Everyone traveled to their own hometowns to have their name put on the list.

dag: N daa lan bo tiŋguliba tin ya ka yɛli, Wummiya kikaa kumsi. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Ti ku wum.
en: Then the Lord appointed sentries to listen for the trumpet's warning. But they said, We will not listen.

dag: Dama n niriba ŋɔ tibidarigibo maa galisi gari Sɔdomnim tibidarigibo la, din daa wurim nini pɔbbu ni neebu ka so nuu daa bi shihi li la.
en: My people have been punished even more than the inhabitants of Sodom, which met a sudden downfall at the hands of God.

dag: Sulemaana daa zaŋla naɣilahi tuhi pisinaayi mini piɛri tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ sani. Lala ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni.
en: He sacrificed , head of cattle and , sheep as fellowship offerings. And so the king and all the people dedicated the Temple.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali shɛm la.
en: Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had specified when he said, Come back to me in three days.

dag: Dahin shɛli o yi ti yɛn kpe luɣ kasi shee dundɔŋ ni ti tum tuma, di simdi ka o mali o daalahichi sara luɣ kasi maa shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then he can go back into the holy place. But on the day he goes into the inner courtyard to serve in the holy place, he must offer a sin offering for himself. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ ba Riuɛl bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ti daŋ kundina lala.
en: Then they went back to their father, Reuel. He asked them, Why have you come home early today.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli Sukɔtinima, N suhiri ya, niŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro ti n niriba bɛn doli ma ŋɔ; dama di wum ba pam, ka m mi na kariti dolila Midian nanim Zɛba mini Zalimuna.
en: So he said to the people of Succoth, Please give some loaves of bread to those who are on foot, because theyre exhausted, but Im chasing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ me dubihi shɛŋa n-tuɣi duu maa ti tuui, ka di zaa yiniyini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ sida dari tuɣ tab ti gɔhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The three-storied annex, each story 1⁄2 feet high, was built against the outside walls of the Temple, and was joined to them by cedar beams.

dag: Ka Ahazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that King Ahaziah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia mini niriba maa zaa suhuri daa paligi Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛli ti niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa tum tuma maa naai yomyom pam.
en: and Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced at what God had done for them, since it had happened so quickly.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri doya, ka di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; n daa deei yi liɣiri maa. Di pa shɛli, yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni la n-daa zaŋ liɣiri maa niŋ yi kpalansi maa ni maa. Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Simiɔn n-yihi bɛ sanna.
en: He said, You are fine. Dont be afraid. Your God and your fathers God must have hidden a treasure in your sacks. I received your money. Then he brought Simeon out to them.

dag: Bee yi na ʒi n-karim zaligu ni ni maligumaaniba tumdi tuun shɛŋa Naawuni jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ka ka galimi di zuɣu?.
en: Or havent you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple treat the Sabbath as any other day and are still innocent?.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man chɛ ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ka Sintani daa lo m-pɔri gɔɣ o yuun pisaayika ŋɔ kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Then isnt it necessary that this woman, a daughter of Abraham, bound by Satan for eighteen long years, be set free from her bondage on the Sabbath day.
