dag: ka Avitinim me Nibihaz mini Taritak buɣili zali, ka Sɛfarivaimnim mi daa mali bɛ bihi nyɔri buɣim tiri Adirammɛlɛk mini Anammɛlɛk bɛn daa nyɛ Sɛravimnim buɣa la.
en: The people of Avva made the false gods Nibhaz and Tartak. The people from Sepharvaim also burned their children in the fire to honor their false gods, Adrammelech and Anammelech.

dag: Tarim mini ŋun nahindi niriba zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka bɛ zaa nina ne.
en: The poor and their oppressors have a common bond— the LORD gives light to the eyes of both.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: Abraham said to him, No, dont take my son to that place.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa zaɣisi ka yɛl o dan paɣ maa, Nyama, n ni be n dan sani ŋɔ, o baɣa lan ka shɛl ni yil ŋɔ. O zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam niŋla n nuu ni.
en: but he refused and said, My master isn't worried about anything in his house, because he has placed me in charge of everything he owns.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ Samaria nti yihiri waazu yɛri ba ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛl ti di yɛla piligu ni ha ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ li, ka ŋuni n-daŋ yɛli di yɛla, ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni o mali yɛlimaŋli? So daa pun bi yɛli di yɛla, ka so bi zaŋ li moli; so mi pun bi wum yi yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Who told us about this before it happened so that we could say he was right? None of your idols told us anything. They didnt say a word, and they cannot hear anything you say.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Amiram yiŋnima mini Izar yiŋnima ni Hiburɔn yiŋnima ni Uziɛl yiŋnima; Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa bala.
en: The families of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel belonged to the family of Kohath. They were the Kohathite family groups.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa yi tɔŋbu saha, amaa ka yi daa yɛli, Ti ku wum. Yi biɛhigu m-pun bala yi bilim tariga, dama yi bi deei n noli.
en: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.

dag: Hal o ni fa bɛn mali taali bahi. Dinzuɣu yihim daɣiri a kɔbili ni ka o tilig a.
en: He will rescue you if you are innocent, if what you do is right.

dag: ka o daa dihi bɛn nahindi ba vi, ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: God pours contempt on their leaders, making them wander aimlessly in the wastelands.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa .
en: Jesus said to them, Follow me! I will teach you how to bring in people instead of fish.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani Samaria. O be Nabɔt wain tihi puu la ni ni o deei li su.
en: King Ahab of Israel is in Naboth's vineyard right now, taking it over.

dag: Ka n daa bɔri ni m baŋ bɛ ni gbaag o shɛli zuɣu, ka zaŋ o tahi bɛ jintɔriba sani.
en: I wanted to find out why they were accusing him, so I brought him to their council.

dag: Salo ni daa ti laɣimna m-muɣi saha shɛli ka Yisa piligi yɛra, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihirili, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: When the crowds grew, Jesus said, This generation is an evil generation. It looks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except Jonahs sign.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Then Job answered the Lord :.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb daa tɛhimi ni Judas ni gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibil la zuɣu ka Yisa yɛl o ni o cham ti da bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa ni bɛ zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa na bee ni o pii liɣiri maa shɛli ti ti nandaamba.
en: Some thought that, since Judas kept the money bag, Jesus told him, Go, buy what we need for the feast, or that he should give something to the poor.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N ni chaŋ ka yi ti bo ma kɔŋ, ka yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi. N ni chani luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: Again Jesus said to them, I will go away; you will look for me, but you will die in your sins. You cannot go where I am going.

dag: Ka gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa din be kasi zaa la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti kana.
en: In fact, the governor told them, You cannot eat the food offered to God until he lets us know if you really are priests.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, wummiya n ni wuhiri ya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ zaa, ka dol li din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni.
en: Now, Israel, in light of all that, listen to the regulations and the case laws that I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live, enter, and possess the land that the LORD, your ancestors God, is giving to you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n sa ni ku bɛ zaa ti Izraɛlnima; ka yi sa chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri napɔn jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi buɣim.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Do not be afraid of them. By this time tomorrow I will have killed all of them for Israel. You are to cripple their horses and burn their chariots.

dag: A yɛliya, N lo n ni pii ninvuɣ so alikauli, n daa poya yɛli n dabili Dauda;.
en: You said, I made a covenant with my chosen one; I promised my servant David.

dag: Zaŋmiya dimbɔŋɔnim maani sara tiri Yawɛ yi churi puhibu ni m-pahi yi pɔri pɔbu sara mini yi suhuyubu sara kaman yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni yi chi sara ni yi binnyura sara ni yi biɛrisuŋ sara la zuɣu.
en: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a nyu wain bee binnyuri kpiɔŋ; a mi miri ka a di binshɛli din chihiri dibu;.
en: Dont drink any wine or any other strong drink. Dont eat any food that is unclean.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zabila yi zuɣu, ka bɔhi biɛri tin ya. N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn teeku kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka di kɔbilisirim gba nyuui.
en: My people, I am on your side, and I will take revenge on Babylon. I will cut off its water supply, and its stream will dry up.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti Sulemaana yɛm mini baŋsim din ka buɣisibu ni tɛhi wɔɣila ka di galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu la.
en: God gave Solomon unusual wisdom and insight, and knowledge too great to be measured.

dag: Miriya ka yi ta yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa daɣiri. N gba bela di ni, dama man Yawɛ bela Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
en: I am the Lord . I will be living in your country with the Israelites, so dont make it unclean with the blood of innocent people.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li yili gɔpiɛliga daantalis anahi shɛŋa zuɣu yi ni niŋ salima pa, ka di mali salima bansi ka tam anzinfa bintamdisi zuɣu la.
en: Make four posts from acacia wood, and cover the posts with gold. Put hooks made from gold on the four posts. Put four silver bases under the posts. Then hang the curtain on the gold hooks.

dag: Malaikanim la daa yɛliya ni bɛ chɛli di tigbirigu la firi tiŋa. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni a ni ti lan lab a nam maa ni na saha shɛli a yi ti baŋ ni Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa fukumsi.
en: And when he said to leave the deepest root of the tree—that means your kingship will again be yours, once you acknowledge that heaven rules all.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun daa sabiri bina yɛla zaani la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka lab Hɛzɛkia sanna nti yɛl o Rabishake maa ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then the palace manager , the royal secretary , and the record keeper went to Hezekiah. Their clothes were torn to show they were upset. They told Hezekiah everything the Assyrian commander had said.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

dag: Rɛkab Jɔnadab bihi maa doli bɛ yabidoo maa ni zali ba shɛm, amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn bi deei n noli.
en: The descendants of Jonadab obeyed the commands that their ancestor gave them, but the people of Judah have not obeyed me.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinim ayi maa daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛri ba, Dumiya kpe na! Ka bɛ daa kpe sagban ni n-du alizanda ni bɛ dimnim maa ninni.
en: Then the two prophets heard a loud voice say to them from heaven, Come up here! As their enemies watched, they went up into heaven in a cloud.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni tuhi tɔbu n-di biŋkɔb shɛb la naɣilahi kɔbisiyopɔin mini piɛri tusaayopɔin m-mali sara ti Yawɛ dindali maa.
en: On that day they sacrificed to the LORD part of the loot they had taken: seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, man Nɛbukadnɛza paɣiri alizanda Naa, ka tir o jilima; ka tibigir o. O ni tumdi shɛlikam zaa nyɛla din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli, ka o ni tooi siɣisi ŋunkam mali karimbaani.
en: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, worship, magnify, and glorify the king of heaven. All his works are truth, all his paths are justice, and he is able to humble all who walk in pride.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa teei bɛ nuhi tirina n-vooi Lɔt kpɛhi duu bɛ sani, ka yo dunoli.
en: But the two men staying with Lot opened the door, pulled him back inside the house, and closed the door.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa zali ba dabisili ni bɛ ka o sanna. Ka dindali maa daa ti paai ka o ye o nam binyɛrigu ʒin o nam ʒiishee n-tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: On a chosen day Herod put on his royal robes, sat on his throne, and made a speech to the people.

dag: N nya o, amaa pa pumpɔŋɔ. N nya o, amaa ka o shee na waɣa. Saŋmariga ni ti puhi yi Yaakubu zuliya ni na. Naa ni ti yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na; O ni ti ku Mɔab zuɣulaannima, ka ku Sɛt zuliya zaa.
en: I look into the future, And I see the nation of Israel. A king, like a bright star, will arise in that nation. Like a comet he will come from Israel. He will strike the leaders of Moab And beat down all the people of Seth.

dag: Di piligu dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, daba ayopɔin maa dali gba, di simdi ka yi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka di bi simdi ka yi tum tuma di dabisa maa ni, amaa yi ni tooi duɣi yi bindira dina.
en: On the first day and again on the seventh day you are to meet for worship. No work is to be done on those days, but you may prepare food.

dag: Amaa nyini ka n naɣ ni lo alikauli. Zaŋm a paɣ min a bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba n-kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: But I solemnly promise that you, your wife, your sons, and your daughters-in-law will be kept safe in the boat.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yu Ɛsta gari paɣiba maa zaa. Hal o nini daa tiɣ o ka o yur o gari paɣisar bɛn la zaa. Dinzuɣu ka o daa dii zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee.
en: The king liked her more than any of the other women, and more than any of the others she won his favor and affection. He placed the royal crown on her head and made her queen in place of Vashti.

dag: N ni lan chɛ ka a zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ m mini n saawaranim maa ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun jɛmbu duu be Jɛrusalɛm maa ka di nyɛ ti suhuyubu pina la m-mali chaŋ.
en: You should bring the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ daa tam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiligira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun daa tum tuun kara Ijipti la yɛla.
en: They forgot the God who saved them— the one who had done great things in Egypt.

dag: Ka chɛ ka niriba maa zaa gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe nudirigu mini nuzaa polo zaa gili naa ka shɛb mi ʒe n-gili sara maligu bimbini la mini duu maa.
en: Then Jehoiada told the men where to stand. Every man had his weapon in his hand. The men stood all the way from the right side of the Temple to the left side of the Temple. They stood near the altar and the Temple, and near the king.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi o ninni Ribila maa; Babilɔn naa maa daa lan ku Juda kpambaliba zaa.
en: There at the town of Riblah, the king of Babylon killed Zedekiahs sons and he killed all the royal officials of Judah while Zedekiah watched.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai Zikilag daba ata dali n-nya ka Amalɛknim kamina ti liri Nɛgɛbinim mini Zikilagnima n-nyaŋ Zikilagnim maa, ka nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: It took David and his men three days to reach Ziklag. But while they had been away, the Amalekites had been raiding in the desert around there. They had attacked Ziklag, burned it to the ground.

dag: Biɛɣuni sa siɣimiya ti tuhi ba. Bɛ sa yɛn dolila Ziz polo duna. Yi sa ni tuhi ba soli vinvamli maa tariga Jɛruɛl tiŋgban nɛl la ni.
en: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa yɛli Anabi Musa, N ni niŋ ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nirilim, ka zo ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nambɔɣu.
en: For he said to Moses, I will have mercy on anyone I wish; I will take pity on anyone I wish.

dag: A piɛma diri pam naa dimnim suhuri ni; ka niriba lur a tooni.
en: Your arrows are sharp, they pierce the hearts of your enemies; nations fall down at your feet.

dag: Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ tuumba? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ anabinima? Bɛ zaa n-nyɛ karimbanima? Bɛ zaa n-tumd alahiziba tumtumsa?.
en: They are not all apostles or prophets or teachers. Not everyone has the power to work miracles.

dag: ka labina ti yɛli Jɔshua, Ainim bi yaɣ lala. Lala zuɣu di chɛ ka tɔbbihi maa zaa chaŋ, amaa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaayi bee tusaata laasabu chaŋ.
en: They came back to Joshua and said to him, There is no need for all of the people to go up. Two or three thousand men could go up and strike Ai. Dont make all of the people bother going there. There are just a few of them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza sapashin kpamba ni daa mali salima nyɔtaɣiri shɛŋa n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David took the gold shields carried by Hadadezers servants and brought them to Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, Karimba, tuun sun bɔ ka n lee yɛn tum ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A man approached him and said, Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life.

dag: O daa lan lab me Naa Hiram ni daa zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa ti o la, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani.
en: After that, Solomon had his workers rebuild the towns that Hiram had given him. Then Solomon sent Israelites to live in those towns.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ lala; bɛ daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia na maa nyaaŋa, ka Naawuni daa lan ka o sanna ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: When Jacob returned from Mesopotamia, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

dag: A kɔŋko ka n tum alahichi maa, ka tum din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu a sani. Dinzuɣu a niŋ din tuhi, a ni wuhi ni m mali taali la puuni; a ka galimi a ni kari ma saria shɛm maa gba puuni.
en: I have sinned against you—only against you— and done what you consider evil. So you are right in judging me; you are justified in condemning me.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi, amaa duhimiya n yuli Izraɛlnim sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: I demand respect from the people of Israel, so don't disgrace my holy name. Remember—I am the one who chose you to be priests and rescued all of you from Egypt, so that I would be your Lord .

dag: Ka o daa lab o sani ti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba ʒiɛla o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini. Ka Balak daa bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: So Balaam went to Balak. Balak was still standing near the altar. The leaders of Moab were there with him. Balak saw Balaam coming and said, What did the Lord say.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord also said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ti mini ya zali Masia ni, ka pii ti.
en: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us.

dag: M mabihi, n ni daa ka yi sanna la, pa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din to ni baŋbu bee yɛm yɛtɔɣa din yi bɔhimbu pam puuni na ka n daa zaŋ Naawuni daashili yɛlimaŋli yɛla la kahigiri wuhiri ya.
en: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.

dag: Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daa bela tiŋgbani maa ni; bɛ daa galisiya pam n-ʒini Bashan zaŋ hal ni Baalihɛrimɔn ni Sɛnir zaŋ kpa Hɛrimɔn Zoli polo.
en: The people of East Manasseh settled in the territory of Bashan as far north as Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon, and their population increased greatly.

dag: Ka o daa yooi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga maa, ka nyɔhi yi di ni na kaman buɣim daaŋkpa tital ni buɣim nyɔhi la, ka di nyɔhi maa daa sabigi wuntaŋ mini zuɣusaa zaa.
en: He opened the shaft of the abyss; and smoke rose up from the shaft, like smoke from a huge furnace. The sun and air were darkened by the smoke from the shaft.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahind o, ka tim niriba ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman bɛ nyɛla bɛn nini mooi yɛlimaŋli zuɣu la m-puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o niŋ gomnanti fukumsi ni.
en: So they looked for an opportunity. They bribed some men to pretend they were sincere, and they sent them to trap Jesus with questions, so that they could hand him over to the authority and power of the Roman Governor.

dag: Amaa ka o nyaandolitab la bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni n-du duli ka vɔri laŋ din daa pali zahim maa na, dama bɛ mini duli daa bi lan wɔɣa. Di daa kul nyɛla kaman mita kɔbiga zuɣu.
en: The boat was only about meters from shore. So the other disciples stayed in the boat and dragged in the net full of fish.

dag: Bumiya yi nyɔri ni suhusaɣiŋgu yi tiŋgbani din vuhiri mini yi tiwala tihi din saɣim la zuɣu.
en: Beat your breasts in sorrow. Cry because your fields are empty. Your vineyards once gave grapes, but now they are empty.

dag: A nuu ni bo n-nya a dimnim zaa. A nudirigu ni bo n-nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je a.
en: Your hand will catch all your enemies; your strong hand will catch all who hate you.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti paai tin shɛlikam ka bɛ bi deei ya, yin doliya di pala yɛra.
en: But if you go into a town and the people dont welcome you, then go out into the streets of that town and say.

dag: ka o chɛ ka noonsi yiɣina ti lu bɛ sani. Bɛ daa galisiya pam ŋ-ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu;.
en: and to his people he sent down birds, as many as the grains of sand on the shore;.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Juda zuliya maa daŋ kam na ti zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zɛra daŋ; ka o daa zaŋ Zɛra daŋ maa ni sokam ni o malibu zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zabidi yiŋnima.
en: So then all the family groups of Judah stood before the Lord , and he chose the Zerah family group. Then all the families of the Zerah group stood before the Lord , and he chose the family of Zimri.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka n niriba ni nya dan shɛli maa ni, ka naɣ yɛrimi, Suhudoo beni, suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani.
en: They should bandage the wounds my people have suffered, but they treat their wounds like small scratches. They say, Its all right, everything is all right. But it is not all right!.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Ibrahimma daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi: Yino daa nyɛla dab paɣ bia, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bilichin paɣ bia.
en: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. Yilimiya yila paɣ o yuli, dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim.
en: Praise the Lord , because he is good; sing praises to his name, because he is kind.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-tuhiri tɔb tiri ya.
en: Dont be afraid of them because the LORD your God is the one who will be fighting for you.

dag: Yi tahiri tab ʒiishɛhi, amaa ka yɛlimaŋli ka yi polo. Yi dolila naŋgbankpeeni mini ʒiri soli ni yi di nasara, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri tiɣi pua n-dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: You cant be trusted, even in court. You lie about each other and depend on false arguments to win your cases. You create pain and produce wickedness.

dag: Dama nyini n Duuma n-nyɛ n tahima. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: because you are my hope, Lord. You, LORD, are the one Ive trusted since childhood.

dag: saha shɛl o ni daa zali saa ni yɛn miri shɛm, ka zali saa nyaɣisibu ni yɛn chani shɛm la.
en: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka di simdi ka yi ti lo noli; di yɛn nyɛla zaligu sahakam.
en: It will be a Sabbath of special rest for you, and you will deny yourselves. This is a permanent rule.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ niriba maa suhu yubu zuɣu ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka o naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he set Barabbas free for them. Then he had Jesus whipped and handed him over to be crucified.

dag: O bi paɣi wɔr so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. O mi bi paɣi ninvuɣ so ŋun tooi zɔri pam.
en: God doesnt prize the strength of a horse; God doesnt treasure the legs of a runner.

dag: Di saha maa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba zaa daa laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas la yiŋa.
en: Then the chief priests and elders of the people gathered in the courtyard of Caiaphas the high priest.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti nya o la Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka o ʒi Yɛhudia adiini karimbanim sunsuuni wumdi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhiri ba bɔhigunima.
en: On the third day they found him in the Temple, sitting with the Jewish teachers, listening to them and asking questions.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be anabi shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu, ka bi nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says. Bad things will happen to you foolish prophets. You are following your own spirits. You are not telling people what you really see in visions.

dag: Ka naa daa bah o bia Jɛramiil mini Aziriɛl bia Sɛraya ni Abidiil bia Shɛlɛmia noli ni bɛ gbaam Baruk ŋun nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa mini anabi Jɛrimia na. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔɣi.
en: The king commanded Jerahmeel, the kings son, along with Seraiah, Azriels son, and Shelemiah, Abdeels son, to arrest the scribe Baruch and the prophet Jeremiah. But the LORD hid them.

dag: Anab so daa bi lan yiɣisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋ-ŋmani Musa, ka Yawɛ min o nini daa nya taba.
en: No prophet like Moses has yet emerged in Israel; Moses knew the LORD face-to-face!.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi na mi n-nya ka nir nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, ka pa ni firila tamdigu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus continued, Does anyone ever bring in a lamp and put it under a bowl or under the bed? Isn't it put on the lampstand?.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa mini bɛ kpamba bɛn daa lo alikauli maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ni bahi bɛ daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka ku lan zaŋ ba niŋ daba yaha. Ka bɛ daa saɣi ka bahi ba.
en: So all the leaders of Judah and all the people accepted this agreement. They would free their male and female slaves so that they would no longer serve them. Everyone agreed, and so all the slaves were set free.

dag: Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka be Tiriza.
en: When King Baasha heard what had happened, he stopped fortifying Ramah and went to Tirzah.

dag: Chɛ ka anabi so ŋun zahim zahindi yɛlila zahindi maa yɛtɔɣa, amaa ŋun mi mali n yɛligu ŋun tɔɣisim n yɛligu maa yɛla ni ʒiɛyimtali. Mɔri mini alikama nyɛla yim? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.

dag: Di saha ka Amalɛknim mini Keenannim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi maa ni daa yina ti lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba n-kari ba hal ni Hɔrima.
en: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi doli Bashan polo; ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu Ɛdirɛi n-tuhi ba.
en: The Israelites headed toward the region of Bashan, where King Og ruled, and he led his entire army to Edrei to meet Israel in battle.

dag: ka sakuɣ kara din tibisim sania zuɣu nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram pihinahi ni anu daa yi zuɣusaa n-luri niriba zuɣu na hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni alɔbo sakuɣa maa zuɣu. Di daalɔbo maa daa mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Huge hailstones weighing about one hundred pounds came down from heaven on the people. They cursed God for the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri ti Duuma pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ ka bi doli so shɛli din tiri Naawuni jilima di ni, o ni mali taali zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ min o ʒim polo.
en: So if you eat the bread or drink the cup of the Lord in a way that does not fit its meaning, you are sinning against the body and the blood of the Lord.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samsin daa ti bɔri paɣ so ŋun be Sɔrɛk Vinvamli ni ka o yuli booni Dilaila.
en: After this, Samson fell in love with a woman named Delilah, who lived in Sorek Valley.

dag: O daa zaŋla dabipaɣiba ayi maa mini bɛ bihi bahi tooni, ka chɛ ka Liya min o bihi paya, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl mini Yisifu be nyaaŋa.
en: He put the servants and their children first, Leah and her children after them, and Rachel and Joseph last.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani binnɛma anahi. Bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa ŋmanila ninsalinima.
en: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans.

dag: Jɛhɔiada kum maa nyaaŋa ka Juda kpamba daa kana ti jɛm naa, ka naa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: But once Jehoiada was dead, the leaders of Judah persuaded King Joash to listen to them instead.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli Ayuba sanʒiɛɣu puuni.
en: The LORD answered Job from the whirlwind.

dag: Izraɛlnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Aduna zuliya, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord , people of Israel; praise him, you priests of God!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli, A ni suhi ma ŋɔ zuɣu, n chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: Then the LORD said, I will forgive as you requested.

dag: Di lan chɛliya ka so biri bimbira bee ka so kpuɣi atam di kpuɣibu saha Babilɔn. Bɛ zaa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba sani tɔb shɛli din yɛn di ba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ zaa ti zo n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Cut Babylon off from those who plant and those who harvest the crops, because of its ruthless sword. Now return, all of you, to your people; flee to your homeland!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Masia daa kana nti yihi suhudoo lahibal suŋ waazu tila yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka daa be katiŋ ni Naawuni la mini Yɛhudianim bɛn daa mir o la.
en: Christ came and brought the message of peace to you non-Jews who were far away from God. And he brought that message of peace to those who were near to God.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa yɛn vih o maa dii yiɣis o sani yi; ka dabiɛm daa kpe sapashin kpɛm maa gba o ni daa baŋ ni Pool nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka o lo o zoligɔnim lala maa zuɣu.
en: At once the men who were going to question Paul drew back from him; and the commander was frightened when he realized that Paul was a Roman citizen and that he had put him in chains.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii niriba maa zuliyazuliya n-zali gooni maa nyaaŋa Palɔni naɣilima ni mini paliyari ni, ka bɛ gbibi takɔbiri mini kpana ni tɔbiri.
en: So I put some of the people behind the lowest places along the wall, and I put them by the holes in the wall. I put families together, with their swords, spears, and bows.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi gbilligbilli ʒini momaha zuɣu.
en: He directed the disciples to seat all the people in groups as though they were having a banquet on the green grass.

dag: Kaman bɛ nina ni biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Bɛ nina maa ni daa kul bemi kaman n ni daa nya shɛba Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la nina ni. Ka bɛ zaa yinoyino daa kul tuhi chana.
en: The forms of their faces were the same faces that I saw at the Chebar River. Their appearance was also the same. All four of them moved straight ahead.

dag: Di saha ka Maika daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni chɛ ka n tɔŋ, n ni zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nira leei m maligumaana ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Micah said, I have a Levite as my own priest. Now I know that the Lord will be kind to me.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka Mariama kumda, ka Yɛhudianim bɛn dol o na maa gba kumdi maa, ka o suhu saɣim pam, ka o siɣim.
en: Jesus saw her weeping, and he saw how the people with her were weeping also; his heart was touched, and he was deeply moved.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tahima niŋbu tahirila suhupiɛlli na, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The hopes of good people lead to joy, but wicked people can look forward to nothing.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋdila suɣili maa nti tiri zaani kpaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ sansani maa. O daa booni li la Yawɛ chirigibu shee, ka ŋunkam daa yi bɔri ni o bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ shɛli, o chanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini sansani maa kpaŋ maa ha.
en: Moses took the tent and pitched it outside the camp, far away from the camp. He called it the meeting tent. Everyone who wanted advice from the LORD would go out to the meeting tent outside the camp.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: At the end of the seven days, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti vili baŋtab piɛla, ka so jinjɛm piɛla. Di bi simdi ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka woligu puhi ba lo bɛmaŋa.
en: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka bi deei li, ka niŋ tipawumli bɛ ni daa lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu, ka bɛ daa dolila bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm, ka lihirila bɛ nyaaŋa, ka bi lihiri bɛ tooni.
en: But they didnt listen or pay attention. They followed their willful and evil hearts and went backward rather than forward.

dag: Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin yɛlim ti. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi yɛli ya, yi ku niŋ yɛda;.
en: Tell us, they said, are you the Messiah? He answered, If I tell you, you will not believe me;.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn mi daa yi Saipurus mini Sairiini n-ka Antiɔk na mali Naawuni yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili, ka yihiri ba ti Duuma Yisa yɛla waazu.
en: But other believers, who were from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and proclaimed the message to Gentiles also, telling them the Good News about the Lord Jesus.

dag: Hal yi yi yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la, ka yi tɛri be saŋmarisi biɛhigu shee, n ni siɣisi ya tiŋ na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Though you soar like the eagle, though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there, says the LORD.

dag: Di ni sabi ni ti Duuma san la, kpe ŋɔ di gbinni nyɛla Naawuni Shia sani; ka ti Duuma Shia maa ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yolisim be.
en: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be yɔɣu maa ni yuun pihinahi la, a daa dihi ba, ka binshɛli daa bi pooi ba; bɛ situra daa bi kpi, ka bɛ naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: You took care of them for years. They had all they needed in the desert. Their clothes didnt wear out, and their feet didnt swell and hurt.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be kasi. Mani n-nam yinim Izraɛlnima, ka nyɛ yi naa.
en: I am the Lord your Holy One. I made Israel. I am your King.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn gbihiri kum ni la polo, ka di chɛ ka yi ku fabindi bɛn kpi la zuɣu kaman bɛn ka tahima ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Our friends, we want you to know the truth about those who have died, so that you will not be sad, as are those who have no hope.

dag: Yuuni maa puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pisiniyini dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai na ni o ti yɛl ti.
en: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the LORDs word came through Haggai the prophet.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee m-bilina zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: Other seed fell into good soil and bore fruit. Upon growing and increasing, the seed produced in one case a yield of thirty to one, in another case a yield of sixty to one, and in another case a yield of one hundred to one.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa chaŋ ti zani wain tihi puri sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din bi yɛlim shee ka goma be di yaɣa ayi zaa.
en: Then the angel stood where the road narrowed between two vineyards and had a stone wall on each side.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ka vibi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim niŋ ya, ka yi ti nyɛligi di puuni.
en: I will put you in my fire of anger and blow on it, and you will begin to melt.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibubalibu kpe bɛ suhuri ni nti ku yɛligu maa, ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: but the worries of this life, the false appeal of wealth, and the desire for more things break in and choke the word, and it bears no fruit.

dag: Binneembihi zaa bɛn mali kpiŋkpama nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani, ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋub ba.
en: All insects with wings are unclean, so dont eat them.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Sukɔt nachimbil so m-bɔh o bɔhigu. Ka nachimbil maa daa kali Sukɔt kpamba pisopɔinnaayopɔin wuhi Gidiɔn.
en: he captured a young man from Sukkoth and questioned him. The young man wrote down for Gideon the names of the seventy-seven leading men of Sukkoth.

dag: Ka chira ayi maa daa ti naai ka o lab o ba sanna, ka o ti zaŋ o niŋ kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli ni o zaŋ o niŋ shɛm maa. O daa nyɛla paɣipiɛliga. Ka di daa leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After two months she came back to her father. He did what he had promised the Lord , and she died still a virgin. This was the origin of the custom in Israel.

dag: Bɛ daa nya n ni zaɣisi Izraɛlnim ka kari ba bahi bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim ka niŋ zina shɛŋa zaa la zuɣu, amaa ka dabiɛm daa bi gbahi bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa. Amaa ka bɛn gba daa chaŋ ti niŋ zina.
en: Judah also saw that I divorced Israel and sent her away because she had turned from me and had become a prostitute. But Judah, Israel's unfaithful sister, was not afraid. She too became a prostitute.

dag: Bɛ vihiri mɔɣa piligu shee n-yihiri binshɛŋa din sɔɣiya palo ni.
en: They dig to the sources of rivers And bring to light what is hidden.

dag: Dinzuɣu zanimiya baalim pumpɔŋɔ n-nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tuun kar shɛli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: Just stand here and watch the Lord show his mighty power.

dag: dindina o ni tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha dɛde, saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini saa ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa, ka yi puri atam niŋ pam, ka yi nya wain mini kpam.
en: I will send rain for your land at the right time. I will send the autumn rain and the spring rain. Then you can gather your grain, your new wine, and your oil.

dag: Amaa man sani, di viɛli ni n vu m-miri Naawuni. N zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ leei n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n zaŋ a tuma zaa yɛla moli gili!.
en: But as for me, how wonderful to be near God, to find protection with the Sovereign Lord and to proclaim all that he has done!.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli suhiri Naawuni. O ni daa ti suhi naai ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti ti ni yɛn suhiri Naawuni shɛm kaman Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba shɛm la.
en: When Jesus had finished praying, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his followers to pray.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa kpɛla Baalnim jɛmbu ni.
en: Then the Israelites did things that the LORD saw as evil: They served the Baals.

dag: Nyama, n yaai n noli, ka n zilinli din be n nol ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Notice that I am opening my mouth; my tongue is speaking in my mouth.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ ni paɣibu kal la paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: So the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law asked Jesus, Why is it that your disciples do not follow the teaching handed down by our ancestors, but instead eat with ritually unclean hands.

dag: Dinzuɣu bin ata ŋɔ m-beni, dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda mini tahima ni yurilim, ka din gari di zaa nyɛla yurilim.
en: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm. Izraɛlnim bɛn daa yi Ijipti na n-nyɛ:.
en: Take a census of those years old and above as the LORD commanded Moses. The Israelites who left the land of Egypt were.

dag: Nyin bilikɔɣindan ŋɔ! Vuɣim daantal shɛli din sa a ninni maa ka nyari viɛnyɛliŋga pɔi, ka naanyi yihi bimburigin shɛli din be a mabia ninni.
en: You hypocrite! First take the log out of your own eye, and then you will be able to see clearly to take the speck out of your brother's eye.

dag: N ni ti yihi bukpahigu yi kɔbili ni, ka baɣisi ti ku lan beni.
en: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani, ka nyuri bara bɛ daazichi din galisi pam zuɣu la.
en: by evil people who trust in their riches and boast of their great wealth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lar o. Amaa ka o daa kari bɛ zaa yihi, ka zaŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma pahi bɛn daa be o san la zuɣu kpe bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa do du shɛli ni maa.
en: They laughed at him, but he threw them all out. Then, taking the childs parents and his disciples with him, he went to the room where the child was.

dag: Amaa ka sapashini maa daa dolila ŋariŋ maa lana mini ŋariŋ maa tuma zuɣulana yɛligu gari Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But Julius listened to the captain of the ship and its owner, rather than to Paul.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Bin suŋ ni tooi yi Nazarɛt na? Ka Filip yɛl o, Kamina ti nya.
en: Nathanael responded, Can anything from Nazareth be good? Philip said, Come and see.

dag: n-yo bidibikpamba bɛn kalinli pani maa zuɣu Aduna min o bidibisi sani.
en: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.

dag: N ni ti daai bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa to taba. N yi ti yɛn ku ba, n ku chɛ so bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And I will shatter every one of them, even parents and children, declares the LORD. I wont take pity; I wont have compassion; I will show no mercy when I destroy them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bimbiɛlli ti biri kulim shee. Di daa nyɛla bimbilli din ʒe m-baɣi kom pam. O daa biri li mi kaman tia din zoora yomyom la.
en: He took a native seed and planted it in a prepared field, placing it like a willow beside plentiful water.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, pumpɔŋɔ ŋmaligim a nina kpa ti polo na ka gbilisi tibili wum ti suhigu kpe ŋɔ.
en: Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers of this place.

dag: Di ni chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee? Ti zaa ti yɛn laɣimmi kpi.
en: Will they go down with me to the underworld; will we descend together to the dust?.

dag: Bɛ daa mali karimbaani, ka tum din chihiri n sani ka n nya li, dinzuɣu ka n daa ku ba.
en: They were proud and stubborn and did the things that I hate, so I destroyed them, as you well know.

dag: Dabiɛm gbahi tinzunnima, ka bɛ yiri bɛ ni me birini gili bɛ tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-kani n sanna, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They lose all their courage and come out of their hiding places shaking with fear.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyolɔrigu lo o pahi, ka zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ di ni;.
en: He put the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in it.

dag: A ni di biɛla shɛli maa, a ni ti li bahi, ka a yɛtɔɣ viɛla bahi yoli.
en: And if you eat their food, you will get sick and be embarrassed.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali taali Yawɛ sani; ka di niŋ o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu.
en: It is a repayment offering for the sin you committed against the Lord .

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi woligi bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni bɛn viɛla, ka lan baŋ yin ni di binnamdi so ŋun mali nyɛvili ni yin ku di binnamdi so ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: You must be careful to distinguish between what is ritually clean and unclean, between animals that may be eaten and those that may not.

dag: Anatɔt — kɔbiga ni pihitaayika.
en: from the town of Anathoth:.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpalim be Yawɛ sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi, o daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom. Ka o daa sabi alikauli maa yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ fukumsi zaligunim pia la pa bimparilana ayi maa zuɣu.
en: Moses stayed on the mountain with the Lord for days and nights, without eating or drinking. And he wrote down the Ten Commandments, the most important part of God's agreement with his people.

dag: Lala ka o daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata ni bɛn zaa daa taɣiri biŋkɔbiri maa; Yi yi ti tuhi Iso soli, yin yɛlimiy o yɛtɔɣ yini maa.
en: Jacob also ordered the second servant, the third servant, and all the other servants to do the same thing. He said, You will say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.

dag: M puhiri Asinkiritus mini Flɛgɔn ni Hɛrimɛs ni Patirɔbas ni Hɛrimas ni ti mabihi bɛn be bɛ san la.
en: My greetings to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and all the other Christians with them.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi ti nya ka Naawuni bɔhi biɛri, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti siɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ʒim ni n-no n-gili.
en: But the righteous will rejoice when they see vengeance done, when they wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ me dubihi shɛŋa n-tuɣi duu maa ti tuui, ka di zaa yiniyini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ sida dari tuɣ tab ti gɔhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Storage rooms just over two meters high were all around the temple, and they were attached to the temple by cedar beams.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli: Yawɛ, a yɛliya ni a ni bela zibisim tital ni.
en: Then Solomon said, The LORD said that he would live in a dark cloud.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka n dimnim kari doli ma hal ti gbaai ma n-no ma sɔŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ ma pi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.

dag: ka o shih o nuu, ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ o saani.
en: He touched her hand; the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.

dag: Yɛm bi bela ninkura sani, ka baŋsim mi bi bela nir yuusim ni?.
en: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.

dag: Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Gɛshɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Laribu la ni ti dimnim bɛn pahi la daa wumya ni ti me gooni maa naai hal ka voya lan ka di ni, amaa di saha maa n daa na bi zaŋ pundi kpɛhi di dunoya la.
en: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.

dag: ŋun daa chɛ o yidaan tuuli, ka tam o ni daa lo Naawuni alikauli shɛli yɛla la.
en: who is faithless to her own husband and forgets her sacred vows.

dag: Ti ni daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa saha shɛli maa, ka n daa zaŋ Aroa nuzaa polo yaɣili din be Arinɔn kulibɔŋ nol la mini Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya ni tinsi la pirigili mini di fɔntinsi ti Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba.
en: When we took possession of the land, I assigned to the tribes of Reuben and Gad the territory north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River and part of the hill country of Gilead, along with its towns.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: N niriba bɛn be Ziɔn, di zɔriya Asirianim dabiɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti zaŋ fiɛbisi fiɛbiri ya, ka kpuɣi jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛbiri ya kaman Ijiptinim ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Therefore, the LORD God of heavenly forces says: My people who live in Zion, dont fear Assyria, which strikes you with the rod and raises its staff against you as Egypt did.

dag: Shɔbal bia Reeya n-daa nyɛ Jahat ba, ka Jahat daa nyɛ Ahumai mini Lahad ba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Zɔranim zuliya.
en: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni chɛ ka kokpɛɣu kpe dunia ŋɔ ni n-di vuhirigu kam zaa ŋun mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka binshɛɣukam zaa din be dunia ŋɔ ni kpi.
en: I am now bringing the floodwaters over the earth to destroy everything under the sky that breathes. Everything on earth is about to take its last breath.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yoliyoli, dama ŋunkam booni man Yawɛ yuli yoliyoli mali taali man Yawɛ sani.
en: Do not use my name for evil purposes, for I, the Lord your God, will punish anyone who misuses my name.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai tin shɛli ka bɛ bi deei ya, yi yi ti yɛn yi di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi tiŋ maa nim zuɣu, ka di niŋ shɛhira biɛɣu jɛndi ba.
en: If the people in the town will not welcome you, go outside the town and shake the dust off your feet as a warning to them.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi gba di li shɛhira ti sani. Tuuli o daa yɛlimi:.
en: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn zaa daa ʒe n-gili nam ʒiishee maa mini kpamba la ni binnɛma anahi la daa gbani nam ʒiishee maa tooni n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: All the angels stood in a circle around the throne, and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell facedown before the throne and worshipped God.

dag: A yi di niŋ din simdi, n naan ku deei li? Ka a yi bi niŋ din simdi, alahichi do a dunol ni m-bɔri ni di nyaŋ a, amaa di niŋ kamaata ni a nyaŋ li.
en: You know that if you do what is right, I will accept you. But if you dont, sin is ready to attack you. That sin will want to control you, but you must control it.

dag: Bɛ niŋdi yomyom chani ni bɛ ti ku niriba.
en: They are quick to hurt and kill;.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ku yi Kalidianim maa nuu ni; amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag o ti Babilɔn Naa, ka o min o nina pali taba, ka bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa garigi taba.
en: and Judahs King Zedekiah will be captured and handed over to the king of Babylon; he will speak to the king of Babylon personally and see him with his very own eyes.

dag: ni kanaafiri ni binnyoon viɛla balibu kam ni tulaale zim ni tulaale zin shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr ni firanki tulaale zim la ni wain ni kpam ni zim balli mini chi ni niɣi mini piɛri ni yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi zaŋ tabili daba mini ninsalinim nyɛviya la.
en: cinnamon, incense, fragrant ointment, and frankincense; wine, oil, fine flour, and wheat; cattle, sheep, horses, and carriages; and slaves, even human lives.

dag: Ifriim zuliya niriba daa sula nudirigu polo, ka Manaasa zuliya niriba mi su nuzaa polo ka Teeku do bɛ sunsuuni n-nyɛ bɛ tintarisi bolo. Asha daa bela nuzaa polo ka Isaka mi be wulimpuhili polo.
en: What lay south of the border belonged to Ephraim, and what lay north of it belonged to Manasseh. The sea was its border. The territory bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi zɔnim zaa yɔhim ya. Bɛ kari ya tahi yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga. Yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi ka taali nyaŋ ya. Yi mini yi zɔnim bɛn laɣindi timdi diri bari ya zana, ka yi ku tooi baŋ li.
en: Your allies have deceived you; they have driven you from your country. People who were at peace with you have now conquered you. Those friends who ate with you have laid a trap for you; they say of you, Where is all that cleverness he had.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa, Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la zaa.
en: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dooni bɛ gom shee n-lɔri nia biɛri. Bɛ bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ zali so viɛlli zuɣu; bɛ mi bi zaɣisiri din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: They make wicked plans in bed at night. They choose a way of life that does no good. And they never say no to anything evil.

dag: Nyin Naa n-zali zaligu ni biŋkumda la yi ti piligi kumsi, sokam ŋun damdim tiŋa n-jɛm salima binnan la.
en: King, you gave a command. You said that everyone who hears the sound of the horns, flutes, lyres, sambucas, harps, bagpipes, and all the other musical instruments must bow down and worship the gold idol.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mmaŋmaŋ ni ŋmaai sida tia wulikpani nyoli ni n-zaŋ li sa. N ni lan ŋmaai di wul polli din wɔɣa pam nyoli ni n-zaŋ li mmaŋmaŋa ti sa zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu.
en: The LORD God proclaims: I myself will take one of the top branches from the tall cedar. I will pluck a tender shoot from its crown, and I myself will plant it on a very high and lofty mountain.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o zuli n-vooi saŋmarisi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim zuɣu bahi dunia ni; ka daa chaŋ ti ʒe paɣ so ŋun yɛn dɔɣi maa tooni ni o ti dɔɣi ka o di bia maa nyɛvili.
en: With his tail he dragged a third of the stars out of the sky and threw them down to the earth. He stood in front of the woman, in order to eat her child as soon as it was born.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Antiɔk Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri.
en: Because of the abundant presence of the Holy Spirit in their lives, the disciples were overflowing with happiness.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn jɛrigi ka ka yɛm. Bɛ buɣa maa ni wuhiri ba shɛli kul nyɛla dari wuhibu.
en: But they are both foolish and silly; they offer nothing because they are mere wood.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa pun yɛli o Kundi ni ni o ni tim anabinim mini tuumba na, ka bɛ ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka niŋ bɛ shɛb mi alaka;.
en: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, bɛna ka o wuhiri di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so shɛli.
en: You will show the right path to all who worship you.

dag: ka me Tadimɔr din daa be tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini tin shɛŋa din daa be Hamat ka nɛma be di ni la zaa.
en: He ordered his workers to build the town of Tadmor in the desert and some towns in Hamath where he could keep his supplies.

dag: A daa tɛhiya ni nyini n-kul yɛn su nam sahakam, ka bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni di nyɛla shɛli bee n-tɛhi di zaa ni ti yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: You said, I will live forever. I will always be the queen. You didnt care what you did to my people. You didnt think about what might happen later.

dag: Jɛhudi daa yi karim kulis ata bee kulis anahi, naa zaŋdila subila ŋ-ŋmaai o ni karim shɛli maa bahi buɣim ni kurupooti maa ni hal ka buɣim ti di gbaŋ maa zaa kurupooti maa ni.
en: As soon as Jehudi finished reading three or four columns, the king cut them off with a small knife and threw them into the fire. He kept doing this until the entire scroll was burned up.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa garigi yɛli Jɛfita, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, hal Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti min a zaa shɛhiralana.
en: The elders from Gilead said to Jephthah, The Lord is listening to everything we are saying. And we promise to do everything you tell us to do.

dag: Dindina, bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋmahindi bee bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ o buɣisi?.
en: Can you compare God to anything? Can you make a picture of God?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di chɛ ka paɣ so lan zali pua di yuŋ maa yaha. Di chɛ ka so lan wum suhupiɛlli vuri di ni yaha.
en: Don't let children be created or joyful shouts be heard ever again in that night.

dag: Ka Mariama paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dali daa ti paai kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm. Ka bɛ zaŋ bia maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ti ti Duuma.
en: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do the things the Law of Moses taught about being made pure. They brought Jesus to Jerusalem so that they could present him to the Lord.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yisahaku Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni. Di saha ka Musa daa pɔb o nina, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yuuni Naawuni.
en: I am the God of your ancestors. I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Moses covered his face because he was afraid to look at God.

dag: Bin ayi ka n suhir a ni a ti ma li pɔi ka n naanyi kpi.
en: I ask you, God, to let me have two things before I die:.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim maa daa yiɣis asibaasi, ka wuntaŋ nyeei kpe kom maa, ka bɛ nya ka di do bɛ tooni ha m-mɔhi kaman ʒim la.
en: The Moabites got up early that morning. The rising sun was shining on the water in the valley, and it looked like blood to the Moabites.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan wum ka kukol shɛli yi alizanda ni na yɛra, N niriba, yimiya o ni na ka o daalahichi ku tabili ya, ka o daalɔbo balibubalibu mi ku din ya.
en: Then I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out, my people! Come out from her! You must not take part in her sins; you must not share in her punishment!.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kambɔna pali bindira balibu kam. Chɛ ka ti biŋkɔbbaligu bɛn be mɔɣu ni la nabi n-niŋ tuhilituhili ni tuhi piapia.
en: so that our barns can be full, providing all kinds of food; so that our flocks can be in the thousands— even tens of thousands—in our fields.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me again.

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchu dama o mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa o bi gbuɣiri ŋubira. O nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: the pig—though it has completely divided hoofs, it does not rechew food, so it is unclean for you.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m biri ka so ti di li; ka shɛb ti gbi m puu bindira.
en: then let others eat what I planted. Let my crops be pulled up by the roots.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kpɛma tusaayopɔin mini tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim tuhili bɛn zaa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonian king also exiled seven thousand warriors—each one a hero trained for battle—as well as a thousand skilled workers and metalworkers to Babylon.

dag: ka n dimnim yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o. Ka n dimnim suhuri ni paligi n lubu zuɣu.
en: My enemies will say, Now we've won! They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Akishi, Di viɛla, a ni ti nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka Akishi daa yɛli Dauda, Mbo, n ni zaŋ a leei ŋun ni be n sani n-guli ma hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: David answered, Certainly, then you can see for yourself what I can do. Achish said, Fine, I will make you my permanent bodyguard.

dag: Di nyɛnya gbinnyaɣinima, amaa lee tummiya ni yi suhuri zaa, ka jɛmmiya ti Duuma.
en: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.

dag: Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa mini lɔndo din daa gili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: All the pegs for the Tent and for the surrounding enclosure were made of bronze.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Ɛhud bidibisi.
en: This was Ehuds family. They were heads of households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were sent into exile to Manahath.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɔhim wuntizɔriba kpɛhi zaɣ biɛɣu ni ni ti lu bɛmaŋmaŋ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛŋa ni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni ti nya laara din viɛla.
en: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me Nam ʒiishee zɔŋ, din nyɛ o ni yɛn kariti saria luɣ shɛli. Zɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ sariadibo shee. Sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali di tiŋ hal ti gbaai di yɔɣira.
en: He also built a throne room where he judged people. He called this the Judgment Hall. The room was covered with cedar from floor to ceiling.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali oniɣisi kuɣa n-zaŋ li tam salima bintaɣindisi ni, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la.
en: They prepared the carnelians and mounted them in gold settings; they were skillfully engraved with the names of the twelve sons of Jacob.

dag: Ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa tim na ti bol a ka a bi kana? A bi tɛhi ni n ni tooi ti a pin titali.
en: Balak said to him, Why didn't you come when I sent for you the first time? Did you think I wasn't able to reward you enough.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla, ka mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya ni di nyɛla din chihiri la.
en: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.

dag: ka boli yil maa ni bi so na nti bɔh o diɛma maa daliri.
en: He called one of the servants and asked what was going on.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa je ma sɔɣirimi yɛri taba n yɛla. Bɛ kul tɛhirila zaɣ biɛɣu tiri ma.
en: Those who hate me whisper about me. They think the worst about me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yihi ti kum barina titali maa ni, ka na kul yihiri ti di ni, ka ti mali tahima ni o ni lan yihi ti yaha.
en: He saved us from these great dangers of death, and he will continue to save us. We feel sure he will always save us.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ miri ma na nti tum tuma kaman maligumaaniba la bee m-miri sara maligu kasi shɛli mini binshɛli din be kasi. Amaa di simdi ka bɛ di vi, ka di wahala shɛlikam bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: They wont approach me to officiate for me as priests or approach any of my holy things or the most holy place. Though they will bear their humiliation and the consequences of their detestable practices.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka doo maa ti zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ yi mabi ŋun la mini Bɛnjamin n-tin ya ka yi labina. Ka n yi ni kɔŋ m bihi maa, n kul ni kɔŋ ba mi.
en: May God Almighty make the man compassionate toward you so that he may send back your other brother and Benjamin with you. But me, if Im left childless, then Im left childless.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o sara maligu shee din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: I will do this in Jerusalem, in the courtyards of the Lord s Temple. Praise the Lord !.

dag: ni Yuria ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ pihitanaayopɔin.
en: and Uriah the Hittite. There were in all.

dag: Dama n suhu bi doya, ka n lan ka alaafee. M bi nyari nyee vuhira, amaa ka muɣisigu n-kul paari ma.
en: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.

dag: N labirila a sanna pumpɔŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n ni na be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ, ni n suhupiɛlli pali bɛ suhuri ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Now Im coming to you and I say these things while Im in the world so that they can share completely in my joy.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bɔŋɔ? Wuhiri palli m-bala! Doo ŋɔ mali yiko mi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli.
en: Everyone was completely surprised and kept saying to each other, What is this? It must be some new kind of powerful teaching! Even the evil spirits obey him.

dag: Chɛ ka o sandan fa o ni mali shɛlikam zaa; ka saamba ʒe o ni tum tuma nya binshɛlikam zaa.
en: Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yaba n-nyɛ Ibrahimma. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi, yi naan tumdi kaman Ibrahimma ni daa tumdi shɛm.
en: They said, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said, If you were really Abrahams descendants, you would do what Abraham did.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa gari Mariama pam ka o bɔhir o suhu, ka bɔ puhigu n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: She was confused by these words and wondered what kind of greeting this might be.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi n dan Naa Dauda nyɛvili.
en: Then Bathsheba bowed down before the king and said, Long live King David.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du mɔɣili maa ni bɛ ti zaŋ naa malibu duhi na, ka niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm. Naa ni daa ti yɛn du mɔɣili maa saha shɛli, ka Shimɛi Gɛra bia maa daa kana ti damdi naa tooni.
en: Then they brought David's family and servants back across the river, and they did everything he wanted them to do. Shimei crossed the Jordan River and bowed down in front of David.

dag: N ni wurim kuŋkuna mini zoya, ka chɛ ka tihi mini mɔri din be di zuɣu zaa kuui. N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa kuui kpakpa, ka chɛ ka kɔpurima nyuui.
en: I will destroy the hills and mountains and dry up the grass and trees. I will turn the river valleys into deserts and dry up the pools of water.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya Izraɛlnim zaa Mizipa ka n ti suhi Yawɛ tin ya.
en: Then Samuel said, Tell everyone in Israel to meet together at Mizpah, and I will pray to the Lord for you.

dag: O daŋdila yiɣisibu di ni na bi neei saha shɛli n-niŋdi bindirigu tir o yiŋnima, ka tir o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi tuma.
en: She gets up while it is still night, providing food for her household, even some for her female servants.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi ŋubi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din nyɛ kasi zaa. Naawuni zaŋ li mi tin ya ni yi yihi niriba maa taali ni ka mali bɛ taali ni yibu maa sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Why did you not eat the sin offering in the holy area! That meat is very holy! God gave it to you to carry away the guilt of the people—to make the people pure before the Lord .

dag: Nyama, zibisim ni ti be dunia ni, ka niriba be bumbɔn ni. Amaa Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o neesim neei gili ya, ka chɛ ka o jilima siɣi yi zuɣu na.
en: Darkness now covers the earth, and the people are in darkness. But the Lord will shine on you, and his Glory will appear over you.

dag: Hal n ni filim mmaŋa n-gari ŋ-ŋɔ gba, ka lihi ʒiɛm mmaŋa, amaa dabipaɣiba shɛb yɛla a ni yɛli ŋɔ bɛn ni ti ma jilima.
en: I'll show you just how great I can be! I'll even be disgusting to myself. But those slave-girls you talked about will still honor me.

dag: di simdi ni a yo ba bɛ dabisili kam tuma yɔri, ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu, ; di yi pa lala bɛ ni fabili niŋ Yawɛ, ka a kpe taali ni.
en: Pay them their salary the same day, before the sun sets, because they are poor, and their very life depends on that pay, and so they dont cry out against you to the LORD. That would make you guilty.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba tah o tiŋgbɔn kasi ni zoya tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ o nudirigu tuhi fa la ni.
en: He led his people to his holy land, to the mountain he took with his own power.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: I am the LORD, who brought you up from the land of Egypt to be your God. You must be holy, because I am holy.

dag: N kuhimi hal ti gbarigi, ka n kukoli biɛra, ka n nina niŋ liti, ka n kul guhirila n Naawuni.
en: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba garigi yɛli.
en: Then Job responded.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa; di gbibiya jaaŋgbɛhi bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima bee bindira bee liɣiri; yi mi di ʒin ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: He told them, Don't take anything with you! Don't take a walking stick or a traveling bag or food or money or even a change of clothes.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la min o dabipaɣiba ayi ni o bihi piniyini la chaŋ ti gbaai Jabok Mɔɣili du.
en: Jacob got up in the middle of the night and took his wives, his eleven children, and everything he owned across to the other side of the Jabbok River for safety.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri bu ma paa, ka n leei piɛ shɛb bɛ ni daa yɛn ku gula. Ka n daa bo jaaŋgbɛh ayi m-boli zaɣ yini yuli anfaani, ka boli din pah ayi mi yuli naŋgban yini. Ka n daa leei piɛri maa gula.
en: Those who bought and sold the sheep hired me, and I became the shepherd of the sheep that were going to be butchered. I took two sticks: one I called Favor and the other Unity. And I took care of the flock.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi yɛligu niŋ pali. Di ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal o kɔb yini gba ti ku kabi.
en: These things happened to fulfill the scripture, They wont break any of his bones .

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Musa, Ti kpe yɔɣu, ti zaa ni kpi.
en: The Israelites said to Moses, We know that we will die! We are lost! We will all be destroyed!.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ ti kpuɣi pagɔrili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani.
en: Priests must not marry a woman who is promiscuous and defiled, nor can they marry a woman divorced from her husband, because priests must be holy to their God.

dag: Lala zuɣu yinim paɣiba, deemiya yi yidaannim noya, ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn bi deei Naawuni yɛligu la ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda bɛ paɣiba biɛhigu zuɣu, ka pa ni yi ni yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: In the same way, you wives should be willing to serve your husbands. Then, even those who have refused to accept Gods teaching will be persuaded to believe because of the way you live. You will not need to say anything.

dag: yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛligu! Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli zoya mini daboya ni yilima ni vinvama shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa ni zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-saɣim yi buɣa jɛmbu shee la.
en: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord , am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.

dag: Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa kunila luɣ yini, taŋkpaɣu ni ka bɛ yina, ka bɛ zaa lan yɛn labila taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: All go to the same place: all are from the dust; all return to the dust.

dag: Ɛba ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanahi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg.
en: When Eber was years old, he had a son, Peleg;.

dag: Dindali maa mi yi ti ku bɔhi binshɛli yɛla n sani. Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: When that day comes, you will not ask me for anything. I am telling you the truth: the Father will give you whatever you ask of him in my name.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa, ka kpahi Pita zuɣu ni yɛli, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! Dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: But Jesus turned and looked at his followers. Then he criticized Peter. He said to Peter, Get away from me, Satan ! You dont care about the same things God does. You care only about things that people think are important.

dag: Bɛ ni daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa neei biɛɣu, ka bɛ daa tuui di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu din nyɛ kawaan shɛra mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: The day after Passover, the people ate food that grew in that land. They ate bread made without yeast and roasted grain.

dag: Dama a bi bɔri sara; ka n yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, a nini ku tiɣi li.
en: Offerings and sacrifices are not what you want.

dag: Daliri dini zuɣu ka ti lee ni nyu bara? Daliri shɛli kani. Bɔ n-niŋ ka di kani? Ti ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu? Aai! Di nyɛla ti ni niŋ yɛda la zuɣu!.
en: What, then, can we boast about? Nothing! And what is the reason for this? Is it that we obey the Law? No, but that we believe.

dag: Yil anahi din daa bili yina n-zani tuuli yilli din daa kab la zaashee la wuhiri ni nama anahi ni ti yiɣisi n-zani nam zaɣ yini maa zaashee, ka di mi ti ku mali kpiɔŋ kaman tuuli nam maa.
en: The horn that snapped so that four came up in its place means that four kingdoms will come from one nation, but these four wont have the strength of the first one.

dag: Di saha ka Sool lan yɛli ba, Vihimiya m mini m bia Jɔnatan sunsuuni nya.! Ka di daa gbaala Jɔnatan.
en: Saul said, Throw them again to show the guilty one—me or my son Jonathan. Jonathan was shown to be the one.

dag: O daa zaŋla salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di nɛma zaa.
en: He made the lampstand and all its equipment from pure gold weighing one kikkar.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ ti zani baɣil o n-ku o, ka pilig o zuɣupiligu din be o zuɣu ni, ka lan pirigi baŋ din be o nuu ni na, dama n daa baŋya ni o ni lu n-doya shɛm maa, o ku lan gali. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o nɛma maa na ni n ti ti nyini n dana.
en: He was hurt so badly that I knew he wouldnt live. So I stopped and killed him. Then I took the crown from his head and the bracelet from his arm and brought them here to you, my lord.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo mini di sambani gba yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also meters.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba fabila mini bɛ kuhigu; bɛ kɔŋ bɛ jilima! Wummiya gbuɣima kuhigu; dama nyɔŋ din dolisi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili la saɣimya!.
en: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Yuria Ijipti na ti ti Naa Jɛhoyakim, ka o daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o n-zaŋ ti bahi tintarimba gbala ni.
en: They brought him back to King Jehoiakim, who had him killed and his body thrown into the public burial ground.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tikpiranima, wummiya! Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoomba, duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya!.
en: Hear, deaf ones, and blind ones, look and see!.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa garigi yɛli Leeban, N daa zɔr a mi, dama n daa tɛhimi ni di pa shɛli ka a ti zaŋ kiŋkansi fa a bipuɣinsi maa n sani.
en: Jacob answered, I was afraid, because I thought that you might take your daughters away from me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ li chaŋ a niriba bɛn be tinzun tinsi ni la sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi wum li bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa dii zaŋ Yisa tahi mɔɣu ni.
en: At once the Spirit forced Jesus out into the wilderness.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha, ka Asa bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di Juda nam.
en: In the fourth year of the reign of King Ahab of Israel, Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah.

dag: Ka suli daa ku bɛnkam zaa be jɛmbu duu maa ni n-wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: When the people in the synagogue heard Jesus say this, they became so angry.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Job said:.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa suhuri daa kpaŋ ka bɛ gba zaŋ bindirigu di.
en: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.

dag: Ka yi ti bu chi hal ni wain tihi wala pɔhibu saha, ka pɔhi wain tihi wala hal ni biribu saha. Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka yɛl shɛli kani.
en: Your threshing will continue until it is time to gather grapes. And your grape gathering will continue until it is time to plant. Then you will have plenty to eat. And you will live safely in your land.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri ba, ka bi chɛra, ka bɛ zo yomyom ni bɛ yi pɔhim kpiɔŋ maa ni.
en: They may try to run away from the power of the storm, but it will come down on them without mercy.

dag: Di daanabinim baɣa ka shɛli ni, ka nyɛ bɛn ka yɛda. Ka di maligumaaniba saɣim binshɛŋa din be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛn birigi zaligu.
en: Her prophets are reckless, men of treachery. Her priests pollute that which is holy; they do violence to the Instruction.

dag: N ni ti wurim yi fɔntinsi din be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka daai yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa luhi.
en: as well as your cities and your fortresses.

dag: Bɛ zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Ishimail bituuli n-daa nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt, bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-daa nyɛ: Kɛdar mini Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: These are their descendants: Ishmaels first son was Nebaioth. His other sons were Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni ni Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi tuun shɛŋa din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi.
en: Fools say to themselves, There is no God. They are all corrupt, and they have done terrible things; there is no one who does what is right.

dag: Wurimbu, wurimbu, n ni wurim li! Di tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Naɣila ŋun mali soli ni o su li maa ti kana, ka n zaŋ li ti o. .
en: A ruin, ruin, ruin, Ill make it! Such a thing has never happened! Even before the rightful judge comes, Ive handed it over to him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ya ti niŋ o ni daa lo yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali fɔntin kara din viɛla, ka pa yi ni me shɛŋa.
en: The Lord your God made a promise to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. He promised to give you this land, and he will give it to you. He will give you great and rich cities that you did not build.

dag: Di ʒiɛmani maa ni naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha maa ka Dan zuliya niriba daa lihiri bɔri luɣ shɛli ni bɛ ʒini, dama Izraɛlnim ni daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab la, bɛ daa na bi ti ba bɛ tiŋgbani.
en: There was no king in Israel at that time. In those days the tribe of Dan was looking for territory to claim and settle in because they had not yet received any land of their own among the tribes of Israel.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka yi ni niŋ yaa. So ku lan nahim ya, ka dabiɛm ku lan mali ya. So ku lan kpɛhi ya dabiɛm, di ni ti niŋ ya katiŋa.
en: You will be built on goodness. You will be safe from cruelty and fear. So you will have nothing to fear. Nothing will come to hurt you.

dag: Yɛlim Juda nayilinima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Say this to Judahs royal family: Listen to the message from the Lord .

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul kpalim be nayili maa hal ti paai Naa Sairus nam dibu yuun tuuli saha.
en: Daniel served there until the first year of King Cyrus.

dag: Rɛzɔn daa nyɛla Izraɛlnim dima Naa Sulemaana ʒiɛman ni, ka daa tumdi ba din bie kaman Hadad ni daa niŋdi ba shɛm la; ka daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnima, ka di nam su Sirianima.
en: Rezon became the king of Aram. He was an enemy of Israel throughout Solomons life and added to the trouble that Hadad created for Israel.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ ni be kaman gbuɣinli la n-gbaai ma vu n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli ŋun ni fa ma bahi ni kani nti dari tɔhitɔhi ma.
en: If you dont help me, I will be torn apart like an animal caught by a lion. I will be carried away with no one to save me.

dag: Amaa ti daa bi chaŋ miri Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni zaŋ tabili Jabok kulibɔŋ dul la mini fɔntin shɛli din daa be zoya tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima mali duu maa puuni tiŋa n-tabili di puuni duri mini di samban polo duri tiŋgban ni.
en: Even the floor was covered with gold.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka niŋmiya nirilim, ka zomiya tab nambɔɣu.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful said: You must do what is right and fair. You must be kind and show mercy to each other.

dag: Amaa ti bɔri ni ti bahi wum din be a sani, dama ti mi ni adiini so shɛli a ni doli ŋɔ, niriba kul tɔɣisiri galindi li mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: But we think its important to hear what you think, for we know that people everywhere are speaking against this faction.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan daa bɔhi Stiivin, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri paliya.
en: The high priest asked Stephen, Are they telling the truth about you.

dag: Ninsal ni kul ni niŋ shɛli nyɛla o di ka nyu, ka di o tuma nyaɣisim. N nyaya ka dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: The best thing we can do is eat and drink and enjoy what we have earned. And yet, I realized that even this comes from God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa zaŋ paɣ maa mirina ti zali Yawɛ tooni;.
en: The priest shall bring the woman forward and have her stand in front of the altar.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhima.
en: told them, I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim ni daa mali zali naai maa, ka maligumaaniba daa kul kpɛri tanti duu din daŋ tooni la ni nti tumdi bɛ maligumaanitali tuma dabisili kam;.
en: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.

dag: So na mi n-nya lahizibu yɛlli ŋɔ? Tiŋgbɔŋ niriba ni tooi zani dahin yini yɛligi? Bee zuliya ni tooi zani dahin yini yɛligi? Ziɔn ku nahim ka di yuui, ka o niriba yɛligi.
en: Has anyone ever seen or heard of such a thing? Has a nation ever been born in a day? Zion will not have to suffer long, before the nation is born.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa nya gariŋga maa ni kaai vil o nuu maa ka yɛli taba, Biɛhiŋ kani, doo ŋɔ nyɛla ninvuɣ kura; hal o ni tiligi kom dibu ni teeku ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, biɛr bɔhibu na kul bi saɣi ni o be.
en: The natives saw the snake hanging on Paul's hand and said to one another, This man must be a murderer, but Fate will not let him live, even though he escaped from the sea.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la mini Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt la tɔbbihi daa yi Mahanaim chaŋ Gibiɔn.
en: Abner son of Ner and the officers of Ish Bosheth son of Saul left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.

dag: ka ŋunkam kpuɣi bɛ zaɣ kpima, ŋun paɣim o situra ka kul be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani.
en: If you pick up the dead bodies of these unclean animals, you must wash your clothes. You will be unclean until evening. These animals are unclean for you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm Aduna jaaŋgbee maa labisi ti sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka di nyɛ shihirili duŋ taariba maa sani, ka a chɛ ka bɛ chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni kpi.
en: But the Lord told Moses, Put Aaron's stick back! Let it stay near the sacred chest as a warning to anyone who might think of rebelling. If these people don't stop their grumbling about me, I will wipe them out.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba wum o kukoli din galisi la, ka chɛ ka sokam nya o suhuyiɣisili tuma. O ni ti chɛ ka buɣim dira, ka sagbana bɔɣi, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛra, ka sakuɣa luri na.
en: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛri ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la; dinzuɣu maliya yɛm kaman tinvura, ka benya baalim kaman ŋmana la.
en: Listen! I am sending you out just like sheep to a pack of wolves. You must be as cautious as snakes and as gentle as doves.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo Ai buɣim, ka di di n-kab lu n-duhiduhi doya; ka na kul doya lala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua burned the city of Ai. That city became an empty pile of rocks. It is still like that today.

dag: Ka dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi maa, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini na ti mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O di ti niŋ kpam bee firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: If you cannot afford two doves or two pigeons, you can bring as the offering for your sin a tenth of an ephah of choice flour as a purification offering. You must not put any oil on it, nor any frankincense, because it is a purification offering.

dag: Tinzunnim yi be zuliya shɛb sani, yin tim ba bɛ tarili nimaani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: a share of the land given to the tribe where they live. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba dii gbaai kumsi.
en: Jesus wept.

dag: Pa ŋun daa nam ma niŋ m ma puli ni n-daa nam bɛ gba? Pa ŋuna n-daa nam ti zaa niŋ ti manim puya ni?.
en: Didnt the one who made me in the belly make them; didnt the same one fashion us in the womb?.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Hilikia maa mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Maika bia Abidɔn ni Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni naa kpambala Asaaya.
en: and gave the following order to Hilkiah, to Ahikam son of Shaphan, to Abdon son of Micaiah, to Shaphan, the court secretary, and to Asaiah, the king's attendant:.

dag: Zimiri daa ku Baasha daŋ niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛhu yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Baasha polo la.
en: Baasha's family was completely wiped out, just as the Lord 's prophet Jehu had warned.
