dag: ka yi yi karim n ni pun sab shɛli maa, yi ni tooi nya n ni baŋ Masia daashili maa yɛla shɛm.
en: And if you read what I wrote, you can see that I understand the secret truth about Christ.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa chihi yɛli, M bi la, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbaag o. Ka o yɛli, Aai, a laya.
en: Sarah lied and said, I didnt laugh, because she was frightened. But he said, No, you laughed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba Yaakubu chaŋ Firawuna sani, ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni.
en: Joseph brought his father Jacob and gave him an audience with Pharaoh. Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

dag: Dinzuɣu karimbaani n-nyɛ bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dolibi, ka duŋ taabo mi nyɛ bɛ kparibu.
en: Thats why they wear arrogance like a necklace, why violence covers them like clothes.

dag: O daa bɔrimi ni o diri bundan maa bindir burisa din luri tiŋa; ka bahi daa kanna ti leen o yuma maa.
en: Lazarus wanted only to eat the scraps of food left on the floor under the rich mans table. And the dogs came and licked his sores.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Simiɔn mini Lɛvi, Yi bo yɛla ti ma, di ni chɛ ka jɛlinsi kpe m mini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni nim bɛn nyɛ Keenannim mini Pɛrizinim ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka m mi niriba bi zooi. Bɛ yi laɣim kana ti liri ma, bɛ ni ku m mini n nyaaŋa zaa.
en: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Look what you've done! Now I'm in real trouble with the Canaanites and Perizzites who live around here. There aren't many of us, and if they attack, they'll kill everyone in my household.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n yɛn darigila Amɔn ŋun nyɛ Tɛbis nir la tibili, ka darigi Firawuna mini Ijiptinim ni di wuna ni di nanim zaŋ tabili bɛn niŋ Firawuna naani la tibili.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. Soon I will punish the god Amon of Thebes and the other Egyptian gods, the Egyptian kings, the people of Egypt, and everyone who trusts in the Egyptian power.

dag: Ka Jɛfita lan bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Yi yi zaŋ ma kuli ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka n nyaŋ ba, yi ni saɣi ka n leei yi zuɣulana.
en: Then Jephthah said to the elders from Gilead, If you want me to come back to Gilead and fight the Ammonites, I will do it. But if the Lord helps me win, I will be your new leader.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka fara gbaari nira, amaa ka tuma tumbu viɛnyɛliŋga mi chɛ ka nir leeri bundana.
en: Being lazy will make you poor, but hard work will make you rich.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni, di yi nyɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bee tuma ni, yin niŋmiya di zaa ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, ka paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: Everything you say and everything you do should be done for Jesus your Lord. And in all you do, give thanks to God the Father through Jesus.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa ŋme tɔbuchiriga bah o zuɣu ka o daa lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim yih o na n-vo o tahi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When the nations heard of him, they trapped him in a pit, then they used hooks to drag him to Egypt.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidibisi maa daa yi mɔɣu ni na ti wum li ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi ka bɛ je suli; Shɛkɛm ni daa tum jɛrilim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga saɣim maa zuɣu. Dama di daa bi simdi ni lala niŋ.
en: just as Jacob's sons were coming in from work. When they learned that their sister had been raped, they became furiously angry, because nothing is more disgraceful than rape, and it must not be tolerated.

dag: ka di ti nyɛ shihirili yi sani. Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: This will be a symbol among you. In the future your children may ask, What do these stones mean to you.

dag: O daa bi tum alahichi, ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa mi daa ka o nol ni.
en: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu. Ŋuna n-tiligiri bɛn ʒe dɛde bɛ suhuri ni.
en: God is my protector; he saves those who obey him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana.
en: The Lord told Solomon:.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali soli bo n-nya buni, di ku niŋ anfaani, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: Wealth gained by doing wrong will not really help you, but doing right will save you from death.

dag: Zomiya yi ʒiri ŋmabu ni, yi mi miriya ka yi ku ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli ka nyɛ ŋun ka taali, dama m pala ŋun ni chɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tum taali.
en: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.

dag: Maak mini Aristakus ni Diimas ni Luk bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditab la gba puhiri ya.
en: Also Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke send their greetings. They are workers together with me.

dag: Taɣimi gban shɛli n-sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa kul be tuuli gban shɛli Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa nyo buɣim la puuni la niŋ di ni.
en: Get another scroll and write in it all the words that were in the first scroll that Judahs King Jehoiakim burned.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa kaman pagɔrili n-nyɛ o maa.
en: But the brothers said, Should we let these people treat our sister like a prostitute? They were wrong to do that to our sister.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, vihim ma m-baŋ n suhu biɛhigu. Buɣisim ma baŋ n tɛha.
en: Examine me, God! Look at my heart! Put me to the test! Know my anxious thoughts!.

dag: Dindali maa o ni ti lan boli ma o yidana yaha, ka pa ni o Baal.
en: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.

dag: Nir lala di tɛhiri ni o ni deei shɛli ti Duuma sani.
en: People like that are thinking two different things at the same time. They can never decide what to do. So they should not think they will receive anything from the Lord.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔh o, Ka daɣila ti gba nyɛla zoomba.
en: Some of the Pharisees were near Jesus. They heard him say this. They asked, What? Are you saying that we are blind too.

dag: So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi yi ni yɛn chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa nim zaa dabiɛm kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.

dag: Ŋmɛnditɔya ni ti liri Gaad, amaa o ni ti kari doli ba ti fa bɛ nɛma.
en: Gad will be attacked by a band of robbers, But he will turn and pursue them.

dag: Amaa n ni saɣi ni shɛli nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛl a ŋɔ: Adiini so shɛli bɛ ni booni adiini soli din bi tuhi la, dina ka n doli n-jɛmdi n yaannim Naawuni, ka niŋ dinkam be zaligu puuni min anabinim sabbu yɛda.
en: I do admit this to you: I worship the God of our ancestors by following that Way which they say is false. But I also believe in everything written in the Law of Moses and the books of the prophets.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛ ka o mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni, yin kum o.
en: Death is the punishment for having sex with an animal.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, dama o niriba maa suhuri daa yiɣisimi, ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ ni lab o kuɣa. Dama sokam daa kul fabindila o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zuɣu. Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Dauda Naawuni ŋɔ daa kpaŋs o suhu.
en: David was now in great trouble, because his men were all very bitter about losing their children, and they were threatening to stone him; but the Lord his God gave him courage.

dag: Di saha ka Balak suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Balaam zuɣu, ka o zaŋ o nuhi kpahi taba ka yɛli Balaam, N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri bahi n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka a ti niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: When Balak heard this, he was so furious that he pounded his fist against his hand and said, I called you here to place a curse on my enemies, and you've blessed them three times.

dag: bɛ muɣisigu zaa ni. Pa malaika ka o daa tim na, amaa ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-daa tiligi ba. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim zuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba. Ŋuna n-daa pun gbib ba piligu ni ha.
en: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.

dag: Ka Sool gba daa kul o ya Gibia, ka dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni, ka Naawuni yɛligu maa kpe bɛ suhuri ni daa pahi dol o kuli.
en: Saul also went back home to Gibeah. Some powerful men, whose hearts God had touched, went with him.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ darigi cheei Izraɛl nam kparibu a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-zaŋ li yɛl a kpe so ŋun so a.
en: Samuel said to him, The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel away from you today and given it to someone who is a better man than you.

dag: Yawɛ, saha yuusim wula ka a yɛn tam n yɛla? A ni tam n yɛla sahakam? A yɛn ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma ka di yuusim paai bɔ saha?.
en: How long will you forget me, LORD? Forever? How long will you hide your face from me?.

dag: Ka so yi tum taali zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli polo, di simdi ni o zani yim zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum taal shɛli maa polo.
en: When you are guilty, you must confess the sin.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kpani lu ninvuɣ kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku ba ka zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Abishai was the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah. Abishai was the leader of the Three Heroes. He used his spear against enemies and killed them. He became as famous as the Three.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya li, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya n laɣifu din daa bɔrigi la.
en: When she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together, and says to them, I am so happy I found the coin I lost. Let us celebrate.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi o kpee zabili ni ŋmanila ŋun gbaai ba so ŋun gariti tiba.
en: To step between two people arguing is as foolish as going out into the street and grabbing a stray dog by the ears.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yi ku tooi jɛm Yawɛ dama o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be kasi; ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri nyuli; ka ku chɛ yi tuumbiɛri bee yi daalahichi.
en: Then Joshua said to the people, You cant serve the LORD, because he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He wont forgive your rebellion and your sins.

dag: Ka o suhu daa yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba.
en: He was angry with his own people and let them be killed by their enemies.

dag: Ka di simdi ni o be o sani yuuni kam kaman padir la. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o yi ninni.
en: Regardless, the Israelite will be to the buyer like a yearly laborer; the buyer must not harshly rule over them in your sight.

dag: Sulemaana daa zaŋla naɣilahi tuhi pisinaayi mini piɛri tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ sani. Lala ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni.
en: Solomon offered well-being sacrifices to the LORD: twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep when the king and all Israel dedicated the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niriba leei daba.
en: Joseph made slaves of the people from one end of Egypt to the other.

dag: Dama Mani Naawuni m-mɔŋ o yɛm, ka mɔŋ o baŋsim.
en: Thats because I did not give wisdom to the ostrich. She is foolish, and I made her that way.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di lan zɔri ya Babilɔn naa kaman yi ni yi zɔr o shɛm la, dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya, ka fan ya o nuu ni bahi.
en: Now you are afraid of the king of Babylon. But dont be afraid of him. Dont be afraid of the king of Babylon, says the Lord , because I am with you. I will save you. I will rescue you. He will not get his hands on you.

dag: Ka Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa wum o kum maa yɛla, ka chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti sɔɣi.
en: When John's followers learned that he had been killed, they took his body and put it in a tomb.

dag: Yi mi di zaŋya yimaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni la bee m-boli bɛ buɣa la yuya bee m-po ba bee n-jɛm ba bee n-damdi di tooni.
en: Dont have anything to do with these nations that remain with you. Dont invoke the names of their gods or take oaths by them. Dont serve them or worship them.

dag: Yawɛ, Garigim ma, garigim ma din ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ baŋ ni nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri labis a sanna.
en: Lord , answer my prayer. Show these people that you, Lord , are God and that you are the one who is bringing them back to you.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, di nyɛla talahi ni woligibu kpe yi sunsuuni n-chɛ ka di kahigi wuhi bɛn nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinim ni nyɛ shɛb yi ni.
en: because of your idea that you must have separate groups to show who the real believers are!.

dag: Nir yi zu nahu bee piɛɣu nti kɔhi bee nti kɔrigi, di simdi ka o yo niɣ anu naɣ yino maa zuɣu, ka yo piɛr anahi piɛ yino maa zuɣu. Di simdi ka o yo di samli maa, ka o yi ka binshɛli din ni yo samli maa, dindina bɛn kɔhim o n-yo o zubu maa samli.
en: If someone steals a cow or a sheep and kills it or sells it, he must pay five cows for one cow and four sheep for one sheep.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋma Sool zuɣu ka yeeg o gbaɣino, ka tim bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-zaŋ lahiba suŋ maa yɛli bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: The Philistines cut off Sauls head and took all his armor. They carried the news to the Philistines and to all the temples of their idols.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntitali be o ʒiɛman ni, ka chɛ ka suhudoo pam beni kaman goli ni beni ka o neesim be shɛm la sahakam.
en: Let the righteous flourish throughout their lives, and let peace prosper until the moon is no more.

dag: O yi mali bidibiga ka o nyɛ biyariga, ka kuri niriba.
en: Then suppose this man has a son who robs and kills, who does any of these things.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi puuni, Naawuni daa yɛli Firawuna, N ni zal a daliri shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni n wuhi n yiko tuma a ni, ka di chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia zaa.
en: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.

dag: Ka malaika so daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-duh o yee kuhiri yɛri ŋun ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa, Dunia atam biya zaa ka di chɛbu saha paai. Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-tim di ni chɛ.
en: Another angel came out of the temple, calling in a loud voice to the one seated on the cloud: Use your sickle to reap the harvest, for the time to harvest has come, and the harvest of the earth is ripe.

dag: Lala ka alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yiɣisi kɔre balibu kam n ni. Di yi di pa lala Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu, alahichi naan nyɛla din kpi.
en: But sin seized the opportunity and used this commandment to produce all kinds of desires in me. Sin is dead without the Law.

dag: Naawuni, kom ni daa nya a, kom maa ni daa shiri nya a, dabiɛm daa gbaai li mi, ka kɔbulli ni daa sɔhira.
en: The waters saw you, God— the waters saw you and reeled! Even the deep depths shook!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai niriba wuhibu biɛɣukam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o;.
en: Every day Jesus taught in the Temple. The chief priests, the teachers of the Law, and the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛla yi zuɣu, ka bɛ suhiri Naawuni tiri ya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi pam yi ni la zuɣu.
en: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, A yi labina, n ni deeg a ka a lan be n sani yaha. A yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri, a ni leei ŋun ni tɔɣisiri n yɛtɔɣa. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti lab a sanna; pa nyini n-ni ti lab bɛ sani.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: If you return to me, I will take you back and let you stand before me. If you utter what is worthwhile, not what is worthless, you will be my spokesman. They will turn to you, not you to them!.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ. .
en: I am the God who came to you at Bethel, and there you made an altar, poured olive oil on it, and made a promise to me. Now I want you to be ready to go back to the country where you were born.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya ŋumaŋuma shɛli yi ni wumdi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu. Yi kul wumdila ŋumaŋuma yuuni kam. Yi wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni bɛ yɛn taala duŋ, ka na so yɛn tuhi na so.
en: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ yi be tiŋ maa ni, bɛ ni tooi tiligila bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya kɔŋko bɛ wuntitali zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I would punish that country even if Noah, Daniel, and Job lived there. They could save their own lives by their goodness, but they could not save the whole country . This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Yi nini na bi nya o, amaa ka yi kul yur o; ka hal yi nini ni na kul bi nya o maa zaa yoli, yi niŋ o yɛda ka kul mali suhupiɛl shɛli din galisi hal ka so ku tooi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa kahigi li wuhi gba.
en: You love him, although you have not seen him, and you believe in him, although you do not now see him. So you rejoice with a great and glorious joy which words cannot express.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa be kaman taŋkuɣibihi la lurina, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo di wari?.
en: He makes hail fall like rocks from the sky. No one can stand the cold he sends.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Olivi tia dari m-mali chɛrubinima ayi n-zali du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi shee maa puuni. Chɛrubi yino kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: Two winged creatures were made of olive wood and placed in the Most Holy Place, each one feet tall.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa ti nya ka Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so ti Ibrahimma la min o bia Yisahaku diɛmda.
en: Sarah saw Hagars son laughing, the one Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa n-tumdi din tuhi ni di chɛ ka n ku mali galimi n suhu tɛha ni Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: And because I am sure, I try my best to have a clear conscience in whatever I do for God or for people.

dag: Ka gbaŋŋmara maa daa yɛl lala n-naai ka yɛli salo maa ni bɛ wurimma.
en: After the city clerk said this, he told the people to go home.

dag: daa ti lo nia n tɛha puuni ni n vihi baŋ binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ni. Di nyɛla Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti daadamnim ka bɛ tumdi ka di tiri ba suhugarigu.
en: I decided to study and to use my wisdom to learn about everything that is done in this life. I learned that it is a very hard thing that God has given us to do.

dag: Yurilim maa nyɛla ni ti doli Naawuni zaligunima. Ka o zaligu maa dolibu nyɛla ni ti yum taba kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm piligu ni la.
en: And loving means living the way he commanded us to live. And Gods command is this: that you live a life of love. You heard this command from the beginning.

dag: Yɛndana tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, jɛra bɛn tɛha puuni pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Knowledge is spread by people who are wise, not by fools.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Ayuba yɛla ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la, N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a min a zɔnim ayi maa zuɣu, dama yi bi tɔɣisi n yɛla ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli kaman n dabili Ayuba ni tɔɣisi li shɛm.
en: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋma di nyɔŋ maa, hal nira ni ku tooi kpe di ni maa zaa yoli. Bɛ ni galisi gari toli maa zuɣu bɛ ka kalinli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They destroy her dense forest, though it is vast, because they outnumber locusts and cant be counted, declares the LORD.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman m bihi n-nyɛn ya la. Niŋmiya ti kaman ti ni niŋ ya shɛm; yi gba yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti!.
en: I speak now as though you were my children: show us the same feelings that we have for you. Open your hearts wide!.

dag: So yi liri ya, di pala n yɛda ni ka o niŋ lala. Ka ŋunkam liri ya, o ku di nasara.
en: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.

dag: O dari tɔhi n yaɣa zaa, ka n yɛla naai, ka darigi vuɣi n tahima kaman tia la.
en: tore me down completely so that Ill die, and uprooted my hope like a tree.

dag: ka zaŋ bubihi pola maa gbandi pɔb o nuchɛhi min o nyiŋgoli;.
en: She put the skins of the goats on his arms and on the hairless part of his neck.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nyɛ faranima ka ka bindirigu diri zuɣu, bɛ daa nyirila taŋkpa kuma tiŋgbani nɛli ni.
en: They are starving with nothing to eat, so they chew on the dry, ruined land.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka n suhu kul yɛya ni n yihi Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-ti yinim bɛn be Rom ŋɔ gba.
en: So then, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who live in Rome.

dag: n-ti Gibiɔnnim maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ti ku ba zoli maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa laɣim kpi. Puu atam kpuɣibu saha, kachɛɣu piligu ni ka bɛ daa ku ba maa.
en: David handed them over to the people of Gibeon, who hanged them on the mountain before the Lord —and all seven of them died together. It was late in the spring, at the beginning of the barley harvest, when they were put to death.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ti chɛ ka bɛ bu ba, ka ku ba Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Bɛ ni daa gbahi Judanim maa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: near Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar had them killed. Most of the people of Judah had been carried away as captives from their own country.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, Ilaisha, n suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɛriko. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Jɛriko.
en: Elijah said, Elisha, stay here, because the LORD has sent me to Jericho. But Elisha said, As the LORD lives and as you live, I wont leave you. So they went to Jericho.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋdi ti ti chɔɣinsi ni, dama ti ʒi di ni simdi ni ti suhiri Naawuni shɛm, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-deeri suhiri Naawuni ni ŋuhibu din ka yɛtɔɣa tiri ti.
en: In the same way the Spirit also comes to help us, weak as we are. For we do not know how we ought to pray; the Spirit himself pleads with God for us in groans that words cannot express.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni yi baŋ ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli ni ti beni. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda la ansarisi.
en: It is important for you to understand what will happen in the last days. People will laugh at you. They will live following the evil they want to do.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa yɛl o ba, N dana, di je suli niŋ ma n ni ku tooi yiɣisi zani a tooni maa zuɣu, dama paɣitali biɛhigu ni ka m be. Ka Leeban daa vihi bo wuni maa ka bi nya li.
en: And Rachel said to her father, Father, dont be angry with me. I am not able to stand up before you. I am having my monthly time of bleeding. So Laban looked through the camp, but he did not find the gods from his house.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti paɣa maa? Ka Gɛhaazi garigi yɛl o, To, paɣ maa ka bidibiga, ka o yidana mi kurigi.
en: Then what can we do for her? Elisha asked Gehazi. Gehazi replied, I do know that her husband is old, and that she doesn't have a son.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam bɛn ka gɔhi mini paɣiri, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: But you arent allowed to eat anything that lacks scales or fins. These are off-limits for you.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi la.
en: They showed him the table with everything on it and the special bread.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛɣuni asiba di yi sa kul neerina, a min a niriba bɛn doli ma kana maa yin daŋmiya yiɣisibu n-labi yiŋ yomyom.
en: Early in the morning, you and your men should go back to the city I gave you. Dont pay attention to the bad things the captains say about you. You are a good man, but you must leave as soon as there is enough light in the morning.

dag: Wuntizɔra yi di nasara, tiŋ zaa malila suhupiɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu yi kpi, niriba warila waa.
en: A city is happy when honest people have good fortune, and there are joyful shouts when the wicked die.

dag: N ni zaŋ alikama zaɣ suma dihi ya, ka zaŋ tampiŋ ni shiri tin ya ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: But I would feed you with the finest wheat. I would satisfy you with honey from the rock.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli ni tiligi. Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti be bɛn kpalim maa ni.
en: And everyone who trusts in the Lord will be saved. There will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, just as the Lord said. Yes, those left alive will be the ones the Lord has called.

dag: O daa bɔrimi ni o diri bundan maa bindir burisa din luri tiŋa; ka bahi daa kanna ti leen o yuma maa.
en: He was happy just to eat the scraps that fell from the rich man's table. His body was covered with sores, and dogs kept coming up to lick them.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka jila be di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ be di ni, ka gbaŋ pɔbi bɛ zaa. Amaa ka vuhim daa ka bɛ ni.
en: When I looked, suddenly there were sinews on them. The flesh appeared, and then they were covered over with skin. But there was still no breath in them.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni; o kɔŋko sani ka n tiliginsim yirina.
en: Only in God do I find rest; my salvation comes from him.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bee Farisiinim ni so niŋ o yɛda?.
en: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.

dag: dama alɔbo ni tooi yi bɛ sanna n-libig a, ka ŋuni n-lee mi bɛ ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu shɛl na?.
en: Disaster comes suddenly from them. Who can know the ruin that both can bring?.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛliya ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mɛbu saha na bi paai. .
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful said, The people say it is not yet the right time to build the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa daa kul ba n-ʒe bɛ zaashɛhi ni gili Midiannim sansani maa, ka Midiannim maa daa kuhi ka yiɣisi guui.
en: Every man stood in his place around the camp, and the whole enemy army ran away yelling.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyar maa, daŋmi n tooni chaŋ daboli ŋɔ zuɣu, dama zuŋɔ m min a ni laɣim di bindirigu, ka n sa yɛl a din be a zuɣu ni biɛɣuni asiba ka chɛ ka a kuli.
en: Im the seer, Samuel told Saul. Go on ahead of me to the shrine. You can eat with me today. In the morning Ill send you on your way, and I will tell you everything you want to know.

dag: Zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka tummila din viɛla, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi kul be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam.
en: Turn away from evil! Do good! Then you will live in the land forever.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baai bɛ bandi la, ka chihi bɛ mihi la ti niŋgbuna ni.
en: They say, Lets rebel against them. Lets break free from them.

dag: N kul ku tam yi yɛla. Nyama, n pun sab yi yuli niŋ n nutaya ni.
en: Look, on my palms Ive inscribed you; your walls are before me continually.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o yuli; malimiya soli ti ŋuna ŋun be sagbana ni n-chani maa. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ, maliya suhupiɛlli o sani!.
en: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Exalt the one who rides the clouds! The LORD is his name. Celebrate before him!.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu, bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu bɛ ni kpi.
en: When those who do the right thing turn from their responsible ways and act maliciously, they will die because of it. For their malicious acts they will die.

dag: Amaa man tɛha ni, o yi kpalim ʒiya o ni mali suhupiɛlli gar o yi kuli doo, ka n tɛhi ni Naawuni Shia Kasi be n ni zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo.
en: The woman is happier if she does not marry again. This is my opinion, and I believe that I have Gods Spirit.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lo ti alikauli shɛl la zuɣu, tinim kul guhirila zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ pala, ka wuntitali be di ni la.
en: But we wait for what God has promised: new heavens and a new earth, where righteousness will be at home.

dag: Amaa ka Juda bituuli Ɛr maa daa nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa ku o.
en: But Er did many bad things. The Lord was not happy with him, so the Lord killed him.

dag: Yi mɔŋdi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli, ka fari yɛlimaŋli n niriba bɛn nyari nahiŋgu la sani, ka fari pakoya mini kpibisi nɛma.
en: to deprive the needy of their rights and to rob the poor among my people of justice; to make widows their loot; to steal from orphans!.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu biɛyanim ninvuɣ pia la daa chaŋ Ijipti ni bɛ ti da kawana.
en: So Josephs ten brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn be tinsi maa ni ka su li, ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee la nyɛ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa dini.
en: The Levites will be able to live in them. And all the cattle and other animals that belong to the Levites will be able to eat from the pastures around these cities.

dag: Ka Jɛtro daa wum Yawɛ ni niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa min o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm maa, ka o suhu daa paligi pam.
en: When Jethro heard all this, he was happy.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa, ka lan nya bɛ ni ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka o taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni daa lo ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa polo, ka daa shiri bi niŋ li.
en: God saw what the people did. He saw that they stopped doing evil. So God changed his mind and did not do what he planned. He did not punish the people.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri.
en: Will I not punish them for these things? Will I not take revenge on a nation like this? I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: N ni zani n ni guli luɣ shɛli polo, ka tam n gooni zuɣu lihiri nya o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm min o ni yɛn garigi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ n fabila polo.
en: I will stand like a guard and watch. I will wait to see what the Lord will say to me. I will wait and learn how he answers my questions.

dag: Amaa Giliad min o paɣ gba daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba. Ka o paɣ bidibisi maa ni daa ti zooi, bɛ daa karila Jɛfita ka yɛl o, Ti min a ku laɣim di ti ba fali, dama a nyɛla paɣ so bia.
en: had other sons by his wife, and when they grew up, they forced Jephthah to leave home. They told him, You will not inherit anything from our father; you are the son of another woman.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr piɛlli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi tɔbu, ka bɛ ti o nam zuɣupiligu, ka o chani gindi n-tuhiri diri nasara.
en: I looked, and there before me was a white horse. The rider on the horse held a bow and was given a crown. He rode out to defeat the enemy and win the victory.

dag: ni binshɛɣukam din mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa daa kpi.
en: The Lord destroyed everything that breathed. Nothing was left alive except Noah and the others in the boat.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni nam binshɛŋa galisiya pam. A yɛm puuni ka a nam di zaa. A binnɛma n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: LORD, you have done so many things! You made them all so wisely! The earth is full of your creations!.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka Izraɛlnim gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka di leei alikauli din kul ni beni sahakam shihirili.
en: The Israelites must remember the Sabbath and make it a special day. They must continue to do this forever. It is an agreement between them and me that will continue forever.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la nira n-nyɛ ma: N nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun be mɔɣu ni m-mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma soli ka di tuhi. .
en: John answered in the words of the prophet Isaiah, I am only someone shouting in the desert, Get the road ready for the Lord! .

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa bɔhi ba, O birigila yi gba?.
en: The Pharisees replied, Have you too been deceived?.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa chaŋ Tɛbiz ti teei gil li ŋ-ŋme n-deei li.
en: Then Abimelech and his men went to the city of Thebez and captured that city.

dag: ti zaŋ anzinfa mini salima maa m-mali nam zuɣupiligu n-zaŋ li pili Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: Make a crown out of the silver and gold they have given, and put it on the head of the High Priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.

dag: Niŋmiya suɣilo biɛla ka n wuhi ya, dama n na malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n zani Naawuni zaani yɛli.
en: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.

dag: Ka Hanna daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, Naawuni ti ma suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka n nya kpiɔŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani. N larila n dimnima, dama m mali suhupiɛlli n nasara dibu puuni.
en: Hannah said, My heart is happy in the Lord . I feel very strong in my God. I laugh at my enemies. I am very happy in my victory.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn tooni tin shɛli din yuli booni Jɛriko, ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ka be Rubin zuliya tiŋgban ni la tinsi din yuya daa booni Bɛza ka di be tiŋgban pasi ni la mini Jaaza ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them.

dag: Yisa min o tuumba maa ni daa ti lan laɣim ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti Duuma, a ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim nam lan kpe bɛ nuu ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: While the apostles were still with Jesus, they asked him, Lord, are you now going to give Israel its own king again.

dag: Ka pirinsi maa daa lab ti yɛli sariakaritib maa Pool ni yɛli shɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba bɛ ni daa wum ni Pool mini Silas nyɛla Rom tiŋbihi maa zuɣu;.
en: The soldiers told the officials what Paul said. When they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were afraid.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ bɛ ni daa bahi dab shɛba, ka bɛ nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba la leei daba yaha.
en: but later they changed their minds, took them back, and forced them to become slaves again.

dag: Ŋun yɛn zani n nyaaŋa mirina. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi n taali ni nyɛ shɛli? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun fiɣisiri ma maa? O chɛ ka m min o chaŋ ʒiishee, ka ti gbɛri ti kpa taba.
en: God is with me, and he is the one who shows that I am innocent. So no one can say I am guilty. If anyone wants to try to prove me wrong, they should come here, and we will have a trial.

dag: A ni zaŋ o bidibisi maa gba na ti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba.
en: Then bring his sons and dress them in tunics.

dag: faashee m bo biɛhigu shee ti Yawɛ; biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ dini.
en: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling place for the strong one of Jacob.

dag: Mbusim yi tahi kum libigirili na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali la nya wahala, o maani ba la ansarisi.
en: When an innocent person suddenly dies, God laughs.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Jɛfita, Kamina ti leei ti zuɣulana n-zaŋ ti chaŋ ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima.
en: They said to him, Come be our commander so we can fight against the Ammonites.

dag: So yi kabi o kpee kɔbili, bɛn kabim o dini labisi, ka ŋun fɔɣ o kpee nini bɛn fɔɣimi o dini labisi, ka ŋun ŋme n-kabi o kpee nyini bɛn ŋmɛm kab o dini labisi. O ni ti o kpee maa dalinli shɛm, di simdi ka bɛ niŋ o gba lala.
en: broken bone for broken bone, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. The same injury the person inflicted on the other will be inflicted on them.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛl niriba bɛn zaa daa laɣim o sani maa daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni. Bɛ daa kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi mali sara hal ka so daa naan ku tooi lan kali ba bee m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm yaha.
en: Then King Solomon and all the Israelites met in front of the Box of the Agreement to offer sheep and bulls as sacrifices. There were so many offerings that no one could count them.

dag: Yi ni sab gbaŋ shɛli ti ma la, bɛ lɛbigi li karim wuhi ma.
en: The letter which you sent has been translated and read to me.

dag: N yi daa niŋ kpibiga zaɣ biɛɣu, n ni mali nyaanzaaniba dunɔdali gbini zuɣu.
en: I never threatened an orphan, even when I knew I had support in court.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina yi tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka biɛhiŋ kani, yi daalahichi maa ku chɛn ya.
en: But if you do not keep your promise, I warn you that you will be sinning against the Lord . Make no mistake about it; you will be punished for your sin.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni o pin shɛli yɛla ninsal maŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa ni ku tooi kahigi wuhi ŋɔ zuɣu!.
en: Let us thank God for his priceless gift!.

dag: Ka Haman daa kpɛna, ka naa ti bɔh o, Ninvuɣ so m-beni ka m bɔri ni n duh o, a lee tɛhiya ni bɔ ka n ni niŋ ti dilana? Ka Haman daa yɛl o suhu ni, Ŋuni ka naa lee lan yɛn bɔri ni o duhi pam ka pa ni mani.
en: So Haman came in, and the king said to him, There is someone I wish very much to honor. What should I do for this man? Haman thought to himself, Now who could the king want to honor so much? Me, of course.

dag: Bɛ daa kpɛnkpɛla sida dari din be duu maa puuni m-malimal li, ka ŋme yɔɣa mini tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi m-pampa di zuɣu, sida dapaɣa maa noli ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi pa di puuni zaa hal ka kuɣ yini gba ti bi lan nyiya.
en: The cedar panels were decorated with carvings of gourds and flowers; the whole interior was covered with cedar, so that the stones of the walls could not be seen.

dag: mani yi Duuma ni chɛ ka Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Judanima. Bɛ ni ti kana kaman Yufretiiz Mɔɣili kom din galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam m-pali hal ti puuri bahiri la.
en: I, the Lord, will bring the emperor of Assyria and all his forces to attack Judah. They will advance like the flood waters of the Euphrates River, overflowing all its banks.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa nyɛla nachimbil so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka Sulemaana daa kpahim nya o ni nyɛ tumtumdi biiŋa maa, ka zaŋ o leei Yisifu zuliya niriba tuun kpɛma zaa zuɣulana.
en: Now Jeroboam was a strong and honorable man. Solomon saw how well this youth did his work. So he appointed him over all the work gang of Josephs house.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti kpe yili maa ni, ka Leeban daa paai laakumnim maa ʒiya, ka niŋ taɣitaɣi mini mɔri ti o ni o ti laakumnim maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Leeban daa tooi kom na ti ti o mini bɛn daa be o sani ni bɛ paɣi bɛ naba.
en: So Abrahams servant went into the house. Laban unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then he gave Abrahams servant water so that he and the men with him could wash their feet.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia min o malaikanim yi ti labina o Ba Naawuni jilima ni, o ni ti ti sokam bɛ tuma laara.
en: For the Human One is about to come with the majesty of his Father with his angels. And then he will repay each one for what that person has done.

dag: Ka o yidan maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a chaŋ o sani zuŋɔ? Zuŋɔ pala gol palli dabisili bee Vuhim Dabisili. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Di bi galim.
en: Why do you need to see him today? her husband asked. It's not the Sabbath or time for the New Moon Festival. That's all right, she answered.

dag: Nir yi gbilisi tibili wum saɣisigu viɛnyɛliŋga, bɛ ni kal o pahi yɛnnim ni.
en: The ear that listens to life-giving correction dwells among the wise.

dag: Yawɛ, n guhirila saha shɛli a ni yɛn tiligi ma.
en: Our Lord , I am waiting for you to save us.

dag: ka ku yɛl o mi ni o malim shili n-zaŋ a bindirigu na ti zal a, ka a di ka nyu pɔi ka o mi naanyi chaŋ ti ʒini di ka nyu?.
en: Of course not! Instead, you say to him, Get my supper ready, then put on your apron and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may have your meal.

dag: bɛ ni ti mali bihim pam ka o ŋubiri waagasi; dama ŋunkam ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni ti diri waagasi mini shiri.
en: But there will be enough milk for them to eat milk curds. In fact, everyone left in the country will eat milk curds and honey.

dag: A ni kpab li kaman biŋŋmaa la, ka di ni taɣi m-be kaman situra la; amaa nyin kul ku taɣi, ka a mi kul ku kurigi.
en: You will fold them up like a coat, and they will be changed like clothes. But you are always the same, and your life never ends.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, so ti ku lan be nimaani, amaa di ni ti kpalimla dabari. Ŋunkam ti gari Babilɔn di ni gar o, ka niŋ o alahiziba di ni wurim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Because of the LORDs anger, no one will live there; she will be reduced to total ruin. All who pass by Babylon will be shocked; they will gasp at all her injuries.

dag: To, m mabihi, n chɛbisiri ya mi ŋɔ. Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be dɛde! Doliya n saɣisigu; maliya naŋgban yini; maliya suhudoo ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yurilimlana mini suhudoolana ŋɔ be yi sani.
en: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yooi dunoli ni o yina chaŋ, ka nya ka o mam maa dola yil maa samban dunol ni, ka o nuhi teei tiri dunoli polo.
en: When her husband got up in the morning, he opened the doors of the house and went outside to set out on his journey. And there was his secondary wife, lying at the entrance of the house, with her hands clutching the doorframe.

dag: Dama dabisi shɛŋa din daa daŋ di saha maa tooni puuni, so daa naan ku tooi bu ninsal paa bee n-zaŋ biŋkɔbigu tum tuun shɛli; ka so daa yi yɛn yi bee n-yɛn lab kpe na, bɛ mini bɛ dimnim kul varimi. Mani n-daa tuɣindi ba maa.
en: Before that time no one could afford to hire either men or animals, and no one was safe from enemies. I turned people against one another.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni nya bindirigu pam n-di n-tiɣi; ka paɣi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum ya tuun kara maa. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: You will eat abundantly and be satisfied, and you will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has done wonders for you; and my people will never again be put to shame.

dag: Bɛ daa liri bɛn mali biŋkɔbiri n-taɣi piɛri mini buhi ni laakuma chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: They also attacked the camps of some shepherds, capturing large numbers of sheep and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ nyo li buɣim; bɛ ŋma li luhi. Lihim ba suhuyiɣisili lihigu ka bɛ kpi.
en: Our enemies have set it on fire and cut it down; look at them in anger and destroy them!.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lo ti alikauli shɛl la zuɣu, tinim kul guhirila zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ pala, ka wuntitali be di ni la.
en: But God made a promise to us. And we are waiting for what he promised—a new sky and a new earth. That will be the place where goodness lives.

dag: Imɛr daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni pihinunaayi.
en: of Immer .

dag: Amaa ŋunkam je o mabia, o bela zibisim ni ka kul chanila zibisim maa puuni ka ʒi o ni kpari shɛli polo, dama zibisim maa zom o nina.
en: But whoever hates their brother or sister is in darkness. They live in darkness. They dont know where they are going, because the darkness has made them blind.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti mali di lahi mini di parante shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali tuɣindi tulaale zim, ka mali duɣuri ni kuruwa shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mal li.
en: Make its plates, dishes, jars, and bowls for pouring drink offerings. Make them of pure gold.

dag: Ana bihi n-daa nyɛ: Dishɔn mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Ana maa bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Anah's children were Dishon and Oholibamah.

dag: Dama yi yi niŋdi ba alaka ka bɛ fabili niŋ ma, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni gbilisi tibili wum bɛ fabila maa.
en: If you do anything wrong to these widows or orphans, I will know it. I will hear about their suffering.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka n ni ti darigi di buɣa la tibili, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya dansi ni ti do di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ŋ-ŋuhira.
en: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, N ku tooi niŋ shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; n ni wum shɛm, dina ka m mali kariti saria, ka n sariakaribo maa mi nyɛla din tuhi, dama m bi bɔri mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka m bɔra.
en: I can do nothing alone. I judge only the way I am told. And my judgment is right, because I am not trying to please myself. I want only to please the one who sent me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi yaha, ka do so daa zɔna ti damd o tooni m-bɔh o, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: As Jesus was walking down a road, a man ran up to him. He knelt down, and asked, Good teacher, what can I do to have eternal life.

dag: Aduna daŋ niriba, di ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tarili n-daŋ tooni la zuɣu. Aduna daa nyɛla Kɔhat daŋ nira, ka Kɔhat mi nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nira.
en: The cities belonged to the descendants of Aaron, one of the Kohathite clans of the Levites, because the lot had fallen to them first.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaɣis o ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: So the Lord was angry with his people; he was disgusted with them.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ siɣili saha, saha shɛli nanim ni daa chani tɔb la, ka Jɔab daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti saɣim Ammɔnim tiŋgbɔŋ, ka daa chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm. Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ ti lu Raba zuɣu n-wurim li.
en: The next spring, the time when kings go to war, Joab marched out in command of the Israelite army and destroyed towns all over the country of Ammon. He attacked the capital city of Rabbah and left it in ruins. But David stayed in Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ yihim niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb mini mari ni yiri shɛb niŋgbuna ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi kpima, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ leei bɛn bi be nyam bɛ sunsuuni.
en: to say to the people of Israel, Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.

dag: Ka a mi o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛŋa Ɛfɛsus la gba yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti Duuma chɛ ka o ti nya nambɔzɔbo o sani ŋun ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: May the Lord grant him his mercy on that Day! And you know very well how much he did for me in Ephesus.

dag: Ka Iso yɛli, Buyi ka o ŋari ma maa. O yuli Yaakubu maa shiri ŋman o. O daa fa n kpamdi, ka lan fa n daalibarika. Di saha ka o daa bɔh o ba, Ka daɣila a bi chɛ alibarika shɛli zali ma.
en: Esau said, This is the second time that he has cheated me. No wonder his name is Jacob. He took my rights as the first-born son, and now he has taken away my blessing. Haven't you saved a blessing for me.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she zabba ka niŋ bimbomaboma niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she bantabiga ka she shɛlɔrigu n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu.
en: Make Aaron's robe and turban of fine linen and decorate his sash with fancy needlework.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya Adɔnibɛzɛk Bɛzɛk maa n-chɛ ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Keenannim mini Pɛrizinim maa.
en: In the city of Bezek, they found the ruler of Bezek and fought him, and they defeated the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Yaakubu zuliya? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Izraɛl zuliya maa pirigibu bunahi puuni yim? Chɛ ka n kpila wuntizɔra kum, ka chɛ ka m bahigu ti be kaman o bahigu.
en: They are living alone in peace. And though they are many, they don't bother the other nations. I hope to obey God for as long as I live and to die in such peace.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ka bɔhi ba, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi ma?.
en: Jesus knew their evil thoughts and said, Why are you trying to test me? You show-offs!.

dag: Samuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Joɛl ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Abija ŋun daa pa o zuɣu.
en: Samuel had two sons: Joel, the older, and Abijah, the younger.

dag: di yi ti wum kom ʒiɛɣu, di ni puhi n-niŋ wula kaman ti polli la.
en: with water it will sprout like a young plant.

dag: Ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga daa yi salo maa ni na nti wa waa, ka di niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd mini bɛn daa ʒi o sani maa zaa nyaɣisim pam. Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa, Yɛlim ma a suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam zaa, ka n ti a li.
en: The daughter of Herodias came in and danced, and pleased Herod and his guests. So the king said to the girl, What would you like to have? I will give you anything you want.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba Yaakubu chaŋ Firawuna sani, ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni.
en: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob and introduced him to the king. Jacob gave the king his blessing.

dag: Ka binshɛb bɛn mali kpiŋkpama ka be nyam, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn zaŋ yi ni lo nia shɛŋa sɔɣi Yawɛ, ka tumdi yi tuma zibisim ni ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi yɛra, So bi nyari ti, So mi bi mi ti.
en: Doom to those who hide their plan deep, away from the LORD, whose deeds are in the dark, who say, Who sees us? Who knows us.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi tiri so yiko ka o tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka so mi tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa Shi yino maa yiko ni.
en: A word of wisdom is given by the Spirit to one person, a word of knowledge to another according to the same Spirit.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ako bee bɛn be Sidɔn bee bɛn be Ahilab bee bɛn be Akizib bee bɛn be Hɛliba bee bɛn be Afik bee bɛn be Rɛhɔb.
en: The people of Asher did not force the other people to leave the cities of Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Aczib, Helbah, Aphek, and Rehob.

dag: Wula ka bɛ zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi nya soli ka nyɛ Naawuni ni sa gariche gili so?.
en: Why do I go on living when God has me surrounded, and I can't see the road?.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla n-yɛli so, dindina ti yi ti bi niŋ a ni chɛ ka ti po ni ti niŋ shɛli maa, ti ku mali taali zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: But if you reveal our mission, we wont be responsible for this pledge you made us swear.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi, dabisi shɛli dali yi ni sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. Kpahimmiya nya din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: So take it to heart from this day forward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month. Take it to heart from the day when the foundation for the LORDs temple was laid.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ku lɔrig o nahu bee o buŋa n-taɣ o chaŋ kuliga ka o ti nyu kom Vuhim Dabisili dali?.
en: The Lord replied, Hypocrites! Dont each of you on the Sabbath untie your ox or donkey from its stall and lead it out to get a drink?.

dag: Ka Asa daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Asa did what the Lord said is right, as his ancestor David did.

dag: Dindali maa Siria naa maa ʒi tibisa ti ku lan tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu; n ni ti kab o naɣikɔra dapuhi din be yi nyiŋgoya ni la.
en: When that time comes, I will free you from the power of Assyria, and their yoke will no longer be a burden on your shoulders.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindira bɛ sani di, ka lan zaŋ liɣiri da kom bɛ sani nyu.
en: You must pay the people of Esau for any food you eat or water you drink there.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka nuchee ŋɔ puhi yina ti sab sabbu ŋɔ.
en: Thats why this hand was sent from God and why this message was written down.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisifu dan maa paɣ ti lihir o kɔre lihigu, ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: Some time later, his masters wife became attracted to Joseph and said, Sleep with me.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n yɛligu yɛli ba, bɛ yi ni wum li bee bɛ yi ni zaɣisi li wumbu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.

dag: Tiŋgbani daa bɔɣiya m-mum Datan, ka pi Abiram min o nyaandoliba.
en: Then the earth opened up and swallowed Dathan and buried Abiram and his family;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa chaŋ ni o ti niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Gaad yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So David went up, following the instructions Gad had delivered in the LORDs name.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee la. Dina n-daa chɛ ka niriba maa daa na bi zaŋ bɛ suhuri zaa labisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni jɛmbu polo.
en: but the pagan places of worship were not destroyed. The people still did not turn wholeheartedly to the worship of the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka bɛn daa lab kulina maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: The people who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month of the following year.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ daa naan ku chɛ li malibu? Ka niriba bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni lala yi daa shiri yi bɛ daalahichi ni, bɛ suhuri daa naan ku lan chihiri alahichi zuɣu.
en: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.

dag: Bɛ fa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni nɛma, ka bɛ kpalim gbihirimi; ka tɔbbi so ku lan tooi zaŋ o nuu ku buchi shɛli.
en: Their brave soldiers have been stripped of all they had and now are sleeping the sleep of death; all their strength and skill was useless.

dag: N zaŋdi n yɛlimuɣisira n-yɛr o asiba mini wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, ka ŋuhiri niŋd o, ka o mi ni wum n kuhigu maa.
en: At evening, morning, and midday I complain and moan so that God will hear my voice.

dag: O malaikanim zaa, paɣimiy o! O tɔbbihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, all you angels! Praise him, all his army !.

dag: mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋ la.
en: and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ŋmanila gumdi, ka bɛ tuma be kaman chɛbili la. Buɣim ni di bɛ mini bɛ tuma zaa, ka so ku kpihi li.
en: Powerful people will be like small, dry pieces of wood, and what they did will be like the sparks that start a fire. These people and their works will both burn up, and no one will be able to put out that fire.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa ni daa baŋ ni binshɛɣukam niŋya naai maa ka o daa yɛli, Kɔnyuri mali ma. O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: After this, knowing that everything was already completed, in order to fulfill the scripture, Jesus said, I am thirsty.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn da ba ku ba mi bi nya tibidarigibo; ka bɛn kɔhi bɛ nimdi mi yɛli, Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ti leei bundaannima. Hal piɛri maa maŋmaŋ piɛguliba maa daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Their owners kill them and go unpunished. They sell the meat and say, Praise the Lord ! We are rich! Even their own shepherds have no pity on them. .

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti sɔ yi dini.
en: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you.

dag: Dunia ni ti laani kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam kuli, ka viini kaman suɣili la. Di tuumbiɛri tibisim nti yɛn marigi li ka di lu, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: The earth itself will stagger like a drunk, sway like a hut in a storm. The world is weighed down by its sins; it will collapse and never rise again.

dag: Di saha ti Duuma ni ti bu wanzam ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa paa ka o yi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli n-kana ti pini yi zuɣuri mini yi teensi ni yi niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri.
en: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.

dag: Ka Filistia nanim anu maa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ lab kul Ɛkurɔn dindali maa.
en: When the five rulers of the Philistines saw what had happened, they went back to Ekron that same day.

dag: Nyama, n ni pii n dab so m-bɔŋɔ; n ni yuri so ni n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala. N ni zaŋ n Shia niŋ o ni, ka o zaŋ yɛlimaŋli kari saria ti zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: Here is my chosen servant! I love him, and he pleases me. I will give him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla peentɔriba, ka daa naan tooi zaŋ bɛ nudiriti bee bɛ nuzahi n-to piɛma bee n-labi kuɣilɔna. Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ Sool dɔɣiriba.
en: They could shoot arrows from their bows with either their right or left hand. They could also throw stones from their slings with either their right or left hand. They were Sauls relatives from the tribe of Benjamin. They were.

dag: Nyini n-zali zoya a kpiɔŋ puuni. A mali yiko pam.
en: You establish the mountains by your strength; you are dressed in raw power.

dag: Nyin Naawuni zuɣu ka ti kul nyuri bara, ka ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N ni kpihim ninsal shɛba n ni daa nam niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri mini biŋgbamda ni noonsi birili, dama di niŋ ma yoli pam n ni daa nam ba maa zuɣu.
en: So the Lord said, I will destroy all the people I created on the earth. I will destroy every person and every animal and everything that crawls on the earth. And I will destroy all the birds in the air, because I am sorry that I have made them.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔrinim bɛn daa be zoya ni tiŋ maa ni daa ti kar doli ya kaman shihi la nti ŋmɛri ya luhira Ɛdom hal ti paai Hɔrima.
en: The Amorites who lived there came out like a swarm of bees and chased you all the way from Seir to Hormah.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Sokam yɛlima, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Bless the LORD, the God of Israel, from forever ago to forever from now! And let all the people say, Amen! Praise the LORD!.

dag: dilan ŋun baŋmi ni ŋunkam ŋmaligi alahichilana o biriginsim sol ni n-labisi zali yɛlimaŋli sol ni ni tiligi alahichilan maa kum ni, ka chɛ ka alahichi pam nya chɛ m-paŋ.
en: remember this: Anyone who brings a sinner back from the wrong way will save that person from eternal death and cause many sins to be forgiven.

dag: Bɛ kul tuhirila bɛ karimbaan yɛtɔɣa bahira, tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul nyurila bara.
en: How much longer will those criminals brag about the evil they did?.

dag: amaa m mi ni hal a yi suhi shɛlikam Naawuni sani pumpɔŋɔ, o ni ti a li.
en: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask him for.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti paai piɛri biɛhigu shee ka tampiŋ voli daa be nimaani so naŋgbanyee; ka Sool daa kpe di puuni ni o ti damdi yɔɣu ni ka Dauda min o niriba gba daa be voli maa puuni ha.
en: He came to the sheep pens beside the road where there was a cave. Saul went into the cave to use the restroom. Meanwhile, David and his soldiers were sitting in the very back of the cave.

dag: O daa va salima mini anzinfa n-tabili Naawuni jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa din daa beni ka Obɛdɛdom bihi gul li la zaa, ka va nayili daazichi zaa, ka gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-lab kuli Samaria.
en: He carried away the gold, the silver, and all the valuable furnishings from God's temple where the descendants of Obed-Edom stood guard. He robbed the king's treasury, took hostages, then returned to Samaria.

dag: Naa Bɛlishaaza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka man Daniɛl daa nya ʒii din pah ayi.
en: In the third year of King Belshazzars rule, a vision came to me, Daniel, some time after the earlier vision I had.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma dabisili kam.
en: Jesus said to everyone, All who want to come after me must say no to themselves, take up their cross daily, and follow me.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, m ba Sool nuu ku shih a. Nyini nti yɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka m mi nyɛ wulana. M ba Sool gba mi lala.
en: saying to him, Don't be afraid. My father Saul won't be able to harm you. He knows very well that you are the one who will be the king of Israel and that I will be next in rank to you.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya dawule paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya dawule pampam paɣ o.
en: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with crashing cymbals!.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul wuhi shihira pam niriba maa sani maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: He had worked a lot of miracles among the people, but they were still not willing to have faith in him.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni ha la, bɛ ʒilɛli maa ni ti nya zaa zani n sani, ka n ti darigi bɛn zaa daa nahindi ba la tibili.
en: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.

dag: Dama nyama, n ni zali zaligu, ka dam Izraɛlnim bɛn be zuliya kam tinsi ni. M mi yɛn niŋ ba mi kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la, hal ka kabiɛl yini gba ku lu tiŋa.
en: I will give the command and shake the people of Israel like grain in a sieve. I will shake them among the nations to remove all who are worthless.

dag: ka Adaya nyɛ Ɛtan bia, ka Ɛtan nyɛ Zimma bia, ka Zimma nyɛ Shimɛi bia.
en: Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei.

dag: Niriba pam bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima ni bɛn yɔhindi niriba beni, di bahi bamdi yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn na kul doli Yɛhudianim adiini soli kaya la.
en: In fact, there are many who are rebellious people, loudmouths, and deceivers, especially some of those who are Jewish believers.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi dɔɣi nabia ka o nyɛla faralana, amaa o ni tooi yi sarika ni na ti di nam.
en: He emerged from prison to become king, even though during his rule a poor child is born.

dag: Dama hal a min a mabihi bɛn be dundɔn yin ni nyɛla bɛn lo a zaɣ biɛɣu. Bɛ kul yimi zani a zuɣu; hal bɛ yi kul paɣir a gba nyin di niŋ ba yɛda.
en: These men are your own brothers. Members of your own family are making plans against you. People from your own family are shouting at you. Dont trust them, even when they speak to you like friends.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundi na, ka piligi bur o tab bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka diri ka nyuri dam kuuna.
en: But what will happen if that servant is evil and thinks his master will not come back soon? He will begin to beat the other servants, men and women. He will eat and drink until he has had too much.

dag: Binnyura kɔre yi ti mali ba, n ni zaŋ bɛ binnyura zali ba ka bɛ nyu li hal ti buɣi, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka bɛ gbihi, ka ku lan neei sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They are ready to devour, so Ill prepare the feast and mix the drinks! But after their noisy drunkenness, they will fall fast asleep. They will sleep forever, never to get up, declares the LORD.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, ka o garigi ma. N daa bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee din zilim pam la ka kuhi bol a, ka a wum n kuhigu maa.
en: I called out to the LORD in my distress, and he answered me. From the belly of the underworld I cried out for help; you have heard my voice.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yinim bɛn mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi ŋɔ, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ:.
en: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand.

dag: Ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa tim na ti bol a ka a bi kana? A bi tɛhi ni n ni tooi ti a pin titali.
en: Balak asked, Why didn't you come when I invited you the first time? Did you think I wasn't going to pay you.

dag: Hiram daa lan me duɣuri, ka mali soobuya mini taha pahi. Lala ka Hiram daa niŋ tum Naa Sulemaana ni daa puh o Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuun shɛŋa maa zaa naai.
en: Huram also made the pots, shovels, and basins. So he finished his work for King Solomon on Gods Temple:.

dag: N lee yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la ninsal suhu yubu puuni bee lala ka Naawuni zaligu puuni gba yɛli?.
en: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya, zomiya tiligi, yimiya Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni. Piɛbimiya kikaa Tɛkɔa, ka ŋmɛnya tɔbuchiriga Bɛtihakɛrɛm. Dama zaɣ biɛɣu mini saɣiŋgu pam ni yi nuzaa polo na.
en: People of Benjamin, run for safety! Escape from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa and build a signal fire in Beth Haccherem. Disaster and destruction are about to come from the north.

dag: Nyamiya, n timla n tumo ni o ti mali soli ti ma. Ka yi ni yuuni bɔri yi Duuma so maa ni ti ka o jɛmbu duu na libigi ya. Alikauli tumo ŋun nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa shiri kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord Almighty answers, I will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then the Lord you are looking for will suddenly come to his Temple. The messenger you long to see will come and proclaim my covenant.

dag: O mi yi ŋme n-vuɣ o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nyini, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nyini maa zuɣu.
en: If he knocks out a tooth, he is to free the slave as payment for the tooth.

dag: O lan bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi sara pahi di zuɣu asiba kam pari taba, ni kpam lita yini n-zaŋdi ŋmiriti zim viɛlli maa m-mali chi sara ti Yawɛ. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din yɛn ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Along with it, two kilograms of fine flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. This law will never change—.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Hiburu paɣiba bɛn bi be kaman Ijipti paɣiba ni be shɛm, bɛ mali yaa pam. Paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda ti yɛn paai ka bɛ pun dɔɣi.
en: The two midwives said to Pharaoh, Because Hebrew women arent like Egyptian women. Theyre much stronger and give birth before any midwives can get to them.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa chaŋ ti neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti; tiligim ti.
en: They came and woke him, saying, Lord, rescue us! Were going to drown.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa ʒin o ba nam ʒiishee n-nya yaa naai, o daa zaŋla takɔbi ku o tizɔbihi maa zaa, ka daa lan ku Izraɛl kpambal shɛb gba.
en: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.

dag: zaŋ tabili bɛn tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba ni bɛn zaŋdi muɣisigu gbahiri niriba ni ʒiŋmariba ni bɛn zaa niŋdi din chihiri wuhibu maŋa la zuɣu.
en: They are people who are sexually unfaithful, and people who have intercourse with the same sex. They are kidnappers, liars, individuals who give false testimonies in court, and those who do anything else that is opposed to sound teaching.

dag: Kpiɔŋlana, lom a takɔbi tabil a gbalipini a jilima min a nam dariza ni.
en: Put on your sword, mighty warrior, so impressive in your splendid uniform.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Yes, you are the voice of the people. When you die, wisdom will die with you.

dag: Tiŋbihi mini saamba zaa zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini; dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: There is but one law on this matter for you, immigrant or citizen alike, because I am the LORD your God.

dag: N Duuma, zom m bidibiga ŋɔ nambɔɣu! O nyɛla kpilinkpihilana, ka di nahind o pam; di kul luhir o la waawaayili, ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni.
en: The man said, Lord, be kind to my son. He suffers so much from the seizures he has. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Aai, di pa shɛli yi yi yɛn sib li, yi ni ti sib alikama maa gba pahi.
en: No! he answered. You might also pull up the wheat.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: When he came, the woman said, Are you Joab? Yes, I am, he answered. She said, Please, listen to what I have to say. All right, he said. I'll listen.

dag: Ka lala ni chɛ ka ti lir o o ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-lu o zuɣu kaman maligim ni luri tiŋgbani zuɣu shɛm la, ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa so ku tiligi.
en: and we will all go to fight David wherever he is. We will fall on him just as dew falls and covers the ground. He and all his soldiers will die!.

dag: ka zaŋ niriba maa zaa labina ti ti a kaman amiliya n-kul o yidan yili la. Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko ka a bɔr ni a ku ka chɛ bɛnkam kpalim zaa ka bɛ suhu doya.
en: and then bring back all his men to you, like a bride returning to her husband. You want to kill only one man; the rest of the people will be safe.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti mali Babilɔn naa ansarisi yɛli, Na putɔɣulan la luya ka ku lan tooi nahim so yaha!.
en: At that time you will begin to sing this song about the king of Babylon: The king was cruel when he ruled us, but now his rule is finished.

dag: ni Iddo ni Ginnɛtɔi ni Abija.
en: Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la daa puhi gari, ka ti mi kpe ŋariŋ Filipai n-zaŋ daba anu chaŋ ti paai ba Troas; ka ti daa niŋ daba ayopɔin nimaani.
en: We sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread and met them five days later in Troas, where we stayed for a week.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ niriba maa sara maligu maa na nti yihi niriba alahichi sanyoo sara shɛli din daa nyɛ bua la n-kɔrig o zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara kaman tuuli alahichi sanyoo sara maligu la.
en: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.

dag: Amaa ka Naaman daa je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi chani ka yɛra, Man di mi ni o yɛn yimina nti zani n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa, ka zaŋ o nuu gahigahi kpe, ka chɛ ka n kɔŋ maa naai.
en: But Naaman stormed off, grumbling, Why couldn't he come out and talk to me? I thought for sure he would stand in front of me and pray to the Lord his God, then wave his hand over my skin and cure me.

dag: Ka bɛn daa be sansani maa ni mini bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni ni niriba maa zaa suhuri dii fuŋ, ka tɔbbihi zaŋ tabili ŋmɛnditoya zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira ka tiŋgbani daa dam, ka bɛ yɛma ŋma pam.
en: All the Philistines in the countryside were terrified; the raiders and the soldiers in the camp trembled with fear; the earth shook, and there was great panic.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi kanna daa ʒirila pina din nyɛ anzinfa nɛma bee salima nɛma bee kpariti bee bidibbina bee tulaale zim bee yuri bee buntaansi na yuuni kam.
en: Year after year they came with tribute: objects of silver and gold, clothing, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.

dag: Tɛkɔa paɣ maa ni daa ti paai naa tooni, o daa lumi gbani zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naa, fam ma bahi.
en: The woman from Tekoa went to David. She bowed very low and said, Your Majesty, please help me.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu daa zaŋ bɛ baŋsim n-zaŋ buhi kɔbiri mi gali.
en: And all the women who were skilled and wanted to help made cloth from the goat hair.

dag: N ni chani ni yolisim, dama m bo n-nya a zaligunima.
en: I will live in perfect freedom, because I try to obey your teachings.

dag: Nyama, Sulemaana daamaŋka m-bala ka tɔbbihi pihiyɔbu bɛn mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gil li.
en: Picture Solomons bed— sixty heroic men round about it, all from the heroes of Israel.

dag: Ka di wula daa teei hal ti paai teeku ni, ka di nyaɣa teei hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: Its branches spread to the Mediterranean Sea, its shoots to the Euphrates River.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔb so ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni nti yo alahichi samli luɣ kasi shee, di bi simdi ka so ŋubi di nimdi maa. Di simdi ni yi nyo li la buɣim.
en: But if any of the blood is brought into the Tent and used in the ritual to take away sin, the animal must not be eaten; it must be burned.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi yɛli, Alaafee. N dana n-tim ma na ni nti yɛl a ni nachimbih ayi bɛn nyɛ anabinima n-yi Ifriim zoya tiŋ ni kana; ni o suhir a ni a ti ba anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra na.
en: Gehazi said, Yes, everything is all right. My master has sent me. He said, Look, two young men came to me from the group of prophets in the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them pounds of silver and two changes of clothes.

dag: N Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni bi wum o noli zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla bɛn dari gindi yɔɣu zuliyanim sunsuuni.
en: Those people will not listen to my God, so he will refuse to listen to them. And they will wander among the nations without a home.

dag: Di daa ʒiɛla Ijipti tɔbbihi mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi sunsuuni. Sagbani maa daa nyɛla zibisim Ijiptinim polo, ka nyɛ neesim Izraɛlnim polo yuŋ zaa ka bɛ so daa bi tooi mir o kpee yuŋ maa zaa.
en: between the Egyptians and the Israelites. The cloud made it dark for the Egyptians, but gave light to the people of Israel, and so the armies could not come near each other all night.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya yɛlli ŋɔ: Di simdi ni paɣ suhuri Naawuni ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu?.
en: Judge for yourselves whether it is proper for a woman to pray to God in public worship with nothing on her head.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini ninvuɣ kubo ni zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ʒiri shɛhiradibo ni nyaanzubo.
en: Out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adultery, sexual sins, thefts, false testimonies, and insults.

dag: N ni wurim kuŋkuna mini zoya, ka chɛ ka tihi mini mɔri din be di zuɣu zaa kuui. N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa kuui kpakpa, ka chɛ ka kɔpurima nyuui.
en: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma zaa yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni zali shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni yɛn ʒi shɛlikam mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam polo; ka a wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn su binshɛlikam zaa ʒibu fukumsi.
en: Aaron and his sons will watch all the work that is done. Everything the Gershonites carry and the other work they do will be watched by Aaron and his sons. You must tell them what they are responsible for carrying.

dag: Miriya ka yi taɣi Naawuni Shia Kasi zali;.
en: Don't turn away God's Spirit.

dag: Famiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba bahi; tiligimiya ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: Rescue them from the power of evil people.

dag: N daa zaŋ wuntitali niŋ mmaŋa, ka di pili ma. N yɛlimaŋli tuma daa ŋmanila zabba mini baŋtabiga.
en: Right living was my clothing. Fairness was my robe and turban.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka yi kanna ti zaani n tooni du shɛli din nyɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛra, Ti tiligiya. Ka lan yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi din chihirinim ŋɔ yaha.
en: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?.

dag: A chɛ ka nintam leei bɛ bindirigu, ka zaŋ nintam leei binnyurigu ti ba ka bɛ nyu pam.
en: Youve fed them bread made of tears; youve given them tears to drink three times over!.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Anabi Musa ni daa ti bi doo, o daa zaɣisiya ni o pala Firawuna bipuɣiŋga bia.
en: By faith Moses refused to be called the son of Pharaohs daughter when he was grown up.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Yaakubu, N dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha m-bɔŋɔ; zaŋm o dɔni ka o dɔɣi bihi ti ma, ka n zaŋ ba ʒili n naba zuɣu.
en: She said, Here is my slave Bilhah; sleep with her, so that she can have a child for me. In this way I can become a mother through her.

dag: O daɣiri maa daa yila palo, ka o baɣa daa ka yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn paag o ni. O lubu maa daa mali alahiziba, ka so daa kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. Yawɛ, lihimi n ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, dama n dimnim di nasara.
en: Her uncleanness was easily seen, but she showed no concern for her fate. Her downfall was terrible; no one can comfort her. Her enemies have won, and she cries to the Lord for mercy.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni tum alahichi shɛŋa min o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu ka o yɛn chɛ Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: Jeroboam sinned and caused the Israelites to sin. Now the Lord will desert Israel.

dag: Bee ŋuni n-na mi n-dih o samli ka di nyɛ talahi ni o yo dilana?.
en: Or who has given him a gift and has been paid back by him? .

dag: Dama bɛ zaa pinila bɛ zuɣuri mini bɛ teensi, ka chihi bɛ bɔɣiri zaa chiha ka so buri.
en: All of them have shaved their heads and cut off their beards. They have all made gashes on their hands, and everyone is wearing sackcloth.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa, bilimiya. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: God said, I command the earth to produce all kinds of plants, including fruit trees and grain. And that's what happened.

dag: Hal zibisim pala zibisim a sani; yuŋ kul nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ ni la, dama zibisim bemi kaman neesim la a sani.
en: Even the darkness is not dark to you. The night is as bright as the day. Darkness and light are the same.

dag: Amaa m bi zaŋ Naawuni ni zali zaligu shɛli ŋɔ tumdi di tuma bee n sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya mi ni n deei shɛli yi sani, dama m paɣiya ni n kpi n-gari ni so niŋ ma shɛli din ni chɛ ka n kɔŋ n ni yɛn nyu bara shɛli zuɣu.
en: But I haven't made use of any of these rights, nor am I writing this now in order to claim such rights for myself. I would rather die first! Nobody is going to turn my rightful boast into empty words!.

dag: O ni saɣim Lɛbanɔn sida tiwɔɣila zaa mini Bashan oki tihi zaa.
en: against all the cedars of Lebanon, high and lofty; against all the oaks of Bashan.

dag: ni o guhiri hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ o dimnim leeg o napɔntamdigu.
en: There he now waits until God puts his enemies as a footstool under his feet.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ti duɣi bindir suma n-di ka nyu binnyuri nyaɣisa, ka niŋya shɛli ti bɛn bi duɣi la, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ dabisili kasi. Di chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, dama Yawɛ ni tiri suhupiɛlli shɛli n-nyɛ yi kpiɔŋ.
en: Nehemiah told the people, Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord , and he will make you happy and strong.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa daa zalila zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yiliyiiniba polo, ka sabi wuhi bɛ ni yɛn yiini yila maa shɛm dabisili kam.
en: There were royal regulations stating how the clans should take turns in leading the Temple music each day.

dag: Di saha ka n di zaŋ n zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun wuhi yɛlimaŋli so shɛli n ni yɛn doli kpuɣi ŋuna n dan maa dɔɣim bipuɣiŋga nti ti o bia maa.
en: I knelt down and worshiped the Lord . I praised the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who had led me straight to my master's relative, where I found his daughter for my master's son.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi be kaman o yab Dauda. O daa niŋ o ba Jɔash ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhu Naawuni, ka daa kpalim be nimaani yuŋ zaa suhiri Naawuni.
en: About that time Jesus went off to a mountain to pray, and he spent the whole night there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam maa ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛlin shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri o puu ni;.
en: Jesus told them another parable: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. A man takes a mustard seed and sows it in his field.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti nya kpiɔŋ, ka muɣisi Keenannim maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba, amaa ka lee bi kari ba.
en: When the Israelites became stronger, they forced the Canaanites to work for them, but still they did not drive them all out.

dag: Musa daa zali ti zaligu, ka di nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ni su shɛli.
en: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa yi Atɛnsi n-chaŋ Kɔrinti.
en: Later, Paul left Athens and went to the city of Corinth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa miligi Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee maa. Datan mini Abiram ni bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bisarinsi ni bɛ bibihi daa yimina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni.
en: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing at the entrance of their tents, with their wives and children.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni suhupiɛlli! Yilimiya yila ka o sanna!.
en: Worship the Lord with joy; come before him with happy songs!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi bela Babilɔn, ka bɛ gba zaŋ ya leei bɛ daba yoli. Ka bɛn sun ya maa nyuri bara ka diri dari, ka kul maani ma ansarisi sahakam, ka ʒiɛmdi n yuli dabisili kam.
en: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nanim mini tarimba zaa daa kul kpalim lihirila ŋuna ka yɛra, Yiko shɛli ti ni booni Naawuni yiko tital la be doo ŋɔ ni.
