en: Everyone, from the least to the greatest, gave him their undivided attention and referred to him as the power of God called Great.

dag: A ni tooi sɔŋ o yɛrigi sagbana ka di kpɛm kaman bɛ ni dooi diɣi la?.
en: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?.

dag: Yi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa nyɛla tampiligim ŋaha, ka yi ni zaŋ shɛli taɣi yimaŋ nyɛla yaɣiri.
en: Your proverbs are as useless as ashes; your arguments are as weak as clay.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubirila yimaŋmaŋ bidɔɣirisi, yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin shɛb Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tin ya la nimdi yi dimnim maa ni ti yɛn teei gili ya n-niŋdi ya alaka shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Yi mali so shɛŋa din ni doli zaɣisi Naawuni zaligunima, ka doli yimaŋmaŋ kaya!.
en: And Jesus continued, You have a clever way of rejecting God's law in order to uphold your own teaching.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyin daadam, yilimi kuyilli bahi Taai zuɣu.
en: Son of man, sing this sad song about Tyre.

dag: dama nir yi bi mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima, wula ka o ni tooi gbibi Naawuni cheechi?.
en: For if a man does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of the church of God?.

dag: Dama bɛ kul bɔr o mi kaman dɔbba ni bɔri pagɔrili shɛm la. Lala ka bɛ daa bɔri Ohola mini Oholiba bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri dɔbba pam maa.
en: They went back to these prostitutes again and again. They went back to Oholah and Oholibah, those immoral women.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba mabia ŋun nyɛ doo paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ma.
en: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba ayi shɛba o ni daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai Jɛriko la, Chamiya pagɔrili la yiŋa nti yih o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ na kaman yi ni daa pun po ni yi ni niŋ shɛm la.
en: Joshua then told the two men who had served as spies, Go into the prostitute's house, and bring her and her family out, as you promised her.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Aai, ti ni jɛm Yawɛ.
en: The people said to Joshua, No! We will serve the Lord .

dag: O ti bom yuun yini piɛbila ŋun ka daŋa m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ dabisili kam, o niŋmi li asiba kam.
en: Every day you will provide a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it. It will be for a burnt offering to the Lord . You will provide it every morning.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures say, No one can live only on food. .

dag: Naawuni n-daa zal o ni o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma ni daa be shɛm.
en: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛlnim Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ yɛliya: To, n ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi yinim bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɔhi ya biɛri.
en: Because of this, the Lord GOD All-Powerful, the Mighty One of Israel, says, Look, I will get relief from my enemies. You will not cause me any more trouble.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara. Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee.
en: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, I will go back to the home I left.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna din ka bukaata la zaŋ bɛ ʒiɛyimtali biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ a sani bahi.
en: Those deceived by worthless things lose their chance for mercy.

dag: Jɛhoyakin yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata ni biɛɣu pia. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Jehoiachin was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled only months and days from Jerusalem. Jehoiachin also disobeyed the Lord by doing evil.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara malibu dabisili.
en: Celebrate Passover in honor of me on the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.

dag: Ibram ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa; doli ma, ka tummi din tuhi.
en: When Abram was years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, I am El Shaddai. Walk with me and be trustworthy.

dag: Di saha ka wuntizɔriba maa ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum mal a, ka ti ti a bindirigu? Bee ka kɔnyuri daa mal a, ka ti ti a kom?.
en: Then those who are righteous will reply to him, Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni gbibi ya hal ni di bahigu ni, ka yi ti ku mali galimi ŋun ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabisili maa dali.
en: He will keep you strong until the end so that on the day when our Lord Jesus Christ comes, you will be free from all blame.

dag: O ni tooi di o Naawuni bindir shɛli din nyɛ zaɣ kasi zaa la mini din nyɛ zaɣ kasi la.
en: He may, of course, eat of his Gods most holy or holy food.

dag: dindina o dana maa ŋun zaŋm o chaŋ Naawuni sani nti zaŋ o zali baɣili dunoli bee duno paɣirili, ka zaŋ peenkpaa chib o tibili voli, ka o leeg o dabili hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: If this happens, the master will bring the slave before God. The master will take the slave to a door or the wooden frame around the door and pierce the slaves ear using a sharp tool to show that the slave will serve that master for all his life.

dag: Ka naa daa yi ti kul chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli nayili dunoli maa kpuɣirila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, ka ti lan zaŋ li ti niŋ bɛ duu yaha.
en: Every time the king went to the Lord s Temple, the guards took out the shields and went with him. After they were finished, they put the shields back on the wall in the guardroom.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni gbiri anzinfa luɣ shɛli beni, ka bɛ ni doori salima luɣ shɛli beni.
en: There is a sure source of silver, a place where gold is refined.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛli ba, Jɔn daa baptaizirila niriba tuuba niŋbu zuɣu, ka yɛri ba ni bɛ niŋm Yisa ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa na la yɛda.
en: Paul said, John told people to be baptized to show they wanted to change their lives. He told people to believe in the one who would come after him, and that one is Jesus.

dag: M mabihi, doliya anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ ti Duuma yuli tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa la naba yi suɣilɔdibo din yuuri yi wahala dibu puuni la.
en: My friends, remember the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord. Take them as examples of patient endurance under suffering.

dag: Amaa pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi dooyili yi po pɔri ni o niŋ shɛli, fashee ka di zani.
en: Every solemn promise of a widow or a divorced woman who makes a binding obligation for herself will stand.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna maa yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: Every year at Passover time the governor would free one prisoner—whichever one the people wanted him to free.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Yi bɔri ni n yihila Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ bahi.
en: he asked them, Do you want me to set free for you the king of the Jews.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔh o, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ a? Ka o yɛli ma, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga. Ka n zaŋ nintua m-pir o, ka zaŋ bansi pir o.
en: I asked her, Who is your father? And she answered, My father is Bethuel son of Nahor and Milcah. Then I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.

dag: ni Hɛlɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Baana Nɛtɔfa nir la bia ni Itai ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ribai ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni nir la.
en: Heleb, Baanahs son from Netophah; Ittai, Ribais son from Gibeah in Benjamin.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli. Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba. Kuruchunim maa daa nyɛla kaman tusaayi laasabu.
en: So Jesus allowed them to do this. The evil spirits left the man and went into the pigs. Then the herd of pigs ran down the hill and into the lake. They were all drowned. There were about pigs in that herd.

dag: Ka n ni zali yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga la Teeku Ʒiɛɣu noli zaŋ hal ni Filistianim Teeku noli, ka lan zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli tariga. Dama n ni ti zaŋ di niriba maa niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi kari ba.
en: Ill set your borders from the Reed Sea to the Philistine Sea and from the desert to the River. Ill hand the inhabitants of the land over to you, and you will drive them out before you.

dag: Amaa n ni ti darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn zaŋ ba leei bɛ daba maa tibili, ka di nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti ʒi azichi pam yi nimaani na.
en: But then I will punish the nation that made them slaves. Your people will leave that land, and they will take many good things with them.

dag: Amaa nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma pul ni na; nyini n-daa chɛ ka m mɔɣi m ma bihim baai.
en: But you are the one who pulled me from the womb, placing me safely at my mothers breasts.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa a zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, Dɔdo ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la bia.
en: Next there was Eleazar son of Dodai from Ahoah. Eleazar was one of the Three Heroes.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul kpaai bɛ nina kpa zuɣusaa lihir o ni chani maa ha, ka bɛ nya ka niriba ayi ye binyɛr piɛla ʒe bɛ sani ka bɔhi ba.
en: They still had their eyes fixed on the sky as he went away, when two men dressed in white suddenly stood beside them.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Absalom yiŋa nti bɔh o, Bɔ zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a tumtumdiba nyo m puu buɣim.
en: Joab went to Absalom's house and demanded, Why did your servants set my field on fire.

dag: Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba: Sɔtai daŋ niriba mini Sofɛrɛt daŋ niriba ni Pɛrida daŋ niriba.
en: Here are the names of Solomon's servants whose descendants returned: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida, Jaala, Darkon, Giddel, Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth Hazzebaim, and Amon.

dag: Bahiyoli mini kum yɛliya, Ti tiba daa wum di ŋumaŋuma.
en: Even death and destruction Admit they have heard only rumors.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti doli Yisa.
en: The two disciples heard him say this and went with Jesus.

dag: Ka a yi yaag a noli yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla a Duuma, ka niŋ yɛda a suhu ni ni Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni, a ni tiligi.
en: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, Jesus is Lord, and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.

dag: Ka ti daa wum kukoli din yi alizanda ni na di o shɛhira maa, dama ti daa be o sani zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: And we heard that voice. It came from heaven while we were with Jesus on the holy mountain.

dag: Ka salo pam dii laɣimna hal ka palichee ti lan ka yili maa ni, ka so daa naan ku tooi lan miri dunol ni gba, ka Yisa yihiri ba waazu.
en: Then so many of them came to the house that there wasn't even standing room left in front of the door. Jesus was still teaching.

dag: ka yi bi lan chɛ ka o gbib o ba min o ma maa gba.
en: then you are no longer required to care for your father or mother.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ ba na ti ʒil amaŋmaŋ zoli zuɣu, nyini Yawɛ ni pii luɣ shɛli n-leeg a biɛhigu shee la. Nyin Yawɛ ni zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nuhi me a jɛmbu du shɛl la ni.
en: You bring them in and plant them on your mountain, the place that you, Lord , have chosen for your home, the Temple that you yourself have built.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dabisili kanna ka n ni ti darigi Babilɔn binnana tibili. N ni ti dihi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa vi. Bɛ ni ti yɛn ku di ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ti lula di puuni.
en: The time is coming when I will deal with Babylons idols; the whole land will be disgraced, and her wounded will fall in her midst.

dag: Ti Naawuni la kanna, o mi bi fo, ka buɣim din diri ni nimmoo be o tooni, ka sanʒiɛ titali ʒiɛri gind o.
en: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.

dag: ka chɛ ka noombil nɛɔŋ maa yiɣi yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣu ni, ka maligumaana maa yo yili maa alahichi samli, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: Then he will release the wild bird outside the city into the countryside. In this way, he will make reconciliation for the house, and it will be clean.

dag: A kari ma saria ka di doli soli; a ʒini nam ʒiishee n-kari ma saria, ka nya ka m-mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: because you have established justice for me and my claim, because you rule from the throne, establishing justice rightly.

dag: Ka yi mali gɔpiɛliga dapuhi, ka niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Make acacia-wood poles for the altar and cover them with copper.

dag: O tiligiri niriba, ka lan fari niriba bahira; o wuhiri shihira, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa alizanda ni mini dunia ŋɔ ni. O fa Daniɛl gbuɣima nuu ni bahi.
en: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.

dag: Yɛm mini kpiɔŋ zaa bela Naawuni sani, ŋuna m-mali ninkurilim mini baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: With him are wisdom and power; counsel and understanding are his.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ kpiɔŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.

dag: Di saha chɛrubinim maa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nudirigu polo, doo maa ni daa chaŋ ti kpe di ni saha shɛli maa. Ka sagbani daa pali di puuni dundɔŋ la ni.
en: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ wuhi ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni, amaa pa daliri suŋ zuɣu ka bɛ niŋdi lala. Bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ woligi m mini ya din ni chɛ ka yi baɣa be bɛ ni.
en: Those other people show a deep interest in you, but their intentions are not good. All they want is to separate you from me, so that you will have the same interest in them as they have in you.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa Yawɛ tooni yi Izraɛlnim zaa sani ka bɛ ti nya. Ka sokam daa yih o jaaŋgbee.
en: Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORDs presence to the Israelites. They saw what happened, and each person took back his staff.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ lala, dama bɛ bi mi ma balle m-mi m Ba Naawuni.
en: People will do these things to you because they have not known either the Father or me.

dag: Yɛhudianim mali soya balibu pam din chɛ ka bɛ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, Naawuni daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa niŋla Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: Yes, the Jews have many benefits. The most important one is this: God trusted the Jews with his teachings.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa neei Balaam nina ka o nya Yawɛ malaika maa ni ʒe soli ni ŋ-ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni shɛm maa, ka o silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Then the LORD uncovered Balaams eyes, and Balaam saw the LORDs messenger standing in the road with his sword drawn in his hand. Then he bowed low and worshipped.

dag: Yi ta ma daɣiri n niriba sani, chi nukurigu pali mini bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi zuɣu. Yi kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi kubu, ka chɛri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi ni bɛ be, yi ni ŋmari ʒiri n niriba bɛn wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa sani la zuɣu.
en: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alikauli zaligu kundi la na ti karim li ka niriba maa wum ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li, ka deeg o noli.
en: Then he read aloud the Lord 's commands and promises, and the people shouted, We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded.

dag: Dauda ni daa ku Filistia doo maa naai ka labina, ka Abinɛr daa zaŋ o chaŋ Sool sani, ka o na kul gbibi Filistia doo maa zuɣu la o nuu ni.
en: When David came back after killing Goliath, Abner brought him to Saul. David was still holding the Philistines head.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kuhiri pampam yi ni nya dan shɛli maa zuɣu? Yi biɛrim maa ka tibbu. Yi taali ni galisi pam, ka yi daalahichi galisi yaɣi ka n niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu.
en: Why cry out for relief from your pain? Your wound is incurable. I have done these things to you, because your guilt is great and your sins are many.

dag: Di ni lan tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn soya golim ka bɛ biɛhigu bi tuhi nuu ni.
en: Their paths are confused; they get lost on their way.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana. O chihi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo ti mi shɛŋa.
en: But the Lord , the righteous one, has freed me from slavery.

dag: Di luɣa ni barilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni pirigili, ka palo din daa do Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini luɣa zuɣu duri la sunsuuni.
en: The outer wall of the side rooms was cubits thick. There was an open area between the side rooms of the Temple.

dag: Wain tiwal pɔhiriba yi ka yi sanna, bɛ ku pɔhi ka guui zaɣ yiha niŋ? Tayiɣisi yi kana yuŋ, bɛ ni kpuɣila bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko.
en: Workers pick grapes from grapevines, but they leave a few grapes on the plants. If thieves come at night, they dont take everything.

dag: Di saha ka Asa daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din zaa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili n-ti o kpambaliba n-tim ba ni bɛ zaŋm li ti ti Siria Naa Bɛnhadad ŋun daa nyɛ Tabirimmɔn bia, ka nyɛ Hɛziɔn yaaŋa ka be Damaskus la, ka yɛl o.
en: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord 's temple. He gave it to some of his officials and sent them to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:.

dag: Ka o daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ bihi banim ŋɔ, ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bɔrɔbɔro ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o bee n-suh o zahim, ka o gbaai wahu ti o.
en: Do any of you have a son? What would you do if your son asked you for a fish? Would any father give him a snake?.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi tɛhi a zaligunim din yi kurimbuni na la yɛla, di kpaŋsirila n suhu.
en: I remember the laws you gave us long ago, Lord , and they bring me comfort.

dag: ni di chɛ ka Abimilɛk mini Shɛkɛmnim bɛn daa kpaŋs o suhu ka o ku Gidiɔn bidibisi pisopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ o ba bihi la laɣim deei bɛ ʒim yihibu maa tibidarigibo.
en: This happened so that Abimelech and the men of Shechem, who encouraged him to murder Gideon's seventy sons, would pay for their crime.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim Juda zuɣulaannima n-zaŋ ba du n-tam gooni maa zuɣu m-pirigi ba gbilligbilli ʒii buyi n-chɛ ka bɛ chani gindi gooni maa zuɣu m-paɣiri Naawuni. Bɛn daŋ tooni daa zaŋ kpala gooni maa zuɣu nudirigu polo n-zaŋ doli Saɣiri Dunɔdal la polo.
en: I assembled the leaders of Judah on top of the wall and put them in charge of two large groups to march around the city, giving thanks to God. The first group went to the right on top of the wall toward the Rubbish Gate.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi teeku ni, ka di niŋ kaman kpim ʒim la, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku maa ni kpi.
en: Then the second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. The water became like the blood of a dead person, and every living creature in the sea died.

dag: N kul nɛla yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka m bɔhim a daalikaulinim yɛla.
en: Late into the night I stay awake to think about your word.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fa ma duŋtaariba nuu ni, ka chɛ ka n leei niriba naa; ka n ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb leei bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: You saved me from those who fought against me. You made me the ruler over nations. People I never knew now serve me.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi dindali maa, ka yiɣimiya jɛmmi ni suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anabinim gba.
en: Be glad when that happens and dance for joy, because a great reward is kept for you in heaven. For their ancestors did the very same things to the prophets.

dag: Yawɛ daa naan ku tooi lan deei yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa maa, dinzuɣu ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari ka bahi yoli doya ka bɛ turi li, ka so ka di ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: And when he could no longer put up with your disgusting sins, he placed a curse on your land and turned it into a desert, as it is today.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kul diri wahala Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba tooi nya tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni ka mali jilima din ku naai la.
en: So I patiently accept all these troubles. I do this to help the people God has chosen so that they can have the salvation that is in Christ Jesus. With this salvation comes glory that never ends.

dag: Lala ka Dauda daa zaŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni kuɣili labi Filistia doo maa ku o, ka takɔbi daa ka Dauda nuu ni.
en: And so, without a sword, David defeated and killed Goliath with a sling and a stone!.

dag: Zɛbulɔn ni ti ʒini n-tabila teeku noli. O kulinoli ni ti nyɛla ŋariŋ kara zaashee. O tintariga ti yɛn zaŋmi hal ni Sidɔn.
en: Zebulun will live beside the sea. His shore will be a haven for ships. His territory will reach as far as Sidon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ piibupiibu m-piila Mataias, ka bɛ daa sab o yuli pahi tuumba piniyini maa yuya ni.
en: When they cast lots, the lot fell on Matthias. He was added to the eleven apostles.

dag: kpamba pisinaanahi maa gbaanila ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ka ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni la tooni m-piligi bɛ nam zuɣupila n-sɔŋ nam ʒiishee maa tooni, ka jɛmd o, ka yiini yila yɛra.
en: At the same time the elders knelt down before the one sitting on the throne. And as they worshiped the one who lives forever, they placed their crowns in front of the throne and said.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim birim, ka saɣim bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ni bɔhi bɛ wuna mini bɛ kpiimba ni bukpahinima ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: The Egyptians will be afraid and confused. They will ask their false gods and wise men what they should do. They will ask their wizards and magicians, but I will ruin their plans.

dag: Di niŋ a zo yɛda, a mi di niŋ a ni yuri so naani. Gbaam a noli yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ paɣa so ŋun do m-baɣa sani.
en: Dont trust your neighbor or trust a friend! Dont even speak freely with your wife.

dag: M mali yɛla pam din ni tɔɣisi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka kari ya saria, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka n ni wum shɛli o sani, dina ka m mali yɛri dunianima.
en: I have many things to say in judgment concerning you. The one who sent me is true, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.

dag: Man Nɛbukadnɛza daa ʒila n yiŋ baalim, ka n nyamma kul pahira n nam yili maa puuni.
en: I was living comfortably in my palace, enjoying great prosperity.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ suɣilo doli naa, o ni ti saɣ o ni yɛl o shɛm, ka zilim balli ni tooi kabisi kɔba.
en: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ni zaŋ suhudo shɛli tin ya la su yi suhuri, dama suhudoo maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya n-laɣim ya niŋgbun yin la ni. Ka paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.

dag: Ka n daa lihi n-nya Piɛbila ka o ʒe Ziɔn zol zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi ʒe o sani, ka o yuli min o Ba yuli sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, who was standing on Mount Zion. There were , people with him. They all had his name and his Fathers name written on their foreheads.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrig o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o, amaa ni o ni lan zaŋ o labisina pumpɔŋɔ.
en: If anyone asks you why you are taking the donkey, tell them, The Master needs it. He will send it back soon.

dag: O ku chɛ ka n vuhi lu m puuni, ka chɛ ka naŋgbantom kul paari ma.
en: He doesnt let me catch my breath, for he fills me with bitterness.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa kana ti ʒini n tooni ni bɛ bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ binshɛli.
en: It was the tenth day of the fifth month of the seventh year of our exile. Some of the leaders of the Israelite community came to consult me about the Lord 's will, and they sat down in front of me.

dag: O daa lan kpuɣi Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka ka o daa dɔɣi Abija mini Atai ni Ziza ni Shɛlomit.
en: Later he married Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, and they had four sons: Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

dag: Yawɛ ni ka o niriba sanna; o ni to o piɛma ka di be kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ni ti piɛb kikaa; ka ni ti be nudirigu polo pɔhim ni kanna.
en: The Lord will appear above his people; he will shoot his arrows like lightning. The Sovereign Lord will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms from the south.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Ibrahimma, Milika gba dɔɣi bihi ti a mabia Nahɔr.
en: After all these things happened, a message was sent to Abraham. It said, Your brother Nahor and his wife Milcah have children now.

dag: Ka Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Next came the tribe of Simeon. Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the commander of that group.

dag: N nina fulimmi n nandahima zuɣu, n dimnim chɛ ka di niŋla liti.
en: My enemies have caused me such sorrow that my eyes are worn out from crying.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu mini buŋa n-tabili taba ni bɛ ko.
en: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.

dag: O ʒila Salɛm, ka o biɛhigu shee nyɛ Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu.
en: His Temple is in Salem. His house is on Mount Zion.

dag: Ka paɣ mi yi yi o yidan yiŋ kuli do so, o gba tum zina.
en: and if a wife divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa pun nyaŋ na shɛba ka deei bɛ tiŋgbana din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛ ni daa deei luɣ shɛŋa maa n-nyɛ Arinɔn Vinvamli zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli zaŋ tabili Araba tiŋgbana din zaa daa be wulimpuhili polo maa.
en: The Israelites struck down these kings of the land and took over their land on the east side of the Jordan. This ran from the Arnon Valley as far as Mount Hermon and included the whole eastern part of the desert plain.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim la zali Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: Place the gold altar for burning incense in front of the chest containing the covenant. Set up the screen at the dwellings entrance.

dag: A yi ni doli Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga, a biɛhigu ni tɔŋ. Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, Di zɔri dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: And you will have success, if you are careful to obey the rules and laws that the Lord gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and brave. Dont be afraid.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti ka Damaskus na. Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa biɛra. Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Naawuni nir la be yaŋɔ.
en: Elisha went to Damascus. King Ben-Hadad of Aram was sick. Someone told Ben-Hadad, The man of God has come here.

dag: N ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni nirilim, ka chɛ ka bɛ be n sani. Ŋunkam doli so shɛli din ka galimi, ŋuna n-ni tum n tuma.
en: I will look throughout the land for those who can be trusted. Only such people can live with me. Only those who live pure lives can be my servants.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Joɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pihita pah o zuɣu.
en: There were people from the tribe of Gershon. Joel was their leader.

dag: N ni lo ni n tum din viɛli zuɣu, n dimnim zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma din viɛli niŋbu samli.
en: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.

dag: dama ti Duuma ni niŋ kaman o ni zali ni o ni niŋ shɛm o sariakaribo puuni dunianim zaa sani ŋ-ŋmaai li jia.
en: Yes, the Lord will quickly finish judging the people on the earth. Isaiah :-.

dag: Ka Azaria mini Ɛzra ni Mɛshulam.
en: Also following them were Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb mi yi Kriit mini Areebia na, amaa ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla timaŋmaŋ ya yɛligu ni.
en: Cretans and Arabs—we hear them declaring the mighty works of God in our own languages.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ninsal kpi n-do mɔɣu ni ka yi bi mi ŋun ku o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ka yi su li maa ni.
en: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.

dag: Ka Sool yɛli Dauda, A ku tooi chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, dama a na nyɛla bia, ka o mi nyɛ doo ŋun pun tuhiri tɔbu o bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You cant go out and fight this Philistine, Saul answered David. You are still a boy. But hes been a warrior since he was a boy.

dag: Ka Omri mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa yi Gibɛtɔn n-chaŋ ti teei gili Tiriza.
en: Omri and his troops left Gibbethon and went and besieged Tirzah.

dag: n zaliya ni Izraɛlnim zaa bee bɛ maligumaaniba bee bɛ Lɛvinim bɛn be n nam sulinsi ni ka bɛ suhu yu ni bɛ kuli Jɛrusalɛm, bɛn dol a kuli.
en: I command that throughout my empire all the Israelite people, priests, and Levites that so desire be permitted to go with you to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, O yi nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ, hal o zabigu zaɣ yini gba ku lu tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be o kɔbili ni, o ni kpi.
en: Solomon replied, If he is loyal, not even a hair on his head will be touched; but if he is not, he will die.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni sokam zaa kpi yim, ka saria karibu lee be di nyaaŋa.
en: We die only once, and then we are judged.

dag: Gbaamiya piɛ viɛlli biŋkɔbbaligu maa ni. Niŋmiya dari kuli daaŋa ni; duɣimiya nimdi maa; duɣimiya o kɔba gba.
en: Take the flocks best animal; arrange the wood beneath it. Bring it to a rolling boil, and cook its bones in it.

dag: N ni sabiri shɛli ŋɔ puuni, n niŋ naani ni a ni niŋ n ni suh a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ hal n-niŋ li yaɣi lala zuɣu gba.
en: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yuri ka tum alahichi, o yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee tinzun nira, o mola Yawɛ maa, di simdi ni bɛ ku dilana.
en: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people.

dag: Naawuni yɛm puuni o bi chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim tooi zaŋ bɛ yɛm baŋ ŋun Naawuni; dina n-chɛ ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini ni o zaŋ ti ni yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu shɛli din ŋmani jɛrilim ŋɔ n-tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: In Gods wisdom, he determined that the world wouldnt come to know him through its wisdom. Instead, God was pleased to save those who believe through the foolishness of preaching.

dag: Niŋmiya Yawɛ naani sahakam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa n-taɣiri ti ka chɛri zaɣ biɛɣu sahakam.
en: So trust the Lord always, because in the Lord YAH you have a place of safety forever.

dag: Mɔab yili kam zuɣusaa mini di dahi ni, shɛli lan kani n-naɣi pahila fabila kɔŋko, dama n wurim Mɔab kaman so ni lan je duɣ shɛli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On all the housetops of Moab and in all its public squares there is nothing but mourning, because I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti yɛli Filip, Yiɣisima n-dol a nudirigu polo mɔɣu ni pal shɛli din yiri Jɛrusalɛm kuni Gaza la.
en: An angel of the Lord spoke to Philip. The angel said, Get ready and go south on the road that leads down to Gaza from Jerusalem—the road that goes through the desert.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin saɣisim o; o yi deeg o galimi, nyin chɛl o taali paŋ o.
en: So be careful! If your brother or sister in Gods family does something wrong, warn them. If they are sorry for what they did, forgive them.

dag: Naawuni bi zali ti ni o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ti di ti, amaa o zali ti ni ti nyala tiliginsim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: God did not choose us to suffer his anger, but to possess salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: N ni bɔri shɛli zaa nyɛla ni m baŋ Masia, ka baŋ o kum ni neebu yiko yɛla, ka pah o zuɣu di wahala, ka be kaman ŋuna o kum puuni.
en: The righteousness that I have comes from knowing Christ, the power of his resurrection, and the participation in his sufferings. It includes being conformed to his death.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, o suhu paligirimi, ka o zaŋ o buɣi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And when you find it, you will be so glad that you will put it on your shoulder.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tiŋ maa ni nɛma, ka gbahi niɣi pahi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Jɔshua shɛm.
en: But the Israelites took the animals and the other possessions of the people of Ai, because this was what the Lord had told Joshua to do.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Job answered them:.

dag: Yi ni ti di di suhumaabo daazichi din galisi pam la daanfaani kaman bia ni mɔɣiri o ma bihili shɛm la.
en: You will enjoy her prosperity, like a child at its mother's breast.

dag: hal nimaani gba n yɛn bela a nuu ni, ka a nudirigu gbib ma kirikiri.
en: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.

dag: Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo, ti dimnim ni daa liri ti la.
en: If the Lord had not been on our side when our enemies attacked us.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm n-ni saɣi po pɔri n-zan o kpee nyaaŋa ni o di samli.
en: One with no sense shakes hands on a deal, securing a loan for a friend.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛli; ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla din chihiri n noli ni yibu na.
en: What I say is the truth; lies are hateful to me.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu kana ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni booni Naawuni sara maligu bimbini la. Ka niriba ni ti kumdi ka fabinda, ka tiŋ maa zaa ni be kaman ʒim ni ŋam sara maligu bimbin shɛli.
en: and then God will bring disaster on the city that is called God's altar. There will be weeping and wailing, and the whole city will be like an altar covered with blood.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ laɣim taba.
en: The Syrians realized that they had been defeated by the Israelites, and so they called all their troops together.

dag: Luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim biŋkɔbiri la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti taali sanyoo biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini luɣilikam.
en: The compensation offering must be slaughtered at the same place where the entirely burned offering is slaughtered, and its blood must be tossed against all sides of the altar.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai sinsabiga maa gbin na n-kpalim zani lihi di zuɣu ka yɛli, Zakius, siɣimina yomyom, dama di kpala talahi ni n kpe a yiŋ zuŋɔ.
en: When Jesus came to that spot, he looked up and said, Zacchaeus, come down at once. I must stay in your home today.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni yɛl shɛli din gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu be kpe.
en: But I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Get up in the morning and go to Pharaoh. Tell him that the Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says, Let my people go to worship me!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti dalim siliga maa noli kuɣili la, ka zali tɔbbihi ka bɛ gul li.
en: So they sealed it tight and placed soldiers there to guard it.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni laɣiyubo, ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣi yi ni mali shɛli, dama Naawuni yɛliya, N kul ku chɛ a, ka mi ku bah a.
en: Keep your lives free from the love of money, and be satisfied with what you have. For God has said, I will never leave you; I will never abandon you.

dag: Amaa ka dindali maa biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka Naawuni chɛ ka zunzuli lu yɔɣili maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋub li ka di kpi.
en: But at dawn the next day, at God's command, a worm attacked the plant, and it died.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ni suhudoo, man dee min a ni daa pun lo tab alikauli Yawɛ yuli ni, ka yɛli ni Yawɛ be ti sani, ka ni ti lan be ti bihi gba sani sahakam ŋɔ saɣiya. Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ, ka Jɔnatan mi lab kuli.
en: Then Jonathan said to David, Go in peace. We have taken an oath in the Lord s name to be friends forever. We have asked the Lord to be a witness between us and our descendants forever.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a ka mi a zaligunim ka n sanna.
en: May those who honor you come to me— all those who know your commands.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Naawuni o jɛmbu duu. Paɣimiy o zuɣusaa din nyɛ o yiko ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti kul zaŋdi wumpaɣibo kaman sara la paɣiri Naawuni, dina n-nyɛ ti yaai ti noya kahigi wuhi ni ti tibigir o yuli.
en: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.

dag: ka sagbani maa zuɣu chɛ ka Maligumaaniba maa kɔŋ bɛ tuma tumbu, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The Lord 's glory was in the cloud, and the light from it was so bright that the priests could not stay inside to do their work.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni lan kpuɣi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, di tariga yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ ni. Yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa mini di tintarisi din gil li m-bala.
en: Then the border will continue along the Jordan River. It will end at the Dead Sea. These are the borders around your country.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The lampstand and its equipment will require kilograms of pure gold.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni n-kul tɛhiri di yɛla.
en: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.

dag: N zɔnim larila mani ŋun suhi Naawuni ka o deei n suhigu ŋɔ, mani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun ka galimi ŋɔ, ka bɛ lari ma.
en: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla bɛ ni pun zali shɛli, ka ninsalinim biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm bi sɔɣi. Ka bɛ mi ku tooi ŋme ŋun gari ba kpiɔŋ naŋgbankpeeni.
en: You are only what you were created to be—a human, and it is useless to argue about it. People cannot argue with God about this because he is more powerful than they are, and a long argument will not change that fact.

dag: Yawɛ galim Judanima. O ni darigi Yaakubu tibili ka di dol o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yo o o tuma samli.
en: The Lord says, I have a complaint against Israel. Jacob must be punished for the bad things he did.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ka lihimiya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka paɣimiy o di puuni.
en: Keep on praying and guard your prayers with thanksgiving.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka n kuhira, ka nintam zɔri n ninni maa; dama ŋun yɛn maai n suhu be katiŋa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ma suhukpeeni. Bɛ zaɣisi m bihi; dama n dim nyaŋ ma.
en: Because of all these things Im crying. My eyes, my own eyes pour water because a comforter who might encourage me is nowhere near. My children are destroyed because the enemy was so strong.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa maa, ti ku tooi nya o; o yiko min o yɛlimaŋli galisiya; o nimmaŋtali din galisi zuɣu, o bi zaŋ kiŋkansi doli so.
en: As for the Almighty, we cant find him— he is powerful and just, abundantly righteous— he wont respond.

dag: Gbibi n nyɛvili, dama n zaŋla mmaŋ zaa ti a; tiligim a dabili ŋun niŋ a naani ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: Save me from death, because I am loyal to you; save me, for I am your servant and I trust in you.

dag: Bilichiisi duri luya, amaa ti ni kpe kuɣa m-me shɛŋa zali di zaani. Sinsabisi tihi vuɣi lu, amaa ti ni bo sida tihi sa n-zali di zaani.
en: Bricks have fallen, but lets rebuild with stones. Sycamores were cut down, but lets replace them with cedars.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa mi zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani nam ʒiishee, ka di biɛhigu ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛli safaya la. Ka binshɛli daa ʒi nam ʒiishee maa zuɣusaa, ka di kɔtomsi ŋmani daadam kɔtomsi.
en: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa ʒini naai di daba ata dali ka o daa yi Siizaria chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Three days after Festus arrived in the province, he went from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ nyɛla yin ni teeri dabisi shɛli yɛla, ka di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu n-tiri Yawɛ jilima. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka gbib li.
en: This day will be a day of remembering for you. You will observe it as a festival to the LORD. You will observe it in every generation as a regulation for all time.

dag: Di saha Ɛli nina daa bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o bi tooi nyara; dahin shɛli yuŋ ka o daa ti do o dooshee;.
en: One night Eli, who was now almost blind, was sleeping in his own room;.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni n-lee zali wuntaŋa ni di ne dabisili puuni, ka zali goli mini saŋmarisi ni bɛ mi ne yuŋ? Ka ŋuni n-lee damdi teeku ka di kɔgbana vura? O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: The LORD proclaims: The one who established the sun to light up the day and ordered the moon and stars to light up the night, who stirs up the sea into crashing waves, whose name is the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Dinzuɣu n kumdila Sibima mini Jaza wain tihi zuɣu. N kumdila Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim zuɣu, dama bɛ bi kpuɣi puu atam din ni chɛ ka bɛ suhuri piɛla.
en: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations.

dag: Amaa kulibɔŋ bee kɔbil shɛli din mali kom, din nyɛla din ka daɣiri. Amaa binshɛɣukam din shihi binkpiŋ ni leei din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: A spring or a well that collects water will remain clean, but anyone who touches the dead bodies of any unclean animal in that water will become unclean.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛlimaŋli maa lee nyɛla dini? Gomna Pailɛt ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan yi Yɛhudianim maa sani ti yɛli ba, M bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: Pilate asked Jesus, What is truth? Pilate went back out and said, I don't find this man guilty of anything!.

dag: Ka Dauda mini tɔbbi kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la ni kpamba zaa daa gbaai saawara.
en: After consulting with the captains of the units of a thousand and a hundred, in fact with every leader.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tuuya, ka Juda lu, dama bɛ yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ tuma bi viɛli Yawɛ sani; bɛ turila Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: Yes, Jerusalem is doomed! Judah is collapsing! Everything they say and do is against the Lord ; they openly insult God himself.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ma paai nimaani, do so daa be nimaani ka o niŋgbuŋ daa nyɛlisira kaman daanya la. O daa gbibila mi piɛlli mini bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli buɣisiri binyara la o nuu ni. O daa ʒiɛla dunɔdali gbini.
en: When he brought me there, I saw a man standing in the gate. He appeared to be bronze, and he had a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti Asiria naa maa nuu ni, ka dunia ŋɔ nama zaa niriba baŋ ni a kɔŋko n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Now, Lord our God, rescue us from the Assyrians, so that all the nations of the world will know that you alone are God.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a nimdi bahi zoya zuɣu, ka zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ maa pali vinvama ni.
en: I will spread your rotting flesh over the mountains and in the valleys.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhuri kpe lala paɣ maa ni. Miriya ka yi birigi dol o soli.
en: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya ka sapashinnim ʒiya tɔri jina, ka o yɛli, Sapashini, m malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Ti ni ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa? Ka o yɛli Jɛhu, N dana, nyini ka n yɛri maa.
en: When he arrived, the army officers were meeting together. Sir, I have a message for you, he said. For which one of us? Jehu asked. You, sir, the prophet answered.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na nti laɣim tab chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: Some Pharisees and some teachers of the law came from Jerusalem and gathered around Jesus.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu piligu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋma gbaŋ fiɣisi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: In the rule of Ahasuerus, at the beginning of his rule, they composed an indictment against those who lived in Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Paɣ viɛla ni paɣ viɛlli, a bi mi? Doli piɛri maa naba n-zaŋ a buhi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri luɣ shɛli din miri piɛguliba tanti suɣa la.
en: If you dont know your way, most beautiful of women, then follow the tracks of the herds and graze your little goats by the tents of the shepherds.

dag: Di nyaaŋa n ni ku paɣ maa bihi, ka cheechinim zaa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri baŋdi din be salinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni, ka nyɛ ŋun ni ti yi zaa yinoyino yi tuma ni simdi shɛm laara.
en: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi duu maa wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia, ka di be du titali maa tooni ha. Ka o daa yɛli ma, Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He measured the room itself, and it was feet square. This room was beyond the central room. Then he said to me, This is the Most Holy Place.

dag: Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ka ka binshɛli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di saha maa o daa ti ba wain tihi puri mini pu shɛŋa pahi.
en: He left in the land of Judah some of the poorest people, who owned no property, and he gave them vineyards and fields.

dag: Ka tihi puu maa lana daa yɛli, Ka wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N ni timla mmaŋmaŋ biyurigu ŋɔ; di pa shɛli bɛ ni ti ti ŋun jilima.
en: The owner of the vineyard said, What will I do now? I will send my son. I love my son very much. Maybe the farmers will respect my son.

dag: Ka Uziɛl bidibisi mi nyɛ Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan ni Sitiri.
en: Uzziel also had three sons: Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

dag: N di suɣilo guhi Yawɛ, ka o gbilis o tibili wum n kuhigu.
en: I waited patiently for the Lord 's help; then he listened to me and heard my cry.

dag: ka o daa pii di liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka o paɣ maa mi di yɛla. Ka Ananias daa zaŋ din kpalim maa ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: With his wifes knowledge, he withheld some of the proceeds from the sale. He brought the rest and placed it in the care and under the authority of the apostles.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yihi saliŋ shɛŋa din be bɛ tiba ni n-zaŋ na ti ti Aduna.
en: So the people collected all their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, A mi ni su tins anu fukumsi.
en: The king said to this servant, You can rule over five cities.

dag: O daa yihi ma na ti zali pal tital ni. O daa fa ma bahi, o nini ni daa tiɣ ma la zuɣu.
en: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.

dag: Teemi ni a ni daa doli Bɔaz so paɣisara yihiri kayiha la nyɛla ti dɔɣira. Wumma, yuŋ ŋɔ o ni be kabɔɣili ni m-buri chi.
en: Now isnt Boaz, whose young women you were with, our relative? Tonight he will be winnowing barley at the threshing floor.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut daa ti yɛli Naomi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti doli kachɛriba yihiri kayiha. M mali tahima ni n ni ti nya so ka o saɣi ka n yihi kayiha o puu ni. Ka Naomi yɛl o, M bia, to chama.
en: One day Ruth, the Moabite, said to Naomi, I think I will go to the fields. Maybe I can find someone who will be kind to me and let me gather the grain they leave in their field. Naomi said, Fine, daughter, go ahead.

dag: Di saha ti daa kul larimi, ka yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn daa gil ti yɛra, Yawɛ tum tuun kara ti ba.
en: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, The Lord has worked miracles for his people.

dag: Di simdi ka yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You must be sure to obey the commands of the Lord your God. You must follow all the teachings and laws he has given you.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi zaɣisi, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ kpi bɛmaŋmaŋ ʒilinsi zuɣu.
en: But if they dont listen, they perish by the sword, breathe their last without understanding.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Karimba, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Teacher, he asked, which is the greatest commandment in the Law.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa boli, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: The Lord called Samuel, and Samuel answered, Here I am.

dag: ka pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di kpahirimi lu, ka so ku lan tooi baŋ di ni di be shɛli.
en: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini di ni ka me a luɣ kasi shee ni bɛ jɛmd a ka yɛra.
en: They have lived here and have built a temple to honor you, knowing.

dag: Di saha maa Filistianim maa daa chaŋmi ti tuhi Rɛfaim tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli ni la nima, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Philistines arrived at Rephaim Valley and began plundering.

dag: O daa lan yih o yabipaɣ Maaka napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me Ashɛra binnan shɛli din chihiri zal la zuɣu. Ka Asa daa ŋme n kab o binnani maa luhi n-zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni.
en: He even removed his grandmother Maacah from the position of queen mother because she had made an image of Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

dag: Yinim bɛn bari bun piɛla ka ʒi bunnyaampar gahinda zuɣu mini yinim bɛn doli soya, yɛlimiya di yɛla.
en: Pay attention you people riding on white donkeys, sitting on saddle blankets, and walking along the road.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zani viɛnyɛliŋga ka yɔhi teeku ni kɔbilinina.
en: when he placed the clouds in the sky, when he opened the springs of the ocean.

dag: Gibar daŋ — pihiwɛinaanu.
en: the descendants of Gibbar:.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, m baŋya ni ʒilinsi zuɣu ka yi mini yi kpamba daa niŋ Yisa lala maa.
en: Brothers and sisters, I know you acted in ignorance. So did your rulers.

dag: Ka o daa gindi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo tinsi zaa n-yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: John went throughout the region of the Jordan River, calling for people to be baptized to show that they were changing their hearts and lives and wanted God to forgive their sins.

dag: n daa ŋmanila jɛrigu ni ŋun ʒi shɛli; ka be kaman biŋkɔbigu la a sani.
en: I was as stupid as an animal; I did not understand you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni tinim kul bela kum barina ni ni di chɛ ka yinim mali nyɛvili.
en: So death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

dag: O daa di nam be Hiburɔn n-su Judanim la yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu. Ka o daa lan ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa yuun pihitanaata.
en: He ruled over Judah for seven and a half years in Hebron. He ruled thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu, ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani.
en: Jesus returned to the synagogue. A man with a withered hand was there.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zo n-kuli Hitinim tiŋgban ni n-daa ti me omaŋmaŋ tiŋa m-boli di yuli Luz; ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He later went to the land of the Hittites, built a city there, and named it Luz, which is still its name.

dag: O daa zali maligumaaniba ka ti ba bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni, ka kpaŋsi ba bɛ tuma maa ni.
en: Josiah chose the priests to do their duties. He encouraged the priests while they were serving in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti boli tab na ka yi ti ʒini yi wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi gbini. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma ni yɛlimaŋli ni ʒiɛyimtali a suhu ni kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpana la ni n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zaa.
en: If you will serve me in honesty and integrity, as your father David did, and if you obey my laws and do everything I have commanded you.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-zaŋdi kom duri zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka di leeri sakom.
en: God takes up water from the earth and changes it into mist and rain.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ka so mi ku tooi yiɣisi li. O pun teeg o nuu, ka so mi ku tooi pɔri li.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces has created a plan; who can stop it? Gods hand is extended; who will stop it?.

dag: Bɛ nolɔbo maa mini bɛ Naawuni suhibu nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: They fasted and prayed, placed their hands on them, and sent them off.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be o sani la, Chamiya gili Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa ni, zaŋ Dan hal ti kpa Bɛrishiiba n-kali niriba maa ka m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So David told Joab and the army officers, Go to every tribe in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north all the way south to Beersheba, and count everyone who can serve in the army. I want to know how many there are.

dag: Yinim maligumaaniba, wummiya! Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbilisimiya tibili! Yinim nayilinima, luɣimiya yi tiba wum! Saria karibu maa ʒila yi zuɣu, dama yi leela zana Mizipa, ka leei laŋa n-yɛrigi pa Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: Listen to this, you priests! Pay attention, people of Israel! Listen, you that belong to the royal family! You are supposed to judge with justice—so judgment will fall on you! You have become a trap at Mizpah, a net spread on Mount Tabor.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yur o paɣ Hanna maa zaa yoli, o daa kul ŋmaarila ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko tarili tir o, dama Yawɛ daa na bi ti o bia.
en: But he would give only one part of it to Hannah, though he loved her, because the LORD had kept her from conceiving.

dag: M mabihi, yi mi n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, dama n yɛrila yinim bɛm mi zaligu yɛla. Zaligu lo nir la kulla o ni na be o nyɛvil ni la.
en: Brothers and sisters, Im talking to you as people who know the Law. Dont you know that the Law has power over someone only as long as he or she lives?.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka bɛ zaŋ kikahi ayopɔin ti malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn ʒe Naawuni tooni.
en: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God. They were given seven trumpets.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka Farisii so yɛl o ni o bɔri ni o ka ŋun Farisii maa yiŋ na ka o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu. Ka o daa chaŋ ka bɛ ti ʒini ni bɛ di;.
en: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.

dag: Daadam, yi mabihi mini yi zuliya niriba ni yi tab Izraɛlnim bɛn be tinzun tiŋ ni ŋɔ zaa ka Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛra, Bɛ chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ Yawɛ. Tinim ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ti ni ti su li.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ so shɛli tiligi Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib nuu ni m-bala. O daa lan tiligi Hɛzɛkia o dimnim zaa nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Lord rescued Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from Sennacherib and also protected them from other enemies.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka doliya zaligunim ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Remember, you were slaves in Egypt. So be sure to obey these laws.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tuma yiɣisi Yawɛ suhu, ka o daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: They made God angry by what they did, so a plague broke out against them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib gba zuɣu! Dama yi ʒiini niriba ʒi tibisi shɛŋa din ʒibu to, amaa ka yimaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ yi nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: Jesus answered, It will be bad for you, you experts in the law! You make strict rules that are very hard for people to obey. You try to force others to obey your rules. But you yourselves dont even try to follow any of those rules.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Her daughters on the mainland will be killed in battle. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: nti kahigi yɛla maa zaa wuhi ba, ka naanyi tim ba Jɔpa maa.
en: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.

dag: ka yɛli Musa, Amaŋmaŋ tɔɣisim ti yɛtɔɣa ka ti wumda, amaa di lan chɛ ka Naawuni tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa, di yi nyɛ lala ti ni kpi.
en: Then the people said to Moses, If you want to speak to us, then we will listen. But please dont let God speak to us. If this happens, we will die.

dag: Ka o daa kahig o daashili zaa wuh o ka yɛl o, N nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani hal n ni daa na be m ma pul ni saha shɛli, ka piliŋ na ʒi n-shihi n zuɣu ni. Ka n yi pini, n kpiɔŋ maa ni yi n ni ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Finally, Samson told her the truth. I have belonged to God ever since I was born, so my hair has never been cut. If it were ever cut off, my strength would leave me, and I would be as weak as anyone else.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piri tɔbbihi maa ʒii buta zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Jɔab su yim zuɣu, ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab tizo la su yim zuɣu, ka Itai Gaat nir la mi daa su bɛn kpalim la. Ka naa daa yɛli niriba maa, Mmaŋmaŋ gba ni yina pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: Then he sent them out in three groups, with Joab and Joab's brother Abishai and Ittai from Gath, each in command of a group. And the king said to his men, I will go with you myself.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Naawuni nira n-ka n sanna, o biɛhigu ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, ka o ninni lihibu mali dabiɛm pam. M bi bɔh o o ni yi luɣ shɛl na, ka o mi bi wuhi ma o yuli.
en: She went to Manoah and said, A prophet who looked like an angel of God came and talked to me. I was so frightened, that I didn't even ask where he was from. He didn't tell me his name.

dag: Zaŋmiya binnɛma balibu kam bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa n-yina, ka bɛ ti dɔɣi pam nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Bring out with you all the animals of every kind—birds, livestock, everything crawling on the ground—so that they may populate the earth, be fertile, and multiply on the earth.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun tuhiri tɔbu. O yuli n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Lord is a great soldier. The Lord is his name.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate asked Jesus, Are you the king of the Jews? Those are your words, Jesus answered.

dag: Bɛ leeri nanima, ka bi niŋdi ma saawara. Bɛ piiri kpamba, amaa ka m bi mi di yɛla. Bɛ zaŋdi bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa maani binnana din yɛn bahi bɛn maŋmaŋ yoli.
en: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi ninvuɣ so daadamnim puuni? Bee bɛ daa dɔɣ a mi pɔi ka daboya naanyi pili?.
en: Do you think you were the first person born? Were you there when God made the mountains?.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi teeku ni, ka di niŋ kaman kpim ʒim la, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku maa ni kpi.
en: The second angel poured his bowl into the sea, and the sea turned into blood, like the blood of a corpse, and every living thing in the sea died.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka teeku kɔgbana daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.

dag: Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, yin di kɔrigiy o min o bia maa zaa dahin yini.
en: Do not sacrifice a cow and its calf or a sheep and its lamb or a goat and its kid on the same day.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn sani nti yɛl o.
en: Then the Israelites sent messengers to Sihon the Amorite king.

dag: Ka shɛb pun yɛli ba a yɛla ni a wuhirila Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn be bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tinsi ni la ni bɛ zaɣisim Anabi Musa zaligu, ka lan yɛri ba ni bɛ di gundi bɛ bihi, ka mi di lan doli bɛ kaya.
en: They have been informed that you teach all the Jews who live among the Gentiles to reject Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children nor to live according to our customs.

dag: Dauda daa gbahila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili mini wɔribariba tusaayopɔin ni tɔbbi tinchandiba tuhi pisi. O daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali, ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa napɔn jila.
en: David captured one thousand chariots from him, seven thousand cavalry, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Then David cut the hamstrings of all but one hundred of the chariot horses.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi ka yinsi din ni di ka nyu nimaani bee yi ʒiɛmla Naawuni cheechi ka dihiri bɛn ka shɛl la gba vi? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn yɛli ya? N ni paɣi ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Aai! N ku paɣi ya!.
en: Dont you have houses to eat and drink in? Or do you look down on Gods churches and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Will I praise you? No, I dont praise you in this.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi laŋ maa bahi yi ŋariŋ maa nudirigu polo; yi yi niŋ lala yi ni nya shɛli. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-gbahi zahim pam hal nti tarigi laŋ maa vɔbu zahim maa galisim zuɣu.
en: He said, Throw your net into the water on the right side of your boat. You will find some fish there. So they did this. They caught so many fish that they could not pull the net back into the boat.

dag: N ni yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi suhuri saɣim.
en: Yet because I have said these things to you, you are filled with sorrow.

dag: Chamiya ti tum tuma maa, dama bɛ bi lan yɛn tin ya mɔri, amaa yi mi kul yɛn ŋmarila bilichiisi maa kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga la.
en: Now get back to work! You will not be given any straw, but you must still make the same number of bricks.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni mali ba, ka bɛ neei kaman machɛli ni maani kurugu shɛm la, ka buɣisi ba nya. Dama wula ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ n niriba bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ?.
en: So the Lord All-Powerful says, A worker heats metal in a fire to test it and see if it is pure. I will test the people of Judah like that. I have no other choice. My people have sinned.

dag: Tɛhimiya o ni daa di wahala alahichinim bɛn daa je o nuu ni shɛm yɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi ku gbarigi ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Think of what he went through; how he put up with so much hatred from sinners! So do not let yourselves become discouraged and give up.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ bali Yisa nyaandoliba ni, ka bɛ daa zɔr o, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ yɛda ni o shiri nyɛla Yisa nyaandola.
en: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him. They didnt believe he was really a disciple.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yɛl o, Yɛlim ti Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n-shiri nyɛ Masia Naawuni Bia la.
en: But Jesus did not answer. So the high priest said, With the living God looking on, you must tell the truth. Are you the Messiah, the Son of God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii tiŋ shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ Juda mini Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti.
en: These are the names of the towns that were in the areas that belonged to Judah and Simeon.

dag: nyin Naawuni naan dii nya, dama a mi ti daashili tɛha din be ti suhuri ni.
en: you would surely have discovered it, because you know our secret thoughts.

dag: N ni yuri shɛba, bɛna ka n saɣisiri ka darigiri bɛ tiba; dinzuɣu moomiya yi nini niŋ tuuba.
en: I rebuke and punish all whom I love. Be in earnest, then, and turn from your sins.

dag: O yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin yɛlimiya yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min o nyaandoliba lee yɛn ʒini puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: to the house he enters, and say to the owner of the house: The Teacher says, Where is the room where my disciples and I will eat the Passover meal.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi, faashee yi wuntizɔbo zooi gari Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim dini, di yi pa lala yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni abada.
en: I say to you that unless your righteousness is greater than the righteousness of the legal experts and the Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Amaa Absalom daa bi yɛli Amnɔn zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, dama o daa lan je Amnɔn yɛlli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi niŋ o tizɔpaɣ Tama shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Absalom began to hate Amnon. Absalom did not say one word, good or bad, to Amnon, but he hated him because Amnon had raped his sister Tamar.

dag: O daa buɣisi li la di luɣa anahi zuɣu. Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gil li, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di woligi din be kasi ka chɛ din bi be kasi.
en: On all four sides he measured the wall all the way around. Its length was seven hundred fifty feet, and its width seven hundred fifty feet. So he made a division between the holy and the ordinary.

dag: Zoya mini kunkuna ni tihi din wandi wala ni sida tihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Do the same, you mountains, every single hill, fruit trees, and every single cedar!.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka niriba ti ku lan deeri wuhibu maŋli, amaa ka ni dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre soli n-kul bɔrila karimbanim bɛn ni wuhiri wuhibu shɛŋa din niŋdi ba nyaɣisim pahira.
en: The time will come when people will not listen to the true teaching. But people will find more and more teachers who please them. They will find teachers who say what they want to hear.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ti Yawɛ o ni daa me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa varanda tooni la zuɣu.
en: Then Solomon offered entirely burned offerings to the LORD on the LORDs altar that Solomon had built in front of the porch.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha kanna ka niriba ni ti yi tinsi pam ni kana.
en: The Lord Almighty says, The time is coming when people from many cities will come to Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman daba anii dali ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: About a week after he had said these things, Jesus took Peter, John, and James with him and went up a hill to pray.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa yɛli niriba maa, Yi tum alahichi titali. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n ni chaŋ Yawɛ sani nti suh o, di pa shɛli o ni chɛ yi daalahichi maa.
en: The next day Moses said to the people, Youve committed a terrible sin. So now I will go up to the LORD. Maybe I can arrange reconciliation on account of your sin.

dag: Ka o daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yuŋ maa ti yɛli ba, Yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yiɣisimiya n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka chɛ n niriba ŋɔ; chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So that night Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron and said to them, Get up and leave my people. You and your people can do as you say. Go and worship the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ li chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili maa ni ti pi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: So I went and hid them near the Euphrates.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa lan yɛl o ba, Bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suh a. Dina n-nyɛ: chɛl ma ka n niŋ chira ayi pahi, ka n chɛ ka m mini n tab du zoya zuɣu n-fabili n ni yɛn kpi ni m paɣipiɛlital ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But she asked her father, Do this one thing for me. Leave me alone for two months, so that I can go with my friends to wander in the mountains and grieve that I must die a virgin.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bindira pam pal a kambɔna, ka wain pal a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: If you do, your barns will be filled with grain, and you will have too much wine to store it all.

dag: Ka di teeri Izraɛlnima ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa maligumaana, ka mi pa ŋun yi Aduna zuliya ni na ku lan kana ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim Yawɛ tooni, ka din niŋ Kɔra min o nyaandoliba maa ti niŋ o kaman Yawɛ ni daa ka chɛ Musa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord . Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers.

dag: Ka di simdi ni ŋun nyo li maa paɣ o situra ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni na.
en: The person who burns them must wash their clothes and bathe their body in water; after that, they can return to the camp.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bin yini ka m bɔri ni n suh a; a mi di mɔŋ ma li.
en: Would you do me a favor? What do you want? Bathsheba asked.

dag: Zaŋmi salima mali bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di yaɣa anahi maa gbaya anahi la.
en: Make four carrying rings of gold for it and put them at the four corners, where the legs are.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duna n-yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nti nya ka bɔrɔbɔro doya, ka nya sala buɣim ka zahim pa di zuɣu.
en: When they stepped ashore, they saw a charcoal fire there with fish on it and some bread.

dag: Ka sagban shɛli daa sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ! Wummiy o noli.
en: Then a cloud appeared and covered them with its shadow, and a voice came from the cloud, This is my own dear Son—listen to him.

dag: yɛra, Ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋun be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, ti paɣir a a ni deeg a yiko din galisi n-diri nam zuɣu.
en: saying: Lord God Almighty, the one who is and who was! We thank you that you have taken your great power and have begun to rule!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuu shihi bɛ nina ka yɛli, Yi yɛda niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmiya lala.
en: Jesus touched their eyes and said, Because of your faith, you will be healed.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli: Zipɔr bia Balak, yiɣisima. Luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Balaam answered: Pay close attention to my words—.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba fabila mini bɛ kuhigu; bɛ kɔŋ bɛ jilima! Wummiya gbuɣima kuhigu; dama nyɔŋ din dolisi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili la saɣimya!.
en: Listen to the crying shepherds. Their powerful leaders were taken away. Listen to the roaring of the young lions. Their thick bushes near the Jordan River have all been taken away.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo ni o zaŋ niŋ o tulaale, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: There may be people who will want to make some of this incense for themselves so that they can enjoy the smell. But whoever does this must be separated from their people.

dag: Di ni nyɛ nyini n-fa bɛ yɛm ka bɛ bi lan mi shɛli maa, dinzuɣu a ku chɛ ka bɛ di nasara.
en: You have closed my friends minds, and they dont understand. Please dont let them win.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka sagbana zibigi ka sagani booi sagbana maa ni.
en: When I bring clouds over the earth, you will see the rainbow in the clouds.

dag: bɛn yɛli tia, Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ka yɛli kuɣili, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi ti. Dama bɛ lɛbila bɛ nyaansi biri ma, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ ma. Amaa muɣisigu yi ti paai ba, bɛ booni ma mi, Kamina ti tiligi ti.
en: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.

dag: Ka dunia nanim mini tiŋgbana zuɣulaannima ni sapashinnima ni bundaannima ni yikolaannima ni sokam zaa bɛn nyɛ daba bee bilichinnima zo nti sɔɣi zoya voya ni mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: Then the kings of the earth, the officials and the generals, the rich and the powerful, and everyone, slave and free, hid themselves in caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

dag: Yinim dee kul zomiyala Yawɛ, ka jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa, dama zahimmiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa tin ya la.
en: But you must honor the Lord . You must serve him sincerely with all your heart. Remember the wonderful things he has done for you.

dag: M puhiri Apɛlees ŋun wuh o ʒiɛyimtali Masia ni ni nyɛ shɛm la. M puhiri Aristɔbulus yiŋnim zaa.
en: and to Apelles, who has proved himself to be a true follower of Christ. Give greetings to everyone in the family of Aristobulus.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu, o ku chɛn ya bahi bee n-kun ya; o mi ku tam o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.

dag: Lihimiya ba kaman bɛn be kasi, dama bɛna n-zaŋdi yi Naawuni bindira maani sara. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun mali ya ka yi be kasi maa nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisiri neesim la, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn bi mili di soya ka bi ʒe di soya zuɣu la.
en: Some people rebel against the light. They dont know what God wants. They dont live the way he wants.

dag: Ka a nuu yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi ka ti kpe buɣim din bi kpiri ni .
en: If your hand makes you sin, cut it off. It is better for you to lose part of your body and have eternal life than to have two hands and go to hell. There the fire never stops.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi zuɣu ka kukoli maa tɔɣisiri maa, pa n zuɣu.
en: Jesus replied, This voice wasnt for my benefit but for yours.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa yɛliŋ zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo gba, di simdi ka di nyɛla mita pisinaayi.
en: On the east side, where the entrance is, the enclosure is also to be yards wide.

dag: Ka nimaani leei jɛŋgbina mini kunduna gɔbu shee, ka alizinnim be nimaani booni taba; ka Lilit ni kani nimaani na ti vuhira.
en: Wildcats will meet hyenas, the goat demon will call to his friends, and there Lilith will lurk and find her resting place.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, ka bɛ ku tooi nya; ka chɛ ka bɛ yaaŋkɔba gbarigi sahakam.
en: Strike them with blindness! Make their backs always weak!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni noli ni din ya; ka yi ni shɛb kul ni nyɛla daba sahakam; ka kabiri dari, ka ŋɔŋdi kom niŋdi n Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: Now, your people will have many troubles. All of your people will be slaves—they will have to cut wood and carry water for the house of God. .

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, N yi zaŋ o ti a, di so ni n zaŋ o ti do so, kpalimmi n sani.
en: Laban replied, It's better for me to let you marry Rachel than for someone else to have her. So stay and work for me.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛshua mini Kadimiɛl — pisopɔinnaanahi.
en: The Levites: the family of Jeshua and Kadmiel—the family of Hodaviah.

dag: Naawuni m-mi di shee, ka mi di soli ni be shɛli.
en: Only God knows the way to wisdom. Only he knows where wisdom is.

dag: amaa n nya zaligu shɛli n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni ka di mini n tɛha ni zaligu tuhiri taba n-zaŋ ma leeg alahichi din be n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni maa dabili.
en: But I see another law working in my body. That law makes war against the law that my mind accepts. That other law working in my body is the law of sin, and that law makes me its prisoner.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni jilima daa yi di ni be chɛrubi so zuɣu la n-chaŋ ti tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa boli do so ŋun ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka binshɛli din sabira be o luɣili zuɣu la.
en: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Nyama, biɛɣuni sa nyɛla goli palli dabisili, ka di simdi ni m mini naa sa laɣim ʒini di bindirigu; amaa chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi mɔɣu ni hal ti paai daba ata dali zaawuni.
en: Tomorrow is the New Moon Festival, David replied, and I am supposed to eat with the king. But if it's all right with you, I will go and hide in the fields until the evening of the day after tomorrow.

dag: Ka Sool daa laɣim ba luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Bɛzɛk la. Izraɛlnim kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita. Ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ tuhi pihita.
en: at Bezek. Saul had them organized and counted. There were , from Israel and , from Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam mini Balak daa doli chaŋ ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Huzɔt la.
en: They left and went to the town of Kiriath-Huzoth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei salima binshɛŋa sapashin kpamba mini sapashin bihi shɛb bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga sani maa tibisim daa miri kilɔgiram kɔbisiyi.
en: The total contribution of the officers weighed over four hundred pounds.

dag: Di saha Napaɣ Vashiti gba daa laɣimla paɣiba na, ka bɛ ti be nayili maa puhiri bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu maa.
en: Meanwhile, inside the royal palace Queen Vashti was giving a banquet for the women.

dag: n-yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi mini biɛɣ pinaanu dabisa n-leei vuhim dabisa yuuni kam.
en: He made it a rule that Jews keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar as special days each and every year.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam o ni yɛn leei naa deemba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ni zali saha shɛli maa daa ti yɛn paai.
en: Sauls officers told this to David. David was happy that he had a chance to become the kings son-in-law, so immediately.

dag: Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu, dama di sabiya: Noli ni di ŋunkam bi deei binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni n-dol li.
en: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.

dag: Hal bɛ sapashinnim mini bɛ tuumba ni pun paai Ijipti tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Zɔan mini Hanɛs la zaa yoli.
en: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ Ninivenim dini. Nahum ŋun nyɛ Ɛlikɔsh nir la ni daa nya ʒii shɛli litaafi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This book is the vision of Nahum from Elkosh. This is the sad message about the city of Nineveh.

dag: Ka a daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa m bela a sani n-nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a. N ni chɛ ka a yuli du kaman dunia ŋɔ ni wɔɣira yuya ni daa du shɛm la.
en: Ive been with you wherever youve gone. Ive eliminated all your enemies before you. Now I will make your name great—like the name of the greatest people on earth.

dag: Ŋunkam yɔhindi niriba, dilan ku be n yiŋa; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi ŋmari ʒiri, m mini dilan gba ku kpe.
en: I will never let a dishonest person live in my house. I will not let liars stay near me.

dag: N naan tooi zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsi yi suhuri, ka n suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa naan ku yi biɛrim maa.
en: But I would say things to encourage you and give you hope.

dag: Masia daa yihi ti dabitim ni, ka ti leei bilichinnima. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di lan niŋya nti leei daba yaha.
en: Freedom is what we have—Christ has set us free! Stand, then, as free people, and do not allow yourselves to become slaves again.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni, ka di bi simdi ni n tam o nirilim yɛla.
en: With all my heart I praise the Lord ! I will never forget how kind he has been.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali yi mabihi ansarisi bɛ nandahima dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali suhupiɛlli Judanim zuɣu bɛ kpimsibu dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi nyu bara n-niŋ ba bɛ wahala dibu dabisili dali.
en: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?.

dag: Nira yi wum alizanda nam yɛla ka bi baŋ di gbinni, Sintani kanimina nti to n-yihi din biri o suhu ni la. Dina n-nyɛ bimbir shɛŋa din lu sol zuɣu maa.
en: Whenever people hear the word about the kingdom and dont understand it, the evil one comes and carries off what was planted in their hearts. This is the seed that was sown on the path.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka bɛ be Mɔab naa maa sani saha shɛli zaa ŋun Dauda ni daa be vokabili maa ni maa.
