en: So David left his parents with the Moabite king, and they stayed with him the whole time David was in the fortress.

dag: Bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla dɔb tusaanahi m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: Four thousand men ate, plus women and children.

dag: Zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ pin shɛŋa Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya bɛn yi Babilɔn na la ni zaŋ ti la n-chaŋ Zɛfania bia Jɔsia yiŋa yomyom.
en: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have come from the captives in Babylon. Get silver and gold from these men and then go to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka di yɛli Yawɛ tɔbu tuhibu Litaafi ni, Wahɛb fɔntiŋ din be Sufa bɔbili mini vinvama ni Arinɔn Mɔɣili.
en: For this reason the scroll of the LORDs wars says: Waheb in Suphah and the ravines. The Arnon.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni bi zɔri Naawuni maa zuɣu, bɛ yɛla ku so, ka bɛ nyɛviya gba ku wɔɣa.
en: but no one who sins and rejects God will prosper or live very long.

dag: Sulemaana daa zaŋla naɣilahi tuhi pisinaayi mini piɛri tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ sani. Lala ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni.
en: Solomon killed , cattle and , sheep as fellowship offerings to the Lord . In this way the king and the people showed that they had dedicated the Temple to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n saɣ a ni bɔri shɛm maa, cham ti zaŋ Absalom na.
en: The king said to Joab, Look, I will do what I promised. Now please bring back the young man Absalom.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari ti paai Sool min o bidibisi n-ku o bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: The Philistines fought hard against Saul and his sons. They killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malki Shua.

dag: Yɛnnim bɛn sani, nyɛvili soli durila zuɣusaa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku siɣi tiŋgban ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Wise people walk the road that leads upward to life, not the road that leads downward to death.

dag: Amaa m bi mi n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm ti n dan Naa Siiza. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o ka yi sanna, di bahi bamdi nyin Naa Agiripa. Ti yi vih o naai, di pa shɛli n ni baŋ n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm;.
en: I have to write some facts about this man to the Emperor. So I have brought him before all of you, but especially before you, King Agrippa. After we have talked about his case, I will then have something to write.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, N ni be Hanun Nahash bia ŋɔ yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu kaman o ba ni daa be ma yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi Nahash kuli maa ti o. Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa ti paai Ammɔnnim maa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: King David said, I must show loyal friendship to Hanun, as his father Nahash did to me. So David sent messengers to express his sympathy. When they arrived in Ammon.

dag: Amaa zaligu palli ka n zaani ya ŋɔ; dina n-nyɛ, Yumiya taba! N ni yuri ya shɛm, yi gba yumiya tab lala.
en: But I am giving you a new command. You must love each other, just as I have loved you.

dag: O daa yɛlila yɛtɔɣa, ka koma din be zuɣusaa gbaai vubu. Ka o daa chɛ ka paɣili yi tiŋgban ni luɣilikam na, ka chɛ ka saanyaɣisibu be saa ni; ŋuna n-daa yihi pɔhim di biɛhigu shee na.
en: At his command the waters above the sky roar; he brings clouds from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning flash in the rain and sends the wind from his storeroom.

dag: Pur maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ booni vuhim dabisa chuɣu maa Purim. Bɛ ni daa sab gban shɛl la mini dinkam daa niŋ ba la zuɣu.
en: That is why the holidays are called Purim. Because of Mordecai's letter and because of all that had happened to them.

dag: Inok ni daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai yuun kɔbisita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Methuselah was born, Enoch walked with God for years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: N ni ti zani a tooni Sinai Zoli tampiŋ zuɣu, ka a ti zaŋ a jaaŋgbee maa fiɛbi tampiŋ maa, ka kom yi di ni na ka niriba maa nyu. Ka Musa daa niŋ lala Izraɛl kpamba maa ninni.
en: I will stand before you on a rock at Horeb. Hit that rock with the walking stick and water will come out of it. Then the people can drink. Moses did these things and the elders of Israel saw it.

dag: Ka n ni darigi Dauda zuliya tibili, amaa m bi yɛn darigi li hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: I will punish Davids descendants because of what Solomon did, but not forever.

dag: O na ʒi n-zaɣisi bee n-siŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari nahiŋgu; bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa ka n ni. O mi bi lɛbir o nyaaŋa biriti ma, amaa n yi kuhi niŋ o bɔri sɔŋsim, o wumda.
en: He does not neglect the poor or ignore their suffering; he does not turn away from them, but answers when they call for help.

dag: Saamba bɛn be yi sani biɛhigu ni ti du pam gari ya, amaa ka yinim biɛhigu ti labi nyaaŋa pam.
en: The foreigners living among you will get more and more power, and you will lose the power you had.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ shɛɣuni, ka Bɛnhadad laɣim Siria tɔbbihi n-chaŋ Afɛk ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: So in the spring, Ben-Hadad gathered the men of Aram and went to Aphek to fight against Israel.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka n suhu kul yɛya ni n yihi Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-ti yinim bɛn be Rom ŋɔ gba.
en: Thats why Im ready to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.

dag: Yi mi bi chɛ yi mabihi ŋɔ bahi di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ, amaa ka kul doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: During these many years, you never once deserted your fellow Israelites. You faithfully obeyed the command of the LORD your God.

dag: dama o daa na bela o yab Ibrahimma niŋgbuŋ ni, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣ o saha shɛli Mɛlikizɛdɛk ni daa tuhi ti yab Ibrahimma sol la.
en: Levi was not yet born, but he already existed in his ancestor Abraham when Melchizedek met him.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika maa daa ti wum ni Pool yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu Bɛria ka chaŋ nimaani gba nti dimdi niriba maa tiba ni ni bɛ taai duŋ.
en: When the Jewish leaders in Thessalonica heard that Paul had been preaching God's message in Berea, they went there and caused trouble by turning the crowds against Paul.

dag: Ka daa lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu niŋm tuuba a biɛribiɛtali ŋɔ zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni; di pa shɛli o ni chɛ a tɛhi biɛri din nyɛ alahichi maa paŋ a.
en: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sulemaana daa kari maligumaana Abiata Yawɛ maligumaanitali tuma ni, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli yiŋnim polo Shilo la niŋ pali.
en: Then Solomon dismissed Abiathar from serving as a priest of the Lord , and so made come true what the Lord had said in Shiloh about the priest Eli and his descendants.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi tooi kom maa m-mali bɛ zilima nyur li kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisita, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa daa gbanila tiŋ nyura.
en: Three hundred men scooped up water in their hands and lapped it, and the rest knelt to get a drink.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ ni mali wun shɛŋa la be ya? Bɛ yi ni tooi tiligi ya, yin chɛliya ka bɛ kana ti tiligi ya yi muɣisigu saha, dama yinim Judanima, yi fɔntinsi ni kul galisi shɛm, lala ka yi wuna gba galisi.
en: Where are the gods you have made for yourselves? Lets see if they will come through for you in your time of trouble. You have as many gods, Judah, as you have towns.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka niriba ni ti bɔhi, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be? Darigim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yih a daba ʒim maa tibili ka timaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: Dont give the other nations a reason to say, Where is their God? Cant he help them? Let us see you punish those people. Punish them for killing your servants.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi din niŋ ti la yɛla; lihimi ti ni nya filiŋ shɛm.
en: Remember, Lord , what happened to us. Look and see our shame.

dag: Amaa lee tɔɣisimiyala taba yɛlimaŋli yurilim puuni, ka zooi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la ni binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: Instead, by speaking the truth with love, lets grow in every way into Christ.

dag: ka ti mabia ŋun mi nyɛ azichilana ka Naawuni siɣis o, di simdi ni o gba mali suhupiɛlli, dama azichilana ni ti vuui kaman mɔpuma ni kpahiri luri shɛm la.
en: Believers who are rich should be glad when bad things happen that humble them. Their riches wont keep them from disappearing as quickly as wildflowers.

dag: N kahigi n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi; n suhu saɣimya n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.

dag: Ka bɛ naa ŋun be bɛ sani ni ti kah o nɛma buɣ o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu zaawun yuŋ yi, ka bɛ ti chibi gooni voli ka o doli dini yi. O ni ti zaŋ bini pil o nina din ni chɛ ka o nini ku nya tiŋgbani.
en: The prince who is ruling them will shoulder his pack in the dark and escape through a hole that they dig for him in the wall. He will cover his eyes and not see where he is going.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala. Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Gidiɔn yiɣisi asiba, o daa kahim piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu maligim palila pipia.
en: That is exactly what happened. When Gideon got up early the next morning, he squeezed the wool and wrung enough dew out of it to fill a bowl with water.

dag: Dama ti yi daa nyɛ Naawuni dimnima, amaa ka simdi yipa kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni o Bia la kum zuɣu, dindina din gari lala nyɛla, simdi ni kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ maa zuɣu, ti ni tilig o bia maa nyɛvili zuɣu.
en: I mean that while we were Gods enemies, he made friends with us through his Sons death. And the fact that we are now Gods friends makes it even more certain that he will save us through his Sons life.

dag: Di zaɣisi ma n kuriginsim saha, a mi di chɛ ma bahi n gbariginsim saha.
en: Do not reject me now that I am old; do not abandon me now that I am feeble.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka bɛ daŋ yibu ti chaŋ gili tiŋ maa kaman bɛ ni daa yi pun gindi li shɛm la napɔŋ buyopɔin. Kulla dindali maa kɔŋko ka bɛ daa gil li napɔŋ buyopɔin maa.
en: On the seventh day, they got up at dawn. They circled the city in this way seven times. It was only on that day that they circled the city seven times.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaɣila Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn nti niŋ sarika ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm ti Duuma Yisa yɛda, ka a min a yiŋnim zaa tiligi.
en: They answered, Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved—you and your family.

dag: Amaa o ni ti ti wun so ŋun guli sansana la jilima. O ni ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni kuɣ viɛla binyara ni pin suma n-ti wun so ŋun nyɛ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm.
en: In their place, he will worship a god of walled fortresses. With gold and silver, rare stones and precious things, he will worship a god his fathers did not acknowledge.

dag: N daa bi di bindir nyaɣisili bee ŋ-ŋub nimdi bee n-chɛ ka wain to n noli, m mi daa bi niŋ kpam ʒe n ni hal ka bakɔi muna ata maa ti gari.
en: I did not eat any rich food or any meat, drink any wine, or comb my hair until the three weeks were past.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa lihir o ka tɛhiri ni o nuu maa ni mɔri bee ni o ni yiɣi lu n-kpi; amaa bɛ ni daa lih o yuui nti nya ka shɛli bi niŋ o maa, ka bɛ daa lan taɣ zilinli yɛli ni o nyɛla buɣili.
en: They were waiting for him to swell up or suddenly fall down dead. But after waiting for a long time and not seeing anything unusual happening to him, they changed their minds and said, He is a god.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa boli Yaakubu na ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Isaac called Jacob and blessed him. Then Isaac gave him a command and said, You must not marry a Canaanite woman.

dag: Yi yi ti wum kikaa kumsi luɣ shɛli polo, yin laɣimmiya ti sanna. Ti Naawuni maa ni tuhi ti ti.
en: If you hear the bugle, gather around me. Our God will fight for us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi bidibikpamba bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: He listed all the firstborn men and boys who were one month old or older. There were , names on that list.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana nyɛla ŋun tiligiri nyɛviya, amaa ŋun ŋmari ʒiri ŋun nyɛla nyaanyira.
en: A witness saves lives when he tells the truth; when he tells lies, he betrays people.

dag: ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa, dilan yi nyɛla ninkurigu bee bia bee doo bee paɣa, bɛn kum o.
en: They agreed that anyone who refused to seek the LORD, Israels God, would be put to death, whether young or old, male or female.

dag: Kum doli ti takɔriti ni kpe na. Di kpe ti nanim yinsi ni di ku bihi solɔri zuɣu ka ku nachimba mi zama laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Death has climbed in through our windows and has come into our palaces. Death has come to our children who play in the streets and to the young men who meet in the public places.

dag: Bɛ tibidarigibo ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ karimbaani zuɣu m-bala, dama bɛ maani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara niŋdi ba.
en: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya lee yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiy o na.
en: Jesus said, You people don't have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy to me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord God said:.

dag: Wummiya satahiŋga din yi o kukoli ni na mini vu shɛli din yir o nol ni na.
en: Listen, all of you, to the voice of God, to the thunder that comes from his mouth.

dag: Ka Musa daa kana ti yɛli niriba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm min o ni zali shɛm zaa, ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li.
en: Moses told the people all the rules and commands from the Lord . Then all the people said, We will obey all the commands that the Lord has spoken.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ bi zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ kɔhi kaman tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri n-zaŋ ti nandaamba.
en: Why wasn't this perfume sold for three hundred silver coins and the money given to the poor.

dag: Yisa ni daa baŋ ni niriba maa loya ni bɛ gbaag o ni kiŋkansi ti leei bɛ naa maa, ka o daa ŋoli yi bɛ sunsuuni n-chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu m-be nimaani o kɔŋko.
en: Jesus knew that they were about to come and seize him in order to make him king by force; so he went off again to the hills by himself.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛla n-kul yiri bɛ suhuri ni na, ka nia biɛri lɔbu yɛla kul be bɛ tɛha ni.
en: Their eyes bulge out from eating so well; their hearts overflow with delusions.

dag: Bɛ yi pooi dabili o bilim ni, di bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: Give your servants everything they want, and they will learn to be wasteful.

dag: Juda zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti ba n-zani kaman tia din ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga wali wala.
en: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.

dag: Ka o daa be mɔɣu maa ni biɛɣ pihinahi, ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-daa be mɔɣu maa ni, ka malaikanim daa kanna nti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: He was in the wilderness for forty days, tempted by Satan. He was among the wild animals, and the angels took care of him.

dag: O ni daa kpe yili maa ni ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kumdi ka fabindi lala? Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: He entered the house and said, Why are you people crying and making so much noise? This child is not dead. She is only sleeping.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛnkam mali Naawuni ni ti ba pina balibubalibu shɛŋa tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga zaŋdi li sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: And serve each other according to the gift each person has received, as good managers of Gods diverse gifts.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa chaŋ ti liri Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ tuhi ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia Bɛzɛk.
en: and Judah went into battle together. The Lord gave them victory over the Canaanites and the Perizzites, and they defeated ten thousand men at Bezek.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: Job had sons and daughters.

dag: N ni yɛli ya shɛli zibisim ni, yɛlimiya li neesim ni; ka yi ni wum shɛli ashilɔni, yin molimiya li gili luɣilikam.
en: I tell you all this secretly, but I want you to tell it publicly. Whatever I tell you privately, you should shout for everyone to hear.

dag: Dinzuɣu do yino ŋun niŋgbuŋ daa gbarigi zaa la daa leei ŋun dɔɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi kaman saŋmarisi bee kaman teeku noli bihigu din ka kalinli ŋɔ.
en: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi yi lɔri noli, yin di zaɣiriya yi ninani kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ zaɣirila bɛ ninani ni niriba nya ba m-baŋ ni bɛ lɔri noli. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: And when you fast, do not put on a sad face as the hypocrites do. They neglect their appearance so that everyone will see that they are fasting. I assure you, they have already been paid in full.

dag: ka lan ka bikpamba bɛn yuya sabi alizanda ni la laɣiŋgu ni na. Yi lan kala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ sokam zaa sariakarita mini wuntizɔriba bɛn mali m-be tibi la shihi sanna.
en: to the assembly of Gods firstborn children who are registered in heaven, to God the judge of all, to the spirits of the righteous who have been made perfect.

dag: N zɔnim larila mani ŋun suhi Naawuni ka o deei n suhigu ŋɔ, mani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun ka galimi ŋɔ, ka bɛ lari ma.
en: Even my friends laugh at me now; they laugh, although I am righteous and blameless; but there was a time when God answered my prayers.

dag: Saɣiŋgu! Dabari zanibu! Saɣiŋgu! Niriba suhuri ŋooya, ka bɛ duna ŋmɛri taba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ nina mɔhi zaa.
en: Destruction and devastation; the city is laid waste! The heart grows faint and knees buckle; there is anguish in every groin; all the faces grow pale.

dag: Bɔhimmiya zaɣ viɛlli tumbu. Niŋmiya din tuhi, ka sɔŋdi bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka niŋdi kpibisi di ni simdi ni yi niŋ ba shɛm, ka sɔŋmiya pakoya.
en: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiligira ŋɔ, chɛ ka n nol ni yɛtɔɣa mini n suhu ni tɛha zaa nyɛ din tiɣi a nini.
en: Let the words of my mouth and the meditations of my heart be pleasing to you, LORD, my rock and my redeemer.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Zadok, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi tiŋ maa puuni ti zali, Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ma, o ni lan zaŋ ma labisina ka n nini ti nya di min o biɛhigu shee.
en: King David said to Zadok, Take Gods Holy Box back to Jerusalem. If the Lord is pleased with me, he will bring me back and let me see Jerusalem and his Temple.

dag: So kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya. Tim kani din ni tibi yi daŋ maa. Yi ku nya tibbu.
en: There is no one to care for your sores, so you will not be healed.

dag: Dama nyini n-galisi, ka tumd alahiziba tuma; a ko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: You are great and do amazing things. You and you alone are God.

dag: Amaa ka man ti tuui, ka bɛn laɣimmi mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka lan laɣim lu n zuɣu. Ka ninvuɣ yoya pahi m-maani ma ansarisi ka bi chɛra.
en: But when I was in trouble, they were all glad and gathered around to make fun of me; strangers beat me and kept striking me.

dag: Dama o suhuyiɣisili bi yuura, ka o nyɛ ŋun kul niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam. Di pa shɛli kuhigu ni beni yuŋ, amaa ka suhupiɛlli mi be biɛɣ neebu ni.
en: His anger lasts for a little while, but then his kindness brings life. The night may be filled with tears, but in the morning we can sing for joy!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima niŋ binyɛribila maa naŋgbambiya.
en: It had two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastened around the waist.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Shɛkɛmnim gba nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tibidarigibo kaman Gidiɔn bia Jɔtan la ni daa pun yɛli noli ti ba wuhi ni di ni niŋ ba shɛm la.
en: God also made the men of Shechem suffer for their wickedness, just as Jotham, Gideon's son, said they would when he cursed them.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ wuna din pa Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka zaŋ bɛ buɣa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi. Lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka bɛn pa niriba niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi.
en: They made me jealous with things that are not really gods. They made me angry with their worthless idols. So I will use people who are not really a nation to make them jealous. I will use a worthless nation to make them angry.

dag: Dauda daa lan zali Lɛvi kpamba maa ni bɛ bom bɛ daŋ maa ni baansi mini biŋkumdiŋmɛriba bɛn ni tooi ŋme biŋkumda pampam, kaman mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa din ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli biŋkumda beni.
en: David commanded the leaders of the Levites to assign various Levites to sing and to play joyful music on harps and cymbals.

dag: Yawɛ ni gul a, a yibu min a lab kpe ni; pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord will protect you as you come and go, both now and forever!.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni chɛ piɛ nyaan shɛb kɔbiri ka su ba kom ka bɛ piɛli shɛm la. Zaɣ yini kam malila jaa, ka zaɣ yini bi pooi di ni.
en: Your teeth are as white as sheep that have just been shorn and washed. Not one of them is missing; they are all perfectly matched.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: The glory belongs to God forever and ever. Amen.

dag: Ka tin shɛli din miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba zaa ni paɣi bɛ nuhi bahi bɛ ni kabi naɣisa so nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni la zuɣu.
en: All the leaders of the town nearest the dead body must wash their hands over the cow that had its neck broken in the valley.

dag: Ka so yi mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa, bɛn zaŋm o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: Whenever someone has an infection of skin disease, they will be brought to the priest.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛl a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe, ka o ku ma? .
en: Now you want me to go and tell the king that you are here. The king will kill me.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, N di bi zaɣisi ka so chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di dunol shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: and he was very thirsty. He said, I wish I had a drink from the well by the gate at Bethlehem.

dag: Ka o daa lan chaŋ Manaasa mini Ifriim ni Simiɔn zuliya tinsi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Naftali zuliya tinsi ni nti gili bɛ dabari la ni zaa.
en: In the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, all the way up to Naphtali, he removed their temples.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n ta yi nanim bɛn be n sara maligu shee daɣiri, ka chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paai Yaakubu zuliya, ka chɛ ka bɛ tu Izraɛlnima.
en: I will make your Temple leaders unfit to serve there. I will destroy Jacob. Bad things will happen to Israel.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka m biɛrim maa bi naara? Bɔzuɣu ka di zaɣisi naabu? Yɛlimaŋli a ŋmanila kulibɔn shɛli din nyɛ yɔhiŋ; ka ŋmani ko shɛŋa din nyuui.
en: Why do I keep on suffering? Why are my wounds incurable? Why won't they heal? Do you intend to disappoint me like a stream that goes dry in the summer.

dag: Dama ŋuna m-bɔhiri biɛri niriba ʒim yihibu zuɣu. O bi tamdi bɛn nyari nahiŋgu kumsi yɛla.
en: Because the one who avenges bloodshed remembers those who suffer; the LORD hasnt forgotten their cries for help.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi laɣim taba ni naŋgban yini m-paɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ.
en: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka o suhu daa gbaai Daina Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa pam, ka o daa tɔɣis o yurilim mini suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: But he was so attracted to her that he fell in love and began expressing his feelings to her.

dag: Ka yi ni zaɣisi n saɣisigu ka bi deei n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Yaakubu, N dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha m-bɔŋɔ; zaŋm o dɔni ka o dɔɣi bihi ti ma, ka n zaŋ ba ʒili n naba zuɣu.
en: Here, take my servant Bilhah, Rachel told him. Have children by her, and I'll let them be born on my knees to show that they are mine.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa buɣisi n-kpe ka di mali shaara mini sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duri maa zuɣusaa.
en: The cedar beams and other stones that had been cut to size were on top of these foundation stones.

dag: Yawɛ soli dolibu nyɛla gooni din mali kpiɔŋ bɛn biɛhigu be tibi sani, amaa di nyɛla din kuri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The Lord protects honest people, but destroys those who do wrong.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa po pɔri ni bɛ ni gbibi alikauli maa, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni daalikauli maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then Josiah made all the people in Jerusalem and Benjamin promise to accept the agreement. The people of Jerusalem obeyed the agreement of God, the God their ancestors obeyed.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa daa mali o kpamba saawara, ka tim ti yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia, ka nyɛ Jɛhu yaaŋa la ni o kana ti chɛ ka bɛ nina pali taba.
en: After Judahs King Amaziah consulted with his advisors, he sent a challenge to Israels King Joash, Jehoahazs son and Jehus grandson. Come on, he said, lets go head-to-head.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa daa ti lan ŋmaligi ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni ka yɛri taba, Dauda daa tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi ti Filistianim nuu ni; ka o ti yiɣisi kpe pumpɔŋɔ n-zo Absalom zuɣu.
en: The tribes of Israel began discussing what to do next. They said, King David saved us from the Philistines and our other enemies. David left the country because he was running away from Absalom.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zan o nyaaŋa n-yɛli ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Jews joined in the accusation and said that all this was true.

dag: Niriba ni ti laɣim be Juda tiŋgbɔn ni mini di fɔntinsi zaa ni. Ka pukpariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu ti beni.
en: Those who live in Judah and its towns will dwell together with farmers and shepherds.

dag: Bihi n-nahindi n niriba, ka paɣiba su ba. N niriba, yi zuɣulaannima m-birigi ya, ka chɛ ka yi tum yi soya.
en: Moneylenders oppress my people, and their creditors cheat them. My people, your leaders are misleading you, so that you do not know which way to turn.

dag: ka a je suli niŋ Naawuni, ka chɛ ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yir a nol ni na?.
en: so that you return your breath to God and utter such words from your mouth?.

dag: Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahinahi, ka binshɛli din ŋmani ninsal nuhi be bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔna ni.
en: Each living being had four faces, four wings, and something that looked like human arms under their wings.

dag: Di piligimi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: It began just as God had said in the book written by Isaiah the prophet, I am sending my messenger to get the way ready for you.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu maa mini alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmanila taba. Di zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini. Maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.

dag: O ni yihi ma zaɣ biɛɣukam ni, ka ni gbib ma hal nti paag o daalizanda nam ni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: The Lord will save me when anyone tries to hurt me. He will bring me safely to his heavenly kingdom. Glory forever and ever be the Lords. Amen.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nyɛ ti naa? Bee a shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn su ti fukumsi? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani daa maan pahi, o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa maa min o yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: His brothers said to him, Will you really be our king and rule over us? So they hated him even more because of the dreams he told them.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times, and then the thing was taken back up into heaven.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Ka daɣila a nyɛla naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma dunia ŋɔ ni ni n dila yɛlimaŋli shɛhira. Ka ŋunkam suhu ye yɛlimaŋli zuɣu wumdi n yɛligu.
en: So you are a king? Pilate said. Jesus answered, You say that I am a king. I was born and came into the world for this reason: to testify to the truth. Whoever accepts the truth listens to my voice.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali firilatamdigu, ka zaŋ matarika kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili, ka di mini di lahi ni bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi zaa din be di ni ti nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: Then you must make a lampstand. Use pure gold and hammer it to make the base and the shaft. Make flowers, buds, and petals from pure gold. Join all these things together into one piece.

dag: Amaa n niriba Izraɛlnim bɛna, baa bi yɛn ŋuhi bɛ biŋkɔbigu gba bee daadam din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ woligi Izraɛlnim ka chɛ Ijiptinima.
en: But as for the Israelites, not even a dog will growl at them, at the people, or at their animals. By this, you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

dag: Ka daa yihi niriba maa ni bɔri do so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu o duŋ taabu min o ninvuɣ kubo zuɣu la bahi, ka zaŋ Yisa ti ba ni bɛ niŋ o bɛ ni bɔri shɛm.
en: He released the one they asked for, who had been thrown into prison because of a riot and murder. But he handed Jesus over to their will.

dag: Ka o daa yi Nɛgɛb n-chaŋ hal ti paai Bɛtɛl luɣ shɛli o ni daa tuui kpa o tanti suɣili zali piligu ni, ka di be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni la.
en: Then he left there and moved from place to place, going toward Bethel. He reached the place between Bethel and Ai where he had camped before.

dag: Ka n daa deei litaafi bila maa malaika maa nuu ni n-zaŋ ŋubi; ka di shiri malisi n nol ni kaman shir la, ka n ni daa ti ŋub li naai, ka di shiri to m puuni.
en: So I took the little scroll from the angels hand and ate it. In my mouth it tasted sweet like honey, but after I ate it, it was sour in my stomach.

dag: Nyam bɛ ni lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu shɛm, ka lo barina tumbu nia, ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: See how wicked people think up evil; they plan trouble and practice deception.

dag: N tir a zaligunim din nyɛ n ni yuri shɛli maa jilima; n kul ni bɔhindi li.
en: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii wɔribariba ayi, ka naa maa tim ba Siria tɔbbihi maa sani ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya.
en: They chose some men, and the king sent them in two chariots with instructions to go and find out what had happened to the Syrian army.

dag: Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka boli di yuli Ɛlbɛtɛl, Naawuni ni daa kahig omaŋ wuh o saha shɛl o ni daa yi o biɛli sani zɔri la zuɣu.
en: He built an altar there and named the place for the God of Bethel, because God had revealed himself to him there when he was running away from his brother.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, Naawuni ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu zuɣu, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi zaŋ yi niŋgbuna kaman sar nɛɔŋ din be kasi ka tiɣiri Naawuni nini la n-ti ŋun Naawuni. Dina n-nyɛ jɛmbu maŋli Naawuni sani.
en: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.

dag: Hal bɛ yi zaŋ takɔbi bee piɛma bee kpana bee baasali sua lir o bɛ ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: There is no sword that can wound him; no spear or arrow or lance that can harm him.

dag: Amaa n ni sabiri zaligu shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ bahi nyɛla zaligu palli, ka di yɛlimaŋtali yi palo Masia ni ni yi gba ni, dama zibisim kul vuurimi chana, ka neesim maŋli mi pum neei na.
en: But what I write is also a new command. It is a true one; you can see its truth in Jesus and in yourselves. The darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man gba zo Ninive din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ nambɔɣu gari lala? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni kalinli gari tuhi kɔbiga ni pisi, ka nyɛ bɛn ʒi bɛ tooni ni bɛ nyaaŋa m-pahi biŋkɔbiri pam zuɣu.
en: If you can get upset over a plant, surely I can feel sorry for a big city like Nineveh. There are many people and animals in that city. There are more than , people there who did not know they were doing wrong.

dag: Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa wurim bɛ nahiŋgu din daa doli Stiivin kubu nyaaŋa la zuɣu daa chaŋ hal ni Fɔnisia mini Saipurus ni Antiɔk. Bɛ daa mali Naawuni yɛligu n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim kɔŋko.
en: Now those who were scattered as a result of the trouble that occurred because of Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch. They proclaimed the word only to Jews.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun lo amiliya yɛla buɣisi li: Zaligu kul lo paɣ ŋun kuli doo mi tabil o yidana hal ni o yidana maa nyɛvili tariga; amaa o yidana maa yi ti kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni zaŋ chaŋ o yidana maa sani.
en: A married woman, for example, is bound by the law to her husband as long as he lives; but if he dies, then she is free from the law that bound her to him.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi yaha ni ŋunkam guni, di nyɛla talahi ni o doli fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: Again I swear to every man who has himself circumcised that he is required to do the whole Law.

dag: Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. .
en: From now on, I tell you, you will never see me again until you say, God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun mi daa yi Kamɛl na la chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: So David went to Hebron, taking with him his two wives: Ahinoam, who was from Jezreel, and Abigail, Nabal's widow, who was from Carmel.

dag: Mishima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamuɛl mini Zakur ni Shimɛi.
en: Mishmas family: his son Hammuel, his son Zaccur, and his son Shimei.

dag: Di kul tuɣituɣila taba kirikiri, ka so ku tooi woligi li.
en: Each clings to its pair; joined, they cant be separated.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan bɔhi Ibrahimma, Wula ka a daa lee tɛhi hal ti niŋ lala maa.
en: Why did you do it.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ŋmanila Izraɛlnim zaa. Bɛ yɛra, Ti kɔba kuuya zaa, ka ti lan ka tahima; ti yɛla naaya zaa.
en: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu maa daa nya yiko n-tɔɣisiri duhimaŋtali mini Naawuni mɔbu yɛtɔɣa, ka mali soli ni o wuh o fukumsi yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm chira pihinahinaayi.
en: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for months it was allowed to rule.

dag: Dama yɛlikpan shɛli n ni daa zaŋ tin ya la nyɛla n gba ni daa tuui deei shɛli. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa kpila ti daalahichi zuɣu kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm;.
en: I passed on to you what I received, which is of the greatest importance: that Christ died for our sins, as written in the Scriptures;.

dag: Taainim kurimbuni ha suhupiɛlli tiŋ la m-bala? Tiŋ maa ni ka niriba daa yi n-du teeku duli ti ʒini la?.
en: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli, N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, amaa di chaŋya katiŋ ti yaɣi. Suhimiya Naawuni ti ma.
en: So Pharaoh said, I will let you go and offer sacrifices to the Lord your God in the desert, but you must not go very far. Now, go and pray for me.

dag: Miri ka a laɣi suhuyiɣisilinim zɔri, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a mini haliyoyanim laɣim be.
en: Dont befriend people controlled by anger; dont associate with hot-tempered people.

dag: Ijiptinim ni tiri niriba sɔŋsim shɛli ka buchi, dinzuɣu man ni pa Ijipti yupaa m-bol li la Rahab ŋun nyɛ ʒinahigulana.
en: for Egypts help is utterly worthless. Therefore, I call her Rahab Who Sits Still.

dag: Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ka bukaata, ka Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ mi leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din bahi yoli, bɛ ni daa liri Judanima n-ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zuɣu.
en: Egypt will become a desert, and Edom a ruined waste, because they attacked the land of Judah and killed its innocent people.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di niŋ bɛn daa nyɛ yi tab la alahiziba, yi ni bi lan doli ba tumdi tuun yoya ŋɔ zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ saɣindi yi yuya.
en: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.

dag: yi yi niŋdi lala, yi bi yaala so yuri ka chɛ so, ka lan leei bɛn doli tɛhi biɛri soli kariti saria?.
en: Doesnt this show that you think some people are more important than others? You set yourselves up as judges—judges who make bad decisions.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o paɣ Jɛzibɛl Ilaija ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa min o ni zaŋ takɔbi ku Baal daanabinim zaa shɛm yɛla.
en: Ahab told his wife Jezebel what Elijah had done and that he had killed the prophets.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kpalim a yili ŋɔ ni ti chaŋ o sani ti maani bara n-suhir o liɣiri bee bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, ka ni ti yɛli, N suhir a, zaŋm ma zali maligumaana so zaani din ni chɛ ka n nyari bindirigu dira.
en: But if anyone is left from your family, he will come to my priest and beg for money or a little bread. He may even say to my priest, Please let me be a priest, so I will at least have something to eat.

dag: Di zaliya yi daazichi dunia ŋɔ ni, dama dunia ŋɔ ni di zahindimi, ka lɛla saɣindi li, ka tayiɣisi kabiri kpɛri zuri li.
en: Stop collecting treasures for your own benefit on earth, where moth and rust eat them and where thieves break in and steal them.

dag: dindina n ni chɛ ka a ʒi Izraɛl nam ʒiishee sahakam kaman n ni daa pun lo a ba Dauda alikauli yɛli, N kul ku chɛ ka ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kɔŋ o zuliya ni.
en: and I will keep my promise to David that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.

dag: Yisa daa pun mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa, dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni yino maa.
en: Jesus knew who would hand him over to his enemies. That is why he said, Not all of you are clean.

dag: Hal ka daa ti lo ni o ta Naawuni jɛmbu duu daɣiri, ka ti daa gbaag o. Ti daa naan tooi doli ti zaligu soli n-kar o saria.
en: and even tried to defile the temple. Thats when we arrested him.

dag: dama ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira.
en: Our God is like a destructive fire!.

dag: ka o zaŋ wain paɣ o dansi maa, ka niŋ kpam bɔbili li, ka zaŋ tana lo li, ka zaŋ o balisi omaŋmaŋ buŋa n-zaŋ o ti kpɛhi saamba yilikpɛrili n-gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: He went over to him, poured oil and wine on his wounds and bandaged them; then he put the man on his own animal and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.

dag: Yi gba ni nyɛ Naawuni bihi maa zuɣu ka Naawuni tim o Bia maa Shia ka o kana ti be ti suhuri ni kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: To show that you are his children, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who cries out, Father, my Father.

dag: dama o daa yɛli o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shihi o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: saying to herself, If I just touch his clothes, I will get well.

dag: Ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira maa yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, di ku yuui ka n shiri kana! Ami! Chɛ ka di niŋ lala. Kamina, ti Duuma Yisa!.
en: Jesus is the one who says that all of this is true. Now he says, Yes, I am coming soon. Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!.

dag: Ka Pool daa kul kpɛri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka kul wuhiri ba hal ni chira ata.
en: For three months Paul went to the synagogue and talked bravely with the people about God's kingdom. He tried to win them over.

dag: Amaa nyin tum alahichi n-gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni. A daai ma baɣil a nyaaŋa ka me buɣa, ka mali binnana zali n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: Instead, you have done more evil than any who were before you. You have made other gods and metal images to anger me. You have turned your back on me.

dag: ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum alahichi a sani maa mini biriginsim shɛli bɛ ni birig a sani maa zaa taali, ka zo ba nambɔɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbahi ba leei daba maa sani, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gba zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Forgive your sinful people for all the things they have done against you. Make their enemies be kind to them.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa bɔb gbaag o tizo Bɛnjamin n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam; ka Bɛnjamin gba daa zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam.
en: He threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and began to cry; Benjamin also cried as he hugged him.

dag: Daadam Bia dabisili ti yɛn ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi di pilibu shee m-mali ti ba di naabu shee shɛm la.
en: As the lightning flashes across the sky and lights it up from one side to the other, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

dag: Ka Dauda daa je suli Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu; ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: David was upset because the Lord had killed Uzzah. David called that place Perez Uzzah. It is still called Perez Uzzah today.

dag: Yisa daa ti yɛli salo pam, Yi yi ti nya ka sagbani dɔni gbinni, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi, ka o ti shiri mi.
en: Jesus also said to the crowds, When you see a cloud forming in the west, you immediately say, Its going to rain. And indeed it does.

dag: Di saha maa o bikpɛm sani la ŋun daa na bela puu polo nti kun na miri yiŋ na wum diɛma biŋkumda kumsi.
en: Now his older son was in the field. Coming in from the field, he approached the house and heard music and dancing.

dag: Sapashini maa ni daa wum Pool ni yɛli shɛm maa ka o chaŋ ti bɔhi sapashin kpɛm la, Tuun bɔ ka a lee yɛn tum ŋɔ? Doo maa nyɛla Rom tiŋbia.
en: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and told him about it. The officer said, Do you know what you are doing? This man is a Roman citizen.

dag: ka ŋun Yaakubu kɔŋko daa kpalim be nyaaŋa. Di saha ka do so daa kana ka o min o ti kpe val ni n-va hal ka biɛɣ ti neerina.
en: Jacob was left alone, and a man came and wrestled with him. The man fought with him until the sun came up.

dag: Ka Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia nira, ka nyɛ yuun pihiyɔbunaayi nir la daa deei nam maa di.
en: Then Darius the Mede, who was years old, took over his kingdom.

dag: Ka nabipuɣiŋga maa be o duu n-zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ salima gali wuɣi situr shɛli binyɛrigu di nachiinsi.
en: with riches of every sort for the royal princess, dressed in pearls, her robe embroidered with gold.

dag: Ka Liya daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayɔbu ti Yaakubu.
en: Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth son for Jacob.

dag: n-zaŋ Naawunitali shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: God has filled him with his power and given him skill, ability, and understanding for every kind of artistic work.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti liri tiŋgbɔn shɛli nim bɛn bi me goma gili bɛ tiŋkpansi ŋɔ. N ni chaŋ ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim ni suhudoo, ka bɛ zaa so bi me goma gili bɛ tinsi, ka mi ka dunokparita bee dunoyɔriti ŋɔ.
en: You will say, I will go up against the open country and come against a quiet people who all live securely without walls, bars, or doors.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di zɔr o dabiɛm, dama n zaŋ o min o niriba maa zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ a nuu ni. Niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn shɛm la.
en: The LORD said to me: Dont be afraid of him! I have handed him, all his forces, and his land over to you. Do the same thing to him that you did to Sihon, the Amorite king who ruled in Heshbon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa wuɣi alichɛbba shɛli maligumaana ni yɛn yɛri pahi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa zuɣu. Alichɛbba maa daa nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa zaa.
en: They also made the vests robe, woven completely in blue.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha, ka wuhi shihira din nyɛ ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi dunia tiŋgbani puuni;.
en: I will work wonders in the sky above. I will cause miraculous signs on the earth below. There will be blood, fire, and thick smoke.

dag: di yi ti wum kom ʒiɛɣu, di ni puhi n-niŋ wula kaman ti polli la.
en: at the scent of water, it will bud and produce sprouts like a plant.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Balak zaŋ Balaam du Bamɔtibaal din nyɛ luɣ shɛli din miri ka o ni tooi lihi nya Izraɛlnim maa viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: The next morning Balak took Balaam to the town of Bamoth Baal. From there they could see part of the Israelite camp.

dag: Di simdi ka yi piɛbil nyɛla ŋun ka daŋa, ka nyɛ yuun yini piɛbila. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bulaa ŋun be lala gba.
en: The lamb must be a one-year-old male, and it must be completely healthy. This animal can be either a young sheep or a young goat.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Miriya ka yi tahi bee n-chɛ ka so wum yi kukoya vuri bee n-chɛ ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi yi nol ni na; naɣila dahin shɛli n yi ti bahi ya noli ni yi tahima.
en: But Joshua had ordered the people not to shout, not to say a word until he gave the order.

dag: a ni daa zaŋ a nudirigu sa wain ti shɛl la. Amaŋmaŋ ni daa sa wain ti pol shɛli la.
en: Come and save this grapevine that you planted, this young vine you made grow so strong!.

dag: Di saha ka o ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa bi niŋ m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa bi niŋ maa.
en: The king will answer, The truth is, anything you refused to do for any of my people here, you refused to do for me.

dag: ni viɣu ni kulijuɣu ni kpiliŋkpi.
en: the tawny owl, the fisher owl, the screech owl.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisili kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan boli kpe Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Niriba Kubu Vinvamli.
en: So then, the time will come when this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. Instead, it will be known as Slaughter Valley.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda, Nyini n-nyɛ lala nir maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa piig a leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka daa fa a Sool nuu ni bahi.
en: You are that man! Nathan told David. This is what the LORD God of Israel says: I anointed you king over Israel and delivered you from Sauls power.

dag: Yi yi ti laɣim taba, di pala ti Duuma bindirigu dibu zuɣu ka yi laɣim;.
en: When you meet together, you don't really celebrate the Lord's Supper.

dag: Gbaridɔɣirili so daa be Listra. Bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dahin shɛli hal ti paag o ninkurilim ni o daa na ʒi n-yiɣisi zani chaŋ.
en: In Lystra there was a crippled man who had been lame from birth and had never been able to walk.

dag: Di ŋmanila Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu maligim din zɔri luri Ziɔn Zoya zuɣu na. Dama nimaani ka Yawɛ lo alibarika alikauli din nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus said to them, Be careful! Dont let anyone fool you.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka niŋdi yɛda binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka mali tahima binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan niŋdi ania binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Love never gives up; and its faith, hope, and patience never fail.

dag: Naawuni, ninʒeensinim yiɣisi lu n zuɣu; ninkuunsinim laɣimya m-bɔri ni bɛ yihi n nyɛvili, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi lihi nya a.
en: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi lan wuhimiy o yi yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: So I beg you to show him that you love him.

dag: Farigudeeriba mini alahichinim zaa daa kul laɣindila Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti wum o wuhibu;.
en: One day when many tax collectors and other outcasts came to listen to Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi zaɣis a zaligu dolibu di chɛrimi ka n suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: I am overcome with anger when I see wicked people, who have stopped following your teachings.

dag: Ka so yi ti tum o kpee taali, ka bɛ yɛli ni o poma, ka o kana ti zani duu ŋɔ ni a sara maligu bimbini gbini po.
en: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, I swear I am innocent.

dag: ni m ba daa yɛli ma, N saɣi kpibu; ka n yi ti kani, nyin zaŋm ma ti sɔɣi n ni daa gbi sil shɛli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ ma sɔɣi di ni la puuni; ka daa chɛ ka m-po di pɔri. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n-suhir o ni o chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi m ba ka labina.
en: My father made me promise, telling me, Im about to die. You must bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan. Now, let me leave and let me bury my father, and then I will return.

dag: A dim yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla, nyin di niŋ li yɛda, dama din chihira ayopɔin sɔɣi be di ni.
en: They may sound fine, but don't believe him, because his heart is filled to the brim with hate.

dag: Nyama, n-nyɛ Ribɛka, zaŋm o kuli nti chɛ ka o leeg a dan bia maa paɣa kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Here is Rebecca; take her and go. Let her become the wife of your master's son, as the Lord himself has said.

dag: N yi ti saɣim Ijiptinim nam sulinsi, ka bɛ bara nyubu yiko naai, wuntaŋ ni ni ti zibigi Tɛhafinɛhɛs, ka sagbana ti lim tiŋ maa. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ tiŋkpansi niriba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Darkness will fall on Tahpanhes when I break the power of Egypt and put an end to the strength they were so proud of. A cloud will cover Egypt, and the people of all her cities will be taken prisoner.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba, Yihimiya salima tibikpara din be yi paɣiba tiba ni mini yi bipuɣinsi tiba ni ni din be yi bidibisi sani n-zaŋ na ti ti ma.
en: Aaron said to them, All right, take out the gold rings from the ears of your wives, your sons, and your daughters, and bring them to me.

dag: Gbariti ni ti yiɣi jɛm kaman waliga la, ka biriti ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli. Kom ni ti zɔri yiri tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ nɛl la ni na. Ka mɔɣa ti dɔni di ni.
en: Then the lame will leap like the deer, and the tongue of the speechless will sing. Waters will spring up in the desert, and streams in the wilderness.

dag: Ka a ni tum din chihiri mini pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, a bi teeg a ni daa nyɛ bia saha shɛli, ka be a zaɣim n-do a ʒim ni talindi la yɛla.
en: You were so busy sinning and being a prostitute that you refused to think about the days when you were young and were rolling around naked in your own blood.

dag: Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Shammai mabia la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛtɛrit mini Jɔnatan, Amaa ka Jɛta ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children.

dag: Ti Duuma wurim Yaakubu zuliya ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa, ka bi zo ba nambɔɣu. O suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka o daa wurim Juda bipuɣiŋga yaa ni be luɣ shɛli polo la. O chɛ ka nama mini di nanim lu tiŋa n-nya filiŋ.
en: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.

dag: Ka Pool daa yiɣisi zani n-kpuɣ o nuu gahiri ka yɛri ba, Yinim Izraɛlnim mini yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Naawuni, wummiya!.
en: Standing up, Paul gestured with his hand and said, Fellow Israelites and Gentile God-worshippers, please listen to me.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ yɛda; dama Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: And so they were not able to believe, because Isaiah also said.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba ka daa ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: Jesus was teaching in the Temple area. He asked, Why do the teachers of the law say that the Messiah is the son of David?.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, bɛ ni shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim beni ni bemi kaman dachɔhira la yi nina ni, ka be kaman gɔhi n-kuhiri yi luɣa ni, ka ni muɣisi ya pam yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa.
en: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those that are left will be as troublesome as splinters in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they will fight against you.

dag: Yi kul ni kpalim bela Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol maa ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ tumdi Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm hal ni daba ayopɔin, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama Yawɛ n-zali ma lala.
en: You must stay at the meeting tents entrance for seven days, day and night, observing the LORDs requirement so you dont die, because thats what I was commanded.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi nam fukumsinim yɛligu dolibu zaɣisila Naawuni ni zali shɛli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala ni bo tibidarigibo ti bɛmaŋa.
en: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa nyɛ anab maa daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: So the young prophet went to Ramoth-gilead.

dag: Bɛ gbiri kɔsoya tampima ni, ka bɛ nina nyari binviɛla kam.
en: They cut tunnels through the rocks and see all the treasures they hold.

dag: Lala ka Lɛvi zuliya ni so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ o gari.
en: Likewise, a Levite came by that spot, saw the injured man, and crossed over to the other side of the road and went on his way.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, a mi ni anabinim kul be kpe n-yɛri ba, Tɔbu ku lan ŋmɛn ya, ka kum mi ku lan lu yi zuɣu, amaa n kul yɛn tin ya la suhudoo ni yɛlimaŋli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: I replied, The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi gbibi n zaligunima ka dol li: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Obey my laws and teachings—I am the Lord .

dag: A mi bɛ ni turi ma, ka dihiri ma vi, ka filindi ma shɛm yɛla; a mi n dimnim zaa.
en: You know how I am insulted, how I am disgraced and dishonored; you see all my enemies.

dag: Ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkpam la nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni bɛ booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka Filistia tɔbbihi zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti bo o shee. Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka yi n-chaŋ ni o ti liri ba.
en: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they all marched up to find him. David heard this and went out to confront them.

dag: Amaa bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa n-nyɛ nir ni ni di shɛli ka ku kpi.
en: Here is the bread that comes down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will never die.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa; ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli nyaaŋa.
en: They arrested Jesus and took him away into the house of the High Priest; and Peter followed at a distance.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ni suhudoo, man dee min a ni daa pun lo tab alikauli Yawɛ yuli ni, ka yɛli ni Yawɛ be ti sani, ka ni ti lan be ti bihi gba sani sahakam ŋɔ saɣiya. Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ, ka Jɔnatan mi lab kuli.
en: Jonathan said, Take care of yourself. And remember, we each have asked the Lord to watch and make sure that we and our descendants keep our promise forever. David left and Jonathan went back to town.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Leeban bidibisi yɛrimi, Yaakubu n-fa ti ba binshɛɣukam zaa, ka binshɛlikam din nyɛ ti ba dini, dina ka o zaŋ nya buni.
en: One day Jacob heard Labans sons talking. They said, Jacob has taken everything that our father owned. He has become rich—and he has taken all this wealth from our father.

dag: N ni chɛ ka sida tihi mini akasia tihi ni mitil tihi ni olivi tihi ni sipirɛs ni oki tihi ni gahi ti galisi mɔɣu ni.
en: I will make cedars grow in the desert, and acacias and myrtles and olive trees. Forests will grow in barren land, forests of pine and juniper and cypress.

dag: Ka Yisa bol o, Mariama! Ka o ŋmalig o polo ka yɛli Hiburuli ni, Rabɔni! Di gbinni nyɛla, Karimba.
en: Then Jesus said to her, Mary! She turned and said to him, Rabboni. The Aramaic word Rabboni means Teacher.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma kul maani ma la ansarisi. Bɛ yi nya ma, bɛ viinila bɛ zuɣuri.
en: Ive become a joke to my accusers; when they see me, they just shake their heads.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi, ka piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ sɔɣi gbaag o salo ni ka o sani saha shɛli.
en: He agreed and started looking for a good chance to betray Jesus when the crowds were not around.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya ni bɛ daa na bi dɔɣi ma, ka o pii ma leeg o dabili ni n zaŋ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima, ka yam yɔɣu la labis o sanna. Yawɛ ti ma jilima. N kpiɔŋ yirila n Naawuni sanna.
en: The Lord is the one who made me in my mothers womb, so that I could be his servant. He wanted me to lead Jacob and Israel back to him. The Lord gives me honor. I get my strength from my God.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa dii moli gili Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: News about Jesus quickly spread all over Galilee.

dag: N yurinima, di bɔhiya biɛri yi toli, amaa chɛliya biɛri bɔhibu tila Naawuni ŋun su tibidarigibo yɛla ŋɔ, dama di sabiya ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi.
en: My friends, dont try to punish anyone who does wrong to you. Wait for God to punish them with his anger. In the Scriptures the Lord says, I am the one who punishes; I will pay people back. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli yɛli, Chamiya! Ka bɛ daa yi dɔb maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ zaa daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: Jesus said to them, Go! So the demons left the men and went into the pigs. Then the whole herd of pigs ran down the hill into the lake, and all were drowned.

dag: Ka Yaakubu maa daa nyɛ Yisifu ba; ka Yisifu mi daa nyɛ Mariama ŋun daa dɔɣi Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la yidana.
en: Jacob was the father of Joseph. Joseph was the husband of Mary, and Mary was the mother of Jesus, who is called the Messiah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yɛlim ba, Di chaŋya ti tuhi ba, dama n ku be yi sani, di yi pa lala yi dimnim maa ni nyaŋ ya. .
en: But the LORD told me: Tell them: Dont go up! Dont fight because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ ti mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: They will ridicule him, spit on him, torture him, and kill him. After three days, he will rise up.

dag: Teem a nuu zuɣusaa tirina. Yihim ma kom din galisi pam ŋɔ ni tiligi ma. Tiligim ma tinzunnim nuu ni.
en: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi niriba maa zuɣu ni ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla, amaa o ni daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bahi mol li gili.
en: Then Jesus ordered the people not to speak of it to anyone; but the more he ordered them not to, the more they told it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sa Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa dahin shɛli, ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili din nyɛ alikauli suɣili maa. Sagbani maa daa bela Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa m-be kaman buɣim la yuŋ zaŋ hal ni asiba.
en: On the day the Holy Tent, the Tent of the Agreement, was set up, a cloud covered it. At night the cloud over the Holy Tent looked like fire.

dag: Zaŋmi dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba; ka kpammi ba jaande, ka kpahimi bɛn wumd a wuhibu zuɣu ni a fukumsi zaa subu puuni. Di chɛ ka so ʒiɛm a.
en: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Filip, m min a ni be ka di yuui ŋ-ŋɔ ka a na bi mi ma? Ŋun nya ma, o nya m Ba; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n wuhimi ya m Ba maa.
en: Jesus replied, Dont you know me, Philip, even after I have been with you all this time? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, Show us the Father?.

dag: Ibram ni daa wum ni bɛ tuhi gbaag o dɔɣim maa chaŋ maa, ka o daa zaŋ o tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o yiŋ puuni, ka bɛ nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisaayika n-kari bɛ naba hal ti paai Dan.
en: that his nephew Lot had been taken away. Three hundred and eighteen of Abram's servants were fighting men, so he took them and followed the enemy as far north as the city of Dan.

dag: Chɛli sujee mini suhuyiɣisili. Chɛli suhuyiɣisili, dama di nyɛla din kpɛhiri nir zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Don't give in to worry or anger; it only leads to trouble.

dag: Tiligim amaŋa kaman waliga ni tiligi tɔha nuu ni shɛm la bee kaman nooŋa ni tiligi noongbahira nuu ni shɛm la.
en: Get out of the trap like a bird or a deer escaping from a hunter.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim n ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ninni maa sani.
en: But instead, I acted for the sake of my name so that it wouldnt be degraded in the sight of the nations who saw me lead them out of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima ni o Ba Naawuni mini malaika kasinim jilima, o gba ni ti zo vi dilana zuɣu.
en: Dont be ashamed of me and my teaching. If that happens, I will be ashamed of you when I come with my divine greatness and that of the Father and the holy angels.

dag: So ni ti gbaag o daŋ puuni ninvuɣ so n-yɛl o, A mali binyɛrigu, leemi ti zuɣulana n-su binshɛɣukam din wurim doya ŋɔ.
en: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.

dag: yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli ti Duuma shiri neei kum ni; hal o yi Saimɔn zuɣu.
en: And they learned from the group that the Lord was really alive and had appeared to Peter.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Jɛrimia bee anabinim la ni yino.
en: They answered, Some people say you are John the Baptizer. Others say you are Elijah. And some say you are Jeremiah or one of the prophets.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tuɣili tulaale zim din bi be kasi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu. Yi mi di zaŋya biŋkɔbigu nyo buɣim bee n-zaŋ bindir kuma mali sara di zuɣu bee m-booi wain bahi di zuɣu.
en: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n suhu daa yiɣisi ka n je suli niŋ Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka chɛ ka di bahi yoli n-leei dabari doya kaman di ni na kul doya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So I showed my anger against them. I punished the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem. My anger made Jerusalem and the towns of Judah the empty piles of stone they are today.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa na maa daa nyɛla din ni tooi zaŋ tum tuma maa zaa ka guui.
en: because what they had already brought was more than enough to do all the work.

dag: bɔ n-lee nyɛ ninsalinima ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla bee daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be bɛ ni?.
en: what are human beings, that you think of them; mere mortals, that you care for them?.

dag: Zomiya tiligi yi nyɛviya. Zomiya kaman mɔɣu ni buŋa m-be tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Run for your lives! Head into the desert like a wild donkey.

dag: ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ la mini sida dari la ni mi ʒee la ni taaŋkɔro la ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa zaa tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so kɔzɔrim kom ni la ʒim ni.
en: He will then take the other wild bird, along with the cedarwood, crimson yarn, and hyssop, and will dip all of this into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun daa zali ya ŋɔ yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛli la zuɣu. Bɛ maanila maligu tiri Baal n-yiɣisiri n suhu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful planted you, and he said that disaster will come to you. That is because the family of Israel and the family of Judah have done evil things. They offered sacrifices to Baal, and that made him angry!.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chaŋ alizanda ni nti be Naawuni nudirigu polo n-su malaikanim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni bɛn nyɛ yikolaannim la.
en: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.

dag: Takɔbi ni ti be samban ni, ka alɔbo mini kum be tiŋ puuni, bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn be sambani, ka kum min alɔbo mi lu bɛn be tiŋ puuni zuɣu.
en: There is fighting in the streets, and sickness and hunger in the houses. Anyone who is out in the country will die in the fighting, and anyone in the city will be a victim of sickness and hunger.

dag: Ohola ni daa kul nyɛ m paɣa maa zaa yoli, o daa na kul tumdila pagɔrisigu tuma. O kɔre daa kul bela o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim.
en: But Oholah became unfaithful to me and lusted after her lovers the Assyrians.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be a niriba bɛn nyɛ a ni pii shɛba, ka bɛ galisi pam ka ka kalinli ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: I am your servant here among your chosen people. There are so many that they cannot be counted.

dag: Niriba yi ti neei kum ni, bɛ bi lan yɛn kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba; bɛ ti kul yɛn bemi kaman malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni la.
en: When God raises people to life, they won't marry. They will be like the angels in heaven.

dag: N Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni bi wum o noli zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla bɛn dari gindi yɔɣu zuliyanim sunsuuni.
en: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.

dag: Naawuni ti o naa nasara din galisi; ka wuhi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili la polo; zaŋ chaŋ Dauda min o zuliya sani pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.

dag: ka ŋun pahi ayɔbu nyɛ Atai, ka ŋun pahi ayopɔin nyɛ Ɛliɛl.
en: Attai was the sixth in command. Eliel was the seventh in command.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la kɔŋko zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Then Jesus replied, I have been sent only to the lost sheep of the people of Israel.

dag: Cham Naa Dauda sani yomyom ti bɔh o, N dan naa, a daa bi po pɔri man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani ni a ni chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ti di nam n-ʒin a nam ʒiishee? Ka di chaŋ wula ka Adɔnija nti di nam.
en: Go to King David and tell him, My lord and king, you promised me that my son Solomon would be the next king after you. So why is Adonijah becoming the new king.

dag: Ka Napaɣ Ɛsta ŋun daa nyɛ Abiheel bia la daa pahi Mɔdɛkai zuɣu ka bɛ sab gban shɛli din pah ayi zaŋ chaŋ Purim chuɣu puhibu maa yɛla polo.
en: Queen Esther daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai the Jew, wrote with her full royal power to show that this second letter about Purim was correct.

dag: Dinzuɣu Filistianima, bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la, di yi pa lala, yi ni leei Hiburunim maa daba kaman bɛ ni yi nyɛ yi daba shɛm la; bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la n-tuhi ba.
en: Be brave, Philistines. Fight like men. In the past they were our slaves, so fight like men or you will become their slaves.

dag: ni Maasɛya so mi mini Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛza ni Uzi ni Jɛhɔhanan ni Malikija ni Ɛlam ni Ɛzɛr. Ka Jɛzirahia daa gari tooni zaŋ yiliyiiniba ka bɛ yili yila.
en: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers.

dag: ka daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim anahi mini naɣilah anii ti Mɛrari bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka maligumaana Aduna bia Itama nyɛ bɛ tuma zuɣulana.
en: Four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the Merarites for their duty under the supervision of Ithamar, Aaron the priests son.

dag: Yawɛ, viim sagbana ka sheena. Shihimi zoya n-chɛ ka nyɔhi yi di ni na.
en: LORD, part your skies and come down! Touch the mountains so they smoke!.

dag: Lala ka o daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata ni bɛn zaa daa taɣiri biŋkɔbiri maa; Yi yi ti tuhi Iso soli, yin yɛlimiy o yɛtɔɣ yini maa.
en: Jacob also told the men in charge of the second and third herds and those who followed to say the same thing when they met Esau.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: Then King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to attack the city of Ramoth in Gilead.

dag: Lala ni daa niŋ maa ka nimaani ŋunkam mali dɔro ka Pool sanna ti nya bɛ dɔriti maa tib kpaŋ.
en: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.

dag: A ni daa na bi darigi n tibili la, n daa birigiya; amaa pumpɔŋɔ n dol a yɛligu.
en: Before I suffered, I did many wrong things. But now I carefully obey everything you say.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba kpɛhi bahiyoli shee.
en: They pleaded with him not to order them to go back into the abyss.

dag: Molimiya molo ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni n-yɛli ba: Malimiya shili n-tuhi tɔbu; bolimiya yi tɔbutuhiriba. Chɛliya ka tɔbutuhiriba zaa yina n-vu m-mirina!.
en: Make this announcement among the nations: Prepare for war; call your warriors; gather all your soldiers and march!.

dag: Bɛ tɛha din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ nyɛla din be zibisim ni; ka bɛ nuu ka Naawuni ni ti nyɛvil shɛl la ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ka nyɛ suhutunanima.
en: They have no understanding, and they know nothing because they refuse to listen. So they cannot have the life that God gives.

dag: Ka kul kpalimmiya be yil yin ni n-diri ka nyuri bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam, dama tumtumda kam simdi yɔri. Ka miriya ka yi lɔhiri yiya.
en: Stay with the same family, eating and drinking whatever they give you, because workers are worth what they earn. Don't move around from house to house.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ayuba bidibisi maa min o bipuɣinsi maa daa ti be bɛ biɛlikpɛm yiŋa n-diri bindira ka nyuri wain;.
en: One day Jobs sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine at the oldest brothers house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Daniɛl ka naa sanna ka naa maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ʒi dab shɛba yi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na yino, ka a yuli booni Daniɛl la?.
en: So Daniel was brought before the king. The king said to him, So you are Daniel, the Daniel from the exiles that my father the king brought from Judah?.

dag: Aduna ku paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa ni, o ni kpi, yi ni daa zaɣisi n zaligu Mɛriba kom la yɛla ni la zuɣu.
en: It is time for Aaron to die and go to be with his ancestors. Aaron will not enter the land that I promised to the Israelites. Moses, I say this to you because both you and Aaron did not fully obey the command I gave you at the waters of Meribah.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, ŋuhima; ŋuhimi ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini biɛrim pam bɛ ninni.
en: Mortal man, groan as if your heart is breaking with despair. Groan in sorrow where everyone can watch you.

dag: Ka n suhi a nyaandoliba ŋɔ ni bɛ kari alizin biɛɣu maa, ka bɛ bi tooi.
en: I begged your disciples to throw it out, but they couldnt.

dag: Dɛbɔra, yiɣisima, yiɣisima. Yiɣisima, yiɣisima, Yilimi yilli! Barak Abinɔam bia, yiɣisim zaŋ a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba la kuli!.
en: and said, Deborah, let's go! Let's sing as we march. Barak, capture our enemies.

dag: Di nyaaŋa n ni ku paɣ maa bihi, ka cheechinim zaa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri baŋdi din be salinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni, ka nyɛ ŋun ni ti yi zaa yinoyino yi tuma ni simdi shɛm laara.
en: I will also kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I am the one who knows what people feel and think. And I will repay each of you for what you have done.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma, hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm yuun pihinahi puuni la zaa yoli.
en: For years in the desert, your people saw what I did. But they tested me and my patience.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni, Naawuni ni ti kari wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri saria, dama o zali yɛlli kam mini tuuni kam saha.
en: I told myself, God is going to judge the righteous and the evil alike, because every thing, every action, will happen at its own set time.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka yi ku tum alahichi, amaa yi ni so yi tum alahichi, ti mali sandaantimda ŋun be ti Ba Naawuni sani: ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ wuntialan la.
en: I am writing this to you, my children, so that you will not sin; but if anyone does sin, we have someone who pleads with the Father on our behalf—Jesus Christ, the righteous one.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi Midian mini Ɛfa laakum pola na ti niŋ yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni. Ka Shiibanim zaa ʒi salima mini tulaale zim na; ka leei bɛn paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord .

dag: O dunɔdaya firi tiŋgban ni. Naawuni kabisi o dunokparita n-saɣim li. O naa mini nabihi bela tinzunnim sani. So bi lan wuhiri ba Naawuni yɛla, ka o daanabinim bi lan nyari ʒii Yawɛ sani.
en: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord .

dag: ka zaŋ nintua n-tu a nyee, ka zaŋ tibikpara kpa a tiba ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli pil a zuɣu.
en: a ring for your nose, some earrings, and a beautiful crown.

dag: Benya n ni, ka n gba be yi ni. Tiwulli ku tooi wali wala dimaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka pa ni di tuɣila tia; yi gba ku tooi wali wala, shee yi tuɣila mani.
en: Remain united to me, and I will remain united to you. A branch cannot bear fruit by itself; it can do so only if it remains in the vine. In the same way you cannot bear fruit unless you remain in me.

dag: Yi bemi kaman yidaampaɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi zina! Yi bi mi ni ŋun zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo nyɛla Naawuni dima? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo, dilana zaŋ omaŋ leela Naawuni dima.
en: You people are not faithful to God! You should know that loving what the world has is the same as hating God. So anyone who wants to be friends with this evil world becomes Gods enemy.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be o sani daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu. Ka niriba pam daa yi Lɛbɔhamat mini Ijipti kulibɔŋ polo kana.
en: Solomon and all the people of Israel celebrated the Festival of Shelters for seven days. There was a huge crowd of people from as far away as Hamath Pass in the north and the Egyptian border in the south.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛ dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ zuɣuri m-be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: These were the family leaders in their ancestor's clan, and they and their descendants lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa zaŋ o niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o o siliga ni m-pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: Ahaziahs servants carried his body in the chariot to Jerusalem. They buried him in his tomb with his ancestors in the City of David.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-daa zaŋ a ba Nɛbukadnɛza leei na titali, ka ti o di viɛlim mini di tibiginsim ni di jilima.
en: King, God Most High made your grandfather Nebuchadnezzar a very great and powerful king and gave him great wealth.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋdi mahili niŋdi sagban tibisa ni, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri yiri sagbana maa ni na.
en: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn jɛrigi ka ka yɛm. Bɛ buɣa maa ni wuhiri ba shɛli kul nyɛla dari wuhibu.
en: All of them are stupid and foolish. What can they learn from wooden idols?.

dag: N zahindi maa puuni, n daa lan nya ka kawana ayopɔin nyaɣi tam kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu n-kul ŋmɛlim baribara;.
en: In my next dream I saw seven heads of grain growing on one plant. They were healthy and full of grain.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni be ti bol o na ka bɛ tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣ shɛli. .
en: While Jesus was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers came and stood outside because they wanted to talk with him.

dag: Yi bi mi ni tizɔbo ni, tizɔriba zaa yi kul zɔra, ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko nti yɛn zo n-di? Dinzuɣu zomiya viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zo n-di.
en: Surely you know that many runners take part in a race, but only one of them wins the prize. Run, then, in such a way as to win the prize.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni di chɛ ka yi ku lan nyɛ bɛ daba, n kabi yi nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi la, ka chɛ ka yi tooi chana ka yi zuɣuri ʒe tibi.
en: I am the Lord your God. You were slaves in Egypt, but I brought you out of Egypt. You were bent low from the heavy weights you carried as slaves, but I broke the poles that were on your shoulders. I let you walk proudly again.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa wum lala ka bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, a bɔri ni ti chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba kaman Anabi Ilaija ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: When the disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them.

dag: Chɛ ka n kpe a biŋkɔbiri maa ni zuŋɔ ti gahim piɛ shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi mini bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni piɛbihi sabila ni bu shɛb bɛn mali sabilimsabilim mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bubihi sabila; ka bɛ leei n yɔri.
en: Let me go through your flocks and herds and take the sheep and goats that are either spotted or speckled and the black lambs. That's all you need to give me.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Sool ni be luɣ shɛli maa ti nya o ni do luɣ shɛli polo, ka Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi zuɣulan la do o sani. Sool daa dola suɣa maa sunsuuni, ka tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: Then he sneaked up to Saul's camp. He noticed that Saul and his army commander Abner the son of Ner were sleeping in the middle of the camp, with soldiers sleeping all around them.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ku yɛligu maa o suhu ni, ka di bi dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim.
en: And what about the seed that fell among the thorny weeds? That is like the people who hear the teaching but let worries about this life and love for money stop it from growing. So it does not produce a crop in their lives.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zal o dabili Musa shɛm, lala ka Musa gba daa zali Jɔshua; ka Jɔshua mi daa niŋ kaman o ni zal o shɛm. O daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka bi chɛ di shɛli bahi.
en: The Lord had given his commands to his servant Moses, Moses had given them to Joshua, and Joshua obeyed them. He did everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus answered them, It is the sick people who need a doctor, not those who are healthy.

dag: Bee a lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la.
en: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be Akasia saha shɛli ka bɛ daa piligi bɔri Mɔab paɣiba.
en: While the Israelites were camped near Acacia, the men committed sexual sins with Moabite women.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tin ya ko mahim biɛla yi ni nyɛ Masia nyaandoliba la zuɣu, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: And anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name, just because you belong to me, will surely be rewarded.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Rubin zuliya kul beni, ka ku kpihim, hal o zuliya kalinli ni kul pɔri maa zaa yoli.
en: I pray that Reuben lives, doesnt die, though his numbers are so few.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yi Sulemaana zuɣu yuŋ yɛl o, N wum a suhigu maa, ka pii kpe ŋɔ ni di nyɛ n sara maligu duu.
en: Then the LORD appeared to Solomon at night and said to him: I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place as my house of sacrifice.
