dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla daa niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, ka o daa chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, he saw a large crowd of people. He felt sorry for them, and he healed the ones who were sick.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm la? Jɛra mali tahima pam gari ba.
en: The most stupid fool is better off than those who think they are wise when they are not.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ anzinfa duhi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka zaŋ situra duhi kaman yaɣiri maa zaa yoli.
en: Evil people collect silver as easily as dirt. They may have so many clothes that they are piled up like clay.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan boli niriba pam na ti yɛli ba, Yi zaa luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: Jesus called the crowd together again and said, Pay attention and try to understand what I mean.

dag: Yi tuumbiɛri n-chɛ ka m-mɔŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnima, ka yi daalahichi mɔŋ ya din viɛla.
en: That's why I cannot bless you! *.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti yɛl a mini Yawɛ finafina; suhim Yawɛ ti ti ka o vuui tinvura maa ka chɛ ti. Ka Musa daa suhi Naawuni ti niriba maa.
en: Some of the people went to Moses and admitted, It was wrong of us to insult you and the Lord . Now please ask him to make these snakes go away. Moses prayed.

dag: Yisa daa ti be tin shɛl ni, ka kɔŋ ni daa wuligi do so niŋgbuŋ zaa ka o sanna ti damd o tooni balind o yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: Jesus was in one of the towns where there was also a man covered with a skin disease. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged, Lord, if you want, you can make me clean.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Nyama, n lan nya dimbɔŋɔ, n zaŋla binshɛŋa pahi di tab ni ni m baŋ di laasabu.
en: The Teacher says, I added all this together to see what answer I could find. I am still looking for answers, but I did find this: I found one good man in a thousand. But I did not find even one good woman.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa nya Dauda ka ʒiɛm o, dama o daa kul nyɛla bisariŋga ka mal alaafee, ka viɛli pam.
en: and when he got a good look at David, he was filled with scorn for him because he was just a nice, good-looking boy.

dag: daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti o.
en: He went to Pilate and asked to have Jesus body. Pilate gave orders for the soldiers to give Jesus body to him.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa tumbu, ka doli n zaligunima zaa, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: Now, if evil people change their lives, they will live and not die. They might stop doing all the bad things they did and begin to carefully obey all my laws. They might become fair and good.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya sahakam. Ka o suhu ni tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But the Lord s decisions are good forever. His plans are good for generation after generation.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o tɔbbihi zaa Tɛlaim na nti kali ba, ka bɛ tinchandiba kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyi, ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Saul gathered the army together at Telaim. There were , foot soldiers and , other men, including the men from Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal viɛla maa ni be shɛm maa, lala ka n lihi Juda ninvuɣ shɛb n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi n-zaŋ ba kpe chaŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka bɛ viɛla.
en: The LORD, the God of Israel, proclaims: Just as with these good figs, I will treat kindly the Judean exiles that I have sent from this place to Babylon.

dag: O daa daŋ kala omaŋmaŋ zuliya sanna, ka bɛ ti bi deeg o.
en: He came into his own world, but his own nation did not welcome him.

dag: n-yɛli, Man Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni bi mɔŋ ma a bigaŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni ŋmaligi po mmaŋa.
en: and said, I give my word as the LORD that because you did this and didnt hold back your son, your only son.

dag: Ka Yisa ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka zom maa yɛl o, Karimba, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Jesus asked, What do you want me to do for you? The blind man answered, Master, I want to see.

dag: Ti mi zɔri niriba ni ti yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: On the other hand, these people think John was a prophet, and we are afraid of what they might do to us. That's why we can't say it was merely some human who gave John the right to baptize.

dag: Hal Babilɔnnim yi du zuɣusaa ti me goondahi gili bɛmaŋa, n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba yi n sani chaŋ ti liri ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even if Babylon could climb to the sky and build a strong fortress there, I would still send people to destroy it. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: ka tiligi shɛba kaman buɣim ni ka yi tim yihi ba la. Ka chɛliya ka shɛb mi yɛla niŋ ya nambɔɣu ni dabiɛm; ka leeya bɛn je bɛ binyɛr taɣilima din be tiŋli ka bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre gabisi li la.
en: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye Jɛrusalɛmnima, zuŋɔ yi yi di baŋ din di naan tin ya suhudoo di di so; amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi bela zibisim ni zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: and said: It is too bad that today your people don't know what will bring them peace! Now it is hidden from them.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, N wumya ni kawana be Ijipti, chamiya nimaani nti da li ti ti na, ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: I have heard that there is grain for sale in Egypt. Go there and buy grain for us so that we will live and not die.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni so ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba n-niŋ o di yiko.
en: He said,For this reason I said to you that none can come to me unless the Father enables them to do so.

dag: Ka ti bɔri ni yi zaa yinoyino kul moor o nini lala hal ti paai di tariga, ka di chɛ ka yi ni mali tahima binshɛl zuɣu la niŋ pali.
en: We want each of you to be willing and eager to show your love like that the rest of your life. Then you will be sure to get what you hope for.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila mini bɛ suhigu alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Listen to their prayers from your home in heaven, and help them.

dag: Dali gba bɛ daa ni bɔ a pam kɔŋ, dinzuɣu cham yɛla ŋɔ ni daa yiɣisina ka a sɔɣi luɣ shɛl la nti ŋuni kuɣa din duhiya la lɔŋni.
en: The day after tomorrow, go all the way to the spot where you hid on the day of the incident, and stay close to that mound.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John wore clothes made from camels hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama o ni tɔɣisi suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-ti o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku ŋmaligi labi jɛrilim biɛhigu ni yaha.
en: Let me hear what the LORD God says, because he speaks peace to his people and to his faithful ones. Dont let them return to foolish ways.

dag: M mabihi, m paɣi ti tizɔpaɣ so ŋun yuli booni Fiibi, ka o nyɛ ŋun tumdi Naawuni tuma Sɛnkiria cheechi ni la.
en: I want you to know that you can trust our sister in Christ, Phoebe. She is a special servant of the church in Cenchrea.

dag: Di daa tuhiya ni Naawuni ŋun nam shɛlikam ka nyɛ ŋun gbib binshɛɣukam ŋɔ chɛ ka Yisa be tibi o wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ Naawuni bihi pam ka bɛ min o ti laɣim nya jilima; dama Yisa n-nyɛ bɛ toondana ŋun tahiri ba tiliginsim shee.
en: It was appropriate for God, for whom and through whom everything exists, to use experiences of suffering to make perfect the pioneer of salvation. This salvation belongs to many sons and daughters whom hes leading to glory.

dag: Ka yi ni daa be Kadɛshibarinia, ka Yawɛ tim ya ka yɛli ya, Chamiya ti deei n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa, ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu maa, ka bi niŋ o yɛda bee n-deeg o yɛligu.
en: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it! But since you didn't trust the Lord , you rebelled and disobeyed his command.

dag: Chɛ ka di nyɛla a kɔŋko dini, ka miri ka a niŋdi li tiri saamba.
en: Your children should grow up to help you, not strangers.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai min o kpamba maa, Nyamiya, mmaŋmaŋ bia m-bɔri ni o ku ma la, di ni ti be ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir ŋɔ? Chɛliy o ka o tu ma, dama Yawɛ n-zal o lala.
en: Then David addressed Abishai and all his servants: Listen! My own son, one of my very own children, wants me dead. This Benjaminite can only feel the same—only more! Leave him alone. And let him curse, because the LORD told him to.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba maa daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: So Noah went out of the boat with his wife, his sons, and their wives.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi so daa kana nti yɛl o, Karimba, n ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: A teacher of the Law came to him. Teacher, he said, I am ready to go with you wherever you go.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Man deei yi kul yi tiŋ puuni tariga, n yɛn zaŋla n nuhi duhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi ŋɔ mini sakuɣa ŋɔ zaa chɛ. Sakuɣa ku lan beni, ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to him, As soon as I go out of the city, I will lift up my hands in prayer to the Lord . The thunder will stop, and there will be no more hail, so that you may know that the earth belongs to the Lord .

dag: Cham ti yɛli ba ka bɛ labi bɛ suɣa ni.
en: Go and tell them: You may go back to your tents.

dag: Di saha maa, niriba maa daa kpahindimi ni bɛ nya shihirili shɛli. Ka bɛ daa dii deeg o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka yɛli, Iin, a mabia Bɛnhadad. Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti zaŋ o na. Ka Bɛnhadad daa ka o sanna, ka o ti chɛ ka o kpe chɛchɛbuŋ ni pah o zuɣu.
en: Taking this as a good sign, Ben-hadads men quickly accepted this statement. Yes, Ben-hadad is your brother! they said. Go and get him, the king ordered. So Ben-hadad came to him, and the king received him into his chariot.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhi pam yɛl o, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: They shouted back, Crucify him.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn ku niriba me tiŋ zali, ka tum tuumbiɛri zali fɔntiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Look at them! They kill people to build their city and do wicked things to make their walled city strong.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia maa ni daa tum tuun shɛli n-zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu m-bala.
en: Those were the brave deeds of Benaiah, who was one of The Thirty.

dag: ka Ammiɛl pah ayɔbu, ka Isaka pah ayopɔin, ka Pɛulɛtai daa pah anii; dama Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.

dag: O daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa o ba ni daa tum la, ka o suhu daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la yim kaman o yab Dauda suhu ni daa ʒiɛya shɛm la.
en: Abijam followed all the sinful ways of his father before him. He didnt follow the LORD his God with all his heart like his ancestor David.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti doli bɛ tuma, ka zana gbahi ya. Di ti bɔhiya bɛ wuna yɛla n-yɛra, Wula ka niriba ŋɔ daa lee jɛmdi bɛ wuna ŋɔ? Ti gba bɔri ni ti jɛm li.
en: But be careful that you dont fall into the same trap they did! Dont go to their false gods for help. Dont say to yourself, They worshiped these gods, so I will worship them too.

dag: Bɛ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu lu o zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun yɛn fiɣis o zan o nudirigu polo.
en: Appoint a wicked person to be against this person, they say, an accuser to stand right next to him.

dag: n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi bi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi; n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi bi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka daa ti lan be sarika ni, ka yi bi kana ti kaai ma.
en: When I had no place to stay, you did not welcome me into your home. When I was without clothes, you gave me nothing to wear. When I was sick and in prison, you did not care for me.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o zuli n-vooi saŋmarisi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim zuɣu bahi dunia ni; ka daa chaŋ ti ʒe paɣ so ŋun yɛn dɔɣi maa tooni ni o ti dɔɣi ka o di bia maa nyɛvili.
en: Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and threw them down to the earth. It stood in front of the woman who was ready to give birth to the baby. It wanted to eat the womans baby as soon as it was born.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒin gil o niŋ sunsuuni ka bɛ yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔr a.
en: A crowd was sitting around Jesus, and they said to him, Look, your mother and your brothers and sisters are outside, and they want you.

dag: A ni tooi tahi sagbani zuɣu n-chɛ ka kom kpe n-lim a?.
en: Can you issue an order to the clouds so their abundant waters cover you?.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti nyɛla yɛnnim bee jɛra, so n-ku tooi baŋ. Amaa bɛna nti yɛn su n ni zaŋ n yɛm niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: and he might be wise, or he might be foolish—who knows? Yet he will own everything I have worked for, everything my wisdom has earned for me in this world. It is all useless.

dag: O tiri biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka tiri kahiŋko bihi bindira bɛ yi ti kuhira.
en: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.

dag: Paɣiba maa ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa, di saha ka siliga maa guliba maa ni shɛb daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba dinkam zaa daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: The women went to tell the followers. At the same time, some of the soldiers who were guarding the tomb went into the city. They went to tell the leading priests everything that happened.

dag: O daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa o ba ni daa tum la, ka o suhu daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la yim kaman o yab Dauda suhu ni daa ʒiɛya shɛm la.
en: He did all the same sins that his father before him had done. Abijah was not faithful to the Lord his God. In this way he was not like his grandfather, David.

dag: Ka yi ni pam ni daa naai noli n-darig o tibili shɛm la saɣ lala.
en: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ niŋ kom biɛla tin ya na ka yi paɣi yi naba, ka ʒini tia ŋɔ gbini vuhi.
en: Let me bring some water for you to wash your feet; you can rest here beneath this tree.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-nyɛ bɛ zuɣupila, amaa jɛrilim n-nyɛ jɛra dolibi.
en: Wise people are rewarded with wealth, but fools are known by their foolishness.

dag: Anfaani maa wuhiri ti ni ti zaɣisim din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini dunia ŋɔ kɔr biɛri, amaa ka lee gbibi timaŋa ka mali bebu din tuhi, ka mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: It teaches us not to live against God and not to do the bad things the world wants to do. It teaches us to live on earth now in a wise and right way—a way that shows true devotion to God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa Naa Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla o daa yɛlimi, M mini n nam ŋɔ ka taali shɛli Yawɛ sani zaŋ chaŋ Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ŋɔ polo hal baabiɛla gba.
en: Later David heard the news and said, My kingdom and I are innocent of the death of Abner son of Ner. The Lord knows this.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi bɛn daa ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Naawuni tooni la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Then the elders, who were seated on thrones in God's presence, knelt down and worshiped him.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pia.
en: In the thirty-ninth year of the reign of King Uzziah of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for ten years.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Rubin zuliya kul beni, ka ku kpihim, hal o zuliya kalinli ni kul pɔri maa zaa yoli.
en: Let Reuben live, and not die! But let there be only a few people in his tribe.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Asiria naa, A ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb na nti ʒili Samaria fɔntinsi ni la bi mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu, dinzuɣu ka o chɛ ka gbuɣima kana nti be nimaani kuri ba; bɛ ni bi mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu zuɣu.
en: A messenger told the king of Assyria, The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.

dag: Di saha ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Izraɛl Naa Pɛka daa kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka teei gil li, amaa ka daa bi tooi nyaŋ Naa Ahaz.
en: King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel attacked Jerusalem and besieged it, but could not defeat Ahaz. .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: At last the woman died.

dag: O gbibila gummua o nuu ni, ka mali o nubihi wahiri jɛni.
en: She puts her hands to the spindle; her palms grasp the whorl.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayopɔin gol so ŋun pahi chir pia ka bɛ boon o Tɛbɛt la ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ɛsta kpɛh o sani nayili maa.
en: So Esther was taken to King Xerxes in the palace. This happened in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his rule.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ, ka o wum ti kuhigu maa ka daa tim o malaika na ka o ti yihi ti Ijipti maa na, ka ti kana ti be Kadɛshi tin shɛli din miri a tintariga la.
en: and we cried to the Lord for help. He heard our cry and sent an angel, who led us out of Egypt. Now we are at Kadesh, a town at the border of your territory.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n wumya. A nini shiri ku lan nya ma.
en: Moses said, Youve said it! Ill never see your face again.

dag: Rɛkab Jɔnadab bihi maa doli bɛ yabidoo maa ni zali ba shɛm, amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn bi deei n noli.
en: Jonadab's descendants have obeyed the command that their ancestor gave them, but you people have not obeyed me.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul ʒila o nam ʒiishee sahakam, ka zal o nam ʒiishee ni o kari saria.
en: You rule forever, Lord , and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.

dag: O niŋla lala ni bɛ bo ŋun Naawuni hal ti nya o. Ka ti zaa yinoyino min o bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: God made the nations so they would seek him, perhaps even reach out to him and find him. In fact, God isnt far away from any of us.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yini maa tɔɣis o yɛra, A ni zaŋ Hiburu dab so na ti gari ti ni la kpɛmina ni o ti lihi ʒiɛm ma;.
en: She told her husband the same story. She said, This Hebrew slave you brought here tried to attack me!.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka anabi yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti gbib ba.
en: But the Lord used a prophet and brought Israel out of Egypt. He used a prophet and kept Israel safe.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa chaŋ Baala, di gbinni nyɛla Kiriatijiarim din daa be Juda tiŋgban ni la ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka shɛli zuɣu Naawuni yuli ni daa be, ka o nam ʒiishee tam chɛrubinim zuɣu la na.
en: David and all the Israelites with him went to Baalah of Judah. They went there to bring out the Holy Box of God the Lord , who sits above the Cherub angels. It is the Box that is called by his name.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli yi yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: Hypocrites! Isaiah really knew what he was talking about when he prophesied about you.

dag: Yisa Masia ni sa be shɛm sɔhila, lala ka o be zuŋɔ, ka kul ni be lala hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu maa. Ka ŋunkam ka n sanna, kum ku lan gbaag o; ka ŋunkam mi niŋ ma yɛda, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada.
en: Then Jesus said, I am the bread that gives life. No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who believes in me will ever be thirsty.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, a zaɣisi ti ka filim ti. Ka ti tɔbbihi yi chani tɔb tuhibu, a lan ka bɛ sani.
en: But now you have rejected us and let us be defeated; you no longer march out with our armies.

dag: Miri ka a laɣi suhuyiɣisilinim zɔri, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a mini haliyoyanim laɣim be.
en: Don't make friends with people who have hot, violent tempers.

dag: Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ yino. Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔa paɣ maa daa yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka a ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam zambu ʒi m mini n daŋ zaa zuɣu, ka a min a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ku mali taali di puuni.
en: The woman said, I hope your decision doesn't cause any problems for you. But if it does, you can blame me.

dag: Di saha maa ti ti ku lan be kaman bihi, ka ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn zaŋ yɛŋkiŋkabina soli birigi niriba la ni zaŋ yɔhiŋgu wuhibu din be kaman pɔhim la n-chɛ ka di ʒiɛri ti laani ginda.
en: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ lumiya Yawɛ sizuura, ka jɛm o ni yɛlimaŋli, ka ʒe o yim. Zaŋmiya wun shɛŋa yi yaannim ni daa jɛmdi Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti la bahi ka jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Now then, Joshua continued, honor the Lord and serve him sincerely and faithfully. Get rid of the gods which your ancestors used to worship in Mesopotamia and in Egypt, and serve only the Lord .

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Giliad maa ti Manaasa bia Makiri ka o ʒini nimaani.
en: So Moses gave Gilead to Makir from the tribe of Manasseh, and his family settled there.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ kahig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi tuun shɛŋa din bi doli wuntia soli mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ninsalinim ni tumdi zuɣu wuhi, dama bɛ zaŋdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa guri yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Gods wrath is being revealed from heaven against all the ungodly behavior and the injustice of human beings who silence the truth with injustice.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yawɛ bɛ yɛlimuɣisira zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim taai bɛ sani n-di bɛ suɣa maa gulinyaansi luɣ shɛŋa.
en: The people began to complain to the Lord about their troubles. When the Lord heard them, he became angry and sent fire on the people. It burned among them and destroyed one end of the camp.

dag: N dimnim kul lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. Bɛ bɔrimi ni n kpi ka n yuli gba kpi m-pahi.
en: My enemies speak maliciously about me: When will he die and his name disappear.

dag: Bɔbu saha beni, ka kɔŋbu saha beni. Gbibbu saha beni, ka zaŋ bahi saha beni.
en: There is a time to look for something and a time to consider it lost. There is a time to keep things and a time to throw things away.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o suhu paligirila o zuɣu gari piɛ kɔbigayinika bɛn bi bɔrigi la.
en: And if he finds the lost sheep, he is happier about that one sheep than about the sheep that were never lost. I can assure you.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ ni dabisi shɛli din paya dali zaa n-gbahi kɔrinsi maa; ŋun daa bi gbahi ba pam ni daa gbahi shɛb tibisim daa bi pooi kilɔgiram ayi ni biɛla, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔŋ yɛrigi gili suɣa maa shee zaa.
en: So all that day, all night, and all the next day, the people worked catching quails; no one gathered less than fifty bushels. They spread them out to dry all around the camp.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa bi neei kum ni, dindina ti waazu yihibu nyɛla yoli, ka yi yɛda niŋbu gba nyɛ yoli.
en: If Christ hasnt been raised, then our preaching is useless and your faith is useless.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia ka di ʒe sokpaŋa; ka o chaŋ di gbini nti bi nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu n-naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko. Ka Yisa daa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga a ku lan wali wala hal abada! Ka tia maa daa dii zani yim kuui.
en: He saw a fig tree by the side of the road and went to it, but found nothing on it except leaves. So he said to the tree, You will never again bear fruit! At once the fig tree dried up.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ni bɛ su li m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the legacy for the clans of the tribe of the people of Judah.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kom vuui ka chɛ soli tin ya hal ka yi ti gbaai li du. Di daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom vuui ka chɛ soli ti ti hal ka ti ti gbaai li du shɛm la.
en: Tell them that the Lord your God dried up the water of the Jordan for you until you had crossed, just as he dried up the Red Sea for us.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ma sa zuɣusaa, n ni vooi sokam zaa tahi n sanna.
en: If I am lifted up above the earth, I will make everyone want to come to me.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: I still rebel and complain against God; I cannot keep from groaning.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka do so daa ti yi Baalishalisha n-ʒi bindir pala din nyɛ kapala bɔrɔbɔro kpil pisi mini kawaan maha o kpalaŋ ni na nti ti Naawuni nir maa. Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm li ti niriba maa ka bɛ ŋubi.
en: A man from the town of Baal-Shalishah brought Elisha some freshly cut grain and loaves of bread made from the first barley that was harvested. Elisha said, Give it to the people so they can eat.

dag: Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ ni, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o kpe.
en: Jesus got into a boat, and his followers went with him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ ni yɛri Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim daalahichi yɛla shɛm galisiya.
en: The Lord said, Abraham, I have heard that the people of Sodom and Gomorrah are doing all kinds of evil things.

dag: N ni chɛ ka anabi ŋun be kaman nyini ŋɔ yi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni na m-be bɛ sani, ka n zaŋ n zilinli niŋ anab maa nol ni, ka o ti yɛri ba n ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa.
en: I will send them a prophet like you from among their own people; I will tell him what to say, and he will tell the people everything I command.

dag: ka yɛli, Lala ka Babilɔn ti yɛn shim ka ku lan puhi na yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa lu di zuɣu maa zuɣu. Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa maa tariga m-bala.
en: Then say, In the same way Babylon will sink. Babylon will rise no more. It will sink because of the terrible things that I will make happen here. The words of Jeremiah end here.

dag: Bumiya tɔbu zambu bahi bɛ zuɣu luɣilikam. Bɛ gbaɣisi tɔbu; bini din taɣi ba luya. Bɛ daai di goma luhi. Dama Yawɛ m-bɔhi ba biɛri maa. Bɔhimiya ba biɛri. Niŋmiya ba kaman bɛ gba ni daa niŋ shɛm.
en: Attack from every side! Babylon surrenders! The enemy tears down its walls and towers. I am taking my revenge by doing to Babylon what it did to other cities.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim maligumaaniba, yi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord Almighty says to the priests, This command is for you:.

dag: Ka Zimiri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The story about Zimris secret plans and the other things that he did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinunaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hɛfiziba.
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-five years. His mother was Hephzibah.

dag: Bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu la gbariginsim puuni, amaa ka o lan be Naawuni yiko zuɣu. Ti gba nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima o ni, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo ti min o ni ti laɣim be Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: For even though it was in weakness that he was put to death on the cross, it is by God's power that he lives. In union with him we also are weak; but in our relations with you we shall share God's power in his life.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ti di nasara man Yawɛ zuɣu ka paɣi ma.
en: The Lord will help the people of Israel live right and praise their God.

dag: Naftali zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Yɛhudianim kpeen so daa beni ka o yuli booni Nikɔdimus. O daa nyɛla Farisiinim ni yino.
en: There was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, a Jewish leader.

dag: O di kpuɣi pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee pagɔrili, amaa o kpuɣim o zuliya ni paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.

dag: ka mali binyila tam di tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka yi ti niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Make a horn for each of the four corners of the altar. Join each horn to its corner so that everything is one piece. Then cover the altar with bronze.

dag: N dolila wuntia soli ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: I lead people the right way— along the paths of justice.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yaɣigari chuɣu puhibu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ, Di bi simdi ka tinzun nira di Yaɣigari chuɣu bindirigu maa.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron, These are the Passover regulations: No foreigner shall eat the Passover meal.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb yi nya filiŋ, a yɛrimi ni bɛ malila karimbaani, dama o tiligiri tarimba.
en: When people are brought down and you ask God to help them, he will rescue those who have been humbled.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali yaa gari bɛ dimnima.
en: God made his people very fruitful, more powerful than their enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa shiri chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi.
en: One of the disciples even struck at the high priest's servant with his sword and cut off the servant's right ear.

dag: Niriba maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Juda zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Jɛfune bia Kalɛb.
en: These are the names of the men: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb, Jephunnehs son.

dag: A yi tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa, di ni niŋ ma nyaɣisim.
en: My inner being will rejoice when your lips speak with integrity.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N zaŋla kurigu dapua ga zuliya kam nyiŋgoya ni ni bɛ jɛm Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, ka bɛ mi shiri ni jɛm o ni yɛlimaŋli. Hal n zaŋla mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba ti o. .
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, has said that he will put an iron yoke on all these nations and that they will serve King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. The Lord has said that he will make even the wild animals serve Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: A dabisa bemi kaman daadam dabisa ni be shɛm bee a yuma bemi kaman daadam yuma ni be shɛm.
en: Are your days like those of a human, your years like years of a human.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ laɣim o tɔbbihi min o kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi la zaa na, ka bɛ daa yi Harɔshɛtihagɔim n-chaŋ Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni.
en: So Sisera gathered his iron chariots and all the men with him, and they marched from the city of Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River.

dag: kaman chuɣu dal la. N ni vuui barina ka chɛn ya, ka yi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: I will remove from you those worried about the appointed feasts. They have been a burden for her, a reproach.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, M biɛhimi ŋmɛnditoya ŋɔ naba? N ni paai ba? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Biɛhimi bɛ naba, a ni paa ba n-fa a niriba maa.
en: David asked the Lord , Shall I go after those raiders? And will I catch them? He answered, Go after them; you will catch them and rescue the captives.

dag: O daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ni o malila Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shili ka bɛ tum Naawuni tuma n-chɛ ka ŋun Masia niŋgbuŋ la zooi.
en: Christ gave these gifts to prepare Gods holy people for the work of serving, to make the body of Christ stronger.

dag: Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ka bukaata, ka Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ mi leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din bahi yoli, bɛ ni daa liri Judanima n-ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zuɣu.
en: Egypt will be empty. Edom will be an empty wilderness, because they were cruel to the people of Judah. They killed innocent people in their country.

dag: Yi chɛ ka bɛ dolila teeku chani dari Ijipti kawaan shɛli bɛ ni ŋahi Nail Mɔɣili duli la kɔhira. Yi nyɛla zuliya kam kɔhigɔriba.
en: They traveled the seas looking for grain. The men from Tyre bought grain that grows near the Nile River and sold it to other nations.

dag: Di zaŋ ma ti n dimnima, dama ʒiri shɛhira diriba yiɣisimi lu n zuɣu, bɛ suhuri kul yɛla gadama niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Don't abandon me to my enemies, who attack me with lies and threats.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yihi wuntizɔriba bɛ zahimbu nyabu ni, ka lan mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka tuumbiɛrinim be tibidarigibo shee guli saria karibu dali.
en: And so the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their trials and how to keep the wicked under punishment for the Day of Judgment.

dag: Hal Naawuni yi chɛ ka n nyɛvili pahi yi yɛda niŋbu sara zuɣu n-leei sara maligu ŋun Naawuni sani, di ni niŋ ma suhupiɛlli, ka yi zaa gba pahi n zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But even if I am poured out like a drink offering upon the altar of service for your faith, I am glad. Im glad with all of you.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la, Ŋunkam kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi.
en: Yes, everyone who trusts in the Lord will be saved.

dag: Yawɛ wum n ni suh o bɔri shɛli maa. Yawɛ ni deei n suhigu.
en: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa pisi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: They made twenty frames for the south side.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka o daa lan lab Naawuni jɛmbu duu yaha; ka niriba daa laɣim o sanna, ka o ʒini gbaai ba wuhibu.
en: Early the next morning he went back to the Temple. All the people gathered around him, and he sat down and began to teach them.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋubi ba tiɣi; dama o daa ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu.
en: So they ate and were completely satisfied; God gave them exactly what they had craved.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, Yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nir ni ni ti niŋ shɛli naani ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Ka ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun zaŋd o Shia n-niŋd o daanabinim ni daa tim o malaika na ni o ti wuh o jɛmdiba din yɛn niŋ ka di ku yuui.
en: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.

dag: O daa yɛlila yɛtɔɣa, ka koma din be zuɣusaa gbaai vubu. Ka o daa chɛ ka paɣili yi tiŋgban ni luɣilikam na, ka chɛ ka saanyaɣisibu be saa ni; ŋuna n-daa yihi pɔhim di biɛhigu shee na.
en: When he thunders, the waters in the skies roar. He sends clouds all over the earth. He sends lightning with the rain. He brings out the wind from his storehouses.

dag: dindina ŋun ku nir maa ya kpamba bɛn timmi tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ o na ti ti ŋun yɛn bɔh o biɛri, ka bɛ ku o.
en: In that case, the leaders of your own town are to send for you and hand you over to the relative responsible for taking revenge for the murder, so that you may be put to death.

dag: Yawɛ yi di bi sɔŋ ma, ŋ-ŋɔ n shia di be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: If the LORD hadnt helped me, I would live instantly in total silence.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa nuu ni n-karim, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: Hezekiah received the letters from the messengers and read them. Then he went up to the Lord s Temple and laid the letters out in front of the Lord .

dag: ka o yɛli ba, Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ lihiri ka ku nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka ku baŋdi di gbinni.
en: and he answered, The knowledge of the secrets of the Kingdom of God has been given to you, but to the rest it comes by means of parables, so that they may look but not see, and listen but not understand.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti laɣim gbariti, ka laɣim n ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la mini n ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili la.
en: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n ni zaŋdi fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So make sure you carefully keep the commandment, the regulations, and the case laws that I am commanding you right now.

dag: Di zaa yoli Lɛvinim bɛn tinsi dina, yiya shɛŋa din be bɛ ni su fɔntin shɛŋa ni, bɛn Lɛvinim maa ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛlikam.
en: However, Levites have the right to buy back at any time their property in the cities assigned to them.

dag: ka yi Sintani ŋun gbahi ba n-chɛ ka bɛ dol o nol la zana ni.
en: They may come to their senses and escape from the devils trap that holds them captive to do his will.

dag: A nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam ma, tim ma yɛm, ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.

dag: Ka a nuu bee a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini bee a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi bee napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your hand or your foot makes you sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose part of your body and have eternal life than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the fire that burns forever.

dag: Zabili piligu ŋmanila bɛ ni yi cheei kom bahi la, dinzuɣu zom yi zabili ni ka di na bi piligi.
en: The start of a quarrel is like letting out water, so drop the dispute before it breaks out.

dag: Dama Naawuni yɛliya: N daa wum yi suhigu n daalibarika saha, ka daa sɔŋ ya yi tiliginsim dabisili dali. Nyamiya! Pumpɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alibarika deebu saha. Nyamiya! Zuŋɔ n-nyɛ tiliginsim nyabu dabisili.
en: Hear what God says: When the time came for me to show you favor, I heard you; when the day arrived for me to save you, I helped you. Listen! This is the hour to receive God's favor; today is the day to be saved!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ daadam kam ni, ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi ninkura ti zahim zahima; ka yi nachimba mi ti nya ʒii.
en: Afterward I will pour out my Spirit on everyone: your sons and daughters will proclaim my message; your old people will have dreams, and your young people will see visions.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa lan nya tiŋ maa ni kpamba pia m-boli ba ni bɛ gba kamina ti ʒin nimaani. Bɛ ni daa ʒini.
en: Then Boaz got ten of the leaders of the town and asked them to sit down there too. When they were seated.

dag: Ka bɛ daa moli molo gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda ni bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn daa lab kulina la laɣimmi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Then he sent a message to every place in Judah and Jerusalem. The message told all the Jewish people who had come back from captivity to meet together in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka yi yi ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin ti miriya ka yi vuɣi yi kpee tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha niriba ni daa kpa shɛli, ka di be bɛ ni yɛn piri tiŋgban shɛŋa tin ya la ni.
en: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones.

dag: yɛl o, Chɛl a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ka yiɣisi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-looi n ni yɛn wuh a tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: and said to him, Leave your family and country and go to the land that I will show you.

dag: ka hal dɔro maa ni daa mali ma maa zaa yoli, di zuɣu daa bi chɛ ka yi zo ka chɛ ma, ka mi daa bi mali ma ansarisi n-ʒiɛm ma, amaa ka daa deei ma kaman Naawuni malaika bee kaman Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa.
en: My sickness was a burden to you, but you did not stop showing me respect or make me leave. Instead, you welcomed me as if I were an angel from God. You accepted me as if I were Jesus Christ himself!.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ni lih o, ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, di bi lan simdi ni maligumaana yuli ni o nya kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim maa, dilan nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: then the priest must look at the person again. If the disease has spread, the priest does not need to look for yellow hair. The person is unclean.

dag: Ti Duuma ni yihi Ziɔn paɣiba daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ saria karibu mini buɣim paɣi ʒim din yi n-do Jɛrusalɛm puuni la ka di yi.
en: The Lord will wash away the filth from the daughters of Zion. He will wash away the blood from Jerusalem. With a spirit of judgment that burns like fire, he will make everything pure.

dag: mini Jɔana ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛrɔd yiŋ tumtumdi so ŋun yuli daa booni Chuza la paɣa ni Suzaana ni niriba pam bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli zɔri Yisa min o nyaandoliba kuŋ la.
en: Joanna, whose husband Chuza was an officer in Herod's court; and Susanna, and many other women who used their own resources to help Jesus and his disciples.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli fukumsi zaligunim ni be, ka bɛn lihi ʒiɛm li ni kpi.
en: Obey the law and live; ignore it and die.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka tɔbbihi pali a ni kaman tol la. Bɛ ni ti ŋme nasara dibu kuŋa m-bah a zuɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful used his name to make this promise: Babylon, I will fill you with so many enemy soldiers they will be like a cloud of locusts. They will win their war against you. They will stand over you shouting their victory cry.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui ka bɛ gun o, ka bol o yuli Yisa, din nyɛ yu shɛli malaika ni daa pun ti o ka Mariama naanyi zal o puu la.
en: When the baby was eight days old, he was circumcised, and he was named Jesus. This name was given by the angel before the baby began to grow inside Mary.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini; ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But Jesus gave no more answers, so that Pilate marveled.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔbbihi la, ka mali suhupiɛlli kaman wain nyuriba la. Bɛ bihi ni ti teei bɛ nasara dibu maa yɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Ephraim will be like a warrior. They will be as glad as if they were drinking wine. Their children will watch and be glad. Their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.

dag: N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: Not only have I filled him with my Spirit, but I have given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa lan yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba gba di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni o ti yɛl o Izraɛlnim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni lo ni bɛ niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli zaa yɛla.
en: Finally, Abner talked with the tribe of Benjamin. Then he left for Hebron to tell David everything that the tribe of Benjamin and the rest of the people of Israel wanted to do.

dag: N gbaala mmaŋ ni so biɛɣu kam dolibu, ni di chɛ ka n tooi gbib a yɛligu.
en: I havent set my feet on any evil path so I can make sure to keep your word.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Samsin, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo a mihi n-zaŋ a ti ti Filistianim maa. Ka Samsin yɛli ba, Pomiya ni yimaŋmaŋ ku ku ma.
en: We came here to tie you up and turn you over to them, said the men of Judah. I won't put up a fight, Samson answered, but you have to promise not to hurt me yourselves.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi Dauda yɛla, ka teeg o ni daa di wahala shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: Our Lord , don't forget David and how he suffered.

dag: O yi bi nahind o taba, amaa ka labisiri o ni deei binshɛŋa talima tiri bindaamba, ka pa ŋun fari niriba, ka nyɛ ŋun dihiri kum ni mali shɛba, ka sooni gbinfini ni mali shɛba.
en: They dont cheat anyone, but fulfill their obligations. They dont rob others, but give food to the hungry and clothes to the naked.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi ti deei piɛɣu maa yi nuu ni n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: Then the priest will take the basket from you. He will put it down in front of the altar of the Lord your God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhi ni m mali taali; ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan tumdi tuma yoli?.
en: Since I am held guilty, why should I bother?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl niriba maa naa ni mali so shɛŋa min o talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka daa sab li niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bahi niriba maa zaa ka bɛ wurim, ka sokam kul o ya.
en: Samuel explained the rights and duties of a king and wrote them all in a book. He put the book in one of the shrines where the Lord was worshiped. Then Samuel sent everyone home.

dag: Ka bɛ ti yɛra, Tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ tiŋgban nɛl la kpalim ŋmanila Idɛn puu. Ka niriba lan pali fɔntin shɛŋa din daa wurim leei dabari la zaa ni, ka bɛ me gooni gil li.
en: They will say, This land, which was a desolation, has become like the garden of Eden. And the cities that were ruined, ravaged, and razed are now fortified and inhabited.

dag: A ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka bi ku Amalɛknim zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa la zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ a o ni niŋ a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You disobeyed the Lord 's command and did not completely destroy the Amalekites and all they had. That is why the Lord is doing this to you now.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: While they were eating, Jesus took a piece of bread, gave a prayer of thanks, broke it, and gave it to his disciples. Take and eat it, he said; this is my body.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni la, n daa lo ba alikauli yɛli.
en: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku tim yi puri ni bee yi wain tihi ni gari bee n-nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari. Ti ku ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo hal ti yi a tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Please permit us to pass through your land. We and our cattle will not leave the road or go into your fields or vineyards, and we will not drink from your wells. We will stay on the main road until we are out of your territory.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti bɔhi Naawuni, Ti ni daŋ dini niriba n-simdi ni bɛ daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa? Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-ni daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: So they went to the place of worship at Bethel and asked God, Which tribe should be the first to attack the people of Benjamin? Judah, the Lord answered.

dag: Dama n shiri ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ takɔbi ku a, amaa a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili zo n-tiligi, a ni niŋ ma naani la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will defend you; you wont die in battle. You will escape with your life, because you have trusted in me, declares the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim ka tarili bee fali bɛ mabihi maa sani. Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm maa.
en: Thats why the Levites dont have a stake or inheritance with the rest of their relatives. The LORD is the Levites inheritance, just as the LORD your God promised them.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa daŋ yiɣisi n-laɣisi tiŋ maa ni kpamba pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: King Hezekiah gathered the city officials and went up to the Temple of the Lord early the next morning.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun be mɔɣu ni n sani. Bɛ ŋumdimi bahiri n zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka n je ba.
en: My inheritance has turned against me like a lion in the forest; she growls at me; therefore, I have rejected her.

dag: Ŋuni ka yi lee yɛn zaŋ ma buɣisi ka nya ka m min o saɣi? So beni ŋ-ŋmani ma?.
en: To whom will you compare me? says the Lord . Is there anyone else like me?.

dag: Miriya ka yi tum alahichi yi sujee puuni, tɛhimiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli yi yi ti do yi gom shee, ka shini.
en: Tremble with fear and stop sinning; think deeply about this, when you lie in silence on your beds.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm yɛtɔɣa tir ba la jilima, amaa jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din diri ba.
en: Words from a wise persons mouth are beneficial, but fools are devoured by their own lips.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda, o ni nya alaafee.
en: When Jesus heard this, he responded, Dont be afraid; just keep trusting, and she will be healed.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri naŋgbankpeeni mini woligibu din chihiri wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa pun dee la nol la. Kaɣimiya ba!.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to be very careful of those who cause arguments and hurt peoples faith by teaching things that are against what you learned. Stay away from them.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni a nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, ka bɛ niŋ ma nirilim a zuɣu, ka tiligi n nyɛvili a zuɣu.
en: Please save my life by saying you are my sister.

dag: Sokam ni tooi bir o bimbira ni suhudoo. Tihi din wandi wala ni wali, ka tiŋgban ni bindira niŋ, ka saa gba mi pam. N ni chɛ ka n ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ di binyara ŋɔ zaa daanfaani.
en: They will plant their crops in peace. Their vines will bear grapes, the earth will produce crops, and there will be plenty of rain. I will give all these blessings to the people of my nation who survive.

dag: Ka Gaal daa gari tooni zaŋ Shɛkɛmnim chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Abimilɛk ti tuhi.
en: So Gaal led the leaders of Shechem out to fight Abimelech.

dag: Ka Yawɛ kari niriba maa tahi katiŋa, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim zaɣ kuŋ.
en: The LORD will send the people far away, and the land will be completely abandoned.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a yiko ni a niŋdi lala.
en: and asked him, What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you such right.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Lɛvi zuliya niriba maa zaa ti ku mali tarili bee fali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ ni ti dirila sara binshɛŋa din nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: The tribe of Levi will not get any share of land in Israel. The priests come from that tribe and they will eat the special sacrifices that are offered as gifts to the Lord . That is the share for the people from the tribe of Levi.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba pia la daa wum lala ka je suli niŋ Jeemsi mini Jɔn.
en: When the ten other disciples heard this, they were angry with James and John.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Anabi Musa litaafinima, chinchini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha;.
en: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pinaanahi ni kɔbisiyopɔin ka naanyi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Kɔra duŋ taabu ni la.
en: But , Israelites were dead, not counting those who had died with Korah and his followers.

dag: Dinzuɣu, nyini daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi kul wum yɛtɔɣ shɛli n noli ni saha shɛlikam, nyin zaŋmi li kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: Now, son of man, I am choosing you to be a watchman for the family of Israel. If you hear a message from my mouth, you must warn the people for me.

dag: Amaa Masia yi be yi ni, hal yi niŋgbuna yi ni kpi alahichi zuɣu gba, yi shihi lee ni ne yi ni yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: Your body will always be dead because of sin. But if Christ is in you, then the Spirit gives you life, because Christ made you right with God.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yalim be yi yɛtɔɣa ni ka di viɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi mi yi ni yɛn garigi sokam shɛm.
en: Your speech should always be gracious and sprinkled with insight so that you may know how to respond to every person.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ lzraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn ŋmanila chi bubu saha kabɔɣili; di kpalim biɛla ka o daatam kpuɣibu saha paai.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I make this promise— Soon Babylon will be leveled and packed down like a threshing place at harvest time.

dag: Naawuni, kabisim bɛ nyina; Yawɛ, kabisim gbuɣim pola maa nyin wɔɣila la.
en: God, they are like lions. So, Lord , break their teeth.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti bɛn suhir o o Shia Kasi maa.
en: As bad as you are, you know how to give good things to your children. How much more, then, will the Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him.

dag: Yawɛ miri ŋunkam zaa suh o mini ŋunkam zaa suh o ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: The LORD is close to everyone who calls out to him, to all who call out to him sincerely.

dag: Di saha ka peentɔriba daa tam gooni zuɣu ka tɔri ti piɛma na. Bɛ daa ku naa tɔbbihi maa shɛba, hal naa tɔbbia Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba kpiya.
en: Then they shot arrows at us from the top of the wall. Some of your soldiers were killed, and one of them was Uriah the Hittite.

dag: Wahala mini nandahima m-mali ma, amaa a zaligunima n-nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: I am filled with trouble and anxiety, but your commandments bring me joy.

dag: M mabiyurisi, wummiya! Pa Naawuni m-pii ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛ nyɛ azichinima zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu polo, ka lan nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn di nam shɛli o ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la?.
en: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.

dag: Ka Akishi daa niŋ Dauda naani pam ka yɛli, O chɛ ka o niriba Izraɛlnim bi lan bɔr o yɛlli zaa, dinzuɣu o kul ni nyɛ n tumtumda sahakam.
en: Achish began to trust David and said to himself, Now Davids own people hate him. The Israelites hate him very much. Now he will serve me forever.

dag: Ka sabi Aduna yuli pa Lɛvi jaaŋgbee zuɣu. Di simdi ni dunoli kam kpɛm malila jaaŋgbe yini.
en: Write Aarons name on Levis staff, for there will be one staff for the leader of each household.

dag: Miri ka a ku ninsala.
en: Do not murder.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Gbilisimiya tibili wum, chɛliya karimbaani.
en: Listen and pay attention. The Lord has spoken to you. Do not be proud.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni tahima lan kani, o kɔŋla o bia maa, ka o daa lan piig o bi so wums o ka o niŋ yaa.
en: The mother lion had hoped that cub would become the leader, but now she has lost all hope. So she took another of her cubs and trained him to be a lion.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnani zali bee m-mali binshɛli ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom puuni.
en: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa wum lala ka bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o, amaa ka daa lee zɔr o, dama o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa pam.
en: When the leading priests and the teachers of the law heard what Jesus said, they began trying to find a way to kill him. They were afraid of him because all the people were amazed at his teaching.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ti shɛŋa bɛ ni sa m-baɣili kulibɔŋ din mali kom, ka di wandi wala di walibu saha, ka di vari bi suura. Bɛ kul dirila nasara bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: They are like trees that grow beside a stream, that bear fruit at the right time, and whose leaves do not dry up. They succeed in everything they do.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Yi yi ti nya binshɛli din chihiri Naawuni sani la, ka di ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu Luɣ Kasi Shee, kaman Anabi Daniɛl ni daa pun yɛli di yɛla la, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm!.
en: You will see The Awful Horror of which the prophet Daniel spoke. It will be standing in the holy place.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-wurindi Babilɔn, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ vuri yɔbu. Bɛ dimnim ni lu bɛ zuɣu kaman kɔgbana la. Bɛ vuri yɔbu maa ka buɣisibu.
en: I am destroying Babylon and putting it to silence. The armies rush in like roaring waves and attack with noisy shouts.

dag: Yinim Samarianima, n zaɣisi yi naɣibil maa. N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn tooi yi taali ni?.
en: Your calf is rejected, Samaria. My anger burns against them. How long will they remain guilty?.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa yi n-chaŋ labina ti yɛl o dana maa, N niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka palo na kul beni.
en: Later, the servant said to him, Master, I did what you told me to do, but we still have places for more people.

dag: Bɛ zaa kalinsi nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: The woman was the last to die.

dag: Biɛɣuni asiba, yi sa ni nya Yawɛ jilima, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ŋun Yawɛ shɛm maa. Dama ti mi lee nyɛla banima, ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ti?.
en: In the morning you will see the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence. He has heard your complaints against him—yes, against him, because we are only carrying out his instructions.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka n daa galim nanim mini zuɣulaannima n-yɛli ba, Yi zaa deeri binyɛra nyɔri yimaŋmaŋ niriba sani. Ka n daa laɣim salo pam na ni ti ti baŋ ti ni yɛn niŋ yɛlli maa shɛm.
en: After thinking it over, I brought charges against the officials and the officers. I told them, You are all taking interest from your own people! I also called for a large assembly in order to deal with them.

dag: Ka Pita chihi bɛ zaa nini maa ni yɛli, Man bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But he denied it in front of all of them, saying, I dont know what you are talking about.

dag: Amaa o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋmahinli la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa.
en: But the temple Jesus was speaking about was his body.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, m be a sani. Mani n nyɛ a Naawuni. Kul di zɔri dabiɛm! N ni ti a kpiɔŋ ka sɔŋ a, n ni tilig a ka gul a, ka chɛ ka a di nasara.
en: Dont fear, because I am with you; dont be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, I will surely help you; I will hold you with my righteous strong hand.

dag: Hashum daŋ ni: Matɛnai mini Matata ni Zabad so mi ni Ɛlifɛlɛt ni Jɛrɛmai ni Manaasa so mi ni Shimɛi.
en: From the descendants of Hashum, these men: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

dag: Ka o neei tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa zuɣu ka yɛli teeku maa, Fom baalim! Ka sanʒiɛɣu maa daa chɛ ʒɛbu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: He got up and gave orders to the wind, and he said to the lake, Silence! Be still! The wind settled down and there was a great calm.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ bi zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bee n-zo n-yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ni bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, amaa ka nyin tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: If you warn them and tell them to change their lives and stop doing evil, but they refuse to listen, they will die because they sinned. But since you warned them, you will have saved your own life.

dag: Di saha ti daa kul larimi, ka yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn daa gil ti yɛra, Yawɛ tum tuun kara ti ba.
en: We will laugh and sing happy songs! Then the other nations will say, The Lord did a great thing for Zion.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum yi tuma.
en: Six days you may work and do all your tasks.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabiya: Man Naawuni duu ni boonila wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu.
en: and said to them, It is written in the Scriptures that God said, My Temple will be called a house of prayer. But you are making it a hideout for thieves.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi nuhi tiri luɣ kasi shee la m-paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!.

dag: saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋuni bɛ biɛhigu shee, bee n-do bɛ dooshee n-gu?.
en: They lie in their den, lie in ambush in their lair.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Pa yinima n-daa je ma hal ka kari ma m ba yiŋ la? Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kani n sanna yi wahala nyabu saha.
en: But Jephthah replied to Gileads elders, Arent you the ones who hated me and drove me away from my fathers household? Why are you coming to me now when youre in trouble.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba ni paɣ a yuli; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi ni ti be a sani.
en: Those who do what is right will praise your name; those who are honest will live in your presence.

dag: ka bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛnyaŋ bee bunyaŋ na nti ti Yawɛ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli.
en: and as the penalty for your sin you must bring to the Lord a female sheep or goat as an offering. The priest shall offer the sacrifice for your sin.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a ka a yɛli ma.
en: Face me and answer the questions I ask!.

dag: ni kulinoo ni mɔɣinooŋa ni jukangba.
en: the white owl, the scops owl, the osprey.

dag: din nyɛ o ni daa po pɔ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma polo la yɛla.
en: He told our ancestor Abraham.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka niriba maa daa kar o naba nti bo n-nya o, ka bi saɣi ni o lan woligi ba;.
en: The next morning Jesus went out to a place where he could be alone, and crowds came looking for him. When they found him, they tried to stop him from leaving.

dag: Lihimiya nya bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa nyɛla din viɛl bee din bie, ka nya bɛ ni be fɔntin shɛŋa ni lee nyɛla tin yari bee di nyɛla bɛ ni me goma gili shɛŋa.
en: Find out whether the land is good or bad and whether the people live in open towns or in fortified cities.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nini na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: There will be great suffering such as the world has never before seen and will never again see.

dag: Yawɛ mali yiko pam, amaa o suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom. Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ku chɛ alahichilana tibili darigibu. O soli nyɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga mini sanʒiɛɣu, ka sagbana nyɛ o napɔna taŋkpagbiligu.
en: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ninsalinim zaa Naawuni, ka binshɛli m-beni n-kpɛm nyaŋ ma.
en: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa be teeku duli, timiya Yawɛ jilima, ka paɣ o.
en: Give glory to the Lord . Praise him, all you people in faraway lands!.

dag: Chɛ ka Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yɛli lala, bɛna n-nyɛ o ni tiligi shɛb muɣisigu ni.
en: Thats what those who are redeemed by the LORD say, the ones God redeemed from the power of their enemies.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ti baŋdiba maa salima mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli.
en: The skilled workers are to use blue, purple, and red wool, gold thread, and fine linen.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman kuɣ tibisili la, ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti bɔri ni bɛ kpuɣ li ni nya yɛlli. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini kana ni bɛ ti liri li.
en: But when that time comes, I will make Jerusalem like a heavy stone—any nation that tries to lift it will be hurt. All the nations of the world will join forces to attack her.

dag: ka goli daa kpalim zani di jilima shee; a piɛma neesim din daa gariti yomyom la min a kpani din daa nyaɣisira la zuɣu.
en: Sun and moon stand still high above. With the light, your arrows shoot, your spear at the flash of lightning.

dag: Yi yi ni deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: if you obey him and carefully observe everything that I command you today.

dag: Dahin shɛli o yi ti yɛn kpe luɣ kasi shee dundɔŋ ni ti tum tuma, di simdi ka o mali o daalahichi sara luɣ kasi maa shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Buɣim ni ti din ya nimaani, ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ŋmahi ya. Di ni ti din ya kaman toli la. Nabimiya kaman toli la, ka nabiya kaman sakɔri la.
en: Fire will consume you there; the sword will cut you down; like the locust it will consume you. Multiply like the locust; multiply like the grasshopper!.

dag: N ni darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Samarianim mini Ɛhab daŋ niriba tibili shɛm la. N ni kpimsi Jɛrusalɛm niriba birili, ka chɛ ka di puuni neei kaman nir ni yi paɣi laa n-nyahi neei di puuni ka zaŋ li pili shɛm la.
en: I will stretch the measuring line of Samaria and the plumb line of Ahabs family over Jerusalem. A man wipes a dish, and then he turns it upside down. I will do that to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ Yawɛ leei bɛ ni ni niŋ so naani, ka shiri niŋ o naani mal alibarika.
en: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord .

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali, ka di nyɛla din yɛligir o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: On the seventh day the priest will again examine it. If it has continued to spread over the skin, the priest will declare the person unclean; it is an infection of skin disease.

dag: Ka n ti bahi yi fɔntinsi yoli, ka chɛ ka yi jɛmbu shɛhi leei dabari, ka m baɣa ku lan be yi binyɛra din nyom viɛl ni.
en: I will turn your cities into ruins, I will devastate your sanctuaries, and I will not smell the soothing smells of your offerings.

dag: Amaa n nyɛla ŋun be biɛrim mini nandahima ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka a tiliginsim yiko gbibi ma.
en: And me? Im afflicted. Im full of pain. Let your salvation keep me safe, God!.

dag: ka yɛli Kɔra min o nyaandoliba maa, Biɛɣuni asiba Yawɛ sa ni wuh o ni pii so ni ŋun be kasi ni o ni yɛn chɛ ka so ka o sanna. O ni pii so, o ni chɛ ka dilan ka o sanna.
en: He spoke to Korah and all his community, In the morning the LORD will make known who is his, who is holy, and who is able to approach him. The one he chooses for himself is the one who will be able to approach him.

dag: Ɛfa ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Haran mini Mɔza ni Gazɛz, ka Haran daa nyɛ Gazɛz ba.
en: Ephah, Calebs secondary wife, gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya o taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa yɛli Gomna Pailɛt ni o kum o.
en: And even though they could find no reason to pass the death sentence on him, they asked Pilate to have him put to death.

dag: O daa lan ʒila o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba hal ti yaɣi.
en: Peter did not know what to say, because he and the other two followers were so afraid.

dag: Dama ti Duuma NAAWUNI lan yɛli, N niriba daa tuui kulila Ijipti ti be nimaani. Nyama, di nyaaŋa ka Asirianim gba daa ti nahim ba yoli.
en: The Lord GOD says, First, my people went down to Egypt and became slaves. Then Assyria made them slaves.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di ka nyu.
en: Isaac prepared a banquet for them, and they ate and drank.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la, alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa saɣim la, hal n ni daa kul gbib ba kaman yili yidana maa zaa yoli. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: It will not be like the agreement I made with their ancestors. I made that agreement when I took them by the hand and brought them out of Egypt. I was their master, but they broke that agreement. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ yinim Zɛruya bihi bɛn be kaman yi leela n dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Di simdi ni ti ku nira Izraɛl tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Pa mani n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: But David said, My problems arent yours, you sons of Zeruiah. Why are you becoming my enemy today? Should anyone in Israel be put to death today? Dont I know that today I am again king over Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na nti ti ti. Bɛ daa lan ʒi lahibali na ti yɛli, Tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ti ti maa.
en: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, The Lord our God is giving us good land.

dag: Ka Naa Azaria daa me Ɛlat n-labisi li ti Judanima, o ba kum maa nyaaŋa.
en: Uzziah reconquered and rebuilt Elath after his father's death.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni nyɛ naa n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dindali maa, Yawɛ yino nti yɛn be, ka o yuli gba nyɛ yu yini.
en: Then the Lord will be king over all the earth; everyone will worship him as God and know him by the same name.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm viɛnyɛliŋga din ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni? Banim ka Yawɛ lee tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li moli? Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bahi yoli doya kaman tiŋgban nɛli, ka so bi lan gariti nimaani?.
en: I asked, Lord , why is the land devastated and dry as a desert, so that no one travels through it? Who is wise enough to understand this? To whom have you explained it so that they can tell others.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣi bɛ binyɛra ni bɛ ti mali soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ di nyɛvili tia la wala, ka doli tiŋ la dunoya kpe di ni la mal alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who have washed their robes. They will have the right to eat the food from the tree of life. They can go through the gates into the city.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi; dunianim zaa lumiy o sizuura.
en: Bow down before the Holy One when he appears; tremble before him, all the earth!.

dag: Yi zuɣulaannim zaa daa laɣimmi guui. Pa piɛma ka bɛ daa zaŋ to n-gbahi ba. Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ ni daa nya yi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa hal bɛ ni daa kul zo n-chaŋ katiŋ la zaa yoli.
en: All your leaders escaped together but were captured without a single bow shot. All your escapees were bound together, even though they fled far away.

dag: Gbib a suhu n-gari binshɛɣukam, dama di ni ka nyɛvili bilisiri yirina.
en: Be careful how you think; your life is shaped by your thoughts.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa guli naa maa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya li, amaa ka a nol lee ku to li.
en: Then the officer, the one the king leaned on for support, spoke to the man of God: Come on! Even if the LORD should make windows in the sky, how could that happen? Elisha said, You will see it with your own eyes, but you wont eat from it.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛliya ka n ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni.
en: Now listen to my words of explanation.

dag: Yi ni chɛ so taali paŋ o, n gba chɛ m-paŋ dilana. N yi pun chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, ka di yi shiri nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni n chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, yi zuɣu ka n chɛ li paŋ o zaŋ chaŋ Masia sani.
en: If you forgive someone, then I also forgive them. And what I have forgiven—if I had anything to forgive—I forgave it for you, and Christ was with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋ paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani, ka ti ni so ti ku lu nɔzaɣisibo ŋɔ tatabo zuɣu.
en: Therefore, lets make every effort to enter that rest so that no one will fall by following the same example of disobedience.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mbaye, n yidan kpimi ka n kpalim pakoli.
en: What do you want? he asked her. I am a poor widow, sir, she answered. My husband is dead.

dag: Doliy o dunoya kpe ni wumpaɣibo, ka kpe o dundɔŋ ni ni paɣibu! Puhimiy o, ka paɣ o yuli!.
en: Come through the gates to his Temple giving thanks to him. Enter his courtyards with songs of praise. Honor him and bless his name.

dag: ka yɛra, Timiya ma yiko ŋɔ, ka n gba zaŋdi n nuhi pari niriba zuɣu ka bɛ deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: He said, Give me this authority too so that anyone on whom I lay my hands will receive the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ leei naa n-ʒili m ba Dauda nam maa ʒiishee hal n ni na kul nyɛ bia ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka m mi bi mi n ni yɛn su niriba shɛm.
en: And now, LORD my God, you have made me, your servant, king in my father Davids place. But Im young and inexperienced. I know next to nothing.

dag: Ka di saha dɛde daa ti paai ka o kahigi li wuhi palɔni o lahibal sun shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni, ka m mol li kaman ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ ni zal li shɛm la.
en: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: The message from the Lord came to Jeremiah. This was during the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah. This was the message from the Lord:.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n noli paɣi Yawɛ pam; n ni paɣ o salo sunsuuni.
en: I give thanks to the Lord . I praise him in front of everyone.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋub o zaɣ kpiŋ maa ŋun paɣim o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam gba kpuɣi zaɣ kpiŋ maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who eats from the dead body must wash their clothes and will be unclean until evening. Anyone who carries such a dead body must wash their clothes and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa yiɣisi zan o nyaandolitab maa sunsuuni. Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisi laasabu ka o yɛli ba.
en: One day there were about of the Lord's followers meeting together, and Peter stood up to speak to them.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ku Chɛmɔshi niriba, ka gbahi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi daba chaŋ.
en: People of Moab, you worshiped Chemosh, your god, but now you are done for, and your children are prisoners in a foreign country.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa n-gooi tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ daa chɛ Izraɛlnim maa kari doli ka labina.
en: Joab had the trumpet blown to stop the fighting, and his troops came back from pursuing the Israelites.

dag: ka di chɛ ka so ku tooi lan da shɛli bee n-kɔhi shɛli, shee o malila dalinli din nyɛ biŋkɔbigu maa yuli bee namba din ʒe o yuli zaani la.
en: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.

dag: N yi yɛli ni zibisim sɔɣim ma, ka neesim din gili ma zaa leei zibisim.
en: I could ask the darkness to hide me or the light around me to turn into night.

dag: Di saha ka Pool min o tab la daa kpe ŋariŋ yiɣisi Pafɔs n-chaŋ Pɛɛga Pamfilia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Jɔn Maak daa ti zani nimaani ŋ-ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ka chɛ ba.
en: Paul and the people with him sailed away from Paphos. They came to Perga, a city in Pamphylia. There John Mark left them and returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into a fire.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu yi ti ʒiɛra, ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ni beni sahakam.
en: After a whirlwind passes by, the wicked are no more, but the righteous stand firm forever.

dag: yin ti zaŋmiya bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba zaa ti Yawɛ. Yi biŋkɔbiri ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣilɔ shɛb zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: you should set aside for the LORD whatever comes out of the womb first. All of the first males born to your animal belong to the LORD.

dag: N ti yɛn baŋ, ka doo bɔbu kɔre zaŋ ma ti ʒili baɣili n nabia o chɛchɛbuŋ ni.
en: But in my imagination I was suddenly riding on a glorious chariot.

dag: Daadam, tin shɛli nim yi bi ʒe yim ni mani ka tum alahichi, ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ka m mɔŋ ba bindirigu, ka chɛ ka kum lu bɛ zuɣu n-kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: Mortal man, he said, if a country sins and is unfaithful to me, I will reach out and destroy its supply of food. I will send a famine and kill people and animals alike.

dag: Musa daa pirigi tiŋgbani shɛli ti Rubin zuliya ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini Itiɔpianima ni Putinima ni Ludinima ni Areebianim zaa ni Libianima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din niriba zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai ba.
en: That war will also kill the soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, and even from among my own people.

dag: Yinim Galilinim ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee ʒiɛya lihiri zuɣusaa lala? Ka lan yɛli ba, Yisa so yi ni nya ka o yi yi sani chani alizanda ni shɛm maa, lala ka o ti lan yɛn labina.
en: They said, Why are you men from Galilee standing here and looking up into the sky? Jesus has been taken to heaven. But he will come back in the same way you have seen him go.

dag: Di biɛrisuŋ mini di viɛlim ti ku mali kpee! Di kawana ni ti chɛ ka nachimbihi mali kpiɔŋ, ka di wain mi chɛ ka paɣisara ni nyeena.
en: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niriba taari duŋ, di malila zuɣulaan bɔbigu, amaa zuɣulaan so ŋun mali yɛm yi dira, binshɛlikam niŋdila viɛnyɛliŋga yuui.
en: A lawless nation will have many bad leaders. But a smart leader will rule for a long time in a land where people obey the law.

dag: Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Lahibal suŋ la zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim laɣim nya Naawuni daalibarika; bɛ daa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣa, ka laɣim diri Naawuni ni daa lo alikauli shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la nyɔri.
en: This plan is that the Gentiles would be coheirs and parts of the same body, and that they would share with the Jews in the promises of God in Christ Jesus through the gospel.

dag: Sɛnaa — tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihita.
en: of Senaah .

dag: Mia pi tiŋgban ni guli ba, ka tɔŋ do sol ni guli ba.
en: A rope is hidden on the ground for them; a trap for them along the path.

dag: Luk . Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anab kura la ni yino ŋun neei kum ni na.
en: They answered, Some people say you are John the Baptizer. Others say you are Elijah. And some people say you are one of the prophets from long ago that has come back to life.

dag: Ka Jɛhu lan yɛl o, Doli ma nti nya n suhu ni ye Yawɛ zuɣu shɛm, ka daa chɛ ka o kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ni pah o zuɣu.
en: and said, Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord . They rode together in Jehu's chariot.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti tabili Pɛɔr tiŋgbɔŋ ni Baal, ka diri kpiimba maligu nimdi.
en: They joined themselves to Baal-peor and ate sacrifices offered to the dead.

dag: Ibrahimma ni daa deei n noli ka doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: I will do this because Abraham obeyed me and kept my orders, my commandments, my statutes, and my instructions.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla n jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni ŋɔ fiɛbi ko shɛli din be Nail Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka di leei ʒim, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Lord is going to do something to show you that he really is the Lord . I will strike the Nile with this stick, and the water will turn into blood.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti nya alahiziba tuuni zuŋɔ.
en: Everyone was completely amazed and began to praise God. They were filled with great respect for Gods power. They said, Today we saw amazing things.

dag: Yi yi ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, ka kahim yi wain naai, yin zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu.
en: After you have threshed all your grain and pressed all your grapes, celebrate the Festival of Shelters for seven days.

dag: So daa naan ku tooi woligi suhupiɛlli tahigu vuri ka chɛ kuhigu vuri maa, dama niriba maa daa kul tahirila pampam, ka di vuri maa daa chaŋ katiŋ pam.
en: No one could distinguish the sound of the joyful shout from the sound of the peoples weeping, because the people rejoiced very loudly. The sound was heard at a great distance.

dag: O yi je suli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? O suhi yi yiɣisi pam, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi beni? O suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka tampima wurind o zuɣu.
en: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can confront the heat of his fury? His wrath pours out like fire; the rocks are shattered because of him.

dag: amaa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla waazu ka tinim yihira. Yɛhudianim sani di nyɛla kuɣituurili, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi sani di nyɛla jɛrilim;.
