en: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.

dag: Yi nuzaa polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli hal ni Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa ka Aizaia sanna.
en: When these leaders came to me.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini nimmaŋtali gbibi sokam zaa.
en: David ruled over all Israel and maintained justice and righteousness for all his people.

dag: Dama alahichi ku lan tooi sun ya yi ni yi fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni kpe Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni la zuɣu.
en: Sin will have no power over you, because you arent under Law but under grace.

dag: Zuliya kam wummi dimbɔŋɔ! Salinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Hear this, everyone! Listen, all people everywhere.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ piɛri mini niɣi ti Abimilɛk, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lo tab alikauli.
en: Abraham took flocks and cattle, gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them drew up a treaty.

dag: N suhu daa yiɣisiya bahi n niriba zuɣu, ka n daa niŋ ba kaman bɛ pala n niriba la. N daa zaŋ ba niŋla yi nuu ni, ka yi daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu, hal ka daa nahim bɛ ninkura pam.
en: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun pah ata la ŋun daa zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa ti gaai bɔɣili zaŋ li pi.
en: But the servant who had received one thousand coins went off, dug a hole in the ground, and hid his master's money.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani ninvuɣ so yi go piɛli gbaai biŋkɔbigu bee nooŋa ŋun ŋubbu bi chihira, dilan ŋun kɔrigim bini maa ʒim bahi tiŋa, ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu pa di zuɣu.
en: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah was years old when he went into the boat to escape the flood, and he did everything the Lord had told him to do. His wife, his sons, and his daughters-in-law all went inside with him.

dag: Ijipti naa ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa o sapashinnim ni yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o, ka ni ti di nam din galisi.
en: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.

dag: Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin, ka di zɔntua be di puuni. Bɛ daa ŋmɛla abie tihi pa di pilanim maa zaa zuɣu. Yaɣili kam daa malila zaɣ yiniyini.
en: Its stairway had seven steps, and its porch was at the other end. On its arches, one on either side, were palm decorations.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ, ka di nyom viɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: Offer a burnt offering to the Lord , an odor pleasing to him: one young bull, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Ka Utai mini Zakur mi daa nyɛ Biɣivai daŋ zuɣulaannima, ka dɔbba pisopɔin daa pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: of Bigvai, Uthai and Zaccur and with them were men.

dag: Yawɛ, a yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam. Di nyɛla din kul ba n-ʒe alizanda ni sahakam.
en: Lord , your word continues forever in heaven.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo! M Ba ni tim ma na shɛm, lala ka n gba timdi ya.
en: After Jesus had greeted them again, he said, I am sending you, just as the Father has sent me.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o suhu saɣim pam ka o yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: After Jesus had said this, he was deeply troubled and declared openly, I am telling you the truth: one of you is going to betray me.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi yila yilibu zani tariga, ka so ku lan wum yi mɔɣilɔnim kumsi.
en: I will bring an end to your cacophonous songs; the sound of your lyres will never be heard again.

dag: Dama yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya kɔŋko, laara bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Pa lala ka farigudeeriba gba niŋda?.
en: Why should God reward you if you love only the people who love you? Even the tax collectors do that!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sɔɣimi doya gu ma ni bɛ ku ma; amaa a zaligunim maa yɛla ka man kul tɛhira.
en: The wicked tried to destroy me, but your rules made me wise.

dag: O yi vihi ya, di ni viɛl yi zuɣu? Bee yi ni tooi yɔhim o kaman niriba ni yɔhindi tab shɛm la?.
en: If God looks at you closely, will he find anything good? Do you think you can fool God the way you fool others?.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.

dag: Shɛb daa zaŋla ŋariŋ kara n-kpe teeku puuni nti tumdi daabiligu tuma ko titali maa ni.
en: Some sailed the sea in ships. Their work carried them across the water.

dag: Dama bɛ zina niŋbu maa daa bi muɣisi ba. Bɛ daa saɣim tiŋgbani maa, ka niŋ zina kuɣili kam mini tia kam gbini.
en: Judah did not care that she was acting like a prostitute. So she made her country dirty. She committed the sin of adultery by worshiping idols made out of stone and wood.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na. Miriya ka yi zaŋ bubil bee piɛbil ma bihim duɣ o.
en: Each year bring to the house of the Lord your God the first grain that you harvest. Do not cook a young sheep or goat in its mother's milk.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be nimaani maa ka ninkur so ti yi o puuni na zaawuni. Doo maa daa yila Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni tiŋ ni na ti be Gibia maa. Amaa nimaaninim daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: That evening an old man came into the city from the fields. His home was in the hill country of Ephraim, but now he was living in the city of Gibeah.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa mini Izraɛlnima n-daa tuhi nyaŋ nanim maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ dabili Musa daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana n-ti Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses, the Lord 's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yihi li daɣiri ni naai, yin zaŋmiya naɣilaa ŋun ka daŋa mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara.
en: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them.

dag: ka ŋun maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yili luɣ kasi shee la tooni.
en: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.

dag: Di nyɛla shihirili shɛli din kul ni be m mini Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ daa zaŋla daba ayɔbu n-nam zuɣusaa mini dunia, ka vuhi daba ayopɔin dali, ka n ni maai. .
en: It is a sign forever between me and the Israelites that in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day the LORD rested and was refreshed.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Filip, m min a ni be ka di yuui ŋ-ŋɔ ka a na bi mi ma? Ŋun nya ma, o nya m Ba; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n wuhimi ya m Ba maa.
en: Jesus answered, Philip, I have been with you for a long time. So you should know me. Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father too. So why do you say, Show us the Father?.

dag: Nyam salima la ni daɣi shɛm. Nyam salima alali la ni daɣi shɛm. Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu kuɣ viɛla la wurim do soya zuɣu luɣilikam.
en: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.

dag: Di yi pa lala Masidɔnianim shɛb yi nyɛla bɛn doli ma kana nti nya ka yi bi mali shili, ti ni di vi zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋ ya naani shɛm la polo, amaa di bahi bamdi yinima.
en: If any of those from Macedonia come with me, and they find that you are not ready, we will be ashamed. We will be ashamed that we were so sure of you. And you will be ashamed too!.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ tiwala tihi puu ni, ni n ti nya vinvamli ni tipuma, ka nya wain tihi puma, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi puma.
en: To the nut grove I went down to look upon the fresh growth in the valley, to see whether the vine was in flower, whether the pomegranates had bloomed.

dag: Ŋun tumdi putuma deerila shɛli o tuma zuɣu, ka laɣindi atam maa sɔŋdi guli nyɛvili din ka bahigu saha ni di chɛ ka ŋun biriti mini ŋun chɛri zaa ti laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who harvest are receiving their pay and gathering fruit for eternal life so that those who sow and those who harvest can celebrate together.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm pina ti ma. Ŋunkam suhu yu ni o ti pini, nyin deem li ti ma.
en: Tell the Israelites to bring me gifts. You will accept gifts for me from everyone who is willing to give.

dag: Yawɛ, tim naa maa nasara; ka garigi ti saha shɛli ti yi ti kuhi bol a.
en: LORD, save the king! Let him answer us when we cry out!.

dag: Yɛhudianim bi be bɛ ko ka chɛ bɛn pa Yɛhudianima; kulla Duuma yino n-nyɛ bɛ zaa Duuma, ka o niŋdi alibarika din galisi n-niŋdi bɛnkam kuhiri boon o ni.
en: This includes everyone, because there is no difference between Jews and Gentiles; God is the same Lord of all and richly blesses all who call to him.

dag: Zaŋmiya li na nti yɛli ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ. Yɛlimiya ti kurimbuni ha yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti zahim li nya din yɛn niŋ di puuni bee wuhimiya ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha.
en: Let your idols come in and tell us what will happen. Idols, tell us what happened in the beginning. We will listen closely so that we can make a decision. Tell us what will happen in the future.

dag: Di pa shɛli na so ni tooi mali napaɣiba pihiyɔbu, ka mali mamanim pihinii ni paɣisara bɛn ka kalinli.
en: There may be sixty queens and eighty secondary wives, young women beyond counting.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ binʒim maa kpaai vie Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni la, ka zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim ka di nyɛ din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest will toss the blood against the LORDs altar at the meeting tents entrance and burn the fat completely as a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri. Bɛ ti ku wum amiliya mini aŋgo kukoya Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm solɔri zuɣu. Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti zani dabari.
en: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.

dag: Chira ayɔbu zaa ka o daa zaŋ wuh o niriba maa azichi din be o nam puuni mini di jilima ni di dariza ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: The party continued for days. All during this time, King Xerxes was showing the great wealth of his kingdom and the majestic beauty and wealth of his palace.

dag: Ŋun biriti omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla din poora niŋgbuŋ kɔre maa zuɣu; amaa ŋun biriti Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu bimbira ni ti chɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu, Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu.
en: If you live to satisfy your sinful self, the harvest you will get from that will be eternal death. But if you live to please the Spirit, your harvest from the Spirit will be eternal life.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Patrɔs zani dabari. N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Zɔan, ka ti kari Tɛbisinim saria.
en: I will make Pathros empty. I will start a fire in Zoan. I will punish Thebes.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bɔri ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni bɛ suhuri zaa la daa yi Izraɛl bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa n-doli Lɛvinim kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la.
en: When the Levites left Israel, the people in all the tribes of Israel who were faithful to the Lord , the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord , the God of their fathers.

dag: N daa yi Ibrahimma zuɣu, ka yi Yisahaku zuɣu, ka lan yi Yaakubu gba zuɣu n-wuhi ba ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa, amaa n daa bi kahigi n yuli Yawɛ wuhi ba.
en: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob as Almighty God, but I did not make myself known to them by my holy name, the Lord .

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: His betrayer had given them a sign: Arrest the man I kiss, and take him away under guard.

dag: ka din pahi pisi daa gbaai Ɛliata min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Twentieth, there were men chosen from Eliathahs sons and relatives.

dag: Naftali tiŋgbani zaa mini Ifriim tiŋgbani ni Manaasa tiŋgbani ni Juda tiŋgbani zaa zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili polo teeku noli.
en: the entire territory of Naphtali; the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh; the territory of Judah as far west as the Mediterranean Sea;.

dag: bɛn daa yi Rubin zuliya ni na la daa ti zaŋ niriba mini Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri kɔbisiyi ni pihinu m-pa bɛmaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti va n-zani Musa tooni. Niriba maa daa nyɛla bɛ ni pii shɛba, ka bɛ nyɛ niriba ni mi shɛb yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: These four men gathered other men from Israel together and came against Moses. They were leaders who had been chosen by the people. All the people knew them.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa gbibi tɔbiri daa ŋmaligi guui tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: The Ephraimites, armed with bows and arrows, ran away on the day of battle.

dag: Yɔɣu ni bunsi tamla daboya zuɣu n-taɣiri ʒiɛɣu kaman yɔbahi la, ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, mɔri ni kani zuɣu.
en: The wild donkeys stand on the hilltops and pant for breath like jackals; their eyesight fails them because they have no food.

dag: Ka bɛ dii mɔhiri vuri, ka ŋari bɛ tiba n-kabi chaŋ o sani.
en: With a loud cry the Council members covered their ears with their hands. Then they all rushed at him at once.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan mali ʒiʒiriba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣikpɛriba tuhi pihinii zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: Solomon also had , stone cutters in the hill country, with , men to carry the stones.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Yisa ka o be katiŋa, ka o guui ti damd o tooni.
en: When the man saw Jesus in the distance, he ran up to him and knelt down.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni yi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria, o sariakaribo maa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: We know that Gods judgment agrees with the truth, and his judgment is against those who do these kinds of things.

dag: chɛ ka a pɔhim biɛɣu doli ba lala, ka chɛ ka a sanʒiɛ titali kpɛhi ba dabiɛm!.
en: pursue and terrify them with storms of your own.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa zo ka chɛ Yisa, ka malaikanim kana ti kpaŋs o suhu.
en: So the devil left him. Then some angels came to Jesus and helped him.

dag: Dama bɛnkam ti tum din chihiri maa, bɛn yihim ba bɛ daŋ ni.
en: You know that whoever does any of these disgusting things will no longer be considered one of God's people.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛli n taali a yuli zuɣu, dama n daalahichi galisiya pam.
en: Be true to your name, Lord , by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam ŋahiri ŋaha, ni ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛli, Ma ni be shɛm lala ka o bipuɣiŋga gba be.
en: Now everyone who speaks in proverbs will say this about you: Like mother, like daughter.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali sania balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ karili mini zaɣ bila yi kola ni.
en: Dont have two different types of money weights in your bag, a heavy one and a light one.

dag: Izraɛl yaɣili polɔnima: Parɔsh daŋ ni: Ramia mini Izia ni Malikija ni Mijamin ni Ɛliɛza ni Malikija so mi ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Among the other Israelites, these men married foreign women: From the descendants of Parosh, these men: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah, and Benaiah.

dag: Ka m mi ni ŋun piligi tuun suŋ ŋɔ yi ni maa ni tum li hal ti naai li ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmɛlimmi yi kparima, ka kpam niŋ bɛ shɛhi ni.
en: They may be rich and fat.

dag: Nyamiya, Naawuni be ti sani, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zuɣulana, ka o maligumaaniba mi mali tɔbutuhiri kikahi ni bɛ piɛb niŋ ti ka ti tuhi ya. Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, miriya ka yi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, dama yi ku di nasara.
en: God himself is our leader and his priests are here with trumpets, ready to blow them and call us to battle against you. People of Israel, don't fight against the Lord , the God of your ancestors! You can't win.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa kul muɣisiri ba ka yɛra, Tummiya yi tuma naari dabisili kam kaman bɛ ni yi tiri ya mɔri ka yi tumdi li shɛm maa.
en: The slave masters drove them hard and said, Make sure you make the same daily quota as when you had the straw.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ o daŋ niriba mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi zaa ʒili nyaɣil o m-pahi lahi balibu kam, din nyɛ pipihi zaŋ tabili lahi ni duɣ bihi zaa.
en: All the honor of his household will hang on him, the offspring and the offshoots, every little dish, every bowl, every jar.

dag: N ka galimi, m baɣa kani. M bi lan bɔri n nyɛvili.
en: Im blameless, yet dont know myself; I reject my life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛbisi ba, ka bɛ mali ti paai Antiɔk n-laɣim yɛdaniŋdiba n-zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ba.
en: So Paul, Barnabas, Judas, and Silas left Jerusalem and went to Antioch. There they gathered the group of believers together and gave them the letter.

dag: Yisa ni daa naai ŋaha ŋɔ, o daa yila nimaani.
en: When Jesus had finished telling these stories, he left.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti zaŋ li tin ya kaman o ni daa lo yi mini yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: When the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you as promised to you and your ancestors.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim ninvuɣ yoya pah omaŋ zuɣu n-leei bɛ salo maa zuɣulana. Dauda ni daa ku o dimnim Sirianim la nyaaŋa ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa. Ka Rɛzɔn min o niriba maa daa chaŋ ti ʒini Damaskus, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o leei Damaskus naa.
en: After David defeated the army of Zobah, Rezon gathered some men and became the leader of a small army. He went to Damascus and stayed there to rule from Damascus.

dag: Yɛm ka Ayuba ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa ni, o yɛtɔɣa maa ka gbinni.
en: that Job is speaking from ignorance and that nothing he says makes sense.

dag: N daa yɛn malila sara, ka zuŋɔ n niŋ n ni daa po pɔri ni n niŋ shɛli maa.
en: I offered a fellowship offering today. I gave what I promised to give.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ dari maa pirigili m-mali buɣim she nimdi ŋubi tiɣi; ka lan zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim wuɣisi ka yɛra, Buɣim ŋɔ wuɣisibu kpe ma nyaɣisim, di kpe n kɔba ni.
en: He burns half of the wood in the fire. He uses the fire to cook his meat, and he eats the meat until he is full. He burns the wood to keep himself warm. He says, Good! Now I am warm, and I can see by the light of the fire.

dag: ka zaŋ manna shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ʒi n-dihi ya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni o chɛ ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zahim ya, ka niŋ ya din viɛla di bahigu ni.
en: In the desert he gave you manna to eat, food that your ancestors had never eaten. He sent hardships on you to test you, so that in the end he could bless you with good things.

dag: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pinaata m-pahi di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu.
en: In all, the Gershon family groups got towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa tum shɛm la. Amɔn daa kɔri biŋkɔbiri m-mali binnan shɛŋa zaa o ba Manaasa ni daa mali zal la, ka jɛmdi li.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as his father Manasseh had done. He sacrificed to all the idols his father had made and worshipped them.

dag: Binshɛɣukam puuni n wuhi ya ni sokam moom o nini n-tum lala sɔŋ bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la, ka teeya ti Duuma Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm la, Dina n-nyɛ ni Ŋun tiri mal alibarika gari ŋun deera. .
en: I have shown you in all things that by working hard in this way we must help the weak, remembering the words that the Lord Jesus himself said, There is more happiness in giving than in receiving.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka nir ni tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa n nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi? Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: Whoever wants to enter a strong mans house and steal his things must first tie him up. Then they can steal the things from his house.

dag: ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya n jilima mini n ni pun tum alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Ijipti mini mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka zahim ma paai siɣimsiɣim pia, ka zaɣisi n noli ŋɔ.
en: None of the people I led out of Egypt will ever see the land of Canaan. They saw my glory and the great signs that I did in Egypt and in the desert. But they disobeyed me and tested me ten times.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ daba ayopɔin dali, n ni chɛ ka saa lu dunia ni na m-mi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa biɛɣ pihinahi n-ku n ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ tiŋgban ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: In seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will wipe off from the fertile land every living thing that I have made.

dag: a yi be kasi ka a biɛhigu be tibi zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni ka a sanna nti labisi din simd a ti a.
en: if you are so honest and pure, then God will come and help you and restore your household as your reward.

dag: Di saha ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli Yawɛ. A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ ma tuhi fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: Then Gideon said to God, You say that you have decided to use me to rescue Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka nyini Ziɔn Zoli, din nyɛ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni be kaman piɛgula n-lihiri o niriba ŋɔ, a ni ti lan nya nam shɛli a ni daa pun su la.
en: Mount Zion in Jerusalem, guardian of my people, you will rule again.

dag: Ka Nɛgɛbinim ti deei Iso Zoli su; ka bɛn be zolɔna ni wulinluhili polo la ti deei Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Izraɛlnim ni ti deei Ifriim mini Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi ti deei Giliad su.
en: People from southern Judah will occupy Edom; those from the western foothills will capture Philistia. Israelites will possess the territory of Ephraim and Samaria; the people of Benjamin will take Gilead.

dag: Dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ti mini ya zali Masia ni, ka pii ti.
en: It is God himself who makes us, together with you, sure of our life in union with Christ; it is God himself who has set us apart.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa: Bɛnya kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bela kasi.
en: Say to the whole community of the Israelites: You must be holy, because I, the LORD your God, am holy.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Lɛvi zuliya niriba maa zaa ti ku mali tarili bee fali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ ni ti dirila sara binshɛŋa din nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: Neither the levitical priests nor any Levite tribe member will have a designated inheritance in Israel. They can eat the sacrifices offered to the LORD, which are the LORDs portion.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla alikauli palibu sara maligu bee o suhuyubu sara maligu, bɛ ni tooi ŋubi di nimdi maa o ni mali sara maa dahin shɛli maa, ka shɛli yi guui zani neei biɛɣu bɛ ni tooi ŋub li;.
en: But if your communal sacrifice of well-being is payment for a solemn promise or if it is a spontaneous gift, it may be eaten on the day you offer it as your communal sacrifice, and whatever is left over can be eaten the next day.

dag: Yisifu biɛyanim ni daa nya ka bɛ ba kpi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Di pa shɛli ka Yisifu zaɣisi ti ka bɔhi ti biɛri ti ni daa niŋ o zaɣ biɛ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: After Jacob died, Josephs brothers were worried. They were afraid that Joseph would still be mad at them for what they had done years before. They said, Maybe Joseph still hates us for what we did.

dag: Dinzuɣu, daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli Gɔg, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa n niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti be ni alaafee, amaŋmaŋ ni ti yiɣisi.
en: So now, prophesy, human one, and say to Gog, The LORD God proclaims: Isnt that what you will decide to do on that day, when my people Israel live securely?.

dag: Ti ni daa tum alahichi shɛli Pɛɔr ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu, ka ti na kul diri di wahala la bi galisi nyaŋ ti?.
en: Remember our sin at Peor, when the Lord punished his own people with an epidemic? We are still suffering because of that. Wasn't that sin enough?.

dag: Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa yɛli Karia bia Jɔhanan, Di niŋ lala, dama ʒiri ka a ŋma m-pa Ishimail maa.
en: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, Dont kill Ishmael. The things you are saying about Ishmael are not true.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N saha na bi paai; amaa yinim nyɛla bɛn kul mali saha sahakam.
en: Jesus said to them, The right time for me has not yet come, but any time is right for you to go.

dag: Ka amiliya aŋgo maa daa ti yuui kandina, ka gom gbahi bɛ zaa ka bɛ gbihi.
en: When the bridegroom was very late, the girls could not keep their eyes open, and they all fell asleep.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti Duuma ni bɔri ni yi be shɛm, ka kul tumdi din tiɣir o nini. Ka lan chɛ ka yi bebu ni tooi mali wala kaman tia la tuun suŋ balibu kam ni, ka yi kul ni zoori pahiri Naawuni baŋbu puuni.
en: Then you will be able to live as the Lord wants and will always do what pleases him. Your lives will produce all kinds of good deeds, and you will grow in your knowledge of God.

dag: Dama dindali yuŋ maa n ni tim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gari, ka ku Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa, ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka darigi Ijipti buɣa zaa tibili. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: That same night I will pass through Egypt and kill the first-born son in every family and the first-born male of all animals. I am the Lord , and I will punish the gods of Egypt.

dag: O tahigu maa vuri ni gili dunia luɣilikam, dama Yawɛ mini zuliya kam malila yɛtɔɣa. O ni kari ninsalinim zaa saria, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn mali taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa dol o naɣikɔra yi puuni kunna ti wum kuhigu maa ka bɔhi, Ka bɔ n-niŋ niriba maa ka bɛ zaa ti kuhiri lala? Ka bɛ daa yɛl o Jabɛshinim ni ʒi lahiba shɛli maa na.
en: Just then, Saul came in from the fields, walking behind his oxen. Why is everyone crying? Saul asked. They told him what the men from Jabesh had said.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi ti nya ka Naawuni bɔhi biɛri, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti siɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ʒim ni n-no n-gili.
en: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.

dag: N ni darigi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa tibili, ka kpihim Baal tuma din kpalim mini buɣa maligumaaniba yuya kpe.
en: I will punish the people of Jerusalem and of all Judah. I will destroy the last trace of the worship of Baal there, and no one will even remember the pagan priests who serve him.

dag: Ŋunkam di ʒiri shɛhira ni nya tibidarigibo, ka ʒirilan ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.

dag: Di yi nyɛla din viɛla bee din bie, ti ni deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti timd a o sani ŋɔ noli. Ti yi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli, di ni chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛla ti sani.
en: Whether we like it or not, we will obey all that the LORD our God says. We will obey the LORD our God, to whom were sending you, so it may go well for us.

dag: Dɛdan mini Tɛma ni Buz ni bɛn zaa pindi bɛ zuɣuri bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri puuni;.
en: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yihi yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli yi puri ni pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu zali yuuni kam.
en: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.

dag: Amaa binneembihi zaa bɛn mali paɣiri, ka mali nab anahi nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: But all other small things that have wings and also crawl must be considered unclean.

dag: Ŋunkam shihi ya, n nimbiɛlim ka o shihi maa. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zaŋ o yɛligu tim ma ni n yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn nahind o niriba la:.
en: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa pihi bɛ napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka yi ni chaŋ Aikɔnium.
en: The apostles shook the dust off their feet in protest against them and went on to Iconium.

dag: O ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gili yili maa ka bi tooi dam li la, dama di daa me n-tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: They are like a man building a house. He digs deep and builds his house on rock. The floods come, and the water crashes against the house. But the flood cannot move the house, because it was built well.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi leeg o tulaalɛmaaniba min o bindir duɣiriba ni o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba.
en: Your daughters will have to make perfumes for him and work as his cooks and his bakers.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bahi, o daa yiɣisila nimaani n-kpe ŋariŋ yi kpaŋa. Ka salo daa wum o chandi maa damli, ka yi tinsi ni n-chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu kar o naba.
en: When Jesus heard what happened to John, he left in a boat. He went alone to a place where no one lived. But the people heard that Jesus had left. So they left their towns and followed him. They went by land to the same place he went.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, ka bi ʒe a kɔsoya maa nyaaŋa, n ni chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa bahi yoli n-leei dabari, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine n-zaŋ hal ti paai Itiɔpia tintariga.
en: I am your enemy and the enemy of your Nile. I will make all of Egypt an empty wasteland, from the city of Migdol in the north to the city of Aswan in the south, all the way to the Ethiopian border.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee gbarigi, ka o gbariginsim maa bi tabili ma? Ŋuni ka so lee luhi, ka n suhu bi yiɣisi bahi ŋun luh o maa zuɣu?.
en: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: The total number of descendants of the Temple workers and of Solomon's servants who returned from exile was .

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n yɛl lala? M bi yuri ya mi zuɣu ka n yɛl lala maa? Naawuni gba mi ni n yuri ya!.
en: Do I say this because I don't love you? God knows I love you!.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Elihu continued talking and said.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, yi yi ti laɣim ni yi di ti Duuma Bindirigu maa, yin guhimiya taba.
en: For these reasons, my brothers and sisters, when you get together to eat, wait for each other.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo bɛ fɔntin shɛŋa ni bɛ ni daa be mini bɛ sansana zaa buɣim.
en: They burned all the cities where they lived and their encampments.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya din niŋ maa ka paɣi Naawuni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla ŋun ka taali.
en: The army officer there saw what happened. He praised God, saying, I know this man was a good man.

dag: Naawuni, a ni daa be a niriba tooni m-mali ba chani la, a ni daa kpe mɔɣu ni gari la.
en: God, you led your people out of Egypt. You marched across the desert. Selah.

dag: N kul ni niŋdi n ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka bɛn yɛli ni ti mini ba dolila so yini n-tumdi la ku nya daliri nyu bara.
en: And I will continue doing what I am doing now, because I want to stop those people from having a reason to boast. They would like to say that the work they boast about is the same as ours.

dag: Zaŋm ninvuɣ so ŋun tu ma maa yihi sansani maa kpaŋa nti chɛ ka bɛn zaa wum o ni tu ma shɛm maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa lab o kuɣa.
en: Bring the man who cursed to a place outside the camp. Then bring together everyone who heard him curse. They will put their hands on his head. And then all the people must throw stones at him and kill him.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Pɛnuɛluɛlnim maa, N yi ti labina ni alaafee, n ni daai yi pii ŋɔ luhi.
en: So Gideon said to the men of Penuel, After I win the victory, I will come back here and pull this tower down.

dag: Ka Hadad daa ti kpi. O kalinsi nyaaŋa na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: The people of Edom were divided into the following tribes: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ tamla nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima zuɣu. Naawuni ŋun ku ŋma ʒiri ŋɔ daa lo ti nyɛvili ŋɔ alikauli la ʒiɛmana din gari la ha ni.
en: which is based on the hope for eternal life. God, who does not lie, promised us this life before the beginning of time.

dag: ka fara lir a kaman tayiɣ la, ka kum lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lo kpara la.
en: but while you are asleep, poverty will attack you like an armed robber.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri soli n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa ni bɛ taba, ka di dihiri bɛmaŋmaŋ nama vi.
en: People wanted only to do evil. So God left them and let them go their sinful way. And so they became completely immoral and used their bodies in shameful ways with each other.

dag: N kul lihirila zoya zuɣu. Ya polo ka n sɔŋsim lee yɛn yina?.
en: I look up to the hills, but where will my help really come from?.

dag: Ka Annas daa chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Kaiafas sani.
en: Then Annas sent him, still tied up, to Caiaphas the High Priest.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la ni yɛn su tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm.
en: Their legacy was assigned by lot, exactly as the LORD had commanded the nine and a half tribes through Moses.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o wum n suhigu maa.
en: I was in trouble. I called to the Lord for help, and he answered me!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la. O ni daa yɛli ba shɛm ka niŋ alibarika shɛŋa din simdi bɛ zaa yinoyino niŋ bɛ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the twelve families of Israel. And this is what their father said to them. He gave each son a blessing that was right for him.

dag: Pa shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa n-nyɛ tuuli, amaa dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ la n-nyɛ tuuli, ka shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa naanyi paya.
en: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.

dag: Amaa ka yi ti yiɣisi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-lu m ba malibu zuɣu n-zaŋ o bidibisi pisopɔin pa tampin yini zuɣu ku ba; ka zaŋ Abimilɛk ŋun nyɛ o dab paɣ bia la leei yi naa ni o su Shɛkɛmnima o ni nyɛ yi dɔɣira la zuɣu.
en: But today you turned against my father's family. You killed his sons—seventy men on a single stone—and just because Abimelech, his son by his servant woman, is your relative, you have made him king of Shechem.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa be nimaani ka di niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk daa ti lihi takɔro ni nya ka Yisahaku diɛmd o paɣ Ribɛka.
en: After Isaac had been there a long time, King Abimelech looked out a window and saw Isaac hugging and kissing Rebekah.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba ni nyaanzuriba. Bɛ ŋmanila tahiʒiɛɣu mini kurigu. Bɛ zaa tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *.

dag: Ninsalinim mi lee nyɛla bɔ, ka a tibigi ba pam, ka zaŋ a zaŋsim niŋ bɛ ni.
en: What are human beings, that you exalt them, that you take note of them.

dag: Ka salo maa daa vu m-miri Gomna Pailɛt nti yɛl o ni o niŋmi ka o ni yi pun niŋdi ba shɛm la.
en: The crowd pushed forward and asked Pilate to release someone, as he regularly did.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi tiligira; labimiya n sanna. Dama n vuui yi tuumbiɛri mini yi daalahichi bahi kaman sagbani bee paɣili ni vuuri shɛm la.
en: I swept away your rebellions like a cloud, and your sins like fog. Return to me, because I have redeemed you.

dag: Doli naa zaligu, a ni po pɔri din nyɛ kasi la zuɣu.
en: Keep the kings command as you would keep a solemn pledge.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ya ti niŋ o ni daa lo yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali fɔntin kara din viɛla, ka pa yi ni me shɛŋa.
en: Just as the Lord your God promised your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, he will give you a land with large and prosperous cities which you did not build.

dag: Malimiya yimaŋ kasi n-kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛɣu ka mali yi zuliya niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali shɛm la.
en: Slaughter the Passover lambs and prepare the holy sacrifices for your relatives in order to celebrate according to the LORDs word through Moses.

dag: Naawuni Shi yino maa zuɣu ka ti zaa deei baptaizibu niŋgbun yini maa ni, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka di yi nyɛla daba bee bilichinnima, Shi yino maa ka ti zaa daa laɣim deei.
en: Some of us are Jews and some of us are not; some of us are slaves and some of us are free. But we were all baptized to become one body through one Spirit. And we were all given the one Spirit.

dag: ka chɛ ka o yo paɣisarili maa ba anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga, o ni saɣim Izraɛl paɣa ŋun nyɛ paɣipali yuli maa zuɣu. O na kul ni nyɛla o paɣa, ka di bi simdi ni o zaɣis o saha shɛl o ni be o nyɛvili ni.
en: They must fine him ounces of silver. They will give the money to the girls father because her husband brought shame to an Israelite girl. And the girl will continue to be the mans wife. He cannot divorce her for the rest of his life.

dag: Bɛ kul tumdila vi tuma, ka di kuri ma suli. Bɛ maanila maligu buɣa ni, ka tuɣindi tulaale buɣa maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens and burning incense on bricks.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula; ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛla pam.
en: As Jesus stepped out of the boat, he saw a large crowd waiting. He felt sorry for them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd to care for them. So he taught the people many things.

dag: Wumpaɣibo yila ni ti yiri di puuni na, ka bɛn puhiri chuɣu ni ti yɔri vuri di puuni. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ nabi, ka ku lan pɔra. N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima, ka so ku lan mali ba ansarisi.
en: People in those places will sing songs of praise, and there will be the sound of laughter. I will give them many children. Israel and Judah will not be small. I will bring honor to them. No one will look down on them.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ puhiri ya, di bahi bamdi bɛn be Naa Siiza yiŋ la.
en: All Gods people here, especially those in Caesars household, send you their greeting.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee din mali kpiɔŋ; ka chɛ ka barina shɛli ka n soli zuɣu.
en: You are my strong fortress, and you set me free.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yi wuhiri ya soli, dindina yi lan pala bɛn be fukumsi zaligu la sulinsi ni.
en: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka dɔro din nyuuri niriba lu bɛn di n-tiɣ la zuɣu. Buɣim ni ti taai bɛ jilima n di li zaa.
en: The Lord Almighty is going to send disease to punish those who are now well-fed. In their bodies there will be a fire that burns and burns.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali, bomiya yuma ayi piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi, ka bo zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam ŋmiri li m-pahi binnyura sara zuɣu.
en: On the Sabbath you must give lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them. You must also give a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil, and a drink offering.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, bɛ daa zu ma la Hiburu tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka kpe gba, m bi tum taal shɛli ka di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ ma kpɛhi sarika.
en: I was stolen from the land of the Hebrews, and here too Ive done nothing to be thrown into this dungeon.

dag: O mɔŋ ma suhudoo; man tamla suhupiɛlli yɛla.
en: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.

dag: N yi ti niŋ buɣim dabi Ijipti, ka bɛnkam sɔŋdi ba maa lu, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: They will know that I am the LORD. On the day that I set fire to Egypt and all its helpers are broken.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti gbahi ya tahi saria karibu shee, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri yi ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm bee n-tɔɣisi shɛm zuɣu; di saha maa yi ni ti baŋ yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Whenever they hand you over, dont worry about how to speak or what you will say, because what you can say will be given to you at that moment.

dag: Ka alikama maa daa ti va puya m-pil dɔɣibu, di saha ka bɛ naanyi baŋ ni piriŋkpana be di ni.
en: When the plants came up and began to mature, the farmer's servants could see the weeds.

dag: A ku zɔri yuŋ varisigu bee peen shɛŋa din yiɣiri wuntaŋ ni.
en: You need not fear any dangers at night or sudden attacks during the day.

dag: Di saha m ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: So when David wanted to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra;.
en: Jesus said to his followers, There is such a big harvest of people to bring in. But there are only a few workers to help harvest them.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ka ti kul ni jɛm, ka deeg o noli.
en: The people said to Joshua, We will serve the LORD our God and will obey him.

dag: Hal bɛ ni booni binshɛŋa buɣa la yi bela zuɣusaa bee dunia ŋɔ ni, dama buɣa pam mini duumanim pam shiri beni.
en: Its really not important if there are things called gods in heaven or on earth—and there are many of these gods and lords out there.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n-chɛ ka n kpi zaŋ chaŋ di dolibu polo ni di chɛ ka n tooi be Naawuni zuɣu.
en: I died to the Law through the Law, so that I could live for God.

dag: A yi nya noombil tiɛɣu tia kam zuɣu bee tiŋa, ka o bihi bee o gala be di ni, ka o ŋuni noombihi maa zuɣu bee gala maa zuɣu, nyin di gbaai nooŋa maa min o bihi maa.
en: If you happen to find a bird's nest in a tree or on the ground with the mother bird sitting either on the eggs or with her young, you are not to take the mother bird.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi ni mali karimbaan shɛli nyuri bara maa, ka chɛ ka yi sagbana mi be kaman kurigu la.
en: I will destroy your prideful power. I will turn your sky to iron and your land to bronze.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a, ka a garigi ma.
en: Now stand up straight and answer the questions I ask you.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinu.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Ka dunianim suhuri ni paligi bɛ kum maa zuɣu, ka bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli ka tiri tab pina, anabinima ayi maa ni daa yi nahindi dunianim shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa bee o ku tib o, dama bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ nyala o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses kept watching Jesus to see if he would heal the man. They did this because they wanted to accuse Jesus of doing something wrong.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa ni bɛ doo kam mini paɣ kam suhim o ʒiʒiinikpee anzinfa mini salima nɛma.
en: Now speak to the people of Israel and tell all of them to ask their neighbors for gold and silver jewelry.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli Ilaija, Pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla Naawuni nira, ka Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli a ni mali tɔɣisiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: You are God's prophet! the woman replied. Now I know that you really do speak for the Lord .

dag: Saimɔn Pita mini Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la ni Nataniɛl ŋun daa yi Kɛna din be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la ni Zɛbidii bihi la m-pahi nyaandoliba ayi n-daa laɣim taba.
en: Simon Peter, Thomas , Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, Zebedees sons, and two other disciples were together.

dag: Musa daa pirigi tiŋgbani shɛli ti Rubin zuliya ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses had given each family group from the tribe of Reuben some land. This is the land they received:.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ, M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, Firawuna ku bɔri ni o wum n yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses answered, You know that I am such a poor speaker; why should the king listen to me.

dag: Ka paɣ ŋɔ ti dɔni marig o bia yuŋ ka o kpi.
en: This womans son died one night when she rolled over him.

dag: ni Zɛla ni Hailɛf ni Jɛbusi; ni Gibia ni Kiriatijiarim: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaanahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city , Gibeah, and Kiriath. There were cities and the fields around them. The tribe of Benjamin got all these areas.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa sani nti boli ba ka bɛ kana ti dol o. Ka o daa lan tim ti boli Asha mini Zɛbulɔn ni Naftali zuliya niriba, ka bɛ gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: He also sent messengers to the tribes of Manasseh, Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, telling the men of these tribes to come and join his army. Then they set out toward the enemy camp.

dag: Amaa Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nima, ka ti daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, ti ni daa zɔri Babilɔn tɔbbihi mini Siria tɔbbihi dabiɛm maa zuɣu. Lala zuɣu ka ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: But when King Nebuchadnezzar invaded the country, we decided to come to Jerusalem to get away from the Babylonian and Syrian armies. That is why we are living in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti boli paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bi kuri bidibbihi maa ka chɛ ba.
en: So the king of Egypt called the two midwives and said to them, Why are you doing this? Why are you letting the baby boys live.

dag: amaa bɛ zaŋmila tuun suma m-malimi bɛmaŋa kaman di ni niŋ kamaata ni paɣiba bɛn doli adiini soli niŋdi shɛm.
en: They should make themselves attractive by doing good, which is appropriate for women who claim to honor God.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Saha kanna, n ni niŋ li. N ku chɛ li niŋbu, n ku tilig a, n suhu ku maai. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma min a biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That time will certainly come! And when it does, I won't show the people of Jerusalem any pity or change my mind. They must be punished for the evil they have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, n ni zaŋ ba Bashan n-labisi kpe na. N ni yihi ba teeku bulli ni na.
en: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.

dag: Tibili bi wumdila yɛtɔɣa ka zahindi li kaman zilinli ni lamdi bindirigu shɛm la?.
en: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka mɔri niŋ mɔɣu ni ka yi biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: and grass for your livestock. You will have all the food you want.

dag: Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka boli di yuli Ɛlbɛtɛl, Naawuni ni daa kahig omaŋ wuh o saha shɛl o ni daa yi o biɛli sani zɔri la zuɣu.
en: Jacob built an altar there. He named the place El Bethel. Jacob chose this name because that is the place where God first appeared to him when he was running from his brother.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sariakaritiba ni bɛ tuma kpamba na nti yɛli ba, N kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ.
en: At this time Joshua called a meeting of all the older leaders, heads of families, judges, and officers of the Israelites. Joshua said, I have grown very old.

dag: Dabiɛm ka yurilim puuni, ka yurilim din niŋ dɛde nyɛla din yihiri dabiɛm bahira. Dama dabiɛm mini tibidarigibo n-dol taba; dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm, yurilim na bi niŋ dɛde o ni.
en: There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear, because fear expects punishment. The person who is afraid has not been made perfect in love.

dag: Yawɛ guli saamba, ka gbibi pakoya mini kpibisi. Amaa o saɣindi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo nia shɛŋa.
en: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka a mini Haman kana yuŋ ŋɔ nti di bindira ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni pun niŋ zali nyin naa ŋɔ.
en: Esther said, I have prepared a party for you and Haman. Will you and Haman please come to the party today.

dag: Dinzuɣu n-chɛ ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka m mali suhupiɛlli; ka n niŋgbuŋ gba tiligi;.
en: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.

dag: O yi bi nahind o taba, amaa ka labisiri o ni deei binshɛŋa talima tiri bindaamba, ka pa ŋun fari niriba, ka nyɛ ŋun dihiri kum ni mali shɛba, ka sooni gbinfini ni mali shɛba.
en: He never cheats or robs anyone and always returns anything taken as security for a loan; he gives food and clothes to the poor.

dag: Bɛ daa chaŋ Nɛgɛb n-zaŋ ti paai Hiburɔn, ka Ahiman mini Shɛshai ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ Anaki zuliya niriba la daa be nimaani. .
en: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aminadab mini Kɔra ni Asir.
en: These are the descendants of Kohath from generation to generation: Amminadab, Korah, Assir.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, hal Anabi Musa daa wuhi di yɛla o ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni n-yɛli shɛm la puuni. O daa boli ti Duuma la, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: Even Moses demonstrated that the dead are raised—in the passage about the burning bush, when he speaks of the Lord as the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob .

dag: di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛli ni m Ba ni pii man ninvuɣ so n-tim dunia ŋɔ ni na maa mɔri Naawuni, n ni yɛli ni n nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu?.
en: So why do you accuse me of insulting God for saying, I am Gods Son? I am the one God chose and sent into the world.

dag: A daa zaŋ a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi shɛba a ni daa dɔɣi ti ma la m-mal a buɣa maa ni bɛ ŋubi, ka di be kaman a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli maa nyɛla yɛlibil la.
en: You and I had children together, but you took our children. You killed them and gave them to those false gods! But that is only some of the evil things you did when you were unfaithful to me and went to those false gods.

dag: Nyini daadam, wuhimi Izraɛlnim maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ buɣisi di biɛhigu maa, ka chɛ ka vi gbahi ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋma di nyɔŋ maa, hal nira ni ku tooi kpe di ni maa zaa yoli. Bɛ ni galisi gari toli maa zuɣu bɛ ka kalinli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: when men with axes start chopping down trees. It can only hiss and try to escape.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zɔhi waɣi pam muɣisi ba, ka chɛ ka poloya gba waɣi n-saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: He sent flies among them, that tormented them, and frogs that ruined their land.

dag: Ka yi yi tum taali ka bɛ fiɛbi ya di zuɣu, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya di zuɣu? Amaa yi yi tum din tuhi ka bɛ niŋ ya wahala di zuɣu ka yi niŋ suɣilo dee li, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani di zuɣu.
en: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa laɣim sokam zaa na nti yɛli ba, Ɛhab daa jɛm Baal la biɛla, amaa man yɛn jɛm o la pam.
en: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.

dag: Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: They started to argue among themselves, What shall we say? If we say, From God, he will say, Why, then, did you not believe John.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhi bol a, ka a fa ba bahi; bɛ daa niŋ a naani ka bi di vi.
en: They called to you and escaped from danger; they trusted you and were not disappointed.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M poya, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa gba ni ti nya turi.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: I myself swear that the nations round about you will themselves suffer ridicule.

dag: Asha zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Imna daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Imnanima; ka Ishivi daŋ niriba nyɛ Ishivinima; ka Bɛraya daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛrayanima.
en: Ashers descendants according to their clans: from Imnah, the Imnite clan; from Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; from Beriah, the Beriite clan.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, vi mali ma pam ni n kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa a tooni. Dama n Naawuni, ti daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi ti zuɣuri zuɣu; ka ti taali du hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: I said, O God, I am too ashamed to raise my head in your presence. Our sins pile up higher than our heads; they reach as high as the heavens.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi n-chaŋ ti da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbiga na ti pahi.
en: Amaziah also paid about . tons of silver to hire , soldiers from Israel.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa paag o nuu bɛ zuɣu ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ daa jɛmdila saŋmarisi kaman anabinim ni daa sab li shɛm bɛ litaafinim ni yɛli, Izraɛlnima, man Naawuni ka yi daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara tiri mɔɣu ni m-mali hal ti paai yuun pihinahi la?.
en: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those years in the desert.

dag: Ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa be bɛ ni.
en: There was a woman who had suffered terribly from severe bleeding for twelve years.

dag: Pa doo ka Naawuni daa nam ti paɣa, amaa paɣ ka Naawuni daa nam ti doo.
en: Nor was man created for woman's sake, but woman was created for man's sake.

dag: Ka sokam zaa nya li ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-niŋ li. Bɛ ni baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di niŋ maa.
en: People will see this and know that I, the Lord , have done it. They will come to understand that Israel's holy God has made it happen.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, Zomiya ka chɛ ma ka n kum pam m pubiɛ niriba kum zuɣu. Di bɔriya ni yi maai n suhu.
en: So I say, Dont look at me! Let me cry! Dont rush to comfort me about the destruction of Jerusalem.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka mali suhukpeeni, ka sokam mi bɛ yɛla bɛ daŋ dunoya ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ni kɔbisinii.
en: From the tribe of Ephraim there were , men. They were brave soldiers. They were famous men in their own families.

dag: Ka Bɛtitɔgarimanim daa zaŋdi yuri mini tɔbutuhiri yuri ni buntaansi na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: People from the nation of Togarmah traded horses, war horses, and mules for the things you sold.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa damdi tiŋa n-jɛm Daniɛl, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm pina mini tulaale viɛlli na ti mal o maligu.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar bowed down in front of Daniel to honor him. The king praised him. He gave an order that an offering and incense be given to honor Daniel.

dag: Dama zuliya kam jɛmdila bɛ wuna, amaa tinim ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God.

dag: Mbusim be piɛgul so ŋun chɛ piɛri bahi maa zuɣu! Bɛ ni zaŋ sua n-chɛ o bɔɣu tabil o nudirigu nini. Ka o bɔɣu maa kpi, ka o nudirigu nini maa gba zom zaa.
en: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya, Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner said to Joab, Lets have the young men fight in a contest before us. All right, Joab said, lets do it.

dag: Ka yi daa ti nya ka Nahash Ammɔnnim naa la daa lo tɔb kana ni o ti tuhi ya, ka yi yɛli ma, Aai, ti bɔri ni naa n-su ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ yi naa di saha maa.
en: But when you saw that King Nahash of Ammon was about to attack you, you rejected the Lord as your king and said to me, We want a king to rule us.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ gba ti leei din bi kpira.
en: For what is mortal must be changed into what is immortal; what will die must be changed into what cannot die.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi zaa chaŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka suhiya Naawuni daalibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Take your sheep, goats, and cattle, and get out. But ask your God to be kind to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini bɛ zaa teensi pirigilipirigili bahi ka chɛ pirigilipirigili, ka daa lan ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu bahi ka chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Hanun arrested David's officials and had their beards shaved off on one side of their faces. He had their robes cut off just below the waist, and then he sent them away.

dag: ka kaari ba asiba kam, ka zahindi ba saha shɛlikam?.
en: Why do you visit them every morning and test them at every moment?.

dag: Maligumaaniba ni su shɛli niriba maa sani n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yɛn mali sara, ka di nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, di simdi ka o yihi bimbɔɣigbini mini yɛno ni bimpuli ti maligumaana.
en: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli ba ka ba bɛ nyɛviya zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ mal alibarika dunia ŋɔ ni; o mi ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The Lord will protect them and preserve their lives; he will make them happy in the land; he will not abandon them to the power of their enemies.

dag: O fa n jilima, ka piligi n nam zuɣupiligu.
en: He has taken away all my wealth and destroyed my reputation.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani ka miri ka bɛ dihi bɛ Naawuni yuli vi; dama bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn zaŋdi bɛ Naawuni bindira n-nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ, dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛ be kasi.
en: They must be holy to their God so that they do not make their Gods name impure. They must be holy because they offer the LORDs food gifts, their Gods food.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa daa yɛli Yisahaku o ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: The servant told Isaac everything that had happened.

dag: Ka n daa da puu din be Anatɔt maa m mabia Hanamɛl sani, ka daa kali liɣiri maa ti o. Di daa nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaayopɔin.
en: I bought the field from Hanamel and weighed out the money to him; the price came to seventeen pieces of silver.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro maa ti o nyaandoliba ni bɛ tari niriba maa; di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi ŋmahi zahim ayi la mi pahi zaŋ tari bɛ zaa.
en: Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and handed it to his disciples to give to the people. He also divided the two fish, so everyone could have some.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila kpambaliba kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ su niriba fukumsi.
en: There were supervisors over Solomons projects. They supervised the men.

dag: Wummiya, kuhigu din yiri Babilɔn na! Ninvuɣ kubo pam lu Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord says, Listen to the sound of crying in Babylon, of mourning for the destruction in the land.

dag: ni Rɛmɛt ni Ɛnganim ni Ɛnhada ni Bɛtipazɛz daa be.
en: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah, and Beth Pazzez.

dag: Dama ti wum kuhigu damli Ziɔn. Ti bahi yoli. Ti di vi zaa! Di simdi ni ti yi ti tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ daai ti yinsi luhi.
en: The sound of sobbing is heard from Zion: Were devastated! Were so ashamed! We have to leave the land and abandon our homes.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ti bari zani bɛ zaashɛhi Balitama n-zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo ba; ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la yi bɛ sɔɣibu shee din be Gɛba wulinluhili polo na.
en: The Israelites moved from their position and reformed their battle lines at Baal-tamar. Then the Israelites who had been set in ambush charged out from their positions west of Gibeah.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ Naa ŋun ka bahigu. O suhu yi yiɣisi, tiŋgbani sɔhigirimi, ka zuliya shɛli ku tooi zan o suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: But you, Lord , are the true God, you are the living God and the eternal king. When you are angry, the world trembles; the nations cannot endure your anger. .

dag: Din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ni na nyɛla: Yurilim mini suhupiɛlli ni suhudoo ni suɣilɔdibo ni nirilimtali ni zaɣisuntali ni ʒiɛyimtali ni.
en: But the fruit that the Spirit produces in a persons life is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuma ata puuni, Mɔabnim ni ti kɔŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli saha biɛla puuni kaman padiriba saha ni bi galisi shɛm la. Bɛ ni kul galisi maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, ka bɛ mi ku mali yaa.
en: Now he says, The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.

dag: Ka Ibram daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa, ka Naawuni yɛl o.
en: Abram bowed with his face to the ground, and God said:.

dag: Ka Aduna zuliya ni bidibiga kam ni tooi di li kaman di ni zali shɛm yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka binshɛɣukam din shihi li ni niŋ kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Only the males from Aarons descendants can eat it as a permanent portion from the LORDs food gifts throughout your future generations. Anything that touches these food gifts will become holy.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn filim bɛmaŋ la lan pala o bihi. Bɛ bela ʒiri biɛhigu o sani. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanim bɛn biɛhigu bi tuhi.
en: But you are unfaithful, unworthy to be his people, a sinful and deceitful nation.

dag: Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti ʒiɛhira, ka bɛ yɛma fa, n ni yɛn zaŋ takɔb shɛli liri ba maa zuɣu.
en: When they drink from it, they will stagger and go out of their minds because of the war I am sending against them.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni baŋ ni bɛ je ma zuɣu ka o ti ma bidibiga ŋɔ gba; ka daa bol o yuli Simiɔn.
en: Leah became pregnant again and had another son. She named this son Simeon. She said, The Lord has heard that I am not loved, so he gave me this son.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o la daa naanyi di ka nyu, ka gbe nimaani. Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka o yiɣisi ka yɛli ba, N suhiri soli ni n labi n dan sani.
en: Then he and his men had something to eat and drink, and they spent the night there. Early the next morning they got up and the servant said, Now we must go back to my master.

dag: M bɔri ni yi di ma suɣilo ka n tɔɣisi ya jɛritali yɛtɔɣa biɛla. N suhiri ya ni yi shiri dim ma suɣilo!.
en: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Paɣa, man bi mi a ni yɛri so maa.
en: But Peter denied it, Woman, I don't even know him.

dag: Yi daa kali Jɛrusalɛm yiya, ka wurim yiya maa n-zaŋ di bilichiisi me di gooni zali.
en: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.

dag: n-zaŋ ba bahi buɣim din diri ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: He will throw them into a burning furnace. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kummiya ka fabili dabisili maa zuɣu.
en: Mortal man, he said, prophesy and announce what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying. You are to shout these words: A day of terror is coming!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi zani, dama nandaamba nyari nahiŋgu, ka faranim mi kul ŋuhira. N ni ti ba faako shɛli bɛ suhuri ni bɔri maa.
en: But you, Lord , tell them, I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.

dag: ka bɛ bɔh o, A wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa bebɔ? Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Iin. Amaa yi na bi karim din sabi Naawuni Kundi ni? Di sabiya: Bihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu ni yɛlimaŋli. .
en: So they asked Jesus, Do you hear what they are saying? Indeed I do, answered Jesus. Haven't you ever read this scripture? You have trained children and babies to offer perfect praise.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mali kpiɔŋ, ka bɛ fɔntinsi nyɛ tiŋ kara, ka bɛ me goma gil li, ka din pahi nyɛla, ti nya Anaki zuliya nimaani.
en: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.

dag: Ka n daa lihi, n nya wɔr fufuhigu, ka ŋun bar o yuli booni Kum, ka Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee dol o nyaaŋa, ka Naawuni daa ti ba yiko ni bɛ tooi zaŋ takɔbiri mini kum ni alɔbo ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri n-ku daadamnim niriba anahi kam puuni ninvuɣ yino.
en: So I looked, and there was a pale green horse. Its riders name was Death, and the Grave was following right behind. They were given authority over a fourth of the earth, to kill by sword, famine, disease, and the wild animals of the earth.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a sujee saha, bee n saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: Lord , dont criticize me when you are angry. Dont discipline me in anger.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ kar a, ka a yi ninsalinim ni chaŋ ka a mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti laɣim be, ka a ŋub mɔri kaman nahu la yuma ayopɔin hal ka a ti baŋ ni Zallakudura Naa n-su ninsalinim nama fukumsi, ka zaŋdi li tir o ni bɔri so.
en: You will be driven away from human society, live with wild animals, and eat grass like an ox for seven years. Then you will acknowledge that the Supreme God has power over human kingdoms and that he can give them to anyone he chooses.

dag: Yim ka Babilɔn dii lu n-wurim. Kummiya di zuɣu. Zaŋmiya kpam na ti bɔbili di daŋ maa, di pa shɛli di ni tibi kpaŋ.
en: But Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Cry for her! Get medicine for her pain, and maybe she can be healed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa chibi soli teeku ni, ka daa ŋme solɔɣu sɔŋ kom pam puuni.
en: The LORD says—who makes a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters.

dag: A bahiri ʒiŋmariba yoli, nyin Yawɛ je ninvuɣ kuriba mini ninvuɣ yɔhindiba.
en: You destroy those who tell lies. Lord , you hate those who make secret plans to hurt others.

dag: Di gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: MENE gbinni nyɛla Naawuni pun kali a nam dabisa m-paai di tariga.
en: This is what these words mean: Mene : God has counted the days until your kingdom will end.

dag: M pun nya jɛra ni maani bɛ biɛhigu shee, amaa ka n yɛli noli niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee maa libigi ba.
en: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them.

dag: Niriba turi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋdi bindira sɔɣira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔhir li mali alibarika.
en: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi tooi pii din tuhi gari shɛlikam, ka chɛ ka yi yi daɣiri tuma zaa mini galimi ni Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: I pray this so that you will be able to decide what really matters and so you will be sincere and blameless on the day of Christ.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri din nyaɣisa ni leei faralana, ka ŋunkam yuri wain mini kpam ku leei bundana.
en: Those who love pleasure end up poor; lovers of wine and oil wont get rich.

dag: Jɛta bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛfune ni Pisipa ni Ara.
en: Jether was the father of Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

dag: Dunia shiri ni ti dahimdahim doya, ka bɛ ʒe di zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone will be forced out of the land. All the wealth will be taken. This will happen because the Lord commanded it.

dag: N ni tumdi Naawuni so tuma ni n suhu zaa o Bia lahibal suŋ tuma ni la di ma shɛhira ni n suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam.
en: I serve God in my spirit by preaching the good news about Gods Son, and God is my witness that I continually mention you.

dag: N ni guli n tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka ku chɛ ka tɔbbihi kpe di ni gari. M mi ku saɣi ka kpeengarigunim lan nahim n niriba yaha, dama mmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ ni di wahala shɛm.
en: God says, I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.

dag: Naa, ka n daa ti deei yiko maligumaaniba kpamba sani m-be soli chani Damaskus;.
en: On one such journey, I was going to Damascus with the full authority of the chief priests.

dag: Teemiya din daa niŋ Lɔt paɣ la.
en: Remember what happened to Lots wife !.

dag: ka bɔhi Musa, Gbala n-daa lee ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti na ni ti ti kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti yi Ijipti na?.
en: They said to Moses, Werent there enough graves in Egypt that you took us away to die in the desert? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt like this?.

dag: Kush daa mali bidib so ka o yuli booni Nimrɔd. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ tuuli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa pam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Cush also had a son named Nimrod who became a very powerful man on earth.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi daa vili ma gbibi, ka kum zana daa do n tooni.
en: The danger of death was around me, and the grave set its trap for me.

dag: Bɛ ni bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligunim maa dolibu maa zuɣu, bɛ bom bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara tahi Yawɛ tooni na ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: The priest shall perform the ritual of purification for the community, and they will be forgiven, because the mistake was unintentional and they brought their sin offering as a food offering to the Lord .

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ mali suhu yini, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli so yini din ni chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura sahakam bɛmaŋmaŋ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu mini bɛ bihi bɛn yɛn doli bɛ nyaaŋa gba zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: I will give them the desire to be one, united people. They will have one goal—to worship me all their lives. They and their children will want to do this.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Mahili bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza mini Kish.
en: Merari had two sons, Mahli and Mushi. Mahli also had two sons, Eleazar and Kish.

dag: N nya binshɛli ka di to n-gari kum. Dina n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun ŋmani zana. O ni wuhi ni o yur a shɛm ŋmanila zana mini tɔŋ, ka o nuhi nyɛ bandi. Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o niŋ din tiɣi Naawuni nini ni yi o yɛla ni, amaa alahichilan ni lu o zana maa ni.
en: I found something more bitter than death—the woman who is like a trap. The love she offers you will catch you like a net, and her arms around you will hold you like a chain. A man who pleases God can get away, but she will catch the sinner.

dag: ka Ɛlimɛlɛk daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi min o bidibis ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: Elimelech died, leaving Naomi with only her two sons.

dag: N ni ti je suli niŋ a, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhuyiɣisili pam lu a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ŋmah a nyee min a tiba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku a bi shɛb bɛn kpalim. Bɛ ni ti gbah a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi nti zaŋ ba zaɣ nɛma nyo buɣim.
en: Because I am angry with you, I will let them deal with you in their anger. They will cut off your nose and your ears and kill your children. Yes, they will take your sons and daughters from you and burn them alive.

dag: Yim ka tiŋgbani daa ti dam pam, dama ti Duuma malaika n-daa yi alizanda ni siɣina nti biligi siliga maa nol ni kuɣili la n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu.
en: Look, there was a great earthquake, for an angel from the Lord came down from heaven. Coming to the stone, he rolled it away and sat on it.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ anzinfa duhi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka zaŋ situra duhi kaman yaɣiri maa zaa yoli.
en: The wicked may have too much silver to count and more clothes than anyone needs;.

dag: Naa suhu yi yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, nyin di yɛli ni a lan je o tuma, dama a yi gbaag amaŋ be balim, di ni ku taali maa.
en: If a rulers temper rises against you, dont leave your post, because calmness alleviates great offenses.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔra daa laɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa taai duŋ maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Then Korah gathered the whole community, and they stood facing Moses and Aaron at the entrance of the Tent. Suddenly the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence appeared to the whole community.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti bo so shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan nabi. Di yi pa lala ti mini ti dimnim yi ti yɛn tuhi, bɛ ni pahi ti dimnim maa zuɣu tuhi ti ka nya soli zo n-yi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Come on, lets be smart and deal with them. Otherwise, they will only grow in number. And if war breaks out, they will join our enemies, fight against us, and then escape from the land.

dag: yin miriya ka yi tam Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.

dag: N daa yɛli bɛ bihi tiŋgban nɛli maa ni, Miriya ka yi doli yi banim zaligunim la bee n-gbibi bɛ kaya la bee n-zaŋ bɛ buɣa la jɛmbu saɣim yimaŋa.
en: Instead, I warned the young people among them: Do not keep the laws your ancestors made; do not follow their customs or defile yourselves with their idols.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu lala zaŋ nachiinsi nɛma din nyɛ tibikpara mini nintuhi ni bansi ni salima nɛma zaa na. Sokam daa zaŋla salima na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: All the men and women who wanted to give brought gold jewelry of all kinds. They brought pins, earrings, rings, and other jewelry. They all gave their jewelry as a special offering to the Lord .

dag: O chɛ ka ti tahi a nasara dibu suhupiɛlli tahigu, ka sa ti tuutanim ti Naawuni yuli zuɣu. Yawɛ deem a suhigu zaa.
en: Then we will shout for joy over your victory and celebrate your triumph by praising our God. May the Lord answer all your requests.

dag: Di di bi simdi ni a gba zo a kpee maa nambɔɣu kaman n ni daa zo a nambɔɣu shɛm maa.
en: You should have had mercy on your fellow servant, just as I had mercy on you.

dag: Dama lala naan nyɛla zaɣ biɛtitali di naan nyɛla bibiɛlim tuuni.
en: for thats a crime; its a punishable offense.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ daa yɛli ni a ni wurim kpe ŋɔ, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ku lan be di ni, ka kpe ti zani dabari sahakam. .
en: then pray, Our Lord , you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam. O paɣibu yɛla kul ni be n nol ni sahakam.
en: I will always praise the Lord .

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa daa bɔri ni bɛ ka Sulemaana sanna nti wum Naawuni ni ti o yɛm shɛli maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: and the whole world wanted to come and listen to the wisdom that God had given him.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb me bɛ tiŋ ʒini nimaani.
en: He let hungry people settle there, and they built a city to live in.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba n-tiligi Kɛilanim maa.
en: So he asked the Lord , Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Yes, the Lord answered. Attack them and save Keilah.

dag: A shiri mi, dama di saha bɛ daa pun dɔɣ a ka a mi yuui pam!.
en: You know, for you were born then; you have lived such a long time!.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara pinaata ni di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna zuliya niriba.
en: In all, they gave towns to the priests. They also gave them some land near each town for their animals.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n saɣ a ni bɔri shɛm maa, cham ti zaŋ Absalom na.
en: So the king said to Joab, All right then. I will do it. Go and bring back my boy Absalom.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba kpɛhi bahiyoli shee.
en: The demons begged Jesus not to send them into the bottomless pit.

dag: amaa ka yipa kahigi wuhi palɔni pumpɔŋɔ la. Yɛlimaŋli maa kahigi wuhila palɔni pumpɔŋɔ anabinim sabbu puuni, ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu lan ŋɔ chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ li ni di chɛ ka niriba niŋ yɛda ka deeg o noli.
en: Now, however, that truth has been brought out into the open through the writings of the prophets; and by the command of the eternal God it is made known to all nations, so that all may believe and obey.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, M bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam;.
en: Israel, tell us how your enemies have persecuted you ever since you were young.

dag: nti kpuɣi Baal jɛmbu binnan shɛli din be di ni na nti nyo li buɣim.
en: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, ŋuni n-lee yɛn zɔn ya nambɔɣu? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni fabili yi zuɣu? Ŋuni n-lee ni zani ni o bɔhi yi daalaafee yɛla?.
en: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?.

dag: Naawuni ni ti lu tiŋ maa zuɣu m-me bindura tabili di gooni gili.
en: I will surround you like a wall, and I will lay a siege against you with assault towers, and I will raise up siegeworks against you.

dag: Nooŋa ni yiɣiri gind o tiɛɣu shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni guli Jɛrusalɛm. O ni fa li bahi, ka gul li.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.

dag: ni bɛ ti yɛli ŋun Juda naa Hɛzɛkia maa: Di chɛ ka a ni zaŋ amaŋ dalim a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli yɛri ni Asiria naa ku ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: of Judah to tell him: The god you are trusting in has told you that you will not fall into my hands, but don't let that deceive you.

dag: Pahat ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab nir la min o bidibisi daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisinii ni pihinunaanahi.
en: the descendants of Pahath Moab of the family line of Jeshua and Joab:.

dag: Yi barinyubo ka gbinni. Yi bi mi ni dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita?.
en: Your proud talk is not good. You know the saying, Just a little yeast makes the whole batch of dough rise.

dag: Yi bipuɣinsi yi gɔri pagɔrisigu, m bi yɛn darigi bɛ tibili bee n-darigi yi bihi paɣiba tibili bɛ yi niŋ zina. Dama yi dɔbba maŋmaŋ gba chana ka bɛ mini buɣa ni pagɔra ti doona kaman buɣa maligu la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛm bahi yoli.
en: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa lan yɛli paɣ maa, Cham ni suhudoo; a yɛda niŋbu n-tilig a.
en: But Jesus told the woman, Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace.

dag: Man Tɛrisius ŋun sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri ya ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: I am Tertius, the one writing this letter for Paul. I send you my own greetings as one who belongs to the Lord.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Musa dindali maa.
en: That same day the Lord said to Moses.

dag: O daa pirigi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu buyi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He split the Red Sea into two parts. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Pa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-chɛ ka niriba tumdi tuma ka buɣim diri li, ka niriba diri wahala yol la?.
en: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.

dag: A daa chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi n-galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka a daa zaŋ ba na ti niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ su li la ni.
en: You multiplied their descendants as the stars of heaven. You brought them into the land that you had told their ancestors to enter and possess.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔh o, Shihir bɔ ka a lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti ka di wuhi ni a mal soli ni a niŋ a ni niŋdi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Some Jews said to Jesus, Show us a miracle as a sign from God. Prove that you have the right to do these things.
