dag: Amaa ka Jɔsia daa zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ o, ka daa bo binyara niŋ omaŋa n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. O daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Nɛko yɛl o shɛm maa; ka daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti lir o Mɛgido bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: But Josiah did not go away. He put on different clothes to hide who he was and went to fight the battle. Josiah refused to listen to the warning Neco had received from God and went to fight on the plain of Megiddo.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A tizɔdoo maa ni neei kum ni yaha.
en: Your brother will rise to life, Jesus told her.

dag: Amaa ka so daa zaŋ Ribɛka bituuli Iso ni yɛli shɛm maa ti yɛli Ribɛka, ka o daa tim ti bol o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa na ti yɛl o, A biɛli Iso ni zaŋ shɛli maag omaŋ suhu nyɛla, o lɔrila nia ni o ku a.
en: Rebekah heard about Esaus plan to kill Jacob. She sent for Jacob and said to him, Listen, your brother Esau is planning to kill you.

dag: Dama n ni bɔri ni n tum zaɣ sun shɛli, m bi tumdi li; amaa zaɣ biɛ shɛli n ni je ni n tum la, dina ka n kul tumda.
en: I don't do the good I want to do; instead, I do the evil that I do not want to do.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o So na be Sool daŋ ni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim kaman Naawuni ni bɔri shɛm? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, Jɔnatan bidibiga na beni, o mi nyɛla gbarigu.
en: The king asked him, Is there anyone left of Saul's family to whom I can show loyalty and kindness, as I promised God I would? Ziba answered, There is still one of Jonathan's sons. He is crippled.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni na.
en: Command the priests carrying the chest containing the testimony to come up out of the Jordan.

dag: A yi ni jɛm Naawuni, ka suhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa.
en: But now, look to God and pray to the All-Powerful.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Nyama, n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ŋunkam ti wum li tiba puuni ni chahira.
en: The Lord said to him, Some day I am going to do something to the people of Israel that is so terrible that everyone who hears about it will be stunned.

dag: Ka o daa shiri fa ba bahi m-mali ba ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa, ka wuhiri shihira Ijipti tiŋ puuni mini Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni ni mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi.
en: This man led them out after he performed wonders and signs in Egypt at the Red Sea and for forty years in the wilderness.

dag: ka Yisa daa tim Pita mini Jɔn n-yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu shili gul ti, ka ti kana ti di di bindirigu.
en: So Jesus said to Peter and John, Go and prepare the Passover meal for us to eat.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi chɛ ka a kpalim zani dabari kaman niriba ni na ʒi n-ʒini tin shɛŋa ni, n yi zaŋ a niŋ kɔbulli ni, ka ko titali lim a.
en: The LORD God proclaims: When I turn you into ruins like uninhabitable cities, when the deep sea washes over you and the raging seas cover you.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi takɔro maa ni ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee be m polo? Ka m ba namɔɣilis ayi bee ata ŋmaligi lih o na.
en: Jehu looked up to the window and said, Whos on my side? Anyone? Two or three high officials looked down at him.

dag: Di bahigu ti ŋmanila wɔɣ dimli, ka dimda kaman gariŋga la.
en: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.

dag: Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa soya ka m bɔhim baŋ a daalahiziba tuma.
en: Help me understand what your precepts are about so I can contemplate your wondrous works!.

dag: O tɔbbihi mali kalinli? Ka ŋuni ka o neesim lee bi paara?.
en: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yɛda niriba bɛn dir o nuu ni nti yɛn luh o; ka o tɔbbihi ti wurim, ka bɛ ku bɛ ni pam mi.
en: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.

dag: Asa daa tum din tuhi ka viɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.

dag: Dabisili din pah ata dali, zaŋmiya naɣilahi piniyini mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the third day of this festival, you must offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: N yi daa yɛli, N kul ni tɔɣisiri lala, n naan nyɛla ŋun bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli a bihi puuni.
en: I wanted to tell others these things, but that would have made me a traitor to your people.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa kpariti yi dunoya nyɛla kuriti mini daanya. Yi dabisa ni yɛn be shɛm, lala ka yi yaa yɛn be.
en: I pray that your dead bolts are iron and copper, and that your strength lasts all your days.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi ʒe yim ku tɔŋ. Ka ŋunkam ŋmari ʒiri kul bela barina ni.
en: Anyone who thinks and speaks evil can expect to find nothing good—only disaster.

dag: Dama n ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia labirina saha shɛli, ka Reechɛl daa kpi sol ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nimaani mini Ɛfirat daa na wɔɣa. Ka n daa sɔɣ o Ɛfirat soli maa ni ; ka di daa ti ma suhugarigu pam.
en: Unfortunately, your mother Rachel died in Canaan after we had left northern Syria and before we reached Bethlehem. And I had to bury her along the way.

dag: Ka tuumba maa mini cheechi kpamba maa daa laɣim ni bɛ to yɛlli maa jina.
en: The apostles and church leaders met to discuss this problem about Gentiles.

dag: Ka ti mabiyurigu Onɛsimus ŋun ʒe yim ka nyɛ yi ni yino la ni pahi o zuɣu kana. Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya binshɛɣukam zaa din niŋdi kpe ŋɔ yɛla.
en: I sent him with Onesimus, our faithful and dearly loved brother, who is one of you. They will let you know about everything here.

dag: Naawuni ni daa neeg o kum ni ka o ku lan labi niŋgbuŋ poobu ni zuɣu ka o daa lan yɛli: N ni zaŋ alibarika suŋ shɛli n ni daa niŋniŋ Naa Dauda ni la n-niŋ a ni.
en: God raised Jesus from death and will never let his body decay. It is just as God said, I will make to you the same holy promises that I made to David.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ ni daa kul moli gili, Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla bɛ puri atam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpam ni shiri pam ni bɛ puri ni bindira zaa na. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ binshɛɣukam pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu pam na.
en: People all around the country heard about this command. So the Israelites gave the first part of their harvest of grain, grapes, oil, honey, and all the things they grew in their fields. They brought one-tenth of all these many things.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ laɣim taba.
en: When the Arameans saw that the Israelites had defeated them, they came together into one big army.

dag: Ninsal ni tumdi tuma ka niŋdi wahala dunia ŋɔ ni m-bɔri ni o nya shɛli maa buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: You work and worry your way through life, and what do you have to show for it?.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo ni o zaŋ niŋ o tulaale, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: If anyone makes any like it for use as perfume, he will no longer be considered one of my people.

dag: Ka n ni lan ti a a ni bi suhi ma shɛli gba pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni ti a azichi mini jilima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ na so m-buɣis a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: I will also give you what you have not asked for: all your life you will have wealth and honor, more than that of any other king.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ suŋ la pun tin ya Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa baŋ din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teei yi ni daa nyɛ bipola ka ʒe yim shɛm la yɛla. Yi yurilim daa ŋmanila amiliya yurilim, yi daa doli ma la tiŋgban nɛl ni, din nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli ni so ni na ʒi m-biri binshɛli.
en: to proclaim this message to everyone in Jerusalem. I remember how faithful you were when you were young, how you loved me when we were first married; you followed me through the desert, through a land that had not been planted.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ŋun be kasi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn miri ma sani, ka chɛ ka sokam nya n jilima. Ka Aduna daa kul shini.
en: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone! Aaron was speechless.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni ka yi teeri di yɛla, ka yɛli Jɔshua ka di kpe o tibili ni ni n ni kpihim Amalɛknim maa birili dunia yili.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Write about this battle. Write these things in a book so that people will remember what happened here. And be sure to tell Joshua that I will completely destroy the Amalekites from the earth.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be sapashin kpɛm maa sani daa daai goon shɛŋa din daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la zaa luhi.
en: Then the Babylonian army that was with Nebuzaradan pulled down the walls around Jerusalem.

dag: Yi niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ la shɛb zaa, yin zaŋmiya ba ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Di zaŋya yi naɣilabihi tuulinim tum tuma, yi mi di chɛnya yi biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb kɔbiri.
en: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord . Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.

dag: N ni kpaŋsi yi suhuri kaman paɣ ni kpaŋsir o bia suhu shɛm la. Yi ni nya suhukpaŋsibo Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I will comfort you in Jerusalem, as a mother comforts her child.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti Maika ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔrɛshɛt nir la m-bɔŋɔ. Di daa nyɛla Jɔtam mini Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa nya binshɛŋa maa daa nyɛla Samaria mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: During the time that Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah, the word of the Lord came to Micah. Micah was from Moresheth. He saw these visions about Samaria and Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ daa yi bela Naawuni biɛhigu shee tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yiini yila hal ka Sulemaana daa ti naanyi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm la. Bɛ daa kul tumdila bɛ tuma maa n-doli di soli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: These men served by singing at the Holy Tent. The Holy Tent is also called the Meeting Tent. These men served until Solomon built the Lord s Temple in Jerusalem. They served by following the rules given to them for their work.

dag: N niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka niriba bɛn be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo baŋ ni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka so bi lan pahi n zuɣu.
en: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord . No other gods are real.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa mali nti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani ni o nya di bahigu.
en: But Peter followed along at a distance and came to the courtyard of the high priest's palace. He went in and sat down with the guards to see what was going to happen.

dag: Lɔt daa ti yɛn paai Zɔa, ka wuntaŋ pun puhimi.
en: As the sun rose over the earth, Lot arrived in Zoar.

dag: Ka n daa lihi bɔri bɛ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun ni mali me gooni maa zali, ka zani tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaani gooni maa voli ni n tooni din ni chɛ ka n ku wurim li, amaa ka bi nya so.
en: I looked for anyone to repair the wall and stand in the gap for me on behalf of the land, so I wouldnt have to destroy it. But I couldnt find anyone.

dag: Bɛna n-daa laɣim naai noli ni bɛ tuhi Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnima.
en: They formed an alliance to fight Joshua and Israel.

dag: Nyɔhi maa ni daa ti yiɣisi mɔni tiŋ maa puuni saha shɛli, ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa ŋmaligi lihi bɛ nyaaŋa nya ka tiŋ maa zaa taala buɣim diri ka di nyɔhi yiɣisi mɔni.
en: Then the signal appeared; a cloud of smoke began to go up from the town. The Benjaminites looked behind them and were amazed to see the whole city going up in flames.

dag: Amaa Dauda ni daa nya ka o kpambaliba maa sɔɣiri yɛri tab maa ka o baŋ ni bia maa kpiya; ka bɔh o kpamba maa, Bia maa kpiya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O kpiya.
en: When David noticed them whispering to each other, he realized that the child had died. So he asked them, Is the child dead? Yes, he is, they answered.

dag: dama Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa zaŋ wuntia soli ka yi sanna la, yi daa bi niŋ o yɛda; amaa ka farigudeeriba mini pagɔra bɛn daa niŋ o yɛda. Ka hal yi ni daa nya lala maa zaa yoli, di nyaaŋa yi daa bi niŋ tuuba ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: John came showing you the right way to live, and you did not believe him. But the tax collectors and prostitutes believed John. You saw that happening, but you would not change. You still refused to believe him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Nyamiya, n lɔrila nia ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu yi daŋ ŋɔ niriba zuɣu, ka yi ku tooi yi di ni, ka yi mi ku lan tooi chaŋ karimbaan chandi, dama di ti yɛn nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu saha.
en: And so the Lord says, I am planning to bring disaster on you, and you will not be able to escape it. You are going to find yourselves in trouble, and then you will not walk so proudly any more.

dag: N daa kul nyarila jilima, ka n kpiɔŋ kul be kaman tɔb palli la.
en: or like an archer's new bow.

dag: O ba min o ma ni daa ti nya o, di daa gari ba pam, ka o ma bɔh o, M bia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? A bi nya m min a ba ni lihiri bɔr a shee ni suhusaɣiŋgu shɛm.
en: His parents were astonished when they saw him, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been terribly worried trying to find you.

dag: Dauda ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛma yila fukumsi bɛ ni daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la labisina la nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the men whom King David put in charge of the music at the place of worship in Jerusalem after the Covenant Box was moved there.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jotham died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David, his ancestor. Jothams son Ahaz became the new king after him.

dag: Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu! Bɛ pala zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni niŋ niriba shɛm, lala ka bɛ yɛn niŋ bɛ gba.
en: Doom to the wicked; they are evil. What they have done will be done to them.

dag: Di viɛli gari salima, hal di viɛli gari salima alali; ka lan nyaɣisi gari shiri, ni shigbani din tɔɣiri shiri.
en: They are more desirable than gold— than tons of pure gold! They are sweeter than honey— even dripping off the honeycomb!.

dag: Di saha maa yi ni ti yɛli, Ti min a n-daa yi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka a be pala zuɣu wuhiri ti la.
en: Then you will say, We ate and drank with you. You taught in the streets of our town.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Amiram yiŋnima mini Izar yiŋnima ni Hiburɔn yiŋnima ni Uziɛl yiŋnima; Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa bala.
en: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and Uzzielites. These were the clans of the Kohathites.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni zɔri ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpamdi niriba jaande; amaa Naawuni mi ti biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka ti mali tahima ni yi gba mi li yi suhuri ni.
en: We know what it means to fear the Lord, and so we try to persuade others. God knows us completely, and I hope that in your hearts you know me as well.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron.

dag: Di saha ka n daa ŋmaligi lihi ni n nya ŋun yɛli ma lala maa. N ni daa lihi maa, ka n nya salima firilatamdis ayopɔin.
en: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili wumdi n ni timdi n dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ anabinim yi sanna la yɛligu, dama yi pun bi gbilisiri tibili wumdi li.
en: and by paying attention to the words of my servants, the prophets, whom I have kept on sending to you. You have never obeyed what they said.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, Naawuni ni deei ŋun Naawuni nam yi sani n-zaŋ li ti zuliya shɛb bɛn ni wali o nam maa wala. .
en: And so I tell you, added Jesus, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce the proper fruits.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti zaŋ li tin ya kaman o ni daa lo yi mini yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord will give you the land of the Canaanites, just as he promised you and your ancestors.

dag: M mi daa bi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti nya Masia tuun shɛb bɛn daa be n tooni la, amaa ka daa naɣ chaŋla Areebia. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti yi nimaani n-lan lab Damaskus.
en: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.

dag: Dama a suui ʒitibisi shɛli din wum ba la; ka kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli bɛ ni mali fiɛbiri bɛ bɔɣusapima la. A nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nahind a niriba kaman a ni daa nyaŋ Midian tɔbbihi shɛm la.
en: That will happen because you will lift the heavy yoke off their shoulders and take away their heavy burden. You will take away the rod that the enemy used to punish your people, as you did when you defeated Midian.

dag: Ziɔn zuɣu, n ku shini; Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu, n ku vuhi hal ka di ti di nasara, ka ne kaman biɛŋmariga la, ka di tiliginsim ne kaman buɣim mokpalli neesim la.
en: I love Zion, so I will continue to speak for her. I love Jerusalem, so I will not stop speaking. I will speak until goodness shines like a bright light, until salvation burns bright like a flame.

dag: Ka ŋun pah anahi nyɛ Adɔnija. O ma n-daa nyɛ Haggit; ka ŋun pah anu nyɛ Shɛfatia, o ma n-daa nyɛ Abital.
en: Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith; Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital;.

dag: O ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a bol o yuli Yisa, dama o ni ti tilig o niriba bɛ daalahichi ni.
en: She will give birth to a son, and you will call him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.

dag: bahim ba yoli a suhuyiɣisili puuni; bahim ba yoli zaa. Ka dunianim zaa baŋ ni Naawuni n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: destroy them in your anger; destroy them completely. Then everyone will know that God rules in Israel, that his rule extends over all the earth.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Other people are like the seeds sown among the thorn bushes. These are the ones who hear the message.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima, dama ninsal sɔŋsim nyɛla yoli.
en: Help us defeat the enemy! No one on earth can rescue us.

dag: Dama n wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛra, Dabiɛm kul bela luɣilikam. Zaɣisimiy o, chɛliya ka ti zaɣis o. N zɔsimnim kul guhirimi ni n tuui lu, ka yɛra, Di pa shɛli ti ni kpɛh o kɔre n-nyaŋ o, ka bɔh o biɛri.
en: I hear many whispering— Panic Lurks Everywhere!— proclaim, yes, lets proclaim it ourselves! All my friends are waiting for me to stumble: Perhaps he can be enticed. Then well prevail against him and get our revenge on him.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun zɔr a nambɔɣu la yɛliya, Zoya mini kunkuna ni vuui, amaa n yurilim din bi naari la ku vuui ka chɛ a; ka n suhudoo alikauli la gba ku vuug a sani.
en: The mountains may shift, and the hills may be shaken, but my faithful love wont shift from you, and my covenant of peace wont be shaken, says the LORD, the one who pities you.

dag: Ka daŋ shɛŋa din kpalim zaa puuni niriba dɔbba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba gba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: And the same thing will happen in all the other tribes. The men and women will cry by themselves.

dag: Bɔ n-lee yi tiŋgban nɛli polo kanna kaman nyɔhi din kpuɣi du zuɣusaa ka mɛɛr mini firanki tulaale zim ni kɔhigɔriba ni mali tulaale zim shɛŋa zaa nyom be di ni ŋɔ?.
en: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.

dag: Yidaampaɣ zinalana ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka a mini saamba n-doona ka chɛ a yidana.
en: You are a woman guilty of adultery. You would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband.

dag: Ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be yinim bundaannim ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi pun di yi nyaɣisim.
en: But you rich people are in for trouble. You have already had an easy life!.

dag: Ka Pool daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛ zuɣu na, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa min anabitali yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: Then Paul laid his hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them. They began speaking different languages and prophesying.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ piɛla yino m-pahi kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim la zuɣu m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, yilimi yila pampam. Izraɛlnima, tahimiya! Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga, mali suhupiɛlli, ka diri dari ni a suhu zaa!.
en: Jerusalem, sing and be happy! Israel, shout for joy! Jerusalem, be happy and have fun!.

dag: Damaskusnim lan ka yaa, ka ŋmaligi ni bɛ guui, ka dabiɛm kpe ba. Biɛrim mini suhugarigu mali ba mi kaman paɣ so ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: You people of Damascus have lost your courage, and in panic you turn to run, gripped by fear and pain.

dag: Ka Ibizan daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Bɛtilihɛm.
en: before he died and was buried in Bethlehem.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul gbaani ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mi nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ tooni.
en: This is why I kneel before the Father.

dag: Ka Judanim ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛmaŋa, Jɛrusalɛmnim malila kpiɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani. .
en: The leaders of Judah will encourage the people and say, The Lord All-Powerful is your God. He makes us strong.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi bi baŋ, nam ŋɔ ni bahi lab Dauda daŋ niriba ŋɔ sani.
en: One day, Jeroboam started thinking, Everyone in Israel still goes to the temple in Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord . What if they become loyal to David's family again? They will kill me and accept Rehoboam as their king.

dag: O daa zaŋla chɛchɛbun gahinda kɔbisiyɔbu ni Ijipti chɛchɛbunsi zaa, ka tɔbbihi daa be di zaa ni.
en: He commanded his officers in charge of his best chariots and all his other chariots to start after the Israelites.

dag: Bɛn pa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhuyiɣisili; hal o yi lo ba mihi gba, bɛ bi suhir o bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.

dag: Naawuni n-daa neei ti Duuma kum ni, ka ni ti neei ti gba kum ni o yiko ni.
en: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.

dag: Nir karimbaani n-tahir o filiŋ na, amaa ŋun siɣisir omaŋ ni nya jilima.
en: Your pride can bring you down. Humility will bring you honor.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhiri li ka di lɛbiri li ginda, ni o chɛ ka di tum o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: He orders the clouds to be blown all around the earth. The clouds do whatever he commands.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, Din kariya! A ku kpi. Nyama, m ba na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛla bin titali bee bimbila ka bi yɛli ma. Ka bɔ zuɣu ka m ba ni sɔɣi ma dimbɔŋɔ dina? Pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Jonathan answered, God forbid that you should die! My father tells me everything he does, important or not, and he would not hide this from me. It just isn't so.

dag: Ka Hɔsa ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi ni yino la gba daa mali bidibisi; Shimri n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Hosah, one of Meraris family, also had a family: Shimri the first.

dag: Yinim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be nyɔŋ puuni, kamiyana ti gbahi di.
en: The Lord has told the foreign nations to come like wild animals and devour his people.

dag: Ka Sool daa laɣim ba luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Bɛzɛk la. Izraɛlnim kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita. Ka Judanim mi kalinli nyɛ tuhi pihita.
en: Saul gathered the men together at Bezek. There were , men from Israel and , men from Judah.

dag: N Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan chɛ ka n nya binshɛli ʒii. Nyama ŋuna n Duuma NAAWUNI daa zaŋla buɣim ni o darig o niriba tibili. Buɣim maa daa dila teeku, ka lan diri tiŋgbani gba.
en: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: I saw the Lord GOD calling for judgment by fire. The fire destroyed the ocean and was beginning to eat up the land.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini yɛm zaa bela o sani, ŋuna n-su ŋun yɔhindi niriba min o ni yɔhindi shɛb zaa.
en: With him are might and success; the deceiver and the deceived are his.

dag: Ka yi yi mali sara, di simdi ka yi ŋub li dindali maa bee dindali cheei biɛɣu, ka di shɛli yi guui zani hal ni daba ata dali, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: The meat must be eaten on the day the animal is killed or on the next day. Any meat left on the third day must be burned.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi n-chaŋ ti da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbiga na ti pahi.
en: He also hired one hundred thousand warriors from Israel for one hundred kikkars of silver.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn mali wumpaɣibo sara ti man Yawɛ, yin malimiya li din ni chɛ ka n deei li yi sani.
en: If you want to offer some special offering of thanks to the Lord , you are free to offer that gift. But you must do it in a way that pleases God.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo Ai buɣim, ka di di n-kab lu n-duhiduhi doya; ka na kul doya lala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua burned Ai and left it in ruins. It is still like that today.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Mbo, ti suhuyubu niŋya! A mi di chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o.
en: Dont let them say to themselves, Yes! Exactly what we wanted! Dont let them say, We ate him up.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa tuhi deei Jɛrusalɛm, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di niriba, ka nyo li buɣim bahi.
en: They attacked Jerusalem, captured it, killed everyone who lived there, and then burned it to the ground.

dag: N teeri yi yɛla zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu.
en: I thank my God every time I mention you in my prayers.

dag: Naa Ahaz muɣisigu ŋɔ ni daa ti kɔŋ tim saha shɛli o daa maan kpɛla din bie nti yaɣi tumbu ni zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani.
en: It was during this troubled time that King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD.

dag: Di saha o ni tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ni suhuyiɣisili, ka kpɛhi ba dabiɛm o suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli.
en: But then God speaks to them angrily; then he terrifies them with his fury.

dag: Kootaali tandɔri n-daa kul yɛrigi Siddim vinvamli maa ni; ka Sɔdom mini Gomɔra nanim la daa ŋmaligi guuri ka bɛ ni shɛb faai lu kootaali tandɔri maa ni, ka bɛn kpalim mi zo nti du zoli.
en: Now the Siddim Valley was filled with tar pits. When the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah retreated, they fell into them; and the rest fled to the mountains.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianima. Ka Filistianim maa daa doli ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The Philistines fought a battle against the Israelites on Mount Gilboa. Many Israelites were killed there, and the rest of them, including King Saul and his sons, fled.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli puuni Ishimail ni daa zaŋ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa niŋ maa daa nyɛla kɔbil titali shɛli Naa Asa ni daa gbi n-gu omaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛl Naa Baasha la. Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ti pali kɔbiliga maa.
en: Now the cistern that Ishmael used to discard the bodies of the men he had killed because of their association with Gedaliah was the one that King Asa had made to defend against Israels King Baasha. Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, filled it with the dead.

dag: Bee di yi pa lala, nyin chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi kpe ŋɔ wuhi bɛ ni daa nya ka jintɔriba la vihi ma n-nya n ni daa tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi.
en: In their absence, have these people who are here declare what crime they found when I stood before the Jerusalem Council.

dag: Gbuɣima ŋum bahi bɛ zuɣu. Bɛ ŋumiya pam. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbani bahi yoli, ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.

dag: Naawuni mi daa bi ŋmaai di tiŋgbɔŋ maa hal napɔŋ yaabu yim zuɣu ti o, amaa ka daa lee lo alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o, ka o yaansi ti di di fali o kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa na ka bia gba.
en: God did not then give Abraham any part of it as his own, not even a square foot of ground, but God promised to give it to him, and that it would belong to him and to his descendants. At the time God made this promise, Abraham had no children.

dag: Ka n daa pii yi bi shɛba n-leeg anabinima, ka pii yi nachimba shɛba n-leei Nazarinima. Izraɛlnima, bee pa lala n-nyɛ li? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I raised up some of your children to be prophets and some of your youth to be nazirites. Isnt this so, people of Israel? says the LORD.

dag: Dama a Duuma saɣisirila o ni yuri so, ka fiɛbiri o ni zaŋ so leeg o bia.
en: Because the Lord corrects everyone he loves, and punishes everyone he accepts as a child.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tuuya, ka Juda lu, dama bɛ yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ tuma bi viɛli Yawɛ sani; bɛ turila Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: This will happen because Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen. They turned against the Lord . They said and did things against him, right in front of his glorious eyes.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman m bihi n-nyɛn ya la. Niŋmiya ti kaman ti ni niŋ ya shɛm; yi gba yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti!.
en: But as a fair trade—Im talking to you like you are children—open your hearts wide too.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ daba tim bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim la jilima, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yuli min o wuhibu ŋɔ.
en: All those who are slaves should show full respect to their masters. Then Gods name and our teaching will not be criticized.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi wuhi ni m mali yiko; bɛ ni tibigi ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord says to the nations, Now I will act. I will show how powerful I am.

dag: Di zuɣu ka yi leei bɛn mali biɛrisuŋ yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn zaa be Masidɔnia mini Akaia la sani.
en: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.

dag: Miriya daadamnima! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: Watch out, for there will be those who will arrest you and take you to court, and they will whip you in the synagogues.

dag: o tuma ni ti yi palɔni. Di dabisili ni ti kahigi li wuhi, dama buɣim nti yɛn kahigi li wuhi, ka buɣim maa ni ti buɣisi sokam tuma n-kahigi di ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi.
en: And the quality of each person's work will be seen when the Day of Christ exposes it. For on that Day fire will reveal everyone's work; the fire will test it and show its real quality.

dag: n-chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab daa yɛli paɣ maa o ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Then go to the king and say to him what I tell you to say. Then Joab told her what to say.

dag: Di mɔŋya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini kpibisi saria karibu din doli zaligu soli; ka di mɔŋya tarima mini nandana bɛ yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa lu Jɔash suhu ni ni o lan malimali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ kpalim leegi n dan dabili ka chɛ bia maa, ka a chɛ ka o dol o biɛyanim maa kuli.
en: So now I beg you, please let the boy go back with his brothers, and I will stay and be your slave.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim pam bɛn mini Mariama daa doli kana la daa nya Yisa ni tum shɛm maa, ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: Many of the people who had come to visit Mary saw the things Jesus did, and they put their faith in him.

dag: Dama saa ni yi nyaɣisi wulimpuhili polo m-mali ti ba wulinluhili polo shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia kandina maa ti yɛn be.
en: The coming of the Son of Man will be like lightning that can be seen from east to west.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim maa, Di luhiya ni nir chɛ ka bara kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali bee di bi luhi.
en: Jesus said to the Pharisees and experts in the law, Is it right or wrong to heal on the Sabbath day.

dag: daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka o dɔro maa dii naai.
en: She came up behind him and touched the hem of his clothes, and at once her bleeding stopped.

dag: Yi ni daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ dahin shɛli yi ni daa laɣim Sinai Zoli gbini la yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi bee n-nya buɣim titali ŋɔ yaha, ti ni kpi.
en: Thats exactly what you requested from the LORD your God at Horeb, on the day of the assembly, when you said, I cant listen to the LORD my Gods voice anymore or look at this great fire any longer. I dont want to die.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa lan laɣim Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa Shɛkɛm na nti boli bɛ kpamba mini sariakaritiba ni zuɣulaannima ni Izraɛl tuma zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ daa ka Naawuni tooni na.
en: Joshua called all the tribes of Israel to meet together at Shechem. Then Joshua called the older leaders, heads of the families, judges, and the officers of Israel. These men stood before God.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi, ka o daa fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bia la.
en: But the Israelites cried to the Lord for help, and the Lord sent a man named Othniel to save them. He was the son of Kenaz, who was Calebs younger brother. Othniel saved the Israelites.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, M bi tim ba yi sanna, amaa bɛ zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisirila ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka n kari ya bahi ka yi mini bɛna anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa ti kpi. .
en: The Lord himself has said that he did not send them and that they are lying to you in his name. And so he will drive you out, and you will be killed, you and the prophets who are telling you these lies.

dag: Amaa man yi chɛ ka n dabili bee n tumo yɛli shɛli, n chɛrimi ka din niŋ pali. N yɛli Jɛrusalɛm ni niriba ni lan ʒini di ni, ka yɛli Juda fɔntinsi ni bɛ ni lan me li zali. Bɛ ni lan me tin shɛŋa din daa lu maa zaa zali.
en: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm o na.
en: Jesus answered, How unbelieving and wrong you people are! How long must I stay with you? How long do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here to me.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kul shini, ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama Naa Hɛzɛkia daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: But the people were silent. They did not say a word to the commander, because King Hezekiah had commanded them, Dont say anything to him.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi zaligu din tahi nyɛvili din be Yisa Masia ni na nti ti ti la yihi ma alahichi mini kum zaligu taali ni.
en: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.

dag: Hal sakpaleensi mɛrila bɛ duri, ka ŋmanʒiɛhi mali bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛri a jɛmbu duu puuni; ka mali bɛ bihi sɔŋdi baɣind a sara maligu bimbini; nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ n naa ni n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni. O ni niŋ alibarika niŋ Aduna zuliya ni.
en: The LORD remembers us and will bless us: God will bless the house of Israel; God will bless the house of Aaron.

dag: Lala mi ka ti Duuma zali ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mooni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molo gba dirila lahibal suŋ maa tuma ni.
en: In the same way, the Lord commanded that those who preach the gospel should get their living from the gospel.

dag: Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni shɛb bɛn kpalim la? Dama ti pun po Yawɛ sani ni ti ni so di zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti ba.
en: What shall we do to provide wives for the men of Benjamin who are left? We have made a solemn promise to the Lord that we will not give them any of our daughters.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni. Dina n-nyɛ: Ɛlitɛke mini Gibɛtɔn.
en: The tribe of Dan gave them Eltekeh, Gibbethon.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋ ti hal ti ni kul bi tam a yɛla bee n-saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la zaa.
en: All this has happened to us, even though we have not forgotten you or broken the covenant you made with us.

dag: Ka Rubin mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn daa lo kpara la daa gari niriba maa tooni kaman Musa ni daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm la.
en: The men of the tribes of Reuben and Gad and of half the tribe of Manasseh, ready for battle, crossed ahead of the rest of the people, as Moses had told them to do.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ wain ti maŋli la, ka m Ba mi nyɛ di gula.
en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the vineyard keeper.

dag: bɔhira, Kpe ka Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la kpɛra.
en: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Ti Duuma ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ sahi takɔbi, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei.
en: Human one, prophesy! Say, The Lord proclaims! Say: A sword! A sharp and polished sword!.

dag: Ti nyɛviya dabisa nyɛla yuun pisopɔin, ka ti yi mali yaa, di ni niŋ yuun pihinii; amaa di yuma maa zaa tiri ti la wahala mini suhugarigu; ka di ku yuui ka di naai ka vuui.
en: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.

dag: Doo mini paɣ yi dɔni, bɛ niriba ayi maa bɛn sum kom, ka nyɛ bɛn ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.

dag: Ka toli maa daa ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Ka bɛ galisim maa kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ.
en: They came in swarms and settled over the whole country. It was the largest swarm of locusts that had ever been seen or that ever would be seen again.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ kpe Pɛɔr buɣili Baal jɛmbu ni. Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord was angry with Israel because they had worshiped the god Baal Peor.

dag: Nyam biŋkɔbiri ni bamdi shɛm. Niɣi kul chanimi gindi mɔri ni kani ka bɛ ni ŋubi zuɣu; ka piɛri mini buhi gba kul diri wahala.
en: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.

dag: Ka a ŋariŋduhiriba kuhigu vuri daa chɛ ka teeku duli sɔhigi.
en: The shouts of the drowning sailors Echoed on the shore.

dag: Hal laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: It is much harder for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God than for a camel to go through the eye of a needle.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam wum n yɛligu ka niŋ ŋun tim ma na maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka bɛ ti ku lan kar o saria, dama o pun yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni.
en: I am telling you the truth: those who hear my words and believe in him who sent me have eternal life. They will not be judged, but have already passed from death to life.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A yɛla ka n daa chɛ ka n daba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl anabinim yɛli kurimbuni ha la, bɛn daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa di dabisa maa ni yuma pam puuni n-yɛli ni o ni ti chɛ ka a kana ti liri ba la. .
en: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti fabili niŋ o ka yɛl o, Wula ka a niŋdi tinim bɛn nyɛ a tumtumdiba ŋɔ lala?.
en: Then the foremen went to the king and complained, Why do you do this to us, Your Majesty?.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛli n taali a yuli zuɣu, dama n daalahichi galisiya pam.
en: Keep your promise, Lord , and forgive my sins, for they are many.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, ti nyɛla daba m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ti yaannim maa ni hal ni zuŋɔ. A daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ diri di tiwala, ka nyari di pin suma daanfaani.
en: And now, we are slaves. We are slaves in this land, the land you gave our ancestors so they could enjoy its fruit and all the good things that grow here.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have the poor with you. But you will not always have me.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, M bia, mirim na ti mɔɣisi n kpariŋ.
en: Then Isaac said to him. Son, come near and kiss me.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu yaha ka Yisa yɛn chaŋ Galili; ka daa ti nya Filip yɛl o, Doli ma.
en: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. There he met Philip, who was from Bethsaida, the hometown of Andrew and Peter. Jesus said to Philip, Follow me.

dag: O zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni niŋ a nuu ni ni a su. Dina n-nyɛ: ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni noonsi. Nyini n-nyɛ zuɣu din nyɛ salima la.
en: He has given you control, and you rule over people and the wild animals and the birds. Wherever they live, God has made you ruler over them all. King Nebuchadnezzar, you are that head of gold on the statue.

dag: Yɛlim naa min o ma, Ʒinimiya tariŋ ʒiishee, dama yi nam zuɣupila din viɛl la yi yi zuɣu ni lu tiŋa.
en: Tell these things to the king and his wife, Come down from your thrones. Your beautiful crowns have fallen from your heads.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Itam bidibisi: Jɛziriil mini Ishima ni Idibash. Bɛ tizɔpaɣ yuli n-daa booni Hazɛlɛlipɔni.
en: This was Etams family: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. Their sisters name was Hazzelelponi.

dag: N ni bɔri ni n yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa yinoyino yɛrila ŋ-ŋɔ: Man dolila Pool; ka so yɛra, N dolila Apolɔs; ka so yɛra, Pita ka man doli; ka so mi yɛra, Man dolila Masia.
en: What I mean is this: that each one of you says, I belong to Paul, I belong to Apollos, I belong to Cephas, I belong to Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a niriba min a paɣiba ni a bihi ni a ni su shɛlikam zaa zuɣu;.
en: As a result, the Lord will severely punish your people, your children, and your wives, and will destroy your possessions.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa suhi o wunsuhigu ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa yiɣisi zan o ni daa gba luɣ shɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini maa gbini n-kpuɣ o nuhi duhi zuɣusaa.
en: When Solomon finished his prayer at the altar, he was kneeling with his arms lifted toward heaven. He stood up.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Samsin paɣ maa ti do so ŋun daa nyɛ Samsin aŋgo zo.
en: and his wife was given to the man that had been his best man at the wedding.

dag: Ka Haga daa ti dɔɣi Ibram bidibiga, ka Ibram daa boli bi so Haga ni dɔɣi maa yuli Ishimail.
en: Hagar gave birth to Abrams son, and Abram named the son Ishmael.

dag: Do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias ka o nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la daa nyɛla ŋun mali yu suŋ nimaani Yɛhudianim zaa sani.
en: There was a certain man named Ananias. According to the standards of the Law, he was a pious man who enjoyed the respect of all the Jews living there.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka a ni du m-ba a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli ni o ku zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni.
en: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi Naa Zɛdɛkia bidibisi n-ku ba o ninni, ka kpaɣ o mi nina; ka ba o bandi n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: While Zedekiah was looking on, his sons were put to death; then Nebuchadnezzar had Zedekiah's eyes put out, placed him in chains, and took him to Babylon.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ti o suɣili Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu ʒini; ka chɛ Bɛtɛl bahi wulinluhili polo, ka chɛ Ai mi bahi wulimpuhili polo. Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ nimaani gba n-jɛmd o di gbini.
en: After that, he moved on south to the hill country east of the city of Bethel and set up his camp between Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There also he built an altar and worshiped the Lord .

dag: A ni ti tam a nandahima ŋɔ yɛla, a ni ti teei di yɛla ka di ŋmanila ko shɛli din pun zo n-gari.
en: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni n ni yɛn tiligi n niriba yuun shɛli paaya, ka n ni yɛn darigi n niriba dimnim tibili saha shɛli gba paai.
en: I chose a time to punish people. Now the time has come for me to save and protect my people.

dag: Ŋmam nudirigu polo, ka ŋma nuzaa polo! Bɛ ni kul zaŋ a noli kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: Cut to the right and the left, you sharp sword! Cut wherever you turn.

dag: Naawuni zaliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: For God said, Respect your father and your mother, and If you curse your father or your mother, you are to be put to death.

dag: Yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zaa la yoli, m bɔri ni n teei ya ni Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi Izraɛlnima n-yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di nyaaŋa o daa ti bahi bɛ ni bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda la yoli.
en: I want to remind you of something you already know very well. The Lord, who once saved a people out of Egypt, later destroyed those who didnt maintain their faith.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim; bɛ ku zo dabiɛm. Di bahigu ni, bɛ ni ti di nasara bɛ dimnim sani.
en: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman awa muna ata saha, ka Ananias paɣ daa kpɛna ka bi mi din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: About three hours later his wife came in. Sapphira did not know about what had happened to her husband.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi pahi buyi ti suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, pipia ŋɔ yi ku miligi n zuɣu ka pa ni n nyu li mi, nyin chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ.
en: Once more Jesus went away and prayed, My Father, if this cup of suffering cannot be taken away unless I drink it, your will be done.

dag: Dama a suui ʒitibisi shɛli din wum ba la; ka kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli bɛ ni mali fiɛbiri bɛ bɔɣusapima la. A nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nahind a niriba kaman a ni daa nyaŋ Midian tɔbbihi shɛm la.
en: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini tiliginsim shee waɣ pam, dama bɛ bi bɔri a zaligunima.
en: The wicked will not be saved, for they do not obey your laws.

dag: Tibikpara viɛl a tapaɣisi zuɣu ka nyiŋgokɔriti viɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.

dag: Biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka zibisim zo la, n yura, nyin ŋmaligim niŋ kaman molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ la n-zo n-yi Bɛtɛr zoya zuɣu na.
en: Before the day breeze blows and the shadows flee, turn about, my love; be like a gazelle or a young stag upon the jagged mountains.

dag: ka yɛli sariakaritiba maa, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi saria karibu ni, dama pa ninsalinim ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira, amaa Yawɛ ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira. O be yi sani yi saria karibu ni.
en: and told them: Be careful when you make your decisions in court, because you are judging by the Lord 's standards and not by human standards, and he will know what you decide.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ tɛhima, ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali na mi n-kpi? Bee ya polo ka bɛ mi n-zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun biɛhigu tuhi?.
en: Can you think of any innocent person who was ever destroyed? Do you know of any place where good people are punished?.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni daa baptaizi ti la wuhiya ni ti be Yisa Masia ni, ka lan wuhi ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi gba?.
en: Or dont you know that all who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?.

dag: Kom pam ku tooi kpihi yurilim, ka kokpɛɣu mi ku tooi di li. Nir yi zaŋ o yiŋ azichi zaa ni o da yurilim, bɛ ni mal o ansarisi.
en: A flood cannot put out love. Rivers cannot drown love. Would people despise a man for giving everything he owns for love?.

dag: amaa ti bi mi din chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, ti mi bi mi ŋun neeg o nina maa. O mi pala bia; bɔhimiy o; omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ya.
en: But we dont know why he can see now. We dont know who healed his eyes. Ask him. He is old enough to answer for himself.

dag: Nyama, ti Duuma mali ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ni yiko din ni tooi lu bɛ zuɣu. O ni kana kaman sakuɣa saa bee sa kurili ni kopaliga nti di tiŋgbani maa.
en: Look, the Lord has someone who is strong and brave. He will come into the country like a storm of hail and rain. Like a powerful river of water flooding the country, he will throw that crown down to the ground.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yi Abinɛr karibu maa yɔɣu labina nti laɣim Dauda tɔbbihi maa zali ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ pisiyinika daa kani m-pahi Asahɛl zuɣu.
en: Joab, meanwhile, returned from pursuing Abner and assembled the troops. Nineteen of Davids soldiers were counted missing in addition to Asahel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Chidɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣ shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa gbibi.
en: As they came to the threshing place of Chidon, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the Covenant Box.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ bukɔbiri wuɣi tani n-zaŋ pili m biɛhigu shee maa. Wuɣimiya li tan tolima piniyini.
en: You should also make curtains of goats hair for a tent over the dwelling. Make eleven curtains.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya. Naawuni daa zaŋ ba leeg o bihi ka chɛ ka bɛ mal omaŋmaŋ jilima; ka daa lo ba alikauli ka zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunima ti ba; ka daa wuhi ba o jɛmbu soli ka lo ba alikaulinima.
en: They are God's people; he made them his children and revealed his glory to them; he made his covenants with them and gave them the Law; they have the true worship; they have received God's promises;.

dag: Ka Asiria naa maa daa gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli Asiria nti zaŋ ba ʒili Hala mini Habɔr Mɔɣili duli din be Gɔzan yaɣili polo la ni Miidianim fɔntinsi ni.
en: The Assyrian emperor took the Israelites to Assyria as prisoners and settled some of them in the city of Halah, some near the Habor River in the district of Gozan, and some in the cities of Media.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ a nini kpa bɛ ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la polo, ka teeg a nu zaŋli n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa kul o yiŋa ni sujee nti fo n-ʒiya, Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zuɣu. Dama o daa yɛl o mi, N ku zaŋ n yaannim fali bini ti a. Ka Naa Ɛhab dɔni o bindoo zuɣu ŋ-ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: So Ahab went home, angry and depressed because of what Naboth had told him. He lay on his bed, just staring at the wall and refusing to eat a thing.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba maa daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: So Noah went out with his sons, his wife, and his sons wives.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Juda Naa ŋun ʒi Dauda nam ʒiishee ŋɔ min a kpamba ni a niriba bɛn doli dunɔdali ŋɔ kpɛra, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to the LORDs word, king of Judah, you who sit on Davids throne—you and your attendants, and all those who go through these gates.

dag: dama hal bɛn guni gba maŋmaŋ bi doli fukumsi zaligu, amaa din chɛ ka bɛ bɔri ni yi guni nyɛla ni bɛ tooi nyu bara yi niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: Those who are circumcised dont observe the Law themselves, but they want you to be circumcised, so they can boast about your physical body.

dag: O daa zaŋla din buɣisiri maa buɣisi wulimpuhili polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: He took the measuring rod and measured the east side, and it was feet.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ʒini Sool zuɣu m-muɣis o pam.
en: Now the LORDs spirit had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the LORD tormented him.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka di zanila dabari, ka di nyɛ dabari n-fabindi niŋdi ma. Tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zanila dabari, amaa ka so baɣa kani.
en: Every field I see lies barren, and no one cares.

dag: Amaa ti daa bi chaŋ miri Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni zaŋ tabili Jabok kulibɔŋ dul la mini fɔntin shɛli din daa be zoya tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: But we did not go near the territory of the Ammonites or to the banks of the Jabbok River or to the towns of the hill country or to any other place where the Lord our God had commanded us not to go.

dag: Jɛhɔzadak ka bɛ daa gbaai chaŋ tinzun tiŋa saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim niŋ Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni ka o gbahi ba chaŋ la.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa bɔhi, O yɛn kula omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka o yɛli ni o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ti ku tooi ka nimaani na maa.
en: The people asked, Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going.

dag: Aram bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Hul ni Gɛta ni Mashi.
en: Arams sons were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

dag: ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini dɔbba pia bɛn be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zaŋ takɔbi ku Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa, Babilɔn naa ni daa zaŋ o leei tiŋgbɔŋ maa Gomna maa zuɣu.
en: Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, and the ten men got up and struck down Gedaliah, Ahikams son and Shaphans grandson, with the sword. They murdered him because he had been appointed over the region by the king of Babylon.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini niriba maa daa lo alikauli dindali maa; ka o daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn doli Shɛkɛm.
en: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people and established just rule for them at Shechem.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa ni yihiri bindiri sun shɛŋa zaa na nyɛla a ni chɛ ka na shɛb su ti maa dini ti daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛna n-lan su ti niŋgbuna yiko zaŋ tabili ti binnɛma n-niŋdi bɛ suhuyubu, ka ti be nandahima pam ni.
en: The harvest is big in this land. But we sinned, so that harvest goes to the kings you put over us. They control us and our cattle. They do anything they want. We are in a lot of trouble.

dag: Ka din gari di zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yɛda niŋbu leei bintaɣirisi din ni chɛ ka yi tooi tiligi Sintani piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la nyɔɣibu.
en: At all times carry faith as a shield; for with it you will be able to put out all the burning arrows shot by the Evil One.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi, yi ni niriba ayi yi naai noli dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ ni suhi Naawuni yɛl shɛli zuɣu, m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: To say it another way, if two of you on earth agree on anything you pray for, my Father in heaven will do what you ask.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Yawɛ yiko malila tariga? To, a ni nya n yɛligu maa ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli yi sani bee di ku niŋ.
en: The Lord answered, I can do anything! Watch and you'll see my words come true.

dag: dama bɛ daa yurila salinim paɣibu gari Naawuni paɣibu.
en: They loved praise from people more than praise from God.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni saɣim yɛnnim yɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali fahim fahim ŋari.
en: As God says in the Scriptures, I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Alimɔndibilataim maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Abarim zoya ni miri Nɛbo.
en: They marched from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the Abarim mountains in front of Nebo.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni nti zaŋ ma gari dundɔŋ lɔrisi anahi la ni, ka dundɔŋ maa ni lɔriga kam ti mali dundɔŋ.
en: We went back to the outer courtyard and walked past the four corners.

dag: Niriba ayi laɣim be so ninvuɣ yino, dama bɛ ni tooi tum bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Two are better off than one, because together they can work more effectively.

dag: Bɛn zaa yuya be kpe ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn daa nyɛ zuɣulaannim bɛ daŋ ni, ka bɛ zuliya maa daa nabi pam.
en: These mentioned by name were leaders in their clans, and their households increased greatly.

dag: Tarim so ŋun nahind o tarim taba ŋmanila sa so ŋun mi n-ʒi bindira zaa chaŋ.
en: Someone in authority who oppresses poor people is like a driving rain that destroys the crops.

dag: N ni tɔɣis a zaligunim maa yɛla nanim tooni, ka ku zo vi.
en: I will discuss your rules with kings, and no one will embarrass me.

dag: Tiŋgbani ni ti dam damdi biɛɣu n-tahi bɔɣi n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: There will be earthquakes, and the earth will split open.

dag: Yi duri zoya din du pam zuɣu nti maani maligu, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni nimaani.
en: You go to the high mountains to offer sacrifices and have sex.

dag: Ti mabihi, di bi kpa talahi ni ti lan sab dabisa mini saha yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli polo;.
en: We dont need to write to you about the timing and dates, brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛ ni daa gbahi shɛba chaŋ Tɛlabib, ka bɛ be Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la sani. Ka n daa ʒini bɛ sani nimaani daba ayopɔin.
en: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni bi niŋ din tuhi? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: So what are we going to say? Isnt this unfair on Gods part? Absolutely not!.

dag: Ka bɛ nahiŋgu maa buɣim nyɔhi ni kpuɣi du zuɣusaa hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ku mali vuhim yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu la min o binnani la ni bɛnkam deeg o yuli dalinli la.
en: And the smoke from their burning pain will rise forever and ever. There will be no rest, day or night, for those who worship the beast and its idol or who wear the mark of its name.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-kul niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim tiri daadamnim sahakam.
en: Look, God does all this, twice, three times with persons.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka tia kam din lihibu viɛla ka simdi dibu bili yi tiŋgban ni na. Ka nyɛvili tia mini tia din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu gba daa be puu maa sunsuuni.
en: He made all kinds of beautiful trees grow there and produce good fruit. In the middle of the garden stood the tree that gives life and the tree that gives knowledge of what is good and what is bad.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti zaɣisi anab maa ni yɛn zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa wumbu, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti kari dilan saria.
en: This prophet will speak for me, and I will punish anyone who refuses to listen to my commands.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ doo maa yi tiŋ maa tariga nti pihi kuɣa lab ku o kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: So the people took him outside the camp and killed him with stones. They did this just as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: N ni gɔŋ Juda kaman tɔb la, ka zaŋ Ifriim mi leei di piɛma. N ni zaŋ Ziɔn leei takɔbi n-tuhi Giriisinima.
en: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋmaligi yɛl o, Mani n-tim a, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ŋɔ chaŋ ti fa Izraɛlnim Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: Then the LORD turned to him and said, You have strength, so go and rescue Israel from the power of Midian. Am I not personally sending you.

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchunima, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa bɛ bi gbuɣiri ŋubira, dinzuɣu bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani. Miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ nimdi, yi mi di ti shihi bɛ zaɣ kpima.
en: Do not eat pigs. They must be considered unclean; they have divided hoofs but do not chew the cud. Do not eat any of these animals or even touch their dead bodies.

dag: Yiliyiiniba daŋ ni: Ɛliashib. Dunɔguliba daŋ ni: Shallum mini Tɛlɛm ni Uri.
en: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N Duuma Naawuni, bɛ ku a daanabinima, ka wurim a sara malibu bimbina, ka n kɔŋko n-kpalim ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yihi man gba nyɛvili.
en: He said, Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa pii Kɛdɛshi din be Galili Naftali zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la mini Shɛkɛm din daa be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la ni Kiriatariba din be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoli zuɣu la.
en: So the Israelites chose some cities to be called cities of safety. These are the cities: Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali; Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim; Kiriath Arba in the hill country of Judah;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnima.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Ka o kɔre daa kul be o mamanim bɛn yoya be kaman bunsi yoya, ka bɛ bɔri paɣiba kaman yuri la ni.
en: She lusted after their male consorts, whose sexual organs were like those of donkeys, and whose ejaculation was like that of horses.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin o ni daa di nam saha shɛli maa.
en: Jehoash was years old when he became king.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Kamiya Bɛtɛl na nti tum tuumbiɛri; ka chaŋya Giligal nti tum tuumbiɛri. Zaŋmiya yi asiba kam sara maligu na, ka zaŋ yi bini pii puuni zaɣ yini na daba ata dali kam.
en: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.

dag: Bɛ yi galim ya Masia yuli zuɣu, yi mal alibarika, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi min o jilima be yi ni. Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri Masia, amaa yinim sani o nyɛla ŋun nyari tibigibu.
en: If you are mocked because of Christs name, you are blessed, for the Spirit of glory—indeed, the Spirit of God—rests on you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu paɣirila ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mini ba bi tuhira.
en: Those who abandon Instruction praise the wicked, but those who follow Instruction battle them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri bi viɛla, lala biɛhigu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o suhu piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The Lord hates those who love to do evil, but he is pleased with those who try to do right.

dag: Di saha Napaɣ Vashiti gba daa laɣimla paɣiba na, ka bɛ ti be nayili maa puhiri bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu maa.
en: While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.

dag: Amaa o daa tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la tatabo. O daa bi lɔɣ li.
en: But he continued to do the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat who had caused the Israelites to sin. Joram did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam.

dag: Hɔdia paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Naham tizɔpaɣ la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gamnim bɛn daa be Kɛila la yaannim mini Maakatinim bɛn daa be Ɛshitɛmɔa la yaannima.
en: Hodiah married the sister of Naham. Their descendants founded the clan of Garm, which lived in the town of Keilah, and the clan of Maacath, which lived in the town of Eshtemoa.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Gɛrishom mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levi had three sons: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, di yi nyɛla nyini m-bala, nyin chɛ ka n tam kom ŋɔ zuɣu ka a sanna.
en: Peter said, Lord, if that is really you, tell me to come to you on the water.

dag: m-bɔh o, Zarai dabili Haga, ya ka a lee yina bee ya ka a lee chana? Ka o yɛli, N yila n lan Zarai sani zɔra.
en: and asked, Hagar, where have you come from, and where are you going? She answered, I'm running away from Sarai, my owner.

dag: Bɛ ka bihi bee zuliya bɛ niriba sunsuuni, ka so lan ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: They will leave behind no children, no descendants. None of their people will be left alive.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Dɛbir ti liri ba.
en: Then Joshua and his army turned back to Debir and attacked it.

dag: Dabiɛm daa kul gbahila tinzunnim maa, ka bɛ yiri bɛ birininim ni zɔrina ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: Foreigners lose their nerve; they come trembling out of their fortresses.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini niɣi ni biŋgbamda ni binyiɣira zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, wild animals and cattle, reptiles and birds.

dag: M puhiri Rufus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ti Duuma ni la min o ma ŋun nyɛ n gba ma la.
en: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.

dag: Pa so n-yɛn yihi n nyɛvili maa, amaa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n yɛn zaŋ li sɔŋ. M mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ li sɔŋ, ka lan mali yiko din ni ti lan kpuɣ li yaha. M Ba ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: No one takes my life away from me. I give it up of my own free will. I have the right to give it up, and I have the right to take it back. This is what my Father has commanded me to do.

dag: Naawuni, ti yaannim daa pun yɛli ti ka ti wum a ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa bɛ ʒiɛman ni kurimbuni ha la yɛla.
en: God, we have heard about you. Our fathers told us what you did in their lifetime. They told us what you did long ago.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni garigi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti ni gbibila ti ni lo nia shɛŋa, ka sokam tumd o tipawumli tuumbiɛri.
en: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Di kpalim biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma yaha dama n labirila m Ba sani.
en: Soon you wont be able to see me; soon after that, you will see me.

dag: Paɣimiy o yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ sahakam. O chɛ ka o jilima pali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa. Ami! Ami!.
en: Praise his glorious name forever! Let his glory fill the whole world. Amen and Amen!.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, di ni ti nyɛla alikauli din ku naai bɛ sani. N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi, ka n ti zaŋ n jɛmbu duu zali bɛ sani sahakam.
en: And I will make a peace agreement with them. This agreement will continue forever. I agree to give them their land. I agree to make them numerous and to put my holy place among them forever.

dag: O ni daa vuui Amasa niŋgbuŋ solɔɣu maa zuɣu maa nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa naanyi doli Jɔab n-lan gbaai Bikiri bia Shiiba la naba biɛhibu.
en: Once Amasa was moved out of the road, everyone who followed Joab marched past in pursuit of Bichris son Sheba.

dag: Ɛdom daa ka naa; wulana n-daa nyɛ naa.
en: The land of Edom had no king; it was ruled by a deputy appointed by the king of Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: There was nothing they could say.

dag: Di saha ka Pool min o tab la daa kpe ŋariŋ yiɣisi Pafɔs n-chaŋ Pɛɛga Pamfilia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Jɔn Maak daa ti zani nimaani ŋ-ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ka chɛ ba.
en: Paul and the others left Paphos and sailed to Perga in Pamphylia. But John left them and went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI poya o kasitali puuni yɛli, Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-vo n-chaŋ. Hal ziŋgɔhi ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ vo yi ni shɛb bɛn kpalim chaŋ.
en: As the Sovereign Lord is holy, he has promised, The days will come when they will drag you away with hooks; every one of you will be like a fish on a hook.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa sagban wɔɣinli ni. Bɛ daa dol o wuhibu min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti ba la.
en: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.

dag: ka zaŋ n ni daa be muɣisigu ni ka yaai n noli yɛli binshɛli yɛla, ka lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ li ti a la ti a.
en: I will give you what I said I would when I was in trouble.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka ti niŋ o shɛli, dama o nyɛla ti tizo ni timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ. Ka o mabihi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: We will profit more if we sell him to these traders. Then we will not be guilty of killing our own brother. The other brothers agreed.

dag: M pun kahig a yuli wuhi ba, ka ni lan kahigi li wuhi ba pahi, ka di chɛ ka yurilim shɛli a ni yuri ma la be bɛ ni, ka n gba be bɛ ni.
en: I showed them what you are like, and I will show them again. Then they will have the same love that you have for me, and I will live in them.

dag: Yawɛ buɣisiri wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa biɛhigu, ka o suhu je bɛn yuri duŋ taabu.
en: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.

dag: O ni ti tuhi sansana din mali kpiɔŋ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm wun so la sɔŋsim zuɣu. O ni ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe wuni ŋɔ nyaaŋa jilima, ka zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni, ka pirigi paliti ti ba ka di leei bɛ laara.
en: That northern king will attack strong fortresses with the help of this foreign god. He will give much honor to the foreign rulers who join him. He will put many people under their rule. He will make the rulers pay him for the land they rule over.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Nandahima gbaai ma pam. Chɛ ka ti kpalimla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya. Amaa di chɛ ka n kpalim ninsalinim nuu ni.
en: David answered, I am in a desperate situation! But I don't want to be punished by people. Let the Lord himself be the one to punish us, for he is merciful.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni dabili mini Yisa Masia tuun so o ni tim ni n ti kpaŋsi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda yɛda mini bɛ yɛlimaŋli baŋbu din nyɛ din luri Naawuni sizuura la sanna.
en: Greetings from Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I was sent to help Gods chosen people have faith and understand the truth that produces a life of devotion to God.

dag: Amaa o yɛla ni ti niŋ niriba pam alahiziba ka nanim ti kɔŋ bɛ noya yaabu o zuɣu. Dama bɛ nini ni ti nya bɛ ni daa bi yɛli ba shɛli yɛla; ka baŋ bɛ ni daa pun bi wum shɛli yɛla.
en: But now many nations will marvel at him, and kings will be speechless with amazement. They will see and understand something they had never known.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ ni o ti bu padiriba paa niŋ o puu ni.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni kpɛbu, o jilima ni daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa puuni maa zuɣu.
en: The priests were unable to enter the LORDs temple because the LORDs glory had filled the LORDs temple.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛn be kpaŋa lun ya sizuura, ka yi mi ku lihiri so ninni ni o dihi ya.
en: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi du shɛli din daa tuhi sambani wulinluhili polo la mini di yaɣa ayi varandanima, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sunsuuni mini di puuni duu ni di samban ni zɔŋ la.
en: He measured the length of the building to the west, including its galleries on both sides, and it was also feet. The entrance room of the Temple, the Holy Place, and the Most Holy Place.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ka bi chaŋ.
en: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka Babilɔn naa bɔɣiri niŋ kpiɔŋ, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna bɔɣiri niŋ bɔɣ zalima, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. N ni ti zaŋ n takɔbi niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o ti zaŋ li lu Ijiptinim zuɣu.
en: Yes, I will weaken him and strengthen the king of Babylonia. When I give him my sword and he points it toward Egypt, everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum. Yawɛ, neem a nina nya; ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tim na nti yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-mali nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm.
en: Lord , please listen to me. Lord , open your eyes and look at this message. Hear the words that Sennacherib sent to insult the living God.

dag: Ti nyari duhibu, ka lan nyari filiŋ; ti nyari ʒiɛmbu, ka lan nyari tibiginsim. Bɛ niŋdi ti mi kaman ʒirinima, amaa ka ti lee nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinima.
en: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.

dag: Ka wula ka yi ni tooi zaŋ binshɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ maai n suhu? Yi lan ka yi ni yɛn garigi ma shɛm naɣila ʒiri kɔŋko.
en: And you! You try to comfort me with nonsense! Every answer you give is a lie!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Nyin Saimɔn, Jona bia, a mal alibarika! Dama pa daadam ni o zabigu n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuh a, amaa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-kahigi li wuh a.
en: Good for you, Simon son of John! answered Jesus. For this truth did not come to you from any human being, but it was given to you directly by my Father in heaven.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli wahu maa, Ti ni tooi di ti shɛŋa din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: The woman answered, God said we could eat fruit from any tree in the garden.

dag: Ka nanim maa zaa mini bɛ tɔbbihi daa laɣim kana ti dɔni Mɛrom kulibɔŋ ni ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: All these kings came together. They came and camped together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel.

dag: Amaa n daa bi lan niŋ lala, dama n daa je ni n yuli saɣim lala zuliyanim maa sani. Dama bɛ ninni ka n da yihi ba na.
en: But I restrained myself and acted for the sake of my name so that it wouldnt be diminished in the sight of the nations who saw me lead them out of Egypt.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa saɣim bɛ mihi mini bɛ chi zaa, dama bɛ chi maa daa bimi ka mihi maa pum puma.
en: Now the flax and the barley were destroyed, because the barley had ears of grain and the flax had buds.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri, ŋun mi viɛnyɛliŋga be n sani.
en: You can rest assured that what I say is true.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira.
en: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl.
en: When Kenan was , he had a son, Mahalalel.

dag: Nadab bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sɛlɛd mini Apaim. Amaa Sɛlɛd ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: Nadabs sons were Seled and Appaim. Seled died without having children.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa ka mali suhukpeeni, dama yi dan Sool kpiya ka Judanim mi zaŋ ma leei bɛ naa.
en: So now take courage and be brave—yes, your master Saul is dead, but the house of Judah has anointed me king over them.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima m-pahi malaikanim zaa, o ni ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee din mali jilima pam.
en: When the Son of Man comes in his glory with all his angels, he will sit on his royal throne.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubiri la bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi la hal ni daba ayɔbu, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, di simdi ni yi ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di ti tumiya tuun shɛli dindali maa.
en: For six days you will eat unleavened bread. The seventh day will be a celebration for the LORD your God. Dont do any work.

dag: Tiŋgbani ni ti dam damdi biɛɣu n-tahi bɔɣi n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.

dag: Naawuni, wuhimi n ni ka taali shɛm, ka zabi n zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri sani, ka fa ma ʒiŋmariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu soli nuu ni bahi.
en: Defend me, God. Argue my case against those people who dont know you. Protect me from those evil liars.

dag: ka Malikija nyɛ Ɛtini bia, ka Ɛtini nyɛ Zɛra bia, ka Zɛra nyɛ Adaya bia.
en: son of Ethni son of Zerah son of Adaiah.

dag: A bahi ti dimnim yoli zaa; ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: Our enemies are finished forever; you have destroyed their cities, and they are completely forgotten.

dag: Ka naa Sulemaana mini Hiram ni Gɛba tumtumdiba daa kpe kuɣa, ka ŋma dakuɣiri m-mal li ni bɛ zaŋ me duu maa.
en: Then Solomon and Hirams builders and the men from Byblos carved the stones and prepared them and the logs for use in building the Temple.

dag: Ka o daa lan gbihi n-zahim zahindi din pah ayi. Kawaan kara ayopɔin din viɛla n-daa nyaɣi kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu.
en: Pharaoh went back to sleep and began dreaming again. This time he dreamed that he saw seven heads of grain growing on one plant. They were healthy and full of grain.

dag: Ka Musa bɔɣiri daa ti ja, ka bɛ bo kuɣili na ti sɔŋ ka o ʒini di zuɣu, ka Aduna mini Hur daa gub gbaag o nuhi maa mali. Yino daa ʒiɛla o nudirigu polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe o nuzaa polo, ka o nuhi maa daa kul ʒe tibi hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When Moses' arms grew tired, Aaron and Hur brought a stone for him to sit on, while they stood beside him and held up his arms, holding them steady until the sun went down.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-nyɛ ti ni pun be so sani ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: My Lord, you have been our home forever and ever.

dag: Ka namɔɣili maa daa bɔhi Filip, Ŋun yɛla ka Anabi maa lee yɛri maa, omaŋmaŋ yɛla bee so yɛla.
en: The eunuch asked Philip, Tell me, about whom does the prophet say this? Is he talking about himself or someone else.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: Finally, the woman died too.

dag: A yi ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ suhuri zɔhirimi. A yi deei bɛ vuhim, bɛ kpirimi n-lab taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: When you turn away from them, they become frightened. When you take away their breath, they die, and their bodies return to the dust.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba. Ti nya bɛ tiŋgbani maa ka di vuhiri pam. Di ʒin ya kpe yoli. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti deei bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: The five men answered, We have found some land, and it is very good. We should attack them. Dont wait! Lets go and take that land!.

dag: N nina fulimmi n nandahima zuɣu, n dimnim chɛ ka di niŋla liti.
en: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.

dag: Ka Gabirɛl daa kana ti zani baɣili ma. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam, ka n lu n-dɔni tiŋa. Ka o yɛli ma, Daadam bia, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ di gbinni. Ʒii maa wuhirila dunia ŋɔ bahigu yɛla.
en: So Gabriel, the angel who looked like a man, came to me. I was very afraid and fell down to the ground. But Gabriel said to me, Human, understand that this vision is about the time of the end.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti na maa ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yilli bɛ sani.
en: With the strength of a wild ox, God led Israel out of Egypt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, A bi yɛn mali tiŋgbani bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bee m-mali tarili bɛ sani. Mani n-nyɛ a tarili ni a ni su shɛli Izraɛlnim sani.
en: The Lord said to Aaron, You will not receive any property that can be inherited, and no part of the land of Israel will be assigned to you. I, the Lord , am all you need.

dag: Ka o napɔnvari be kaman daanya sun shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she zuɣiri buɣim ni m-paɣi ka di yi viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ka o kukoli mi vuri kaman kɔzɔrim vubu la.
en: His feet were like brass that glows hot in a furnace. His voice was like the noise of flooding water.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisa; di kul chanimi ti dooni niŋgbina ni.
en: Gossip is so tasty—how we love to swallow it!.

dag: O daa me o jɛmbu duu ka di be kaman alizanda la, ka be kaman o ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ ka di kul beni sahakam shɛm la.
en: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.

dag: A ni kpab li kaman biŋŋmaa la, ka di ni taɣi m-be kaman situra la; amaa nyin kul ku taɣi, ka a mi kul ku kurigi.
en: You will fold them up like a coat, and they will be changed like clothes. But you never change, and your life will never end. Psalm :-.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa, Darimiya chahi yi situra, ka zaŋ buri so n-kum Abinɛr kuli. Ka Naa Dauda daa doli kum adaka maa nyaaŋa.
en: Then David ordered Joab and all the troops who were with him, Tear your clothes and put on funeral clothes! Mourn for Abner! King David himself walked behind the body.

dag: ka lan laɣim nyu binnyur yini; dama Naawuni ni daa ti ba kuɣ shɛli ka di doli ba la kom ka bɛ daa nyura. Masia mi n-daa nyɛ kuɣili maa.
en: and drank the same spiritual drink. They drank from the spiritual rock that went with them; and that rock was Christ himself.

dag: ka dabiɛm mini niŋgbuŋ sɔhibu daa paai ma din daa dam n kɔba ni zaa.
en: It frightened me, and I trembled down to my bones.

dag: Nachimba daa yi nya ma, bɛ labiri la nyaaŋa, ka ninkura yiɣisi ti ma jilima.
en: When the young men saw me coming, they stepped out of my way. And the old men stood up to show they respected me.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm yɛtɔɣa tir ba la jilima, amaa jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din diri ba.
