en: If you talk sensibly, you will have friends; if you talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.

dag: N daa ʒila niriba pam yi kpe chaŋ, amaa ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka n labimina ni nuzaŋa. Ŋun Yawɛ n-chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa paai ma, ka wula ka yi lan booni ma Naomi.
en: When I left here, I had plenty, but the Lord has brought me back without a thing. Why call me Naomi when the Lord Almighty has condemned me and sent me trouble.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni di timaha gbinni; ka zaŋdi yi bihi maani maligu vinvama mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.

dag: N kumdila Mɔabnim zuɣu! Bɛ zo n-kuli Zɔa mini Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama shɛb lu soli kuni Luhit, ka kumdi chana; ka shɛb mi zo n-kuli Hɔrɔnaim ni suhugarigu pam.
en: My heart cries out for Moab. Its fugitives flee to Zoar, to Eglath-shelishiyah. At the ascent of Luhith, each will go up with weeping. On the road to Horonaim, they will raise a piercing cry.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mɔŋ nandaamba bɛ ni bɔri shɛli bee n-chɛ ka pakoli kɔŋ tahima.
en: I have never cheated widows or others in need.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. Binshɛɣukam shiri luhiya, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa n-kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: Some of you say, We can do whatever we want to! But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam bɛ zaa suhuri, ka mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.

dag: ka Naawuni yi di yiɣisi zani, wula ka n di yɛn niŋ? Ka o yi bɔhi ma, wula ka n yɛn garigi yɛl o?.
en: what could I do when God rises; when he requires an account, what could I answer?.

dag: Lihimi n nudirigu polo nya, so bi bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli. N ka sɔɣibu shee; so baɣa ka n ni.
en: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.

dag: Yuun tuhili yi ti gari, di ŋmanila sɔhila a sani, bee ŋ-ŋmani kaman yuŋ saha biɛla yuusim.
en: To you, a thousand years is like yesterday, like a few hours in the night.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam, amaa ka di niŋdiya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm, dama bɛ wuhiri din tuhi, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee bi dol li.
en: So you should obey them. Do everything they tell you to do. But their lives are not good examples for you to follow. They tell you to do things, but they dont do those things themselves.

dag: Bɛ yooi mɔɣili dunɔdaya, ka nayili dam.
en: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.

dag: amaa ka daa lee yɛli ni bɛ di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama ni di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu zuɣu.
en: But they said, We must not do it during Passover, because the people will riot.

dag: Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi. Ka o daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-daa ku bɛ zaa, ka gba daa zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed men with his spear. He was just as famous as the Three Warriors.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni ku zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi bee n-deei tuumbiɛrilana.
en: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.

dag: Ti daa da puu maa mini siliga din be di ni maa la Hitinim sani.
en: Both the cave and the land that goes with it were bought from the Hittites.

dag: Ka Naftali bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jaziil mini Guni ni Jɛza ni Shilɛm.
en: Naphtalis sons were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai Zikilag daba ata dali n-nya ka Amalɛknim kamina ti liri Nɛgɛbinim mini Zikilagnima n-nyaŋ Zikilagnim maa, ka nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: As soon as David and his men arrived at Ziklag on the third day, they saw that the Amalekites had attacked Ziklag. The Amalekites invaded the Negev area, attacked Ziklag, and burned the city.

dag: Dindali maa yuntisuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti ku Ijipti bikpamba zaa. Firawuna ŋun daa ʒi o nam ni la bidib kpɛm daa kpiya, hal dansarika so ŋun daa be vol ni sarika ni bidibituuli gba daa kpiya zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi biŋkɔb dib shɛb zaa.
en: At midnight the LORD struck down all the first offspring in the land of Egypt, from the oldest child of Pharaoh sitting on his throne to the oldest child of the prisoner in jail, and all the first offspring of the animals.

dag: Ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mali yiko pam. O baŋsim galisiya yaɣi.
en: Our Lord is great and so strong! Gods knowledge cant be grasped!.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lab o nachimba maa sani ka o mini ba ti lab kuli Bɛrishiiba, ka Ibrahimma ti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba.

dag: Yilimiya o yuli jilima yila. Paɣimiy o jilima paɣibu!.
en: Sing to the glory of his name; offer him glorious praise!.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi, ka di niŋ pali. Di ti bi lan yɛn yuui yaha. Amaa yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni ka n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord , make this promise.

dag: Pool ni daa kul yɛn yaag o noli saha shɛli ka Gallio dii yɛli ba, Yinim Yɛhudianim ŋɔ, di yi di nyɛla tuun gala bee tuumbiɛ shɛli ka o tum ka yi tah o ŋɔ na, n naan wum yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Paul was about to speak when Gallio said to the Jews, If this were a matter of some evil crime or wrong that has been committed, it would be reasonable for me to be patient with you Jews.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa daa yi Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ bɛ zilinkom lab Izraɛlnim maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti yɛli ba.
en: Phinehas and the clan leaders left Gilead and went back to Canaan to tell the Israelites about their meeting with the Reuben and Gad tribes.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba niŋ zuliya shɛb nuu ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ba su ba.
en: He gave his people to other nations and let their enemies rule over them.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli, Paɣ ŋɔ nyɛla tuumbiɛri kɔtomsi. Ka o daa dihi paɣ maa ʒili piɛɣu maa ni ka zaŋ di liŋ maa pil li.
en: The angel said, The woman represents evil. Then the angel pushed the woman down into the bucket and put the lead lid back on it.

dag: Ka Farisii so ŋun daa boli Yisa na maa daa nya lala ka yɛli o suhu ni, Doo ŋɔ yi di nyɛla anabi, o naan baŋ paɣ ŋun shihir o ŋɔ ni nyɛ so, dama o nyɛla tuumbiɛrilana.
en: When the Pharisee who asked Jesus to come to his house saw this, he thought to himself, If this man were a prophet, he would know that the woman who is touching him is a sinner.

dag: Yuma ata kam puuni, zaŋmiya yi puri atam pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim sɔŋ yi tinsi ni.
en: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.

dag: O naan zaŋ o yiko din galisi ŋɔ zab ma? Aai, amaa o naan gbilisi tibili wum n yɛligu.
en: Would God use all his strength against me? No, he would listen as I spoke.

dag: Nir suhu ni karimbaani n-tahir o saɣiŋgu na, amaa maŋsiɣisibu m-be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: No one is respected unless he is humble; arrogant people are on the way to ruin.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ ti teei gili Samaria.
en: Some time later, King Benhadad of Syria called his entire army together, then they marched to Samaria and attacked.

dag: N daa ti lihi n yiŋ takɔro voya ni.
en: From the window of my house, I once happened to see.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti mini Pool chaŋ ti puhi Jeemsi, ka cheechi kpamba la zaa gba daa be o sani.
en: The next day Paul went with us to see James; and all the church elders were present.

dag: Di tamiya, teemiya yi ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi shɛm tiŋgban nɛl ni la yɛla. Dahin shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mali hal ti paai kpe na ŋɔ yi kul nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: Remember—dont ever forget!—how you made the LORD your God furious in the wilderness. From the very first day you stepped out of Egypt until you arrived at this place, you have been rebels against the LORD.

dag: dama yi yi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu yi ni kpi, amaa yi yi chɛ ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku yi ninsalitali biɛhigu maa tuma yi ni, yi ni be.
en: If you use your lives to do what your sinful selves want, you will die spiritually. But if you use the Spirits help to stop doing the wrong things you do with your body, you will have true life.

dag: Tindaannim maa daa bi kani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la gbin na, amaa ka lee pahiri bɛ mabihi zuɣu ŋ-ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din ka dabindi la.
en: Those local priests could not serve at the Lord 's altar in Jerusalem, but they were allowed to eat sacred bread, just like the priests from Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Di chɛ ka a bia maa min a dab paɣ maa yɛla muɣis a. Zara ni kul yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm o ni yɛl a shɛm maa, dama Yisahaku zuɣu ka a zuliya yɛn yɛligi.
en: But God said, Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee tiri kahiŋkɔɣu nimdi saha shɛli kum yi ti mal o bihi ka bɛ kumdi niŋdi man Naawuni, ka chani bɔri bindirigu?.
en: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?.

dag: Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun kpihim ninsalinim daalahichi ka mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka o min o ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi maa zaa laɣim mali Ba yino. Dina n-chɛ ka vi bi mal o ni o bol ba o mabihi.
en: This is because the one who makes people holy and the people who are being made holy all come from one source. That is why Jesus isnt ashamed to call them brothers and sisters when he says.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni, Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Zebulun—Eliab son of Helon;.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni la Shia yi be yi ni, ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni maa ni zaŋ nyɛvili niŋ yi gba niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni, o Shia ŋun be yi ni la zuɣu.
en: If the Spirit of the one who raised Jesus from the dead lives in you, the one who raised Christ from the dead will give life to your human bodies also, through his Spirit that lives in you.

dag: Ka ninsalinim daa ti tumdi tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka duŋ taabo daa kul be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: When God looked at the earth, he saw that people had ruined it. Violence was everywhere, and it had ruined their life on earth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ŋmalig o sani n-chaŋ shɛb sani nti lan yɛli lala yaha; ka niriba maa gba garigi yɛl o kaman bɛn la ni pun yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: He turned to another man and asked him the same question, and every time he asked, he got the same answer.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim bɛn bi niŋdi anabinim yɛligu yɛda ŋɔ!.
en: Then Jesus said to the two men, You are foolish and slow to realize what is true. You should believe everything the prophets said.

dag: nyin Naawuni naan dii nya, dama a mi ti daashili tɛha din be ti suhuri ni.
en: wouldnt God have discovered it? After all, God knows every secret of the heart.

dag: Ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ku di. Amaa ka o tumtumdiba la mini paɣ maa daa kpaŋ bɛmaŋa m-balim o hal ka o ti saɣi, ka daa yiɣisi tiŋa n-ʒini garo zuɣu.
en: Saul refused and said he would not eat anything. But his officers also urged him to eat. He finally gave in, got up from the ground, and sat on the bed.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa naai, o dii yiɣisimi yi; di daa nyɛla yuŋ.
en: Judas accepted the bread and went out at once. It was night.

dag: Ka o bidibis ayi maa daa kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba. Paɣiba maa yuya n-daa booni: Opa ni Rut.
en: who married Moabite women, Orpah and Ruth. About ten years later.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ʒii nyabu puuni, a daa yɛli a daba bɛn ʒe a yim: N zaŋ sɔŋsim ti ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ; n duhi n ni pii ninvuɣ so niriba puuni.
en: In a vision long ago you said to your faithful servants, I have given help to a famous soldier; I have given the throne to one I chose from the people.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa daa yi chani naa Sulemaana sani ti wumdi Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli niŋ o suhu ni maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: and kings of every nation wanted an audience with Solomon in order to hear his God-given wisdom.

dag: ka Ibram daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Shɛkɛm ti ʒini Mɔre oki tia gbini. Keenannima n-daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni di saha maa.
en: Abram traveled through the land as far as the sacred place at Shechem, at the oak of Moreh. The Canaanites lived in the land at that time.

dag: ka nahindi nandaamba mini bɛn ka, ka fari niriba, ka bi labisiri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima o sani n-tiri bindaannima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka tumdi din chihira.
en: He cheats the poor, he robs, he keeps what a borrower gives him as security. He goes to pagan shrines, worships disgusting idols.

dag: Dan zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shuham daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shuhamnima. Dan zuliya niriba m-bala.
en: The tribe of Dan: the clan of Shuham.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn wurimla n ni daa me shɛli zali, ka vuɣi n ni daa sa shɛli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Jeremiah, tell Baruch that this is what the Lord says: I will tear down what I have built, and I will pull up what I have planted. I will do that everywhere in Judah.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni gbib ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga sahakam, ka gul ti.
en: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.

dag: Firawuna ni daa mirina, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lihi bɛ nyaaŋa n-nya ka Ijiptinim maa kani bɛ sanna, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ kuhi pam niŋ Yawɛ.
en: When the Israelites saw Pharaoh and his army coming toward them, they were very frightened and cried to the Lord for help.

dag: Ka bɛ yiɣisi zani n-yɛrigi luɣilikam chaŋ ti teei gili Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda biɛhigu shee mini Naawuni tin yurigu la; ka buɣim ti yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba.
en: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.

dag: N sabi n zaligunim paai ʒiibutuhili ti ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi li, ka tɛhi ni di nyɛla zaɣ pala.
en: Even though I write out for him a large number of my instructions, they are regarded as strange.

dag: M mabia Jɔnatan, n suhu saɣimya pam a zuɣu. M min a biɛhigu daa lu n-taɣili tab pam. A yurilim zaŋ chaŋ n sani daa mali alahiziba, ka galisi pam gari paɣ ni mali yurilim shɛm.
en: I grieve for you, my brother Jonathan; how dear you were to me! How wonderful was your love for me, better even than the love of women.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a nuu n-tum lala maa.
en: Then they will know that you did it. They will know that it was your power, Lord , that helped me.

dag: O ni daa kum o yidan kuli maa naai, ka Dauda daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o kul o yiŋ na ka o ti zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa ka Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: When the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to the palace; she became his wife and bore him a son. But the Lord was not pleased with what David had done.

dag: Firawuna yuri min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la ni daa siɣi teeku maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka teeku maa kom lan nahi taba n-lim ba, amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa dolila teeku tiŋ kuŋ zuɣu ti du.
en: The Lord covered the royal Egyptian cavalry and chariots with the sea, after the Israelites had walked safely through on dry ground.

dag: Hal o ni fa bɛn mali taali bahi. Dinzuɣu yihim daɣiri a kɔbili ni ka o tilig a.
en: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven. They will be saved because you did what was right.

dag: Ka ŋunkam deeri anabi o ni nyɛ anabi zuɣu ni ti deeg anabi laara; ka ŋunkam deeri wuntizɔra o ni nyɛ wuntizɔra zuɣu ni ti deei wuntizɔra laara.
en: Whoever welcomes God's messenger because he is God's messenger, will share in his reward. And whoever welcomes a good man because he is good, will share in his reward.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Dauda tɔbutuhiri kpamba, bɛ mini Izraɛlnim zaa n-daa be Dauda kɔbili ni sɔŋd o pam o nam maa ni, ka o nyɛ naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo la.
en: This is a list of the leaders over Davids special soldiers. These heroes became very powerful with David in his kingdom. They and all the Israelites supported David and made him king, just as the Lord had promised.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee din mali kpiɔŋ; ka chɛ ka barina shɛli ka n soli zuɣu.
en: God is my strong fortress. He clears the path I need to take.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa bɔh o ba Sool, Bɔ zuɣu ka a yɛn ku o? Bɔ ka o lee niŋ.
en: Why do you want to kill David? Jonathan asked. What has he done.

dag: A dimnim bela a jɛmbu duu maa luɣ kasi shee la n-tahiri nasara dibu tahigu; ka zaŋ bɛ tuutanim sa nimaani.
en: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.

dag: N yura, a viɛlimi kaman Tiriza, ka viɛli kaman Jɛrusalɛm la, ka a ni be shɛm ŋmanila tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanima.
en: My darling, you are as beautiful as Tirzah, as pleasant as Jerusalem, as awesome as the stars in the sky.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa bi bɔri ni o saɣi ka yɛl o, Mani n-naan ka a sanna ka a ti baptaizi ma, amaa ka nyini nti lee kani n sanna.
en: John tried to stop him and said, I need to be baptized by you, yet you come to me.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti nya Yisa di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, dama o daa pun wum o yɛla ka di wɔɣa, ka bɔri ni o nya o ni o nini, ka daa lan tɛhiri ni di pa shɛli Yisa ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛli ka o nya.
en: When Herod saw Jesus, he was very happy. He had heard all about him and had wanted to meet him for a long time. Herod wanted to see a miracle, so he was hoping that Jesus would do one.

dag: Yoomi wuntitali dunoya ti ma, ka n dol li kpe nti puhi Yawɛ.
en: Open to me the gates of the Temple; I will go in and give thanks to the Lord !.

dag: Di tiwul kpana kuumi kab lu, ka paɣiba va li ti mali buɣim. Dama niriba maa nyɛla bɛn bi baŋdi shɛli, dinzuɣu ŋun nam ba maa ku zo ba nambɔɣu bee n-niŋ ba nirilim.
en: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula; ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛla pam.
en: When Jesus arrived and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd. Then he began to teach them many things.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bia Zuriɛl. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila laɣiŋgu suɣili maa nuzaa polo.
en: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Nyam bɛn je ma ni chɛ ka n di wahala shɛŋa! Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yihiri ma kum ni.
en: Please have mercy, Lord ! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death.

dag: Di saha Sɔdomnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛn tumd alahichi pam Yawɛ sani.
en: The citizens of Sodom were very evil and sinful against the LORD.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi maa ha ka bɛ yɛli taba, Doo maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum bee sarika kpɛhibu.
en: and after leaving they said to each other, This man has not done anything for which he should die or be put in prison.

dag: Ka Dibɔn Mɔɣili kom daa deei ʒim mɔhi, amaa di zaa yoli, n ni niŋ Dibɔnnim din bie n-gari lala. Iin, gbuɣinli ni doli Mɔab ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim, ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la.
en: The waters of Dibon are full of blood. But I will bring still more upon Dibon: a lion for Moabs survivors, for the remaining few in the land.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka Farisii so yɛl o ni o bɔri ni o ka ŋun Farisii maa yiŋ na ka o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu. Ka o daa chaŋ ka bɛ ti ʒini ni bɛ di;.
en: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and sat down to eat.

dag: dama o zali dabisili ni o ti chɛ ka o ni pii so la zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kari dunianim saria. Lala zuɣu ka o daa neeg o ni daa pii so maa kum ni ni di leei shɛhira sokam zaa sani.
en: He has set a day when he will judge the world's people with fairness. And he has chosen the man Jesus to do the judging for him. God has given proof of this to all of us by raising Jesus from death.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa kpi yuun shɛli ka n daa nya n Duuma ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee din du pam ka mali jilima; ka o binyɛrigu pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaa.
en: In the year of King Uzziahs death, I saw the Lord sitting on a high and exalted throne, the edges of his robe filling the temple.

dag: M bi lan yɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ, dama n labirila a sanna, amaa bɛn kul ni beni. M Ba Suŋ, gbib ba a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm.
en: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A zuɣu n-lɛbigi! Amaa ka o nini kul mooi ka o yɛri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ka bɛ yɛl o, O malaika m-bala.
en: The believers said to her, You are crazy! But she continued to say that it was true. So they said, It must be Peters angel.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu daa ti miri puhibu, ka Yisa baŋ ni o saha paaya ni o chɛ dunia ŋɔ ka lab o Ba sani. Amaa o ni daa pun yur omaŋmaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni la, o daa kul yuri ba la lala hal ti yi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.

dag: Naawuni ni daa duh o n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo maa ka o deei Shia Kasi so o Ba Naawuni ni daa zaŋ lo ti alikauli la n-ti ti na. Alikauli maa palibu shihira ka yi nya ka wum ŋɔ.
en: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.

dag: ti daa ti zahimla zahindi yuŋ dahin yini, ka ti zaa yino kam zahindi daa mali di gbinni.
en: One night each of us had a dream, and the dreams had different meanings.

dag: ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: Someone who is in the field must not go back to get a cloak.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Ti yi bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a ni a yɛli ti ka ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ ŋun dim shɛhira jɛndi ti.
en: Then the people said to Jeremiah, If we dont do everything the Lord your God tells us, then we hope the Lord will be a true and faithful witness against us. We know he will send you to tell us what to do.

dag: di saha yin bɔhimiya ka vihi di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga; di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni bɛ tum din chihiri ŋɔ yi sunsuuni.
en: If you hear this kind of news, you must do all you can to learn if it is true. If you learn that it is true, if you prove that such a terrible thing really did happen.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya biɛrim, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam. Biɛrim maa ni ti ŋmanila paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ni ti lihiri tab ninni ka dabiɛm mali ba. Bɛ nini ni ti mooi.
en: They will all be terrified and overcome with pain, like the pain of a woman in labor. They will look at each other in fear, and their faces will burn with shame.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka n ni yɛn chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli paai Jɛrusalɛm maa niŋ a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni ka a nini nya li. N ni chɛ ka a ti yi dunia yili ni suhudoo. Ka tuumba maa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa lab ti yɛli Naa Jɔsia.
en: and the punishment which I am going to bring on Jerusalem will not come until after your death. I will let you die in peace. The men returned to King Josiah with this message.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔhi zom maa yaha, O ni neeg a nina maa, a lee tɛhiya ni o nyɛla ŋuni? Ka o yɛli ba, O nyɛla anabi.
en: they asked the man, What do you say about this one who healed your eyes? He is a prophet! the man told them.

dag: Dinzuɣu tim man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛm din ni zaŋ gbib a niriba maa, ka tooi baŋ zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu; dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: So I ask you to give me the wisdom to rule and judge them well and to help me know the difference between right and wrong. Without such great wisdom, it would be impossible to rule this great nation.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpe bɛ sani asiba n-nya ka bɛ malila suhugarigu.
en: When Joseph met them in the morning, he saw that they were upset.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi dol o gbin na yɛra, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali din daa muɣisi zuliya kam ka bɛ nyu di kɔr biɛri wain la luya.
en: A second angel followed the first one, saying, She has fallen! Great Babylon has fallen! She made all peoples drink her wine—the strong wine of her immoral lust.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus went down to the city of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people each Sabbath.

dag: Ka Pita daa lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam n-saɣisiri ba yɛra, Tiligimiya yimaŋ ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa daa kana ti paala salo, ka bɛ ni do so daa kana ti damdi Yisa tooni yɛli.
en: When they came to the crowd, a man met Jesus. He knelt before him.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Kom ŋɔ zɔri kparila wulimpuhili polo yaɣili n-zɔri chani Araba vinvamli ni. Ka di yi zo nti lu teeku kom din bi zɔri ŋɔ ni, teeku kom maa ni niŋ ko nyaɣisili.
en: He said to me, This water flows east, down to the Arabah Valley.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n nya saŋmar so ŋun daa yi zuɣusaa lu dunia ni na la, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɔɣ shɛli din ziliŋ ka tariga saafɛbia ti o.
en: Then the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and he was given the key to the shaft of the abyss.

dag: Abiata ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana saha shɛl la ka ŋun Naa Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li nti ti bɛn daa be o sani la.
en: It was during the time of Abiathar the high priest. David went into Gods house and ate the bread that was offered to God. And the Law of Moses says that only priests can eat that bread. David also gave some of the bread to the people with him.

dag: Dama o ni lo ni o niŋ ma shɛli maa, o ni niŋ li naai; ka lala binyara pam kul be o suhu ni.
en: He will do to me what he planned, and he has many other plans for me.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa shiri di o ʒiri shɛhira, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi nya o galimi. Di nyaaŋa ka niriba ayi daa tɔhi zanna.
en: But they could not find any, even though many did come and tell lies. At last, two men came forward.

dag: amaa pirimiya namda, ka di yɛn ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: It's all right to wear sandals, but don't take along a change of clothes.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na nti laɣim tab chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: The Pharisees and some legal experts from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus.

dag: Ka Lɔt ŋun daa doli Ibram maa gba daa mali biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni tantinima.
en: Now Lot, who traveled with Abram, also had flocks, cattle, and tents.

dag: Ti ni daa zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihi tin ya la zuɣu ka Naawuni boli ya ni yi mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima.
en: God called all of you through our good news so you could possess the honor of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: ka a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino bee bɛ zaa yi mi bɛ wahala mini bɛ suhugarigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka teei bɛ nuhi tiri duu ŋɔ polo na n-fabili niŋ a ka suh a.
en: listen to their prayers. If any of your people Israel, out of heartfelt sorrow, stretch out their hands in prayer toward this Temple.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Sool daa piligi m-bɔri Dauda soya.
en: And so he was jealous and suspicious of David from that day on.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti kuhi pam niŋ a, nyin wummi n kuhigu maa! Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka garigi ma!.
en: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim o sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka sapashini maa daa chaŋ Ilaija sani ka o ti ʒila zoli zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa yɛliya, Siɣim na. .
en: Ahaziah sent a captain and men to Elijah. The captain went to Elijah, who was sitting on top of a hill. The captain said to Elijah, Man of God, the king says, Come down.

dag: Di saha zuliya kam ni ti booni ya la suhupiɛllinima, dama nyaɣisim ni ti be yi tiŋgban ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then the people of all nations will call you happy, because your land will be a good place to live.

dag: Yuun pihinahi zaa ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul birigiri bɛ suhuri ni ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: For forty years I despised that generation; I said, These people have twisted hearts. They dont know my ways.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bo naa ti ba. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Sokam labimi kul o ya.
en: The Lord answered, Do what they want and give them a king. Then Samuel told all the men of Israel to go back home.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa yi bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi, ka di taali maa ʒi bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: The whole nation of Israel might sin without knowing it. They might break one of the commands of the Lord and become guilty of doing something he said must not be done.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa baŋ ni Naa Sɛnachɛrib loya ni o tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnim maa.
en: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib intended to attack Jerusalem also.

dag: O daa lan mali salima firilatamdisi pia kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, diba anu nudirigu polo, diba anu din la mi nuzaa polo.
en: Ten gold lampstands were also made according to the plans. Solomon placed these lampstands inside the temple, five on each side of the main room.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla Manaasa daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali pam hal ka bɛ ʒim ti kul zɔri doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri, di yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ din la polo m-pah o ni daa chɛ ka Judanim tum alahichi mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la.
en: Manasseh was guilty of causing the people of Judah to sin and disobey the Lord . He also refused to protect innocent people—he even let so many of them be killed that their blood filled the streets of Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan ka tuun shɛli yaɣa ŋɔ ni, ka n suhu mi pun ye yi sani kandina zuɣu yuma pam puuni la zuɣu.
en: But now, since I dont have any place to work in these regions anymore, and since Ive wanted to come to see you for many years.

dag: N sabi yɛtɔɣa biɛla din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tin ya la Silvanus ŋun nyɛ n ni lihi so m mabia ŋun ʒe yim la sɔŋsim ni. M bɔri ni n kpaŋsila yi suhuri, ka lan yɛli ya ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daanfaani maŋli yɛla. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya di ni dɛde.
en: Silas will bring this letter to you. I know that he is a faithful brother in Christ. I wrote this short letter to encourage you. I wanted to tell you that this is the true grace of God. Stand strong in that grace.

dag: A yi tarigi yɛl biɛɣu nyabu dali, a yaa m-pun bi galisi.
en: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble.

dag: di saha yin bɔhimiya ka vihi di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga; di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni bɛ tum din chihiri ŋɔ yi sunsuuni.
en: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yi lu, ŋun la ni yiɣis o zali. Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko zuɣu. O yi lu, o ka ŋun ni yiɣis o zali.
en: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.

dag: ka baŋdi ŋaha mini yɛliŋmahima din nyɛ yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ saliŋlɔha.
en: They help one understand proverbs and difficult sayings, the words of the wise, and their puzzles.

dag: Dama ŋunkam ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ biŋkpam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which a food gift could be offered to the LORD, that person will be cut off from their people.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli, o ni daa nam ninsala n-niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu; ka o suhu daa saɣim pam di zuɣu.
en: The LORD regretted making human beings on the earth, and he was heartbroken.

dag: dindina yi m-baŋmiya ni Naawuni n-zaŋ ma niŋ chirimbu maa ni, ka chɛ ka o zana gbaai ma maa.
en: Can't you see it is God who has done this? He has set a trap to catch me.

dag: Hiram daa lan yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa ni dunia, ka nyɛ ŋun ti Naa Dauda bi so ŋun mali baŋsim mini yɛm, ka lan mi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga, din ni me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka lan me omaŋmaŋ nam yili ŋɔ.
en: Praise the Lord God of Israel who made heaven and earth! He has given David a son who isn't only wise and smart, but who has the knowledge to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.

dag: m mali tahima ni n yi ti gariti chani Speen n ni nyan ya. Ka n yi ti kaai ya n-niŋ daba ayi yi sani, yi ni sɔŋ ma ka n gari chaŋ.
en: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba maa daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: So Noah went out of the ark with his sons, his wife, and his sons wives.

dag: Ka zoya daa sɔhigi nyin Yawɛ tooni, nyin ŋun daa yi zahira Sinai Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ, nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni tooni ka di daa sɔhigi maa.
en: The mountains quaked before the LORD, the one from Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.

dag: Babilɔn yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni ʒiɛri tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm, lala ka mbusim pɔhim yɛn yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali dabiɛm ni na.
en: An oracle about the wilderness near the sea. Like whirlwinds sweeping through the arid southern plain, it comes from the desert, from a fearsome land.

dag: Yi gba yumiya saamba, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So then, show love for those foreigners, because you were once foreigners in Egypt.

dag: ka Jɛfune bia Kalɛb daa yi Juda zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Judah—Caleb son of Jephunneh;.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya, zomiya tiligi, yimiya Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni. Piɛbimiya kikaa Tɛkɔa, ka ŋmɛnya tɔbuchiriga Bɛtihakɛrɛm. Dama zaɣ biɛɣu mini saɣiŋgu pam ni yi nuzaa polo na.
en: Escape, people of Benjamin, get out of Jerusalem! Blow the trumpet in Tekoa, sound the alarm in Beth-haccherem; for disaster looms from the north, massive devastation.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti o Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a binshɛŋa zaa la ni shɛli. A ni tooi piig a biŋkɔbbaligu ti o bee a puu atam bee a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain ti o ni a suhu zaa.
en: You must give him some of your animals, grain, and wine. The Lord your God blessed you and gave you plenty of good things. In the same way you must give plenty of good things to your slave.

dag: ti yɛli Nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ wuhi ti o jilima min o galisim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ti nyaya ni Naawuni ni tooi tɔɣisi ninsal yɛtɔɣa, ka ninsal maa na be o nyɛvili ni.
en: They said, The Lord our God has shown us his Glory and his greatness! We heard him speak from the fire. We have seen today that it is possible to continue living even after God speaks to us.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla din chɛ ka nir lara, amaa suhugarigu nyɛla din chɛ ka nandahima mali nira.
en: If you are happy, your face shows it. If you are sad, your spirit feels defeated.

dag: ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli she bantabiga mini zuɣupila, ka lan zaŋ tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she jɛŋjɛŋŋmahi.
en: and the turban, the caps, the linen shorts.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa sagban wɔɣinli ni. Bɛ daa dol o wuhibu min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti ba la.
en: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they obeyed the laws and commands that he gave them.

dag: dama a yi dee li niŋ a kɔbili ni, ka di zaa be a noli ni, di viɛla.
en: It will be good for you to remember these words and have them ready when they are needed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋsim yiri Yaakubu Naawuni sanna mal alibarika. Bɛ tahima bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.

dag: Ka Firawuna Nɛko daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Ɛliakim n-leei naa zal o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim. Ka o daa zaŋ Jɛhɔahaz n-kuli Ijipti, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: Neco appointed Josiah's son Eliakim king of Judah, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. He took Jehoahaz as a prisoner to Egypt, where he died.

dag: A malila ninsal nina? A nyarila binyɛra kaman ninsalinim ni nyari shɛm?.
en: Do you have physical eyes; do you see like a human?.

dag: Dama n yi saɣim yi suhuri, banima n-nyɛ bɛn ni chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli, ka pa ni n ni saɣim yinima ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri maa?.
en: For if I were to make you sad, who would be left to cheer me up? Only the very persons I had made sad.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli ka duh a. Zallakudura Naa, n ni yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: I will sing with joy because of you. I will sing praise to you, Almighty God.

dag: Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo, ti dimnim ni daa liri ti la.
en: The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi gba lala.
en: They made loops of blue thread on the edge of the outer curtain of the first set. They did the same on the edge of the outer curtain of the second set.

dag: M biyurisi, ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi pumpɔŋɔ, ka di na bi kahigi wuhi ti ni ti yɛn be shɛm, amaa ti lee mi ni o yi ti yi palo, ti ni bemi kaman ŋuna, dama ti ni ti nya o kaman o ni kul be shɛm.
en: Dear friends, now we are Gods children, and it hasnt yet appeared what we will be. We know that when he appears we will be like him because well see him as he is.

dag: Ka Isaka zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Issachar were .

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa daŋ yibu asiba n-labi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ Jɛziriil.
en: So David and his soldiers got up early in the morning to go back to Philistine territory, but the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

dag: Ka Pita daa dol o yi ka bi baŋ ni malaika maa ni niŋ o shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa tɛhi ni o zahimla zahindi.
en: Peter left with the angel, but he thought everything was only a dream.

dag: O bi ʒe tibi nyɛvili soli zuɣu. O soli kpɛla yɔɣu, ka o bi mi lala.
en: She does not stay on the road to life; but wanders off, and does not realize what is happening.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ti ni ti yihim waazu ti niriba, ka wuhi ba ni ŋuna ka Naawuni zaŋ leei nyɛvilinim mini kpiimba zaa sariakarita.
en: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na. Bɛ daa kul tahirimi ka piɛbiri kikahi ni piɛlahi yila, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka daa lan ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim pampam.
en: So all the Israelites accompanied the Covenant Box up to Jerusalem with shouts of joy, the sound of trumpets, horns, and cymbals, and the music of harps.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka bɛ daa bi sɔɣi ma kaman bɛ ni dɔɣi bi so zaɣ kpiŋ la, bee kaman biliɛ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-nya neesim la?.
en: Or why wasnt I like a buried miscarried infant, like babies who never see light?.

dag: ni Ana ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Hɔri nanima, ka nyɛ Siɛr bidibisi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These sons were all Horite family leaders from Seir in Edom.

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Azaria ni Raamia ni Nahamani ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipɛrɛt ni Biɣivai ni Nɛhum ni Baana n-daa doli kuna.
en: They came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah. The number of the people of Israel: The family of Parosh .

dag: O daa zaŋla anzinfa din kpalim ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihita m-mali bansi din yɛn yili daantalisi la mini di mihi ka niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni.
en: With the remaining pounds of silver Bezalel made the rods, the hooks for the posts, and the covering for their tops.

dag: A dabili yɛn guhi hal ti paai bɔ saha? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka la tibili?.
en: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?.

dag: Dinzuɣu, a yi yɛn tum shɛlikam, nyin tummi li ni a kpiɔŋ zaa; dama kpiimba biɛhigu shee din nyɛ a ni kuni luɣ shɛli maa, tuun shɛli bee tɛhi shɛli bee baŋsim bee yɛm ka nimaani.
en: Work hard at whatever you do. You will soon go to the world of the dead, where no one works or thinks or reasons or even knows anything.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Darius ka ti sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tira. Naawuni ti ma suhudoo zaa!.
en: This is a copy of that letter: To King Darius. Greetings:.

dag: N tɔɣisi jɛrilim m barinyubo ni, amaa yinima m-muɣisi ma ka n niŋ lala. Di di simdi ni yinim paɣi ma, dama hal n yi kul pa shɛli, n lee pala ŋun pɔri tuum shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: Ive become a fool! You made me do it. Actually, I should have been commended by you. Im not inferior to the super-apostles in any way, even though Im a nonentity.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ŋɔ kun ya lari. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni chɛ ka yi tiligibu niŋ tom. Dama n wum ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zali ka wuhi ni o ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa shɛm.
en: So now stop your scoffing, or your chains will be tightened, because destruction has been ordered—I have heard it!— by the LORD God of heavenly forces against the whole land.

dag: Wummiya zoya zuɣu vuri, salo vuri n-nyɛ li. Wummiya nama balibu mini zuliya balibu niriba tab laɣimbu vuri. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-laɣindi tɔbbihi ni o tuhi tɔbu.
en: Listen to that loud noise in the mountains. It sounds like crowds of people. People from many kingdoms are gathering together. The Lord All-Powerful is calling his army together.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yi dabitim ni n-labina maa zaa daa tila suɣa n-kpe m-be di ni. Ka sokam daa mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia la saha zaŋ na hal ti paai di saha maa, Izraɛlnim daa na ʒi n-lan niŋ lala.
en: The whole assembly of those who had returned from captivity made booths and lived in them. This was something that the people of Israel hadnt done since the days of Joshua, Nuns son, and there was very great rejoicing.

dag: So ka ti sunsuuni ŋun ni tooi gooi ti.
en: Oh, that there were a mediator between us; he would lay his hand on both of us.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Daniɛl daa ti kana. O nyɛla wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia ni be so ni, ka n daa yɛl o n zahindi maa. N daa yɛl o mi:.
en: Daniel, who is called Belteshazzar after the name of my god, was the last to come before me. In him is the breath of the holy gods! I told Daniel the dream.

dag: Yɛhudianim n-daa gbaai do so n ni tahi a sanna ŋɔ n-yɛn ku o, ka n daa wum ni o nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti fa o bahi.
en: This man was seized by the Jews and was almost killed by them. I was nearby with a unit of soldiers, and I rescued him when I discovered that he was a Roman citizen.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa yi tɔŋbu saha, amaa ka yi daa yɛli, Ti ku wum. Yi biɛhigu m-pun bala yi bilim tariga, dama yi bi deei n noli.
en: I spoke to you when you felt safe and secure, but you said, I wont listen. You have been that way since your youth: not listening to a word I say.

dag: ni di chɛ ka nyuli gbaai Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ mmaŋmaŋ zuliya la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni shɛb tiligi.
en: I hope I can make my own people jealous. That way, maybe I can help some of them to be saved.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kal ti pahi niɣi ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a lihi ti jɛra?.
en: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?.

dag: A chɛ ka nintam leei bɛ bindirigu, ka zaŋ nintam leei binnyurigu ti ba ka bɛ nyu pam.
en: Instead of bread and water, you gave your people tears.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara. Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee.
en: When an unclean spirit leaves a person, it wanders through dry places looking for a place to rest. But it doesnt find any. Then it says, Ill go back to the house I left.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab said, If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you must help me, and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, Ill help you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi tin ya vuhim yi dimnim bɛn gili ya ŋɔ sani tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya ni yi su li maa ni, yin kpihimmiya Amalɛknim maa birili dunia ŋɔ ni, Miriya ka yi ti tam.
en: So then, when the Lord your God has given you the land and made you safe from all your enemies who live around you, be sure to kill all the Amalekites, so that no one will remember them any longer. Do not forget!.

dag: Yihim ma bɛ daansarisi mini bɛ ninvuɣ tubo ni, dama n dol a zaligunima.
en: Free me from their insults and scorn, because I have kept your laws.

dag: Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni wum bɛ fabila, ka bɛ zaa chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa. Dama Yawɛ je suli, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: If they turn from their evil ways, perhaps the LORD will hear their prayers. The LORD has threatened them with fierce anger.

dag: Ka bee binshɛli beni, ka bɛ ni yɛli, Nyamiya, bini ŋɔ din nyɛla bin palli? Di nyɛla binshɛli din pun beni hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ti gba.
en: Look, they say, here is something new! But no, it has all happened before, long before we were born.

dag: Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama tɔb maa daa nyɛla Naawuni ni bɔr shɛli. Ka bɛ daa ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni hal ti paai saha shɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la.
en: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria.

dag: Iso bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Iso paɣ Ada bidibiga la mini Riuɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Iso paɣ Basɛmat bidibiga la.
en: Esau and Adahs son was Eliphaz. Esau and Basemaths son was Reuel.

dag: Ka o daa mali sara zoli zuɣu n-laɣim o dɔɣiriba ni bɛ kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka bɛ daa kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu maa ka kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and invited his relatives to a meal. They ate together and spent the night on the mountain.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bɔh o, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yɛliya ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: The disciples asked, Then why do the legal experts say that Elijah must first come.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali taali Yawɛ sani; ka di niŋ o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu.
en: It is a compensation offering. You have definitely become guilty before the LORD.

dag: O ni daa yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi bɛ naba ni.
en: When Moses finished saying these things, the ground under the men opened.

dag: Ka anabi so daa yi tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri suhudoo yɛla, anabi maa yɛligu daa yi ti niŋ pali, di saha ka bɛ baŋdi ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim o na ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: But a prophet who predicts peace can only be recognized as a prophet whom the Lord has truly sent when that prophet's predictions come true.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Hazaɛl daa yi Ilaisha sani n-lab o dan maa sani, ka o ti bɔh o, Ka wula ka Ilaisha lee yɛl a? Ka o garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma ni a ni kpaŋ.
en: Hazael went back to Benhadad, who asked him, What did Elisha say? He told me that you would certainly get well, Hazael answered.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ashpɛnaz ni daa zaŋ o min o tab niriba ata la niŋ so nuu ni ni o lihiri ba la sani ti yɛl o.
en: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard.

dag: Ka salo pam dii laɣimna hal ka palichee ti lan ka yili maa ni, ka so daa naan ku tooi lan miri dunol ni gba, ka Yisa yihiri ba waazu.
en: So many gathered that there was no longer space, not even near the door. Jesus was speaking the word to them.

dag: Dama di ni yuui ka Izraɛlnim ku lan mali naa bee zuɣulana, ka ku lan mali maligu, ka binwɔɣila ku lan be bɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan mali wuni bee baɣibihi.
en: Similarly, the Israelites will remain many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred standing stone, without a priestly vest or household divine images.

dag: Asaf bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani ka o wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-daa nyɛ: Zakur mini Yisifu ni Nɛtania ni Asharɛla. Naa n-daa wuhiri ba luɣ shɛŋa ni saha shɛli di ni simdi ni bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: The four sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. They were under the direction of Asaph, who proclaimed God's messages whenever the king commanded.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o ti kpuɣi paɣiba pam niŋ o paɣiba, di yi niŋ lala o suhu ni lɛbigi. O mi di ti va anzinfa bee salima pam mali.
en: Also, the king must not have too many wives, because that will make him turn away from the Lord. And he must not make himself rich with silver and gold.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi yo alizanda nam dunoli ni niriba di kpe di ni. Yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi bi saɣiri ni bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni kpe. .
en: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You lock people out of the kingdom of heaven. You won't go in yourselves, and you keep others from going in.

dag: Wummiya Hɔrɔnaimnim kuhigu na. Damili dambu mini saɣiŋgu pam.
en: The people of Horonaim cry out, Violence! Destruction.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm n-niŋ yuun pihinunaayi. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛkolia.
en: Azariah was years old when he began to rule. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mother was named Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛm mali biɛhigu shee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛhi zilima tɛha ni, amaa di ka jɛra bɛn suhuri ni.
en: Wisdom resides in an understanding heart, but its not known in fools.

dag: O daa di nam su Izraɛlnim la yuun pihinahi, o daa di nam ʒini Hiburɔn la yuma ayopɔin, ka ʒini Jɛrusalɛm mi yuun pihitanaata.
en: for forty years. He ruled in Hebron for seven years and in Jerusalem for thirty-three.

dag: ka nya ka pɔhim ʒɛra, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o piligi shimdi ka kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, tiligim ma.
en: But while Peter was walking on the water, he saw the wind and the waves. He was afraid and began sinking into the water. He shouted, Lord, save me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Pool kpe tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee saha shɛli ka o daa bɔhi sapashin kpɛm maa, A ni ti ma noli ka n yɛl a shɛli? Ka sapashin maa bɔh o, A wumdi Giriikili.
en: When the soldiers were ready to take Paul into the army building, he asked the commander, Can I say something to you? The commander said, Oh, you speak Greek?.

dag: Ti mabihi, din pahi nyɛla yi pun bɔhim ti sani di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm n-tiɣi Naawuni nini yɛla. Hal lala ka yi kul be, ka ti suhiri ya ka kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: Brothers and sisters, now I have some other things to tell you. We taught you how to live in a way that will please God. And you are living that way. Now we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus to live that way more and more.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛm min o ni daa deei Damaskus mini Hamat din nyɛ Judanim ni su shɛl la shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jeroboams deeds, all that he accomplished, and his powerful acts—how he fought and how he restored Damascus and Hamath to Judah in Israel—arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab yɛli so yɛla ni Naawuni yɛliya, N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: In the Scriptures God says about him, I am sending my messenger ahead to get things ready for you.

dag: Bɛ ni bi darigi bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri tibili yomyom zuɣu chɛ ka niriba kul lo bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ tumla tuumbiɛri.
en: Sometimes people are not immediately punished for the bad things they do. Their punishment is slow to come, and that makes other people want to do bad things too.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be ti ni, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa.
en: Now, there were seven brothers who used to live here. The oldest got married and died without having children, so he left his widow to his brother.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Zaŋm a yiko tiligi ti; zaŋm a yiko maa niŋ kaman a ni daa pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahi teeku ni biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni Rahab la.
en: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD. Awake as in times past, generations long ago. Arent you the one who crushed Rahab, who pierced the dragon?.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa yɛli, Aai, di bi simdi ni ti ku so zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnim faako.
en: But Saul said, No one will be put to death today, for this is the day the Lord rescued Israel.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛri n-nahindi ti yaannim maa ka muɣisiri ba ka bɛ zaŋdi bɛ biliɛri bahira ni bɛ zuliya maa kpihim.
en: He exploited our people and abused our ancestors. He even forced them to abandon their newly born babies so they would die.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bala, biɛɣuni ni sa nyɛ vuhim dabisi tibisili ka nyɛ Yawɛ vuhim dabisi kasi la zuɣu. Shɛmiya yin ni tooi she shɛli zuŋɔ, ka duɣiya yin ni tooi duɣi shɛli zuŋɔ, ka din guui yin zaŋmiya li zali hal ni asiba.
en: he told them that the Lord had said, Tomorrow is the Sabbath, a sacred day of rest in honor of me. So gather all you want to bake or boil, and make sure you save enough for tomorrow.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni fa shɛba. Bɛ gbahila bɛ zaa niŋ voya ni bee n-sɔɣi sarikanim ni. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi. Bɛ ŋmanila faɣiri nɛma, ka so ku tooi yɛli ni bɛ chɛl li.
en: But now his people have been plundered; they are locked up in dungeons and hidden away in prisons. They were robbed and plundered, with no one to come to their rescue.

dag: ka ʒiɛm n zaligunim ka zaɣisi li yi suhu ni, ka bi niŋ n zaligunim maa zaa ni yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm, amaa ka saɣim n daalikauli.
en: If you refuse to obey my laws and commands and break the covenant I have made with you.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa nini daa shiri neei, ka bɛ nya ka bɛ bela bɛ zaɣim, ka bɛ daa ŋahi fiig tia vari she n-zaŋ so.
en: Then they both saw clearly and knew that they were naked. So they sewed fig leaves together and made garments for themselves.

dag: Yili maa yi nyɛla yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim di ni; amaa di yi pala yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim yi sani.
en: If the home is deserving, let your blessing remain with them. But if the home doesn't accept you, take back your blessing of peace.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani.
en: Then one of the twelve followers went to talk to the leading priests. This was the follower named Judas Iscariot.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa chaŋ ti to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm puɣisi gbaai Yisa o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Then the Pharisees met together to find a way to trap Jesus in his words.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Dama sokam kul yɛri ma la yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa yɛla.
en: Eli said to his sons, The people here told me about the evil things you have done. Why are you doing such things?.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisiyinika puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu daba ayopɔin dali, ka Babilɔn naa kpambal so ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi sapashin kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan la daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: On the seventh day of the fifth month in the nineteenth year of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan arrived at Jerusalem. He was the commander of the guard and an official of the Babylonian king.

dag: Zara daa lan yɛli, Ŋuni n-daa naan yɛli Ibrahimma ni bihi ni ti mɔɣi man Zara biha. Amaa m bahi dɔɣi bia ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni.
en: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.

dag: Yi zuɣulaannim zaa daa laɣimmi guui. Pa piɛma ka bɛ daa zaŋ to n-gbahi ba. Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ ni daa nya yi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa hal bɛ ni daa kul zo n-chaŋ katiŋ la zaa yoli.
en: All your leaders ran away and were captured before they shot a single arrow.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani Masia ʒim zuɣu maa, din gari lala nyɛla, o zuɣu ka ti ni tiligi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni yaha.
en: By his blood we are now put right with God; how much more, then, will we be saved by him from God's anger!.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa wum Yisa ŋaha ŋɔ, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛna ka o ŋahi li dalim maa.
en: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew Jesus was talking about them.

dag: Jɛrigu bi bɔri tɛhi zilima, amaa ka naɣ wuhirila omaŋmaŋ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Fools dont want to learn from others. They only want to tell their own ideas.

dag: A halli zuɣu ka n daa zo a dabiɛm, dama a bɔri ni a nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri a ni bi biri binshɛli.
en: I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take what is not yours and reap what you did not plant.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri gadamanim nyuli, a mi di pii bɛ soya shɛli doli.
en: Dont envy those who are violent. Never choose to be like them.

dag: ka yɛli, Ti nuhi ka doo ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni bee n-di di shɛhira.
en: These leaders must say, We did not kill this person, and we did not see it happen.

dag: Yihim ninvuɣ biɛri naa kɔbili ni, ka o nam maa leei wuntitali nam.
en: Take the evil advisors away from a king, and goodness will make his kingdom strong.

dag: Ka a ti she jinjɛŋŋmahi ti ba ka di limsi bɛ zaɣim, ka di wɔɣilim ti zaŋ bɛ shɛhi ni hal ti paai bɛ gbalipina ni.
en: Make linen shorts for them, reaching from the waist to the thighs, so that they will not expose themselves.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka yi tɔŋ yi tuma zaa ni, ka yi bihi nabi, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nabi, ka yi puri atam gba nabi. Dama Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka o zaɣa be yi ni, ka yi tɔŋ kaman o zaɣa ni daa be yi yaannim ni ka bɛ tɔŋ shɛm la.
en: The Lord will make you prosperous in all that you do; you will have many children and a lot of livestock, and your fields will produce abundant crops. He will be as glad to make you prosperous as he was to make your ancestors prosperous.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa sani maa daa daai goon shɛŋa din zaa daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la luhi.
en: and his soldiers tore down the city walls.

dag: Abimilɛk daa bela Aruma, ka Zɛbul daa kari Gaal min o dɔɣiriba maa ti bahi ka bɛ ku tooi lan be Shɛkɛm.
en: Abimelech lived in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem, so that they could no longer live there.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: Then he prayed:.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ba ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ bɔh o, Rabai, ya polo ka a kpɛra.
en: Jesus turned, saw them following him, and asked, What are you looking for? They answered, Where do you live, Rabbi.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi bi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ gbinni? Ka wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahi shɛŋa din kpalim la gbinni?.
en: Then Jesus asked them, Don't you understand this parable? How, then, will you ever understand any parable?.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mali ti shili gu dimbɔŋɔ, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: Now the one who prepared us for this very thing is God, and God gave us the Spirit as a down payment for our home.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda, o ni nya alaafee.
en: Jesus heard this and said to Jairus, Dont be afraid! Just believe and your daughter will be well.

dag: Di saha ka n di zaŋ n zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun wuhi yɛlimaŋli so shɛli n ni yɛn doli kpuɣi ŋuna n dan maa dɔɣim bipuɣiŋga nti ti o bia maa.
en: I bowed and worshipped the LORD and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who led me in the right direction to choose the granddaughter of my masters brother for his son.

dag: Ka Ibram daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa, ka Naawuni yɛl o.
en: Then Abram bowed down before God. God said to him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya filiŋ pam Midiannim maa zuɣu, ka daa naɣ ti kummi niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: and Israel was helpless against them.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛnkam be yoma ni katiŋ zaa wum n ni niŋ shɛm ka baŋ ni m mali yiko.
en: You who are far away, hear what I have done; and you who are near, know my strength!.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa kari doli Jɛrɔbɔam nti ŋme n-deeg o tinsi; Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛshana mini di tiŋkpansi ni Ɛfurɔn mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took these cities away from him: Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, along with their villages.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli ka duh a. Zallakudura Naa, n ni yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.

dag: Ka Iso daa je Yaakubu yɛlli, o ba ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ o ni la zuɣu. Ka Iso daa yɛli, Di ku lan yuui ka ti ba kpi, di saha n ni ku n tizo Yaakubu.
en: Esau hated his brother Jacob because he had stolen the blessing that was supposed to be his. So he said to himself, Just as soon as my father dies, I'll kill Jacob.

dag: Di saha maa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba zaa daa laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas la yiŋa.
en: Then the leading priests and the older Jewish leaders had a meeting at the palace where the high priest lived. The high priests name was Caiaphas.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi ŋmanila yalim dunia ŋɔ ni. Yalim mi yi ti niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha; bɛ ni kpaa li mi bahi ka niriba nɔri li, dama di lan ka buchi.
en: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its taste, it cannot be made salty again. Salt is useless if it loses its salty taste. It will be thrown out where people will just walk on it.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi nya doo maa, dabiɛm gbaari ba mi pam ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: When the Israelites saw Goliath, every one of them ran away terrified of him. .

dag: Di saha ka ti chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na, dama Sool ʒiɛman la ni ti baɣa daa lan ka di ni.
en: so that we may bring the chest of our God back to us, because we didnt look for it in Sauls days.

dag: Di zaa yoli Yawɛ daa bi bɔr ni o bahi Dauda daŋ maa yoli, o ni daa lo Dauda alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. O daa lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ nam ti o min o zuliya ka bɛ be kaman firila la sahakam.
en: Nevertheless, because of the covenant he had made with David, the LORD wasnt willing to destroy Davids dynasty. He had promised to preserve a lamp for David and his sons forever.

dag: Ramanim mini Gɛbanim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisi ni yini.
en: from the towns of Ramah and Geba:.

dag: Ka a bia yi ti bɔh a daliri shɛli din chɛ ka a doli zaligu maa, nyin yɛlim o, Ti ni daa nyɛ daba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Yawɛ n-daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-yihi ti dabitim ni, lala zuɣu ka ti doli zaligu maa.
en: In the future, when your son asks what this observance means, you will answer him, By using great power the Lord brought us out of Egypt, the place where we were slaves.

dag: Naawuni simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ŋuna n-su yɛm mini yiko.
en: God is wise and powerful! Praise him forever and ever.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka Ashidɔdnim daŋ yiɣisibu n-nya ka buɣili Dagɔn lu m-pilila o puli zuɣu Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi buɣili Dagɔn n-lan zal o zaashee.
en: But when the citizens of Ashdod got up early the next morning, there was Dagon, fallen facedown on the ground before the LORDs chest! So they took Dagon and set him back up where he belonged.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-tɛhi ni dabisi shɛli so di kpee, ka so mi beni n-tɛhi ni dabisa zaa nyɛla yim. Chɛliya ka sokam doli o ni tɛhi shɛm omaŋmaŋ suhu ni.
en: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim birim, ka saɣim bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ni bɔhi bɛ wuna mini bɛ kpiimba ni bukpahinima ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti laɣim Shilo n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu tanti suɣili la kpa nimaani; ka bɛ ni daa tuhi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa kul doya ka bɛ lihiri li.
en: All the Israelites gathered together at Shiloh where they set up the Meeting Tent. The Israelites controlled that country. They had defeated all the enemies in that land.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zɛbida. O daa nyɛla Ruma nir ŋun yuli daa booni Pɛdaya la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoiakim was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eleven years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Zebidah; she was Pedaiahs daughter and was from Rumah.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka bɛ tum tuma maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ tum li shɛm maa, ka o daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: When Moses saw that they in fact had done all the work exactly as the LORD had commanded, Moses blessed them.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka dab paɣ bia maa gba nam zuliya, dama o gba nyɛla a zuliya.
en: But I will also bless the son of your slave woman. He is your son, so I will make a great nation from his family also.

dag: Kush bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Raama bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi gbilisi tibili wum, ka chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu bee buɣa jɛmbu.
en: But they wouldnt listen or pay attention or turn from their evil ways. They continued making offerings to other gods.

dag: Ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Bɔzuɣu ka a ŋari ma zaŋ m bipuɣinsi zo kaman tɔbu ka a tuhi gbahi ba maa? Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma maa?.
en: Laban said to Jacob, Why did you deceive me and carry off my daughters like women captured in war?.

dag: Putɔɣunim muɣisigu lan ka nimaani; ka di ni wum shɛb la nya vuhim.
en: There the wicked stop causing trouble, and the weary find rest.

dag: ka zuliya kam ti laɣim zan o tooni, ka o woligi ba kaman piɛgul ni woligiri piɛri mini buhi shɛm la.
en: and the people of all the nations will be gathered before him. Then he will divide them into two groups, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai tinsi maa ni nti zaŋ Yisa tuumba maa mini Jɛrusalɛm cheechi kpamba ni daa tɔɣisi gbaai yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la wuhi ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: As Paul and the others went from city to city, they told the followers what the apostles and leaders in Jerusalem had decided, and they urged them to follow these instructions.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi zɔŋ din daa be dunɔdali shee, ka di daa nyɛ mita anahi. Ka di daantalisi nyɛ mita yiniyini, ka zɔntua maa daa be puuni ha tariga.
en: Then he measured the porch of the gate: it was twelve feet, and its arches were three feet. The porch of the gate was opposite the temple.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiri ya, N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be yomayoma ka pa Naawuni ŋun be katiŋ gba.
en: I am a God who is everywhere and not in one place only.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Anabi Musa ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni yɛli shɛm la yɛla? O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: Now, as for the dead being raised: haven't you ever read in the Book of Moses the passage about the burning bush? There it is written that God said to Moses, I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yi tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni. N nyɛla ŋun wuhiri ya din ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli, ka lan wuhiri ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.

dag: Bɛ yooi mɔɣili dunɔdaya, ka nayili dam.
en: The gates by the river burst open; the palace is filled with terror.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti niŋ naani ni ti ni tooi kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la Yisa ʒim zuɣu.
en: And so, brothers and sisters, we are completely free to enter the Most Holy Place. We can do this without fear because of the blood sacrifice of Jesus.

dag: Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and had no children, his brother must marry the woman. Then they will have children for the dead brother.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali Bia maa mali nyɛvili; ka ŋunkam mi ka Naawuni Bia maa ka nyɛvili.
en: The one who has the Son has life. The one who doesnt have Gods Son does not have life.

dag: Yisifu bihi puuni, Ifriim zuliya ni, Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-yɛn sɔŋ ya; ka Manaasa gba zuliya ni, Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the descendants of Joseph: from the tribe of Ephraim—Elishama son of Ammihud; from the tribe of Manasseh—Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ Naa Sihɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba. Dina n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim daa deei Amɔrinim ni daa be tiŋgban shɛl ni maa zaa su.
en: But the Lord God helped Israel defeat Sihon and his army. Israel took over all of the Amorite land where Sihon's people had lived.

dag: Daadam, niriba ŋɔ niŋla bɛ buɣa yɛda ka chɛ ka bɛ daalahichi leei bɛ kuɣituurili do bɛ tooni. N ni chɛ ka bɛ bɔhi ma baŋ shɛli?.
en: Son of man, these men came to talk to you. But they still have their filthy idols. They kept the things that made them sin. They still worship those statues, so why do they come to me for advice? Should I answer their questions?.

dag: ka pɔb o nina ka yɛl o, A daanabitali puuni, wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: They blindfolded him and asked him, Who hit you? Guess.

dag: A ni di a tuma nyɔri. A ni tɔŋ ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: You will get what you work for. You will enjoy the Lords blessings, and all will go well for you.

dag: dama o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima Masia tuma zuɣu hal ti kpi. O daa niŋ lala ni o ti ma la sɔŋsim shɛli yi ni daa naan ku tooi ti ma.
en: He risked his life and almost died for the work of Christ, and he did this to make up for the help you couldnt give me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zahim laɣ shɛli tibisim sania zuɣu n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa fukumsi ni bɛ mal li yɔri kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim bɛn tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: They would then hand over the money that had been counted to those who supervised the work on the temple. These supervisors then paid money to those who worked on the LORDs temple: carpenters, builders.

dag: Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Lahibal suŋ la zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim laɣim nya Naawuni daalibarika; bɛ daa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣa, ka laɣim diri Naawuni ni daa lo alikauli shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la nyɔri.
en: The secret is that by means of the gospel the Gentiles have a part with the Jews in God's blessings; they are members of the same body and share in the promise that God made through Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ niriba maa kuli Yisifu yiŋa kaman o ni daa wuh o shɛm maa.
en: The servant did as he was commanded and took the brothers to Joseph's house.

dag: Ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛli kpamba maa, N daa zaŋla m bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti doo ŋɔ ka o niŋ o paɣa, amaa ka o ti bi lan bɔr o.
en: Her father will say to them, I gave my daughter to this man in marriage, and now he doesn't want her.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Ti ni yɛn woligi tab ŋɔ, n suhiri Yawɛ ni o gul ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa lan boli nimaani yuli Mizipa.
en: He also named it Mizpah, because he said, The LORD will observe both of us when we are separated from each other.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa pirig o dansarika binyɛra sɔŋ; ka daa kul diri nayili bindirigu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Evil Merodach let Jehoiachin stop wearing prison clothes. And every day for the rest of his life, he ate at the same table with the king.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ bia maa nti ti o ma; ka o zaŋ o ʒil o naba zuɣu n-gbib o hal ti paai wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: The servant carried the boy back to his mother, who held him in her lap until noon, at which time he died.

dag: Yi yi chɛ yi chi ka tam kabɔbili sɔŋ yi puuni, yin di lan labiya ti zaŋ li; di ni leela sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli dini, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.
en: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Saadis Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali Naawuni shih ayopɔin mini saŋmaris ayopɔin la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi mali yuli din wuhiri ni yi ne, amaa yi kpimi.
en: To the angel of the church in Sardis write: This is the message from the one who has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know what you are doing; I know that you have the reputation of being alive, even though you are dead!.

dag: Shilo zuliya ni mi, Asaaya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma nti pahi o bidibisi zuɣu.
en: The Shilonites who lived in Jerusalem were Asaiah the oldest son and his sons.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣiri ka suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli paari nir nyɛla din chɛ ka o niŋdi tuuba n-nyari tiliginsim, ka di pa din tahiri suhumiligibo na; amaa dunia ŋɔ ni chɛ ka nir nyari suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli nyɛla din tahiri kum na.
en: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yi Abinɛr karibu maa yɔɣu labina nti laɣim Dauda tɔbbihi maa zali ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ pisiyinika daa kani m-pahi Asahɛl zuɣu.
en: As soon as Joab stopped chasing Abner, he got David's troops together and counted them. There were missing besides Asahel.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba zɔrimi sɔɣira, amaa bɛ yi ti lan kani, wuntizɔriba zoorimi pahi.
en: People stay in hiding when the wicked come to power. But when they fall from power, the righteous will rule again.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Jabin sapashin kpɛm Sisɛra zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi kana ti chirigi ya Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni; ka n zaŋ o niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Ill lure Sisera, the commander of Jabins army, to assemble with his chariots and troops against you at the Kishon River, and then Ill help you overpower him.

dag: ka zaŋ diba anu n-niŋ luɣ din la mi polo dapaɣa, ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa wulinluhili polo dapaɣa.
en: five for the frames on the other side, and five for the frames on the west end, at the back.

dag: Ti daa fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ li ti Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili.
en: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.

dag: ka bindana maa yi beni, dindina samli yɔbu kani; ka di yi nyɛla o haayila biŋkɔbigu maa, dindina haayibu liɣiri maa ni zani biŋkɔbigu maa zaani.
en: But if that happens when the owner is present, he need not repay. If it is a rented animal, the loss is covered by the rental price.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa zaŋ bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb yuya ŋɔ.
en: Moses and Aaron took these men who were selected by name.

dag: N dol a zaligunima, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I obey your teachings; I love them with all my heart.

dag: amaa ŋunkam zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣisi dilana m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: But if you stand before others and say you do not believe in me, then I will tell my Father in heaven that you do not belong to me.

dag: Daantalisi maa ni daa yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu daa nyɛla daanya, amaa daantalisi maa bansi mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa, ka bɛ daa niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni, ka lɔndo maa daantalisi mihi zaa daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: The bases for the posts were made of copper, but the hooks for the posts and their bands were made of silver. The tops of the posts were covered with silver, and all the posts surrounding the courtyard had silver bands.

dag: So ni tooi baŋ saa ni kuri shɛm bee saa tahigu din yiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni na?.
en: No one can understand how he spreads the clouds out or how the thunder rumbles from his home in the sky.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi leei yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ bihi, dama ŋuna n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ neeri ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zaa zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka saa miri ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri tinsi ni.
en: If you do this, you will be children who are truly like your Father in heaven. He lets the sun rise for all people, whether they are good or bad. He sends rain to those who do right and to those who do wrong.

dag: Amaa Bɛzalɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Uri bia, ka nyɛ Hur yaaŋa la ni daa mali daanya sara maligu bimbini shɛl la din daa kpalim bela Gibiɔn Yawɛ biɛhigu shee la tooni, ka Naa Sulemaana mini zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni nimaani.
en: But the bronze altar that Bezalel, Uris son and Hurs grandson, had made was there in front of the LORDs dwelling, so that is where Solomon and the assembly worshipped.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka n wum li. N wum a yɛtɔɣa maa vuri.
en: I have heard you argue.

dag: Bimbira kpila tiŋgban ni, ka ti kambɔna kpalim zaɣ kuma, ka ti kunchuna zaa saɣim, dama ti chi zaa kuuya.
en: The seeds die in the dry earth. There is no grain to be stored, and so the empty granaries are in ruins.

dag: Pɔhim ni ti ʒe yi zuɣulaannim chaŋ, ka bɛ ti gbahi yi ni yuri shɛba leei daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka vi ti gbahi ya ka di gari ya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zaa zuɣu.
en: Your leaders will be blown away by the wind, your allies taken as prisoners of war, your city disgraced and put to shame because of all the evil you have done.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a yiko ni a niŋdi lala.
