en: They asked, What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority.

dag: Ka Firawuna suhu daa yiɣisi bah o tumtumdiba ayi bɛn daa nyɛ o wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm zuɣu.
en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief wine steward and the chief baker.

dag: Bɛ tibirila n niriba maa daŋa bɛ baɣa ka tibbu ka yɛra, Di mali soochi, di mali soochi. Ka soochi mi kani.
en: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka o lo ti alikauli kara din mali buchi ni di chɛ ka ti yi dunia ŋɔ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri din saɣindi ninsalinim la ni, ka ti min o laɣim mali Naawunitali biɛhigu.
en: Through his honor and glory he has given us his precious and wonderful promises, that you may share the divine nature and escape from the worlds immorality that sinful craving produces.

dag: N daa ko ʒiɛri puri mini tihi puri, ka tiwala balibu kam tihi be di ni.
en: I planted gardens and orchards, with all kinds of fruit trees in them;.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ sahakam mali alibarika, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu kpɛma ni nya mbusim.
en: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.

dag: ka tam o ni daa wuhi shihir shɛŋa Ijipti la mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni daa tum Zɔan mɔɣu ni la gba yɛla.
en: and performed his mighty acts and miracles in the plain of Zoan in the land of Egypt.

dag: Gol tuuli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni, di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pisiniyini dali zaawuni.
en: Begin on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month by eating bread made without yeast. Then continue this celebration until the evening of the twenty-first day.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino nya biɛhigu shee yi yidaannim yinsi. Ka Naomi daa chɛbisi ba ka ŋmaligi. Ka paɣiba ayi maa zaa dii kuhiri.
en: May the LORD provide for you so that you may find security, each woman in the household of her husband. Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices and wept.

dag: Ŋuna ka Naawuni tibigi n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo ni o leei ti toondana ni ti tiligira n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim niŋ tuuba ka nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa da jinjɛŋŋmaa maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa n-zaŋ li so.
en: So I bought a linen undergarment, as the LORD told me, and I put it on.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, Fom baalim ʒini zibisim ni, bɛ ku lan bol a zuliya kam paɣiba naa.
en: The Lord says to Babylon, Sit in silence and darkness; no more will they call you the queen of nations!.

dag: N yɛli ya ni yinyahi m-pooi ma, ka yi ti zaŋ doo ŋɔ na ni o ti tumd o yinyahili tuma ŋɔ n tooni? Doo ŋɔ ni tooi be n yili ŋɔ.
en: I have enough crazy people without your bringing another one here. Keep him away from my palace.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya pam ka diri ti shɛhira biɛɣu a sani; ti tumdi tuumbiɛri, ka mi ti daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Our rebellions are numerous in your presence; our sins testify against us. Our rebellions are with us; were aware of our guilt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord then told Moses.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya kam saria, ka chɛ ka niriba kpi n-yɛrigi bɛ tiŋgbana ni. O ni ti nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: He will pass judgment on the nations and fill the battlefield with corpses; he will defeat kings all over the earth.

dag: Amaa o tɔbu ku kabi, ka ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o nuhi mali kpiɔŋ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim gula, ka yihiri ba barina ni ŋɔ yuli zuɣu.
en: But his bow remains steady, And his arms are made strong By the power of the Mighty God of Jacob, By the Shepherd, the Protector of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni so bi labina ni o ti paɣi Naawuni shee tinzun nir ŋɔ kɔŋko.
en: Why is this foreigner the only one who came back to give thanks to God.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so cheechinim zaa ni luri sizuura o lahibal suŋ molo molibu zuɣu la n-dolisir o na.
en: With him we are sending the brother who is highly respected in all the churches for his work in preaching the gospel.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, m baŋya ni ʒilinsi zuɣu ka yi mini yi kpamba daa niŋ Yisa lala maa.
en: My brothers, I know that what you did to Jesus was done because you did not understand what you were doing. And your leaders did not understand any more than you did.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa darigi toog o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu so o shee ni n-kum o bia maa kuli dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Jacob was so sorry about his son that he tore his clothes. Then Jacob put on special clothes to show that he was sad. He continued to be sad about his son for a long time.

dag: Bɛ bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim, dama bɛ dɔɣi tinzun bihi. Pumpɔŋɔ yi gol paliga churi puhibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi puri zaa bahi yoli.
en: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord ; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ba lala maa ka kab laɣim taba; ka bɛ ni shɛb daa zo nti sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi voya ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi tampima lɔna ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi silisi ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi kɔbilisi ni.
en: Then they launched a strong attack against the Israelites, putting them in a desperate situation. Some of the Israelites hid in caves and holes or among the rocks or in pits and wells;.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n zaŋla duu tanzaa kuɣili sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din viɛli ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka ni chɛ ka duu tanzaa mali yaa. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku zo dabiɛm.
en: Because of these things, the Lord GOD says, I will put a rock—a cornerstone—in the ground in Zion. This will be a very precious stone. Everything will be built on this very important rock. Anyone who trusts in that rock will not be disappointed.

dag: Ka daa lan kpihim zaligu shɛli din mini di soya daa galindi ti ka kul nyari ti taali la n-daa zaŋ li kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-yihi li zaa bahi.
en: Because we broke Gods laws, we owed a debt—a debt that listed all the rules we failed to follow. But God forgave us of that debt. He took it away and nailed it to the cross.

dag: n yi niŋ ŋun ka ma taali zaɣ biɛɣu bee n yi niŋ n dima zaɣ biɛɣu ka di ka soli.
en: if I have repaid a friend with evil or oppressed a foe for no reason.

dag: ni yi ni ti tiligi m ba mini m ma ni m mabihi ni bɛ ni su shɛb zaa, ka fa ti nyɛviya kum ni bahi.
en: Spare the lives of my father, mother, brothers, and sisters, along with everything they own. Rescue us from death.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o kpamba, Yi bi mi ni ŋun nyɛ sapashin kpeeni ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ titali ka Izraɛlnim kɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: The king said to his officials, Don't you realize that this day a great leader in Israel has died?.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ bar so ŋun gbaya zaa kpi n-niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o kana ti bɔri soli ni bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: and some people came carrying a man on a mat because he could not walk. They tried to take him inside the house and put him in front of Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋm chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnima, ka di niŋ din pahi napɔŋ buyi.
en: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, Make knives from flint rocks and circumcise the men of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be dunia ni n-nyɛ:.
en: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba m-bala. Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: These are Benjamins descendants according to their clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa ŋɔ sa niŋ bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ biɛɣuni yaha; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ sa zaŋ Haman bidibisi pia la ti yili dari.
en: Esther said, If it pleases the king, please let the Jews in Susa do the same thing again tomorrow. Also, hang the bodies of Hamans ten sons on posts.

dag: M biɛhigu nyɛla ŋmahinli niriba pam sani, amaa nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee din mali kpiɔŋ.
en: You are my source of strength, so I have been an example to others.

dag: N Naawuni, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni; fam ma bɛn yiɣisi wuɣili n zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: Save me from my enemies, my God; protect me from those who attack me!.

dag: Di tam a dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛl la yɛla; a mi di tam bɛ ni na kul tahiri yɔri vu shɛŋa sahakam la gba yɛla.
en: Dont forget the voices of your enemies, the racket of your adversaries that never quits.

dag: Safaya kuɣa be tiŋgbani puuni, ka salima be di taŋkpazim ni.
en: Its rocks are the source for lapis lazuli; there is gold dust in it.

dag: ka yim zuɣu be nayili, ka yim zuɣu mi be tanzaa dunɔdal la gbini. Ka zama zaa mi kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.

dag: Dama ŋunkam zaa ŋubiri li ka nyuri li ka bi zahim baŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ yɛla gbinni, o ŋubiri li ka nyuri li bɔrila tibidarigibo tir omaŋa.
en: For if you do not recognize the meaning of the Lord's body when you eat the bread and drink from the cup, you bring judgment on yourself as you eat and drink.

dag: nyini n-daa chɛ ka a dabili ti yab Naa Dauda yaag o noli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni yɛli: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim jɛri suli tahira, ka zuliya kam tɔri jin yoya?.
en: Our ancestor David was your servant. With the help of the Holy Spirit he wrote these words: Why are the nations shouting? Why are the people planning such useless things?.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi gbahi ba, bɛ ni yo bɛ ni zu shɛli maa zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka bɛ fa bɛ yinsi nɛma zaa.
en: But if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold; he must give all the riches of his house.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni ka o yihi ma bɛn bi niŋ yɛda ka be Judia la nuu ni, ka n ni ti yɛn tum tuun shɛli Jɛrusalɛm la ti tiɣi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be nimaani la nini.
en: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.

dag: Zaadali Ninivenim ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama Anabi Jona ni daa yihi ba waazu la, bɛ daa niŋ tuuba; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Anabi Jona be kpe!.
en: The citizens of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it as guilty, because they changed their hearts and lives in response to Jonahs preaching. And look, someone greater than Jonah is here.

dag: N ŋmanila dikili, ka m biha ŋmani gaɣibihi. N nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka o nyari suhudoo.
en: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.

dag: Karimi saria n-ti ma nasara, lihimi din tuhi.
en: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa yɛl o, Niŋm a ni tɛhi ni shɛli viɛl a sani, kul guhim hal ka bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili. Yawɛ chɛ ka o yɛligu niŋ pali. Ka Hanna daa kpalim yiŋa m-mal o bia maa hal ka o ti ŋmaai bihili.
en: You know what's best, Elkanah said. Stay here until it's time to stop nursing him. I'm sure the Lord will help you do what you have promised. Hannah did not go to Shiloh until she stopped nursing Samuel.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina ti yɛli Yaakubu, Ti chaŋ a biɛli Iso sani, ka o zaŋ ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kanna ni o ti tuh a soli.
en: When the messengers returned, they told Jacob, We went to your brother Esau, and now he is heading this way with men.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tiliginsim yirila Yawɛ sanna, ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani bɛ wahala saha.
en: The Lord saves those who are good. When they have troubles, he is their strength.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daai di gooni din gil li la luhi, ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa gariti nimaani pɔhiri di wala?.
en: God, why did you pull down the walls that protect your vine? Now everyone who passes by picks its grapes.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa yɛdaniŋdib bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-doli Pita na la alahiziba bɛ ni daa nya ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu;.
en: The circumcised believers who had come with Peter were astonished that the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma, n ni garigi ba; n ni be bɛ sani bɛ muɣisigu nyabu saha, n ni tiligi ba ka ti ba jilima.
en: When my followers call to me, I will answer them. I will be with them when they are in trouble. I will rescue them and honor them.

dag: Wula ka a tah o ʒiishee ka yɛra, O ku garigi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛli.
en: So why do you challenge God to answer you?.

dag: Ka o daa ti nyu tihi maa wain kuli n-do o zaɣim o suɣili ni.
en: One day Noah made some wine. He got drunk, went into his tent, and took off all his clothes.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa yinima n-daa tahi ma kpe na, amaa Naawuni n-daa tahi ma na nti zaŋ ma leei Firawuna ba ni ŋun su o yiŋnim zaa fukumsi, ka lan zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa zuɣulana.
en: After all, you weren't really the ones who sent me here—it was God. He made me the highest official in the king's court and placed me over all Egypt.

dag: N kpuɣila n nuhi wuh a n-suhir a, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ ni bɔri kom shɛm la.
en: I lift up my hands to you in prayer; like dry ground my soul is thirsty for you.

dag: Ka Pool daa laɣisi dagansi na ti pa buɣim maa ni, ka gariŋga yi dari maa ni na buɣim maa tulim zuɣu n-kaai vil o nuu.
en: Paul gathered up a bundle of sticks and was putting them on the fire when a snake came out on account of the heat and fastened itself to his hand.

dag: Hal bɛ yi kari ya tahi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni laɣim ya nimaani n-zaŋ ya nimaani labisina.
en: Even if he has driven you to the far end of heaven, the LORD your God will gather you up from there; he will take you back from there.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Ti ka taali. O suhu bi lan yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn kari ya la saria, dama yi yɛliya, Ti bi tum alahichi.
en: you say, I am innocent; surely the Lord is no longer angry with me. But I, the Lord , will punish you because you deny that you have sinned.

dag: chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bidibis ayopɔin ti ti ka ti zaŋ ba chaŋ Gibiɔn nti ku ba Yawɛ zol la zuɣu ŋun Yawɛ tooni. Ka naa daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ ba tin ya.
en: hand over seven of his sons to us, and we will hang them before the LORD at Gibeon on the LORDs mountain. I will hand them over, the king said.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a. Ka bɔ ka ti lee ti yɛn nya di zuɣu.
en: Peter replied, Remember, we have left everything to be your followers! What will we get.

dag: Amaa Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Laribunim ni Ammɔnnim ni Ashidɔdnim ni daa wum ni Jɛrusalɛm goma maa mali me tuma chani tooni hal ka di voya piligi ŋaribu la, ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Sanballat, Tobiah, and the people of Arabia, Ammon, and Ashdod heard that we were making progress in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem and that the gaps in the wall were being closed, and they became very angry.

dag: Naawuni ni mali soli ti ba, ka yihi ba dabitim ni. Bɛ ni ti kabi dunɔdali n-dol li gari yi. Bɛ naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ maŋmaŋa ni ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: I will break down the gate and lead them out— then I will be their king.

dag: Dindali maa Siria naa maa ʒi tibisa ti ku lan tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu; n ni ti kab o naɣikɔra dapuhi din be yi nyiŋgoya ni la.
en: He will take away the troubles Assyria brought you—troubles that are like heavy weights carried with a yoke on your neck. But that yoke will be taken off your neck. The burden will be lifted from your shoulders.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa ʒi gbaridɔɣirili na nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa duno shɛli din yuli daa booni Duno Viɛlli la shee. Bɛ daa yi pun ʒir o la lala na nti sɔŋdi nimaani sahakam ka o maani bɛn kpɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bara.
en: Meanwhile, a man crippled since birth was being carried in. Every day, people would place him at the temple gate known as the Beautiful Gate so he could ask for money from those entering the temple.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Sin tiŋgban nɛli ni m-piri taba gbilligbilli n-chani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai Rɛfidim n-ti suɣa nimaani, amaa ka kom daa lee ka nimaani ka bɛ ni nyu.
en: The whole Israelite community broke camp and set out from the Sin desert to continue their journey, as the LORD commanded. They set up their camp at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli ba, Pa yi ni chani tin shɛli maa soli m-bɔŋɔ; pa yi mi ni chani tin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ. Doliya ma ka n zaŋ ya tahi yi ni bɔri so maa sani. Ka o daa zaŋ ba tahi Samaria.
en: Elisha said to the Aramean army, This is not the right way. This is not the right city. Follow me. I will lead you to the man you are looking for. Then Elisha led them to Samaria.

dag: Amaa a na kul duhirila amaŋa n niriba sani, ka zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: You are still determined not to let the Lord 's people go.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi ni doli Galili tiŋgbɔŋ polo. Ka o bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o be nimaani.
en: Jesus and his disciples left that place and went on through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where he was.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa, ka nam niɣi balibu kam zaa, ka nam binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa balibu kam zaa. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: So God made them all, and he was pleased with what he saw.

dag: Zuŋɔ gba n fabila maa lan kɔŋla tim. Di mini n ŋuhibu ŋɔ zaa yoli, Naawuni na kul pahiri ma la biɛrim.
en: I am still complaining today. I groan because God is still making me suffer.

dag: Jona ni daa piligi chani gindi tiŋ maa, o daa chanimi ka kuhiri yɛra, Di kpalim biɛɣ pihinahi ka Naawuni chɛ ka Ninive lɛb pili. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ti paai dahin yini chandi tariga.
en: Jonah went to the center of the city and began speaking to the people. He said, After days, Nineveh will be destroyed.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm yi nyɛla ʒiri amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni yɛlimaŋli zani ka o nya jilima, dindina wula ka o ni lan kari ma saria kaman alahichilana?.
en: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbibi ŋariŋtuurisi daa yi bɛ ŋarima ni na. Ka kpatoonsi mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa bɛn be teeku ni du nti ʒe duli.
en: Those entrusted with the oars desert their posts. All sailors and helmsmen seek footing on the shore.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la shiri niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni Naawuni yɛliya: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, These people will listen and listen, but never understand. They will look and look, but never see.

dag: kaman di ni daa sab ti Duuma zaligu ni shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ zaŋmi bidib tuuli kam ti ti Duuma Naawuni.
en: just as the Law of the Lord says, Each first-born baby boy belongs to the Lord.

dag: Ka o daa ti nyu tihi maa wain kuli n-do o zaɣim o suɣili ni.
en: He drank some of the wine, became drunk, and took off his clothes in his tent.

dag: Naa maa ni ti nyu sokpaŋ kulibɔŋ kom n-nya kpiɔŋ di nasara.
en: The king will drink from the stream by the road, and strengthened, he will stand victorious.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nir yi bɔri tiwal suma, faashee o malila ti suŋ; amaa o yi malila ti biɛɣu, tiwal biɛri ka o ni nya, dama bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni.
en: Either consider the tree good and its fruit good, or consider the tree rotten and its fruit rotten. A tree is known by its fruit.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ yi ni booni so Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ.
en: Pilate replied, Then what do you want me to do with the one you call king of the Jews.

dag: ka ŋun mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli m-buɣi doli ma gba bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: Those who do not take up their cross and follow in my steps are not fit to be my disciples.

dag: O ku deei sandaani sanyoo kam, o mi ku deei birapu, di yi kul galisi kabo.
en: He will not accept any payment; no amount of gifts will satisfy his anger.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa kpuɣ kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa, ka o ŋoli yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.

dag: A yɛliya, Mbusim be n zuɣu. Yawɛ zaŋ suhugarigu pahi m biɛrim zuɣu; n ŋuhirimi hal ti tarigi, ka bi nyari vuhim. .
en: You have said, I cant take it anymore! The LORD has added sorrow to my pain. Im worn out from groaning and can find no rest.

dag: A yi tahi kom maa zuɣu, di guurimi, ka a yi chɛ ka saa tahi, kom maa zɔrimi chana.
en: But you gave the command, and the water turned back. You shouted at the water, and it rushed away.

dag: ka yɛl o tumo, Cham ti lihi teeku polo. Ka o daa chaŋ ti lihi ka yɛli, M bi nya shɛli. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labimi yaha n-niŋ lala hal ti paai siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: He said to his assistant, Please get up and look toward the sea. So the assistant did so. He said, I dont see anything. Seven times Elijah said, Do it again.

dag: N ni ti ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri bɛn be kulisi ni, ka ninsalinim naba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha, ka niɣi takarifiɛma gba ku lan siɣi di ni yaha.
en: I will slaughter your cattle at every water hole. There will be no people or cattle to muddy the water any more.

dag: Chamiya gili Ziɔn zaa, ka kaliya di pihi la.
en: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa yi n-chaŋ labina ti yɛl o dana maa, N niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka palo na kul beni.
en: The servant said, Master, your instructions have been followed and there is still room.

dag: N zɔnim ni m mini bɛn doli bi lan miriti ma n yuma maa zuɣu; hal n ʒiʒiinitab gba kaɣiri ma mi.
en: My loved ones and friends keep their distance from me in my sickness; those who were near me now stay far away.

dag: Bɛ ti zaŋm li mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi. Mani n-zaŋ li ti ba ka di nyɛ bɛ tarili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti ma maa ni, di nyɛla binshɛli din be kasi zaa kaman alahichi sanyoo bee taali sanyoo sara la.
en: I have given this part of the grain offering as the priests share of the gifts offered to me. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy. It must not be baked with yeast.

dag: N ni lan chahi yi sarisi ŋɔ, ka fa n niriba bɛn be yi nuu ni maa bahi, ka bɛ ku lan be yi nuu ni n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn ku shɛba. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will tear off your veils and snatch my people out of your clutches. They will be prey in your clutches no longer. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Anyone who obeys God is my brother or sister or mother.

dag: Di tiŋli duu dunoli daa bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka nir ni tooi doli di dunɔdura ti kpe sunsuuni duu la puuni n-yi ni ti kpe du shɛli din pah ata ni.
en: The entrance to the bottom storage rooms was on the south side of the building, and stairs to the other rooms were also there.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba zaa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiwɛinaayi.
en: A total of descendants of temple workers and of Solomon's servants returned.

dag: ka di nyɛ o min o zuliya maligumaanitali alikauli ʒiɛmani kam ni, dama o zab nyuli ti o Naawuni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. .
en: It will be for him and his descendants a covenant of permanent priesthood, because he was jealous for his God and sought reconciliation for the Israelites.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti guli bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ gbarima ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman Dauda la. Ka Dauda zuliya maa ni ti gari tooni m-be kaman Yawɛ malaika la bee Naawuni maŋmaŋ la m-mali ba chana.
en: But the Lord will protect the people in Jerusalem. Even the man who trips and falls will become a great soldier like David. And the men from Davids family will be like gods—like the Lord s own angel leading the people.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka n sɔɣi. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti yɛri ma, Yiɣimi kaman nooŋa la n-chaŋ zoya zuɣu?.
en: I have taken refuge in the LORD. So how can you say to me, Flee to the hills like a bird.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: Each of them also had sons. Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei;.

dag: Tiŋgbani, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, amaa chɛ ka a suhu piɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli; dama Yawɛ tum tuun kara.
en: Dont fear, fertile land; rejoice and be glad, for the LORD is about to do great things!.

dag: bɛn daa yi Rubin zuliya ni na la daa ti zaŋ niriba mini Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri kɔbisiyi ni pihinu m-pa bɛmaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti va n-zani Musa tooni. Niriba maa daa nyɛla bɛ ni pii shɛba, ka bɛ nyɛ niriba ni mi shɛb yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: rose up against Moses, along with two hundred fifty Israelite men, leaders of the community, chosen by the assembly, men of reputation.

dag: So yi daa tum din tiri suhusaɣiŋgu, pa mani ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu, ka m mi bi bɔri ni n tibigi li, dama nir yi lihi di puuni, di nyɛla yi zaa ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu maa.
en: Someone in your group has caused sadness—not to me, but to all of you. I mean he has caused sadness to all in some way.

dag: Yi nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb o ni yu ka pii leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba. Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi zaŋ nambɔzɔbo mini nirilim niŋbu ni maŋsiɣisibutali ni tarimtali ni suɣilɔdibo kpɛhi yi tɛr ni.
en: God has chosen you and made you his holy people. He loves you. So your new life should be like this: Show mercy to others. Be kind, humble, gentle, and patient.

dag: Yawɛ, saha shɛli a yi ti niŋ a niriba nirilim, nyin teemi n yɛla; saha shɛli a yi ti tiligi ba, nyin sɔŋm ma.
en: Remember me, Lord , when you show kindness by saving your people.

dag: Ka Pita daa yɛl o, Ɛnias, Yisa Masia tib a; dinzuɣu yiɣisima m-mal a bindoo maa yɛrigi! Ka o daa dii vaai yiɣisi.
en: Aeneas, Peter said to him, Jesus Christ makes you well. Get up and make your bed. At once Aeneas got up.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Ŋun nyɛ kasi ŋɔ baŋbu tahiri tɛhi zilima na.
en: Respect and obey the Lord ! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ zuliyanim maa zaa zali ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Bɛnjamin zuliya.
en: Then Samuel brought all the Israelite tribes forward, and the tribe of Benjamin was selected.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣ o zɔnim dini, yurilim shɛl lan kani gari li.
en: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.

dag: Ka Musa daa pii asanza niriba Izraɛlnim maa puuni n-zaŋ ba leei niriba maa zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ shɛb su niriba tuhilituhili, ka shɛb su niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, ka shɛb su niriba pihinunu ka shɛb mi su niriba piapia fukumsi.
en: and chose capable men from among all the Israelites. He appointed them as leaders of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.

dag: Ka a ni tɛhi tɛhi viɛl shɛŋa ka taɣ ma zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka m bi tum taali so ʒim yihibu puuni bee n-zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuhi ŋɔ bɔhi biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu, a mali alibarika.
en: Thank God for your good sense and for what you have done today in keeping me from the crime of murder and from taking my own revenge.

dag: Kom koligu maa ni kom ni daa ti naai, ka o zaŋ bia maa ti sɔŋ tutuɣu gbini.
en: When the water was all gone, she left the child under a bush.

dag: Ka niriba chɛ solɔri dolibu, ka sochandiba chɛ so kara dolibu. Ka zɔtali saɣim, ka alikaulinim saɣim, ka so baɣa ka di yɛla ni.
en: The highways are so dangerous that no one travels on them. Treaties are broken and agreements are violated. No one is respected any more.

dag: Amaa ka o paɣ yɛl o, Naawuni yi di bɔri ti kubu, o naan ku deei ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti o ŋɔ ti nuu ni bee n-yɛl ti o ni yɛl ti yɛl shɛŋa ŋɔ bee n-wuhi ti o ni wuhi ti binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa.
en: But his wife answered, If the Lord had wanted to kill us, he would not have accepted our offerings; he would not have shown us all this or told us such things at this time.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: and made them work so hard.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka malaika maa kuri niriba maa, di saha ka o daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, n tum taali, Mani n-tum zaɣ biɛɣ maa, ka bɔ ka piɛri ŋɔ mi lee niŋ? Dinzuɣu n suhir a mi, darigim la m mini n daŋ niriba kɔŋko tibili.
en: David saw the angel killing everyone and told the Lord , These people are like sheep with me as their shepherd. I have sinned terribly, but they have done nothing wrong. Please, punish me and my family instead of them.

dag: Ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Wula ka o daa lee niŋ a? Wula ka o daa lee niŋ neeg a nina maa.
en: What did he do to you? they asked. How did he cure you of your blindness.

dag: Ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir maa mini Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la ni Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ayuba suhigu.
en: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord , and he answered Job's prayer.

dag: Ka so yi tah a ʒiishee nti deeg a binyɛrigu, nyin chɛ ka o deeg a chinchini gba pahi.
en: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika; ka o ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-leeg o niriba mali alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who have the Lord as their God! He chose them to be his own special people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe a yim, a gba ʒe ba la yim; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi, a wuhir o a gba ni ka galimi shɛm.
en: O Lord , you are faithful to those who are faithful to you, and completely good to those who are perfect.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan tim wɔribar so ŋun pah ayi, ka o tuhi ba soli nti yɛli, Naa ni n ti bɔh a nya Alaafee? Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim doli n nyaaŋa.
en: Another messenger was sent out, who asked Jehu the same question. Again Jehu answered, That's none of your business! Fall in behind me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka a ti timdi ni bɛ cham ti bɔhi Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la nya a ni kpaŋ bee a ku kpaŋ? Dinzuɣu a ku yiɣis a bariŋ bindo shɛli zuɣu a ni doya ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi.
en: Elijah told Ahaziah, This is what the Lord says: There is a God in Israel, so why did you send messengers to ask questions of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Since you did this, you will not get up from your bed. You will die.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di simdi ka yi teeri dabisili ŋɔ yɛla, di nyɛla yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛli ka yi dabitim bandi ni la, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu n-daa yihi ya nimaani maa. Di bi simdi ka yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi.
en: Moses said to the people, Remember this day. You were slaves in Egypt, but on this day the Lord used his great power and made you free. You must not eat bread with yeast.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ gili Jɛriko goma hal ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, ka goma maa lu.
en: By faith Jerichos walls fell after the people marched around them for seven days.

dag: Ka Yisa boli ba na ti bɔhi ba; Wula ka Sintani ni tooi kari Sintani? Ka ŋahi ba ŋaha yɛli.
en: So Jesus called them together and talked to them using some stories. He said, Satan will not force his own demons out of people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi bɔhim zuliya shɛb biɛhigu bee n-chɛ ka zuɣusaa shihira niŋ ya alahiziba, dama shihira maa niŋla zuliya shɛba alahiziba.
en: This is what the Lord says: Dont live like people from other nations. Dont be afraid of special signs in the sky. The other nations are afraid of what they see in the sky. But you must not be afraid of them.

dag: ni Ahiam ŋun daa nyɛ Sakar Harar nir la bia ni Ɛlifal ŋun daa nyɛ Ur bia la.
en: Ahiam son of Sacar the Hararite; Eliphal son of Ur;.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be sarika ni maa nya yolisim. Bɛ ku kpi, bindirigu mi ku pooi ba.
en: People in prison will soon be made free. They will not die and rot in prison. They will have plenty of food.

dag: N kul dolila a soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: I have followed your way. My feet never left your path.

dag: o yi doli n zaligunima, ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka ʒe yim, o nyɛla wuntizɔra, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and faithfully obeys my laws and teachings. This man is good, and I promise he will live.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kuhi pam yɛli, ŋmamiya tia maa luhi; ka ŋmahi di wula bahi; ka wɔbi di vari bahi; ka wɔbi di wala gba bahi. Karimiya biŋkɔbiri la di gbini ka kari noonsi la di wula maa zuɣu.
en: and shouted: Chop down the tree and cut off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Make the animals leave its shade and send the birds flying from its branches.

dag: chɛ ka a pɔhim biɛɣu doli ba lala, ka chɛ ka a sanʒiɛ titali kpɛhi ba dabiɛm!.
en: Chase them away with your blasts of wind; frighten them with your storms.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ bɛ sɔɣimi do n-gu ni bɛ di n nyɛvili; kpiɔŋlaannim taala duŋ bahi n zuɣu. Yawɛ, di mi pala n tuumbiɛri bee n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Look, powerful men are waiting for me. Lord , they are waiting to kill me, even though I did not sin or commit a crime.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali bidibisi. Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Jɛdiayɛl pa, ka Zɛbadia daa pah ata, ka Jatiniɛl pahi anahi;.
en: Meshelemiahs family: Zechariah the oldest, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth.

dag: Naftali tiŋgbani zaa mini Ifriim tiŋgbani ni Manaasa tiŋgbani ni Juda tiŋgbani zaa zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili polo teeku noli.
en: He showed him all the land of Naphtali, Ephraim, and Manasseh. He showed him all the land of Judah as far as the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Naawuni, di shini; Naawuni, di fo, a mi di kpalim ʒiya!.
en: God, dont be silent! Dont be quiet or sit still, God.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bindirigu mini kom tuhi Izraɛlnim soli na nti ti ba saha shɛli bɛ ni daa be soli chani la zuɣu. Amaa ka bɛ daa naɣ bula Balaam paa ni o yɛli nol ti Izraɛlnima, amaa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nol yɛlibu maa ŋmaligi leela alibarika.
en: This is because they hadnt met the Israelites with food and water but instead hired Balaam against them to curse them. Yet our God turned the curse into a blessing.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi yaannim Tɛra min o bihi Ibrahimma mini Nahɔr daa bela Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli kurimbuni ha n-jɛmdi buɣa.
en: Joshua said to all the people, This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, has to say: Long ago your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates River and worshiped other gods. One of those ancestors was Terah, the father of Abraham and Nahor.

dag: ni Kɔra ni Gatam ni Amalɛk. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ɛlifaz bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Ada yaansi.
en: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. These were all descendants of Esau's wife Adah.

dag: Naawuni Kundi bi yɛli ni Masia yɛn yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi Bɛtilihɛm din nyɛ Naa Dauda ya na la.
en: Didnt the scripture say that the Christ comes from Davids family and from Bethlehem, Davids village.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisinahi.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Zebulun was .

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pia dali, yin lomiya noli ka laɣim jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: The tenth day of this seventh month will be a holy occasion for you. You will deny yourselves and not do any work.

dag: N yuya ni yi baŋ ni timaŋ buɣisibu pala din nyaŋ ti.
en: But I hope that you will realize that we dont fail the test.

dag: Rɛhabia daŋ ni, ŋun Rɛhabia bidibisi ni, Ishia n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Isshiah was the oldest son of Rehabiah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Deemi suhuyiɣisili wain pipia ŋɔ n nuu ni n-chɛ ka n ni yɛn tim a zuliya shɛb sani ŋɔ zaa nyu li.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, said to me, Here is a wine cup filled with my anger. Take it to all the nations to whom I send you, and make them drink from it.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti paai yuun pihinu, bɛn chɛli di tuma maa tumbu.
en: and at the age of fifty he shall retire.

dag: Di chɛ ka kɔgbana lim ma bee n-chɛ ka kɔbulli di ma bee n-chɛ ka bɔɣ zilinli mum ma niŋ.
en: Dont let me be swept away by the floodwaters! Dont let the abyss swallow me up! Dont let the pit close its mouth over me!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri. O nyɛla ŋun zaŋ ʒiri ni o tum faranim barina, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka nandaamba kɔŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: A stupid person is evil and does evil things; he plots to ruin the poor with lies and to keep them from getting their rights.

dag: Miri ka a ʒiɛhi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo. Zom yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Dont go to the right or to the left, and you will stay away from evil.

dag: n yi yɛli gballi, M ba n-nyɛ a, ka yɛli zunzuli, M ma n-nyɛ a, bee, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a.
en: I might say to the grave, You are my father, and to the worms, my mother or my sister.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Yi mi ma, ka mi n ni shiri yi shɛl na? Pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka n kana; ka ŋun tim ma na maa mi nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa yi bi mi o.
en: While Jesus was teaching in the temple, he exclaimed, You know me and where I am from. I havent come on my own. The one who sent me is true, and you dont know him.

dag: Chibimi gooni voli bɛ ninni n-kahi a nɛma doli nimaani yi.
en: While they are watching, break a hole through the wall of your house and take your pack out through it.

dag: Ti ni daa kul wum li; ti suhuri zaa daa dii fuŋmi, ka suhukpeeni lan ka ti ni so suhu ni yi zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Naawuni.
en: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The people of Gad and Reuben answered, We promise to do what the Lord commanded.

dag: Ka n ni yɛn ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni maa zuɣu, n takɔbi ni yi di tɔɣu ni n-ku sokam bɛn be nudirigu polo mini nuzaa polo zaa.
en: In order to cut off the righteous and wicked from you, my sword will go out from its sheath against everyone from south to north.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn wurimla n ni daa me shɛli zali, ka vuɣi n ni daa sa shɛli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: But all over the earth I am tearing down what I built and pulling up what I planted.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa na kul kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ maa, ka Musa daa chaŋ miri Naawuni ni daa be sagban sabili shɛli ni maa.
en: But the people continued to stand a long way off, and only Moses went near the dark cloud where God was.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli pahi, Yisa ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa neei kum ni ka ti zaa leei di shɛhiranima.
en: This Jesus God raised up. We are all witnesses to that fact.

dag: Ti mabihi, zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna mini ti ni ti yɛn laɣim tuh o sol la yɛla polo, ti suhiri ya.
en: Brothers and sisters, we have a request for you concerning our Lord Jesus Christs coming and when we are gathered together to be with him.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Di ku lan yuui ka ŋun yɛn kana maa ku kpalim, ka shiri kana.
en: For, as the scripture says, Just a little while longer, and he who is coming will come; he will not delay.

dag: ka mali dapaɣa ayi niŋ di nyaaŋa lɔrisi la ni.
en: Make two additional boards for the dwellings rear corners.

dag: Isaka zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Azan bia Palitiɛl.
en: from the tribe of the Issacharites, a chief, Paltiel, Azzans son.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi gba di li shɛhira ti sani. Tuuli o daa yɛlimi:.
en: And the Holy Spirit also gives us his witness. First he says.

dag: Ka din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li ni suhupiɛlli, amaa ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka zahimbu yi ti paai ba, bɛ zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: Others are like the seed that fell on rock. That is like the people who hear Gods teaching and gladly accept it. But they dont have deep roots. They believe for a while. But when trouble comes, they turn away from God.

dag: Ka niriba ni be tin shɛŋa ni zaa ni ti kpalim tiŋ kuma. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinu.
en: There were men in the Kohath family group who were qualified to do this work.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa di nasara n-yɛligi gili luɣilikam.
en: In this powerful way the word of the Lord kept spreading and growing stronger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi n-laɣim gbaai soli kuni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi soli ha.
en: They started out together to go back to Judah, but on the way.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuui pam, di simdi ni bɛ mali suhupiɛlli di yuma zaa puuni, amaa di simdi ni bɛ teei ni zibisim saha dabisa ni ti galisi pam. Dinkam zaa niŋdi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Be grateful for every year you live. No matter how long you live, remember that you will be dead much longer. There is nothing at all to look forward to.

dag: Dama ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ mali n yuli tɔɣisiri maa. Pa mani n-tim ba na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They are telling you lies in my name. I did not send them. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛ ka binnɛma pam be kom ni, ka chɛ ka noonsi be zuɣusaa sagbana tiŋli yiɣiri gindi dunia ni.
en: God said, Let the waters swarm with living things, and let birds fly above the earth up in the dome of the sky.

dag: Yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba, miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmaai yimaŋa bee m-pini yi gbɛri yi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: People of Israel, you are the Lord 's children, so when you mourn for the dead, you must not cut yourselves or shave your forehead.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni daa ti yɛn giligi, ka Siria tɔbbihi daa lo tɔb na ti liri Naa Jɔash. Bɛ daa lirila Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-ku bɛ zuɣulaannim zaa, ka di nɛma n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti Damaskus naa.
en: That spring the Aramean army marched against Jehoash. They attacked Judah and Jerusalem, destroyed all the peoples leaders, and sent all the loot to the king of Damascus.

dag: N ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ sɔŋda; n ni lab yi sanna.
en: I wont leave you as orphans. I will come to you.

dag: O ni daa yuri yi yaannim la zuɣu ka o daa pii bɛ bihi bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka daa be yi sani n-yihi ya Ijipti na. O daa zaŋ o yiko.
en: And because he loved your ancestors and chose their descendants after them, God brought you out of Egypt with his own presence, by his own great power.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Those who have will receive more, but as for those who dont have, even what they dont have will be taken away from them.

dag: yɛli, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ tum alahiziba tuun karili ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nya li, ka ti ku tooi chihi li.
en: What shall we do with these men? they asked. Everyone in Jerusalem knows that this extraordinary miracle has been performed by them, and we cannot deny it.

dag: Ka niŋmiya tab nirilim, ka mali nambɔzɔbo biɛhigu, ka chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba Masia zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Instead, be kind and tender-hearted to one another, and forgive one another, as God has forgiven you through Christ.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni bi kpe m-me sara maligu bimbini maa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord , burning them completely on the altar.

dag: Ka Haman daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nam kpar shɛŋa a ni pun ye min amaŋmaŋ wɔribaro ni nam zuɣupiligu din ni zaŋ pili dilan na;.
en: So Haman said to the king, Heres what should be done for the man the king really wants to honor.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mini saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: There will be one Instruction for the native and for the immigrant who lives with you.

dag: Amaa nyamiya, m mini ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa n-laɣim ʒi teebuli gbini diri ŋɔ.
en: Jesus said, But here on this table is the hand of the one who will hand me over to my enemies.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n dabili Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.

dag: ka daa lan nyɛ bɛn dari gindi tinsi, n-kpe zuliya shɛli ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe zuliya shɛli ni ni n-kpe na so tiŋ ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe na so tiŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: They traveled around from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ ku wuhi ya ka yi tum bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa tiri bɛ buɣa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ti tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Then they cant teach you to do all the detestable things they did for their gods, with the result that you end up sinning against the LORD your God.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be o sani, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura na.
en: Then Jeremiah called together Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him. He also called all the other people together, from the least important to the most important.

dag: Ka Azaria mini Ɛzra ni Mɛshulam.
en: The following priests, blowing trumpets, marched next: Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam, Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah. Next came Zechariah, the son of Jonathan and grandson of Shemaiah.

dag: Bɛ ni voo li to ba ka di pili yi bɛ niŋgbuna ni. Ka di naŋgban dirili maa pili yi bɛ binsom ni; ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: Arrows stick through their bodies; the shiny points drip with their blood, and terror grips their hearts.

dag: Nyin Sulemaana n-su anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili maa, ka pukpariba maa mi su anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyiyi. Man malila mmaŋmaŋ dahalali wain tihi puu.
en: Solomon, you can keep your shekels. Give shekels to each man for the grapes he brought. But I will keep my own vineyard.

dag: O yɛliya, Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya, dama o ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋari ma ka sɔɣi zo, ka bi yɛli ma. N naan chɛbis a ni suhupiɛlli, ka ŋme goonjɛnim ka chaɣisi sayɛya ka yili yila niŋ a.
en: Why did you run away without telling me? If you had told me, I would have given you a party. There would have been singing and dancing with music.

dag: Yinim bɛn doli Yawɛ yɛligu ŋɔ, wummiya o ni yɛl shɛm. Yi niriba bɛn jɛn ya ka zaɣisi ya n zuɣu ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka Yawɛ wuh o yiko ni nyɛ shɛli ka di niŋ ya suhupiɛlli ka ti nya. Amaa bɛna n-yɛn di vi.
en: You who obey the Lord s commands, listen to what he says: Your brothers hated you. They turned against you because you followed me. Your brothers said, When the Lord shows his glory, then we will rejoice with you. But they will be punished.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun so yaha; miriya ka yi gbani n-jɛm tinzunnim wuni.
en: There must be no foreign god among you. You must not bow down to any strange deity.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli ba Yisa ni di yɛli ba shɛm la, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: They answered just as Jesus had told them, and the crowd let them go.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zani bɛ zaashɛhi n-zaŋ awa muna ata karim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ litaafi dabisili maa puuni, ka zaŋ awa muna ata kahigi bɛ daalahichi wuhi, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: They stood there for about three hours, and the people read the Book of the Law of the Lord their God. Then for three more hours they confessed their sins and bowed down to worship the Lord their God.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, yomiya suhupiɛlli vuri paɣi Naawuni.
en: Everything on earth, shout with joy to God!.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali, ka di nyɛla din yɛligir o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: On the seventh day, the priest must look at the person again. If the spot has spread on the skin, the priest must announce that the person is unclean. It is leprosy.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ nabihi bɛn daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo bɛ kpamba tuma.
en: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi niŋ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la zaa. Yi lan niŋ n gba ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Joshua said to them, Moses was the Lord s servant. You obeyed everything that Moses told you to do. And you also obeyed all of my commands.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Kamiyana ka ti chaŋ Giligal nti lan leei ti nam maa.
en: And Samuel said to them, Let us all go to Gilgal and once more proclaim Saul as our king.

dag: Di ni chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee? Ti zaa ti yɛn laɣimmi kpi.
en: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni maa biɛɣu pinaanahi dali, yin ti puhimiya Yaɣigari chuɣu, ka sokam ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the th day of the first month, you must celebrate the Passover. The Festival of Unleavened Bread begins at this time. It continues for seven days.

dag: Yi chɛ Naawuni zaligunima, ka dolila salinim kaya.
en: You have stopped following Gods commands, preferring instead the man-made rules you got from others.

dag: ni Bɛtigiligal ni Gɛba ni Azimavɛt polo na, dama yiliyiiniba maa daa mɛla bɛ tiŋkpansi gili Jɛrusalɛm.
en: also from Beth-hagilgal and from the region of Geba and Azmaveth, because the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa shɛli yɛla. Bɛ tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be.
en: None of the sins theyve committed will be remembered against them. Theyve done what is just and right, and they will live.

dag: Amaa dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi lan yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ maa ni o daɣiri ni yibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But if the disease spreads on the skin after the person has become clean.

dag: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa ka so bi lan mi o yɛla soli, luɣ shɛli neesim ni bemi kaman zibisim la. .
en: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.

dag: Ka Hur bia Rɛfaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi gba daa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti mi lee yɛn niŋ? Ka o yɛli ba, Di muɣisiriya niriba bee n-diri shɛhir kpɛma fari bɛ nɛma; ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣimi yi yɔri.
en: Some soldiers asked him, And what about us? What do we have to do? John told them, Don't force people to pay money to make you leave them alone. Be satisfied with your pay.

dag: Wummi nyaɣisim a ni yuri paɣ so sani a ni mali nyɛvili shɛli din ka buchi dunia puuni ŋɔ, dama dina n-nyɛ a biɛhigu min a dunia ŋɔ ni tuma wahala tarili.
en: Enjoy life with the wife you love. Enjoy every day of your short life. God has given you this short life on earth—and it is all you have. So enjoy the work you have to do in this life.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa fan ya bahi, dinzuɣu ka n zaani ya zaligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Remember, you were slaves in Egypt. And the Lord your God set you free. So that is why I am giving you this command today.

dag: ka di nyɛla ŋun Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli din so n-ti ti la zuɣu. Di daliri nyɛla, bɛ ku tooi mali be dɛde, ka pa ni Naawuni zaŋ ti mi pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: God planned something better for us. He wanted to make us perfect. Of course, he wanted those great people to be made perfect too, but not before we could all enjoy that blessing together.

dag: Ti Duuma yi di bi filim di dabisa maa, so naan ti ku tiligi; amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn nyɛ o ni pii shɛb la zuɣu, o filim di dabisa maa.
en: If the Lord hadnt shortened that time, no one would be rescued. But for the sake of the chosen ones, the ones whom God chose, he has cut short the time.

dag: Ti ni daa ti yiɣisi nimaani ti daa dolila so gɔŋ ti paai Rijium n-daa yi biɛɣu ka nudirigu polo pɔhim din daa sɔŋ ti pam yiɣisi ʒiɛra. Di daba ayi dali ka ti daa paai Putioli.
en: From there we sailed on and arrived in the city of Rhegium. The next day a wind began to blow from the south, and in two days we came to the town of Puteoli.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ yi be tiŋ maa ni, bɛ ni tooi tiligila bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya kɔŋko bɛ wuntitali zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even if those three men, Noah, Danel, and Job, were living there, their goodness would save only their own lives. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti darigi bɛnkam zaa kpahi yaɣi dunɔbia zuɣu mini bɛnkam zaŋ damli dambu ni ŋarili soya bo nɛma pali bɛ dan yiŋ la tibili.
en: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi yi nya n yura maa, yi ni yɛl o ni n lula bole o zuɣu.
en: Young women of Jerusalem, if you find the one I love, please say to him, She is weak with desire.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la, zaŋ labi Hamat polo, o ni daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ bini zal o Sulinsi tariga Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli luɣ shɛli la.
en: David defeated Zobahs King Hadadezer at Hamath, as he continued to establish his control along the Euphrates River.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa jɛmd a mi; bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a, bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a yuli.
en: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.

dag: Di saha Dauda daa bela bɛ ni me birini gili luɣ shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa shɛb daa be Bɛtilihɛm.
en: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress.

dag: Amaa yi yi taɣi yi suhuri ka zaɣisi wumbu ka birigi n-jɛmdi wuna.
en: But if your heart turns away and you refuse to listen, and so are misled, worshipping other gods and serving them.

dag: O daa lan mali bidibis anu, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Hashuba mini Ohɛl ni Bɛrɛkia ni Hasadia ni Jushabihɛsɛd, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu.
en: He had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa je a ka zaɣis a, ka so bi kpɛr a ni la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ ka a galisi ka mali jilima, ka lan chɛ ka a nyɛ luɣ shɛli suhupiɛlli ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: People hated you. You were left all alone with no one passing through. But I will make you great from now on. You will be happy forever and ever.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: The LORD said to me: What theyve said is right.

dag: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la, n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: The stone which the builders rejected as worthless turned out to be the most important of all.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti yili yila yɛl o ni yur o wain tihi pu shɛl la yɛla.
en: On that day the Lord will say of his pleasant vineyard.

dag: n-yɛra, Di niŋya dunia bee teeku bee tihi shɛli hal ka ti ti zaŋ bintabinda tabili ti Naawuni jɛmdiba gbiɛri zuɣu naai pɔi.
en: Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zo n-daŋ bɛ tooni nti du sinsabiga ni o nya o, dama Yisa daa yɛn dolila ni gari.
en: So he ran ahead and climbed up a sycamore tree so he could see Jesus, who was about to pass that way.

dag: Amaa ka Sihɔn daa zaɣisi ni Izraɛlnim di kpe o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari. O daa laɣimla o tɔbbihi zaa n-chaŋ Jahaz din daa be yɔɣu maa ni la nti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: But Sihon wouldnt allow the Israelites to cross his border. Sihon gathered all his people and went out to meet the Israelites in the desert. When he came to Jahaz, he attacked the Israelites.

dag: Ka Amazia nam yiko ni daa ti ba jila zaa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku o kpambal shɛb bɛn daa ku o ba la.
en: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.

dag: Ka kul doliya n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ n ni daa sab shɛŋa tin ya la. Kul doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: You must obey the rules, laws, teachings, and commands that he wrote for you. You must obey these things all the time. You must not respect other gods.

dag: Dama o daa lab me buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim la; ka lan lab me Baal mini Ashɛra bimbina zali kaman Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa niŋ shɛm la; ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi.
en: He rebuilt the local shrines that his father Hezekiah had torn down. He built altars for the god Baal and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah, just as King Ahab of Israel had done. And he faithfully worshiped the stars in heaven.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa yi bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi, ka di taali maa ʒi bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: If it is the entire Israelite community that has done something wrong unintentionally and the deed escapes the assemblys notice—but theyve done something that shouldnt be done in violation of the LORDs commands, becoming guilty of sin.

dag: Wɔribariba niŋdi shili, ka takɔbi chɛri piɣibpiɣib, ka kpana nyaɣisira. Ka bɛ ku niriba pam, n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ duyaduya. Kpiimba maa ka tariga, ka bɛ tuuri kpiimba maa.
en: Soldiers on horses are attacking, their swords are shining, their spears are gleaming! There are many dead people. Dead bodies are piled up—too many bodies to count. People are tripping over the dead bodies.

dag: Yawɛ tiligi Yaakubu zuliya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o yiko. Alizanda, yilimi yila. Tiŋgbani, yɛrimi saɣi. Zoya mini nyɔŋ puuni tia kam, yɛrimiya saɣi.
en: Skies, rejoice for what the Lord has done. Earth, shout for joy down to your deepest parts! Start singing, you mountains and all you trees in the forest! Yes, the Lord has saved Jacob. He has shown his glory by rescuing Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yili Naawuni paɣibu yilli naai, ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu.
en: After singing songs of praise, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni n kul lɔri nia ni n ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ yi ni shɛb ka bɛ niŋ Yisa yɛda kaman n ni pun niŋ shɛm bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb san la; amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa kul guri ma soli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: You must remember, my friends, that many times I have planned to visit you, but something has always kept me from doing so. I want to win converts among you also, as I have among other Gentiles.

dag: Yɛlim o ni o maam o ni ka mali shili gu, ka di zɔri dabiɛm. O mi di chɛ ka o suhu zɔhiri Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Aram bɛn suhu yiɣisi pam ka nyɛ bɛn ŋmani buɣim datɛhi ayi la zuɣu.
en: and say to him, Be careful and stay calm. Dont fear, and dont lose heart over these two pieces of smoking torches, over the burning anger of Rezin, Aram, and Remaliahs son.

dag: Bɛn pa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhuyiɣisili; hal o yi lo ba mihi gba, bɛ bi suhir o bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Those who are godless keep on being angry, and even when punished, they don't pray for help.

dag: Hal bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni tuma zuɣulaannim mini gomnanim ni kpambaliba ni bɛnkam zaa daa ʒe nam fukumsi zaashee daa sɔŋla Yɛhudianim maa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Mɔdɛkai.
en: In fact, all the provincial officials—governors, administrators, and royal representatives—helped the Jews because they were all afraid of Mordecai.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o tumtumda maa, Ti yi chaŋ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn ti o? Dama ti lan ka bindirigu ti koligu ŋɔ ni bee bɔ ka ti lee mali? Ti ka pin shɛli din ni ti Naawuni nir maa.
en: Saul said, How can we talk to the prophet when I don't have anything to give him? We don't even have any bread left in our sacks. What can we give him.

dag: Nina neesim chɛ ka nir suhu piɛla, ka lahibali viɛlli tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: Bright eyes give joy to the heart; good news strengthens the bones.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli ba, O ni daa na ne ka n lo noli ka kumd o zuɣu maa, n daa yɛlimi, Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni zo ma nambɔɣu ka chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: David said, While the baby was still living, I cried and refused to eat because I thought, Who knows? Maybe the Lord will feel sorry for me and let the baby live.

dag: Dama Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ti o niriba suhudoo, ka ni kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.

dag: Ka yihi di biŋkpam zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then he shall take all its fat and burn it on the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn wuhi ba mi, n ni wuhi ba n yaa mini n yiko, ka bɛ baŋ ni n yuli m booni Yawɛ.
en: So then, says the Lord , once and for all I will make the nations know my power and my might; they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa kul dolila o ba Asa soli ka bi birigi li. O daa kul tumdila din tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Like his father Asa before him, he did what was right in the sight of the Lord ;.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyo naɣisaa maa buɣim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka su kom; o gba ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: The one who burned the cow must also wash his clothes and pour water over himself, but he also remains unclean until evening.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam mini zugbini kpam ni biŋkpam din zaa be namanama ni ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina ayi mini di biŋkpam ni nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili.
en: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat on the inner parts, the fat covering of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yihi nandaamba bɛ nandahima ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ malibu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: But God raises the needy from their suffering; he makes their families as numerous as sheep!.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din daa lo ni di tahi nyɛvili na la, man sani di tahila kum na.
en: and I died. And the commandment which was meant to bring life, in my case brought death.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi deei Yawɛ daalikauli ni o nyɛ yi Naawuni ka yi ni dol o soli ka gbib o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka deeg o noli.
en: Today you have acknowledged the Lord as your God; you have promised to obey him, to keep all his laws, and to do all that he commands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sin tiŋgban nɛli maa ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Dofika.
en: They marched from the Sin desert and camped at Dophkah.

dag: Ka Jɔda daa nyɛ Jɔanan bia, ka Jɔanan nyɛ Riisa bia, ka Riisa nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl bia, ka Zɛrubabɛl nyɛ Shialtiɛl bia, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Nɛri bia.
en: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri.

dag: Ka ŋunkam po Naawuni jɛmbu duu pola di mini Naawuni ŋun be di ni maa.
en: and when he swears by the Temple, he is swearing by it and by God, who lives there;.

dag: Dauda daa yɛla zabba piɛl viɛlli kaman Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa mini baansi maa ni Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ baan kpɛm maa ni daa ye zabba shɛŋa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru lo o shee ni.
en: David wore a fine-linen robe, as did the singers, all the Levites who were carrying the chest, and Chenaniah, the leader of transportation. David also wore a linen priestly vest.

dag: Zakaria ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the other things that Zechariah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka Asa daa chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. Ka bɛ zaa daa zani bɛ tɔb gɔri ni Zɛfata din daa be Marɛsha la vinvamli ni.
en: Asa went out to fight against Zerah. Asas army got ready for battle in the Valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Mɛsopoteemia a ma ba Bɛtuɛl yiŋa nti kpuɣi a ma tizɔdoo Leeban bipuɣinsi ni yino niŋ a paɣa.
en: Go at once to your mother's father Bethuel in northern Syria and choose a wife from one of the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.

dag: Ka o daa kpɛri bɛ jɛmbu duri ni ti wuhiri ba, ka sokam zaa daa tibigir o pam.
en: He began to teach in the synagogues, and everyone praised him.

dag: Ka chɛ ka niriba maa zaa gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe nudirigu mini nuzaa polo zaa gili naa ka shɛb mi ʒe n-gili sara maligu bimbini la mini duu maa.
en: He stationed the men with drawn swords all around the front of the Temple, to protect the king.

dag: N daa tiligi ya Ijiptinim mini bɛnkam zaa daa nahindi ya nuu ni, ka kari ba ka zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: I rescued you from the Egyptians and from the people who fought you here in this land. I drove them out as you advanced, and I gave you their land.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Oi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ! Bɛ kul yɛrila n yɛla yɛra, Pa saliŋ lɔha ka o lɔhi maa? .
en: But I protested, Sovereign Lord , don't make me do it! Everyone is already complaining that I always speak in riddles.

dag: Dabisili maa ni ti bie pam! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la dali miriya. Di ni ti kana kaman zaɣ biɛɣu din yi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sanna.
en: What a terrible day! The day of the LORD is near; it comes like chaos from the Almighty.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni dɔɣirikpamba, yi mini yi mabihi zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-yi daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ti zali luɣ shɛli n ni mali ni n zaŋ li zal la.
en: He said to the Levites, You are the leaders of the Levite clans. Purify yourselves and your fellow Levites, so that you can bring the Covenant Box of the Lord God of Israel to the place I have prepared for it.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asiba ka Jɔnatan zaŋ bia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni kaman o mini Dauda ni daa pun tɔɣisi shɛm la.
en: In the morning, Jonathan went out to the field to meet David. He took a servant boy along.

dag: O ni ti zaɣisi binshɛɣukam ninsalinim ni jɛmdi mini ninsalinim ni lihi so Naawuni la; o ni ti duh omaŋ gari dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha; hal o ni ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti ʒini, ka yɛri ni o nyɛla Naawuni.
en: He is the opponent of every so-called god or object of worship and promotes himself over them. So he sits in Gods temple, displaying himself to show that he is God.

dag: Ka di mi pala bɛn zaa yi ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaan maŋa. Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Yisahaku zuliya n-yɛn nyɛ a yaan maŋa.
en: Not all of Abrahams children are called Abrahams descendants, but instead your descendants will be named through Isaac. .

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni pala din yi ti Ba Naawuni sanna, amaa di nyɛla din yi dunia ŋɔ ni na. Dina n-nyɛ: Niŋgbuŋ kɔre mini nini kɔre ni barinyubo dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: This is all there is in the world: wanting to please our sinful selves, wanting the sinful things we see, and being too proud of what we have. But none of these comes from the Father. They come from the world.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ, Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn kpɛm suɣili maa ni nti yiligi pateesa shɛli din yiliya la n-zaŋ li pili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: When its time to break camp, Aaron and his sons will enter and take down the screening curtain, and they will cover the chest containing the covenant with it.

dag: Saha paaya ni n nyɛvili leei sara maligu Naawuni sani; n dunia ŋɔ ni yibu saha miriya.
en: As for me, the hour has come for me to be sacrificed; the time is here for me to leave this life.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa vuhim yuuni maa ni ti niŋ bindira tin ya, yi mini yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba mini dɔbba ni yi ni bu shɛb paa ni san kam ŋun be yi sani.
en: Whatever the land produces during its sabbath will be your food—for you, for your male and female servants, and for your hired laborers and foreign guests who live with you.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni mali simdi la zuɣu, yi nya binshɛɣukam pam o zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣa mini baŋsim zaa.
en: who helps you speak and understand so well.

dag: Bɛ daa vihiya ni bɛ nya bɛ yuya be maligumaaniba yaannim yuya maa ni, amaa ka di daa kani. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa wuhi ni bɛ bi be kasi, ka yihi ba maligumaaniba ni.
en: These people searched for their family histories, but they could not find them. They could not prove that their ancestors were priests, so they could not serve as priests. Their names were not included in the list of priests.

dag: dama kaman zabigu ni zaani lɔŋni shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ba. Bɛ ni yɛl a, Dim ka nyu. amaa di bi paai bɛ puu ni.
en: Come on and have some more, he says, but he doesn't mean it. What he thinks is what he really is.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Jabɛshi bia Shallum daa di nam maa. O mi daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la gol yini Samaria.
en: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king.

dag: Bee miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye a kpee yili zuɣu bee o puu zuɣu bee o dabili ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa bee o naɣilaa bee o buŋa bee a kpee ni su binshɛlikam zuɣu.
en: Do not desire to possess anything that belongs to another person—not a house, a wife, a husband, a slave, an ox, a donkey, or anything else.

dag: O ni daa tuui me sara maligu bimbini zali luɣ shɛl la; nimaani ka Ibram daa jɛm Yawɛ.
en: where he had earlier camped and built an altar. There he worshiped the Lord .

dag: Bɛ niriba ayɔbu yuya ni pa kuɣ yini zuɣu, ka niriba ayɔbu la mi yuya pa kuɣ din la zuɣu, ka a ti chɛ ka di ti doli bɛ kpamli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: six names on one stone and the other six names on the other stone, in the order of their birth.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini n naɣ beni ka ti ni bɔri ni yi niŋ li pɔi ka ti naanyi saɣi, dina n-nyɛ: yi chɛ ka yi dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman tinima.
en: But we will let you marry her, if you and the other men in your tribe agree to be circumcised.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni na be ŋɔ, biribu saha mini chɛbu saha ni maasim saha ni tulim saha ni shɛɣu saha ni kikaa saha ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kul ni beni.
en: As long as the world exists, there will be a time for planting and a time for harvest. There will always be cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Ijipti na. O daa nyɛla sana m-be nimaani luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Ham la.
en: Then Israel came to Egypt. Jacob lived there in Hams country.

dag: Molimiya Naawuni yiko yɛla; ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa, ka o yiko be sagbana ni.
en: Recognize how strong God is! His majesty extends over Israel; his strength is in the clouds.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A good tree doesnt produce bad fruit, nor does a bad tree produce good fruit.

dag: Di lan sab yaha: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa, paɣimiya ti Duuma, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa paɣ o.
en: And again, Praise the Lord, all Gentiles; praise him, all peoples.

dag: N ka galimi, m baɣa kani. M bi lan bɔri n nyɛvili.
en: I am innocent, but I dont know what to think. I hate my own life.

dag: Ka Aduna daa kpuɣi Aminadab bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa nyɛ Nashɔn tizɔpaɣa ka o yuli booni Ɛlishɛba la, ka o daa dɔɣi Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron married Elisheba. She was the daughter of Amminadab and the sister of Nahshon; they had four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; di chɛ ka ninsalinim yaa gari a yaa! Chɛ ka zuliya kam ka a sanna ka a ti kari ba saria.
en: Get up, LORD! Dont let people prevail! Let the nations be judged before you.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ ti paai di yuma anu saha, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa kana ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: In the fifth year of Rehoboam's reign King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

dag: Di kari ma a sani bahi, a mi di yih a shia kasi n ni.
en: Please dont throw me out of your presence; please dont take your holy spirit away from me.

dag: Ka zaŋya taaŋkɔro tim ʒi shɛli yi ni taɣi niŋ taha ni zali la ni n-zaŋ vie yi dunoya zuɣusahi mini dunɔpaɣira, ka di chɛliya ka so doli dunoli maa yi hal ni asiba.
en: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it into the blood that is in the bowl, and touch the beam above the door and the two doorposts with the blood in the bowl. None of you should go out the door of your house until morning.

dag: Deem o wuhibu din yir o nol ni na, ka zaŋ o yɛligu niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila bɛ nyaansi biri ma ka pa bɛ tooni. Hal n ni daa kul wuhiri ba sahakam maa zaa yoli, bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum wuhibu ka deei saɣisigu.
en: They should have come to me for help, but they turned their backs to me. I tried to teach them again and again, but they would not listen to me. I tried to correct them, but they would not listen.

dag: Dim a bindira ni suhupiɛlli, ka nyum a wain ni suhupiɛlli, dama Naawuni pun saɣi ti a ni niŋdi shɛm maa ka di waɣa.
en: So be happy and enjoy eating and drinking! God decided long ago that this is what you should do.

dag: Chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa nyin Naawuni sani sahakam. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali kul gul o.
en: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.

dag: Bindirigu mini kom kɔŋko zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ lihiri taba ni suhuzɔhibo, ka bahi yoli bɛ tibidarigibo maa puuni.
en: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: For your own sake, be very careful to love the LORD your God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tahi pina pam na nti ti ti. Ka ti daa ti yɛn yiɣisi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, ka bɛ zaŋ ti ni bɔri shɛlikam niŋ ti ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: The people were very respectful to us, and when we sailed, they gave us everything we needed.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu. Ka bɛ yi bi nya n-di n-tiɣi, bɛ ŋumdimi.
en: They roam around looking for food, but even if they eat their fill, they still growl and complain.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Duuma; n ka bin sun shɛli pahila nyini.
en: I say to the Lord , You are my Lord; all the good things I have come from you.

dag: Ka kuhigu pam ni ti be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ yaha.
en: Then a terrible cry of agony will echo through the whole land of Egypt unlike any heard before or that ever will be again.

dag: nti zaŋ Izraɛlnim ni daa zaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma maa ti ba. Ka niriba maa daa na kul zaŋdi pina na ni bɛ suhuyubu asiba kam nti tir o.
en: They received from him all the offerings which the Israelites had brought for constructing the sacred Tent. But the people of Israel continued to bring Moses their offerings every morning.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaana Azaria daa zaŋ Yawɛ maligumaaniba pihinii bɛn mali suhukpeeni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ doli Naa Uzia kpe.
en: Azariah the priest, accompanied by eighty strong and courageous priests, followed the king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va bɛ kɔba ti sɔɣi Jabɛshi tiŋ puuni tamarisik tia gbini, ka lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: Later, they buried the bones of Saul and his three sons under the big tree in Jabesh. Then the people of Jabesh showed their sadness—they did not eat for seven days.

dag: Yisifu mini Mariama ni daa niŋ ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛlikam zaa naai maa, ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ ya Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After Joseph and Mary had done everything that the Law of the Lord commands, they returned home to Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam yɛla pala yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla yiko yɛla.
en: For the Kingdom of God is not a matter of words but of power.

dag: Niŋmiya ma yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba gba be n ni; ka di yi pa lala, yin niŋmiya ma yɛda n tuma zuɣu.
en: Trust me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me, or at least believe on account of the works themselves.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri ya, ka gbib o ni daa po yi yaannim pɔri shɛl la zuɣu ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n yihi ya dabitim ni, ka fan ya Ijipti naa Firawuna nuu ni bahi maa.
en: But the Lord loved you and wanted to keep the promise that he made to your ancestors. That is why he saved you by his great might and set you free from slavery to the king of Egypt.

dag: Di daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo maa hal ti paai Akirabim n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Zin n-kul zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo maa hal ni Kadɛshibarinia n-zaŋ ti gari Hɛzirɔn m-mali ti paai Adda ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ Karika.
en: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Ahaz yaha.
en: Again the LORD spoke to Ahaz.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o lan yi o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn daa be sol ni kuni bɛ ya zuɣu.
en: Later, Jesus appeared in another form to two disciples, as they were on their way out of the city.

dag: Zibisim shɛli kani bee bumbɔni, ka alahichinim ni tooi sɔɣi di ni.
en: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.

dag: Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa mini bɛ tab bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la ni daa wuhi tab shihirili shɛli nyɛla ni bɛ yi ti nya ka nyɔhi yiɣisi mɔni tiŋ maa puuni.
en: The main Israelite army and the men in hiding had arranged a signal. When they saw a big cloud of smoke going up from the town.

dag: N kɔŋko n-daa kul kpalim be nimaani n-lihiri alahiziba ʒii maa. Ya buriginli daa lan ka n ni, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi hal ka so ku lan tooi baŋ ni mani m-bala gba.
en: So I was left alone to see this great vision all by myself. All my strength left me. My energy was sapped, and I couldnt stay strong.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Ɛlizabɛt, So ka yi zuliya ni ka o yuli booni Jɔn.
en: The people said to Elizabeth, But no one in your family has that name.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu, ka Ilaisha lab Giligal na. Ka anabinim daa ti ʒi o sani, ka o yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm duɣ titali tam n-duɣi ʒiɛri ti anabinim ŋɔ.
en: Elisha went to Gilgal again. There was a famine in the land. The group of prophets was sitting in front of Elisha. Elisha said to his servant, Put the large pot on the fire, and make some soup for the group of prophets.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Neetan, N tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ka Neetan garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ chɛ a taali maa, a ku lan kpi.
en: Then David said to Nathan, I have sinned against the Lord . Nathan said to David, The Lord will forgive you, even for this sin. You will not die.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri gba daa zo ka chɛ niriba pam ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia! Alizin biɛri maa daa mi ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia, dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa tahiri bɛ zuɣu ka bi tiri ba soli ni bɛ yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: Demons also came out of many people. They screamed, You are Gods Son. But he spoke harshly to them and wouldnt allow them to speak because they recognized that he was the Christ.

dag: Bɛ mi ma ka di yuui, ka hal bɛ yi ni saɣi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mi ni n daa doli Farisiinim daadiini soli din dolibu kpɛm pam la.
en: They have always known, if they are willing to testify, that from the very first I have lived as a member of the strictest party of our religion, the Pharisees.

dag: O daa yɛli Hagai ni o bɔhim Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba zuɣulana ni niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: He told Haggai to speak to Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah, to Joshua, the High Priest, and to the people, and to say to them.

dag: Ka o ma daa ŋmaligi yɛli yili maa ni bihi, O yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛlikam, yin niŋmiya li.
en: His mother said to the servants, Do what he tells you.

dag: Di saha ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka di ti mii. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, malimi shɛlikam shili zali, dama a ku lan yiɣisi, a ni kpi.
