en: At about that time Hezekiah became deathly sick. The prophet Isaiah, Amozs son, came to him and said: The LORD God says this: Put your affairs in order because you are about to die. You wont survive this.

dag: Kalim Lɛvinima kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm dɔbba bɛn nyɛ kaman gol yini zaŋ chana.
en: to register the Levites by clans and families, enrolling every male a month old or older.

dag: Yoomiya tiŋ maa dunoya, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛli din niriba nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka ʒe yim ŋɔ gari kpe.
en: Open the city gates and let the faithful nation enter, the nation whose people do what is right.

dag: O daa yihi ma na ti zali pal tital ni. O daa fa ma bahi, o nini ni daa tiɣ ma la zuɣu.
en: He helped me out of danger; he saved me because he was pleased with me.

dag: A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, a ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ ku chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: In fact, you might save their lives.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ, Izraɛlnim bi saɣiri ŋubiri binsakpuɣu zuɣu nimdi, doo maa ni daa shihi Yaakubu sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: So even today, the people of Israel dont eat the muscle that is on the hip joint, because this is the muscle where Jacob was hurt.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia; Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: The fig tree teaches us a lesson: When its branches become green and soft, and new leaves begin to grow, then you know that summer is very near.

dag: ka zaŋ tani n-yirigi pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka kpuɣi binshɛli din yɛn pili suɣili maa pil li kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: After that Moses put the outer tent over the Holy Tent. Then he put the covering over the outer tent. He did these things just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Di saha ka Neetan daa bɔhi Sulemaana ma Batishiiba, A bi wum ni Hagit bia Adɔnija leei naa, ka ti dan Dauda ʒi di yɛla?.
en: Then Nathan went to Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and asked her, Haven't you heard that Haggith's son Adonijah has made himself king? And King David doesn't know anything about it!.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, di zaligu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the law of the sacrifice of fellowship offerings that you bring to the Lord :.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun shihi lala bini maa ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ku di binyɛr kasinim la, faashee o su kom.
en: Any priest who becomes unclean remains unclean until evening, and even then he may not eat any of the sacred offerings until he has taken a bath.

dag: Samarianim naa ni ti bahi yoli kaman tipɔɣu din pa kom zuɣu la.
en: Their king will be carried off, like a chip of wood on water.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sandaantimdiba mal alibarika, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti boli ba o bihi.
en: Happy are those who work for peace; God will call them his children!.

dag: Yi yi du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zuɣu, wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari n dan sapashinnim ni ŋun pɔri gba.
en: But even then, you couldnt beat even one of my masters lowest ranking officers. So why do you still depend on Egypts chariots and horse soldiers?.

dag: dindina di simdi ka dilan pini. Amaa o di pini dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yili yilli ŋɔ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yɛli, Ti tiŋ ŋɔ mali yaa! Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun guli di goma!.
en: A day is coming when the people will sing this song in the land of Judah: Our city is strong! God himself defends its walls!.

dag: Nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka yi labisi puu maa ti bɛ ni daa da li ninvuɣ so sani maa, ŋun daa su li, ka di nyɛla o di li la fali maa.
en: At the year of Jubilee, the land will go to the family that originally owned the land.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n-dol a ni doli so shɛli kana. .
en: The Lord warned me not to eat or drink or to go home the same way I came.

dag: Bee n yi chɛ ka alɔbo lu di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka n suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni n ku ba, ka n kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: Or I might send a disease against that country. I will pour my anger down on the people. I will remove all the people and animals from that country.

dag: Nyaandol maa n-nyɛ ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira ni ŋun sabi dimbɔŋɔnim ŋɔ, ka ti mi ni o shɛhira maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: He is the disciple who spoke of these things, the one who also wrote them down; and we know that what he said is true.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N ku dol a kuli bee n-kpe a yiŋa bee n-di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom kpe;.
en: But the prophet from Judah answered, I can't go home with you or accept your hospitality. And I won't eat or drink anything with you here.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ n-saɣim bɛ nanim yinsi.
en: We'll attack by night; we'll destroy the city's fortresses.

dag: Ka Adɔnija ŋun daa nyɛ Hagit bia la daa ti duh omaŋa n-yɛli, N ni leei naa; ka daa bo chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba pihinu ni bɛ be o tooni.
en: Adonijah, Haggiths son, bragged about himself and said, Ill rule as king myself. He got his own chariot and horses with fifty runners to go in front.

dag: N zahimya ni ti ni diri wahala shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ bi saɣi shɛli ni ti zaŋ li buɣisi jilima shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn ti ti la.
en: I consider that what we suffer at this present time cannot be compared at all with the glory that is going to be revealed to us.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mali sariakaribo nyolɔrigu viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni yɛn she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm, di simdi ka a ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: Make an embroidered chest pendant used for making decisions. Make it in the style of the vest, using gold, blue and purple and deep red yarns, and fine twisted linen.

dag: Ka n daa lan yɛli ba n Naawuni nuu ni pa n zuɣu shɛm mini naa ni daa yɛli ma shɛm yɛla. Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, Chɛliya ka ti yiɣisi piligi di mɛbu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kpalanzuya gbini taba.
en: I also told them that my God had been kind to me. I told them what the king had said to me. Then they answered, Lets start to work, now! So we began this good work.

dag: Man kul ku lihi yaɣi bɛ so zuɣu bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ tuma maa ʒili ba.
en: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.

dag: N kahig a yuli wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb a ni zaŋ ti ma dunia ŋɔ ni la; nyini n-su ba ka daa zaŋ ba ti ma, ka bɛ mi deeg a yɛligu.
en: You gave me some people from the world. I have shown them what you are like. They belonged to you, and you gave them to me. They have obeyed your teaching.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini Masia ni laɣim neei kum ni la zuɣu, bomiyala binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni Masia ni ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo luɣ shɛl la.
en: You were raised from death with Christ. So live for what is in heaven, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God.

dag: O zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka kul zaŋ o nina kpa n soya zaa.
en: He binds chains on my feet; he watches every move I make.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lo ni a niŋ Naawuni niriba zaɣ biɛɣu? Dama naa yi bi chɛ ka o bia ŋun be yɔɣu la labina yaha, dindina naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din gbaag omaŋmaŋa.
en: The woman said: Haven't you been hurting God's people? Your own son had to leave the country. And when you judged in my favor, it was the same as admitting that you should have let him come back.

dag: ka bɛ nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni.
en: from to years old, all who are eligible for service to do the work of the meeting tent.

dag: N kul ku tam a zaligunim maa yɛla; dama di zuɣu ka a ti ma nyɛvili.
en: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ti ŋmanila yaɣiri a sani, ka a mi ŋmani yaɣimɛra. Ti zaa nyɛla a ni zaŋ a nuhi nam shɛba.
en: You, Lord , are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba mini bɛn zaa daa be nimaani maa, Yi zaa di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n da Ɛlimɛlɛk min o bidibis ayi Kiliɔn ni Malɔn ni su binshɛɣukam zaa Naomi sani.
en: Then Boaz said to the leaders and all the others there, You are all witnesses today that I have bought from Naomi everything that belonged to Elimelech and to his sons Chilion and Mahlon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm yaɣi ti ni tɛhi ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu: Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋa n-ti ti Duuma ka naanyi zaŋ bɛmaŋa n-ti ti gba Naawuni yubu puuni.
en: They even exceeded our expectations, because they gave themselves to the Lord first and to us, consistent with Gods will.

dag: Amaa alizanda ni Jɛrusalɛm la nyɛla bilichina. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ma.
en: But the heavenly Jerusalem that is above is like the free woman, who is our mother.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leela dabiɛm shee, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li sahakam. Bɛnkam zaa gari nimaani, dabiɛm gbahi ba mi ka bɛ viini bɛ zuɣuri.
en: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.

dag: amaa hal yi zabigu zaɣ yini gba ti ku bɔrigi.
en: But not a single hair from your heads will be lost.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaana Azaria daa zaŋ Yawɛ maligumaaniba pihinii bɛn mali suhukpeeni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ doli Naa Uzia kpe.
en: The priest Azariah, accompanied by eighty other of the LORDs courageous priests, went in after him.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn teei do wɔbinyina gariti zuɣu, ka zaŋdi piɛla kara mini yi naɣikpahi ni naɣila kara n-kɔriti puhiri churi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: How terrible it will be for you that stretch out on your luxurious couches, feasting on veal and lamb!.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti neei bɛ nina, ka gbilisi bɛ tiba wum niriba yɛlimuɣisira.
en: Their eyes and ears will be open to the needs of the people.

dag: amaa bɛ ku chaŋ tooni, dama sokam ni nya bɛ jɛritali tuma kaman bɛ ni daa nya niriba ayi ŋɔ jɛritali tuma shɛm la.
en: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out.

dag: O daa yi kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla puri ni bee tiŋkpansi ni bee fɔntinsi ni, bɛ ʒirila barinim na nti sɔŋdi di dahi ni, ka suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shihi o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: Wherever he went—villages, cities, or farming communities—they would place the sick in the marketplaces and beg him to allow them to touch even the hem of his clothing. Everyone who touched him was healed.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan labina nya ka o nyaandoliba maa lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa wum ba pam, ka bɛ daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm.
en: But when he returned to the disciples, he found them sleeping again. They simply could not keep their eyes open, and they did not know what to say.

dag: Ka Balak yɛl o, Kamina ka ti chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo a ni yɛn nya ba; a ku tooi nya bɛ zaa, a kul ni nyala bɛ ni shɛb kɔŋko; ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, Come with me to another place from which you can see only some of the Israelites. Curse them for me from there.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o luɣ kasi shee yɛli, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm; ka zaŋ Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: From his sanctuary God has said, In triumph I will divide Shechem and distribute Sukkoth Valley to my people.

dag: Zaŋmiya biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yini naŋgbambili, ka lan zaŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pahi ayi la gba naŋgbambili.
en: Make fifty loops on the edge of the outer curtain in one set and fifty loops on the edge of the outer curtain in the second set.

dag: Dinzuɣu, nyini daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi kul wum yɛtɔɣ shɛli n noli ni saha shɛlikam, nyin zaŋmi li kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: Now, mortal man, I am making you a lookout for the nation of Israel. You must pass on to them the warnings I give you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ ti zani baɣil o n-ku o, ka pilig o zuɣupiligu din be o zuɣu ni, ka lan pirigi baŋ din be o nuu ni na, dama n daa baŋya ni o ni lu n-doya shɛm maa, o ku lan gali. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o nɛma maa na ni n ti ti nyini n dana.
en: So I went over to him and killed him, because I knew he couldnt survive after being wounded like that. I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and Ive brought them here to you, my master.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka tɔbbihi maa chɛ Pool ti wɔribariba la ni bɛ zaŋ o tahi, ka bɛn daa ŋmaligi lab bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: The next day the foot soldiers returned to the fort and left the horsemen to go on with him.

dag: Di tamya saamba saani niŋbu yɛla, dama shɛb daa niŋdi saani lala hal ti niŋ malaikanim saani ka bi baŋ ni malaikanim m-bala.
en: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa puri zaa n-ti Firawuna; dama Ijiptinim zaa daa zaŋla bɛ puri kɔhi, kum maa ni daa mii ba pam maa zuɣu. Ka puri maa daa leei Firawuna dini.
en: The famine became so severe that Joseph finally bought every piece of land in Egypt for the king.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka bol li, Yawɛ nyɛla suhudoo. Ka di na kul ʒe Ofira Abiɛzanim ni su luɣ shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Gideon built an altar there to worship the Lord and named it The Lord is Peace. It still stands in the city of Ophrah, where the Abiezer family lives.

dag: Di saha maa Ibrahimma mini Zara zaa daa kurigiya pam hal ka Zara bi lan nyari sɔrilim gba.
en: Abraham and Sarah were very old. Sarah was past the right age for women to have children.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi gba lala.
en: Then loops of blue cloth were put along one of the wider sides of each curtain, and the two curtains were fastened together at the loops with gold hooks.

dag: Amaa ka Hadad daa be Ijipti maa ka ti wum ni Dauda min o sapashin kpɛm Jɔab zaa kpiya, ka o daa yɛli Firawuna, Tim ma soli ka n lab kuli n ya.
en: While in Egypt, Hadad heard that David had lain down with his ancestors and that Joab the general was also dead. Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me go to my homeland.

dag: Yawɛ, labisim ti na kaman saa ni miri n-zaŋdi kom na ti niŋdi Nɛgɛb mɔɣ kuma ni shɛm la.
en: Lord , make us prosperous again, just as the rain brings water back to dry riverbeds.

dag: Ka Maligumaaniba daa mali me Wɔhu Dunɔdali zuɣusaa polo. Sokam daa mali mɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋ tooni.
en: A group of priests built the next section, going north from the Horse Gate, each one building in front of his own house.

dag: M mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma ni. Di pala yɛl tibisili n sani ni n lab sabi n ni daa pun sab yɛl shɛŋa tin ya la n-lan tin ya, dama di nyɛla din ni gbibi ya.
en: So then, my brothers and sisters, be glad in the Lord. Its no trouble for me to repeat the same things to you because they will help keep you on track.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol la ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o yih o daɣiri ni dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali.
en: On the eighth day, that person will bring these things to the priest at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. These things will be offered before the Lord so that the person can become clean.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛli ba o ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa saha shɛli Baruk ni daa karindi gbaŋ maa ka niriba maa wumdi maa.
en: Micaiah told them what he had heard Baruch read to the people.

dag: dama ŋun nyɛ yikolana ka o yuli nyɛ kasi ŋɔ tum ma tuun kara.
en: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.

dag: M be a sani, ka so ku tooi niŋ a shɛli, dama m mali niriba pam tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Im with you and no one who attacks you will harm you, for I have many people in this city.

dag: Keenan nir ŋun daa nyɛ Arad naa m-be Nɛgɛb ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim dolila Atarim polo kanna, ka o daa chaŋ ti ŋme ba tɔbu, ka gbahi bɛ shɛba ti leei daba.
en: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who ruled in the arid southern plain, heard that the Israelites were coming on the Atharim road, he fought against Israel and took some of them captive.

dag: N kul tɛhirila di yɛla sahakam ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: I think of it constantly, and my spirit is depressed.

dag: Naawuni Kundi bi yɛli ni Masia yɛn yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi Bɛtilihɛm din nyɛ Naa Dauda ya na la.
en: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ jaaŋgbee ŋme o dabipaɣ bee dabidoo ka o kpi o nuu ni, bɛn darigim o tibili.
en: Death is the punishment for beating to death any of your slaves.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa boli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yɛl o:.
en: The Lord called to Moses from the Tent of the Lord 's presence and gave him the following rules.

dag: Karimbaannim bari ma la tɔŋ, ka teei bɛ mihi sɔŋ kaman laŋ la, bɛ bari ma la zana soli zuɣu.
en: Arrogant people have laid a trap for me with ropes. Theyve spread out a net alongside the road. Theyve set snares for me. Selah.

dag: Zuliya shɛli na mi n-taɣi bɛ wuna, hal bɛ ni kul pa Naawuni maa zaa? Amaa n niriba bɛn zaŋla binshɛli din ka nyɔri taɣi bɛ jilima.
en: Has any nation ever stopped worshiping their old gods so that they could worship new gods? No! And their gods are not really gods at all! But my people stopped worshiping their glorious God and started worshiping idols that are worth nothing.

dag: Di saha ka buɣim daa yi Yawɛ sanna ti di ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu bɛn daa tuɣili tulaale zim maa.
en: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire that burned up the men who had offered incense to him.

dag: Uzia daa lan me du wɔɣila zali Jɛrusalɛm goon gɔŋ dunɔdal la polo mini vinvamli dunɔdali ni malaika dunɔdal la polo zaa, ka mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: He built towers in Jerusalem, at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and at the Angle, and reinforced them.

dag: ni chuɣu dali binyɛra ni binyɛr shɛŋa din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni binyɛr kara ni nuhi ni kolibihi.
en: the robes and capes; the shawls and handbags.

dag: Bɛ yiya ni ti leei shɛb dini, ka bɛ puri mini bɛ paɣiba leei shɛb dini, dama n ni darigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim tibili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm pina ti ma. Ŋunkam suhu yu ni o ti pini, nyin deem li ti ma.
en: Tell the Israelites to make an offering to me. Receive whatever offerings anyone wishes to give.

dag: Ka nyini m bia, bɛ ni ti boon a la Zallakudura Naa daanabi, dama a ni ti daŋ ti Duuma tooni nti mal o soya gu o;.
en: You, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the Lord to prepare his way.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti lan kana ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: When the angels gathered around the Lord again, Satan was there with them.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Baal anabinim maa, Yi ni galisi maa zuɣu, daŋmiya pii yi naɣilaa kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa, ka suhi yi buɣili maa; amaa ka lee di niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Since there are so many of you, you take a bull and prepare it first. Pray to your god, but don't set fire to the wood.

dag: Nyama, ka anabi so daa kana ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Nyama, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka a baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Then a prophet went to King Ahab and said, King Ahab, the Lord says to you, Do you see that great army? I will defeat that army for you today. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ mi daa bi niŋ tuuba bɛ ninvuɣ kubo bee bɛ baɣibuɣibo bee bɛ zina niŋbu bee bɛ tayiɣisigu zuɣu.
en: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.

dag: Pa yi zaa yɛla ka n yɛri maa, dama m mi n ni pun pii shɛba; amaa di kpala talahi ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni dihiri so gbi ma zamba bɔɣili.
en: Im not speaking about all of you. I know those whom Ive chosen. But this is to fulfill the scripture, The one who eats my bread has turned against me.

dag: Yawɛ, m bi duhi mmaŋa, m mi bi nyuri bara. M bi zaŋ binyara din galisi pam mini din viɛli pam yɛla muɣisi mmaŋa.
en: Lord , I have given up my pride and turned away from my arrogance. I am not concerned with great matters or with subjects too difficult for me.

dag: Wuntizɔriba wuntitali n-tiligiri ba, amaa bilikɔɣinim nia biɛri nyɛla din gbahiri ba.
en: Doing right sets honest people free, but people who cant be trusted are trapped by their greed.

dag: ni Maasɛya so mi mini Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛza ni Uzi ni Jɛhɔhanan ni Malikija ni Ɛlam ni Ɛzɛr. Ka Jɛzirahia daa gari tooni zaŋ yiliyiiniba ka bɛ yili yila.
en: Also there were Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang with Jezrahiah as their leader.

dag: Nyama, bɛ kahi kuɣa duhi n-teei gili tiŋ maa ni bɛ ŋme n-deei li. Ka tɔb maa mini kum ni alɔbo zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ Kalidianim bɛn tuhiri ni bɛ deei li maa nuu ni. A ni daa yɛli shɛm la n-niŋ pali, ka amaŋmaŋ dii nya li maa.
en: The Babylonians have built siege mounds around the city to capture it, and they are attacking. War, starvation, and disease will make the city fall into their hands. You can see that all you have said has come true.

dag: So ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba Naawuni ŋun tim ma na maa n-vo o tahina; ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: The Father is the one who sent me, and he is the one who brings people to me. I will raise them up on the last day. Anyone the Father does not bring to me cannot come to me.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmɛri bɔɣiri tampiŋ sɔŋdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ kɔba bahi gballi nol ni.
en: Like wood that is split and chopped into bits, so their bones are scattered at the edge of the grave.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa baɣisi mɔɣu maa tariga zaŋ kpa Nɔba mini Jɔgbɛha wulimpuhili polo nti lu bɛ tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, dama tɔbbihi maa daa bi mali shili gu.
en: Gideon reached the enemy camp by going east along Nomad Road past Nobah and Jogbehah. He made a surprise attack.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan chɛ ka o shia siɣi ti zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban shɛli din kpi la leei tiŋgban shɛli din vuhira; ka puri atam niŋ pam.
en: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.

dag: bɛ bi zɔri nambɔɣu, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.

dag: Dama o daŋ maa pala din ni tibi kpaŋ. Di looi Judanima. Di paai n niriba dunɔdal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Samarias wound cannot be healed. Her disease has spread to Judah. It has reached the city gate of my people; it has spread all the way to Jerusalem.

dag: Hal yi ni to tɛte ni yi di kpibisi, ka yi mini niriba tɔɣisi gbaai yi zɔsimo daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: You would even roll dice for orphan slaves and make yourselves rich off your closest friends!.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn bi zɔri vi ŋɔ, laɣimmiya taba.
en: Shameless people, change your lives.

dag: ni o yihi bɛ shihi gballi ni na, ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan nya nyɛvili neesim.
en: He wants them to be saved from death so that they can enjoy life.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni ka galindi niriba. Bɛ dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri soli, ka nyuri bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ni be di niriba zuɣu nyɔri.
en: These people always complain and find wrong in others. They always do the evil things they want to do. They boast about themselves. The only reason they say good things about others is to get what they want.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣim n daalikauli, ka bi gbibi alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yɛli n san la, n ni niŋ ba kaman bɛ ni yi pirigi naɣisaa buyi sɔŋ, ka tim pirigibu maa sunsuuni gari shɛm la.
en: I will make those who disregarded my covenant, violating its terms that they agreed to in my presence, like the calf they cut in two and then walked between the halves of its carcass.

dag: Speen ŋarima n-daa ʒiri a daguya chana. Dinzuɣu a nɛma daa palila teeku bulli zaa.
en: The ships from Tarshish carried the things you sold. Tyre, you are like one of those cargo ships. You are on the sea, loaded with many riches.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm Naa Dauda bia ŋun nyɛ karimba la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The words of the Teacher of the Assembly, Davids son, king in Jerusalem.

dag: Atɛr daŋ — kɔbigaayika.
en: the descendants of Ater through the family of Hezekiah:.

dag: M bɔri ni yi baŋ ni bɛ yihi ti mabia Timoti sarika ni; o yi paana tu n kandina saha, n ni zaŋ o pahi mmaŋ zuɣu na ti nyan ya.
en: You should know that our brother Timothy has been set free. If he comes soon, we will travel together to see you.

dag: N nina fulimmi n nandahima zuɣu, n dimnim chɛ ka di niŋla liti.
en: My vision fails because of my grief; its weak because of all my distress.

dag: Bee miri ka a di ʒiri shɛhira jɛndi a kpee.
en: Do not testify falsely against your neighbor.

dag: O daa zaŋ li ti o daba Izraɛlnima. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Musa, Siɣimi ti saɣisi niriba maa, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kab kana ni bɛ ti nya man Yawɛ, ka bɛ pam ni kpi.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Go down and warn the people not to come near me and look at me. If they do, many will die.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla maa, ka ti Duuma malaika ka o sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Nyin Yisifu ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, di zɔri dabiɛm ni a chɛ ka bɛ kulisi Mariama a yiŋ na, dama o ni mali pu shɛli maa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na.
en: As he was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, Joseph son of David, dont be afraid to take Mary as your wife, because the child she carries was conceived by the Holy Spirit.

dag: Miri ka a lihi ni a mali yɛm, zom Yawɛ, ka zo n-yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Never let yourself think that you are wiser than you are; simply obey the Lord and refuse to do wrong.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti lan nya wuntizɔra mini ninvuɣ biɛɣu biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm, ka lan nya ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni mini ŋun bi jɛmd o biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm.
en: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, Izraɛlnima, yi ŋmanila Itiɔpianima n sani? Pa mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na? Pa mani n-daa yihi Filistianim Kafitɔr na, ka daa yihi Aramnim Kiri na?.
en: Arent you like the Cushites to me, people of Israel? says the LORD. Havent I brought Israel up from the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni yili a yurilim maŋli la yila sahakam, n ni moli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla molo ʒiɛmani kam zaa niriba sani.
en: I will sing of the LORDs loyal love forever. I will proclaim your faithfulness with my own mouth from one generation to the next.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti du Hɔr Zoli maa niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: Moses obeyed, and everyone watched as he and Aaron and Eleazar walked to the top of Mount Hor.

dag: Bɛ ni kul galisi pam shɛm, lala ka bɛ tumdi alahichi pam n sani. N ni chɛ ka bɛ jilima nyabu leei vi.
en: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl.
en: then he set up his tents and built an altar there to honor the God of Israel.

dag: Yi zaŋdi bindir shɛŋa din saɣim maani sara n sara maligu bimbina zuɣu. Yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee saɣim li? Yi tɛhiya ni nira ni tooi ʒiɛm Yawɛ bindira dibu shee.
en: By approaching my altar with polluted food. But you say, How have we polluted it? When you say, The table of the LORD can be despised.

dag: Bipola kpiɔŋ n-nyɛ bɛ jilima, amaa ninkura mi zab piɛla n-nyɛ bɛ jilima.
en: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lihi nya ka dɔbba ata ʒiɛya mir o. O ni daa nya ba maa, ka o yiɣis o tanti suɣili dunoli maa ni n-zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti damdi ba tiŋa.
en: He looked up and suddenly saw three men standing near him. As soon as he saw them, he ran from his tent entrance to greet them and bowed deeply.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani; dinzuɣu ka n chɛ o niŋ sarika ni hal ni saha shɛli n ni ni ti tooi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Siiza sani.
en: But Paul asked to be kept in jail until the Emperor could decide his case. So I ordered him to be kept here until I could send him to the Emperor.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; chamiya ti yɛli m mabihi maa ni bɛ cham Galili; nimaani ka bɛ ni ti nya ma.
en: Then Jesus said, Don't be afraid! Tell my followers to go to Galilee. They will see me there.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli niriba maa zaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa ti o ka tim o ni o ti yɛli ba la naai.
en: So Jeremiah finished telling the people the message from the Lord their God. He told them everything that the Lord their God had sent him to tell them.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka o mini niriba maa zaa ni naa lo alikauli ni bɛn yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ niriba.
en: The priest Jehoiada had King Joash and the people join him in making a covenant that they would be the Lord 's people.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu puuni ka nir niŋdi naani din mali kpiɔŋ, ka o bihi nyari sɔɣisili shee.
en: If you respect the Lord , you and your children have a strong fortress.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bo biŋkɔbiri maa mini ŋmana maa zaa na nti kɔri ba m-pirigipirigi ba buyiyi n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ tuhi taba. Amaa o daa bi pirigi ŋmana la bɛn buyiyi.
en: Abram brought all these to God. Abram killed these animals and cut each of them into two pieces. Then he laid each half across from the other half. He did not cut the birds into two pieces.

dag: Yi daazichi pooya, ka lɛla ŋubi saɣim yi situra.
en: Your riches will rot and be worth nothing. Your clothes will be eaten by moths.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ti di nasara man Yawɛ zuɣu ka paɣi ma.
en: I, the Lord , will rescue all the descendants of Jacob, and they will give me praise.

dag: Di simdi ka yi dɔbba zaa laɣindi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ tooni buta yuuni puuni.
en: All your males should appear three times a year before the LORD God.

dag: Kaman tɔrili ni damd o tiɛɣu ka yiɣiri gind o bihi, ka teer o kpiŋkpama kpuɣiri ba, ka zaŋ o kpiŋkpan yiɣira gbib ba zuɣusaa shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ daa gbibi Izraɛl ka o bi lu.
en: Like an eagle teaching its young to fly, catching them safely on its spreading wings, the Lord kept Israel from falling.

dag: Ka o ba maa yɛl o, M bia, nyin kul bela n sani sahakam; ka n ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a dini.
en: His father replied, My son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

dag: Yɛl biɛri din ka kalinli n-kul gili ma, di galisiya pam. N daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi n zuɣu, ka n ku lan tooi lihi nya binshɛli; di galisi gari n zabiri; ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: because countless evils surround me. My wrongdoings have caught up with me— I cant see a thing! Theres more of them than hairs on my head— my courage leaves me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Wummi niriba maa ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa, dama pa nyini ka bɛ zaɣisi, amaa mani ka bɛ zaɣisi ni n di lan nyɛ bɛ naa maa.
en: The LORD answered Samuel, Comply with the peoples request—everything they ask of you—because they havent rejected you. No, theyve rejected me as king over them.

dag: Dama m ba daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima n-tuhi fan ya Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: But remember what my father did for you. He fought for you and risked his life when he saved you from the Midianites.

dag: O daa paɣiya ni o pahi Naawuni niriba zuɣu n-di wahala gar o di alahichi nyaɣisim din ku yuui.
en: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jehu did, including his brave deeds, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Dama n daa yi zabirila karimbaannim nyuli. N daa nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni tɔŋdi shɛm.
en: because I was jealous of the proud when I saw that things go well for the wicked.

dag: ka ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la mini bɛnkam pahi bɛ zuɣu binshɛlikam din daa niŋ maa zaa yɛla.
en: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven disciples and all the rest.

dag: Di saha ka Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar maa daa lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma. Di nyaaŋa ka Shafan daa karim li wuhi naa.
en: Then Shaphan said to King Josiah, Hilkiah the priest gave a book to me. Then Shaphan read from the book in front of the king.

dag: dama n yɛri ya mi ni zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ hal ka Naawuni nam ti kana.
en: I tell you that I will not drink any more wine until God's kingdom comes.

dag: a ti ku mali suhugarigu a ni daa ku so ka di ka daliri zuɣu bee amaŋmaŋ ni daa bɔhi biɛri zuɣu. N dana, ka Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a sani, nyin di ti tam mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: then you will not have to feel regret or remorse, sir, for having killed without cause or for having taken your own revenge. And when the Lord has blessed you, sir, please do not forget me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb be a ni ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri ka kuri niriba, ka shɛb be a ni n-diri bindira zoya zuɣu ka be biɛriyoli.
en: Some of your own people tell lies, so that others will be put to death. Some of you eat meat sacrificed to idols at local shrines, and others never stop doing vulgar things.

dag: N ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni, ka yihi ba bɛ dimnim tiŋgbana ni na nti chɛ ka n kasitali yi palo bɛ zuɣu ka zuliya kam nya li la.
en: In order to show to the many nations that I am holy, I will bring my people back from all the countries where their enemies live.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin m-pahi zim bihi biɛla.
en: How much bread do you have? Jesus asked. Seven loaves, they answered, and a few small fish.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya ka niriba ŋɔ lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ yila katiŋ na; Babilɔn ka bɛ yina.
en: Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah and said to him, What did these men say? Where have they come from? Hezekiah said, They came from a distant country: Babylon.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisiyinika ni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛma ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan ka o nyɛ Babilɔn naa kpambal la daa kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Nebuzaradan was the commander of the king of Babylons special guard. He was one of the kings most important officials while at Jerusalem. He came to Jerusalem on the tenth day of the fifth month, in the th year that Nebuchadnezzar was king.

dag: Di saha Dauda daa bela bɛ ni me birini gili luɣ shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa shɛb daa be Bɛtilihɛm.
en: At that time David was in the fortress, and a Philistine fort was in Bethlehem.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Do kura mini paɣ kpamba bɛn dihiri jaaŋgbɛhi ni lan ʒiini Jɛrusalɛm puuni sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Old men and old women will again dwell in the plazas of Jerusalem. Each of them will have a staff in their hand because of their great age.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ ku wuhi ya ka yi tum bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa tiri bɛ buɣa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ti tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Kill them, so that they will not make you sin against the Lord by teaching you to do all the disgusting things that they do in the worship of their gods.

dag: N ni garig a min a zɔnim bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *.

dag: Zaŋ Aroa din be Arinɔn vinvamli tariga ni la hal ni fɔntin shɛli din be vinvamli maa ni la m-mali hal ni Giliad, tiŋ daa kani din goma du n-nyaŋ ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa ti ti.
en: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.

dag: Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl Jɛziriil tintariga, ka so ku sɔɣ o. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka anab maa daa yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi.
en: And as for Jezebel: The dogs will devour her in the area of Jezreel. No one will bury her. Then the young prophet opened the door and ran.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla, o Keenan paɣ ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua la ni daa dɔɣi bidibisi ata shɛba m-bala. Juda bikpɛm sani ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛr maa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpi.
en: Judah had five sons in all. By his wife Bathshua, a Canaanite, he had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. His oldest son, Er, was so evil that the Lord killed him.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka n daa galim nanim mini zuɣulaannima n-yɛli ba, Yi zaa deeri binyɛra nyɔri yimaŋmaŋ niriba sani. Ka n daa laɣim salo pam na ni ti ti baŋ ti ni yɛn niŋ yɛlli maa shɛm.
en: and decided to act. I denounced the leaders and officials of the people and told them, You are oppressing your own relatives! I called a public assembly to deal with the problem.

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi mali yum o zuɣu ni bee o teeŋa ni.
en: Someone might get an infection on the scalp or beard.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: But the Lord made the king stubborn, and he did not let the Israelites go.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol li Dauda tiŋa.
en: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.

dag: Ka Hiram ŋun daa nyɛ Taai naa la daa tim tuumba ka bɛ ʒi sida tihi dari na ti ti Dauda, ka daa lan tim kapintanim mini tammɛriba na ni bɛ ti me Naa Dauda yili ti o.
en: King Hiram of Tyre sent messengers to David. He also sent cedar trees, carpenters, and stonemasons. They built a house for David.

dag: dimbɔŋɔ ka n yɛn niŋ ya, n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya, ka chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din bahiri nir yoli lu yi zuɣu, dɔr shɛli din saɣindi nina ka nyɛ din diri nyɛvili. Ka yi ti biri yi bimbira yoli, dama yi dimnima n-ni ti di li.
en: If you do that, I will cause terrible things to happen to you. I will cause you to have disease and fever. They will destroy your eyes and take away your life. You will not have success when you plant your seed. And your enemies will eat your crops.

dag: Mɔɣu ni mini fɔndi ni nima, paɣimiya Naawuni; Kɛdarinima, paɣimiy o. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Sɛla fɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu, tahimiya, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Let the desert and its towns praise God; let the people of Kedar praise him! Let those who live in the city of Sela shout for joy from the tops of the mountains!.

dag: Jɛsi dapala maa ŋun dee yi be o nyɛvili ni, nyini bee a nam kul ku nya zaashee zani. Dinzuɣu timmi ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na, dama di kpala talahi ni o kpi.
en: As long as Jesses son lives, you will never be king and have a kingdom. Now, bring David to me! He is a dead man.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a zuɣu n ni tooi nyaŋ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ. N Naawuni zuɣu, n ni tooi kpahi yaɣi gooni.
en: With you I can charge into battle; with my God I can leap over a wall.

dag: Di daa nyɛla binnɛma la kpiŋkpama din daa shihiri taba la mini kalima din baɣi li la vuri. Di daa vurimi kaman tiŋgbani n-damdi pampam la.
en: I heard the wings of the creatures beating together in the air, and the noise of the wheels, as loud as an earthquake.

dag: ka chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim dol o chaŋ ti chɛ ka o ba naa buntaaŋa la.
en: King David sent Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and all the kings officers with Solomon out to Gihon Spring. They put Solomon on the kings mule.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ku yi tibidarigibo ni, ka ʒirilan mi ni kpi.
en: A witness who lies will be punished. That liar will be destroyed.

dag: Din pahi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim mini bɛn daa zo n-tiligi ti kpi.
en: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.

dag: Amaa ka o nyaandolitab la bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni n-du duli ka vɔri laŋ din daa pali zahim maa na, dama bɛ mini duli daa bi lan wɔɣa. Di daa kul nyɛla kaman mita kɔbiga zuɣu.
en: The other disciples came to shore in the boat, pulling the net full of fish. They were not very far from land, about a hundred yards away.

dag: Nyam ti bɔrɔbɔro, di daa na kul tulimi ka ti zaŋ li yi yiŋ na ti ni daa yiɣisina dahin shɛli ni ti ti diri sol ni, amaa nyam di ni kuui ka kpe yue shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Look at our bread. When we left home with it and started out to meet you, it was still warm. But look! Now it is dry and moldy.

dag: amaa ŋunkam zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣisi dilana m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: But everyone who denies me before people, I also will deny before my Father who is in heaven.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai Naawuni nir maa sani zoli maa zuɣu, o daa gbaala o napɔŋ, ka Gɛhaazi kana ni o ti daag o bahi, ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, Chɛl o. O malila yɛli muɣisirili ka Yawɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi ma ka bi kahigi li wuhi ma.
en: But as soon as she got to the top of the mountain, she went over and grabbed Elisha by the feet. Gehazi started toward her to push her away, when Elisha said, Leave her alone! Don't you see how sad she is? But the Lord hasn't told me why.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa taai bahi Musa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, Ti yi di daa pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu kpi Yawɛ tooni, di naan so.
en: and complained, Moses, we'd be better off if we had died along with the others in front of the Lord 's sacred tent.

dag: Ka Piɛgul Kpɛm la yi ti kana, yi ni deei nam zuɣupila din mali jilima ka di viɛlim ku kpaai.
en: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.

dag: Ti bɔri ni a vii sagbana ka siɣina. Ka zoya nya a, ka dabiɛm gbaai li ka di sɔhigi.
en: If you would tear open the skies and come down to earth, then everything would change. Mountains would melt before you.

dag: Ka zoya ni saa buri ba, ka bɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn kpe shɛli yi saa bubu ni, ka baɣila tampima.
en: They are drenched by the rain that falls on the mountains, and they huddle beside the rocks for shelter.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni daa ku niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ta li daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people.

dag: Shaul ni daa ti kpi, Baalihanan ŋun daa nyɛ Akibɔr bia la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Shaul died, Baal Hanan son of Acbor became the new king.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka kɔbil nina puhigi zɔra; ka daa chɛ ka mɔɣa din kom kul zɔri sahakam la nyuui.
en: You made springs and fountains flow; you dried up large rivers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun tɛhi ni o ʒe dɛde, ŋun miri ka o ti niŋ lu.
en: If you think you are standing firm you had better be careful that you do not fall.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa yi zaani Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa la dabisa biɛla, ka bɛ daa doli Yawɛ zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kpalim doya, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti lan doli Yawɛ zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: Sometimes the cloud would be over the dwelling for a number of days, so they would camp at the LORDs command, marching again only at the LORDs command.

dag: Ti wum ti dimnim yuri napɔnchichiba Dan tiŋgban ni. Ka bɛ wɔridibisi kumsi chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zaa sɔhigi. Bɛ kana ni bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka saɣim tiŋ maa n-tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni.
en: The snorting of their horses can be heard as far as Dan; the neighing of their stallions makes the whole land tremble. They come to devour the land and everything in it, towns and people alike.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, a kul darigirila n tibili; ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai kaman wuuni saha tulim ni nyuuri mahili shɛm la.
en: Every day you made life harder for me. I became like a dry land in the hot summertime. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa darigi cheeicheei bɛ binyɛra, ka kpuɣi bɛ ʒiya pa bɛ bunsi zuɣu ŋ-ŋmaligi lab tiŋ maa ni.
en: The brothers were very sad. They tore their clothes to show their sadness. They put their sacks back on the donkeys and went back to the city.

dag: Neesim viɛla, ka nina yi nya wuntaŋa, di viɛla.
en: Sweet is the light, and its pleasant for the eyes to see the sun.

dag: Ti zaa daa bela lala, ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, ka tumdi dinkam tiɣiri timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini ti tɛha nini. Ka ti zaa daa nyɛla bɛn ti yɛn di Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo wahala shɛli sokam ni ti yɛn di la.
en: At one time you were like those persons. All of you used to do whatever felt good and whatever you thought you wanted so that you were children headed for punishment just like everyone else.

dag: Sool mini Jɔnatan, n yurinima bɛn veeni yurilim. Bɛ daa bi woligi taba bɛ nyɛviya ni mini bɛ kum ni. Bɛ daa valim gari tɔrili. Bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari gbuɣima.
en: It was easy to love Saul and Jonathan. Together in life, together in death, they were faster than eagles and stronger than lions.

dag: N ni labi laŋ pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn ti kar o saria nimaani, o ni taai duŋ niŋ ma la zuɣu.
en: I will set my trap, and he will be caught in it. Then I will bring him to Babylon, and I will punish him there. I will punish him because he turned against me.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ kul wummi ka ninvuɣ shɛb yɛra, Ŋun daa niŋdi ti alaka la yipa yihirila o ni daa kpaŋd omaŋ ni o saɣim adiini so shɛl la waazu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: They only heard a report about me: The man who used to harass us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.

dag: Wummiya! Baansi bɛn be kɔbilisi gbini yɛri Yawɛ nasara dibu yɛla nimaani, nasara din nyɛ Izraɛl kpariba nasara! Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ niriba daa chaŋ dari dibu chandi yi bɛ tinsi ni na.
en: At the watering holes for the animals, we hear the music of cymbals. People sing about the victories of the Lord , the victories of his soldiers in Israel when the Lord s people fought at the city gates and won!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa n-chaŋ ti tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu, ka sagbani maa daa pali duu maa puuni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa pali dundɔŋ maa.
en: Then the LORDs glory rose from above the winged creatures and moved toward the temples threshold. The temple was filled with the cloud, and the courtyard was filled with the brightness of the LORDs glory.

dag: N ni daa lɔnya alikauli shɛli ni ʒim yihibu sara maligu shɛhira la zuɣu, n ni ti yi niriba bɛn be dabitim ni la yolisim. N ni yihi ba dabitim kɔbil kuŋ la ni.
en: The Lord says, Because of my covenant with you that was sealed by the blood of sacrifices, I will set your people free— free from the waterless pit of exile.

dag: Ti zaa yinoyino deerila pin gahinda kaman Masia ni buɣisiri li shɛm tiri ti.
en: Each one of us has received a special gift in proportion to what Christ has given.

dag: Dama n suhu daa zɔhirimi ni Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam bahi yi zuɣu shɛm maa, o ni kun ya. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan wum n suhigu di saha maa gba.
en: I was afraid of the Lord 's fierce anger, because he was furious enough to destroy you; but once again the Lord listened to me.

dag: Ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi tam daantalisi maa zuɣusaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-naai daantalisi maa tuma.
en: After putting the lily shapes on top of the columns, he was finished with the columns.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa daa saɣi ni o ni be Maika sani m-be kaman o bidibisi ni yino.
en: The Levite agreed to stay with him; and the young man became like one of his own sons.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Nyamiya, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: Then Jesus went back to the followers and said, Are you still sleeping and resting? The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to the control of sinful men.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ nina neei ka bɛ baŋ o, ka o daa dii bɔrigi ka chɛ ba ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: At once they knew who he was, but he disappeared.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb daa tɛhimi ni Judas ni gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibil la zuɣu ka Yisa yɛl o ni o cham ti da bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa ni bɛ zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa na bee ni o pii liɣiri maa shɛli ti ti nandaamba.
en: Since Judas was the one in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus meant for him to go and buy some things they needed for the feast. Or they thought that Jesus wanted him to go give something to the poor.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Izraɛlnim sansan ni, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka Mɔabnim maa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba ŋ-ŋmɛri kuri ba chana.
en: But when they reached the camp, the Israelites attacked them and drove them back. The Israelites kept up the pursuit, slaughtering the Moabites.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka sanʒiɛ tital shɛli bɛ ni booni pɔhim tilli la daa yiɣisi wulimpuhili duli polo ʒiɛrina.
en: Before long, a hurricane-strength wind known as a northeaster swept down from Crete.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Ɛlizabɛt, So ka yi zuliya ni ka o yuli booni Jɔn.
en: They said to her, None of your relatives have that name.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari ninkura, dama n kul gbibila a zaligunim maa.
en: I understand more than those who are older, because I obey your instructions.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛgilɔn daa laɣim Ammɔnnim mini Amalɛknima m-pah o min o niriba zuɣu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka fa dɔbino tihi tiŋ la bɛ sani.
en: He convinced the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, defeated Israel, and took possession of Palm City.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia. Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: He told her, I am your father's relative, the son of Rebecca. She ran to tell her father;.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei zuɣu, ka pa ni zuli, ka chɛ ka yi kul chani tooni ka ku lab nyaaŋa, yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The LORD will make you the head of things, not the tail; you will be at the top of things, not the bottom, as long as you obey the LORD your Gods commandments that Im commanding you right now, by carefully doing them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ; amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: Anyone who speaks a word against the Human Onewill be forgiven, but whoever insults the Holy Spirit wont be forgiven.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko n-tum shihira mini alahiziba tuma din mali dabiɛm n-yih a niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: With a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and with awesome power, yes, with signs and wonders, you brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt.

dag: N nina fulimmi n nandahima zuɣu, n dimnim chɛ ka di niŋla liti.
en: I can hardly see; my eyes are so swollen from the weeping caused by my enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa sanna Kadɛshi Paran mɔɣu ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ chandi yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli bɛ mini niriba maa zaa, ka zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwala wuhi ba.
en: to Moses, Aaron, and the whole community of Israel at Kadesh in the wilderness of Paran. They reported what they had seen and showed them the fruit they had brought.

dag: Dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam hal ka nir ni tooi ʒe luɣ kasi shee din be Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa tooni la ka lihi nya di zuɣuri mini di nyoya, amaa nir yi be samban ni, o ku tooi nya li, ka dapuhi maa na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The poles are still there today. They are too long for the Most Holy Place, so anyone standing in the Holy Place can see the ends of the poles, although no one outside can see them.

dag: nyama, n ni chɛ ka tinzunnim kana ti lir a. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri lu a yɛm din viɛl ŋɔ zuɣu, ka saɣim a jilima la.
en: will make you the victim of cruel enemies. They will destroy all the possessions you've worked so hard to get.

dag: Ka bɛ ti tan ya daɣiri zuliyanim maa ninni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: You will be humiliated in the eyes of other nations. Then you will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋ n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli yi ni niŋ naani ŋɔ mini n ni daa zaŋ luɣ shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim la kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm maa.
en: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.

dag: ni bɛ ni nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la mini di nɛma zaa ni tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu la.
en: the altar for burning offerings, together with all its equipment, and the washbasin with its base.

dag: N ni bɔri ni n yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa yinoyino yɛrila ŋ-ŋɔ: Man dolila Pool; ka so yɛra, N dolila Apolɔs; ka so yɛra, Pita ka man doli; ka so mi yɛra, Man dolila Masia.
en: This is what I mean: One of you says, I follow Paul, and someone else says, I follow Apollos. Another says, I follow Peter, and someone else says, I follow Christ.

dag: Ti mali mɔri mini difu din ni ti ti bunsi ŋɔ, ka mali m min a bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ni nachimbil so ŋun be tinim a daba ŋɔ sani ŋɔ bindirigu mini wain. Ti mali ti ni bɔri binshɛlikam.
en: We brought food for our donkeys and bread and wine for ourselves, so we don't need anything except a place to sleep.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa daŋ tooni na la o daa yihirila waazu yɛri Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ niŋm tuuba ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: But before Jesus came, John was telling everyone in Israel to turn back to God and be baptized.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o suhu saɣim pam ka o yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a jilima kul be sahakam. Yawɛ, chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a tuma zuɣu.
en: Our Lord , we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi nyaŋ o, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah, captured Jehoiakim, and took him to Babylonia in chains.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Sool ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pool la, ka o mirig o nina niŋ bukpaha maa.
en: Then Saul, better known as Paul, was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked straight at Elymas.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lan niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm la; bɛ daa suhi Ijiptinim maa anzinfa mini salima yɛri ni situra.
en: The Israelites had done as Moses had said, and had asked the Egyptians for gold and silver jewelry and for clothes.

dag: Amaa ka a daa zaŋ binyɛra ŋɔ sɔɣ a suhu ni. M mi ni a nia ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: But this is what you hid in your heart. Now I know what you were planning for me.

dag: Bɛ ni so bi labina ni o ti paɣi Naawuni shee tinzun nir ŋɔ kɔŋko.
en: Why was this foreigner the only one who came back to thank God.

dag: ka o yɛli Musa, Gbahim niriba maa toondaannima n-zaŋ kpana kuhi ba tabili bini zali wuntaŋa man Yawɛ tooni, ka n vuui n suhuyiɣisili titali maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Get all the leaders of these people. Then kill them so that all the people can see. Lay their bodies before the Lord . Then the Lord will not show his anger against all the Israelites.

dag: Ka guliba maa zaa daa gbib bɛ bidibbina n-ʒiɛya gu Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ ti kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti gili sara maligu bimbini mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.

dag: Ka niriba daa tumdi alahichi nimaani, ka chɛ dabisili kam sara maligu maŋli malibu, ka bɛ daa daai yɛlimaŋli luhi. Ka yilli maa daa kul diri nasara di ni tumdi shɛlikam ni.
en: In an act of rebellion, another force will take control of the daily sacrifice. It will throw truth to the ground and will succeed in everything it does.

dag: o nyɛla do so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ka maligumaana yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, o nyɛla ŋun mali dɔro o zuɣu ni.
en: then he has leprosy on his scalp. The person is unclean. The priest must announce that he is unclean.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu din daŋ tooni ni din nyɛ kpɛma.
en: This is the first and most important commandment.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, M bia, mirim na ti mɔɣisi n kpariŋ.
en: Then Isaac said, Son, come over here and kiss me.

dag: N daa bi zaɣisi ka m mali ŋun ni wum n yɛtɔɣa. M bi zaɣisi ka n dim maa di sabi o ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ma ŋɔ sɔŋ.
en: Will no one listen to what I am saying? I swear that every word is true. Let Almighty God answer me. If the charges my opponent brings against me were written down so that I could see them.

dag: Ka yi ni pam ni daa naai noli n-darig o tibili shɛm la saɣ lala.
en: The punishment handed out by the majority is enough for this person.

dag: Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni wum bɛ fabila, ka bɛ zaa chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa. Dama Yawɛ je suli, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Lord is furious, and if the people hear how he is going to punish them, maybe they will ask to be forgiven.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba, N kamina ni n ti niŋ buɣim juui dunia ŋɔ, ka n di bi zaɣisi ka di pun taai dira.
en: Jesus continued speaking: I came to bring fire to the world. I wish it were already burning!.

dag: Bɛn daa tumdi di tuma maa mini bɛ bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔhat daŋ ni niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ yiliyiina, ka nyɛ Joɛl bia la, Joɛl daa nyɛla Samuɛl bia.
en: The family lines of those who held this office are as follows: The clan of Kohath: Heman, the leader of the first choir, was the son of Joel. His family line went back to Jacob as follows: Heman, Joel, Samuel.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka o daa yɛli zaŋ kpa Juda zuliya polo, Yawɛ, deemi Juda zuliya suhigu, ka zaŋ ba laɣim bɛ niriba ni, ka ti ba kpiɔŋ, ka sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: Moses said this to Judah: LORD, listen to Judahs voice! Bring him back to his own people, strengthen his hands; be his help against every enemy.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ yihim niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb mini mari ni yiri shɛb niŋgbuna ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi kpima, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ leei bɛn bi be nyam bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Tell the people to send away from the camp anyone who is unclean, that is, anyone who has a serious skin disease or discharge and anyone who has touched a dead body.

dag: Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Alikizandria tiŋbia ka o yuli booni Apolɔs daa ti ka Ɛfɛsus na. O daa nyɛla zilinvaliŋgalana, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mi Naawuni Kundi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Meanwhile, a certain Jew named Apollos arrived in Ephesus. He was a native of Alexandria and was well-educated and effective in his use of the scriptures.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka zaligubaŋdi so daa ti bɔri ni o zahim Yisa, ka yiɣisi zani bɔh o, Karimba, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A teacher of the Law came up and tried to trap Jesus. Teacher, he asked, what must I do to receive eternal life.

dag: Ka o daa ti wum ni Yisa yi Judia ka Galili na, ka o chaŋ o sani nti balim o ni o kana ti tib o bidibiga maa ti o, dama o daa tarigimi yɛn kpi.
en: The man heard that Jesus had come from Judea and was now in Galilee. So he went to Jesus and begged him to come to Capernaum and heal his son, who was almost dead.

dag: Niŋmiya ma yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba gba be n ni; ka di yi pa lala, yin niŋmiya ma yɛda n tuma zuɣu.
en: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Jona bahi kom maa ni maa, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka ziŋ karili zaŋ o vali, ka o daa be ziŋ maa puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa daba ata.
en: At the Lord 's command a large fish swallowed Jonah, and he was inside the fish for three days and three nights.

dag: Ka shɛb daa niŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛda, ka bɛn kpalim mi biɛhim li.
en: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.

dag: M bia, zom Yawɛ ka zom naa, ka miri ka a zaɣisi bɛ so noli;.
en: Fear the LORD, my child, as well as the king. Dont associate with those who are rebellious.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk bɔhi Ibrahimma, A ni woligi piɛsah ayopɔin shɛb zali bɛ ko maa mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: Abimelech asked Abraham, Why did you put these seven female lambs by themselves.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti miri kum saha shɛli, ka o daa saɣis o bia Sulemaana yɛli.
en: Davids time was coming to an end. So he commanded Solomon his son.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa nti ti Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛlnima sansani din daa be Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Jɛriko polo la.
en: Then they returned to their own camp in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, where Moses, Eleazar, and the other Israelite leaders met the troops outside camp.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the dwelling.

dag: A nina be kasi ni di lihi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a ku tooi lihiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛda, ka shini ka ninvuɣ biɛri kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba gari ba?.
en: But how can you stand these treacherous, evil men? Your eyes are too holy to look at evil, and you cannot stand the sight of people doing wrong. So why are you silent while they destroy people who are more righteous than they are?.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Nyama, n ni kari Amɔrinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima, ka chɛ palo tin ya.
en: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa kul zaŋ di yɛla kaɣili Samsin biɛɣukam, ka kul mal li dol o hal ka o nyee ti nyɔni pam di zuɣu.
en: She kept bothering Samson day after day. He got so tired of her asking him about his secret that he felt like he was going to die.

dag: Daadam, paɣiba ayi n-daa beni, bɛ daa nyɛla paɣ yino bihi.
en: Mortal man, he said, there were once two sisters.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa sab sabbu shɛli tabili Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Pilate wrote a notice and had it put on the cross. Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews, is what he wrote.

dag: Noli ni ti din ya yi fɔntinsi ni, ka din ya yi puri ni.
en: Your businesses and farms will fail.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli maa zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: They crucified him. They divided up his clothes, drawing lots for them to determine who would take what.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Yɛhudianim jɛmbu du shɛl ni wuhiri niriba Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: One Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in a synagogue.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ku tooi ba nir zali, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa kul ku vuɣi.
en: No one is established by wicked acts, but the roots of the righteous cant be disturbed.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa yihi ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ puuni binyara n-lan bahi kom maa ni.
en: and on the following day they threw part of the ship's equipment overboard.

dag: ka kula ŋun tiri nyɛvili; amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni. Tinima n-nyɛ di shɛhiranima.
en: You killed the author of life, the very one whom God raised from the dead. We are witnesses of this.

dag: Dama a pala Naawuni ŋun yu gala tumbu, a mi mini zaɣ biɛɣu bi kpɛra.
en: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana ka o yɛli ba, Yi zaa mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm dahin shɛli n ni daa tuui ka Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na nti be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: When they came, Paul said to them, You know about my life from the first day I came to Asia. You know the way I lived all the time I was with you.

dag: Di saha ka Siria naa kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Izraɛlnim Naawuni nyɛla zoya zuɣu Naawuni, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti maa, amaa chɛliya ka ti tuhi ba la bɔpiɛligu ni, biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni nyaŋ ba.
en: King Benhadad's officials said to him, The gods of Israel are mountain gods, and that is why the Israelites defeated us. But we will certainly defeat them if we fight them in the plains.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim di bindir yin shɛli Naawuni ni daa ti ba la.
en: All ate the same spiritual food.

dag: Bɛ ni ti mol o tiliginsim yɛla molo bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb sani yɛra, o pun niŋ li.
en: People not yet born will be told: The Lord saved his people.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhiɛl bia Shɛkania ŋun daa yi Ɛlam daŋ ni na la daa yɛli Ɛzra, Tinima n-zaɣisi ti Naawuni noli ka kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba sani, amaa di zaa yoli, Izraɛlnim na kul mali tahima.
en: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, of the clan of Elam, said to Ezra, We have broken faith with God by marrying foreign women, but even so there is still hope for Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Hɛzɛkia yɛliya, Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini ti zuɣu ni kpahibu ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani n-dɔɣiri ba.
en: These are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti da kpam maa ka amiliya aŋgo maa dii paana, ka o mini bɛn daa pun mali shili gu o maa kpe amiliya lɔbu yili maa ni, ka bɛ kpari di dunoli.
en: So the foolish girls went to buy oil. While they were gone, the bridegroom came. The girls who were ready went in with the bridegroom to the wedding feast. Then the door was closed and locked.

dag: Dama Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka nuhi tuumbaŋda daa mal li. Di pala Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti wurim Samaria naɣibil maa.
en: An Israelite craftsman made the idol, and it is not a god at all! The gold bull worshiped in Samaria will be smashed to pieces!.

dag: Di nanim deerila birapu ka kariti saria, ka di maligumaaniba deeri liɣiri ka wuhiri niriba, ka di daanabinim tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka deeri liɣiri, amaa bɛ zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ be ti sani; zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti.
en: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-nyɛ bɛ zuɣupila, amaa jɛrilim n-nyɛ jɛra dolibi.
en: A wise persons reward is wealth, but a fools reward is foolishness.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi ni paɣ ŋɔ nya o daalahichi din galisi ŋɔ zaa chɛ m-paŋ, dama o yurilim galisiya pam; amaa ŋun nya o daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ ka di pɔri nyɛla ŋun yurilim pɔra.
en: This is why I tell you that her many sins have been forgiven; so she has shown great love. The one who is forgiven little loves little.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti Sulemaana yɛm mini baŋsim din ka buɣisibu ni tɛhi wɔɣila ka di galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu la.
en: Solomon was brilliant. God had blessed him with insight and understanding.

dag: Yi birila ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka kpuɣi atam din bi doli yɛlimaŋli. Yi dila ʒiri tiwala. Yi ni niŋ yi chɛchɛbunsi mini yi tɔbbihi bɛn galisi ŋɔ naani la zuɣu.
en: But instead you planted evil and reaped its harvest. You have eaten the fruit produced by your lies. Because you trusted in your chariots and in the large number of your soldiers.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul dolila yɛlimaŋli soli, ka bihi bɛn doli bɛ naba mali alibarika.
en: The righteous live with integrity; happy are their children who come after them.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma ka bi zaɣis o ba min o ma ni o paɣa ni o mabi dɔbba ni o tizɔpaɣiba ni hal zaŋ tabili omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili gba, o ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: If you come to me but will not leave your family, you cannot be my follower. You must love me more than your father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters—even more than your own life!.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kpɛm ninvuɣ shɛba m-maani ma ansarisi la; n ni daa yuli ʒiɛm shɛb banima, ka ku saɣi zaŋ ba pahi m bahi zuɣu ka bɛ doli m piɛri la.
en: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpe mɔɣu chaŋ dabisi muni chandi nti teei ʒini ti shɛli gbini n-suhiri Naawuni bɔri ni o kpi. O daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, di saɣiya, deemi n nyɛvili pumpɔŋɔ, dama m bi so n yaannima.
en: and walked for a whole day into the desert. Then he sat down under a bush and asked to die. He said, I have had enough, Lord ! Take my life. I am no better than my ancestors.

dag: Ka Balak daa zaŋ Balaam ti du n-tam Pɛɔr Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli nir ni ni tooi zani ka lihi nya bɔpiɛligu maa ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, which overlooks Jeshimon.

dag: Dama Naawuni nina kul gɔrimi gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam ni o kpaŋsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani suhuri. A tum jɛrilim dimbɔŋɔ puuni, dama pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, a kul yɛn bela tɔb tuhibu ni.
en: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ziɔnnima, paɣimiya yi Naawuni!.
en: Jerusalem, praise the Lord ! Zion, praise your God!.

dag: Sokam zaa wum yi ni deei Naawuni noli shɛm yɛla, ka n suhu paligi yi zuɣu; amaa m bɔri ni yi niŋ yɛnnim zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛlli tumbu polo, ka nyɛ bɛn bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Everyone has heard that you do what you were taught, and I am very happy about that. But I want you to be wise about what is good and to know nothing about what is evil.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi: Labimiya ti yɛli yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tu ma la zuɣu.
en: Isaiah said to them, Say this to your master: This is what the LORD says: Dont be afraid at the words you heard, which the officers of Assyrias king have used to insult me.

dag: ka Sabinim kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku tumtumdiba maa ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: when some Sabeans attacked us and took your animals! They killed the other servants. I am the only one who escaped to come and tell you the news.

dag: Hal ka daa ti lo ni o ta Naawuni jɛmbu duu daɣiri, ka ti daa gbaag o. Ti daa naan tooi doli ti zaligu soli n-kar o saria.
en: When he tried to disgrace the temple, we arrested him. If you question him, you will find out for yourself that our charges are true.

dag: Buɣisim nya Yawɛ ni viɛli shɛm; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo nti sɔɣ o sani mali alibarika.
en: Give the Lord a chance to show you how good he is. Great blessings belong to those who depend on him!.

dag: Deem o wuhibu din yir o nol ni na, ka zaŋ o yɛligu niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Accept his teaching. Pay attention to what he says.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Giliad ti Makiri.
en: I assigned Gilead to the clan of Machir of the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Di saha Dauda zuliya ni so ni ti leei naa, ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini yurilim su niriba. O ni ti niŋ din tuhi yomyom. Ka chɛ ka niriba doli din tuhi soli.
en: a throne will be established based on goodness, and someone will sit faithfully on it in Davids dwelling— a judge who seeks justice and timely righteousness.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ? Ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: So who wins against the world? Only those who believe that Jesus is the Son of God.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nya li, ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka bɛn ka taali lara, ka maani ba ansarisi yɛra.
en: When God's people see the godless swept away, they celebrate.

dag: Ka Mariama yɛli, Chɛ ka di niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma dabili ŋɔ kaman a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Di saha ka malaika maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: Mary said, I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said. And the angel left her.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yɛlimaŋli naɣ beni kaman kulibɔŋ kom din zɔri la, ka chɛ ka wuntia mi be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔri la.
en: But let justice flow like a river, and let goodness flow like a stream that never becomes dry.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Zadok, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi tiŋ maa puuni ti zali, Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ma, o ni lan zaŋ ma labisina ka n nini ti nya di min o biɛhigu shee.
en: Then the king said to Zadok, Take the Covenant Box back to the city. If the Lord is pleased with me, some day he will let me come back to see it and the place where it stays.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ o tahi bɛ sani, ŋmɛnditoya maa daa woliwolila taba ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka wari wahi, bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa Filistia mini Juda tiŋgbana ni maa zuɣu.
en: And he led David to them. The raiders were scattered all over the place, eating, drinking, and celebrating because of the enormous amount of loot they had captured from Philistia and Judah.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria naa shiri bahi niriba pam mini bɛ tiŋgbɔna yoli.
en: It is true, Lord . The kings of Assyria did destroy all those nations.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ o bia pakoli Tama maa n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi ayi pahi, bɛna n-nyɛ Pɛrɛz mini Zɛra. Juda bidibisi zaa daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: By his daughter-in-law Tamar, Judah had two more sons, Perez and Zerah.

dag: O ni saɣim Lɛbanɔn sida tiwɔɣila zaa mini Bashan oki tihi zaa.
en: They might be like the tall cedar trees from Lebanon or the great oak trees from Bashan, but they will be cut down.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-wurindi Babilɔn, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ vuri yɔbu. Bɛ dimnim ni lu bɛ zuɣu kaman kɔgbana la. Bɛ vuri yɔbu maa ka buɣisibu.
en: The LORD is destroying Babylon and silencing her outcry, whose roar is like the crushing waves, a deafening crash.

dag: Ka n nya ka vuhim daa yi Naawuni sanna nti kpe bɛ ni di daba ata ni pirigili maa dali ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi zani, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi bɛnkam nya ba.
en: But after three and a half days, God let life enter the two witnesses again. They stood on their feet. All those who saw them were filled with fear.

dag: Yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa o daa kul bela gbala maa shee mini zoya zuɣu kuhiri ka mali kuɣa jɛr omaŋa.
en: Day and night he wandered among the tombs and through the hills, screaming and cutting himself with stones.

dag: Di saha naa maa ni ti ŋmaligi zaŋ kpa omaŋmaŋ ya sansana polo, amaa o ni ti tuui lu n-kpi.
en: Then he will turn his attention to the walled fortresses of his own country but will stumble, fall, and disappear.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, binshɛl lan yina chana.
en: Then the messenger speaking with me came forward and said, Look up and see whats approaching.

dag: N yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛla wuntizɔbo yɛtɔɣa, di shɛli pala ʒiri bee n-nyɛ din gɔŋ.
en: Everything I say is true; nothing is false or misleading.

dag: Bee a gari ti yab Yaakubu ŋun daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ ti ti hal ka o min o bihi ni o biŋkɔbiri daa nyuri di kom la.
en: Are you greater than our ancestor Jacob? He is the one who gave us this well. He drank from it himself, and his sons and all his animals drank from it too.

dag: Wuntaŋ kul puhirimina n-chani ti lura, ka lan zɔri yomyom labiri o ni puhiri shɛli polo.
en: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa, ka n zaŋ o niŋ m-paɣa? Dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a paɣa! Zaŋm o chaŋ.
en: You said, She is my sister. Why did you say that? I took her so that she could be my wife, but now I give your wife back to you. Take her and go.

dag: Man kul chɛmi ka n suhu be kasi yoli, ka paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali yoli.
en: Clearly, then, I gain nothing by keeping my thoughts pure! What good is it to keep myself from sin?.

dag: Ka di chɛliya ka ti naɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni chɛ ka di chandi zaɣisibu niŋ ba miligu shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti kpaŋsiri tab suhuri, di bahi bamdi yi ni nya ka ti Duuma Dabisili dal la vuri miriti la zuɣu.
en: Let us not give up the habit of meeting together, as some are doing. Instead, let us encourage one another all the more, since you see that the Day of the Lord is coming nearer.

dag: Ti Duuma ni ti Ziɔn paɣiba zuɣutalisi ni dansi ka di niŋ yukaɣima. Yawɛ ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ zaɣim.
en: the Lord will shave the heads of Zions daughters, and will expose their scalps.

dag: Bɛ suhuri daa bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o sani; ka bɛ mi daa bi dol o ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la soli.
en: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.

dag: Bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ diribarilim zuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli n-kul dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli.
en: I was angry with them because of their sin and greed, and so I punished them and abandoned them. But they were stubborn and kept on going their own way.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi bi nyari soli din ni tooi ka yi sanna.
en: Thats what has kept me so busy and prevented my coming to see you even though I have wanted to come many times.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zali yuma ata shɛŋa la saha daa ti paai, ka Ashpɛnaz zaŋ nachimbihi maa zaa tahi ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza sani.
en: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.

dag: Amaa ka a daa zaŋ binyɛra ŋɔ sɔɣ a suhu ni. M mi ni a nia ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: You have not explained all of your mysteries.

dag: Binnamdi so ku tooi sɔɣi Naawuni, dama binshɛɣukam dola palɔni o sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zaa ni ti yɛn kahigi ti bebu ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi so.
en: Nothing in all the world can be hidden from God. He can clearly see all things. Everything is open before him. And to him we must explain the way we have lived.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim lo nia ni bɛ kana nti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-tahi girigiri niŋbu na.
en: So all these men got together and made plans against Jerusalem. They planned to stir up trouble against Jerusalem. They planned to come and fight against the city.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ʒiri, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tuma nyɛla vidibo mini filiŋ nyabu.
en: The righteous hate false words, but the wicked create disgust and scorn.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Jɛrubaal mini Barak ni Jafta ni Samsin ka bɛ kana ti fan ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni bahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka chɛ ka yi beni ka barina shɛli lan kani.
en: The Lord sent Gideon, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel to rescue you from your enemies, and you didn't have to worry about being attacked.

dag: Yɛlimiya Aakipus ni di niŋ kamaata ni o tum ti Duuma ni ti o tuun shɛl la naai.
en: Tell Archippus, Be sure to do the work the Lord gave you.

dag: Dama lala ka ti Duuma daa zali ti kaman di ni sabi yɛli shɛm la: N zal a mi ni a leei bɛn pa Yɛhudianim firila, ka zaŋ tiliginsim yɛla ŋɔ gili dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam hal ti kpa di tarisi zaa. .
