en: For this is the commandment that the Lord has given us: I have made you a light for the Gentiles, so that all the world may be saved.

dag: Amaa m mali piɛ shɛba ka bɛ ka buzɔŋ ŋɔ ni, faashee m bahi zaŋ ba na ka bɛ gba ti baŋ n kukoli, ka di chɛ ka piɛgul yino mini buzɔn yini kɔŋko beni.
en: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni daa di n-tiɣi naai ka bɛ pii ŋariŋ maa ni alikama kpalan shɛŋa bahi teeku maa ni ni ŋariŋ maa tibisim filim.
en: We ate all we wanted. Then we began making the ship lighter by throwing the grain into the sea.

dag: O daa paɣiya ni o pahi Naawuni niriba zuɣu n-di wahala gar o di alahichi nyaɣisim din ku yuui.
en: He preferred to suffer with God's people rather than to enjoy sin for a little while.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a mali yɛm gari Daniɛl, ka ashili shɛli kani ka a bi mi li.
en: You think you are wiser than Danel, that no secret can be kept from you.

dag: N naan tooi zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsi yi suhuri, ka n suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa naan ku yi biɛrim maa.
en: But I would offer hope and comfort instead.

dag: Yɛlim daba la gba ni bɛ deemi bɛ duumanim noya, ka tumdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini binshɛɣukam zaa puuni; ka di ŋmɛri ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Tell slaves to submit to their own masters and please them in everything they do. They shouldnt talk back.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zaligunim maa zaa dolibu, ka nyɛligi binyara malila naɣibih ayi kɔtomsi zali; ka lan mali Ashɛra binnana zali, ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi mini Baal.
en: They broke all the laws of the Lord their God and made two metal bull-calves to worship; they also made an image of the goddess Asherah, worshiped the stars, and served the god Baal.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim ya ka yi ŋmaligi doli wuna jɛmdi li, dama di saha.
en: Do not let yourselves be led away from the Lord to worship and serve other gods.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka anzinfa mini salima galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi kaman sinsabisi dari ni galisi shɛm Shɛfɛla la.
en: While Solomon was king of Israel, there was silver and gold everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ o tuma zuɣulaannim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Zadok bia Azaria n-daa nyɛ maligumaana.
en: These were his officials: the priest Azariah, Zadoks son.

dag: Bɛnkam chaŋ o sani bi lan labina bee n-lan nya nyɛvili soli.
en: All those who go to her will never return; they will never again reach the ways of the living.

dag: ka wuhiri ba ni bɛ doli n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la. Nyamiya, n kul ni be yi sani sahakam hal ti paai dunia yiɣisibu dali.
en: Teach them to obey everything that I have told you to do. You can be sure that I will be with you always. I will continue with you until the end of time.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs yuli ka Mɔdɛkai daa zaŋ sab gbana maa, ka zaŋ ŋun naa nintua dalinli dihi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li tim wɔribariba bɛn daa bari nayili wɔrikpaa ni wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam, ka bɛ zaŋ li tahi.
en: Mordecai wrote commands by the authority of King Xerxes. Then he sealed the letters with the kings ring and sent them by messengers on horses. The messengers rode fast horses, which were raised especially for the king.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa chɛ naɣikɔra maa, ka guui doli Ilaija nti yɛl o, Chɛ ka n chɛbisi m ba mini m ma pɔi ka naanyi dol a. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labima, ka n yɛl a la wula?.
en: Elisha immediately left the oxen and ran after Elijah. Let me kiss my father and my mother, Elisha said, then I will follow you. Elijah replied, Go! Im not holding you back.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ibram daa vuɣ o tanti suɣili n-chaŋ ti kpa Mamri oki ti shɛŋa din be Hiburɔn la gbini; ka daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ.
en: So Abram moved his camp and settled near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, and there he built an altar to the Lord .

dag: Ka di ni daa ti miig o pam saha shɛli ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, bidibiga n-lan bala.
en: She was having a rough time, but the woman who was helping her said, Don't worry! It's a boy.

dag: Chɛ ka dilan maa biɛhigu ti be kaman Yawɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa ka bi zo li nambɔɣu la. Chɛ ka o kul wumdi kuhigu asiba, ka wumdi tɔbuchiriga wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha.
en: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n tumtumda n-daa yɔhim ma, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Pam m buŋ ŋɔ gali ti ma ka m ba n-doli naa chaŋ, dama a mi ni mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla wɔbiga.
en: He answered, Your Majesty, you know I can't walk. I told my servant to saddle a donkey for me so I could go with you. But my servant left without me, and.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛli, Alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: but some of the people said, It is Beelzebul, the chief of the demons, who gives him the power to drive them out.

dag: tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Kolɔsai ka nyɛ ti mabihi bɛn ʒe yim Masia san la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: To God's people in Colossae, who are our faithful friends in union with Christ: May God our Father give you grace and peace.

dag: O daa zaŋ salima alali mali teebuli maa zuɣu duɣuri mini di parantɛnima ni di lahi din ni tuɣindi tulaale zim ni pipi shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain.
en: He made the dishes of pure gold for the table: the plates, the cups, the jars, and the bowls to be used for the wine offering.

dag: Asirianim ku tooi tiligi ti, ti ku lan ba yuri yaha, ti mi ku lan boli ti ni zaŋ ti nuhi mali binshɛŋa la ti Naawuni. Yɛlimaŋli, kpibiga nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Assyria wont save us; we wont ride upon horses; we will no longer say, Our God, to the work of our hands. In you the orphan finds compassion.

dag: Ka dɔrolan maa garigi yɛl o, N Duuma, kom maa yi ti dam, n ka so ŋun ni zaŋ ma siɣi di ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ yi chani ni n ti siɣi, so daŋdi ma la di ni siɣibu.
en: The sick man answered, Sir, there is no one to help me get into the water when it starts moving. I try to be the first one into the water. But when I try, someone else always goes in before I can.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni niŋ wuhi ni o yuri ti: O daa tim o Bi gaŋ na ni o ti chɛ ka ti nya nyɛvili o zuɣu.
en: And God showed his love for us by sending his only Son into the world, so that we might have life through him.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn daa nya Yisa ka o kpari o polo na ka o yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbila ŋun kpihindi dunianim daalahichi la.
en: The next day John saw Jesus coming to him, and said, There is the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia yɛla dabisi muni puuni dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: My tongue, also, will tell of your righteousness all day long, because those who seek my downfall have been put to shame and disgraced.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sool daa tim ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gu Dauda o yiŋa, o daa lomi ni o ku o asiba. Amaa ka Dauda paɣa Mikal daa yɛl o, A yi bi tilig a nyɛvili yuŋ ŋɔ, biɛɣuni bɛ sa ni ku a.
en: That same night Saul sent some men to watch David's house and kill him the next morning. Michal, David's wife, warned him, If you don't get away tonight, tomorrow you will be dead.

dag: Ka a min a bihi ni a tumtumdiba zaa yɛn kɔrila o yaaŋa ŋɔ puri din ni chɛ ka a dan yaaŋa maa nyari bindirigu dira. Amaa m min a dan yaaŋa Mɛfibɔshɛt n-yɛn laɣindi diri sahakam. Ziba daa malila bidibisi pinaanu ni tumtumdiba pisi.
en: You will work the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants—and you will bring food into your masters house for them to eat. But Mephibosheth, your masters grandson, will always be at my table.

dag: O tiri bɛn zɔr o bindirigu; o bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla.
en: He gives food to his followers. He remembers his agreement forever.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa ti yɛli Dauda, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ di ti shɛhira, biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bee dali, n yi daa bɔhi m ba ka o bi lan lo ni o niŋ nyin Dauda zaɣ biɛɣu, n ku tim na ti yɛl a?.
en: Jonathan said: I swear by the Lord God of Israel, that two days from now I'll know what my father is planning. Of course I'll let you know if he's friendly toward you.

dag: A zaŋ ʒim ti bɛn daa yih a wuntizɔriba mini anabinim ʒim la ni bɛ nyu. Di ni simdi ni a niŋ ba shɛm m-bala.
en: They poured out the blood of God's people and of the prophets, and so you have given them blood to drink. They are getting what they deserve.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ka di yɛri malaikanima ayopɔin la, Zaŋmiya Naawuni suhuyiɣisili ni pali lah ayopɔin shɛŋa la n-chaŋ ti kpaai bahi dunia ni.
en: Then I heard a loud voice speaking from the temple to the seven angels: Go and pour out the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni bɛ lom bɛ niriba ata maa mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: Then he commanded some of the strongest soldiers in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He told the soldiers to throw them into the hot furnace.

dag: Saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi yɛn liri nira? Yi zaa yɛn bula yi ni gbaai ninvuɣ so, kaman yi ni yɛn niŋ dikili ŋmaŋ bee kikara din kab ŋuniya m-bɔri ni di lu shɛm la?.
en: How much longer will all of you attack someone who is no stronger than a broken-down fence?.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika la bɛ zuɣu; a ni deei n noli maa zuɣu.
en: All the nations will ask me to bless them as I have blessed your descendants—all because you obeyed my command.

dag: Ka Pool daa laɣisi dagansi na ti pa buɣim maa ni, ka gariŋga yi dari maa ni na buɣim maa tulim zuɣu n-kaai vil o nuu.
en: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn Zol zuɣu; m-moli nolɔbo molo, ka laɣim niriba.
en: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li dindali maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni dindali maa kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Lakishinim shɛm la.
en: They captured it the same day and put everyone there to death, just as they had done at Lachish.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ sariakaribo nyolɔrigu maa ni, ka di ti pa Aduna nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti ka Yawɛ tooni na. Dina n-ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim saria karibu yɛla kul be Aduna suhu ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: He must also wear on his breastpiece the two small objects that he uses to receive answers from me.

dag: Dindali zaŋ chana Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Bɛ no n-taai nandaamba niŋ taŋkpaɣu ni, ka daai bɛn diri wahala bahi, ka doo min o ba laɣindi mali dabipaɣ yino. Lala ka bɛ niŋ saɣim n yuli din be kasi la.
en: They crush the head of the poor into the dust of the earth, and push the afflicted out of the way. Father and son have intercourse with the same young woman, degrading my holy name.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a nyu wain bee binnyuri kpiɔŋ; a mi miri ka a di binshɛli din chihiri dibu;.
en: Be sure not to drink any wine or beer, or eat any forbidden food;.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M ma, ka wula ka a yɛl ni n niŋ? N saha na bi paai.
en: Jesus replied, Woman, what does that have to do with me? My time hasnt come yet.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani, ka nyuri bara bɛ daazichi din galisi pam zuɣu la.
en: those people who trust in their fortunes and boast of their fantastic wealth?.

dag: Nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma bahi? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dimnim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛm o o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: Praise the Lord our God. Bow down toward his holy mountain and worship him. The Lord our God is holy!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti nya doo maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu yɛl o, Nyama, a kpaŋya zaa! Di lan tum alahichi din ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu din gari din la ti paag a yaha.
en: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.

dag: M bia, Yawɛ yi saɣis a, nyin di lihi ʒiɛm li bee o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a nyee nyɔni.
en: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yoog o daazichi duu din nyɛ zuɣusaa ŋɔ tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saa mibu saha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni; ka yi ti dihi zuliya pam samli, amaa yinim ti ku di so samli.
en: The LORD will open up for you his own well-stocked storehouse, the heavens, providing your land with rain at just the right time and blessing all your work. You will lend to many nations, but you wont have any need to borrow.

dag: Ka yi yi gbaai do so ka o zaŋ o kpee paɣ doya, yin kumiya bɛ niriba ayi maa; doo maa min o ni zaŋ paɣ so doya maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If a man is found having sex with a woman who is married to someone else, both of them must die—the man who was having sex with the woman and the woman herself. Remove such evil from Israel!.

dag: Suhugarigu zuɣu chɛmi ka n nina niŋ liti, Yawɛ, n kul teela n nuhi n-suhir a dabisili kam.
en: My eyes are tired of looking at my suffering. Ive been calling out to you every day, LORD— Ive had my hands outstretched to you!.

dag: Amaa shɛb daa bi saɣi Musa yɛligu maa, ka zaŋ shɛli zali hal ni asiba, ka di daa nyɔni wɔɣi zunzuya. Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: But some of the people did not obey Moses. They saved their food for the next day. But worms got into the food and it began to stink. Moses was angry with the people who did this.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka maligumaana maa lan kana ti nya, dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.

dag: Ka Hadadɛza daa tim ti zaŋ Sirianim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la n-ka Hɛlam na, ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Hadadezer sent for Arameans from beyond the Euphrates River. They came to Helam with Shobach leading them as commander of Hadadezers army.

dag: Ka zaŋya Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ tɔroko maa ni, ka zaŋ salima binyara din nyɛ yi daalahichi sanyoo pini la zali baɣili di luɣili ni n-daai li bahi n-chɛ ka di chaŋ di ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: Take the Lord 's Covenant Box, put it on the wagon, and place in a box beside it the gold models that you are sending to him as a gift to pay for your sins. Start the wagon on its way and let it go by itself.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ti kani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa laɣimna nti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ya Rama. Sool daa pun karila bukpahinim mini jinwariba Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: After Samuel died, all the Israelites mourned for him and buried him in Ramah, his hometown. Saul had removed the mediums and fortunetellers from Israel.

dag: Yɛlim a mabia ŋun nyɛ doo la, N niriba. Ka yɛl a tizɔpaɣa, O nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Say to your brother, My People, and to your sister, Compassion.

dag: Hal Yisa mabihi gba daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: Not even his brothers believed in him.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya Masia niŋ yi suhuri ni ka o nyɛ yi Duuma. Ka kul malimiya shili guri ni yi garigi ŋunkam bɔhi ya bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni mali tahima shɛli yi ni la polo.
en: Instead, regard Christ the Lord as holy in your hearts. Whenever anyone asks you to speak of your hope, be ready to defend it.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi pa di olivi tihi dari pundi maa zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka lan dooi shɛli pa chɛrubinim mini abie tihi la gba zuɣu.
en: He overlaid the two olive-wood doors with gold-plated carvings of winged creatures, palm trees, and blossoming flowers.

dag: Dama di daa bi ŋari m ma bidɔɣirisurigu noli, din ni chɛ ka m bi nya wahala.
en: I wish it had stopped me from being born and kept me from seeing all these troubles.

dag: Ŋuna ka anabinim zaa di shɛhira ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ o yuli zuɣu la.
en: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di sabigi di paɣibu maa nyaaŋa, ŋun cheem di ni be situra maa ni luɣ shɛli maa bee gbaŋ maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bahi.
en: But if, when the priest examines it again, the mildew has faded, he shall tear it out of the clothing or leather.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo bee m-booi li bahi ninvuɣ yiriŋ zuɣu ni, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni. .
en: Whoever makes a perfume like that and puts it on anyone except a priest must be separated from the people.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti yiɣis o garo zuɣu wuntaŋ ŋmalli saha n-du n-tam nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa chana nti lihi nya paɣ so ni suri kom, paɣ maa daa viɛli pam.
en: One evening he got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of his house. From there he saw a woman bathing. She was very beautiful.

dag: yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli ti Duuma shiri neei kum ni; hal o yi Saimɔn zuɣu.
en: They were saying to each other, The Lord really has risen! He appeared to Simon.

dag: Bɛ ku zaŋ a pahi bɛ zuɣu sɔɣi, dama a daa saɣim a tiŋgbɔŋ, ka ku a niriba. So ku teei a zuliya bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la ni so yɛla.
en: Because you ruined your country and killed your own people, you will not be buried like other kings. None of your evil family will survive.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi Bɛrishiiba n-lu soli. Ka Yaakubu bihi daa zaŋ bɛ ba Yaakubu mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi n-niŋ tɔroko shɛŋa Firawuna ni daa zaŋ ti ba ni bɛ zaŋ o niŋ n-ʒi o na la ni.
en: Jacob set out from Beersheba. His sons put him, their small children, and their wives in the wagons which the king of Egypt had sent.

dag: Nyama, Na so ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni ti di nam, ka o kpambaliba nyɛ bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: See here: A king rules to promote righteousness; rulers govern to promote justice.

dag: Maligumaaniba n-daa nyɛ: Joyarib bia Jɛdaya mini Jachin.
en: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, and Jachin.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni a mali taali, pa mani n-yɛli. Amaŋmaŋ naŋgbampiba n-di shɛhira jɛnd a.
en: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.

dag: Amaa nyini n tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ti la birim.
en: because its you who saved us from our foes, you who put those who hate us to shame.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla a niriba, a mi ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla n niriba, ka n nyari jilima bɛ sani.
en: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.

dag: Musa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinii, ka Aduna mi yuma nyɛ yuun pihiniinaata saha shɛli bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: and spoke to the king. At the time, Moses was years old, and Aaron was .

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa nya ŋariŋ shɛli din chani Fɔnisia, ka ti kpe li chaŋ.
en: There we found a ship that was going to Phoenicia, so we went aboard and sailed away.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣ o, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o. Molimiy o daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: Sing praise to the Lord ; tell the wonderful things he has done.

dag: Ti paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋ ti niŋ ti dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ bahi ti yoli ŋɔ.
en: Praise the Lord ! He did not let our enemies tear us apart.

dag: Dama wuhibu din viɛla ka n zaŋ tiri ya maa, miriya ka yi zaɣisi n wuhibu.
en: The advice I give is good, so dont ever forget what I teach you.

dag: M bi galim ya yi sara maligu mini yi ni kul mali biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-zaŋdi ba nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la zuɣu.
en: The problem I have with you is not your sacrifices or the burnt offerings you bring to me every day.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni Sinai mɔɣu maa ni. Yawɛ ni daa kul zali Musa shɛlikam zaa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: The people did this in the desert of Sinai just before dark on the th day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Do shɛb bɛn na bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba ni pakoya la mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Bɛ yi ni kpalim be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, di viɛla.
en: Now for those who are not married and for the widows I say this: It is good for you to stay single like me.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o lan pala dabili kɔŋko, amaa o gari dabili; o yipa nyɛla ti mabiyurigu Masia ni. O mali ma buchi pam, amaa nyini ka o lee ni mali buchi pam, o ni nyɛ a dabili la min o ni nyɛ a mabia ti Duuma zuɣu la puuni.
en: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.

dag: N yi tɛhi ni n yiŋ nyɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka n yi zaŋ m bindoo yɛrigi zibisim ni.
en: My only hope is the world of the dead, where I will lie down to sleep in the dark.

dag: Ka Ribɛka tizɔdoo maa min o ma daa yɛli, Chɛ ka paɣisarili maa na kpalim be ti sani daba ayi kaman biɛɣu pia pahi ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: Rebekahs mother and her brother said, Let Rebekah stay with us for a short time. Let her stay with us ten days. After that she can go.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita nini daa neei ka o yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o malaika na ka o ti fa ma Naa Hɛrɔd mini Yɛhudianim zaa ni lɔri nia ni bɛ niŋ ma bɛ ni yu shɛm la nuu ni bahi.
en: At that, Peter came to his senses and remarked, Now Im certain that the Lord sent his angel and rescued me from Herod and from everything the Jewish people expected.

dag: Yihimiya yi biɛr kurili din chɛ ka yi be kaman yi ni daa pun be shɛm la bahi, dama yi biɛr kurili maa daa pun saɣim la kɔr biɛ shɛŋa din daa yɔhim ya la puuni.
en: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mɔdɛkai daa lan lab ti ʒi nayili samban dunol maa ni yaha; ka Haman mi daa zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu tabil o nina ŋ-ŋmaligi kuli yomyom ni suhugarigu.
en: After that Mordecai went back to the kings gate, but Haman hurried home with his head covered because he was embarrassed and ashamed.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa dii tim zuɣuŋmara ni o cham ti ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu na. Ka o daa chaŋ sarika duu nti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: At once he ordered a guard to cut off John's head there in prison.

dag: Dama bɛ chira tariga yi ti paai, bɛ baɣa bɔ n-lee lan be bɛ malibu ni, bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: What do they care about their household after they die, when their numbered days are cut off?.

dag: N zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu mi kaman Naawuni ni zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu shɛm, dama n zaŋ ya tila Masia kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi paɣipiɛliga tiri do yino shɛm la.
en: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.

dag: Yawɛ, a nudirigu mali yiko ni jilima. Yawɛ, a nudirigu ka a zaŋ dari tɔh a dim bahi.
en: With the tremendous force of your right arm, our Lord , you crushed your enemies.

dag: Nyama, ti Duuma mali ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ni yiko din ni tooi lu bɛ zuɣu. O ni kana kaman sakuɣa saa bee sa kurili ni kopaliga nti di tiŋgbani maa.
en: The Lord has someone strong and powerful ready to attack them, someone who will come like a hailstorm, like a torrent of rain, like a rushing, overpowering flood, and will overwhelm the land.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kpi maa, o bia Ahazia n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahab died, and his son Ahaziah became king.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa be n-yɛri ago kpariti mini binyɛr suma, ka dir o suhu yubu sahakam.
en: Jesus said, There was a rich man who always dressed in the finest clothes. He was so rich that he was able to enjoy all the best things every day.

dag: Yɛligim a suɣili. Di niŋ zinchili. Kpam a kpahi ka di kpɛma, ka voog a mihi ka di kpaŋ.
en: Make the tent you live in larger; lengthen its ropes and strengthen the pegs!.

dag: Naa Bɛnhadad daa timmina nti yɛl o, Samaria taŋkpaɣu yi ni tooi pali n niriba bɛn doli ma zaa nukurigu yimyim, m buɣa bɛn niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal n niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba.
en: who sent back this reply: May the gods do whatever they want to me if there is even a handful of dust left in Samaria for the armies under me.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yisifu na be o nyɛvil ni, ka nyɛla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana. Ka Yaakubu yɛma daa ŋma, dama o daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: They told him, Father, Joseph is still alive! And he is the governor over the whole country of Egypt. Their father did not know what to think. At first he didnt believe them.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o, Bɔ m-poog a n sani ka a bɔri ni a kul a ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka Hadad yɛl o, Kul chɛ ka n kuli.
en: Pharaoh said to him, What do you lack here with me that would make you want to go back to your homeland? Hadad said, Nothing, but please let me go.

dag: Ka dɔro daa ti gbaag o ka o kpi, ka bɛ suug o kom n-zaŋ o kpɛhi jirambisa zuɣusaa duu ti sɔŋ.
en: At that time she got sick and died. Her body was washed and laid in a room upstairs.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhiri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: And don't be troubled when you hear the noise of battles close by and news of battles far away. Such things must happen, but they do not mean that the end has come.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni san la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu. Sokam zaa nyɛla yim.
en: God puts people right through their faith in Jesus Christ. God does this to all who believe in Christ, because there is no difference at all:.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: Then Joshua addressed the Reubenites, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Yi mi di deeya biŋkɔbigu tinzun nir sani n-zaŋ o mali sara shɛli din nyɛ yi Naawuni bindirigu sara la. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali dansi; bɛ ni mali ba tumdi din bi tu kamaata zuɣu, n ku deei ba yi sani.
en: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi zaa chaŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka suhiya Naawuni daalibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Take your sheep, goats, and cattle, and leave. Also pray for a blessing on me.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ ŋun be Ziɔn ŋɔ! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla!.
en: Sing praises to the LORD, who lives in Zion! Proclaim his mighty acts among all people!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ɛdomnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri n-kari doli bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim ka nambɔɣu zɔbu kani. Bɛ sujee maa kɔŋla tim, ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili mi kɔŋ tariga zanibu.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of Edom, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because he chased after his brother with the sword, denied all compassion, kept his anger alive, and fueled his wrath forever.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa gbi mɔɣili ka niŋ kɔsoli n-vo kom kpɛhi tiŋ puuni na la zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: All the great things that Hezekiah did, including his work on the pool and the aqueduct to bring water into the city, are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka Asha bidibisi daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Sɛra. Ka Bɛraya bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl.
en: Ashers sons were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. Beriahs sons were Heber and Malchiel.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, Di nyɛla din ni dini? Ka Yisa yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma;.
en: The man said, Which ones? Then Jesus said, Dont commit murder. Dont commit adultery. Dont steal. Dont give false testimony .

dag: Dama ti ku tooi niŋ din ni chihi yɛlimaŋli; faashee din kul ni doli yɛlimaŋli maa ka ti ni niŋ.
en: For we cannot do a thing against the truth, but only for it.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna ti bɔh o, Banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ.
en: God came to Balaam and asked, Who are these people that are staying with you.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa yur o paɣ Maaka ŋun nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga maa n-gar o paɣ shɛb bɛn pahi min o mamanim zaa. .
en: Rehoboam loved Maacah more than he loved all his other wives and slave women. Rehoboam had wives and slave women. He was the father of sons and daughters.

dag: Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni daa sab ninvuɣ shɛb yuya saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili Jɛriko tooni polo la m-bala.
en: All these clans were listed by Moses and Eleazar when they took a census of the Israelites in the plains of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya putariga bindira, yi mi di ti labiya ti yihi binyiha di ni yaha. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Mani Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: When you harvest your fields, do not cut the grain at the edges of the fields, and do not go back to cut the heads of grain that were left; leave them for poor people and foreigners. The Lord is your God.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka alɔbo din daa lu Ijiptinim zuɣu la tatabo lu yi zuɣu; ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi nachimba; ka gbahi yi yuri zaa chaŋ; ka chɛ ka yi sansan ni nyo luɣiluɣi kpɛri ya; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I sent a plague on you like the one I sent on Egypt. I killed your young men in battle and took your horses away. I filled your nostrils with the stink of dead bodies in your camps. Still you did not come back to me.

dag: Wula ka a tah o ʒiishee ka yɛra, O ku garigi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛli.
en: You are arguing with God! Why do you think he should explain everything to you?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam maa ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛlin shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri o puu ni;.
en: Jesus told them another story: The kingdom of heaven is like what happens when a farmer plants a mustard seed in a field.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka nir lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: The disciples said, This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, di zɔri ba bee n-zɔri bɛ yɛtɔɣa dabiɛm. Hal di yi nyɛla suligunyinyari bee gɔhi gil a, ka a be nɔnsi sunsuuni, nyin di zɔri bɛ yɛtɔɣa bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave.

dag: N ni kpihim bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa n sani, ka chɛ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa ka zaɣisi ma la taali.
en: They sinned and rebelled against me, but I will forgive them and take away their guilt.

dag: Ishimail daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin, ka naanyi kpi m-pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: Ishmael had settled in the land east of his brothers, and his sons settled everywhere from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt on the way to Asshur. Ishmael was when he died.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛli Mɔabnim yɛtɔɣ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ar zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi. Kɛɛr zani dabari yuŋ zaɣ yini, ka Mɔabnim fo chichi.
en: This is a message about Moab: One night armies took the wealth from Ar in Moab, and the city was destroyed. One night armies took the wealth from Kir in Moab, and the city was destroyed.

dag: Ka anab Gaad daa ti yɛli Dauda, Di kpalim be vokabili ŋɔ ni, yiɣisim kpe kuli Juda tiŋgban ni. Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani chaŋ Hɛrɛt yɔɣu ni.
en: Then the prophet Gad came to David and said, Don't stay here; go at once to the land of Judah. So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.

dag: ni o chɛ ka Pool lab Jɛrusalɛm na, dama bɛ daa lɔrila nia ni bɛ gu soli ku o.
en: they asked as a favor from Festus that he summon Paul to Jerusalem. They were planning to ambush and kill him along the way.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord said to me.

dag: Dindali maa dɔbba ayi ni ti be puu ni; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: Two men will be in the same field, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn daa bi kpalim ʒe bɛ zaashee, ka daa chɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee la, Naawuni zaŋ saha din ka bahigu zoligɔnim lo ba zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali din nyɛ dabisi titali dal la.
en: I remind you too of the angels who didnt keep their position of authority but deserted their own home. The Lord has kept them in eternal chains in the underworld until the judgment of the great day.

dag: dama ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira.
en: because our God is like a fire that can destroy us.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa, Gbahimiya Baal daanabinim maa, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ ni so zo n-tiligi. Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba, ka Ilaija zaŋ ba sirigi Kishɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti ku ba nimaani.
en: Just then, Elijah said, Grab the prophets of Baal! Don't let any of them get away. So the people captured the prophets and took them to Kishon River, where Elijah killed every one of them.

dag: M biyurisi, di niŋya ŋunkam yɛli ni o mali Naawuni Shia yɛda, amaa buɣisimiya ba nya bɛ ni mali shi so maa yila Naawuni sanna; dama anab ʒirinim pam yiɣisiya m-be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam.
en: My dear friends, do not believe all who claim to have the Spirit, but test them to find out if the spirit they have comes from God. For many false prophets have gone out everywhere.

dag: N ni bo bɛn bɔrigi la shee, ka taɣi bɛn yirigi la labisina, ka zaŋ tana lo bɛn nya dansi la, ka kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi la. Amaa bɛn bara, ka mali yaa la, n ni ku ba. N ni zaŋ din tuhi dihi ba.
en: I will seek out the lost, bring back the strays, bind up the wounded, and strengthen the weak. But the fat and the strong I will destroy, because I will tend my sheep with justice.

dag: ka o yɛli Musa, Gbahim niriba maa toondaannima n-zaŋ kpana kuhi ba tabili bini zali wuntaŋa man Yawɛ tooni, ka n vuui n suhuyiɣisili titali maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: The LORD said to Moses: Take all the leaders of the people and kill them on behalf of the LORD in broad daylight, so that the LORDs anger turns away from Israel.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: Ti min o yi daa laɣim kpi, ti min o ni ti lan laɣim be.
en: Here is a true statement: If we died with him, we will also live with him.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla tiliginsim Naawuni. Ti Duuma Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri niriba kum ni.
en: He is our God, the God who saves us. My Lord GOD saves us from death.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kiburɔtihataava maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hazɛrɔt.
en: They marched from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o bidibbina maa ti o bia maa ka yɛl o, Zaŋmi li kuli yiŋa.
en: Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and told him to take them back to town.

dag: Ka ti daa bo n-nya Yisa nyaandoliba n-kpalim nimaani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin. Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛli Pool Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: We found the Lord's followers and stayed with them for a week. The Holy Spirit had told them to warn Paul not to go on to Jerusalem.

dag: N ni dol a zaligunima; di chɛ ma bahi zaa.
en: I will obey your laws; never abandon me!.

dag: Miri ka a zabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli bee m-bɔri ni a mini ba be.
en: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.

dag: A viɛlim zuɣu ni chɛ ka naa bɔr a. Ka o ni nyɛ a duuma la zuɣu, lum o sizuura.
en: Your beauty will make the king desire you; he is your master, so you must obey him.

dag: Aduna bihi ni ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu bee ʒim ni yiri so ni mir ka o di bin yɛr kasinim la, faashee o ti yi daɣiri ni. Ŋunkam ti shihi bin shɛli din nyɛ daɣiri ka di nyɛla kpima ka o shihi bee do so ŋun dɔbilim yi o tooni na.
en: Any descendant of Aaron who is afflicted with skin disease or has a discharge cannot eat of the holy things until he is clean. Anyone who touches anything made unclean by a dead body, or who has an emission of semen.

dag: ka daa bi lan saɣi ni so ʒi binshɛɣu gari kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: and he would not let anyone carry anything through the Temple courtyards.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-kpuɣ a bindoo chaŋ.
en: Jesus said to him, Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.

dag: A ni suh o, ka o deeg a suhigu, ka a niŋ a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni niŋ binshɛŋa la.
en: When you pray, he will hear you. And you will be able to do all that you promised him.

dag: O daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ni o malila Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shili ka bɛ tum Naawuni tuma n-chɛ ka ŋun Masia niŋgbuŋ la zooi.
en: His purpose was to equip Gods people for the work of serving and building up the body of Christ.

dag: Di sabi yi zaligu ni ni niriba ayi shɛhiradibo n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: In your Law it is written that the witness of two people is true.

dag: yin ti zaŋmiya bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba zaa ti Yawɛ. Yi biŋkɔbiri ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣilɔ shɛb zaa nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: you must offer every first-born male to the Lord . Every first-born male of your animals belongs to the Lord .

dag: O zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ malibu yuya m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali ba m-baŋ bɛ kalinli la. Naa mini Jɛiɛl ni Zakaria.
en: Joels brothers and all his tribes are listed just as they are written in the family histories: Jeiel was the first son, then Zechariah.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa kpah o zuɣu ni di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka buŋ ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsal la n-kari anabi maa o yinyari tuma ni.
en: But Balaam was rebuked for his wrongdoing. A donkey, which has no voice, spoke with a human voice and put a stop to the prophets madness.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi deei binshɛli zali ninvuɣ kura ŋun simdi kubu zaani. Ninvuɣ kura simdi kubu.
en: A murderer must be put to death. Dont take money to change the punishment. That murderer must be killed.

dag: Yi vihiri Naawuni Kundi, dama yi tɛhiya ni di ni ka yi ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka Naawuni Kundi maa maŋmaŋ gba diri ma shɛhira.
en: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me.

dag: O daa daŋ tɔɣisirila Ijipti yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Ijipti Naa Nɛko tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli Karikɛmish, ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa nyaŋ ba Juda naa Jɔsia bia Naa Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni la.
en: About Egypt! A message for the army of Pharaoh Neco, Egypts king, which was defeated by Babylons Nebuchadnezzar at Carchemish near the Euphrates River in the fourth year of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son.

dag: Ka Pita ŋun daa kpalim ʒe samban dunol ni. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol so maa daa yi nti suhi soli yili maa ni bipuɣin so ŋun daa guli dunoli la sani n-zaŋ Pita kpe.
en: while Peter stayed outside by the gate. Then the other disciple went back out, spoke to the girl at the gate, and brought Peter inside.

dag: Yɛnnim ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla bɛ ni daa wum shɛli bɛ yaannim sani.
en: Those who are wise have taught me truths which they learned from their ancestors, and they kept no secrets hidden.

dag: Tayiɣisi yi ka yi yinsi na bee ŋmɛnditoya yi kana yuŋ, pa bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko ka bɛ zura? Ka puri tumtumdib yi kana ni bɛ ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, bɛ ku chɛ binyiha bahi? Amaa yi dimnim bɛn ni kpimsi ya zaa!.
en: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a, ka a garigi ma.
en: Prepare yourself like a man; I will interrogate you, and you will respond to me.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa yɛli Yisahaku, Hiti paɣiba ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu bi doya. Yaakubu yi kpuɣi Hiti paɣa ka o be kaman bɛmbɔŋɔ, bebu bukaata lan yɛn nyɛ bɔ n sani.
en: Rebekah then said to Isaac, I really loathe these Hittite women. If Jacob marries one of the Hittite women, like the women of this land, why should I go on living.

dag: So ka tɛha bee baŋsim din ni chɛ ka o baŋ ka yɛli: N zaŋla dari maa pirigili mali buɣim n-zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini nimdi she di buɣimsala ni ŋubi, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ din kpalim mali binshɛli din bi tu ni m mali n-damdi di tooni jɛm li.
en: He doesnt think, and has no knowledge or understanding to think: Half of it I burned in the fire, and I baked bread on its coals, and roasted meat and ate. Should I make the rest into something detestable? Should I bow down to a block of wood?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Sool ni Dauda be Kɛila, ka Sool yɛli, Naawuni zaŋ o niŋ n nuu ni, dama o kpari omaŋa n-niŋ tin shɛli din dunoya mali pundi mini kur wɔɣila din kpariti dunoya.
en: When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, he said, God has handed him over to me now because he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.

dag: Bɛnkam be yi ni n-nyɛ o niriba, bɛ Naawuni maa ŋun be bɛ sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi kuli Jɛrusalɛm, Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti lab me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ duu, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: If any of Gods people are living among you, I pray God will bless them. You must let them go to Jerusalem in the country of Judah. You must let them go build the Temple of the Lord , the God of Israel, the God who is in Jerusalem.

dag: Yisa ni daa yiɣisi ni n-chaŋ naai ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kul gbaag o nol ni luɣisibu ni di chɛ ka o yɛli din bie.
en: When Jesus left that place, the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees began to criticize him bitterly and ask him questions about many things.

dag: nti yɛli ba, M mi ni Yawɛ zaŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka dabiɛm pun gbahi ti pam yi zuɣu; ka bɛnkam zaa be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni suhuri fuŋmi.
en: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.

dag: Ka o daa lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ duna tariga. Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ shee tariga.
en: He measured off another fifteen hundred feet and made me cross the water; it was knee-deep. He measured off another fifteen hundred feet and made me cross the water, and it was waist-high.

dag: mini Jɛrusalɛm ni Idumia ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli polo hal zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn laɣim o sanna, bɛ ni daa wum o ni tumdi tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla zuɣu.
en: Many also came from Judea, from Jerusalem, from Idumea, from the area across the Jordan River, and from the area around Tyre and Sidon. These people came because they heard about all that Jesus was doing.

dag: Ka Zara daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Ibrahimma o ninkurilim ni, saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o la.
en: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura, ka dol o soli mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those who obey the Lord , who live by his commands.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nirilim min o yurilim ni daa ti yi palo ninsalinim san la.
en: But then the kindness and love of God our Savior was made known.

dag: Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, yin di kɔrigiy o min o bia maa zaa dahin yini.
en: But you must not kill the animal and its mother on the same day. This rule is the same for cattle and sheep.

dag: Ka yi mali gɔpiɛliga dapuhi, ka niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Use acacia wood to make poles for the altar, and cover them with bronze.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa yɛli Samuɛl, Cham ti dɔni, o yi ti lan bol a, nyin yɛlima, Yawɛ, yɛlima, a dabili wumda. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa lan lab ti dɔni o dooshee maa.
en: Eli told Samuel, Go to bed. If he calls you again, say, Speak, Lord . I am your servant, and I am listening. So Samuel went back to bed.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kahig omaŋ wuhi Ijiptinima, ka bɛ baŋ o dindali maa ka jɛm o, ka bo pina mini sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti o. Bɛ ni ti pɔri pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka niŋ bɛ ni po ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm.
en: At that time the Lord will make himself known to the Egyptians, and they really will know the Lord . They will serve him and give him many sacrifices. They will make promises to the Lord , and they will do what they promise.

dag: N ni kpe yi tiŋ ŋɔ ni n-chani ginda, n nya yi ni jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa, ka nya maligu malibu bimbin shɛli ka bɛ sab pa di zuɣu yɛli, Ti ni ʒi wun so ka jɛmd o la mi bimbini m-bɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu yi ni ʒi so ka jɛmd o maa yɛla ka n kahigiri wuhiri ya maa.
en: As I was going through your city and looking at the things you worship, I found an altar with the words, To an Unknown God. You worship this God, but you don't really know him. So I want to tell you about him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka tɔb daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɛza. Di saha ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Sipai ŋun daa yi tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na la, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa.
en: Later on, war broke out again with the Philistines at Gezer. This was when Sibbecai from Hushah killed a giant named Sippai, and the Philistines were defeated.

dag: Nanim daa laɣimya n-kana ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Kings joined forces to attack the city.

dag: Ka Musa daa yeei Aduna kpariti maa n-zaŋ li yɛli o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna daa shiri kpi zoli maa zuɣu. Ka Musa mini Ɛliɛza daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina.
en: Moses removed Aarons special clothes and put them on Aarons son Eleazar. Then Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Moses and Eleazar came back down the mountain.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun doli n nyaaŋa na la hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi li.
en: He comes after me, but Im not worthy to untie his sandal straps.

dag: ni Gaat ni Marɛsha ni Zif.
en: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph.

dag: O daa niŋ li wuhi ya ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: You were shown these things so that you would know this: The LORD is the only God. Theres no other god except him.

dag: Chɛliya yi kpibisi; n ni gbib ba, ka chɛ ka yi pakoya niŋ ma naani.
en: Leave your orphans with me, and I will take care of them. Your widows can depend on me.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Nyama, Abinɛr kala a sanna, ka bɔ niŋ ka a bah o ka o chaŋ?.
en: Joab went to David and said, What have you done? Abner came to you, and you let him go. Now he's long gone!.

dag: O daa yɛl ti Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tin ya yurilim shɛl la yɛla.
en: He informed us of your love in the Spirit.

dag: Yawɛ kpihim a saria karibu la, ka kar a dimnima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, di lan zɔriya barina shɛli dabiɛm yaha.
en: The Lord stopped your punishment. He destroyed your enemies strong towers. King of Israel, the Lord is with you. You dont need to worry about anything bad happening.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti kul zaɣisi alahiziba tuma ayi ŋɔ dihi tabili bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a yɛligu, nyin toomi Nail Mɔɣili la kom kpaai bahi tiŋkuŋ zuɣu ka di leei ʒim tiŋkuŋ maa zuɣu.
en: If they still refuse to believe after you show them both of these signs, then take some water from the Nile River. Pour the water on the ground, and as soon as it touches the ground, it will become blood.

dag: Ka n yi saɣim yi suhuri n ni daa sab gban shɛli tin ya la puuni, n suhu bi miligi di zuɣu, hal n suhu ni daa pun miligi di zuɣu la zaa yoli, dama n nyaya ka gbaŋ maa daa shiri saɣim yi suhuri, amaa ka yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa daa lee bi yuui.
en: Even though my letter hurt you, I dont regret it. Well—I did regret it just a bit because I see that that letter made you sad, though only for a short time.

dag: Bɛ ŋme n-deei Babilɔn, dunia zaa ni daa mali shɛli nyuri bara la. Babilɔn leela din yɛla mali dabiɛm zuliya kam sani.
en: How Sheshach has been defeated, the pride of the whole earth taken captive! How Babylon has become a wasteland among the nations!.

dag: Goli palli dabisili dali, o ni ti bo naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa mini piɛbihi pola ayɔbu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi.
en: On the day of the New Moon he must offer a young bull that has nothing wrong with it. He will also offer six lambs and a ram that have nothing wrong with them.

dag: Dama bɛ dirila ninvuɣ biɛtali bindirigu, ka nyuri duŋtaabo wain.
en: They eat the bread of evil, and they drink the wine of violence.

dag: Ka a niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover the table with pure gold and put gold trim around it.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɔri maligunim buɣim, ka tumdi alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka bi deer o noli bee n-dol o zaligunim zaa la zuɣu ka yɛlibiɛɣu ŋɔ paai ya kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: This disaster happened because you worshiped other gods and rebelled against the Lord by refusing to obey him or follow his laws and teachings.

dag: N ni niŋ jila niŋ ya, ka niŋ niŋgbuna niŋ ya, ka zaŋ gbaŋ pɔbi ya, ka niŋ vuhim niŋ ya ka yi niŋ nyɛvili; ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi nimaani n-chani Samaria n-daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Piɛguliba Dooshee la.
en: Jehu left Jezreel and went to Samaria. On the way, he stopped at a place called Shepherds Camp.

dag: So yi liri ya, di pala n yɛda ni ka o niŋ lala. Ka ŋunkam liri ya, o ku di nasara.
en: I will never send anyone to attack you. And if any army tries to attack you, you will defeat them.

dag: Naa daa lan bahi noli ni o tim ba nayili bindira mini wain shɛli o ni nyura n-dihi ba lala yuma ata. Ka yuma ata maa ti paai ka o zaŋ ba tahi ŋun naa sanna.
en: and give them the same food and wine that I am served. Train them for three years, and then they can become court officials.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa zaŋ alikama biɛlim suma bir o puu ni;.
en: Then Jesus used another story to teach them. Jesus said, Gods kingdom is like a man who planted good seed in his field.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: yumiya yi dimnim gba, ka niŋmiya alibarika niŋdi bɛn turi ya ni, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli; ka suhimiya Naawuni n-tiri bɛn niŋdi ya alaka.
en: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.

dag: O ni ti kpa o nam tanti suɣ kara teeku mini zo shɛli din be kasi la sunsuuni. Amaa o ni ti kpi, ka so ku be o sani sɔŋ o.
en: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain. But he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma: Siria na so ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka soli ni o di nam maa, amaa o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu fa nam maa di n-libigi ba.
en: The angel went on to explain: The next king of Syria will be an evil man who has no right to be king, but he will come unexpectedly and seize power by trickery.

dag: To, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ sunsuuni, a tɛhiya ni ŋuni n-lee lihi ŋmɛnditoya ni daa liri do so maa kaman o ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: Then Jesus asked, Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers.

dag: Ka a nudirigu mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini, di so ni a niŋgbuŋ zaa ti kpe buɣim ni.
en: If your right hand makes you sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to go into hell.

dag: Ti ni daa be yi sani maa, ti daa bahi ya noli ni ŋun je ni o tum tuma bi simdi ni o di.
en: Even when we were with you we were giving you this command: If anyone doesnt want to work, they shouldnt eat.

dag: Naawuni shia n-nam ma, ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ti ma nyɛvili.
en: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.

dag: Di saha maa Abiata bia Jɔnatan mini Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa sɔɣila Ɛnrɔgɛl, ka bipuɣimbil so chani ti yɛri ba dinkam beni, ka bɛ mi zaŋdi li chani ti yɛri Naa Dauda, dama bɛ daa bi bɔr ni bɛ kpe tiŋ puuni ka so nya ba.
en: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were standing by at En-rogel. A female servant would come and report to them, and they would then travel and report to King David because they couldnt risk being seen entering the city.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Mɔabnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi tiligi.
en: They killed about , strong and brave men from Moab. Not one Moabite man escaped.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu, ka o dii teei zaa zani ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: He placed his hands on her, and at once she stood up straight and praised God.

dag: To, lala zuɣu m bi zɔrila yiriŋ; m mi bi be kaman chɔriŋmɛra ŋun ŋmɛri pɔhim.
en: That is why I run straight for the finish line; that is why I am like a boxer who does not waste his punches.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa boli Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba na.
en: Then Joshua called together the people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpiri nyo wurigu mi.
en: He will come ready to clean the grain. He will separate the good grain from the straw, and he will put the good part into his barn. Then he will burn the useless part with a fire that cannot be stopped.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka niriba ni ti bɔhi, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be? Darigim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yih a daba ʒim maa tibili ka timaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: Why should the nations say, Wheres their God now? Let vengeance for the spilled blood of your servants be known among the nations before our very eyes!.

dag: Jɔn ni daa ti mirit o tuma naabu o daa bɔhi niriba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka lan ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M pala yi ni yuuni so sol la. Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna, hal man pɔri ni n ti damd o tooni n-gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi gba. .
en: As John was completing his mission, he said, Who do you think I am? Im not the one you think I am, but he is coming after me. Im not worthy to loosen his sandals.

dag: Ti daa lola Ijiptinim mini Asirianim alikauli ni bɛ tiri ti bindirigu ka ti diri tiɣira.
en: We made an agreement with Egypt. We also made an agreement with Assyria to get enough bread.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ lala, wula ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni shee lala niŋya la yɛn niŋ pali.
en: But then, how could the words of the Scriptures come true, which say this must happen.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kul bɔrila tin shɛli din so. Tin shɛli din be alizanda ni ka bɛ daa bɔra. Dinzuɣu vi bi mali Naawuni ni bɛ bol o bɛ Naawuni, dama o pun me tiŋ zali ba.
en: But they were waiting for a better country—a heavenly country. So God is not ashamed to be called their God. And he has prepared a city for them.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, chɛ ka n sɔŋsim bɔbu kuhigu ŋɔ paag a.
en: LORD, hear my prayer! Let my cry reach you!.

dag: Jɛhɔiada kum maa nyaaŋa ka Juda kpamba daa kana ti jɛm naa, ka naa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: After Jehoiada died, the leaders of Judah came and bowed to King Joash. The king listened to the leaders.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: He prayed: Lord God of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.

dag: Bɛ ni yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, amaa yinima ni kum ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: My servants will sing with contented hearts, but you will cry out from heartache; with broken spirits you will wail.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhi bol a, ka a fa ba bahi; bɛ daa niŋ a naani ka bi di vi.
en: They called to you for help and escaped their enemies. They trusted you and were not disappointed!.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa yihi anzinfa mini salima binyara ni chinchina ti Ribɛka; ka ti o tizɔdoo maa min o ma gba nachiinsi binshɛŋa din liɣiri galisi pam.
en: Then he brought out clothing and silver and gold jewelry, and gave them to Rebecca. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and to her mother.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ ŋun ka taali ŋɔ zaa yoli mmaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛn wuhi ni m mali taali. Hal n kul ka galimi maa zaa yoli ŋuna n-ni wuhi ni n kul bela galimi ni.
en: If Im innocent, my mouth condemns me; I have integrity; but God declares me perverse.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai.
en: So Solomon constructed the temple and completed it.

dag: Ka o daa be mɔɣu maa ni biɛɣ pihinahi, ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-daa be mɔɣu maa ni, ka malaikanim daa kanna nti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: He stayed there for days while Satan tested him. Jesus was with the wild animals, but angels took care of him.

dag: Leedan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn bidibisi ni yino la daa nyɛla zuliya pam zaŋ tabil o bia Jɛhiɛl daŋ niriba yabidoo.
en: Ladan was from Gershons family. Jehieli was one of the leaders of the tribe of Ladan.

dag: dama o ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ titali ti Duuma sani. O ti ku nyu wain bee binnyura din mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti pal o la saha shɛl o ma ni dɔɣ o.
en: John will be great in the Lord's sight. He must not drink any wine or strong drink. From his very birth he will be filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpiɔŋ hal ti liri la zuɣusaa tɔbbihi, bɛna n-nyɛ saŋmarisi n-daa vooi bɛ shɛb bahi tiŋ na n-du tam bɛ zuɣu nɔra.
en: It grew as high as the heavenly forces, until it finally threw some of them and some of the stars down to the earth. Then it trampled on them.

dag: Ʒiɛmana kanimina ka vuura, amaa dunia ŋɔ din kul ni beni sahakam.
en: People live and people die, but the earth continues forever.

dag: ka yi bi lan chɛ ka o gbib o ba min o ma maa gba.
en: You won't let those people help their parents.

dag: n-zaŋ o dalinli tabili ti, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: He put his mark on us to show that we are his. Yes, he put his Spirit in our hearts as the first payment that guarantees all that he will give us.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, dama bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli leei bɛ bin jɛmdili nyɛla be niŋgbuŋ kɔre; bɛ nyuri bara la di ni simdi ni vi mali ba shɛli zuɣu, ka bɛ baɣa kul bela dunia ŋɔ binyara ni kɔŋko.
en: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.

dag: Ka Juda daa ti nya Keenan do so ŋun yuli daa booni Shua la bipuɣiŋga n-kpuɣ o; ka daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: There Judah met a young Canaanite woman whose father was named Shua. He married her.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha, ka Zimiri daa di nam ʒini Tiriza daba ayopɔin. Di saha maa Izraɛl tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti teei gilila Gibɛtɔn din be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: In the twenty-seventh year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, Zimri ruled in Tirzah over Israel for seven days. The Israelite troops were besieging the city of Gibbethon in Philistia.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Atad kabɔɣili din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la shee, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum nandahima kumsi nimaani; ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daba ayopɔin kum o ba kuli nimaani.
en: When they arrived at the threshing floor of Atad on the other side of the Jordan River, they observed a solemn, deeply sorrowful period of mourning. He grieved seven days for his father.

dag: Ka o daa ti lihi nya kɔbiliga ka di do mɔɣu ni, ka piɛri tiɣisi do ʒii buta gil li, dama kɔbiliga maa ni kom ka bɛ daa ŋɔŋdi nyuhiri ba, ka kuɣ yɛlinli daa pa di noli zuɣu.
en: he looked out in a field and saw a well where shepherds took their sheep for water. Three flocks of sheep were lying around the well, which was covered with a large rock.

dag: Hal yi daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, Sinai Zoli gbini, ka o daa je suli n- yɛn kun ya.
en: Even at Horeb you angered the LORD! He was so enraged by you that he threatened to wipe you out.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Nyama, n lan nya dimbɔŋɔ, n zaŋla binshɛŋa pahi di tab ni ni m baŋ di laasabu.
en: Yes, said the Philosopher, I found this out little by little while I was looking for answers.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ omaŋ pahi ninvuɣ nɛma zaa ni mali tahima, dama ba nɛɔŋ so gbuɣin kpiŋ.
en: There is hope for those who are still alive—it does not matter who they are. But this saying is true: A living dog is better than a dead lion.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul mal o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa puuni yɛla bilisir o suhu ni saha shɛli maa ka Kɔniilius tuumba maa bɔhi n-kana ti ʒe Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzab yiŋ maa dunol ni.
en: Peter was bewildered about the meaning of the vision. Just then, the messengers sent by Cornelius discovered the whereabouts of Simons house and arrived at the gate.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun yuli daa booni Siiva bidibis ayopɔin n-daa niŋdi lala maa.
en: Seven brothers, who were the sons of a Jewish High Priest named Sceva, were doing this.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisiya pam ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: When the men heard this, they became very angry. They shouted, Great is Artemis, the goddess of Ephesus.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Biŋkɔb kara anahi maa wuhirila nanima anahi bɛn ti yɛn yiɣisi zani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: These four giant beasts are four kings that will rise up from the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa, ka po ni o ni chɛ ka bɛ kpi yɔɣu maa ni.
en: So you threatened them by saying, I'll kill you out here in the desert!.

dag: Chɛ ka naa maa yuli ku kpi, ka chɛ ka o yul kul beni kaman wuntaŋ ni beni shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa nya alibarika o zuɣu. Ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa bol o alibarika naa.
en: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kalima anahi ni ʒe m-baɣi chɛrubinim maa. Kalinli yini daa ʒe m-baɣi la chɛrubi yino kam. Kalima maa daa ŋmanila diɣi n-nyaɣisira.
en: I also saw that there were four wheels, all alike, one beside each creature. The wheels shone like precious stones, and each one had another wheel which intersected it at right angles.

dag: Dama Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛli naa, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria dunɔdal ni la.
en: Because when the man of God said to the king, At this time tomorrow two seahs of barley will sell for a shekel at Samarias gate, and one seah of wheat flour will sell for a shekel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋdimi ni di chɛ ka tiŋgbani tiɣi kom, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ dabari ka ka buchi, ni di chɛ ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni.
en: to saturate dry wasteland and make grass sprout?.

dag: N ku zaŋ binshɛli naɣila n nachimba ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli ma chaŋ la ni pun di shɛl la; amaa naɣ chɛ ka Anɛr mini Ɛshikol ni Mamri n-yihi bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli di ni.
en: The only exception is that the young men may keep whatever they have taken to eat, and the men who went with me—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre—may keep their share.

dag: O chɛ ka tom pali n ni, ka chɛ ka n di wahala.
en: He gave me this poison to drink. He filled me with this bitter drink.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi ni kpiimba be nimaani, ka o saamba be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.

dag: O yihiri nanim nam ni, ka chɛri ka bɛ leeri bɛn pa shɛli.
en: He brings down powerful rulers and reduces them to nothing.

dag: N daa bela Jɔpa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka n nya binshɛli din kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la ʒii puuni, ka di yi zuɣusaa sirigiri n sanna.
en: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima tɔb ni zoya zuɣu.
en: Zebulun is a people that readily risked death; Naphtali too in the high countryside.

dag: Bɛ laɣimmi naai noli, ka lo nia biɛɣu jɛnd a.
en: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are.

dag: Naawuni Bia maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam labisi omaŋmaŋ sani. Naawuni deeri sandaani la o Bia maa ʒim din daa yi dapulli zuɣu la zuɣu, ka zaŋdi binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni mini din be alizanda ni n-labisiri omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.

dag: Malimiya yi binyɛra zaa mini yi binshɛŋa din nyɛ biŋkɔbiri gbana ni buhi kɔbiri binyara zaa ni dari binyara zaa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: You must also purify every piece of clothing and everything made of leather, goats' hair, or wood.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi gba lala.
en: Then they used blue cloth to make loops along the edge of the end curtain of one group. And they did the same on the end curtain in the other group.

dag: N dolila wuntia soli ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: I walk the way of righteousness; I follow the paths of justice.

dag: O daa yɛlimi, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma m-pal o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli.
en: He said, Praise the Lord God of Israel! He has kept the promise he made to my father David, when he told him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tiligira ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiligi Yaakubu zuliya bɛn niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Then a redeemer will come to Zion to save the people of Jacob who have turned away from sin.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Piimiya yi ni na yoli gbahi zahin shɛb maa ni na.
en: Jesus said to them, Bring some of the fish that youve just caught.

dag: dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi ni nabipuɣinsi ni Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaa be Ahikam bia Shafan san la chaŋ. Bɛ daa zaŋ anabi Jɛrimia mini Nɛria bia Baruk gba chaŋ.
en: Now Johanan and all the army officers took all the men, women, and children and led them to Egypt. Among those people were the kings daughters. Johanan also took Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.

dag: Dama alahichi ku lan tooi sun ya yi ni yi fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni kpe Naawuni daalibarika sulinsi ni la zuɣu.
en: Sin will not be your master, because you are not under law. You now live under Gods grace.

dag: M maŋmaŋ ni bo shɛhiradiriba ayi shɛb n ni dihi tabili. Bɛna n-nyɛ maligumaana Yuria mini Zakaria ŋun nyɛ Jɛbɛrikia bia la.
en: Get two reliable men, the priest Uriah and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah, to serve as witnesses.

dag: Ka bulaa la mi wuhiri Giriis naa yɛla. Ka o yil gahindili din daa sa o nina ayi sunsuuni la nyɛla di tuuli naa.
en: The goat represents the kingdom of Greece, and the prominent horn between his eyes is the first king.

dag: amaa yi ni kpi kaman sal kam ni kpiri shɛm; ka yi nyɛviya zani tariga kaman naa kam la.
en: But you will die as all people must die. Your life will end like that of any ruler.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa balim Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, chɛ ka a ni daa tim do so na la lan lab ti sanna nti wuhi ti ti ni ti yɛn niŋ bi so ti ni yɛn dɔɣi maa shɛm.
en: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord , Please, Lord , let the man of God that you sent come back to us and tell us what we must do with the boy when he is born.

dag: Naa suhu yi ti piɛla, alaafee benimi. Ka o nirilim ŋmanila sagbana din tahiri siɣili saa na.
en: The king's favor is like the clouds that bring rain in the springtime—life is there.

dag: Yuuni kam puuni ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni tɔhiri anzinfa giram diba anu, ka bɛ mal li tumdi ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma.
en: Every year we will each contribute one-eighth of an ounce of silver to help pay the expenses of the Temple.

dag: Ka Yisa bol o, Mariama! Ka o ŋmalig o polo ka yɛli Hiburuli ni, Rabɔni! Di gbinni nyɛla, Karimba.
en: Jesus said to her, Mary. She turned and said to him in Aramaic, Rabbouni .

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti yɛn bahi yoli ŋɔ zuɣu, di simdi ni yi nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔnima? Di niŋ kamaata ni yi bebu be kasi, ka yi nyɛ bɛn luri Naawuni sizuura binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Since all these things will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people should you be? Your lives should be holy and dedicated to God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ bolim o na. Ka bɛ daa bol zom maa ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma! Yiɣisima, o boon a.
en: Jesus stopped and said, Call him forward. They called the blind man, Be encouraged! Get up! Hes calling you.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka gom gbaarila nira, ka ŋun je ni o ni bii ni gbe kum.
en: Go ahead and be lazy; sleep on, but you will go hungry.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kani, yin zaŋmiy o binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi maa ti o bidibisi maa ka bɛ ye, ka yi booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba.
en: Aaron's priestly garments are to be handed on to his sons after his death, for them to wear when they are ordained.

dag: Chamiya gili Ziɔn zaa, ka kaliya di pihi la.
en: Walk around Zion; go all the way around it; count its towers.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu na nti yɛli zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo n-chɛ ka niriba maa zaa ŋum bɛ kparima ni niŋ Yawɛ la.
en: The men whom Moses sent out to explore the land had returned and caused the entire community to complain against him by starting a rumor about the land.

dag: Ka so yi ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ni yo ka deei li, dindina omaŋmaŋ yi nya liɣiri ka ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If there is not a close relative to buy back the land, the person might get enough money to buy it back.

dag: Abigeel ni daa ti kul nya Dauda, o dii sheela o buŋ maa zuɣu na yom lu n-gbani Dauda tooni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: When Abigail saw David, she quickly dismounted and threw herself on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa ni ti yɛli bɛn ʒe o nudirigu polo la, Yinim bɛn mal alibarika m Ba Naawuni sani ŋɔ, kamiyana ti di nam shɛli o ni daa pun zaŋ zali ya tum dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: Then the King will say to the people on his right, Come, you that are blessed by my Father! Come and possess the kingdom which has been prepared for you ever since the creation of the world.

dag: Jɛra tuma nyɛla din gbarigiri ba, hal ka bɛ bi lan mi yiŋ soli gba.
en: The hard work of fools tires them out because they dont even know the way to town!.

dag: Nyini n-nam ba, ka bɛ beni, ka zooi n-dɔɣi bihi, ka a yɛla kul be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni nyini.
en: You plant them, and they take root; they flourish and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.

dag: ka Kɔra nyɛ Izar bia, ka Izar nyɛ Kɔhat bia, ka Kɔhat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi mi daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia.
en: Korah was Izhars son; Izhar was Kohaths son; Kohath was Levis son; Levi was Israels son.

dag: ka n chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni a ku kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga n-ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: I want you to make a vow in the name of the Lord , the God of heaven and earth, that you will not choose a wife for my son from the people here in Canaan.

dag: Bɛ ni yino yuli n-daa booni Gɛrishom, dama o daa yɛlimi, N nyɛla sana m-be saan tiŋa.
en: Jethro also brought Moses two sons with him. The first son was named Gershom, because when he was born, Moses said, I am a stranger in a foreign country.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dii yi Mizipa na n-kar doli Filistianim maa n-kuri ba hal ti miri Bɛtikar.
en: The men of Israel ran out of Mizpah and chased the Philistines all the way to Beth Car. They killed Philistine soldiers all along the way.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim nyɛla bɛn fari niriba mini ŋmɛnditoya. Bɛ muɣisiri faranim mini nandaamba, ka fari saamba nɛma, ka bi labisiri li tiri ba.
en: The people themselves cheat and rob; they abuse the poor and take advantage of foreigners.

dag: N ni daa kul tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla saha shɛli, ka n daa nya malaika ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣina. O daa nyɛla ŋun niŋ shili gu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I was looking at those things in the vision while lying on my bed. And then I saw a holy angel coming down from heaven.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim tiɣisirila tab ʒiina, ka zuɣulaannim laɣindi tɔri jina jɛndiri Yawɛ min o ni pii na so la yɛra.
en: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.

dag: Dinzuɣu malaikanim lee nyɛla bɔ? Bɛ nyɛla shihi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ o ni timdi shɛb ka bɛ ti sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn nyari tiliginsim.
en: Arent all the angels ministering spirits who are sent to serve those who are going to inherit salvation?.

dag: Miriya ka yi saɣim yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa, dama ninvuɣ kubo nyɛla din saɣindi tiŋgbani. Binshɛli kani ka yi ni tooi zaŋ mali tiŋgbani maa naɣila ninvuɣ so ŋun ku nir maa ʒim.
en: Dont let your land be polluted with innocent blood. If a person murders someone, the only payment for that crime is that the murderer must be killed! There is no other payment that will free the land from that crime.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni, gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanu dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the fifteenth day of that same month, the Lord said:.

dag: Bɛ yi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka lo ni bɛ yi a nyaaŋa n-niŋ a shɛli, bɛ ku di nasara.
en: That is because they made evil plans against you. They wanted to do things they could not do.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa yihi Izraɛlnim zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gbilligbilli.
en: On that day the Lord brought the Israelite tribes out of Egypt.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must keep my sabbaths and treat my sanctuary with respect; I am the LORD.

dag: Nyama, ka anabi so daa kana ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Nyama, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka a baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: At that very moment, a prophet ran up to Ahab and said, You can see that Benhadad's army is very strong. But the Lord has promised to help you defeat them today. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, nyini Ayuba, wummi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa zaa.
en: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni gbiri anzinfa luɣ shɛli beni, ka bɛ ni doori salima luɣ shɛli beni.
en: There are mines where silver is dug; There are places where gold is refined.

dag: ka zaŋ niriba maa zaa labina ti ti a kaman amiliya n-kul o yidan yili la. Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko ka a bɔr ni a ku ka chɛ bɛnkam kpalim zaa ka bɛ suhu doya.
en: Then I will bring all the people back to you. If David is dead, all the people will come back in peace.

dag: Fabila maa m-bala. Zaŋmiya li yili yila. Zuliya kam paɣiba ni zaŋ li yili yila. Bɛ ni zaŋ li yili yila Ijipti mini di tɔbbihi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This solemn warning will become a funeral song. The women of the nations will sing it to mourn for Egypt and all its people. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: N ni labi laŋ piri ba saha shɛli bɛ ni chani maa. N ni siɣisi ba tiŋ na kaman noombihi la. N ni fiɛb ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli niŋ a. O ni gul a nyɛvili.
en: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dinzuɣu zaŋm a yɛlimaŋli maa m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Dedicate them to yourself by means of the truth; your word is truth.

dag: N ku chɛ ka n suhu ŋmaligi ka chɛ din tuhi. N ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I will not be dishonest and will have no dealings with evil.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi kpuɣi di ni wuhi ni yi saɣimmi binshɛɣukam maa ni binshɛli, dama yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni bo yɛla ti Izraɛlnima, ka di bahi ba yoli bɛ sansan ni.
en: Remember, we must destroy everything else. Dont take anything. If you take anything and bring it into our camp, you yourselves will be destroyed, and you will cause trouble for the rest of our people.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa labina di saha maa ti ŋme n-deei Hazɔr, ka zaŋ takɔb ku di naa, dama Hazɔr n-daa nyɛ nama maa zaa tin zuɣu.
en: Joshua then turned back, captured Hazor and killed its king.

dag: Hashabia ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛmuɛl bia la n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni kpɛma. Aduna zuliya ni, Zadok n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma;.
en: Hashabiah son of Kemuel, leader of the tribe of Levi; Zadok, leader of the people of Aaron;.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kikahi piɛbbu mini tɔbu zambu bubu dabisili din yɛn lu bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa mini bɛn wɔɣila din du pam zuɣu.
en: a day for blowing the trumpet and alarm against their invincible cities and against their high towers.

dag: Ka n daa bahi noli ni bɛ vihim yɛlli maa, ka bɛ daa vihi n-nya ka kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ tiŋ maa shiri nyɛla tin shɛli din bi zani tuhi nam fukumsi, ka duŋtaariba mini gadamanima n-kul pali di ni.
en: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi ni o kar o naba ti balim o zaŋ o lab o yiŋa. Lɛvi zuliya doo maa daa zaŋla o tumtumda pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ buns ayi chaŋ. Ka o daa mali ti paari paɣ maa ba yiŋa, ka paɣ maa ba maa nya o ka chaŋ ti tuh o soli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Then her husband set out after her to convince her to come back. He had his servant and a couple of donkeys with him. She took him into her fathers house, and when the young womans father saw him, he was happy to welcome him.

dag: Sool suhu daa na kul yiɣisiri bahirila ti Duuma nyaandoliba zuɣu, ka kul kpɛhiri ba dabiɛm ni o ni ku ba; ka daa chaŋ maligumaaniba zuɣulan sani.
en: In the meantime Saul kept up his violent threats of murder against the followers of the Lord. He went to the High Priest.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n yɛma ŋma; kpaŋsim ma kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I am overcome by sorrow; strengthen me, as you have promised.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba; ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum ti luri pam; amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. There will be earthquakes in many places, and people will starve to death. But this is just the beginning of troubles.

dag: N wum ka a ba yɛr a biɛli Iso.
en: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, Listen, I heard your father talking to your brother Esau.

dag: Chuɣu maa puhi naai dali n-daa nyɛ chuɣu maa dabisi tital dali, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi zani kuhi yɛli, Kɔnyuri yi wum so, ŋun kam n sanna ti nyu.
en: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: Everyone will hate you because you follow me.

dag: Nyama, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na, nyin zaŋm mi ʒiɛ shɛl a ni zaŋ tiri takɔro ni ka ti dol li yina ŋɔ n-lo a yiŋ maa takɔro maa, ka laɣim a ba min a ma ni a mabihi ni a ba yiŋnim zaa na nti niŋ a yiŋ maa ni.
