en: When we come back to this land, you must tie in your window this red rope you are using to help us escape. You must bring your father, your mother, your brothers, and all your family into your house with you.

dag: Hal yi naɣikɔra mini bunsi bɛn kɔri yi puri ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ soobul mini soobul jɛba yɛli bindir shɛli.
en: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.

dag: Amaa biɛɣu yi neei bee di yi niŋ daba ayi ka dabili maa kpaŋ, di bi simdi ni bɛ darig o tibili dama ŋuna n-su dabili maa.
en: But if the slave gets up after a day or two, the slave owner shouldnt be punished because the slave is the owners property.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli din zaŋ di nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni n-jɛmd o, n ni chɛ di zuliya maa ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ be nimaani kɔra. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.

dag: Ka bɛ daa be Ijipti n-tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma. Bɛ bilim ni ka bɛ daa kul tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma maa. Nimaani ka bɛ daa tabisi bɛ biha, ka zaŋ ba saɣim.
en: They became prostitutes in Egypt while they were still young girls. Thats where they first let men touch and handle their young breasts.

dag: Masia ni daa di wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni shɛm la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi gba zaŋ o tɛha maa tatabo kpaŋsi yimaŋa, dama ŋunkam diri wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni, o bi lan zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri alahichi tumbu ni.
en: Christ suffered while he was in his body. So you should strengthen yourselves with the same kind of thinking Christ had. The one who accepts suffering in this life has clearly decided to stop sinning.

dag: Jahat n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka Ziza pa o zuɣu. Amaa Jɛushi mini Bɛraya bɛn daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi pam, dinzuɣu bɛ daa zaŋ ba leela daŋ yini niriba.
en: Jahath was the first, and Ziza the second; since Jeush and Beriah didnt have many children, they became a single household.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin cham ti wuh o o taali maa a min o kɔŋko. O yi deeg o galimi, a zaŋ o labisi yi mabiligu maa puuni yaha m-bala.
en: If your brother or sister sins against you, go and correct them when you are alone together. If they listen to you, then youve won over your brother or sister.

dag: N zahimya ni ti ni diri wahala shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ bi saɣi shɛli ni ti zaŋ li buɣisi jilima shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn ti ti la.
en: I believe that the present suffering is nothing compared to the coming glory that is going to be revealed to us.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuma ata puuni, Mɔabnim ni ti kɔŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli saha biɛla puuni kaman padiriba saha ni bi galisi shɛm la. Bɛ ni kul galisi maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, ka bɛ mi ku mali yaa.
en: And now the Lord says, In three years all those people and the things they are proud of will be gone. Only a few of their weakest people will be left.

dag: Ka salindooriba mini kɔhigɔriba daa mali me zuɣusaa duu din be gɔŋbu shee la mini Piɛri Dunɔdali sunsuuni la.
en: And between the upper room of the corner and the Sheep Gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

dag: Binshɛɣukam ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla n dini, bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi yi bidib shɛb zaa mini yi niɣi ni yi piɛri ni tuui dɔɣi naɣila shɛb ni piɛla shɛb zaa nyɛla n dini.
en: Every first-born son and first-born male domestic animal belongs to me.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ pia puuni ninvuɣ yino yi kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni ku o gba. O ni bemi kaman oki ti shɛli bɛ ni ŋma n-luhi ka chɛ di tigbirigu. Tigbirigu maa nyɛla bimbirili din be kasi din ni lan zooi yaha.
en: Even if one person out of ten remains in the land, he too will be destroyed; he will be like the stump of an oak tree that has been cut down.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Farisii, ka o yuli booni Gamaliɛl ka o daa nyɛ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu karimba so sokam ni tiri jilima la daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ni bɛ na zaŋmi Yisa tuumba maa yi kpaŋ pɔi.
en: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi yi taali ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu yihi yimaŋa Masia ni, ka lan ka Naawuni daalibarika puuni.
en: You people who are trying to be made righteous by the Law have been estranged from Christ. You have fallen away from grace!.

dag: Lɛvinim daŋ ni: Jɔzabad mini Shimɛi ni Kɛlaya, bɛ ni daa lan booni la ni Pɛtahia ni Juda ni Ɛliɛza.
en: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

dag: Ka n ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa shɛli yɛla. Bɛ tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be.
en: Their past sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they have done right.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, so di lan muɣisiri ma, dama m mali wulɛ shɛŋa din be n niŋgbuŋ ni n-wuhiri ni n nyɛla Yisa ni su so.
en: From now on, no one should bother me because I bear the marks of Jesus on my body.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuun biɛ shɛli nyaŋ a, amaa nyin zaŋmi zaɣ suŋ niŋbu nyaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Do not let evil defeat you; instead, conquer evil with good.

dag: dama n yɛri ya mi ni zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ hal ka Naawuni nam ti kana.
en: I tell you that from now on I wont drink from the fruit of the vine until Gods kingdom has come.

dag: Nyama, timbil din ʒiɛya ŋɔ nyɛla din mirina ka nir ni zo nti kpe di ni. Chɛliya ka n zo nti kpe di ni tiligi. Yi nya di ni nyɛ timbil shɛm, ka m mi ni tooi zo nti kpe di ni tiligi.
en: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.

dag: Jɛrilim tuma tirila ŋun ka yɛm suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun mali tɛhi zilima ŋun tumdila din tuhi.
en: Stupid people are happy with their foolishness, but the wise will do what is right.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya ti ti bɛ suɣa zali gbilligbilli nuzaa polo. Dan zuliya niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza.
en: On the north will be the banner of Dans camp with its military units. The chief of the people of Dan is Ahiezer, Ammishaddais son.

dag: Buni chɛ ka nir nyarila zɔnim pam, amaa faranim bɛn ka zɔnima.
en: Wealth will bring you many friends, but become poor and your friends will leave you.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi bimbin ni na yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa, a saria karibu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi.
en: Then I heard a voice from the altar saying, Lord God Almighty! True and just indeed are your judgments.

dag: ni Hɔrima naa ni Arad naa.
en: the king of Hormah one.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn niŋ lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn laɣim wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku, ka wuntizɔriba maa pahi ninvuɣ biɛri maa zuɣu nya tibidarigibo. Di niŋ lala! Nyin ŋun nyɛ dunianim zaa sariakarita ŋɔ ku niŋ din tuhi.
en: You surely wouldn't let them be killed when you destroy the evil ones. You are the judge of all the earth, and you do what is right.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam ni o ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else Manasseh did while he was king, including his terrible sins, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: N kɔre yi daa kpe paɣa ni, ka n do n kpee yiŋ dunol ni gul o.
en: If I have desired another woman or waited at my neighbors door to sin with his wife.

dag: Amaa Ashurinim ni ti gbahi yinim Kɛnnim ti leei daba, ka kun ya.
en: But you Kenites will be destroyed When Assyria takes you captive.

dag: Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim kuhiya, ka bɛ kuhigu maa chaŋ ti paai Jahaz mini Zɔa ni Hɔrɔnaim ni Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama hal Nimrim kom gba nyuuya.
en: Screams are heard from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz; their cries resound from Zoar to Horonaim and Eglath-shelishiyah. Even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa pii fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni ti Lɛvinima kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: Since the Lord had said this, the leaders of the other Israelite tribes agreed to give some of the towns and pastures from their tribal lands to Levi.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka zaŋ o leei ti yɛm mini ti wuntia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali ti ka ti be kasi ni ŋun yihi ti alahichi ni.
en: It is God who has made you part of Christ Jesus. And Christ has become for us wisdom from God. He is the reason we are right with God and pure enough to be in his presence. Christ is the one who set us free from sin.

dag: Pini nyɛla din maani soli tiri nira, di nyɛla din chɛ ka nir tooi nyari ninvuɣ wɔɣira.
en: A gift opens the way for access to important people.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini.
en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years.

dag: Asa daa bi wurim luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa ʒe Yawɛ yim o suhu ni hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: As long as Asa lived, he was completely faithful to the Lord , even though he did not destroy the local shrines.

dag: A ni me goonda shɛŋa gil a tinsi zaa ŋmanila fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi. Bɛ yi kul gbaɣiri li, di lurila ŋun yɛn di li nol ni.
en: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti zani, ka kuhi bahi Izraɛl tɔbbihi na, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lo tɔbu na ni yi ti tuhi ti? Pa Filistia nira n-nyɛ ma? Ka yi mi pala Sool tɔbbihi? Dinzuɣu piimiya yi ni ninvuɣ yino n-chɛ ka o siɣi n sanna.
en: Each day Goliath would come out and shout a challenge to the Israelite soldiers. He would say, Why are all of your soldiers lined up ready for battle? You are Sauls servants. I am a Philistine. So choose one man and send him to fight me.

dag: Amaa n ni mali tahima sahakam; ka kul ni paɣir a waawaayili.
en: Then I will always trust in you and praise you more and more.

dag: Tɔb daa yi ti lu Naa Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni saha shɛlikam, di saha Abinɛr nyarila yaa Sool niriba maa sani.
en: Throughout the war between Sauls house and Davids house, Abner was gaining power in Sauls house.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima zaa niŋla buni nyaɣisim dibu ni, bɛ ni ti chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: They spend their days contentedly, go down to the grave peacefully.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo o zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o niŋ gampiliga ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan wum o kukoli Izraɛl zoya zuɣu yaha.
en: They put him in a cage and took him to Babylonia. The lion was locked away, so that his mighty roar would never again be heard on Israel's hills.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa kul niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Bɛ ni daa tiri bɛ suɣa ʒiini bɛ tuutanim gbini shɛm, lala ka sokam min o malibu daa doli chani kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Israelites did everything exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses: they camped under their banners and they marched by their clans and by their households.

dag: Bɛ yi kɔhi a ʒilɛl ni Yɛhudia doo bee paɣa a zuɣu, ka o tum tuma ti a yuma ayɔbu, yuun shɛli din pahira ayopɔin ni, nyin bahimi dilana ka o chaŋ.
en: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Abimilɛk daa kpah o niriba zuɣu ni yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ doo ŋɔ bee o paɣ ŋɔ shɛli, bɛn kum o.
en: Abimelech warned all the people: Anyone who mistreats this man or his wife will be put to death.

dag: Yɛhudia do so daa be Susa din nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni ka o yuli booni Mɔdɛkai. O daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira. Mɔdɛkai ba n-daa nyɛ Jair. O yaba n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi, ka o yab do kurili mi nyɛ Kish.
en: Now there was a Jew in the fortified part of Susa whose name was Mordecai, Jairs son. He came from the family line of Shimei and Kish; he was a Benjaminite. .

dag: Ka n yɛli, N ni du abie tia maa, n-gbaai di wula gbibi. N suhigu nyɛla a biha kul be kaman wain wala yila la, ka a vuhim ʒiɛɣu ŋmani apil nyom.
en: I say, I will climb the palm tree; I will hold its fruit! May your breasts be now like grape clusters, and the scent of your breath like apples!.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na n-zɔri chani tiŋgban nɛli zuɣu kaman mɔɣili la.
en: He split the rock, and water came bubbling out. A river began flowing in the desert!.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, yi suɣa viɛli pam. Izraɛlnima, yi doo viɛli pam!.
en: The tents of Israel are beautiful.

dag: Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Bɔzuɣu ka bidibiga ku di wahala o ba tuumbiɛri zuɣu? Bidibiga maa yi nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, ka nyɛ ŋun doli n zaligunim zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: You might ask, Why will the son not be punished for his fathers sins? The reason is that the son was fair and did good things. He very carefully obeyed my laws, so he will live.

dag: N nyala putɔɣu yɛl shɛŋa din niŋdi ʒii. Di nyɛla nyaanyira ni ŋun tumdi saɣiŋgu tuma ʒii. Ɛlam tɔbbihi, lirimiya ba. Miidia tɔbbihi, dɔnimiya gili tinsi gu. Naawuni ni chɛ ka Babilɔnnim ni tahi wahala shɛli na maa zan tariga.
en: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin maa ni yino kana nti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun du n-ʒi kulisi koma zuɣu ŋɔ saria karibu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: One of the seven angels came and spoke to me. This was one of the angels that had the seven bowls. The angel said, Come, and I will show you the punishment that will be given to the famous prostitute. She is the one sitting over many waters.

dag: Ka Anakinim maa ni so daa lan ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, naɣila Gaza mini Gaat ni Ashidɔd ka bɛ ni shɛb daa be.
en: There were no Anakites left living in the land of Israel. The only Anakites who were left alive were in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

dag: hal n ni nyɛla ŋun daa yɛr o zilima ka niŋd o alaka ka tur o la zaa yoli. Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu, dama n daa niŋ li la ʒilinsi ni n ni daa na bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: In the past I insulted Christ. As a proud and violent man, I persecuted his people. But God gave me mercy because I did not know what I was doing. I did that before I became a believer.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o biɛhigu shee. O yɛliya, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm, ka pirigi Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: From his sanctuary God has said, In triumph I will divide Shechem and distribute Sukkoth Valley to my people.

dag: ka m mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn be n sani ni chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka bɛ yi ti yina ni ti mini ba zaŋ nya taba, ti ni ŋmaligi guui kaman ti ni daa pun niŋ shɛm la.
en: I will approach the city with all the people. When they come out against us the same way as before, we will flee from them.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Nir yi jɛmdi Naawuni, di ka anfaani.
en: He says that it never does any good to try to follow God's will.

dag: Amiram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Jokɛbɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi ni daa dɔɣi bipuɣin so Ijipti la. Ka Jokɛbɛd daa dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Miriam Amiram yiŋa.
en: the husband of Levi's daughter Jochebed, who was born in Egypt. Amram and Jochebed's three children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.

dag: Ka ti gba biɛhigu ŋmani zuliya shɛb biɛhigu, ti naa maa ni su ti, ka ni yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ti tuhi tɔb kam.
en: Then we will be the same as all the other nations. Our king will lead us. He will go before us and fight our battles.

dag: Tuun kpɛma tumbu tiri nir yiko, amaa vinnyaɣili chɛ ka nir leerila dabili.
en: Hard work will give you power; being lazy will make you a slave.

dag: Zahimmiya dimbɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn tam Naawuni yɛla ŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni dari tɔhi ya zaa ka so ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.

dag: Salo maa ni daa baŋ ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nir maa ka bɛ zaŋ kaman awa mun ayi n-duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam! Ɛfɛsusnim buɣili Aritɛmis galisiya pam.
en: but when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison, Great is Artemis of the Ephesians! This continued for about two hours.

dag: Ashidɔd mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi ni Gaza mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ mini Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli tintariga la.
en: Ashdod, its dependent cities and surrounding areas. Gaza, its dependent cities and surrounding areas as far as the border of Egypt and the Mediterranean Sea and its shoreline.

dag: Amaa di saha wuntizɔriba ni ti bela bɛ Ba Naawuni nam ni n-ne kaman wuntaŋ la. Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Then God's people will shine like the sun in their Father's Kingdom. Listen, then, if you have ears!.

dag: Zaŋm a yɛla niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka chɛ ka o tilig a. Chɛ ka o fa o nini ni tiɣi so bahi.
en: and say, Trust the Lord ! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.

dag: Ka Harihaya bia Uziɛl ŋun daa nyɛ machɛli ŋun doori salima la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ tulaale maana la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa lab mali Jɛrusalɛm hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: Uzziel son of Harhaiah repaired the next section of the wall. Uzziel was a goldsmith. Hananiah was one of the perfume makers. These men built and repaired Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli. Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: Even the hairs of your head have all been counted. So do not be afraid; you are worth much more than many sparrows!.

dag: Ka m mi ni o zaligu nyɛla din tiri nyɛvili din ka bahigu. Dinzuɣu n ni yɛri shɛlikam nyɛla m Ba ni wuhi ma ni n yɛli shɛm.
en: I know that his commands will bring eternal life. This is why I tell you exactly what the Father has told me.

dag: Ka Pool daa boli sapashinnim ni yino na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm nachimbil ŋɔ tahi sapashin kpɛm sani; o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl o.
en: So Paul said to one of the army officers, Take this young man to the commander. He has something to tell him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tuumba maa mini yɛdaniŋdib bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa wum ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The apostles and the other believers throughout Judea heard that the Gentiles also had received the word of God.

dag: Yi yi kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi ma, hal yi yi suhi ma kabo, n ku lihi yi polo na; m mi ku wum yi suhigu maa. Yi nuhi tim ʒim ni.
en: When you lift your hands in prayer, I will not look at you. No matter how much you pray, I will not listen, for your hands are covered with blood.

dag: Ka bɛ yi bi gbaai tayiɣ maa, dindina di simdi ka yili maa lana chaŋ Naawuni sani nti wuhi kaman o nuu tim o kpee maa daazichi maa ni bee di bi tim.
en: But if the thief isn't caught, some judges will decide if you are the guilty one.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Vuri mɔni Rama, di nyɛla fabila mini kuhigu pam. Reechɛl n-kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni so di maag o suhu o bihi maa zuɣu, dama bɛ lan kani.
en: The LORD proclaims: A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and wailing. Its Rachel crying for her children; she refuses to be consoled, because her children are no more.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ gili yɛli niriba maa ni bɛ bom bindira m-mali shili gu, dama ni di kpalim daba ata ni bɛ gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: Go through the camp and tell the people, Get some food ready. Three days from now we will go across the Jordan River and take the land that the Lord our God is giving us.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia nyɛla ŋun nyandi dunia ŋɔ. Ti yɛda niŋbu mi n-nyɛ din nyandi dunia ŋɔ.
en: because every child of God is able to defeat the world. And we win the victory over the world by means of our faith.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa ŋmɛnditoya shɛb daa ti yi bɛ suɣa maa ni m-piri tab ʒii buta zuɣu; ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa tin shɛli din yuli booni Ofira ka di be Shual tiŋgban ni la polo.
en: The Philistine soldiers went out on raids from their camp in three groups: one group went toward Ophrah in the territory of Shual.

dag: ka yɛli, Din kariya ni n niŋ lala n Naawuni sani. N ni tooi nyu niriba ŋɔ ʒim ŋɔ? Dama bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ zaŋ pa talima chaŋ ti tooi kom ŋɔ na. Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaɣisi li nyubu maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: and said, I could never drink this! It would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives! So he refused to drink it. These were the brave deeds of the three famous soldiers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuui ʒini nimaani, bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima kana nti gbahi bɛ ni shɛb ku.
en: When they first settled there, they did not worship the Lord , and so he sent lions, which killed some of them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, Fom a noli ka wara.
en: Jesus ordered the spirit, Be quiet, and come out of the man.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam mini alaka balibu kam din yɛla bi sabi zaligu kundi ŋɔ ni lu yi zuɣu hal ti naai yi balibu.
en: Whats more, the LORD will bring on you all the other diseases and plagues that arent written in this Instruction scroll until you are completely wiped out.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, hal bɛ yi yɛn kpɛh a la duu, m min a ni laɣim kpe duu maa; di mi yi nyɛla kum, m min a ni laɣim kpi.
en: Peter said, Lord, I am ready to go with you to jail and even to die with you.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: the Lord said to me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya paɣ maa ka yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai.
en: Jesus turned around and saw her, and said, Courage, my daughter! Your faith has made you well. At that very moment the woman became well.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim naŋgban yini ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Gibianima.
en: So all the Israelites joined together and were united as one against the city.

dag: Chɛ ka zuliya kam suhuri paligi, chɛ ka bɛ yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama a kariti niriba saria ka di tuhi, ka wuhiri zuliya kam soli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, because you judge the peoples with justice and guide every nation on earth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋme n-deei bɛ fɔntinsi mini bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. Dindali maa Mɔab tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka o suhu be shɛm la.
en: The towns will be captured; the strongholds will be seized. On that day, the heart of every soldier from Moab will be like that of a woman in the throes of labor.

dag: A yi zahim n suhu, a yi ka n sanna yuŋ ti buɣisi ma viɛnyɛliŋga, a ni nya ka ninvuɣ biɛtali ka n ni; ka m mi noli bi tumd alahichi.
en: You know my heart. You have come to me at night; you have examined me completely and found no evil desire in me. I speak no evil.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti fiɛb o gba n-dih o vi, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: The man sent another servant. But they beat him, treated him disgracefully, and sent him away empty-handed as well.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A yi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba, dindina a ni tiligi, ka bɛ ku nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim, ka a mini a yiŋnim ku kpi.
en: So Jeremiah said to Zedekiah: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: If you surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, you and your family will live, and this city will not be burned down.

dag: Yinima ŋ-ŋubiri n niriba ka shiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka ŋmari bɛ kɔba ka ŋmahiŋmahi ba kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣubil ni bee kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣutitali ni la.
en: You eat my people up. You strip off their skin, break their bones, and chop them up like meat for the pot.

dag: Ka sandira maa daa damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, N dana, na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: But the servant fell on his knees and begged, Be patient with me. I will pay you everything I owe.

dag: Tizɔra ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka yaalana ti kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka kpiɔŋlana ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ gba, niriba biɛla ka Naawuni piig o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lan labi pahi naba ayi ka Yisifu daa kahig omaŋ n-wuh o biɛyanim maa ka bɛ baŋ o, ka Firawuna gba daa baŋ ŋun Yisifu biɛyanim maa.
en: On the second visit Joseph made himself known to his brothers, and the king of Egypt came to know about Joseph's family.

dag: a yi bo li kaman anzinfa la, ka bo li ni nimmoo kaman azichi shɛli din sɔɣi la.
en: Seek it like silver; search for it like hidden treasure.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul yɛla binshɛŋa din be nimaani zuɣu, ka pa ni binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni zuɣu.
en: Keep your minds fixed on things there, not on things here on earth.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yinyari mini zoontali ni suhufuŋbo be yi suhuri ni;.
en: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused.

dag: Nyama, yinim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, zahimmiya yɛlli maa nya ka wuhi ti ni yɛn gbaai li shɛm.
en: All of you here are Israelites. What are we going to do about this.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpuɣi paɣ so pah o zuɣu, di bi simdi ka o filim o bindirigu bee situra bee n-zaɣis o min o dɔnibu.
en: If the man later marries another woman, he must continue to provide food and clothing for the one he bought and to treat her as a wife.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Naawuni nam lee ŋmanila bɔ bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ li ŋmahindi?.
en: Jesus asked, What is the Kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it with?.

dag: M biyurisi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba, dama yurilim yirila Naawuni sanna; ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka mi Naawuni.
en: Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Whoever loves is a child of God and knows God.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba wum o kukoli din galisi la, ka chɛ ka sokam nya o suhuyiɣisili tuma. O ni ti chɛ ka buɣim dira, ka sagbana bɔɣi, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛra, ka sakuɣa luri na.
en: The LORD will unleash his majestic voice and display his crushing arm in furious anger, with a flame of consuming fire, in stormy rain and hail.

dag: O guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu soli, ka taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim barina ni.
en: He makes sure that people are treated fairly. He watches over his loyal followers.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Lala n-nyɛ ŋun bo n-nya bun la omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, lala nir pala bundana.
en: This is the way it will be for those who hoard things for themselves and arent rich toward God.

dag: N zaŋ n fabila sɔŋla o tooni. N yɛli n yɛlimuɣisira ni nyɛ shɛli o tooni.
en: I tell him my problems; I tell him about my troubles.

dag: Ka Mariama yɛli, Chɛ ka di niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma dabili ŋɔ kaman a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Di saha ka malaika maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: I am the Lord's servant, said Mary; may it happen to me as you have said. And the angel left her.

dag: Ka kum yi ti lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee alɔbo yi ti lu bee bindira yi ti kuura bee maligu bee toli yi ti yina bee zunzuya, ka bee bɛ dimnim yi ti kana nti teei gili ba bɛ tinsi ŋɔ ni zaɣ yin ni, ka alɔbo kam bee dɔr shɛlikam yi ti lu.
en: Whenever there is a famine or plague in the land; or whenever there is blight, mildew, locust, or grasshopper; or whenever someones enemy attacks them in their cities; or any plague or illness comes.

dag: ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pili ba; ka maligumaanitali maa leei bɛ dini sahakam. A ni ti yɛn zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa leei maligumaaniba shɛm m-bala.
en: Tighten the sashes on them, on both Aaron and his sons. Wrap the turbans on their heads. It will be a permanent regulation that the duties of priesthood belong to them. In this way, you will ordain Aaron and his sons.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa mini anabinim maa, Doo ŋɔ bi simdi ni ti ku o, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ka o zaŋ tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then the rulers and all the people spoke. They said to the priests and the prophets, Jeremiah must not be killed. What he told us comes from the Lord our God.

dag: Ka di daa muɣis o pam asibaasi, ka o tim ti boli Ijipti timanim mini baŋdiba zaa na, ka ŋun Firawuna daa yɛli ba o zahima maa, amaa ka so daa kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi Firawuna o zahima maa gbinni.
en: In the morning, he was disturbed and summoned all of Egypts religious experts and all of its advisors. Pharaoh described his dreams to them, but they couldnt interpret them for Pharaoh.

dag: So miri ka o kpuɣ o paɣ mabia pah o zuɣu saha shɛl o paɣ maa ni na be o nyɛvili ni maa.
en: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n fabili niŋ a ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a tib ma.
en: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me.

dag: Kpambaliba bɛn be di ni ŋmanila kunduna n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa, ka kuri niriba ni bɛ doli bibiɛlim soya nya buni.
en: The leaders in Jerusalem are like a wolf eating the animal it has caught. They attack people and kill them just to get rich.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama n yɛn chɛmi ka a be kaman Naawuni la Firawuna sani, ka chɛ ka a mabia Aduna mi nyɛ a daanabi.
en: The Lord said to Moses, See how important I have made you? In speaking to Pharaoh, you will be like God, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.

dag: ni Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Azaz bia la, ka Azaz daa nyɛ Shɛma bia, ka Shɛma daa nyɛ Joɛl bia, Joɛl maa min o niriba n-daa ʒini Aroa zaŋ hal ni Nɛbo mini Baalimiɔn la.
en: and Bela, Azazs son, Shemas grandson, and Joels great-grandson. They lived in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.

dag: ni Sulemaana nɛma duri fɔntinsi ni o chɛchɛbunsi fɔntinsi ni o wɔribariba fɔntinsi m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me mɛr shɛŋa zaa zali Jɛrusalɛm ni Lɛbanɔn ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli o ni daa su maa zaa ni.
en: He also built cities where he could store grain, and he built places for his chariots and his horses. King Solomon also built whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and all the places he ruled.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo mini suhusaɣiŋgu ni birimbu lu yi zuɣu yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛlikam puuni hal ka yi ti kpi yomyom naai zaa yi tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, dama yi zaɣisi ma.
en: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord .

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la ni? Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma Ɛdom?.
en: But, God, it seems that you have left us! You do not go out with our army. So who will lead me into the strong, protected city? Who will lead me into battle against Edom?.

dag: Yɛl biɛri din ka kalinli n-kul gili ma, di galisiya pam. N daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi n zuɣu, ka n ku lan tooi lihi nya binshɛli; di galisi gari n zabiri; ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: I am surrounded by many troubles— too many to count! My sins have caught up with me, and I can no longer see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and I have lost my courage.

dag: Yi zaa laɣimmiya na nti wum! Wun ŋuni n-lee pun yɛli dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla zali? Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so la ni niŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. O ni tuhi Babilɔnnim maa.
en: Assemble and listen, all of you! None of the gods could predict that the man I have chosen would attack Babylon; he will do what I want him to do.

dag: Taɣimiya Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ yuli m bol o, Vuyɔra ŋun zaŋ o daalɔbo bahi.
en: There they call Pharaoh, Egypts king, Loudmouth—Nothing But Hot Air!.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka tiŋgbani mi nyɛ n napɔntamdigu. Ka yil bɔ ka yi lee yɛn me n-ti ma? Bee luɣ shɛli be dunia ŋɔ ni ka n ni ʒini nimaani vuhi?.
en: Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?.

dag: Amaa ka Juda daa yɛl o, Doo maa daa kpahi ti zuɣu ni yɛli, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yin di chɛ ka n ninni nyan ya.
en: Judah said to him, The man was absolutely serious when he said, You may not see me again without your brother with you.

dag: Amaa a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu, n ni tooi kpe a jɛmbu duu nti gbani a duu din be kasi maa puuni ni sizuura.
en: But because of your great love I can come into your house; I can worship in your holy Temple and bow down to you in reverence.

dag: di saha , Yawɛ chɛ ka a daŋ niriba yɛli noli ti a ka zaɣis a; ka chɛ ka a dɔɣibu soli ŋari, ka a leei paɣiŋoo.
en: then the priest must make the woman utter the curse and say to the woman, May the LORD make you a curse and a harmful pledge among your people, when the LORD induces a miscarriage and your womb discharges.

dag: Ti ni daa yuui soli maa ni zuɣu ka barina daa ti yɛn paai ti, ka nolɔbo saha mi pun gari, ka Pool daa saɣisi ba yɛli.
en: Much time had been lost, and the voyage was now dangerous since the Day of Reconciliation had already passed. Paul warned them.

dag: Ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni lo ni n niŋ ba shɛm.
en: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni leei ti sariakarita, o ni woligi ti m min a. O ni lihi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka zani n nyaaŋa n-fa ma a nuu ni bahi.
en: May the LORD be the judge and decide between you and me. May he see what has happened, argue my case, and vindicate me against you.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla galimi n-yo ma yurilim samli, amaa ka man suhiri Naawuni tiri ba.
en: Instead of returning my love, they accuse me— but I am at prayer.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi ba ni bɛ zabbanim yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee Kpaŋa kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: So Mishael and Elzaphan obeyed Moses. They carried the bodies of Nadab and Abihu outside the camp. Nadab and Abihu were still wearing their special woven shirts.

dag: Niriba ata maa daa bi lan garigi Ayuba o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali maa zuɣu.
en: Because Job was convinced of his own innocence, the three men gave up trying to answer him.

dag: Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn la bɛn daa pun deei bɛ tarili. Yawɛ dabili Musa n-daa pun pirigi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: The tribes of Reuben and Gad and the other half of the tribe of Manasseh had already received the land that Moses, the Lord 's servant, had given them; it was on the east side of the Jordan River.

dag: Saha shɛli o ni daa zali pɔhim di tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka buɣisi kom tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm la.
en: When God divided out the wind and the water.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira, ka nyɛ Taasus din be Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi pɔri la tiŋbia. Ka lan yɛl o, N suhir a noli ni a chɛ ka n tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa. .
en: Paul answered, I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of an important city. Please let me speak to the people.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani! Yaa n Naawuni, tiligim ma! A labi n dimnim zaa tapaɣisi, ka ŋme n-kabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina.
en: Stand up, LORD! Save me, my God! In fact, hit all my enemies on the jaw; shatter the teeth of the wicked!.

dag: bee so ti yɛli, Nyamiya, di be kpe! Bee n-yɛli, Di be kpe ha! Dama Naawuni nam maa be yi sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Nor will people say, Look, here it is! or There it is! Dont you see? Gods kingdom is already among you.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisiri Jɛrusalɛmnim Naawuni maa yɛla mi kaman dunianim buɣ shɛŋa niriba ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali la.
en: They talked about the God of Jerusalem in the same way that they talked about the gods of the other peoples, idols made by human hands.

dag: N yi paɣi Naawuni n ni yɛn di bindir shɛli zuɣu, di chaŋ wula ka so ni galim ma n ni paɣi Naawuni bindir shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: I eat the meal with thankfulness. So I dont want to be criticized because of something I thank God for.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuhiri yɛri lala maa ka bɛ mali bɛ binyɛra gahiri ka toori taŋkpaɣu yaɣindi zuɣusaa.
en: As they were screaming, throwing off their garments, and flinging dust into the air.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka yi ni shɛb pam gbarigi ka ka alaafee, ka shɛb mi kpi.
en: Because of this, many of you are weak and sick, and quite a few have died.

dag: N ni yiɣisi labi m ba sani nti yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani.
en: I will go to my father and say to him, Father, I have sinned against God in heaven and against you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi ma polo, n ni sabi Ijiptinim mini Babilɔnnim yuya, ka sabi Filistianim gba mini Taainim ni Itiɔpianim yuya ka yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim gba leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, I was born in Zion.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo, bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa piligila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-zaŋ hal ti du Jɛriko nuzaa polo kuŋkuni n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo ti du zoya zuɣu m-mali hal ti paai di tariga Bɛtavɛn yɔɣu ni.
en: Their border on the north side ran from the Jordan. The border went up to the slope of Jericho on the north. It went up westward in the highlands and ended at the wasteland of Beth-aven.

dag: Nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma bahi? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dimnim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: Because you are my God, my protective fortress! Why have you rejected me? Why do I have to walk around, sad, oppressed by enemies?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Saimɔn, m mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, yɛlim ma.
en: Jesus replied, Simon, I have something to say to you. Teacher, speak, he said.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Naawuni nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa yɛn go, ka bol o yiŋbihi na ti zaŋ o liɣiri pirigi ti ba ni bɛ deei wolimma.
en: At that time the Kingdom of heaven will be like this. Once there was a man who was about to leave home on a trip; he called his servants and put them in charge of his property.

dag: Bɛ yɛli bɛmaŋa, Ti ni nyaŋ ba zaa. Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛma laɣiŋgu shɛhi zaa din be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni buɣim.
en: They said in their hearts, Well kill all of them together! They burned all of Gods meeting places in the land.

dag: Ijipti ŋmanila naɣisa viɛlli, ka viɛbiga yi nuzaa polo na ni o ti tabil o.
en: Egypt is a beautiful, yes, beautiful heifer, but a horsefly from the north is coming to bite her.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika maa daa ti wum ni Pool yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu Bɛria ka chaŋ nimaani gba nti dimdi niriba maa tiba ni ni bɛ taai duŋ.
en: But when the Jews in Thessalonica heard that Paul had preached the word of God in Berea also, they came there and started exciting and stirring up the mobs.

dag: Teem a nuu zuɣusaa tirina. Yihim ma kom din galisi pam ŋɔ ni tiligi ma. Tiligim ma tinzunnim nuu ni.
en: Stretch out your hand from above! Rescue me and deliver me from deep water, from the power of strangers, whose mouths speak lies.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna yiŋa n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: After leaving the palace, Moses prayed.

dag: Ka Pool daa mihigi gariŋga maa bahi buɣim maa ni, ka bi wum biɛrim damli.
en: But Paul shook the snake off into the fire without being harmed at all.

dag: N kul lihirila zoya zuɣu. Ya polo ka n sɔŋsim lee yɛn yina?.
en: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?.

dag: Ti yaannim maa ni daa be Ijipti saha shɛl la, bɛ baɣa daa ka a daalahiziba tuma ni. Bɛ daa tam a yurilim maŋli din galisi la yɛla, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ nyin Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: Lord, our ancestors learned nothing from the miracles you did in Egypt. They forgot your kindness at the Red Sea and rebelled against you.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn pun niŋ yɛda la paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani. Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani. Naawuni daa yɛli dimbɔŋɔ la hal saha shɛl o ni daa pun nam dunia naai la nyaaŋa;.
en: Only we who believe it are able to enter Gods place of rest. As God said, I was angry and made a promise: They will never enter my place of rest. Psalm : But Gods work was finished from the time he made the world.

dag: A mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa cham gilimi Jɛriko goondaa maa napɔŋ yim dahin yini kam n-niŋ lala hal ti paai daba ayɔbu.
en: You and your soldiers are to march around the city once a day for six days.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa: Gbilisim tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni wuhir a shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: Turn your ear and hear the words of the wise; focus your mind on my knowledge.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ bɛ ni daŋ shɛb tinsi tibu. Bɛ daa piila fɔntinsi pinaata Juda mini Simiɔn ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaana la daŋ niriba.
en: The families of the Levite clan of Kohath were the first to be assigned cities. The families who were descended from Aaron the priest were assigned thirteen cities from the territories of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

dag: Tim o o nuhi tuma tarili, ka chɛ ka o tuma paɣ o tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni.
en: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni ti Yisa jilima yu shɛli maa zuɣu la ni chɛ ka sokam bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛn be tiŋgbani puuni ha ni ti gbani o tooni.
en: And so, in honor of the name of Jesus all beings in heaven, on earth, and in the world below will fall on their knees.

dag: Dama, naa kul ni tumla na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ o tooni ni tum shɛli. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi yɛm mini biɛri yoli ni jɛrilim yɛla.
en: I asked myself, What can the next king do that I haven't done? Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.

dag: Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni daba mini bilichinnima ni dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bi be kɔŋkɔba; yi zaa nyɛla zaɣ yini Yisa Masia ni.
en: Now, in Christ, it doesnt matter if you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or free, male or female. You are all the same in Christ Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛm maa na ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi chɛ ka Lɛvinim chaŋ Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm ti deei Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali Izraɛlnim ni bɛ yɔri Yawɛ alikauli suɣili farigu shɛli la na.
en: So the king summoned the chief priest Jehoiada and asked him, Why havent you required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by the LORDs servant Moses and the Israelite assembly for the covenant tent? .

dag: Ka Balaam daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba ni ti bɛ suɣa doya gbilligbilli. Di saha ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na.
en: He looked out across the desert and saw all the Israelites. They were camped with the tribes in their different areas. Then the Spirit of God came on him.

dag: N ni tum shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ti kpalim yoli zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu kul zɔhirimi.
en: Im afraid for you! Perhaps my hard work for you has been for nothing.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa puuni binshɛŋa din daa kpalim ka tɔbbihi maa zaŋ li kalinli daa nyɛla piɛri tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni tuhi pisopɔinnaanu.
en: The following is a list of what was captured by the soldiers, in addition to what they kept for themselves: , sheep and goats, , cattle, , donkeys, and , virgins.

dag: Yawɛ yuli nyɛla din du pam ka mali yaa, ka wuntizɔriba zɔri kpɛri di ni tiligira.
en: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun yiɣisiri zoya ka zoya maa bi mi di yɛla ŋɔ, o suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o lɛbiri li pilina.
en: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.

dag: Dama n yi saɣim yi suhuri, banima n-nyɛ bɛn ni chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli, ka pa ni n ni saɣim yinima ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri maa?.
en: If I make you sad, who will be there to make me glad when you are sad because of me?.

dag: N wahala ŋɔ mini n ni ka kpɛhili shee ŋɔ yɛla tɛha tomi kaman binsom la.
en: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.

dag: O nam maa ni daa ti niŋ yaa naai, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o kpamba bɛn daa ku o ba ŋun daa nyɛ naa la.
en: Once he had secured control over his kingdom, he executed the officials who had assassinated his father the king.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, di daa niŋ o muɣisigu pam, ka o kpaŋ omaŋa m-bɔri soli ni o yihi Daniɛl, ka daa kul be lala nia niŋbu ni hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa laɣim naa sani chu shɛli din daa puhiri chira ayopɔin ni la dali.
en: They all assembled at the time of the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work.

dag: Ka ti zaa daa lu tiŋa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri ma Hiburuli ni, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka? Di to ni a tabigi gɔhi.
en: We all fell to the ground. Then I heard a voice talking to me in Aramaic. The voice said, Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? You are only hurting yourself by fighting me.

dag: Hal Yisa mabihi gba daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka o yiɣiri kaman toli la? O nyeeni firisibu din mali jilima la mali dabiɛm.
en: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ gba nyɛla nɔzaɣisiriba pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka bɛ nya nambɔzɔbo kaman yi ni nya nambɔzɔbo shɛm.
en: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: Take the anointing oil and pour it on Aarons head. This will show that he is chosen for this work.

dag: Dama nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri guri bɛ tɔbiri n-zaŋ bɛ piɛma pa tɔbimii zuɣu n-kpuɣi tiri ni bɛ to ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi zibisim ni.
en: because the wicked have drawn their bows and aimed their arrows to shoot from the shadows at good people.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi di ni daa fo n-dɔni baalim maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ ba na ti zali bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ zani kulino shɛl ni.
en: So they rejoiced because the waves had calmed down; then God led them to the harbor they were hoping for.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim niŋ ya nirilim din ni chɛ ka yi ku yi nimaani chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: Ill make it so that when you leave Egypt, the Egyptians will be kind to you and you wont go away empty-handed.

dag: M mabihi, dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya.
en: Dont be surprised, brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni fa shɛba. Bɛ gbahila bɛ zaa niŋ voya ni bee n-sɔɣi sarikanim ni. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi. Bɛ ŋmanila faɣiri nɛma, ka so ku tooi yɛli ni bɛ chɛl li.
en: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.

dag: Rabishake daa labiya nti wum ni Asiria naa yi Lakishi n-chaŋla Libina ka o mini ba ti tuhiri taba.
en: Meanwhile, the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.

dag: Kunduna ni ti tam bɛ pihi zuɣu kumda, ka yɔbahi be bɛ nayili viɛla puuni kumda. Babilɔn saha miriya, ka di dabisili ku lan tirisi tooni.
en: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!.

dag: A ni ti zaŋla ninsal bindi mali buɣim n-she chi bɔrɔbɔro maa ŋ-ŋub li bɛ ninni.
en: You are to build a fire out of dried human excrement, bake bread on the fire, and eat it where everyone can see you.

dag: Zahimmiya yimaŋa n-nya yi shiri doli yi yɛda niŋbu soli. Buɣisimiya yimaŋa! Yi bi mi ni Masia be yi ni? Di yi pa lala yi daa naɣ bi nyaŋla yimaŋ buɣisibu la.
en: Examine yourselves to see if you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Dont you understand that Jesus Christ is in you? Unless, of course, you fail the test.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ kpiɔŋ jilima. A nirilim zuɣu ka ti di nasara.
en: You give us great victories; in your love you make us triumphant.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim shɛb bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda dim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tiba ni, ka bɛ taai duŋ n-yiɣisi bɛ suhuri bahi Yisa nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: But the Jews who did not have faith in him made the other Gentiles angry and turned them against the Lord's followers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi Musa mini Aduna yɛtɔɣa ka zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim mini Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa polo n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yihim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Nevertheless, the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron about the Israelites and Pharaoh, Egypts king, giving them orders to let the Israelites go from the land of Egypt.

dag: Yi daa zaŋ wuntizɔra taali n-ku o, amaa o bi zaɣisi ya.
en: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi nya Yawɛ ni pii so maa? Niriba ŋɔ zaa ni so bi be kaman ŋuna. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili.
en: Samuel said to all the people, See the man the Lord has chosen. There is no one like Saul among the people. Then the people shouted, Long live the king.

dag: O ni deei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima suhigu, o ku zaɣisi bɛ suhigu.
en: He will hear his forsaken people and listen to their prayer.

dag: ka a zaŋ binyɛra din be kasi yɛli Aduna ka booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni m-mal o, ka o leei maligumaana n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Dress Aaron in the priestly garments, anoint him, and in this way consecrate him, so that he can serve me as priest.

dag: ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmani maa ʒim shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ʒi shɛli din kpalim yi m-bahi sara maligu bimbini maa gbini, di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mali bindir shɛli ka yi bi mi li.
en: But Jesus answered, I have food to eat that you know nothing about.

dag: Yi yi me yil palli, yin niŋm bini kɔɣili yi mɔpilli ti tuui, di yi pa lala so yi yi di zuɣu luna kpi o ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi yili maa zuɣu.
en: When you build a new house, be sure to put a railing around the edge of the roof. Then you will not be responsible if someone falls off and is killed.

dag: Ka Halɔhɛshi bia Shallum ŋun gba daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la min o bipuɣinsi daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.

dag: O daa jɛm Naawuni Zakaria ŋun daa wuh o Naawuni jɛmbu sol la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa jɛmdi Yawɛ saha shɛli maa zaa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: He sought God as long as Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God, was alive. And as long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lola nia biɛɣu jɛndi ma.
en: The Lord said to me, Jeremiah, I know that the people of Judah and the people living in Jerusalem have made secret plans.

dag: ka mali tahima ni mmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti neei kum ni.
en: so that I may perhaps reach the goal of the resurrection of the dead.

dag: Yi bi chaŋ dikiya din lu maa ni ti gu voya shee bee m-mali me gooni ti Izraɛlnima din ni chɛ ka tɔbu ti ku daai li luhi Yawɛ dabisili dali.
en: You have not put soldiers near the broken walls of the city. You have not built walls to protect the family of Israel. So when the day comes for the Lord to punish you, you will lose the war!.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Din kariya, n yi di mi ni m ba lo a zaɣ biɛɣu n naan ku yɛl a.
en: Don't even think such a thing! Jonathan answered. If I knew for sure that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn't I tell you.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni tumtumdiba, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn tumd o yubu ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ.
en: Praise the Lord , all his armies. You are his servants, and you do what he wants.

dag: O pun baai du mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti gbe Gɛba; ka dabiɛm gbaai Ramanima; ka Sool ya Gibianim yi n-zo.
en: The army will cross the river at the Crossing and sleep at Geba. Ramah will be afraid. The people at Gibeah of Saul will run away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ʒeei gom, ka sanʒiɛɣu ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni n-ʒiɛri kom niŋdi bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka di ti yɛn tum ba barina.
en: While they were sailing, Jesus slept. A big storm blew across the lake, and the boat began to fill with water. They were in danger.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni, ka chɛ ka kom zɔri teeni puri.
en: He sends rain on the land and he waters the fields.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛda ni o yi nya turi Masia zuɣu, di so Ijipti azichi, dama o daa lihirila o ni ti yɛn nya laara shɛli dahin shɛl ha la.
en: He thought that the abuses he suffered for Christ were more valuable than the treasures of Egypt, since he was looking forward to the reward.

dag: Di ku ba, a yi niŋ lala, n niriba maa ni ti tam, amaa nyin ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti nyɔtaɣirigu ŋɔ, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ wurim ba, ka bɛ lu.
en: Dont kill them, or my people might forget; instead, by your power shake them up and bring them down, you who are our shield and my Lord.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what Isaiah, Amozs son, saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gɔhi din gabi taba, ka ŋmani danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣi; buɣim ni di ba kaman mokuma la.
en: They are tangled up like thorns, like drunkards in their cups. They are consumed like stubble that is entirely dried up.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn gbaag omaŋmaŋ naɣikpahi ni naɣinyaŋ bee naɣilaa m-mali suhudoo sara maligu, di simdi ka o zaŋla naɣ so ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa ti Yawɛ.
en: When any of you offer one of your cattle as a fellowship offering, it is to be a bull or a cow without any defects.

dag: Bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la ka bɛ daa zaŋ me gooni maa, ka tiŋ maa maŋmaŋ nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The wall was made of jasper. The city was made of pure gold, as pure as glass.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti wummi tin ya n-tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ, ka yi ti Naawuni nyaaŋa kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba maa.
en: Should we then listen to you and do all this great evil, acting unfaithfully toward our God by marrying foreign women.

dag: Yisa kum la tatabo kul bela ti niŋgbuna ni ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili gba tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: We always carry Jesus death around in our bodies so that Jesus life can also be seen in our bodies.

dag: M mabihi, suhimiya sɔŋ yi ma, dama o lan pala m paɣa, m mi lan pala o yidana. Suhimiya ka o yihi pagɔrisigu o kɔbili ni ka yihi zina niŋbu o suhu ni.
en: Level a charge against your mother; plead with her! She is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove prostitution from her presence, and adultery from between her breasts.

dag: Yisa kum la tatabo kul bela ti niŋgbuna ni ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili gba tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: At all times we carry in our mortal bodies the death of Jesus, so that his life also may be seen in our bodies.

dag: O teei gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka n nya biɛrim mini naŋgbantom pam.
en: He besieged me, surrounding me with bitterness and weariness.

dag: Yi niriba ŋmanila zana ni gbahi kparibu shɛba. Bɛ kul gbarigimi do sochira kam zuɣu. Bɛ nyula Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili mini Naawuni tibidarigibo buɣi.
en: Your children passed out; they lay at the head of every street like antelope in a net, filled with the LORDs wrath, with the rebuke of your God.

dag: Nyama, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gind o, ka chɛ ka teeku puuni nyaɣa limsi.
en: look how he spreads lightning across it and covers the seabed.

dag: O suhu zaa daa kul yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu zuɣu, ka din pahi nyɛla o daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini Ashɛrim ŋmahima zaa din be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: he remained completely faithful to the Lord . He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti yɛl o tizo Ɛbɛl, Ti cham mɔɣu ni. Bɛ ni daa ti be mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli, ka Keen yiɣisi lu o tizo Ɛbɛl maa zuɣu n-ku o.
en: Cain said to his brother Abel, Lets go out to the field. When they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

dag: Ka n ni zali yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga la Teeku Ʒiɛɣu noli zaŋ hal ni Filistianim Teeku noli, ka lan zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli tariga. Dama n ni ti zaŋ di niriba maa niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi kari ba.
en: I will give you all the land from the Red Sea to the Mediterranean Sea, and from the desert of Sinai to the Euphrates River. I will let you defeat the people living there and force them all to leave.

dag: Dindali maa ti Duuma ni ti lan zaŋ o niriba bɛn kpalim be tinduya ni la labisi yiŋ na yaha. O ni ti yihi ba Asiria mini Ijipti ni Patrɔs ni Itiɔpia ni Ɛlam ni Babilɔn ni Hamat ni teeku duli tinsi ni teeku noli tinsi ni na.
en: On that day, the Lord will extend his hand a second time to reclaim the survivors of Gods people who are left from Assyria and from Egypt, from Pathros, Cush, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and from the coastlands of the sea.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka foliŋga maa pirigi kom din be di tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa maa buyi. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: God made the dome and separated the waters under the dome from the waters above the dome. And it happened in that way.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ʒiishee leei dabari, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan be bɛ yinsi.
en: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.

dag: Ka Ibram min o paɣa daa zaŋ bɛ ni su binshɛlikam zaa n-yi Ijipti chaŋ Nɛgɛb, ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ.
en: So Abram left Egypt. He traveled through the Negev with his wife and everything he owned. Lot was also with them.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee yɛli ba, Bin shɛli ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suhi ya, Yi zaa piim tibikpara yi ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa la ni ti ma. .
en: But Gideon said to them, May I make one request of you? Everyone give me the earrings from their loot; the Midianites had worn gold earrings because they were Ishmaelites.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini teeku kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: But Jesus replied, Why are you so afraid? You surely don't have much faith. Then he got up and ordered the wind and the waves to calm down. And everything was calm.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma, ka n ti yɔn ya din niŋ kamaata.
en: so he told them, You also go and work in the vineyard, and I will pay you a fair wage.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu waawaayili.
en: He and Jeroboam were constantly at war.

dag: Noombihi shɛb yi ni yɛn chihiri dibu m-bɔŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni yi di ba; bɛ nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu. Bɛna n-nyɛ: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: Eagles, vultures, buzzards, crows, ostriches, hawks, sea gulls, owls, pelicans, storks, herons, hoopoes, and bats are also disgusting, and you are forbidden to eat any of them.

dag: N ni suhiri Naawuni yi zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhiri Naawuni ni yi yurilim mini yi baŋsim maŋli zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni baŋbu zoori pahira.
en: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand.

dag: Di ni tɔɣisi binshɛŋa yɛla zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma so polo ŋɔ daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, ka o zuliya ni so mi daa bi tum maligumaaniba tuma bimbini gbini.
en: And our Lord, of whom these things are said, belonged to a different tribe, and no member of his tribe ever served as a priest.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-yɛn nyɛ yi zaligunima yi ni yɛn be luɣ shɛlikam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: These will be the regulations and case laws for all time in all your settlements.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka gbariti maa leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim; ka bɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la ti leei zuliya shɛli din mali yaa, ka Yawɛ ti su ba Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu sahakam.
en: They are crippled and far from home, but I will make a new beginning with those who are left, and they will become a great nation. I will rule over them on Mount Zion from that time on and forever.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, Zallakudura Naa bi be nuhi ni me du shɛl ni kaman anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la ni ti Duuma yɛliya:.
en: But the Most High God does not live in houses built by human hands. This is what the prophet writes:.

dag: N niriba alahichi tumbu puuni ka bɛ nyari bindirigu, ka bɔri ni bɛ kul tumdi alahichi.
en: You grow rich from the sins of my people, and so you want them to sin more and more.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yiŋa; ka binshɛli bi kpalim n nɛma dur la ni ka m bi zaŋ li wuhi ba.
en: What have they seen in your palace? Isaiah asked. They have seen everything in my palace, Hezekiah answered. Theres not a single thing in my storehouses that I havent shown them.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa kurigi maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o ni tooi nya. Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bihi maa mir o, ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi bɔb gbaai ba n-vooi ba tabil omaŋa, ka mɔɣisi bɛ kparima.
en: Israel was old and his eyes were not good. So Joseph brought the boys close to his father. Israel kissed and hugged the boys.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Gomna Pailɛt maŋmaŋ daa yina ti bɔhi ba, Yi ni tahi do so ŋɔ na taali lee nyɛla dini.
en: So Pilate went outside to them and asked, What do you accuse this man of.

dag: Ka Zilipa ŋun daa nyɛ Liya dabipaɣ la mi bidibisi daa nyɛ Gaad mini Asha. Yaakubu ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Mɛsopoteemia m-bala.
en: The sons of Leah's slave Zilpah were Gad and Asher. These sons were born in Mesopotamia.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu pahi yi Naawuni sizuura lubu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi yurilim mi pahi yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: and to godliness, affection for others; and to affection for others, love.

dag: Kaman kom ni chɛ ka nir nyar o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ninsal suhu nyari di kpee.
en: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.

dag: Filistia doo maa ni daa yiɣisi vu m-miri Dauda ni o ti tuh o saha shɛli, ka Dauda gba daa dii guui yi tɔb gɔɣu maa ni ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: Goliath the Philistine started to attack David. He slowly walked closer and closer toward David, but David ran out to meet Goliath.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kom puhigi zɔri tiŋgban nɛl ni, ka chɛ ka kom puhiri yiri tiŋgban kuŋ ni na.
en: But God can also turn the desert into watery pools, thirsty ground into watery springs.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi ni nir dee li zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti tiligila alahichinima; mani mi n-nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam.
en: This saying is reliable and deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—and Im the biggest sinner of all.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Yinim Yaakubu zuliya zuɣulaannima ni yinim Izraɛl nanim ŋɔ, wummiya! Pa yinima n-di simdi ni yi mi zaligu ni wuhi ni shɛli tuhiya?.
en: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong.

dag: Yi ni kpi n-do mɔɣu ŋɔ ni; ka yinim bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani zaa, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya, ka yi nyɛ bɛn ŋum yi kparima ni niŋ ma la.
en: You will die and your corpses will be scattered across this wilderness. Because you have complained against me, none of you over twenty years of age will enter that land.

dag: Musa ni daa ti bi doo, ka o daa ti yi n-chaŋ o niriba sani nti nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa, ka daa ti nya Ijipti do so ni buri o niriba Hiburunim maa ni yino.
en: Moses grew and became a man. He saw that his own people, the Hebrews, were forced to work very hard. One day he saw an Egyptian man beating a Hebrew man.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku tooi gbib bɛmaŋa, bɛn kpuɣimi paɣiba, ka paɣiba la mi kuli dɔbba, dama bɛ yi niŋ lala di so ni bɛ kɔre diri ba bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman buɣim la.
en: But if they cant control themselves, they should get married, because its better to marry than to burn with passion.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi zaɣis a zaligu dolibu di chɛrimi ka n suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: When I see the wicked breaking your law, I am filled with anger.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi, yi ni niriba ayi yi naai noli dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ ni suhi Naawuni yɛl shɛli zuɣu, m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Paɣiŋoo ŋun bi dɔɣi, mali suhupiɛlli! Nyin ŋun ʒi bia dɔɣibu wolisibu biɛrim ŋɔ, yaam a noli n-tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu! Dama bɛ ni chɛ paɣ so bahi mali bihi pam n-gari ŋun mali yidana.
en: For the scripture says, Be happy, you childless woman! Shout and cry with joy, you who never felt the pains of childbirth! For the woman who was deserted will have more children than the woman whose husband never left her.

dag: Ka Amalɛknim daa lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim Rɛfidim maa.
en: When the Israelites were at Rephidim, they were attacked by the Amalekites.

dag: Hal n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi saɣim ŋ-ŋɔ, ka n niŋgbuŋ na beni, dindina n ni nya Naawuni.
en: After my skin has been torn apart this way— then from my flesh Ill see God.

dag: nti zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu maa m-booi di ni kpam bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa; ka yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi, ka di niŋ zinchili.
en: then pour olive oil on his head to show that he is the new king. Say to him, The Lord has chosen you to be king of Israel. Then leave quickly—don't wait around for anything!.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim daa kana nti laɣim gil o bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ ka ti chɛ biɛhiŋ? Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin kahigim li yɛli ti.
en: and the people gathered all around him. They said, How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ma ni Zɛbidii bihi ma la gba daa be bɛ ni.
en: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the wife of Zebedee.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na zo ma nambɔɣu kaman a ni pun niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli shɛm la.
en: Turn to me and have mercy on me as you do on all those who love you.

dag: Ka niriba daa ʒiri barinim bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu mini bɛ daamaŋkanim ni na nti sɔŋdi sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi ni Pita ti gariti ka o shilinshia mahim lee lu bɛ ni shɛb zuɣu.
en: So the people brought those who were sick into the streets and put them on little beds and mats. They were hoping that Peters shadow might fall on them as he walked by.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Dɛbir ti liri ba.
en: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: to say to the people of Israel: When you cross the Jordan River and enter the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, Naawuni yur a pam. Yiɣisim zani n-luɣ a tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga; bɛ tim ma la a sanna. O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n yiɣisi zani ka n ni na kul sɔhira.
en: The man in the vision said to me, Daniel, God loves you very much. Think very carefully about the words I will speak to you. Stand up; I have been sent to you. And when he said this, I stood up. I was still shaking because I was afraid.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n leei cheechi tumtumda ka ti ma tuuni ŋɔ ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ o lahibal suŋ zaa molo molibu tuma la.
en: I became a servant of the church because God gave me a special work to do. This work helps you. My work is to tell the complete message of God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi li bɛ nuhi ni n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei Maligumaana leebu sara maligu din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord . This was part of the ordination ceremony.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋ kam ka bɛ deei ya, yin dimiya bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam;.
en: Whenever you enter a city and its people welcome you, eat what they set before you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli ni bɛ ni niriba tuhi pisinaanahi n-yɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi, ka niriba tusaayɔbu nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini sariakaritiba.
en: He said, Twenty-four thousand of the Levites will be in charge of the temple, , will be temple officials and judges.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuui ʒini nimaani, bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima kana nti gbahi bɛ ni shɛb ku.
en: But when they began to live there, they didnt worship the LORD, so the LORD sent lions against them, and the lions began to kill them.

dag: Nam zuɣupiligu yi ti zuɣu ni lu. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti tum alahichi.
en: Nothing is left of all we were proud of. We sinned, and now we are doomed.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, All of you will reject me, as the Scriptures say, I will strike down the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaɣisi din viɛla, bɛ dimnim ni ti kari doli ba.
en: But Israel refused the good things, so the enemy chases him.

dag: N bɔbi n gar bila zali. N zaŋla Ijipti tampiɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ shim niŋ pa di zuɣu.
en: I have clean sheets on my bed—special ones from Egypt.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri tuuli bihi nyɛla n ni su shɛba. N ni daa ku bikpamba zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la, ka n daa mali ba kasi ti mmaŋa.
en: When I killed all the first-born in Egypt, I consecrated as my own the oldest son of each Israelite family and the first-born of every animal.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o na. O ni daa ti mirina ka Yisa bɔh o.
en: So Jesus stopped and ordered the blind man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Yi dimnim ni kana nti teei gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ n-saɣim yi ni zaŋ binshɛŋa taɣi yimaŋa, ka ʒe yi nayiya nɛma maa.
en: So the Lord GOD says, An enemy will surround your land. They will break down your strong walls and take the things you have hidden in your high towers.

dag: ni di pindigu din daa nyɛ bɛ ni nani piɛlahi gban shɛŋa n-niŋ moonsi mɔhi li la mini di pindigu shɛli din nyɛ teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana la ni pateesa la.
en: the covering of rams' skin dyed red; the covering of fine leather; the curtain;.

dag: O ni daa yiɣisi zani maa, ka o duh o yee suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa ni yɛli.
en: turned toward the people, blessed them, and said loudly:.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni, fɔntins anahi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba. Dina n-nyɛ: Gibiɔn mini Gɛba.
en: They also gave Aarons descendants cities that belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. These cities were Gibeon, Geba.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili azichi biɛhigu shee la n-tim ti ti Asiria naa pini.
en: Ahaz also took the silver and gold that was in the Temple of the Lord and in the treasuries of the kings palace. Then Ahaz sent a gift to the king of Assyria.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Izraɛl bidibisi maa yuya din sabi pa sariakaribo nyolɔrigu zuɣu la n-ye m-pa o nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee la, ka di nyɛ bɛ yɛla teebu shihirili Yawɛ sani sahakam.
en: In this way Aaron will have the names of the twelve tribes of Israel written on his heart each time he enters the holy place, and I will never forget my people.

dag: Stiivin yɛligu ŋɔ ni daa lu bɛ tiba ni maa, ka di dim bɛ nyinyɛhi ni ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi pam, ka bɛ je suli niŋ o.
en: Once the council members heard these words, they were enraged and began to grind their teeth at Stephen.

dag: Yi ŋmanila abie tihi din vuɣisi waɣa. Yi ŋmanila pu shɛŋa din do m-baɣ mɔɣili. Yi ŋmanila aloosi ti shɛŋa Yawɛ ni sa. Yi ŋmanila sida ti shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi kom.
en: It's like a grove of palm trees or a garden beside a river. You are like tall aloe trees that the Lord has planted, or like cedars growing near water.

dag: Chɛ ka n doli a yɛlimaŋli la, ka a wuhi ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni. Nyin ka n niŋ naani dabisili puuni zaa.
en: Lead me in your truth—teach it to me— because you are the God who saves me. I put my hope in you all day long.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli, N ni birigi chaŋ ti nya lahizibu din chɛ ka buɣim maa bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: This is strange! he said to himself. I'll go over and see why the bush isn't burning up.

dag: Di zuɣu ka yi leei bɛn mali biɛrisuŋ yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn zaa be Masidɔnia mini Akaia la sani.
en: You became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, dama daba ayopɔin ka ti yɛn zaŋ leei ya maligumaaniba.
en: You must not leave the meeting tents entrance for seven days, until the period of your ordination is completed, because your ordination takes seven days.

dag: Tiligim ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba nuu ni, ka fa ma ninvuɣ kuriba nuu ni bahi.
en: Deliver me from evildoers; save me from the bloodthirsty.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛfɛr mini Ishi ni Ɛliɛl ni Aziriɛl ni Jɛrimia ni Hɔdavia ni Jadiɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛn yuya du, ka bɛ daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba.
en: The following were the heads of their clans: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were all outstanding soldiers, well-known leaders of their clans.

dag: N daa lan ti a bindirigu din nyɛ zim viɛlli mini kpam ni shiri ni a di, ka a daa zaŋ li zali bɛ tooni ni di nyɛ din nyom viɛla, ka di daa shiri nyɛ lala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You set my food that I had given you to eat—fine wheat, oil, and honey—before them as a pleasing aroma. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Nimaani ka Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ o kpari maa. Zɛdɛkia daa bɔh o mi, Bɔzuɣu ka a tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-deei li.
en: Judahs King Zedekiah had Jeremiah sent there after questioning him: Why do you prophesy, This is what the LORD says: Im handing this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will occupy it.

dag: N daa zaŋ wuntitali niŋ mmaŋa, ka di pili ma. N yɛlimaŋli tuma daa ŋmanila zabba mini baŋtabiga.
en: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;.

dag: Amaa dimdi yi be so min o kpee sunsuuni, ka o do n-gu o nti chaŋ ti lir o ku dilana ka zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin yin ni.
en: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.

dag: Naa yi wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, o kpamba zaa yɛn nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: If a ruler listens to lies, those who serve him will be wicked.

dag: Ti ni daa nya filiŋ la o daa bi tam ti yɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God remembered us when we were humiliated— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ ya na ti paai Amɔrinim bɛn be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa tuhi ya, amaa ka n daa chɛ ka yi nyaŋ ba; ka n ku ba ka chɛ ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: Then I brought you to the land of the Amorites, who lived on the east side of the Jordan. They fought you, but I gave you victory over them. You took their land, and I destroyed them as you advanced.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti kpe alibarika shɛl ni ti ni be ŋɔ, ka mali suhupiɛlli ti tahima shɛli ti ni mali zaŋ chaŋ ti mini Naawuni ni laɣim nya jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: He has brought us by faith into this experience of God's grace, in which we now live. And so we boast of the hope we have of sharing God's glory!.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zuliya bɔbili laɣimla taba ni bɛ lir a ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ta o daɣiri, chɛliya ka ti mooi ti nini bahi Ziɔn zuɣu.
en: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.

dag: Ka a nudirigu nini yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini, di so ni bɛ ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ zaa kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: And if your right eye causes you to fall into sin, tear it out and throw it away. Its better that you lose a part of your body than that your whole body be thrown into hell.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini noonsi balibu kam n-zaŋ ba na ti ti ninsal ni o nya o ni yɛn boli ba yu shɛŋa; ka ninsal ni daa boli binnɛɔŋ kam zaa yu shɛli, o yuli n-kul bala.
en: So the LORD God formed from the fertile land all the wild animals and all the birds in the sky and brought them to the human to see what he would name them. The human gave each living being its name.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, yɛlim a tumtumdib zaa bɛn be a sani ŋɔ ni bɛ lihim nya ninvuɣ so ŋun mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga ti a, ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka alizin biɛ so kana ti muɣisir a maa yi ti lan siɣ a zuɣu na, ka dilan ŋme mɔɣilo maa, a ni nya amaŋa.
en: Give us the command and we will look for someone who can play the harp. If the evil spirit from God comes on you, this person will play music for you. Then you will feel better.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhiri anabinim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli ya? bee Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: Jeremiah, ask the prophets, What answer did the Lord give you? What did the Lord say.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, alizin birigu n-ʒi m bia zuɣu, ka n zaŋ o tah a sanna.
en: A man answered, Teacher, I brought my son to you. He is controlled by an evil spirit that keeps him from talking.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ammɔnnim na so ŋun yuli daa booni Nahash la daa ti lo tɔb na nti teei gili Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga la nima. Ka Jabɛshi dɔbba zaa daa yɛli naa Nahash, Chɛ ka ti min a tɔɣisi ka a zali ti zaligu ka ti jɛmd a.
en: About a month later, Nahash the Ammonite went up and laid siege to Jabesh-gilead. All the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a treaty with us, and well be your servants.

dag: Guum yomyom tuh o soli ti bɔh o, A min a yidan ni yi bia la mal alaafee? Ka o garigi yɛli Gɛhaazi, Ti mal alaafee.
en: Hurry to her and find out if everything is all right with her, her husband, and her son. She told Gehazi that everything was all right.

dag: Amaa din beni nyɛla, saria karibu mini buɣim din mali dabiɛm ka nyɛ din ti yɛn bahi bɛn tuhiri Naawuni yol la n-naɣ kpalim.
en: If we continue sinning, all that is left for us is a fearful time of waiting for the judgment and the angry fire that will destroy those who live against God.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa. N ni yili yila paɣ a wuna sani.
en: With all my heart I praise you, Lord . In the presence of angels I sing your praises.

dag: Bɛ sani, a ŋmanila yiliyiina ŋun yiini yurilim yila, ŋun kukoli viɛla, ka o mi biŋkumda ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga. Bɛ wumd a ni yɛri shɛm, amaa bɛ ku niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: To them you are nothing more than an entertainer singing love songs or playing a harp. They listen to all your words and don't obey a single one of them.

dag: Shɛhira diba ata m-be alizanda ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini bɛ ni booni so Yɛligu la ni Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka bɛba ata ŋɔ nyɛla yino. Ka shɛhira diba ata be dunia ŋɔ ni:.
en: In fact, there are three who tell about it.

dag: M mɛla yili shɛli din mali jilima ti o, ka di nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: But, Lord, I have built a beautiful house for you to live in forever.

dag: O daa zaŋla anzinfa din kpalim ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihita m-mali bansi din yɛn yili daantalisi la mini di mihi ka niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni.
