en: The remaining kilograms of silver were used for the hooks and rods and for covering the tops of the posts.

dag: Naawuni mi daa bi ŋmaai di tiŋgbɔŋ maa hal napɔŋ yaabu yim zuɣu ti o, amaa ka daa lee lo alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o, ka o yaansi ti di di fali o kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa na ka bia gba.
en: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔbbihi la, ka mali suhupiɛlli kaman wain nyuriba la. Bɛ bihi ni ti teei bɛ nasara dibu maa yɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Ephraim will be as happy as soldiers who have too much to drink. Their children will be rejoicing and they, too, will be happy. They will all have a happy time together with the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: The notice of the formal charge against him was written, The king of the Jews.

dag: Jɔra daŋ — kɔbiga ni pinaayi.
en: the descendants of Jorah:.

dag: Di saha ka o daa laɣim bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihitanaayi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tusaayopɔin.
en: So Ahab called together the young soldiers and the , troops in Israel's army, and he got them ready to fight the Syrians.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa ti tim tuumba ashilɔni nti yɛli Izraɛl zuliya zaa, Yi yi ti kul wum kikaa kumsi yin yɛlimiya, Absalom leei naa Hiburɔn.
en: But he sent messengers to all the tribes of Israel to say, When you hear the sound of trumpets, shout, Absalom has become king at Hebron.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim, dama n niŋ a zaligunim yɛda.
en: Teach me knowledge and good judgment because Ive put my trust in your commandments.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, o daa nyɛla Dɔdo bia, ka Dɔdo mi nyɛ Aho bia. Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani saha shɛli bɛ ni daa filim Filistianim bɛn lo tɔbu n-laɣim nimaani na, ka Izraɛlnim nya ba ka tiri gbin la.
en: The second of the famous three was Eleazar son of Dodo, of the clan of Ahoh. One day he and David challenged the Philistines who had gathered for battle. The Israelites fell back.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒi nimaani maa zaa mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka nya o ninni ka di ŋmanila malaika ninni.
en: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.

dag: Aduna daŋ niriba, di ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tarili n-daŋ tooni la zuɣu. Aduna daa nyɛla Kɔhat daŋ nira, ka Kɔhat mi nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nira.
en: The first choice of towns was given to the Levites from the Kohath family group.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa ŋmaligi Dauda sani yi nti tim ni bɛ cham ti gɔŋ Abinɛr labisina. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paag o Sira kɔbiliga gbini n-gɔŋ o labisina, amaa Dauda daa bi mi di yɛla.
en: Joab left David, then he sent some messengers to catch up with Abner. They brought him back from the well at Sirah, but David did not know anything about it.

dag: Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa ti ka n sanna ti ʒini n tooni.
en: When some of the elders of the house of Israel came to sit in my presence.

dag: Duri pam be m Ba yiŋa. N chanimi ni n ti mali biɛhigu shee zali ya. Di yi di pa lala n naan ku yɛli ya di yɛla.
en: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.

dag: A leela ninkuunsilana zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka niŋ ma alaka ni a yaa zaa.
en: You are cruel to me, attack me with the strength of your hand.

dag: O miri ka o ti chaŋ nir ni kpi n-do luɣ shɛli. O miri ka o saɣim omaŋa, hal di yi nyɛla o ba bee o ma.
en: He has been dedicated to me and is not to make himself ritually unclean nor is he to defile my sacred Tent by leaving it and entering a house where there is a dead person, even if it is his own father or mother.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di bi kpan ya ni yi baŋ di dabisa bee saha shɛli m Ba Naawuni ni zal li o yiko ni.
en: Jesus said to them, You don't need to know the time of those events that only the Father controls.

dag: Yinim malaikanima, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali yaa ka tumd o ni yɛli shɛm, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: Praise the Lord , you strong and mighty angels, who obey his commands, who listen to what he says.

dag: Di simdi ka firilatamdigu maa ti mali jaba ayɔbu di luɣa zuɣu; jaba ata yaɣ yini polo, jaba ata yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: The lampstand must have six branches—three branches on one side and three branches on the other.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa ku so mam maa yɛli ba, M mini m mam n-daa chaŋ Gibia din nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋ la ni ni ti ti gbe.
en: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, answered, My secondary wife and I came to Gibeah of Benjamin to spend the night.

dag: Farisiinima n-daa tim tuumba maa Jɔn sani maa.
en: The messengers, who had been sent by the Pharisees.

dag: n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be Jɛrusalɛm; ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka n zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini wuntitali su ba.
en: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.

dag: Giliadnim yi tum alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni bahi yoli. Giligal tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ maanila maligu tiri naɣilahi. Lala zuɣu bɛ maligu bimbina maa ni ti ŋmanila kuɣa ka bɛ laɣisi duhi puu ni.
en: In Gilead there is wickedness; they will surely come to nothing. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls, so their altars will be like piles of stones on the rows of the field.

dag: ka o lan labi kpe saria karibu shee maa ti bɔhi Yisa, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka Yisa bi garig o shɛli.
en: He went back inside and asked Jesus, Where are you from? But Jesus did not answer.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei zuɣu, ka pa ni zuli, ka chɛ ka yi kul chani tooni ka ku lab nyaaŋa, yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.

dag: Hal ti tuumbiɛri ni kul di shɛhira jɛndi ti maa zaa yoli, Yawɛ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli zuɣu. Ti zoya ka chɛ a siɣimsiɣim bushɛm, ka tum alahichi pam a sani.
en: We know that this is our fault. We are now suffering because of our sins. Lord , do something to help us for the good of your name. We admit that we have left you many times. We have sinned against you.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, amaa ka lee tumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, dindina hal bɛ ni bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa zaa yoli, bɛ kul mali fukumsi zaligu bɛ suhuri ni m-bala.
en: Some people naturally obey the Law's commands, even though they don't have the Law.

dag: O daa wuhila tumo maa, A yi kuli ti yɛli naa tɔb maa lahibali naai.
en: When you have finished reporting all the news of the battle to the king, Joab instructed the messenger.

dag: Yisa daa ti chani Jɛrusalɛm n-zaŋ doli Samaria mini Galili sunsuuni garita.
en: As Jesus made his way to Jerusalem, he went along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

dag: Ɛnɔsh daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni anu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Zaŋm dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba, ka zali ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: Command these things. Teach them.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa boli kpeen so na ti yɛl o, Cham yomyom ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya na.
en: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.

dag: A mi ni bɛnkam be Ɛsha daa zoya ka chɛ ma, bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Faijɛlus mini Hɛrimɔjɛneez.
en: You know that everyone in Asia has turned away from me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

dag: Bɛ ku ninkura mini bihi sɔŋ solɔri zuɣu; bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku m paɣisara mini n nachimba. A suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛl la ka a daa ku ba maa. A daa kɔrikɔri ba, ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.

dag: Nyin Farisii ŋun nyɛ zom ŋɔ, daŋm paɣila pipia mini laa puuni, ka naanyi chɛ ka di nyaaŋa gba neei.
en: Blind Pharisee! Clean what is inside the cup first, and then the outside will be clean too!.

dag: Ka anabi kurili maa daa kpuɣi anab ŋuni maa pa buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kuli yiŋa ni bɛ ti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o.
en: The old prophet put the body on his donkey and carried it back to the city to cry for him and bury him.

dag: Yisifu biɛyanim ni daa nya ka bɛ ba kpi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Di pa shɛli ka Yisifu zaɣisi ti ka bɔhi ti biɛri ti ni daa niŋ o zaɣ biɛ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: After the death of their father, Joseph's brothers said, What if Joseph still hates us and plans to pay us back for all the harm we did to him.

dag: Yisa min o ni daa yur o nyaandol so la n-daa ʒi n-tab taba.
en: One of the disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, was at Jesus side.

dag: amaa ka di ni nyɛla bɛ ni nyari yi biɛrisuŋ zaŋ tabili yi ni luri ba sizuura Naawuni zuɣu shɛm la zuɣu.
en: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.

dag: Dunɔguliba bɛn ʒiya m-bi gbihiri hal ka bɛ duuma ti paana mal alibarika. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o gba ni ti mali shili chɛ ka bɛ ʒini, ka o kpuɣi bindirigu na ti zali ba ka bɛ di.
en: Happy are those servants whom the master finds waiting up when he arrives. I assure you that, when he arrives, he will dress himself to serve, seat them at the table as honored guests, and wait on them.

dag: Ka buɣim daa yi di mundili maa ni n-di di wula mini di wala. Ka di daa lan ka mundili din mali yaa din ni niŋ nam jaaŋgbee, ka bɛ zaŋ li su nam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla fabila yilli, ka di simdi ni bɛ yiini li fabila saha.
en: The stem of the vine caught fire; fire burned up its branches and fruit. The branches will never again be strong, will never be royal scepters. This is a song of sorrow; it has been sung again and again.

dag: Amaa kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi nya ma ni yi nini, amaa ka bi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: But I told you that you have seen me and still dont believe.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Naawuni nol ni na zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: Jesus answered him, The Scriptures say, It is not just bread that keeps people alive. Their lives depend on what God says. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi sabilifaa niŋ li ni bɛ zaŋ li lɔri pari bantabiga maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: They fastened the gold strip to a blue ribbon. Then they tied the blue ribbon around the turban like the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, Yɛlimaŋli, a Naawuni maa shiri nyɛla ŋun gari wuna zaa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa Duuma ni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka a tooi kahig ashili ŋɔ gbinni wuhi ma maa.
en: Then the king said to Daniel, I know for sure your God is the God over all gods and the Lord over all kings. He tells people about things they cannot know. I know this is true because you were able to tell these secret things to me.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Samaria, o daa kula Ɛhab daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim Samaria zaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Ilaija shɛm la.
en: When they arrived there, Jehu killed all of Ahab's relatives, not sparing even one. This is what the Lord had told Elijah would happen.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be samban ni yi shihi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee n-shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi o dahalali kum bee n-shihi ninsal kɔbili bee gballi, dilana ni leei ŋun bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: If any touch a person who has been killed or has died a natural death outdoors or if any touch a human bone or a grave, they become unclean for seven days.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani mini ti kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-kul be ti sani n-sɔŋdi ti ti muɣisigu saha.
en: God is our shelter and strength, always ready to help in times of trouble.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi pahi ʒiibukɔbiga zuɣu, ka bɛ zaa ni nyɛla n dan naa tɔbbihi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa lan bɔr ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha? Bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa bɔri ni o bo taali ti Izraɛlnima.
en: But Joab replied, May the LORD increase his people a hundred times! Sir, arent you the king, and arent they all your servants? Why do you want to do this? Why bring guilt on Israel.

dag: N daa ka galimi o sani, dama n daa bi tum taal shɛli.
en: I obey you completely and guard against sin.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti chaŋ ti be azaaba din ka bahigu ni; amaa ka wuntizɔriba la bɛn ti kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu ni.
en: And they will go away into eternal punishment. But the righteous ones will go into eternal life.

dag: Naa Asa daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinahi ni yini ka faai siɣ o yaannim sani.
en: He died two years later.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ni o pin o zuɣu min o teeŋkɔbiri ni o ninkari ni o niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o paɣ o situra ka su kom n-leei ŋun yi daɣiri ni.
en: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, hal di pa shɛli yi ni yɛn nya wahala din ku yuui zahimbu balibu shɛŋa din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu la zaa yoli;.
en: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.

dag: Man ŋuna, Naawuni ka n yɛn jɛmda, ka zaŋ n yɛla niŋ Naawuni nuu ni.
en: But I would seek God, put my case to God.

dag: Hɛzɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Abija, o daa nyɛla Zakaria bipuɣiŋga.
en: Hezekiah was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

dag: A ni daa na bi nam zoya bee a ni daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini dunia ŋɔ, nyini n-daa nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni.
en: Before the mountains were born, before you birthed the earth and the inhabited world— from forever in the past to forever in the future, you are God.

dag: Dama bɛn be ʒilinsi ni biriginsim n-kuri ba, ka jɛra mi nini ni tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ shɛm kuri ba.
en: The immature will die because they turn away; smugness will destroy fools.

dag: Ka Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa yi Rɔgɛlim n-chaŋ naa sani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni ni o ti doli naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: Barzillai came from Rogelim in Gilead to meet David at the Jordan River and go across with him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋmi kpani din be a nuu ni ŋɔ tiri Ai; n ni zaŋ li niŋ a nuu ni. Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ kpani din be o nuu ni maa tiri.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Point your spear at Ai; I am giving it to you. Joshua did as he was told.

dag: Bɛ yihi laɣ shɛli bɛ ni nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛ tumtumdiba maa.
en: We have taken the money that was kept in the Temple and handed it over to the workers and their supervisors.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun zɔr a nambɔɣu la yɛliya, Zoya mini kunkuna ni vuui, amaa n yurilim din bi naari la ku vuui ka chɛ a; ka n suhudoo alikauli la gba ku vuug a sani.
en: The mountains may disappear, and the hills may become dust, but my faithful love will never leave you. I will make peace with you, and it will never end. The Lord who loves you said this.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti leei yi zɔnim la yi ti leei yi zuɣulaannima, wula ka yi lee yɛn yɛli? Di biɛrim maa ku ŋmanila paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: I will let your enemies become your rulers— people you once trusted with your secrets. What will you say then? Surely you will feel great pain, like a woman giving birth.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa kumdila, n daa bi di li; saha shɛli n ni daa be daɣiri ni la, n daa bi pii di shɛli. Ka m mi daa bi zaŋ li mali kpiimba. Ti deei nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli. Ti tum a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm zaa.
en: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.

dag: Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Gɛshɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Laribu la ni ti dimnim bɛn pahi la daa wumya ni ti me gooni maa naai hal ka voya lan ka di ni, amaa di saha maa n daa na bi zaŋ pundi kpɛhi di dunoya la.
en: Then Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab, and our other enemies heard that I had built the wall. We repaired all the holes in the wall, but we had not yet put the doors in the gates.

dag: dama tiŋgbani kuumi tahi la, saa ni bi lan miri maa zuɣu, ka di niŋ pukpariba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: No one prepares the ground for crops. No rain falls on the land. The farmers are depressed. So they cover their heads from shame.

dag: Ka a nuu yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi ka ti kpe buɣim din bi kpiri ni .
en: If your hand causes you to fall into sin, chop it off. Its better for you to enter into life crippled than to go away with two hands into the fire of hell, which cant be put out.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka zibisim titali zibigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka sokam ti kpalim bɔbinda.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Stretch your arm toward the sky, and everything will be covered with darkness thick enough to touch.

dag: N dabili Dauda ni ti nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ zaa ti mali piɛgul yino. Bɛ ni ti doli n zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: My servant David will be king over them. There will be just one shepherd for all of them. They will follow my case laws and carefully observe my regulations.

dag: N yi ti saɣim Ijiptinim nam sulinsi, ka bɛ bara nyubu yiko naai, wuntaŋ ni ni ti zibigi Tɛhafinɛhɛs, ka sagbana ti lim tiŋ maa. Ka bɛ ti gbahi bɛ tiŋkpansi niriba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: You were so proud of your nation's power, but when I crush that power and kill that pride, darkness will fall over the city of Tahpanhes. A dark, gloomy cloud will cover the land as you are being led away into captivity.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi yɛli bɛ ni zaŋ liɣiri maa n-niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni ni bɛ yo tumtumdiba maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di liɣiri maa shɛm laasabu wuhi ba, dama bɛ daa doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: Those who were in charge of paying the workers did not have to give a report of how they spent the money, because they could be trusted.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba daa nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri daa fo bɛ noya.
en: Good people see this and are happy. But the wicked see it and dont know what to say.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n suhu daa yiɣisi ka n je suli niŋ Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka chɛ ka di bahi yoli n-leei dabari doya kaman di ni na kul doya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So my fierce anger poured out and blazed against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem. And they were reduced to an utter wasteland, as they are today.

dag: Miri ka a bɔh a kpee biɛri bee n-je suli niŋ o, amaa yum a kpee kaman amaŋ la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not take revenge nor hold a grudge against any of your people; instead, you must love your neighbor as yourself; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Musa daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu zalizali, ka zaŋ di dapaɣa la tamtam di zuɣu, ka zaŋ di dapuhi la niŋ li, ka zaŋ di daantalisi la sa;.
en: Moses set up the dwelling. He laid out its bases. He set up its boards, inserted its bars, and raised up its posts.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli, yi ni shiri kɔhi yi puu la laɣ shɛli zaa m-bɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin, di zaa m-bala.
en: Peter asked her, Tell me, was this the full amount you and your husband received for your property? Yes, she answered, the full amount.

dag: Ninsal nini ni ni tooi nya Masia so la nyɛla Naawuni so ninsal nini ni ku tooi nya ŋɔ ŋmahinli, ka lan nyɛ Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun gari binnamda zaa.
en: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.

dag: Shimɛi daa malila bidibisi pinayɔbu mini bipuɣins ayɔbu. Amaa o mabihi maa bɛn daa bi dɔɣi bihi pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ zuliya maa daa bi yɛligi kaman Judanim ni daa yɛligi shɛm la.
en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his relatives had fewer children, and the tribe of Simeon did not grow as much as the tribe of Judah did.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ ku Lazarɔs gba.
en: So the leading priests made plans to kill Lazarus too.

dag: Ka n daa niŋ kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga n-wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli so ni bi mi ba. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daa kpalim zani dabari, ka so bi lan kpɛri di ni gariti yira. Lala ka di daa niŋ ka tiŋgban suŋ maa ti leei so ni ka shɛl ni.
en: Like a storm I swept them away to live in foreign countries. This good land was left a desolate place, with no one living in it.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza ni o yihim tulaale tuɣindi labihi maa buɣim niɛm maa ni n-kpaai di buɣim bahi katiŋa, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: Tell Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to remove the bronze fire pans from the remains of those who have been burned, and scatter the coals from the fire pans somewhere else, because the fire pans are holy.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan kani ŋun bi kana kpe ka nyɛ ti n-ni bɔhi so baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Doesnt the Lord have another prophet here? Lets ask him what God says.

dag: N ni ti lan zaŋ nyin Izraɛl leei m paɣa sahakam ni wuntizɔbo mini yɛlimaŋli ni yurilim pam ni nambɔzɔbo.
en: Israel, I will make you my wife; I will be true and faithful; I will show you constant love and mercy and make you mine forever.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Yɛhudianim jɛmbu du shɛl ni wuhiri niriba Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in a synagogue.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ binshɛɣukam ka yiɣisi dol o.
en: Levi left everything and went with Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nyaŋ tin shɛŋa din daa gili Gɛra maa nim zaa, dama Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm. Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ʒe fɔntinsi maa zaa nɛma chaŋ, dama nɛma daa be tinsi maa ni.
en: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord . So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.

dag: Ka o daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, du shɛli yɛla Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la.
en: He even built altars in the two courtyards of the LORDs temple—the very place the LORD was speaking of when he said: I will put my name in Jerusalem.

dag: Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛbat bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha ka Abijam daa leei Juda naa.
en: Abijah became the new king of Judah during the th year that Jeroboam son of Nebat ruled Israel.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣirina ka zaŋ sagbani n-ye kaman chinchin la, ka sagani booi gil o zuɣu, ka o ninni be kaman wuntaŋa, ka o biɛhi mi be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: Then I saw another powerful angel coming down from heaven. He was robed with a cloud, with a rainbow over his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet were like fiery pillars.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn yi tindul na ni ti tuhi deei Fɔnisia tiŋgbɔŋ n-zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo hal ni Zarɛfat su. Ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim ka yi tindul na nti be Saadis la mi ti tuhi deei Nɛgɛb tinsi su.
en: The army of exiles from northern Israel will return and conquer Phoenicia as far north as Zarephath. The exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sardis will capture the towns of southern Judah.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di lan booni ya ma Naomi, amaa bolimiya ma la Mara, dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa chɛ ka n nya naŋgbantom.
en: She replied to them, Dont call me Naomi, but call me Mara, for the Almighty has made me very bitter.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a nam jaaŋgbee yi Ziɔn na, ka a di nam a dimnim sunsuuni.
en: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.

dag: M banima mini m mabihi, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zabi mmaŋ zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: Paul said, My brothers and fathers, listen to me! I will make my defense to you.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza tɔbbihi maa ni daa teei gili Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, ka ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza maŋmaŋ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: During the attack, Nebuchadnezzar himself arrived at the city.

dag: ka Okiran bia Pagiɛl daa nyɛ Asha zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kari doli ma kaman yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni maa? N niŋgbuŋ ni be shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko bi saɣi lala yi sani?.
en: Why do you pursue me like God does, always hungry for my flesh?.

dag: Ka saa daa luna m-mi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ nyɛla, faashee ka bɛ ŋme n-wurisi chɛfirinim maligu malibu bimbina la buɣibuɣi kaman zim la; ka saɣim Ashɛra ŋmahinli binyara mini di tulaale tuɣilibu bimbina la zaa.
en: But Israel's sins will be forgiven only when the stones of pagan altars are ground up like chalk, and no more incense altars or symbols of the goddess Asherah are left.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka lihiri n ni doli so shɛŋa zaa; ka zahindi n napɔna bɔba.
en: You bind chains on my feet; you watch every step I take, and even examine my footprints.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ a nini kpa bɛ ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la polo, ka teeg a nu zaŋli n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Now, roll up your sleeve and raise your arm over the brick. Act like you are attacking the city of Jerusalem. Do this to show that you are speaking as my messenger to the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ti chaŋ ka di ti paai yuun pisinaanu piligu ni goli biɛɣu pia dali. Bɛ ni daa wurim tiŋ maa ka di ti paai yuun pinaanahi saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: It was the tenth day of the new year, which was the twenty-fifth year after we had been taken into exile and the fourteenth year after Jerusalem was captured. On that day I felt the powerful presence of the Lord , and he carried me away.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛli Rut, M bia, a yi shiri chani Bɔaz puu maa ni nti yihiri kayiha maa, di so. Di pa shɛli ka a chaŋ so puu ni ka puu maa lan ti yih a halibiɛɣu.
en: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, Its good, my daughter, that you go out with his young women, so that men dont assault you in another field.

dag: Adam ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ŋman o m-bol o yuli Sɛt.
en: When Adam was , he had a son who was just like him, and he named him Seth. Adam had more children.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ni vuri yɔbu mini bana piɛbbu.
en: And so he and all the Israelites took the Covenant Box up to Jerusalem with shouts of joy and the sound of trumpets.

dag: Bɛ daa chaŋ Nɛgɛb n-zaŋ ti paai Hiburɔn, ka Ahiman mini Shɛshai ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ Anaki zuliya niriba la daa be nimaani. .
en: They went up into the arid southern plain and entered Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of the Anakites, lived.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi. O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino jɛm o ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: No household servant can serve two masters. Either you will hate the one and love the other, or you will be loyal to the one and have contempt for the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani Masia ʒim zuɣu maa, din gari lala nyɛla, o zuɣu ka ti ni tiligi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni yaha.
en: So, now that we have been made righteous by his blood, we can be even more certain that we will be saved from Gods wrath through him.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa maa niriba maa ninni.
en: Aaron told them everything that the LORD had told to Moses, and he performed the signs in front of the people.

dag: Dunia zuliya kam, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Zaŋmiya jilima ti Yawɛ ka wuhi ni o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Give to the LORD, all families of the nations— give to the LORD glory and power!.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni ŋun pahi, ka man filim.
en: He must become more important while I become less important.

dag: Gaad bihi n-daa ʒini bɛ nyaaŋa baɣili ba Bashan tiŋgban ni zaŋ lala hal ni Salɛka.
en: The people of Gad lived across the river from Reuben, in the area of Bashan. They spread all the way to the town of Salecah.

dag: M bia, dim shiri, dama di nyɛla din viɛla, ka shikpam din tɔɣiri shigbaŋ ni na nyɛla din nyaɣis a noli ni.
en: My child, eat honey; it is good. And just as honey from the comb is sweet on your tongue.

dag: Ti ni niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika zuɣu ka ti tiligi shɛm, lala n-nyɛ bɛ gba.
en: But we believe that we will be saved by the gift of undeserved grace from our Lord Jesus Christ, just as the Gentiles are.

dag: A chɛ ka kɔbil nina kom puhiri yiri vinvama ni na n-zɔri gariti daboya sunsuuni.
en: Lord, you cause water to flow from springs into the streams that flow down between the mountains.

dag: Nir yi be tiŋgban nɛl ni, di so ni o mali paɣ so ŋun mali suhuyiɣisili ka bɔri zabili.
en: Better to live in a wilderness than in a house with a contentious and angry woman.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: One of the followers standing near Jesus grabbed his sword and pulled it out. He swung it at the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.

dag: Di simdi ka o kpuɣila paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: The high priest must marry a woman who is a virgin.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak daa nya Izraɛlnim ni niŋ Amɔrinim shɛlikam zaa.
en: Balak, Zippors son, saw everything that the Israelites did to the Amorites.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o suhudoo pina din nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpila din mali dabindi m-pahi o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa zuɣu na.
en: You must present this offering, plus the leavened flatbread, with the communal thanksgiving sacrifice of well-being.

dag: Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ. Masia cheechinim zaa puhiri ya.
en: Say hello to each other with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ say hello to you.

dag: Sool n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi Yisa nyaandoliba maa alaka maa; o daa dolila yiya n-gbahiri dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba nti kpɛhiri duu.
en: But Saul tried to destroy the church; going from house to house, he dragged out the believers, both men and women, and threw them into jail.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di yi ti kpa ni n darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi tibidarigibo tibili, man di darigi bɛ tibili? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu. Di simdi ni yi nya tibidarigibo.
en: Even those nations that don't deserve to be punished will have to drink from the cup of my anger. So how can you possibly hope to escape?.

dag: Dama, naa kul ni tumla na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ o tooni ni tum shɛli. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi yɛm mini biɛri yoli ni jɛrilim yɛla.
en: Then I decided to think about what it means to be wise or to be foolish or to do crazy things. And I thought about the one who will be the next king. The new king will do the same as the kings before him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka a zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa samban ni na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then bring the bull to that place at the front of the Meeting Tent. Aaron and his sons must put their hands on the bulls head.

dag: daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm.
en: two of each, male and female, went into the ark with Noah, just as God commanded Noah.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini Itiɔpianima ni Putinima ni Ludinima ni Areebianim zaa ni Libianima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din niriba zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai ba.
en: Cush, Put, and Lud, all Arabia and Cub, and the people from the allied country with them will fall by the sword.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣu daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: The next day, which was the day after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered before Pilate.

dag: N kamina ni n ti tuɣili bidibiga min o ba ni bipuɣiŋga min o ma ni paɣa min o yidana ma;.
en: I have come to make this happen: A son will turn against his father. A daughter will turn against her mother. A daughter-in-law will turn against her mother-in-law.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be o sani chaŋ ti dɔni Ai nuzaa polo m-miri li, ka vinvamli do bɛ mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: All the soldiers who were with Joshua marched to Ai. They stopped in front of the city. The army made its camp north of the city. There was a valley between the army and Ai.

dag: ka bɛ ti yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa hal ka so ti ku lan nya tiŋgbani gba. Ka bɛ ti bahi ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa chɛ bindir shɛŋa zali ya la mini yi tihi din be mɔɣu ni.
en: The locusts will cover the land. There will be so many locusts that you will not be able to see the ground. Anything that was left from the hailstorm will be eaten by the locusts. The locusts will eat all the leaves from every tree in the field.

dag: Zimiri ni daa baŋ ni bɛ nyaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa nim maa, ka o daa du nayili birini nti niŋ buɣim nyo nayili maa, ka di di n-ku omaŋmaŋa.
en: When Zimri saw the city had been captured, he ran to the palace fortress, but the soldiers burned it down with him still in it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nudirigu polo dunɔdali n-kpe dundombil ni nti buɣisi nudirigu polo dunɔdali maa, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall.

dag: O daa yɛli Hagai ni o bɔhim Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba zuɣulana ni niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, the governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to all the people. Say this:.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu ni yi zaa gbib naŋgban yini ka woligibu ku kpe yi sunsuuni, amaa ka yi naɣ ni zaŋla yi noya naai taba m-mali tɛhi yini ni naŋgban yini.
en: By the authority of our Lord Jesus Christ I appeal to all of you, my friends, to agree in what you say, so that there will be no divisions among you. Be completely united, with only one thought and one purpose.

dag: ka o daa pii di liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka o paɣ maa mi di yɛla. Ka Ananias daa zaŋ din kpalim maa ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles.

dag: ni Zɔra ni Aijalɔn ni Hiburɔn. O ni daa me goondahi gili Juda mini Bɛnjamin fɔntin shɛŋa m-bala.
en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. These cities in Judah and Benjamin were made strong.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: But now, all you exiles I deported from Jerusalem to Babylon, listen to the LORDs word.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Naawuni nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa yɛn go, ka bol o yiŋbihi na ti zaŋ o liɣiri pirigi ti ba ni bɛ deei wolimma.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like a man who was leaving on a trip. He called his servants and handed his possessions over to them.

dag: Ka Mɔza nyɛ Binia ba; o bihi n-daa nyɛ Rafa mini Ɛliasa ni Azɛl.
en: Moza the father of Binea, Binea of Raphah, Raphah of Eleasah, and Eleasah of Azel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zaawuni maa n-zo ni bɛ tiligi, ka chɛ bɛ tanti suɣa mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ bunsi. Bɛ daa kul zomi ka chɛ bɛ sansani maa kaman di ni daa kul be shɛm.
en: So that evening the Syrians had fled for their lives, abandoning their tents, horses, and donkeys, and leaving the camp just as it was.

dag: Ibram ni daa nyaŋ Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn be o sani ka labirina saha shɛli, ka Sɔdom naa daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Shave vinvamli ni bɛ ni daa booni luɣ shɛli Naa Vinvamli la.
en: Abram returned after he had defeated King Chedorlaomer and the other kings. Then the king of Sodom went to meet Abram in Shaveh Valley, which is also known as King's Valley.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi ti kpe fɔŋ maa ni n-chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o ti kpe o ni kuni yil shɛli.
en: He answered, As you go into the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him into the house that he enters.

dag: Ka Nɔba daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei Kɛnat mini di tiŋkpansi, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli Nɔba boli tinsi maa.
en: Nobah defeated Kenath and the small towns near it. Then he called that place by his own name.

dag: Ka yil maa lana daa yi bɛ sani ti yɛli ba, M mabihi, doo maa nyɛla n sana, dinzuɣu di tumiya tuun biɛɣu ŋɔ bee n-tum vi tuuni ŋɔ.
en: The old man went outside and said to them, My friends, dont do such an evil thing! This man is a guest in my house. Dont commit this terrible sin.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka ti mali yɛri ya maa. Dina n-nyɛ ni ti ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn mali nyɛviya hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha ti ku daŋ bɛn pun gbihiri kum ni la tooni.
en: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.

dag: Lɛvinim maa shɛb talahi tuma daa nyɛla bɛ su tah shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni kalibu fukumsi. Bɛ daa yi yɛn zaŋ li yi ni bɛ daa yi ti zaŋ li labisina.
en: Some of the gatekeepers had the job of caring for the dishes used in the Temple services. They counted them when they were brought in. They also counted these dishes when they were taken out.

dag: Ka Amazia daa bɔhi Naawuni nira maa, Ka n ni pun zaŋ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi shɛli da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiriba maa na, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ chaŋ di polo? Ka Naawuni nira maa garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni tooi ti a anzinfa din gari li.
en: Amaziah said to the man of God, But what about the money I already paid to the Israelite army? The man of God answered, The Lord has plenty. He can give you much more than that.

dag: O daa lan wurim Juda nanim ni daa me bimbin shɛŋa n-tam Ɛhab yiŋ dufahira zuɣu la mini Manaasa gba ni daa me bimbin shɛŋa zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi la ni. Ka o daa daai di zaa luhi ŋ-ŋme n-wurisi li n-va li ti bahi Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni.
en: In the past the kings of Judah had built altars on the roof of Ahabs building. King Manasseh had also built altars in the two courtyards of the Lord s Temple. Josiah destroyed all the altars and threw the broken pieces into the Kidron Valley.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni nya bindirigu pam n-di n-tiɣi; ka paɣi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum ya tuun kara maa. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.

dag: Ka yɛli, Laɣimmiya n niriba bɛn ʒe ma yim la ti ma na, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ma sara maligu alikauli la.
en: Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.

dag: Ijipti yiɣisirimi m-be kaman Nail mɔɣili; di bemi kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pali. Di yɛliya, Chɛ ka n yiɣisi, chɛ ka n yiɣisi lim dunia, chɛ ka n wurim tinsi tabili di niriba.
en: It is Egypt, rising with a roar like a raging river and saying, I'll flood the earth, destroying cities, and killing everyone in them.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba ni bɛ cham ti puɣisi nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Nɛgɛb tooni ha n-gari chaŋ zoya ni tinsi ni.
en: When Moses was sending them out to explore Canaan, he said, Go through the Negev and then into the hill country.

dag: Laɣimmiya dakuɣiri duhi, ka niŋ buɣim niŋ li n-niŋ binnyoma niŋ nimdi maa ni duɣi li, ka chɛ ka di kɔba di buɣim.
en: Bring more wood! Fan the flames! Cook the meat! Boil away the broth! Burn up the bones!.

dag: ka nahindi nandaamba mini bɛn ka, ka fari niriba, ka bi labisiri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima o sani n-tiri bindaannima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka tumdi din chihira.
en: cheats the poor, and robs people. He keeps what is given to him as security for a loan. He worships idols, does disgusting things.

dag: Yawɛ, a binnamda zaa ni paɣ a, ka a niriba bɛn zaa ʒe yim ni paɣ a.
en: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.

dag: Ti mabihi, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti gba.
en: Brothers and sisters, please pray for us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi bi tum daɣiri tuma mini daɣiri ni ka shɛb suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi jɛmdi buɣa, ka mi bi doli yɔhiŋgu soli alikauli lɔbu ni.
en: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.

dag: Ka di tiŋgbɔŋ maa salima viɛl pam; ka tulaale tihi mini kuɣ viɛla gba be nimaani.
en: That lands gold is pure, and the land also has sweet-smelling resins and gemstones.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi ti ma kom; n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi;.
en: I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me a drink. I was a stranger and you welcomed me.

dag: Amaa ka o yidan maa daa dol o kuhiri hal ni Bahurim. Ka Abinɛr daa ti yɛl o, Ŋmaligi lab kuli, ka o daa lab kuli.
en: Michals husband, Paltiel, followed them, crying all the way to Bahurim. Finally, Abner said to him, Go back home. So Paltiel went back home.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba zuɣulana daa yi zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la ti maani sara alahichi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maa zaɣ muna yiri tin tariga ti nyɔri buɣim.
en: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri bi viɛla, lala biɛhigu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o suhu piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The LORD detests a crooked heart, but he favors those whose path is innocent.

dag: Ka Dauda niriba maa daa ti nya Ijipti nachimbil so mɔɣu maa ni n-zaŋ o ka Dauda sanna nti ti o bɔrɔbɔro ka o ŋubi, ka ti o kom ka o nyu.
en: Davids men found an Egyptian in a field and took him to David. They gave the Egyptian some water to drink and some food to eat.

dag: Yi ni daa labina ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, Yawɛ daa bi wum yi kuhigu maa bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa be yi ni.
en: So you cried out to the Lord for help, but he would not listen to you or pay any attention to you.

dag: Ka paɣ mi yi yi o yidan yiŋ kuli do so, o gba tum zina.
en: A woman who divorces her husband and marries again is also unfaithful.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin m-puhi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi chuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. O ni daa lɛbigi Asiria naa suhu ti ba ka o sɔŋ ba Izraɛl Naawuni jɛmbu duu mɛbu tuma ni la.
en: For seven days they joyfully celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread. They were full of joy because the Lord had made the emperor of Assyria favorable to them, so that he supported them in their work of rebuilding the Temple of the God of Israel.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn turila binshɛŋa bɛ ni bi mi; ka binshɛŋa bɛ ni baŋ kaman biŋkɔbiri ni baŋdi shɛm mi nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o ni nimmoo, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: But Peter strongly protested, I will never say I dont know you! I will even die with you! And all the other followers said the same thing.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini kpam din be di ni zaa ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi n-nyo buɣim kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la.
en: the kidneys and the fat on them, and the best part of the liver.

dag: Yawɛ m-paɣir a, dama nyini n-yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka chɛ ka n dimnim bi di dari niŋ ma.
en: Lord , you lifted me out of my troubles. You did not give my enemies a reason to laugh, so I will praise you.

dag: Zaŋm a ni daa da jinjɛŋŋma shɛli sɔri maa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti zaŋ li pi tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: Take the undergarment that you are wearing and go at once to the Euphrates and put it under a rock.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a mini so zabi ka di ka soli, ka di pala o tum a la taali.
en: Dont accuse anyone without reason, when they havent harmed you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum baŋdiba zaa bɛn be Babilɔn.
en: At this, the king exploded in a furious rage and ordered that all Babylons sages be wiped out.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: Whoever isnt with me is against me, and whoever doesnt gather with me scatters.

dag: Di simdi ni yi kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: Never be guilty of doing any of these disgusting things!.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Eleazar did what the Lord commanded.

dag: A du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ gbiŋgbaŋ jaaŋgbe kabili din ni tooi kuhi nir ŋun zaŋ omaŋ dalim li nuu ŋɔ. Lala n-nyɛ Firawuna zaŋ chaŋ ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ dalim o polo.
en: Are you depending on Egypt to help you? Egypt is like a broken walking stick. If you lean on it for support, it will only stab you and hurt you. Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, cannot be trusted by anyone who depends on him for help.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ka bi chaŋ.
en: But you werent willing to go up. You rejected the LORD your Gods instruction.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu. N ni tɔɣisi n fabila ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka shɛli ku kaɣili ma. N ni tɔɣisi ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: I am tired of living. Listen to my bitter complaint.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni niŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa n zuɣu, dama bɛ bi mi ŋun tim ma na.
en: They will do to you whatever they did to me, because you belong to me. They dont know the one who sent me.

dag: Ka bɛ yi bi gbaai tayiɣ maa, dindina di simdi ka yili maa lana chaŋ Naawuni sani nti wuhi kaman o nuu tim o kpee maa daazichi maa ni bee di bi tim.
en: But if the thief is not found, the one who was keeping the valuables is to be brought to the place of worship and there he must take an oath that he has not stolen the other one's property.

dag: Zaŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ yi wumpaɣibo sara maligu na, ka moliya yi ni tiri pin shɛŋa pahiri la molo, dama yinim Izraɛlnim ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken!.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣisiri nachimba ka bɛ niɛmdi zim, ka chɛ ka bidibisi ʒiri dabɔb kara chani ʒiɛhira.
en: Our young men are forced to grind grain like slaves; boys go staggering under heavy loads of wood.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bindirigu pam be di ni. N ni ti ti di nandaamba bindirigu.
en: I will most certainly bless its food supply; I will fill its needy full of food!.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, chibimi gooni maa voli. N ni daa chibi gooni maa ka di niŋ voli.
en: He said, Mortal man, break through the wall here. I broke through it and found a door.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔab yaa naaya. Di lan ka yiko.
en: Moabs strength has been cut off. Its arm has been broken. This is what the Lord said.

dag: dindina n ni zo ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ darigi yi tibili buyopɔin yi daalahichinim maa zuɣu.
en: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nuzaa tabila n zuɣu gbibi, ka a nudirigu mi bɔb gbaai ma mali.
en: Your left hand is under my head, and your right hand caresses me.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni, kuhimi pampam niŋ ti Duuma. Chɛ ka a nintam zɔri yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni kaman kɔpaliga la. Miri ka a ti amaŋ vuhim, di chɛ ka a nina vuhi.
en: O Jerusalem, let your very walls cry out to the Lord! Let your tears flow like rivers night and day; Wear yourself out with weeping and grief!.

dag: O bia Shɛmaya gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim pam.
en: Obed Edoms son was Shemaiah. Shemaiah also had sons. His sons were leaders in their fathers family because they were brave soldiers.

dag: Dunɔdali daa be dundombil ni nudirigu polo. Ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti kpa dunɔdali din be nudirigu polo, ka di nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: There was a gate to the inner courtyard on the south. When he measured from gate to gate on the south side, it was one hundred fifty feet.

dag: Yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita maa naabu dali, ka Yawɛ niriba gbilligbilli maa zaa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: On the day the years ended, all the tribes of the Lord 's people left Egypt.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ zaa saha shɛli, ka buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara shɛŋa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali duu maa.
en: When King Solomon finished his prayer, fire came down from heaven and burned up the sacrifices that had been offered, and the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence filled the Temple.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi zaŋ chaŋ o sani, ka kul taari duŋ niŋdi Zallakudura Naa mɔɣu maa ni.
en: But they continued to sin against God, and in the desert they rebelled against the Most High.

dag: Yilimiya yila jɛm Yawɛ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o tiligi tarimba nyɛviya tuumbiɛrinim nuu ni.
en: Sing to the Lord ! Praise the Lord ! He saves the lives of the poor! He saves them from the wicked!.

dag: Ka o ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba, ka to n-wurim ba kaman yaɣiri duɣiri ni ŋmari n-wurisiri shɛm la, ka o yiko maa ni be kaman mmaŋmaŋ gba ni daa deei yiko shɛli m Ba Naawuni san la;.
en: to rule the nations with an iron rod and smash them like pottery.

dag: Malimiya yi binyɛra zaa mini yi binshɛŋa din nyɛ biŋkɔbiri gbana ni buhi kɔbiri binyara zaa ni dari binyara zaa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: You must also purify every garment, and everything made of leather, goats hair, or wood.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani ni o ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve apostles, went to talk to the leading priests about handing Jesus over to them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro maa ti o nyaandoliba ni bɛ tari niriba maa; di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi ŋmahi zahim ayi la mi pahi zaŋ tari bɛ zaa.
en: Then Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, and gave thanks to God. He broke the loaves and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.

dag: Tiŋgbani maŋmaŋ n-chɛ ka di niŋdi maa: Tuuli, di tɔrimi duna niŋ vari; din paya, ka di ti va puya n-naanyi dɔɣi;.
en: Without any help the ground produces grain. First the plant grows, then the head, and then all the grain in the head.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni. Ka o yɛligu maa daa gari ba pam.
en: Then Jesus told them, Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God. The men were amazed at Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa bahi Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa noli yɛli Zaŋmi niriba ata kpe m-pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti yihi anabi Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ka o ku kpi.
en: Zedekiah answered, Take of my soldiers and pull Jeremiah out before he dies.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa paɣ o ninni ka yina nti maag o ni ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya bindirigu ti ti na.
en: Then Joseph washed his face and came out. He regained control of himself and said, Now it is time to eat.

dag: Yawɛ n-su ti naba chandi ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ baŋ timaŋmaŋ soya?.
en: The Lord has determined our path; how then can anyone understand the direction his own life is taking?.

dag: Nyama, n lɔr a la mihi, ka a ku tooi lan lɛbigi yaɣ yini polo dɔni yaɣ din la hal ka a ti naai a teei gili dabisa maa.
en: I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.

dag: Kulla Yisa ka ti naɣ nya! Naawuni daa chɛ ka o pooi malaikanim saha biɛla puuni ni ŋun Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu chɛ ka o kpi sokam zaa zuɣu. Ka ti nya ka o mali jiri mini jilima pumpɔŋɔ o ni daa di wahala kpi kum shɛl la zuɣu.
en: For a short time Jesus was made lower than the angels, but now we see him wearing a crown of glory and honor because he suffered and died. Because of Gods grace, Jesus died for everyone.

dag: Amaa lee tɔɣisimiyala taba yɛlimaŋli yurilim puuni, ka zooi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la ni binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: No, we will speak the truth with love. We will grow to be like Christ in every way. He is the head.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mini Yisa daa laɣim diri maa gbaai bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi yɛra taba, Ŋun mi n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ti chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba.
en: The people sitting at the table began to think to themselves, Who does this man think he is? How can he forgive sins.

dag: Di daa bi yuui, ka o kuhi yɛli, Wɔribariba be chɛchɛbuŋ ni, ka yuri ayi vɔri li kanna! Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli, Babilɔn luya, di luya! Ka di wuna binnana zaa lu n-wurisiwurisi do tiŋa.
en: Here they come: charioteers, pairs of horsemen! One spoke up and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon, and all the images of her gods are shattered on the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu shia ni ka niŋgbun shɛl ni ni nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kpiŋ shɛm la, lala ka yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma gba nyɛ yɛda kpiŋ.
en: So then, as the body without the spirit is dead, also faith without actions is dead.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino nya biɛhigu shee yi yidaannim yinsi. Ka Naomi daa chɛbisi ba ka ŋmaligi. Ka paɣiba ayi maa zaa dii kuhiri.
en: I pray that the Lord will help each of you find a husband and a good home. Naomi kissed her daughters-in-law, and they all started crying.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya Filip la Azɔtus, ka o doli nimaani tinsi n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu hal ti paai Siizaria.
en: Philip found himself in Azotus. He traveled through that area, preaching the good news in all the cities until he reached Caesarea.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ma pul ni na? M paɣiya ka n daa kpi ka so nini na bi nya ma.
en: So why did you let me be born? I wish I had died before anyone saw me.

dag: Bɛ daa kpiya ka bɛ saha na bi paai kaman kom ni ʒiri tanzaa chani shɛm la.
en: who were swept away without warning.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, n ni daa be yi sani ka yi deeri n noli shɛm la, hal n ni ka yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, di niŋ kamaata ni yi na kul deeri n noli lala. Kul tummiya ni dabiɛm zɔbu mini ni sɔhibu nti nya yi tiliginsim tuma naabu.
en: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Ammihul bia Shɛmuɛl.
en: from the tribe of the Simeonites, Shemuel, Ammihuds son.

dag: Ninsalinim daa di malaikanim bindirigu. O daa ti ba li pam.
en: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.

dag: Ti zaŋmiya ti viɛla wala mini abie tihi vari ni ti shɛŋa din mali vari wulikpana ni kul tihi na di piligu dali maa nti wuhi yi suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On that day take some of the best fruit from your trees, take palm branches and limbs from leafy trees, and begin a religious festival to honor the Lord your God.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kamina ka n ti a saɣisigu shɛli din ni chɛ ka a tooi tilig amaŋmaŋ min a bia Sulemaana nyɛviya.
en: You and your son Solomon will be killed, unless you do what I tell you.

dag: bɛ ni kpi n-chaŋ ti pahi bɛ yaannim ni m-be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ zibisim shee hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: he will join all his ancestors in death, where the darkness lasts forever.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, A yi ti labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛlli ŋɔ. Ka daa lan yɛli, Sokam zaa, wummiya.
en: Micaiah said, Listen to me, everyone! Ahab, if you come back alive from the battle, the Lord has not spoken through me.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ ti zani baɣil o n-ku o, ka pilig o zuɣupiligu din be o zuɣu ni, ka lan pirigi baŋ din be o nuu ni na, dama n daa baŋya ni o ni lu n-doya shɛm maa, o ku lan gali. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o nɛma maa na ni n ti ti nyini n dana.
en: So I went up to him and killed him, because I knew that he would die anyway as soon as he fell. Then I took the crown from his head and the bracelet from his arm, and I have brought them to you, sir.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ma ni n zaŋ wuhi ya ka yi ti doli li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: Now these are the commandments, the regulations, and the case laws that the LORD your God commanded me to teach you to follow in the land you are entering to possess.

dag: ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: They love to have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

dag: Ifriim tiŋgbɔŋ ku lan mali birini, ka Damaskusnim kɔŋ nam. Ka Aramnim bɛn kpalim ni kɔŋ jilima kaman Izraɛlnim ni kɔŋ shɛm la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Ephraims security will cease, as will Damascus rule. Whats left of Aram will resemble the glory of the Israelites, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: ka ti wum salo ni garita ka o bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee niŋdi maa.
en: The man heard the crowd walking by and asked what was happening.

dag: N ŋmanila Sharɔn tutuɣu din pum viɛli pam, ka ŋmani vinvamli ni Paɣiviɛligakushihikom.
en: I am only a wild flower in Sharon, a lily in a mountain valley.

dag: hal ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi bi kɔŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli yi ni guhiri saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: Now you have every gift from God while you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to come again.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa yi nayili n-chaŋ ti yɛli naa.
en: So Ebedmelech went there and said to the king.

dag: Dama n daa fa nandaamba bɛn kuhiri bahi, ka fa kpibisi bɛn ka ŋun ni sɔŋ ba bahi.
en: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sin tiŋgban nɛli maa ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Dofika.
en: Then they camped at Dophkah.

dag: Ka Abija min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam, ka bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: , enemy troops.

dag: A nyɛla Naawuni suŋ, ka tumdi din viɛla; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: You are good, and you do good things. Teach me your laws.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du duli ha.
en: That evening, Jesus said to his disciples, Let's cross to the east side.

dag: Amaa wula ka Naawuni daa lee garigi yɛl o? O daa yɛl o, M mali niriba tusa ayopɔin bɛn na bi jɛm buɣili Baal.
en: But what is Gods reply to him? I have kept for myself seven thousand people who havent bowed their knees to Baal. .

dag: Bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm wuhiri ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm sabi be bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha gba di ba shɛhira ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama shɛlini bɛ tɛha galindi ba, ka shɛlini mi ka di zaani bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: This proves that the conscience is like a law written in the human heart. And it will show whether we are forgiven or condemned.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino.
en: The Scriptures say, That is why a man will leave his father and mother and join his wife, and the two people will become one.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa kpe Maika yiŋ ti kpuɣi dari binnani mini tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru ni binnan bihi ni anzinfa binnani maa, ka maligumaana maa bɔhi ba, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tumdi maa.
en: When the men went into Micah's house and took the sacred objects, the priest asked them, What are you doing.

dag: Ka Pɛkahia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali du shɛli din be puuni la mini du titali maa dukpina ka ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi ŋmahima pa di zuɣu.
en: The walls of the two rooms were decorated with carvings of palm trees, flowers, and winged creatures.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye yurilim zuɣu, ka bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina, di bahi bamdi anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini.
en: It is love, then, that you should strive for. Set your hearts on spiritual gifts, especially the gift of proclaiming God's message.

dag: M bia, wummi n yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka luɣi a tiba wum m baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Son, listen to this piece of wisdom from me. Pay attention to what I know to be true.

dag: Dauda daa nyɛla Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Ɛfirat daŋ ni nira, ka be Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgban ni la. O daa malila bidibis anii. Sool ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛsi daa kurigiya pam.
en: Now David was Jesses son, an Ephraimite from Bethlehem in Judah who had eight sons. By Sauls time, Jesse was already quite old and far along in age.

dag: ka bɛ laɣimbu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbia ni o ti yɛl o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaa ni bɛ kana ni binshɛɣukam shili biya.
en: When it was time to eat, he sent his servant to tell the guests, Come. The food is ready.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Ti yi bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a ni a yɛli ti ka ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ ŋun dim shɛhira jɛndi ti.
en: They answered, The Lord himself will be our witness that we promise to do whatever he says.

dag: Ka yi ti kpi tinzunnim maa sunsuuni, ka yi dimnim maa tiŋgbani ti vali ya.
en: You will disappear among the nations—the land of your enemies will devour you.

dag: Dama a nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bahira; amaa ka siɣisiri karimbaannima.
en: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Misia tintariga shee m-bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Bitinia, amaa ka Yisa Shia daa bi saɣi;.
en: When they approached the province of Mysia, they tried to enter the province of Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus wouldnt let them.

dag: Dunɔdali maa tooni zaŋ hal ti paai zɔntua puuni dunoli maa ni, di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu.
en: The total length of the gateway from the outside wall of the gate to the far side of the last room was feet.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ kpam din be yiligu ni maa m-booi bah o zuɣu ni, o biɛyanim maa zaa tooni. Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi Dauda zuɣu na pam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi labi Rama.
en: So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him right there in front of his brothers. The LORDs spirit came over David from that point forward. Then Samuel left and went to Ramah.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣina ti pali bia maa ba Zakaria, ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra.
en: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, To, di pa taali! Amaa Yawɛ yi zaŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna niŋ n nuu ni, n ni zaŋ ya pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n du n-tam yi zuɣu nɔn ya.
en: Then Gideon said, The Lord will help me capture Zebah and Zalmunna. And since you would not give us any food, I will come back and beat you with thorns and briers from the desert.

dag: Ti ni mali dunia ŋɔ ni doo la kɔtomsi shɛm, lala ka ti ni ti mali do so ŋun yi alizanda ni na la gba kɔtomsi.
en: We were made like that man of earth, so we will also be made like that man of heaven.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, O yi nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ, hal o zabigu zaɣ yini gba ku lu tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be o kɔbili ni, o ni kpi.
en: So Solomon answered, If Adonijah shows that he is a good man, I promise that not a hair on his head will be hurt. But if he does anything wrong, he will die.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannima bɛn mali yɛm, ka mali yu suma n-zaŋ ba leei yi zuɣulaannima. Ka bɛ su niriba tuhilituhili mini niriba kɔbigakɔbiga ni niriba pihinunu ni niriba piapia fukumsi, ka nyɛ yi daŋ kam ni kpamba.
en: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of . or , or , or .

dag: N pun wum dimbɔŋɔnim pam; yi zaa bɛn di yɛn maai n suhu ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn lan saɣindi n suhu pam.
en: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.

dag: N ni zaŋ mmaŋ pa talima o zuɣu, ka a ti bɔh o yɛla n sani. N yi ti bi ʒi o labina ti ti a, nyin chɛ ka di taali kul ʒi n zuɣu sahakam.
en: I promise to bring him back safely, and if I don't, you can blame me as long as I live.

dag: Daadam ni daa tahi kum na shɛm, lala ka daadam lan tahi kpiimba kum ni neebu gba na;.
en: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa naan ku tooi chaŋ nimaani ni o ti bɔhi Naawuni shɛli yɛla, dama o daa zɔrila Yawɛ malaika la takɔbi la dabiɛm.
en: but David couldnt go there to seek God because he feared the sword of the LORDs messenger.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni so yi bɔri alibarika, Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ n-ni niŋ alibarika maa niŋ o ni. Ka ŋunkam mi yɛn po pɔri, ŋun pom li dalim la Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim maa. Dama n tam yɛl shɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla. Di zaa yiɣiya ka firi.
en: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted.

dag: Yinim Galilinim ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee ʒiɛya lihiri zuɣusaa lala? Ka lan yɛli ba, Yisa so yi ni nya ka o yi yi sani chani alizanda ni shɛm maa, lala ka o ti lan yɛn labina.
en: and said, Galileans, why are you standing there looking up at the sky? This Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way that you saw him go to heaven.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka wuntaŋ lu wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka yuŋ zibi wuntaŋ maa ni.
en: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.

dag: Di simdi ni yi bo kulagaa niŋ yi nɛma ni, ka yi yi ti yi kpaŋa ni yi ti damdi yɔɣuni, ka yi zaŋ li gbi bɔɣili pi yi bindi maa.
en: Carry a shovel with the rest of your gear; once you have relieved yourself, use it to dig a hole, then refill it, covering your excrement.

dag: Di daa yi chana, di chanila luɣa anahi maa zaa ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: so that they could move in any direction without turning.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei ka bɛ daŋ yiɣisibu lo tab alikauli, ka Yisahaku daa chɛbisi ba ka bɛ kuli ni suhudoo.
en: Early next morning each man made his promise and sealed it with a vow. Isaac said good-bye to them, and they parted as friends.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o ku n-vu o ti bahi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha.
en: So they grabbed the son and killed him and threw his body out of the vineyard.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli nachimbil maa, Miri ka a yɛli so ni a kana ti yɛli ma yɛlli maa. Ka daa chɛ ka o yi n-kuli.
en: The commander dismissed the young man, ordering him, Dont tell anyone that you brought this to my attention.

dag: Ka paɣ maa paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihitanaata. Di bi simdi ni o shihi binshɛli din be kasi bee n-kpe luɣ kasi shee hal ka o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa maa ti naai.
en: For thirty-three days the mother will be in a state of blood purification. She must not touch anything holy or enter the sacred area until her time of purification is completed.

dag: ka tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi wuntitali soya dolibu ka dolila zibisim soya la.
en: They forsake the way of integrity and go on obscure paths.

dag: Amaa niŋmi Barizillai ŋun nyɛ Giliad nir la bihi nirilim, ka zaŋ ba pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. Dama bɛ daa niŋ ma nirilim saha shɛli a biɛli Absalom ni daa kariti doli ma ka n zɔri la.
en: Also, be kind to the children of Barzillai from Gilead. Be friends with them, and let them eat at your table, because they helped me when I ran away from your brother Absalom.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali Naawuni Shia Kasi vihiri binshɛɣukam zaa baŋdi di gbinni, amaa ka so ku tooi vihi baŋ ŋun yɛla gbinni.
en: Spiritual people comprehend everything, but they themselves arent understood by anyone.

dag: O daa lan kpuɣi Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka ka o daa dɔɣi Abija mini Atai ni Ziza ni Shɛlomit.
en: Then Rehoboam married Maacah. Maacah was Absaloms granddaughter. And Maacah gave Rehoboam these children: Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

dag: Yi lan pihiri nimaani nyolinsi n-leeri buɣa jɛmdi li; ka boori binyɛra mini zimbuli bahiri di zuɣu. Yi tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ni chɛ ka n suhu piɛla?.
en: You take smooth stones from there and worship them as gods. You pour out wine as offerings to them and bring them grain offerings. Do you think I am pleased with all this?.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, Aduna ni zaŋdi li zaani ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni kaman lzraɛlnim ʒiɛyimtali, ka di leei alikauli sahakam.
en: Aaron will always set it out before the LORD, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a permanent covenant.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta zuɣusaa daboli din nyɛ zaɣ nɛli zuɣu. Kuhimiya yɛli tɔbbihi, ka kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa wuhi ni yi cham ti liri tin shɛli din niriba mali karimbaani la.
en: On the top of a barren hill raise the battle flag! Shout to the soldiers and raise your arm as the signal for them to attack the gates of the proud city.

dag: Ka di daa ti paai biɛɣu pia maa, ka bɛ nina ni kul nɛmi zaa kasi, ka bɛ lan ŋmɛlim gari bɛ tab bɛn zaa daa diri nayili bindirigu maa.
en: At the end of ten days they looked better and healthier than all the young men who were eating the kings food.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, Yawɛ chu shɛli bɛ ni puhiri yuuni kam la beni, ka bɛ ni puhi li Shilo din be Bɛtɛl nuzaa polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo solɔɣu din yi Bɛtɛl kuni Shɛkɛm, ka be Lɛbɔna nudirigu polo la.
en: Then someone suggested, What about the Lord 's Festival that takes place each year in Shiloh? It's held north of Bethel, south of Lebonah, and just east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem.

dag: Suhugarigu zuɣu chɛmi ka n nina niŋ liti, Yawɛ, n kul teela n nuhi n-suhir a dabisili kam.
en: my eyes are weak from suffering. Lord , every day I call to you and lift my hands to you in prayer.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa biŋkpam ni zugbini kpam ni kpam din pili namanama ni binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla.
en: His sons placed all the fat, as well as the kidneys and the lower part of the liver.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili firilatamdigu la mini di firilanim ni di firiladuhirisi ni firilakpihindisi ni di tahipɔna ni di kpam ni be kpaŋman shɛŋa ni;.
en: They will take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, its lamps, its extinguishers, its trays, and all the containers for oil that are used in its service.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niriba leei daba.
en: And everywhere in Egypt all the people became Pharaohs slaves.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai, ka o teeg o nuhi min o naba wuhi ba.
en: After Jesus said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

dag: Shiina Naa Amirafɛl mini Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ni Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal.
en: About this time, King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Chedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ku ma suli, ka n suhu yiɣisi la, n daa loya ni n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba; ka daa bi taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, Your ancestors made me angry, so I decided to destroy them. I decided not to change my mind. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Bɛn daa di li maa daa nyɛla kaman niriba tusaanahi laasabu.
en: This was a crowd of about four thousand people! Jesus sent them away.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba yɛla muɣis a. Di zabiri ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli;.
en: Dont get fighting mad at evil people; dont be envious of the wicked.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli Naawuni nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mi bi ʒiɛm so, o yɛm galisiya pam.
en: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Naawuni o jɛmbu duu. Paɣimiy o zuɣusaa din nyɛ o yiko ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Praise the Lord ! Praise God in his Temple! Praise him in heaven, his strong fortress!.

dag: Ka yi yi tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka doli wun shɛŋa n-tumdi bɛ ni bɔri shɛm ka jɛmdi li, nimmoo ka n yɛri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi.
en: But if you do, in fact, forget the LORD your God and follow other gods, serving and bowing down to them, I swear to you right now that you will be completely destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino yɛli ma, Di kumda! Nyama, Naa Dauda zuliya ni bɛ ni booni so Juda zuliya ni Gbuɣinli la di nasara. Dinzuɣu o ni tooi tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ka bɔɣi litaafi maa.
en: Then one of the elders said to me, Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the Lion from the Tribe of Judah and King David's Great Descendant has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.

dag: Duumanima, yi gba niŋmiya yi daba lala, ka chɛ ba dabiɛm kpɛhibu, dama yi mi ni yi mini ba zaa Duuma be alizanda ni, ka o mi bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites.

dag: Amaa o yi bi paɣ o situra bee n-su kom, o taali maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If they do not, they must suffer the consequences.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya o ninni, ka o yuli ni ti sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela daɣiri mini saɣiri zuliya shɛb sani.
en: You have made us the garbage dump of the world.

dag: Ka din pah ayopɔin daa gbaai Jɛsarɛla min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi;.
en: the seventh to Jesarelah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Bɛ daa bu o la paa ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm n-chɛ ka n tum alahichi lala niŋbu ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli, ka mali ma ansarisi.
en: They hired him to frighten me into sinning, so that they could ruin my reputation and humiliate me.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ʒirilana ka pa ni ŋun chihi ni Yisa pala Masia? Ninvuɣ so ŋun chihi ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia maa, dilana n-nyɛ Masiachihira.
en: Who, then, is the liar? It is those who say that Jesus is not the Messiah. Such people are the Enemy of Christ—they reject both the Father and the Son.

dag: Riuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza. Iso paɣ Basɛmat bihi n-daa bala.
en: These are Reuels sons: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the sons of Esaus wife Basemath.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa paɣir a ti jɛmbu du kasi shɛli puuni la, buɣim di li, ka luɣ shɛŋa zaa din viɛli ka ti daa yuri li la wurim doya.
en: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yɛli ma, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: I heard a voice say, Get up, Peter! Kill and eat.

dag: O ni lo a alikauli ni a zaŋm o leeg a tumtumda sahakam?.
en: Will he make an agreement with you and promise to serve you forever?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim niriba maa zaa chaŋ Raba ti tuhi deei li.
en: So David gathered all the soldiers together and went to Rabbah. He fought against Rabbah and captured the city.

dag: Lumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka jɛmiy o kɔŋko, ka zaŋya yimaŋ ti o, ka zaŋd o yuli pɔri pɔri.
en: Have reverence for the Lord your God and worship only him. Be faithful to him and make your promises in his name alone.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka muɣisigu ŋɔ paai niriba ka bɛ ti chani kaman zoomba la, bɛ ni tum alahichi man Yawɛ sani zuɣu. Bɛ ʒim ni yi n-zɔri kaman kom la. Ka bɛ niŋgbuna ti dɔni tiŋgban ni pooi.
en: I will make humanity suffer; they will walk like the blind because they sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their intestines like manure.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa sabi yilli ŋɔ dindali maa n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: So Moses wrote this poem down that very day, and he taught it to the Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya niriba ayi ka bɛ ʒe m-baɣi mɔɣili, yino daa ʒɛla yaɣ yini polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe yaɣ din la polo.
en: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi yɛli bɛ ni zaŋ liɣiri maa n-niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni ni bɛ yo tumtumdiba maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di liɣiri maa shɛm laasabu wuhi ba, dama bɛ daa doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: There was no need to check on those who received the money and paid the workers, because they acted honestly.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo n-doli wuna n-jɛmdi li, ka tumdi di tuma. Ka miriya ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa din ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: They told you not to worship and serve other gods and not to make the Lord angry by worshiping the idols you had made. If you had obeyed the Lord , then he would not have punished you.

dag: Yisa min o ni daa yur o nyaandol so la n-daa ʒi n-tab taba.
en: One of the followers was next to Jesus and was leaning close to him. This was the one Jesus loved very much.

dag: Labisimiya yi tɛha zali di zaashee, ka di lan tumdiya alahichi yaha. Di nyɛla vi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ni n yɛli ni yi ni shɛb bi mi Naawuni yɛla baabiɛla.
en: Come back to your right senses and stop your sinful ways. I declare to your shame that some of you do not know God.

dag: ka yɛra, Ami! Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun su alibarika mini yɛm ni yiko ni kpiɔŋ simdi jilima tibu mini paɣibu ni tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami.
en: and said, Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ba zalila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bɛ zoori ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Those who have been replanted in the LORDs house will spring up in the courtyards of our God.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni Yɛhudianim bɛn yi a sani n-kuli ti sanna la chaŋ ti ʒinila Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ lab mɛrila di tiŋ din nyɛ tin biɛɣu ni duŋtaabo tiŋ maa yaha. Bɛ pun sɔŋ di tanzahi, ka me di goma maa miri naabu.
en: We want Your Majesty to know that the Jews who came here from your other territories have settled in Jerusalem and are rebuilding that evil and rebellious city. They have begun to rebuild the walls and will soon finish them.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mali suhupiɛlli bɛn je ma daashaara nyabu zuɣu bee m mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu ni paai ba zuɣu.
en: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.

dag: Yisa ni daa naai ŋaha ŋɔ, o daa yila nimaani.
en: When Jesus finished these parables, he departed.

dag: N di yuya ni Naawuni saɣi ku ma. O wɔɣisim o nuu ka chɛ ka n lu.
en: and do away with me.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma zuɣu ni yi karimmi gbaŋ ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la zaa.
en: By the Lords authority, I order all of you to have this letter read aloud to all the brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o nachimba ka bɛ ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣiri mini bɛ naba n-zaŋ li ti lo n-yili baɣili Hiburɔn biaŋ. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu maa ti sɔɣi Abinɛr siliga din be Hiburɔn la ni.
