en: Then David said to his troops, Kill these two brothers! Cut off their hands and feet and hang their bodies by the pool in Hebron. But bury Ishbosheth's head in Abner's tomb near Hebron. And they did.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛhiŋ la suhuri;.
en: Have mercy on those who doubt.

dag: A zaligunim kul nyɛla din tuhi sahakam. Tim ma baŋsim din ni chɛ ka m be.
en: Your laws are righteous forever. Help me understand so I can live!.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Yawɛ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: In the center of this section, a special area miles by miles is to be dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Dauda tɔbutuhiri kpamba, bɛ mini Izraɛlnim zaa n-daa be Dauda kɔbili ni sɔŋd o pam o nam maa ni, ka o nyɛ naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo la.
en: This is the list of David's famous soldiers. Together with the rest of the people of Israel, they helped him become king, as the Lord had promised, and they kept his kingdom strong.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be Akasia saha shɛli ka bɛ daa piligi bɔri Mɔab paɣiba.
en: When the Israelites lived at Shittim, the people made themselves impure by having illicit sex with Moabite women.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi dii pali ma, ka n nya ka nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni ka so ʒi nimaani.
en: At once I was in a Spirit-inspired trance and I saw a throne in heaven, and someone was seated on the throne.

dag: Bɛ piɛma diri pam, bɛ tɔbiri gba guri viɛla. Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ŋmanila pilima, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi kalima zɔri gindi yomyom kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la.
en: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready to shoot. Their horses' hoofs are as hard as flint, and their chariot wheels turn like a whirlwind.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa n-vo laŋ din pali ziŋ kara maa duna. Zahim maa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga ni pihinunaata, amaa bɛ ni daa zooi shɛm maa zaa yoli, laŋ maa daa bi cheei.
en: Simon Peter got back into the boat and dragged the net to shore. In it were large fish, but still the net did not rip.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binnɛma balibu kam, bɛnya tiŋgbani zuɣu; niɣi mini binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam. Ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: God said, Let the earth produce every kind of living thing: livestock, crawling things, and wildlife. And thats what happened.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi niriba maa, ka bɛ zaa lab kuli bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Joshua sent everyone back to their homes.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu palli bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na, dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: Good people have good things saved in their hearts. Thats why they say good things. But those who are evil have hearts full of evil, and thats why they say things that are evil. What people say with their mouths comes from what fills their hearts.

dag: ni Uzia ŋun daa nyɛ Ashitɛrat nir la ni Shama mini Jɛiɛl bɛn daa nyɛ Hɔtam Aroa nir la bihi la.
en: Uzzia the Ashterathite; Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite.

dag: Naawuni ʒin o ʒiishee saria karibu ni; o kari saria wuna sunsuuni.
en: God presides in the heavenly council; in the assembly of the gods he gives his decision:.

dag: Gɛrishomnim mi, bɛ daa zaŋla Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti ba. Bɛ daa zaŋla Golan din be Bashan la mini Ashitarɔt ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The Gershon families got the towns of Golan in the area of Bashan and Ashtaroth from half the tribe of Manasseh. They also got the fields near those towns.

dag: Di daa nyɛla binnɛma la kpiŋkpama din daa shihiri taba la mini kalima din baɣi li la vuri. Di daa vurimi kaman tiŋgbani n-damdi pampam la.
en: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.

dag: Miri ka a deei anab shɛb bɛn yɛr a ni a di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu, dama bɛ tɔɣisir a la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Pay no attention to the words of the prophets who encourage you not to serve the king of Babylon, for they are lying to you.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi zim mali binshɛli bɔrɔbɔro duu puuni mini bɛ ni chim shɛli zaa tahilaa bee mahilaa puuni, maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: Every grain offering belongs to the priest who offers it. That priest will get the grain offerings that were baked in an oven, or cooked on a frying pan, or in a baking dish.

dag: Ti bi be kaman Anabi Musa ŋun daa zaŋ sariga pili n-lir o ninni ni Izraɛlnim di nya jilima din daa ti yɛn vuu la bahigu la.
en: We arent like Moses, who used to put a veil over his face so that the Israelites couldnt watch the end of what was fading away.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Pa Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu la tin ya? Amaa yi ni so bi dol li. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma.
en: Moses gave you the law, right? But you dont obey that law. If you do, then why are you trying to kill me.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila Yawɛ suhu yula bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ mini sara pina n-gar o noli deebu? Nyama, noli deebu gari sara maligu, ka o yɛligu wumbu mi gari piɛla kara.
en: Samuel said, Which does the Lord prefer: obedience or offerings and sacrifices? It is better to obey him than to sacrifice the best sheep to him.

dag: Ɛzɛr n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu nyɛ Obadia, ka ŋun pahi ata nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: Ezer was the leader of the army from the tribe of Gad. Obadiah was the second in command. Eliab was the third in command.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam bɛn daa nyɛ bukpahinim laɣisi bɛ tabibi tumbu kundinim na nti nyɔri buɣim niriba maa ninni; ka bɛ daa mali di liɣiri laasabu ka di paai kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu dahin yini tuma yɔri.
en: Some who had been practicing witchcraft even brought their books and burned them in public. These books were worth about , silver coins.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pini zuɣukpina, ka so buri a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum a zuɣu ni suhusaɣiŋgu mini fabila pam.
en: They shave their heads for you And dress themselves in sackcloth. Their hearts are bitter as they weep.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini Itiɔpianima ni Putinima ni Ludinima ni Areebianim zaa ni Libianima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din niriba zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai ba.
en: Soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, as well as from Israel, will die in that battle.

dag: Di saha ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ paɣ yoli ŋun bi zani tuhi bia ŋɔ. A tɛhi ni m bi mi ni a zaŋ Jɛsi dapala maa kpɛh a kɔbili ni ni a dihila amaŋ vi, ka lan dih a ma gba vi?.
en: At that, Saul got angry at Jonathan. You son of a stubborn, rebellious woman! he said. Do you think I dont know how youve allied yourself with Jesses son? Shame on you and on the mother who birthed you!.

dag: Dama yi dolila Omri zaligunima, ka tumdi Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa, ka doli bɛ kaya. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi yiya kpalim zani dabari, ka di niriba nya filiŋ, ka zuliya kam zaa ti mali ya ansarisi.
en: Yet you have kept the policies of Omri, all the practices of the house of Ahab; you have followed their counsels. Therefore, I will make you a sign of destruction, your inhabitants an object of hissing! You must bear the reproach of my people.

dag: Yisa daa ti lan wuhiri niriba dahin shɛli, ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi m-mir o; bɛ daa yila Jɛrusalɛm mini Galili ni Judia tiŋkpansi na. Ka ti Duuma yiko din daa chɛ ka Yisa tibiri barinim maa daa be ŋun Yisa sani.
en: One day when Jesus was teaching, some Pharisees and teachers of the Law were sitting there who had come from every town in Galilee and Judea and from Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was present for Jesus to heal the sick.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ suhuri chihi pam, ka bɛ bɔhi Pita min o tab maa, Ti mabihi, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: When the people heard this, they felt very, very sorry. They asked Peter and the other apostles, Brothers, what should we do.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbu saha shɛli, ka o daa lan kpuɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bipuɣiŋga n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Sɛgub.
en: Later when Hezron was years old, he married Makirs daughter. Makir was the father of Gilead. Hezron had sexual relations with Makirs daughter, and she gave birth to Segub.

dag: yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɔrili zaɣ titali ŋun daa mali kpiŋkpaŋ kara, ka o kpiŋkpan piɛma wɔɣa, ka o mali kɔb garigari pam daa ti ka Lɛbanɔn na. O daa gbaala sida tia.
en: Say, The LORD God proclaims: The great eagle with great wings, long feathers, and full, colorful plumage came to Lebanon and took the top branch of the cedar.

dag: Bɛ bi niŋ yɛda ni bɛ ni lan yi zibisim ni yaha, bɛ nyɛla takɔbi ni yɛn ku shɛba.
en: An evil man has no hope of escaping the darkness. There is a sword somewhere waiting to kill him.

dag: Zaŋmiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nina ka nyɛ zoomba la na, ka zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tiba ka nyɛ tikpiranim la na.
en: Bring out the blind people who have eyes, the deaf ones who have ears.

dag: ni Judas Jeemsi so bia mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti leei nyaanyira la.
en: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became the traitor.

dag: Bɛn mali kpiɔŋ tɔbiri kabisiya, ka ninvuɣ gbarima nya yaa.
en: The bows of strong soldiers break, and weak people become strong.

dag: Yawɛ dabisi titali la miriya. Di miriya, ka kanna yomyom. Ka Yawɛ dabisili maa kandina ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu pam, ka tɔbbihi ni ti ŋme tɔbuchiriga dindali maa.
en: The great day of the LORD is near; it is near and coming very quickly. The sound of the day of the LORD is bitter. A warrior screams there.

dag: Ka kul doliya n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ n ni daa sab shɛŋa tin ya la. Kul doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: Never worship any other god, always obey my laws and teachings.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla Yɛhudianim kɔŋko Naawuni? Bee o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni? Iin, o nyɛla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba Naawuni.
en: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi Midian mini Ɛfa laakum pola na ti niŋ yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni. Ka Shiibanim zaa ʒi salima mini tulaale zim na; ka leei bɛn paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: Countless camels will cover your land, young camels from Midian and Ephah. They will all come from Sheba, carrying gold and incense, proclaiming the LORDs praises.

dag: A yɛliya, N ka taali, m bi tum birigi shɛli, n kul bela kasi, ka taali shɛli ka n kɔbili ni.
en: I am pure and innocent; I did nothing wrong; I am not guilty!.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ahija ŋun nyɛ Shilo nir la yɛli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam shɛm la palibu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Rɛhɔbɔam bi saɣi ti niriba maa.
en: The king didnt listen to the people because this turn of events came from the LORD so that he might keep the promise he delivered through Ahijah from Shiloh concerning Jeroboam, Nebats son.

dag: Ka zoomba mini gbariti daa ka o sanna Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: People who were blind and lame came to Jesus in the temple, and he healed them.

dag: Ka daŋ kam puuni dunoya zuɣulaannim shɛb gba daa ti salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pisopɔinayika ni anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: The family leaders gave pounds of gold to the treasury to support the work. They also gave pounds of silver.

dag: O zaŋ o lɔɣu ni piɛm to n suhu.
en: He shot me in the stomach with his arrows.

dag: Naawuni daa lan yɛl o ni o zuliya ni ti be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim ti zaŋ ba leei daba n-niŋ ba wahala yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: God put it this way: His descendants will be strangers in a land that belongs to others, who will enslave them and abuse them for four hundred years. .

dag: Yi yi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, o ni niŋ alibarikanim ŋɔ zaa niŋ yi ni.
en: All these blessings will come upon you and find you if you obey the LORD your Gods voice.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ʒili naa dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn guli Lɛvinim yaɣili polo dunɔdal la gbini.
en: Now these men stand next to the Kings Gate on the east side. They were the gatekeepers from the tribe of Levi.

dag: Paɣ yi birigi n-tum daɣiri tuma saha shɛl o ni be o yidan sulinsi ni, ka o yidan maa zilis o.
en: These are the instructions about jealousy, when a wife has an affair while married to her husband and defiles herself.

dag: Ka ŋun daŋ tooni daa yina m-mɔha, ka o niŋgbuŋ zaa mali kɔbiri m-be kaman biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri siturili la; ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Iso.
en: The first one was reddish, and his skin was like a hairy robe, so he was named Esau.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Di pun sabi anabinim litaafinim ni ni Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni wuhi sokam zaa. Ka ŋunkam wum ka bɔhim m Ba sani n-nyɛ ŋun kani n sanna.
en: One of the prophets wrote, God will teach all of them. And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma chɛri fali zaani bɛ yaansi, amaa alahichinim buni nyɛla wuntizɔriba ni ti yɛn su shɛli.
en: Good people leave their grandchildren an inheritance, but the wealth of sinners is stored up for the righteous.

dag: Anzinfa mini salima palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daazichi ka tariga. Yuri palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ka tariga.
en: Jacobs land has been filled with silver and gold from other places. There are many treasures there. His land has been filled with horses and many chariots.

dag: Yi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu puuni, yi mali yi suhu ni bɔri binshɛɣukam ka diri nyaɣisim pam. Yi dihi yimaŋa ŋ-ŋmɛlim kaman biŋkɔbiri bɛn ʒe n-guli bɛ kɔrigibu dali.
en: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.

dag: Ti ni mali salima mini anzinfa yɛri ti a.
en: Lets make you some more gold jewelry and decorate it with silver.

dag: Ŋuna n-saɣindi yɛmbimbiɛrinim ni lo nia ni bɛ tum tuun shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nuhi bi diri nasara.
en: He upsets the plans of cunning people, and traps the wise in their own schemes, so that nothing they do succeeds;.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate asked him, Are you the king of the Jews? So you say, answered Jesus.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ anabinim polo: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi. N ŋmanila ŋun nyu dam kuli ka ŋmani ŋun nyu wain buɣi, Yawɛ min o yɛligu kasi zuɣu.
en: My heart is crushed, and I am trembling. Because of the Lord , because of his holy words, I am like a man who is drunk, someone who has had too much wine.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim shɛb zaa bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ kali ba kaman sokam ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm la, bɛ dɔbba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaayi.
en: The total enrollment of the Levites, all the males over one month old whom Moses and Aaron enrolled by orders from the LORD, according to their clans, was .

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yidan yipa ni zaŋ omaŋ tabili ma, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ata ti o; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Lɛvi.
en: She became pregnant again and gave birth to a son. She said, Now, this time my husband will embrace me, since I have given birth to three sons for him. So she named him Levi.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan ŋɔ di ma shɛhira ni n yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi sani pala Iin mini Aai yɛla.
en: As surely as God speaks the truth, my promise to you was not a Yes and a No.

dag: Ti kul dolila ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun nyɛ Rɛkab bia maa ni daa zali ti zaligu shɛŋa maa, dina n-nyɛ ni ti mini ti paɣiba ni ti bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi di nyu wain ti biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: Our clan has always obeyed Jonadab's command. To this very day, we and our wives and sons and daughters don't drink wine or build houses or plant vineyards or crops. And we have lived in tents.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi di binshɛli din mali dabindi, Di simdi ni yi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: You should not eat anything made with yeast in all your settlements. You should eat only unleavened bread.

dag: N naɣ mali yɛm yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisirila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ba n-zani, amaa di pala ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛm bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim bɛn ni ti vuui ŋɔ yɛm.
en: Yet I do proclaim a message of wisdom to those who are spiritually mature. But it is not the wisdom that belongs to this world or to the powers that rule this world—powers that are losing their power.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni niŋdi anfaan shɛli niŋdi ti ni galisiya pam; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni Kundi yɛli, Naawuni zaɣisiri karimbaannima, amaa ka lee niŋdi anfaani niŋdi bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ ni.
en: But he gives us more grace. This is why it says, God stands against the proud, but favors the humble .

dag: Ka ŋun paya yɛli, N dala naɣikɔra pia, ka yɛn zaŋ ba chaŋ ti zahim bɛ tuma, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: Another one said, I have bought five pairs of oxen and am on my way to try them out; please accept my apologies.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni doo be o ko, n ni nam sɔŋda ŋun simd o ti o.
en: Then the Lord God said, I see that it is not good for the man to be alone. I will make the companion he needs, one just right for him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ o nyaandoliba m-pa omaŋ zuɣu dol o.
en: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.

dag: Ka Pasɛa bia Joyada mini Bɛsɔdɛya bia Mɛshulam daa mali me Dunɔdal Kurili la. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.

dag: amaa ka Naa Jɔram ŋun daa lab Jɛziriil ni o ti tibi dan shɛŋa Sirianim ni daa ti o saha shɛl o mini Siria Naa Hazaɛl ni daa tuhiri tab la. Ka Jɛhu daa yɛli, Di yi nyɛla lala ka yi bɔra, yin di chɛ ka so yi tiŋ ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti yɛli Jɛziriilnima.
en: but King Joram had gone back to Jezreel to recover from wounds that the Arameans had given him when he fought Hazael. So Jehu said, If this is the way you feel, then dont let anyone escape from the city to talk about it in Jezreel.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Lɛhi tiŋgban ni vinvamli tahi bɔɣi, ka kom yi di ni na, ka Samsin nyu ka o ni maai, ka o kpiɔŋ lan labina yaha. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbili nini maa yuli Ɛnhakɔr. Ka di na kul be Lɛhi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So God split open the hollow rock in Lehi, and water flowed out of it. When Samson drank, his energy returned and he was recharged. Thus that place is still called by the name En-hakkore in Lehi today.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka anabi Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi Nɛria bia Baruk yɛtɔɣa, ka Baruk daa sabi yɛtɔɣa maa niŋ gbaŋ ni saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisiri maa.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, Jeremiah the prophet spoke these things to Baruch son of Neriah. Baruch wrote them on a scroll. This is what Jeremiah said to Baruch:.

dag: n-sɔɣi ŋuniya mal li tɔri ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali; bɛ kul tɔrila niriba libigiri ba, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Suddenly, from their hiding places, they let their arrows fly. They shoot to kill innocent people.

dag: Ka salo maa galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bara maa zaŋ paai Yisa sani, ka daa dula duu maa zuɣusaa nti chib voli Yisa zuɣusaa dɛde. Bɛ ni daa chib voli maa, ka bɛ zaŋ bara maa mini amaŋka maa siɣisi li ti sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: But they could not get the man inside to Jesus because the house was so full of people. So they went to the roof above Jesus and made a hole in it. Then they lowered the mat with the paralyzed man on it.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa yɛl o, Miri ka a chɛ ka ti niriba ŋɔ wum a damli, ka bɛ puuni suhuyiɣisilinim lu a zuɣu n-ku a min a yiŋnima.
en: The men from the tribe of Dan answered, You had better not argue with us. Some of our men become angry easily. If you shout at us, they will attack you. You and your families will be killed.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛdɔr tooni Vinvamli wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: They went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to find pasture for their flocks.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛli din nyɛ Saimɔn din ni, ka balim o ni o tirisim li zal o tooni biɛla. Ka o daa ʒini ŋariŋ maa ni wuhiri niriba maa.
en: Jesus got into the boat that belonged to Simon and asked him to row it out a little way from the shore. Then Jesus sat down in the boat to teach the crowd.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Ʒe a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini; ka n chaŋ Yawɛ sani kpe ha.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering, and I will meet God over there.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ o ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna nti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu, ka tɔɣi o ʒim bahi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ o nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: The priest shall present it at the altar, wring its neck, and burn its head on the altar. Its blood shall be drained out against the side of the altar.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, O yi nyɛ alahichilana bee o pa alahichilana n ku tooi baŋ. Bin yini kɔŋko ka n naɣ mi: N daa nyɛla zoma, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n neeya.
en: I do not know if he is a sinner or not, the man replied. One thing I do know: I was blind, and now I see.

dag: Hal bɛ sapashinnim mini bɛ tuumba ni pun paai Ijipti tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Zɔan mini Hanɛs la zaa yoli.
en: Though their officials are in Zoan, and their messengers reach Hanes.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ galisiya pam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba, ka yi bɔri ni bɛ chɛ tuun kpema tumbu bebɔ.
en: There are very many workers, and you are keeping them from doing their jobs.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kɔtomsi shɛli ka di biɛhigu ŋmani daadam. Din daa be kaman o shee la tiŋli polo daa nyɛla buɣim, ka shee maa zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo mi daa kul piɛli paratɛte, ka be kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: I looked, and there was a form that looked like fire. Below what looked like his waist was fire, but above his waist it looked like gold, like gleaming amber.

dag: Yawɛ nam binshɛlikam la ni di daliri, hal ninvuɣ biɛri benila bɛ wahala nyabu dali zuɣu.
en: The LORD made everything for a purpose, even the wicked for an evil day.

dag: ni o tiligi ba kum ni, ka dihiri ba kum saha.
en: He saves them from death. He gives them strength when they are hungry.

dag: Ka yi daa ti nya ka Nahash Ammɔnnim naa la daa lo tɔb kana ni o ti tuhi ya, ka yi yɛli ma, Aai, ti bɔri ni naa n-su ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ yi naa di saha maa.
en: But then you saw King Nahash of the Ammonites coming to fight against you. You said, No, we want a king to rule over us! You said that, even though the Lord your God was already your king.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya Yila litaafi puuni: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: David himself says in the scroll of Psalms, The Lord said to my lord, Sit at my right side.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛ ni boli ni bɛ ka Piɛbil maa amiliya lɔbu chuɣu bindirigu dibu ni na mal alibarika! Ka lan yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu maŋli.
en: Then the angel said to me, Write this: Favored are those who have been invited to the wedding banquet of the Lamb. He said to me, These are the true words of God.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti gbani bɛ buɣa la tooni bee n-jɛm ba bee n-tum kaman bɛ ni tumdi shɛm, amaa ti daamiya bɛ buɣa maa zaa luhi, ka wurim bɛ ni me buɣa maa binwɔɣil shɛŋa zaa zali.
en: Do not bow down to their gods or worship them, and do not adopt their religious practices. Destroy their gods and break down their sacred stone pillars.

dag: O daa va malaika n-nyaŋ o, ka kuhi niŋ o n-suh o bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka o daa ti nya Naawuni Bɛtɛl, ka Naawuni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: He struggled with the messenger and survived; he wept and sought his favor; he met him at Bethel, and there he spoke with him.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi laɣim taba ni naŋgban yini m-paɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ.
en: so that all of you together may praise with one voice the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu n-zan o ba Dauda zaani leei naa. O daa tɔŋya, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa deeg o noli.
en: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.

dag: Amaa ka Hadad daa be Ijipti maa ka ti wum ni Dauda min o sapashin kpɛm Jɔab zaa kpiya, ka o daa yɛli Firawuna, Tim ma soli ka n lab kuli n ya.
en: When Hadad heard that David and Joab were dead, he said to the king, Your Majesty, please let me go back to my own country.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhiri ni o ni niŋ o ni lo alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Isaiah replied, The Lord will give you a sign to prove that he will keep his promise.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Asiria naa sapashin kpamba kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ mii tu o nyee ni, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: So the Lord brought commanders from the king of Assyrias army to attack Judah. These commanders captured Manasseh and made him their prisoner. They put hooks in him and brass chains on his hands and took him to the country of Babylon.

dag: Di yi ti nyɛ asiba, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla zaawuni. Ka zaawuni yi ti paai, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla asiba. Dabiɛm din ti yɛn be yi suhuri ni mini yi nina ni ti yɛn nya binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: In the morning you will say, I wish it were evening! In the evening you will say, I wish it were morning! This will happen because of the fear in your heart and the terrible things you will see.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Kiriatijiarimnim sani ti yɛli ba, Filistianim labisi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la na, kamiyana ti kpuɣi li.
en: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath-jearim. The Philistines returned the LORDs chest! they said. Come down and take it back with you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N ni kana nti chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: I will go and heal him, Jesus replied.

dag: ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan pun booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam Gihɔn; ka bɛ yi nimaani na m-mali suhupiɛlli, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɔri vuri tiŋ puuni maa. Di vuri ka yi wum maa.
en: and Zadok and Nathan anointed him as king at Gihon Spring. Then they went into the city, shouting for joy, and the people are now in an uproar. That's the noise you just heard.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ni o yihi ba sansani maa ni hal ka bɛ zaa daa ti shiri kpi.
en: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.

dag: Yɛhudianim kpeen so daa beni ka o yuli booni Nikɔdimus. O daa nyɛla Farisiinim ni yino.
en: There was a man named Nicodemus, one of the Pharisees. He was an important Jewish leader.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Naa Zɛdɛkia n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn Naa sani Ribila, ka o daa kar o saria.
en: Zedekiah was taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who was in the city of Riblah, and there Nebuchadnezzar passed sentence on him.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛli, Alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But some people said, He forces out demons by the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of the demons.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni.
en: Then some teachers of the Law said to themselves, This man is speaking blasphemy.

dag: Yi yi chɛ o dolibu, o ni lan chɛ niriba ŋɔ bahi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka yinima n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: If you people of Reuben and Gad refuse to follow him now, he will once again abandon all these people in the wilderness, and you will be responsible for their destruction.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ ʒim; yi ni ti kpaai li mi bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: Even so, dont consume any blood. Pour it out on the ground, like water.

dag: Lala ka Dauda daa zaŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni kuɣili labi Filistia doo maa ku o, ka takɔbi daa ka Dauda nuu ni.
en: And thats how David triumphed over the Philistine with just a sling and a stone, striking the Philistine down and killing him—and David didnt even have a sword!.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God; I brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord .

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai di puuni palo din nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di leei Naawuni jɛmbu duu palo, ka di yaɣili kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu. Ka yi ŋmaai palo din yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu gili di zaa.
en: The temple will be on a piece of land meters square, and the temple will be completely surrounded by an open space meters wide.

dag: N di yuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chirindi ya maa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dii leela namɔɣilisi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!.

dag: Yi churi puhibu ni, yi ŋmɛrila goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnima, ka piɛbiri yuhi, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka nyuri wain, amaa ka bɛ lihi nya Yawɛ tuma bee n-lihi nya o yiko tuma.
en: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done.

dag: Karimbaannim bari ma la tɔŋ, ka teei bɛ mihi sɔŋ kaman laŋ la, bɛ bari ma la zana soli zuɣu.
en: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa puuni, a ka taali, dama a nyɛla ŋun ʒe ti yim, ka tinim lee tum din bie.
en: You have been just in all that has happened to us; you have acted faithfully, and we have done wrong.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni ti zaa ti zani Masia tooni ka o kari ti saria, ka sokam ti deeg o ni daa tum shɛm o niŋgbuŋ ni nyɔri, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies.

dag: Ka n yi saɣim yi suhuri n ni daa sab gban shɛli tin ya la puuni, n suhu bi miligi di zuɣu, hal n suhu ni daa pun miligi di zuɣu la zaa yoli, dama n nyaya ka gbaŋ maa daa shiri saɣim yi suhuri, amaa ka yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa daa lee bi yuui.
en: Even if the letter I wrote you made you sad, I am not sorry I wrote it. I know that letter made you sad, and I was sorry for that. But it made you sad only for a short time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa moli zaligu maa gili ni bɛ kum baŋdiba maa zaa, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Daniɛl min o tab la ni bɛ ku bɛ gba.
en: So the order was issued for all of them to be killed, including Daniel and his friends.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, yi ni ti wum kuŋa Zahim Dunɔdal la gbini, ka wum fabila yiya pala la ni, ka wum vuri pam daboya zuɣu.
en: On that day—says the LORD— an outcry will resound from the Fish Gate, wailing from the second quarter, a loud crash from the hills.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ ŋubiri bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka bɛ zaa ti ŋubiri taba bɛ dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya ka teei gili ba la nahiŋgu zuɣu.
en: And when their enemies lay siege to the city, seeking their lives, they will resort in desperation to eating the flesh of their sons and daughters, and to devouring the flesh of their neighbors.

dag: Ka o daa moli molo gili Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm zaa ni bɛ yo Yawɛ farigu shɛli Naawuni dabili Musa ni daa zali Izraɛlnim tiŋgban nɛli ni ni bɛ yo la.
en: Then a proclamation was issued throughout Judah and Jerusalem requiring the people to bring to the LORD the tax that Gods servant Moses had imposed on Israel in the wilderness.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o wuhibu maa gari ba pam.
en: The crowds were surprised to hear what Jesus was teaching.

dag: Bɛ kul dolila bɛ nia biɛri maa soli n-gbaari nia ni bɛ bari zana ashilɔni; ka tɛhira, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya ti?.
en: They encourage each other in their evil plots; they talk about where they will place their traps. No one can see them, they say.

dag: Ka tuumbaŋdiba bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee maa daa ti yi bɛ tuma shee na.
en: Finally, all the skilled workers building the sanctuary left their work that they were doing one by one to come.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Jɔa bia Asaf ŋun daa su bɛ ni sab gban shɛŋa sɔŋ tuma la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka ŋmaligi lab Hɛzɛkia sani nti yɛl o Rabishake ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Hilkiahs son Eliakim, who was the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Asaphs son Joah the recorder, came to Hezekiah with ripped clothes. They told him what the field commander had said.

dag: Zabili piligu ŋmanila bɛ ni yi cheei kom bahi la, dinzuɣu zom yi zabili ni ka di na bi piligi.
en: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.

dag: Yi tuumbiɛri n-chɛ ka m-mɔŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnima, ka yi daalahichi mɔŋ ya din viɛla.
en: You dont have these blessings because you have done wrong. Your sins have kept these good things away from you.

dag: Adɔnikam daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayopɔin.
en: the descendants of Adonikam:.

dag: Di saha ka kpambaliba maa daa yɛli Baruk, Cham ka a mini Jɛrimia ti sɔɣi, ka di chɛnya ka so baŋ yi ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: The officials then said to Baruch, You and Jeremiah had better go and hide. And dont let anyone know where you are.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, m bi bɔri yi naɣikpahi ni naɣilahi bee yi buzɔna ni buhi.
en: And yet I do not need bulls from your farms or goats from your flocks;.

dag: Na so ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana yi su tarimba, o ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun ŋumda bee jɛŋgbini ŋun yiɣina ni o gbaai so.
en: Poor people are helpless against a wicked ruler; he is as dangerous as a growling lion or a prowling bear.

dag: Ka Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Amaŋmaŋ yiɣisim ku ti. Dama doo ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ gba. Ka Gidiɔn daa yiɣisi ku Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka yihi bɛ laakumnim nyiŋgoya ni nachiinsi binyara.
en: So Zebah and Zalmunna said, You stand up and strike us yourself, because as they say, A man is measured by his strength! So Gideon stood up and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels necks.

dag: N ni yɛl a o naba min o bɔɣiri ni o yaa ni o biɛhigu ni viɛl shɛm yɛla.
en: Im not awed by his limbs, his strength, and impressive form.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Ibrahimma, Milika gba dɔɣi bihi ti a mabia Nahɔr.
en: After these events, Abraham was told: Milcah has now also given birth to sons for your brother Nahor.

dag: ka o bɛhi nyɛ kuriti, ka o napɔnvari shɛli polo nyɛ kuriti, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri.
en: its legs of iron, and its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnima kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Bɛ ni daa deei li naai, bɛ daa ʒinila di ni.
en: So the Lord kept the promise that he had made to the Israelites and gave the people all the land that he had promised. The people took the land and lived there.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi ti paai tiŋ shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya maa ni nti kpuɣi di tiŋgbani maa daatam, yin zaŋmiya yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli maa bindir tuuli kam bɔbili na ti ti maligumaana;.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land that I am giving you and harvest its produce, you must bring the first bundle of your harvest to the priest.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kum o kuli, ka zaŋ o ti sɔɣi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Ahija yɛli shɛm la.
en: The people of Israel mourned for him and buried him, as the Lord had said through his servant, the prophet Ahijah.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ŋumaŋuma jɛndiri ma? Yi zaa taala duŋ zaɣisi ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Why would you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me, declares the LORD.

dag: N yi siɣisi mmaŋa n-lo noli, bɛ turi ma la n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ni nya filiŋ, ka sokam di vi. Di chɛ bɛ taali!.
en: Everyone will be humiliated and disgraced. Do not forgive them, Lord !.

dag: amaa niriba daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu, Masia daa malila sara maligu yim din kul ni ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But Christ offered only one sacrifice for sins, and that sacrifice is good for all time. Then he sat down at the right side of God.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ʒini gbilligbilli: Shɛb kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi pihinunu.
en: They sat down in groups of and groups of .

dag: N yi nya din daa niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni paɣisara la, di biɛri ma mi.
en: My eyes hurt me because of whats happened to my citys daughters.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, A daa ŋmanila paɣiŋoo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, yilimi yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli. Nyini ŋun na ʒi n-wolisi ŋɔ! Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, a ni mali bihi gari paɣ so ŋun mali yidana.
en: Sing, barren woman who has borne no child; break forth into singing and cry out, you who were never in labor, for the children of the wife who has been deserted will be more numerous than the children of the married, says the LORD.

dag: Do so ŋun daa nya alahiziba tibbu maa yuma daa gari yuun pihinahi.
en: because the man who had experienced this sign of healing was over years old.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri yi ti nya o, ŋun kum o.
en: The close relative responsible for the blood of the dead is the one who will put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he will execute him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kadɛshi maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hɔr Zoli gbini din miri Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ tintariga la shee.
en: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.

dag: Ka o ba Yisahaku bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o yɛl o, Mani a bituuli Iso.
en: But Isaac said to him, Who are you? He answered, I am your son—your first son—Esau.

dag: Man yɛm, m mini baŋsim m-be, ka baŋsim mini fahim be n sani.
en: I am Wisdom —Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.

dag: N ni zaŋ o wain tihi puu la labisi ti o, ka chɛ ka Akɔr Vinvamli leei tahima dunoli. Nimaani o ni ti saɣi ti ma kaman o paɣisarilim saha la ni kaman o ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la.
en: There I will give her vineyards. I will give her Achor Valley as a doorway of hope. Then she will answer as she did when she came out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa lan chaŋ Manaasa mini Ifriim ni Simiɔn zuliya tinsi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Naftali zuliya tinsi ni nti gili bɛ dabari la ni zaa.
en: Josiah did the same for the towns in the areas of Manasseh, Ephraim, Simeon, and all the way to Naphtali. He did the same for the ruins near all these towns.

dag: Bɛ deei kulibɔna dubu shee la, ka nyo bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la buɣim, ka tɔbbihi suhuri fuŋ.
en: The enemy have captured the river crossing and have set the fortresses on fire. The Babylonian soldiers have panicked.

dag: Yɛm bi boonila niriba? Ka tɛhi zilima mi duhiri di yee?.
en: Doesnt Wisdom cry out and Understanding shout?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o ku n-vu o ti bahi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha.
en: So they grabbed the owner's son, killed him, and threw his body out of the vineyard.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ a ni pun darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili alaka; ka nahind a ni ti shɛb dansi la pahira.
en: They persecute those whom you have punished; they talk about the sufferings of those you have wounded.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa mini Samarianim zaa ni nya li. Amaa bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ duhimaŋtali zuɣu, bɛ ni yɛli.
en: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zali Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab maa samli ka bɛ yo, ka bɛ naanyi bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So they made Jason and the other followers pay bail before letting them go.

dag: Ka Pita daa dol o yi ka bi baŋ ni malaika maa ni niŋ o shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa tɛhi ni o zahimla zahindi.
en: So the angel went out and Peter followed. He did not know if the angel was really doing this. He thought he might be seeing a vision.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ Sool takɔbi nyaɣi pa gbaɣino maa zuɣu, ka yɛn chaŋ ka di nyaŋ o, dama o daa na ʒi n-zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa. Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, N ku tooi zaŋ nɛma ŋɔ niŋ mmaŋ chaŋ; dama m bi mil li. Ka daa yihi di zaa sɔŋ.
en: David strapped on a sword and tried to walk around, but he was not used to wearing those things. I can't move with all this stuff on, David said. I'm just not used to it. David took off the armor.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda mini bɛn zaa be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Amaa mbusim be dunia mini teeku zuɣu! Dama Sintani siɣi yi sanna ni sujee zaɣ titali o ni mi ni o saha bi lan wɔɣa zuɣu.
en: And so be glad, you heavens, and all you that live there! But how terrible for the earth and the sea! For the Devil has come down to you, and he is filled with rage, because he knows that he has only a little time left.

dag: Sool ni daa kuli ti tuhi Filistianim maa ka labina ka bɛ yɛl o, Nyama Dauda be Ɛngɛdi.
en: When Saul came back from fighting the Philistines, he was told that David was in the wilderness near Engedi.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋ bali niriba maa ni n-niŋdi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.

dag: Yisa alizanda ni labbu saha ni daa ti miri, o daa lo nia ni o chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Not long before it was time for Jesus to be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni daa nya ka n ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka n daa tim Timoti yi sanna ni di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛda niŋbu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Dama n suhu daa kul zɔhirimi ni di pa shɛli ka Sintani ti zahim ya ka ti tuma la zaa kpalim yoli.
en: Thats why I sent Timothy to find out about your faithfulness when I couldnt stand it anymore. I was worried that the tempter might have tempted you so that our work would have been a waste of time.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa zaŋ yi Kadɛshibarinia hal ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa daa nyɛla yuun pihinahaayika hal ka di ʒiɛman maa ni bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba zaa daa ti kpi sansani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri po pɔri yɛli ba shɛm la.
en: This was years after we left Kadesh-Barnea, and by that time all the men who had been in the army at Kadesh-Barnea had died, just as the Lord had said they would.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuhiri yɛri lala maa ka bɛ mali bɛ binyɛra gahiri ka toori taŋkpaɣu yaɣindi zuɣusaa.
en: They kept shouting. They waved their clothes around and threw dust into the air.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayi, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ayi yɛli, Kamina.
en: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, Come.

dag: M birimmi zaa n dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛli zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɔri vu shɛli zuɣu. Dama bɛ niŋ ma muɣisigu pam, ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka je n yɛlli.
en: My enemies shout at me and threaten me. In their anger they attack me. They bring troubles crashing down on me.

dag: Amaa ka so daa zaŋ Ribɛka bituuli Iso ni yɛli shɛm maa ti yɛli Ribɛka, ka o daa tim ti bol o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa na ti yɛl o, A biɛli Iso ni zaŋ shɛli maag omaŋ suhu nyɛla, o lɔrila nia ni o ku a.
en: But when Rebecca heard about Esau's plan, she sent for Jacob and said, Listen, your brother Esau is planning to get even with you and kill you.

dag: O nina ŋmanila ŋmana bɛn ʒe kɔzɔrim noli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ bihim paɣi shɛba.
en: His eyes are a pair of doves bathing in a stream flowing with milk.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa suhu daa yu Yisifu pam, ka Yisifu daa tumd o tuma, ka o zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ tumtumdiba zuɣulana, ka zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Potiphar thought highly of Joseph, and Joseph became his assistant; he appointed Joseph head of his household and put everything he had under Josephs supervision.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, Karimba, tuun sun bɔ ka n lee yɛn tum ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A man came to Jesus and asked, Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life.

dag: Amaa di wuhiri yi gba yɛla: Di simdi ni yidan kam yur o paɣa kaman omaŋmaŋ la; ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣ kam gba lur o yidan sizuura.
en: But each one of you must love his wife as he loves himself. And a wife must respect her husband.

dag: Di simdi ni ti mabi so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka Naawuni duh o mali suhupiɛlli;.
en: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɔhimi duŋtaariba maa, Yi bi mi dimbɔŋɔnim maa gbinni? Yɛlim ba, Babilɔn naa n-daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti gbaai di naa mini di kpambaliba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: Explain this story to the people of Israel who always turn against me. Tell them this: The first eagle is the king of Babylonia. He came to Jerusalem and took away the king and other leaders. He brought them to Babylonia.

dag: Kaman nɔhi ni pali nɔsuɣu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ di nɛma ti pali bɛ yinsi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ leei wɔɣira ni bundaamba.
en: Their houses are full of lies, like a cage full of birds. Their lies made them rich and powerful.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim bɛn gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa nuu ni la yɛla.
en: The people of Israel didnt remember the LORD their God, who had delivered them from the power of all their enemies on every side.

dag: Zaŋmiya ʒilinsi biɛhigu bahi ka be, ka doliya tɛhi zilima soli.
en: Leave the company of ignorant people, and live. Follow the way of knowledge.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni booni tab yɛra, Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa yɛl o, M ba, a yi pun yaag a noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, nyin niŋm ma kaman a ni pun yɛli shɛm maa, Yawɛ ŋun dee ni bɔh a dimnim Ammɔnnim biɛri ti a ŋɔ.
en: But she replied to him, My father, youve opened your mouth to the LORD, so you should do to me just what youve promised. After all, the LORD has carried out just punishment for you on your enemies the Ammonites.

dag: N ni zaŋ o leei m bituuli, ka o gari dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: I will make him my first-born son, the greatest of all kings.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayi dali zaŋmiya naɣilabihi pinaayi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the second day offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Yin ni tooi di binshɛŋa zaa bɛn be kom ni n-nyɛ: binshɛɣukam bɛn mali gɔhi mini paɣiri.
en: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni la shiri yi a zuɣu.
en: The Lord said, Do this to prove to the Israelites that the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, has appeared to you.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Naawuni tooni nimaani n-duhi bɛ yee kum pam ka fabili yɛli.
en: But the people came to Bethel and sat there until evening before God, raising their voices and crying bitterly.

dag: Zaŋm nɛkaŋa n-niɛm zim. Paam a sariga sɔŋ, ka kahi a mukuru ka chɛ a biɛhi n-siɣi mɔɣa kom ni du.
en: Turn the millstone! Grind the flour! Off with your veil! Strip off your fine clothes! Lift up your skirts to cross the streams!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tin ya ko mahim biɛla yi ni nyɛ Masia nyaandoliba la zuɣu, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: I can assure you that anyone who helps you by giving you a drink of water because you belong to the Messiah will definitely get a reward.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga shɛɣuni kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛl o ni o ni dɔɣi saha shɛli maa.
en: But the woman did become pregnant and gave birth to a son that next spring, just as Elisha had said.

dag: Ka a lan pii di shɛli niŋ buɣim ni n-nyo li. Ka buɣim maa yi nimaani na nti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.

dag: Ka wula ka ninsal lee ni tooi be kasi Naawuni tooni? Wula ka paɣ ni dɔɣi so lee ni tooi be ka ka daɣiri?.
en: How can anyone claim to be right before God? No human being can really be pure.

dag: Piɛ yini daa malila fiig tiwal viɛla kaman fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi, amaa piɛ din la din daa malila fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: One basket was filled with fresh and ripe figs; the other basket was filled with rotten figs—too rotten to eat.

dag: Di saha, Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la ti ku lan zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim zuliya shɛb bɛn bahiri ba yol la, amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: Then the people from Jacobs family who are left living in Israel will stop depending on the one who beat them. They will learn to depend on the Lord , the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Di saha n ni ti chɛ ka di koma niŋ viɛlim, ka chɛ ka di kulibɔna kom zɔri kaman kpam la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: At that time, I will allow the waters to run clear, and make its rivers flow like oil. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Mbusim be a zuɣu, nyini ŋun kuri niriba, ka so na bi ku a ŋɔ; nyini yɛŋkiŋkabinalana, so ʒi n-tum a yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma. A yi ti chɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, bɛ ni tum a yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma; ka a yi ti chɛ niriba kubu, bɛ ni ku a.
en: Our enemies are doomed! They have robbed and betrayed, although no one has robbed them or betrayed them. But their time to rob and betray will end, and they themselves will become victims of robbery and treachery.

dag: Ŋun yur o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋun mi je o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti mal li hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Those who love their lives will lose them, and those who hate their lives in this world will keep them forever.

dag: A min a bidibisi yi yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni, yin di nyu wain bee binnyɔr kpiɔŋ, yi yi niŋ lala yi ni kpi; di nyɛla zaligu din kul ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam.
en: You and your sons are not to enter the Tent of my presence after drinking wine or beer; if you do, you will die. This is a law to be kept by all your descendants.

dag: ka leei ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ka di pala o yila maligumaaniba zuliya ni na kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu, amaa ka nyɛla maligumaana nyɛvil shɛli din ku bahi yol la yiko zuɣu.
en: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ ninsal maa niŋ Idɛn puu maa ni ni o kɔr li, ka yuuni li.
en: The LORD God took the human and settled him in the garden of Eden to farm it and to take care of it.

dag: Paɣ yi zaɣisi ni o zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dindina di simdi ni o chɛ o zabiri m-bahi; amaa di yi nyɛ vi ni paɣ chɛ o zabiri bee m-pini, ŋun bom bini m-pil o zuɣu.
en: If the woman does not cover her head, she might as well cut her hair. And since it is a shameful thing for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair, she should cover her head.

dag: ka niriba dooi anzinfa mini salima pa di zuɣu, ka zaŋ kpahi mini matarika n-kpahi li zali, din ni chɛ ka di ku dam.
en: They make their idols beautiful with silver and gold. They use hammers and nails to fasten their idols down so that they will not fall over.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba sani ti yɛli ba, Ti pola pɔri ni shee ti ku Pool, di yi pa lala ti ku di shɛli.
en: Then they went to the chief priests and elders and said, We have taken a solemn vow together not to eat a thing until we have killed Paul.

dag: Dama o ni chɛ ka o malaikanim gul a a chandi shee zaa.
en: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.

dag: Ba maa ni neeri kpiimba kum ni ka tiri ba nyɛvili shɛm, lala ka Bia maa gba tiri o ni bɔri so nyɛvili.
en: The Father raises the dead and gives them life. In the same way, the Son gives life to those he wants to.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛbisi Izraɛlnima, ka sokam daa lab kuli ni bɛ ti deei bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa ti ba maa.
en: Then Joshua told the people to go home, so each tribe went to take their area of land.

dag: Bɛ niriba anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn yi Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ zaa.
en: These four were descendants of the giants of Gath, and they were killed by David and his men.

dag: Ka Sool yaaŋa Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔnatan bia maa daa ka Naa Dauda sanna nti lu n-gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura. Ka Dauda bol o, Mɛfibɔshɛt. Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: Mephibosheth, Jonathans son and Sauls grandson, came to David, and he fell to the ground, bowing low out of respect. Mephibosheth? David said. Yes, he replied. I am at your service.

dag: ka bɔhi Musa, Gbala n-daa lee ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti na ni ti ti kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti yi Ijipti na?.
en: They said to Moses, Weren't there any graves in Egypt? Did you have to bring us out here in the desert to die? Look what you have done by bringing us out of Egypt!.

dag: Ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi la, amaa ka ti dimnim daa kari ti nimaani, ka wurim a jɛmbu shee din be kasi maa.
en: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Amon did what the Lord said was wrong, just as his father Manasseh had done.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Naa maa yɛligu maa bahi ka bɛ yi n-gbaai chandi; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka saŋmar so bɛ ni daa nya wulimpuhili polo maa dii gari bɛ tooni hal nti kpalim zani bia maa ni daa be yil shɛli maa dɛde.
en: When they heard the king, they went; and look, the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stood over the place where the child was.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bimbihili gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni. Dina n-daa nyɛ Musa tarili maligumaana leebu piɛlaa maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord . This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.

dag: Wɔhu simdila fiɛbiga, ka buŋ simdi langami, ka jɛra yaansi zuɣu mi simdi fiɛbiga.
en: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti lan da yiya mini puri ni wain tihi puri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaha. .
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi pina na ti ti Yawɛ. Ŋunkam mali yurilim o suhu ni, ŋun zaŋmi Yawɛ pina din nyɛ: salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: Make an offering to the Lord . Everyone who wishes to do so is to bring an offering of gold, silver, or bronze;.

dag: Bin ayi ka n suhir a ni a ti ma li pɔi ka n naanyi kpi.
en: God, I ask you to do two things for me before I die.

dag: N daa ŋme ba luhi n naba ni, ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.

dag: Ishimail daa lan ku Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Gɛdalia sani mini Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Ishmael also killed all the men of Judah who were with Gedaliah at the town of Mizpah. He also killed the Babylonian soldiers who were there with Gedaliah.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli zaɣisi wumbu.
en: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord , became angry.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ daa malila bidibis ayi, ka bɛ daa ti chaŋ puu ni ti zabi, ka so kani ŋun ni goo ba, ka yino daa ŋme n-ku ŋun la.
en: I had two sons. They were out in the field fighting. There was no one to stop them. One son killed the other son.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla; ka o yurilim maŋli kul beni sahakam.
en: Praise the Lord because he is good. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Piimi n wuhibu ŋɔ ka chɛ anzinfa. Piimi baŋsim ka chɛ salima din viɛla.
en: Take my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Bɔhimiya Juda kpamba, Bɔzuɣu ka yinim nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa naa zaŋ kulis o yiŋa, hal ka Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ti paai man naa?.
en: When David found out what they were saying, he sent a message to Zadok and Abiathar the priests. It said: Say to the leaders of Judah, Why are you the last tribe to think about bringing King David back home?.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni daa yihi tin shɛŋa mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba n-daa nyɛ Ramɔt din daa be Giliad la mini Mahanaim ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its pasturelands, Mahanaim with its pasturelands.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa malila bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbila bɛn zaa daa labina maa mini bɛ maligumaanitaba ni bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: All of the priests and the Levites had purified themselves; all of them were clean. They slaughtered the Passover animals for all the returned exiles, their fellow priests, and themselves.

dag: Ka n yi daa nyu bara yi zuɣu o sani, dindina vi bi mali ma di zuɣu, amaa kaman ti ni daa pun yɛli ya binshɛɣukam ni daa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛm la, lala ka ti barinyubo yi zuɣu Taitus sani gba wuhi palɔni ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: I had bragged about you to Titus, and you didnt embarrass me. We have always told you the truth, and now what we told Titus about you has been shown to be true.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tuui labina ti ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-daa nyɛ: Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba.
en: And the first people to return to their towns included priests, Levites, temple workers, and other Israelites.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa kana ti kpe duu maa ni n-nya ka biŋŋmahindili maa do garo zuɣu, ka di zuɣu kuɣi bukɔbiri difiɛli.
en: They went inside and found the household idol in the bed and the goats' hair pillow at its head.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kum kana, ka n ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka zaŋ ba labisina. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ doli kulibɔna din mali kom, ka doli soli din tuhi ka ku tuura. Dama n leela Izraɛlnim ba, ka Ifriim nyɛ m bi kpɛma.
en: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhu daa bahi ku Ɛhab daŋ niriba min o ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni o zɔnim ni o tindaannim zaa bɛn daa kpalim be Jɛziriil, ka o ninvuɣ so daa bi kpalim.
en: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana nyɛla ŋun tiligiri nyɛviya, amaa ŋun ŋmari ʒiri ŋun nyɛla nyaanyira.
en: A witness who tells the truth saves lives, but one who tells lies hurts others.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi deei Naawuni nam kaman bia ni deeri li shɛm ti ku kpe di ni.
en: I promise you that you cannot get into God's kingdom, unless you accept it the way a child does.

dag: Dim liɣiri maa ka di doli soli. Zaŋm li da naɣilahi mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi ni kawana ni wain n-zaŋ di mini biŋkɔbiri maa zaa mali sara yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu sara maligu bimbini zuɣu Jɛrusalɛm.
en: You are to spend this money carefully and buy bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine and offer them on the altar of the Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Yi wuntaŋ mini yi goli ku lan lu, dama Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam; ka yi fabila dabisa la zani tariga.
en: Your sun will no longer set; your moon will no longer wane. The LORD will be an everlasting light for you, and your days of mourning will be ended.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛligu, o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii, o luya, amaa ka o nina bi pɔbi.
en: Who can hear what God is saying. With staring eyes I see in a trance A vision from Almighty God.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana ti kpaag o kaman bɛ ni kpaari wain di duɣuri ni shɛm la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duɣuri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So now, the time is coming when I will send people to pour Moab out like wine. They will empty its wine jars and break them in pieces.

dag: N saɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛlli ŋɔ puuni m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ zaɣ suŋ nyabu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi naai yi ni daa piligi niŋdi shɛli yuuni la ha. Di pa ni yi daa daŋmi piligi li kɔŋko, amaa yi daa daŋmi yu ni yi niŋ li.
en: My opinion is that it is better for you to finish now what you began last year. You were the first, not only to act, but also to be willing to act.

dag: ansarisimaaniba mini ninvuɣ turiba ni yɛri ti shɛm ti dimnim mini bɛn bɔri ni bɛ bɔhi ti biɛri ninni la zuɣu.
en: because of the voices of those who make fun of me and bad-mouth me, because of the enemy who is out for revenge.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ sana bee yi ni bu so paa bi simdi ni o di li.
en: but no foreigners who work for you are allowed to have any.

dag: Puhimiya dakulɔdakulo churi mini ka daŋda chɛbu chuɣu ni wuuni atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: Keep the Harvest Festival when you begin to harvest the first crop of your wheat, and keep the Festival of Shelters in the autumn when you gather your fruit.

dag: Naŋgban shɛli din ŋmari ʒiri je di ni ŋmari ʒiri pari shɛb maa, ka naŋgbammalisim tahiri saɣiŋgu na.
en: A lying tongue hates those it crushes; a flattering mouth causes destruction.

dag: O ni daa wum lala maa ka o dii yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: When Mary heard this, she stood up and went quickly to Jesus.

dag: Saha shɛli Pool ni daa be Milɛtus maa ka o daa tim ti boli Ɛfɛsus Cheechi kpamba.
en: From Miletus Paul sent a message to Ephesus, asking the elders of the church to meet him.

dag: Yɛhudianim maa daa bi niŋ yɛda ni doo maa daa nyɛla zoma ka ti neei maa faashee bɛ ni daa ti bol o ba min o ma na.
en: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents.

dag: Wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: Thats why the Scriptures say, Abraham believed God, and because of this he was accepted as one who is right with God.

dag: Amaa ka tɔbbihi maa ni yino daa zaŋ kpani kuhi Yisa luɣili, ka ʒim mini kom dii zɔri yirina.
en: But one of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus side. Immediately blood and water came out.

dag: N daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ka yi sanna, ka daa lan chɛ ka ti mabi so pah o zuɣu na. Taitus daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri? Pa biɛhigu yini ka ti mali? Pa so yini ka ti doli?.
en: I strongly encouraged Titus to go to you and sent the brother with him. Titus didnt take advantage of you, did he? Didnt we live by the same Spirit? Didnt we walk in the same footsteps?.

dag: Ŋunkam maani fiig tia viɛnyɛliŋga ni di di wala; ka ŋunkam lihir o dana viɛnyɛla ni nya jilima.
en: Those who tend a fig tree will eat its fruit, and those who look after their master will be honored.

dag: ka niŋ tuuba a suhu ni, a ni wum ka n yɛli ni n yɛn niŋ Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba shɛm ni n ni yɛn chɛ ka noli di li ka di zani dabari, ka a siɣis amaŋ n sani n-darigi toog a binyɛrigu ka kum niŋ ma la zuɣu, Man Yawɛ yɛliya, N wum a kumsi maa.
en: I noticed how sad you were when you read that this country and its people would be completely wiped out. You even tore your clothes in sorrow, and I heard you cry.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim, ka tɛhi ni shɛli bi mali ya la, yiɣisimiya wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Some of you women are calm now; you feel safe. But you should stand and listen to the words I say.

dag: ka ba bɛ nanim bandi, ka zaŋ zoligɔnim lo bɛ nabihi.
en: They will put their kings in chains and their leaders in chains of iron.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bulahi bɛn nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri maa ka naa mini zama maa sanna, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.

dag: Miriya ka yi pɔhi yi puri ni tiwala zaa bee n-gahim yi wain wal shɛŋa din lu tiŋa. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Dont pick all the grapes in your vineyards or pick up the grapes that fall to the ground. You must leave those things for your poor people and for people traveling through your country. I am the Lord your God.

dag: a mi di pɔ a zuɣu, dama a ku tooi chɛ ka di zabigu zaɣ yini lɛbigi zaɣ piɛlli bee zaɣ sabinli.
en: And you must not pledge by your head, because you cant turn one hair white or black.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka so ni ti yi Jɛsi zuliya ni na n-lee shihirili zuliya kam sani, ka o biɛhigu shee ni ti viɛla, ka niriba ti bɔhiri bɔr o shee.
en: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna daa kul nyɛlisiri la ŋubi. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei.
en: and the thin cows ate up the fat cows. Then the king woke up.

dag: Naa ŋun ʒini saria karibu shee, o nina nyari zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: The king sits in judgment and knows evil when he sees it.

dag: N Duuma, zom m bidibiga ŋɔ nambɔɣu! O nyɛla kpilinkpihilana, ka di nahind o pam; di kul luhir o la waawaayili, ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni.
en: saying, Lord, show mercy to my son. He is epileptic and suffers terribly, for he often falls into the fire or the water.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn doli dundɔŋ ni polo dunɔdal la kpe, di simdi ni bɛ yɛla binyɛr piɛla. Bɛ di ti ye biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri binyɛra, bɛ yi ti be dundɔŋ ni dunoya ni bee di puuni n-tumdi tuma.
en: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum sapashini maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli salo bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard these words, he was impressed with the centurion. He turned to the crowd following him and said, I tell you, even in Israel I havent found faith like this.

dag: Hal jɛra yi doli soli, bɛ bi tumdi yɛm tuma, bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋdi ni bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: Their stupidity will be evident even to strangers they meet along the way; they let everyone know that they are fools.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka noli yɛlibu yɛla ŋɔ zaa di yi dimnim bɛn daa nahim ya la.
en: Then the Lord your God will make all these bad things happen to your enemies, who hate you and cause you trouble.

dag: ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Rɛfaimnim.
en: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni, ka tɛhiya din yɛn niŋ ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani yɛla nya. Yi ni daa na bi piligi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mɛbu tuma.
en: Think about what has happened to you. Think about how things were before you began working on the Lord s Temple.

dag: Zoya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la? Daboya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la?.
en: Mountains, why did you dance like rams? Hills, why did you dance like lambs?.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, Kulima! A ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, alizin biɛɣu maa zoya ka chɛ a bia maa.
en: So Jesus said to her, Because of that answer, go back home, where you will find that the demon has gone out of your daughter.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Baal anabinim maa, Yi ni galisi maa zuɣu, daŋmiya pii yi naɣilaa kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa, ka suhi yi buɣili maa; amaa ka lee di niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: So Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Choose one of these bulls. Prepare it first since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but dont add fire.

dag: Chɛ ka o be n-yuui kaman wuntaŋ mini goli ni be shɛm ŋɔ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.

dag: Ka Gabirɛl daa kana ti zani baɣili ma. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam, ka n lu n-dɔni tiŋa. Ka o yɛli ma, Daadam bia, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ di gbinni. Ʒii maa wuhirila dunia ŋɔ bahigu yɛla.
en: Gabriel approached me, and I was terrified when he came. I fell with my face to the ground. Gabriel said to me, Know this, human one: the vision is for the end time.

dag: dama o daa wuhirila o nyaandoliba yɛri ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni ka bɛ ti ku o; amaa bɛ yi ti ku o, o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: This was because he was teaching his disciples, The Human One will be delivered into human hands. They will kill him. Three days after he is killed he will rise up.

dag: ka yɛli nachimba maa, Chamiya n tooni ka n doli yi nyaaŋa na. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o yidan Nabal.
en: Then Abigail told her servants, Go on. Ill follow you. But she did not tell her husband.

dag: O nyaya ka nimaani vuhim shee viɛla, ka di tiŋgbani biɛhigu mali kɔre. Dinzuɣu ka o deei talahi n-tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: He saw that a resting place was good and that the land was pleasant. He lowered his shoulder to haul loads and joined the work gangs.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na ti zali di zaashee Dauda ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni. Ka Dauda daa mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: David put up a tent for the Holy Box. The Israelites put the Lord s Holy Box in its place under the tent. Then David offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the Lord .

dag: kaman bɛ yaannim la, bɛ daa bemi kaman tɔb shɛli din naɣilimnaɣilim.
en: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa bi tim o Bia maa dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti karila dunianim saria, amaa ni dunianim lee ti tiligi o zuɣu.
en: God didnt send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world might be saved through him.

dag: O daa na bi ʒini tiŋ gba ka paɣ so pun wum o yɛla ka kana nti gban o tooni, dama alizin biɛɣu n-daa ʒi o bipuɣim bil zuɣu.
en: A woman whose daughter had an evil spirit in her heard where Jesus was. And at once she came and knelt down at his feet.

dag: Amaa alɔbo maa ni daa pun ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi.
en: but , Israelites had already died.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni ka nyɛ o Ba ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ni o tin ya o Shia Kasi ŋun ni chɛ ka yi nya yɛm, ka kahigi Naawuni ni nyɛ so wuhi ya ka yi baŋ o.
en: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.

dag: Nintam kul yɛn zɔrila n ninni ka ku ŋmaai, di mi ku chɛ zɔbu.
en: My eyes will flow without stopping. I will keep on crying.

dag: Naa Dauda maa zuliya ni ka Naawuni daa ti Izraɛlnim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ Yisa kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la.
en: God promised that someone from David's family would come to save the people of Israel, and this one is Jesus.

dag: Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira; ka di shɛŋa daa lu sol zuɣu ka niriba nɔri li garita, ka noonsi ti kana nti gahim li di.
en: A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field. While the farmer was doing this, some of the seeds fell along the road and were stepped on or eaten by birds.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa suhi Naawuni shɛm ni anab shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yuli tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa la zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Manasseh did, his prayer to his God and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, are all written in the book, The Official Records of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka daa chɛ ka Timoti mini Ɛrastus bɛn daa nyɛ o sɔŋdib la chaŋ Masidɔnia, amaa ka ŋun Pool maŋmaŋ daa kpalim Ɛsha n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: He sent two of his assistants, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he remained awhile in the province of Asia.

dag: Bɛ leela ninvuɣ diɣilima bɛn bi zɔri vi. Bɛ tumdila kɔr biɛri tuma, ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla daɣiri tuma balibu kam tumbu zuɣu.
en: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.

dag: Ka pumahigu mini niŋgbun duɣili daa ti gbaag o ba, ka Pool daa kpe nti kaag o ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti o ka o kpaŋ zaa.
en: Publius father was very sick. He had a fever and dysentery, but Paul went to him and prayed for him. He laid his hands on the man and healed him.

dag: Niriba maa mini farigudeeriba ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni, dama bɛn daa pun deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani;.
en: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahim nya ka bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa piila jilima ʒiishɛhi. Di saha maa ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: Jesus saw how the guests had tried to take the best seats. So he told them:.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be o sani chaŋ ti dɔni Ai nuzaa polo m-miri li, ka vinvamli do bɛ mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: The entire army that was with him went up. They moved in close, in front of the city. Then they camped north of Ai, with the valley between them and Ai.

dag: Dama n ku tɔɣisi shɛli yɛla n-naɣ pahila Masia ni zaŋ ma tum tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim deeg o noli n yɛligu mini n tuma ni.
en: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Aai, n ni da li mi kaman di daa ni kul nyɛ shɛm. N ku zaŋ binshɛli din nyɛ a dini ti Yawɛ bee n-zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: But King David answered Araunah, No, I will pay you the full price. I will not take anything that is yours and give it to the Lord . I will not give offerings that cost me nothing.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri maa bi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni, amaa ka nyini lee tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: But if you do warn the evil people to change their lives and stop sinning, and if they refuse to stop, they will die because they sinned. But you have saved your life.

dag: Ka dim maa daa yɛli, N ni kari gbahi ba; n ni di bɛ nɛma, ka zaŋ n ni bɔri shɛlikam. N ni zaŋ n nuu ŋooi takɔbi n-ku ba.
en: The enemy said, Ill pursue, Ill overtake, Ill divide the spoils of war. Ill be overfilled with them. Ill draw my sword; my hand will destroy them.

dag: O ni ti nyɛla suhudoolana. Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti liri ti, ti ni chɛ ka piɛguliba ayopɔin mini niriba anii shɛb ti ni zaŋ leei nanima la lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: because he will bring peace. Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers.

dag: ka chɛ ka sokam baŋ Naawuni daashili nia shɛli o ni daa lo la ni yɛn pali shɛm. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam zaa namda daa sɔɣ o daashili maa ʒiɛmana din gari la zaa puuni.
en: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Yaakubu, N dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha m-bɔŋɔ; zaŋm o dɔni ka o dɔɣi bihi ti ma, ka n zaŋ ba ʒili n naba zuɣu.
en: She said, Heres my servant Bilhah. Sleep with her, and she will give birth for me. Because of her, I will also have children.

dag: Ŋunkam zani sana nyaaŋa ka o paŋ binshɛli, yin deem dilan binyɛrigu, ŋunkam zaŋ binshɛli pa talima ka deei binshɛli ti tinzunnima, yin deemiy o ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima maa.
en: When you make a deal with a stranger, get something from him and any other foreigners with him to make sure he will pay you.

dag: amaa tinim ni zaŋ ti dahima zaa n-niŋla Naawuni suhibu min o yɛligu tɔɣisibu tuma ni.
en: We ourselves, then, will give our full time to prayer and the work of preaching.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla alahichi dabili.
en: Jesus said, The truth is, everyone who sins is a slave—a slave to sin.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi fa piɛri mini niɣi, ka o niriba maa daa taɣiri niɣi maa be tooni ka yɛra, Dauda ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He took all the sheep and cattle. His men led these animals to the front of the group and said, This is Davids prize.

dag: Zuliya kam, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu, ka mol li gili teeku noli tiŋgbana din be katinsi. Yɛlimiya, Ŋun daa wurim Izraɛlnim kpɛhi yɔɣu la ni lan laɣim ba, o ni gul ba kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la.
en: The Lord says, Nations, listen to me and proclaim my words on the far-off shores. I scattered my people, but I will gather them and guard them as a shepherd guards his flock.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm bɛ wuna, ka di daa leei zana gbahi ba.
en: and serving those false gods, which became a trap for them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ti Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ so ka o fa ba Sirianim maa nuu ni bahi; ka Izraɛlnim daa lan ʒi bɛ yinsi ni suhudoo kaman bɛ ni daa pun ʒiya shɛm.
en: The LORD sent Israel a savior, and they escaped from Arams power. Then the Israelites lived peacefully at home, just as they had in the past.

dag: Bɛ ni ti vɔn ya tahi gooni ŋmabu shee nti daai ya bahi Hamɔn. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Your city will be destroyed. The women will rush out through cracks in the wall and throw themselves onto the pile of dead bodies. This is what the Lord says:.

dag: ka zuliya kam ti laɣim zan o tooni, ka o woligi ba kaman piɛgul ni woligiri piɛri mini buhi shɛm la.
en: All the people of the world will be gathered before him. Then he will separate everyone into two groups. It will be like a shepherd separating his sheep from his goats.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Di pilila nuzaa polo tintariga Hɛtilɔn soli zuɣu n-zaŋ Lɛbɔhamat hal ni Hazarɛnɔn n-yi nimaani wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Dan zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: These are the tribes names: Beginning at the north, along the Hethlon road from Lebo-hamath to Hazar-enon, the boundary of Damascus with Hamath to the north, from the eastern border to the western border: Dan, one portion.

dag: Ka Samsin min o ba ni o ma daa yiɣisi chani Timna, ka Samsin daa ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puu ni; ka gbuɣim polli nya o ŋumda.
en: As Samson and his parents reached the vineyards near Timnah, a fierce young lion suddenly roared and attacked Samson.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa laɣim maa fo baalim wumdi Baanabas mini Pool ni daa kahigiri shihir shɛŋa bɛ ni wuhi mini alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum bɛn pa Yɛhudianim maa sani yɛla wuhiri ba.
en: Everyone kept quiet and listened as Barnabas and Paul told how God had given them the power to work a lot of miracles and wonders for the Gentiles.

dag: Daadam, piimi dapaɣili sabi, Juda dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka a lan pii dapaɣili shɛli sabi Yisifu dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu.
en: Son of man, get one stick and write this message on it: This stick belongs to Judah and his friends, the people of Israel. Then take another stick and write on it, This stick of Ephraim belongs to Joseph and his friends, the people of Israel.

dag: Di yi nyɛla din viɛla bee din bie, ti ni deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti timd a o sani ŋɔ noli. Ti yi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli, di ni chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛla ti sani.
en: even if it isn't what we want to do. We will obey the Lord so that all will go well for us.
