dag: O daŋdila yiɣisibu di ni na bi neei saha shɛli n-niŋdi bindirigu tir o yiŋnima, ka tir o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi tuma.
en: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and to tell her servant women what to do.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi shɛb tabili dapula m-pahi Yisa zuɣu maa ni yino daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi Yisa zuɣu m-bɔhir o, A pala Masia? Tiligim amaŋa, ka tiligi ti pahi.
en: One of the criminals hanging there began to shout insults at Jesus: Arent you the Messiah? Then save yourself, and save us too.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋa n-lu tiŋ sa, dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli, ka bɛ gbib a. Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: He said to Jesus, If you are the Son of God, jump off, because the Scriptures say, God will command his angels to help you, and their hands will catch you, so that you will not hit your foot on a rock. Psalm :-.

dag: Hal zibisim pala zibisim a sani; yuŋ kul nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ ni la, dama zibisim bemi kaman neesim la a sani.
en: but even darkness is not dark for you, and the night is as bright as the day. Darkness and light are the same to you.

dag: A ni be alizanda ni a biɛhigu shee din be kasi ka mali jilima ŋɔ, lihim na nya. A baɣa ni daa yi be ti ni shɛm ni a yiko la lee kpalimla ya? A yurilim min a nambɔzɔbo la lan kani zaŋ kana ti sani.
en: Look down from heaven and see, from your holy and glorious perch. Where are your energy and your might, your concern and your pity? Dont hold back!.

dag: ka ti nyaandolitab bɛn be Rom daa wum ti damli ka kana hal ti paai luɣ shɛŋa din daa booni Apius Daa mini Yilikpɛra Ata la shee ni bɛ tuhi ti soli. Pool ni daa nya ba, ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o paɣiri Naawuni.
en: When the brothers and sisters there heard about us, they came as far as the Forum of Appius and the Three Taverns to meet us. When Paul saw them, he gave thanks to God and was encouraged.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu shili zaa dindali maa. Bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu kaman Naa Jɔsia ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: So on that day all of the LORDs service was prepared for celebrating Passover and offering up entirely burned offerings on the LORDs altar, just as King Josiah had ordered.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni ka Pool ti kpaŋsiri yɛdaniŋdiba suhuri.
en: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi pina na ti ti Yawɛ. Ŋunkam mali yurilim o suhu ni, ŋun zaŋmi Yawɛ pina din nyɛ: salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: Collect gift offerings for the LORD from all of you. Whoever freely wants to give should bring the LORDs gift offerings: gold, silver, and copper.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia, ka nyɛ maligumaana la min o daŋ zaa bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba m-be Nɔb maa na. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa sanna.
en: The king then sent for the priest Ahimelech, Ahitubs son, and all his extended family, who were the priests at Nob. All of them came to the king.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbibi n jɛmbu duu maa, ka tumdi di puuni tuun shɛli zaa din simdi tumbu.
en: I will appoint them to keep charge of the temple, all its work, and all that is done in it.

dag: Ti ŋmanila zoomba bɛn chani baɣisiri dukpini ka tuuri wuntaŋ zuɣusaa kaman di nyɛla yuŋ la. Bɛn mali yaa sunsuuni, ti ŋmanila kpiimba.
en: We are like people without eyes. We walk into walls like blind people. We stumble and fall as if it was night. Even in the daylight, we cannot see. At noontime, we fall like dead men.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi tuun suma, ka di wuhi bɛn kpalim la din simdi niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛli binshɛɣukam puuni. Mali biɛri suŋ mini maŋgbibbu a wuhibu puuni.
en: In all things you yourself must be an example of good behavior. Be sincere and serious in your teaching.

dag: Yawɛ n-su zuɣusaa ha, amaa ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ ti ninsalinima.
en: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ o niŋ o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim shɛb o ni daa niŋ kɔre maa nuu ni.
en: So I let her lovers have her. She wanted Assyria, so I gave her to them!.

dag: Yi noli yi kuli yaa yɛli shɛli, yin palimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni kul yaai yi noli po pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani shɛm maa.
en: But you must do what you say you will do. If you choose to make a promise to the Lord your God, you must do what you promised.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ni tim so na.
en: What about you? he asked them. Who do you say I am? Peter answered, You are God's Messiah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Balaam, Doli ba chaŋ, amaa kul yɛlimila n ni yɛl a ni a yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ka Balaam daa doli Balak kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: The LORDs messenger said to Balaam, Go with the men. But dont say anything. Say only that which I tell you. So Balaam went with Balaks officials.

dag: Tiŋ maa dunoya ti ku yɔri wuntaŋ ni, ka yuŋ mi ti ku zibiri nimaani.
en: The gates of the city will stand open all day; they will never be closed, because there will be no night there.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan kahig o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa wuhi, ka yo o ni tum taal shɛli maa samli zaa, ka lan yo di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi n-zaŋ li ti o ni tum so taali maa.
en: you must confess your sin and make full repayment, plus an additional percent, to the person you have wronged.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti da kpam maa ka amiliya aŋgo maa dii paana, ka o mini bɛn daa pun mali shili gu o maa kpe amiliya lɔbu yili maa ni, ka bɛ kpari di dunoli.
en: While the foolish ones were on their way to get some oil, the groom arrived. The five who were ready went into the wedding, and the doors were closed.

dag: Fam ma baɣiri firibu ni bahi. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. Tiligim ma kɔbulli ŋɔ ni.
en: Save me from the mud! Dont let me drown! Let me be saved from those who hate me and from these watery depths!.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ daa ʒila Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni. Dinzuɣu kuɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri yɛlli ŋɔ yɛla sahakam.
en: You will tell them that the Lord stopped the water from flowing in the Jordan River. When the Holy Box of the Lord s Agreement crossed the river, the water stopped flowing. These rocks will help the Israelites remember this forever.

dag: N yi bi tumdi m Ba tuma, yin di niŋ ma yɛda;.
en: Do not believe me, then, if I am not doing the things my Father wants me to do.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, sɔŋmi ti a yuli jilima nyabu zuɣu. Fam ti bahi, ka chɛ ti daalahichi a yuli zuɣu.
en: God of our salvation, help us for the glory of your name! Deliver us and cover our sins for the sake of your name!.

dag: Ti ni daa paai yiŋa, ti daa zaŋ nyini n dan ni daa yɛli shɛm maa yɛli ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: So we returned to our father and reported what you had said.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ titali nyɛla ŋun tumdi din doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa.
en: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans.

dag: O daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa a ba ni daa ʒili ti la? .
en: What do you advise? he asked them. How should we respond to these people who said to me, Lighten the workload your father demanded from us.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, ka pumpɔŋɔ man na yɛn pahi ya la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi leei barazim saɣisiri ya.
en: Tell them, My father placed heavy burdens on you; I will make them even heavier. He beat you with whips; I'll flog you with bullwhips.

dag: dama tiŋgbani kuumi tahi la, saa ni bi lan miri maa zuɣu, ka di niŋ pukpariba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: Because there is no rain and the ground is dried up, the farmers are sick at heart; they hide their faces.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bari ma la zana, amaa m bi birigi a zaligunim maa.
en: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.

dag: Zaŋm a yɛla niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka chɛ ka o tilig a. Chɛ ka o fa o nini ni tiɣi so bahi.
en: You relied on the Lord , they say. Why doesn't he save you? If the Lord likes you, why doesn't he help you.

dag: Amaa vi tuma maa nyɛla din di ti yaannim ni daa tum tuma bo binshɛlikam zaa zali ti ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ la, dina n-nyɛ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: But the worship of Baal, the god of shame, has made us lose flocks and herds, sons and daughters—everything that our ancestors have worked for since ancient times.

dag: Ayuba bipuɣinsi maa viɛlim kpee daa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Ka bɛ ba daa ti ba fali pahi bɛ tizɔdɔbba maa zuɣu.
en: Jobs daughters were among the most beautiful women in all the country. And, like their brothers, they each got a share of their fathers property.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga.
en: She answered, My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila dakol pala ni.
en: Instead, new wine must be put into new wineskins.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu naai, ka o daa zaŋ alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi ti o. Naawuni daa zaŋla o nubila n-sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu.
en: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two stone tablets on which God himself had written the commandments.

dag: M bɔri ni yi di ma suɣilo ka n tɔɣisi ya jɛritali yɛtɔɣa biɛla. N suhiri ya ni yi shiri dim ma suɣilo!.
en: I wish you would be patient with me even when I am a little foolish. But you are already patient with me.

dag: Ka niriba daa be samban ni ka wum chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama vuri, ka di be kaman Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o kukoli be shɛm la.
en: The noise from the wings of the Cherub angels could be heard all the way out into the outer courtyard. The sound was very loud—like the thundering voice when God All-Powerful speaks.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ ka ti niriba maa baŋ ni di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma n-sɔŋ bɛn simdi sɔŋbu, ka pa ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din ka nyɔri.
en: Our people must learn to spend their time doing good, in order to provide for real needs; they should not live useless lives.

dag: Ka o daa me yiya Millo polo hal ti gil di zaa. Ka Jɔab mi daa mali tiŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din kpalim me.
en: David built the city around the fort. He built it from the Millo to the wall around the city. Joab repaired the other parts of the city.

dag: Ka Asiria naa maa daa gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli Asiria nti zaŋ ba ʒili Hala mini Habɔr Mɔɣili duli din be Gɔzan yaɣili polo la ni Miidianim fɔntinsi ni.
en: Assyrias king sent Israel into exile to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River, and in the cities of the Medes.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛl o, Ka doo mini paɣ yɛla yi nyɛla lala, dindina di bi simdi ni nir kpuɣi paɣa.
en: His disciples said to him, If thats the way things are between a man and his wife, then its better not to marry.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bahiyoli bina anahi lu bɛ zuɣu. Tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba, ka bahi vu ba chaŋ, ka juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri tɔhi ba vali.
en: I will appoint over them four agents of death, declares the LORD: soldiers to kill, dogs to drag off, and vultures and wild animals to devour and destroy.

dag: Lihimiya nya din niŋdi gili ya; sokam zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yi bidibisi ni yi katiŋ na, ka bɛ kpuɣi yi bipuɣinsi buɣ na nti tin ya.
en: Look around you and see what is happening: Your people are gathering to come home! Your sons will come from far away; Your daughters will be carried like children.

dag: Di saha kopaliga din mali kpiɔŋ daa naan du ti gari.
en: then the raging waters would have come over our necks!.

dag: Ka n daa lihi n-nya Piɛbila ka o ʒe Ziɔn zol zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi ʒe o sani, ka o yuli min o Ba yuli sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: I looked and saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion! With him were . who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya, ka na ʒi n-leei so daba; ka di chaŋ wula ka a ti yɛli ni ti ni yi dabitim ni.
en: We are the descendants of Abraham, they answered, and we have never been anybody's slaves. What do you mean, then, by saying, You will be free.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛhɔinai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛrahia bia la daa nyɛ Pahatimɔab daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbisiyi daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Pahath Moab: Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and other men;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim shɛli zaa na ti mali sara ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma luɣ kasi shee la tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tuhili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The total amount of the gold that was used for construction of the whole sanctuary, gold from the uplifted offerings, was twenty-nine kikkars and seven hundred thirty shekels in weight, measured by the sanctuary shekel.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim daa yɛli Midian kpamba, Salo ni gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni naai binshɛlikam din gili ti zaa kaman naɣilaa ni ŋubiri mɔri mɔɣu ni shɛm la. Zipɔr bia Balak n-daa nyɛ Mɔab naa di saha maa.
en: The Moabites said to the leaders of the Midianites, This horde will soon destroy everything around us, like a bull eating the grass in a pasture. So King Balak.

dag: Paɣ so daa beni n-nyɛ anabi, ka o yuli booni Anna. O daa nyɛla Fanuɛl bia, ka nyɛ Asha zuliya ni nira. O daa kurigiya pam; o daa ʒini doo yil la yuma ayopɔin.
en: There was also a prophet, Anna the daughter of Phanuel, who belonged to the tribe of Asher. She was very old. After she married, she lived with her husband for seven years.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ata maa ni ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Izraɛl naa sani.
en: Then during the third year, King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to visit King Ahab of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ŋɔ kun ya lari. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni chɛ ka yi tiligibu niŋ tom. Dama n wum ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zali ka wuhi ni o ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa shɛm.
en: Now dont complain about these things. If you fight against them, you will only tighten the ropes around you. The words I heard will not change. They came from the Lord GOD All-Powerful, the ruler of all the earth, and these things will be done.

dag: Dama n ni gbahi Ifriimnim kaman gbuɣinli ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la, ka gbahi Judanim kaman gbuɣimbil ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni dari tɔhi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: I will attack the people of Israel and Judah like a lion. I myself will tear them to pieces and then leave them. When I drag them off, no one will be able to save them.

dag: Dishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛmdan mini Ishiban ni Itiran ni Kɛran.
en: These are Dishons sons: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

dag: Salima pipihi din diba ayi kam daa bi ŋman taba ka bɛ daa mali nyuri binnyura. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ni nyuri wain shɛli pam ti niriba maa.
en: Wine was served in golden cups, and every cup was different. There was plenty of the kings wine, because the king was very generous.

dag: ni taataa ni yuŋ nooŋa ni teeku ni laɣipiɛliga ni wubiga balibu kam.
en: horned owls, screech owls, sea gulls, any kind of hawk.

dag: O bela nimaani lihiri bɔr o ni yɛn gbaai binshɛli di, di yi be haliya o nina ni nya li.
en: From there it watches near and far for something to kill and eat.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbaai nachimbil maa nuu ni n-zaŋ o yi kpaŋa nti bɔh o ashilɔni, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka a mali ni a yɛli ma.
en: The commander led the young man to a place where they could be alone. The commander asked, What do you want to tell me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lan da puri tiŋgbɔn shɛli bɛ ni yɛra, Di leela dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri lan ka di ni, bɛ zaŋ li niŋla Kalidianim nuu ni la.
en: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.

dag: Amaa ka Juda bituuli Ɛr maa daa nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa ku o.
en: But Er was very evil, and the Lord took his life.

dag: ni Gazam daŋ niriba ni Yuza daŋ niriba ni Pasia daŋ niriba.
en: Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni tooi chɛ ka aŋgo zɔnim lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli?.
en: Jesus said to them, At a wedding you cant ask the friends of the bridegroom to be sad and fast while he is still with them.

dag: Biɛɣ asiba ka Yawɛ daa be sagban buɣim daantaliga maa ni, ka lihi tiŋ na n-nya Ijipti tɔbbihi maa, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lu abirima.
en: But before daylight the Lord looked down at the Egyptian army from the fiery cloud and made them panic.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pirigi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ tiŋgbana ti Izraɛlnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Ɛliɛza ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛl zuliyanim kpamba n-daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tari ba.
en: What follows is an account of how the land of Canaan west of the Jordan was divided among the people of Israel. Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders of the families of the Israelite tribes divided it among the population.

dag: ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣis o Naawuni malaikanim sani.
en: But those who reject me publicly, the Son of Man will also reject them before the angels of God.

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni mi so yɛla pam.
en: At that time a well-known terrorist named Jesus Barabbas was in jail.

dag: Dama Keenannim mini bɛnkam be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yi wum li, bɛ ni kana ti teei gil ti, ka kpihim ti birili dunia ŋɔ ni; ka di yi niŋ lala, wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ a yuli din galisi ŋɔ.
en: The Canaanites and everyone else in the country will hear about it. They will surround us and kill every one of us! And then what will you do to protect your honor.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka bɛ siɣisi bɛmaŋ maa ka o daa yɛli Shɛmaya, Bɛ ni saɣi ni bɛ tum taali maa, n ku lan ku ba, ka ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli, amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya faako n-yi Shishak nuu ni.
en: When the Lord saw this, he spoke again to Shemaiah and said to him, Because they admit their sin, I will not destroy them. But when Shishak attacks, they will barely survive. Jerusalem will not feel the full force of my anger.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba kana ti mali Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ mali neen shɛŋa zaa;.
en: All of you who are skilled in crafts should come forward and make everything that the LORD has commanded.

dag: Tuunkpɛmalana ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din tahiri nyamma pam na, amaa ŋunkam bɔri yomyom ni nyari shɛlikam poor o mi.
en: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma!.
en: If you have ears, then listen!.

dag: O daa zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei niriba maa ni su shɛlikam zaa su.
en: Then he gave his people the lands of other nations. His people got what others had worked for.

dag: di simdi ni yi bo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga.
en: For each one pay five pieces of silver, according to the official standard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Reehab, Ti yɛn zaŋla ti nyɛviya n-taɣ a dini. A yi bi zaŋ ti ni lo ni ti niŋ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla yɛli so, ka Yawɛ ti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ti, ti ni niŋ a nirilim.
en: The men said to her, May God take our lives if we don't do as we say! If you do not tell anyone what we have been doing, we promise you that when the Lord gives us this land, we will treat you well.

dag: Amaa kulibɔŋ bee kɔbil shɛli din mali kom, din nyɛla din ka daɣiri. Amaa binshɛɣukam din shihi binkpiŋ ni leei din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: Now, a spring or cistern that collects water is clean, but anyone who touches one of these animals dead bodies in it will be unclean.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Kiriatijiarim maa yuui pam. Di daa niŋ la yuun pisi nimaani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa kul ye Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: The Covenant Box of the Lord stayed in Kiriath Jearim a long time, some twenty years. During this time all the Israelites cried to the Lord for help.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ dina yi ti bi yɛn niŋ yomyom yi n-chaŋ bee n-yi n-guui. Yawɛ nti yɛn be yi tooni mali ya chana. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni nyɛ ŋun yɛn be yi nyaaŋa polo n-nyɛ yi gula.
en: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks.

dag: Dama ti ni daa birigi maa nyaaŋa ti daa niŋ tuuba, ti ni daa ti baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka ti daa zaŋ ti zuɣuri ba tiŋa. Vi daa gbahi ti, ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisi, ti ni daa nya filiŋ ti bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: I wandered away from you. But I finally realized how wrong I was. So I changed my heart and life. I am ashamed and embarrassed about the foolish things I did when I was young.

dag: Yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Family of Jacob, hear the Lord s message. Tribes of Israel, listen.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka so ni ti yi Jɛsi zuliya ni na n-lee shihirili zuliya kam sani, ka o biɛhigu shee ni ti viɛla, ka niriba ti bɔhiri bɔr o shee.
en: A day is coming when the new king from the royal line of David will be a symbol to the nations. They will gather in his royal city and give him honor.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kul maari bɛn suhuri saɣindi suhuri ŋɔ daa maai ti suhuri Taitus kandina la zuɣu.
en: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.

dag: So yi mali buɣim ka di looi mɔɣu n-chaŋ ti di bɛ ni chɛ bindir shɛŋa sɔŋ bee bɛ ni na bi chɛ bindir shɛŋa bee n-di so puu zaa, di simdi ni ŋun mali buɣim maa yo di zuɣu zaa.
en: If someone starts a fire in his own field and it spreads through the weeds to someone else's field and burns up grain that is growing or that has been cut and stacked, the one who started the fire is to pay for the damage.

dag: Ka Juda daa bɔh o, N dana, wula ka ti lee lan yɛn yɛl a? Ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Bee wula ka ti yɛn tooi niŋ tɔɣisi yi? Naawuni nya tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ taali ni nyɛ shɛli; ti mini bɛ ni nya pipia ŋɔ so sani maa zaa leela nyini n dan daba.
en: Sir, what can we say? Judah replied. How can we say we are innocent, when God has shown we are guilty? And now all of us are your slaves, especially the one who had the cup.

dag: Midian mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura zuliya.
en: Midians sons were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. These men were the descendants of Keturah.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yi ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi viɛla. Di simdi ni yi zɔri Naawuni ka tumdi din tuhi. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ku ti zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ ti dimnim la soli ka bɛ mali ti ansarisi.
en: I continued, What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.

dag: O daa tɛhiya ni o mabihi maa baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o na ni o ti fa ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ lala.
en: He thought that his own people would understand that God was going to use him to set them free, but they did not understand.

dag: Puhimiya n churi siɣimsiɣim buta yuuni puuni.
en: Celebrate three festivals a year to honor me.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti vili baŋtab piɛla, ka so jinjɛm piɛla. Di bi simdi ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka woligu puhi ba lo bɛmaŋa.
en: So that they won't perspire, they are to wear linen turbans and linen trousers, but no belt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai nti suhi Naawuni ti ba ni bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: When Peter and John arrived, they prayed for the Samaritan believers to receive the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Then Jesus said, Why do you come to get me with swords and clubs as if I were a criminal?.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Ifriimnima? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Judanima? Yi yurilim ŋmanila asiba sagbaŋ, di ŋmanila maligim din bi yuuri ka kpahiri luri la.
en: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.

dag: Miri ka a niŋ a kpee fitiina bee n-fa o. A yi bu so paa ka o tum a tuma, nyin di chɛ ka o liɣiri gbe a sani.
en: You must not oppress your neighbors or rob them. Do not withhold a hired laborers pay overnight.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ni kpi, amaa ŋun gbilisi tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga ni di shɛhira viɛlli.
en: The testimony of a liar is not believed, but the word of someone who thinks matters through is accepted.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ayuba.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: ka bɛ ni yino daa kani ka chɛ ma, ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ bini n-dari chɛrisichɛris o; ka m bi lan nya o hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: One disappeared and I said, He must have been torn up by a wild animal, and I havent seen him since.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa garigi yɛli Jɔab, Hal anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili yi kpe n nuu ni gba, n ku zaŋ n nuu shihi nabia maa, dama ti di wum naa ni yɛl a mini Abishai ni Itai, N zuɣu miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom maa shɛli.
en: But the man said to Joab, Even if I had a thousand pieces of silver in my hand, I wouldnt touch the kings son! We heard what the king commanded you, Abishai, and Ittai—For my sake, take care of my boy Absalom.

dag: Ka bɛ sɔŋdi taba, ka yɛra, M mali suhukpeeni.
en: Workers help each other. They encourage each other to be strong.

dag: Ka Keenan paɣ so ŋun daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni daa ka Yisa sanna ti kuhiri yɛra, N Duuma ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi m bipuɣiŋga zuɣu m-muɣisir o pam.
en: A Canaanite woman from those territories came out and shouted, Show me mercy, Son of David. My daughter is suffering terribly from demon possession.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Mbo n-faaŋa, bi suŋ ni n yɛdalana ŋun ʒe ma yim! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ a leei bin din zooi pam zuɣulana; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli kaman n suhu ni piɛli shɛm ŋɔ.
en: His master replied, Excellent! You are a good and faithful servant! Youve been faithful over a little. Ill put you in charge of much. Come, celebrate with me.

dag: Dama n yi be, Masia n-nyɛ n nyɛvili, ka m mi yi kpi, di nyɛla din so.
en: To me, the only important thing about living is Christ. And even death would be for my benefit.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa chɛ ka tuumba ʒi sida dakuɣiri chaŋ ti ti Dauda. O daa bola tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ ti me Dauda yili ti o.
en: Hiram was king of the city of Tyre. He sent messengers to David. He also sent logs from cedar trees, stonecutters, and carpenters to David. Hiram sent them to build a house for David.

dag: m-pahi daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni daa yɔr o farigu shɛli zuɣu. Ka Areebia nanim zaa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gomnanim zaa daa ʒiri salima mini anzinfa na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: In addition to the gold brought in by the traveling merchants and traders, all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land also brought gold and silver to Solomon.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri bɔri ma? Yi bi mi ni di nyɛ ma la talahi ni m be m Ba duu.
en: Jesus said to them, Why did you have to look for me? You should have known that I must be where my Fathers work is. .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi doli Bashan polo; ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu Ɛdirɛi n-tuhi ba.
en: Then the Israelites traveled on the road toward Bashan. King Og of Bashan got his army and marched out to meet the Israelites. He fought against them at Edrei.

dag: Ka Iso daa ŋmaligi kuli Ɛdom dindali maa.
en: So Esau left for Edom.

dag: O mali yɛm o suhu ni, ka o kpiɔŋ galisi; ŋuni n-na mi m-mo o ka di nasara?.
en: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?.

dag: Asahɛl bia Jɔnatan mini Tikiva bia Jazɛya n-daa zaɣisi yɛlli maa, ka Mɛshulam mini Shabɛtai ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir la daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim zani n-zab amaŋ zuɣu! Teemi jɛra ni maan a ansarisi dabisi muni zaa puuni shɛm la yɛla.
en: God, rise up! Make your case! Remember how unbelieving fools insult you all day long.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vihi yɛlli maa n-nya ka bɛ ni wum shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ niriba ayi maa n-zaŋ ba yili dasara. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ sab yɛlli maa yɛla niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛlikura litaafi ni o ninni.
en: The matter was investigated and found to be true, so the two men were impaled on pointed poles. A report about the event was written in the royal record with the king present.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee be a nuu ni ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Jaaŋgbee.
en: So the Lord asked him, What are you holding? A walking stick, he answered.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zaŋ tuhi Juda Naa Amazia la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Jehoash did and his wars against King Amaziah of Judah are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl bila Yawɛ sani. O ni lan zaŋ Mɔabnim niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: This is easy for the LORD to do. He will also hand Moab over to you.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi la, Zaŋmiy o doli guliba maa sunsuuni gari, ka zaŋ takɔb ku ŋunkam be o polo. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛlimi, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: Jehoiada the priest gave a command to the captains who were in charge of the soldiers. Jehoiada told them, Take Athaliah outside of the Temple area. Kill any of her followers, but dont kill them in the Lord s Temple.

dag: N naba kul ʒiɛla luɣ pasi shee; ka n kul ni paɣiri nyin Yawɛ jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni.
en: My feet now stand on level ground. I will bless the LORD in the great congregation.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔh o, Naawuni maligumaaniba zuɣulana ka a tu lala maa.
en: Those standing near him asked, You dare to insult Gods high priest.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pagɔra ayi daa ti kana ti gbani naa tooni.
en: One day two prostitutes came and presented themselves before King Solomon.

dag: ti yɛli Nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ wuhi ti o jilima min o galisim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ti nyaya ni Naawuni ni tooi tɔɣisi ninsal yɛtɔɣa, ka ninsal maa na be o nyɛvili ni.
en: and said, The Lord our God showed us his greatness and his glory when we heard him speak from the fire! Today we have seen that it is possible for people to continue to live, even though God has spoken to them.

dag: N Ba ŋun zaŋ ba ti ma maa gari sokam, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba m Ba maa nuu ni.
en: My Father is the one who gave them to me, and he is greater than all. No one can steal my sheep out of his hand.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lo ni a niŋ Naawuni niriba zaɣ biɛɣu? Dama naa yi bi chɛ ka o bia ŋun be yɔɣu la labina yaha, dindina naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din gbaag omaŋmaŋa.
en: Then the woman said, Why have you planned these things against the people of God? When you say these things, you show you are guilty because you have not brought back the son who you forced to leave home.

dag: Sulemaana daa dari yuri la Ijipti mini Silisia. O kɔhigɔriba n-daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomon's merchants bought his horses and chariots in the regions of Musri and Kue. They paid pieces of silver for a chariot and pieces of silver for a horse. They also sold horses and chariots to the Hittite and Syrian kings.

dag: Tiligim ma ninsalinim nahiŋgu ni, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: Save me from those who oppress me, so that I may obey your commands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa zali ni bɛ malim adaka zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali gbini.
en: So at the kings command a box was made and placed outside the gate of the LORDs temple.

dag: Di bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni tin shɛŋa din kɔɣili li niriba ni daa tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kul tumdi din chihiri la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka saha din ka bahigu buɣim bahi ba yoli, ka di leei din kpahiri sokam zaa zuɣu ni.
en: In the same way, Sodom and Gomorrah and neighboring towns practiced immoral sexual relations and pursued other sexual urges. By undergoing the punishment of eternal fire, they serve as a warning.

dag: Yilimiya yila ka ŋmɛm guŋgombihi, ka ŋmɛm goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnim din kumsi nyaɣisa.
en: Start the music and beat the tambourines; play pleasant music on the harps and the lyres.

dag: Dinzuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuli n ya, amaa kamina ka n wuh a niriba ŋɔ ni ti yɛn niŋ a niriba shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: So I'm going back home, but I'm leaving you with a warning about what the Israelites will someday do to your nation.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛ wula? N ni suhi Naawuni n shia ni, ka lan suhi Naawuni m milinsi ni; n ni yili yila n shia ni, ka lan yili yila m milinsi ni gba.
en: So what should I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim o, N zaŋ sandaani timbu tuma ti o;.
en: Therefore, say: Im now giving him my covenant of well-being.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu yi ti paai ya kaman sanʒiɛɣu la, ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ya kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la, ka biɛrim mini nandahima yi ti paai ya;.
en: when it comes on you like a storm, bringing fierce winds of trouble, and you are in pain and misery.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni shiri ni tooi be dunia ŋɔ ni? Nyama, zuɣusaa mini di galisim ŋɔ zaa pɔri ni a biɛhigu shee, di ni ti be ka n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ?.
en: But how could God possibly live on earth? If heaven, even the highest heaven, cant contain you, how can this temple that Ive built contain you?.

dag: Bɛ daa lan bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri duu maa yuya lee booni bɔ.
en: They also asked Zerubbabel, What are the names of the men who are working on this building.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛra vinvamli ni.
en: So Isaac moved away from there, camped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

dag: A bia paɣ maa yur a, ka tum din gari bidibis ayopɔin tuma ti a. O dɔɣi yaaŋa ŋun nyɛ bidibiga ti a, ka o ni ti nyɛla ŋun ni kpaŋsir a ni ŋun ni ti gbib a a kuriginsim saha.
en: He will make you happy and take care of you in your old age, because he is the son of your daughter-in-law. And she loves you more than seven sons of your own would love you.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi kɔr biɛri mini danyubo ni dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda ti dihi ya sɔŋ, ka dindali maa ti dii libigi ya.
en: Take care that your hearts arent dulled by drinking parties, drunkenness, and the anxieties of day-to-day life. Dont let that day fall upon you unexpectedly.

dag: Ka so mi bi nyɔri firila n-zaŋdi lɔɣu pindi li, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni di ne sokam zaa yili maa ni.
en: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl; instead it is put on the lampstand, where it gives light for everyone in the house.

dag: ka Mɔza daa nyɛ Binia ba; ka Binia nyɛ Rɛfaya ba, ka Rafaya nyɛ Ɛliasa ba, ka Ɛliasa nyɛ.
en: Moza was the father of Binea. Rephaiah was Bineas son. Eleasah was Rephaiahs son. And Azel was Eleasahs son.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi be yi ni?.
en: Dont you know that you are Gods temple and Gods Spirit lives in you?.

dag: A ni daa mali karimbaani saha shɛli la a daa bi maanila a mabia Sɔdom ansarisi.
en: In the past, you were proud and made fun of your sister Sodom. But you will not do that again.

dag: O chɛ ka ti kul be ti nyɛvili ni, ka bi chɛ ka ti sarigi.
en: God preserved us among the living; he didnt let our feet slip a bit.

dag: Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, dama n zaɣis o yɛligu. Amaa zuliya kam zaa, wummiya, nyamiya n ni diri wahala shɛm. Bɛ gbahi m paɣisara mini n nachimba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: The LORD is right, because I disobeyed his word. Listen, all you people; look at my suffering. My young women and young men have gone away as prisoners.

dag: N yɛn dolila dunianim zaa ni doli so shɛl la. Mali yaa.
en: My son, I will soon die, as everyone must. But I want you to be strong and brave.

dag: N ni ti gbib a ni ʒiɛyimtali, ka a baŋ man Yawɛ.
en: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.

dag: N daa nya a luɣ kasi shee la; N daa nya a yiko min a jilima la.
en: Yes, Ive seen you in the sanctuary; Ive seen your power and glory.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ n-yɛn teei n nuu din mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ ni sujee mini suhuyiɣisili pam n-tuhi ya.
en: I will fight against you with all my might, my anger, my wrath, and my fury.

dag: Amaa yɛda niŋbu soli maa ni yipa kana pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, ti bi lan be gula maa sulinsi ni yaha.
en: Now that the time for faith is here, the Law is no longer in charge of us.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chɛ Filistianim kari doli; ka Filistianim maa daa labi bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Then Saul stopped chasing the Philistines, and the Philistines went back to their own country.

dag: ka Maligumaana maa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi bee kawana sara la sara maligu bimbini la zuɣu. Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ mali taali ni yibu sanyoo sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa, ka o yi daɣiri ni.
en: The priest will offer up the entirely burned offering and the grain offering on the altar. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for the person, and they will be clean again.

dag: n-daa yi gbala maa ni na Yisa kum ni neebu nyaaŋa n-chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni tiŋ kasi la puuni, ka niriba pam daa nya ba ni bɛ nini.
en: They came out of the graves. And after Jesus was raised from death, they went into the holy city, and many people saw them.

dag: a ni daa zaŋ a nudirigu sa wain ti shɛl la. Amaŋmaŋ ni daa sa wain ti pol shɛli la.
en: Look at the vine you planted with your own hands. Look at the young plant you raised.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣisaribila n-zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa, di nyaaŋa ka o lan je o.
en: A man might marry a woman and have sexual relations with her. Then he might decide that he does not like her.

dag: N nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul nahindila niriba ka duri zuɣusaa kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tihi la.
en: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun wumdi bɛn be sarika ni ŋuhibu, ka fari bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la bahira.
en: He heard the groans of prisoners and set free those who were condemned to die.

dag: di saha bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ daa naan vali ti zaɣ nɛma.
en: would have killed us all, because it was furious.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gari nimaani n-lan gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ ti yɛn lu ka bɛ paai Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: They walked on and reached Gibeah in the territory of Benjamin just after sunset.

dag: A daa lan zaŋ n ni ti a salima min anzinfa yɛ viɛli shɛŋa la m-mali binnana din nyɛ dɔbba n-zaŋ ba tum pagɔrisigu tuma.
en: You made idols out of the gold and silver jewelry I gave you, then you sinned by worshiping those idols.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N tum alahichi, dama m bi mi ni a ʒiɛla sol ni gu ma soli. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, di yi bi luhi a sani, n ni ŋmaligi labi kuli.
en: Balaam replied, I was wrong. I didn't know you were trying to stop me. If you don't think I should go, I'll return home at once.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn deei n noli, ka doli n zaligunima?.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, How much longer will you people refuse to obey my commands?.

dag: N ni saɣim o wain tihi min o fiig tihi pu shɛli o ni yɛra, M mamanim ni zaŋ shɛli yo ma samli m-bɔŋɔ la. N ni zaŋ li leei yɔɣuni, ka yɔɣuni biŋkɔbiri ŋubi di zaa.
en: I will destroy her vines and fig trees. She said, My lovers gave these things to me. But I will change her gardens—they will become like a wild forest. Wild animals will come and eat from those plants.

dag: Dinzuɣu binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni diri ka nyura bee binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni niŋda, niŋmiya li ka di tiri Naawuni jilima.
en: Well, whatever you do, whether you eat or drink, do it all for God's glory.

dag: Ka ti ba maa daa ti lan yɛli ti, Labimiya ti da bindira biɛla ti ti na.
en: Later our father sent us back here to buy more grain.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo, yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim ka yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka a sabi yɛli gbaŋ maa puuni ni Babilɔn naa shiri ni kana ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri di ni? .
en: The Lord told me to say to the king, You have burned the scroll, and you have asked Jeremiah why he wrote that the king of Babylonia would come and destroy this land and kill its people and its animals.

dag: Yɛlim a mabia ŋun nyɛ doo la, N niriba. Ka yɛl a tizɔpaɣa, O nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: So let your brothers be called My People and your sisters be called Shown Mercy.

dag: Ka Obɛdɛdom daa yina ti deei duno shɛli din daa be nudirigu polo la, ka bɛ daa zaŋ nɛma duri fukumsi niŋ o bidibisi nuu ni.
en: Obed Edom was allotted the south gate, and his sons were allotted to guard the storerooms.

dag: Nyama, n ni dihi ya sɔŋ tiŋa yi biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni vari kabɔba m-marigiri taba tɔroko lɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: So now I will oppress you, just like a cart is weighed down when it is full of harvested grain.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha, ka Zimiri daa di nam ʒini Tiriza daba ayopɔin. Di saha maa Izraɛl tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti teei gilila Gibɛtɔn din be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: In the twenty-seventh year of Judahs King Asa, Zimri became king. He ruled in Tirzah for seven days. The army was camped at Gibbethon in Philistia.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni n-yɛli Juda fɔntinsinim bɛn zaa yɛn kana ti jɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa n ni zal a ni a yɛli, ka miri ka a sɔɣi ba yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: the Lord said to me, Stand in the court of the Temple and proclaim all I have commanded you to say to the people who come from the towns of Judah to worship there. Do not leave out anything.

dag: Deemiya saɣisigu kaman din yi yi ba sanna, dama di wuhiri ni Naawuni lihi ya la o bihi. Bi ŋuni n-lee beni ka o ba bi saɣisir o?.
en: So accept sufferings like a fathers discipline. God does these things to you like a father correcting his children. You know that all children are disciplined by their fathers.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, ka kari mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti be mɔɣu maa ni, ka gbɛri nimaani ka barina shɛli kani.
en: I will make a covenant of peace for them, and I will banish the wild animals from the land. Then they will safely live in the desert and sleep in the forest.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti kpa di naba dali yaha, ka o nyaandoliba maa lan laɣim be duu puuni, ka Tomas gba beni. Duu maa dunoya daa kparimi, ka Yisa daa ti lan puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: A week later the disciples were together again. This time, Thomas was with them. Jesus came in while the doors were still locked and stood in the middle of the group. He greeted his disciples.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin bapira Matania n-leei naa zali ŋun Jɛhoyachin zaani, ka taɣ o yuli Zɛdɛkia.
en: Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Jehoiachin's uncle Mattaniah king of Judah and changed his name to Zedekiah.

dag: dama Naawuni yi daa bi tiligi puu ni olivi tia maa wula la, dindina o ku tilig a gba.
en: If God didnt spare the natural branches, he wont spare you either.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bi be kasi ka ŋubi Yawɛ sara maligu nimdi ni daɣiri, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: but if any of you who are not clean eat it, you shall no longer be considered one of God's people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ka lala tɛhi zilima.
en: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.

dag: Pa lala ka yi daa bɔhim Masia yɛla.
en: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee biɛhindi n yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ?.
en: Who is this ignorant person saying these foolish things?.

dag: Ka o ni yɛli shɛm maa min anabinim yɛligu doli taba kaman di ni sab yɛli shɛm la:.
en: The words of the prophets agree completely with this. As the scripture says.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o.
en: People passing by shook their heads and hurled insults at Jesus:.

dag: Dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin baŋmiya ni mani ka bɛ pun daŋ zaɣisi ka naanyi ti jɛn ya maa.
en: If the world hates you, just remember that it has hated me first.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania, Hanania, wumma, pa Yawɛ n-tim a na ka a ti chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ ʒiri yɛda maa.
en: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah: Listen, Hananiah! The LORD hasnt sent you. All you are doing is persuading these people to believe a lie.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, niriba maa ni ŋubiri nimdi maa shɛm maa, bɛ tumdila alahichi Yawɛ sani maa, dama bɛ bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka o yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla nyaanyiriba, bilimmiya kuɣ titali sɔŋ ma kpe na.
en: Someone said to Saul, Look, the men are sinning against the Lord . Theyre eating meat that still has blood in it! Saul said, You have sinned. Roll a large stone over here now.

dag: Dama bɛ bi nyari biɛrim; ka bɛ niŋgbuna mal alaafee, ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: They suffer no pain; their bodies are fit and strong.

dag: Yisifu daa nyɛla yuun pihita nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpe Ijipti Firawuna tuma ni maa. Ka Yisifu daa yiri Naa Firawuna sani n-chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: Joseph was years old when he began serving the king of Egypt. He traveled throughout the country of Egypt.

dag: Daadam Bia kandina ni ti ŋmanila do so ŋun daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋa, ka zaŋ o yili niŋ o yiŋbihi nuu ni ka ti sokam o tuma, ka yɛl o yiligula ni o gul o yili maa la.
en: It will be like a man who goes away from home on a trip and leaves his servants in charge, after giving to each one his own work to do and after telling the doorkeeper to keep watch.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti laɣim kpe n-tɔɣisi, ka tɛhi ni di luhiya ni ti pii ti ni shɛba n-chɛ ka bɛ doli ti mabiyurisi Baanabas mini Pool.
en: We reached a united decision to select some delegates and send them to you along with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla yaɣimɛriba m-be Nɛtaim mini Gɛdɛra, Bɛ daa bela naa sani nimaani n-tumd o tuma.
en: They were potters in the service of the king and lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah.

dag: Amaa di daa nyɛla Yawɛ yubu ni o chɛ ka o nya dansi ni biɛrim. O daa chɛ ka o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima alahichi zuɣu, ka o ni ti nya o zuliya, ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli. Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali o zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, It was my will that he should suffer; his death was a sacrifice to bring forgiveness. And so he will see his descendants; he will live a long life, and through him my purpose will succeed.

dag: Ka n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni zuɣu chɛ ka ti mabihi pam niŋ ti Duuma naani, naɣ kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni niriba biɛla. Ka bɛn niŋ naani maa kul mali suhukpeeni sahakam ka yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu ka dabiɛm zɔbu kani.
en: And my being in prison has given most of the believers more confidence in the Lord, so that they grow bolder all the time to preach the message fearlessly.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu. Ka bɛ yi bi nya n-di n-tiɣi, bɛ ŋumdimi.
en: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa yɛl o lala ka chaŋ naai, ka o bol o yiŋbih ayi mini tɔbbi so ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka gul o sahakam la na.
en: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jothams deeds, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Yawɛ, n guhirila saha shɛli a ni yɛn tiligi ma.
en: Lord , I am waiting for your salvation.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa po pɔri yɛli, Naawuni yi ni be n sani, ka gbib ma n ni chani luɣ shɛli ŋɔ, ka ti ma bindirigu ka n di, ka ti ma situra ka n ye.
en: Then Jacob made a vow to the Lord : If you will be with me and protect me on the journey I am making and give me food and clothing.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam deei n tumo deela mani, ka ŋunkam mi deei ma deela ŋun tim ma na.
en: I am telling you the truth: whoever receives anyone I send receives me also; and whoever receives me receives him who sent me.

dag: Di chɛ ka shɛli yɛla niŋ a nandahima bee n-chɛ ka shɛli ti a biɛrim a niŋgbuna ni. Dama bipolitali mini biɛhigu piligu nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Remove anxiety from your heart, banish pain from your body, because youth and the dawn of life are pointless too.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa bɔri ni bɛ ʒi Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi.
en: Barnabas wanted to take along John, whose other name was Mark.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi niŋ hal ko mahim biɛla ti n nyaandoliba ni yino, hal ŋun pɔri bɛ ni gba, o ni nyɛ n nyaandol zuɣu, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: I assure you that everybody who gives even a cup of cold water to these little ones because they are my disciples will certainly be rewarded.

dag: Amaa Gibiɔnnim ni daa wum Jɔshua ni niŋ Jɛriko mini Ai shɛm la zuɣu.
en: But the people of Gibeon, who were Hivites, heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka di daa muɣisi Dauda pam, o ni daa ŋmaai Sool binyɛrigu maa zuɣu.
en: Afterwards, David was sorry that he had even done that.

dag: N kuhimi hal ka n nimbihi ti fulim. Di biɛri m puuni. Bɛ ni ku n niriba shɛm maa zuɣu, n suhu saɣimmi, dama biliɛri mini biyaɣilima tarigimi lu tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu.
en: My eyes are worn out with tears, and my insides are upset. My heart feels like it has been poured on the ground; I feel this way because of the destruction of my people. Children and babies are fainting in the public squares of the city.

dag: O luɣi bɛ tiba, ka wuhi ba, ka zali ba ni bɛ zom yi alahichi ni labi o sanna.
en: He makes them listen to his warning to turn away from evil.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa nyɛ Jaara ba, ka Jaara nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba, ka Zimiri nyɛ Mɔza ba.
en: The descendants of Ahaz included Jarah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza, Binea, Rephaiah, Eleasah, and Azel and his six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya saŋkpalima bee muli zaɣ nyama ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li, ka di saha na bi paai.
en: Make a solemn pledge, daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the wild deer: Dont rouse, dont arouse love until it desires.

dag: ka Hilikia nyɛ Shallum bia, ka Shallum nyɛ Zadok bia, ka Zadok nyɛ Ahitub bia.
en: Hilkiah was the son of Shallum. Shallum was the son of Zadok. Zadok was the son of Ahitub.

dag: So ku tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa o nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi. Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: No one can break into a strong man's house and take away his belongings unless he first ties up the strong man; then he can plunder his house.

dag: Ka binyɛra maa zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu binshɛli zuɣu di ni leei zaɣ daɣiri, di yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro duu bee daaŋa yin wurimmiya li, di leei daɣiri, ka kul ni nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: If any part of a dead, unclean animal falls on something, that thing is unclean. It may be a clay oven or a clay baking pan. It must be broken into pieces. These things will remain unclean. They will always be unclean for you.

dag: Ka Baasha ŋun daa nyɛ Ahija ŋun yi Isaka zuliya ni na bia la daa lo nia n-chaŋ ti liri Nadab n-ku o Gibɛtɔn din be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama Nadab mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa teei gilila Gibɛtɔn.
en: Baasha son of Ahijah, of the tribe of Issachar, plotted against Nadab and killed him as Nadab and his army were besieging the city of Gibbethon in Philistia.

dag: N vu n tiliginsim mirina, ka di shee bi wɔɣa. N tiliginsim maa kandina ku yuui. N ni tiligi Jɛrusalɛm, ka di ti Izraɛlnim jilima.
en: But I am close to making things right. Salvation will not be delayed much longer. I will bring salvation to Zion and to my wonderful Israel.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanu dali din daa nyɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu puhi kaai biɛɣu dal la, ka Izraɛlnim daa yi Ramɛsis n-chani nasara dibu chandi Ijiptinim zaa ninni.
en: They marched from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Passover the Israelites went out defiantly in the sight of all the Egyptians.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa.
en: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.

dag: Bini bahigu so di piligu; ka suɣilo so karimbaani.
en: The end of something is better than its beginning. Patience is better than pride.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Ka a paɣ Zara be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, O be tanti suɣili ŋɔ ni.
en: They said to him, Wheres your wife Sarah? And he said, Right here in the tent.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu ŋun be bia maa ni zuɣu, ka o zo ka chɛ o, ka bia maa dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Then Jesus spoke harshly to the demon. And it came out of the child, who was healed from that time on.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a dimnim zaa kpi lala, amaa ka chɛ ka a zɔnim mi ne kaman wuntaŋ ni puhirina ni yaa n-ne shɛm la. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: So may all your enemies die like that, O Lord , but may your friends shine like the rising sun! And there was peace in the land for forty years.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa daa yi chani naa Sulemaana sani ti wumdi Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli niŋ o suhu ni maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: Year after year, other kings came to hear the wisdom God had given him. And they brought gifts of silver and gold, as well as clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi nam fukumsinim yɛligu dolibu zaɣisila Naawuni ni zali shɛli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala ni bo tibidarigibo ti bɛmaŋa.
en: So anyone who is against the government is really against something God has commanded. Those who are against the government bring punishment on themselves.

dag: O teeg o nambɔzɔbo yɛla, ka sɔŋ o dabili Izraɛl.
en: God has helped Israel—the people he chose to serve him. He did not forget his promise to give us his mercy.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya wain pali wain duɣu kam. Bɛ ni bɔh a, A tɛhiya ni ti bi mi ni di simdi ni ti niŋ wain pali wain duɣu kam.
en: So deliver this word to them: The LORD the God of Israel proclaims: Every wine jug should be filled with wine. And they will answer you, Dont we already know that? Obviously every wine jug should be filled with wine.

dag: Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna ni bɛ su li. Pina sara shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi mali nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la n-daa nyɛ bɛ tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: Moses had given no land to the tribe of Levi. As the Lord had told Moses, they were to receive as their possession a share of the sacrifices burned on the altar to the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: He said, And what about you? Who do you say that I am.

dag: Yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zaa la yoli, m bɔri ni n teei ya ni Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi Izraɛlnima n-yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di nyaaŋa o daa ti bahi bɛ ni bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda la yoli.
en: For even though you know all this, I want to remind you of how the Lord once rescued the people of Israel from Egypt, but afterward destroyed those who did not believe.

dag: Ka dɔr biɛɣu yi mali ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun yɛm binchɛra, ka chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim, ka o pɔb o zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili ka kuhiri yɛra, Daɣiri! Daɣiri.
en: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, I'm unclean! I'm unclean.

dag: Amiram bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Aduna mini Musa. Ka bɛ daa pii Aduna min o bidibisi ni bɛ su jɛmbu duu puuni neen kasi la fukumsi sahakam, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri Yawɛ, ka tumd o tuma, ka lan zaŋd o yuli suhiri alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam.
en: Amrams family: Aaron and Moses. Aaron, together with his sons, was set apart to make the holiest objects holy, to make offerings before the LORD, to serve him, and to give blessings in his name forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Samsin zuɣu na pam, ka o zaŋ o nuzaŋa gbaai gbuɣinli maa n-darigi pirig o kaman nir ni darigiri pirigiri bubil shɛm la. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba bee o ma o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The Spirit of the Lord came on Samson with great power. He tore the lion apart with his bare hands. It seemed easy to him. It was as easy as tearing apart a young goat. But Samson did not tell his father or mother what he had done.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; dama m bela n ko ka be nahiŋgu ni.
en: Turn to me, God, and have mercy on me because Im alone and suffering.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la, ka di zaŋ yaɣ yini hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: They made the middle brace so that it passed through the frames from one end to the other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, Zaligu ŋɔ ka a ba daa zali ti pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: So they approached Joseph and said, Your father gave orders before he died, telling us.

dag: Ka kom gili ma niŋ sunsuuni ka teeku maa kom kul lim ma zaa. Ka teeku kɔtiŋ mɔri vilivili n zuɣu.
en: Waters have grasped me to the point of death; the deep surrounds me. Seaweed is wrapped around my head.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣibɔɣili din daa be Sukɔt mini Zarɛtan sunsuuni la ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa.
en: near the Jordan River between Succoth and Zarethan by pouring melted bronze into clay molds.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa yɛli do so ŋun kpaŋ maa, Zuŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali; di bi luhi ni a kpuɣ a bindoo maa n-ʒiri li chana.
en: So some Jews said to the man who had been healed, Today is the Sabbath. It is against our law for you to carry your mat on the Sabbath day.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din gari la puuni, Naawuni daa bi kahigi ashili ŋɔ wuhi ninsalinima, amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni yipa kahigi li o Shia Kasi zuɣu n-wuh o tuumba min o daanabinim bɛn be kasi la.
en: Earlier generations didnt know this hidden plan that God has now revealed to his holy apostles and prophets through the Spirit.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Chɛ ka n niriba pah a niriba zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ ŋarima maa chaŋ; amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bi saɣi.
en: Then King Ahaziah of Israel offered to let his men sail with Jehoshaphat's men, but Jehoshaphat refused the offer.

dag: Di pa shɛli Judanim yi wum n ni lo ni n niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ yɛla bɛ zaa ni chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ daalahichi taali.
en: then read it to the people of Judah. Maybe they will stop sinning when they hear what terrible things I plan for them. And if they turn back to me, I will forgive them.

dag: N nya mbusim ni be Izraɛl tiŋgban ni; Ifriimnim tum yolimyolim, ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: In the house of Israel I have seen something horrible; Ephraim acts like a prostitute; Israel is defiled.

dag: N ni daa kul be Izraɛlnim zaa sani n-chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa la, n daa mi n-bɔhi Izraɛl zuɣulaannim shɛb n ni daa pii ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la ni so, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me yili ti ma? .
en: Throughout my traveling with the Israelites, did I ever ask one of Israels tribal leaders, whom I appointed to shepherd my people, Why havent you built me a cedar temple?.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiri bimbira chani biribu, ka kumdi ti ʒi bɛ ni biri shɛli maa bɔba kuna ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who cried as they carried the seeds will be happy when they bring in the crops!.

dag: Bɛ zaliya ni bɛ gbahimi tiŋ maa nim chaŋ. Bɛ gbahi di dabipaɣiba chaŋ, ka bɛ fabindi kaman ŋmana la, ka buri bɛ nyɔri.
en: The queen is taken captive; her servants moan like doves and beat their breasts in sorrow.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɔɣu din chaɣisira n-nyaɣil o, ka zaŋ kpan titali din nyaɣisira mini banchiriga n-nyaɣil o pahi.
en: The soldiers quiver shakes on the horses side. The spear and weapons its rider carries shine in the sun.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ o ti ti, ka ti ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa.
en: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m piɛma varim ʒim. N ni chɛ ka n takɔbi ŋmahi n ni ku shɛba mini n ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb nimdi mini ʒim din yi n dimnim bɛn nyɛ zab wɔɣilanim la ni na.
en: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: Jesus said to them, Take care; be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: n karitimi dol o hal ti ŋme n-fa piɛbila maa o nol ni; ka o yi lɛbigi doli ma na, n gbaarila o nyiŋgol ni ŋme n-ku o.
en: I go after it, attack it, and rescue the lamb. And if the lion or bear turns on me, I grab it by the throat and beat it to death.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ la saha shɛl o ni daa wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Kapɛrinium la.
en: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnima, Pɔhim tulli ni ti yi n sani daboya zuɣusaa n-ʒe n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti ʒe n-kpa n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ polo, di pala pɔhim shɛli din ni yɛli binyara bee din ni pɔbisi binyara saɣiri chaŋ.
en: At that time this message will be given to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: A hot wind blows from the bare hills. It comes from the desert to my people. It is not like the gentle wind that is used to separate the grain from the chaff.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Asha zuliya ni dɔbba, ka daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ gahinda. Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi pisinaayɔbu.
en: All these men were descendants of Asher. They were leaders of their families. They were the best men. They were soldiers and great leaders. Their family history shows , soldiers ready for war.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Mara nti kɔŋ di kom nyubu, dama di daa tomi, di zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Mara.
en: They did find water at Marah, but it was bitter, which is how that place got its name.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ tipawumli siɣi doli ba na, ka di chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba zuɣu.
en: I will make the Egyptians so stubborn that they will go after you. Then I will be praised because of what happens to the king and his chariots and cavalry.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti doli Yisa.
en: The two followers heard him say this, so they followed Jesus.

dag: Yɛnnim yi nya ka barina kanna, bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa ka tarimba bɛn chaŋ ti di di wahala.
en: Prudent people see trouble and hide, while the simpleminded go right to it and get punished.

dag: dama dina n-viɛla, ka nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nini.
en: This is right and it pleases God our savior.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ti lan labina pahi buyi nti shih o ka yɛli, Yiɣisim di ka nyu, di yi pa lala a chandi maa ni ti nyaŋ a.
en: Later the Lord s angel came to him again, touched him, and said, Get up and eat! If you dont, you will not be strong enough to make the long trip.

dag: ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu ka bi lan jɛmd o bee m-bɔhir o binshɛli yɛla la birili.
en: They have turned away from me, the Lord . They have stopped following me. They no longer ask me, the Lord , for help.

dag: Amaa ŋun mi n ni doli so shɛli, o yi vihi ma o ni nya ka n viɛlimi kaman salima la.
en: But God knows me. He is testing me and will see that I am as pure as gold.

dag: Di nabihi daa be kasi gari sakuɣa, ka piɛli gari bihim. Bɛ niŋgbuna daa mali alaafee. Bɛ zabiri viɛlim daa ŋmanila safaya kuɣa viɛlim.
en: Our princes were undefiled and pure as snow, vigorous and strong, glowing with health.

dag: Balinte a ti yɛli ni a bi nyar o; amaa yɛla maa kpalimla o sani, kul guhim o.
en: Job, you say you can't see God; but wait patiently—your case is before him.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Judanim ni ti nya tiliginsim, ka Izraɛlnim mi be ni alaafee. O yuli ti yɛn boonila, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia. .
en: When he rules, Judah will be saved, and Israel will live in safety. This will be his name: The Lord Makes Things Right for Us.

dag: Nyin ninsala, ka a ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria ka amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi li maa, a tɛhiya ni a ni nya soli din ni doli yi Naawuni sariakaribo ni?.
en: If you judge those who do these kinds of things while you do the same things yourself, think about this: Do you believe that you will escape Gods judgment?.

dag: Speen ŋariŋduhiriba, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama bɛ saɣim yi birininima.
en: Howl with grief, you sailors out on the ocean! The city you relied on has been destroyed.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi m-mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: For the person who has something will be given more, so that he will have more than enough; but the person who has nothing will have taken away from him even the little he has.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka di mi pala bindirigu kum bee kɔnyuri, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu kum.
en: The time is coming when I will send famine on the land. People will be hungry, but not for bread; they will be thirsty, but not for water. They will hunger and thirst for a message from the Lord . I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: amaa hal yi zabigu zaɣ yini gba ti ku bɔrigi.
en: Still, not a hair on your heads will be lost.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din kpaŋsi ti suhuri. Ka din pahi timaŋmaŋ suhukpaŋsibo ŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli pam Taitus suhupiɛlli nyabu la zuɣu, dama o tɛha dɔniya yi zaa zuɣu.
en: And that is what was so encouraging to us. We were greatly encouraged, but we were especially pleased to see how happy Titus was. You all made him feel so much better.

dag: Amaa nyin Daniɛl, kul ʒe yim hal ni di bahigu ni. A ni ti vuhi, ka ni ti zani a zaashee zaadali.
en: And you, Daniel, be faithful to the end. Then you will die, but you will rise to receive your reward at the end of time.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, buni nyɛla din yɔhindi nira. Karimbaannim ku be. Bɛ yɛla bɛ lɔna kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee la. Bɛ ŋmanila kum, bɛ bi tiɣira. Bɛ laɣim zuliya kam leei bɛ niriba, bɛ zaŋ niriba zaa lee bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: Moreover, wine betrays an arrogant man. He doesnt rest. He opens his jaws like the grave; like death, he is never satisfied. He gathers all nations to himself and collects all peoples for himself.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika Yalim vinvamli ni ka labina, ka o yuli daa maan du pam.
en: David fought the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed , of their soldiers. When he returned, he built a monument.

dag: Yawɛ, ti dolila a yubu ni nyɛ shɛli, ka niŋ a ni doli so shɛŋa kariti saria naani. A kɔŋko ka ti kul bɔra.
en: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, amaa bɛ ku wum a yɛligu. A ni boli ba, amaa bɛ ku garig a.
en: Jeremiah, no matter what you do, the people won't listen.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu yomyom; n gbarigiya zaa. Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma. Di yi niŋ lala, n ni bemi kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: Answer me now, Lord ! I have lost all hope. Don't hide yourself from me, or I will be among those who go down to the world of the dead.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niɣi kpe baɣa pam, ka di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi bahira. Di chɛ ka ti doli solɔri kuhiri nandahima kumsi.
en: And may our cows be heavy with calves. May no enemy break through our walls or carry away any of our people. May there be no cries of pain in our streets.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa yi nya o saha shɛlikam, bɛ lurila o tooni ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: And whenever the people who had evil spirits in them saw him, they would fall down before him and scream, You are the Son of God.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi bi yuri ka tum birigi n ni zali ya ni yi di tum shɛl la n-tum alahichi.
en: Say to the Israelites: Do the following whenever someone sins unintentionally against any of the LORDs commands, doing something that shouldnt be done.

dag: N kpamdi Yuɔdia mini Sintike jaande ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ noya naai taba ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: Euodia and Syntyche, you both belong to the Lord, so please agree with each other.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Ka sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di.
en: Do you gain anything if you win the whole world but lose your life? Of course not!.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ ni paɣibu kal la paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: The Pharisees and teachers asked Jesus, Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? Why do they eat without washing their hands.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ daba tim bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim la jilima, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yuli min o wuhibu ŋɔ.
en: Those who are slaves must consider their masters worthy of all respect, so that no one will speak evil of the name of God and of our teaching.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa ti tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti yih o na ka o deeg o. Ka naa maa daa bɔh o ashilɔni o yiŋ maa ni, Yawɛ yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli? Ka Jɛrimia garigi yɛli, O yɛli shɛli. Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Bɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni.
en: King Zedekiah secretly had me brought to his palace, where he asked, Is there any message for us from the Lord ? Yes, there is, Your Majesty, I replied. The Lord is going to let the king of Babylonia capture you.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama o ni tɔɣisi suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-ti o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku ŋmaligi labi jɛrilim biɛhigu ni yaha.
en: I heard what the Lord God said. He said there would be peace for his people and his loyal followers. So they must not go back to their foolish way of living.

dag: Yɛm ni zaŋ jilima zuɣupiligu pil a, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli ti a.
en: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa, zomiya Yawɛ! Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, lumiy o sizuura!.
en: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord !.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa zaŋ bia maa yi jirambisa maa zuɣu n-siɣina kpɛhi yili maa ni nti ti o ma maa ka yɛli, Nyama, a bia maa lan leei nyɛvililana yaha.
en: Elijah picked him up and carried him downstairs. He gave the boy to his mother and said, Look, your son is alive.

dag: Ka di daa ku ba suli pam ti yaɣi, ka bɛ piligi tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ Yisa shɛm.
en: They were furious and began talking with each other about what to do to Jesus.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka labina.
en: They returned from exploring the land after forty days.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Ʒe a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini; ka n chaŋ Yawɛ sani kpe ha.
en: Then Balaam said to Balak, Stay here by this altar while I go meet with God over there.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi goli palli dabisili maa nyaaŋa, ka Dauda ʒiishee maa na kul nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ. Di saha ka Sool daa bɔh o dapala Jɔnatan, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Jɛsi dapala ŋɔ bi kana bindirigu dibu shee ŋɔ sɔhila bee zuŋɔ.
en: The day after the New Moon Festival, when David's place was still empty, Saul asked Jonathan, Why hasn't that son of Jesse come to eat with us? He wasn't here yesterday, and he still isn't here today.

dag: Ŋuni n-na mi n-zaŋ o nuu tooi teeku kom m-buɣisi di ni nyɛ shɛm bee n-zaŋ o nutali buɣisi sagbana yɛliŋ, bee n-va tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu niŋ bini puuni, bee n-zaŋ zoya mini kuŋkuna pa sania zuɣu buɣisi li?.
en: Can anyone measure the ocean by handfuls or measure the sky with his hands? Can anyone hold the soil of the earth in a cup or weigh the mountains and hills on scales?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi Sintani, A tɛhi n dabili Ayuba yɛla? So bi ŋman o dunia ni. O nyɛla ŋun ka galimi ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to Satan, Have you noticed my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him. He is a good, faithful man. He respects God and refuses to do evil.

dag: ni Hashɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Gizɔn nir la ni Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Shage Harar nir la bia.
en: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite;.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi a ni na ka nyɛ ŋun lo Yawɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka wuhiri yikombiɛlim.
en: Someone from Nineveh is making evil plans against the Lord . That advisor is a worthless troublemaker.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti shiri nya ka buŋ maa lo so yiŋ samban ni sokpaŋa, ka bɛ lɔrig o.
en: The followers went into the town. They found a young donkey tied in the street near the door of a house, and they untied it.

dag: N kpamdi Yuɔdia mini Sintike jaande ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ noya naai taba ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.

dag: Miriya ka yi ku ninsala.
en: Do not kill.

dag: Iso ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdomnim bɛn daa be Siɛr zoya tiŋ maa ni yab la zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the descendants of Esau, the ancestor of Edom, which lies in the mountains of Seir.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zahimmi yɛlli maa ka baŋ a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm; dama dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi tahi zaɣ biɛɣu ti kpɛm maa sanna n-tabil o yiŋnim zaa, ka o mi yɛla kpɛm pam ka nir ku tooi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Please think this over and decide what to do. This could be disastrous for our master and all his family. He is so mean that he won't listen to anybody.

dag: Riuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza.
en: Reuels family: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

dag: dama a yihi ma kum ni. A mi ku saɣi n-chɛ a ni yuri so niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee n-chɛ ka a dabili kpalim gballi ni pooi.
en: because you wont abandon my life to the grave; you wont let your faithful follower see the pit.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa tɔɣisirila Lazarɔs kum yɛla, ka o nyaandoliba maa bɛn tɛhi ni o tɔɣisirila o daalaafee gom yɛla.
en: They thought Jesus meant that Lazarus was literally sleeping, but he really meant that Lazarus was dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, niriba maa ni ŋubiri nimdi maa shɛm maa, bɛ tumdila alahichi Yawɛ sani maa, dama bɛ bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka o yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla nyaanyiriba, bilimmiya kuɣ titali sɔŋ ma kpe na.
en: Saul was told, Look, the people are sinning against the Lord by eating meat with the blood in it. You are traitors! Saul cried out. Roll a big stone over here to me.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa tim dunia ni n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala n-zaŋ li bahi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka titali ni.
en: The angel swung his sickle over the earth. He gathered the earths grapes and threw them into the great winepress of Gods anger.

dag: Nir yi pii yu suŋ di gari buni pam, ka jilima mi gari anzinfa bee salima.
en: A good reputation and respect are worth much more than silver and gold.

dag: Yinim Marɛshanima, n ni lan piɛli yi dim ŋun ni nyaŋ ya bahi yi zuɣu. Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mali jilima ni ti zo na ti sɔɣi Adulam.
en: Again I will bring to you the one who conquers, inhabitants of Mareshah; the glory of Israel will come as far as Adullam.

dag: Dama Masia daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu yim, ka di yɛla naai zaa. Ŋuna ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra daa kpi bɛn pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ti tahi Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa kula o niŋgbuŋ, amaa ka Naawuni Shia daa lee neeg o n-chɛ ka o mali nyɛvili.
en: For Christ died for sins once and for all, a good man on behalf of sinners, in order to lead you to God. He was put to death physically, but made alive spiritually.

dag: ka zo yomyom ti yɛl o nyaandoliba ni o neei kum ni n-daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o. Nyamiya, mani n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: Now hurry, go and tell his disciples, Hes been raised from the dead. Hes going on ahead of you to Galilee. You will see him there. Ive given the message to you.

dag: Dama a mini mɔɣu ni kuɣa ni ti lo tab alikauli. Ka a mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ti be ni suhudoo.
en: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.

dag: amaa yi ni mali pam pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi sɔŋ bɛn ka. Ka yi gba yi ti ka ka bɛ mi mali pam, bɛ ni sɔŋ ya, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka yi tab sɔŋbu saɣ taba.
en: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Wula ka n lee ni tooi baŋ di gbinni, ka pa ni so n-dolisi ma? Ka daa yɛli Filip ni o kpɛm o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa ni na ti ʒin o sani.
en: The man replied, Without someone to guide me, how could I? Then he invited Philip to climb up and sit with him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim sahakam. Sinai Zoli gbini ka bɛ daa zali di niŋbu, ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: This sacrifice to please me was first offered at Mount Sinai.

dag: N kuhiri boonila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ma binshɛlikam din simdi ma.
en: I call to God, the Most High, to God, who supplies my every need.

dag: ka doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: and obey all his laws. I am giving them to you today for your benefit.

dag: Di zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim jintɔriba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ? Dama doo ŋɔ wuhiri shihira pam.
en: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called the council together and said, What should we do? This man is working a lot of miracles.

dag: ka o min o kpamba ni tɔbbihi daa niŋ tab saawara n-saɣi ni bɛ ŋarim bɛ ya maa kɔbilisi din be tiŋ maa kpaŋa, ka bɛ daa sɔŋ o.
en: he consulted with his officials and soldiers about stopping up the springs outside the city, and they supported him.

dag: Ka Midiannim maa daa zaŋ Yisifu chaŋ Ijipti nti kɔhi Pɔtifa ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm zuɣu.
en: Meanwhile, the Midianites had sold Joseph in Egypt to a man named Potiphar, who was the king's official in charge of the palace guard.

dag: Banima n-nyɛ bɛn daa lee wum Naawuni kukoli, amaa ka ti taai duŋ la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la?.
en: Who was it who rebelled when they heard his voice? Wasnt it all of those who were brought out of Egypt by Moses?.

dag: Malimiya shili kaman yi daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni daa piripiri ya kaman Izraɛl Naa Dauda ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la ni kaman o bia Sulemaana ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la.
en: Make yourselves ready for service in the Temple by your tribes. Do the jobs that King David and his son King Solomon gave you to do.
