dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ! O wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu, o wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu.
en: Praise the Lord , my protector! He trains me for battle and prepares me for war.

dag: Dabisili din pahir ayi dali ka niriba maa zaa dunoya dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim daa laɣim chaŋ Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ zaligubaŋda la sani ni bɛ ti bɔhim baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu maa ni.
en: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyari niriba galimi ŋɔ ni tooi mo Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Ŋunkam ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni ŋun garigima.
en: Will the one who disputes with the Almighty correct him? Gods instructor must answer him.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti di ka nyu n-naai, ka o suhu dɔni luɣ yini, ka o chaŋ kaʒee gbini ti dɔni ni o gbihi. Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Rut ti puɣisi chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli.
en: After Boaz finished eating and drinking and was feeling happy, he went over and fell asleep near the pile of grain. Ruth slipped over quietly. She lifted the cover and lay down near his feet.

dag: Ka n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ m muɣisigu maa puuni; n daa kuhimi boli n Naawuni ni o sɔŋ ma. Ka n kuhigu maa daa chaŋ ti lu o tibili ni; ka o daa wum n kuhigu maa o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ nira n-ti yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa, bɛ naa ti yɛn yila bɛ sunsuuni na. N ni voog o mirina, ka o ti be n sani. Dama so ku tooi ka n sanna omaŋmaŋ yiko ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa daa bɔri ni o paɣ omaŋa ka bɔhi Yisa, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ n ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: But the man wanted to show that the way he was living was right. So he said to Jesus, But who is my neighbor.

dag: N daa gbihimi, amaa ka n suhu lee ne. Wumma, n yura n-kpahiri n dunoli maa. N yura ni n tizɔpaɣa, yoomi ka n kpɛna. N ŋmani ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi. Maligim lumi mahigi n zuɣu, ka yuŋ paɣili kpe m-mahigi n zabiri.
en: I was asleep, but dreaming: The one I love was at the door, knocking and saying, My darling, my very own, my flawless dove, open the door for me! My head is drenched with evening dew.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla naɣilahi tuhi pisinaayi mini piɛri tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi mali sara. Naa min o niriba maa zaa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni shɛm m-bala.
en: He sacrificed , head of cattle and , sheep as fellowship offerings. And so he and all the people dedicated the Temple.

dag: Ka Yisahaku tumtumdiba daa ka o sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o bɛ ni gbi kɔbil shɛli yɛla, ka yɛli, Ti nya kom.
en: On that day Isaac's servants came and told him about the well which they had dug. They said, We have found water.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Asha zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their surrounding areas are the legacy for the clans of the Asher tribe.

dag: Dan ni ti nyɛla o niriba naa kaman Izraɛl zuliyanim ni yino.
en: Dan will be a ruler for his people. They will be like the other tribes of Israel.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛli shɛm maa bi wuhirila chɛfirinim bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma ka nyɛ kɔrɛnim mini ninvuɣ fariba ni buɣijɛmdiba la; di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi naɣ ni yila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Now I did not mean pagans who are immoral or greedy or are thieves, or who worship idols. To avoid them you would have to get out of the world completely.

dag: Yi daa kam ni dolila jɛmbu duu sania. Gɛra bini pisi n-ni nyɛ anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini.
en: Every value will be according to the sanctuarys shekel. The shekel will be twenty gerahs.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zo n-chaŋ o biŋkɔbiri sani nti gbaai naɣilabil polli ŋun viɛla n-ti o tumtumda, ka o kɔrig o mal o yomyom.
en: Then he ran to the herd and picked out a calf that was tender and fat, and gave it to a servant, who hurried to get it ready.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya li lala ka di niŋ ba alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka fiig tia maa dii zani yim kuui lala.
en: When the followers saw this, they were very surprised. They asked, How did the fig tree dry up and die so quickly.

dag: Ka Pita gbaag o nuu ni n-yiɣis o zali; ka boli Yisa nyaandoliba maa mini pakoya maa na nti zaŋ Dɔɔkas ŋun lan niŋ nyɛvililan maa ti ba.
en: He gave her his hand and helped her stand up. Then he called the believers and the widows into the room. He showed them Tabitha; she was alive!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ti ni daa wum Naawuni Bia maa sani ka yɛri ya di yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Naawuni nyɛla neesim, ka zibisim ka o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli tiŋgban kuŋ maa Tiŋgbani, ka boli kom din laɣim do luɣ yini maa mi Teeku. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: God named the dry land earth, and he named the water that was gathered together seas. And God saw that this was good.

dag: Yɛlim ti a ni tɛhiri shɛm: Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: So tell us what you think. Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi kuli Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli puuni niriba, dindina ti yaannim tarili ni ka bɛ tarili ni yina, ka bɛ zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni; di saha ka di yi ti tarili ni.
en: But remember, if they marry men of another tribe, their property will then belong to that tribe, and the total allotted to us will be reduced.

dag: Lihimiya nya din niŋdi gili ya; sokam zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yi bidibisi ni yi katiŋ na, ka bɛ kpuɣi yi bipuɣinsi buɣ na nti tin ya.
en: Lift up your eyes and look all around: they are all gathered; they have come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters on caregivers hips.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni tɔbu ni din ya, ka kum kun ya, ka alɔbo din ya luɣ shɛli yi ni bɔri ni yi chaŋ ti ʒini maa.
en: So know without a doubt that you will die by war, famine, and disease in the place you yearn to go and live.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ n daalahichi, ka kpihim n tuumbiɛri zaa.
en: Dont look at my sins. Erase them all.

dag: dama pagɔrili ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli, paɣ zinalan ŋmanila kɔbil muɣiliŋga.
en: Prostitutes and immoral women are a deadly trap.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa nya ŋariŋ shɛli din chani Fɔnisia, ka ti kpe li chaŋ.
en: There we found a ship that was going to the area of Phoenicia. We got on the ship and sailed away.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Eliphaz answered.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka di simdi ka yi ti lo noli; di yɛn nyɛla zaligu sahakam.
en: You must humble yourselves because this day is a very important day of rest for you. This law will continue forever.

dag: Hashum daŋ ni: Matɛnai mini Matata ni Zabad so mi ni Ɛlifɛlɛt ni Jɛrɛmai ni Manaasa so mi ni Shimɛi.
en: Of the family of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Chama, ka daa chɛ ka o chaŋ ni o ti niŋ chira ayi. Ka o daa ŋmaligi ka o min o dol tab chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-fabil o ni yɛn kpi ni o paɣipiɛlital maa zuɣu.
en: He told her to go and sent her away for two months. She and her friends went up into the mountains and grieved because she was going to die unmarried and childless.

dag: O ni ti tuhi sansana din mali kpiɔŋ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm wun so la sɔŋsim zuɣu. O ni ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe wuni ŋɔ nyaaŋa jilima, ka zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni, ka pirigi paliti ti ba ka di leei bɛ laara.
en: He will deal with walled fortresses with the help of a foreign god. He will heap rewards on those who support him, making them rule over many and dividing up the land for a price.

dag: Yi ni daa yi Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka n daa pun lɔnya alikauli ni n kul ni be yi sani. Di zɔriya dabiɛm. .
en: When you came out of Egypt, I promised that I would always be with you. I am still with you, so do not be afraid.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum Gaad yɛligu maa ka chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: So David went up, following Gads instructions, just as the LORD had commanded.

dag: O daa sabila gbaŋ maa yɛli Jɔab, Zaŋmi Yuria zali tooni tɔb maa ni mali kpiɔŋ luɣ shɛli polo, ka miligi ka chɛ o ka bɛ ku o.
en: The letter said: Put Uriah on the front line where the fighting is the worst. Then pull the troops back from him, so that he will be wounded and die.

dag: O daa kamina ni o ti di neesim maa shɛhira, ka bɛnkam zaa wum o yɛligu niŋ yɛda o zuɣu.
en: who came to tell people about the light, so that all should hear the message and believe.

dag: Nyama, n nini nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka n tiba wum, ka m baŋ di gbinni.
en: Everything you say, I have heard before. I understand it all; I know as much as you do. I'm not your inferior.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o dolila adiini soli ka bi gbib o zilinli, o yɔhindila omaŋa o suhu ni, ka o daadiini soli dolibu nyɛla yoli.
en: You might think you are a very religious person. But if your tongue is out of control, you are fooling yourself. Your careless talk makes your offerings to God worthless.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti tim boli tindaannim mini laasabuniŋdiba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ Izraɛlnim Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ? Ka ti yi yɛn zaŋ li labisi di biɛhigu shee, bɔ ka ti lee yɛn zaŋ pahi di zuɣu labisi.
en: The Philistines called for the priests and the diviners. What should we do with the LORDs chest? they asked. Tell us how we should send it back to its own home.

dag: M mabihi, lala zuɣu sokam kul kpalimmi be Naawuni sani kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni ti bol o.
en: Stay what you were when God chose you.

dag: Ka Mɛlatia ŋun daa yi Gibiɔn na la mini Jadɔn ŋun daa yi Mɛrɔnɔt na la ni Gibiɔnnim ni Mizipanim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo gomna sulinsi ni la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa ti giri zaŋ chaŋ Amnɔn kum maa polo, o ni daa nya ka o lan kani maa zuɣu, ka o suhu lan yu ni o kari Absalom naba.
en: David still felt so sad over the loss of Amnon that he wanted to take his army there and capture Absalom.

dag: Ka sokam ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-shiri ŋooi n takɔbi maa di tɔɣu ni ka ku lan labisi li su di tɔɣu maa ni yaha.
en: Then everyone will know that I am the Lord . They will know that I have pulled my sword from its sheath. My sword will not go back into its sheath again until it is finished.

dag: Babilɔnnim daa mɛla Sukɔtibɛnɔt buɣili zali, ka Kutinim me Nɛrigal buɣili zali, ka Hamatinim me Ashima buɣili zali.
en: The people of Babylon made the false god Succoth Benoth. The people of Cuthah made the false god Nergal. The people of Hamath made the false god Ashima.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be kaman yɛndana? Ka ŋuni n-lee baŋdi yɛla gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm? Yɛm chɛmi ka nir ninni ne zaa, ka chɛ ka o ninni lihibu biɛhigu taɣi.
en: No one can understand and explain things the way wise people can. Their wisdom makes them happy. It changes a sad face into a happy one.

dag: Di chɛ ka o be kaman bɛ ni yi dɔɣi bikpiin so bahina ka o yaɣ yini saɣim la.
en: Don't let her become like something born dead with half its flesh eaten away.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: In the same way, when you see these things happening, you will know that the time is near, ready to begin.

dag: Ka yi ti kari doli yi dimnima n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: You will chase your enemies, and they will fall before you in battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia ni paɣ a, ka ku shini. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: So I will not be silent; I will sing praise to you. Lord , you are my God; I will give you thanks forever.

dag: ni Shaalabin ni Aijalɔn ni Itila.
en: Shaalbim, Aijalon, Ithlah.

dag: Dama tiŋgbani ni chɛri ka bimbira puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na shɛm ni kaman puu ni chɛri ka bɛ ni zaŋ bimbiri shɛŋa biri di ni zoori shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka wuntia tuma yi zahira, ka zuliya kam zaa tibig o.
en: The earth causes plants to grow, and a garden makes the seeds planted there rise up. In the same way, the Lord GOD will make goodness and praise grow throughout the nations.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa kul o ba Yisahaku sani Mamri bee Kiriatariba luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Hiburɔn ka di nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni daa be shɛl la.
en: Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, that is, Kiriath-arba. This is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac lived as immigrants.

dag: N Duuma, dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka niriba be, din nim zaa zuɣu ka n nyɛvili be. Tim ma alaafee, ka n lan be!.
en: Lord, I will live for you, for you alone; Heal me and let me live.

dag: Di simdi ka yi dɔbba zaa laɣindi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ tooni buta yuuni puuni.
en: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa mini kaya shɛŋa ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: These are the rules, regulations, and instructions between the LORD and the Israelites that he gave through Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Sokam zaa ni daa pun niŋdi tiliginsim nyabu tahima maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra, Amii Masia la m-bala bee so mi.
en: Everyone became excited and wondered, Could John be the Messiah.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham a ʒiʒiinitab sani nti suhi kpaŋman kuma pam na, pa biɛla.
en: Go to your neighbors and borrow as many empty jars as you can, Elisha told her.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma n-leei lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molomoona mini di tumo ni di karimba.
en: I was chosen to tell people that message as an apostle and teacher.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhu ni, Zuliyanim ŋɔ galisiya gari ti, wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari ba.
en: Dont say in your heart, These nations are stronger than we are. How can we force them out.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o ni pun tum shɛm min o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa wuhi ba la yɛla.
en: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Bɛrɔtibɛnɛjaakan n-chaŋ Mɔsɛra. Nimaani ka Aduna daa kpi, ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o nimaani, ka o bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa leei maligumaana zan o zaani.
en: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.

dag: Dama Anabi Jona ni daa be zahim pul ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba ti yɛn be tiŋgban ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata.
en: He was in the stomach of a big fish for three days and nights, just as the Son of Man will be deep in the earth for three days and nights.

dag: Di saha ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa yiɣisi zani suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ niriba maa ni, ka Naawuni daa be alizanda ni o biɛhigu shee din nyɛ kasi la ka deei bɛ suhigu maa.
en: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa suhi o wunsuhigu ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa yiɣisi zan o ni daa gba luɣ shɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini maa gbini n-kpuɣ o nuhi duhi zuɣusaa.
en: As soon as Solomon finished praying and making these requests to the LORD, he got up from before the LORDs altar, where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out to heaven.

dag: dama o yuri ti zuliya ŋɔ hal ka me jɛmbu duu ti ti.
en: He loves our people and he built our synagogue for us.

dag: Amaa ka o sɔŋda maa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ tari ninvuɣ kɔbiga? Ka Ilaisha daa lan garigi yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ba ka bɛ ŋubi, dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ŋub li tiɣi ka guui. .
en: but he answered, Do you think this is enough for a hundred men? Elisha replied, Give it to them to eat, because the Lord says that they will eat and still have some left over.

dag: Ti ka soli ni bɛ ti ti bindirigu mini kom?.
en: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.

dag: Zaŋm a yiko ŋɔ shɛli ti o, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa deer o noli.
en: Show the people that you are making him leader, then all the people will obey him.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchinima; din kul ka buchi mi din ka buchinima! Di zaa shiri ka buchi.
en: It is useless, useless, said the Philosopher. Life is useless, all useless.

dag: Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: Jesus of Nazareth! What do you want with us? Did you come to destroy us? I know who you are—Gods Holy One.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ nayili ti kpe gbaŋŋmar duu, ka kpambaliba zaa daa ʒi nimaani. Bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la mini Shɛmaya bia Dɛlaiya ni Akibɔr bia Ɛlnatan ni Shafan bia Gɛmaria ni Hanania bia Zɛdɛkia ni kpambaliba zaa.
en: When Baruch finished reading, Micaiah went down to the palace. His father Gemariah was in the officials' room, meeting with the rest of the king's officials, including Elishama, Delaiah, Elnathan, and Zedekiah.

dag: N ni wuhi ya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm; n ku sɔɣi ya din be Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani.
en: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.

dag: dama a yihi ma kum ni. A mi ku saɣi n-chɛ a ni yuri so niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee n-chɛ ka a dabili kpalim gballi ni pooi.
en: because you protect me from the power of death. I have served you faithfully, and you will not abandon me to the world of the dead.

dag: Dama nyamiya, ŋuna n-nam zoya, ka nam pɔhim. O kahigi din be o suhu ni n-wuhi ninsala. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka yuŋ zibira. O nyɛla ŋun chani gindi dunia ŋɔ ni. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ, Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa!.
en: He is the one who made the mountains. He created the wind. He lets people know his thoughts. He changes the darkness into dawn. He walks over the mountains of the earth. His name is YAHWEH, Lord God All-Powerful.

dag: Di ʒiɛman maa ni Ahitɔfɛl daa yi kul yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ŋmanila Naawuni maŋmaŋ yɛligu n-nyɛ li. Ka Dauda min o bia Absalom zaa daa yi bi zaŋd o yɛligu niŋd asahi.
en: Now in those days, the advice Ahithophel gave was like asking for a word from God. Thats why Ahithophels advice was valued by both David and Absalom.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zahim ti biɛhigu nya, ka ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani.
en: Let us check and see what we have done. Then let us turn back to the Lord .

dag: Ka a zaŋ li sɔŋ pie taba kulis ayi salima teebuli la zuɣu. Kul yini kam zuɣu zaɣ kpil ayɔbu.
en: Put the loaves in two rows, six in each row, on the table covered with pure gold, which is in the Lord 's presence.

dag: Teem ŋun nam a yɛla a bipolitali saha, ka wahala saha na bi paai, ka yuun shɛŋa ni a ni ti yɛn yɛli, M baɣa lan ka shɛl ni la gba saha na bi paai.
en: Remember your Creator while you are young, before the bad times come—before the years come when you say, I have wasted my life.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Any members of your family who die in the city will be eaten by dogs, and any who die in the open country will be eaten by vultures. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Kul sɔŋm ma, dama m piila a zaligunima.
en: Always be ready to help me, because I follow your commands.

dag: Bɛ daa daai ma la pam ka n yɛn lu, amaa ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ma.
en: I was pushed so hard I nearly died, but the LORD helped me.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilɔi, Ilɔi, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: At three oclock Jesus cried out loudly, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani. This means My God, my God, why have you left me alone.

dag: Dinzuɣu binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni diri ka nyura bee binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni niŋda, niŋmiya li ka di tiri Naawuni jilima.
en: So if you eat, or if you drink, or if you do anything, do it for the glory of God.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n niŋ li. N ku chɛ ka bɛ galim n yuli maa. N ku zaŋ n jilima ti so.
en: I will do this for myself—for me! I will not let you treat me as if I am not important. I will not let some false god take my glory and praise.

dag: Di yi di nyɛ lala, dindina o naan kul dirila wahala tum dunia piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ; amaa din beni nyɛla, saha ni daa ti paai, o daa kana yim nti zaŋ omaŋa m-mali sara kpihim niriba daalahichi.
en: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ kul ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You, Lord , will be king forever and ever.

dag: Bɛ bɔhira, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti lɔri noli ka a bi nyara? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka ti nahim timaŋa, ka a baɣa kani. Nyama, yi ni lɔri noli dahin shɛli maa yi niŋdila din ni sɔŋ yimaŋa, ka nahindi yi tumtumdiba.
en: The people ask, Why should we fast if the Lord never notices? Why should we go without food if he pays no attention? The Lord says to them, The truth is that at the same time you fast, you pursue your own interests and oppress your workers.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa chihi yɛli, M bi la, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbaag o. Ka o yɛli, Aai, a laya.
en: Because Sarah was afraid, she denied it. I didn't laugh, she said. Yes, you did, he replied. You laughed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ti zaŋ kuɣ parilana maa niŋ n ni daa mali adaka shɛli maa puuni, ka di be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ma shɛm maa.
en: and I turned and went down the mountain. Then, just as the Lord had commanded, I put them in the Box that I had made—and they have been there ever since. .

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi bɛn guli naa sapashin kpɛm la daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulana Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ lala. O daa zaŋ firilanim maa zali ni di ne firilatamdigu maa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Aaron obeyed and placed the lamps facing the front of the lampstand.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim ni zɔri Juda tiŋgbɔŋnima, ka bɛ yi ti boli Juda yuli bɛ ni so sani, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni lɔri nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo zuɣu.
en: Judahs land will become what the Egyptians dread; whenever anyone mentions it, they will be terrified because of the plans that the LORD of heavenly forces is making against them.

dag: Alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ beni, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba beni; amaa alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba viɛlim be di ko.
en: And there are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies; the beauty that belongs to heavenly bodies is different from the beauty that belongs to earthly bodies.

dag: Kalidianim bɛn tuhiri tiŋ ŋɔ maa ni ti kana ti niŋ buɣim dabi li n-nyo li tabili bɛ ni daa tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri Baal, ka boori binnyura bahiri buɣa yiya shɛŋa mɔpila zuɣu n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la.
en: They will enter the city, set it on fire, and burn it down—including the houses on whose roofs offerings have been made to Baal and drink offerings to other gods, which made me especially angry.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Eventually the LORD said.

dag: Ka Kɔniilius yɛl o, Daantal la kurig ata saha ka n daa suhiri Naawuni n yili ŋɔ nti nya ka do so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒe n tooni.
en: Cornelius answered, Four days ago at this same time, three oclock in the afternoon, I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in radiant clothing stood before me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ʒe Gomna Pailɛt tooni, ka Gomna Pailɛt maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Jesus stood before the Roman governor, who questioned him. Are you the king of the Jews? he asked. So you say, answered Jesus.

dag: Di saɣi n-wum niriba ni fiɣisi toondana n-yɛli shɛm naɣila niriba ata bee ayi n-di li shɛhira.
en: Dont accept an accusation made against an elder unless it is confirmed by two or three witnesses.

dag: Ka yi yaannim maa be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka anabinim maa mi, bɛ gba na kul beni?.
en: So where are your ancestors? Do the prophets live forever?.

dag: O zaŋ liɣiri pam mali chaŋ. O ku kuna, naɣila goli muni.
en: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli Bɛri bia Hozia Naa Uzia mini Naa Jɔtam ni Naa Ahaz ni Naa Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ni Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛmana ni m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the Lord s message that came to Hosea son of Beeri during the time that Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah, and Jeroboam son of Joash was king of Israel.

dag: Ka kom zo n-tiɛli n zuɣu, ka n yɛli, N ku be.
en: water flowed over my head. I thought: Im finished.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi ma ŋɔ? Ka bɛ zaa daa chihi ti tuui taba, ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, niriba maa m-muɣi pam daar a.
en: Jesus asked, Who touched me? Everyone denied it, and Peter said, Master, the people are all around you and crowding in on you.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ ʒim; yi ni ti kpaai li mi bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, N fabilimi niŋ naa ni o di lan zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ ka n ti kpi nimaani. .
en: If they say this to you, tell them, I was begging the king not to send me back to the cell in the dungeon under Jonathans house. If I were to go back there, I would die.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo daa kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu ni bɛ naai ba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa na kul bi chɛ; o daa na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Aram from the east and the Philistines from the west— and they devoured Israel with an open mouth. Even then Gods anger didnt turn away; Gods hand was still extended.

dag: Ka anabi so daa yi tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri suhudoo yɛla, anabi maa yɛligu daa yi ti niŋ pali, di saha ka bɛ baŋdi ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim o na ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o biɛhigu shee; chɛliya ka ti jɛm o o napɔntamdigu shee.
en: We said, Let us go to the Lord 's house; let us worship before his throne.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama n yɛn chɛmi ka a be kaman Naawuni la Firawuna sani, ka chɛ ka a mabia Aduna mi nyɛ a daanabi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, See, Ive made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia chɛ ka suhudoo mini yurilim ni yɛda be ti mabihi la zaa ni.
en: May there be peace with the brothers and sisters as well as love with the faith that comes from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka di puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini diribarilim.
en: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You clean the outside of your cup and plate, while the inside is full of what you have gotten by violence and selfishness.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ ti.
en: our enemies curse us.

dag: O mɛla gooni ŋari n soli, ka di chɛ ka n kɔŋ garibu, ka chɛ ka n soli leei liɣa.
en: God has blocked my way to keep me from getting through. He has hidden my path in darkness.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Hal Musa mini Samuɛl yi di ʒe n tooni, n naan ku ŋmaligi n suhu kpa niriba ŋɔ polo. Zaŋmi ba miligi n sani n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.

dag: N ni chɛ ka anabi ŋun be kaman nyini ŋɔ yi bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni na m-be bɛ sani, ka n zaŋ n zilinli niŋ anab maa nol ni, ka o ti yɛri ba n ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa.
en: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.

dag: Zaŋmiya wumpaɣibo mali sara ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ yi ni lo alikauli ni yi zaŋ binshɛŋa ti Zallakudura Naa ti o.
en: Offer God a sacrifice of thanksgiving! Fulfill the promises you made to the Most High!.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi leei tampiŋ nɛli doya, ka bɛ zaŋdi ziŋgbahiri lansi yɛrigiri deeni yi zuɣu. Ka so ti ku lan me yi dabari maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place by the sea for spreading fishing nets! You will not be rebuilt, because I, the Lord , have spoken! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: O ni dih o piɛri kaman piɛgul ni dihir o piɛri shɛm la. O laɣisi piɛbihi niŋ o bɔɣiri ni, ka zaŋ ba buɣi o nyɔɣu zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ manim baalim kuli.
en: He will take care of his flock like a shepherd; he will gather the lambs together and carry them in his arms; he will gently lead their mothers.

dag: ka ti wum salo ni garita ka o bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee niŋdi maa.
en: When he heard the people coming down the road, he asked, What is happening.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima m-be nandaamba sani, di so ni a mini karimbaannim pirigiri bɛ ni ŋmɛri diri neen shɛŋa.
en: Better to be humble with the needy than to divide plunder with the proud.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya shɛb bɔhira, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be.
en: Why should the nations ask, Where is your God.

dag: bee n-kpuɣiri bɛ neem bihibihi. Amaa bɛ lee chɛ ka bɛ bebu kahigi wuhi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim ni yɛlimaŋli ni be shɛb ni, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ yɛla wuhibu la nya jilima bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: they should not steal from them; and they should show their masters that they can be trusted. Then, in everything they do, they will show that the teaching of God our Savior is good.

dag: Ka di simdi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam ni bɛ yɔri Izraɛlnim daalahichi zaa samli tiri ba yim yuuni puuni. Ka Musa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa.
en: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka bɛ ti yɛra, Tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ tiŋgban nɛl la kpalim ŋmanila Idɛn puu. Ka niriba lan pali fɔntin shɛŋa din daa wurim leei dabari la zaa ni, ka bɛ me gooni gil li.
en: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zilima dirimi kaman tinvura zilima la, ka garinsi lɔɣu be bɛ noya ni.
en: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o lan nyɛla ninvuɣ so cheechinim ni pii n-zal o ni o doli ti ka ti tumdi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ti Duuma jilima nyabu zuɣu, ka dimbɔŋɔ wuhi ni ti yuya ni ti sɔŋ ti taba.
en: And besides that, he has been chosen and appointed by the churches to travel with us as we carry out this service of love for the sake of the Lord's glory and in order to show that we want to help.

dag: Yisifu zuliya ni, Manaasa zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Ɛfɔd bia Hanniɛl.
en: from Josephs descendants: of the tribe of the Manassites, a chief, Hanniel, Ephods son.

dag: So yi da o ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, di saha o ni tooi chɛ ka paɣ maa yiŋnim yo o zuɣu ka deeg o. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o tom kɔhi tinzunnim zuɣu, dama o pun niŋ o din bi tuhi.
en: If she doesnt please her master who chose her for himself, then her master must let her be bought back by her family. He has no right to sell her to a foreign people since he has treated her unfairly.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa bi bɔh a ni bɔ ka a leei niŋdi maa?.
en: Son of man, did the people of Israel—those people who always refuse to obey—ask you what you were doing?.

dag: Stiivin daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tipawumlinim yi suhuri ni; yi kul zaɣisirila Naawuni Shia Kasi. Yi yaannim biɛhigu maa ka yi gba kul doli.
en: You stubborn people! In your thoughts and hearing, you are like those who have had no part in Gods covenant! You continuously set yourself against the Holy Spirit, just like your ancestors did.

dag: Dama nyamiya, ŋuna n-nam zoya, ka nam pɔhim. O kahigi din be o suhu ni n-wuhi ninsala. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka yuŋ zibira. O nyɛla ŋun chani gindi dunia ŋɔ ni. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ, Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa!.
en: The one who forms the mountains, creates the wind, makes known his thoughts to humankind, makes the morning darkness, and moves over the heights of the earth— the LORD, the God of heavenly forces is his name!.

dag: Jokitan bihi n-daa nyɛ: Alimɔdad mini Shɛlɛf ni Hazarimavɛt ni Jɛra.
en: The descendants of Joktan were the people of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah.

dag: kaman di ni daa sab ti Duuma zaligu ni shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ zaŋmi bidib tuuli kam ti ti Duuma Naawuni.
en: as it is written in the law of the Lord: Every first-born male is to be dedicated to the Lord.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Mɛkɔna ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: in Ziklag, in Meconah and its villages.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti zali ya ni yi gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ gbinnyaɣinima ka bi doli wuhibu shɛli ti ni daa wuhi ya la.
en: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha, ka Omri bia Ɛhab daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya ʒinila Samaria n-su Izraɛlnim la yuun pisinaayi.
en: In the thirty-eighth year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for twenty-two years.

dag: Haga n-nyɛ Sinai Zoli din be Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ŋmahinli; o lan nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ŋmahinli, dama o min o bihi bela dabitim ni.
en: So Hagar is like Mount Sinai in Arabia. She is a picture of the earthly Jewish city of Jerusalem. This city is a slave, and all its people are slaves to the law.

dag: Yɛlim o ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni ninvuɣ so bɛ ni booni Tiwulli la ni zoog o biɛhigu shee n-yiɣisi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: Tell him that the Lord Almighty says, The man who is called The Branch will flourish where he is and rebuild the Lord 's Temple.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ tum Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa zaa.
en: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.

dag: Ka bɛ daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then they pleaded with Jesus to leave their region.

dag: Ka yɛm yi pooi yi ni so, ŋun suhimi Naawuni ka o ti o li; dama Naawuni nyɛla ŋun tiri sokam ka di galisira, ka bi nyari so taali di puuni.
en: Do any of you need wisdom? Ask God for it. He is generous and enjoys giving to everyone. So he will give you wisdom.

dag: Dama hal so ku lan be nayili, bɛ ni ti zo zaa ka chɛ tiŋ maa. Ka tiŋgula biɛhigu shee mini yiya lu n-dahim zaa n-kul doya sahakam. Ka nimaani leei mɔɣu ni bunsi gɔrim shee ni piɛri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep.

dag: Kpahimi bɛn tumd alahichi la zuɣu ni palɔni din ni chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe bɛn kpalim la.
en: Tell those who sin that they are wrong. Do this in front of the whole church so that the others will have a warning.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tim ti boli Reechɛl mini Liya ni bɛ ka o sanna o ni daa mal o biŋkɔbiri be mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli la.
en: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to meet him in the field where his flocks were.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee sɔŋ ya ka yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ? Ka ŋuni shia n-lee yi yi sanna maa.
en: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N suhir a, di chɛ ti, dama nyini m-mi ti ni yɛn dooni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, leemi ti sowuhira.
en: Please don't leave us, Moses said. You know where we can camp in the wilderness, and you can be our guide.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu bee n-doli alahichinim biɛhigu bee n-doli ansarisi maaniba biɛhigu mali alibarika.
en: The truly happy person doesnt follow wicked advice, doesnt stand on the road of sinners, and doesnt sit with the disrespectful.

dag: O teem a pina zaa yɛla, ka chɛ ka o nini tiɣ a sar shɛŋa zaa a ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim.
en: May he remember all the gifts you have offered. May he accept all your sacrifices. Selah.

dag: A shiri mi, dama di saha bɛ daa pun dɔɣ a ka a mi yuui pam!.
en: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa bɔhi Dauda, Baa n-nyɛ ma ka a zaŋ kpahi kani n sanna? Ka o daa kar o buɣa bahiri Dauda zuɣu.
en: Do you think I'm a dog? Goliath asked. Is that why you've come after me with a stick? He cursed David in the name of the Philistine gods.

dag: Miligim ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ, ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ! Ka bɛ daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Move away from these people so that I can destroy them now. So Moses and Aaron bowed with their faces to the ground.

dag: Viri ni ti te bɛ tɛri nimaani n-nye gala wɔɣi, ka dihiri bɛ bihi maa nimaani. Juri gba ni ti laɣindi nimaani.
en: Owls will build their nests, lay eggs, hatch their young, and care for them there. Vultures will gather there, one after another.

dag: O ni daa yaɣindi li maa ka shɛŋa lu sol zuɣu, ka noonsi kana nti gahim li di.
en: While he was scattering the seed, some of it fell by the road. The birds came and ate all that seed.

dag: amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun kul tumdila o maligumaanitali tuma, dama o kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But Jesus lives forever. He will never stop serving as a priest.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya nam ʒiishe titali din nyɛ zaɣ piɛlli ka lan nya ŋun ʒi nimaani, ka tiŋgbani mini sagbana daa laligi ka chɛ o, ka so bi lan nya li yaha.
en: Then I saw a large white throne. I saw the one who was sitting on the throne. Earth and sky ran away from him and disappeared.

dag: A daa chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi n-galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka a daa zaŋ ba na ti niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ su li la ni.
en: You gave them as many children as there are stars in the sky, and let them conquer and live in the land that you had promised their ancestors to give them.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma! Dama kom paala n nyiŋgoli tariga.
en: Save me, O God! The water is up to my neck;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim nuu ni ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm o yuma anii.
en: This made the Lord angry, so he let Israel be defeated by King Cushan Rishathaim of northern Syria, who ruled Israel eight years and made everyone pay taxes.

dag: Ɛhab daa malila bidibisi pisopɔin, ka bɛ be Samaria. Ka Jɛhu daa sab gbana zaŋ tim Samaria nti ti tiŋ maa nanim mini tiŋ kpamba ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi Ɛhab bidibisi maa n-yɛli.
en: Ahab had sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the rulers and leaders of Jezreel. He also sent the letters to the people who raised Ahabs sons saying.

dag: Amaa n yi ti neei kum ni, n ni daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili.
en: But after I am raised to life, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.

dag: A mini Harannima ni Kannɛnima ni Idɛnnima ni Ashurinima ni Kilimadnim daa niŋdila daabiligu.
en: Haran, Canneh, and Eden were your agents, and also Assyria and Chilmad.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri daa ti paligi pam ka bɛ yɛli, Bolimiya Samsin na ka o ti diɛm wuhi ti. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ sarika ni ti zaŋ Samsin na, ka o daa kana ti diɛm wuhi ba. Bɛ daa chɛ ka o ʒiɛla daantalisi sunsuuni.
en: The people were having a good time at the celebration. So they said, Bring Samson out. We want to make fun of him. So they brought Samson from the prison and made fun of him. They made him stand between the columns in the temple of the god Dagon.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli mi, Ti du m-bala Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, pa bɛ ni jɛmd o luɣ shɛŋa min o bimbina ka Hɛzɛkia daa wurim ka yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Jɛmmiya Naawuni bimbin shɛli din be Jɛrusalɛm la gbin la?.
en: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord 's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o ninni, ka ŋmɛr o nutala, ka shɛb labir o tapaɣisi.
en: Then they spit in his face and beat him. They hit him.

dag: Bɛ daa ʒiɛhira ka jeeni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyu dam kuli, ka bɛ yɛm zaa daa naai la.
en: They staggered and stumbled around like they were drunk. None of their skill was of any help.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ lzraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn ŋmanila chi bubu saha kabɔɣili; di kpalim biɛla ka o daatam kpuɣibu saha paai.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor ready to be trampled down. In a little while her harvest will come.

dag: nyin di nyuri bara n-niŋdi tiwul shɛŋa o ni ŋmahi bahi maa. Ka a yi nyuri bara, nyin baŋmi ni pa nyini ŋun nyɛ tiwulli maa n-sɔŋdi tia maa nyaɣa, amaa di nyaya maa n-sɔŋd a.
en: But dont act as if you are better than those branches that were broken off. You have no reason to be proud of yourself, because you dont give life to the root. The root gives life to you.

dag: nti kpe ŋariŋ ni bɛ baai du Kapɛrinium polo. Ka di daa mali ti zibi ka Yisa na bi ka bɛ sanna.
en: got into a boat, and went back across the lake toward Capernaum. Night came on, and Jesus still had not come to them.

dag: Ka chɛchɛbun duhiriba mini wɔribariba daa pahi dol o chaŋ. Niriba maa daa galisiya pam.
en: Even chariots and horsemen went with him; it was a huge collection of people.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa niŋ a naani di vi; amaa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taari duŋ niŋd a ka di ka daliri la n-di vi.
en: No one who trusts in you will be disappointed. But disappointment will come to those who try to deceive others. They will get nothing.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nandahima mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti maai bɛ suhuri.
en: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!.

dag: Sokam zaa tamla n yɛla, kaman bɛ ni tamdi ŋun kpi yɛla shɛm la, hal n ŋmanila salichee gba.
en: I am forgotten, like Im dead, completely out of mind; I am like a piece of pottery, destroyed.

dag: Mbaye, ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm! N na mi m-be kaman tiŋgban nɛl la Izraɛlnim sani? Bee n na mi m-be kaman zibisim titali ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni shɛm la? Ka wula ka yi yɛra, Ti sula timaŋa, ti ku lan lab a sanna.
en: People of Israel, listen to what I am saying. Have I been like a desert to you, like a dark and dangerous land? Why, then, do you say that you will do as you please, that you will never come back to me?.

dag: ka leei yi Ba, ka yi mi leei m bidibisi mini m bipuɣinsi. Ti Duuma Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-yɛl lala maa.
en: I will be your father, and you shall be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nudirigu tiri, ka tiŋgbani vali ba.
en: You raised your strong hand; earth swallowed them up.

dag: Kamiya n sanna nti zaŋ n naɣikɔra dapua ye n-zaŋ yimaŋ tabili ma m-bɔhim biɛhigu n sani ka nya vuhim; dama n nyɛla tarima zaa.
en: Accept my teaching. Learn from me. I am gentle and humble in spirit. And you will be able to get some rest.

dag: m-pahi fɔn shɛŋa mini tiŋkpan shɛŋa din daa be Manaasa min o zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ daa lee zaŋ li n-ti Ifriim min o zuliya niriba maa la.
en: Many of the border towns of Ephraim were actually in Manassehs borders, but the Ephraimites got the towns and the fields around them.

dag: Ninsal kam ŋun tumdi tuumbiɛri ni nya nahiŋgu mini wahala, Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya;.
en: There will be suffering and pain for all those who do what is evil, for the Jews first and also for the Gentiles.

dag: Dibɔnnim chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu bɛ buɣa duu nti kumda; ka Mɔabnim kumdi Nɛbo mini Mɛdɛba zuɣu; ka sokam pini bɛ zuɣuri ni bɛ teensi.
en: The people of Dibon climb the hill to weep at the shrine. The people of Moab wail in grief over the cities of Nebo and Medeba; they have shaved their heads and their beards in grief.

dag: Di zaa ni ti nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu; ka dapaɣili kam tam diba ayi zuɣu.
en: And so there will be eight boards with their sixteen silver bases, two bases under the first board, two bases under the next board, and so on.

dag: Yi ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa daa nyɛla biɛɣ pihinahi. Dinzuɣu dabisi yini kam yɛn leela yuun muni. Yi ni ʒi yi daalahichi ʒili yuun pihinahi, ka baŋ ni yi ni niŋ shɛm bi tiɣi n nini. .
en: For years you will suffer for your sins. You will know that it is a terrible thing for me to be against you.

dag: Dama bɛ daa ku o suli bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni, ka daa chɛ ka nyuli gbaag o bɛ binnana jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: They angered him with their heathen places of worship, and with their idols they made him furious.

dag: N ku gbihi bee n-ʒeei gom.
en: or close my eyelids.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala, di yi pa lala o ku tooi nya Naawuni nam.
en: Jesus answered, I assure you, unless someone is born anew, its not possible to see Gods kingdom.

dag: A daa zaŋ wain tia Ijipti na nti kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ li sa.
en: You brought a grapevine out of Egypt; you drove out other nations and planted it in their land.

dag: Naawuni, a soli nyɛla din be kasi; wun ŋuni n-lee galisi paai ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: Everything you do, O God, is holy. No god is as great as you.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti shihi biŋgbamdigu din ni chɛ ka o kpe daɣiri ni bee di yi nyɛla ninsal sani ka o nya daɣiri maa, o daɣiri maa yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam;.
en: or if he has touched an unclean animal or person.

dag: Ka o daa lee shini, ka ŋmaligi baalim kul o yiŋa nti tim bol o zɔnim na, ka bol o paɣa Zɛrɛshi na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: But Haman controlled his anger and went home. Then Haman called together his friends and his wife, Zeresh.

dag: Hal maligumaaniba zuɣulana mini ya ŋɔ jintɔriba zaa ni tooi di ma shɛhira, dama bɛ sani ka n daa deei gbana n-chani ni n ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Damaskus la, ka gbahi bɛn doli soli ŋɔ n-lo ba mihi tahi Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ na ka bɛ ti darigi bɛ tiba.
en: The High Priest and the whole Council can prove that I am telling the truth. I received from them letters written to fellow Jews in Damascus, so I went there to arrest these people and bring them back in chains to Jerusalem to be punished.

dag: dama dina n-ni chɛ ka ti Duuma niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tim Yisa Masia so o ni daa pun lo ni o ni tim yi sanna la.
en: Then the Lord will give you times of spiritual rest. He will send you Jesus, the one he chose to be the Messiah.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihinahi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Kenan had more children.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi pa di olivi tihi dari pundi maa zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka lan dooi shɛli pa chɛrubinim mini abie tihi la gba zuɣu.
en: The doors were decorated with carved figures of winged creatures, palm trees, and flowers. The doors, the winged creatures, and the palm trees were covered with gold.

dag: Bɛ daa pun nyala o mini Trɔfimus Ɛfɛsus tiŋbia la tiŋ puuni, ka tɛhi ni Pool ʒi o kala Naawuni jɛmbu duu na.
en: Some of them thought that Paul had brought Trophimus from Ephesus into the temple, because they had seen them together in the city.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ. Ka o daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ kurigu pinaayi saha ni kurig ata saha ti nya shɛba n-lan yɛli bɛ gba lala.
en: So they went. Then at twelve o'clock and again at three o'clock he did the same thing.

dag: Ka Stiivin garigi yɛli, M banim mini m mabihi, wummiya! Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka na bi yiɣisi looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ daa yi o zuɣu.
en: Stephen responded, Brothers and fathers, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he settled in Haran.

dag: Sool mam daa beni ka o yuli booni Rizipa. O daa nyɛla Aiya bipuɣiŋga, ka Ishibɔshɛt daa ti bɔhi Abinɛr, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ m ba mam maa dɔni.
en: Now Saul had a secondary wife named Rizpah, Aiahs daughter. Ishbosheth said to Abner, Why have you had sex with my fathers secondary wife.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Filistianim maa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei bɛ ni ku shɛb maa nɛma, ka daa nya ka Sool min o bidibis ata maa lu n-dola Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The day after the battle the Philistines went to plunder the corpses, and they found the bodies of Saul and his three sons lying on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Dama a noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhiri a tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli ka a yula yɛŋkiŋkabina yɛtɔɣa.
en: What you say clearly shows your sin. Job, you are trying to hide your sin by using clever words.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli Pita, Malim shili ka zaŋ a namda piri. Ka o niŋ lala. Ka o lan yɛl o, Zaŋm a binyɛrigu ye n-doli ma.
en: Then the angel said, Tighten your belt and put on your sandals. Peter did so, and the angel said, Put your cloak around you and come with me.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa kul kpalim be nayili maa hal ti paai Naa Sairus nam dibu yuun tuuli saha.
en: And Daniel stayed in the kings service until the first year of King Cyrus.

dag: ka pɔb o nina ka yɛl o, A daanabitali puuni, wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: They blindfolded him and asked him repeatedly, Prophesy! Who hit you.

dag: Ka Saimɔn kuhi yɛli, Suhim ti Duuma ti ma, ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa miligi n zuɣu.
en: Simon said to Peter and John, Please pray to the Lord for me, so that none of these things you spoke of will happen to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli ye situra ʒiya; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: They came to Jesus, and they saw the man who had the many evil spirits. He was sitting down and was wearing clothes. He was in his right mind again. When they saw this, they were afraid.

dag: ka pihi kuɣa sɔŋ n-lihi nya bulah ayi maa sunsuuni, kuɣ yini ni ti nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka kuɣ yini ti nyɛ Azazɛl dini.
en: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ni ti kpe ŋariŋ n-yiɣisi chaŋ Itali, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool m-pahi dansarika shɛb zuɣu n-ti sapashin so ŋun yuli daa booni Julius. O daa sula tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Naa Siiza Agasitus Maŋmaŋ Tɔbbihi la fukumsi.
en: When it was decided that we should sail to Italy, they handed Paul and some other prisoners over to Julius, an officer in the Roman army regiment called The Emperor's Regiment.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Dauda tɔbutuhiri kpamba, bɛ mini Izraɛlnim zaa n-daa be Dauda kɔbili ni sɔŋd o pam o nam maa ni, ka o nyɛ naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo la.
en: These are the commanders of Davids warriors who continued to support him while he was king. Together with all Israel, they made him king, as the LORD had promised Israel.

dag: Ka di ti leei shihirili shɛli din yɛn lo yi nuu ni, ka be yi gbɛri zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi teeri di yɛla din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ zaligu maa yɛla kul be yi noya ni, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu ka o daa zaŋ yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: It will be a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead so that you will often discuss the LORDs Instruction, for the LORD brought you out of Egypt with great power.

dag: dama niriba pam suhuri ni tɛha ni ti yi palo o zuɣu. Ka suhusaɣiŋgu ti ŋma amaŋmaŋ gba suhu kaman takɔb la.
en: So the secret thoughts of many will be made known. And the things that happen will be painful for you—like a sword cutting through your heart.

dag: Ka Shɛm mini Jafɛt daa kpuɣi kparibu m-pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu n-tirisi bɛ nyaaŋa kpe nti zaŋ li pa bɛ ba zuɣu, ka bi nya bɛ ba zaɣim.
en: Shem and Japheth took a robe, threw it over their shoulders, walked backward, and covered their naked father without looking at him because they turned away.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N lan yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, Daadam Bia gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa Naawuni malaikanim sani;.
en: I tell you, if you stand before others and are willing to say you believe in me, then I will say that you belong to me. I will say this in the presence of Gods angels.

dag: Bɛ bari ma la zana n soli zuɣu. N nandahima maa yaɣiya. Bɛ gbila bɔɣili sɔŋ n soli zuɣu, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee lan ŋmaligi lu di ni.
en: My enemies set a trap for my feet to bring me down. They dug a deep pit to catch me, but they fell into it. Selah.

dag: Ka n tɛhi ni a yihi ma la a sani bahi, ka n ku lan nya a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: So I said, I have been driven away from your sight. Will I ever again look on your holy temple?.

dag: M muɣisigu puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord . He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ kaman n ni niŋ shɛm maa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini pɔbi yi zuɣusaa naŋgbampiba, yi mi di ti di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: You will do as I have done. You will neither cover your upper lip nor eat in human company.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o yihi luɣ kasi shee maa daɣiri ni ni Izraɛlnim daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi la zaa zuɣu; ka di simdi ka o niŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili din be bɛ sani bɛ daɣiri tuma ni maa lala.
en: In this way he will perform the ritual to purify the Most Holy Place from the uncleanness of the people of Israel and from all their sins. He must do this to the Tent, because it stands in the middle of the camp, which is ritually unclean.

dag: N daa da daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi daba n yiŋ puuni. Ka n daa lan mali niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ n tooni be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I bought men and women slaves, and there were slaves born in my house. I owned many great things. I had herds of cattle and flocks of sheep. I owned more things than any other person in Jerusalem did.

dag: Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, dama n zaɣis o yɛligu. Amaa zuliya kam zaa, wummiya, nyamiya n ni diri wahala shɛm. Bɛ gbahi m paɣisara mini n nachimba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: But the Lord is just, for I have disobeyed him. Listen to me, people everywhere; look at me in my pain. My young men and women have been taken away captive.

dag: Ka n daa lan zaŋ Araba gba mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili mini di duli zaŋ Kinɛrɛt ni Araba Teeku din nyɛ Teeku Kpiŋ la ni Pisiga zo lɔŋ din be wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: On the west their territory extended to the Jordan River, from Lake Galilee in the north down to the Dead Sea in the south and to the foot of Mount Pisgah on the east.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Jɔtam bia Naa Ahaz mi daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa kuli nti yɛl o taba Hanania mini Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So Daniel went to his house. He explained the whole story to his friends Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm n-niŋ yuun pihinunaayi. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛkolia.
en: He was years old when he became king, and he ruled for fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Nadab Jɛrɔbɔam bia daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya su Izraɛlnim la yuma ayi.
en: During Asas second year as king of Judah, Jeroboams son Nadab became king of Israel. Nadab ruled over Israel for two years.

dag: Yinim bɛn daa ʒe n niriba ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi suhuri paligi, ka yi ŋumda kaman naɣisaa n-nɔri buri chi la bee n-kuhiri kaman yuri la.
en: Sure, you gloat and rejoice, you plunderers of my possession. Sure, you dance around like a calf and neigh like a stallion.

dag: Zab piɛla nyɛla jilima nam zuɣupiligu, Wuntizɔbo biɛhigu puuni ka di yirina.
en: Gray hair is a crown of glory on people who have lived good lives. It is earned by living right.

dag: Maata ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ o tizo Mariama sani nti sɔɣi yɛl o, Karimba kana, ka boon a.
en: After Martha said this, she went back and called her sister Mary privately. The Teacher is here, she told her, and is asking for you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni bi wumdi kuhigu din ka buchi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa baɣa ka di ni.
en: It is useless for them to cry out; Almighty God does not see or hear them.

dag: Ka bidibbihi mini bipuɣimbihi ni doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri diɛmda.
en: And the streets will again be full of boys and girls playing.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ Uzia ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was years old, and made him king after his father Amaziah.

dag: Naawuni ni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛm m-bala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ mini zuɣusaa dahin shɛli.
en: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created. On the day the LORD God made earth and sky.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka bi saɣi ka naɣ yɛli ma mi, Di saɣiya, di lan yɛli ma yɛlli ŋɔ yaha.
en: But because of you people the Lord was angry with me and would not listen. Instead, he said, That's enough! Don't mention this again!.

dag: dama di bemi kaman so ni daa yɛli la: O zuɣu ka ti be ka damda, ka kul be ŋɔ. Di lan bemi kaman yi baŋdib shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la, Ti gba shiri yila Naawuni ni na.
en: and he gives us the power to live, to move, and to be who we are. We are his children, just as some of your poets have said.

dag: Di saha ka Sool bipuɣiŋga ŋun pah ayi ka o yuli daa booni Mikal la suhu daa yu Dauda pam, ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla, ka di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: Saul's daughter Michal, however, fell in love with David, and when Saul heard of this, he was pleased.

dag: ka daa kpihi buɣim din mali dabiɛm, ka daa tiligi takɔb kum ni. Bɛ daa nya kpiɔŋ bɛ gbariginsim saha. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhir biinsi bɛn tuhi nyaŋ tinzun tinsi tɔbbihi.
en: put out raging fires, escaped from the edge of the sword, found strength in weakness, were mighty in war, and routed foreign armies.

dag: Yawɛ, a nirilim niŋbu puuni, ka a daa ba ma zali kaman zo shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ la; a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma, ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam.
en: Because it pleased you, LORD, you made me a strong mountain. But then you hid your presence. I was terrified.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi mini di kpam din zaa be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: the two kidneys and the fat around them at the loins; and the lobe on the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys.

dag: N daa bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛŋa din ni sɔŋ ya, amaa ka daa zaŋ li wuhi ya niriba ni mini yili kam ni.
en: You know that I did not hold back anything that would be of help to you as I preached and taught in public and in your homes.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi yɔhim yimaŋ yɛra, Babilɔnnim maa shiri zoya ka chɛ ti, dama bɛ ku zo ka chɛn ya.
en: This is what the Lord says: People of Jerusalem, dont fool yourselves. Dont say to yourselves, The army of Babylon will surely leave us alone. They will not.

dag: ka gbala yɔhi; ka kpiimba pam bɛn daa nyɛ wuntizɔriba la neei kum ni.
en: the graves broke open, and many of God's people who had died were raised to life.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o zali ni bɛ be kaman o Bia la, ka di chɛ ka o Bia maa leei bikpɛma o mabihi pam ni.
en: We know this because God knew them in advance, and he decided in advance that they would be conformed to the image of his Son. That way his Son would be the first of many brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Ainim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa dindali maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pinaayi.
en: Joshua kept his spear pointed at Ai and did not put it down until every person there had been killed. The whole population of Ai was killed that day—twelve thousand men and women.

dag: Bimɔɣiriga ni ti be gariŋga voli gbini diɛmda, ka bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni ti zaŋ o nuu tim bahiga voli ni.
en: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N nya ka Sintani yi zuɣusaa luna kaman saa n-nyaɣisi la.
en: Jesus told them: I saw Satan fall from heaven like a flash of lightning.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa ysɛli Anabi Hosea litaafi ni: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa n niriba, n ni boli ba, N niriba. Ka zuliya shɛb n ni bi yura, n ni boli ba, N ninvuɣ yurisi.
en: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.

dag: Di zɔnya yi dimnim dabiɛm! Kul maliya suhukpeeni ka di kahigi wuhi ba ni bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, amaa ka yinim ti tiligi, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nasara.
en: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋ yɛda ka suhi binshɛɣukam, yi ni nya li.
en: If you believe, you will get anything you ask for in prayer.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa lab maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim maa sani, ka bɛ ti bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ʒi o na.
en: The guards returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked, Why didnt you bring him.

dag: N ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla saha shɛli maa, ka bula so daa yi wulinluhili polo na n-kul kpaŋ zɔri yomyom hal ka o naba bi shihiri tiŋ gba. Ka o daa mali yil gahindili ka di sa o nina ayi sunsuuni.
en: While I was wondering what this meant, a goat came rushing out of the west, moving so fast that his feet didn't touch the ground. He had one prominent horn between his eyes.

dag: ŋun zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni, ka chɛ ka n leei tumo ni n wuhi zuliya kam zaa ka bɛ deeg o noli n-niŋ yɛda o yuli zuɣu la.
en: Through him God gave me the privilege of being an apostle for the sake of Christ, in order to lead people of all nations to believe and obey.

dag: Bɛ ni bi nyari saɣisigu zuɣu ka bɛ kpira, ka bɛ jɛrilim din galisi zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zuɣuri kpi.
en: They die because they have no self-control. Their utter stupidity will send them to their graves.

dag: hal n ni bi tum taali, ka kul suhiri Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga maa zaa yoli.
en: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa kpalim zani puu maa sunsuuni, ka bɛ zabi di zuɣu n-ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa tiligi ba ni nasara dibu tital la.
en: so he and his men took a stand in the middle of the field and fought the Philistines. The Lord gave him a great victory.

dag: ka yɛli ni di simdi ka bɛ wuhi Judanima ni di sabi Jashar litaafi puuni yɛli.
en: David told his men to teach the song to the people of Judah. This song is called The Bow, and it is written in the Book of Jashar .

dag: Bɛ zaŋla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni wuɣi tampiɛl viɛl shɛli niŋ a ŋariŋ tani, ka di nyɛ a tuuta. Ka a zuɣusaa bimparigu din nyɛ zaɣ sabinli mini zaɣ ʒee la yi Ɛlisha teeku duli na.
en: For your sail, they used colorful linen made in Egypt. That sail was your flag. The coverings over your cabin were blue and purple. They came from the coast of Cyprus.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ soli maa, mani n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, mani n-lan nyɛ nyɛvili; ka so ku tooi chaŋ m Ba sani, ka pa ni o paala mani.
en: I am the way, the truth, and the life! Jesus answered. Without me, no one can go to the Father.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita, ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ata, ka o daa zaŋ di zaa niŋ Lɛbanɔn dakuɣuri yil la ni.
en: He also made smaller gold shields that weighed almost two kilograms, and he put these shields in his palace in Forest Hall.

dag: hal ka deei gbana maligumaaniba kpamba sani n-ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛnkam dol a.
en: Now he has come here to Damascus. The leading priests have given him the power to arrest all people who trust in you. .

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti lo tɔbu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni yi tuhi yi dimnim bɛn muɣisiri ya, di saha yin piɛbimiya kika biɛɣu, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ teei yi yɛla, ka tiligi ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni.
en: When you are at war in your land, defending yourselves against an enemy who has attacked you, sound the signal for battle on these trumpets. I, the Lord your God, will help you and save you from your enemies.

dag: O ni daa ka ti sanna maa o daa zaŋla Pool shɛlɔrigu lo omaŋmaŋ nuhi min o naba ka yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, Lala ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ti yɛn lo ninvuɣ so ŋun su shɛlɔrigu ŋɔ n-zaŋ o niŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He came to us and borrowed Pauls belt. He used it to tie his own hands and feet. He said, The Holy Spirit tells me, This is how the Jews in Jerusalem will tie up the man who wears this belt. Then they will hand him over to people who dont know God.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa suhi alibarika niŋ Kalɛb ni; ka zaŋ Hiburɔn ti ŋun Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la ni o su li.
en: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti vuhi pam bahi mɔri zuɣu, di kuurimi, ka tipum kpahiri lura; yɛlimaŋli, ninsalinim shiri ŋmanila mɔri.
en: Grass withers and flowers fade when the Lord sends the wind blowing over them. People are no more enduring than grass.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ŋmaai Izraɛl zuɣu ni o nyoli kaman kpikpal tia wulli bee gbiŋgbaŋ la bahi dahin yini.
en: In a single day the Lord will punish Israel's leaders and its people; he will cut them off, head and tail.

dag: Ka Pool daa mirig o nina kpa jintɔriba maa ka yɛli, M mabihi, m bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: Paul stared at the council and said, Brothers, I have lived my life with an altogether clear conscience right up to this very day.

dag: Ka ti lan mi ni Naawuni Bia daa kana nti ti ti la baŋsim ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli; ka ti nyɛla bɛn be Naawuni maŋli ni o Bia Yisa Masia puuni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli, ka lan nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding. So now we can know the one who is true, and we live in that true God. We are in his Son, Jesus Christ. He is the true God, and he is eternal life.

dag: O chɛ ka n niŋgbuŋ nya wahala, ka kabi n kɔba.
en: He has left my flesh open and raw, and has broken my bones.

dag: N ni yihi ya zuliyanim maa ni mini tiŋgbɔna maa zaa ni n-zaŋ ya labisi yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: I will take you out of those nations, gather you together, and bring you back to your own land.

dag: Yinim zoomba ŋɔ, bina ayi maa ni dini n-lee gari di kpee: Sara maa bee bimbini din chɛ ka sara maa be kasi maa?.
en: How blind you are! Which is the more important, the gift or the altar which makes the gift holy?.

dag: Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛbat bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha ka Abijam daa leei Juda naa.
en: Abijam became king of Judah in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Nebats son.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba dii gbaai kumsi.
en: Jesus cried.

dag: mini Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi ni o tizo Jɔn, o ni daa pa shɛb mi yupaa Bɔanɛjiiz la.
en: James and John, Zebedees sons, whom he nicknamed Boanerges, which means sons of Thunder.

dag: Kpuɣim a kpan titali min a kpam bila n-lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kariti doli ma la zuɣu; ka yɛli ma, Mani n-nyɛ a tiligira.
en: Use your spear and ax against those who are out to get me! Say to me: Im your salvation.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi; o daalahiziba tuma la zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tuumbiɛri taali ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu. Yi nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri. Yi nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ, ka lɛb yi nyaaŋa bir o!.
en: Doom! Sinful nation, people weighed down with crimes, evildoing offspring, corrupt children! They have abandoned the LORD, despised the holy one of Israel; they turned their backs on God.

dag: Di chɛ ka a baɣa be kurimbuni lahibaya din bi luri Naawuni sizuura ka nyɛ din pa yɛlimaŋli la ni. Kul zaŋm amaŋ niŋla wuntia soli yɛla bɔhimbu ni.
en: People tell silly stories that dont agree with Gods truth. Dont follow what these stories teach. But teach yourself to be devoted to God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka ŋumdi kaman gbuɣimbihi la.
en: Like lions they will roar together; they will growl like lions cubs.

dag: Ka o daa bɔri ni o baŋ Yisa, amaa ka salo zoosim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kɔŋ o nyabu, dama ŋun Zakius daa nyɛla ninvuɣ jia.
en: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but, being a short man, he couldnt because of the crowd.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha din daa nyɛ Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia mi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha la, ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa kana ti teei gili Samarianima.
en: Assyrias King Shalmaneser marched against Samaria and attacked it in the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Israels King Hoshea, Elahs son.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa maa di na kul bela n suhu ni, ka Ribɛka paana, ka o koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, ka o gari siɣi kɔbiliga maa ni ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma kom ka n nyu.
en: Before I finished praying, Rebekah came out to the well to get water. She had her water jar on her shoulder as she went to get water from the well. I asked her to give me some water.

dag: A ŋmanila ŋmani ŋun be tampima voya ni. Chɛ ka n nya a ninni tampima voya maa ni. Chɛ ka n wum a kukoli, dama a kukoli viɛli pam, ka a ninni viɛli pam.
en: My dove, hiding in the caves high on the cliff, hidden here on the mountain, let me see you, let me hear your voice. Your voice is so pleasant, and you are so beautiful!.

dag: Zoya ni gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ gil o niriba, pumpɔŋɔ hal ni sahakam.
en: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.

dag: N daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka n lee bi baŋ di gbinni. Di zuɣu ka n daa bɔh o, Ndana, ka wula ka di zaa ti yɛn bahindi.
en: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, Sir, how will it all end? The angel in my vision then replied:.

dag: Dinzuɣu doli ninvuɣ suma soli, ka doli wuntizɔriba soli.
en: Wisdom will help you follow the example of good people and stay on the right path.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb ni nyɛla ninkuunsinima mini halikpɛmanima ni munaafichinima ni bɛn bi gbaari bɛmaŋa ni ninvuɣ yarisi ni bɛn je zaɣ suŋ.
en: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.

dag: A daabiligu maa ni daa ti yɛligi, a daa zaŋla gadama kpɛh a kɔbili ni, ka tum alahichi, dinzuɣu ka n kar a Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu bahi kaman daɣiri bini maa, ka chɛrubi ŋun daa gul a maa mi kar a yihi buɣim kuɣa maa ni.
en: You were busy buying and selling, and this led you to violence and sin. So I forced you to leave my holy mountain, and the angel who guarded you drove you away from the sparkling gems.

dag: Yawɛ yuri Jɛrusalɛm gari tin shɛŋa din zaa be Izraɛl.
en: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.

dag: Amaa kumiya ba. Yinima n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni be tooni bɛ kubu maa ni, ka sokam zaa naanyi kana ti pahi.
en: Instead, you must execute them. Your own hand must be against them from the beginning of the execution; the hand of all the people will be involved at the end.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zaɣ biɛɣu ni lu lala nir zuɣu libig o n-tum o barina saha biɛla puuni ka di ka yɛtɔɣa.
en: But they will be punished. Disaster will strike, and they will be destroyed. There will be no one to help them.

dag: Dama naa ni wum n fabila maa ka fa m mini m bia ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔr ni o ku ti n-kpihim ti birili Naawuni ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni la nuu ni bahi.
en: In fact, I knew that you would listen and save my son and me from those who want to take the land that God gave us.

dag: Amaa di ni kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣa mini yuya ni yimaŋmaŋ zaligu yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku di di saria. Yimaŋmaŋ malimiya li.
en: But since it is an argument about words and names and your own law, you yourselves must settle it. I will not be the judge of such things.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ni mani m-bɔŋɔ; dinzuɣu yi yi bɔrila mani, yin chɛ ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa chaŋ.
en: Jesus answered, I told you, I Am. If you are looking for me, then let these people go.

dag: Yi ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, amaa yi ti ku su ba, dama bɛ ni ti gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ.
en: You will have sons and daughters. But you will not be able to keep them, because they will be captured and taken away.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garigi paɣ maa ni bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa zaa; ka shɛli daa kani ka naa kɔŋ li kahigi wuh o.
en: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tinima bee malaika so ŋun yi alizanda ni na yi yihi lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ ti ni daa pun yihi shɛli waazu tin ya la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu tuhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ni Anduru bɔh o ashilɔni.
en: Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple. Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately.

dag: Yi mi ni Stɛfanas yiŋnima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui niŋ Yisa yɛda Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu tuma ni. M mabihi, n suhiri ya.
en: You know about Stephanas and his family; they are the first Christian converts in Achaia and have given themselves to the service of God's people. I beg you, my friends.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ti Sinai, Yi be zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka di yuui saɣi lala.
en: At Mount Horeb the Lord our God spoke to us. He said, You have stayed at this mountain long enough.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛb ti mmaŋa, ka bɛ kul ni yiini yila paɣiri ma.
en: this people whom I formed for myself, who will recount my praise.

dag: Laligim ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la; di nyɛla din kariti niriba Naawuni sani tahiri katiŋa.
en: Stay away from people who talk about useless things that are not from God. That kind of talk will lead a person more and more against God.

dag: Iso ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa lan booni so Ɛdom la zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the descendants of Esau, also called Edom.

dag: Ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a. Kɔhim a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: When Jesus heard this, he said, There is one thing you still need to do. Go and sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋ ni nyini ni bahi yoli; a ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe a yim yoli.
en: Those who abandon you will certainly perish; you will destroy those who are unfaithful to you.

dag: N yi ti wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.

dag: Niriba maa mini farigudeeriba ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni, dama bɛn daa pun deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani;.
en: All the people heard him; they and especially the tax collectors were the ones who had obeyed God's righteous demands and had been baptized by John.

dag: bee so binshɛli yi bɔrigi ka o pihi li ka ŋma ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ di polo bee m-pɔri ʒiri pɔri zaŋ chaŋ niriba ni tumdi binshɛŋa zaa ka di nyɛ alahichi polo.
en: when you find something that was lost and lie about having it; when you fail to keep a promise; or when you do any other bad things like these.

dag: Amaa sanʒiɛɣu n-lee ni ti ʒe ti ti bahi tiŋgban bil din be kom sunsuuni zuɣu.
en: But we will crash on an island.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yiko puuni o kuri wɔɣira. O yi tum o tuma, ninvuɣ biɛri kpirimi.
en: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ bidibilim n-tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknima, ka daa fa Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi liriti ba fari bɛ nɛma la nuu ni bahi.
en: Saul was very brave. He saved Israel from all the enemies who tried to take things from the Israelites. He even defeated the Amalekites.

dag: Ka naa daa ti chaŋ Gibiɔn ni o ti mali sara shɛli nimaani, dama nimaani n-daa nyɛ sara maligu shee din galisi pam. Sulemaana daa yi zaŋdila bɛ ni mali sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bin tuhili m-maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: On one occasion he went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices because that was where the most famous altar was. He had offered hundreds of burnt offerings there in the past.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Mara n-chaŋ Ɛlim. Kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin n-daa be Ɛlim maa, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani.
en: They marched from Marah and arrived at Elim. At Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees and they camped there.

dag: bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili dukpina maa zaa gili, ka dur ata maa zaa daa mali takɔriti ti kpa. Di takɔriti maa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔbia polo, bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili di tiŋ polo gili hal ti taɣi di takɔriti.
en: had wood paneling on all the walls. All the windows and doors had wood trim around them. By the doorway, the Temple had wood paneling from the floor up to the windows and up to the part of the wall.

dag: yi ni yɛn mali sara shɛli ka n deei li nyɛla yi bo binlɔɣu ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa, naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee bulaa.
en: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.

dag: N kul je ba la jɛri maŋli; n zaŋ ba leela n dimnima.
en: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa zaa daa ka Jɛrimia sanna nti bɔh o; ka o garigi yɛli ba kaman naa ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bi lan bɔh o shɛli, dama bɛ daa bi wum bɛ daalizama maa.
en: Then all the officials approached Jeremiah to question him. And he responded exactly as the king had instructed him. So they stopped interrogating him because the conversation between the king and Jeremiah hadnt been overheard.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi ya yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa, ka laɣim ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa na nti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ tin ya.
en: But you must tell those people that the Lord GOD will bring them back. I have scattered you among many nations, but I will gather you together and bring you back from those nations. I will give the land of Israel back to you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o daalibarika yi Ziɔn na paai ya.
en: May the Lord , who made heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
