dag: Ka niriba daa ʒiri barinim bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu mini bɛ daamaŋkanim ni na nti sɔŋdi sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi ni Pita ti gariti ka o shilinshia mahim lee lu bɛ ni shɛb zuɣu.
en: As a result of what the apostles were doing, sick people were carried out into the streets and placed on beds and mats so that at least Peter's shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.

dag: Chɛliya ka n yili yilli ŋɔ ka yi wum, di nyɛla n yura min o tihi puu yilli: N yura m-mal o tihi puu ka di be daboli din tiŋgbani vuhiri zuɣu.
en: Listen while I sing you this song, a song of my friend and his vineyard: My friend had a vineyard on a very fertile hill.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni so yi bɔri alibarika, Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ n-ni niŋ alibarika maa niŋ o ni. Ka ŋunkam mi yɛn po pɔri, ŋun pom li dalim la Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim maa. Dama n tam yɛl shɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla. Di zaa yiɣiya ka firi.
en: Those who pronounce a blessing in the land will do so by the God called Amen; those who make a solemn pledge in the land will do so by the God called Amen. Past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my sight.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ba yi di nyɛ Naawuni yi naan yuri ma, dama o sani ka n yina; pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka n kana, amaa ŋun Naawuni n-tim ma na.
en: Jesus said to them, If God were really your Father, you would love me. I came from God, and now I am here. I did not come by my own authority. God sent me.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa daa chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ yiŋ din daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada killed Joab, and he was buried near his home in the desert.

dag: Ti lan wuhiri li ti biɛr kasi puuni mini baŋsim ni ni suɣilo dibu ni ni nirilim niŋbu ni ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yurilim maŋli ni.
en: We displayed purity, knowledge, patience, and generosity. We served with the Holy Spirit, genuine love.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri pam niŋdi puri ka di maara, ka chɛ ka vuɣisi doya baalim, ka sakom chɛ ka di bala, ka bimbilli kam zoora.
en: Drenching the earths furrows, leveling its ridges, you soften it with rain showers; you bless its growth.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yawɛ daa yɛli nyini n dan Musa ni a pihim kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari Izraɛlnima. Yawɛ daa lan yɛli nyini n dana ni a zaŋm ti mabia Zɛlɔfɛhad tarili ti o bipuɣinsi.
en: They said, The Lord commanded you to distribute the land to the people of Israel by drawing lots. He also commanded you to give the property of our relative Zelophehad to his daughters.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin: Yisifu ŋun daa pun bela Ijipti.
en: Another son, Joseph, was already in Egypt. So Jacobs whole family was with him in Egypt— descendants in all.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Lari nyɛla jɛrilim, ka nyaɣisim bɔbu mi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: It is foolish to laugh all the time. Having fun does not do any good.

dag: Dama ŋunkam bo n-nya ma, o nya nyɛvili, ka Yawɛ ni niŋ o nirilim.
en: Those who find me find life; they gain favor from the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka saa kum ka mi dindali maa. Ka Yawɛ mini Samuɛl yɛla daa gbahi niriba maa zaa dabiɛm pam.
en: So Samuel prayed to the Lord . That same day the Lord sent thunder and rain. And the people became very afraid of the Lord and Samuel.

dag: A ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim neesim din ni kahig a soli wuhi ba, ka duh a niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: A light to reveal your will to the Gentiles and bring glory to your people Israel.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ku Chɛmɔshi niriba, ka gbahi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi daba chaŋ.
en: How terrible for you, Moab; the people of Chemosh have perished. Your sons have been carried off; your daughters have been taken captive.

dag: Mɔri shiri kuura, ka tipum kpahiri lura, amaa ti Naawuni maa ŋun yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Grass dies and flowers fall, but the word of our God lasts forever.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: These were the family groups from the tribe of Judah. The total number of men was .

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya so sani fɔŋ ni ti yɛl o, Ti karimba n-tim ti na ni ti ti yɛl a ni o saha miriya; ka o bɔri ni o min o nyaandoliba puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ a yili ŋɔ. .
en: Go to a certain man in the city, he said to them, and tell him: The Teacher says, My hour has come; my disciples and I will celebrate the Passover at your house.

dag: Ka bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kulina maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm. Ka Ɛzra daa pii daŋ kam zuɣulaannim ni niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ sab bɛ yuya sɔŋ. Ka bɛ daa piligi yɛlli maa vihibu gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali.
en: Then the returned exiles did so. Ezra the priest chose certain men, heads of families, each representing their family houses. Each of them was designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to examine the matter.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛlabihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You must also give the right amount of grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai Sirakus n-zani nimaani niŋ daba ata.
en: We stopped at the city of Syracuse. We stayed there three days and then left.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ; nyamiya, ŋun yi n nyaaŋa maa paana.
en: Get up! Let's go. The one who will betray me is already here.

dag: A daa bi dolila bɛ naba n-tum bɛ ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa kɔŋko, amaa saha biɛla ka a daa zaŋ tum din bie n-gari bɛ dini a soya zaa ni.
en: Were you satisfied to follow in their footsteps and copy their disgusting actions? No, in only a little while you were acting worse than they were in everything you did.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Gɔg yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, Mortal man, denounce Gog, the chief ruler of the nations of Meshech and Tubal, and tell him that I am his enemy.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, din kariya ni n niŋ lala. N ni tooi nyu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima chaŋ ŋɔ ʒim? Dinzuɣu ka o daa bi nyu kom maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala.
en: The LORD forbid that I should do that, he said. Isnt this the blood of men who risked their lives? So he refused to drink it. These were the kinds of things the three warriors did.

dag: Di zaŋya bindira dibu yɛla saɣim Naawuni tuma. Binshɛli kani n-chihiri dibu, amaa di nyɛla taali ni so chɛ ka o ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka o tab lu.
en: Dont destroy what God has done because of food. All food is acceptable, but its a bad thing if it trips someone else.

dag: Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali, ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ.
en: Since it was late in the afternoon on Preparation Day, just before the Sabbath.

dag: ka di yi nyɛla niriba sɔŋbu, chɛliya ka ti sɔŋm ba. Ka ŋun nyɛ karimba, ŋun wuhima;.
en: Whoever has the gift of serving should serve. Whoever has the gift of teaching should teach.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣir a; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: I praise you, Lord ! Teach me your laws.

dag: Asha zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Naftali zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Manaasa zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Asher: , from the tribe of Naphtali: , from the tribe of Manasseh: .

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N yaaŋa, teemi ni a ni daa be a nyɛvil ni la, a daa nyar a suhu yubu, ka Lazarɔs mi daa nyari wahala, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o suhu maaya, ka a mi be azaaba ni.
en: Abraham answered, My friend, remember that while you lived, you had everything good, and Lazarus had everything bad. Now he is happy, and you are in pain.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni n-yɛli ni bɛ kali ma pahila tuumbiɛrinim ni la ni bahi niŋ pali m bebu ni; dama di kpala talahi ni di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm maa niŋ pali.
en: I tell you that this scripture must be fulfilled in relation to me: And he was counted among criminals .Indeed, whats written about me is nearing completion.

dag: Dama alɔbo n-lu n zuɣu dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka n nyari tibidarigibo asiba kam.
en: O God, you have made me suffer all day long; every morning you have punished me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa siɣi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu na, ka sagbani maa daa limsi li hal ni daba ayɔbu; dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka o daa boli Musa sagbani maa ni.
en: The LORDs glorious presence settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it for six days. On the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from the cloud.

dag: Mani n-daa yi piiri bɛ ni bɔri shɛli tiri ba. Mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. N daa bemi kaman naa m-be o tɔbbihi san la, ka be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun maari bɛn fabindi suhuri la.
en: I was their leader and made decisions about their future. I was like a king among his troops, comforting those who were sad.

dag: Yi ni chani bɔri mamanim maa, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! Lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi wuhi paɣ yoya yi soya.
en: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di tamya bin yini din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti Duuma sani, dahin yini nyɛla kaman yuun tuhili, ka yuun tuhili mi nyɛ kaman dahin yini.
en: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as , years, and , years is the same as one day.

dag: dabisi shɛli din kanna ni di ti di Filistianim zaa ka mɔŋ Taainim mini Sidɔnnim sɔŋsim shɛŋa din kpalim la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ yɛn kula Filistianim bɛn kpalim be Kriit teeku duli la.
en: You refugees from Crete, your time has now come, and I will destroy you. None of you will be left to help the cities of Tyre and Sidon.

dag: N ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa la niŋya, ka yi ni saɣi yɛli ni n ni daa yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn yɛli ya la yɛl pala, di nyɛla ashili yɛl shɛŋa yi ni na ʒi.
en: All I foretold has now taken place; you have to admit my predictions were right. Now I will tell you of new things to come, events that I did not reveal before.

dag: Di saha ka Sool mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa dii lu tɔb tuhibu soli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa gbaai tab tuhibu, dama bɛ daa birimya pam.
en: Saul gathered his army together and went to the battle. The Philistine soldiers were very confused. They were even fighting each other with their swords.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni n-dari gindi saha shɛl la ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa lala maa. Amaa nyama, di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla yuun pihinahinaanu, ka o na kul chɛ ka m be. Ka nyama, n nyɛla yuun pihiniinaanu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Now the Lord has kept me alive for more years—as he said he would. During that time we all wandered in the desert. Now, here I am, years old.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa kuli; ka salo daa lan laɣim o sani hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ bindirigu dibu.
en: Jesus went back home, and once again such a large crowd gathered that there was no chance even to eat.

dag: Bɛ pala tuum maŋa; bɛ nyɛla tumtumdiba bɛn yɔhindi niriba, ka lɛbigi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ be kaman Masia tuumba n-nyɛ ba la.
en: They are false apostles, lying workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.

dag: Di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o nuhi pa nahu maa zuɣu ni ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini.
en: You shall put your hand on the head of the animal and kill it at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence. The Aaronite priests shall throw the blood against all four sides of the altar.

dag: Sulemaana daa nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuun yini puuni.
en: Every year King Solomon received over twenty-five tons of gold.

dag: M piila ʒiɛyimtali soli. N zaŋla a zaligunim zali n tooni.
en: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko pam mini jilima.
en: Then people will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo n-wuhiri shihir kara, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: False messiahs and false prophets will come and work great miracles and signs. They will even try to fool God's chosen ones.

dag: Ka bɛ yi bi gbaai tayiɣ maa, dindina di simdi ka yili maa lana chaŋ Naawuni sani nti wuhi kaman o nuu tim o kpee maa daazichi maa ni bee di bi tim.
en: If you dont find the thief, then the owner of the house must go before the judges who will decide if that person is guilty.

dag: Tins ayɔbu maa yɛn nyɛla Izraɛlnim mini saamba bɛn ʒi bɛ sani ni saan shɛb bɛn gariti tiliginsim tinsi, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala sarati kubu ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: These cities will be places of safety for citizens of Israel and for foreigners and travelers. Any of these people will be able to run to one of these cities if they accidentally kill someone.

dag: Ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam kum shɛli din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa na maa zuɣu, dama kum maa ni ti mii pam.
en: It will be so bad that people will forget what it was like to have plenty of food.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be Filistianim maa sani yuuni ni chira anahi.
en: David lived in the Philistine countryside for a total of one year and four months.

dag: Nir lala di tɛhiri ni o ni deei shɛli ti Duuma sani.
en: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi bimbin ni na yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa, a saria karibu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi.
en: After this, I heard the altar shout, Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.

dag: Yin ni di biŋkɔb shɛba n-nyɛ niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi.
en: You may eat these animals: cattle, sheep, goats.

dag: ka Ahimaaz nyɛ Azaria ba, ka Azaria nyɛ Jɔhanan ba.
en: Ahimaaz was Azariahs father. Azariah was Johanans father.

dag: Ka bihi daa ti var o pul ni ka o yɛli, Di yi yɛn nyɛ ŋ-ŋɔ n ni be? Ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti bɔhi Yawɛ nya.
en: While Rebekah was pregnant, the babies inside her struggled with one another. She prayed to the Lord and said, What is happening to me.

dag: Babilɔn nyɛla nam tiŋgban suŋ gari nam tiŋgbana zaa. Di nyɛla Kalidianim jilima ni bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara. Man Naawuni ni wurim li kaman n ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra shɛm la.
en: Babylon will be destroyed like the time God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. Babylon is the most beautiful of all kingdoms. The Babylonians are very proud of their city.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n ni pɔbisi tinzunnim bɛn lir a zaa bahi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn zɔr dabiɛm zo yomyom kaman pɔhim n-ʒe wurigu chaŋ la. Nini pɔbbu ni neebu.
en: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla ŋun tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa bi tum li ni o suhu zaa.
en: He did what was pleasing to the Lord , but did it reluctantly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa boli Naawuni ni tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa yuli Bɛtɛl.
en: and he named the place Bethel.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o yi pil li mɛbu ka bi tooi me n-naai, ŋunkam nya li lala ni mal o ansarisi.
en: If you don't, you will not be able to finish the tower after laying the foundation; and all who see what happened will make fun of you.

dag: A yuri din tuhi, ka je din bi tuhi; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa piig a, ka ti a jilima pam din tiri suhupiɛlli gar o ni ti a tab shɛm la.
en: You love what is right and hate what is wrong. That is why God, your God, has chosen you and has given you the joy of an honor far greater than he gave to your companions.

dag: Sulemaana daa dila nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa yuun pihinahi.
en: Solomon ruled in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.

dag: Bɛ maanila niriba ansarisi ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri; bɛ nyɛla karimbaannim bɛn lɔri niriba nahiŋgu nia biɛri.
en: They laugh at other people and speak of evil things; they are proud and make plans to oppress others.

dag: Amaa n daa zo ba nambɔɣu, ka daa bi ku ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bee n-kpihim bɛ birili.
en: Yet, I felt sorry for them and could not let them die in the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, A ku lan yiɣis a ni do bindo shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, a ni kpi. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ.
en: This is what the LORD says: You will never get out of the bed you are lying in; you will die for sure! So Elijah set off.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali kpamba bɛn daa ʒiin o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba ŋɔ wula.
en: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, What should I tell these people.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔ maa wuhirila bɛ ni booi kpam bahi shɛb zuɣuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa Duuma la tuma.
en: Then he said, These are the two men whom God has chosen and anointed to serve him, the Lord of the whole earth.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dar tɔhi binshɛli, dilan yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee sana, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi leei ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: Anyone, whether citizen or immigrant, who eats an animal that has died naturally or that was killed by another animal, must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening. At that time, they will be clean again.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli Musa, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni niŋ nyini ti dan ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The men of Gad and Reuben said, Sir, we will do as you command.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mmaŋmaŋ ni ŋmaai sida tia wulikpani nyoli ni n-zaŋ li sa. N ni lan ŋmaai di wul polli din wɔɣa pam nyoli ni n-zaŋ li mmaŋmaŋa ti sa zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will take the top of a tall cedar and break off a tender sprout; I will plant it on a high mountain.

dag: Soli maa yɛliŋ daa chaŋ ti gbaala dundɔntitali maa gooni la. Nudirigu polo zaŋ labi palo din daa doya la tooni, duri daa lan beni.
en: The entrance was at the start of the wall beside the courtyard. There were rooms on the south side, by the restricted area and the other building. These rooms had a.

dag: O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm, dama n yiŋnim yɛn malila sara ti ya, ka m biɛli yɛli ni n kana. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a yi baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma, nyin chɛ ka n chaŋ ti nya m biɛyanim maa. Lala zuɣu ka o bi ka nyin naa bindirigu ŋɔ dibu shee na maa.
en: He said, Please let me go because we have a family sacrifice there in town, and my brother has ordered me to be present. Please do me a favor and let me slip away so I can see my family. Thats why David hasnt been at the kings table.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi doli n zalikpana maa, amaa ka zaɣisi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la dolibu, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nini kul moola bɛ yaannim buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu la.
en: because they had disobeyed my laws and ignored my teachings; they had disgraced my Sabbath and worshiped the idols their ancestors had made.

dag: Ka Judanim daa laɣim ni bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka o sɔŋ ba. Bɛ daa yila Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni n-laɣimna ni bɛ ti niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ.
en: People from all of Judahs cities came to ask the LORD for help.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nini ni nya ma zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? Amaa bɛn nini bi nya ma ka niŋ yɛda mal alibarika.
en: Jesus replied, Do you believe because you see me? Happy are those who dont see and yet believe.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zaa sani nti bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tum la?.
en: The tribes of Israel sent men to the tribe of Benjamin with this message: What about this terrible thing that some of your men have done?.

dag: Di saha ka Ila bia Hɔshia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Rɛmalia bia Pɛka polo ŋ-ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani, Uzia bia Jɔtam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha.
en: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri pali ninvuɣ biɛtali balibu kam. Dina n-nyɛ: Tuumbiɛri mini bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni biɛr biɛɣu ni nyuli ni ninvuɣ kubo ni naŋgbankpeeni ni yɔhiŋ ni jɛlinsi. Bɛ nyɛla munaafichinim mini.
en: They are filled with every kind of sin, evil, greed, and hatred. They are full of jealousy, murder, fighting, lying, and thinking the worst things about each other. They gossip.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba ŋɔ zaa daa malila shili doli taba kaman bɛ ni chani tɔb tuhibu shɛm n-ka Hiburɔn na ni suhuyini, ka bɛ nia daa nyɛla bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa; lala ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa yu ni bɛ zaŋ Dauda leei bɛ naa.
en: All these men were brave fighters. They came to the town of Hebron for one reason—to make David king of all Israel. All the other Israelites also agreed that David should be king.

dag: Naa bi diri nasara tɔb ni la o tɔbbihi galisim zuɣu, ka tɔbutuhiri biiŋa mi bi diri nasara la o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: Kings arent saved by the strength of their armies; warriors arent rescued by how much power they have.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli. Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla alikauli diba ayi: Yino yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na n-dɔɣiri bihi bɛn nyɛ daba. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Haga.
en: These things are an allegory: the women are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, which gives birth to slave children; this is Hagar.

dag: Karimbaandan ŋun nyɛ nyarimaŋlana yuli m-booni Ansarisimaana. O kul tumdila karimbaani duhimaŋtali tuma.
en: Proud people think they are better than others. They show they are evil by what they do.

dag: Tumo ni daa kana ti yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ naa bidibisi maa zuɣuri na, o daa yɛlimi, Zaŋmiya li sɔŋ duya ayi tiŋ ŋɔ dunol ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: When Jehu was told that the heads of Ahab's descendants had been brought, he ordered them to be piled up in two heaps at the city gate and to be left there until the following morning.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ anabinim polo: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi. N ŋmanila ŋun nyu dam kuli ka ŋmani ŋun nyu wain buɣi, Yawɛ min o yɛligu kasi zuɣu.
en: A message to the prophets: I am very sad—my heart is broken. All my bones are shaking. Because of the Lord and his holy words, I am like a man who is drunk.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya yi bihi maa, Ti daa nyɛla Firawuna daba be Ijipti, amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa yihi ti Ijipti maa na.
en: Tell them: We were Pharaohs slaves in Egypt. But the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

dag: Di nyɛla shihirili shɛli din kul ni be m mini Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ daa zaŋla daba ayɔbu n-nam zuɣusaa mini dunia, ka vuhi daba ayopɔin dali, ka n ni maai. .
en: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.

dag: O daa yi ti chɛ ka bɛ kpira, bɛ ŋmaligirimi lab o sani ti niŋ tuuba, ka jɛmd o ni nimmoo.
en: When he killed some of them, the others would turn back to him. They would come running back to God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n nyee nyɔni biɛhigu, dama binshɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla din tiri ma suhugarigu, dinzuɣu di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmani nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: So life came to mean nothing to me, because everything in it had brought me nothing but trouble. It had all been useless; I had been chasing the wind.

dag: N yura ŋmanila mɛɛr kpalambila m-pa m biha sunsuuni.
en: My lover has the scent of myrrh as he lies upon my breasts.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Sokam yɛlima, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel! He always was and will always be worthy of praise. Let all the people say, Amen! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ʒiɛman ni, Bishilam mini Mitrɛdat ni Tabiil ni bɛ tab bɛn kpalim daa sabila gbaŋ ti Pɛriʒia Naa Atazɛrikisɛs Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, ka daa lɛbigi li.
en: Again in the reign of Emperor Artaxerxes of Persia, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their associates wrote a letter to the emperor. The letter was written in Aramaic and was to be translated when read.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa ni ti jɛm o min o bia ni o yaaŋa hal ka omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ lubu saha ti paai, ka zuliya pam mini na kara ti zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: All nations will serve him, his son and grandson, until the time for his land arrives; then many nations and great kings will conquer him.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka a zilinli tabili a noli puuni, ka a leei birigu, ka ku lan kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: I will paralyze your tongue so that you won't be able to warn these rebellious people.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛl anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa, Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni zaɣis o noli, ka bi doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: a message for the prophet from Judah: Listen to the Lord 's message. You have disobeyed the Lord your God.

dag: Ka di chɛliya ka ti naɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni chɛ ka di chandi zaɣisibu niŋ ba miligu shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti kpaŋsiri tab suhuri, di bahi bamdi yi ni nya ka ti Duuma Dabisili dal la vuri miriti la zuɣu.
en: Dont stop meeting together with other believers, which some people have gotten into the habit of doing. Instead, encourage each other, especially as you see the day drawing near.

dag: bɛ daa kulila Gɛdalia sani Mizipa. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni Tanhumɛt bia Sɛraya ni Ɛfaai ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la bidibisi ni Jɛzania ŋun daa nyɛ Maakati nir la ni bɛ tɔbbihi.
en: So Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, the sons of Ephai from Netophah, and Jezaniah from Maacah went with their men to Gedaliah at Mizpah.

dag: ni yi niɣi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, binshɛɣukam din ti yɛn bili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na ni ti nyɛla bindirigu.
en: as well as for your livestock and for the wild animals in your land. All of the lands produce can be eaten.

dag: Zuɣusaa, wumma, tiŋgbani, wumma! Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni wumsi bi shɛb zaɣisi ma.
en: The Lord has said, Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.

dag: Ka o daa va Naawuni jɛmbu duu duɣuri mini lahi, zaɣ kara mini zaɣ bihi zaa ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni azichi mini nayili azichi ni kpambaliba yinsi azichi zaa kuli Babilɔn.
en: Nebuchadnezzar carried all the things in Gods Temple away to Babylon. He took all the valuable things from the Lord s Temple, from the king, and from the kings officials.

dag: Amaa a ti ma kpiɔŋ ka di be kaman yɔnaɣilaa kpiɔŋ la. A booi kpa viɛlli bahi n zuɣu ni.
en: But youve made me as strong as a wild ox. Im soaked in precious ointment.

dag: Din daa pun beni na kul ni beni. Ka din daa pun niŋ mi na kul ni niŋda. Binshɛli kani n-nyɛ bin palli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: All things continue the way they have been since the beginning. The same things will be done that have always been done. There is nothing new in this life.

dag: Ka maligumaana yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti so, ŋun maligumaana maa n-su o ni mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ.
en: The hide of the entirely burned offering that a priest has offered belongs to the priest who offered it.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni fa shɛba. Bɛ gbahila bɛ zaa niŋ voya ni bee n-sɔɣi sarikanim ni. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi. Bɛ ŋmanila faɣiri nɛma, ka so ku tooi yɛli ni bɛ chɛl li.
en: But this is a people plundered and looted, everyone trapped in holes and hidden in dungeons. They have become plunder with no one to rescue, loot with no one to say, Give it back.

dag: Chɛ ka m min a laɣi tab zɔri kaman a ba mini m ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, Anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ, n zaŋ li mi ti a pini. Larigim a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔsimdi alikauli la din ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Let us be allies, as our fathers were. This silver and gold is a present for you. Now break your alliance with King Baasha of Israel so that he will have to pull his troops out of my territory.

dag: Ka ti Duuma garigi yɛli, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlan zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: The Lord said, Who is the wise and trusted servant? The master trusts one servant to give the other servants their food at the right time. Who is the servant that the master trusts to do that work?.

dag: ka nachimbil maa fuɣ o chinchini maa bahi, ka guui ni nyɔfindili.
en: but he left the linen cloth behind and ran away naked.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi n dan Naa Dauda nyɛvili.
en: Bathsheba bowed down with her face to the ground. She honored the king and said, May my master King David live forever.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ma ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti lu n tibili ni shɛm zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo niŋ a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige le a ŋ-ŋmalig a ka a dol a ni daa doli so shɛli kana labi.
en: Yes, you were upset at me. I heard your proud insults. So I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth. Then I will turn you around and lead you back the way you came.

dag: ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka lan tam o ni lihi nya omaŋ shɛm maa kɔtomsi.
en: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.

dag: Hashum daŋ ni: Matɛnai mini Matata ni Zabad so mi ni Ɛlifɛlɛt ni Jɛrɛmai ni Manaasa so mi ni Shimɛi.
en: Clan of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.

dag: Ka chua ni mali ninvuɣ so daa ʒi Yisa tooni.
en: A man suffering from an abnormal swelling of the body was there.

dag: Dama di ku lan yuui, ka n ni yɛn darigi yi tibili zali shɛm tariga paai, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu m-bahi ba yoli.
en: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.

dag: Dama m bi niŋ n tɔbu naani bee n-niŋ n takɔb yɛda ni di ni tiligi ma.
en: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛna, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ka ti na ʒi n-zaɣis o. Aduna bidibisi n-nyɛ ti maligumaaniba bɛn maani sara tiri Yawɛ ka Lɛvinim nyɛ bɛn sɔŋdi ba.
en: But we still serve the Lord our God and have not abandoned him. Priests descended from Aaron perform their duties, and Levites assist them.

dag: Doo min o mabia yi laɣim be, ka bɛ ni yino ti bi dɔɣi bidibiga ka kpi ka chɛ o paɣa, pakoli maa ŋun di yi bɛ daŋ maa ni chaŋ ti kuli ninvuɣ zino. O yidan mabia maa ŋun zaŋm o n-leeg o paɣa, ka tum di ni simdi ni o yidan mabia tum tuun shɛli ti o.
en: If two brothers live on the same property and one of them dies, leaving no son, then his widow is not to be married to someone outside the family; it is the duty of the dead man's brother to marry her.

dag: Ka Ifriim min o paɣ maa daa lan dɔni ka o niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Bɛraya, zaɣ biɛɣu din daa niŋ o yiŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.

dag: dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili paaya, ka ŋuni n-ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li.
en: The great day for their anger has come. No one can stand against it.

dag: dama n suhu kul yɛmi ni n nyan ya n-zaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli kpaŋsi ya.
en: I want very much to see you and give you some spiritual gift to make your faith stronger.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: After that the Lord s servant Joshua son of Nun died. He was years old.

dag: Niriba maa kul bela nimaani kuhira, amaa ka o bi garigi ba, bɛ karimbaani mini bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: Or if evil people ask God for help, he will not answer them, because they are too proud.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi ni mali karimbaan shɛli nyuri bara maa, ka chɛ ka yi sagbana mi be kaman kurigu la.
en: I will break your stubborn pride; there will be no rain, and your land will be dry and as hard as iron.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi, ka nyɛ yi tiligira la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zuɣu, n ni tim Babilɔn nti ŋme n-kab bɛ dunoya zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ niriba tahigu leei kumsi.
en: Israel's holy God, the Lord who saves you, says, To save you, I will send an army against Babylon; I will break down the city gates, and the shouts of her people will turn into crying.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn sani nti yɛl o.
en: Then the people of Israel sent messengers to the Amorite king Sihon to say:.

dag: Buɣim di yi tinsi, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ nyɛ zaɣ nɛli. Tinzunnim fa yi tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li yi ninni, ka di kpalimla zaɣ nɛli.
en: Your country is deserted, your cities burned with fire; your land—strangers are devouring it in plain sight. Its a wasteland, as when foreigners raid.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-naai saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: After all the people had crossed the Jordan River, the Lord said to Joshua.

dag: O ni wuhi ba alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, bɛ ni bi niŋ ma yɛda zuɣu.
en: They are wrong about sin, because they do not believe in me;.

dag: Cham gili bɛ ni saɣim luɣ shɛli zaa kahikahi maa; ti dimnim maa saɣim binshɛɣukam din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la.
en: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka a nya filiŋ zuliya kam sani, ka ninsalinim lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: Your nation will be small, yet hated by other nations.

dag: A zaligu din yi a nol ni na nyɛla bin viɛlli n sani gari salima mini anzinfa kpila tusa shɛm.
en: Your teachings are worth more to me than a thousand pieces of silver and gold.

dag: N ni daa be yi sani ka ti lan ka shɛl la, n daa bi zaŋ n yɛla doli yi ni so, dama m mabi shɛb bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na la daa ti ma n ni kɔŋ shɛli maa. Dinzuɣu n daa bi zaŋ n yɛla doli yi ni so, ka na kul ku zaŋ n yɛla doli ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛri be. Bɛ kul nyarila buni pahiri ka di bi to.
en: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.

dag: Ka Dauda paɣiba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ti o Hiburɔn; o bidib kpɛm sani n-daa nyɛ Amnɔn, o ma n-daa nyɛ Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la.
en: Davids sons were born in Hebron. His oldest son was Amnon, by Ahinoam from Jezreel.

dag: A daa nyɛla dabili ka ti Duuma bol a? Di chɛ ka di muɣis a. Amaa a yi ni tooi nya yolisim, nyin bom li.
en: If you were a slave when God chose you, dont let that bother you. But if you can be free, then do it.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam ŋahiri ŋaha, ni ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛli, Ma ni be shɛm lala ka o bipuɣiŋga gba be.
en: People will use this saying about you, Jerusalem: If the mother is bad, so is her daughter.

dag: N ni tɔɣis a dunia ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣa ka a bi niŋ li yɛda ŋɔ, ka n yi tɔɣis a alizanda ni yɛtɔɣa, wula ka a ni tooi niŋ li yɛda?.
en: I have told you about things here on earth, but you do not believe me. So Im sure you will not believe me if I tell you about heavenly things!.

dag: Di saha yiliguliba ni ni ti sɔhira, ka kpiɔŋlaannim pɔri gɔɣi, ka paɣiba bɛn niɛmdi chɛ niɛmbu, bɛ ni bi lan galisi zuɣu, ka din lihiri takɔriti ni niŋ liti.
en: on the day when the housekeepers tremble and the strong men stoop; when the women who grind stop working because theyre so few, and those who look through the windows grow dim.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ fukumsi mini bɛ yiko zaa n-ti biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ na so ŋun ʒi Dauda nam ʒiishee la polo mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be tiŋ puuni ka nyɛ yi dɔɣiriba shɛb bɛ ni daa bi gbahi pahi yi zuɣu chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the LORD proclaims concerning the king sitting on Davids throne and all the people who live in this city, that is, those among you who didnt go into exile.

dag: ka wuɣi gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ kaɣili gbibil o nudirigu ni; ka damdir o tooni maan o ansarisi yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: They twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They put a stick in his right hand. Then they bowed down in front of him and mocked him, saying, Hey! King of the Jews.

dag: Ashili pini nyɛla din maari suhuyiɣisili, ka ashilɔni birapu tibu gba nyɛ din maari suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: If someone is angry with you, a gift given secretly will calm him down.

dag: Amaa chamiya ti yɛl o nyaandoliba mini Pita ni Yisa daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: Go, tell his disciples, especially Peter, that he is going ahead of you into Galilee. You will see him there, just as he told you.

dag: Ka Sool daa yiɣisi zani n-neeg o nina ka bi lan ne; ka bɛ daa gbaag o nuu ni n-vo o hal ni Damaskus.
en: Saul got up from the ground and opened his eyes, but could not see a thing. So they took him by the hand and led him into Damascus.

dag: dama Naawuni pala ŋun tumdi chirachira, amaa o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun tumdi din doli soli. Zaŋ chaŋ di ni be Yisa nyaandoliba cheechinim zaa ni shɛm la polo.
en: God is not a God of confusion but a God of peace. This is the rule for all the meetings of Gods people.

dag: O niŋla Naawuni naani; lala zuɣu Naawuni yi bɔr o, ŋun fam o bahi pumpɔŋɔ, dama o yɛliya, N nyɛla Naawuni Bia. .
en: He trusts in God, so let God deliver him now if he wants to. He said, Im Gods Son.

dag: Aduna zuliya, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Aarons family, say it: His faithful love will last forever.

dag: N suhu dammi, ka bi lan doya; ka wahala dabisa kul paari ma.
en: I am torn apart by worry and pain; I have had day after day of suffering.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa deei yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: An oracle about Babylon, which Isaiah, Amozs son, saw.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Namɔɣili so ŋun gbibi n vuhim dabisa, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri n nini, ka gbibi n daalikauli.
en: They should not say that because the Lord says, Some eunuchs obey the laws about the Sabbath. They choose to do what I want, and they follow my agreement.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛlnim daa ka naa, dinzuɣu sokam daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: There was no king in Israel at that time; everyone did whatever they wanted.

dag: chaŋ Hiburɔn ti zaŋ li ti Naa Dauda ka yɛl o, Naa, a dim Sool ŋun daa kul dol a ni o ku a la bia Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ m-bɔhi Sool min o bihi biɛri n-ti n dan naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ maa.
en: They presented the head to King David at Hebron and said to him, Here is the head of Ishbosheth, the son of your enemy Saul, who tried to kill you. Today the Lord has allowed Your Majesty to take revenge on Saul and his descendants.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a ti zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the meeting tents entrance and wash them with water.

dag: Lɛbanɔn tihi zaa dari ku saɣi sara maligu buɣim; ka di biŋkɔbiri zaa ku saɣi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la malibu.
en: All the trees in Lebanon are not enough to burn on the altar for the Lord. And all the animals in Lebanon are not enough to kill for a sacrifice.

dag: Bɛ daa bi mi ni Yisifu wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa, dama so n-daa deeri yɛtɔɣa maa lɛbigiri tiri ba.
en: They didnt know that Joseph was listening to them because they were using an interpreter.

dag: di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali alikama mini chi ni wain tihi ni fiig tihi ni pumpɔrinchihi tihi. Di lan nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali olivi tihi mini shikpam.
en: It is a land with wheat and barley, grapevines, fig trees, and pomegranates. It is a land with olive oil and honey.

dag: Ka a min a bihi ni a tumtumdiba zaa yɛn kɔrila o yaaŋa ŋɔ puri din ni chɛ ka a dan yaaŋa maa nyari bindirigu dira. Amaa m min a dan yaaŋa Mɛfibɔshɛt n-yɛn laɣindi diri sahakam. Ziba daa malila bidibisi pinaanu ni tumtumdiba pisi.
en: You and your sons and servants will work for Mephibosheth. You will farm his land and bring in his crops, so that Saul's family and servants will have food. But Mephibosheth will always eat with me at my table.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la, Ŋunkam kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi.
en: As the scripture says, Everyone who calls out to the Lord for help will be saved.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa sagban wɔɣinli ni. Bɛ daa dol o wuhibu min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti ba la.
en: God spoke from the tall cloud, and they obeyed his commands and the law he gave them.

dag: Dama Yisa ni daa be Galili la, bɛna n-daa dol o ka sɔŋd o; ka paɣiba pam bɛn daa dol o na hal ni Jɛrusalɛm la gba beni.
en: These were the women who had followed Jesus in Galilee and cared for him. Many other women who had come with Jesus to Jerusalem were also there.

dag: ka lan nyɛ nanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn niriba anu pun lu, ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn kpalim maa ni yino be nam ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka yino la ŋun na bi di, amaa o yi ti di, o ku yuui.
en: Five of the rulers have already died. One of the rulers lives now, and the last ruler is coming. When he comes, he will stay only a short time.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa guhi daba ayopɔin, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ.
en: After seven days Noah again sent out the dove.

dag: Di mi mali dabiɛm ni nir kpe Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ nuu ni!.
en: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!.

dag: M piɛri mi n kukoli, ka n gba mi ba, ka bɛ doli ma;.
en: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me.

dag: Amaa nyin min a niriba ŋɔ na bi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: But I know that you and your officials still dont take the LORD God seriously. .

dag: Amaa a ni bi niŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm maa yɛda zuɣu, a ni leei birigu ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa faashee n yɛligu ŋɔ zaa ti niŋ pali; di mi ti kul yɛn niŋla pali saha shɛli Naawuni ni zal li maa.
en: But you have not believed my message, which will come true at the right time. Because you have not believed, you will be unable to speak; you will remain silent until the day my promise to you comes true.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ti gba, ti ni daa nyɛ bihi ka na bi zooi wuntia soli dolibu ni la, ti daa nyɛla bɛn be dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni.
en: In the same way, we too were slaves of the ruling spirits of the universe before we reached spiritual maturity.

dag: Cheebu saha beni, ka shɛbu saha beni. Shinibu saha beni, ka tɔɣisibu saha beni.
en: the time for tearing and the time for mending, the time for silence and the time for talk.

dag: Giliad nyɛla n dini, ka Manaasa nyɛ n dini; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurugu zuɣupiligu; ka Juda nyɛ n nam jaaŋgbee.
en: Gilead and Manasseh will be mine. Ephraim will be my helmet. Judah will be my royal scepter.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa yɛl o, A ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: Then Jethro said, You are not doing this right.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-zaŋdi kom duri zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka di leeri sakom.
en: God gathers moisture into the clouds.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ firilatamdigu la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali tuhi teebuli maa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo.
en: He put the lampstand in the meeting tent, opposite the table on the south side of the dwelling.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kahigi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni Bia, Naawuni be o ni ka o gba be Naawuni ni.
en: Anyone who says, I believe that Jesus is the Son of God, is a person who lives in God, and God lives in that person.

dag: Farisiinim daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ saha ka Naawuni nam yɛn piligi? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni nam bi yɛn piligimi ni shihira ka niriba nya li ni bɛ nini;.
en: Some of the Pharisees asked Jesus, When will Gods kingdom come? Jesus answered, Gods kingdom is coming, but not in a way that you can see it.

dag: Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti ku o. Bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni. N niriba daalahichi zuɣu ka bɛ daa ku o.
en: He was arrested and sentenced and led off to die, and no one cared about his fate. He was put to death for the sins of our people.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka maligumaaniba daa kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka Kasi maa buɣi.
en: Then the priests and the Levites carried to the temple the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa dɔni n-shiri niŋ kaman o biɛrimi la. Ka naa daa ti kana ni o ti kaag o, ka Amnɔn yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka Tama kana ti mali maha ti ma n ninni, ka zaŋ li na ti gbib o nuu ni ka n ŋubi.
en: So Amnon lay down in bed and pretended to be sick. King David came in to see Amnon. He said to King David, Please let my sister Tamar come in. Let her make two cakes for me while I watch. Then I can eat from her hands.

dag: Amaa bɛ kul domi gu ni bɛ ŋmaligi ku bɛmaŋa. Bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya ka bɛ doya gu maa.
en: But evil people cannot see the trap they set for themselves.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli, zaɣ biɛɣu ku milig o yiŋa.
en: Evil will never depart from the house of those who return evil for good.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Yawɛ di ma shɛhira, ka o ni pii na so ŋɔ gba di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi bi nya galimi shɛli m biɛhigu ni. Ka bɛ daa saɣi, Iin, o di shɛhira.
en: Samuel said, The Lord and his chosen king are witnesses to what you have said. That's true, they replied.

dag: N ni zaŋ li ti tinzunnima, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri, ka di leei bɛ ni ŋme n-di shɛli. Bɛ ni ti ta li daɣiri.
en: Wicked foreigners will rob and disgrace you.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa birili, ka kpihim yuŋ shɛli bɛ ni daa yɛli, Bɛ zali bidibbil puu la gba birili.
en: I wish the day I was born would be lost forever. I wish the night they said, Its a boy! had never happened.

dag: Bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la jɛmbu, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gil ba la wuna. Ka bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhi yiɣisi.
en: and they went away from the LORD, their ancestors God, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt. They went after other gods from among the surrounding peoples, they worshipped them, and they angered the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O tin ya suhudoo luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la niŋ n nuu ni, ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leei ŋun Yawɛ min o niriba ni su shɛli.
en: He said, The Lord your God has been with you and given you peace on all sides. He let me conquer all the people who used to live in this land, and they are now subject to you and to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Yiya mɛbu saha na bi miri. Tiŋ ŋɔ nyɛla duɣu, ka ti mi nyɛ nimdi.
en: They say things like, Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.

dag: Ka di yi di nyɛla n niŋ o la zaɣ biɛɣu ka binshɛli mi bi sɔɣiri naa sani, di saha a ku zani n nyaaŋa.
en: If I had taken Absaloms life behind the kings back then—though nothing is hidden from the king—you would have kept your distance from me.

dag: M bihi, di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi n-nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Masia ni nyɛ wuntizɔra shɛm.
en: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi Judanim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaanu daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ. Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: and in his twenty-third year, —taken away by Nebuzaradan. In all, , people were taken away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suui bɛ noli maa naai ka Yisa bɔhi Saimɔn Pita, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma gari bɛmbɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛbihi.
en: When Jesus and his disciples had finished eating, he asked, Simon son of John, do you love me more than the others do? Simon Peter answered, Yes, Lord, you know I do! Then feed my lambs, Jesus said.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila bɛ nyaansi biri ma ka pa bɛ tooni. Hal n ni daa kul wuhiri ba sahakam maa zaa yoli, bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum wuhibu ka deei saɣisigu.
en: They turned their backs on me; and though I kept on teaching them, they would not listen and learn.

dag: Ka yɛli Izraɛlnima, Zaŋmiya bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ naɣibil ŋun paai yuuni mini piɛbil ŋun paai yuuni m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la;.
en: Then tell the Israelites, Take a male goat as a purification offering; a young bull and a sheep—both one-year-old flawless animals—as an entirely burned offering.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni pun yɛli, N tin ya vuhim mini suhudoo, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku wum ti ma.
en: He offered rest and comfort to all of you, but you refused to listen to him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Shallum ŋun daa di nam zan o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni gbaai so kpe n-zaŋ o chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku lan labi kpe na yaha.
en: Jehoahaz became king of Judah after his father King Josiah died. But Jehoahaz was taken as a prisoner to a foreign country. Now I, the Lord , promise that he will die there without ever seeing his own land again. *.

dag: Di saha ka a dol a soli ni alaafee, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui shɛli.
en: Then you will walk safely on your path, and your foot wont stumble.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu bela palɔni kaman zabiri pambu mini salima yɛri yɛbu bee situr viɛla yɛbu.
en: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka di pala ti yɛn zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri m-maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee m-maani sara shɛli di zuɣu.
en: So we built an altar, not to burn sacrifices or make offerings.

dag: Ka o kpee maa garigi yɛl o, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Jɔash bia Gidiɔn ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nir la takɔbi. Naawuni pun zaŋ Midiannim mini bɛ tɔbbihi ŋɔ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: His friend replied, Can this be anything other than the sword of the Israelite Gideon, Joashs son? God has handed over Midian and its entire camp to him.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa pinila bɛ zuɣuri mini bɛ teensi, ka chihi bɛ bɔɣiri zaa chiha ka so buri.
en: Every head is shaved, every beard is cut off, every hand is slashed, and everyone wears mourning clothes.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb tiri pini, amaa ka bɛ buni kul nabirimi pahira, ka shɛb mi vili bɛ ni su shɛli gbibi ka kɔŋda.
en: Some people spend their money freely and still grow richer. Others are cautious, and yet grow poorer.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka na biɛri yiko zan tariga.
en: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings.

dag: Ka Ishipan mini Ɛba ni Ɛliɛl.
en: Shashak's descendants included Ishpan, Eber, Eliel.

dag: Shɛlini so shɛli ni tooi beni ŋmani din viɛla, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛ kum soli.
en: There is a way that seems right to people, but that way leads only to death.

dag: Ka naa maa daa mali saawara, ka zaŋ salima mali naɣilabih ayi zali; ka yɛli niriba maa, Yi chani Jɛrusalɛm ka di saha wɔɣa. Izraɛlnima, nyamiya yi buɣa bɛn daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: Jeroboam asked for advice and then made two gold statues of calves. He showed them to the people and said, Listen everyone! You won't have to go to Jerusalem to worship anymore. Here are your gods who rescued you from Egypt.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa bi saɣi shɛli o sani. O bi lihi ba ka bɛ nyɛ shɛli o sani.
en: The nations are nothing at all to him.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli; Aai, di simdi ni n da li kaman di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, dama n ku zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli n-nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka Dauda daa da kabɔɣili maa mini naɣikɔra maa anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: But the king answered, No, I will pay you for it. I will not offer to the Lord my God sacrifices that have cost me nothing. And he bought the threshing place and the oxen for fifty pieces of silver.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim la zaa n-na be yi nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: but those of you who were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.

dag: Di kul tuɣituɣila taba kirikiri, ka so ku tooi woligi li.
en: than breath to breath.

dag: Ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be bɛ sani maa daa kpalim be Gɛba din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Amaa ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Mikimash.
en: Saul, his son Jonathan, and their men camped in Geba in the territory of Benjamin; the Philistine camp was at Michmash.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni guhiri dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ mali biɛr kasi ka ku mali galimi Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka suhudoo be yi min o sunsuuni.
en: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni n-gbiri binyara ŋubira; ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni. Ka o daa bahi ba noli.
en: There was a large herd of pigs near by, feeding on a hillside. So the demons begged Jesus to let them go into the pigs, and he let them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bia maa ŋun yi yihi ya dabitim ni, yi shiri yiya ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!.

dag: Zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Tie them on your arms and wear them on your foreheads as a reminder.

dag: Tins ayɔbu maa yɛn nyɛla Izraɛlnim mini saamba bɛn ʒi bɛ sani ni saan shɛb bɛn gariti tiliginsim tinsi, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala sarati kubu ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: These will serve as cities of refuge for Israelites and for foreigners who are temporary or permanent residents. Anyone who kills someone accidentally can escape to one of them.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura nyari alibarika.
en: Yes, the Lord will really bless those who respect him.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni pun yɛli, N tin ya vuhim mini suhudoo, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku wum ti ma.
en: He has said to them, This is the place of rest; give rest to the weary; this is the place of repose; but they refused to listen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ alichɛbba maa tiŋli ti tuui.
en: All around its lower hem they put pomegranates of fine linen and of blue, purple, and red wool, alternating with bells of pure gold, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Bɛ ni yi gbaai tayiɣa ka o di vi shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim gba yɛn di vi; bɛ mini bɛ nanima ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim.
en: As a thief is ashamed when caught in his tracks, so the people of Israel are ashamed— their kings, officials, priests, and prophets.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa vooi dunoli yo ka yi bɛ sani nti yɛli ba.
en: Lot went outside and closed the door behind him.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛl o niriba maa, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Sool Ka Sool daa ti yiɣisi voli maa ni yina chaŋ o chandi.
en: David said these things to stop his men. He would not let his men hurt Saul. Saul left the cave and went on his way.

dag: O ni yɛn wolig omaŋ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o miri ka o di wain tia binshɛlikam, hal o miri ka o di di biɛlim bee di paɣiri.
en: not even the seeds or skins.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, gunibu mali buchi la a yi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm; amaa a yi bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, dindina a bemi kaman ŋun bi guni.
en: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.

dag: ni Bɛtinimira ni Bɛtiharan, ka me buzɔna zali bɛ piɛri mini buhi, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran.

dag: O daa mali salima bans anahi n-zaŋ li ga teebuli maa luɣ anahi zuɣu naba la.
en: He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs.

dag: Naa ti ku lan beni n-su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka nabihi zaa ti ku lan beni.
en: The free men and leaders will all be gone, and there will be nothing left for them to rule.

dag: N ni tilig a a niriba mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb sani n ni timd a maa nuu ni.
en: I will rescue you from your own people and from the Gentiles. I am sending you.

dag: Yisa Masia puuni yi zaa nyɛla Naawuni bihi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tintariga kpaa din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha bee n-fa kpibisi palo.
en: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.

dag: Ka Naa Sairus maŋmaŋ daa zaŋ neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la nti niŋ o buɣa duu la na.
en: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord 's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi ku o kpee, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who kills anyone, even if he is not caught! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Di daa bi lan kpa ni so wuh o ninsal biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, dama omaŋmaŋ pun mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni.
en: There was no need for anyone to tell him about them, because he himself knew what was in their hearts.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli Tiriza. O ni daa kul mali ti kpɛri bɛ yiŋ dunol ni, ka bia maa dii leei Naawuni dini.
en: Jeroboam's wife went back to Tirzah. Just as she entered her home, the child died.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m mi ni n ni gili yihi Naawuni nam waazu yi ninvuɣ shɛb sani zaa ŋɔ ku lan nya ma ni yi nini yaha.
en: I know that none of you will see me again—you among whom I traveled and proclaimed the kingdom.

dag: ka yi tiŋgbani mi ti be kaman tahiʒiɛɣu. Yi ni ti yihi yi yaa tum tuma yoli, ka yi tiŋgbani ku niŋ bindirigu, ka di tihi gba ti ku wali wala.
en: You will work hard, but it will not help. Your land will not give any crops, and your trees will not grow their fruit.

dag: Dauda ni daa labi Zikilag, o daa piila o ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa maa shɛli nti ti o zɔnim bɛn daa nyɛ Juda kpamba la ka yɛli ba, N ni tuhi Yawɛ dimnim ka di neen shɛŋa ka m pii tin ya na maa.
en: When David returned to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah and to his friends. Here is a gift for you from the plunder of the LORDs enemies, he said.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni di timaha gbinni; ka zaŋdi yi bihi maani maligu vinvama mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: You worship the fertility gods by having sex under those sacred trees of yours. You offer your children as sacrifices in the rocky caves near stream beds.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi Pɛɛga maa chaŋ Antiɔk din be Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ti ʒini.
en: The rest of them went on from Perga to Antioch in Pisidia. Then on the Sabbath they went to the synagogue and sat down.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan bidibiga daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal, ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, the grandfather of Micah, and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

dag: Ŋun daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ o banim min o manim polo, M bi lihi nya ba. O daa zaɣisi o mabihi, ka zaɣisi o bihi. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dol a yɛligu, ka gbib a daalikauli.
en: They showed greater loyalty to you Than to parents, brothers, or children. They obeyed your commands And were faithful to your covenant.

dag: Laɣimmiya niriba maa na Chɛliya ka laɣiŋgu maa be kasi. Laɣimmiya ninkura na, ka laɣimmiya bihi mini bimɔɣirisi gba na. Hal di nyɛla talahi ni aŋgɔnim yi bɛ duri na, ka amiliyanim yi amiliya lɔbu duri na.
en: Gather the people; prepare a holy meeting; assemble the elders; gather the children, even nursing infants. Let the groom leave his room and the bride her chamber.

dag: O neesim bemi kaman wuntaŋa, ka neesim bɔba yiri o nuhi ni na, nimaani ka o yiko sɔɣiya.
en: He comes with the brightness of lightning; light flashes from his hand, there where his power is hidden.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtɛl maligumaana Amazia daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam, Amɔs yila a nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim sani. O yɛtɔɣa muɣila tiŋgbani maa.
en: Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, then sent a report to King Jeroboam of Israel: Amos is plotting against you among the people. His speeches will destroy the country.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa nyɛla Salɛm Naa mini Naawuni Zallakudura Naa maligumaana. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa chaŋ ti tuhi nanim tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ka labirina la, Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋɔ n-daa tuh o soli niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and a priest of the Most High God. As Abraham was coming back from the battle in which he defeated the four kings, Melchizedek met him and blessed him.

dag: Naa zaligu lahibali maa ni daa paai bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni, Yɛhudianim daa kul kuhirila fabila kuhigu pampam. Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa lo noli n-kum ka fabili, ka bɛ ni niriba pam daa pili buri n-teei do tampiligim ni.
en: In every province where the king's orders were read, the Jews cried and mourned, and they went without eating. Many of them even put on sackcloth and sat in ashes.

dag: O niŋla lala ni bɛ bo ŋun Naawuni hal ti nya o. Ka ti zaa yinoyino min o bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: God wanted people to look for him, and perhaps in searching all around for him, they would find him. But he is not far from any of us.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Samsin; ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi, ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: So the woman had a boy. She named him Samson. He grew and the Lord blessed him.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, yi nyɛla wuna, yi zaa nyɛla Zallakudura Naa bihi.
en: You are gods, I said; all of you are children of the Most High.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa bɔri daliri shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisi luhi Yisa ka ku o, amaa ka daa lee bi nya di daliri.
en: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for testimony against Jesus in order to put him to death, but they couldnt find any.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla din bari ti suhuri zaana. Dina n-nyɛ din chɛ ka ti gariti chinchini la zuɣu kpɛri du kasi shɛl ni.
en: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi ka sabbu be di yaɣa ayi. Di daa sab niŋla di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa.
en: Moses went back down the mountain, carrying the two stone tablets with the commandments written on both sides.

dag: Amaa tarimba ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka tɔŋ pam, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa bi deei Naawuni yɛligu saha shɛl o ni daa di suɣilo guhiri ba Anabi Nuhu ʒiɛman ni la. Di saha ka Anabi Nuhu daa kpahiri ŋariŋ shɛli niriba biɛla bɛn nyɛ niriba anii kɔŋko ni daa kpe n-tiligi kom dibu ni la.
en: In the past, these spirits were disobedient—when God patiently waited during the time of Noah. Noah built an ark in which a few lives were rescued through water.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri yi suhuri ni?.
en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, Why do you fill your minds with evil things?.

dag: Sool suhu daa na kul yiɣisiri bahirila ti Duuma nyaandoliba zuɣu, ka kul kpɛhiri ba dabiɛm ni o ni ku ba; ka daa chaŋ maligumaaniba zuɣulan sani.
en: Meanwhile, Saul was still spewing out murderous threats against the Lords disciples. He went to the high priest.

dag: Daniɛl daa lo o suhu ni ni o ku di nayili bindirigu maa bee n-nyu wain shɛli naa ni daa nyurila n-saɣim omaŋa; dinzuɣu ka o daa suhi namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa n-yɛl o ni o bi lo ni o saɣim omaŋa nayili bindirigu maa dibu ni, lala zuɣu ni o sɔŋm o.
en: Daniel made up his mind not to let himself become ritually unclean by eating the food and drinking the wine of the royal court, so he asked Ashpenaz to help him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ tiligira ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun sɔɣ amaŋa.
en: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.

dag: Maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi kuli do so ŋun pa maligumaana, ŋun miri ka o lan di sara maligu kasinim maa.
en: A priest's daughter who marries someone who is not a priest may not eat any of the sacred offerings.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi nimaani kul o ya, ka o nyaandoliba daa dol o.
en: Jesus left that place and came to his hometown. His disciples followed him.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka niriba ni niŋ shɛb naani leeri biriti, ka mɔŋdi kpamba baŋsim.
en: silences the talk of trusted people; takes away elders discernment.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ di vulo maa yi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini hal ni Lɛbohamat samban ni, ka di tintariga naabu shee yɛn nyɛla Zɛdad.
en: and from there to Hamath Pass. It will continue to Zedad.

dag: Naawuni, a mi n jɛrilim ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni pun tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bi sɔɣ a sani.
en: God, you know my foolishness; my wrongdoings arent hidden from you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-ka Hɛlam na. Ka Sirianim maa daa niŋ shili yina ti liri Dauda ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba.
en: When David heard of it, he gathered the Israelite troops, crossed the Jordan River, and marched to Helam, where the Syrians took up their position facing him. The fighting began.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sokam ŋmanila shilinshia. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam nyɛla yoli. Bɛ laɣindila bɛ nyamma sɔŋda, ka bi mi ŋun ti yɛn di li.
en: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.

dag: Yisa ni daa du Galili Teeku duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu yi gbala polo n-tuhir o sol na. Bɛ nini daa tuli pam hal ka so ku tooi gari bɛ ni be shɛli polo maa.
en: Jesus arrived at the other side of the lake in the country of the Gadarene people. There, two men who had demons inside them came to him. They lived in the burial caves and were so dangerous that no one could use the road by those caves.

dag: ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ ti yi mɔɣu polo na yim nti ʒe n-daai yili maa zaa luhi bipola maa zuɣu, ka bɛ kpi. N kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: when suddenly a windstorm from the desert blew the house down, crushing all of your children. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: Di saha ka yɔɣ ni tihi zaa ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni; dama o kamina ni o ti kari dunia saria.
en: The trees in the woods will shout for joy when the Lord comes to rule the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ku Midian paɣ so maa mi yuli daa boonila Kɔzibi. O daa nyɛla Zur bipuɣiŋga, ka Zur daa nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba dɔɣirikpɛma Midian.
en: And the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cozbi. She was the daughter of Zur. Zur was the head of a family and leader of a Midianite tribe.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi nab pam pahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ŋɔ ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: Israelites, listen carefully and obey these laws. Then everything will be fine with you. You will have many children, and you will get the land filled with many good things —just as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, promised.

dag: Bɛ kpari Nɛgɛbinim niŋ bɛ fɔntinsi ni, ka so kani ŋun ni kparigi ba. Bɛ gbahi Judanim zaa chaŋ.
en: The cities in the Negev are locked. No one can open them. All the people of Judah have been taken away as captives. They were carried away as prisoners.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa? Ka Yisa yɛligu maa daa paligi salo maa suhuri pam.
en: David himself called him Lord; so how can the Messiah be David's descendant? A large crowd was listening to Jesus gladly.

dag: Ka o tumtumdiba daa chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Ti ba, anab maa yi di yɛl a ni a niŋm binshɛli din to pam, a naan ku niŋ li? Di ni ti be ka o ni yɛl a mi, Cham ti mim kom ni ka nya alaafee ŋɔ? .
en: His servants went up to him and said, Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, you would have done it. Now why can't you just wash yourself, as he said, and be cured.

dag: N ni yɛli Naawuni, Di wuhi ni m mali taali. Chɛ ka m baŋ a ni tuhiri ma daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: I will say to God, Dont declare me guilty; tell me what you are accusing me of doing.

dag: Lala ka Dauda daa zaŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni kuɣili labi Filistia doo maa ku o, ka takɔbi daa ka Dauda nuu ni.
en: So David defeated the Philistine with only a sling and one stone! He hit the Philistine and killed him. David didnt have a sword.

dag: ka lihiri buɣim ni dir o ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa maa ka kuhiri yɛra, Tin dini n-yi lee beni ŋ-ŋmani tin titali ŋɔ.
en: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, This was the greatest city ever.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Jeremiah the prophet.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura; dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura binshɛli bi poori ba.
en: Honor the Lord ! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.

dag: Bɛ ni lo barina tumbu nia shɛli ŋmaligiri lurila bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ duŋtaabo ŋmaligiri luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tulila zaliŋ, ka bi tuli viɛnyɛliŋga ka mi bi mahi la zuɣu, n ni tuhi ya n nol ni bahi.
en: But you are only warm—not hot, not cold. So I am ready to spit you out of my mouth.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: Joab went to talk with the woman. She asked him, Are you Joab? Joab answered, Yes, I am. Then the woman said, Listen to me. Joab said, I am listening.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu yomyom; n gbarigiya zaa. Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma. Di yi niŋ lala, n ni bemi kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: Answer me, LORD—and quickly! My breath is fading. Dont hide your face from me or Ill be like those going down to the pit!.

dag: O daa kari zuliya shɛba, ka piri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ti Izraɛl zuliya, ka deei bɛ yinsi ti ba ka bɛ kpe m-beni.
en: He drove out the inhabitants as his people advanced; he divided their land among the tribes of Israel and gave their homes to his people.

dag: Lala ka Naa Dauda gba wuhi alibarika shɛli din be ninvuɣ so ni Naawuni ni lihi wuntizɔra, ka di pala o tuma zuɣu. O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya kam ni dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa nimaani, yi mini yi yaannim ni daa pun bi mi buɣ shɛŋa.
en: The Lord will scatter you among all the nations, from one end of the earth to the other, and there you will serve gods made of wood and stone, gods that neither you nor your ancestors have ever worshiped before.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa ni daa yiri maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa n-kum pam. Ka Naa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ du, ka o min o niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: The people of Jerusalem were crying and moaning as David and everyone with him passed by. He led them across Kidron Valley and along the road toward the desert.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi so daa kana nti yɛl o, Karimba, n ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, Teacher, I will follow you any place you go.

dag: Di saha n ni ti zaŋ firilanim lihi Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka shɛli ni ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Yawɛ ku niŋ din viɛla bee din bie la tibili.
en: At that time, I will search Jerusalem with lamps; I will punish the men growing fat on the sediment in their wine, those saying to themselves, The LORD wont do good or evil.

dag: Ka Naa Akishi kpambaliba daa bɔh o, Pa Dauda ŋɔ n-nyɛ o ya naa la? Pa o yɛla ka bɛ daa wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Naa Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia la? .
en: Achishs servants said to him, Isnt that David, king of the land? Hes the one people sing about in their dances, Saul has killed his thousands, but David has killed his tens of thousands.

dag: N ni daa be shɛm daa pala din sɔɣi a sani. Bɛ ni daa nam ma ashilɔni saha shɛli, bɛ daa zaŋ ma tuɣila tab alahizibu tuɣibu tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: You could see my bones grow as my body took shape, hidden in my mothers womb.

dag: Ka a zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ zuɣupil shɛli din be kasi pil o pa bantabiga maa zuɣu.
en: Put on his turban with its narrow strip of engraved gold.

dag: Dama Bɛ daa bi pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Lɛvinima, naɣila tinsi ka bɛ daa ti ba ni bɛ beni m-pahi luɣ shɛŋa bɛ niɣi ni yɛn ŋubiri mɔri mini luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ bɛ binyara zali.
en: The people of Joseph consisted of two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites werent given any portion of the land, except cities to live in and pastureland for their cattle and flocks.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ piɛri mini niɣi ti Abimilɛk, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lo tab alikauli.
en: So Abraham and Abimelech made an agreement. Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle as proof of the agreement.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli niriba maa zaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa ti o ka tim o ni o ti yɛli ba la naai.
en: I told the people everything the Lord had told me.

dag: Goma tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi zaa mini Bɛtitɔgarima din be nuzaa polo la tɔbbihi zaa be a sani, bɛ galisiya pam.
en: as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa.
en: They will tear off your clothes and take your jewels.

dag: Di luhiya ni ti suhuri paligi ka ti diɛm, dama a tizɔbil maa kpimi ka lan neena; o daa bɔrigimi, ka ti lan nya o maa.
en: But this was a day to be happy and celebrate. Your brother was dead, but now he is alive. He was lost, but now he is found.

dag: Yɛhudianim maa daa bi niŋ yɛda ni doo maa daa nyɛla zoma ka ti neei maa faashee bɛ ni daa ti bol o ba min o ma na.
en: The Jewish leaders still did not believe that this really happened to the man—that he was blind and was now healed. But later they sent for his parents.

dag: Masia zuɣu n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri. Ka n suhu ni tɛha diri ma shɛhira Naawuni Shia Kasi sani.
en: I am in Christ and I am telling you the truth. I am not lying. And my conscience, ruled by the Holy Spirit, agrees that what I say now is true.

dag: Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia maa ni daa tum tuun shɛli n-zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu m-bala.
en: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors.

dag: Yinim Itiɔpianima bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gba.
en: Moreover, you too, Cushites, will be pierced by my sword.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni nya yolisim ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ dolila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n tɛha ni, amaa ka doli alahichi zaligu n ninsalitali biɛhigu ni.
en: Thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then Im a slave to Gods Law in my mind, but Im a slave to sins law in my body.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba maa ŋmaligi yuuni taba, ka bi baŋ o ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: His followers all looked at each other. They did not understand who Jesus was talking about.

dag: O ʒiinila o yiŋ dunɔdali gbini bee tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee.
en: She sits at the doorway of her house, on a seat at the city heights.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ wuntizɔriba ka lihi ʒiɛm bɛ tab la ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni.
en: Jesus also told this parable to people who were sure of their own goodness and despised everybody else.

dag: Ka o daa tim Izraɛl nachimba ka bɛ chaŋ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa kɔri naɣilahi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ.
en: Then Moses sent young men of Israel to offer sacrifices. These men offered bulls to the Lord as burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.

dag: Kika biɛɣu ni kum tiŋ ni, ka dabiɛm ku gbahi niriba? Yɛlibiɛɣu ni niŋ tiŋ ni, ka pa ni Yawɛ n-niŋ li?.
en: Does the war trumpet sound in a city without making the people afraid? Does disaster strike a city unless the Lord sends it?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ kpamba zaa daa bo jaaŋgbɛhi na ti ti o. Kpɛm kam jaaŋgbe yiniyini, ka di kalinli daa yiɣisi jaaŋgbɛhi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Ka Aduna jaaŋgbee daa be bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa ni.
en: Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their chiefs gave him a staff, one staff for each chief and his household, twelve staffs, and the staff of Aaron was with their staffs.

dag: Bɛ daa kulila Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya daŋ ni dɔbba, ka bɛ fali tarili daa kpalim bɛ yaannim daŋ puuni.
en: Their husbands were from Manassehs family groups, so their land remained within their fathers family group and tribe.

dag: Musa daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ binshɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses called together the whole community of the people of Israel and said to them, This is what the Lord has commanded you to do:.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be bɛnkam zaa yuri ti Duuma Yisa Masia yurilim shɛli din ku naai la ni!.
en: May grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ forever.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zadok ti zaŋ kpam yiligu din daa be suɣili ni nimaani m-booi kpam maa bahi Sulemaana zuɣu ni. Di saha ka bɛ daa piɛb kikaa, ka niriba maa zaa dii kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: Zadok took the container of olive oil which he had brought from the Tent of the Lord 's presence, and anointed Solomon. They blew the trumpet, and all the people shouted, Long live King Solomon.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Isaka zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli, ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their surrounding areas are the legacy for the clans of the Issachar tribe.

dag: Dama di daa bi ŋari m ma bidɔɣirisurigu noli, din ni chɛ ka m bi nya wahala.
en: because it didnt close the doors of my mothers womb, didnt hide trouble from my eyes.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di niŋ kamaata ni yi teei ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuumba ni daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zal la yɛla.
en: But you, dear friends, remember the words spoken beforehand by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha ka nachimba maa daa zaŋ pini maa mini liɣiri ʒiibuyi zuɣu ni Bɛnjamin n-yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti Yisifu sani.
en: So the brothers took the gifts to give to the governor. And the brothers took twice as much money with them as they took the first time. This time Benjamin went with the brothers to Egypt.

dag: M Ba, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n nya jilima a sani, jilima shɛli n ni daa pun mal a sani ka dunia na bi nam la.
en: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.

dag: O daa piila bunyama kɔbisiyi mini bulahi pisi ni piɛnyama kɔbisiyi mini piɛlahi pisi.
en: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams.

dag: O ni daa kul suhiri Yawɛ maa, ka Ɛli lihir o noli.
en: Hannah prayed to the Lord a long time. Eli was watching her mouth while she was praying.

dag: Ka Stiivin garigi yɛli, M banim mini m mabihi, wummiya! Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka na bi yiɣisi looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ daa yi o zuɣu.
en: Stephen answered, My Jewish fathers and brothers, listen to me. Our great and glorious God appeared to Abraham, our ancestor, when he was in Mesopotamia. This was before he lived in Haran.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa bari zani puu maa sunsuuni n-zabi di zuɣu, ka daa ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ di nasara pam.
