en: but Shammah took a position in the middle of the plot, defended it, and struck down the Philistines. The LORD accomplished a great victory.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ ba lala hal ni Kadɛshibarinia zaŋ ti paai Gaza zaŋ tabili Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali lala hal ti paai Gibiɔn.
en: Joshua captured all the cities from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza. He captured all the cities from Goshen to Gibeon.

dag: Yi churi puhibu ni, yi ŋmɛrila goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnima, ka piɛbiri yuhi, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka nyuri wain, amaa ka bɛ lihi nya Yawɛ tuma bee n-lihi nya o yiko tuma.
en: At your feasts you have harps and tambourines and flutes—and wine. But you don't understand what the Lord is doing.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ku vuui bɛ zaashee; bɛ kul ni teeri bɛ yɛla sahakam.
en: Such good people will never fall. They will always be remembered.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti lan kana ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: When the day came for the heavenly beings to appear before the Lord again, Satan was there among them.

dag: Ka o daa ŋme chɛrubinim mini gbuɣima ni abie tihi kɔtomsi pa di bintaɣirisi mini di dapaɣa zuɣu kaman di zaɣ yini kam ni ni tooi deei palo shɛm tariga, ka mali biŋgolima gil li.
en: The sides of the cart and the frames had pictures of Cherub angels, lions, and palm trees carved into the bronze. These pictures were carved all over the carts—wherever there was room. And there were flowers carved on the frame around the cart.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika maa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔri ni n wuh a n yuli? Dama n yuli maa nyɛla alahiziba yuli.
en: The angel of the Lord said, Why do you ask my name? It is too amazing for you to believe. .

dag: Ka o daa kab dari pa bimbin maa zuɣu, ka ŋmahiŋmahi naɣilaa maa nimdi pa dari maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ba, Niŋmiya kom pali koyuya anahi n-kpaai li tɛli sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ mini dari maa.
en: Then he placed the wood on the altar, cut the bull in pieces, and laid it on the wood. He said, Fill four jars with water and pour it on the offering and the wood. They did so.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ninkura maa yɛligu maa wumbu, ka dolila o bipalitab bɛn min o laɣim zooi ka bɛ be o san la yɛligu.
en: But Rehoboam ignored the advice the elders gave him and instead sought the counsel of the young advisors who had grown up with him and now served him.

dag: Yawɛ darigi n tibili pam, amaa o bi chɛ ka n kpi.
en: The Lord punished me, but he did not let me die.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ ni daa niŋ ania la zuɣu, ti booni ba la bɛn mal alibarika. Yi pun wum Ayuba ania niŋbu yɛla, ka nya ti Duuma daliri ni daa nyɛ shɛm di puuni, ka lan nya ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo zaŋ chaŋ o polo min o baɣa ni daa be o ni shɛm.
en: We call them happy because they endured. You have heard of Job's patience, and you know how the Lord provided for him in the end. For the Lord is full of mercy and compassion.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi nyeei, so ku tooi lih o, ka pɔhim yi ʒe sagbana chaŋ ka chɛ o, o kul nyaɣisirimi.
en: And now the light in the sky is dazzling, too bright for us to look at it; and the sky has been swept clean by the wind.

dag: Di saha ka n daa kpe di ni nti nya ka bɛ ŋmɛla biŋgbamda mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi zaa ni Izraɛl buɣa zaa kɔtomsi pa gooni maa zuɣu gili.
en: So I went in and looked. The walls were covered with drawings of snakes and other unclean animals, and of the other things which the Israelites were worshiping.

dag: kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa sab bɛ yuya maa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: Moses did exactly what the Lord commanded—he counted the people while they were in the desert of Sinai.

dag: Di saha n ni ti darigi bɛn muɣisiri ya la tibili, ka tiligi gbariti, ka laɣim bɛ ni kari shɛb bahi la, ka chɛ ka bɛ vi leei jilima, ka bɛ yuli du dunia zaa ni.
en: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.

dag: Lala ka paɣ shɛb bɛn bebu daa be kasi, ka bɛ mali tahima Naawuni sani daa yi maani bɛmaŋa, ka deeri bɛ yidaannim noya.
en: For it was in this way that holy women who trusted in God used to make themselves beautiful, accepting the authority of their own husbands.

dag: O ni daa mali ti miriti Damaskus, o nini nyabu yim ka neesim shɛli yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gil o;.
en: During the journey, as he approached Damascus, suddenly a light from heaven encircled him.

dag: Kɔnyuri gbaai biliɛɣu hal ka o lɔŋni ti kuui zaa. Bihi suhiri bindirigu, amaa ka so bi tiri ba shɛli.
en: They let their babies die of hunger and thirst; children are begging for food that no one will give them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba bɛn daa nyɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu daa yi Kɛila maa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa naan tooi chaŋ. Ka Sool daa wum ni Dauda yi Kɛila maa zo, ka o chɛ o naba karibu.
en: David and his men got out of there fast and started moving from place to place. Saul heard that David had left Keilah, and he decided not to go after him.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashee kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Many people are nice to a generous person. Everyone wants to be friends with someone who gives gifts.

dag: Niriba yi ti neei kum ni, bɛ bi lan yɛn kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba; bɛ ti kul yɛn bemi kaman malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni la.
en: When people rise from death, there will be no marriage. People will not be married to each other. All people will be like angels in heaven.

dag: Kpammi bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ binyara bundaannim la jaande ni bɛ di mali karimbaani, ka mi di zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ buni din nyɛ din kul ku be sahakam ŋɔ ni, amaa ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ tahima niŋla Naawuni ŋun tiri ti binshɛɣukam ni ti mali maani ti bukaata ŋɔ ni.
en: Command those who are rich in the things of this life not to be proud, but to place their hope, not in such an uncertain thing as riches, but in God, who generously gives us everything for our enjoyment.

dag: Di simdi ka yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka lumiy o kɔŋko sizuura, ka dol o zaligunima, ka deeg o noli, ka jɛmiy o, ka ʒe o yim.
en: Follow the Lord and honor him; obey him and keep his commands; worship him and be faithful to him.

dag: Yawɛ, tibimi ma, ka n kpaŋ, tiligim ma, ka n tiligi, dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni paɣiri so.
en: You, Lord , are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.

dag: Ka a bih ayi shɛb a ni pun dɔɣi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni pɔi ka n naanyi kul a sanna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na la nyɛla m bihi. Ifriim mini Manaasa nyɛla m bihi kaman Rubin mini Simiɔn ni nyɛ m bihi shɛm la.
en: Now you have two sons. These two sons were born here in the country of Egypt before I came. Your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, will be like my own sons. They will be like Reuben and Simeon to me.

dag: Ka o kpee maa garigi yɛl o, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Jɔash bia Gidiɔn ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nir la takɔbi. Naawuni pun zaŋ Midiannim mini bɛ tɔbbihi ŋɔ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The mans friend knew the meaning of the dream. He said, Your dream can only have one meaning. Your dream is about that man from Israel. It is about Gideon son of Joash. It means that God will let Gideon defeat the whole army of Midian.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Saimɔn, yi gbihirimi? Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: He came and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, Simon, are you asleep? Couldnt you stay alert for one hour?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N ni be a sani. Dimbɔŋɔ mi n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri ni mani n-tim a, a yi ti yihi niriba maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, yi ni ti jɛmdi man Naawuni zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: God answered, I will be with you, and when you bring the people out of Egypt, you will worship me on this mountain. That will be the proof that I have sent you.

dag: Bolimi pumpɔŋɔ, so beni ŋun ni garig a? Ka malaika ŋuni sani ka a lee yɛn ŋmaligi chaŋ?.
en: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!.

dag: Zanimiya luɣ kasi shee kaman yi daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka Lɛvinim be bɛ ni piripiri yi zuliya daŋ niriba maa pirigibu kam puuni.
en: Divide yourselves into groups, then arrange yourselves throughout the temple so that each family of worshipers will be able to get help from one of you.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni.
en: A leader of the synagogue came. His name was Jairus. He saw Jesus and bowed down before him.

dag: Ka zaŋ ti m-buɣisi ti nachintab bɛn diri nayili bindirigu ka nyuri di binnyura la n-nya ti bebu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ka a yi kpahim ti nya, nyin niŋm tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kaman a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm.
en: Then after ten days, compare us with the other young men who eat the kings food. See for yourself who looks healthier, and then decide how you want to treat us, your servants.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti tum tuma dindali maa, n ni yihi dilan maa niriba sunsuuni.
en: And if any do any work on that day, the Lord himself will put them to death.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Dɔr bɔ n-lee be a suhu ni ka a tum dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa, din nyɛ vi kalinsi pagɔrisigu tuma ŋɔ?.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: You have done all this like a shameless prostitute.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔŋda ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi ni m mali taali? Bɛ zaa ni kpi kaman siturili la. Lɛla ni ŋub ba zaa.
en: The Sovereign Lord himself defends me— who, then, can prove me guilty? All my accusers will disappear; they will vanish like moth-eaten cloth.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman alahichi ni nyaŋ sokam kum puuni shɛm, lala ka Naawuni daalibarika gba nyaŋ di nasara wuntia puuni, ka tahi nyɛvili din ka bahigu na ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo.
en: The result is that grace will rule through Gods righteousness, leading to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord, just as sin ruled in death.

dag: N ni niŋ a daŋ niriba kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba mini Ahija bia Baasha daŋ niriba shɛm la, a ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi, ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu.
en: Your whole family will be wiped out, just like the families of King Jeroboam and King Baasha. You've made the Lord very angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli Sukɔtinima, N suhiri ya, niŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro ti n niriba bɛn doli ma ŋɔ; dama di wum ba pam, ka m mi na kariti dolila Midian nanim Zɛba mini Zalimuna.
en: When they arrived at Sukkoth, he said to the men of the town, Please give my men some loaves of bread. They are exhausted, and I am chasing Zebah and Zalmunna, the Midianite kings.

dag: Amaa di bahi ni mini di biɛma ni kom din ti ku niŋ nyaɣisim. Din ti kul yɛn nyɛla din mali yalim.
en: But the marshes along the shore will remain salty, so that people can use the salt from them.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti birigi ka chɛ a soli? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti niŋ tipawumli n-zo a sani? Labimi ti sanna, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba la mini zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ a niriba la zuɣu.
en: Why do you lead us astray, LORD, from your ways? Why do you harden our heart so we dont fear you? Return for the sake of your servants the tribes that are your heritage!.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga yin doliya zaligu ŋɔ.
en: If the bull kills a boy or a girl, the same rule applies.

dag: Dama Ɛzra daa zaŋ o suhu n-niŋla Yawɛ zaligu bɔhimbu ni, ka daa dol li, ka mali zaligu shɛŋa mini biɛhigu soya zaligunim wuhiri Izraɛlnima.
en: Ezra had always given his time and attention to studying and obeying the law of the Lord . He also loved to teach its rules and commandments to others in Israel.

dag: A yi chana, di ni wuh a soli, a yi gbihira, di ni gul a, a yi ti neei, di ni dir a alizama.
en: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.

dag: Bɛ daa niŋ naani, ka naani goo ti kuhi ba. Ka bɛ daa ti paai, ka bɛ laasabu parigi.
en: but their hope dies beside dry streams.

dag: N wum anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli ŋmari ʒiri yɛra, N zahimla zahindi, n zahimla zahindi.
en: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ti doli n ni kariti zuliya shɛb ka chɛri ya ŋɔ kaya, dama bɛ daa tumdila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, dinzuɣu ka n zaɣisi ba.
en: I am forcing other people to leave that country because they committed all those sins. I hate those sins! So dont live the way those people lived.

dag: Ka olivi tiwula ayi shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi salima bimmulima ayi shɛŋa ni bɛ ni boori olivi kpam la mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: Then I responded a second time, What are these two olive branches that empty out golden oil through the two gold pipes.

dag: ka Arɔd daŋ niriba nyɛ Arɔdnima; ka Arɛli mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Arɛlinima.
en: from Arod, the Arodite clan; from Areli, the Arelite clan.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ ni ka yaa yɛla pam ni zuɣu, o ni tooi di suɣilo o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be ʒilinsi ni mini bɛn chirindi polo.
en: The high priest is able to deal gently with the ignorant and those who are misled since he himself is prone to weakness.

dag: ka hal teeku kɔgbana yi vuri ka ŋmuɣinda, ka hal di vubu maa yi chɛ ka zoya sɔhira, ti ku zɔri dabiɛm.
en: We are not afraid when the seas become rough and dark and the mountains tremble. Selah.

dag: n-chɛ ka bɛ laɣim niriba maa zaa na gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali, ka bɛ mini bɛ zuliya ti sab bɛ yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gari lala.
en: called together the whole community on the first day of the second month and registered all the people by clans and families. The names of all the men twenty years old or older were recorded and counted.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi daɣiri ni m-bala, di yi pa lala bɛ ni saɣim m biɛhigu shee din be bɛ sunsuuni ŋɔ ka kpi ni bɛ daɣiri.
en: The Lord told Moses to warn the people of Israel about their uncleanness, so that they would not defile the Tent of his presence, which was in the middle of the camp. If they did, they would be killed.

dag: Di saha ka Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm daa chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni nti yɛli tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: Hamor and his son Shechem went to the meeting place at the city gate and spoke to the people of the town:.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa;.
en: Make chains of pure gold twisted like cords for the chest pendant.

dag: Bɛ yi ti paai goli yini, nyin zalim ba ka bɛ yo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu, ka bɛ daa zali ba kaman Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri zahimbu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Their redemption price from one month of age you will calculate at five shekels of silver according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali sara maligu bimbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla. Malimiya li zaɣ mɔɣu.
en: Use acacia wood to build an altar . meters square and . meters high.

dag: N ni tim malaika na ka o ti be yi tooni n-guli ya yi chandi maa ni hal ti zaŋ ya paai n ni mali luɣ shɛli zali ya la ni.
en: I am sending an angel before you to protect you along the way and to lead you to the place that I have prepared for you.

dag: Naa yi wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, o kpamba zaa yɛn nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.

dag: ni nuzaa polo nanim zaa bɛn be katinsi ni yoma zaa ti nyu li ka ti taba. Ka dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni ti nyu li. Babilɔn naa nti yɛn bahindi bɛ zaa nyaaŋa nyu li.
en: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ buɣim dabi tiŋ maa, ka di di tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, naɣila anzinfa mini salima ni daanya kuriti la kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma biɛhigu shee.
en: Then the Israelites burned the whole city and everything in it except for the things made from silver, gold, bronze, and iron. They put these things in the Lord s treasury.

dag: M be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je suhudoo sani n-yuui pam.
en: Ive lived far too long with people who hate peace.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o bidibbina maa ti o bia maa ka yɛl o, Zaŋmi li kuli yiŋa.
en: Jonathan handed his weapons to the boy and told him, Get going. Take these back to town.

dag: Wumma! N suhu n-yɛli ma ni n garig a, dama di muɣisi ma pam n suhu ni.
en: You upset me, so I must answer you. I must tell you what I am thinking.

dag: Kɔbulli yɛliya, Di ka n ni, ka teeku yɛli, Di ka n sani.
en: The deep ocean says, Its not here with me. The sea says, Its not here with me.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi Naawuni nam maa ni kpɛbu tahima la nti bahi bumbɔn ni; nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: But the children of the kingdom will be thrown outside into the darkness. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka bɛ daa lee baptaizi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu ka ti daa deei.
en: Then he said, What baptism did you receive, then? They answered, Johns baptism.

dag: Amaa yi bi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni gbahi ba chaŋ la, n ni zaŋ ba kulisi nimaani ka bɛ ti baŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ʒiɛm maa.
en: But your children, whom you said would be taken by force, Ill bring them in and they will know the land that you rejected.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla duno shɛli din labiri wulinluhili polo la mini Shalɛkɛt duno shɛli din be pal shɛli din be kunkuni zuɣu palli polo n-ti Shupim mini Hɔsa. Ka bɛ daa gul li ka tiri taba.
en: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen for the West Gate and the Shalleketh Gate on the upper road. Guards stood side by side.

dag: Izraɛlnim mini Judanim Naawuni, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ bi zaɣisi ba, hal alahichi ni kul pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani maa zaa yoli.
en: Everyone in Israel and Judah is guilty. But I, the Lord All-Powerful, their holy God, have not abandoned them.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zakaria zilinjila daa dii lɔrigi, ka o nya noli gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: Then Zechariah could talk again, and he began praising God.

dag: dama yi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ pala din tiri Yisa nyaandoliba din simdi ba kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla din chɛ ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu pam di zuɣu.
en: Your ministry of this service to Gods people isnt only fully meeting their needs but it is also multiplying in many expressions of thanksgiving to God.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ bi zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ kɔhi kaman tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri n-zaŋ ti nandaamba.
en: This perfume was worth a years wages! Why wasnt it sold and the money given to the poor? .

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa;.
en: When Jesus finished these words, the crowds were amazed at his teaching.

dag: fɔntiŋ kara mini fɔndi zaa din baɣi Ashidɔd la m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: They also got the area west of Ekron and all the fields and towns near Ashdod.

dag: Ka n ti wum lahibali ni Yɛhudianim dɔni n-gu o soli, dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka bɛ tah o a sanna yomyom maa; ka yɛli bɛn fiɣisir o maa ni bɛ kam a sanna nti yɛl a bɛ ni fiɣisir o shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: I was told that some of the Jews were making a plan to kill him. So I decided to send him to you. I also told those Jews to tell you what they have against him.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ kɔŋko nti di bindir shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara bɛ maligumaaniba leebu saha maa. Amaa di bi simdi ka ŋun pa maligumaana ti di li, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: They alone should eat the food that was used to purify them, to ordain them, and to make them holy. No one else should eat it because it is holy.

dag: N ni yɛli nuzaa polo nim ni bɛ bahimi ba ka bɛ kuna; ka yɛli nudirigu polo nim ni bɛ di gbibi ba. Chɛliya ka m bidibisi bɛn be katiŋ ha kuna, ka chɛ ka m bipuɣinsi bɛn be dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ ni zaa kuna.
en: I will say to the north and to the south, Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.

dag: Ka ti daa chaŋ ti baɣisi tiŋgban bil shɛli din be kom sunsuuni ka bɛ booni li Kauda la gari, ka di daa taɣi ti ka chɛ pɔhim maa. Ti wahala nyabu ŋɔ puuni ti daa kpaŋ timaŋa ni ti lo ŋarin bil din daa baɣi ŋarin titali maa tabili ka di ku lu.
en: We got some shelter when we passed to the south of the little island of Cauda. There, with some difficulty we managed to make the ship's boat secure.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛl o, Bimbuɣisirigu. Di saha ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Nyama, n zaŋla bimbuɣisirigu sɔŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni; n ku lan ka bɛ sanna yaha.
en: The Lord said to me, Amos, what do you see? I said, A plumb line. Then the Lord said to me, See, I will put a plumb line among my people Israel. I will not let their crooked ways pass inspection anymore.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani hal abada, amaa o daalahichi maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven. They will always be guilty of that sin.

dag: Ka o daa ti zaŋ bɛ farigu tahi ti yo Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn. Naa Ɛgilɔn daa nyɛla ninvuɣ karili.
en: Ehud and some other Israelites took the taxes to Eglon, who was a very fat man. As soon as they gave the taxes to Eglon, Ehud said it was time to go home.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun nya gballi ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o suhu paligi?.
en: They are not happy till they are dead and buried;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yi tiŋ maa ni n-chaŋ biɛla ha saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, Yiɣisim kari niriba maa naba, a yi ti paai ba, nyin bɔhim ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zu n daanzinfa pipia?.
en: They had left the city but hadnt gone far when Joseph said to his household manager, Get ready, go after the men and catch up with them! Ask them, Why have you repaid hospitality with ingratitude?.

dag: N niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ alahichinima ka yɛra, Zaɣ biɛɣu ku niŋ ti shɛli bee m-paai ti la, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed.

dag: Yinim Dibɔnnim bɛn ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ, yiɣisimiya jilima ʒiishee maa ti ʒini tiŋgban ni. Dama ŋun saɣindi Mɔab la kana ti liri ya. O saɣim yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli la.
en: You people living in Dibon, come down from your place of honor. Sit on the ground in the dust, because the Destroyer is coming. And he will destroy your strong cities.

dag: Ka Liya min o bihi kana ti gban o tiŋa, ka Yisifu mini Reechɛl gba doli nyaaŋa na ti gban o tiŋa.
en: then Leah and her children came, and last of all Joseph and Rachel came and bowed down.

dag: Bia ŋɔ ka n daa suhi maa, ka Yawɛ daa deei n suhigu ka shiri ti ma n ni daa suh o bɔri shɛli maa.
en: I asked him for this child, and he gave me what I asked for.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nti yɛn kari dunia ŋɔ nim saria? Ka yinima n-yi nyɛ bɛn ni ti kari dunianim saria, dindina yi ku tooi kari yimaŋmaŋ sunsuuni yɛtɔɣ bihi saria?.
en: Or dont you know that Gods people will judge the world? If the world is to be judged by you, are you incompetent to judge trivial cases?.

dag: Zuliya shɛb gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ŋ-ŋmaligi lu di ni; bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bari tɔn shɛli ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The nations have fallen into the hole they themselves made! Their feet are caught in the very net they themselves hid!.

dag: Ka nira yi vuɣi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee, di nyaaŋa bɛ biɛhigu shee maa ni zaɣisi ba ka yɛli, Man na ʒi n-nyan ya.
en: But if you move it, it will die, and no one can tell it was ever there.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo bo o dokpee kaman paɣ la, di nyɛla din chihira.
en: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Mitika maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hashimɔna.
en: They marched from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bimparilan shɛli din pari gbɛɣu zuɣu ka di nyɛ din be kasi, ka sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni mali nintu shɛli dalinli dihiri tabindi binyara zuɣu la. Sabbu maa n-daa nyɛ: O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: They made the flower ornament for the holy crown out of pure gold. Like the engraving on an official seal, they engraved on it the saying Holy to the LORD.

dag: So ni tooi baŋ saa ni kuri shɛm bee saa tahigu din yiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni na?.
en: Even if one perceives a spreading cloud and the thunder of his pavilion.

dag: Timiya ba tuun kpɛma pam ka bɛ tumda din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan gbilisi tibili wum yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Make them work so hard that they won't have time to listen to these lies.

dag: Di sɔɣi bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi maa a sani, dama bɛ yɛli zilima pam tammɛriba maa ninni.
en: Dont take away their guilt or forgive the sins they have done in your sight. They have insulted and discouraged the builders.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tumdi buɣijɛmbo tuma niriba maa sani, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim birigi n-tum alahichi la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu m poya zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ni bɛ ni nya tibidarigibo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But the Levites helped the people sin against me! They helped the people worship their idols! So I am making this promise against them: They will be punished for their sin. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: ka ni be kasitali mini wuntitali ni o sani hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: in a way that is holy and right for as long as we live.

dag: N yaannim ni daa ku tiŋ shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa la, buɣ dini n-daa lee tooi fa di niriba n nuu ni, ka yinim Naawuni ni ti tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni?.
en: When did any of the gods of all those countries ever save their country from us? Then what makes you think that your god can save you?.

dag: Yi yi yuri taba, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba. .
en: This is how everyone will know that you are my disciples, when you love each other.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa tin ya ni yi be di ni la tin yin ni.
en: The Lord your God has given you cities to live in. Sometimes you might hear some bad news about one of these cities. You might hear that.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Mɛkɔna ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: and in Ziklag, in Meconah and the small towns around it.

dag: N nyɛla a dabili; tim ma baŋsim, din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: I am your servant. Give me wisdom to understand your rules.

dag: Ka bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa daa sɔŋ ba n-ti ba anzinfa nɛma mini salima ni nɛma ni biŋkɔbiri ni binshɛŋa din mali bukaata m-pahi niriba suhu ni daa yu ka bɛ ti binshɛlikam zaa.
en: All their neighbors helped them by giving them many things: silver utensils, gold, supplies, pack animals, other valuables, and offerings for the Temple.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnim yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnima, ka zaŋ biŋkumda kumsi paɣ o.
en: Sing your praises to the LORD with the lyre— with the lyre and the sound of music.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba, ka guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdaya. Bɛ ni ti kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb nyɔri buɣim maani sara la mini niriba ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti mali sara la. Bɛ ni ti tumdi tuma tiri niriba maa.
en: They may serve me in the Temple by taking charge of the gates and by performing the work of the Temple. They may kill the animals which the people offer for burnt offerings and for sacrifices, and they are to be on duty to serve the people.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti kpɛna n-gbaai salo maa yulibu nti nya do so ka o bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa binyɛrigu.
en: When the king went in to meet the guests, he found that one of them wasn't wearing the right kind of clothes for the wedding.

dag: Bɛ tirila pagɔra zaa liɣiri, amaa nyini n-lee tiri a mamanim zaa pina ni bɛ yi luɣilikam zaa kana a pagɔrisigu tuma maa zuɣu.
en: Most prostitutes force men to pay them for sex, but you gave money to your many lovers. You paid all the men around to come in to have sex with you.

dag: N nyɛvili kul bela barina ni sahakam, amaa m bi tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: Though my life is constantly in danger, I wont forget your Instruction.

dag: Dama n yi saɣim yi suhuri, banima n-nyɛ bɛn ni chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli, ka pa ni n ni saɣim yinima ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri maa?.
en: If I make you sad, then who will make me happy? Only you can make me happy—you, the ones I made sad.

dag: O ni daa di bindirigu maa ka nyu kom naai nyaaŋa ka o daa pa buŋ nyaampara ti o ni daa bol a anab so labisina maa.
en: After they had finished eating, the old prophet saddled the donkey for the prophet from Judah.

dag: Mbusim be n zuɣu, n ni nya biɛrim shɛli zuɣu. N daŋ maa yaɣiya! Amaa ka n yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n tibidarigibo m-bala, di kpala talahi ni n deei li.
en: The people answered, We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?.

dag: Madimɛnanim mini Gɛbimnim zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi.
en: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.

dag: Ka Keen yɛli Yawɛ, N tibidarigibo maa galisiya gari ma.
en: Cain said to the LORD, My punishment is more than I can bear.

dag: Ka so yi ti bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya a nyɔɣu ni dansi ŋɔ? O ni garigi yɛli, N zo yiŋ ka n nya dansi maa.
en: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, It happened at the house of some friends.

dag: Mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam; dama a ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ chaŋ ti di tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima alikauli ni n ni zaŋ li ti ba la fali.
en: Be brave and strong, because you are the one who will help this people take possession of the land, which I pledged to give to their ancestors.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Hɛrɔd saha la ka baŋdib shɛb daa yi wulimpuhili polo ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Jesus was born in the town of Bethlehem in Judea during the time when Herod was king. After Jesus was born, some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa yina ti teei zani bɛ tiŋ maa tooni, ka na shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba maa mi ʒe mɔɣu ni palo ni bɛ ko.
en: The Ammonites came out and got ready for battle. They were near the city gate. The kings who had come to help stayed out in the fields by themselves.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛli ma, Di bi simdi ni a me yili ti ma, dama a nyɛla tɔbbia ŋun ku niriba pam.
en: but he has forbidden me to do it, because I am a soldier and have shed too much blood.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya ni suhudoo. Yawɛ nuu pa yi zuɣu yi chandi maa ni.
en: The priest said to the five men, Yes. Go in peace. The Lord will lead you on your way.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la kɔŋ nasara, ka di vi! Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo la birim ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Let those who want me dead be humiliated and put to shame. Let those who intend to hurt me be thoroughly frustrated and disgraced.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ba chaŋ Babilɔn maa nyaaŋa ka Jɛkɔnia daa dɔɣi Shialtiɛl, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl ba.
en: From the exile to the birth of Jesus, his ancestors were: Jehoiachin, Shealtiel, Zerubbabel, Abiud, Eliakim, Azor, Zadok, Achim; Eliud, Eleazar, Matthan, Jacob, and Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who is called the Messiah.

dag: Ka so mi beni, o ka suhupiɛlli, ka ti kpi ni suhugarigu.
en: Others have no happiness at all; they live and die with bitter hearts.

dag: N ku lan chɛ ka yi wum zuliya shɛb turi, yi mi ku lan nya filiŋ zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya maa lu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The land will no longer have to listen to the nations making fun of it or see the peoples sneer at it. The land will no longer rob the nation of its children. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Nyini n-nam zibisim, ka di nyɛ yuŋ, ka biŋkɔbiri bɛn be yɔɣu ni yirina gɔra.
en: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.

dag: N kahigi n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi; n suhu saɣimya n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Lord, I told you about the evil I have done. I am sorry for my sin.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ ba ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ di ba fali yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka bɛ leei bɛ ni su shɛba sahakam. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bɛna n-leei yi daba, amaa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛna, di zaŋya ninkuunsi su taba.
en: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt paɣ ŋun daa be o nyaaŋa daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka leei yalim kuɣili.
en: But Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a pillar of salt.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ŋub o suhudoo sara maligu maa nimdi daba ata maa dali, dilan sara maligu maa ku lan gbaai, ka bɛ ku kal li kpɛhi sara maligu ni, di ni ti nyɛla din bi be kasi, ka ŋun ti ŋub li ni ti ʒi di zambu.
en: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted. It will not be credited to the one who offered it. It will be considered foul, and the person who eats of it will be liable to punishment.

dag: Nail Mɔɣili kom ni filim, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui zaa.
en: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiini yila paɣiri ka puhiri Yawɛ yɛra: Dama o viɛla ka o yurilim zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo kul beni sahakam. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kul tahiri pampam paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ duu maa tampuɣili maa zuɣu.
en: They praised and gave thanks to the LORD, singing responsively, He is good, his graciousness for Israel lasts forever. All of the people shouted with praise to the LORD because the foundation of the LORDs house had been laid.

dag: Hazɔr ni ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam, ka yɔbahi ti gɔri di ni. So ti ku lan be nimaani bee ka so ti lan ʒini di ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Only jackals will live where your villages once stood. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ifriim zuliya maa tinzuɣu nyɛla Samaria, ka Samarianim zuɣulana nyɛ Rɛmalia bia la. Yi yi bi niŋ yɛda viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ku di nasara.
en: Ephraim depends on its capital Samaria, and Samaria is led by Remaliahs son. So you have no reason to fear. Believe this, or you will not survive.

dag: Kum daa ti lan lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di daa nyɛla kum din pahi din daa pun lu Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la zuɣu. Ka Yisahaku daa chaŋ Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk sani Gɛra.
en: There was another famine in the land besides the earlier one during the time of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka di niŋdiya shɛli bɛ nini yi beni zuɣu ni bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiya lala ni suhu yini Naawuni zɔbu zuɣu.
en: Slaves, obey your human masters in all things, not only when they are watching you because you want to gain their approval; but do it with a sincere heart because of your reverence for the Lord.

dag: ti yɛli Nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ wuhi ti o jilima min o galisim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ti nyaya ni Naawuni ni tooi tɔɣisi ninsal yɛtɔɣa, ka ninsal maa na be o nyɛvili ni.
en: and you said: Look here! The LORD our God has shown us his glory and greatness. Weve heard his voice come out of the very fire itself. Weve seen firsthand that God can speak to a human being and they can survive!.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni a dol ti chaŋ. Dama tinim yi ŋmaligi guui bɛ baɣa ku be ti ni, ka ti pirigili yi kpi, bɛ baɣa ku be ti ni, a kɔŋko saɣi ti niriba tuhi pia, dinzuɣu di simdi ka a kpalim yiŋ ŋɔ, ka lee tir ti sɔŋsim na.
en: But the troops replied, No! You must not march out! If we flee, they wont care about us. Even if half of us die, they wont care about us. But you are worth ten thousand of us. It is much better if you support us from the city.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi piligu ni hal ti paai di bahigu ni, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Hanani bia Jɛhu yɛlikura sabbu ni, ka di be Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Jehoshaphat did, from the beginning of his reign to its end, is recorded in The History of Jehu Son of Hanani which is a part of The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni wum ti paɣ so ŋun bol omaŋa anabi ka o yuli booni Jɛzibɛl la zuɣu. O nyɛla ŋun yɔhindi n jɛmdiba n-wuhiri ba ka bɛ niŋdi zina, ka diri buɣa maligu nimdi.
en: But I have this against you: you put up with that woman, Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. You allow her to teach and to mislead my servants into committing sexual immorality and eating food sacrificed to idols.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali ba kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm, bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihita.
en: There were men in the families of the Gershon family group who were qualified.

dag: ka olivi tih ayi ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu maa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo.
en: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.

dag: N nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul nahindila niriba ka duri zuɣusaa kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tihi la.
en: I once saw a wicked man who was powerful. He was like a strong, healthy tree.

dag: ka yɛli Yisa, Karimba, paɣ ŋɔ bela zina tumbu ni ka ti gbaag o.
en: They said to Jesus, Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa bɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ tusaata bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi n-chaŋ ni o ti bɔ Dauda min o niriba maa shee Yɔbuhi Tampima tooni polo.
en: So Saul chose men from all over Israel and began searching for David and his men. They looked near Wild Goat Rocks.

dag: n-yi a biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo katiŋ kana. A mini niriba bɛn be a sani zaa nyɛla wɔribariba, ka nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa ka galisi pam.
en: to come from your place in the far north, leading a large, powerful army of soldiers from many nations, all of them on horseback.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla n naba firila mini n soli neesim.
en: Your word is like a lamp that guides my steps, a light that shows the path I should take.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha mini tiŋgban ni; dina n-nyɛ: ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi din tuɣiri sagbana ni.
en: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.

dag: N shia, labim a vuhim shee na, dama Yawɛ niŋ a nirilim pam.
en: I tell myself, You can be at peace again, because the LORD has been good to you.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba tahi naa sanna.
en: At that, the king flew into a rage and ordered the three men to be brought before him.

dag: Ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee zuɣusaa ha n-daa nam li, ka ninsalinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila salinsahi. O teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman sɔŋ la bee kaman tanti shɛl ni nir ni yɛn kpe m-beni.
en: It was made by the one who sits on his throne above the earth and beyond the sky; the people below look as tiny as ants. He stretched out the sky like a curtain, like a tent in which to live.

dag: Bɛn daa niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zaa daa malila suhu yini ni tɛhi yini, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛli ni o ni su shɛli nyɛla o kɔŋko dini, amaa bɛ zaa daa laɣim sula bɛ ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The whole group of believers was united in their thinking and in what they wanted. None of them said that the things they had were their own. Instead, they shared everything.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri nambɔɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti zo bɛ gba nambɔɣu.
en: Happy are people who show mercy, because they will receive mercy.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Yisa nyaandoliba maa ansarisi yɛra, Bɛ nyula dam kuli.
en: But others made fun of the believers, saying, These people are drunk.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa piligi yihiri waazu n-yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina .
en: Then Jesus started preaching, Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.

dag: ka yɛli di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N je a yɛlli, n ni ŋooi n takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni.
en: Say to the land of Israel, This is what the Lord said: I am against you! I will pull my sword from its sheath. I will remove all people from you—the good and the evil.

dag: O tim a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli, ka chɛ ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa pali.
en: Let God grant what is in your heart and fulfill all your plans.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia daa yɛli gbaŋŋmara Shafan, N nyala Naawuni zaligu kundi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni; ka daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan ka o karim li.
en: The high priest Hilkiah told Shaphan the secretary: I have found the Instruction scroll in the LORDs temple. Then Hilkiah turned the scroll over to Shaphan, who read it.

dag: N chɛ ka baɣisi leei jɛra, ka chɛ ka baŋdiba bɛn yɛri binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla birinda; ka chɛ ka yɛnnim baŋsim leei jɛrilim.
en: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Dinzuɣu deemiya liɣiri maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ tuhi pia ŋɔ;.
en: So the master told his other servants, Take the one bag of money from that servant and give it to the servant who has ten bags.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee niŋ ti Mɔdɛkai din ni ti o jilima? Ka o naazɔnim bɛn be o sani yɛl o, Ti bi niŋ shɛl ti o.
en: What was done to honor and reward Mordecai for this? the king asked. His young male servants replied, Nothing was done for him, sir.

dag: Mirim ma, tiligim ma; fam ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Come to me and save me; rescue me from my enemies.

dag: A nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam ma, tim ma yɛm, ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: With your hands you made me and helped me become what I am. Now help me learn and understand your commands.

dag: Piɛguliba ni ti zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu kana ti lu o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ti bɛ suɣa gil o. Bɛ ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam mɔri.
en: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a zaligunim mali suhudoo pam; ka binshɛli ku chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu.
en: Those who love your teachings will find true peace. Nothing can make them fall.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka di puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini diribarilim.
en: How terrible it will be for you legal experts and Pharisees! Hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and plate, but inside they are full of violence and pleasure seeking.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, yinim Ibrahimma zuliya mini yinim bɛn pa ti zuliya ka be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri Naawuni, tinim ka Naawuni daa tahi tiliginsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ na ti ti.
en: My fellow Israelites, descendants of Abraham, and all Gentiles here who worship God: it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm piɛgul so ŋun ka buchi nɛma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Once again act the part of a shepherd, this time a worthless one.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba ni; ka chɛ ka a yurilim taɣi ba kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la.
en: Lord , when you bless good people, you surround them with your love, like a large shield that protects them.

dag: ka o daa nya ba ka yɛli, Naawuni sansani m-bɔŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Mahanaim.
en: When Jacob saw them, he said, This is Gods camp, and he named that sacred place Mahanaim.

dag: Pa Zallakudura Naa n-zaani zaɣ viɛlli mini zaɣ biɛɣu ka di niŋda?.
en: Good and evil alike take place at his command.

dag: Di bi simdi ni nir di shiri pam bee m-bɔri jilima ti yaɣi.
en: Just as eating too much honey is not good, it is not good for people to always be looking for honor.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai tiŋgbɔna nam kam zaa dabiɛm, bɛ ni daa wum Yawɛ ni tuhi Izraɛlnim dimnim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: People in all the surrounding kingdoms became afraid of God when they heard that the Lord fought against the enemies of Israel.

dag: A yi ti jɛrigu jilima, di ŋmanila a ni lo kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni la.
en: Praising someone who is stupid makes as much sense as tying a stone in a sling.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la bɛn dee li sani.
en: God's wisdom, however, is shown to be true by all who accept it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa labiri kuna ka Yisa doli ba. O ni daa ti miri sapashini maa yiŋa ka sapashini maa lan tim o zɔnim Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni o di nahim omaŋa, dama ni ŋun sapashini maa pɔri ni Yisa ka o yiŋ na.
en: Jesus went with them. He had almost reached the house when the centurion sent friends to say to Jesus, Lord, dont be bothered. I dont deserve to have you come under my roof.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa ni zali ni bɛ zaŋ binshɛŋa maa zaa na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-miri ti zani Yawɛ tooni.
en: They brought to the front of the Tent everything that Moses had commanded, and the whole community assembled there to worship the Lord .

dag: Birim a bimbira asiba ni zaawuni, dama a ku tooi baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ, dimbɔŋɔ bee din la bee di zaa nti yɛn niŋ.
en: So begin planting early in the morning, and dont stop working until evening. You dont know what might make you rich. Maybe everything you do will be successful.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Lɛvinim ni bɛ malim bɛmaŋa m-be kasi n-kana ti guli dunoya maa, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gbib Vuhim Dabisili maa kasi. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ gba yɛla ka tiligi ma a yurilim din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: I also commanded the Levites to purify themselves and to come and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember this also in my favor, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your mercy.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ ba zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana ti niŋ yalim bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa tahirila alibarika na, ka yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa kaman di ni daa niŋ shɛm yi sani dahin shɛli yi ni daa tuui wum Naawuni daanfaani yɛla ka baŋ ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli la.
en: The gospel keeps bringing blessings and is spreading throughout the world, just as it has among you ever since the day you first heard about the grace of God and came to know it as it really is.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini niriba yinsi biɛɣukam nti wuhiri ba, ka yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: The apostles did not stop teaching the people. They continued to tell the Good News—that Jesus is the Messiah. They did this every day in the Temple area and in peoples homes.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m binnamda zaa kpɛma, ŋun nam o kɔŋko n-ni tooi zaŋ takɔbi mir o.
en: The most amazing of all my creatures! Only his Creator can defeat him.

dag: Naawuni ku chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maai; o nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi Reehab la.
en: God's anger is constant. He crushed his enemies who helped Rahab, the sea monster, oppose him.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o nachimba ka bɛ ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣiri mini bɛ naba n-zaŋ li ti lo n-yili baɣili Hiburɔn biaŋ. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu maa ti sɔɣi Abinɛr siliga din be Hiburɔn la ni.
en: David gave the order, and his soldiers killed Rechab and Baanah and cut off their hands and feet, which they hung up near the pool in Hebron. They took Ishbosheth's head and buried it in Abner's tomb there at Hebron.

dag: Zaŋmi m paɣiba mini m bi shɛb zuɣu n ni jɛm a ŋɔ ti ma ka n kuli, dama a mi n ni tum tuun shɛli ti a.
en: You know how hard I've worked for you, so let me take my wives and children and leave.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Dinzuɣu tihi puu maa lana yi ti kana, wula ka o lee yɛn niŋ padiriba maa.
en: Jesus asked, When the owner of that vineyard comes, what do you suppose he will do to those renters.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Ka Sool daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: Samuel got up and went on his way from Gilgal, but the rest of the people followed Saul to join the army, and they went from Gilgal to Gibeah in Benjamin. Saul counted about six hundred men still with him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu n-chaŋ ti zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa.
en: Then the Glory of the Lord rose from the threshold of the Temple, moved to the place over the Cherub angels, and stopped there.

dag: ka yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba maa, Ti bia ŋɔ nyɛla tipawumlilana ni nɔzaɣisira; o bi deeri ti noli; o nyɛla pulaandana ni danyura.
en: They must say to the leaders of the town: Our son is stubborn and refuses to obey. He does not do anything we tell him to do. He eats and he drinks too much.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ nyaaŋa, n ni kabis o bɔɣiri din mali yaa mini din pun kabi la, ka chɛ ka takɔbi yi o nuu ni lu.
en: Now then, this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , say: I am the enemy of the king of Egypt. I am going to break both his arms—the good one and the one already broken—and the sword will fall from his hand.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ puuni n-lir a min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa. A yiŋ mini Ijipti yili kam ni ti palila zɔhi; ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa gba ni ti palila zɔhi.
en: If you dont let my people go, then flies will come into your houses. The flies will be on you and your officials. The houses of Egypt will be full of flies. They will be all over the ground too!.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli nyariba, Di lan nyan ya, ka yɛli anabinima, Di yɛliya ti din tuhi; naɣ yɛlimiya ti la ti suhu ni yu shɛli ni binshɛŋa din bi tuhi yɛla.
en: They tell the prophets, Dont see dreams about things we should do. Dont tell us the truth. Say nice things to us and make us feel good. See only good things for us.

dag: Bɛ daa yihila tinsi pinaayi Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba kaman bɛ daŋ maa niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: In the same way, twelve towns in the territories of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun were assigned to the clan of Merari, family by family.

dag: Yi ni ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, amaa di ti chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: You will soon hear about wars and threats of wars, but don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.

dag: N daa bi bɔhim yɛm bee m-mi ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni nyɛ so.
en: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim Juda ni o daŋmi tooni ti yɛli Yisifu ka o wuhi ba soli din kuni Goshɛn; ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jacob sent Judah ahead to speak to Joseph. Judah went to Joseph in the land of Goshen. Then Jacob and his people followed into the land.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni sahakam, ka bɛ zuliya kul ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.

dag: Di sɔɣi bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi maa a sani, dama bɛ yɛli zilima pam tammɛriba maa ninni.
en: Dont forgive their iniquity or blot out their sins from your sight. They have thrown insults at the builders!.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛli, wuhim a kpiɔŋ kaman a ni pun niŋdi shɛm ti zuɣu la.
en: Summon your strength, God! Show how strong you are, God, just as youve done for us before.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu niriba maa zuɣu bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Aduna mali naɣibil so la zuɣu.
en: So the Lord sent a disease on the people, because they had caused Aaron to make the gold bull-calf.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kaman biɛɣu pia dali, ka Yawɛ daa ku Nabal.
en: Some ten days later the Lord struck Nabal and he died.

dag: Dama n suhuyiɣisili maa dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka ni di hal ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Di saɣindi dunia mini di binshɛɣukam, ka niŋdi buɣim nyɔri zoya tanzahi.
en: My anger will flame up like fire and burn everything on earth. It will reach to the world below and consume the roots of the mountains.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni suui bɛ ni zaŋ ʒi tibisa shɛŋa ʒili ya la, ka kabi bɛ ni ban ya bandi shɛŋa la.
en: I will now end Assyria's power over you and break the chains that bind you.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Saimɔn, o daa warila bukpahigu ka wuhir omaŋa ni o nyɛla wɔɣirili, ka o yɛla daa mali Samarianim alahiziba pam.
en: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.

dag: Nyin ʒirilana ŋɔ, a yu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din biɛri niriba tɔɣisibu!.
en: You and your lying tongue love to hurt people.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti labisi Ammɔnnim daazichi ti ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ʒimiya liɣiri pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ laɣ shɛli labisi niŋ yi kpalansi noya ni la zuɣu mali chaŋ, di pa shɛli bɛ daa chirimmi maa.
en: Also take along twice the amount of money for the grain, because there must have been some mistake when the money was put back in your sacks.

dag: Ka Pita daa zani dunol ni niŋdi gaafara, ka paɣisar so ŋun yuli booni Roda daa kana ni o ti nya ŋun bala.
en: Peter knocked at the outside door, and a servant named Rhoda came to answer it.

dag: Nir yi ŋubiri ka kuma ka mali suhudoo, di so yil shɛli nim bɛn diri bindir nyaɣisa ka zabili be di yili maa ni.
en: Better to eat a dry crust of bread with peace of mind than have a banquet in a house full of trouble.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛsi daa bol o bidibiga Abinadab na nti chɛ ka o gari Samuɛl tooni. Ka Samuɛl yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Then Jesse called his second son, Abinadab. Abinadab walked by Samuel. But Samuel said, No, this is not the man who the Lord chose.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa kana ti ʒini n tooni ni bɛ bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ binshɛli.
en: Seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, some of Israel's leaders came to me on the tenth day of the fifth month. They sat down and asked for a message from the Lord .

dag: Ka Hɔshaya mini Juda zuɣulaannim pirigili daa pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dabisili dali kam, sokam zaa yihim kaman Naawuni ni lɔrig o shɛm tariga na ti zali, ka di chɛ ka n ti kana ka laɣ tɔhibu yɛla ku lan beni yaha.
en: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di lan zɔri ya Babilɔn naa kaman yi ni yi zɔr o shɛm la, dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya, ka fan ya o nuu ni bahi.
en: Don't be afraid of the King of Babylonia. I will protect you from him.

dag: Ti nyɛla jɛra Masia zuɣu, amaa ka yinima nyɛ yɛnnim Masia puuni. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima, amaa ka yinima nyɛ kpiɔŋlaannima. Yi nyɛla bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima, amaa ka tinim nyɛ bɛ ni ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.

dag: Di ti chɛliya ka so nya dabindi yi sani daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni, yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa bee n-chɛ ka yi ni kɔrigi biŋkɔb so dabisi tuuli dali maa nimdi zani yuŋ hal ti neei biɛɣu.
en: There must be no yeast in anyones house anywhere in the country for seven days. And all the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day must be eaten before morning.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd min o tɔbbihi daa ʒiɛm Yisa ka mal o ansarisi; ka daa zaŋ kpar viɛlli yɛl o, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o labi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Herod and his soldiers made fun of Jesus and treated him with contempt; then they put a fine robe on him and sent him back to Pilate.

dag: Ka yi lan niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim pahira. Yi kuhira, ka fabinda, ka yi nintam tɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini, o ni bi lan lihi nya yi sara bee n-deeri li yi nuu ni ni yurilim la zuɣu.
en: You should do this as well: cover the altar of the LORD with tears, weeping, and groaning because there is still no divine favor for your offering or favorable regard for anything from your hand.

dag: Ka gɔtihi maa tir o mahim, ka kuligara gil o niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The lotuses screen him with shade; poplars of the stream surround him.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa boli nimaani yuli, Yawɛ ni tahi na. Ka niriba na kul booni li lala hal ni zuŋɔ. Yawɛ zol la zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni tahi na.
en: So Abraham gave that place a name, The Lord Provides. Even today people say, On the mountain of the Lord , he will give us what we need.

dag: Kamiyana nti dinya nanim mini sapashinnim ni kpiɔŋlaannim ni yuri mini bɛn bari ba zaŋ tabili daadam kam bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba ni wɔɣira mini tarimba nimdi.
en: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.

dag: Di daa bi lan kpa ni so wuh o ninsal biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, dama omaŋmaŋ pun mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni.
en: No one had to tell him what people were like. He already knew.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Baɣisimiya fiig tia wala na nti ʒe o bintɔrigu maa ka o nya alaafee.
en: Then Isaiah told the king's attendants to put on his boil a paste made of figs, and he would get well.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Asha zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and the fields around them were given to the tribe of Asher. Each family in that tribe got its share of the land.

dag: N wum ka a ba yɛr a biɛli Iso.
en: she said to Jacob, I heard your father tell Esau.

dag: ka ti daai yi dikiya luhi n-dahimdahim li pa yi mini yi bihi zuɣu; hal ka tandaɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu, yi ni bi baŋ saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa kana ni o ti tiligi ya la zuɣu.
en: They will destroy you and all your people. Not one stone of your buildings will stay on top of another. All this will happen because you did not know the time when God came to save you.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa tum tuma, ka duu maa malibu tuma chaŋ tooni. Ka bɛ daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm, ka lan niŋ yaa pahi.
en: All of them worked hard, and they restored the Temple to its original condition, as solid as ever.

dag: ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni kum ni daa yɛn lu la piligi kaman Yisifu ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kum maa daa lula luɣilikam zaa tiŋgbɔna ni; amaa ka bindira daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ din zaa ni.
en: Then the seven years of hunger began, just as Joseph had said. No food grew anywhere in any of the countries in that area. But in Egypt people had plenty to eat because Joseph had stored the grain.

dag: A yi chɛ ka a suhu ʒe dɛde, a ni tooi teeg a nuhi tir o.
en: Prepare your heart to serve only God. Lift your arms and pray to him.

dag: Yawɛ neeri zoomba nina. Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lu. Yawɛ yuri wuntizɔriba.
en: and gives sight to the blind. He lifts those who have fallen; he loves his righteous people.

dag: ka o ba wum o ni po pɔri shɛli bee o ni lo alikauli shɛli maa ka bi yɛl o shɛli, dindina o pɔri maa zaa ni zani, ka o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa ni zani.
en: she must do everything that she vowed or promised unless her father raises an objection when he hears about it.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ n di domi baalim; ŋ-ŋɔ n di gbihiya; di nyaaŋa ka n di vuhi.
en: Now I would be at peace in the silent world below.

dag: A chɛ ka a niriba di wahala pam; a ti ti la wain ka ti nyu, ka di chɛ ka ti chani jeena.
en: You have made your people suffer greatly; we stagger around as though we were drunk.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni ni tooi neei Yisahaku kum ni; ka di bemi kaman lala n-daa shiri niŋ, dama ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun sani, Yisahaku daa bemi kaman ŋun shiri neei kum ni na.
en: He figured that God could even raise him from the dead. So in a way he did receive him back from the dead.

dag: Saha shɛli Pool ni daa be Milɛtus maa ka o daa tim ti boli Ɛfɛsus Cheechi kpamba.
en: From Miletus, Paul sent a message for the church leaders at Ephesus to come and meet with him.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dɔɣi Anabi Musa, ka o daa viɛli pam ka Naawuni nini tiɣ o, ka o ba min o ma daa mal o duu hal ti paai chira ata.
en: This was the time when Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him at home.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Musa, Yim n sani, Miri ka a lan chɛ ka n nya a yaha. N nini yi ti lan nya a, n ni ku a.
en: Pharaoh said to him, Get out of here! Make sure you never see my face again, because the next time you see my face you will die.

dag: ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Hɔrinim nanima kaman bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These men were the leaders of the families that lived in the country of Seir.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛn lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli ka so kani n-gari ŋun Naawuni ka o ni po o la zuɣu, o daa ŋmaligi m-pola omaŋ.
en: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa labi kuli ti yɛl o deemba Jɛtro, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n labi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n niriba sani nti nya bɛ na be bɛ nyɛviya ni. Ka Jɛtro daa yɛli Musa, Cham ni suhudoo.
en: Moses went to his father-in-law Jethro and asked, Please let me return to Egypt to see if any of my people are still alive. All right, Jethro replied. I hope all goes well.

dag: Amazia ni daa tuhi Ɛdomnim naai ka labiri kuna, o daa kpuɣila bɛ wuna m-mali kuli ti zaŋ li leeg omaŋmaŋ wuna n-jɛmdi li ka maani li.
en: After Amaziah had defeated the Edomite army, he returned to Jerusalem. He took with him the idols of the Edomite gods and set them up. Then he bowed down and offered them sacrifices.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn teei do wɔbinyina gariti zuɣu, ka zaŋdi piɛla kara mini yi naɣikpahi ni naɣila kara n-kɔriti puhiri churi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: who lie on beds of ivory, stretch out on their couches, eat lambs from the flock, and bull calves from the stall.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lo noli n-jɛmdi ti Duuma ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛli ba, Piimiya Baanabas mini Sool ti ma, ka n chɛ ka bɛ tum n ni yɛn ti ba tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: While they were serving the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said to them, Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul, to do the work to which I have called them.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa yɛl o.
en: The Hittites responded to Abraham.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣir a; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: You, LORD, are to be blessed! Teach me your statutes.

dag: Yisa daa ti zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo doli fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba chana.
en: Jesus traveled through cities and villages, teaching and making his way to Jerusalem.

dag: ni Ifriim Dunɔdal la zuɣusaa ni Dunɔdal Kurili la gbini ni Zahim Dunɔdali ni Hananɛl Pia ni Kɔbiga Pia la gbini m-mali hal ti paai Piɛri Dunɔdal la gbini, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani Guliba Dunɔdal la gbini.
en: Then they went over these gates: the Gate of Ephraim, the Old Gate, and the Fish Gate. And they went over the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred. They went as far as the Sheep Gate and stopped at the Guard Gate.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duna n-yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nti nya ka bɔrɔbɔro doya, ka nya sala buɣim ka zahim pa di zuɣu.
en: When they stepped out of the boat and onto the shore, they saw a fire of hot coals. There were fish on the fire and some bread there too.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Shaaf ŋun daa nyɛ Madimanna ba la mini Shɛva ŋun daa nyɛ Makibɛna mini Gibia ba la. Kalɛb bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Akisa.
en: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.

dag: O suhu kpɛmmi kaman kuɣili la, di kpɛmmi kaman nɛli la.
en: His heart is like a rock; he has no fear. It is as hard as a millstone.

dag: Sokam daa yul o tuma maa, sokam daa ʒiɛla katiŋa ka yuuni li.
en: Every person has seen him; people can observe at great distance.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ni ninsal shia durila zuɣusaa, ka biŋkɔbigu shia siɣiri tiŋgban ni?.
en: Who knows what happens to a persons spirit? Who knows if a humans spirit goes up to God while an animals spirit goes down into the ground.

dag: N ni ti yihi n jilima palo ni zuliya kam sani, ka zuliya kam ti nya n ni kari saria shɛli ŋɔ mini n ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm maa.
en: When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-naɣ wuhiri ma tiŋ kam ni ni sarika kpɛbu mini wahala n-guli ma nimaani.
en: I know only that in every city the Holy Spirit tells me that troubles and even jail wait for me.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛ nuhi gbaag a, a bɔɣirimi ŋ-ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣusapima. Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛmaŋ jɛm a, a kabigirimi ka chɛ ka bɛ naba kɔŋ zanibu.
en: When they reached out to you for support, you broke in half, cutting their arms and making them fall.

dag: Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ni yihi ya yi bi ʒiɛyimtali maa ni. Ti ka a sanna, dama nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: Return, rebellious children, and I will heal your rebellion. Here we are; we come to you, for you are the LORD our God.

dag: Nyin Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, ŋmɛlim amaŋ ka ŋuhimi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisira, dama pumpɔŋɔ a ni yi fɔntiŋ ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni. Ka di nyaaŋa, a ni ti kuli Babilɔn. Nimaani ka a ni ti nya faako. Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni ti tilig a a dimnim nuu ni.
en: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.

dag: O nina ŋmanila ŋmana bɛn ʒe kɔzɔrim noli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ bihim paɣi shɛba.
en: His eyes are like doves by a stream, like doves in a pool of milk, like a jewel in its setting.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tirila yinim bɛn zaa be Rom n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka boli ya ni yi leeg o ninvuɣ gahinda la: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na. Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: Later, it was time for the grapes to be picked. So the man sent a servant to those farmers so that they would give him his share of the grapes. But they beat the servant and sent him away with nothing.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka o biɛhigu be tibi, di so ni o nyɛ bundana ka nyɛ bilikɔɣino o tuma ni.
en: It is better to be poor and honest than rich and evil.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa sab sabbu shɛli tabili Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.

dag: O yuri ni o yɛli noli din bie ti niriba. Chɛ ka noli di o. O je alibarika, dinzuɣu di chɛ ka alibarika mir o.
en: He loved to curse others, so let those bad things happen to him. He never blessed others, so dont let good things happen to him.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinahi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zibia, o daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba nira.
en: Joash became king of Judah at the age of seven, and he ruled in Jerusalem for forty years. His mother was Zibiah from the city of Beersheba.

dag: O ni daa ti yina, o daa kɔŋla yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka bɛ baŋ ni o nya ʒii Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama o daa kul malila o nuhi buɣisira, ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: Then Zechariah came outside, but he could not speak to them. So the people knew that he had seen a vision inside the Temple. He was not able to speak, so he could only make signs to the people.

dag: N daa lo nia ni n ka yi sanna nti kaai ya ka gari chaŋ Masidɔnia; ka ti lan yi Masidɔnia lab yi sanna ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ Judia.
en: I wanted to visit you on my way to Macedonia, and then come to you again on my way back from Macedonia, at which point I was hoping you would help me on my way to Judea.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ matarika kuri salima ŋ-ŋmahi li kaman gal la n-zaŋ li garisi gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-wuɣi binyɛra pa tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli zuɣu.
en: They beat out thin sheets of gold and cut them into threads to work into designs among the blue, purple, and deep red yarns and the fine linen.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chani baɣisi mini bukpahinim bɛn sɔɣiri yɛr la sani ni bɛ ti yɛl a a zuɣu ni yɛlli? Miri ka a wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛri shɛli maa. Ŋun ne ni tooi vihi baŋ o zuɣu ni yɛlli kpiimba sani? A bi bɔhir a Naawuni?.
en: Someone may say to you, Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods.

dag: Di doli wumdi niriba ni yɛri shɛlikam, di yi pa lala, a ni ti wum ka a tumtumda tur a.
en: Dont worry about all the things people say, so you dont hear your servant cursing you.

dag: Bɛ gbibila tɔbiri mini kpana. Bɛ nyɛla ninkuunsinima, ka bi zɔri nambɔɣu. Bɛ vuri ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana vubu. Bɛ barila yuri m-pie taba kaman tɔbbihi ni chani tɔbu ni shɛm la n-kanna ni bɛ ti liri yinim Babilɔnnima.
en: They have taken their bows and swords; they are cruel and merciless. They sound like the roaring sea, as they ride their horses. They are ready for battle against Babylonia.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ o lala, dama niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: It happened to the officer just that way. The people knocked him down at the gate and trampled him, and he died.

dag: Jɔn daa nyɛla firila din diri ka ne, ka yi daa saɣi m-mali suhupiɛlli o neesim maa ni daba ayi.
en: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli ba, O ni daa na ne ka n lo noli ka kumd o zuɣu maa, n daa yɛlimi, Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni zo ma nambɔɣu ka chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: David answered: While he was still alive, I went without food and cried because there was still hope. I said to myself, Who knows? Maybe the Lord will have pity on me and let the child live.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa, ka di bi lu la, dama o daa me li tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: It rained hard, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house. But it did not fall because it was built on rock.

dag: ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la. Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha.
en: and the two will be one flesh. So they are no longer two but one flesh.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili salima sara maligu bimbin la, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They will spread a blue cloth on the gold altar and cover it with fine leather.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma tuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: Our dear friend Tychicus, who is a faithful worker and fellow servant in the Lord's work, will give you all the news about me.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa wuh o niriba maa zaa, Hiburunim maa yi lan dɔɣi bidibiga, yin zaŋm o ti lɔhi Nail Mɔɣili ni, amaa chɛliya bipuɣinsi bɛna.
en: Then Pharaoh gave an order to all his people: Throw every baby boy born to the Hebrews into the Nile River, but you can let all the girls live.

dag: Suhu n-nyɛ din mali yɔhiŋgu gari binshɛɣukam; di bi ʒe yim. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li?.
en: Nothing can hide its evil as well as the human mind. It can be very sick, and no one really understands it.

dag: O daa yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya, Yawɛ ni yuri so, barina ku tooi paag o. Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be o luɣilikam dabisi muni puuni zaa. O ni yuri so ʒila o bɔɣusapima sunsuuni.
en: He said to Benjamin: The LORDs dearest one rests safely on him. The Lord always shields him; he rests on Gods chest.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ nyɛla bɛn birigi n niriba ka yɛra, Suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani. Ka n niriba maa yi me gooni, anabinim ŋɔ zaŋdila bimpiɛlli paligi li.
en: Again and again those false prophets lied to my people. They said there would be peace, but there is no peace. The people need to fix the walls and prepare for war. But they only slap a thin coat of plaster over the broken walls.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Ti ka taali. O suhu bi lan yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn kari ya la saria, dama yi yɛliya, Ti bi tum alahichi.
en: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.

dag: dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli ka bɛ gbib a ka gul a.
en: The Scriptures say, God will command his angels to take care of you. Psalm :.

dag: N ni labisi Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daazichi ti ba, ka mali ba zali kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm piligu ni la.
en: I will bring back the captives of Judah and Israel, and I will rebuild them as they were at first.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di Izraɛl nam ka di ti paai yuun pisaayika saha shɛli, ka Abija mi daa leei Juda naa.
en: Abijah became the new king of Judah. This was during the th year that Jeroboam son of Nebat ruled Israel.

dag: ti zaŋ anzinfa mini salima maa m-mali nam zuɣupiligu n-zaŋ li pili Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: Use the silver and gold to make a crown. Put it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee maani ansarisi ka tura? Ŋun zuɣu ka a lee tahira, ka niŋ karimbaani m-mirigir a nina niŋda? Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a mɔri maa.
en: Whom do you think you have been insulting and ridiculing? You have been disrespectful to me, the holy God of Israel.

dag: Ka Mikaya yɛl o, A yi labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-wuhi ma n ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka lan yɛli, Yinim salo ŋɔ zaa, wummiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Micaiah said, If you do come back, I was wrong about what the Lord wanted me to say. Then he told the crowd, Don't forget what I said.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ binnyɔɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa mini maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa gbalipuɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: Take the breast and the leg of the ram that was used to make Aaron the high priest and make these parts holy. Then give these special parts to Aaron and his sons.

dag: ni Giliad ni Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tiŋgban la ni Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ ti paai Salɛka.
en: It included Gilead, the regions of Geshur and Maacah, all of Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Ŋuna m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Aai, o ŋman o mi. Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛli ba, Mani m-bala.
en: Some said, It is, and others said, No, its someone who looks like him. But the man said, Yes, its me.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zani yim saɣi deei ti ninvuɣ biɛtali din nyɛ ti yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la, dama ti tum alahichi a sani.
en: We have sinned against you, Lord ; we confess our own sins and the sins of our ancestors.

dag: Do so niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi mali bimmɔriŋ bee yum bee dalinli, ka di ti leei niŋgbuŋ dɔro o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina bɛn zaŋm o tahi Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la sani bee o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ni yino sani.
en: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: Remember that all these things will take place before the people now living have all died.

dag: M bɔri ni yi yi yɛla muɣisigu puuni. Ŋun ka paɣa baɣa bela ti Duuma yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o nini;.
en: I would like you to be free from worry. An unmarried man concerns himself with the Lord's work, because he is trying to please the Lord.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigiri buŋ maa.
en: some of the bystanders asked them, What are you doing, untying that colt.

dag: Ka paɣ yino yɛli, N dana, m mini paɣ ŋɔ n-laɣim be yil yini, ka n daa ti dɔɣi, ka o kul bela yili maa ni.
en: One of them said, Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house, and I gave birth to a baby boy at home while she was there.

dag: Lala ka Jɛhu daa niŋ kpihim Baal birili zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: That was how Jehu wiped out the worship of Baal in Israel.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili tiŋ maa ni tiŋbi so, ka o timd o o puu ni ka o ti dihir o kuruchunima.
en: So he went to work for one of the citizens of that country, who sent him out to his farm to take care of the pigs.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti kpɛri n jɛmbu duu, bɛna n-ni ti kani n sara maligu bimbini gbini na nti tumdi n tuma, ka doli n zaligunima.
en: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ di ku ba, amaa ni bɛ nahimmi ba mi chira anu, ka bɛ mi yi dim nira, di biɛrim ŋmanila nɔŋ dimbu biɛrim.
en: The locusts were not allowed to kill these people, but only to torture them for five months. The pain caused by the torture is like the pain caused by a scorpion's sting.

dag: O yiɣis o suhu bahi n zuɣu, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: His anger burns against me; he considers me his enemy.

dag: O yi daa kala o zaɣ zaŋli na, di simdi ka o lan chaŋ o zaɣ zaŋli. Ka di yi nyɛla o min o paɣa n-daa kana, dindina di simdi ka o min o paɣa maa zaa lan chaŋ.
en: If he is not married when he becomes your slave, when he becomes free, he will leave without a wife. But if the man is married when he becomes your slave, then he will keep his wife at the time he is made free.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ Mɔdɛkai sani tiŋ puuni pal shɛli din daa miri nayili dunol la shee.
en: So Hathach went out to where Mordecai was in the open place of the city in front of the kings gate.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti vuui, amaa nyin kul ni kpalim be; di zaa ni kurigi kaman situra ni kurigiri shɛm la.
en: They will pass away, but you remain. They will all wear out like old clothes. .

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka bɛ bi lan tiri Lɛvinim bɛ dihili ni nyɛ shɛli, dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim mini yiliyiiniba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma maa daa chɛ li ka chaŋ bɛ puri ni.
en: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Kpa ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ yomyom ʒini n-taɣi sab pihinu.
en: One hundred barrels of olive oil, he answered. Here is your account, the manager told him; sit down and write fifty.

dag: Amaa bɛ ti ku lan labi bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ labi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni na ŋɔ.
en: Jehoiachin, you will want to come back to your land, but you will never be allowed to come back.

dag: O ni daa paai naa sani, ka naa bɔh o, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka Makaya garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: When Micaiah arrived, the king asked him, Micaiah, should we go to war with Ramoth-gilead or not? Attack and win! Micaiah answered. The LORD will hand it over to the king.

dag: Ka Kush bidibisi daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Ka Raama bidibisi nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Cushs sons: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamahs sons: Sheba and Dedan.

dag: ka wɔr piɛla vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ata, ka wɔr fufuhisi vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah anahi mi.
en: the third by white horses, and the fourth by dappled horses.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n daashili sɔɣibu shee ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: Hide me and protect me. I trust what you say.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus answered, Its written, You will worship the Lord your God and serve only him. .
