dag: Ka Ahaz daa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu lahi mini di nɛma zaa na nti ŋmaŋŋma Naawuni duu nɛma maa, ka kpari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka me maligu bimbina zali Jɛrusalɛm lɔrigi kam ni.
en: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka so daa ka alizanda ni bee dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia tiŋgbani puuni ŋun ni tooi bɔɣi litaafi maa bee nti tooi lihi di puuni.
en: But there was no one in heaven or on earth or in the world below who could open the scroll and look inside it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi ŋariŋ maa chaŋ kaman maal anahi bee ata nti nya Yisa ka o tam kom zuɣu chanina ti miriti bɛ ŋariŋ maa, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam.
en: When the wind had driven them out for about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He was approaching the boat and they were afraid.

dag: Dama tinim bɛn be ti nyɛviya ni ŋɔ kul bela kum barina ni Yisa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni.
en: Throughout our lives we are always in danger of death for Jesus' sake, in order that his life may be seen in this mortal body of ours.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So yi ni tooi zaŋ bini buɣisi zuɣusaa bee n-vihi baŋ tiŋgbani puuni tanzahi ni nyɛ shɛli, di saha n ni zaɣisi Izraɛlnim bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: The LORD proclaims: If the heavens above could be measured and the foundation of the earth below could be fathomed, only then would I reject Israels descendants for what they have done, declares the LORD.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla man ŋuna, mani m-be yi nuu ni maa. Niŋmiya ma kaman yi ni kul nya ka shɛli viɛla ka tuhi yi sani.
en: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.

dag: Chɛ ka m be din ni chɛ ka m paɣir a, ka chɛ ka a zaligunim sɔŋ ma.
en: Give me life, so that I may praise you; may your instructions help me.

dag: Di saha ka dabipaɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi daa kana ti gban o tiŋa.
en: Then the concubines came up with their children and bowed down;.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛn gbarigi tiɣi, ka chɛ ka bɛn tarigi la niŋgbuna maai.
en: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Aai, n suhir a, a suhu yi shiri maai ni mani, nyin deemi m pini maa, dama n ni nya a ka a deei ma ni suhumahili maa, di ŋmanila n nini nyala Naawuni.
en: Jacob said, No, I beg you! If you really accept me, please accept the gifts I give you. I am very happy to see your face again. It is like seeing the face of God. I am very happy to see that you accept me.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pihitanaayɔbu saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka me goma gili Rama ni di chɛ ka so ku tooi yi Juda Naa Asa tiŋgban ni bee n-kana ti kpe di ni.
en: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, King Baasha of Israel invaded Judah and started to fortify Ramah in order to cut off all traffic in and out of Judah.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti n dabili Yaakubu la ni; yi yaannim ni daa be shɛl ni la. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi ni ti be nimaani sahakam. Ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa sahakam.
en: They will live on the land that I gave to my servant Jacob. Your ancestors lived in that place, and my people will live there. They and their children and their grandchildren will live there forever. My servant David will be their leader forever.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali bidibisi. Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Jɛdiayɛl pa, ka Zɛbadia daa pah ata, ka Jatiniɛl pahi anahi;.
en: Meshelemiah had sons. Zechariah was the oldest son. Jediael was the second son. Zebadiah was the third son. Jathniel was the fourth son.

dag: N niriba Izraɛlnima, yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ shɛb kaman bɛ ni bu ka shɛli n-yɛl li ŋɔ, n ni wum shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka n zaŋ yɛri ya maa.
en: My people Israel, you have been threshed like wheat, but now I have announced to you the good news that I have heard from the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba maa, N nya ti Duuma! Ka yɛli ba Yisa ni daa yɛl o shɛm la zaa.
en: Mary Magdalene then went and told the disciples she had seen the Lord. She also told them what he had said to her.

dag: Miri ka a leei dabiɛm bini n sani, nyini n-nyɛ n ni yɛn sɔɣi so sani m muɣisigu saha.
en: Please dont make me afraid of you. I depend on you in times of trouble.

dag: ka di puuni zahim zaa kpi n-niŋ di kom maa ni ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim kɔŋ li nyubu. .
en: The fish in the river will die, and the river will begin to stink. Then the Egyptians will not be able to drink the water from the river.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o ti o bidibiga ni o niŋ o paɣa, di simdi ka o gbib o kaman o bipuɣiŋga la.
en: If he assigns her to his son, he must give her the rights of a daughter.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa dii baŋ ni yiko shɛli yi o ni, ka ŋmaligi salo maa ni bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi m binyɛrigu ŋɔ.
en: At that very moment, Jesus recognized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and said, Who touched my clothes.

dag: N Naawuni, n yɛrimi, di zaŋ ma n nyɛvili sunsuuni, nyini ŋun kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni ŋɔ.
en: O God, do not take me away now before I grow old. O Lord , you live forever;.

dag: Ŋmahimiya gɔpiɛliga daantalis anu n-niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi n-gɔhigɔhi pateesa maa n-zaŋ li yili daantalisi maa, ka zaŋ daanya mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba anu.
en: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai sinsabiga maa gbin na n-kpalim zani lihi di zuɣu ka yɛli, Zakius, siɣimina yomyom, dama di kpala talahi ni n kpe a yiŋ zuŋɔ.
en: When Jesus came to where Zacchaeus was, he looked up and saw him in the tree. Jesus said, Zacchaeus, hurry! Come down! I must stay at your house today.

dag: Jɛrigu ŋɔ! A ni biri binshɛli ku bilina ka pa ni di poomi.
en: Look, fool! When you put a seed into the ground, it doesnt come back to life unless it dies.

dag: Judas ŋun daa yi o nyaaŋa la daa mi tihi puu maa ni, dama Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yi kul chanila nimaani waawaayili.
en: Judas, his betrayer, also knew the place because Jesus often gathered there with his disciples.

dag: Nuhu zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Nuhu daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka ka galimi o ʒiɛman ni.
en: These are Noahs descendants. In his generation, Noah was a moral and exemplary man; he walked with God.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-kpuɣ a bindoo chaŋ.
en: Jesus said to him, Get up, pick up your mat, and walk.

dag: Shutɛla zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛran daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Ɛrannima.
en: Eran was from Shuthelahs family group; Eran—the Eranite family group.

dag: O daa daŋ kala omaŋmaŋ zuliya sanna, ka bɛ ti bi deeg o.
en: The light came to his own people, and his own people didnt welcome him.

dag: N ku saɣi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be m biɛhigu ni. N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn birigi tuma. M mini ba ku mali jina.
en: I refuse to be corrupt or to take part in anything crooked.

dag: Ka Yisa daa deei komihigu maa ka yɛli, Di naaya! Ka silim o zuɣu tiŋa n-dii bahi.
en: Jesus drank the wine and said, It is finished! Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

dag: Chɛliya ka sokam be kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni o be shɛm min o ni daa pun be shɛm ka ti Duuma bol o la. N ni zali shɛm cheechi kam ni m-bala:.
en: But each one of you should continue to live the way the Lord God has given you to live—the way you were when God chose you. I tell people in all the churches to follow this rule.

dag: Bɛ ni niriba pam ni tuui lu n-nya dansi; tɔŋ ni gbahi ba.
en: Many will stumble; they will fall and be crushed. They will be caught in a trap.

dag: Dama, naa kul ni tumla na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ o tooni ni tum shɛli. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi yɛm mini biɛri yoli ni jɛrilim yɛla.
en: After all, a king can only do what previous kings have done. So I started thinking about what it meant to be wise or reckless or foolish.

dag: Dama alahichi tumbu yɔri nyɛla kum, amaa Naawuni pini nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.

dag: Naawuni, a pun buɣisi ti nya. A nyahi ti zaa kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi anzinfa shɛri buɣim ni m-maani li shɛm la.
en: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla dunia zaa daa kala Ijipti na Yisifu sani ni bɛ ti da kawana, dama kum maa daa miila dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: People from all over the world came to Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was so severe in their countries.

dag: Nanim daa laɣimya n-kana ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Look: the kings assembled themselves, advancing all together.

dag: Saliŋgbiriba zaŋdi bɛ firilanima n-nyandi zibisim tiŋgbani puuni, ka gbiri chani bɛ ni ni tooi paai luɣ shɛli tariga m-bɔri tahiʒiɛɣu kuɣa bumbɔn ni.
en: Miners explore the deepest darkness. They search the depths of the earth And dig for rocks in the darkness.

dag: Bɛ tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nyɛla bɛ ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee dasara mini di kuruwɔɣila ni daantalisi ni di binzahi.
en: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands.

dag: Bɛ ŋmarila tab ʒiri; naŋgbammalisim mini tɛha ayiyi yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisira.
en: People lie to their neighbors. They say whatever they think people want to hear.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam pala bindira mini binnyura yɛla, amaa di nyɛla wuntia mini suhudoo ni suhupiɛlli yɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: Gods kingdom isnt about eating food and drinking but about righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

dag: ni Bɛtaraba ni Zɛmaraim ni Bɛtɛl.
en: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa chaŋ nti gari Amfipolis mini Apolɔnia m-mali ti paai Tɛsalɔnaika, ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu daa be nimaani.
en: Paul and Silas journeyed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, then came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

dag: Di kpala talahi ni ti zaa kpi; ti ŋmanila kom din kpaai bahi tiŋa ka nir ku lan tooi va li la. Amaa Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yih o bia ŋun zo n-kpe yɔɣu o daŋ ni.
en: We will all die; we are like water spilled on the ground, which can't be gathered again. Even God does not bring the dead back to life, but the king can at least find a way to bring a man back from exile.

dag: N ni daa bi baŋ n ni yɛn gbaai yɛlli maa shɛm zuɣu ka n daa bɔhi Pool ni o bɔri ni o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar o saria nimaani.
en: Since I did not know how to find out the truth about all this, I asked Paul if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem and be put on trial there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi fɔntinsi ata Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo.
en: Then Moses set aside three cities on the eastern side of the Jordan River.

dag: ka zaŋ o bidibisi maa na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba;.
en: Next, dress Aaron's sons in their special shirts.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋmi li bahi tiŋa. Ka o zaŋ li bahi tiŋa ka di leei wahu, ka Musa tirisi lab nyaaŋa ka chɛ li.
en: The Lord said, Throw it on the ground. When Moses threw it down, it turned into a snake, and he ran away from it.

dag: Kubu saha beni, ka tibbu saha beni. Daai luhi saha beni, ka me n-zali saha beni.
en: a time for killing and a time for healing, a time for tearing down and a time for building up.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli ba, Firawuna yɛliya, N ku lan tin ya mɔri.
en: So the peoples slave masters and supervisors came out and spoke to the people, This is what Pharaoh says, Im not giving you straw anymore.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi tinsi pinaata Isaka zuliya mini Asha zuliya ni Naftali zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni n-zaŋ tari Gɛrishomnima kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: To the clan of Gershon, family by family, were assigned thirteen towns in the territories of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.

dag: Chɛ ka anabi so ŋun zahim zahindi yɛlila zahindi maa yɛtɔɣa, amaa ŋun mi mali n yɛligu ŋun tɔɣisim n yɛligu maa yɛla ni ʒiɛyimtali. Mɔri mini alikama nyɛla yim? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Straw is not the same as wheat! In the same way, the dreams of those prophets are not messages from me. If people want to tell about their dreams, let them. But those who hear my message must speak it truthfully. This is what the Lord says.

dag: Naawuni, a chandi mali jiri pam ka niriba nyari li. N Naawuni ni n Naa maa chanimi ni o ti kpe o jɛmbu duu.
en: O God, your march of triumph is seen by all, the procession of God, my king, into his sanctuary.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, a nyɛla binzɔrigu! A suhu yi yiɣisi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani a tooni?.
en: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.

dag: dama m mi ni di ku lan yuui ka n kani kaman ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni kahigi wuhi ma shɛm.
en: I know that I must soon leave this body. Our Lord Jesus Christ has shown me that.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas daa yɛli Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili daŋ niriba maa, Zuŋɔ ti baŋya ni Yawɛ be ti sani, dama yi bi tum tuumbiɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani. Yi fa Izraɛlnim Yawɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, said to them, Now we know that the Lord is with us. You have not rebelled against him, and so you have saved the people of Israel from the Lord 's punishment.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka n yihi ya yi dimnim zaa nuu ni.
en: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.

dag: Di wuhir o ni daa di nam shɛm min o kpiɔŋ ni binshɛŋa din daa niŋ o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zaŋ tabili dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa yɛla.
en: The records tell how he ruled, how powerful he was, and all the things that happened to him, to Israel, and to the surrounding kingdoms.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya n yɛligu ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni mini yi biɛhigu ni, zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Place these words Im speaking on your heart and in your very being. Tie them on your hand as a sign. They should be on your forehead as a symbol.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Ahija bia Baasha daa leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa n-ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuun pisinaanahi.
en: In the third year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel, and he ruled in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛba yo wuntizɔriba talima samli, ka zaŋ bɛn ka yɛda yo bɛn biɛhigu tuhi samli.
en: The wicked are a ransom for the righteous; the treacherous will be punished in the place of the virtuous.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ti bi lan lihiri so kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm; hal ti ni daa lihi Masia kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm la, ti bi lan lihir o lala.
en: So then, from this point on we wont recognize people by human standards. Even though we used to know Christ by human standards, that isnt how we know him now.

dag: Di saha bɛ yi ti wum kikaa maa kumsi ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka, ka tɔbu maa kana ti di ba, bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If they hear the sound of the trumpet but dont heed the warning, when the sword comes and they are taken away, they are responsible for their blood.

dag: N zaligu maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yumiya taba kaman n ni yuri ya shɛm.
en: This is what I command you: Love each other as I have loved you.

dag: N dima, di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla n lubu zuɣu; dama n ni lan yiɣisi. N yi ʒini zibisim ni, Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ n neesim.
en: Our enemies have no reason to gloat over us. We have fallen, but we will rise again. We are in darkness now, but the Lord will give us light.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa mali shili n-yiɣisi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then we got ready to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun guli ma kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la, ka binshɛli bi poori ma.
en: You, Lord , are my shepherd. I will never be in need.

dag: Ka di daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb suli pam ka bɛ yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale ŋɔ lala?.
en: Some of the people there became angry and said to one another, What was the use of wasting the perfume?.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal bɛ ni kul mali kpiɔŋ ka lan galisi maa zaa yoli, n ni ku n-naa ba. Hal n ni daa chɛ ka yi di wahala la, n ku lan chɛ ka yi di wahala yaha.
en: The LORD proclaims: Though once they were a healthy and numerous force, they have been cut off and have disappeared. I have afflicted you; I wont afflict you further, Zion.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm viɛnyɛliŋga din ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni? Banim ka Yawɛ lee tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li moli? Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bahi yoli doya kaman tiŋgban nɛli, ka so bi lan gariti nimaani?.
en: Is there a man who is wise enough to understand these things? Is there someone who has been taught by the Lord ? Can anyone explain his message? Why was the land ruined? Why was it made like an empty desert where no one goes?.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tibi ŋɔ m-mali soli din be polipoli ti wuntizɔriba. Bɛ ni doli so shɛli nyɛla so viɛlli.
en: Lord , you make the path smooth for good people; the road they travel is level.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: A voice came from heaven and said, You are my Son, the one I love. I am very pleased with you.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Alizin birigu maa kul luhir o la waawaayili; ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni ni o di o nyɛvili. Ka a yi ni tooi sɔŋ ti, nyin zom ti nambɔɣu sɔŋ ti.
en: Many times the evil spirit has tried to kill him by throwing him in the fire and into water. Have pity on us and help us, if you possibly can.

dag: Alahichinima chɛli bɛ daalahichi soli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri chɛ bɛ tɛhi biɛri, ka ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ka o ti zo ba nambɔɣu, dama o ni chɛ bɛ taali zaa.
en: Let the wicked abandon their ways and the sinful their schemes. Let them return to the LORD so that he may have mercy on them, to our God, because he is generous with forgiveness.

dag: A ni bi mi vuhim ni kpɛri bia kɔba ni o ma puuni shɛm, lala ka a ku tooi baŋ Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa ŋɔ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God made everything, and you can no more understand what he does than you understand how new life begins in the womb of a pregnant woman.

dag: Maligumaaniba kɔŋko puri ka Yisifu daa bi da. Dama Firawuna daa tirila maligumaaniba maa laɣidira, dina ka bɛ daa mali dira, dinzuɣu ka bɛn daa bi kɔhi bɛ puri maa.
en: except the priests. The king gave the priests a regular food allowance, so they did not have to sell their land.

dag: Cheechi maa ni zaŋ dimaŋ ti Masia shɛm la, lala ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣiba gba zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti bɛ yidaannim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: So wives submit to their husbands in everything like the church submits to Christ.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam binnɛma zaɣ kara niŋ teeku ni, ka nam binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be kom ni chana ni noonsi balibu kam. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: So God made the giant sea monsters and all the living creatures that swim in the ocean. He also made every kind of bird. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.

dag: Dama n ni kul wum a puhigu maa, bia ŋun be m pul ni maa dii dammi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: As soon as I heard your greeting, the baby in my womb jumped for joy.

dag: Daadamnim mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ni tooi be kasi? Bee bɛn nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi shɛb ŋɔ, wula ka bɛ yɛn tooi niŋ nyɛ wuntizɔriba?.
en: No human is pure and innocent.

dag: Ka o daa tim tɔbbihi pam, ka bɛ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti teei gili tiŋ maa.
en: Then the king of Aram sent horses, chariots, and a large army to Dothan. They arrived at night and surrounded the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi zaŋdi tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ŋɔ tiri ya la yi wuntitali zuɣu, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: Know then that the LORD your God isnt giving you this excellent land for you to possess on account of your righteousness—because you are a stubborn people!.

dag: amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda hal ti kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Nyama, hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm bi paai di pirigili gba. A yɛm min a tɔŋbu yɛla gari n ni wum di yɛla shɛm.
en: I didnt believe it until I came and saw it with my own eyes. In fact, the half of it wasnt even told to me! You have far more wisdom and wealth than I was told.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna yiŋa n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: Moses left the king and prayed to the Lord .

dag: Yinim bɛn doli Yawɛ yɛligu ŋɔ, wummiya o ni yɛl shɛm. Yi niriba bɛn jɛn ya ka zaɣisi ya n zuɣu ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka Yawɛ wuh o yiko ni nyɛ shɛli ka di niŋ ya suhupiɛlli ka ti nya. Amaa bɛna n-yɛn di vi.
en: Listen to the LORDs word, you who tremble at his word: Your family members, those who hate and exclude you because of my name, have said, Let the LORD be glorified; lets see your joy. But they will be ashamed.

dag: Makiri paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maaka la daa dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Pɛrɛsh. O mabia yuli n-daa booni Shɛrɛsh; o mi mabihi yuya n-daa booni Ulam mini Rɛkɛm.
en: Makirs wife Maacah had a son. She named this son Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh. The sons of Sheresh were Ulam and Rakem.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Ka sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di.
en: It is worth nothing for you to have the whole world if you yourself are lost.

dag: n-saɣim di tinsi maa mini di vinvamli zaa ni tinsi maa niriba zaa ni tiŋgban ni bimbilli kam zaa.
en: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu la leei yuun kasi, ka moli yolisim nyabu molo ti bɛnkam be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani, ka sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su shɛlikam, ka lab o malibu sani.
en: You will make the fiftieth year holy, proclaiming freedom throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It will be a Jubilee year for you: each of you must return to your family property and to your extended family.

dag: Yisa daa ti kari alizin birigu do so zuɣu bahi; alizin birigu maa ni daa chaŋ naai ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira, ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam.
en: Jesus was throwing out a demon that causes muteness. When the demon was gone, the man who couldnt speak began to talk. The crowds were amazed.

dag: M bi suhir a tirila bɛmbɔŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa n suhir a tiri bɛn gba na yɛn niŋ ma yɛda bɛmbɔŋɔ yɛligu wumbu ni la.
en: Im not praying only for them but also for those who believe in me because of their word.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa malila binshɛli bɛ kpiŋkpama lɔna ni ka di ŋmani ninsal nuhi.
en: It appeared that the winged creatures had the form of a human hand under their wings.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia na maa nyaaŋa, ka Naawuni daa lan ka o sanna ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: When Jacob came back from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again. God blessed Jacob.

dag: Teem a niriba la, ka kpam ba jaande Naawuni zuɣu ni bɛ zom yi yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu din tahiri naŋgbankpeeni na la ni. Di ka buchi, di naɣ saɣindila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li.
en: Remind them of these things and warn them in the sight of God not to engage in battles over words that arent helpful and only destroy those who hear them.

dag: Amaa Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la n-daa nyɛ bɛn naɣi bi kpi.
en: but he let Joshua and Caleb live.

dag: Dama saha kanna ka yi dimnim ni ti kana nti teei gili ya, ka lan me bimbin kara tabili yi gooni.
en: A time is coming when your enemies will build a wall around you and hold you in on all sides.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi li bɛ nuhi ni n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei Maligumaana leebu sara maligu din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: Then Moses took these things from the hands of Aaron and his sons and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering. So this was the offering for appointing Aaron and his sons as priests. It was a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: dimbɔŋɔ gba di yɛn nyɛla taali din simdi ni sariakaritiba darigi n tibili. Dama n daa naan nyɛla ʒiŋmara Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani.
en: that also is a punishable offense, because I would then be disloyal to God above.

dag: Naa Sool ni daa kul mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa naai, di daa bi yuui ka Samuɛl paai na. Ka Naa Sool daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli puh o.
en: and just as he was finishing, Samuel arrived. Saul went out to meet him and welcome him.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa wum li, ka o chaŋ ti du n-tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu n-kuhi yɛli ba, Yinim Shɛkɛmnima, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, ka Naawuni wum yi gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm!.
en: When Jotham was told about this, he went and stood on the top of Mount Gerizim. He raised his voice and called out, Listen to me, you leaders of Shechem, so that God may listen to you!.

dag: Ka o ti bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti ti maligumaana din nyɛ o taali sanyoo Yawɛ sani, ka a zahim o daa ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ taali sanyoo polo.
en: You must bring to the priest as your compensation to the LORD a flawless ram from the flock at the standard value as a compensation offering.

dag: N tɔɣisirila n nini ni nya shɛli m Ba sani; ka yi mi niŋdi yi nini ni nya shɛli yi ba sani.
en: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you.

dag: Di zaliya yi daazichi dunia ŋɔ ni, dama dunia ŋɔ ni di zahindimi, ka lɛla saɣindi li, ka tayiɣisi kabiri kpɛri zuri li.
en: Dont save treasures for yourselves here on earth. Moths and rust will destroy them. And thieves can break into your house and steal them.

dag: Ka Ananias yɛli, N Duuma, m pun wum doo maa yɛla niriba pam sani zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi a nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm alaka shɛm polo.
en: But Ananias answered, Lord, many people have told me about this man. They told me about the many bad things he did to your holy people in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mini ŋun laɣim suɣiri ʒiɛri ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa.
en: Jesus answered, One who has dipped his bread in the same bowl with me will be the one to hand me over.

dag: ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi ni di mihi.
en: the dwellings tent pegs and the courtyards tent pegs, and their cords.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛɣ asiba, o yi sa chani mɔɣili ni, nyin sa zaŋm a jaaŋgbe shɛli din daa leei wahu la niŋ a nuu ni chaŋ ti zani mɔɣili maa duli gul o.
en: Tomorrow morning take the stick that turned into a snake, then wait beside the Nile River for the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu vuhim nyabu ni na kul ʒiɛya gul shɛb ni bɛ vuhi, hal ka bɛn daa tuui wum lahibal suŋ la daa bi paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: So the opportunity is still there for some to enter and enjoy Gods rest. But those who first heard the good news about it did not enter, because they did not obey.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin m-puhi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi chuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. O ni daa lɛbigi Asiria naa suhu ti ba ka o sɔŋ ba Izraɛl Naawuni jɛmbu duu mɛbu tuma ni la.
en: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku wɔribara min o wɔhu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ku chɛchɛbunduhira.
en: I used you to smash horse and rider. I used you to smash chariot and driver.

dag: Ka niriba daa ʒe kpaŋ lihir o; amaa ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra, O daa tiligi shɛba, dinzuɣu o yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili ŋun nyɛ ŋun Naawuni Masia, ŋun tiligim omaŋa.
en: The people were standing around watching, but the leaders sneered at him, saying, He saved others. Let him save himself if he really is the Christ sent from God, the chosen one.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa gun o bia Ishimail mini bɛ ni daa dɔɣi dab bidib shɛb o yiŋa bee o ni daa zaŋ o liɣiri da shɛba. Doo kam ŋun daa be Ibrahimma yiŋa, o daa guni ba dindali maa kaman Naawuni ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: Abraham took his son Ishmael, all those born in his household, and all those purchased with his silver—that is, every male in Abrahams household—and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that same day, just as God had told him to do.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa fan ya bahi, dinzuɣu ka n zaani ya zaligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: I am commanding you to obey the Lord as a reminder that you were slaves in Egypt before he set you free.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai ka Yisa nyaandoliba ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread the disciples came to Jesus and asked him, Where do you want us to get the Passover meal ready for you.

dag: Dama n tumtumdiba n-nyɛ Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdi shɛba n ni daa yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.

dag: Ka sagbana mi yi ti mɔhi ka sabigi asiba, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi zuŋɔ. Yi baŋdi sagbana shihira, ka lee bi tooi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ shihira.
en: And in the morning you say, There will be bad weather today because the sky is cloudy. You know how to make sense of the skys appearance. But you are unable to recognize the signs that point to what the time is.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ni yino wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka yɛl o, Dindina ŋun ti yɛn ʒini Naawuni nam ni di bindirigu ni ti nya alibarika.
en: One of the men sitting at the table with Jesus heard these things. The man said to him, It will be a great blessing for anyone to eat a meal in Gods kingdom.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam daa chɛ o dolibu.
en: Because of this, many of Jesus' followers turned back and would not go with him any more.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tiŋgbani fabinda, ka ŋunkam be di ni kɔba ni chɔɣisi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣira ni teeku ni zahim gba ku lan beni.
en: Therefore, the earth itself becomes sick, and all who live on it grow weak; together with the wild animals and the birds in the sky, even the fish of the sea are dying.

dag: O di kpuɣi pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee pagɔrili, amaa o kpuɣim o zuliya ni paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: not a widow or a divorced woman or a woman who has been a prostitute. He shall marry only a virgin from his own clan.

dag: Shɛfatia daŋ — kɔbisita ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: the descendants of Shephatiah:.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni di nyɛla yi fa m-bahi zuɣu ka n daa chɛ Kɔrinti kandina.
en: I call God as my witness—he knows my heart! It was in order to spare you that I decided not to go to Corinth.

dag: Ka bɛ mini so daa bi lan tuhi tɔbu hal ti paai Asa nam dibu maa yuun pihitanaanu saha.
en: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of his reign.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la.
en: They made the vest of gold, of blue, purple, and deep red yarns, and of fine twisted linen.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Sulemaana daa mali buni mini yɛm n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: Solomon was the richest and wisest king in the world.

dag: Bɛ ni bi tum ʒiɛyimtali tuma maa zuɣu n ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make their country an empty wasteland, because they have not been loyal to me. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka yi ni ti lo noli goli maa daba awɛi dali zaawuni. Yi ni ti gbibila yi Vuhim Dabisili maa zaawuni hal ti lan paai zaawuni.
en: This is a Sabbath of special rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. You will observe your Sabbath on the ninth day of the month from evening to the following evening.

dag: ka n tiri ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti ku bahi yoli, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba n nuu ni.
en: I give them eternal life. They will never die, and no one will snatch them from my hand.

dag: Di ni sabi ni ti Duuma san la, kpe ŋɔ di gbinni nyɛla Naawuni Shia sani; ka ti Duuma Shia maa ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yolisim be.
en: Now, the Lord in this passage is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is present, there is freedom.

dag: M puhiri Asinkiritus mini Flɛgɔn ni Hɛrimɛs ni Patirɔbas ni Hɛrimas ni ti mabihi bɛn be bɛ san la.
en: Give my greetings to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and all the brothers in Christ who are with them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali Gɛrishɔn zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The enrollment of the Gershonites by their clans and their households.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: So then, you also must always be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you are not expecting him.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti paɣa maa? Ka Gɛhaazi garigi yɛl o, To, paɣ maa ka bidibiga, ka o yidana mi kurigi.
en: Elisha asked, So what can be done for her? Gehazi said, Well, she doesnt have a son, and her husband is old.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha maa ti Yaakubu ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So she gave Bilhah to her husband, and he had intercourse with her.

dag: Ŋuna n-duhiri tarimba, ka tiri bɛn be nandahima ni nasara.
en: Yes, it is God who raises the humble and gives joy to all who mourn.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka nyɛ duŋtaariba, bɛ lɛbi bɛ nini biri ma, ka zo ka chɛ ma.
en: But the people of Judah are stubborn. They are always planning ways to turn against me. They turned away from me and left me.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma ti kpe dundombil ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Then the Spirit picked me up and brought me into the inner courtyard. The Glory of the Lord filled the Temple.

dag: Ka Sintani yi kariti Sintani bahira, o ŋmaligimi tuhir omaŋa m-bala; ka wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani?.
en: So if Satan forces out his own demons, then he is fighting against himself, and his kingdom will not survive.

dag: Ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Sool lo o la zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu, ka daa yɛli Abiata ŋun nyɛ maligumaana maa, Zaŋmi tan la na.
en: David heard about Saul's plan to capture him, and he told Abiathar, Let's ask God what we should do.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zɔri vi ni a di ti Duuma bee man ŋun nyɛ o dansarika ŋɔ shɛhira, amaa Naawuni yiko ni, chɛ ka m min a laɣim di wahala lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Do not be ashamed, then, of witnessing for our Lord; neither be ashamed of me, a prisoner for Christ's sake. Instead, take your part in suffering for the Good News, as God gives you the strength for it.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli Filip, Guumi paai chɛchɛbuŋ ŋɔ lana.
en: The Holy Spirit said to Philip, Go over to that carriage and stay close to it.

dag: Ka Nahɔr mam ŋun yuli daa booni Riuma la mi daa dɔɣi Tɛba mini Gaham ni Tahash ni Maaka.
en: Reumah, Nahor's concubine, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

dag: Dama o mi ninvuɣ yoya, ka o yi nya zaɣ biɛɣu, o ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord made their enemies attack them.

dag: O daa ku Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Sihon, king of the Amorites; his love is eternal;.

dag: Nama ŋɔ tariga paabu yi ti miri, ka bɛ leei ninvuɣ biɛri n-simdi tibidarigibo, na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ hal kpiɔŋlana ni baŋda ni ninvuɣ yɔhinda.
en: When their kingship nears its end and their sins are almost complete, a king will step forward. He will be stern and a master of deception.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Absalom ti bahi bɔɣ zilinli ni mɔɣu maa ni, ka kahi kuɣa na ti pa o zuɣu, ka di du pam. Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa yinoyino daa zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: They threw Absalom's body into a deep pit in the forest and put a big pile of rocks over it. Meanwhile, the people of Israel had all run back to their own homes.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ zaa daa bela Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: These cities and their surrounding areas are the legacy of Zebuluns clans.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan yi nti yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ o mi yina nti wuhi ya ka yi baŋ ni m bi nya o taali baabiɛla.
en: Pilate came out of the palace again and said to the Jewish leaders, Look! Im bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no grounds for a charge against him.

dag: amaa a yi ku chɛ ka o dol ti chaŋ, ti ku chaŋ, dama doo maa daa yɛl ti, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yi ti ku nya n ninni. .
en: But if you dont agree to send him, then we cant go down because the man said to us, You may not see me again without your brother with you.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi chɛmi ka bɛ wurim bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani ti maani maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.

dag: N kpɛla yɔɣu kaman piɛ so ŋun bɔrigi la. Bom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ shee, dama m bi tam a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Come and find me. I am your servant, and I have not forgotten your commands.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o yiŋnim mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani, Yihimiya tinzun tiŋ wuna din be yi sani bahi, ka mali yimaŋa, ka taɣi binyɛra ye.
en: So Jacob said to his family and to all who were with him, Get rid of the foreign gods that you have; purify yourselves and put on clean clothes.

dag: Miri ka a di jɛrigu alizama, o ni lihi ʒiɛm a yɛm yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you.

dag: Niriba daa chɛla vuri ka gbilisiri tibili guhiri n ni yɛn di ba kpamli alizam shɛli.
en: People listened to me and waited, were silent for my advice.

dag: Yi bundaannim nyɛla duŋtaariba, ka yi niriba nyɛ ʒiŋmariba, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa be bɛ noya ni.
en: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.

dag: Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni paɣ a, dama bɛ wum a yɛtɔɣa.
en: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord , and they will praise you.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ: Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni tintani din zaa daa baɣi Mɛdɛba la.
en: It was the land from Aroer near the Arnon Ravine to the town of Medeba. This included the whole plain and the town in the middle of the ravine.

dag: Pa Jɛhoyachin ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni lihi ʒiɛm duɣu ŋmaŋ shɛli, ni duɣ shɛli so ni je la? Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o min o bihi vil labi bɛ ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni?.
en: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Aai, m bihi, n ni wum ka Yawɛ niriba maa yɛri yi yɛla shɛm luɣ shɛlikam maa bi viɛla.
en: Sons, stop that! The Lord s people are saying bad things about you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi halli zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka yi yihiri yi paɣiba, amaa piligu ni ha, pa lala n-daa nyɛ li.
en: Jesus replied, You are so heartless! That's why Moses allowed you to divorce your wife. But from the beginning God did not intend it to be that way.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ ni niriba ayi daa kuni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Ɛmaus, ka di mini Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛ kaman maali ayopɔin la.
en: On that same day, two disciples were traveling to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

dag: Di ŋubiya li, ka binshɛɣukam ti niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, yi ni tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani zuɣu.
en: So dont eat blood. You must do what the Lord says is right, and good things will happen to you and to your descendants.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn chɛ ka yi ʒiʒiinitab nyuri yi suhuyiɣisili dam, ka yi kul boori yi lɔɣu pahiri hal ka bɛ ti nyu m-buɣi ni di chɛ ka yi nya bɛ zaɣim la zuɣu.
en: You're doomed! You get your friends drunk, just to see them naked.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ mali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: For seven days, the priests will make the altar pure and ready for use in worshiping God.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so yi be Masia ni, o biɛhigu leela biɛr palli; nyama, ka o biɛr kurili la din gari; ka biɛr palli maa deei di zaani zani.
en: So then, if anyone is in Christ, that person is part of the new creation. The old things have gone away, and look, new things have arrived!.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a me jɛmbu duu ti ma maa, a niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a ni lo lala a suhu ni maa zuɣu.
en: But the LORD said to my father David, It is very good that you thought to build a temple for my name.

dag: Ka Leeban daa zaŋ o dɔɣiriba pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kari Yaakubu naba daba ayopɔin hal ti mir o zoya ni tiŋ shɛli din yuli daa booni Giliad maa.
en: So he took some of his relatives along and chased after Jacob for seven days, before catching up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyari bilila n niriba tiŋgban ni. Iin, kummiya suhupiɛlli ni daa be yil shɛŋa ni mini tin shɛl ni la zuɣu.
en: for my peoples soil growing barbs and thorns, for all the joyous houses in the jubilant town.

dag: M mi ni bin sun shɛli ka n ni. N ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa. Hal n ni yu zaɣ suŋ tumbu n suhu ni maa zaa yoli, n kul bi tooi tumdi li.
en: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.

dag: O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisinaata. Ka o daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Shamir.
en: Tola was a leader of Israel for years, then he died and was buried in Shamir.

dag: Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun chɛ ka Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: Pharaoh refused to let the Israelites go free, just as the Lord had said through Moses.

dag: Mɔɣu ni mini fɔndi ni nima, paɣimiya Naawuni; Kɛdarinima, paɣimiy o. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Sɛla fɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu, tahimiya, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Deserts and cities, villages of Kedar, praise the Lord! People living in Sela, sing for joy! Sing from the top of your mountain.

dag: O daa bi chɛ o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa. Dama o bilim ni ka dɔbba daa pun niŋ o kɔre n-zaŋ o saɣim.
en: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.

dag: Ka sala buɣimniɛm yiri neesim shɛli din be o sani maa ni na.
en: Fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa wuhirila o Bia yɛla: Zaŋ chaŋ o daadamtali polo, bɛ daa dɔɣ o la Naa Dauda zuliya ni;.
en: It is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ: as to his humanity, he was born a descendant of David;.

dag: N yi yɛli ni zibisim sɔɣim ma, ka neesim din gili ma zaa leei zibisim.
en: If I said, The darkness will definitely hide me; the light will become night around me.

dag: Amaa Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa bɛn be o sani ni daa wum Nɛtania bia Ishimail ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the evil things Ishmael had done.

dag: Ŋun yɛn zani n nyaaŋa mirina. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi n taali ni nyɛ shɛli? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun fiɣisiri ma maa? O chɛ ka m min o chaŋ ʒiishee, ka ti gbɛri ti kpa taba.
en: The one who will declare me innocent is near. Who will argue with me? Lets stand up together. Who will bring judgment against me? Let him approach me.

dag: Ifriimnim daa ŋmanila bɛ ni wuhi naɣisa so ka o bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ o bu chi, ka n daa bi zaŋ binshɛli pa o nyiŋgoli din viɛl la zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zaŋ dapua n-ga Ifriimnim nyiŋgoya ni. Judanim ni jari, ka Yaakubu zuliya yɛbisi bɛmaŋmaŋ puu.
en: Israel was once like a well-trained young cow, ready and willing to thresh grain. But I decided to put a yoke on her beautiful neck and to harness her for harder work. I made Judah pull the plow and Israel pull the harrow.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa labi ti yɛl o dana maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Ka o daa je suli pam, ka yɛl o yiŋbia maa ni o yim yom doli solɔri mini sobihi m-boli nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni zoomba mini gbariti na.
en: When he returned, the servant reported these excuses to his master. The master of the house became angry and said to his servant, Go quickly to the citys streets, the busy ones and the side streets, and bring the poor, crippled, blind, and lame.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka piɛgula yino ŋun nyɛ n dabili Dauda guli ba ka dihiri ba. O ni ti dihiri ba ka nyɛ bɛ piɛgula.
en: Then I will put one shepherd over them, my servant David. He will feed them and be their shepherd.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daliri ka maligumaani so doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ gari ka chɛ o.
en: It so happened that a priest was going down that road; but when he saw the man, he walked on by on the other side.

dag: Piɛla so a ni daa nya ka o mali yil ayi la wuhirila Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim nanim yɛla.
en: The ram you saw that had two horns represents the kingdoms of Media and Persia.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must be holy and keep yourselves holy because I am the LORD your God.

dag: N yur a zaligunim maa pam. Di nyɛla n saawaranima.
en: Your rules make me happy. They give me good advice.

dag: Amaa ka n daa yɛli, Ka mani ŋɔ tatabo zo? Mani ŋɔ tatabo ni zo nti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni n tiligi? N ku niŋ lala.
en: I answered, I'm not the kind of person that runs and hides. Do you think I would try to save my life by hiding in the Temple? I won't do it.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ʒini yi sani. Guliya ti ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ti maa ku paai ti. Ŋun nahindi ti maa yi ti lan kani, saɣiŋgu maa ni zani tariga; ka ninvuɣ kuriba maa gba ku lan be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Let the outcasts of Moab live among you. Be a hiding place for them from the destroyer. When the oppressor is no more, when destruction has ceased, when the trampler has vanished from the land.

dag: Bɛ tim a anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi, ka ti a alikama din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pia, ka ti a wain lita tusaayi, ka ti a kpam lita tusaayi, ka ti a yalim pam kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: They will be allowed to give as much as . tons of silver, tons of wheat, , liters of wine, , liters of olive oil, and all the salt you need.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ bi lan bɔri bindirigu, ka bɛ kɔre lan ka bindir viɛlli ni gba.
en: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu kam nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani. Baŋmiya ni bɛ ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.

dag: Musa daa yɛli ba, Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya bɛn zaa lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu ni Yawɛ ninni ŋɔ, yi doli ya gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du, ka yi ti tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, dindina yin zaŋmiya Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: If the men of Gad and Reuben cross the Jordan ready for battle at the Lord 's command and if with their help you are able to conquer the land, then give them the land of Gilead as their property.

dag: Naawuni ka n niŋ naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: I trust God, so I am not afraid of what people can do to me!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini niriba yinsi biɛɣukam nti wuhiri ba, ka yihiri waazu yɛri ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Every day they continued to teach and proclaim the good news that Jesus is the Christ, both in the temple and in houses.

dag: Ti daa pun yɛli ya ni yi miri ka yi mali Yisa yuli ŋɔ yihiri waazu tiri niriba, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ka bahi zaŋ li moli gili Jɛrusalɛm zaa, ka bɔri ni yi zaŋ o kum zambu ʒil ti.
en: He said, We told you never again to teach using that name. But look at what you have done! You have filled Jerusalem with your teaching. And you are trying to blame us for his death.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yi o pɔri maa nyaaŋa m-mɔŋ bipuɣiŋga maa o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: King Herod was very sad, but he didnt want to break the promise he had made to her in front of his guests.

dag: Cham nuzaa polo ti moli yɛligu ŋɔ n-yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ku lan yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra. N ku je suli niŋ ya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Jeremiah, look toward the north and speak this message: Come back, you faithless people of Israel. This message is from the Lord . I will stop frowning at you. I am full of mercy. The Lord says, I will not be angry with you forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan nya ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri ŋɔ bee n-tum buɣijɛmbo tuma. N ni tiligi n niriba yi nuu ni. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So now your false visions and misleading predictions are over. I am rescuing my people from your power, so that you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana ŋun daa gul o ba Zibiɔn bunsi ka ti nya kɔbilisirim mɔɣu ni la.
en: These are Zibeons sons: Aiah and Anah. Anah is the one who found water in the desert while pasturing his father Zibeons donkeys.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ gba nyɛla nɔzaɣisiriba pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka bɛ nya nambɔzɔbo kaman yi ni nya nambɔzɔbo shɛm.
en: And now they are the ones who refuse to obey, because God showed mercy to you. But this happened so that they can also receive mercy from him.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu yi be situra ni, di yi nyɛla ago ni bee bimpiɛlli ni.
en: Some clothing might have mildew on it. The cloth could be linen or wool, woven or knitted. Or the mildew might be on a piece of leather or on something made from leather.

dag: Paɣipuulan ti ku zaŋ bahi, ka paɣiŋoo mi ti ku be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni tin ya nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.

dag: Chɛ ka di dabisili maa leei zibisim. Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ di lan teei di yɛla bee n-chɛ ka neesim neei di ni.
en: Turn that day into darkness, God. Never again remember that day; never again let light shine on it.

dag: A daalikauli min a suhu yubu zuɣu, ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa ni a chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋ li.
en: You will do all these wonderful things because you said you would do them and because you want to do them. And you decided to let me know about all these things.

dag: Nyama, di pun sabimi ʒiɛya n sani, m bi yɛn shini, amaa n ni darigi bɛ tibili.
en: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.

dag: N suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu; ka yihi ma n dabeenzɔbo zaa ni.
en: I went to the Lord for help, and he listened. He saved me from all that I fear.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tir o ba min o ma jilima, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who does not show respect to their father or their mother! Then all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na yirila o suhu ni na; dina n-nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these are the things that make you ritually unclean.

dag: Ka wula ka yi lee tɛhira? So yi mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka bɛ ni yino ti bɔrigi, o ku chɛ kɔbigayinika la zoya zuɣu bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu?.
en: Let me ask you this. What would you do if you had sheep and one of them wandered off? Wouldn't you leave the on the hillside and go look for the one that had wandered away?.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ taali ni yibu Naawuni sani din yi yɛda niŋbu ni na polo di sabiya: Di bɔhi a suhi ni, Ŋuni n-lee ni du alizanda ni? .
en: But this is what the Scriptures say about being made right through faith: Dont say to yourself, Who will go up into heaven.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Din kariya ka ti chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna.
en: The people replied, We would never leave the Lord to serve other gods!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: Jesus replied, Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi sani, din kariya, ka n chɛ Yawɛ suhi tin ya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. N ni wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli ka tuhi.
en: As for me, the Lord forbid that I should sin against him by no longer praying for you. Instead, I will teach you what is good and right for you to do.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ din tari ninsal daɣiri, amaa nir yi bi doli ni paɣibu kali soli m-paɣir o nuhi ka diri bindirigu, din bi tar o daɣiri.
en: These are the things that make people wrong. Eating without washing their hands will never make people unacceptable to God.

dag: M bihi, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Ka yi ni daa pun wum ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Masiachihira ni ti kana la, hal Masiachihiriba pam pun kana gba, dinzuɣu ti baŋya ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa n-shiri bɔŋɔ.
en: My dear children, the end is near! You have heard that the enemy of Christ is coming. And now many enemies of Christ are already here. So we know that the end is near.

dag: Hal ti nyari ka yɛnnim kpira, ka jɛra mini bɛn ka laasabu gba kpira. Bɛ zaa mi kpirimi n-chani ka chɛri bɛ daazichi tiri shɛba.
en: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa kul duhir omaŋ pahira, amaa o ni daa mali kpiɔŋ pam maa ka o yilli la kabi. Ka yila anahi daa bili yina n-zani di zaashee, ka nir ni tooi nya li viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi zaa noya daa kpala dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ zaa yiniyini polo.
en: The goat grew more and more arrogant, but at the height of his power his horn was broken. In its place four prominent horns came up, each pointing in a different direction.

dag: Kum yi ti lu, o ni tilig a ka a ku kpi; tɔb tuhibu ni, o ni tilig a takɔbi kum ni.
en: In famine he will ransom you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ salima jɛŋgbaris adaka mini alɔbo kɔtomsi la niŋ di ni.
en: They put the Covenant Box in the wagon, together with the box containing the gold models of the mice and of the tumors.

dag: A nyɛla nambɔzɔra ni ŋun chɛri taali paŋda, hal ti ni kul zaɣis a la zaa yoli.
en: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛli shɛm maa tiɣi Izraɛlnim maa nini, ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni, ka bi lan yɛli tɔbu lo n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba, ka saɣim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni daa ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa yɛla.
en: The Israelites were satisfied and praised God. They no longer talked about going to war to devastate the land where the people of Reuben and Gad had settled.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim o, N zaŋ sandaani timbu tuma ti o;.
en: So tell him that I am making a covenant with him that is valid for all time to come.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bɔri ni bɛ ku o ka di lahibali ti nti to Rom sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa su nimaani ni Jɛrusalɛm zaa damya.
en: While they were trying to kill Paul, the commander of the Roman army in Jerusalem got word that the whole city was in a state of riot.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti jɛm Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, saa ku mi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Whoever among the families of the earth doesnt go up to Jerusalem to pay homage to the king, the LORD of heavenly forces, upon them no rain will fall.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n yi ti niŋ ya din viɛla n yuli zuɣu ka pa ni yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛri yoli ni simdi shɛm zuɣu, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When I act to protect my honor, you Israelites will know that I am the Lord , because I do not deal with you as your wicked, evil actions deserve. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, amaa o nirilim ŋmanila maligim din lu mɔri zuɣu.
en: The king's anger is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like welcome rain.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the Lord s message to Jeremiah:.

dag: N kul dolila o ni wuhi ma shɛm; n kul dolila o soli ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: I follow faithfully the road he chooses, and never wander to either side.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yihi salima nɛma din be bɛ ni zaa Sinai Zoli gbini, ka bi lan zaŋ li niŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: So the Israelites stopped wearing their jewelry at Mount Horeb.

dag: Ka ti lan mi ni Naawuni Bia daa kana nti ti ti la baŋsim ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli; ka ti nyɛla bɛn be Naawuni maŋli ni o Bia Yisa Masia puuni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli, ka lan nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.

dag: Dama dindali yuŋ maa n ni tim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gari, ka ku Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa, ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka darigi Ijipti buɣa zaa tibili. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Tonight I will go through Egypt and kill every firstborn man and animal in Egypt. In this way I will judge all the gods of Egypt and show that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka n daa yɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ maa Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma binshɛŋa zaa.
en: and I told the exiles everything that the Lord had shown me.

dag: Ka Gaad bidibisi daa nyɛ: Zifiɔn mini Hagi ni Shuni ni Ɛzibɔn ni Ɛr ni Arɔd ni Arɛli.
en: Gads sons were Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli, ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim a yurilim maŋli zuɣu. Dama a nya n ni diri wahala shɛli; ka mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni.
en: I will be glad and rejoice because of your constant love. You see my suffering; you know my trouble.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Dan was .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zahim maa m-mali chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: So the priests and the Levites received the silver and the gold and the utensils as they were weighed out, in order to bring them to Jerusalem, to our Gods house.

dag: ka Buki nyɛ Abishua bia, ka Abishua nyɛ Finɛhas bia, ka Finɛhas nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza mi nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulana Aduna bia.
en: Bukki was the son of Abishua. Abishua was the son of Phinehas. Phinehas was the son of Eleazar. Eleazar was the son of Aaron the high priest.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tim ti boli Pool na ka Tɛɛtulus gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra: N dan Filiksi, a zuɣu ka ti ʒiya ni alaafee, ka a tumdi tuun suma tiri ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa.
en: After the governor summoned Paul, Tertullus began to make his case against him. He declared, Under your leadership, we have experienced substantial peace, and your administration has brought reforms to our nation.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ka m mi yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Hushai told the priests Zadok and Abiathar, Here is what Ahithophel advised Absalom and the Israelite elders, and here is what I advised.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundombila ti maligumaaniba, ka lan mali dundɔn titali, ka mali pundi niŋ li, ka dooi daanya pa di pundi maa zuɣu.
en: He made the courtyard of the priests and the great courtyard, with doors covered with bronze for the courtyard.

dag: Yawɛ ni yu shɛlikam, dina ka o niŋda zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni, ni teekunim ni mini kɔbula zaa ni.
en: He does whatever he wishes in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in the depths below.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa niŋ o nu yin ni, ka kpuɣi zali niŋ o nudirigu ni n-zaŋ tanti kpaa maa ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋa.
en: She reached for a tent-peg and held a hammer in her right hand. And with a blow to the head, she crushed his skull.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka yi yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, He has a demon.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb tiŋgbani n-ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o pahi.
en: She answered, I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply. Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: Remember that all these things will happen before the people now living have all died.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi fɔŋ maa ni chani Yisa sani.
en: So they left the town and went to Jesus.

dag: Binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa puuni, naɣila Musa ni daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa niŋ di puuni Sinai Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nyaaŋa la.
en: The only things inside the Holy Box are the two tablets that Moses put there at Mt. Horeb. This is where the Lord made his agreement with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N ni kpihim ninsal shɛba n ni daa nam niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri mini biŋgbamda ni noonsi birili, dama di niŋ ma yoli pam n ni daa nam ba maa zuɣu.
en: So the LORD said, I will wipe off of the land the human race that Ive created: from human beings to livestock to the crawling things to the birds in the skies, because I regret I ever made them.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ shiri yɛn niŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku doo ŋɔ.
en: So the Israelite told David about the reward for killing Goliath.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili zani. Zaŋmiya yɛlimaŋli leei shɛlɔriti lo yi shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ wuntitali leei yi nyɔtaɣirisi;.
en: So stand with the belt of truth around your waist, justice as your breastplate.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋmaligi po omaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N je Yaakubu karimbaani la. N je bɛ ni me bɛ yiya suma shɛŋa la. N ni zaŋ bɛ tin tital la niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.

dag: Ka o daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o suhu saɣim pam, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: When he heard these words, the man became sad because he was extremely rich.

dag: M-pahi Bɛɔr bia Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ baɣa, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ takɔb ku o pahi bɛ ni daa pun ku shɛb zuɣu la.
en: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.

dag: Dama a nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bahira; amaa ka siɣisiri karimbaannima.
en: You are the one who saves people who suffer and brings down those with proud eyes.

dag: ka zaŋ niriba maa zaa labina ti ti a kaman amiliya n-kul o yidan yili la. Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko ka a bɔr ni a ku ka chɛ bɛnkam kpalim zaa ka bɛ suhu doya.
en: and I will bring all the people back to you like a bride comes back to her husband. Its only one mans life you are seeking; everyone else can be at peace.

dag: Teeku kom yiɣisiya pili Babilɔn, ka di kɔgbana din mali vuri pam la lim li.
en: The sea has risen over Babylon; its pounding waves overwhelm her.

dag: Nɛtɔfa — pihinunaayɔbu.
en: from the town of Netophah:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti tim omaŋmaŋ bia ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia ŋɔ ŋun jilima.
en: Finally, the owner sent his own son to the renters, because he thought they would respect him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; ka man gba ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli yi ni daa tum tuun shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: And now may the Lord be kind and faithful to you. I too will treat you well because of what you have done.

dag: Bɛ yi ti paai goli yini, nyin zalim ba ka bɛ yo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu, ka bɛ daa zali ba kaman Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri zahimbu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The price for a first-born son who is at least one month old will be five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.

dag: Teem ŋun nam a yɛla a bipolitali saha, ka wahala saha na bi paai, ka yuun shɛŋa ni a ni ti yɛn yɛli, M baɣa lan ka shɛl ni la gba saha na bi paai.
en: Remember your creator in your prime, before the days of trouble arrive, and those years, about which youll say, I take no pleasure in these.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la, ka Yisa nyaandoliba bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when the Passover lamb was sacrificed, the disciples said to Jesus, Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover meal.

dag: M ma, mbusim be n zuɣu a ni daa dɔɣi ma zuɣu. Tiŋ maa nim zaa kul mali ma la naŋgbankpeeni mini zabili. N na ʒi n-dihi so samli bee n-di so samli, amaa bɛ zaa kul turi ma mi.
en: What an unhappy man I am! Why did my mother bring me into the world? I have to quarrel and argue with everyone in the land. I have not lent any money or borrowed any; yet everyone curses me.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla yim, dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, O kurila ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: So I say, Does it make any difference? God destroys the innocent as well as the guilty.

dag: Ŋun bɔri ni o jɛm ma, ŋun doli ma. N ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka n yiŋbia gba ni ti be. Ŋun jɛmdi ma, dilana ka m Ba Naawuni tiri jilima.
en: Whoever wants to serve me must follow me, so that my servant will be with me where I am. And my Father will honor anyone who serves me.

dag: Fɔnisia, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya. Zomiya kuli Speen.
en: You ships, try to escape to Tarshish! Cry out, you people living near the sea!.

dag: Yinim Speennima, labimiya yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni. Kpe lan pala teeku kulinoli.
en: Go and farm the land, you people in the colonies in Spain! There is no one to protect you any more.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa daa balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ. Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o.
en: The man from whom the demons had gone out begged Jesus, Let me go with you. But Jesus sent him away, saying.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni ka a sanna sagban tibisili puuni, dina n-ni chɛ ka niriba maa wum n ni tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa shɛm, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ niŋ a yɛda sahakam. Musa ni daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm zaa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: The Lord said to Moses, I will come to you in a thick cloud and let the people hear me speak to you. Then they will always trust you. Again Moses reported to the Lord what the people had said.

dag: Absalom daa lan yɛli; Mani n-yi di nyɛ sariakarita Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ŋunkam yi di zaŋ o kpee tahi n sanna bee n-zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam na, n naan kari saria maa dɛde n-ti o nasara.
en: And he would add, How I wish I were a judge! Then anyone who had a dispute or a claim could come to me, and I would give him justice.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni na.
en: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the meeting tent.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so yi kɔrigi nahu bee piɛɣu bee bua yi sansani ŋɔ ni bee kpaŋa.
en: Any one of you Israelites might kill a bull, a lamb, or a goat. You might be in the camp or outside the camp.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɔnatan daa ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma, Kamina ka ti chaŋ Filistia tɔbbi shɛb bɛn be yaɣili ŋɔ polo ha nim sani. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o ba.
en: One day Jonathan said to the young man who carried his weapons, Let's go across to the Philistine camp. But Jonathan did not tell his father Saul.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, M bo n-nya yɛm pam gari na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ n tooni ʒini Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ zaa; ka kpahim baŋ yɛla pam yɛm mini baŋsim puuni.
en: I said to myself, Look here, I have grown much wiser than any who ruled over Jerusalem before me. My mind has absorbed great wisdom and knowledge.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ata maa ni ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Izraɛl naa sani.
en: In the third year, Judahs King Jehoshaphat visited Israels king.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa yi ka luɣ shɛli nimaani nim baɣa ka shɛl ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: When theres no vision, the people get out of control, but whoever obeys instruction is happy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bimbiɛlli ti biri kulim shee. Di daa nyɛla bimbilli din ʒe m-baɣi kom pam. O daa biri li mi kaman tia din zoora yomyom la.
en: Then the eagle took some of the seeds from Canaan. He planted them in good soil by a good river.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal biɛri din bie pam ka so ku tooi di li la ni be shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Juda naa Zɛdɛkia min o kpambaliba ni Jɛrusalɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni mini bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka timaŋmaŋ kul nyuri bara yi zuɣu Naawuni cheechinim ni. Ti niŋdila lala yi ni mali ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛda niŋbu yi daalaka nyabu mini yi wahala dibu puuni la zuɣu.
en: That is why we ourselves boast about you in the churches of God. We boast about the way you continue to endure and believe through all the persecutions and sufferings you are experiencing.

dag: zaŋ Nɛgɛb mini bɔpiɛligu din nyɛ Jɛriko vinvamli, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din mali dɔbino tihi la hal ni Zɔa.
en: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.

dag: Ka o daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; o daa bela pɔhim kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-kana yomyom.
en: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.

dag: O ni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ kara m-mo Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, ka ni ti no n-taai wuntizɔriba. O ni ti kpaŋ omaŋa ni o taɣi bɛ daadiini zaligunim mini churi puhibu saha, ka ni ti su wuntizɔriba yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.

dag: Yila pia la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn ti yɛn su fukumsi nam maa ʒiɛman ni. Di nyaaŋa na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ ŋun be o ko ni o tab bɛn daŋ o tooni na la, ka ni ti yihi nanim ata nam ni.
en: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n zalila tiŋguliba a goma zuɣu. Bɛ di shini wuntaŋ ni zaŋ tabili yuŋ zaa. Yinim bɛn kul teeri Yawɛ ŋɔ, di bɔriya ni yi vuhi.
en: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni o ti tuh o. Ka Hɔshia daa zaŋ omaŋ ti Asiria naa maa ka yɔr o farigu.
en: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni n-kuli Ɛliashib bia Jɛhɔhanan yiŋa nti gbe nimaani, ka kul bela suhugarigu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi la polo. O mi daa bi di bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: Then he went from in front of the Temple into the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib, and spent the night there grieving over the unfaithfulness of the exiles. He did not eat or drink anything.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ Yaakubu ti neendiriba, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim ti ŋmɛnditoya? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni tum alahichi so sani, ka bi dol o zaligu ni o soya la n-niŋ lala maa.
en: Who gave Israel up to the looters? It was the Lord himself, against whom we sinned! We would not live as he wanted us to live or obey the teachings he gave us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu n ni bɔr a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: For the good of the Temple of the Lord our God, I pray that good things will happen to this city.

dag: Ka o daa yihi ti nimaani na nti zaŋ o ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim la ti ti.
en: He freed us from Egypt to bring us here and give us this land, as he had promised our ancestors he would.

dag: N kala dunia ŋɔ ni na kaman neesim, ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda ku kpalim be zibisim ni.
en: I came into this world as a light. I came so that everyone who believes in me will not stay in darkness.

dag: Dindali maa n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli min o yiŋnim polo la ni ti niŋ pali, di piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: On that day, I will bring to pass against Eli everything I said about his household—every last bit of it!.

dag: Din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ni na nyɛla: Yurilim mini suhupiɛlli ni suhudoo ni suɣilɔdibo ni nirilimtali ni zaɣisuntali ni ʒiɛyimtali ni.
en: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ nimaani n-kpe duu maa ni ni o ti vuhi.
en: The next time Elisha was in Shunem, he stopped at their house and went up to his room to rest.

dag: Ka Miriam daa yiini yila yɛra: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima, ka daai wɔribara min o wɔhu zaa niŋ teeku ni.
en: Miriam repeated the words, Sing to the Lord ! He has done great things. He threw horse and rider into the sea ....

dag: amaa ka Maikil min o malaikanim maa daa nyaŋ waɣ biɛ titali maa min o malaikanima, ka bɛ lan ka biɛhigu shee alizanda ni.
en: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Naawuni. Ka Aduna mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka bɛ mini Musa deemba maa ti laɣim di bindirigu Naawuni tooni.
en: Then Jethro, Moses father-in-law, brought an entirely burned offering and sacrifices to God. Aaron came with all of Israels elders to eat a meal with Moses father-in-law in Gods presence.

dag: M mɛla yili shɛli din mali jilima ti o, ka di nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: but God, I have built you a lofty temple—a place where you can live forever.

dag: O ni daa niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni saha shɛli maa ka o daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni.
en: As he was doing this, he left and was taken up to heaven.

dag: Chɛrubi yino wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla. Ka chɛrubi ŋun la gba wɔɣilim nyɛ lala.
en: The height of both winged creatures was fifteen feet.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yuli ba ti tuui taba ni suli, ka o suhu daa lan saɣim pam bɛ ninkuunsi zuɣu, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o daa tee li ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus looked at the people. He was angry, but he felt very sad because they were so stubborn. He said to the man, Hold out your hand. The man held out his hand, and it was healed.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali soli bo n-nya buni, di ku niŋ anfaani, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: The treasure of the wicked wont profit them, but righteousness rescues people from death.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Whoever does what my Father in heaven wants is my brother, my sister, and my mother.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Juda Naa ŋun ʒi Dauda nam ʒiishee ŋɔ min a kpamba ni a niriba bɛn doli dunɔdali ŋɔ kpɛra, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to this message from the Lord , King of Judah. You rule from Davids throne, so listen. King, you and your officials must listen well. All of your people who come through the gates of Jerusalem must listen to the message from the Lord.

dag: N na mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa yi na ku tooi deei li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: I have much more to say to you, but you cant handle it now.

dag: A ŋmanila abie tia, ka a biha be kaman di wala yila la.
en: You are tall— as tall as a palm tree. And your breasts are like the clusters of fruit on that tree.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Aai, m bihi, n ni wum ka Yawɛ niriba maa yɛri yi yɛla shɛm luɣ shɛlikam maa bi viɛla.
en: No, my sons. Dont do this. The report I hear spreading among Gods people isnt good.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o ba paɣa, noli din dim o, o ni ta o ba bindoo daɣiri zuɣu. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who disgraces his father by having intercourse with any of his father's wives. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Hal bɛ kalinli ni daa bi galisi, ka bɛ lan nyɛ saamba nimaani.
en: God's people were few in number, strangers in the land of Canaan.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to Egypt and gathered all the Israelite leaders together.

dag: Inok ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla.
en: When Enoch was years old, he became the father of Methuselah.

dag: Kahimiya yi nɛma ka bɛ gbahi ya daba chaŋ, yinim bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ. Dama Mɛmfisi ni ti leei dabari n-wurim doya, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: Get ready to be taken prisoner, you people of Egypt! Memphis will be made a desert, a ruin where no one lives.

dag: Tin shɛli din daa ʒe yim la yipa ŋmanila pagɔrili! Yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali n-daa yi be di ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ ninvuɣ kuriba m-be di ni.
en: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Obɔt.
en: The Israelites moved on and camped at Oboth.

dag: Chɛ ka di biɛŋmarisi leei zibisim, ka chɛ ka di niŋ neesim tahima, amaa ka bi nya li. Di chɛ ka asiba neesim lan neei di ni.
en: Let that days morning star be dark. Let that night wait for a morning that never comes. I wish it had never seen the first rays of sunlight.

dag: N ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni nirilim, ka chɛ ka bɛ be n sani. Ŋunkam doli so shɛli din ka galimi, ŋuna n-ni tum n tuma.
en: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.

dag: Niriba pam daa di o shɛhira kpɛma, amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa daa lee bi doli taba.
en: Many people did tell lies against Jesus, but they did not agree on what they said.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni. Bɛ ni tur a tu shɛŋa zaa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: My devotion to your Temple burns in me like a fire; the insults which are hurled at you fall on me.

dag: ka yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba maa, Ti bia ŋɔ nyɛla tipawumlilana ni nɔzaɣisira; o bi deeri ti noli; o nyɛla pulaandana ni danyura.
en: They are to say to them, Our son is stubborn and rebellious and refuses to obey us; he wastes money and is a drunkard.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima n-fa nam maa ti ŋun Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and take control of the whole country. So he called together , soldiers from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Di saha ka o naanyi kahigi yɛli ba, Lazarɔs kpimi;.
en: Then Jesus told them plainly, Lazarus is dead!.

dag: Timoti daa mali yu suŋ Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Listra mini Aikɔnium la sani.
