en: All the believers in Lystra and Iconium spoke well of Timothy.

dag: ka Salimɔn dɔɣi Bɔaz, ka Bɔaz dɔɣi Obɛd.
en: Salmon was the father of Boaz. Boaz was the father of Obed.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam li pa teeku zuɣu, ka chɛ ka di pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.

dag: Dama so na mi n-yɛli Naawuni, N nyɛla alahichilana, amaa n ku lan tum lala yaha.
en: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.

dag: N kala dunia ŋɔ ni na kaman neesim, ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda ku kpalim be zibisim ni.
en: I have come as a light into the world so that everyone who believes in me wont live in darkness.

dag: n di bi zaɣisi ni m be yi sani pumpɔŋɔ n-taɣ zilinli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama n suhu zɔhiri yi zuɣu.
en: But I wish I could be with you now and change how I sound, because Im at a loss about you.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yuri Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn pam.
en: The messenger speaking with me called out, This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: I care passionately about Jerusalem and Zion.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa;.
en: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.

dag: A yi di nyɛla jɛrigu ŋun duhir amaŋa bee a yi di lɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu, nyin zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli;.
en: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani maa na.
en: she replied, This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: Tell this to the man who sent you to me.

dag: Ka n daa lan bo da shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali nyɔri sara maligu binyara buɣim la na di bɔbu saha; ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ tahiri tiwala din daŋ moobu na. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: I also provided for the wood offering at appointed times as well as for the early produce. Remember me, my God, for good.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi mini Amiliya maa yɛli, Kamina! Ŋunkam wum dimbɔŋɔ, ŋun gba yɛlima, Kamina! Ka kɔnyuri ni mali sokam mini ŋun bɔri nyɛvili kom, ŋun kamina nti dee li yoli.
en: The Spirit and the bride say, Come! Everyone who hears this should say, Come! If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A nya Izraɛlnim bɛn ka ba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm, bɛ ni daa chaŋ daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini ti niŋ zina shɛm bebɔ?.
en: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.

dag: Bɛn daa ʒi bindirigu maa dibu shee maa ni so daa bi baŋ din chɛ ka o yɛli Judas lala maa.
en: No one sitting at the table understood why Jesus said this to him.

dag: M bia, a yi deei n yɛligu, ka doli n zaligunim din be a suhu ni.
en: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.

dag: ni Ira ŋun daa nyɛ Ikɛsh Tɛkɔa nir bia la ni Abiɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Anatɔt nir la.
en: Ira, Ikkeshs son from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth.

dag: M mali Ofiri salima din gari tɔn kɔbiga mini anzinfa din nyɛ alali tɔn kɔbisiyi ni pihinahi ni bɛ zaŋ li dooi pa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dukpina zuɣu.
en: three thousand kikkars of gold from the gold of Ophir, seven thousand kikkars of refined silver for covering the walls of the rooms.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa nimdi min o gbaŋ ni o nyɔri dina, zaŋm li yi yi sansani maa kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim, dama din nyɛla alahichi sara maligu.
en: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka yi yi gundi nira Vuhim Dabisili dali ni Anabi Musa zaligu maa di saɣim, di chaŋ wula ka yi je suli niŋ ma n ni chɛ ka ninsal niŋgbuŋ zaa nya alaafee Vuhim Dabisili dali zuɣu?.
en: If a boy is circumcised on the Sabbath so that Moses' Law is not broken, why are you angry with me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni noli ni din ya; ka yi ni shɛb kul ni nyɛla daba sahakam; ka kabiri dari, ka ŋɔŋdi kom niŋdi n Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: So now you are cursed. Some of you will always serve as woodcutters and water haulers for my Gods house.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi n-dol o kaman naɣilaa ka bɛ vɔri chani ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la bee n-nyɛ tɔŋtɔŋ kaman molifu n-zɔri chani tɔŋ ni la.
en: He followed her, like a bull being led to the slaughter. He was like a deer walking into a trap.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ o yɛligu n-yɛli Pɛtuɛl bia Joɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the Lord 's message to Joel son of Pethuel.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zali dimbɔŋɔ ka niŋ li, ka wuhi ʒiɛmana yɛla piligu ni zaŋ kana? Man Yawɛ n-daa beni piligu ni, ka ni lan beni naabu ni.
en: Who has acted and who has done this, calling upon generation after generation since the beginning? I, the LORD, was first, and I will be the last!.

dag: Dama n daa bi dee li la ninsal sani; pa so mi n-daa zaŋ li wuhi ma, amaa di yila Yisa Masia ŋun daa kahigi li wuhi ma la sanna.
en: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.

dag: ka lan zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi la. Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ li niŋ salima bintabindisi la ni.
en: The fourth row should have a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. Set all these jewels in gold.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani mini bɛnkam jɛmd o zaɣ viɛlli.
en: The LORD is good to those who hope in him, to the person who seeks him.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ dundɔŋ gili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunoli. Lala ka Musa daa niŋ naai tuma maa.
en: Moses set up the enclosure around the Tent and the altar and hung the curtain at the entrance of the enclosure. So he finished all the work.

dag: Yi dimnim tɔbbi yino ni ti kari yi ninvuɣ tuhili ka yi ŋmaligi guui, ka bɛ tɔbbih anu ni tooi kari ya ka yi zaa ŋmaligi guui, ka yi tɔbbi yino gba ti ku kpalim zani naɣila binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili din be zoli zuɣu la n-ni ti kpalim beni.
en: A thousand of you will run away when you see one enemy soldier, and five soldiers will be enough to make you all run away. Nothing will be left of your army except a lonely flagpole on the top of a hill.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n kul dol a zaligunim maa zaa. N je ʒiri soli kam.
en: Thats why I walk straight by every single one of your precepts. Thats why I hate every false path.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam Ziɔn; bɛ duh o gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: The Lord in Zion is great! He is the great leader over all people.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ku tum tuumbiɛɣu; Kpiɔŋlan Naa ku ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli.
en: Almighty God does not do evil; he is never unjust to anyone.

dag: Bɛ bi diri wahala kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni diri wahala shɛm. Alɔbo mi bi luri bɛ zuɣu kaman di ni luri ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu shɛm.
en: They are never in trouble; they arent weighed down like other people.

dag: Molimiya Naawuni yiko yɛla; ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa, ka o yiko be sagbana ni.
en: Tell everyone how powerful he is! He rules over Israel. His power fills the skies.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, A yi kari ti, nyin chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: So the demons begged Jesus, If you are going to drive us out, send us into that herd of pigs.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ paɣir o yɛtɔɣ suma din yi o nol ni na maa zuɣu, ka bɔhiri taba, Pa Yisifu dapal la m-bala.
en: All the people started talking about Jesus and were amazed at the wonderful things he said. They kept on asking, Isn't he Joseph's son.

dag: Chɛ ka puri atam niŋ pam. Chɛ ka daboya zuɣu zaa zibigi bindira, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pam kaman Lɛbanɔn bindira ni niŋdi shɛm la. Chɛ ka fɔntinsi ni pali niriba kaman mɔri ni zibigi mɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: May there be plenty of grain in the land; may the hills be covered with crops, as fruitful as those of Lebanon. May the cities be filled with people, like fields full of grass.

dag: Gbariti ni ti yiɣi jɛm kaman waliga la, ka biriti ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli. Kom ni ti zɔri yiri tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ nɛl la ni na. Ka mɔɣa ti dɔni di ni.
en: Crippled people will dance like deer, and those who cannot speak now will use their voices to sing happy songs. This will happen when springs of water begin to flow in the dry desert.

dag: Wahu daa nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana n-gari Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb zaa. Ka wahu daa ti bɔhi paɣ maa, Naawuni yɛliya ni yi miri ka yi di puu ŋɔ ni ti shɛli wala.
en: Now the snake was the most cunning animal that the Lord God had made. The snake asked the woman, Did God really tell you not to eat fruit from any tree in the garden.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee nyɛ li? Ka o garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla piɛɣu, ka nyɛ din ʒe bɛ daalahichi zaani dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: I said, Whats this? He said, This is the basket that is going out. This is how it appears throughout the entire land.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti lo ni m bɔhim nya yɛm, ka nya niriba ni gaani gom yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa dunia ni.
en: Then I set my mind to know wisdom and to observe the business that happens on earth, even going without sleep day and night.

dag: N ni daa kari yi yaannim saria Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm la, lala ka n yɛn kari yi gba saria. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will judge you as I judged your ancestors in the desert near Egypt. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Izraɛl daa yuri Yisifu pam gar o bihi bɛn kpalim maa zaa, o ni daa nyɛ o ni dɔɣi bi so o kuriginsim saha la zuɣu. O daa shɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din baɣiri wɔɣa n-ti o.
en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons because he was born when Jacob was old. Jacob had made for him a long robe.

dag: ni o ni daa tum tuun shɛli tin ya tiŋgban nɛl ni hal ka yi ti paai kpe ŋɔ na.
en: You know what the Lord did for you in the desert before you arrived here.

dag: Jɛhoyakim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛkɔnia mini Zɛdɛkia.
en: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la yuli duya pam. Ti pun wum o yɛla; ka wum o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa Ijipti la yɛla;.
en: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ni daa pun piligi niŋdi shɛm la o kul niŋmi lala n-naai yurilim tuuni ŋɔ yi gba sani.
en: So we urged Titus, who began this work, to continue it and help you complete this special service of love.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum lala maa di daa muɣis o mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya.
en: When King Herod heard about this, he was very upset, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee nyɛ li? Ka o garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla piɛɣu, ka nyɛ din ʒe bɛ daalahichi zaani dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: What is it? I asked. He replied, It is a basket, and it stands for the sin of the whole land.

dag: Judas ni daa yiɣisi yi n-naai, ka Yisa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ ka Daadam Bia jilima yipa yi palo, ka Naawuni gba jilima yi palo o zuɣu;.
en: After Judas had left, Jesus said, Now the Son of Man's glory is revealed; now God's glory is revealed through him.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: Then he used acacia wood to make the poles for carrying the table. He covered the poles with pure gold.

dag: Tumo ŋun biɛ tahirila yɛla na, amaa tumo ŋun ʒe yim tahirila faako na.
en: Wicked messengers fall into trouble, but a reliable one brings healing.

dag: O nam dibu yuma ata saha ka o daa laɣim o kpambaliba min o tuma zuɣulaannim na ni bɛ ti puhi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu. Pɛriʒia mini Miidia tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim gba daa beni nti pahi gomnanim mini tiŋgbana maa nabihi.
en: In the third year of his rule he hosted a feast for all his officials and courtiers. The leaders of Persia and Media attended, along with his provincial officials and officers.

dag: Naawuni nia lɔbu min o ni zali shɛm puuni ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋda; ka ŋun Naawuni pii ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba ti mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun lo ka zal li shɛm omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni piligu ni ha la zuɣu.
en: In Christ we were chosen to be Gods people. God had already planned for us to be his people, because that is what he wanted. And he is the one who makes everything agree with what he decides and wants.

dag: Ti nyɛla do yino bidibisi pinaayi; ka ti ni yino daa kani, ka ŋun nyɛ ti zaa biasani be ti ba maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: We come from a family of twelve brothers. The youngest is still with our father in Canaan, and the other is dead.

dag: ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan pun booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam Gihɔn; ka bɛ yi nimaani na m-mali suhupiɛlli, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɔri vuri tiŋ puuni maa. Di vuri ka yi wum maa.
en: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anointed Solomon at Gihon Spring and then went back into the city. The people followed them, and now everyone in the city is celebrating. That is the noise you hear.

dag: O daa laɣim teeku kom kaman luɣuluɣu ni kom la n-sɔŋ luɣ yini. O daa nam bula niŋ di biɛhigu shɛhi.
en: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yiɣisi kpɛri dunoli maa zuɣusaa duu puuni ka kumda. O ni daa chani ni o ti kpe maa o daa yɛrimi, Mbaye, m bia Absalom, m bia, m bia Absalom! Mani n-yi di kpi ka chɛ a ŋɔ, di di so. Mbaye, Absalom. M bia, m bia.
en: So the king knew Absalom was dead and he became very upset. He went upstairs to the room over the gate, crying, O my son Absalom! My son Absalom, I wish I had died instead of you! O Absalom, my son, my son.

dag: A zuɣu ka bɛ kul turi ma, ka n kul diri vi.
en: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.

dag: Bɛ sani, a ŋmanila yiliyiina ŋun yiini yurilim yila, ŋun kukoli viɛla, ka o mi biŋkumda ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga. Bɛ wumd a ni yɛri shɛm, amaa bɛ ku niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: You are nothing to these people but a singer singing love songs. You have a good voice. You play your instrument well. They listen to your words, but they will not do what you say.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, o suhu paligirimi, ka o zaŋ o buɣi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And when he finds it, he is thrilled and places it on his shoulders.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, dabiɛm mini bɔɣ biɛri ni zana n-ʒe n-gun ya.
en: Listen to me, everyone! There are terrors, pits, and traps waiting for you.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a dɔni a kabiri ni ni suhudoo, ka n chɛ ka a paag a yaannim tooni pɔi. A nini ku nya n ni ti yɛn chɛ ka zaɣibiɛ shɛli zaa lu Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba zuɣu maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ labi ti yɛli naa.
en: So before I destroy this place, I will let you die in peace. The men left and reported to Josiah what Huldah had said.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ di o shɛhira o ni tumdi ni nimmoo yi mini Laodisianim ni Hiɛrapolisnim zuɣu shɛm.
en: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.

dag: Chɛ ka buɣim salinɛma lu bɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi bɔɣ zilima ni, ka bɛ ku lan tooi yi di ni na.
en: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.

dag: A ni ti nyu li zaa n-lɛlilɛli di puuni, ka dim cheei li ka zaŋ di ŋmama maa ŋme m-bɔɣ a biha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will drink and drain it dry, and with its broken pieces tear your breast. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Juda naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaata saha shɛli ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa, ka n gba kul mal li tɔɣisiri ya di zuŋɔ yuun pisinaata, amaa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu.
en: From the thirteenth year of Judahs King Josiah, Amons son, to this very day—twenty-three years—the LORDs word has come to me. I have delivered it to you repeatedly, although you wouldnt listen.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa shiri niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza.
en: All this did happen to King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Bɛ kul malila kpiɔŋ chana; bɛ ni nya Naawuni ŋun gari wuna zaa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.

dag: ni o tiligi ba kum ni, ka dihiri ba kum saha.
en: He protects them from death and starvation.

dag: Yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba, miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmaai yimaŋa bee m-pini yi gbɛri yi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: You are the people of the Lord your God. So when you mourn for the dead, don't gash yourselves or shave the front of your head, as other people do.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi ba, Buɣ din ni ka yi lee chani maa? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni nimaani yuli Bama hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: I said to them, What shrine are you going to now? So its called Shrine to this very day.

dag: Kɛlub bia Ɛzri n-daa su kpariba fukumsi.
en: in charge of agricultural workers cultivating the fertile land—Ezri, Chelubs son.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa kpe nti shiri niŋ kaman Ilaija ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o min o bidibiga maa ni o yiŋnim zaa kul nyari bindirigu diri dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: The widow went home and did exactly what Elijah had told her. She and Elijah and her family had enough food for a long time.

dag: ni Ishimaya ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn nira, ka nyɛ tɔbbi so ŋun yuli daa du, ka o gba su ninvuɣ pihita fukumsi la ni Jɛrimia ni Jahaziɛl ni Jɔhanan ni Jɔzabad ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛdɛra nir la.
en: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite ; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad from the Gederathites;.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba bɔhi, Paɣ ŋuni n-lee ni mal anzinfa laɣibaligu pia, ka di zaɣ yini ti bɔrigi, ka o ku nyo firila kolikol o yiŋ zaa m-bo li ni nimmoo hal ti nya li?.
en: Jesus told the people another story: What will a woman do if she has ten silver coins and loses one of them? Won't she light a lamp, sweep the floor, and look carefully until she finds it?.

dag: Bɛ ŋmarila tab ʒiri; naŋgbammalisim mini tɛha ayiyi yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisira.
en: Everyone tells lies to everyone else; they talk with slick speech and divided hearts.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni, dama ŋun sani bɛ zaa kul bemi.
en: He is the God of the living, not of the dead, for to him all are alive.

dag: Di boliya so yi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, dama Naawuni yino ŋun bɛ alizanda ni ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ yi ba.
en: Don't call anyone on earth your father. All of you have the same Father in heaven.

dag: Yawɛ, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka a ni yɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ n zuliya polo ŋɔ niŋ pali sahakam. Niŋmi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Lord , you made this promise to me and my family. Now, keep your promise forever. Do what you said you would.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai bɛ daa laɣimla Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ha n-yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam zaa min o ni daa mali soli ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka bɛ niŋ yɛda shɛm yɛla.
en: On their arrival, they gathered the church together and reported everything that God had accomplished through their activity, and how God had opened a door of faith for the Gentiles.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka ala ka n lee yɛn yo a? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, di bi kpa talahi ni a yo ma shɛli. N na kul ni gul a biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: Laban said, What will I pay you? Jacob said, Dont pay me anything. If you will do this for me, I will take care of your flock again, and keep a portion.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin: Yisifu ŋun daa pun bela Ijipti.
en: The total number of these people directly descended from Jacob was seventy. His son Joseph was already in Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhu Naawuni, ka daa kpalim be nimaani yuŋ zaa suhiri Naawuni.
en: At that time Jesus went up a hill to pray and spent the whole night there praying to God.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Pa ŋuna nti yɛn di a fali; amaŋmaŋ bia nti yɛn di a fali.
en: The LORDs word came immediately to him, This man will not be your heir. Your heir will definitely be your very own biological child.

dag: N ni mihi n ninni niŋ ba, bɛ ni daa kul tiligi buɣim dili ni maa, buɣim na kul ni bahi di ba. Ka n yi ti mihi n ninni niŋ ba, a ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and I have confronted them. They may try to go out from the fire, but the fire will consume them. You will know that I am the LORD, because I confronted them.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa; ka Filistianim maa daa dol ba ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: When the Philistines attacked the Israelites, the Israelites ran away from the Philistines, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sabi o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will die as the Scriptures say he will, but how terrible for that man who will betray the Son of Man! It would have been better for that man if he had never been born.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa bi saɣi bahi omaŋ ti ba, dama o daa mi din be ninsal kam suhu ni.
en: But Jesus did not trust them, because he knew how all people think.

dag: Amaa ka o ŋari ma. O taɣi n yɔri la siɣimsiɣim bupia, amaa Naawuni bi saɣi ka o niŋ ma shɛli.
en: and that he keeps cheating me by changing my wages time after time. But God has protected me.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu soli ni daa na bi kana, ti daa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ni di gbibi ti hal ti paai yɛda niŋbu soli maa palo yibu saha.
en: Before faith came, we were guarded under the Law, locked up until faith that was coming would be revealed.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n chɛ ka n suhu bi yiɣisi. M paɣibu zuɣu ka n gbaai mmaŋa ni di chɛ ka n ku kun ya.
en: But I will be patient. I will do this for myself. People will praise me for not becoming angry and destroying you. You will praise me for waiting.

dag: Zaŋmiya sania maŋa mini kuruwa maŋa ni taha din nyɛ zaɣ maŋa n-zahindi binyara.
en: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ o yiko puuni. O yɛm puuni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ. O baŋsim puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: God used his wisdom and power to create the earth and spread out the heavens.

dag: Ka Hiburɔn daa leei Jɛfune ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb ni su shɛli hal ni zuŋɔ, o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yim la zuɣu.
en: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Lala zuɣu Masia ŋun daa zaŋ omaŋ mali sara yim ni o kpihim niriba pam daalahichi la ni lan labina pahi buyi, ka di pala alahichi zuɣu, amaa o yɛn labina ti tiligila bɛn suhuri kul ye o labbuna zuɣu ka guhir o la.
en: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni zaŋ kuɣituurili sɔŋ bɛ soli zuɣu, ka bɛ ti tuui li; bihi mini bɛ laamba zaa, ka ʒiʒiinikpee min o zo zaa ti kpi.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: Im putting obstacles before this people, and both parents and children will stumble over them; neighbor and friend alike will perish.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa nahim ba pam, ka zaŋ bɛ yiko su ba.
en: Their enemies controlled them and made life hard for them.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani Pasidamim saha shɛli Filistianim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim chi puu ni ka Izraɛlnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ba la.
en: He fought on David's side against the Philistines at the battle of Pas Dammim. He was in a barley field when the Israelites started to run away.

dag: ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: when seven cows, fat and sleek, came up out of the river and began feeding on the grass.

dag: N ni tum jɛrilim zuɣu chɛ ka n dansi maa yuma niŋla yu biɛri, ka nyo pam.
en: Because I have been foolish, my sores stink and rot.

dag: Ka tuun biɛri ni ti yɛn zooi zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yurilim filim.
en: Such will be the spread of evil that many people's love will grow cold.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa, wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani? Dama yi yɛri ni Biilzibul yiko ni ka n kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: So if Satan is fighting against himself, how will his kingdom survive? You say that I use the power of Satan to force out demons.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Yawɛ di ma shɛhira, ka o ni pii na so ŋɔ gba di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi bi nya galimi shɛli m biɛhigu ni. Ka bɛ daa saɣi, Iin, o di shɛhira.
en: Samuel replied, The Lord and the king he has chosen are witnesses today that you have found me to be completely innocent. Yes, the Lord is our witness, they answered.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bi niŋ yɛlimaŋli la yɛda, amaa ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla alahichi tumbu nyaɣisim zuɣu la ni ti nya saria karibu.
en: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth.

dag: Chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ leei zaɣ palli kaman bipolli niŋgbuŋ la; ka chɛ ka o lan mali yaa kaman o ni daa nyɛ bipolli la.
en: Our health is restored, we feel young again.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa, Ninvuɣ so yi ku doo ŋɔ ka yihi filiŋ ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɔ ka bɛ yɛn niŋ ti dilana? Dama Filistia nir ŋun bi guni ŋɔ mi leei nyɛ ŋuni hal ti kana ni o ti ta Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ tɔbbihi daɣiri.
en: David asked the men who were near him, What will the man get who kills this Philistine and frees Israel from this disgrace? After all, who is this heathen Philistine to defy the army of the living God.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ san la, ka di leei alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.

dag: Aduna zuliya, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, God is always merciful.

dag: Paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni ʒe go tihi sunsuuni shɛm, lala ka n yura be paɣisara sunsuuni.
en: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni bɛ ni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa nyaaŋa bɛ ni labi n sanna, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labina, ka bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa daa nya li.
en: I said to myself, Israel will come back to me after she has finished doing these evil things. But she did not come back to me. And Israels unfaithful sister, Judah, saw what she did.

dag: Naawuni yɛlimaŋtali zuɣu, o ni tiligi Ziɔn; o wuntitali zuɣu o ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni ka niŋ tuuba.
en: Zion will be redeemed by justice, and those who change their lives by righteousness.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa darigi Ashidɔdnim tibili pam n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ tiŋ maa ni zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi din gil li zaa.
en: The Lord caused a lot of trouble for the people of Ashdod and their neighbors. He made sores break out all over their bodies, and everyone was in a panic.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ti mali taɣitaɣi mini mɔri, ka palo beni ka yi ni gbe.
en: Then she said, Yes, we have straw and other food for your camels and a place for you to sleep.

dag: N daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, so ku lan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di nyaaŋa, dama n yɛtɔɣa daa yi kpɛri ba pam.
en: they had nothing to add when I had finished. My words sank in like drops of rain;.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi ni, ka Ijipti dɔr biɛ shɛŋa zaa din daa gbahiri ya la, o ku lan chɛ ka di gbahi ya. Amaa o ni chɛ ka di gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa jɛn ya.
en: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases.

dag: Dɔro di bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa, kum bituuli di bɛ nuhi min bɛ naba.
en: Diseases will eat away their skin. Death itself will eat their arms and legs.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka a nuu pa ŋun be a nudirigu polo la zuɣu, ŋun nyɛ a ni ti so kpiɔŋ ti amaŋ la.
en: Preserve and protect the people you have chosen, the nation you made so strong.

dag: Dama bɛ dirila ninvuɣ biɛtali bindirigu, ka nyuri duŋtaabo wain.
en: Wickedness and violence are like food and drink to them.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa chɛ o kɔchuɣu zali nimaani ka lab fɔŋ ni ti yɛli niriba.
en: The woman put down her water jar and went into the city. She said to the people.

dag: Hal ka daa ti lo ni o ta Naawuni jɛmbu duu daɣiri, ka ti daa gbaag o. Ti daa naan tooi doli ti zaligu soli n-kar o saria.
en: Also, he was trying to make the Temple unclean, but we stopped him. You can decide if all this is true. Ask him some questions yourself.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti ku n-naai bɛ zuliya maa. Di chɛliya ka so ti lan teei Izraɛlnim yuli yɛla yaha.
en: Come, they say, let us destroy their nation, so that Israel will be forgotten forever.

dag: N ni zaŋ o kpa luɣ viɛlli shee viɛnyɛliŋga kaman kpaa la, ka o leeg o daŋ niriba jilima nam ʒiishee.
en: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.

dag: ka n naanyi chaŋ ka ku lan labi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa mini zibisim titali ŋɔ ni na.
en: before I travel to the land.

dag: dama yi pun baŋ ti Duuma nirilim nyaɣisim ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: You have already tasted the goodness of the Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala shiri gbahi zahim pam, hal ka bɛ lansi maa ti pili chɛhibu;.
en: They did this and caught so many fish that their nets began ripping apart.

dag: Yi ku niriba pam yi tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, ka zaŋ yi ni ku shɛb maa pali di solɔri zuɣu.
en: You have murdered so many people here in the city that the streets are full of corpses.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o niriba maa chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti jɛm o. Amaa ka a na kul bi saɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Say to him, The LORD, the Hebrews God, has sent me to you with this message: Let my people go so that they can worship me in the desert. Up to now you still havent listened.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ŋun ni tooi chaŋ ti liri Kiriatisɛfanima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣ pini.
en: Caleb said, Ill give my daughter Achsah as a wife to the one who defeats and captures Kiriath-sepher.

dag: Neesim neeri wuntizɔriba sani, ka bɛn biɛhigu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yisifu zuliya, o daa bi pii Ifriim zuliya.
en: Then he rejected Josephs family. He did not accept Ephraims family.

dag: Zunzuya mini daɣiri m-pali n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ kul mɔri ti puhigira.
en: My body is full of worms; it is covered with scabs; pus runs out of my sores.

dag: Kamiya n sanna nti zaŋ n naɣikɔra dapua ye n-zaŋ yimaŋ tabili ma m-bɔhim biɛhigu n sani ka nya vuhim; dama n nyɛla tarima zaa.
en: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.

dag: Ka timanim gba daa niŋ bɛ tabibi ni bɛ chɛ ka pɔri yina, ka wolim je. Ka pɔri maa daa kul dimdi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: The magicians tried to use their magic to make gnats appear, but they failed. There were gnats everywhere.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naawuni, Wara ka chɛ ti. Bɔ ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛn tooi niŋ ti?.
en: who say to God, Turn away from us; what can the Almighty do to us.

dag: Saha shɛli ha o daa ka a buchi, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun mali buchi m min a zaa sani.
en: He was useless to you before, but now he is useful to both of us.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli ni maa zuɣu! Di chɛ ka alibarika be m ma ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa ni!.
en: Cursed be the day that I was born. May the day my mother gave birth to me not be blessed.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Gɔg yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord , am your enemy!.

dag: M mabihi bɛn mali be kasi ka saɣi alizanda ni boligu ŋɔ, tɛhimiya Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti daadiini tumo ni maligumaani tital la yɛla.
en: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!.

dag: O bidib kpɛm sani yuli daa boonila Joɛl, ka ŋun paya mi yuli booni Abija; Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba zuɣulaannima.
en: Samuels first son was named Joel. His second son was named Abijah. Joel and Abijah were judges in Beersheba.

dag: Man Yisa n-tim m malaika ni o zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ na nti ti cheechinima. N nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa ni biɛŋmariga ŋun ne.
en: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.

dag: Ka Piɛgul Kpɛm la yi ti kana, yi ni deei nam zuɣupila din mali jilima ka di viɛlim ku kpaai.
en: And when the chief shepherd appears, you will receive an unfading crown of glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ niŋ nimmoo n-chɛ ka yi bolibu mini yi piibu la ba n-zani, dama yi yi niŋ lala yi ku lu.
en: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yiɣisim lu m piɛgul ŋɔ zuɣu ku o, ka piɛri maa wurim, ka n lu bɛ zaɣ bihi gba zuɣu.
en: The Lord Almighty says, Wake up, sword, and attack the shepherd who works for me! Kill him, and the sheep will be scattered. I will attack my people.

dag: Ka n daa zahim anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa naa min o saawaranim ni o kpambaliba ni Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be nimaani ni daa ti ni bɛ zaŋ tum ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma la ti ba.
en: Then I weighed out the silver, the gold, and the utensils which the emperor, his advisers and officials, and the people of Israel had given to be used in the Temple, and I gave it to the priests.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa teei di ni daa sab yɛli shɛm la yɛla. Di ni daa sab shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni.
en: When this happened, his followers remembered what was written in the Scriptures: My strong devotion to your Temple will destroy me. Psalm :.

dag: Masia dapulli zuɣu kum puuni ka o daa kpihim dimdi din be ti sunsuuni la, ka zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba leei zaɣ yini n-zaŋ ba labisi Naawuni sani.
en: Through the cross Christ ended the hate between the two groups. And after they became one body, he wanted to bring them both back to God. He did this with his death on the cross.

dag: Dauda daa bela Zif mɔɣu ni Hɔrɛshi maa. Di saha ka o daa wum ni Sool kana ni o ti ku o.
en: David saw that Saul was out to kill him. David was at Horesh, in the wilderness near Ziph.

dag: ka nachimbil maa fuɣ o chinchini maa bahi, ka guui ni nyɔfindili.
en: but he ran away naked, leaving the cloth behind.

dag: O puli zuɣu gbaŋ ŋmanila salichɛhi; o teer omaŋ dooni baɣiri ni kaman kaburi dɔɣu la.
en: His abdomen is like jagged pottery shards; its sharp edges leave a trail in the mud.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti paai tin shɛlikam ka bɛ bi deei ya, yin doliya di pala yɛra.
en: But if the people of a town refuse to welcome you, go out into the street and say.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi bɛ naa salima zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu, ka kuɣ viɛlli daa be di ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda zuɣu ni, ka o daa va bɛ ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam.
en: From the head of the idol of the Ammonite god Molech David took a gold crown which weighed about seventy-five pounds and had a jewel in it. David took the jewel and put it in his own crown. He also took a large amount of loot from the city.

dag: M bia, chɛ ka a baɣa be n yɛligu ni. Gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛr a shɛm.
en: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.

dag: A mini Speen daa gɔrila kɔhigu tab tiŋgbɔna ni, yi ni daa mali azichi pam zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ di anzinfa mini kuriti ni dalima ni nuɣiso n-taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: Merchants from southern Spain traded silver, iron, tin, and lead for your products.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: Then Jesus replied, Neither will I tell you what kind of authority I have to do these things.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, niŋmiya tuuba ni yi suhuri zaa, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna ni nolɔbo mini kumsi ni fabila.
en: Yet even now, says the LORD, return to me with all your hearts, with fasting, with weeping, and with sorrow.

dag: ka di be o sani, ka o karindi li dabisili kam o biɛhigu ni din ni chɛ ka o bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu ŋɔ ni mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: He is to keep this book near him and read from it all his life, so that he will learn to honor the Lord and to obey faithfully everything that is commanded in it.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni lu yi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi nyɛ yi daba la ŋmaligi nyaŋ ya. Ka lala yi niŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: But look, I am about to raise my hand against them; they will become prey to their own slaves, so you will know that the LORD of heavenly forces sent me.

dag: Ka mɔɣili dɔni bihigu tiŋgban tulli shee; ka tiŋgban kuŋ shee leei kɔbil nina. Ka mɔri zooi lim kunduna ni daa yi be luɣ shɛli.
en: the burning sand will become a lake, and dry land will be filled with springs. Where jackals used to live, marsh grass and reeds will grow.

dag: Di nuzaa polo gba daa mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi la daa nyɛ daanya, amaa bin shɛŋa din daa yili daantalisi maa mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa.
en: The north side of the courtyard also had a wall of curtains cubits long. There were posts with bronze bases. The hooks for the posts and the curtain rods were made from silver.

dag: Ka Zikiri ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa ku nabia Maasɛya mini Azirikam ŋun daa nyɛ nayili sapashin kpɛm la ni Ɛlikana ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpɛma m-pa naa zuɣu la.
en: An Ephraimite warrior named Zichri killed the kings son Maaseiah, the palace administrator Azrikam, and Elkanah, the kings second in command.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zɔri ni bɛ ti du tampima, ka zaŋ kur tibisa anahi din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kɔtiŋa di nyaaŋa polo, ka kari bɛ buɣa ka jiɣiri biɛɣu neebu zuɣu.
en: The sailors were afraid that we would hit the rocks, so they threw four anchors into the water. Then they prayed for daylight to come.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bi niŋ yɛlimaŋli la yɛda, amaa ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛla alahichi tumbu nyaɣisim zuɣu la ni ti nya saria karibu.
en: The result is that all who have not believed the truth, but have taken pleasure in sin, will be condemned.

dag: Nyama, a pun wum Asiria naa ni pun niŋ tiŋgbɔna pam shɛm n-saɣim li zaa la yɛla. Ka a tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You have heard what an Assyrian emperor does to any country he decides to destroy. Do you think that you can escape?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ya Yawɛ maligumaaniba, ka lan boli ya Naawuni tumtumdiba. Yi ni ti di zuliya shɛb azichi daanfaani, ka nyu bara di ni nyɛ yi dini maa zuɣu.
en: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.

dag: Ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ti biɛhigu zaŋ tabili ti Duuma gba biɛhigu, dama hal yi ni daa di wahala pam la zaa yoli, yi daa deei ti yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛl shɛli din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi sanna la.
en: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sida dapaɣa kpahi duu maa nyaaŋa polo hal ti gbaai yɔɣira, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ kpahi di puuni gba lala ni di leei di puuni luɣ kasi shee, ka niŋ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi.
en: At the back of the temple he built thirty feet of cedar panels from the floor to the ceiling. Solomon built the inner sanctuary, the most holy place.

dag: Mbayooi! Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni tim na.
en: Jesus of Nazareth! What do you want with us? Did you come here to destroy us? I know who you are—Gods Holy One.

dag: Masia ŋun nyɛ ti nyɛvili la yi ti yi palo, yi gba ni yi palo m-pah o zuɣu nya jilima.
en: Your real life is Christ and when he appears, then you too will appear with him and share his glory!.

dag: Di daa kul malila takɔriti di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni kaman dimbalanim takɔriti ni daa be shɛm la. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its windows and its porch all around were like the others, and the gate also was seventy-five feet long and thirty-seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi yɛli, N kpuɣila paɣa, dinzuɣu n ku tooi kana.
en: A third man said, I just got married; I cant come.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka wuntaŋ mini maligu ni sakuɣa kanna ti kuri yi ni biri binshɛlikam, amaa ka yi na kul bi bɔri ni yi ŋmaligi lab n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Yɛl titali paai ma, chɛ ka n kpɛla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam, amaa di chɛ ka n kpe ninsal nuu ni.
en: Im in deep trouble, David said to Gad. Id rather fall into the hands of the LORD, who is very merciful; dont let me fall into human hands.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bapir maa, O kahigimi wuhi ti ni yi nya bunsi maa. Amaa Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o nam yɛtɔɣa la dina, o daa bi saɣi yɛl o di shɛli yɛla.
en: Saul answered, Samuel told us the donkeys were already found. He did not tell his uncle everything. Saul did not tell him what Samuel said about the kingdom.

dag: di saha ŋun ti zaŋ sara maa na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ŋmiri li.
en: Whoever presents a sheep or a goat as a burnt offering to the Lord is to bring with each animal pounds of flour mixed with pints of olive oil as a grain offering, together with pints of wine.

dag: Apil tia ni be nyɔŋ tihi sunsuuni shɛm la, lala ka n yura be nachimba sunsuuni. N yur o mahim ʒinibu ka o wala nyaɣisi pam n sani.
en: My lover, among other men, you are an apple tree among the wild trees in the forest! I enjoy sitting in my lovers shadow; his fruit is so sweet to my taste.

dag: Asa mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: The whole time that King Asa was king of Judah, he fought a war against King Baasha of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu, ka Ɛlhanan ŋun daa nyɛ Jair bia la daa ku Lahimi ŋun daa nyɛ Goliat Gaat nir la mabia, ka o kpani daɣu daa ŋmani kpalu daɣu.
en: In another battle against the Philistines, Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yi naa maa sani, zaŋ chaŋ o ti yɛn paai zɔn titali sunsuuni ka Yawɛ yɛl o.
en: Before Isaiah got to the middle court of the palace.

dag: Di bi wumdi so yɛligu; di bi deeri so saɣisigu; di bi niŋdi Yawɛ naani; di mi bi vuri miriti di Naawuni.
en: It has not listened to the Lord or accepted his discipline. It has not put its trust in the Lord or asked for his help.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni ha la, bɛ ʒilɛli maa ni ti nya zaa zani n sani, ka n ti darigi bɛn zaa daa nahindi ba la tibili.
en: Jacobs family will be like the family of Israel long ago. I will make Israel and Judah strong, and I will punish those who hurt them.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o diɛmpaɣa, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who has sex with his mother-in-law. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo daa kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu ni bɛ naai ba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa na kul bi chɛ; o daa na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.

dag: bɛ daa malila pin shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ti Yisifu la zali gu o kundina saha wuntaŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa wumya ni bɛ min o n-yɛn laɣim di.
en: The brothers heard that they were going to eat with Joseph, so they worked until noon preparing their gifts for him.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla duno shɛli din labiri wulinluhili polo la mini Shalɛkɛt duno shɛli din be pal shɛli din be kunkuni zuɣu palli polo n-ti Shupim mini Hɔsa. Ka bɛ daa gul li ka tiri taba.
en: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:.

dag: Ka di daa bi yuui ka biasani maa laɣis o ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha. Nimaani ka o daa ti zaŋ o buni maa zaa tum yoliyoli.
en: Soon afterward, the younger son gathered everything together and took a trip to a land far away. There, he wasted his wealth through extravagant living.

dag: M bi sɔɣi a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla n suhu ni, n kul yɛr a ʒiɛyimtali min a sɔŋsim maa yɛla. M bi sɔɣ a ʒiɛyimtali min a yurilim maŋli yɛla niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni.
en: I have not kept the news of salvation to myself; I have always spoken of your faithfulness and help. In the assembly of all your people I have not been silent about your loyalty and constant love.

dag: Pin suma mini pina din be tibi zaa yirila Naawuni ŋun nam alizanda mini neesim, ka nyɛ ŋun ka taɣibu, ka mi ka shilinshia din limsiri neesim maa la sanna.
en: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.

dag: M mabihi, doliya anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ ti Duuma yuli tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa la naba yi suɣilɔdibo din yuuri yi wahala dibu puuni la.
en: Brothers and sisters, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They suffered many bad things, but they were patient.

dag: Ka kum daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na. Ka kɔnyuri daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba kom din yi tampiŋ ni na. Ka a daa yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni zaŋ ti ba fali la su.
en: When they were hungry, you gave them bread from heaven, and water from a rock when they were thirsty. You told them to take control of the land which you had promised to give them.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti, dama ti niŋ yɛda ni ti ka galimi ti suhuri tɛha ni; ka di nyɛla ti ni bɔri ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka di tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Keep on praying for us. We are sure we have a clear conscience, because we want to do the right thing at all times.

dag: ka yi ti yɛli yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min nyaandoliba yɛn ʒini m-puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: Say to the owner of the house, The teacher says to you,Where is the guestroom where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples.

dag: O daa piila kuɣa pinaayi n-saɣisi Yaakubu so Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, A yuli n-nyɛ Izraɛl la bidibisi kalinli.
en: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob—to whom the LORDs word came: Your name will be Israel.

dag: Chɛ ka vi di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! N-yɛwaa! la.
en: Let those who say to me, Yes! Oh, yes! be destroyed by their shame.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Pa yi ninvuɣ pinaayi ka m pii ka yi ni yino ti nyɛ Sintani nir la.
en: Jesus replied, Didnt I choose you twelve? Yet one of you is a devil.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M ma mini n tizɔbihi nyɛla bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dol li.
en: Jesus said to them all, My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and obey it.

dag: M bia, mali yɛm, ka chɛ ka n suhu piɛla, ka n ni tooi garigi ŋunkam galindi ma yɛtɔɣa.
en: Be wise, my child, and make my heart glad, so I can answer those who insult me.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tum tuun shɛli dindali, dama di nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: You must not do any work that day because it is a Day of Reconciliation to make reconciliation for you before the LORD your God.

dag: Ka Midian kɔhigɔriba daa garita, ka bɛ yihi Yisifu bɔɣili maa ni na n-zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya maa zuɣu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti.
en: When some Midianite traders passed by, they pulled Joseph up out of the cistern. They sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver, and they brought Joseph to Egypt.

dag: Ka a ti she zabbanim mini shɛlɔriti ni zuɣupila n-ti Aduna bidibisi. Di simdi ka a mal li ka di nyɛla bɛ jilima mini bɛ nachiinsi situra.
en: Also make coats, belts, and cloth caps for Aarons sons. This will give them honor and respect.

dag: Dabiɛm ka bɛ yinsi puuni, ka Naawuni bi darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: God does not bring disaster on their homes; they never have to live in terror.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tibig o niriba laɣiŋgu ni, ka paɣ o kpamba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Praise God in the great assembly. Praise him when the older leaders meet together.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Balaam, Labimi ti zaŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm yɛli Balak.
en: Then the Lord gave Balaam a message for Balak and said, Go back to Balak and say the things that I have given you to say.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni labisi yi daazichi tin ya ka zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka laɣim ya yihi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb zaa ni la na.
en: Then the LORD your God will restore you as you were before and will have compassion on you, gathering you up from all the peoples where the LORD your God scattered you.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm mali ba kasi m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋm ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la mihi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ pini bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔbiri zaa, ka paɣi bɛ situra m-mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: in the following way: sprinkle them with the water of purification and have them shave their whole bodies and have them wash their clothes. Then they will be ritually clean.

dag: Ka naa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka Chimham daa dol o chaŋ; ka Judanim zaa mini Izraɛlnim pirigili gba daa zaŋ naa lu soli.
en: When the king crossed over to Gilgal, Chimham went with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel escorted the king across.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina; ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣiyihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: Any man who divorces his wife and marries another woman is guilty of adultery. And the man who marries a divorced woman is also guilty of adultery.

dag: ka a bɔri ni a nya n taali, ka vihiri ni a baŋ n daalahichi.
en: You look for my wrong and search for my sin.

dag: Aminadab ŋun daa nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la bia Nashɔn n-daa zaŋ o sara na ti mali dabisili din daŋ tooni dali.
en: The one presenting his offering on the first day was Nahshon, Amminadabs son, from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ gbibi bɛnkam zaa yɛn lu; ka yiɣisiri bɛnkam zaa pun lu.
en: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.

dag: Ka ti ni mali maligumaani titali ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.

dag: Lɛvinim shɛb bɛn kpalim puuni, bɛ daa pii fɔntins anahi Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Jokiniam mini Karita.
en: To the clans of the descendants of Merari, the rest of the Levites, from the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam and its pastures, Kartah and its pastures.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika; ka o ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-leeg o niriba mali alibarika.
en: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord ; happy are the people he has chosen for his own!.

dag: Ti saɣindi naŋgbankpeeni mini binshɛɣukam din duhiri dimaŋa ka nyɛ din guri Naawuni baŋsim sol la; ka gbahiri tɛha kam n-niŋdi li fukumsi ni ti chɛ ka di deei Masia noli.
en: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.

dag: Amaa nir yi yuri ka ku o kpee, yin zaŋmiya dilana sara maligu bimbini gbini n-yi kpaŋ ti ku o.
en: But whoever plans to kill someone out of anger or hatred must be punished. Take them away from my altar and kill them.

dag: O ni ti nyu bara o nasara dibu maa min o ni gbahi tɔbbihi pam ku ba zuɣu, amaa o kul ku nyɛ ŋun diri nasara sahakam.
en: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long.

dag: Daba ayɔbu dali bɛ daa yi pihirila ʒii buyi zuɣu. Bɛ daa pihirila lita anahi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana ti yɛli Musa di yɛla.
en: On the sixth day the people collected twice as much food as usual, two omers per person. All the chiefs of the community came and told Moses.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa yɛl o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi, M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa man maan yɛn pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa nɔnsi ka man yɛn zaŋ fiɛb ya.
en: He did what his friends told him to do and said, My father forced you to work hard, but I will make you work much harder! My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with whips that have sharp metal tips.

dag: Di zaa daa nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu. Dapaɣili kam daa tamla diba ayi zuɣu.
en: And so there were eight boards with their sixteen silver bases, with two bases under every board.

dag: Ka tibili yi yɛli ni di pala nini, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni, lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: The ear might say, I am not an eye, so I dont belong to the body. But saying this would not make the ear stop being a part of the body.

dag: Sool ni daa kul yɛri maligumaana maa lala saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa zɔbu yiriŋ mini bɛ vuri maa daa kul maan pahira; ka Sool daa yɛli maligumaana maa, Chɛl li.
en: As Saul was speaking to the priest, the confusion in the Philistine camp kept getting worse, so Saul said to him, There's no time to consult the Lord .

dag: Ka o yi yɛn zaŋla piɛɣu na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋmi piɛnyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli na.
en: If you bring a sheep as a sin offering, it must be a female without any defects.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi lihi nya ka bɛ ni she mahi kpil shɛli kuɣ tula zuɣu mini kɔgaɣili n-ʒe o zuɣu polo. Ka o daa di ka nyu, ka lan lab dɔni.
en: Elijah looked around, and by his head there was a cake that had been baked over coals and a jar of water. He ate and drank and then went back to sleep.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa diri tiɣiri zaŋ bɛmaŋ pa talima pumpɔŋɔ ni bɛ nya bindirigu di, amaa kum bi lan mali di ni daa mali shɛb la yaha. Paɣiŋoo dɔɣi bih ayopɔin, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi bihi pam la kɔŋ bihi.
en: The people who once were well fed now hire themselves out to get food, but the hungry are hungry no more. The childless wife has borne seven children, but the mother of many is left with none.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaata Isaka mini Asha ni Naftali ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni ti Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba.
en: The clan of Gershon was assigned thirteen cities from the territories of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh.

dag: Ka niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa mini nudirigu polo na ti ʒini Naawuni nam ni n-diri ka nyura.
en: People will come from all directions and sit down to feast in God's kingdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋunkam nyuri bara, ŋun nyum li la ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: This is consistent with what was written: The one who brags should brag in the Lord! .

dag: dama Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa zaŋ wuntia soli ka yi sanna la, yi daa bi niŋ o yɛda; amaa ka farigudeeriba mini pagɔra bɛn daa niŋ o yɛda. Ka hal yi ni daa nya lala maa zaa yoli, di nyaaŋa yi daa bi niŋ tuuba ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: When John the Baptist showed you how to do right, you would not believe him. But these evil people did believe. And even when you saw what they did, you still would not change your minds and believe.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛli, A takɔbi ni daa kul chɛ ka paɣiba kɔŋ bihi shɛm la, lala ka a ma gba yɛn kɔŋ bia paɣiba ni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahiŋmahi Agag sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Giligal.
en: Samuel said, As your sword has made many mothers childless, so now your mother will become childless. And he cut Agag to pieces in front of the altar in Gilgal.

dag: Lɛvinima m-bɔŋɔ: Azania bia Jɛshua la mini Binnui Hɛnadad daŋ ni nir la ni Kadimiɛl.
en: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan, Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah, Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani ni o ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to give Jesus up to them.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ni o zabi omaŋ zuɣu yɛli, M bi tum birigi Yɛhudianim zaligu shɛli bee n-tum taal shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu; m mi bi tum Naa Siiza taali hal baabiɛla.
en: Paul defended himself, saying, I have done nothing wrong against the Jewish law, against the Temple, or against Caesar.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bikpamba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He killed the firstborn males in Egypt, both men and animals. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pia saha shɛli din daa nyɛ Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: This is the message from the Lord that came to Jeremiah during the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah. The tenth year of Zedekiah was the th year of Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi piapia chani Lɛbanɔn nti niŋdi goli yiniyini ka tiri taba. Bɛ daa niŋdila goli yiniyini Lɛbanɔn, ka niŋdi chira ayiyi yiŋ mi. Adɔniram n-daa nyɛ niriba maa zuɣulana.
en: and he put Adoniram in charge of these workers. Solomon divided them into three groups of . Each group worked one month in Lebanon and had two months off at home.

dag: ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi bi zaŋ yimaŋ zali bia zaani yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: and said, I assure you that if you dont turn your lives around and become like this little child, you will definitely not enter the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di bi kpan ya ni yi baŋ di dabisa bee saha shɛli m Ba Naawuni ni zal li o yiko ni.
en: Jesus said to them, The times and occasions are set by my Father's own authority, and it is not for you to know when they will be.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya malaika so ka o tam teeku kom zuɣu mini dul la daa kpuɣ o nudirigu zuɣusaa.
en: Then the angel I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

dag: ni Bɛtimaakabɔt ni Hazarisusim ni Bɛtibiri ni Shaaraim. Bɛ fɔntinsi ni daa nyɛ tiŋ shɛŋa m-bala hal ka Dauda ti naanyi di nam.
en: Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their towns until David became king.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni, niŋm ti nirilim ka chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ. Iin, chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ!.
en: Lord our God, may your blessings be with us. Give us success in all we do!.

dag: Amaa bɛn sani, di ni ti ŋmanila ʒiri baɣiri, bɛ pun po pɔri, amaa ŋun teeri ba la bɛ taali ni nyɛ shɛli ni di chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: Everyone in Jerusalem had promised to be loyal to Babylonia, and so none of them will believe that this could happen to them. But Babylonia's king will remind them of their sinful ways and warn them of their coming captivity.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa tiligi ya nimaani; dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ maa.
en: Remember how you were a slave in Egypt but how the LORD your God saved you from that. Thats why Im commanding you to do this thing.

dag: Bɔ ka yɛnnim lee zaŋ so jɛra? Ka nyɔ bɔ ka tarimba lee nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa niriba ni?.
en: What advantage do the wise have over the foolish? Or what do the poor gain by knowing how to conduct themselves before the living?.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum lala maa ka o bɔhi ni Yisa nyɛla Galili nira?.
en: When Pilate heard this, he asked, Is this man from Galilee.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni tiri n gba, ka Naawuni ti ma n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka n tooi tɔɣisiri li ni suhukpeeni n-kahigiri lahibal suŋ la ashili gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba.
en: And pray also for me, that God will give me a message when I am ready to speak, so that I may speak boldly and make known the gospel's secret.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka anabinim shɛb daa ti yɛli Ilaisha, Nyama, luɣ shɛli ti ni be ka a wuhiri ti ŋɔ pɔri pam.
en: One day the group of prophets that Elisha was in charge of complained to him, The place where we live is too small!.

dag: Bɛ ku ninkura mini bihi sɔŋ solɔri zuɣu; bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku m paɣisara mini n nachimba. A suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛl la ka a daa ku ba maa. A daa kɔrikɔri ba, ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Young and old alike lie dead in the streets, Young men and women, killed by enemy swords. You slaughtered them without mercy on the day of your anger.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli nanim mini zuɣulaannim ni niriba bɛn pahi, Tuma maa galisiya ka di shɛhi wɔɣ ni taba, ka ti woliwoli taba gooni maa gbini.
en: I told the people and their officials and leaders, Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.

dag: Bɛ yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka ŋmari ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: those who say bad things about you. Your enemies use your name falsely.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: So suhu yi yɛya ni o leei cheechi toondana, o ni bɔri tuun shɛli maa nyɛla tuun suŋ.
en: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka doli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: Like King Jeroboam before him, he sinned against the Lord and led Israel into sin; he never gave up his evil ways.

dag: Tiŋkpambila n-daa beni, ka di puuni niriba bi galisi. Ka na titali daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi na ti teei gili tiŋ maa, ka mɛri bindura gindi di gooni.
en: It happened when a powerful ruler surrounded and attacked a small city where only a few people lived. The enemy army was getting ready to break through the city walls.

dag: O daa kaai gili nimaani tinsi zaa n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri pam m-mali ti paai Giriis.
en: He traveled through that region with a message of encouragement. When he came to Greece.

dag: ka ŋun boli ya maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a ni a yiɣisim ka ti ŋun gar a maa ʒiishee, di saha di ni mal a vi ni a chaŋ ti ʒini tariŋ ʒiishee.
en: The host who invited both of you will come and say to you, Give your seat to this other person. Embarrassed, you will take your seat in the least important place.

dag: Yɛndana nyarila baŋsim pahira. Amaa jɛrigu yɛtɔɣ yoya tahirila saɣiŋgu na.
en: The wise store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool brings on ruin.

dag: Ka bɛ ba bɔhi ba, So dini ka o lee doli? Ka o bidibisi maa daa wuh o anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa ni doli so shɛli. Ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa.
en: Which way did he go when he left? the old prophet asked them. They showed him the road.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi luri tiŋ na kaman sanʒiɛ titali ni yi yiɣisina nti ʒe fiig tia ka di wal kaha suuri luri shɛm la.
en: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.

dag: Yi yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba, dunianim naan yuri ya, amaa yi pala dunia ni su shɛba, dama mani m-pii ya, dinzuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim jɛn ya maa.
en: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.

dag: Yidana n-su o paɣ fukumsi kaman Masia ni su cheechi fukumsi shɛm la; Masia maŋmaŋ mi n-lan nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la tiligira.
en: For a husband has authority over his wife just as Christ has authority over the church; and Christ is himself the Savior of the church, his body.

dag: Dina ka ti mali paɣiri ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la, ka lan mal li turi ninsalinim bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni nam shɛba ŋ-ŋmahind omaŋ la.
en: We use it to give thanks to our Lord and Father and also to curse other people, who are created in the likeness of God.

dag: Naawuni ni booni so Nyɛvili Yɛligu la daa pun bela piligu ni, ka ti daa wum o yɛla, ka ti nini daa nya o ka ti lih o hal ka ti zaŋ ti nuhi tabis o.
en: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.

dag: Dama dunia ŋɔ nanim lo tɔbu, ka nazuɣuri laɣim n-zaɣisi ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia.
en: The kings of the earth prepare themselves to fight, and the rulers all come together against the Lord and against his Messiah. Psalm :-.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kun ya, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi sɔŋ ya?.
en: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia min o tɔbbihi zaa ni daa nya ba, ka bɛ zo n-kpe naa ʒiɛvari puu ni nti yi dunɔdali shɛli din daa be goma ayi sunsuuni la n-zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri ʒi Araba polo.
en: When Judahs King Zedekiah and his troops saw them, they tried to escape at night through the royal gardens and the gate between the two walls, toward the desert plain.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa ti paana n-yi biɛɣu n daa bi niŋ zinchili, ka chaŋ ti ʒini n sariadibo ʒiishee ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool na.
en: So when these Jews came here for the trial, I did not waste time. The next day I sat on the judgment seat and ordered Paul to be brought in.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Asaaya n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: Asaiah, the leader of the Merari clan, and of his relatives;.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga maa daa kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ la tariga mini di kulinol ni n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: Their south border ran from the end of the Dead Sea, from the bay that faces south.

dag: O daa fa li la Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknim sani, ni o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza Rɛhɔb bia ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la ka di neen shɛŋa la zaa.
en: Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek—as well as part of the loot he had taken from Hadadezer.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi ni daa na ʒi Naawuni la, yi daa bela dunia ŋɔ binshɛŋa din pa bin jɛmda dabitim ni.
en: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.

dag: Aduna mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya Musa ka o ninni nyaɣisira maa ka bɛ zɔri ni bɛ mir o.
en: Aaron and all the people looked at Moses and saw that his face was shining, and they were afraid to go near him.

dag: Ti kul dolila ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun nyɛ Rɛkab bia maa ni daa zali ti zaligu shɛŋa maa, dina n-nyɛ ni ti mini ti paɣiba ni ti bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi di nyu wain ti biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: We have obeyed all the instructions that Jonadab gave us. We ourselves never drink wine, and neither do our wives, our sons, or our daughters.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa yɛl o, M ba, a yi pun yaag a noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, nyin niŋm ma kaman a ni pun yɛli shɛm maa, Yawɛ ŋun dee ni bɔh a dimnim Ammɔnnim biɛri ti a ŋɔ.
en: She told him, If you have made a promise to the Lord , do what you said you would do to me, since the Lord has given you revenge on your enemies, the Ammonites.

dag: Amaa ka bɛn daa ti biɛra, ka man yɛla buɣu ka lo noli n-zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋ suhiri Naawuni;.
en: When they were sick, I was sad and wore sackcloth. I went without eating to show my sorrow.

dag: Ka bɔ n-daa lee niŋ ka a bi zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni? N ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan ku nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: If that is true, you should have put my money in the bank. Then, when I came back, my money would have earned some interest.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika maa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔri ni n wuh a n yuli? Dama n yuli maa nyɛla alahiziba yuli.
en: No, the angel replied. You don't need to know my name. And if you did, you couldn't understand it.

dag: A kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma bahi kpaŋa, a suhu ni yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: You were angry with me, so you picked me up and threw me away.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya n ni tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa alizanda ni na shɛm.
en: Then the Lord told Moses to say this to the Israelites: You people have seen that I talked with you from heaven.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, niŋmiya tuuba ni yi suhuri zaa, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna ni nolɔbo mini kumsi ni fabila.
en: But even now, says the Lord , repent sincerely and return to me with fasting and weeping and mourning.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣim chaŋ Mizipa. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa, Yɛlim ti bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛɣu maa shɛm.
en: The people from the tribe of Benjamin heard that the Israelites were meeting together in Mizpah. The Israelites said, Tell us how this terrible thing happened.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat ni tum shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka teei Nɔadia ŋun nyɛ anab paɣ la mini anab shɛb bɛn zaa pahi m-bɔri ni bɛ kpɛhi ma dabiɛm la gba yɛla.
en: My God, remember these deeds of Tobiah and Sanballat! Also remember Noadiah the prophetess and the rest of the prophets who have been trying to frighten me.

dag: Yawɛ, a suhuyubu puuni ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kahigi yɛl kara ŋɔ zaa wuhi ma.
en: It was your will and purpose to do this for me and to show me my future greatness.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, ti sa pun lab li mi yuŋ la zaa ka bi gbaai hal zin yino gba; amaa a ni kul yɛli ma shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni lab li.
en: Master, Simon answered, we have worked hard all night long and have not caught a thing. But if you tell me to, I will let the nets down.

dag: Dama nyin daa niŋ li la ashilɔni, amaa man yɛn niŋ li la palɔni wuntaŋ ni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni. .
en: You had sexual relations with Bathsheba in secret, but I will punish you so that all the people of Israel can see it.

dag: N daa niŋdi ba alaka waawaayili Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m muɣisi ba ka bɛ tu Yisa. N suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu pam maa zuɣu ka n daa du tin duya ni ni m paai ba nimaani ti niŋ ba alaka.
en: I often had them punished in our synagogues, and I tried to make them give up their faith. In fact, I was so angry with them, that I went looking for them in foreign cities.

dag: Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira.
en: I feel sorry for these people, because they have been with me for three days and now have nothing to eat.

dag: Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu! Bɛ pala zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni niŋ niriba shɛm, lala ka bɛ yɛn niŋ bɛ gba.
en: Tell those who disobey, You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.

dag: Ka a ni yɛn mali tulaale zim maa shɛm maa, miri ka a ti mali di tatabo n-leeg amaŋmaŋ dini. Zaŋm li leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: Do not use the same formula to make any incense like it for yourselves. Treat it as a holy thing dedicated to me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa lan yɛli paɣ maa, Cham ni suhudoo; a yɛda niŋbu n-tilig a.
en: Jesus said to the woman, Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

dag: Binnyura kɔre yi ti mali ba, n ni zaŋ bɛ binnyura zali ba ka bɛ nyu li hal ti buɣi, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka bɛ gbihi, ka ku lan neei sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Are they greedy? I will prepare them a feast and make them drunk and happy. They will go to sleep and never wake up.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Leemi ti naa su ti; ka a bidibiga min a nyaaŋa gba ti nyɛ ti nanim su ti, a ni fa ti Midiannim nuu ni bahi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: After the battle with the Midianites, the Israelites said, Gideon, you rescued us! Now we want you to be our king. Then after your death, your son and then your grandson will rule.

dag: Dindali maa, Izraɛlnim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka kɔɣisi yi fini zaa.
en: At that time Jacobs wealth will all be gone. Yes, Israel will be like a sick man who has become weak and thin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ba ka bɛ doli tipawumli soya n-tumdi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni yu shɛm.
en: So I sent them off to follow their willful hearts; they followed their own advice.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ firilatamdigu la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali tuhi teebuli maa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo.
en: He put the lampstand in the Tent, on the south side, opposite the table.

dag: A yurilim maŋli nyɛla din du m-paai zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mali hal ti paai sagbana.
en: Your constant love reaches the heavens; your faithfulness touches the skies.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino.
en: The servant woman saw him there and began to repeat to the bystanders, He is one of them.

dag: M mabihi, n kul bela kum barina ni dabisili kam. N ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ ti ni mali biɛhigu shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛl lala maa.
en: Brothers and sisters, I swear by the pride I have in you in Christ Jesus our Lord, Im facing death every day.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu Yawɛ sani. Di simdi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be tibi paɣir o.
en: All you who are righteous, shout joyfully to the LORD! Its right for those who do right to praise God.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti gbibi ti ni daa pun wum yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa la viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣu ti ku ʒi ti chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.

dag: Ka bɛn ti nya a ni ti kpaai bɛ nina kpa a ka di gari ba ka bɛ bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-daa dam dunia zaa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe zuliya kam zaa la?.
en: Those who see you will stare and wonder, Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa wuh o di sol la zuɣu.
en: For as long as he lived, Joash did what the Lord considered right. He did what Jehoiada the priest taught him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔhi daanya shɛli tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi ni pisinaanu.
en: The amount of copper from the uplifted offering was seventy kikkars and two thousand four hundred shekels in weight.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb la ni daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli na tibisim daa nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni pihita kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The silver from the community census totaled one hundred kikkars and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels in weight, measured by the sanctuary shekel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be o sani, ka o daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa o dirila nasara. O daa zaɣisi Asiria naa jɛmbu.
en: The LORD was with Hezekiah; he succeeded at everything he tried. He rebelled against Assyrias king and wouldnt serve him.

dag: ka niŋ tipawumli n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi din tibisa n-zɔri na ni bɛ ti tuh o.
en: like a soldier with a thick, strong shield who runs at his enemy to strike him in the neck.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa boli Obadia ŋun daa su nayili tuma fukumsi la na. Obadia daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛmdi Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: At that time Obadiah was in charge of Ahab's palace, but he faithfully worshiped the Lord . In fact, when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord 's prophets, Obadiah hid of them in two caves and gave them food and water. Ahab sent for Obadiah.

dag: bɛ yi ti baŋ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛli maa saha shɛli, bɛ laɣiŋgu maa bɛn zaŋmi naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu. Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini na.
en: When they learn about that sin, the community of Israel must offer a young bull as a sin offering for the whole nation. They must bring the bull to the Meeting Tent.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali ka Yisa daa gari tandi n-zaŋ neeg o nina maa.
en: The day that Jesus made the mud and cured him of his blindness was a Sabbath.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa buɣisi bɔh o ba Zakaria ni bɛ baŋ o ni bɔri ni bɛ bol o bia maa yu shɛli.
en: Then they began gesturing to his father to see what he wanted to call him.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa zaŋ niriba maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm ti ti naa. Izraɛl tiŋgban ni, dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii. Ka Juda tiŋgban ni mi nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: Joab gave the list of the people to the king. There were , men in Israel who could use the sword. And there were , men in Judah.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri n-nya chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi, yuri mi tuhi pinaayi. Ka o daa zaŋ shɛb ti niŋ chɛchɛbunsi tinsi ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be o sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Solomon had a force of , chariots and , horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.

dag: Ka n daa su a kom, m-paɣ a ni ʒim maa bahi, ka ʒe a kpam.
en: Then I washed you with water, rinsed off your blood, and poured oil on you.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: After Jesus finished saying all these things, he said to his followers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun ti bi lo noli dindali maa, bɛn yihim o n niriba ni.
en: I will destroy anyone who refuses to go without eating.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: Those who try to gain their own life will lose it; but those who lose their life for my sake will gain it.

dag: Sulemaana ŋaha shɛŋa din pahi m-bɔŋɔ, ka Juda naa Hɛzɛkia kpambaliba daa yaai li sabi sɔŋ.
en: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.

dag: N niŋ ya naani pam, ka nyuri bara pam yi zuɣu, ka lan mali suhudoo. Ti wahala dibu la zaa yoli, m mali suhupiɛlli hal ti yaɣi.
en: I have every confidence in you. Im terribly proud of you. Im filled with encouragement. Im overwhelmed with happiness while in the middle of our problems.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat ni tum shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka teei Nɔadia ŋun nyɛ anab paɣ la mini anab shɛb bɛn zaa pahi m-bɔri ni bɛ kpɛhi ma dabiɛm la gba yɛla.
en: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me.

dag: ni Hushai bia Baana ŋun daa be Asha mini Biilɔt yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana, Hushais son, in Asher and Bealoth.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ɛdomnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri n-kari doli bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim ka nambɔɣu zɔbu kani. Bɛ sujee maa kɔŋla tim, ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili mi kɔŋ tariga zanibu.
en: The Lord says, The people of Edom have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They hunted down their relatives, the Israelites, and showed them no mercy. Their anger had no limits, and they never let it die.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ti tooi biŋkuma sara maligu maa zim viɛlli nukurigu pali mini di kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim din be biŋkuma sara maligu maa ni nti nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu n-yihi di chihili maa, ka di leei din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: Then he shall take a handful of the flour and oil, and the incense on it, and burn it on the altar as a token that all of it has been offered to the Lord . The odor of this offering is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: ka Izraɛl daa yɛli, Di saɣiya! M bia Yisifu na shiri be o nyɛvil ni. N ni chaŋ ti nya o pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
