en: My son Joseph is still alive! he said. This is all I could ask for! I must go and see him before I die.

dag: Dama mani n-yihi bɛ ni zaŋ bimbihili shɛli gahigahi la mini bɛ ni zaŋ nudirigu gbali shɛli mali Izraɛlnim suhudoo sara la Izraɛlnim sani n-zaŋ li ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli ʒiɛman kam ni.
en: I will accept the breast that was lifted up and the gift of the right thigh from the Israelites. Then I will give these things to Aaron and his sons. This is their share from the fellowship offerings of the Israelites forever.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, a daa wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm yih a niriba Ijipti na, ka bɛ na kul teer a yiko tuma maa yɛla. Ti tum alahichi ka tum din bi tuhi.
en: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.

dag: dindina n ni tin ya sakom saa mibu saha, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bindira niŋ pam, ka yi puri ni tihi wali wala.
en: I will send you rain at the right time, so that the land will produce crops and the trees will bear fruit.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: He told them, Go into the next village. As soon as you enter it, you will find a young donkey that has never been ridden. Untie the donkey and bring it here.

dag: Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam dindali maa; dama Sool daa pola pɔri yɛli, Ŋunkam di bindirigu ka wuntaŋ na bi lu n ni bɔhiri n dimnim biɛri dahin shɛli ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Lala zuɣu niriba maa ni so noli daa bi to bindirigu.
en: Now the Israelite soldiers were in a difficult situation that day because Saul had bound the troops by a solemn pledge: Anyone who eats anything before evening when I have taken revenge on my enemies is doomed. So none of the army ate anything.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn kpe Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni bee n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbin la gbini, bɛ paɣirila bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: whenever they went into the Tent or to the altar, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti ŋmanila tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima o niriba bɛn tiligi sani.
en: At that time the Lord All-Powerful will become the Beautiful Crown. He will be the Wonderful Crown of Flowers for his people who are left.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N dana, ka yuri ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka malaika so ŋun daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa garigi yɛli ma, N ni wuh a bɛ yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka do so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa daa garigi yɛli.
en: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, Sir, who are these riders? I'll tell you, the angel answered.

dag: Dabisa kanna, ka bɛ ni ti duhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli ŋɔ ka di du n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboya. Ka niriba ti daai ka di gbinna.
en: In days to come the mountain where the Temple stands will be the highest one of all, towering above all the hills. Many nations will come streaming to it.

dag: Kaman chɛulɔnim ni kul gbibi punu ka di viini gindi shɛm la, lala ka vinnyaɣilan gba be o garo zuɣu.
en: Like a door on its hinges, a lazy man turns back and forth on his bed.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal biɛri din bie pam ka so ku tooi di li la ni be shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Juda naa Zɛdɛkia min o kpambaliba ni Jɛrusalɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni mini bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: As for King Zedekiah of Judah, the politicians around him, and the rest of the people of Jerusalem who have stayed in this land or moved to Egypt—I, the Lord , will treat them all like these figs that are too bad to be eaten.

dag: O daa piila o dabili Dauda, o daa yih o la piɛgulibo ni.
en: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep.

dag: Yawɛ daa booni ya la olivi ti mahali din mali wal viɛla, amaa sanʒiɛ titali puuni o ni niŋ buɣim dab li, ka di di di wula.
en: The Lord gave you a name. He called you, A green olive tree, beautiful to look at. But with a powerful storm, he will set that tree on fire, and its branches will be burned up.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa deei tɔrokɔnim maa mini naɣilahi maa n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim maa.
en: So Moses gave the wagons and the oxen to the Levites.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu yuŋ. Nyini ka n suhu zaa kul bɔra. Dama a yi kari dunia mini niriba bɛn be di ni saria, di chɛmi ka bɛ baŋdi din tuhi.
en: At night I long for you with my whole being; my spirit within me watches for you. When your judgments are at work in the earth, those living in the world learn righteousness.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ li pah o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb ka fa bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa shɛŋa la zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ. O ni daa fa li tin shɛŋa nim sani n-nyɛ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknima.
en: King David dedicated these to the LORD along with the silver and the gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalek.

dag: ni Matania ni Matɛnai ni Jaasu.
en: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri kabirila sida tihi luhira. Yawɛ kabi Lɛbanɔn sida tihi luhi.
en: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars, even the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa pa Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba la daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisinahi bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: All the tribes of Israel, except Benjamin, gathered together , fighting men with swords. Each one was a trained soldier.

dag: Yi tibidarigibo dali, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ, ka zaɣ biɛɣu ni ti yɛn yi katiŋ na ti paai ya dahin shɛli, wula ka yi lee ti yɛn niŋ? Ŋun sani ka yi lee ti yɛn zo n-chaŋ ti bo sɔŋsim bee luɣ dini ka yi lee ti yɛn zaŋ yi daazichi sɔŋ?.
en: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋma Sool zuɣu ka yeeg o gbaɣino, ka tim bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-zaŋ lahiba suŋ maa yɛli bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: They cut off Saul's head, stripped off his armor, and sent messengers with them throughout Philistia to tell the good news to their idols and to their people.

dag: niriba mini nanim yi ti laɣim ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ.
en: when people from every nation meet to worship you.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa lab maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim maa sani, ka bɛ ti bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ʒi o na.
en: When the guards went back, the chief priests and Pharisees asked them, Why did you not bring him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛlila noli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi, amaa o niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ bulah ayi maa ti zali Naawuni tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: He will take the two male goats and place them before the LORD at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: O ni daa kul kpuɣ o nuu maa tiri saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la dii vaai yiɣisi bɛ dooshee ti kpe tiŋ maa ni n-deei li ka niŋ buɣim nyo li yomyom bahi.
en: and as soon as he lifted his hand, the men who had been hiding got up quickly, ran into the city and captured it. They immediately set the city on fire.

dag: Maligumaana yi zaŋ kawana bee chi na ti mali sara, di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim, di bi simdi ni bɛ di li.
en: Every priestly grain offering must be a complete offering; it must not be eaten.

dag: Ka lan yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti nya ka alizanda dunoli yooi, ka Naawuni malaikanim siɣiri Daadam Bia sanna ka labiri dura.
en: I assure you that you will see heaven open and Gods angels going up to heaven and down to earth on the Human One.

dag: Ka yi yi nyɛla Masia ni su shɛba, dindina yi nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi bɛn ni di o fali kaman Naawuni daalikauli la ni wuhi shɛm.
en: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ kɔhigɔriba gba ni ti kum ka fabili paɣ maa zuɣu, so ni bi lan dari bɛ nɛma zuɣu.
en: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhuri ye Naawuni zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ Naawuni bɔbu milinsi maa lee bi doli soli.
en: I can vouch for them: they are enthusiastic about God. However, it isnt informed by knowledge.

dag: Ti Duuma, wuna puuni, wun so kani m-be ka nyini, ka tuun shɛli mi kani ŋ-ŋman a tuma.
en: My Lord, there is no God like you. No one can do what you have done.

dag: Alibarika be wuntizɔr ni, amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli ni.
en: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.

dag: Ka Bɛzalɛl daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali Alikauli Adaka la. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Bezalel made the Holy Box from acacia wood. The Box was / cubits long, / cubits wide, and / cubits high.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goondaa la luhi, ka nyo nayili zaa buɣim, ka saɣim duɣuri mini la viɛl shɛŋa din daa be nayili maa zaa.
en: Next the Babylonians burned Gods temple down, demolished the walls of Jerusalem, and set fire to all its palaces, destroying everything of value.

dag: Ti Naawuni a ku darigi bɛ tibili ti ti? Dama ti ka yiko din ni tooi tuhi salo pam bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi ti ŋɔ. Ti bi mi ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, amaa nyini ka ti kul lihira.
en: Aren't you going to punish them? We won't stand a chance when this army attacks. We don't know what to do—we are begging for your help.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham miri ha ti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a shɛm zaa, ka ti wum ka niŋ li.
en: Go back, Moses, and listen to everything that the Lord our God says. Then return and tell us what he said to you. We will listen and obey.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Du shɛli din dunoli kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ nyɛla maligumaana ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa fukumsi duu.
en: He said, The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple.

dag: Ka Maligumaaniba daa mali me Wɔhu Dunɔdali zuɣusaa polo. Sokam daa mali mɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋ tooni.
en: The priests repaired the section over the Horse Gate. Each priest repaired the wall in front of his own house.

dag: Bɛn ti be katiŋa, alɔbo ni di ba, bɛn be yoma, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, bɛn mi ti kpalim, kum ni ku ba. Lala ka n ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Those far away will get sick and die; those nearby will be killed in war; those who survive will starve to death. They will feel all the force of my anger.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: Those who do not carry their own cross and come after me cannot be my disciples.

dag: Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina.
en: Change your hearts and lives! Here comes the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia, ka di puhi vari ʒiɛya ha, ka o chaŋ di gbini ni o ti nya o ni nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu di; o ni daa paai di gbini o daa bi nya binshɛɣu naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko, dama fiig tihi walibu saha daa na bi paai.
en: He saw a fig tree with leaves. So he went to the tree to see if it had any figs growing on it. But he found no figs on the tree. There were only leaves, because it was not the right time for figs to grow.

dag: O daa yɛli ba ni bɛ suhim Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu n-kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ ba pahi Babilɔn baŋdiba shɛb bɛn kpalim la zuɣu ku.
en: Daniel asked his friends to pray to the God of heaven that God would be kind to them and help them understand this secret. Then Daniel and his friends would not be killed with the other wise men of Babylon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti nyo buɣim mali sara maa daa nyɛla naɣilahi pisopɔin mini piɛlahi kɔbiga ni piɛbihi kɔbisiyi. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛb nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: They brought bulls, sheep, and lambs as burnt offerings for the Lord ;.

dag: Ti yi kul tumd alahichi milinsi puuni, ti ni baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛl la nyaaŋa, sara maligu shɛli lan kani din ni kpihim ti daalahichi.
en: For there is no longer any sacrifice that will take away sins if we purposely go on sinning after the truth has been made known to us.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni niŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa n zuɣu, dama bɛ bi mi ŋun tim ma na.
en: The world will do all these things to you on account of my name, because it doesnt know the one who sent me.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔritiŋmana.
en: You won't have enough bread to eat.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pia.
en: Menahem son of Gadi became king over Israel during the th year that Azariah was king of Judah. Menahem ruled ten years in Samaria.

dag: Ninive yɛla ŋɔ zaa ŋmanila pagɔr tuma din nyɛ kɔre kpɛhibu din ka kalinli; di ŋmanila paɣ timalana ŋun zaŋ kɔre kpɛhibu gbahi zuliya pam, ka zaŋ o tima maa yɔhim niriba pam la.
en: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua maa daa boli maligumaaniba na nti yɛli ba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka la, ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: So Joshua, Nuns son, called the priests. He said to them, Lift up the covenant chest. Let seven priests carry seven trumpets made from rams horns in front of the LORDs chest.

dag: Di saha maa Yisa ma Mariama min o tizo Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Klɔpas paɣa la ni Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa ʒiɛla Yisa dapulli maa gbini.
en: Jesus mother stood near his cross. Her sister was also standing there with Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka niŋdi yɛda binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka mali tahima binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan niŋdi ania binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Love is always supportive, loyal, hopeful, and trusting.

dag: Ka biasani ti yɛl o ba, M ba, tim ma fal shɛli n ni ti yɛn di a kalinsi nyaaŋa pumpɔŋɔ. Ka doo maa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛli m-pirigi ti o bihi maa.
en: The younger one said to him, Father, give me my share of the property now. So the man divided his property between his two sons.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Jɛrubaal mini Barak ni Jafta ni Samsin ka bɛ kana ti fan ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni bahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka chɛ ka yi beni ka barina shɛli lan kani.
en: So the Lord sent Gideon, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel. He saved you from your enemies around you, and you lived in safety.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa kuli Nabal sani nti nya ka o puhirila chuɣu o yiŋa, ka di ŋmanila naa m-puhiri chuɣu. Ka ŋun Nabal daa kul mali suhupiɛlli, dama o daa nyula dam buɣi. Ka o paɣ maa daa bi yɛl o shɛli dindali maa hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Abigail went back home and found Nabal throwing a party fit for a king. He was very drunk and feeling good, so she didn't tell him anything that night.

dag: Ka kuŋ daa ti ŋme yuntisuɣu yɛli, Aŋgo maa paana! Yimiyana ti tuh o soli.
en: Then in the middle of the night someone shouted, Here's the groom! Come to meet him.

dag: Yi zuliya mini yi bihi galisim naan ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka n naan ku chɛ ka bɛ birili kpihim hal baabiɛla gba.
en: Your descendants would be as numerous as grains of sand, and I would have made sure they were never destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu n-chaŋ ti zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa.
en: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord 's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, nayili yila ni ti leei fabila kuhigu. Niriba ni ti kpi n-do luɣ shɛlikam. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba labi ka fo baalim.
en: Their temple songs will become funeral songs. This is what the Lord GOD said. There will be dead bodies everywhere. In silence, people will take out the dead bodies and throw them onto the pile. .

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, ka n nya suhupiɛlli pɔi ka naanyi chaŋ n chandi shee n-leei ŋun ku lan beni yaha.
en: Leave me alone so that I may have some happiness before I go away and am no more.

dag: m-pahi Giliad pirigili ni Ashitarɔt ni Ɛdirɛi din daa nyɛ fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa Bashan Naa Ogi ni daa su la. Musa daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim tila Manaasa bia Makiri ni di nyɛ Makiri maa zuliya pirigili dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The land also included half of Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei. All this land was given to the family of Makir son of Manasseh. Half of all his sons got this land.

dag: Amaa o bela o kɔŋko, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi taɣ o? O ni bɔri shɛli, dina ka o niŋda.
en: He never changes. No one can oppose him or stop him from doing what he wants to do.

dag: Zaŋmiya di zaɣ kuŋ tam sala buɣim zuɣu ka di bii, ka di tahiʒiɛɣu mooi, ka di daɣiri zaa nyɛligi niŋ di puuni, ka din zahimzahim la zaa di buɣim.
en: Then let the pot stand empty on the coals. Let it become so hot that its stains begin to glow. Those stains will be melted away. The rust will be destroyed.

dag: N ni dol a zaligunima; di chɛ ma bahi zaa.
en: I will obey your laws, so please dont leave me!.

dag: Ka bunsi daa nyɛ tuhi pihita ni kɔbisinu. Ka Yawɛ zaka bunsi kalinli daa nyɛ bunsi pihiyɔbu.
en: The donkeys were . of which the LORDs tribute was .

dag: Chɛliya ka zuliya kam mali shili lir o, Miidia nanim mini bɛ gomnanim ni bɛ wulaannima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din be bɛ sulinsi ni zaa.
en: Prepare the nations for war against Babylonia. Send for the kings of Media, their leaders and officials, and the armies of all the countries they control.

dag: Di saha ka Siria naa kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Izraɛlnim Naawuni nyɛla zoya zuɣu Naawuni, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti maa, amaa chɛliya ka ti tuhi ba la bɔpiɛligu ni, biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni nyaŋ ba.
en: King Ben-Hadads officers said to him, The gods of Israel are mountain gods. We fought in a mountain area, so the Israelites won. If we fight them on level ground, we will win.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ayi: yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , ka o mabia yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: Eber named his first son Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided into tribal regions. Eber's second son was Joktan.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa jɛra ʒiɛmdila bɛ manima.
en: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.

dag: Shɛlini bɛ daa turi ya ka muɣisiri ya palɔni, ka shɛlini mi yi daa nyɛla bɛn pahi bɛ ni niŋdi yi tab shɛb lala zuɣu.
en: Sometimes you were exposed to insults and abuse in public. Other times you became partners with those who were treated that way.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ wuntitali kaman shɛlɔrigu la n-lo o shee ni; ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali kaman shɛlɔrigu la n-lo o shee ni pahi.
en: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ni mani m-bɔŋɔ; dinzuɣu yi yi bɔrila mani, yin chɛ ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa chaŋ.
en: Jesus said, I told you that I am Jesus. So if you are looking for me, let these other men go free.

dag: O wuhiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa din tuhi, ka wuhiri ba o soli.
en: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia, Asiria na tital la ni bɔhir a shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni. A mi di saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha!.
en: Lord , don't be angry and rebuke me! Don't punish me in your anger!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o lan pala dabili kɔŋko, amaa o gari dabili; o yipa nyɛla ti mabiyurigu Masia ni. O mali ma buchi pam, amaa nyini ka o lee ni mali buchi pam, o ni nyɛ a dabili la min o ni nyɛ a mabia ti Duuma zuɣu la puuni.
en: And now he is not just a slave, but much more than a slave: he is a dear brother in Christ. How much he means to me! And how much more he will mean to you, both as a slave and as a brother in the Lord!.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ zuliyanim maa zaa zali ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Bɛnjamin zuliya.
en: Samuel brought each tribe, one after the other, to the altar, and the Lord chose the Benjamin tribe.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi yɛlila din bi tuhi, nyin wuhim di ni nyɛ shɛli; ka n yi yɛlila din tuhi, di chaŋ wula ka a ŋme ma.
en: Jesus answered, If I have done something wrong, say so. But if not, why did you hit me.

dag: ka daa tim ni bɛ cham sarika ni nti ŋma Jɔn zuɣu na.
en: to go to the prison and cut off John's head.

dag: Ɛzra ni daa suhiri n-kahigiri bɛ daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka kumdi ka luri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tooni shɛm maa, ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi pam daa laɣim o sani. Bɛ gba daa kumiya pam.
en: Ezra was praying and confessing. He was crying and bowing down in front of Gods Temple. While Ezra was doing that, a large group of the Israelites—men, women, and children—gathered around him. They were crying.

dag: Ka n tarili lee nyɛ dini Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani? Ka n fali lee nyɛ dini Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani?.
en: What is Gods portion for me from above, the Almightys inheritance from on high?.

dag: Naawuni lan yɛli yaha: A nyɛla Duuma ŋun daa nam dunia ŋɔ piligu ni, ka zuɣusaa mi nyɛ a nuhi ni tum tuun shɛli.
en: God also said, O Lord, in the beginning you made the earth, and your hands made the sky.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri niriba yɛligu, o ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali; doli yɛnnim ni yɛn wuh a so shɛli n-tuhi tɔbu.
en: Get good advice and you will succeed; don't go charging into battle without a plan.

dag: O ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam; dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: They were amazed at his teaching. He did not teach like their teachers of the law. He taught like someone with authority.

dag: Bɛ daa wum n ni ŋuhiri shɛm, ka so kani ŋun ni maai n suhu. N dimnim zaa daa wum m muɣisigu maa yɛla. A ni niŋ shɛm maa mali ba la suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli dabisi shɛli yɛla la paana, ka chɛ ka bɛ gba be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: People heard that I was groaning, that I had no comforter. All my enemies heard about my distress; they were thrilled that you had done this. Bring the day you have announced so they become like me!.

dag: O daa kul niŋd o la lala yuuni kam. Bɛn dee daa yi kul chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, o ni bahi miligi Hanna suhu ka o kum hal ti bi di bindirigu.
en: So that is what took place year after year. Whenever Hannah went to the Lords house, Peninnah would make fun of her. Then she would cry and wouldnt eat anything.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n kamina ni n ti yɛli nyini n dan naa dimbɔŋɔ, dama niriba maa chɛmi ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam ka n tɛhi ni n yi yɛli nyin naa, di pa shɛli a ni niŋ man ŋun nyɛ o dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni bɔr shɛm maa.
en: My lord and king, I came to say these words to you, because the people made me afraid. I said to myself, I will talk to the king. Maybe the king will help me.

dag: Di mi pala din be teeku duli ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du teeku duli ti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: Nor is it across the ocean somewhere so that you have to ask, Who will cross the ocean for us and get it for us that we can hear it and do it.

dag: Ka hal n yi nyu bara gba, m bi tum jɛrilim, dama n ni tɔɣisila yɛlimaŋli di puuni. Amaa n zaɣisila lala niŋbu ni di chɛ ka so ku duhi ma n-gar o ni nya ma ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu bee o ni wum ka n niŋ shɛm zuɣu.
en: If I did want to brag, I wouldnt make a fool of myself because Id tell the truth. Im holding back from bragging so that no one will give me any more credit than what anyone sees or hears about me.

dag: Yi kpe taali ni yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la zuɣu, ka ta yimaŋ daɣiri yi ni maani buɣa la zuɣu. Yi chɛ ka yi dabisili mirina. N ni daa zali ya yuun shɛl la paaya. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi di vi zuliya kam sani, ka tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim mali ya ansarisi.
en: Those crimes have made you guilty, and the idols have made you unacceptable to me. So your final punishment is near. Other nations will laugh at you and make insulting remarks.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi tɛha be kaman tɛhi shɛli din be Masia ni la:.
en: The attitude you should have is the one that Christ Jesus had:.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi mir o ni o damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura, o teerila o nuu gbaai dilana m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Whenever anyone came near to Absalom, bowing low out of respect, he would reach his hand out, grab them, and kiss them.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: Praise the Lord , you who are loyal to him! Praise his holy name !.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋub ba yi tinsi ni, bɛn be nyam mini bɛn bi be nyam zaa yi ni tooi ŋub ba kaman yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm la.
en: You may eat such animals at home. All of you, whether ritually clean or unclean, may eat them, just as you eat deer or antelope.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin biɛɣu maa bahi.
en: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, Why couldn't we force out the demon.

dag: Ka o kpee maa gba damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, Na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: His fellow servant fell down and begged him, Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni daa nya ka ti ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka ti daa saɣi ni ti kɔŋko kpalim be Atɛnsi.
en: Finally, we could not bear it any longer. So we decided to stay on alone in Athens.

dag: Ka alikama maa daa ti va puya m-pil dɔɣibu, di saha ka bɛ naanyi baŋ ni piriŋkpana be di ni.
en: When the stalks sprouted and bore grain, then the weeds also appeared.

dag: Ka tɔb daa ti lan lu Izraɛlnim maa mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɔb yaha, ka Jaariɔrigim ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la bia Ɛlhanan gba daa lan ku Goliat ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nira ka o kpani dɔɣu daa be kaman kpalua dapua la.
en: Later, there was another battle at Gob against the Philistines. Elhanan the son of Jaare Oregim from Bethlehem killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath from Gath. His spear was as big as a post.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi. .
en: Therefore, Ill have him whipped, then let him go.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisili kanna, ka bɛ ti ku lan boli kpe Tɔfɛt bee Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli, amaa bɛ ni ti booni li la Niriba Kubu Vinvamli.
en: So now the time is coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call this place Topheth or Ben-hinnom Valley but Carnage Valley.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Yihimila Barabas bahi, ka ku doo ŋɔ.
en: The whole crowd cried out, Kill him! Set Barabbas free for us! .

dag: Obɛdɛdom daa mali bidibisi: Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ o bituuli n-zaŋ Jɛhɔzabad pa, ka Jɔa pah ata, ka Sakar pah anahi, ka Nɛtanɛl pah anu.
en: There was also Obed Edom, whom God blessed by giving him eight sons, listed in order of age: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel.

dag: Ka yi yi ku tooi niŋ bin din pɔri ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi jiɣindi binshɛŋa din kpalim zuɣu?.
en: If you cant do such a small thing, why worry about the rest?.

dag: N Duuma, sɔŋm ma ka n yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will proclaim your praise.

dag: ti yɛl o, Amiliya lɔbu ni sokam daŋdila wain viɛlli tibu pɔi, ka niriba yi ti nyu n-tiɣi, di saha ka bɛ naanyi zaŋdi wain piti na, amaa nyin zaŋla wain nyaɣisili sɔɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: and said to him, Everyone else serves the best wine first, and after the guests have drunk a lot, he serves the ordinary wine. But you have kept the best wine until now.

dag: Di bo yomyom yaag a noli bee n-jiɣ a suhu ni n-yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli Naawuni tooni, dama Naawuni bela alizanda ni, ka a mi be dunia ŋɔ ni; dinzuɣu chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa pɔra.
en: Dont be quick with your mouth or say anything hastily before God, because God is in heaven, but you are on earth. Therefore, let your words be few.

dag: Fam ma baɣiri firibu ni bahi. Tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. Tiligim ma kɔbulli ŋɔ ni.
en: Save me from sinking in the mud; keep me safe from my enemies, safe from the deep water.

dag: Dunɔguliba: Akub mini Talimɔn ni bɛ taba bɛn daa guli dunoya la zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba, Yi yi ti zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa yi ni baŋ ni mani m-bala, ka lan baŋ ni m bi niŋdi shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ni wuhi ma shɛm, dina ka m mali tɔɣisira.
en: So he said to them, You will lift up the Son of Man. Then you will know that I AM. You will know that whatever I do is not by my own authority. You will know that I say only what the Father has taught me.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli Pita, Malim shili ka zaŋ a namda piri. Ka o niŋ lala. Ka o lan yɛl o, Zaŋm a binyɛrigu ye n-doli ma.
en: and the angel said, Get dressed and put on your sandals. Peter did what he was told. Then the angel said, Now put on your coat and follow me.

dag: Ŋuna ka anabinim zaa di shɛhira ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ o yuli zuɣu la.
en: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, ka ti deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma maa;.
en: We can, they answered. Jesus said, You will drink the cup I drink and receive the baptism I receive.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka zaŋ jɛlinsi yo ma yurilim samli.
en: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ niriba maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ suhuri yula yɔɣu kpɛbu, ka bɛ ku tooi gbaai bɛmaŋa, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ bi deei ba. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: The Lord says about these people, They love to run away from me, and they will not control themselves. So I am not pleased with them. I will remember the wrongs they have done and punish them because of their sins.

dag: ni Ahio ni Shashak ni Jɛrɛmɔt.
en: Beriah's descendants included Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth.

dag: O daa zaŋ o zali tiŋgbani luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu; ka daa zaŋ puri ni bindira dihir o. O daa zaŋ tampima voya ni shiri mini chɛribo kuɣa voya ni kpam dih o.
en: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.

dag: Bɛ mini Pool zaa tuma daa nyɛla tanti wuɣibu tuma, dinzuɣu ka Pool daa chaŋ ti be bɛ sani ni o mini ba laɣim wolindi dira.
en: Because they practiced the same trade, he stayed and worked with them. They all worked with leather.

dag: Ka nahiŋgu mini wahala ni suhugarigu daa ti chɛ ka bɛ filim.
en: When God's people were defeated and humiliated by cruel oppression and suffering.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: The disciples left, went to the city, and found everything just as Jesus had told them; and they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Shi yino maa n-lan tiri so yɛda niŋbu pini, ka tiri so dɔriti tibbu pina;.
en: faith to still another by the same Spirit, gifts of healing to another in the one Spirit.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Saimɔn, o daa warila bukpahigu ka wuhir omaŋa ni o nyɛla wɔɣirili, ka o yɛla daa mali Samarianim alahiziba pam.
en: A man named Simon lived there, who for some time had astounded the Samaritans with his magic. He claimed that he was someone great.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kaman biɛɣu pia dali, ka Yawɛ daa ku Nabal.
en: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal, and he died.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin shɛli dihi niriba tusaanahi la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛr ayopɔin.
en: And when I divided seven loaves of bread for people, how many baskets did you fill with the leftover pieces? They answered, We filled seven baskets.

dag: Ka Maika bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔhi ma ni bɔ n-chɛ ka n zaŋ niriba ŋɔ pa mmaŋ zuɣu na? Yi kpuɣila n wuna, ka zaŋ m maligumaana pahi, ka bɔ ka yi lee chɛ n-ti mani.
en: Micah replied, Youve taken my gods that I made, and the priest, and have gone off! What do I have left? How can you ask me what is wrong.

dag: A ni sabi jaaŋgbe shɛŋa zuɣu maa yi ti be a nuu ni ka bɛ nya li.
en: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhi ni m mali taali; ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan tumdi tuma yoli?.
en: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa kul dolila o ba Asa soli ka bi birigi li. O daa kul tumdila din tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Jehoshaphat walked in the way of his father Asa and didnt turn aside from it, doing what was right in the LORDs eyes.

dag: N daa loya n yɛm puuni ni n nyu dam n-nya suhupiɛlli, ka tum jɛrilim; ka yɛm daa kul be n tɛha ni. N daa tɛhiya ni di ni simdi ni nir zaŋ o dunia ŋɔ yili saha biɛla ŋɔ tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Musa mini Aduna ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛl kpamba pinaayi bɛn ʒe bɛ daŋ niriba zaashee sɔŋ ba ka bɛ kali ba la.
en: Moses, Aaron, and the twelve leaders of Israel counted these men.

dag: O ni daa kul nya ba, ka o kɔre kpe bɛ ni, ka o tim tuumba bɛ sani Kalidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and Oholibah wanted them.

dag: Amaa saha shɛlikam yi yi ti bɔra, yi ni tooi kɔri yi biŋkɔbiri ŋubi yi tin shɛŋa ni yi ni be kaman Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni shɛm; bɛn be kasi mini bɛn bi be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub li kaman yi ni ŋubiri kparibuhi bee wolisi shɛm la.
en: But you are free to kill and eat your animals wherever you live. You may eat as many as the Lord gives you. All of you, whether ritually clean or unclean, may eat them, just as you would eat the meat of deer or antelope.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani baɣisiri Galili Teeku n-daa ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ti ʒini.
en: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.

dag: O tihi nyɔŋ maa ni tihi din kpalim ni nyɛla biɛla, hal ka bia ni tooi kal li.
en: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi yinim shɛb Yisa Masia ni la zaŋla Masia biɛhigu kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: You were baptized into union with Christ, and now you are clothed, so to speak, with the life of Christ himself.

dag: Yi ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka di niŋ ya suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti ʒi teeku ni azichi na ti tin ya, ka ʒi zuliya shɛb gba daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: Then you will see and be radiant; your heart will tremble and open wide, because the seas abundance will be turned over to you; the nations wealth will come to you.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa, ka kpahi Pita zuɣu ni yɛli, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! Dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: But Jesus turned around, looked at his disciples, and rebuked Peter. Get away from me, Satan, he said. Your thoughts don't come from God but from human nature.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ma, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You make my enemies run from me; I destroy those who hate me.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa kul o yiŋa ni sujee nti fo n-ʒiya, Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zuɣu. Dama o daa yɛl o mi, N ku zaŋ n yaannim fali bini ti a. Ka Naa Ɛhab dɔni o bindoo zuɣu ŋ-ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: Ahab went home, depressed and angry over what Naboth had said to him. He lay down on his bed, facing the wall, and would not eat.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti sa zahimla zahima ka bi nya ŋun ni wuhi ti di gbinni. Ka Yisifu bɔhi ba, Pa Naawuni n-wuhiri zahindi gbinni? N suhiri ya, yɛlimiya ma yi zahima maa.
en: We each had a dream last night, they answered, and there is no one to tell us what they mean. Joseph replied, Doesn't God know the meaning of dreams? Now tell me what you dreamed.

dag: Bolimi pumpɔŋɔ, so beni ŋun ni garig a? Ka malaika ŋuni sani ka a lee yɛn ŋmaligi chaŋ?.
en: Call out. Will anyone answer you? To which holy one will you turn?.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.

dag: Di saha maa ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti bɔhi Pool, Yɛlim ma, a shiri nyɛla Rom tiŋbia? Ka Pool saɣi, Iin.
en: The commander went to Paul and demanded, Tell me! Are you a Roman citizen? He said, Yes.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna ku wum a yɛligu maa, ka di chɛ ka n daalahiziba tuma maa galisi pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, The reason Pharaoh did not listen to you is so that I could show my great power in Egypt.

dag: ni Mikilɔt . Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ niriba daa ʒini baɣilila bɛ dɔɣim maa Jɛrusalɛm fɔŋ ni.
en: Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. These also lived near their relatives in Jerusalem.

dag: A chɛ a suhuyiɣisili la zaa, ka chɛ a sujee din kpɛm pam la.
en: You stopped being angry with them and held back your furious rage.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yɛhudianim shɛb lo nia ni bɛ ku Pool, ka daa laɣim po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu.
en: The next morning more than Jewish men got together and vowed that they would not eat or drink anything until they had killed Paul.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ a hal ni n nyɛvili tariga. N ni kpuɣi n nuhi zuɣusaa m-paɣ a yuli.
en: By my life, I will praise you. In your name, I lift my hands in prayer.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa puuni binshɛŋa din daa kpalim ka tɔbbihi maa zaŋ li kalinli daa nyɛla piɛri tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni tuhi pisopɔinnaanu.
en: and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included , sheep and goats, , cattle, , donkeys, and , young women who had never had sex.

dag: Ka bimbini maa gba daa shiri wurim, ka tampiligim maa kpaai bahi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun wuhi ni Yawɛ yɛliya ni o ni chɛ ka di niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The altar split in half, and the ashes fell to the ground, just as the prophet had warned.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋmamiya di tihi luhi. Kahimiya kuɣa duhi gili Jɛrusalɛm. Tiŋ shɛli din simdi tibidarigibo m-bala. Shɛli ka di puuni naɣila alaka niŋbu.
en: The Lord Almighty has ordered these kings to cut down trees and build mounds in order to besiege Jerusalem. He has said, I will punish this city because it is full of oppression.

dag: ni naɣilima ni vinvama din zaŋ hal ni Ar zaŋ lab Mɔabnim tintariga polo la.
en: and the hills by the valleys that lead to the town of Ar. These places are at the border of Moab.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani salo maa sunsuuni m-bɔhi Yisa, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ.
en: Then the high priest stood up in the middle of the gathering and examined Jesus. Arent you going to respond to the testimony these people have brought against you.

dag: chaŋ Hiburɔn ti zaŋ li ti Naa Dauda ka yɛl o, Naa, a dim Sool ŋun daa kul dol a ni o ku a la bia Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ m-bɔhi Sool min o bihi biɛri n-ti n dan naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ maa.
en: They brought Ishbosheths head to David at Hebron. Here is the head of Ishbosheth, they told the king, the son of Saul your enemy, who wanted you dead. Today the LORD has avenged our master the king on Saul and his descendants.

dag: Ka o daa sabi yɛtɔɣ yinsi shɛŋa o ni daa tuui sab la pa kuɣ parilana maa zuɣu. Yɛtɔɣa maa n-nyɛ fukumsi zalikpana pia shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛli ya buɣim sunsuuni yi laɣiŋgu dal la, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ li ti ma.
en: God wrote on the new tablets what had been written on the first set: the Ten Commandments that the LORD spoke to you on the mountain, from the very fire itself, on the day we assembled there. Then the LORD gave them to me.

dag: A bemi kaman tampiŋ la ka n sɔɣir a sani. Nyini n-nyɛ m birini din mali kpiɔŋ ni a tiligi ma; dama nyini n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini.
en: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa kpi, bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi shɛba bɛ kpiɔŋ saha.
en: Then the Lord killed every firstborn in their country. He killed their oldest sons.

dag: Ŋun daa pahi pia n-su chir pia ni n-daa nyɛ Maharai ŋun daa yi Nɛtɔfa na ka nyɛ Zɛra daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite from the Zerahites. His division numbered .

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbaai nachimbil maa nuu ni n-zaŋ o yi kpaŋa nti bɔh o ashilɔni, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka a mali ni a yɛli ma.
en: The commander took him by the hand and withdrew to a place where they could speak privately. He asked, What do you have to report to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi baŋ din yɛn niŋ ma kpe ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli, n ni lo nia tim o yi sanna.
en: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.

dag: O mi bi be kaman daadam ŋun bɔri shɛl o daadamkpee nuu ni la, dama ŋun Naawuni n-tiri daadam nyɛvili m-pahi vuhim ni shɛlikam.
en: Nor does he need anything that we can supply by working for him, since it is he himself who gives life and breath and everything else to everyone.

dag: O ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o di miri kpima.
en: Your hair is the sign of your dedication to God, and so you must not defile yourself by going near a corpse, not even that of your father, mother, brother, or sister.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo nti kpe fɔŋ ni n-yɛli niriba dinkam daa niŋ maa mini din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu maa yɛla zaa.
en: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim yɛn chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa su, ka yi bɔri ni yi gbarigi ba?.
en: How dare you try to discourage the people of Israel from crossing the Jordan into the land which the Lord has given them?.

dag: Di daa kul malila takɔriti di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni kaman dimbalanim takɔriti ni daa be shɛm la. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: The gateway and its porch had windows all around like the other gates. The gateway was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni la pirigibu bɛn pahi buyi daa zaŋ kpa gooni maa zuɣu nuzaa polo, ka m mi zaŋ bɛ pirigili n-doli bɛ nyaaŋa gooni maa zuɣu Kpimkpimbihi Pia zuɣusaa polo m-mali hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, so ka dunia ŋɔ ni n-nyɛ wuntizɔra ŋun kul tumdi tuun suma, ka na ʒi n-tum alahichi.
en: Remember: theres no one on earth so righteous as to do good only and never make a mistake.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri pini nyarimi pahira, ka ŋun tiri kom gba nyari kom.
en: Give freely, and you will profit. Help others, and you will gain more for yourself.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, ŋuni n-lee yɛn zɔn ya nambɔɣu? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni fabili yi zuɣu? Ŋuni n-lee ni zani ni o bɔhi yi daalaafee yɛla?.
en: The Lord says, Who will pity you, people of Jerusalem, and who will grieve over you? Who will stop long enough to ask how you are?.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a kahigi wuhi ma a ni niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli shɛm, ka bi ku ma saha shɛli Yawɛ ni di zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: You've told me how you were kind enough not to kill me when the Lord gave you the chance.

dag: Naomi ni daa nya ka Rut shiri bɔri ni o dol o kuli ni o suhu zaa maa zuɣu, ka o daa shini ka bi lan yɛli shɛli.
en: Naomi saw that Ruth wanted very much to go with her. So Naomi stopped arguing with her.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o sara maligu shee din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: in the courtyards of the LORDs house, which is in the center of Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!.

dag: Naawuni ni daa saɣindi vinvamli ni tinsi maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa teei Ibrahimma yɛla, ka yihi Lɔt o ni daa saɣindi tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Lɔt ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛl la n-tilig o.
en: But when God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot was living, he kept Abraham in mind and allowed Lot to escape to safety.

dag: Obadia bia Ishimaya n-daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni kpɛma, ka Kɛrimɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Aziriɛl bia la daa nyɛ Naftali zuliya kpɛma.
en: Ishmaiah son of Obadiah, leader of the tribe of Zebulun; Jeremoth son of Azriel, leader of the tribe of Naphtali;.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri, di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; dama momaha niŋ mɔɣu ni; ka tihi wali, ka fiig tihi mini wain tihi wali pam.
en: Dont be afraid, animals of the field, for the meadows of the wilderness will turn green; the tree will bear its fruit; the fig tree and grapevine will give their full yield.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kum ka fabili pam, ka lo noli Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni Yawɛ niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu dindali hal ni zaawuni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba maa zuɣu.
en: They grieved and mourned and fasted until evening for Saul and Jonathan and for Israel, the people of the Lord , because so many had been killed in battle.

dag: Yi ni ti be suɣa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin. Izraɛl tiŋbihi zaa ni ti bela suɣa ni.
en: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla piɛ polli ni o mali sara maa, dindina ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If you offer a sheep.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ Naawuni ni daa lo o niriba alikauli ni bɛ ti yɛn nya shɛl la shihirili, hal ka tinim bɛn nyɛ omaŋmaŋ niriba nya yolisim maŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: The Spirit is the guarantee that we shall receive what God has promised his people, and this assures us that God will give complete freedom to those who are his. Let us praise his glory!.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi teeku ni, ka di niŋ kaman kpim ʒim la, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku maa ni kpi.
en: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. Then the sea became blood like a dead mans blood. And everything living in the sea died.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ Sool sani nti nya ka dabiɛm gbaai Sool pam ka o yɛl o, Nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛli maa, m mi zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima, ka niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The woman went over to him and saw that he was terrified, so she said to him, Please, sir, I risked my life by doing what you asked.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Kamiya Bɛtɛl na nti tum tuumbiɛri; ka chaŋya Giligal nti tum tuumbiɛri. Zaŋmiya yi asiba kam sara maligu na, ka zaŋ yi bini pii puuni zaɣ yini na daba ata dali kam.
en: Go to Bethel and sin. Go to Gilgal and sin even more. Offer your sacrifices in the morning. Bring a tenth of your crops for the three-day festival.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ka o zaŋ omaŋ leei kaman o yidan la o niriba sunsuuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim omaŋa.
en: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.

dag: Ka Pita daa dol o yi ka bi baŋ ni malaika maa ni niŋ o shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa tɛhi ni o zahimla zahindi.
en: Peter followed him out of the prison, not knowing, however, if what the angel was doing was real; he thought he was seeing a vision.

dag: Ka tiŋgula ŋun daa tam Jɛziriil pii zuɣu daa ti lihi nya Jɛhu min o niriba ni kanna ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ kanna. Ka Jɔram yɛl o, Timmi wɔribara ka o chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli m-bɔhi ba, Alaafee? .
en: A guard was standing on the tower in Jezreel. He saw Jehus large group coming. He said, I see a large group of people! Joram said, Send someone on a horse to meet them. Tell this messenger to ask if they come in peace.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti faai siɣi o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: he died and was buried in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, amaa bimbihili maa din ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la dini.
en: The priest will completely burn the fat on the altar, but the breast will go to Aaron and his sons.

dag: Ka Jɔab min o niriba zaa daa kana ti teei gili Ɛbɛl Bɛtimaaka n-kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gili tiŋ maa ka di du nti saɣisi di gooni zuɣusaa, ka gbiri di gbinni ni bɛ daai li luhi.
en: Joab and his troops came and surrounded Abel, so that no one could go in or come out. They made a dirt ramp up to the town wall and then started to use a battering ram to knock the wall down.

dag: dama bɛ daa kul zaŋ li tila bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu malibu tuma maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tum di malibu maa tuma kɔŋko.
en: It was all used to pay the workers and to buy the materials used in the repairs.

dag: dama n nini nya a tiliginsim shɛli.
en: With my own eyes I have seen what you have done to save your people.

dag: Yi na ʒi n-wum di yɛla bee m-mi li. Piligu ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ tipawumlinima. Dama m mi ni yi ni tum yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, ka lan mi ni yi bilim ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ duŋtaariba.
en: I knew that you couldn't be trusted, that you have always been known as a rebel. That is why you never heard of this at all, why no word of it ever came to your ears.

dag: bɛ kpiŋkpama maa daa shihirila taba. Bɛ daa yi ti chana, bɛ zaɣ yino kam kul tuhimi chani tooni ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wurim niriba ŋɔ mini tiŋ ŋɔ kaman nir ni wurindi yaɣimɛr duɣu shɛm la, ka so ku lan tooi mal li me yaha. Bɛ ni ti sɔɣi ba Tɔfɛt hal ka palo ti lan kani ka bɛ ni sɔɣi ba.
en: and you should say to them: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: Just as one smashes the potters piece beyond repair, so I will smash this people and this city. And they will bury the dead in Topheth until theres no room left.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zahim ti biɛhigu nya, ka ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani.
en: We must search and examine our ways; we must return to the LORD.

dag: Bɛ chɛ soli din tuhi ka birigi; bɛ dolila Bɛɔr bia Anabi Balaam ŋun daa tum din bi tuhi liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la naba.
en: Leaving the straight path, they have gone off course, following the way of Balaam son of Bosor, who loved the payment of doing wrong.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bɔh o, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yɛliya ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: The followers asked Jesus, Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come before the Messiah comes.

dag: Nyama, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli vinvamli ni la.
en: But the Glory of the God of Israel was there. The Glory looked just like the vision I saw in the valley by the Kebar Canal .

dag: N ni tumdi Naawuni so tuma ni n suhu zaa o Bia lahibal suŋ tuma ni la di ma shɛhira ni n suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam.
en: God is my witness that what I say is true—the God whom I serve with all my heart by preaching the Good News about his Son. God knows that I remember you.

dag: Amaa ka Diɔnisius ŋun daa nyɛ Ariɔpagus jintɔriba ni yino la mini paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Damaris m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛba daa niŋ yɛda, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool.
en: Some men joined him and believed, among whom was Dionysius, a member of the council; there was also a woman named Damaris, and some other people.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yisa gba daa kpi tin tariga ni o zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ʒim mali niriba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: So Jesus also suffered outside the city. He died to make his people holy with his own blood.

dag: Lala ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la gba daa niŋ yi taali ni Naawuni sani, o ni daa deei tuumba la n-chɛ ka bɛ taɣi doli so shɛli n-zo n-tiligi la puuni.
en: It was the same with the prostitute Rahab. She was put right with God through her actions, by welcoming the Israelite spies and helping them to escape by a different road.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ kum shɛli ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn kpi la polo yɛla niŋ pali.
en: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum ka o tahi pam yɛli, Yinim bɛn yɛn darigi tiŋ ŋɔ tibili, vumiya mirina. Sokam zaŋm o bidibbini gbib o nuu ni.
en: Then in my hearing he called out loudly: Draw near, you guardians of the city, and bring your weapons of destruction!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ yino alahichi tumbu zuɣu yi chɛ ka Naawuni nya sokam taali, lala mi n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino wuntia tuma zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka sokam yi taali ni ka nya nyɛvili.
en: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.

dag: Amaa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛb bahi ni bɛ maani wain tihi, ka kɔra.
en: But he left in Judah some of the poorest people, who owned no property, and he put them to work in the vineyards and fields.

dag: Chɛ ka a binyɛra kul piɛli sahakam, ka niŋmi kpam ʒiɛm a zuɣu.
en: Let your garments always be white; dont run short of oil for your head.

dag: Dama m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni kum bee nyɛvili bee malaikanim bee alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bee binyara din be pumpɔŋɔ bee binyara din ti yɛn kana bee yikombiɛri.
en: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ni bɛ su li m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:.

dag: N ni ti ŋme n-wurim o buɣa la zaa, ka nyo bɛ ni zaŋ laɣ shɛŋa zaa yo o samli buɣim, dama buɣa jɛmbu shee pagɔrisigu tuma puuni ka o daa nya li, ka o dimnim ni ti kana ti ŋme n-di di zaa chaŋ ti lan zaŋ li tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma.
en: All her images will be beaten to pieces; all her wages will be burned; I will make all her idols worthless. Since she gathered them from the wages of a prostitute, they will again become wages of a prostitute.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban yɛl o, Chɛ ka n yɛl a, n vihiya nya ka di nyɛla a zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni;.
en: But Laban told him, If you really are my friend, stay on, and I'll pay whatever you ask. I'm sure the Lord has blessed me because of you.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be vinvamli ni ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim ŋmaligimi guui, ka Sool min o bidibisi kpi, ka bɛ daa yi bɛ tinsi ni zo. Ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ti be di ni.
en: The Israelites who lived in Jezreel Valley learned that their army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead. They ran away too, and the Philistines moved into the towns the Israelites left behind.

dag: Nimaani ka Masia be ka su binshɛɣukam zaa zaŋ tabili alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yikolaannim ni bɛn nyɛ duumanima, ka o yuli tibisi gari yuli kam ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni mini ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna ni.
en: far above every ruler and authority and power and angelic power, any power that might be named not only now but in the future.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni bi tum di tuun shɛli mini fɔntin shɛŋa yi ni bi me n-tin ya, ka yi be di ni diri ti shɛŋa yi ni bi sa mini olivi ti shɛŋa yi ni bi sa wala. .
en: You didn't have to work for this land—I gave it to you. Now you live in towns you didn't build, and you eat grapes and olives from vineyards and trees you didn't plant.

dag: Ka so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee dolibu mi to, ka di dunoli nyɛ duno muɣiliŋga, ka niriba bɛn mi dol li bi yaɣ lala.
en: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it.

dag: ka zaŋ manna shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ʒi n-dihi ya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni o chɛ ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zahim ya, ka niŋ ya din viɛla di bahigu ni.
en: In the desert he fed you manna—something your ancestors had never seen. He tested you to make you humble so that everything would go well for you in the end.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili dahin shɛli ka tum tuun shɛŋa m-mali hal ti me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa naai zaa shɛm m-bala.
en: All Solomons work was carried out from the day the foundation of the LORDs temple was laid until its completion. Then the LORDs temple was completely finished.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi maligumaani zuɣulaantali tuma Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din be tanti jɛmbu du maŋli la ni, ka di nyɛ ti Duuma ni zali shɛli, ka pa ni ninsal ni zali shɛl la.
en: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.

dag: Dinzuɣu o tumtumdiba yi lɛbigi bɛmaŋa m-be kaman wuntizɔriba n-nyɛ ba la, di bi simdi ni di gari ti. Bɛ bahigu ni ti bemi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So it is no great thing if his servants disguise themselves to look like servants of righteousness. In the end they will get exactly what their actions deserve.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan kahig o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa wuhi, ka yo o ni tum taal shɛli maa samli zaa, ka lan yo di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi n-zaŋ li ti o ni tum so taali maa.
en: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of percent.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa yɛli niriba maa, Yi tum alahichi titali. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n ni chaŋ Yawɛ sani nti suh o, di pa shɛli o ni chɛ yi daalahichi maa.
en: The next morning Moses told the people, You have committed a terrible sin! But now I will go up to the Lord , and maybe I can do something so that he will forgive you for your sin.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Kush nir maa daa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka din niŋ nachimbil maa niŋ nyini n dan naa dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu ni bɛ niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: The king asked the Ethiopian, Is young Absalom all right? The Ethiopian answered, May your enemies, or whoever tries to hurt you, suffer the same as this young man did.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Miriam yihi kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, ka niriba maa daa bi yiɣisi chaŋ hal ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ Miriam labina.
en: So they took Miriam outside the camp for seven days. And the people did not move from that place until she was brought in again.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Deem piɛsah ayopɔin ŋɔ n nuu ni, ka di wuhi ni a di ma shɛhira ni mani n-daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ.
en: Abraham answered, Accept these seven lambs. By doing this, you admit that I am the one who dug this well.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ binnɛma balibu kam zaɣ lɔɣu ni zaɣ nyaŋ niŋ a sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: From all living things—from all creatures—you are to bring a pair, male and female, into the ark with you to keep them alive.

dag: Kum ku gbuɣinli ŋun mali yaa, ka gbuɣinnyaŋ bihi wurim.
en: Like lions with nothing to kill and eat, they die, and all their children are scattered.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yaakubu leei bundana ka mali biŋkɔbiri pam, ka mali daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: Jacob soon became rich and successful. He owned many sheep, goats, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of slaves.

dag: A yi shin a noli saha shɛli ti ni be ŋɔ ni, sɔŋsim ni yi luɣ shɛl polo na nti tiligi Yɛhudianima, amaa ka nyin lee kpi ka a ba zuliya kpihim. Bee ŋuni n-ni tooi baŋ ni pa lala zuɣu ka a ʒe a ni ʒe zaashe tital shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: If you don't speak up now, we will somehow get help, but you and your family will be killed. It could be that you were made queen for a time like this.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ni leeg o daba din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ man Naawuni jɛmbu mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nanim jɛmbu ni pa yim shɛm.
en: Nevertheless, they will be subject to him so that they learn the difference between serving me and serving other nations.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa yiɣisi Giligal lu soli n-gbaai chandi yuŋ hal ti kab ti liri ba libigi ba.
en: All night Joshua and his army marched from Gilgal to Gibeon, and they made a surprise attack on the Amorites.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li; amaa ka Yisa do di ni gbihira.
en: After the boat left the shore, a very bad storm began on the lake. The waves covered the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.

dag: Di daa zɔri dolila tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu sunsuuni, ka bɛ ni booni ti shɛli nyɛvili tia la sa n-doli mɔɣili maa yaɣa ayi zaa, ka wala balibu pinaayi be di zuɣu, ka di wandi goli kam, ka di vari mi nyɛ din tibiri zuliya kam.
en: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.

dag: a ni daa zaŋ ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinima ka bɛ zaŋ ti ti ka yɛra, Yi ni kuni tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba ni zaŋ bɛ din chihiri tumbu saɣim tiŋgbɔn shɛli. Bɛ chɛ ka tuumbiɛri maa yɛligi gili di luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: that you gave us through your servants, the prophets. They told us that the land we were going to occupy was an impure land because the people who lived in it filled it from one end to the other with disgusting, filthy actions.

dag: Amaa galimi ni ka m biɛhigu ni zuɣu, a sɔŋ ma, ka zaŋ ma zal a tooni sahakam.
en: You support me in my integrity; you put me in your presence forever.

dag: Ŋun baɣa ka Yawɛ tuma ni, noli ni di o, ka ŋun bi bɔri ni o zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba, noli ni di o.
en: Bad things will happen to those who dont obey the Lord and dont use their swords to kill those people.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai Saimɔn Pita sani, ka Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, a yɛn paɣila n naba.
en: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, Lord, are you going to wash my feet.

dag: Ka di ni yiri so tooni na maa yi shihi yaɣiri laa kam, bɛn ŋmam li, ka di yi nyɛ dari bini, bɛn paɣimi li kom.
en: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.

dag: Ka niriba ni daa lihi bɛ ni shɛb zuɣulaannim la bi pahiri ma shɛli, man dee baɣa ka bɛ ni daa nyɛ shɛb ni, dama Naawuni bi gaŋdi so; ka n na kul yɛrimi ni niriba ni lihi shɛb zuɣulaannim maa bi pahiri ma shɛli.
en: Those men who were considered to be important did not change the Good News message I tell people.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi nyaŋ yi dimnim bɛn yiɣisi ni bɛ tuhi ya. Bɛ ni ti doli so yini kana ni be ti tuhi ya, ka ni ti ŋmaligi guui doli soya ayopɔin zo ka chɛn ya.
en: The LORD will defeat any enemies who attack you. They will come against you from one direction but will run for their lives away from you in seven different directions.

dag: Bɛ bela bɛ olivi tihi folinsi ni n-kahindi kpam, ka kahindi wain, amaa ka kɔnyuri kuri ba.
en: They press out olive oil and walk on grapes in the winepress, but they have nothing to drink.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Izraɛl toondaannima n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb maa, ka niriba maa daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu.
en: Praise the Lord ! The Israelites were determined to fight; the people gladly volunteered.

dag: Ka o tizɔpaɣiba maa daa tim ti yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, a ni yuri so pam la biɛra.
en: So Mary and Martha sent someone to tell Jesus, Lord, your dear friend Lazarus is sick.

dag: Amaa di yi ti niŋ a viɛnyɛla, n suhir a, nyin teemi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Firawuna; ka lala chɛ ka n yi sarika ŋɔ ni.
en: But please, remember me when you are doing well and be loyal to me. Put in a good word for me to Pharaoh, so he sets me free from this prison.

dag: lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana ti balim ba ni bɛ niŋm suɣilo, ka daa naanyi yihi ba bahi, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋ maa ni.
en: So they came and apologized. They led them out of the jail and asked them to please leave town.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chaŋ ti doli bɛ naba hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-nya ka Sirianim maa situra mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zo ka chɛ m-bahi kul dɔndo sol ni. Ka tuumba maa daa labina ti yɛli naa.
en: The men went as far as the Jordan, and all along the road they saw the clothes and equipment that the Syrians had abandoned as they fled. Then they returned and reported to the king.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ kaɣisi yili maa puuni dukpina zaa, ka va bɛ ni kaɣisi taŋkpa shɛli maa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: After that he must have all the interior walls scraped and the plaster dumped in an unclean place outside the city.

dag: Rubin zuliya bɛn daa ʒiya gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni pihinu ni yini ni kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ bɛn yɛn doli pahi buyi.
en: These , troops will march into battle second.

dag: N Naawuni, nyini ka n niŋ naani. Di chɛ ka n di vi; a mi di chɛ ka n dimnim di nasara ka chɛ ma.
en: in you, my God, I trust. Save me from the shame of defeat; don't let my enemies gloat over me!.

dag: Dama bɛ bi nyari biɛrim; ka bɛ niŋgbuna mal alaafee, ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: They do not suffer pain; they are strong and healthy.

dag: Paɣ viɛla ni paɣ viɛlli, a bi mi? Doli piɛri maa naba n-zaŋ a buhi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri luɣ shɛli din miri piɛguliba tanti suɣa la.
en: Don't you know the place, loveliest of women? Go and follow the flock; find pasture for your goats near the tents of the shepherds.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na nti zali pal shɛli din labiri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: Then he brought in the priests and Levites and assembled them in the eastern square.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ Samaria nti yihiri waazu yɛri ba ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and began to preach Christ to them.

dag: Dama zahimmiya: Bɔ n-lee kpalim? Yi yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga, lala ku niŋ? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: because it is not just a test. You refused to be punished with the wooden stick, so what else should I use to punish you? A sword? This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Ziba, Ka a dan bia la lee be ya polo? Ka Ziba garigi yɛli naa, Nyama, o kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, dama o yɛlimi, Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ n yab nam ŋɔ ti ma. .
en: Where is your masters grandson? the king asked. He is still in Jerusalem, Ziba answered the king, because he thinks that the Israelites are now going to give his grandfathers kingdom back to him.

dag: N ni yɛri ya yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda.
en: Because I speak the truth, you dont believe me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya kul diri nam sahakam, ka chɛ ka a nam kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni. .
en: There will always be someone from your family to rule. I will make your kingdom continue forever and ever. Selah.

dag: bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ ni deei binshɛŋa talima labisi ti bindana, ka labisi bɛ ni zaŋ kpiɔŋ fa binshɛŋa ti dilana, ka doli zaligu shɛŋa din tiri nyɛvili, ka bi lan tumdi alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: They might give back the things they took when they loaned money. They might pay for the things they stole. They might begin to follow the laws that give life and stop doing bad things. Then they will surely live. They will not die.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kaman biɛɣu pia dali, ka Yawɛ daa ku Nabal.
en: About ten days later, the Lord gave him a stroke and Nabal died.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni, di nyɛla Yawɛ vuhim yuuni; di ti biriya yi puri bee n-wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi.
en: But in the seventh year the land will have a special sabbath rest, a Sabbath to the LORD: You must not plant your fields or prune your vineyards.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N ni yɛl a ni n nya a fiig tia gbin la zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? A ni ti nya binshɛŋa din gari lala.
en: Jesus answered, Do you believe because I told you that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see greater things than these!.

dag: Zoya sɔhirila o tooni, ka daboya nyɛligira ka tiŋgbani mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋuhir o tooni.
en: The mountains quake because of him; the hills melt away. The earth heaves before him— the world and all who dwell in it.

dag: O bela tampima shee, ka zaŋ tampin choya zuɣusaa leeg o yiŋa.
en: their nests on rocky cliffs.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam nam maa ni daa nya zaa zani ka niŋ yaa, di daa bi yuui ka o mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu.
en: But as soon as Rehoboam had secured his royal power, he, along with all Israel, abandoned the LORDs Instruction.

dag: ka zaŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla n-tuɣili di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: Then he burned sweet-smelling incense on the altar. He did this as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim maligu bimbina din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la mini bɛ ni daa tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa n-va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: First, they removed the altars in Jerusalem, and hauled off the incense altars and dumped them in the Kidron Valley.

dag: ka lɔri zaɣ biɛɣu o tɛha puuni, ka tahiri tuɣiligu na sahakam.
en: all the while planning evil in their perverted minds, stirring up trouble everywhere.

dag: Tinzunnima, Laɣimmiya, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Tin shɛŋa din be katinsinima, wummiya. Lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Iin, lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm shiri mali ya.
en: All you nations, prepare for war. You will be defeated. Listen, all you faraway countries! Prepare for battle. You will be defeated.

dag: Naawuni vuhim n-tahiri maasim na, nti chɛ ka ko titaŋa kilim.
en: The breath of God freezes the waters, and turns them to solid ice.

dag: Amaa a nini yi ti bi tiɣ o, nyin bahim o ka o chaŋ, ka di zaŋ o kɔhi. Di bi simdi ni a niŋ o kaman dabili la, a ni zaŋ o dɔni m-baŋ o daashil la zuɣu.
en: Later, if you no longer want her, you are to let her go free. Since you forced her to have intercourse with you, you cannot treat her as a slave and sell her.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni o ni ʒi a puu atam labina ti sɔŋ a kabɔɣili ni?.
en: Can you rely on it to bring back your grain to gather into your threshing floor?.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbibi n ni daa po pɔ shɛli yi yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ. Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. Yes, Lord , I replied, that's true.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn diri wahala ka di nyɛ Naawuni yubu la kul tumdi din tuhi, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya niŋ bɛ Namda ŋun kul ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa la nuu ni.
en: So then, those who suffer because it is God's will for them, should by their good actions trust themselves completely to their Creator, who always keeps his promise.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, Zaŋmiya yi ni gbahi yi mabi shɛb daba ŋɔ na labisi, dama Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. .
en: Listen to me! These prisoners are your brothers and sisters. Let them go, or the Lord will punish you in his anger.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, yi ni zaɣisi so zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi dolibu, amaa ka dolila zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya niŋ sunsuuni la zaligunim la zuɣu. .
en: You will know that I am the LORD, whose regulations you didnt observe and whose case laws you didnt follow. Instead, you followed the case laws of the nations around you.

dag: Amaa Azazɛl kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la ŋuna o ni ti zaŋ o la zaɣ nɛɔŋ ti Yawɛ n-yo bɛ daalahichi samli, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi mɔɣu ni nti ti Azazɛl.
en: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Make acacia-wood poles and cover them with gold.

dag: Dama n doli Yawɛ zaligu; ka na ʒi m-birigi zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni maa sani.
en: I have obeyed the law of the Lord ; I have not turned away from my God.

dag: A bilim ni ha mi ka a pun mi Naawuni Sabbu Kasi din ni tooi wuh a tiliginsim soli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la.
en: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kulim ni suhudoo. Naaman ni daa chaŋ, o daa na bi paai shɛli.
en: Elisha said to him, Go in peace. But when Naaman had gone some distance from Elisha.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a ni kari Ohola mini Oholiba saria, ka yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa?.
en: The Lord said to me, Mortal man, are you ready to judge Oholah and Oholibah? Accuse them of the disgusting things they have done.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yi Akasia chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti dɔn nimaani ni bɛ gbaai li du.
en: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi daa be Gɛba luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ Mikimash mini Aija ni Bɛtɛl ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages.

dag: Ka dunia zuliya kam ni be di neesim maa ni chana; ka dunia ŋɔ nanim ni zaŋ bɛ jilima na nti kpe di ni.
en: The peoples of the world will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their wealth into it.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku a min a niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm jɛndi zuliya shɛli din zaɣisi ni di ku jɛm Babilɔn Naa la?.
en: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyaŋ ninvuɣ maŋa pam, chɛliya ka ti chɛ ba ka bɛ be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-gɔri kɔhigu bɛ yubu, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ galisiya pam; ka chɛ ka ti kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi; ka ti gba zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ba.
en: These men want peace with us. Let them live in the land and travel through it; theres plenty of land for them. We will marry their daughters and give them our daughters.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Naawuni nira n-ka n sanna, o biɛhigu ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, ka o ninni lihibu mali dabiɛm pam. M bi bɔh o o ni yi luɣ shɛl na, ka o mi bi wuhi ma o yuli.
en: Then the woman went and told her husband, A man of God has come to me, and he looked as frightening as the angel of God. I didn't ask him where he came from, and he didn't tell me his name.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhimiya.
en: and he said to them, I am so sad that I feel as if I am dying. Stay here and keep awake with me.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bia ka kpi;.
en: Once there were seven brothers; the oldest got married and died without having children.

dag: O ni daa wum lala maa ka o dii yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir o ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini ni, Bul goli ŋun nyɛ gol so ŋun pahir anii la ni ka bɛ daa me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka mali di binshɛɣukam kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi shɛm naai. Yuma ayopɔin ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: In the eighth month, the month of Bul, in the eleventh year of Solomon's reign, the Temple was completely finished exactly as it had been planned. It had taken Solomon seven years to build it.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ŋun nyɛ na titali la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la m-puhir a. Ka pumpɔŋɔ.
en: From King Artaxerxes, To Ezra the priest, a teacher of the law of the God of heaven: Greetings!.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu nya o tizo Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ o ma puuni bia la, ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni daa yɛli ma yi tizɔbil so yɛla la m-bɔŋɔ? Di saha ka o daa yɛli, M bia, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni! .
en: When Joseph saw his brother Benjamin, he said, So this is your youngest brother, the one you told me about. God bless you, my son.

dag: Yinim dee kul zomiyala Yawɛ, ka jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa, dama zahimmiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa tin ya la.
en: Just fear the LORD and serve him faithfully with all your heart. Look at what great things he has done for you!.

dag: Karimbaannim maani ma la ansarisi ka di ka yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka m bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ a zaligu maa dolibu.
en: People full of pride are always making fun of me, but I have not stopped following your teachings.

dag: Biɛɣukam niriba daa yi kul kanila Dauda sanna ti pahir o zuɣu hal ka o tɔbbihi ti galisi kaman Naawuni tɔbbihi la.
en: Almost every day new men joined David's forces, so that his army was soon enormous.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a dɔni a nuzaa luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim tibidarigibo pa amaŋ zuɣu n-ʒi bɛ tibidarigibo maa dabisa shɛŋa ni zaa a ni yɛn do nimaani maa.
en: Then lie down on your left side, and I will place on you the guilt of the nation of Israel. For days you will stay there and suffer because of their guilt. I have sentenced you to one day for each year their punishment will last.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma n suhusaɣiŋgu saha. Gbilisim tibili wum, ka garigi ma yomyom n ni suhir a saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Dont turn away from me when I have troubles. Listen to me, and answer me quickly when I cry for help.

dag: Yisa daa ti kari alizin birigu do so zuɣu bahi; alizin birigu maa ni daa chaŋ naai ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira, ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam.
en: Jesus was driving out a demon that could not talk; and when the demon went out, the man began to talk. The crowds were amazed.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, dabiɛm yi ti mali ma, nyini ka n ni niŋ naani.
en: whenever Im afraid, I put my trust in you.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi biŋgolinsi maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ tanti yini.
en: and fasten the two panels at the loops with bronze hooks.

dag: Amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima bɛ kpaŋsibu mini bɛ saɣisibu ni bɛ suhumaabo zuɣu.
en: Those who prophesy speak to people, building them up, and giving them encouragement and comfort.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tooi wumda, di zuɣu ka n ku tooi garigi yɛli shɛli.
en: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.

dag: n yɛn zaŋ ya mi ti wulimpuhili polo nima ka bɛ sun ya. Ka bɛ ti ti bɛ suɣa yi sani n-ʒini yi sunsuuni. Bɛ ni ti di yi tiwala, ka nyu yi bihim.
en: therefore, Im handing you over to people in the east for them to take possession. They will set up their encampments against you, establish residence, devour your fruit, and drink your milk.

dag: Ka Uzai bia Palal daa mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee mini pia din du n-gari nayili jirambisa din miri nayili guliba biɛhigu shee la tooni. Ka Parɔsh bia Pɛdaya daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.

dag: piɛri mini niɣi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba.
en: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni din tuui mal alikauli di ni yɛliya: Tim a ba min a ma jilima.
en: The commandment Honor your father and mother is the first one with a promise attached.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya Izraɛlnim zaa Mizipa ka n ti suhi Yawɛ tin ya.
en: Next Samuel said, Assemble all Israel at Mizpah. I will pray to the LORD for you.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka naŋgbammalisimnim maa yɛtɔɣa zan tariga. Chɛ ka barinyuriba fo bɛ noya.
en: The Lord should cut off their lying lips and cut out their bragging tongues.
