dag: O yi ti yiɣis o luɣ shɛlikam, o luhir o mi ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋarit o noli, ka o ŋubir o nyina ka kpaŋ dilinli; ka n suhi a nyaandoliba ŋɔ ni bɛ kari alizin birigu maa, ka bɛ bi tooi.
en: The spirit attacks him and throws him on the ground. He foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes very stiff. I asked your followers to force the evil spirit out, but they could not.

dag: Di lan doliya yimaŋmaŋ suhu yubu n-niŋdi kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ: Kɔr biɛri tuma mini niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni tab laɣim nyuri dam ni buɣijɛmbo din chihiri zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la.
en: You have spent enough time in the past doing what the heathen like to do. Your lives were spent in indecency, lust, drunkenness, orgies, drinking parties, and the disgusting worship of idols.

dag: Zaŋmi n talima ni nyɛ shɛli zal a sani. Ŋuni n-lee beni ŋun ni zani n nyaaŋa?.
en: I am being honest, God. Accept my word. There is no one else to support what I say.

dag: Ka n ni lan ti a a ni bi suhi ma shɛli gba pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni ti a azichi mini jilima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ na so m-buɣis a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: And I will also give you what you did not ask for. You will have riches and honor all your life. There will be no other king in the world as great as you.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka niriba duh a yuli, ka tibigi li sahakam ka yɛra, Yawɛ nyɛla Tɔbbihi Naa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni. Chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaa zani a sani.
en: so that it may be established and so that your name may be made great forever when people say, The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, is Israels God. May your servant Davids household be established before you.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛlimi, M Ba, chɛ ka a yuli nya jilima. Di saha ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi alizanda ni na yɛra, M pun chɛ ka di nya jilima; amaa n ni lan chɛ ka di nya jilima pahi.
en: Father, do what will bring you glory! Then a voice came from heaven, I have already brought glory to myself. I will do it again.

dag: Zaadali paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ naa n-yi nudirigu polo na la gba ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama o daa yi katiŋa n-kana ni o ti wum Sulemaana yɛm yɛtɔɣa; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Sulemaana be kpe.
en: The queen of the South will be raised up by God at the judgment with this generation and condemn it because she came from a distant land to hear Solomons wisdom. And look, someone greater than Solomon is here.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal ka man ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim bia ŋɔ yi di nyɛ n nintu shɛli n ni mali dihiri binyara zuɣu la, ka di piri n nudirigu ni gba, n naan darigi fuɣ a n nubil maa ni.
en: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.

dag: Nyam n dimnim ni galisi shɛm; ka nya bɛ ni je ma pam shɛm.
en: Look at how many enemies I have and how violently they hate me!.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, pahim ti yɛda.
en: The apostles said to the Lord, Increase our faith.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tahi yɛli, Di bemi kaman n ni pun tɛhi shɛm! Yi bɔrila saha, dama yi baŋya ni n lo n suhu ni.
en: The king replied: Now I definitely know you are stalling for time, because you see that my decision is final.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam! A viɛlim maa yaɣimi gba! A nina bemi kaman ŋmana la a sariga ni. A zabiri kul yɛbisirimi kaman bu bɔbigu ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli shɛm la.
en: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee kpalim n-nyɛ ŋun nini daa nya n jɛmbu du kurili la jilima ni daa be shɛm? Yi ni nya jɛmbu du dini ŋɔ maa, wula ka di lee be yi sani? Di pa shɛli di bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: Does anyone remember how glorious this temple used to be? Now it looks like nothing.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, Fom baalim ʒini zibisim ni, bɛ ku lan bol a zuliya kam paɣiba naa.
en: Sit silent and go into darkness, Daughter Chaldea, because they will no longer call you Queen of Kingdoms.

dag: Ka a yihi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi din be piɛɣu puuni n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la zaɣ kpil yini mini maha din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini.
en: Then take the basket of bread that you made without yeast. This is the basket you put before the Lord . Take these things out of the basket: one loaf of bread, one cake made with oil, and one small thin cake.

dag: Mbusim be n zuɣu, n ni nya biɛrim shɛli zuɣu. N daŋ maa yaɣiya! Amaa ka n yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n tibidarigibo m-bala, di kpala talahi ni n deei li.
en: I am hurt badly. I am injured and I cannot be healed. But I told myself, This is my sickness; I must suffer through it.

dag: ni Anatɔt ni Alimɔn.
en: Anathoth, and Almon, with their pasture lands.

dag: Ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ kuriti mali binyila ka yɛli, Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Binyila ŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe Sirianim ŋɔ hal ti naai bɛ balibu. .
en: Zedekiah, Chenaanahs son, made iron horns for himself and said, This is what the LORD says: With these horns you will gore the Arameans until theres nothing left of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Dan zuliya niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligina bɔhi Maika, Bɔ n-chɛ ka a zaŋ salo ŋɔ tatabo pa amaŋ zuɣu na.
en: and shouted for them to stop. They turned to face him and asked, What's wrong? Why did you bring all these men.

dag: N yura yɛli ma, N ni yuri so pam, ŋun viɛli pam n sani, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: and speaking to me. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.

dag: Dama o kul wuhirila zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe, biɛlifu kpe.
en: It is tsav letsav, tsav letsav; qav leqav, qav leqav, a little of this, a little of that.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinunaayi saha ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pisi.
en: Pekah son of Remaliah began to rule over Israel in Samaria during the nd year that Azariah was king of Judah. Pekah ruled years.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn daa bi lihiri bɔri wuntitali Naawuni san la nya li bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So what does all this mean? It means that people who are not Jews were made right with God because of their faith, even though they were not trying to make themselves right.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ, ka neeri ni shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili. Dunia ŋɔ ni ninsal niŋgbuŋ yi beni, shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili gba nyɛla din beni.
en: Its a physical body when its put into the ground, but its raised as a spiritual body. If theres a physical body, theres also a spiritual body.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ jilima n-taɣi naɣibil ŋun ŋubiri mɔri kɔtomsi.
en: they exchanged the glory of God for the image of an animal that eats grass.

dag: Naawuni, a yuli nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana. Chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: God, rise above the heavens! Let all the world see your glory.

dag: N ni daa labi maa, ka n daa nya tihi pam mɔɣili maa duli yaɣa ayi.
en: When I went back, I saw very many trees on both banks of the river.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nti nya farigudeer so ŋun yuli booni Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma.
en: After this Jesus went out and saw a tax collector sitting at his place for collecting taxes. His name was Levi. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ o, ka daa tim anabi o sani ka o ti yɛl o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a jɛmdi tinzun buɣ shɛŋa din daa bi tooi tiligi dimaŋmaŋ niriba a nuu ni la.
en: As a result, the LORD was angry with Amaziah and sent a prophet to him. Why do you seek the gods of this people? the prophet asked. They couldnt even deliver their own people from you.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni n-dari gindi saha shɛl la ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa lala maa. Amaa nyama, di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla yuun pihinahinaanu, ka o na kul chɛ ka m be. Ka nyama, n nyɛla yuun pihiniinaanu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Now look. The LORD has kept me alive, exactly as he promised. It is forty-five years since the LORD spoke about this to Moses. It was while Israel was journeying in the desert. Now look. Today Im years old.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni, gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanu dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the fifteenth day of the first month of the twelfth year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: kuhi pam yɛli, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a Naawuni yuli zuɣu, di nahim ma.
en: He shouted, Jesus, Son of God in heaven, what do you want with me? Promise me in God's name that you won't torture me.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka n tɛhi kurimbuni ha yɛla, ka teei yuun shɛŋa din gari la yɛla.
en: I think of days gone by and remember years of long ago.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di zaŋ Izraɛl zuliya shɛli fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli n-tom ti Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli nima; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim zaa kul gbibila bɛ yaannim daŋ fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: In this way land will not be passed from tribe to tribe among the Israelites. Each Israelite will keep the land that belonged to their own ancestors.

dag: Sida tihi din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa bi paai li. Gɔhi tihi bi paai di wulikpana. Nira ku tooi zaŋ ti shɛŋa din be polipoli buɣisi di wula. Tia daa ka Naawuni tihi puu la ni din viɛl paai li.
en: No cedar was its equal in Gods garden. The fir trees didnt have anything like its branches, and the plane trees had nothing like its boughs. None of the trees in Gods garden could compare to it in its beauty.

dag: Zom ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka tummila din viɛla; bom suhudoo n-gbibi li.
en: Stop doing anything evil, and do good. Look for peace, and do all you can to help people live peacefully.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli wahu maa, Ti ni tooi di ti shɛŋa din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: The woman said to the snake, We may eat the fruit of the gardens trees.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya guŋgombihi n-wa waa paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi yuhi paɣ o.
en: Praise God with drum and dance! Praise God with strings and pipe!.

dag: Ka o ti yih o fiɛɣu min o kɔbiri bahi sara maligu bimbini maa wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kpaari tampiligim bahiri la.
en: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.

dag: Niriba yi daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-tum tuun kpɛma bindirigu zuɣu hal ni yuŋ, ka bi daŋ gbihibu, di ka buchi, dama Yawɛ n-tir o ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb gom.
en: It is pointless that you get up early and stay up late, eating the bread of hard labor because God gives sleep to those he loves.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lola nia biɛɣu jɛndi ma.
en: The LORD said to me: A conspiracy is taking place among the people of Judah and residents of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bina ayi ŋɔ nyɛla din ku tooi taɣi, ka Naawuni mi ku ŋma ʒiri di puuni. Lala zuɣu di simdi ni tinim bɛn nya sɔɣibu shee Naawuni sani ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni pam gbibi tahima shɛli din be ti tooni la kirikiri.
en: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.

dag: Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ, dama o tum alahiziba tuma. O nudirigu min o bɔɣu dim be kasi ŋɔ ti o nasara.
en: Sing to the LORD a new song because he has done wonderful things! His own strong hand and his own holy arm have won the victory!.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋaha puuni ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima; saha kanna ka n ti ku lan yɛli ya shɛli ŋaha puuni, amaa ka ni ti kahigi m Ba yɛla wuhi ya.
en: Ive been using figures of speech with you. The time is coming when I will no longer speak to you in such analogies. Instead, I will tell you plainly about the Father.

dag: Amaa ka yi niŋ tipawumli, ka zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi baɣaka. Yi tum tuumbiɛri pam n-gari yi yaannim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: But your ancestors did not listen to me. They did not pay attention to me. They were very stubborn and did evil even worse than their fathers did.

dag: ni tayiɣisi ni kɔrɛnima ni danyuriba ni ninvuɣ turiba ni ninvuɣ fariba zaa ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: thieves, the greedy, drunks, abusive people, and swindlers wont inherit Gods kingdom.

dag: Niɣi mi bɛ lana, ka bunsi mi bɛ lan ni dihiri ba luɣ shɛli. Amaa Izraɛlnim bi mi lala, n niriba maa bi baŋ.
en: Oxen and donkeys know who owns and feeds them, but my people won't ever learn.

dag: dama Naawuni chɛ ka sokam kpe bɛmaŋmaŋ nɔzaɣisibo ni m-be kaman dansarikanima n-nyɛ ba la ni di chɛ ka o zo sokam nambɔɣu.
en: All people have refused to obey God. And he has put them all together as people who dont obey him so that he can show mercy to everyone.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Piimi dɔbba n-sa chaŋ ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Biɛɣuni n sa ni zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ n nuu ni n-chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli zuɣu.
en: Moses said to Joshua, Pick out some men to go and fight the Amalekites tomorrow. I will stand on top of the hill holding the stick that God told me to carry.

dag: Timoti ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee la puhiri ya; ka Lusius mini Jeesɔn ni Sɔsipata bɛn nyɛ n zuliya la gba puhiri ya.
en: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ti ni ti kari malaikanim gba saria? Ka di yi nyɛ lala, dindina ti ni tooi kari ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu yɛla saria gari lala!.
en: Dont you know that we will judge angels? Why not ordinary things?.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni di n-tiɣi ka zaɣis a ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ. Bee n yi nyɛ faralana n ni zu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ta n Naawuni yuli daɣiri.
en: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.

dag: Amaa nyin yihirila Naawuni zɔbo a kɔbili ni. Ka guri Naawuni jɛmbo soli.
en: If you had your way, no one would respect God and pray to him.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi mali sara din ni tiɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ nini, ka suh o naa min o bihi nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: This is to be done so that they can offer sacrifices that are acceptable to the God of Heaven and pray for his blessing on me and my sons.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti yili yila yɛl o ni yur o wain tihi pu shɛl la yɛla.
en: At that time people will sing about the pleasant vineyard.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla yi situra varimla nandaamba bɛn ka taali ʒim, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa zaa yoli. Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa puuni.
en: Your garments are stained with the blood of the innocent poor, even though you didnt catch them breaking and entering. Yet, despite all this.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be du shɛl ni ka kpari di dunoya, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima. Ka Yisa ti puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: The day was Sunday, and that same evening the followers were together. They had the doors locked because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders. Suddenly, Jesus was standing there among them. He said, Peace be with you.

dag: ni Judas Jeemsi so bia mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti leei nyaanyira la.
en: Judas, the son of James, Judas Iscariot .

dag: Ka siliga guliba maa daa deei liɣiri maa, ka chaŋ ti shiri niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm maa, ka Yɛhudianim daa deei yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ yɛlimaŋli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: The soldiers took the money and did what they were told. The people of Judea still tell each other this story.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n dana, nyama, Adɔnija n-nyɛ naa, hal a ni kul bi mi di yɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: Now, you dont know this, but Adonijah is making himself king.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni wum ti paɣ so ŋun bol omaŋa anabi ka o yuli booni Jɛzibɛl la zuɣu. O nyɛla ŋun yɔhindi n jɛmdiba n-wuhiri ba ka bɛ niŋdi zina, ka diri buɣa maligu nimdi.
en: But this is what I have against you: you tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a messenger of God. By her teaching she misleads my servants into practicing sexual immorality and eating food that has been offered to idols.

dag: Nyini n-zali dunia di tariga, nyini n-zali woligu saha mini kikaa saha.
en: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro maa na zuɣu? Yi nini na kul bi neei bee yi na kul bi baŋ? Yi nyɛla suhutunanima?.
en: Jesus knew what they were discussing and said, Why are you talking about the fact that you dont have any bread? Dont you grasp what has happened? Dont you understand? Are your hearts so resistant to what God is doing?.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali mabihi ni bidibisi bɛn daa mali yiko din ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Meshelemiah had sons and relatives who were powerful men. In all there were sons and relatives.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, Labim a ba min a dɔɣiriba tiŋgban ni. N ni be a sani.
en: Then the LORD said to Jacob, Go back to the land of your ancestors and to your relatives, and I will be with you.

dag: Pu shɛli daa do m-miri bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa, ka sil pal shɛli bɛ ni daa na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni do puu maa ni.
en: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.

dag: ka boli yil maa ni bi so na nti bɔh o diɛma maa daliri.
en: So he called to one of the servant boys and asked, What does all this mean.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi zani, dama nandaamba nyari nahiŋgu, ka faranim mi kul ŋuhira. N ni ti ba faako shɛli bɛ suhuri ni bɔri maa.
en: But the LORD says, Because the poor are oppressed, because of the groans of the needy, Im now standing up. I will provide the help they are gasping for.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a jɛmbu duu shiri nyɛla luɣ shɛli din viɛli shee.
en: How lovely is your dwelling place, LORD of heavenly forces!.

dag: Ka o pii ninvuɣ pinaayi ni bɛ be o sani, ka o timdi ba ka bɛ ti yihiri waazu.
en: and he chose twelve, whom he named apostles. I have chosen you to be with me, he told them. I will also send you out to preach.

dag: Di saha ka a yipa ni bɔri sara maligunima din tuhi ni sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la; di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan zaŋ naɣilahi m-mali sara a sara maligu bimbin la zuɣu.
en: Then you will be pleased with proper sacrifices and with our burnt offerings; and bulls will be sacrificed on your altar.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti yɛl o zuliya maa, N saɣi kpibu; amaa Naawuni ni ti ka yi sanna nti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya kulisi o ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: He said to his brothers, I am about to die, but God will certainly take care of you and lead you out of this land to the land he solemnly promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa leeg alahichi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni; ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka di simdi ni bɛ yaag o daŋ maa n-kpihim di birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: In this way the house of Jeroboam acted sinfully, leading to its downfall and elimination from the earth.

dag: Hal di nyaɣa yi kul kurigi tiŋgban ni, ka di mundili kuui do tiŋa.
en: Its roots and stump may rot.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi ka sabbu be di yaɣa ayi. Di daa sab niŋla di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa.
en: Moses then turned around and came down the mountain. He carried the two covenant tablets in his hands. The tablets were written on both sides, front and back.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma pal yɛlinli ka n yaari n naba chana, ka n naba daa bi sarigi.
en: You have kept me from being captured, and I have never fallen.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋna nti nya zoondɔɣirili.
en: While Jesus was walking, he saw a man who had been blind since the time he was born.

dag: Dindali maa ti Duuma ni ti yihi bɛ napɔnchahi ni nachintɛri mini bɔbisi ni dolibinima.
en: On that day, the LORD will remove: the splendid ankle chains; headbands and moon-shaped pendants.

dag: Yi tam yi namda ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa ka zali dunia ŋɔ tanzaa la yɛla. Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri yiɣisi, ka bɛ nahindi ya ka bɔri ni bɛ kun ya la dabiɛm? Bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa ku tooi niŋ ya shɛli.
en: I, the Lord , am the one who made you. With my power I made the earth and spread the sky over the earth. But you have forgotten me, so you are always afraid that angry men will hurt you. Those men planned to destroy you, but where are they now?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk, A ka takɔbi bee kpani kpe n-zaŋ ti ma? Dama naa tuma maa ni bɔri yomyom shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka m bi tooi zaŋ n takɔbi bee m bidibbin shɛli.
en: David asked Ahimelech, Do you have a spear or sword on hand? I didnt bring my sword or gear with me because the kings mission was urgent.

dag: amaa bɛ zaŋmila tuun suma m-malimi bɛmaŋa kaman di ni niŋ kamaata ni paɣiba bɛn doli adiini soli niŋdi shɛm.
en: but with good deeds, as is proper for women who claim to be religious.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ lab mali Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin la, ka o daa mali suhudoo mini wumpaɣibo sara di zuɣu, ka daa zali Judanima ni bɛ jɛmmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa.
en: Then he repaired the Lord 's altar and offered sacrifices to thank him and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He gave orders that everyone in Judah must worship the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ti yi niŋ ninsalinim shɛhiradibo yɛda, Naawuni shɛhiradibo n-dii gari, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛli.
en: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn gbe, ka bɛ ni yino lɔrig o kpalaŋa ni o niŋ bindirigu ti o buŋa ka nya ka liɣiri be o kpalaŋ maa nol ni;.
en: When they stopped for the night, one of them opened his sack to get some grain for his donkey, and at once he saw his moneybag.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli, N ni birigi chaŋ ti nya lahizibu din chɛ ka buɣim maa bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: This is strange, he thought. Why isn't the bush burning up? I will go closer and see.

dag: Ana daa nyɛla Dishɔn ba. Dishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamiran mini Ɛshiban ni Itiran ni Kɛran.
en: Anahs son was Dishon. Dishons sons were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

dag: Dama tia mali tahima, bɛ yi ŋmaai li luhi, di ni lan kpiri, ka ku chɛ zoobu.
en: There is hope for a tree that has been cut down; it can come back to life and sprout.

dag: Ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha maa ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba.
en: Edom has been independent of Judah ever since. During this same period the city of Libnah also revolted.

dag: Di saha maa ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nira ka ʒe Sool sapashin kpamba maa san la daa garigi yɛli Sool, N daa nya Jɛsi bia maa ka o ka Nɔb na nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Ahitub bia la sani.
en: Doeg was standing there with Saul's officers, and he said, I saw David when he went to Ahimelech son of Ahitub in Nob.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa wum Yisa yɛla, ka tim Yɛhudianim kpeen shɛba ni bɛ ti suhi Yisa ka o kana ti tib o dabili maa ti o.
en: When he heard about Jesus, he sent some older Jewish leaders to him. He wanted the men to ask Jesus to come and save the life of his servant.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun lihim o, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun ka o dɔro maa daɣiri ni, o niŋgbuŋ zaa ni leei zaɣ piɛlli maa zuɣu, o lan pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: If the priest sees that the skin disease covers the whole body and that it has turned all the skin white, the priest must announce that the person is clean.

dag: So bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla dunia ni, ka bɛ yuya lan ka solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: The memory of them will perish from the earth; they will achieve no recognition abroad.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ŋariŋ maa tumtumdiba ka bɛ zaa yinoyino gbaai bɛ wuna kabu, ka kpuɣiri ŋarin titali maa ni nɛma bahiri kom ni ni di chɛ ka ŋarin titali maa tibisim filim. Amaa ka Jona ŋun daa kpɛla ŋarin titali maa puuni ha nti doya gbihira.
en: The men wanted to make the boat lighter to stop it from sinking, so they began throwing the cargo into the sea. The sailors were very afraid. Each man began praying to his god. Jonah had gone down into the boat to lie down, and he went to sleep.

dag: ka nya ka pɔhim ʒɛra, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o piligi shimdi ka kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, tiligim ma.
en: But when he noticed the strong wind, he was afraid and started to sink down in the water. Save me, Lord! he cried.

dag: Naawuni yi nuzaa polo na ni jilima din be kaman salima la, ka nam dariza din mali dabiɛm gil o.
en: A golden glow is seen in the north, and the glory of God fills us with awe.

dag: Teemi ni n saha bi waɣa; dama a nam ninsalinim zaa ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpira.
en: Remember how short my life is. You created us to live a short life and then die.

dag: Yi mi ku lan nya karimbaannim bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ saani yi sani ka yi ʒi li, ka ku tooi baŋ di gbinni la.
en: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.

dag: Ka kpamba maa daa yih o o ni daa be chɛchɛbun shɛli ni maa n-zaŋ o niŋ o chɛchɛbun shɛli din daa pahir ayi ni n-zaŋ o kuli Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni. Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kum o kuli.
en: They lifted him out of his chariot, placed him in a second chariot which he had there, and took him to Jerusalem. There he died and was buried in the royal tombs. All the people of Judah and Jerusalem mourned his death.

dag: ka daa lab kuli ti bo tulaale mini kpaʒiɛrim zali. Ka bɛ daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then they went to prepare some sweet-smelling spices for his burial. But on the Sabbath they rested, as the Law of Moses commands.

dag: ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini dɔbba pia bɛn be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zaŋ takɔbi ku Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa, Babilɔn naa ni daa zaŋ o leei tiŋgbɔŋ maa Gomna maa zuɣu.
en: During the meal, Ishmael and his soldiers killed Gedaliah, the man chosen as ruler of Judah by the king of Babylonia.

dag: Piligu ni, Naawuni daa namla zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: In the beginning, when God created the earth and sky.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-nya ka so kpira ka di nyɛla o ni ka situra zuɣu bee ka nandana ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: When I found someone in need, too poor to buy clothes.

dag: Nira ni tooi kabigi kurigu mini tahiʒiɛɣu din gabi taba, ka nyɛ din yi nuzaa polo na?.
en: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.

dag: Ofiri ni Havila ni Jɔbab. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-daa laɣim nyɛ Jokitan daŋ niriba.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these people were Joktans sons.

dag: Ka paɣ so mi yi mali yidan ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda, ka doo maa yu ni o mal o, ŋun miri ka o yi o yiŋa.
en: And if you have a husband who is not a believer, you should not divorce him if he will continue to live with you.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi bihi ni. Alibarika ni ti be yi puri atam ni, alibarika ni ti be yi biŋkɔbiri bihi ni. Yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi ni ti nabi.
en: Your own fertility, your soils produce, and your livestocks offspring—the young of both cattle and flocks—will be blessed.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba bi gbɛri kum, amaa o chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: If you obey the Lord , you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.

dag: M bi bɔri ni di be kaman n sabirila gbana ni n kpɛhi ya dabiɛm.
en: I dont want it to seem like Im trying to intimidate you with my letters.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi ti Masia yurilim ni? Muɣisigu bee wahala bee alaka bee fifali bee gbinfini bee barina bee takɔbi ni tooi yihi ti di ni?.
en: Who will separate us from Christs love? Will we be separated by trouble, or distress, or harassment, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword?.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also give male goat as a sin offering. This must be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: Binyara ŋɔ bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsalinim ni tɔɣisiri shɛm. So mi bi wumdi di kukoya.
en: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali tahima ŋɔ kul maanila omaŋa m-be kasi kaman o ni be kasi shɛm.
en: He is pure, and everyone who has this hope in him keeps themselves pure like Christ.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na.
en: When the time came to gather the grapes, he sent a slave to the tenants to receive from them his share of the harvest.

dag: Ka kpiimba mini tampiligim vinvamli ni zaa ni pu shɛŋa din be Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli zaa ni Wɔhu Dunɔdali din be gooŋgɔŋ shee zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo la ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan wurim li bee n-saɣim li yaha.
en: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes are thrown and all the terraces down to the bottom of Kidron Valley all the way to the corner of Horse Gate will be holy to the Lord . The city of Jerusalem will never again be torn down or destroyed.

dag: Bahigu maa paana. Di bahigu saha paaya. Di nyɛla din yiɣisi lu yi zuɣu. Nyama, di kanna.
en: And when it comes, your life will be over.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin mini Hashub daa mali me bɛ yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Maasɛya bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ Anania yaaŋa la daa mali me o yiŋ luɣili ni m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Benjamin and Hasshub repaired the wall in front of their own house. And Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, repaired the wall next to his house.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ piɛlaa maa kpam min o zuli ni kpam ni o nyɔri kpam ni o saba ni o yaannina ayi ni di kpam ni o nudirigu gbalipuɣili, dama o nyɛla maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa.
en: Cut away the ram's fat, the fat tail, the fat covering the internal organs, the best part of the liver, the two kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ, n suhir a, deemi n nyɛvili, dama n kum so m bebu.
en: So now, Lord , just kill me. It is better for me to die than to live.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din be dukpina ni ni kuhi bahi ya na, ka dapua din be dari ni garigi saɣi.
en: The stones of the walls will cry out against you. Even the wooden rafters in your own house will prove that you are wrong.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa tintariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nuzaa polo, di ti yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli n-doli Hɛtilɔn nti gari Lɛbɔhamat n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛdad.
en: This is the boundary of the land. The northern limit begins at the Mediterranean Sea and goes in the direction of Hethlon toward Lebo-hamath, Zedad.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Damaskusnim polo. Hamatinim mini Aripadnim birimmi, dama bɛ wumla lahiba biɛɣu. Dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya kaman teeku kom din ku tooi fo n-doya la.
en: This is what the Lord said about Damascus: The people in the cities of Hamath and Arpad are worried and troubled because they have heard bad news. Anxiety rolls over them like a sea, and they cannot rest.

dag: Ka Asiria naa Tiligatipilinɛza daa lee ti kana ti lir o mi n-nahim o, ka bi sɔŋ o.
en: Assyrias King Tiglath-pileser came to Ahaz, but he brought trouble, not support.

dag: Ka Naawuni ti o binyɛr piɛlli din nyɛlisiri ka be nyam ni o ye. Binyɛr piɛlli maa nyɛla wuntizɔriba wuntia tuma.
en: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi a suhu ni ni a gba tur a tab pam.
en: Haven't you cursed many others?.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Tuun shɛli Naawuni ni bɔri ni yi tum nyɛla ni yi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: Jesus answered, God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa na be n sani, ka m bihi na be n san la.
en: and all of my children were nearby.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni kpi. Yawɛ dimnim ni ŋmanila tipuma din viɛla. Bɛ ni vuui yom, bɛ ni vuui kaman nyɔhi la.
en: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.

dag: Amaa so beni ŋun diri ma shɛhira, ka m mi ni o ni diri ma shɛhira shɛli maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: There is someone else who testifies about me, and I know his testimony about me is true.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa daa dam, ka niriba zo n-laɣimna nti gbaai Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-dar o yi, ka dii yo di dunoya.
en: The whole city was in an uproar, and the people turned into a mob. They grabbed Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Then suddenly the doors were shut.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Ninvuɣ kɔbisita shɛb bɛn mali bɛ zilima nyuri kom ŋɔ ka n ni zaŋ fan ya bahi, ka zaŋ Midiannim maa niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zaa lab kuli.
en: The Lord said, Gideon, your army will be made up of everyone who lapped the water from their hands. Send the others home. I'm going to rescue Israel by helping you and your army of defeat the Midianites.

dag: Tuumba maa ni daa ti paai Gibia din nyɛ Sool ya la nti yɛli yɛlli maa ka di lu niriba tiba ni, bɛ daa dii duhila kuŋa n-kuhiri pampam.
en: When the messengers reached Gibeah where Saul lived, they reported the news directly to the people there. Then they all wept aloud.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye Yawɛ zuɣu ka bɛ guh o ni nya ya palli. Bɛ ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔrili kpiŋkpama la. Bɛ ni guui ka di ku gbarigi ba. Bɛ ni chaŋ ka di ku wum ba.
en: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.

dag: Diimas ni yuri dunia ŋɔ la zuɣu, o zoya chaŋ Tɛsalɔnaika ka chɛ ma; Krɛshɛnsi chaŋ Galɛshia, ka Taitus mi chaŋ Dalimatia.
en: Demas has fallen in love with the present world and has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ yinim Zɛruya bihi bɛn be kaman yi leela n dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Di simdi ni ti ku nira Izraɛl tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Pa mani n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: David said, What should I do with you, sons of Zeruiah? Are you trying to cause me trouble? No one will be put to death in Israel today! Today I know that I am king over Israel.

dag: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun daŋ tooni ni ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ni ŋun lan nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: I am the first and the last, the beginning and the end.

dag: Naŋgbankpeeni maa ni daa mali ti mooi nini saha shɛli ka sapashin kpɛm maa zɔri ni bɛ ti bu Pool n-chɛrisi o nimdi gari taŋkpaɣu ni zuɣu daa chɛ ka o yɛli tɔbbihi ni bɛ cham ti fa Pool bɛ sani n-zaŋ o tahi bɛn tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee.
en: The argument became so violent that the commander was afraid that Paul would be torn to pieces. So he ordered his soldiers to go down into the group, get Paul away from them, and take him into the fort.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi mini Jɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Saimɔn tumtumdi tab la gba alahiziba. Ka Yisa yɛli Saimɔn, Di zɔri dabiɛm, a nyɛla kulipal ŋun gbahiri zahim, amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a ni leela ŋun vɔri ninsalinim tiri Naawuni.
en: James and John, Zebedees sons, were Simons partners and they were amazed too. Jesus said to Simon, Dont be afraid. From now on, you will be fishing for people.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee paligi pam, ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-zo yomyom ni bɛ ti ti o nyaandoliba di lahibali.
en: So they left the tomb in a hurry, afraid and yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

dag: O daa bi chɛ o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa. Dama o bilim ni ka dɔbba daa pun niŋ o kɔre n-zaŋ o saɣim.
en: She continued what she had begun as a prostitute in Egypt, where she lost her virginity. From the time she was a young woman, men slept with her and treated her like a prostitute.

dag: di bahi bamdi a ni nyɛ ŋun mi Yɛhudianim kaya mini bɛ naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla zuɣu. N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: You know a lot about our religious customs and the beliefs that divide us. So I ask you to listen patiently to me.

dag: Kaman kurimbuni ha yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ni yɛli shɛm la, Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kɔbili ni ka ninvuɣ biɛtali yirina. Amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: You know the old saying, Evil is done only by evil people. And so I will not harm you.

dag: Amaa o yi zaɣisi wumbu, nyin bom ninvuɣ yino bee niriba ayi pah amaŋ zuɣu lab o sani, ka niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira dibu zuɣu ti chɛ ka yɛtɔɣili kam mali nyaanzaana.
en: But if they refuse to listen, go to them again and take one or two people with you. Then there will be two or three people who will be able to tell all that happened.

dag: Di yi di nyɛla n dimnima n-di maani ma ansarisi, n naan tooi deei li; ka n datahi n-yi di diri dari niŋdi ma, n naan tooi sɔɣi ka bɛ ku nya ma.
en: If it were an enemy insulting me, I could bear it. If it were my enemies attacking me, I could hide.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi ni Izraɛlnim zaa ni man Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, and to all the Israelites. Tell them this is what the Lord has commanded:.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta zaligu ŋɔ n-daa wuhi Purim.
en: Esther's command, confirming the rules for Purim, was written down on a scroll.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ niriba ŋɔ shɛlikam zaa ŋɔ yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: I pray you, O God, remember to my credit everything that I have done for this people.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chani gindi tiŋkpan shɛŋa din be Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Jesus and his disciples went into the villages near Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, Who do people say that I am.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o yɛl o, N yuli Yaakubu.
en: He said to Jacob, Whats your name? and he said, Jacob.

dag: Pu shɛli daa do m-miri bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa, ka sil pal shɛli bɛ ni daa na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni do puu maa ni.
en: There was a garden in the place where Jesus had been put to death, and in it there was a new tomb where no one had ever been buried.

dag: Bɛ ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: and they dont know the way of peace. .

dag: Naawuni, di shini; Naawuni, di fo, a mi di kpalim ʒiya!.
en: O God, do not keep silent; do not be still, do not be quiet!.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi kul ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ, yi wuhirila ti Duuma kum yɛla hal ni o ti labina.
en: This means that every time you eat this bread and drink from this cup you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

dag: Amazia daa lan ku Ɛdom tɔbbihi tuhi pia Yalim Vinvamli ni, ka tuhi fa Sɛla m-boli di yuli Joktiɛl, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Amaziah killed ten thousand Edomite soldiers in Salt Valley; he captured the city of Sela in battle and called it Joktheel, the name it still has.

dag: ka salo ŋɔ zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋdila takɔbi bee kpani n-tiligir o niriba, dama tɔb ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ tɔbu, ka o mi ni zaŋ ya niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: All the people gathered here will know that the Lord doesnt need swords or spears to save people. The battle belongs to the Lord , and he will help us defeat all of you.

dag: Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are. You are the holy one from God.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa tiɣi Naawuni nin la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa ka daa na bi nya Naawuni ni daa lo ba binshɛŋa alikauli la;.
en: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.

dag: n-nya tarimba, ka n daa kpahim bipola n-nya nachimbil so ŋun ka yɛm bɛ ni.
en: at some foolish teenagers and noticed one who had no sense at all.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Ka Zara daa be o nyaaŋa tanti suɣili dunol ni n-wumda.
en: One of the guests was the Lord , and he said, I'll come back about this time next year, and when I do, Sarah will already have a son. Sarah was behind Abraham, listening at the entrance to the tent.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun lihiri tiŋgbani ka di sɔhiri ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun shihi zoya, ka di tuɣiri nyɔhi.
en: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.

dag: Nyama, m bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: Look, I have chosen Bezalel, Uris son and Hurs grandson from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Naawuni, sara shɛli a ni deeri nyɛla siɣisimaŋtali; a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ so ŋun siɣis omaŋ niŋ tuuba o suhu ni.
en: A broken spirit is my sacrifice, God. You wont despise a heart, God, that is broken and crushed.

dag: ni Ahimaaz ŋun daa be Naftali.
en: Ahimaaz in Naphtali, who also took Solomons daughter Basemath as his wife.

dag: Bɛ laɣindimi sɔɣiri dooni ni bɛ nya n ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka maani tahima ni bɛ ku ma.
en: They get together and set an ambush— they are watching my steps, hoping for my death.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu lahi mini di nɛma zaa na nti ŋmaŋŋma Naawuni duu nɛma maa, ka kpari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka me maligu bimbina zali Jɛrusalɛm lɔrigi kam ni.
en: Ahaz gathered the things from Gods Temple and broke them to pieces. Then he closed the doors of the Lord s Temple. He made altars and put them on every street corner in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa pa ni Naawuni sani; dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked straight at them and answered, This is impossible for human beings but not for God; everything is possible for God.

dag: Ka naa daa zaɣisi ninkura la yɛligu la, ka zaŋla halibiɛɣu yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi niriba maa.
en: King Rehoboam did not listen to the advice from the older men, and he was rude to the people.

dag: Amaa yuma maa yi kpalim biɛla ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa, dindina ŋun chɛ ka o mini dilan mali yuun shɛŋa din kpalim ni o tum tuma maa laasabu, ka o labisi di liɣiri ti o ka deeg omaŋa.
en: If only a few years are left, they will calculate that and pay for their purchase according to the years of service.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbin la mini buɣa jɛmbu duri din be Samaria tinsi ni shɛm la shiri ni ti niŋ pali.
en: The Lord used him to speak against the altar at Bethel and against the high places in the other towns in Samaria. And what he said will certainly happen.

dag: Ka o daa boli bidib so ŋun pah ayi mi yuli Ifriim, ka yɛli, Naawuni ti ma nama n ni di wahala tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: He also said, God has given me children in the land of my trouble; so he named his second son Ephraim.

dag: O daa yɛli ba mi, Wummiya n ni sa zahim zahindi shɛli ŋɔ:.
en: He said, Listen to the dream I had.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni sariakaribo din tuhi shihira, ka di wuhiri ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi ŋun Naawuni nam shɛli zuɣu yi ni diri wahala ŋɔ ni kpɛbu.
en: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.

dag: Ka bɛ daa to tɛte, ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la di, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgbani ti bɛ zuliya maa pirigili kaman daŋ kam ni yɛn deei shɛm, bɛ daa zaŋla fɔntinsi pia ti ba.
en: The rest of Kohaths descendants got ten towns from half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.

dag: Sulemaana daa yi nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuuni kam puuni.
en: Solomon received an annual income of six hundred sixty-six kikkars of gold.

dag: Shɛb daa nyɛla jɛra n-tum tuumbiɛri, ka daa di wahala bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Some of the redeemed were fools because of their sinful ways. They suffered because of their wickedness.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piripiri dunɔgulibo tuma maa Kɔra daŋ niriba mini Mɛrari daŋ niriba maa sunsuuni shɛm m-bala.
en: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers from Korahs family and Meraris family.

dag: Hal yi yi nyaŋ Babilɔn tɔbbi shɛb bɛn tuhiri ya maa zaa, ka di ti kpalimla bɛn nya dansi kɔŋko bɛ suɣa ni gba, bɛ ni yiɣisina ti nyo ya ŋɔ buɣim. .
en: Even if you defeat the whole Babylonian army, so that only wounded men are left, lying in their tents, they would still get up and burn this city to the ground.

dag: Anabi maa n-nyɛ ŋun guli Ifriimnim bɛn nyɛ n Naawuni niriba ŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ bari noongbahiri zana bɛ soya zuɣu, ka dimdi be bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: God and the prophet are like guards watching over Ephraim, but there are many traps along his way. And people hate the prophet, even in the house of his God.

dag: Lahibali ni daa ti nti to Firawuna yiŋa ni Yisifu biɛyanima n-kana, di daa niŋ Firawuna min o kpambaliba nyaɣisim pam.
en: When it was told in the palace that Joseph's brothers had come, the king and his officials were happy.

dag: ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi wuhi paɣisara ka bɛ yuri bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi.
en: in order to train the younger women to love their husbands and children.

dag: Amaa ka o yanim daa je o, ka tim tuumba nti yɛli ŋun daa yɛn leeg o nam maa ni bɛ je ni doo maa niŋ bɛ naa.
en: Now, his own people hated him, and so they sent messengers after him to say, We don't want this man to be our king.

dag: Yi pun mi bɛ ni daa fiɛb ti ka dihi ti vi Filipai shɛm pɔi ka ti daa naanyi ti ka yi sanna la yɛla, amaa ti Naawuni daa bahi ti ti suhukpeeni ka ti yihi lahibal suŋ waazu din yi o sanna la n-tin ya hal sɔguriba ni daa kul zooi la zaa yoli.
en: Before we came to you, people in Philippi abused us with insults and made us suffer. You know all about that. And then, when we came to you, many people there caused trouble for us. But our God gave us the courage we needed to tell you his Good News.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ni zal o shɛm maa n-nyaŋ Filistianim maa Gibiɔn hal ni Gɛza.
en: David followed Gods orders exactly, and they defeated the Philistine army from Gibeon all the way to Gezer.

dag: So yi bi saɣi li, yin di chɛliya ka yi baɣa be o ni.
en: But if he does not pay attention to this, pay no attention to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: Know then today and keep in mind that the LORD is the only God in heaven above or on earth below. There is no other.

dag: Yi bi bɔri ni yi saɣi ni dabisi biɛɣu dali mirina, amaa yi ni niŋdi shɛm lee chɛmi ka dindali maa mirina.
en: Doom to those who ignore the evil day and make violent rule draw near.

dag: n-chaŋ ti ʒe Yisa sani kumda, ka o nintam tɔɣiri luri Yisa naba zuɣu, ka o mal li paɣiri Yisa naba maa, ka mal o zabiri nyɛhiri li, ka bɔbindi li ka zaŋ tulaale maa ʒiɛri li.
en: She stood at Jesus feet, crying. Then she began to wash his feet with her tears. She dried his feet with her hair. She kissed his feet many times and rubbed them with the perfume.

dag: Alahichi daa pun bela dunia ŋɔ ni hal ka Naawuni ti naanyi zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa fukumsi zaligu ni daa na kani la, shɛli daa kani din ni wuhi ni alahichi tumbu chihira.
en: Sin was in the world before the Law of Moses. But God does not consider people guilty of sin if there is no law.

dag: n-yɛra, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: promising, I hereby give you the land of Canaan as your allotted inheritance.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dunia zaa ni yɛn mali suhupiɛlli saha shɛli ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, I will make you so desolate that the whole world will rejoice at your downfall.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka kum lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din tiri bindirigu.
en: The Lord sent famine to their country and took away all their food.

dag: Ka Dauda yuli daa du pam tiŋgbɔna maa ni zaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda yɛla gbaai zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: So David became famous in all the countries. The Lord made all nations afraid of him.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni mani n-zali ya zaligu ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛl la zani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you will learn why I am giving you this command. I am telling you these things so that my agreement with Levi will continue. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Tɔbbia ŋun be tɔbbitali tuma ni bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri bɛn pa tɔbbihi yɛla ni, dama o nia nyɛla ni o tum din tiɣi ŋun kpɛh o tɔbbitali tuma ni maa nini.
en: A soldier wants to please his commanding officer, so he does not spend any time on activities that are not a part of his duty.

dag: Baanabas mini Sool ni daa tum bɛ tuma naai, ka bɛ zaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu yi Jɛrusalɛm n-lan chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: Barnabas and Saul returned to Antioch from Jerusalem after completing their mission, bringing with them John, who was also known as Mark.

dag: Ka Harim bia Malikija mini Pahatimɔab bia Hashub daa mali me yaɣ shɛli mini Bɔrɔbɔro Shɛbu Duri Shee Pia la.
en: Malkijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath-Moab repaired the next section. They also repaired Oven Tower.

dag: Buɣim mini sakuɣa ni gulisigu ni sanʒiɛɣu din deer o noli, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord !.

dag: n-yaai li mahilaa ni ti zal o tooni, ka o zaɣisi li ŋubbu, ka yɛl o, Karimi sokam ka bɛ yi ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ zaa daa yi.
en: She took the pan and served Amnon, but he refused to eat. Everyone leave me, Amnon said. So everyone left him.

dag: Dama m mi yi tipawumli mini yi noli zaɣisibu yɛla. Yi yi pun nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ noli saha shɛli n ni na be n nyɛvili ni m-be yi sani ŋɔ, wula nti yɛn nyɛ li n kum nyaaŋa?.
en: because I know how rebellious and hardheaded you are. If you are this rebellious toward the LORD while Im still alive, its bound to get worse once Im dead!.

dag: O ni wurim pihi din du mini birini goma zaa;.
en: every high tower, and the walls of every fortress.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yɛl bɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Nazarɛt do so ŋun yuli booni Yisa, ka o daa nyɛ anab titali o tumtumsa min o yɛtɔɣa ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni mini salinim zaa san la yɛla.
en: He said to them, What things? They said to him, The things about Jesus of Nazareth. Because of his powerful deeds and words, he was recognized by God and all the people as a prophet.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: Only God is my rock and my salvation— my stronghold!—I wont be shaken anymore.

dag: n ni zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba nuu ni. Bɛ niŋgbuna ni ti leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: So I will give them to their enemies and to everyone who wants to kill them. Their bodies will become food for the birds of the air and for the wild animals of the earth.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wulimpuhili polo tintariga daa kpuɣi chaŋ. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini maa, ka tintarisi ŋɔ zaa daa gili niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The Jordan bordered it on the east side. This is the legacy of the Benjaminite clans according to its borders.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ ka ti niriba maa baŋ ni di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma n-sɔŋ bɛn simdi sɔŋbu, ka pa ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din ka nyɔri.
en: Our people must learn to use their lives for doing good and helping anyone who has a need. Then they will not have empty lives.

dag: Ka Midiannim daa nyaŋ Izraɛlnima; ka Izraɛlnim maa zo nti sɔɣi bɔɣa din daa be zoya zuɣu puuni mini tampima voya ni ni luɣ shɛŋa bɛ n-ni tooi sɔɣi zani tuhi tɔbu.
en: The Midianites were so cruel that many Israelites ran to the mountains and hid in caves.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Ka m mi lee nyɛla ŋuni ka n Duuma ma ti kani n sanna?.
en: Why do I have this honor, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?.

dag: Zakaria ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Zechariahs deeds are written in the official records of Israels kings.

dag: Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ nachimbil tɔbutuhiri biiŋa ni suhukpeendan la gba daa zaŋ o daŋ ni sapashinnim pisinaayi na.
en: and Zadok, a young man, a mighty warrior, and officers from his household.

dag: Teem a ni daa yɛli mani a dabili ŋɔ shɛm, ka m mali tahima di zuɣu la yɛla.
en: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.

dag: Ka o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu maa n-yɔhim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bahi yol la. Din chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn bahi yoli maa nyɛla bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ yu yɛlimaŋli ka tiligi la zuɣu.
en: The Man of Evil will use every kind of evil to fool those who are lost. They are lost because they refused to love the truth and be saved.

dag: Paɣa, ka pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba. Ka di pa ni n sabirila zaligu palli tir a, amaa di nyɛla ti ni daa pun deei shɛli piligu ni la.
en: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.

dag: Amaa m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni doo kam zuɣulana nyɛla Masia; ka paɣ zuɣulana nyɛ o yidana; ka Masia mi zuɣulana nyɛ Naawuni.
en: But I want you to understand that Christ is supreme over every man, the husband is supreme over his wife, and God is supreme over Christ.

dag: Chɛliya ma vuri ka n yɛli, ka chɛ ka din yɛn niŋ ma niŋ ma.
en: Be quiet and give me a chance to speak, and let the results be what they will.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, O be wula? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O mal alaafee; ka lan yɛli, O bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl n-taɣiri piɛri kanna ŋɔ.
en: Is he well? he asked. He is well, they answered. Look, here comes his daughter Rachel with his flock.

dag: Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Adiɛl bia la n-daa su nayili azichi fukumsi, ka Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Uzia bia la mi daa nyɛ ŋun su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ fɔntinsi ni tiŋkpansi du shɛŋa din du pam azichi fukumsi.
en: In charge of the kings treasuries—Azmaveth, Adiels son; in charge of the treasuries in the country, cities, villages, and towers—Jonathan, Uzziahs son.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binyar shɛŋa sɔŋ gbilligbilli maa polo.
en: When Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the piles.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o chɛ ka mahim maa lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia kaman Ahaz ni daa buɣisi wuntaŋ chandi yɛla zali shɛm la.
en: Isaiah prayed, and the Lord made the shadow go back ten steps on the stairway built for King Ahaz.

dag: Amaa Abimilɛk daa na bi zaŋ Zara dɔni, dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔhi, N Duuma, a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali?.
en: But Abimelech had not come near her, and he said, Lord, I am innocent! Would you destroy me and my people?.

dag: Di yi di nyɛ lala, dindina o naan kul dirila wahala tum dunia piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ; amaa din beni nyɛla, saha ni daa ti paai, o daa kana yim nti zaŋ omaŋa m-mali sara kpihim niriba daalahichi.
en: If that were so, then Jesus would have to suffer many times since the foundation of the world. Instead, he has now appeared once at the end of the ages to get rid of sin by sacrificing himself.

dag: Ko zurili nyaɣisa, ka nir ni sɔɣi di bindir shɛli nyaɣisa.
en: Stolen water is sweeter. Stolen bread tastes better.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa kuhi pam suhi Naawuni yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Hezekiah the king and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz prayed about this problem. They prayed very loudly to heaven.

dag: Rabishake daa labiya nti wum ni Asiria naa yi Lakishi n-chaŋla Libina ka o mini ba ti tuhiri taba.
en: The field commander heard that the Assyrian king had left Lachish. So he went back to the king and found him attacking Libnah.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, M bia Dauda, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. A ni ti tum tuma pam, ka di nasara di tumbu ni. Ka Dauda daa chaŋ o chandi, ka Sool mi ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Saul said to David, God bless you, my son! You will succeed in everything you do! So David went on his way, and Saul returned home.

dag: Ka naa daa bah o bia Jɛramiil mini Aziriɛl bia Sɛraya ni Abidiil bia Shɛlɛmia noli ni bɛ gbaam Baruk ŋun nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa mini anabi Jɛrimia na. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔɣi.
en: The king told his son Jerahmeel to take Seraiah and Shelemiah and to go arrest Baruch and me. But the Lord kept them from finding us.

dag: Ka so yi tah a ʒiishee nti deeg a binyɛrigu, nyin chɛ ka o deeg a chinchini gba pahi.
en: When they wish to haul you to court and take your shirt, let them have your coat too.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, N Duuma, m pala zilinvaliŋgalana, hal dahin shɛli ha bee a ni tɔɣisiri mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yomyom, ka n zilinli bi tooi lɛbigira.
en: Moses replied, I have never been a good speaker. I wasn't one before you spoke to me, and I'm not one now. I am slow at speaking, and I can never think of what to say.

dag: ni Holɔn ni Dɛbir.
en: Holon, Debir.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛri ŋun turi niriba taali paŋd o nyɛla ŋun bɔri zɔtali, amaa ŋunkam teeri zabili nyɛla ŋun saɣindi zɔtali.
en: Forgive someone, and you will strengthen your friendship. Keep reminding them, and you will destroy it.

dag: Ka yi ni ti be Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ zuliya la ni yuui, di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: Then you will live a long life in that country. The Lord promised to give that land to your ancestors and all their descendants. It is a land filled with many good things.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: But the LORD made Pharaoh stubborn so that he wouldnt let the Israelites go.

dag: Bihi maa ni daa ti zooi, Iso daa niŋla tɔha biiŋa ŋun daa kul be mɔɣu ni; ka Yaakubu mi be baalim m-be yiŋa.
en: The boys grew up. Esau became a skilled hunter, who loved to be out in the fields. But Jacob was a quiet man, who stayed at home.

dag: Nir ni tooi zaŋ buɣim buɣi ka di ku di o situra?.
en: Can you carry fire against your chest without burning your clothes?.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ gari ma pam! Yi bi mi doo maa ni yi shɛl na, amaa o neegi n nina.
en: The man answered, This is incredible! You dont know where he is from, yet he healed my eyes!.

dag: ka n ti labiri kuni yiŋ na, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti kul yi n yiŋa n-daŋ ma soli tuhibu na, dilana ni leei nyin Yawɛ dini, ka n zaŋ o mali sara n-nyo o buɣim ti a.
en: and come home safely, I will sacrifice to you whoever comes out to meet me first.

dag: Ka n kul ni be n niriba Izraɛlnim sani, ka ku bahi ba.
en: I will live among my people Israel in this Temple that you are building, and I will never abandon them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Sisɛra min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o tɔbbihi zaa birim Barak tooni, ka Barak daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ba. Ka Sisɛra daa sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu na guui.
en: And during the battle, the Lord confused Sisera, his chariot drivers, and his whole army. Everyone was so afraid of Barak and his army, that even Sisera jumped down from his chariot and tried to escape.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n lan yɛri ya, saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka kpiimba ni ti wum Naawuni Bia maa kukoli, ka bɛnkam ti wum li ni mali nyɛvili.
en: Believe me, an important time is coming. That time is already here. People who are dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen will live.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI poya o kasitali puuni yɛli, Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-vo n-chaŋ. Hal ziŋgɔhi ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ vo yi ni shɛb bɛn kpalim chaŋ.
en: The Lord GOD made a promise. He promised by his holiness that troubles will come to you. People will use hooks and take you away as prisoners. They will use fishhooks to take away your children.

dag: ka tulim maa daa kpe daadamnim pam hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni ŋun su alɔbo balibu kam maa fukumsi la, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba n-ti o jilima.
en: They were burned by the fierce heat, and they cursed the name of God, who has authority over these plagues. But they would not turn from their sins and praise his greatness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ nya n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntinsi ni shɛm. Lihimiya li, zuŋɔ di zaa leela dabari, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You saw how I destroyed Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. They lie empty and in ruins today.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so dabidoo bee dabipaɣa, di simdi ka nahu maa lan yo dabili maa lana anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita, ka chɛ ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o.
en: If the bull kills a male or female slave, its owner shall pay the owner of the slave thirty pieces of silver, and the bull shall be stoned to death.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa kɔŋ o ni yɛn yɛli Abinɛr shɛm, dama o daa zɔr o mi.
en: Ish Bosheth was too afraid of Abner to say anything in response.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, N yi ti nya wuntizɔriba pihita nimaani, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham said, Please don't be angry, Lord, but I must speak again. What if there are only thirty? He said, I will not do it if I find thirty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kpaŋsi Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la ni niriba maa zaa suhuri, ka bɛ yiɣisi n-gbaai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu.
en: Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel was the governor of Judah. Joshua son of Jehozadak was the high priest. The Lord made them and the rest of the people excited about working on the Temple of their God, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: The apostles returned and met with Jesus, and told him all they had done and taught.

dag: ka ʒi o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-labiri kuni ka karindi Anabi Aizaia litaafi.
en: He was reading the prophet Isaiah while sitting in his carriage.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni wuɣi tampiɛl viɛl shɛli niŋ a ŋariŋ tani, ka di nyɛ a tuuta. Ka a zuɣusaa bimparigu din nyɛ zaɣ sabinli mini zaɣ ʒee la yi Ɛlisha teeku duli na.
en: Fine embroidered linen from Egypt was your sail; it became your emblem. Your awning was made of blue and purple cloth from the coasts of Elishah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi zaa ni nti laɣim Lɛvinim mini Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba, ka bɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: They went throughout Judah recruiting the Levites from all the cities of Judah, as well as the family heads of Israel, who then came to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ bi zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bee n-zo n-yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ni bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, amaa ka nyin tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: If you do warn an evil man and he doesn't stop sinning, he will die, still a sinner, but your life will be spared.

dag: O ni daa ba n-chana, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni.
en: And as he rode along, the people spread clothes on the road in front of him.

dag: Ka piɛri maa zaa daa yi ti laɣim nimaani na, piɛguliba maa paarila kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu sɔŋ ka ŋɔŋ kom ti piɛri maa, ka lan labisi kuɣili maa pa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu.
en: When all of the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone from the wells opening, water the sheep, and return the stone to its place at the wells opening.

dag: Ka tin shɛli din miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba zaa ni paɣi bɛ nuhi bahi bɛ ni kabi naɣisa so nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni la zuɣu.
en: All the elders of the city closest to the corpse will wash their hands over the cow whose neck was broken in the river valley.

dag: N nya bɛ tuma, amaa n ni tib ba. N ni wuhi ba soli, ka sɔŋ ba, ka maai bɛn be fabila ni suhuri.
en: I have seen their ways, but I will heal them. I will guide them, and reward them with comfort. And for those who mourn.

dag: N dabili m-bɔŋɔ. N ni pii so ni n suhu ni yu so m-bala. N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni. O ni ti wuhi niriba zaligu soli.
en: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.

dag: ni Nɛbo ni Baalimiɔn ni Sibima; ka bɛ daa ti bɛ ni me tin shɛŋa maa yu pala.
en: Nebo, and Baal-meon , and Sibmah. They named the cities that they built.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana, ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka bɛ yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, That man has a demon in him.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chaŋ zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi maa ni, hal Musa mini Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la ni daa kul kpalim be bɛ sansani maa ni la zaa yoli.
en: Yet they recklessly ascended toward the top of the mountains, even though Moses and the LORDs chest containing the covenant didnt depart from the camp.

dag: Tim ka Giliad? Dɔɣite ka nimaani? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ bi nya alaafee?.
en: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?.

dag: Bɛ ni yino ni daa nya ka o kɔŋ maa naai maa ka o ŋmaligi labiri ka duhir o yee paɣiri Naawuni m-mal.
en: When one of them saw that he was healed, he came back, praising God in a loud voice.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni pala din tar o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri.
en: It is not what people put in their mouth that makes them wrong. It is what comes out of their mouth that makes them wrong.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa wum lala maa ka o zo n-chaŋ Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Nimaani ka o daa be hal nti dɔɣi bidibis ayi.
en: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he lived as an immigrant and had two sons.

dag: N nyee nyɔni n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam zaa dunia ŋɔ ni, dama m mi ni n yɛn chɛ li zalila na shɛb bɛn yɛn doli n nyaaŋa.
en: I began to hate all the hard work I had done, because I saw that the people who live after me would get the things that I worked for. I will not be able to take them with me.

dag: ka o yɛli ma, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu, nyin chɛ ka ŋuna n-nyɛ nyin Yawɛ ni bɔri ni so leei n-dan bia paɣa maa.
en: and she responds to me, Drink, and I will draw water for your camels too, may she be the woman the LORD has selected for my masters son.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa chaŋ na sɔasɔa ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni dindali maa kaman tɔbbi shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi guui tɔbu ni n-kuli ti kpɛri bɛ ya ni vi la.
en: The people came into the city quietly as if they were the ones who had been defeated in battle.

dag: Ti mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti, ti neei shɛlikam wuhi ya; ti yooi ti suhuri tin ya.
en: Dear friends in Corinth! We have spoken frankly to you; we have opened our hearts wide.

dag: Ka o gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni, ka takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi yir o nol ni na, ka o ninni ne kaman wuntaŋ ni yi neei ni o kpiɔŋ zaa shɛm la.
en: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came out of his mouth. His face was as bright as the midday sun.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya bee kuriti tum tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ piligim tuma maa, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam tuma din pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of what King Rehoboam did is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: dama ti bidibbina pala dunia ŋɔ bidibbina, amaa di nyɛla din mali Naawuni yiko di ni, ka daari tinsi goon kara luhira.
en: Our weapons that we fight with arent human, but instead they are powered by God for the destruction of fortresses. They destroy arguments.

dag: Daadamnim mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ni tooi be kasi? Bee bɛn nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi shɛb ŋɔ, wula ka bɛ yɛn tooi niŋ nyɛ wuntizɔriba?.
en: What are humans that they might be pure, and those born of woman that they might be innocent?.

dag: Adam n-daa nyɛ Shɛt ba, ka Shɛt nyɛ Ɛnɔsh ba.
en: Adam was the father of Seth, Seth was the father of Enosh, Enosh the father of Kenan.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣisi zaɣ chɛhi din guui m-pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: They all ate and had enough, and the disciples took up twelve baskets of what was left over.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni nya suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli maa paai ma la n sɔŋsim zuɣu. A tiligi n nyɛvili barina kam ni; ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: My bitterness will turn into peace. You save my life from all danger; You forgive all my sins.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb yi daa bi ʒe yim, di wuhiri ni Naawuni mi bi ʒe yim?.
en: But what if some of them were not faithful? Does this mean that God will not be faithful?.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Naawuni zali Vuhim Dabisili dali tila ninsalinima, amaa o bi nam ninsalinim ti Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: And Jesus concluded, The Sabbath was made for the good of human beings; they were not made for the Sabbath.

dag: Bee m mini Baanabas kɔŋko n-ka soli ni ti chɛ ti nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma tum dihi timaŋa?.
en: Or are Barnabas and I the only ones who have to work for our living?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ʒe Jɛhɔshafat nyaaŋa, dama o daa kul bemi kaman o ba ni daa tuui di nam ka be shɛm la, o daa bi jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: The Lord blessed Jehoshaphat because he followed the example of his father's early life and did not worship Baal.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa kpɛhi Juda zuliya niriba maa dabiɛm, ka gbarigi ba zaŋ chaŋ mɛbu maa polo.
en: The neighboring peoples discouraged the people of Judah, made them afraid to build.

dag: Alichɛbba maa nyiŋgoli daa ŋmanila kurugu gbaɣino nyiŋgoli, ka bɛ niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was reinforced with a strong border so that it didnt tear.

dag: ti kuli do so.
en: When she has left his house, she may go and become another mans wife.

dag: Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ leei Juda naa n-zali Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin zaani.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had removed Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim from being the king of Judah and had made Josiah's son Zedekiah king instead.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ wain tihi, ka chɛ ka maligim din leeri sakuɣa luna saɣim bɛ fiig tihi wala zaa.
en: He killed their grapevines with hail and their fig trees with frost.

dag: ni Makinadɛbai ni Shashai ni Sharai.
en: Macnadebai, Shashai, Sharai.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma maa yɛl o, Niŋm a suhu ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, dama m be a sani, ka a suhu ni kul be shɛm, lala ka n gba suhu be.
en: The young man who carried Jonathans weapons said to him, Do what you think is best. Whatever you decide, I am with you all the way.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Jɛriko, ka bɛ mini salo pam daa ti yiri Jɛriko maa, ka Timius bia Baatimius ŋun daa nyɛ zoma, ka nyɛ barimaana ʒi sokpaŋa.
en: Jesus and his followers came into Jericho. As Jesus was leaving Jericho, together with his disciples and a sizable crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus, Timaeus son, was sitting beside the road.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka biŋkɔbigu la mini dunia nanima ni bɛ tɔbbihi laɣim lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ŋun ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa min o tɔbbihi.
en: Then I saw that the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies had gathered to make war against the rider on the horse and his army.

dag: Dama nir yi bɔri ni o yuli yi palo, o ku tumd o tuma ashilɔni. A yi tumdi tuma ŋɔ tatabo, nyin yihim amaŋ palɔni ka sokam baŋ a.
en: People don't hide what they are doing if they want to be well known. Since you are doing these things, let the whole world know about you! .

dag: Yinim bɛn bari bun piɛla ka ʒi bunnyaampar gahinda zuɣu mini yinim bɛn doli soya, yɛlimiya di yɛla.
en: You who ride white donkeys, who sit on saddle blankets, who walk along the road: tell of it.

dag: M min a n-simdi lala, dama tinim tuma nyɔri ka ti diri ŋɔ; amaa ŋun bi tum taal shɛli.
en: We are rightly condemned, for we are receiving the appropriate sentence for what we did. But this man has done nothing wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Tama, A yidan ba chanila Timna ni o ti chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: Tamar was told, Your father-in-law is now on his way up to Timnah to shear his sheep.

dag: amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna ka di karitiya ba, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: But Jesus said, Let the children come to me, and don't try to stop them! People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: But they grabbed the servant, beat him, and sent him away empty-handed.

dag: Ka Juda daa ti nya Keenan do so ŋun yuli daa booni Shua la bipuɣiŋga n-kpuɣ o; ka daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: While there he met the daughter of Shua, a Canaanite man. Judah married her.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii bɛ buɣili Baalibɛriti duu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisopɔin ti o. Ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ liɣiri maa ti da ninvuɣ galima mini ninkuunsinima n-zaŋ ba pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: So the leaders of Shechem gave Abimelech pieces of silver. That silver was from the temple of the god Baal Berith. Abimelech used the silver to hire some men. These men were worthless, reckless men. They followed Abimelech wherever he went.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli ya zuŋɔ, amaa yi bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tim ma na ni n ti yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa maa ni shɛli.
en: Today I have told you, but you still havent obeyed all that the LORD your God has sent me to tell you.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa yi Taiatira na n-nyɛ ago chinchin kɔha, ka o yuli booni Lidia, ka o daa nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni la daa be nimaani. Ka ti Duuma daa yoog o suhu ka o niŋ Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm yɛda.
en: One of those women was Lydia, a Gentile God-worshipper from the city of Thyatira, a dealer in purple cloth. As she listened, the Lord enabled her to embrace Pauls message.

dag: Ka zoya ni saa buri ba, ka bɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn kpe shɛli yi saa bubu ni, ka baɣila tampima.
en: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Samsin, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo a mihi n-zaŋ a ti ti Filistianim maa. Ka Samsin yɛli ba, Pomiya ni yimaŋmaŋ ku ku ma.
en: Then they said to Samson, We have come to tie you up. We will give you to the Philistines. Samson said to the men from Judah, Promise me that you yourselves will not hurt me.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ daanya mali wahu maa n-zaŋ li tabili da wɔɣinli zuɣusaa; ka wahu daa yi dim so, ka o lihi li, o tiligirimi.
en: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it on a pole. Then when a snake bit anyone, that person looked at the bronze snake on the pole and lived.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili shee dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ su kom.
en: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of my presence, and have them take a ritual bath.

dag: ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya, ka yi paɣiba kpalim pakoya, ka yi bihi gba leei kpibisi.
en: and I will become angry and kill you in war. Your wives will become widows, and your children will be fatherless.

dag: Di saha maa ka Daadam Bia shihirili ni ti be zuɣusaa, ka zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti fabili, ka nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky; and all the peoples of earth will weep as they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

dag: Bɛ mi di yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim so, ka di ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni, amaa ka lee be baalim, ka mali sizuura lubu biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani.
en: Tell them not to speak evil of anyone, but to be peaceful and friendly, and always to show a gentle attitude toward everyone.

dag: ka o niŋgbuna ni ti do tiŋa Jɛziriil tintariga kaman saɣiri la; ka so ti ku tooi yɛli, Jɛzibɛl m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.

dag: Hal ŋun pun beni maa yi yuui m-paai yuun tusaayi gba, amaa ka bi di binshɛli nyaɣisim, pa luɣ yini ka bɛ zaa kuna?.
en: more so than the man who never enjoys life, though he may live two thousand years. After all, both of them are going to the same place.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wun so ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni ŋ-ŋman a; a dol a ni lo alikauli shɛli ka mali yurilim din bi naari zaŋ chaŋ a daba zaa sani.
en: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka puu maa lan yɛl o nachin kpɛma, Cham ti boli tumtumdiba maa na ti yo ba. Daŋmi bɛn yoli kana la yɔbu pɔi, ka naanyi yo bɛn di daŋna la.
en: At the end of the day, the owner of the field said to the boss of all the workers, Call the workers and pay them all. Start by paying the last people I hired. Then pay all of them, ending with the ones I hired first.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yuri so, dilan zuɣu ni ka o kpahira kaman doo ni kpahir o ni yur o bidib so zuɣu ni shɛm la.
en: The LORD loves those he corrects, just like a father who treats his son with favor.

dag: N kahig a yuli wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb a ni zaŋ ti ma dunia ŋɔ ni la; nyini n-su ba ka daa zaŋ ba ti ma, ka bɛ mi deeg a yɛligu.
en: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.

dag: Yinima n-kpuɣi n daanzinfa mini n salima; ka ʒi n daazichi nɛma nti niŋ yi wuna jɛmbu duri ni.
en: You took my silver and gold. You took my precious treasures and put them in your temples.

dag: Di saha ka niriba daa bɔhi ma, A ku yɛli ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then the people said to me, Why are you doing this? What does it mean.

dag: Amaa Sɔŋda so n ni yɛn tim ka o yi m Ba sani n-ka yi sanna la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni be so ni. O yi ti kana, o ni leei n shɛhiralana.
en: The Helper will come—the Spirit, who reveals the truth about God and who comes from the Father. I will send him to you from the Father, and he will speak about me.

dag: Judanim ni ti niŋ ayɛi, niriba maa ni daa bi tooi sɔŋ ba la zuɣu. Bɛ ni chɛ ka Judanim maa di vi.
en: But Egypt can't protect you, and to trust that nation is useless and foolish.

dag: yɛra, Ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋun be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, ti paɣir a a ni deeg a yiko din galisi n-diri nam zuɣu.
en: They said, Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.

dag: ŋun woligim omaŋ ka chɛ wain mini binnyuri kpɛma, ka di nyu bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi komihigu mali shɛli bee binnyuri kpeen shɛli, o mi di nyu wain tiwala kom bee n-di di zaɣ maha bee di zaɣ kuma.
en: They must stay away from wine or other strong drink. They must not drink vinegar that is made from wine or from other strong drink. They must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.
