dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni maa zaa biɛlabiɛla; yi ku tooi kari ba naai yomyom, di yi niŋ lala mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni ti galisi nyaŋ ya.
en: Little by little he will drive out these nations as you advance. You will not be able to destroy them all at once, for, if you did, the number of wild animals would increase and be a threat to you.

dag: N ku kpi, amaa n ni be, ka moli Yawɛ tuma yɛla.
en: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.

dag: O ni ti tibigi ma, dama n yɛla ka o ti yɛn zaŋ wuhi ya.
en: He will glorify me, because he will take what is mine and proclaim it to you.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm soya ni yiko din tuhiri tɔbu? Ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka mɔri ma maa?.
en: I tell you, if you are trusting in power and great battle plans, that is useless. Those are nothing but empty words. Now I ask you, who do you trust so much that you are willing to rebel against me?.

dag: Pool mini niriba anahi maa ni daa mali bɛmaŋa ka di ti miri daba ayopɔin paabu saha shɛli ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na nya Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-gbaag o n-chɛ ka niriba suhuri yiɣisi bahi o zuɣu.
en: When the period of seven days for the ceremony was almost over, some of the Jewish people from Asia saw Paul in the temple. They got a large crowd together and started attacking him.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi bɛ daalaafee yɛla; ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi ba do kur so yɛla yi ni daa yɛli ma la na be o nyɛvil ni? O mal alaafee.
en: Joseph asked them how they were doing. Then he said, How is your elderly father you told me about? Is he still alive.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma alahiziba pam. Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: Her parents were astounded, but Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone what had happened.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: He put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and gave them orders to fight the Ammonites.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Doɛg, Nyin lum maligumaaniba maa zuɣu n-ku ba. Ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nir maa daa lu maligumaaniba maa zuɣu. Dindali maa o daa kula bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn so tan piɛla din be kaman mukuriti la ninvuɣ pihiniinaanu.
en: So Saul said to Doeg, You kill them!—and Doeg killed them all. On that day he killed eighty-five priests who were qualified to carry the ephod.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ sariakarita, yiɣisima. Tim karimbaannim din simdi ba!.
en: You are the judge of the whole earth. Give proud people the punishment they deserve.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa lala zuɣu ka n daŋna nti baptaiziri niriba kom ni ni o ti yi palo ka Izraɛlnim baŋ o.
en: Even I didnt recognize him, but I came baptizing with water so that he might be made known to Israel.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chaŋ alizanda ni nti be Naawuni nudirigu polo n-su malaikanim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni bɛn nyɛ yikolaannim la.
en: who is at Gods right side. Now that he has gone into heaven, he rules over all angels, authorities, and powers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ laɣim o tɔbbihi min o kuriti chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisiwɛi la zaa na, ka bɛ daa yi Harɔshɛtihagɔim n-chaŋ Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni.
en: Sisera summoned all of his nine hundred iron chariots and all of the soldiers who were with him from Harosheth-ha-goiim to the Kishon River.

dag: Yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn lɔŋdi nanviɣu, amaa ka lee vaani laakum.
en: You blind guides! You filter out an ant but swallow a camel.

dag: So ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaag o bee n-zaŋ tɔŋ nyini kuh o nyee?.
en: Can he be seized by his eyes? Can anyone pierce his nose by hooks?.

dag: Dama n yɛn lumi maa, ka be biɛrim pam ni sahakam.
en: I am about to fall and am in constant pain.

dag: Neemiya yi nina lihi gili nya, bɛ zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni shiri be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa ye kaman amiliya ni yɛri o salima yɛri shɛm la.
en: Look around and see what is happening! Your people are assembling—they are coming home! As surely as I am the living God, you will be proud of your people, as proud as a bride is of her jewels.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisiya, di nyɛla sanʒiɛ biɛɣu din ʒiɛri gariti ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣuri zuɣu.
en: Look! The LORDs anger breaks out like a violent storm, a fierce wind that strikes the heads of the wicked.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nanim mini tarimba zaa daa kul kpalim lihirila ŋuna ka yɛra, Yiko shɛli ti ni booni Naawuni yiko tital la be doo ŋɔ ni.
en: and everyone in the city, from all classes of society, paid close attention to him. He is that power of God known as The Great Power, they said.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa zo a tiŋgbɔŋ la nambɔɣu; ka daa chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya lan tɔŋ yaha.
en: Lord , you have been merciful to your land; you have made Israel prosperous again.

dag: Jɛra n-zaŋdi bɛ nuhi taɣindi tab ʒiya, ka chɛ ka kum kuri ba.
en: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.

dag: O daa diya ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ata. O ma daa nyɛla Absalom bia, ka o yuli booni Maaka.
en: Abijah ruled in Jerusalem for three years. His mothers name was Maacah. She was Absaloms daughter.

dag: Ka o daa ti miriti Jɛrusalɛm n-siɣiri Olivi Tihi zolɔŋni ha, ka salo bɛn nyɛ o nyaandoliba suhuri paligi pam, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛri pampam m-paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa nya alahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: As Jesus approached the road leading down from the Mount of Olives, the whole throng of his disciples began rejoicing. They praised God with a loud voice because of all the mighty things they had seen.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba garigi yɛli.
en: Job said:.

dag: dama Yawɛ zabiri bɛ zuɣu, ka ni ku bɛnkam bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhiya bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni tiligi ba; ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, amaa ka o bi garigi ba.
en: They cried out for help, but there was no one to save them. They cried out to the Lord , but he did not answer them.

dag: Dama nir yi nya o dindana ŋ-ŋɔ, o ni chɛ o ni alaafee? Dinzuɣu a ni niŋ ma shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, Yawɛ ni yo a sam viɛlli.
en: This shows that you are not my enemy. A man doesnt catch his enemy, and then just let him go. He doesnt do good things for his enemy. May the Lord reward you for being good to me today.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, zuliya kam ni ti nya a nasara dibu, ka nanim zaa ti nya a jilima. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ yu palli shɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti a la bol a.
en: Jerusalem, the nations will see you victorious! All their kings will see your glory. You will be called by a new name, A name given by the Lord himself.

dag: O palo yibu maa mi ni ti niŋla di saha dɛde kaman Naawuni ni zal li shɛm. Ŋun Naawuni kɔŋko n-nyɛ alibarika Natitamlana mini nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: God will make that happen at the right time. God is the blessed and only Ruler. He is the King of all kings and the Lord of all lords.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya ni kpamba.
en: Simeon had six sons: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman; they were the ancestors of the clans that bear their names.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi chana.
en: One Sabbath Jesus and his disciples were walking through some wheat fields. His disciples were picking grains of wheat as they went along.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa kpariti yi dunoya nyɛla kuriti mini daanya. Yi dabisa ni yɛn be shɛm, lala ka yi yaa yɛn be.
en: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni bɛ yi ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, bɛn kpalimmi zani di kom maa ni baalim.
en: Tell the priests carrying the Covenant Box that when they reach the river, they must wade in and stand near the bank.

dag: Ka gɔhi mini tutu shɛŋa din mali gɔhi ni bili tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; ka a ni diri tiŋgban ni tihi wala.
en: Weeds and thistles will grow for you, even as you eat the fields plants.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ di ma shɛhira ni n daa yɛliya ni pa mani n-nyɛ Masia maa, amaa Naawuni n-tim ma ni n daŋ o tooni na.
en: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o daa zaŋ buɣim lu Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu; ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord heard what they said and became angry with Jacobs people. He was angry with Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Pita mini Jɔn bɔhi ba, Naawuni sani, di luhiya ni ti wumla yi noli bee ŋun Naawuni dini? Yɛlimiya ti!.
en: Peter and John answered, Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ kpaluhi alahiziba, ka bɛnkam zaa tumdi tuma deeri yɔri ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa kpila yɛda niŋbu puuni ka na bi nya Naawuni ni daa lo ba binshɛŋa alikauli maa, amaa ka daa lee lihi nya li katiŋ ha, ka dee li ni suhupiɛlli, ka saɣi ni bɛ nyɛla saamba ni tinzunnima dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: It was in faith that all these persons died. They did not receive the things God had promised, but from a long way off they saw them and welcomed them, and admitted openly that they were foreigners and refugees on earth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yi tiŋ maa ni n-chaŋ biɛla ha saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, Yiɣisim kari niriba maa naba, a yi ti paai ba, nyin bɔhim ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zu n daanzinfa pipia?.
en: After they had left the city, Joseph said to his servant, Go and follow the men. Stop them and say to them, We were good to you! So why have you been bad to us? Why did you steal my masters silver cup?.

dag: Ka a zaligu ŋɔ yi moli gili a sulinsi tiŋgbɔn titali ŋɔ zaa ni, di ni chɛ ka paɣ kam lu o yidan sizuura, o yidana yi nyɛla wɔɣirili bee tarima.
en: When your proclamation is made known all over this huge empire, every woman will treat her husband with proper respect, whether he's rich or poor.

dag: Ka naa min o niriba daa lo tɔb chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛbusinim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋ maa tiŋbihi ka yɛli Dauda, A kul ku kpɛna, hal zoomba mini gbariti ni gu a soli kar a labisi. Bɛ daa tɛhiya ni Dauda ku tooi kpe nimaani na.
en: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and David led his army there to attack them. The Jebusites did not think he could get in, so they told him, You can't get in here! We could keep you out, even if we couldn't see or walk.

dag: bee so yi gbib kuɣili din ni tooi ku nira, ka di faai lu o kpee zuɣu ku o, ka di mi pala o dima n-nyɛ o, ka o mi di bi pun lo ni o ti o daŋa.
en: Perhaps you threw a rock that was large enough to kill, but it hit someone you didnt see and killed them. You didnt plan to kill anyone. You didnt hate the person you killed—it was only an accident.

dag: Ka Judanim daa laɣim ni bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka o sɔŋ ba. Bɛ daa yila Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni n-laɣimna ni bɛ ti niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ.
en: They immediately left for Jerusalem to ask for the Lord 's help.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nanim mini tarimba zaa daa kul kpalim lihirila ŋuna ka yɛra, Yiko shɛli ti ni booni Naawuni yiko tital la be doo ŋɔ ni.
en: All the people—the least important and the most important—believed what he said. They said, This man has the power of God that is called the Great Power.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya azichi mini mɔ viɛla. Ka tiŋgbani maa lan galisi ka vuri kani ka suhudoo beni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be nimaani daa nyɛla Hamnima.
en: They found fertile pasture, and the land was spacious, quiet, and peaceful; the people of Ham used to live there.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: He said to them, Go to the town you can see there. When you enter it, you will find a young donkey that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here to me.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ya dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa sunsuuni n-zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: because you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God chose you to be his own treasured people beyond all others on the fertile land.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, cham ti nya guliŋguhi biɛhigu, ka niŋ yɛm.
en: Lazy people should learn a lesson from the way ants live.

dag: Ŋuni n-na mi n-zaŋ o nuu tooi teeku kom m-buɣisi di ni nyɛ shɛm bee n-zaŋ o nutali buɣisi sagbana yɛliŋ, bee n-va tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu niŋ bini puuni, bee n-zaŋ zoya mini kuŋkuna pa sania zuɣu buɣisi li?.
en: Who measured the oceans in the palm of his hand? Who used his hand to measure the sky? Who used a bowl to measure all the dust of the earth? Who used scales to measure the mountains and hills?.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔbil nin shɛli ni ti puhigi, ka Dauda daŋ ni niriba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaŋ di kom su n-yi alahichi mini buɣijɛmbo daɣiri ni.
en: But at that time a new spring of water will be opened for Davids family and for the other people living in Jerusalem. That fountain will be to wash away their sins and to make the people pure.

dag: Ka Sool daa wum Jɔnatan ni yɛl o shɛm maa zaa, ka po pɔri yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku lan ku o.
en: Saul agreed and promised, I swear by the living Lord that I won't have David killed.

dag: ni wuntaŋ ni kpɛri tiwal viɛl shɛŋa, ka di wandi pam di goya ni.
en: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.

dag: Nir yi di n-tiɣi, o baɣa ka shiri ni, amaa kum yi mali nira, hal binshɛli din to gba nyaɣisimi.
en: When you are full, you will not even eat honey. When you are hungry, even something bitter tastes sweet.

dag: M mabihi, di maliya yɛtɔɣ bihibihi ni yi taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti kari ya saria. Nyamiya, sariakarita maa ʒiɛla dunoli ni.
en: Dont complain about each other, brothers and sisters, so that you wont be judged. Look! The judge is standing at the door!.

dag: N ni daa lo o alikauli shɛli daa nyɛla nyɛvili mini alaafee alikauli din nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti o ka di wuhiri jilima tibu, ka o daa tiri ma jilima ka luri n yuli sizuura la.
en: The Lord said, I made that agreement with Levi. I promised to give him life and peace—and I gave him those things. Levi respected me and showed honor to my name.

dag: N niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ leela zaɣ sabinli ŋ-ŋmaari lura, ka tulim diri n kɔba.
en: My skin is charred; my bones are scorched by the heat.

dag: Wula ka bipala lee yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ soya be kasi? A yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka bɛ ni doli n-chɛ ka di be kasi.
en: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.

dag: Yi yi chaŋ, yi ni nya ka niriba maa nyɛla bɛn ka zilisigu. Di nyɛla tiŋgban titali, ka nir ni bɔri binshɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni be di ni; yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni mi zaŋ li tin ya.
en: When you arrive, youll come upon a secure people and a wide-open land, because God has given to you a place where nothing on earth is lacking.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Are you finally through with your windy speech?.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pinaanahi ni kɔbisiyopɔin ka naanyi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Kɔra duŋ taabu ni la.
en: Those who died from the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died because of Korah.

dag: Ka Anduru daa dii chaŋ ti bo n-nya o mabia Saimɔn n-yɛl o, Ti nya Masia la.
en: At once he found his brother Simon and told him, We have found the Messiah.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa kul o yiŋa ni sujee nti fo n-ʒiya, Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zuɣu. Dama o daa yɛl o mi, N ku zaŋ n yaannim fali bini ti a. Ka Naa Ɛhab dɔni o bindoo zuɣu ŋ-ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: So Ahab went to his palace, irritated and upset at what Naboth had said to him—because Naboth had said, I wont give you my family inheritance! Ahab lay down on his bed and turned his face away. He wouldnt eat anything.

dag: Bɛ ŋme Ifriimnima, ka bɛ nyaɣa zaa kuui, bɛ ku lan dɔɣi bihi. Hal bɛ yi kul dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ biyurisi zaa.
en: Ephraim is sick, their root is dried up, they will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, I will put to death their much-loved little ones.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka n niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: In this way Aaron and his sons will use my name to give a blessing to the Israelites, and I will bless them.

dag: Ŋunkam kpɛri kuɣa ni nya daŋ di ni, ka ŋunkam mi wɔriti dari ni be di daŋ nyabu barina ni.
en: Whoever quarries stones may be injured by them; whoever splits logs may be endangered by them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yina n-na kul yɛla kpar ʒiɛɣu la, ka pili gɔhi zuɣupiligu maa. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya doo maa.
en: When Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, Heres the man.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti shihi kum din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpe daɣiri ni, amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ ba bee bɛ ma bee bɛ bidibiga bee bɛ bipuɣiŋga bee bɛ mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee bɛ tizɔpaɣa ŋun bi kuli doo, bɛ ni tooi kpe daɣiri ni.
en: In order to avoid uncleanness, they must not approach the dead. They may, however, become unclean for their father or mother, son or daughter, brother or unmarried sister.

dag: Yi ni ti sa wain tihi ka mali di ni, amaa yi ti ku pɔhi di wala bee n-nyu di wain, dama zunzuya ni ti ŋubi di zaa.
en: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya bi biɛ yoli ŋɔ ti bahi kpaŋ ha, zibisim ni be shɛl la. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: Then the master said, Throw that useless servant outside into the darkness, where people will cry and grind their teeth with pain.

dag: Amaa n ti ku yihi n suhu o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n suhu Sool ŋun daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: But I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba, ka di pala Yɛhudianim kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba.
en: For we are the people he called, not only from among the Jews but also from among the Gentiles.

dag: M puhiri Traifɛna mini Traifɔsa bɛn nyɛ ti Duuma tumtumdiba la. M puhiri Pɛrisis n ni yuri so ka o nyɛ ŋun tum tuma pam ti Duuma ni la.
en: and to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, women who work very hard for the Lord. Greetings to my dear friend Persis. She has also worked very hard for the Lord.

dag: Ka o daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, du shɛli yɛla Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la.
en: He built altars to honor false gods in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Sokam ni tooi bir o bimbira ni suhudoo. Tihi din wandi wala ni wali, ka tiŋgban ni bindira niŋ, ka saa gba mi pam. N ni chɛ ka n ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ di binyara ŋɔ zaa daanfaani.
en: These people will plant in peace. Their grapevines will produce grapes. The land will give good crops, and the skies will give rain. I will give all these things to my people.

dag: Ka yi ni ti no ninvuɣ biɛri maa sɔŋ tiŋa, dama bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tampiligim n-do yi naba ni dahin shɛli n yi ti tum n tuma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you will walk on the evil people—they will be like ashes under your feet. I will make this happen at the time of judgment. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Daadam, wula ka tuŋ din be tibɔŋ ni wulli lee yɛn tooi gari tia wulli tibɔŋ maa ni?.
en: Mortal man, he said, how does a vine compare with a tree? What good is a branch of a grapevine compared with the trees of the forest?.

dag: Jɔn daa di shɛhira n-lan yɛli, N nya Naawuni Shia Kasi ka o yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: John testified, I saw the Spirit coming down from heaven like a dove, and it rested on him.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo nambɔɣu, di ni ti nyɛla nyɛvil la nyɛvili, nin la nini, nyin la nyini, nuu la nuu, napɔŋ la napɔŋ.
en: In such cases show no mercy; the punishment is to be a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, and a foot for a foot.

dag: Ka a saha yi ti paai ni a pah a yaannim zuɣu, n ni piig amaŋmaŋ zuliya ni so ŋun nyɛ amaŋmaŋ bidɔɣiro ka o leei naa.
en: When you die, and you join your ancestors, then I will let your own son be the new king. The new king will be one of your sons, and I will make his kingdom strong.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o suhupiɛlli min o churi puhibu ni o goli paliga churi puhibu ni o vuhim dabisa ni o ni zali chu shɛŋa zaa la zani tariga.
en: I will put an end to all her festivities—her annual and monthly festivals and her Sabbath celebrations—all her religious meetings.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla anzinfa viɛlli yi Speen na, ka zaŋ salima yi Ufaz na. Di nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba mini salindooriba nuhi tuma. Di situra nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa mini zaɣ ʒiɛhi. Di zaa nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba ni mali binshɛŋa.
en: Covered with silver from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz, they are the work of a craftsman and the hands of a goldsmith. Clothed in blue and purple, all of them nothing more than the work of artisans.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia mini niriba maa zaa suhuri daa paligi Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛli ti niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa tum tuma maa naai yomyom pam.
en: King Hezekiah and the people were happy, because God had helped them to do all this so quickly.

dag: Yi lan pihiri nimaani nyolinsi n-leeri buɣa jɛmdi li; ka boori binyɛra mini zimbuli bahiri di zuɣu. Yi tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ni chɛ ka n suhu piɛla?.
en: You love to worship the smooth rocks in the rivers. You pour wine on them to worship them. You give sacrifices to them, but those rocks are all you get. Do you think this makes me happy?.

dag: ni Maarat ni Bɛtanɔt ni Ɛlitɛkɔn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara ayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Maarath, Beth-anoth, and Eltekon. In total: six cities and their surrounding areas. Tekoah, Ephrathah , Peor, Etam, Koulon, Tatam, Sores, Karem, Gallim, Bether, and Manahath. In total: eleven cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyɛla Masia tuumba bɛn ʒe o zaani, ka Naawuni be ti ni n-kul booni niriba. Lala zuɣu ka ti kul ʒe Masia zaani n-suhiri ya yɛra, Zaŋmiya yimaŋa n-naai Naawuni.
en: So we are ambassadors who represent Christ. God is negotiating with you through us. We beg you as Christs representatives, Be reconciled to God.

dag: Ka Balak daa zaŋ Balaam ti du n-tam Pɛɔr Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli nir ni ni tooi zani ka lihi nya bɔpiɛligu maa ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So Balak led Balaam to the top of Mount Peor, which looks out over the desert.

dag: Miri ka a vili tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba mini faranim yɔri gbibi. Bɛ yi nyɛla a Izraɛl taba bee bɛ yi nyɛla saamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi tinsi maa tin shɛl ni.
en: You must not cheat a hired servant who is poor and needy. It does not matter if he is an Israelite or if he is a foreigner living in one of your cities.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ka so mi ku tooi yiɣisi li. O pun teeg o nuu, ka so mi ku tooi pɔri li.
en: When the Lord All-Powerful makes a plan, no one can change it. When he raises his arm to punish, no one can stop him.

dag: Ka Miriam ŋun daa nyɛ anabi ka nyɛ Aduna tizɔpaɣ la daa zaŋ guŋgombil din mali chaɣisa, ka paɣiba zaa daa zaŋ guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa n-yi nti pah o zuɣu wari waa.
en: The prophet Miriam, Aaron's sister, took her tambourine, and all the women followed her, playing tambourines and dancing.

dag: Dama Naawunitali biɛhigu zaa be Masia daadamtali niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: God lives fully in Christ.

dag: ka yɛli nachimba maa, Chamiya n tooni ka n doli yi nyaaŋa na. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o yidan Nabal.
en: and told her servants, Take this on ahead, and I'll catch up with you. She didn't tell her husband Nabal what she was doing.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm! Bɛ ku Jɔnatan sɔŋ zoya zuɣu!.
en: The brave soldiers have fallen, they were killed in battle. Jonathan lies dead in the hills.

dag: Pɛdaya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrubabɛl mini Shimɛi. Zɛrubabɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam mini Hanania, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Shɛlomit.
en: Pedaiahs family: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabels family: Meshullam, Hananiah, and their sister Shelomith.

dag: Dama man bi yu ni yi so kpi. Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord God, don't want to see that happen to anyone. So stop sinning and live!.

dag: Yaakubu mini ba ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri saha shɛli maa, ka Reechɛl taɣ o ba piɛri paa na; dama ŋuna n-daa guli ba.
en: While Jacob was still talking with the men, his cousin Rachel came up with her father's sheep.

dag: Dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, molimiy o tiliginsim molo dabisili kam.
en: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord . Day after day announce, The Lord has saved us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ saguya ŋɔ, baŋmiya, jɛra ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn niŋ yɛm?.
en: My people, how can you be such stupid fools? When will you ever learn?.

dag: N tuhi tuhiri suŋ; n zo tizɔbo la naai; n gbib yɛda niŋbu la.
en: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.

dag: Bɛ ni ti chɛ bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn kpi sɔŋ palo ni, ka zoya zuɣu noonsi mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri di ba, ka ŋub ba. Noonsi ni ti di ba shɛɣu ni, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mi ŋub ba kikaa saha.
en: The corpses of their soldiers will be left exposed to the birds and the wild animals. In summer the birds will feed on them, and in winter, the animals.

dag: Ka Pool daa mihigi gariŋga maa bahi buɣim maa ni, ka bi wum biɛrim damli.
en: But Paul shook the snake off into the fire and was not hurt.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa deei paɣ maa ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na maa ka yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋ ni suhudoo, nyama, n wum a yɛligu maa, ka ni niŋ a ni fabili niŋ ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then David accepted Abigails gifts. He told her, Go home in peace. I have listened to your request, and I will do what you asked.

dag: Ka o naanyi zaŋ dari maa din kpalim mali o wuni zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li, ka suhiri li yɛra, Tiligim ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n wuni.
en: And the rest of it he makes into a god, into his idol, and he bows down, worships, and prays to it, saying, Save me, for you are my god.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yi yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla: Iin bee Aai, dama shɛli yi lan pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di nyɛla biriginsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Just say Yes or No—anything else you say comes from the Evil One.

dag: N ni zaŋ Ijiptinim niŋ na biɛɣu ŋun mali putɔɣu nuu ni ka o su ba. Man yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.

dag: Amaa a halibiɛɣu min a tipawumli zuɣu chɛ ka a bɔri Naawuni suhuyiɣisili zaani gur amaŋ zaadali din nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari saria din tuhi dahin shɛl la.
en: But you are so stubborn! You refuse to change. So you are making your own punishment greater and greater. You will be punished on the day when God will show his anger. On that day everyone will see how right God is to judge people.

dag: Vi bi mali ma lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu, dama lahibal suŋ maa nyɛla Naawuni yiko din tiligiri ŋunkam niŋ li yɛda; Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.

dag: ka daa me binwɔɣila mini Ashɛra binnana zalizali zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi kari Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinima, lala zuɣu Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim maa na kul be Izraɛlnim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Israelites did not force out the people of Geshur and Maacah. They still live among the Israelites today.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: No one dared to ask him anything else.

dag: Zahimmiya dimbɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn tam Naawuni yɛla ŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni dari tɔhi ya zaa ka so ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: Listen to this, you that ignore me, or I will destroy you, and there will be no one to save you.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yuli ka n zaŋ kana, ka yi ti bi deei ma, amaa so yi ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli kana, ŋuna ka yi ni deei.
en: I have come with my Father's authority, but you have not received me; when, however, someone comes with his own authority, you will receive him.

dag: ni shihira wuhibu ni ni alahiziba tumtumsa mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni la. Lala zuɣu ka n yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ hal ti kpa Ilirikum zaa.
en: by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of Gods Spirit. So Ive completed the circuit of preaching Christs gospel from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla din tuhi ninvuɣ so ŋun baŋ di gbinni sani, ka nyɛ din tuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim sani.
en: To those with insight, it is all clear; to the well-informed, it is all plain.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisim a nam ʒiishee nti ʒini tiŋ taŋkpaɣu ni. Bɛ ku lan bol a ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: Go down and sit in the dust, virgin Daughter Babylon! Sit on the ground without a throne, Daughter Chaldea, because they will no longer call you tender and pampered.

dag: Aduna ni daa nya li ka o me maligu bimbini zali di gbini, ka moli molo yɛli, Biɛɣuni ti sa yɛn puhila Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord .

dag: A zuɣulaannim nyɛla tipawumlinim mini tayiɣisi zɔnima. Bɛ zaa yuri birapu dibu ni faɣiri dibu. Bɛ bi sɔŋdi kpibisi bɛ saria dibu ni, ka bi saɣiri ka pakoya zaŋdi bɛ yɛlimuɣisira kani bɛ sanna.
en: Your leaders are rebels and friends of thieves; they are always accepting gifts and bribes. They never defend orphans in court or listen when widows present their case.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di tamya bin yini din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti Duuma sani, dahin yini nyɛla kaman yuun tuhili, ka yuun tuhili mi nyɛ kaman dahin yini.
en: But do not forget one thing, my dear friends! There is no difference in the Lord's sight between one day and a thousand years; to him the two are the same.

dag: Ka sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ tahilaa chim shɛli, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni, ka dabindi ka di ni.
en: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.

dag: Naa Ahaz kum yuuni ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa kana:.
en: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun tum tuun suma, dama a daa wurim Ashɛra ŋmahima zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a suhu zaa niŋla Naawuni jɛmbu ni.
en: Fortunately, you did some good things in your life. You did remove the Asherah poles from this country, and you did decide to ask God for his advice.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi niŋ n dab bidibisi mini n dab bipuɣinsi ni, ka bɛ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: In those days I will pour out my Spirit on my servants, men and women, and they will prophesy.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini di biŋkpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi o ni yɛn yihi yaannin shɛŋa maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li mali sara.
en: the two kidneys and the fat around them at the loins; and the lobe on the liver, which should be removed with the kidneys.

dag: A daa bi kpaai ma mi bahi kaman bihim la, ka kahim ma kaman waagasi la?.
en: Didnt you pour me out like milk, curdle me like cheese?.

dag: Di saha ka biŋkɔbiri chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee nti kpalim do bɛ lɛya ni.
en: and they force animals to seek shelter.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Kamiya kpe na nti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Joshua said to the Israelites, Come close. Listen to the words of the LORD your God.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N wuhi ya tuun suma pam din yi m Ba maa sanna, ka di ni dini zuɣu ka yi lee yɛn lab ma kuɣa ŋɔ.
en: Jesus responded, I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of those works do you stone me.

dag: Di saha maa Babilɔn Naa tɔbbihi daa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa kpari anabi Jɛrimia niŋ guliba dundɔŋ din daa be Juda nayili la ni.
en: At that time, the army of the Babylonian king had surrounded Jerusalem, and the prophet Jeremiah was confined to the prison quarters in the palace of Judahs king.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ naɣilaa la na nti mal o min o yiŋnim daalahichi sanyoo sara, ka o ti kɔrigi naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: When Aaron sacrifices the bull as the sin offering for himself and his family.

dag: ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣis o Naawuni malaikanim sani.
en: But the one who rejects me before others will be rejected before Gods angels.

dag: N niriba maa ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn bɔrigi, bɛn guli ba taɣi ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋ-ŋmaligiri ba gindi zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu, ka bɛ tam bɛ biɛhigu shee yɛla.
en: My people were lost sheep; their shepherds led them astray; they deserted them on the mountains, where they wandered off among the hills, forgetting their resting place.

dag: A nyɛla nambɔzɔra ni ŋun chɛri taali paŋda, hal ti ni kul zaɣis a la zaa yoli.
en: You are merciful and forgiving, although we have rebelled against you.

dag: Man Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn wurim kpe tinzun tinsi ni m-be Pɔntus mini Galɛshia ni Kapadɔsia ni Ɛsha ni Bitinia.
en: Greetings from Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To Gods chosen people who are away from their homes—people scattered all over the areas of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ a dabili min o daŋ polo la niŋ pali ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: And now, Lord God, fulfill for all time the promise you made about me and my descendants, and do what you said you would.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ba n-yɛn deei Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini di tooni ha tiŋgbana maa su, tinim ni yɛn deei tiŋgban shɛŋa su bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ na.
en: We will not take any of the land west of the Jordan River. No, our part of the land is east of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya filiŋ pam Midiannim maa zuɣu, ka daa naɣ ti kummi niŋ Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: So Israel became very weak on account of Midian, and the Israelites cried out to the LORD.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni bɛ gbaam bɛmaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bin kasi shɛŋa na ti ti ma la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Tell Aaron and his sons: The gifts that the Israelites bring to me become holy. They belong to me, so you priests must show respect for these things. If you dont, you will show that you dont respect my holy name. I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ vuhim yi ti naai, bɛ labirila tiŋgban ni; di saha ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa kpalim yoli.
en: Their breath leaves them, then they go back to the ground. On that very same day, their plans die too.

dag: Ti yi doli Naawuni zaligunima dina n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni ti yuri ŋun Naawuni. Ka o zaligunim maa mi pala yɛlimuɣisira.
en: This is the love of God: we keep Gods commandments. Gods commandments are not difficult.

dag: Yawɛ, n teeg a tuun kara la yɛla; ka teeg a ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la gba yɛla.
en: I will remember your great deeds, Lord ; I will recall the wonders you did in the past.

dag: dama a yi dee li niŋ a kɔbili ni, ka di zaa be a noli ni, di viɛla.
en: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin.
en: Offer a burnt offering as an odor pleasing to the Lord : two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba, ka di pala Yɛhudianim kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba.
en: Whether Jews or Gentiles, we are those chosen ones.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu, ka bɔhira, Ya polo ka di lee be? Bɛ mi ni zibisim dabisili shee bi lan waɣa.
en: He wanders from place to place, looking for food. But he knows a dark day is coming, which he brought on himself.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla man ŋuna, mani m-be yi nuu ni maa. Niŋmiya ma kaman yi ni kul nya ka shɛli viɛla ka tuhi yi sani.
en: As for me, I am in your power! Do with me whatever you think is fair and right.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti niŋ bindira ka yi di n-tiɣi, ka be ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: The land will produce its crops, and you will have all you want to eat and will live in safety.

dag: Ti bɔri ni ti lan lab yi sanna. Hal man Pool maŋmaŋ kpaŋ mmaŋ gari yimyim bushɛm ni n kana, amaa ka Sintani kul guri ti soli.
en: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.

dag: Ŋunkam tiri nandaamba pini, shɛli ku poog o, amaa ŋunkam lab o nini kpaŋa, noli ni di o.
en: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka di yi n-chaŋ ti kpe tayiɣ mini ŋun ŋmari ʒiri m-pɔri n yuli yinsi n-saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaŋ tabili dari mini kuɣa. .
en: I sent it out, says the LORD of heavenly forces. It will come to the house of the thief and the one swearing lies in my name. It will lodge in their house and destroy the wood and stones of that house.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni ŋme n-wurim o dimnim la zuɣuri, o ni saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ka kul doli bɛ daalahichi soya la zuɣutalisi.
en: Yes, God will shatter the heads of his enemies— the very skulls of those who walk in guilt.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Kish, o daa nyɛla Abiɛl bia, ka Abiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛro bia, ka Zɛro nyɛ Bɛkɔrat bia, ka Bɛkɔrat mi daa nyɛ Afia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la bia, o daa mali buni pam.
en: There was a wealthy man from the tribe of Benjamin named Kish. He was the son of Abiel son of Zeror son of Becorath son of Aphiah, a Benjaminite.

dag: Din simdi ya m-bala. N ni lo ni n niŋ ya shɛm m-bala! Dama yi tam n yɛla, ka niŋla ʒiri naani. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: He has said that this will be your fate. This is what he has decided to do with you, because you have forgotten him and have trusted in false gods.

dag: ni Amaria ni Maluk ni Hatush.
en: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, niriba maa ni ŋubiri nimdi maa shɛm maa, bɛ tumdila alahichi Yawɛ sani maa, dama bɛ bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka o yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla nyaanyiriba, bilimmiya kuɣ titali sɔŋ ma kpe na.
en: Someone told Saul, Look! The army is disobeying the Lord by eating meat before the blood drains out. You're right, Saul answered. They are being unfaithful to the Lord ! Hurry! Roll a big rock over here.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi binfalafala din daa be chɛrubinim zuɣuri zuɣusaa la, ka binshɛli daa be bɛ zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani safaya kuɣili, di kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee.
en: At that moment I saw a form of a throne in the dome above the heads of the winged creatures. It appeared above them, and it looked like lapis lazuli.

dag: Di simdi ni a baŋ a biŋkɔbbaligu daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka lihi a niɣi viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: Know your flock well; pay attention to your herds.

dag: Nyama, ti Duuma mali ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ni yiko din ni tooi lu bɛ zuɣu. O ni kana kaman sakuɣa saa bee sa kurili ni kopaliga nti di tiŋgbani maa.
en: Look! The Lord has someone who is powerful and strong; like a hailstorm, a disastrous tempest, like a downpour of mighty, overflowing waters, he can level them to the ground with his hand.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ jilima baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord .

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: Pekah did what the Lord said was wrong. He did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat who caused Israel to sin.

dag: O maari suhugarigunim suhuri, ka tibiri bɛ dansi.
en: God heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.

dag: Ti zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ Masia ŋun ka alahichi la n-zali alahichi zaani ni di chɛ ka ti leei wuntizɔriba ŋun Naawuni sani o zuɣu.
en: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: So nini na bi nya, ka so mi tibili na bi wum bee so ti baŋ binshɛŋa Naawuni ni mali zali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o la.
en: But this is precisely what is written: God has prepared things for those who love him that no eye has seen, or ear has heard, or that havent crossed the mind of any human being .

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Yawɛ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ niriba ŋɔ zaa ʒi tibisili ʒili ma ka bi sɔŋ ma?.
en: He asked the Lord , Why did you bring this trouble on me? I am your servant. What did I do wrong? What did I do to upset you? Why did you give me responsibility over all these people?.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee ŋun mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, di simdi ni o saɣi ni n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ nyɛla ti Duuma zaligu.
en: If anyone thinks that they are prophets or spiritual people, then let them recognize that what Im writing to you is the Lords command.

dag: O zuɣu ka yi niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neeg o kum ni ka ti o jilima la naani ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi tahima niŋbu zaa bela Naawuni ni.
en: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from death and gave him glory; and so your faith and hope are fixed on God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Alɔbo zaɣ yini n-kpalim ka n yɛn chɛ ka di lu Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, o ni kari ya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Ill bring one more disaster on Pharaoh and on Egypt. After that, hell let you go from here. In fact, when he lets you go, hell eagerly chase you out of here.

dag: M puhiri n zuliya Hɛrɔdiɔn. M puhiri Narisisus yiŋnim bɛn be ti Duuma ni la.
en: Say hello to my relative Herodion. Say hello to the members of the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

dag: N naan tooi zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsi yi suhuri, ka n suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa naan ku yi biɛrim maa.
en: I could strengthen you with advice and keep talking to comfort you.

dag: Chɛl niriba ŋɔ taali a yurilim din galisi la min a ni daa pun chɛ bɛ taali Ijipti zaŋ na hal ni pumpɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: And now, Lord , according to the greatness of your unchanging love, forgive, I pray, the sin of these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa daa yuri Dauda, dama ŋuna n-daa yi zaŋdi ba chani tɔb ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina.
en: But everyone in Israel and Judah loved David because he was such a successful leader.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa ti ka o sanna ti bɔh o, A mi ni Farisiinim ni wum a ni yɛli shɛm la bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim bebɔ.
en: Then the followers came to Jesus and asked, Do you know that the Pharisees are upset about what you said.

dag: tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Kolɔsai ka nyɛ ti mabihi bɛn ʒe yim Masia san la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: nyin chɛl a sara maa nimaani, ka chaŋ a kpee maa sani ka yi ti mali yi yɛlli maa pɔi ka a naanyi labi nti zaŋ a sara maa ti Naawuni.
en: leave your gift there in front of the altar, go at once and make peace with your brother, and then come back and offer your gift to God.

dag: Yi yi tuɣi ma ka n yɛligu be yi suhuri ni, ka yi suhi yi ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa, yi ni nya li.
en: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, then you will ask for anything you wish, and you shall have it.

dag: Amaa ka Diɔnisius ŋun daa nyɛ Ariɔpagus jintɔriba ni yino la mini paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Damaris m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛba daa niŋ yɛda, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool.
en: some of the men put their faith in the Lord and went with Paul. One of them was a council member named Dionysius. A woman named Damaris and several others also put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti yɛli yi suhuri ni, Timaŋmaŋ yiko mini ti nuhi kpiɔŋ ka ti zaŋ nya azichi ŋɔ.
en: When you become successful, don't say, I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi n-chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: This was to give full meaning to what Isaiah the prophet said when he spoke for God:.

dag: Di saha ka pɔhim daa yi Yawɛ sani n-ʒe kɔrinsi teeku ni na ti luhi gili suɣa maa shee luɣilikam m-paai kilomita bɔbili wɔɣilim tariga, ka bɛ ni do tiŋ shɛm dubu nyɛ kaman mita yini laasabu.
en: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.

dag: Cham Rɛkabinim sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na nti zaŋ ba kpɛhi dubihi la yini puuni, ka niŋ wain ti ba ka bɛ nyu.
en: Go to the members of the Rechabite clan and talk to them. Then bring them into one of the rooms in the Temple and offer them some wine.

dag: Bɛ daa zanila bɛ zaashɛhi kaman Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la. Lɛvinim n-daa yi taɣiri biŋkɔbiri ʒim n-zaŋna ti ti maligumaaniba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋdi li mihira.
en: They took their regular places in the Temple as described in the Law of Moses, the man of God. The Levites gave the blood to the priests. Then the priests sprinkled the blood on the altar.

dag: Yi bi kpaŋsiri bɛn ka yaa la, yi bi tibiri bɛn biɛri la, yi bi niŋdi tana lɔri bɛn nya dansi la, yi bi taɣiri bɛn yirigi la na, yi mi bi bo bɛn bɔrigi la shee. Amaa yi zaŋla kiŋkansi mini ninkuunsi su ba.
en: You dont strengthen the weak, heal the sick, bind up the injured, bring back the strays, or seek out the lost; but instead you use force to rule them with injustice.

dag: Di saha ka Juda zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini Bɛnjamin zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni sokam bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni daa neei shɛb suhuri daa mali shili ni bɛ kuli nti lab me Yawɛ duu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Many people felt that the Lord God wanted them to help rebuild his temple, and they made plans to go to Jerusalem. Among them were priests, Levites, and leaders of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku Hɛliɔpolis mini Bubastis nachimba, ka gbahi tinsi maa nim ti leei daba.
en: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the women will be taken away as prisoners.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Ka Ibram daa lan gbaai chandi zaŋ kpa Nɛgɛb polo.
en: Later, Abram started out toward the Southern Desert.

dag: O ni wurim zoya din du pam mini kunkuna din du pam zaa.
en: He will level the high mountains and hills.

dag: Nyin gba mir o, dama o daa chihi ti yɛligu pam.
en: Be on your guard against him yourself, because he was violently opposed to our message.

dag: dama bɛ daa yurila salinim paɣibu gari Naawuni paɣibu.
en: They loved human approval rather than the approval of God.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be Filistianim maa sani yuuni ni chira anahi.
en: David was in Philistia for a year and four months.

dag: Ka o daa lan me luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee, ka di wɔɣilim mini duu maa yɛliŋ nyɛ yim. Di daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ gba daa nyɛ mita awɛi. Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima alali, din tibisim gari mɛtiriki tɔn pisi n-dooi pa di zuɣu.
en: Then he made the most holy place. It was as long as the temple was wide, thirty feet long and thirty feet wide. He covered it with six hundred kikkars of fine gold.

dag: Dama n ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia labirina saha shɛli, ka Reechɛl daa kpi sol ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nimaani mini Ɛfirat daa na wɔɣa. Ka n daa sɔɣ o Ɛfirat soli maa ni ; ka di daa ti ma suhugarigu pam.
en: On the trip from Paddan Aram, Rachel died in the land of Canaan. This made me very sad. We were still traveling toward Ephrath. I buried her there on the road to Ephrath.

dag: dama yɛm soli ka a ni tooi doli tuh a tɔbu, ka saawaranim pam mi chɛ ka nir diri nasara.
en: You should make war with guidance; victory comes with many counselors.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka so ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kpuɣi ba bee n-sɔɣi ba. Bɛ ni ti do tiŋgban ni kaman naɣ bina la.
en: At that time, those struck down by the LORD will fill the earth. And no one will mourn for them or prepare their bodies for burial. They will become like refuse lying on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi bɛ tinsi ni n-laɣim Gibia na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: The people from the tribe of Benjamin left their cities and went to the city of Gibeah. They went to Gibeah to fight against the other tribes of Israel.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara pam; dinzuɣu timiya Naawuni jilima yi niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi bɛba ayopɔin daa doli bɛ nyaaŋa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na nti zani naɣ bɛmbala maa sani Nail Mɔɣili maa duli.
en: Just then, seven other cows, terrible-looking and scrawny, climbed up out of the Nile after them and stood beside them on the bank of the Nile.

dag: Ibrahimma daa lan kpuɣi paɣ so. O yuli n-daa booni Kɛtuura.
en: Abraham married another woman, whose name was Keturah.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka o mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa chaŋ ti kpe Saimɔn mini Anduru yiŋa.
en: As soon as Jesus left the synagogue with James and John, they went home with Simon and Andrew.

dag: Ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim daa saɣisi ti saha biɛla puuni kaman bɛ ni tɛhi ni di tuhiya shɛm zuɣu; amaa Naawuni niŋdi lala la ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim mal o biɛrikasitali.
en: Our fathers on earth disciplined us for a short time in the way they thought was best. But God disciplines us to help us so that we can be holy like him.

dag: Ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka paɣiba maa zaŋ tulaale shɛli bɛ ni daa mali zal la chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early on Sunday morning the women went to the tomb, carrying the spices they had prepared.

dag: dindina bɛ niriba ayi bɛn mali yɛtɔɣa maa bɛn cham Yawɛ tooni maligumaaniba mini sariakaritiba bɛn be tuma ni di saha maa sani.
en: If that happens, both of them must go to the Lord s special house and be judged by the priests and judges who are on duty at that time.

dag: Zaŋmiya di binnyura lita yini sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu, ka booi binnyuri kpiɔŋ bahi luɣ kasi shee m-mali binnyura sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Finally, along with each of these two sacrifices, a liter of wine must be poured on the altar as a drink offering.

dag: Daadam, kummi ka fabili, dama di nyɛla din yɛn lu n niriba zuɣu, di nyɛla din yɛn lu Izraɛl nanim zaa zuɣu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini n niriba. Mbaye! Kpahimiya yi gbalipina.
en: Human one, cry aloud, and wail, for it comes against my people, against all of Israels princes, handed over to the sword along with my people. Therefore, strike your thigh.

dag: O ni ti taɣi ti niŋgbuna din poori ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di be kaman omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ din bi poori la. O yiko din chɛ ka o tooi su binshɛɣukam zaa la puuni ka o yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: He will transform our humble bodies so that they are like his glorious body, by the power that also makes him able to subject all things to himself.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di manna maa yuun pihinahi hal ti paai bɛ ni daa yɛn ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa. Bɛ daa kul dirila manna maa hal ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Israelites ate manna for years, before they came to the border of Canaan that was a settled land.

dag: Ka anabi so daa yi tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri suhudoo yɛla, anabi maa yɛligu daa yi ti niŋ pali, di saha ka bɛ baŋdi ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim o na ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: So the prophet who prophesies peace is recognized as one who is actually sent by the LORD only when that prophets message is fulfilled.

dag: Zuɣusaa, gbilisim tibili wum ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani wum n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ata.
en: There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the third day.

dag: Dama di sab Yila litaafi ni yɛli: Chɛ ka o yili zani dabɔɣu, ka so ku kpe di ni; ka Chɛ ka so zani o zaani n-deeg o ni chɛ tuun shɛli maa.
en: For it is written in the book of Psalms, May his house become empty; may no one live in it. It is also written, May someone else take his place of service.

dag: Jɛshua daa nyɛla Joyakim ba; ka Joyakim nyɛ Ɛliashib ba, ka Ɛliashib nyɛ Joyada ba;.
en: Jeshua was the father of Joiakim. Joiakim was the father of Eliashib. Eliashib was the father of Joiada.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zaligunim maa zaa dolibu, ka nyɛligi binyara malila naɣibih ayi kɔtomsi zali; ka lan mali Ashɛra binnana zali, ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi mini Baal.
en: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.

dag: Amaa ka Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia maa bidib so ŋun yuli booni Abiata la ŋun daa zo n-tiligi chaŋ Dauda sani.
en: But Abiathar, one of Ahimelech's sons, escaped, and went and joined David.

dag: O daa zaŋ salima alali mali teebuli maa zuɣu duɣuri mini di parantɛnima ni di lahi din ni tuɣindi tulaale zim ni pipi shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain.
en: Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings.

dag: N daa mali nyɛvili saha shɛli n ni daa na ʒi zaligu yɛla la, amaa n ni daa ti baŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa, ka alahichi neei ka man lee kpi.
en: I myself was once alive apart from law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life.

dag: Yi ŋarima saɣimya, ka di mihi chihi, ka di tana chahi. Ti ni fa ti dimnim tɔbbihi nɛma zaa piri ti taba. Hal gbariti gba ni nya tarili di ni.
en: Your ropes are loosened; they cant hold the mast firmly; they cant spread the sail. Then abundant spoil will be divided; even the lame will seize spoil.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu ni ka yɛli: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku ni daa jɛm so ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bihi ŋɔ ni! Naawuni ŋun gbib ma hal ti paai zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni!.
en: Then he gave Joseph his blessing and said: My grandfather Abraham and my father Isaac worshiped the Lord God. He has been with me all my life.

dag: Di saha doo maa ya kpamba maa ni boli doo maa na ti tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa, ka o yi na kul vili ʒiɛla lala ka yɛli, N je ni n kpuɣ o.
en: Then the leaders of the city must call the man and talk to him. If the man is stubborn and says, I dont want to take her.

dag: Amaa Abija ŋun yaa daa kul kirisimi. O daa kpuɣila paɣiba pinaanahi n-dɔɣi bidibisi pisinaayi mini bipuɣinsi pinaayɔbu.
en: Abijah had a total of wives, sons, and daughters.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima; dama ninsal sɔŋsim ka buchi.
en: Help us defeat the enemy! No one on earth can rescue us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi nyaŋ ba, di saha yin kumiya bɛ zaa. Di ti lɔnya ba alikauli, yi mi di ti zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord your God will put these nations under your power. And you will defeat them. You must destroy them completely. Dont make an agreement with them or show them mercy.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o tumtumdiba bɛn mi teeku kom yɛtɔɣa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa zaŋ ŋariŋ din zɔri pam.
en: Hiram sent his expert sailors on the fleet along with Solomons workers.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: Any of you who try to save the life you have will lose it. But you who give up your life for me will find true life.

dag: Ka o daa bɔh o bipuɣinsi maa, Ka o be ya? Wula ka yi chɛ o zali samban ni? Bolimiy o na ka o ti di bindirigu.
en: Where is he? Jethro asked. Why did you leave him out there? Invite him to eat with us.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛliya ni ti ni ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka lan tiligi bɛnkam zaa je ti gba nuu ni.
en: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.

dag: Dama Sulemaana ŋarima daa yi zaŋdila Hiram tumtumdiba n-chani Tarishish. Ŋarima maa daa yi yiri Tarishish labirina yim yuma ata puuni bɛ ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: The royal fleet sailed to Tarshish with the servants of Huram, returning once every three years with gold, silver, ivory, monkeys, and peacocks.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza sapashin kpamba ni daa mali salima nyɔtaɣiri shɛŋa n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David took the gold shields that had belonged to Hadadezers servants and brought them to Jerusalem.

dag: Buɣim ni di li wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa sahakam. Ka di tiŋgbani ni leei tiŋgban nɛli doya ʒiɛmani kam ni; ka so ku lan ka di ni na.
en: The fires will burn day and night—no one will stop the fire. The smoke will rise from Edom forever. The land will be destroyed forever and ever. No one will ever travel through that land again.

dag: n-ʒiya diri bindirigu, ka paɣ so zaŋ luɣulu viɛlli din pali tulaale din mali shaara pam ka o sanna ti kpaa li niŋ o zuɣu ni.
en: While he was there, a woman came to him. She had an alabaster jar filled with expensive perfume. She poured the perfume on Jesus head while he was eating.

dag: Bɛ yi daa pun mali tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni bɛ zɔri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima zaa sahakam, dindina binshɛɣukam naan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ mini bɛ bihi sani.
en: I only wanted to change their way of thinking—I wanted them to respect me and obey all my commands from the heart. Then everything would be fine with them and with their descendants forever.

dag: Ka yi yi ku tooi niŋ bin din pɔri ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi jiɣindi binshɛŋa din kpalim zuɣu?.
en: And if you cant do the little things, why worry about the big things?.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa ku o mini ŋun nyɔɣu yo taba. Ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba, amaa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ba wɔhu pahi wɔribariba ni n-zo n-tiligi.
en: Each one struck down his opponent, so that the Arameans fled. Israel chased after them. Ben-hadad, Arams king, escaped with some horses and chariots.

dag: Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buyi. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buyi. Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buta. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buta.
en: and he said, Do it again—and they did. Do it once more, he said—and they did.

dag: Bɛ yuri zɔri gari jɛŋgbina, ka mali suhuyiɣisili gari kunduna bɛn gɔri zaawuni. Ka bɛ yuri ni nyam. Bɛ wɔribariba yila katiŋ na. Bɛ yiɣirimi kaman tɔrili ni yiɣiri yomyom ni o ti to binshɛli shɛm la.
en: Their horses will be faster than leopards and more dangerous than wolves at sunset. Their horse soldiers will come from faraway places. They will attack their enemies quickly, like a hungry eagle swooping down from the sky.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa yi gbaag a piɛɣu, m bi zaŋd o na ti wuhir a, amaa n daa yi gbaarila mmaŋmaŋ piɛɣu zal o zaani. Bɛ daa yi zu binshɛli wuntaŋ ni bee yuŋ, a chɛrimi ka n yo a li.
en: Whenever a sheep was killed by wild animals, I always bore the loss myself. I didn't take it to you to show that it was not my fault. You demanded that I make good anything that was stolen during the day or during the night.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri yɛla muɣis a; a mi di zabiri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nyuli.
en: Don't be worried on account of the wicked; don't be jealous of those who do wrong.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti Naawuni ka pa ni Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti tampiŋ pahi ti Naawuni ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.

dag: Nyin Farisii ŋun nyɛ zom ŋɔ, daŋm paɣila pipia mini laa puuni, ka naanyi chɛ ka di nyaaŋa gba neei.
en: Pharisees, you are blind! First make the inside of the cup clean and good. Then the outside of the cup will also be clean.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo din daa pahiri buyi la, bɛ daa malila dapaɣa pisi.
en: For the dwellings other side on the north, they made twenty boards.

dag: Ka di simdi ni yi yipa ŋmaligi chɛ m-paŋ o ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama di yi pa lala suhugarigu pam zuɣu ni chɛ ka o lu.
en: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.

dag: Maligumaaniba n-daa nyɛ: Jɛdaya mini Jɛhoyarib ni Jachin.
en: From the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin.

dag: Hal fiig tihi ni bi pum puma, ka wain tihi bi wali, ka olivi tihi bi wali, ka puri ni bindira bi niŋ, ka biŋkɔbbaligu lan ka buzɔna ni, ka niɣi lan ka naɣikpahi ni maa zaa yoli.
en: Though the fig tree doesnt bloom, and theres no produce on the vine; though the olive crop withers, and the fields dont provide food; though the sheep are cut off from the pen, and there are no cattle in the stalls.

dag: amaa yi ni shɛb bi niŋ li yɛda. Yisa daa pun mi piligu ni ha bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ni nyɛ so.
en: But some of you dont believe.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ku zaɣis o niriba; o ku chɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda bahi.
en: The LORD will not reject his people; he will not abandon his very own possession.

dag: Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa kul palila zinaniŋdiba. Noli yɛlibu la zuɣu, tiŋgbɔŋ maa kumdimi ka biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee kuui. Bɛ tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ tuma pala din tuhi.
en: Because the country teems with adulterers, because of them, yes, because their might isnt right and their way is evil, the land dries up, and the grazing areas in the wilderness wither.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra.
en: Jesus again asked, Who are you looking for? We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth, they answered.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo nti kpe fɔŋ ni n-yɛli niriba dinkam daa niŋ maa mini din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu maa yɛla zaa.
en: The men who had been taking care of the pigs ran away and went into the town, where they told the whole story and what had happened to the men with the demons.

dag: N yi ti teeg a nintam la yɛla, n suhu kul yɛla a nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli.
en: When I remember your tears, I long to see you so that I can be filled with happiness.

dag: ka din pahi pisinaayi daa gbaai Gidalit min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the twenty-second to Giddalti, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Aai, bɛ zaa pa shɛli, bɛ tuma ka buchi; bɛ binnana gba ka yiko.
en: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.

dag: N ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi, dama ti Naawuni maa galisiya gari wuni kam.
en: I will build a great temple because our God is greater than all the other gods.

dag: Dauda tɔbutuhiri biinsi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jashɔbiam ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔn nira, ka daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la kpɛma. Ŋuna n-daa ti zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa saha yin la.
en: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed men with his spear.

dag: A yi zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali Yawɛ tooni, Izraɛlnim bɛn zaŋm bɛ nuhi pa Lɛvinim maa zuɣu.
en: where the people will place their hands on them.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, So di zaŋ li zali hal ni asiba.
en: Moses told them, Dont save that food to eat the next day.

dag: Firawuna yi boli ya ti bɔhi ya, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tumda.
en: When Pharaoh summons you and says, What do you do.

dag: O daa lan wurim Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi ni zaa buɣa mini bɛ ni daa yi tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka suhudoo be o nam ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: Because he abolished the pagan places of worship and the incense altars from all the cities of Judah, the kingdom was at peace under his rule.

dag: Nira ni tooi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Amaa bɛ gbi ma la zamba bɔɣili. Teemi n ni daa zani a tooni n-tɔɣisi bɛ zaɣ viɛlli yɛla shɛm ni di chɛ ka a miligi a suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la.
en: Is evil the payment for good? Yet they have dug a pit for me to fall in. Remember how I came to you and spoke on their behalf, so that you would not deal with them in anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini jintɔriba timmiya ti yɛli sapashin kpɛm maa ni o sa zaŋm Pool tahi yi sanna, ka di be kaman yi bɔrimi ni yi vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ti mali shili ni ti ti ku o ka o na bi paai yi sanna.
en: So this is what we want you to do: Send a message to the commander from you and the high council. Tell him you want him to bring Paul out to you. Say that you want to ask him more questions. We will be waiting to kill him while he is on the way here.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili firilatamdigu la mini di firilanim ni di firiladuhirisi ni firilakpihindisi ni di tahipɔna ni di kpam ni be kpaŋman shɛŋa ni;.
en: They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand, with its lamps, tongs, trays, and all the olive oil containers.

dag: A nɛma daa yi kul yi teeku ni na, niriba pam nyari li mi. A daa zaŋ a daazichi min a daguya sɔŋ dunia ŋɔ nanima ka bɛ nya azichi.
en: Nations that received your merchandise were always pleased; kings everywhere got rich from your costly goods.

dag: M bi bɔri ni di be kaman n sabirila gbana ni n kpɛhi ya dabiɛm.
en: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.

dag: Riu ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Sɛrug.
en: When Reu was years old, he became the father of Serug.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la mini Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt la tɔbbihi daa yi Mahanaim chaŋ Gibiɔn.
en: Abner, Ners son, along with the soldiers of Ishbosheth, Sauls son, left Mahanaim to go to Gibeon.

dag: ka bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka bi niŋdi ba nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka doli n zaligunima ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam, o ku kpi o ba tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: He helps the poor. If people want to borrow money, the good son lends them the money, and he does not charge interest on the loan. He obeys my laws and follows them. He will not be put to death for his fathers sins. The good son will live.

dag: N daa lan yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na m mali ya be mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi ni yi deei Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka Yisa yɛl lala maa nyɛla, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu la.
en: Jesus said this because the people were saying that he had an evil spirit in him.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi kpi kaman sokam zaa ni kpiri shɛm bee yɛl shɛli din paari sokam zaa yi paai ba, dindina, pa Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ alizanda polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ zilima yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: Their mouths dare to speak against heaven! Their tongues roam the earth!.

dag: Yi yi da Yɛhudia nira ka o leei dabili, o ni tum yi tuma yuma ayɔbu, ka yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, di simdi ka yi chɛ ka o chaŋ yoli, ka ku yo shɛli.
en: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he shall serve you for six years. In the seventh year he is to be set free without having to pay anything.

dag: Ti leela kpibisi bɛn ka banima; ti manim nyɛla pakoya.
en: We have become orphans, having no father; our mothers are like widows.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o shiri nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa. O nyɛla m ba bipuɣiŋga, amaa ka lee pa m ma puuni bia, ka n zaŋ o leei m paɣa.
en: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.

dag: Lala zuɣu bindir shɛli dibu yi nyɛla din ni luhi m mabia, dindina n kul ku ŋubi nimdi ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mabia lu.
en: So if the food I eat makes another believer fall into sin, I will never eat meat again. I will stop eating meat, so that I will not make my brother or sister sin.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee la. Dina n-daa chɛ ka niriba maa daa na bi zaŋ bɛ suhuri zaa labisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni jɛmbu polo.
en: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.

dag: Di saha Ɛzɛkiɛl ni ti leei shihirili yi sani. Yi ni ti niŋ kaman o ni kul niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Di yi ti niŋ lala, yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Duuma.
en: Ezekiel is your sign. You will do everything that he has done. When this happens, you will know that I am the LORD God.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi tiŋgban shɛli din be Damaskus tooni ha. Man Yawɛ ŋun yuli nyɛ Binnamda zaa Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: when I take you into exile in a land beyond Damascus, says the Lord , whose name is Almighty God.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini neen shɛŋa din be nayili zaa chaŋ; ka daa lan kpuɣi salima nyɔtaɣirisi shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa chɛ ka bɛ mali la.
en: He took the treasures from the Lord s Temple and from the kings palace. He even took the gold shields that David had taken from the officers of King Hadadezer of Aram and put on the walls of Jerusalem.

dag: Samla ni daa ti kpi, Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔt, tin shɛli din be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo nir la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Samlah died, Shaul became the new king. Shaul was from Rehoboth by the Euphrates River.

dag: Ifriim zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi ni kɔbisinu. Yisifu zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba m-bala.
en: These are Ephraims descendants. Their enrollment was . These are Josephs descendants according to their clans.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Gibia dal la ka yi daa tum alahichi. Nimaani ka bɛ daa dii gbaai alahichi tumbu. Dinzuɣu tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu Gibia.
en: The Lord says, The people of Israel have not stopped sinning against me since the time of their sin at Gibeah. So at Gibeah war will catch up with them.

dag: ka Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf nyɛ Gaad zuliya zuɣulana.
en: Eliasaph, Deuels son, commanded the military of the tribe of Gad.

dag: ni Anatɔt ni Alimɔn.
en: Anathoth and its pastures, and Almon and its pastures. In total: four cities.

dag: Di saha ka wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa daa vaai yiɣisi tim Filistia tɔbbihi maa sunsuuni gari chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm kɔbil shɛli din daa do di dunol shee maa nti tooi di kom na ti ti Dauda. Amaa ka o zaɣisi li nyubu, ka kpaai li bahi tiŋ ti Naawuni.
en: So the three warriors broke through the Philistine camp and drew water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem and brought it back to David. But he refused to drink it and poured it out to the LORD.

dag: Kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, kpahimmi wuntizɔriba nya; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhudoo, bɛ ni mali zuliya bɛn dol bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Notice good people, observe the righteous; peaceful people have descendants.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shutɛla mini Bɛrɛd ni Tahat ni Ɛliada ni Tahat.
en: These were the names of Ephraims descendants. Ephraims son was Shuthelah. Shuthelahs son was Bered. Bereds son was Tahath.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti lo ni m bɔhim nya yɛm, ka nya niriba ni gaani gom yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa dunia ni.
en: Whenever I tried to become wise and learn what goes on in the world, I realized that you could stay awake night and day.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya o ka bɔh o, Asahɛl, nyini m-bala? Ka o yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: Abner looked behind him and said, Is that you, Asahel? Yes, its me, Asahel answered.

dag: Bɛnjamin bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Jɛdiayɛl, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.

dag: N ni labisi Izraɛlnim ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ ti di bindir shɛli din be Kamɛl mini Bashan, ka di Ifriim zoya ni bindira ni Giliad bindira tiɣi.
en: But I will bring Israel back to its own land. The people will be like sheep eating their fill on Mount Carmel and in Bashan, in the hill country of Ephraim and in Gilead.

dag: Yinim tuumbiɛtumdiba ŋɔ zomiya ka chɛ ma; ka n doli n Naawuni zaligunima.
en: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.

dag: ni Ɛla bia Shimɛi ŋun daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni.
en: Shimei son of Ela: the territory of Benjamin.

dag: Ka o mini gbuɣima daa doli, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu ka ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: He went on the prowl with the other lions and became a strong young lion. He learned to tear flesh and devour humans.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛla bɛ noya jɛndi ma, ka yɛra, Iin, Iin, ti nini nya li.
en: They are quick to accuse me. They say, You did it! We saw you ourselves.

dag: Ti kul dolila ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun nyɛ Rɛkab bia maa ni daa zali ti zaligu shɛŋa maa, dina n-nyɛ ni ti mini ti paɣiba ni ti bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi di nyu wain ti biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: We have obeyed everything our ancestor Jonadab, Rechabs son, commanded us. No one in our household, including our wives and children, has ever had wine.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti niŋ yuun shɛŋa, ka Ijipti naa maa daa kpi. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul be bɛ dabitim maa ni fabinda, ka kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka bɛ dabitim ni kuhigu maa daa paai Naawuni.
en: A long time passed and that king of Egypt died. But the Israelites were still forced to work very hard. They cried for help, and God heard them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti laɣim Shilo n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu tanti suɣili la kpa nimaani; ka bɛ ni daa tuhi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa kul doya ka bɛ lihiri li.
en: After they had conquered the land, the entire community of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ. Ibram daa nyɛla yuun pisopɔinnaanu nira saha shɛl o ni daa yiɣisi Haran maa.
en: So Abram left Haran just like the Lord said, and Lot went with him. Abram was years old when he left Haran.

dag: Mani yi Duuma NAAWUNI kul pala n nini lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, n ni di bɛ nyɛviya dunia ŋɔ ni. Amaa n ku di Yaakubu daŋ niriba zaa nyɛviya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: n ni daa mali bihim paɣiri n naba, ka doori kpam tampima zuɣu la.
en: when my steps were washed with cream and a rock poured out pools of oil for me.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu yaha ka Yisa yɛn chaŋ Galili; ka daa ti nya Filip yɛl o, Doli ma.
en: The next day Jesus wanted to go into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

dag: Dama o daa yɛl o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shih o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She was thinking, If I can touch his coat, I will be healed.

dag: Bɛ kul niŋdila nirilim sahakam, ka zaŋdi bɛ liɣiri paŋdi niriba, ka alibarika be bɛ bihi ni.
en: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ti yɛn kana la shilinshia, amaa din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli m-be Masia ni la yipa paana.
en: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!.

dag: O wurim o suɣili la kaman ʒiɛvari puu la. O wurim o jɛmbu duu la. Yawɛ chɛ ka Ziɔnnim tam bɛ churi puhibu mini bɛ vuhim dabisa yɛla. O suhu ni yiɣisi pam zuɣu, o zaɣisila naa mini maligumaana.
en: He wrecked his own booth like a garden; he destroyed his place for festivals. The LORD made Zion forget both festival and sabbath; in his fierce rage, he scorned both monarch and priest.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Ilaija binyɛr shɛli din daa yi o sani luna n-lab ti zani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: Then he picked up Elijah's cloak that had fallen from him, and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Firawuna, Zalim ma saha shɛli a ni bɔri ni n suhi Naawuni ti a min a niriba ni a kpamba zaa, ka poloya maa kpi yi yinsi, ka chɛla bɛn be Nail Mɔɣili ni la kɔŋko.
en: Moses said to Pharaoh, I will pray for you, your people, and your officials. Then the frogs will leave you and your houses. They will remain only in the river. When do you want the frogs to go away.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N ni be a sani. Dimbɔŋɔ mi n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri ni mani n-tim a, a yi ti yihi niriba maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, yi ni ti jɛmdi man Naawuni zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: God said, You can do it because I will be with you. This will be the proof that I am sending you: After you lead the people out of Egypt, you will come and worship me on this mountain.

dag: Ka Hushai daa kana, ka Absalom ti yɛl o, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛl ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ti niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa? Di yi pa lala, nyin yɛlim ti.
en: Hushai came in, and Absalom told him what Ahithophel had planned. Then Absalom said, Should we do what he says? And if we shouldn't, can you come up with anything better.

dag: A mi kparibuhi ni dɔɣiri saha shɛli? A na mi n-nya saŋkpaliŋ ni dɔɣiri shɛm?.
en: Do you know when mountain goats are born? Have you watched wild deer give birth?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, yi yi ni labi n sanna, yi yi chɛ din chihira n sani maa tumbu, ka chɛnya ʒiɛhi gili.
en: This message is from the Lord . Israel, if you want to come back, then come back to me. Throw away your idols. Dont wander farther away from me.

dag: Kpɛmiya kuɣa voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni.
en: You should be afraid of the Lord ! Go hide in the dirt and behind the rocks. Hide from his glorious power!.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daanya mali paɣibu tahili, ka mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Make a bronze basin with a bronze base. Place it between the Tent and the altar, and put water in it.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di lan yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ polo yaha. M pun zali ni a mini Ziba pirigim tiŋgbani maa ti taba.
en: David answered, You've said enough! I've decided to divide the property between you and Ziba.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni alikauli suɣili maa ni.
en: Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the meeting tent.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani mini bɛnkam jɛmd o zaɣ viɛlli.
en: The Lord is good to those who wait for him. He is good to those who look for him.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni o yɛn bela sagban sabila ni.
en: Then Solomon said, The LORD said that he would live in a dark cloud.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka chɛ a daba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ taali ka deei bɛ suhigu; ka wuhi ba di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so viɛl shɛli; ka chɛ ka saa mi a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti a niriba maa ka bɛ di li fali ŋɔ ni.
en: then listen from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the best way for them to follow, and send rain on your land that you gave to your people as an inheritance.

dag: Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni, ka zaŋ o leei cheechi zuɣu ni o su cheechi binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: God put everything under Christs power and made him head over everything for the church.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yihi o niriba maa; ka bɛ daa ʒi anzinfa mini salima yi, bɛ ni so daa bi tuui.
en: Then he led the Israelites out; they carried silver and gold, and all of them were healthy and strong.
