dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka ku tum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa tuma.
en: But if you do not obey me and do not carry out all these commands.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chaŋ naai ka niriba maa yi kɔbiliga maa ni na n-chaŋ ti yɛli Naa Dauda, bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim yomyom gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du, dama n-nyɛ Ahitɔfɛl ni wuhi yikombiɛlim shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: After they had left, Jonathan and Ahimaaz climbed out of the well. They went and reported to King David, Get up! Cross the water immediately because Ahithophel has made plans against you.

dag: N kul yɛn kariti ba la biɛlabiɛla hal ka yi daadam biɛligu ti nabi n-su tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.

dag: A zaligu din yi a nol ni na nyɛla bin viɛlli n sani gari salima mini anzinfa kpila tusa shɛm.
en: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.

dag: Ka nir yi ti ku o kpee sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli lala tinsi maa zaɣ yin ni tiligi ŋun dol o ni o ku o yo samli nuu ni.
en: Anyone who kills someone accidentally can go to a city of safety to hide from the relatives who want to kill him.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a yiko ni a niŋdi lala.
en: They asked, What kind of authority do you have for doing these things? Who gave you this authority to do them.

dag: N niŋ ya naani pam, ka nyuri bara pam yi zuɣu, ka lan mali suhudoo. Ti wahala dibu la zaa yoli, m mali suhupiɛlli hal ti yaɣi.
en: I am so sure of you; I take such pride in you! In all our troubles I am still full of courage; I am running over with joy.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti nyɛ o ni dihiri shɛba, ka nyɛ kaman piɛri be o nuu ni. Di di simdi ni yi wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: He is our God; we are the people he cares for, the flock for which he provides. Listen today to what he says:.

dag: Mɛmiya tinsi ti yi bihi ka me piɛri buzɔna ti yi piɛri mini yi buhi, ka niŋ kaman yi ni lo alikauli ni yi ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Build cities for your children and barns for your animals. But then, you must do what you promised.

dag: Ka goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali mi nyɛla Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu Yawɛ sani. Ka yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin.
en: On the fifteenth day the Festival of Unleavened Bread begins, and for seven days you must not eat any bread made with yeast.

dag: Dama bɛ daa kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa hal ka tiŋgbani ti ku n-sabigi. Ka bɛ daa ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim bimbil shɛŋa la mini tiwala zaa, ka va mahali bee tihi vari bee puri ni bimbilima daa lan ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: They covered the ground, and the whole country became dark. The locusts ate every plant on the ground and all the fruit in the trees that the hail had not destroyed. There were no leaves left on any of the trees or plants anywhere in Egypt.

dag: Ka noonsi bɛn be zuɣusaa tɛri bɛ tɛri tihi din baɣi li zuɣu, ka be di wula zuɣu kumda.
en: Wild birds come to live by the pools; they sing in the branches of nearby trees.

dag: N suhir a mi, chɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ taali. Dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni me a yili a ni tuhiri ŋun Yawɛ tɔb shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu; ka a ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: Please forgive me if I say a little more. The Lord will always protect you and your family, because you fight for him. I pray that you won't ever do anything evil as long as you live.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɔri nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa duŋtaabo dirila nyɛvili.
en: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and the wise gather lives.

dag: Yawɛ ni be nyini n dan naa sani shɛm, o kul be Sulemaana gba sani lala ka chɛ ka o nam gari nyini n dan Naa Dauda nam.
en: As the Lord has been with Your Majesty, may he also be with Solomon and make his reign even more prosperous than yours.

dag: Kamina pumpɔŋɔ nti chɛ ka a mini n dan Asiria naa puli. N ni ti a yuri tusaayi, a yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni ba ba.
en: If you still want to fight my master, the king of Assyria, I will make this agreement with you. I promise that I will give you horses if you can find enough men to ride them into battle.

dag: Zaŋmiya Alikauli Adaka la zali di puuni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili limsi li.
en: Place the chest containing the covenant inside the dwelling. Hide the chest from view with the veil.

dag: Amiramnim mini Izarinim ni Hiburɔnnim ni Uziɛlinim ni:.
en: Other leaders were chosen from the tribes of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Ka Rubin daa bɔhi ba, N daa bi yɛli ya ni yi di niŋ bia maa shɛli? Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, o kubu maa biɛri m-bɔhiri ti maa.
en: Reuben responded to them, Didnt I tell you, Dont do anything wrong to the boy? But you wouldnt listen. So now this is payback for his death.

dag: O neesim bemi kaman wuntaŋa, ka neesim bɔba yiri o nuhi ni na, nimaani ka o yiko sɔɣiya.
en: Rays of light shine from his hand, a bright, shining light. There is such power hiding in that hand.

dag: Di pa shɛli a shiri paɣirila Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa di pala din ni kpaŋsi so suhu.
en: You may offer a beautiful prayer of thanksgiving, but the other person is not being built up.

dag: Ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka n kahi Tɔbaya nɛma m-bahi samban ni.
en: I was very angry and threw all of Tobiahs household furniture out of the room.

dag: Zaŋm dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba, ka zali ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: Give them these instructions and these teachings.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi nti tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: But the Pharisees left and made plans to kill Jesus.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam Balaam ni daa chani maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ ti zani sol ni n-gu o soli. Balaam daa barila buŋa, ka o tumtumdiba ayi be o sani.
en: Balaam was riding his donkey to Moab, and two of his servants were with him. But God was angry that Balaam had gone, so one of the Lord 's angels stood in the road to stop him.

dag: Paɣiba pam gba daa be nimaani n-kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni din niŋ maa. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn doli Yisa yi Galili na, ka nyɛ bɛn sɔŋd o la.
en: Many women were watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to serve him.

dag: Naa Jɔsia daa nyɛla na so ŋun ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani ni o suhu zaa ni o shia zaa ni o kpiɔŋ zaa kaman Musa zaligu puuni ni sab wuhi shɛm zaa. Ka na so daa ka na shɛb bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn zaa daa dol o nyaaŋa puuni m-be ka o ni be shɛm.
en: There had never been a king like him before, who served the Lord with all his heart, mind, and strength, obeying all the Law of Moses; nor has there been a king like him since.

dag: Bee a lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la.
en: Do you want to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday.

dag: ni Zanɔa ni Ɛnganim ni Tapua ni Ɛnam.
en: Zanoah, En-gannim, Tappuah, Enam.

dag: Ka di daa ti paai biɛɣu pia maa, ka bɛ nina ni kul nɛmi zaa kasi, ka bɛ lan ŋmɛlim gari bɛ tab bɛn zaa daa diri nayili bindirigu maa.
en: After ten days, Daniel and his friends looked healthier than all the young men who ate the kings food.

dag: A bela a biɛhigu shee ka chɛ ka saa yiri zuɣusaa luri zoya zuɣu na, ka tiŋgbani diri a tuma nyɔri.
en: You send rain down on the mountains. The earth gets everything it needs from what you have made.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma mi ka n ni sɔhira, ka dabiɛm din galisi nyaŋ ma;.
en: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.

dag: O ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ noombil maa ʒim mini kom maa ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa ni sida dari ni taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee maa n-yihi yili maa daɣiri ni m-bala.
en: In this way, the priest will cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, the fresh water, the wild bird, the cedarwood, the hyssop, and the crimson yarn.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ni o ti nya ninsalinim ni me tin shɛli ka me pii tam di zuɣu maa.
en: Then the Lord came down to see the city and the tower.

dag: Naawuni ni daa neeg o kum ni ka o ku lan labi niŋgbuŋ poobu ni zuɣu ka o daa lan yɛli: N ni zaŋ alibarika suŋ shɛli n ni daa niŋniŋ Naa Dauda ni la n-niŋ a ni.
en: God raised Jesus from the dead, never again to be subjected to deaths decay. Therefore, God said, I will give to you the holy and firm promises I made to David. .

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa tum shɛm la. Amɔn daa kɔri biŋkɔbiri m-mali binnan shɛŋa zaa o ba Manaasa ni daa mali zal la, ka jɛmdi li.
en: Like his father Manasseh, he sinned against the Lord , and he worshiped the idols that his father had worshiped.

dag: Nyama, a wuhi niriba pam, ka kpaŋsi bɛn nuhi ka yaa.
en: Look, youve instructed many and given strength to drooping hands.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni anabinim mini nanim pam daa bɔri ni bɛ nina nya yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ, ka bi nya li; ka daa lan bɔri ni bɛ wum yɛl shɛŋa yi ni wumdi ŋɔ, ka daa bi wum li.
en: I assure you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see and hear what you hear, but they didnt.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Kul shini a noli. Zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli, ka dol ti ti leei ti ba ni ti maligumaana. A yi nyɛ ninvuɣ yino maligumaana ni a yi nyɛ Izraɛl daŋ yini maligumaana, dini n-lee so.
en: They told him, Keep quiet. Don't say a word. Come with us and be our priest and adviser. Wouldn't you rather be a priest for a whole Israelite tribe than for the family of one man.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ o niriba maa kaman piɛri la chaŋ, ka wuhi ba soli mɔɣu ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu n-nyɛ ba la.
en: God led his own people out like sheep, guiding them like a flock in the wilderness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o bidibisi pini, di simdi ni di leeg o bidibisi maa dini, ka di nyɛ bɛ fali shɛli bɛ ni yɛn su.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: If the ruler gives a gift from part of his land to any of his sons, it will belong to his sons. It is their property.

dag: Amaa ka Samsin zabiri maa daa ti lan bilina gbaai zoobu o pinibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But his hair started growing back.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi m piɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa n ni kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa na nti zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ dɔɣi bihi ka nabi.
en: I sent my sheep to other countries. But I will gather together my sheep that are left, and I will bring them back to their pasture. When my sheep are back in their pasture, they will have many children and grow in number.

dag: Yawɛ, a nudirigu mali yiko ni jilima. Yawɛ, a nudirigu ka a zaŋ dari tɔh a dim bahi.
en: Your strong hand, LORD, is dominant in power; your strong hand, LORD, shatters the enemy!.

dag: Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim mi daa laɣim lo tɔbu chaŋ ti ti bɛ suɣa Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-doya ni bɛ tuhi Filistianim maa.
en: King Saul and the Israelite army set up camp on a hill overlooking Elah Valley, and they got ready to fight the Philistine army that was on a hill on the other side of the valley.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrubaal mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa daa daŋ yibu chaŋ ti dɔni baɣili Harɔd kulibɔŋ. Ka Midiannim mi daa do vinvamli ni zaŋ lab nuzaa polo miri Mɔre daboli.
en: One day Gideon and all his men got up early and camped beside Harod Spring. The Midianite camp was in the valley to the north of them by Moreh Hill.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka anabi yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti gbib ba.
en: The Lord sent a prophet to rescue the people of Israel from slavery in Egypt and to take care of them.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli ni maa zuɣu! Di chɛ ka alibarika be m ma ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa ni!.
en: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: I responded, Absolutely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.

dag: Pinimiya zuɣukpina, yi ni yuri yi bi shɛb la zuɣu. Pinimiya zuɣukpina ka di be kaman juɣu zuɣu la, dama bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni.
en: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani mini bɛ malibu na ka bɛ ti ʒini Hiburɔn fɔndi ni.
en: David also brought his men and their families. All of them made their homes in Hebron and the towns nearby.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli nti zaŋ bɛ ŋariŋ lo n-zali teeku noli.
en: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and brought the boat to shore near the town of Gennesaret.

dag: Bee ŋuni n-na mi n-dih o samli ka di nyɛ talahi ni o yo dilana?.
en: Who has ever given God anything? God owes nothing to anyone. Job :.

dag: Nooŋa ni siɣi zana ni ka bɛ bi bari li? Ka tɔŋ ni tooi tɔhi ka pa ni bɛ bari li mi ka binshɛɣu no li?.
en: Will a bird fall into a trap on the ground when there is no bait for it? Will a trap spring up from the ground when it has taken nothing?.

dag: Gbibi bɛ ni wuh a shɛli viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a chɛ ka di faai. Guli yɛm, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ a nyɛvili.
en: Always remember what you have learned. Your education is your life—guard it well.

dag: Sa malimi shili biɛɣuni asiba n-du Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti zaŋ amaŋ ti ma zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Get ready in the morning and come up to Mount Sinai. Stand there on top of the mountain in front of me.

dag: N yur a, n ni zaŋ a ŋmahindila Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi wɔridibiga.
en: I picture you, my dearest, as a mare among Pharaohs chariots!.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim tahima; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha. Wula ka a be kaman sana n-nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee kaman yuŋ ni sabigi sochanda so ka o yɛn zani gbe luɣ shɛli maa?.
en: You are the hope of Israel, its savior in times of trouble. Why are you like a stranger in the land, like a tourist spending only the night?.

dag: Amaa m bihi, yi nyɛla Naawuni niriba ka pun nyaŋ anab ʒirinim maa, dama Shi so ŋun be yi ni maa mali yiko gari shi so ŋun be dunianim ni.
en: My dear children, you belong to God, so you have already defeated these false prophets. Thats because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam yirila o sanna; ka binshɛɣukam bela o zuɣu; ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla o ni su shɛli. Ŋuna n-simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: For all things were created by him, and all things exist through him and for him. To God be the glory forever! Amen.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wumbu, m poya, yili ŋɔ ni leei dabɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.

dag: Ka di daa ti Yɛhudianim suhupiɛlli mini tahima din wuhi ni bɛ di nasara.
en: For the Jews it was a day of light, happiness, joy, and honor.

dag: Dabisi muni puuni, di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la; di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni luɣilikam zaa.
en: that strike each day and from every side.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe o yilikpɛrili ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ashilɔni, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin birigu maa bahi.
en: After Jesus and the disciples had gone back home and were alone, they asked him, Why couldn't we force out that demon.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya kam saria, ka chɛ ka niriba kpi n-yɛrigi bɛ tiŋgbana ni. O ni ti nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: God brings the nations to justice, piling the dead bodies, crushing heads throughout the earth.

dag: Yawɛ, ti dolila a yubu ni nyɛ shɛli, ka niŋ a ni doli so shɛŋa kariti saria naani. A kɔŋko ka ti kul bɔra.
en: We follow your will and put our hope in you; you are all that we desire.

dag: Ka bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa dol ba daa yi n-chaŋ.
en: The young soldiers led the attack, followed by the Israelite army.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni kpɛbu, o jilima ni daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa puuni maa zuɣu.
en: Because the Temple was full of the dazzling light, the priests could not enter it.

dag: Ka Iso daa nya paɣiba mini bihi maa ka bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Naawuni ni niŋ mani a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ti ma bi shɛba m-bala.
en: Esau looked up and saw the women and children. He said, Who are all these people with you? Jacob answered, These are the children that God gave me. God has been good to me.

dag: Bɛ zaa gbibila takɔbiri, bɛ nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ takɔbiri maa baɣi bɛ gbalipina; bɛ malila shili gu yuŋ bimbiɛri.
en: All of them are trained fighting men with their swords at their side, ready for any danger of the night.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ ŋmɛnditoya nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme ba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gil ba nyaŋ ba, ka Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛmaŋ zuɣu zabbu.
en: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let enemies attack them and take their possessions. He let their enemies who lived around them defeat them. The Israelites could not protect themselves from their enemies.

dag: Ŋunkam paɣir o ʒiʒiinikpee ti yaɣi nyɛla ŋun bariti o ʒiʒiinikpee maa zana.
en: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.

dag: Lala ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa, ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa nyɛ din viɛla ni din tuhi ka lan wuh o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Throughout all Judah, King Hezekiah did what was right and what was pleasing to the Lord his God.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi tɛhiri ni m mi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa gili ba niŋla sunsuuni, ka bɛ ʒe n tooni.
en: They dont believe that I will remember their crimes. The bad things they did are all around. I can see their sins clearly.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔh o ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa dɔɣi ma lala? bee m-bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka a daa wolisi dɔɣi? Mbusim be dilan zuɣu.
en: Do we dare say to our parents, Why did you make me like this.

dag: Ula bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ara mini Hanniɛl ni Rizia.
en: Ulla was the father of Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka niŋ din tuhi, ka kar a daba saria n-wuhi ŋun tum taali, ka chɛ ka o tuuni maa ʒin o zuɣu. Ka a zani wuntizɔra maa nyaaŋa, ka ti o laara o wuntitali maa zuɣu.
en: then listen from heaven, act, and decide which of your servants is right. Condemn the guilty party, repaying them for their conduct, but justify the innocent person, repaying them for their righteousness.

dag: Di pa shɛli Onɛsimus daa yi a sani n-zomi ni o yi kpaŋ biɛla, ka ti lan lab a sanna n-yipa ti beni sahakam.
en: Maybe this is the reason that Onesimus was separated from you for a while so that you might have him back forever.

dag: Nyama, ka anabi so daa kana ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Nyama, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka a baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Meanwhile, a prophet went to King Ahab and said, The Lord says, Don't be afraid of that huge army! I will give you victory over it today, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi pahi biŋkɔbigu ʒim zuɣu m-mali sara ti ma bee n-chɛ ka yi ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara biŋkpam zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. The fat of animals sacrificed to me during these festivals is not to be left until the following morning.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ya yi ni daa nyari biɛrim shɛli mini wahala shɛŋa ni, ka yihi ya tuun kpɛma mini bɛ ni daa muɣisiri ya ka yi tumdi tuun shɛŋa la tumbu ni.
en: When the LORD has given you rest from pain and trouble and from the hard labor that you perform.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn chɛ ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ kpuɣi Ilaija chaŋ alizanda ni saha shɛli, o mini Ilaisha daa yila Giligal m-be soli zuɣu chana.
en: Not long before the Lord took Elijah up into heaven in a strong wind, Elijah and Elisha were leaving Gilgal.

dag: Bɛ chib bɔɣili n-gbi li sɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli maa ni.
en: But in the traps they set for others, they themselves get caught.

dag: Yili maa yi nyɛla yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim di ni; amaa di yi pala yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim yi sani.
en: If the house is worthy, give it your blessing of peace. But if the house isnt worthy, take back your blessing.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a ma ŋun dɔɣ a labi bɛ ni daa bi dɔɣi ya tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: I will banish you and your mother who bore you to a land far from your native soil, and there the two of you will die.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu min o mabihi maa ni bɛ ʒiɛman ni niriba zaa daa ti kpi.
en: After Joseph, his brothers, and everyone else in that generation had died.

dag: N ni daa wum o kukoli, n daa lu n-dɔn la tiŋa n-liɣi ka n nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Then I heard the man in the vision talking. As I listened to his voice, I fell into a deep sleep, with my face on the ground.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu; nyini n-chɛ ka n dimnim lu n naba ni.
en: You equipped me with strength for war; you brought my adversaries down underneath me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli mini laasabuniŋdiba zaa ni ti di vi, ka tabi bɛ noya, dama Naawuni ti ku garigi ba.
en: The seers are ashamed. The fortunetellers are embarrassed. None of them will say anything, because God will not speak to them.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Kpiɔŋlan Naa mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ti jɛmd o? Ka ti yi suhir o, nyo bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya.
en: who is the Almighty that we should serve him, and what can we gain if we meet him.

dag: Ti lomiya tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba; yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba wuntaŋ zuɣusaa dɛde. Mbusim paai ti, dama wuntaŋ luya, ka yuŋ zibira.
en: They will say, Prepare to attack Jerusalem! Get ready! We'll attack at noon! But then they will say, It's too late, the day is almost over, and the evening shadows are growing long.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛ dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ zuɣuri m-be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: These were the heads of households, in their generations. They were leaders who lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti du Olivi tihi Zoli n-chani ka kumda. O daa zaŋla bini pil o zuɣu, ka chani napɔn zaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani gba zaŋ bina pil bɛ zuɣuri n-kumdi dol o chana.
en: But David, his head covered, walked barefoot up the slope of the Mount of Olives crying. All the people who were with him covered their heads too and cried as they went up.

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi mali yum o zuɣu ni bee o teeŋa ni.
en: Whenever a man or woman has an infection, whether on the head or in the beard.

dag: Hal ka bia maa daa ti bɔri ni o dirila kuruchunim maa bindira maa shɛli, dama so daa bi tir o bindirigu.
en: He would have been glad to eat what the pigs were eating, but no one gave him a thing.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lo tɔbu tuh a, amaa bɛ ti ku tooi nyaŋ a. Dama m be a sani ni n fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord , give my word— I won't let them harm you.

dag: Tinzun nira yi di a samli, a ni tooi bɔh o dee li, amaa a mabia ŋun be yi ʒilɛl ni ŋuna, di simdi ni a ku san shɛli din be a min o sunsuuni.
en: You may collect what a foreigner owes you, but you must not collect what any of your own people owe you.

dag: amaa dabisa din kpalim nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni, o tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa la o Bia la nol ni. O Bia maa kɔbili ni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zal o ni o su binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: In these final days, though, he spoke to us through a Son. God made his Son the heir of everything and created the world through him.

dag: Dama a suhuyiɣisili chɛmi ka ti dabisa garita; ti yuma kul naarimi kaman siɣimbu la.
en: Our life is cut short by your anger; it fades away like a whisper.

dag: Di zaa daa nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu. Dapaɣili kam daa tamla diba ayi zuɣu.
en: Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi bɛ biŋkɔbiri ni bɔri shɛli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna, bɛ nambɔzɔbo nyɛla putɔɣu niŋbu.
en: Good people take good care of their animals, but the wicked know only how to be cruel.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋumbɔŋɔ amiliya dakulo ŋɔ naai pɔi, ka ti zaŋ ŋuni maa gba ti a, ka a tum tuma o zuɣu ti ma yuma ayopɔin pahi.
en: Wait until the week's marriage celebrations are over, and I will give you Rachel, if you will work for me another seven years.

dag: ka sakuɣ kara din tibisim sania zuɣu nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram pihinahi ni anu daa yi zuɣusaa n-luri niriba zuɣu na hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni alɔbo sakuɣa maa zuɣu. Di daalɔbo maa daa mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Hailstones, weighing about kilograms each, fell from the sky on people. Finally, the people cursed God, because the hail was so terrible.

dag: Amaa ka timanim gba daa niŋ tabibi n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But the magicians used their secret powers to do the same thing.

dag: A ni daa darigi n tibili maa, di viɛla. Di ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: My punishment was good for me, because it made me learn your commands.

dag: Jɔnatan ni daa yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa sani maa zuɣu tampiŋ kara ayi n-daa doya; yini daa dola yaɣili ka yini mi do yaɣ din la. Tampiŋ yini yuli daa boonila Bɔzɛz ka yini mi yuli booni Sɛne.
en: In Michmash Pass, which Jonathan had to go through to get over to the Philistine camp, there were two large jagged rocks, one on each side of the pass: one was called Bozez and the other Seneh.

dag: Man gba ni kpahi n nuhi, ka tum n suhuyiɣisili tuma. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: It is I who strike hand to hand! Ill satisfy my wrath! I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nina neei, ka o nya ka kɔbiliga doya, ka o daa chaŋ di ni nti tooi kom pal o kom koligu maa na nti booi li ti bia maa ka o nyu.
en: Then God allowed Hagar to see a well of water. So she went to the well and filled her bag with water. Then she gave water to the boy to drink.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ naɣilaa la na nti mal o min o yiŋnim daalahichi sanyoo sara, ka o ti kɔrigi naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: Then Aaron will offer the bull as a sin offering for himself. He will purify himself and his family. He will kill the bull for the sin offering for himself.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: These are the Gadite clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: ka bɛ daa bi baŋ hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: They knew nothing about what was happening until the flood came and destroyed them all. It will be the same when the Son of Man comes.

dag: N Duuma, n ni paɣ a niriba balibu kam sani. N ni yili yila paɣ a zuliya balibu kam sani.
en: My Lord, I will praise you before all people. I will sing praises about you to every nation.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa kaman Naa Ahaz ni daa be Damaskus ka tim ti wuh o shɛm zaa la. Ka maligumaana Yuria daa me sara maligu bimbini maa naai pɔi ka Naa Ahaz naanyi yi Damaskus kuna.
en: Then Uriah the priest built an altar just like the model King Ahaz had sent him from Damascus. Uriah the priest built the altar this way before King Ahaz came back from Damascus.

dag: Ka Yisahaku tumtumdiba daa ka o sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o bɛ ni gbi kɔbil shɛli yɛla, ka yɛli, Ti nya kom.
en: Later that same day Isaac's servants came and said, We've struck water.

dag: Bɛ bɔbindimi gindi liɣa, ka ka firila, ka o chɛ ka bɛ ʒiɛhiri gindi kaman nir ni nyu dam kul la.
en: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.

dag: N lihila a tiliginsim min a ni lo ma alikauli maŋli shɛl la soli hal ka n nina ti fulim.
en: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa kana ti tuhi Judanima.
en: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, n ku deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, n ni chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa hal ni o nyɛvili tariga n dabili Dauda ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pii so ka o doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: Solomon is David's son, and David was my chosen leader, who did what I commanded. So I will let Solomon be king until he dies.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Ilaija binyɛr shɛli din daa yi o sani luna n-lab ti zani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: Then Elisha picked up the coat that had fallen from Elijah. He went back and stood beside the banks of the Jordan River.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su maa ni, ka n ti zaŋ dɔr biɛɣu niŋ so yil ni yi ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: the following regulations about houses affected by spreading mildew. If any of you find that the Lord has sent mildew on your house, then you must go and tell the priest about it.

dag: Yi zaa laɣimmiya na nti wum! Wun ŋuni n-lee pun yɛli dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla zali? Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so la ni niŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. O ni tuhi Babilɔnnim maa.
en: Gather yourselves, all of you, and listen. Who among you announced these things? The LORD loves him. He will do what God wants with Babylon and with the descendants of Chaldea.

dag: Ti bi zaŋ binshɛli sɔŋ gu so soli ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka so ku tooi nya ti taali ti tuma puuni.
en: We dont want people to find anything wrong with our work. So we do nothing that will be a problem to others.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla piɛɣu bee bua, di simdi ka di nyɛla piɛlaa bee bulaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: If you are offering one of your sheep or goats, it must be a male without any defects.

dag: Bɛ di ti kpuɣi pakoli bee n-kpuɣi paɣ so ŋun yi doo yili. Amaa di simdi ni bɛ ti kpuɣila paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Izraɛlnim zuliya ni bee bɛ ni tooi kpuɣi maligumaana pakoli.
en: They must not marry widows or divorced women, but only Israelite virgins. Priests may, however, marry the widows of other priests.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a ni a niŋ alibarika niŋ man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni din ni chɛ ka n daŋ kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni nyin Naawuni sani; dama nyini Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka a daalibarika kul ni be man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: I ask you to bless my descendants so that they will continue to enjoy your favor. You, Sovereign Lord , have promised this, and your blessing will rest on my descendants forever.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, ti naba ʒiɛla a dunoya ni.
en: And now we are here, standing inside the gates of Jerusalem!.

dag: ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la. Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha.
en: and the two will become one. So they are no longer two, but one.

dag: Ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam kum shɛli din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa na maa zuɣu, dama kum maa ni ti mii pam.
en: The famine will be so bad that no one will remember that once there had been plenty.

dag: Ka do so yi mali bidibiga ŋun nyɛ tipawumlilana ŋun bi deer o ba min o ma noli, ka bɛ yi darig o tibili o ni bi deeri bɛ yɛligu zuɣu.
en: A man might have a son who is stubborn and refuses to obey. This son does not obey his father or mother. They punish the son, but he still refuses to listen to them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Libina maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Risa.
en: They marched from Libnah and camped at Rissah.

dag: Ti mali yɛla pam ni ti yɛli ya zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo ka di mi kahigibu to, dama yi nyɛla suhutunanima.
en: We have many things to tell you about this. But it is hard to explain because you have stopped trying to understand.

dag: Yawɛ ni bi maani ninvuɣ shɛb taali laasabu mini yɔhiŋgu ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: It is a great blessing when the Lord says they are not guilty, when they dont try to hide their sins.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni baansi. Bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni duri ni tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa bi lan tumdi tuun shɛli pahi di zuɣu.
en: The Levites who were singers and leaders of their families stayed in the rooms at the Temple. They did not have to do other work because they were responsible for the work in the Temple day and night.

dag: Ka Iso daa je Yaakubu yɛlli, o ba ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ o ni la zuɣu. Ka Iso daa yɛli, Di ku lan yuui ka ti ba kpi, di saha n ni ku n tizo Yaakubu.
en: Esau hated Jacob, because his father had given Jacob the blessing. He thought, The time to mourn my father's death is near; then I will kill Jacob.

dag: Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ni ti tarigi n-kpalim zani Hɛshibɔn, dama buɣim yi Hɛshibɔn na ka buɣim niɛm yi naa Sihɔn yiŋ na. Di di Mɔabnim ninvuɣ zuɣuri, ka di duŋtaariba zuɣuŋmana.
en: Near the city of Heshbon, where Sihon once ruled, tired refugees stand in shadows cast by the flames of their burning city. Soon, the towns on other hilltops, where those warlike people live, will also go up in smoke.

dag: Saha paaya ni saria karibu piligi; Naawuni niriba mi n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn daŋ tooni saria karibu maa ni. Ka di yi piligi ti sani, wula ka di ni ti bahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sani?.
en: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba pinyaayi maa bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm naai, o daa yiɣisimi n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din miri nimaani nti wuhiri niriba ka yihiri ba waazu.
en: When Jesus finished teaching his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and preach in their cities.

dag: O mabia Hɛlɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔfa mini Imna ni Shɛlɛsh ni Amal.
en: His brother Helems family: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ʒi o dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntu mahili ni, ka Ɛhud ka o sanna ti yɛl o, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din yi Naawuni sanna ni n-yɛl a. Ka naa maa vaai yiɣis o ʒiishee zani.
en: Ehud approached him while he was sitting alone in his cool second-story room, and he said, I have a message from God for you. At that, Eglon got up from his throne.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara pam; dinzuɣu timiya Naawuni jilima yi niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: You have been bought and paid for, so honor God with your body.

dag: O daa zaŋla anzinfa din kpalim ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihita m-mali bansi din yɛn yili daantalisi la mini di mihi ka niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni.
en: He used one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels of silver to make the hooks for the posts, cover their tops, and make bands for them.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul zoori ka mali zuɣu Yawɛ mini salinim sani.
en: Each day, as Samuel grew older, the Lord was pleased with him, and so were the people.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa kpi dindali maa kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaanu. Ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Twenty-five thousand soldiers of Benjamin died that day, all of them experienced warriors.

dag: Javan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Rodanim.
en: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti ʒini saria karibu ʒiya n-fa o yiko maa, ka bah o yoli kahikahi.
en: Then the heavenly court will sit in judgment, take away his power, and destroy him completely.

dag: Di saha ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Firawuna, N teegi n galimi ni nyɛ shɛli zuŋɔ.
en: Then the wine servant remembered Joseph and said to Pharaoh, I remember something that happened to me.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti sab pa yuri buɣilimbuɣilinsi zuɣu yɛli, Ti woligi li di ko n-zaŋ tila Yawɛ. Ka saɣiduɣuri din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni ti leei din be kasi kaman la shɛŋa din ʒe sara maligu bimbini gbin la.
en: At that time even the harness bells of the horses will be inscribed with the words Dedicated to the Lord . The cooking pots in the Temple will be as sacred as the bowls before the altar.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ fɔɣi Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi ni bɛ zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: After that, he had Zedekiah's eyes put out and had him placed in chains to be taken to Babylonia.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Samsin; ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi, ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: The woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The boy grew up, and the LORD blessed him.

dag: Ka Isaka zuliya ni toondaannim daa doli Dɛbɔra; Isaka zuliya niriba maa daa ʒe Barak yim, ka dol o du o napɔŋkpahi siɣi vinvamli maa ni. Amaa Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: The rulers of Issachar came along with Deborah, and Issachar followed Barak into the valley. But the tribe of Reuben was no help at all!.

dag: Dama yi mi ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli pa talima n-tiligi ya biɛr yo shɛli yi ni daa deei yi yaannim san la ni pala din nyɛ binshɛŋa din saɣindi kaman anzinfa bee salima.
en: For you know what was paid to set you free from the worthless manner of life handed down by your ancestors. It was not something that can be destroyed, such as silver or gold;.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi gbibi alikauli.
en: Say to them: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Cursed are those who dont heed the terms of this covenant.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n firila, Yawɛ tiri ma neesim n zibisim ni.
en: You are my lamp, LORD; the LORD illumines my darkness.

dag: Nyini n-galisi, ka su yiko mini jilima ni nasara ni nam dariza zaa, dama nyini n-su binshɛɣukam din be zuɣusaa ni tiŋa. Yawɛ, nyini n-nya duhibu gari sokam zaa.
en: You are great and powerful, glorious, splendid, and majestic. Everything in heaven and earth is yours, and you are king, supreme ruler over all.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kikahi piɛbbu mini tɔbu zambu bubu dabisili din yɛn lu bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa mini bɛn wɔɣila din du pam zuɣu.
en: a day filled with the sound of war trumpets and the battle cry of soldiers attacking fortified cities and high towers.

dag: Pool daa bɔri ni o baɣisila Ɛfɛsus gari, dama o daa bi bɔri ni sangal shɛli ti taɣ o zali Ɛsha. O daa niŋdila yomyom ni di yi ni tooi nani ka o paai Jɛrusalɛm Pɛntikɔst dali.
en: Paul had already decided not to stop at Ephesus. He did not want to stay too long in Asia. He was hurrying because he wanted to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost if possible.

dag: Dama n ni moli Yawɛ yuli. Yɛlimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ galisim yɛla!.
en: Praise God as I speak the Lord s name!.

dag: Shafan bia Ɛlasa mini Hilikia bia Gɛmaria bɛn daa nyɛ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim shɛba Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza san la n-daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa mali chaŋ. Di daa yɛlimi.
en: It was delivered to Babylon by Elasah, Shaphans son, and Gemariah, Hilkiahs son—two men dispatched to Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar by King Zedekiah.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣila yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi;.
en: You must offer a burnt offering as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord . You must offer bull, ram, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka zaligubaŋdi so daa ti bɔri ni o zahim Yisa, ka yiɣisi zani bɔh o, Karimba, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Then an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. He said, Teacher, what must I do to get eternal life.

dag: Bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ka o leei maligumaana zan o ba zaani n-ni ti ye binyɛr piɛl kasi m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa.
en: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, A kul ku paɣi n naba hal abada. Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi bi paɣi a naba maa, shɛl lan ka m min a sunsuuni.
en: Peter said, No! You will never wash my feet. Jesus answered, If I dont wash your feet, you are not one of my people.

dag: Dama dabisi shɛŋa din daa daŋ di saha maa tooni puuni, so daa naan ku tooi bu ninsal paa bee n-zaŋ biŋkɔbigu tum tuun shɛli; ka so daa yi yɛn yi bee n-yɛn lab kpe na, bɛ mini bɛ dimnim kul varimi. Mani n-daa tuɣindi ba maa.
en: Before this time, there were no wages for people or animals; there was no relief from distress about going out or coming in, because I set everyone against their own neighbor.

dag: Zakaria min o maligumaanitab daa yi tumdila maligumaanitali tuma deeri taba.
en: One day Zechariah was doing his work as a priest in the Temple, taking his turn in the daily service.

dag: Wɔr sabila ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la daa zaŋ kpala nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la, ka wɔr piɛla ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka wɔr fufuhisi ni daa vɔri chɛchɛbun shɛl la mi zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: The chariot pulled by the black horses was going north to Babylonia, the white horses were going to the west, and the dappled horses were going to the country in the south.

dag: N nya mbusim, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so kum ni mali ka o bi nya tiwalli bee wain tiwala dira. Dama bɛ pun pɔhi wain tiwala mini fiig tiwala zaa.
en: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yaa, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa. Di yi nyɛla din tuhi dolibu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tah o ʒiishee?.
en: Should I try force? Try force on God? Should I take him to court? Could anyone make him go?.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ti baŋdiba maa salima mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli.
en: they should use gold, blue, purple, and deep red yarns and fine linen.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni shɛb bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee tɔɣisiri ti yɛri ni di kpalim biɛla ka ti ku lan nya o; ka di ti tooi biɛla ka ti lan nya o yaha maa; ka lan yɛri ni dama o labirila o Ba sani.
en: Some of the followers said to each other, What does he mean when he says, After a short time you wont see me. Then after another short time you will see me again? And what does he mean when he says, Because I am going to the Father.

dag: O ni ti ʒini kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun paɣiri neeri anzinfa la; o ni ti paɣi neei Lɛvi zuliya kaman bɛ ni paɣiri neeri salima mini anzinfa shɛm la, hal ka bɛ ti zaŋ pina din tuhi ti Yawɛ.
en: He will come to judge like one who refines and purifies silver. As a metalworker refines silver and gold, so the Lord 's messenger will purify the priests, so that they will bring to the Lord the right kind of offerings.

dag: Ka sapashinnim maa daa niŋ kaman maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa. Ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ bɛ niriba bɛn bi yɛn be tuma ni mini bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali n-ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada sanna.
en: The unit commanders did everything that Jehoiada the priest ordered. They each took charge of those men reporting for duty on the Sabbath as well as those going off duty on the Sabbath. They came to the priest Jehoiada.

dag: M bia, gbaam amaŋa ka chɛ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa.
en: My child, don't go with people like that. Stay away from them.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi tooi baŋ ni pa bɔrɔbɔro yɛla ka n yɛri maa? Ka daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: Dont you know that I wasnt talking about bread? But be on your guard for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: Silas mini Timoti ni daa yi Masidɔnia paai Pool sani, o nini daa kul moola waazu yihibu zuɣu, ka o yɛri Yɛhudianim ni Yisa n-shiri nyɛ Masia.
en: Once Silas and Timothy arrived from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself fully to the word, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

dag: O daa lan wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma balibu kam salima lahi ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma kam anzinfa lahi.
en: He gave instructions as to how much silver and gold was to be used for making the utensils.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Lala tuhiya! Hal alizin biɛri gba niŋdi yɛda lala, ka zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Do you believe that there is only one God? Good! The demons also believe—and tremble with fear.

dag: Ka n yi be bɛ ni ka a mi be n ni, dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini ni yɛlimaŋli, ka dunianim baŋ ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na, ka lan baŋ ni a yuri bɛn niŋ ma yɛda maa kaman a ni yuri ma shɛm.
en: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ yuli jilima din simd o, zaŋmiya pina ka o jɛmbu duu na!.
en: Praise the Lord 's glorious name; bring an offering and come into his Temple.

dag: Amaa Lɔt ni daa ti yi Sɔdom dindahin shɛli, ka buɣim ni chilibi buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: But on the very day Lot left Sodom, fiery flames poured down from the sky and killed everyone.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka pii ya leeg o niriba;.
en: Brothers and sisters, you are loved by God, and we know that he has chosen you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a ti ŋma a zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yili tia ka noonsi di a nimdi.
en: and in three days the king will cut off your head. He will hang your body on a pole, and birds will come and peck at it.

dag: Di daa ti lu Farisiinim tibili ni ni Yisa nyari nyaandoliba pam baptaiziri ba n-gari Jɔn Baptaizira.
en: Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard the report that he was making and baptizing more followers than John.

dag: Di saha ka na so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam ni ti yiɣisi n-di nam su o nam sulinsi ni yiko, ka tumd o ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then a heroic king will appear. He will rule over a huge empire and do whatever he wants.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni di wahala pam, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani, o yurilim maŋli ni be bɛ sani.
en: The wicked will have to suffer, but those who trust in the Lord are protected by his constant love.

dag: Di saha ka buɣili Zius ŋun duu daa be tiŋ maa tooni la tindana daa bo naɣilahi mini vari n-ka tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni na ni o mini niriba maa ti kɔrigi mali ba.
en: The priest of the god Zeus, whose temple stood just outside the town, brought bulls and flowers to the gate, for he and the crowds wanted to offer sacrifice to the apostles.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn deei n noli, ka doli n zaligunima?.
en: Then the Lord said, Moses, how long will you people keep disobeying my laws and teachings?.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ doola anzinfa m-mali di dasara pa di dunɔpaɣisi zuɣu, ka dooi salima n-zaŋ mali di nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ mali di kuɣa, ka Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba zaŋ yurilim mali di puuni.
en: Its pillars he made of silver, its covering, cloth of gold, its cushions, royal purple; its interior inlaid with love. Daughters of Jerusalem.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi anabinim gbala, ka maani wuntizɔriba yɛla teebu binyara zaana.
en: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You make fine tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of those who lived good lives;.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, n ni wuɣ a mukuru pa a ninni, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam nya a zaɣim, ka nanim nya a ni di vi shɛm.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I am against you, Nineveh. I will pull your dress up over your face. I will let the nations see your naked body. The kingdoms will see your shame.

dag: Amaa yinim birigimi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ soli, ka yi wuhibu chɛ ka niriba pam tuui, yi saɣim n ni daa lo Lɛvi alikauli shɛli maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But now you priests have turned away from the right path. Your teaching has led many to do wrong. You have broken the covenant I made with you.

dag: Ka Abija daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o ba zaani. Asa ʒiɛmani maa ni, bɛ mini so daa bi tuhi tɔbu hal ni yuun pia.
en: Abijah died and was buried in Jerusalem. Then his son Asa became king, and Judah had ten years of peace.

dag: Shallum ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛl la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Shallums deeds and the conspiracy he plotted are written in the official records of Israels kings.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaanu.
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king of Judah. He was king for years in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidibisi shɛba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei namɔɣilisi ka bɛ be Babilɔn nayili.
en: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Foliŋga, niŋmi kom ŋɔ sunsuuni m-pirigi kom maa buyi.
en: God said, Let there be a dome in the middle of the waters to separate the waters from each other.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Masia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o ma Mariama ti Yisifu ka na bi kulis o la, ka bɛ ti nya o ka o malila pua Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah happened. His mother Mary was engaged to marry Joseph. But before they married, he learned that she was expecting a baby.

dag: Wummiya vuri! Wummiya, di kanna. Vuri pam n-yi nuzaa polo na ni di ti chɛ ka Juda fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka leei yɔbahi gɔbu shee.
en: Listen! The sound is getting louder, a mighty uproar from the land of the north; it will reduce the towns of Judah to ruins, a den for wild dogs.

dag: Di chɛ ka n lihiri binshɛŋa din ka buchi. Tim ma nyɛvili a soli zuɣu.
en: Dont let me look at worthless things. Help me live your way.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me o tɔbutuhiri bimbina tabili yi goma, ka zaŋ kpandi wurim yi binwɔɣila.
en: He will pound his battering ram against your walls; with crowbars he will tear down your towers.

dag: Di saha Naa Dauda daa bela zoli zuɣu birini puuni, ka Filistia tɔbbihi mi do Bɛtilihɛm.
en: At that time David was on a fortified hill, and a group of Philistines had occupied Bethlehem.

dag: ni Lɔd ni Ono din daa nyɛ Nuhi Tuumbaŋdiba Vinvamli la ni.
en: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni labi n-neei Naa Dauda yili din daa lu la. N ni lan me o dabɔɣu maa zali.
en: I, the Lord, will return and rebuild David's fallen house. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam binshɛɣukam, ka binshɛli daa kani ka o nam li ka Yɛligu maa nuu ka di ni.
en: And with this Word, God created all things. Nothing was made without the Word. Everything that was created.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ yiko mini dunia ŋɔ nama zaa zoosim ti Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nam maa ku mali tariga, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni ti kana ti tumdi tuma tiri ba, ka deei bɛ noli.
en: The power and greatness of all the kingdoms on earth will be given to the people of the Supreme God. Their royal power will never end, and all rulers on earth will serve and obey them.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl daa bo Damaskus binshɛɣukam n-ʒili laakumnim pihinahi chaŋ ni o ti puhi Naawuni nir maa. Ka Hazaɛl daa paai ti zani Ilaisha tooni ka yɛl o, A bia Siria Naa Bɛnhadad n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti bɔh a nya o ni kpaŋ o barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: Hazael left with forty camel loads of the best things made in Damascus as a gift for Elisha. He found the prophet and said, Your servant, King Benhadad, wants to know if he will get well.

dag: Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa pa buŋ maa nyaampara ti o ka o ba.
en: The old prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey. They put the saddle on the donkey, and the prophet left.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yɛli, Ti Naawuni m-bɔŋɔ! Ti pun guhir o mi ni o tiligi ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni pun guhiri so la m-bala. Chɛliya ka ti mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ti maa zuɣu.
en: At that time people will say, Here is our God! He is the one we have been waiting for. He has come to save us. We have been waiting for our Lord . So we will rejoice and be happy when he saves us.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa yɛli Anabi Musa, N ni niŋ ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nirilim, ka zo ninvuɣ so n ni bɔri nambɔɣu.
en: He says to Moses, Ill have mercy on whomever I choose to have mercy, and Ill show compassion to whomever I choose to show compassion .

dag: Ʒiɛnya yim yi yɛda niŋbu puuni ka zaɣis o, dama yi mi ni yi mabihi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nyarila wahala shɛŋa yi gba ni nyari maa tatabo.
en: Resist him, standing firm in the faith. Do so in the knowledge that your fellow believers are enduring the same suffering throughout the world.

dag: Babilɔnnim zuɣu, dama bɛ daa zɔr ba mi, Nɛtania bia Ishimail ni daa ku Ahikam bia Gɛdalia so Babilɔn naa ni daa zaŋ leei tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna la zuɣu.
en: because they were afraid of what the Babylonians would do when they found out that Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, had killed Gedaliah, Ahikams son, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the region.

dag: Dama n daa yi zabirila karimbaannim nyuli. N daa nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni tɔŋdi shɛm.
en: I saw that wicked people were successful, and I became jealous of those proud people.

dag: Dina n-ni ti chɛ ka yi niŋ n shɛhiranima.
en: This will provide you with an opportunity to testify.

dag: Daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tusaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: There were , trained soldiers, all under the command of , clan leaders. These powerful troops protected the king against any enemy.

dag: Dama alikauli maa nyɛla yi mini yi bihi zaŋ tabili bɛn be katiŋ ha ka nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ni na yɛn boli ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dini.
en: This promise is for you. It is also for your children and for the people who are far away. It is for everyone the Lord our God calls to himself.

dag: ni Abiɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Anatɔt nir la ni Mɛbunai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la.
en: Abiezer from Anathoth; Mebunnai the Hushathite.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n yi ni tooi? A bi mi ni binshɛɣukam zaa nandi ŋun niŋ yɛda sani.
en: Jesus replied, Why do you say if you can? Anything is possible for someone who has faith.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa bi tim o Bia maa dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti karila dunianim saria, amaa ni dunianim lee ti tiligi o zuɣu.
en: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!.

dag: Amaa Azazɛl kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la ŋuna o ni ti zaŋ o la zaɣ nɛɔŋ ti Yawɛ n-yo bɛ daalahichi samli, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi mɔɣu ni nti ti Azazɛl.
en: The goat chosen for Azazel shall be presented alive to the Lord and sent off into the desert to Azazel, in order to take away the sins of the people.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ni o bɔri shɛli ka di shiri niŋ, ka di pala ti Duuma n-zal li?.
en: The will of the Lord alone is always carried out.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, Zomiya n sani! dama Yawɛ wum n kumsi maa;.
en: Get away from me, all you evildoers, because the LORD has heard me crying!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini bɛ zaa teensi pirigilipirigili bahi ka chɛ pirigilipirigili, ka daa lan ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu bahi ka chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Hanun seized David's messengers, shaved off one side of their beards, cut off their clothes at the hips, and sent them away.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli ba, Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim; ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.

dag: tutuɣu daa na kani, ka binshɛli mi daa na bi bili yi tiŋgban ni na, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa bi chɛ ka saa mira, ka so mi daa kani kɔra;.
en: no grass or plants were growing anywhere. God had not yet sent any rain, and there was no one to work the land.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ninvuɣ kubo.
en: For from the inside, from your heart, come the evil ideas which lead you to do immoral things, to rob, kill.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpaai kom bahina; ka saa daa tahira, ka a saa nyaɣisibu piɛma nyaɣisiri gindi luɣilikam zaa.
en: The clouds poured water, the skies cracked thunder; your arrows were flying all around!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani miri Gibia.
en: So the next morning, the Israelites got up and camped near Gibeah.

dag: ka sɔŋmiya taba. Yi ni so yi mali yɛli shɛli ni o kpee, yin chɛliya tab taali paŋ taba; di niŋ kamaata ni yi chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman ti Duuma ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba shɛm la.
en: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni pam, dama lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn tuhi yi dimnim shɛb zaa.
en: Then Joshua said to his officers, Don't be afraid or discouraged. Be determined and confident because this is what the Lord is going to do to all your enemies.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ pin kasinim maa, ka di kpɛhi ba alahichi ni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord , the one who makes these offerings holy.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔ kul yɛn beni? A kul yɛn sɔɣimi sahakam? A yɛn chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili be kaman buɣim la hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: Lord , how long will this continue? Will you ignore us forever? Will your anger burn like a fire forever?.

dag: Miriya ka yi me napɔna dubu shee n-zali n sara maligu bimbini gbini n-dur li din ni chɛ ka so nya yi zaɣim. .
en: And don't build an altar that requires steps; you might expose yourself when you climb up.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa taai bahi Musa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, Ti yi di daa pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu kpi Yawɛ tooni, di naan so.
en: Then the people confronted Moses and said to him, If only we too had died when our brothers perished in the LORDs presence!.

dag: Ka sana yi be yi ni, ka bɔri ni o puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, ŋun doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa kaya mini di zaligu soli puhi li. Yinim tiŋbihi mini saamba bɛn be yi ni zaa doliya zaligu yini.
en: Anyone, including foreigners who live among you, can celebrate Passover, if they follow all the regulations.

dag: ka din pahi pisinaayi daa gbaai Gidalit min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Twenty-second, there were men chosen from Giddaltis sons and relatives.

dag: Kalim bɛn zaa nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni.
en: You will enroll those from to years old, all who are eligible for service to do work in the dwelling.

dag: Wuntizɔriba firilanim kul nɛmi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri firilanim kpira.
en: The righteous are like a light shining brightly; the wicked are like a lamp flickering out.

dag: Sool chandi maa dazɔhigu dali, Yawɛ daa pun daŋ kahigi wuhi Samuɛl yɛli.
en: Now the day before Saul came, the LORD had revealed the following to Samuel.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Manaasa zuliya pirigili la kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses provided for half the tribe of Manasseh. It was for the clans in half the tribe of the people of Manasseh.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je wuntizɔriba ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: But troubles will kill the wicked. The enemies of those who live right will all be punished.

dag: O ni daa ti neei kum ni la nyaaŋa ka o nyaandoliba teei ni o daa pun yɛli yɛlli ŋɔ zali; ka daa niŋ Naawuni Kundi mini Yisa ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa yɛda.
en: So when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered that he had said this, and they believed the scripture and what Jesus had said.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ nabihi naani.
en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to depend on human leaders.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha, ka wuhi shihira din nyɛ ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi dunia tiŋgbani puuni;.
en: I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii shɛb maa n-daa nyɛ: Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria. Bɛ mi zaa daa yi la Juda zuliya ni na.
en: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Ti yi bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a ni a yɛli ti ka ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ ŋun dim shɛhira jɛndi ti.
en: Then they said to Jeremiah, May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we fail to do everything that the LORD your God tells us through you.

dag: Ti ni daa deei Musa noli shɛlikam ni shɛm, lala ka ti yɛn deeg a noli, amaa ti lee suhirimi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ be a sani kaman o ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la!.
en: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yili yilli ŋɔ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yɛli, Ti tiŋ ŋɔ mali yaa! Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun guli di goma!.
en: On that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: Ours is a strong city! God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.

dag: N daa bi ʒini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sani, m mi daa bi mali suhupiɛlli; a daa chɛ ka n ʒila n ko, dama a daa chɛ ka n suhu miligi pam.
en: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.

dag: Di saha Sool daa pun zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la n-ti do so ŋun yuli booni Paliti ka o nyɛ Laishi Gallim nir bia la.
en: David was also married to Sauls daughter Michal, but Saul had taken her away from him and had given her to a man named Palti, son of Laish. Palti was from the town named Gallim.

dag: ka bi zaŋ li ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni na ti mal li ti Yawɛ, bɛn yihim dilan Yawɛ niriba ni.
en: without bringing it to the meeting tents entrance in order to offer it to the LORD will be cut off from their people.

dag: Ti malila ti tizɔpaɣa, ka o biha bi yaɣi lala. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa, dɔbba yi ti kana ti bɔr o?.
en: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What should we do for our sister when a man comes asking to marry her?.

dag: A suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti kpe n tibili ni zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo tu a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige niŋ a nol ni ŋ-ŋmalig a bah a ni doli so shɛli kana zuɣu.
en: And because you rage against me and because your pride has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose, and my bit in your mouth. I will make you go back the same way you came.

dag: Dama bɛ zo n-kpɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka niŋ yomyom ni bɛ ku niriba.
en: because their feet run to evil; they hurry to spill blood.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi zaligu din tahi nyɛvili din be Yisa Masia ni na nti ti ti la yihi ma alahichi mini kum zaligu taali ni.
en: That is because in Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit that brings life made you free. It made you free from the law that brings sin and death.

dag: Paɣ ŋɔ niŋ ma o kpiɔŋ tariga, dama o zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma n-gula n sɔɣibu.
en: She did what she could; she poured perfume on my body to prepare it ahead of time for burial.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai, ka ti yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣili noli luɣ shɛli ti ni daa tɛhi ni Naawuni suhibu shee be n-daa ti ʒini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim sani n-tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then on the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to a place by the river, where we thought there would be a Jewish meeting place for prayer. We sat down and talked with the women who came.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ma, Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kɔba maa, Yinim kɔb kuma ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: He said to me, Prophesy over these bones, and say to them, Dry bones, hear the LORDs word!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: N niriba bɛn be Ziɔn, di zɔriya Asirianim dabiɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti zaŋ fiɛbisi fiɛbiri ya, ka kpuɣi jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛbiri ya kaman Ijiptinim ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: The Sovereign Lord Almighty says to his people who live in Zion, Do not be afraid of the Assyrians, even though they oppress you as the Egyptians used to do.

dag: amaa bɛ daa ka bia, dama Ɛlizabɛt daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo m-pahi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa lan kurigi pam.
en: They had no children because Elizabeth was unable to become pregnant and they both were very old.

dag: N kul kuhirimi bɔri sɔŋsim hal ni asiba. O bemi kaman gbuɣinli la n-kul ŋmari n kɔba wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul ŋmaarila n nyɛvili.
en: All night I cried as loud as a lion, but my hopes were crushed like a lion eating bones. You finished my life in such a short time.

dag: Ka so yi je o kpee ka daag o luhi bee n-zaŋ bini lab o bee n-sɔɣi dɔni gu o ku o.
en: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyara ni, ka lan mi dari zaŋ kpe m-mali binyɛra mini nuhi tuumbaŋsim kam.
en: cut stones for setting; carve wood; and do every kind of work.

dag: Dama alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yɔhim ma ku ma di zuɣu.
en: Sin seized the opportunity through the commandment, deceived me, and killed me.

dag: Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jafilɛtinim tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Bɛtihɔrɔnnim tiŋgbani din daa be zolɔŋni la m-mali lala hal ni Gɛza n-yi nimaani chaŋ ti naai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: It goes down westward to the border of the Japhletites as far as the border of Lower Beth-horon and as far as Gezer. It ends at the sea.

dag: mini nɛma balibu kam ni pali yiya shɛŋa, ka di pala yinima n-zaŋ li niŋ di ni ni kɔbil shɛŋa din gbi n-doya, ka di pala yinima n-gbi li ni wain tihi mini olivi tihi puri, ka di pala yinima n-sa li, ka yi yi ti di n-tiɣi.
en: He will give you houses full of good things that you did not put there. He will give you wells that you did not dig. He will give you vineyards and olive trees that you did not plant, and you will have plenty to eat.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Jɔn mabia Jeemsi.
en: He ordered soldiers to cut off the head of James, the brother of John.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Bɛtani Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ kɔŋlan la yiŋa.
en: Jesus was in Bethany at the house of Simon the leper.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa daa niŋ ba mi n-leei yɛliŋmahima, ka di sabi zali tinim bɛn be ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ni wuhibu zuɣu.
en: These things happened to them as an example and were written as a warning for us to whom the end of time has come.

dag: Amaa saha shɛlikam yi yi ti bɔra, yi ni tooi kɔri yi biŋkɔbiri ŋubi yi tin shɛŋa ni yi ni be kaman Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni shɛm; bɛn be kasi mini bɛn bi be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub li kaman yi ni ŋubiri kparibuhi bee wolisi shɛm la.
en: Whenever you want to eat meat, you can enjoy that blessing from the Lord your God wherever you live. You can butcher the animal just as you do gazelles and deer, and anyone, clean or unclean, can eat it.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo din daa pahiri buyi la, bɛ daa malila dapaɣa pisi.
en: They made twenty frames for the north side of the Tent.

dag: ka dihi ti nam n-zaŋ ti leei maligumaaniba ni ti jɛmd o Ba Naawuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu, ka simdi ni o su yiko hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: He made us his kingdom and priests who serve God his Father. To Jesus be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni deei n noli ka gbibi n daalikauli, n ni zaŋ ya leei n dahalali niriba zuliya kam sunsuuni, dama mani n-su dunia zaa.
en: So now I tell you to obey my commands and keep my agreement. So if you do this, you will be my own special people. The whole world belongs to me, but I am choosing you to be my own special people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti be o ni ka o gba be ti ni. Dina n-nyɛ: O ni zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Shia ti ti la zuɣu.
en: This is how we know we remain in him and he remains in us, because he has given us a measure of his Spirit.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai, ka o teeg o nuhi min o naba wuhi ba.
en: He said this and showed them his hands and his feet.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses did exactly as the LORD commanded him.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla, di daa chɛ ka alahichi tumbu galisi; amaa alahichi tumbu ni galisi shɛm maa Naawuni daalibarika galisiya gari lala.
en: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai tab bɔhibu ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yino ŋun yɛn niŋ lala maa.
en: Then they began to ask among themselves which one of them it could be who was going to do this.

dag: Niŋmiy o larigim ka miriya ka yi kul chaŋ mir o yiŋ dunoli.
en: Stay on a path that is far from her; dont approach the entrance to her house.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ti bahi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti? Bɛ ni gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bihi chaŋ; ti yi di lab Ijipti, di di bi so.
en: Why is the LORD bringing us to this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our children will be taken by force. Wouldnt it be better for us to return to Egypt.

dag: Ti daa bi deei shɛli so sani ka bi yo di zuɣu, amaa ti daa kul tumdila wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku ʒi yi ni so zuɣu.
en: We did not accept anyone's support without paying for it. Instead, we worked and toiled; we kept working day and night so as not to be an expense to any of you.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa galisiya pam. Dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda niŋbu mini yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni baŋsim ni nimmoo niŋbu shɛlikam ni ni yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ ti sani. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi gba ni niŋdi shɛm galisi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ni.
en: You are so rich in all you have: in faith, speech, and knowledge, in your eagerness to help and in your love for us. And so we want you to be generous also in this service of love.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi nya, ka wum malaika bɔbili bɛn nyɛ tusatusa paai shɛm kukoya. Bɛ daa ʒe n-gilila nam ʒiishee maa ni binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la.
en: Then I looked, and I heard the sound of many angels surrounding the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. They numbered in the millions—thousands upon thousands.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, di zɔri ba bee n-zɔri bɛ yɛtɔɣa dabiɛm. Hal di yi nyɛla suligunyinyari bee gɔhi gil a, ka a be nɔnsi sunsuuni, nyin di zɔri bɛ yɛtɔɣa bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: And as for you, human one, dont be afraid of them or their words. Dont be afraid! You possess thistles and thorns that subdue scorpions. Dont be afraid of their words or shrink from their presence, because they are a household of rebels.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim n ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ninni maa sani.
en: But that would have disgraced me, because many other nations had seen me bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Yɛlim daba la gba ni bɛ deemi bɛ duumanim noya, ka tumdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini binshɛɣukam zaa puuni; ka di ŋmɛri ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: And tell this to those who are slaves: They should be willing to serve their masters at all times; they should try to please them, not argue with them;.

dag: Ka Uzia daa chɛ ka bɛ kuri nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana ni kuriti woliɣisi ni kuriti gbaɣinɔnima ni tɔbiri ni kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa n-ti tɔbbihi maa zaa.
en: Uzziah supplied the entire force with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and sling stones.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu, dilana kpɛhil o paɣ maa zina niŋbu ni, ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣ paɣiyihiŋ maa gba niŋ zina.
en: But now I tell you: if a man divorces his wife for any cause other than her unfaithfulness, then he is guilty of making her commit adultery if she marries again; and the man who marries her commits adultery also.

dag: Yɛligim a suɣili. Di niŋ zinchili. Kpam a kpahi ka di kpɛma, ka voog a mihi ka di kpaŋ.
en: Enlarge the site of your tent, and stretch out the drapes of your dwellings; dont hold back. Lengthen your tent ropes and strengthen your stakes.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa ni na. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: Then there was a sound from above the dome over their heads. They stood still, and their wings came to rest.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma kpe na.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Build seven altars here, then bring seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: N daa yi chaŋ tiŋ puuni dunɔdali gbini nti zaŋ n kuɣ zali laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Whenever the city elders met and I took my place among them.

dag: Anabi Ilaija daa nyɛla ninsala kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka o daa ti suhi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa ni saa di mi, ka saa maa daa shiri bi tɔɣisi lu tiŋgbani zuɣu yuun muna ata ni pirigili.
en: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.

dag: Amaa lee maliyala suhupiɛlli yi mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka yi suhuri ti paligi, ka yi tooi mali suhupiɛlli pam saha shɛl o jilima yi ti yi palo la.
en: Rather be glad that you are sharing Christ's sufferings, so that you may be full of joy when his glory is revealed.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa, ka bɛ daa kum pam.
en: Moses spoke these words to all the Israelites, and the people mourned bitterly.

dag: A min a zuliya maa ni yɛn doli n daalikauli shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni yi puuni doo kam guni.
en: As the sign that you are keeping this promise, you must circumcise every man and boy in your family.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, N ni daa ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira so zuɣu la n-lan neei kum ni na maa.
en: Herod heard these things about Jesus. He said, I killed John by cutting off his head. Now he has been raised from death.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o tɔbu n-darigi li ni o kpiɔŋ zaa n-to Jɔram bɔɣusapima sunsuuni, ka piɛm maa chaŋ ti gbaag o suhu, ka o lɛb lu o chɛchɛbuŋ puuni.
en: But Jehu grabbed his bow and shot Joram in the middle of his back, through the heart. Joram fell dead in his chariot.

dag: ka kaɣ yi kpaŋ ha kaman nir ni ni tooi to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti lu luɣ shɛli tariga ti ʒini, ka yɛli, N je ni n nini nya bia ŋɔ bahibu. O ni daa kaɣ yi kpaŋa nti ʒiya ka chɛ o maa, ka duh o yee kuhi.
en: Then she sat down a long way off, because she could not bear to watch him die. And she cried bitterly.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti? Di tam ti wahala dibu mini ti nahiŋgu ŋɔ yɛla!.
en: Why are you hiding from us? Don't forget our suffering and trouble!.

dag: M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini. .
en: Father, if you are willing, please dont make me drink from this cup. But do what you want, not what I want.

dag: Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ saɣim yimaŋa.
en: I am the Lord your God, and you must keep yourselves holy, because I am holy.

dag: Baŋsim puuni ka bɛ zaŋdi neen viɛla mini azichi nɛma paani duri.
en: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisa ni daa ti paai kaman yuun pihita, ka o daa piligi o tuma, ka niriba daa tɛhi ni o nyɛla Yisifu bia. Yisifu daa nyɛla Hɛli bia.
en: When Jesus began to teach, he was about years old. People thought that Jesus was Josephs son. Joseph was the son of Eli.

dag: Ɛlifaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfi ni Gatam ni Kɛnaz ni Timna ni Amalɛk.
en: Eliphazs sons were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz. Also Eliphaz and Timna had a son named Amalek.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn, ka zo n-yi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-be kaman bulahi m-be tooni mali bɛ tab chan la.
en: Run away from Babylon. Leave the land of the Babylonians. Be like the goats that lead the flock.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut yidan ma Naomi daa ti yɛl o, Di simdi ni m bo soli n-sɔŋ a ka a nya doo kuli, ka di chɛ ka a gba mal a dintoli biɛhigu shee.
en: One day, Naomi said to Ruth: It's time I found you a husband, who will give you a home and take care of you.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam neesim titaŋa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He made the sun and the moon; his love is eternal;.

dag: Ti bi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm tariga ti ni daa ka yi sanna la puuni; dama tinima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui zaŋ Masia lahibal suŋ na ti tin ya.
en: We arent going out of bounds, as if our work area doesnt extend as far as you. We were the first ones to travel as far as Corinth with the gospel of Christ.

dag: Doo zabiri yi guhi, o nyɛla ŋun mali zuɣupalo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: A man might begin to lose the hair on his head. It is only baldness, so he is clean.

dag: Fomiya ti Duuma Yawɛ tooni, d amaa Yawɛ dabisili la miriya. Yawɛ niŋla sara maligu shili, o mal o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Hush before the LORD God, for the day of the LORD is near! The LORD has established a sacrifice; he has made holy those he has summoned.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔ ka a lee nya maa? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala gbaŋ ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: The angel asked me what I saw. I answered, A scroll flying through the air; it is thirty feet long and fifteen feet wide.

dag: Nyini n dan naa m-bahi noli ka tuuni ŋɔ tum, ka bi yɛli tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ŋun yɛn ʒini a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: If this message was from my master the king, you didnt make it known to your servant. Who should follow you on the throne of my master the king.

dag: Ka a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni, .
en: If your foot causes you to sin, chop it off. You would be better off to go into life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mali sariakaribo nyolɔrigu viɛnyɛliŋga kaman yi ni yɛn she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm, di simdi ka a ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: Make the judgment pouch for the high priest. Skilled workers should make this pouch just as they made the ephod. They must use gold threads, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn.

dag: ka kaɣ yi kpaŋ ha kaman nir ni ni tooi to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti lu luɣ shɛli tariga ti ʒini, ka yɛli, N je ni n nini nya bia ŋɔ bahibu. O ni daa kaɣ yi kpaŋa nti ʒiya ka chɛ o maa, ka duh o yee kuhi.
en: She walked away from him about as far as a bow shot and sat down, telling herself, I cant bear to see the boy die. She sat at a distance, cried out in grief, and wept.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ Ribɛka yiŋ dabipaɣ la daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o oki ti shɛli din daa be Bɛtɛl tiŋli la gbini. Ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Kumsi tia.
en: Rebekahs nurse Deborah died and was buried at Bethel under the oak, and Jacob named it Allon-bacuth.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum bee kɔnyuri mal a bee ka a nyɛ sana bee n-chani gbinfini bee ka a biɛra bee m-be sarika ni, ka ti baɣa ka a ni.
en: Then they will reply, Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and didnt do anything to help you.

dag: Ulam bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Bɛdan. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Giliad bihi, ka Giliad nyɛ Makiri bia, ka Makiri mi nyɛ Manaasa bia.
en: Ulams son was Bedan. These were the descendants of Gilead. Gilead was Makirs son. Makir was Manassehs son.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by Gods will, and Timothy our brother.
