dag: ka tulim maa daa kpe daadamnim pam hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni ŋun su alɔbo balibu kam maa fukumsi la, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba n-ti o jilima.
en: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.

dag: So ku lan wum girigiri yɛla yi tiŋgban ni. Ka so mi ku lan saɣim yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yaha. N ni be kaman gooni la n-taɣi ya ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu; ka yi paɣi ma n ni tiligi ya zuɣu.
en: The sounds of violence will be heard no more; Destruction will not shatter your country again. I will protect and defend you like a wall; You will praise me because I have saved you.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka bɔ n-lee bala.
en: Amazed and confused, they kept asking each other, What does this mean.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-nyɛ yɛndana ni baŋda? Di simdi ni o zaŋ o biɛrisuntali n-wuh o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm tarimtali yɛm puuni.
en: Are there any among you who are really wise and understanding? Then you should show your wisdom by living right. You should do what is good with humility. A wise person does not boast.

dag: Ka o daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom; o daa ʒili tɔbbihi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣilikam. Ka Ɛdomnim maa zaa daa leei ŋun Dauda ni su shɛba. Ka Yawɛ daa kul tiri Dauda nasara luɣ shɛlikam zaa o ni chaŋ.
en: He set up forts in Edom, and all the Edomites became Davids subjects. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.

dag: Bidib bil so n-naɣ be kpe m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi, amaa ka bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ salo ŋɔ zaa.
en: There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people.

dag: Ka zaŋya Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ tɔroko maa ni, ka zaŋ salima binyara din nyɛ yi daalahichi sanyoo pini la zali baɣili di luɣili ni n-daai li bahi n-chɛ ka di chaŋ di ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: Then put the chest on the cart. Put the gold rats and sores into a bag and put it on the cart next to the chest. Then send it on its way.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛli Tama, Zaŋmi bindirigu maa kpɛhi n dugbɛrili puuni nti gbib li a nuu ni ka n di. Ka Tama daa zaŋ o ni mali mahi shɛŋa maa kpɛh o tizɔdoo Amnɔn dugbɛrili maa ni.
en: Then he said to her, Bring the cakes here to my bed and serve them to me yourself. She took the cakes and went over to him.

dag: o ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim bɛ sani, ka be kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka wuntaŋ puhi na asiba ka o neesim be shɛm la; ka be kaman saa ni yi mi ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni yina shɛm la.
en: is like the light of sunrise on a morning with no clouds, like the bright gleam after the rain that brings grass from the ground.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba binshɛɣukam.
en: He answered: I have explained the secret about God's kingdom to you, but for others I can use only stories.

dag: Nyɛvili din ka bahigu maa nyɛla ni ninsalinim baŋ nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli ŋɔ, ka baŋ man Yisa Masia so a ni timna la.
en: And this is eternal life: that people can know you, the only true God, and that they can know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti darigi yiko shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa tibili, ka darigi dunia ŋɔ nanim tibili.
en: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.

dag: Amaa yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma zahindi maa mini di gbinni, yi ni nya pina mini laara ni jilima pam n sani. Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma zahindi maa, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: But if you can tell me both the dream and its meaning, I will reward you with gifts and great honor. Now then, tell me what the dream was and what it means.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna daa duh o bɔɣiri zuɣusaa kpa niriba maa polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka daa yi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni suhudoo sara malibu shee maa siɣina.
en: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.

dag: N ni yɛl a jilima din galisi ŋɔ min a tibiginsim yɛla, ka tɛh a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: Your majesty and glory are wonderful. I will tell about your miracles.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya niriba ayi o sani. Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija.
en: Two men, Moses and Elijah, were talking with him.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o daalibarika zuɣu ka o pii ba, dindina di pala bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu. Ka di yi nyɛla bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu, dindina alibarika maa naan ku lan nyɛla alibarika yaha.
en: But if it is by grace, it isnt by whats done anymore. If it were, Gods grace wouldnt be grace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ni bɛ ti boli Naa Hɛzɛkia na. Ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun mi daa su bɛ ni sab gban shɛŋa sɔŋ tuma la daa yi bɛ sanna.
en: These men called for the king, but Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Shebna, and Joah son of Asaph went out to meet them. Eliakim was the palace manager, Joah was the record keeper, and Shebna was the royal secretary.

dag: Daamiya maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim bɛ buɣa bin wɔɣila la, ka nyo bɛ wuni Ashɛra binnana la buɣim, ka lala chɛ ka yi kpihim bɛ yuli nimaani.
en: Rip down their altars and shatter their sacred stones. Burn their sacred poles with fire. Hack their gods idols into pieces. Wipe out their names from that place.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la? Ka bɛ zaa yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate said, Then what should I do with Jesus who is called Christ? They all said, Crucify him.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ saha shɛli yin ni nya o. Suhimiy o saha shɛli o ni miri ya.
en: So you should look for the Lord before it is too late. You should call to him now, while he is near.

dag: Kaman yim bee buyi ka kɔhigɔriba mini bɛn kɔhiri nɛma balibu kam daa kana ti gbe Jɛrusalɛm gooni maa sambani polo.
en: One or two times, traders and merchants had to stay the night outside Jerusalem.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku la, n ni zaŋ li ti a, ka ni lan zaŋ li ti a zuliya a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: I will give you the land which I gave to Abraham and to Isaac, and I will also give it to your descendants after you.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa kpalim be Jɛhɔshɛba sani n-sɔɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu, ka Atalia daa diri nam su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.

dag: Ka o ye binyɛr shɛl din ŋam ʒim, ka o yuli daa booni Naawuni Yɛligu.
en: The robe he wore was covered with blood. His name is The Word of God.

dag: Amaa faɣiri dibu zuɣu yi zaŋdi bɛn mali taali bahira, ka lee mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli.
en: But for just a bribe you let the guilty go free, and you keep the innocent from getting justice.

dag: Masia gba daa bi pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima. Naawuni n-daa lee piig o ka yɛl o: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: In the same way Christ also didnt promote himself to become high priest. Instead, it was the one who said to him, You are my Son. Today I have become your Father .

dag: Ka pako so daa be tiŋ maa ni n-kul ʒe n-kan o sanna waawaayili nti yɛr o, Karimi ti saria ŋɔ ti ma nasara, ka chɛ n dim ŋɔ.
en: In that city there was a widow who kept coming to him, asking, Give me justice in this case against my adversary.

dag: Ka sagbani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka maligumaaniba ku tooi tum bɛ tuma, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pali jɛmbu duu maa zaa.
en: The priests were unable to carry out their duties on account of the cloud because the LORDs glory filled Gods temple.

dag: ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la. Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha.
en: He becomes like one person with his wife. Then they are no longer two people, but one.

dag: M mabihi, n kul bela kum barina ni dabisili kam. N ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ ti ni mali biɛhigu shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛl lala maa.
en: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga bol o yuli Samuɛl, dama Hanna daa yɛlimi, N suh o la Yawɛ sani.
en: By that time the following year, Hannah had become pregnant and had a son. She named him Samuel. She said, His name is Samuel because I asked the Lord for him.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: This is why I sent him to you, so that youll know all about us and so he can encourage your hearts.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba daa yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni n-chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ kana ti muɣisir a maa.
en: His servants said to him, We know that an evil spirit sent by God is tormenting you.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ba yɛlimaŋtali mini maŋgbibbu ni zaadali saria karibu yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbaai Gomna Filiksi ka o yɛli Pool, Na yim pɔi; n yi ti lan nya dahima, n ni bol a.
en: But Felix was frightened when Paul started talking to them about doing right, about self-control, and about the coming judgment. So he said to Paul, That's enough for now. You may go. But when I have time I will send for you.

dag: Yi yi chaŋ, yi ni nya ka niriba maa nyɛla bɛn ka zilisigu. Di nyɛla tiŋgban titali, ka nir ni bɔri binshɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni be di ni; yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni mi zaŋ li tin ya.
en: When you come to that place, you will see that there is plenty of land. There is plenty of everything there. You will also see that the people are not expecting an attack. Surely God has given that land to us.

dag: Gbib ma ka n tiligi, ka kul dol a zaligunim sahakam.
en: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.

dag: Yawɛ yi bahi li noli, wula ka di lee yɛn tooi fo? O zal li mi ni di liri Ashikɛlɔnnim mini bɛn be teeku noli.
en: How can you be silent when the LORD has directed you to attack Ashkelon and the coast line?.

dag: O daa va malaika n-nyaŋ o, ka kuhi niŋ o n-suh o bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka o daa ti nya Naawuni Bɛtɛl, ka Naawuni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: Jacob wrestled with Gods angel and won. He cried and asked for a favor. That happened at Bethel. There he spoke to us.

dag: Lɛvi mabia Asaf ŋun daa be o nudirigu polo jɛmbu duu maa ni la daa nyɛla Bɛrɛkia bia, ka Bɛrɛkia nyɛ Shimia bia.
en: Asaph was leader of the second choir. His family line went back to Levi as follows: Asaph, Berechiah, Shimea.

dag: Buɣim mini sakuɣa ni gulisigu ni sanʒiɛɣu din deer o noli, paɣimiy o!.
en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, strong winds that obey his command.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na. .
en: I am the Lord your God, who rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim wum li, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka tuumbiɛɣu lala tatabo ku lan tum yi sunsuuni yaha.
en: Other people will hear about this and be afraid, and people will not do evil things like that again.

dag: Duumanima, niŋmiya yi daba din niŋ kamaata, dama yi mi ni yi gba mali Duuma alizanda ni.
en: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka niriba maa lab kuli bɛ ya gol so ŋun daa pahir ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pisinaata dali, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa wuh o nirilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda mini Sulemaana ni o niriba Izraɛlnim zaa san la zuɣu.
en: Then on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent everyone home. They left very happy because of all the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon, and for his people Israel.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ni kɔrisikɔrisi da shɛŋa maa sɔŋ biŋkɔbiri maa tooni kɔnyuri bɔɣili gbini luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbiri maa ni kanna ti nyuri kom. Ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa yi ti kana ni bɛ ti nyu kom ka duri taba.
en: He put the branches in front of the flocks at the watering places. When the animals came to drink, they also mated in that place.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni. So ku tooi fa nira n nuu ni bahi; so ku tooi gu n ni yɛn tum shɛli soli.
en: I have always been God. When I do something, no one can change what I have done. And no one can save people from my power.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Jɛziriil, dama di ku lan yuui, n ni darigi Jɛhu zuliya tibili o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Jɛziriil la ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Izraɛl nam zani tariga.
en: The Lord said to Hosea, Name him Jezreel, because soon I will punish the family of Jehu for the people he killed at Jezreel Valley. Then I will put an end to the kingdom of the nation of Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋsim yiri Yaakubu Naawuni sanna mal alibarika. Bɛ tahima bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: The person whose help is the God of Jacob— the person whose hope rests on the LORD their God— is truly happy!.

dag: Dama yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa bi be kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na la, nimaani yi daa yi biri yi bimbira, yi chanila yi naba zuɣu ti ŋɔŋ kom na ti yɔɣi li kaman ʒiɛvari puu la.
en: The land that you will get is not like the land of Egypt that you came from. In Egypt you planted your seeds and used your feet to pump water from the canals to water your fields like a vegetable garden.

dag: Di saha ka Naa daa tim boli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm kpamba zaa na.
en: Then King Josiah called for all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem to come and meet with him.

dag: N kpɛla yɔɣu kaman piɛ so ŋun bɔrigi la. Bom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ shee, dama m bi tam a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: I wander about like a lost sheep; so come and look for me, your servant, because I have not neglected your laws.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbani ni la dina. Di zaa yoli, Asa daa kul ʒiɛla yim o biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord , even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi di di zaa din dali maa, di bi simdi ka yi guui shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: eat it the same day and leave none of it until the next morning.

dag: Amaa o ni yɛli shɛm maa yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka shɛhira shɛli kani din wuhiri ni paɣisarili maa daa nyɛla ŋun pali.
en: However, if the claim is true and proof of the young womans virginity cant be produced.

dag: Yi yinsi nyɛla tampima voya ni. Yi karimbaani n-yɔhim ya ka yi me yi yinsi maa tamla zoya zuɣu, ka ŋmaligi yɛli yimaŋa, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣisi ti tiŋ na.
en: Your pride has fooled you. You live in those caves high on the cliff. Your home is high in the hills. So you say to yourself, No one can bring me to the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, told me to go and say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem, I, the Lord , ask you why you refuse to listen to me and to obey my instructions.

dag: Di saha ka solɔri zuɣu dunoya yo, ka nɛya niɛmbu vuri bi lan wumda, ka nooŋa kumsi vuri neeri nir gom ni, ka nir bi lan wumdi paɣiba bɛn nyɛ baansi zaa yila.
en: when the doors to the street are shut, when the sound of the mill fades, the sound of the bird rises, and all the singers come down low.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka bɛ baŋ o nasara dibu yɛla. O kahig o tiliginsim yiko wuhi zuliya kam.
en: The Lord showed the nations his power to save. He showed them his goodness.

dag: Yihimiya tins ata zali Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli, ka yihi tins ata zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi.
en: three on each side of the Jordan River.

dag: Ŋunkam mi deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani.
en: Whoever welcomes one such child in my name welcomes me.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun daa kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, Sool kpiya, ka daa tɛhi ni o ʒila lahiba suŋ na ti ti ma la, n daa gbaag o mi n-ku o Zikilag, ka di leeg o yɔri o ni ti ma lahiba shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: Once before a man thought he would bring me good news. He told me, Look! Saul is dead. He thought I would reward him for bringing me the news. But I grabbed this man and killed him at Ziklag.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ dabisa biɛla o sani ka Gomna Fɛstus daa ti pii Pool yɛla maa n-yɛli Naa Agiripa. O daa yɛl o mi, Gomna Filiksi daa chɛ do so niŋ sarika ni ya ŋɔ;.
en: After they had been there several days, Festus explained Paul's situation to the king: There is a man here who was left a prisoner by Felix;.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ a ni ti be n sani Naawuni yili.
en: Jesus replied, I promise that today you will be with me in paradise.

dag: Paɣisara maa ni daa laɣimna m-pahi buyi saha shɛli, Mɔdɛkai daa ʒila nayili dunol ni.
en: Meanwhile Mordecai had been appointed by the king to an administrative position.

dag: Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la. O yi ti yɛli ya shɛlikam, yin doliya li.
en: For Moses said, The Lord your God will send you a prophet, just as he sent me, and he will be one of your own people. You are to obey everything that he tells you to do.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai, nyin di mir o ni a bo o.
en: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba daa chani gindina ti nya ma n-gbaai ma bu ma ti ma dansi. Ka tiŋ maa gooni guliba daa darigi fuɣi n chinchin shɛli din gbini n nyiŋgoli ni.
en: The guards patrolling the city found me. They hit me. They hurt me. The guards on the wall took my robe from me.

dag: m-booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti chani bɛ chandi shee.
en: She invites those who pass by on the path, those going straight on their way.

dag: n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim. N ni lan ti a buni mini azichi ni jilima, ka di galisi gari na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ a tooni la zaa dini, ka na shɛb bɛn ti yɛn dol a nyaaŋa na mi so dini ti ku paai li.
en: I will give you wisdom and knowledge. And in addition, I will give you more wealth, treasure, and fame than any king has ever had before or will ever have again.

dag: Lihimiya ba kaman bɛn be kasi, dama bɛna n-zaŋdi yi Naawuni bindira maani sara. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun mali ya ka yi be kasi maa nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: The people must consider the priest holy, because he presents the food offerings to me. I am the Lord ; I am holy and I make my people holy.

dag: M bia, a yi mali yɛm, n suhu ni piɛla.
en: My son, it makes me happy when you make a wise decision.

dag: Hɔdia so mi ni Bani ni Bɛninu.
en: Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yina dabisili din pah ayi maa dali ti lu Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika; ka bɛ zaa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: But the Benjaminites marched out of Gibeah to meet them on that second day and cut down another eighteen thousand Israelite men, all of whom were armed with swords.

dag: Ka a ti she jinjɛŋŋmahi ti ba ka di limsi bɛ zaɣim, ka di wɔɣilim ti zaŋ bɛ shɛhi ni hal ti paai bɛ gbalipina ni.
en: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.

dag: Wuntizɔra wuhir o zɔnim din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri soli kpɛhirila nir yɔɣu.
en: Good people are careful about choosing their friends, but evil people always choose the wrong ones.

dag: Ka o yi zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, nyin zaŋm li yɛli cheechi, ka o yi kul zaɣisi cheechi gba yɛligu wumbu, nyin lihim o kaman chɛfira bee lampɔdeera.
en: But if they still wont pay attention, report it to the church. If they wont pay attention even to the church, treat them as you would a Gentile and tax collector.

dag: Di daba anu dali ka o daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ni o kuli, ka paɣ maa ba maa lan yɛl o, Niŋm suɣilo suug a noli, ka chɛ ka di bii na pɔi ka a naanyi chaŋ. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di.
en: On the fifth day, he got up early in the morning to set out, and the young womans father said, Have some food for strength. So the two of them ate, sitting around until late in the day.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita; ka wurim ti kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni.
en: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Yɛhudianim jɛmbu du shɛl ni wuhiri niriba Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Jesus taught in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti tuhi deei Hamatizɔba.
en: He captured the territory of Hamath and Zobah.

dag: Chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi gili luɣilikam wurim a dimnima. Zaŋm a piɛma to ba ka bɛ guui.
en: Flash lightning and scatter the enemy! Shoot your arrows and defeat them!.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli. N ni yɛli ni yi yɛla be n suhu ni la nyɛla din yi Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ suhu ni na.
en: God is my witness that I tell the truth when I say that my deep feeling for you all comes from the heart of Christ Jesus himself.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni vihi bo m piɛri, n shiri ni bo bɛ shee.
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , tell you that I myself will look for my sheep and take care of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Bɛrilahairoi; ka di do Kadɛshi mini Bɛrɛd sunsuuni.
en: Therefore, that well is called Beer-lahai-roi; its the well between Kadesh and Bered.

dag: Di saha ka solɔri zuɣu dunoya yo, ka nɛya niɛmbu vuri bi lan wumda, ka nooŋa kumsi vuri neeri nir gom ni, ka nir bi lan wumdi paɣiba bɛn nyɛ baansi zaa yila.
en: Your ears will be deaf to the noise of the street. You will barely be able to hear the mill as it grinds or music as it plays, but even the song of a bird will wake you from sleep.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ kurugu bidibbini, ka daanya piɛm ni to ba pili yi.
en: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze.

dag: Bɛ daa lan malila ninsal nuhi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔŋni bɛ luɣa anahinahi zuɣu. Bɛba anahi maa ninani mini bɛ kpiŋkpama maa ni daa be shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: In addition to their four faces and four wings, they each had four human hands, one under each wing.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ mali maligu ti Naawuni la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti beni.
en: The Jewish governor told them that they could not eat the food offered to God until there was a priest who could use the Urim and Thummim.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tuma yiɣisi Yawɛ suhu, ka o daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.

dag: Amaa man ŋmanila olivi ti mahili din sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni. N niŋla Naawuni yurilim maŋli la naani sahakam.
en: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.

dag: Ka dilan maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti zuɣulana ni ti sariakarita? A lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la? Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Musa, ka o tɛhi ni o ni sa niŋ shɛli maa yi palo.
en: The man answered, Who put you in charge of us and made you our judge? Are you planning to kill me, just like you killed that Egyptian? This frightened Moses because he was sure that people must have found out what had happened.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ piim tiliginsim tinsi kaman n ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: Through Moses, I told you to choose some cities to be cities of safety.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim mi nyɛ o ni pii zuliya shɛli. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: But the portion of Jacob is utterly different, for he has formed all things, including his very own tribe; the LORD of heavenly forces is his name!.

dag: A ni yɛn mal li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pihitanaata; ka chɛ ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka chɛ ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata.
en: This is the size I want you to make the boat: cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, O be ya? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, O be Ammiɛl bia Makiri la yiŋa Lɔdɛba.
en: Where is he? the king asked. He is at the house of Ammiels son Machir at Lo-debar, Ziba told the king.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli shia din be daadam ni, ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ŋɔ n-chɛ ka daadam baŋdi binyara.
en: But it is the spirit in people, the breath from God All-Powerful, that makes them understand.

dag: O tizo yuli n-daa booni Jubal. Ŋun mi n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini yupiɛbiriba yaba.
en: His brothers name was Jubal; he was the ancestor of those who play stringed and wind instruments.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛli Yaakubu, M bia, saɣisim mirina ka n shih a nya a shiri nyɛla m bia Iso bee a pa o.
en: Isaac said to Jacob, Come here and let me touch you, my son. Are you my son Esau or not.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, Nyama, dahin shɛli a ni ti yɛn zo nti sɔɣ a dudoonigu ni, ka a ni baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Micaiah answered, Look, what I said will happen! And you will see it one day when you are in a secret room somewhere hiding.

dag: Ka yi yi tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka doli wun shɛŋa n-tumdi bɛ ni bɔri shɛm ka jɛmdi li, nimmoo ka n yɛri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi.
en: Dont ever forget the Lord your God. Dont ever follow other gods or worship and serve them. If you do that, I warn you today: You will surely be destroyed!.

dag: Ya polo ka Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva buɣa la lee be? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: Where are they now, the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Did anyone save Samaria?.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti kum ka fabili, amaa ka dunianim bɛn suhuri ti piɛla; yi suhuri ni ti saɣim, amaa yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa ni ti leei suhupiɛlli.
en: I assure you that you will cry and lament, and the world will be happy. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.

dag: Di kul shɛbisila tab ni hal ka pɔhim ku tooi kpe di sunsuuni gba.
en: Each one is joined so tight to the next, not even a breath can come between.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa lan yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba gba di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni o ti yɛl o Izraɛlnim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni lo ni bɛ niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli zaa yɛla.
en: Abner said these things to David in Hebron, and he said these things to the people of the tribe of Benjamin. The things Abner said sounded good to the tribe of Benjamin and to all the people of Israel.

dag: Bakibukia mini Unno n-daa nyɛ bɛ tab bɛn ʒe n-tuhi ba laɣiŋgu maa ni.
en: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses.

dag: Bɛ daa pun baŋ Naawuni yɛligu nyaɣisim mini dunia shɛli din ti yɛn kana la yiko yɛla.
en: and tasted Gods good word and the powers of the coming age.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee kuhi pam; bɛ daa kumiya pam dindali yuŋ maa.
en: That night all the people in the camp began shouting loudly.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Nandahima gbaai ma pam. Chɛ ka ti kpalimla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya. Amaa di chɛ ka n kpalim ninsalinim nuu ni.
en: Im in deep trouble, David said to Gad. Lets fall into the LORDs hands because his mercy is great, but dont let me fall into human hands.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan bia Ɛbɛd daa nyɛ Adin daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pihinu daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Adin: Ebed son of Jonathan, and other men;.

dag: o ni daa niŋ Ijipti tɔbbihi mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shɛm la ni o ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu di ba shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kariti doli ya la. Yawɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You, not your children, saw what he did to the Egyptian army—to their horses and chariots. They were chasing you, but you saw him cover them with the water from the Red Sea. You saw how the Lord completely destroyed them.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun bɔhi biɛri ti ma; ka nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be n sulinsi ni ti ma.
en: This is the God who avenges on my behalf, who subdues people before me.

dag: Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; dama n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: You will look for me, but you will not find me. And you cannot come where I am.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa gbani zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka suhi alibarika niŋ naa ni ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋya ni nyini n dan naa baɣa be n ni, a ni saɣi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni bɔri shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Joab threw himself to the ground in front of David in respect, and said, God bless you, Your Majesty! Now I know that you are pleased with me, because you have granted my request.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya ma, mani m-bala. Wuni so lan kani m-pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kura, ka lan neera. Mani n-tir dansi; mani n-lan tibira, ka so ku tooi fa shɛli n nuu ni.
en: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!.

dag: Cham biŋkɔbiri la sani ti gbahi bubihi pol ayi ti ma na ka n zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli a ba ni yuri pam;.
en: Go out to our goats and bring me two young ones. I will prepare them the way your father loves them.

dag: Ka Musa daa saɣi m-be bɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Zipɔra ti Musa.
en: So Moses decided to live there, and Jethro gave him his daughter Zipporah in marriage.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ti lihi tiŋ na nya li.
en: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa n-zaŋ li ti zali baɣili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: Aaron did as the LORD commanded Moses, and he put it in front of the covenant document for safekeeping.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi, ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni wahala paai ma la ŋmaligi labi ni vi.
en: May those who try to kill me be completely defeated and confused. May those who are happy because of my troubles be turned back and disgraced.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lab ti Dauda suɣili din daa lu la zali. N ni ti mali di luɣ shɛŋa din daa saɣim la zaa, ka ti li zali ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la;.
en: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.

dag: Bɛ pun zaŋ baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba n-ka n sanna ni bɛ ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma di gbinni, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ di gbinni.
en: Now, the sages and the dream interpreters were brought before me to read this writing and interpret it for me, but they couldnt explain its meaning.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ gba, niriba biɛla ka Naawuni piig o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: It is the same now. God has chosen a few people by his grace.

dag: Amaa n ni ti deei nam maa o bia nuu ni n-zaŋ li ti nyin ŋun su zuliya pia ŋɔ.
en: But Jeroboam, I will take the ten tribes away from his son and give them to you.

dag: Zakai daŋ — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu.
en: of Zaccai.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm maa min o nyaaŋa daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na; amaa bɛ daa bi lan gbahi ba ni kiŋkansi yaha, dama bɛ daa zɔrimi ni niriba ti lab ba kuɣa.
en: So the officer went off with his men and brought the apostles back. They did not use force, however, because they were afraid that the people might stone them.

dag: Ka a nudirigu nini yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini, di so ni bɛ ti zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ zaa kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: If your right eye causes you to sin, poke it out and throw it away. It is better to lose one part of your body, than for your whole body to end up in hell.

dag: Ka Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa min o maligumaanitab maa daa lihi nya ka kɔŋ wulig o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa daag o yihi yomyom, ka o gba maŋmaŋ daa niŋ yomyom yi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka kɔŋ maa wulig o maa.
en: Azariah and the other priests saw it and immediately told him to leave the temple. Uzziah realized that the Lord had punished him, so he hurried to get outside.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka o daa tim Azalia bia Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara, ka nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɛl o.
en: After Josiah had been king for years, he told Shaphan, one of his highest officials: Go to the Lord 's temple.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi liɣiri chaŋ. N suhu n-yu ni n yo yi mini bɛn yoli kana maa zaa yim.
en: Now take your pay and go home. I want to give this man who was hired last as much as I gave you.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa gari tooni zaŋ Izraɛlnima ka bɛ yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni chani kaman tɔbbihi la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The following account gives the names of the places where the Israelites set up camp after they left Egypt in their tribes under the leadership of Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ chi bee kawana mali maha na ti mali sara, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni m-mal li, ka dabindi ka di ni bee karikaasi shɛli din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ shɛli ni.
en: When you present a grain offering baked in an oven, it must be of choice flour: unleavened flatbread mixed with oil or unleavened wafers spread with oil.

dag: Ka Sintani lan zaŋ o chaŋ nti du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu n-wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama mini di jilima zaa.
en: Then the devil brought him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

dag: Dama Ahaz daa zaŋla Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni salima mini kpambaliba yinsi salima zaa chaŋ ti yo farigu Asiria naa sani, amaa ka di daa bi sɔŋ o.
en: So Ahaz took the gold from the Temple, the palace, and the homes of the leaders of the people, and gave it to the emperor, but even this did not help.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ, nyamiya doo ŋɔ ni bɔri ti vuri shɛm. O daa pun timna nti yɛli ma ni o bɔrila m paɣiba mini m bihi ni n daanzinfa ni n salima, ka m bi mɔŋ o.
en: Ahab called a meeting with the leaders of Israel and said, Benhadad is causing real trouble. He told me to give him my wives and children, as well as my silver and gold. And I agreed.

dag: Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N tɛha pala yi tɛha, ka yi soya mi pala n soya.
en: My thoughts, says the Lord , are not like yours, and my ways are different from yours.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka doli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: Jehoahaz did what the Lord considered wrong. Like Jeroboam son of Nebat, he committed sins that also caused the people of Israel to sin. And he never stopped doing those things.

dag: ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ŋmani la ti tam o zuɣu. Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven, You are my own dear Son. I am pleased with you.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti ni daa woligi ya daba ayi la puuni, kulla ti niŋgbuna tab woligibu ko yɛla ka n yɛri maa, ka pa ni ti tɛha tab Woligibu. Ti naɣi ya nyabu, ka mi kul kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti lan nyan ya yaha.
en: Brothers and sisters, we were separated from you for a short time. But even though we were not there, our thoughts were still with you. We wanted very much to see you, and we tried very hard to do this.

dag: M Ba ŋun nyɛ wuntialan ŋɔ, dunianim bi mi a, amaa man mi a, ka bɛmbɔŋɔ gba mi ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: Father, you are the one who always does what is right. The world does not know you, but I know you, and these followers of mine know that you sent me.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi bɛ daalaafee yɛla; ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi ba do kur so yɛla yi ni daa yɛli ma la na be o nyɛvil ni? O mal alaafee.
en: He asked them how they were and said, How is your elderly father, about whom you spoke? Is he still alive.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni.
en: I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. He is the God of the living, not of the dead.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti ku zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa lo nia ni bɛ liri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa ti ka mɔɣili maa ni na ni o ti su kom. Ka o min o paɣisara daa baɣisiri mɔɣili maa chana, ka o daa ti nya piɛɣu maa ni su kaɣili ni, ka o tim o paɣisara maa ni yino ni o chaŋ ti zaŋ li na.
en: Just then, Pharaohs daughter went to the river to bathe. She saw the basket in the tall grass. Her servants were walking beside the river, so she told one of them to go get the basket.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa boli baŋdiba maa ashilɔni na nti vihi ba viɛnyɛliŋga ni o baŋ saha shɛli saŋmariga maa ni daa puhi.
en: Then Herod secretly called for the magi and found out from them the time when the star had first appeared.

dag: Ka Dauda daa sɔɣi mɔɣu maa ni. Ka gol palli dali maa daa ti paai, ka naa ʒini ni o di bindirigu.
en: Then David hid in the field. The time for the New Moon celebration came, and the king sat down to eat.

dag: ka lan zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit la m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: The third row was a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini di biŋkpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi o ni yɛn yihi yaannin shɛŋa maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li mali sara.
en: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.

dag: Dama niriba maa kaya nyɛla ʒiri kaya. Bɛ ŋmaala mɔɣu ni tia, ka ŋun kpɛri binyara zaŋ lɛbil kpe li.
en: The customs of other people are worth nothing. Their idols are nothing but wood from the forest. Their idols are made by workers with their chisels.

dag: Ka Dauda daa duh o yee bɔhi tɔbbihi maa mini Nɛr bia Abinɛr la, Abinɛr, a ku garigi ma? Ka Abinɛr garigi bɔhi, Nyin ŋuni n-lee booni naa maa.
en: Abner! David shouted toward Saul's army. Can you hear me? Abner shouted back. Who dares disturb the king.

dag: Yɛhudianim kpeen so daa beni ka o yuli booni Nikɔdimus. O daa nyɛla Farisiinim ni yino.
en: There was a Jewish leader named Nicodemus, who belonged to the party of the Pharisees.

dag: Laɣimmiya yi zuliya ni kpamba mini yi sapashin kpamba zaa n sanna, ka n ti yɛli ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ wum, ka n chɛ ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani di shɛhira jɛndi ba.
en: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa nya dansi ni nahiŋgu maa. O ni daa nya tibidarigibo shɛli zuɣu n-chɛ ka nyaɣisim kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni. O fiɛbbu dansi zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti nyari tibbu.
en: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.

dag: ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba sanna ti yɛli ba.
en: they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of the community and said.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be anabi Samuɛl ʒiɛman ni mini anab shɛb bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa pun yɛli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.

dag: Ka n lan zaŋ Dauda zuliya saafe ti o, ka o ti yooi, ka so ku tooi yo bee ka o ti yo, ka so ku tooi yooi.
en: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.

dag: Bɛna n-daa lan su daantal shɛŋa din daa gili di dundɔŋ la zaa mini di binzahi ni di kpahi din kpara ni di mihi fukumsi.
en: and the pillars of the courtyard all around, their bases, pegs, and cords.

dag: Dimiya binnɛɔŋ kam. N ni zaŋ ʒiɛvari tin ya shɛm lala ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa tin ya.
en: Everything that lives and moves will be your food. Just as I gave you the green grasses, I now give you everything.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa n-yiɣisi lab doo maa sani yaha.
en: Take your brother and return at once.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhirimi ni n taɣirila n ni daa lo ni n niŋ shɛm? Bee n lɔri n nia mi kaman ŋun doli dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ni lɔri nia shɛm yɛra, Iin, Iin mini Aai, Aai zaa yim?.
en: In planning this, did I appear fickle? When I make my plans, do I make them from selfish motives, ready to say Yes, yes and No, no at the same time?.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa gari tooni zaŋ Izraɛlnima ka bɛ yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni chani kaman tɔbbihi la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Here is a list of the places the Israelites went when they left Egypt. They were organized in groups like an army and were led by Moses and Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sulemaana n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Salima sara maligu bimbini mini salima teebuli shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: Solomon also had gold furnishings made for the Temple: the altar, the table for the bread offered to God.

dag: Ka yuri daa balisira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma tɔri tiŋ yɔri vuri.
en: Sisera's horses galloped off, their hoofs thundering in retreat.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Piɛgula ni fari biŋgbaya ayi bee bin tibichaɣu gbuɣinli nol ni shɛm la, lala ka n fa Izraɛlnim bɛn be Samaria n-do gar suma zuɣu la bahi.
en: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion.

dag: Yisa alizanda ni labbu saha ni daa ti miri, o daa lo nia ni o chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: As the time drew near when Jesus would be taken up to heaven, he made up his mind and set out on his way to Jerusalem.

dag: Niriba pam daa ti yi tinsi gari shɛm ni laɣim Yisa sanna, ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: A large crowd came together. People came to Jesus from every town, and he told them this story:.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla anabi.
en: I see you are a prophet, sir, the woman said.

dag: Yawɛ ti ti nasara. Chɛliya ka ti moli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ti ti ŋɔ Ziɔn.
en: The LORD has come to our defense, so lets declare in Zion what the LORD our God has done!.

dag: Ʒiɛmiya anzinfa! Ʒiɛmiya salima! Azichi maa ka tariga, ka bin suma pam beni.
en: Enemy soldiers shout, The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o So na be Sool daŋ ni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim kaman Naawuni ni bɔri shɛm? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, Jɔnatan bidibiga na beni, o mi nyɛla gbarigu.
en: David asked, Are any of Saul's family still alive? If there are, I want to be kind to them. Ziba answered, One of Jonathan's sons is still alive, but he can't walk.

dag: n-yo bidibikpamba bɛn kalinli pani maa zuɣu Aduna min o bidibisi sani.
en: Give the silver to Aaron and his sons as payment for the Israelites.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka di gari ya; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa Nazarɛt do so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la. O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni; nyamiya bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: The man said, Don't be alarmed! You are looking for Jesus from Nazareth, who was nailed to a cross. God has raised him to life, and he isn't here. You can see the place where they put his body.

dag: Naawuni, di simdi ni ti paɣ a Ziɔn. Ka zaŋ ti ni lo alikauli ni ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa ti a la ti a.
en: God in Zion, we praise you and give you what we promised.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɛhimiya, ka boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi fabila ka bɛ kana; ka tim boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi kuyila ka bɛ kana.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said, Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.

dag: N yi bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti be teeku tariga.
en: If I flew away beyond the east or lived in the farthest place in the west.

dag: Siɣisimiya yimaŋ ti Duuma sani, ka o duhi ya.
en: Be humble before the Lord, and he will make you great.

dag: Isaka ŋmanila bun so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ piɛri sunsuuni.
en: Issachar is no better than a donkey That lies stretched out between its saddlebags.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa piila din nyɛ jɛrilim dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yɛnnim vi; ka daa pii din nyɛ bin chɔɣima dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yikolaannim vi;.
en: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise. He chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

dag: Lɛmiya yuri galigɛnima bamiya tɔbutuhiri yuri, Pilimiya kuriti zuɣupila zani yi zaashɛhi. Sahimiya yi kpana, ka yɛn ya kuriti gbaɣinɔnima.
en: saddle your horses, and polish your spears. Put on your helmets and armor, then take your positions.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ yi gba me n-tamla Yisa Masia tuumba min anabinim ni daa zali tanza shɛli din gbinni kuɣ gahindili nyɛ Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ la zuɣu.
en: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.

dag: amaa n suhu daa bi doya n ni daa bi nya ti mabia Taitus nimaani la zuɣu. Dina n-daa chɛ ka n chɛbisi bɛn be nimaani ka chaŋ Masidɔnia.
en: But I had no peace because I did not find my brother Titus. So I said goodbye and went to Macedonia.

dag: Binnɛma anahi maa daa yi ti tibigiri ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni ka tir o jilima, ka paɣiri ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu maa saha shɛli.
en: These living beings were giving glory and honor and thanks to the one who sits on the throne, the one who lives forever and ever. And every time they did this.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim, ka gbib alikauli ni yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim sani zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani tuhili niriba.
en: Remember that the Lord your God is the only God and that he is faithful. He will keep his covenant and show his constant love to a thousand generations of those who love him and obey his commands.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi, N ni ti kpila n tiɛɣu ni, ka ni ti chɛ ka n dabisa galisi kaman bihigu la.
en: I always thought I would live a long life, growing old with my family around me.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna maa tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: Then Pilates soldiers took Jesus into the governors palace. All the soldiers gathered around him.

dag: A zal a zaligunima ni niriba dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;.

dag: Miri ka a doli niriba maa ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa maa, a mi di zɔri bɛ ni zɔri shɛli dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: Dont call conspiracy all that this people calls conspiracy. Dont fear what they fear, and dont be terrified.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ka o daa zaŋ kpihim Yɛhudianim zaligunim mini bɛ daadiini soli kaya ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba min omaŋmaŋ naai taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti sunsuuni.
en: He abolished the Jewish Law with its commandments and rules, in order to create out of the two races one new people in union with himself, in this way making peace.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi zaŋ chaŋ o sani, ka kul taari duŋ niŋdi Zallakudura Naa mɔɣu maa ni.
en: But they continued to sin against God, rebelling against the Most High in the desert.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa nya zama maa, ka di niŋ ba nyuli ka bɛ ŋmɛri Pool ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa naŋgbankpeeni, ka tur o.
en: When the Jewish people saw the crowds, they were very jealous. They insulted Paul and spoke against everything he said.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti lan labisi Mɔabnim daazichi ti ba dabisa shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni. Mɔabnim tibidarigibo tariga m-bala.
en: Yet someday, I will bring your people back home. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbiga bɛn daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai sansani maa shee yuntisuɣu saha tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛli n-dii piɛb bɛ kikahi ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ ni gbib duɣubihi shɛŋa maa.
en: Gideon and his group reached the edge of the enemy camp a few hours after dark, just after the new guards had come on duty. Gideon and his soldiers blew their trumpets and smashed the clay jars that were hiding the torches.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa ti ma. Ka o daa bol o, ka o kana ti zan o tooni.
en: He told his servant Gehazi to go and call the woman. When she came.

dag: Ka yi ti kpi tinzunnim maa sunsuuni, ka yi dimnim maa tiŋgbani ti vali ya.
en: You will be lost in other nations. You will disappear in the land of your enemies.

dag: A ni nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa zaa, n ni zaŋ li ti a zuliya ka bɛ su li sahakam.
en: I am going to give you and your descendants all the land that you see, and it will be yours forever.

dag: Ka n daa nya malaika so ka o yi alizanda ni na n-gbib bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la saafɛbia mini zoligo titali o nuu ni.
en: I saw an angel come down from heaven, carrying the key to the deep pit and a big chain.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n yɛn filimla Jɛrusalɛmnim bindirigu. Bɛ ni ti zahindila bɛ bindira tiri ba, ka bɛ diri li ni dabiɛm, ka zahindi kom tiri ba, ka bɛ nyuri li ni suhuzɔhibo.
en: Then he said to me: Human one, Im destroying the food supply in Jerusalem. They will anxiously ration and eat their food, and in dismay they will dole out and drink their water.

dag: O sɔɣimi doya gu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka chɛ ka niriba pam bi ʒe yim.
en: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim.

dag: Ka Mariama daa kpalim Ɛlizabɛt sani kaman chira ata laasabu, ka naanyi kul o ya.
en: Mary stayed with Elizabeth for about three months and then went home.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Niriba maa zaŋ nɛma maa na pam n-gari ti ni bɔri shɛm tariga ni ti zaŋ tum Yawɛ ni zali ti ni ti tum tuun shɛli maa.
en: and told Moses, The people are bringing more than is needed for the work which the Lord commanded to be done.

dag: Laɛl bia Ɛliasaf n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The leader of the family groups of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa labi kuli ti yɛl o deemba Jɛtro, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n labi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n niriba sani nti nya bɛ na be bɛ nyɛviya ni. Ka Jɛtro daa yɛli Musa, Cham ni suhudoo.
en: Moses went back to his father-in-law Jethro and said to him, Please let me go back to my family in Egypt and see whether or not they are still living. Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yisa daa yi yiŋ chaŋ ti ʒini teeku duli.
en: That day Jesus went out of the house and sat down beside the lake.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Izraɛlnim maa zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka wula ka Firawuna ŋun lee ni wum mani ŋun bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: But Moses replied, I'm not a powerful speaker. If the Israelites won't listen to me, why should the king of Egypt.

dag: O daa galim Naa Hɛrɔd ŋun Naa Hɛrɔd tizɔbil paɣa Hɛrɔdias yɛla zuɣu m-pah o ni daa tum tuun biɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: But Herod the ruler had been criticized harshly by John because of Herodias, Herods brothers wife, and because of all the evil he had done.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya ba, ku lan nya ba, bɛ yanim ku lan nya ba.
en: The eye that saw them will do so no more; they wont be seen again at home.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ifriim zuliya tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti Kɔhat daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

dag: N ni daŋ wuhi ya yin ni zo so: Zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi ku daadam ka mali yiko din ni tooi zaŋ o shia niŋ buɣim ni ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zomiy o.
en: I will show you whom to fear: fear God, who, after killing, has the authority to throw into hell. Believe me, he is the one you must fear!.

dag: O zaŋm o ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Ibrahimma ni la niŋ a min a zuliya bɛn be a san ni, ka yi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Ibrahimma, ka yi be di ni ŋɔ su.
en: and that God will bless you and your children the same way he blessed Abraham. And I pray that you will own the land where you live. This is the land God gave to Abraham.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bah o niriba zuɣu, ka o zaŋ o nuu ŋme n-ku ba, ka zoya sɔhigi, ka bɛ kpi n-do solɔri zuɣu kaman saɣiri la. Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa na kul bi chɛ, amaa ka o na kul kpuɣ o nuu gu.
en: You are the Lord 's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Olivi tia dari m-mali chɛrubinima ayi n-zali du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi shee maa puuni. Chɛrubi yino kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: The workers made two statues of Cherub angels with wings. They made the statues from olive wood and put them in the Most Holy Place. Each angel was cubits tall.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani tin ya ka di leei yi tarili.
en: He said, I will give you the land of Canaan. It will be your very own.

dag: Bɛn daa be o nuzaa polo n-daa nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi la, Ɛtan daa nyɛla Kish bia, ka Kish nyɛ Abidi bia, ka Abidi nyɛ Maluk bia.
en: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ Ziɔn, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord in Zion, in Jerusalem, his home. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa ti Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn kpiɔŋ ka o lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: Once more the Israelites started disobeying the Lord . So he let them be defeated by King Eglon of Moab.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino daa yɛl o, A yi di saɣi n-dol ti chaŋ. Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ.
en: One of them said, Please come with us, your servants. Elisha said, Okay, Ill go.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Jahinjɛya ayi bi kɔhirila siidi yini? Ka bɛ ni yino mi ku lu tiŋa ka di pala yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni.
en: When birds are sold, two small birds cost only a penny. But not even one of those little birds can die without your Father knowing it.

dag: Amaa dimdi yi be so min o kpee sunsuuni, ka o do n-gu o nti chaŋ ti lir o ku dilana ka zo n-kuli fɔntinsi ŋɔ tin yin ni.
en: But suppose there is a man who hates his neighbor. That man might hide and wait to kill the person he hates. If he kills that person and runs to one of these cities of safety.

dag: Ka chɛliya ka ti chɛ ka ti biɛhigu be dɛde kaman bɛn be neesim ni, ka pa ni bɛn tumdi yoliyoli bee n-nyuri dam kuuna. Ti miri ka ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini zina balibu kam. Ti mi miri ka ti bɔri zabili bee n-zabiri nyuli.
en: Lets behave appropriately as people who live in the day, not in partying and getting drunk, not in sleeping around and obscene behavior, not in fighting and obsession.

dag: Kɔhimiya yi ni mali shɛli n-zaŋ ti nandaamba pini; bomiya liɣiri kolibihi shɛŋa din bi kurigira n-sɔŋ azichi shɛli din ti ku naai Naawuni yili, tayiɣ ni ti ku be shɛli bee lɛla ni ti ku saɣim li luɣ shɛli.
en: Sell all your belongings and give the money to the poor. Provide for yourselves purses that don't wear out, and save your riches in heaven, where they will never decrease, because no thief can get to them, and no moth can destroy them.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu Abib goli ni, dama Abib goli maa ni yuŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Honor the Lord your God by celebrating Passover in the month of Abib; it was on a night in that month that he rescued you from Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna.
en: The Lord said to Aaron:.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa yɛl ti, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba m-bɔŋɔ: chɛliya yi ni yino n sani, ka zaŋ kawana kuli ti ti yi yiŋnim shɛb kum ni muɣisi maa;.
en: The man answered, This is how I will find out if you are honest men: One of you will stay with me; the rest will take grain for your starving families and leave.

dag: Di lan simdi ka o bo ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli, ka bɛ ti zaŋ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: You shall also bring two doves or two pigeons, one for the sin offering and one for the burnt offering.

dag: Ka o yi zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, nyin zaŋm li yɛli cheechi, ka o yi kul zaɣisi cheechi gba yɛligu wumbu, nyin lihim o kaman chɛfira bee lampɔdeera.
en: And if he will not listen to them, then tell the whole thing to the church. Finally, if he will not listen to the church, treat him as though he were a pagan or a tax collector.

dag: Di saha Lɛvinim ni ti duhi bɛ yee yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa:.
en: The Levites will speak these words in a loud voice:.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ni tɔŋda, ka bɛ bihi ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: They will always be prosperous, and their children will possess the land.

dag: N shia faai siɣi, n dabisa naaya, gballi malila shili guli ma.
en: The end of my life is near. I can hardly breathe; there is nothing left for me but the grave.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani, ka o ni niŋ binshɛŋa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o kpe taali ni maa kpihim.
en: The priest will make reconciliation for you before the LORD, and you will be forgiven for anything you may have done that made you guilty.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa yihi anzinfa mini salima binyara ni chinchina ti Ribɛka; ka ti o tizɔdoo maa min o ma gba nachiinsi binshɛŋa din liɣiri galisi pam.
en: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa, ŋuna n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka mi yi ni nahindi shɛm yɛla mini yi daania niŋbu ni yi ni je tuumbiɛrinim shɛm yɛla. N lan mi yi ni kpahim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-boli Yisa tuumba, amaa ka pa o tuumba la ni yi ni nya ka bɛ nyɛla ʒirinim la.
en: I know what you have done; I know how hard you have worked and how patient you have been. I know that you cannot tolerate evil people and that you have tested those who say they are apostles but are not, and have found out that they are liars.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi tiri so yiko ka o tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka so mi tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa Shi yino maa yiko ni.
en: The Spirit gives one person a message full of wisdom, while to another person the same Spirit gives a message full of knowledge.

dag: O chanila kum shee, o ni doli so shɛli kunila kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: She will take you down to the world of the dead; the road she walks is the road to death.

dag: o yi ti baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa, ŋun bom bulaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti mali sara.
en: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Ka a ti baŋ ni barina shɛli ka a yiŋa. Ka a yi ti kaag a piɛri, a ni nya ka bɛ zaa beni.
en: You will live in peace because your tent is safe. You will count your property and find nothing missing.

dag: Maligumaaniba n-daa nyɛ: Joyarib bia Jɛdaya mini Jachin.
en: Of the priests: Jedaiah son of Joiarib, Jachin.

dag: Ka tia maa daa kul zoori n-niŋdi zaɣ titali hal ka di zuɣusaa ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: The tree grew in size and strength; it was as high as the sky; it could be seen from every corner of the earth.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Then Jehoshaphat died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Then his son, Jehoram became the next king.

dag: ka nir yiŋnim ni nyɛla o dimnima.
en: Even members of your own family will be your enemies. Micah :.

dag: Hal muɣisigu yi gili ma niŋ sunsuuni gba, a yihiri ma di puuni ni alaafee. A kul yihiri ma n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu nuu ni. A teer a nudirigu n-fari ma bahira.
en: When I am surrounded by troubles, you keep me safe. You oppose my angry enemies and save me by your power.

dag: ka baŋ ni dilana nyɛla tɛhitilimalana ni alahichilana ŋun maŋmaŋ tuma kar o saria. Wuhibu shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: because you know that someone like this is twisted and sinful—so they condemn themselves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti zaɣisi nyin Yawɛ ka jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashitarɔt. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ fam ti ti dimnim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi, ka ti jɛmd a.
en: Again your ancestors cried out to the Lord for help. They said, We have sinned! We stopped worshiping you, our Lord , and started worshiping Baal and Astarte. But now, if you rescue us from our enemies, we will worship you.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ galisiya pam, ka yi bɔri ni bɛ chɛ tuma bebɔ.
en: Pharaoh continued, The lands people are now numerous. Yet you want them to stop their hard work.

dag: Ka Shisha bihi Ɛlihɔrɛf mini Ahija nyɛ gbansabiriba. Ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ ŋun su gbana gbibbu fukumsi.
en: the scribes Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha; Jehoshaphat, the recorder, Ahiluds son.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Hɛrɔd saha la ka baŋdib shɛb daa yi wulimpuhili polo ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li, ŋunkam bi chɛ o ni mali shɛlikam ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: It is the same for each of you. You must leave everything you have to follow me. If not, you cannot be my follower.

dag: M bia, di kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, ka di chɛ ka a wum wuhibu.
en: If, my child, you stop listening to discipline, you will wander away from words of knowledge.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi sara shɛli din kpihindi alahichi la mini yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the purification offering of reconciliation, and the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and drink offerings.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka Izraɛlnim gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka di leei alikauli din kul ni beni sahakam shihirili.
en: The Israelites should keep the Sabbath. They should observe the Sabbath in every generation as a covenant for all time.

dag: Yinim Galɛshianim bɛn tum jɛrilim ŋɔ, timalaan ŋuni n-lee birim ya? Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla daa kahigi wuhi palɔni yimaŋmaŋ ninni.
en: You irrational Galatians! Who put a spell on you? Jesus Christ was put on display as crucified before your eyes!.

dag: Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ; amaa ka yalim yi ti niŋ piti, wula ka yi lee yɛn niŋ chɛ ka di lan nyaɣisi yaha? Chɛliya ka yalim be yi ni, ka yi mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: Salt is good. But if it loses its salty taste, you cant make it good again. So, dont lose that good quality of salt you have. And live in peace with each other.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti paai kɔbili shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Bɛr la. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi niriba maa na ka n ti ti ba kom.
en: From there they went on to a place called Wells, where the Lord said to Moses, Bring the people together, and I will give them water.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bi ku ba Izraɛl kpamba ni daa pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni n-niŋdi bɛ kpamba maa.
en: But the army of Israel did not try to fight against those cities. They had made a peace agreement with them. They had made a promise to them before the Lord , the God of Israel. All the people complained against the leaders who made the agreement.

dag: Yinim jɛra ŋɔ, pa ŋun nam di nyaaŋ maa n-nam di puuni maa gba?.
en: You are foolish! The same one who made what is outside also made what is inside.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni ka nyɛ o Ba ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ni o tin ya o Shia Kasi ŋun ni chɛ ka yi nya yɛm, ka kahigi Naawuni ni nyɛ so wuhi ya ka yi baŋ o.
en: and ask the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the glorious Father, to give you the Spirit, who will make you wise and reveal God to you, so that you will know him.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa, zomiya Yawɛ! Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, lumiy o sizuura!.
en: All the earth honors the LORD; all the earths inhabitants stand in awe of him.

dag: bɛ kpiŋkpama maa daa shihirila taba. Bɛ daa yi ti chana, bɛ zaɣ yino kam kul tuhimi chani tooni ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: Two wings of each creature were spread out so that the creatures formed a square, with their wing tips touching. When they moved, they moved as a group without turning their bodies.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kahigi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni Bia, Naawuni be o ni ka o gba be Naawuni ni.
en: If we declare that Jesus is the Son of God, we live in union with God and God lives in union with us.

dag: Ka nanim daa kana Taanak Mɛgido kulibɔŋ la ni ti tuhi tɔbu. Ka Keenan nanim daa tuhi, amaa ka bi di nɛma din nyɛ anzinfa.
en: At Taanach, by the stream of Megiddo, the kings came and fought; the kings of Canaan fought, but they took no silver away.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlimi, Pa Musa kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi. O daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi tinim gba. Ka Yawɛ daa wum li.
en: They said to themselves, Moses is not the only one the Lord has used to speak to the people. He has also spoken through us! The Lord heard this.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ ŋun ka taali ŋɔ zaa yoli mmaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛn wuhi ni m mali taali. Hal n kul ka galimi maa zaa yoli ŋuna n-ni wuhi ni n kul bela galimi ni.
en: I am innocent, but anything I say makes me seem guilty. I am innocent, but if I speak, my mouth proves me wrong.

dag: Kuruwa kɔŋkɔba zaŋ zahim binyara nyɛla din chihira Yawɛ sani, ka ʒiri sanianim bi viɛla.
en: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu bahi kom ni ni bɛ zahim kom maa ziliŋ, ka daa nya ka di nyɛla mita pihinahi. Ka bɛ daa tirisi tooni biɛla n-lan buɣisi n-nya ka di ziliŋ nyɛla mita pihita.
en: They threw a rope into the water with a weight on the end of it. They found that the water was feet deep. They went a little farther and threw the rope in again. It was feet deep.

dag: Molimiya molo ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni n-yɛli ba: Malimiya shili n-tuhi tɔbu; bolimiya yi tɔbutuhiriba. Chɛliya ka tɔbutuhiriba zaa yina n-vu m-mirina!.
en: Announce this among the nations: Prepare for war! Wake up the strong men! Let all the men of war come near. Let them come up!.

dag: Ka Zimiri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Zimri did while he was king, including his rebellion against Elah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: So shɛli daa be duri maa tiŋa, ka nira ni tooi yi dundɔntitali ni wulimpuhili polo n-dol li kpe duri maa ni.
en: The entrance was below these rooms at the east end of the building so that people could enter from the outer courtyard.

dag: Dindali maa n shiri ni ti ŋmaligi n nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa din nyɛ bɛ ni jɛmdi wuna la zuɣu.
en: And I will refuse to help them, because they have done evil and worshiped other gods.

dag: Yi bi da tulaale viɛlli ti ma bee n-zaŋ yi sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ti ma. Amaa yinim lee chɛmi ka yi daalahichi yɛla muɣisi ma, ka chɛ ka n nyee nyɔni yi tuumbiɛri.
en: You didnt buy spices for me with your money, or satisfy me with the fat of your sacrifices. Instead, you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your evil actions.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim daa gbibi Dauda biŋkumda la, ka maligumaaniba mi daa gbibi kikahi.
en: While the Levites took their places holding Davids instruments, and the priests their trumpets.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyini Masia, a daanabitali puuni wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: They said, Show us that you are a prophet, Messiah! Tell us who hit you.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa mali shili n-kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni chaŋ Goshɛn ni o ti nya o ba Izraɛl. Bɛ ni daa ti nya taba, ka Yisifu chaŋ o sani nti zaŋ o nuhi m-bɔb gbaag o ba n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kum yuui.
en: Joseph got in his chariot and went to Goshen to meet his father. When they met, Joseph threw his arms around his father's neck and cried for a long time.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di sabigi di paɣibu maa nyaaŋa, ŋun cheem di ni be situra maa ni luɣ shɛli maa bee gbaŋ maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa luɣ shɛli maa bahi.
en: But if the priest looks at that piece of leather or cloth, and the mildew has faded, he must tear the infected spot out of the piece of leather or cloth. It doesnt matter if the cloth is woven or knitted.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be mɔɣu ni, yin di chaŋya; ka bɛ mi yi ti yɛli ya, O be duu puuni, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Someone might tell you, The Messiah is there in the desert! But dont go into the desert to look for him. Someone else might say, There is the Messiah in that room! But dont believe it.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi tiri man Yawɛ la, n zaŋ li ti Lɛvinim ni di nyɛ bɛ tarili. Dinzuɣu ka m pun yɛli ni bɛ ku mali tiŋgbani Izraɛlnim sani.
en: they will be given the crops and newborn animals that the Israelites offer to me.

dag: Di saha maa ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nira ka ʒe Sool sapashin kpamba maa san la daa garigi yɛli Sool, N daa nya Jɛsi bia maa ka o ka Nɔb na nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Ahitub bia la sani.
en: Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Sauls servants, responded, I saw Jesses son go to Ahimelech, Ahitubs son, at Nob.

dag: nti kpe ŋariŋ ni bɛ baai du Kapɛrinium polo. Ka di daa mali ti zibi ka Yisa na bi ka bɛ sanna.
en: It was dark now, and Jesus had not yet come back to them. They got into a boat and started going across the lake to Capernaum.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa mɛbu tuma, di daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla lala hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi saha.
en: So the work stopped on Gods Temple in Jerusalem. The work did not continue until the second year that Darius was king of Persia.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋ-ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni m-booni tab yɛra:.
en: Now, to what can I compare the people of this day? They are like children sitting in the marketplace. One group shouts to the other.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ni ti mali ba ansarisi, ka sabisi ba bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: It claps its hands over them, hisses at them from their place.

dag: m-bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ yɛda maa, yi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Aai, ti na ʒi n-wum ni Naawuni Shia beni gba.
en: He asked them, When you put your faith in Jesus, were you given the Holy Spirit? No! they answered. We have never even heard of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛn daa daŋ puu maa ni la ti kana n-tɛhiri ni bɛn ni deei gari lala; amaa ka o ti yo bɛ gba la tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: Then the workers who were hired first came to get their pay. They thought they would be paid more than the others. But each one of them also received one silver coin.

dag: Yi yi di niŋ Anabi Musa yɛda, yi naan niŋ n gba yɛda, dama o daa sabi n yɛla zali.
en: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi ni.
en: In the two courtyards of the Temple he built altars for the worship of the stars.

dag: ka yɛra, Ami! Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun su alibarika mini yɛm ni yiko ni kpiɔŋ simdi jilima tibu mini paɣibu ni tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami.
en: They said, Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili, mani n-lan su kum ni neebu yiko; ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, hal o yi kpi gba, o ni lan neei yaha.
en: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection. I am life. Everyone who believes in me will have life, even if they die.

dag: Ka Naa Ahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz died and was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu; ka chɛ ka n nuhi mali yaa din ni tooi zaŋ daanya tɔb to.
en: who trains my hands for war so my arms can bend a bronze bow.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, n ni kana ti paɣ a a tuun kara zuɣu, ka yɛl a kɔŋko wuntital la yɛla.
en: I will dwell on your mighty acts, my Lord. LORD, I will help others remember nothing but your righteous deeds.

dag: Ka Ahitɔfɛl daa ti lan yɛli Absalom yaha, Chɛ ka m pii niriba tuhi pinaayi n-zaŋ ba biɛhi Dauda naba yuŋ ŋɔ.
en: Ahithophel said to Absalom: Let me choose , men and attack David tonight.

dag: O chɛ ka suhudoo be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka zaŋ alikama viɛlli dihiri ya.
en: He brought peace to your country, so you have plenty of grain for food.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba suhiri Naawuni sɔŋdi ti, ka di chɛ ka niriba pam paɣi Naawuni o ni deei bɛ wunsuhigu gbaliŋ ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni la zuɣu.
en: as you help us by means of your prayers for us. So it will be that the many prayers for us will be answered, and God will bless us; and many will raise their voices to him in thanksgiving for us.

dag: Ka yi ni tumdi binshɛɣukam zaa tiri ba puuni, tummiya li ni yi suhuri zaa kaman ti Duuma ka yi tumdi li tiri la, ka pa ni ninsalinim ka yi tumdi li tira.
en: In all the work you are given, do the best you can. Work as though you are working for the Lord, not any earthly master.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa bɔhi, O yɛn kula omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka o yɛli ni o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ti ku tooi ka nimaani na maa.
en: So the Jewish leaders asked themselves, Will he kill himself? Is that why he said, You cannot come where I am going.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni mini duumanim zaa Duuma. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm, ŋun bi gaŋdi so bee n-diri birapu.
en: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: It is worth nothing for you to have the whole world if you yourself are lost. You could never pay enough to buy back your life.

dag: Wula ka a zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni ti bemi kaman Shilo la, ka tiŋ ŋɔ ti lee dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni? Ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim gili Jɛrimia Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Why have you said in the Lord 's name that this Temple will become like Shiloh and that this city will be destroyed and no one will live in it? Then the people crowded around me.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli zali maa zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili gili. Dina n-nyɛ luɣ kasi shee zaŋ tabili tiŋ maa tiŋgban la.
en: And so the total area in the center of the section which was set apart will be a square measuring miles on each side, and it will include the area occupied by the city.

dag: Yuuni kam puuni ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni tɔhiri anzinfa giram diba anu, ka bɛ mal li tumdi ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma.
en: We will accept the responsibility for obeying the commands to take care of Gods Temple. We will give / shekel of silver each year to support the Temple service to honor our God.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.

dag: Ka bɛ nahiŋgu maa buɣim nyɔhi ni kpuɣi du zuɣusaa hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ku mali vuhim yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu la min o binnani la ni bɛnkam deeg o yuli dalinli la.
en: The smoke of their painful suffering goes up forever and always. There is no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its image, and those who receive the mark of its name.

dag: Imɛr daŋ ni: Hanani mini Zɛbadia.
en: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Ka sɔŋsim bɔ ka a leei bɔra? Ka n daa suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: The king asked, What do you want me to do? I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim gba nyɛla yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa: Nimmira yɛlimaŋli tibu saria karibu bi viɛla.
en: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka yi yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo.
en: The Son of Man came eating and drinking. And you say, Look at him! He eats too much and drinks too much wine! He is a friend of tax collectors and other sinners.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Pɛka ʒiɛman ni ka Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza daa kana nti tuhi fa Ijɔn mini Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Janɔa ni Kɛdɛshi ni Hazɔr ni Giliad ni Galili ni Naftali tiŋgbani zaa, ka gbahi di niriba kuli Asiria ti leei daba.
en: In the days of Israels King Pekah, Assyrias King Tiglath-pileser came and captured Ijon, Abel-beth-maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor. He also captured Gilead, Galilee, and all the land of Naphtali. He sent the people into exile to Assyria.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri lala saha shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan, ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Abiata bia la dii paana. Ka Adɔnija yɛl o, Kpɛmina, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka ʒiri lahiba suŋ na.
en: Just then, Jonathan son of Abiathar came running up. Come in, Adonijah said. An important man like you must have some good news.

dag: Ba maa yur o Bia maa, ka wuhir o omaŋmaŋ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka ni lan wuh o tuun kara gari dimbɔŋɔnima din ni chɛ ka di niŋ ya alahiziba.
en: The Father loves the Son and shows him everything that he does. He will show him greater works than these so that you will marvel.

dag: O daa va salima mini anzinfa n-tabili Naawuni jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa din daa beni ka Obɛdɛdom bihi gul li la zaa, ka va nayili daazichi zaa, ka gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-lab kuli Samaria.
en: He took the gold and silver and all the other things in Gods Temple that Obed Edom was responsible for. Jehoash also took the treasures from the kings palace and some people as hostages. Then he went back to Samaria.

dag: A chɛ ka a mini Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ a ʒiʒiinitaba, ka nyɛ kɔribiɛrinim la tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam, ni a chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: Then you went to Egypt, your neighbor that is always ready for sex. With more and more sexual sin, you made me angry.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi la, Zaŋmiy o doli guliba maa sunsuuni gari, ka zaŋ takɔb ku ŋunkam be o polo. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛlimi, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: Jehoiada did not want Athaliah killed in the Temple area, so he ordered the army officers: Take her out between the rows of guards, and kill anyone who tries to rescue her.

dag: Aduna ŋɔ mini Musa ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Yihimiya Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbilligbilli la.
en: It was this same Aaron and Moses whom the LORD commanded, Bring the Israelites out of the land of Egypt in military formation.
