dag: N daa kul nyarila jilima, ka n kpiɔŋ kul be kaman tɔb palli la.
en: Everyone was always praising me, and my strength never failed me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da yaɣimɛr yaɣiri duɣu, ka zaŋ niriba kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba pahi amaŋ zuɣu.
en: The LORD proclaims: Go buy a clay jar from a potter in the presence of the elders of the people and the priests.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu n-gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi la o nuu ni siɣina. Musa daa bi mi ni o ninni nyaɣisira, o mini Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: Moses came down from Mount Sinai. As he came down from the mountain with the two covenant tablets in his hand, Moses didnt realize that the skin of his face shone brightly because he had been talking with God.

dag: Ka Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi daa nyaɣi lɔɣiri ba yuri n-zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi kana. Ka Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi mi daa gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: The soldiers from the land of Elam came riding on horseback, armed with bows and arrows. Soldiers from the land of Kir had their shields ready.

dag: Dinzuɣu, poloya ŋɔ zaa ni yi a min a yiŋnim zaa yinsi, ka lan yi a kpamba min a niriba zaa yinsi. Bɛ ni bela Nail Mɔɣili la ni kɔŋko.
en: The frogs will leave you, your house, your officials, and your people. They will remain only in the river.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la Amɔrinim nanim maa nuu ni, zaŋ Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini.
en: In that way we took the land from the two Amorite kings. We took that land on the east side of the Jordan River, from Arnon Valley to Mount Hermon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Sabimiya ni doo ŋɔ bi dɔɣi bihi, do so ŋun kul ku di nasara o nyɛvili ni. Dama o bihi ni so ti ku nya soli n-ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee n-lan su Judanim yaha.
en: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpɛhi Naawuni nini, ka lo kpara ni bɛ tuhi Kpiɔŋlan Naa;.
en: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful.

dag: N ni bɔri shɛli zaa nyɛla ni m baŋ Masia, ka baŋ o kum ni neebu yiko yɛla, ka pah o zuɣu di wahala, ka be kaman ŋuna o kum puuni.
en: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did.

dag: Hal Yisa ni daa yuri Lazarɔs mini Maata ni Mariama pam la zaa yoli.
en: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

dag: ka daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima sokam zaa zuɣu la. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din di Naawuni ni daa pun lo shɛm shɛhira, ka nyɛ din yi palo di saha dɛde.
en: who gave himself as a payment to set all people free. This was a testimony that was given at the right time.

dag: O ni balim a pam? O ni tɔɣis a suhumahili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will he beg you to let him go free? Will he speak to you with gentle words?.

dag: Ka n daa wum tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kalinli, ka di nyɛla tuhi piapia ʒii tuhi pia.
en: I heard how many troops on horses were in their army. There were .

dag: O yi taɣi saa zali, binshɛɣukam kuurimi; o yi bahi saa, kom din puhigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: God can hold back the rain or send a flood.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Karimba, m pun dolila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Teacher, he responded, Ive kept all of these things since I was a boy.

dag: Ti paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋ ti niŋ ti dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ bahi ti yoli ŋɔ.
en: Bless the LORD because he didnt hand us over like food for our enemies teeth!.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana n-niŋ tinsi maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka di niŋ yaa pam. O ni daa su Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliyanim shɛm m-bala.
en: and also shields and spears. In this way he kept Judah and Benjamin under his control.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili Jɔpa zaa, ka niriba pam daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Nyama, n daa zaŋ o leela shɛhira niriba sani. Ka lan zaŋ o leei niriba toondana ni tɔbbihi zuɣulana.
en: I made David a witness of my power for all nations. I promised him that he would become a ruler and commander of many nations.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Keenan Naa Jabin ŋun daa diri ʒi Hazɔr, ka o sapashin kpɛm nyɛ Sisɛra ŋun daa be Harɔshɛtihagɔim la nuu ni.
en: So the Lord let them be conquered by Jabin, a Canaanite king who ruled in the city of Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived at Harosheth-of-the-Gentiles.

dag: Ba maa ni mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni shɛm, lala ka o ti o Bia maa yiko ni o gba mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni.
en: Just as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son to have life in himself.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ninvuɣ tusa ayopɔin bɛn zaa na bi gbani jɛm Baal bee n-zaŋ bɛ noya mɔɣis o kuɣa la Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Yet I will leave seven thousand people alive in Israel—all those who are loyal to me and have not bowed to Baal or kissed his idol.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka niriba diri Naawuni daalikauli maa nyɔri, dindina ninsal yɛda niŋbu ka buchi, ka Naawuni daalikauli maa gba ka buchi.
en: If people could get Gods promise by following the law, then faith is worthless. And Gods promise to Abraham is worthless.

dag: Naa Sulemaana n-daa diri nam n-su Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: Solomon was king of all Israel.

dag: Ka o daa be bɛ sani hal ni yuma ayɔbu n-kul sɔɣila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka Atalia daa leei naa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: He remained hidden with them in Gods temple for six years while Athaliah ruled the country.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi kari Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinima, lala zuɣu Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim maa na kul be Izraɛlnim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: However, the Israelites did not force the people of Geshur and Maacah to leave, and they still live there among the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm gbaŋ maa ni m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs, a bihi bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ ti a.
en: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.

dag: O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni. Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ yɛli, Naawuni tiligim ti ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: I'll tell you what. He will come and kill those renters and let someone else have his vineyard. When the people heard this, they said, This must never happen.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, So beni m-me yili palli ka na bi suhi Naawuni ka kpe di ni? O labimi kul o yili maa ni, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so ti suhi Naawuni ka kpe o yili maa ni.
en: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.

dag: Ka sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya din niŋ maa ka paɣi Naawuni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla ŋun ka taali.
en: When the centurion saw what happened, he praised God, saying, Its really true: this man was righteous.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mi a sujee yiko ni nyɛ shɛm? A suhuyiɣisili galisimi kaman bɛ ni lur a sizuura shɛli ni galisi shɛm.
en: Who has felt the full power of your anger? Who knows what fear your fury can bring?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna ka yi ti ku lan po n-yɛli Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu. .
en: People make promises and say, As surely as the Lord lives—the Lord who brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt .... But the time is coming, says the Lord , when people will not say that.

dag: M mabiyurisi, hal ti ni kul yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ maa zaa yoli, ti niŋ ya naani. Ti mi ni yi mali bin suma din yi yi tiliginsim ni na ka nyɛ din so binshɛɣukam.
en: But even if we speak like this, dear friends, we feel sure about you. We know that you have the better blessings that belong to your salvation.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yinim lzraɛlnim bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani, miriya ka yi ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni.
en: That is why I am telling you Israelites and the foreigners living among you that you must not eat blood.

dag: n-gbahi ba ti kpɛhi duu.
en: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.

dag: Bee ŋuni n-na mi n-dih o samli ka di nyɛ talahi ni o yo dilana?.
en: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila maligumaaniba zuɣulana Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋ bipuɣin so ti kana.
en: While Peter was still in the yard, a servant girl of the high priest came there.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, Dauda be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: Someone told Saul, David is at Prophets Village in Ramah.

dag: Ka Siria naa ŋun liri ba n-teei gili ba maa ni niŋ ba o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka bɛ ku tooi niŋ shɛli. O ni ti chaŋ ti zani Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la ni n-deei li omaŋmaŋ yiko ni n-su zaa.
en: The one who comes to attack will do whatever he wants; no one will be able to oppose him. He will take his place in the beautiful country, and he will hand out destruction.

dag: Bin viɛla kul palila yɛndan yiŋa, amaa jɛrigu ŋun dirila di zaa.
en: Wise people live in wealth and luxury, but stupid people spend their money as fast as they get it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti lan tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka fa Gaat mini di tiŋkpansi zaa Filistianim maa sani.
en: Some time later King David attacked the Philistines again and defeated them. He took out of their control the city of Gath and its surrounding villages.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zabila yi zuɣu, ka bɔhi biɛri tin ya. N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn teeku kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka di kɔbilisirim gba nyuui.
en: And so the Lord said to the people of Jerusalem, I will take up your cause and will make your enemies pay for what they did to you. I will dry up the source of Babylonia's water and make its rivers go dry.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim paɣila mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: Solomon made two hundred large shields and had each one overlaid with almost fifteen pounds of gold.

dag: Ka m mi ni n yi ti ka yi sanna n ni ʒi Masia daalibarika din galisi pam na.
en: And I know that when I come to you I will come with the fullest blessing of Christ.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri pam niŋdi puri ka di maara, ka chɛ ka vuɣisi doya baalim, ka sakom chɛ ka di bala, ka bimbilli kam zoora.
en: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Jɛrubaal mini Barak ni Jafta ni Samsin ka bɛ kana ti fan ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni bahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka chɛ ka yi beni ka barina shɛli lan kani.
en: And the Lord sent Gideon, Barak, Jephthah, and finally me. Each of us rescued you from your enemies, and you lived in safety.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yihi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda puuni sɔŋsim mini niriba ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ni bindira sɔŋsim zaa ni kom sɔŋsim zaa.
en: Understand what I am telling you: The Lord GOD All-Powerful will take away everything Judah and Jerusalem depend on. He will take away all the food and water.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnima.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka tummi din viɛla; ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka a be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ka shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Trust the LORD and do good; live in the land, and farm faithfulness.

dag: Lɛbanɔn tihi zaa dari ku saɣi sara maligu buɣim; ka di biŋkɔbiri zaa ku saɣi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la malibu.
en: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.

dag: ni Jokim ni Kɔzɛbanima ni Jɔash ni Saraf ŋun daa di nam su Mɔabnima; ka daa ti lan labi Lɛhɛm la.
en: Jokim; the men of Cozeba; Joash; and Saraph, who married into Moab but returned to Bethlehem .

dag: N suhir a, deemi n ni zaŋ pin shɛl na ti ti a maa, dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma nirilim ti ma n ni mali shɛlikam maa, ka m mi mali pam. Lala ka Yaakubu daa balim o hal ka o ti dee li.
en: Please accept these as gifts I brought to you. God has been good to me, and I have everything I need. Jacob kept insisting until Esau agreed.

dag: Di simdi ni shɛhiranim maa n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni daŋ zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ bɛ ni yɛn ku ninvuɣ so maa kubu ni, di nyaaŋa ka sokam naanyi zaŋ bɛ nuhi kpɛhi di ni. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: The witnesses must throw the first stones to kill that person. Then the other people should throw stones to finish killing that person. In this way you will remove this evil from your group.

dag: Naa yi doli zaligu soli n-kariti nandaamba saria, o nam ni zani yuui.
en: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ, ka zaŋ o tanti suɣili kpa nimaani. Ka o tumtumdiba daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli nimaani yaha.
en: So Isaac built an altar there and worshipped in the LORDs name. Isaac pitched his tent there, and his servants dug a well.

dag: ka Hilikia nyɛ Amizi bia, ka Amizi nyɛ Bani bia, ka Bani nyɛ Shɛmɛr bia.
en: son of Amzi son of Bani son of Shemer.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Madimanna ni Sansanna.
en: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah.

dag: Paɣ zinalan biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O dirimi ka nyɛh o noli ka yɛli, M bi tum gala.
en: A woman who is not faithful to her husband acts innocent. She eats, wipes her mouth, and says she has done nothing wrong.

dag: O sani ka dɔɣiri yini kam niriba bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa yu maŋli yina.
en: Every ethnic group in heaven or on earth is recognized by him.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa yɛliŋ zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo gba, di simdi ka di nyɛla mita pisinaayi.
en: The courtyards width on the front, facing east, should be seventy-five feet.

dag: N kɔŋko ku tooi gbibi niriba ŋɔ zaa, dama bɛ galisi nyaŋ ma.
en: I can't be responsible for all these people by myself; it's too much for me!.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa ŋmaligi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: After this King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu somiya buri, ka kum ka fabili, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa na bi miligi ka chɛ ti.
en: Then I told the people of Israel, Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, The Lord is still angry with us. .

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas; o daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ ku nir ni yino.
en: There was a man in prison at that time named Barabbas. He and the rebels with him had been put in prison for committing murder during a riot.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka niriba paɣ a, chɛ ka niriba zaa paɣ a!.
en: Let the people thank you, God! Let all the people thank you!.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka doli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa la.
en: The Lord told me to say to the people, I, the Lord , have said that you must obey me by following the teaching that I gave you.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri li billi kaman o ni bɔri shɛm; o tiri bimbiɛlli kam la dimaŋmaŋ billi.
en: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛli ba, Jɔn daa baptaizirila niriba tuuba niŋbu zuɣu, ka yɛri ba ni bɛ niŋm Yisa ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa na la yɛda.
en: Paul replied, John baptized people so they would turn to God. But he also told them someone else was coming, and they should put their faith in him. Jesus is the one that John was talking about.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani.
en: Then one of the twelve disciples—the one named Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: That's why a man will leave his own father and mother. He marries a woman, and the two of them become like one person.

dag: ka zaŋ suhudoo lahibal suŋ molo molibu leei namdanim piri.
en: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.

dag: Yi ni so yi mali taali ni o kpee, o ni buɣisi ni o zaŋ di yɛla maa tahi sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka pa ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sani?.
en: When one of you has something against someone else in your group, why do you go to the judges in the law courts? The way they think and live is wrong. So why do you let them decide who is right? Why dont you let Gods holy people decide who is right?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Nyamiya, n je yi kan shɛŋa yi ni pirita ka zaŋ li diri n niriba nyɛviya maa. N ni dari chihi li yi nuhi ni ka chɛ ka yi ni mal li doli shɛba ni yi di bɛ nyɛviya kaman noonsi la nya bɛmaŋa.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says to you: You make those cloth bracelets to trap people, but I will set them free. I will tear those bracelets off your arms, and the people will be free from you. They will be like birds flying from a trap.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li.
en: Promise me, women of Jerusalem, that you will not interrupt our love.

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dunol ni na Yawɛ tooni nti zaŋ o nuu pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi naɣilaa maa Yawɛ tooni.
en: He will bring the bull before the LORD at the entrance to the meeting tent and press his hand on the bulls head. Then he will slaughter the bull before the LORD.

dag: A yɛliya, N ka taali, m bi tum birigi shɛli, n kul bela kasi, ka taali shɛli ka n kɔbili ni.
en: I am not guilty; I have done nothing wrong. I am innocent and free from sin.

dag: O niŋla lala ni bɛ bo ŋun Naawuni hal ti nya o. Ka ti zaa yinoyino min o bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: He did this so that they would look for him, and perhaps find him as they felt around for him. Yet God is actually not far from any one of us;.

dag: Di kpala talahi ni ti chɛ ba ti ni lo ba alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu; di yi pa lala, ti ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: This is what we must do. We must let them live. We cannot hurt them or God will be angry with us because we broke the promise we made to them.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaag o yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Job continued his answer:.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Biɛɣuni sa nyɛla gol palli dabisili, ka bɛ sa ni bɔ a kɔŋ, dama a sa ku ʒi a ʒiishee.
en: Tomorrow is the festival of the new moon, Jonathan told David. You will be missed because your seat will be empty.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa darigi cheeicheei bɛ binyɛra, ka kpuɣi bɛ ʒiya pa bɛ bunsi zuɣu ŋ-ŋmaligi lab tiŋ maa ni.
en: The brothers tore their clothes in sorrow, loaded their donkeys, and returned to the city.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, yum maa yi paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, o shiri nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: The priest must look at the person. If the skin has become white, the person who had the infection is clean, and the priest must announce this.

dag: ka bo wain lita yini ni pirigili din nyɛ binnyura sara shɛli din ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: And you must prepare / quarts of wine as a drink offering. Its smell will please the Lord .

dag: Yi yaannim bɛn daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti la daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin, ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: Your ancestors went down to Egypt with a total of seventy people, but now look! The LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the nighttime sky!.

dag: Ka Ɛhab bɔh o, Ka banima n-lee yɛn gari tooni chaŋ ti liri ba? Ka anab maa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi la n-yɛn gari tooni. Ka Ɛhab lan bɔh o, Ka ŋuni nti lee yɛn piligi tɔb maa? Ka o yɛl o, Nyini.
en: Who will fight the battle? Ahab asked. The prophet answered, The young bodyguards who serve the district officials. But who will lead them into battle? Ahab asked. You will! the prophet replied.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ŋmanila gɔ shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ labi; dama so ku tooi zaŋ o nuu kpuɣi ba.
en: But evil people are like thorns. People dont hold thorns. They throw them away.

dag: Ti wum dinkam beni. Yɛlli maa naabu m-bɔŋɔ: Zom Naawuni, ka dol o zaligunima; di ni simdi ni sokam niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o lab kuli o ya Rama. Ŋuna n-daa lan maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani gba. O daa lan me sara maligu bimbini nimaani ti Yawɛ.
en: Then he would return to Ramah because thats where his home was. In Ramah too he served as Israels judge, and that is also where he built an altar to the LORD.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa yɛdaniŋdib bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-doli Pita na la alahiziba bɛ ni daa nya ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu;.
en: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yaɣili kam zuliya yɛtɔɣa ni mini bɛ sabbu ni nyɛ shɛm puuni n-ti o tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nima n-yɛli ni yidan kam n-nyɛ o yiŋ zuɣulana. Ka o yɛligu simdi ni di zani.
en: He sent written orders to all the kings provinces. Each province received it written in its own alphabet and each people received it in its own language. It said that each husband should rule over his own house.

dag: yɛra, Yawɛ yi di daa chɛ ka ti kpi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di daa naan so, dama ti daa nyari nimdi ŋubira, ka diri bindira ti yubu, amaa yi zaŋ ti mi na ti bahi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ni yi chɛ ka kum ku ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: We wish the Lord had killed us in Egypt. When we lived there, we could at least sit down and eat all the bread and meat we wanted. But you have brought us out here into this desert, where we are going to starve.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila gomna Rɛhum mini Shimshai ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaɣili polo gbaŋŋmar la ni bɛ taba bɛn kpalim ni sariakaritiba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni kpamba ni Pɛriʒianim ni Ɛrɛknim ni Babilɔnnim ni Susa din be Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nima.
en: From Rehum the royal deputy and Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their colleagues, the judges, the administrators, the officials, the Persians, the people of Erech, the Babylonians, the people of Susa.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din be Nail Mɔɣili maa duli ni ti kuui, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛlikam dolisi mɔɣili maa ti kuui zaa, ka pɔhim ʒe li chaŋ.
en: All the plants along the riverbanks will die and blow away. Even the plants at the widest part of the river will dry up, blow away, and disappear.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim niriba maa ni ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm ka o ni sɔhira, ŋun lab kuli. Ka Gidiɔn daa buɣisi ba lala, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi daa lab kuli; ka chɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia kɔŋko.
en: Announce to the people, Anyone who is afraid should go back home, and we will stay here at Mount Gilead. So twenty-two thousand went back, but ten thousand stayed.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla tarimba ni yino bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-kpe taali ni.
en: If any ordinary person sins unintentionally by breaking one of the LORDs commands, doing something that shouldnt be done, and becomes guilty of sin.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa: Gbilisim tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni wuhir a shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: Listen, and I will teach you what the wise have said. Study their teachings.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni nir ŋubi nimdi bee n-nyu dam bee n-niŋ binshɛli din ni chɛ ka o kpee tuui lu.
en: The right thing to do is to keep from eating meat, drinking wine, or doing anything else that will make other believers fall.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-bala.
en: And so the land will be made clean again.

dag: di simdi ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la.
en: just as this is removed from the ox for the communal sacrifice of well-being. Then the priest will completely burn these on the altar of entirely burned offerings.

dag: Ka Yaakubu paɣ Reechɛl bidibisi daa nyɛ: Yisifu mini Bɛnjamin.
en: The sons of Jacobs wife Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

dag: ni Zɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la ni Naharai ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nira ka daa nyɛ ŋun ʒiri Zɛruya bia Jɔab tɔbutuhiri nɛma la.
en: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai from Beeroth ;.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli hal ti paai di tariga, ka Izraɛl laɣiŋgu maa zaa wum li.
en: Then Moses recited the entire song while all the people of Israel listened.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum a niriba Izraɛlnim maa suhigu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi ka lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni na.
en: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa bi lan lihir o ni zaŋ binshɛlikam niŋ Yisifu nuu ni maa, dama Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani, ka o daa yi niŋ shɛlikam, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka di tɔŋ.
en: The commander of the guards trusted Joseph with everything that was in the prison. This happened because the Lord was with Joseph. The Lord helped Joseph be successful in everything he did.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka niŋdi n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka doli n zaligunim zaa.
en: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings.

dag: Nir yi gbaag omaŋa ka chɛ zabili, di tir o jilima, amaa jɛrigu kam ŋun bɔrila zabili yomyom.
en: It is honorable to back off from a fight, but fools jump right in.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kul niŋdi ba fitiina shɛm, lala ka bɛ zuliya maa daa kul nabiri ka yɛligiri pahira. Ka jɛlinsi mini dabiɛm daa kpe Ijiptinim maa suhuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: The Egyptians forced the Israelites to work harder and harder. But the harder they worked, the more they grew and spread, and the more the Egyptians became afraid of them.

dag: ni Zadok ni Ahimaaz.
en: Zadok, Ahimaaz.

dag: Ka daɣila m piɛri maa yɛn ŋubila yi ni no mo shɛŋa sɔŋ maa, ka nyu yi ni zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli maa?.
en: That means my other sheep have nothing fit to eat or drink.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania maligumaaniba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa ʒe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni ninni.
en: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:.

dag: Ka m mali tahima ti Duuma sani ni di ku yuui ka mmaŋmaŋ gba tooi ka yi sanna.
en: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will be able to come to you soon.

dag: Man yɛm, m mini baŋsim m-be, ka baŋsim mini fahim be n sani.
en: I, Wisdom, dwell with prudence; I have found knowledge and discretion.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ saha ka a dimnim maa lee yɛn chɛ a labu? Bɛ kul yɛn tarila a yuli daɣiri sahakam?.
en: How long, O God, will our enemies laugh at you? Will they insult your name forever?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lan da puri tiŋgbɔn shɛli bɛ ni yɛra, Di leela dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri lan ka di ni, bɛ zaŋ li niŋla Kalidianim nuu ni la.
en: You people are saying, This land is an empty desert. There are no people or animals here. The Babylonian army defeated this country. But in the future people will once again buy fields in this land.

dag: N nyaya ka Ifriimnim bidibisi simdi ni binyara ŋub ba. Di simdi ni Ifriimnim zaŋ bɛ bidibisi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ku ba.
en: When I looked toward Tyre, Ephraim was planted in a lovely meadow; but now Ephraim must lead out his children for slaughter.

dag: Amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku ka n sanna ti nya nyɛvili.
en: yet you dont want to come to me so that you can have life.

dag: Dama Anabi Jona ni daa be zahim pul ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba ti yɛn be tiŋgban ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata.
en: In the same way that Jonah spent three days and nights in the big fish, so will the Son of Man spend three days and nights in the depths of the earth.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi tahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din gbibi ya.
en: But Jesus turned and corrected them for what they had said.

dag: N tuumbiɛri mini n daalahichi lee nyɛla diba ala? Chɛ ka m baŋ m biriginsim mini n daalahichi.
en: How many sins have I committed? What wrongs have I done? Show me where I went wrong or how I sinned.

dag: Di bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni tin shɛŋa din kɔɣili li niriba ni daa tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kul tumdi din chihiri la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka saha din ka bahigu buɣim bahi ba yoli, ka di leei din kpahiri sokam zaa zuɣu ni.
en: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.

dag: Bɛ bɔhira, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti lɔri noli ka a bi nyara? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka ti nahim timaŋa, ka a baɣa kani. Nyama, yi ni lɔri noli dahin shɛli maa yi niŋdila din ni sɔŋ yimaŋa, ka nahindi yi tumtumdiba.
en: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara. Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee.
en: When an evil spirit comes out of someone, it travels through dry places, looking for a place to rest. But it finds no place to rest. So it says, I will go back to the home I left.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm mali Aduna min o bidibisi ka bɛ tooi tum maligumaaniba tuma ti ma m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi naɣila polli mini piɛlah ayi bɛn ka galimi.
en: This is what you are to do to Aaron and his sons to dedicate them as priests in my service. Take one young bull and two rams without any defects.

dag: N ni zaŋ di mini Ammɔnnim niŋ wulimpuhili polo nim nuu ni, ka bɛ su ba, ka zuliya shɛb ku lan teei Ammɔnnim yɛla.
en: I will let the tribes of the eastern desert conquer Moab, together with Ammon, so that Moab will no longer be a nation.

dag: Ka Maika bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔhi ma ni bɔ n-chɛ ka n zaŋ niriba ŋɔ pa mmaŋ zuɣu na? Yi kpuɣila n wuna, ka zaŋ m maligumaana pahi, ka bɔ ka yi lee chɛ n-ti mani.
en: Micah answered, You know what's wrong. You stole the gods I made, and you took my priest. I don't have anything left.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ? Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ʒi nam kuɣu zuɣu zuɣusaa ha.
en: Who could possibly compare to the LORD our God? God rules from on high.

dag: Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpuɣi Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir ŋun daa yi Mɛsopoteemia la na bipuɣiŋga la. Ribɛka daa nyɛla Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir la tizɔpaɣa.
en: Isaac was years old when he married Rebekah the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean and the sister of Laban the Aramean, from Paddan-aram.

dag: Dama bɛ dirila ninvuɣ biɛtali bindirigu, ka nyuri duŋtaabo wain.
en: Evil and violence are their food and drink.

dag: O daa me Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yili; ka di wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka bɛ daa me li tamla sida dari kulis ata mini di dapuhi zuɣu.
en: He also built the building called the Forest of Lebanon. It was cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high. It had four rows of cedar columns. On top of each column was a cedar capital.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim niriba maa ni ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm ka o ni sɔhira, ŋun lab kuli. Ka Gidiɔn daa buɣisi ba lala, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi daa lab kuli; ka chɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pia kɔŋko.
en: So make an announcement to your men. Tell them, Anyone who is afraid may leave Mount Gilead and go back home. At that time , men left Gideon and went back home, but , still remained.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka zɔhi mini nanviri waɣi pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: The Lord gave the command, and the flies and gnats came. They were everywhere!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Daadam Bia labina ni o nam.
en: Believe me when I say that there are some people standing here who will see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom before they die.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, bɛ kul chanimi gindi tiŋ maa goma, ka tuumbiɛri mini nyaanyibo be di ni.
en: surrounding it day and night, filling it with crime and trouble.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni deei n kawana, kawana ŋahibu saha, ka deei n wain, wain tɔɣibu saha, ka deei n daago mini atampa shɛli n ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o lir o gbin la.
en: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.

dag: Bɛ kuhiri booni ma, Ti Naawuni, tinim Izraɛlnim mi a.
en: Israel cries to me, My God, we know you.

dag: Bɛ yi kana ti kaai ma, bɛ tɛhirila yɛl biɛri yɛla. Bɛ yi lo yɛtɔɣ biɛri ŋɔ nia bɛ suhuri ni naai, bɛ yirimi chaŋ ti zaŋ li moli gili.
en: If they come to see me, they dont say what they are really thinking. They come to gather a little gossip and then go to spread their rumors.

dag: Yinim Samarianima, n zaɣisi yi naɣibil maa. N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn tooi yi taali ni?.
en: I hate the gold bull worshiped by the people of the city of Samaria. I am furious with them. How long will it be before they give up their idolatry?.

dag: O yi lo ni o kul doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi kaman o ni doli li shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, n ni chɛ ka o nam mali yaa.
en: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.

dag: Bihi bɛn nyɛ jɛra tirila bɛ banim suhugarigu, ka tiri bɛ ma ŋun dɔɣi ba biɛrim.
en: Foolish children bring grief to their fathers and bitter regrets to their mothers.

dag: Yawɛ zali zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo. Yi yuli ku lan beni. N ni wurim yi ni kpe binnan shɛŋa mini yi ni mali binnan shɛŋa zali yi buɣa duu puuni la. N ni gbi yi gbala, dama yi ka buchi.
en: This is what the Lord has decreed about the Assyrians: They will have no descendants to carry on their name. I will destroy the idols that are in the temples of their gods. I am preparing a grave for the Assyrians—they don't deserve to live.

dag: Ka Jɛfita lan bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Yi yi zaŋ ma kuli ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka n nyaŋ ba, yi ni saɣi ka n leei yi zuɣulana.
en: Jephthah said to them, If you take me back home to fight the Ammonites and the Lord gives me victory, I will be your ruler.

dag: ka lan mi o yubu, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa, ka di nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuh a lala zuɣu.
en: You know what God wants you to do. And you know what is important, because you have learned the law.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn soli ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim, di kul neerimi pahiri hal ti be kaman wuntaŋ yi ti zani zuɣu ni la.
en: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.

dag: A takɔb zuɣu ka a yɛn dira, ka jɛmd a tizo maa. Amaa a yi zaɣis amaŋ zuɣu, a ni yi o sulinsi ni.
en: You will live by your sword, But be your brother's slave. Yet when you rebel, You will break away from his control.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko nyɛla ŋun kul niŋd o ni bɔri shɛli, ka o nini bi tiɣiri shɛb ni tumdi din tuhi ka di viɛli shɛm.
en: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-su ti nyɔtaɣirigu, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-su ti naa.
en: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla ŋun paai goli zaŋ hal ni yuma anu, di yi nyɛla doo, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini diba anu, ka di yi nyɛla paɣa, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini diba ata.
en: If the age of the person is between one month and years, the value for a male is five silver shekels, for a female three silver shekels.

dag: Dauda n-daa nyɛ biasani, ka bidib kpamba ata maa daa doli Sool chaŋ.
en: David was the youngest son, and while the three oldest brothers stayed with Saul.

dag: Ti Duuma Shia Kasi be n zuɣu, dama o pii ma ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti tarimba. O tim ma na ni n ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ daba la yi dabitim ni, ka chɛ ka zoomba nina neei, ka fa bɛn be muɣisigu ni la bahi.
en: The Lord's Spirit has come to me, because he has chosen me to tell the good news to the poor. The Lord has sent me to announce freedom for prisoners, to give sight to the blind, to free everyone who suffers.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Gibiɔnnim maa na ka o ti bɔhi ba. Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɔhim ti yɛli, Ti mini ya shee wɔɣ pam. ka kul bela ti sani kpe ŋɔ?.
en: Joshua called the Gibeonites together. He said, Why did you lie to us? Your land was near our camp. But you told us you were from a faraway country.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan n-zaŋd o nuu timdi laa ni hal ka bi bɔri ni o ŋmaai bindirigu ti kpar o nol ni.
en: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.

dag: Ka Jɛsi lan chɛ ka Shamma kana ti gari, ka o lan yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Jesse then brought Shammah. No, the Lord hasn't chosen him either, Samuel said.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba zɔrimi sɔɣira, amaa bɛ yi ti lan kani, wuntizɔriba zoorimi pahi.
en: When the wicked rise to power, everyone hides. When they are defeated, good people multiply.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Shɛmaya daa ka Rɛhɔbɔam mini Juda kpamba bɛn daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm Shishak dabiɛm zuɣu la sanna nti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni zaɣisi ma la zuɣu ka n gba zaɣisi ya ka zaŋ ya niŋ Shishak nuu ni maa.
en: Then the prophet Shemaiah went to Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and told them, This is what the LORD says: Since you have abandoned me, now I am abandoning you to Shishaks power.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka di ka nyu. Ka o daa bo difu ti bɛ bunsi la gba.
en: So he took them home with him and fed their donkeys. His guests washed their feet and had a meal.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a so Tɛbis din baɣi Nail ka kom gil li, ka teeku nyɛ din taɣiri li ka kom nyɛ di gooni la?.
en: Nineveh, are you better than Thebes on the Nile River? Thebes also had water all around her to protect herself from enemies. She used that water like a wall too.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka bɛ zaŋ kikahi ayopɔin ti malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn ʒe Naawuni tooni.
en: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.

dag: Naawuni, Wummi n kuhigu; ka deei n suhigu!.
en: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer!.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa duhi Jɔshua Izraɛlnim zaa ninni, ka bɛ daa lu Jɔshua sizuura kaman bɛ ni daa yi luri Musa sizuura shɛm la hal ni Jɔshua nyɛvili tariga.
en: The LORD made Joshua great in the opinion of all Israel on that day. So they revered him in the same way that they had revered Moses during all of his life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shini ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama naa daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: But they kept quiet and didnt answer him with a single word, because King Hezekiahs command was, Dont answer him.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi. Di simdi ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam bɛ mini bɛ zuliya sani bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: They must wash their hands and feet, so that they will not die. This is a rule which they and their descendants are to observe forever.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab ni daa ti baŋ ni Naa Dauda suhu lu Absalom ni.
en: Joab knew that King David missed Absalom very much.

dag: Ka bɛ daa karim li hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din wuhi Bigitana mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣilis ayi bɛn guli naa zɔntua dunol la ni daa lo nia ni bɛ sɔɣ ku Naa Ahasivɛrɔs, ka Mɔdɛkai daa wum li ka zaŋ yɛli naa la.
en: They came to the report about Mordecai informing on Bigthan and Teresh.

dag: N ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ, yi pa leela ŋmɛnditoya duu yi sani? Yawɛ yɛliya, N kul pala nina lihiri ya.
en: Do you think that my Temple is a hiding place for robbers? I have seen what you are doing.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli, ka zaŋ ma doli so viɛlli, n dimnim zuɣu.
en: Teach me, Lord , what you want me to do, and lead me along a safe path, because I have many enemies.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa kaɣil o hal ka di ti niŋ o vi, ka o bahi ba noli ni bɛ timma. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim ninvuɣ pihinu ka bɛ chaŋ ti lihi bɔ o dabisi muna ata zaa ka bi nya o.
en: They insisted until he became embarrassed and said, Okay, send them. So they sent fifty men who searched for three days. But they couldnt find Elijah.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti ni bɔh o nya.
en: But Jehoshaphat asked, Isn't there another prophet through whom we can consult the Lord .

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ suhukpeendana ni kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The LORDs messenger appeared to him and said, The LORD is with you, mighty warrior.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋun pun su kom bi lan bɔr o luɣ shɛli polo paɣibu n-naɣ pahila o naba, dama o ni zaa pun viɛlimi. Ka yɛli ba, Yi zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila yi ni yino.
en: Jesus answered, People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.

dag: Di niŋya binshɛli nyuli zabbu tɛha puuni bee m-bɔri ni yi doli alaha soli nyu bara; amaa siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani ka miriya ka yi tɛhiri ni yi so yi taba.
en: Dont do anything for selfish purposes, but with humility think of others as better than yourselves.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ yɛli ba ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then they went and did what the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: So Jesus called them all together to him and said, You know that those who are considered rulers of the heathen have power over them, and the leaders have complete authority.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o yiŋnim dɔbba yinoyino zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Karimi bia Ɛkan ŋun daa nyɛ Zabidi mini Zɛra yaaŋa ka yi Juda zuliya ni na la.
en: He made each soldier of his family come forward. Achan was selected. He was a son of Carmi, grandson of Zabdi, great-grandson of Zerah, and of the tribe of Judah.

dag: Yi yaanniin daa di bindir shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni ka kpi.
en: Your ancestors ate the manna God gave them in the desert, but it didnt keep them from dying.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ammɔnnim na so ŋun yuli daa booni Nahash la daa ti lo tɔb na nti teei gili Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga la nima. Ka Jabɛshi dɔbba zaa daa yɛli naa Nahash, Chɛ ka ti min a tɔɣisi ka a zali ti zaligu ka ti jɛmd a.
en: About a month later King Nahash of Ammon led his army against the town of Jabesh in the territory of Gilead and besieged it. The men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a treaty with us, and we will accept you as our ruler.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teei yi ni daa nyɛ bipola ka ʒe yim shɛm la yɛla. Yi yurilim daa ŋmanila amiliya yurilim, yi daa doli ma la tiŋgban nɛl ni, din nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli ni so ni na ʒi m-biri binshɛli.
en: Go and proclaim to the people of Jerusalem, The LORD proclaims: I remember your first love, your devotion as a young bride, how you followed me in the wilderness, in an unplanted land.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn pa a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka yi tinshee katiŋ kana a yuli din galisi ŋɔ min a yiko tuma ni a ni kul tumdi shɛlikam zuɣu, bɛ yi ti zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: When foreigners who live in a distant land hear how great and powerful you are and how you are always ready to act, and then they come to pray at this Temple.

dag: Amaa a ti ma kpiɔŋ ka di be kaman yɔnaɣilaa kpiɔŋ la. A booi kpa viɛlli bahi n zuɣu ni.
en: But you have made me as strong as a wild ox. You have given me your blessing.

dag: Ʒiɛman biɛɣu ŋɔ nim ninvuɣ yino gba nini ku nya n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli ti yi yaannim maa.
en: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.

dag: Dama nir yi bɔri ni o yuli yi palo, o ku tumd o tuma ashilɔni. A yi tumdi tuma ŋɔ tatabo, nyin yihim amaŋ palɔni ka sokam baŋ a.
en: If you want to be well known, you must not hide what you do. So, if you can do such amazing things, let the whole world see you do them.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina, n yi lan niŋ Filistianim zaɣ biɛɣu, di pala n taali.
en: Samson replied, No one can blame me now for being ready to bring down trouble on the Philistines.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya nyɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma. Ka Zadok mini Abiata nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Commander of the army: Benaiah son of Jehoiada Priests: Zadok and Abiathar.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zani Gibia ni bɛ liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa.
en: Then they left their camp and got into position to attack the army of Benjamin.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, Naawuni yur a pam. Yiɣisim zani n-luɣ a tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga; bɛ tim ma la a sanna. O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n yiɣisi zani ka n ni na kul sɔhira.
en: The angel said to me, Daniel, God loves you. Stand up and listen carefully to what I am going to say. I have been sent to you. When he had said this, I stood up, still trembling.

dag: Ŋunkam ku nira mini ŋunkam shihi kpima, benya sambani ŋɔ ni daba ayopɔin. Yi mini yi ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb na maa zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-niŋ kasi daba ata dali mini daba ayopɔin dali.
en: Now all of you who have killed anyone or have touched a corpse must stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and on the seventh day purify yourselves and the women you have captured.

dag: m-pahi paɣ shɛb o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ dɔriti naai min o ni daa kari alizin biɛri paɣ shɛb zuɣu bahi la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na ka nyɛ alizin biɛr ayopɔin ni daa ʒi so zuɣu la.
en: and so did some women who had been healed of evil spirits and diseases: Mary , from whom seven demons had been driven out;.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni daa bi boli ti ni ti ti tumdila niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, amaa o daa boli ti ni ti ti dolila kasitali biɛhigu soli.
en: God chose us to be holy. He does not want us to live in sin.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni.
en: That evening, Jesus and the disciples went outside the city.

dag: Amaa ka Naaman daa je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi chani ka yɛra, Man di mi ni o yɛn yimina nti zani n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa, ka zaŋ o nuu gahigahi kpe, ka chɛ ka n kɔŋ maa naai.
en: But Naaman went away in anger. He said, I thought for sure that hed come out, stand and call on the name of the LORD his God, wave his hand over the bad spot, and cure the skin disease.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai niriba maa pam ka bɛ yɛl o, Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ŋɔ? Bɛ daa baŋya ni o yila Yawɛ sani zɔra, dama omaŋmaŋa n-daa pun yɛli ba lala.
en: Then the men were terrified and said to him, What have you done.

dag: Mirimiya ma na ti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm. Piligu ni zaŋ kana, n na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni. N daa pun beni ka yɛlli ŋɔ na bi niŋ. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-zaŋ o shia niŋ n ni n-tim ma.
en: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me.

dag: Yɛlim Lɛvinima, Yi yi ti deei zaka bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini Izraɛlnim sani, din nyɛ n ni deei shɛli bɛ sani tin ya ka di nyɛ yi tarili la, yin yihimiya di bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini ti man Yawɛ, ka di nyɛ zaka binyɛra puuni mi zaka.
en: Speak to the Levites and tell them: The Israelites will give one-tenth of everything they own to the Lord . That one-tenth will belong to the Levites. But you must give one-tenth of that to the Lord as your offering.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl min o bia Bɛnhadad kul tuhiri nyandi ba waawaayili.
en: So the Lord was angry with Israel, and he allowed King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad to defeat Israel time after time.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya Juda fɔntinsi ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa tɔhi liɣiri ka yi zaŋ li na ka ti ti maani yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuuni kam. Niŋmiya lala yomyom. Amaa ka Lɛvinim maa daa bi niŋdi yomyom.
en: He called together the priests and Levites and said, Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple. But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wuni ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni m-be ka nyini. Dama nyini n-gbib a alikauli ni yurilim din bi naara zaŋ chaŋ a daba bɛn dol a ni bɛ suhuri zaa sani.
en: and said, Lord , God of Israel, there is no god like you in heaven or on earth. You keep the agreement that you made with your people. You are kind and loyal to those who follow you with all their heart.

dag: A ni mali yɛm pam zaŋ chaŋ daabiligu polo maa zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a buni nabi pahi, ka a mali karimbaani a buni maa zuɣu.
en: Through your shrewd trading you multiplied your riches. But then you became proud of your riches.

dag: Ka zoomba mini gbariti daa ka o sanna Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: The blind and the crippled came to him in the Temple, and he healed them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa teeg o nuu kpuɣi sua ni o kɔrig o bia maa.
en: Then Abraham reached for his knife to kill his son.

dag: Ka ŋunkam saɣim Naawuni zaligu zaɣ yini ni mali di zaa saɣimbu taali.
en: Anyone who tries to keep all of the Law but fails at one point is guilty of failing to keep all of it.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo bee m-booi li bahi ninvuɣ yiriŋ zuɣu ni, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni. .
en: Whoever blends an oil like it or whoever uses the oil on someone else will be cut off from the people.

dag: Bɛ laɣimmi naai noli, ka lo nia biɛɣu jɛnd a.
en: They agree on their plan and form an alliance against you:.

dag: Ka Zakaria daa nya malaika maa ka di gar o, ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pam.
en: When he saw the angel, Zechariah was upset and very afraid.

dag: ka zaŋ o yiko niŋ dabitim ni, ka chɛ o jilima ti ti dimnima.
en: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.

dag: Azuba ni daa ti kpi, Kalɛb daa kpuɣila Ɛfirat, ka o daa dɔɣi Hur.
en: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur.

dag: Ŋarimiya yiliŋ kam, ka gbi zoya mini kuŋkuna ka di siɣi n-leei tintani, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli.
en: Every valley will be raised up, and every mountain and hill will be flattened. Uneven ground will become level, and rough terrain a valley plain.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa ti niŋ ŋun kani Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Tɛra daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: Terah died there at the age of .

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a daa chɛ ka sagbani wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn doli shɛli polo.
en: With a pillar of cloud you led them by day and with a column of lightning by night; they lit the way in which the people should go.

dag: Di simdi ni tiŋgbani dam dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, ka ŋunkam be di ni fabili. Di simdi ni di kpuɣi du zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la n-lalilali gili nti lab ti fim; ka lan kpuɣi zuɣusaa n-lab lu tiŋa kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: And so the earth will quake, and everyone in the land will be in distress. The whole country will be shaken; it will rise and fall like the Nile River.

dag: Dauda n-daa nyɛ biasani, ka bidib kpamba ata maa daa doli Sool chaŋ.
en: David was the youngest son. The three oldest sons were in Sauls army.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa niŋ darigi Abimilɛk tibili o ni daa tum o ba tuumbiɛ shɛli din nyɛ o ni daa ku omaŋmaŋ ba bidibisi pisopɔin la zuɣu.
en: That's how God punished Abimelech for killing his brothers and bringing shame on his father's family.

dag: Ka Naa Hiram ŋariŋ shɛli din daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima la na daa lan ʒi alimug dari pam mini kuɣ viɛla gba n-yi Ofiri maa na.
en: Hirams ships brought gold from Ophir. They also brought jewels and a special kind of wood.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli kpamba maa, Yinim kpalimmiya be kpe n-guhi ti hal ka ti ti lab yi sanna. Aduna mini Hur be yi sani, ka ŋunkam mali yɛl shɛli, ŋun cham bɛ sani.
en: Moses said to the leaders, Wait here in the camp for us until we come back. Aaron and Hur are here with you; and so whoever has a dispute to settle can go to them.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so bahi maa so, dama zibisim ni ka o ŋmaligi labi, ka so ʒi o yɛla.
en: It is senseless when a baby is born dead. The baby is quickly buried in a dark grave, without even a name.

dag: ka n daa ti nya ʒii ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Zom yom yi Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ ku deeg a shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ m polo.
en: of the Lord who said to me, Hurry and leave Jerusalem! The people won't listen to what you say about me.

dag: Ka Dauda daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani m-mali suhudoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ daa wum bɛ ni suh o Izraɛl tiŋgbani maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka vuug alɔbo maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: Then he built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. The Lord answered his prayer, and the epidemic in Israel was stopped.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa gbahi bɛ mabihi Judanim maa niriba tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣiba mini bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi, ka di nɛma pam n-zaŋ kuli Samaria.
en: The Israelite troops captured , women and children and took them back to their capital city of Samaria, along with a large amount of their possessions. They did these things even though the people of Judah were their own relatives.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba na ti zaani tooni, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Juda zuliya.
en: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n daa yi m ma puli ni na ni n ti nyari muɣisigu mini suhugarigu, ka vi kul yɛn diri ma hal ni n nyɛvili tariga?.
en: Why was I born? Was it only to have trouble and sorrow, to end my life in disgrace?.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ Sool sani nti nya ka dabiɛm gbaai Sool pam ka o yɛl o, Nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛli maa, m mi zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima, ka niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The woman came over to Saul and saw how afraid he was. She said, Look, I am your servant. I have obeyed you. I risked my life and did what you told me to do.

dag: Hal nandaamba ʒiʒiinitab je ba, amaa bundaannim bɛn mali zɔnim pam.
en: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn pun tiɣi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama kum ni ti wum ya. Mbusim be yinim bɛn lari pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi ni ti kum ka fabili.
en: You well-fed people are in for trouble. You will go hungry! You people who are laughing now are in for trouble. You are going to cry and weep!.

dag: Naawuni, nyini m-pun wuhi ma m bilim ni ha, ka n na kul mooni a daalahiziba tuma molo.
en: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.

dag: Amaa yimaŋmaŋ tumdi tab taali ka diri tab zalinsi, hal yimaŋmaŋ mabihi ka yi niŋdi lala maa.
en: Instead, you yourselves wrong one another and rob one another, even other believers!.

dag: Musa ni daa ti kul kana ti miri suɣa maa gbini n-nya naɣibila maa, ka nya bɛ ni wari waa maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaŋ bimparilana din daa be o nuu ni maa bahi zoli maa gbini ka di ŋma.
en: When he got near the camp and saw the bull calf and the dancing, Moses was furious. He hurled the tablets down and shattered them in pieces at the foot of the mountain.

dag: Teeku puuni zahim mini noonsi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be mɔɣu ni ŋɔ ni biŋgbamda ni ninsalinim zaa bɛn be dunia ni niŋgbuna ni ti sɔhigi n tooni, ka zoya ti wurim ka tampima luna, ka gooni kam lu.
en: Every fish and bird, every animal large and small, and every human being on the face of the earth will tremble for fear of me. Mountains will fall, cliffs will crumble, and every wall will collapse.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa yiɣisi Seir zoya zuɣu, a ni daa yi Ɛdom tiŋgban ni chana, tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa luna. Iin, ka sagbana daa chɛ ka saa luna.
en: Lord , when you left the mountains of Seir, when you came out of the region of Edom, the earth shook, and rain fell from the sky. Yes, water poured down from the clouds.

dag: Ka o dii siɣina ti puh o, ka deeg o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Zacchaeus hurried and came down. He was happy to have Jesus in his house.

dag: Ka yi ti leei bɛ ni je ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ ni turi ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ni maani ninvuɣ shɛba ansarisi Yawɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ya tahi zuliya shɛb zaa sani maa.
en: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.

dag: Anabinima n-su bɛmaŋmaŋ shihi fukumsi.
en: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka doliya zaligunim ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Remember how each of you was a slave in Egypt, so follow these regulations most carefully.

dag: N suhu kul tɔrila pampam ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai, ka n nina niŋ liti.
en: My heart is pounding. My strength is gone, and I am going blind.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa zaŋ tulaale laa maa m-mooi bimbini maa zuɣu buɣim m-pal li n-zaŋ kpaai bahi dunia ni, ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ni tahibu, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda.
en: Then the angel took the incense container and filled it with fire from the altar. He threw it down to the earth, and there were thunder, voices, lightning, and an earthquake.

dag: Ti daa wum bɛ yɛla ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisimi, ka biɛrim pam mali ti, ka biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: We have heard reports of them and are panic-stricken; distress overwhelms us, pain like that of a woman in labor.

dag: Di mi bi tuhi ni ti zahim ti Duuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka tinvura dim ku ba la.
en: Lets not test Christ, like some of them did, and were killed by the snakes.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n daa zaŋla n kpiɔŋ zaa niŋ gooni maa mɛbu tuma ni. Ka n tumtumdiba zaa daa laɣim nimaani tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma. N daa bi gbaai mmaŋmaŋ palo.
en: I put all my energy into rebuilding the wall and did not acquire any property. Everyone who worked for me joined in the rebuilding.

dag: Ka bɛ naa ŋun be bɛ sani ni ti kah o nɛma buɣ o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu zaawun yuŋ yi, ka bɛ ti chibi gooni voli ka o doli dini yi. O ni ti zaŋ bini pil o nina din ni chɛ ka o nini ku nya tiŋgbani.
en: Their prince will shoulder his backpack at night and go out. They will dig through the wall to lead him out through it, and he will cover his face so that his eyes wont see the land.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Anduru, ka Anduru mini Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: Philip told Andrew. Then the two of them went to Jesus and told him.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb zaa ka va anzinfa mini salim shɛŋa la pahi di zuɣu ti Yawɛ.
en: David took these things and dedicated them to the Lord , as he had done with all the other things he had taken from the nations he had defeated:.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-mali duu maa puuni zaa mini bimbin shɛli din be du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee la zuɣu hal ka duu maa malibu tuma ti naai.
en: The whole interior of the Temple was covered with gold, as well as the altar in the Most Holy Place.

dag: N ni daa nya o maa, ka n lu n-dɔni o tooni m-be kaman kpim la. Amaa ka o zaŋ o nudirigu m-pa n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; mani n-nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: When I saw him, I fell down at his feet like a dead man. He put his right hand on me and said, Dont be afraid! I am the First and the Last.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt ni daa wum Mariama puhigu maa ka ŋun Ɛlizabɛt bia dam o pul ni, ka Shia Kasi daa pali Ɛlizabɛt.
en: When Elizabeth heard Marys greeting, the child leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua.
en: The children she bore him were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

dag: n-lan yi nimaani zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti du Bɛtaraba Zoli m-mali lala hal ti siɣi Araba.
en: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ so shɛli tiligi Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib nuu ni m-bala. O daa lan tiligi Hɛzɛkia o dimnim zaa nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi luɣilikam zaa.
en: This is how the LORD rescued Hezekiah and the citizens of Jerusalem from the power of Assyrias King Sennacherib, and all others, giving them rest on all sides.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye binyoya jɛmbu mini din chihiri tumbu zuɣu la, n ni chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ŋmaligi lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then God said, But now, their hearts belong to those terrible, filthy idols, and I must punish those people for the bad things they have done. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti lan zahim zahindi shɛli, ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa yaha. O daa yɛli ba mi: Nyamiya, n lan zahimla zahindi shɛli. N sa nyami ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi piniyini damdi ma tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph had another dream and described it to his brothers: Ive just dreamed again, and this time the sun and the moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa baŋ nɛma maa ka yɛli, Paɣ maa nyɛla wuntizɔra n-gari ma, n ni bi zaŋ o ti m bia Shɛla la zuɣu. Ka o daa bi saɣi ka o mini paɣ maa lan dɔni yaha.
en: Judah recognized them and said, Shes more righteous than I am, because I didnt allow her to marry my son Shelah. Judah never knew her intimately again.

dag: Yinim Iso zuliya, bɛ ni ʒiɛn ya n-zaŋ yi daazichi chaŋ.
en: But the enemy will search hard for Esaus hidden treasures, and they will find them all.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka niriba maa noya daa woli.
en: So there was a division in the crowd because of Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Yɛlim ti a zahindi maa ka ti wuh a di gbinni.
en: They answered the king in Aramaic, May Your Majesty live forever! Tell us your dream, and we will explain it to you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Gibiɔnnim maa, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn niŋ tin ya? Bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yɔn ya ti ni daa tum ya taal shɛli maa samli, ka yi suhi alibarika niŋ Yawɛ ni su shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: He said, What can I do to make up for what Saul did, so that you'll ask the Lord to be kind to his people again.

dag: Amaa ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Hazaɛl niŋ kom mahigi bɔdua n-zaŋ pa naa maa ninni hal ka o ti leei Naawuni dini. Ka Hazaɛl daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: But the next day Hazael took a thick cloth and dipped it in water. Then he held it on Ben-Hadads face until he died. Then Hazael became the new king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ti yɛli Akishi, A suhu yi yu ma, nyin tim ma a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli ka n ʒini, dama wula ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a lee yɛn laɣim ʒi na tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: One day, David was talking with Achish and said, If you are happy with me, then let me live in one of the towns in the countryside. I'm not important enough to live here with you in the royal city.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia bia Zakaria la n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔgula.
en: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was also one of the guards at the temple.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun yiɣisiri zoya ka zoya maa bi mi di yɛla ŋɔ, o suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o lɛbiri li pilina.
en: Without warning he moves mountains and in anger he destroys them.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ kpamba zaa daa bo jaaŋgbɛhi na ti ti o. Kpɛm kam jaaŋgbe yiniyini, ka di kalinli daa yiɣisi jaaŋgbɛhi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Ka Aduna jaaŋgbee daa be bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa ni.
en: So Moses spoke to the Israelites. Each of the leaders gave him a walking stick. There were twelve walking sticks. There was one stick from each leader of each tribe. One of the walking sticks belonged to Aaron.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi bɛ naa salima zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu, ka kuɣ viɛlli daa be di ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda zuɣu ni, ka o daa va bɛ ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam.
en: and took the crown from the statue of their god Milcom. The crown was made of about kilograms of gold, and there was a valuable jewel on it. David put the jewel on his own crown. He also carried off everything else of value.

dag: O tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi nyɛla zaɣ ʒiɛhi, ka o tɔbbihi ye gbaɣino ʒiɛhi. Bɛ yi mali bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shili zali dahin shɛli kur shɛŋa din tab li nyaɣisirimi. Ka sapashinnim yuri yiɣira.
en: The shields of his warriors are red; his soldiers are dressed in crimson. The ironwork of the chariots flashes like fire on the day he has prepared; the horses quiver.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Alushi maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Rɛfidim, ka kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu.
en: They left Alush and camped at Rephidim. There was no water for the people to drink at that place.

dag: Dama n ni zɔri binshɛli pam n-ka n sanna, ka binshɛli din kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm lu n zuɣu.
en: Because I was afraid of something awful, and it arrived; what I dreaded came to me.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Du shɛli din dunoli kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ nyɛla maligumaana ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa fukumsi duu.
en: The man said to me, The room that looks to the south is for the priests who are on duty and serving in the Temple area.

dag: Bɛ ba daa ti ba pina pam din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni anfaani binyara, ka daa zaŋ bɛ ni me goondahi gili Juda tin shɛŋa la ti ba pahi, amaa o daa zaŋ o nam maa tila Jɛhɔram, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bituuli.
en: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Wummiya n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ: Anabinim yi be yi ni, man Yawɛ ni kahigi mmaŋ wuhi ba ʒii puuni, ka tɔɣis ba yɛtɔɣa zahindi ni.
en: God said, Listen to me! You will have prophets. I, the Lord , will let them learn about me through visions. I will speak to them in dreams.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba; ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum ti luri pam; amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: Countries will fight each other; kingdoms will attack one another. There will be earthquakes everywhere, and there will be famines. These things are like the first pains of childbirth.

dag: Tinsi ŋɔ zaa wuna maa puuni wun ŋuni n-na tooi fa bɛ tinsi maa shɛli n nuu ni bahi, ka Yawɛ ti yɛn fa Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahi? .
en: None of the gods of these other places were able to save their land from me! So why do you think the Lord can save Jerusalem from me?.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi kpi kaman sokam zaa ni kpiri shɛm bee yɛl shɛli din paari sokam zaa yi paai ba, dindina, pa Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: If these men die a natural death without some punishment from God, then the Lord did not send me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka gom gbaai doo maa pam, o ni daa gbihiri saha shɛli maa, ka o daa yih o sapir kɔb yini ka daai nimaani nimdi ŋari;.
en: So the Lord God made him fall into a deep sleep, and he took out one of the man's ribs. Then after closing the man's side.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba, ka kum mini tiŋgbani dambu ti be bɔb shɛŋa polo.
en: Countries will fight each other; kingdoms will attack one another. There will be famines and earthquakes everywhere.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi Lɛvi bihi yuya n-doli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa sabi li dolila bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni bɛ ninvuɣ yinoyino bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, ka ni tooi tum tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: These were the clans and families of the tribe of Levi. Those who were years and older were assigned to work at the Lord 's temple.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli ni tiligi. Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti be bɛn kpalim maa ni.
en: But everyone who calls on the LORDs name will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be security, as the LORD has promised; and in Jerusalem, the LORD will summon those who survive.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Nyama, a biɛli Ɛlizabɛt so bɛ ni yi booni paɣiŋoo la gba mali pua o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; di chira ayɔbu m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka o daa ŋoli bɛ ni yi.
en: They tried to get Jesus again, but he escaped from them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Labimiya nti yɛli Jɔn yi ni nya ka wum shɛm:.
en: Jesus answered, Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.

dag: Gomna Filiksi ni daa wum lala ka mi mi soli ŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga la zuɣu ka o daa chɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa zali soli ka yɛli ba, Sapashin kpɛm Lisias n-ni kana ka n naanyi ŋmaai yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Then Felix, who was well informed about the Way, brought the hearing to a close. When the commander Lysias arrives, he told them, I will decide your case.

dag: Ka Inok daa dɔɣi Irad; ka Irad daa nyɛ Mɛhujaɛl ba, ka Mɛhujaɛl nyɛ Mɛtushaɛl ba, ka Mɛtushaɛl mi nyɛ Lamɛk ba.
en: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad fathered Mehujael, Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.

dag: N yi nyɛla tuumbiɛ tumda bee n yi tumla tuun shɛli din simdi kum, m bi bɔri soli ni n yi di ni; bɛ ni fiɣisiri ma shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ zaa yi nyɛla ʒiri, so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni. N ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani.
en: If I have broken the law and done something for which I deserve the death penalty, I do not ask to escape it. But if there is no truth in the charges they bring against me, no one can hand me over to them. I appeal to the Emperor.

dag: Dinzuɣu Dimitirius min o tumtumditab maa yi zaŋla so taali, saria karibu duu beni ka sariakaritiba be di ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn zaŋm taba tahi ni.
en: Therefore, if Demetrius and the craftspeople with him have a charge against anyone, the courts are in session and governors are available. They can press charges against each other there.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Napaɣ Ɛsta ka o ʒe zɔŋ maa ni maa, ka o suhu gbaag o, ka o kpuɣ o salima nam jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni maa tir o. Ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ ti shihi jaaŋgbee maa zuɣu ni.
en: When the king saw Queen Esther standing in the court, he was very pleased. He held out to her the gold scepter that was in his hand. So Esther went in to the room and went near the king. Then she touched the end of the kings gold scepter.

dag: O ni daa mali Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni la, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zali.
en: He set up the inner sanctuary inside the temple so that he could put the chest containing the LORDs covenant there.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ piɛla yino n-chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ kum shɛli ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn kpi la polo yɛla niŋ pali.
en: This happened in order to make come true what Jesus had said when he indicated the kind of death he would die.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba maa sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: Then they stayed there with the followers for a long time.

dag: O yiŋ nyɛla so shɛli din kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka nyɛ din kuni kum shee.
en: Her house is a path to the grave, going down to the chambers of death.

dag: Wuntizɔra yi di nasara, tiŋ zaa malila suhupiɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu yi kpi, niriba warila waa.
en: When the righteous succeed, a city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

dag: ni n yi yuui kandina, di ni chɛ ka a mi a ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm Naawuni niriba bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ cheechi la ni, ka nyɛ daantaliga mini tanzaa Naawuni yɛlimaŋli ni tam shɛli zuɣu la.
en: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila kɔhigɔr so ŋun gɔri bɔri waya zaɣ suma.
en: Also, the Kingdom of heaven is like this. A man is looking for fine pearls.

dag: Wuntia tuma mini din tuhi tumbu nyɛla Yawɛ ni deeri shɛli gari sara maligu.
en: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Ahaz was years old when he became king, and he ruled for sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didnt do what was right in the LORDs eyes, unlike his ancestor David.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ mi pal shɛŋa bɛ ni na bi zaŋ lo binshɛli lo ma, n ni gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Samson said, Someone would have to tie me up with new ropes. They would have to tie me with ropes that have not been used before. If someone did that, I would become as weak as any other man.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli nti paai sariga maa sɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ o pako chinchina maa so.
en: Tamar went home, took off her veil, and put her widow's clothes back on.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yi dabitim ni n-labina maa zaa daa tila suɣa n-kpe m-be di ni. Ka sokam daa mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia la saha zaŋ na hal ti paai di saha maa, Izraɛlnim daa na ʒi n-lan niŋ lala.
en: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum saa tahibu mini kikaa maa kumsi, ka nya saa nyaɣisibu mini nyɔhi ni mɔni zoli maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ daa kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: When the people heard the thunder and the trumpet blast and saw the lightning and the smoking mountain, they trembled with fear and stood a long way off.

dag: Di saha o min o bihi ni yi a sani n-lab o dɔɣiriba sani ti ʒin o yaannim tiŋgban ni.
en: Then they can leave you, take their children, and go back to their family. They can go back to the property of their ancestors.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani tin ya ka di leei yi tarili.
en: promising, I hereby give you the land of Canaan as your allotted inheritance.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisiyinika puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu daba ayopɔin dali, ka Babilɔn naa kpambal so ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi sapashin kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan la daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: About a month later, in Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king, Nebuzaradan, who was his official in charge of the guards, arrived in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Keen min o paɣ daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Inok. Ka Keen daa me o tiŋa n-zaŋ o bia Inok maa yuli m-bol li Inok.
en: Later, Cain and his wife had a son named Enoch. At the time Cain was building a town, and so he named it Enoch after his son.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ kura maa yi ti chaŋ yaɣi o ni zo n-kuli tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa tiŋgbani tariga.
en: But if the killer ever goes outside the boundaries of the refuge city where he fled.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa ti paai yuun pihiwɛi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Kɛnan.
en: When Enosh was , he had a son named Kenan.

dag: Chamiya, amaa nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛbihi ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la.
en: Now go, but remember, I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd mini Gomna Pailɛt daa malila dimdi ni taba, amaa dindali maa zaŋ chana bɛ daa laɣila tab zɔri.
en: On that very day Herod and Pilate became friends; before this they had been enemies.

dag: Faranim mabihi zaa yi je ba, di ni niŋ wula ka bɛ zɔnima ku zo ka chɛ ba? Hal bɛ yi kul kpaŋ bɛmaŋ kabo ni bɛ boli ba labisina, bɛ ku lan nya ba.
en: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.

dag: Chamiya ti zani Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni n-yɛli niriba nyɛvil palli ŋɔ yɛla zaa.
en: Go, take your place in the temple, and tell the people everything about this new life.

dag: Yawɛ, kokpɛɣu kpuɣi zani, kokpɛɣu duhi di yee, kokpɛɣu gbaai vubu.
en: The ocean depths raise their voice, O Lord ; they raise their voice and roar.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab daa baŋ lala ka zaŋ o tahi Siizaria nti chɛ ka o kul o ya Taasus.
en: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.

dag: M mi yi wahala dibu ni yi fara yɛla, amaa yinima n-lee nyɛ azichinima. Ka lan mi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ya, ka yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianim la gba yɛla. Bɛ pala Yɛhudianima, amaa bɛ nyɛla Sintani jɛmdiba.
en: I know your hardship and poverty . I also know the hurtful things that have been spoken about you by those who say they are Jews .

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam binshɛɣukam, ka binshɛli daa kani ka o nam li ka Yɛligu maa nuu ka di ni.
en: Through him God made all things; not one thing in all creation was made without him.

dag: ka zaŋ naɣilaa mini piɛlaa ni zim shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri m-mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni, dama zuŋɔ Yawɛ ni yi zahira yi sani.
en: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord 's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi n-chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: so that what was spoken through Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled.

dag: Di piligirila zuɣusaa yaɣ shɛli tariga, n-zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la tariga. Ka binshɛli ku tooi sɔɣi ka di biisim ku paa li.
en: It starts at one end of the sky and goes across to the other. Nothing can hide from its heat.

dag: Ziɔnnim ni ti yɛli, Naawuni bɔhimi Babilɔnnim biɛri ti niŋgbuna dari tɔhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛmnim ni ti yɛli, Naawuni bɔhimi Babilɔnnim biɛri ti ʒim yihibu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: May Babylon be violated as our bodies were, say the inhabitants of Zion. May our blood be on the Babylonians, say those from Jerusalem.

dag: M mi na kul malila yaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ kaman n ni daa mali yaa shɛm saha shɛli Musa ni daa tim ma maa. Ka n na kul mali yaa din ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: and am just as strong today as I was when Moses sent me out. I am still strong enough for war or for anything else.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka chɛ ka di leei shɛhira m min a sunsuuni.
en: Come, lets make a treaty, you and me, and let something be our witness.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bia paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o bia paɣa, di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your sons wife, so you must not have sexual relations with her.

dag: Miriya ka yi zɔri ba, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ka be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm.
en: So do not be afraid of these people. The Lord your God is with you; he is a great God and one to be feared.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Mɛrab ti Dauda, bɛ daa ŋmalig o mi ti do so ŋun yuli booni Adiriɛl ka o nyɛ Mɛholat nir la, ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: And so when the time came for Sauls daughter Merab to be married to David, she was given to Adriel from Meholah instead.

dag: bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni ka lan mali suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu ni la nuu ni.
en: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka n ka yi sanna ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni yubu puuni, ka nya suhukpaŋsibo m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim be zuɣu.
