en: Then, if God wants me to, I will come to you. I will come with joy, and together you and I will have a time of rest.

dag: Ka alizanda ni tɔbbihi ye binyɛr piɛla din piɛli ka be kasikasi m-bari wɔr piɛla dol o.
en: Heavens armies, wearing fine linen that was white and pure, were following him on white horses.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli din ŋmani teeku, ka ŋmani diɣi din mini buɣim gari taba. Ka bɛn daa nyaŋ biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ni o yuli dalinli deebu la daa ʒe m-baɣi teeku din ŋmani diɣi maa n-gbib Naawuni mɔɣilɔnima.
en: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps.

dag: nti nya zaɣ yini din mali shaara pam, ka chaŋ nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da li.
en: When he found one very precious pearl, he went and sold all that he owned and bought it.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti she di nimdi maa dindali yuŋ maa ŋ-ŋubi di mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to.
en: That night the animals are to be roasted and eaten, together with bitter herbs and thin bread made without yeast.

dag: O ni daa be o ma pul ni, o daa gbaala o jabil kpee napɔŋkpaa; ka o ni daa ti bi doo, o daa vala Naawuni.
en: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa paai Sinai tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: On exactly the third-month anniversary of the Israelites leaving the land of Egypt, they came into the Sinai desert.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ tuuli naɣ kara ayopɔin la ŋubi.
en: The thin cows ate up the fat ones.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka zama maa zaa daa paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Yawɛ maa, ka silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni, ka lu naa sizuura.
en: Then David said to the whole assembly, Bless the LORD your God, and the whole assembly blessed the LORD, the God of their ancestors, bowed down, and worshipped before the LORD and the king.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba yi ti yɛri ni suhudoo mini gom beni, di saha maa ka bahi yoli dii yɛn paai ba, ka bɛ ku tiligi. Di ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: When they are saying, There is peace and security, at that time sudden destruction will attack them, like labor pains start with a pregnant woman, and they definitely wont escape.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi Samuɛl, Banima n-daa lee yɛli ni Sool ku tooi niŋ ti naa la? Chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba na ka ti ku ba.
en: Then the people said to Samuel, Where are the people who said they didnt want Saul to rule as king? Bring them here, and we will kill them.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyuri wain pam zuɣu bee n-zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye nimdi ŋubbu zuɣu;.
en: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɛri ŋma n-saɣim a jɛmbu duu maa ni da shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi la.
en: Their soldiers attacked the doors, like workmen chopping down trees.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Yisahaku zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba.
en: This is the story of Isaac. Abraham had a son named Isaac.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Bɛ pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha? Yi bi mi dunia ni daa nam shɛm?.
en: Surely you know the truth, dont you? Surely you have heard. Surely someone told you long ago. Surely you understand who made the earth.

dag: Hal Babilɔnnim yi du zuɣusaa ti me goondahi gili bɛmaŋa, n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba yi n sani chaŋ ti liri ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even if Babylon scales the heavens and strengthens its towering defenses, the destroying armies will still come against her, at my command, declares the LORD.

dag: Di saha a mini Lɛvinim ni saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani zaa ni puhi chuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a min a yiŋnim binshɛŋa zaa o nirilim puuni maa zuɣu.
en: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ guhirimi ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu. O bɔri ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul niŋdi din tuhi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani mal alibarika.
en: And yet the Lord is waiting to be merciful to you. He is ready to take pity on you because he always does what is right. Happy are those who put their trust in the Lord .

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Di pun sabi anabinim litaafinim ni ni Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni wuhi sokam zaa. Ka ŋunkam wum ka bɔhim m Ba sani n-nyɛ ŋun kani n sanna.
en: The prophets wrote, Everyone will be taught by God. Anyone who hears the Father and learns from him comes to me.

dag: ka daa me binwɔɣila mini Ashɛra binnana zalizali zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: They put up memorial stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

dag: Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa kul nahindila Izraɛlnima Naa Jɛhɔahaz ʒiɛman ni zaa.
en: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.

dag: Ka Shallum Jabɛshi bia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-daa ŋme o luhi Ibiliam n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against King Zechariah, assassinated him at Ibleam, and succeeded him as king.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa deei pipia maa Yawɛ nuu ni n-chɛ ka o ni daa tim ma zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa nyu li.
en: So I took the cup from the LORDs hand, and I made all the nations drink from it where the LORD had sent me.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini kpam din be di ni zaa ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi n-nyo buɣim kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la.
en: He will take the two kidneys and the fat covering them near the lower back muscle. He will also remove the fat part of the liver that is near the kidneys.

dag: Yi ni zaŋdi yi pin shɛŋa na maa ka buchi. Chɛliya li zaŋbuna. Yi tulaale zim nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu n sani. Yi goli palli churi puhibu mini vuhim dabisa ni yi ni booni laɣiŋgu shɛŋa puuni, n je alahichi ni be yi jɛmbu laɣiŋgu shɛŋa ni.
en: It's useless to bring your offerings. I am disgusted with the smell of the incense you burn. I cannot stand your New Moon Festivals, your Sabbaths, and your religious gatherings; they are all corrupted by your sins.

dag: Dahin shɛli n ni daa yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim Ijipti la na hal ni wayo n daa bi pii Izraɛl zuliya ni fɔntin shɛli ni bɛ me duu ka n yuli be nimaani amaa ka daa piila Dauda ni o su n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: From the time I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen any city in all the land of Israel in which a temple should be built where I would be worshiped. But I chose you, David, to rule my people.

dag: Ka Yaakubu mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani la daa ka Luz din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: Jacob came with all his people to Luz, which is now known as Bethel, in the land of Canaan.

dag: Di pa shɛli Judanim yi wum n ni lo ni n niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ yɛla bɛ zaa ni chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ daalahichi taali.
en: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I intend to bring upon them, they will turn from their evil ways, and I will forgive their wrongdoing and sins.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried in David's City and his son Ahaz succeeded him as king.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma ni n yɛl a ni o ni niŋ a shɛm la ka o niŋ a maa, dama o darigi deei nam maa a nuu ni n-zaŋ ti Dauda ŋun nyɛ a kpee la.
en: The Lord used me to tell you what he would do, and now he is doing what he said he would do. He is tearing the kingdom out of your hands and giving it to your neighbor, David.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka n ni ti nyu di zaɣ palli Naawuni nam ni.
en: I want you to know, I will not drink this wine again until that day when I drink it in Gods kingdom and the wine is new.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Musa zali ya la. Dina n-nyɛ: Yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka tumm o yubu, ka dol o zaligunima, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, ka kul jɛmm o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa.
en: But remember—continue to obey the law that the Lord s servant Moses gave you. You must love the Lord your God and obey his commands. You must continue to follow him and serve him the very best that you can.

dag: Pɛrɛz daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi ni pisopɔinayika. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: The number of Perezs descendants living in Jerusalem was . All of them were brave men.

dag: Goonje mini mɔɣilo, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake the dawn itself!.

dag: Ti yi ti nya saɣisigu, di saha maa di bemi kaman din to ka pa din tiri suhupiɛlli; amaa di nyaaŋa bɛn deei saɣisigu tibidarigibo puuni ti nyari suhudoo din nyɛ wuntia biɛhigu laara.
en: No discipline is fun while it lasts, but it seems painful at the time. Later, however, it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness for those who have been trained by it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim shɛb zaa bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ kali ba kaman sokam ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm la, bɛ dɔbba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaayi.
en: The Lord commanded Moses and Aaron to count all the men and boys one month old or older in Levis family group. The total number was .

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ titali nyɛla ŋun tumdi din doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa.
en: But a good leader plans good things to do, and that will make him a leader over other leaders.

dag: O gbaai ma n soli zuɣu chaŋ ti dari tɔhi ma. O chɛ ka m bahi yoli.
en: He took me from my path and tore me apart; he made me desolate.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ti gari ka bol omaŋmaŋ yuli, Yawɛ, Yawɛ. N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ka niŋdi nirilim. N suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka yurilim din bi naara mini ʒiɛyimtali galisi n sani.
en: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa ŋma kuyila n-yili niŋ Naa Jɔsia. Ka baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa na kul yiini kuyila yɛri Jɔsia yɛla hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li leei kali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka sab li niŋ fabila litaafi ni.
en: Jeremiah the prophet wrote a funeral song in honor of Josiah. And since then, anyone in Judah who mourns the death of Josiah sings that song. It is included in the collection of funeral songs.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli ba di ni niŋ shɛm ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa ti lan leei ninvuɣ maŋli maa yaha.
en: Then all who had seen the man healed told about it.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti paai Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Saika la. Tiŋ maa daa mirila pu shɛli Yaakubu ni daa zaŋ ti o bia Yisifu la.
en: In Samaria he came to a town named Sychar, which was not far from the field that Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

dag: Izraɛlnim mini Judanim Naawuni, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ bi zaɣisi ba, hal alahichi ni kul pali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ sani maa zaa yoli.
en: I, the Lord God Almighty, have not abandoned Israel and Judah, even though they have sinned against me, the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yɛlimaŋli, yoli ka n daa kul guli doo ŋɔ binyara ŋɔ mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ka bi chɛ ka o binshɛli bɔrigi ŋɔ, ka ŋun ti zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma samli.
en: David had been thinking, Why did I ever protect that fellow's property out here in the wilderness? Not a thing that belonged to him was stolen, and this is how he pays me back for the help I gave him!.

dag: Filistia doo maa ni daa yiɣisi vu m-miri Dauda ni o ti tuh o saha shɛli, ka Dauda gba daa dii guui yi tɔb gɔɣu maa ni ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: The Philistine got up and moved closer to attack David, and David ran quickly to the front line to face him.

dag: Ka o daa lan guhi daba ayopɔin pahi, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi n-chaŋ yaha, dindina, ka ŋmani maa daa bi lan labina.
en: Then he waited another seven days and sent out the dove once more; this time it did not come back.

dag: A gba ni ti nyu dam kuli, a ni ti zo n-sɔɣi. A ni ti bɔri sɔɣisili shee a dim sani.
en: So, Nineveh, you will also fall like a drunk. You will try to hide. You will look for a safe place away from the enemy.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din be daadam suhu ni ka pa ni daadam maŋmaŋ shia din be o ni maa zuɣu? Lala ka so gba ku tooi baŋ din be Naawuni suhu ni ka pa ni Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: It is like this: No one knows the thoughts that another person has. Only the persons spirit that lives inside knows those thoughts. It is the same with God. No one knows Gods thoughts except Gods Spirit.

dag: A ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha din zilim ŋɔ? A ni tooi baŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ yɛm tariga?.
en: Do you think you really understand God? Do you completely understand God All-Powerful?.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi dindali maa, ka yiɣimiya jɛmmi ni suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anabinim gba.
en: You can be happy then and jump for joy, because you have a great reward in heaven. The ancestors of those people did the same things to the prophets.

dag: Ka Rut daa yɛl o, N dana, a niŋ ma nirilim pam. Hal m biɛhigu ni kul bi paag a paɣisara bɛn tumd a tuma ŋɔ ni yino gba biɛhigu maa zaa yoli, a kpaŋsi ma a ni tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛm maa puuni.
en: She said, May I continue to find favor in your eyes, sir, because youve comforted me and because youve spoken kindly to your female servant—even though Im not one of your female servants.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔb bia ka nyɛ Zɔba naa la, saha shɛli ŋun Hadadɛza ni daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi deei Yufretiiz Mɔɣili polo la.
en: David went to an area near the Euphrates to set up a monument for himself. At that time he defeated the king of Zobah, Hadadezer son of Rehob.

dag: Yɔɣu ni bunsi tamla daboya zuɣu n-taɣiri ʒiɛɣu kaman yɔbahi la, ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, mɔri ni kani zuɣu.
en: The wild donkeys stand on the well-traveled paths, panting like thirsty dogs; they go blind since theres nothing to eat.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul larila ninvuɣ biɛri maa, dama o mi ni bɛ biɛɣu kanna.
en: But the Lord laughs at wicked people, because he knows they will soon be destroyed.

dag: Amaa ka sapashini maa daa dolila ŋariŋ maa lana mini ŋariŋ maa tuma zuɣulana yɛligu gari Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But the army officer was convinced by what the captain and the owner of the ship said, and not by what Paul said.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M poya, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa gba ni ti nya turi.
en: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni daa zaŋ doo maa du alizanda ni. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: I know that this man was caught up into paradise and that he heard unspeakable words that were things no one is allowed to repeat. I dont know whether it was in the body or apart from the body. God knows.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa be faranim ni mal alibarika; bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba.
en: Happy are those who are concerned for the poor; the Lord will help them when they are in trouble.

dag: N wumla galimi shɛli din tu ma, m milinsi puuni ka n nya garigibu.
en: You insulted me with your answers! But I am wise and know how to answer you.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Do so ŋun yɛl ti lala maa yɛla biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ gbaŋ lo o shee ni. Ka o yɛli, Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la m-bala.
en: They answered Ahaziah, This man was wearing a hairy coat with a leather belt around his waist. Then Ahaziah said, That was Elijah the Tishbite.

dag: Ŋun kɔra, o ni mali bindirigu pam, amaa ŋun doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi, fara ni gbaag o pam.
en: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, a kpani maa m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nachimba maa ni yino kana ti zaŋ li.
en: Here is the kings spear, David answered. Allow one of your servants to come over and get it.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa mi gumdi mibu daa mi gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli.
en: Every skilled woman made fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn.

dag: Amaa o bihi maa bɛn daa bi dol o naba, ka zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim niŋla bun ni, ka deeri birapu niriba sani, ka bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli maani bɛ yɛla.
en: But Samuels sons didnt follow in his footsteps. They tried to turn a profit, they accepted bribes, and they perverted justice.

dag: Niriba yi chaŋ bɛ tuma ni, bɛ tumdimi hal ni zaawuni.
en: Then people go out to do their work, and they work until evening.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leela dabiɛm shee, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li sahakam. Bɛnkam zaa gari nimaani, dabiɛm gbahi ba mi ka bɛ viini bɛ zuɣuri.
en: They have ruined their country and brought utter shame on it. All who pass by are shocked and shake their heads.

dag: M puhiri Andurɔnikus mini Junias bɛn nyɛ n zuliya mini n sarikakpɛritab la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali jilima tuumba ni, ka nyɛ bɛn daŋ ma Masia yɛda niŋbu.
en: And greet Andronicus and Junia. They are my relatives, and they were in prison with me. They were followers of Christ before I was. And they are some of the most important of the ones Christ sent out to do his work.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. Ka fukumsi zaligu shɛl lan kani kpɛm gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: The second most important command is this: Love your neighbor the same as you love yourself. These two commands are the most important.

dag: Aai, yɛligu maa kul bela yi sani, di bela yi noya ni mini yi suhuri ni ni yi dol li.
en: No, it is here with you. You know it and can quote it, so now obey it.

dag: N nya o, amaa pa pumpɔŋɔ. N nya o, amaa ka o shee na waɣa. Saŋmariga ni ti puhi yi Yaakubu zuliya ni na. Naa ni ti yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na; O ni ti ku Mɔab zuɣulaannima, ka ku Sɛt zuliya zaa.
en: What I saw in my vision hasn't happened yet. But someday, a king of Israel will appear like a star. He will wipe out you Moabites and destroy those tribes who live in the desert.

dag: Amaa mani ŋuna, Yawɛ yiko min o shia ni zaligu ni yaa be n ni, ka n yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛ biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: But the Lord s Spirit has filled me with power, goodness, and strength. So I can tell Jacob about his crimes, and so I can tell Israel about his sins!.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa din gili zoli maa zuɣusaa nyɛla din be kasi zaa. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bala.
en: These are the instructions for the temple: the top of the mountain, as well as its boundaries all around, are most holy. These are the instructions for the temple.

dag: Amaa maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa fiɣis o, o daa bi garigi shɛli.
en: But he said nothing in response to the accusations of the chief priests and elders.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra; dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: He said to them, The harvest is bigger than you can imagine, but there are few workers. Therefore, plead with the Lord of the harvest to send out workers for his harvest.

dag: Jɛrilim n-kul pali bia suhu ni, amaa tibidarigibo fiɛbiga n-kariti li bahiri katiŋa.
en: Children do foolish things, but if you punish them, they will learn not to do them.

dag: A bi kpahim nya niriba maa ni yɛra, Yawɛ zaɣisila o ni daa pii zuliya ayi shɛb la? Lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lihi ʒiɛmla n niriba maa, ka bi lan lihi ba ka bɛ ŋmani zuliya yaha. .
en: Arent you aware of what people are saying: The LORD has rejected the two families that he had chosen? They are insulting my people as if they no longer belong to me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila, dama n kanimina ni n ti be yi sani.
en: The Lord said, Sing for joy, people of Jerusalem! I am coming to live among you.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Pa yi ninvuɣ pinaayi ka m pii ka yi ni yino ti nyɛ Sintani nir la.
en: Jesus told his disciples, I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon.

dag: O wuɣir omaŋmaŋ garo bimpara. O situra nyɛla tampiɛl viɛlli mini tan ʒiɛkpeein.
en: She makes sheets and spreads for the beds, and she wears clothes of fine linen.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs suhuyiɣisili la ni daa ti maai, di saha ka o daa teei Vashiti yɛla min o ni daa niŋ shɛm ni bɛ ni daa zali zaligu shɛli ka di di o la gba yɛla.
en: After a while, King Xerxes got over being angry. But he kept thinking about what Vashti had done and the law that he had written because of her.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ o bia pakoli Tama maa n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi ayi pahi, bɛna n-nyɛ Pɛrɛz mini Zɛra. Juda bidibisi zaa daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sani ti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba ʒiɛla o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini. Ka Balak daa bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: So he went back and found Balak still standing by his burnt offering, with the leaders of Moab. Balak asked what the Lord had said.

dag: Ka a ti chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl nyɛla m bidib kpɛma.
en: Then you must tell him that I, the Lord , say, Israel is my first-born son.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a kɔŋko ŋun yuli nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ, n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then they will know that your name is YAHWEH— that you alone are the Lord . They will know that you are God Most High, ruler over all the earth!.

dag: dama mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri o tuumba maa zaa ni, hal ka m bi simdi ni bɛ boli ma o tumo gba, n ni daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka la zuɣu.
en: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.

dag: Ti zaŋdila ti nyɛviya pari talima n-chani ti bɔri bindirigu na, dama tɔbutuhiriba be mɔɣu ni.
en: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the desert heat.

dag: Kom be kulibɔŋ maa ni ka a ni nyura, ka n zali kahiŋkɔri ni bɛ tahiri bindirigu na ti tir a.
en: You can drink water from the creek, and eat the food I've told the ravens to bring you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-yi Hazaɛl takɔbi kubu ni, Jɛhu ŋun kum o; ka ŋun ti zo n-yi Jɛhu takɔbi kubu ni, Ilaisha mi ŋun kum o.
en: Whoever escapes from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will kill. Whoever escapes from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will kill.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa bi neei kum ni, dindina ti waazu yihibu nyɛla yoli, ka yi yɛda niŋbu gba nyɛ yoli.
en: And if Christ has never been raised, then the message we tell is worth nothing. And your faith is worth nothing.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Yisifu yuli Zafɛnatipania, ka zaŋ Pɔtifɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan la bipuɣiŋga Asɛnat n-ti Yisifu ni o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yisifu daa yiri chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: Pharaoh renamed Joseph, Zaphenath-paneah, and married him to Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera the priest of Heliopolis. Then Joseph assumed control of the land of Egypt.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn gbihiri kum ni la polo, ka di chɛ ka yi ku fabindi bɛn kpi la zuɣu kaman bɛn ka tahima ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisa nyɛla maligumaani tital so ŋun tumdi din sɔŋdi ti ni yɛlimaŋli. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi ka ka galimi, ka alahichi mi ka o ni; Naawuni n-wolig o ka o be o ko ka chɛ alahichinima, ka duh o gari sokam zaa bɛn be alizanda ni.
en: So Jesus is the kind of high priest we need. He is holy. He has no sin in him. He is pure and not influenced by sinners. And he is raised above the heavens.

dag: O chɛ ka bɛ mini nanim ʒiina, nanim bɛn nyɛ o niriba nanima.
en: He puts them in important positions, giving them a place among the leaders of his people.

dag: Maazia ni Biligai ni Shɛmaya; maligumaaniba m-bala.
en: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests who put their names on the sealed agreement.

dag: Amaa Naawuni tiligim ma ka n nyu bara shɛli zuɣu ka pa ni ti Duuma Yisa Masia dapulli la kɔŋko zuɣu. Masia dapulli maa zuɣu dunia nyɛla binkpiŋ n sani, ka n gba nyɛ binkpiŋ dunia ŋɔ sani.
en: I hope I will never boast about things like that. The cross of our Lord Jesus Christ is my only reason for boasting. Through Jesus death on the cross the world is dead to me, and I am dead to the world.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm di biŋkpam zaa mali sara, di zuli ni kpam mini kpam din pili namanama.
en: All of its fat shall be removed and offered on the altar: the fat tail, the fat covering the internal organs.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata.
en: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for three months.

dag: Ti kpaŋ timaŋ ni ti tibi Babilɔn, amaa ka kɔŋ li tibbu. Chɛliya li ka ti zaa kuli timaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama o tibidarigibo maa du zuɣusaa hal ti kpe sagbana ni.
en: We tried to cure Babylon, but she was beyond help. Lets depart from her and return to your own country, each of you. Her punishment reaches to heaven and extends to the clouds.

dag: O zaŋ ma luhi baɣiri ni, ka m be kaman taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim la.
en: He threw me into the mud, and I became like dust and ashes.

dag: Yi mi lan kala Yisa ŋun nyɛ sandaantimdi so ŋun zali alikauli palli min o ʒi shɛli din mihibu wuhiri ti yɛl shɛŋa din sɔ Ɛbɛl maŋmaŋ ʒim la sanna.
en: You have come to Jesus—the one who brought the new agreement from God to his people. You have come to the sprinkled blood that tells us about better things than the blood of Abel.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ʒini di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa ni ʒini binshɛli zuɣu, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: or sits on anything the man has sat on must wash his clothes and take a bath, and he remains unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Zara daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Ibrahimma o ninkurilim ni, saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o la.
en: At exactly the time God said it would happen, Sarah became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Abraham in his old age.

dag: N suhu ni daa miligi ka biɛrim lan mali ma n suhu ni la.
en: I was so stupid. I thought about such people and became upset. God, I was upset and angry with you! I acted like a senseless animal.

dag: n-gari chaŋ hal ni Azimɔn n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ m-mali hal ti paai di tariga teeku ni. Yi nudirigu polo tiŋgbani tariga n-yɛn bala.
en: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yaannim ni daa zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdi buɣa ka lan zaɣisi n zaligu dolibu la zuɣu.
en: then you should tell them: Its because your ancestors have deserted me and followed other gods, declares the LORD. They have served and worshipped them, while abandoning me and refusing to keep my Instruction.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Ka bɛ yi ti bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka yɛli ni a bi yi n zuɣu.
en: Then Moses answered the Lord , But suppose the Israelites do not believe me and will not listen to what I say. What shall I do if they say that you did not appear to me.

dag: Ka Judanim daa yɛli, Ʒiʒiriba gbarigiya; ka saɣiri pam mi beni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti kɔŋ gooni maa mɛbu.
en: The people of Judah had a song they sang: We grow weak carrying burdens; There's so much rubble to take away. How can we build the wall today.

dag: Daadam shia nyɛla Yawɛ firila din vihiri baŋdi din be daadam niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord , and they search our hearts.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N zaŋla kurigu dapua ga zuliya kam nyiŋgoya ni ni bɛ jɛm Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, ka bɛ mi shiri ni jɛm o ni yɛlimaŋli. Hal n zaŋla mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba ti o. .
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: I will put iron yokes on the necks of all these nations, and they will serve Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar; even the wild animals will be subject to him!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihirili shɛli din yi Yawɛ sanna n-wuhiri ni o ni niŋ o ni lo alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.

dag: Sokam daa yul o tuma maa, sokam daa ʒiɛla katiŋa ka yuuni li.
en: Everyone can see what he has done, even people in faraway countries.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi Lɛvi bihi yuya n-doli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa sabi li dolila bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni bɛ ninvuɣ yinoyino bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, ka ni tooi tum tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: These were the descendants of Levi, by clans and families, every one of them registered by name. Each of his descendants, twenty years of age or older, had a share in the work of the Lord 's Temple.

dag: Momaha be mɔɣu ni pam, ka suhupiɛlli pali daboya zuɣu.
en: Even the desert pastures drip with it, and the hills are dressed in pure joy.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa niŋ shɛhira ka tɔɣisi ti Duuma yɛligu naai maa ka bɛ daa doli Samaria tiŋkpansi pam chani yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu n-labiri kuni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After the apostles had testified and proclaimed the Lords word, they returned to Jerusalem, preaching the good news to many Samaritan villages along the way.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi mali sara din ni tiɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ nini, ka suh o naa min o bihi nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: so that they may offer pleasing sacrifices to the God of heaven and pray for the lives of the king and his sons.

dag: ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔh o yaha, A ka noli din ni garigi? A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: Then Pilate questioned him again, Don't you have anything to say? Don't you hear what crimes they say you have done.

dag: Bee yi na ʒi n-karim zaligu ni ni maligumaaniba tumdi tuun shɛŋa Naawuni jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ka ka galimi di zuɣu?.
en: And you have read in the Law of Moses that on every Sabbath day the priests at the Temple break the law about the Sabbath day. But they are not wrong for doing that.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu, dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋkpansi nti da bindira di.
en: That evening his disciples came to him and said, It is already very late, and this is a lonely place. Send the people away and let them go to the villages to buy food for themselves.

dag: Bɛ pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒii buyopɔin. Juda zuliya niriba la kul ni be o tiŋgbani din be nudirigu polo la ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba mi kul be o tiŋgbani din be nuzaa polo la ni.
en: They will divide the land into seven parts. The people of Judah will keep their land in the south. The people of Joseph will keep their land in the north.

dag: ka ŋun Yaakubu kɔŋko daa kpalim be nyaaŋa. Di saha ka do so daa kana ka o min o ti kpe val ni n-va hal ka biɛɣ ti neerina.
en: but he stayed behind, alone. Then a man came and wrestled with him until just before daybreak.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu paɣirila ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mini ba bi tuhira.
en: If you have no regard for the law, you are on the side of the wicked; but if you obey it, you are against them.

dag: Ni o bɔhim o nachimba maa, bɛ ni yɛl o. Dinzuɣu n suhir o mi ni o niŋmi n nachimba ŋɔ nirilim, dama chuɣu dali ka ti kana maa. N suhir o mi, din kul be o nuu ni, ŋun zaŋ ti yinim bɛn nyɛ o tumtumdiba ŋɔ ka yi zaŋ na ti ti o bia Dauda.
en: Ask your servants and they will tell you this is true. Please be kind to my young men. We come to you now, at this happy time. Please give these young men anything you can. Please do this for me, your friend David.

dag: Yihim daɣiri din be anzinfa ni, ka machɛli zaŋ li mali duɣu.
en: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.

dag: Ka Mɛɔnɔtai daa nyɛ Ofira ba. Sɛraya daa nyɛla Jɔab ba, ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ Gɛharashimnim yabidoo. Din daa chɛ ka bɛ boli ba lala maa nyɛla, bɛ daa nyɛla nuhi tuumbaŋdiba.
en: Meonothai was Ophrahs father. And Seraiah was Joabs father. Joab was the founder of the Ge Harashim. The people used that name because they were skilled workers.

dag: Shɛm zuliya mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ tiŋgbana ni bɛ zuliyazuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the descendants of Shem, living in their different tribes and countries, each group speaking its own language.

dag: Bɛna n-daa kana ti zani Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba ni salo zaa tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni yɛli.
en: One day his daughters went to the sacred tent, where they met with Moses, Eleazar, and some other leaders of Israel, as well as a large crowd of Israelites. The young women said:.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ ba la nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam na. Zoomba mini gbariti ni paɣipuhinim ni paɣ shɛb bɛn wolisiri ni bɛ dɔɣi zaa ni ti be bɛ ni. Bɛ ni ti galisi pam labi kpe na.
en: I, the Lord , will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb yaha, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni m pun mali bindirigu dibu shili; ka pun ku naɣilahi mini naɣipol kpaba, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, dinzuɣu ni bɛ kam amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na.
en: Again he sent other servants and said to them, Tell those who have been invited,Look, the meal is all prepared. Ive butchered the oxen and the fattened cattle. Now everythings ready. Come to the wedding party.

dag: Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, m bi mi n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛm, dama n na nyɛla bia.
en: Ah, LORD God, I said, I dont know how to speak because Im only a child.

dag: Pita ni daa kul ʒiya tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛl o, Nyama, niriba ata kana ti bɔr a.
en: While Peter was brooding over the vision, the Spirit interrupted him, Look! Three people are looking for you.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara ka so ku tooi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: who does great things beyond comprehension, wonderful things without number.

dag: amaa ka yi bi niŋ yɛda, ka di nyɛla yi ni pa m piɛri la zuɣu.
en: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.

dag: ka Josɛf bia Igal daa yi Isaka zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Issachar—Igal son of Joseph;.

dag: O daa maani maligunima ka tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: He also sacrificed and burned incense at the shrines on every hill and beneath every shady tree.

dag: Dama di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sab o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will die, just as the Scriptures say. But it is going to be terrible for the one who betrays me. That man would be better off if he had never been born.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kpahi Jɛrimia ŋun nyɛ Anatɔt nira, ka zaŋ omaŋ leeg anabi yi sani la zuɣu ni?.
en: Why haven't you done this to Jeremiah of Anathoth, who has been speaking as a prophet to the people?.

dag: bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bɛn ŋmaligim zani ka bɛ mini ba tuhi. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa pun daŋ kula Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ pihita ka yɛra, Ti yaa nyaŋ ba kaman ti ni daa pun nyaŋ ba shɛm piligu ni la.
en: the Israelites out on the battlefield were to turn around. By this time the Benjaminites had already killed the thirty Israelites. They told themselves, Yes, we've beaten them just as before.

dag: M bɔhirila n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tam n yɛla? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: To God, my defender, I say, Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go on suffering from the cruelty of my enemies.

dag: Ka salo bɛn zaa daa laɣim ʒe nimaani ni bɛ lihi ninliha maa daa nya din niŋ maa. Ka ŋmaligi buri bɛ nyɔri kuna.
en: All the crowds who had come together to see this event returned to their homes beating their chests after seeing what had happened.

dag: Naawuni daa bi tiligi malaika shɛb bɛn daa tuui tum alahichi la, amaa o daa zaŋ ba bahila buɣim biɛhigu shee n-lo ba zoligɔnim zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali.
en: God did not spare the angels who sinned, but threw them into hell, where they are kept chained in darkness, waiting for the Day of Judgment.

dag: A tɛhiya ni n ku tooi suhi m Ba Naawuni ka o tim malaikanim tusatusa shɛm n sanna pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Don't you know that I could call on my Father for help, and at once he would send me more than twelve armies of angels?.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa vaai yiɣisi kaman o neela gom ni la bee m-be kaman tɔbutuhira ni yi nyu wain buɣi n-tahiri shɛm la.
en: But then my Lord woke up— as if hed been sleeping! Like a warrior shaking off wine.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka o ku duh omaŋ yaɣ o mabihi maa sani, ka mi ku birigi fukumsi zaligu maa n-kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo din ni chɛ ka o min o zuliya ti di nam yuui Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the king will not think that he is better than any of his own people. He will not turn away from the law, but he will follow it exactly. Then he and his descendants will rule the kingdom of Israel a long time.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahim nya ka bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa piila jilima ʒiishɛhi. Di saha maa ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: Then Jesus noticed that some of the guests were choosing the best places to sit. So he told this story:.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya mini Nɛtania ni Zɛbadia ni Asahɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhɔnatan ni Adɔnija ni Tɔbija ni Tɔbadɔnija m-pahi Maligumaaniba Ɛlishama mini Jɛhɔram.
en: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa n-yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛrishiiba nti mali sara o ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Israel packed up everything he owned and traveled to Beer-sheba. There he offered sacrifices to his father Isaacs God.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani! Yaa n Naawuni, tiligim ma! A labi n dimnim zaa tapaɣisi, ka ŋme n-kabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina.
en: Come, Lord ! Save me, my God! You punish all my enemies and leave them powerless to harm me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ti yɛn kana la shilinshia, amaa din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli m-be Masia ni la yipa paana.
en: All such things are only a shadow of things in the future; the reality is Christ.

dag: Absalom daa zaŋla Amasa leeg o tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani. Amasa daa nyɛla do so ŋun yuli booni Itira, ka o nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la dapala. Itira maa daa kpuɣila Jɔab ma Zɛruya tizo Abigeel Nahash bipuɣiŋga.
en: Absalom had put Amasa in command of the army in the place of Joab. Amasa was the son of Jether the Ishmaelite; his mother was Abigail, the daughter of Nahash and the sister of Joab's mother Zeruiah.

dag: Maata ni daa ti wum ni Yisa be soli kanna o daa yiɣisimi ti tuh o soli, ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim be yiŋa.
en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to greet him. But Mary stayed home.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa na maa daa nyɛla din ni tooi zaŋ tum tuma maa zaa ka guui.
en: But there was already more than enough to do what needed to be done.

dag: Niŋmiya bindira tiri kum ni kuri shɛba, ka deemiya nandaamba bɛn ka kpɛhili shee niŋmi yi yinsi; ka timiya bɛn chani gbinfini situra; ka di zaɣisiya yi dɔɣiriba sɔŋbu.
en: Share your food with the hungry and open your homes to the homeless poor. Give clothes to those who have nothing to wear, and do not refuse to help your own relatives.

dag: nti yɛl o, N dana, ti daa pun kala kpe na ti da bindira.
en: Please, Master, we came down the first time just to buy food.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu n-chani bɔri Yawɛ shee, amaa bɛ ti ku nya o, dama o zo bɛ sani.
en: The leaders of the people went to look for the Lord . They took their sheep and cattle with them, but they did not find the Lord because he refused to accept them.

dag: M mali n yɛtɔɣa shili, m mi ni bɛ ni wuhi ni n ka galimi.
en: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labirila ŋun daa tim ma na maa sani, ka yi ni so mi bi bɔhi ma, Ya ka a chana.
en: But now I am going to him who sent me, yet none of you asks me where I am going.

dag: Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni su zuliya shɛb chana. Di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ nimaani.
en: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna, A zahima maa nyɛla zaɣ yini, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuhi nyin Firawuna maa.
en: Joseph said to the king, The two dreams mean the same thing; God has told you what he is going to do.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: Then he will follow the proper rules for offering the other bird as a sacrifice to please me. You will be forgiven when the priest offers these sacrifices as the price for your sin.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa daŋ yibu asiba n-labi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ Jɛziriil.
en: So David and his men got up early in the morning and went back to the country of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

dag: Ti Duuma, a ni nam zuliya shɛb la zaa ni kana ti gbani a tooni tibig a yuli.
en: All the nations that youve made will come and bow down before you, Lord; they will glorify your name.

dag: ka n naɣikɔra dapua yɛbu bi to, ka n ʒili mi bi tibisa.
en: Yes, the teaching that I ask you to accept is easy. The load I give you to carry is light.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri lala maa ka Yisa maŋmaŋ dii zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: While the two were telling them this, suddenly the Lord himself stood among them and said to them, Peace be with you.

dag: Na so ŋun pahi n-nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛfaimnim ni yino ŋun kpalim ka be Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi;.
en: Next, Moses and the Israelites defeated King Og of Bashan, who lived in the town of Ashtaroth part of each year and in Edrei the rest of the year. Og was one of the last of the Rephaim.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka n ni zaŋ n yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suh o suhigu shɛli mini n ni suhi binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yɛla be o suhu ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa; ka zo mani ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ min o niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: And may these words of mine that I have cried out before the LORD remain near to the LORD our God day and night so that he may do right by his servant and his people Israel for each days need.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti birigi ka chɛ a soli? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti niŋ tipawumli n-zo a sani? Labimi ti sanna, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba la mini zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ a niriba la zuɣu.
en: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord ? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.

dag: Ka Jɛhu lan yɛl o, Doli ma nti nya n suhu ni ye Yawɛ zuɣu shɛm, ka daa chɛ ka o kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ni pah o zuɣu.
en: Jehu said, Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD. So Jehu had Jehonadab ride with him in his chariot.

dag: ka n niriba bɛn nyɛ n ni su shɛb maa yi siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-suhi ma, ka niŋ tuuba, ka bo sɔŋsim n sani, ka zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni, n ni be alizanda ni ka wum bɛ suhigu maa, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka tibi bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: if they pray to me and repent and turn away from the evil they have been doing, then I will hear them in heaven, forgive their sins, and make their land prosperous again.

dag: Di saha ka biŋkɔbiri chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee nti kpalim do bɛ lɛya ni.
en: The wild beast enters its lair, lies down in its den.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka lan zaŋ tana ayɔbu la she n-tuɣi taba di ko.
en: The workers joined five curtains together into one group and six curtains together into another group.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka wuntaŋ lu wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka yuŋ zibi wuntaŋ maa ni.
en: On that day, says the LORD God, I will make the sun go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in broad daylight.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi Juda Naa Amazia shɛm la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Jehoash did, including how he fought against King Amaziah of Judah, are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa garigi yɛli Adɔnija, Aai, dama ti dan Naa Dauda zaŋ Sulemaana leei naa;.
en: Jonathan replied to Adonijah, No! Our master King David has made Solomon king!.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla nir ni daa yi zɔri kuni tin shɛŋa ni tiligiri la ti ba. Shɛkɛm din be zoya ni la mini Gɛza ni di momaha tiŋgbana ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba.
en: Shechem, the city of refuge in the hills of Ephraim, Gezer.

dag: Nir suhu ni karimbaani n-tahir o saɣiŋgu na, amaa maŋsiɣisibu m-be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: Pride comes before a disaster, but humility comes before respect.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-yɛra, ka booni dunianim zaa bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo.
en: From the rising of the sun to where it sets, God, the LORD God, speaks, calling out to the earth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Yiɣisima, cham Kɛila, dama n zaŋ Filistianim maa niŋ a nuu ni.
en: So David asked the LORD again, and the LORD reaffirmed, Yes, go down to Keilah, because I will hand the Philistines over to you.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yili yilli ŋɔ: Yilimiya yila yɛli di yɛla; Kɔbiliga, chɛ ka kom yi a ni na;.
en: At that time the people of Israel sang this song: Wells, produce your water; And we will greet it with a song—.

dag: Nyama, ka anabi so daa kana ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Nyama, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka a baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Suddenly a prophet approached Israels King Ahab. He said, This is what the LORD says: Do you see that great army? Today I am handing it over to you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka n ti nya neesim din ne pam gari wuntaŋa ka di yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili m mini bɛn daa laɣim chani maa soli maa ni.
en: While on the road at midday, King Agrippa, I saw a light from heaven shining around me and my traveling companions. That light was brighter than the sun.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana daa bi zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o daba ni bɛ tumd o tuma, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi min o sapashin kpamba ni kpamba bɛn daa su o chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba fukumsi.
en: Israelites were not used at forced labor, but served as soldiers, officers, chariot commanders, and cavalry troops.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi daŋ maa galisiya pam, di ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: This is what the LORD says: Your injury is incurable; your illness is grave.

dag: A ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu, ka a nudirigu sɔŋ ma. A chɛ ka n leei ninvuɣ titali a sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: O Lord , you protect me and save me; your care has made me great, and your power has kept me safe.

dag: Ŋun daa ʒiya maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa jasipa ni kanɛlian la; ka sagani din ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli ɛmɛrald la booi gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.

dag: Zibisim shɛli kani bee bumbɔni, ka alahichinim ni tooi sɔɣi di ni.
en: There is no darkness dark enough to hide a sinner from God.

dag: Nandaamba bɛn dabisa zaa nyɛla wahala dabisa, amaa bɛn suhuri piɛla kul puhirila chuɣu sahakam.
en: All the days of the needy are hard, but a happy heart has a continual feast.

dag: ka ti mabia ŋun mi nyɛ azichilana ka Naawuni siɣis o, di simdi ni o gba mali suhupiɛlli, dama azichilana ni ti vuui kaman mɔpuma ni kpahiri luri shɛm la.
en: Those who are wealthy should find satisfaction in their low status, because they will die off like wildflowers.

dag: A yi be mɔpilli zuɣusaa larigi ni di so ni a mini yidaampaɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yil ni.
en: Better to live on the roof than share the house with a nagging wife.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlana zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: Who, then, is a faithful and wise servant? It is the one that his master has placed in charge of the other servants to give them their food at the proper time.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka binshɛli kani n-so m-pahila di simdi ni ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa di bɛ tuma nyɔri, bɛ tarili m-bala. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ ba labisina ka bɛ ti nya din yɛn be bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: So I perceived that there was nothing better for human beings but to enjoy what they do because thats what theyre allotted in life. Who, really, is able to see what will happen in the future?.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi gbahi ba, bɛ ni yo bɛ ni zu shɛli maa zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka bɛ fa bɛ yinsi nɛma zaa.
en: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.

dag: Bɛ nyaɣa vilivilila kuɣ duli, ka bɛ be tampima ni.
en: Their roots wrap around the stones and hold fast to every rock.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa chɛ ka Samsin zaŋ o zuɣu pa o naba zuɣu gbihi, ka o bol do so na ti chɛ ka o pini Samsin zuɣu ni zab kpila ayopɔin maa. Ka o daa piligi damdi Samsin, ka o kpiɔŋ maa daa shiri yi o ni.
en: Delilah had lulled Samson to sleep with his head resting in her lap. She signaled to one of the Philistine men as she began cutting off Samson's seven braids. And by the time she was finished, Samson's strength was gone. Delilah tied him up.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro maa na zuɣu? Yi nini na kul bi neei bee yi na kul bi baŋ? Yi nyɛla suhutunanima?.
en: Jesus knew what they were saying, so he asked them, Why are you discussing about not having any bread? Don't you know or understand yet? Are your minds so dull?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Babilɔn naa lo tɔbu na ti liri ba n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ bipola bɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee, ka bi zo nachimbil bee paɣisarili bee ninkurili bee barinim nambɔɣu. O daa zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The Lord sent King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to attack Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar killed the young men who were in the temple, and he showed no mercy to anyone, whether man or woman, young or old. God let him kill everyone in the city.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya yi daɣiri zaa ni, ka chɛ ka yi bindira niŋ pam ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu.
en: I will save you from everything that defiles you. I will command the grain to be plentiful, so that you will not have any more famines.

dag: A ni yɛn mal li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pihitanaata; ka chɛ ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka chɛ ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata.
en: Make it meters long, meters wide, and meters high.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mini zuliya kam ni ti bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ lee niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ? Bɔ n-daa lee chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam lala.
en: All the other nations will ask, Why did the Lord do this to this land? Why was he so angry.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ! O wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu, o wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu.
en: Praise the Lord ! He is my Rock. He prepares me for war. He trains me for battle.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri suhuyubu niŋ; di chɛ ka bɛ di nasara bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: LORD, dont give the wicked what they want! Dont allow their plans to succeed, or theyll exalt themselves even more! Selah.

dag: Yi bi mi m mini n yaannim ni daa niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba zaa shɛm la yɛla? Tiŋgbɔna maa buɣa daa tooi tiligi di niriba n nuu ni?.
en: Dont you know what I and my predecessors have done to the people of other nations? Were any of the gods of these other nations able to rescue their lands from my power?.

dag: Dama chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa baŋ ni pa Izraɛl naa maa m-bala maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: When the commanders saw that he was not King Ahab, they stopped chasing him.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn leei yuɣimpina biɛhigu shee ni ko dooshee, ka zaŋ sɔɣu din ni saɣim li n-kol li bahi. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will turn Babylon into a marsh, and owls will live there. I will sweep Babylon with a broom that will sweep everything away. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Jɛrusalɛm shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A piligu shee mini bɛ ni dɔɣ a luɣ shɛli nyɛla Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A ba daa nyɛla Amɔri nira, ka a ma mi nyɛ Hiti nira.
en: and tell them that I, the Lord God, am saying: Jerusalem, you were born in the country where Canaanites lived. Your father was an Amorite, and your mother was a Hittite.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Kpamiya zoya ŋɔ polo, ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ku chirigi ya; kul sɔɣimiya be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ti labina pɔi ka yi naanyi yiɣisi kuli.
en: Then she said to them, Go toward the highlands so that those chasing you dont run into you. Hide there for three days until those chasing you return. Then you may go on your way.

dag: N ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, n daa dari tɔhila m binyɛra, ka dari sibi n zabiri mini n teeŋa ka teei ʒini tiŋa, ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni.
en: When I heard about this, I tore my robe and my coat to show I was upset. I pulled hair from my head and beard. I sat down, shocked and upset.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa lan tim tuumba Ammɔn naa maa sani, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛl o.
en: Then Jephthah again sent messengers to the Ammonite king.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba; ka ti gbahi bɛn kpalim ti leei daba zuliya kam ni; ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ti deei Jɛrusalɛm n-yɔɣiri gindi hal ti paai Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ su li yuma shɛm tariga.
en: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be taken away as captives among all nations. Jerusalem will be plundered by Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are concluded.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ, n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala.
en: Then a voice said from heaven, This is my own dear Son, with whom I am pleased.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛli Rut, M bia, a yi shiri chani Bɔaz puu maa ni nti yihiri kayiha maa, di so. Di pa shɛli ka a chaŋ so puu ni ka puu maa lan ti yih a halibiɛɣu.
en: Then Naomi said to her daughter-in-law Ruth, It is good for you to continue working with his women servants. If you work in another field, some man might hurt you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka a zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa samban ni na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.

dag: Dabiɛm daa kul gbahila tinzunnim maa, ka bɛ yiri bɛ birininim ni zɔrina ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They lose all their courage and come out of their hiding places shaking with fear.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu maa sɔŋ baɣil omaŋ hal ka Yisifu dan maa ti kuna.
en: Potiphar's wife kept Joseph's coat until her husband came home.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa kpi ti zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim be, di yi nyɛ ti bela ti nyɛviya ni bee ti yi gbihirila kum puuni.
en: Jesus died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we will live together with him.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa yi o sani kuli nti chɛ ka o min o bihi maa kpe duu ka yo bɛmaŋ niŋ di puuni; ka o bihi maa zaŋdi ŋmana n-zaan o, ka o boori kpam maa niŋdi di ni.
en: She left Elisha and closed the door behind her and her sons. They brought her containers as she kept on pouring.

dag: Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn be a ni zaŋla bɛmaŋmaŋ yiko kuri niriba.
en: Your own leaders use their power to murder.

dag: Kum ku gbuɣinli ŋun mali yaa, ka gbuɣinnyaŋ bihi wurim.
en: they starve, and their children are scattered.

dag: N daa pii chɛrubi zali ka o gul a, ka a be Naawuni zoli din be kasi zuɣu. A daa bela buɣim kuɣa ni chana.
en: You, a winged creature, were installed as a guardian. I placed you in Gods holy mountain where you walked among the stones of fire.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Riu.
en: When Peleg was , he had a son named Reu.

dag: Ka Jɔsia daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa Izraɛl nanim ni daa me n-zali Samaria n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi la zaa kaman o ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbina la shɛm la.
en: Josiah also destroyed all the temples at the high places in the cities of Samaria. The kings of Israel had built those temples, which had made the Lord very angry. Josiah destroyed them, just as he had destroyed the place of worship at Bethel.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi yum maa, di yi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di ni kɔbiri niŋ zaɣ dɔzim ka balisibalisi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni; di nyɛla dɔr shɛli din loora, ka nyɛ zuɣu ni bee teeŋa ni dɔr biɛɣu.
en: A priest must look at the infection. If the infection seems to be deeper than the skin, and if the hair around it is thin and yellow, the priest must announce that the person is unclean. It is a serious skin disease.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yihi kuɣa maa, ka kaɣisi tari maa ka lan ta li, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa lan puhi yili maa ni yaha.
en: If the mildew appears a second time.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn be dahima biɛhigu Ziɔn zuɣu. Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be luɣ viɛlli shee Samaria Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ninvuɣ kara bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni kani shɛb sanna nti bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: Oh, look at the people enjoying life in Zion, and those on Mount Samaria who feel so safe. They are such important leaders of a most important nation. The House of Israel comes to you for advice.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam. Ka n suhuyiɣisili maa ti lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n nini ti tiɣi li. Ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala n nyuli zabbu puuni, n suhu yi ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Only then will I stop being angry with your people. I will know that they have been punished for the bad things they did to me. They will know that I am the Lord and that I spoke to them because of my strong love for them.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni, ka n ŋme a luhi, ka ŋmaag a zuɣu, ka zaŋ Filistia tɔbbi kpima pam niŋgbuna ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri. Ka dunia zaa baŋ ni Naawuni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni;.
en: Today the Lord will help me defeat you. I'll knock you down and cut off your head, and I'll feed the bodies of the other Philistine soldiers to the birds and wild animals. Then the whole world will know that Israel has a real God.

dag: Ka daadam kam ŋun ti zaɣisi anab maa yɛligu wumbu ni ti bahi yoli zaa kahikahi.
en: Anyone who does not obey that prophet shall be separated from God's people and destroyed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka lari mini suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu naai, ka lan chɛ ka aŋgo mini amiliya kukoya vuri naai kpe yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: Listen to what I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, have to say. I will silence the sounds of joy and gladness and the happy sounds of wedding feasts. The people here will live to see this happen.

dag: Tɛhimiya o ni daa di wahala alahichinim bɛn daa je o nuu ni shɛm yɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi ku gbarigi ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Think about the one who endured such opposition from sinners so that you wont be discouraged and you wont give up.

dag: ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di nyaaŋa yi ni tooi labina, ka ku mali talahi yɛl shɛli Yawɛ mini Izraɛlnim sani; ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ leei yi ni su shɛli Yawɛ sani.
en: After the Lord helps us all take the land, you can go back home. Then the Lord and Israel will not think that you are guilty. And the Lord will let you have this land.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa ka bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ti cham ba takɔbiri.
en: The followers of Jesus were standing there too. They saw what was happening and said to Jesus, Lord, should we use our swords.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi ni.
en: Manasseh built altars for all the stars in the sky in both courtyards of the LORDs temple.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun lo amiliya yɛla buɣisi li: Zaligu kul lo paɣ ŋun kuli doo mi tabil o yidana hal ni o yidana maa nyɛvili tariga; amaa o yidana maa yi ti kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni zaŋ chaŋ o yidana maa sani.
en: A married woman is united with her husband under the Law while he is alive. But if her husband dies, she is released from the Law concerning her husband.

dag: ni daŋ kam ni kpɛm bom jaaŋgbe yini ka jaaŋgbɛhi maa kalinli yiɣisi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm ti a. Ka a sabi sokam yuli pa o jaaŋgbee zuɣu.
en: Speak to the Israelites. Get twelve wooden walking sticks from them. Get one from the leader of each of the twelve tribes. Write the name of each man on his walking stick.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim mi nyɛ o ni pii zuliya shɛli. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: But the Lord , Israel's God, is all-powerful. He created everything, and he chose Israel to be his very own.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli Ziɔn Zoli, amaa niriba ni no n-taai Mɔabnima kaman bɛ ni nɔri mɔri niŋdi kulim bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.

dag: Di saha maa ka yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be Ziɔn din nyɛ n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni nyɛla tin shɛli din be kasi, ka tinzunnim ku lan tooi tuhi fa li yaha.
en: So you will know that I am the LORD your God, settle down in Zion, my holy mountain. Jerusalem will be holy, and never again will strangers pass through it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Mikal, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii ma ka duhi ma gar a ba min o yiŋnim zaa, ka zaŋ ma leei nabia ni n su Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ tooni ka n di wari waa maa, ka di simdi ni m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: David replied to Michal, I was celebrating before the LORD, who chose me over your father and his entire family, and who appointed me leader over the LORDs people, over Israel—and I will celebrate before the LORD again!.

dag: amaa tinim sani, Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni, ka binshɛɣukam yila o sanna, ka ti bela o zuɣu. Duuma yino ko mi m-beni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam nambu ni yi so tuma ni na la, ka ti gba bela o zuɣu.
en: However, for us believers, There is one God the Father. All things come from him, and we belong to him. And there is one Lord Jesus Christ. All things exist through him, and we live through him.

dag: Amaa yinim bi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu ni wuhiri ya shɛm, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi shiri be yi ni, yi ni dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Masia Shia, o pala Masia ni su so.
en: But you arent self-centered. Instead you are in the Spirit, if in fact Gods Spirit lives in you. If anyone doesnt have the Spirit of Christ, they dont belong to him.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni mali tahima so sani. Bɛnkam zaɣis a ni di vi. Bɛnkam zo ka chɛ a, bɛ ni sabi bɛ yuya niŋ tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ.
en: LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will suffer disgrace; those who turn away from you in the land will be written off, for they have abandoned the LORD, the fountain of living water.

dag: N ni ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro zaɣa, ka paɣiba pia ni ti mali yi bɔrɔbɔro dubil yini puuni, ka ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro maa tibisim, ka yi ti ŋub li ka bi tiɣi.
en: I will cut off your food supply, so that ten women will need only one oven to bake all the bread they have. They will ration it out, and when you have eaten it all, you will still be hungry.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a mi, dama a nyɛla ŋun ni garigiri ma, lala zuɣu ka n suhir a maa; dinzuɣu gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu maa.
en: Every time I call to you, God, you answer me. So listen to me now, and hear what I say.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu ŋooi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: God has weakened my mind; the Almighty has frightened me.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa yi tɔb maa ni n-zo hal ni Shilo dindali maa, o daa dari tɔhi la o situra, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu.
en: That very day, a Benjaminite ran from the battle to Shiloh. His clothes were torn, and dirt was on his head.

dag: di simdi ni maligumaana lihi li, ka dalima din be o niŋgbuŋ ni maa yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛl tim, dindina di kul nyɛla saŋkpambihi n-niŋ o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu maa, o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, You are clean.

dag: Niriba ayi bɛn daa wum Jɔn ni yɛli shɛm ka doli Yisa maa ni yino n-daa nyɛ Anduru, Saimɔn Pita tizo.
en: One of the two disciples who heard what John said and followed Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.

dag: Hur n-daa nyɛ Uri ba, ka Uri mi daa nyɛ Bɛzalɛl ba.
en: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri was the father of Bezalel.

dag: amaa ninsal ku tooi maai zilinli nini. Di nyɛla din bi saɣi ni so su li, ka lan nyɛ lɔɣu ni pali shɛl ni!.
en: No one can tame the tongue, though. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔh o ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa dɔɣi ma lala? bee m-bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka a daa wolisi dɔɣi? Mbusim be dilan zuɣu.
en: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, What have you done to make us what we are.

dag: N kul gbibi n yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani sahakam, ka gbibi m min o daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: My love will protect him forever. My agreement with him will never end.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa ni o biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Jotham did and all his wars are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah .

dag: A leela ninkuunsilana zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka niŋ ma alaka ni a yaa zaa.
en: You are treating me cruelly; you persecute me with all your power.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim bɔhi Ɛdomnim biɛri ti ma. Bɛ ni ti niŋ Ɛdomnim maa kaman n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ baŋ m biɛri bɔhibu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: My people Israel will take revenge on Edom for me, and they will make Edom feel my furious anger. Edom will know what it means to be the object of my revenge. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Fɔnisia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Speen ŋarima din be teeku ni, kummiya ni suhugarigu! Dama Taai luya ka lan ka yili bee kulinoli. Niriba daa yila Saipurus na nti wum di yɛla.
en: This is a message about Tyre. Howl with grief, you sailors out on the ocean! Your home port of Tyre has been destroyed; its houses and its harbor are in ruins. As your ships return from Cyprus, you learn the news.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa yi chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bɛ jɛma saha nti tumdi bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ yab Aduna zali ba shɛm la.
en: These men were registered according to their assignments for going to the Temple and performing the duties established by their ancestor Aaron in obedience to the commands of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: O vuhim pɔhim daa ʒe n-neei zuɣusaa, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu kuhi wahu ŋun zɔri ni o tiligi.
en: Due to his wind, heaven became clear; his hand split the fleeing serpent.

dag: amaa ka daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama sokam zaa zaɣa daa kul bela o wuhibu maa ni.
en: but they could not find a way to do it, because all the people kept listening to him, not wanting to miss a single word.

dag: Dama yi yi niŋdi ba alaka ka bɛ fabili niŋ ma, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni gbilisi tibili wum bɛ fabila maa.
en: If you do, I, the Lord , will answer them when they cry out to me for help.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri wuntitali mini nirilim niŋbu ni nya nyɛvili mini jilima.
en: Be kind and honest and you will live a long life; others will respect you and treat you fairly.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lɔrigiri buŋ maa ka bɛn su o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o.
en: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, Why are you untying the colt.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba. O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi mini wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi, ka daa zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi maa shɛŋa zali tin shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mi zali Jɛrusalɛm ŋun naa sani.
en: Solomon acquired more and more chariots and horses until he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses that he kept in chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa o zuɣu dɛde. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Above his head they put the written notice of the accusation against him: This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti garigi zuɣusaa ka di mi garigi tiŋgbani.
en: At that time I will answer the prayers of my people Israel. I will make rain fall on the earth, and the earth will produce grain and grapes and olives.

dag: Wɔhu simdila fiɛbiga, ka buŋ simdi langami, ka jɛra yaansi zuɣu mi simdi fiɛbiga.
en: You have to whip a horse, you have to bridle a donkey, and you have to beat a fool.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ ŋun be Ziɔn ŋɔ! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla!.
en: Sing praises to the Lord , who sits as King in Zion. Tell the nations about the great things he has done.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Sokam tiligim o nyɛvili. Di kpinya di taali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ni bɔhiri biɛri saha shɛli m-bɔŋɔ; o yɔr li la di tuma samli.
en: Escape from Babylon; each of you run for your lives! Dont perish because of her guilt, because this is the time for the LORDs retribution, a day of reckoning for all that Babylon has done.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa tuui wuhi shihir shɛli ka di wuhi o yiko ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba daa niŋ o yɛda. Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la ka o daa wuhi shihirili maa.
en: This was Jesus' first miracle, and he did it in the village of Cana in Galilee. There Jesus showed his glory, and his disciples put their faith in him.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Chɛl paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Chɛ ka o niŋ li gu n sɔɣibu dali.
en: Jesus answered, Dont stop her. It was right for her to save this perfume for today—the day for me to be prepared for burial.

dag: O baŋsim puuni ka teeku daa yina, ka o daa chɛ ka saa yiri sagbana ni lurina.
en: With his knowledge, he made the oceans and the clouds that produce rain.

dag: Lihimi Bɛhɛmɔt so n ni nam kaman n ni nam a shɛm ŋɔ; o ŋubirila mɔri kaman naɣilaa la.
en: Look at Behemoth, whom I made along with you; he eats grass like cattle.

dag: dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-ku la.
en: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But God, the same God our fathers had, raised Jesus up from death.

dag: Di saha yiliguliba ni ni ti sɔhira, ka kpiɔŋlaannim pɔri gɔɣi, ka paɣiba bɛn niɛmdi chɛ niɛmbu, bɛ ni bi lan galisi zuɣu, ka din lihiri takɔriti ni niŋ liti.
en: At that time your arms will lose their strength. Your legs will become weak and bent. Your teeth will fall out, and you will not be able to chew your food. Your eyes will not see clearly.

dag: ka m mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn be n sani ni chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka bɛ yi ti yina ni ti mini ba zaŋ nya taba, ti ni ŋmaligi guui kaman ti ni daa pun niŋ shɛm la.
en: I will lead the men with me; we will march toward the city. The men in the city will come out to fight against us. We will turn and run away from them as we did before.

dag: Nyini n dan naa m-bahi noli ka tuuni ŋɔ tum, ka bi yɛli tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ŋun yɛn ʒini a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: Did Your Majesty approve all this and not even tell your officials who is to succeed you as king.

dag: Ka Pita daa kpalim Jɔpa, Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ gbanzab la yiŋa n-niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.

dag: Amaa yi ni yi alahichi dabitim ni pumpɔŋɔ n-yipa leela Naawuni daba ŋɔ, yi ni nya nyɔ shɛli di ni nyɛla biɛr kasi, ka di bahigu nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: But now that you have been set free from sin and become slaves to God, you have the consequence of a holy life, and the outcome is eternal life.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi n-lab o sapashin tab maa sani ka bɛ ti bɔh o, Alaafee? Ka lan bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka yinyaa maa lee kana ti bɔr a sani? Ka Jɛhu yɛli ba, Yi pun mi o ni o yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: Jehu went back to his fellow officers, who asked him, Is everything all right? What did that crazy fellow want with you? You know what he wanted, Jehu answered.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o daalibarika zuɣu ka o pii ba, dindina di pala bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu. Ka di yi nyɛla bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu, dindina alibarika maa naan ku lan nyɛla alibarika yaha.
en: And if he chose them by grace, then it is not what they have done that made them his people. If they could be made his people by what they did, his gift of grace would not really be a gift.

dag: Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: They celebrated this Passover in Josiahs th year as king.

dag: A yi nya shiri, nyin dim li a kum tariga, a yi di li yaɣi, a ni ti li bahi.
en: Honey is good, but dont eat too much of it, or you will be sick.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti bi saɣim timaŋa, ti na ʒi n-jɛm Baalinima? Lihimiya yi biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm vinvamli ni, nyamiya yi ni daa tum shɛm. Yi daa ŋmanila laakum nyaŋ ŋun bɔri dubu ka faai zɔra ginda.
en: How can you say you have not defiled yourself, that you have never worshiped Baal? Look how you sinned in the valley; see what you have done. You are like a wild camel in heat, running around loose.

dag: Amaa ka Sukɔt kpamba daa bɔh o, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu.
en: But the leaders of the city of Succoth said to Gideon, Why should we give your soldiers something to eat? You havent caught Zebah and Zalmunna yet.

dag: Ka bɛ yi boli so na ni o ti di o nini ni nya shɛli bee o ni mi shɛli yɛla shɛhira, amaa ka o zaɣisi ka bi yɛli shɛli, o tum alahichi, ka o taali maa ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you refuse to testify in court about something you saw or know has happened, you have sinned and can be punished.

dag: Amaa sokam zaa ni o saha: Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ tooni; ka o ni ti yɛn su shɛb o labbuna saha mi naanyi paya.
en: Each event will happen in the right order: Christ, the first crop of the harvest, then those who belong to Christ at his coming.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Damaskusnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Giliadnima nahindi biɛɣu.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba, Yihimiya salima tibikpara din be yi paɣiba tiba ni mini yi bipuɣinsi tiba ni ni din be yi bidibisi sani n-zaŋ na ti ti ma.
en: Aaron said to the people, Bring me the gold earrings that belong to your wives, sons, and daughters.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zan o sani nimaani ka yɛli, N yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: The Lord came down in a cloud, stood with him there, and pronounced his holy name, the Lord .

dag: ni man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai yiya ŋɔ nima mini di niriba kaman kundi maa puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam zaa, ka Juda naa karim li maa.
en: The Lord says this: I am bringing trouble on this place and on the people who live here. These are the troubles that are mentioned in the book that the king of Judah read.

dag: N zaŋ a leela ŋun ni be n niriba ni n-kpahindi ba ka yihiri ba daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ka kpahim bɛ soya.
en: Jeremiah, I want you to be like a worker who tests metals. You will test my people and watch how they live.

dag: ka so mi yi yihi shɛli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, Naawuni ni yih o tarili nyɛvili tia la mini tiŋ kasi shɛli din yɛla sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la ni.
en: And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away that persons share of the tree of life and of the holy city, which are written about in this book.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku deei pin shɛli a sani. Ka Naaman daa balim o ni o deem li, amaa ka o zaɣisi.
en: But Elisha said, I swear by the life of the LORD I serve that I wont accept anything. Naaman urged Elisha to accept something, but he still refused.

dag: ni Hanan daŋ niriba ni Gidɛl daŋ niriba ni Gahar daŋ niriba.
en: Hanan, Giddel, Gahar.

dag: Ka n ni ti yɛli ni n suhu zaa, Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee beni ŋ-ŋman a? Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fari bɛn ka yaa kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun fari nandaamba bɛn nahindi ba nuu ni bahira.
en: Every bone in my body will shout: No one is like the Lord ! You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi la, Zaŋmiy o doli guliba maa sunsuuni gari, ka zaŋ takɔb ku ŋunkam be o polo. Dama maligumaana maa daa yɛlimi, Di kuny o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord 's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka Ɛhab bia Jɛhɔram daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi.
en: Joram, Ahabs son, became king of Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat, Judahs king. He ruled for twelve years.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi mini di kpam din zaa be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: the kidneys and the fat on them, and the best part of the liver.

dag: Bɛn daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba pahi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: and their relatives, heads of their households, , capable men for the religious work of Gods house.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛnkam mali Naawuni ni ti ba pina balibubalibu shɛŋa tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga zaŋdi li sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: Each one, as a good manager of God's different gifts, must use for the good of others the special gift he has received from God.

dag: Sool min o bidibis ata ni o neen ʒira ni o yiŋnim zaa ni daa laɣim kpi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Saul and three of his sons died. All of Sauls family died together.

dag: Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kafitɔrinima Filistianim ni yi shɛb zuliya ni na la.
en: Pathrus, Casluh, and of Crete, from whom the Philistines are descended.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul gbibiya yi ni pun mali shɛl la kirikiri hal ka n ti kana.
en: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
