dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol li Dauda tiŋa.
en: David occupied the fortress, so it was renamed Davids City.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim mali laara, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali putɔɣu tumdila bɛmaŋ barina.
en: Kind persons benefit themselves, but cruel people harm themselves.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara ti ku lan kpi kum din pahi buyi la yaha.
en: Everyone who hears this should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Those who win the victory will not be hurt by the second death.

dag: Ka du shɛli din dunoli kpa nuzaa polo ŋɔ nyɛ maligumaana ŋun su sara maligu bimbini fukumsi duu. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yi Zadok zuliya ni na. Bɛ kɔŋko m-mali soli Lɛvi zuliya niriba sunsuuni ni bɛ miri Yawɛ sani nti tum o tuma.
en: and the chamber facing north is for the priests who keep watch over the altar. Of all the Levites, only the Zadokites may draw near to serve the LORD.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti di n-tiɣi, ka di wuhi ni bɛ tiɣiya ka bɛ daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛhi bɛ suhuri ni, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tam n yɛla.
en: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni vuhi pɔhim shɛli bahi. Bɛ dabisa ŋmanila shilinshia din garita.
en: Our life is like a puff of air. It is like a passing shadow.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka sapashin kpɛm maa bɔri ni o baŋ daliri din chɛ ka Yɛhudianim zaŋ o taali n-fiɣis o maa, ka daa lɔrig o ka tim ti boli maligumaaniba kpamba mini jintɔriba zaa ni bɛ laɣimna. Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Pool ti zali bɛ tooni.
en: The next day the commander decided to learn why the Jews were accusing Paul. So he ordered the leading priests and the whole high council to meet together. He had Pauls chains taken off and had him brought in to face the council.

dag: M pun nya ka binshɛɣukam zaa viɛlim malila tariga, amaa a zaligunim din viɛlim nyɛla din ka tariga.
en: Ive seen that everything, no matter how perfect, has a limit, but your commandment is boundless.

dag: Chɛ ka di dabisili maa leei zibisim. Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ di lan teei di yɛla bee n-chɛ ka neesim neei di ni.
en: That day—let it be darkness; may God above ignore it, and light not shine on it.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi nimaani gariti tooni, ka dɔbba ayi bɛn nyɛ zoomba dol o n-kuhiri pampam yɛra, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, Son of David, have pity on us.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini paɣ shɛba ni Yisa ma Mariama ni Yisa tizɔbihi zaa daa malila tɛhi yini n-laɣim suhiri Naawuni.
en: The apostles often met together and prayed with a single purpose in mind. The women and Mary the mother of Jesus would meet with them, and so would his brothers.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti tiligira. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: The holy God of Israel sets us free— his name is the Lord Almighty.

dag: Momaha be mɔɣu ni pam, ka suhupiɛlli pali daboya zuɣu.
en: The desert and hills are covered with grass.

dag: Sana yi be yi sani, yin zaŋmiy o leei tiŋbia yi sani, ka yur o kaman yimaŋmaŋ la. Dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You must treat them the same as you treat your own citizens. Love them as you love yourselves. Remember, you were foreigners in Egypt. I am the Lord your God!.

dag: di saha maa n daa bela o luɣili zuɣu kaman tumtumdiba kpɛm la. O suhu daa piɛli n zuɣu dabisili kam, ka n kul mali suhupiɛlli o sani sahakam.
en: I was right beside the Lord , helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.

dag: Dum Abarim zoli din nyɛ Nɛbo zoli ka be Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ labi Jɛriko tooni polo la nti lihi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su maa.
en: Go to the Abarim Mountains in the land of Moab opposite the city of Jericho; climb Mount Nebo and look at the land of Canaan that I am about to give the people of Israel.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi tɛha ni.
en: Sinners, change your heart and mind. Think about this again. Remember it and be strong.

dag: Di ni daa be shɛm hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli.
en: In the days before the flood people ate and drank, men and women married, up to the very day Noah went into the boat;.

dag: ka bɛ ʒin ya chaŋ kaman wurigu la pɔi ka Yawɛ suhu naanyi yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya tab saawara ka laɣimmiya pɔi ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali dabisili la naanyi paai ya.
en: before the decision is made—the day vanishes like chaff— before the burning anger of the LORD comes against you, before the day of the LORDs anger comes against you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔguliba tuma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔra daŋ ni, bɛ daa piila Kɔre ŋun daa nyɛ Asaf bidibiga la bia Mɛshɛlɛmia.
en: The divisions of the gatekeepers: from the Korahites: Meshelemiah, Kores son, one of Ebiasaphs family.

dag: Naawuni duya nti ʒini o nam ʒiishee ni tahigu. Yawɛ duya ni kikaa kumsi.
en: God has gone up with a joyous shout— the LORD with the blast of the rams horn.

dag: Kom daa lim bɛ dimnim maa, ka bɛ ni yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: But the waters covered over their foes— not one of them survived!.

dag: O ni ti kpa o nam tanti suɣ kara teeku mini zo shɛli din be kasi la sunsuuni. Amaa o ni ti kpi, ka so ku be o sani sɔŋ o.
en: He will set up his kings tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain. But finally, that bad king will die. There will be no one to help him when his end comes.

dag: Deemiya bɛ suɣa mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu ni bɛ pateesanima ni bɛ nɛma zaa. Taɣimiya bɛ laakuma chaŋ ti leei yi dini. Ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Yɛlibiɛɣu gili ti luɣilikam zaa.
en: His fearsome army will surround you, taking your tents and possessions, your sheep and camels.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Then Elihu continued his speech:.

dag: A daa nam o ka o jilima pooi malaikanim jilima saha biɛla puuni; a daa chɛ ka o mali jiri mini jilima.
en: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.

dag: Ifriimnim daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, niriba niŋgbuna sɔhirimi, bɛ daa tibigi ba pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti jɛmdi Baal, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: When Ephraim spoke, there was excitement; he was praised in Israel; but he became guilty through Baal and died.

dag: Yi nini na bi nya o, amaa ka yi kul yur o; ka hal yi nini ni na kul bi nya o maa zaa yoli, yi niŋ o yɛda ka kul mali suhupiɛl shɛli din galisi hal ka so ku tooi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa kahigi li wuhi gba.
en: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannima bɛn mali yɛm, ka mali yu suma n-zaŋ ba leei yi zuɣulaannima. Ka bɛ su niriba tuhilituhili mini niriba kɔbigakɔbiga ni niriba pihinunu ni niriba piapia fukumsi, ka nyɛ yi daŋ kam ni kpamba.
en: So I took leading individuals from your tribes, people who were wise and well-regarded, and I set them up as your leaders. There were commanders over thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens, as well as officials for each of your tribes.

dag: Bolimiya Yawɛ yuli m-puh o. Chɛliya ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , proclaim his greatness; tell the nations what he has done.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan gariti a sani ka yul a n-nya ka a saɣi bɔbu, ka n daa zaŋ n chinchini pil a limsi a zaɣim maa, ka po pɔri lo a alikauli, ka a leei n ni su so. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I looked you over. I saw you were ready for love, so I spread my clothes over you and covered your nakedness. I promised to marry you. I made the agreement with you, and you became mine. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔhimi, Pa Yisifu bia Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti ni mi so ba min o ma la m-bala? Ka di chaŋ wula ka o ti yɛli ni o yila alizanda ni na.
en: So they said, This man is Jesus son of Joseph, isn't he? We know his father and mother. How, then, does he now say he came down from heaven.

dag: Nyini Ijipti paɣipiɛliga, Cham Giliad ti bom tim. A ni niŋ tima pam maa zaa, yoli ka a niŋ li maa; a ku tibi kpaŋ.
en: People of Egypt, go to Gilead and look for medicine! All your medicine has proved useless; nothing can heal you.

dag: Inok daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka so daa ti bi lan nya o, dama Naawuni n-daa kpuɣ o.
en: He spent his life in fellowship with God, and then he disappeared, because God took him away.

dag: Ti ni daa chɛbisi ba bahi ka ti ŋariŋ yiɣisi n-zaŋ sochibiga nti paai Koos n-naanyi neei biɛɣu m-paai Rodis n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Patara.
en: We said good-bye to them and left. After sailing straight across, we came to Cos; the next day we reached Rhodes, and from there we went on to Patara.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, n niriba maa pirigili n-daa tumdi mɛbu maa tuma, ka pirigili mi ye gbaɣinɔnima ka gbib kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni tɔbiri. Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul ʒe Judanim zaa bɛn mɛri gooni maa nyaaŋa.
en: But from that day on, only half of my workers continued in the construction, while the other half held the spears, shields, bows, and body armor. Meanwhile, the leaders positioned themselves behind the whole house of Judah.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa bela Giligal. Nimaani ka n nyee daa piligi ba nyɔnibu. Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu n ni kari ba yihi n yiŋa. N ku lan yuri ba yaha; bɛ kpamba zaa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi ma.
en: The Lord says, All their evildoing began in Gilgal. It was there that I began to hate them. And because of the evil they have done, I will drive them out of my land. I will not love them any more; all their leaders have rebelled against me.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Asa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa pa omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti va kuɣ shɛŋa mini dakuɣ shɛŋa Naa Baasha ni daa mali mɛri Rama maa zaa n-chaŋ ti me Gɛba mini Mizipa.
en: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Haman, Niriba maa mini bɛ liɣiri maa zaa nyɛla a dini, niŋm bɛ min li a ni yu shɛm.
en: The king said to Haman, Both the money and the people are under your power. Do as you like with them.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum din bahiri niriba yoli mini buɣim din dira ni alɔbo din ni chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaŋ bɛ nyina liri ba lu bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ tinvura lɔɣu lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga n-ti Hadad, ka bɛ bol o yuli Gɛnubat, ka napaɣ maa daa wums o nayili maa; ka bia maa mini Firawuna bidibisi daa laɣim be nayili maa.
en: Hadad and the sister of Tahpenes had a son named Genubath. Queen Tahpenes let Genubath grow up in Pharaohs house with his children.

dag: Wɔribariba mini peentɔriba vuri ni ti chɛ ka fɔŋ kam niriba zo, bɛ ni ti zo n-kpe mɔɣu ni, ka shɛb du tampima. Bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ fɔndi maa zaa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: At the noise of the cavalry and archers everyone will run away. Some will run to the forest; others will climb up among the rocks. Every town will be left empty, and no one will live in them again.

dag: Bɛ ti yɛn zahindila kom kɔpu buyi tir a ka a nyura. A ni ti nyuri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a nyu li saha shɛli.
en: You will also ration your water by measure, drinking a sixth of a hin at fixed times each day.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa lab maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim maa sani, ka bɛ ti bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ʒi o na.
en: The Temple police went back to the leading priests and the Pharisees. The priests and the Pharisees asked, Why didnt you bring Jesus.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Naawuni ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la?.
en: Now, as for the dead rising to life: haven't you ever read what God has told you? He said.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be wuhibu ni, ka gbilisi tibili wum baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Listen to instruction and do your best to learn.

dag: Babilɔnnima, yi bari yimaŋ zana ka di gbahi ya, amaa ka yi bi baŋ lala. Bɛ daa nyan ya n-gbahi ya yi ni daa mo Yawɛ la zuɣu.
en: You set a trap for others, Babylon, but you yourself were caught in it unaware; you have been found and captured because you have defied the LORD.

dag: N ni wuhi ya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm; n ku sɔɣi ya din be Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani.
en: Let me teach you how great is God's power, and explain what Almighty God has planned.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ tipawumli siɣi doli ba na, ka di chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba zuɣu.
en: I have made the Egyptians brave, so they will chase you. But I will show you that I am more powerful than Pharaoh and all of his horses and chariots.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Panniriba, dama yi pala n niriba, m mi pala yi Naawuni.
en: The Lord said to Hosea, Name him Not-My-People, because the people of Israel are not my people, and I am not their God.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔriti taŋkpaɣu m-puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri, ka kumdi ka fabindi kuhiri yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali ŋɔ daazichi zuɣu ka bɛn mali ŋarima mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa leei bundaannim la, ka di ti zani awa yini puuni n-lu n-dahim zaa.
en: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.

dag: Ka Ham ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan ba la daa nya o ba ni do o zaɣim maa, ka yi samban ni nti yɛl o mabih ayi la.
en: When Ham, the father of Canaan, saw that his father was naked, he went out and told his two brothers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niɣi maa na ti ti Yisifu, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ yuri mini piɛri ni buhi ni bunsi. Ka o daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ niɣi zaa di yuuni maa puuni.
en: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them food for the horses, flocks, cattle, and donkeys. He got them through that year with food in exchange for all of their livestock.

dag: Ka gbarigu maa daa kul vili Pita mini Jɔn gbibi kirikiri, ka di niŋ niriba alahiziba, ka bɛ kab doli ba hal ni kazal shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni.
en: While the healed man clung to Peter and John, all the people rushed toward them at Solomons Porch, completely amazed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Samsin paɣ maa ti do so ŋun daa nyɛ Samsin aŋgo zo.
en: And Samsons wife married one of those who had been his companions.

dag: Yi ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa daa nyɛla biɛɣ pihinahi. Dinzuɣu dabisi yini kam yɛn leela yuun muni. Yi ni ʒi yi daalahichi ʒili yuun pihinahi, ka baŋ ni yi ni niŋ shɛm bi tiɣi n nini. .
en: I will punish you severely every day for the next years—one year for each day that the land was explored.

dag: Gibiɔn maa ka Yawɛ daa ti ka Sulemaana sanna zahindi ni yuŋ nti yɛl o, Suhim a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: The LORD appeared to Solomon at Gibeon in a dream at night. God said, Ask whatever you wish, and Ill give it to you.

dag: Siɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan.
en: Seirs sons were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

dag: ka yɛl o, Yoom wulimpuhili polo takɔro ŋɔ; ka o yoo li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Toma, ka o to li. Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ nasara dibu piɛm m-bɔŋɔ, nasara dibu piɛm din yɛn nyaŋ Sirianima m-bala! Dama a ni tuhi Sirianim Afɛk hal nti ku n-naai ba.
en: Elisha said, Open the east window. Jehoash opened the window. Then Elisha said, Shoot. Jehoash shot. Then Elisha said, This is the Lord s arrow of victory over Aram! You will defeat the Arameans at Aphek until you destroy them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛli, Gunibu ŋɔ zuɣu a shiri nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: So the Lord did not harm Moses. Then Zipporah said, Yes, my dear, you are safe because of this circumcision.

dag: Amaa ka Ashpɛnaz daa lee zɔri naa dabiɛm, ka yɛli Daniɛl, Naa pun wuhi yi ni yɛn diri bindir shɛŋa mini yi ni yɛn nyuri binnyur shɛli, ka yi niŋgbuna yi ti bi pa taba kaman yi tab la dini, o ni ŋma n zuɣu.
en: But the man still told him, The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi maa na ka Musa ti niŋ binʒim maa niŋ bɛ nudiriti tibinyaɣa ni mini bɛ nudiriti polo nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti polo napombihilɔri. Ka Musa daa kpaai ʒim maa vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Then Moses brought Aarons sons close to the altar. He put some of the blood on the tip of their right ears, on the thumb of their right hands, and on the big toe of their right feet. Then he sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaɣisi n yɛligu ka dolila kiŋkansi mini yɔhiŋ soli, ka niŋ li naani.
en: The Holy One of Israel says, You people have refused to accept this message from me. You depend on fighting and lies to help you.

dag: Ka salo maa daa vu m-miri Gomna Pailɛt nti yɛl o ni o niŋmi ka o ni yi pun niŋdi ba shɛm la.
en: When the crowd gathered and began to ask Pilate for the usual favor.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli, Di simdi ni ti ku Shimɛi o ni daa tu Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But Abishai shouted, You should be killed for cursing the Lord 's chosen king.

dag: Amaa ni malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin ni ti yɛn piɛb o kikaa dahin shɛl la ka Naawuni daashili yɛl shɛŋa o ni daa yɛl o daanabinim la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa ʒin o ba nam ʒiishee n-nya yaa naai, o daa zaŋla takɔbi ku o tizɔbihi maa zaa, ka daa lan ku Izraɛl kpambal shɛb gba.
en: Jehoram took over his fathers kingdom and made himself strong. Then he used a sword to kill all his brothers. He also killed some of the leaders of Israel.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garig o bɔhigunim maa zaa, ka binshɛɣu daa kani din sɔɣi ka Sulemaana bi tooi kahigi li wuhi paɣ maa.
en: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for him to answer.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini maligumaana Abiata n-leeg o saawaranima, ka bɛ dol o n-sɔŋd o.
en: He talked with Joab and with Abiathar the priest, and they agreed to support his cause.

dag: Gaad zuliya mini bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zɛfɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛfɔnnima; ka Hagi daŋ niriba nyɛ Haginima; ka Shuni daŋ niriba nyɛ Shuninima.
en: The tribe of Gad: the clans of Zephon, Haggi, Shuni.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa piligi niriba maa kalibu, amaa o daa bi kali ba naai, ka alɔbo daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu niriba kalibu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa bi sabi bɛ kalinli maa niŋ Naa Dauda yɛla teebu litaafi ni.
en: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the people, but he did not finish. God became angry with the Israelites. That is why the number of the people was not put in the book, The History of King David .

dag: Masia zuɣu m mali suhupiɛlli chɔɣinsi ni mini ʒiɛmbu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni alaka nyabu ni ni wahala dibu puuni, dama n yi ti gbarigi, di saha ka n lan nyari yaa.
en: I am content with weaknesses, insults, hardships, persecutions, and difficulties for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o ka o kabiri dari maa daa zaŋ o tahi Musa mini Aduna ni niriba maa zaa sani.
en: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the whole community.

dag: bee n-ni suh o zahim ka o gbaai wahu ti o?.
en: Or if he asked for a fish, would you give him a snake? Of course not!.

dag: Ka Sool daa chaŋ Amalɛknim maa ya nti sɔɣi dɔni vinvamli ni.
en: Then Saul advanced on the Amalekite city and laid an ambush in the valley.

dag: n-sɔɣi ŋuniya mal li tɔri ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali; bɛ kul tɔrila niriba libigiri ba, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: They are quick to spread their shameless lies; they destroy good people with cowardly slander.

dag: ka me Tadimɔr din daa be tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini tin shɛŋa din daa be Hamat ka nɛma be di ni la zaa.
en: and fortified the city of Palmyra in the desert. He rebuilt all the cities in Hamath that were centers for storing supplies.

dag: Amaa a nyara, hal a nya muɣisigu mini wahala shɛŋa bɛ ni dira, chɛ ka yɛla maa be a nuu ni. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri sɔŋsim zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋla a nuu ni; a mi pun nyɛla kpibisi sɔŋda.
en: But you do see; you take notice of trouble and suffering and are always ready to help. The helpless commit themselves to you; you have always helped the needy.

dag: Ka Hamat Naa Tɔi daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa min o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ, tiligim amaŋa! A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na.
en: and saying, So you were going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, were you? Save yourself! If you are Gods Son, come down from the cross.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔa paɣ maa daa yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka a ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam zambu ʒi m mini n daŋ zaa zuɣu, ka a min a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ku mali taali di puuni.
en: Your Majesty, she said, whatever you do, my family and I will take the blame; you and the royal family are innocent.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ din niŋ o maa, ka dabiɛm kpe o pam ka o ni dii sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o din niŋ o maa zaa.
en: The woman knew what had happened to her. So she came trembling with fear and knelt down in front of Jesus. Then she told him the whole story.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niɣi maa na ti ti Yisifu, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ yuri mini piɛri ni buhi ni bunsi. Ka o daa zaŋ bindirigu taɣi bɛ niɣi zaa di yuuni maa puuni.
en: So the people used their cattle and horses and all their other animals to buy food. And that year, Joseph gave them food and took their animals.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi nya ma, ka n labisi yi daazichi zaa tin ya, ka yihi ya zuliya shɛb ni zaa mini luɣ shɛŋa zaa n ni daa kari ya tahi la n-zaŋ ya labisi n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya yi luɣ shɛŋa ni chaŋ la na. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and accept your worship. Then I will gather you from all the nations where I scattered you, and you will return to Jerusalem.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa; di gbibiya jaaŋgbɛhi bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima bee bindira bee liɣiri; yi mi di ʒin ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: He said to them, When you travel, dont take a walking stick. Also, dont carry a bag, food, or money. Take for your trip only the clothes you are wearing.

dag: Ka kahiŋkɔri maa daa shiri tahiri bindirigu mini nimdi na nti tir o asiba ni zaawuni; ka o daa nyuri kulibɔŋ maa ni kom.
en: Ravens brought Elijah food every morning and every evening, and he drank water from the stream.

dag: Dauda ni daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka bi zaɣis o noli o ni zal o zaligu shɛŋa zaa ni, naɣila Yuria Hiti nir la yɛla la zuɣu ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: David had always done what the Lord said was right. He had always obeyed his commands. The only time David did not obey the Lord was when he sinned against Uriah the Hittite.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina; ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣiyihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: Any man who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery, and a man who marries a woman divorced from her husband commits adultery.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o jilima min o yiko nyɔhi kpe m-pali jɛmbu duu maa, ka so daa bi lan tooi kpe di ni hal ka malaikanima ayopɔin maa alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la tuma zaa ti naai.
en: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory and power of God, and no one could go into the temple until the seven plagues brought by the seven angels had come to an end.

dag: Zuliya kam ŋmanila kom biɛla din tɔɣ lu bokati puuni, ka be kaman taŋkpa zim din pa sania zuɣu o sani. Nyama, ŋuna n-zahindi teeku ni gili tiŋgban bihi shɛŋa kaman taŋkpaɣu biɛla la.
en: Look, all the nations in the world are like one small drop in the bucket. If the Lord took all the faraway nations and put them on his scales, they would be like small pieces of dust.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn. Ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛl naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Samuɛl yɛli shɛm la.
en: All the leaders of Israel came to King David at the town of Hebron. David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord . The leaders anointed David. That made him king over Israel. The Lord had promised through Samuel that this would happen.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fa ma duŋtaariba nuu ni, ka chɛ ka n leei niriba naa; ka n ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb leei bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: You saved me from a rebellious people and made me ruler over the nations; people I did not know have now become my subjects.

dag: Nyini n-nam zibisim, ka di nyɛ yuŋ, ka biŋkɔbiri bɛn be yɔɣu ni yirina gɔra.
en: You bring on the darkness and it is night, when every forest animal prowls.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun doli yili maa dunoli yi, ka yo yili maa zali hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: he must go out of the house and lock the house for seven days.

dag: Amaa ka bidibbil so daa ti nya ba ka chaŋ ti yɛli Absalom, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa zo yomyom ti kpe Bahurim do so yiŋa, doo maa daa malila kɔbiliga o yiŋa ka bɛ siɣi di puuni.
en: But a young man saw them and went to tell Absalom. So Jonathan and Ahimaaz left and hurried to the house of a man who lived in Bahurim. Then they climbed down into a well in the courtyard.

dag: Ka nira yi vuɣi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee, di nyaaŋa bɛ biɛhigu shee maa ni zaɣisi ba ka yɛli, Man na ʒi n-nyan ya.
en: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;.

dag: Du bihi shɛŋa daa be di ni, ka du bil yini kam yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ata, ka di wɔɣilim gba nyɛ mita ata. Ka goma din daa be du bihi maa sunsuuni barilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili. Ka zɔŋ duno shɛli bɛ ni daa doli kpɛri puuni ha dunɔbia nyɛ mita ata.
en: The rooms were ten and a half feet long and ten and a half feet wide, with a space of seven and a half feet between them. The plaza next to the porch at the gate opposite the temple was ten and a half feet.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bi ʒe na so nyaaŋa ka chɛ so, bee n-lihi nya bundaamba ka chɛ nandaamba, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla o nuhi tuma.
en: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yi daa zaŋ sara mini pina na ti ti ma saha shɛli n ni daa mali ya be mɔɣu ni la?.
en: Israel, you offered me sacrifices and offerings in the desert for years.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: So they wanted to seize Jesus, but they couldnt because his time hadnt yet come.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ma sa zuɣusaa, n ni vooi sokam zaa tahi n sanna.
en: When I am lifted up from the earth, I will draw everyone to me. .

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili tia ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbi gbaai li gbibi sani. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi li kirikiri nyɛ bɛn mali suhupiɛlli.
en: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her; those who hold her tight are happy.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka doo ŋɔ tɔɣisiri lala? O mɔri Naawuni! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: Why does he speak this way? Hes insulting God. Only the one God can forgive sins.

dag: M mini Masia kpimi o dapulli zuɣu, ka di pala mani n-lan be maa, amaa di nyɛla Masia ŋun be n ni la m-be maa; ka n ni mali biɛhigu shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, m mal li la Naawuni Bia ŋun daa yuri ma ka kpi n zuɣu maa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. And the life that I now live in my body, I live by faith, indeed, by the faithfulness of Gods Son, who loved me and gave himself for me.

dag: Amaa hal yi ni sari li ka di daari pum dindali, ka neeri biɛɣu zoori la zaa yoli, di ku wali ka yi pɔhi li; di kul yɛn tin ya la nandahima ni biɛrim.
en: You will plant your grapevines one day and try to make them grow, and the next day they will blossom. But at harvest time, you will go to gather the fruit from the plants, and you will see that everything is dead. A sickness will kill all the plants.

dag: ka chɛ ka noombil nɛɔŋ maa yiɣi yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣu ni, ka maligumaana maa yo yili maa alahichi samli, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: Then he shall let the live bird fly away outside the city over the open fields. In this way he shall perform the ritual of purification for the house, and it will be ritually clean.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa labi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni na. Ka Judanim maa daa ka Giligal na ni bɛ ti tuh o soli n-zaŋ o du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: David started back and had gone as far as the Jordan River when he met the people of Judah. They had gathered at Gilgal and had come to help him cross the river.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra daa yɛli Barak, Yiɣisima! Yawɛ m-be a tooni mal a chana. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Yawɛ zaŋ Sisɛra niŋ a nuu ni. Di saha ka Barak daa yiɣisi ka tɔbbihi tuhi pia dol o ka bɛ yi Tabo Zoli zuɣu siɣi.
en: Then Deborah said to Barak, Go! The Lord is leading you! Today he has given you victory over Sisera. So Barak went down from Mount Tabor with his ten thousand men.

dag: Bom mɔɣu ni nimdi na ti duɣi n ni yuri bindir shɛli, ka n di ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni Yawɛ tooni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Bring me some game and make me some delicious food so I can eat, and I will bless you in the LORDs presence before I die.

dag: Ka a niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold border around it.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Ti Duuma, o yi gbihirimi dindina o ni nya alaafee.
en: They replied, Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.

dag: Yi tiŋ dunoli ti ku yo n-kpari yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa, dama tinzun nanim ni gari tooni n-zaŋ bɛ niriba ka bɛ ʒi bɛ daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.

dag: Ti suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la maŋmaŋ mini ti Duuma Yisa ni bɛ mali soli ti ti ka ti kana ti kaai ya.
en: We pray that our God and Father and our Lord Jesus will prepare the way for us to come to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa karim Naawuni zaligu din be litaafi maa ni, ka kahigi di ni yɛli shɛm wuhi. Bɛ daa wuhi di gbinni ka di chɛ ka niriba baŋ karimbu maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: They read aloud from the scroll, the Instruction from God, explaining and interpreting it so the people could understand what they heard.

dag: Ka Manɔa bɔh o, A yɛligu maa yi ti niŋ pali, bia maa biɛhigu ti yɛn nyɛla wula, ka tuun bɔ ka o lee ti yɛn tum.
en: Manoah said, Now when your words come true, what should be the rules for the boy and how he should act.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ liɣiri maa labisi ti o ma; ka o ma daa yihi di ni anzinfa kpila kɔbisiyi ti anzinfa doora, ka o daa zaŋ li mali anzinfa binnani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li zali Maika yiŋa.
en: So he gave the silver back to his mother, and she took two hundred pieces of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who used it for a sculpted image and a molded image. And they were placed in Micahs house.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee tum tuuni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ daa vihi di zuɣu hal ka so ti yɛli ba ni Gidiɔn Jɔash bia la n-tum tuuni maa.
en: They asked each other, Who did this? They searched and investigated, and finally they concluded, Gideon, Joashs son, did this.

dag: Baanabas daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pal o ka o mali yɛda pam. Ka niriba pam daa kpe ti Duuma jɛmbu ni pahi.
en: Barnabas responded in this way because he was a good man, whom the Holy Spirit had endowed with exceptional faith. A considerable number of people were added to the Lord.

dag: Ka Yisahaku mini Ishimail bɛn daa nyɛ o bidibisi la daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi Makipɛla siliga din daa be Zɔhar ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la bia Ɛfurɔn palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him east of Hebron in Machpelah Cave that was part of the field Abraham had bought from Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite. Abraham was buried there beside his wife Sarah.

dag: O daa niŋ li wuhi ya ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Then Jesus said, If you have ears, pay attention.

dag: Cham yaɣimɛra yiŋa ka n ti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis a nimaani.
en: Go down to the potter's house, where I will give you my message.

dag: Di chɛ ka karimbaannim zaŋ bɛ naba du n-tam n zuɣu nɔra bee n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaŋ bɛ nuhi kari ma.
en: Dont let the feet of arrogant people walk all over me; dont let the hands of the wicked drive me off.

dag: Yawɛ, saha shɛli a yi ti niŋ a niriba nirilim, nyin teemi n yɛla; saha shɛli a yi ti tiligi ba, nyin sɔŋm ma.
en: Remember me, Lord , when you help your people; include me when you save them.

dag: Bɛ sani binshɛli din nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ bin jɛmdili la zomla bɛn bɛn bi niŋ yɛda maa nina, ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku nya lahibal suŋ la neesim din kahigiri Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋmaŋ ŋmahinli ŋɔ jilima wuhiri la.
en: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.

dag: Ka Filip daa guui paag o sani nti wum ka o karindila Anabi Aizaia litaafi. Ka Filip bɔh o, A baŋ a ni karindi litaafi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: So he went toward the chariot, and he heard the man reading from Isaiah the prophet. Philip asked him, Do you understand what you are reading.

dag: Duhimaŋtali lihigu mini karimbaani suhu nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri firila, ka nyɛ alahichi.
en: Proud looks and proud thoughts are sins. They show a person is evil.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ni daa ti paai Hiburɔn na, Jɔab daa zaŋ o la niriba sunsuuni yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini ni o ti tɔɣis o ashili yɛtɔɣa, ka daa ti zaŋ sua n-kuh o pul ni ka o kpi nimaani. O daa ku o mi n-yo o mabia Asahɛl kubu la samli.
en: When Abner arrived at Hebron, Joab met him in the gateway, pulled him aside to talk in private, and then stabbed him in the stomach. So he got his revenge against Abner. Joab killed Abner because Abner had killed Joabs brother Asahel.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Then Jesus said to him, Dont tell anyone about what happened. But go and let the priest look at you. And offer the gift that Moses commanded for people who are made well. This will show everyone that you are healed.

dag: Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri ni o yi gbuɣinli gbaabu ni nti tuhi biŋkɔb so ŋun bie n-gari gbuɣinli soli bee nir yi kpe duu nti zaŋ o nuu dihi dukpini, ka wahu dim o la.
en: It will be like someone who runs from a lion and meets a bear! Or like someone who comes home and puts his hand on the wall—only to be bitten by a snake!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Jesus told him, Don't tell anyone about this, but go and show the priest that you are well. Then take a gift to the temple just as Moses commanded, and everyone will know that you have been healed.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba ti shihi ma, ka di yi niŋ lala, di ni wuhi ni n mal o la ansarisi maa; ka di ni chɛ ka o yɛli noli ti ma ka pa ni o niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: What if my father touches me and thinks Im making fun of him? I will be cursed instead of blessed.

dag: Ti yaannim daa jɛmdila Naawuni zol ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka yinim Yɛhudianim ti yɛri ni Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu shee.
en: My Samaritan ancestors worshiped God on this mountain, but you Jews say that Jerusalem is the place where we should worship God.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi di nya soli n-tuhi fa bindir shɛŋa bɛ dimnim ŋɔ sani di naan so, dama bɛ dii bi ku Filistianim maa pam zuŋɔ.
en: I wish you had eaten some of the food the Philistines left behind. We would have been able to kill a lot more of them.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛli, M mabihi, m bi mi ni o nyɛla maligumaaniba zuɣulana; dama di sabiya, Miri ka a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalim a zuliya zuɣulana. .
en: Paul said, Brothers, I did not know this man was the high priest. The Scriptures say, You must not say bad things about a leader of your people. .

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Gɛhaazi, Malim shili kpuɣi n jaaŋgbee ŋɔ chaŋ. A yi ti nya so sol ni, nyin di puh o; ka so yi puh a, nyin di saɣi. A yi ti paai, nyin zaŋmi n jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni.
en: Elisha said to Gehazi, Get ready, take my staff, and go! If you encounter anyone, dont stop to greet them. If anyone greets you, dont reply. Put my staff on the boys face.

dag: Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli, N nɔrila zuliya kam niriba kaman wain tiwala la, ka so bi sɔŋ ma. Ka n daa no ba ni suli mini suhuyiɣisili, ka bɛ ʒim varim m binyɛrigu ka di gabisi zaa.
en: I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Zadok mini Abiata daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kpalim be nimaani.
en: Zadok and Abiathar took the sacred chest back into Jerusalem and stayed there.

dag: Tinzunnim luri ma la sizuura; ka man dee yi kul yɛli shɛlikam ka bɛ wum, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: As soon as they heard about me, they were ready to obey. Those foreigners fall helpless before me!.

dag: N ni mali Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la tahima zuɣu ka n ʒe kpe ŋɔ saria karibu shee pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Now I am on trial because I believe the promise God made to our people long ago.

dag: Yawɛ ni yiɣisi tuhi kaman o ni daa niŋ shɛm Pɛrazim Zoli zuɣu mini Gibiɔn vinvamli ni la din ni chɛ ka o tum o ni lo ni o tum shɛm. O ni yɛn tum shɛli maa yi kul nyɛ yɛl saani kabo, o ni bahi tum o tuma din nyɛ alahiziba tuma maa naai.
en: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa wuhi ma nyɛvili kom mɔɣili, ka di zɔri yiri Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la gbin na n-doya nyaɣisiri kaman diɣi la.
en: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti ni me fɔntinsi kpe n-zaŋ ti bihi niŋ di ni, ka me buzɔna n-zaŋ ti piɛri mini ti buhi niŋ di ni.
en: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Ephraim was .

dag: Dauda ni daa kul yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Jɔnatan suhu dii gbaai Dauda, ka o daa yur o kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm.
en: Saul decided to take David with him. He would not let David go back home to his father. After David finished talking with Saul, Jonathan developed a strong friendship with David.

dag: Ka o tiba maa dii yooi, ka o zilinli lɛbigi ka o dii gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: At once, his ears opened, his twisted tongue was released, and he began to speak clearly.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o duhi ya, ka yi nyari paɣibu mini yudua ni jilima n-gari o ni nam zuliya shɛb zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ti niŋ zuliya kasi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ a binyɛrigu ni. Ka o zaŋ o nuu niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu gbaai li, ka di paligi zaa paratɛte kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: Next, the Lord commanded Moses, Put your hand inside your shirt. Moses obeyed, and when he took it out, his hand had turned white as snow—like someone with leprosy.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa nya malaika so ka o be alizanda sunsuuni yiɣiri ginda, ka mali lahibal suŋ din ka bahigu ni o yɛli niriba balibu kam mini dɔɣim kam ni zuliya balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima bɛn be dunia ni.
en: Then I saw another angel flying high overhead with eternal good news to proclaim to those who live on earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm din ni tooi kali sagbana? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbiligi zuɣusaa kom kola.
en: Who is wise enough to count the clouds and tilt them over to pour out the rain.

dag: Ti ba maa ni ka bidibisi maa zuɣu ka o yuli yɛn kpi o daŋ ni maa? Timiya ti ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ba maa mabihi sani.
en: to carry on his family name. But why should his name die out for that reason? Give us some land like the rest of his relatives in our clan, so our father's name can live on.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Kpalimmi kpe zuŋɔ yaha, ka n sa bah a ka a lab biɛɣuni. Ka Yuria daa kpalim Jɛrusalɛm dindali maa neei biɛɣu.
en: So David said, Then stay here the rest of the day, and tomorrow I'll send you back. So Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day and the next.

dag: ti lan zaɣisim a zaligunim maa yaha ka chaŋ ti kpuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din chihiri ŋɔ bipuɣinsi n-niŋ ti paɣiba? A ku je suli m-bahi ti yoli zaa kahikahi, ka chɛ ka ti ni so ku lan tiligi?.
en: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda lan ka saria karibu ni, amaa ŋunkam bi niŋ o yɛda, bɛ pun kar o saria, dilan ni bi niŋ Naawuni Bi gaŋ maa yɛda zuɣu.
en: People who believe in Gods Son are not judged guilty. But people who do not believe are already judged, because they have not believed in Gods only Son.

dag: N niriba, kpɛmiya yi duri ka yo yi dunoya. Sɔɣimiya ka di tooi biɛla ha, ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa saha gari.
en: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut your doors behind you. Take cover, for in a little while the fury will be over.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii dunɔguliba ŋɔ ka di doli bɛ zuɣulaannim ni nyɛ shɛm maa, bɛ gba daa malila bɛ tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman bɛ dɔɣiriba maa ni daa tumdi shɛm maa.
en: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.

dag: Dauda yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihita ka o naanyi di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi.
en: David was years old when he became king, and he ruled for forty years.

dag: Ŋuna n-damdi dunia ŋɔ di zaashee, ka di daantalisi sɔhira.
en: God sends earthquakes and shakes the ground; he rocks the pillars that support the earth.

dag: Ka Judianim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kabi chaŋ o sani nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: All the people from Judea, including everyone from Jerusalem, came out to John. They confessed the bad things they had done, and he baptized them in the Jordan River.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ o chaŋ luɣ shɛli maa ka o ti yɛn kpi. O nini ku lan nya o tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yaha.
en: Jehoahaz will die in the place where the Egyptians have taken him, and he will not see this land again.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli. Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba. Kuruchunim maa daa nyɛla kaman tusaayi laasabu.
en: He let them go, and the evil spirits went out of the man and entered the pigs. The whole herd—about two thousand pigs in all—rushed down the side of the cliff into the lake and was drowned.

dag: Jɔshua yi di daa chɛ ka Naawuni niriba nya vuhim Naawuni sani, dindina ŋun Naawuni daa naan ku lan tɔɣisi dabisi shɛli yɛla yaha.
en: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.

dag: Bɛ daa ba o bandi n-ti o naba biɛrim, ka zaŋ kuriti ga o nyiŋgol ni.
en: They tied a rope around his feet and put an iron ring around his neck.

dag: Zomiya ti soli zuɣu, ka di guriya ti soli. Di lan tɔɣisiriya ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa yɛla.
en: Stop seeing things that will really happen. Get out of our way. Stop telling us about the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Amaa sapashin kpɛm maa daa naɣ chɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛba ni bɛ maani tihi puri ka kɔra.
en: But he left in Judah some of the poorest people, who owned no property, and put them to work in the vineyards and fields.

dag: Ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu yi chɛ ka a kpee suhu miligi, dindina a bi doli yurilim soli. Di chɛ ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka Yisa Masia ni kpi a kpe so zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: If your brother or sister is upset by your food, you are no longer walking in love. Dont let your food destroy someone for whom Christ died.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum a daba bɛn nyɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ suhigu ka chɛ bɛ taali maa, ka wuhi ba so viɛl shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ka a chɛ ka saa mi a tiŋgban shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti a niriba ni bɛ su li ŋɔ ni.
en: So please listen in heaven to their prayer. Then forgive us for our sins. Teach the people to live right. Then, please send rain to the land you gave them.

dag: So nahu yi ʒe n-ti o kpee nahu daŋa ka o kpi, bɛn kɔhimi naɣ nɛɔŋ maa m-pirigi liɣiri maa ti taba, ka lan pirigi naɣ kpiŋ maa gba ti taba.
en: If one mans bull kills another mans bull, they should sell the bull that is alive. Both men will get half of the money that comes from selling the bull, and both men will also get half of the bull that was killed.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ bin suma ti bɛn suhir o li?.
en: As bad as you are, you know how to give good things to your children. How much more, then, will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask him!.

dag: N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu dihi niriba tusaanu la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛri pinaayi.
en: how many baskets of leftovers you picked up when I fed those , people with only five small loaves of bread? Yes, the disciples answered. There were twelve baskets.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili ŋme ma mi gari, ka a ni lu n zuɣu ka di mali dabiɛm shɛm bahi jahi ma.
en: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanania daa paai naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kabigi li.
en: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa maa di na kul bela n suhu ni, ka Ribɛka paana, ka o koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, ka o gari siɣi kɔbiliga maa ni ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma kom ka n nyu.
en: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi tamdi teebuli maa zuɣu n-zaani n tooni sahakam.
en: The table is to be placed in front of the Covenant Box, and on the table there is always to be the sacred bread offered to me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi wuhir o nyaandoliba maa yɛra, Faashee Daadam Bia nya wahala pam, ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa ti zaɣis o, ka chɛ ka bɛ ku o, amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: Then Jesus began to teach his disciples: The Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law. He will be put to death, but three days later he will rise to life.

dag: nti nya o yɛl o, Sokam kul lihiri bɔrila a shee.
en: And when they found him, they said, Everyone is looking for you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni maa, dama bɛ lihiri ka bi nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka bi baŋdi bɛ ni wumdi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: This is why I speak to the crowds in parables: although they see, they dont really see; and although they hear, they dont really hear or understand.

dag: ka di chɛ ka so ku tooi lan da shɛli bee n-kɔhi shɛli, shee o malila dalinli din nyɛ biŋkɔbigu maa yuli bee namba din ʒe o yuli zaani la.
en: No one could buy or sell without this mark.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛbihi ni ti laɣindi dira, ka gbuɣima ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman niɣi la, ka tinvura bindirigu ni nyɛla taŋkpaɣu. Bɛ ti ku lan dim so bee n-ku so n zoli din be kasi maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Bɛ nini yi ti nya bi shɛba n ni yɛn ti ba, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-tum lala maa, ka ti ma jilima ka lu man ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura.
en: When he sees his children among them, the work of my hands, proclaiming my name holy, they will make holy the holy one of Jacob, and stand in awe of Israels God.

dag: Dinzuɣu hal tiŋgbani yi damda, ka zoya vuuri ti luri teeku kɔbulli ni;.
en: So we will not be afraid, even if the earth is shaken and mountains fall into the ocean depths;.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaanu.
en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-five years.

dag: Hal n ni pa so dabili maa zaa yoli, n zaŋ mmaŋ leela sokam zaa dabili din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi niriba pahi.
en: I am a free man, nobody's slave; but I make myself everybody's slave in order to win as many people as possible.

dag: Di simdi ni a baŋ a biŋkɔbbaligu daalaafee ni nyɛ shɛm, ka lihi a niɣi viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: Look after your sheep and cattle as carefully as you can.

dag: Yisifu daa bol o bidib kpɛm yul la Manaasa dama o daa yɛlimi, Naawuni chɛ ka n tam n wahala la zaa mini n dɔɣiriba yɛla.
en: Joseph named the oldest son Manasseh, because, he said, God has helped me forget all of my troubles and everyone in my fathers household.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chani baɣisi mini bukpahinim bɛn sɔɣiri yɛr la sani ni bɛ ti yɛl a a zuɣu ni yɛlli? Miri ka a wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛri shɛli maa. Ŋun ne ni tooi vihi baŋ o zuɣu ni yɛlli kpiimba sani? A bi bɔhir a Naawuni?.
en: The people will say, Go to the fortunetellers and wizards who mumble and chirp like birds. Ask them what to do. But I say, Shouldnt people go to their God for help? Why go to the dead to get help for the living.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Ka di sambani mini di duu ni goma wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: Then the man measured the Temple. The Temple was cubits long. The restricted area, including the building and its walls, was also cubits long.

dag: Di yuma anahi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa chaŋ ti yɛli naa, Naa, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka n chaŋ Hiburɔn nti pali n ni daa lo Yawɛ alikauli shɛli nimaani.
en: Four years later, Absalom said to David, Please, let me go to Hebron. I have to keep a promise that I made to the Lord .

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anu, ka n nya bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni yɛligu mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu zuɣu la shihi bimbini gbini.
en: The Lamb opened the fifth seal. Then I saw some souls under the altar. They were the souls of those who had been killed because they were faithful to Gods message and to the truth they had received.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti wum ka Filip yihi Naawuni nam mini Yisa Masia yuli waazu maa ka bɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: But Philip told the people the Good News about Gods kingdom and the power of Jesus Christ. Men and women believed Philip and were baptized.

dag: Ŋun pah ata n-daa nyɛ Absalom ŋun ma daa nyɛ Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛshur naa Talimai bipuɣiŋga la, ŋun pah anahi n-daa nyɛ Adɔnija ŋun ma daa nyɛ Hagit la.
en: The third son was Absalom. His mother was Maacah, daughter of Talmai. Talmai was the king of Geshur. The fourth son was Adonijah. His mother was Haggith.

dag: N zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuma zaa yɛla, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuun kara yɛla.
en: I will meditate on all your works; I will ponder your deeds.

dag: Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli lan yɛli, Bɛ ni ti lihiri bɛ ni daa zaŋ kpani kuhi so la.
en: and They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: Ive sent him for this reason—so that you will know about us. He can reassure you.

dag: N ni tɔɣis a zaligunim maa yɛla nanim tooni, ka ku zo vi.
en: I will talk about your laws before rulers with no shame whatsoever.

dag: Ŋuna n-yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa n-wuhi di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm n-zaŋ li tari ba; ka bɛ kul su li sahakam, ka be di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: God decided what he should do with them, and then he chose a place for them. He drew a line and showed them their land. So the animals will own that land forever. They will live there year after year.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma nyɛla jɛmbu tuma mini ʒiʒibo.
en: They shall be responsible for carrying the following objects:.

dag: Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: God never said to any of his angels: Sit here at my right side until I put your enemies as a footstool under your feet.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ninsalitali yubu ku tooi tiɣi Naawuni nini.
en: People who are self-centered arent able to please God.

dag: N Naawuni, n Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ ma bahi? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a be katiŋ ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu n ŋuhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha.
en: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi Ijipti na ka nyɛ bɛn paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana bɛ so nini ku nya n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la; dama bɛ bi doli ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: None of the people who came from Egypt and are years old or older will be allowed to see this land. I made a promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I promised to give this land to these people, but they did not really follow me.

dag: dindina yi m-baŋmiya ni Naawuni n-zaŋ ma niŋ chirimbu maa ni, ka chɛ ka o zana gbaai ma maa.
en: know then that God has wronged me and enclosed his net over me.

dag: Hal o ni fa bɛn mali taali bahi. Dinzuɣu yihim daɣiri a kɔbili ni ka o tilig a.
en: He will deliver the guilty; they will be saved by your pure hands.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya ti ti bɛ suɣa zali gbilligbilli nuzaa polo. Dan zuliya niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza.
en: The flag of Dans camp will be on the north side. The tribes of Dan will camp there. The leader of the tribe of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka a chɛ ka bɛ bo naɣilabila mini sara maligu zim viɛlli shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri, ka a mi bo naɣilabil so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o daalibarika yi Ziɔn na paai ya.
en: May the Lord , who made heaven and earth, bless you from Zion!.

dag: Ka n daa na kul suhiri Naawuni, ka kahigiri m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka balindi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni o chɛ ka o Jɛmbu du kasi la lan me n-zali yaha.
en: While I was still speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sins of my people Israel—while I was still praying my prayer for help to the LORD my God about my Gods holy mountain.

dag: ni Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa diri ʒi Hɛshibɔn la tin kara zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Ammɔnim tintariga.
en: It went as far as the border of Ammon and included all the cities that had been ruled by the Amorite king Sihon, who had ruled at Heshbon.

dag: Ka binshɛli din ŋmani buɣim zilima puhi yina nti tamtam bɛ zaa yinoyino zuɣu ni ti kpa.
en: Then they saw what looked like tongues of fire which spread out and touched each person there.

dag: Ka a yi lan ko puu tiŋgbani maa ni, di bindira ku lan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. A ni leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: If you try to grow crops, the soil will not produce anything; you will be a homeless wanderer on the earth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Atad kabɔɣili din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la shee, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum nandahima kumsi nimaani; ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daba ayopɔin kum o ba kuli nimaani.
en: They went to Goren Atad, east of the Jordan River. There they had a long funeral service for Israel, which continued for seven days.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti ni yɛli ni a nyɛla Samaria nira ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi a zuɣu la, di pala yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Jewish opposition answered, We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and have a demon, werent we.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m birini mini n yurilim din bi naara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini n tiligira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani. O nyaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: He loves me and protects me. He is my safe place high on the mountain. He rescues me. He is my shield. I trust in him. He helps me rule my people.

dag: N zaŋla tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni sinnamɔn tulaalɛnim la mihi li.
en: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

dag: Kalima anahi maa zaa kɔtomsi daa nyɛla yim, ka be kaman kalinli yini kpe n-gabila di kpee ni.
en: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it.

dag: bɔ n-lee nyɛ ninsalinima ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla bee daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be bɛ ni?.
en: And I wonder, Why are people so important to you? Why do you even think about them? Why do you care so much about humans ? Why do you even notice them.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi Firawuna sani chaŋ, ka Musa daa ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ zaŋ chaŋ poloya maa polo kaman o mini Firawuna ni daa saɣi shɛm maa.
en: Then Moses and Aaron left the king, and Moses prayed to the Lord to take away the frogs which he had brought on the king.

dag: Masia yɛlimaŋli din be n ni la zuɣu, binshɛli kani din ni tooi yihi barinyubo shɛli din be n ni ŋɔ Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinsi ni.
en: Since Christs truth is in me, I wont stop telling the entire area of Greece that Im proud of what I did.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi gbarigira. Hal ti niŋgbuna yi filinda, ti suhuri ni biɛhigu din kul leerila zaɣ pala biɛɣukam.
en: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.

dag: ni o chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali zani dɛde daadam mini Naawuni sani kaman nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee la.
en: let him plead with God for a human being, like a person pleads for a friend.

dag: A chɛ ka n dolintab kaɣiri ma mi, a chɛ ka n leela bɛ ni zaɣisi so. Bɛ kpari ma mi niŋ duu, ka n ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: You made my friends leave me. They all avoid me like someone no one wants to touch. Like a prisoner in my house, I cannot go out.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri bɛ tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni nya bindirigu pam, amaa bɛn doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Farmers who work their land have plenty of food, but those who waste their time on worthless projects are foolish.

dag: Ka zuliya tital dini n-lee beni m-mali zalikpana mini zaligunim din pahi ka wuntizɔbo be di ni kaman n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: Or does any great nation have regulations and case laws as righteous as all this Instruction that I am setting before you today?.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yiɣisi chaŋ Naa Sulemaana sani ni o ti tɔɣis o di yɛtɔɣa ti Adɔnija. Ka naa daa yiɣisi ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa, ka lab ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ na nti ti naa ma ka o ʒin o nudirigu polo.
en: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to talk with him about Adonijah. The king stood up to meet her and bowed low to her. Then he returned to his throne and had a throne set up for the queen mother. She sat to his right.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tirila yinim bɛn zaa be Rom n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka boli ya ni yi leeg o ninvuɣ gahinda la: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: To those in Rome who are dearly loved by God and called to be Gods people. Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ti Ijipti n-zaŋ ti na ti niŋ luɣ shɛli din bi viɛli ŋɔ? Luɣ shɛŋa nir ni yɛn biri chi bee n-sa fiig tihi bee n-sa wain tihi bee n-sa pumpɔrinchihi tihi kani, ka kom gba kani ka ti ni nyu.
en: Why have you led us up from Egypt to bring us to this evil place without grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates? And theres no water to drink.

dag: Chɛ ka o be n-yuui kaman wuntaŋ mini goli ni be shɛm ŋɔ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Let the king live as long as the sun, as long as the moon, generation to generation.

dag: Niriba pam mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam ni ti ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.

dag: Naawuni, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu ŋɔ; di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: God, hear my prayer. Dont ignore my cry for help.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa gba daa lan beni yaha. Dina n-nyɛ: Ain mini Rimɔn ni Ɛta ni Ashan: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara anahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: There were also Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan: four cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yɛrigi nuzaa polo sagbana limsi vau, ka daa bi zaŋ dunia ŋɔ yili binshɛli.
en: He stretched the North over chaos, hung earth over nothing.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Dama di chɛ biɛla ka bɛ lab ma kuɣa.
en: So Moses cried out to the LORD, What should I do with this people? They are getting ready to stone me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi nya ma ka m mini so ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni bee ka n tuɣindi niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bee Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni bee tiŋ maa puuni.
en: These Jews who are accusing me did not find me arguing with anyone at the Temple or making trouble with the people. And I was not making trouble or arguing in the synagogues or any other place in the city.

dag: Ka kokpɛɣu din galisi pam maa daa kul kpɛri pahiri hal ti paai biɛɣu pihinahi, ka kom maa kul zoori pahira, ka kpuɣi ŋariŋ maa zuɣusaa, ka di du ka chɛ tiŋgbani.
en: The flood remained on the earth for forty days. The waters rose, lifted the ark, and it rode high above the earth.

dag: Ka Iso daa yɛl o, Malim shili ka m min a doli kuli.
en: Then Esau said, Now you can continue your journey. I will go with you.

dag: O daa tiligi shɛba, ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa. O nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa. To, o siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti niŋ o yɛda.
en: He saved others, but he cannot save himself! Isn't he the king of Israel? If he will come down off the cross now, we will believe in him!.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfo ni Onam.
en: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn bi zɔri vi ŋɔ, laɣimmiya taba.
en: Gather together and assemble yourselves, shameless nation.

dag: Yisa mini Pita ni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa ti paai Yisa nyaandol bɛn la sani nya ka salo pam n-laɣim gil ba, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib ŋmɛr o nyaandoliba maa naŋgbankpeeni.
en: When they joined the rest of the disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and some teachers of the Law arguing with them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya ka Naa Dauda kul wari waa, ka yiɣiri jamdi Yawɛ tooni, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Dauda o suhu ni.
en: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing for the Lord , she was disgusted.

dag: Mani yi Duuma NAAWUNI kul pala n nini lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, n ni di bɛ nyɛviya dunia ŋɔ ni. Amaa n ku di Yaakubu daŋ niriba zaa nyɛviya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord GOD is watching this sinful kingdom. The Lord says, I will wipe Israel off the face of the earth, but I will never completely destroy Jacobs family.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpahi niriba ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo, ka Yisa daa be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: There they nailed Jesus to the cross. They also nailed two other men to crosses. They put them on each side of Jesus with him in the middle.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: Go in peace, the king said. So Absalom left and went to Hebron.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn darigiri bɛ tibili saha shɛli maa ti yɛn nyɛla o niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgɔna mini mɔɣilɔnim saha shɛli. Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni tuhi Asirianim maa.
en: And every crack that is made in the foundation wall, which the LORD will bring down upon him, will be accompanied by timbrels and lyres. The LORD will raise his arm and fight against Assyria in battle.

dag: Fɔntinsi zaa din daa be tintan ni mini Giliad zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ni Salɛka ni Ɛdirɛi, fɔn shɛŋa din daa be Bashan Naa Ogi nam sulinsi ni la.
en: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled.

dag: ka Naawuni daa sɔŋ ba ka bɛ nyaŋ Hagirinim mini bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu maa zaa. Dama bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni yɛda ka suh o ni o sɔŋ ba tɔb maa ni.
en: they received help against them. The Hagrites and all who were with them were handed over to them, because they cried out to God in battle. God granted their prayer because they trusted in him.

dag: A ni ti yɛn diri bindir shɛli tibisim ti yɛn nyɛla giram kɔbisiyi ni pihita dahin yini kam. A ni ti diri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a di li saha shɛli.
en: At fixed times you will eat your food by weight, fourteen ounces a day.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli maa duya gari sagbana, ka a ʒiɛyimtali chaŋ hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.

dag: Yaakubu daa zo n-kuli Mɛsopoteemia, nimaani ka o daa tum tuma paɣ zuɣu; o daa gulila biŋkɔbiri ni di yo o paɣ kpuɣibu samli.
en: Jacob ran away to the land of Aram. There Israel worked for a wife. He kept sheep to get another wife.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ma ni n wuhim ya zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka yi ti gbib li yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa ni.
en: At that time, the LORD commanded me to teach you all the regulations and the case laws that you must keep in the land that you are entering to possess.

dag: Yɛm be Yawɛ sizuura lubu ni. Yawɛ kukoli tahiri yɛri tiŋ maa: Wummiya, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn laɣim be tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The voice of the LORD calls out to the city; wisdom appears when one fears your name. Hear, tribe, and who appointed her!.

dag: hal niriba ata maa yi di beni, hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko n-naan tiligi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and even if those three men lived there—as surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God—they would not be able to save even their children, but only their own lives.

dag: Ka yɛl o nyaandola maa mi, N-nyɛ a ma! Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka nyaandola maa daa zaŋ Yisa ma maa mali kul o yiŋa.
en: Then he said to the disciple, Here is your mother. And from that time on, this disciple took her into his home.

dag: ni zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbihi ni sariakaritiba ni anabinima ni baɣisi ni kpamba.
en: He will take away all the heroes and soldiers. He will take away all the judges, the prophets, the fortunetellers, and the elders.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla faralana, nyin di chɛ ka o chinchin shɛli a ni deei sɔŋ maa gbe a sani.
en: If he is a poor man, then he might give the clothes that keep him warm . You must not keep that security overnight.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli noli ti tikpiralana bee n-zaŋ kuɣili sɔŋ zom tooni ni o tuui li, amaa zom a Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not curse the deaf or put something in front of the blind so as to make them stumble over it. Obey me; I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ram daa nyɛla Aminadab ba, ka Aminadab daa nyɛ Nashɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Juda bidibisi ni asanza nir la ba.
en: Ram was Amminadabs father, and Amminadab was Nahshons father. Nahshon was the leader of the people of Judah.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka di mi pala bindirigu kum bee kɔnyuri, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu kum.
en: The days are surely coming, says the LORD God, when I will send hunger and thirst on the land; neither a hunger for bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the LORD s words.

dag: Di dinya buɣa maligu nimdi mini binʒim ni jifa; yi mi di niŋya zina. Yi yi gbaai yimaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim niŋbu, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. Naawuni sɔŋmi ya.
en: refuse food offered to idols, blood, the meat from strangled animals, and sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid such things. Farewell.

dag: A mi n yibu saha ni n dɔnibu saha, ka mi n soya zaa.
en: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam daa kpuɣ kuɣili din ŋmani nɛ titali m-bahi teeku puuni ha ka yɛra, Lala ka nyin Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ ti shiri yɛn lu n-wurim zaa, ka so ti ku lan mi a zaashee yaha!.
en: Then a powerful angel picked up a large rock. This rock was as big as a large millstone. The angel threw the rock into the sea and said, That is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down. It will never be found again.

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa naai, o daa chaŋ ti dula daboli zuɣu.
en: When the prophetic frenzy was over, Saul went home.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-ni be nimaani. Ka viri mini taatahi kpe m-be bɛ yinsi; ka mɔɣu ni buhi be nimaani n-yiɣiri jamda.
en: Wildcats will rest there; houses will be filled with owls. Ostriches will live there, and goat demons will dance there.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pii wun pala la, di saha ka tɔbu daa be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋuni n-daa lee mali nyɔtaɣirigu bee kpani?.
en: When they chose new gods, then war came to the city gates. Yet there wasnt a shield or spear to be seen among forty thousand in Israel!.

dag: Ka yi suhi yi Naawuni maa, ka n gba suhi Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so ŋun chɛ ka buɣim taai nimdi maa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka Niriba maa zaa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla.
en: Prophets of Baal, pray to your god, and I will pray to the Lord . Whichever god answers the prayer and starts the fire is the true God. All the people agreed that this was a good idea.

dag: Lɔt daa ti yɛn paai Zɔa, ka wuntaŋ pun puhimi.
en: The sun was rising when Lot reached Zoar.

dag: A paɣiba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a nayili bihi bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni wumd a yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Your wives and officers are very fortunate, because they serve you and hear your wisdom every day.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yi samban ni ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa n-kali saŋmarisi, a yi ni tooi kali ba. Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Lala ka a zuliya ti yɛn be.
en: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said, Look at the sky and see if you can count the stars. That's how many descendants you will have.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino kpuɣim o labila, ka di kalinli yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka yi niŋ tulaale zim niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ka Yawɛ tooni na. Ka a gba mini Aduna gbibi yi tulaale lahi.
en: Each of you will take his fire pan, put incense on it, and then present it at the altar.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha na kul bi bahi tiɣi n nini, ka di daliri nyɛla n ni na kul nyari Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la ka o ʒiini nayili dunol ni la.
en: But all this means nothing to me. I cannot be happy as long as I see that Jew Mordecai sitting at the kings gate.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-tɛhi ni dabisi shɛli so di kpee, ka so mi beni n-tɛhi ni dabisa zaa nyɛla yim. Chɛliya ka sokam doli o ni tɛhi shɛm omaŋmaŋ suhu ni.
en: One person considers some days to be more sacred than others, while another person considers all days to be the same. Each person must have their own convictions.

dag: Musa ni daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa niŋ kundi ni naai zaa.
en: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book.

dag: Lan zaŋm bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam mini di binnyura sara zuɣu.
en: And in addition to the daily burnt offering with its wine offering, offer one male goat as a sin offering.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa zab nyuli n-chaŋ ti laɣim tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ yoya n-chɛ ka bɛ dam tiŋ maa, ka chaŋ ti be n-gili Jeesɔn yiŋa n-yɛli ni bɛ yihim Pool mini Silas palɔni na ti ba.
en: But the Jews became jealous and brought along some thugs who were hanging out in the marketplace. They formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They attacked Jasons house, intending to bring Paul and Silas before the people.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli, Yawɛ n-tim ma na ni n ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mini tiŋ ŋɔ yi ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the rulers of Judah and all the other people. He said, The Lord sent me to say these things about this Temple and this city. Everything that you have heard is from the Lord.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: King Rehoboam made more shields to put in their places, but they were made from bronze. He gave them to the guards on duty at the palace gates.

dag: Bɛ na mi m-be kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri mɔ shɛŋa ka be kaman wurigu ka pɔhim ʒe n-chaŋ la?.
en: and blow them away like straw in the wind, or like dust carried away in a storm?.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣis o, ka nahim o, amaa ka o bi yaag o noli. Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi chaŋ kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛbil chani kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛɣu kɔbiri ka o fo shɛm la. O daa bi yaag o noli.
en: He was treated harshly, but endured it humbly; he never said a word. Like a lamb about to be slaughtered, like a sheep about to be sheared, he never said a word.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe Omri nyaaŋa daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe Ginat bia Tibini nyaaŋa, ka Tibini daa kpi; ka Omri leei naa.
en: But Omris followers were stronger than the followers of Tibni son of Ginath. Tibni died, and Omri became king.

dag: A nyɛvoya ni pɔhim daa kahi kom duhi, ka kɔgbana daa yiɣisi zani zuɣusaa, ka teeku bulli maa sunsuuni daa kpaŋ diɣinli.
en: You blew on the sea and the water piled up high; it stood up straight like a wall; the deepest part of the sea became solid.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa gbaŋŋmara daa gooi salo maa ka yɛli, Ɛfɛsusnima, ŋuni n-lee beni n-ʒi ni Ɛfɛsusnim nyɛla bɛn guli buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun galisi ŋɔ duu mini kuɣ shɛli din daa yi zuɣusaa luna la?.
en: The city manager brought order to the crowd and said, People of Ephesus, doesnt everyone know that the city of Ephesus is guardian of the temple of the great Artemis and of her image, which fell from heaven?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim bɛn daa be o sani maa na nti piripiri ba, ka niriba tuhili kam bee niriba kɔbiga kam mali di sapashin kpɛma.
en: Then David gathered the troops who were with him and appointed unit commanders over thousands and hundreds.

dag: Kpalimmi be n sani, ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o ku ma m-bɔri ni o ku a gba maa; a yi be n sani shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Stay with me. Dont be afraid, because the man who tried to kill you is the same man who wants to kill me. I will protect you if you stay with me.

dag: Ka a yi ti wum niriba napɔna vubu balisam tihi maa zuɣu, di saha nyin lirim ba, dama man Naawuni n-daŋ a tooni ni n ti nyaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa.
en: When you hear the sound of marching in the treetops, then attack, because I will be marching ahead of you to defeat the Philistine army.

dag: M pun nya ka binshɛɣukam zaa viɛlim malila tariga, amaa a zaligunim din viɛlim nyɛla din ka tariga.
en: Everything has its limits, except your commands.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli. N ni yɛli ni yi yɛla be n suhu ni la nyɛla din yi Yisa Masia maŋmaŋ suhu ni na.
en: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Cham ti bol a yidan na.
en: Jesus told her, Go and bring your husband.

dag: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa duɣuri mini di lahi zaa zaŋ tabili di kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi zaa ti nyɛ daanya binyɛra.
en: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard.

dag: Ka Ɛlizabɛt dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka o dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When Elizabeth's son was born.

dag: . O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa. Ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka boli ba ninsalinima saha shɛl o ni daa nam ba maa.
en: He created them male and female, blessed them, and named them Human Beings.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ shiri yɛn niŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku doo ŋɔ.
en: Then the troops repeated to him what they had been saying. So thats what will be done for the man who kills him, they said.

dag: Dauda ni daa yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Sool bɔhi, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Sool daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: As soon as David finished saying all this to Saul, Saul said, David, my son, is that your voice? Then he broke down in tears.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli.
en: The commander told him he could speak, so Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the people. When they were quiet, he spoke to them in Aramaic:.

dag: Nam zuɣupiligu yi ti zuɣu ni lu. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti tum alahichi.
en: The crown has fallen off our head. We are doomed because we have sinned.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pinaayopɔin dali, ka ŋariŋ maa daa kana ti tam Ararat Zoli zuɣu.
en: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month the boat came to rest on a mountain in the Ararat range.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu yul o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, Yinim bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla yi dini.
en: Jesus looked at his followers and said, Great blessings belong to you who are poor. Gods kingdom belongs to you.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o laɣim bɛn bi ʒe yim ni.
en: The master of those servants would come on a day when they werent expecting him, at a time they couldnt predict. The master will cut them into pieces and assign them a place with the unfaithful.
