dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti lan tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka fa Gaat mini di tiŋkpansi zaa Filistianim maa sani.
en: Later, David attacked and defeated the Philistines. He captured their town of Gath and the nearby villages.

dag: ka di be o sani, ka o karindi li dabisili kam o biɛhigu ni din ni chɛ ka o bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu ŋɔ ni mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: That Instruction must remain with him, and he must read in it every day of his life so that he learns to revere the LORD his God by keeping all the words of this Instruction and these regulations, by doing them.

dag: M mabiyurisi, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ. Di simdi ni sokam wumdi yomyom, ka gbaam omaŋa o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni, ka mi di jɛri suli yomyom.
en: Remember this, my dear friends! Everyone must be quick to listen, but slow to speak and slow to become angry.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, wummi dimbɔŋɔ, zanimi tɛhi Naawuni daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.

dag: Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni ka gbib ya;.
en: The LORD bless you and protect you.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni ti mali pal yaɣu. Nuzaa polo, di ni ti nyɛla mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka nudirigu polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulimpuhili polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulinluhili polo gba nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu.
en: and an open area meters wide will surround the city.

dag: Naawuni, n niŋ a naani zaa; n shiri niŋ a naani zaa! N ni yili yila ni kukoli nyaɣisili niŋ a.
en: I have complete confidence, O God; I will sing and praise you!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ nabia Jɔash n-yina ti booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam; ka zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o; ka zaŋ Naawuni kundi ti o; ka bɛ kpahi bɛ nuhi ka yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, Long live the king.

dag: Gɛrishom daa nyɛla Finɛhas daŋ zuɣulana, ka Daniɛl nyɛ Itama daŋ zuɣulana, ka Hatush.
en: of the family of Phinehas, Gershom; of Ithamar, Daniel; of David, Hattush.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni wuh a Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ʒii maa wuhirila di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yɛla maa naabu saha.
en: and said, I am showing you what the result of God's anger will be. The vision refers to the time of the end.

dag: Dauda yɛligu din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim zaa bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana.
en: Davids last instructions were to count the Levites years old and above.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔŋ ma, bɛmaŋ ka bɛ tum barina maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je ma nyɛla bɛn yuri kum.
en: Those who do not find me hurt themselves; anyone who hates me loves death.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa lɛbila ninsala m-be ti sani, ka anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli pal o kɔbili ni. Ka ti nya o jilima shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Bi gaŋ ŋun yi o Ba sanna jilima.
en: The Word became a human being and lived here with us. We saw his true glory, the glory of the only Son of the Father. From him the complete gifts of undeserved grace and truth have come down to us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani n-nya luɣ shɛli ʒini ni bɛ gbe Gibia, dama so daa bi zaŋ ba ti kpɛh o yiŋa ni bɛ gbe.
en: They turned in to enter there, so they could spend the night in Gibeah, and he went and sat down in the city square. But no one offered to take them home to spend the night.

dag: Bɛ ni laɣindi piriŋkpana nyɔri buɣim shɛm la, lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali.
en: Weeds are gathered and burned. That's how it will be at the end of time.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu, dilana kpɛhil o paɣ maa zina niŋbu ni, ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣ paɣiyihiŋ maa gba niŋ zina.
en: But I tell you that any man who divorces his wife, except for the problem of sexual sin, is causing his wife to be guilty of adultery. And whoever marries a divorced woman is guilty of adultery.

dag: Yawɛ, n je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a. N ʒiɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpɛhir a nini.
en: Lord , I hate those who hate you. I hate those who are against you.

dag: Ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal maa daa bi dɔɣi bia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Michal never had any children.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa bɔri ni bɛ zahim o, ka yɛl o ni o wuhim ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: Others wanted to trap Jesus, so they asked him to perform a miracle to show that God approved of him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa labiri kuna ka Yisa doli ba. O ni daa ti miri sapashini maa yiŋa ka sapashini maa lan tim o zɔnim Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni o di nahim omaŋa, dama ni ŋun sapashini maa pɔri ni Yisa ka o yiŋ na.
en: So Jesus went with them. He was coming near the officers house when the officer sent friends to say, Lord, you dont need to do anything special for me. I am not good enough for you to come into my house.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa.
en: This is the message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah and all the people of Jerusalem:.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ o leei n niriba zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o nam kul beni sahakam.
en: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.

dag: Biɛɣu daa yi neei, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka sagban daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-wuhiri ba soli, yuŋ mi daa yi ti zibi, o chɛrimi ka buɣim daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-ne ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ chani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: During the day the Lord went ahead of his people in a thick cloud, and during the night he went ahead of them in a flaming fire. That way the Lord could lead them at all times, whether day or night.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Pa ninvuɣ pia n-di kpaŋ maa? Ka niriba awɛi la, bɛn kpalim ya?.
en: Jesus spoke up, There were ten who were healed; where are the other nine?.

dag: Chɛ ka a neesim min a yɛlimaŋli kana; ka chɛ ka di wuhi ma soli n-zaŋ ma tahi a zoli din be kasi ka nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: Send your light and your truth to guide me, to lead me to your holy mountain, to your home.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kɔri naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin mali sara, Naawuni ni daa sɔŋ ba maa zuɣu.
en: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zuliya bɔbili sunsuuni; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: Thats why I thank you, LORD, in the presence of the nations. Thats why I sing praises to your name.

dag: Kopaliga zaŋ ba guui yomyom, ka noli di bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛli, ka so napɔŋ bi lan no bɛ wain tihi puri ni yaha.
en: The wicked are swept away by floods, and the land they own is under God's curse; they no longer go to work in their vineyards.

dag: Ti chamiya ʒiishee ka yi ti wuhi ma yi ni zaŋ ma taali shɛli zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi tɔɣisi wuhi ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli na.
en: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.

dag: A mali tumtumdiba pam; kuɣikpɛriba mini tammɛriba ni kapintanima ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim balibu kam zaa tumtumdiba bɛn ka kalinli.
en: You have many workers. There are stonecutters to work in the quarries, and there are masons and carpenters, as well as a large number of skilled workers of every sort who can work.

dag: Dauda ni daa yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Sool bɔhi, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Sool daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: David, my son—is that you? Saul asked. Then he started crying.

dag: Lala ka o daa yih o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ daa yiini yila.
en: God brought his people out with rejoicing, his chosen ones with songs of joy.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nya ti ni be yɛlimuɣisir shɛl ni. Jɛrusalɛm lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di n-saɣim di dunɔdaya. Dinzuɣu kamiyana ka ti lan lab me di gooni maa din ni chɛ ka ti yi vi shɛl ni ti ni be maa.
en: But now I said to them, See what trouble we are in because Jerusalem is in ruins and its gates are destroyed! Let's rebuild the city walls and put an end to our disgrace.

dag: Yi ni ŋmaligi yomyom ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun boli ya Masia daalibarika puuni, ka lan ŋmaligi n-doli lahibal sun shɛli din be di ko ka chɛ Masia lahibal suŋ la yɛla gari ma pam.
en: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message.

dag: Nyamiya ti Ba Naawuni ni yu ti yurilim shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o bol ti ŋun Naawuni bihi; ka lala n-shiri nyɛ ti. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim bi mi ti, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni bi mi o la zuɣu.
en: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa doli vinvamli ni yuŋ maa n-yuuni nimaani polo chani ka yuuni gooni maa. Ka n daa lan ŋmaligi doli Vinvamli Dunɔdal la labi.
en: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.

dag: Ka n yi bi mi tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli gbinni, dindina n nyɛla tinzun nira ŋun tɔɣisiri li maa sani, ka o gba nyɛ tinzun nira n sani.
en: But if I do not know the language being spoken, those who use it will be foreigners to me and I will be a foreigner to them.

dag: ka di ti pali, ka bɛ vo li duhi dul na nti ʒini n-gahim zin suma niŋ piɛri ni ka zaŋ zaɣ biɛri bahi.
en: When it was full, they pulled it to the shore, where they sat down and put the good fish together into containers. But the bad fish they threw away.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ ŋun ka taali ŋɔ zaa yoli mmaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛn wuhi ni m mali taali. Hal n kul ka galimi maa zaa yoli ŋuna n-ni wuhi ni n kul bela galimi ni.
en: I am innocent and faithful, but my words sound guilty, and everything I say seems to condemn me.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Obɛdɛdom bidibisi. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ mabihi daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim, ka simdi ni bɛ tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Obɛdɛdom daŋ maa ni niriba.
en: All these were members of Obed-edoms family, they, their sons, and their relatives. They were valiant and strong in their service, men belonging to Obed-edom.

dag: O daa yi ʒiinila Dɛbɔra dɔbino tia din be Rama mini Bɛtɛl sunsuuni Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ la ni gbini, ka Izraɛlnim chan o sani ka o ti kariti bɛ yɛla saria tiri ba.
en: She would sit under Deborah's Palm Tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, where Israelites would come and ask her to settle their legal cases.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi mali yi yaa nyuri bara? Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, yi yaa naarimi maa. Yi niŋ yi daazichi naani ka yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi liri ti.
en: Why do you brag about your strength? Your strength is exhausted, you rebellious daughter. You trust in your treasures, never imagining who would attack you.

dag: Saawara niŋbu yi kani, nia lɔbu bi paana, amaa saawaranim pam yi beni, bɛ dirila nasara.
en: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka chɛchɛbuŋ maa zani; ka o mini Filip zaa yi n-chaŋ ti siɣi kom maa ni, ka Filip baptaiz o.
en: He ordered that the carriage halt. Both Philip and the eunuch went down to the water, where Philip baptized him.

dag: Di lan simdi ni a pii kpambal shɛb ka bɛ su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tuma fukumsi, ka bɛ ti laɣim bindira pirigibu bunu puuni yim zuɣu zali bindira ni ti yɛn niŋ pam yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni la.
en: Then you should choose other men to collect food from the people. During the seven good years, the people must give them one-fifth of all the food they grow.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi, a yuli m-booni Pita; tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yɛn me n cheechi tam hal ka kum mini di yiko ti ku tooi wurim li.
en: And so I tell you, Peter: you are a rock, and on this rock foundation I will build my church, and not even death will ever be able to overcome it.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka alɔbo din daa lu Ijiptinim zuɣu la tatabo lu yi zuɣu; ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi nachimba; ka gbahi yi yuri zaa chaŋ; ka chɛ ka yi sansan ni nyo luɣiluɣi kpɛri ya; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I sent diseases against you, as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with swords. I took away your horses. I made your camp smell very bad from all the dead bodies, but still you didnt come back to me for help. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni. Doliya n zalikpana la, ka gbibiya n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I am the LORD your God! Follow my regulations! Observe my case laws and do them!.

dag: A mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl daŋ kam dunoli dɔɣirikpamba niŋmi bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa din nyɛ ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri maa na laasabu.
en: You, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders should count all the prisoners, animals, and everything the soldiers took in war.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa garigi bɔhi Yawɛ, Ayuba Naawuni zɔbo maa nyɛla yoli?.
en: The Adversary answered the LORD, Does Job revere God for nothing?.

dag: ka ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la mini bɛnkam pahi bɛ zuɣu binshɛlikam din daa niŋ maa zaa yɛla.
en: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and some other women were the ones who had gone to the tomb. When they returned, they told the eleven apostles and the others what had happened.

dag: O ni daa kuni maa, ka o yiŋbihi tuh o sol na ti yɛl o, A bia la kpaŋya.
en: On his way home his servants met him with the news, Your boy is going to live.

dag: Daliri dini zuɣu ka ti lee ni nyu bara? Daliri shɛli kani. Bɔ n-niŋ ka di kani? Ti ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu? Aai! Di nyɛla ti ni niŋ yɛda la zuɣu!.
en: So do we have any reason to boast about ourselves? No reason at all. And why not? Because we are depending on the way of faith, not on what we have done in following the law.

dag: Ka so daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigila Absalom polo.
en: A messenger came to David, reporting, The hearts of the Israelites have gone over to Absalom.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ teer a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni. Dinzuɣu niriba ni ti paɣir a sahakam.
en: My song will keep your fame alive forever, and everyone will praise you for all time to come.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yi fa Lɔdɛba. Ka lan nyuri bara yɛri ni yi kpiɔŋ ka yi zaŋ fa Karinaim.
en: you who rejoice in Lo-debar, who say, Havent we by our own strength taken Karnaim for ourselves.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti sɔŋdi niriba lala tatabo, ka di chɛ ka ti leei bɛn mini ba laɣindi tumdi yɛlimaŋli la puuni.
en: Therefore, we ought to help people like this so that we can be coworkers with the truth.

dag: N ni ti gbib a ni ʒiɛyimtali, ka a baŋ man Yawɛ.
en: I will keep my promise and make you mine, and you will acknowledge me as Lord .

dag: N dan naa, ka pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnim zaa lihirila a ninni ni a wuhi ba ŋun yɛn zani a zaani n-di nam a kalinsi nyaaŋa ʒin a nam ʒiishee.
en: Your Majesty, all the people of Israel are looking to you to tell them who is to succeed you as king.

dag: Naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa filim Judanim maa, dama o daa bi gbibi Judanim viɛnyɛla, ka daa bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim.
en: But God was punishing Judah with these disasters, because Ahaz had disobeyed him and refused to stop Judah from sinning.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zooi yomyom kaman kuliga ni mɔri la, ka lan zooi yomyom kaman mo shɛŋa din ʒe baa din kom zɔri ni la.
en: They will spring up from among the reeds like willows by flowing streams.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N suhu zaa kul yɛmi ni m mini ya laɣim di Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ bindirigu ka n naanyi di wahala.
en: he said to them, I have very much wanted to eat this Passover meal with you before I suffer.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin dali. Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka yi puhiri Yawɛ chuɣu maa.
en: For seven days, you must eat only bread without yeast. On the seventh day there will be a great festival to show honor to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ ni bi maani ninvuɣ shɛb taali laasabu mini yɔhiŋgu ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: Happy is the one whom the Lord does not accuse of doing wrong and who is free from all deceit.

dag: Niriba Zuɣulaannim n-daa nyɛ: Parɔsh mini Pahatimɔab ni Ɛlam ni Zatu ni Bani so mi ni.
en: The leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din pahir anahi dali ka bɛ daa laɣim Bɛraka Vinvamli ni, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣi Yawɛ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Bɛraka Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: On the fourth day Jehoshaphat and his army met in the Valley of Beracah. They praised the Lord . That is why people still call that place, The Valley of Beracah.

dag: Ka n daa nya malaika so ka o yi alizanda ni na n-gbib bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la saafɛbia mini zoligo titali o nuu ni.
en: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven. The angel had the key to the bottomless pit. The angel also held a large chain in his hand.

dag: Bɔ saha ka o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani maa? Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la bee o gunibu la nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o zali di ni maa? Di nyɛla o ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la, ka pa ni o ni daa gun la nyaaŋa.
en: So how was it credited? When he was circumcised, or when he wasnt circumcised? In fact, it was credited while he still wasnt circumcised, not after he was circumcised.

dag: N yi ti teeg a nintam la yɛla, n suhu kul yɛla a nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli.
en: I remember that you cried for me. I want very much to see you so that I can be filled with joy.

dag: Pa mani ka o di tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa maa jɛndira, ka n ku zaŋ yi yɛtɔɣa maa garig o.
en: Job was speaking to you, not to me, but I would never answer the way you did.

dag: Dahin shɛli man Yawɛ ni ti yɛn kari zuliya kam zaa saria la miriya. Yi ni nya yi ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti yi tab la tatabo. Yi ni daa niŋ shɛm la ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu.
en: The Day of the Lord is coming soon to all the nations. And the evil you did to others will happen to you. The same bad things will fall down on your own head.

dag: O daa yɛli Naftali zuliya: Yinim Naftalinima, yi nya yurilim tiɣi, ka Yawɛ daalibarika pali yi ni. Yinima n-su wulinluhili mini nudirigu polo.
en: About the tribe of Naphtali he said: Naphtali is richly blessed by the Lord 's good favor; Their land reaches to the south from Lake Galilee.

dag: Di tahigu maa nyɛla din yɛr o yɛla, ka niɣi gba mi ni saa kanna.
en: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.

dag: Toli nyɛla bɛn ka naa, amaa bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli tab chana sariasaria.
en: Locusts dont have a king, but they march together in ranks.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni daa di n-tiɣi naai ka bɛ pii ŋariŋ maa ni alikama kpalan shɛŋa bahi teeku maa ni ni ŋariŋ maa tibisim filim.
en: After everyone had eaten enough, they lightened the ship by throwing all the wheat into the sea.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: Jesus replied, You surely know that the Scriptures say, The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all. This is something the Lord has done, and it is amazing to us.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili maa puuni ka n daa no m-bɔribɔri zuliya kam niriba, ka bɛ ʒim yi n-do tiŋgban ni.
en: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.

dag: Bɛ daa koya m-biri bimbira ka sa tihi, ka di daa niŋ, ka tihi maa gba daa wali pam.
en: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi bi maha, yi mi bi tula. N di bɔri ka yi mahimi bee n-tula!.
en: I know what you do. You are not hot or cold. I wish that you were hot or cold!.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha.
en: At noon the whole country became dark. This darkness continued until three oclock.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ tin shɛŋa din mali kpiɔŋ ni ti bemi kaman Hivinim mini Amɔrinim ni daa zo ka chɛ tin shɛŋa bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka di zani dabari la.
en: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti be bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, n ti ku ʒiɛm ba bee n zaɣisi ba din ni chɛ ka n ku bɛ zaa ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl la, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ takɔbi, saha yuusim wula ka a lee kul yɛn ŋmara? Labimi kpe a tɔɣu ni ti dɔni baalim vuhi.
en: Sword of the Lord , you have not stopped. How long will you keep fighting? Go back into your scabbard ! Stop! Be still!.

dag: Amaa kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi nya ma ni yi nini, amaa ka bi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: I told you before that you have seen me, and still you dont believe.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ma la zaɣ nɛɔŋ niŋ gballi ni, ka kahi kuɣa pa n zuɣu.
en: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Rɛkab min o mabia Baana bɛn daa nyɛ Rimɔn Bɛrɔt nir la bihi maa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiligi ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: David answered them, I take a vow by the living Lord , who has saved me from all dangers!.

dag: Di pala din be zuɣusaa ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du zuɣusaa nti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: It is not up in the sky. You do not have to ask, Who will go up and bring it down for us, so that we can hear it and obey it.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋub nimdi ka ʒim na be di ni. Di ti bɔhimya baɣitali bee sotali.
en: Do not eat any meat with blood still in it. Do not practice any kind of magic.

dag: Buni chɛ ka nir nyarila zɔnim pam, amaa faranim bɛn ka zɔnima.
en: Rich people are always finding new friends, but the poor cannot keep the few they have.

dag: Hal bɛ sapashinnim mini bɛ tuumba ni pun paai Ijipti tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Zɔan mini Hanɛs la zaa yoli.
en: Although their ambassadors have already arrived at the Egyptian cities of Zoan and Hanes.

dag: O ni daa niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni saha shɛli maa ka o daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni.
en: While he was blessing them, he was separated from them and carried into heaven.

dag: Niriba maa kanimina, ka bɛ chandi vuri ŋmani kom pam vuri, amaa o ni tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ katiŋa. Bɛ ni zo kaman zoya zuɣu wurigu ni taŋkpa shɛli pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe m-bahi.
en: Nations roar like the roaring of rushing waters. But God will rebuke them, and they will flee far away, pursued like chaff by wind in the mountains, like tumbleweeds before a storm.

dag: Shɛkɛm ni daa dihi Yaakubu bidibisi maa tizɔpaɣ Daina vi maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa garigi Shɛkɛm min o ba Hamɔr yɔhiŋgu garigibu.
en: Jacobs sons responded deviously to Shechem and his father Hamor because Shechem defiled their sister Dinah.

dag: Ka o daa ka naa Ɛhab sanna, ka naa bɔhi, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni nya nasara, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Micaiah went and stood before King Ahab. The king asked him, Micaiah, should we go and attack the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead or not? Micaiah answered, Yes, go and be successful! You will take the city.

dag: Ka o daa saɣisi ba yɛli, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu ni boonila zuliya kam wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: He then taught the people: It is written in the Scriptures that God said, My Temple will be called a house of prayer for the people of all nations. But you have turned it into a hideout for thieves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Zius la yuli ti Baanabas, ka zaŋ buɣ so ŋun mi yuli booni Hɛrimɛs la yuli ti Pool mi, Pool ni daa nyɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira la zuɣu.
en: They referred to Barnabas as Zeus and to Paul as Hermes, since Paul was the main speaker.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Someone might say to you at that time, Look, there is the Messiah! Or someone else might say, There he is! But dont believe them.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini n naɣ beni ka ti ni bɔri ni yi niŋ li pɔi ka ti naanyi saɣi, dina n-nyɛ: yi chɛ ka yi dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman tinima.
en: We can only agree to do this if you circumcise every male as we do.

dag: Ka Dauda yɛl o, A ʒim yihibu taali ʒi a zuɣu, dama amaŋmaŋ noli n-di a shɛhira yɛli, Mani n-ku Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so maa. .
en: Your blood is on your own head, David said to the Amalekite, because your own mouth testified against you when you admitted, I killed the LORDs anointed.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli pateesa yil li, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: The courtyard should be cubits long and cubits wide. The wall of curtains around the courtyard should be cubits high. The curtains must be made from fine linen. The bases under the posts must be bronze.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka bɛ yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo. Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la di tumtumsa ni.
en: Yet the Human One came eating and drinking, and they say, Look, a glutton and a drunk, a friend of tax collectors and sinners. But wisdom is proved to be right by her works.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n siɣisi mmaŋa n-niŋ tuuba ka do taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim ni ŋɔ.
en: So I am ashamed of all I have said and repent in dust and ashes.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla jɛlinsi yɛtɔɣa m-muɣisiri ma, ka lu n zuɣu ka di ka daliri.
en: Hateful words surround me; they attack me for no reason.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya niriba ni o nyaandoliba n-kana ti zu n-yih o yuŋ saha shɛli yi ni daa ʒeei gom.
en: They said to the soldiers, Tell everyone that Jesus' disciples came during the night and stole his body while you were asleep.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alikauli zaligu kundi la na ti karim li ka niriba maa wum ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li, ka deeg o noli.
en: Then he took the covenant scroll and read it out loud for the people to hear. They responded, Everything that the LORD has said we will do, and we will obey.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tarimba, ka tumd o ni zali ya shɛm ŋɔ, jɛmmiya Yawɛ. Bomiya wuntitali mini tarimtali, di pa shɛli ka yi ti nya sɔɣisili shee Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali.
en: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land who practice his justice; seek righteousness; seek humility. Maybe you will be hidden on the day of the LORDs anger.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ biɛri vuui; hal a yi lihi viɛnyɛliŋga m-bo ba, bɛ ku beni.
en: In a short time there will be no more evil people. You can look for them all you want, but they will be gone.

dag: Di saha o ni ti bɔhi, Bɛ wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ ni daa sɔɣi tampiŋ shɛli ni la lee be ya?.
en: But first the Lord will say, You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa kul duhir omaŋ pahira, amaa o ni daa mali kpiɔŋ pam maa ka o yilli la kabi. Ka yila anahi daa bili yina n-zani di zaashee, ka nir ni tooi nya li viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi zaa noya daa kpala dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ zaa yiniyini polo.
en: The he-goat became even greater, but at the height of its power, its large horn snapped. In its place, four horns, each a sight to see, came up toward the four winds of heaven.

dag: O ni daa ti piligi maani di laasabu maa ka bɛ zaŋ do so ŋun daa di naa maa laɣ gbaliŋ samli na.
en: The king began to collect his money. One servant owed him several thousand pounds of silver.

dag: Di saha ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yaba, n suhir a mi ni a tim Lazarɔs m ba yiŋa dunia ni.
en: The rich man said, Then I beg you, father Abraham, send Lazarus to my father's house.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi o nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka o shia kasi suhu saɣim pam. Dinzuɣu ka o daa leei bɛ dima, ka ŋmaligi tuhi ba o toli.
en: but they rebelled against him and made his holy spirit sad. So the Lord became their enemy and fought against them.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Bashan oki tihi m-mali a ŋariŋ duhirisi. Bɛ zaŋla Saipurus teeku duli wolifahi dari mali a puuni ka niŋ wɔbinyina pa di zuɣu.
en: They took oak trees from Bashan to make oars; They made your deck out of pine from Cyprus And inlaid it with ivory.

dag: Ka Leeban daa laɣim nimaaninim zaa na ka bɛ ti puhi chuɣu.
en: So Laban gave a wedding feast and invited everyone.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni saɣim n luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ yi ni mali shɛli nyuri bara, ka yi nini tiɣi li, ka yi suhuri yu li la, ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin shɛba yi ni chɛ yiŋ la.
en: Say to the house of Israel, the LORD God proclaims: Im about to make my sanctuary impure, the pride of your strength, the delight of your eyes. Your hearts desire, the sons and daughters you left behind, will fall by the sword.

dag: ni o ti darigi bɛn bi mi Naawuni mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ti Duuma Yisa lahibal suŋ wumbu la tibili.
en: with a flaming fire, to punish those who reject God and who do not obey the Good News about our Lord Jesus.

dag: daa ti lo nia n tɛha puuni ni n vihi baŋ binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ni. Di nyɛla Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti daadamnim ka bɛ tumdi ka di tiri ba suhugarigu.
en: I applied my mind to investigate and to explore by wisdom all that happens under heaven. Its an unhappy obsession that God has given to human beings.

dag: Dama o ni tilig a bɛn bariti zana nuu ni mini alɔbo din kuri niriba ni.
en: He will keep you safe from all hidden dangers and from all deadly diseases.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu. Naawuni, ka bɔ saha ka n yɛn kana ti nya a ninni?.
en: My soul thirsts for the living God. When can I go to meet with him?.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima alali mali Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: He made a lid of pure gold, inches long and inches wide.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti yɛl ti, Guhimiya hal ka ti ti ka yi sanna, di saha ti ni kpalim ʒe nimaani ka ku lan chaŋ bɛ sani.
en: If they agree to come down the hill and fight where we are, then we won't climb up to their camp.

dag: ni Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la ni Ilai ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la.
en: Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai from Ahoh.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu labisi. Guhimi Yawɛ, o ni sɔŋ a.
en: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord , and he will help you.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, dindina ka tim ma kom maa ka n nyu, ka kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ma bee ka n ti lan ka kpe na ni n ti ŋɔŋ kom yaha.
en: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I will never be thirsty and will never need to come here to draw water.

dag: Di yi nyɛla Pool bee Apolɔs bee Pita bee dunia ŋɔ bee nyɛvili bee kum bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ bee dahin shɛli ha yɛla, di zaa ha nyɛla yi dini;.
en: Paul, Apollos, and Peter; this world, life and death, the present and the future—all these are yours.

dag: Chɛ ka ti bidibisi zoori kaman tipola din zoori ni kpiɔŋ la, ka ti bipuɣinsi mi be kaman nayili zɔŋ daantalisi la.
en: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.

dag: N yi zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a zaligunim maa zaa ni, n ku di vi.
en: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo kabiri laɣindina maa, ka o tah alizin birigu maa zuɣu yɛli, Nyin alizin tikpiralan birigu ŋɔ, n yɛr a mi, wari ka chɛ bia maa, ka di lan lab o sanna yaha.
en: When Jesus saw that a crowd was gathering fast, he spoke sternly to the evil spirit that had kept the boy from speaking or hearing. He said, I order you to come out of the boy! Don't ever bother him again.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baai bɛ bandi la, ka chihi bɛ mihi la ti niŋgbuna ni.
en: Come! they say. We will tear off their ropes and throw off their chains.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ mi sabilifaa n-lo li tabili bantabiga la, ka di ti be bantabiga maa tooni polo.
en: You should fasten it on the turban with a blue cord. It should be on the front of the turban.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N nyɛla Ibrahimma nachin kpɛma.
en: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Zaŋmi duɣu n-zahim manna maa lita ayi n-kpaai niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka di be nimaani yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Moses said to Aaron, Take a jar, and put one full omer of manna in it. Then set it in the LORDs presence, where it should be kept safe for future generations.

dag: A deei ti suhigu ka tiligi ti alahizibu tuun kara puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, binnamda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa zaŋ tabili bɛn be teeku ni katiŋ ha mali tahima la a sani.
en: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na la yɛli, Biilzibul n-ʒi o zuɣu. Alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o karit alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: Some teachers of the Law who had come from Jerusalem were saying, He has Beelzebul in him! It is the chief of the demons who gives him the power to drive them out.

dag: Ka do so daa nya o ka yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, n nyala Absalom ka o yili oki tia zuɣu.
en: One of David's men saw him and reported to Joab, Sir, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree.

dag: Di pa shɛli na so ni tooi mali napaɣiba pihiyɔbu, ka mali mamanim pihinii ni paɣisara bɛn ka kalinli.
en: There might be queens and slave women, and young women too many to count.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋya nirilim shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, pomiya ni yi gba ni ti niŋ m mini m ba yiŋnim nirilim lala, ka wuhi ma di shihirili.
en: So now, I want you to make a promise to me. I was kind to you and helped you. So promise me before the Lord that you will be kind to my family. Please tell me that you will do this.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ kurugu bidibbini, ka daanya piɛm ni to ba pili yi.
en: If they flee an iron weapon, a bronze bow pierces them.

dag: ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nini nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka o nya binshɛli ka di kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la, ka di sirigiri o sanna hal ti paai tiŋa.
en: He saw something coming down through the open sky. It looked like a big sheet being lowered to the ground by its four corners.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛmaŋa n-doli tab chani buɣa maligu shee mini bɛn ŋubiri kuruchunim ni jɛŋgbarisi, ka diri bindiri yoya la bahigu saha miriya.
en: Those who became holy and purify themselves, following their leader into the gardens, who eat pork, detestable animals, and mice, will meet their end together, says the LORD.

dag: Ka Juda maa daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia, ka Yaakubu nyɛ Yisahaku bia, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Ibrahimma bia, ka Ibrahimma nyɛ Tɛra bia, ka Tɛra mi nyɛ Nahɔr bia.
en: son of Jacob son of Isaac son of Abraham son of Terah son of Nahor.

dag: Bɛ ku Izraɛl jilima zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka wɔɣira lu.
en: Oh, no, Israel! Your prince lies dead on your heights. Look how the mighty warriors have fallen!.

dag: Di kumdiya ŋun kpi zuɣu bee n-fabindi o zuɣu. Amaa lee kummiyala bɛ ni gbaai so chaŋ zuɣu, dama o ku lan labina ka o nini ti nya o tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.

dag: Yi tuuli yabidoo daa tum alahichi, ka yi yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisiriba tum alahichi n sani.
en: Your first father sinned, and your lawyers committed crimes against me.

dag: Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: All these things happened in the eighteenth year of Josiah's rule in Judah.

dag: Bɛ yiinila yila saɣisiri guŋgombihi mini mɔɣilo, ka kalambua kumsi niŋdi ba nyaɣisim.
en: They raise drum and lyre, rejoice at the sound of a flute.

dag: Nyini n-daa fa ma m mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zabiri nuu ni bahi. Nyini n-zaŋ ma leei zuliya bɔbili zuɣulana; ka n ni daa bi mi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa jɛmdi ma mi.
en: You saved me from those who fought against me. You made me the ruler over nations. People I never knew now serve me.

dag: ni nanim shɛb bɛn daa be nuzaa polo zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la ni Araba din daa be Kinɛrɔt nudirigu polo la ni tintan ni tinsi la nima ni Nafɔtido din daa be wulinluhili polo la nima.
en: and to the kings in the hill country in the north, in the Jordan Valley south of Lake Galilee, in the foothills, and on the coast near Dor.

dag: Nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula niŋ binshɛli? Ka nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula kpahi kpa n-zaŋ binyɛra yili li?.
en: Can you use it to make anything? Can you even make a peg out of it to hang things on?.

dag: mini Jɛrusalɛm ni Idumia ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli polo hal zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn laɣim o sanna, bɛ ni daa wum o ni tumdi tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla zuɣu.
en: from Jerusalem, from the territory of Idumea, from the territory on the east side of the Jordan, and from the region around the cities of Tyre and Sidon. All these people came to Jesus because they had heard of the things he was doing.

dag: To, fukumsi zaligu ni, Anabi Musa yɛliya ni ŋun niŋ lala, ti n-labim o kuɣa. Ka wula ka a mi lee yɛli.
en: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa tim ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ba Yaakubu min o daŋ zaa na; bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Joseph sent for his father Jacob and all his relatives—seventy-five in all—and invited them to live with him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba maa daa ti zab bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la nyuli n-gaŋ o, ka daa ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ijiptinim zuɣu; amaa ka Naawuni daa zan o nyaaŋa.
en: These ancestors of ours became jealous of their brother Joseph and sold him to be a slave in Egypt. But God was with him.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zakaria zilinjila daa dii lɔrigi, ka o nya noli gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: At that moment Zechariah was able to speak again, and he started praising God.

dag: Laabira salo ŋɔ ʒi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, lala zuɣu Naawuni noli ni di ba.
en: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.

dag: Di zaŋya fukumsi biɛɣu su piɛ shɛb Naawuni ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la, amaa lee maliya biɛhigu shɛli din simdi ni bɛ doli di naba.
en: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli ni tiligi. Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti be bɛn kpalim maa ni.
en: But all who ask the Lord for help will be saved. As the Lord has said, Some in Jerusalem will escape; those whom I choose will survive.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ti yaag o noli yɛli ni Yisa Masia nyɛla Duuma, ka di chɛ ka o Ba Naawuni nya jilima.
en: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

dag: Nyin naa ni bɔri ni ti wuh a shɛli ŋɔ to pam, ka so ku tooi wuh a li naɣila wuna din mini ninsalinim bi laɣim bela n-ni tooi niŋ lala.
en: What the king is asking is impossible! No one could declare the dream to the king but the gods, who dont live among mere humans.

dag: A zuɣu ŋmanila Kamɛl Zoli. A zabiri nyɛlisirimi kaman ago la. Di viɛlim ni tooi chɛ ka naa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu.
en: Your head is held high like Mount Carmel; your hair is so lovely it holds a king prisoner.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ Shunɛm ka paɣ bundaan so daa be nimaani m-balim o ni o dim bindirigu. Dinzuɣu o daa yi ti doli nimaani polo saha shɛlikam, o kpɛrila yili maa ni ti diri bindirigu.
en: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where a rich woman lived. She invited him to a meal, and from then on every time he went to Shunem he would have his meals at her house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa zaligu maa moli gili Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa ni, ka tuumba daa zaŋ di lahibali zo n-tahi yaɣili kam ni. Di saha maa Haman mini naa daa ʒimi nyuri dam, amaa ka Susa tiŋ puuninim zaa bɛn yɛma ŋma.
en: At the king's command the decree was made public in the capital city of Susa, and runners carried the news to the provinces. The king and Haman sat down and had a drink while the city of Susa was being thrown into confusion.

dag: Ka anabinim maa daa kul kuhiri pampam, ka mali suhi mini kpana ŋ-ŋmari bɛmaŋa ka chɔhiri bɛmaŋa kaman bɛ taara ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ka ʒim ti puhiri yiri bɛ niŋgbuna ni na.
en: The prophets kept shouting louder and louder, and they cut themselves with swords and knives until they were bleeding. This was the way they worshiped.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, cham Izraɛlnim sani nti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ba.
en: Then he said to me: Human one, go! Go to the house of Israel and speak my words to them.

dag: ka zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara, ka di kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: Also offer a male goat as a sin offering to make you pure.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisiyi.
en: The total number of males one month old or older that were enrolled was .

dag: Ka Hadad daa ti kpi. O kalinsi nyaaŋa na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth.

dag: Paɣ maa daa yɛla ago ʒiɛɣu, ka o luɣilikam nyaɣim salima mini kuɣ viɛla yɛri ni waya, ka o gbib salima pipia o nuu ni ka chihi biɛri min o zina niŋbu tabizahim daɣiri pal li.
en: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.

dag: Di bi simdi ni ti be kaman Keen ŋun daa nyɛ Sintani nira ka ku o mabia la. Bɔzuɣu ka o daa lee ku o? Di nyɛla o tuma ni daa bi tuhi ka o mabia maa ŋun tuma tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Dont be like Cain. He belonged to the Evil One. Cain killed his brother. But why did he kill him? Because what Cain did was evil, and what his brother did was good.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli yɛli, Chamiya! Ka bɛ daa yi dɔb maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ zaa daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: Then he said to the demons, Go away, and they came out and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the cliff into the lake and drowned.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli alizanda ni, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu bee saa ni yi tahiri shɛm la. N ni daa wum kukol shɛli maa daa ŋmanila mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba ni yi ŋmɛri bɛ mɔɣilɔnim ka di kumsi vuri shɛm la.
en: And I heard a sound from heaven as loud as the crashing of floodwaters or claps of thunder. But it sounded like harpists playing their harps.

dag: Di saha ka pɔhim daa yi Yawɛ sani n-ʒe kɔrinsi teeku ni na ti luhi gili suɣa maa shee luɣilikam m-paai kilomita bɔbili wɔɣilim tariga, ka bɛ ni do tiŋ shɛm dubu nyɛ kaman mita yini laasabu.
en: Suddenly the Lord sent a wind that brought quails from the sea, flying three feet above the ground. They settled on the camp and all around it for miles and miles in every direction.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi ti kpe fɔŋ maa ni n-chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o ti kpe o ni kuni yil shɛli.
en: Jesus told them, As you go into the city, you will meet a man carrying a jar of water. Follow him into the house.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba. Naawuni mi daa bi yɛli malaika so: Man Naawuni ni leeg a Ba, ka a mi leegi m Bia.
en: After all, when did God ever say to any of the angels: You are my Son. Today I have become your Father? Or, even, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son? .

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka tiligira so lan kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I alone am the Lord , the only one who can save you.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ deebu la daa dii zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa wolim nya nyɔri ka di min o laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: The servant who got five bags went quickly to invest the money. Those five bags of money earned five more.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka o ti a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli.
en: Seek your happiness in the Lord , and he will give you your heart's desire.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri ninsalinim yɛligu balibu kam, hal zaŋ tabili malaikanim yɛligu, ka ka yurilim, dindina m bemi kaman dawule bee gbiŋgbarinlun shɛŋa bɛ ni mali ŋmɛri taba ka di yɔri vuri yiriŋ la.
en: If I speak in tongues of human beings and of angels but I dont have love, Im a clanging gong or a clashing cymbal.

dag: A niŋ bindirigu zali n tooni n dimnim ninni. A niŋ kpam ʒe n zuɣu. A chɛ ka m pipia pali hal ti puuri bahira.
en: You set a table for me right in front of my enemies. You bathe my head in oil; my cup is so full it spills over!.

dag: Ka a ti she jinjɛŋŋmahi ti ba ka di limsi bɛ zaɣim, ka di wɔɣilim ti zaŋ bɛ shɛhi ni hal ti paai bɛ gbalipina ni.
en: Use linen to make underclothes for the priests. These underclothes will cover them from the waist to the thighs.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa zaa kalinli nyɛla tinsi pihinuayika ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: with their pasture land, making a total of forty-eight.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛlamnim polo Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni.
en: Soon after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord Almighty spoke to me about the country of Elam.

dag: Ka bɔh o di saha maa, Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: Tell us, is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni yɛn nam zuɣusaa zaɣ palli shɛli mini dunia palli shɛl la ni yɛn yuui shɛm, lala ka yi zuliya ni yi yuli yɛn yuui.
en: Just as the new earth and the new heavens will endure by my power, so your descendants and your name will endure.

dag: Miri ka a vili tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba mini faranim yɔri gbibi. Bɛ yi nyɛla a Izraɛl taba bee bɛ yi nyɛla saamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi tinsi maa tin shɛl ni.
en: Do not cheat poor and needy hired servants, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living in one of your towns.

dag: O chɛ ka m bela zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi ka di yuui la.
en: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi yɛtɔɣ shɛli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛli ŋɔ ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Amaa doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya ŋɔ.
en: Do not add anything to what I command you, and do not take anything away. Obey the commands of the Lord your God that I have given you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti boli niriba na ti yɛli ba, Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni:.
en: Then Jesus called the crowd to him and said to them, Listen and understand!.

dag: N lɔn ya alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka kom di binnɛma zaa, ka m mi ku lan chɛ ka kom di dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: With these words I make my covenant with you: I promise that never again will all living beings be destroyed by a flood; never again will a flood destroy the earth.

dag: amaa ti shɛli din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu la, miri ka a di li, dama a yi ti di li dahin shɛli, a ni kpi.
en: except the tree that gives knowledge of what is good and what is bad. You must not eat the fruit of that tree; if you do, you will die the same day.

dag: Ka bɛ daa moli zaligu maa gili ni bɛ kum baŋdiba maa zaa, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Daniɛl min o tab la ni bɛ ku bɛ gba.
en: So the command went out: The sages were to be killed. Daniel and his friends too were hunted down; they were to be killed as well.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Labimi mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din miri Damaskus la. A yi paai nimaani, nyin boom kpam bahi Hazaɛl zuɣu ni ka o leei Siria naa;.
en: The Lord said, Return to the wilderness near Damascus, then enter the city and anoint Hazael as king of Syria;.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa, ka bɛ daa kum pam.
en: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord 's message.

dag: Di saha ka so daa kana ti yɛli ba, Yi ni sa kpɛhi ninvuɣ shɛb duu la be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba.
en: Just then, someone arrived and announced, Look! The people you put in prison are standing in the temple and teaching the people.

dag: A guri a tɔbu, ka zali zaligu, ka piɛma pani di zuɣu. A zaŋ mɔɣa bɔɣi tiŋgbani.
en: Even then you showed your rainbow. It was proof of your agreement with the families of the earth. Selah And the dry land split the rivers.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o nuhi puli pa tab zuɣu n-zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim ŋun daa nyɛ biasan la zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa mi pa Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ bituuli maa zuɣu ni.
en: But Israel put out his right hand and placed it on the head of Ephraim, the younger one, and his left hand on Manassehs head, crossing his hands because Manasseh was the oldest son.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di lan pahi lala! Ka daa zaŋ o nuu shihi doo maa tibili maa ka di lab tabili yaha.
en: Jesus responded, Stop! No more of this! He touched the slaves ear and healed him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: They buried him within the boundaries of his family property in Timnath-heres in the highlands of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ kurimbuni ha, a nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa.
en: long ago you created the earth, and with your own hands you made the heavens.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Lamɛk.
en: When Methuselah was , he had a son named Lamech.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ nyɛla din chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe tibi yɛma ŋma. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali yiɣisi wuɣili ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu.
en: Those who do the right thing are amazed at this; the guiltless become troubled about the godless.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya o ni nam binshɛɣukam maa zaa, ka di viɛl pam. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayɔbu.
en: God looked at what he had done. All of it was very good! Evening came, then morning—that was the sixth day.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yihi kuɣa maa, ka kaɣisi tari maa ka lan ta li, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa lan puhi yili maa ni yaha.
en: If the infection breaks out again in the house after the stones have been pulled out and the house scraped and replastered.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim gil o; sagban tibisa din sabigi ka kom be di ni n-nyɛ o sampaa.
en: God made darkness cloak him; his covering was dark water and dense cloud.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zani baɣil o ka yɛli, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a ni do tiŋgban shɛli ni ŋɔ ti a min a zuliya;.
en: And then Jacob saw the Lord standing by the ladder. He said, I am the Lord , the God of your grandfather Abraham. I am the God of Isaac. I will give you the land that you are lying on now. I will give this land to you and to your children.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa puuni, a ka taali, dama a nyɛla ŋun ʒe ti yim, ka tinim lee tum din bie.
en: You have done right to punish us; you have been faithful, even though we have sinned.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri alizanda nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in the synagogues, preaching the Good News about the Kingdom, and healing people who had all kinds of disease and sickness.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn zaŋ kuɣa me sara maligu bimbini ti ma, yin di zaŋya kuɣ kpɛra me li, dama yi yi zaŋ chiriga shihi kuɣ shɛli, di ni leei kuɣ shɛli din mali daɣiri.
en: If you make an altar of stone for me, do not build it out of cut stones, because when you use a chisel on stones, you make them unfit for my use.

dag: Dauda daa bi chɛ ka binshɛli kpalim nimaani. Neem bihi bee neen kara bee bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi ni bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa la mini Amalɛknim maa ni daa kpuɣi bɛ neen shɛŋa zaa, Dauda daa zaŋ di zaa lab kuli.
en: Nothing was missing. They found all the children and old people, all their sons and daughters, and all their valuables. They got back everything the Amalekites had taken. David brought everything back.

dag: Yisa daa pun mi ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa, dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni yino maa.
en: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, except for one of you.

dag: Amaa bɛn sani, di ni ti ŋmanila ʒiri baɣiri, bɛ pun po pɔri, amaa ŋun teeri ba la bɛ taali ni nyɛ shɛli ni di chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: It seems to them like a lying divination, because solemn pledges had been sworn to them. But he will remind them of their guilt, and they will be captured.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti doli Yisa.
en: John's two followers heard him, and they went with Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali bindirigu mini situra, ti n-chɛ ka ti nini tiɣ li.
en: well be happy with food and clothing.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn ʒe dunol ni n-nyɛ ninkura mini bipola maa zaa zom, ka chani bɔbindi bɔri dunoli shee.
en: Then they struck blind everyone in the crowd, and none of them could even find the door.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina. Ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: but the animals insides and lower legs must be washed with water. The priest will then completely burn all of it on the altar as an entirely burned offering, a food gift of soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: So na ʒi n-zaɣis omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o dihiri li mi ka maani li kaman Masia ni niŋdi cheechi shɛm la.
en: because no one ever hates his own body, but feeds and takes care of it. And that is what Christ does for the church.

dag: Naawuni di wuhi gba! Wula ka tinim bɛn kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo ŋɔ na kul ni kpalim be di tumbu ni?.
en: Certainly not! We have died to sin—how then can we go on living in it?.

dag: saha shɛl o ni daa zali saa ni yɛn miri shɛm, ka zali saa nyaɣisibu ni yɛn chani shɛm la.
en: when he made a decree for the rain, a path for thunderbolts.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni. A mi di saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha!.
en: Lord , dont punish me. Dont correct me when you are so angry.

dag: Amaa niriba maa galisiya pam ka saa mi miri pampam, ka ti ku tooi ʒe palo ŋɔ ni lala. Di mi pala dahin yini bee daba ayi tuuni n-nyɛ li, dama ti pam n-tum birigi yɛlli maa ni.
en: But there are many people here. And it is the rainy time of year, so we cannot stay outside. This problem cannot be solved in a day or two because we have sinned in a very bad way.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ yɛmbimbiɛtali maa ka yɛli ba.
en: But Jesus knew that these men were trying to trick him. He said to them.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali Naawuni Shia Kasi vihiri binshɛɣukam zaa baŋdi di gbinni, amaa ka so ku tooi vihi baŋ ŋun yɛla gbinni.
en: We who have the Spirit are able to make judgments about all these things. But anyone without the Spirit is not able to make proper judgments about us.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni tooi yɛli naa, A nyɛla ninvuɣ yoli ka yɛli kpambaliba, Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: God condemns kings and rulers when they are worthless or wicked.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ gbantolima lo Pool naai ka o bɔhi sapashin so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani, Di luhiya ni yi fiɛbi Rom tiŋbia ka na bi kar o saria ŋ-ŋmaag o yɛtɔɣa.
en: While the soldiers were tying Paul up to be beaten, he asked the officer standing there, Is it legal to beat a Roman citizen before he has been tried in court.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm, sɔɣirila o milinsi, amaa jɛra bɛn kul moonila bɛ jɛrilim.
en: The shrewd conceal their knowledge, but the heart of fools proclaims their stupidity.

dag: Naawuni tamla o nirilim niŋbu la yɛla? O suhuyiɣisili chɛ ka o zaɣisila nambɔɣu zɔbu.
en: Has God forgotten what mercy is? Has his compassion changed to anger? Selah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim lo nia ni bɛ kana nti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-tahi girigiri niŋbu na.
en: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n nya n ni suhiri bɔri shɛli ŋɔ, m bi zaɣisi ka Naawuni ti ma n suhu ni bɔri shɛli ŋɔ.
en: How I wish that God would answer my prayer.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di ka nyu. Ka paɣ maa ba maa daa yɛli doo maa, Niŋm ania kpalim gbe m-pahi, ka chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: So the two of them sat down and ate and drank together. The young womans father said to the man, Why not spend the night and enjoy yourself.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu chihila Naawuni daalikaulinima? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Dama Naawuni yi daa zali fukumsi zaligu shɛli ni di tooi tahi nyɛvili na, dindina taali ni yibu Naawuni sani naan shiri yi fukumsi zaligu maa dolibu ni na.
en: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so ka o ku tooi nyaŋ o daɣiri ni yibu sara maligu zaligu m-bala.
en: This is the law for those who have a dreaded skin disease but who cannot afford the normal offerings required for his purification.

dag: Izraɛl naa maa ni daa ti karim gbaŋ maa, o daa darigimi toog o binyɛrigu ka yɛli, N nyɛla Naawuni ka ni tooi ku nir ka lan neeg o, ka doo ŋɔ ti yɛri ma ni n tibimi nir kɔŋa? Nir yi kpahim yɛlli maa, a ni baŋ ni vuri ka o bɔri ma maa.
en: When the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his clothes in fear and shouted, That Syrian king believes I can cure this man of leprosy! Does he think I'm God with power over life and death? He must be trying to pick a fight with me.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti boli Yisifu n-zaŋ o sarika maa ni na yomyom; ka o daa pini o ninni ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-kpe Firawuna sani.
en: So Pharaoh called Joseph from the prison. The guards quickly got Joseph out of prison. Joseph shaved, put on some clean clothes, and went to see Pharaoh.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, n ni kana ti paɣ a a tuun kara zuɣu, ka yɛl a kɔŋko wuntital la yɛla.
en: I will tell about your greatness, my Lord GOD. I will talk only about you and your goodness.

dag: Ka Harumaf bia Jɛdaya daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hashabinɛya bia Hatush mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ka yi zaɣisi wumbu. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi lan bɔri ni yi wum yaha? Yi gba bɔrimi ni yi leeg o nyaandoliba yɔɣɔ.
en: The man answered, I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yiɣis o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu pam ka ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: The Lord was very angry with them, and he left them.

dag: N yi ti tim Aritimas bee Tikikus a sanna, nyin kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna Nikɔpolis, dama n loya ni m be nimaani kikaa saha.
en: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛba n-lan beni pahi yi zuɣu, amaa yinima n-kul nyɛ ti tahima mini ti suhupiɛlli ni ti nasara dibu barinyubo shɛli ti ni ti yɛn mali ti Duuma Yisa tooni o labbuna dali.
en: What is our hope, joy, or crown that we can brag about in front of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Isnt it all of you?.

dag: N yuri a zaligu pam! N kul tɛhirila di yɛla dabisili kam.
en: How I love your law! I think about it all day long.

dag: N daa yi chaŋ tiŋ puuni dunɔdali gbini nti zaŋ n kuɣ zali laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Those were the days when I went to the city gate and sat in the public meeting of the elders.

dag: ka yɛli Samsin, Man daa tɛhiya ni a lan je o mi, ka zaŋ o ti a daaŋgo zo la. O tizɔbil ŋɔ viɛli gar o, dinzuɣu jaande, zaŋm o tizɔbil maa ka chɛ o.
en: He told Samson, I really thought that you hated her, so I gave her to your friend. But her younger sister is prettier, anyway. You can have her, instead.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Balak zaŋ Balaam du Bamɔtibaal din nyɛ luɣ shɛli din miri ka o ni tooi lihi nya Izraɛlnim maa viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: In the morning Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal, where he could see part of the people.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima; dama ninsal sɔŋsim ka buchi.
en: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.

dag: A dabili Jɔab bɔrimi ni o mali yɛla zali dɛde, dina n-chɛ ka o niŋ lala maa. Amaa n dan mali yɛm kaman Naawuni malaika ni mali yɛm shɛm la din ni tooi baŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: but only to show you the other side of this problem. You must be as wise as the angel of God to know everything that goes on in this country.

dag: Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti ku o. Bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni. N niriba daalahichi zuɣu ka bɛ daa ku o.
en: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.

dag: N daa darigi bɛ tibili ka di dolila bɛ daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba.
en: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their transgressions and hid my face from them.

dag: Yi ni ti be suɣa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin. Izraɛl tiŋbihi zaa ni ti bela suɣa ni.
en: All the people of Israel shall live in shelters for seven days.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ ma la lala, nyin niŋm ma nirilim n-dii ku ma, ka lala chɛ ka n ku nya n nandahima biɛhigu.
en: If you are going to treat me like this, have pity on me and kill me, so that I won't have to endure your cruelty any longer.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nambu piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ Naawuni biɛhigu shɛli ti nini ni ku tooi nya ka di nyɛ o Naawunitali min o yiko din ka bahigu la dola palɔni, ka ninsalinim nyari li o ni nam binshɛŋa la ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ lan ka soli din ni doli yi taali ni.
en: Ever since God created the world, his invisible qualities, both his eternal power and his divine nature, have been clearly seen; they are perceived in the things that God has made. So those people have no excuse at all!.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Jafɛt tɔŋ! Naawuni chɛ ka o zuliya mini Shɛm zuliya laɣim be; ka chɛ ka Keenan nyɛ o dabili.
en: May God give more land to Japheth. May God live in Shems tents, and may Canaan be their slave.

dag: O daa daŋ kala omaŋmaŋ zuliya sanna, ka bɛ ti bi deeg o.
en: He came to the world that was his own. And his own people did not accept him.

dag: Ka niɣi maa daa dii zaŋ li lu solɔɣu n-kpa Bɛtishɛmɛshi polo, bɛ daa bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, bɛ daa kul chanimi ka kuhira. Ka Filistia nanim daa dol ba hal ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi tintariga.
en: The cows started off on the road to Beth Shemesh and headed straight toward it, without turning off the road. They were mooing as they went. The five Philistine kings followed them as far as the border of Beth Shemesh.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum tuun viɛl shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni sab li shɛm Yawɛ zaligu kundi ni la.
en: Everything else Josiah did while he was king, including how he faithfully obeyed the Lord .

dag: Di ni lan sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛm wuhibu mini wuntitali ni zaligu dolibu ni nimmaŋtali polo.
en: They can teach you how to live intelligently and how to be honest, just, and fair.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la? Ka bɛ zaa yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate asked, So what should I do with Jesus, the one called the Messiah? All the people said, Kill him on a cross.

dag: Ka naa Ivilmɛrɔdak daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣ dira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Each day, for as long as he lived, he was given a regular allowance for his needs.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii pam dindali maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa daa do n-dalim chɛchɛbuŋ maa puuni, ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo hal ni zaawuni, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka o kpi.
en: While the battle raged all that day, Israels king stood propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. But that evening he died, just as the sun was going down.

dag: Ka yɛdaniŋdib bɛn daa be Bɛria daa dii chɛ ka Pool chaŋ teeku noli, amaa ka Silas mini Timoti bɛn daa kpalim nimaani.
en: At once the followers sent Paul down to the coast, but Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.

dag: Luk . Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anab kura la ni yino ŋun neei kum ni na.
en: Lk . They answered, Some say you are John the Baptist or Elijah or a prophet from long ago who has come back to life.

dag: Amaa niriba biɛla be yinim Saadisinim ni n-na bi gabisi bɛ binyɛra. M mini ba ni ye binyɛr piɛla n-laɣim dol taba, dama bɛ simdi lala.
en: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.

dag: Sool yuma daa nyɛla kaman yuun ... ka o naanyi di nam. O daa di nam maa n-su Izraɛlnim la kaman yuun ... ni ayi.
en: Saul was years old when he became king, and he ruled over Israel forty-two years.

dag: Piimiya ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Choose men from each of the tribes of Israel.

dag: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara maligu balibu kam; a mi bi bɔri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛba m-maani sara nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la; amaa a luɣila n tiba ti ma.
en: Lord, you made me understand this: You dont really want sacrifices and grain offerings. You dont want burnt offerings and sin offerings.

dag: Miri ka a ʒiɛhi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo. Zom yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Avoid evil and walk straight ahead. Don't go one step off the right way.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ka o mini Sool labi, ka Sool ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: So Samuel went back with him, and Saul worshiped the Lord .

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni dini ka yi lee bɔra: Yi bɔri ni n ʒila fiɛbiga ka yi sanna bee yi bɔri ni n ʒila yurilim mini tarimtali kana?.
en: Which do you want? Should I come to you with a big stick to punish you, or with love and a gentle spirit?.

dag: Ka o daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom; o daa ʒili tɔbbihi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣilikam. Ka Ɛdomnim maa zaa daa leei ŋun Dauda ni su shɛba. Ka Yawɛ daa kul tiri Dauda nasara luɣ shɛlikam zaa o ni chaŋ.
en: David left soldiers all through Edom, and the people of Edom had to accept him as their ruler. Wherever David went, the Lord helped him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ni bɔhim n niriba maa soya ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka zaŋdi n yuli pɔri bɛ pɔri yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi n niriba maa ka bɛ pɔri Baal shɛm la, dindina bɛ ni pahi n niriba ni.
en: And then, if they will learn the ways of my people, to make a solemn pledge in my name, As the LORD lives, just as they once taught my people to swear to Baal, then they will be built up in the midst of my people.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim daa ti chɛ Naawuni maŋli jɛmbu ka di yuui pam, ka mi ka maligumaana ŋun ni wuhiri ba; ka daa bi lan doli zaligu yaha.
en: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila yɛla pili ma. Yaɣimɛra mini yaɣiri pala yim. Bɛ ni mali binshɛli ku tooi yɛli ŋun mal li, Pa nyini m-mali ma; bee bɛ ni nam bin so ku tooi yɛli ŋun nam o, A bi nam ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You turn things upside down. You think the clay is equal to the potter. You think that something that is made can tell the one who made it, You did not make me! This is like a pot telling its maker, You know nothing.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa lo daantalisi din gili dundɔŋ maa zaa ti nyɛla anzinfa ka di bansi ti nyɛ anzinfa, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: All the posts around the courtyard will have silver bands, silver hooks, and copper bases.

dag: Tɛhimiya o ni daa di wahala alahichinim bɛn daa je o nuu ni shɛm yɛla, ka di chɛ ka yi ku gbarigi ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Think about Jesus. He patiently endured the angry insults that sinful people were shouting at him. Think about him so that you wont get discouraged and stop trying.

dag: Zɔnim shɛb zaŋla zɔtali yɛla niŋ asahi, amaa zɔ maŋli so beni gari nir mabia gba.
en: Some friends are fun to be with, but a true friend can be better than a brother.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-bo li ti ba. Ŋuna n-niŋ lala ni o vuui bɛ barinyubo shɛli bɛ ni nyuri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni tum shɛli polo la, ka dihi bɛ ni tibigi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni vi.
en: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.

dag: N daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi kaman n ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tuuli la. Ka Yawɛ daa lan deei n suhigu, ka daa bi lan lo ni o kun ya.
en: When I had taken the second set of stones up the mountain, I spent days and nights there, just as I had done before. Once again, the Lord answered my prayer and did not destroy you.

dag: Ka Amazia daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-gari tooni zaŋ o niriba maa chaŋ Yalim Vinvamli la ni nti ku Ɛdomnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Amaziah courageously led his people to the Salt Valley, where they killed ten thousand people from Seir.

dag: Hɛman bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani n-daa nyɛ: Bukia mini Matania ni Uziɛl ni Shɛbuɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Hanania ni Hanani ni Ɛliata ni Gidalit ni Romamtiɛza ni Jɔshibɛkasha ni Mallɔti ni Hɔtir ni Mahaziɔt.
en: Hemans sons who served were Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael, and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbaai nyin Pashihur mini bɛn be a yiŋ zaa daba n-zaŋ ya kuli Babilɔn, ka a min a zɔnim zaa ti kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣi ya nimaani. A zɔnim shɛba a ni yi tɔɣisiri ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la.
en: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried.

dag: Ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-lu naa sizuura, ka naa bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: and bowed down. What can I do for you? David asked.

dag: Ka dɔro daa ti gbaag o ka o kpi, ka bɛ suug o kom n-zaŋ o kpɛhi jirambisa zuɣusaa duu ti sɔŋ.
en: About that time, though, she became so ill that she died. After they washed her body, they laid her in an upstairs room.

dag: Jona ni daa piligi chani gindi tiŋ maa, o daa chanimi ka kuhiri yɛra, Di kpalim biɛɣ pihinahi ka Naawuni chɛ ka Ninive lɛb pili. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ti paai dahin yini chandi tariga.
en: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed.

dag: Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani, ka Ɛdom nyɛ n ni pirigiri n namda sɔŋdi luɣ shɛli; n ni ŋme nasaridibo kuŋa m-bahi Filistianim zuɣu.
en: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.

dag: M bilim ni zaa, n nyɛla nandahimalana ka miri kum. A ni kpɛhi ma dabiɛm shɛli chɛ ka n di wahala, ka n lan ka tahima.
en: I have been sick and weak since I was young. I have suffered your anger, and I am helpless.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Amnɔn daa kul lan je Tama yɛlli zaa, hal ka o ni daa je o shɛm maa gar o ni daa yur o shɛm la gba. Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim yi.
en: Then Amnon was filled with a deep hatred for her; he hated her now even more than he had loved her before. He said to her, Get out.

dag: Yi jɛmdila yi ni ʒi so, amaa tinim jɛmdila ti ni mi so, dama Yɛhudianim zuliya ni ka tiliginsim yina;.
en: You Samaritans worship something you dont understand. We Jews understand what we worship, since salvation comes from the Jews.

dag: Ka pumahigu mini niŋgbun duɣili daa ti gbaag o ba, ka Pool daa kpe nti kaag o ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti o ka o kpaŋ zaa.
en: Publius father was bedridden, sick with a fever and dysentery. Paul went to see him and prayed. He placed his hand on him and healed him.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N suhu zaa kul yɛmi ni m mini ya laɣim di Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ bindirigu ka n naanyi di wahala.
en: He said to them, I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima n-nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn daŋ gbahi shɛb kuli tinduya ni, ka yi churi puhibu mini yi suhuyubu maa zani tariga.
en: You people are stretched out on your couches now, but your good times will end. You will be taken away as prisoners to a foreign country, and you will be some of the first people taken.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun daa pii Ibram ka yih o Ur din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; ka daa taɣ o yuli m-bol o Ibrahimma.
en: You are the Lord , the God who chose Abram. You led him from Ur in Babylonia. You changed his name to Abraham.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida mini sipirɛs ni ɛligum dakuɣiri ti ma na. N ni chɛ ka n niriba kana ti pah a niriba zuɣu, dama m mi ni a niriba maa mi Lɛbanɔn dakuɣiri maa ŋmabu pam.
en: Also send me cedar, cypress, and sandalwood logs from Lebanon. I know your servants know how to cut Lebanese timber, so my servants will work with your servants.

dag: Dama naa maa niŋla Yawɛ naani; ka Zallakudura Naa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu chɛ ka binshɛli ku tooi vuug o.
en: The king trusts in the Lord , and the faithful love of God Most High will keep him from falling.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yiko daa kpe Ilaija ni, ka o voog o shɛlɔrigu lo n-zo n-daŋ Ɛhab tooni ti paai Jɛziriil dunɔdali gbini.
en: but the LORDs power strengthened Elijah. He gathered up his clothes and ran in front of Ahab until he came to Jezreel.

dag: Ka bɛ lan garigi yɛli naa yaha, Naa, a yi ni yɛli ti a zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ti mi ni wuh a di gbinni.
en: Your Majesty, they said, if you will only tell us your dream, we will interpret it for you.

dag: Ka o ti yihi bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini sara maligu kam puuni n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka di leei maligumaana ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa ʒim kpaai vie maa dini.
en: You shall present one part of each kind of bread as a special contribution to the Lord ; it belongs to the priest who takes the blood of the animal and throws it against the altar.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yooi dunoli ni o yina chaŋ, ka nya ka o mam maa dola yil maa samban dunol ni, ka o nuhi teei tiri dunoli polo.
en: About that time, her husband woke up and got ready to leave. He opened the door and went outside, where he found his wife lying at the door with her hands on the doorstep.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kumdi bɔri sɔŋsim, Yawɛ wumda, ka yihiri ba bɛ muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.

dag: Nyin ka ti yaannim daa niŋ naani; ka bɛ ni daa niŋ a naani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka a tiligi ba.
en: Our ancestors put their trust in you; they trusted you, and you saved them.

dag: Ti daa tum alahichi, ka daa tum tuumbiɛri mini tuun shɛŋa din bi tuhi. Ti daa zaɣis a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛli, ka daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ a ni wuhi ti din tuhi shɛli tumbu.
en: We have sinned, we have been evil, we have done wrong. We have rejected what you commanded us to do and have turned away from what you showed us was right.

dag: Pa kapinta bia la m-bala? Pa o ma yuli m-booni Mariama la? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ni Saimɔn ni Judas la?.
en: Isn't he the carpenter's son? Isn't Mary his mother, and aren't James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas his brothers?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di bindirigu ka nyu n-naai Shilo maa nyaaŋa, ka Hanna suhu daa saɣim pam ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ tooni ti suh o, ka kum pam. Di saha Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daa ʒila kuɣ zuɣu Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tab dunoli.
en: When the sacrifice had been offered, and they had eaten the meal, Hannah got up and went to pray. Eli was sitting in his chair near the door to the place of worship.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiri shɛli yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina di lan pala alikauli lɔbu zuɣu; amaa Naawuni daa zaŋ li tila ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: Can following the law give us the blessing God promised? If we could receive it by following the law, then it would not be Gods promise that brings it to us. But God freely gave his blessings to Abraham through the promise God made.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba, amaa nyin cham ti moli Naawuni nam molo.
en: But Jesus said to him, Let the people who are dead bury their own dead. You must go and tell about Gods kingdom.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa chɛ bɛ ni gbahi shɛb maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa zaa zali kpamba maa mini zama maa zaa tooni.
en: So the warriors released the captives and brought the loot before the officers and the whole assembly.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man gba zo Ninive din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ nambɔɣu gari lala? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni kalinli gari tuhi kɔbiga ni pisi, ka nyɛ bɛn ʒi bɛ tooni ni bɛ nyaaŋa m-pahi biŋkɔbiri pam zuɣu.
en: How much more, then, should I have pity on Nineveh, that great city. After all, it has more than , innocent children in it, as well as many animals.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni, ka n ŋme a luhi, ka ŋmaag a zuɣu, ka zaŋ Filistia tɔbbi kpima pam niŋgbuna ti juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri. Ka dunia zaa baŋ ni Naawuni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni;.
en: Today the Lord will let me defeat you. I will kill you. I will cut off your head and feed your body to the birds and wild animals. And we will do the same thing to all the other Philistines too. Then all the world will know there is a God in Israel.

dag: Ka mɔɣili dɔni bihigu tiŋgban tulli shee; ka tiŋgban kuŋ shee leei kɔbil nina. Ka mɔri zooi lim kunduna ni daa yi be luɣ shɛli.
en: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground, fountains of water. The jackals habitat, a pasture; grass will become reeds and rushes.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Rɛkab min o mabia Baana bɛn daa nyɛ Rimɔn Bɛrɔt nir la bihi maa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiligi ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: David answered Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, As surely as the LORD lives, who has rescued me from all kinds of trouble, he told them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shihi zaa;.
en: They made a covenant to seek the LORD, the God of their ancestors, with all their heart and all their being.

dag: Bɛ lubu vuri ni ti dam tiŋgbani, ka bɛ kuhigu ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: When Edom falls, there will be such a noise that the entire earth will shake, and the cries of alarm will be heard as far away as the Gulf of Aqaba.

dag: ŋun be chɛchɛbuŋ ni zuɣusaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Wummiya o kukoli din mali kpiɔŋ la tahigu.
en: Sing to him who rides his chariot through the ancient skies. Listen to his powerful voice!.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa darigi cheeicheei bɛ binyɛra, ka kpuɣi bɛ ʒiya pa bɛ bunsi zuɣu ŋ-ŋmaligi lab tiŋ maa ni.
en: At this, they tore their clothing. Then everyone loaded their donkeys, and they returned to the city.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti kul zaŋdi wumpaɣibo kaman sara la paɣiri Naawuni, dina n-nyɛ ti yaai ti noya kahigi wuhi ni ti tibigir o yuli.
en: So through Jesus we should never stop offering our sacrifice to God. That sacrifice is our praise, coming from lips that speak his name.

dag: Bɛ boonila niriba duri zoya zuɣu; nimaani ka bɛ maani sara din tuhi. Dama teeku puuni ka bɛ nyari bɛ daazichi, ka nyari azichi sɔɣira bihigu ni.
en: They invite foreigners to their mountain And offer the right sacrifices there. They get their wealth from the sea And from the sand along the shore.
