dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibisi pihita mini bipuɣinsi pihita. Ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣinsi pihita maa ti dɔbba kpaŋa bɛn pa o daŋ puuni niriba; ka daa bo paɣiba pihita kpaŋ na ti ti o bidibisi maa mi. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayopɔin.
en: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He gave his daughters in marriage outside the clan and brought thirty young women from outside the clan for his sons to marry. Ibzan led Israel for seven years.

dag: Ɛlikana daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli daa boonila Hanna, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Pɛnina. Pɛnina n-daa nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi bihi, amaa ka Hanna ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia.
en: Elkanah had two wives, one named Hannah and the other named Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah didnt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Ka bɛ dimnim zaa puuni ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tooi zani bɛ tooni, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: And the Lord allowed them to have peace on all sides of their land, just as he had promised their ancestors. None of their enemies defeated them. The Lord allowed the Israelites to defeat every enemy.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga m-bol o yuli Daina.
en: Later, Leah gave birth to a daughter. She named her Dinah.

dag: Hɔdia paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Naham tizɔpaɣ la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gamnim bɛn daa be Kɛila la yaannim mini Maakatinim bɛn daa be Ɛshitɛmɔa la yaannima.
en: The family of his Judean wife, the sister of Naham, Keilahs father the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

dag: Lihimi n nahiŋgu mini n wahala ŋɔ, ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: Look at my suffering and trouble— forgive all my sins!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman tuŋ wula ni be mɔɣu ni tihi ni ka n zaŋ li ti ka bɛ maani buɣim shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: So people throw the pieces of wood from a grapevine into the fire. It is just like wood from any other tree in the forest. In the same way I will throw the people living in Jerusalem into the fire! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Solɔɣu ni ti be nimaani ka di yuli booni Soli din be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be daɣiri ni ti ku doli soli maa; ka sochanda ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu gba ti ku yirigi soli maa zuɣu.
en: There will be a highway there, called The Road of Holiness. No sinner will ever travel that road; no fools will mislead those who follow it.

dag: Barinyuriba ku zan a tooni; a mi je tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: Arrogant people wont last long in your sight; you hate all evildoers.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka bɛ gbaai yibu yinoyino. Ninkura n-daa daŋ yibu; ka di ti kpalimla Yisa kɔŋko, ka paɣ maa ʒe o tooni.
en: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m pah a ninvuɣ gahinda maa zuɣu tɔŋ, ka pah a zuliya zuɣu nya suhupiɛlli, ka pah a niriba zuɣu tibig a.
en: Let me see the prosperity of your people and share in the happiness of your nation, in the glad pride of those who belong to you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi ʒe yim ku tɔŋ. Ka ŋunkam ŋmari ʒiri kul bela barina ni.
en: Those with crooked hearts wont prosper, and those with twisted tongues will fall into trouble.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya maa, tuuli dini daa gbaala Asaf yiŋ Yisifu, ka din pah ayi daa gbaai Gɛdalia min o mabihi ni o bidibisi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: The first one chosen was Asaph . Second, there were men chosen from Gedaliahs sons and relatives.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa garigi bɔhi Yawɛ, Ayuba Naawuni zɔbo maa nyɛla yoli?.
en: Satan answered the Lord , But Job has a good reason to respect you.

dag: Ka Ibram daa niŋ Yawɛ yɛda, ka Yawɛ daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: Abram believed the Lord , so the Lord was pleased with him and accepted him.

dag: Yi Duuma ni chɛ ka yi nya wahala ni nahiŋgu, amaa ŋuna ŋun maŋmaŋ nyɛ yi karimba maa ku lan sɔɣi ka chɛn ya, amaa o ni chɛ ka yi nini nya o, ka o wuhi ya.
en: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.

dag: A mali tumtumdiba pam; kuɣikpɛriba mini tammɛriba ni kapintanima ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim balibu kam zaa tumtumdiba bɛn ka kalinli.
en: You also have innumerable people to do the work: stonecutters, masons, and carpenters with every skill required for any task.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: He told them, Go into the next village, where you will find a young donkey that has never been ridden. Untie the donkey and bring it here.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda yi mali pakoya o dɔɣiriba ni, di simdi ni o lihiri ba, ka di zaŋ di yɛla ʒili cheechi, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka cheechi mi tooi lihi pako shɛb bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her family, she should take care of them herself. Then the church will not have that burden and will be able to care for the widows who have no one else to help them.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn gbib o daalikauli, ka dol o zaligunima.
en: of those who are true to his covenant and who faithfully obey his commands.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni yino kuli ti zaŋ yi tizo maa na, ka yinim bɛn kpalim be sarika ni, ka ti buɣisi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa nya yɛlimaŋli ka yi yɛli maa, di yi pa lala, m po Firawuna ni yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: One of you must go back to get your youngest brother while the rest of you stay here in prison. Then we can prove whether you are telling the truth or not. If you are not telling the truth, then by Pharaoh, I swear that you are spies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord commanded Moses.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu; amaa di daba ata dali, o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: and then they will hand him over to foreigners who will make fun of him. They will beat him and nail him to a cross. But on the third day he will rise from death.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa guli ni o yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di yuŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni gbibi shɛli, ka di nyɛ Yawɛ guhibu yuŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: For the LORD, that was a night of intent watching, to bring them out of the land of Egypt. For all Israelites in every generation, this same night is a time of intent watching to honor the LORD.

dag: Ka o mini gbuɣima daa doli, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu ka ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: He hunted with the adult lions and became a strong young lion. He learned to catch his food. He killed and ate a man.

dag: Amaa nyin tum alahichi n-gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni. A daai ma baɣil a nyaaŋa ka me buɣa, ka mali binnana zali n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: But you have sinned worse than anyone who ruled before you. You stopped following me and made other gods for yourself. You made those statues to make me angry.

dag: Ti mabi shɛb ni daa ti paana nti yɛl a ni doli yɛlimaŋli shɛm min a ni shiri kul be yɛlimaŋli maa ni sahakam shɛm, di daa niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam.
en: Some believers came and told me about the truth in your life. They told me that you continue to follow the way of truth. This made me very happy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi piim fɔntins ata maa.
en: That is why I commanded you to choose three special cities.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tumd alahiziba tumtumsa; ka nyɛ ŋun kahig a yiko tuma wuhi zuliya shɛba.
en: You are the God who works miracles; you showed your might among the nations.

dag: Amaa man kul ni lihirila Yawɛ. N ni guhirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligir ŋɔ. N Naawuni ni wum n suhigu.
en: So I will look to the Lord for help. I will wait for God to save me. My God will hear me.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti ni mali tahima shɛli yɛda la kirikiri ka di viini ginda, dama ŋun lo ti alikauli maa nyɛla ŋun kul ʒe yim.
en: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, dindina ŋun yom di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi ka di leeg o dini.
en: If you decide to buy back the land, you must pay the price plus an additional percent.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zal o tumtumdiba zaa bɛn ʒe o dunol ni ni bɛ tim Haman jilima n-damdir o tiŋa. Amaa ka Mɔdɛkai ŋun daa zaɣisi ni o ku damd o tiŋa bee n-ti o jilima.
en: All the kings leaders at the kings gate would bow down and give honor to Haman. This is what the king commanded them to do. But Mordecai refused to bow down or give honor to Haman.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa laɣim taba n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama.
en: So all the Israelite elders got together and went to Samuel at Ramah.

dag: Ka naazɔnim maa daa yɛl o, Haman be kpe; o ʒe zɔŋ ni. Ka naa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiy o ni o kpɛmina.
en: The kings servants said, Haman is standing in the courtyard. So the king said, Bring him in.

dag: Dama a suhuyiɣisili chɛmi ka ti dabisa garita; ti yuma kul naarimi kaman siɣimbu la.
en: Your anger can end our life. Our lives fade away like a whisper.

dag: Sulemaana daa dari yuri la Ijipti mini Silisia. O kɔhigɔriba n-daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The king's agents controlled the export of horses from Musri and Cilicia.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, A na ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba balibu pam mini zuliya pam ni tinzun yɛligu pam nima ni nanim pam polo.
en: Then I was told, You must prophesy again about many races of people, many nations, languages, and rulers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ lala. Shɛb daa pihi pampam, ka shɛb mi pihi biɛlabiɛla.
en: The Israelites did this, some gathering more, others less.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tɔbu lu Sirianim zuɣu. Tɔbu lu bɛn be Babilɔn zuɣu, ka lu bɛ kpambaliba mini bɛ yɛnnim zuɣu.
en: I have declared war on you, your officials, and advisors.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli soli din tuhi nyɛla bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛriyoli ʒiɛmd o mi.
en: Those who walk with integrity fear the LORD, but those who take a crooked path despise him.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri piniyini ka bɛ boon o Shɛbat la biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti man Anabi Zakaria Bɛrɛkia bia ŋun nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la.
en: On the th day of the eleventh month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, Zechariah received another message from the Lord . This is the message:.

dag: ka kuhiri yɛri zoya maa mini tampima maa, Lumiya ti zuɣu na n-lim ti ka ti sɔɣi yi ni, ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni nini ku lan nya ti, ka Piɛbil ŋɔ mi suhuyiɣisili yɛlli ŋɔ ku paai ti.
en: They called to the mountains and the rocks, Fall on us and hide us from the face of the one seated on the throne and from the Lambs wrath!.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Trust in the Lord , you people of Israel. He helps you and protects you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O nyɛla tɔbutuhira ŋun tiri nasara. O ni ti di dari yi zuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. O ni ti zaŋ ya leei ninvuɣ pala o yurilim puuni. O ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli yi zuɣu.
en: The Lord your God is with you; his power gives you victory. The Lord will take delight in you, and in his love he will give you new life. He will sing and be joyful over you.

dag: Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa biɛ ŋ-kpaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa sabi sabbu ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: A composition by Judahs King Hezekiah when he was sick and then recovered from his sickness.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli ma, Daadam, lihimi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni yɛn wuh a binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa ni. Dama n zaŋ a mi ka kpe na ni n ti wuh a li. Yɛlim Izraɛlnim a ni nya shɛli maa zaa.
en: The man said, Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa kani n-lo o suhu ni n-tum zaɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani n-lan paai Ɛhab ŋun paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpaŋs o ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: Truly there has never been anyone like Ahab who sold out by doing evil in the LORDs eyes—evil that his wife Jezebel led him to do.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yisifu ni tɔɣisi ba n-yɛl o, ka o nya tɔroko shɛŋa Yisifu ni daa zaŋ ti na ni bɛ ti kpuɣ o na la, ka o suhu daa kpaŋ;.
en: Then they told him everything Joseph had said. When he saw the wagons Joseph had sent, he felt much better.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ni leei faralana ni vidira, amaa ŋun deeri wuhibu ni nya jilima.
en: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa be nimaani maa ka anab so ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa yi Judia na.
en: After staying there for several days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

dag: ka zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛl la ni be adaka shɛl ni la niŋ di puuni.
en: There Ive placed the chest that contains the covenant that the LORD made with the Israelites.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zɔri, niŋm a ni kana ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Di saha ka salo maa dii kana ti gbaai Yisa.
en: Jesus answered, Friend, do the thing you came to do. Then the men came and grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa teei Yisa yɛligu maa.
en: Then they remembered what Jesus had said.

dag: Ka o yi bi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuuni maa puuni, dindina yili din be bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni maa ni leela ŋun da li maa dini sahakam o ʒiɛman ni, ka di bi simdi ka bɛ ti deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: But if the owner does not buy back the house before a full year is finished, the house that is in the walled city will belong to the one who bought it and to their descendants. The house will not go back to the first owner at the time of Jubilee.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa mali Shɛkɛm din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni la me m-be nimaani; ka daa ti lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti me Pɛnuɛl.
en: Jeroboam rebuilt Shechem in Ephraim and made it a stronger town, then he moved there. He also fortified the town of Penuel.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa ni barinyuriba, amaa bɛ barinyubo maa nyɛla yoli.
en: The people of Judah say, We have heard how proud the people of Moab are. We know that they are arrogant and conceited, but their boasts are empty.

dag: Bɛn daa ʒi bindirigu maa dibu shee maa ni so daa bi baŋ din chɛ ka o yɛli Judas lala maa.
en: No one at the table understood why Jesus said this to Judas.

dag: Dinzuɣu cheechi zaa yi ti laɣim ka sokam tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka bɛn ka yi kalinli ni mini bɛn bi niŋ yɛda kpɛna, bɛ ku yɛli ni yi kpɛla yinyari?.
en: So suppose that the whole church is meeting and everyone is speaking in tongues. If people come in who are outsiders or unbelievers, wont they say that you are out of your minds?.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ chaŋ ha nti lan gili Baala wulinluhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛdom zoya ni n-zaŋ chaŋ hal ti baɣisi Jiarim Zoli nuzaa polo gari bee din nyɛ Chɛsalɔn la, ka di lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-gari chaŋ ti baɣisi Timna gari.
en: where it circled west of Baalah toward the hill country of Edom, went on the north side of Mount Jearim , down to Beth Shemesh, and on past Timnah.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe Odɛd bia Azaria ni.
en: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anahi.
en: There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the fourth day.

dag: Nyin ŋun lihiri daadamnim ŋɔ, n yi tumla alahichi, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum a? Bɔ n-chɛ ka a kul zaŋ dolila mani? Ka a kul liritila mani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka n yɛla muɣis a?.
en: Are you harmed by my sin, you jailer? Why use me for your target practice? Am I so great a burden to you?.

dag: Chɛ ka n doli a yɛlimaŋli la, ka a wuhi ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni. Nyin ka n niŋ naani dabisili puuni zaa.
en: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛman ni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani baɣisiri Galili Teeku n-daa ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ti ʒini.
en: Jesus moved on from there along the shore of the Galilee Sea. He went up a mountain and sat down.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa ka di ti tamya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gbibbu.
en: Make certain that you do not forget the Lord your God; do not fail to obey any of his laws that I am giving you today.

dag: Ti daa pun yɛli ya ni yi miri ka yi mali Yisa yuli ŋɔ yihiri waazu tiri niriba, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ka bahi zaŋ li moli gili Jɛrusalɛm zaa, ka bɔri ni yi zaŋ o kum zambu ʒil ti.
en: We gave you strict orders not to teach in the name of this man, he said; but see what you have done! You have spread your teaching all over Jerusalem, and you want to make us responsible for his death.

dag: Ka a saa tahibu be pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni, ka a saa nyaɣisibu neei dunia ŋɔ ni zaa, ka dunia sɔhiri ka damda.
en: There were loud claps of thunder. Lightning lit up the world. The earth shook and trembled.

dag: fɔntiŋ kara mini fɔndi zaa din baɣi Ashidɔd la m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: From Ekron toward the sea, everything that was near Ashdod and its surrounding areas.

dag: gol so ŋun daa pahir ayɔbu biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali, Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi la saha.
en: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yihi yɛli ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu ka wumdi tirila shi biɛri bɛn yɔhindi niriba la ka ni dolila alizin biɛri wuhibu.
en: The Spirit says clearly that some people will abandon the faith in later times; they will obey lying spirits and follow the teachings of demons.

dag: Amiramnim mini Izarinim ni Hiburɔnnim ni Uziɛlinim ni:.
en: From the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and Uzzielites.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tulila zaliŋ, ka bi tuli viɛnyɛliŋga ka mi bi mahi la zuɣu, n ni tuhi ya n nol ni bahi.
en: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ. Ka Itiɔpia namɔɣili so ŋun daa su Kandɛse ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia napaɣ la azichi fukumsi daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti jɛm Naawuni.
en: So he did. Meanwhile, an Ethiopian man was on his way home from Jerusalem, where he had come to worship. He was a eunuch and an official responsible for the entire treasury of Candace.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa kpi ti zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim be, di yi nyɛ ti bela ti nyɛviya ni bee ti yi gbihirila kum puuni.
en: who died for us in order that we might live together with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.

dag: Di ni sabi ni ti Duuma san la, kpe ŋɔ di gbinni nyɛla Naawuni Shia sani; ka ti Duuma Shia maa ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yolisim be.
en: The Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

dag: Di saha n ni ti darigi bɛn muɣisiri ya la tibili, ka tiligi gbariti, ka laɣim bɛ ni kari shɛb bahi la, ka chɛ ka bɛ vi leei jilima, ka bɛ yuli du dunia zaa ni.
en: The time is coming! I will punish your oppressors; I will rescue all the lame and bring the exiles home. I will turn their shame to honor, and all the world will praise them.

dag: Amaa dabeenzɔriba mini bɛn ka yɛda ni halibiɛrinima ni ninvuɣ kuriba ni zinaniŋdiba ni baɣibuɣiriba ni buɣijɛmdiba ni ʒiŋmariba zaa biɛhigu shee ni ti nyɛla buɣim teeku din buɣim nyɛ chilibi buɣim din dir ni; di ni kpɛbu n-nyɛ kum din pahi buyi la.
en: But cowards, traitors, perverts, murderers, the immoral, those who practice magic, those who worship idols, and all liars—the place for them is the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ni nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm, ka ninvuɣ suma nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, o ni be? O ku be, o ni tum binshɛŋa din chihiri ŋɔ zaa zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani o ni kpi. Ka o kum maa taali ni ʒi omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: and charges high interest when lending money. An evil man like that will certainly not live. He is the one who has done these horrible sins, so it's his own fault that he will be put to death.

dag: Ka nyini m bia, bɛ ni ti boon a la Zallakudura Naa daanabi, dama a ni ti daŋ ti Duuma tooni nti mal o soya gu o;.
en: You, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High God. You will go ahead of the Lord to prepare his road for him.

dag: Amaa ka yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Pumpɔŋɔ yinim Izraɛlnima wummiya, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yinima ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: But you say, What the Lord does isn't right. Listen to me, you Israelites. Do you think my way of doing things isn't right? It is your way that isn't right.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ zaliya ni yi zaŋ bindirigu maa lita ayi zuɣu zali yi bihi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka bɛ ti nya n ni daa zaŋ bindir shɛli dihiri ya tiŋgban nɛli ni saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: Moses said, This is what the LORD has commanded: Let an omer of it be kept safe for future generations so that they can see the food that I used to feed you in the desert when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni ku dɔɣi bihi, ka buɣim ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei birapu yiya.
en: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes.

dag: Yawɛ wumdi nandaamba suhigu, ka bi tamd o niriba bɛn be sarika ni yɛla.
en: The Lord listens to poor, helpless people. He does not turn away from those who are in prison.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la, Yi gba ni chɛ ma dolibu.
en: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tahi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini nanim ni zuɣulaannim sani, yin di ti bɔhiri yi suhuri yi ni yɛn garigi shɛm bee yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: When they bring you before the synagogues, rulers, and authorities, dont worry about how to defend yourself or what you should say.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ zaa daa dii pirigi bɛ binyɛra n-yɛrigi sɔŋ dunɔdura zuɣu ni o no li gari, ka piɛb kikaa ka kuhi yɛli, Jɛhu n-nyɛ naa.
en: Then each man quickly took his cloak and put it beneath Jehu on the paved steps. They blew a trumpet and said, Jehu has become king.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni tooi yɛli naa, A nyɛla ninvuɣ yoli ka yɛli kpambaliba, Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.

dag: Bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba. Yi na mi n-nya ka goo wali gaya bee ka pirinkpaŋ wali fiig tia wala?.
en: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.

dag: A yɛn gbibila so kur shɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni daa doli la?.
en: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners.

dag: Na kul yum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la, ka ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la polo.
en: Extend your faithful love to those who know you; extend your righteousness to those whose heart is right.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi be fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ŋɔ, yi bi wum fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm? Yɛlimiya ma!.
en: Tell me—those of you who want to be under the Law—dont you listen to the Law?.

dag: Aai! N yɛri ya mi ni shee yi niŋ tuuba, di yi pa lala yi zaa gba ni ti bahi yoli.
en: No indeed! And I tell you that if you do not turn from your sins, you will all die as they did.

dag: Areebia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Dɛdannim sochandiba bɛn dooni Areebia mɔɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: This is a message about Arabia: A caravan from Dedan spent the night near some trees in the Arabian Desert.

dag: ka malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will offer burnt offerings. Their smell will please the Lord . You will offer bull, ram, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn bah o ka o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka di muɣis a, dama o tum tuma yuma ayɔbu ti a, ka di gar a ni di yɛn zaŋ laɣ shɛli bu padiriba paa ʒii buyi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ a tuuni kam ni.
en: Dont consider it a hardship to set these servants free from your service, because they worked for you for six years—at a value double that of a paid worker. The LORD your God will bless you in everything that you do.

dag: Judas daa nyɛla ti ni yino, ka o nuu daa be ti tuma ŋɔ ni.
en: This happened even though he was one of us and received a share of this ministry. .

dag: Di tiwul kpana kuumi kab lu, ka paɣiba va li ti mali buɣim. Dama niriba maa nyɛla bɛn bi baŋdi shɛli, dinzuɣu ŋun nam ba maa ku zo ba nambɔɣu bee n-niŋ ba nirilim.
en: The vines will become dry, and the branches will break off. Women will use them for firewood. The people refuse to understand. So God, their Maker, will not comfort them or be kind to them.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla: Miriya ka yi po alizanda bee dunia ŋɔ bee m-po pɔ shɛli pahi. Chɛliya ka yi Iin kul nyɛla Iin, ka yi Aai mi kul nyɛla Aai, ka di chɛ ka yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: Most important, my brothers and sisters, never make a solemn pledge—neither by heaven nor earth, nor by anything else. Instead, speak with a simple Yes or No, or else you may fall under judgment.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a ni kari Ohola mini Oholiba saria, ka yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa?.
en: Then the LORD said to me, Human one, judge Oholah and Oholibah, and make known their detestable practices to them.

dag: Dama bɔhimi ninkura nya bɛ yaannim ni daa mi shɛli.
en: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ yuuni ni pirigili nimaani n-wuhiri niriba Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Paul stayed there for a year and a half teaching Gods message to the people.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: Then in their trouble they called to the Lord , and he saved them from their distress.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu. Ka o daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, Kulimi ti kpari amaŋ niŋ a yiŋa.
en: but God's spirit entered me and raised me to my feet. The Lord said to me, Go home and shut yourself up in the house.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi chɛ ba bahi mɔɣu maa ni. Sagban shɛli din daa wuhiri ba sol la daa bi vuui ka chɛ ba wuntaŋ ni, ka buɣim din daa ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba soli la gba daa bi chɛ ba.
en: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.

dag: N daa bi tim anabinim maa, amaa ka bɛ yiɣisi guui chaŋ. N daa bi zaŋ n yɛligu ti ba, amaa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: I did not send those prophets, but they ran to tell their messages. I did not speak to them, but they spoke in my name.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan yɛli Yisifu, N daa bi tɛhi ni n ni lan nya a ni n nini, amaa ka Naawuni mi ti chɛ ka n nya a bihi gba.
en: Israel said to Joseph, I didnt expect Id see your face, but now God has shown me your children too.

dag: Amaa di ni chɛri ka daadamnim tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni doo kam mal o dahalali paɣa, ka paɣ kam mi mal o dahalali yidana.
en: Each man should have his own wife, and each woman should have her own husband because of sexual immorality.

dag: Bɛn mali suhupiɛlli, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu m-mali suhupiɛlli; bɛn fabinda, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu fabili.
en: Be happy with those who are happy, weep with those who weep.

dag: Ti yaannim maa ni daa be Ijipti saha shɛl la, bɛ baɣa daa ka a daalahiziba tuma ni. Bɛ daa tam a yurilim maŋli din galisi la yɛla, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ nyin Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: Our ancestors in Egypt did not understand God's wonderful acts; they forgot the many times he showed them his love, and they rebelled against the Almighty at the Red Sea.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Kalidia din nyɛ kɔhigɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ la ni, hal ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi dimbɔŋɔ gba.
en: You were also a prostitute for the Babylonians, that nation of merchants, but they didn't satisfy you either.

dag: nti zaŋ o leei naa ni o su Giliad mini Ashur ni Jɛziriil ni Ifriim ni Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: and made him king of Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, Benjamin, and all Israel.

dag: Lala ka Naa Sulemaana daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ o ba Dauda ni daa pun bo neen shɛŋa din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni duɣuri ni la shɛŋa ti Naawuni la n-kpɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma duri la ni.
en: When King Solomon finished all the work on the Temple, he placed in the Temple storerooms all the things that his father David had dedicated to the Lord —the silver, gold, and other articles.

dag: Nira ni tooi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Amaa bɛ gbi ma la zamba bɔɣili. Teemi n ni daa zani a tooni n-tɔɣisi bɛ zaɣ viɛlli yɛla shɛm ni di chɛ ka a miligi a suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la.
en: Should evil be returned for good? Yet they have set traps for me. Remember that I stood before you, begging you to be merciful and not to punish them.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee m-bilina zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: But some seeds fell in good soil, and the plants sprouted, grew, and bore grain: some had thirty grains, others sixty, and others one hundred.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: The Master needs it, they answered.

dag: Bɛ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu lu o zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun yɛn fiɣis o zan o nudirigu polo.
en: They said, Choose someone evil to represent him. Let the one at his side really be his accuser.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Ijipti naa Firawuna min o niriba zaa: A galisim lee ŋmanila ŋuni?.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the king of Egypt and his people that I am saying: You are more powerful than anyone on earth. Now listen to this.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka niriba ni ti yɛra, Yawɛ, ti paɣir a! A suhu daa yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu, amaa pumpɔŋɔ a suhu maaya, ka a lan kpaŋsi ti.
en: You will say on that day: I thank you, LORD. Though you were angry with me, your anger turned away and you comforted me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yi samban ni ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa n-kali saŋmarisi, a yi ni tooi kali ba. Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Lala ka a zuliya ti yɛn be.
en: The Lord took him outside and said, Look at the sky and try to count the stars; you will have as many descendants as that.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abiata, N ni daa kul nya Doɛg Ɛdom nir la dindali maa, n daa pun baŋ ni o ni yɛli Sool di yɛla. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun bo kum ti a ba daŋ ŋɔ zaa maa.
en: Then David told Abiathar, I saw Doeg the Edomite at Nob that day. I knew he would tell Saul! I am responsible for the death of your fathers family.

dag: Di saha maa zuliya pam ni ti zo n-ka Yawɛ sanna nti leeg o niriba. Ka ŋun Yawɛ ni be yi sani, ka yi baŋ ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma yi sanna maa.
en: Many nations will be joined to the LORD on that day. They will become my people, and I will dwell among you so you will know that the LORD of heavenly forces sent me to you.

dag: Di saɣi ka so ʒiɛm a a bipalitali zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yɛtɔɣa min a ni niŋdi shɛm ni a yurilim ni a yɛda niŋbu ni a biɛr kasi wuhi ni a biɛhigu nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba ni ni dol shɛli naba.
en: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young, but be an example for the believers in your speech, your conduct, your love, faith, and purity.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa yɛl o ba, N dana, di je suli niŋ ma n ni ku tooi yiɣisi zani a tooni maa zuɣu, dama paɣitali biɛhigu ni ka m be. Ka Leeban daa vihi bo wuni maa ka bi nya li.
en: Rachel said, Father, please don't be angry with me for not getting up; I'm having my period. Laban kept on searching, but still did not find the idols.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yiriŋ nyɛla ŋun mali baŋsim, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali suɣilo nyɛ ŋun mali tɛhi zilima.
en: Wise are those who restrain their talking; people with understanding are coolheaded.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anii nyɛ Jɔhanan, ka ŋun pahi awɛi nyɛ Ɛlizabad.
en: Johanan was the eighth in command. Elzabad was the ninth in command.

dag: Filip daa mali bipuɣins anahi bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba, ka nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: He had four unmarried daughters who were involved in the work of prophecy.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Chɛliya ka o niŋ yomyom n-tum o tuma ka ti nya; kul chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tum o ni lo shɛm ka ti baŋ li.
en: They say, We wish God would hurry and do what he plans to do so that we can see it. Let the plan of the Holy One of Israel happen soon so that we can know what it is.

dag: Ka Musa daa pii asanza niriba Izraɛlnim maa puuni n-zaŋ ba leei niriba maa zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ shɛb su niriba tuhilituhili, ka shɛb su niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, ka shɛb su niriba pihinunu ka shɛb mi su niriba piapia fukumsi.
en: Moses chose good men from among the Israelites. He made them leaders over the people. There were rulers over people, people, people, and ten people.

dag: ka din pahi pisiyinika gbaai Pɛtahia, ka din pahi pisi gbaai Jɛhɛzikɛl.
en: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel.

dag: ka yɛli, Tibigimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma n-chɛ ka o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali ŋɔ. O daa yɛliya.
en: He said, Praise the Lord God of Israel! He has kept the promise he made to my father David when he said to him.

dag: Bɛ yi ti biɛra, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba, ka tib bɛ dɔriti zaa.
en: The Lord will help them when they are sick and will restore them to health.

dag: Yawɛ po o nudirigu din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛli: N ku lan zaŋ yi chi ti yi dimnim ka bɛ di. M mi ku lan chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ yi ni di wahala tɔɣi yi wain shɛli nyu.
en: The Lord has made a solemn promise, And by his power he will carry it out: Your grain will no longer be food for your enemies, And foreigners will no longer drink your wine.

dag: Yinim Marɛshanima, n ni lan piɛli yi dim ŋun ni nyaŋ ya bahi yi zuɣu. Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mali jilima ni ti zo na ti sɔɣi Adulam.
en: You people who live in Mareshah, I will bring someone against you who will take the things you own. The Glory of Israel will come into Adullam.

dag: Amaa di sabiya ni ninsalinim nambu piligu ni, Naawuni daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: At the beginning of creation, God made them male and female .

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka buɣim daa diri zoli maa, ka alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi la daa be n nuh ayi ni.
en: So I turned and went down the mountain, carrying the two stone tablets on which the covenant was written. Flames of fire were coming from the mountain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛli Firawuna, Tinim a daba ŋɔ kamina ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dama kum maa miiya pam Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti biŋkɔbiri bi nyari mɔri ŋubira; ka pumpɔŋɔ ti suhir a mi ni a chɛ ka ti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni.
en: But in our country all the pastures are dried up, and our sheep have no grass to eat. So we, your servants, have come here. Please let us live in the region of Goshen.

dag: So di bɔr omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko sɔŋsim nyabu, amaa o bom o tab gba sɔŋsim nyabu.
en: No one should look out for their own advantage, but they should look out for each other.

dag: Dahin shɛli man Yawɛ ni ti yɛn kari zuliya kam zaa saria la miriya. Yi ni nya yi ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti yi tab la tatabo. Yi ni daa niŋ shɛm la ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu.
en: The day is coming when I, the Lord , will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla yaɣimɛriba m-be Nɛtaim mini Gɛdɛra, Bɛ daa bela naa sani nimaani n-tumd o tuma.
en: These sons of Shelah were workers who made things from clay. They lived in Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king.

dag: di saha ŋun ti zaŋ sara maa na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ŋmiri li.
en: the one presenting the offering to the LORD will bring a grain offering of one-tenth of a measure of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil.

dag: Tɛra daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Tɛra daa nyɛla Ibram mini Nahɔr ni Haran ba; ka Haran mi daa nyɛ Lɔt ba.
en: These are the descendants of Terah, who was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran was the father of Lot.

dag: Bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina din so maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka n ni lan wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli gari shɛlikam.
en: Continue to give your attention to the spiritual gifts you consider to be the greatest. But now I want to point out a way of life that is even greater.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima alali mali Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: The entire lid of the chest, which was made of pure gold, was the place of mercy.

dag: Ka Ɛr daa nyɛ Jɔshua bia, ka Jɔshua nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza nyɛ Jɔrim bia, ka Jɔrim nyɛ Matat so bia, ka Matat maa mi nyɛ Lɛvi so bia.
en: Joshua, Eliezer, Jorim, Matthat, Levi;.

dag: Ka anab maa daa lan chaŋ do so sani ti yɛl o, Ŋmɛm ma. Ka doo maa daa ŋme o, ŋ-ŋme n-ti o daŋa.
en: Then the prophet found another man and said, Please strike me. He hit the prophet, and the attack left a wound.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yaɣili maa ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm, amaa Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba ni Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ la zaa daa bela bɛmaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi ni ni bɛmaŋmaŋ paliti ni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ yɛl ti mi ni bɛ bɔri ni ti teeri nandaamba bɛn be bɛ ni yɛla, ka n gba suhu ni daa pun ye shɛli niŋbu zuɣu n-daa bala.
en: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu wummi n saɣisigu ŋɔ. Chɛl alahichi tumbu ka tumdila din tuhi, ka zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nambɔɣu. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a nya suhudoo ka di yuui.
en: So, King, please accept my advice. Stop sinning and do what is right. Stop doing bad things and be kind to poor people. Then you might continue to be successful.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Zaŋm a kpamdi ti ma pɔi.
en: Jacob answered, I will give it to you if you give me your rights as the first-born son.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa ti kpe n-zani dunol ni ha, ka Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Nyin Zimiri ŋun ku a dan ŋɔ, Alaafee.
en: As Jehu came through the gate, she called out, You Zimri! You assassin! Why are you here.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa mɔɣisi Barizillai kpariŋ, ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni, ka Barizillai daa labi kul o yiŋa, ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa du.
en: Then David and all of his men crossed the Jordan. He kissed Barzillai and gave him his blessing, and Barzillai went back home.

dag: ni di chɛ ka o yihi ba kpaŋa, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka yihi ba karimbaani ni.
en: God warns people to stop them from doing wrong and to keep them from becoming proud.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Pa Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu la tin ya? Amaa yi ni so bi dol li. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma.
en: Moses gave you the Law, didn't he? But not one of you obeys the Law. Why are you trying to kill me.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli, o ni daa nam ninsala n-niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni maa zuɣu; ka o suhu daa saɣim pam di zuɣu.
en: He was sorry that he had made them.

dag: Tim ba suhusaɣiŋgu; chɛ ka a noli di ba.
en: Curse them and fill them with despair!.

dag: ka a dabisa yi ti pali ka a dɔni a yaannim tooni, n ni piig a bihi ni yino ŋun nyɛ a dahalali bia n-chɛ ka o nam nya zaashee zani.
en: When your life is finished, you will die and be buried with your ancestors. But then I will make one of your own children become the king.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka naa maa paag o sanna ti yɛl o, Ti muɣisigu ŋɔ yila Yawɛ sanna! Ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan yɛn guhi ŋun Yawɛ yaha.
en: He had hardly finished saying this, when the king arrived and said, It's the Lord who has brought this trouble on us! Why should I wait any longer for him to do something.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a ni a niŋ alibarika niŋ man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni din ni chɛ ka n daŋ kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni nyin Naawuni sani; dama nyini Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka a daalibarika kul ni be man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Now, please, bless my family. Let them stand before you and serve you forever. Lord GOD, you yourself said these things. You yourself blessed my family with a blessing that will continue forever.

dag: ni daanya sara maligu bimbini la mini di daanya kurupooti ni di dapuhi ni di zuɣu nɛma zaa ni tahili la ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the copper altar and its copper grate, its poles, and all its equipment, the washbasin with its stand.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi tinzunnim bɛn yi su n niriba maa zuɣu. N ni darigi bɛ tibili. Judanim nyɛla n niriba, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni gbib ba. Bɛna n-yɛn nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri yuri bɛn mali yiko pam.
en: The Lord says, I am very angry with the shepherds. I made them responsible for what happens to my sheep.

dag: Dindali maa ŋun ti be dufahirili zuɣu ka o nɛma be duu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe n-kah o nɛma maa. Ka ŋun mi ti be puu ni di lan kuli yiŋa.
en: On that day if a man is on his roof, he will not have time to go inside and get his things. If a man is in the field, he cannot go back home.

dag: O ni mi bɛ tuma zuɣu, yuŋ ka o ŋmɛri paari ba, ka ŋmɛri kabisiri ba.
en: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.

dag: ka yi nina ni ti yɛn nya shɛli ni ti kpɛhi ya yinyari.
en: The sights your eyes see will drive you insane.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma daa pii ninvuɣ pisopɔin n-tim ba niriba ayiyi ni bɛ daŋ o tooni chaŋ tin shɛŋa zaa omaŋmaŋ gba ni daa yɛn chaŋ.
en: After this the Lord chose another seventy-two men and sent them out two by two, to go ahead of him to every town and place where he himself was about to go.

dag: Ka din pahi piniyini daa gbaai Azarɛl min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the eleventh to Uzziel, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia, ka nyɛ maligumaana la min o daŋ zaa bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba m-be Nɔb maa na. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa sanna.
en: So King Saul sent for the priest Ahimelech and all his relatives, who were also priests in Nob, and they came to him.

dag: Ka Leeban daa zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha ti Reechɛl gba ni o sɔŋd o.
en: Laban had given his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her servant.

dag: Hal Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda, amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Farisiinim zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ yihi li palo, ka Farisiinim maa ti kari ba bɛ jɛmbu duu;.
en: But many people believed in Jesus. Even many of the Jewish leaders believed in him, but they were afraid of the Pharisees, so they did not say openly that they believed. They were afraid they would be ordered to stay out of the synagogue.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mi dol ti chana? Labimiya ka yi mini naa maa ti be, dama yinim nyɛla tinzunnima, ka lan nyɛ yi yanim ni kari shɛb bahi na.
en: and the king said to Ittai, their leader, Why are you going with us? Go back and stay with the new king. You are a foreigner, a refugee away from your own country.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, dini n-lee be asama ni nir yɛli: A yi yɛli gbalikpimalana ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim zaŋ o daamaŋka chaŋ.
en: Is it easier for me to tell this man his sins are forgiven or to tell him to get up and pick up his mat and go on home?.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, a ni ti bela tiŋgbani puuni ha tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka a yɛtɔɣa yiri tiŋgban ni na. A kukoli ni ti ŋmanila kpim kukoli n-yiri tiŋgban ni na. A ti yɛn sɔɣirimi yɛri ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa pii Joɛl bia Hɛman min o mabia Asaf ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɛkia bia la ni Mɛrari bidibisi ni bɛ daŋ ni mabia Ɛtan, ka o nyɛ Kushaya bia la.
en: Then the Levites got Heman and his brothers, Asaph and Ethan. Heman was Joels son. Asaph was Berekiahs son. Ethan was Kushaiahs son. These men were from the Merari tribe.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ti o ni daa nya malaika o yiŋ shɛm, ka o yɛl o ni o timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.

dag: M biɛhigu nyɛla ŋmahinli niriba pam sani, amaa nyini n-nyɛ n sɔɣisili shee din mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Ive become an example to many people because you are my strong refuge.

dag: Zaŋmi n talima ni nyɛ shɛli zal a sani. Ŋuni n-lee beni ŋun ni zani n nyaaŋa?.
en: If you, Lord , don't help, who will pay the price for my release?.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla bɛ ni zɔri so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni, o nyɛla ŋun galisi ni ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm gari bɛnkam zaa gil o.
en: You are feared in the council of the holy ones; they all stand in awe of you.

dag: Ka Dauda nachimba maa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Dauda yuli yɛli Nabal yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka kpalim ʒiɛya guhira.
en: Davids men went to Nabal. They gave his message to Nabal.

dag: Teemiy o daalikauli yɛla sahakam. O ni daa zaŋ yɛligu shɛli zali ʒiɛmana tuhili nim la;.
en: We must never forget his agreement and his promises, not in thousands of years. *.

dag: Niriba ayi yi vara, bɛ ni yino ni luh o kpee, amaa niriba ayi ni tooi luhi ninvuɣ yino. Mih ata gabiga bi chihiri yom.
en: Also, one can be overpowered, but two together can put up resistance. A three-ply cord doesnt easily snap.

dag: Amaa n ni lan chɛ ka bɛ nya tibbu mini alaafee, ka tib ba, ka kahigi tɔŋsim pam mini binshɛŋa din ni taɣi ba barina ni wuhi ba.
en: But I will heal this city and its people and restore them to health. I will show them abundant peace and security.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la, ka zaɣis o zaligunim gba dolibu.
en: Amon left the Lord , the God of his ancestors, and did not live the way the Lord wanted.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla ka mali hal ti baai du teeku yaɣili.
en: Jesus and his followers went across the lake. But the followers forgot to bring bread.

dag: O yi mali bidibiga ka o nyɛ biyariga, ka kuri niriba.
en: But someone like that might have a son who does not do any of these good things. The son steals things and kills people.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri duŋtaabo ni ʒi ba chaŋ, bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku tum din tuhi zuɣu.
en: The bad things that evil people do will destroy them, because they refuse to do what is right.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti be Ɛngɛdi sɔɣisili shee.
en: David left the desert of Maon and went to the fortresses near En Gedi.

dag: Ka lan lihi nya tiŋgbani maa vuhiri bee di nyɛla tiŋgban kpiŋ, ka nya tihi be di ni bee di kani. Niŋmiya suhukpeeni n-ʒi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na. Wain tihi wal daŋda moobu saha n-daa bala.
en: Is the land rich or poor? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous and bring back the lands fruit. It was the season of the first ripe grapes.

dag: A mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni tooi mali jina? A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ din pa yɛlimaŋli leei din tuhi ni tooi mali jina?.
en: Can a wicked ruler be your ally; one who wreaks havoc by means of the law?.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim; bɛ ku zo dabiɛm. Di bahigu ni, bɛ ni ti di nasara bɛ dimnim sani.
en: He is not worried or afraid; he is certain to see his enemies defeated.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tɛhiri yi yɛla, ka o baɣa shiri be yi yɛla ni.
en: I have no one like him. He is a person who genuinely cares about your well-being.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya. Naawuni daa zaŋ ba leeg o bihi ka chɛ ka bɛ mal omaŋmaŋ jilima; ka daa lo ba alikauli ka zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunima ti ba; ka daa wuhi ba o jɛmbu soli ka lo ba alikaulinima.
en: They are Israelites. The adoption as Gods children, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the Law, the worship, and the promises belong to them.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka zuliya balibu kam nianim kpalindi yoli; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm zaani soli.
en: The LORD overrules what the nations plan; he frustrates what the peoples intend to do.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: For everyone who asks, receives. Whoever seeks, finds. And to everyone who knocks, the door is opened.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni bee ka paɣ zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu ka o min o dɔni; di nyɛla biriginsim.
en: Anyone who has sex with an animal is unclean.

dag: Di yuuni maa puuni, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni, ka anabi Hanania daa shiri kpi.
en: Hananiah died in the seventh month of that same year.

dag: Tim ti ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu;.
en: Give us day by day the food we need.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: For they did not dare ask him any more questions.

dag: Amaa shee o di wahala balibu kam pɔi, ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ti zaɣis o.
en: But first he must suffer much and be rejected by the people of this day.

dag: Hiram daa lan me duɣuri, ka mali soobuya mini taha pahi. Lala ka Hiram daa niŋ tum Naa Sulemaana ni daa puh o Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuun shɛŋa maa zaa naai.
en: Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the bowls. So Huram finished all his work on Gods temple for King Solomon.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka saa ku lan min ya, ka yi bindira ku niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kpi yomyom Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: If you do, the Lord will become angry with you. He will hold back the rain, and your ground will become too dry for crops to grow. Then you will soon die there, even though it is a good land that he is giving you.

dag: Amaa dindali maa, n ni woligi Goshɛn, n niriba ni be luɣ shɛli polo la, ka zɔhi maa ti ku be nimaani dina din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: But on that day Ill set apart the land of Goshen, where my people live. No swarms of insects will come there so you will know that I, the LORD, am in this land.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bo kuɣili sa Mizipa mini Jɛshana sunsuuni, ka bol li Ɛbɛnɛza, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kpe ka Yawɛ sɔŋ ti.
en: Then Samuel took a stone, set it up between Mizpah and Shen, and said, The Lord has helped us all the way—and he named it Stone of Help.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ chɛ ka Naawuni yɛligu bi tumdi di tuma yi ni, yi yaannim kal shɛŋa yi ni mali wuhiri niriba la zuɣu. Ka yi lan tumdi tuun shɛŋa din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnim pam.
en: In this way you do away with Gods word in favor of the rules handed down to you, which you pass on to others. And you do a lot of other things just like that.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Zɔri, ŋuni n-lee zaŋ ma leei yi sariakarita bee yi falitarita.
en: Jesus answered, Who gave me the right to settle arguments between you and your brother.

dag: Adin daŋ — kɔbisinahi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: the descendants of Adin:.

dag: Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: Be on your guard against the teachers of the Law, who like to walk around in their long robes and love to be greeted with respect in the marketplace; who choose the reserved seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts;.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, N tum tuma maa paai di tariga, zaŋmi m paɣa maa ti ma ka n zaŋ o niŋ m paɣa.
en: Jacob said to Laban, The time has come. Give me my wife so that I may sleep with her.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Itai, Dindina garim ka ti chaŋ. Di saha ka Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir maa min o niriba zaa ni bibihi bɛn daa be o sani zaa gari tooni.
en: Okay then, David replied to Ittai. Keep marching! So Ittai the Gittite and all of his men and all the little children with him marched past.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhiri pampam n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ni yɛlimaŋlilana ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka a yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ku ti ka na be dunia ni ŋɔ saria m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti ti.
en: These souls shouted in a loud voice, Holy and true Lord, how long until you judge the people of the earth and punish them for killing us.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tim anabinim mini yɛnnima ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yi sanna, ka yi ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka kpahi bɛ shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu, ka fiɛb bɛ shɛb mi yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka niŋ ba alaka tiŋ ni zaŋ ti kpa tiŋ ni.
en: I will send to you prophets and wise people and experts in the Law of Moses. You will kill them or nail them to a cross or beat them in your synagogues or chase them from town to town.

dag: Kpɛmiya kuɣa voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni.
en: They will hide in caves in the rocky hills or dig holes in the ground to try to escape from the Lord 's anger and to hide from his power and glory!.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol a zaligunim maa zo.
en: Im a friend to everyone who honors you and to all who keep your precepts.

dag: Amaa n yi ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, n ni chɛ ka a noli yaai ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya. Chɛ ka bɛn ni wum, wum. Ka chɛ ka bɛn zaɣisi wumbu, zaɣisi. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ti shɛhira gbaŋ din sab ti suhuri ni ni sokam nya li karim.
en: No, you yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts. It is known and read by all people.

dag: Ka niriba daa pili buri; ka shɛb du n-tam duri zuɣusaa, ka shɛb mi ʒe tiŋ puuni laɣiŋgu shee kumdi ka fabinda.
en: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.

dag: Zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti taba yi ni luri Masia sizuura la zuɣu.
en: Honor Christ and put others first.

dag: O daa me Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yili; ka di wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka bɛ daa me li tamla sida dari kulis ata mini di dapuhi zuɣu.
en: He built the Forest of Lebanon Palace one hundred fifty feet in length, seventy-five feet in width, and forty-five feet in height. It had four rows of cedar columns with cedar engravings above the columns.

dag: Yumiya taba kaman mabi yinsi la, ka timiya tab jilima viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni sɔŋdi ma zuɣu, n ku di vi. Dinzuɣu ka n zuɣu ʒe ya. M mi ni n ku di vi.
en: But their insults cannot hurt me because the Sovereign Lord gives me help. I brace myself to endure them. I know that I will not be disgraced.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ la o ni daa lo nia shɛli ka chɛ ka di pali ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la puuni.
en: This was consistent with the plan he had from the beginning of time that he accomplished through Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi daa yi kani bɛ sanna sahasaha nti sɔŋdi ba daba ayopɔinpɔin.
en: These guards were assisted by their relatives, who lived in the villages and who had to take turns at guard duty for seven days at a time.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa paɣir a ti jɛmbu du kasi shɛli puuni la, buɣim di li, ka luɣ shɛŋa zaa din viɛli ka ti daa yuri li la wurim doya.
en: Our holy, glorious house, where our ancestors praised you, has gone up in flames; all that we treasured has become a ruin.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa be yi sani, ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim; ti daa kul bela baalim, ka gbib ya kaman paɣ ni gbib o bihi shɛm la.
en: When we were with you, as apostles of Christ we could have used our authority to make you help us. But we were very gentle with you. We were like a mother caring for her little children.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam o dirila nasara; dama Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: The Lord was with David, so he was successful in everything.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Naa Dauda ni Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o malibu zaa ni, Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Obɛdɛdom yiŋa n-zaŋ li kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: King David heard that because of the Covenant Box the Lord had blessed Obed Edom's family and all that he had; so he got the Covenant Box from Obed's house to take it to Jerusalem with a great celebration.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa wuna.
en: Do not worship other gods, any of the gods of the peoples around you.

dag: A daa pirigi teeku buyi ka chɛ ka a niriba doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du, amaa ka a daai bɛn daa doli ba maa niŋ teeku maa bulli ni, kaman kuɣili ni lu kɔtitali ni shɛm la.
en: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.

dag: Yawɛ daalikaulinim nyɛla alali; di nyɛla alali kaman anzinfa maŋli shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she tiŋgban ni buɣim ni m-mal li buyopɔin ka di yi zaa la.
en: The LORDs promises are pure, like silver thats been refined in an oven, purified seven times over!.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ yuya nyɛviyanim litaafi la ni, ka di chɛ ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya pahi wuntizɔriba yuya ni.
en: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.

dag: Di tiŋli duu dunoli daa bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka nir ni tooi doli di dunɔdura ti kpe sunsuuni duu la puuni n-yi ni ti kpe du shɛli din pah ata ni.
en: The entrance to these rooms was on bottom floor at the south side of the Temple. Inside there were stairs that went up to the second floor and from there to the third floor.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ni ti zaŋ o binshɛɣukam fukumsi niŋ o yiŋbia maa nuu ni.
en: A servant who is always faithful will surely be put in charge of everything the master owns.

dag: Yisa ni daa be Jɛrusalɛm Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha maa, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda bɛ nini ni daa nya shihir shɛŋa o ni wuhi la zuɣu.
en: While Jesus was in Jerusalem during the Passover Festival, many believed in him as they saw the miracles he performed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti dan ti yɛl o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ? Naawuni di wuhi gba, ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ti tum tuuni ŋɔ tatabo!.
en: They replied, Why does my master talk to us like this? Your servants would never do such a thing.

dag: Ka Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba ni yino ka nyɛ ŋun daa ti yɛn yi Yisa nyaaŋa la bɔhi.
en: One of Jesus' disciples, Judas Iscariot—the one who was going to betray him—said.

dag: Vinvamli ni taŋkpaɣu niŋdi ba la nyaɣisim, ka sokam ni doli bɛ nyaaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun daŋ tooni ka kalinli.
en: thousands join the funeral procession, and even the earth lies gently on their bodies.

dag: Nir yi chɛ ka o nini tiɣ o ni mali shɛli, di so ni o mali kɔre biɛri. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: It is better to be happy with what you have than to always want more and more. Always wanting more and more is useless. It is like trying to catch the wind.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya; dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia. Saha maa paaya! Miriya ka yi ti doli ba!.
en: Jesus said, Be careful! Dont be fooled. Many people will come using my name. They will say, I am the Messiah and The right time has come! But dont follow them.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛn lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli ka so kani n-gari ŋun Naawuni ka o ni po o la zuɣu, o daa ŋmaligi m-pola omaŋ.
en: God made a promise to Abraham. And there is no one greater than God, so he made the promise with an oath in his own name—an oath that he would do what he promised.

dag: ka a daa wum n ni fabindi niŋd a maa. Di ŋar a tiba ka bi wum n ni kuhiri niŋd a ni a sɔŋ ma ŋɔ.
en: Hear my voice. Dont close your ear to my need for relief, to my cry for help.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa wuhi ma machɛlinim anahi.
en: Then the Lord showed me four workers with hammers.

dag: Ka o daa chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: So he kept on preaching in the synagogues in Judea.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti boli niriba na ti yɛli ba, Luɣimiya yi tiba wum ka baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni:.
en: Jesus called the crowd near and said to them, Listen and understand.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn kul deeri yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi.
en: Look, you put your trust in deceitful words.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi Daniɛl ʒii nyabu puuni yuŋ. Ka Daniɛl daa paɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: Then that same night the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision, and he praised the God of heaven:.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa kuli ti gbaai bubil kɔrigi, ka tooi zim kilɔgiram pia m-mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi. Ka daa zaŋ nimdi maa n-niŋ piɛɣu ni, ka zaŋ ʒiɛri mi niŋ ʒɛduɣu ni n-zaŋ li ka oki tia maa gbinna ti ti o.
en: So Gideon went into his house and cooked a young goat and used a bushel of flour to make bread without any yeast. He put the meat in a basket and the broth in a pot, brought them to the Lord 's angel under the oak tree, and gave them to him.

dag: Naɣ kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam; ka doli zaligu shɛŋa zaa n dabili Musa ni daa zali ya la viɛnyɛliŋga; ka miri ka a ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li, ka di chɛ ka a tooi diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: Be very brave and strong as you carefully obey all of the Instruction that Moses my servant commanded you. Dont deviate even a bit from it, either to the right or left. Then you will have success wherever you go.

dag: ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Ibram ni!.
en: and he blessed him, Bless Abram by El Elyon, creator of heaven and earth.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ Gibianim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka chaŋ ti liri ba.
en: We'll send one tenth of the men from each tribe to get food for the army. And we'll ask God who should attack Gibeah, because those men deserve to be punished for committing such a horrible crime in Israel.

dag: saha shɛl o firila ni daa ne n zuɣusaa, ka n dol o firila maa neesim gari zibisim ni la.
en: when his lamp shone on my head, I walked by his light in the dark.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ka nir chaŋchaŋ ti lan ŋmaligi gbamda. Ŋunkam niŋdi lala bi simdi Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Jesus said, Anyone who begins to plow a field but looks back is not prepared for Gods kingdom.

dag: Man a dabili ŋɔ kul ni dolila nyini naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ n-chaŋ biɛla ha. Bɔzuɣu ka nyini naa ti yɛn yo ma san titali ŋɔ?.
en: Your servant will cross a short way over the Jordan with the king, but why should the king give me such a reward?.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛliya ka niriba pam ka bɛ sanna nti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka ʒe bɛ nɛma.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Bring up an assembly against them, and decree terror and plunder for them.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɔhimi duŋtaariba maa, Yi bi mi dimbɔŋɔnim maa gbinni? Yɛlim ba, Babilɔn naa n-daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti gbaai di naa mini di kpambaliba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: Ezekiel, ask the rebellious people of Israel if they know what this story means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem, then he captured the king of Judah and his officials, and took them back to Babylon as prisoners.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu.
en: I am the bread that gives life.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zuliya n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒini baɣili teeku. Bɛna n-nyɛ Jafɛt zuliya bɛn daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni, ka mali bɛmaŋmaŋ zuliyazuliya yɛtɔɣ kɔŋkɔba bɛ tiŋgban ni.
en: All the people who lived in the area around the Mediterranean Sea came from these sons of Japheth. The people separated and went to different countries according to languages, families, and nations.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Siɣimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni ti pii kuɣa pinaayi maligumaaniba la ni ʒe luɣ shɛl la n-ʒi li ti sɔŋ yi ni ti yɛn gbe luɣ shɛli yuŋ ŋɔ. .
en: Tell them to look in the river where the priests were standing and get twelve rocks from that place. Carry these rocks with you and put them where you stay tonight.

dag: O daa niŋla lala hal ti paai nayili samban dunol ni. O daa bi kpe nayili maa, dama bɛ daa bi saɣiri ka ninvuɣ so ŋun pili buɣu zaŋdi li kpɛri nayili.
en: He went only as far as the Kings Gate because it was against the law for anyone to pass through it wearing mourning clothes.

dag: ni o chɛ ka Pool lab Jɛrusalɛm na, dama bɛ daa lɔrila nia ni bɛ gu soli ku o.
en: to do them the favor of having Paul come to Jerusalem, for they had made a plot to kill him on the way.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa yiɣisi zani n-darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka pini o zuɣu, ka gbani tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛli Mariama, A mal alibarika paɣiba ni, ka bi so ŋun be a pul ni ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: and said in a loud voice, You are the most blessed of all women, and blessed is the child you will bear!.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ sana zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-niŋ o fitiina, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Do not mistreat or oppress a foreigner; remember that you were foreigners in Egypt.

dag: Kulla sɔhila ka yi paai kpe na; ka n chɛ ka yi doli ma chani gindi ka m bi mi n ni kuni luɣ shɛli polo gba? Zaŋm a mabihi maa ka yi labi. Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim din bi naari min o ʒiɛyimtali.
en: You came to join me only yesterday. You dont need to wander from place to place with me. Take your brothers and go back. Go with my faithful, loving kindness.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa sɔŋdi niriba pam, amaa jɛra kpirila bɛ yɛm kalinsi zuɣu.
en: The lips of the righteous nourish many people, but fools who lack sense will die.

dag: Sool ʒiɛman ni zaa, o mini Filistianim daa kul tuhirimi ni nimmoo, dinzuɣu o daa yi kul nya do so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ bee suhukpeeni o zaŋd o mi leeg o tɔbbia.
en: As long as he lived, Saul had to fight fiercely against the Philistines. So whenever he found a man who was strong or brave, he would enlist him in his army.

dag: Arivadnim mini Hɛlɛchinim daa nyɛla bɛn ʒi a goma zuɣu ti gili, ka Gamadinim mi daa ʒe a binchunchuna gbini. Bɛ daa zaŋdila bɛ lɔɣubuya yiini a dukpina zuɣu ti tuui. Bɛna n-daa chɛ ka a viɛl zaa.
en: Soldiers from Arvad guarded your walls, and troops from Gamad guarded your towers. They hung their shields on your walls. They are the ones who made you beautiful.

dag: Ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini Dauda tɔbbihi mi daa yi n-chaŋ ti paai ba Gibiɔn biaŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ yini polo ka bɛn la mi chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ din la polo.
en: Joab, whose mother was Zeruiah, and David's other officials met them at the pool, where they all sat down, one group on one side of the pool and the other group on the opposite side.

dag: Kalim Lɛvinima kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm dɔbba bɛn nyɛ kaman gol yini zaŋ chana.
en: Enroll the Levites by their households and their clans. You will enroll all the males over one month old.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli, Nyama, wuntaŋ ni n-na bɔŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri maa taɣ kuli yiŋ saha na bi paai, dinzuɣu ŋɔŋmiya kom ti piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu, ka yi zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: Jacob said, Since it is still broad daylight and not yet time to bring the flocks in, why don't you water them and take them back to pasture.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim la zaa n-na be yi nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But all of you who stayed with the Lord your God are alive today.

dag: Yawɛ tim o niriba kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka ti ba suhudoo.
en: Let the LORD give strength to his people! Let the LORD bless his people with peace!.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat bɔh o, Yawɛ anab so ka kpe ka ti ni bɔh o baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm? Di saha ka Izraɛl naa sapashinnim ni yino daa garigi yɛli, Shafat bia Ilaisha, ŋun daa nyɛ Ilaija sɔŋda la be kpe.
en: King Jehoshaphat asked, Is there a prophet here through whom we can consult the Lord ? An officer of King Joram's forces answered, Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was Elijah's assistant.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛli ba, Man ni chaŋ kulipaligu. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti gba ni dol a chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa yi nti kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, amaa dindali maa yuŋ maa bɛ daa bi gbaai shɛli.
en: Simon Peter said to the others, I am going fishing. We will come with you, they told him. So they went out in a boat, but all that night they did not catch a thing.

dag: N yi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, n ka bara nyubu di ni; dama di nyɛla n talahi tuuni, ka mbusim be n zuɣu n yi bi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu maa!.
en: Its not my work of telling the Good News that gives me any reason to boast. That is my duty—something I must do. If I dont tell people the Good News, I am in real trouble.

dag: Ka o mi buɣisi yɛli ba ni bɛ tim o gbaŋ; ka bɛ daa ti o gbaŋ maa ka o sab yɛli, Bia maa yuli Jɔn. Ka di daa gari sokam pam.
en: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, His name is John. Everyone was amazed.

dag: Bɛ ku zaŋ a pahi bɛ zuɣu sɔɣi, dama a daa saɣim a tiŋgbɔŋ, ka ku a niriba. So ku teei a zuliya bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la ni so yɛla.
en: You wont join them in burial, for you destroyed your own land; you killed your own people. Such evil offspring will never be mentioned again!.

dag: Amaa nyini malimi shili n-yiɣisi zani yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa. Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, di yi pa lala n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaag a pam bɛ sani.
en: Get ready, Jeremiah; go and tell them everything I command you to say. Do not be afraid of them now, or I will make you even more afraid when you are with them.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣis a zaligunim dolibu. Bɛ yɔhiŋgu soya nyɛla yoli.
en: You discard everyone who strays from your statutes because they are dishonest and false.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti bi mi di ni daa yi so sanna.
en: So they answered, We don't know where it came from.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, m bɔri ni a mali duu zali ma, dama m mali tahima ni Naawuni ni deeg a suhigu, ka labisi ma ti a.
en: Also, please prepare a room for me. I hope that God will answer your prayers and that I will be able to come and see you.

dag: O ni daa ti wuhi ba naai ka o yɛli Saimɔn, Chamiya teeku ŋɔ bulli ni ha ti lab yi lansi maa gbahi zahim.
en: When he finished speaking to the crowds, he said to Simon, Row out farther, into the deep water, and drop your nets for a catch.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma nyɛla jɛmbu tuma mini ʒiʒibo.
en: This is what the Gershonite family must do and the things they must carry:.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛba bɛn birigi n niriba la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti nya n-di saha shɛli, bɛ kuhirimi yɛra, Suhudoo beni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ti ba ka bɛ di, bɛ yɛrimi ni bɛ ni tuhi ba.
en: Some false prophets are telling lies to the Lords people. This is what the Lord says about them: These prophets are led by their stomachs. They promise peace for those who give them food, but they promise war to those who do not give them food.

dag: Ka Ariok daa dii zaŋ Daniɛl n-kpɛhi Naa Nɛbukadnɛza sani ti yɛl o, Naa, n nya Juda daba la ni yino ŋun ni tooi wuh a a zahindi la gbinni.
en: At once Arioch took Daniel into King Nebuchadnezzar's presence and told the king, I have found one of the Jewish exiles who can tell Your Majesty the meaning of your dream.

dag: Ka Ibram daa be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Lɔt mi be vinvamli maa ni fɔntinsi ni, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-zaŋ o tanti suɣili chaŋ ti kpa Sɔdom.
en: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived among the cities in the valley. Lot moved as far as Sodom and made his camp there.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni!.
en: O Lord , our Lord, your greatness is seen in all the world!.

dag: bɛ so nini ku nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po ni n ni zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim la. Bɛn ʒiɛm ma la so nini ku nya li.
en: I promised their ancestors that I would give them that land. But none of those people who turned against me will ever enter that land!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni lo shɛm ni niŋ, ka n ni zali shɛm ni niŋ pali.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces has promised: As I intended, so it will be; and as I have planned, so it will happen.

dag: Ka Shɛbania mini Jɔshafat ni Nɛtanɛl ni Amasai ni Zakaria ni Bɛnaaya ni Ɛliɛza, bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa nyɛ bɛn yɛn be Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni piɛbiri kikahi. Ka Obɛdɛdom mini Jɛhaya gba daa nyɛ Alikauli Adaka maa dunɔguliba.
en: The priests Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer were to blow the trumpets before Gods chest. Obed-edom and Jehiah also were to be gatekeepers for the chest.

dag: Amaa ka o yanim daa je o, ka tim tuumba nti yɛli ŋun daa yɛn leeg o nam maa ni bɛ je ni doo maa niŋ bɛ naa.
en: But the people of his country hated him, and they sent messengers to the foreign country to say, We don't want this man to be our king.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi yira, ka shɛb gba zaŋ alizin birigu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu tahi Yisa sanna.
en: As they were leaving, people brought to him a man who was demon-possessed and unable to speak.

dag: Amaa Yuria daa bi kul o yiŋa, ka daa yi nti dɔnila nayili samban dunol ni tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli nayili maa sani.
en: But Uriah didn't go home. Instead, he slept outside the entrance to the royal palace, where the king's guards slept.

dag: Di niŋdiya pakoli kam bee kpibiga alaka.
en: You must never do anything bad to women whose husbands are dead or to orphans.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zuliya bɔbili laɣimla taba ni bɛ lir a ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ta o daɣiri, chɛliya ka ti mooi ti nini bahi Ziɔn zuɣu.
en: Many nations have come to fight against you. They say, Look, there is Zion! Lets attack her.

dag: O chɛ ka n naba ŋmanila naba anahilan nyaaŋa naba, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana ka barina shɛli kani.
en: who makes my step as sure as the deers, who lets me stand securely on the heights.

dag: Zaŋmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli ba ka bɛ zaŋ mali kuli ti yɛli bɛ nanima ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli yi nanim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Tell them to say to their masters: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Say this to your masters.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N yi chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zaa chaŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ be yi sani? Zaɣ biɛɣu ka yi lo maa.
en: Pharaoh said to them, Yes, the LORD will be with you, all right, especially if I let your children go with you! Obviously, you are plotting some evil scheme.

dag: Deemiya tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ʒin di ni, dama mani n-zaŋ li tin ya ni yi su li.
en: You will take the land and you will settle there, because I am giving this land to you. It will belong to your family groups.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn nyɛ ansarisimaaniba, ka di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya man Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Therefore, hear the LORDs word, you scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Dindina niŋmiya zim ti ma na. Ka o daa zaŋ zim maa yuɣisi ʒiɛri maa ni ka yɛli ba, Toomiya li ti niriba maa ka bɛ piɛbi. Ka barina shɛli daa lan ka di ni yaha.
en: Elisha said, Get some flour. He threw it into the pot and said, Serve the people so they can eat. At that point, there was nothing bad left in the pot.

dag: Do so daa be Uzi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o yuli booni Ayuba. Doo maa daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: A man in the land of Uz was named Job. That man was honest, a person of absolute integrity; he feared God and avoided evil.

dag: ka paɣimiya Naawuni shɛlikam zaa puuni. Dina n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yu shɛli yi biɛhigu ni Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: be thankful in all circumstances. This is what God wants from you in your life in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: bɛ na ʒi n-di ka guui binshɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daazichi ku zani yuui.
en: After filling himself, there is nothing left. His success will not continue.

dag: dama yi dibu ni, sokam kpaɣirimi dira, ka kum mali shɛba ka shɛb mi nyu m-buɣi.
en: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.

dag: nyin Naawuni naan dii nya, dama a mi ti daashili tɛha din be ti suhuri ni.
en: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.

dag: Jɛfita daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayɔbu. Ka ŋun Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ya Giliad maa.
en: Jephthah was a judge for the Israelites for six years. Then Jephthah from Gilead died and was buried in his town in Gilead.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba bɛn daa leei bundaannim paɣ maa zuɣu la ni ti kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋa o ni nya nahiŋgu shɛli din mali dabiɛm maa zuɣu, ka kuhiri ka fabindi.
en: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.

dag: Gban shɛli Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa sabi ti Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni gbansabira ni baŋda so ŋun daa mi Yawɛ zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ o ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi daŋ maa galisiya pam, di ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: The Lord says to his people, Your wounds are incurable, your injuries cannot be healed.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti kul kpɛri ha m-be dunol ni, ka Ahija wum o naba vubu ka yɛli, Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa, kpɛmina; bɔ n-niŋ ka a taɣ a biɛhigu ni a be kaman paɣ so la. M mali yɛtɔɣ kpɛma ni n yɛl a.
en: But when Ahijah heard her coming to the door, he said, Come in! I know who you are. You are Jeroboams wife. Why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.

dag: Mani n-nam neesim mini zibisim, mani n-tahiri alibarika na, ka lan tahiri tɔbu na. Man Yawɛ n-niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord , do all this.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii zuɣulaannim ti ba; ka zuɣulaannim maa daa tiligi ba ŋmɛnditoya maa nuu ni.
en: Then the Lord gave the Israelites leaders who saved them from the raiders.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yila dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa man yila alizanda ni na; yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, amaa man pala dunia ŋɔ nira.
en: Jesus answered, You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.

dag: Lee miriya ka yi ŋubi nimdi din ʒim bi yi di ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: But I give you one command. You must not eat meat that still has its life in it.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi ka Izraɛl kpamba daa dol o ka bɛ chaŋ Datan mini Abiram sani.
en: Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiram. Israels elders followed him.

dag: ka pihi kuɣa sɔŋ n-lihi nya bulah ayi maa sunsuuni, kuɣ yini ni ti nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka kuɣ yini ti nyɛ Azazɛl dini.
en: Aaron will cast lots over the two goats: one lot labeled the LORDs and the other lot labeled Azazels.

dag: Lihimiya ŋarima gba: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ kara ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ ʒiɛri li n-chani la zaa yoli, dabihi shɛŋa din lo di nyoya ni n-nyɛ din ŋmaligiri li kpari ŋun duhiri li ni bɔri shɛli polo.
