en: Consider ships: They are so large that strong winds are needed to drive them. But pilots direct their ships wherever they want with a little rudder.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan tirisi tooni ha nti nya Zɛbidii min o bih ayi: Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni n-liɣiri bɛ lansi. Ka Yisa daa boli bɛ gba;.
en: Jesus continued walking by Lake Galilee. He saw two other brothers, James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee. They were preparing their nets to catch fish. Jesus told the brothers to come with him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi Naiɔt din be Rama tiŋgban ni maa n-chaŋ Jɔnatan sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? N taali nyɛ dini? Ka tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee dii tum a ba, ka o bɔri ni o ku ma.
en: David escaped from Prophets Village. Then he ran to see Jonathan and asked, Why does your father Saul want to kill me? What have I done wrong.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Yisahaku sanna ti yɛl o, Di chaŋ Ijipti, kpalim be tiŋgban shɛli ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The Lord had appeared to Isaac and had said, Do not go to Egypt; stay in this land, where I tell you to stay.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni. Ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li.
en: Suddenly a storm struck the lake. Waves started splashing into the boat, and it was about to sink.

dag: Ka yi yi lihi zuɣusaa nya wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni zuɣusaa binyara zaa, yin miriya ka yi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li ka di chɛ ka yi birigi. Di nyɛla binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: And be careful when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon, and the stars—all the many things in the sky. Be careful that you are not tempted to worship and serve them. The Lord your God lets the other people in the world do this.

dag: Ka yi gba daa tumdila lala yi ni daa siɣi ʒe di puuni saha shɛl la.
en: You also did these things in the past, when you lived like them.

dag: Lom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ alikauli ni a ni gbib ma viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka karimbaannim nahim ma.
en: Guarantee good things for your servant. Please dont let the arrogant oppress me.

dag: dama n zo so m-paai n yiŋ na pumpɔŋɔ, ka n ka bindir shɛli din ni ti o ka o di.
en: A friend of mine who is on a trip has just come to my house, and I don't have any food for him.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ammɔnnim mini bɛ vi tuma polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlima, Takɔbi, bɛ ŋooi takɔbi ni bɛ ku niriba! Bɛ nyɛhimi neei li ni di ku niriba, ka di nyaɣisiri kaman saa la.
en: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn goon titali ŋɔ ni ti lu tiŋgban ni dahim, ka di dunɔdaya din du pam la ti di buɣim. Niriba maa daa kul nahimla bɛmaŋ yoli, di daa kul wum ba la yoli, ka buɣim ti yɛn di li.
en: The walls of mighty Babylon will be thrown to the ground, and its towering gates burned down. The work of the nations is all for nothing; their efforts go up in flames. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Dama bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, di laara ka Naawuni yɛn ti ba, ka darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He pays us back for what we have done. He gives us what we deserve.

dag: Yawɛ neem o nina lihi ya ka tin ya suhudoo.
en: The LORD lift up his face to you and grant you peace.

dag: Zɛbulɔn ni ti ʒini n-tabila teeku noli. O kulinoli ni ti nyɛla ŋariŋ kara zaashee. O tintariga ti yɛn zaŋmi hal ni Sidɔn.
en: Zebulun, you will settle along the seashore and provide safe harbors as far north as Sidon.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, dinzuɣu gbibiya n zaligunim mini n ni yɛli ya shɛm, ka tummiya tuun shɛli din ni chɛ ka daadam be.
en: You must keep my rules and my regulations; by doing them one will live; I am the LORD.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bun shɛb bɛn bɔrigi zuŋɔ daba ata la bɛna, di lan chɛ ka bɛ yɛla muɣis a, dama bɛ nya ba. Ka ŋuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa lee yuuni bɔra? Pa a min a zuliya zaa.
en: As for the donkeys that were lost three days ago, don't worry about them; they have already been found. But who is it that the people of Israel want so much? It is you—you and your father's family.

dag: amaa ka Hadad min o ba tumtumdiba shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛdomnim la shɛba daa tiligi n-zo n-kuli Ijipti.
en: At the time Hadad was only a young boy. He and some of his fathers servants ran away to Egypt.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka Musa daa piligi kahigiri zaligunim ŋɔ wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: The Israelites were in Moab on the east side of the Jordan River when Moses began to explain what God had commanded:.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni yiɣisi n suhu darigi bɛ tibili, n ku chɛ ba bee n-zo ba nambɔɣu, hal bɛ yi kuhiri pampam niŋdi ma ni n wum, n ku wum.
en: I will certainly respond with wrath. I wont spare or pity anyone. Even though they call out loudly to me in my hearing, I wont listen to them.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka tiligi Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku m bia Jɔnatan, hal Naawuni ni kul chɛ ka ti nya tiliginsim ŋun Jɔnatan kɔbili ni maa zaa yoli. Amaa ka niriba maa zaa so daa bi garig o.
en: As surely as the LORD lives—the one who has saved Israel—even if its my own son Jonathan, that person will be executed. Not one of the soldiers answered him.

dag: N niŋ ya naani pam, ka nyuri bara pam yi zuɣu, ka lan mali suhudoo. Ti wahala dibu la zaa yoli, m mali suhupiɛlli hal ti yaɣi.
en: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa m-me bimbini zali Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa, ka booi wain mini kpam bahi di zuɣu ti Naawuni.
en: So Jacob set up a sacred pillar, a stone pillar, at the place God spoke to him. He poured an offering of wine on it and then poured oil over it.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yiɣisi dol o paɣ maa chaŋ doo maa sani ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa tɔɣisi paɣ ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa la? Ka o yɛli, mani.
en: Manoah got up and followed his wife. When he came to the man, he said, Are you the same man who spoke to my wife before? The angel said, I am.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa ba min o ma daa dɔɣ o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi chir muna ata ka bi zo dabiɛm ni bɛ zaɣisi naa zaligu, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka bia maa nyɛla bi viɛlli.
en: And the mother and father of Moses hid him for three months after he was born. They did this because they had faith. They saw that Moses was a beautiful baby. And they were not afraid to disobey the kings order.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim maligumaaniba, yi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Priests, this rule is for you.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya bɛn nuhi gbarigi la mini bɛn duna gbarigi la.
en: Strengthen the weak hands, and support the unsteady knees.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Shɛbuɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma.
en: Gershoms family: Shebuel the first.

dag: Ka yuri daa balisira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma tɔri tiŋ yɔri vuri.
en: The horses hooves hammered the ground. Siseras mighty horses ran and ran.

dag: Mani yi Duuma NAAWUNI kul pala n nini lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, n ni di bɛ nyɛviya dunia ŋɔ ni. Amaa n ku di Yaakubu daŋ niriba zaa nyɛviya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , am watching this sinful kingdom of Israel, and I will destroy it from the face of the earth. But I will not destroy all the descendants of Jacob.

dag: Amaa ka n daa kul timdi n daba bɛn zaa nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna ti yɛri ya, Jaande, miriya ka yi tum din chihiri shɛli n ni je.
en: Yet time and again I sent you all my servants the prophets, saying, Dont do these detestable things that I hate.

dag: Naawuni tiŋa, bɛ yɛli binshɛŋa din mali jilima zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛla.
en: Wonderful things are said about you, City of God. Selah.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi kpi, bɛ tahima naaya; ka bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: When the wicked die, all their hopes are lost; everything they thought they could do comes to nothing.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun be kasi, ka bi go ka mi bi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa, bɛn yihim dilan n niriba ni, o ni bi mali Yawɛ sara maa di saha la zuɣu, ka o daalahichi kpalim o zuɣu.
en: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abigeel, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun tim a na ka a ti tuhi ma soli ŋɔ mali alibarika!.
en: David said to her, Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who sent you today to meet me!.

dag: Bɛ ni ko tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ zaɣ nɛli la, ka di ku lan nyɛ zaɣ nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti nimaani sani.
en: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa zaa daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiniinaayopɔin bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya doli bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The official records of all the families of the tribe of Issachar listed , men eligible for military duty.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so maa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi baŋ ti chɔɣinsi yɛla ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa nya zahimbu kaman ti gba ni nyari zahimbu shɛm, amaa o daa bi tum alahichi di puuni.
en: because we dont have a high priest who cant sympathize with our weaknesses but instead one who was tempted in every way that we are, except without sin.

dag: Ti Duuma kpaŋsim a suhu! Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The Lord be with your spirit. God's grace be with you all.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti kpe alibarika shɛl ni ti ni be ŋɔ, ka mali suhupiɛlli ti tahima shɛli ti ni mali zaŋ chaŋ ti mini Naawuni ni laɣim nya jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: Through our faith, Christ has brought us into that blessing of Gods grace that we now enjoy. And we are very happy because of the hope we have of sharing Gods glory.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi bɔh o.
en: Eliphaz from Teman said:.

dag: Mɛtusɛla daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinyinika, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: Buni mini jilima be n sani, ka azichi din yuura mini tɔŋsim be n sani.
en: With me there are riches and honor. I have lasting wealth to give to you.

dag: Jɛfita ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim daa bi fa Mɔabnim tiŋgbani bee Ammɔnnim tiŋgbani.
en: They took this message: This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of the Moabites or the land of the Ammonites.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wun shɛŋa din pa din daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ zaa ni ti naai dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ku lan be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na.
en: Tell them this: The gods who didnt make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.

dag: Kush n-daa nyɛ Nimrɔd ba. O daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa dunia ni.
en: Cush had a son named Nimrod, who became the world's first great conqueror.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yi salima bimbin shɛli din do Naawuni tooni la yila anahi ni na.
en: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the gold altar that is before God.

dag: n ni ti lan labisi Ijipti zali di zaashee, ka zaŋ ba labisi Patrɔs din nyɛ bɛ virili shee la. Ka bɛ nam ti ku mali yaa nimaani.
en: They will once again live in their homeland in southern Egypt. But they will be a weak kingdom.

dag: Yi zaŋdi bindir shɛŋa din saɣim maani sara n sara maligu bimbina zuɣu. Yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee saɣim li? Yi tɛhiya ni nira ni tooi ʒiɛm Yawɛ bindira dibu shee.
en: This is how—by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, How have we failed to respect you? I will tell you—by showing contempt for my altar.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa be Ijipti Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Bɛ daa nya azichi pam nimaani, ka daa dɔɣi bihi ka bɛ zuliya maa nab pam.
en: The people of Israel made their home in the land of Goshen, where they became prosperous and had large families.

dag: Nyama, Na so ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni ti di nam, ka o kpambaliba nyɛ bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: Some day there will be a king who rules with integrity, and national leaders who govern with justice.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma kaman Yawɛ ni daa tim o ka o ti tum tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-jɛndi Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa la.
en: Thats not even to mention all those signs and wonders that the LORD sent Moses to do in Egypt—to Pharaoh, to all his servants, and to his entire land.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔ maa wuhirila bɛ ni booi kpam bahi shɛb zuɣuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa Duuma la tuma.
en: Then he told me, These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa lo Gibiɔnnim alikauli maa nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka bɛ ti wum ni Gibiɔnnim maa nyɛla bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, ka bɛ mini ba kul bela luɣ yini.
en: Three days after the Israelites made a treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were actually their neighbors and were living among them.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ŋmaai palo shɛli din dolisi luɣ kasi yaɣili la ti Izraɛlnima ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntiŋa. Di wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili. Di ni ti nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni su shɛli.
en: Next to my sacred land will be an area . kilometers long and kilometers wide. This will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem.

dag: saha shɛli yi ni guhiri Naawuni dabisili dali ka yi suhuri kul ye di kandina zuɣu ŋɔ. Dindali maa buɣim ni ti taai zuɣusaa di li zaa, ka buɣim maa ni ti chɛ ka binyara din be zuɣusaa maa nyɛligi.
en: You should be looking forward to the day of God, wanting more than anything else for it to come soon. When it comes, the sky will be destroyed with fire, and everything in the sky will melt with heat.

dag: Ninsalinim ni tooi mali bɛ wuna? Binyara lala pala Naawuni.
en: Can people make real gods for themselves? No, they can only make statues that are not really gods.

dag: Buni mini jilima be n sani, ka azichi din yuura mini tɔŋsim be n sani.
en: Riches and honor are with me, as well as enduring wealth and righteousness.

dag: ka din pah ayopɔin gbaai Hakɔz, ka din pah anii gbaai Abija.
en: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili maa ni daa ti yi palo, ti daa nya o ka di o shɛhira, ka yɛri ya ŋuna ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu ka daa be ti Ba Naawuni sani, ka ŋun Naawuni daa kahig o wuhi ti la yɛla.
en: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.

dag: O naan zaŋ o yiko din galisi ŋɔ zab ma? Aai, amaa o naan gbilisi tibili wum n yɛligu.
en: Would God use his power against me? No, he would listen to me!.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ waagasi mini bihim ni naɣilabil kpabili so bɛ ni daa kɔrigi duɣi maa nimdi na nti zali bɛ tooni, ka ʒe bɛ sani tia maa gbini ka bɛ dira.
en: He then served his guests some yogurt and milk together with the meat. While they were eating, he stood near them under the tree.

dag: N daa pii chɛrubi zali ka o gul a, ka a be Naawuni zoli din be kasi zuɣu. A daa bela buɣim kuɣa ni chana.
en: I put a terrifying angel there to guard you. You lived on my holy mountain and walked among sparkling gems.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: Meanwhile, God told Shemaiah the prophet.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Naawuni zaŋ alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: Jesus came to them and said: I have been given all authority in heaven and on earth!.

dag: Di daba anahi dali ka bɛ daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-mali shili ni bɛ kuli, amaa ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛl o deemba maa, Ʒinimi suug a noli n-nya kpiɔŋ ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning. The Levite was getting ready to leave. But the young womans father said to his son-in-law, Eat something first. After you eat, you can go.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi yɛli teeku ni di nyuuma. N ni chɛ ka yi mɔɣa kom nyuui.
en: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.

dag: buɣim ni ku di binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ buɣim ni m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi. Amaa faashee ka yi bahi zaŋ kom din maani binyara ka di be kasi paɣi li. Ka binshɛŋa din mi ku tooi kpe buɣim ni, yin zaŋmiya kom paɣi li.
en: anything that can withstand fire—you will put through the fire and it will be clean. It will also be purified with the water of purification. Anything that isnt able to withstand fire, you will immerse in water.

dag: Ka o daa mir o ti mɔɣis o kpariŋ; ka Yisahaku wum o binyɛra ʒiɛɣu ka niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Wummi m bia ʒiɛɣu, di ŋmanila Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ mɔ shɛl ni ʒiɛɣu.
en: So Jacob went to his father and kissed him. When Isaac smelled Esaus clothes, he blessed him and said, My son smells like the fields the Lord has blessed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-bo li ti ba. Ŋuna n-niŋ lala ni o vuui bɛ barinyubo shɛli bɛ ni nyuri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni tum shɛli polo la, ka dihi bɛ ni tibigi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni vi.
en: The Lord Almighty planned it. He planned it in order to put an end to their pride in what they had done and to humiliate their honored ones.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti be o ni ka o gba be ti ni. Dina n-nyɛ: O ni zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Shia ti ti la zuɣu.
en: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ baŋ ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: Jesus' disciples were arguing about which one of them was the greatest.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya ka Musa yuui zoli maa zuɣu ka na bi siɣina maa, ka bɛ daa laɣim ka Aduna sanna ti yɛl o, Yiɣisim mali buɣili ti ti ka o gari tooni n-zaŋ ti chaŋ, dama Musa ŋun daa zaŋ ti yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o.
en: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.

dag: Yinima n-kpuɣi n daanzinfa mini n salima; ka ʒi n daazichi nɛma nti niŋ yi wuna jɛmbu duri ni.
en: You have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my rich treasures into your temples.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba n-dihi duu maa nachiinsi. Parivaim salima ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: He put valuable stones in the Temple for beauty. The gold he used was gold from Parvaim.

dag: Chamiya Lɛbanɔn nti kuhi pam, ka duhi yi yee Bashan. Kuhimiya Abarim polo bahina, dama bɛ ku yi ni yuri shɛba.
en: Judah, go up to the mountains of Lebanon and cry out. Let your voice be heard in the mountains of Bashan. Cry out in the mountains of Abarim, because all your lovers will be destroyed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli ka n wum: Yiya pam ni ti zani dabari, ka so ti ku be yiya din galisi mini yiya din viɛl ni.
en: I have heard the Lord Almighty say, All these big, fine houses will be empty ruins.

dag: Ka o lan tim so yaha, ka bɛ daa ti ku ŋuna. Ka o lan tim niriba pam pahi, ka bɛ ti fiɛb bɛ shɛba, ka ku bɛ gba ni shɛba.
en: The owner sent another slave, and they killed him; and they treated many others the same way, beating some and killing others.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: because the Lord your God hates for his people to worship other gods. And he can be like a fire that destroys!.

dag: Yinim yi mali kpiɔŋ ka tinim gbarigi, ti mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka ti ni suhiri Naawuni shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni yi nya kpaŋsibu.
en: We are glad when we are weak but you are strong. And so we also pray that you will become perfect.

dag: Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana ŋun daa gul o ba Zibiɔn bunsi ka ti nya kɔbilisirim mɔɣu ni la.
en: Zibeon's sons were Aiah and Anah—the same Anah who found an oasis in the desert while taking the donkeys of his father out to pasture.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba, saha shɛli n yi ti kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: This is my covenant with them, when I take away their sins .

dag: O ni ti labisi Izraɛlnim pam bɛ Duuma Naawuni sani yaha.
en: John will lead many people in Israel to turn back to the Lord their God.

dag: Ka Bɛzalɛl daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali Alikauli Adaka la. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Bezalel made the Covenant Box out of acacia wood, inches long, inches wide, and inches high.

dag: Dunia zuliya kam, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Zaŋmiya jilima ti Yawɛ ka wuhi ni o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Praise the Lord , all people on earth; praise his glory and might.

dag: O ni daa paai ni, o daa kuhila fabila kuhigu m-boli Daniɛl bɔh o, Daniɛl, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ dabili ŋɔ, a Naawuni so a ni jɛmdi viɛnyɛliŋga maa tooi fa a gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi.
en: As he approached it, he called out to Daniel, worried: Daniel, servant of the living God! Was your God—the one you serve so consistently—able to rescue you from the lions.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa ti wum ni kawana be Ijipti, ka o bɔh o bihi, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri taba.
en: During the famine in Canaan, Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt. So he said to his sons, Why are you sitting here doing nothing?.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anu ni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi ni ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Juda fɔntinsi ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na zaa daa moli nolɔbo molo Yawɛ tooni.
en: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son, all the people in Jerusalem and all those who had come from Judean towns observed a fast for the LORD in Jerusalem.

dag: Asha zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Imna daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Imnanima; ka Ishivi daŋ niriba nyɛ Ishivinima; ka Bɛraya daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛrayanima.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Asher were Imnah—the Imnite family group; Ishvi—the Ishvite family group; Beriah—the Beriite family group.

dag: ka Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was in command of the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Ka n daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a kpalim be n sani dabisi gbaliŋ. Di bi simdi ka a lan go pagɔrisigu bee n-chɛ ka do so su a yaha. N gba ni be a sani lala.
en: Then I told her, You must stay at home with me for many days. You will not be like a prostitute. You will not have sexual relations with another man. I will be your husband.

dag: Ka shɛb daa niŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛda, ka bɛn kpalim mi biɛhim li.
en: Some were persuaded by what he said, but others refused to believe.

dag: Bɛ ni teei bɛ nuhi kaman kɔduɣiriba ni teeri bɛ nuhi ni bɛ duɣi kom shɛm la. Amaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ shɛm zaa yoli, bɛ ni bahi di vi.
en: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.

dag: Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tiligim ti! Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tim ti nasara!.
en: LORD, please save us! LORD, please let us succeed!.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa pa ni Naawuni sani; dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked at them carefully and said, Its impossible with human beings, but not with God. All things are possible for God.

dag: Yilimiya yila pampam paɣi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ!.
en: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.

dag: So yi kɔhi yili bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni, o ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuun muni nyaaŋa, dama di yi paai yuun muni o mali soli ni o yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: Anyone who sells a home in a walled city still has the right to get it back until a full year after it was sold. Their right to get the house back will continue one year.

dag: Nyama, m bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.

dag: ni naɣila kpaba pia mini naɣ pisi bɛn nyari mɔri ŋubiri viɛnyɛliŋga ni piɛri kɔbiga m-pahi wolidibisi ni kparibudibisi ni saŋkpalindibisi ni no kara.
en: stall-fed cattle, pasture-fed cattle, and sheep, besides deer, gazelles, roebucks, and poultry.

dag: Ka a ti yihi kpa shɛli din zaa be naɣilaa maa binnyɔri ni mini binsaba ni yaannina mini kpam din be di ni n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then take the fat from the animal's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and send them up as an offering to me in the smoke from the altar.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi tiligira. Mani n-daa nam ya. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa. N kɔŋko n-daa nam zuɣusaa. Mani n-daa lan nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ.
en: Israel, I am your Lord , the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la, ka ti ti a tiliginsim.
en: Show us your faithful love, LORD! Give us your salvation!.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, O yɛli ma ni di bi simdi ni n lab kuna ni nuzaŋa, ka zaŋ chi ŋɔ zaa ti ma.
en: She said, He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said to me, Dont go away empty-handed to your mother-in-law.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi o kpee zabili ni ŋmanila ŋun gbaai ba so ŋun gariti tiba.
en: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Zakaria: Yɛlim ba.
en: The Lord gave this message to Zechariah:.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa maa daa lan laɣim tab bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali n-lan ku ninvuɣ kɔbisita tiŋ maa puuni pahi. Amaa bɛ daa bi di bɛ nɛma.
en: On the fourteenth day of Adar the Jews of Susa got together again and killed three hundred more people in the city. But again, they did no looting.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrubaal mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa daa daŋ yibu chaŋ ti dɔni baɣili Harɔd kulibɔŋ. Ka Midiannim mi daa do vinvamli ni zaŋ lab nuzaa polo miri Mɔre daboli.
en: Then Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, and all of the people with him rose early and set up camp beside the Harod spring; Midians camp was north of theirs, in the valley by the Moreh hill.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli nimaani yuli Masa ni Mɛriba, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ o taali, ka daa lan zahim Yawɛ yɛra, Amii Yawɛ be ti sani bee o kani.
en: He called the place Massah and Meribah, because the Israelites argued with and tested the LORD, asking, Is the LORD really with us or not.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa chaŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti be o sani pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: I went to stay with Gedaliah in Mizpah and lived among the people who were left in the land.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ tum tuma maa zaa.
en: The Israelites did all this work exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka nyɔhi yir o nyɛvoya ni kaman mɔri ka bɛ zaŋ mali buɣim n-zaŋ duɣu tam la.
en: Smoke pours from his nose like burning weeds under a boiling pot.

dag: N yuri bɛn yuri ma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ma ni nimmoo nyari ma.
en: I love those who love me; whoever looks for me can find me.

dag: Miriya ka yi siŋ Ɛdomnim ni so, dama bɛ nyɛla yi mabihi, miriya ka yi siŋ Ijiptinima, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba m-be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Do not despise the Edomites; they are your relatives. And do not despise the Egyptians; you once lived in their land.

dag: ka ninvuɣ galima bɛn ka buchi laɣimna ti pah o zuɣu, ka bɛ zaɣisi Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun daa na nyɛ bipolli ka o yɛm na bi ziligi ka o ku tooi nyaŋ ba la noli.
en: Later he gathered together a group of worthless scoundrels, and they forced their will on Rehoboam son of Solomon, who was too young and inexperienced to resist them.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-diri binshɛɣukam, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm mi kul dirila bindir gahinda.
en: One person believes in eating everything, while the weak person eats only vegetables.

dag: Ka Goma bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Rifat ni Tɔgarima.
en: Gomers sons were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o mi o ka bi dol o zaligunima, o ŋmarila ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ka o ni.
en: The one who claims, I know him, while not keeping his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in this person.

dag: Zahindi ni mini yuŋ ʒii puuni, saha shɛli gom yi ti gbaai niriba, ka bɛ do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu gbihiri la.
en: At night when people are asleep, God speaks in dreams and visions.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum, ka neeg a nina nya, ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ti na tu nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ.
en: Lord , please pay attention and hear this. Open your eyes, Lord , and see what is happening. Listen to all the insults against the living God in the message Sennacherib sent!.

dag: Ka Gibianim daa ti kana ti liri ma yuŋ n-teei gili n yilikpɛrili. Bɛ daa lo ma la kubu; ka daa gbaai m mam maa chaŋ ti goli ku o.
en: Later that night, the men of Gibeah surrounded the house. They wanted to kill me, but instead they raped and killed my wife.

dag: O ni daa wolisira, ka bi yino zaŋ o nuu tirina, ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda daa zaŋ gali ʒee lo o nuu maa ka yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ dɔɣibu.
en: At birth, one boy put out his hand, and the midwife took it and tied a red thread on his hand, saying, This one came out first.

dag: O daa di nam be Hiburɔn n-su Judanim la yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu. Ka o daa lan ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa yuun pihitanaata.
en: He lived in Hebron for the first seven and a half years and ruled only Judah. Then he moved to Jerusalem, where he ruled both Israel and Judah for years.

dag: Cham niriba ŋɔ sani ti yɛli ba: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: For he said, Go and say to this people: You will listen and listen, but not understand; you will look and look, but not see.

dag: Dama Naawuni yuri dunianim hal ti zaŋ o Bi gaŋa ti ba ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ti ku bahi yoli, amaa o ni ti nyala nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Yes, God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him would not be lost but have eternal life.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ cheechi sɔŋdiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ mali biɛrisuŋ, ka di yɛri naŋgbanvoya ayiyi, ka di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyuri dam kuuna bee bɛn suhuri ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: In the same way, servants in the church should be dignified, not two-faced, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.

dag: N di yuya ni bɛ zaŋ n nahiŋgu ŋɔ mini n suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: Oh, that my grief were actually weighed, all of it were lifted up in scales.

dag: Pa sokam zaa n-daa nya o, naɣila Naawuni ni daa pii tinim shɛb leei shɛhiranim maa n-daa nya o, ka ti min o laɣim di ka nyu o ni daa neei kum ni maa nyaaŋa.
en: He was not seen by everyone, but only by us, the ones God had already chosen to be witnesses. We ate and drank with him after he was raised from death.

dag: Kasitali sara maligu biŋkɔbiri daa nyɛla naɣilahi kɔbisiyɔbu mini piɛri tusaata.
en: There were also bulls and sheep and goats that were sacrificed as holy offerings.

dag: Ahazia daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi nira saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa; o daa di nam la maa yuun yini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Izraɛl Naa Omri yaaŋa, ka o yuli booni Atalia.
en: Ahaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for one year in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Athaliah; she was the granddaughter of Israels King Omri.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ni ŋmahiŋmahi nim shɛŋa maa mini binzuɣu ni biŋkpam nti pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: They shall put on the fire the pieces of the animal, including the head and the fat.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla yi yɛli ma mi, Ti du m-bala Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ. Pa o bimbina ka Hɛzɛkia pun wurim ka yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Yi yɛn jɛmd o la bimbini ŋɔ gbin la.
en: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord , your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord 's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?.

dag: ka sɔŋmiya taba. Yi ni so yi mali yɛli shɛli ni o kpee, yin chɛliya tab taali paŋ taba; di niŋ kamaata ni yi chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman ti Duuma ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba shɛm la.
en: Dont be angry with each other, but forgive each other. If you feel someone has wronged you, forgive them. Forgive others because the Lord forgave you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Yisa ka bɔhiri taba, Yi lee zahimla wula? O ni ka Chuɣu ŋɔ ni na bee o ku kana.
en: They looked around for Jesus. Then when they were in the temple, they asked each other, You don't think he will come here for Passover, do you.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa chɛ bɛ ni gbahi shɛb maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa zaa zali kpamba maa mini zama maa zaa tooni.
en: So the soldiers gave the prisoners and valuable things to the leaders and to the people.

dag: Din chɛ ka ti yɛl lala nyɛla ti ni niŋ Naawuni naani Masia zuɣu la.
en: This is the confidence that we have through Christ in the presence of God.

dag: O yurilim maŋli la naala zaa? O daalikaulinim la zanila tariga sahakam maa?.
en: Has he stopped loving us? Does his promise no longer stand?.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha maa ti Yaakubu ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Then Rachel let Jacob marry Bilhah.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm.
en: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.

dag: Ka Naa daa zan o zaashee n-lo alikauli Yawɛ tooni ni o ni jɛmd o, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa ni o shia zaa, ka niŋ kaman alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi kundi maa puuni ni wuhi shɛm.
en: After Josiah had finished reading, he stood in the place reserved for the king. He promised in the Lord 's name to faithfully obey the Lord and to follow his laws and teachings that were written in the book.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛ yino ka o ti lu bɔɣ zilinli ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku yaag o di ni?.
en: Jesus answered, What if one of you has a sheep and it falls into a deep hole on the Sabbath? Will you not take hold of it and lift it out?.

dag: Ka n yi ti na be n nyɛvili ni, nyin kul gbibi Yawɛ yurilim ŋɔ ni mani, ka ʒe ma yim din ni chɛ ka n ku kpi.
en: If I remain alive, be loyal to me. But if I die.

dag: Nyama, n ni lihi a nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, lala ka Naawuni gba ni lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ, ka o ni tiligi ma nahiŋgu kam zaa ni.
en: Just as I have spared your life today, may the Lord do the same to me and free me from all troubles.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali tahima ŋɔ kul maanila omaŋa m-be kasi kaman o ni be kasi shɛm.
en: And all who have this hope in him purify themselves even as he is pure.

dag: N yaa paai kuɣili yaa? Bee n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla daanya?.
en: Am I made of stone? Is my body bronze?.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Simiɔn zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Benjamin from the eastern border to the western border: Simeon, one portion.

dag: Baptaizibu shɛli n-na ʒe n-guli ma; di mi nyɛla din chɛ ka n suhu bi doya shee di ti niŋ naai.
en: I have a baptism I must experience. How I am distressed until its completed!.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni n-yɛli ni bɛ kali ma pahila tuumbiɛrinim ni la ni bahi niŋ pali m bebu ni; dama di kpala talahi ni di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm maa niŋ pali.
en: For I tell you that the scripture which says, He shared the fate of criminals, must come true about me, because what was written about me is coming true.

dag: Di saha ka dansarika gula maa kuhi yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm firila na, ka o daa guui kpe ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o ni sɔhira, ka o damdi Pool mini Silas tooni.
en: The jailer told someone to bring a light. Then he ran inside and, shaking with fear, fell down in front of Paul and Silas.

dag: Shia Kasi yino m-beni, amaa ka o pina lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they are all from the same Spirit.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋun sani ka ti yɛn chaŋ? Nyini m-mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu yɛtɔɣa.
en: Simon Peter answered, Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.

dag: Yi kul yɛra, Ti nyee nyɔniya, ka naɣiri yi nyɛhi niŋdi ma. Yi zaŋdi yi ni fa biŋkɔb shɛb bee biŋkɔb gbariti bee biŋkɔb barinim na ti maani sara tiri ma, yi tɛhiya ni n ni dee li yi sani? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You smell the food and refuse to eat it. You say it is bad. Then you bring sick, crippled, and hurt animals to me. You try to give sick animals to me as sacrifices, but I will not accept them. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi Naawuni nam maa ni kpɛbu tahima la nti bahi bumbɔn ni; nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: And those who should have the kingdom will be thrown out. They will be thrown outside into the darkness, where people will cry and grind their teeth with pain.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔhi Ilaisha, N daa yɛli nyini n dana ni a tim ma bia? N daa pun bi yɛl a ni a di yɔhim ma.
en: The woman said to him, Sir, did I ask you for a son? Didn't I tell you not to get my hopes up.

dag: Wahu daa nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana n-gari Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb zaa. Ka wahu daa ti bɔhi paɣ maa, Naawuni yɛliya ni yi miri ka yi di puu ŋɔ ni ti shɛli wala.
en: The snake was the most clever of all the wild animals that the Lord God had made. The snake spoke to the woman and said, Woman, did God really tell you that you must not eat from any tree in the garden.

dag: ka so mi yi yihi shɛli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, Naawuni ni yih o tarili nyɛvili tia la mini tiŋ kasi shɛli din yɛla sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la ni.
en: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti daŋ yibu nolɔɣu kukoli saha chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: The next morning Jesus woke up very early. He left the house while it was still dark and went to a place where he could be alone and pray.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din gba daa be yɔɣu ni la n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtaraba mini Midin ni Sɛkaka.
en: The twelfth region was located in the desert along the Dead Sea, and it had the following six towns with their surrounding villages: Beth-Arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, Salt Town, and En-Gedi.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa, ka niriba maa kpalim zani ka bi lan kariti doli Izraɛlnim maa bee n-lan tuhiri ba.
en: Then Joab blew the trumpet as a signal for his men to stop pursuing the Israelites; and so the fighting stopped.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi ti zaŋ bɛ nɛma bee kawana ni chi na Vuhim Dabisili dali ni bɛ ti kɔhi, ti ku da li Vuhim Dabisili dali bee dabisili kasi dali. Ti mi ku ko yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin puuni, ka ku ti sama zaa din dol ti taba.
en: If foreigners bring grain or anything else to sell to us on the Sabbath or on any other holy day, we will not buy from them. Every seventh year we will not farm the land, and we will cancel all debts.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi bɛn daa kpalim yina, ka Yawɛ niriba daa yina ni bɛ ti tuhi wɔɣira ti o.
en: Now, survivors, go to the leaders. People of the Lord , come with me and the soldiers.

dag: Nyama, m piila Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la pah o zuɣu, ka lan ti tuumbaŋdiba zaa yiko ni bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa n ni zal a ni a mali, dina n-nyɛ:.
en: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:.

dag: Gbansabiriba zuliya bɛn daa ʒi Jabɛz n-daa nyɛ: Tiratinim mini Shimiatinim ni Sukatinima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Kɛnnim bɛn daa yi Hammat na, ka bɛ yabidoo daa nyɛ Rɛkab la.
en: The clans of the scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. They were Kenites who descended from Hammath, Beth-rechabs father.

dag: Amaa daliri shɛli zuɣu n ni chɛ a maa nyɛla m bɔrimi ni n wuh a n yiko ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia ni zaa.
en: But to show you my power I have let you live so that my fame might spread over the whole world.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ŋunkam chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi n-tum alahichi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni ka kom di o, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: If one of these little children believes in me, and someone causes that child to sin, it will be very bad for that person. It would be better for them to have a millstone tied around their neck and be drowned in the deep sea.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita, ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi ŋmɛmdi bɛ nuhi ni ŋubira.
en: One Sabbath, as Jesus was going through the wheat fields, his disciples were picking the heads of wheat, rubbing them in their hands, and eating them.

dag: amaa di zuliya maa nim yi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu n sani, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, dindina n ni taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli n ni di yɛn niŋ ba maa polo.
en: but then that nation disobeys me and does evil, I will not do what I said I would.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli paɣ maa, N chɛ a daalahichi maa paŋ a.
en: Then Jesus said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

dag: ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ŋmani la ti tam o zuɣu. Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: and the Holy Spirit came down upon him in the form of a dove. A voice from heaven said, You are my own dear Son, and I am pleased with you.

dag: Ka Huram daa lan mali kɔniŋdi bini, ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli ka di naŋgbanyɛra yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ yini yɛliŋ nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka booli din daa gili di sunsuuni wɔɣilim mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla.
en: Hiram also made a large bowl called the Sea. It was just over two meters deep, about . meters across, and . meters around.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mabia Anduru ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni yino la yɛli Yisa.
en: Another follower there was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter. Andrew said.

dag: Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha, amaa bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ yino. Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: So they are no longer two but one flesh. Therefore, humans must not pull apart what God has put together.

dag: ka dabiɛm mini niŋgbuŋ sɔhibu daa paai ma din daa dam n kɔba ni zaa.
en: fear and dread struck me; all of my bones shook.

dag: Di saha ka Asa daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din zaa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili n-ti o kpambaliba n-tim ba ni bɛ zaŋm li ti ti Siria Naa Bɛnhadad ŋun daa nyɛ Tabirimmɔn bia, ka nyɛ Hɛziɔn yaaŋa ka be Damaskus la, ka yɛl o.
en: So King Asa took all the silver and gold that was left in the Temple and the palace, and sent it by some of his officials to Damascus, to King Benhadad of Syria, the son of Tabrimmon and grandson of Hezion, with this message:.

dag: Ka anabi so daa yi tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-yɛri suhudoo yɛla, anabi maa yɛligu daa yi ti niŋ pali, di saha ka bɛ baŋdi ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim o na ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: So the prophet who says that we will have peace must be tested. People can know that he really was sent by the Lord only if his message comes true.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli, M pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, I promised the LORD, El Elyon, creator of heaven and earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tum alahiziba tuma niriba ŋɔ sani, ka di gari ba ka niŋ ba alahiziba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ni leei jɛra, ka bɛ yɛm maa leei din ka buchi.
en: So I will continue to amaze them by doing powerful and amazing things. Their wise men will lose their wisdom. Even the most intelligent among them will not be able to understand.

dag: ni Taai nanim zaa ni Sidɔn nanim zaa ni teeku duli tiŋgbɔna din nyɛ.
en: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, N fabilimi niŋ naa ni o di lan zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ ka n ti kpi nimaani. .
en: So if they question you, tell them you were begging me not to send you back to the prison at Jonathan's house, because going back there would kill you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa vinvamli din be Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la. Amaa so bi mi bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli maa hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.

dag: dama a ni nya ka wum shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu a ni niŋ o shɛhiralana sokam zaa sani.
en: You must tell everyone what you have seen and heard.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: May you be blessed by the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth!.

dag: Bɛ tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nyɛla bɛ ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee dasara mini di kuruwɔɣila ni daantalisi ni di binzahi.
en: This is what they are responsible to carry as their work in the meeting tent: the frames of the meeting tent, its bars, pillars, and bases.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa din pala man tibu; amaa m Ba Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: Jesus said to them, It is true that you will drink from the cup that I drink from. But it is not for me to say who will sit at my right or my left. My Father has decided who will do that. He has prepared those places for them.

dag: M bihi, di bi simdi ni ti yurilim nyɛla yɛtɔɣa bee ti ni yɛri shɛm kɔŋko, amaa di simdi ni di nyɛla yurilim maŋli di tuma puuni.
en: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.

dag: n yi daa yuli wuntaŋa saha shɛl o ni daa puhi na, bee n-nya goli ni chani ni jilima.
en: if Ive looked at the sun when it shone, the moon, splendid as it moved.

dag: Daadamnim bi malila tuun kpɛma tumbu dunia ŋɔ ni? Ka bɛ dabisa bi ŋmanila bɛ ni bu so paa dabisa?.
en: Human life is like forced army service, like a life of hard manual labor.

dag: Dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo? Naawuni yi ʒe ti nyaaŋa, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo ti?.
en: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, ka bɛ ku tooi nya; ka chɛ ka bɛ yaaŋkɔba gbarigi sahakam.
en: Let their eyes grow too dim to see; make their insides tremble constantly.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa ti buŋ maa noli ka o bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ a ka a fiɛb ma buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then the LORD opened the donkeys mouth and it said to Balaam, What have I done to you that youve beaten me these three times.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti yi, ka alibarika ti lan be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti lab kpɛna.
en: You will be blessed when you are out and about and blessed when you come back.

dag: A ni daa gbibi duŋ kurugu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku Izraɛlnima saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nya yɛlibiɛɣu bɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa ni la zuɣu.
en: You were Israel's constant enemy and let her people be slaughtered in the time of her disaster, the time of final punishment for her sins.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino gbib bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe n-gil naa, ka ŋunkam kani bɛ sanna, bɛn kum o. Naa yi ti chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛn kul be o sani.
en: You are to guard King Joash with drawn swords and stay with him wherever he goes. Anyone who comes near you is to be killed.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm; salima tuumbaŋdib zaa buɣa dihi ba vi, dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binyara ka bi vuhira.
en: People are so stupid! Metalworkers are fooled by the idols that they themselves made. These statues are nothing but lies. They are stupid.

dag: ka booi kom niŋ tahili ni n-gbaag o nyaandoliba maa naba paɣibu, ka mali bɔdu shɛli din mil o shee ni maa nyɛhiri bɛ naba maa.
en: Then he poured some water into a washbasin and began to wash the disciples' feet and dry them with the towel around his waist.

dag: Dama nir yi nya o dindana ŋ-ŋɔ, o ni chɛ o ni alaafee? Dinzuɣu a ni niŋ ma shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, Yawɛ ni yo a sam viɛlli.
en: When someone finds an enemy, do they send the enemy away in peace? May the LORD repay you with good for what you have done for me today.

dag: Yawɛ yoog o bidibbina ni be luɣ shɛli n-yih o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina, dama ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ mali tuma ni o tum Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I have opened the place where my weapons are stored, and in my anger I have taken them out, because I, the Sovereign Lord Almighty, have work to do in Babylonia.

dag: yin piimiya tin shɛŋa ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi zali. Ka nir yi ku ninsal sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: you are to choose cities of refuge to which any of you can escape if you kill someone accidentally.

dag: Nyama, a yɛri ni a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka duh amaŋa nyuri bara. Ʒi a yiŋ baalim. Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn bo yɛla ti amaŋ tabili Judanima.
en: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. But stay at home and do your celebrating. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.

dag: Bɛ bi niŋ yɛda ni bɛ ni lan yi zibisim ni yaha, bɛ nyɛla takɔbi ni yɛn ku shɛba.
en: They have no hope of escaping from darkness, for somewhere a sword is waiting to kill them.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra. Ijipti yɛnnim nyɛla jɛra bɛn wuhi niriba din bi viɛla. Bɛ ku tooi yɛli Firawuna ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnim mini na kura zuliya.
en: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago.

dag: N yi ti gbarigi saha shɛli, a mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ bari ma la tɔŋ n ni doli so shɛli zuɣu.
en: When my spirit is weak inside me, you still know my way. But theyve hidden a trap for me in the path Im taking.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋubi yi naɣibihi, ka di yi puri atam zaa hal nti naai yi balibu, bɛ mi ti ku guui yi chi bee yi wain mini yi kpam ni yi naɣibihi ni biŋkɔbbaligu bihi hal ti kpihim yi birili.
en: They will eat your livestock and your crops, and you will starve to death. They will not leave you any grain, wine, olive oil, cattle, or sheep; and you will die.

dag: M mi ni di ni simdi ni daadamnim niŋ shɛli nyɛla bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, ka di nyaɣisim hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life.

dag: N ni zaŋ nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam maa yihi ya yi ni wurim be zuliya shɛb sani tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa zaa ni na.
en: I will lead you out from the peoples and gather you from the countries where youve been scattered—yes, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm and with wrath poured out!.

dag: Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni daa sab ninvuɣ shɛb yuya saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili Jɛriko tooni polo la m-bala.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest counted all these people. They counted the Israelites while they were in the Jordan Valley in Moab. This was near the Jordan River across from Jericho.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa lo Ibram alikauli yɛli, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Zaŋ Ijipti mɔɣili noli hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣ tital la noli.
en: At that time the Lord made an agreement with Abram and told him: I will give your descendants the land east of the Shihor River on the border of Egypt as far as the Euphrates River.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili yi sani din wuhiri ni n ni darigi yi tibili kpe ka yi baŋ ni n ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ya la shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: I will give you people proof, says the Lord , that I will punish you here in Egypt. Then you will know for sure that my promises to harm you will really happen.

dag: amaa ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm maa ti yil tia kaman Yisifu ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: but he executed the chief baker. It all happened just as Joseph had said.

dag: Ka Rut lan yɛli Naomi, Ka din gari dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla, o yɛli ma ni n kul dol o kachɛriba yihimi kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ n-naai.
en: Then Ruth said, Best of all, he told me to keep gathering grain with his workers until they finish the harvest.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ a min a mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ Lɛvinim la mir omaŋa. Di zaa yoli ka yi lan bɔri maligumaanitali tuma gba?.
en: He brought you Levites near to him to help the priests, but now you are trying to become priests also.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila yuri; bɛ guurimi kaman bɛ ni bari wɔr shɛb tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: They resemble horses, and like warhorses they charge.

dag: M biyurigu, a ʒe yim a ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa tiri ti mabihi la puuni, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ saamba la.
en: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa, ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Caleb had a younger brother named Kenaz. Kenaz had a son named Othniel. Othniel captured the city of Kiriath Sepher. So Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to Othniel to be his wife.

dag: Yi bi teei ni n ni daa be yi san la, n daa pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla?.
en: Don't you remember? I told you all this while I was with you.

dag: Yi bemi kaman yidaampaɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi zina! Yi bi mi ni ŋun zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo nyɛla Naawuni dima? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ zo, dilana zaŋ omaŋ leela Naawuni dima.
en: You unfaithful people! Dont you know that friendship with the world means hostility toward God? So whoever wants to be the worlds friend becomes Gods enemy.

dag: Ka Mɔab naa daa ti nya ka tɔb maa mii taɣ o na, ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ takɔbinyaɣiriba m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-tim Ɛdom naa polo ni o gari zo, amaa ka kɔŋ garibu.
en: The king of Moab saw that the battle was too strong for him, so he took men with swords to break through to the king of Edom. But they were not able to do it.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmiya yomyom ka bɛ ti yɛli Dauda ni o di gbe kulibɔŋ duli maa yuŋ ŋɔ, amaa ni o chɛ ka o min o niriba maa tirisi tooni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kpimsi ŋun naa mini niriba bɛn be o sani maa birili zaa.
en: Send a message to David now! Tell him not to spend the night at the places where people cross into the desert. Tell him to go across the Jordan River at once. If he crosses the river, the king and all his people will not be caught.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi tiŋgban shɛli din be Damaskus tooni ha. Man Yawɛ ŋun yuli nyɛ Binnamda zaa Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So I will send you as captives, far beyond Damascus. This is what the Lord says. His name is God All-Powerful.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa pii ma zali hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma, ka boli ma o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: But God had set me apart from birth and called me through his grace. He was pleased.

dag: ni di chɛ ka alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na baŋ ŋun Naawuni yɛm soya balibubalibu ni nyɛ shɛm cheechi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Izraɛl tin yini ninvuɣ tuhili yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ kɔbiga n-ni ti labina. Ka tin shɛli nim mi ninvuɣ kɔbiga yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, ninvuɣ pia n-ni ti labina.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, A city in Israel sends out a thousand soldiers, but only a hundred return; another city sends out a hundred, but only ten come back.

dag: Ibizan kalinsi nyaaŋa, Elɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. O daa niŋ bɛ zuɣulan la yuun pia.
en: After Ibzan, Elon from Zebulun led Israel for ten years.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Juda daa yɛli Onan, Zaŋm a biɛli pakoli maa dɔni, ka niŋ di ni simdi ni a niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yidan tizo n-nyɛ a, ka zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ti a biɛli maa.
en: So Judah told Onan, It's your duty to marry Tamar and have a child for your brother.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: No! Abraham answered. Don't ever do that, no matter what.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa ŋmari daɣu ka o lɛbiɛlim ti kpaai lu kom ni. Ka o kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Ndana! N suhi li mi na.
en: One of them was cutting down a tree when his ax head fell into the water. He cried out, Oh, no! Master, it was a borrowed ax.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka zuɣusaa ŋari ka saa bi lan mira, ka binshɛɣukam kɔŋ niŋbu.
en: That is why the sky holds back its dew and why the earth holds back its crops.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n lan ka yaburiga n niŋgbuŋ ni. N sɔŋsim zaa zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: I dont have the power to help myself, because all hope of success has been taken away from me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-yɛn nyɛ yi zaligunima yi ni yɛn be luɣ shɛlikam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The community of Israel must always obey these laws.

dag: ni di chɛ ka alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na baŋ ŋun Naawuni yɛm soya balibubalibu ni nyɛ shɛm cheechi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Gods purpose is now to show the rulers and powers in the heavens the many different varieties of his wisdom through the church.

dag: Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba bɛn be Wulinluhili polo daa deei tiŋgbani ŋɔ ka di leei bɛ dini.
en: So the people of Manasseh and Ephraim got their land.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm gba, ka zaŋ Daina Shɛkɛm yiŋa n-chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with their swords, took Dinah from Shechems household, and left.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be nimaani maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di saha maa, ka puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi chuɣu daba ayopɔin.
en: The Israelites who were there celebrated Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days.

dag: dama yi yi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu yi ni kpi, amaa yi yi chɛ ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku yi ninsalitali biɛhigu maa tuma yi ni, yi ni be.
en: If you live on the basis of selfishness, you are going to die. But if by the Spirit you put to death the actions of the body, you will live.

dag: A zuɣu, n ni tooi nyaŋ n dimnima. N Naawuni maa zuɣu, n ni tooi yiɣi yaɣi gooni.
en: With your help I can defeat an army. If my God is with me, I can climb over enemy walls.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni ni Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi tuun shɛŋa din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi.
en: Only fools think there is no God. People like that are evil and do terrible things. They never do what is right.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri di yɛla chani maa ka Yisa chirigi ba sol ni, ka bɛ min o doli chana;.
en: While they were talking, discussing these things, Jesus himself came near and walked with them.

dag: Pagɔr bia bi simdi ni o be Yawɛ niriba ni, hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, di bi simdi ni bɛ chɛ ka o bia kpe Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord 's people.

dag: Lala ka bɛ yɛn ku yi gba m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni la zuɣu.
en: Egypt, you also will be destroyed, and you will lie down by those foreigners. You will lie with the other soldiers who were killed in battle.

dag: Dama dindali yuŋ maa n ni tim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gari, ka ku Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bikpamba zaa, ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka darigi Ijipti buɣa zaa tibili. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: On that night I will go through the land of Egypt, killing every first-born male, both human and animal, and punishing all the gods of Egypt. I am the Lord .

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni Yisa nyɛla Naa Hɛrɔd sulinsi ni nira, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Hɛrɔd sani, dama Naa Hɛrɔd gba daa kala Jɛrusalɛm na di saha maa.
en: When he learned that Jesus was from Herods district, Pilate sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Shifitan bia Kɛmuɛl.
en: from the tribe of Ephraim—Kemuel son of Shiphtan;.

dag: Ka ŋunkam dɔni tiŋa yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka ŋunkam di bindirigu yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra.
en: Anyone who eats in that house or lies down in there must wash their clothes.

dag: Amaa yinim Taiatiranim bɛn kpalim ka bi doli wuhibu maa, ka mi na bi bɔhim bɛ ni shɛb ni booni shɛli Sintani ashili yɛl kara tuma la, n yɛri ya mi ni n ku zaŋ ʒi tibisi shɛli n-ʒili ya.
en: But others of you in Thyatira have not followed her teaching. You have not learned the things they call Satans deep secrets. This is what I say to you: I will not put any other burden on you.

dag: Yawɛ neem o nina lihi ya ka tin ya suhudoo.
en: May the Lord answer your prayers and give you peace.

dag: Wain yi ti mɔha, ka be pipia ni kpeera, ka yiɣiri lɛbira, nyin di lihi li.
en: Dont look at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, going down smoothly.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yi gba: Yi yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli so ni bi mi, wula ka so ni tooi baŋ di gbinni? Di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi tɔɣisiri bahirila pɔhim ni yoli.
en: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba tah o tiŋgbɔn kasi ni zoya tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ o nudirigu tuhi fa la ni.
en: He brought them to his holy land, to the mountains which he himself conquered.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni.
en: Im the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? He isnt the God of the dead but of the living.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɛriko naa, Nyama, Izraɛlnim shɛb ka kpe na yuŋ ŋɔ ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni be shɛm.
en: Someone told the king of Jericho, Men from the Israelites have come here tonight to spy on the land.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya biɛrim, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam. Biɛrim maa ni ti ŋmanila paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ni ti lihiri tab ninni ka dabiɛm mali ba. Bɛ nini ni ti mooi.
en: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nini kpa tiŋa.
en: Hearing this, the disciples fell on their faces, filled with awe.

dag: N sabi Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri sɔŋ, n zaŋ bɛ daalahichi maa niŋ sɔɣisili shee.
en: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi kariti ti saria, o darigirila ti tibili ni ti di pahi dunianim zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.

dag: Chɛ ka ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒeensi yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo mini karimbaannim bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ taba la fo.
en: Those evil people brag and tell lies about those who do right. They are so proud now, but their lying lips will be silent.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa yi tɔb maa ni na ka nyɛ bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: Moses became angry with the officers, the commanders of battalions and companies, who had returned from the war.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tinzun tiŋ wuna din be bɛ sani zaa mini bɛ ni daa kpa tibikpar shɛŋa ti Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li sɔɣi ti shɛli din nyɛ oki tia din miri Shɛkɛm la gbini.
en: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods that they had and also the earrings that they were wearing. He buried them beneath the oak tree near Shechem.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia zaa, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku duli tiŋgbana nima, maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa yihi nabi yino n-lo o alikauli, ka chɛ ka o po pɔri. Ka o daa zaŋ tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa chaŋ.
en: He chose someone from the family of Judah's king and signed a treaty with him, then made him swear to be loyal. He also led away other important citizens.

dag: Ka bulaa la mi wuhiri Giriis naa yɛla. Ka o yil gahindili din daa sa o nina ayi sunsuuni la nyɛla di tuuli naa.
en: The long-haired he-goat is the king of Greece, and the big horn between its eyes is the first king.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛiayika ka di yɛlim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Then he made the table from acacia wood. The table was cubits long, cubit wide, and / cubits high.

dag: Ti paɣiba mini ti bihi ni ti piɛri ni buhi ni ti niɣi zaa ni kpalim be Giliad tinsi maa ni.
en: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi bihi ayopɔin tarigiya, o tarigiya lu. Wuntaŋ na bi lu ka yuŋ pun zib o sani. O di vi ka nya filiŋ. N ni chɛ ka bɛn kpalim lu tɔbu ni bɛ dimnim tooni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The mother of seven will grow weak and gasp for air; her sun will set while it is yet day; she will be ashamed and disgraced. I will deliver the survivors to the sword, to the power of their enemies, declares the LORD.

dag: Namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa daa taɣi ba la yuya: O daa boli Daniɛl la Bɛlitishaaza, ka boli Hanania Shadirak, ka boli Mishɛl Mɛshak, ka boli Azaria mi Abɛdnɛgo.
en: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.

dag: Mɛmiya duɣuri n-zaŋdi tampiligim niŋdi di puuni, ka mali soobuya mini taha ni dirijaba ni lahi din ni niŋdi buɣim. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali di lahi mini duɣuri zaa.
en: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o tiliginsim shee bi wɔɣa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd o sani din ni chɛ ka o jilima kul kpalim be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.

dag: Yawɛ, labisim ti na kaman saa ni miri n-zaŋdi kom na ti niŋdi Nɛgɛb mɔɣ kuma ni shɛm la.
en: Our Lord , we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.

dag: Fukumsinim yi bɔhi ti zuŋɔ taabu ŋɔ gbinni, ti ni kpe yɛla ni di zuɣu, dama ti ka daliri yɛlli ŋɔ puuni din ni zaŋ wuhi ba.
en: I say this because someone might see this trouble today and say we are rioting. We could not explain all this trouble, because there is no real reason for this meeting.

dag: Bɛ kul bela nimaani n-yaari bɛ noya kumda, ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri bɛ noya ni na. Bɛ tɛhiya, Ŋuni n-lee ni wum ti ni yɛli shɛm.
en: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, No one can hear us.

dag: Yɛm viɛla, ka ŋmanila fali, ka niŋdi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni anfaani.
en: Having wisdom is better than an inheritance.

dag: Ka n nyee daa ti nyɔni piɛguliba ata shɛb bɛn daa je ma, ka n kari ba gol yini puuni.
en: I lost patience with three other shepherds, who hated me, and I got rid of them all in a single month.

dag: Ka a kpamba ŋɔ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni yɛli ma, A min a niriba zaa bɛn dol a yimiya chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka n ni chaŋ. Ka o daa ŋmaligi Firawuna sani n-yi ni suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: All these officials of yours will come down and bow to me. They will say, Leave and take all your people with you. Only then will I leave! Then in anger, Moses left the meeting with Pharaoh.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpe mɔɣu chaŋ dabisi muni chandi nti teei ʒini ti shɛli gbini n-suhiri Naawuni bɔri ni o kpi. O daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, di saɣiya, deemi n nyɛvili pumpɔŋɔ, dama m bi so n yaannima.
en: then walked another whole day into the desert. Finally, he came to a large bush and sat down in its shade. He begged the Lord , I've had enough. Just let me die! I'm no better off than my ancestors.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ suhuyubu soli ka jɛmdi wun shɛŋa la ni ti bemi kaman jinjɛŋŋmaa din lan ka buchi ŋɔ ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Instead of listening to me, this wicked people follow their own willful hearts and pursue other gods, worshipping and serving them. They will become like this linen garment—good for nothing!.

dag: So yi chɛ ka o biŋkɔbiri ŋub so puu ni binyɛra bee o wain tihi puu bee n-chɛ o biŋkɔbigu bahi ka o chaŋ so puu ni nti ŋub o bindira, di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o puu ni bindira din niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bee o wain tihi din wali viɛnyɛliŋga yo di samli.
en: When someone lets an animal loose to eat in another persons field and causes the field or vineyard to be stripped of its crop, the owner must pay them back with the best from his own field or vineyard.

dag: Kaman ninvuɣ fariba ni sɔɣi doya guli so shɛm, lala ka bɛ maligumaaniba gba laɣim doya. Bɛ kula niriba sol ni hal ni Shɛkɛm. Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: The priests are like a gang of robbers who wait in ambush for someone. Even on the road to the holy place at Shechem they commit murder. And they do all this evil deliberately!.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi tooi kom maa m-mali bɛ zilima nyur li kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisita, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa daa gbanila tiŋ nyura.
en: There were men who used their hands to bring water to their mouth and lapped it like a dog does. All the other people bent down and drank the water.

dag: ka di nyɛ o min o zuliya maligumaanitali alikauli ʒiɛmani kam ni, dama o zab nyuli ti o Naawuni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. .
en: He and his descendants are permanently established as priests, because he did not tolerate any rivals to me and brought about forgiveness for the people's sin.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ mɔɣa kom leei ʒim, ka bɛ ku tooi lan nyu bɛ kulibɔna kom.
en: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land to which Im bringing you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yihi ma biŋkɔbigulibo maa ni ka yɛli ma, Cham ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ti n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: But the Lord took me from my work as a shepherd and ordered me to come and prophesy to his people Israel.

dag: Ka Dauda nachimba maa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Dauda yuli yɛli Nabal yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka kpalim ʒiɛya guhira.
en: David's men went to Nabal and gave him David's message, then they waited for Nabal's answer.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi ka n sanna, yi daa bi je ma mi ka kari ma yi ya.
en: Isaac asked, Why have you come to see me? You were not friendly to me before. You even forced me to leave your country.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi tiŋ dunɔdali gbini ni zuri so nyaaŋa, ka danyuriba zaŋ ma niŋ yila ni yiina.
en: Those who sit at the city gate muttered things about me; drunkards made up rude songs.

dag: N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi lee m bia. N ti ku yihi n yurilim maŋli o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n yurilim ŋun daa daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not withdraw my support from him as I did from Saul, whom I removed so that you could be king.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka mɔɣu ni buŋ gɔr o yubu? Ka ŋuni n-lee gaai mɔɣu ni bun so ŋun zɔri pam naba ni tanachi?.
en: Who gave the wild donkeys their freedom? Who turned them loose and let them roam?.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa kana di saha maa ti ku Anakinim zaa bɛn daa be zoya tinsi ni la. Bɛ daa bela Hiburɔn mini Dɛbir ni Anab ni zoya zuɣu tinsi din zaa daa be Juda mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔna ni la. Jɔshua daa ku niriba maa zaa, ka saɣim bɛ tinsi.
en: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.

dag: ka n tiri ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti ku bahi yoli, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba n nuu ni.
en: I give them eternal life, and they shall never die. No one can snatch them away from me.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yaa, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa. Di yi nyɛla din tuhi dolibu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tah o ʒiishee?.
en: If the issue is strength—behold power! If justice—who calls God to meet me?.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bɔŋɔ? Wuhiri palli m-bala! Doo ŋɔ mali yiko mi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli.
en: Everyone was shaken and questioned among themselves, Whats this? A new teaching with authority! He even commands unclean spirits and they obey him.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi binnana la mini yi binwɔɣila din be yi san la, ka yi ku lan jɛm yi ni zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them.

dag: O bi labir o nini kpaŋ ka chɛri wuntizɔriba, amaa o zaŋdi ba mi ʒiini bɛ nanim sani bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi, ka niriba duhiri ba sahakam.
en: He doesnt avert his eyes from the righteous; he seats kings on thrones forever, and they are lifted up.

dag: N daa bi tim anabinim maa, amaa ka bɛ yiɣisi guui chaŋ. N daa bi zaŋ n yɛligu ti ba, amaa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord said, I did not send these prophets, but even so they went. I did not give them any message, but still they spoke in my name.

dag: Amaa niriba maa n-daa va ti ni tuhi di binshɛŋa maa zaa na, piɛri mini naɣilahi ni di ni daa simdi ni bɛ saɣim bin viɛl shɛŋa zaa, bɛ daa zaŋ li mi na ni bɛ ti mali sara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani Giligal.
en: All the animals were going to be destroyed anyway. That's why the army brought the best sheep and cattle to Gilgal as sacrifices to the Lord your God.

dag: Izraɛl bihi min o yaansi bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayɔbu. O bidibisi paɣiba daa ka bɛ kalinli maa ni.
en: Sixty-six members of Jacob's family went to Egypt with him, not counting his daughters-in-law.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ lan zaŋm daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa yaha. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: they all decided to celebrate for another seven days. So they celebrated with joy.

dag: Ka tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi zoli maa zuɣu n-zaŋ hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔna n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ti paai tiŋ kar shɛŋa din ʒi Ɛfurɔn Zoli zuɣu la. Ka di daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ŋmaligi n-zaŋ hal ti paai Baala bee Kiriatijiarim.
en: The border turned from the top of the mountain to the waters of Nephtoah Spring and went to the cities of Mount Ephron. The border turned toward Baalah .

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti pirigi Yisa binyɛra ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: They stripped off Jesus' clothes and put a scarlet robe on him.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, n ni chɛ ka zuliya shɛb kana ti lu yi zuɣu. Bɛ ni nahim ya Lɛbohamat dunol la shee zaŋ hal ni Araba kulibɔŋ la ni.
en: But Israel, I will bring a nation against you that will bring troubles to your whole country from Lebo Hamath to Arabah Brook. This is what the Lord God All-Powerful said.

dag: Bɛ pala tuum maŋa; bɛ nyɛla tumtumdiba bɛn yɔhindi niriba, ka lɛbigi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ be kaman Masia tuumba n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.

dag: Miriya ka yi di binshɛŋa din chihiri dibu.
en: Do not eat anything that the Lord has declared unclean.

dag: Nyama, n ni ti tim bi so ka yɛl o, Cham ti bo piɛma maa shee. N yi ti yɛl o, Nyama, piɛma maa be a luɣili ŋɔ polo, kpuɣimi li na, di saha nyin yim na, dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛli ku lan niŋ a, ka barina shɛli mi lan kani.
en: Then Ill send the servant boy, saying, Go retrieve the arrow. If I yell to the boy, Hey! The arrow is on this side of you. Get it! then you can come out because it will be safe for you. There wont be any trouble—I make a pledge on the LORDs life.

dag: dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Everyone who uses what they have will get more. They will have much more than they need. But people who do not use what they have will have everything taken away from them.

dag: ka yɛra, Naawuni chɛ o bahi; doliy o ti gbaag o, dama so kani n-ni fa o bahi.
en: They say, Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o So na be Sool daŋ ni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim kaman Naawuni ni bɔri shɛm? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, Jɔnatan bidibiga na beni, o mi nyɛla gbarigu.
en: The king said, Is there anyone left in Sauls family? I want to show Gods kindness to this person. Ziba said to King David, Jonathan has a son still living. He is crippled in both feet.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm gbaŋ maa ni m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs, a bihi bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ ti a.
en: This is the copy of the letter sent to King Artaxerxes: From your servants living in the area west of the Euphrates River.

dag: Niriba maa kanimina, ka bɛ chandi vuri ŋmani kom pam vuri, amaa o ni tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ katiŋa. Bɛ ni zo kaman zoya zuɣu wurigu ni taŋkpa shɛli pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe m-bahi.
en: The nations advance like rushing waves, but God reprimands them and they retreat, driven away like dust on a mountainside, like straw in a whirlwind.

dag: Ka tizɔra bi deeri tizɔbo laara naɣila o dolila tizɔbo zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Athletes in a race must obey all the rules to win.

dag: Ka Dauda zɔsimo Hushai daa labi tiŋ puuni ti saɣisi saha shɛli Absalom ni kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: So Davids friend Hushai went back to the city, just as Absalom arrived in Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa tim tuumba nti yɛli Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl Naa Jɛhu yaaŋa la, Kamina ka ti ti zaŋ ti gbɛri kpa taba.
en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Israels King Joash son of Jehoahaz son of Israels King Jehu, saying, Come on! Lets go head-to-head.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan niŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuhi me bimbin shɛŋa la yɛda. Bɛ mi ti ku lihi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa din nyɛ dari mini bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim Ashɛrim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: They will not trust the great things they have made. They will not go to the special gardens and altars they made for false gods.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o lan zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni nti zaŋ ma gari dundɔŋ lɔrisi anahi la ni, ka dundɔŋ maa ni lɔriga kam ti mali dundɔŋ.
en: Then the man led me out to the outer courtyard. He led me to the four corners of the courtyard. I saw smaller courtyards in each corner of the large courtyard.

dag: Hal yi ni kul zaŋ bɔchaa mini chibo pam paɣi yimaŋ maa zaa yoli, man sani yi taali maa na kul beni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even if you washed with the strongest soap, I would still see the stain of your guilt.

dag: Ka Mariama daa ti paai Yisa sani n-gban o tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi.
en: Mary arrived where Jesus was, and as soon as she saw him, she fell at his feet. Lord, she said, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

dag: ka yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zaani ya ni yi doli so shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi, din mi n-nyɛ noli dibu maa.
en: but a curse, if you disobey these commands and turn away to worship other gods that you have never worshiped before.
