dag: A ni tooi zaŋ gabiga tu o nyee ni bee n-zaŋ goo kuh o yɛno pili yi?.
en: Can you put a cord through his nose, pierce his jaw with a barb?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the angel told Joshua that.

dag: Sɛt ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni anu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh.
en: After Seth was years old, he had a son named Enosh.

dag: Amaa nyin kpuɣim a jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa n-teeg a nuu tiri teeku maa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du.
en: Then hold your walking stick over the sea. The water will open up and make a road where they can walk through on dry ground.

dag: Di saha maa, zuliya kam bɛn daa kana ti lu Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti chani Jɛrusalɛm yuuni kam ti jɛmdi Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka puhiri Suɣa Tibu chuɣu la.
en: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni ku zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi bee n-deei tuumbiɛrilana.
en: God does not support evil people, and he does not abandon the innocent.

dag: ni Biliha ni Ɛzɛm ni Tolad.
en: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: Then he put his brother Abishai in command of the rest of the army and told them to fight against the Ammonites.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun lo paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti o amiliya niŋ din viɛla, amaa ŋun bi lo amiliya n-nyɛ ŋun niŋ din so.
en: So the man who marries does well, but the one who doesn't marry does even better.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa mali hal ti kurigi ka naanyi kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o ba Jɔash siliga ni Abiɛza daŋ niriba ya Ofira.
en: So Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age. He was buried in the tomb that Joash, his father, owned. That tomb is in the city of Ophrah, where the family of Abiezer lives.

dag: A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Your cheeks glow behind your veil.

dag: Di saha ka Ishibibɛnɔb ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumya zuliya, ka o kpani tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata ni pirigili, ka takɔb palli lo o sheeni la daa tɛhi ni o ni tooi ku Dauda.
en: One of the Philistine warriors was Ishbibenob, who was a descendant of the Rephaim, and he tried to kill David. Ishbibenob was armed with a new sword, and his bronze spearhead alone weighed about three and a half kilograms.

dag: Ka Hiram ŋun daa nyɛ Taai naa la daa tim tuumba ka bɛ ʒi sida tihi dari na ti ti Dauda, ka daa lan tim kapintanim mini tammɛriba na ni bɛ ti me Naa Dauda yili ti o.
en: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. Carpenters and stone workers came with them, and they brought cedar logs so they could build David a palace.

dag: Ka binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa shiri bili. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: The earth produced all kinds of vegetation. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.

dag: Ka niriba anahi daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o ka Yisa sanna.
en: when four people came up, carrying a man on a mat because he could not walk.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, Yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nir ni ni ti niŋ shɛli naani ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Ka ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun zaŋd o Shia n-niŋd o daanabinim ni daa tim o malaika na ni o ti wuh o jɛmdiba din yɛn niŋ ka di ku yuui.
en: Then the angel said to me, These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must happen soon:.

dag: Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa ʒini tuhi Yisifu. Ŋun nyɛ bɛ kpɛma n-daa daŋ ʒinibu, ka bɛn paya ʒini tuɣi hal ti paai bɛ biasani, ka di daa gari niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba.
en: To the surprise of Joseph's brothers, they were seated in front of him according to their ages, from the oldest to the youngest.

dag: Alahichinima chɛli bɛ daalahichi soli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri chɛ bɛ tɛhi biɛri, ka ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ka o ti zo ba nambɔɣu, dama o ni chɛ bɛ taali zaa.
en: Let the wicked leave their way of life and change their way of thinking. Let them turn to the Lord , our God; he is merciful and quick to forgive.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sɔɣimi doya gu ma ni bɛ ku ma; amaa a zaligunim maa yɛla ka man kul tɛhira.
en: The wicked wait for me, wanting to kill me, but Im studying your laws.

dag: Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daa galisimi kaman teeku duli bihigu la, ka bɛ daa diri ka nyuri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: The people of Judah and Israel were as numerous as the grains of sand on the seashore; they ate and drank, and were happy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa ŋmaai Izraɛl zuɣu ni o nyoli kaman kpikpal tia wulli bee gbiŋgbaŋ la bahi dahin yini.
en: So the Lord cut off Israels head and tail. He took away the branch and the stalk in one day.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ Bɛrishiiba.
en: Isaac went on to Beersheba.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suhi Naawuni maa nti fo ka bɛ laɣiŋgu maa shee ti gbaai dambu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kpe m-pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu ni suhukpeeni.
en: When they finished praying, the place where they were meeting was shaken. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to proclaim God's message with boldness.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kul niŋdi ba fitiina shɛm, lala ka bɛ zuliya maa daa kul nabiri ka yɛligiri pahira. Ka jɛlinsi mini dabiɛm daa kpe Ijiptinim maa suhuri ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But the more they were oppressed, the more they grew and spread, so much so that the Egyptians started to look at the Israelites with disgust and dread.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni Sinai mɔɣu maa ni. Yawɛ ni daa kul zali Musa shɛlikam zaa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: and on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month they did so in the Sinai Desert. The people did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma min o kurigu gbaɣino yɛli Dauda, ka zaŋ kurigu zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: Saul put his own clothes on David. He put a bronze helmet on Davids head and armor on his body.

dag: Ʒilinsi saha la ha Naawuni daa di ti suɣilo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o zali shɛlikam zaa ni sokam niŋmi tuuba;.
en: In the past, God forgave all this because people did not know what they were doing. But now he says that everyone everywhere must turn to him.

dag: Di tamiya, teemiya yi ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi shɛm tiŋgban nɛl ni la yɛla. Dahin shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mali hal ti paai kpe na ŋɔ yi kul nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n zaligunima, ka miriya ka yi ti doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaya din chihiri la, ka miriya ka yi ti zaŋ li saɣim yimaŋa: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: And the Lord said, Obey the commands I give and do not follow the practices of the people who lived in the land before you, and do not make yourselves unclean by doing any of these things. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka a saha yi ti paai ni a pah a yaannim zuɣu, n ni piig amaŋmaŋ zuliya ni so ŋun nyɛ amaŋmaŋ bidɔɣiro ka o leei naa.
en: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Dolintab biɛr biɛɣu dolibu saɣindi biɛrisuŋ.
en: Dont be fooled: Bad friends will ruin good habits.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di yi ti kpa ni n darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi tibidarigibo tibili, man di darigi bɛ tibili? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu. Di simdi ni yi nya tibidarigibo.
en: The LORD proclaims: If the innocent must drink the cup, why do you expect to escape punishment? You wont! You will drink it!.

dag: Amaa yuma maa yi kpalim biɛla ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa, dindina ŋun chɛ ka o mini dilan mali yuun shɛŋa din kpalim ni o tum tuma maa laasabu, ka o labisi di liɣiri ti o ka deeg omaŋa.
en: If only a few years are left until the year of Jubilee, the one who was sold must pay a small part of the original price.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛsta daa boli Hatak ŋun daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣili so naa ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o sɔŋd o la na nti yɛl o ni o cham ti bɔhi Mɔdɛkai nya din niŋ o ni din tahi lala na.
en: Esther had a servant named Hathach, who had been given to her by the king. So she called him in and said, Find out what's wrong with Mordecai and why he's acting this way.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ti ku lan beni, ka sagbana ti kpabikpabi kaman sɔŋ la; ka saŋmarisi ti luna kaman wain tia vari la bee kaman fiig tia wala ni suuri luri shɛm la.
en: All the stars of heaven will dissolve, the skies will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall, like a leaf withering from a vine, like fruit from a fig tree.

dag: Ka bɛn daa mali Pool tahiri maa daa zaŋ o hal ti paai Atɛnsi, ka Pool yɛli ba ni bɛ yi lab kuli bɛn yɛlimi Silas mini Timoti ni bɛ yi nya soli bɛn paam o na yomyom. Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: The men who were taking Paul went with him as far as Athens and then returned to Berea with instructions from Paul that Silas and Timothy should join him as soon as possible.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa ŋmaligi Dauda sani yi nti tim ni bɛ cham ti gɔŋ Abinɛr labisina. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paag o Sira kɔbiliga gbini n-gɔŋ o labisina, amaa Dauda daa bi mi di yɛla.
en: Joab left David and sent messengers to Abner at the well of Sirah. The messengers brought Abner back, but David did not know this.

dag: Nyin Naawuni zuɣu ka ti kul nyuri bara, ka ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: So we glory in God at all times and give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

dag: Dama bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ku tooi puh a, bɛ mi ku tooi paɣ a. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be gbala ni ku tooi mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ a ʒiɛyimtali polo.
en: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.

dag: Pa pumpɔŋɔ ka yi boli ma, Ti ba, a nyɛla ŋun daa yuri ti ti bilim ni.
en: You call me your father or your long-lost friend;.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa bɔhim Yawɛ jɛmbu yila, ka mi li yilibu viɛnyɛliŋga kalinli daa nyɛla niriba kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛiayika.
en: These men and their relatives from the tribe of Levi were trained to sing. There were men who learned to sing praises to the Lord .

dag: Mbaye, dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali, ka di kpee kani. Di nyɛla Yaakubu suhusaɣiŋgu saha, amaa bɛ ni tilig o di ni.
en: My people, soon you will suffer worse than ever before, but I will save you.

dag: Nir yi be mɔpilli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli, di so ni o min o paɣa so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yili ni.
en: Better to live on the edge of a roof than with a contentious woman in a large house.

dag: Amaa niŋmi Barizillai ŋun nyɛ Giliad nir la bihi nirilim, ka zaŋ ba pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. Dama bɛ daa niŋ ma nirilim saha shɛli a biɛli Absalom ni daa kariti doli ma ka n zɔri la.
en: The sons of Barzillai from Gilead helped me when I was running from your brother Absalom. Be kind to them and let them eat at your table.

dag: Zɛrubabɛl n-sɔŋ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu ŋɔ tampuɣili. O mi ni me li naai. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n niriba maa baŋ ni mani n-shiri tim a bɛ sanna.
en: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiya ba Izraɛlnim ni daa chaŋ taŋkpa kuŋ zuɣu Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni n-du li shɛm yɛla.
en: you will tell them about the time when Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yɛli naa, M bɔri ni n suh a la bimbil yini, a mi di mɔŋ ma li. Ka naa yɛl o, M ma, yɛlim ma a ni bɔri shɛli maa, dama n ku mɔŋ a li.
en: Bathsheba said to him, I have one small thing to ask you. Please dont refuse me. The king answered, Ask whatever you want, mother. I will not refuse you.

dag: Kamiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kuɣ nɛɔŋ shɛli ninsalinim ni zaɣisi ka lih o ka o ka buchi, amaa ka Naawuni ŋun piig o ka lih o ka o mali buchi la sanna.
en: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Farisiinim yɛri taba, Nyamiya, ti kul nahindila timaŋ yoli! Dunianim zaa n-kabiri dol o la.
en: But the Pharisees said to each other, There is nothing we can do! Everyone in the world is following Jesus.

dag: amaa di sabiya ni ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma sani, chinchini maa piligirimi.
en: But it can be removed, as the scripture says about Moses: His veil was removed when he turned to the Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔzuɣu ka ti lan yɛn bo kum ti timaŋa? Dama buɣim titali ŋɔ ni ti di ti. Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi, ti ni kpi.
en: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord 's voice, we will die.

dag: Chɛ ka teeku mini di puuni binshɛɣukam zaa ŋum; ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Let the sea and everything in it roar! Let the countryside and everything in it celebrate!.

dag: Hɛzirɔn bia Kalɛb min o paɣiba Azuba ni Jɛriɔt daa dɔɣi bihi. O bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛshɛr mini Shɔbab ni Aridɔn.
en: Caleb was Hezrons son. Caleb had children with his wife Azubah. Azubah was the daughter of Jerioth. Azubahs sons were Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma kul maani ma la ansarisi. Bɛ yi nya ma, bɛ viinila bɛ zuɣuri.
en: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.

dag: Dama o daa bi ku ma niŋ m ma pul ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m ma puli maa leei n gballi, ka o puli maa kul bara sahakam.
en: because he did not kill me while I was in my mothers womb. If he had killed me then, my mother would have been my grave, and I would not have been born.

dag: Baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo mali ma alahiziba pam. Di galisiya yaɣi ka n ku tooi baŋ li.
en: That kind of knowledge is too much for me; its so high above me that I cant reach it.

dag: Ka sapashin maa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb maa daa lab yiŋa nti nya ka sapashini maa dabili maa shiri kpaŋmi zaa.
en: The officer's friends returned and found the servant well.

dag: Dama n wumla kuhigu kaman paɣa n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la. Ka di biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn tuui dɔɣi la. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi vuhibu ka kuhira, ka teeg o nuhi ka yɛra, Mbusim paai ma! N tarigiri lurila bɛn yɛn ku ma tooni. .
en: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. I'm dying! she said. They have murdered me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa nam ya yi manim puya ni; n ni sɔŋ ya. N dabili Yaakubu zuliya, Jɛshurun ŋun nyɛ n ni pun pii so ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: I am the Lord , and I made you. I am the one who created you. I have helped you since you were in your mothers womb. Jacob, my servant, dont be afraid. Jeshurun, I chose you.

dag: N niriba Izraɛlnima, yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ shɛb kaman bɛ ni bu ka shɛli n-yɛl li ŋɔ, n ni wum shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka n zaŋ yɛri ya maa.
en: Oh, my downtrodden people, threshed on my threshing floor, what I heard from the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, I reported to you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa karibu yɛla, ka daa ti bo n-nya o bɔh o, A niŋ Daadam Bia la yɛda.
en: When Jesus heard that they had forced the man to leave, he found him and asked him, Do you believe in the Son of Man.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ yalim gari biŋkuma sara kam zaa ni, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini Naawuni yalim alikauli la ti pooi yi sara maligu maa ni, dinzuɣu yi sara maligu kam ni di simdi ka yi chɛ ka yalim be di ni.
en: Also, you must put salt on every grain offering you bring. You must not forget to add salt, because it represents Gods agreement with you. Always put salt on these offerings.

dag: mini Pateesa shɛŋa din yili dundɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ ni dunol ni n-liri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili mini sara maligu bimbin la ni di mihi zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.

dag: Ka yi ti mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di li nimaani, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Offer up well-being sacrifices and eat them there, celebrating in the LORD your Gods presence.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa boli doo maa m-bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee be.
en: The LORD God called to the man and said to him, Where are you.

dag: Di saha maa Masia cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim daa na ʒi ma ni bɛ nini.
en: but I wasnt known personally by the Christian churches in Judea.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa bi lan saɣi chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, Yɛhudianim bɛn be nimaani ni daa lo ni bɛ ku o la zuɣu.
en: After this, Jesus traveled in Galilee; he did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jewish authorities there were wanting to kill him.

dag: Yi yi yuri taba, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba. .
en: All people will know that you are my followers if you love each other.

dag: N ni chɛ ka di maligumaaniba zaŋ tiliginsim ye kaman situra la, ka chɛ ka di niriba bɛn ʒe yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: I will bless her priests in all they do, and her people will sing and shout for joy.

dag: Ŋuna n-tuhi nyaŋ sokam zaa, ka chɛ ka ti su zuliya kam zaa.
en: He gave us victory over the peoples; he made us rule over the nations.

dag: Ka n timdi m mabihi ŋɔ na pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu shɛm la ku kpalim yoli, ka di chɛ ka yi mali shili kaman n ni yɛli ni yi pun mali shili shɛm la.
en: Now I am sending these believers, so that our boasting about you in this matter may not turn out to be empty words. But, just as I said, you will be ready with your help.

dag: Ka vuri daa mɔni, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim daa yiɣisi zani n-zaɣisi ka yɛli, Ti bi nya doo ŋɔ galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di pa shɛli shi so bee malaika n-shiri tɔɣis o di yɛla.
en: and so there was a lot of shouting. Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees. Finally, they became angry and said, We don't find anything wrong with this man. Maybe a spirit or an angel really did speak to him.

dag: Di saha a ni ti teei a ni daa be shɛm la yɛla, ka vi gbaag a. Saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ a mabihi bɛn nyɛ a biɛli min a tizo la ti a kaman a bipuɣinsi la. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala n ni lo a alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: And you will remember your ways and be ashamed, when in spite of your covenant I take your big sisters and little sisters from you and give them back to you as daughters.

dag: M mabihi, so yi yɛli ni o mali yɛda, amaa ka di bi tumdi tuma, di buchi lee nyɛla dini? Yɛda niŋbu ŋɔ tatabo ni tooi tilig o?.
en: My brothers and sisters, if a person claims to have faith but does nothing, that faith is worth nothing. Faith like that cannot save anyone.

dag: Amaa Siria naa ŋɔ bihi ni ti laɣim tɔbbihi pam lo tɔbu. Bɛ ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam chaŋ kaman kokpɛɣu la n-tuhi tɔb maa hal ti paai bɛ dimnim sansan ni.
en: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya nira ni o mabia: Saimɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: As Jesus walked along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers who were fishermen, Simon and his brother Andrew, catching fish in the lake with a net.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti nyɛla juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka so ti ku kari ba.
en: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.

dag: Ŋun kɔra, o ni mali bindirigu pam, amaa ŋun doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi, fara ni gbaag o pam.
en: Those who work the land will have plenty to eat, but those with worthless pursuits will have plenty of poverty.

dag: dunɔdaya ata. Rubin zuliya dunɔdali mini Juda zuliya dunɔdali ni Lɛvi zuliya dunɔdali. Bɛ ti yɛn zaŋla Izraɛl zuliya maa yuya boli tiŋ maa dunɔdaya.
en: There will be three gates: Reubens Gate, Judahs Gate, and Levis Gate.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, sabimi yilli ŋɔ n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnima, zaŋm li niŋ bɛ noya ni din ni chɛ ka yilli ŋɔ leei shɛhira n sani n-jɛndi Izraɛlnima.
en: Moses and Joshua, I am going to give you the words to a new song. Write them down and teach the song to the Israelites. If they learn it, they will know what I want them to do, and so they will have no excuse for not obeying me.

dag: Nimaani ka ŋun gbibi yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ min o naan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n sariakarita maa naan bahi ma zaa.
en: Since I am an honest man, he would let me tell my story. Then my Judge would set me free!.

dag: N nyuli zabbu mini n suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Dindali maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti dam pam.
en: In my anger and strong emotions, I make this promise: I promise that there will be a strong earthquake in the land of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-zahindi wuntizɔriba, nyini n-nyari din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn bɔhi ba biɛri shɛm, dama n zaŋ n yɛla maa niŋla a nuu ni.
en: But, Almighty Lord , you test people justly; you know what is in their hearts and minds. So let me see you take revenge on my enemies, for I have placed my cause in your hands.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ŋun labina maa, Yiɣisim chaŋ a chandi; a yɛda niŋbu zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ.
en: Then Jesus said to the man, Stand up! You can go. You were healed because you believed.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinima.
en: Canaan was also the ancestor of the Jebusites, the Amorites, Girgashites.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun pɔra ka bɛ ʒiɛm ma, amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: Im insignificant and unpopular, but I dont forget your precepts.

dag: Lala ka di lan simdi ni yi zaŋ yi naɣilabil tuuli bee yi biŋkɔbbaligu bi tuuli kam ti ma. O ni be o ma sani daba ayopɔin, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ o ti ma.
en: and the first-born of your cattle and sheep. Let the animals stay with their mothers for seven days, then on the eighth day give them to me, your God.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri pam, ka darigi bɛ tibili ni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga. N yi bɔhi ba biɛri, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will punish them severely and take full revenge on them. They will feel my anger. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ garig o, bee n nya yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o?.
en: So how can I find words to answer God?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kana ti mɛhim vinvama din be gbirimagbirima ni, ni tampima voya ni, ka mɛhim gɔhi tuturi mini mɔri ni.
en: They will swarm in the rugged valleys and in the caves in the rocks, and they will cover every thorn bush and every pasture.

dag: Ka binfalafala daa be binnɛma maa zuɣusaa ka nyaɣisira kaman bɛ ni booni shɛli kirisital la.
en: Above the heads of the creatures there was something that looked like a dome made of dazzling crystal.

dag: Ka n daa kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli din yuli booni Anfaani la ni n lɔrigi Yawɛ ni daa lo zuliya kam alikauli shɛl la.
en: Then I took the staff Delight, and I chopped it up in order to break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn be n san la puhiri ya.
en: Give our greetings to Gods people there—to each one who belongs to Christ Jesus. Those in Gods family who are with me send you their greetings.

dag: Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ti, o ni zaŋ ti tahi tiŋgban shɛli din vuhiri maa ni nti zaŋ li ti ti.
en: If we obey the Lord , he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.

dag: o daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini puri bee n-sɔŋ dunia tampuɣili.
en: before God made the earth and its fields or even the first handful of soil.

dag: Ka duu maa dunol ni kazala puuni ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili; ka di yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di mini jɛmbu duu maa maŋmaŋ yɛliŋ nyɛ yim.
en: A four-and-a-half-meter porch went all the way across the front of the temple.

dag: Toondaannim ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa a zuɣu ka Naawuni ti a pin shɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la, miri ka a zaŋ li niŋ a baɣaka.
en: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.

dag: Ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda ti niŋ o yiŋ dindali maa, ka bi saɣi ni o lan kul o ba yiŋa.
en: Saul kept David with him from that day on and did not let him go back home.

dag: Ka n ti wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will scatter the Egyptians throughout the world. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yaa biɛla gba lan ka n niŋgbuna ni m bariŋ maa zuɣu, ka di muɣisi ma n suhu ni, ka n kul ŋuhira.
en: I hurt so much I cannot feel anything. My pounding heart makes me scream!.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa bɔhi ba, O birigila yi gba?.
en: The Pharisees answered, So he has fooled you too!.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan wuhi ma binshɛli. Nyama, o daa wuhi ma la tiwal moma ni pali piɛ shɛli.
en: This is what the Lord GOD showed me: I saw a basket of summer fruit.

dag: ka a zaŋ binyɛra din be kasi yɛli Aduna ka booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni m-mal o, ka o leei maligumaana n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Dress Aaron in the holy clothes. Anoint him and make him holy so that he may serve me as priest.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋari ma ka sɔɣi zo, ka bi yɛli ma. N naan chɛbis a ni suhupiɛlli, ka ŋme goonjɛnim ka chaɣisi sayɛya ka yili yila niŋ a.
en: Why did you leave secretly, deceiving me, and not letting me know? I wouldve sent you off with a celebration, with songs and tambourines and harps.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya ka wɔɣi n-nab pali teeku mini dunia.
en: God blessed all the living things in the sea and told them to have many babies and fill the seas. And he blessed the birds on land and told them to have many more babies.

dag: A kul malila shɛhira pala jɛndiri ma, ka a suhuyiɣisili kul pahiri zaŋ chaŋ m polo; ka a kul zaŋdi tɔbbi pala liriti ma.
en: You continue to send your witnesses against me and increase your anger toward me, a swift army against me.

dag: Yisa ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o min o nyaandoliba daa yimi chaŋ ti du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli nti kpe tihi pu shɛli din daa do nimaani la ni.
en: After Jesus had said this prayer, he left with his disciples and went across Kidron Brook. There was a garden in that place, and Jesus and his disciples went in.

dag: Suhu ni nia lɔbu nyɛla daadamnim dini, amaa zilinli ni yɛn garigi shɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: We may make our plans, but God has the last word.

dag: Di niŋya niriba bina fabu naani; yi mi di zaŋya tahima yoli niŋ ŋmɛnditoli tuma ni. Hal yi daazichi yi zoori pahira, yin di niŋya li naani.
en: Don't put your trust in violence; don't hope to gain anything by robbery; even if your riches increase, don't depend on them.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa ba min o ma daa dɔɣ o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi chir muna ata ka bi zo dabiɛm ni bɛ zaɣisi naa zaligu, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka bia maa nyɛla bi viɛlli.
en: It was faith that made the parents of Moses hide him for three months after he was born. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's order.

dag: Yaa tiŋgbani, miri ka a pi n ʒim; di chɛ ka n kuhigu zani soli.
en: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, amaa bɛ ku wum a yɛligu. A ni boli ba, amaa bɛ ku garig a.
en: When you tell them all this, they wont listen to you. When you call to them, they wont respond.

dag: Nyama, n ni lihi a nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, lala ka Naawuni gba ni lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ, ka o ni tiligi ma nahiŋgu kam zaa ni.
en: And just as I considered your life valuable today, may the LORD consider my life valuable, and may he deliver me from all trouble.

dag: A ni daa nya ti shɛli maa daa wɔɣ pam ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka di zuɣusaa mali hal ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: The tree, so tall that it reached the sky, could be seen by everyone in the world.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dee lala, ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi yil yidan maa.
en: They took their money and started grumbling against the employer.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni palila ʒiŋmabo. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu. Naawuni ni ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ maligu bimbina maa, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila maa.
en: The people of Israel tried to trick God, but now they must accept their guilt. He will break down their altars and destroy their memorial stones.

dag: A daanab shɛb bɛn daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛri ni Babilɔn naa ku kana ti tuh a bee n-tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim la lee be ya?.
en: What happened to your prophets who told you that the king of Babylonia would not attack you or the country?.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari doli Naa Sool min o bidibisi nti ku Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: The Philistines closed in on Saul and his sons and killed three of them: Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni bi ku ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn ka bɛ ti leeg o min o bihi daba hal ka Pɛriʒia nam ti nya zaa zani.
en: He took all the survivors to Babylonia, where they served him and his descendants as slaves until the rise of the Persian Empire.

dag: Nir yi bɔri ni o mali binshɛli n-zaŋ ti pini, o bɔrila da shɛli din bi dura n-zaŋ ti tuumbaŋda ka o mal li zali ka di ku lu.
en: For the base he chooses special wood, a kind of wood that will not rot. Then he finds a good wood worker, and the worker makes a god that will not fall over.

dag: Ŋum mali Yawɛ yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka ti be ka puhiri ya maa.
en: May God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord ! From the Temple of the Lord we bless you.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chani ka Naawuni malaikanim chirig o sol ni;.
en: As Jacob went on his way, some angels met him.

dag: So tuma yi ti kpalim be o ni zaŋ shɛli me n-tam duu gbinni tanzaa maa zuɣu, o ni deei di laara.
en: If the building they put on the foundation still stands, they will get their reward.

dag: ka a zaŋ li ti ti a ba ka o di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: You can take it to him to eat, and he will give you his blessing before he dies.

dag: Ka o daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti gbaai dari maa ŋmabu.
en: and they set out together. When they arrived at the Jordan, they began to work.

dag: Musa daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ binshɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses gathered together the whole Israelite community and said to them: These are the things that the LORD has commanded you to do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ma la, chɛ ka bɛ noya ni yɛli yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa la lab ʒini bɛ zuɣu.
en: My enemies are planning trouble for me. Lord, make that trouble fall on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ti ku mali ninvuɣ so ŋun ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya yi tintariga bɔbili ni nyɛ shɛli Yawɛ niriba sunsuuni.
en: So then, when the time comes for the land to be given back to the Lord 's people, there will be no share for any of you.

dag: Ka maligumaana so ŋun ti zaŋ li mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa ni ti ŋub li. O ti ŋubim li luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: The priest who sacrifices the animal shall eat it in a holy place, the courtyard of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Tummiya tuma daba ayɔbu, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la dali, yin vuhimiya, ka chɛ ka yi niɣi mini yi bunsi ni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb yi yinsi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa vuhi dindali maa.
en: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.

dag: Ka yi mi din na taɣi di niŋbu zali. Dina n-nyɛ ni di chɛ ka Zaliguzaɣisira la ti yi zahira o saha dɛde.
en: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.

dag: Nyamiya o ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ titali shɛm! Hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛlikam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o.
en: See how great Melchizedek was! Abraham, the father of the people, gave him a tenth of everything he captured.

dag: ka tumo daa ti kana ti yɛli Ayuba, Ti di malila naɣilahi la kɔra, ka bunsi la ʒe m-baɣi ba ŋubiri mɔri.
en: A messenger came to Job and said: The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys were grazing nearby.

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim galisiya pam, bɛn yiɣisi lu n zuɣu galisiya pam!.
en: Lord , I have so many enemies. So many people have turned against me.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ba yɛlimaŋtali mini maŋgbibbu ni zaadali saria karibu yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbaai Gomna Filiksi ka o yɛli Pool, Na yim pɔi; n yi ti lan nya dahima, n ni bol a.
en: But as Paul went on discussing about goodness, self-control, and the coming Day of Judgment, Felix was afraid and said, You may leave now. I will call you again when I get the chance.

dag: Bahi n-kul gili ma; tuumbiɛtumdiba pam n-teei gili ma. Bɛ malila binyara kuhiri n nuhi mini n naba.
en: Dogs surround me; a pack of evil people circle me like a lion— oh, my poor hands and feet!.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Izraɛl zoya polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: He said, Son of man, turn toward the mountains of Israel and speak against them for me.

dag: Niriba pam bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima ni bɛn yɔhindi niriba beni, di bahi bamdi yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn na kul doli Yɛhudianim adiini soli kaya la.
en: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.

dag: N niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ, n niŋgbunzabili ŋɔ! Biɛrim mali ma, ka n lɛbiri ginda. Mbaye, n suhu ni, n suhu kul tɔrila pampam. N ku tooi shini, dama n wumla kikahi kumsi, di nyɛla tɔbuchiriga.
en: My sadness and worry is making my stomach hurt. I am bent over in pain. I am so afraid. My heart is pounding inside me. I cannot keep quiet, because I have heard the trumpet blow. The trumpet is calling the army to war.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: When Jesus and his followers approached Jerusalem, they came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives. Jesus gave two disciples a task.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman awa muna ata saha, ka Ananias paɣ daa kpɛna ka bi mi din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: About three hours later, his wife entered, but she didnt know what had happened to her husband.

dag: Naawuni kukoli daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, amaa ka pumpɔŋɔ o lo alikauli yɛli, N ku lan chɛ ka tiŋgbani kɔŋko dam, amaa n ni lan chɛ ka zuɣusaa gba dam.
en: His voice shook the earth then, but now he has made a promise: Still once more I will shake not only the earth but heaven also .

dag: Tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ŋmari li mi luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.

dag: Nyin ninsala, ka a ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria ka amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi li maa, a tɛhiya ni a ni nya soli din ni doli yi Naawuni sariakaribo ni?.
en: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni labisi yi daazichi tin ya ka zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka laɣim ya yihi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb zaa ni la na.
en: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn doli chaŋ ti tuhi ba? Ka Jɛhɔram garigi yɛl o, Ti yɛn dolila Ɛdom yɔɣu polo chaŋ.
en: What route shall we take for the attack? We will go the long way through the wilderness of Edom, Joram answered.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya m-bahi naai li! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di naabu zuɣu kaman yi suhuri ni daa ye di piligibu zuɣu shɛm la; zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli niŋ li.
en: On with it, then, and finish the job! Be as eager to finish it as you were to plan it, and do it with what you now have.

dag: Shaul bia n-daa nyɛ Shallum, o yaaŋa n-daa nyɛ Mibisam, ka o yaantibichee nyɛ Mishima.
en: Shaul's son was Shallum, his grandson was Mibsam, and his great-grandson was Mishma.

dag: Bɛ daa mali salima naɣibila n-zali Sinai Zoli gbini; ka daa jɛm salima binnani.
en: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue.

dag: ka o niŋ li pam niŋ ti ni la zuɣu. Naawuni yɛm min o ni nyari din be tooni zaa la zuɣu.
en: which he poured over us with wisdom and understanding.

dag: Zatu daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pihinahinaanu.
en: the descendants of Zattu:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Ayuba daa lan niŋ yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi pahi. Ka o nini daa nya o yaantibichahi mi yaansi.
en: Job lived a hundred and forty years after this, long enough to see his grandchildren and great-grandchildren.

dag: Ti daa wumya ka o yɛli ni o ni wurim bɛ ni daa zaŋ nuhi me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka me din pa nuhi mɛbu zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: We heard him say, I will tear down this Temple which men have made, and after three days I will build one that is not made by men.

dag: Ka anabinim maa daa kul kuhiri pampam, ka mali suhi mini kpana ŋ-ŋmari bɛmaŋa ka chɔhiri bɛmaŋa kaman bɛ taara ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ka ʒim ti puhiri yiri bɛ niŋgbuna ni na.
en: So the prophets prayed louder and cut themselves with knives and daggers, according to their ritual, until blood flowed.

dag: Chɛ ka di dabisili maa leei zibisim. Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ di lan teei di yɛla bee n-chɛ ka neesim neei di ni.
en: I wish that day had remained dark. I wish God above had forgotten that day and not let any light shine on it.

dag: Ti zaa ba pala ba yino? Pa Naawuni yino n-nam ti? Ka wula ka ti bi ʒe tab yim, ka saɣindi Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛli maa?.
en: Don't we all have the same father? Didn't the same God create us all? Then why do we break our promises to one another, and why do we despise the covenant that God made with our ancestors?.

dag: Dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim maa. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Miriya ka yi ŋubi binnɛɔŋ kam ʒim, dama binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili nyɛla o ʒim, ka ŋunkam ŋub li, bɛn yihim o o niriba ni.
en: Again: for every creatures life, its blood is its life. That is why I have told the Israelites: You must not consume any creatures blood because every creatures life is its blood. Anyone who consumes it will be cut off.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla dunia zaa daa kala Ijipti na Yisifu sani ni bɛ ti da kawana, dama kum maa daa miila dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: but the famine was bad everywhere. So people from the countries around Egypt had to come to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so yi kɔrigi nahu bee piɛɣu bee bua yi sansani ŋɔ ni bee kpaŋa.
en: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulinluhili polo na nti ʒe toli maa ti niŋ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi lan kpalim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So the Lord changed the wind. He made a very strong wind blow from the west, and it blew the locusts out of Egypt and into the Red Sea. Not one locust was left in Egypt!.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa nya pakoli maa ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu ka o yɛl o, Di kuhira.
en: When the Lord saw her, his heart was filled with pity for her, and he said to her, Don't cry.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba sani.
en: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve disciples. He went to the chief priests.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira jɛnd o kpee, dilan ŋmanila tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu bee takɔbi bee piɛm din dira.
en: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.

dag: Zaŋm ma mali kuli, chɛ ka ti niŋ yomyom. Naa zaŋ ma kpe o duu. Ti ni di dari ka mali suhupiɛlli a zuɣu; ti ni paɣ a yurilim maa gari wain; dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yur a maa.
en: Take me with you. Lets run away. The king took me into his room. We will rejoice and be happy for you. Remember, your love is better than wine. With good reason, the young women love you.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha ka Samsin ti labiri ni o ti niŋ paɣisarili maa amiliya, ka o daa ti ŋmaligi birigi ni o lihi nya o ni daa ku gbuɣin so sɔŋ la, ka nya ka shihi n-kpe m-pal o zaɣ woliŋ ni niŋ kpam.
en: Several days later, Samson came back to marry her. On his way, he went over to look at the dead lion. He found a swarm of bees in its body. They had made some honey.

dag: Dama yɛm ni ka a suhu ni na, ka baŋsim niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: You will become wise, and your knowledge will give you pleasure.

dag: Bɛ wahala maa puuni ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord , and he rescued you.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o diɛmpaɣa, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who has intercourse with his mother-in-law. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinu Sɔdom puuni, n ni chɛ bɛ taali maa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said, If I find fifty good people in the city of Sodom, I will save the whole city.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following law: The people of Israel must bring Moses a reddish-brown cow that has nothing wrong with it and that has never been used for plowing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Mara n-chaŋ Ɛlim. Kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin n-daa be Ɛlim maa, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani.
en: Next, they camped at Elim, where there were springs of water and palm trees.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti nabi n-yɛligi pali tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di saha bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka. Di yɛla ti ku lan be bɛ tɛha ni bee ka bɛ ti teei di yɛla. Bɛ ti ku lan zaŋ di yɛla muɣisi bɛmaŋa bee nti lan mali shɛli yaha.
en: And in those days, when your numbers have greatly increased in the land, declares the LORD, people will no longer talk about the LORDs covenant chest; they wont recall or remember it; they wont even miss it or try to build another one.

dag: N ni zaŋ a leei Izraɛl naa, ka chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri tiŋgbani shɛm tariga zaa.
en: Jeroboam, I will make you king of Israel, and you will rule over all the territory that you want.

dag: Suhu ni nia lɔbu nyɛla daadamnim dini, amaa zilinli ni yɛn garigi shɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.

dag: N ti yɛn baŋ, ka doo bɔbu kɔre zaŋ ma ti ʒili baɣili n nabia o chɛchɛbuŋ ni.
en: I hardly knew myself; she had set me in an officials chariot!.

dag: Tiligim ma takɔb kum ni, fam n nyɛvili baa nuu ni bahi.
en: Save me from the sword; save my life from these dogs.

dag: amaa di zuliya maa nim yi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu n sani, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, dindina n ni taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli n ni di yɛn niŋ ba maa polo.
en: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.

dag: ka Iddo ŋun daa nyɛ Zakaria bia la mi nyɛ Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn daa be Giliad la kpɛma, ka Jaasiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Abinɛr bia la nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni kpɛma.
en: for half the tribe of Manasseh in Gilead—Iddo, Zechariahs son; for Benjamin—Jaasiel, Abners son.

dag: Ka o bidibiga Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam n-zan o zaani, ka daa mali shili gu Izraɛlnima.
en: Asas son Jehoshaphat became the new king after him. Jehoshaphat made Judah strong so that they could fight against Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋ ni nyini ni bahi yoli; a ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe a yim yoli.
en: God, people who leave you will be lost. You will destroy all who are not faithful to you.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Arid mini Naaman, ka Arid daŋ niriba nyɛ Aridnima; ka Naaman daŋ niriba nyɛ Naamannima.
en: The family groups from Bela were Ard—the Ardite family group; Naaman—the Naamanite family group.

dag: Amaa yum maa yi ti lan taɣi m-paligi, di saha ŋun kam maligumaana sanna.
en: But if the raw flesh turns white again, the person will go back to the priest.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zo n-gili bimbini maa, ka pali bɔɣili la gba.
en: The water ran down off the altar and filled the ditch.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa garigi yɛli Balak kpamba maa, Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ ka di pooi bee n-niŋ ka di yaɣi.
en: Balaam answered, Even if Balak offered me a palace full of silver or gold, I wouldn't do anything to disobey the Lord my God.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Kul shini a noli. Zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli, ka dol ti ti leei ti ba ni ti maligumaana. A yi nyɛ ninvuɣ yino maligumaana ni a yi nyɛ Izraɛl daŋ yini maligumaana, dini n-lee so.
en: Shut up! they said to him. Put your hand over your mouth! Come with us and be a father and a priest for us. Would you rather be a priest for one mans household or a priest for a tribe and a clan in Israel.

dag: Zaŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ yi wumpaɣibo sara maligu na, ka moliya yi ni tiri pin shɛŋa pahiri la molo, dama yinim Izraɛlnim ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Offer a thanksgiving sacrifice of leavened bread, and publicize your gifts to the LORD; for so you love to do, people of Israel! says the LORD God.

dag: Di saha ka Neetan daa bɔhi Sulemaana ma Batishiiba, A bi wum ni Hagit bia Adɔnija leei naa, ka ti dan Dauda ʒi di yɛla?.
en: When Nathan heard what had happened, he asked Bathsheba, Solomon's mother: Have you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has made himself king? But David doesn't know a thing about it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ shihir shɛli Yisa ni daa wuhi pahi buyi, o ni daa yi Judia ka Galili na la.
en: That was the second miraculous sign that Jesus did after coming from Judea to Galilee.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Naɣila yi ni yɛn be Babilɔn yuun pisopɔin la saha ti gari, ka n naanyi ka yi sanna nti chɛ ka n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali, ka n zaŋ ya labisi kpe na.
en: After Babylonia has been the strongest nation for years, I will be kind and bring you back to Jerusalem, just as I have promised.

dag: Yi zɔnim mini yi dɔɣiriba ni yi mabihi hal zaŋ tabili yi banim mini yi manim ni ti chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya n-ku yi ni shɛb gba.
en: Even your parents, brothers, relatives, and friends will turn against you. They will have some of you killed.

dag: Dama zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Izraɛlnim la mini Izraɛl nanim ni Juda nanim saha la zaa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-lan puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: A Passover like this hadnt been celebrated since the days when the judges judged Israel; neither had it been celebrated during all the days of the Israelite and Judean kings.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni ŋun be tibi. Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: The Lord is good and merciful; our God is so kind.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka mali biɛri suŋ, di so jɛrigu ŋun ŋmari ʒiri.
en: It is better to be poor but honest than to be a lying fool.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti zaŋ ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri ni ti yiya m-pa talima din ni chɛ ka ti nya chi.
en: Others said, We have to mortgage our fields, our vineyards, and our houses in order to get grain during the famine.

dag: Ka Shɛla daa nyɛ Kainan bia, ka Kainan nyɛ Arifazad bia, ka Arifazad nyɛ Shɛm bia, ka Shɛm nyɛ Nuhu bia, ka Nuhu mi nyɛ Lamɛk bia.
en: Shelah was the son of Cainan. Cainan was the son of Arphaxad. Arphaxad was the son of Shem. Shem was the son of Noah. Noah was the son of Lamech.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Lɛvi bidibisi maa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yi mali yimaŋa m-be kasi ni yi tumdi Yawɛ tuma, yi zaa yinoyino bidibisi mini yi mabihi kubu ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya alibarika zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Moses said, Today youve been ordained to the LORD, each one of you at the cost of a son or a brother. Today youve gained a special blessing for yourselves.

dag: Ka Dauda zɔsimo Hushai daa labi tiŋ puuni ti saɣisi saha shɛli Absalom ni kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: So Davids friend Hushai went into Jerusalem, just as Absalom was entering the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa bahi, ka di yi n nuh ayi maa ni lu tiŋ ŋ-ŋma yi ninni.
en: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.

dag: ka guhiri ti tahima din mal alibarika dabisi shɛli dali ti Naawuni Natitamlana ŋun nyɛ tiligira Yisa Masia la jilima palo yibu saha.
en: At the same time we wait for the blessed hope and the glorious appearance of our great God and savior Jesus Christ.

dag: Tummiya din viɛla ka chɛ din bie, ka tiligi. Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm.
en: You say that God is with you, so you should do good things, not evil. Then you will live, and the Lord God All-Powerful will be with you.

dag: Ŋuna n-kuri nabihi, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zɔri dabiɛm.
en: He breaks the spirit of princes. He is terrifying to all the kings of the earth.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, hal n ni kul yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni kpi maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi zo n-yi bɛ daalahichi ni, ka tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi.
en: Or maybe I will tell some evil people that they will die. But they might change their lives, stop sinning, and begin to live right. They might become good and fair.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ kɔhigɔriba gba ni ti kum ka fabili paɣ maa zuɣu, so ni bi lan dari bɛ nɛma zuɣu.
en: And the merchants of the earth will cry and be sad for her. They will be sad because now there is no one to buy the things they sell—.

dag: n-yɛra, Di niŋya dunia bee teeku bee tihi shɛli hal ka ti ti zaŋ bintabinda tabili ti Naawuni jɛmdiba gbiɛri zuɣu naai pɔi.
en: He said, Dont damage the earth, the sea, or the trees until we have put a seal on the foreheads of those who serve our God.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋda. N Duuma, nyini ka n suhiri ni a zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: So, Lord , I turned and prayed to you. I asked you, Lord, to show me mercy.

dag: Ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa ka teeg o bɔɣu n-tum yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm, ka tum alahiziba tuma ka wuhi shihira n-yihi ti Ijipti maa.
en: By his great power and strength he rescued us from Egypt. He worked miracles and wonders, and caused terrifying things to happen.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yiɣisi kpɛri dunoli maa zuɣusaa duu puuni ka kumda. O ni daa chani ni o ti kpe maa o daa yɛrimi, Mbaye, m bia Absalom, m bia, m bia Absalom! Mani n-yi di kpi ka chɛ a ŋɔ, di di so. Mbaye, Absalom. M bia, m bia.
en: The king trembled. He went up to the room over the gate and cried. As he went, he said, Oh, my son Absalom! Oh, my son! My son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you! Oh, Absalom, my son! My son.

dag: Ka maligumaana mi kul ku kɔŋ Lɛvi zuliya ni ŋun ni zani n tooni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara maligunim maani maligunim sahakam.
en: And the levitical priests will always have someone in my presence to make entirely burned offerings and grain offerings, and to present sacrifices.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun daŋ Jɛbusinim ŋɔ kubu ni leei toondana, ka lan leei sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɔab ŋun nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa daŋ chaŋ, ka daa leei toondana.
en: David had told his troops, The first soldier to kill a Jebusite will become my army commander. And since Joab son of Zeruiah attacked first, he became commander.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kuhiri niŋdi ma? Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ cham tooni.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Why do you keep calling out to me for help? Tell the Israelites to move forward.

dag: Rɛhabia daŋ ni, ŋun Rɛhabia bidibisi ni, Ishia n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.

dag: Ahazia gba daa dolila Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba n-tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o daa nyɛla Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa deemba.
en: He walked in the ways of Ahabs dynasty, doing what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as Ahabs dynasty had done, because he had married into Ahabs family.

dag: Chɛ ka m be din ni chɛ ka m paɣir a, ka chɛ ka a zaligunim sɔŋ ma.
en: Let me live to praise you. Let me find the help I need in your laws.

dag: Ti ni daa wum lala maa ka ti mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani balim Pool ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: When we heard this, we and the other followers there begged Paul not to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi gba bi mi yi Duuma ni yɛn labina dahin shɛli.
en: So always be ready. You dont know the day your Lord will come.

dag: O daa lan bɔhi, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: Why do you notice the small piece of dust that is in your friends eye, but you dont see the big piece of wood that is in your own eye?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya, dama Masia daa di wahala yi zuɣu, ka o niŋsim maa nyɛ di ni simdi ni yi zaa dol shɛli.
en: This is what you were chosen to do. Christ gave you an example to follow. He suffered for you. So you should do the same as he did:.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni daanfaani; ka miriya ka yi chɛ ka putɔɣu kpe yi ni so ni n-zooi muɣisi ya ka ta yi ni shɛb daɣiri.
en: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.

dag: Ka n daa lan kab jaaŋgbe shɛli din pah ayi ka di yuli booni Naŋgban yini la, ka Juda mini Izraɛl naŋgbanyini biɛhigu la daa saɣim.
en: Then I broke the second stick, the one called Unity, and the unity of Judah and Israel was shattered.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naa Dauda piligu ni o bahigu tuma zaa sab bela anabi Samuɛl yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafi ni, ka lan sab be anabi Neetan mini anabi Gaad yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafinim ni.
en: Everything David did while he was king is included in the history written by the prophets Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nabia la leei Sulemaana dima n-yiɣisi lu o zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord raised up Hadad the Edomite to become Solomons enemy. Hadad was from the royal family of Edom.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o tin ya yiko o Shia Kasi zuɣu, ka o kpaŋsi yi suhuri o jilima azichitali puuni.
en: I ask God from the wealth of his glory to give you power through his Spirit to be strong in your inner selves.

dag: N ni daa siɣisi mmaŋa n-yihi Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya ka bi deei ya shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi nya duhibu la, n tumla taali maa?.
en: I did not charge you a thing when I preached the Good News of God to you; I humbled myself in order to make you important. Was that wrong of me?.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: Then Pharisees and legal experts came to Jesus from Jerusalem and said.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhi ba soli birigi ba, ka bɛ ni birigi ninvuɣ shɛb maa birim.
en: But this peoples leaders were misleading, and those being led were confused.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi tum a taal shɛli, amaa nyini n-lee tum ma taali a ni lo tɔbu na ni a ti tuhi ma maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ sariakarita ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti Izraɛlnim mini Ammɔnnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Israelites have not sinned against you. But you are doing a very bad thing against them. May the Lord , the true Judge, decide whether the Israelites or the Ammonites are right.

dag: Bɛ ka buchi, ka nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: Those idols are worthless. People made them, and they are nothing but a joke. Their time of judgment will come, and those idols will be destroyed.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ʒi ʒiya yi yinsi bee n-tum tuun shɛli Vuhim Dabisili dali, amaa gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili maa ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi kaman n ni daa zali yi yaannim shɛm la.
en: Dont bring a load out of your houses on the Sabbath day. Dont do any work on that day. You must make the Sabbath day a holy day. I gave this same command to your ancestors.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni tooi kpuɣ a zuɣu ka galimi kani, a ni yi barina ni, ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Then face the world again, firm and courageous.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ o niriba maa kaman piɛri la chaŋ, ka wuhi ba soli mɔɣu ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka sanzali zani tiŋgban ni mini di zoya zuɣu ni puri ni zaŋ tabili tihi puri ni ni olivi kpam tihi puri ni ni binshɛɣukam din yiri tiŋgban ni na; ka chɛ ka di miisim maa tabili ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ nuhi tuuni kam. .
en: I gave the command for the land and the mountains to be dry. The grain, the new wine, the olive oil, and everything the earth produces will be ruined. All the people and all the animals will become weak.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm bɛn daa be duu maa daa ti zahim zahima dahin shɛli yuŋ. Sokam zahindi daa bela di ko, ka mali di gbinni.
en: One night each of the two men had a dream, but their dreams had different meanings.

dag: Doo yi dɔni o do kpee kaman paɣ la, bɛ niriba ayi maa tum din chihira, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual relations with another man, they have done a disgusting thing, and both shall be put to death. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka malaika so ŋun daa pun yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa la kana ti zani, ka malaika so daa ka o sanna.
en: As I watched, the messenger speaking with me went ahead and another messenger came to meet him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni darigi Amalɛknim ŋɔ tibili bɛ ni daa niŋ Izraɛlnim shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila zuɣu.
en: He is going to punish the people of Amalek because their ancestors opposed the Israelites when they were coming from Egypt.

dag: ka Shammua daa nyɛ Biliga daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Jɛhɔnatan so mi daa nyɛ Shɛmaya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: The leader of Bilgahs family was Shammua. The leader of Shemaiahs family was Jehonathan.

dag: M biyurisi, ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi pumpɔŋɔ, ka di na bi kahigi wuhi ti ni ti yɛn be shɛm, amaa ti lee mi ni o yi ti yi palo, ti ni bemi kaman ŋuna, dama ti ni ti nya o kaman o ni kul be shɛm.
en: Dear friends, now we are children of God. We have not yet been shown what we will be in the future. But we know that when Christ comes again, we will be like him. We will see him just as he is.

dag: ni naɣilima ni vinvama din zaŋ hal ni Ar zaŋ lab Mɔabnim tintariga polo la.
en: and the ravines that extend to the settlement of Ar and lie along the border of Moab.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛli Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Nyama, a mini Abiata zaŋmiya yi bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ a bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan n-labi tiŋ maa puuni ni suhudoo.
en: And he went on to say to Zadok, Look, take your son Ahimaaz and Abiathar's son Jonathan and go back to the city in peace.

dag: Di pala o daa yurila nandaamba zuɣu ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ tayiɣ la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibila, ka zuri piiri liɣiri maa.
en: Judas did not really care about the poor. He asked this because he carried the moneybag and sometimes would steal from it.

dag: Zaŋmiya li na nti yɛli ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ. Yɛlimiya ti kurimbuni ha yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti zahim li nya din yɛn niŋ di puuni bee wuhimiya ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha.
en: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.

dag: Yi ni tooi pihi li hal ni daba ayɔbu dali, amaa daba ayopɔin dali din nyɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, di shɛli ku beni.
en: You will find it there for the first six days of the week, but not on the Sabbath.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka piɛguliba maa daa yi ni labiri kuna ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa wum ka nya shɛm maa zuɣu, dama di daa kul nyɛla kaman malaika la ni daa yɛli ba shɛm.
en: The shepherds returned home, glorifying and praising God for all they had heard and seen. Everything happened just as they had been told.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya daazichi ti ba, ka zo Izraɛlnim zaa nambɔɣu. Ka n ni ti zabi nyuli n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, But now I will be merciful to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel, and make them prosperous again. I will protect my holy name.

dag: Dindina yi ni shɛb ni bɔhi ma, Ka di yi nyɛ lala, di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni na kul nyari ninsalinim taali? Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu Naawuni yubu soli ka di ku niŋ.
en: Someone may ask, How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fiɛb ba pam ka zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu, ka yɛli dansarika gula ni o guli ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: After they had been badly beaten, they were put in jail, and the jailer was told to guard them carefully.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban daa gahim bula shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ni sabilimsabilim mini bunyama bɛn zaa liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn zaa mali piɛlimpiɛlim ni piɛbihi shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ zaɣ sabila n-zaŋ ba ti o bihi ni bɛ guli ba.
en: However, on that very day Laban took out the striped and spotted male goats and all of the speckled and spotted female goats—any with some white in it—and all of the black male lambs, and gave them to his sons.

dag: Piimi n wuhibu ŋɔ ka chɛ anzinfa. Piimi baŋsim ka chɛ salima din viɛla.
en: Choose my instruction instead of silver; choose knowledge rather than the finest gold.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla kaman awa yini laasabu yaha ka so lan yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa sani, dama o nyɛla Galili nira.
en: About an hour later, another man said, Its true. Im sure this man was with him, because he is from Galilee.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa doya hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o yiɣisi yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya, ka zɔr dabiɛm ni o yɛli Ɛli o ni nya ʒii shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Samuel stayed in bed until morning; then he got up and opened the doors of the house of the Lord . He was afraid to tell Eli about the vision.

dag: ni o chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali zani dɛde daadam mini Naawuni sani kaman nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee la.
en: I want someone to plead with God for me, as one pleads for a friend.

dag: Saimɔn ni daa nya ka tuumba maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu ka o daa bɔ liɣiri ni o ti ba.
en: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Ahaz did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha, Yi yi ti yihi zaɣ viɛla maa zaka di ni, yinim Lɛvinim yin zaŋmiya din kpalim kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: When you have presented the best part, you may keep the rest, just as the farmer keeps what is left after he makes his offering.

dag: Ka Mɔza nyɛ Binia ba; o bihi n-daa nyɛ Rafa mini Ɛliasa ni Azɛl.
en: Moza was the father of Binea; his son was Raphah, his son Eleasah, and his son Azel.

dag: Ka nimaaninim daa nya o m-baŋ o, ka tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋkpan shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim zaa tahi o sanna.
en: where the people recognized Jesus. So they sent for the sick people in all the surrounding country and brought them to Jesus.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin maa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the leaders, went up the mountain.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, yi ni zaɣisi so zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi dolibu, amaa ka dolila zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya niŋ sunsuuni la zaligunim la zuɣu. .
en: Then you will know that I am the Lord . It was my law that you broke. You did not obey my commands. You decided to live like the nations around you.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka niriba diri Naawuni daalikauli maa nyɔri, dindina ninsal yɛda niŋbu ka buchi, ka Naawuni daalikauli maa gba ka buchi.
en: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: Give me three days to think about it, Rehoboam replied, then come back for my answer. So the people left.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o paɣ tizɔdoo Hɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ o deemba Riuɛl Midian nir bia la, Ti yiɣisiri kunila luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl ti, N ni zaŋ li tin ya la ni. Dol ti, ka ti ti niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli; dama Yawɛ pun lo Izraɛlnim zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu alikauli.
en: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.

dag: Ka o daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma ata. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mikaya, o daa nyɛla Uriɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia nir la bipuɣiŋga. Ka tɔb daa ti lu Abija mini Jɛrɔbɔam sunsuuni.
en: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel from Gibeah. Some time later, Abijah and King Jeroboam of Israel went to war against each other.

dag: Ka o yi mali luɣ kasi shee maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni sara maligu bimbini maa ka di be kasi naai, ŋun zaŋm bu nɛɔŋ la na.
en: When Aaron has finished reconciling the inner holy area, the rest of the meeting tent, and the altar, he will bring forward the live goat.

dag: Biɛɣu daa yi neei, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka sagban daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-wuhiri ba soli, yuŋ mi daa yi ti zibi, o chɛrimi ka buɣim daantaliga be bɛ tooni n-ne ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ chani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: During the day the Lord went in front of them in a pillar of cloud to show them the way, and during the night he went in front of them in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel night and day.

dag: Bɛ karimbaani biɛhigu zuɣu, bɛ yɛrimi, Naawuni ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo; ka bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla, Naawuni kani.
en: The wicked do not care about the Lord ; in their pride they think that God doesn't matter.

dag: Ka mmaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ o ʒili tiŋgbani maa ni. Ka Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni ti nya nambɔzɔbo n sani, ka n ni ti yɛli Panniriba, Yi nyɛla n niriba; ka bɛ mi ni ti yɛli, Nyini n-nyɛ ti Naawuni. .
en: I will establish my people in the land and make them prosper. I will show love to those who were called Unloved, and to those who were called Not-My-People I will say, You are my people, and they will answer, You are our God.

dag: Yi daa lan nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbibi ya shɛm tiŋgban nɛl la ni kaman nira ni buɣiri bia shɛm la, ka yi chaŋ na hal ti paai kpe.
en: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.

dag: Miligim ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ, ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ! Ka bɛ daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Get away from this community, so that I may consume them in an instant. They fell on their faces.

dag: So beni n-nyɛ ŋun pun guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan kul kpalimmi be lala. Ka so mi beni n-nyɛla ŋun bi guni ka ti Duuma naanyi bol o? Dilan di bɔri ni o leei ŋun guni.
en: If you are already circumcised, don't try to change it. If you are not circumcised, don't get circumcised.

dag: Tɔb tuhibu vuri be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka saɣiŋgu pam be nimaani.
en: The noise of battle is heard in the land, and there is great destruction.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka dabiɛm mali ba? Bɛ tirila gbini. Bɛ ŋme bɛ tɔbutuhiriba luhi, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui yomyom. Bɛ bi kaɣiri lihiri bɛ nyaaŋa, dabiɛm n-kul be luɣilikam! Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But what do I see? asks the Lord . They are turning back in terror. Their soldiers are beaten back; overcome with fear, they run as fast as they can and do not look back.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia A ni zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli maa viɛla. O daa tɛhimi ni suhudoo ni alaafee ni be o ʒiɛman ni.
en: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, The LORDs word that you delivered is good, since he thought, That means there will be peace and security in my lifetime.

dag: A ko pin titali zali amaŋa, ka me binshɛŋa din dundu zal amaŋa niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam.
en: by the side of every road you built places to worship idols and practice prostitution.

dag: Do so daa be Uzi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o yuli booni Ayuba. Doo maa daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: There was a man named Job, living in the land of Uz, who worshiped God and was faithful to him. He was a good man, careful not to do anything evil.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ naa ni daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ shɛlikam polo bee zaŋ chaŋ nɛma duri polo la.
en: and the storage rooms. The priests and Levites followed these instructions exactly.

dag: Daadam, chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm baŋ di ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Human one, show Jerusalem her detestable practices.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zaŋmi kpani din be a nuu ni ŋɔ tiri Ai; n ni zaŋ li niŋ a nuu ni. Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ kpani din be o nuu ni maa tiri.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Hold your spear toward the city of Ai, because I will give you that city. So Joshua held his spear toward the city of Ai.

dag: Bɛ daa laɣimla Jɛrusalɛm Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu gol so ŋun pahir ata la ni.
en: They gathered in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asas rule.

dag: dama ŋun puh o gba leela ŋun pah o zuɣu tum o tuumbiɛri maa.
en: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ kum kuyila bahi ti zuɣu yomyom, ka nintam yi ti nina ni na, ka nintam ti tɛli ti niŋkari zaa.
en: The people say, Let those women come quickly and cry for us. Then our eyes will fill with tears that flow over our eyelids like streams of water.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka n naba be kaman saŋkpaliŋ naba la, ka chɛ ka n du n-tam luɣ shɛŋa din du.
en: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.

dag: Pita mini Jɔn ni daa na kul wuhiri niriba maa saha shɛli maa ka maligumaaniba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛma ni Sadusiinim dii vana ti zani bɛ tooni.
en: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.

dag: Ka daa kari ba yihi.
en: Then he sent them out of the court.

dag: Shihir shɛli yi ni ti yɛn nya ka baŋ nyɛla, yi ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋ chinchini pili biliɛɣu maa sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.

dag: ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa ti ni tɛhiri ni di buchi bi yaɣ lala la nyɛla ti ni lihiri shɛŋa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din bi viɛl la, dina ka ti lee niŋdi din tu kamaata shɛli.
en: and those parts that we think aren't worth very much are the ones which we treat with greater care; while the parts of the body which don't look very nice are treated with special modesty.

dag: ka ania niŋbu tahiri biɛrisuntali na, ka biɛrisuntali tahiri tahima na.
en: And endurance builds character, which gives us a hope.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Bɛ pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha? Yi bi mi dunia ni daa nam shɛm?.
en: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?.

dag: ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ yaɣ din la mi polo dapaɣa, ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ di nyaaŋa wulinluhili polo dapaɣa.
en: five for the frames on the other side, and five for the frames on the west end, at the back.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa deei bɛ bindira maa shɛli di, ka bi suhi Yawɛ n-niŋ o saawara di zuɣu.
en: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Bɛria daa nyaŋ niriba gari bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika la, dama bɛ daa taɣi deei yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka vihiri Naawuni litaafinim ni biɛɣukam ni bɛ nya yɛla maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The people there were more open-minded than the people in Thessalonica. They listened to the message with great eagerness, and every day they studied the Scriptures to see if what Paul said was really true.

dag: Dɛdan mini Tɛma ni Buz ni bɛn zaa pindi bɛ zuɣuri bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri puuni;.
en: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all those who cut the hair of their foreheads.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul yɛri lala maa, ka sagbani dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam bɛ ni kpe sagbani maa ni maa zuɣu.
en: While he was still speaking, a cloud appeared and covered them with its shadow; and the disciples were afraid as the cloud came over them.

dag: N niriba, wummiya n wuhibu; wummiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Listen, my people, to my teaching; tilt your ears toward the words of my mouth.

dag: dama Naawuni yi daa bi tiligi puu ni olivi tia maa wula la, dindina o ku tilig a gba.
en: God did not spare the Jews, who are like natural branches; do you think he will spare you?.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti piɛbi zaɣ yini kɔŋko, di saha zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba la bɛn laɣimm a sanna.
en: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mmaŋmaŋ ni kari saria wuhi din be piɛ titali mini piɛ kɔɣu sunsuuni.
en: So the Lord GOD says to them: I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the thin sheep!.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n wumpaɣibo pini ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunim la.
en: Lord , accept the praise I want to give you, and teach me your laws.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Nyama, luɣ shɛli be n sani kpe ka a ni tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o mini Yɛhudianim ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn daa jɛmdi Naawuni tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla bɛ jɛmbu duu; ka o daa yi lan yiri daa ni nti tɔɣisiri ŋunkam yɛn gar o sani Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: In the synagogue he talked with the Jews and with the Greeks who were worshipers of the true God. He also went to the public square every day and talked with everyone who came by.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani ŋun laɣim Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be yɔɣu la na ni laɣim zuliya shɛb na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord GOD said these things. The Israelites were forced to leave their country, but the Lord will gather them together again. He says, I will bring them back together again.

dag: Kpahimmiya noonsi bɛn yiɣiri ŋɔ: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna; amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-dihiri ba. Ka yi bi mali bukaata pam gari ba?.
en: Look at the birds. They dont plant, harvest, or save food in barns, but your heavenly Father feeds them. Dont you know you are worth much more than they are?.

dag: Yawɛ n-su ti naba chandi ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ baŋ timaŋmaŋ soya?.
en: The Lord guides our steps, and we never know where he will lead us.

dag: O chanila kum shee, o ni doli so shɛli kunila kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead to the grave.

dag: Bɛ daa yi chana, di gba chanimi. Bɛ daa yi ti zani, di gba zaanimi. Bɛ daa yi wuɣi du zuɣusaa, kalima maa gba wuɣirimi du zuɣusaa doli ba, dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela kalima maa ni.
en: When they moved, the wheels moved; when they stood still, the wheels stood still; and when they rose above the earth, the wheels rose up along with them, because the spirit of the creatures was in the wheels.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ, ka yi na kul zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka kul kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma.
en: If after all of this you still continue to defy me and refuse to obey me.

dag: Dama Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili wain din mali kpiɔŋ pam pipia m-be o nuu ni kpeera, ka o booi li ni o ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri zaa ka bɛ nyu li hal ti naai di zaa kahikahi.
en: Indeed, theres a cup in the LORDs hand full of foaming wine, mixed with spice. He will pour it out, and all of the earths wicked people must drink it; they must drink every last drop!.

dag: Amaa Naawuni chɛ ka o Shia Kasi kahigi li wuhi tinima; dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri binshɛɣukam hal zaŋ tabili Naawuni yɛla din gbinni zilima.
en: God has revealed these things to us through the Spirit. The Spirit searches everything, including the depths of God.

dag: Ka Nɛri daa nyɛ Mɛlikai so bia, ka Mɛlikai maa nyɛ Addi bia, ka Addi nyɛ Kosam bia, ka Kosam nyɛ Ɛlimadam bia, ka Ɛlimadam nyɛ Ɛr bia.
en: Melchi, Addi, Cosam, Elmadam, Er.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim maligu bimbina din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la mini bɛ ni daa tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa n-va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: The people took away the altars in Jerusalem that were for false gods and all the incense altars that were for false gods. They threw them into the Kidron Valley.

dag: Ka binnɛɔŋ balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, noonsi mini yiŋ biŋkɔbiri ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛn be dunia ni zaŋ tabili ninsalinim zaa.
en: Every living thing on earth died—every man and woman, every bird, and every kind of animal. All the many kinds of animals and all the things that crawl on the ground died. Every living, breathing thing on dry land died.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini kpamba maa daa zali Lɛvinim maa ni bɛ zaŋm Dauda mini anabi Asaf yɛtɔɣa la yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa yili wumpaɣibo yila maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: The king and the leaders of the nation told the Levites to sing to the Lord the songs of praise that were written by David and by Asaph the prophet. So everyone sang with great joy as they knelt and worshiped God.

dag: Ka yi ni bɛn ti kpalim ni ti bahi yoli yi dimnim tiŋgbɔna ni bɛ mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛ yaannim maa.
en: Any of you who do survive will rot in enemy territory on account of their guilty deeds. And they will rot too on account of their ancestors guilty deeds.

dag: Ti mali tahima maŋli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama ti mi ni ti mini ya ni laɣim di wahala shɛm, lala ka ti mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nya suhumaabo.
en: So our hope in you is never shaken; we know that just as you share in our sufferings, you also share in the help we receive.

dag: Saha shɛli Musa ni daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la, ka o daa wum kukol shɛli Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu la zuɣusaa chɛrubinim ayi la sunsuuni ka di tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Moses entered the meeting tent to speak with the LORD, he would hear the voice speaking to him from above the cover that was on the chest containing the covenant, from between the two winged creatures. In this way he spoke to Moses.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɛsi daa ti yɛl o bia Dauda, Zaŋmi kawaan chimda kpalaŋ ŋɔ mini bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia ŋɔ chaŋ sansan maa ni yomyom ti ti a biɛyanima.
en: One day Jesse said to his son David, Take this basket of cooked grain and these ten loaves of bread to your brothers in the camp.
