dag: Dama so yi nyɛla ŋun wumdila yɛligu maa kɔŋko, ka pa ŋun tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm, o ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi diɣi ni n-nya o ninni m-baŋ omaŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If you listen to the word, but do not put it into practice you are like people who look in a mirror and see themselves as they are.

dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bini paligi li la ni di ni lu. Sa titali ni mi, ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe.
en: Tell the prophets that their wall is going to fall down. I will send a pouring rain. Hailstones will fall on it, and a strong wind will blow against it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o zaligunima, ka jɛmd o ni bɛ suhuri zaa mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those who follow his commands, who obey him with all their heart.

dag: Malimi soli ti takɔbi maa ka di ka Raba din nyɛ Ammɔnnim tiŋ la ni na bee n-ka Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli la ni na.
en: Clearly mark where the two roads lead. One goes to Rabbah, the capital of Ammon, and the other goes to Jerusalem, the fortified capital of Judah.

dag: Izraɛlnim ŋmanila gbuɣima ni kari doli piɛ shɛba n-wurim ba bahi. Tuuli, Asiria naa n-daa liri ba, ka pumpɔŋɔ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mi bahi naai ba.
en: The Lord says, The people of Israel are like sheep, chased and scattered by lions. First, they were attacked by the emperor of Assyria, and then King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia gnawed on their bones.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia la daa mali suhukpeeni pam Kabiziil niriba ni. O daa tum tuun kara pam. Ŋuna n-daa ku Mɔabnim tɔbutuhiri biinsi ayi la, ŋuna n-daa lan siɣi bɔɣili ni ti ku gbuɣinli dahin shɛli sakuɣa ni daa lu la.
en: Benaiah, Jehoiadas son from Kabzeel, was a hero who performed great deeds. He killed two of Moabs leaders, and on a snowy day went down into a pit where he killed a lion.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ yi ni mali naɣibil so ka di nyɛ alahichi bini maa nyo buɣim wurim li, ka baɣisi li zaa hal ka di ti be kaman zim la, ka n daa zaŋ di zim maa bahi kulibɔn shɛli din kom zɔri yiri zoli zuɣu sirigirina la ni.
en: And as for that sinful thing you made, that calf, I took it and I burned it with fire. Then I smashed it, grinding it thoroughly until it was as fine as dust. Then I dumped the dust into the stream that ran down the mountain.

dag: dindina n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan zɔr o dabiɛm, dama m mi ni m pala bɛ ni tɛhi ni n nyɛ so maa.
en: Then I could say what I want without being afraid of him. But I cannot do that now.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi Lɛvi bihi yuya n-doli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa sabi li dolila bɛ yaannim dunoya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni bɛ ninvuɣ yinoyino bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, ka ni tooi tum tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: These were Levis descendants. They were listed by their families. They were the leaders of families. Each persons name was listed. The people who were listed were years old or older. They served in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The Israelites obeyed everything the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron to tell them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ Ijiptinim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa tibidarigibo.
en: This would be the sin of Egypt and the sin of all the nations who dont go up to celebrate the Festival of Booths.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa nya malaika so ka o be alizanda sunsuuni yiɣiri ginda, ka mali lahibal suŋ din ka bahigu ni o yɛli niriba balibu kam mini dɔɣim kam ni zuliya balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima bɛn be dunia ni.
en: Then I saw another angel flying high in the air. The angel had the eternal Good News to announce to the people living on earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and race of people.

dag: Pool ni daa lab du duu maa ni nti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro ŋubi naai, o daa lan gbaai ba la yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu n-daa mali lala hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o naanyi chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ.
en: Then Paul went back upstairs and ate. He talked for a long time—right up until daybreak—then he left.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti nahiŋgu mini ti wahala dibu puuni, ti nya suhukpaŋsibo yi zuɣu. Yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri ti.
en: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la.
en: Gad was Davids seer. The Lord said to Gad, Go and tell David: This is what the Lord says: I am going to give you three choices. You must choose one of them. Then I will punish you the way you choose.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba; ka yɔbahi ŋub ba.
en: They will be killed with swords. Wild dogs will eat their dead bodies.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, N ni va m biɛli val shɛli din kpɛm pam la zuɣu ka n di nasara ŋɔ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Naftali.
en: Rachel said, I have fought a hard fight with my sister, but I have won; so she named him Naphtali.

dag: Puhimiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ duumanim zaa Duuma ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the mightiest of all lords; his love is eternal.

dag: Di nyɛla din ni tooi sɔŋ nira kaman liɣiri ni sɔŋdi nir shɛm. Baŋsim daanfaani nyɛla yɛm tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li nyɛvili.
en: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli, N dana, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili. Ka lan yɛli, N dana, mani n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun daa ʒe a tooni kpe n-suhiri Yawɛ la.
en: Hannah said to him, Excuse me, sir. Do you remember me? I am the woman you saw standing here, praying to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi me duu ti o, dama alizanda mini di galisim zaa ku saɣ o? Ka m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni nti mɛri duu tir o? N kul yɛn mɛla luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim o tooni.
en: Yet no one can really build a temple for God, because even all the vastness of heaven cannot contain him. How then can I build a temple that would be anything more than a place to burn incense to God?.

dag: Di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, dama muɣisigu be yoma, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ma.
en: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.

dag: Di bi kpa talahi ni n sabi n-wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yuri yi mabihi shɛm, dama Naawuni pun wuhi ya yimaŋmaŋ ni yɛn yuri tab shɛm.
en: There is no need to write you about love for each other. You yourselves have been taught by God how you should love one another.

dag: N nyar alibarika a zaligunim maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka mali Nazari nir maa daalahichi sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ suma n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali nyɛ bɛn ni ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Righteous people—people of integrity—will live in this land of ours.

dag: A du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ gbiŋgbaŋ jaaŋgbe kabili din ni tooi kuhi nir ŋun zaŋ omaŋ dalim li nuu ŋɔ. Lala n-nyɛ Firawuna zaŋ chaŋ ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ dalim o polo.
en: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.

dag: ka soli be di tooni. Duri maa daa bemi kaman nuzaa polo duri la. Di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa daa kul nyɛla yim. Ka niriba ni yɛn doli luɣ shɛŋa yira mini di mɛbu ni di dunoya zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: path in front of them. They were like the rooms on the north side. They had the same length and width and the same kind of doors.

dag: Bɛ yihi suhupiɛlli mini nyaɣisim Mɔab tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niŋdi bindira pam la ni. N chɛ ka wain tɔɣibu ŋmaai wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ni. So bi lan tɔɣiri wain ka yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni yɔri vu shɛli maa pala suhupiɛlli vuri.
en: Joy and happiness are gone from the large vineyards of Moab. I stopped the flow of wine from the winepresses. There is no singing and dancing from people walking on the grapes to make wine. There are no shouts of joy.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa pirig o dansarika binyɛra sɔŋ; ka daa kul diri nayili bindirigu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: So Jehoiachin was permitted to change from his prison clothes and to dine at the king's table for the rest of his life.

dag: Yi mi lan kala Yisa ŋun nyɛ sandaantimdi so ŋun zali alikauli palli min o ʒi shɛli din mihibu wuhiri ti yɛl shɛŋa din sɔ Ɛbɛl maŋmaŋ ʒim la sanna.
en: You have come to Jesus, who arranged the new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that promises much better things than does the blood of Abel.

dag: Ka a ti baɣisi di shɛli ka di niŋ zim balli, ka a zaŋ di shɛli ti zali Alikauli Adaka shɛli din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir a la gbini. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla din be kasi zaa a sani.
en: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.

dag: Di saha ka Maika daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni chɛ ka n tɔŋ, n ni zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nira leei m maligumaana ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: And Micah said to himself, Now I know that the LORD will give me good things, because a Levite has become my priest.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha din daa nyɛ Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia mi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha la, ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa kana ti teei gili Samarianima.
en: King Shalmaneser of Assyria went to fight against Samaria. His army surrounded the city. This happened during the fourth year that Hezekiah was king of Judah.

dag: M mi ni bin sun shɛli ka n ni. N ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa. Hal n ni yu zaɣ suŋ tumbu n suhu ni maa zaa yoli, n kul bi tooi tumdi li.
en: I know that good does not live in me—that is, in my human nature. For even though the desire to do good is in me, I am not able to do it.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, N ni pun sab shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: But Pilate told them, What is written will not be changed.

dag: Tiligim ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba nuu ni, ka fa ma ninvuɣ kuriba nuu ni bahi.
en: Save me from those who do wrong. Save me from those murderers.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa gɔb chinchin piɛlli kɔŋko doli Yisa, ka bɛ daa yɛn gbaag o gba.
en: One of them was a young man who was wearing only a linen cloth. And when the men grabbed him.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-pa chɛrubinima ayi maa luɣilikam zaa zuɣu.
en: He covered the winged creatures with gold.

dag: dama ti wum ka o yɛli ni Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ni wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka taɣi ka shɛŋa Anabi Musa ni daa zali ni ti dol la.
en: In fact, we heard him say that this man Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and alter the customary practices Moses gave us.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa pii Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili vinvamli polo maa n-daa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo. Bɛ ni daa woligi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Lot chose for himself the entire Jordan Valley. Lot set out toward the east, and they separated from each other.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o zalikpana la min o fukumsi zaligunim la kaman yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Now may you be committed to the LORD our God with all your heart by following his laws and observing his commands, just as you are doing right now.

dag: Chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, ka fabilimiya, ka kuhimiya. Chɛliya ka yi lari leei kumsi, ka chɛ ka yi suhupiɛlli leei suhugarigu.
en: Cry out in sorrow, mourn, and weep! Let your laughter become mourning and your joy become sadness.

dag: Ɛlikana daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli daa boonila Hanna, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Pɛnina. Pɛnina n-daa nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi bihi, amaa ka Hanna ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia.
en: Elkanah had two wives. One wife was named Hannah and the other wife was named Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah did not.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila anzinfa viɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun tɛha buchi bi yaɣi lala.
en: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔzuɣu ka a fiɛbi buŋ maa buta ŋɔ zaa? N kamina ni n ti gu a soli, dama m bi yu a ni chani chandi shɛli maa.
en: The angel demanded, Why have you beaten your donkey three times like this? I have come to bar your way, because you should not be making this journey.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa zaŋ Absalom so leei ti naa maa kpi tɔb ni. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ naa maa zaŋbuna polo.
en: We anointed Absalom as our king, but he has been killed in battle. So why doesn't somebody try to bring King David back.

dag: O daa saɣim bɛ wain tihi mini bɛ fiig tihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa kab lu.
en: he destroyed their grapevines and fig trees and broke down all the trees.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa niŋ pua, ka tim na ti yɛli Dauda ni o malila pua.
en: Afterward she discovered that she was pregnant and sent a message to David to tell him.

dag: Amaa yi ni naɣ niŋdi zaɣ viɛl shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Yi je Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba tuma kaman man gba ni je li shɛm.
en: But there is something you do that is right—you hate the things that the Nicolaitans do. I also hate what they do.

dag: Ka Harim bia Malikija mini Pahatimɔab bia Hashub daa mali me yaɣ shɛli mini Bɔrɔbɔro Shɛbu Duri Shee Pia la.
en: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.

dag: Ŋuna n-duhiri tarimba, ka tiri bɛn be nandahima ni nasara.
en: He raises up the humble and makes sad people happy.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a ni daa pun yɛli ni a ni niŋ ti mini ti kpamba shɛm. A darigi Jɛrusalɛm tibili pam gari tiŋ kam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God confirmed the words he spoke against us and against our rulers, bringing great trouble on us. What happened in Jerusalem hasnt happened anywhere else in the entire world!.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a niŋ yuun pinaanu pahi. N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will add fifteen years to your life. I will rescue you and this city from the power of the Assyian king. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuun kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise him who alone does wonderful miracles! His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: and said, Moses, get your walking stick. Then you and Aaron call the people together and command that rock to give you water. That's how you will provide water for the people of Israel and their livestock.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir maa daa wum Izraɛl naa ni darigi toog o binyɛrigu shɛm maa yɛla, ka tim ti bɔhi naa maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a darigi toog a binyɛrigu? Chɛ ka doo maa ka n sanna nti baŋ ni anabi be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: As soon as Elisha the prophet heard what had happened, he sent the Israelite king this message: Why are you so afraid? Send the man to me, so that he will know there is a prophet in Israel.

dag: Dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, molimiy o tiliginsim molo dabisili kam.
en: Let the whole world sing to the Lord ! Tell the good news every day about how he saves us.

dag: Ka bɛ nina maa dii neei. Ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Their eyes were opened. Then Jesus sternly warned them, Make sure nobody knows about this.

dag: Bɛ kul tumdila vi tuma, ka di kuri ma suli. Bɛ maanila maligu buɣa ni, ka tuɣindi tulaale buɣa maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: They keep doing things, right in front of me, that make me angry. They offer sacrifices and burn incense in their special gardens.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti nya do so ŋun yuli booni Ɛnias, ka o gbaya kpi ka o do tiŋa yuma anii zaa.
en: There he found a man named Aeneas who was paralyzed and had been confined to his bed for eight years.

dag: O ʒiinila o yiŋ dunɔdali gbini bee tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee.
en: She sits on her chair at the door of her house, up on the highest hill of the city.

dag: Nyama, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n zaŋ a leei zuliya pam mini nanim zuɣulana, ni a vuɣi, ka daai luhi, ni a wurim ka ŋme m-paai, ni a me ka sa.
en: Today I give you authority over nations and kingdoms to uproot and to pull down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nuu din mali jilima n-gbaai Musa nudirigu chana, ka daa chɛ ka kom din do bɛ tooni pirigi ni o zali yuli din ku kpi ti omaŋa.
en: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.

dag: Ka sagban daantaliga din daa be niriba maa tooni wuntaŋ ni la mini buɣim daantaliga din daa be bɛ tooni yuŋ la daa na ʒi n-zo bɛ sani.
en: The cloud was always with them during the day, and the column of fire was always with them at night.

dag: nti yɛl o paɣ Zɛrɛshi min o zɔnim la zaa dinkam niŋ o. Di saha ka o yɛndaannim la min o paɣ Zɛrɛshi yɛl o, A mini Mɔdɛkai so ŋun kpa tab ŋɔ ni nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu, o pilig a la luhibu maa. A kul ku tooi nyaŋ o, amaa ŋuna n-naɣ ni nyaŋ a.
en: Then Haman told his wife Zeresh and all his friends everything that had happened to him. His wife and the men who gave him advice said, If Mordecai is a Jew, you cannot win. You have already started to fall. Surely you will be ruined.

dag: Ka o daa mal ti paai yiŋa m-bo sua pa o mam maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋmah o niŋkpil pinaayi n-zaŋ o niŋkpil yini kam tim ti ti Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nim zaa.
en: When he arrived at his house, he took a knife and cut her body into parts. Then he sent the parts of the woman to each of the areas where the Israelites lived.

dag: Di pa shɛli o turi ŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka Yawɛ lihi n wahala ŋɔ ka niŋ ma din viɛli zuŋɔ.
en: Maybe the Lord will see the wrong things that are happening to me and give me something good for every bad thing that Shimei says today.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tum tuma yuma ayopɔin Reechɛl zuɣu, amaa ka di daa ŋmanila dabisa biɛla o sani, o ni daa yuri Reechɛl maa zuɣu.
en: Jacob worked seven years so that he could have Rachel, and the time seemed like only a few days to him, because he loved her.

dag: Dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo? Naawuni yi ʒe ti nyaaŋa, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo ti?.
en: So what should we say about this? If God is for us, no one can stand against us. And God is with us.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a mali yɛm gari Daniɛl, ka ashili shɛli kani ka a bi mi li.
en: You think you are wiser than Daniel and no secret is hidden from you.

dag: Dama ti bi mali baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zaa, ti mi bi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zaa;.
en: These will all end because this knowledge and these prophecies we have are not complete.

dag: Obadia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ daa tim o tumo zuliya shɛb sani, ka ti wum o yɛligu maa. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Malimiya shili ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnima.
en: The vision of Obadiah. The LORD God proclaims concerning Edom: We have heard a message from the LORD— a messenger has been sent among the nations: Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai naa bia Abija.
en: About the same time, Abijah son of Jeroboam got sick.

dag: Yinim Filipainim mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni lahibal suŋ molo molibu piligu ni saha, n ni daa yiɣisi Masidɔnia la, yi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ cheechi shɛli niriba bɛn pahi n zuɣu baŋ deebu mini tibu yɛla.
en: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa baŋ ni bɛ kɔŋ nasara. Izraɛlnim maa ni daa niŋ bɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn sɔɣ do n-gu Gibia la naani zuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa sani zo.
en: So the people of Benjamin saw that they were defeated. The army of Israel had moved back because they were depending on the surprise attack. They had men hiding near Gibeah.

dag: Bipuɣiŋga, gbilisim a tibili wum; tamm a niriba min a ba yiŋ yɛla.
en: My lady, listen to me. Listen carefully and understand me. Forget your people and your fathers family.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ka tumdi din doli zaligu soli mini din tuhi, bɛ ni be di zuɣu.
en: And when the wicked turn from their wickedness to do what is just and right, it is for that reason they will live.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu, o ku chɛn ya bahi bee n-kun ya; o mi ku tam o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: because the LORD your God is a compassionate God. He wont let you go, he wont destroy you, and he wont forget the covenant that he swore to your ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa lu soli chani Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka o gba dii gbaai anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu m-mali lala hal ti paai Naiɔt Rama tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: So Saul went to the camps at Ramah, and Gods spirit came over him too. So as he traveled, he was in a prophetic frenzy until he reached the camps at Ramah.

dag: Ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi tarimba shɛba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zo n-labi Babilɔn naa polo la ni nuhi tuumbaŋdiba bɛn daa kpalim la n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: Nebuzaradan commander of the guard deported some of the poorest people, the rest of the people left in the city, a few skilled workers, and those who had joined the king of Babylon.

dag: Chɛ ka a binyɛra kul piɛli sahakam, ka niŋmi kpam ʒiɛm a zuɣu.
en: Dress up, comb your hair, and look your best.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Praise the Lord ! Give thanks to the Lord because he is good! His faithful love will last forever!.

dag: Ka bɛ laɣim bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa sɔŋ kaman zunzuya ni laɣindi binyara shɛm la, ka yiɣiri luri di zuɣu kaman toli ni yiɣiri luri binyara zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Their belongings are pounced upon and taken as loot.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka di gari ya; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa Nazarɛt do so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la. O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni; nyamiya bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: But he said to them, Dont be alarmed! You are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He has been raised. He isnt here. Look, heres the place where they laid him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya niriba la.
en: The other families of the Levite clan of Kohath were assigned some cities from the territory of Ephraim.

dag: N yi chɛ a ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa maa taali, di ni chɛ ka a teei di yɛla ka di gar a, ka a ku lan yaag a noli a vi maa zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will forgive all the wrongs you have done, but you will remember them and be too ashamed to open your mouth. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ yi be tiŋ maa ni, bɛ ni tooi tiligila bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya kɔŋko bɛ wuntitali zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were living in that nation, their faithfulness would not save anyone but themselves.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi tɛr ni bahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Sujee mini suhuyiɣisili ni biɛr biɛɣu. Ka di chɛliya ka turi mini yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na.
en: But now set aside these things, such as anger, rage, malice, slander, and obscene language.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli salo pah o nyaandoliba zuɣu na nti yɛli ba, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: After calling the crowd together with his disciples, Jesus said to them, All who want to come after me must say no to themselves, take up their cross, and follow me.

dag: Ŋunkam deei saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun doli so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee, amaa ŋun zaɣisi zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla ŋun kpe yɔɣu.
en: Those who accept correction show others how to live. Those who reject correction lead others the wrong way.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, o di chɛ ka n nini nya o. Dinzuɣu ka Absalom daa be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, ka bi chani naa sani.
en: The king said, He must go straight to his own house. He must not see my face. So Absalom went straight to his own house and did not see the king.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili n-wumm o yɛligu ka di zaɣisiy o noli, dama yi yi birigi, o ku chɛ yi taali, dama n yuli be o ni.
en: Pay attention to him and obey him. Do not rebel against him, for I have sent him, and he will not pardon such rebellion.

dag: M bɔri ni dɔbba bɛn be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kpuɣiri bɛ nuhi din be kasi zuɣusaa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka sujee bee naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ka di puuni.
en: In every church service I want the men to pray, men who are dedicated to God and can lift up their hands in prayer without anger or argument.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla anabi mini maligumaana bee niriba bɛn yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna la, n ni darigi bɛ mini bɛ yinsinim tibili.
en: If any of you say, Here is news from the Lord , I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.

dag: Ka naa daa kpuɣ o salima jaaŋgbee la tir o.
en: King Xerxes held out the golden scepter to Esther.

dag: Bɛ naala noli n-lu wuntizɔriba zuɣu, ka kari saria n-zali ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali.
en: who gang up to murder innocent victims.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Jɔn daa bɔhi salo bɛn ka o sanna ni o ti baptaizi ba maa, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: Crowds of people came out to be baptized, but John said to them, You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?.

dag: Yinim bɛn be tiŋ maa vinvamli ni, fabilimiya, dama kɔhigɔriba la zaa kpiya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yi zahindi anzinfa sania zuɣu la kpi.
en: The ones who grind the grain will wail; all the merchants will be silenced. I will eliminate all those weighing out silver.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛ dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ zuɣuri m-be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: These were the ancestral heads of families and their principal descendants who lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka Naawuni deeg o suhigu Aruna Jɛbusi nir maa kabɔɣili maa ni maa, ka o daa mali sara nimaani.
en: David saw by this that the Lord had answered his prayer, so he offered sacrifices on the altar at Araunah's threshing place.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, M mini kum kul chɛ tab la kpe ni kpe, ka buchi bɔ ka kpamdi lan yɛn ku ma.
en: Esau said, Since Im going to die anyway, what good is my birthright to me.

dag: Dauda daa yɛla zabba piɛl viɛlli kaman Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa mini baansi maa ni Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ baan kpɛm maa ni daa ye zabba shɛŋa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru lo o shee ni.
en: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.

dag: ka o yidan maa wum li ka bi yɛl o shɛli, ka mi bi galim li, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o ni niŋ shɛli maa ni zani.
en: If her husband hears about the promise and lets her keep her promise, she must do exactly what she promised. She must give everything she promised.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, bihilaamba ni ti ŋubi bɛ bihi, ka bihi gba ti ŋubi bɛ laamba. N ni ti kari ya saria, ka wurim yi bɛn kpalim la dolisi pɔhim kam.
en: Therefore, parents among you will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will impose penalties from case laws on you and scatter all that is left of you to the winds.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti. Ka din pahi nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa suhuri fuŋmi ti zuɣu.
en: We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country, they said. The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.

dag: ka lan wum o ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim nanima ayi la shɛlikam zaa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Nanima ayi maa n-nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa be Ashitarɔt la.
en: We heard about everything he did to the two kings of the Amorites on the east side of the Jordan, Heshbons King Sihon and Bashans King Og, who was in Ashtaroth.

dag: Paɣimiya yi nuhi maa ka di yi. Chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka n nini nyari maa tumbu. Chɛliya tuumbiɛri maa tumbu.
en: Wash yourselves clean! I hate your filthy deeds. Stop doing wrong.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Galili do so ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la gba daa ti yiɣisi daadam biɛligu yuya sabbu saha la n-laɣim niriba pah omaŋ zuɣu, amaa o gba ni daa ti kani, bɛn dol o maa zaa daa wurimmi.
en: Later, during the time of the census, a man named Judas came from Galilee. Many people joined his group, but he was also killed, and all his followers were scattered.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti zali ya ni yi gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ gbinnyaɣinima ka bi doli wuhibu shɛli ti ni daa wuhi ya la.
en: Our friends, we command you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to keep away from all believers who are living a lazy life and who do not follow the instructions that we gave them.

dag: Ka nam din pah anahi gba ti deei. Di ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman kuriti din ŋmɛri burisiri ka kabiri binshɛɣukam la. Ka kuriti ni ŋmɛri burisiri binshɛɣukam shɛm la, lala ka di ni ti ŋme n-wurisi nam shɛŋa din daŋ di tooni.
en: And then there will be a fourth empire, as strong as iron, which shatters and breaks everything. And just as iron shatters everything, it will shatter and crush all the earlier empires.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba mini salo maa, M bi nya doo ŋɔ taali.
en: Pilate told the chief priests and the crowd, I don't find him guilty of anything.

dag: Zaŋmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli ba ka bɛ zaŋ mali kuli ti yɛli bɛ nanima ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli yi nanim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Tell them to give the message to their masters. Tell them that this is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: Tell your masters that.

dag: Yawɛ, saha shɛli a yi ti niŋ a niriba nirilim, nyin teemi n yɛla; saha shɛli a yi ti tiligi ba, nyin sɔŋm ma.
en: Remember me, LORD, with the favor you show your people. Visit me with your saving help.

dag: Di chɛ ka n ni yɛl a ni faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣ a yaha maa niŋ a alahiziba.
en: Dont be surprised that I said to you, You must be born anew.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Izraɛlnim maa zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka wula ka Firawuna ŋun lee ni wum mani ŋun bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: But Moses said to the LORD, The Israelites havent even listened to me. How can I expect Pharaoh to listen to me, especially since Im not a very good speaker.

dag: Yi ni tooi chɛ ka nandaamba birim bɛ nia lɔbu ni, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: You wicked people want to spoil the hopes of the poor, but the Lord will protect them.

dag: ni Goshɛn ni Holɔn ni Gilo: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara piniyini m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Goshen, Holon, and Giloh. In total: eleven cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa kul dolila o ba Asa soli ka bi birigi li. O daa kul tumdila din tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Like his father Asa, Jehoshaphat was good and did everything that the Lord wanted, except he did not destroy the high places. Also, the people did not turn back to the God their ancestors worshiped.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi kul ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ, yi wuhirila ti Duuma kum yɛla hal ni o ti labina.
en: Every time you eat this bread and drink this cup, you broadcast the death of the Lord until he comes.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn su laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nɛma fukumsi, ka tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni, ka lan tumdi tuma tiri Izraɛlnima.
en: They shall take charge of all the equipment of the Tent and perform the duties for the rest of the Israelites.

dag: Amaa Naawuni pun zaŋ niŋgbuŋ yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa n-niŋ niŋgbun yini kaman o ni yu shɛm.
en: But as it is, God has placed each one of the parts in the body just like he wanted.

dag: ni Bɛra, ŋuna ka Tiligatipilinɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Asiria naa la daa zaŋ kuli tinzun tiŋ ni la. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya naa.
en: Beerah was Baals son. King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria forced Beerah to leave his home. So Beerah became the kings prisoner. Beerah was a leader of the tribe of Reuben.

dag: N zaŋ n yɛligu niŋ a nol ni, ka zaŋ a niŋ n nuu mahim ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa, ka nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. N yɛli Ziɔnnima, Yi nyɛla n niriba.
en: I stretched out the heavens and laid the earth's foundations; I say to Jerusalem, You are my people! I have given you my teaching, and I protect you with my hand.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ni biŋgbamda bɛn be tiŋgban ni alikauli tin ya, ka kpihim tɔbiri mini takɔbiri ni tɔb tuhibu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: On that day, I will make a covenant for them with the wild animals, the birds in the sky, and the creeping creatures of the fertile ground. I will do away with the bow, the sword, and war from the land; I will make you lie down in safety.

dag: O ni chɛ ka a wuntitali ne kaman wuntaŋ la, ka chɛ ka a yɛlimaŋli be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim ni be shɛm la.
en: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛŋa mini kpa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali tulaale zim shɛli din nyom viɛla.
en: The people also brought spices and olive oil. These things were used for the sweet-smelling incense, the anointing oil, and the oil for the lamps.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yi di daa bi chɛ ka shɛb tiligi, ti tiŋ maa naan bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra.
en: If the Lord All-Powerful had not allowed a few people to live, we would have been destroyed completely like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. And that almost happened!.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ deei Ammɔn nira bee Mɔab nira niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, soli kani ni bɛ deei bɛ zuliya niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Ammonites and Moabites cant belong to the LORDs assembly. Not even the tenth generation of such people can belong to the LORDs assembly, as a rule.

dag: di saha , Yawɛ chɛ ka a daŋ niriba yɛli noli ti a ka zaɣis a; ka chɛ ka a dɔɣibu soli ŋari, ka a leei paɣiŋoo.
en: may the Lord make your name a curse among your people. May he cause your genital organs to shrink and your stomach to swell up.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma.
en: Balaam said to him, Build seven altars for me here and bring me seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan laɣim ka Rɛfaim vinvamli maa ni na ti doya yaha.
en: Once again the Philistines came up and spread out across the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Kom daa lim bɛ dimnim maa, ka bɛ ni yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: But the water drowned their enemies; not one of them was left.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla anabi mini maligumaana bee niriba bɛn yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna la, n ni darigi bɛ mini bɛ yinsinim tibili.
en: If any of my people or a prophet or a priest even uses the words the Lord 's burden, I will punish them and their families.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: The people of Israel divided the land as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba, ka chɛla Juda zuliya kɔŋko.
en: The Lord was angry with the Israelites and banished them from his sight, leaving only the kingdom of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul dumi hal ti kpe zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mi du hal ni sagbana ni.
en: Lord , your constant love reaches the heavens; your faithfulness extends to the skies.

dag: ka bɛn kpalim mi gbahi naa maa yiŋbihi maa n-dihi ba vi, ka ku ba.
en: The rest of them grabbed his servants, abused them, and killed them.

dag: Kaman man ni nya shɛm, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri zaɣ biɛɣu puu, ka biriti yɛlimuɣisira, dina ka bɛ ti yɛn chɛra.
en: I have seen people plow fields of evil and plant wickedness like seed; now they harvest wickedness and evil.

dag: Lala ka paɣ shɛb bɛn bebu daa be kasi, ka bɛ mali tahima Naawuni sani daa yi maani bɛmaŋa, ka deeri bɛ yidaannim noya.
en: It was the same with the holy women who lived long ago and followed God. They made themselves beautiful in that same way. They were willing to serve their husbands.

dag: Nyamiya, Sintani jɛmdiba bɛn yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianima amaa ka pa Yɛhudianim la nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. N ni chɛ ka bɛ kana nti gbani yi tooni m-baŋ ni n yuri ya.
en: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ jilima n-taɣi naɣibil ŋun ŋubiri mɔri kɔtomsi.
en: They traded their glorious God for an image of a bull that eats grass.

dag: Shimɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amnɔn mini Rina ni Bɛnhanan ni Tilɔn. Ishi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔhɛt mini Bɛnzɔhɛt.
en: Shimons family: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. Ishis family: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

dag: Amaa o paɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la bihi bɛna, pina ka o daa ti ba, o ni daa na be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛli. Ka o daa chɛ ka o bihi bɛn kpalim maa chaŋ ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni wulimpuhili polo ka chɛ Yisahaku.
en: To the sons of Abrahams secondary wives, Abraham gave gifts and, while he was still living, sent them away from his son Isaac to land in the east.

dag: ni tiŋgban ni pin suma mini di binshɛɣukam ni ŋun daa be tutuɣu din diri buɣim ŋɔ yurilim. Chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim siɣi Yisifu zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka di siɣi ŋun ŋun nyɛ nabia o mabihi sunsuuni ŋɔ ningbaɣu kɔbiri zuɣu na.
en: with the gifts of the earth and all that fills it, and the favor of the one who lives on Sinai. I pray that all these rest on Josephs head, on the crown of that prince among brothers.

dag: Sool ni daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ yɛlli maa ni nyɛ shɛm, Yawɛ daa bi garig o zahindi puuni bee Urim puuni bee n-chɛ ka anab so yɛl o shɛli.
en: So he asked the Lord what to do. But the Lord would not answer, either in a dream or by a priest or a prophet.

dag: Sagbani maa ni daa kul vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa saha shɛli, nyama, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu dii gbaai Miriam, ka o niŋgbuŋ paligi zaa kaman gumbɔrigu la. Ka Aduna daa ŋmaligi lihi Miriam polo n-nya ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-gbaag o.
en: The cloud rose from the Tent. Aaron turned and looked at Miriam. Her skin was white like snow—she had a terrible skin disease!.

dag: N ni guhi Yawɛ ŋun lɛb o nyaaŋa biri Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, ka niŋ o naani.
en: The Lord has hidden himself from his people, but I trust him and place my hope in him.

dag: Kaman sagbana ni yi wurim naai shɛm la, lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ku lan labina.
en: A cloud breaks apart and moves on— like the one who descends to the grave and wont rise.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti duhiri timaŋa ka tumdi din yiɣisiri tab suhuri bee n-zabiri tab nyuli.
en: Lets not become arrogant, make each other angry, or be jealous of each other.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the greatest of all gods; his love is eternal.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la.
en: Abraham set out early for the place where he had stood with the LORD.

dag: Kum n-yi di mali ma, n naan ku yɛli ya, dama mani n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: Even if I were hungry, I wouldnt tell you because the whole world and everything in it already belong to me.

dag: ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la gba bahi yoli.
en: It would also mean that the believers in Christ who have died are lost.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpɛhi bɛ yuri dabiɛm, ka kpɛhi bɛn bari ba mi yinyari. Amaa n ni ti guli Judanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yuri zom.
en: At that time I will terrify all their horses and make all their riders go crazy. I will watch over the people of Judah, but I will make the horses of their enemies blind.

dag: Yuun tuhili maa tariga yi ti paai, Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ yooi Sintani o sarika maa ni bahi.
en: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison.

dag: ka so ku baŋ ni a lɔri noli naɣila a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ kawaan daŋda bee ka daŋda na ni yi ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, yin zaŋmiya zaɣ maha n-chim li niɛm zim.
en: If you present a grain offering to the LORD from the first produce, you must make such an offering from the crushed heads of newly ripe grain, roasted with fire.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka suhi Yawɛ yɛli.
en: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD, saying.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa darigi Ashidɔdnim tibili pam n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ tiŋ maa ni zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi din gil li zaa.
en: The LORDs hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod: God terrified them and struck them in Ashdod and its surroundings with tumors.

dag: A yurilim maŋli nyɛla din du m-paai zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mali hal ti paai sagbana.
en: Your faithful love is higher than the highest clouds in the sky!.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam mini Balak daa doli chaŋ ti paai tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Huzɔt la.
en: Then Balaam went with Balak and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihitaayika.
en: of Bebai.

dag: Firilatamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni firilanima ni firila kpam.
en: the lampstand that is used for light and the things used with the lampstand, the lamps, and oil for the light;.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila wɔridib shɛba bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kɔre be wɔrinyama ni la; sokam kɔre daa bela o kpee paɣa bɔbu ni.
en: They are like horses that have had plenty to eat and are ready to mate. They are like a horse that is calling its neighbors wife.

dag: o yi ti baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa, ŋun bom bulaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti mali sara.
en: If he learns about his sin, he must bring a male goat that has nothing wrong with it as his offering.

dag: dindina n gba ni chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ ni ti ŋmɛn ya buyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: I'll remain your enemy and punish you even worse.

dag: bɛ bi zɔri nambɔɣu, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: They have no pity; their mouths speak arrogantly.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ku lan lihiri Ijiptinim ninni bɔri sɔŋsim. Bɛ yi ti teei din daa niŋ Ijiptinim maa yɛla, di saha bɛ ni baŋ bɛ ni daa bɔri sɔŋsim bɛ sani maa galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: Israel will never again depend on them for help. Egypt's fate will remind Israel how wrong it was to rely on them. Then Israel will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

dag: N kɔŋko n-daa kul kpalim be nimaani n-lihiri alahiziba ʒii maa. Ya buriginli daa lan ka n ni, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi hal ka so ku lan tooi baŋ ni mani m-bala gba.
en: So I was left alone. I was watching this vision, and it made me afraid. I lost my strength. My face turned white like a dead persons face, and I was helpless.

dag: Di tiriya nimmira yɛlimaŋli, amaa doliyala yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Stop judging by external standards, and judge by true standards.

dag: suhimiya Naawuni sahakam.
en: pray at all times.

dag: Siria naa daa ti lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa niŋ o sapashinnim saawara, yɛli, Luɣili yaakaza ka n yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni.
en: Time after time, when the king of Syria was at war against the Israelites, he met with his officers and announced, I've decided where we will set up camp.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, a bi zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ti bee n-zaŋ puri mini tihi puri ti ti ka di leei ti dini. Pumpɔŋɔ a bɔrimi ni a yɔhim ti. Ti ku kana.
en: Moreover, you havent brought us to a land full of milk and honey, nor given us the inheritance of field and vineyard. Would you also gouge out the eyes of these men? We wont come up.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam chani yuŋ tuurimi, ka di nyɛla neesim ni kani zuɣu.
en: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.

dag: Ka naa lan bɔhi ba, Ka ŋuni n-lee be zɔŋ ni? Di saha maa ka Haman mi daa kpɛna ti ʒe zɔŋ ni. O daa kamina ni o ti yɛli naa ka o bah o noli ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Mɔdɛkai ti yili gar da shɛli o ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ sa n-zal la.
en: Are any of my officials in the palace? the king asked. Now Haman had just entered the courtyard; he had come to ask the king to have Mordecai hanged on the gallows that was now ready.

dag: N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: I will give you the land of Canaan, he said. It will be your own possession.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anabinim maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla bintɔri dihi ba, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nyuhi ba. Dama tuumbiɛri maa yila Jɛrusalɛm anabinim maa sani n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD of heavenly forces proclaims concerning the prophets: Im going to feed them bitter food and give them poison to drink. Wickedness has spread from the prophets of Jerusalem throughout the land.

dag: Ka maligumaani maa ti booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ o nuzaa nutal ni;.
en: The priest will pour some of the oil into his left palm.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ kali tinzunnim bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman o ba Dauda ni daa chɛ ka bɛ kali ba shɛm la. Ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi niriba tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: So Solomon counted all the foreigners living in Israel. They found , strangers in the country.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu sani bindir shɛŋa nti ti ba. Amaa Bɛnjamin dini daa gar o tab maa dini ʒiibunu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa nyu binnyura, ka bɛ min o zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Food was served to them from Joseph's table, and Benjamin was served five times as much as the rest of them. So they ate and drank with Joseph until they were drunk.

dag: ka Machi bia Gɛuɛl daa yi Gaad zuliya ni na.
en: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel, Machis son.

dag: A daa labisi ti taŋkpaɣu ni; ka yɛli, Yinim daadamnima, labimiya taŋkpaɣu ni yaha.
en: You return people to dust, saying, Go back, humans.

dag: Bee nir yi yaag o noli po yiriŋ ni o ni niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi po pɔri kam yiriŋ ka bi baŋ, o yi ti baŋ, o mali taali di puuni.
en: If you make a careless vow, no matter what it is about, you are guilty as soon as you realize what you have done.

dag: ka doli Naawuni ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnim la kaya mini Izraɛl nanim ni daa zaŋ ka shɛŋa wuhi ba la.
en: They followed the practices of the nations that the LORD had removed before the Israelites, as well as the practices that the Israelite kings had done.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa, ka kuhi pam ka naanyi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: The spirit shook him. Then it gave a loud shout and left.

dag: N daa da daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi daba n yiŋ puuni. Ka n daa lan mali niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ n tooni be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I bought many slaves, and there were slaves born in my household. I owned more livestock than anyone else who had ever lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Yi ni ti booi kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-bahi Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini di puuni nɛma zaa zuɣu, ka malimali di mini di puuni binyɛra zaa, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Use the anointing oil and anoint the Holy Tent and everything in it. When you put the oil on these things, you will make them holy.

dag: Ka Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was in command of the tribe of Simeon.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nambɔzɔbo galisiya, ka o yurilim gba galisi zaŋ chaŋ ti polo.
en: But God's mercy is so abundant, and his love for us is so great.

dag: Judanim bi ʒe yim, ka din chihiri kul tumdi Izraɛl mini Jɛrusalɛm puuni. Dama Judanim saɣim Yawɛ ni yuri o jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka kpuɣi tinzunnim bɛn jɛmdi buɣa bipuɣinsi.
en: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord . You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.

dag: Juda min o mabihi maa ni daa paai Yisifu yiŋa, o daa na be yiŋa, ka bɛ daa damd o tooni.
en: When Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, he was still there. They bowed down before him.

dag: Amaa di ku yuui ka yɛla ayi ŋɔ zaa paag a dahin yini puuni. A baɣibuɣibo min a tima la zaa yoli, a ni bahi kɔŋ yidana mini bihi.
en: But in a moment, in a single day, both of these things will happen. In spite of all the magic you use, you will lose your husband and children.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, Izraɛlnim miri ka bɛ kana ti miri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: The other Israelites must no longer approach the Tent and in this way bring on themselves the penalty of death.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Siizaria o daa chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm nti puhi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be nimaani ka naanyi gari chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: Paul sailed to Caesarea, where he greeted the church. Then he went on to Antioch.

dag: Amalɛknima m-be Nɛgɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Hitinim mini Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim be zoya ni tinsi ni; ka Keenannim mi ʒi m-baɣi teeku mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili.
en: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.

dag: Ka o paɣ tab bɛn mali yɛm daa garig o yɛli, Aai. Ka o garigi yɛl omaŋa.
en: Her wisest servant girl answers her. Yes, the servant gives her an answer:.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Filistianim maa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei bɛ ni ku shɛb maa nɛma, ka daa nya ka Sool min o bidibis ata maa lu n-dola Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The next day, the Philistines went back to take things from the dead bodies. They found Saul and his three sons dead on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa gbani zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka suhi alibarika niŋ naa ni ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋya ni nyini n dan naa baɣa be n ni, a ni saɣi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni bɔri shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Joab bowed very low and said, Your Majesty, I thank you for giving your permission. It shows that you approve of me.

dag: Ka m mini m paɣa ŋun nyɛ anabi la daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Bolim o yuli Mahɛshalalihashibaz.
en: Then I went to my wife, the woman prophet. She became pregnant and had a son. The Lord told me, Name the boy Maher Shalal Hash Baz.

dag: Chɛ ka tuumba bɛn ka Juda naa Zɛdɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm maa zaŋ lahibali ti ti Ɛdom naa mini Mɔab naa ni Ammɔn naa ni Taai naa ni Sidɔn naa.
en: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Send the message with the messengers of these kings who have come to Jerusalem to see King Zedekiah of Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ nyɛla do yino ŋun be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bihi pinaayi, ŋun nyɛ ti zaa ha biasani be ti ba maa sani ka yino ŋun kani.
en: They said, We, your servants, are twelve brothers, sons of one man in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, but one is gone.

dag: Ka Naawuni ti o binyɛr piɛlli din nyɛlisiri ka be nyam ni o ye. Binyɛr piɛlli maa nyɛla wuntizɔriba wuntia tuma.
en: She has been given clean shining linen to wear.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali du shɛli din be puuni la mini du titali maa dukpina ka ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi ŋmahima pa di zuɣu.
en: The walls around the main room and the inner room were carved with pictures of Cherub angels, palm trees, and flowers.

dag: Ka ninkurigu maa daa yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka yi suhuri doya. N ni tin ya yi ni bɔri shɛlikam, amaa lee di gbɛnya palo ŋɔ ni.
en: The old man said, You are welcome to stay at my house. I will give you anything you need, but dont stay the night in the public square.

dag: Ti zaa daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn bɔrigi, ka sokam dol o suhuyubu soli. Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ti zaa daalahichi ʒil o.
en: We had all wandered away like sheep. We had gone our own way. And yet the Lord put all our guilt on him.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi, dama so kani m-be ka nyini, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani m-pah a zuɣu kaman ti ni wum shɛm ti tiba ni.
en: That is why you are so great, LORD God! No one can compare to you, no god except you, just as we have always heard with our own ears.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi nuu be zibisim tuun yoya ni, amaa lee yihimiya tuun yoya maa la palɔni.
en: Have nothing to do with the worthless things that people do, things that belong to the darkness. Instead, bring them out to the light. .

dag: Juda zuliya niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Everyone who has ears should pay attention.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: So, you shepherds, listen to the word of the Lord .

dag: Kɛnaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Otiniɛl mini Sɛraya, ka Otiniɛl mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hatat mini Mɛɔnɔtai.
en: Kenaz had two sons, Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel also had two sons, Hathath and Meonothai.

dag: ni Matiu mini Tomas ni Jeemsi Alifius bia mini Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Matthew and Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, and Simon .

dag: Naomi min o bia paɣ Rut ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab paɣ la ni daa yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Bɛtilihɛm na shɛm m-bala. Chi mi chɛbu piligibu saha ka bɛ daa paai Bɛtilihɛm maa.
en: Thus Naomi returned. And Ruth the Moabite, her daughter-in-law, returned with her from the territory of Moab. They arrived in Bethlehem at the beginning of the barley harvest.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n kamina ni n ti yɛli nyini n dan naa dimbɔŋɔ, dama niriba maa chɛmi ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam ka n tɛhi ni n yi yɛli nyin naa, di pa shɛli a ni niŋ man ŋun nyɛ o dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni bɔr shɛm maa.
en: Your Majesty, I came here to tell you about my problem, because I was afraid of what someone might do to me. I decided to come to you, because I thought you could help.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛdom naa daa lab ŋme n-deei Ɛlat n-ti Ɛdomnima, ka daa kari Judanim yihi Ɛlat maa; ka Ɛdomnim maa daa kana ti be Ɛlat hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: At the same time the king of Edom regained control of the city of Elath and drove out the Judeans who lived there. The Edomites settled in Elath and still live there.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ a ni pun darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili alaka; ka nahind a ni ti shɛb dansi la pahira.
en: They try to hurt people you have already punished. They tell everyone about the suffering you gave them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai min o kpamba maa, Nyamiya, mmaŋmaŋ bia m-bɔri ni o ku ma la, di ni ti be ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir ŋɔ? Chɛliy o ka o tu ma, dama Yawɛ n-zal o lala.
en: Then David said to Abishai and all his soldiers: My own son is trying to kill me! Why shouldn't this man from the tribe of Benjamin want me dead even more? Let him curse all he wants. Maybe the Lord did tell him to curse me.

dag: ka yɛl o, Cham Sailom biaŋ ni ti paɣ a nina maa. Ka o chaŋ ti paɣ o nina maa, ka di dii neei, ka o labina.
en: Jesus said to him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam . So the man went away and washed. When he returned, he could see.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na ni n ti tum tuma ŋɔ zaa, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ yubu ka n tumda.
en: Then Moses said, I will show you proof that the Lord sent me to do all the things I told you. I will show you that all these things were not my own idea.

dag: Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, Nuhu daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihinu pahi.
en: Noah lived years after the flood.

dag: Yɔhiŋ sania zaŋ zahim binyɛra nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa binyɛra zahimbu sania zuɣu din tuhi nyɛla din paligir o suhu.
en: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti ba; ka o suhu daa paligi pam o min o yiŋnim zaa ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda maa zuɣu.
en: They were very glad they had put their faith in God. After this, the jailer took Paul and Silas to his home and gave them something to eat.

dag: Di saha ka o kuhi yɛli, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda nyaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: The blind man was excited and said, Jesus, Son of David, please help me.

dag: Tuumba ayi maa ni daa ti yɛn dɔni gbihi saha shɛli, ka Reehab du bɛ sani dufahirili maa zuɣusaa.
en: The two men were ready to sleep for the night, but Rahab went to the roof to talk to them.

dag: Di saha maa ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu daa kul moorila nini pahira. Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Jona, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ a ka teeku ŋɔ fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: The wind and the waves of the sea were becoming stronger and stronger. So the men said to Jonah, What should we do to save ourselves? What should we do to you to make the sea calm.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn saɣi siɣis amaŋa n tooni? Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh. They told him, The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says, How long will you refuse to obey me? Let my people go to worship me!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yabidoo Dan ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia la yuli m-boli tiŋ maa. Amaa tiŋ maa yuli daa tuui boonila Laishi.
en: But they named it Dan, after one of Israel's sons, who was the ancestor of their tribe.

dag: ka Annas mini Kaiafas mi daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima. Di saha maa ka Naawuni zilinli daa ti paai Zakaria bia Jɔn ŋun daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Annas and Caiaphas were the Jewish high priests. At that time God spoke to Zechariah's son John, who was living in the desert.

dag: Anzinfa doora ŋun yuli daa booni Dimitirius daa malila anzinfa n-doori buɣili Aritɛmis binnana, ka o mini bɛn daa laɣim tumdi di tuma nyari liɣiri pam di ni.
en: A silversmith named Demetrius had a business that made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis. Those who worked for him earned a lot of money.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim polo nyɛla, di simdi ni yi zaa mali naŋgban yini, ka chɛ ka yi baɣa be nandahima ni paai shɛb yɛla ni, ka yumiya mabihili, ka maliya suhuballi, ka siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani.
en: So all of you should live together in peace. Try to understand each other. Love each other like brothers and sisters. Be kind and humble.

dag: Bom binshɛli n-zaŋ pili ŋariŋ maa, ka chɛ ka di zuɣusaa dubu polo nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi; ka chibi di dunoli di luɣili ni, ka kpahi li tambu buta tam taba.
en: Make a window for the boat about cubit below the roof. Put a door in the side of the boat. Make three floors in the boat: a top deck, a middle deck, and a lower deck.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.

dag: N kpamd a jaande ni a kul kpalimmi be Ɛfɛsus kaman n ni daa gariti chani Masidɔnia ka yɛl a shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka a kpahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhiri ʒiri wuhibu la zuɣu ni ka bɛ chɛ li.
en: When I left for Macedonia, I asked you to stay behind in Ephesus so that you could instruct certain individuals not to spread wrong teaching.

dag: O bi ʒe tibi nyɛvili soli zuɣu. O soli kpɛla yɔɣu, ka o bi mi lala.
en: She doesnt stay on the way of life. Her paths wander, but she doesnt know it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku tinsi maa niriba zaa, ka bi chɛ ka paɣa bee doo kpalim; ka daa gbahi bɛ piɛri mini niɣi, ni bunsi ni laakumnima, ka va bɛ situra pahi n-lab Akishi sanna.
en: David defeated the people in that area. He took all their sheep, cattle, donkeys, camels, and clothes and brought them back to Achish. But David didnt let any of those people live.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a daa yɔhim Jɛrusalɛmnim pam n-yɛli, Shɛli ti ku niŋ ya, amaa ka takɔbi ti be bɛ kukoya ni.
en: Then I said, Sovereign Lord , you have completely deceived the people of Jerusalem! You have said there would be peace, but a sword is at their throats.

dag: Ka lan chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ Masia yurilim maa, hal di ni nyɛ nir ni ku tooi baŋ shɛli zaa la, ka di chɛ ka binshɛɣukam din pali Naawuni ni la pali yi gba ni.
en: Christs love is greater than anyone can ever know, but I pray that you will be able to know that love. Then you can be filled with everything God has for you.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o yiko din be kasi la tum tuma. O ni tilig o niriba, ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa nya.
en: The LORD has bared his holy arm in view of all the nations; all the ends of the earth have seen our Gods victory.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ ba zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana ti niŋ yalim bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: and bring them to me. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and burn them as an offering to me.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Damaskusnim polo. Hamatinim mini Aripadnim birimmi, dama bɛ wumla lahiba biɛɣu. Dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya kaman teeku kom din ku tooi fo n-doya la.
en: The Lord says about Damascus: The towns of Hamath and Arpad have heard your bad news. They have lost hope, and worries roll over them like ocean waves.

dag: Amaa bɛ ku mali fali bɛ mabihi sani, Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛm la.
en: because he has promised to provide for them in this way.

dag: Yi zaŋ kpamli yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm, ka tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa pam.
en: You give such good advice and share your knowledge with a fool like me!.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ kuriba bɛn nuhi tum taali; ka yi lan ŋmari ʒiri ka zaŋ yi zilima tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: Your hands are stained with blood, and your fingers with guilt. Your lips speak lies; your tongues mutter malice.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla m mini n niriba kɔhi ni bɛ ku ti kpihim ti birili. Di yi di nyɛla bɛ zaŋla ti dɔbba mini paɣiba kɔhi ni ti leei daba, n naan shini ka ku zaŋ di yɛla muɣis a, dama nir ku tooi zaŋ ti ni yɛn di wahala shɛli buɣisi nyin naa ni yɛn kɔŋ shɛli.
en: because a reward has been promised to anyone who kills my people. Your Majesty, if we were merely going to be sold as slaves, I would not have bothered you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Zaŋm a kabɔɣili ŋɔ palo ŋɔ ti ma ka m me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, kɔhimi li ti ma kaman di daa ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ miligi ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: David said to Araunah, Sell me your threshing floor. I will pay you the full price. Then I can use the area to build an altar to worship the Lord . Then the terrible sicknesses will be stopped.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni duri duli, ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi tiŋ maa puuni tuhir o sol na; o daa chɛ situra yɛbu ka di yuui, o mi daa bi gbɛri yiŋa; gbal kaba ni ka o daa kul gbɛra.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man from that town came to him. This man had demons inside him. For a long time he had worn no clothes. He did not live in a house but in the caves where the dead are buried.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu maa ni benibu zuɣu hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala. N niŋgbuŋ yaɣa pinaayi kul yiinila yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣiri nyin Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ.
en: My very being longs, even yearns, for the LORDs courtyards. My heart and my body will rejoice out loud to the living God!.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zal o tumtumdiba zaa bɛn ʒe o dunol ni ni bɛ tim Haman jilima n-damdir o tiŋa. Amaa ka Mɔdɛkai ŋun daa zaɣisi ni o ku damd o tiŋa bee n-ti o jilima.
en: and the king had given orders for his officials at the royal gate to honor Haman by kneeling down to him. All of them obeyed except Mordecai.

dag: N ni zaŋ azichi shɛli din be zibisim ni mini ashili shee ti a. Ka di chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ m-bol a yuli.
en: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.

dag: Biɛri bɔhibu mini sanyoo nyɛla n dini, saha shɛli bɛ napɔna yi ti sarigi; dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha kanna yomyom.
en: The Lord will take revenge and punish them; the time will come when they will fall; the day of their doom is near.

dag: Ka Pita mini Jɔn mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka Pita ti yɛl o, Lihim ti.
en: They looked straight at him, and Peter said, Look at us.

dag: Ka n ni ti kari ba saria bɛ ni zaɣisi ma bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali kam puuni la zuɣu. Bɛ mali maligu ti buɣa, ka jɛm bɛmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.

dag: Ka a daa zaŋ yuma pam di ba suɣilo, ka daa zaŋ a shia niŋ a daanabinim ni, ka bɛ kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ba niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim nuu ni.
en: Year after year you patiently warned them. You inspired your prophets to speak, but your people were deaf, so you let them be conquered by other nations.

dag: Anabi Hanania ni daa kabigi naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the message from the Lord came to Jeremiah. This happened after Hananiah had taken the yoke off Jeremiahs neck and had broken it.

dag: M banima, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun mi ŋun daa be piligu ni ha la zuɣu. Nachimbihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni pun nyaŋ Tuumbiɛrilan la zuɣu.
en: Parents, Im writing to you because you have known the one who has existed from the beginning. Young people, Im writing to you because you have conquered the evil one.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili; ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: He went to her, took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Kiriatariba mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti ba pahi. . Bɛ booni li la Hiburɔn pumpɔŋɔ, ka di be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni.
en: They were given the city of Arba , now called Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, along with the pasture land surrounding it.

dag: Sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya daba ayi bee goli bee di daa yi kpalim ʒe Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa yuui, Izraɛlnim maa kul kpalindimi doya ka bi chana; amaa di daa yi ti vuui saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.
en: Whether it was two days, a month, a year, or longer, as long as the cloud remained over the Tent, they did not move on; but when it lifted, they moved.

dag: Dishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛmdan mini Ishiban ni Itiran ni Kɛran.
en: Dishon had four sons. They were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

dag: Di saha ka waɣ biɛ titali maa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi paɣ maa zuɣu, ka o lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi paɣ maa zuliya bɛn kpalim n-nyɛ bɛn doli Naawuni zaligunima ka mali Yisa shɛhira la.
en: So the dragon was furious with the woman, and he went off to make war on the rest of her children, on those who keep Gods commandments and hold firmly to the witness of Jesus.

dag: Kamiyana nti sɔŋ ma ka ti chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-ku ba, bɛ ni chaŋ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni guhiri dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ mali biɛr kasi ka ku mali galimi Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka suhudoo be yi min o sunsuuni.
en: And so, my friends, as you wait for that Day, do your best to be pure and faultless in God's sight and to be at peace with him.

dag: Ka o daa gindi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo tinsi zaa n-yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So John went along the Jordan Valley, telling the people, Turn back to God and be baptized! Then your sins will be forgiven.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi, ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi yɛn suhiri alibarika niŋdi Izraɛlnim ni: yɛlimiya ba.
en: Tell Aaron and his sons that when they bless the Israelites, this is what they should say:.

dag: Naaman ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa sapashin kpɛma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali, ka mali jilima pam o naa maa sani, dama o zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa tiri Sirianim nasara. O daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhir biiŋa; amaa ka kɔŋ lee mal o.
en: Naaman, a general for the king of Aram, was a great man and highly regarded by his master, because through him the LORD had given victory to Aram. This man was a mighty warrior, but he had a skin disease.

dag: Pool ni daa tɔɣisiri ni o zab omaŋ zuɣu maa, ka Gomna Fɛstus ti duh o yee yɛl o, Pool, di ni bɔŋɔ a kpɛla yinyari! A baŋsim pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpe yinyari maa.
en: At this point in Pauls defense, Festus declared with a loud voice, Youve lost your mind, Paul! Too much learning is driving you mad.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka doliya zaligunim ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Be sure that you obey these commands; do not forget that you were slaves in Egypt.

dag: m-pahi Yawɛ vuhim dabisa la mini yi pina ni yi ni po pɔri shɛŋa sara ni yi suhuyubu sara shɛŋa yi ni maani tiri Yawɛ la zaa zuɣu.
en: This is in addition to the LORDs sabbaths and in addition to your presents, all the payments for solemn promises, and all the spontaneous gifts that you give to the LORD.

dag: Dauda min o niriba maa ni daa mali ti paai Mahanaim, ka Nahash bia Shɔbi ŋun daa yi Raba din be Ammɔn tiŋgban ni la na mini Makiri Amiɛl bia ŋun daa yi Lɔdɛba na la ni Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nira ka yi Rɔgɛlim na la.
en: When David arrived in Mahanaim, Nahashs son Shobi, who was from Rabbah of the Ammonites; Ammiels son Machir, who was from Lo-debar; and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ gbansabira.
en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests. Seraiah was secretary.

dag: Di ti ŋubiya niŋkaha bee n-duɣ li, amaa ti shɛmiya binzuɣuri ni biɛhi zaa n-tabili puuni nɛma zaa.
en: You must not eat the lamb raw or boiled in water. You must roast the whole lamb over a fire. The lamb must still have its head, legs, and inner parts.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti ŋme mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi kikahi ti kpe Yawɛ duu.
en: They entered Jerusalem with lyres, harps, and trumpets and went to the Temple of the Lord .

dag: A bi saɣi n-chɛ ka n dimnim gbaai ma; a zaŋ ma zali palo ni.
en: You have not let my enemies capture me; you have given me freedom to go where I wish.

dag: Bɛ ni mali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu soli ti wuntizɔriba, ka ŋunkam zaa be tibi o suhu ni ni dol li.
en: Justice will return and bring fairness. And those who want to do right will be there to see it.

dag: Piimiya zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa zuliya kam puuni niriba atata ti ma, ka n tim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti chaŋchaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-buɣisi li nya, ka sab wuhi di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ su yaɣ shɛŋa yɛla zaa na ti ti ma.
en: Pick out three men for each tribe. I will send them out, and they will go up and travel throughout the land. They will write a description of it as the basis for determining their legacy. Then they will come back to me.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa ti yɛl o, Yi mini yi bihi chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ, amaa chɛliya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi bɛna.
en: The king sent for Moses and told him, Go worship the Lord ! And take your families with you. Just leave your sheep, goats, and cattle.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ bindirigu na ti zali nachin kpɛm maa ni o di, ka o yɛli, Di yi pa ni n yɛlila daliri din tahi ma na, n ku di bindirigu maa. Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Laban then gave him food to eat, but the servant refused to eat. He said, I will not eat until I have told you why I came. So Laban said, Then tell us.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o tumtumdiba bɛn mi teeku kom yɛtɔɣa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa zaŋ ŋariŋ din zɔri pam.
en: King Hiram had some skilled sailors who knew the sea well. He sent them to serve in Solomons navy and work with Solomons men.

dag: Lihimi zuɣusaa ka a nya, nyam sagbana din be a zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha.
en: Look at the sky! See how high the clouds are!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha ka Samsin ti labiri ni o ti niŋ paɣisarili maa amiliya, ka o daa ti ŋmaligi birigi ni o lihi nya o ni daa ku gbuɣin so sɔŋ la, ka nya ka shihi n-kpe m-pal o zaɣ woliŋ ni niŋ kpam.
en: A few days later Samson went back to marry her. On the way he left the road to look at the lion he had killed, and he was surprised to find a swarm of bees and some honey inside the dead body.

dag: Bɛna n-daa laɣim naai noli ni bɛ tuhi Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnima.
en: All these kings came together and made plans to fight against Joshua and the Israelites.

dag: ka di be kaman n zo sumo bee m mabia zuɣu ka m mali nandahima maa. N daa kul gbami ni suhugarigu, ka chani gindi fabindi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ma kpi.
en: as I would pray for a friend or a brother. I went around bent over in mourning, as one who mourns for his mother.

dag: Tummiya yi dabitali tuma ni suhupiɛlli ka di be kaman yi tumdi li tirila ti Duuma la, ka pa ni ninsalinima;.
en: Do your work, and be happy to do it. Work as though it is the Lord you are serving, not just an earthly master.

dag: Zaliguzaana ni sariakarita yino kɔŋko ŋun ni tooi tiligi niriba ka ni tooi bahi ba yoli m-beni. Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a mi ka a karit a daadamkpee saria?.
en: There is only one lawgiver and judge, and he is able to save and to destroy. But you who judge your neighbor, who are you?.

dag: amaa tinim ni zaŋ ti dahima zaa n-niŋla Naawuni suhibu min o yɛligu tɔɣisibu tuma ni.
en: Then we can use all our time to pray and to teach the word of God.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi niŋ fawɔɣili zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa ku tum naa barina.
en: Do this at once, so that no more harm may be done to my interests.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ ninsalinim naani.
en: Its far better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust any human.

dag: Miriya ka yi yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ yoya bee n-tu yi niriba toondana.
en: You must not curse God or the leaders of your people.

dag: Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti ʒiɛhira, ka bɛ yɛma fa, n ni yɛn zaŋ takɔb shɛli liri ba maa zuɣu.
en: They will drink this wine. Then they will vomit and act like crazy people. They will do this because of the war that I will soon bring against them.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ.
en: People walked by and said bad things to Jesus. They shook their heads and said, You said you could destroy the Temple and build it again in three days.

dag: Di saha maa ka naa daa bahi Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya noli, ka o chaŋ ti ŋme Shimɛi luhi ka o kpi. Di saha ka nam maa daa nya zaashee zani Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: Then the king commanded Benaiah, Jehoiadas son, who went and attacked Shimei, and he died. In these ways royal power was handed over to Solomon.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, bihilaamba ni ti ŋubi bɛ bihi, ka bihi gba ti ŋubi bɛ laamba. N ni ti kari ya saria, ka wurim yi bɛn kpalim la dolisi pɔhim kam.
en: As a result, parents in Jerusalem will eat their children, and children will eat their parents. I will punish you and scatter in every direction any who are left alive.

dag: Kom be kulibɔŋ maa ni ka a ni nyura, ka n zali kahiŋkɔri ni bɛ tahiri bindirigu na ti tir a.
en: You can drink from the brook. I have also ordered the ravens to provide for you there.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Amaa o daa lee bi tummi kaman o ba min o ma ni daa tum shɛm la; dama o daa wurim o ba ni daa me Baal binwɔɣinli shɛli zal la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, but he wasnt as bad as his father and mother. He removed the sacred pillar of Baal that his father had made.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai Naawuni yɛla tɔɣisibu ni suhukpeeni; ka Akuila mini Prisila daa wum o wuhibu maa, ka zaŋ o ti maan wuh o Naawuni yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga pahi.
en: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him home with them and explained to him more correctly the Way of God.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daalahichi daa ti galisi pam Yawɛ sani, dama bɛ daa bi tiri Yawɛ sara maligu pina maa jilima.
en: The sin of these priestly assistants was very serious in the LORDs sight because they were disrespecting the Lords own offering.

dag: Nir yi nya o suhu ni bɔri shɛli, di nyaɣisila o sani, amaa nir yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, di nyɛla din chihira jɛra sani.
en: People are happy when they get what they want. But stupid people want nothing but evil, and they refuse to change.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinima ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hagai mini Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo bia la daa piligi m-mali Izraɛl Naawuni yuli n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa tiri Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm ka nyɛ o ni su shɛb la.
en: At that time the prophets Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo began to prophesy in the name of God. They encouraged the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Suhu ni zaɣ biɛɣu lɔbu, ni ŋun kul zɔri yomyom chani zaɣ biɛɣ tumbu.
en: hearts that plan evil things to do, feet that run to do evil.

dag: O daa lan yɛli bia maa yaha, Kpaŋmina, niŋmi yomyom, di lan ʒiɛya. Di saha ka Jɔnatan bia maa daa pih o piɛma maa n-zaŋ ka o sanna.
en: Don't just stand there! Hurry up! The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, di ni lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bimbilima din be puri ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuɣu.
en: The Lord told Moses, Raise your hand into the air and the hail will start falling all over Egypt. The hail will fall on all the people, animals, and plants in all the fields of Egypt.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛl o, ka o yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir yɛl la. O daa yɛliya, Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl niŋgbuŋ Jɛziriil tintariga;.
en: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.

dag: Amaa tinim daa niŋ tahima ni ŋuna n-yɛn tiligi Izraɛlnima; ka din pahi ŋɔ zaa ha zuɣu nyɛla, di ni niŋ maa zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: We had hoped that he would be the one to set Israel free! But it has already been three days since all this happened.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o ninni, ka ŋmɛr o nutala, ka shɛb labir o tapaɣisi.
en: Then they spat in his face and beat him; and those who slapped him.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nya ma, o nya ŋun tim ma na maa.
en: Whoever sees me sees also him who sent me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ka yiko. Dabiɛm kpe ba, ka di niŋ ba alahiziba. Bɛ ŋmanila mɔri din be mɔɣu ni bee mɔ shɛŋa din bili mɔpilli zuɣu ka na bi zooi ka wuntaŋ ŋme n-ku li.
en: The people living there had no power. They were afraid and confused. They were about to be cut down like grass and plants in the field. They were like grass growing on the housetops, dying before it grows tall.

dag: Ka ŋun Ahazia daa pahi Ɛhab bia Jɔram la zuɣu, ka bɛ lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Siria Naa Hazaɛl Ramɔtigiliad, ka Sirianim daa ti ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: Joram was from Ahabs family. Ahaziah went with Joram to fight against King Hazael of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram.
