dag: Dinzuɣu di ni ti nyɛla yuŋ yi sani, ka yi ku lan nya ʒii, ka liɣa ti be yi sani, ka binshɛli ku kahigi wuhi ya. Wuntaŋ ni ti lu anabinim maa sani, ka biɛkaali nyaaŋa ti nyɛ zibisim bɛ sani.
en: Prophets, your day is almost over; the sun is going down on you. Because you mislead my people, you will have no more prophetic visions, and you will not be able to predict anything.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣili paɣ maa lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking. He said, Why do you make trouble for the woman? Shes done a good thing for me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ŋ-ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni, Ibrahimma Naawuni ni Yisahaku Naawuni ni Yaakubu Naawuni la n-tim ma yi sanna. N yuli m-bala sahakam. Ʒiɛmani kam nim ni yɛn booni ma shɛm m-bala.
en: Tell the Israelites that I, the Lord , the God of their ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, have sent you to them. This is my name forever; this is what all future generations are to call me.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima alali mali Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Then he made the mercy-cover from pure gold. It was / cubits long and / cubits wide.

dag: Di saha gom daa wum Pita min o tab la pam, amaa ka bɛ lee ne n-ʒiya, ka daa ti nya Yisa jilima ni niriba ayi bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa.
en: Peter and his companions were sound asleep, but they woke up and saw Jesus' glory and the two men who were standing with him.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba maa ŋmaligi yuuni taba, ka bi baŋ o ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: His disciples looked at each other, confused about which of them he was talking about.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ma bahi kɔbulli ŋɔ ni, ka m mali hal ti paai teeku ŋɔ puuni kɔtiŋa. Ka kokpɛɣu kul gili n luɣilikam, ka a kɔgban kara la zaa zɔri duri ma garita.
en: You threw me into the sea. Your powerful waves splashed over me. I went down, down into the deep sea. The water was all around me.

dag: Ti bɔri ni a vii sagbana ka siɣina. Ka zoya nya a, ka dabiɛm gbaai li ka di sɔhigi.
en: Why don't you tear the sky open and come down? The mountains would see you and shake with fear.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, n ni kana ti paɣ a a tuun kara zuɣu, ka yɛl a kɔŋko wuntital la yɛla.
en: I will go in the strength of the Lord God; I will proclaim your goodness, yours alone.

dag: Ti zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ Masia ŋun ka alahichi la n-zali alahichi zaani ni di chɛ ka ti leei wuntizɔriba ŋun Naawuni sani o zuɣu.
en: God caused the one who didnt know sin to be sin for our sake so that through him we could become the righteousness of God.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma kpe o bindira dibu duu, ka o ni daa lo shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m polo nyɛla o bɔri ma mi.
en: My lover took me to the wine house; his intent toward me was love.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yili Naawuni paɣibu yilli naai, ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu.
en: Then, after singing songs of praise, they went to the Mount of Olives.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi Naawuni kaman Naawuni maa zuɣu ka o chɛ ba bahi, ka bɛ tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri ka tumdi din chihiri tumbu.
en: Because those people refuse to keep in mind the true knowledge about God, he has given them over to corrupted minds, so that they do the things that they should not do.

dag: Ŋmɛnditɔya ni ti liri Gaad, amaa o ni ti kari doli ba ti fa bɛ nɛma.
en: Gad will be attacked by attackers, but hell attack their back.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa wuɣi lans ayi din nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri ka mali zoligo bansi niŋ li n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpila din tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu la. Daantaliga kam daa malila di laŋa.
en: The top of each column was decorated with a design of interwoven chains.

dag: dindina yin zomiya takɔbi dabiɛm, dama suhuyiɣisili tahiri tibidarigibo din nyɛ takɔbi na ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni sariakaribo din tuhi beni.
en: But watch out for the judgment, when God will punish you!.

dag: Hashabia ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛmuɛl bia la n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni kpɛma. Aduna zuliya ni, Zadok n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma;.
en: for the Levites—Hashabiah, Kemuels son; for Aaron—Zadok.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa, ka kpahi Pita zuɣu ni yɛli, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! Dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, then sternly corrected Peter: Get behind me, Satan. You are not thinking Gods thoughts but human thoughts.

dag: Ka di ni daa ti miig o pam saha shɛli ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, bidibiga n-lan bala.
en: She was having a lot of trouble with this birth. She was in great pain. When her nurse saw this, she said, Dont be afraid, Rachel. You are giving birth to another son.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ lɛbihi mini matarikanima n-saɣim bɛ ni kpe dari mali binshɛŋa la zaa.
en: Using axes and hatchets, they smashed the carved panels inside.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi salo maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi n-kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa? M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma.
en: Then Jesus said to the crowds, Have you come with swords and clubs to arrest me, like a thief? Day after day, I sat in the temple teaching, but you didnt arrest me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yɛlim ba, Di chaŋya ti tuhi ba, dama n ku be yi sani, di yi pa lala yi dimnim maa ni nyaŋ ya. .
en: But the Lord said to me, Warn them not to attack, for I will not be with them, and their enemies will defeat them.

dag: Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla, o daa chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋla tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: David heard what was happening, and he sent out Joab with his army.

dag: O nuu din mali kpiɔŋ min o bɔɣu ka o daa teei yihi ba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka niriba daa tumdi alahichi nimaani, ka chɛ dabisili kam sara maligu maŋli malibu, ka bɛ daa daai yɛlimaŋli luhi. Ka yilli maa daa kul diri nasara di ni tumdi shɛlikam ni.
en: People sinned there instead of offering the proper daily sacrifices, and true religion was thrown to the ground. The horn was successful in everything it did.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Libina mini Ɛta ni Ashan.
en: There were also Libnah, Ether, Ashan.

dag: Karimbaani tahirila saɣiŋgu na, ka maŋduhibu mi tahiri lubu na.
en: Pride leads to destruction, and arrogance to downfall.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa bɔri ni n laɣim n niriba, amaa ka bɛ daa ŋmanila wain tia din ka wala bee fiig tia din ka wala, hal bɛ ŋmanila tia din vari suui. N ni daa zaŋ binshɛli ti ba la faaya ka chɛ ba.
en: I wanted to gather my people, as a farmer gathers a harvest; but they are like a vine with no grapes, like a fig tree with no figs; even the leaves have withered. Therefore, I have allowed outsiders to take over the land.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti laɣim gbariti, ka laɣim n ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la mini n ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili la.
en: On that day, says the LORD, I will gather the lame; I will assemble those who were driven away and those whom I have harmed.

dag: N tɛha ni daa labi n ni na saha shɛli maa, ka n jilima mini n dariza ni n nam maa tibiginsim gba daa lan labi n sanna. Ka n jintɔriba mini n kpambaliba daa lan deei ma, ka n nam maa yiko mini di jilima din gari di ni daa pun be shɛm lan labi n sanna.
en: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o yi ku yiɣisi zaŋ li ti o o min o simdi maa zuɣu, amaa o nimmoo suhigu maa zuɣu o ni yiɣisi zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa ti o.
en: I tell you, maybe friendship is not enough to make him get up to give you the bread. But he will surely get up to give you what you need if you continue to ask.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe siliga maa ni nti nya ka nachimbil so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒi bɛ nudirigu polo, ka di gari ba pam.
en: So they entered the tomb, where they saw a young man sitting at the right, wearing a white robe—and they were alarmed.

dag: Ka din niŋ ba maa wuhiya ni yɛliŋahili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ŋahili maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Baa labi dir o tiri, ka bɛ ni su kuruchu so kom mi lan ŋmaligi labi ti bilindi baɣiri ni yaha.
en: What happened to them shows that the proverbs are true: A dog goes back to what it has vomited and A pig that has been washed goes back to roll in the mud.

dag: N ni ti yɛn chɛ a yiŋ ŋɔ ni do so ka o be n sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nya biɛrim o suhu ni, ka kum hal ka o nina ti fulim, ka niriba ti zaŋ takɔbi ku a yiŋnim zaa.
en: If I let anyone from your family be a priest, his life will be full of sadness and sorrow. But most of the men in your family will die a violent death!.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina yi tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka biɛhiŋ kani, yi daalahichi maa ku chɛn ya.
en: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.

dag: Amaa n zaŋla Lɛvinim maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bikpamba zaa.
en: I have taken the Levites in place of all the oldest among the Israelites.

dag: Amaa ka kɔnyuri daa wum ba pam nimaani, ka bɛ ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka a yihi ti Ijipti na ni kɔnyuri ti ku ti mini ti bihi ni ti biŋkɔbiri.
en: But the people were very thirsty and continued to complain to Moses. They said, Why did you bring us out of Egypt? To kill us and our children and our livestock with thirst.

dag: Ka yi daa lan zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-kɔhi Giriikinim zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒi ba chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.

dag: Ka Maata daa paai Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi;.
en: Martha said to Jesus, If you had been here, Lord, my brother would not have died!.

dag: hal ka bɛ je ni bɛ zaŋ li bahi, ka zaŋ li gbabi bɛ noya maa zaa yoli.
en: they like it, wont let it go; they hold it in their cheeks.

dag: Ka o daa me yiya Millo polo hal ti gil di zaa. Ka Jɔab mi daa mali tiŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din kpalim me.
en: He had the city rebuilt, starting at the landfill on the east side. Meanwhile, Joab supervised the repairs to the rest of the city.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ifriim zuliya tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti Kɔhat daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Some of the Kohathite clans had towns of their territory from the tribe of Ephraim.

dag: N ni saɣim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun viɛlim ŋmani momaha la.
en: Jerusalem, you are like a beautiful meadow. But I will destroy you!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: The Lord said to Satan, Where have you been? Satan answered the Lord , I have been roaming around the earth, going from place to place.

dag: Yihim ma n suhuyubu alahichi tumbu ni; ka di chɛ ka di su ma. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n ku mali galimi, ka yi taali din galisi pam ni.
en: Keep me safe, also, from willful sins; don't let them rule over me. Then I shall be perfect and free from the evil of sin.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka o yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: So they answered Jesus, We don't know. And he said to them, Neither will I tell you, then, by what right I do these things.

dag: Yawɛ alibarika ni yi Ziɔn na paag a. Naawuni chɛ ka a nya Jɛrusalɛm tɔŋbu a dunia yili bebu ni zaa.
en: May the Lord bless you from Zion! May you see Jerusalem prosper all the days of your life!.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ka dɔro maa niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, o zuɣu ni hal ni o naba ni, ka maligumaana maa nya li.
en: But if the skin disease continues to break out so that the disease covers all of the infected persons skin from head to toe, as far as the priest can tell.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa pii kuɣili sa nimaani ni di nyɛ din teeri ba.
en: So Jacob found a large rock and put it there to show that he had made an agreement.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa na be n sani, ka m bihi na be n san la.
en: God All-Powerful was still with me then, and my children were all around me.

dag: A yi kpahi ninvuɣ so ŋun tahiri woligibu na zuɣu ni yim nti lan pahi buyi ka o bi taɣi, nyin di lan kal o pahi yi kalinli ni.
en: Give at least two warnings to those who cause divisions, and then have nothing more to do with them.

dag: Ka yi suhi yi Naawuni maa, ka n gba suhi Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so ŋun chɛ ka buɣim taai nimdi maa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka Niriba maa zaa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla.
en: The prophets of Baal will pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord . The one who answers by starting the fire is God. That's a good idea, everyone agreed.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka tirisi tooni biɛla ha kaman nira ni ni tooi lab kuɣili paai shɛl tariga nti gbani tiŋa n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra.
en: Then Jesus went about steps away from them. He knelt down and prayed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yi o zuɣu mɔɣu ni kulibɔn shɛli din daa be Shur soli polo.
en: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring of water in the desert. The spring was by the road to Shur.

dag: Hal jɛra yi doli soli, bɛ bi tumdi yɛm tuma, bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋdi ni bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: Fools show their stupidity by the way they live; it's easy to see they have no sense.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa wuhi ma machɛlinim anahi.
en: The Lord showed me four workers.

dag: Ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nina mini sagbana ni kɔsoya daa ŋari; ka saa chɛ mibu.
en: The outlets of the water beneath the earth and the floodgates of the sky were closed. The rain stopped.

dag: Dauda yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihita ka o naanyi di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi.
en: David was years old when he became king, and he ruled for years.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina saha shɛli ka Yisa kana ti ʒe teeku duli, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa na bi baŋ ni ŋun Yisa m-bala.
en: As the sun was rising, Jesus stood at the water's edge, but the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.

dag: Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ. Masia cheechinim zaa puhiri ya.
en: Greet one another with the kiss of peace. All the churches of Christ send you their greetings.

dag: Naawuni, tim ma suhu yini, ka ti ma tɛh pala din tuhi n suhu ni.
en: Create a clean heart for me, God; put a new, faithful spirit deep inside me!.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tuhi bɛn be tiŋ maa puuni hal ti luhi wuntaŋa n-daa ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, ka ku niriba bɛn be di ni, ka niŋ yalim bahi tiŋ maa tiŋgbani zaa zuɣu.
en: Abimelech and his men fought against the city of Shechem all that day. They captured the city of Shechem and killed its people. Then Abimelech tore down the city and threw salt over the ruins.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N sara maligu dabisili maa dali, n ni ti darigi kpambaliba mini nabihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri tinduya ni binyɛra la tibili.
en: On the day of the LORDs sacrifice, I will punish the princes, the kings sons, and all those wearing foreign clothes.

dag: Di saha maa ka naa daa bahi Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya noli, ka o chaŋ ti ŋme Shimɛi luhi ka o kpi. Di saha ka nam maa daa nya zaashee zani Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: Benaiah, Solomon shouted, kill Shimei. So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.

dag: Daadam, fabilim Taai naa zuɣu ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini n-daa nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri din ka galimi ka mali baŋsim pam, ka viɛl zaa.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, sing a funeral song for the king of Tyre and tell him I am saying: At one time, you were perfect, intelligent, and good-looking.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o dab paɣa ti do so, ka bɛ na bi yo o zuɣu bee ka dab paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni, ka o dan maa lan zaŋ o dɔni, di simdi ka bɛ vihi yɛlli maa. Di bi simdi ka bɛ ku ba, dama paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni.
en: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.

dag: Di bi simdi ka naa ti deei niriba maa tiŋgbani ka kari ba di ni. O ti zaŋmi omaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgban shɛli ti o bidibisi din ni chɛ ka n niriba ni so ti ku kɔŋ o tiŋgbani.
en: The ruler must never abuse my people by taking land from them. Any land he gives his children must already belong to him.

dag: Dama a piɛma nyɔɣ ma n-kpe nti lim, ka a zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma.
en: Your arrows have pierced me; your fist has come down hard on me.

dag: Ka so yi do m-baɣ o ka ti kpi n-libig o, ka di chɛ ka o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa bi lan be kasi, dindina ŋun pinim o zuɣu maa o ni ti yɛn yi daɣiri ni dahin shɛli. O pinim li daba ayopɔin dali.
en: So if you are with someone when they suddenly die, you will be unclean and you will have to shave the hair from your head. You must do that on the seventh day of your purification ceremony when you are made clean.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya suhukpeeni, dama n niŋ Naawuni yɛda ni o ni chɛ ka o malaika maa yɛli ma shɛm maa shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: Be encouraged, men! I have faith in God that it will be exactly as he told me.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zani naŋgban yini yɛli, Ti ni so ku lab kul o tanti ni bee o yiŋa.
en: The whole army was in agreement, and they said, None of us will go home.

dag: nti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yiliya la tooni.
en: The priest will dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD toward the inner curtain.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi kpe ŋɔ mini ninsalinim ni biŋkɔbiri ni puri ni tihi ni tiŋgbani atam zuɣu. N suhuyiɣisili maa ni bemi kaman buɣim la, ka so ku tooi kpihi li.
en: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A ba ka alaafee; ka o daa zaŋ o bidibis ayi la, Manaasa mini Ifriim chaŋ o sani.
en: Some time later Joseph was told that his father was ill. So he took his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, and went to see Jacob.

dag: N tiliginsim mini n jilima yirila Naawuni sanna; ŋuna n-nyɛ n gula ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: My victory and honor come from God. He is the mighty Rock, where I am safe.

dag: Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ wuh o ti shɛli wulli ka o daa zaŋ li na ti lɔhi kom maa ni, ka di niŋ nyaɣisim. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa zali ba zaligu, ka zahim ba.
en: So Moses called to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a large piece of wood. When Moses put the wood in the water, the water became good to drink. There the Lord put in place a law and a command for him and tested him to see if he would obey.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ Naawuni n-kul sɔŋdi ma, dinzuɣu ka n ʒe kpe n-diri di shɛhira wɔɣira mini tarimba sani n-kul yɛrila Anabi Musa min anabinim ni daa yɛli ni shɛli ni ti niŋ pali la yɛla kɔŋko.
en: But all this time God has helped me, and I have preached both to the rich and to the poor. I have told them only what the prophets and Moses said would happen.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbani maa zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo mi daa kpuɣi Tapua m-mali hal ti paai Kana kulibɔŋ n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai di tariga Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dina n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim min o daŋ niriba ni bɛ su la.
en: From Tappuah the border goes westward by the Kanah Valley. It ends at the sea. This is the legacy for the clans of the Ephraimite tribe.

dag: Din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu ni na nyɛla: Yurilim mini suhupiɛlli ni suhudoo ni suɣilɔdibo ni nirilimtali ni zaɣisuntali ni ʒiɛyimtali ni.
en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii Lɛvi zuliya niriba zali ni bɛ ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa, ka zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka zaŋd o yuli niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: At that time the Lord appointed the men of the tribe of Levi to be in charge of the Covenant Box, to serve him as priests, and to pronounce blessings in his name. And these are still their duties.

dag: Amaa ti daa bi chaŋ miri Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni zaŋ tabili Jabok kulibɔŋ dul la mini fɔntin shɛli din daa be zoya tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: But you didnt go near the Ammonite lands or hillside cities alongside the Jabbok River, in compliance with all that the LORD our God had commanded.

dag: Ka o yi mali luɣ kasi shee maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni sara maligu bimbini maa ka di be kasi naai, ŋun zaŋm bu nɛɔŋ la na.
en: When Aaron has finished performing the ritual to purify the Most Holy Place, the rest of the Tent of the Lord 's presence, and the altar, he shall present to the Lord the live goat chosen for Azazel.

dag: Ti bi ŋmaligi ti suhuri ka chɛ a; ti mi bi birigi ka chɛ a soli.
en: Our hearts havent turned away, neither have our steps strayed from your way.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Judas, puhigu mini kpariŋ mɔɣisibu ka a yɛn zaŋ yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa.
en: Jesus asked Judas, Are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, So yi lan yɛl a shɛli, nyin tahim o n sanna, ka o ku lan tooi niŋ a shɛli yaha.
en: The king replied, If anyone threatens you, bring him to me, and he will never bother you again.

dag: Anabi Ilaija daa nyɛla ninsala kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka o daa ti suhi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa ni saa di mi, ka saa maa daa shiri bi tɔɣisi lu tiŋgbani zuɣu yuun muna ata ni pirigili.
en: Elijah was the same kind of person as we are. He prayed earnestly that there would be no rain, and no rain fell on the land for three and a half years.

dag: O ni daa paɣi bɛ naba maa naai, ka o zaŋ o kparibu ye n-lab ti ʒini ka bɔhi ba, Yi baŋ n ni niŋ ya shɛm ŋɔ gbinni?.
en: When Jesus finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and went back to the table. He asked, Do you understand what I did for you?.

dag: Amaa bɛ so bi bɔhi, Naawuni ŋun nam ma, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ma yaa yuŋ ŋɔ lee be ya?.
en: But they don't turn to God, their Creator, who gives them hope in their darkest hours.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi Yawɛ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛ bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli, bɛ mi bi mi ni o laɣim ba mi kaman kabɔba ka bɛ lo n-sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni la.
en: But they don't know that I, the Lord , have gathered them here to grind them like grain.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me o tɔbutuhiri bimbina tabili yi goma, ka zaŋ kpandi wurim yi binwɔɣila.
en: He will command some of his troops to use large wooden poles to beat down your walls, while others use iron rods to knock down your watchtowers.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yisifu ni tɔɣisi ba n-yɛl o, ka o nya tɔroko shɛŋa Yisifu ni daa zaŋ ti na ni bɛ ti kpuɣ o na la, ka o suhu daa kpaŋ;.
en: When they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the wagons Joseph had sent to carry him, Jacob recovered.

dag: Tɔbaya ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la daa ʒiɛmi tab o, ka gba daa yɛli, Kuɣa goon shɛli bɛ ni mɛri maa, hal ŋɔɣu yi du n-tam di zuɣu, o ni daai li luhi.
en: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim na kul mali duŋ ni Dauda yilinim hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: And so Israel has been in rebellion against Davids dynasty to this day.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa zaŋ Yisa n-tahi mɔɣu ni ni Sintani ti zahim o.
en: Then the Spirit led Jesus up into the wilderness so that the devil might tempt him.

dag: Hal ka daa ti lo ni o ta Naawuni jɛmbu duu daɣiri, ka ti daa gbaag o. Ti daa naan tooi doli ti zaligu soli n-kar o saria.
en: He also tried to defile the Temple, and we arrested him.

dag: A ni kul yiɣisina, a na mi n-zali asiba di ni yɛn piligi saha shɛli? Ka chɛ ka biɛɣu neebu mi di biɛhigu shee?.
en: Job, have you ever in all your life commanded a day to dawn?.

dag: bee n-zaŋ o nuu ŋme o dim ku o, dindina ŋun ŋme o maa nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, ka ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa yi nya ninvuɣ kura maa, ŋun kum o.
en: or by striking him with your fist, you are guilty of murder and are to be put to death. The dead person's nearest relative has the responsibility for putting the murderer to death. When he finds you, he is to kill you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii shɛb maa n-daa nyɛ: Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria. Bɛ mi zaa daa yi la Juda zuliya ni na.
en: Among those young men were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim saha shɛli maa, ka Giliad kpamba daa chaŋ Tɔb tiŋgban ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ Jɛfita na.
en: The Ammonites were fighting against Israel, so the elders in Gilead went to Jephthah. They wanted Jephthah to leave the land of Tob and come back to Gilead.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o nuu tim o koligu ni yihi kuɣili niŋ o kuɣilɔŋ ni n-zaŋ labi Filistia doo maa gbɛɣu, ka kuɣili maa chaŋ ti firi o gbɛɣu maa ni, ka o lu m-pil o puli zuɣu, ka o nini kpa tiŋa.
en: David took out a stone from his bag. He put it in his sling and swung the sling. The stone flew from the sling and hit Goliath right between the eyes. The stone sank deep into his head, and Goliath fell to the ground—face down.

dag: Bɛ ni voo li to ba ka di pili yi bɛ niŋgbuna ni. Ka di naŋgban dirili maa pili yi bɛ binsom ni; ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyɛra ni ka ni tooi zaŋ dari kpe m-mali nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuuni kam.
en: cut stones for setting, carve wood, do every kind of creative work.

dag: Yihimiya ansarisimaana yi kɔbili ni, ka zabili naai, ka naŋgbankpeeni mini turi chɛ.
en: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi la daa ti binnani maa vuhim hal ka binnani maa ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa gba, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi binnani maa jɛmbu.
en: It was allowed to give breath to the beasts image so that the beasts image would even speak and cause anyone who didnt worship the beasts image to be put to death.

dag: Bɛ daa kana nti liri ma la n ni daa be muɣisigu ni dahin shɛli; amaa ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ dalim Yawɛ.
en: They came at me on the very day of my distress, but the LORD was my support.

dag: Suhudoo din lɔn ya tabili tab la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye naŋgban yini malibu shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu.
en: Do your best to preserve the unity which the Spirit gives by means of the peace that binds you together.

dag: Amaa Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa, ka Mɔab naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan niŋ lala ti Izraɛl naa.
en: But soon after the death of Ahab, Mesha rebelled against Israel.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba laɣim to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: Early the next morning, all the leading priests and older leaders of the people met and decided to kill Jesus.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba zuɣu, di bi lan kpa ni sara maligu din ni kpihim alahichi mali yaha.
en: So when these have been forgiven, an offering to take away sins is no longer needed.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku niŋ o zo nirilim, zaŋla Kpiɔŋlan Naa zɔbu bahi.
en: Are friends loyal to the one who despairs, or do they stop fearing the Almighty?.

dag: Dama n doli Yawɛ zaligu; ka na ʒi m-birigi zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni maa sani.
en: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.

dag: Pateesa shɛŋa din zaa daa yili gili lɔndo maa daa nyɛla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli.
en: All the curtains around the enclosure were made of fine linen.

dag: Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa zaa din be kasi puuni bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛlikam ti maligumaana, di nyɛla o dini.
en: If any of you Israelites gives a special gift to God, the priest who accepts that gift can keep it for himself.

dag: Naawuni, n suhu kul ʒiɛla yim. N ni yili yila ni kukoli viɛlli. N shia, neema!.
en: My heart is unwavering, God. I will sing and make music— yes, with my whole being!.

dag: dama binshɛɣukam din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ mini din tuhi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yirila neesim ni na.
en: for it is the light that brings a rich harvest of every kind of goodness, righteousness, and truth.

dag: Ka Zakaria mini Aziɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhiɛl ni Unni ni Ɛliab ni Maasɛya ni Bɛnaaya daa nyɛ bɛn ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim kaman Alamɔt ŋmɛbu la.
en: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah played the alamoth harps.

dag: N zaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ yiŋa, ka zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din ka kulim ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: I gave them the desert to be their home, and let them live on the salt plains.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa bi saɣi shɛli o sani. O bi lihi ba ka bɛ nyɛ shɛli o sani.
en: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa bɔh o mabihi maa, Ti yi ku ti tizo ŋɔ ka wuhi ni pa tinima n-ku o, nyɔ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya di ni?.
en: So Judah said, What will we gain if we kill our brother and hide his body?.

dag: Dama naa ni wum n fabila maa ka fa m mini m bia ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔr ni o ku ti n-kpihim ti birili Naawuni ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni la nuu ni bahi.
en: I thought you would listen to me and save me from the one who is trying to kill my son and me and so remove us from the land God gave his people.

dag: Amaa a ba Dauda zuɣu, n ku niŋ li a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, n ni ti darigi deei nam maa la a bia nuu ni.
en: Even so, on account of your father David, I wont do it during your lifetime. I will tear the kingdom out of your sons hands.

dag: O kari ma bahi zibisim ni, ka neesim shɛli kani.
en: He drove me away, forced me to walk in darkness, not light.

dag: N yɛli noli tin ya, dama yi zuliya maa zaa fari ma mi.
en: A curse is on all of you because the whole nation is cheating me.

dag: Amaa ka Jona suhu daa miligi pam, ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: But Jonah thought this was utterly wrong, and he became angry.

dag: Ka dunia zuliya kam ni be di neesim maa ni chana; ka dunia ŋɔ nanim ni zaŋ bɛ jilima na nti kpe di ni.
en: The peoples of the world will walk by the light given by the Lamb. The rulers of the earth will bring their glory into the city.

dag: ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ salima alali, ka o zaŋ matarika kuri li.
en: The buds, the branches, and the lampstand were a single piece of pure hammered gold.

dag: Yawɛ niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti yili yila kpe Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ nandahima ni ti naai, ka bɛ leei bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: They will reach Jerusalem with gladness, singing and shouting for joy. They will be happy forever, forever free from sorrow and grief.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maa naai, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni.
en: When David had finished offering the entirely burned offerings and the well-being sacrifices, he blessed the people in the LORDs name.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni wum o yɛligu ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ? M bi mi Yawɛ maa, dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: But Pharaoh said, Who is this LORD whom Im supposed to obey by letting Israel go? I dont know this LORD, and I certainly wont let Israel go.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa yuri Jɛrusalɛm, maliya suhupiɛlli di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn zaa fabindi di zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli pam!.
en: Rejoice with Jerusalem; be glad for her, all you that love this city! Rejoice with her now, all you that have mourned for her!.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-zaŋ so, amaa di zaŋ li tim kom ni.
en: The LORD proclaimed to me: Go and buy a linen undergarment. Wear it for a while without washing it.

dag: ni pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yiini ni mini di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini dundɔŋ maa dunoli.
en: the courtyards drapes, its posts, and its bases, and the screen for the courtyard gate.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, n ni zaŋ ba Bashan n-labisi kpe na. N ni yihi ba teeku bulli ni na.
en: My Lord has spoken: From Bashan I will bring those people back. I will bring them back from the oceans depths.

dag: ka tiri kum ni kuri shɛb bindira, ka tiri nandaamba bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli, dindina yi neesim ni neei zibisim ni m-be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim la.
en: Feel sorry for hungry people and give them food. Help those who are troubled and satisfy their needs. Then your light will shine in the darkness. You will be like the bright sunshine at noon.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Viligim a baŋtabiga, ka piligi a nam zuɣupiligu. Binyara bi la yɛn be kaman di ni daa be shɛm. Duhimiya tarimba, ka siɣisi bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa.
en: I, the Lord God, command you to take off your royal turban and your crown, because everything will be different. Those who had no power will be put in charge, and those who now rule will become nobodies.

dag: Di simdi ni di ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛi, ka di mini di binyila zaa ti nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini.
en: Make it centimeters square and centimeters high, and make each of its four corners stick up like the horn of a bull.

dag: Ka Musa daa shiri kpuɣi jaaŋgbee maa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: Moses went and got the stick, as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Yɛl yini n-kul paari sokam zaa. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl biɛɣu din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Din pahi nyɛla, zaɣ biɛɣu n-kul pali sokam zaa suhu ni. Yinyari biɛhigu n-kul be bɛ suhuri ni bɛ biɛhigu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ kpi.
en: This is the sad thing about all that happens under the sun: the same fate awaits everyone. Moreover, the human heart is full of evil; peoples minds are full of madness while they are alive, and afterward they die.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔŋ mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di puuni zaa gili ni di zɔntua ni. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was meters long and . meters wide.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi yɛligu niŋ pali. Di ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal o kɔb yini gba ti ku kabi.
en: This was done to make the scripture come true: Not one of his bones will be broken.

dag: Mbusim be n zuɣu, n ni nya biɛrim shɛli zuɣu. N daŋ maa yaɣiya! Amaa ka n yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n tibidarigibo m-bala, di kpala talahi ni n deei li.
en: How terrible for me, due to my injury; my wound is terrible. Yet I said to myself: This is my sickness, and I must bear it.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Lɛvi zuliya niriba maa zaa ti ku mali tarili bee fali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ ni ti dirila sara binshɛŋa din nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord .

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa yi ni pun mi la zuɣu ka n niŋ suhukpeeni n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n teei ya di yɛla. Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni la zuɣu.
en: But I have written to you very openly about some things that I wanted you to remember. I did this because God gave me this special gift:.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni. Doliya n zalikpana la, ka gbibiya n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I reminded them that I was the Lord their God and that they should obey my laws and teachings.

dag: amaa ka Ammɔn nabihi daa yɛli bɛ dan Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim tuumba na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ka o be a maa? Dauda timla niriba ŋɔ na ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ yaŋɔ daashili zaa ka tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: But the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, their lord, Do you think that David is trying to honor your father by sending some men to comfort you? No, David sent these men to spy on your city. They plan to make war against you.

dag: N dimnim kul lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. Bɛ bɔrimi ni n kpi ka n yuli gba kpi m-pahi.
en: My vicious enemies ask me, When will you die and be forgotten.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Nyama, Itiɔpia Naa Tirihaka lola tɔbu kanna ni o ti tuh a. Ka o daa sabi gbaŋ lan tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani n-yɛli ba.
en: Then the Assyrian king learned that Cushs King Tirhakah was on his way to fight against him. So he sent messengers to Hezekiah again, saying.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ o sani nti fiɣisi Pool, ka balim o.
en: where the chief priests and the Jewish leaders brought their charges against Paul. They begged Festus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Arinɔn Mɔɣili yaɣili yɔ shɛli din zaŋ hal ni Amɔrinim tintariga la ni; dama Arinɔn Mɔɣili n-nyɛ Mɔabnim tintariga m-be Mɔabnim mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: Then they moved and camped across from the Arnon River in the desert. This river started at the Ammonite border. The valley was the border between Moab and the Amorites.

dag: M biyurigu, di chɛ ka a bebu doli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa chɛ ka a bebu dolila din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyɛla ŋun mi Naawuni, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyɛla ŋun ʒi Naawuni.
en: Dear friend, dont imitate what is bad but what is good. Whoever practices what is good belongs to God. Whoever practices what is bad has not seen God.

dag: Niriba anahi bɛn daa nyɛ kɔnsi daa do Samaria sambani polo dunol shee. Ka bɛ daa ti bɔhi taba, Bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ʒi kpe hal ti kpi?.
en: Four men who were suffering from a dreaded skin disease were outside the gates of Samaria, and they said to each other, Why should we wait here until we die?.

dag: O daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, M biɛli Iso yi ti tuhi ya soli bɔhi ya, Ŋuni n-lee sun ya? Ka ya polo ka yi lee chana? Ka ŋuni n-lee su biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ.
en: He ordered the first group, When my brother Esau meets you and asks you, Who are you with? Where are you going? And whose herds are these in front of you.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni duh a ka paɣ a yuli. A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, a pal a ni daa pun lo nia shɛŋa kurimbuni ha, ka di mali alahiziba la.
en: LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you; I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, planned long ago, faithful and sure.

dag: ka kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ ko viɛlli din be yaɣiri duɣu ni.
en: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, If any of you want to come with me, you must forget yourself, carry your cross, and follow me.

dag: Sisɛra daa suh o la kom, amaa ka o ti o la bihim; o daa zaŋ bihim maa niŋla pipi viɛli ni na ti ti o.
en: He asked for water, and she provided milk; she presented him cream in a majestic bowl.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa ku maai, faashee o niŋla o ni lo o suhu ni ni o niŋ shɛli maa. Dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ka yi ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.

dag: Dama o yurilim maŋli la galisiya pam zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka o ʒiɛyimtali kul ni beni sahakam. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He loves us very much! The Lord will be faithful to us forever! Praise the Lord !.

dag: N lan zali zaligu ni so yi taɣi zaligu ŋɔ, bɛn darigim ŋooi ŋun tum taali maa yiŋ yɔɣirili n-zaŋ li sa n-zaŋ o yil li, ka o yiŋ zani dabɔɣu.
en: I also decree that if anyone disobeys this edict, a beam is to be pulled out of the house of the guilty party, and the guilty party will then be impaled upon it. The house will be turned into a trash heap.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ nɛ karili lo n-yili dilan nyiŋgoli n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni, di naan so o zuɣu gar o chɛ ka bibihi ŋɔ ni yino birigi.
en: It would be better for them to be thrown into a lake with a large stone hung around their neck than to cause one of these little ones to trip and fall into sin.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ Ninivenim dini. Nahum ŋun nyɛ Ɛlikɔsh nir la ni daa nya ʒii shɛli litaafi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is a message about Nineveh, the account of a vision seen by Nahum, who was from Elkosh.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Nakɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣila shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, di saha ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali.
en: As they came to the threshing place of Nacon, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the Covenant Box.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛl o, Zaŋm a bigaŋ Yisahaku so a ni yuri pam la n-chaŋ Mɔria tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la nimaani n ni ti yɛn wuh a zo shɛli zuɣu.
en: Take your son, God said, your only son, Isaac, whom you love so much, and go to the land of Moriah. There on a mountain that I will show you, offer him as a sacrifice to me.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wumdi yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ a suhu niŋ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Turn your ear toward wisdom, and stretch your mind toward understanding.

dag: ni Hɛlikat ni Rɛhɔb ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Helkath, and Rehob. In all, Asher gave them four towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa yɛli, Malimiya n chɛchɛbuŋ shili ti ma. Ka bɛ mal li shili ti o. Di saha ka ŋun Izraɛl Naa Jɔram mini Juda Naa Ahazia daa kpe bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli n-daa mali ti tuh o soli maa la Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ni.
en: Get my chariot ready, King Joram ordered. It was done, and he and King Ahaziah rode out, each in his own chariot, to meet Jehu. They met him at the field which had belonged to Naboth.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ lala, ka daa bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣiri na nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, ka zaŋ naɣibihi maa niŋ duu n-yo ba niŋ di ni.
en: The Philistines followed their advice. They hitched up the two cows to the cart, but they kept their calves in a barn.

dag: Bɛ daa vihiya ni bɛ nya bɛ yuya be maligumaaniba yaannim yuya maa ni, amaa ka di daa kani. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa wuhi ni bɛ bi be kasi, ka yihi ba maligumaaniba ni.
en: looked for their entries in the genealogical records, but they werent found there, so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim maa daa yili yilli ŋɔ m-paɣiri Yawɛ yɛra: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima; o daai wɔribara min o wɔhu niŋ teeku ni.
en: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: I will sing to the LORD, for an overflowing victory! Horse and rider he threw into the sea!.

dag: Absalom daa niŋ yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm ka o nini bi nya naa.
en: Absalom lived in Jerusalem for two years without seeing his father.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: Then Pilate said, Dont you hear the testimony they bring against you.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya lee yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiy o na.
en: Jesus answered, You people today dont believe! How long must I stay with you? How long must I be patient with you? Bring the boy to me.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi nya Yawɛ dabisili la zuɣu. Zaɣ viɛl bɔ ka Yawɛ dabisili maa yɛn tum ya? Di yɛn nyɛla zibisim dabisili, ka pa ni neesim dabisili.
en: Some of you want to see the Lord s special day of judgment. Why do you want to see that day of the Lord ? His special day will bring darkness, not light.

dag: Chɛ ka n wumd a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba kam; dama nyini ka n niŋ naani. N suhir a, wuhim ma n ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda.
en: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi, dama so kani m-be ka nyini, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani m-pah a zuɣu kaman ti ni wum shɛm ti tiba ni.
en: How great you are, Sovereign Lord ! There is none like you; we have always known that you alone are God.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o pam; dama Gibiɔn daa nyɛla tin titali kaman tin titali kam din mali naa. Di daa galisi gari Ai, ka di dɔbba mali kpiɔŋ.
en: So Adoni Zedek and his people were very frightened. Gibeon was not a small town like Ai. It was a very big city—as big as any royal city. And all the men in that city were good fighters, so the king was afraid.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Bɛlishaaza nam dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa zahim zahindi n dooshee n-nya ʒii yuŋ, ka sabi zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ.
en: In the first year of Babylons King Belshazzar, Daniel had a dream—a vision in his head as he lay on his bed. He wrote the dream down. Here is the beginning of the account.

dag: Ka daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa ko n-nya bindirigu pam.
en: So Jesus told them this story: A rich man's farm produced a big crop.

dag: O bi zaŋdi bini din ni saɣim siŋkaafa buri li. O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ naɣikɔra tɔroko kpe di ni no li ka di biɛlim ku bɔɣi.
en: Bread grain is crushed, but the thresher doesnt thresh it forever. He drives the cart wheel over it; he spreads it out but doesnt crush it.

dag: Di saha ka nyaandol so ŋun daa daŋ siliga maa gbini paabu la gba kpe di ni nti nya ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Then the other disciple, the one who arrived at the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra, ka Mɛmfisi nabihi nyɛ bɛn yɔhindi niriba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri birigi Ijiptinima.
en: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa ti tuma ŋɔ kɔŋko n-yɛn be barina ni, amaa Aritɛmis ŋun nyɛ ti buɣ titali, ka Ɛshanim mini dunia zaa jɛmd o la jɛmbu duu nti yɛn kpalim yoli, hal di pa shɛli ka buɣili Aritɛmis maŋmaŋ gba ti kɔŋ jilima sokam sani.
en: Everyone will start saying terrible things about our business. They will stop respecting the temple of the goddess Artemis, who is worshiped in Asia and all over the world. Our great goddess will be forgotten!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa kuli Rama, ka Sool gba kul o ya Gibia.
en: Then Samuel left and went to Ramah. And Saul went up to his home in Gibeah.

dag: ka yi ti yɛli yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min nyaandoliba yɛn ʒini m-puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: and say to the owner of the house: The Teacher says to you, Where is the room where my disciples and I will eat the Passover meal.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kab chaŋ bɛ ni daa tuhi fa neen shɛŋa maa gbini nti kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi ni naɣinyama sɔŋ, ka niriba maa daa ŋub ba, bɛ mi daa bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So the troops tore into the plunder, taking sheep, cattle, and calves. They slaughtered them right on the ground and devoured them with the blood still in them.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: All the other things that Josiah did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Alikauli maa zuɣu ka ti zuliya pinaayi jɛmdi Naawuni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka mali tahima ni ti ti nya di palibu. Naa, tahima maa zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim ŋmari ma tiŋŋmaŋ maa.
en: This is the promise that all the twelve tribes of our people hope to receive. For this hope the Jews serve God day and night. My king, the Jews have accused me because I hope for this same promise.

dag: Bɛ daa lan malila ninsal nuhi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔŋni bɛ luɣa anahinahi zuɣu. Bɛba anahi maa ninani mini bɛ kpiŋkpama maa ni daa be shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Human hands were under their wings on all four sides. All four creatures had faces and wings, and.

dag: ni ago sabilifaa ni ago ʒiɛkpeein ni ago ʒiɛkpain ni ago piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: blue, purple, and deep red yarns; fine linen; goats hair.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daamiy o bahina. Ka bɛ daa daai Jɛzibɛl bahina, ka o ʒim yiɣ vie dukpini mini yuri, ka bɛ du n-tam o zuɣu n-nɔnno o.
en: and Jehu shouted, Throw her out the window! They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.

dag: ka n yi daa mali suhupiɛlli m buni ni galisi pam zuɣu, bee n ni zaŋ n nuhi tum tuma n-nya binshɛli pam zuɣu.
en: or taken pride in owning many possessions. *.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni yi mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa beni n-nyɛla ŋun chani gbinfini ka ka bindirigu din ni di.
en: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food.

dag: Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla tiŋŋmara ni ninvuɣ tuɣinda Yɛhudianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka lan nyɛ bɛ ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb Nazarinim la adiini soli toondana.
en: This man is a troublemaker. He causes trouble with the Jews everywhere in the world. He is a leader of the Nazarene group.

dag: Dindali maa, Izraɛlnim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka kɔɣisi yi fini zaa.
en: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.

dag: A mi di bi puhi ma ka mɔɣisi n kpariŋ kaman ti kali ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa n ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na hal ni wayo, paɣ ŋɔ na bi chɛ n naba bɔbilibu.
en: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.

dag: Ka naa daa ti yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi dan kpambaliba m-pahi yimaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ba mmaŋmaŋ buntaaŋa la, ka yi zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: he said to them, Take my court officials with you; have my son Solomon ride my own mule, and escort him down to Gihon Spring.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam. N nam yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nam, n niriba naan zabi n zuɣu ka so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni. Amaa n nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam.
en: Jesus replied, My kingdom doesnt originate from this world. If it did, my guards would fight so that I wouldnt have been arrested by the Jewish leaders. My kingdom isnt from here.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, tinim tɔɣisirila ti ni mi shɛli yɛla, ka diri ti nini ni nya shɛli shɛhira; amaa ka yi bi niŋdi ti shɛhira maa yɛda.
en: I tell you for certain we know what we are talking about because we have seen it ourselves. But none of you will accept what we say.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu a ni, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niriba a ni solɔri zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din jɛnd a maa ku niriba luɣilikam, ka kpiimba ti do a ni, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will send deadly diseases to wipe you out, and I will send enemies to invade and surround you. Your people will be killed, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul zɔrimi, ka nyaandol ŋun maa daa zo ŋ-ŋma Pita zuɣu daŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: The two of them were running, but the other disciple ran faster than Peter and reached the tomb first.

dag: M bihi, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Ka yi ni daa pun wum ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Masiachihira ni ti kana la, hal Masiachihiriba pam pun kana gba, dinzuɣu ti baŋya ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa n-shiri bɔŋɔ.
en: Little children, it is the last hour. Just as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, so now many antichrists have appeared. This is how we know it is the last hour.

dag: ŋun zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni, ka chɛ ka n leei tumo ni n wuhi zuliya kam zaa ka bɛ deeg o noli n-niŋ yɛda o yuli zuɣu la.
en: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ zuliya la luya, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha! Bɛ chɛ ba sɔŋ tiŋa, ka so kani n-ni yiɣisi ba zali.
en: Fallen, no more to rise, is virgin Israel, deserted on her land, with no one to raise her up.

dag: ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ŋuna n-kul yɛn wuhiri ti soli sahakam.
en: Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila kɔhigɔr so ŋun gɔri bɔri waya zaɣ suma.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like what happens when a shop owner is looking for fine pearls.

dag: Ka Gadi bia Mɛnahɛm daa ti yi Tiriza n-ka Samaria na ti ŋme Jabɛshi bia Shallum maa luhi Samaria n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Menahem son of Gadi came up from Tirzah to Samaria and killed Shallum son of Jabesh. Then Menahem became the new king after him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zahim laɣ shɛli tibisim sania zuɣu n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa fukumsi ni bɛ mal li yɔri kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim bɛn tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: Then they paid the men who were in charge of the work on the Lord s Temple. They paid the carpenters and other builders who worked on the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka Judanim ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛmaŋa, Jɛrusalɛmnim malila kpiɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani. .
en: The chieftains of Judah will say to themselves, We are strong; the inhabitants of Jerusalem will say, The LORD their God of heavenly forces is strong.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi piɛguliba maa, M mabihi, ka tiŋkani ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila Haran na.
en: Jacob asked the shepherds, Where are you from? We're from Haran, they answered.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Gbɛmiya kpe, ka n sa zaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm yɛli ya. Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa gbe Balaam sani.
en: Spend the night here, Balaam replied, and tomorrow I will tell you the Lord 's answer. So the officials stayed at his house.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi la mini binnɛma anahi la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee la ka yɛra, Ami! Haliluya.
en: Then the elders and the four living beings bowed down. They worshiped God, who sits on the throne. They said, Amen! Hallelujah.

dag: N kul nɛla yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka m bɔhim a daalikaulinim yɛla.
en: My eyes encounter each hour of the night as I think about your word.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛm o o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: Magnify the LORD our God! Bow low at his holy mountain because the LORD our God is holy!.

dag: ka yɛli, N zaɣim ka m ma daa dɔɣi ma, n zaɣim ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ yi dunia ni. Yawɛ n-daa ti ma, Yawɛ n-lan deei. Yawɛ yuli simdi paɣibu.
en: He said: Naked I came from my mothers womb; naked I will return there. The LORD has given; the LORD has taken; bless the LORDs name.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni kpi. Yawɛ dimnim ni ŋmanila tipuma din viɛla. Bɛ ni vuui yom, bɛ ni vuui kaman nyɔhi la.
en: But the wicked will die; the enemies of the Lord will vanish like wild flowers; they will disappear like smoke.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam la daa wum di yɛla, ka yi Ijipti maa kuna.
en: When Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had gone to Egypt to escape from King Solomon, heard this news, he returned home.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so ti ku wuhi o kpee bee o mabia yɛra, Baŋmi ti Duuma! Sokam zaa ni ti mi ma, hal bɛn nyɛ tarimba zaŋ tabili wɔɣira.
en: Never again will anyone have to teach their neighbors or their family to know the Lord. All people—the greatest and the least important—will know me.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa ayɔbu mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side.

dag: Ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be bɛ sani maa daa kpalim be Gɛba din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Amaa ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Mikimash.
en: Saul, his son Jonathan, and the people who were with him were staying at Geba in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Michmash.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ ka n naɣ zaŋ niŋ n suhu ni, dinzuɣu ka m mali tahima:.
en: But then I think about this, and I have hope:.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Lala ka Izraɛlnim ti yɛn ŋubiri bɛ bɔrɔbɔro daɣiri n ni ti yɛn kari ba tahi zuliya shɛb ni maa sani.
en: The LORD says: In this same way the Israelites will eat their unclean bread among the nations where I am scattering them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai, ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o n-zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: When they had finished making fun of him, they took the robe off and put his own clothes back on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim maa ni daa chaŋ, n daa na mi m-bɔhi sariakaritib shɛb n ni daa pii zali ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me duu ti ma? .
en: I never told any of the tribes of Israel to build me a fancy house made from cedar wood.

dag: Ka o ni ti kpuɣi bɛ wuna mini bɛ binnana ni neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa mali n-zaŋ ti bɛ wuna la n-lab kuli Ijipti. Ka yuma biɛla din ti nyɛ suhudoo saha puuni.
en: He will take their gods and their metal idols and their expensive things made from silver and gold. He will take those things away to Egypt. Then he will not bother the northern king for a few years.

dag: A ŋmanila ŋmani ŋun be tampima voya ni. Chɛ ka n nya a ninni tampima voya maa ni. Chɛ ka n wum a kukoli, dama a kukoli viɛli pam, ka a ninni viɛli pam.
en: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa teei Reechɛl yɛla n wum o fabila ka yoog o dɔɣim soli ti o.
en: Then God heard Rachels prayer and made it possible for Rachel to have children.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa saɣim o suhu pam ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: The man was upset when Jesus told him to give away his money. He didnt want to do this, because he was very rich. So he went away sad.

dag: Kum maa ni daa mii pam maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bindira ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim gbarigi zaa.
en: The famine was bad everywhere in Egypt and Canaan, and the people were suffering terribly.

dag: Labisim li su di tɔɣu ni. N yɛn kari ya la saria n ni daa nam ya luɣ shɛl la, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yi piligu shee la ni ka n yɛn kari ya saria.
en: Return it to its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your origin, I will judge you.

dag: Ka ti zaa kul nyari anfaani din galisi n-yir o kɔbili ni na pari taba.
en: Yes, the Word was full of grace and truth, and from him we all received one blessing after another.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ daŋ shɛli niriba fali tarili n-tom ti daŋ shɛli niriba; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba vili gbibila bɛmaŋmaŋ fali tarili.
en: An inheritance of land may not be transferred from one tribe to another, for the Israelite tribes will each retain its own inheritance.

dag: Kum doli ti takɔriti ni kpe na. Di kpe ti nanim yinsi ni di ku bihi solɔri zuɣu ka ku nachimba mi zama laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Death has climbed through our windows; it has entered our fortresses to eliminate children from the streets, the youth from the squares.

dag: Wurimbu, wurimbu, n ni wurim li! Di tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Naɣila ŋun mali soli ni o su li maa ti kana, ka n zaŋ li ti o. .
en: I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ni ŋun nam ba la yɛliya, Yi ni tooi bɔhi ma bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ m bihi polo? Bee n-wuhi ma di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm?.
en: The Lord , the holy God of Israel, the one who shapes the future, says: You have no right to question me about my children or to tell me what I ought to do!.

dag: Mani n-su Giliad; mani n lan su Manaasa; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurigu zuɣupiligu din taɣiri n zuɣu, ka Juda mi nyɛ n nam kurigu jaaŋgbee.
en: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet; Judah is my scepter.

dag: Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ gahinda, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi n sani. Miriya ka yi ŋubi mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku binshɛli, di simdi ni yi zaŋ li tila bahi.
en: You are holy people to me. Dont eat any meat killed by wild animals out in the field. Throw it to the dogs instead.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka yi yɔri lampoo gba zuɣu, dama nam fukumsinim nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn tuma nyɛ ni bɛ niŋ lala.
en: You should also pay taxes for the same reason, because the authorities are Gods assistants, concerned with this very thing.

dag: Ka ti yi doli fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm, dindina ti niŋ din tuhi. .
en: Whats more, we will be considered righteous if we are careful to do all this commandment before the LORD our God, just as he commanded us.

dag: N ni yaai n noli ni suhupiɛlli saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn yili yila paɣ a. N shia din nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛl la gba ni yili yila paɣ a.
en: My lips will rejoice aloud when I make music for you; my whole being, which you saved, will do the same.

dag: Ka yi yi mali yi bina m-paŋdila ninvuɣ shɛb yi ni tɛhiri ni yi ti lan dee li bɛ sani yaha, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba paŋdila bɛ daalahichilan taba ni bɛ ti lan deei bɛ ni paŋ ba shɛm maa tariga.
en: If you lend things to people, always expecting to get something back, should you get any special praise for that? No, even sinners lend to other sinners so that they can get back the same amount!.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Dimbɔŋɔ din nyɛla Naawuni yiko tuma. Amaa ka Firawuna daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: So the magicians told Pharaoh that the power of God did this. But Pharaoh refused to listen to them. This happened just as the Lord had said.

dag: man Yawɛ ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu a biŋkɔbiri bɛn be mɔɣu ni min a yuri ni a bunsi ni laakuma ni a niɣi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu zaa zuɣu.
en: he will bring a terrible disease on your horses and donkeys, your camels and cattle, and your sheep and goats.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpuɣi puri maa atam, yin pum li sɔŋ ʒiibunu n-vaai di yim zuɣu ti Firawuna, ka yi mi zaŋ di ʒiibunahi la ka yi mini yi yiŋnim ni yi bihi di, ka chɛ di shɛli zali nti biri.
en: At the time of harvest you must give one-fifth to the king. You can use the rest for seed and for food for yourselves and your families.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa daa yi chani naa Sulemaana sani ti wumdi Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli niŋ o suhu ni maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: They all consulted him, to hear the wisdom that God had given him.

dag: ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paai ba Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, bɛ dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: But it does not sink deep into them, and they don't last long. So when trouble or persecution comes because of the message, they give up at once.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali mabihi ni bidibisi bɛn daa mali yiko din ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.

dag: Dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyari bilila n niriba tiŋgban ni. Iin, kummiya suhupiɛlli ni daa be yil shɛŋa ni mini tin shɛl ni la zuɣu.
en: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Pul daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-ti Asiria Naa Pul ni o sɔŋ o ka o kul su o nam maa.
en: Tiglath Pileser, the emperor of Assyria, invaded Israel, and Menahem gave him thirty-eight tons of silver to gain his support in strengthening Menahem's power over the country.

dag: Ka salo maa ni niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra n-teeri sɔŋdi sol ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb mi ŋahiri tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: Now a large crowd spread their clothes on the road. Others cut palm branches off the trees and spread them on the road.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn goon titali ŋɔ ni ti lu tiŋgban ni dahim, ka di dunɔdaya din du pam la ti di buɣim. Niriba maa daa kul nahimla bɛmaŋ yoli, di daa kul wum ba la yoli, ka buɣim ti yɛn di li.
en: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke.

dag: Timiya yi banim mini yi manim jilima din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni.
en: You must honor and respect your father and your mother. Do this so that you will have a full life in the land that the Lord your God gives you.

dag: Ka Amazia nam yiko ni daa ti ba jila zaa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku o kpambal shɛb bɛn daa ku o ba la.
en: Once he had secured control over his kingdom, he executed the officials who had assassinated his father the king.

dag: M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn chɛ ka paɣ so ku a zuɣu, ka a ti bɔbili paɣ zinalana biha?.
en: and dont go stumbling into the arms of another woman.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ maami tab suhuri.
en: So then, encourage one another with these words.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa garigi yɛli Iso, M pun zaŋ o leeg a dana, ka zaŋ o mabihi zaa leeg o daba; ka zaŋ kawana mini wain ti o. M bia, ka bɔ ka n ni tooi lan niŋ ti a mi.
en: Isaac answered, I have already given Jacob the power to rule over you. And I said all his brothers would be his servants. I have given him the blessing for much grain and wine. There is nothing left to give you, my son.

dag: Ti mali tahima maŋli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama ti mi ni ti mini ya ni laɣim di wahala shɛm, lala ka ti mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nya suhumaabo.
en: Our hope for you is certain, because we know that as you are partners in suffering, so also you are partners in comfort.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli, N tum taali, m bia Dauda, labimina, n ku lan niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu yaha, dama a lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; nyama, n tum jɛrilim ka birigi pam.
en: Then Saul said, David, my son! I have sinned. Come back. Today you showed me that my life is important to you, so I wont try to hurt you. I have acted foolishly. I have made a big mistake.

dag: ni naɣilima ni vinvama din zaŋ hal ni Ar zaŋ lab Mɔabnim tintariga polo la.
en: and the slope of the valleys that extend to the town of Ar and toward the border of Moab.

dag: Daadam ŋun mali bahigu ŋɔ ni tooi be tibi gari Naawuni? Daadamnim ni tooi be kasi gari ŋun nam ba?.
en: A person cannot be more right than God. People cannot be more pure than their Maker.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o binshɛɣukam, ka bi sɔɣ o shɛli. Ka Ɛli garigi yɛli, Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ, o niŋm o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: So Samuel told him everything and hid nothing from him. He is the LORD, Eli said. He will do as he pleases.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka zuɣulaannim su bɛ niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam su niriba su ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: By me rulers govern, and officials judge righteously.

dag: Ti bi nyu dam kuli kaman yi ni tɛhiri shɛm maa, dama yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ na kul nyɛla asiba kurig awɛi.
en: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi n yɛligu, ka ʒe n dunɔdali gbini dabisili kam, ka ʒe n dunoli ni guhiri mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who listen to me will be happy— those who stay at my door every day, waiting at the entrance to my home.

dag: Ka do so yi bi yuri ka di bin kasi maa, ŋun bom di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ bin kasi maa ti ti maligumaana.
en: If someone eats a holy offering unintentionally, they must provide the priest with an equal item, plus one-fifth.

dag: Musa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa naai, o daa zaŋla sariga pili lir o ninni.
en: When Moses finished speaking with them, he put a veil over his face.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n jɛrigiya pam ni bɛ boli ma daadam. N ka daadam tɛhi zilima.
en: I am more like an animal than a human being; I do not have the sense we humans should have.

dag: O ti o niriba faako. O lo o daalikauli ni di kul ʒiɛya sahakam. O yuli be kasi ka mali dabiɛm.
en: He rescued his people and made his agreement with them forever. His name is awesome and holy.

dag: Di kpala talahi ni ti chɛ ba ti ni lo ba alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu; di yi pa lala, ti ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: We must let them live because of our promise; if we don't, God will punish us.

dag: Doo yi na yoli niŋ amiliya, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka o doli tɔbbihi chaŋ tɔb ni bee n-chɛ ka o tum tuma lala tatabo, amaa di simdi ni bɛ chɛ o ka o be yiŋ yuun yini, ka o min o ni kpuɣi paɣ so maa laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: When a man is newly married, he must not be sent into the army. And he must not be given any other special work. For one year he must be free to stay home and make his new wife happy.

dag: Wuntizɔra yi di nasara, tiŋ zaa malila suhupiɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu yi kpi, niriba warila waa.
en: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yɛrigi nuzaa polo sagbana limsi vau, ka daa bi zaŋ dunia ŋɔ yili binshɛli.
en: God stretched the northern sky over empty space. He hung the earth on nothing.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm.
en: If you have ears, then, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti niŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: They did as Jesus told them and prepared the meal.

dag: ka n suhu kpe bɛ ni ashilɔni ka n jɛm ba.
en: I was never foolish enough to worship the sun and the moon.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa chɛ ka Samsin zaŋ o zuɣu pa o naba zuɣu gbihi, ka o bol do so na ti chɛ ka o pini Samsin zuɣu ni zab kpila ayopɔin maa. Ka o daa piligi damdi Samsin, ka o kpiɔŋ maa daa shiri yi o ni.
en: Delilah got Samson to go to sleep with his head lying in her lap. Then she called in a man to shave off the seven braids of Samsons hair. In this way she made Samson weak, and his strength left him.

dag: N ni ku Asirianim bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu no ba n zoya la zuɣu, ka tiligi n niriba Asirianim maa ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: I will destroy the king of Assyria in my country. I will walk on him on my mountains. He forced my people to be his slaves; he put a yoke on their necks. But that pole will be taken off Judahs neck, and that burden will be removed.

dag: Hal n yi nyɛla ŋun ʒi yɛtɔɣa, amaa n lee bi kɔŋ baŋsim dina; binshɛɣukam puuni ti pun kahigiri dimbɔŋɔ yɛla n-wuhiri ya palɔni sahakam.
en: Perhaps I am an amateur in speaking, but certainly not in knowledge; we have made this clear to you at all times and in all conditions.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa daa tirila bɛ suɣa Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent.

dag: Mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ti ŋubiri mɔri, o lan kumda? Bee nahu yi ti ŋubiri taɣitaɣi, o lan ŋumda?.
en: Even a wild donkey does not complain when it has grass to eat. And a cow is quiet when it has food.

dag: Amaa yi ni daa niŋ ma nirilim sɔŋ ma n wahala puuni la viɛli pam.
en: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.

dag: Ʒiɛnya yim yi yɛda niŋbu puuni ka zaɣis o, dama yi mi ni yi mabihi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nyarila wahala shɛŋa yi gba ni nyari maa tatabo.
en: Refuse to follow the devil. Stand strong in your faith. You know that your brothers and sisters all over the world are having the same sufferings that you have.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba wurindila tiŋa, amaa yɛnnim bɛn maarila niriba suhuri.
en: Mockers set a city on fire, but the wise turn back anger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tibigi Naawuni n zuɣu.
en: These believers praised God because of me.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bala? Dama bɛ daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli. Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli tin ya ni yi di m-bala.
en: When the Israelites saw it, they asked each other, What is that? because they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, This is the food the Lord is giving you to eat.

dag: Amaa niriba maa galisiya pam ka saa mi miri pampam, ka ti ku tooi ʒe palo ŋɔ ni lala. Di mi pala dahin yini bee daba ayi tuuni n-nyɛ li, dama ti pam n-tum birigi yɛlli maa ni.
en: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.

dag: Ka o mali Naawuni Kundi yɛligu kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra, Di daa kpala talahi ni Masia di wahala ka lan neei kum ni, dinzuɣu n ni yihiri Yisa so waazu maa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: He explained the Scriptures to show them that the Messiah had to die and then rise from death. He said, This Jesus that I am telling you about is the Messiah.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu daa ti zahim zahindi ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani maan pahi.
en: Joseph had a dream and told it to his brothers, which made them hate him even more.

dag: Yɛl yini n-kul paari sokam zaa. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl biɛɣu din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Din pahi nyɛla, zaɣ biɛɣu n-kul pali sokam zaa suhu ni. Yinyari biɛhigu n-kul be bɛ suhuri ni bɛ biɛhigu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ kpi.
en: It's terribly unfair for the same thing to happen to each of us. We are mean and foolish while we live, and then we die.

dag: A yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, nyaɣisim bɔ ka di lee tiri Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Bee a yi nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, nyo bɔ ka o yɛn nya di zuɣu?.
en: Does your living right benefit him? Does God All-Powerful gain anything if you follow him?.

dag: Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kafitɔrinima Filistianim ni yi shɛb zuliya ni na la.
en: Pathrusim, Casluhim, and Caphtorim, from which the Philistines came.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ so daa kpuɣ nɛkaŋa n-daai li bah o zuɣu ni na, ka di ŋma o zuɣuŋmaŋ.
en: But a woman threw a millstone down on his head and fractured his skull.

dag: Di yi niŋ kamaata ni n nyu bara, n ni nyula bara binshɛŋa din wuhiri n chɔɣinsi ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu.
en: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.

dag: Naawuni, a shiri zaɣisi ti mi? Naawuni, a bi lan doli ti tɔbbihi chani tɔb ni.
en: Have you really rejected us? Aren't you going to march out with our armies?.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, m bela yi polo, ka ni ŋmaligi kpa yi polo na, ka yi ko m-biri.
en: I am with you, and I will help you. People will till your soil and plant seeds in you.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama bɛn be ti sani gari bɛn be bɛ sani.
en: Don't be afraid, Elisha answered. We have more on our side than they have on theirs.

dag: Buni mini jilima be n sani, ka azichi din yuura mini tɔŋsim be n sani.
en: I have riches and honor to give, prosperity and success.

dag: N dana, ka so yi ti dol a ni o ku a, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun zaŋm a nyɛvili ŋɔ pahi nyɛviya pam zuɣu n-gul li, amaa o ni ti zaŋ a dimnim nyɛviya labi kaman kuɣilɔŋ kuɣili ka bɛ labi la.
en: If someone chases you to kill you, the Lord your God will save your life. But he will throw away your enemies like a stone from a sling.

dag: ka n yi daa mali suhupiɛlli m buni ni galisi pam zuɣu, bee n ni zaŋ n nuhi tum tuma n-nya binshɛli pam zuɣu.
en: I have been wealthy, but that didnt make me proud. I earned a lot of money, but that is not what made me happy.

dag: ka Zikiri daa nyɛ Abija daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Pilitai daa nyɛ Miniamin mini Mɔadia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa kpuɣi paɣiba ayi, ka yino yuli booni Ada, ka yino mi yuli booni Zilla.
en: Lamech married two women. One wife was named Adah, and the other was named Zillah.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni tinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ di suɣilo n-sɔŋ bɛn ka yaa, ka di bɔri ni ti tum din ni tiɣi timaŋmaŋ nini.
en: We who are strong in the faith ought to help the weak to carry their burdens. We should not please ourselves.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai Naawuni nir maa sani zoli maa zuɣu, o daa gbaala o napɔŋ, ka Gɛhaazi kana ni o ti daag o bahi, ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, Chɛl o. O malila yɛli muɣisirili ka Yawɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi ma ka bi kahigi li wuhi ma.
en: but when she came to Elisha, she bowed down before him and took hold of his feet. Gehazi was about to push her away, but Elisha said, Leave her alone. Can't you see she's deeply distressed? And the Lord has not told me a thing about it.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ni goli ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali yiliyidan kam ŋun bom piɛbila o min o malibu zuɣu, ka yili kam ti mali piɛbila.
en: Tell the whole Israelite community: On the tenth day of this month they must take a lamb for each household, a lamb per house.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, A yi kari ti, nyin chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: So the demons begged Jesus, If you force us out, please send us into those pigs.

dag: Tɔbbia ŋun be tɔbbitali tuma ni bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri bɛn pa tɔbbihi yɛla ni, dama o nia nyɛla ni o tum din tiɣi ŋun kpɛh o tɔbbitali tuma ni maa nini.
en: A soldier on active duty wants to please his commanding officer and so does not get mixed up in the affairs of civilian life.

dag: Bee m-bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣi tiŋgban ni? .
en: And dont say, Who will go down into the world below.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila Anakinima, ka niriba booni ba Rɛfaimnima, amaa Mɔabnim daa booni ba la Ɛmimnima.
en: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.

dag: Jakim mini Zikiri ni Zabidi.
en: Shimeis family: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi.

dag: Dama bɛ chaŋ Asiria kaman yɔɣuni buntaaŋa ŋun gɔr o ko la. I friimnim darila niriba ni bɛ sɔŋdi ba.
en: They have gone up to Assyria, a wild ass wandering alone; Ephraim has hired lovers.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti yɛl o tizo Ɛbɛl, Ti cham mɔɣu ni. Bɛ ni daa ti be mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli, ka Keen yiɣisi lu o tizo Ɛbɛl maa zuɣu n-ku o.
en: Cain said to his brother Abel, Lets go out to the field. So they went to the field. Then Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

dag: O mabihi n-daa nyɛ Gabai mini Sallai. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pihitaayika.
en: And after him were Gabbai and Sallai: .

dag: N kul tɔɣisirimi kaman yinyaa n-nyɛ ma la. Bɛ nyɛla Masia tumtumdiba? N nyɛla Masia tumtumda gari ba: N tum pam gari ba gba; bɛ kpɛhi ma sarika n-gari ba: n nya buri din ka kalinli; ka be kum barina ni waawaayili.
en: Are they serving Christ? I am serving him more. I have worked much harder than they have. I have been in prison more often. I have been hurt more in beatings. I have been near death many times.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni. Bɛ ni tur a tu shɛŋa zaa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: My strong devotion to your Temple is destroying me. Those who insult you are also insulting me.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi bi paɣ o nuhi ka shihi ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If a man who has a discharge touches one of you without first having washed his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, and you remain unclean until evening.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni tutuɣu, ka faako yi ti kana, bɛ ku nya li. Bɛ ni ti bela tiŋgban nɛli tiŋ kuŋ ni. Tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yalim tiŋgbani, ka so ka di ni.
en: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa chɛ ka Tarishish ŋarima tatabo chaŋ Ofiri ni bɛ ti ʒi salima na; amaa ka di daa bi paai, dama ŋarima maa daa saɣimla Ɛziɔngɛba.
en: Jehoshaphat built Tarshish-styled ships to go to Ophir for gold. But the fleet didnt go because it was wrecked at Ezion-geber.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa laɣim sɔŋ o gballi maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ Reechɛl gballi maa kuɣiduli, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Jacob set up a memorial stone there, and it still marks Rachel's grave to this day.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl daa nyɛla naa Saawaralana, ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir la daa nyɛ naa zo sumo.
en: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
