dag: Bɔhimiya Shɛkɛmnim zaa, yi lee yuya ni Gidiɔn bidibisi pisopɔin la zaa n-sun ya bee yi paɣiya ni o bidib yino n-sun ya? Teemiya ni n nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ni yi ʒim.
en: Ask the leaders of the city of Shechem this question: Is it better for you to be ruled by the sons of Gideon or to be ruled by only one man? Remember, I am your relative.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa chɛ ka tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini paɣ shɛb bɛn mali jilima ka doli Yɛhudianim daadiini sol la taai duŋ n-daa niŋ Pool mini Baanabas alaka, ka kari ba bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But the Jews stirred up the leading men of the city and the Gentile women of high social standing who worshiped God. They started a persecution against Paul and Barnabas and threw them out of their region.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni lan zo Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu, ka lan pii ba n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha; ka chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ bɛmaŋ pahi Yaakubu zuliya maa zuɣu n-doli ba labi.
en: The Lord will again show his love to Jacob. He will again choose the people of Israel. He will give them their land. Then the non-Israelites will join the Israelites, and both will become one family—Jacobs family.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti yiri Jɛriko ka salo pam dol o.
en: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd was following.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya daa lab mali me tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Dibɔn mini Atarɔt ni Aroa.
en: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer.

dag: Izraɛlnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Aduna zuliya, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Family of Israel, praise the Lord ! Aarons family, praise the Lord !.

dag: Amaa n daa kul pii ya mi kaman wain ti viɛlli bira la n-zaŋna ti sa, ka bɔzuɣu ka yi taɣi n-lee mɔɣu ni wain tia?.
en: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anabinim sabbu niŋ pali. Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But all this happened, so that what the prophets wrote would come true. All Jesus' disciples left him and ran away.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra:.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, You have permission to speak on your own behalf. Paul stretched out his hand and defended himself as follows:.

dag: Bɛ ni ninvuɣ suŋ ŋmanila suligunyinyaɣu, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ maŋli mi ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ gɔ shɛŋa sa n-gili. Bɛ tibidarigibo dabisili la biɛɣu neeya, anabinim bɛn ŋmani tiŋguliba ni daa pun yɛli ba dabisi shɛli yɛla la. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ birimbu saha paaya.
en: Even the best of them is as crooked as a tangled thornbush. Your prophets said this day would come, and the day of your watchmen has come. Now you will be punished. Now you will be confused!.

dag: Naawuni, Wummi n kuhigu; ka deei n suhigu!.
en: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n siɣisi mmaŋa n-niŋ tuuba ka do taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim ni ŋɔ.
en: Therefore, I relent and find comfort on dust and ashes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ʒili naa dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn guli Lɛvinim yaɣili polo dunɔdal la gbini.
en: stationed until now in the Kings Gate on the east side. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the Levites camp.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, ti bi zabiri dunia ŋɔ zabili.
en: It is true that we live in the world, but we do not fight from worldly motives.

dag: Naawuni ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili din zooi pam niŋ bɛ puya ni ka di pali, ka o chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu na kaman saa la, ka di leei bɛ bindirigu.
en: If he does get all he wants, God will throw his burning anger against him. God will attack him and rain down punishment on him.

dag: O neesim bemi kaman wuntaŋa, ka neesim bɔba yiri o nuhi ni na, nimaani ka o yiko sɔɣiya.
en: His radiance is like the sunlight, with rays flashing from his hand. That is the hiding place of his power.

dag: Yisifu daa bol o bidib kpɛm yul la Manaasa dama o daa yɛlimi, Naawuni chɛ ka n tam n wahala la zaa mini n dɔɣiriba yɛla.
en: Their first son was named Manasseh, which means, God has let me forget all my troubles and my family back home.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa dol o tab maa gbin na duh o yee pam yɛra, Ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛm biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ka deeg o dalinli la pa o gbiɛɣu zuɣu bee o nuu ni.
en: Then another angel, a third one, followed them and said in a loud voice, If any worship the beast and its image, and receive a mark on their foreheads or their hands.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa guui ti tuh o soli yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ka n nyu.
en: The servant ran to meet her and said, Give me a little sip of water from your jar.

dag: M mabihi, lala zuɣu sokam kul kpalimmi be Naawuni sani kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni ti bol o.
en: So then, brothers and sisters, each of you should stay with God in the situation you were in when you were called.

dag: N kala dunia ŋɔ ni na kaman neesim, ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda ku kpalim be zibisim ni.
en: I am the light that has come into the world. No one who has faith in me will stay in the dark.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be yɔɣu maa ni yuun pihinahi la, a daa dihi ba, ka binshɛli daa bi pooi ba; bɛ situra daa bi kpi, ka bɛ naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: You kept them alive for forty years— they lacked nothing in the wilderness! Their clothes didnt wear out, and their feet didnt swell.

dag: Yawɛ, amaa a miri ma, ka a zaligunim zaa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: But you are near me, Lord , and all your commands can be trusted.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Gibiɔnnim maa na ka o ti bɔhi ba. Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɔhim ti yɛli, Ti mini ya shee wɔɣ pam. ka kul bela ti sani kpe ŋɔ?.
en: Joshua called for the Gibeonites and spoke to them: Why have you deceived us by saying, We live very far away from you, when actually you live among us?.

dag: Dama di niŋ kamaata ni o diri nam hal ti nyaŋ o dimnim zaa n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: Christ must rule until God puts all enemies under his control.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-wurim ba, o baɣa lan ka bɛ ni. Maligumaaniba lan ka jilima, ka niriba bi lan niŋdi kpamba nirilim.
en: The Lord had no more concern for them; he scattered them himself. He showed no regard for our priests and leaders.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zalila niriba tɔto ka bɛ tɔhi, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma bɛ nuu ni m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min omaŋmaŋ nam yili ni Millo ni Jɛrusalɛm gooni, ni Hazɔr ni Mɛgido ni Gɛza.
en: This is the story of the labor gang that King Solomon put together to build the LORDs temple and his own palace, as well as the stepped structure, the wall of Jerusalem, Hazor, Megiddo, and Gezer: .

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ be mɔɣu ni n-dari ginda m-mali ti paai yuun pihinahi hal ka ʒiɛmani maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tum din bie Yawɛ sani maa zaa ti kpi.
en: The Lord was very angry with the Israelites. So he made the people stay in the desert for years. He made them stay there until all the people who had sinned against the Lord were dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa ni daa zaŋ gban shɛli ti Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomnanim mini zuɣulaannim la ti ba, ka bɛ daa zani bɛ nyaaŋa ka sɔŋ ba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma ni.
en: Then the people gave the letter from King Artaxerxes to the royal satraps and to the governors of the area west of the Euphrates River. Then the leaders gave their support to the Israelites and to the Temple.

dag: A yi yi zahira kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di so ashilɔni yurilim.
en: Better to correct someone openly than to let him think you don't care for him at all.

dag: Bɛ ka bihi bee zuliya bɛ niriba sunsuuni, ka so lan ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: They have no offspring or descendants among their people, no survivor in their dwelling place.

dag: Yuun pinaayi shɛŋa ni zaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ma leei bɛ gomna Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi la saha zaŋ hal ti paag o yuun pihitanaayi la saha, mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi daa bi di bindir shɛŋa din nyɛ gomna tarili.
en: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.

dag: M bihi, di bi simdi ni ti yurilim nyɛla yɛtɔɣa bee ti ni yɛri shɛm kɔŋko, amaa di simdi ni di nyɛla yurilim maŋli di tuma puuni.
en: My children, our love should not be only words and talk. No, our love must be real. We must show our love by the things we do.

dag: Yawɛ bela n sani ni o sɔŋ ma. N ni di nasara bɛn je ma sani.
en: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.

dag: Naawuni zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni; ka ŋmalig a nini lihi ti ni yurilim.
en: God, be merciful to us and bless us; look on us with kindness.

dag: Miriya ka yi be kaman yi yaannim mini yi mabihi bɛn daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ yim, ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya naŋgbantom yi zaa ninni la.
en: Do not be like your ancestors and your Israelite relatives who were unfaithful to the Lord their God. As you can see, he punished them severely.

dag: So ku tooi baŋ yɛl biɛɣu ni yɛn paag o saha shɛli. Ziŋgbahiri laŋ din mali putɔɣu ni gbahiri zahim shɛm ni zana ni gbahiri noombihi shɛm la, lala ka yɛl biɛɣu gba libigiri daadamnim gbahiri ba.
en: People most definitely dont know when their time will come. Like fish tragically caught in a net or like birds trapped in a snare, so are human beings caught in a time of tragedy that suddenly falls to them.

dag: M bela bina ayi maa sunsuuni: N suhu kul yɛmi ni n kpi n-chaŋ ti be Masia sani, dama dina n-so shɛlikam;.
en: I am pulled in two directions. I want very much to leave this life and be with Christ, which is a far better thing;.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Maasɛya so mini Ɛlia ni Shɛmaya ni Jɛhiɛl ni Uzia.
en: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dabili bi gar o duuma; tumo mi bi gari ŋun tim o.
en: I assure you, servants arent greater than their master, nor are those who are sent greater than the one who sent them.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhiri anabinim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli ya? bee Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, What answer did the Lord give to my question? or What has the Lord said.

dag: ni o bɔrila a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣ viɛla ni a bihi.
en: you surrender to him your silver and gold, your women and the strongest of your children.

dag: N lihila a tiliginsim min a ni lo ma alikauli maŋli shɛl la soli hal ka n nina ti fulim.
en: My eyes are worn out looking for your saving help— looking for your word that will set things right.

dag: Mbusim be a zuɣu, nyini ŋun kuri niriba, ka so na bi ku a ŋɔ; nyini yɛŋkiŋkabinalana, so ʒi n-tum a yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma. A yi ti chɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, bɛ ni tum a yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma; ka a yi ti chɛ niriba kubu, bɛ ni ku a.
en: Look at you. You attack others when you have not been attacked. You turn against others when no one has turned against you. So when you stop your attacks, you will be attacked. When you stop turning against others, they will turn against you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya Filip la Azɔtus, ka o doli nimaani tinsi n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu hal ti paai Siizaria.
en: Philip found himself in Azotus; he went on to Caesarea, and on the way he preached the Good News in every town.

dag: Di simdi ni dapaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Each frame is to be feet long and inches wide.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The seeds that fell on rocky ground are the people who gladly hear the message and accept it at once.

dag: O chɛ ka n zaŋla n nyina ŋubiri kuɣichaɣila, ka chɛ ka n kɔri tampiligim puɣi mmaŋa.
en: He pushed my teeth into rocky ground. He pushed me into the dirt.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa kum niŋ o bɛ daamiliya chuɣu daba ayopɔin maa ni zaa. Ka paɣ maa daa muɣisi Samsin hal ka o ti bahi wuh o ŋahili maa gbinni di daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti yɛl o niriba maa.
en: She cried about it for the whole seven days of the feast. But on the seventh day he told her what the riddle meant, for she nagged him so about it. Then she told the Philistines.

dag: Zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Giliad tiŋgbani ni Gaad niriba mini Rubin niriba ni Manaasa niriba tiŋgbana zaa n-lan zaŋ Aroa din baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la hal ti paai Giliad mini Bashan tiŋgbana.
en: east of the Jordan, as far south as the town of Aroer on the Arnon River—this included the territories of Gilead and Bashan, where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and East Manasseh lived.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni doo be o ko, n ni nam sɔŋda ŋun simd o ti o.
en: Then the Lord God said, It is not good for the man to live alone. I will make a suitable companion to help him.

dag: amaa ka yi bi niŋ yɛda, ka di nyɛla yi ni pa m piɛri la zuɣu.
en: but you will not believe, for you are not my sheep.

dag: Dama yuŋ la ka n Duuma Naawuni ŋun su ma ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ malaika sa ka n sanna.
en: Last night an angel came to me from God—the God I worship and belong to.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni a saria karibu nyɛla din tuhi. Ʒiɛyimtali puuni ka a daa darigi n tibili maa.
en: I know that your judgments are righteous, Lord , and that you punished me because you are faithful.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a daba niŋgbuna ti juri bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ bɛn ʒe a yim niŋgbuna ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be tiŋgban ni.
en: They left the bodies of your people for the vultures, the bodies of your servants for wild animals to eat.

dag: Hal malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil mini Sintani ni daa mali taba Anabi Musa niŋgbuŋ zuɣu la, o daa bi saɣi tu Sintani; o daa naɣ yɛlimi, Ti Duuma ni bɔh a.
en: Not even the chief angel Michael did this. In his quarrel with the Devil, when they argued about who would have the body of Moses, Michael did not dare condemn the Devil with insulting words, but said, The Lord rebuke you.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli jintɔriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi ni lo ni yi niŋ niriba maa shɛm maa;.
en: Then he said to them, Men of Israel, be careful of what you are planning to do to these men.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o kpambaliba zaŋ ŋarima mini tumtumdiba bɛn mili teeku nti ti o, ka bɛ mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanu na ti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: Hiram sent him ships and some of his experienced sailors. They went with Solomon's own sailors to the country of Ophir and brought back more than tons of gold for Solomon.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɛla zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni di bɛ tuma nyɔri.
en: Tell the righteous how blessed they are; they will eat the fruit of their labors.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be zibisim ni yipa nya neesim titali. Bɛn daa be zibisim tital ni, neesim neei paai ba.
en: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.

dag: Ka so daa yɛli bɛ tab Izraɛlnim la, Nyamiya, Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la mɛla sara maligu bimbini zali Gɛlilɔt Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili polo na din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛl la.
en: Then the Israelites heard a report: Look. The people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh have built an altar at the far edge of the land of Canaan. It lies in the districts of the Jordan on the Israelite side.

dag: Ŋun pa maligumaana zuliya miri ka o di sara maligu kasi la. Sana yi be maligumaana yiŋa bee maligumaana yi bu so paa, o bi simdi ni o di sara maligu kasi maa.
en: Only a member of a priestly family may eat any of the sacred offerings; no one else may eat them—not even someone staying with a priest or hired by him.

dag: Ka Ibram daa be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Lɔt mi be vinvamli maa ni fɔntinsi ni, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-zaŋ o tanti suɣili chaŋ ti kpa Sɔdom.
en: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan, and Lot settled among the cities in the valley and camped near Sodom.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim ni bɛ daŋ niriba pahi bɛ ni.
en: But the Levites, belonging to their own ancestral tribe, werent enlisted along with them.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. Hamutal mi ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eleven years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hamutal; she was Jeremiahs daughter and was from Libnah.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, yi daa bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: But in spite of what I said, you still would not trust the Lord .

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ti paai Bahurim, ka Sool daŋ ni do so ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛra bia ka o yuli booni Shimɛi la daa yina ti turi ba.
en: David was near the town of Bahurim when a man came out and started cursing him. The man was Shimei the son of Gera, and he was one of Saul's distant relatives.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa zaŋ bar so ŋun gbaya zaa kpi n-niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o kana ti bɔri soli ni bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: Some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a bed, and they tried to carry him into the house and put him in front of Jesus.

dag: Yi tarili ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli sara maligu binshɛŋa din be kasi ka bɛ bi zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ sara maligu kam din be kasi ka bɛ zaŋ li ti ma, din nyɛ chi sara bee alahichi sara bee taali tumbu sara kam di nyɛla a min a bidibisi dini.
en: The people will bring gifts, grain offerings, sin offerings, and guilt offerings. These offerings are most holy. Your share in the most holy offerings will come from the parts that are not burned. All these things will be for you and your sons.

dag: Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Gaatinima, ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa. Amaa Naa Hazaɛl ni daa chani ni o ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: At that time King Hazael of Syria attacked the city of Gath and conquered it; then he decided to attack Jerusalem.

dag: O yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin yɛlimiya yili maa yidana ni yi karimba n-tim ya na ni yi ti bɔh o ni du din ni ka o min o nyaandoliba lee yɛn ʒini puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ ka di di bindirigu?.
en: Wherever he enters, say to the owner of the house, The teacher asks,Where is my guest room where I can eat the Passover meal with my disciples.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Ka a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela neesim ni; amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa bela zibisim ni.
en: Your eyes are like a lamp for the body. When your eyes are sound, your whole body is full of light; but when your eyes are no good, your whole body will be in darkness.

dag: Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ, dama o tum alahiziba tuma. O nudirigu min o bɔɣu dim be kasi ŋɔ ti o nasara.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.

dag: Dama bɛn be ʒilinsi ni biriginsim n-kuri ba, ka jɛra mi nini ni tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ shɛm kuri ba.
en: Inexperienced people die because they reject wisdom. Stupid people are destroyed by their own lack of concern.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba yihi yi ni deei zaka binshɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim sani maa mi zaka ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ din nyɛ Yawɛ dini maa ti maligumaana Aduna.
en: In this way you will also present a gift offering to the LORD from all the one-tenth portions that you take from the Israelites. You will provide from it a gift offering to the LORD for Aaron the priest.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu, ka nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri bidibbini. Nyin ka n zaŋ ŋme n-wurim zuliya kam, nyini ka n zaŋ ku nanima.
en: The Lord says, Babylonia, you are my hammer, my weapon of war. I used you to crush nations and kingdoms.

dag: Dum Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi bahi wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo, lihim li viɛnyɛliŋga, dama a ku du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali saŋmarisi kalinli ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka mi bɛ yuya.
en: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.

dag: Ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: And Peter went out and cried uncontrollably.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni di tiŋkpansi shɛm la, lala ka so ti ku lan be nimaani gba bee n-ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The same thing will happen to Babylon that happened to Sodom and Gomorrah, when I destroyed them and the nearby towns. No one will ever live there again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: dama binshɛɣukam din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ mini din tuhi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yirila neesim ni na.
en: Light produces fruit that consists of every sort of goodness, justice, and truth.

dag: Dama ti yab Ibrahimma yi daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani la o tuma zuɣu, o daa naan mal li kuuna, amaa ka pa ni Naawuni sani.
en: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.

dag: ka n yi daa mali suhupiɛlli m buni ni galisi pam zuɣu, bee n ni zaŋ n nuhi tum tuma n-nya binshɛli pam zuɣu.
en: or taken pride in my wealth.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba bihi ni be ni alaafee. Bɛ zuliya ni ti nya zaa zani a sani.
en: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri ni sokam zaa tiligi ka bɔhim baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: who wants everyone to be saved and to come to know the truth.

dag: Yawɛ po Yaakubu zuɣu n-yɛli, N kul ku tam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla.
en: I, the Lord , won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.

dag: ka yɛra, Ami! Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun su alibarika mini yɛm ni yiko ni kpiɔŋ simdi jilima tibu mini paɣibu ni tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami.
en: saying, Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might belong to our God forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Ti tum tuumbiɛri, ka yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa, ka zaɣisi ti Naawuni jɛmbu. Ti nahindi ti taba, ka taari duŋ. Ti nyɛla bɛn ŋmari ʒiri din yiri ti suhuri ni na.
en: We rebelled against the Lord and lied to him. We turned away from our God and left him. We planned to hurt others and to rebel against God. From hearts filled with lies, we talked about it and made our plans.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka di mini li laɣim zooi ka gɔhi maa girimgirim li.
en: Other seed fell among thorny plants. The thorns grew with the plants and choked them.

dag: ka Joyada nyɛ Jɔnatan ba; ka Jɔnatan mi nyɛ Jadua ba.
en: Joiada was the father of Jonathan; and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.

dag: O daa di tarimba mini nandaamba saria ka di viɛla. Pa nira ni yɛn niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o mi ma m-bala? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He defended the rights of the poor and needy; then it went well. Isnt that what it means to know me? declares the LORD.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nti nya farigudeer so ŋun yuli booni Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma.
en: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi, sitting in his office. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

dag: Ka zom maa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ chana; amaa bɛ ŋmanila tihi.
en: The man looked up and said, I see people. They look like trees, only they are walking around.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa yɛliya ni doo yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, they said, Moses said that if a man who has no children dies, his brother must marry the widow so that they can have children who will be considered the dead man's children.

dag: Aduna ŋɔ mini Musa ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Yihimiya Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbilligbilli la.
en: Aaron and Moses were the ones to whom the Lord said, Lead the tribes of Israel out of Egypt.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ a niŋ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb la nuu ni.
en: But because you trusted me, I will protect you from the officials of Judah, and when Judah is struck by disaster, I will rescue you and keep you alive. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni ʒe go tihi sunsuuni shɛm, lala ka n yura be paɣisara sunsuuni.
en: Like a lily among thorns is my darling among women.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ba tin ya, ka yi niŋ ba kaman n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm.
en: The Lord will help you defeat these nations. But you must do to them everything I told you to do.

dag: Fɔnisia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Speen ŋarima din be teeku ni, kummiya ni suhugarigu! Dama Taai luya ka lan ka yili bee kulinoli. Niriba daa yila Saipurus na nti wum di yɛla.
en: An oracle about Tyre. Wail, ships of Tarshish, because your port is destroyed! When returning from Cyprus, they heard about it.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o ku lan tooi gbib omaŋa, nyin gbib o ka chɛ ka o be a sani kaman sana bee tinzun nir la.
en: If one of your fellow Israelites faces financial difficulty and is in a shaky situation with you, you must assist them as you would an immigrant or foreign guest so that they can survive among you.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ bubil polli maa ti o zo ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la ni o ti ti paɣ maa ka deeg o neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira la na, amaa ka o daa bi nya paɣ maa.
en: Judah asked his friend Hirah take a goat to the woman, so he could get back the ring and walking stick, but she wasn't there.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o ba min o ma maa daa yɛli ni o gba lan pala bia, dinzuɣu ni bɛ bɔhim o maa.
en: That is why his parents said, He is old enough; ask him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe o nuzaa polo la mi, Yinim bahiyolinim ŋɔ, wariya ti kpe azaaba buɣim shɛl ni Naawuni ni daa mali gu Sintani min o malaikanim la.
en: Then the king will say to those on his left, Get away from me! You are under God's curse. Go into the everlasting fire prepared for the devil and his angels!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa du duli maa ha, ka Ilaija yɛli Ilaisha, Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ti a pɔi ka bɛ naanyi kpuɣ ma chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, N suhir a, chɛ ka a shia ŋun be a ni ŋɔ ʒiibuyi zuɣu be n ni.
en: There, Elijah said to Elisha, Tell me what you want me to do for you before I am taken away. Let me receive the share of your power that will make me your successor, Elisha answered.

dag: Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu sokam zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la. .
en: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be crushed, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.

dag: ka Azaria nyɛ Sɛraya ba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ Jɛhɔzadak ba.
en: Azariah of Seraiah, and Seraiah of Jehozadak.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya puuni niriba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda. Ka Shimɛi daŋ puuni niriba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: Levi, Shimei.

dag: Nir yi tum din tuhi, di niŋdila wuntizɔriba suhupiɛlli, amaa ka lee tiri tuumbiɛtumdiba suhugarigu.
en: When justice is done, good people are happy, but evil people are brought to despair.

dag: Apaim bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ishi, Ishi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛshan, Shɛshan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ahilai.
en: Appaims family: Ishi. Ishis family: Sheshan. Sheshans family: Ahlai.

dag: Binshɛli din gɔŋ ku tooi lan teei tuhi; ka nir mi ku tooi yɛli binshɛli din kani yɛla.
en: Whats crooked cant be straightened; what isnt there cant be counted.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: As they approached Jerusalem, near the towns of Bethphage and Bethany, they came to the Mount of Olives. Jesus sent two of his disciples on ahead.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛdɛkia Chɛnaana bia la daa chaŋ ti lab Mikaya tapaɣa, ka bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ shia niŋ yi n ni kana ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then the prophet Zedekiah went up to Micaiah, slapped his face, and asked, Since when did the Lord 's spirit leave me and speak to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn diri wahala ka di nyɛ Naawuni yubu la kul tumdi din tuhi, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya niŋ bɛ Namda ŋun kul ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa la nuu ni.
en: So then, those who suffer because they follow Gods will should commit their lives to a trustworthy creator by doing what is right.

dag: A yɛligu ka n zaŋ sɔɣi n suhu ni, ni di chɛ ka n ku tum alahichi a sani.
en: I keep your law in my heart, so that I will not sin against you.

dag: Ka Nɛri daa nyɛ Mɛlikai so bia, ka Mɛlikai maa nyɛ Addi bia, ka Addi nyɛ Kosam bia, ka Kosam nyɛ Ɛlimadam bia, ka Ɛlimadam nyɛ Ɛr bia.
en: Neri was the son of Melchi. Melchi was the son of Addi. Addi was the son of Cosam. Cosam was the son of Elmadam. Elmadam was the son of Er.

dag: Nimaani ka Masia be ka su binshɛɣukam zaa zaŋ tabili alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yikolaannim ni bɛn nyɛ duumanima, ka o yuli tibisi gari yuli kam ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni mini ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna ni.
en: He put Christ over all rulers, authorities, powers, and kings. He gave him authority over everything that has power in this world or in the next world.

dag: Ti yi be, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti be; ka ti yi kpi, ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpi; dinzuɣu ti yi bemi bee ti yi kpimi, ti Duuma n-su ti.
en: If we live, it is for the Lord that we live, and if we die, it is for the Lord that we die. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

dag: A yi ti yi palo, a ni bahi ba yoli kaman buɣim n-di ba la. Yawɛ ni bahi ba yoli zaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni, ka buɣim di ba.
en: When you appear, you will burn them up like a blazing furnace. In your anger, Lord , you will completely destroy them; they will be swallowed by flames of fire.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yuuni dunia tarisi, ka nyari binshɛɣukam din be sagbana tiŋli.
en: He can see to the very ends of the earth. He sees everything under the sky.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Ɛliɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba pihinii pah o zuɣu.
en: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and of his relatives; and.

dag: Yawɛ kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinima ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: The LORD looks down from heaven on humans to see if anyone is wise, to see if anyone seeks God.

dag: O daa zaŋla tɔrokɔnim ayi mini naɣilah anahi ti Gɛrishɔn bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the men in Gershons group. They needed the wagons and the oxen for their work.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be n ni, nyin wuhim ma so shɛli din tuhi, ka nyɛ din ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.

dag: Gbihim biɛla, dɔnim biɛla, zaŋm a nuhi taɣili taba vuhi biɛla.
en: Go ahead and take your nap; go ahead and sleep. Fold your hands and rest awhile.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti yili yila yɛl o ni yur o wain tihi pu shɛl la yɛla.
en: On that day: Sing about a delightful vineyard!.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n lo ni n kul teeri ya dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, hal yi ni pun mi li ka ba n-zani yɛlimaŋ shɛli yi ni pun dee la ni zaa yoli.
en: So Ill keep reminding you about these things, although you already know them and stand secure in the truth you have.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni, ka niŋ kɔpaɣirim niŋ di ni.
en: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water.

dag: Ka Jɛbusi tiŋbihi maa daa yɛli Dauda, A ku kuli ya ŋɔ na. Amaa ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: The Jebusites told David he would never get inside the city, but David captured their fortress of Zion, and it became known as David's City.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, kummiya! Sokam kummi Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum Kiriharɛsɛt bindira zuɣu.
en: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.

dag: Man Jud ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni Jeemsi mabia la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni ni boli ka bɛ nyɛ ŋun ti Ba Naawuni ni yuri shɛba, ka lan nyɛ Yisa Masia ni gbib shɛb la:.
en: From Jude, servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James— To those who have been called by God, who live in the love of God the Father and the protection of Jesus Christ:.

dag: ni Mizipa ni Chɛfira ni Mɔza.
en: Mizpah, Kephirah, Mozah.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: The king replied, Those who have something will be given more. But everything will be taken away from those who don't have anything.

dag: M Ba ni su binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla n dini; dina n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni o ni ti zaŋ n yɛla wuhi ya maa.
en: All that the Father has is mine. That is why I said that the Spirit will tell you what he receives from me.

dag: O ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni maa, ka o daa naanyi bo sɔŋsim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka siɣis omaŋ pam o yaannim Naawuni sani.
en: In his suffering he became humble, turned to the Lord his God, and begged him for help.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Zadok, Zaŋmi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi tiŋ maa puuni ti zali, Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ma, o ni lan zaŋ ma labisina ka n nini ti nya di min o biɛhigu shee.
en: Then David said: Zadok, take the sacred chest back to Jerusalem. If the Lord is pleased with me, he will bring me back and let me see it and his tent again.

dag: Kubu saha beni, ka tibbu saha beni. Daai luhi saha beni, ka me n-zali saha beni.
en: There is a time to kill and a time to heal. There is a time to destroy and a time to build.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N zɔrila Yɛhudianim bɛn zo nti pahi Babilɔnnim maa zuɣu la, bɛ ti zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni ka bɛ niŋ ma alaka zuɣu.
en: But King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, But I am afraid of the men of Judah who have already gone over to the side of the Babylonian army. I am afraid that the soldiers will give me to those men, and they will treat me badly and hurt me.

dag: O daa bi chɛ o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa. Dama o bilim ni ka dɔbba daa pun niŋ o kɔre n-zaŋ o saɣim.
en: But she never gave up her promiscuities with the Egyptians, who had slept with her in her girlhood and fondled her nubile breasts, and who continued to seduce her.

dag: A ni ti dɔni, ka so ku lan kpɛh a dabiɛm, ka niriba pam ti bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim.
en: You won't be afraid of your enemies; many people will ask you for help.

dag: Duma yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Ka so daa boli ma Siɛr yɛra, Tiŋgula, bɔ saha ka biɛɣu yɛn neei? Yɛlim biɛɣu maa ni yɛn neei saha shɛli.
en: This is a message about Edom. Someone calls to me from Edom, Sentry, how soon will the night be over? Tell me how soon it will end.

dag: Hal o daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa m mo alizanda Nabia ŋun lan nyɛ nimaani tɔbbihi zuɣulan la gba, ka daa kari dabisili kam sara maligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi na ti maan o; ka daag o jɛmbu duu luhi.
en: It grew as high as the very leader of those forces, taking the daily sacrifice away from him and overturning his holy place.

dag: ka Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: and when Jezebel was killing the Lord 's prophets, Obadiah took a hundred of them, hid them in caves in two groups of fifty, and provided them with food and water.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ, Izraɛlnim bi saɣiri ŋubiri binsakpuɣu zuɣu nimdi, doo maa ni daa shihi Yaakubu sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: Therefore, Israelites dont eat the tendon attached to the thigh muscle to this day, because he grabbed Jacobs thigh muscle at the tendon.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu maa ni daa ʒiɛri tuhi ŋariŋ maa, ka di ku tooi lan kpa ti ni bɔri ni di doli shɛli polo zuɣu ka ti daa chɛ li ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri li chana.
en: The ship was caught in the storm and couldnt be turned into the wind. So we gave in to it, and it carried us along.

dag: Anabinim zaa kpiya; ka nyin lee zaŋ amaŋ leela ŋuni? A gari ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa kpi maa.
en: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, jɛra kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa. So bi mi din yɛn niŋ, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛl o kpee din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha?.
en: Fools are always talking about what they will do, but you never know what will happen. People cannot tell what will happen in the future.

dag: Ka Tama daa niŋ tampiligim buɣ o zuɣu ka darigi cheeg o ni daa ye saalo shɛli maa, ka kah o nuhi pa o zuɣu ni n-kuhiri pampam chana.
en: Tamar tore her robe of many colors and put ashes on her head. Then she put her hand on her head and began crying.

dag: Ka Yisifu Arimatia tiŋbia ŋun daa nyɛ bilichin titali ka lan nyɛ Yɛhudianim jintɔriba ni yino ka daa guli Naawuni nam kandina saha la daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: Joseph from Arimathea dared to approach Pilate and ask for Jesus body.

dag: Zaŋm biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi la zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi la zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: Take with you seven pairs of each kind of ritually clean animal, but only one pair of each kind of unclean animal.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi bela n sani ka n zaŋ bini dihi tabili li sɔŋ?.
en: Dont I have this stored up, sealed in my vaults?.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi baŋ hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: They didn't know anything was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. This is how it will be when the Son of Man appears.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zal omaŋmaŋ maligumaaniba buɣa jɛmbu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o ni daa mali bu so mini naɣisa so zali, ka di nyɛ o buɣili la.
en: Jeroboam chose his own priests to serve at the local shrines in Israel and at the places of worship where he had set up statues of goat-demons and of calves.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, n ni paɣ a zuliya kam sani; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: Lord , that is why I praise you among the nations. That is why I sing songs of praise to your name.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpi bela fɔŋ ni ŋuhira, ka bɛn mali dansi kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka Naawuni baɣa ka bɛ suhigu ni.
en: In the city you can hear the sad sounds of dying people. Those who are hurt cry out for help, but God does not listen.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa maa zaa yoli, n kɔba ni chɔɣisimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Zɛruya bihi maa nyɛla ninvuɣ yarisi. Yawɛ ni yo tuumbiɛrilana san shɛli din simd o putɔɣu tuma.
en: Even though I am the king chosen by God, I feel weak today. These sons of Zeruiah are too violent for me. May the Lord punish these criminals as they deserve.

dag: Tahima shɛlikam bɛ ni niŋ zaŋ chaŋ o gbaabu polo ku di nasara. Hal niriba yi nya o, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi.
en: Anyone who sees Leviathan loses courage and falls to the ground.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia.
en: Then Jesus asked, Who do you say I am? Peter answered, You are the Messiah.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum Pool yɛtɔɣa maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai o ni yoli yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o! Dama nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo bi simdi ni o be.
en: The people listened to Paul until he said this; but then they started shouting at the top of their voices, Away with him! Kill him! He's not fit to live.

dag: ni Basɛmat ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ka nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt tizɔpaɣ la.
en: Basemath, Ishmaels daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.

dag: Yi ni daa bi kpuɣi li tuuli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi ti zuɣu n-darigi ti tibili la, dama ti daa bi niŋ li kaman di ni simdi ni ti niŋ li shɛm.
en: The first time we tried to bring it, we failed to ask the Lord about the right way to move it. And he punished us because you Levites did not carry it.

dag: di yi nyɛla bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni n-tum alahichi maa, ka di taali meei niriba maa, di saha ŋun zaŋmi naɣilabil polli ŋun ka dalinli m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara ti Yawɛ.
en: If the anointed priest makes a mistake that leaves the people guilty for their sin, he must offer a young bull to the Lord as a sin offering. The bull must have nothing wrong with it.

dag: Parɔsh daŋ — tusaayi ni kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: Parosh - , Shephatiah - Arah - Pahath Moab - , Elam - , Zattu - Zaccai - Bani - Bebai - Azgad - , Adonikam - Bigvai - , Adin - Ater - Bezai - Jorah - Hashum - Gibbar -.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim din nyɛ ti daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ la.
en: who forgives our sins and sets us free.

dag: dama yi yi ba n-zani yi biɛhigu ni ti Duuma zuɣu, di ni chɛ ka ti leei bɛn be.
en: because now we really live if you stand firm in your life in union with the Lord.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yawɛ di saɣi ka n niŋ n dan ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ŋɔ lala. O di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shih o, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bihi so zuɣu ni.
en: and he told his men, Stop talking foolishly. We're not going to attack Saul. He's my king, and I pray that the Lord will keep me from doing anything to harm his chosen king. Saul left the cave and started down the road.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni.
en: Jairus, an official of the local synagogue, arrived, and when he saw Jesus, he threw himself down at his feet.

dag: Ka Pita daa yɛl o, Ɛnias, Yisa Masia tib a; dinzuɣu yiɣisima m-mal a bindoo maa yɛrigi! Ka o daa dii vaai yiɣisi.
en: Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed! He stood up immediately.

dag: Lɛvinim tiŋgbani ni ti do m-baɣi maligumaaniba tiŋgbani maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu. Di wɔɣilim zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: The Levites allotment is next to the boundary of the priests, a length of . miles and a width of . miles. The entire length is . miles and the width . miles.

dag: M mi yi tɛha mini yi ni lo nia shɛli na ni yi ti birigi ma.
en: I know what spiteful thoughts you have.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka niriba duh a yuli, ka tibigi li sahakam ka yɛra, Yawɛ nyɛla Tɔbbihi Naa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni. Chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaa zani a sani.
en: Keep your promise so that people will honor your name forever. Then people will say, The Lord All-Powerful is Israels God! I am your servant. Please let my family be strong and continue to serve you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya zuɣusa palli mini dunia palli; dama tuuli zuɣusaa mini tuuli dunia la daa vuuya, ka teeku gba lan kani.
en: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared. Now there was no sea.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni o zahim o, dama omaŋmaŋ daa mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: He said this to test Philip; actually he already knew what he would do.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli, yi ni shiri kɔhi yi puu la laɣ shɛli zaa m-bɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin, di zaa m-bala.
en: Peter asked her, Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount? Yes, she answered, that's the amount.

dag: Karimbaannim gbi ma la bɔɣ biɛri. Bɛ maanila a zaligu ansarisi.
en: The arrogant have dug pits for me— those people who act against your Instruction.

dag: Ka Mɛnahɛm daa ti kani, ka o bia Pɛkahia di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried, and his son Pekahiah succeeded him as king.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ chinchin ʒee pil li, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They shall spread a red cloth over all of this, put a fine leather cover over it, and then insert the carrying poles.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya o maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ dii zɔri chan o sani ti puhir o.
en: When the people saw Jesus, they were very surprised and ran to welcome him.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N yi naai n ni niŋdi shɛlikam Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm, n ni darigi Asiria naa tibili o karimbaani min o barinyubo zuɣu.
en: But when the Lord has finished all this work on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, he will punish the Assyrian kings arrogant actions and the boasting of his haughty eyes.

dag: Bɛ kpaai ma mi bahi kaman kom la, ka n kɔbituɣa zaa miligimiligi; ka n suhu be kaman kpam din nyɛligi la n nyɔɣu ni.
en: Im poured out like water. All my bones have fallen apart. My heart is like wax; it melts inside me.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka Naawuni nir bebu mali m-be viɛnyɛliŋga zaa, ka o mali din ni chɛ ka o tooi tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: so that the person who serves God may be fully qualified and equipped to do every kind of good deed.

dag: Bani daŋ ni: Mɛshulam mini Maluk ni Adaya ni Jashub ni Shial ni Jɛrɛmɔt so yaha.
en: Clan of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

dag: Ka ti daa wum kukoli din yi alizanda ni na di o shɛhira maa, dama ti daa be o sani zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: We ourselves heard this voice from heaven while we were with him on the holy mountain.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiri bimbira chani biribu, ka kumdi ti ʒi bɛ ni biri shɛli maa bɔba kuna ni suhupiɛlli.
en: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.

dag: ka dam zuliya kam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ daazichi zaa kuli kpe na, ka n chɛ ka duu ŋɔ mali jilima.
en: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa ŋmari daɣu ka o lɛbiɛlim ti kpaai lu kom ni. Ka o kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Ndana! N suhi li mi na.
en: As one of them was cutting down a tree, suddenly his iron ax head fell in the water. What shall I do, sir? he exclaimed to Elisha. It was a borrowed ax.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia Yisa ŋun daa chaŋ ti be Naawuni san la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti daadiini ŋɔ kirikiri.
en: Let us, then, hold firmly to the faith we profess. For we have a great High Priest who has gone into the very presence of God—Jesus, the Son of God.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ka Yawɛ zali ya ni yi niŋ, ka ŋun Yawɛ jilima yi zahira yi sani.
en: Moses said, The Lord has commanded you to do all this, so that the dazzling light of his presence can appear to you.

dag: yin di chɛ ka o gbe tia maa zuɣu, amaa yin sɔɣimiy o dindali maa, dama bɛ ni yili ninvuɣ so mia nyɛla Naawuni noli ni di so, di bi simdi ni yi ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa daɣiri.
en: you must not leave the body hanging on the tree but must bury it the same day because Gods curse is on those who are hanged. Furthermore, you must not pollute the ground that the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance.

dag: O ni ti fa yi puri mini yi wain tihi ni yi Olivi tihi puri zaa din mali vuhim n-zaŋ ti o tumtumdiba.
en: The king will take your best fields, as well as your vineyards, and olive orchards and give them to his own officials.

dag: Ka bɛ nina maa dii neei. Ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so di yɛla.
en: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.

dag: hal ti damdi Yisa tooni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋ puhir o. Doo maa daa nyɛla Samaria nira.
en: He bowed down at the feet of Jesus and thanked him. The man was from the country of Samaria.

dag: O yi daa tum a taali bee n-di a samli, nyin chɛ ka di dolila mani.
en: If he has harmed you in any way or owes you money, charge it to my account.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li mali sara maa Yawɛ tooni n-yo paɣa maa daalahichi samli, di nyaaŋa ka paɣa maa ni yi o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri maa ni. Zaligu ŋɔ gbibila paɣ so ŋunkam dɔɣi bia di yi nyɛla bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga.
en: The priest will present it before the LORD and make reconciliation for her. She will then be cleansed from her blood flow. This is the Instruction for any woman who has a child, male or female.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ nyɛla do yino ŋun be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bihi pinaayi, ŋun nyɛ ti zaa ha biasani be ti ba maa sani ka yino ŋun kani.
en: But they explained, Sir, we come from a family of twelve brothers. The youngest is still with our father in Canaan, and one of our brothers is dead.

dag: Kpiimba bi paɣiri Yawɛ, ka bɛn chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba bi paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord .

dag: M mabihi, n suhiri ya, di tumiya tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ.
en: and said, My brothers, dont do such an evil thing.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa naai, o dii yiɣisimi yi; di daa nyɛla yuŋ.
en: So when Judas took the bread, he left immediately. And it was night.

dag: Zuɣusaa niriba maa ni daa kpuɣi ninsalinim bipuɣinsi dɔɣi bihi saha shɛli mini di saha maa nyaaŋa ka tiyaawumyanim daa piligi be dunia ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn mali kpiɔŋ kurimbuni maa ha ni bɛn mali yuya.
en: The children of the supernatural beings who had married these women became famous heroes and warriors. They were called Nephilim and lived on the earth at that time and even later.

dag: Puhimiya yi zuɣulaannim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Italinim la puhiri ya.
en: Give my greetings to all your leaders and to all Gods people. All those from Italy send you their greetings.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli sapashin maa, Kulima! A ni niŋ yɛda shɛm maa zuɣu, di ni niŋ lala. Ka o yiŋbia maa daa shiri kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Then Jesus said to the officer, Go home. Your servant will be healed the way you believed he would. Right then his servant was healed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi la daa lan lab Izraɛl naa sanna ti yɛl o, Lan malimiya shili gu, ka baŋ yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama zaŋ chaŋ shɛɣuni, Siria naa ni lan labina ti liri ya.
en: Then the prophet went to King Ahab and said, The king of Aram will come back to fight again next spring. So go back and strengthen your army and make careful plans to defend yourself against him.

dag: Ka di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋubi o ni mali suhudoo sara maligu shɛli, ka di nyɛ o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa nimdi zaa o ni mal li dahin shɛli maa. O di ti chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba.
en: The flesh of your communal thanksgiving sacrifice of well-being must be eaten on the day you offer it; you cannot save any of it until morning.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Abarim zoya maa ni, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko polo la.
en: They left the mountains of Abarim and camped in the Jordan Valley in Moab. This was near the Jordan River across from Jericho.

dag: Ka na shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam gba pun di n-ʒini nimaani, ka daa su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣilinim zaa, ka deeri ba farigu.
en: Powerful kings have reigned there and have ruled over the entire province of West-of-Euphrates, collecting taxes and revenue.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi Naiɔt din be Rama tiŋgban ni maa n-chaŋ Jɔnatan sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? N taali nyɛ dini? Ka tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee dii tum a ba, ka o bɔri ni o ku ma.
en: David fled from the camps at Ramah. He came to Jonathan and asked, What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father that he wants me dead.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o kpambaliba ni o bidibisi ni o naazɔnim daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn naa. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa gbaai Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun Babilɔn naa maa nam dibu yuma anii saha kuli Babilɔn.
en: and King Jehoiachin, along with his mother, his sons, his officers, and the palace officials, surrendered to the Babylonians. In the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's reign he took Jehoiachin prisoner.

dag: Ibrahimma bidibisi daa nyɛla Yisahaku mini Ishimail.
en: Abrahams family: Isaac and Ishmael.

dag: Yi ni tahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ na bi ʒiɛmdi buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun nyɛ ti ni jɛmdi buɣ so la n-tur o.
en: The men you brought here have neither robbed the temple nor slandered our goddess.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Ilaisha daa bol anab bil so na nti yɛl o, Malim shili n-zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu ŋɔ gbib a nuu ni chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: One day, Elisha called for one of the other prophets and said: Take this bottle of olive oil and get ready to go to the town of Ramoth in Gilead.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa, dama di nyɛla dabisili din be kasi yi sani, ka ninvuɣ so yi bi gbib li, bɛn kum o. Ŋunkam tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn yihim dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: You must keep the day of rest, because it is sacred. Whoever does not keep it, but works on that day, is to be put to death.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nazari nir maa pini o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri maa niŋ biɛrisuŋ sara maligu la buɣim ni.
en: The nazirite will shave his ordained head at the meeting tents entrance, take the hair from his ordained head, and put it in the fire under the well-being sacrifice.

dag: Farisiinim ni so daa ti boli Yisa ni o ka o yiŋ na ka bɛ ti laɣim di bindirigu; ka Yisa daa chaŋ o yiŋa nti ʒini bindirigu maa dibu shee ni bɛ di.
en: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him, and Jesus went to his house and sat down to eat.

dag: Ka naa daa zaɣisi ninkura la yɛligu la, ka zaŋla halibiɛɣu yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi niriba maa.
en: The king then answered the people harshly. He ignored the elders advice.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ lala, wula ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni shee lala niŋya la yɛn niŋ pali.
en: But if I did that, how would the scriptures be fulfilled that say this must happen.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dahin shɛli tɛha ni yɛm n-zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Now you should choose some man with wisdom and insight and put him in charge of the country.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Namɔɣili so ŋun gbibi n vuhim dabisa, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri n nini, ka gbibi n daalikauli.
en: The LORD says: To the eunuchs who keep my sabbaths, choose what I desire, and remain loyal to my covenant.

dag: Ka hal Izraɛlnim ni daa ti niŋ kpiɔŋ, bɛ daa bi kari Keenannim maa zaa, amaa ka daa naɣ lee muɣisiri ba mi ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa; di gbibiya jaaŋgbɛhi bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima bee bindira bee liɣiri; yi mi di ʒin ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: He told them, Take nothing for the journey—no walking stick, no bag, no bread, no money, not even an extra shirt.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ba n-yɛn deei Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini di tooni ha tiŋgbana maa su, tinim ni yɛn deei tiŋgban shɛŋa su bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ na.
en: We will not take possession of any property among them on the other side of the Jordan, because we have received our share here east of the Jordan.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun gari dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa; nyini n-gari dunia ŋɔ wuna zaa.
en: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.

dag: Ka anab so ŋun daa goog o labisina maa daa wum li, ka yɛli, Anab so ŋun zaɣisi Yawɛ nol la m-bala. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yawɛ zaŋ o niŋ gbuɣinli maa nuu ni ka o gbaag o ku kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: When the old prophet heard the news, he said, That must be the prophet from Judah. The Lord warned him, but he disobeyed. So the Lord sent a lion to kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti garigi yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ alikauli, ka jɛmdila wun shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: This will be the answer to that question: God destroyed Jerusalem because the people of Judah stopped following the agreement of the Lord their God. They worshiped and served other gods.

dag: Nyamiya, Sintani jɛmdiba bɛn yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianima amaa ka pa Yɛhudianim la nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. N ni chɛ ka bɛ kana nti gbani yi tooni m-baŋ ni n yuri ya.
en: Listen! As for that group that belongs to Satan, those liars who claim that they are Jews but are not, I will make them come and bow down at your feet. They will all know that I love you.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sɔdom naa mini Gomɔra naa ni Adima naa ni Zɛbɔiim naa ni Bɛla naa bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Zɔa la daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ Siddim vinvamli ni.
en: At Siddim Valley, the armies of the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela fought the armies of King Chedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar. The valley.

dag: Ka jɛmbu du palli ŋɔ jilima ni gari jɛmbu du kurili la jilima, ka ni chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ kpe; man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The new Temple will be more splendid than the old one, and there I will give my people prosperity and peace. The Lord Almighty has spoken.

dag: N nyaya ka daadamnim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I looked at everything done on earth, and I saw that it is all a waste of time. It is like trying to catch the wind.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard this, he was impressed and said to the people following him, I say to you with all seriousness that even in Israel I havent found faith like this.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim yi wum n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli ma.
en: A wise person would listen to me. A wise person would say.

dag: Teemi ni a daa me ma mi kaman yaɣiri la, ka lan yɛn chɛ ka n leei taŋkpaɣu?.
en: Remember that you made me from clay, and you will return me to dust.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham a ʒiʒiinitab sani nti suhi kpaŋman kuma pam na, pa biɛla.
en: Elisha told her, Ask your neighbors for their empty jars. And after you've borrowed as many as you can.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni daa tum shɛlikam Yɛhudianim tinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm maa zaa shɛhiranima. Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ o kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o;.
en: We saw all that Jesus did in Judea and in Jerusalem. But he was killed. They put him on a cross made of wood.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa piligi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la. Amaa bɛ daa na bi sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa tampuɣili.
en: So on the first day of the seventh month, these Israelites again began offering sacrifices to the Lord . This was done, even though the Lord s Temple had not been rebuilt.

dag: ka a je suli niŋ Naawuni, ka chɛ ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yir a nol ni na?.
en: that's why you attack God with everything you say.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na nti zaŋ li mali kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: He also brought the animal for the burnt offering and offered it according to the regulations.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyaŋ ninvuɣ maŋa pam, chɛliya ka ti chɛ ba ka bɛ be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-gɔri kɔhigu bɛ yubu, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ galisiya pam; ka chɛ ka ti kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi; ka ti gba zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ba.
en: These people really are friendly. Why not let them move freely about until they find the property they want? There's enough land here for them and for us. Then our families can marry into theirs, and theirs can marry into ours.

dag: Ti bi ŋmaligi ti suhuri ka chɛ a; ti mi bi birigi ka chɛ a soli.
en: We did not turn away from you. We did not stop following you.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi gbaai ma, ka kum zana do n tooni.
en: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.

dag: O ni daa kul kpuɣ o nuu maa tiri saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la dii vaai yiɣisi bɛ dooshee ti kpe tiŋ maa ni n-deei li ka niŋ buɣim nyo li yomyom bahi.
en: When the Israelites who were hiding saw this, they quickly came out from their hiding place and hurried toward the city. They entered the city and took control of it. Then the soldiers started fires to burn the city.

dag: Buɣim ni ti di n-kabi zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni nyɔri kɔba ka di leeri tampiligim shɛm la, ka lan be kaman bɛ ni ŋma go shɛŋa sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: You will crumble like rocks burned to make lime, like thorns burned to ashes.

dag: Duumanima, yi gba niŋmiya yi daba lala, ka chɛ ba dabiɛm kpɛhibu, dama yi mi ni yi mini ba zaa Duuma be alizanda ni, ka o mi bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: Masters, behave in the same way toward your slaves and stop using threats. Remember that you and your slaves belong to the same Master in heaven, who judges everyone by the same standard.

dag: Dama o daa bi ku ma niŋ m ma pul ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m ma puli maa leei n gballi, ka o puli maa kul bara sahakam.
en: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba zuɣu, di bi lan kpa ni sara maligu din ni kpihim alahichi mali yaha.
en: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ti mali biɛhigu shee maa zali ya, n ni labina nti zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu shee, ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yi gba ni ti be.
en: When I go to prepare a place for you, I will return and take you to be with me so that where I am you will be too.

dag: ka Hashabia daa nyɛ Hilikia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Nɛtanɛl mi daa nyɛ Jɛdaya so mi daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

dag: yi ni guhi hal ni bɛ ti zooi bi dɔbba? Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka yi ku kuli dɔb shɛba? Aai, m bihi, yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani. Yawɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm maa biɛri ma pam yi zuɣu.
en: would you wait for them to become old enough to marry? No, my daughters! Life is harder for me than it is for you, because the Lord has turned against me.

dag: Chɛ ka a binyɛra kul piɛli sahakam, ka niŋmi kpam ʒiɛm a zuɣu.
en: Wear nice clothes and make yourself look good.

dag: Bɛ kul mɛrila buɣili Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Vinvamli ni la jɛmbu shee ni bɛ zaŋdi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyɔri buɣim, ka di pala n ni zali shɛli, ka mi pala din yi n tɛha ni na.
en: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.

dag: O niŋla Naawuni naani; lala zuɣu Naawuni yi bɔr o, ŋun fam o bahi pumpɔŋɔ, dama o yɛliya, N nyɛla Naawuni Bia. .
en: He trusted God, so let God save him, if he wants to. He even said he was God's Son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim maa daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nti sɔŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-tum tuma. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo, lala ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ ba.
en: After that the Levites came to the Meeting Tent to do their work. Aaron and his sons watched them. They were responsible for the work of the Levites. Aaron and his sons did what the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Ziɔnnima, Maliya suhupiɛlli pam! Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu! Nyamiya, Yi naa kani yi sanna! O nyaŋmi ka di nasara n-kanna maa, amaa o nyɛla siɣisimaŋlana, ka bari buŋa ŋun nyɛ buŋ polli.
en: People of Zion, rejoice! People of Jerusalem, shout with joy! Look, your king is coming to you! He is the good king who won the victory, but he is humble. He is riding on a donkey, on a young donkey born from a work animal.

dag: dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba m-pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: God owns the harvest. Ask him to send more workers to help gather his harvest.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naa daa bi saɣi niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la yɛli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: So the king did not do what the people wanted. The Lord caused this to happen. He did this in order to keep the promise he made to Jeroboam son of Nebat when he sent Ahijah, the prophet from Shiloh, to speak to him.

dag: Ka jɛmbu du palli ŋɔ jilima ni gari jɛmbu du kurili la jilima, ka ni chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ kpe; man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And the Lord All-Powerful said, This last Temple will be more beautiful than the first one, and I will bring peace to this place. Remember, this is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Ka man Yawɛ kul ni wuhiri ya soli sahakam, ka tiri ya binshɛŋa din simdi ya wuntaŋ tulim pam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka tin ya yaa; ka chɛ ka yi be kaman pu shɛli din puuni mali kom; ka lan chɛ ka yi be kaman kɔbil nini din kom bi ŋmaara.
en: The LORD will guide you continually and provide for you, even in parched places. He will rescue your bones. You will be like a watered garden, like a spring of water that wont run dry.

dag: Dindali maa Izraɛlnim daa zanila Mikimash n-ku Filistianim maa lala hal ti paai Aijalɔn. Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam.
en: That day the Israelites defeated the Philistines. They fought them all the way from Micmash to Aijalon. So the people were very tired and hungry.

dag: Zatu daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pihinahinaanu.
en: of Zattu.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni pirigi yi situra n-dihi ya vi.
en: Jerusalem, I will pull your skirt up over your face. Everyone will see you, and you will be ashamed.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord spoke to me again. He said.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti nya Dauda ashilɔni yɛl o, Nyama, naa suhu yur a pam, ka o tumtumdib zaa nini tiɣ a, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ leemi naa deemba! .
en: Saul commanded his officers to speak to David in private. He told them to say, Look, the king likes you. His officers like you. You should marry his daughter.

dag: O zaŋm o ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Ibrahimma ni la niŋ a min a zuliya bɛn be a san ni, ka yi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Ibrahimma, ka yi be di ni ŋɔ su.
en: He will give you and your descendants Abrahams blessing so that you will own the land in which you are now immigrants, the land God gave to Abraham.

dag: Harim daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni pinaayopɔin.
en: of Harim .

dag: Ti bi lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni nyara, amaa ti lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni bi nyara, dama nir nini ni nyari binshɛŋa nyɛla din ku yuui, amaa binshɛŋa nir nini ni bi nyari nyɛla din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: We dont focus on the things that can be seen but on the things that cant be seen. The things that can be seen dont last, but the things that cant be seen are eternal.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam pala bindira mini binnyura yɛla, amaa di nyɛla wuntia mini suhudoo ni suhupiɛlli yɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: In Gods kingdom, what we eat and drink is not important. Here is what is important: a right way of life, peace, and joy—all from the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu, o yi ti chɛ ka di biɛɣ maa neesim neei yi alizanda ni na.
en: With the loving mercy of our God, a new day from heaven will shine on us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi Midiannim maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm n-ku dɔbba zaa.
en: They attacked Midian, as the Lord had commanded Moses, and killed all the men.

dag: Amaa bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa n-nyɛ nir ni ni di shɛli ka ku kpi.
en: This is the bread that comes down from heaven so that whoever eats from it will never die.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asiba ka Yisa labiri Jɛrusalɛm ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: When Jesus got up the next morning, he was hungry. He started out for the city.

dag: O daba maa bihi ni ti su li, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ti be nimaani.
en: the descendants of his servants will inherit it, and those who love him will live there.

dag: mini Salima ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm ba la ni Harɛf ŋun mi daa nyɛ Bɛtigadɛr ba la.
en: his second son Salma founded Bethlehem, and his third son Hareph founded Bethgader.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N sara maligu dabisili maa dali, n ni ti darigi kpambaliba mini nabihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri tinduya ni binyɛra la tibili.
en: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.

dag: Ibinɛya daa nyɛla Jɛrɔham bia, ka Ɛla daa nyɛ Uzi bia, ka Uzi daa nyɛ Mikiri bia, ka Mɛshulam daa nyɛ Shɛfatia bia, ka Shɛfatia daa nyɛ Riuɛl bia, ka Riuɛl nyɛ Ibinija bia.
en: Ibneiah, Jerohams son; Elah son of Uzzi son of Michri; Meshullam son of Shephatiah son of Reuel son of Ibnijah.

dag: Man Pool mini Timoti bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia daba la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la mini cheechi zuɣulaannim ni sɔŋdiba bɛn be Filipai.
en: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.

dag: Hal Siria tɔbbihi maa ni daa bi galisi maa zaa yoli, Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, dama tɔbbihi maa daa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa darigi Jɔash tibili.
en: The Syrian army was small, but the Lord let them defeat a much larger Judean army because the people had abandoned him, the Lord God of their ancestors. In this way King Joash was punished.

dag: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa m-bala, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is the land that you will distribute as an inheritance for the tribes of Israel. These are their portions. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini noonsi balibu kam n-zaŋ ba na ti ti ninsal ni o nya o ni yɛn boli ba yu shɛŋa; ka ninsal ni daa boli binnɛɔŋ kam zaa yu shɛli, o yuli n-kul bala.
en: So he took some soil from the ground and formed all the animals and all the birds. Then he brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and that is how they all got their names.

dag: amaa ka labina nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom luɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom la zuɣu, o ku chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a sɔɣi pah a yaannim ni. .
en: You came back and ate food and drank water in this place. But he had commanded you: Dont eat food! Dont drink water! Now your body wont go to the grave of your ancestors.

dag: Naawuni yino ŋun nyɛ ti zaa Ba, ka nyɛ ti zaa Duuma ŋun be ti zaa ni ka tumdi ti zaa ni la m-beni.
en: There is one God and Father of us all, who rules over everyone. He works through all of us and in all of us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali buɣim sɔŋ dundɔŋ sunsuuni ʒiya wuɣisira, ka Pita daa chaŋ ti ʒini pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: A fire had been lit in the center of the courtyard, and Peter joined those who were sitting around it.

dag: To, m mabihi, n chɛbisiri ya mi ŋɔ. Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be dɛde! Doliya n saɣisigu; maliya naŋgban yini; maliya suhudoo ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yurilimlana mini suhudoolana ŋɔ be yi sani.
en: Now, brothers and sisters, be filled with joy. Try to make everything right, and do what I have asked you to do. Agree with each other, and live in peace. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa guui yomyom chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, do so ŋun daa ka n sanna la lan yi n zuɣu.
en: So the woman ran to tell her husband, The man is back! The man who came to me the other day is here.

dag: o biɛhigu shee mini di suɣili ni din yɛn pil li ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: the dwelling, its tent and its covering, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its posts, and its bases.

dag: Kuhimiya boli ma yi muɣisigu dali, ka n tiligi ya, ka yi ti ma jilima.
en: Call to me when trouble comes; I will save you, and you will praise me.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni di n-tiɣi ka zaɣis a ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ. Bee n yi nyɛ faralana n ni zu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ta n Naawuni yuli daɣiri.
en: If I have more, I might say that I do not need you. But if I am poor, I might steal and bring disgrace on my God.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, Naawuni biɛhigu ni be o ni ka o nyɛ Naawuni bia maa zuɣu ka o ku tooi tum alahichi.
en: Those who are Gods children do not continue to sin, because the new life God gave them stays in them. They cannot keep sinning, because they have become children of God.

dag: Naawuni ni daa saɣindi vinvamli ni tinsi maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa teei Ibrahimma yɛla, ka yihi Lɔt o ni daa saɣindi tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Lɔt ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛl la n-tilig o.
en: When God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot lived, he remembered his promise to Abraham and saved Lot from the terrible destruction.

dag: bɛ daa kul darimi gindi tinsi, ka dari gindi nam sulinsi tiŋgbana.
en: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.

dag: Zomiya tiligi yi nyɛviya. Zomiya kaman mɔɣu ni buŋa m-be tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Run for your lives! Be like Aroer in the desert.

dag: A min a zuliya maa ni yɛn doli n daalikauli shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni yi puuni doo kam guni.
en: You and your descendants must all agree to circumcise every male among you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ɛdom zoli zani dabari bahi yoli. Ka n chɛ ka bɛn zaa daa yi kanna ka chana ku lan kana.
en: I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it.

dag: Ka Samsin daa chaŋ ka o mini paɣisarili maa ti nya taba, ka Samsin suhu daa yu o pam.
en: When they got to Timnah, Samson talked to the woman, and he was sure that she was the one for him.

dag: Dindali maa yi zaa ni ti zaŋ yi daanzinfa buɣa mini salima buɣa din nyɛ yi nuhi ni tum alahichi m-malila labi.
en: That is because when those things happen, people will reject the gold and silver idols you made when you sinned against me.

dag: Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ ni, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o kpe.
en: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples.

dag: O daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma mini nayili nɛma zaa, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma salima la shɛŋa zaa Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm.
en: The Lord had warned that someday the treasures would be taken from the royal palace and from the temple, including the gold objects that Solomon had made for the temple. And that's exactly what Nebuchadnezzar ordered his soldiers to do.

dag: N shɛla buɣu m-pɔbi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ n yaa sɔŋ taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: Ive sewed rough cloth over my skin and buried my dignity in the dust.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ Dauda sani Zikilag saha shɛl o ni daa bi lan tooi yiri palo gɔr o yubu, Kish bia Sool zuɣu la gba daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋ o tuhi tɔbu la.
en: Some time earlier, David had gone to live in the town of Ziklag to escape from King Saul. While David was there, several brave warriors joined him to help fight his battles.

dag: Bɛ ni pam daa yɛlimi, Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu! O kpɛla yinyari! Bɔzuɣu ka yi wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Many of them said, A demon has come into him and made him crazy. Why listen to him.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni, ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who really knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.

dag: N zɔri ni di pa shɛli ka n ti lab yi sanna ka Naawuni ti siɣisi ma yi sani, ka n fabili bɛn daa tum alahichi ka na bi niŋ tuuba bɛ daɣiri tuma mini bɛ zina niŋbu ni bɛ kɔr biɛri tuun shɛŋa bɛ ni tumdila zuɣu.
en: I am afraid that the next time I come my God will humiliate me in your presence, and I shall weep over many who sinned in the past and have not repented of the immoral things they have done—their lust and their sexual sins.

dag: Dama bɛ tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa nyɛla diribarilimnima bɛn suhuri kul yɛla zalinsi dibu zuɣu. Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: From the least to the greatest, each is eager to profit; from prophet to priest, each trades in dishonesty.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi ni yi yaansi ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi nyɛvili ni zaa, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaŋ wuhiri ya ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: so that you will fear the LORD your God by keeping all his regulations and his commandments that I am commanding you—both you and your sons and daughters—all the days of your life and so that you will lengthen your life.

dag: Ka Jɔn garigi yɛli, Kom ni ka man baptaiziri niriba; amaa so ʒe yi sani kpe, ka yi bi mi o.
en: John answered, I baptize with water. Someone greater stands among you, whom you dont recognize.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti kpe yil shɛli, ka bi bɔri ni so baŋ o yɛla, amaa ka daa bi tooi sɔɣ omaŋa.
en: Jesus left and went to the region near the town of Tyre, where he stayed in someone's home. He did not want people to know he was there, but they found out anyway.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, So di zaŋ li zali hal ni asiba.
en: Moses said to them, No one is to keep any of it for tomorrow.

dag: Ziɔn nachimbihi daa ŋmanila salima ti sani. Nyam bɛ ni niŋ ba shɛm kaman yaɣiri duɣ shɛŋa yaɣimɛra ni zaŋ o nuhi me la.
en: The precious people of Zion were once worth more than gold. But now they are treated like something worthless, like the cheap clay jars a potter makes.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Go tell Pharaoh that he must let the Israelites leave his land.

dag: So miri ka o ti niŋ bindirigu ti bɛn kumdi kuyila ni o maai bɛ suhuri bɛ kpiimba maa zuɣu bee n-ti ba binnyurigu ni bɛ nyu ka bɛ suhuri maai hal di yi kul nyɛla bɛ banim bee bɛ manim kum zuɣu gba.
en: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.

dag: Dama Yawɛ sagbani maa daa kul bela o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa wuntaŋ ni, yuŋ mi ka buɣim be sagbani maa puuni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni bɛ chandi maa zaa ni.
en: So the cloud of the Lord was over the Holy Tent during the day, and at night there was a fire in the cloud. So all the Israelites could see the cloud while they traveled.

dag: Bɛ daa kul darimi gindi kaman bɛn kɔŋ kpɛhili shee, ka be mɔɣu ni mini zoya zuɣu chana, ka be kuɣa lɔna ni mini voyari ni. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma n-yaɣi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu zuɣu.
en: The world was not good enough for these great people. They had to wander in deserts and mountains, living in caves and holes in the ground.

dag: Ninsal kam ŋun tumdi tuumbiɛri ni nya nahiŋgu mini wahala, Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya;.
en: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil, for the Jew first and also for the Greek.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa; n ni yɛl a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I will thank you, LORD, with all my heart; I will talk about all your wonderful acts.

dag: N kpamdi Yuɔdia mini Sintike jaande ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ noya naai taba ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: Euodia and Syntyche, please, I beg you, try to agree as sisters in the Lord.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl yɛl o, Karimba, a nyɛla Naawuni Bia! A nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa.
en: Teacher, answered Nathanael, you are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, zaŋm ti labis a sani, ka chɛ ka ti lan lab a sanna. Chɛ ka ti lan labi ti biɛr kurili la ni.
en: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.

dag: Daba bɛn yi n-zo bɛ laamba sani n-ka yi sanna, yin di lan zaŋ ba labisi ti bɛ laamba maa.
en: Dont return slaves to owners if theyve escaped and come to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti gbibi ti ni daa pun wum yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa la viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣu ti ku ʒi ti chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: So we must be more careful to follow what we were taught. We must be careful so that we will not be pulled away from the true way.

dag: Di ni daa be shɛm hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli.
en: In those days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day Noah entered the ark.

dag: Alɔbɔnima n-doli taba, tiŋgbani maa zaa bahila yoli. Yim ka bɛ daa ti dii saɣim n suɣa, ka chahi m pateesanima.
