en: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land is ruined. Suddenly, my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.

dag: Kɔra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asir mini Ɛlikana ni Abiasaf. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ niriba.
en: Korah had three sons: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; they were the ancestors of the divisions of the clan of Korah.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Bɛlishaaza daa ti laɣim o kpambaliba tuhili na ni bɛ ti puhi chu titali ka nyu wain.
en: King Belshazzar gave a big party for of his officials. The king was drinking wine with them.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n nyari zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu mini yɛlimuɣisira? Saɣiŋgu mini damli dambu kul bela n tooni; ka zabili mini suhuyiɣisili kul yiɣisira.
en: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi kom maa ni na maa ka ti Duuma Shia Kasi daa kpuɣi Filip chaŋ, ka namɔɣili maa bi lan nya o, ka mi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When they came up out of the water, the Lords Spirit suddenly took Philip away. The eunuch never saw him again but went on his way rejoicing.

dag: N ŋmanila bɛ ni chɛ kpiin shɛb bahi, ka ŋmani bɛ ni ku shɛb ka bɛ do gbala puuni, ka lan ŋman a ni bi lan teeri shɛb yɛla yaha, dama bɛ nyɛla a baɣa ni lan ka shɛb sɔŋsim ni.
en: drifting among the dead, lying in the grave, like dead bodies— those you dont remember anymore, those who are cut off from your power.

dag: Ka o mini niriba maa gbaai saawara naai, ka o daa pii baansi shɛba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ neen kasinim yɛna ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka baansi maa daa gari tɔbbihi maa tooni ka ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o yurilim bi naara.
en: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: Praise the Lord ! His love never ends.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul yɛr o lala saha shɛli maa, ka nayili namɔɣilisi paana nti zaŋ Haman yomyom chaŋ Ɛsta ni daa pun duɣi bindir shɛŋa la dibu.
en: While they were still talking to Haman, the kings eunuchs came to Hamans house. They made Haman hurry to the party that Esther had prepared.

dag: ka nyin Ayuba yaag a noli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ŋɔ, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka bi mi di gbinni maa.
en: So he continues his worthless talking. Everything he has said shows he does not know what he is talking about.

dag: Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his ancestor King David, he did what was pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Di saha maa Abiata bia Jɔnatan mini Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa sɔɣila Ɛnrɔgɛl, ka bipuɣimbil so chani ti yɛri ba dinkam beni, ka bɛ mi zaŋdi li chani ti yɛri Naa Dauda, dama bɛ daa bi bɔr ni bɛ kpe tiŋ puuni ka so nya ba.
en: Jonathan and Ahimaaz had been waiting at Rogel Spring because they did not want to be seen in Jerusalem. A servant girl went to the spring and gave them the message for David.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ ti du Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka Abimilɛk ti zaŋ lɛhu ŋ-ŋma dabɔbili n-zaŋ li buɣi; ka yɛli bɛn be o sani, Yi ni nya ka n niŋ shɛm maa, yi gba niŋmiya lala yomyom.
en: So Abimelech and all his men went up to Mount Zalmon. Abimelech took an ax and cut off some branches and carried them on his shoulders. Then Abimelech said to the men with him, Hurry! Do the same thing that I have done.

dag: Bomiya bua mini naɣilaa ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara hal ti paai daba ayopɔin.
en: You will prepare a goat every day for seven days for a sin offering. Also, you will prepare a young bull and a ram from the flock. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.

dag: N ni yu shɛm mini n tahima nyɛla ni n di kɔŋ n tuma tumbu, amaa ka kul ni tumdi li mi sahakam, di bahi bamdi pumpɔŋɔ. N ni mali suhukpeeni ka di chɛ ka n ti Masia jilima n niŋgbuŋ zaa puuni, n yi be bee n yi kpimi.
en: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.

dag: Amaa Abimilɛk daa na bi zaŋ Zara dɔni, dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔhi, N Duuma, a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali?.
en: But Abimelech had not yet slept with Sarah, so he said, Lord, I am not guilty. Would you kill an innocent man?.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi so zuɣu maa dii kahi nti kpe bɛ ni n-nyaŋ bɛ zaa m-bu n-ti ba dansi, ka bɛ zo ni bɛ zaɣim n-yi yili maa ni.
en: Then the man who had the evil spirit inside him jumped on these Jews. He was much stronger than all of them. He beat them up and tore their clothes off. They all ran away from that house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lab Ilaisha sanna Jɛriko o ni daa be luɣ shɛli, ka o bɔhi ba, N daa pun bi yɛli ya ni yi di chaŋ.
en: Then they returned to Elisha, who had waited at Jericho, and he said to them, Didn't I tell you not to go.

dag: Bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidib dɔɣirisi shɛb chaŋ ka bɛ ti leei namɔɣilisi be Babilɔn naa yiŋa.
en: Some of your own direct descendants will be taken away and made eunuchs to serve in the palace of the king of Babylonia.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka Pita ni daa yi duu maa ni shɛm yɛla gari duguliba maa pam, ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri di zuɣu.
en: The next morning the soldiers were flustered about what had happened to Peter.

dag: Zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣim o! Kom din be sagbana zuɣusaa ha, paɣim o.
en: Praise him, highest heaven! Waters above the sky, praise him!.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi wuntampuhili saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early on Sunday morning, at sunrise, they went to the tomb.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi di di zaa din dali maa, di bi simdi ka yi guui shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: It must be eaten on the same day; you must not leave any of it until morning; I am the LORD.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa be suɣa ni gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni kɔbiga. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛn yiɣisi doli chani pahi buta.
en: These , troops will march into battle third.

dag: Amaa di daa nyɛla Yawɛ yubu ni o chɛ ka o nya dansi ni biɛrim. O daa chɛ ka o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima alahichi zuɣu, ka o ni ti nya o zuliya, ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli. Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali o zuɣu.
en: But the LORD wanted to crush him and to make him suffer. If his life is offered as restitution, he will see his offspring; he will enjoy long life. The LORDs plans will come to fruition through him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai sinsabiga maa gbin na n-kpalim zani lihi di zuɣu ka yɛli, Zakius, siɣimina yomyom, dama di kpala talahi ni n kpe a yiŋ zuŋɔ.
en: When Jesus got there, he looked up and said, Zacchaeus, hurry down! I want to stay with you today.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nir maa daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl naa, Miri ka a doli yaakaza polo, dama Sirianim yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni la nimaani.
en: Each time, Elisha would send this warning to the king of Israel: Don't go near there. That's where the Syrian troops have set up camp.

dag: Amaa hal yi yi di wahala wuntia zuɣu, yi mal alibarika. Di zɔriya ninsalinima bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: But even if you should suffer for doing what is right, how happy you are! Do not be afraid of anyone, and do not worry.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tum alahiziba tuma niriba ŋɔ sani, ka di gari ba ka niŋ ba alahiziba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ni leei jɛra, ka bɛ yɛm maa leei din ka buchi.
en: So I will startle them with one unexpected blow after another. Those who are wise will turn out to be fools, and all their cleverness will be useless.

dag: A ni kul yiɣisina, a na mi n-zali asiba di ni yɛn piligi saha shɛli? Ka chɛ ka biɛɣu neebu mi di biɛhigu shee?.
en: In your lifetime have you commanded the morning, informed the dawn of its place.

dag: Obadia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ daa tim o tumo zuliya shɛb sani, ka ti wum o yɛligu maa. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Malimiya shili ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnima.
en: This is the prophecy of Obadiah—what the Sovereign Lord said about the nation of Edom. The Lord has sent his messenger to the nations, and we have heard his message: Get ready! Let us go to war against Edom.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o nuu pa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa zuɣu, ka niriba maa daa lan nab pahi ka niŋ yaa.
en: The nurses trusted God, so he was good to them and allowed them to have their own families. The Hebrews continued to have more children, and they became very strong.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka malaika maa kuri niriba maa, di saha ka o daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, n tum taali, Mani n-tum zaɣ biɛɣ maa, ka bɔ ka piɛri ŋɔ mi lee niŋ? Dinzuɣu n suhir a mi, darigim la m mini n daŋ niriba kɔŋko tibili.
en: When David saw the messenger who was striking down the people, he said, Im the one who sinned! Im the one who has done wrong. But these sheep—what have they done wrong? Turn your hand against me and my household.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo mini di sambani gba yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The distance across the front of the Temple, including the open space on either side, was also feet.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi daa palila Yisa ka o yi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo na, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa zaŋ o chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Now filled with the Holy Spirit, Jesus returned from the Jordan River. And then the Spirit led him into the desert.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka daa ku Filistianim maa Gɛba hal ti paai Gɛza.
en: David did what the Lord had commanded, and was able to drive the Philistines back from Geba all the way to Gezer.

dag: Dabiɛm ka yurilim puuni, ka yurilim din niŋ dɛde nyɛla din yihiri dabiɛm bahira. Dama dabiɛm mini tibidarigibo n-dol taba; dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm, yurilim na bi niŋ dɛde o ni.
en: Where Gods love is, there is no fear, because Gods perfect love takes away fear. It is his punishment that makes a person fear. So his love is not made perfect in the one who has fear.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee viɛli gari? Siɣimiya tiŋgban ni ti dɔni pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu.
en: Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down and take your bed with the uncircumcised.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa nim daa pun baŋ ni Mɔdɛkai mali yiko pam nayili, ka o yiko maa mi kul pahirimi.
en: It was well-known throughout the empire that Mordecai was now a powerful man in the palace and was growing more powerful.

dag: Zanimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔdali gbini n-yɛli ba nimaani, Judanim zaa bɛn doli dunoya ŋɔ kpɛri ti jɛmdi Yawɛ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Stand near the gate of the LORDs temple and proclaim there this message: Listen to the LORDs word, all you of Judah who enter these gates to worship the LORD.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni bee ka paɣ zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu ka o min o dɔni; di nyɛla biriginsim.
en: Men, you must not have sexual relations with any animal. This will make you filthy. And women, you must not have sexual relations with any animal. It is against nature!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim puuni Naawuni Shia Kasi kahigi wuhi ni tuuli tanti duu la ni daa na kul ʒiɛya la zuɣu, di wuhiya ni Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la soli na bi yooi.
en: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, N fabilimi niŋ naa ni o di lan zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ ka n ti kpi nimaani. .
en: you should say to them, I was begging the king not to send me back to the house of Jonathan to die there.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi bɛn guli naa sapashin kpɛm la daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulana Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: The commander of the guard also took away Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank, and the three doorkeepers.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Olivi tia dari m-mali chɛrubinima ayi n-zali du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi shee maa puuni. Chɛrubi yino kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made from olive wood to put in the most holy place. Each creature was four and a half meters tall.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi fiɛb o bupihinahi, amaa di bi simdi ni di gari lala. Bɛ yi fiɛb o gari lala dindina yi ʒiʒiinikpee maa ni nya filiŋ yi ninni.
en: Dont hit anyone more than times during punishment, because more than that means that their life is not important to you.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a.
en: Then Peter spoke up, Look, we have left everything and followed you.

dag: O daa zaŋla niriba niŋ sapashin kpamba nuu ni, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣim fɔŋ maa dunɔdali palo ni, ka o daa tɔɣisi ba suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: and he appointed army commanders over the troops. Then he gathered the troops together in the open area in front of the city gate and said to them:.

dag: Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn ba la daa bela Gibiɔn, ka o paɣa yuli daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel was Gibeons father. He and his wife, Maacah, lived in the town of Gibeon.

dag: N dimnim kul sɔɣirimi yɛri ŋumaŋuma n-jɛndiri ma, ka lɔri ma nia biɛri dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: All day long they attack with words and whispers.

dag: Tan tolli kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu daa nyɛla yim.
en: Each curtain was the same size— cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Ka Ariok daa dii zaŋ Daniɛl n-kpɛhi Naa Nɛbukadnɛza sani ti yɛl o, Naa, n nya Juda daba la ni yino ŋun ni tooi wuh a a zahindi la gbinni.
en: So very quickly, Arioch took Daniel to the king. Arioch said to the king, I have found a man among the captives from Judah who can tell the king what his dream means.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli ba, Firawuna yɛliya, N ku lan tin ya mɔri.
en: The slave drivers and the Israelite foremen went out and said to the Israelites, The king has said that he will not supply you with any more straw.

dag: Ka n lo alikauli ni n ni yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni wahala maa ni n-zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: and I promise to lead them out of their troubles. I will give them a land rich with milk and honey, where the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites now live.

dag: Ka a pii Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ba ti Aduna min o bidibisi, ka bɛ nyɛ o ni su shɛb fukumsi zaa.
en: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons. The Levites were chosen from all the Israelites to help Aaron and his sons.

dag: Di saha Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛla bɛ alichɛbbanim ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi kabɔɣili din daa be Samaria dunɔdali gbin la ni ka anabinim maa zaa daa ʒe bɛ tooni n-tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Now Israels king and Judahs King Jehoshaphat were sitting on their thrones dressed in their royal robes at the threshing floor beside the entrance to the gate of Samaria. All the prophets were prophesying in front of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Dan zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Dan was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim din nyɛ ti daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ la.
en: He set us free through the Son and forgave our sins.

dag: Bɛ daa bela nimaani kaman yuun pia, ka Malɔn mini Kiliɔn gba daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi ka o kpalim o kɔŋko ka lan ka yidana bee bihi.
en: Mahlon and Chilion also died, and Naomi was left all alone, without husband or sons.

dag: Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam dindali maa; dama Sool daa pola pɔri yɛli, Ŋunkam di bindirigu ka wuntaŋ na bi lu n ni bɔhiri n dimnim biɛri dahin shɛli ŋɔ, noli din dim o. Lala zuɣu niriba maa ni so noli daa bi to bindirigu.
en: The Israelites were weak with hunger that day, because Saul, with a solemn oath, had given the order: A curse be on anyone who eats any food today before I take revenge on my enemies. So nobody had eaten anything all day.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣidira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Every day the king of Babylon paid Jehoiachin enough to take care of his needs until the day Jehoiachin died.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ kul ʒila o nam ʒiishee sahakam, ka zal o nam ʒiishee ni o kari saria.
en: But the Lord is king forever; he has set up his throne for judgment.

dag: n-zaŋ li yɛrigi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni daa yuri binshɛŋa ka tumdi di tuma, ka dol li, ka jɛmdi li la, ka so ti ku lan va bɛ kɔba maa bee n-zaŋ li pi. Di ti kul yɛn dola tiŋgban ni kaman naɣibindi la.
en: and exposed to the sun, the moon, and the whole heavenly forces, which they have loved and served and which they have followed, consulted, and worshipped. Their bones wont be gathered for reburial but will become like refuse lying on the ground.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Cham Juda nayili nti zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ba.
en: The Lord told me to go to the palace of the king of Judah, the descendant of David, and there tell the king, his officials, and the people of Jerusalem to listen to what the Lord had said:.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔhi ba pahi buta, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? M bi nya ka o tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi.
en: Pilate spoke to them a third time, But what crime has he done? I have not found him guilty of anything for which he should be put to death. I will have him beaten with a whip and set free.

dag: Ka nachimba pia bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔab gbaɣino ʒiriba daa laɣim gili Absalom m-bahi jɛh o.
en: Ten of Joab's bodyguards came over and finished him off.

dag: Ka bɛn ti yɛn bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu nyɛla Isaka zuliya. Isaka niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Zua bia Nɛtanɛl.
en: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to the tribe of Judah. The leader of the tribe of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said:.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, tinim ka a lee ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ bee sokam zaa.
en: Peter asked Jesus, Did you say this just for us or for everyone.

dag: N niriba maa kul kpɛrila yɔɣu ka chɛri ma, dinzuɣu ka n zali ba ni bɛ ʒi ʒi tibisa maa, ka so ku tooi yihi li.
en: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Ɛdomnim tinsi din kpalim la mini tin shɛŋa din zaa daa pun nyɛ n tinsi la. Yawɛ ŋun yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ maa n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And so the people of Israel will conquer what is left of the land of Edom and all the nations that were once mine, says the Lord , who will cause this to happen.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl ni daa nya ka bɛ bi deeg o yikombiɛlim soli maa, ka o dii pa o buŋ gali n-kul o ya nti malimal o yiŋ binshɛɣukam zali dɛde ka yil omaŋ mia kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o yaannim siliga ni.
en: When Ahithophel saw that the Israelites did not do what he suggested, he saddled his donkey and went back to his hometown. He made plans for his family and then hanged himself. They buried him in his fathers tomb.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Then Jesus gave them strict orders not to tell this to anyone.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dundɔŋ maa. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ mita pihinu. Di daa nyɛla mɔɣumɔɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni.
en: Then he measured the courtyard. It was square, one hundred fifty feet long and one hundred fifty feet wide. The altar was in front of the temple.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Matiu maa yiŋa n-daa ti ʒini ni o di bindirigu, ka farigudeeriba pam mini alahichinim kana nti ʒini pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: While Jesus was having a meal in Matthew's house, many tax collectors and other outcasts came and joined Jesus and his disciples at the table.

dag: Waazuyihira maa boya ni o nya yɛtɔɣa din tuhi, ka o ni sab yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa.
en: The Teacher tried very hard to find the right words, and he wrote the teachings that are true and dependable.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ di gba mini di naa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku niriba bɛn zaa be di ni, ka so daa bi kpalim; ka daa niŋ di naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.

dag: Paɣ yi zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu kam ka o gol o, bɛn kum paɣa maa mini biŋkɔbigu maa, kumiya ba, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a woman tries to have sexual relations with an animal, she and the animal shall be put to death. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: N sabila dimbɔŋɔ tin ya ni n yɛli ya bɛn bɔri ni bɛ yɔhim ya la yɛla;.
en: I write these things to you about those who are attempting to deceive you.

dag: Zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ puuni, yinim ka m pii, dinzuɣu n ni darigi yi tibili yi tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu.
en: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun kalimi daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa o ni yi daɣiri ni.
en: Seven days after the woman gets well, she will be considered clean.

dag: Nyini n-su teeku din kul damdi pampam ŋɔ yiko; di kɔgbana yi ti yiɣisi, nyini n-chɛri ka di maari dooni baalim.
en: You rule the stormy sea. You can calm its angry waves.

dag: Chɛ ka n kpe a biŋkɔbiri maa ni zuŋɔ ti gahim piɛ shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi mini bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni piɛbihi sabila ni bu shɛb bɛn mali sabilimsabilim mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bubihi sabila; ka bɛ leei n yɔri.
en: Let me go through all your flocks today and take every black lamb and every spotted or speckled young goat. That is all the wages I want.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kpa viɛl shɛli mini wain viɛla zaa ni chi ni bindiri daŋda shɛŋa zaa ti man Yawɛ, n zaŋ li tin ya.
en: And I give you all the best olive oil and all the best new wine and grain. These are the things that the Israelites give to me, the Lord . These are the first things that they gather in their harvest.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu ka di simdi ni n na be n nyɛvil ni.
en: but for your sake it is much more important that I remain alive.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba. Bɛ ŋmanila bɔrɔbɔro du shɛli bɛ ni mali buɣim niŋ ka di bii, ka bɔrɔbɔromaana bi lan niŋ buɣim niŋ di ni bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔribu saha hal ti paai di dubu saha la.
en: They all act like adulterers; they are like a heated oven, whose baker doesnt need to stoke the fire, from the kneading of the dough until it is leavened.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: So Jesus said, Well, then, pay to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, and pay to God what belongs to God.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani kpa shɛli din boori bahiri niriba zuɣu mini tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet-smelling incense;.

dag: Amaa a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu, n ni tooi kpe a jɛmbu duu nti gbani a duu din be kasi maa puuni ni sizuura.
en: But by your great mercy, I can enter your house. I can worship in your holy Temple with fear and respect for you.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa yu ni bɛ niŋ lala, ka di mi shiri simdi ni bɛ niŋ lala ti ba, dama bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi daa nya Naawuni alibarika Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zuɣu, dindina di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba zaŋ dunia ŋɔ binyara sɔŋ ba.
en: That decision was their own; but, as a matter of fact, they have an obligation to help them. Since the Jews shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles, the Gentiles ought to use their material blessings to help the Jews.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi sɔŋbu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni n lab ŋun tim ma na maa sani, dama n yi bi labi, Sɔŋda la ku ka yi sanna; amaa n yi labi, n ni tim o yi sanna.
en: I assure you that it is better for you that I go away. If I dont go away, the Companion wont come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

dag: Siria tinsi ni zani dabari zaa. Mɔri ni be nimaani, ka niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubira, ka so ku kari ba.
en: People will leave the cities of Aroer. Flocks of sheep will wander freely in those empty towns; there will be no one to bother them.

dag: O kurimmi, ka dɔni kaman gbuɣindaa la. O ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yiɣis o? Ŋunkam niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, o ni nya alibarika; ka ŋunkam yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi yi zuɣu, yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu maa din dim o.
en: Israel is like a lion, curled up and lying down. Yes, they are like a young lion, and no one wants to wake him! Anyone who blesses you will be blessed. And anyone who curses you will have great troubles.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ti bi lan lihiri so kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm; hal ti ni daa lihi Masia kaman daadamnim ni lihir o shɛm la, ti bi lan lihir o lala.
en: No longer, then, do we judge anyone by human standards. Even if at one time we judged Christ according to human standards, we no longer do so.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm n-niŋ yuun pihinunaayi. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛkolia.
en: at the age of sixteen, and he ruled in Jerusalem for fifty-two years. His mother was Jecoliah from Jerusalem.

dag: Di yi pa lala Yawɛ ni nya li, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o ku lan yiɣisi o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord will see this, and he might be upset with you and decide not to punish your enemy.

dag: ka o daa pun lo ni o ni zaŋ ti tah omaŋmaŋ sani n-chɛ ka ti leeg o bihi Yisa Masia zuɣu; o ni daa lo shɛm min o yubu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: God destined us to be his adopted children through Jesus Christ because of his love. This was according to his goodwill and plan.

dag: Amaa di niŋ kamaata ni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu yihi ti zuliya kam pɔi.
en: First, the good news must be proclaimed to all the nations.

dag: ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Ɛr.
en: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, whom she named Er.

dag: Ŋun yɛn zani n nyaaŋa mirina. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi n taali ni nyɛ shɛli? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun fiɣisiri ma maa? O chɛ ka m min o chaŋ ʒiishee, ka ti gbɛri ti kpa taba.
en: for God is near, and he will prove me innocent. Does anyone dare bring charges against me? Let us go to court together! Let him bring his accusation!.

dag: Yɛm bi boonila niriba? Ka tɛhi zilima mi duhiri di yee?.
en: Listen, Wisdom is calling. Yes, Understanding is shouting for us.

dag: Doo miri ka o kpuɣ o ba paɣa n-filim o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o nya o ba zaɣim.
en: A man must not bring shame to his father by marrying his fathers wife.

dag: Ʒiɛman yini niriba ni paɣ a a ni tum shɛm zuɣu ʒiɛman shɛli niriba sani, ka yɛl a yiko tuma yɛla.
en: What you have done will be praised from one generation to the next; they will proclaim your mighty acts.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣiri tiŋgbani din daa be Sukɔt mini Zɛrɛda sunsuuni la ni ka Naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa.
en: The king had them all made in the foundry between Sukkoth and Zeredah in the Jordan Valley.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, M bi tim ba yi sanna, amaa bɛ zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisirila ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka n kari ya bahi ka yi mini bɛna anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa ti kpi. .
en: I havent sent these prophets, declares the LORD; they are prophesying falsely in my name. If you listen to them, I will drive you out, and you will perish, both you and your prophets!.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛli, Mmaŋmaŋ kɔbili mini mmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ m-bɔŋɔ. O yuli m-booni paɣa, dama doo niŋgbuŋ ni ka o yina.
en: Then the man said, At last, here is one of my own kind— Bone taken from my bone, and flesh from my flesh. Woman is her name because she was taken out of man.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa be suɣa ni gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni kɔbiga. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛn yiɣisi doli chani pahi buta.
en: All those enlisted in Ephraims camp with their military units are . They will march third.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔb so ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni nti yo alahichi samli luɣ kasi shee, di bi simdi ka so ŋubi di nimdi maa. Di simdi ni yi nyo li la buɣim.
en: But if the blood of the sin offering was taken into the Meeting Tent and used in the Holy Place to make people pure, that sin offering must not be eaten. It must be completely burned in the fire.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔriti gbaai Firawuna min o yiŋnima, Ibram paɣ Zarai maa zuɣu.
en: Pharaoh took Abrams wife, so the Lord caused Pharaoh and all the people in his house to have very bad diseases.

dag: Tuuni kam nyɛla din tuhi ŋun tum li sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi suhu.
en: You may think that everything you do is right, but remember that the Lord judges your motives.

dag: Ka Nɛgɛbinim ti deei Iso Zoli su; ka bɛn be zolɔna ni wulinluhili polo la ti deei Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Izraɛlnim ni ti deei Ifriim mini Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi ti deei Giliad su.
en: Those of the arid southern plain will possess Mount Esau, and those of the western foothills, the land of the Philistines; they will possess the land of Ephraim and the land of Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

dag: Bɛ nina ni lihibu di ba shɛhira; bɛ tum alahichi palɔni ka bi sɔɣiri li kaman Sɔdomnima. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Dama bɛ bo yɛl biɛɣu ti bɛmaŋa.
en: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves.

dag: Ka Annas daa chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Kaiafas sani.
en: So Annas sent Jesus to Caiaphas the high priest. He was still tied.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahi tayiɣis ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo. .
en: They also nailed two criminals to crosses beside Jesus—one on the right and the other on the left.

dag: n-yi a biɛhigu shee nuzaa polo katiŋ kana. A mini niriba bɛn be a sani zaa nyɛla wɔribariba, ka nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa ka galisi pam.
en: You will come up from your place from the far north, you and many peoples with you, all of them riding horses, a great assembly, a mighty army.

dag: Ka jintɔriba maa daa lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pahi, ka bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ daa ʒi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm darigi bɛ tibili, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba dabiɛm, sokam zaa ni daa paɣiri Naawuni tuun shɛli din tum ka bɛ nini nya maa zuɣu la.
en: So the Council warned them even more strongly and then set them free. They saw that it was impossible to punish them, because the people were all praising God for what had happened.

dag: Izraɛl naa ni daa nya ba, o daa bɔhila Ilaisha, M ba, n kum ba? N kum ba.
en: When he saw them, Israels king said to Elisha, Should I kill them, my father? Should I.

dag: A naŋgbampiba ŋmanila gali ʒee, ka a noli viɛli pam. A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Your lips are like a red silk thread. Your mouth is beautiful. Your cheeks under your veil are like two slices of pomegranate.

dag: Amaa ti yi niŋ tahima ti nini ni na bi nya shɛli zuɣu, dindina ti ni di suɣilo guhiri li.
en: But if we hope for what we dont see, we wait for it with patience.

dag: ka lab o mabihi maa sani ti yɛli ba, Bia maa kani, ka ya ka n lee yɛn kpe.
en: Then he went back to his brothers and said, The boy is gone! What am I going to do.

dag: O maani ansarisimaaniba ansarisi, amaa ka niŋdi tarimba nirilim.
en: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa ŋun pahi ayi ka nyɛ maligumaana leebu piɛlaa la na. Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then Moses brought the second ram, which was for the ordination of priests, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

dag: M birimmi zaa ka dabiɛm kpe ma. N suhu kul yɛla yuŋ zibbu zuɣu, amaa ka di tahiri ma la dabiɛm na.
en: I am worried and shaking with fear. My pleasant evening has become a nightmare.

dag: N ni lan yɛli yaha, so di tɛhi ni n nyɛla jɛrigu, ka yi yi tɛhi lala, yin shiri lihimiya ma kaman jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka n gba tooi nyu bara biɛla.
en: I repeat, no one should take me for a fool. But if you do, then allow me to be a fool so that I can brag like a fool for a bit.

dag: Daadam shia nyɛla Yawɛ firila din vihiri baŋdi din be daadam niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: The breath of a person is the lamp of the LORD, searching all the inmost parts.

dag: A ni vihi m binshɛɣukam zaa ni maa, a yiŋ bimbɔ ka a nya di ni? Zaŋm li zali n dɔɣiriba min a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ninni, ka bɛ baŋ ti ni ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: Youve now felt through all of my baggage, and what have you found from your households belongings? Put it in front of our relatives, and let them decide between us.

dag: Yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni guli ya o yiko puuni n-gu tiliginsim shɛli din mali shili gu ni di ti kahigi wuhi palo ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni la.
en: They are for you, who through faith are kept safe by God's power for the salvation which is ready to be revealed at the end of time.

dag: nti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, ka nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni lee nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ bee bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima ka nya bɛ nyɛla bɛn galisi bee bɛn pɔra.
en: See what the land looks like. Learn about the people who live there. Are they strong or are they weak? Are they few or are they many?.

dag: A zuɣu ka bɛ kul turi ma, ka n kul diri vi.
en: I am insulted because of you. Shame covers my face.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee chi ni chana, a ni tooi zaŋ a nuu ŋmɛm kazuɣuri maa ŋubi, amaa miri ka a zaŋ sua ŋ-ŋmah a kpee chi.
en: When you walk along a path in someone else's grainfield, you may eat all the grain you can pull off with your hands, but you must not cut any grain with a sickle.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be crucified. The soldiers took Jesus prisoner.

dag: Bom tulaale viɛla, mɛɛr kom din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mini tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla ka bɛ booni li sinnamɔn la kilɔgiram ata ni kaɣa tulaale shɛli din nyom viɛla kilɔgiram ata.
en: Take the finest spices— pounds of liquid myrrh, pounds of sweet-smelling cinnamon, pounds of sweet-smelling cane.

dag: Ka Dauda yuli daa du pam tiŋgbɔna maa ni zaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda yɛla gbaai zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: David's fame spread everywhere, and the Lord made every nation afraid of him.

dag: Di bemi kaman Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli ni yɛli shɛm la: N niŋ yɛda, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisira. Ti gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ŋun daa sab sabbu maa zuɣu, ka ti gba tɔɣisira.
en: The scripture says, I spoke because I believed. In the same spirit of faith we also speak because we believe.

dag: Di saha ka niriba daa bɔhi ma, A ku yɛli ti a ni niŋ shɛm maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: and when people saw me, they asked, Why aren't you mourning for your wife.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n timdi m biyurigu Timoti ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma dolibu ni la yi sanna ni o ti teei ya n ni doli so shɛŋa Masia dolibu ni, ka wuhiri li shɛm luɣ shɛlikam cheechinim ni la.
en: For this purpose I am sending to you Timothy, who is my own dear and faithful son in the Christian life. He will remind you of the principles which I follow in the new life in union with Christ Jesus and which I teach in all the churches everywhere.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zali ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaa di saha maa.
en: So at that time, I commanded you concerning everything you were to do.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu pam, amaa ka o bi garig o.
en: Herod questioned Jesus at length, but Jesus didnt respond to him.

dag: A deeg o nam jaaŋgbee o nuu ni, ka daag o nam luhi.
en: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.

dag: Ka yi yi gbaai do so ka o zaŋ o kpee paɣ doya, yin kumiya bɛ niriba ayi maa; doo maa min o ni zaŋ paɣ so doya maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu mini Rɛkab bia Jɛhɔnadab daa kpe Baal duu maa ni, ka o yɛli Baal jɛmdiba maa, Di chɛliya ka Yawɛ jɛmda be yi ni, amaa chɛliya ka di kul nyɛla yinim bɛn nyɛ Baal jɛmdiba maa kɔŋko.
en: Then Jehu and Jehonadab, Rechabs son, entered Baals temple. They said to Baals worshippers, Make sure there are no worshippers of the LORD here with you. There should be only Baal worshippers.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bidibisi, ka Abiheel daa nyɛ Huri bia, ka Huri nyɛ Jarɔa bia, ka Jarɔa nyɛ Giliad bia, ka Giliad nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Jɛshishai bia, ka Jɛshishai nyɛ Jado bia, ka Jado mi nyɛ Buz bia;.
en: They were the descendants of Abihail. Abihail was Huris son. Huri was Jaroahs son. Jaroah was Gileads son. Gilead was Michaels son. Michael was Jeshishais son. Jeshishai was Jahdos son. Jahdo was Buzs son.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni chɛ ka tinvura bɛn nyɛ garinsi lu yi zuɣu n-dimdi ya, ka yi ku tooi niŋ ba tim.
en: See, Im sending serpents against you, vipers that you cant charm, and they will bite you, declares the LORD.

dag: ka Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: When Jezebel killed the LORDs prophets, Obadiah took one hundred of them and hid them, fifty each in two caves. He supplied them with food and water.

dag: N goonje kumsi leela fabila, ka n yua kumsi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kumdi kukoya.
en: My only songs are sorrow and sadness.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Ilaisha daa bol anab bil so na nti yɛl o, Malim shili n-zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu ŋɔ gbib a nuu ni chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: Elisha the prophet called one of the men from the group of prophets and said to him, Get ready and take this small bottle of oil in your hand. Go to Ramoth Gilead.

dag: O daa gbimi vuɣi kuɣa nimaani, ka bo ti viɛla na ti sa nimaani; ka sa gara zali puu maa sunsuuni, ka mali wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili sɔŋ di ni. O daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, amaa ka di ti walila wal biɛri.
en: He dug it, cleared away its stones, planted it with excellent vines, built a tower inside it, and dug out a wine vat in it. He expected it to grow good grapes— but it grew rotten grapes.

dag: Niriba pam mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam ni ti ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Many peoples and mighty nations will come to seek the LORD of heavenly forces in Jerusalem and to seek the favor of the LORD.

dag: Ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: If you are out in the field, don't go back for your coat.

dag: Ka Rut daa yɛl o, N dana, a niŋ ma nirilim pam. Hal m biɛhigu ni kul bi paag a paɣisara bɛn tumd a tuma ŋɔ ni yino gba biɛhigu maa zaa yoli, a kpaŋsi ma a ni tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛm maa puuni.
en: Ruth replied, Sir, it's good of you to speak kindly to me and make me feel so welcome. I'm not even one of your servants.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ ania di suɣilo hal ti shiri nya alikauli maa palibu.
en: Abraham waited patiently for this to happen, and later he received what God promised.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zuŋ a ninni?.
en: Then the Lord said to Cain, Why are you angry? Why that scowl on your face?.

dag: Ka o daa ti laɣim o tumtumdiba mini bɛn mini ba tuma nyɛ tuun yinsi na nti yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni ti nyarila liɣiri ti tuma ŋɔ ni.
en: Demetrius brought together everyone who was in the same business and said: Friends, you know we make a good living at this.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya Amalɛknim naa Agag maa n-ti ma na. Ka Agag daa yi o sanna ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, kum biɛrim vuuya. .
en: Samuel said, Bring King Agag of the Amalekites to me. Agag came to Samuel. Agag was tied with chains and thought, Surely he wont kill me.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Chɛliya ka o niŋ yomyom n-tum o tuma ka ti nya; kul chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tum o ni lo shɛm ka ti baŋ li.
en: You say, Let the Lord hurry up and do what he says he will, so that we can see it. Let Israel's holy God carry out his plans; let's see what he has in mind.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa garita n-nya ka fiig tia la kuumi zaa nti tabili di tiŋ wula.
en: Early in the morning, as Jesus and his disciples were walking along, they saw the fig tree withered from the root up.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N wuhi ya tuun suma pam din yi m Ba maa sanna, ka di ni dini zuɣu ka yi lee yɛn lab ma kuɣa ŋɔ.
en: But he said, I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka timaŋmaŋ kul nyuri bara yi zuɣu Naawuni cheechinim ni. Ti niŋdila lala yi ni mali ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛda niŋbu yi daalaka nyabu mini yi wahala dibu puuni la zuɣu.
en: Thats why we ourselves are bragging about you in Gods churches. We tell about your endurance and faithfulness in all the harassments and trouble that you have put up with.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu. N ni tɔɣisi n fabila ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka shɛli ku kaɣili ma. N ni tɔɣisi ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: I hate my own life, so I will complain freely. I am very bitter, so now I will speak.

dag: A ba daalibarika mali kpiɔŋ gari zoya din doya sahakam ŋɔ mini kuŋkuna din kul beni sahakam ŋɔ daalibarika. Naawuni chɛ ka o daalibarika ŋɔ zaa be Yisifu ŋun min o mabihi daa woligi ŋɔ zuɣu ni, ka be o gbɛɣu zuɣu.
en: My son, the blessings I give are better than the promise of ancient mountains or eternal hills. Joseph, I pray these blessings will come to you, because you are the leader of your brothers.

dag: Ka Tomas bɔh o, N Duuma, ti bi mi a ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka wula ka ti ni tooi baŋ di soli.
en: Thomas said, Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way.

dag: bee n-di m bindirigu n kɔŋko, ka kpibiga bi di li.
en: and I have always shared my food with orphans.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa bɔh o mabihi maa, Ti yi ku ti tizo ŋɔ ka wuhi ni pa tinima n-ku o, nyɔ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya di ni?.
en: So Judah said to his brothers, What profit will we get if we kill our brother and hide his death?.

dag: Ka paɣ so yi yila o yidana yiŋa, ŋun kpalimmi ʒiya; ka di yi pa lala, ŋun niŋmi sandaani niŋ o yidan kuro maa, ka lan lab o yiŋa. Ka doo mi miri ka o yih o paɣa.
en: but if she does leave him, then she should stay single or be reconciled to her husband. And a man shouldnt divorce his wife.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli din ŋmani teeku, ka ŋmani diɣi din mini buɣim gari taba. Ka bɛn daa nyaŋ biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ni o yuli dalinli deebu la daa ʒe m-baɣi teeku din ŋmani diɣi maa n-gbib Naawuni mɔɣilɔnima.
en: Then I saw what appeared to be a sea of glass mixed with fire. Those who gained victory over the beast, its image, and the number of its name were standing by the glass sea, holding harps from God.

dag: Ka ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda yi bɔri ni o woligi ka chɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda, ŋun niŋmi lala, dimbɔŋɔ puuni doo bee paɣa ŋun nyɛla yɛdaniŋda mali soli ni o niŋ o ni yu shɛm. Dama Naawuni bɔri ni ti malila suhudoo.
en: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi alizanda ni na, ka o jilima neesim daa neei dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam.
en: Then I saw another angel coming down from heaven. This angel had great power. The angels glory made the earth bright.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka boli Aduna mini Miriam, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kana ti zani.
en: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.

dag: Asa daa bi wurim luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa ʒe Yawɛ yim o suhu ni hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Though the shrines werent eliminated, nevertheless Asa remained committed with all his heart to the LORD throughout his life.

dag: Bɛ daa yila Ifriim tiŋgban ni, ka vinvamli ni na, n-doli nyin Bɛnjamin min a daŋ niriba. Ka sapashin kpamba daa yi Makiri na, ka sapashim bihi mi daa yi Zɛbulɔn na.
en: Troops came from Ephraim, where Amalekites once lived. Others came from Benjamin; officers and leaders came from Machir and Zebulun.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi tinsheenima, yin tɔɣisimiya ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: When you approach a city to fight against it, you should first extend peaceful terms to it.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ n ni chɛ ka n daalɔbɔnim lu amaŋmaŋ min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni n kpee ka dunia yili zaa.
en: If you don't, he will send his worst plagues to strike you, your officials, and everyone else in your country. Then you will find out that no one can oppose the Lord .

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoon jɛra ŋɔ, bina ayi ŋɔ dini n-lee gari di kpee: Salima maa bee Naawuni jɛmbu duu din chɛ ka salima maa be kasi maa?.
en: You are blind fools! Cant you see that the Temple is greater than the gold on it? Its the Temple that makes the gold holy!.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la. .
en: There may be two women working together. One will be taken and the other will be left.

dag: Di bi simdi ka naa ti deei niriba maa tiŋgbani ka kari ba di ni. O ti zaŋmi omaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgban shɛli ti o bidibisi din ni chɛ ka n niriba ni so ti ku kɔŋ o tiŋgbani.
en: And the ruler will not take any of the peoples land or force them to leave their land. He must give some of his own land to his sons. In that way my people will not be forced to lose their land.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Anab Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ zuliya shɛb polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord often told me what to say about the different nations of the world.

dag: Yi ta ma daɣiri n niriba sani, chi nukurigu pali mini bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi zuɣu. Yi kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi kubu, ka chɛri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi ni bɛ be, yi ni ŋmari ʒiri n niriba bɛn wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa sani la zuɣu.
en: When you degrade me to my people for handfuls of barley and bread crumbs, you mislead my gullible people, and you bring about the death of those who shouldnt die and keep alive those who shouldnt live.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim nuu ni ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm o yuma anii.
en: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he allowed King Cushan Rishathaim of Aram Naharaim to defeat the Israelites and to rule over them. The Israelites were under that kings rule for eight years.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ni o zabi omaŋ zuɣu yɛli, M bi tum birigi Yɛhudianim zaligu shɛli bee n-tum taal shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu; m mi bi tum Naa Siiza taali hal baabiɛla.
en: Then Paul spoke in his own defense, I have not broken the Law of my people. And I have not done anything against either the temple or the Emperor.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni zahim bɛn be teeku ni zaa ni zɔri ya. N zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: All animals, birds, reptiles, and fish will be afraid of you. I have placed them under your control.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mbo! A garigi viɛnyɛliŋga; niŋmi lala ka be.
en: Jesus said, Your answer is right. Do this and you will have eternal life.

dag: Daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa pa shɛli o sani; ŋuna n-su malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini daadamnim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni fukumsi. Ka so ku tooi goog o ka o chɛ o ni bɔri shɛli niŋbu bee m-bɔh o, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala?.
en: He looks on the people of the earth as nothing; angels in heaven and people on earth are under his control. No one can oppose his will or question what he does.

dag: N wuhiya ni a yurilim maŋli maa kul yɛn benimi sahakam; a ʒiɛyimtali mi kul bami ʒiɛya kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: I know that your love will last for all time, that your faithfulness is as permanent as the sky.

dag: N ni chaŋ nimaani ti nya bɛ shiri tumdi bɛ ni yɛri ni bɛ tumdi shɛm maa zaa bee bɛ bi tumdi li.
en: I will go down now to examine the cries of injustice that have reached me. Have they really done all this? If not, I want to know.

dag: Ka Jɔda daa nyɛ Jɔanan bia, ka Jɔanan nyɛ Riisa bia, ka Riisa nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl bia, ka Zɛrubabɛl nyɛ Shialtiɛl bia, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Nɛri bia.
en: Joda was the son of Joanan. Joanan was the son of Rhesa. Rhesa was the son of Zerubbabel. Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the son of Neri.

dag: Dama Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la niriba daa pun deei bɛ tarili.
en: The tribes of Reuben and Gad and the eastern half of Manasseh have received their property, divided according to their families.

dag: Do so niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi mali bimmɔriŋ bee yum bee dalinli, ka di ti leei niŋgbuŋ dɔro o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina bɛn zaŋm o tahi Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la sani bee o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ni yino sani.
en: Someone might have a swelling on their skin, or it may be a rash or a bright spot. If the sore looks like the disease of leprosy, the person must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.

dag: Ka nir yi zaŋ kuɣili din be o nuu ni ka nyɛ din ni ku nir lab so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, bɛn kum o.
en: If you use a rock large enough to kill someone and you kill another person, you are a murderer, and you must die.

dag: Dauda daa bi kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi paai yuun pisi, dama Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ni o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: King David did not take a census of the people who were under the age of twenty, because of the Lord 's promise to make the people of Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

dag: Nyini n-zali dunia di tariga, nyini n-zali woligu saha mini kikaa saha.
en: you set the limits of the earth; you made summer and winter.

dag: Ka n ni lan ti a a ni bi suhi ma shɛli gba pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni ti a azichi mini jilima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ na so m-buɣis a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: I now also give you what you didnt ask for: wealth and fame. There wont be a king like you as long as you live.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di to ni bundana kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, I tell you, it's terribly hard for rich people to get into the kingdom of heaven!.

dag: ni tammɛriba ni kuɣikpɛriba, ka da dari mini nyolimbɔɣa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan zaŋ di shɛli mi mali duu maa luɣ shɛlikam din simdi ni bɛ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gabiga m-pɔripɔri li n-zaŋ kari bɛ mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa zaa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daai laɣitaɣiriba la teebuya maa luhi n-kpahi bɛ liɣiri bahi.
en: So he made a whip from cords and drove all the animals out of the Temple, both the sheep and the cattle; he overturned the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins;.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni nti kuhi yɛli ba ni man Naawuni nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma la.
en: Nineveh is a big city. I have heard about the many evil things the people are doing there. So go there and tell them to stop doing such evil things.

dag: Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala, ka o gba yuli daa du m-pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Those were the brave deeds of Benaiah, who was one of The Thirty.

dag: Shɛhira dira ŋun nyɛ nia biɛɣulana yi kana ti wuhi ni so tum tuumbiɛɣu.
en: Now if a spiteful witness comes forward against someone, so as to testify against them falsely.

dag: A yi chɛ ka a suhu ʒe dɛde, a ni tooi teeg a nuhi tir o.
en: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer.

dag: A zaŋ ma bahila bɔɣ zilinli ni, luɣ shɛli din zibisi ka zilima.
en: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;.

dag: Amaa ti yi niŋ tahima ti nini ni na bi nya shɛli zuɣu, dindina ti ni di suɣilo guhiri li.
en: But if we hope for what we do not see, we wait for it with patience.

dag: Dahin shɛli yuŋ ka o daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti mi ni a nyɛla karimba ŋun yi Naawuni sanna, dama so kani ŋun ni tooi wuhi shihir shɛŋa a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ka pa ni Naawuni m-be o sani.
en: He came to Jesus at night and said to him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God, for no one could do these miraculous signs that you do unless God is with him.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tan shɛli din guui, ka nyɛ tani maa pirigili la n-yili m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa polo.
en: The panel of goat hair will be a meter longer than the tent itself, so fold centimeters of the material behind the tent and on each side as a protective covering.

dag: Bɛ yɛla mali dabiɛm pam, bɛ karimbaani zuɣu bɛ zalila bɛmaŋmaŋ zaligunima.
en: The Chaldean is dreadful and fearful. He makes his own justice and dignity.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tim ti boli Jɛrɔbɔam na, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa ti chaŋ Rɛhɔbɔam sani ti yɛl o.
en: But the people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said.

dag: Ka o bidibis ayi maa daa kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba. Paɣiba maa yuya n-daa booni: Opa ni Rut.
en: Later, Naomi's sons married Moabite women. One was named Orpah and the other Ruth. About ten years later.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti ba; ka o suhu daa paligi pam o min o yiŋnim zaa ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda maa zuɣu.
en: He brought them into his home and gave them a meal. He was overjoyed because he and everyone in his household had come to believe in God.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, so yi po pɔri n-zaŋ daadam ti Yawɛ kaman yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: the following regulations for the people of Israel. When any of you have been given to the Lord in fulfillment of a special vow, you may be set free by the payment of the following sums of money.

dag: o daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini puri bee n-sɔŋ dunia tampuɣili.
en: before God made the earth and the fields or the first of the dry land.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔa paɣ maa daa yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka a ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam zambu ʒi m mini n daŋ zaa zuɣu, ka a min a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ku mali taali di puuni.
en: The woman of Tekoa said to the king, Let the blame be on me, my lord and king. You and your kingdom are innocent.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa mini Firawuna yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba zaa ni o tɔbbihi zaa daa doli Izraɛlnim maa ti paai ba, ka bɛ dola teeku noli luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Pihahirɔt din daa be Baalizɛfɔn tooni polo la.
en: But the king's horses and chariots and soldiers caught up with them while they were camping by the Red Sea near Pi-Hahiroth and Baal-Zephon.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ni o ni zo ti yaannim nambɔɣu shɛm la niŋ pali, ka teeg o daalikauli suŋ.
en: He said he would show mercy to our ancestors and remember his sacred covenant.

dag: Lihimiy o ka mali suhupiɛlli; ka vi ku be yi ninni.
en: If you look to him for help, he will put a smile on your face. You will have no need to be ashamed.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd pie kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row;.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be a niriba bɛn nyɛ a ni pii shɛba, ka bɛ galisi pam ka ka kalinli ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: Here I am among the people you have chosen to be your own, a people who are so many that they cannot be counted.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kom niŋ o sagban tibisa ni, ka sagbana maa bi cheei.
en: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst.

dag: A ni di a tuma nyɔri. A ni tɔŋ ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: You will definitely enjoy what youve worked hard for— youll be happy; and things will go well for you.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi, ka bɛ ti a vuhim, ka ti a suhupiɛlli.
en: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.

dag: So daa bi zo a nambɔɣu n-niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli ti a nambɔzɔbo zuɣu. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ a mi ti bahi samban ni, dama bɛ daa zaɣis a mi bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli maa.
en: No one took pity or cared enough to do any of these things for you. You were despised on the day of your birth and thrown out on the open field.

dag: ni o ni daa tum Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Ijipti la;.
en: You, not your children, saw the miracles he did in Egypt. You saw what he did to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and to his whole country.

dag: Ka n daa su a kom, m-paɣ a ni ʒim maa bahi, ka ʒe a kpam.
en: I washed you in water. I poured water over you to wash away the blood that was on you, and then I put oil on your skin.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them in water.

dag: Ka Yisahaku mini Ishimail bɛn daa nyɛ o bidibisi la daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi Makipɛla siliga din daa be Zɔhar ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la bia Ɛfurɔn palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah. This cave is in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar. It was east of Mamre.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni ka di nyɛ din bi tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa sani. Ka bɛ daa lan me buɣijɛmbo shee zali bɛ fɔntinsi zaa ni mini tiŋkpan bihi ni ni bɛ ni me birini gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni;.
en: The Israelites secretly did things against the LORD their God that werent right. They built shrines in all their towns, from watchtowers to fortified cities.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya pɔi ka naanyi piri ba. Bɛ daa niŋla bɛ zaa lala, dama luɣ kasi shee tumtumdiba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni tuma daa be Ɛliɛza mini Itama bidibisi maa zaa ni.
en: Men were chosen from each family. They were chosen by throwing lots. Some of the men were chosen to be in charge of the Holy Place. And other men were chosen to serve as priests. All these men were from the families of Eleazar and Ithamar.

dag: Kum yi mali so, ŋun dim yiŋ pɔi ka di chɛ ka yi ku nya tibidarigibo yi laɣiŋgu ni. Zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa din kpalim polo, n yi ti kana, n ni wuhi ya di gba yɛla.
en: If some are too hungry to wait, they should eat at home. Do this so that your meeting together will not bring Gods judgment on you. I will tell you what to do about the other things when I come.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Bɛ ni ti niŋ zina, amaa ka ku dɔɣi bihi, dama bɛ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled.

dag: Ka Nabal daa garigi bɔhi Dauda tuumba maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Dauda? Ka ŋuni mi n-lee nyɛ Jɛsi bia? Pumpɔŋɔ daba pam kul zɔrimi ka chɛri bɛ laamba.
en: But Nabal answered Davids servants, Who is David? Who is Jesses son? There are all sorts of slaves running away from their masters these days.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Zaŋ chaŋ yuun yini saha din nyɛ kaman bɛ ni bu tumtumda so paa tuma yuma tariga saha, Kɛdar jilima ni zan tariga.
en: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.

dag: Yaakubu daa niŋla yuun pinaayopɔin Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni; ka o yuma kalinli daa yiɣisi yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi ni ayopɔin.
en: Jacob himself lived there for years, before dying at the age of .

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi nya nambɔzɔbo ka o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ya labisi ʒili yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and I will even force him to have mercy on you and give back your farms.

dag: N daa ti baɣisila vinnyaɣilan puu gari, ka daa ti lan baɣisi jɛrigu wain tihi puu gari.
en: I walked past a field that belonged to a lazy man. It was a vineyard that belonged to someone who understood nothing.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu n-zaŋ o noli min o nina kpa bia maa noli ni o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o nuhi zuɣu; ka teeg omaŋ dolisi bia maa, ka o niŋgbuna piligi biibu.
en: He got up on the bed and lay down on top of the child, putting his mouth on the boys mouth, his eyes on the boys eyes, his hands on the boys hands. And as he bent over him, the childs skin grew warm.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣi Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, man daa pun beni.
en: Jesus answered, I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: and the Lord said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Dama yi yi zaɣisi ka zaŋ yimaŋa n-tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni ŋɔ, ka kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi n-niŋdi yi paɣiba ka bɛ gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi n-niŋdi bɛ paɣiba.
en: If you are disloyal and join with the nations that are still left among you and intermarry with them.

dag: Yi ni tooi pihi li hal ni daba ayɔbu dali, amaa daba ayopɔin dali din nyɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, di shɛli ku beni.
en: You should gather the food for six days. But the seventh day of the week is a day of rest—so there will not be any of the special food on the ground.

dag: Ka n daa labisi n garigibu zilinkom ti o ha yɛli: A ni yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli pa yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-kul ʒini tɛhi n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, None of this is true! You are making it all up.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli n dana, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti zaŋ a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: The Lord said to my lord, Sit at my right side, while I put your enemies under your control.

dag: Miri ka a lo a ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka niŋ a naani zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont make plans to harm your neighbor, who lives near you and trusts you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Nyamiya, kuɣili ŋɔ n-yɛn di ti shɛhira. Dama di wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni tɔɣisi ti maa, dinzuɣu yi yi bi ʒe yi Naawuni maa yim, dina n-yɛn din ya shɛhira.
en: Joshua said to all the people, This stone will serve here as a witness against us, because it has heard all the LORDs words that he spoke to us. It will serve as a witness against you in case you arent true to your God.

dag: Naa, a nyɛla na titali gari nanim zaa. Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-ti a nam maa; ka lan ti a yiko mini kpiɔŋ ni jilima.
en: You, Your Majesty, are the king of kings. The God of heaven has given kingship, power, might, and glory to you!.

dag: Yi yinsi nyɛla tampima voya ni. Yi karimbaani n-yɔhim ya ka yi me yi yinsi maa tamla zoya zuɣu, ka ŋmaligi yɛli yimaŋa, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣisi ti tiŋ na.
en: Your pride has deceived you. Your capital is a fortress of solid rock; your home is high in the mountains, and so you say to yourself, Who can ever pull me down.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Jɔshua sani Makɛda sansan la ni ni alaafee. Ka so daa bi tooi yaar o noli yɛri shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim maa polo.
en: After the fighting, Joshuas men came back to him at Makkedah. Not one of the people in that country was brave enough to say anything against the Israelites.

dag: di saha ŋun ti zaŋ sara maa na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ŋmiri li.
en: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti niŋ bindira ka yi di n-tiɣi, ka be ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: And the land will produce good crops for you. Then you will have plenty of food, and you will live safely on the land.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛn kpɛla tiŋ ŋɔ ni na nti ku Ijiptinima, ka o yi ti nya ʒim maa yili shɛli dunoli zuɣusaa mini dunɔpaɣira ni, o ni yaɣi lala yili maa gari, ka ku chɛ ka kum maa kpe yi yinsi ti kun ya.
en: At the time the Lord goes through Egypt to kill the firstborn, he will see the blood on the sides and top of each doorframe. Then he will protect that house and not let the Destroyer come into any of your houses and hurt you.

dag: Niriba pam daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ ti sani.
en: Many people have tried to tell the story of what God has done among us.

dag: Pa a ninvuɣ biɛtali ni galisi zuɣu? A tuumbiɛri ka tariga.
en: No, it's because you have sinned so much; it's because of all the evil you do.

dag: A daa wuhi ba a Vuhim Dabisili din be kasi yɛla, ka daa zaŋ a zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-ti a dabili Musa ka o ti ba.
en: You taught them to keep your Sabbaths holy, and through your servant Moses you gave them your laws.

dag: Bɛ chib bɔɣili n-gbi li sɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli maa ni.
en: They dig a pit to trap others, but they are the ones who will fall into it.

dag: Amaa Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Laribunim ni Ammɔnnim ni Ashidɔdnim ni daa wum ni Jɛrusalɛm goma maa mali me tuma chani tooni hal ka di voya piligi ŋaribu la, ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam.
en: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people of Ashdod heard that the work on the walls was progressing and the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛbihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihiri timaŋa. Niriba yi turi ti, ti niŋdila alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni; ka bɛ yi niŋ ti alaka, ti zaŋdila suɣilo dee li;.
en: We work hard with our own hands to feed ourselves. When people insult us, we ask God to bless them. When people treat us badly, we accept it.

dag: Naawuni zaliya, Tim a ba min a ma jilima. O lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam tur o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: God said, You must respect your father and mother. And God also said, Whoever says anything bad to their father or mother must be killed.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋbihi ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Pita ni daa chɛ n-shɛligi so tibili la dɔɣim bɔh o, N di bi nya a o sani tihi puu la ni.
en: A servant of the high priest, a relative of the one whose ear Peter had cut off, said to him, Didnt I see you in the garden with him.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaanu laasabu chaŋ ti dɔni Ai wulinluhili polo luɣ shɛli din be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: He took about five thousand men and positioned them as an ambush between Bethel and Ai to the west of the city.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ninvuɣ biɛri yɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri gba je wuntizɔriba yɛlli.
en: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ sahakam mali alibarika, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu kpɛma ni nya mbusim.
en: Always obey the Lord and you will be happy. If you are stubborn, you will be ruined.

dag: Di simdi ni yi kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: Be completely faithful to the Lord .

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Akan.
en: These are Ezers sons: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

dag: A paɣ ni ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala a yiŋ puuni. A bihi ni ŋmanila olivi tia wula n-ʒi n-gil a, ka yi laɣim diri ŋman yini ni.
en: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine in your home, and your children will be like young olive trees around your table.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa lan yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu, m bɔrimi ni n lan zaŋ piɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ buɣisi bin yini pahi. N suhir a, chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gili piɛ gbaŋ maa, amaa ka chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kuma.
en: Then Gideon said to God, Dont be angry with me, but let me speak just one more time. Please let me make just one more test with the fleece: now let only the fleece be dry and let dew be on all the ground.

dag: ni Kɛriɔt ni Bɔzira ni Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ fɔntinsi zaa din be yoma mini katiŋa.
en: Judgment has come to the towns of Kerioth and Bozrah. Judgment has come to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni yuli m-booni Pishɔn. Dina n-zɔri gindi Havila tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka salima be nimaani.
en: The name of the first river was Pishon. This river flowed around the entire country of Havilah.

dag: Anabi ninkur so daa be Bɛtɛl di saha maa. Ka o bidibisi daa kuli ti yɛl o Naawuni nir maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa Bɛtɛl dindali maa yɛla; ka lan yɛl o o ni daa yɛli Naa Jɛrɔbɔam shɛlikam zaa la gba yɛla.
en: At that time there was an old prophet living in Bethel. His sons came and told him what the prophet from Judah had done in Bethel that day and what he had said to King Jeroboam.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la n-chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Therefore, since we have been made righteous through his faithfulness, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: So shɛŋa din kuni Ziɔn kumdimi, dama so bi lan kanna ti puhiri churi. Bɛ chɛ o dunɔdaya zaa bahi, ka o maligumaaniba ŋuhira. O paɣisara malila nandahima; o nya naŋgbantom pam.
en: The roads to Zion are very sad, because no one comes to Zion for the festivals anymore. All of Zions gates have been destroyed; all her priests groan in sorrow. Zions young women have been taken away, and all this made Zion sad.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni labisi yi daazichi tin ya ka zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka laɣim ya yihi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb zaa ni la na.
en: then the Lord your God will have mercy on you. He will bring you back from the nations where he has scattered you, and he will make you prosperous again.

dag: N ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri fo bɛ sani. Ka nir ku lan wum aŋgo kukoli bee amiliya kukoli bee n-wum nɛya niɛmbu vuri bee n-nya firila neesim.
en: I will silence the sounds of joy and laughter and the voices of the bride and the bridegroom. Yes, I will silence the millstones and snuff out the lamplight.

dag: N yi chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari m-bahi yoli bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will punish you because of your sins, and I will turn your nation into a barren desert. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: O yɛla ka n daa yɛri ni o doli n nyaaŋ na ka nyɛ ŋun gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: He is the one I told you about when I said, Someone else will come, who is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni lahibal sun shɛli waazu n ni daa yihi la pala din yi daadam tɛha ni na.
en: Let me tell you, my friends, that the gospel I preach is not of human origin.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n daashili sɔɣibu shee ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.

dag: Nyamiya, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka n zaŋ sɔŋ yi tooni maa, kpɛmiya di ni ti deei n ni daa po pɔri zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni bɛ zuliya la.
en: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land.

dag: M bɔri ni Izraɛlnim nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Yawɛ yi chɛ ka o niriba lan tɔŋ, di ni niŋ Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim nyaɣisim, ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: Let Israels salvation come out of Zion! When the LORD changes his peoples circumstances for the better, Jacob will rejoice; Israel will celebrate!.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ soya maa ni ti nyɛla sariginli soya din be zibisim ni, bɛ ni ti yɛn kari ba bahi so shɛli zuɣu ka bɛ ti lu. Dama n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili yuun shɛli n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Therefore, they will find themselves on slippery ground and will be thrust into darkness, where they will collapse. I will bring disaster upon them, when their time comes, declares the LORD.

dag: Yi vinvam shɛŋa din mali kulim puuni zaa daa palila chɛchɛbunsi, ka wɔribariba ʒe dunɔdaya ni.
en: Your favorite valley was filled with chariots. Horse soldiers were stationed in front of the city gates.

dag: Ka Leeban daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-mɔɣis o yaansi min o bipuɣinsi maa kparima, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka lab kuli.
en: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters good-bye, and left to go back home.

dag: Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ a sɔŋda ŋɔ n-naɣi ni ti kpe di ni. Kpaŋsim o, dama ŋuna n-yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim deei li su.
en: But Nuns son Joshua, your assistant, will enter it. Strengthen him because hes the one who will help Israel inherit the land.

dag: Ti ni daa wum lala maa ka ti mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani balim Pool ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: When we heard this, we and the local believers urged Paul not to go up to Jerusalem.

dag: Miri ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka miri ka a zaŋ ʒiŋmabo kpɛh a kɔbili ni.
en: Never say anything that isn't true. Have nothing to do with lies and misleading words.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa mɔɣis o biɛyanim maa zaa kparima ka kum pam, di nyaaŋa ka o biɛyanim maa daa naanyi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Joseph was still crying as he kissed each of his other brothers. After this, they started talking with Joseph.

dag: Pool ni daa nya ʒii maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa dii gbaai nia lɔbu ni ti chaŋ Masidɔnia maa ti ni daa baŋ ni Naawuni n-tim ti ni ti ti yihi Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ waazu ti nimaani nim gba zuɣu.
en: After Paul had seen the vision, we immediately prepared to leave for Macedonia. We understood that God had called us to tell the Good News to those people.

dag: Ti ni daa be Tabɛra mini Masa ni Kiburɔtihataava la gba, yi daa lan chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisimi.
en: Also, at Taberah, Massah, and Kibroth Hattaavah you made the Lord angry.

dag: ka yim zuɣu be nayili, ka yim zuɣu mi be tanzaa dunɔdal la gbini. Ka zama zaa mi kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: another third will guard the royal palace, and the rest will be stationed at the Foundation Gate. All the people will assemble in the Temple courtyard.

dag: Amaa yi bi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni gbahi ba chaŋ la, n ni zaŋ ba kulisi nimaani ka bɛ ti baŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ʒiɛm maa.
en: You were afraid and complained that your enemies in that new land would take your children away from you. But I tell you that I will bring them into the land. They will enjoy what you refused to accept.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: So you must continue to love the Lord your God.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yi jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-labi Jɛrusalɛm ti su Izraɛlnima.
en: Solomon left the Meeting Tent that was at the high place in Gibeon and went back to Jerusalem to rule as the king of Israel.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim daa ka Yisa sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus. In order to test him they asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam. Ka n suhuyiɣisili maa ti lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n nini ti tiɣi li. Ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala n nyuli zabbu puuni, n suhu yi ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: You will feel all the force of my anger and rage until I am satisfied. When all this happens, you will be convinced that I, the Lord , have spoken to you because I am outraged at your unfaithfulness.

dag: Yi yi ti laɣim taba, di pala ti Duuma bindirigu dibu zuɣu ka yi laɣim;.
en: When you meet together as a group, it is not the Lord's Supper that you eat.

dag: Dauda bia Absalom daa mali tizɔpaɣ viɛlli ka o yuli booni Tama. Dahin shɛli ka Dauda bia Amnɔn kɔre daa ti kpe o ni.
en: David had a beautiful daughter named Tamar, who was the sister of Absalom. She was also the half sister of Amnon, who fell in love with her.

dag: Malaika maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi la, ka o binyɛrigu piɛli kaman gol la.
en: Now his face was like lightning and his clothes as white as snow.

dag: Ka shɛb yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, chɛliya ka bɛ niriba ata bee ayi kɔŋko n-tɔɣisiri ka tiri taba; ka chɛ ka so wuhi di gbinni.
en: If someone is going to speak in strange tongues, two or three at the most should speak, one after the other, and someone else must explain what is being said.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa ka Aizaia sanna.
en: When King Hezekiahs officers came to Isaiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ŋɔ, dama a chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli suŋ. Amaa n yi mali taali, amaŋmaŋ nyin kum ma, dama bɔ zuɣu ka a lan yɛn zaŋ ma chaŋ a ba sani yaha.
en: Be kind to me. After all, it was your idea to promise the Lord that we would always be loyal friends. If I've done anything wrong, kill me yourself, but don't hand me over to your father.

dag: ni tayiɣisi ni kɔrɛnima ni danyuriba ni ninvuɣ turiba ni ninvuɣ fariba zaa ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.

dag: So miri ka o ʒiɛm o, ka chɛliya ka o ti yi yi sani ni suhudoo lab n sanna, dama n kul lihirila o mini ti mabihi la soli.
en: So dont let anyone disrespect him, but send him on in peace so he can join me. Im waiting for him along with the brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be samban ni yi shihi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee n-shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi o dahalali kum bee n-shihi ninsal kɔbili bee gballi, dilana ni leei ŋun bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: If there is a dead body out in a field, whether the person died in battle or for some other reason, whoever touches that dead body, or its bones, or even its grave will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ so ŋunkam mali salima yihi li na. Ka bɛ daa yihi li na ti ti ma, ka n zaŋ li bahi buɣim ni, ka naɣibil ŋɔ yina.
en: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti ŋum bahi ba na kaman teeku kom ni vuri shɛm la. Ka so yi ti lihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, zibisim mini nandahima n-yɛn beni; ka sagbana zibigi fa neesim.
en: Then there is a roar as loud as the ocean waves, and the captives turn their faces to the ground. And there is only darkness closing in as the light fades away in a black cloud.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn daa bɔri taali ni yibu din ni yi zaligu dolibu ni Naawuni san la daa bi nya li zaligu maa dolibu puuni.
en: while God's people, who were seeking a law that would put them right with God, did not find it.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa bi tam Nuhu mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni la yɛla. Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛna, ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu.
en: But God did not forget about Noah. God remembered him and all the animals that were with him in the boat. God made a wind blow over the earth, and all the water began to disappear.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Anduru, ka Anduru mini Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: Philip went and told Andrew. Then Andrew and Philip went and told Jesus.

dag: O bela nimaani lihiri bɔr o ni yɛn gbaai binshɛli di, di yi be haliya o nina ni nya li.
en: From there it looks far into the distance, searching for its food.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka kul dolila bɛ kal kura la.
en: But those people would not listen, and they continued to follow their old customs.

dag: Jɛhɔram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa, o daa di nam maa la yuma anii Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jehoram was years old when he began to rule. He ruled eight years in Jerusalem.

dag: O teeya ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima, ka ŋmani pɔhim din ʒe n-gari ka ku lan tooi labina.
en: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba bɛn lo kpara ŋɔ zaa ni du n-chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa ti Yawɛ kaman nyin ti dan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But all of us are ready to go into battle under the Lord 's command. We will cross the Jordan and fight, just as you have said.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa teei Yisa yɛligu maa.
