en: Then they remembered his words.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n kana ti kaag a, amaa n sabiri yɛl shɛŋa din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tir a mi.
en: As I write this letter to you, I hope to come and see you soon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Lɛvi maa yiŋa, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni farigudeeriba pam ni alahichinim laɣim ʒini diri bindirigu, dama bɛ pam n-daa doli Yisa na.
en: Later that day, Jesus and his followers ate at Levis house. There were also many tax collectors and others with bad reputations eating with them.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni ŋmala sida tia bee ka o piila oki bee siɣirili n-zaŋ li sa nyɔŋ puuni, ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ kpiɔŋ.
en: He cuts down cedars for himself, or chooses a cypress or oak, selecting from all the trees of the forest. He plants a pine, and the rain makes it grow.

dag: Yisa nyaandol so daa be Damaskus maa ka o yuli booni Ananias. Ka o daa ti nya ʒii, ka ti Duuma bol o di ni, Ananias! Ka o saɣi n-yɛli, N-nyɛ ma, n Duuma.
en: There was a believer in Damascus named Ananias. He had a vision, in which the Lord said to him, Ananias! Here I am, Lord, he answered.

dag: Ka bɛ daa suhi alibarika suhigu ti Ribɛka n-yɛli: Ti tizɔpaɣa, Naawuni chɛ ka a leei niriba tusatusa ni tuhi piapia ma! Naawuni chɛ ka a zuliya ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: While Rebekah was leaving they said to her, Our sister, may you be the mother of millions of people, and may your descendants defeat their enemies and take their cities.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni o ni ku ba, ka Musa ŋun nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahindili daa zan o tooni n-taɣ o ni o maag o suhu; ka o ku ku ba.
en: God wanted to destroy those people, but Moses, the leader he chose, stood in the way. God was very angry, but Moses begged him to stop, so God did not destroy the people.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, So di zaŋ li zali hal ni asiba.
en: Moses said to them, Dont keep any of it until morning.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi wuntampuhili saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they came to the tomb.

dag: Bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini bɛ zuɣulaannim ni daa bi baŋdi anabinim yɛligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi karindi Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, ka daa bi baŋ Yisa ni nyɛ so la zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ o puhi kubu, ka lala daa chɛ ka anabinim yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: The people in Jerusalem and their leaders didnt recognize Jesus. By condemning him they fulfilled the words of the prophets that are read every Sabbath.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun nini tiɣ a, ka zaŋ a ʒili Izraɛl nam ʒiishee ŋɔ simdi paɣibu. Yawɛ ni kul yuri Izraɛlnim saha shɛlikam la zuɣu ka o piig a leei bɛ naa ni a doli yɛlimaŋli mini wuntia soli su ba.
en: Praise the Lord your God! He has shown how pleased he is with you by making you king of Israel. Because his love for Israel is eternal, he has made you their king so that you can maintain law and justice.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, Naawuni ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu zuɣu, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi zaŋ yi niŋgbuna kaman sar nɛɔŋ din be kasi ka tiɣiri Naawuni nini la n-ti ŋun Naawuni. Dina n-nyɛ jɛmbu maŋli Naawuni sani.
en: So, brothers and sisters, because of Gods mercies, I encourage you to present your bodies as a living sacrifice that is holy and pleasing to God. This is your appropriate priestly service.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛl lala maa nyɛla bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima, dama Yɛhudianim maa daa pun yɛli ni so yi ti yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, bɛ ni kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: They said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders. The leaders had already decided that they would punish anyone who said Jesus was the Messiah. They would stop them from coming to the synagogue.

dag: Wuntizɔriba zoorimi kaman abie tia la, ka zoori kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tia la.
en: The righteous will spring up like a palm tree. They will grow strong like a cedar of Lebanon.

dag: Dama zuliya shɛli yi nuzaa polo na ti lir o. Bɛ ni ti chɛ ka o tiŋgbani maa leei dabari, ka so ku lan be nimaani. Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa ni ti yi nimaani zo.
en: A nation from the north has risen up against her. It will decimate her land, and no one will live in it. Every living thing will flee.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: Then make a curtain to cover the entrance to the Holy Tent. Use blue, purple, and red yarn and fine linen to make this curtain. Weave pictures into it.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu ka n daa bi zaɣisi Naawuni ni wuhi ma shɛli ʒii maa puuni la.
en: Paul continued speaking: King Agrippa, after I had this vision from heaven, I obeyed it.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa baŋ ni yɛlli ka bɛ nya maa, bɛ ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kul ŋmam bilichiisi maa kaman bɛ ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga dabisili kam la zuɣu.
en: The men knew they were in deep trouble when they were ordered to make the same number of bricks each day.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Job, you upset me. Now I'm impatient to answer.

dag: Paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni ʒe go tihi sunsuuni shɛm, lala ka n yura be paɣisara sunsuuni.
en: Like a lily among thornbushes, so is my dearest among the young women.

dag: Ijipti yiɣisirimi m-be kaman Nail mɔɣili; di bemi kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pali. Di yɛliya, Chɛ ka n yiɣisi, chɛ ka n yiɣisi lim dunia, chɛ ka n wurim tinsi tabili di niriba.
en: Its Egypt that rises like the Nile, whose banks overflow, who declares, I will arise and cover the earth and destroy cities and inhabitants.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri yi zuɣu la yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni vuui n ni zaŋ n suhuyiɣisili binnyuri shɛli tin ya la. Yi ku lan nyu li n suhuyiɣisili pipia maa ni n-chani laana.
en: the Lord your God defends you and says, I am taking away the cup that I gave you in my anger. You will no longer have to drink the wine that makes you stagger.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m birini mini n yurilim din bi naara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini n tiligira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani. O nyaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: God is my loyal one, my fortress, my place of safety, my rescuer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, and the one who subdues people before me.

dag: Ka puu atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti miri, ka wɔɣiri kɔba pihita la ni niriba ata daa chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni. Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: Once during harvest time David was at the cave of Adullam, and three of the Thirty Heroes went down to meet him there. At the same time the Philistine army was camped in the Valley of Rephaim.

dag: A ni ti nyu m-buɣi, ka nya suhugarigu. A biɛli Samaria pipia maa nyɛla bahiyoli mini dabiɛm pipia.
en: You will stagger like a drunk. You will become very dizzy. That is the cup of destruction and devastation. It is like the cup of punishment that your sister drank.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yi ni yo Yawɛ sam shɛli m-bala? Pa ŋuna n-nyɛ yi ba ŋun nam ya? Pa ŋuna n-nam ya, ka zali ya?.
en: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.

dag: Zaŋ Aroa din be Arinɔn vinvamli tariga ni la hal ni fɔntin shɛli din be vinvamli maa ni la m-mali hal ni Giliad, tiŋ daa kani din goma du n-nyaŋ ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa ti ti.
en: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the Arnon Ravine, to the town that is in the valley there, even as far as Gilead, there wasnt a city that could resist us. The LORD our God laid everything out before us.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be nam ʒiishee maa tooni ŋ-ŋmani teeku kom din be kaman takɔriti diɣisi kɔtomsi la, ka lan be kaman diɣi la. Ka binnɛma anahi bɛn nyɔri zaŋ tabili bɛ puya mini bɛ nyaansi daa pali nina gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: Something like a glass sea, like crystal, was in front of the throne. In the center, by the throne, were four living creatures encircling the throne. These creatures were covered with eyes on the front and on the back.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋdimi ni di chɛ ka tiŋgbani tiɣi kom, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ dabari ka ka buchi, ni di chɛ ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni.
en: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali yaa gari bɛ dimnima.
en: The Lord gave many children to his people and made them stronger than their enemies.

dag: ni o yihi bɛ shihi gballi ni na, ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan nya nyɛvili neesim.
en: to bring them back from the pit, to shine with lifes light.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba benya kaman kuɣ nɛma la kana, ka Naawuni zaŋ ya me o jɛmbu duu ka yi leei Naawuni maligumaaniba bɛn be kasi, ka maani sara maligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni deeri Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: Come as living stones, and let yourselves be used in building the spiritual temple, where you will serve as holy priests to offer spiritual and acceptable sacrifices to God through Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o tumtumdiba bɛn mi teeku kom yɛtɔɣa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa zaŋ ŋariŋ din zɔri pam.
en: King Hiram let some of his experienced sailors go to the country of Ophir with Solomon's own sailors, and they brought back about tons of gold for Solomon.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn saɣim Judanim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni mali shɛli nyuri bara pam la.
en: This is what the Lord said: The loincloth is ruined and not good for anything. In the same way, I will ruin the proud people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Yi yuri yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu; ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;.

dag: ka Samuɛl nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Jɛrɔham bia, ka Jɛrɔham nyɛ Ɛliɛl bia, ka Ɛliɛl nyɛ Tɔa bia.
en: Samuel was Elkanahs son; Elkanah was Jerohams son; Jeroham was Eliels son; Eliel was Toahs son;.

dag: Dabisili din pah awɛi dali, Gidiɔni bia Abidan ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the ninth day Benjamins Chief Abidan, Gideonis son.

dag: tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Kolɔsai ka nyɛ ti mabihi bɛn ʒe yim Masia san la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: To the holy and faithful brothers and sisters in Christ who live in Colossae. Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya siɣa, ka teeya ni yuun muna ata ka n zaŋ saɣisi yi zaa ha ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: Watch, then, and remember that with many tears, day and night, I taught every one of you for three years.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ maligumaaniba, ka bɛ pakoya daa bi tooi kum bɛ zuɣu.
en: Gods priests were killed by the sword, and his widows couldnt even cry.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, A ni saɣi tahi ma ŋmɛnditoya maa sani? Ka o garigi yɛli Dauda, Pom Naawuni ni a ku ku ma bee n-zaŋ ma niŋ n dan maa nuu ni pɔi, ka n naanyi zaŋ a tahi bɛ sani.
en: Will you lead me to those raiders? David asked him. He answered, I will if you promise me in God's name that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban daa gahim bula shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ni sabilimsabilim mini bunyama bɛn zaa liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn zaa mali piɛlimpiɛlim ni piɛbihi shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ zaɣ sabila n-zaŋ ba ti o bihi ni bɛ guli ba.
en: But that day Laban hid all the male goats that had spots. And he hid all the female goats that had spots on them. He also hid all the black sheep. Laban told his sons to watch these sheep.

dag: Bɛ yihi ba neesim ni m-bahi zibisim ni, ka kari ba yihi dunia yili.
en: They will be driven out of the land of the living, driven from light into darkness.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be sol ni, gbuɣinli be solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: Why don't lazy people ever get out of the house? What are they afraid of Lions?.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zali ba zaligu yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim bɛn ti ka tuma ni na Vuhim Dabisili dali pirigibu buta zuɣu yim n-yɛn guli nayili.
en: He commanded them, This is what you must do: A third of you coming on sabbath duty will guard the palace.

dag: Ka paɣ ŋɔ ti dɔni marig o bia yuŋ ka o kpi.
en: One night while this woman was asleep with her baby, the baby died.

dag: Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ naa sahakam. Ziɔn, Naawuni n-kul nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naawuni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: The LORD will rule forever! Zion, your God will rule from one generation to the next! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni di chɛ ka so ku mali noli din ni tooi yɛli shɛli, ka Naawuni ti kari dunianim zaa saria.
en: What the law says is for those who are under the law. It stops anyone from making excuses. And it brings the whole world under Gods judgment.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni bi so ŋun nyɛ falidira yi na nyɛ bia, hal o ni kul su binshɛɣukam maa zaa yoli, o bi gari dabili.
en: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tiligira ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiligi Yaakubu zuliya bɛn niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: A redeemer will come to Zion and to those in Jacob who stop rebelling, says the LORD.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti yiɣisi wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋchaŋ ti paai Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɔpiɛligu ni n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: When they traveled east, they found a valley in the land of Shinar and settled there.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ni chɛ ka yi kpe daɣiri ni m-bɔŋɔ, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛlikam ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: They will make you unclean. If you touch the dead bodies of these insects, you will become unclean until evening.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi fuɣ o gbaŋ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi to n-chib o kuriti gbaɣino ziɣinli ŋɔ?.
en: No one can tear off his outer coat or pierce the armor he wears.

dag: Naawuni, fam ma ʒim yihibu taali ni bahi; nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ. Ka n zaŋ n zilinli yili yila pam yɛl a fa m-bahi maa yɛla.
en: God, spare me from the punishment of death. My God, you are the one who saves me! Let me sing about all the good things you do for me!.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali di daantalis anu mini di bansi, ka niŋ salima pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni mini di mihi zuɣu, amaa di ni yɛn tamdi bina anu shɛŋa zuɣu la dina, daanya ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: They made its five posts with hooks. They covered their tops and bands with gold, but made their five bases out of copper.

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas; o daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ ku nir ni yino.
en: And at that time there was a prisoner named Barabbas. He and some others had been arrested for murder during a riot.

dag: mini yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ni ti tizɔpaɣa Afia ni Aakipus ŋun nyɛ ti tɔbbikpee la.
en: Also to our sister Apphia, to Archippus, who serves with us in the Lords army, and to the church that meets in your home.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka anabi Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi Nɛria bia Baruk yɛtɔɣa, ka Baruk daa sabi yɛtɔɣa maa niŋ gbaŋ ni saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisiri maa.
en: In the fourth year of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son, Baruch was writing in a scroll the words that Jeremiah was dictating to him. Jeremiah the prophet told Baruch, Neriahs son.

dag: Dama a daba yuri di kuɣa pam, bɛ zɔri di taŋkpaɣu nambɔɣu.
en: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samsin mabihi min o dɔɣiriba zaa daa chaŋ ti kpuɣ o ti sɔɣ o ba Manɔa siliga shɛli din daa be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la ni. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuun pisi.
en: His brothers and his fathers entire household traveled down, carried him back up, and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah. He had led Israel for twenty years.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Niriba maa ku tooi du Sinai Zoli ŋɔ na, dama nyin maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ti ni m beemi chɛriga gil li, ka mal li ka di be kasi.
en: Moses said to the Lord , But the people cannot come up the mountain. You yourself told us to make a line and not allow the people to cross the line to holy ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni bee ti yi ka di ni, ti nia lɔbu nyɛla ni ti tiɣi o nini.
en: So our goal is to be acceptable to him, whether we are at home or away from home.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa n-vo laŋ din pali ziŋ kara maa duna. Zahim maa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga ni pihinunaata, amaa bɛ ni daa zooi shɛm maa zaa yoli, laŋ maa daa bi cheei.
en: Simon Peter got up and pulled the net to shore. It was full of large fish, one hundred fifty-three of them. Yet the net hadnt torn, even with so many fish.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri wuna ni birim. Di ni gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ di vi.
en: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.

dag: Zomiya yi yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ n sani la tumbu ni, ka chɛ ka yi suhuri mini yi shihi leei zaɣ pala. Izraɛlnima, bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn kpi?.
en: Abandon all of your repeated sins. Make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, house of Israel?.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ lala. Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni daa chaŋ maa nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ mi ʒee maa lo n-tabil o takɔro maa.
en: She agreed and sent them away. When they had gone, she tied the red cord to the window.

dag: Nyam dabisili maa! Nyama, di kanna, yi bahiyoli biɛɣu neeya. Tibidarigibo jaaŋgbee yirigi puma, ka karimbaani tiri.
en: The day of disaster is coming. Violence is flourishing. Pride is at its height.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa jɛra ʒiɛmdila bɛ manima.
en: Wise children make their fathers happy. Only fools despise their mothers.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ nyɛla yin ni teeri dabisi shɛli yɛla, ka di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu n-tiri Yawɛ jilima. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka gbib li.
en: You must celebrate this day as a religious festival to remind you of what I, the Lord , have done. Celebrate it for all time to come.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ʒiishee la tooni n-jɛmd o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ o jɛmbu duu puuni maa; ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee mahim kul ni luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.

dag: Yawɛ, fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi; guli ma, ka duŋtaariba ku paai ma.
en: Rescue me from evil people, LORD! Guard me from violent people.

dag: Ti ni ti wum wumpaɣibo yila din tibigiri Wuntialan ŋɔ dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Amaa ka n yɛli, Mbusim paai ma. N lan ka tahima, dama bilikɔɣinim kul tumdila bɛ bilikɔnsi tuma pahira.
en: From the most distant parts of the world we will hear songs in praise of Israel, the righteous nation. But there is no hope for me! I am wasting away! Traitors continue to betray, and their treachery grows worse and worse.

dag: Ka nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ti paai Yisa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira n-tim ti a sanna ni ti ti bɔh a ni nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ni ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: When they came to Jesus, they said, John the Baptist sent us to ask if you are the one he said was going to come, or should we expect someone else.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dikili, ka di barilim nyɛ mita ata. Ka du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣa zuɣu gil la zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi.
en: The man measured the thickness of the inner wall of the Temple building, and it was feet. Against this wall, all around the Temple, was a series of small rooms feet wide.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛn lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli ka so kani n-gari ŋun Naawuni ka o ni po o la zuɣu, o daa ŋmaligi m-pola omaŋ.
en: When God gave Abraham his promise, he swore by himself since he couldnt swear by anyone greater.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Nyama, n ni kana kaman tayiɣ la! Ŋum bi gbihiri ka mal o binyɛra zali ni o di ti chaŋ o zaɣim n-dih omaŋ vi mal alibarika.
en: Look! Im coming like a thief! Favored are those who stay awake and clothed so that they dont go around naked and exposed to shame.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Ziba, Nyama, Mɛfibɔshɛt ni daa su shɛlikam zaa leeg a dini pumpɔŋɔ. Ka Ziba garigi yɛli, N nyɛla ŋun luri n dan sizuura. Chɛ ka nyini n dan naa nini kul tiɣiri ma sahakam.
en: David then told him, Everything that used to belong to Mephibosheth is now yours. Ziba said, Your Majesty, I am your humble servant, and I hope you will be pleased with me.

dag: Binshɛɣukam tariga paabu saha miriya, dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu suhiri Naawuni.
en: The end of all things is near. You must be self-controlled and alert, to be able to pray.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma maŋmaŋa ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna la ni o timiya suhudoo sahakam mini yɛlli kam ni. Ti Duuma kul kpalimmi be yi zaa sani!.
en: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Elihu continued.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, ʒiɛnya dɛde ka di damdiya. Kul tummiya ti Duuma tuma ni yi kpiɔŋ zaa, yi ni mi ni yi tuma ku kpalim yoli ti Duuma ni la zuɣu.
en: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim ʒe samban ni maa daa guhi Zakaria je, ka di daa gari ba o ni yuui Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: In the meantime the people were waiting for Zechariah and wondering why he was spending such a long time in the Temple.

dag: Ɛliashib mini Joyada ni Jɔhanan ni Jadua saha la, bɛ daa sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba yɛla hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: A record was kept of the heads of the Levite families and of the priestly families during the lifetimes of the following High Priests: Eliashib, Joiada, Jonathan, and Jaddua. This record was finished when Darius was emperor of Persia.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yibu asibaasi n-liri ba n-tuhi ba hal ni zaawuni, ka do so daa bi zo n-tiligi naɣila nachimba kɔbisinahi n-daa ba laakumnim zo n-tiligi.
en: David attacked them and killed them. They fought from sunrise until the evening of the next day. None of the Amalekites escaped, except for young men who jumped onto their camels and rode away.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam pihi di wala ni di li ka paɣi Yawɛ, ka bɛnkam pihi wain tiwala laɣim sɔŋ ni nyu di wain n jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: But you that planted and harvested the grain Will eat the bread and praise the Lord . You that tended and gathered the grapes Will drink the wine in the courts of my Temple.

dag: Ka ti niŋ yɛda ka mi ni nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa deei paɣ maa ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na maa ka yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋ ni suhudoo, nyama, n wum a yɛligu maa, ka ni niŋ a ni fabili niŋ ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: David accepted the food Abigail had brought. Don't worry, he said. You can go home now. I'll do what you asked.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni, dama m mali tahima o sani.
en: I depend on God alone; I put my hope in him.

dag: A bihi maa daa tumla alahichi o sani, bɛ daalahichi maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛ shɛm ka o niŋ ba maa.
en: He made your children pay for their sins.

dag: Dama bɛ ku Yaakubu zuliya, ka wurim bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.

dag: Dama n yɛn lumi maa, ka be biɛrim pam ni sahakam.
en: I am about to collapse from constant pain.

dag: ka boli laɣiŋgu maa niriba zaa ka bɛ ka Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni na.
en: Then gather the people together at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: A kpaʒiɛrima nyom viɛla; a yuli ŋmanila tulaale. Dinzuɣu ka paɣiba yur a maa.
en: Your perfume smells wonderful, but your name is sweeter than the best perfume. That is why the young women love you.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia daa niŋ suhukpeeni gari lala yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi yuuni bɔri ma la nya ma; n zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi bɔhi n yɛla.
en: And Isaiah is even bolder when he says, I was found by those who were not looking for me; I appeared to those who were not asking for me.

dag: Ti yi nyɛla bɛn zuɣuri lɛbigi, di nyɛla Naawuni zuɣu; ka ti yi nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, di nyɛla yi zuɣu.
en: Are we really insane? It is for God's sake. Or are we sane? Then it is for your sake.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka piɛlaa ŋun mali yil wɔɣila ayi ʒe mɔɣili maa noli. O yila maa zaɣ yini daa wɔɣimi gari yin la, ka nyɛ din bahindi nyaaŋa yina.
en: When I lifted my eyes, I suddenly saw a ram with two horns standing in front of the canal. Both horns were high, but one was higher than the other. The higher one came up after the other one.

dag: Sidɔnnima, yi ku lan mali suhupiɛlli, ka yi niriba ni nya nahiŋgu. Hal bɛ yi zo n-kuli Saipurus, bɛ na kul bi yi.
en: saying, You will no longer celebrate, violated virgin Daughter Sidon. Get up and head to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilisi tibili wum n siɣimbu.
en: Listen, Lord , as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa ti bɔr o shee chuɣu maa ni, ka bɔhir o yɛla yɛra, Ya polo ka o lee be.
en: The Jewish leaders were looking for Jesus at the festival. They kept asking, Where is he.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ li chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili maa ni ti pi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: So I went to Perath and hid the loincloth there, just as the Lord told me to do.

dag: Dindali n ni ti tim tuumba ka bɛ yi n sani kpe ŋarima chaŋ ti kpɛhi Itiɔpianim bɛn bi mi bɛ yɛla ŋɔ dabiɛm pam. Biɛrim ni ti paai ba Ijiptinim mbusim dabisili maa dali, dama di kanna.
en: On the same day I destroy Egypt, I will send messengers to the Ethiopians to announce their coming destruction. They think they are safe, but they will be terrified.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So the Israelites made their camp in the land of the Amorites.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti lihi bo Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka yi yi ti bo o ni yi suhu zaa ni yi shia zaa, yi ni nya o.
en: But there in these other lands you will look for the Lord your God. And if you look for him with all your heart and soul, you will find him.

dag: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba leei shihirili mini bɛ ni maani shɛba ansarisi, ka yihi ba n niriba sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will confront that one. I will set them up as a sign and an object lesson, and I will cut them off from my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Juda zuliya daa leela Naawuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka Izraɛlnim leeg o ni su shɛba.
en: Judah became the Lord's holy people, Israel became his own possession.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Take a census of the entire Israelite community, from years old and above by their households, to determine everyone in Israel who is eligible for military service.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig awɛi saha ka o daa lan yi n-chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb ʒi daa ni yoli.
en: He went out again to the marketplace at nine o'clock and saw some men standing there doing nothing.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Na so ŋun ti yɛn sun ya biɛhigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yi sani m-bɔŋɔ, o ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi niŋ chɛchɛbumbariba mini wɔribariba, ka bɛ be o chɛchɛbuŋ tooni.
en: This is how the king will rule over you, Samuel said: He will take your sons, and will use them for his chariots and his cavalry and as runners for his chariot.

dag: Amaa n ni mali tahima sahakam; ka kul ni paɣir a waawaayili.
en: I will always put my hope in you; I will praise you more and more.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa man yɛligu ku yiɣisi.
en: The sky and the earth will not last forever, but my words will.

dag: Dama o yurilim maŋli la galisiya pam zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka o ʒiɛyimtali kul ni beni sahakam. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Because Gods faithful love toward us is strong, the LORDs faithfulness lasts forever! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Amaa a yi lɔri noli, nyin paɣim a ninni, ka niŋ kpam ʒe a zuɣu.
en: When you fast, brush your hair and wash your face.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛli ma, Di bi simdi ni a me yili ti ma, dama a nyɛla tɔbbia ŋun ku niriba pam.
en: God said to me, You must not build a temple for my name, because you are a military man and youve shed blood.

dag: Ka di lan be kaman wulimpuhili polo pɔhim n-ʒiɛri Speen teeku ni ŋarima ka di saɣindi la.
en: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti zaŋ li tin ya kaman o ni daa lo yi mini yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord will lead you into the land he promised to give you. The Canaanites live there now. But God promised your ancestors that he would give you this land. When that happens.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tir nir nyɛvili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di yi be nir kɔbili ni, o ni mali alaafee, ka barina shɛli ku paag o.
en: Obey the Lord and you will live a long life, content and safe from harm.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zani viɛnyɛliŋga ka yɔhi teeku ni kɔbilinina.
en: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.

dag: O daa ŋahila ŋaha tusaata, ka o ni daa yili yil shɛŋa mi daa nyɛ tuhilinaanu.
en: By the end of his life, he had written proverbs and songs.

dag: Dabiɛm daa kul gbahila tinzunnim maa, ka bɛ yiri bɛ birininim ni zɔrina ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They lose their courage and come trembling from their fortresses.

dag: O bi darigiri ti tibili kaman ti daalahichi ni simdi shɛm bee n-yɔri ti ti tuumbiɛri samli.
en: He does not punish us as we deserve or repay us according to our sins and wrongs.

dag: O mali so palli din nyɛ nyɛvili soli din doli kpɛri chinchin tibisili la ni ti ti. Chinchin tibisili maa nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ ŋmahinli.
en: He opened for us a new way, a living way, through the curtain—that is, through his own body.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tahi Ɛkurɔn. Amaa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ni daa paai Ɛkurɔn na, ka Ɛkurɔnnim daa kuhi yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la tahi ti ya ŋɔ na ni di ti ku ti mini ti niriba.
en: Then they sent Gods chest to Ekron, but as soon as Gods chest entered Ekron, the inhabitants cried out, Why have you moved the chest of Israels God to us? In order to kill us and our people.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab maani ti la ansarisi, ka ti dimnim laɣindi lara.
en: Youve put us at odds with our neighbors; our enemies make fun of us.

dag: O ni zaŋ wuntia kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la ye, ka zaŋ tiliginsim kaman zuɣupiligu la pili. O ni zaŋ o suhu ni lo ni o mali binshɛɣukam zali dɛde shɛm, ka bɔhi biɛri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala la kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: He will wear justice like a coat of armor and saving power like a helmet. He will clothe himself with the strong desire to set things right and to punish and avenge the wrongs that people suffer.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, A tizo pun kana ti yɔhim ma deeg a daalibarika.
en: Isaac said, Your brother tricked me! He came and took your blessing.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni be kaman zunzuya Ifriimnim sani ka be kaman bin pɔŋ Judanim sani.
en: I will destroy Ephraim as a moth eats a piece of cloth. I will ruin Judah, like rot on a piece of wood.

dag: Nir yi bo n-nya azichi yomyom di dii bi nabira, amaa bɛn bɔri nyari li biɛlabiɛla, di nabirimi.
en: The more easily you get your wealth, the sooner you will lose it. The harder it is to earn, the more you will have.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi maa mabia la pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko.
en: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them to the top of a very high mountain.

dag: Yaɣimɛr ka yiko ni o zaŋ yaɣ kpil yini me duɣ shɛli din ni ku buchi zama ni, ka lan zaŋ li me duɣ shɛli din ku yi zama ni?.
en: The one who makes the jar can make anything he wants. He uses the same clay to make different things. He might make one thing for special purposes and another for daily use.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nahiŋgu nyɛla din chɛri ka yɛndan niŋdi jɛrigu, ka birapu dibu mi saɣindi nira.
en: Even the wise will forget their wisdom, if someone pays them enough. That money destroys their understanding.

dag: Ti mini ti nanim ni ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim tum vi tuma, ka tum alahichi nyin Yawɛ sani.
en: Lord , we should all be ashamed. All our kings and leaders should be ashamed. Our ancestors should be ashamed, because we sinned against you.

dag: Yɔbuhi bela zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka sisirisi sɔɣiri di kuɣa lɔna ni.
en: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni daa ŋmahi tiŋgbani maa tari ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la n-daa daŋ tiŋgbani deebu.
en: This is the territory assigned to the descendants of Aaron of the clan of Kohath. They received the first share of the land assigned to the Levites.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni tihi zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Mani n-zaŋdi ti wɔɣinli leeri ti jia. Mani zaŋdi ti jia leeri ti wɔɣinli. Mani n-chɛ ka ti mahili leeri ti kuŋ, ka chɛ ka ti kuŋ leeri ti mahili. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka shiri ni niŋ li.
en: Then all the trees in the countryside will know that I, the LORD, bring down the tall tree and raise up the lowly tree, and make the green tree wither and the dry tree bloom. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa; ka daa yihi zɔhi pam maa zaa Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o niriba sani, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: and the Lord answered his prayer. Not a fly was left to pester the king, his officials, or anyone else in Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord told me.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o, Lab kuli nti yɛl a yiŋnim a Duuma ni zo a nambɔɣu ka tum tuun kar shɛli ti a ŋɔ yɛla.
en: But Jesus would not let him. Instead, he said, Go home to your family and tell them how much the Lord has done for you and how good he has been to you.

dag: Wuhibu maa bela lahibal sun shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalana mini alibarikalan ŋɔ ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni ni m mol li la puuni.
en: That teaching is found in the gospel that was entrusted to me to announce, the Good News from the glorious and blessed God.

dag: Yi nyɛla neesim mini wuntaŋ ni niriba. Ti pala yuŋ bee zibisim ni niriba.
en: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.

dag: Di saha ka Filip daa zaŋ litaafi maa ni luɣ shɛli o ni karim maa n-gbaag o Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu.
en: Then Philip began to speak; starting from this passage of scripture, he told him the Good News about Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya, di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus said, I want to heal you. Be healed! Then he touched the man, and immediately the leprosy disappeared.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpuɣi paɣ so pah o zuɣu, di bi simdi ka o filim o bindirigu bee situra bee n-zaɣis o min o dɔnibu.
en: If he takes another woman for himself, he may not reduce her food, clothing, or marital rights.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: And Micaiah concluded: This is what has happened. The Lord has made these prophets of yours lie to you. But he himself has decreed that you will meet with disaster.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛn guli siliga maa pam, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ be kaman kpiimba la.
en: The soldiers guarding the tomb were very afraid of the angel. They shook with fear and then became like dead men.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti chɛ ka ŋmani yiɣi yi ni o nyaa kom maa nyuuya.
en: Noah also sent out a dove. He wanted it to find dry ground. He wanted to know if water still covered the earth.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dar tɔhi binshɛli, dilan yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee sana, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi leei ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ni gbib yi mini yi bihi. Lala ka o daa lan lo ba alikauli ka kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri.
en: You have nothing to fear. I will take care of you and your children. So he reassured them with kind words that touched their hearts.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ni ti kana ti zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be a yiŋ puuni min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali hal ni zuŋɔ la n-kuli Babilɔn, ka di shɛli ku kpalim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: a time is coming when everything in your palace, everything that your ancestors have stored up to this day, will be carried off to Babylonia. Nothing will be left.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n gbarigi zaa; n kul malila nandahima m biɛhigu puuni. Ka n ni be nandahima shɛŋa ni maa zuɣu chɛ ka n gbarigi zaa ka n kɔba ni zaa kul chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣi bɛ binyɛra ni bɛ ti mali soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ di nyɛvili tia la wala, ka doli tiŋ la dunoya kpe di ni la mal alibarika.
en: Happy are those who wash their robes clean and so have the right to eat the fruit from the tree of life and to go through the gates into the city.

dag: Ka di ʒiɛmani maa niriba zaa gba daa ti kpi. Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din paya niriba daa yiɣisina. Bɛn daa bi mi Yawɛ bee m-mi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: When that whole generation had passed away, another generation came after them who didnt know the LORD or the things that he had done for Israel.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaɣisi kpamba la ni daa wuh o shɛm la, ka zaŋla yɛtɔɣ yoli yɛli niriba maa.
en: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors. He spoke bluntly.

dag: A yi ti ba bindirigu maa, bɛ laɣisiri li mi sɔŋ. A yi teeg a nuu, bɛ nyarila binsuŋ kam tiɣi.
en: You give it to them, and they eat it; you provide food, and they are satisfied.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu tuuli alikauli la daa naan ku tooi zani, ka pa ni ʒim n-yi.
en: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋ o tɔbbi kpɛma zaa chaŋ bɛ tuhibu.
en: When David heard this, he sent Joab with the entire army of warriors.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa daa ku ba n-zaŋ ba niŋ kɔbiliga puuni.
en: But after they were inside the town, Ishmael ordered his soldiers to kill them and throw their bodies into a well.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yibu asibaasi n-liri ba n-tuhi ba hal ni zaawuni, ka do so daa bi zo n-tiligi naɣila nachimba kɔbisinahi n-daa ba laakumnim zo n-tiligi.
en: David attacked them from twilight until evening of the next day. He killed them all. No one escaped except four hundred young men who got on camels and fled.

dag: Firawuna ni daa mirina, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lihi bɛ nyaaŋa n-nya ka Ijiptinim maa kani bɛ sanna, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ kuhi pam niŋ Yawɛ.
en: As Pharaoh drew closer, the Israelites looked back and saw the Egyptians marching toward them. The Israelites were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi nya a ni darigi so tibili maa. Di luhiya ni paɣiba ŋubiri bɛ bihi? Bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba? Di luhiya ni bɛ ku maligumaaniba mini anabinim ti Duuma jɛmbu duu?.
en: Look at us, Lord ! Have you ever treated anyone else so badly? Is it right for women to eat their own babies, the children they have cared for? Should priests and prophets be killed in the Temple of the Lord?.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, a bahiyoli paag a, di saha paaya, di biɛɣu neeya, di ti yɛn nyɛla suhusaɣiŋgu dabisili, ka pa ni suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu zoya zuɣu.
en: The end is coming for you people who live in the land. The time is near when there will be no more celebrations at the mountain shrines, only confusion.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu sani bindir shɛŋa nti ti ba. Amaa Bɛnjamin dini daa gar o tab maa dini ʒiibunu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa nyu binnyura, ka bɛ min o zaa suhuri paligi.
en: They were served food from Joseph's table, and Benjamin was given five times as much as each of the others. So Joseph's brothers ate and drank with him and had a good time.

dag: dama Yawɛ je tuumbiɛrinima, amaa wuntizɔriba nyɛla o zɔsimnima.
en: because the Lord hates people who do evil, but he takes righteous people into his confidence.

dag: Di simdi ni karimbia bemi kaman o karimba; ka dabili mi be kaman o duuma. Ka bɛ yi zaŋ alizin biɛri naa yuli Biilzibul m-boli yil yidana, wula ka bɛ lee ni bol o yiŋnim bɛna.
en: Its enough for disciples to be like their teacher and slaves like their master. If they have called the head of the house Beelzebul, its certain that they will call the members of his household by even worse names.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka zibisim titali zibigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka sokam ti kpalim bɔbinda.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, Raise your hand into the air and darkness will cover Egypt. It will be so dark you can feel it.

dag: Amaa nyin pun kpahim baŋ n wuhibu mini m biɛhigu ni n ni lo shɛm m bebu ni ni n yɛda niŋbu yɛla zaŋ tabili n daania niŋbu ni n yurilim ni n ʒiɛyimtali.
en: But you have followed my teaching, my conduct, and my purpose in life; you have observed my faith, my patience, my love, my endurance.

dag: Maak mini Aristakus ni Diimas ni Luk bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditab la gba puhiri ya.
en: as well as my coworkers Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke.

dag: Saamba bɛn be yi sani biɛhigu ni ti du pam gari ya, amaa ka yinim biɛhigu ti labi nyaaŋa pam.
en: Foreigners who live in your land will gain more and more power, while you gradually lose yours.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi kpamba maa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka lan mal o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒiin o tooni la saawara.
en: But he ignored the advice of the older men and went instead to the young men who had grown up with him and who were now his advisers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa zo Dauda sani n-chaŋ ti doli Shiiba Bikiri bia maa, amaa ka Judanim daa doli bɛ naa maa ni ʒiɛyimtali n-yi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So the Israelites deserted David and went with Sheba, but the men of Judah remained loyal and followed David from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

dag: Di sabi Yisa maa yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Kuɣ shɛli yinim tammɛriba ŋɔ ni daa zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka a tuma ti ma suhupiɛlli; a ni tum tuun shɛŋa chɛ ka n yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Your mighty deeds, O Lord , make me glad; because of what you have done, I sing for joy.

dag: Molimiy o jilima yɛla zuliya kam sani, ka mol o ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛŋa niriba zaa sunsuuni shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: Tell every nation on earth, The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka foliŋga maa pirigi kom din be di tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa maa buyi. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: So God made the space and separated the water. Some of the water was above it, and some of the water was below it.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo ŋmanila kulibɔŋ kuma mini sagban shɛŋa sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒiɛri chana, ka Naawuni mali biɛhigu shee bumbɔn ni zali gu ba.
en: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.

dag: Ka o yi ti liri tinsi maa, hal Ijipti gba ti ku tiligi.
en: When he invades all those countries, even Egypt will not be spared.

dag: M mabihi n yɛri ya mi, Ʒim ni be niŋgbun shɛl ni ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni, ka din poori mi ku tooi be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nira n-deeri Naawuni yɛligu; amaa yinim ni pa Naawuni niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi deeri o yɛligu maa.
en: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God.

dag: Ŋunkam deei n zaligu ka dol li, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun yuri ma; ka m Ba ni yuri ŋun yuri ma maa, ka n gba ni yuri dilana ka kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir o.
en: Those who really love me are the ones who not only know my commands but also obey them. My Father will love such people, and I will love them. I will make myself known to them.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba kpɛhi bahiyoli shee.
en: The demons begged Jesus not to send them into the abyss.

dag: Dama yi ni ti bemi kaman oki ti shɛli din vari suui, ka be kaman mahili ni ka pu shɛl ni.
en: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.

dag: Ka bɛ nina maa dii neei. Ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Then the men were able to see. Jesus gave them a strong warning. He said, Dont tell anyone about this.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili maa puuni ka n daa no m-bɔribɔri zuliya kam niriba, ka bɛ ʒim yi n-do tiŋgban ni.
en: In my anger I trampled whole nations and shattered them. I poured out their lifeblood on the ground.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Makɛda n-gari chaŋ Libina ti liri Libinanima.
en: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.

dag: Suhudoo be ŋmɛnditoya yinsi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ wuna niŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuu ni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisiri ŋɔ lee nyɛ bɛn yiri barina ni.
en: But thieves and godless people live in peace, though their only god is their own strength.

dag: Bihi nyɛla pini din yi Yawɛ sanna. Bihi nyɛla bidɔɣibo laara din yi Yawɛ sanna.
en: Children are a gift from the Lord , a reward from a mothers womb.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa ti kurigi ka o nina niŋ liti, ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli, ka o daa bol o bituuli Iso na ti yɛl o, M bia. Ka o saɣi yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: Isaac grew old, and his eyes became so weak that he could not see clearly. One day he called his older son Esau to him and said, Son! Esau answered, Here I am.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi ti kul biri bimbirili kam, Midiannim maa mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim kanimina ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Whenever the Israelites planted seeds, the Midianites, Amalekites, and other easterners would invade.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, ti nyɛla daba m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ti yaannim maa ni hal ni zuŋɔ. A daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ diri di tiwala, ka nyari di pin suma daanfaani.
en: Now we are slaves in this fruitful land you gave to our ancestors.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni tahima lan kani, o kɔŋla o bia maa, ka o daa lan piig o bi so wums o ka o niŋ yaa.
en: She waited until she saw all hope was gone. Then she raised another of her cubs, and he grew into a fierce lion.

dag: Ŋunkam chihi Bia maa, o ka ti Ba Naawuni. Ka ŋunkam deei Bia maa mali ti Ba Naawuni gba.
en: Whoever does not believe in the Son does not have the Father, but whoever accepts the Son has the Father too.

dag: Ka zoya ni saa buri ba, ka bɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn kpe shɛli yi saa bubu ni, ka baɣila tampima.
en: They are soaked with rain in the mountains. They stay close to the large rocks for shelter.

dag: chɛliya ka paɣiba shini baalim cheechinim ni, dama bɛ ka soli ni bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛ toondaannim kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: the women should be quiet during the meeting. They are not allowed to talk. Instead, they need to get under control, just as the Law says.

dag: O daa lan mali bidibis anu, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Hashuba mini Ohɛl ni Bɛrɛkia ni Hasadia ni Jushabihɛsɛd, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu.
en: Zerubbabel had five other sons also. Their names were Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, N-hii, pumpɔŋɔ a yipa kahigiri yɛri ti, ka di pa ŋaha puuni yaha!.
en: The disciples said, Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.

dag: Bee bɔndali ka ti daa nya o ka a biɛra bee nti be sarika ni, ka ti ka a sanna ti kaag a.
en: When did we ever see you sick or in prison, and visit you.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ wumbu, m poya, yili ŋɔ ni leei dabɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: But I, the Lord , tell you that if you dont obey these commands, then I promise with an oath in my own name that this kings palace will be destroyed—it will become a pile of rocks.

dag: O chɛ ka wuntaŋ su wuntaŋ ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.

dag: ka bɛ gahi bɛ kulipal tab nuu ni bɛ kana ti sɔŋ ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba, ka bɛ yihi zahim maa pali ŋarima ayi maa zaa hal ka di ti yɛn shim.
en: They called to their friends in the other boat to come and help them. The friends came, and both boats were filled so full of fish that they were almost sinking.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa na ni bɛ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Next, Moses brought the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mali ti shili gu dimbɔŋɔ, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le da kol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim.
en: Nor do you pour new wine into used wineskins, because the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will pour out, and the skins will be ruined.

dag: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la daa lan mali bidib shɛba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Haroi ŋun zuliya nyɛ Mɛnuhɔtinim pirigili la.
en: Shobal, the founder of Kiriath Jearim, was the ancestor of the people of Haroeh, of half the inhabitants of Menuhoth.

dag: Bɛ daa guni ma la daba anii dali. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Izraɛl nira. N yila Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Hiburu alali. Ka zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim zaligunim mi dolibu polo n daa nyɛla Farisii;.
en: I was circumcised on the eighth day after my birth. I am from the people of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Jew, and so were my parents. The law was very important to me. That is why I became a Pharisee.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nyɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna la zuɣu, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun kɔhiri bindira maa tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa zuɣu. Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa kana ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa.
en: Joseph, as governor of the land of Egypt, was selling grain to people from all over the world. So Joseph's brothers came and bowed down before him with their faces to the ground.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi niŋ yɛda ka bi biɛhim, pa n ni niŋ fiig tia ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko ka yi ni niŋ, amaa hal yi yi yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ ti lu teeku ni ha, di ni niŋ lala.
en: Jesus answered, I assure you that if you believe and do not doubt, you will be able to do what I have done to this fig tree. And not only this, but you will even be able to say to this hill, Get up and throw yourself in the sea, and it will.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛla ba yaha, Dinzuɣu di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: So do not be afraid of people. Whatever is now covered up will be uncovered, and every secret will be made known.

dag: Elɔn mi kalinsi yaaŋa, Hilliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la bia Abidɔn n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: After Elon, Abdon son of Hillel from Pirathon led Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ni ti chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, a mi ni bihi ŋɔ ka yaa, ka biŋkɔb bihi bɛn mɔɣiri be biŋkɔbiri maa ni, ka di simdi ni n chɛ ka n zaɣa be bɛ ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti yi taɣi ba chaŋ pam dahin yini, bɛ zaa ni kpi.
en: But Jacob said to him, You know that my children are weak. And I must be careful with my flocks and their young animals. If I force them to walk too far in one day, all the animals will die.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli: N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor nodded at Paul, giving him permission to speak. He responded, I know that you have been judge over this nation for many years, so I gladly offer my own defense.

dag: Ti Duuma, deem ti suhigu ka chɛ m-paŋ ti. Ti Duuma, wummi ti suhigu maa ka niŋ ti ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni nyini n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni. Di chɛ ka di lan yuui! Tiŋ maa mini niriba maa nyɛla a dini.
en: Lord, hear us. Lord, forgive us. Lord, listen to us, and act! In order that everyone will know that you are God, do not delay! This city and these people are yours.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi pahi buyi ti suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, pipia ŋɔ yi ku miligi n zuɣu ka pa ni n nyu li mi, nyin chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ.
en: Again Jesus went to pray and said, My Father, if there is no other way, and I must suffer, I will still do what you want.

dag: Ka ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa zaŋ o ti, ka bɛ di o saria n-yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But our leaders and the leading priests handed him over to be judged and killed. They nailed him to a cross.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa dari yuri Ijipti mini Silisia tiŋgbana ni, ka naa kɔhigɔriba daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomon's merchants bought his horses and chariots in the regions of Musri and Kue. They paid pieces of silver for a chariot and pieces of silver for a horse. They also sold horses and chariots to the Hittite and Syrian kings.

dag: Ishimail bidibisi yuya kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ ba pa tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛbaiɔt ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Kɛdar ni Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: These are the names of Ishmaels sons, by their names and according to their birth order: Nebaioth, Ishmaels oldest son; Kedar; Adbeel; Mibsam.

dag: A mi bɛ ni turi ma, ka dihiri ma vi, ka filindi ma shɛm yɛla; a mi n dimnim zaa.
en: You know full well the insults Ive received; you know my shame and my disgrace. All my adversaries are right there in front of you.

dag: Ti ni lo kpara du Yawɛ ninni n-chaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti yɛn su li maa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli ŋɔ na.
en: We will cross the Jordan River and march before the Lord into the land of Canaan. And our part of the country is the land east of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Pɛnuɛluɛlnim maa, N yi ti labina ni alaafee, n ni daai yi pii ŋɔ luhi.
en: So he said to them, I am going to come back safe and sound, and when I do, I will tear this tower down.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum n Duuma kukoli ka di yɛra, Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn tim, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti ti? Ka n daa yɛli, N-nyɛ ma; timmi ma.
en: Then I heard the Lords voice, saying, Who can I send? Who will go for us? So I said, Here I am. Send me.

dag: Ŋunkam mi deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani.
en: Whoever accepts a little child like this in my name is accepting me.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ kuliga ni nti kpaai yalim maa bahi kom maa ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, n chɛ ka kom maa leei ko viɛlli; ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di ku lan ku so bee n-chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: and he went to the spring, threw the salt in the water, and said, This is what the Lord says: I make this water pure, and it will not cause any more deaths or miscarriages.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla alizanda tiŋbihi, ka ti suhuri kul yɛla tiligir so ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia m-be alizanda ni la labbuna zuɣu.
en: Our citizenship is in heaven. We look forward to a savior that comes from there—the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Sɛnnachɛrib, Jɛrusalɛm lar a mi ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: the Lord had said, The city of Jerusalem laughs at you, Sennacherib, and makes fun of you.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti ni bɔh o nya.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord 's prophets we can ask.

dag: Amaa bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ di ni bi simdi ni yi ŋubi shɛba: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: But don't eat the meat of any of the following birds: eagles, vultures, falcons, kites, ravens, ostriches, owls, sea gulls, hawks, pelicans, ospreys, cormorants, storks, herons, and hoopoes. You must not eat bats.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni yɛla polo taɣi ʒiri, ka doli binnamda n-jɛmdi li ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa namda ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: They exchange the truth about God for a lie; they worship and serve what God has created instead of the Creator himself, who is to be praised forever! Amen.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti chɛ ka yi nya alahiziba binyara kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka n chɛ ka yi nya li shɛm la.
en: I did many miracles when I took you out of Egypt. I will let you see more miracles like that.

dag: Ɛhud kum nyaaŋa, Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha.
en: After Ehud died, the people again did what the Lord said was wrong.

dag: Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni ka gbib ya;.
en: May the Lord bless you and take care of you;.

dag: Amaa ŋun mi n ni doli so shɛli, o yi vihi ma o ni nya ka n viɛlimi kaman salima la.
en: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sabimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛtɔɣa maa ka n zaŋ lo a mini Izraɛlnim alikauli.
en: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni, ka yi yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam mi dunia ŋɔ ni, di ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: I assure you that whatever you fasten on earth will be fastened in heaven. And whatever you loosen on earth will be loosened in heaven.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna. Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Yi va n-ʒi pam. Dama niriba ŋɔ zaa yinoyino nyɛla bɛn be kasi, ka Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi ti duhi yimaŋ Yawɛ niriba sani lala.
en: They assembled before Moses and Aaron and said to them, You have gone too far! All the members of the community belong to the Lord , and the Lord is with all of us. Why, then, Moses, do you set yourself above the Lord 's community.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari bihikpam, amaa ka lee lo tɔbu o suhu ni; o yɛtɔɣa bali gari kpam, amaa ka ŋmari kaman sudirili la.
en: Though his talk is smoother than butter, war is in his heart; though his words are more silky than oil, they are really drawn swords.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa lo tɔbu yi Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol.
en: So six hundred men from the tribe of Dan left Zorah and Eshtaol, ready for battle.

dag: Naawuni ku chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maai; o nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi Reehab la.
en: God wont retract his anger; the helpers of Rahab bow beneath him.

dag: Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa soya ka m bɔhim baŋ a daalahiziba tuma.
en: Help me understand your instructions, and I will think about your wonderful teachings.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Kiriatijiarim maa yuui pam. Di daa niŋ la yuun pisi nimaani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa kul ye Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: Now a long time passed—a total of twenty years—after the chest came to stay in Kiriath-jearim, and the whole house of Israel yearned for the LORD.

dag: N Duuma, wummi n kuhigu! Gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: my Lord, listen to my voice! Let your ears pay close attention to my request for mercy!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: When you come into the land that the Lord is giving you and you harvest your grain, take the first sheaf to the priest.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛr ya shɛm ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi ti boli buɣili yuli n-jɛm li bee n-chɛ ka so wum lala yɛtɔɣa yi noya ni.
en: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔhi tɔto shɛli maa ti ba naai, n ni doli yi yi sanna gari chaŋ Speen.
en: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.

dag: Di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi ku o shia; amaa zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi zaŋ daadam niŋgbuŋ min o shia zaa niŋ buɣim ni la.
en: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.

dag: Di saha ka Sool bipuɣiŋga ŋun pah ayi ka o yuli daa booni Mikal la suhu daa yu Dauda pam, ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla, ka di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: Now Sauls younger daughter Michal loved David. When this was reported to Saul, he was happy about it.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa naan ku lan tooi zani Musa tooni yaha bintɔra maa zuɣu, dama bintɔra maa daa tola timanim maa mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: The magicians were not able to appear before Moses, because they were covered with boils, like all the other Egyptians.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuun biɛ shɛli nyaŋ a, amaa nyin zaŋmi zaɣ suŋ niŋbu nyaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont be defeated by evil, but defeat evil with good.

dag: Di nyɛla shihirili shɛli din kul ni be m mini Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ daa zaŋla daba ayɔbu n-nam zuɣusaa mini dunia, ka vuhi daba ayopɔin dali, ka n ni maai. .
en: It is a permanent sign between the people of Israel and me, because I, the Lord , made heaven and earth in six days, and on the seventh day I stopped working and rested.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn chɛmi ka sanʒiɛ biɛɣu ʒe Babilɔn mini di niriba.
en: The Lord says, I am bringing a destructive wind against Babylonia and its people.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti kpe duu maa ni na, ka neesim neei duu maa puuni zaa; ka malaika maa daa chaŋ ti kpahi Pita luɣili n-neeg o yɛli, Yiɣisim yomyom! Ka zoligɔnim din daa lo o nuhi la surigi lu tiŋa.
en: Suddenly an angel of the Lord stood there, and a light shone in the cell. The angel shook Peter by the shoulder, woke him up, and said, Hurry! Get up! At once the chains fell off Peter's hands.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu tuuli alikauli la daa naan ku tooi zani, ka pa ni ʒim n-yi.
en: So not even the first covenant was put into effect without blood.

dag: Ka Ɛlizabɛt dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka o dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: The time came for Elizabeth to have her baby, and she gave birth to a son.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi duɣuri mini soobuya ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa n-kpihindi firilanima ni tulaale zim lahi ni daanya la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni la.
en: They carried off the bronze things used for worship at the temple, including the pans for hot ashes, and the shovels, snuffers, and also the dishes for incense.

dag: ka benya kaman dunɔguliba bɛn mali shili ʒi n-guli bɛ duuma ni o ti yi amiliya chuɣu ni na n-niŋ gaafara ka bɛ yoog o yom ka o gari.
en: just like those servants who wait up for their master to return from a wedding feast. As soon as he comes and knocks, they open the door for him.

dag: Dama bɛ chira tariga yi ti paai, bɛ baɣa bɔ n-lee lan be bɛ malibu ni, bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: When their life is finished and they are dead, they will not care about the family they leave behind.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, bihilaamba ni ti ŋubi bɛ bihi, ka bihi gba ti ŋubi bɛ laamba. N ni ti kari ya saria, ka wurim yi bɛn kpalim la dolisi pɔhim kam.
en: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.

dag: Ka paɣ yi po pɔri ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o yidan yiŋa.
en: A married woman might make a promise to give something to the Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya maa, tuuli dini daa gbaala Asaf yiŋ Yisifu, ka din pah ayi daa gbaai Gɛdalia min o mabihi ni o bidibisi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: The first lot fell for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, his relatives, and his family.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti nyo di biŋkpam zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman suhudoo sara maligu la din ni chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo alahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: He will completely burn all of its fat on the altar just as the fat of the communal sacrifice of well-being is burned. In this way the priest will make reconciliation for the leader to remove his sin, and he will be forgiven.

dag: Nyama, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na, nyin zaŋm mi ʒiɛ shɛl a ni zaŋ tiri takɔro ni ka ti dol li yina ŋɔ n-lo a yiŋ maa takɔro maa, ka laɣim a ba min a ma ni a mabihi ni a ba yiŋnim zaa na nti niŋ a yiŋ maa ni.
en: This is what you must do. When we invade your land, tie this red cord to the window you let us down from. Get your father and mother, your brothers, and all your father's family together in your house.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, di luhiya ni yi yɛl lala? Yawɛ suɣilo maa naami? O niŋsim m-bala? N yɛtɔɣa bi niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuun suma zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: Do you think the people of Israel are under a curse? Has the Lord lost his patience? Would he really do such things? Doesn't he speak kindly to those who do right.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Molimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu n-yɛra, Wummiya alikauli ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka gbibi li.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Go to the cities of Judah and to the streets of Jerusalem. Proclaim my message there and tell the people to listen to the terms of the covenant and to obey them.

dag: Ka nir yi yuri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa min o tɛha zaa ni o kpiɔŋ tariga, ka yur o ʒiʒiinikpee kaman omaŋmaŋ la, di gari sara malibu balibu kam.
en: And to love God with all of the heart, a full understanding, and all of ones strength, and to love ones neighbor as oneself is much more important than all kinds of entirely burned offerings and sacrifices.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ zaɣ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la; ka maligumaana maa mali sanyoo sara yo daɣ shɛli din daa yi o ni maa samli Yawɛ sani ti o.
en: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.

dag: O daa yi ti chɛ ka bɛ kpira, bɛ ŋmaligirimi lab o sani ti niŋ tuuba, ka jɛmd o ni nimmoo.
en: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli wuntia soli m-me o yili mini ŋun bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli m me o jirambisa, ka chɛ ka o taba tum o tuma yoli ka o bi yo ba zuɣu.
en: It will be very bad for King Jehoiakim. He is doing wrong so that he can build his palace. He is cheating people so that he can build rooms upstairs. He is not paying his own people. He is making them work for nothing.

dag: Ka m mi nya ka o bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum; amaa omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ni o bɔri ni o zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani zuɣu ka n gba lɔri nia ni n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tah o sani.
en: I have not found him guilty of any crime deserving death. But because he has asked to be judged by the Emperor, I have decided to send him to Rome.

dag: dama yi na kul dolila daadam biɛhigu. Nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu yi be yi sunsuuni, pa daadam biɛhigu ka yi doli ka niŋdi kaman dunianim ni niŋdi shɛm?.
en: Now you are still not up to it because you are still unspiritual. When jealousy and fighting exist between you, arent you unspiritual and living by human standards?.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n zuɣu nyɛ kɔbiliga, ka n nina nyɛ nintam kɔbilinini ka n di tooi kuhiri bɛ ni ku n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.

dag: ni Ɛnrimɔn ni Zɔra ni Jarimut.
en: in Enrimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth.

dag: ka Avitinim me Nibihaz mini Taritak buɣili zali, ka Sɛfarivaimnim mi daa mali bɛ bihi nyɔri buɣim tiri Adirammɛlɛk mini Anammɛlɛk bɛn daa nyɛ Sɛravimnim buɣa la.
en: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛl o, ka o yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir yɛl la. O daa yɛliya, Bahi ni ti ŋubi Jɛzibɛl niŋgbuŋ Jɛziriil tintariga;.
en: When they reported this to Jehu, he said, This is what the Lord said would happen, when he spoke through his servant Elijah: Dogs will eat Jezebel's body in the territory of Jezreel.

dag: Tizɔriba kul zɔrimi doli taba, ka tuumba kul zɔri doli taba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Babilɔn naa ni bɛ deeg o tiŋ la zaa.
en: Messenger after messenger runs to tell the king of Babylonia that his city has been broken into from every side.

dag: Yi pun lan wum ka di sab yɛli, So yi fɔɣ a nini, a gba nyin fɔɣim o dini labisi, ka so yi ŋme n-kab a nyini, a gba nyin ŋmɛm kab o dini labisi.
en: You have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth .

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na ka o nyaandoliba ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, nyam kuɣa ŋɔ mini duri ŋɔ ni viɛl shɛm.
en: As Jesus was leaving the Temple, one of his disciples said, Look, Teacher! What wonderful stones and buildings.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ tuuli naɣ kara ayopɔin la ŋubi.
en: The skinny cows ate the fat ones.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun kariti saria ni wuntia; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, dama n zaŋla di binshɛɣukam niŋ a nuu ni.
en: So I prayed, Lord All-Powerful, you are a fair judge. You know how to test peoples hearts and minds. I will tell you my arguments, and I will let you give them the punishment they deserve.

dag: Yawɛ daa be alizanda ni ka tahi bahina, ka bɛ daa wum Zallakudura Naa kukoli.
en: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Shua bipuɣiŋga la daa kpi. O ni daa mal o kuli naai nyaaŋa ka o min o zo Hira ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la chaŋ Timna ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chɛr o piɛri kɔbiri la sani.
en: After some time Judah's wife died. When he had finished the time of mourning, he and his friend Hirah of Adullam went to Timnah, where his sheep were being sheared.

dag: Ka yi yi zaŋ ŋumbɔŋɔ gba chaŋ, ka binshɛli ti niŋ o, yi ni chɛ ka n kpi ni n zab piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: If you take this one from me now and something happens to him, the sorrow you would cause me would kill me, as old as I am.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni dabiɛm mini ni sɔhibu.
en: Serve the Lord with fear; tremble.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bala, biɛɣuni ni sa nyɛ vuhim dabisi tibisili ka nyɛ Yawɛ vuhim dabisi kasi la zuɣu. Shɛmiya yin ni tooi she shɛli zuŋɔ, ka duɣiya yin ni tooi duɣi shɛli zuŋɔ, ka din guui yin zaŋmiya li zali hal ni asiba.
en: He said to them, This is what the LORD has said, Tomorrow is a day of rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. But you can set aside and keep all the leftovers until the next morning.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tikpiranima, wummiya! Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoomba, duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya!.
en: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n daa zaŋla n nuu kpɛh a biɛhigu ni zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, mani n-daa piɛl a dimnim maa bah a zuɣu a wahala saha min a nandahima saha.
en: Lord , may all their curses come true if I have not served you well, if I have not pleaded with you on behalf of my enemies when they were in trouble and distress. .

dag: N dooni gbihira, ka lan yirisira, dama Yawɛ n-guli ma.
en: I can lie down to rest and know that I will wake up, because the Lord covers and protects me.

dag: Di saha ka paɣipiɛlisi maa zaa daa yiɣisi malimali bɛ firilanima.
en: The ten young women woke up and trimmed their lamps.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba je ni so kpahi bɛ zuɣuri ni; bɛ ku chaŋ yɛnnim sani.
en: Fools hate to be told they are wrong, so they refuse to ask wise people for advice.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa po pɔri yɛli, Naawuni yi ni be n sani, ka gbib ma n ni chani luɣ shɛli ŋɔ, ka ti ma bindirigu ka n di, ka ti ma situra ka n ye.
en: Jacob made a solemn promise: If God is with me and protects me on this trip Im taking, and gives me bread to eat and clothes to wear.

dag: Chɛ ka n naba yaabu doli soli ka n chani kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka di chɛ ka tuumbiɛri nyaŋ ma.
en: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu ku tɔŋ, amaa ŋunkam yihi li palɔni, ka zaɣisi li ni nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.

dag: N daa jɛmdi ti Duuma ni maŋsiɣisibu mini nintam m-pahi muɣisigu shɛŋa n ni daa nyari Yɛhudianim ni daa dooni guri ma sol la zuɣu.
en: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears in the midst of trials that came upon me because of the Jews schemes.

dag: Amaa dɔbba pia daa be bɛ ni ka yɛli Ishimail, Di ku ti, dama ti mali alikama mini chi ni kpam ni shiri ka di sɔɣi mɔri ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ba, ka bi ku ba pahi bɛ tab maa zuɣu.
en: But there were ten men in the group who said to Ishmael, Please don't kill us! We have wheat, barley, olive oil, and honey hidden in the fields. So he spared them.

dag: Taibɛrius Siiza ni daa diri nam, ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu saha shɛl la, ka Pɔntius Pailɛt daa nyɛ Judia Gomna, ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa diri Galili, ka o tizo Filip daa su Ituria mini Trakɔnaitis, ka Naa Laisanias diri Abiliin.
en: It was the th year of the rule of Tiberius Caesar. These men were under Caesar: Pontius Pilate, the governor of Judea; Herod, the ruler of Galilee; Philip, Herods brother, the ruler of Iturea and Trachonitis; Lysanias, the ruler of Abilene.

dag: niriba ayi n-daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni; bɛ ni yino daa nyɛla Farisii, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ farigudeera.
en: Two men went into the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

dag: A mi ni lan zo ti nambɔɣu, a ni zaŋ ti daalahichi sɔŋ a naba ni no li. A ni zaŋ ti daalahichi zaa bahi teeku bulli ni.
en: He will once again have compassion on us; he will tread down our iniquities. You will hurl all our sins into the depths of the sea.

dag: O daa zaɣis o biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ tanti du shɛl ni o ni daa be ninsalinim sunsuuni la.
en: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni paɣ zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu malaikanim zuɣu, ka di wuhi ni so su o fukumsi.
en: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni di chɛ ka n suhupiɛlli be yi ni, ka yi suhupiɛlli maa yaɣi.
en: I have said these things to you so that my joy will be in you and your joy will be complete.

dag: Ti mali tahima ni Naawuni ni ti yihi ti taali ni o sani; ka dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ ti ni guhiri shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko din tumdi di tuma ti yɛda niŋbu ni la puuni.
en: I say this because our hope of being right with God comes through faith. And the Spirit helps us feel sure as we wait for that hope.

dag: Di saha ka zaligubaŋdib ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, a ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni a galindila ti gba.
en: One of the legal experts responded, Teacher, when you say these things, you are insulting us too.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini yi ni chani ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa lo tab alikauli. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni leei tɔŋ yi sani.
en: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.

dag: Naawuni ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni di tiŋkpansi shɛm la, lala ka so ti ku lan be nimaani gba bee n-ʒini nimaani. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Just as God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors, declares the LORD, so no one will live in Babylon or settle there again.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Uzziah did what the Lord wanted him to do. He obeyed God the same as his father Amaziah had done.

dag: M mabia Jɔnatan, n suhu saɣimya pam a zuɣu. M min a biɛhigu daa lu n-taɣili tab pam. A yurilim zaŋ chaŋ n sani daa mali alahiziba, ka galisi pam gari paɣ ni mali yurilim shɛm.
en: Jonathan, my brother, I miss you! I enjoyed your friendship so much. Your love for me was wonderful, stronger than the love of women.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha n ni zaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa zaa kpe n-kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the Temple treasures that King Nebuchadnezzar took to Babylonia.

dag: amaa wuuni ka bɛ laɣisiri bɛ bindira sɔŋda, atam kpuɣibu saha ka bɛ vari bɛ bindira sɔŋda.
en: but they store up their food during the summer, getting ready for winter.

dag: Judanim kuhirimi, ka bɛ fɔntinsinim tarigi; bɛ dola tiŋgban ni ni suhugarigu, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim kuhigu chaŋ haliya.
en: Judah is in mourning; its cities are dying, its people lie on the ground in sorrow, and Jerusalem cries out for help.

dag: Dama yi yi diri wahala din tuhi tumbu zuɣu ka di nyɛla Naawuni yubu m-bala, di so ni yi di wahala din bi tuhi tumbu zuɣu.
en: For it is better to suffer for doing good, if this should be God's will, than for doing evil.

dag: Ŋuna n-deeri dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannim yɛm ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi mɔɣu.
en: He makes their leaders foolish. He makes them wander around in the desert.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin kpɛm a duu nti yo a dunoli ka suh a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: But when you pray, go to your room, shut the door, and pray to your Father who is present in that secret place. Your Father who sees what you do in secret will reward you.

dag: Ŋun mali tɛha yuuni bɔrila yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun kul lihirila dunia luɣilikam.
en: An intelligent person aims at wise action, but a fool starts off in many directions.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn kpalim, wummiya! Mani n-daa gbibi ya yi manim puuni zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ.
en: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord . Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan labina nti neei ma kaman nir ni yi gbihiri ka bɛ neeg o shɛm la.
en: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.

dag: Ilaija ni daa wum li saha shɛli, o daa zaŋla o binyɛrigu pɔb o nina yi nti ʒe vokabili maa dunol ni. Nyama, ka kukoli maa daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: When Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his cloak and went out and stood at the entrance of the cave. A voice said to him, Elijah, what are you doing here.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ti Kɔhat bihi la shɛli, dama bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din be kasi la buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.

dag: Doli dimbɔŋɔnima, ka zaŋ amaŋ ti li, ka di chɛ ka sokam nya a tooni chandi a tuma puuni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kun ya, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi sɔŋ ya?.
en: I will destroy you, people of Israel! Then who can help you?.
