dag: Yaakubu zuliya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin: Yisifu ŋun daa pun bela Ijipti.
en: The total number in Jacobs family was seventy. Joseph was already in Egypt.

dag: Chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi gili luɣilikam wurim a dimnima. Zaŋm a piɛma to ba ka bɛ guui.
en: Send flashes of lightning and scatter your enemies; shoot your arrows and send them running.

dag: Zuɣusaa wuhir o wuntitali; ka zuliya kam zaa nyar o jilima.
en: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the nations see his glory.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli zali maa zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili gili. Dina n-nyɛ luɣ kasi shee zaŋ tabili tiŋ maa tiŋgban la.
en: This special area of land will be square. It will be , cubits long by , cubits wide. You must set apart this area for its special purposes. One part is for the priests, one part is for the Levites, and one part is for the city.

dag: A ni ti boli ma, ka n saɣi. A kɔre ni ti be a nuhi tuma ni.
en: You would call, and I would answer you; you would long for your handiwork.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi m-bo chi pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti pa sara maligu tampiŋ bimbini zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma ŋɔ.
en: Then Manoah sacrificed a young goat on a rock. He offered the goat and a grain offering as a gift to the Lord and to the One Who Does Amazing Things.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, n yi zaŋ n nuhi tum taali.
en: LORD, my God, if I have done this— if my hands have done anything wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmahi abie tihi wula din mali vari n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli ka kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Izraɛlnim Naa ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika.
en: They took palm branches and went out to meet him. They shouted, Hosanna! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Blessings on the king of Israel.

dag: Izar daŋ ni, Kɛnania min o bidibisi ka bɛ daa pii ni bɛ tumdi samban ni tuma, ka nyɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn maani Izraɛlnim yɛla.
en: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.

dag: Ka daa yɛli sapashini ni o zaŋm Pool ti kpɛhi duu, amaa ka lee wɔɣis o, ka chɛ ka o zɔnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋd o kan o sanna.
en: Felix told the army officer to keep Paul guarded but to give him some freedom and to let his friends bring whatever he needed.

dag: ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum mini alɔbo ti luri pam; ka binyara din kpɛhiri niriba dabiɛm ti beni, ka shihir kara ti wuhiri zuɣusaa.
en: There will be great earthquakes, sicknesses, and other bad things in many places. In some places there will be no food for the people to eat. Terrible things will happen, and amazing things will come from heaven to warn people.

dag: O kul ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni saha shɛli zaa dɔro ŋɔ ni na be o ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni o yi kpaŋ ti be o ko.
en: They will be unclean as long as they are infected. They are unclean. They must live alone outside the camp.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: I say to you in all seriousness that you wont get out of there until youve paid the very last penny.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia na maa nyaaŋa, ka Naawuni daa lan ka o sanna ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: God appeared to Jacob again, while he was on his way back from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.

dag: Yisa ni daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni lan baai du duli ha nti ʒe teeku noli ka salo pam daa lan laɣim o sanna.
en: Jesus crossed the lake again, and on the other side a large crowd gathered around him on the shore.

dag: Yi yi wum zaligunim ŋɔ ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbib o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani la.
en: If you listen to these laws, and if you are careful to obey them, the Lord your God will keep his agreement of love with you. He promised this to your ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ dabili maa daa kpi nimaani Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa.
en: Then Moses, the Lord s servant, died there in the land of Moab. The Lord had told Moses this would happen.

dag: A zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. To, ti ni wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti zaŋ takɔbi su Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ takɔbi su Nimrɔd tiŋgbɔŋ; ka Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti be ti tintarisi bɛ ni fa ti bahi.
en: They will shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with the drawn sword. He will rescue us from Assyria when he invades our land and treads within our territory.

dag: Ti zaa ba pala ba yino? Pa Naawuni yino n-nam ti? Ka wula ka ti bi ʒe tab yim, ka saɣindi Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛli maa?.
en: Isnt there one father for all of us, one God who created us? Why does everyone cheat each other to make the covenant of our ancestors impure?.

dag: So na ʒi n-zaɣis omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o dihiri li mi ka maani li kaman Masia ni niŋdi cheechi shɛm la.
en: None of us ever hate our own bodies. Instead, we feed them, and take care of them, just as Christ does the church;.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisifu dan maa paɣ ti lihir o kɔre lihigu, ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: and Potiphar's wife soon noticed him. She asked him to make love to her.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti sa Ashɛra tia baɣili yi ni ti yɛn me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbin shɛl la.
en: When you set up an altar for the Lord your God, you must not place beside the altar any of the wooden poles that honor the goddess Asherah.

dag: A niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba, amaa di nyaaŋa ka bɛ labina ti bol a yuli, ka fabili niŋ a, ka suh a, duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness.

dag: Ka bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa zaa daa niŋ lala, ka chɛ bɛ firilanim gbib bɛ nuzahi ni, ka gbib kikahi mi bɛ nudiriti ni m-piɛbiri ka kuhiri yɛra, Yawɛ mini Gidiɔn takɔbi.
en: So the three units blew their trumpets and broke their jars, holding the torches with their left hands and blowing the trumpets in their right hands. And they called out, A sword for the LORD and for Gideon.

dag: Ka Mɛnahɛm daa ti kani, ka o bia Pɛkahia di nam zan o zaani.
en: Menahem lay down with his ancestors. His son Pekahiah succeeded him as king.

dag: Naa suhu yi ti piɛla, alaafee benimi. Ka o nirilim ŋmanila sagbana din tahiri siɣili saa na.
en: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali bimparilani, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi pa di zuɣu yɛli, O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani. Chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la.
en: Make an ornament of pure gold and engrave on it Dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ bɔhim baŋ din tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: Therefore, test everything to see whats pleasing to the Lord.

dag: N yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi zaa ha polo kul zoorimi pahira Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ami!.
en: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, ka yi yi bɔri ba din viɛli niŋbu, yi ni tooi niŋ ba saha shɛlikam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have the poor with you. And whenever you want to, you can give to them. But you won't always have me here with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi kari zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa yomyom, ka mi daa bi chɛ ka Jɔshua kari ba.
en: The Lord allowed those nations to stay in the land. He did not quickly force them to leave the country. He did not help Joshuas army defeat them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu n-chani bɔri Yawɛ shee, amaa bɛ ti ku nya o, dama o zo bɛ sani.
en: They take their sheep and cattle to offer as sacrifices to the Lord , but it does them no good. They cannot find him, for he has left them.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pinaanu dali chuɣu maa puhibu daba ayopɔin puuni, di simdi ka o lan bo lala bina maa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni chi mini kawana ni kpam sara.
en: For the festival that begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, he will make the same provisions for the purification offerings, entirely burned offerings, grain offerings, and oil, for all seven days of the festival.

dag: zaŋ Aroa din daa be Arinɔn vinvamli naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ la hal ti paai Siriɔn Zoli .
en: This land extended from the town of Aroer, on the edge of the Arnon River, all the way north to Mount Sirion, that is, Mount Hermon.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o kpambaliba bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba la nuu ni. Di nyaaŋa niriba ni ti lan be Ijipti kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni la. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will hand them over to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army. But I also promise that Egypt will someday have people living here again, just as it had before. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Alizin biɛɣu bi ʒi n zuɣu; n tirila m Ba Naawuni jilima, amaa ka yinim lee ʒiɛmdi ma.
en: Jesus answered, I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.

dag: Naawuni, n ni zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ shɛli ti a la ti a. N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo pini ti a.
en: God, I will keep the special promises I made to you. I will give you my thank offering.

dag: N zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini la ti Lɛvinima ni di nyɛ bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri.
en: I have given all the one-tenth portions in Israel to the Levites as an inheritance. They are a reward for performing their service in the meeting tent.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ka o mini Sool labi, ka Sool ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Samuel followed Saul back, and Saul worshiped the Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la kɔŋko zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus answered, God sent me only to the lost people of Israel.

dag: Ham bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Kush mini Ijipti ni Put ni Keenan.
en: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Apis guui? Bɔzuɣu ka yi naɣilaa maa di bi zani? Yawɛ ni ŋme o luhi zuɣu.
en: Why have your mighty fallen? Why havent they stood their ground? Because the LORD has struck them down.

dag: Di saha ka yɛri bɛ taba, Ti nyɛla bɛn be kasi; miligimiya ka chɛ ti. M mini niriba bɛn be lala ku tooi kpe. N suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani ŋmanila buɣim din bi kpiri dabisili puuni zaa.
en: And then they say to others, Keep away from us; we are too holy for you to touch! I cannot stand people like that—my anger against them is like a fire that never goes out.

dag: Yisifu ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala, ka nyɛ din ʒe n-tab kulibɔŋ, ka di wula zooi yaɣi kuligbiriŋ zuɣu.
en: Joseph, you are a fruitful vine growing near a stream and climbing a wall.

dag: Di saha ka na so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam ni ti yiɣisi n-di nam su o nam sulinsi ni yiko, ka tumd o ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then a warrior-king will come forward, ruling over a vast empire and doing whatever he wants.

dag: Yi ŋmari ʒiri n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba suhuri gbarigira, hal n ni bi gbarigir bɛ suhuri maa zaa yoli; ka kpaŋsiri ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba ni ka bɛ bi niŋdi tuuba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: You prophets tell lies. Your lies hurt good people—I did not want to hurt them! You support the wicked and encourage them. You dont tell them to change their lives. You dont try to save their lives!.

dag: O ka ba bee ma bee zuliya; o ka piligu, o mi ka bahigu, amaa o ŋmanila Naawuni Bia, ka kul nyɛ maligumaana hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.

dag: Di simdi ni a vili zaɣ yini gbibi, amaa ka di chɛ din la gba bahi; dama ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Naawuni ni tooi gbibi di bina ayi maa zaa.
en: Try to be a little of this and a little of that. Even Gods followers will do some good things and some bad things.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kom din kpe nti taɣi ninsal yɛno tariga n-kpe Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ. Bɛ ni ti yɛrigi nyin Imanuɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: This water will be like a flash flood as it passes through Judah. It will rise to Judahs throat and almost drown him. But he will spread his wings over your whole country, Immanuel.

dag: Zara daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Zara yuma ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: Sarah lived to be years old.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun daa teeg n nuu n-zaŋ n yiko din galisi pam yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la; damdimiya n tooni ka maani yi sara maligu tiri ma.
en: But you must follow the Lord , who brought you out of Egypt. He used his great power to save you. You must worship him and make sacrifices to him.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa sunsuuni, ka niŋ kɔpaɣirim niŋ di ni.
en: Then Moses put the bowl between the Meeting Tent and the altar. He put water in the bowl for washing.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa yina kuli naai, ka naazɔnim daa kpe nti nya ka dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntua maa dunoya yomi kpari, ka bɛ tɛhi ni naa maa kpɛla zɔntua maa ni du bil ni ni o ti wɔɣis omaŋa.
en: After Ehud had slipped out, the kings servants came and found that the rooms doors were locked. So they thought, He must be relieving himself in the cool chamber.

dag: M bihi, di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi n-nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Masia ni nyɛ wuntizɔra shɛm.
en: Let no one deceive you, my children! Whoever does what is right is righteous, just as Christ is righteous.

dag: O daa lan mali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu binyara zaa. Di duɣuri mini di soobuya ni di taha ni di dirijaba ni lahi din ni moori buɣim. Daanya ka o daa zaŋ mali di zaa.
en: He made all the altars equipment: the pails, the shovels, the bowls, the meat forks, and the trays. He made all its equipment out of copper.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi teeku la tula yuŋ maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim n-chɛ ka Lɛviatan suhu yiɣisir la.
en: Some magicians think they can wake Leviathan. So let them say their curses and curse the day I was born.

dag: Nyamiya, n timla n tumo ni o ti mali soli ti ma. Ka yi ni yuuni bɔri yi Duuma so maa ni ti ka o jɛmbu duu na libigi ya. Alikauli tumo ŋun nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa shiri kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I am sending my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly, the Lord you are looking for will come to his temple. Yes, the messenger you are waiting for, the one who will tell about my agreement, is really coming!.

dag: Yawɛ n-sɔŋdi ba, ka fari ba bahira; ŋuna n-fari ba ka tiligiri ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; bɛ ni zɔrina nti sɔɣir o sani zuɣu.
en: The LORD will help them and rescue them— rescue them from the wicked—and he will save them because they have taken refuge in him.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ nandan nirilim dihila Yawɛ samli, ka o ni ti yo o di zaa.
en: Giving help to the poor is like loaning money to the Lord . He will pay you back for your kindness.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali yaa daa yi ti duri taba, Yaakubu zaŋdila dari maa sɔŋ bɛ tooni kɔbɔɣili maa gbini ni bɛ be dari maa gbini duri taba.
en: Whenever the strongest of the flock mated, Jacob put the branches in front of them near the watering troughs so that they mated near the branches.

dag: Ka Naaman daa saɣi, ka chaŋ ti mim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa, ka nya alaafee zaa. Ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni m-be kaman bibil niŋgbuna la.
en: So Naaman did what the man of God said. He went down and dipped himself in the Jordan River seven times, and he became pure and clean. His skin became soft like the skin of a baby.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ sunsuuni, ka lan me binwɔɣinli zali bɛ tintariga ka di teeri ba Yawɛ yɛla.
en: At that time there will be an altar for the Lord in the middle of Egypt. At the border of Egypt there will be a monument to show honor to the Lord .

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba mini m ma ti chɛ ma bahi, amaa Yawɛ ŋun kul ni gbib ma.
en: My father and mother may abandon me, but the Lord will take care of me.

dag: N zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu mi kaman Naawuni ni zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu shɛm, dama n zaŋ ya tila Masia kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi paɣipiɛliga tiri do yino shɛm la.
en: I am jealous for you, just as God is; you are like a pure virgin whom I have promised in marriage to one man only, Christ himself.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a daa chɛ ka sagbani wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn doli shɛli polo.
en: With the tall cloud, you led them by day, and at night you used the column of fire. That is the way you lit their path and showed them where to go.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa ti yɛn chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri Baalihazɔr din mini Ifriim bi wɔɣ ni tab la, ka daa boli nabihi zaa ni bɛ kana.
en: Two years later, Absalom had some men come to Baal Hazor to cut the wool from his sheep. He invited all the kings sons to come and watch.

dag: Ŋun di nasara, n ni chɛ ka m min o laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee kaman n gba ni daa di nasara ka m mini m Ba Naawuni laɣim ʒi o nam ʒiishee shɛm la.
en: To those who win the victory I will give the right to sit beside me on my throne, just as I have been victorious and now sit by my Father on his throne.

dag: Ahaz daa nyɛla Jɛhɔada ba, ka Jɛhɔada nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba; Zimiri mi daa nyɛla Mɔza ba;.
en: Saul's other descendants were Jehoaddah, Alemeth, Azmaveth, Zimri, Moza.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ka dɔro maa niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, o zuɣu ni hal ni o naba ni, ka maligumaana maa nya li.
en: But if the disease has run its course and only the scars remain, he will say, You are clean.

dag: O bom ŋman ʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋman bih ayi na nti ti maligumaana Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni daba anii dali.
en: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Di ŋubiya biŋkpam, nahu kpam bee piɛɣu kpam bee bua kpam.
en: Tell the Israelites: You must not eat any fat from your cattle, sheep, or goats.

dag: Ka n daa zahim anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ mɛtiriki tɔn pisinaayi min anzinfa lahi kɔbiga ni salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ti ba.
en: This is what I gave them: silver - tons silver utensils - pounds gold - , pounds gold bowls - ounces fine bronze bowls, equal in value to gold bowls.

dag: M mabihi n yɛri ya mi, Ʒim ni be niŋgbun shɛl ni ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni, ka din poori mi ku tooi be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: This is what Im saying, brothers and sisters: Flesh and blood cant inherit Gods kingdom. Something that rots cant inherit something that doesnt decay.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tiŋgbani maa tariga daa nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku la. Tintariga bɔbili maa n-daa gili Juda zuliya maa niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The Mediterranean Sea was the western border. So the land of Judah was inside these four borders. The families of Judah lived in this area.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba benya kaman kuɣ nɛma la kana, ka Naawuni zaŋ ya me o jɛmbu duu ka yi leei Naawuni maligumaaniba bɛn be kasi, ka maani sara maligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni deeri Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: You yourselves are being built like living stones into a spiritual temple. You are being made into a holy priesthood to offer up spiritual sacrifices that are acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma. Bɛ daa tuui lu ka kɔŋ ŋun ni sɔŋ ba.
en: So God humbled them with hard work. They stumbled, and there was no one to help them.

dag: Naawuni, a wum n ni lo alikauli shɛŋa la, ka pun ti ma pin shɛli a ni zaŋdi tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a yuli sizuura la.
en: Because you, God, have heard my promises; youve given me the same possession as those who honor your name.

dag: Ka di wula daa teei hal ti paai teeku ni, ka di nyaɣa teei hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.

dag: Nyin Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga ŋun be Uzi ŋɔ, kul lam ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni zaŋ pipia maa ti a gba, ka a gba nyu n-kuli, ka pirig a zaɣim.
en: Rejoice and be happy, Daughter Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But this cup will pass over to you too. You will get drunk on it. You will be stripped naked.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa suhu daa yu Yisifu pam, ka Yisifu daa tumd o tuma, ka o zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ tumtumdiba zuɣulana, ka zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Potiphar was pleased with him and made him his personal servant; so he put him in charge of his house and everything he owned.

dag: Zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Giliad tiŋgbani ni Gaad niriba mini Rubin niriba ni Manaasa niriba tiŋgbana zaa n-lan zaŋ Aroa din baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la hal ti paai Giliad mini Bashan tiŋgbana.
en: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.

dag: Dabiɛm gbahi tinzunnima, ka bɛ yiri bɛ ni me birini gili bɛ tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-kani n sanna, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: They have lost all courage and from their fortresses they come trembling.

dag: Ka n wurim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa kpɛhi luɣilikam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋd o min o tɔbbihi zaa, ka ŋooi takɔbi doli ba.
en: I will scatter in every direction all the members of his court and his advisers and bodyguards, and people will search for them to kill them.

dag: O ʒi n-niŋ zuliya shɛb lala; bɛ ʒi o zaligunima. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He has not done this for other nations; they do not know his laws. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli niriba maa; ka daa laɣim Izraɛlnim kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin na nti chɛ ka bɛ zani gili suɣili maa.
en: So Moses went out and told the people what the Lord had said. He assembled seventy of the leaders and placed them around the Tent.

dag: Chɛ ka dilan maa biɛhigu ti be kaman Yawɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa ka bi zo li nambɔɣu la. Chɛ ka o kul wumdi kuhigu asiba, ka wumdi tɔbuchiriga wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha.
en: May he be like those cities that the Lord destroyed without mercy. May he hear cries of pain in the morning and the battle alarm at noon.

dag: Sool paɣ mi yuli n-daa booni Ahinɔam. O daa nyɛla Ahimaaz bipuɣiŋga. Ka o tɔbbi kpɛm mi yuli daa booni Abinɛr, o daa nyɛla Sool bapir Nɛr bia.
en: The name of Sauls wife was Ahinoam, Ahimaazs daughter. The name of his general was Abner, Ners son, Sauls uncle.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya binshɛɣukam zaa ni, dama dina n-tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: Children, it is your Christian duty to obey your parents always, for that is what pleases God.

dag: Niŋmi lala pɔi ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni neesim naanyi zibigi, ka sagbana chɛ ka saa luna.
en: Remember your Creator while you are young, before the time comes when the sun and the moon and the stars become dark to you—before problems come again and again like one storm after another.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kul shini, ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama Naa Hɛzɛkia daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.

dag: hal ka n ti paɣi ni bɛ mirisi n nyiŋgol ni ka n kpi n-gari m biɛhigu.
en: I would choose strangling and death instead of my bones.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku bia maa kpiya.
en: and said, Get up, take the child and his mother, and go back to the land of Israel, because those who tried to kill the child are dead.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa tɔɣis o bihi maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa vuui la o naba pa o bindoo zuɣu dɔni n-leei Naawuni dini pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: When Jacob had finished giving these instructions to his sons, he lay down on his bed and died.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi zaŋ viɛlim ŋɔ tatabo ti mɔri din be mɔɣu ni zuŋɔ n-kaai biɛɣu ka buɣim diri li ŋɔ, di chaŋ wula ka o ku ti yinim situra? Laabira, yi yɛda shiri pɔra!.
en: It is God who clothes the wild grass—grass that is here today and gone tomorrow, burned up in the oven. Won't he be all the more sure to clothe you? What little faith you have!.

dag: dama pako shɛb pun birigi doli Sintani.
en: Some have already turned away to follow Satan.

dag: Timiya yi banim mini yi manim jilima din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni.
en: Respect your father and your mother, so that you may live a long time in the land that I am giving you.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ku yi tibidarigibo ni, ka ʒirilan mi ni kpi.
en: No one who tells lies in court can escape punishment; he is doomed.

dag: ka di shiri niŋ pali, ka bɛ yɛli ya, Chɛliya ka ti doli wun shɛŋa ka jɛmdi li.
en: and the sign or wonder that was spoken actually occurs; if he says: Come on! We should follow other gods—ones you havent experienced—and we should worship them.

dag: Ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. Ka nir yi ni tooi gbaag omaŋ o suhuyiɣisili saha, di so ŋun ŋme n-deei tin muni.
en: It is better to be patient than to be a strong soldier. It is better to control your anger than to capture a city.

dag: Amaa faɣiri dibu zuɣu yi zaŋdi bɛn mali taali bahira, ka lee mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli.
en: who spare the guilty for bribes, and rob the innocent of their rights.

dag: Di nuzaa polo gba daa mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi la daa nyɛ daanya, amaa bin shɛŋa din daa yili daantalisi maa mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa.
en: Likewise the north side stretched one hundred fifty feet, with twenty posts, twenty copper bases, and silver hooks and bands for the posts.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim maa daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nti sɔŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-tum tuma. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo, lala ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ ba.
en: The people did everything the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites. And so the Levites were qualified to work in the Tent under Aaron and his sons.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The prophet Jeremiah delivered this message to Judahs King Zedekiah in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa m bihi, yi nyɛla Naawuni niriba ka pun nyaŋ anab ʒirinim maa, dama Shi so ŋun be yi ni maa mali yiko gari shi so ŋun be dunianim ni.
en: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.

dag: Dinzuɣu, buɣim ni diri mɔgbina mini mɔ kuma shɛm la, lala ka yi wula yɛn taai buɣim, ka pɔhim ʒe yi puma chaŋ kaman taŋkpaɣ la. Dama yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka ʒiɛm Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: So now, just as straw and dry grass shrivel and burn in the fire, your roots will rot and your blossoms will dry up and blow away, because you have rejected what the Lord Almighty, Israel's holy God, has taught us.

dag: dama n sani, m bia ŋɔ daa kpimi ka lan neei na, o daa bɔrigimi ka n lan nya o yaha. Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai diɛma diɛmbu ni suhupiɛlli.
en: For this son of mine was dead, but now he is alive; he was lost, but now he has been found. And so the feasting began.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali firilatamdigu. O daa zaŋla matarika n-kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili. Ka di mini di pipihi ni di bintira kɔtomsi la ni di tipuma kɔtomsi la zaa daa nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: He made the lampstand of pure gold. He made its base and its shaft of hammered gold; its decorative flowers, including buds and petals, formed one piece with it.

dag: Dinzuɣu, m bia, wummi n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ, yiɣisim zo n-kuli n tizɔdoo Leeban sani Haran.
en: So now, my son, listen to me: Get up and escape to my brother Laban in Haran.

dag: Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Juda Naa Ahaz bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam.
en: Hezekiah son of Ahaz became king of Judah in the third year of Hoshea's rule in Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti dolila yɛlimaŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: This is how we will know that we belong to the truth and reassure our hearts in Gods presence.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Aduna min o bidibisi tarili bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba zali ni bɛ leei man Yawɛ maligumaaniba la, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ba.
en: who have been ordained as priests to serve me.

dag: Kamiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kuɣ nɛɔŋ shɛli ninsalinim ni zaɣisi ka lih o ka o ka buchi, amaa ka Naawuni ŋun piig o ka lih o ka o mali buchi la sanna.
en: The Lord Jesus is the living stone. The people of the world decided that they did not want this stone. But he is the one God chose as one of great value. So come to him.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Yawɛ kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la m-mali sara.
en: Aaron shall sacrifice the goat chosen by lot for the Lord and offer it as a sin offering.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kumdi olivi tihi puri ni, dama n ni ka yi sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People will be crying in the vineyards, because I will pass through and punish you. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sipirɛs dari pili pie tab tabili duu maa puuni dukpini, ka dooi salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali abie tihi mini zoligɔnim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: He paneled the walls of the main room with pine, covered them with fine gold, and decorated them with palm trees and chains.

dag: Yɛhudianim n-daa gbaai do so n ni tahi a sanna ŋɔ n-yɛn ku o, ka n daa wum ni o nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka daa zaŋ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti fa o bahi.
en: Some Jews had taken this man and planned to kill him. But I learned that he is a Roman citizen, so I went with my soldiers and saved him.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ: kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim ni tammɛriba, ka da dari mini kuɣ bɔɣa din yɛn zaŋ mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: the carpenters, the builders, and the masons. It should be used to pay for lumber and quarried stone to repair the temple.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni boli shɛb Izraɛlnima, ka yi yi Juda zuliya ni na la, wummiya! Yawɛ yuli ka yi mali pɔri pɔri, ka yɛri ni yi jɛmdila Izraɛl Naawuni, amaa ka lee bi jɛmd o ni yɛlimaŋli ni wuntia.
en: Listen to this, people of Israel, you that are descended from Judah: You swear by the name of the Lord and claim to worship the God of Israel— but you don't mean a word you say.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, pa Yawɛ milinsi ni ka n kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbani ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma, Cham ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa. .
en: Do you think I have attacked your country and destroyed it without the Lord 's help? The Lord himself told me to attack it and destroy it.

dag: Ka Mariama paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dali daa ti paai kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm. Ka bɛ zaŋ bia maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ o ti ti Duuma.
en: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa naan ku lan tooi zani Musa tooni yaha bintɔra maa zuɣu, dama bintɔra maa daa tola timanim maa mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: The religious experts couldnt stand up to Moses because of the skin sores, because there were skin sores on the religious experts as well as on all the Egyptians.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa deei tiŋgbana taribu maa bupia m-pahi Giliad mini Bashan din daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din la polo la zuɣu;.
en: This is why Manasseh received ten shares in addition to Gilead and Bashan on the east side of the Jordan.

dag: O yi vuhi, buɣim taarila sala, ka buɣim zibizibi yir o noli ni na.
en: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.

dag: Di ni ti ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee yina; ŋun yɛn ku zuliya pam yi palo. O yi o biɛhigu shee na ni o bahi yi tiŋgbani yoli. Yi fɔntinsi ni wurim, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: A lion bursts out of the thicket; a destroyer of nations advances. Hes gone forth from his place to ravage your land, to wipe out your towns, until no one is left.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim suhuri daa yiɣisi ka bɛ ŋmɛr o ni yɛli shɛm maa naŋgbankpeeni ka bɔhiri taba, Wula ka doo ŋɔ ni tooi zaŋ o niŋgbuŋ ti ti ka ti ŋubi.
en: Then the Jews debated among themselves, asking, How can this man give us his flesh to eat.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na nti zali pal shɛli din labiri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: He assembled a group of priests and Levites in the east courtyard of the Temple.

dag: Maligumaana maa ni zaŋ ʒim maa shɛli n-ʒe ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu zuɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu zuɣu.
en: The priest will take some of the blood from the compensation offering and will put it on the right earlobe, the right thumb, and the right big toe of the person needing purification.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi nyala daŋa, dindina yin doliya zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: But if she is seriously injured, the payment will be life for life.

dag: Birapu tibu ŋmanila tim bɛn tiri li sani, bɛ yi kul chaŋ luɣilikam bɛ dirila nasara.
en: A bribe seems magical in the eyes of those who give it, granting success to all who use it.

dag: Bɛ wuhibu ŋmanila yumaha din diri ninsal niŋgbuŋ la. Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Filɛtus.
en: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way.

dag: Ninsal ni tumdi tuma ka niŋdi wahala dunia ŋɔ ni m-bɔri ni o nya shɛli maa buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: I mean, What do people get for all their hard work and struggles under the sun?.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala, kola maa ni chɛhichɛhi, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli n-lɛrila kol pala ni, ka di bina ayi maa zaa shɛli ku saɣim.
en: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. If they did, the wineskins would burst, the wine would spill, and the wineskins would be ruined. Instead, people pour new wine into new wineskins so that both are kept safe.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: The apostles Jesus had sent out came back to him. They gathered around him and told him about all they had done and taught.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn be tinsi maa ni ka su li, ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee la nyɛ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa dini.
en: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ kul be n sani sahakam, dama o kul bela n nudirigu polo, ka shɛli ku tooi dam ma.
en: I always put the LORD in front of me; I will not stumble because he is on my right side.

dag: Ka o daa va bɛ nɛma zaa, ka zaŋ o dɔɣim Lɔt min o nɛma gba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni paɣiba m-pahi labina.
en: He brought back all of the looted property, together with his relative Lot and Lots property, wives, and people.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka Babilɔn naa bɔɣiri niŋ kpiɔŋ, ka n zaŋ n takɔbi niŋ o nuu ni. Amaa n ni kabisi Firawuna bɔɣiri, ka o ti be o tooni ŋuhira kaman ŋun nya daŋa din yɛn ku o la.
en: Then I will make the arms of the king of Babylonia strong and put my sword in his hands. But I will break the arms of the king of Egypt, and he will groan and die in front of his enemy.

dag: ka n chɛ ka bɛ niŋ bindirigu tin ya na, yi ni ka mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani ŋɔ na zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi gari. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I will also bring a bit of food; it will give you strength to continue your journey. You have honored me by coming to my home, so let me serve you. They replied, Thank you; we accept.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ yinim Zɛruya bihi bɛn be kaman yi leela n dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Di simdi ni ti ku nira Izraɛl tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Pa mani n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: David said, Abishai, what will I ever do with you and your brother Joab? Is it your job to tell me who has done wrong? I've been made king of all Israel today, and no one will be put to death.

dag: Yi kul ni kpalim bela Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol maa ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ tumdi Yawɛ ni zali ya shɛm hal ni daba ayopɔin, di yi pa lala yi ni kpi, dama Yawɛ n-zali ma lala.
en: You must stay at the entrance of the Meeting Tent day and night for seven days. If you dont obey the Lord s commands, you will die! The Lord gave me these commands.

dag: Bɛ gbila bɔɣili kpe tiŋgban ni katiŋa, ka di mini ninsalinim ni be shɛli waɣa, ka sochandiba bi mi bɛ yɛla. Bɛ yilila mihi zuɣu m-be katiŋa laana.
en: Far from where people live, they dig deep into the ground, down where no one else has been before. There they work all alone, hanging from ropes.

dag: O daa mali di gbaya maa ka di ŋmanila chɛchɛbuŋ gbaya. Di spindilinim mini di fiilinim ni di sipuɣisinim ni di duɣuri zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: The wheels were like the wheels on a chariot. Everything on the wheels—the axles, the rims, the spokes, and the hubs were made from bronze.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya bee bɔ n-leei niŋ ka yi biɛhindi yi suhuri ni?.
en: But he said to them, Why are you alarmed? Why are these doubts coming up in your minds?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka teeku kɔgbana puɣiri luri yɔri vuri. N yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: I am the Lord your God; I stir up the sea and make its waves roar. My name is the Lord Almighty!.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti bɛn suhir o o Shia Kasi maa.
en: Even you who are bad know how to give good things to your children. So surely your heavenly Father knows how to give the Holy Spirit to the people who ask him.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o kpambaliba zaŋ ŋarima mini tumtumdiba bɛn mili teeku nti ti o, ka bɛ mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanu na ti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: Huram had his servants bring ships to Solomon, along with crews of expert sailors. They went with Solomons servants to Ophir and imported four hundred fifty kikkars of gold, which they brought back to King Solomon.

dag: A mi ni a nyɛla zoomba sowuhira mini bɛn be zibisim ni firila.
en: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti wum ni be gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus heard that John was put in prison, so he went back to Galilee.

dag: Naawuni, m paɣir a. Di shini ma!.
en: God of my praise, dont keep quiet.

dag: ni Ɛgilɔn naa ni Gɛza naa.
en: the king of Eglon, the king of Gezer.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim yi be yi ni galisi pam, di ni chɛ ka yi nyɛla bɛn tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ bɛn mali buchi baŋbu shɛli din yiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni na la puuni.
en: These are the qualities you need, and if you have them in abundance, they will make you active and effective in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Hal bɛ bihi na teeri bɛ maligu bimbina mini Ashɛra binwɔɣila shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi ti mahili kam mini daboli kam zuɣu.
en: Their children remember the altars that were dedicated to false gods. They remember the wooden poles that were dedicated to Asherah. They remember those things under the green trees and on the hills.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ni tim so na.
en: Jesus then asked, But who do you say I am? Peter answered, You are the Messiah sent from God.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-su yurilim maŋli. Dama nyini n-tiri sokam zaa o tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: and that his love is constant. You yourself, O Lord, reward everyone according to their deeds.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛli shɛm maa tiɣi Izraɛlnim maa nini, ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni, ka bi lan yɛli tɔbu lo n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba, ka saɣim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni daa ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa yɛla.
en: The Israelites were happy and praised God. There was no more talk about going to war and wiping out the tribes of Reuben and Gad.

dag: O ŋmɛri bɔbili din nyaɣisira pari kom zuɣu o nyaaŋa. So ni tɛhi ni kɔbulli maa ni nyɛla zabipiɛla.
en: leaves a bright wake behind him; the frothy deep seems white-haired.

dag: Yi daa lo ma la zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li leei zaɣ suŋ ni di chɛ ka niriba pam ti tiligi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You tried to harm me, but God made it turn out for the best, so that he could save all these people, as he is now doing.

dag: Ka o mini Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni, ka bɛ to jina m-bɔri soli ni bɛ ku o.
en: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti maa hal ka o mini ti yaannim maa zaa daa ti kpi nimaani.
en: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.

dag: Di ni lan tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn soya golim ka bɛ biɛhigu bi tuhi nuu ni.
en: unreliable people who cannot be trusted.

dag: N ni darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna, ka wuna maa nyɛ din galisi gari wuna din be Jɛrusalɛm mini Samaria la tibili.
en: Just as I took control of idolatrous kingdoms with more images than Jerusalem and Samaria.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi ti kpe fɔŋ maa ni n-chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o ti kpe o ni kuni yil shɛli.
en: When you go into the city, you will see a man carrying a jar of water. Follow him. He will go into a house.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshɛzabɛl yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Baana bia Zadok daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Meremoth, the son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built the next section. Meshullam, the son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, built the next section. Zadok son of Baana built the next section.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋ, ka bɛ nina ku nya shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri mi ku baŋ shɛli, ka bɛ labi n sanna, ka n tib ba.
en: The Lord has blinded the eyes of the people, and he has made the people stubborn. He did this so that they could not see or understand, and so that they would not turn to the Lord and be healed.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la polo, m bɔri ni yi gba niŋ li kaman n ni daa wuhi cheechinim din be Galɛshia tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm la.
en: Now, concerning what you wrote about the money to be raised to help God's people in Judea. You must do what I told the churches in Galatia to do.

dag: Yiɣisima, kuhimi pampam zaawuni, tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛl la. Chɛ ka a suhu saɣim pam ti Duuma tooni. Suhim o a bihi nyɛviya zuɣu; kum ni tarigi bi shɛb sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing.

dag: Zuɣusaa wuhir o wuntitali; ka zuliya kam zaa nyar o jilima.
en: The skies tell about his goodness, and the nations see his glory.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka man Pool nyɛ Yisa Masia dansarika yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zuɣu.
en: This is why I, Paul, am a prisoner of Christ for you Gentiles.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila, dama n kanimina ni n ti be yi sani.
en: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.

dag: A nini pɔbbu biɛla, gom gbihibu biɛla, zali nuhi ʒia vuhi biɛla.
en: You say, I need a rest. I think Ill take a short nap.

dag: Atarɔt mini Dibɔn ni Jaza ni Nimira ni Hɛshibɔn ni Ɛliale ni Siibam ni Nɛbo ni Bɛɔn.
en: This region which the Lord has helped the Israelites occupy—the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sibmah, Nebo, and Beon—is good land for livestock, and we have so much livestock.

dag: N ni yuri so yi tum ma tuumbiɛɣu, o mali soli ni o lan be n yiŋa? Pɔri pɔbu bee biŋkɔbiri sara maligu ni tooi vuui mbusim maa? O ni tooi mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: The Lord says, The people I love are doing evil things. What right do they have to be in my Temple? Do they think they can prevent disaster by making promises and by offering animal sacrifices? Will they then rejoice?.

dag: Ka o yaa daa kul pahiri biɛɣukam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛl ti di yɛla piligu ni ha ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ li, ka ŋuni n-daŋ yɛli di yɛla, ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni o mali yɛlimaŋli? So daa pun bi yɛli di yɛla, ka so bi zaŋ li moli; so mi pun bi wum yi yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.

dag: Gbuɣima ti ku be nimaani, biŋkɔb biɛɣu mi ti ku doli soli maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi kɔŋko nti yɛn dol li.
en: no lion will be there, and no predator will go up on it. None of these will be there; only the redeemed will walk on it.

dag: Lɛvinim ni gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-zani gili naa, ka ŋunkam kpe nayili maa na, bɛn kum o. Kul benya naa sani, o yi ti yɛn yina, yin benya o sani, ka o yi ti labiri kpɛra yin benya o sani.
en: The Levites must surround the king, each with his weapons drawn. Whoever comes near your ranks must be killed; stay near the king wherever he goes.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: And Micaiah concluded: This is what has happened. The Lord has made these prophets of yours lie to you. But he himself has decreed that you will meet with disaster.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa daa dam, ka niriba zo n-laɣimna nti gbaai Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-dar o yi, ka dii yo di dunoya.
en: An angry reaction spread throughout the city, and everyone came running to the Temple. They grabbed Paul and dragged him out of the holy area, and the gates were closed immediately.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ san la nya taali chɛ m-paŋ, niriba maa zaa nuu ni be chirimbu maa ni la zuɣu.
en: the sin of everyone—both Israelites and foreigners among you—will be forgiven.

dag: Shɛla ni daa dɔɣi Ɛba maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Eber was born, Shelah lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Di wumya bɛ yɛtɔɣa. Jɛmmiya Babilɔn Naa ka be. Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ zani dabari?.
en: Dont listen to those prophets. Serve the king of Babylon. Accept your punishment, and you will live. There is no reason for you to cause this city of Jerusalem to be destroyed.

dag: Bina anahi m-be dunia ni ka nyɛ bɛn pɔra, amaa ka lee mali yɛm pam.
en: Four things are among the smallest on earth, but they are extremely wise.

dag: Zaŋmiya di zaɣ kuŋ tam sala buɣim zuɣu ka di bii, ka di tahiʒiɛɣu mooi, ka di daɣiri zaa nyɛligi niŋ di puuni, ka din zahimzahim la zaa di buɣim.
en: Then set the empty pot over the hot coals until it is red-hot. That will clean the pot and burn off the rust.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim Farisiinim mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaanib shɛb Yisa sani ni bɛ ti puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: They sent some of the Pharisees and supporters of Herod to trap him in his words.

dag: Been shɛli daa be Jɛrusalɛm n-do m-miri duno shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Piɛri Dunol la. Hiburuli ni bɛ booni biaŋ maa la Bɛtizata, ka lunfanima anu daa be nimaani.
en: Near the Sheep Gate in Jerusalem there is a pool with five porches; in Hebrew it is called Bethzatha.

dag: Ka a ni wuhi Izraɛlnim zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ka o mi zaŋ ti ba la.
en: And you must teach the people about all the laws that the Lord gave them through Moses.

dag: Amaa ka a mi daa pun yɛli ma, N ni niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli, ka chɛ ka a zuliya ti be kaman mɔɣ bihigu la, ka so ku tooi kali ba. .
en: Remember that you promised to make everything go well for me and to give me more descendants than anyone could count, as many as the grains of sand along the seashore.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Haga daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua. Haga ni daa nya ka o mali puu maa, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Zarai ŋun daa su o maa.
en: He slept with Hagar, and she became pregnant. But when she realized that she was pregnant, she no longer respected her mistress.

dag: Ka ŋun paya la gba daa niŋ lala nya nyɔri ka di min o gba laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: The servant who had , coins did the same with his money and earned , more.

dag: Rɛzɔn daa nyɛla Izraɛlnim dima Naa Sulemaana ʒiɛman ni, ka daa tumdi ba din bie kaman Hadad ni daa niŋdi ba shɛm la; ka daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnima, ka di nam su Sirianima.
en: He was an enemy of Israel during the lifetime of Solomon.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma.
en: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For years you have gone without eating during the fifth and seventh months of the year. But did you really do it for me?.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Yisahaku, Yiɣisim ti sani, dama a mali kpiɔŋ gari ti.
en: Finally, Abimelech said, Isaac, I want you to leave our country. You have become too powerful to stay here.

dag: A dim yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla, nyin di niŋ li yɛda, dama din chihira ayopɔin sɔɣi be di ni.
en: What they say sounds good, but dont trust them. They are full of evil ideas.

dag: Ka naa maa ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu n-saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni bɛn ni ti zani dɛde, ka chɛ ka bɛ min o tuhi.
en: By deceit the king will win the support of those who have already abandoned their religion, but those who follow God will fight back.

dag: bɛ daa malila pin shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ti Yisifu la zali gu o kundina saha wuntaŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa wumya ni bɛ min o n-yɛn laɣim di.
en: The brothers got their gifts ready to give to Joseph at noon, since they had heard they were going to eat there.

dag: Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya. Timiya ba bɛ tarili bɛ ba mabihi maa sani, ka bɛ ba tarili leei bɛ dini.
en: Zelophehad's daughters are right. They should each be given part of the land their father would have received.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yɛri din viɛli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la m-mali binnana din chihira ka nyɛ n ni je binshɛŋa la. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka di leei binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul laɣi zuliya shɛba zɔri maa zaa yoli, n ni laɣim bɛ zaa luɣ yini, ka di ku yuui ka bɛ piligi diri wahala bɛ nanim mini bɛ kpambaliba nuu ni.
en: Yes, Israel was taken to the nations, but I will bring them back. But first, they must suffer a little by carrying the burden of that mighty king.

dag: bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni ka lan mali suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu ni la nuu ni.
en: They enjoy doing evil and are happy with the confusion it brings.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa lan bɔhi Balaam, Pa a bun so a ni bari sahakam zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-nyɛ ma? Ka n na mi n-niŋ a lala? Ka o garigi yɛli, Aai.
en: But you're my owner, answered the donkey, and you've ridden me many times. Have I ever done anything like this before? No, Balaam admitted.

dag: amaa lee niŋmiya lala la biɛribaalimtali mini sizuura lubu puuni. Kul chɛliya ka yi suhuri ni tɛha ku mali galimi, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi ya ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri yi biɛrisuntali yi ni doli Masia la zuɣu di vi.
en: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ bi wuhiri ni n zaani ya la zaligu, amaa n zaŋdila shɛb nini ni mooi bɛ tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla n-wuhiri ya ni n nya ni yi gba yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli.
en: I am not laying down any rules. But by showing how eager others are to help, I am trying to find out how real your own love is.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa diɛhi duɣubihi mini kikahi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn kpalim la sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa lab kuli ka chɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa. Ka Midiannim daa zaŋ bɛ tantinim kpa n-do bɛ ni daa be zo shɛli zuɣu maa vinvamli ni.
en: So Gideon sent the other men of Israel home. He kept the men with him. Those men kept the supplies and the trumpets of the other men who went home. The Midianites were camped in the valley below Gideons camp.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ piim tinsi bɛ ni deei tiŋgban shɛŋa la ni n-ti Lɛvinim ka bɛ be di ni, ka ti ba biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee tiŋgbana ka di do n-gili tinsi maa.
en: Tell the Israelites that from the property they receive they must give the Levites some cities to live in and pasture land around the cities.

dag: A ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be a biɛhigu shee mal alibarika! Ti nini ni tiɣi a jɛmbu du kasi maa puuni bin suma.
en: How happy is the one you choose to bring close, the one who lives in your courtyards! We are filled full by the goodness of your house, by the holiness of your temple.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni nti kuhi yɛli ba ni man Naawuni nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma la.
en: Get up and go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry out against it, for their evil has come to my attention.

dag: Bɛ yi ti naai bɛ shɛhira tuma maa, biŋkɔb so ŋun yi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni na ni ti tuhi ba tɔbu n-nyaŋ ba ku ba.
en: When the two witnesses have finished telling their message, the beast will fight against them. This is the beast that comes up from the bottomless pit. It will defeat and kill them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha.
en: Now tell them that I am the Lord God, and as surely as I live, that saying will no longer be used in Israel.

dag: Naawuni, a wuntitali zaŋmi hal ti paai sagbana ni. Nyini n-tum tuun kara ŋɔ. Ŋuni n-lee be kaman nyini?.
en: and about your ultimate righteousness, God, because youve done awesome things! Who can compare to you, God?.

dag: amaa jɛmmiyala man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka n yihi ya yi dimnim zaa nuu ni.
en: Instead, worship only the LORD your God. He will rescue you from your enemies power.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni ŋun pahi, ka man filim.
en: He must become more and more important, and I must become less important.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ piɛguliba ŋɔ, kummiya, kummiya pampam, ka lunya bilim tampiligim ni, dama yi kubu biɛɣu neeya, ka yi wurim kpe yɔɣu biɛɣu neei, ka yi ni ti lu kaman duɣu viɛlli la.
en: The Lord 's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni kari zuliya shɛb zaa bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ bahi, ka yi ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya tinsi su.
en: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.

dag: Ka buɣim daa taai bɛ salo maa sunsuuni n-di ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Then a fire burned that mob of people. It burned those wicked people.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa nti ti Izraɛl naa. O ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yi paag a, nyin baŋmi ni mani n-chɛ ka Naaman ŋun nyɛ n tumtumda ŋɔ ka a sanna ni a ti tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: The letter that he took read: This letter will introduce my officer Naaman. I want you to cure him of his disease.

dag: Ka so yi wum n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ku kar o saria, dama m bi kamina ni n ti kari dunianim saria, amaa n kamina ni n ti tiligi dunianima.
en: I did not come into the world to judge people. I came to save the people in the world. So I am not the one who judges those who hear my teaching and do not obey.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kpahi Jɛrimia ŋun nyɛ Anatɔt nira, ka zaŋ omaŋ leeg anabi yi sani la zuɣu ni?.
en: So why havent you threatened Jeremiah of Anathoth, who pretends to be a prophet among you?.

dag: Ka Keenannim Naa Arad ŋun daa be Nɛgɛb din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa wum Izraɛlnim kandina damli.
en: The king of Arad in southern Canaan heard that the Israelites were coming.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ nandaamba alaka ka bɛ baɣa ka bɛ ni, bɛ fa yili shɛli din pa bɛ ni me shɛl la.
en: because he hurt the poor and left them with nothing. He took houses he did not build.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali luɣ shɛli yi sansani maa kpaŋa n-chani nimaani ti damdiri yɔɣuni.
en: You also must have a place outside the camp where people can go to relieve themselves.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni fɔŋ kara n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Shiiba ni Molada.
en: It included Beersheba, Sheba, Moladah.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so yi be Masia ni, o biɛhigu leela biɛr palli; nyama, ka o biɛr kurili la din gari; ka biɛr palli maa deei di zaani zani.
en: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.

dag: Kaman sala buɣim ni tahiri biisim na, ka dari chɛ ka buɣim diri shɛm, lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili chɛ ka zabili neera.
en: Like adding charcoal to embers or wood to fire, quarrelsome people kindle strife.

dag: Di saha maa ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nira ka ʒe Sool sapashin kpamba maa san la daa garigi yɛli Sool, N daa nya Jɛsi bia maa ka o ka Nɔb na nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Ahitub bia la sani.
en: Doeg the Edomite was standing there with Sauls officers. Doeg said, I saw Jesses son at Nob. David came to see Ahimelech son of Ahitub.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn lo ni bɛ kuli Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani maa, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ku ba, ka bɛ so ti ku kpalim bee n-tiligi alɔbo shɛli n ni yɛn chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu maa ni.
en: Every one of you who is determined to go and live in Egypt will die by the sword, famine, and disease. No one will escape the disaster that I will bring upon them there.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti jɛmdi wuna din nyɛ kuɣa mini dari, ka nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa, ka di ku tooi nya bee n-wum bee n-di bee n-wum nyom ŋɔ.
en: There you will serve gods made by men—things made of wood and stone that cannot see or hear or eat or smell!.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ka guhira, ka suhimiya Naawuni, dama yi bi mi di saha.
en: Be careful! Always be ready. You dont know when that time will be.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka niriba ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ ma ʒiɛmbu? Hal n ni wuhi ba shihira shɛŋa la zaa yoli, bɛ kul zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ ma yɛda.
en: The Lord said to Moses, How much longer will these people reject me? How much longer will they refuse to trust in me, even though I have performed so many miracles among them?.

dag: Di saha ka Zarai daa yɛli Ibram, N ʒiɛmbu ŋɔ taali ʒi a zuɣu. Mani n-zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti a, ka o ti nya ka o mali pua, ka lihi ʒiɛm ma. Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a.
en: Then Sarai said to Abram, It's your fault that Hagar despises me. I myself gave her to you, and ever since she found out that she was pregnant, she has despised me. May the Lord judge which of us is right, you or me.

dag: dama yuri maa yiko daa bela bɛ noya ni mini bɛ zuya ni. Ka bɛ zuya ŋmani tinvura ka mali zuɣuri; dina ka bɛ daa mali dimdi niriba.
en: The horses power is in their mouths and their tails, for their tails are like snakes with heads that inflict injuries.

dag: Jona ni daa be ziŋ karili maa puuni saha shɛli maa, ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli.
en: While Jonah was in the stomach of the fish, he prayed to the Lord his God. He said.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti nya Naawuni.
en: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa lan yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl sapashin kpamba ka n ta daɣiri ŋɔ. Bomiya do so na ka m min o ti tuhi.
en: The Philistine also said, Today I stand and make fun of the army of Israel. I dare you to send me one of your men and let us fight.

dag: Ti yi zaŋ Naawuni Shia yɛla biri yi suhuri ni, dindina di zooya ni ti deei dunia ŋɔ ni binyara yi sani?.
en: We planted spiritual seed among you, so we should be able to harvest from you some things for this life. Surely that is not asking too much.

dag: Pirigili din daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili maa piɛri mini buhi kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita ni tuhi pihitanaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: the communitys half-share was , sheep.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, O yi nyɛ alahichilana bee o pa alahichilana n ku tooi baŋ. Bin yini kɔŋko ka n naɣ mi: N daa nyɛla zoma, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n neeya.
en: The man replied, I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see.

dag: Zom ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka tummila din viɛla; bom suhudoo n-gbibi li.
en: Turn away from evil! Do good! Seek peace and go after it!.

dag: A zaligu maa yi di pala n suhu ni yu shɛli, n naan bahi yoli n nandahima ŋɔ ni.
en: If your Instruction hadnt been my delight, I would have died because of my suffering.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam n-yɛra, Zomiya Naawuni ka timiy o jilima, dama o ni yɛn kari saria saha shɛli paaya! Jɛmmiya ŋuna ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni teeku mini kɔbil nina la.
en: He said in a loud voice, Fear God and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship the one who made heaven and earth, the sea and springs of water.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: The Lord again said to Moses in the desert of Sinai.

dag: maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ bo noombihi nɛma ayi bɛn ka daɣiri mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro na.
en: the priest will order that two birds—wild and clean—and cedarwood, crimson yarn, and hyssop be brought for the person who needs purification.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla yi bibihi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni ŋme ŋ-gbahi ba la, yi bi shɛb bɛn bi mi din viɛla ni din bie zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-ni ti kpe di ni, bɛna ka n ni ti zaŋ li ti ka bɛ deei li su.
en: Then the Lord said to all of us, Your children, who are still too young to know right from wrong, will enter the land—the children you said would be seized by your enemies. I will give the land to them, and they will occupy it.

dag: Ka o daa yooi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga maa, ka nyɔhi yi di ni na kaman buɣim daaŋkpa tital ni buɣim nyɔhi la, ka di nyɔhi maa daa sabigi wuntaŋ mini zuɣusaa zaa.
en: The star opened the abyss, and smoke poured out of it, like the smoke from a large furnace; the sunlight and the air were darkened by the smoke from the abyss.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi n-gbaai bɛ naba biɛhibu hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni dol duri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili. Bɛn daa biɛhiri bɛ naba maa ni daa kul yi n-naai, ka bɛ lan yo dunoli maa yaha.
en: The king's men left the city, and then the gate was shut. They went looking for the Israelite spies as far as the place where the road crosses the Jordan.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: Today I am giving you a choice. You may choose the blessing or the curse.

dag: kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa sab bɛ yuya maa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: Moses enlisted them in the Sinai desert just as the LORD commanded him.

dag: N suhu ni daa miligi ka biɛrim lan mali ma n suhu ni la.
en: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.

dag: Ka n nya malaika ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka o kuhiri pampam bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee simdi ni o tabigi bintabinda ŋɔ ka bɔɣi litaafi ŋɔ n-lihi di puuni.
en: I saw a powerful angel, who proclaimed in a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N ni be ŋɔ zuɣu, sokam ni ti gbani n tooni, ka sokam ti yaag o noli m-paɣi man Naawuni.
en: Because it is written, As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to me, and every tongue will give praise to God. .

dag: ka nyo bɛ buɣa buɣim; dama buɣa maa pala Naawuni; amaa di nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛli, ka di nyɛ dari mini kuɣa, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa saɣim li maa.
en: They did throw the gods of those nations into the fire. But they were not real gods. They were only wood and stone—statues that people made. That is why the kings of Assyria could destroy them.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya ti Duuma zuɣu, dama dina n-tuhi.
en: Children, obey your parents the way the Lord wants, because this is the right thing to do.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣim yuma ayopɔin maa bindira zaa din daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-sɔŋ fɔntinsi ni, ka laɣim fɔntiŋ kam ni puri ni bindira n-sɔŋ lala tinsi maa ni.
en: Joseph collected and stored up the extra grain in the cities of Egypt near the fields where it was harvested.

dag: O ku yihi tahima bee n-gbarigi, hal ka o ti wuhi zaligu soli ni nyɛ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tin shɛŋa din be katinsi nim ti ʒiya guhir o wuhibu.
en: He wont be extinguished or broken until he has established justice in the land. The coastlands await his teaching.

dag: Ka n daa kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli din yuli booni Anfaani la ni n lɔrigi Yawɛ ni daa lo zuliya kam alikauli shɛl la.
en: On that same day, I broke the stick named Mercy to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.

dag: ni Gɛdɛrɔt ni Bɛtidagɔn ni Naama ni Makɛda: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Gederoth, Beth-dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah. In total: sixteen cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti laɣim o tɔbbihi m-pahi nanim pihitanaayi bɛn ʒe o nyaaŋa ni bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi n-kana ti liri Samarianima n-teei gili ba ni bɛ tuhi ba.
en: King Benhadad of Syria gathered all his troops, and supported by thirty-two other rulers with their horses and chariots, he marched up, laid siege to Samaria, and launched attacks against it.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labiri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, saha shɛli a yi ti niŋ a niriba nirilim, nyin teemi n yɛla; saha shɛli a yi ti tiligi ba, nyin sɔŋm ma.
en: Lord , remember me when you show kindness to your people. Remember to save me too!.

dag: N yi yɛli, N garo ni maai n suhu, n garibil ni chɛ ka n fabila naai;.
en: I lie down and try to rest; I look for relief from my pain.

dag: Dama ti mi ŋun yɛli, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi la. O lan yɛli, Yi Duuma ni kar o niriba saria.
en: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.

dag: Ka yi ti di bindir kura hal ni saha shɛli, ka yi ni ti kɔrigila bindir kura ka su zaɣ pala.
en: Your harvests will be so plentiful that they will last for a year, and even then you will have to throw away what is left of the old harvest to make room for the new.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n ka kpe ŋɔ na ni n ti tumla a yubu kaman di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm nyin Naawuni Kundi ni la. .
en: Then I said, Here I am, God. It is written about me in the book of the law. I have come to do what you want. Psalm :-.

dag: Ka Yawɛ zaka piɛri mini buhi kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: They gave sheep to the Lord .

dag: Ibram mini Lɔt ni daa woligi maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo.
en: After Lot separated from him, the LORD said to Abram, From the place where you are standing, look up and gaze to the north, south, east, and west.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti ŋme n-chib o zuɣu ka dih o vi.
en: Again the landowner sent another servant to them, but they struck him on the head and treated him disgracefully.

dag: Dama n yi lan labi m-me n ni daa pun wurim shɛl la, dindina n leela ŋun tum din chihi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: If I start to rebuild the system of Law that I tore down, then I show myself to be someone who breaks the Law.

dag: Daba anii dali bɛ ni guni bia maa.
en: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa tumdila din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din viɛla, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But they have all gone wrong; they are all equally bad. Not one of them does what is right, not a single one.

dag: N ni guli n tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka ku chɛ ka tɔbbihi kpe di ni gari. M mi ku saɣi ka kpeengarigunim lan nahim n niriba yaha, dama mmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ ni di wahala shɛm.
en: I will encamp before my house as a guard against anyone departing or returning. A slave driver will no longer pass through against them, for I have seen you with my eyes.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣili paɣ maa lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: Jesus knew what they were saying, and so he said to them, Why are you bothering this woman? It is a fine and beautiful thing that she has done for me.

dag: Ŋun saɣindi maa ni ti liri tiŋ kam, ka tin shɛli ti ku yi. O ni ti wurim vinvamli ni tinsi, ka saɣim bɔpiɛligu ni tinsi, kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Not one of your towns will escape destruction. I have told your enemies, Wipe out the valley and the flatlands of Moab.

dag: O nam dibu yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pia dali, ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima. Bɛ daa teemi gil li, ka me bindura gil li ti tuui.
en: In the ninth year, the tenth month, and the tenth day of the month, Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar attacked Jerusalem with all of his army. He camped beside the city and built a siege wall around it.

dag: Musa daa sabi bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini yuya sɔŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Bɛ ni daa piligiri chandi luɣ shɛŋa maa yiniyini ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Following the Lord s command, Moses kept a record of each place they stayed before moving on to the next place. These are all the places they went:.

dag: Dinzuɣu n wum Izraɛlnim maa fabila zaŋ chaŋ Ijiptinim ni zaŋ ba leei daba maa polo, ka teei n ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Now I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians have enslaved, and I have remembered my covenant.

dag: Ka takɔr kɔrikɔɣa mini abie tihi daa be zɔntua maa luɣa zuɣu dukpina zuɣu.
en: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bi ʒe na so nyaaŋa ka chɛ so, bee n-lihi nya bundaamba ka chɛ nandaamba, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla o nuhi tuma.
en: He does not take the side of rulers nor favor the rich over the poor, for he created everyone.

dag: N ni niŋ jila niŋ ya, ka niŋ niŋgbuna niŋ ya, ka zaŋ gbaŋ pɔbi ya, ka niŋ vuhim niŋ ya ka yi niŋ nyɛvili; ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will put sinew and muscles on you, and I will cover you with skin. Then I will put breath in you, and you will come back to life! Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Iso bɔh o ba, M ba, ka daɣila alibarika zaɣ yini kɔŋko ka a kul mali? M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni. Ka Iso daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: Esau continued to plead with his father: Do you have only one blessing, father? Bless me too, father! He began to cry.

dag: Bɛ ni wuh a, ka yɛl a bɛ ni mi shɛlikam zaa.
en: But they will instruct you with great understanding.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi kpe ŋɔ mini ninsalinim ni biŋkɔbiri ni puri ni tihi ni tiŋgbani atam zuɣu. N suhuyiɣisili maa ni bemi kaman buɣim la, ka so ku tooi kpihi li.
en: And so I, the Sovereign Lord , will pour out my fierce anger on this Temple. I will pour it out on people and animals alike, and even on the trees and the crops. My anger will be like a fire that no one can put out.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la daa yi Bahurim kana yomyom ti pahi Judanim maa zuɣu ni bɛ tuhi Naa Dauda soli.
en: Shimei son of Gera, from the tribe of Benjamin, lived in Bahurim. Shimei rushed down to meet King David, with the rest of the people of Judah.

dag: Chamiya Lɛbanɔn nti kuhi pam, ka duhi yi yee Bashan. Kuhimiya Abarim polo bahina, dama bɛ ku yi ni yuri shɛba.
en: Go up to Lebanon and cry out, lift up your voice in Bashan, cry out from Abarim, because all your lovers have been ravished.

dag: Lan zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din kpalim la n-niŋ a min a dɔɣiriba ni nya ka di simdi shɛm, ka lee chɛ ka di nyɛla din doli yi Naawuni maa yubu.
en: As long as it is Gods will, you and your colleagues may do what you think best with the rest of the silver and gold.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi duu maa wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia, ka di be du titali maa tooni ha. Ka o daa yɛli ma, Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he measured the length of the room. It was cubits long and cubits wide. He said to me, This is the Most Holy Place.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi ni paɣ ŋɔ nya o daalahichi din galisi ŋɔ zaa chɛ m-paŋ, dama o yurilim galisiya pam; amaa ŋun nya o daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ ka di pɔri nyɛla ŋun yurilim pɔra.
en: So I tell you that all her sins are forgiven, and that is why she has shown great love. But anyone who has been forgiven for only a little will show only a little love.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa nyarila o ninni ni nyaɣisira, ka o zaŋ sariga pili lir li, naɣila o ti lan chaŋ ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: and they would see that his face was shining. Then he would put the veil back on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord .

dag: Ŋunkam chɛri ŋun turi niriba taali paŋd o nyɛla ŋun bɔri zɔtali, amaa ŋunkam teeri zabili nyɛla ŋun saɣindi zɔtali.
en: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Bɛrishiiba n-zaŋ kpa Haran polo.
en: Jacob left the town of Beersheba and started out for Haran.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku doo mini paɣa. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku do kurugu mini bidibbila. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku nachimbil mini paɣisaribila.
en: With you I will crush men and women. With you I will crush old and young. With you I will crush young men and young women.

dag: Filistia doo maa daa yi kul yirimina ti zaana asiba ni zaawuni n-kul niŋdi lala hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: For forty days straight the Philistine came out and took his stand, both morning and evening.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini, ka zaŋ Olivi tihi kpam din viɛli lita yini ŋ-ŋmiri li mali chi sara.
en: Also give a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with quart of olive oil.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa tuɣindi tulaale zim kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba la ni daa niŋdi shɛm la. Bɛ daa tum tuumbiɛri pam n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi;.
en: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti yo ba li bɛ nyɛviya ni, ka bɛ wula ti ku maha.
en: He will die before his time, like a tree whose top branches have already begun to die.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi n zuɣu, a chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili maa ŋmanila kɔgbana, n-ŋme ma luhi.
en: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.

dag: Yi tiŋ dunoli ti ku yo n-kpari yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa, dama tinzun nanim ni gari tooni n-zaŋ bɛ niriba ka bɛ ʒi bɛ daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: Day and night your gates will be open, So that the kings of the nations May bring you their wealth.

dag: Jɛrigu yi ŋahi ŋahili, di ŋmanila nir ni nyu dam kuli ka bɔri ni o ŋooi goo o nuu ni la.
en: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni sokam ʒi omaŋmaŋ ʒili.
en: Each person will have to carry their own load.

dag: Ka ti daa bo n-nya Yisa nyaandoliba n-kpalim nimaani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin. Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛli Pool Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: There we found some believers and stayed with them a week. By the power of the Spirit they told Paul not to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔram daa lab kuli Jɛziriil ni o ti tibi dan shɛli Sirianim ni daa ti o Rama saha shɛl o mini Siria Naa Hazaɛl ni daa tuhiri tab la. Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa chaŋ Jɛziriil ni o ti kaai Ɛhab bia Jɔram, o ni daa biɛri la zuɣu.
en: King Joram went back to Israel so that he could get well from those wounds. He went to the area of Jezreel. Ahaziah son of Jehoram was the king of Judah. Ahaziah went to Jezreel to see Joram.

dag: Yisa min o tuumba maa ni daa ti lan laɣim ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti Duuma, a ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim nam lan kpe bɛ nuu ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: When the apostles met together with Jesus, they asked him, Lord, will you at this time give the Kingdom back to Israel.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa.
en: Some Pharisees came to him and tried to trap him. Tell us, they asked, does our Law allow a man to divorce his wife.

dag: Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib zuɣu! Dama yi ŋooi baŋsim bɔhimbu dunoli saafɛbia; yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi guri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni soli.
en: How terrible for you legal experts! You snatched away the key of knowledge. You didnt enter yourselves, and you stood in the way of those who were entering.

dag: Yawɛ, n teeg a tuun kara la yɛla; ka teeg a ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la gba yɛla.
en: Our Lord , I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun mi daa yi Kamɛl na la chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: David went to Hebron with his two wives, Ahinoam and Abigail. Ahinoam was from Jezreel, and Abigail was the widow of Nabal from Carmel.

dag: Ti yaannim daa di bindiri shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la. Di sabiya: O daa ti ba bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na ka bɛ di. .
en: Our ancestors were given manna to eat in the desert. As the Scriptures say, He gave them bread from heaven to eat. .

dag: Ti yiɣisibu dali ni daa ti paai ka ti yiɣisi ni ti chaŋ; ka bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi zaa daa biɛl ti ti yi tiŋ maa tariga, ka ti gbani teeku noli n-suhi Naawuni.
en: But when the week was over, we started on our way again. All the men, together with their wives and children, walked with us from the town to the seashore. We knelt on the beach and prayed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Nyamiya, Jɔab puu m-baɣi m puu ka siŋkaafa be di ni la, chamiya ti niŋ buɣim nyo li. Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri chaŋ ti niŋ buɣim nyo puu maa.
en: Then Absalom said to his servants, Look, Joabs field is next to my field. He has barley growing in that field. Go burn the barley. So Absaloms servants went and started a fire in Joabs field.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim kpiya dola bɛmaŋmaŋ gbala ni ni jilima;.
en: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.

dag: Dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zaa niŋ pali la yɛtɔɣ yini puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: For the whole Law is summed up in one commandment: Love your neighbor as you love yourself.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali wuni ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee binshɛli din be tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni.
en: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.

dag: ka di daa kpa o talahi ni o doli yi Samaria.
en: Jesus had to go through Samaria.

dag: Dama alikauli maa nyɛla yi mini yi bihi zaŋ tabili bɛn be katiŋ ha ka nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ni na yɛn boli ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dini.
en: This promise is for you, your children, and for all who are far away—as many as the Lord our God invites.
