dag: Zomiya kɔr biɛri tuma! ŋun tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma tumdi li dalindirila omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa ninsal ni tumd alahichi balibu shɛŋa zaa pahi pala din dalind o niŋgbuŋ.
en: Avoid sexual immorality! Every sin that a person can do is committed outside the body, except those who engage in sexual immorality commit sin against their own bodies.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!.

dag: Amaa Amnɔn daa mal o zo so ka o yuli booni Jɔnadab, o daa nyɛla Dauda mabia Shamma dapala, ka daa mali yɛm pam.
en: But Amnon had a very clever friend named Jonadab, who was Davids brother Shimeahs son.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ suɣilo doli naa, o ni ti saɣ o ni yɛl o shɛm, ka zilim balli ni tooi kabisi kɔba.
en: A commander can be persuaded with patience, and a tender tongue can break a bone.

dag: Ka niriba daa ʒe kpaŋ lihir o; amaa ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra, O daa tiligi shɛba, dinzuɣu o yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili ŋun nyɛ ŋun Naawuni Masia, ŋun tiligim omaŋa.
en: The people stood there watching everything. The Jewish leaders laughed at Jesus. They said, If he is Gods Chosen One, the Messiah, then let him save himself. He saved others, didnt he.

dag: Mbaye n zɔnima, zomiya ma nambɔɣu, zomiya ma nambɔɣu! Dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma lala maa!.
en: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.

dag: O ni daa wolisira, ka bi yino zaŋ o nuu tirina, ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda daa zaŋ gali ʒee lo o nuu maa ka yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ dɔɣibu.
en: While she was giving birth, one baby put his hand out. The nurse tied a red string on the hand and said, This baby was born first.

dag: Yi churi puhibu ni, yi ŋmɛrila goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnima, ka piɛbiri yuhi, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka nyuri wain, amaa ka bɛ lihi nya Yawɛ tuma bee n-lihi nya o yiko tuma.
en: At your parties with your wine, harps, drums, flutes, and other musical instruments, you dont see what the Lord has done. You dont notice what his hands have made.

dag: Daadam, paɣiba ayi n-daa beni, bɛ daa nyɛla paɣ yino bihi.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, listen to this story about two sisters.

dag: Paɣ kam ŋun nyɛ sɔnya, yin kum o.
en: Put to death any woman who practices magic.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla n daa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa din bi viɛla mini zaligu shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku be n-ti ba.
en: So I gave them laws that were not good. I gave them commands that would not bring life.

dag: Dama zuliya kam jɛmdila bɛ wuna, amaa tinim ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Each of the peoples walks in the name of their own god; but as for us, we will walk in the name of the LORD our God forever and always.

dag: bɛ bi zɔri nambɔɣu, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: They think only of themselves and brag about what they will do.

dag: ka kul suhiri Naawuni ni di yi nyɛ o yubu, ŋun malim soli ti ma ka m bahi ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ;.
en: every time I pray. I ask that God in his good will may at last make it possible for me to visit you now.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi nya nambɔzɔbo ka o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ya labisi ʒili yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I will be kind to you, and the king of Babylon will also treat you with mercy. He will bring you back to your land.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya ka Naa Dauda kul wari waa, ka yiɣiri jamdi Yawɛ tooni, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Dauda o suhu ni.
en: As the LORDs chest entered Davids City, Sauls daughter Michal was watching from a window. She saw King David jumping and dancing before the LORD, and she lost all respect for him.

dag: Naawuni simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ŋuna n-su yɛm mini yiko.
en: He said, Praise Gods name forever and ever! Power and wisdom belong to him.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagban ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then people will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

dag: Nir yi zɔri Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu. N je karimbaani mini maŋduhibu ni zaɣ biɛɣu ni ʒiŋmabo yɛtɔɣa.
en: To honor the Lord is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil ways and false words.

dag: Kom ni ti zɔri yir o ŋmana ni na, ka o bimbira tiɣi kom pam. O naa ni ti gari Agag. O nam ni ti du pam.
en: They will have abundant rainfall And plant their seed in well-watered fields. Their king shall be greater than Agag, And his rule shall be extended far and wide.

dag: Zɔri, Yawɛ ni to n-kpuɣ a ni suli n-zaŋ ti labi. O ni gbaag a kirikiri.
en: You may be important, but the Lord will pick you up and throw you away.

dag: Ɛliɔnai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔdavia mini Ɛliashib ni Pɛlaya ni Akub ni Jɔhanan ni Dalaiya ni Anani, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: Elioenai had seven sons: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni bɛ gbaam bɛmaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bin kasi shɛŋa na ti ti ma la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Tell Aaron and his sons to be very careful how they treat the holy things that the Israelites devote to me so that they do not make my holy name impure: I am the LORD.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ m polo galisiya pam; a yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: You have such great love for me. You save me from the place of death.

dag: A yuri din tuhi, ka je din bi tuhi; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa piig a, ka ti a jilima pam din tiri suhupiɛlli gar o ni ti a tab shɛm la.
en: You loved righteousness and hated lawless behavior. That is why God, your God, has anointed you more than your companions with the oil of joy. .

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi binyɛra maa ni be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni dilan paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whoever touches these things will be unclean until evening. They must wash their own clothes and bathe in water.

dag: Jair daa malila bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn bari bunsi pihita. Ka o bihi maa daa mali tinsi pihita Giliad tiŋgban ni; ka bɛ na kul booni li Havɔtijairi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He had thirty sons who rode thirty donkeys. They had thirty cities in the land of Gilead, which are still called the villages of Jair.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni lab kuli nti lan laɣim tɔbbihi bɛn galisi gar o tuuli tɔbbihi la. Ka saha ti paai ka o zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam ka mali bidibbina n-lan labina.
en: The northern king will then muster another army—this one bigger than the first. After some years have passed, he will attack with a large and well-equipped army.

dag: Yi ni daa bi jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni suhupiɛlli yi ni mali binshɛɣukam pam la zuɣu.
en: Because you didnt serve the LORD your God joyfully and gladly above all else.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ Daadam Bia gba dabisili dali.
en: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be during the days of the Human One.

dag: Fabila maa m-bala. Zaŋmiya li yili yila. Zuliya kam paɣiba ni zaŋ li yili yila. Bɛ ni zaŋ li yili yila Ijipti mini di tɔbbihi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is a lament, and it will be sung as a lament. The daughters of the nations will lament for Egypt, and they will also lament for Egypts hordes. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nya yaa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛh o kɔbili ni, ka di daa luh o. Dama o daa bi niŋdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa sani, ka daa kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini zuɣu.
en: But when King Uzziah became strong, he grew arrogant, and that led to his downfall. He defied the Lord his God by going into the Temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya niriba maa ka bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are.

dag: Mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ti ŋubiri mɔri, o lan kumda? Bee nahu yi ti ŋubiri taɣitaɣi, o lan ŋumda?.
en: A donkey is content when eating grass, and a cow is quiet when eating hay.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yuli ba ka yɛli ba, Ninsalinim sani ka dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, binshɛɣukam nandimi.
en: Jesus looked straight at them and said, There are some things people cannot do, but God can do anything.

dag: Man yɛn bela Mizipa n-ʒe yi zaani Babilɔnnim bɛn yɛn ka kpe na sani. Amaa yinim kul benya yi ni be tin shɛŋa ni maa, ka tɔɣimiya wain mini kpam, ka pɔhiri tiwala n-zaŋdi li niŋdi binyara ni zaana.
en: But me? I will stay at Mizpah so I can speak on your behalf when the Babylonians arrive. But you? Settle down in the towns you have taken; harvest the grapes, the summer fruits and figs, and then store them in your containers.

dag: Yawɛ, n gbib a zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka n di vi.
en: Im holding tight to your laws, LORD. Please dont let me be put to shame.

dag: Naad mini safurɔn ni kalamɔsi ni sinnamɔn ni firanki tulaale zim tihi zaa ni mɛɛr ni aloosi ni tulaale suma zaa be di ni.
en: of saffron, calamus, and cinnamon, or incense of every kind. Myrrh and aloes grow there with all the most fragrant perfumes.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm la, dama o ba kum nyaaŋa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o saawaranim bɛn luh o.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as Ahabs dynasty had done, because after his fathers death they gave him advice that led to his downfall.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa nya Sool maa, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni sa yɛl a ninvuɣ so yɛla la m-bala, Ŋuna n-yɛn su n niriba maa.
en: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the Lord said to him, This is the man I told you about. He will rule my people.

dag: Yuun pisinaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the first month in the twenty-seventh year of exile, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu, darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. Darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ nuhi tuma ni simdi shɛm; tim ba bɛ tuma laara.
en: Pay them back for what theyve done! Pay them back for their evil deeds! Pay them back for their handiwork! Give back to them exactly what they deserve!.

dag: Yi kpe taali ni yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la zuɣu, ka ta yimaŋ daɣiri yi ni maani buɣa la zuɣu. Yi chɛ ka yi dabisili mirina. N ni daa zali ya yuun shɛl la paaya. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi di vi zuliya kam sani, ka tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa nim mali ya ansarisi.
en: People of Jerusalem, you killed many people. You made filthy idols. You are guilty, and the time has come to punish you. Your end has come. Other nations will make fun of you and laugh at you.

dag: ka o zaŋ wain paɣ o dansi maa, ka niŋ kpam bɔbili li, ka zaŋ tana lo li, ka zaŋ o balisi omaŋmaŋ buŋa n-zaŋ o ti kpɛhi saamba yilikpɛrili n-gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka anabi yi yimaŋmaŋ niriba ni na kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ti wummiya anabi maa yɛligu.
en: The LORD your God will raise up a prophet like me from your community, from your fellow Israelites. Hes the one you must listen to.

dag: Asa mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: Asa was always at war with King Baasha of Israel.

dag: Amaa yinim gbibi n ni zali zaligu shɛŋa, ka miriya ka yi ni tiŋbia bee saan so ŋun be yi sani tum din chihiri maa.
en: But all of you must keep my rules and my regulations. You must not do any of these detestable things, neither citizen nor immigrant who lives with you .

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi mali yum o zuɣu ni bee o teeŋa ni.
en: If you have a sore on your head or chin.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; cham ti niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee daŋ mali mahili zaɣ bila n-ti ma na, ka naanyi chaŋ ti mal a min a bidibiga maa mi dini.
en: Elijah said, Everything will be fine. Do what you said. Go home and fix something for you and your son. But first, please make a small piece of bread and bring it to me.

dag: Zabili piligu ŋmanila bɛ ni yi cheei kom bahi la, dinzuɣu zom yi zabili ni ka di na bi piligi.
en: The start of an argument is like the first break in a dam; stop it before it goes any further.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa kali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: So Moses did what the Lord commanded. He counted all the firstborn children of the Israelites.

dag: ka n ti sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa wurim la zuɣu m-pa kuɣ parilana ayi maa zuɣu, ka a zaŋ li niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: and I will write on those tablets what I wrote on the tablets that you broke, and then you are to put them in the Box.

dag: Amaa ti yi be neesim ni kaman o ni be neesim ni shɛm, ti ni mali dolintabitali ni taba, ka o Bia Yisa ʒim kul ni kpihindi ti daalahichi zaa bahira.
en: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.

dag: Naftali zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Ammihud bia Pɛdahɛl.
en: from the tribe of Naphtali—Pedahel son of Ammihud.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yiɣisim taŋkpaɣu ni n-dam amaŋa. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yihim mii din be a nyiŋgol ni bahi.
en: Shake yourself free, Jerusalem! Rise from the dust and sit on your throne! Undo the chains that bind you, captive people of Zion!.

dag: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa o yi tiri gbini, n suhu ku piɛl o zuɣu.
en: The person who is right with me will live by trusting in me. But I will not be pleased with the one who turns back in fear. Habakkuk :-.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A bihi bɛn be a ʒiɛman ni zaa ŋun mali dalinli, ŋun miri ka o mirina ni o ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: Tell Aaron: If any of your descendants have anything wrong with them, they must not carry the special bread to God.

dag: hal ka piɛm ti nyɔɣ o gbaag o nyɔri. O ŋmanila noombil so ŋun zɔri chani zana ni ka bi mi ni di nyɛla din yɛn di o nyɛvili.
en: until an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird hurrying to the snare, not aware that it will cost him his life.

dag: O nyari bina pam, amaa ka bi baŋdi li; o tiba mali voya, amaa di bi wumda.
en: Israel, you have seen so much, but what has it meant to you? You have ears to hear with, but what have you really heard.

dag: Jɛhɔram ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba, ka bo bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: While Jehoram was king, the people of Edom rebelled and chose their own king.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli, ka gbilisiya tibili wum fabila shɛŋa din yɛn yi n noli ni na.
en: Listen while I state my case.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka so zaŋ salinim ni ni tooi niŋ shɛli nyuri bara, dama binshɛɣukam nyɛla yi dini.
en: So then, no one should brag about human beings. Everything belongs to you.

dag: O ni ti liri nuzaa polɔnima, ka wurim Asiria. O ni ti chɛ ka Ninive kpalim dabari n kuui doya kaman tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: He will stretch out his hand against the north and will cause Assyria to perish. Let him make Nineveh a desolation, a desolate place like the wilderness.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali, ka chani gind a sara maligu bimbini.
en: Lord , I wash my hands to make myself pure, so that I can come to your altar.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa vihi do shɛb bɛn kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa yɛla maa zaa naai.
en: and within the next three months they investigated all the cases of men with foreign wives.

dag: Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ tooni na ti gbani? N zaŋmi yuun yini naɣ bihi ka o tooni na nti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la?.
en: What shall I bring to the Lord , the God of heaven, when I come to worship him? Shall I bring the best calves to burn as offerings to him?.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta zaligu ŋɔ n-daa wuhi Purim.
en: Esthers order made these features of Purim part of the law, so it was written down.

dag: N kpahimya nya ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri yɛm pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhuyiɣisili. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɔri baŋsim pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhugarigu.
en: The wiser you are, the more worries you have; the more you know, the more it hurts.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di to ni bundana kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: Then Jesus said to his followers, The truth is, it will be very hard for a rich person to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-nyɛ: Jɛramiil mini Ram ni Kɛlubai.
en: Hezron had three sons: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

dag: ni ashaara dali ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tiligirimi, ka nyari faako suhuyiɣisili dali?.
en: Evil people are spared when disaster comes. They survive when God shows his anger.

dag: di yi simdi ni bɛ bu ŋun mali taali maa, dindina sariakarita maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o sɔŋ n fiɛb o o ninni, ka o fiɛbbu kalinli yɛn dolila o taali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If the guilty one is sentenced to be beaten, the judge is to make him lie face downward and have him whipped. The number of lashes will depend on the crime he has committed.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla zali, ka kahigi li wuhi, ka di daa bi yuui, ka n chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: The Lord says to Israel, Long ago I predicted what would take place; then suddenly I made it happen.

dag: Ka shɛb daa yiɣisi zani dir o shɛhira kpɛma yɛra.
en: Finally, some men stood up and lied about him. They said.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka ti kpɛh o tanti suɣili ni. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka n-leeg o paɣa, ka yur o pam, ka di daa chɛ ka o nya suhukpaŋsibo o ma kum la nyaaŋa.
en: Then Isaac brought the girl into his mothers tent. Rebekah became his wife that day. Isaac loved her very much. So he was comforted after his mothers death.

dag: N ni yɛl a o naba min o bɔɣiri ni o yaa ni o biɛhigu ni viɛl shɛm yɛla.
en: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!.

dag: Binshɛŋa din ŋmani sakuɣa la na mi n-kɔŋ Lɛbanɔn tampima la lɔna ni? Ka zoya ni kulibɔŋ maha la kɔzɔrim na mi n-nyuui?.
en: Are Lebanon's rocky heights ever without snow? Do its cool mountain streams ever run dry?.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣila yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi;.
en: You will present an entirely burned offering, a food gift as a soothing smell to the LORD: one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, all without blemish.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ: Katat mini Nahalal ni Shimrɔn ni Idala ni Bɛtilihɛm: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: They also owned Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem; in total: twelve cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: ni Mishima ni Duma ni Masa ni Hadad ni Tɛma.
en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema.

dag: dama ti wum ka o yɛli ni Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ni wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka taɣi ka shɛŋa Anabi Musa ni daa zali ni ti dol la.
en: We heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will tear down the Temple and change all the customs which have come down to us from Moses.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yisa, ti teemi n yɛla a nam ni.
en: And he said to Jesus, Remember me, Jesus, when you come as King.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Piim Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ la n-zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu;.
en: The Lord answered, Joshua son of Nun can do the job. Place your hands on him to show that he is the one to take your place.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti zaŋ takɔbi su Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ takɔbi su Nimrɔd tiŋgbɔŋ; ka Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti be ti tintarisi bɛ ni fa ti bahi.
en: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land.

dag: Yinim tuumbiɛtumdiba ŋɔ zomiya ka chɛ ma; ka n doli n Naawuni zaligunima.
en: Get away from me, you evildoers; I want to guard my Gods commandments!.

dag: ka pumpɔŋɔ o shiri niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi zaa ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani ka bi deeg o nol la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka yɛlli ŋɔ paai ya maa.
en: And now the Lord has done everything just as he said he would do. This disaster happened because you people of Judah sinned against the Lord . You did not obey him.

dag: Ŋun Masia maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun daa ʒi ti daalahichi o niŋgbuŋ ni dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ wuntia polo. O fiɛbbu bɔba ni dansi la zuɣu ka yi nyari dɔriti tibi kpaŋ.
en: Christ carried our sins in his body on the cross. He did this so that we would stop living for sin and live for what is right. By his wounds you were healed.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yihi yɛli ni o bela neesim ni ka je o mabia, o na kul bela zibisim ni.
en: Someone might say, I am in the light, but if they hate any of their brothers or sisters in Gods family, they are still in the darkness.

dag: Niriba yi zabira, ka yino ti zaŋ kuɣili lab o kpee bee n-kpilim o nuu ŋme o kpee, ka o nya daŋa ka bi kpi, amaa ka lee dɔni.
en: Two men might argue and one might hit the other with a rock or with his fist. If the man who was hurt is not killed, the man who hurt him should not be killed.

dag: Anfaani maa wuhiri ti ni ti zaɣisim din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini dunia ŋɔ kɔr biɛri, amaa ka lee gbibi timaŋa ka mali bebu din tuhi, ka mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa piila din nyɛ jɛrilim dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yɛnnim vi; ka daa pii din nyɛ bin chɔɣima dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yikolaannim vi;.
en: God purposely chose what the world considers nonsense in order to shame the wise, and he chose what the world considers weak in order to shame the powerful.

dag: M bi chɛ a zaligu shɛŋa dim pahi la dolibu, dama nyini n wuhi ma li.
en: You are my teacher, so I will always do whatever you decide.

dag: Di saha maa, anab kam ti ku lan nyu bara ʒii nyabu zuɣu bee n-wuhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee n-ye binyɛr shɛli din mali biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri di ni n-yɔhim niriba.
en: On that day each of the prophets will be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies and wont put on a shaggy coat in order to deceive.

dag: Dama gɔgbihiriba gbihirila yuŋ, ka danyuriba gba nyuri kuuni yuŋ.
en: It is at night when people sleep; it is at night when they get drunk.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni kul du shɛm, ka tiŋgbani mi zilim shɛm, lala n-nyɛ nanim tɛha, di ka vihi baŋ.
en: We cannot discover how high the sky is above us or how deep the earth is below. The same is true with the minds of kings. We cannot understand them.

dag: O daa dolila solɔɣu m-miri paɣa maa lɔndo polo. O daa dolila soli chani o yiŋa.
en: He was crossing the street at her corner and walked down the path to her house.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Jɛhɔash daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoahaz lay down with his ancestors. He was buried in Samaria. His son Joash succeeded him as king.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb yila katinsi na, dinzuɣu n yi chɛ ka bɛ kuli ni kum bɛ ni ti tarigi sol ni.
en: Some of them live a long way from here. If I send them away hungry, they might faint on their way home.

dag: Ka n daa kul mali lala hal ti paai Kɔbilinini Dunɔdal la mini Naa Kosubo bɔɣili la polo. Ka n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so maa daa bi tooi nya soli gari.
en: Then on the east side of the city I went north to the Fountain Gate and the King's Pool. The donkey I was riding could not find any path through the rubble.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n yi lab m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa sani, ka bia maa bi dol ti labi, dindina o nyɛvili ni tab bia maa nyɛvil la zuɣu.
en: Now, imagine what will happen when we go home without our youngest brother—he is the most important thing in our fathers life!.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: So Pilate said to him, Don't you hear all these things they accuse you of.

dag: O nam yiko kul ni zoori pahira; ka suhudoo kul ni be o ʒiɛman ni. O nam ni be kaman Dauda nam. O ni doli wuntia ni din tuhi soli n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yu ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: His royal power will continue to grow; his kingdom will always be at peace. He will rule as King David's successor, basing his power on right and justice, from now until the end of time. The Lord Almighty is determined to do all this.

dag: ka Sulemaana daa lab me Gɛza mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din be tiŋli polo la.
en: Solomon rebuilt Gezer and the city of Lower Beth Horon.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Zadok mini Itama bia Ahimɛlɛk daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o piripiri Aduna bidibisi maa kaman bɛ talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: David, with the help of Zadok from Eleazars family and Ahimelech from Ithamars family, divided them according to their appointed duties.

dag: dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣ mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: Whatever is covered up will be uncovered, and every secret will be made known.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa po pɔri di saha maa ha yɛli, Ŋunkam ti yiɣisi ni o lab me Jɛriko zali, Yawɛ ŋun yɛlim noli ti o ka di di o. Ŋunkam ti zali di tanzaa, o bidib kpɛm ni kpi; Ŋunkam mi ti mali di duno yɔriti, o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani ni kpi.
en: At that time Joshua made this decree: Anyone who starts to rebuild this city of Jericho will be cursed before the LORD. Laying its foundations will cost them their oldest child. Setting up its gates will cost them their youngest child.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi n-tuɣituɣi taba n-zaŋ li kaai vili kɔniŋdi bini maa nyingol ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anu.
en: Two rows of bronze gourds were around the outer edge of the bowl, ten gourds to every centimeters.

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa yi ni pun mi la zuɣu ka n niŋ suhukpeeni n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n teei ya di yɛla. Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni la zuɣu.
en: But Ive written to you in a sort of daring way, partly to remind you of what you already know. Im writing to you in this way because of the grace that was given to me by God.

dag: Tarim ŋɔ daa kuhiya, ka Yawɛ wum, ka yih o o muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni; o kɔŋko sani ka n tiliginsim yirina.
en: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.

dag: ka daa lab kuli ti bo tulaale mini kpaʒiɛrim zali. Ka bɛ daa vuhi Vuhim Dabisili dali maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then they went back home and prepared the spices and perfumes for the body. On the Sabbath they rested, as the Law commanded.

dag: ka yɛl o, Di ni nyɛ a suhuyubu ni ka a zaɣis a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛl la mini n ni daa zal a zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu zuɣu, n ni deeg a nam maa n-zaŋ li ti a kpambal so.
en: and said to him, Because you have deliberately broken your covenant with me and disobeyed my commands, I promise that I will take the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your officials.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa wuh o niriba maa zaa, Hiburunim maa yi lan dɔɣi bidibiga, yin zaŋm o ti lɔhi Nail Mɔɣili ni, amaa chɛliya bipuɣinsi bɛna.
en: until finally, the king gave a command to everyone in the nation, As soon as a Hebrew boy is born, throw him into the Nile River! But you can let the girls live.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi paɣiba mini yi bihi ni yi biŋkɔbiri ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni Musa ni daa zaŋ tin ya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili ŋɔ na. Amaa ka yi ni tɔbbihi bɛn lo kpara zaa pahi yi mabihi maa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba.
en: Your wives, children, and cattle may remain in the land that Moses has given you on the east side of the Jordan. But all you brave fighters, organized for war, must cross over in front of your fellow Israelites. You must help them.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ tulaale zim tuɣindi laa m-mooi buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni m-pal li, ka niŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla nukurigu pali buyi ŋ-ŋmiri li biɛlabiɛla n-zaŋ li kpe pateesa maa puuni.
en: he shall take a fire pan full of burning coals from the altar and two handfuls of fine incense and bring them into the Most Holy Place.

dag: Ka bɛ daa goog o yɛl o, Kpalimmi ya ŋɔ n-gbe ti sani, dama wuntaŋ luya ka yuŋ zibira. Ka o daa doli ba kpe bɛ yiŋa.
en: But they urged him, saying, Stay with us. Its nearly evening, and the day is almost over. So he went in to stay with them.

dag: dama bɛ daa wum ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa paɣiri Naawuni. Di saha ka Pita bɔhi.
en: They heard them speaking different languages and praising God. Then Peter said.

dag: suhir a n ni leei bi so ba sarika ŋɔ ni la zuɣu. Bia maa n-nyɛ Onɛsimus.
en: appeal to you for my child Onesimus. I became his father in the faith during my time in prison.

dag: Jɔn daa bi sɔɣ ba shɛli, o mi daa bi chihi. O daa yɛli ba, M pala Masia.
en: Without any hesitation he said openly and plainly, I am not the Messiah.

dag: N daa lan yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na m mali ya be mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi ni yi deei Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to lay claim to the land of the Amorite.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa shiri biɛra, hal ti yɛn kpimi gba; amaa ka Naawuni daa zo o nambɔɣu, ka di pala o kɔŋko ka o daa zo nambɔɣu maa, amaa zaŋ tabili man gba ni di chɛ ka n ku mali nandahima n-lan pahi.
en: Indeed he was sick and almost died. But God had pity on him, and not only on him but on me, too, and spared me an even greater sorrow.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord s message came to me:.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kpi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣimna ti kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ yiŋa Rama. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Now Samuel died, and all Israel gathered to mourn for him. They buried him at his home in Ramah. David then left and went down to the Maon wilderness.

dag: Amaa yinim ni kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: You will die here in the desert!.

dag: Kalimiya yuma ayopɔin ʒiibuyopɔin. Di yuma maa ni ti nyɛla yuun pihinuyinika.
en: Once every years.

dag: Naawuni ŋun yihi ya Ijipti na ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yila yi sani. Yi nyandi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi dimnima. Yi kabiri bɛ kɔba. O ni to ba o piɛma.
en: With the strength of a wild ox, God led you out of Egypt. You will defeat your enemies, shooting them with arrows and crushing their bones.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ba yi di nyɛ Naawuni yi naan yuri ma, dama o sani ka n yina; pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka n kana, amaa ŋun Naawuni n-tim ma na.
en: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.

dag: O daa kari zuliya shɛba, ka piri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ti Izraɛl zuliya, ka deei bɛ yinsi ti ba ka bɛ kpe m-beni.
en: God drove out the nations before them and apportioned property for them; he settled Israels tribes in their tents.

dag: Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la be nimaani. Dinzuɣu a yi ti kul wum shɛlikam nayili maa, nyin yɛlim Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa.
en: The priests Zadok and Abiathar will be with you. You must tell them everything you hear in the kings palace.

dag: Deemiya ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm Naawuni dolibu ni, amaa ka di niŋy o naŋgbankpeeni o ni chihiri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Be willing to accept those who still have doubts about what believers can do. And dont argue with them about their different ideas.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Shunɛm paɣ so bia o ni daa neei kum ni la, Yiɣisim zaŋ a yiŋnim zaa kuli luɣ shɛli a ni yɛn tooi kuli; dama Yawɛ ni chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Elisha spoke to the woman whose son he had brought back to life: You and your household must go away and live wherever you can, because the LORD has called for a famine. It is coming to the land and will last seven years.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa boli bindirigu maa Manna, di daa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din nyɛ zaɣ piɛla, ka nyaɣisi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ shiri mali karikaasi shɛŋa.
en: The people called the special food manna. It was like small white coriander seeds and tasted like thin cakes made with honey.

dag: dindina o dana maa ŋun zaŋm o chaŋ Naawuni sani nti zaŋ o zali baɣili dunoli bee duno paɣirili, ka zaŋ peenkpaa chib o tibili voli, ka o leeg o dabili hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: then his master will bring him before God. He will bring him to the door or the doorpost. There his master will pierce his ear with a pointed tool, and he will serve him as his slave for life.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni yinim bɛn daa nyɛ alahichi daba la ni doli wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa deei ni yi suhuri zaa la zuɣu.
en: In the past you were slaves to sin—sin controlled you. But thank God, you fully obeyed what you were taught.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa daa tirila bɛ suɣa Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: The clans of the Gershonites were to camp behind the dwelling on the west side.

dag: Kalima maa biɛhigu mini bɛ ni daa mal li shɛm. Di zaa kɔtomsi daa nyɛla zaɣ yinsi, ka nyɛlisira kaman vakahili la. Di malibu maa daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla kalinli yini kpɛhi din la ni.
en: All four wheels were alike; each one shone like a precious stone, and each had another wheel intersecting it at right angles.

dag: Dama din daa bi yɛn yuu la yi daa kana ni jilima, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ jilima gari lala.
en: If the agreement that was brought to an end came with glory, then the agreement that never ends has much greater glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa suhu daa yu Yisifu pam, ka Yisifu daa tumd o tuma, ka o zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ tumtumdiba zuɣulana, ka zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: So Potiphar was very happy with Joseph. He allowed Joseph to work for him and to help him rule the house. Joseph was the ruler over everything Potiphar owned.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Daina ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu mini Liya bipuɣiŋga la daa ti chaŋ ni o ti puhi tiŋ maa ni paɣiba;.
en: One day, Dinah, the daughter of Leah and Jacob, went out to see the women of that place.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti kpimsi Ɛdom yɛnnima; ka kpimsi Iso Zoli zuɣunim baŋsim.
en: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord , will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Duhimiya Yawɛ tuuta maa zuɣusaa, Yawɛ kul ni tuhiri Amalɛknim maa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Moses said, I lifted my hands toward the Lord s throne. So the Lord fought against the Amalekites, as he always has.

dag: ka chɛ ka di ku pali mɔchɛriba nukura bee n-saɣi mɔbɔbilɔriba mɔbɔɣu.
en: which wont fill the reapers hand or fill the harvesters arms.

dag: Dama Naawuni mi ni yi yi di li, yi nini ni neei, ka yi be kaman ŋun Naawuni, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God understands what will happen on the day you eat fruit from that tree. You will see what you have done, and you will know the difference between right and wrong, just as God does.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o soya, ka bi tum taali gba mali alibarika.
en: They dont do wrong. They follow his ways.

dag: O zaŋ o piɛm pa o tɔbu zuɣu n-darigi li kpa ma.
en: God took careful aim and shot his arrows.

dag: Shɛhira dira ŋun nyɛ nia biɛɣulana yi kana ti wuhi ni so tum tuumbiɛɣu.
en: If any of you try to harm another by false accusations.

dag: O ni daa kpi kum shɛl la, o daa kpimi yim zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa nyɛvil shɛli o ni mali be ŋɔ, Naawuni zuɣu ka o be maa.
en: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.

dag: Ka naa daa zaɣisi ninkura la yɛligu la, ka zaŋla halibiɛɣu yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi niriba maa.
en: Rehoboam ignored the advice of the older advisors.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dagɔn tindaannim mini Ashidɔdnim bɛn zaa yɛn kpe Dagɔn duu maa ni bi lan tamdi di dunɔbia zuɣu kpɛri hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: This is why the priests and everyone else step over that part of the doorway when they enter the temple of Dagon in Ashdod.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka anzinfa mini salima galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi kaman sinsabisi dari ni galisi shɛm Shɛfɛla la.
en: In Jerusalem, the king made silver and gold as common as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore trees that grow in the foothills.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac said to his father Abraham, Father! Abraham answered, Yes, son? Isaac said, I see the wood and the fire. But where is the lamb we will burn as a sacrifice.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka o zaŋ bin suma pali bɛ yinsi. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli ka n je.
en: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.

dag: Bɛ deei kulibɔna dubu shee la, ka nyo bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la buɣim, ka tɔbbihi suhuri fuŋ.
en: The enemy now controls the river crossings! The marshes are on fire! Your army has panicked.

dag: ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya, ka yi paɣiba kpalim pakoya, ka yi bihi gba leei kpibisi.
en: And I will be very angry. I will kill you with a sword. Then your wives will become widows, and your children will become orphans.

dag: Naa maa ni ti nyu sokpaŋ kulibɔŋ kom n-nya kpiɔŋ di nasara.
en: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Maasɛya so mini Ɛlia ni Shɛmaya ni Jɛhiɛl ni Uzia.
en: From the descendants of Harim, these men: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Ti Duuma, o yi gbihirimi dindina o ni nya alaafee.
en: The disciples said, Lord, if hes sleeping, he will get well.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti liri Dɛbirinima. Bɛ daa tuui booni li la Kiriatisɛfa.
en: From Hebron, Judah's army went to attack Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.

dag: Teebuya anahi n-daa ʒe di puuni, ka diba anahi ʒe samban ni dunɔdali yaɣili. Teebuya anii n-daa nyɛ li, ka bɛ kɔriti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri di zuɣu.
en: Altogether there were eight tables on which the animals to be sacrificed were killed: four inside the room and four out in the courtyard.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ ti zaa yinoyino ni nya salima binshɛŋa din nyɛ nuhi ni bansi ni zoligɔnim ni nintuhi din dihiri gbana zuɣu ni tibikpara ni yɛri na ni ti ti mali sara ti daalahichi zuɣu Yawɛ sani.
en: So we are bringing the gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces that each of us has taken. We offer them to the Lord as a payment for our lives, so that he will protect us.

dag: Yi kpalim malila yi buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Molok la suɣili mini yi buɣ so ŋun gba yuli booni Rɛfan, ka o nyɛ saŋmariga kɔtomsi ka nyɛ yi ni daa me shɛŋa n-zali ni yi jɛmdi la. Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi Babilɔn tooni ha.
en: No! Instead, you took the tent of Moloch with you, and the star of your god Rephan, the images that you made in order to worship them. Therefore, I will send you far away, farther than Babylon. .

dag: Dama ti pun wum yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom pirigi buyi m-mali soli tin ya la yɛla; ka lan wum yi ni daa niŋ Amɔri nanim ayi bɛn yuya booni Sihɔn mini Ogi la gba shɛm ku ba Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la yɛla.
en: We have heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea in front of you when you were leaving Egypt. We have also heard how you killed Sihon and Og, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sagban piɛlli, ka so ʒi di zuɣu ŋ-ŋmani daadam ka pil salima nam zuɣupiligu, ka gbib gɔr dirili o nuu ni.
en: I looked and there before me, sitting on a white cloud, was one who looked like the Son of Man. He had a gold crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim bɛn be vinvamli ni ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn be bɔpiɛligu ni ŋɔ, m mini ya mali zabili. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa. Yinim bɛn yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi siɣina ti liri ti? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kpe ti sɔɣisili shee ŋɔ na.
en: I am against you, you who live in the valley, like a rock of the plain, declares the LORD, and who say, Who will come down to attack us? Who will breach our fortresses.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa sagban wɔɣinli ni. Bɛ daa dol o wuhibu min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ti ba la.
en: he spoke to them from a pillar of cloud. They kept the laws and the rules God gave to them.

dag: Amaa man kul tumdila din tuhi. Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama yi na ʒi n-doli soli maa. Amaa lee miriya ka yi miri Alikauli Adaka maa. Doliya di nyaaŋa m-be li larigim kaman kilomita yini laasabu.
en: But let there be some distance between you and it, about three thousand feet. Dont come near it! You will know the way you should go, even though youve never traveled this way before.

dag: Dama zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Izraɛlnim la mini Izraɛl nanim ni Juda nanim saha la zaa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-lan puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: The people had not celebrated a Passover like this since the days when the judges ruled Israel. None of the kings of Israel or the kings of Judah ever had such a big celebration for Passover.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm o suhu ni n-doli zaligunima. Amaa jɛrigu ŋun mali yɛtɔɣ yoya ni bahi yoli.
en: The wise accept instruction, but fools argue and bring trouble on themselves.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee biɛhindi n yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ?.
en: Who are you to question my wisdom with your ignorant, empty words?.

dag: ni Mishima ni Duma ni Masa.
en: Mishma; Dumah; Massa.

dag: A yiko puuni, cham ti di nasara; ka taɣi yɛlimaŋli mini din tuhi zali. Chɛ ka a nudirigu tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm.
en: Go and succeed in your grandeur! Ride out on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness! Let your strong hand perform awesome deeds.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim bɔhi Ɛdomnim biɛri ti ma. Bɛ ni ti niŋ Ɛdomnim maa kaman n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ baŋ m biɛri bɔhibu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will send my own people to take revenge on the Edomites by making them feel my fierce anger. And when I punish them, they will know that I am the Lord God.

dag: Ti loya ni ti ku niŋ din ni chɛ ka so galim ti yurilim pina din galisi ŋɔ taribu ni.
en: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nol ni yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka o zaŋ yɛli zali zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni buɣim ti saɣim li ŋɔ. Di ʒiɛya gulila dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri ŋun Naawuni sizuura saria la.
en: And that same word of God is keeping the skies and the earth that we have now. They are being kept to be destroyed by fire. They are kept for the day of judgment and the destruction of all people who are against God.

dag: Naawuni ni daa saɣindi vinvamli ni tinsi maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa teei Ibrahimma yɛla, ka yihi Lɔt o ni daa saɣindi tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Lɔt ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛl la n-tilig o.
en: God destroyed the cities in the valley, but he remembered what Abraham had said. So God sent Lot away from those cities before destroying them.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi daa yi zuɣusaa na ti tuhi tɔbu; bɛ daa yila bɛ biɛhigu shee na ti tuhi Sisɛra.
en: The stars fought from the sky; as they moved across the sky, they fought against Sisera.

dag: N wum lahibali Yawɛ sani. O tim tumo zuliya kam sani ti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya taba n kana ti lir o. Yiɣisimiya tuhi tɔbu.
en: I said, Edom, I have received a message from the Lord . He has sent a messenger to tell the nations to assemble their armies and to get ready to attack you.

dag: Yi ni daa zaŋ dabisi shɛŋa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa daa nyɛla biɛɣ pihinahi. Dinzuɣu dabisi yini kam yɛn leela yuun muni. Yi ni ʒi yi daalahichi ʒili yuun pihinahi, ka baŋ ni yi ni niŋ shɛm bi tiɣi n nini. .
en: You will suffer the consequences of your sin for forty years, one year for each of the forty days you spent exploring the land. You will know what it means to have me against you!.

dag: Ti ni nya nɛma balibu kam din mali shaara, ka ŋme n-di nɛma pam ti pali ti yinsi.
en: We will take everything they have and fill our houses with stolen goods.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam mini noonsi ni biŋgbamda ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be teeku ni nyɛla ninsal ni ni tooi maai shɛb nina hal ka pun maai li gba.
en: People can tame and already have tamed every kind of animal, bird, reptile, and fish.

dag: O ni daa ti wuhi ba naai ka o yɛli Saimɔn, Chamiya teeku ŋɔ bulli ni ha ti lab yi lansi maa gbahi zahim.
en: When Jesus finished speaking, he said to Simon, Take the boat into the deep water. If all of you will put your nets into the water, you will catch some fish.

dag: ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba sanna ti yɛli ba.
en: So the people from the tribes of Reuben and Gad came to Moses. They spoke to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the people.

dag: Amaa ka wuntizɔriba bɛn kul gbibi be wuntizɔbo soli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi viɛla kul nyari yaa pahira.
en: Those who claim to be respectable are more and more convinced they are right.

dag: Ka daa kari alizin biɛri pam niriba zuɣu bahi, ka zaŋ kpam ʒe barinim pam gbiɛri n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: They forced many demons out of people and put olive oil on many who were sick and healed them.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunim wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la. .
en: Their worship of me is empty since they teach instructions that are human rules .

dag: amaa m mi ni hal a yi suhi shɛlikam Naawuni sani pumpɔŋɔ, o ni ti a li.
en: Even now I know that whatever you ask God, God will give you.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka a nini nya a yaansi. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: May you live to see your grandchildren! Peace be with Israel!.

dag: Bɛ ku di vi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu ni, ka kum yi ti lu, bɛ ni mali bindira pam.
en: When trouble comes, good people will not be destroyed. When times of hunger come, good people will have plenty to eat.

dag: Niriba maa zaa ni, ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka nyɛ gɔbisinima daa be bɛ ni. Bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino kam daa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi zaŋ kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni n-lab ninsal zabigu gba ka ku nyahigi li.
en: Out of this entire army, seven hundred specially chosen men were left-handed, and every one of them could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

dag: Zaŋ hal ni ʒiɛmani din pahiri buta ni, yi ni tooi deei bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: From the third generation onward their descendants may be included among the Lord 's people.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn tɛhi lala baŋ ni ti ni yɛri shɛm ti gbana puuni maa, lala ka ti ni niŋ ti yi ti be yi sani gba.
en: These people need to think about this—that when we are with you, our actions will show that we are the same as the words we wrote when we were away from you.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanim nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe ma yim baabiɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The family of Israel and the family of Judah have been unfaithful to me in every way. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima min anzinfa neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn na la n-labisi li ti zali di zaashe kura ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Also, the gold and silver things from Gods Temple must be put back in their places. Nebuchadnezzar took them from the Temple in Jerusalem and brought them to Babylon. They must be put back in Gods Temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ labimi kuli ni suhudoo, ka miri ka a chɛ ka Filistia nanim suhuri ti miligi a zuɣu.
en: Go back in peace. Dont do anything against the Philistine rulers.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti boli tab na ka yi ti ʒini yi wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi gbini. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On that day, says the LORD of heavenly forces, everyone will invite their neighbors to sit beneath their vines and the fig trees.

dag: Amaa naŋgbammalisim ka bɛ daa kul niŋd o, bɛ daa ŋmar o la ʒiri.
en: But their words were all lies; nothing they said was sincere.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya ka neesim maa viɛla, ka o woligi neesim maa ka chɛ zibisim.
en: God looked at the light and saw that it was good. He separated light from darkness.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ wuɣi tan ʒiɛkpeein mini tan sabilifaa ni zaɣ ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli, ka mali chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ li yili dunoli maa.
en: Then he made the curtain out of fine linen and violet, purple, and crimson yarn, weaving winged creatures into it.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka o mini ba naai noli, ka o lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ku ku ba. Ka Izraɛl kpamba gba daa lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ni ʒe alikauli maa nyaaŋa.
en: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.

dag: ka zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛr ayi ʒil tuh o; ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɣis o yɛli, A turi Naawuni mini naa; di saha ka yi zaŋ o yi nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: Then bring in two liars in front of him and have them testify as follows: You cursed God and king! Then take Naboth outside and stone him so he dies.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di saha maa kpa shɛli din daa kpa luɣ viɛlli shee la ti ku lan beni, bɛ ni ti ŋma li luhi, ka ʒi shɛli din daa ʒi di zuɣu la kpalim yoli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.

dag: A mini niriba maa kul yɛn gbarigimi zaa. Tuma maa yaɣ a kɔŋko tuma, a kɔŋko ku tooi tumdi li.
en: It is too much work for you to do alone. You cannot do this job by yourself. It wears you out. And it makes the people tired too.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: All of you whom I sent into exile in Babylonia, listen to what I, the Lord , say.

dag: Paɣ yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi, o malila suhusaɣiŋgu o biɛrim nyabu saha ni paai zuɣu; amaa o yi ti dɔɣi bia maa naai, o bi lan teer o biɛrim maa yɛla yaha, o ni dɔɣi bia dunia ni maa zuɣu.
en: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.

dag: amaa wuuni ka bɛ laɣisiri bɛ bindira sɔŋda, atam kpuɣibu saha ka bɛ vari bɛ bindira sɔŋda.
en: But in the summer, ants gather all of their food and save it. So when winter comes, there is plenty to eat.

dag: O miri ka o di binshɛlikam din yi wain tia zuɣu na bee n-nyu wain bee n-nyu binnyuri kpiɔŋ bee n-di binshɛli din chihiri dibu. Chɛ ka o doli n ni zal o shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: She must not eat anything that grows on a grapevine. She must not drink any wine or strong drink. She must not eat any food that is unclean. She must do everything that I have commanded her to do.

dag: Yawɛ niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba.
en: This has happened because of the LORD; it is astounding in our sight!.

dag: Bɛ ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣili Baal ka chɛ ma; bɛ ŋmanila tɔb shɛli din ka naani niŋbu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ kpamba zaa bɛ yɛtɔɣ yoya zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ ti leei bɛ daansarisi malibo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They keep on turning away from me to a god that is powerless. They are as unreliable as a crooked bow. Because their leaders talk arrogantly, they will die a violent death, and the Egyptians will laugh.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ suɣilo doli naa, o ni ti saɣ o ni yɛl o shɛm, ka zilim balli ni tooi kabisi kɔba.
en: Patient persuasion can break down the strongest resistance and can even convince rulers.

dag: Wuntaŋ kul puhirimina n-chani ti lura, ka lan zɔri yomyom labiri o ni puhiri shɛli polo.
en: The sun still rises, and it still goes down, going wearily back to where it must start all over again.

dag: A ni kpi zo shɛli a ni yɛn du maa zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣ a pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a mabia Aduna ni daa kpi Hɔr Zoli zuɣu ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.

dag: Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hur yaaŋa, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la n-daa mali binshɛɣukam zaa Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o mali maa.
en: Bezalel, Uris son and Hurs grandson from the tribe of Judah, made everything that the LORD had commanded Moses to make.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Asa soli, ka yɛl o, Nyin Naa Asa mini Juda zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, yi yi kul be Naawuni sani, o gba ni be yi sani. Yi yi bo o, yi ni nya o. Amaa yi yi zaɣis o, o gba ni zaɣisi ya.
en: and he went to meet King Asa. He called out, Listen to me, King Asa, and all you people of Judah and Benjamin! The Lord is with you as long as you are with him. If you look for him, he will let you find him, but if you turn away, he will abandon you.

dag: Dinzuɣu chamiya ti yɛli zuliya kam ka bɛ leei n nyaandoliba, ka yi baptaizi ba ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia ni o Shia Kasi yul ni;.
en: Go, then, to all peoples everywhere and make them my disciples: baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

dag: ka Bɔaz daa nyɛ Obɛd ba, ka Obɛd mi daa nyɛ Jɛsi ba.
en: Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse.

dag: Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni bela yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ya yɛlimaŋli zaa soli; dama o bi ti yɛn yɛli shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa o ni wum shɛlikam, dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ yɛli, ka ni ti wuhi ya binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ.
en: But when the Spirit of truth comes, he will lead you into all truth. He will not speak his own words. He will speak only what he hears and will tell you what will happen in the future.

dag: Dama bɛ ni zaɣi kaman mɔri la; ka suui kaman vari la.
en: because they will fade fast, like grass; they will wither like green vegetables.

dag: Maligim maa ni daa ti vuui, ka Izraɛlnim maa nya ka binkpil bihi piɛla yɛrigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: After the dew was gone, something like thin flakes of frost was on the ground.

dag: O daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ni o malila Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shili ka bɛ tum Naawuni tuma n-chɛ ka ŋun Masia niŋgbuŋ la zooi.
en: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ, ka zaŋ o tanti suɣili kpa nimaani. Ka o tumtumdiba daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli nimaani yaha.
en: Isaac built an altar there and worshiped the Lord . Then he set up his camp there, and his servants dug another well.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: though no one can tell the future.

dag: Naa Bɛlishaaza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka man Daniɛl daa nya ʒii din pah ayi.
en: In the third year that Belshazzar was king, I saw a second vision.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa, ka di bi lu la, dama o daa me li tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: The rain poured down, the rivers flooded over, and the wind blew hard against that house. But it did not fall, because it was built on rock.

dag: Bɛn daa niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zaa daa malila suhu yini ni tɛhi yini, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛli ni o ni su shɛli nyɛla o kɔŋko dini, amaa bɛ zaa daa laɣim sula bɛ ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The community of believers was one in heart and mind. None of them would say, This is mine! about any of their possessions, but held everything in common.

dag: Ka o daa zo n-chaŋ Saimɔn Pita mini nyaandol so Yisa ni daa yuri la sani nti yɛli ba, Bɛ yihi ti Duuma siliga la ni, ka ti bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: She ran to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved, and said, They have taken the Lord from the tomb, and we dont know where theyve put him.

dag: Mɛshulam ni Abija ni Mijamin ni.
en: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ tiligi Izraɛlnima, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim din ku naai; ka bɛ kul ku lan di vi yaha. .
en: Israel has been saved by the LORD of everlasting salvation. You wont be shamed, and you wont be disgraced forever and always.

dag: Ka paɣ bundan maa daa ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni do so ŋun doli yiri ti sanna waawaayili ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: She said to her husband, Look, I know that he is a holy man of God and he passes by regularly.

dag: dama bɛ daa pun deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, amaa ka na lee bi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: For the Holy Spirit had not yet come down on any of them; they had only been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Kamiyana ka ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Chɛliya ka ti yo suhupiɛlli vuri m-paɣi ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ!.
en: Come, lets sing out loud to the LORD! Lets raise a joyful shout to the rock of our salvation!.

dag: N yi lih a ni nam sagban shɛŋa ŋɔ, ka lihi goli mini saŋmar shɛb a ni nam ŋɔ.
en: I look at the heavens you made with your hands. I see the moon and the stars you created.

dag: Ka Musa daa siɣina, ka boli Izraɛl kpamba na nti yɛli ba Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o yɛli ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: So Moses went down and called the leaders of the people together and told them everything that the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl bɔh o, Ya ka a dabili ŋun nyɛ baa ŋɔ yɛn nya yiko n-tum tuun karili ŋɔ! Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ kahigi wuhi ma ni a ni ti leei Siria naa.
en: Hazael said, I am not a powerful man! How can I do these great things? Elisha answered, The Lord showed me that you will be king over Aram.

dag: ka Zimiri daa kana nti ŋme o luhi ku o; ka daa di nam zan o zaani. Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa.
en: Zimri entered the house, assassinated Elah, and succeeded him as king. This happened in the twenty-seventh year of the reign of King Asa of Judah.

dag: Ti Duuma kul yɛn zaɣisi ti mi pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani ka kul ku lan niŋ ti nirilim sahakam?.
en: I wondered, Has our Lord rejected us forever? Will he ever accept us again?.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa yɛl o niriba, Zaŋmiya maligumaaniba shɛb yi ni daa ʒi nimaani na la yino n-labisi ni, ka o ti be nimaani wuhiri ba tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu.
en: So Assyrias king commanded, Return one of the priests that you exiled from there. He should go back and live there. He should teach them the religious practices of the local god.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: because no one knows what will happen, and no one can say when something might happen.

dag: Yi ni tooi chɛ ka nandaamba birim bɛ nia lɔbu ni, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Evildoers frustrate the plans of the humble, but the Lord is their protection.

dag: Rubin zuliya tintariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Juda zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Reuben from the eastern border to the western border: Judah, one portion.

dag: Chamiya ti zani Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni n-yɛli niriba nyɛvil palli ŋɔ yɛla zaa.
en: Go and stand in the Temple area. Tell the people everything about this new life.

dag: ka kuhi pam kaman gbuɣinli ni yi ŋum shɛm la. O ni daa kuhi maa, ka satahins ayopɔin tahi.
en: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni so pun nya m Ba maa; naɣila ŋun yi ŋun Naawuni sanna la n-naɣ nyɛ ŋun nya o.
en: This does not mean that anyone has seen the Father; he who is from God is the only one who has seen the Father.

dag: Dama bɛ yihi ba la Izraɛlnim puuni n-zaŋ ba ti ma zaa ka n deei ba leei n ni su shɛba, ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba.
en: The Israelites will give me the Levites. They will belong to me. In the past I told every Israelite family to give me their firstborn son. But now I am taking the Levites in place of these firstborn sons from the other families in Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ba chaŋ Babilɔn maa nyaaŋa ka Jɛkɔnia daa dɔɣi Shialtiɛl, ka Shialtiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛrubabɛl ba.
en: After they were taken to Babylon: Jehoiachin was the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel was the grandfather of Zerubbabel.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: He said to them, Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar and to God what belongs to God.

dag: Amaa dunia ŋɔ ni ti leei tiŋgban nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: But the earth will become a desert because of the wickedness of those who live on it.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka saa maa mini sakuɣa ni satahinsi maa zaa naai maa, ka o daa lan gbaai taali tumbu yaha, o min o kpamba maa daa lan niŋ tipawumli.
en: When the king realized that the storm was over, he disobeyed once more. He and his officials were so stubborn.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka paɣ maa daa nya ka o bia maa viɛli pam, ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣiri hal ni chira ata.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a baby boy. The mother saw how beautiful the baby was and hid him for three months.

dag: N nyɛvili kul bela barina ni sahakam, amaa m bi tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.

dag: Ka yi yi mali yi bina m-paŋdila ninvuɣ shɛb yi ni tɛhiri ni yi ti lan dee li bɛ sani yaha, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba paŋdila bɛ daalahichilan taba ni bɛ ti lan deei bɛ ni paŋ ba shɛm maa tariga.
en: If you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, why should you be commended? Even sinners lend to sinners expecting to be paid back in full.

dag: O daa wuhi ba: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli n dan Iso shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A dabili Yaakubu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N daa chaŋ ti bela Leeban sani hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ.
en: He told them, Tell this to my master Esau: Your servant Jacob says, I have lived with Laban all these years.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nɛmi kaman wuntaŋa ka be kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la. Ŋuna n-niŋdi ti nirilim ka chɛ ka niriba tiri ti jilima. Yawɛ bi mɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi binsuma.
en: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn doli chaŋ ti tuhi ba? Ka Jɛhɔram garigi yɛl o, Ti yɛn dolila Ɛdom yɔɣu polo chaŋ.
en: Jehoshaphat asked Joram, Which way should we go? Joram answered, We should go through the desert of Edom.

dag: Wula ka ninvuɣ yino ni tooi kari doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka niriba ayi mi tuhi nyaŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pia, ka pa ni bɛ Tampiŋ n-kɔhi ba? Ka pa ni Yawɛ n-zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni?.
en: Why were a thousand defeated by one, and ten thousand by only two? The Lord , their God, had abandoned them; their mighty God had given them up.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa bɔhi ba, Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yi shiri zaɣisi n wun la mini n ni mali salima binnan shɛli zal la jɛmbu?.
en: Nebuchadnezzar said to them: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego: Is it true that you dont serve my gods or worship the gold statue Ive set up?.

dag: Dama o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim na bela o ni. O daa kpaai li pala tampiŋ zuɣu. O daa bi kpaai li bahi tiŋa ni o niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: There was murder in the city, but the blood was not spilled on the ground where the dust could hide it; it was spilled on a bare rock.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ sahakam mali alibarika, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu kpɛma ni nya mbusim.
en: People who respect others will be blessed, but stubborn people will have plenty of troubles.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb yihiri Masia yɛla waazu la nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zuɣu, amaa ka shɛb mi yihiri li la dalir suŋ zuɣu.
en: Some people are telling the message about Christ because they are jealous and bitter. Others do it because they want to help.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun be o ko nyɛla ŋun kul niŋd o ni bɔri shɛli, ka o nini bi tiɣiri shɛb ni tumdi din tuhi ka di viɛli shɛm.
en: Some people like to do things their own way, and they get upset when people give them advice.

dag: Jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla fiɛbiga n-fiɛbiri bɛ yaansi zuɣu, amaa yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa n-gbibi ba.
en: Pride sprouts in the mouth of a fool, but the lips of the wise protect them.

dag: Di kumdiya ŋun kpi zuɣu bee n-fabindi o zuɣu. Amaa lee kummiyala bɛ ni gbaai so chaŋ zuɣu, dama o ku lan labina ka o nini ti nya o tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: People of Judah, do not weep for King Josiah; do not mourn his death. But weep bitterly for Joahaz, his son; they are taking him away, never to return, never again to see the land where he was born.

dag: Ka o gba ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: The messenger responded to me: Dont you know what these are? I said, No, sir. I dont.

dag: Ka Iso daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka n ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa daliri lee nyɛla dini? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N zaŋ ba mi na ni n ti ti a m-maai nyini n dan suhu.
en: Esau asked, What about that other group I met? What did that mean? Jacob answered, It was to gain your favor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa ku ti ka lo ni o kpihim ti birili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa maa.
en: Okay then, they said to the king. That man who opposed and oppressed us, who planned to destroy us, keeping us from having a place to live anywhere in Israel.

dag: Dama nir yi nya o dindana ŋ-ŋɔ, o ni chɛ o ni alaafee? Dinzuɣu a ni niŋ ma shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, Yawɛ ni yo a sam viɛlli.
en: How often does someone catch an enemy and then let him get away unharmed? The Lord bless you for what you have done to me today!.

dag: M bi ʒiini ninvuɣ yoya sani, bee ka m mini bilikɔɣinim ti mali jina ni taba.
en: I do not keep company with worthless people; I have nothing to do with hypocrites.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bɛrishiiba ni Biziɔtia.
en: Hazar-shual, Beer-sheba and its dependent cities.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, litaafi shɛli n ni daa tuui sab la wuhirila Yisa ni daa piligi wuhiri niriba ka tumdi shɛm.
en: Theophilus, the first scroll I wrote concerned everything Jesus did and taught from the beginning.

dag: Yi yi ti daai yi dimnim pihi luhi ka ku ba dahin shɛli, kom ni ti zɔri yiri zoya din du pam mini kuŋkuna din du pam zaa ni na.
en: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.

dag: N kuhimi ka n nina mɔhi, ka zibisim titali limsi n niŋkari.
en: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes.

dag: a ni daa zaŋ a nudirigu sa wain ti shɛl la. Amaŋmaŋ ni daa sa wain ti pol shɛli la.
en: this root that you planted with your strong hand, this son whom you secured as your very own.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni pam, dama lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn tuhi yi dimnim shɛb zaa.
en: Then Joshua said to his men, Be strong and brave! Dont be afraid. I will show you what the Lord will do to all the enemies you will fight in the future.

dag: Amaa do so ŋun gbib omaŋa ka di bi muɣis o ni o lo amiliya, ka o lo omaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni o ku lo bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti o amiliya, o niŋ din viɛla.
en: But it is better to have self-control and to make up your mind not to marry.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ nayil guliba kpɛm Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa la sani nti zaŋ yɛm yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣis o.
en: Then Daniel, with wisdom and sound judgment, responded to Arioch the kings chief executioner, who had gone out to kill Babylons sages.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa la sani ti yɛl o, Ti suhir a, chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni gari kuli ti ya.
en: Then the Israelites sent messengers to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon, and asked him for permission to go through his country to their own land.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti bɔri ni yi nya Daadam Bia saha ŋɔ dabisili zaɣ yini gba, ka ku nya li.
en: Then Jesus said to his followers, The time will come when you will want very much to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not be able to.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti yi n-chaŋ o sani tin tariga maa ha nti pah o zuɣu di vi.
en: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.

dag: ka yipa zaŋla biɛr palli kpɛhi yi ni, Dina n-nyɛ: Biɛr pal shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ di namda la ni zaŋd omaŋmaŋ ŋmahinli n-kul lɛbigiri li zaɣ palli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ŋun Naawuni la.
en: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Yɛhudia ninvuɣ so sunsuuni bɛ ni paɣibu kali dolibu zuɣu.
en: A debate started between Johns disciples and a certain Jew about cleansing rituals.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti kana ti ʒi oki tia din daa be Ofira ka nyɛ Jɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Abiɛza zuliya ni nir ni su shɛl la gbini. Ka o bia Gidiɔn daa sɔɣi be nimaani wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni buri alikama ka bi bɔri ni Midiannim nya o.
en: Then the LORDs messenger came and sat under the oak at Ophrah that belonged to Joash the Abiezrite. His son Gideon was threshing wheat in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛligu zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda pahi.
en: Many more people became believers because of the things he said.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha n-niŋ yomyom chaŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa gbini.
en: The next morning, King Darius got up just as it was getting light and ran to the lions den.

dag: Amaa di ni chɛri ka daadamnim tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni doo kam mal o dahalali paɣa, ka paɣ kam mi mal o dahalali yidana.
en: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zooi lim zoya maa, ka di ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita ayopɔin zoya maa zuɣu.
en: The water continued to rise above the mountains. The water was more than feet above the highest mountain.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa yaha, Yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni n-teei li tiri kulibɔna mini ko soya ni kopurim ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti n-yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Tell Aaron to hold out his walking stick over the rivers, the canals, and the pools, and make frogs come up and cover the land of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yɛligu din kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yɛligu maa nyɛla lahibal suŋ molomooniba ni tahi shɛl na ti tin ya.
en: but the word of the Lord remains forever. This word is the Good News that was proclaimed to you.

dag: Miriya ka yi wum Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya shɛm maa; dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Timmiya sandaani niŋ ma, ka yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi diri yimaŋmaŋ wain tihi mini yi fiig tihi wala, ka nyuri yimaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi kom.
en: Stop listening to Hezekiah! Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la, Ŋunkam kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi.
en: All who call on the Lords name will be saved. .

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka ŋmaligi yɛli wain tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Then the trees said to the vine, Come and be our king.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli Neetan, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa simdila kubu.
en: David became very angry at the rich man and said, I swear by the living Lord that the man who did this ought to die!.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka n daa galim nanim mini zuɣulaannima n-yɛli ba, Yi zaa deeri binyɛra nyɔri yimaŋmaŋ niriba sani. Ka n daa laɣim salo pam na ni ti ti baŋ ti ni yɛn niŋ yɛlli maa shɛm.
en: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, How can you charge your own people interest? Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders.

dag: Ka Farisiinim bɔh o, Nyama! Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: So the Pharisees said to Jesus, Look, it is against our Law for your disciples to do that on the Sabbath.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila, ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni dawulɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka piɛbiri kikahi n-wari waa ni bɛ yaa zaa Naawuni tooni.
en: David and all the Israelites were celebrating before God. They were praising God and singing songs. They were playing harps, lyres, drums, cymbals, and trumpets.

dag: Kul sɔŋm ma, dama m piila a zaligunima.
en: Let your power help me because I have chosen your precepts.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka zuɣusaa paɣ a daalahiziba tuma, ka chɛ ka a ʒiɛyimtali kul be a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Our Lord , let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.

dag: N daa bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛŋa din ni sɔŋ ya, amaa ka daa zaŋ li wuhi ya niriba ni mini yili kam ni.
en: You know I held back nothing that would be helpful so that I could proclaim to you and teach you both publicly and privately in your homes.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli, N ni birigi chaŋ ti nya lahizibu din chɛ ka buɣim maa bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: So he decided to go closer to the bush and see how a bush could continue burning without being burned up.

dag: Yi ni sɔɣ yɛli shɛlikam zibisim ni ni ti yi neesim ni; ka yi ni sɔɣ ŋumsi shɛli duu puuni, bɛ ni mol li gili luɣilikam.
en: Therefore, whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light, and whatever you have whispered in the rooms deep inside the house will be announced from the rooftops.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛrusalɛm Naa Adɔnizɛdɛk daa tim ti yɛli Hiburɔn Naa Hɔham mini Jarimut naa Piram ni Lakishi Naa Jafia ni Ɛgilɔn Naa Dɛbir.
en: King Adoni Zedek of Jerusalem talked with King Hoham of Hebron. He also talked with King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The king of Jerusalem begged these men.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi jiɣindi situra zuɣu? Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda, di mi bi miri gumdi.
en: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.

dag: Teeku dulinim nyaya ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ kab laɣimna.
en: People along the coast saw this, and they were frightened. Nations at the ends of the earth shook with fear. They have come near. They have arrived.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa suug o koyuli maa na yomyom gbibi ka yɛl o, N dana, nyuma.
en: She said, Drink, sir, and quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga n-yo suhupiɛlli vuri paɣ o!.
en: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.

dag: ka tulim maa daa kpe daadamnim pam hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni ŋun su alɔbo balibu kam maa fukumsi la, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba n-ti o jilima.
en: The people were burned by the great heat. They cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues. But they refused to change their hearts and lives and give glory to God.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Karimba, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Teacher, what is the greatest commandment in the Law.

dag: Di saha ka Stiivin daa yɛli, Nyamiya, n nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Daadam Bia la ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: Look! he said. I see heaven opened and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God.

dag: Ka naa lan bɔhi ba, Ka ŋuni n-lee be zɔŋ ni? Di saha maa ka Haman mi daa kpɛna ti ʒe zɔŋ ni. O daa kamina ni o ti yɛli naa ka o bah o noli ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Mɔdɛkai ti yili gar da shɛli o ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ sa n-zal la.
en: Who is that out in the courtyard? the king asked.

dag: ni Ɛliɛl ŋun daa yi Mahava na la ni Jɛribai mini Jɔshavia bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛlnaam bihi la ni Itima ŋun daa yi Mɔab na la.
en: Eliel the Mahavite; Jeribai and Joshaviah, Elnaams sons; Ithmah the Moabite.

dag: Ŋuni ka yi lee yɛn zaŋ ma buɣisi ka nya ka m min o saɣi? So beni ŋ-ŋmani ma?.
en: To whom will you liken me and count me equal and compare me so that we are alike?.

dag: ka o daa niŋ omaŋmaŋ ni pun lo shɛm, ka kahigi ashili nia shɛli o ni pun lo ni o pal li Masia zuɣu la wuhi ti.
en: God did what he had purposed, and made known to us the secret plan he had already decided to complete by means of Christ.

dag: O daa niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ naani, ka so daa ka Juda nanim zaa ni bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman o.
en: Hezekiah trusted in the Lord , the God of Israel. There was no one like Hezekiah among all the kings of Judah before him or after him.

dag: Hal o bi dih o tumtumdib tabili, o nyar o malaikanim chirimbu.
en: God does not trust his heavenly servants; he finds fault even with his angels.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma kaman Yawɛ ni daa tim o ka o ti tum tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-jɛndi Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa la.
en: The Lord sent Moses to do powerful miracles in the land of Egypt. Pharaoh, all his officers, and all the people in Egypt saw those miracles.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ; nyamiya, ŋun yi n nyaaŋa maa paana.
en: Stand up! We must go. Here comes the man who is handing me over to them.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin cham ti wuh o o taali maa a min o kɔŋko. O yi deeg o galimi, a zaŋ o labisi yi mabiligu maa puuni yaha m-bala.
en: If your brother sins against you, go to him and show him his fault. But do it privately, just between yourselves. If he listens to you, you have won your brother back.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni daanfaani; ka miriya ka yi chɛ ka putɔɣu kpe yi ni so ni n-zooi muɣisi ya ka ta yi ni shɛb daɣiri.
en: Make sure that no one misses out on Gods grace. Make sure that no root of bitterness grows up that might cause trouble and pollute many people.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli Ziɔn Zoli, amaa niriba ni no n-taai Mɔabnima kaman bɛ ni nɔri mɔri niŋdi kulim bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: The LORDs hand will indeed rest on this mountain. Moab will be trampled down as straw is trampled into manure.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma ti niriba ŋɔ bee n-kum bee n-zani bɛ zaani suhi ma, dama bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma bɛ muɣisigu saha, n ku garigi ba.
en: As for you, dont pray for these people, dont cry out or plead for them, for I wont listen when they cry out to me on account of their distress.

dag: Bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o ninni nyaɣisiri kaman wuntaŋ la, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: As they looked on, a change came over Jesus: his face was shining like the sun, and his clothes were dazzling white.

dag: Amaa Kɔra zuliya bɛn daa bi kpi.
en: But the other people who were from the family of Korah did not die.

dag: A mi saha shɛli bɛ ni dooni dɔɣiri bɛ bihi? Ka a mi saha shɛli bɛ bihi maa ni yirina?.
en: before they deliver?.

dag: Niriba biɛla bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya maa ni ti lab bɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sanna.
en: A few will return, whats left of Jacob, to the mighty God.

dag: Yi ni ti di biŋkpam hal ti tiɣi, ka nyu ʒim hal ti buɣi sara maligu chu shɛli shili n ni maani tiri ya maa ni.
en: You can eat all the fat you want and drink blood until you are full. You will eat and drink from my sacrifice, which I will kill for you.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛl o mi, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yɛlim Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa n ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa.
en: He said, I am the Lord . Tell the king of Egypt everything I tell you.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya, ka wain dii bi lan nyara, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli liɣi ʒini.
en: The wine dries up; the vine withers; all the merry-hearted groan.

dag: n-daa ti yi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ kuli Antiɔk, luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni ni bɛ tum bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛli naai maa la.
en: and from there they sailed back to Antioch, the place where they had been commended to the care of God's grace for the work they had now completed.
