dag: Amaa n nahindila n niŋgbuŋ ni n nyaŋ li su, dama di yi pa lala, n ni yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti niriba ŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naawuni ni ti daai ma baɣili kpaŋa.
en: I harden my body with blows and bring it under complete control, to keep myself from being disqualified after having called others to the contest.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lab ti Dauda suɣili din daa lu la zali. N ni ti mali di luɣ shɛŋa din daa saɣim la zaa, ka ti li zali ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la;.
en: On that day I will raise up the meeting tent of David that has fallen, and repair its broken places. I will raise up its ruins, and I will rebuild it like a long time ago.

dag: Zoya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la? Daboya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la?.
en: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa ni na. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: but there was still a sound coming from above the dome over their heads.

dag: Bundan maa daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam.
en: The rich man had a lot of sheep and cattle.

dag: Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di niŋ zina, a nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zina? Nyin ŋun je buɣa, a nyɛla ŋun zuri buɣa jɛmbu duu nɛma?.
en: You say they must not commit adultery, but you yourself are guilty of that sin. You hate idols, but you steal them from their temples.

dag: Bɛ yi di mali yɛm, bɛ naan baŋ dimbɔŋɔ. Bɛ naan baŋ di bahigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: If you did, you could see where you are headed.

dag: Di ti piniya yi tapaɣisi kɔbiri bee n-kɔrisi taɣi yi teeŋkɔbiri.
en: You must not cut off the hair on your forehead or clip the ends of your beard.

dag: Yisa ni daa pun mi binshɛɣukam zaa din yɛn niŋ o maa zuɣu ka o daa chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra.
en: Jesus knew everything that was to happen to him, so he went out and asked, Who are you looking for.

dag: Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deeri la mani; ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma, pa mani ka o deera, amaa ŋun tim ma na ka o deera.
en: Whoever accepts children like these in my name is accepting me. And anyone who accepts me is also accepting the one who sent me.

dag: amaa yi zuɣu di niŋ ma nyaɣisim n ni daa ka nimaani maa zuɣu, dama dina n-ni chɛ ka yi niŋ yɛda. Ka yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ o sani.
en: And I am glad I was not there. I am happy for you because now you will believe in me. We will go to him now.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli, N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, amaa di chaŋya katiŋ ti yaɣi. Suhimiya Naawuni ti ma.
en: So Pharaoh said, Ill let you go to offer sacrifices to the LORD your God in the desert, provided you dont go too far away and you pray for me.

dag: Gala tumbu ŋmanila diɛma jɛrigu sani, amaa yɛm biɛhigu niŋdila tɛhi zilimalan nyaɣisim.
en: Fools enjoy vile deeds, but those with understanding take pleasure in wisdom.

dag: O zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti o niriba n-wuhi ba o yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: Do not worship any god except me.

dag: N daa bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ashilɔni bee bumbɔn ni. N daa bi yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom ma luɣ shɛli din ka nyam shee. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, ka wuhiri din tuhi.
en: I didnt speak in secret or in some land of darkness; I didnt say to the offspring of Jacob, Seek me in chaos. I am the LORD, the one who speaks truth, who announces what is correct.

dag: Dama yi tam yi Naawuni ŋun tiligi ya, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe n-taɣi ya kaman tampiŋ din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛla. Dinzuɣu ka yi sa tihi ni yi jɛmdi tinzun wuna.
en: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.

dag: Bɛ mi ma ka di yuui, ka hal bɛ yi ni saɣi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mi ni n daa doli Farisiinim daadiini soli din dolibu kpɛm pam la.
en: They have known me for a long time. If they wanted to, they could testify that I followed the way of life set out by the most exacting group of our religion. I am a Pharisee.

dag: Zaŋmiya jilima din simdi Yawɛ yuli ti o. Zaŋmiya pina tah o sanna, Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni tibiginsim din be kasi.
en: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple. Worship the Lord , majestic and holy.

dag: Amaa ti malimiya li la luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ni yi jɛmd o nimaani kɔŋko, ka yi ni ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa zaawuni wuntan luhili saha, yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la saha.
en: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.

dag: N daa laɣisi anzinfa mini salima ni nanim azichi na ti puli, ka su tiŋgbana. N daa mali baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka daa mali mamanim pam n-di niŋgbuŋ nyaɣisim.
en: I amassed silver and gold for myself, the treasures of kings and provinces. I acquired male and female singers for myself, along with every human luxury, treasure chests galore!.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Bihi laamba di wain tiwala din miha, ka bihi nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: When that time comes, people will no longer say, The parents ate the sour grapes, But the children got the sour taste.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlima, kpiimba ni ti doya kaman naɣibina n-do mɔɣu ni la, bee kaman chi ni dɔndo kachɛriba nyaaŋa shɛm la, ka so ti ku kpuɣi ba.
en: Dead bodies are scattered everywhere, like piles of manure on the fields, like grain cut and left behind by the reapers, grain that no one gathers. This is what the Lord has told me to say.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zoya ŋɔ nim zaa zaŋ takɔbiri ti lu Gɔg zuɣu. O tɔbbihi ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: The Lord GOD says, On the mountains of Israel, I will call for every kind of terror against Gog. His soldiers will be so afraid that they will attack each other and kill each other with their swords.

dag: Bɛtazimavɛtnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinahinaayi.
en: of Beth-azmaveth.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali di firilanim ayopɔin mini di buɣim kpihiri bina ni di buɣim moori bina.
en: The lamp and its equipment, including the tongs and trays, were made of about kilograms of pure gold.

dag: N ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ, yi pa leela ŋmɛnditoya duu yi sani? Yawɛ yɛliya, N kul pala nina lihiri ya.
en: Do you regard this temple, which bears my name, as a hiding place for criminals? I can see whats going on here, declares the LORD.

dag: Lala ka o daa me buɣa jɛmbu shee ti o tinzun paɣiba la zaa, ka bɛ daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani bɛ buɣa maa, ka tuɣindi li tulaale zim.
en: In fact, he built a shrine for each of his foreign wives, so all of them could burn incense and offer sacrifices to their own gods.

dag: Siria naa daa ti lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa niŋ o sapashinnim saawara, yɛli, Luɣili yaakaza ka n yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni.
en: Arams king was fighting against Israel. He took counsel with his officers, saying, Ill camp at such-and-such a place.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alikauli zaligu kundi la na ti karim li ka niriba maa wum ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li, ka deeg o noli.
en: Moses read the scroll with the special agreement written on it. He read the agreement so that all the people could hear him. And the people said, We have heard the laws that the Lord has given us. And we agree to obey them.

dag: ka a zuliya ni ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka yi ni yɛligi kpa wulinluhili polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a min a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: You will have as many descendants as there are particles of dust on the earth. They will spread east and west, north and south. All the families on earth will be blessed because of you and your descendants.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ŋunkam yuli bi sabi nyɛvili litaafi la ni gba bahi buɣim teeku maa ni.
en: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

dag: Izraɛlnim gula, wummi ti suhigu; nyin ŋun mali Yisifu zuliya chani kaman piɛri la, wummi ti suhigu. Nyin ŋun ʒi a nam ʒiishee din be chɛrubinim zuɣu la, chɛ ka a neesim neei.
en: Shepherd of Israel, listen! You, the one who leads Joseph as if he were a sheep. You, who are enthroned upon the winged heavenly creatures. Show yourself.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o puli zuɣu suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini.
en: Then he went a short distance farther and fell on his face and prayed, My Father, if its possible, take this cup of suffering away from me. However—not what I want but what you want.

dag: Bɛ daa kul mɛri bɛ ni jɛmdi Baal luɣ shɛŋa n-zaŋdi bɛ bihi nyɔri buɣim maani maligu tiri Baal, ka di pa n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋdi shɛm, ka di tɛha mi na ʒi n-kpe n suhu ni.
en: Yes, they have built shrines to Baal, to burn their sons and daughters in the fire, although I never commanded or ordered such a thing, nor did it ever cross my mind.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ zaa daa bela Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: This is the tribal land, and these are the towns and villages of the Zebulun clans.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman bɛn mali fahim; yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n shia siɣi Izraɛlnim zuɣu na, ka n ku lan ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will pour out my Spirit on the family of Israel, and I will never turn away from my people again. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya yi bihi maa, Ti daa nyɛla Firawuna daba be Ijipti, amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa yihi ti Ijipti maa na.
en: Then tell them, We were slaves of the king of Egypt, and the Lord rescued us by his great power.

dag: A dol a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la. Yɛlimaŋli, a zaŋ a nuu tum tuma m-pal a ni daa yaag a noli yɛli shɛm maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: This is the covenant you kept with your servant David, my father, which you promised him. Today, you have fulfilled what you promised.

dag: Yisa daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba biɛɣukam, amaa ka daa lee duri Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu ti gbɛri yuŋ kam.
en: Jesus taught in the temple each day, and he spent each night on the Mount of Olives.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, di kuhiriya n zuɣu, amaa kuhimiyala yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: Jesus turned to them and said, Women of Jerusalem! Don't cry for me, but for yourselves and your children.

dag: Bina anahi yɛla n-niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: Three things are too wonderful for me, four that I cant figure out.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o bidibbina maa ti o bia maa ka yɛl o, Zaŋmi li kuli yiŋa.
en: Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and told him, Take these back into town.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim yi yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ maŋli lan kani. Bɛ zaa domi gu ni bɛ ku niriba, ka zaŋ lansi gbahiri taba.
en: Faithful ones have perished from the land; there is no righteous one among humanity. All of them lie in wait for bloodshed; they hunt each other with nets.

dag: M min a n-simdi lala, dama tinim tuma nyɔri ka ti diri ŋɔ; amaa ŋun bi tum taal shɛli.
en: You and I are guilty. We deserve to die because we did wrong. But this man has done nothing wrong.

dag: Yisa alizanda ni labbu saha ni daa ti miri, o daa lo nia ni o chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The time was coming near when Jesus would leave and go back to heaven. He decided to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa zahim nya ka o ku tooi yihi ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa ni, ka nya ka bɛ maan piligirila duŋ taabu maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ kom paɣ o nuhi salo maa ninni ka yɛli, N nuu ka doo ŋun ka taali ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni. Yi yɛla m-bala.
en: Pilate saw that there was nothing he could do and that the people were starting to riot. So he took some water and washed his hands in front of them and said, I won't have anything to do with killing this man. You are the ones doing it.

dag: M bɔri ni a baŋ ni n ni be a sani, ka gbib a luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ, ka ni ti zaŋ a labisi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni na. Dama n kul ku chɛ a hal ti niŋ n ni lo a alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm maa.
en: Wherever you go, I will watch over you, then later I will bring you back to this land. I won't leave you—I will do all I have promised.

dag: Amaa ka yi chɛ ka Nazarinim maa nyuri wain, ka yɛri anabinima ni bɛ miri ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: But you made the nazirites drink wine, and commanded the prophets, saying, You wont prophesy.

dag: n-zaŋ a vilivili labi pal yaɣu ni kaman bolli la. Ka a kpi nimaani ka chɛ a chɛchɛbun shɛŋa a ni mali nyuri bara maa bahi nimaani. A nyɛla ŋun dih a dan yiŋ vi!.
en: He will pick you up like a ball and throw you into a much larger country. You will die there beside the chariots you were so proud of. You are a disgrace to your master's household.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ zaa la Firawuna ninni, amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Now Moses and Aaron did all these amazing acts in front of Pharaoh, but the LORD made Pharaoh stubborn so that he didnt let the Israelites go from his land.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti maa? Di pa shɛli ka yaŋɔnim ni so di zaŋ a paɣ maa dɔni. A naan chɛ ka di taali ʒin ti zuɣu.
en: Don't you know what you've done? Abimelech exclaimed. If someone had slept with her, you would have made our whole nation guilty.

dag: Ka ti mi yi yihi yɛli ni ti bi tum alahichi, dindina ti zaŋ Naawuni leela ʒirilana, ka o yɛligu ka ti ni.
en: If we say that we have not sinned, we make a liar out of God, and his word is not in us.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tuuya, ka Juda lu, dama bɛ yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ tuma bi viɛli Yawɛ sani; bɛ turila Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: Yes, Jerusalem has stumbled and Judah has fallen, because the way they talk and act in word and deed insults the LORD, defying his brilliant glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni diri ka nyura bee binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni niŋda, niŋmiya li ka di tiri Naawuni jilima.
en: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina shee n zuɣu, ka m puhiri ba pam di zuɣu, ka di pala n kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim cheechinim zaa gba puhiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They risked their own lives to save mine. I am thankful to them, and all the non-Jewish churches are thankful to them.

dag: O daa tim o yɛligu na ti tib ba, ka daa yihi ba kum ni.
en: He healed them with his command and saved them from the grave.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya sani. Wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm ka kana ti tiligi ti!.
en: Shepherd of Israel, show your greatness to the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Come and save your people.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinim.
en: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites.

dag: O daa bi tum tuun kara pam nimaani, bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu.
en: And because the people did not have any faith, Jesus did not work many miracles there.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka Naawuni deeg o suhigu Aruna Jɛbusi nir maa kabɔɣili maa ni maa, ka o daa mali sara nimaani.
en: David saw that the Lord had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah, so David offered sacrifices there.

dag: Di ŋubiya bɛ nimdi, yi mi di shihiya bɛ zaɣ kpima. Bɛ nyɛla daɣiri bina yi sani.
en: Do not eat these animals or even touch their dead bodies; they are unclean.

dag: N dana, daŋmi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ tooni, ka m mali biŋkɔbiri maa mini bihi maa chani biɛlabiɛla na hal ti paag a Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Why don't you go on ahead and let me travel along slowly with the children, the herds, and the flocks. We can meet again in the country of Edom.

dag: So miri ka o ti chɛ ka o bipuɣiŋga leei pagɔrili n-dih o vi, di yi pa lala, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti leei pagɔra tiŋgbɔŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali pali di ni.
en: Do not dishonor your daughters by making them become prostitutes. If you do that, your whole country will turn away from God and be filled with all kinds of sinful things.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ m mali suhupiɛlli n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu ŋɔ puuni; dama n ni diri wahala shɛŋa maa nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ naai wahala shɛŋa din kpalim ka nyɛ Masia ni daa diri shɛl o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ cheechi la zuɣu la.
en: Now Im happy to be suffering for you. Im completing what is missing from Christs sufferings with my own body. Im doing this for the sake of his body, which is the church.

dag: ka ti wum salo ni garita ka o bɔhi, Bɔ n-lee niŋdi maa.
en: When the man heard the crowd passing by, he asked what was happening.

dag: Naɣ kara bɛba ayopɔin la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kar ayopɔin la gba gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin; zahindi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The seven healthy cows are seven years, and the seven healthy ears of grain are seven years. Its actually one dream.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni ka yiɣisi kuli.
en: Jacob blessed Pharaoh and left Pharaohs presence.

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa naai, o daa chaŋ ti dula daboli zuɣu.
en: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the place of worship.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli ti ni daa kul chɛ alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa malibu, ka bi lan boori kom bahir o, ti daa lan ka binshɛli, ka tɔbu mini kum kuri ti.
en: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the queen of heaven and pouring drink offerings to her, we have been destroyed by the sword and by famine.

dag: Yisa daa ti be soli n-chani Jɛrusalɛm ka daa ti zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi la yi kpaŋa nti yɛli ba.
en: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the Twelve aside by themselves on the road. He told them.

dag: Man Daniɛl kɔŋko n-daa nya ʒii maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani bɛn daa bi nya li, amaa ka dabiɛm lee gbahi ba pam ka bɛ zo nti sɔɣi.
en: I was the only one who saw the vision. Those who were with me did not see anything, but they were terrified and ran and hid.

dag: Di saha chɛrubinim maa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nudirigu polo, doo maa ni daa chaŋ ti kpe di ni saha shɛli maa. Ka sagbani daa pali di puuni dundɔŋ la ni.
en: The Cherub angels were standing in the area south of the Temple as the man walked to them. The cloud filled the inner courtyard.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛtali yi suhuri ni ka tiligi. Nia biɛri maa kul yɛn bela yi ni sahakam?.
en: People of Jerusalem, wash the evil from your hearts. Make your hearts pure so that you can be saved. Dont continue making evil plans.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka noli di dunia, ka niriba bɛn be di ni di wahala bɛ taali zuɣu; ka di chɛ ka daadamnim kul filinda hal ka niriba biɛla nti kpalim.
en: So God has pronounced a curse on the earth. Its people are paying for what they have done. Fewer and fewer remain alive.

dag: A na mi n-chɛ ka biɛkaali neesim neei gili dunia zaa, n-kari ninvuɣ biɛri zaa di ni?.
en: Have you ordered the dawn to seize the earth and shake the wicked from their hiding places?.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ taali sanyoo sara piɛlaa maa mali sara Yawɛ tooni o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: The priest will use the ram for the compensation offering to make reconciliation for him before the LORD on account of the sin he committed. Then he will be forgiven of the sin that he committed.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka di shɛli kpalim ka biɛɣu neei paai li bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili. Bɛ doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa zaligu puhi li.
en: They must not leave any of it until morning, nor break any of its bones. They will keep the Passover according to all its regulations.

dag: Daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tusaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: The grand total of family heads in charge of these courageous warriors was twenty-six hundred.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka Mariama kumda, ka Yɛhudianim bɛn dol o na maa gba kumdi maa, ka o suhu saɣim pam, ka o siɣim.
en: When Jesus saw her crying and the Jews who had come with her crying also, he was deeply disturbed and troubled.

dag: N ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, dama bɛ tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa maligu zoya zuɣu, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. N shiri ni darigi bɛ tibili pam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: for their sins and the sins of their ancestors. They have burned incense at pagan hill shrines and spoken evil of me. So I will punish them as their past deeds deserve.

dag: O mi bi kpe di ni mi ni o ti zaŋd omaŋ maani maligu yuuni kam kaman maligumaaniba zuɣulana ni daa yi zaŋdi biŋkɔbigu ʒi shɛli din pa ŋun maŋmaŋ ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee nti maani maligu shɛm la.
en: He didnt enter to offer himself over and over again, like the high priest enters the earthly holy place every year with blood that isnt his.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nanim ni tum zina ni paɣ so, ka dunianim zaa nyu o zina maa wain n-kul la.
en: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni, di simdi ni yi bahi yi ni da Hiburu dab so kam ŋun tum yi tuma hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu ka o chaŋ. Di bi lan simdi ka yi chɛ ka bɛ tum yi tuma yaha. Amaa ka yi yaannim maa daa zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: As part of this agreement, you must let a Hebrew slave go free after six years of service. Your ancestors did not obey me.

dag: Hal Babilɔnnim yi du zuɣusaa ti me goondahi gili bɛmaŋa, n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba yi n sani chaŋ ti liri ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Babylon might grow until she touches the sky. Babylon might make her forts strong, but I will send people to fight against that city. And they will destroy her. This is what the Lord said.

dag: N kul ku nyari n niriba maa taali bee n yiɣisiri n suhu bahiri bɛ zuɣu sahakam, dama di yi nyɛ lala n ni ti bɛn ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛvili maa ni kpi.
en: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.

dag: Yɛndana niŋdila binshɛɣukam ni yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun wuhirila jɛrilim palo ni.
en: Sensible people always think before they act, but stupid people advertise their ignorance.

dag: Ka ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun bɔri ni a paŋ o binshɛli, nyin paŋm o.
en: Give to anyone who asks you for something. Dont refuse to give to anyone who wants to borrow from you.

dag: N yi nya jilima Firawuna min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ŋɔ zuɣu, di saha ka Ijiptinim maa ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I defeat them, the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di simdi ka di mali daanya daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tam binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi, amaa ban shɛŋa din yɛn yili daantalisi maa mini di dapuhi dina, zaŋmiya anzinfa mal li.
en: supported by twenty bronze posts in twenty bronze bases, with hooks and rods made of silver.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi bɛn daa kpalim yina, ka Yawɛ niriba daa yina ni bɛ ti tuhi wɔɣira ti o.
en: Then those who remained marched down against royalty; the LORDs people marched down against warriors.

dag: N yi ti gbarigi saha shɛli, a mi m biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ bari ma la tɔŋ n ni doli so shɛli zuɣu.
en: When I am ready to give up, he knows what I should do. In the path where I walk, my enemies have hidden a trap for me.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ŋahiba paɣ dɔni, o ŋahiba maa zaɣim ka o nya maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ku dɔɣi bia hal ti kpi.
en: If a man has sexual intercourse with his aunt, he has uncovered his uncles nakedness. The man and the aunt will be liable to punishment; they will die childless.

dag: Wula ka nir lee yɛn garigi yɛli Filistianim tuumba? Yawɛ m-me Ziɔn zali, ka o niriba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ni nya biɛhigu shee nimaani.
en: What will one say to that nations messengers? The LORD has founded Zion; the oppressed among Gods people will find refuge there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, chɛli paŋ ba, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛli maa gbinni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ n-tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they dont know what theyre doing. They drew lots as a way of dividing up his clothing.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm soya ni yiko din tuhiri tɔbu? Ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka mɔri ma maa?.
en: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?.

dag: N daamiliya, a naŋgbampiba tɔɣirila binnyuri nyaɣisili ka shiri mini bihim be a zilinli ni. A situra ʒiɛɣu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn ʒiɛɣu.
en: Sweetness drops from your lips, my bride; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa yɛl o ma, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a suhirila Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili maa n-tiri Adɔnija? Dindina suhim ma nam ŋɔ gba ti o; dama o nyɛla m biɛli, ka maligumaana Abiata mini Zɛruya bia Jɔab la be o polo.
en: King Solomon replied to his mother, Why ask only for Abishag from Shunem for Adonijah? Why not ask for the entire kingdom for him? After all, he is my older brother and has the support of Abiathar the priest and Joab, Zeruiahs son.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Isaka zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli, ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and towns were part of the land that was given to the tribe of Issachar. Each family got its part of the land.

dag: Di daa kul wum ma la yoli, buɣim maa ni daa bi yihi di ni din zahimzahim maa shɛm.
en: although all that corrosion will not disappear in the flames.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Ibrahimma daa ti lihi nya o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ka di be katiŋ ha.
en: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihita ni yini saha, ka Omri daa leei Izraɛl naa maa. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi. O daa diya ʒinila Tiriza yuma ayɔbu.
en: In the thirty-first year of Judahs King Asa, Omri became king of Israel. He ruled for twelve years, six of which were in Tirzah.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti bo so shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan nabi. Di yi pa lala ti mini ti dimnim yi ti yɛn tuhi, bɛ ni pahi ti dimnim maa zuɣu tuhi ti ka nya soli zo n-yi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: We must make plans to stop them from growing stronger. If there is a war, they might join our enemies, defeat us, and escape from the land.

dag: nti zaŋ kpa luɣuluɣu maa m-booi di ni kpam bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa; ka yooi dunoli n-zo n-yi, ka di niŋ zinchili.
en: Take the small bottle of oil and pour the oil on Jehus head. Say, This is what the Lord says: I have anointed you to be the new king over Israel. Then open the door and run away. Dont wait.

dag: Ka bɛ mini so daa bi lan tuhi tɔbu hal ti paai Asa nam dibu maa yuun pihitanaanu saha.
en: There was no more war until the th year of Asas rule.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yuya pun bi sabi niŋ Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku la nyɛvili litaafi la ni tun dunia piligu ni la ha ni ti jɛm biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: All who live on earth worshipped it, all whose names hadnt been written—from the time the earth was made—in the scroll of life of the Lamb who was slain.

dag: Ka yi yi zaŋ ŋumbɔŋɔ gba chaŋ, ka binshɛli ti niŋ o, yi ni chɛ ka n kpi ni n zab piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: and he said, I am an old man. If you take Benjamin from me, and something happens to him, I will die of a broken heart.

dag: Amaa buŋdibbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ni yi zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi tuuli bidibisi n-tiligi ba.
en: You can spare the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must spare every first-born son.

dag: Ti mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti, ti neei shɛlikam wuhi ya; ti yooi ti suhuri tin ya.
en: We have spoken freely to you people in Corinth. We have opened our hearts to you.

dag: Yawɛ je tuumbiɛtumdiba. O bɔri ni o kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But the LORDs face is set against those who do evil, to eliminate even the memory of them from the earth.

dag: N yi yɛli, N garo ni maai n suhu, n garibil ni chɛ ka n fabila naai;.
en: I go to bed, hoping for rest.

dag: M mi ni a ni chɛ ka n kpi n-kuli yili shɛli a ni zaŋ zali nyɛvililan kam la ni.
en: I know you are taking me off to my death, to the fate in store for everyone.

dag: ka daadam kam ti nya Naawuni tiliginsim. .
en: Then everyone will see how God will save his people! Isaiah :-.

dag: Ka naa Sulemaana mini Hiram ni Gɛba tumtumdiba daa kpe kuɣa, ka ŋma dakuɣiri m-mal li ni bɛ zaŋ me duu maa.
en: Solomon's and Hiram's workers and men from the city of Byblos prepared the stones and the timber to build the Temple.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ʒinimi tiŋa n-karim li ka ti wum. Ka Baruk daa karim li ka bɛ wum.
en: Sit down, they said, and read the scroll to us. So Baruch did.

dag: N yi dɔni tiŋa m bɔhirimi, Bɔ saha ka n lee yɛn yiɣisi? Amaa ka biɛɣu neebu wɔɣa. Ka n kul mali mmaŋ wolisiri hal ka biɛɣu ti miri neebu.
en: If I lie down and think—When will I get up?— night drags on, and restless thoughts fill me until dawn.

dag: Dinzuɣu n gba ni chɛ ka alɔbo din nyɛ bɛ ni zɔri shɛl la lu bɛ zuɣu. Dama n kuhi boli ba ka so bi saɣi, ka tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ka so bi saɣi wum li, amaa ka tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka niŋdi din bi piɛli n suhu.
en: So I too will choose to punish them, to bring horrors upon them, since I called and no one answered. I spoke and no one heard, but they did evil in my eyes. What I didnt want, they chose.

dag: ka nahindi nandaamba mini bɛn ka, ka fari niriba, ka bi labisiri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima o sani n-tiri bindaannima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka tumdi din chihira.
en: oppresses the poor and needy, robs others and doesnt fulfill his obligations, pays attention to the idols and does detestable things.

dag: Amaa o ni yɛli shɛm maa yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka shɛhira shɛli kani din wuhiri ni paɣisarili maa daa nyɛla ŋun pali.
en: But what the husband said about his wife might be true. The wifes parents might not have the proof that she was a virgin. If this happens.

dag: N nini nya n dimnim lubu; ka n tiba wum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn liriti ma azaaba nyabu kuhigu.
en: My eyes will see the defeat of those waiting to attack me. My ears will hear the cries of my evil enemies.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa daa yuri Dauda, dama ŋuna n-daa yi zaŋdi ba chani tɔb ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina.
en: But all the people in Israel and Judah loved David because he was out among them and led them into battle.

dag: Ka Maata yɛl o, M mi ni o ni ti neei kum ni zaadali.
en: Martha replied, I know that he will rise in the resurrection on the last day.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri jiɣindi shɛli zuɣu, amaa yi suhigu zaa puuni, yɛlimiya Naawuni yi ni bɔri shɛli, ka kul balimmiya Naawuni ni wumpaɣibo din yiri yi suhuri ni na.
en: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.

dag: Tim ti suhupiɛlli dabisi gbaliŋ kaman a ni daa chɛ ka ti nya suhugarigu shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paligi yuun gbaliŋ kaman ti ni daa nya zaɣ biɛɣu shɛm.
en: Give us now as much happiness as the sadness you gave us during all our years of misery.

dag: n-yiini wumpaɣibo yila pampam, ka yɛr a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I sing a song to give you thanks, and I tell about all the wonderful things you have done.

dag: Kummiya kaman paɣisar so ŋun so buɣu n-kumdi nachimbil so ŋun di yɛn lo o amiliya zuɣu la.
en: Cry, you people, like a young woman who mourns the death of the man she was going to marry.

dag: ka kpihim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani mɔpila zuɣu n-jɛmdi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi la ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani pɔri Yawɛ, amaa ka lan pɔri buɣili Milikom ŋɔ.
en: And those who go up on their roofs to worship the stars will be forgotten. They worship me, the Lord , but they also use the name of the false god Milcom to make promises.

dag: O chɛ ka Lɛbanɔn zoya yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman naɣibil la; ka chɛ ka Siriɔn Zoli gba yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman yɔnaɣila bil la.
en: He makes the mountains of Lebanon jump like calves and makes Mount Hermon leap like a young bull.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti yi n-chaŋ o sani tin tariga maa ha nti pah o zuɣu di vi.
en: Let us, then, go to him outside the camp and share his shame.

dag: Ka binnɛɔŋ balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, noonsi mini yiŋ biŋkɔbiri ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛn be dunia ni zaŋ tabili ninsalinim zaa.
en: Every creature took its last breath: the things crawling on the ground, birds, livestock, wild animals, everything swarming on the ground, and every human being.

dag: O yiɣis o suhu bahi n zuɣu, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tinzun tiŋ wuna din be bɛ sani zaa mini bɛ ni daa kpa tibikpar shɛŋa ti Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li sɔɣi ti shɛli din nyɛ oki tia din miri Shɛkɛm la gbini.
en: So the people gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had, and they gave him all the rings they were wearing in their ears. He buried everything under an oak tree near the town called Shechem.

dag: Yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to the Lord 's message, you descendants of Jacob, you tribes of Israel.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka sanʒiɛ tital shɛli bɛ ni booni pɔhim tilli la daa yiɣisi wulimpuhili duli polo ʒiɛrina.
en: But soon a strong wind called The Northeaster blew against us from the island.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ o ninkuunsi takɔb titali din mali kpiɔŋ la n-darigi Lɛviatan ŋun nyɛ waɣ so ŋun pɔripɔri ka yiɣiri la tibili; ka ku teeku ni biŋkɔb biɛɣu la.
en: At that time the Lord will judge Leviathan, the crooked snake. He will use his great sword, his hard and powerful sword, to punish Leviathan, that twisting, turning snake. He will kill the monster of the sea.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa daa niŋ Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm nyaɣisim pam.
en: Hamor and Shechem liked what was said.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa lu Jɔash suhu ni ni o lan malimali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: Then later on, Joash decided to rebuild the Lord s Temple.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti suh o, o ni deei yi suhigu, ka yi yi ti ŋme kuŋa m-bɔri sɔŋsim, o ni yɛli, M be kpe ni n sɔŋ ya. Yi yi ni ti yi ni nahindi shɛb la vuhim, ka chɛ niriba ansarisi malibu ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu;.
en: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry for help, and God will say, Im here. If you remove the yoke from among you, the finger-pointing, the wicked speech.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Listen, then, if you have ears!.

dag: M mabihi, fiig tia ni tooi wali olivi tia wala bee gaa ni tooi wali fiig tia wala? Lala ka ko nyaɣisili ku tooi yi ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ ni na.
en: My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree make olives? Or can a grapevine make figs? No, and a well full of salty water cannot give good water.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla pɔhim shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari lala. Mani n-kari ba saria pumpɔŋɔ maa.
en: the wind that comes at the Lord 's command will be much stronger than that! It is the Lord himself who is pronouncing judgment on his people.

dag: Pomiya pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka niŋya kaman yi ni po shɛm maa. Chɛliya ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kɔɣilikɔɣili la nim zaa zaŋ pina na ti ti ŋun nyɛ binzɔrigu maa.
en: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi tum din ni tiɣila omaŋmaŋ nini, amaa di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, zilim biɛ shɛŋa zaa niriba ni daa yɛr a la ʒinila n zuɣu.
en: Christ didnt please himself, but, as it is written, The insults of those who insulted you fell on me. .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu saha kanna ka bɛ ti ku lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The time is coming, says the Lord , when people will no longer swear by me as the living God who brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa niŋdi lala maa, bɛ daa nya ma ka m malila mmaŋa m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka salo bee duŋtaariba daa ka n sani hal ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la ti kana.
en: It was while I was doing this that they found me in the Temple after I had completed the ceremony of purification. There was no crowd with me and no disorder.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, n kul ʒiɛla n zaashee wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: Then one day the watchman called out, My master, every day I have been in the watchtower watching. Every night I have been standing on duty.

dag: ka Saimɔn Pita daa buɣisi yɛl o ni o wuhim ba Yisa ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.

dag: Amaa pu shɛŋa din be bɛ fɔntinsi maa tiŋgban ni, di bi simdi ka bɛ kɔhi dina, dama di nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli saha shɛlikam.
en: But the pasture land around the Levite cities shall never be sold; it is their property forever.

dag: ka daa lan nyɛ bɛn dari gindi tinsi, n-kpe zuliya shɛli ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe zuliya shɛli ni ni n-kpe na so tiŋ ni n-yi n-chaŋ ti kpe na so tiŋ ni maa zaa yoli.
en: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa deei Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa ka Yisa Masia mi tahi anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli na.
en: The Law was given by Moses, but Jesus Christ brought us undeserved kindness and truth.

dag: Nyamiya, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka n zaŋ sɔŋ yi tooni maa, kpɛmiya di ni ti deei n ni daa po pɔri zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni bɛ zuliya la.
en: Look, I have laid the land before you. Go and possess the land that I promised to give to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as well as to their descendants after them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka o lo ti alikauli kara din mali buchi ni di chɛ ka ti yi dunia ŋɔ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri din saɣindi ninsalinim la ni, ka ti min o laɣim mali Naawunitali biɛhigu.
en: through which he also gave us the very great and rich gifts that he promised us. With these gifts you can share in being like God. And so you will escape the ruin that comes to people in the world because of the evil things they want.

dag: A nyɛla do viɛlli dɔbba puuni; a zilinkom viɛla. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni sahakam.
en: You are the most handsome of men; you are an eloquent speaker. God has always blessed you.

dag: Yi ni daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ dahin shɛli yi ni daa laɣim Sinai Zoli gbini la yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi bee n-nya buɣim titali ŋɔ yaha, ti ni kpi.
en: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord , Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die.

dag: Di saha ka Judanim maa daa bu tɔb zambu. Bɛ ni daa bu tɔb zambu maa, ka Naawuni daa nyaŋ Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Abija mini Judanim tooni maa.
en: and raised the battle cry. When they raised the battle cry, God defeated Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.

dag: Yihim ma yɔhiŋgu ni, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Dont let me live a lie. Guide me with your teachings.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri galisiya gari n zabiri. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ ku ma galisiya pam, ka n dimnim ŋmari ʒiri pari ma. Bɛ chɛ ka n yola n ni bi zu neen shɛŋa samli.
en: I have more enemies than the hairs on my head. They hate me for no reason. They try hard to destroy me. My enemies tell lies about me. They say I stole from them and they demand that I pay for things I did not steal.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa kpalim zani puu maa sunsuuni, ka bɛ zabi di zuɣu n-ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa tiligi ba ni nasara dibu tital la.
en: But the Three Heroes stood there in that field and defended it. They defeated the Philistines. The Lord gave the Israelites a great victory.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm zaŋ chaŋ sanzali polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The LORDs word to Jeremiah concerning the droughts.

dag: Bee bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka a nyɛ sana, ka ti deeg a kpɛhi ti yinsi bee ka a chani gbinfini, ka ti ti a situra?.
en: When did we welcome you as a stranger or give you clothes to wear.

dag: Kalimiya Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn be Lɛvinim puuni bɛ ko kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: to take a census of the Levite clan of Kohath by subclans and families.

dag: Ka n daa lan bo da shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali nyɔri sara maligu binyara buɣim la na di bɔbu saha; ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ tahiri tiwala din daŋ moobu na. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣiriba kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinunaayɔbu kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: and their relatives in their line of descent— in all. All of these were heads of their households.

dag: n-daa ti kpɛri tiŋkpan shɛl ni ka kɔnsi pia chirig o sol ni n-kaɣ ti ʒe katiŋ ha.
en: As he entered a village, ten men with skin diseases approached him. Keeping their distance from him.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi nyaŋ yi dimnim bɛn yiɣisi ni bɛ tuhi ya. Bɛ ni ti doli so yini kana ni be ti tuhi ya, ka ni ti ŋmaligi guui doli soya ayopɔin zo ka chɛn ya.
en: The Lord will help you defeat your enemies who come to fight against you. Your enemies will come against you one way, but they will run away from you seven different ways!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli ŋɔɣu maa ni n yɛn karila alizin biɛri, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋ zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali n ni naai n tuma.
en: Jesus answered them, Go and tell that fox: I am driving out demons and performing cures today and tomorrow, and on the third day I shall finish my work.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Lɛvinim n-ni ti zaŋ tɔto binyɛra din nyɛ chi mini wain ni kpam tahi nɛma du shɛŋa ni luɣ kasi shee lahi ni be. Nimaani ka maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi tuma mini dunɔguliba ni yiliyiiniba gba be. Ti ku chɛ ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa bahi.
en: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.

dag: Amaa ka aŋgo maa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ʒin ya.
en: Certainly not! I don't know you, the bridegroom answered.

dag: Jɔtam daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa tum shɛm; ŋun daa lee bi ŋmɛla nyɔɣu kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Amaa niriba maa daa na kul tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: Jotham did what was right in the LORDs eyes, just as his father Uzziah had done. Unlike Uzziah, Jotham didnt enter the LORDs temple. But the people continued their crooked practices.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Zɔfai ni Nahat.
en: Zophai was Elkanahs son. Nahath was Zophais son.

dag: Dunɔdali zɔntua maa ni, teebuya ayi daa ʒiɛla yaɣ yini polo ka teebuya ayi ʒe yaɣ din la polo. Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛn kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la min alahichi sara ni alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: and inside the porch on each side of the gate were two tables where the entirely burned offerings, the purification offerings, and the compensation offerings were slaughtered.

dag: Hal o ni da tɔbbi shɛb ka bɛ be o sani maa ŋmanila naɣisa kpaba, bɛn gba ŋmaligimi guui doli taba. Bɛ bi zani, dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili paaya din nyɛ bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: Even her hired soldiers are helpless as calves. They did not stand and fight; all of them turned and ran. The day of their doom had arrived, the time of their destruction.

dag: ŋun di kpihim man Jɔnatan yuli nyin Dauda daŋ ni. Yawɛ bɔhimi nyin Dauda dimnim biɛri ti a.
en: So Jonathan made this agreement with David and his family, and he asked the Lord to hold them responsible for keeping it.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa tim ti deeg o o yidan Palitiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Laishi bia la sanna.
en: Then Ish Bosheth told the men to go and take Michal from a man named Paltiel son of Laish.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba m-bala. Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa lan me duri zali buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka pii niriba maa ni shɛb bɛn pa Lɛvi zuliya n-leei maligumaaniba.
en: Jeroboam built small places of worship at the shrines and appointed men who were not from the tribe of Levi to serve as priests.

dag: ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn ni Bɛnjamin.
en: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin.

dag: Dama bindirigu bi kpɛrila ninsal suhu ni, amaa o pul ni ka di kpɛra, ka gariti yira.
en: It doesn't go into your heart, but into your stomach, and then out of your body. By saying this, Jesus meant that all foods were fit to eat.

dag: Ka n daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri taŋkpa zim shɛli chana, ka n daa zaŋ ba labi kaman soli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: I crushed them like dust blown away by the wind; I threw them out like mud dumped in the streets.

dag: Shɛli bi to Yawɛ sani. N shiri ni ti labina yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, ka Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: But is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will come again in the spring, just as I said I would, and your wife Sarah will have a son.

dag: Ka Ananias daa wum yɛligu ŋɔ ka dii lu n-kpi, ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛnkam zaa daa wum li.
en: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. Some young men came and wrapped his body. They carried it out and buried it. And everyone who heard about this was filled with fear.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina; ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: God parted the skies and came down; thick darkness was beneath his feet.

dag: Di piligu dali ti nyɛla laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di ti tumiya yi dabisili kam tuma dindali maa.
en: On the first of these days come together for worship and do none of your daily work.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Dimiya li zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili, yi ku nya li tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ.
en: On Saturday, Moses told the people, Today is the Sabbath, the special day of rest to honor the Lord . So none of you should be out in the fields. Eat the food you gathered yesterday.

dag: Riuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza. Iso paɣ Basɛmat bihi n-daa bala.
en: Reuel had four sons: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were Esaus grandsons from his wife Basemath.

dag: A yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni tooi chɛ ka niriba fo bɛ noya? Ka a yi maani niriba ansarisi so ŋun di dih a vi?.
en: Will your idle talk silence everyone; will you mock and not be put to shame?.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Amɔrinim dahin shɛli maa, ka Jɔshua daa tɔɣisi Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋmaligi yɛli Izraɛlnim ninni: Wuntaŋa, kpalimmi zani luɣ yini Gibiɔn dɛde, ka nyin Goli gba, kpalim zani Aijalɔn vinvamli dɛde.
en: On the day that the Lord gave the men of Israel victory over the Amorites, Joshua spoke to the Lord . In the presence of the Israelites he said, Sun, stand still over Gibeon; Moon, stop over Aijalon Valley.

dag: Ka a saa tahibu be pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni, ka a saa nyaɣisibu neei dunia ŋɔ ni zaa, ka dunia sɔhiri ka damda.
en: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi sabbu shɛli sɔŋ. Sabimi li bachibihi kara n yɛli, Mahɛshalalihashibaz dini.
en: The Lord said, Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ zuɣulaantab daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti bɔhi Yɛhudianim maa: Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu ŋɔ hal ka yi me li ti naai.
en: At the same time, Tattenai, the governor of the province Beyond the River, and Shethar-bozenai and their colleagues came to them and spoke to them, asking, Who authorized you to build this house and finish preparing this building material.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu, miriya ka yi doli zaligusaɣindiba ŋɔ biriginsim soli maa ka kɔŋ yimaŋmaŋ ʒiɛyimtali zaashee la ni zanibu.
en: Therefore, dear friends, since you have been warned in advance, be on guard so that you arent led off course into the error of sinful people, and lose your own safe position.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri kum, ka kum bi kanna, ka o gbi m-bo di shee n-gari azichi sɔɣirili;.
en: those waiting in vain for death, who search for it more than for treasure.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tim anabinim mini yɛnnima ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yi sanna, ka yi ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka kpahi bɛ shɛb tabili dapula zuɣu, ka fiɛb bɛ shɛb mi yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka niŋ ba alaka tiŋ ni zaŋ ti kpa tiŋ ni.
en: So I tell you this: I send to you prophets and teachers who are wise and know the Scriptures. You will kill some of them. You will hang some of them on crosses. You will beat some of them in your synagogues. You will chase them from town to town.

dag: Ka o daa bo Ijipti bin suma n-ʒili bunsi pia ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti o ba, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ su kawana mini bɔrɔbɔro ni di ti nyɛ o ba sol ni bindira n-ʒili bunnyama pia pahi.
en: He sent his father ten donkeys loaded with the best Egyptian goods and ten donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and other food for the trip.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Tuun shɛli Naawuni ni bɔri ni yi tum nyɛla ni yi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: Jesus replied, This is what God requires, that you believe in him whom God sent.

dag: Amaa ka Sɔdomnim maa yɛl o, Miligim ka ti ti palo. A nyɛla sana kpe, ka bɔri ni a wuhi ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm? A yi bi baŋ ti ni niŋ a din bie n-gari ti ni yɛn niŋ ba shɛm. Ka bɛ daa kul dihiri Lɔt na hal ti paai dunoli m-bɔri ni bɛ ŋme n-kab li.
en: They said, Get out of the way! And they continued, Does this immigrant want to judge us? Now we will hurt you more than we will hurt them. They pushed Lot back and came close to breaking down the door.

dag: O chɛ ka n zaŋla n nyina ŋubiri kuɣichaɣila, ka chɛ ka n kɔri tampiligim puɣi mmaŋa.
en: He rubbed my face in the ground and broke my teeth on rocks.

dag: Ka Ainim daa kari ba bɛ tiŋ maa dunol ni hal ti paai Shɛbarim n-daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ pihitanaayɔbu laasabu sɔŋ zolɔŋni. Ka Izraɛlnim baɣiri ni daa cheei kom, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: The men of Ai struck down approximately thirty-six of them. They chased them from outside the gate as far as Shebarim. They struck them down on the slope. Then the hearts of the people melted and turned to water.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa zaŋ buɣim ni daa di ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni daa zaŋ daanya tulaale tuɣindi labihi shɛŋa ti Naawuni maa n-kuri gbiŋgbarinlinsi pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: So Eleazar the priest took the fire pans and had them beaten into thin plates to make a covering for the altar.

dag: mini Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi ni o tizo Jɔn, o ni daa pa shɛb mi yupaa Bɔanɛjiiz la.
en: James and his brother John, the sons of Zebedee ;.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi chɛ ka m mɔɣisi n yaansi maa mini m bipuɣinsi maa kparima n-chɛbisi ba? A tum gala.
en: You didnt even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You were very foolish to do this!.

dag: Ka Amalɛknim daa lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim Rɛfidim maa.
en: At Rephidim the Amalekites came and fought against the Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yɛli, Yɛm so kpiɔŋ. Amaa bɛ daa lihi ʒiɛm doo maa yɛm maa, ka bi deeg o yɛligu.
en: So I decided that wisdom is better than strength. Yet if you are poor, no one pays any attention to you, no matter how smart you are.

dag: Ka yi beni duhiri yimaŋa! Di di bi simdi ni yi fabindimi? Yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa yi ni.
en: And still you are proud of yourselves! You should have been filled with sadness. And the man who committed that sin should be put out of your group.

dag: N yi zaŋ chibo paɣi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ bɔchaa paɣi n nuhi.
en: Even if I scrubbed my hands with soap and washed myself whiter than snow.

dag: Yawɛ ku saɣi zaŋ o niriba bah o yuli din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, dama ŋuna n-daa yu ka pii ya leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: But the Lord has chosen you to be his own people. He will always take care of you so that everyone will know how great he is.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Pa sokam zaa n-ni tooi doli dimbɔŋɔ naɣila Naawuni ni zaŋ lala ti shɛba.
en: Jesus answered, This teaching does not apply to everyone, but only to those to whom God has given it.

dag: Ka bɛ yi wuh o la samli, di simdi ka o yo bɛ ni wuh o sam shɛli maa zaa o nyɛvili tiligibu zuɣu.
en: However, if the owner is allowed to pay a fine to save his life, he must pay the full amount required.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti na kul zaɣisi n noli ka ku doli ma, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin kaman yi daalahichi ni galisi shɛm tariga.
en: If you still continue to resist me and refuse to obey me, I will again increase your punishment seven times.

dag: N dabisa maa zɔrimi gariti kaman ŋariŋ shɛli din zɔri pam la, di chanimi kaman tɔrili ni yi silim na ni o ti to binnɛɔŋ shɛm la.
en: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa be di ni dini.
en: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa mini kaya shɛŋa ti Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima m-bala.
en: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa o ni daa zaŋ li yɛl o ba min o biɛyanim maa, o ba daa tahila o zuɣu ka bɔh o, Zahim bɔ ka a lee zahim maa? M min a ma ni a biɛyanim ŋɔ shiri ti yɛn damdila a tooni.
en: Joseph also told his father about this dream, but his father criticized him. His father said, What kind of dream is this? Do you believe that your mother, your brothers, and I will bow down to you.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hanania, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kabigila dapua, amaa m bo kurigu dapua n-zali di zaani.
en: The Lord said to Jeremiah, Go and tell Hananiah that this is what the Lord says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but I will make a yoke of iron in the place of the wooden yoke.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun zali ni Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni ni lu. O daa buɣisi li mi. O daa bi chɛ li wurimbu. O chɛ ka pihi mini goma fabili; di zaa bahila yoli.
en: The LORD planned to destroy Daughter Zions wall. He stretched out a measuring line, didnt stop himself from devouring. He made barricades and walls wither—together they wasted away.

dag: A daa yina ni a ti tilig a niriba, ka daa yina ni a ti tilig a ninvuɣ gahindili. Nyini n-ŋme wurim ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili, ka wurim di mɔpilli hal ti tabili di tanzaa.
en: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.

dag: Kul paɣimiya Yawɛ ka duhimiy o yuli, ka molimiy o tuma yɛla zuliya kam ni.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , proclaim his greatness; tell the nations what he has done.

dag: Di darigi ti tibili ti yaannim daalahichi zuɣu. Zom ti nambɔɣu yomyom; dama ti nya filiŋ pam.
en: Dont remember the iniquities of past generations; let your compassion hurry to meet us because weve been brought so low.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu maa labisi niŋ a binyɛrigu maa ni. Ka o daa lan zaŋ o nuu maa labisi niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na ka di min o niŋgbuŋ zaa lan nyɛla yim.
en: Put your hand back inside your shirt, the Lord told him. Moses did so, and when he took it out again, it was as healthy as the rest of his body.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni yino kuli ti zaŋ yi tizo maa na, ka yinim bɛn kpalim be sarika ni, ka ti buɣisi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa nya yɛlimaŋli ka yi yɛli maa, di yi pa lala, m po Firawuna ni yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: Send one of you to get your brother, but the rest of you will stay in prison. We will find out if your words are true. If not, as Pharaoh lives, you are certainly spies.

dag: Amaa yinima nina mal alibarika, dama di nyara; ka yi tiba gba mal alibarika, dama di wumda.
en: Happy are your eyes because they see. Happy are your ears because they hear.

dag: Ka Aduna garigi yɛl o, N dana, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi pam bahi n zuɣu, a mi ni niriba maa suhuri zaa kul yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa ti bahi di nam maa labina, ka daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bolim o ni daa zaŋ liɣiri ti o yiŋbi shɛb ka chaŋ la na ka o ti nya bɛ ni go kɔhigu maa nya nyɔri shɛm tariga.
en: The man was made king and came back. At once he ordered his servants to appear before him, in order to find out how much they had earned.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa wum lala ka bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o, amaa ka daa lee zɔr o, dama o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa pam.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses heard what Jesus said, and they started looking for a way to kill him. They were afraid of him, because the crowds were completely amazed at his teaching.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ o niriba maa kaman piɛri la chaŋ, ka wuhi ba soli mɔɣu ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu n-nyɛ ba la.
en: Then he led his people out like a shepherd and guided them through the desert.

dag: Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do laa gbini diri bihi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: She answered, That is true, Lord. But the dogs under the table can eat the pieces of food that the children dont eat.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdisi mini di firilanima ni bɛ nyɔri li zaani luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: the lampstands with their lamps, all of pure gold, to burn before the inner sanctuary as prescribed.

dag: ka benya kaman dunɔguliba bɛn mali shili ʒi n-guli bɛ duuma ni o ti yi amiliya chuɣu ni na n-niŋ gaafara ka bɛ yoog o yom ka o gari.
en: Be like servants who are waiting for their master to come home from a wedding party. The master comes and knocks, and the servants immediately open the door for him.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Pa yinima n-daa je ma hal ka kari ma m ba yiŋ la? Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kani n sanna yi wahala nyabu saha.
en: But Jephthah answered, You hated me so much that you forced me to leave my father's house. Why come to me now that you're in trouble.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o sɔŋda Bidikar, Yihim o bahi Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ŋɔ ni. Ka bɔh o, A teei m min a ni daa laɣim dol o ba Ɛhab nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo la?.
en: Jehu said to Bidkar his chariot officer, Pick him up, and throw him on the plot of ground belonging to Naboth the Jezreelite. Remember how you and I were driving chariot teams behind his father Ahab when the LORD spoke this prophecy about him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: So now, since the LORD placed a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours, it is the LORD who has pronounced disaster against you.

dag: Amaa so beni ŋun diri ma shɛhira, ka m mi ni o ni diri ma shɛhira shɛli maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: But there is someone else who tells people about me, and I know that what he says about me is true.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Izraɛl zuɣulana hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Samuel was a leader in Israel all his life.

dag: dama yi dibu ni, sokam kpaɣirimi dira, ka kum mali shɛba ka shɛb mi nyu m-buɣi.
en: For as you eat, you each go ahead with your own meal, so that some are hungry while others get drunk.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi chana, ka dabiɛm gbaai tiŋ shɛŋa din daa gili ba nim pam, ka bɛ daa bi kari doli Yaakubu bihi maa.
en: Then Jacob and his sons left that place. The people in the surrounding cities wanted to follow and kill them, but God filled them with such great fear that they did not go after them.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ Yawɛ leei bɛ ni ni niŋ so naani, ka shiri niŋ o naani mal alibarika.
en: But I will bless the person who puts his trust in me.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun mi daa deei pɔŋ tuhili la ŋun daa yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, m pun mi a halli ni nyɛ shɛm, dama a dirila a ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri a ni bi di atam shɛli wahala;.
en: Then the servant who got one bag of money came to the master. The servant said, Master, I knew you were a very hard man. You harvest what you did not plant. You gather crops where you did not put any seed.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ tum Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa zaa.
en: In this way all the work of the meeting tent dwelling was finished. The Israelites did everything just exactly as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti paai Jɔnatan ni to piɛm maa bahi luɣ shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan bol o n-yɛl o, Pa piɛm maa m-be a tooni maa ha.
en: When the boy got to the spot where Jonathan shot the arrow, Jonathan yelled to him, Isnt the arrow past you.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, yi daa bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: But you didnt trust the Lord your God then either.

dag: Di niŋdiya din bi tuhi yi saria karibu ni, di niŋya faralan nirilim bee n-chɛ yi ni di yɛn niŋ shɛm bundan zuɣu, amaa doliya wuntia soli n-kariti saria.
en: Be fair, no matter who is on trial—don't favor either the poor or the rich.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm maa daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli pam. Ka Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba daa kul yiini yila ka ŋmɛri Yawɛ biŋkumda din kumdi pampam m-paɣiri Yawɛ dabisili kam.
en: For seven days the people who had gathered in Jerusalem celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread with great joy, and day after day the Levites and the priests praised the Lord with all their strength.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa chɛ naɣikɔra maa, ka guui doli Ilaija nti yɛl o, Chɛ ka n chɛbisi m ba mini m ma pɔi ka naanyi dol a. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labima, ka n yɛl a la wula?.
en: Elisha then left his oxen, ran after Elijah, and said, Let me kiss my father and mother good-bye, and then I will go with you. Elijah answered, All right, go back. I'm not stopping you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la yɛli Pita, Ti Duuma m-bala! Pita daa pirigila o binyɛrigu sɔŋ ka tumdi tuma, ka o ni daa ti wum ni di nyɛla bɛ Duuma maa, ka o zaŋ o binyɛrigu maa ye n-kpilim lu teeku kom maa ni ha.
en: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, Its the Lord! When Simon Peter heard it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself and jumped into the water.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bibihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa nya lala ka tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: People were bringing babies to Jesus so that he would bless them. When the disciples saw this, they scolded them.

dag: N nyaya ka sokam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa dolila nachimbil so ŋun di nam zani naa zaani.
en: But I have watched people in this life, and I know this: People will follow that young man. He will become the new king.

dag: Bɛ pun chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛl la, ka malila naɣibila n-jɛmdi li, ka maani maligu tiri li, ka yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: They have already left the way that I commanded them to follow; they have made a bull-calf out of melted gold and have worshiped it and offered sacrifices to it. They are saying that this is their god, who led them out of Egypt.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa daa tirila bɛ suɣa Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo.
en: This clan was to camp on the west behind the Tent.

dag: Dama tiŋgbani ni chɛri ka bimbira puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na shɛm ni kaman puu ni chɛri ka bɛ ni zaŋ bimbiri shɛŋa biri di ni zoori shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka wuntia tuma yi zahira, ka zuliya kam zaa tibig o.
en: As surely as seeds sprout and grow, The Sovereign Lord will save his people, And all the nations will praise him.

dag: Ka Annas daa chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Kaiafas sani.
en: Then Annas sent him, bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: Whoever doesnt carry their own cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

dag: N yi ti teeg a nintam la yɛla, n suhu kul yɛla a nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli.
en: I remember your tears, and I want to see you very much, so that I may be filled with joy.

dag: Di saha ka yi ni baŋ ni m be Izraɛlnim sani, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka so lan kani. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: You will know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God—no other exists; never again will my people be put to shame.

dag: Ka Rubin daa ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni alikama chɛbu saha ti bo ŋmaankpihiga na ti ti o ma Liya. Ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Liya, N suhir a, niŋm a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa shɛli ti ma.
en: During the time of the wheat harvest, Reuben found some love flowers and took them to his mother Leah. Rachel asked Leah for some of them.

dag: Amaa ti yipa yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu lɔbu ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka kpi zaŋ chaŋ din daa kpɛhi ti dabitim ni la polo. Ka ti mi ku lan doli fukumsi zaligu kurili din daa sabi zal la sulinsi soli, amaa ka ni dolila Shia Kasi nyɛvili palli la sulinsi soli.
en: Now, however, we are free from the Law, because we died to that which once held us prisoners. No longer do we serve in the old way of a written law, but in the new way of the Spirit.

dag: Ti Duuma pala ŋun bi niŋdi yomyom zaŋ chaŋ o daalikauli palibu polo kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni tɛhiri shɛm la, amaa o lee nyɛla ŋun mali suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama o bi yu ni so ti bahi yoli, amaa o bɔri ni sokam zaa lee niŋla tuuba.
en: The Lord is not slow to do what he has promised, as some think. Instead, he is patient with you, because he does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants all to turn away from their sins.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la yi ni kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Be sure you dont offer your burnt offerings in just any place you see.

dag: Amaa ti doliyala ti Duuma Yisa Masia biɛrisuŋ la soli, ka di bo so shɛli ti ni ni doli n-tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma.
en: But be like the Lord Jesus Christ, so that when people see what you do, they will see Christ. Dont think about how to satisfy the desires of your sinful self.

dag: Nyin Bɛtilihɛm, tiŋ din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, a pala tin bila Juda nabihi sani, dama a ni ka na so ŋun ni su n niriba Izraɛlnim ni ti yina. .
en: Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel. .

dag: Ka o daa ti wum ni Yisa yi Judia ka Galili na, ka o chaŋ o sani nti balim o ni o kana ti tib o bidibiga maa ti o, dama o daa tarigimi yɛn kpi.
en: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went to him and asked him to go to Capernaum and heal his son, who was about to die.

dag: ka bɛ ti yihi tuuba niŋbu mini alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu ŋun Masia yul ni n-ti zuliya kam zaa, ka di piligu shee mi yɛn nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ nti kpa luɣilikam.
en: and in his name the message about repentance and the forgiveness of sins must be preached to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chaŋ Samuɛl sani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni nti yɛl o, Wuhim ma ŋun nyari niriba yɛla la yiŋa.
en: Saul went up to a man near the gate to ask directions. This man just happened to be Samuel. Saul said, Excuse me. Could you tell me where the seers house is.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti bi mi di ni daa yi so sanna.
en: So they answered, We dont know the answer.

dag: n-yaai li mahilaa ni ti zal o tooni, ka o zaɣisi li ŋubbu, ka yɛl o, Karimi sokam ka bɛ yi ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ zaa daa yi.
en: Then Tamar took the cakes out of the pan and set them out for him. But he refused to eat. He said to his servants, Get out of here. Leave me alone! So all of his servants left the room.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kahig omaŋ wuhi Ijiptinima, ka bɛ baŋ o dindali maa ka jɛm o, ka bo pina mini sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti o. Bɛ ni ti pɔri pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka niŋ bɛ ni po ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm.
en: The LORD will make himself known to the Egyptians; the Egyptians will know the LORD on that day. They will worship with sacrifices and offerings, making solemn promises to the LORD and fulfilling them.

dag: Bɛ daa bi baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba yɛla ka o tɔɣisiri ba maa.
en: They did not understand who he was talking about. He was telling them about the Father.

dag: Chɛ ka n galimi kalinsi mini m biɛhigu din tuhi gbib ma, dama nyini ka n niŋ naani.
en: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.

dag: A chɛ ka mɔri zoori ka biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka chɛ bindira bimbilima ti ninsalinim ni bɛ kɔri li ka di yihiri bindirigu tiŋgban ni na.
en: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli sokam din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa mini kuruchunim maa.
en: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the man with the demons, and about the pigs.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl neesim ni leei buɣim zilinli. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni leei buɣim zilinli n-di o gɔhi mini suligunyinyari dahin yini.
en: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mi a sujee yiko ni nyɛ shɛm? A suhuyiɣisili galisimi kaman bɛ ni lur a sizuura shɛli ni galisi shɛm.
en: No one really knows the full power of your anger, but our fear and respect for you is as great as your anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha bee Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Pray that it doesnt happen in winter or on the Sabbath day.

dag: Amaa tinim kul ku nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga; ti kul ni ʒiɛla Naawuni ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm tariga la puuni hal ni zaŋ chaŋ yi gba sani.
en: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.

dag: N ni zaŋ li ti tinzunnima, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri, ka di leei bɛ ni ŋme n-di shɛli. Bɛ ni ti ta li daɣiri.
en: Ill hand it over to foreigners as loot taken in war, to the earths wicked ones as plunder—they will defile it!.

dag: Amaa o ni daa duh omaŋa ka niŋ karimbaani, ka mali hali yoli ni ninkuunsi la zuɣu ka Naawuni daa vuug o o nam ʒiishee, ka o kɔŋ o jilima zaashee maa.
en: But Nebuchadnezzar became proud and stubborn, so his power was taken away from him. He was taken off his royal throne and stripped of his glory.

dag: Dama yi mi ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli pa talima n-tiligi ya biɛr yo shɛli yi ni daa deei yi yaannim san la ni pala din nyɛ binshɛŋa din saɣindi kaman anzinfa bee salima.
en: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yihi ma biŋkɔbigulibo maa ni ka yɛli ma, Cham ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ti n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: But the LORD took me from shepherding the flock, and the LORD said to me, Go, prophesy to my people Israel.

dag: Saha shɛli Mɔdɛkai ni daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunoli, ka Bigitan mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ namɔɣilis ayi n-ʒe n-guli naa zɔntua dunoli daa ti je suli niŋ Naa Ahasivɛrɔs ka lo ni bɛ sɔɣi ku o.
en: During the time Mordecai was sitting next to the kings gate, this happened: Bigthana and Teresh, two of the kings officers who guarded the doorway, became angry with the king. They began to make plans to kill King Xerxes.

dag: Ka Manaasa bia Jair daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei tiŋkpan shɛŋa, ka bol li Havɔtijairi.
en: Jair, from the family of Manasseh, defeated the small towns there. Then he called them Towns of Jair.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ. Bɛ daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: The Lord had given these commandments to Moses. So the Israelites did everything he commanded.

dag: Yinim bɛn yɔhindi niriba ŋɔ, wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ ya? O ku darigi yi tibili?.
en: You liars, what will God do to you? How will he punish you?.

dag: Vihiriba maa yi ti gindi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti nya ninsal kɔba luɣ shɛli, ŋun bom bini dalim nimaani hal ka kasiɣiriba ti kana ti zaŋ li sɔɣi Hamɔngɔg.
en: They will go around looking, and if anyone sees a bone, a marker will be put up by it. The sign will stay there until the gravediggers come and bury the bone in the Valley of Gogs Army.

dag: ni Sulemaana nɛma duri fɔntinsi ni o chɛchɛbunsi fɔntinsi ni o wɔribariba fɔntinsi m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me mɛr shɛŋa zaa zali Jɛrusalɛm ni Lɛbanɔn ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli o ni daa su maa zaa ni.
en: They also built towns where he could keep his supplies and his chariots and horses. Solomon ordered them to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere in his kingdom.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti zal o niriba bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaɣ shɛŋa din daa be teeku polo zaŋ tabili bɛn daa be kukɔɣu polɔnim zaa ni bɛ yo farigu.
en: King Xerxes made everyone in his kingdom pay taxes, even those in lands across the sea.

dag: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ muni la di pun ka buchi, bɛ ni ti yɛri ni buɣim di li ka di niŋ sala? Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li niŋ binshɛli yaha.
en: Look, even when it was whole, it was worthless. Now that the fire has consumed it, and it is charred, its even more useless.

dag: Dama pagɔrili naŋgbampiba malisimi kaman shiri la, ka o yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari kpam.
en: Now, another mans wife might be very charming, and the words from her lips so sweet and inviting.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Ayuba yɛla ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la, N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a min a zɔnim ayi maa zuɣu, dama yi bi tɔɣisi n yɛla ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli kaman n dabili Ayuba ni tɔɣisi li shɛm.
en: After the LORD had spoken these words to Job, he said to Eliphaz from Teman, Im angry at you and your two friends because you havent spoken about me correctly as did my servant Job.

dag: Akasia dari ka o daa zaŋ mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: He made carrying poles of acacia wood, covered them with bronze.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba bɛn miri ma na ŋɔ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi, di yi pa lala, man Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Only the priests may come near me, and they must obey strict rules before I let them. If they don't, they will be punished.

dag: N nintam n-kul nyɛ m bindirigu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka niriba kul bɔhiri ma sahakam, A Naawuni maa lee be ya.
en: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, Where is your God.

dag: Musa daa yi ti kpe suɣili maa puuni, sagban daantaliga sirigirimina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka Yawɛ tɔɣisiri Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Moses entered the tent, the column of cloud would come down and stand at the tents entrance while the LORD talked with Moses.

dag: Abigeel n-daa dɔɣi Amasa, Amasa ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la.
en: Abigail was Amasas mother. Amasas father was Jether. Jether was from the Ishmaelites.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam. O suhuyiɣisili din daa kɔŋ tim maa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ buɣim juui Ziɔn ka di di li zaa.
en: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.

dag: Yi ni ti mali olivi tihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, amaa yi ti ku ʒe di kpam, dama di wala zaa ni ti wɔbi lu.
en: You might have many olive trees throughout your territories, but you wont cover yourself with their oil because your olive trees will fail.

dag: Tuuni kam tumbu mali nyɔri, amaa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu kɔŋko nyɛla din tahiri fara na.
en: If you work hard, you will have plenty. If you do nothing but talk, you will not have enough.

dag: Zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ puuni, yinim ka m pii, dinzuɣu n ni darigi yi tibili yi tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu.
en: You only have I loved so deeply of all the families of the earth. Therefore, I will punish you for all your wrongdoing.

dag: Bɛ lɔrila nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a niriba polo; ka niŋdi tab saawara zaŋ chaŋ a ni guli a ninvuɣ shɛb la polo.
en: They concoct crafty plans against your own people; they plot against the people you favor.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni daa ku niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ta li daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: and so I poured out my fury on them for all the blood they had poured out on the land and for all the defilement of their idols.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul ʒiɛri pampam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ pii neen shɛŋa din daa be ŋariŋ maa ni bahi kom ni.
en: The next day the storm was blowing against us so hard that the men threw some things out of the ship.

dag: Bɔ saha ka o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani maa? Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la bee o gunibu la nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o zali di ni maa? Di nyɛla o ni daa na bi guni saha shɛl la, ka pa ni o ni daa gun la nyaaŋa.
en: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Jesus said to the mob, Why do you come with swords and clubs to arrest me like a criminal?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi zuɣu ka o daa kari ba o sani bahi.
en: It was precisely because the LORD was angry with Jerusalem and Judah that he thrust them out of his presence.

dag: Doo maa ni daa nya ka o bi tooi nyaŋ Yaakubu maa, ka o daa shih o sakpuɣu, ka o sakpuɣu maa ŋmirigi bɛ ni daa vari saha shɛli maa.
en: When the man saw that he could not win, he struck Jacob on the hip and threw it out of joint.

dag: ka salo pam daa kul kabiri dol o, ka o daa tib barinim bɛn be bɛ ni.
en: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din chihiri niŋ yi yinsi puuni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni woligi ya kun ya kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ saɣim li shɛm maa. Di simdi ka yi ti siŋ li ka zaɣisi li, dama di nyɛla di ni simdi ni yi saɣim binshɛli.
en: Dont bring any detestable thing into your house, or you will be placed under the ban too, just like it is! You must utterly detest these kinds of things, despising them completely, because they are under the ban.

dag: Hɛshibɔnnima, kuhimiya, dama Ai wurimya. Raba paɣiba, kummiya. Somiya buri; kummiya, ka fiɛbimiya yimaŋ fiɛbisi. Dama bɛ ni ti gbahi Milikom min o tindaannima ni bɛn jɛmd o daba chaŋ.
en: Weep, you people of Heshbon; Ai has been destroyed. Wail, you daughters of Rabbah; put on funeral clothing, cry your eyes out, run for shelter. Milcom will surely go into exile, together with his priests and ministers.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋma di nyɔŋ maa, hal nira ni ku tooi kpe di ni maa zaa yoli. Bɛ ni galisi gari toli maa zuɣu bɛ ka kalinli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what the Lord says: They will chop down Egypts forest. There are many trees in that forest, but they will all be cut down. There are more enemy soldiers than locusts. There are so many soldiers that no one can count them.
