dag: N ni darig o tibili o ni daa tam n yɛla Baalnim chuɣu dabisa saha, ka tuɣindi ba tulaale zim, ka pir o nintua, ka ye salima n-zo n-dol o mamanim la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will punish her for the days dedicated to the Baals, when she offered sweet-smelling sacrifices to them and dressed herself up with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, and forgot me, says the LORD.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan tim wɔribar so ŋun pah ayi, ka o tuhi ba soli nti yɛli, Naa ni n ti bɔh a nya Alaafee? Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim doli n nyaaŋa.
en: Then Joram sent out a second messenger on a horse. This man came to Jehus group and said, King Joram says, Peace. Jehu answered, You have nothing to do with peace. Come and follow me.

dag: Daanya kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛri mii barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili, ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la. Di daa deerila kom lita tuhi pihiyɔbu.
en: The sides of the bowl were millimeters thick, and its rim was in the shape of a cup that curved outward like flower petals. The bowl held about , liters.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ niriba pam na ti lir a, ka bɛ ti lab a kuɣa, ka zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmahiŋmah a jilajila.
en: Your lovers and an angry mob will stone you to death; they will cut your dead body into pieces.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa kul duhir omaŋ pahira, amaa o ni daa mali kpiɔŋ pam maa ka o yilli la kabi. Ka yila anahi daa bili yina n-zani di zaashee, ka nir ni tooi nya li viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi zaa noya daa kpala dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ zaa yiniyini polo.
en: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika ŋ-ŋmɛnŋme li mal li; ka yi mal li piɛbiri laɣindi niriba, ka mal li piɛbiri ka bɛ yiɣisira chana.
en: Make two silver trumpets and make them from hammered metalwork. Use them for summoning the community and for breaking camp.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛn mali yɛm di nyuri bara bɛ yɛm zuɣu, ka bɛn mali yaa di nyuri bara bɛ yaa zuɣu. Ka bɛn gba mali buni di nyuri bara bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord says: The wise must not brag about their wisdom. The strong men must not brag about their strength. The rich must not brag about their money.

dag: Ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila omaŋa, amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila cheechi ni niriba.
en: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a ni so a taba? Bɔ ka a lee mali ka di pala pini ka Naawuni zaŋ li ti a? Ka a yi daa dee li mi o sani, di chaŋ wula ka a nyuri bara kaman pa pini ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li ti a la?.
en: Who do you think you are? Everything you have was given to you. So, if everything you have was given to you, why do you act as if you got it all by your own power?.

dag: Musa daa zaŋla o paɣa Zipɔra labisi ka o deemba Jɛtro daa deeg.
en: So Jethro went to Moses while Moses was camped near the mountain of God. Jethro brought Moses wife, Zipporah, with him.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: When Joab and the troops who were with him advanced into battle against the Arameans, they fled from him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi Midiannim maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm n-ku dɔbba zaa.
en: The Israelites fought the Midianites as the Lord had commanded. They killed all the Midianite men.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun doli anyinsi soli biri shɛli ni ti kpuɣila mbusim, ka o suhuyiɣisili mi ku ti o nasara.
en: Those who spread trouble will harvest trouble. In the end, they will be destroyed for the trouble they caused.

dag: Aai! N ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa chɛfirinim ni zaŋdi maani maligu, bɛ zaŋdi li maanila alizin biɛri, pa ni Naawuni. Ka m mi bi bɔri ni yi mini alizin biɛri yɛla kpɛri tab ni.
en: No, but this kind of sacrifice is sacrificed to demons and not to God. I dont want you to be sharing in demons.

dag: Yɛnnim ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla bɛ ni daa wum shɛli bɛ yaannim sani.
en: wisdom known by others since ancient times.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm, ka ŋmari ma ʒiri, ka bi lan tɛhiri n yɛla yi suhuri ni? N ni shini ya ka di yuui, ka ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi lan zɔri ma maa.
en: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Tiŋgbana ayi ŋɔ mini di fɔntinsi ayi ŋɔ nyɛla ti dini, ka ti ni deei li su, hal Yawɛ ni kul be di ni maa zaa yoli.
en: You said, These two nations and these two territories are mine. We will take possession of them even if the LORD is there.

dag: Jɛhoyachin daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Jehoiachin disobeyed the Lord , just as his father Jehoiakim had done.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa yɛli, Malimiya n chɛchɛbuŋ shili ti ma. Ka bɛ mal li shili ti o. Di saha ka ŋun Izraɛl Naa Jɔram mini Juda Naa Ahazia daa kpe bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli n-daa mali ti tuh o soli maa la Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ni.
en: Joram said, Hitch up the chariot! So they hitched up his chariot. Then Israels King Joram and Judahs King Ahaziah—each in his own chariot—went out to meet Jehu. They happened to meet him at the plot of ground that belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-mali sara ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla taali sanyoo sara maligu.
en: The priest shall burn all the fat on the altar as a food offering to the Lord . It is a repayment offering.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa zaŋ o bia Ibram min o yaaŋa Lɔt ni Ibram paɣa Zarai m-pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ yi Ur din be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Haran n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: Terah took his family and left Ur of Babylonia. They planned to travel to Canaan. Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot , and his daughter-in-law Sarai . They traveled to the city of Haran and decided to stay there.

dag: Sool ni daa nya ka Dauda chani ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, ka o bɔhi Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ nachimbil maa? Ka Abinɛr garigi yɛli, Naa, nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi mi.
en: Now when Saul saw David go out to meet the Philistine, he asked Abner the army general, Abner, whose son is that boy? As surely as you live, Your Majesty, I dont know, Abner answered.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila chɛchɛbuŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu, ka dari wɔhu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga ni pihinu. Lala ka bɛ gba daa kɔhiri ba tiri Hitinim mini Siria nanim zaa.
en: They would import a chariot from Egypt for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty, and then export them to all the Hittite and Aramean kings.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Jesus and his followers went to a place named Gethsemane. He said to them, Sit here while I pray.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, n da yi mini yi puri n-ti Firawuna zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Pumpɔŋɔ deemiya bimbira ŋɔ zali nti biri.
en: Joseph said to the people, Now I have bought you and your land for Pharaoh. So I will give you seed, and you can plant your fields.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Doli ma ka ti kuli n yiŋa, ka a ti di bindirigu.
en: Come home with me, the old prophet said, and have something to eat.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋ ti hal ti ni kul bi tam a yɛla bee n-saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la zaa.
en: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.

dag: Lazarɔs tizɔpaɣ Mariama maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ tulaale ʒe ti Duuma Yisa ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛh o naba la.
en: This Mary was the one who poured the perfume on the Lord's feet and wiped them with her hair; it was her brother Lazarus who was sick.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣisaribila n-zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa, di nyaaŋa ka o lan je o.
en: Suppose a man gets married and consummates the marriage but subsequently despises his wife.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Baasha daa ku Nadab, ka di nam zan o zaani.
en: This happened during the third year of the reign of King Asa of Judah. And so Baasha succeeded Nadab as king of Israel.

dag: Bi so ŋun mal o ba ansarisi ka ʒiɛm o ma, ka zaɣis o noli, vinvamli ni kahiŋkɔri ni kpuɣ o chaŋ ka juri ti di o.
en: An eye that mocks a father and rejects obedience to a mother, may the ravens of the river valley peck it out, and the eagles young eat it.

dag: Di saha ka Judas ŋun daa yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa bɔh o, Karimba, mani? Ka Yisa yɛl o, Iin, nyini.
en: Then Judas, the very one who would hand him over, said to Jesus, Teacher, surely I am not the one you are talking about, am I? Jesus answered, Yes, it is you.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla yaɣili maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi dabitim ni na, ka nyɛ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb daba la. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda na, ka sokam ti be o ya.
en: These are the people of the province who returned from the captivity of those exiles whom Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar had taken into exile. They all returned to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to their own town.

dag: Anatɔtnim daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihitaayika.
en: of Anathoth.

dag: dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka alikauli maa daa yɛli, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: The words in the promise were: A year from now I will return, and Sarah will have a son .

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti zaŋ ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri ni ti yiya m-pa talima din ni chɛ ka ti nya chi.
en: Other people were saying, This is a time of famine. We have to use our fields, vineyards, and homes to pay for grain.

dag: O yiɣisiri faranim taŋkpaɣu ni, ka yiɣisiri nandaamba tampiligim ni.
en: He lifts the poor out of the dirt and rescues beggars from the garbage dump.

dag: Ka Balak daa zaŋ Balaam ti du n-tam Pɛɔr Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli nir ni ni tooi zani ka lihi nya bɔpiɛligu maa ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So he took Balaam to the top of Mount Peor overlooking the desert.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim Naa Sulemaana sanna Ɛtanim gol ni ŋun nyɛ goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin la puuni chuɣu dali.
en: Everyone in Israel assembled before King Solomon in the seventh month, the month of Ethanim, during the festival.

dag: Galimi yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi n nol ni na? N ku tooi baŋla nia biɛɣu ni nyɛ shɛli?.
en: Is there wrong on my tongue, or can my mouth not recognize disaster?.

dag: Bɛ kari ba niriba ni bahi; niriba yɔhiri ba mi kaman tayiɣ la.
en: People banish them from society, shout at them as if to a thief.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam tin ya la, yi di ba zalinsi n-zaɣisi ba yɔbu. Wummiya bɛ fabila! Tumtumdiba maa kuhigu chaŋ ti lu ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa tibili ni.
en: Listen! Hear the cries of the wages of your field hands. These are the wages you stole from those who harvested your fields. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of heavenly forces.

dag: Amaa nir nyari zahimbu din ni chɛ ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la omaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri yi ti voog o kpɛhi di ni n-gbaag o kaman tɔŋ la.
en: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.

dag: Ka o daa pii bɛ niriba tuhi pisopɔin ni bɛ ʒiri ʒiya, ka pii niriba tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ zoya tiŋgban ni ti kpɛri kuɣa, ka zaŋ niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa.
en: He assigned , of them to carry building supplies and , of them to cut stone from the hills. He chose , others to supervise the workers and to make sure the work was completed.

dag: Yi pun mali din simdi ya zaa! Yi pun niŋ bundaannima! Yi di nam ka chɛ ti! N di bi zaɣisi ka yi shiri nyɛla nanima, ka ti di pahi yi zuɣu n-di yi nam maa!.
en: Youve been filled already! Youve become rich already! You rule like kings without us! I wish you did rule so that we could be kings with you!.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima tɔb ni zoya zuɣu.
en: But soldiers of Zebulun and Naphtali risked their lives to attack the enemy.

dag: Ti yi dol o zaligunima, dina n-ni chɛ ka ti baŋ ni ti mi o.
en: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.

dag: Mani n-su Giliad; mani n lan su Manaasa; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurigu zuɣupiligu din taɣiri n zuɣu, ka Juda mi nyɛ n nam kurigu jaaŋgbee.
en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh too; Ephraim is my helmet and Judah my royal scepter.

dag: Dibɔnnim chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu bɛ buɣa duu nti kumda; ka Mɔabnim kumdi Nɛbo mini Mɛdɛba zuɣu; ka sokam pini bɛ zuɣuri ni bɛ teensi.
en: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchu dama o mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa o bi gbuɣiri ŋubira. O nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: Other animals have hooves that are split into two parts, but they dont chew the cud. Dont eat these animals. Pigs are like that, so they are unclean for you.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha ni bɛ ti mal li, ka daa va binyar shɛŋa din zaa bi be kasi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni n-yihi ti zali jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni, ka Lɛvinim daa va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: The priests went inside the Temple to purify it, and they carried out into the Temple courtyard everything that was ritually unclean. From there the Levites took it all outside the city to Kidron Valley.

dag: Heei! Kɔnyuri ni mali sokam, ŋun kam kom ŋɔ gbin na! Ka yinim bɛn mi ka liɣiri, kamiyana ti da bindirigu di! Kamiyana ti da wain mini bihim nyu ka di yɔnya shɛli!.
en: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.

dag: Ŋuna ka n ti yɛn nya ka o baɣi ma, ka n nina ti nya o, ka pa ni so yaha. N suhu kul yɛla di zuɣu.
en: I will see him with my own eyes, and he will not be a stranger. My courage failed because you said.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin; di dabisi tuuli dali maa, di simdi ka yi yihi dabindi kam yi yinsi. Ka so yi ti di dabindi daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni, dilan ni yi Izraɛl zuliya ni.
en: For seven days you must eat bread made without yeast. And on the first of these seven days, you must remove all yeast from your homes. If you eat anything made with yeast during this festival, you will no longer be part of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n firila, Yawɛ tiri ma neesim n zibisim ni.
en: You, Lord , are my light; you dispel my darkness.

dag: O wuhi kpiɔŋ, ka wurim karimbaannima bɛ suhuri ni tɛhi biɛri zuɣu.
en: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.

dag: Jɛra noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-saɣindi ba, ka bɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛ zana din gbahiri bɛmaŋmaŋa.
en: The mouth of fools is their ruin; their lips are a trap for their lives.

dag: N wum Izraɛlnim ni ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni shɛm maa. Yɛlim ba ni yi yɛn ŋubirila nimdi yuŋ, ka diri bindirigu mi tiɣiri asiba, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I have heard the complaints of the Israelites. Tell them that at twilight they will have meat to eat, and in the morning they will have all the bread they want. Then they will know that I, the Lord , am their God.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni kul du shɛm, ka tiŋgbani mi zilim shɛm, lala n-nyɛ nanim tɛha, di ka vihi baŋ.
en: Like the high heavens and the depths of the earth, so the mind of a king is unsearchable.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi o kpee zabili ni ŋmanila ŋun gbaai ba so ŋun gariti tiba.
en: Like yanking the ears of a dog, so is one who passes by and gets involved in another persons fight.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nam kana, ka chɛ ka a yubu niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni ka di ni niŋdi alizanda ni shɛm la.
en: Bring in your kingdom so that your will is done on earth as its done in heaven.

dag: Mani n-daa nyɛ zoomba nina, ka nyɛ gbariti napɔna.
en: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.

dag: Di saha maa machɛli daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, dama Filistianim maa daa yɛlimi ni di yi pa lala Izraɛlnim ni ti kuri takɔbiri bee kpana zali.
en: No metalworker was to be found anywhere in Israelite territory because the Philistines had said, The Hebrews must not make swords and spears.

dag: Yawɛ kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinima ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: The Lord looks down from heaven at us humans to see if there are any who are wise, any who worship him.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ni ti nya ka vi gbahi ba ka bɛ yaa zaa naai, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi tabi bɛ noya, ka bɛ tiba ti kpiri.
en: The nations will see this and be frustrated in spite of all their strength. In dismay they will close their mouths and cover their ears.

dag: shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa. Timmi bɛ zuliya kam puuni ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Choose one of the leaders from each of the twelve tribes and send them as spies to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites.

dag: Amaa leemiyala bɛn tumdi yɛligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni bɛn yɔhim bɛmaŋ wumdila di ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko.
en: You must be doers of the word and not only hearers who mislead themselves.

dag: Kush n-daa nyɛ Nimrɔd ba. O daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa dunia ni.
en: Nimrod, a descendant of Cush, grew up to become the strongest and bravest soldier in the world.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee yi ŋub Daadam Bia niŋgbuŋ ka nyu o ʒim, di yi pa lala yi ku mali nyɛvili.
en: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.

dag: ka bɛ ba Ifriim daa kum bɛ zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ, ka o dɔɣiriba daa kana ti maag o suhu la.
en: Ephraim was the father of Ezer and Elead. He cried for many days because Ezer and Elead were dead. Ephraims family came to comfort him.

dag: Di chɛliya ka sam shɛli doli ya n-naɣ pahila tab yubu samli, dama ŋunkam yur o ʒiʒiinikpee nyɛla ŋun pali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Dont be in debt to anyone, except for the obligation to love each other. Whoever loves another person has fulfilled the Law.

dag: Jɛrigu ŋɔ! A ni biri binshɛli ku bilina ka pa ni di poomi.
en: You fool! When you plant a seed in the ground, it does not sprout to life unless it dies.

dag: Amaa a yi labi tiŋ maa puuni nti yɛli Absalom, N dan naa, n ni leeg a kpambala. Kaman n ni yi kul nyɛ a ba kpambala shɛm, lala ka n yɛn nyɛ a gba kpambala, dina n-ni chɛ ka a nyaŋ Ahitɔfɛl yikombiɛlim maa ti ma.
en: but you can help me by returning to the city and telling Absalom that you will now serve him as faithfully as you served his father. And do all you can to oppose any advice that Ahithophel gives.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ nya ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: An argument broke out among the disciples as to which one of them should be thought of as the greatest.

dag: Hal o ni da tɔbbi shɛb ka bɛ be o sani maa ŋmanila naɣisa kpaba, bɛn gba ŋmaligimi guui doli taba. Bɛ bi zani, dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili paaya din nyɛ bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: The hired soldiers in Egypts army are like fat calves. They will all turn and run away. They will not stand strong against the attack. Their time of destruction is coming. They will soon be punished.

dag: N ni kpuɣi n tiliginsim pipia zuɣusaa, ka kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli.
en: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.

dag: N ni pii mmaŋmaŋ nini ni tiɣi zuɣulaan shɛb tin ya, ka bɛ zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim sun ya.
en: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.

dag: Saha paaya ni nyin Yawɛ niŋ shɛli, dama niriba saɣim a zaligu.
en: It is time for the LORD to do something! Your Instruction has been broken.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ omaŋ dalim kpatinariga yili di ni lu, ka so yi gbaa li di ku tooi zani.
en: When they lean against it, it will break. When they reach out for it, it will not hold them up.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di simdi ka a gba niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka n niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di ka nya yaa lab yiŋa.
en: Please, listen to me. You need to eat. Let me get you some food. Then you will have enough strength to go on your way.

dag: Nyama, n-nyɛ Ribɛka, zaŋm o kuli nti chɛ ka o leeg a dan bia maa paɣa kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Here is Rebekah. Take her and go. Let her marry your masters son. This is what the Lord wants.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Siɣim yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Hurry and go back down, because your people, whom you led out of Egypt, have sinned and rejected me.

dag: Ka n daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti yɛli ba, N tumdila tuun shɛli din niŋ kamaata, n ku tooi kana. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ tuma maa ka di kpalim zani, ka ka yi sanna.
en: so I sent messengers to tell them, Im doing important work, so I cant come down. Why should the work stop while I leave it to come down to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi cheechinima, ka lan kahigi wuhi ni ti ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu ti mabihi maa sani shɛm la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: So show these men that you really have love. Show them why we are proud of you. Then all the churches can see it.

dag: Bɛ daa yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi bɛn bi tum taali ʒim, bɛ daa kɔri ba m-mal la Keenan wuna; ka bɛ ʒim maa daa ta tiŋgbɔŋ maa daɣiri.
en: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their own sons and daughters— the ones they sacrificed to Canaans false gods— so the land was defiled by the bloodshed.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ninsalinima n-tuhiri taba, amaa ti mini alizinnim bɛn be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na mini bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima ni bɛn su fukumsi mini dunia ŋɔ yikolaannim bɛn be zibisim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni la n-tuhiri taba.
en: Our fight is not against people on earth. We are fighting against the rulers and authorities and the powers of this worlds darkness. We are fighting against the spiritual powers of evil in the heavenly places.

dag: n-ti Nɛria bia Baruk ŋun daa nyɛ Masɛya yaaŋa la, m mabia Hanamɛl mini shɛhiranim bɛn daa dihi bɛ nuhi dabu gbana maa zuɣu la ni Judanim zaa bɛn daa be guliba dundɔŋ maa ni ninni.
en: And while he, the witnesses, and all the other Jews sitting in the courtyard were still watching, I gave both copies to Baruch son of Neriah.

dag: Ka Aduna daa zaŋ li guui ti kpe niriba maa sunsuuni kaman Musa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa, ka alɔbo maa daa pun lu niriba maa zuɣu, ka o daa niŋ tulaale zim maa pa buɣim maa zuɣu m-mali sara ti niriba maa.
en: Aaron obeyed, took his fire pan and ran into the middle of the assembled people. When he saw that the plague had already begun, he put the incense on the coals and performed the ritual of purification for the people.

dag: Ŋunkam daŋdi yiɣisibu asiba n-duhi o yee puhi o ʒiʒiinikpee, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli ka o yɛr maa.
en: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Isaka zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Kishiɔn mini Dɛbɛrat.
en: From the territory of Issachar they received four cities: Kishion, Daberath.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, sokam ŋun cham ti jɛm o buɣa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana. Amaa miriya ka yi lan zaŋ yi buɣa mini yi pina ta n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ daɣiri.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, And now, all you Israelites, suit yourselves! Go on and serve your idols! But I warn you that after this you will have to obey me and stop dishonoring my holy name by offering gifts to your idols.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Shɛmaya daa ka Rɛhɔbɔam mini Juda kpamba bɛn daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm Shishak dabiɛm zuɣu la sanna nti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni zaɣisi ma la zuɣu ka n gba zaɣisi ya ka zaŋ ya niŋ Shishak nuu ni maa.
en: Shemaiah the prophet went to King Rehoboam and the Judean leaders who had gathered in Jerusalem to escape Shishak. He said to them, This is the Lord 's message to you: You have abandoned me, so now I have abandoned you to Shishak.

dag: Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia ŋɔ kpɛmmi ʒiɛya, ka kul ku vuui. O ni doli zaligu soli kari niriba saria.
en: Tell the nations, The LORD rules! Yes, he set the world firmly in place; it wont be shaken. He will judge all people fairly.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kana, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa gili luɣilikam maa, laɣimmiya nimaani. Yawɛ, timmi a tɔbbihi na!.
en: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.

dag: ni Dɔri naa ni Goiim naa.
en: Dor , Goiim .

dag: Bɛnkam zaa gariti kpahirila bɛ nuhi niŋd a. Bɛ maan a la ansarisi, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd a, nyin Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga. Tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni tin viɛlli zaa, ka nyɛ dunia zaa suhupiɛlli shee la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now.

dag: O yi di milig o jaaŋgbee ka chɛ ma, ka bi chɛ ka o yɛla kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm.
en: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa sahakam, dama yi yɛn niŋdila din viɛl mini din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Obey faithfully everything that I have commanded you, and all will go well for you and your descendants forever, because you will be doing what is right and what pleases the Lord your God.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka ninsal nuchee daa ti puhi yina n-sabiri sabbu shɛli pari nayili maa dukpini zuɣu m-miri firila ni ʒe luɣ shɛli polo ne viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka naa maa daa nya nuchee maa ni sabiri sabbu maa.
en: Suddenly a human hand appeared and began writing on the plaster wall of the palace, where the light from the lamps was shining most brightly. And the king saw the hand as it was writing.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ.
en: and he asked, Whose picture and name are on it.

dag: Karimbaannim gbi ma la bɔɣ biɛri. Bɛ maanila a zaligu ansarisi.
en: Proud people have tried to trap me and make me disobey your teachings.

dag: O palo yibu maa mi ni ti niŋla di saha dɛde kaman Naawuni ni zal li shɛm. Ŋun Naawuni kɔŋko n-nyɛ alibarika Natitamlana mini nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: The timing of this appearance is revealed by God alone, who is the blessed and only master, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianim bɛn guni gunibu shɛli bɛ ni niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ni la ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni. Teemiya yi bebu ni daa nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: You Gentiles by birth—called the uncircumcised by the Jews, who call themselves the circumcised —remember what you were in the past.

dag: Ka anab Gaad daa ti yɛli Dauda, Di kpalim be vokabili ŋɔ ni, yiɣisim kpe kuli Juda tiŋgban ni. Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani chaŋ Hɛrɛt yɔɣu ni.
en: Then the prophet Gad told David, Dont stay in the fortress any longer. Leave now and go to the land of Judah. So David left and went to Hereth forest.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: He made acacia-wood poles and covered them with gold.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bahiyoli bina anahi lu bɛ zuɣu. Tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba, ka bahi vu ba chaŋ, ka juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri tɔhi ba vali.
en: I, the Lord , have decided that four terrible things will happen to them: they will be killed in war; their bodies will be dragged off by dogs; birds will eat them, and wild animals will devour what is left over.

dag: Bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ diribarilim zuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli n-kul dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli.
en: I was enraged about their illegal profits; I struck them; in rage I withdrew from them. Yet they went on wandering wherever they wanted.

dag: Ka a daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, m bela a sani, ka nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a, ka duh a yuli kaman dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ kara yuya ni du shɛm.
en: Ive been with you wherever youve gone, and Ive eliminated all your enemies before you. Now I will make your name great—like the name of the greatest people on earth.

dag: Dama Naawuni jɛrilim nyɛla yɛm gari ninsalinim yɛm, ka Naawuni chɔɣinsi mi nyɛ kpiɔŋ gari ninsalinim kpiɔŋ.
en: For what seems to be God's foolishness is wiser than human wisdom, and what seems to be God's weakness is stronger than human strength.

dag: Yinim Aroanima, zanimiya palli noli lihira! Doo bee paɣa yi ti zɔri garita, ka yi bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee niŋ.
en: You people living in Aroer, stand next to the road and watch. See the man running away. See that woman running away. Ask them what happened.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ yiko shiri galisi kaman a ni daa pun lo alikauli yɛli.
en: Show us your great power, Lord . You promised.

dag: Lala ka Absalom daa yi niŋdi Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa kani naa sanna ni o ti kari bɛ yɛtɔɣa saria ti ba, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigi ŋun Absalom polo.
en: That's how he treated everyone from Israel who brought a complaint to the king. Soon everyone in Israel liked Absalom better than they liked David.

dag: Di ku yuui ka nyɔŋ puuni leei kɔbu shee kɔbu shee mi leei nyɔŋ.
en: This is the truth: After a very short time, Lebanon will become rich farmland, and the farmland will be like thick forests.

dag: Dama ti Duuma nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka o tiba kul wumdi be suhigu. Amaa ti Duuma kul lihirila bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nimbiɛɣu.
en: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.

dag: Paɣiba maa ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa, di saha ka siliga maa guliba maa ni shɛb daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba dinkam zaa daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: While the women went on their way, some of the soldiers guarding the tomb went back to the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.

dag: ni naɣila kpaba pia mini naɣ pisi bɛn nyari mɔri ŋubiri viɛnyɛliŋga ni piɛri kɔbiga m-pahi wolidibisi ni kparibudibisi ni saŋkpalindibisi ni no kara.
en: grain-fed cattle, pasture-fed cattle, sheep, as well as deer, gazelles, and geese.

dag: ka a kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Kill it, and take its blood and throw it against all four sides of the altar.

dag: Sunsuuni dunɔpaɣira daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa tooni, binshɛli daa beni ŋ-ŋmani.
en: The walls on either side of the Holy Place were square. In front of the Most Holy Place, there was something that looked like.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A min a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, yiɣisimiya chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po pɔri Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu sani yɛli, N ni zaŋ li ti yi zuliya la ni.
en: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Bɛ yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnima, ashee bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: While they were claiming to be wise, they made fools of themselves.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lihi Kɛnnim gba, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛli, Yi biɛhigu shee nyɛla barina ni ka luɣ shɛli. Yi biɛhigu shee maa ŋmanila tiɛɣu din pa kuɣili zuɣu.
en: In his vision he saw the Kenites, and uttered this prophecy: The place where you live is secure, Safe as a nest set high on a cliff.

dag: Nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa pa shɛli, amaa Naawuni zaligu dolibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: For whether or not a man is circumcised means nothing; what matters is to obey God's commandments.

dag: Bɛ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiri gba be di ni; ka bɛ je ni bɛ tum yɛm tuma ni din viɛla.
en: Their words are wicked lies. They have stopped doing anything wise or good.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣi Ijipti naa Firawuna zɔri o bipuɣiŋga kpuɣibu zuɣu. Ka Sulemaana daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa n-zaŋ o na ti niŋ Dauda tiŋ la ni hal ka bɛ ti me omaŋmaŋ yiŋ mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm naai.
en: Solomon made a peace treaty with Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, by marrying his daughter. Solomon brought her to the City of David. This was when Solomon was still building his palace, the Temple of the Lord , and the wall around Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Tama, A yidan ba chanila Timna ni o ti chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: Someone told Tamar that her father-in-law was going to Timnah to shear his sheep.

dag: Bɛ ku Izraɛl jilima zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka wɔɣira lu.
en: Israel, your famous hero lies dead on the hills, and your mighty warriors have fallen!.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu. Ŋuna n-tiligiri bɛn ʒe dɛde bɛ suhuri ni.
en: God helps people who want to do right, so he will protect me.

dag: O ni daa ti miri Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani zo shɛli bɛ ni booni Olivi Tihi zol la gbini ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: He came near Bethphage and Bethany, towns near the hill called the Mount of Olives. He sent out two of his followers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yabidoo Dan ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bia la yuli m-boli tiŋ maa. Amaa tiŋ maa yuli daa tuui boonila Laishi.
en: The people of Dan gave the city a new name. That city had been called Laish, but they changed the name to Dan. They named the city after their ancestor Dan, one of the sons of Israel.

dag: Bɛ na mi n-vii kpiimba biɛhigu shee dunoya ka a nya, bee a na mi n-nya zibisim titali dunoya?.
en: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?.

dag: Teem o yɛla pɔi ka anzinfa mia la naanyi yihi, ka salima laa la ŋma; ka koyul la ŋma kɔbiliga ni bee ka kalinli la kabi kɔbiliga ni.
en: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa dol a zaligunim maa zo.
en: I am a friend of all who serve you, of all who obey your laws.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-gbani Ilaisha naba ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa, ka kpuɣ o bia maa yi.
en: She fell at Elisha's feet, with her face touching the ground; then she took her son and left.

dag: ka bipuɣins ayopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana so bihi daa ti kana ti toori kom niŋdi bɔɣili ni ni bɛ nyuhi bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri.
en: There was a priest there who had seven daughters. These girls came to that well to get water for their fathers sheep. They were trying to fill the water trough with water.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ijipti do so n-fa ti piɛguliba maa nuu ni bahi hal ka ŋɔŋ kom ti ti ka ti nyuhi ti biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: They replied, An Egyptian man rescued us from a bunch of shepherds. Afterward, he even helped us draw water to let the flock drink.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bindirigu pam be di ni. N ni ti ti di nandaamba bindirigu.
en: I will richly provide Zion with all she needs; I will satisfy her poor with food.

dag: bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ ni deei binshɛŋa talima labisi ti bindana, ka labisi bɛ ni zaŋ kpiɔŋ fa binshɛŋa ti dilana, ka doli zaligu shɛŋa din tiri nyɛvili, ka bi lan tumdi alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: if they return pledges, make restitution for robbery, and walk in life-giving regulations in order not to sin—they will live and not die.

dag: Ka takɔr kɔrikɔɣa mini abie tihi daa be zɔntua maa luɣa zuɣu dukpina zuɣu.
en: while closed windows and palm trees decorated both sides of the facade of the porch, the temples side chambers, and the beams.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni bee n-to piɛm di ni bee n-zaŋ nyɔtaɣira ka di ni na bee n-kana ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gil li.
en: And this is what the Lord has said about the Assyrian emperor: He will not enter this city or shoot a single arrow against it. No soldiers with shields will come near the city, and no siege mounds will be built around it.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: He said, Count the Israelites. Count all the men who are years old or older and list them by families. These are the men who are able to serve in the army of Israel.

dag: Ka kapinta yɛli machɛle, A niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka ŋun kpɛri dari ka di niŋdi polipoli kpaŋsi ŋun kpahiri li tuɣiri taba ka yɛra, Di tuɣibu maa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ kpahikpahi li tuɣi taba, ka di ku tooi yihi.
en: The carpenter says to the goldsmith, Well done! The one who beats the idol smooth encourages the one who nails it together. They say, The soldering is good— and they fasten the idol in place with nails.

dag: ka di be kaman n daa na ʒi m-be, ka bɛ daa kul dɔɣi ma n-zaŋ ma ti niŋla gballi ni.
en: Then I would be just as if I hadnt existed, taken from the belly to the grave.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani! Yaa n Naawuni, tiligim ma! A labi n dimnim zaa tapaɣisi, ka ŋme n-kabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina.
en: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu nti be nimaani.
en: And Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntia tuma sahakam mali alibarika.
en: Those who obey his commands are happy. They do good things all the time.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Di saha maa tinzun tiŋ kam niriba pia ni ti kana nti ʒe n-gbaai Yɛhudia nira binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Chɛ ka ti dol a kul a ya, dama ti wumya ni Naawuni be yi sani.
en: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!.

dag: Ka Musa daa yihi biŋkpam din daa be namanama ni zaa mini binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina mini di biŋkpam n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.

dag: Sida dari n-nyɛ ti yiŋ dapuhi, ka ti yɔɣira nyɛ timaha.
en: the cedars will be the beams of our house, and the cypress trees the ceiling.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, Zallakudura Naa bi be nuhi ni me du shɛl ni kaman anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la ni ti Duuma yɛliya:.
en: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord.

dag: ka yɛl o, Di ni nyɛ a suhuyubu ni ka a zaɣis a ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛl la mini n ni daa zal a zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu zuɣu, n ni deeg a nam maa n-zaŋ li ti a kpambal so.
en: and he said to Solomon: You did what you wanted and not what I told you to do. Now I'm going to take your kingdom from you and give it to one of your officials.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa laɣimna nti muɣi dunoli.
en: Everyone in the town gathered at the door of that house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tibigi Naawuni n zuɣu.
en: So they were glorifying God because of me.

dag: Lihimiya yi yab Ibrahimma mini Zaratu bɛn dɔɣi ya la. N daa piig o ka o nyɛla o ko, amaa ka n daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka o tuŋ teei.
en: Abraham is your father, so look at him. Look at Sarah, who gave birth to you. Abraham was alone when I called him. Then I blessed him, and he began a great family with many descendants.

dag: Ka a noli mɔɣisibu ŋmani wain viɛlli din chani viɛnyɛliŋga. Dindina, n yuya ni wain maa paagi n yura maa n-zo n-tiɛli o naŋgbampiba min o nyina.
en: Kissing you is more delicious than drinking the finest wine. How wonderful and tasty!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɔri ni bɛ mali Naawuni sizuura lubu biɛhigu Yisa Masia zuɣu ni bahi nya alaka.
en: Everyone who wants to live showing true devotion to God in Christ Jesus will be persecuted.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa nyɛ Mɛtusɛla bia, ka Mɛtusɛla nyɛ Inok bia, ka Inok nyɛ Jarɛd bia, ka Jarɛd nyɛ Mahalalɛl bia, ka Mahalalɛl mi nyɛ Kɛnan so bia.
en: son of Methuselah son of Enoch son of Jared son of Mahalalel son of Cainan.

dag: Ka yi ti ku Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni la zaa, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu. Miriya ka yi ti jɛm bɛ wuna, dama di ni ti leei zana yi sani.
en: Destroy every nation that the Lord your God places in your power, and do not show them any mercy. Do not worship their gods, for that would be fatal.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka nyɛ tarimba be yi sani. Bɛ ni ti bo sɔŋsim man Yawɛ sani.
en: I will leave there a humble and lowly people, who will come to me for help.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam.
en: How terrible it will be in those days for women who are pregnant and for mothers with little babies!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋlan ŋun fari ma bahira. A zaŋ bini pili n zuɣu tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: My Lord GOD, you are the powerful one who saves me. You protect my head in battle.

dag: Izraɛlnim tipawumli ŋmanila naɣisaa tipawumli. Yawɛ ni tooi lan dihi ba kaman piɛbil ni be mɔri pam shee shɛm la?.
en: Like a stubborn cow Israel is stubborn. Now the LORD will tend them, as the LORD tends a lamb in a pasture.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yur o paɣ Hanna maa zaa yoli, o daa kul ŋmaarila ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko tarili tir o, dama Yawɛ daa na bi ti o bia.
en: But he gave Hannah even more, because he loved Hannah very much, even though the Lord had kept her from having children of her own.

dag: Ka naa yi bi yura ka tum birigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi kpe taali ni.
en: Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty.

dag: Ti luya zaa; ti kul teei dola taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: Look: were going down to the dust; our stomachs are flat on the ground!.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni duhi ya gari dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa.
en: Now if you really obey the LORD your Gods voice, by carefully keeping all his commandments that I am giving you right now, then the LORD your God will set you high above all nations on earth.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yina dabisili din pah ayi maa dali ti lu Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika; ka bɛ zaa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: The army of Benjamin came out of the city of Gibeah to attack the army of Israel on the second day. This time, the army of Benjamin killed another , men from the army of Israel. All the men in the army of Israel were trained soldiers.

dag: Bɛ daa suh o ka o ti ba kɔrinsi, ka ti ba bindir shɛli din yi zuɣusaa na pam.
en: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa wuɣi alichɛbba shɛli maligumaana ni yɛn yɛri pahi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa zuɣu. Alichɛbba maa daa nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa zaa.
en: Then they made the robe for the ephod from blue cloth. It was woven by a skilled worker.

dag: Ka nyɔhi yir o nyɛvoya ni kaman mɔri ka bɛ zaŋ mali buɣim n-zaŋ duɣu tam la.
en: Smoke pours from his nostrils like a boiling pot over reeds.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛlnim Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ yɛliya: To, n ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi yinim bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɔhi ya biɛri.
en: So now, listen to what the Lord Almighty, Israel's powerful God, is saying: I will take revenge on you, my enemies, and you will cause me no more trouble.

dag: bɛ yi yɛli ya di yɛla bee yi yi wum di yɛla, ka yi vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din chihiri maa shiri tumiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.

dag: N wum lahibali Yawɛ sani. O tim tumo zuliya kam sani ti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya taba n kana ti lir o. Yiɣisimiya tuhi tɔbu.
en: I heard a message from the Lord : He sent this messenger to the nations. This is the message: Gather your armies together! Get ready for battle! March against the nation of Edom!.

dag: amaa ka yi bi niŋ yɛda, ka di nyɛla yi ni pa m piɛri la zuɣu.
en: But you do not believe, because you are not my sheep.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo ni a me jɛmbu duu ti n yuli jilima maa, di viɛla.
en: but the Lord said to him, You were right in wanting to build a temple for me.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buyi, Saimɔn Jɔn bia a yuri ma? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: Again Jesus said to him, Simon, son of John, do you love me? Peter answered, Yes, Lord, you know that I love you. Then Jesus said, Take care of my sheep.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba, ka bɛ yɔri farigu o sani. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda kul diri nasara o ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: He left some of his soldiers in Damascus, and the Arameans had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim daa dɔni sansani Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: Israel and Absalom camped in the territory of Gilead.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a ku ninsala, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee.
en: You have heard that people were told in the past, Do not commit murder; anyone who does will be brought to trial.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka doo ŋɔ tɔɣisiri lala? O mɔri Naawuni! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: Why would he say such a thing? He must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla bɛn be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka lahi maa nyɛ din be kasi; ka anzinfa mini salima maa nyɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then I said to the twelve priests: You and these things are holy to the Lord . People gave this silver and gold to the Lord , the God of your ancestors.

dag: yin tooi ŋub bɛna, sakɔnooŋa min o balibu zaa ni sakɔnooŋa ŋun ka paɣiri min o balibu zaa ni paaŋa min o balibu zaa ni sakɔɣu min o balibu zaa.
en: You may also eat all kinds of locusts, all kinds of winged locusts, all kinds of crickets, and all kinds of grasshoppers.

dag: n ni zaŋ shɛli zali gu muɣisigu saha mini zabili ni tɔbu tuhibu dal la?.
en: that I have reserved for a time of distress, for a day of battle and war?.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛdomnima, Nyamiya, n ni filim ya zuliya kam sani; ka chɛ ka sokam ʒiɛm ya.
en: Look now, I will make you of little importance among the nations; you will be totally despised.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mi daa yɛli Filistia doo maa, Nyin kanila n sanna ni takɔbi mini kpan titali ni kpam bila, amaa man zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛl tɔbbihi Naawuni so a ni ta daɣiri ŋɔ yuli kan a sanna.
en: But David told the Philistine, You are coming against me with sword, spear, and scimitar, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israels army, the one youve insulted.

dag: Pukpar so n-na ʒi n-kɔr o puu n-kul kɔri li yɛrigira.
en: Farmers don't constantly plow their fields and keep getting them ready for planting.

dag: ni n ni ti yɛn darigi Izraɛlnim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu dahin shɛli, n ni ti saɣim Bɛtɛl sara maligu bimbina, ka ŋme n-kabisi di lɔrisi ni tandaɣa din sansaya la bahi tiŋa.
en: On the day when I punish the people of Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel. The corners of every altar will be broken off and will fall to the ground.

dag: Ka bɛ ba bɔhi ba, So dini ka o lee doli? Ka o bidibisi maa daa wuh o anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa ni doli so shɛli. Ka o yɛl o bidibisi maa.
en: Which way did he go? their father asked them. His sons had seen the way the man of God went when he came from Judah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, n gba ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli noli ti a, n gba ni yɛli noli ti ba. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will bless those who bless you, those who curse you I will curse; all the families of the earth will be blessed because of you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ kabiɛlim maa ʒi n-kuli ti wuh o yidan ma o ni nya shɛm tariga. Ka daa lan zaŋ o ni ŋub ka guui bɔrɔbɔro shɛl la gba ti o.
en: She picked it up and went into town. Her mother-in-law saw what she had gleaned. She brought out what she had left over after eating her fill and gave it to her.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ti chaŋ a ni daa tim ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka di tiŋgbani maa vuhira, di tiwala mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then they gave their report: We entered the land to which you sent us. Its actually full of milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

dag: Yɛlimiya Aakipus ni di niŋ kamaata ni o tum ti Duuma ni ti o tuun shɛl la naai.
en: And tell Archippus, See to it that you complete the ministry that you received in the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, N tum tuma maa paai di tariga, zaŋmi m paɣa maa ti ma ka n zaŋ o niŋ m paɣa.
en: Jacob said to Laban, The time is up, and I want to marry Rachel now.

dag: O mini Ammɔn naa min o niriba daa tuhiya ka o daa nyaŋ ba. Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa ti o anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili ni chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili, ka bɛ daa ti o li lala yuma ata.
en: Jotham also fought against the king of the Ammonites and his army and defeated them. So each year for three years the Ammonites gave Jotham / tons of silver, , bushels of wheat, and , bushels of barley.

dag: Di bi tu ka maligumaana Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun mali dalinli ti mirina ni o ti zaŋ Yawɛ pina maa nyo buɣim mali sara; o ni mali dalinli zuɣu, di bi simdi ni o mirina ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: These men may not serve as my priests and burn sacrifices to me.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim shɛb daa yi Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium na nti lɛbigi niriba maa suhuri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lab Pool kuɣa hal ti tɛhi ni o kpimi ka vu o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga.
en: Some Jewish leaders from Antioch and Iconium came and turned the crowds against Paul. They hit him with stones and dragged him out of the city, thinking he was dead.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n lee ni kuhi ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a ku wum? Bee ka n ni kuhi yɛl a Damli damiya! ka a ku tiligi ti?.
en: Our Lord , how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Apolɔs? Bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Pool? Ti kul nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn sɔŋ ya ka yi niŋ yɛda kaman ti Duuma ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm.
en: Is Apollos so important? Is Paul so important? We are only servants of God who helped you believe. Each one of us did the work God gave us to do.

dag: N tumdila m Ba ni zali ma shɛm ni dunianim baŋ ni n yuri m Ba maa. Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ kpe ha.
en: But the world must know that I love the Father. So I do exactly what the Father told me to do. Come now, lets go.

dag: Ka Omri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa wuhi kpiɔŋ shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of the story about Omri and the great things he did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: The coming of the Son of Man will be like what happened in the time of Noah.

dag: Di saha ka dansarika gula maa kuhi yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm firila na, ka o daa guui kpe ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o ni sɔhira, ka o damdi Pool mini Silas tooni.
en: The jailer called for a light, rushed in, and fell trembling at the feet of Paul and Silas.

dag: Naawuni daa pun lo lahibal suŋ ŋɔ alikauli o daanabinim noya ni ka di yuui, hal ka di yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni.
en: God promised this good news about his Son ahead of time through his prophets in the holy scriptures. His Son was descended from David.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zaŋ Daniɛl n-zali zaashe tital ni; ka ti o pin kara pam; ka zaŋ o leei ŋun su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ fukumsi ni baŋdiba zaa zuɣulana.
en: Then he gave Daniel a high position, presented him with many splendid gifts, put him in charge of the province of Babylon, and made him the head of all the royal advisers.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika ŋ-ŋmɛnŋme li mal li; ka yi mal li piɛbiri laɣindi niriba, ka mal li piɛbiri ka bɛ yiɣisira chana.
en: Make two trumpets. Use silver and hammer it to make the trumpets. These trumpets will be for calling the people together and for telling them when it is time to move the camp.

dag: Yinim bɛn be tiŋ maa vinvamli ni, fabilimiya, dama kɔhigɔriba la zaa kpiya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yi zahindi anzinfa sania zuɣu la kpi.
en: Wail and cry when you hear this, you that live in the lower part of the city, because all the merchants will be dead!.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa jɛra ʒiɛmdila bɛ manima.
en: Wise children make their parents happy. Foolish children bring them shame.

dag: Ninsalinim dabisa pun buɣisimi zali, ka a mi bɛ chira kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyini n-zali bɛ tariga ni nyɛ luɣ shɛli ka bɛ ku tooi yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.

dag: Amaa m bi mi n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm ti n dan Naa Siiza. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o ka yi sanna, di bahi bamdi nyin Naa Agiripa. Ti yi vih o naai, di pa shɛli n ni baŋ n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm;.
en: But I have nothing definite about him to write to the Emperor. So I have brought him here before you—and especially before you, King Agrippa!—so that, after investigating his case, I may have something to write.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋaha puuni ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima; saha kanna ka n ti ku lan yɛli ya shɛli ŋaha puuni, amaa ka ni ti kahigi m Ba yɛla wuhi ya.
en: I have told you these things, using words that hide the meaning. But the time will come when I will not use words like that to tell you things. I will speak to you in plain words about the Father.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli ninvuɣ shɛb sani mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika.
en: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi nti nya ka Izraɛlnim niriba ayi ŋmaligi zabira, ka o chaŋ ni o ti gooi ba ka yɛli, M mabihi, yi nyɛla mabi yinsi, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan ŋmaligi zabira.
en: The next day he came upon some Israelites who were caught up in an argument. He tried to make peace between them by saying, You are brothers! Why are you harming each other.

dag: Ka sapashinnim bɛn daa su chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi maa ni daa nya ka di pala Izraɛl naa maa ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ o.
en: When the commanders saw that he was not King Ahab, they stopped chasing him.

dag: nti zaŋ o leei naa ni o su Giliad mini Ashur ni Jɛziriil ni Ifriim ni Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: There he made him king over Gilead, the Geshurites, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin—over all Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Ɛkan, M bia, paɣimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka ti o jilima, ka yɛli ma a ni tum tuun shɛli, ka di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: Joshua said to Achan, My son, give glory to the LORD the God of Israel. Tell me what you have done. Dont hide anything from me.

dag: Ka zoya daa sɔhigi nyin Yawɛ tooni, nyin ŋun daa yi zahira Sinai Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ, nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni tooni ka di daa sɔhigi maa.
en: The mountains shook before the Lord , the God of Mount Sinai, before the Lord , the God of Israel!.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gili ba tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa, ka bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka maligumaaniba daa piɛbi bɛ kikahi.
en: Judah's army realized they were trapped, and so they prayed to the Lord . The priests blew the signal on the trumpet.

dag: N ku chɛ ka n suhu ŋmaligi ka chɛ din tuhi. N ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I will not be involved in anything dishonest. I will have nothing to do with evil.

dag: Dapaɣili kam daa malila dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tuɣi taba. Bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: There were two side poles joined together with cross pieces to make each frame. Every frame for the Holy Tent was made the same.

dag: M mabihi, chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu kul be kaman m biɛhigu. Ti pun wuhi ya biɛrisuŋ soli, dinzuɣu kpahimmiya nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol li.
en: Brothers and sisters, become imitators of me and watch those who live this way—you can use us as models.

dag: So yi kpi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni, di mi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam be suɣili maa ni mini ŋunkam kpe di ni na ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: This is the rule about those who die in their tents: If someone dies in the tent, everyone in the tent will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Anduru, ka Anduru mini Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: Philip went and told Andrew, and the two of them went and told Jesus.

dag: Ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir ka nyɛ Dauda zɔsimo la daa chaŋ Absalom sani ti yɛl o, Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili! Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili.
en: Then Davids friend Hushai, who was from Erek, approached Absalom and said to him, Long live the king! Long live the king.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Nyama, Abinɛr kala a sanna, ka bɔ niŋ ka a bah o ka o chaŋ?.
en: So Joab went to the king and said to him, What have you done? Abner came to you—why did you let him go like that?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu kpari, dama bɛ daa na bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: They placed him in custody, because it wasnt clear what should be done to him.

dag: ka malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will offer an entirely burned offering as a soothing smell to the LORD: one bull from the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla din viɛla kɔŋko, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla suhuyiɣisili.
en: The desires of the righteous end up well, but the expectations of the wicked bring wrath.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anahi daa nyɛ Nɛtanɛl, ka ŋun pahi anu daa nyɛ Radai.
en: Nethanel was Jesses fourth son. Jesses fifth son was Raddai.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi daa firi bayaɣiti ni n-kɔŋ chandi. Di saha ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo ka chɛ Izraɛlnim maa, dama Yawɛ tuhirila Ijiptinim pahiri bɛ zuɣu.
en: The wheels of the chariots became stuck. It was very hard to control the chariots. The Egyptians shouted, Lets get out of here! The Lord is fighting against us. He is fighting for the Israelites.

dag: M mabihi, Klɔi yiŋnim shɛb daa yɛli ma ni naŋgbankpeeni kpe yi sunsuuni.
en: For some people from Chloe's family have told me quite plainly, my friends, that there are quarrels among you.

dag: Samarianim daa bi tum a daalahichi ŋɔ pirigili, a tum din chihiri gari ba. Ka a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka a mabihi maa ŋmanila wuntizɔriba.
en: Samaria didnt sin even half as much as you did. Youve so outstripped her in multiplying your detestable practices, with all the detestable things youve done, that youve even made your sisters seem innocent.

dag: Ka o daa yul o luɣa ni ka bi nya so, ka daa ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa n-zaŋ o pi bihigu ni.
en: Moses looked around and saw that no one was watching, so he killed the Egyptian and buried him in the sand.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, bɛ ni ti mi o niriba la, Bɛ ni pirigi so namdili yiŋnima.
en: His family will be known in Israel as the family of the man who had his sandal pulled off.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti buɣisi pal yaɣu puuni luɣ shɛli polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la ti be di ni.
en: Beginning with this measurement, you will measure out an area . miles long and . miles wide. The sanctuary, the most holy place, will lie on it.

dag: O teeg o nambɔzɔbo yɛla, ka sɔŋ o dabili Izraɛl.
en: He has kept the promise he made to our ancestors, and has come to the help of his servant Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala shiri gbahi zahim pam, hal ka bɛ lansi maa ti pili chɛhibu;.
en: So they dropped the nets and their catch was so huge that their nets were splitting.

dag: Wɔr fufuhisi la ni daa ti yina, bɛ ni daa kul ŋmɛrimi ni bɛ kaai gili dunia ŋɔ. Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya kaai gili dunia ŋɔ, ka bɛ daa chaŋ.
en: Then the powerful ones approached, intent on going to patrol the earth. He said, Go! Patrol the earth! So they patrolled the earth.

dag: Bɛ yihi laɣ shɛli bɛ ni nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛ tumtumdiba maa.
en: They got the money that was in the Lord s Temple and are paying the supervisors and the workers.

dag: Ka salo maa ni so daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, yɛlimi m biɛli ni o chɛ ka ti pirigi ti ba fali ti taba.
en: One of the men in the crowd said to Jesus, Teacher, our father just died and left some things for us. Tell my brother to share them with me.

dag: Ti suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la maŋmaŋ mini ti Duuma Yisa ni bɛ mali soli ti ti ka ti kana ti kaai ya.
en: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus guide us on our way back to you.

dag: Amaa so yi bɔri ni o ŋme dimbɔŋɔ naŋgbankpeeni, ti ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu, ka Naawuni cheechinim gba lan ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu.
en: Some people may still want to argue about this. But we and the churches of God dont accept what those people are doing.

dag: Kaman niriba ni kul zaŋdi anzinfa mini daanya ni kuriti ni samafuu ni dalima n-niŋdi binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara ni, ka vibiri buɣim niŋdi li ni di nyɛligi shɛm la, lala ka n ti yɛn zaŋ ya niŋ n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili puuni n-nyɛligi ya.
en: I will be like a metalworker who collects that metal from the furnace and melts it down. I will collect the Israelites and blow on them with my fiery anger. They will melt inside the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka di pala mani n-tim ba la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Amaa tɔbu mini kum ni ku anabinim maa.
en: I, the Lord , tell you what I am going to do to those prophets whom I did not send but who speak in my name and say war and starvation will not strike this land—I will kill them in war and by starvation.

dag: Yawɛ sizuura lubu viɛla; ka nyɛ din kul be sahakam. Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka nyɛ wuntia zaa.
en: Learning respect for the Lord is good. It will last forever. The Lord s judgments are right. They are completely fair.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi tinsheenima, yin tɔɣisimiya ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: When you go to attack a city, first give its people a chance to surrender.

dag: Niriba maa zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi bɛ ni ŋooi takɔb shɛli mini bɛ ni vooi tɔb shɛli ni bɛ to barina ni.
en: People are fleeing to escape from swords that are ready to kill them, from bows that are ready to shoot, from all the dangers of war.

dag: A mali nuu ka di be kaman Naawuni nuu? A mali kukoli din ŋmani saa tahibu kaman o kukol la?.
en: Or do you have an arm like God; can you thunder with a voice like him?.

dag: bee so yi gbib kuɣili din ni tooi ku nira, ka di faai lu o kpee zuɣu ku o, ka di mi pala o dima n-nyɛ o, ka o mi di bi pun lo ni o ti o daŋa.
en: Or suppose that, without looking, you throw a stone that kills someone whom you did not intend to hurt and who was not your enemy.

dag: Ka Lɔt min o bipuɣins ayi la daa ti yiɣisi Zɔa n-chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-kpe m-be vokabili ni, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o be Zɔa.
en: Because Lot was afraid to stay in Zoar, he and his two daughters moved up into the hills and lived in a cave.

dag: Amaa ka Naomi yɛli ba, M bihi, labimiya kuli. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔri ni yi doli ma kuli? Yi tɛhiya ni n ni lan tooi dɔɣi bidibisi yaha ka yi kuli ba?.
en: But Naomi said, No, daughters, go back to your own homes. Why should you go with me? I cant have any more sons to be your husbands.

dag: Amaa n nyɛla ŋun be biɛrim mini nandahima ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka a tiliginsim yiko gbibi ma.
en: But I am in pain and despair; lift me up, O God, and save me!.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, a shiri viɛli pam; a nina bemi kaman ŋmana la.
en: Look at you—so beautiful, my dearest! Look at you—so beautiful! Your eyes are doves!.

dag: Bɛ sahi li mi ni bɛ ku niriba, ka so n-neei li ni di nyaɣisira kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga mini tibidarigibo kam zaa, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: It is sharpened to kill, polished to flash like lightning. There can be no rejoicing, for my people have disregarded every warning and punishment.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni mini duumanim zaa Duuma. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm, ŋun bi gaŋdi so bee n-diri birapu.
en: because the LORD your God is the God of all gods and Lord of all lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God who doesnt play favorites and doesnt take bribes.

dag: ka naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin shɛb bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi daa yina n-ka bɛ sanna, ka n nini daa na ʒi n-nya bɛ tatabo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Next, seven skinny, bony cows came up out of the river. I have never seen such terrible looking cows anywhere in Egypt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti be Ɛngɛdi sɔɣisili shee.
en: David left and went to live in the hideouts at En-Gedi.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu na saha ka Yaakubu daa yi Pɛnuɛl chana ka luri wɔbiliwɔbili, o sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: The sun was coming up as Jacob was leaving Peniel. He was limping because he had been struck on the hip.

dag: Di saha ka ti chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na, dama Sool ʒiɛman la ni ti baɣa daa lan ka di ni.
en: Then we will go and get God's Covenant Box, which was ignored while Saul was king.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ gabiga tu o nyee ni bee n-zaŋ goo kuh o yɛno pili yi?.
en: Can you put a rope through his nose or a hook through his jaw?.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ buŋ yɛno kɔbili maa bahi. Ka bɛ daa bol o ni zaŋ li bahi luɣ shɛli maa yuli Ramatilɛhi.
en: Samson tossed the jawbone on the ground and decided to call the place Jawbone Hill. It is still called that today.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni tuhi tɔbu n-di biŋkɔb shɛb la naɣilahi kɔbisiyopɔin mini piɛri tusaayopɔin m-mali sara ti Yawɛ dindali maa.
en: On that day they offered sacrifices to the Lord from the loot they had brought back: seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

dag: N zɔr a mi, ka n ni sɔhira, ka zɔr a saria karibo.
en: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.

dag: Bɛ daa lan ʒini wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli din mini bihigu shee bi wɔɣ ni taba, ka di be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi tiŋgban nɛli ŋ-ŋɔ polo na la. Dama bɛ niɣi daa yɛligiya m-pali Giliad zaa.
en: They also settled in the east as far as the edge of the desert that stretches to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in the land of Gilead.

dag: N yuun kɔbiga ni pisi m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. N lan ka yaa din ni chaŋ shɛli. Ka Yawɛ pun yɛli ma, A ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: telling them: Im years old today. I cant move around well anymore. Plus, the LORD told me You wont cross the Jordan River.

dag: Di ni nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ tooni Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni sahakam yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim ka n tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: You and your descendants must always offer this sacrifice on the altar at the entrance to the sacred tent. People of Israel, I will meet and speak with you there, and my shining glory will make the place holy.

dag: Ka ti zaa daa lu tiŋa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri ma Hiburuli ni, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka? Di to ni a tabigi gɔhi.
en: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice that said to me in Aramaic, Saul, Saul, why are you harassing me? Its hard for you to kick against a spear.

dag: ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo na la.
en: the ones God gathered from various countries, from east and west, north and south.

dag: Naa Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o daa chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka o tuma maa daa zani tariga.
en: When King Baasha heard what was happening, he stopped fortifying Ramah and abandoned the work.

dag: Ka Nabal daa garigi bɔhi Dauda tuumba maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Dauda? Ka ŋuni mi n-lee nyɛ Jɛsi bia? Pumpɔŋɔ daba pam kul zɔrimi ka chɛri bɛ laamba.
en: but Nabal said, Who is David? Who is this son of Jesse? There are many slaves who have run away from their masters these days.

dag: Daba bɛn yi n-zo bɛ laamba sani n-ka yi sanna, yin di lan zaŋ ba labisi ti bɛ laamba maa.
en: If slaves run away and come to you, dont force them to go back to their masters.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ba yi di nyɛ Naawuni yi naan yuri ma, dama o sani ka n yina; pa mmaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka n kana, amaa ŋun Naawuni n-tim ma na.
en: Jesus said to them, If God really were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. I did not come on my own authority, but he sent me.

dag: Zaŋmi Aduna min o bidibisi ni binyɛra la ni bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la ni alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa ni piɛlah ayi ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu.
en: Take Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent of my presence and bring the priestly garments, the anointing oil, the young bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread.

dag: Dinzuɣu pom Yawɛ ni a ti ku ku n zuliya n kalinsi nyaaŋa bee n-kpihim n daŋ birili.
en: But promise me in the Lord 's name that you will spare my descendants, so that my name and my family's name will not be completely forgotten.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a zaligunim mali suhudoo pam; ka binshɛli ku chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu.
en: The people who love your Instruction enjoy peace—and lots of it. Theres no stumbling for them!.

dag: ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa tiri ya ka di nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu ti yi bihi din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: he said to them, You must be sure to pay attention to all the commands I tell you today. And you must tell your children to obey completely the commands in this Law.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Dauda daa niŋ yuun bɔbili ka kurigi pam; ka bɛ daa kul mali chinchin tibisa m-pind o, amaa di zaa yoli, di daa bi kur o wari.
en: King David had become very old. His servants covered him with blankets, but he couldnt stay warm.

dag: N kuhimi hal ti gbarigi, ka n kukoli biɛra, ka n nina niŋ liti, ka n kul guhirila n Naawuni.
en: I am tired of crying. My throat is hoarse. My eyes are exhausted with waiting for my God.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa laɣimna ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Barabas bee Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la.
en: So when the crowd came together, Pilate asked them, Which prisoner do you want me to set free? Do you want Jesus Barabbas or Jesus who is called the Messiah.

dag: Ka so daa yɛli bɛ tab Izraɛlnim la, Nyamiya, Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la mɛla sara maligu bimbini zali Gɛlilɔt Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili polo na din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛl la.
en: But the other Israelites who were still at Shiloh heard about the altar that these three tribes built. They heard that the altar was at the border of Canaan at the place called Geliloth. It was near the Jordan River on Israels side.

dag: Ka Asa daa chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. Ka bɛ zaa daa zani bɛ tɔb gɔri ni Zɛfata din daa be Marɛsha la vinvamli ni.
en: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.

dag: ni Ɛlishama ni Ɛliada ni Ɛlifɛlɛt bɛ daa nyɛla niriba awɛi.
en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

dag: A ni ti kahi a nɛma yina wuntaŋ ni bɛ ninni kaman nira ni yɛn zo kuŋkɔɣim ka kahi o nɛma shɛm la, ka a ti yi bɛ ninni zaawuni kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la.
en: While it is still daylight, pack your bundle for exile, so that they can see you, and then let them watch you leave in the evening as if you were going into exile.

dag: Dama Ɛhab daŋ niriba zaa ni kpi. N ni ku Ɛhab daŋ ni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Every man and boy in Ahab's family must die, whether slave or free.

dag: Ka Maika yɛl o, Kpalimmi n sani leei m ba ni m maligumaana. N ni tir a anzinfa kpila pia yuuni kam, ka tir a situra mini bindirigu pahi.
en: Then Micah said to him, Live with me. Be my father and my priest. I will give you ounces of silver each year. I will also give you clothes and food. The Levite did what Micah asked.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti kum ka fabili, amaa ka dunianim bɛn suhuri ti piɛla; yi suhuri ni ti saɣim, amaa yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa ni ti leei suhupiɛlli.
en: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ŋunkam tum alahichi n sani, dilan yuli ka n ni kpihim litaafi maa ni.
en: The Lord replied, I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.

dag: Di zuɣu ka m boli ya na ni n ti nyan ya ka m mini ya tɔɣisi, dama Izraɛlnim zaa ni mali tahima shɛl la zuɣu ka bɛ lo ma zoligo ŋɔ.
en: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.

dag: ka bɛ ti yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa hal ka so ti ku lan nya tiŋgbani gba. Ka bɛ ti bahi ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa chɛ bindir shɛŋa zali ya la mini yi tihi din be mɔɣu ni.
en: They will cover the landscape so that you wont be able to see the ground. They will eat the last bit of vegetation that was left after the hail. They will eat all your trees growing in the fields.

dag: Dama Sulemaana daa ŋmaligi dolila Sidɔnnim buɣili Asitati din nyɛ paɣ la mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Milikom din nyɛ daɣiri la.
en: Solomon also worshiped Astarte the goddess of Sidon, and Milcom the disgusting god of Ammon.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, n ni chɛ ka zuliya shɛb kana ti lu yi zuɣu. Bɛ ni nahim ya Lɛbohamat dunol la shee zaŋ hal ni Araba kulibɔŋ la ni.
en: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinu Sɔdom puuni, n ni chɛ bɛ taali maa bɛ zuɣu.
en: The LORD said, If I find fifty innocent people in the city of Sodom, I will save it because of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi bidibikpamba bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: there were , of them.

dag: Ka sokam deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri pin shɛŋa maa niriba zaa sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: The Spirit's presence is shown in some way in each person for the good of all.

dag: Shaul bia n-daa nyɛ Shallum, o yaaŋa n-daa nyɛ Mibisam, ka o yaantibichee nyɛ Mishima.
en: Shauls son was Shallum. Shallums son was Mibsam. Mibsams son was Mishma.

dag: Ka Hiburunim bɛn daa pun be Filistianim sani hal ti paai tɔb maa tuhibu saha maa mini bɛn daa pahi doli ba chaŋ bɛ sansani maa ni zaa daa dii ŋmaligi pahi Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zuɣu.
en: Even those Hebrews who had earlier joined up with the Philistines and moved into their camp changed sides to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

dag: N lee yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la ninsal suhu yubu puuni bee lala ka Naawuni zaligu puuni gba yɛli?.
en: These arent just my own thoughts. Gods law says the same thing.

dag: Ka n gbaai yila yilibu n suhu ni yuŋ, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-suhi Naawuni, ka bɔhi n suhu:.
en: I meditate with my heart at night; I complain, and my spirit keeps searching.

dag: N lɔri nia ni n chaŋ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n yi ti chaŋ nimaani, di nyaaŋa n ni gari ka yi sanna.
en: I plan to go through Macedonia, so I will come to you after that.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim zaa daa ti chaŋ Naawuni sani ni bɛ yaa ti mali yuuniyuuni sara la Yawɛ sani, ka pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: The next time Elkanah and his family went to offer their yearly sacrifice, he took along a gift that he had promised to give to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋ Izraɛlnim maa zaa tooni.
en: Then Moses and Aaron bowed to the ground in front of all the people.

dag: Miri ka a bo yomyom n-zaŋ a nuhi pa so zuɣu m-piig o ni o tum ti Duuma tuma; a mi miri ka a chɛ ka a nuu be so daalahichi tumbu ni. Gbib amaŋa m-be kasi.
en: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.

dag: ka Aminadab dɔɣi Nashɔn, ka Nashɔn dɔɣi Salimɔn.
en: Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha a ni gbib bidibiga a nuu ni. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Aai. Wɛi, n dana, a nyɛla Naawuni nira, di yɔhim man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ.
en: Elisha said to her, Next year at this time, you'll be holding your own baby son in your arms. You're a man of God, the woman replied. Please don't lie to me.

dag: Zilim balli nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din chɛ ka nir suhu saɣinda.
en: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, man Naawuni maa ni kul yɛli ni n yɛli shɛli, dina ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: But Micaiah answered, As surely as the LORD lives, I will say only what God tells me to say.

dag: Asirianim yi ti wum Yawɛ kukoli, ka nya o ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, bɛ ni tarigi.
en: The Assyrians will be terrified when they hear the Lord 's voice and feel the force of his punishment.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia ni daa zaɣisi ni tɔbutuhiriba shɛb di dol o chaŋ tɔb maa ni ka kari ba ni bɛ kulim maa daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa, zaŋ Samaria hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn n-daa ku niriba tusaata ka di nɛma pam.
en: Meanwhile, the Israelite army was attacking towns in Judah. They attacked the towns from Beth Horon all the way to Samaria. They killed people and took many valuable things. They were angry because Amaziah didnt let them join him in the war.

dag: M mi ni Ijipti naa maa ku chɛ ka yi chaŋ, naɣila n zaŋla kiŋkansi niŋ o.
en: But I know that the king of Egypt won't let you go unless something forces him to.

dag: n-chɛ ka o suhu ni daashiya zaa yi zahira. Ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka o gban tiŋ jɛm Naawuni, ka yihi yɛli ni Naawuni shiri be yi sani.
en: The secret things in their heart will be made known. So they will bow down and worship God. They will say, Without a doubt, God is here with you.

dag: Ka yɛda niŋbu wunsuhigu ni tiligi bara maa, ka ti Duuma ni yiɣis o; ka o yi tumla alahichi gba, o ni nya di chɛ m-paŋ.
en: Prayer that comes from faith will heal the sick, for the Lord will restore them to health. And if they have sinned, they will be forgiven.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o baŋ ni o bidib tuuli nyɛla o ni bi yur paɣ so la bidibiga maa, ka pirig o ni su shɛli maa ʒiibuyi zuɣu ti o, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ saha bia, ka bituuli tarili nyɛla o dini.
en: Instead, he must acknowledge the unloved wifes son as the oldest male, giving to him two-thirds of everything that he owns, because that son is the earliest produce of his physical power. The oldest males rights belong to that son.

dag: Amaa ka o daa tim bɛ sunsuuni gari chaŋ o chandi.
en: But he walked through the middle of the crowd and went away.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara maligu pam dindali maa, ka niriba maa suhuri paligi pam, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. Ka paɣiba mini bihi gba daa mali suhupiɛlli. Katiŋnim daa wum Jɛrusalɛmnim suhupiɛlli maa damli.
