en: That day many sacrifices were offered, and the people were full of joy because God had made them very happy. The women and the children joined in the celebration, and the noise they all made could be heard for miles.

dag: Ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa ka teeg o bɔɣu n-tum yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm, ka tum alahiziba tuma ka wuhi shihira n-yihi ti Ijipti maa.
en: The LORD brought us out of Egypt with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, with awesome power, and with signs and wonders.

dag: Amaa ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba maa zaa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa bɛn daa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn yi bɛ ni daa kari ba tahi tin shɛŋa ni zaa n-labina ni bɛ ti ʒini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Then Johanan and all the army officers took everybody left in Judah away to Egypt, together with all the people who had returned from the nations where they had been scattered:.

dag: Ka Iso daa je Yaakubu yɛlli, o ba ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ o ni la zuɣu. Ka Iso daa yɛli, Di ku lan yuui ka ti ba kpi, di saha n ni ku n tizo Yaakubu.
en: Esau was furious at Jacob because his father had blessed him, and Esau said to himself, When the period of mourning for the death of my father is over, I will kill my brother.

dag: ka zooi kaman tia ni zoori shɛm. A daa zooya niŋ wɔɣilim m-bi paɣa. A daa yi biha, ka a tooni bili kɔbiri, amaa a daa na bela a zaɣim.
en: I made you grow like a healthy plant. You grew strong and tall and became a young woman. Your breasts were well-formed, and your hair had grown, but you were naked.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi gbahi ba daba.
en: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.

dag: O me o tiŋa n-tam zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: The Lord built his city on the sacred hill;.

dag: Ka salo maa daa vu m-miri Gomna Pailɛt nti yɛl o ni o niŋmi ka o ni yi pun niŋdi ba shɛm la.
en: The people came to Pilate and asked him to free a prisoner as he always did.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Gazanim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋgbɔn muni niriba chaŋ ti ti Ɛdomnima ka bɛ zaŋ ba leei daba.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish the people of Gaza for the many crimes they did. They took an entire nation of people and sent them as slaves to Edom.

dag: O no n-gur o tɔbu kaman o nyɛla ti dima, ka zaŋ o nudirigu tiri ti kaman ti dim la. O ku ti ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyuri bara Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga tanti suɣili puuni la. O chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili yina kaman buɣim la.
en: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.

dag: n ni ti laɣim zuliya kam zaa n-zaŋ ba ti zali Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni. N ni ti kari ba saria nimaani bɛ ni daa niŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim shɛm la zuɣu. Dama bɛ nyɛla n ni su shɛba. Bɛ daa kari ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni, ka pirigi n tiŋgbani ti taba.
en: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land.

dag: Saha paaya ni saria karibu piligi; Naawuni niriba mi n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn daŋ tooni saria karibu maa ni. Ka di yi piligi ti sani, wula ka di ni ti bahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sani?.
en: It is time for judging to begin. That judging will begin with Gods family. If it begins with us, then what will happen to those who dont accept the Good News of God?.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Omri did what the Lord said was wrong. He was worse than all the kings who were before him.

dag: ka wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ o ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa puuni maa zaa, ka bo yuun yini piɛlaa na ti mali sara taali tumbu zuɣu; o ni daa pun niŋ shɛl la din kpalim la yoli, dama daɣiri ta o ni daa pun mal o zuɣu shɛli ka di be kasi la.
en: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni daŋ kam niriba laɣim gbilligbilli, ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Matiri daŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ Matiri daŋ maa ni dɔbba zaa zali, ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Kish bia Sool. Amaa bɛ ni daa ti bɔr o bɛ daa bi nya o.
en: Then Samuel had the families of the tribe of Benjamin come forward, and the family of Matri was picked out. Then the men of the family of Matri came forward, and Saul son of Kish was picked out. They looked for him, but when they could not find him.

dag: A mini naa yi ʒini ni yi di bindirigu, nyin kpahimmi baŋ din ʒe a tooni maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: When you sit down to eat with someone important, keep in mind who he is.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra yɛli, N ni dol a chaŋ, amaa pa nyini nti yɛn nya a chandi maa nasara dibu jilima, dama Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka paɣa n-nyaŋ Sisɛra. Ka Dɛbɔra daa yiɣisi doli Barak chaŋ Kɛdɛshi.
en: All right, I'll go! she replied. But I'm warning you that the Lord is going to let a woman defeat Sisera, and no one will honor you for winning the battle. Deborah and Barak left for Kedesh.

dag: N ni labisi Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daazichi ti ba, ka mali ba zali kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm piligu ni la.
en: I will make Judah and Israel prosperous, and I will rebuild them as they were before.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni ni tum shɛlikam kul ni beni sahakam. So ku tooi zaŋ shɛli pahi di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Naawuni n-tum lala ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa zo o.
en: I know that whatever God does will last forever; its impossible to add to it or take away from it. God has done this so that people are reverent before him.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ miri ma na nti tum tuma kaman maligumaaniba la bee m-miri sara maligu kasi shɛli mini binshɛli din be kasi. Amaa di simdi ka bɛ di vi, ka di wahala shɛlikam bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: They are not to serve me as priests or to go near anything that is holy to me or to enter the Most Holy Place. This is the punishment for the disgusting things they have done.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Nyamiya, n je yi kan shɛŋa yi ni pirita ka zaŋ li diri n niriba nyɛviya maa. N ni dari chihi li yi nuhi ni ka chɛ ka yi ni mal li doli shɛba ni yi di bɛ nyɛviya kaman noonsi la nya bɛmaŋa.
en: Therefore, the LORD God proclaims: Im against the bands that you use to trap human lives. I will tear them from your arms, and I will set free the lives that youve trapped like birds.

dag: Isaka zuliya n-daa pah anahi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The fourth assignment made was for the families of the tribe of Issachar.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi ka wum ka tɔrili be zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbusim, mbusim, mbusim be dunianim zuɣu, malaikanima ata shɛb bɛn kpalim n-na yɛn piɛb bɛ kikahi la zuɣu.
en: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.

dag: Nyama, o kanimina kaman sagbana la, o chɛchɛbunsi ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o yuri zɔri yomyom gari tɔrili. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti bahi yoli.
en: Look, the enemy is coming like clouds. Their war chariots are like a whirlwind, and their horses are faster than eagles. We are lost! We are doomed!.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan ku Ijipti do so ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣirili, ka o wɔɣilim daa gari mita ayi la. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni ka di barilim daa ŋmani kpalua dapua. Amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa o kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: He also killed an Egyptian seven and a half feet tall, who was holding a spear like a weavers beam. Benaiah went down to him with a club, grabbed the spear from the Egyptians hand, and killed him with it.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti laɣim Shilo n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu tanti suɣili la kpa nimaani; ka bɛ ni daa tuhi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa kul doya ka bɛ lihiri li.
en: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zɛrubabɛl, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma; Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba, tummiya tuma maa, m be yi sani.
en: But now don't be discouraged, any of you. Do the work, for I am with you.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Yisa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ ni shɛb yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la.
en: When the people heard the things that Jesus said, some of them said, This man really is the Prophet. .

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yum ayi saha ka o daa ti zahim zahindi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔŋ gom.
en: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzars rule, he had many dreams. The dreams made him anxious, but he kept sleeping.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani kuli. Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda bɛ ni niŋ tuumba maa shɛm, ka o daa tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka Naa daa yɛli tuumba maa, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti lan bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: They were terribly ashamed. When David found out what had happened to his officials, he sent a message that told them, Stay in Jericho until your beards grow back. Then you can come home.

dag: ka Abija daa laɣim dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni din ni tuhi tɔbu ka lan nyɛ bɛn mi tɔb tuhibu ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu. Ka Jɛrɔbɔam mi daa laɣim tɔbutuhiri biinsi bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii ni bɛ tuhi taba.
en: Abijahs army had , brave soldiers. Abijah led that army into battle. Jeroboams army had , brave soldiers. Jeroboam got ready to have a war with Abijah.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmɛla binnɛma maa mini abie tihi pa sunsuuni duu maa dunoya zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa ŋme li pa dukpina maa zuɣu shɛm la. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ dari mali varanda zɔntua maa tooni sambani polo.
en: There were palm trees and winged creatures carved on the doors of the Holy Place, just as there were on the walls. And there was a wooden covering over the outside of the doorway of the entrance room.

dag: Ka Shɛbania mini Jɔshafat ni Nɛtanɛl ni Amasai ni Zakaria ni Bɛnaaya ni Ɛliɛza, bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa nyɛ bɛn yɛn be Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni piɛbiri kikahi. Ka Obɛdɛdom mini Jɛhaya gba daa nyɛ Alikauli Adaka maa dunɔguliba.
en: The priests Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer had the job of blowing trumpets as they walked in front of Gods Holy Box. Obed Edom and Jehiah were the other guards for the Holy Box.

dag: Bɛ kuhirimi niŋdi bɛ manima, Bindirigu mini wain be ya? Bɛ tarigiri luri tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu kaman bɛ nyala dansi la, saha shɛli bɛ ni kpiri niŋdi bɛ manim nuhi ni la.
en: They say to their mothers, Where are grain and wine? while fainting like the wounded in the city streets, while their lives are draining away at their own mothers breasts.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihira, ka na kul wumdi yilli zaɣ bil la yɛtɔɣ kara la. Ka n ni daa na kul lihiri maa, ka n ti nya ka bɛ ku biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la n-zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim ni, ka di di n-saɣim o.
en: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lihi Kɛnnim gba, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛli, Yi biɛhigu shee nyɛla barina ni ka luɣ shɛli. Yi biɛhigu shee maa ŋmanila tiɛɣu din pa kuɣili zuɣu.
en: Then Balaam saw the Kenites and said this: You believe that your country is safe, like a birds nest high on a mountain.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti kpaŋ ka o zaŋ o tahi ti ti nabipuɣiŋga maa, ka o zaŋ o leeg o bia, ka bol o yuli Musa, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kom ni ka n yih o na.
en: After the child had grown up, she brought him back to Pharaohs daughter, who adopted him as her son. She named him Moses, because, she said, I pulled him out of the water.

dag: a ni zaŋ zali zuliya kam zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: which you have prepared in the presence of all peoples:.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di zɔr o; dama n zaŋ o min o niriba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niŋ a nuu ni, niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la shɛm la.
en: But the Lord said to Moses, Dont be afraid of that king. I will allow you to defeat him. You will take his whole army and all his land. Do the same to him as you did to Sihon, the Amorite king who lived in Heshbon.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daai ba luhi kaman bɛ ni yi ŋma tia wula ka di lu shɛm la. O ni luhi karimbaannim mini wɔɣira bɛn be bɛ ni n-dihi ba vi.
en: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti fabili niŋ o ka yɛl o, Wula ka a niŋdi tinim bɛn nyɛ a tumtumdiba ŋɔ lala?.
en: Then the Hebrew foremen went to Pharaoh. They complained and said, We are your servants. Why are you treating us like this?.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Dauda, N ni yiɣisi chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-ka n dan naa sanna ka bɛ ti lo a alikauli, ka di chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri shɛb zaa. Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛbisi Abinɛr ka o kuli ni suhudoo.
en: Abner said to David, My lord and king, let me go bring all the Israelites to you. Then they will make an agreement with you, and you will rule over all Israel, as you wanted. So David let Abner leave in peace.

dag: Amaa di bahi ni mini di biɛma ni kom din ti ku niŋ nyaɣisim. Din ti kul yɛn nyɛla din mali yalim.
en: But the swamps and small marshes will not become fresh. They will be left for salt.

dag: Dama n yi suhuri Naawuni tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛl ni, n shia n-suhiri maa, amaa di ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ m milinsi polo.
en: If I pray in a different language, my spirit is praying, but my mind does nothing.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi yɛnnim vi. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba chaŋ ka di gari ba. Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu ŋɔ, yɛm bɔ ka bɛ lan mali?.
en: The wise will be shamed and shocked when they are caught. Look, they have rejected the LORDs word; what kind of wisdom is that?.

dag: Dama n ni tibi yi dansi maa, ka tin ya alaafee, dama bɛ lihi ya la bɛn ka so. Ziɔn ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ bɛ baɣa ka maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will restore your health, and I will heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because you were labeled an outcast, Zion, the lost cause.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi. A baɣiri ni ka n yɛn sɔɣi hal ka din tahiri saɣiŋgu ŋɔ na ti gari.
en: Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful, because I come to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings I find protection until the raging storms are over.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa siɣina Sinai Zoli maa kpaakpaanyom ni nti boli Musa du zoli maa kpaakpaanyom maa ni, ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to come up to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, kom yi nuzaa polo zɔrina ni di ti leei kokpɛɣu. Di ni ti lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛlikam din be di ni, ka lim tiŋ maa ni bɛn be di ni. Niriba ni ti kum pam, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa ti fabili.
en: I, the Lord , tell you that your land will be flooded with an army from the north. It will destroy your towns and sweep you away, moaning and screaming.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Zaŋm tɔbbihi zaa yiɣisi chaŋ Ai; nyama, n zaŋ Ai naa min o niriba ni o tiŋ maa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Take all the soldiers with you and go on up to Ai. Don't be afraid or discouraged. I will give you victory over the king of Ai; his people, city, and land will be yours.

dag: Amaa pihimiyala kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba kaman bɛ daŋ dɔɣirikpamba yuya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I will show you what land to give each tribe, and they will receive as much land as they need, according to the number of people in it.

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa zaŋ Babilɔnnim mini Kutanim ni Avanim ni Hamatinim ni Sɛfarivaimnim na nti ʒili Samaria fɔntinsi ni ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Ka niriba maa daa deei Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ m-be di fɔntinsi ni.
en: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.

dag: Maligumaanitali tuma yi taɣi, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni zaligu gba taɣi.
en: And when a different kind of priest comes, then the law must be changed too.

dag: Bɛ daa wɔbirila giŋgaɣiri mini tuturi vari ni sɔɣu jila ŋ-ŋubira.
en: They pulled up the plants of the desert and ate them, even the tasteless roots of the broom tree!.

dag: N ŋmanila dabili ŋun ʒe o dan tooni. Wula ka n ni tooi tɔɣisi n dan yɛtɔɣa? Ya buriginli bee vuhim lan ka n ni.
en: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Dofika maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Alushi.
en: They left Dophkah and camped at Alush.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi Nimshi bia Jɛhu zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa; ka lan booi kpam bahi Shafat ŋun nyɛ Ɛbɛlimɛhola nir la bia Ilaisha zuɣu ni, ka o mi leeg anabi zani a zaani.
en: anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king of Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.

dag: Yisa daa lola noli biɛɣ pihinahi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: Jesus ate nothing for days and nights. After this, he was very hungry.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa piila din nyɛ jɛrilim dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yɛnnim vi; ka daa pii din nyɛ bin chɔɣima dunia ŋɔ ni ni o zaŋ li dihi yikolaannim vi;.
en: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va ba duhiduhi, ka bɛ nyɔni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The dead frogs were placed in piles, and the whole country began to stink.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Samsin chaŋ ni o ti puh o paɣ maa alikama chɛbu saha, ka ʒi bubil polli mali ni o ti ti o paɣ maa. Ka Samsin daa ti yɛl o paɣ maa ba, N ni kpe m paɣ sani. Amaa ka o paɣ ba maa bi saɣi;.
en: Later on, at the time of the wheat harvest, Samson went to visit his wife, bringing along a young goat. He said, Let me go into my wifes bedroom. But her father wouldnt allow him to go in.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan chɛ ka tɔɣisigu niŋ o mini Izraɛl naa sunsuuni.
en: Jehoshaphat made peace with Israels king.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bah o niriba noli, ka bɛ zaŋ Ibram min o paɣa ni o ni mali binshɛlikam zaa yihi soli.
en: So the king told his men to let Abram and Sarai take their possessions and leave.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛli ya, amaa n lee bi bɔri ni n zaŋ tadabo sab li pa gbaŋ zuɣu tin ya. M mali tahima ni n ni kana ti kaai ya, ka m mini ya nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi, ka di chɛ ka ti nya suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: I have much to say to you. But I dont want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to come visit you. Then we can be together and talk. That will make us very happy.

dag: O ku chɛ ka a napɔŋ pihigi; ŋun gul a maa bi gbihira.
en: God wont let your foot slip. Your protector wont fall asleep on the job.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Gɛhaazi, Malim shili kpuɣi n jaaŋgbee ŋɔ chaŋ. A yi ti nya so sol ni, nyin di puh o; ka so yi puh a, nyin di saɣi. A yi ti paai, nyin zaŋmi n jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni.
en: Gehazi, get ready and go to her house, Elisha said. Take along my walking stick, and when you get there, lay it on the boy's face. Don't stop to talk to anyone, even if they try to talk to you.

dag: Dama daliri din chɛ ka Masia daa kpi ka lan neei kum ni nyɛla ni di chɛ ka o leei bɛn kpi mini bɛn ne Duuma.
en: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.

dag: a yi bo li kaman anzinfa la, ka bo li ni nimmoo kaman azichi shɛli din sɔɣi la.
en: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.

dag: Ka Makiri zuliya ni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa bia daa chaŋ ti liri Giliadnima ŋ-ŋme n-deei li ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani la.
en: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.

dag: Ka ti yi nyɛla Naawuni bihi, dindina ti nyɛla o bindiriba. Ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ Naawuni bindiriba, tinim dee min o yi laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka ti min o ti laɣim nya jilima.
en: But if we are children, we are also heirs. We are Gods heirs and fellow heirs with Christ, if we really suffer with him so that we can also be glorified with him.

dag: Yawɛ di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa, amaa lee saami kpan shɛli din sa o zuɣusaa ŋɔ ka kpuɣ o ko gaɣili ŋɔ ka ti chaŋ.
en: But I pray that the Lord never lets me hurt the Lord s chosen king. Now pick up the spear and water jug by Sauls head and lets go.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka a nuu pa ŋun be a nudirigu polo la zuɣu, ŋun nyɛ a ni ti so kpiɔŋ ti amaŋ la.
en: Reach out and help your chosen one. Reach out to the people you raised up.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti paai Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Saika la. Tiŋ maa daa mirila pu shɛli Yaakubu ni daa zaŋ ti o bia Yisifu la.
en: He came to a Samaritan city called Sychar, which was near the land Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni ti ti suhudoo; dama yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-chɛ ka ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Lord , you have succeeded in doing everything we tried to do, so give us peace.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o paɣ min o bidibisi balisi buŋa n-labi Ijipti, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee la gbib o nuu ni.
en: So Moses took his wife and his children, put them on a donkey, and went back to the land of Egypt. Moses also carried the shepherds rod from God in his hand.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Tahat maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Tɛra.
en: They left Tahath and camped at Terah.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl kpamba maa zaa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti pun pola Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka lo ba alikauli maa, dinzuɣu ti ku tooi niŋ ba shɛli pumpɔŋɔ.
en: but they answered, We have made our solemn promise to them in the name of the Lord God of Israel. Now we cannot harm them.

dag: Juda ni daa nya o, o daa tɛhiya ni o nyɛla pagɔrili, dama o daa zaŋla sariga m-pil lims o ninni.
en: When Judah came along, he did not recognize her because of the veil. He thought she was a prostitute.

dag: Ka Imɛr bia Zadok daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Shɛkania bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa guli Wulimpuhili polo Dunɔdal la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti pii wuntizɔr so Dauda daŋ ni, ka o ti di nam n-zaŋ yɛm su niriba, ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntitali tuma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will raise up a righteous descendant from Davids line, and he will rule as a wise king. He will do what is just and right in the land.

dag: A bahi ti dimnim yoli zaa; ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia ka nyɛ Kabiziil nir la gba daa nyɛla suhukpeendan ŋun tum tuun kara. Ŋuna n-daa ku Mɔabnim wɔɣiri kɔba ayi, ka daa ti lan siɣi bɔɣili ni ti ku gbuɣinli paɣili ni daa kpe dahin shɛl la.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada from Kabzeel was another famous soldier; he did many brave deeds, including killing two great Moabite warriors. He once went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

dag: A ni vihi m binshɛɣukam zaa ni maa, a yiŋ bimbɔ ka a nya di ni? Zaŋm li zali n dɔɣiriba min a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ ninni, ka bɛ baŋ ti ni ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: Now that you have searched through all my belongings, what household article have you found that belongs to you? Put it out here where your men and mine can see it, and let them decide which one of us is right.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kuhi niŋ Musa; ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ka buɣim maa kpi.
en: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.

dag: Yimiya Babilɔn; zomiya ka chɛ ba. Tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu n-yɛli di yɛla. Ka mol li ka dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nim wum li. Yɛlimiya, Yawɛ tilig o dabili Yaakubu zuliya.
en: My people, leave Babylon! My people, run from the Chaldeans! Tell the news with joy. Spread the news around the world. Tell them, The Lord rescued his servant Jacob.

dag: Ka teeku maa kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei ʒim, ka teeku maa ni binnɛma zaa pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim kpi, ka ŋarima din daa pa teeku maa kom zuɣu diba ata kam puuni zaɣ yini saɣim.
en: And a third of the created beings in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

dag: Ɛzra ni daa suhiri n-kahigiri bɛ daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka kumdi ka luri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tooni shɛm maa, ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi pam daa laɣim o sani. Bɛ gba daa kumiya pam.
en: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa pun bahi noli ni so yi mi Yisa ni be shɛli, ŋun nyihim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaag o.
en: The chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone knew where Jesus was, he must report it, so that they could arrest him.

dag: Ti daa wolisirimi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu, amaa ka ti lee bi dɔɣi shɛli. Ti bi di nasara; ti mi bi dɔɣi so ni o zani ti zaani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: We were pregnant, we writhed, but we gave birth to wind. We have achieved no victories on earth; the inhabitants of the earth never fall.

dag: Yawɛ, pa tinima, pa tinima, amaa a yuli ka ti tiri jilima, a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu.
en: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan liri vinvamli ni nim maa n-lan tuhi ba, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Philistines attacked the people living in the Valley of Rephaim again.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la daa lo nia ni o liri Jɔram. Di saha maa Jɔram mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa pun dola Ramɔtigiliad n-gu Siria Naa Hazaɛl;.
en: So Jehu son of Jehoshaphat, son of Nimshi, made plans against Joram. At that time Joram and the Israelites had been trying to defend Ramoth Gilead from King Hazael of Aram.

dag: ka tum birigi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka bi doli n zalikpana la.
en: if they break my laws and ignore my commands.

dag: Amaa yinim yiɣisimi lu n niriba zuɣu kaman yi dimnim la. Yi darigi fuɣi suhudoolan binyɛrigu, ka darigi fuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn garita ka bi lan tɛhiri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla binyɛra.
en: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.

dag: Nir yi gbilisi tibili wum saɣisigu viɛnyɛliŋga, bɛ ni kal o pahi yɛnnim ni.
en: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.

dag: ka lan fari pakoya yinsi, ka suhiri Naawuni yuuri ni niriba tɛhi ni bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ suma la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam.
en: But they cheat widows and take their homes. Then they try to make themselves look good by saying long prayers. God will punish them very much.

dag: Ʒiɛmiya anzinfa! Ʒiɛmiya salima! Azichi maa ka tariga, ka bin suma pam beni.
en: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The city is full of treasure!.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa lee be ya? Wuhim ti a yura maa ni kpa shɛli polo ka ti bo o sɔŋ a.
en: Most beautiful of women, tell us where he has gone. Let us help you find him.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu lan yɛli ba, Di kul nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: Joseph replied: It's like I said. You're spies.

dag: Niriba ayi maa ni daa ti ŋmaligi chani saha shɛli ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini. Ŋun Pita daa ʒi o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: Moses and Elijah were about to leave, when Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah. But Peter did not know what he was talking about.

dag: ka daa zaŋ a dan maa yili ti a, ka zaŋ o paɣiba ti a, ka zaŋ Izraɛl mini Juda ti a pahi. Ka dimbɔŋɔ yi di pɔra, n naan ti a din gari lala pahi.
en: I gave your masters house to you, and gave his wives into your embrace. I gave you the house of Israel and Judah. If that was too little, I would have given even more.

dag: Dinzuɣu Filistianima, bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la, di yi pa lala, yi ni leei Hiburunim maa daba kaman bɛ ni yi nyɛ yi daba shɛm la; bamiya zani kaman dɔbba la n-tuhi ba.
en: Pull yourselves together and act like men, Philistines! Otherwise, youll serve the Hebrews like theyve been serving you. Act like men and fight.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Zadok bia, ka o yuli booni Jɛrusha.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king, and he ruled for sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jerusha; she was Zadoks daughter.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa nyaaŋa, ka Sintani kpe ŋun Judas suhu ni. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋmi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛli maa yomyom.
en: Right then Satan took control of Judas. Jesus said, Judas, go quickly and do what you have to do.

dag: Nyama, m pɔri pam. Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi garig a? N ni zaŋ n nuhi pɔbi n noli.
en: Who am I to answer you?.

dag: bee o tizɔpaɣ ŋun na ʒi doo, .
en: his unmarried sister.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The word of the LORD of heavenly forces came to me.

dag: Yisa tuumba maa daa wuhiri shihira pam, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa niriba sani; ka yɛdaniŋdib la zaa daa laɣim be Sulemaana Kazala ni.
en: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.

dag: Wuhibunim ŋɔ yirila ninvuɣ yɔhindiba bɛn nyɛ ʒirinima, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha diɣilim kaman kur tulli n-tabili li n-di li la sanna.
en: Such teachings are spread by deceitful liars, whose consciences are dead, as if burnt with a hot iron.

dag: ka lan nyɛ zuɣusaa neesim din ne dunia ni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: They will be lights in the dome of the sky to shine on the earth. And thats what happened.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ li pah o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb ka fa bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa shɛŋa la zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ. O ni daa fa li tin shɛŋa nim sani n-nyɛ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknima.
en: King David dedicated them for use in worship, along with the silver and gold he took from the nations he conquered—Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ dabu gbaŋ maa ti Nɛria bia Baruk maa nyaaŋa, ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: After I had given the documents to Baruch, Neriahs son, I prayed to the LORD.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa nim daa pun baŋ ni Mɔdɛkai mali yiko pam nayili, ka o yiko maa mi kul pahirimi.
en: Everyone in the provinces knew that the king had promoted him and had given him a lot of power.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yiko daa kpe Ilaija ni, ka o voog o shɛlɔrigu lo n-zo n-daŋ Ɛhab tooni ti paai Jɛziriil dunɔdali gbini.
en: The power of the Lord came on Elijah; he fastened his clothes tight around his waist and ran ahead of Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, a wuhiri ba ni a gba bela kasi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, a wuhiri ba a ninkuunsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: With all who are sincere you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka kum ku bɛ bihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ paɣiba leei pakoya ni bɛn kɔŋ bɛ bihi. Chɛ ka alɔbo ku bɛ dɔbba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ nachimba tɔbu ni.
en: So now make their children starve to death! Let their enemies kill them with swords. Let their wives lose their children and husbands. Let their men die from disease, and let their young men be killed in battle.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka Sintani dii kana nti yihi yɛligu shɛli din lu bɛ suhuri ni maa.
en: Some people are like the seeds that fall along the path; as soon as they hear the message, Satan comes and takes it away.

dag: Ka Ibram ni daa ti kpe Ijipti, Ijiptinim daa shiri nyaya ka paɣ maa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: So when Abram went into Egypt, the Egyptian men saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb yaha, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni m pun mali bindirigu dibu shili; ka pun ku naɣilahi mini naɣipol kpaba, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, dinzuɣu ni bɛ kam amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na.
en: Then the king sent some more servants. He said to them, I have already invited the people. So tell them that my feast is ready. I have killed my best bulls and calves to be eaten. Everything is ready. Come to the wedding feast.

dag: Bia maa ni daa kul ŋmaligi naai, di daa bi yuui ka Dauda yi kuɣa maa lɔŋni na nti lu n-gbani n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka silim o zuɣu buta; ka bɛ va m-bibigi taba, ka kum niŋ taba. Dauda n-daa kum pam gari Jɔnatan.
en: After the boy had gone, David got up from beside the mound and bowed very low three times. Then he and Jonathan kissed each other and cried, but David cried louder.

dag: O chɛ ka n zaŋla n nyina ŋubiri kuɣichaɣila, ka chɛ ka n kɔri tampiligim puɣi mmaŋa.
en: He crushed my teeth into the gravel; he pressed me down into the ashes.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, ka ti zaa ti ŋma dari na nti me duri pahi beni. Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Chamiya.
en: Lets go to the Jordan River and each get a log from there. Then we can make a place to live there. Elisha said, Do it.

dag: Dama a deei talima a mabihi sani ka di ka daliri, ka deei bɛ situra sɔŋ ka chɛ ba bɛ zaɣim.
en: Maybe to guarantee loans you took things from people for no reason. Maybe you took a poor mans clothes to make sure he paid you back.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a, nyin ninsala, ni a ŋme Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni? Duɣu ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a me ma lala.
en: But who are you, my friend, to talk back to God? A clay pot does not ask the man who made it, Why did you make me like this.

dag: So yi kɔhi yili bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni, o ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuun muni nyaaŋa, dama di yi paai yuun muni o mali soli ni o yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.

dag: N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔɣi bihi n-nabi pahi, ka n kul gbibi n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la.
en: Then I will turn to you. I will let you have many children. I will keep my agreement with you.

dag: amaa saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka Naawuni jɛmdi maŋa ni ti jɛm ti Ba Naawuni ni bɛ shihi zaa ni yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ tatabo ka ti Ba Naawuni bɔri ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: But the time is coming and is already here, when by the power of God's Spirit people will worship the Father as he really is, offering him the true worship that he wants.

dag: Saha shɛli naa ni daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka Lɛvi zuliya do so daa zaŋ o mam ŋun yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee din be katiŋa.
en: Before kings ruled Israel, a Levite was living deep in the hill country of the Ephraim tribe. He married a woman from Bethlehem in Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhu Naawuni, ka daa kpalim be nimaani yuŋ zaa suhiri Naawuni.
en: During that time, Jesus went out to the mountain to pray, and he prayed to God all night long.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daadamnim zaa, kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya! N kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: So all you people in faraway places, turn to me and be saved, because I am God, and there is no other.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa yi bɛ sansani maa ni na chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli.
en: Then Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the leaders of the people went out of the camp to meet with the soldiers.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe Pita yiŋa n-nya ka Pita deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ bii ka o doya;.
en: Jesus went home with Peter and saw Peters mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi puhina m-bii ni tulim n-kpe mɔri, di puma kpahirimi lu ka di viɛlim gba kpaai. Lala ka azichilana gba ni ti kpaai o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni, tɔbbihi bɛn daa mali tɔbutuhiri nɛma balibu kam, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu saha shɛlikam, ka daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Dauda ni suhuyini kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinu.
en: from Zebulun, , experienced troops, armed for battle with all the weapons of war, to help with undivided loyalty.

dag: Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni noli ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Naawuni la, yi bi teei Naawuni suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu shɛm la yɛla? Ka di pala Ɛkan kɔŋko n-daa kpi o daalahichi maa tumbu zuɣu. .
en: Didnt Achan, Zerahs son, do such a disrespectful thing with the items reserved for God? Wrath came on the entire community of Israel. And he wasnt the only one to die for his crime.

dag: Yɛlim Shɛmaya ŋun nyɛ Nɛhilam nir la.
en: Also give a message to Shemaiah from the Nehelam family.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo, ka di kpihim tuun sun shɛŋa n ni tum ti n Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di tuma ŋɔ.
en: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kulima! A bia maa ni gali. Ka zuɣulan maa daa niŋ Yisa ni yɛl o shɛm maa yɛda, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Jesus said to him, Go; your son will live! The man believed Jesus' words and went.

dag: Siprɛs tihi ni ti bili zani gɔhi zaashee. Ka ti shɛli bɛ ni booni mitil la mi ti bili suligunyinyari zaashee. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ shihirili shɛli din ni beni sahakam ka ku vuui.
en: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord .

dag: ni Dɔri naa ni Goiim naa.
en: the king of Dor in Naphath-dor one.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ yi biɛhigu shee bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ zim kuruwa ayi malina, ka bɛ ti zaŋ gahi. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka yi ti niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, ka di leei bindir tuuli shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: From wherever you live, you will bring two loaves of bread as an uplifted offering. These must be made of two-tenths of an ephah of choice flour, baked with leaven, as early produce to the LORD.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ti bela yi nuu ni; niŋmiya ti yi ni nya ka di simdi ni yi niŋ ti shɛm.
en: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni saɣim ninvuɣ biɛri yiko, amaa n ni pahi wuntizɔriba yiko.
en: God says: I will demolish every bit of the wickeds power, but the strength of the righteous will be lifted up.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa deei Naawuni noli o ni daa yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ti o la ni; ka o daa yiɣisi omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbaai chandi, hal ka ʒi o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa.
en: By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to a place that he was going to receive as an inheritance. He went out without knowing where he was going.

dag: A zaŋ a yiko nuu tilig a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu mini Yisifu zuliya la.
en: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.

dag: Bee miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye a kpee yili zuɣu bee o puu zuɣu bee o dabili ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa bee o naɣilaa bee o buŋa bee a kpee ni su binshɛlikam zuɣu.
en: Do not desire another man's wife; do not desire his house, his land, his slaves, his cattle, his donkeys, or anything else that he owns.

dag: Ka mmaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ o ʒili tiŋgbani maa ni. Ka Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni ti nya nambɔzɔbo n sani, ka n ni ti yɛli Panniriba, Yi nyɛla n niriba; ka bɛ mi ni ti yɛli, Nyini n-nyɛ ti Naawuni. .
en: I will sow her many seeds on her land. To Lo-Ruhamah, I will show mercy. To Lo-Ammi, I will say, You are my people. And they will say to me, You are our God.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la daa bi sabi zalila ti yab Ibrahimma kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: These words were written not only for Abraham.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya o ninni, ka o yuli ni ti sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: They will see his face. Gods name will be written on their foreheads.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni tooi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, ka ti deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma maa;.
en: Yes, we are! James and John answered. Then Jesus replied, You certainly will drink from the cup from which I must drink. And you will be baptized just as I must!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmahi abie tihi wula din mali vari n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli ka kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Izraɛlnim Naa ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika.
en: they took palm branches and went out to greet him. They shouted, Hooray! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel.

dag: Ŋun mali tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, o bi mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima, amaa o mal li tɔɣisirila Naawuni, dama o tɔɣisirila yɛlisɔɣira Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka so bi mi o ni tɔɣisiri yɛl shɛŋa maa gbinni.
en: This is because those who speak in a tongue dont speak to people but to God; no one understands it—they speak mysteries by the Spirit.

dag: di simdi ni yi bo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga.
en: Using the official measure, collect five shekels of silver for each of the people. Collect that silver from the Israelites.

dag: Daba anii dali ka Musa daa boli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛl kpamba na.
en: On the eighth day, Moses called for Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ paɣ so ŋun bala: Ka so yɛl o, Iliam bia Batishiiba ŋun nyɛ Yuria Hiti nir la paɣa m-bala.
en: David sent someone and inquired about the woman. The report came back: Isnt this Eliams daughter Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah the Hittite.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-bo li ti ba. Ŋuna n-niŋ lala ni o vuui bɛ barinyubo shɛli bɛ ni nyuri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni tum shɛli polo la, ka dihi bɛ ni tibigi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni vi.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces planned it, to defile the pride of all beauty, to shame all the honored of the earth.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the God of gods! His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yo Babilɔn mini di niriba zaa bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la samli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: I will repay Babylon and all its inhabitants for the terrible things they have done to Zion in your sight, declares the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa tiligi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord , and he rescued you.

dag: Naaman ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa sapashin kpɛma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali, ka mali jilima pam o naa maa sani, dama o zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa tiri Sirianim nasara. O daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhir biiŋa; amaa ka kɔŋ lee mal o.
en: Naaman was the commander of the Syrian army. The Lord had helped him and his troops defeat their enemies, so the king of Syria respected Naaman very much. Naaman was a brave soldier, but he had leprosy.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mini Yisa daa laɣim diri maa gbaai bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi yɛra taba, Ŋun mi n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ti chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba.
en: The others sitting at the table began to say to themselves, Who is this, who even forgives sins.

dag: O mabia Hɛlɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔfa mini Imna ni Shɛlɛsh ni Amal.
en: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb zaa ka va anzinfa mini salim shɛŋa la pahi di zuɣu ti Yawɛ.
en: David gave these to the Lord , just as he had done with the silver and gold that he had captured from.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla n nam ʒiishee, ka tiŋgbani mi nyɛ n napɔntamdigu. Ka yil bɔ ka yi lee yɛn me n-ti ma? Bee luɣ shɛli be dunia ŋɔ ni ka n ni ʒini nimaani vuhi?.
en: The Lord says, Heaven is my throne, and the earth is where I rest my feet. So do you think you can build a house for me? Do I need a place to rest?.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lab kpe saria karibu shee maa ka boli Yisa na ti bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Pilate went back into the palace and called Jesus. Are you the king of the Jews? he asked him.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi di mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi naan tooi yɛli sinsabiga ŋɔ ni di vuɣim di zaashee ŋɔ chaŋ ti zani teeku ni, ka di di niŋ lala.
en: Jesus replied: If you had faith no bigger than a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this mulberry tree to pull itself up, roots and all, and to plant itself in the ocean. And it would!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa ti be puu maa ni zaawun mahili saha n-chani ginda, ka doo maa min o paɣ maa wum o damli, ka zo nti sɔɣi puu maa ni tihi ni ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ di nya ba.
en: During the cool part of the day, the Lord God was walking in the garden. The man and the woman heard him, and they hid among the trees in the garden.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, ŋuni n-lee yɛn zɔn ya nambɔɣu? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni fabili yi zuɣu? Ŋuni n-lee ni zani ni o bɔhi yi daalaafee yɛla?.
en: No one will feel sorry for you, city of Jerusalem. No one will be sad and cry for you. No one will go out of their way to even ask how you are.

dag: Dama yi mi wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa ni zali ti shɛm puuni la yɛla.
en: You know all that we told you to do by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ? Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Yiɣisim bahi paai Damaskus tiŋ puuni, nimaani ka bɛ ni ti wuh a n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: I asked, What shall I do, Lord? and the Lord said to me, Get up and go into Damascus, and there you will be told everything that God has determined for you to do.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a wumdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛr a, Nyama, Dauda lo a zaɣ biɛɣu la yɛtɔɣa.
en: David said to Saul, Why do you listen when people say, David plans to hurt you?.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi lo ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni alikauli, naɣ wurimmiyala bɛ buɣa bimbina la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n ni zali ya shɛm maa niŋbu. Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa?.
en: You must not make any covenant with the people who live in this land. You must tear down their altars. But you have not done what I told you. You have done just the opposite!.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o yuli; malimiya soli ti ŋuna ŋun be sagbana ni n-chani maa. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ, maliya suhupiɛlli o sani!.
en: Sing to God, sing praises to his name; prepare a way for him who rides on the clouds. His name is the Lord —be glad in his presence!.

dag: Amaa di ni kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣa mini yuya ni yimaŋmaŋ zaligu yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku di di saria. Yimaŋmaŋ malimiya li.
en: However, since these are squabbles about a message, names, and your own Law, deal with them yourselves. I have no desire to sit in judgment over such things.

dag: Ka o daa ti lihi nya kɔbiliga ka di do mɔɣu ni, ka piɛri tiɣisi do ʒii buta gil li, dama kɔbiliga maa ni kom ka bɛ daa ŋɔŋdi nyuhiri ba, ka kuɣ yɛlinli daa pa di noli zuɣu.
en: Suddenly he came upon a well out in the fields with three flocks of sheep lying around it. The flocks were watered from this well, which had a large stone over the opening.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti yi Jɛrusalɛm chana, ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la chirig o sol ni. Anabi Ahija daa yɛla binyɛr palli; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kɔŋko daa be mɔɣu maa ni chana.
en: One day, as Jeroboam was traveling from Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh met him alone on the road in the open country.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa chaŋ ti liri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali ti paai Samaria n-daa teei gil li hal ka di ti paai yuma ata.
en: Shalmaneser invaded Israel and attacked the city of Samaria for three years.

dag: ni Hivinim ni Arikinim ni Sinitinim.
en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tim ti boli Yisahaku na ti bɔh o, O nyɛla a paɣa; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa? Ka Yisahaku garigi yɛl o, N tɛhimi ni n yi yɛli ni m paɣa m-bala, bɛ ni ku ma o zuɣu.
en: Abimelech called him in and said, Rebekah must be your wife! Why did you say she is your sister? Because I thought someone would kill me, Isaac answered.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛlikam zaa maa.
en: So Aaron and his sons did everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Mani m-mi o, dama n yila o sanna, ŋun mi n-nyɛ ŋun tim ma na.
en: but I know him, because I come from him and he sent me.

dag: Chɛliya ka m bɔhi ya bin yini ŋɔ kɔŋko yɛla: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini di yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa?.
en: I just want to know this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by doing the works of the Law or by believing what you heard?.

dag: Naawuni daa ti tim tuun so ŋun yuli booni Jɔn na.
en: There was a man named John, who was sent by God.

dag: N ni ti yɛn chɛ a yiŋ ŋɔ ni do so ka o be n sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nya biɛrim o suhu ni, ka kum hal ka o nina ti fulim, ka niriba ti zaŋ takɔbi ku a yiŋnim zaa.
en: There is only one man I will save to serve as priest at my altar. He will live until his eyes wear out and his strength is gone. But all of your descendants will die by the sword.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya, alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa, ninsalinim ni tooi nya di taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani, amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: For this reason I tell you: people can be forgiven any sin and any evil thing they say; but whoever says evil things against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

dag: Ka Amasa daa kpi n-do o ʒim ni solɔɣu maa zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam daa yi kana ti nya o, dilan kpalindimi zani. Ka doo maa ni daa nya ka niriba kanna ti kpalindi zaani maa, ka o daa vuui Amasa solɔɣu maa zuɣu nti sɔŋ mɔri ni, ka zaŋ binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: Amasa was still rolling in his own blood in the middle of the road. The soldier who had shouted noticed that everyone who passed by would stop, so he dragged Amasa off the road and covered him with a blanket.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, bɛ ni shɛb bɛn yɛn kpalim beni ni bemi kaman dachɔhira la yi nina ni, ka be kaman gɔhi n-kuhiri yi luɣa ni, ka ni muɣisi ya pam yi ni yɛn be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa.
en: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yaɣili kam zuliya yɛtɔɣa ni mini bɛ sabbu ni nyɛ shɛm puuni n-ti o tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nima n-yɛli ni yidan kam n-nyɛ o yiŋ zuɣulana. Ka o yɛligu simdi ni di zani.
en: To each of the royal provinces he sent a message in the language and the system of writing of that province, saying that every husband should be the master of his home and speak with final authority.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa zaŋ Absalom so leei ti naa maa kpi tɔb ni. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ naa maa zaŋbuna polo.
en: And Absalom, the one we anointed over us, is dead in battle. So why do you say nothing about bringing the king back.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ suma nirilim, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nia biɛri, o wuhiya ni bɛ mali taali.
en: The Lord is pleased with good people, but condemns those who plan evil.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi kaman kurimbuni ha binyɛra buɣisibu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: These are the measurements he used for building the foundation of Gods Temple, using the old cubit. The foundation was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: n-zaŋ li na ti zali Sool min o tumtumdiba maa tooni ka bɛ di, ka daa yiɣisi kuli yuŋ maa.
en: She served this to Saul and his servants, and they ate. They got up and left that very night.

dag: yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛligu! Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli zoya mini daboya ni yilima ni vinvama shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa ni zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-saɣim yi buɣa jɛmbu shee la.
en: Say: Hear the LORD Gods word, mountains of Israel! The LORD God proclaims to the mountains and hills, to the valleys and their deepest ravines: Im about to bring a sword against you and destroy your shrines.

dag: Nir ni ti zaŋ tɔbu mini piɛma kpe nimaani ni o ti go mɔɣu, dama gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: Only those with bows and arrows will go there, because the entire land will become thorns and thistles.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bɔh o, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yɛliya ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: The disciples asked Jesus, Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n yuli m-bala. M bi zaŋdi n jilima tiri so. M mi bi zaŋdi m paɣibu tiri binnana.
en: I am the LORD; that is my name; I dont hand out my glory to others or my praise to idols.

dag: Ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun kpuɣ a nɛma, nyin di lan bɔh o di yɛla.
en: Give to everyone who asks you for something. When someone takes something that is yours, dont ask for it back.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa niŋ Naa Ahaz ni yɛli ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Uriah the priest did everything that King Ahaz commanded him to do.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ; n kul guhir o mi, ka mali tahima o yɛligu ni.
en: I am waiting for the Lord to help me. My soul waits for him. I trust what he says.

dag: Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa yi bɛn na kpalim, ka tiligi yi niriba pam nyɛviya tin ya.
en: God sent me before you to make sure youd survive and to rescue your lives in this amazing way.

dag: N ni zaŋ zuliya biɛri na ka bɛ ti deei bɛ yiya su. N ni chɛ ka bɛn mali yaa karimbaani naai, ka bɛ ta bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri.
en: I will bring evil people from other nations, and they will get all the houses of the people of Israel. I will stop all you powerful people from being so proud. Those people from other nations will get all your places of worship.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, M bo n-nya yɛm pam gari na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ n tooni ʒini Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ zaa; ka kpahim baŋ yɛla pam yɛm mini baŋsim puuni.
en: I said to myself, You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.

dag: Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din kul tuhi, ka tiri suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din do palo ni; ka neeri niriba nini.
en: The laws of the Lord are right, and those who obey them are happy. The commands of the Lord are just and give understanding to the mind.

dag: Mani n-su mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa mini naɣ shɛb bɛn be zoya tusatusa shɛm zuɣu la.
en: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Ka sɔŋsim bɔ ka a leei bɔra? Ka n daa suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: The emperor asked, What is it that you want? I prayed to the God of Heaven.

dag: Ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: The followers were even more amazed and said to each other, Then who can be saved.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Magadan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After they all ate, Jesus told the people they could go home. He got into the boat and went to the area of Magadan.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb yihiri Masia yɛla waazu la nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zuɣu, amaa ka shɛb mi yihiri li la dalir suŋ zuɣu.
en: Of course some of them preach Christ because they are jealous and quarrelsome, but others from genuine good will.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi na nti ti ba bidibbina ni bɛ yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba. Bɛ daa pirigila buyi dɔni kaman buhi biɛla la, amaa ka Siria tɔbbihi maa bɛn kul yɛrigila luɣilikam zaa.
en: Now the Israelites had already been assembled and provisioned, so they went to engage the Arameans. The Israelites camped before them like two small flocks of goats, but the Arameans filled the land.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi kpi kaman sokam zaa ni kpiri shɛm bee yɛl shɛli din paari sokam zaa yi paai ba, dindina, pa Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: If all these people die a natural death, or if their fate be that of all humans, then the LORD hasnt sent me.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali yaa daa yi ti duri taba, Yaakubu zaŋdila dari maa sɔŋ bɛ tooni kɔbɔɣili maa gbini ni bɛ be dari maa gbini duri taba.
en: Any time the stronger animals in the flock were mating, Jacob put the branches before their eyes. The animals mated near those branches.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul gbibila a nudirigu ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛl a, Di zɔri dabiɛm; n ni sɔŋ a la.
en: I am the Lord your God; I strengthen you and tell you, Do not be afraid; I will help you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kamina ti zani baɣili ma n-ku ma, dama n nya daŋ pam, ka m mi shia na bi siɣi.
en: Then Saul said, Please kill me. I am hurt badly. And I am about to die anyway.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ dansarika n ni tumdi n Duuma tuma la zuɣu kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali biɛhigu din doli Naawuni ni daa zali ya biɛhigu so shɛl o ni daa boli ya boligu shɛl la puuni.
en: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.

dag: Din dali maa wain ni ti tɔɣiri zoya zuɣusaa luri na; ka bihim ti zɔri daboya zuɣu; ka Juda kulibɔna zaa ti pali kom zɔra. Ka kɔbil nini ti yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka kom zɔri ti luri Akasia Vinvamli ni.
en: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.

dag: Yɛndaan yino chaŋ ti liri tɔbutuhiriba tiŋa n-wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli ka bɛ niŋ li naani la.
en: A shrewd general can take a city defended by strong men, and destroy the walls they relied on.

dag: Di ti yɛn nyɛla dabisi gahindili. Di ti ku mali wuntaŋ ni, di mi ti ku mali yuŋ, dama yuŋ gba ti yɛn malila neesim. Yawɛ kɔŋkɔ m-mi lala ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli.
en: nor any darkness. There will always be daylight, even at nighttime. When this will happen is known only to the Lord .

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n-daa darigi di tibili, ka di gbuɣi di niriba maa bahi maa.
en: That is also how the land became unclean, and I held it liable for punishment, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ Sool takɔbi nyaɣi pa gbaɣino maa zuɣu, ka yɛn chaŋ ka di nyaŋ o, dama o daa na ʒi n-zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa. Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, N ku tooi zaŋ nɛma ŋɔ niŋ mmaŋ chaŋ; dama m bi mil li. Ka daa yihi di zaa sɔŋ.
en: David put on the sword and tried to walk around. He tried to wear Sauls uniform, but David was not used to all those heavy things. David said to Saul, I cant fight in these things. Im not used to them. So David took them all off.

dag: A yi yɛn deei nir binshɛli sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o binshɛlikam, nyin di dol o kpe o yiŋ puuni ti deei li.
en: When you lend someone something, do not go into his house to get the garment he is going to give you as security;.

dag: Amaa ka Pita na kul ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara, ka bɛ daa kana ti yooi dunoli maa nya o, ka di gari ba pam.
en: But Peter kept on knocking, until finally they opened the gate. They saw him and were completely amazed.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa doli ba na ti siɣi teeku maa sunsuuni, Firawuna yuri zaa min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la zaa.
en: The Egyptian chariots and cavalry went after them.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Yawɛ tooni na.
en: Moses presented their case to the Lord .

dag: Ka Alikizanda mini Rufus ba ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini nira, ka o yuli booni Saimɔn la daa yi tinshee garita; ka bɛ daa bol o na nti muɣis o ni o ʒim Yisa dapulli maa.
en: Simon from Cyrene happened to be coming in from a farm, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross. Simon was the father of Alexander and Rufus.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Jotham did what the Lord said was right, just as his father Uzziah had done.

dag: Amaa yimaŋmaŋ tumdi tab taali ka diri tab zalinsi, hal yimaŋmaŋ mabihi ka yi niŋdi lala maa.
en: But instead, you cheat and rob other followers.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka n dimnim kari doli ma hal ti gbaai ma n-no ma sɔŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ ma pi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: then let my enemies pursue me and catch me, let them cut me down and kill me and leave me lifeless on the ground!.

dag: ka o daa pun lo ni o ni zaŋ ti tah omaŋmaŋ sani n-chɛ ka ti leeg o bihi Yisa Masia zuɣu; o ni daa lo shɛm min o yubu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: God had already decided that through Jesus Christ he would make us his children—this was his pleasure and purpose.

dag: Naawuni daa lan yɛl o ni o zuliya ni ti be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim ti zaŋ ba leei daba n-niŋ ba wahala yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated years.

dag: Hal o ni ti chaŋ ti liri Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la gba n-ku niriba tuhi pii nimaani. Amaa kulla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Ɛdom mini Mɔab ni Ammɔn zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn kpalim kɔŋko n-ni ti yi o nuu ni.
en: He will invade the beautiful country, and tens of thousands will die. But Edom, Moab, and the best of the Ammonites will escape from his hand.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna din ka bukaata la zaŋ bɛ ʒiɛyimtali biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ a sani bahi.
en: Those who worship worthless idols have abandoned their loyalty to you.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli jintɔriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi ni lo ni yi niŋ niriba maa shɛm maa;.
en: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla galimi n-yo ma yurilim samli, amaa ka man suhiri Naawuni tiri ba.
en: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.

dag: Di yɔhimya yimaŋa; Naawuni pala bɛ ni maani so ansarisi, dama ninsal ni biri binshɛli, dina ka o ni ti chɛ.
en: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam bia Zakaria daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ayɔbu.
en: Zechariah son of Jeroboam ruled over Samaria in Israel for six months. This was during the th year that Azariah was king of Judah.

dag: Ni o bɔhim o nachimba maa, bɛ ni yɛl o. Dinzuɣu n suhir o mi ni o niŋmi n nachimba ŋɔ nirilim, dama chuɣu dali ka ti kana maa. N suhir o mi, din kul be o nuu ni, ŋun zaŋ ti yinim bɛn nyɛ o tumtumdiba ŋɔ ka yi zaŋ na ti ti o bia Dauda.
en: Ask your shepherds, and they'll tell you the same thing. My servants are your servants, and you are like a father to me. This is a day for celebrating, so please be kind and share some of your food with us.

dag: Ka di puuni zaa daa palila biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini tinvura ni biŋgbamda ni noonsi.
en: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and wild birds.

dag: Ka n ni ti saɣim yi jɛmbu shɛhi zaa, ka wurim yi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina, ka ti zaŋ ya zaɣ kpima pa yi buɣ kpima zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ya ni n suhu zaa.
en: I will eliminate your shrines, chop down your incense altars, and pile your dead bodies on the dead bodies of your idols. I will despise you.

dag: Dama yi yi shiri ni doli yɛligu ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm, dindina na shɛb bɛn ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee ka nyɛ bɛn kpɛri chɛchɛbunsi ka bari yuri mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ niriba ni ti doli yili ŋɔ dunɔdaya ŋɔ ni kpe.
en: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu bi saɣi ni bɛ wuhi ni nir mali taali bee galimi zaŋ chaŋ taali shɛlikam tumbu polo naɣila niriba ayi bee niriba ata shɛhira dibu ka yi ni doli n-wuhi ni nir mali taali.
en: If someone is accused of doing something against the law, one witness is not enough to prove that the person is guilty. There must be two or three witnesses to prove that the person really did wrong.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam n-su Judanim shɛm m-bala. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pisinaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Azuba, o daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoshaphat ruled over the country of Judah. He was years old when he became king, and he ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti gbahi ya tahi saria karibu shee, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri yi ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm bee n-tɔɣisi shɛm zuɣu; di saha maa yi ni ti baŋ yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.

dag: Wulimpuhili zaŋ chaŋ wulinluhili ni waɣ shɛm, lala ka o yihi ti daalahichi bahi katiŋa.
en: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!.

dag: Bɛ ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣili Baal ka chɛ ma; bɛ ŋmanila tɔb shɛli din ka naani niŋbu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ kpamba zaa bɛ yɛtɔɣ yoya zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ ti leei bɛ daansarisi malibo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They return, but not to the Most High; they have become like a worthless bow; their officials will fall by the sword because of the rage of their tongues; in Egypt they will make fun of them.

dag: Bɛ bi mi, bɛ mi bi baŋ, bɛ tɛha mini bɛ nina zommi, ka bɛ ku tooi baŋ shɛli bee n-nya shɛli.
en: They dont know or comprehend, for their eyes cant see and their minds cant comprehend.

dag: Ka yi mini Giriisinim ni Tubalnim ni Mɛshɛkinim daa lan niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi ninsalinim mini daanya nɛma na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: You did business in Greece, Tubal, and Meshech and traded your goods for slaves and for articles of bronze.

dag: Bɔ n-chɛ ka bɛ daa kpalim bɛ piɛri sani ni bɛ wumdi piɛguliba ni piɛbiri yuhi booni piɛri shɛm? Iin, Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: Why did they stay behind with the sheep? To listen to shepherds calling the flocks? Yes, the tribe of Reuben was divided; they could not decide to come.

dag: Di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ni bɔhim n niriba maa soya ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka zaŋdi n yuli pɔri bɛ pɔri yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi n niriba maa ka bɛ pɔri Baal shɛm la, dindina bɛ ni pahi n niriba ni.
en: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.

dag: Hal n ni daa yɛli ya lala maa, yi daa zaɣisi wumbu ka zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu, ka ŋme nyɔɣu chaŋ zoya ni tiŋ maa ni.
en: I spoke to you, but you did not listen. You refused to obey the Lord s command. You thought you could use your own power, so you went up into the hill country.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi bi baŋ, nam ŋɔ ni bahi lab Dauda daŋ niriba ŋɔ sani.
en: He said to himself, As things are now, if my people go to Jerusalem and offer sacrifices to the Lord in the Temple there, they will transfer their allegiance to King Rehoboam of Judah and will kill me.

dag: Kum dimbu yiko nyɛla alahichi; ka alahichi yiko nyɛ zaligu.
en: Deaths power to hurt is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ku o tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa, ka bɛn mi ti gali ni wurim kpe luɣilikam. Ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: His best troops will be killed in battle, and the survivors will be scattered in every direction. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ni ti zaŋ o binshɛɣukam fukumsi niŋ o yiŋbia maa nuu ni.
en: Indeed, I tell you, the master will put that servant in charge of all his property.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya paɣisar shɛb bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi kɔbisinahi Jabɛshigiliadnim maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Shilo sansani din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: The , soldiers found young women in the city of Jabesh Gilead who had never had sex with a man. They brought these women to the camp at Shiloh in the land of Canaan.

dag: ni tanvoya binyɛra ni tan piɛl viɛlli binyɛra ni bantabisi ni sarisi.
en: their revealing garments, their linen handkerchiefs, and the scarves and long veils they wear on their heads.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi n zuɣu na ka o yɛli ma, Yɛlima, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, yi ni tɛhi shɛm m-bala? M mi binshɛŋa din kpe yi tɛha ni.
en: The spirit of the Lord took control of me, and the Lord told me to give the people this message: People of Israel, I know what you are saying and what you are planning.

dag: ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa. Ka dɔbba ayi maa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ kpiimba ni?.
en: The women were frightened and bowed their faces toward the ground, but the men said to them, Why do you look for the living among the dead?.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni, bɛn daa nyɛ Sool dɔɣiriba la kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaata, ka bɛ niriba pam mi daa na kul ʒe Sool nyaaŋa.
en: from Benjamin, Sauls relatives, . most of whom had been loyal to Sauls household.

dag: ka Dauda yiɣisi zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti ku Filistianim kɔbisiyi, ka ŋmahi bɛ yokol gbana n-zaŋ di zaa ti ti naa din ni chɛ ka o leei naa deemba. Ka Sool daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: David got up and went with his soldiers and killed one hundred Philistines. David brought their foreskins and counted them out for the king so he could become the kings son-in-law. Then Saul gave his daughter Michal to him in marriage.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋdila yi zuɣu; ka Naawuni daalibarika yi paari niriba pam n-kul pahira, di ni chɛ ka bɛ wumpaɣibo din tibigiri Naawuni gba kul pahira.
en: All these things are for your benefit. As grace increases to benefit more and more people, it will cause gratitude to increase, which results in Gods glory.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a yihi li bɛ nuhi maa ni n-zaŋ li pahi sara shɛli din yɛn nyo buɣim maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Then take them from Aaron and his sons and put them on the altar with the ram. Then burn everything on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the Lord . It is a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Mɔabnima, ka chɛ ka bɛ dɔni tiŋa m-pie taba ʒii buta zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ ku ʒii buyi zuɣu niriba zaa ka chɛ yim zuɣu niriba. Ka Mɔabnim maa daa leei Dauda daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani.
en: Then he defeated the Moabites. He made the prisoners lie down on the ground and put two out of every three of them to death. So the Moabites became his subjects and paid taxes to him.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she pateesa, ka chɛ ka tuumbaŋda wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: They made the veil of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and fine twisted linen, with figures of winged heavenly creatures worked into its design.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa piligi yihiri waazu n-yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina .
en: From that time Jesus began to preach his message: Turn away from your sins, because the Kingdom of heaven is near.

dag: Amaa ka Zimiri ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin so ŋun su o chɛchɛbunsi pirigili fukumsi la daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo. Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛla daa ti chaŋ Tiriza, do so ŋun yuli booni Ariza ka o su nayili fukumsi la yiŋa nti nyu dam kuli.
en: Zimri was one of King Elahs officers. Zimri commanded half of Elahs chariots, but Zimri plotted against Elah. King Elah was in Tirzah, drinking and getting drunk at Arzas home. Arza was the man in charge of the palace at Tirzah.

dag: Niriba soya yi tiɣi Yawɛ nini, hal o ni chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ dimnim be ni suhudoo.
en: When we please the Lord , even our enemies make friends with us.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa dii zaŋ Yisa tahi mɔɣu ni.
en: At once God's Spirit made Jesus go into the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ba golimgolim tiŋgban nɛli ni kpa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo. Izraɛlnim daa lola tɔbu n-yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So he led them around through the desert and toward the Red Sea. The Israelites left Egypt, prepared for battle.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli yi tahima niŋbu puuni; ka maliya suɣilo yi muɣisigu nyabu ni; ka kul suhimiya Naawuni.
en: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.

dag: Amaa nir nyari zahimbu din ni chɛ ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la omaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri yi ti voog o kpɛhi di ni n-gbaag o kaman tɔŋ la.
en: But we are tempted when we are drawn away and trapped by our own evil desires.

dag: Nyama, m mini bi shɛb Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ nyɛla shihirili din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ŋɔ sanna.
en: Here I am with the children the Lord has given me. The Lord Almighty, whose throne is on Mount Zion, has sent us as living messages to the people of Israel.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ bihi maa mali bɛ buɣa dahin shɛli maa, dindali maa ka bɛ daa kpe n jɛmbu duu ti ta li daɣiri. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ n duu maa ni.
en: The very day that they killed my children as sacrifices to idols, they came to my Temple and profaned it!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Zipɔr bia Balak ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka binshɛli gu a soli ka a bi ka n sanna.
en: They went to Balaam and told him that Balak had said, Balaam, if you come to Moab.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi duri tusaanahi. O daa malila yuri tuhi pinaayi, ka daa piripiri ba niŋ chɛchɛbunsi ni be tin shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be ŋun naa sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Solomon had , stalls for his horses and chariots, and he owned , horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.

dag: Ka Musa mini Nan bia Jɔshua daa kana ti zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ wum li.
en: Moses spoke the words of the song so that all the Israelites could hear, and Joshua helped him. When Moses had finished.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli Ilaija, Pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla Naawuni nira, ka Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli a ni mali tɔɣisiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The woman answered, Now I know that you really are a man from God. I know that the Lord really speaks through you.

dag: A daanzinfa saɣimya, ka kom gari a wain ni.
en: Once you were like pure silver, but now you are like the impurities that people throw away when the silver is purified. You are like good wine that has been weakened with water.

dag: Yisa mini ba ni daa laɣim maa ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ di yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ luɣ shɛli, amaa ni bɛ kul guhim hal ka bɛ ni wum ŋun Yisa sani ni o ba Naawuni lo ba alikauli shɛl la ti niŋ pali.
en: And when they came together, he gave them this order: Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift I told you about, the gift my Father promised.

dag: Dama Musa ni daa mali Yawɛ biɛhigu shee du shɛli tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa nyɔri sara maligunim la daa bela jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn la di saha maa.
en: The Tent of the Lord 's presence which Moses had made in the wilderness, and the altar on which sacrifices were burned were still at the place of worship at Gibeon at this time;.

dag: Izraɛlnima, dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti doli Yufretiiz Mɔɣili zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tintariga n-laɣim ya yinoyino kaman bɛ ni yihiri chi ka chɛri wurigu shɛm la.
en: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.

dag: Ti mabihi, teemiya ti ni daa tum ni ti yaa tariga ka di wahala shɛm la yɛla. Ti daa kul tumdimi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku muɣisi ya ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ din yi Naawuni sanna la waazu tin ya.
en: You remember, brothers and sisters, our efforts and hard work. We preached Gods good news to you, while we worked night and day so we wouldnt be a burden on any of you.

dag: Di bi simdi ni tinzun nir ŋun niŋ Yawɛ yɛda ti yɛli, Yawɛ ku saɣi ka m pah o niriba ŋɔ ni. Di mi bi simdi ni namɔɣili ti yɛli, Man nyɛla ti kuŋ.
en: Foreigners who worship me must not say, The Lord won't let us be part of his people. Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, We are dried-up trees.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ŋmaligi nya ba, ka zaŋ Yawɛ yuli yɛli ba noli. Ka gbuɣin nyama ayi daa yi tibɔŋ ni na nti dim ku bidibbihi pihinahinaayi.
en: Elisha looked back and saw them. He asked the Lord to cause bad things to happen to them. Then two bears came out of the forest and attacked the boys. There were boys ripped apart by the bears.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyuri ti Duuma pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ ka bi doli so shɛli din tiri Naawuni jilima di ni, o ni mali taali zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ min o ʒim polo.
en: It follows that if one of you eats the Lord's bread or drinks from his cup in a way that dishonors him, you are guilty of sin against the Lord's body and blood.

dag: N niriba, wummiya n wuhibu; wummiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Listen, my people, to my teaching, and pay attention to what I say.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ Yawɛ leei bɛ ni ni niŋ so naani, ka shiri niŋ o naani mal alibarika.
en: Happy are those who trust in the LORD, who rely on the LORD.

dag: Naawuni daa bi ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri maa, ka bɛ daa nya o, ka di ka nyu.
en: God didnt harm the Israelite leaders, though they looked at God, and they ate and drank.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiri pini mali alibarika, dama bɛ niŋdi bɛ bindirigu tiri nandaamba.
en: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.

dag: Naa Bɛnhadad daa timmina nti yɛl o, Samaria taŋkpaɣu yi ni tooi pali n niriba bɛn doli ma zaa nukurigu yimyim, m buɣa bɛn niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal n niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba.
en: he replied, I'll completely destroy Samaria! There won't even be enough of it left for my soldiers to carry back in their hands. If I don't do it, I pray that the gods will punish me terribly.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: If I throw out demons by the authority of Beelzebul, then by whose authority do your followers throw them out? Therefore, they will be your judges.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi anabinim yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka bɛ nya ʒiinim pam. Mani n-daa chɛ ka anabinim maa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha.
en: I spoke to the prophets; and I multiplied visions, and through them I uttered parables.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba kuhigu, wummiya bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu kuhigu, dama Yawɛ saɣindi bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: I hear the shepherds shouting. I hear the leaders of the sheep crying, because the Lord is destroying their pastures.
