dag: N Duuma, wummi n kuhigu! Gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Hear my cry, O Lord; listen to my call for help!.

dag: Wula ka a be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun bi lan mi o yɛla nini, bee kaman tɔbutuhiri biiŋa ŋun ku tooi sɔŋ so maa? Amaa nyini Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be ti sani. Ti nyɛla a niriba, di zaŋ ti bahi.
en: Why are you like someone taken by surprise, like a soldier powerless to help? Surely, Lord , you are with us! We are your people; do not abandon us.

dag: ka wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ o ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa puuni maa zaa, ka bo yuun yini piɛlaa na ti mali sara taali tumbu zuɣu; o ni daa pun niŋ shɛl la din kpalim la yoli, dama daɣiri ta o ni daa pun mal o zuɣu shɛli ka di be kasi la.
en: and rededicate to the Lord your time as a nazirite. The previous period of time doesn't count, because your consecrated hair was defiled. As a repayment offering you shall bring a one-year-old lamb.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ la saha shɛl o ni daa wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Kapɛrinium la.
en: Jesus said all this while he was teaching in the synagogue in the city of Capernaum.

dag: ka yɛra, Naawuni chɛ o bahi; doliy o ti gbaag o, dama so kani n-ni fa o bahi.
en: God has abandoned him! Pursue him! Grab him because no one will deliver him.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun be, ka nyɛ n ni ʒe so tooni ŋɔ zuɣu, n shiri ni zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi Ɛhab zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Elijah said, I'm a servant of the living Lord All-Powerful, and I swear in his name that I will meet with Ahab today.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu n-gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi la o nuu ni siɣina. Musa daa bi mi ni o ninni nyaɣisira, o mini Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai, he carried the two stone tablets of the agreement. Because he had talked with the Lord, his face was shining, but he did not know it.

dag: Lala ka o yɛn bɔri piɛri mini chi ni kpam asiba kam ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pari taba.
en: So they will give the lamb, the grain offering, and the oil every morning for a burnt offering forever.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Zaŋ chaŋ a paɣ Zarai mi polo, di lan bol o Zarai, amaa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana bolim o la Zara.
en: God said to Abraham, As for your wife Sarai, you will no longer call her Sarai. Her name will now be Sarah.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya li, ka tɛhi di yɛla, ka lan lihi li, ka deei wuhibu di ni.
en: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma ka n sabi li shɛm. O daa kahigi tuma maa zaa ni yɛn tum shɛm wuhi ma.
en: David said, All these plans were written with the Lord guiding me. He helped me understand everything in the plans.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila anzinfa viɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun tɛha buchi bi yaɣi lala.
en: A good person's words are like pure silver; a wicked person's ideas are worthless.

dag: O zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni niŋ a nuu ni ni a su. Dina n-nyɛ: ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni noonsi. Nyini n-nyɛ zuɣu din nyɛ salima la.
en: over all humans, animals, and birds. You are the head of gold.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ wuhi ni di simdi ni niriba suhiri Naawuni sahakam ka di niŋdi anyinsi.
en: Jesus told his disciples a story about how they should keep on praying and never give up:.

dag: Ka lan chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ Masia yurilim maa, hal di ni nyɛ nir ni ku tooi baŋ shɛli zaa la, ka di chɛ ka binshɛɣukam din pali Naawuni ni la pali yi gba ni.
en: Yes, may you come to know his love—although it can never be fully known—and so be completely filled with the very nature of God.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Ibram na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi yɛli ma ni o nyɛla a paɣa?.
en: Then the king sent for Abram and asked him, What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me that she was your wife?.

dag: Shɛb daa bela tiŋgban nɛl ni n-dari ginda, ka bi nya tiŋ ʒiina.
en: Some of them wandered in the dry desert. They were looking for a place to live, but they could not find a city.

dag: Amaa n dabili Kalɛb ni mali tɛhi shɛl la min o ni doli ma ni o suhu zaa la zuɣu, n ni zaŋ o kulis o ni daa chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka o zuliya ti su li.
en: But my servant Caleb was different. He follows me completely. So I will bring him into the land that he has already seen, and his people will get that land.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔh o, Yɛhudia nira n-nyɛ ma? Amaŋmaŋ niriba mini maligumaaniba kpamba n-zaŋ a tahi n sanna! Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka a lee tum.
en: Pilate replied, Do you think I am a Jew? It was your own people and the chief priests who handed you over to me. What have you done.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Pihahirɔt n-chaŋ ti tim teeku sunsuuni gari kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni n-daa chaŋ daba ata chandi Itam tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Mara.
en: They left Pi Hahiroth and walked through the middle of the sea. They went toward the desert. Then they traveled for three days through the desert of Etham. The people camped at Marah.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛzibɔn mini Uzi ni Uziɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Iri, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu, ka nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni zuɣulaannima, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ zuliya maa daadambiɛligu kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni pihitanaanahi.
en: Bela had five sons: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were heads of families in the clan and were all famous soldiers. Their descendants included , men eligible for military duty.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nyɛ faranima ka ka bindirigu diri zuɣu, bɛ daa nyirila taŋkpa kuma tiŋgbani nɛli ni.
en: They were so poor and hungry that they would gnaw dry roots— at night, in wild, desolate places.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa labi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni na. Ka Judanim maa daa ka Giligal na ni bɛ ti tuh o soli n-zaŋ o du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: On his way back the king was met at the Jordan River by the men of Judah, who had come to Gilgal to escort him across the river.

dag: Amaa paɣisar shɛb bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la, chɛliya bɛna n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi paɣiba.
en: You can let all the young girls live—but only if they never had sexual relations with any man.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan gbaai niriba maa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ neesim; ka ŋunkam doli ma ku be zibisim ni, amaa o ni malila nyɛvili neesim.
en: Jesus spoke to the people again, saying, I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me wont walk in darkness but will have the light of life.

dag: Ka o ni daa tim shɛb maa chaŋ ti shiri nya o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: They went on their way and found everything just as Jesus had told them.

dag: N nina kul zɔrila nintam kaman kulibɔŋ kom la, bɛ ni bahi n niriba yoli zaa maa zuɣu.
en: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes.

dag: Marɔtinim kul guhirimi, ka bɛ suhuri ye zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu pun yi Yawɛ sani siɣi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdal ni na.
en: The people living in Maroth wait for something good to happen, even though trouble has come down from the Lord and has reached the city gate of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Amasa daa zaŋ Judanim maa zaa suhuri laɣim taba ka bɛ be kaman ninvuɣ yino la, ka daa tim ti yɛli Naa A min a kpamba zaa labimina.
en: David touched the hearts of the people of Judah, and they all agreed as one. The people of Judah sent a message to the king, saying, You and all your officers come back.

dag: M bolila n tumtumda, amaa ka o bi garigi ma. Di simdi ni mmaŋmaŋ balim o.
en: When I call a servant, he doesn't answer— even when I beg him to help me.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-dɔni ninkurigu maa yiŋ dunol ni Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni daa kpe shɛl la biɛkaali saha n-do nimaani hal ka di ti neei.
en: At dawn the woman came and fell down at the door of the old man's house, where her husband was. She was still there when daylight came.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka ala ka n lee yɛn yo a? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, di bi kpa talahi ni a yo ma shɛli. N na kul ni gul a biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: How much do you want me to pay you? Laban asked. Then Jacob told him: I don't want you to pay me anything. Just do one thing, and I'll take care of your sheep and goats.

dag: Ti mali mɔri mini difu din ni ti ti bunsi ŋɔ, ka mali m min a bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ni nachimbil so ŋun be tinim a daba ŋɔ sani ŋɔ bindirigu mini wain. Ti mali ti ni bɔri binshɛlikam.
en: We already have straw and food for our donkeys. There is also bread and wine for me, the young woman, and my servant. We dont need anything.

dag: ka o daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o yiŋ maa na nti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, o ni zaŋ Hiburu nir maa na ka o ti lihi ʒiɛm ti shɛm, o kpɛmina ni o ti zaŋ ma dɔni, ka n kuhi pam.
en: She called to the men outside and said, Look! This Hebrew slave was brought here to make fun of us. He came in and tried to attack me, but I screamed.

dag: Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo, ti dimnim ni daa liri ti la.
en: if the LORD hadnt been for us, when those people attacked us.

dag: Jɛrigu yɛtɔɣa tahirila zabili na, ka jɛrigu noli ni yɛtɔɣa lan bɔri buri tir o.
en: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi n ni be fitiina shɛli ni, di biɛri m puuni, ka n suhu dam, n ni daa nyɛ ŋun zaɣis a noli zuɣu. Bɛ daa malila takɔbiri be soya zuɣu kuri niriba, ka kpibu be yiŋa.
en: Look at me, Lord . I am in distress! I am upset, as if my heart turned upside down inside of me. I feel this way because I have been so stubborn. Out in the streets, I lost my children to the swords. Inside, it is like death.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Mara n-chaŋ Ɛlim. Kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin n-daa be Ɛlim maa, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani.
en: They left Marah and went to Elim and camped there. There were springs of water and palm trees there.

dag: So di yɔhim omaŋa! So yi be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yɛndana, ŋun leemi jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka o leei yɛndana.
en: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimiya doli solɔri m-boli yi ni kul nya shɛb zaa ka bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ ni na.
en: Now go to the main streets and invite to the feast as many people as you find.

dag: Nimaani daa mali momaha pam, ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa ni bɛ ʒinima. Ka dɔbba bɛn daa ʒini kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu.
en: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About , men were in the crowd.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ Ishimail zuliya ni ti kpuɣi Ibrahimma bia Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ŋun yuli daa booni Mahalat ka o tizɔdoo nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt la na ti pah o ni daa pun mali paɣ shɛb maa zuɣu.
en: So he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath daughter of Abrahams son Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth, in addition to his other wives.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Kpiɔŋlan Naa mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ti jɛmd o? Ka ti yi suhir o, nyo bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya.
en: And they say, Who is God All-Powerful? We dont need to serve him! It will not help to pray to him.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Jɛrimia bee anabinim la ni yino.
en: They replied, Some say John the Baptist, others Elijah, and still others Jeremiah or one of the other prophets.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o, ka wuɣ gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o;.
en: They put a purple robe on him, and on his head they placed a crown they had made out of thorn branches.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ Sool min o tumtumda maa kpɛhi du tital ni nti ti ba ʒiishe gahinda bɛ ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa sani, niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pihita laasabu.
en: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant to the eating area. About people had been invited to eat together and share the sacrifice. Samuel gave Saul and his servant the most important place at the table.

dag: Dundombil ni dunɔdali samban ni, duri daa beni din nyɛ baansi duri. Yini daa bela nuzaa polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nudirigu polo, ka zaɣ yini mi ʒe nudirigu polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nuzaa polo.
en: Then he brought me into the inner court. There were two rooms opening on the inner court, one facing south beside the north gateway and the other facing north beside the south gateway.

dag: Ka m mini niriba biɛla bɛn daa be n sani daa ti yiɣisi yuŋ. N daa bi yɛli so n Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli niŋ n suhu ni ni n tum ti Jɛrusalɛm. Biŋkɔb so daa ka n sani m-pahi n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so la.
en: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi doli Bashan polo; ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu Ɛdirɛi n-tuhi ba.
en: Then the Israelites turned and took the road to Bashan, and King Og of Bashan marched out with his army to attack them at Edrei.

dag: A mi ti yaannim ni daa kuli Ijipti, ka ti be nimaani yuui pam, ka Ijiptinim maa daa nahim ti mini ti yaannim maa pam shɛm la yɛla.
en: how our ancestors went to Egypt, where we lived many years. The Egyptians mistreated our ancestors and us.

dag: Ka yi yi mali karimbanim paai tuhi pia Masia dolibu ni, amaa ba yino ka yi lee mali; dama n leei yi ba Yisa Masia dolibu ni la n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu zuɣu.
en: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni o pin shɛli yɛla ninsal maŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa ni ku tooi kahigi wuhi ŋɔ zuɣu!.
en: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!.

dag: Ka buɣim yi ti di so mi tuma zaa, o ni kɔŋ di laara, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ lee ni tiligi, amaa ka di naɣ ni bemi kaman ŋun zo n-yi buɣim ni tiligi.
en: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yisifu kɔba m-mali chaŋ kaman ŋun Yisifu ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm la. Dama Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Naawuni yi ti ka yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti tiligi ya, ka yi yɛn chaŋ, yin zaŋmiya n kɔba mali chaŋ.
en: Moses had them take the bones of Joseph, whose dying words had been, God will come to your rescue, and when he does, be sure to take my bones with you.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu kam nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani. Baŋmiya ni bɛ ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: The LORD detests all who are arrogant; they surely wont go unpunished.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba ŋmanila teeku ni zahim, ka ŋmani biŋgbamda bɛn ka naa.
en: You made people like fish in the sea. They are like little sea animals without a leader.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan yih a wahala ni n-zaŋ a tahi palo ni be luɣ shɛli ka muɣisigu kani, ka nim kpaba daa pali a ŋman ni.
en: God brought you out of trouble, and let you enjoy security; your table was piled high with food.

dag: ka di ʒiɛmya anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: Dont treat prophecy like something that is not important.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa yila Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o niriba daa ku ba.
en: These three, who were killed by David and his men, were descendants of the giants at Gath.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi yaha, ka do so daa zɔna ti damd o tooni m-bɔh o, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Jesus started to leave, but a man ran to him and bowed down on his knees before him. The man asked, Good Teacher, what must I do to get the life that never ends.

dag: Amaa ka Ziɔnnim yɛli, Yawɛ chɛ ti bahi! O tam ti yɛla.
en: The people of Zion said, The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa laɣimna ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Barabas bee Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la.
en: When the crowd had come together, Pilate asked them, Whom would you like me to release to you, Jesus Barabbas or Jesus who is called Christ.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ dabindi niŋ n sara maligu ʒim ni, yi mi di chɛ ka Yaɣigari chuɣu sara nimdi zani kaai biɛɣu.
en: When you kill an animal and offer its blood as a sacrifice, you must not include anything that has yeast in it. Dont let any of the meat from the Passover meal remain until morning.

dag: Ka Hiburu nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a la sapashin kpɛm dabili daa be ti sani, ka ti yɛl o, ka o daa wuhi ti ti zaa yinoyino zahindi gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: A young Hebrew was there with us, a slave of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ puuni, m mali tahima ni n yi ti doli n naa chaŋ Siria buɣili Rimɔn jɛmbu duu nti damdi di tooni, biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni chɛ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali.
en: But I pray that the Lord will forgive me when I go into the temple of the god Rimmon and bow down there with the king of Syria.

dag: dindina yi kpamba mini sariakaritiba bɛn cham ti buɣisi o ni do luɣ shɛli maa zaŋ chaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa din miri nimaani wɔɣilim.
en: your elders and judges must come out and measure the distances to the cities nearest the body.

dag: nti zaŋ li shihi n noli ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ni shihi a noli maa, di yih a galimi, ka kpihim a daalahichi.
en: He touched my lips with the burning coal and said, This has touched your lips, and now your guilt is gone, and your sins are forgiven.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli din yɛli ni hal biŋkɔbigu yi shihi zoli maa, bɛn labim o kuɣa ku bee n-to o piɛm la daa kpɛhi ba dabiɛm ka nyaŋ ba dolibu.
en: They did not want to hear the command: If anything, even an animal, touches the mountain, it must be killed with stones.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so o yubu puuni n-leei Yisa Masia tumo la mini ti mabia Sɔstɛniiz.
en: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba pinyaayi maa bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm naai, o daa yiɣisimi n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din miri nimaani nti wuhiri niriba ka yihiri ba waazu.
en: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi n-gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali ka bɛ paai Gibiɔnnim ni daa be tin shɛŋa maa ni. Bɛ tinsi maa n-nyɛ Gibiɔn mini Chɛfira ni Bɛrɔt ni Kiriatijiarim.
en: So on the third day the Israelites marched out and came to their cities: Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-jearim.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti nya Yisa duli din maa polo bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ saha ka a ka kpe na.
en: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, Rabbi, when did you get here.

dag: M bi zaŋ mmaŋ dalimla ninsal shɛhira, amaa n yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔ yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: Although I dont accept human testimony, I say these things so that you can be saved.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O tin ya suhudoo luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la niŋ n nuu ni, ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leei ŋun Yawɛ min o niriba ni su shɛli.
en: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.

dag: ka zaŋ manna shɛli yi yaannim ni daa ʒi n-dihi ya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni o chɛ ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zahim ya, ka niŋ ya din viɛla di bahigu ni.
en: the one who fed you manna in the wilderness, which your ancestors had never experienced, in order to humble and test you, but in order to do good to you in the end.

dag: yin chɛliya ka o mal o ni daa kɔhi li yuun shɛli maa zaŋ kana di saha maa laasabu, ka yo laɣ shɛli din pahi ti o ni daa kɔhi li ti so maa, ka bɛ labis o tiŋgbani ti o.
en: they must calculate the years since its sale and refund the balance to the person to whom they sold it. Then it will go back to the family property.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa chaŋ Baala, di gbinni nyɛla Kiriatijiarim din daa be Juda tiŋgban ni la ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka shɛli zuɣu Naawuni yuli ni daa be, ka o nam ʒiishee tam chɛrubinim zuɣu la na.
en: David and the people went to the city of Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, in the territory of Judah, to get the Covenant Box of God, which bears the name of the Lord enthroned above the winged creatures.

dag: Pɛka ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Pekah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔb tusaanu laasabu m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: About five thousand men plus women and children had eaten.

dag: Amaa nyini malimi shili n-yiɣisi zani yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa. Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, di yi pa lala n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaag a pam bɛ sani.
en: But you must prepare for battle and be ready to utter every word I command you. Dont be frightened before them, or I will frighten you before them.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi puuni, Naawuni daa yɛli Firawuna, N ni zal a daliri shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni n wuhi n yiko tuma a ni, ka di chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia zaa.
en: In the Scriptures God says to Pharaoh: I made you king so that you could do this for me. I wanted to show my power through you. I wanted my name to be announced throughout the world.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ŋmaligi ni o chaŋ, ka Sool va n-gɔh o binyɛrigu tiŋli, ka di cheei.
en: Samuel turned to leave, but Saul grabbed at the edge of his robe, and it ripped.

dag: Ka o daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom; o daa ʒili tɔbbihi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣilikam. Ka Ɛdomnim maa zaa daa leei ŋun Dauda ni su shɛba. Ka Yawɛ daa kul tiri Dauda nasara luɣ shɛlikam zaa o ni chaŋ.
en: He put teams of soldiers throughout Edom, and the whole nation became his servants. The Lord gave victory to him wherever he went.

dag: Bi jɛrigu nyɛla ŋun tiri o ba suhugarigu. Yidaampaɣ so ŋun yuri zabili ŋmanila saa ŋun yɔrita.
en: Stupid children can bring their parents to ruin. A nagging wife is like water going drip-drip-drip.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi fɔntinsi ata Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo.
en: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan River.

dag: ka yi ti yɛn bahi ka ŋuhira, ka yi niŋgbuna zaa sheei;.
en: You will groan at the end when your body and flesh are exhausted.

dag: Ka o daa zani, ka dunia dam. Ka o daa lihi, ka niriba ni sɔhira. Ka kurimbuni ha zoya la wurim, ka o kurimbuni ha daboya din nyɛ o so kurisi la firi.
en: He stops and measures the earth. He looks and sets out against the nations. The everlasting mountains collapse; the eternal hills bow down; the eternal paths belong to him.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi nuu be zibisim tuun yoya ni, amaa lee yihimiya tuun yoya maa la palɔni.
en: and dont participate in the unfruitful actions of darkness. Instead, you should reveal the truth about them.

dag: Yi ni ti be suɣa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin. Izraɛl tiŋbihi zaa ni ti bela suɣa ni.
en: You will live in temporary shelters for seven days. All the people born in Israel will live in them.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka wuntia luna kaman saa la. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi, ka tiliginsim yina; ka chɛ ka wuntia gba yina; Man Yawɛ n-nam li.
en: I will send victory from the sky like rain; the earth will open to receive it and will blossom with freedom and justice. I, the Lord , will make this happen.

dag: Jɛriko — kɔbisita ni pihinahinaanu.
en: of Jericho.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka niriba pam yi tiŋkpansi n-daŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti doli bɛ kali soli m-mali bɛmaŋa ka Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa dali na bi paai.
en: The time for the Passover Festival was near, and many people went up from the country to Jerusalem to perform the ritual of purification before the festival.

dag: ni Oholibama ni Ɛla ni Pinɔn ni.
en: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla daa niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, ka o daa chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni kpaŋ.
en: Jesus got out of the boat, and when he saw the large crowd, his heart was filled with pity for them, and he healed their sick.

dag: Chɛ ka n wum suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣa; ka chɛ ka a ni daa kabisi n kɔb shɛŋa la mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Let me hear joy and celebration again; let the bones you crushed rejoice once more.

dag: O daa malila biŋkɔbbaligu tusaayopɔin mini laakumnim tusaata ni naɣilakɔra tuhili ni bunnyama kɔbisinu, ka mali tumtumdiba pam; ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nyɛ ninvuɣ titali gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa.
en: and owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred pairs of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a vast number of servants, so that he was greater than all the people of the east.

dag: dama ŋunkam kul nyurila bihim nyɛla ŋun yɛm na bi goligi wuntia yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka o na kul nyɛla bia.
en: Anyone who lives on milk is still a baby and is not able to understand much about living right.

dag: Di saha ka yɔɣ ni tihi zaa ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni; dama o kamina ni o ti kari dunia saria.
en: Then the trees of the forest will shout out joyfully before the LORD, because he is coming to establish justice on earth!.

dag: Amaa bɛn baɣa daa ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa ni bɛn daa chɛla bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri niŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: But others paid no attention to his threats and left their slaves and animals out in the open.

dag: ka hal teeku kɔgbana yi vuri ka ŋmuɣinda, ka hal di vubu maa yi chɛ ka zoya sɔhira, ti ku zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina.
en: You have heard that it was said, Dont commit adultery.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti ku ninvuɣ biɛri la tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka darigi yihi bɛn bi ʒe yim di ni.
en: But the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the treacherous will be ripped up.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋda. N Duuma, nyini ka n suhiri ni a zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I cried out to you, LORD. I begged my Lord for mercy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di simdi ni dunɔdali ŋɔ kul yo n-ʒiɛya, di bi simdi ni di yooi, ka so mi di doli li kpe. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa doli li kpe, dinzuɣu di simdi ni di kul yomi ʒiɛya.
en: and the Lord said to me, This gate will stay closed and will never be opened. No human being is allowed to use it, because I, the Lord God of Israel, have entered through it. It is to remain closed.

dag: Teemi ni a ni daa doli Bɔaz so paɣisara yihiri kayiha la nyɛla ti dɔɣira. Wumma, yuŋ ŋɔ o ni be kabɔɣili ni m-buri chi.
en: Remember that this man Boaz, whose women you have been working with, is our relative. Now listen. This evening he will be threshing the barley.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali bɛ bidibisi bɛn nyɛ goli yini bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura, ka bɛ kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata; dama bɛ daa bi zaŋ Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni, bɛ ni daa bi pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa pal shɛli ti ba la zuɣu.
en: In the tribe of Levi there were , men and boys at least a month old. They were not listed with the other tribes, because they would not receive any land in Canaan.

dag: Amaa ka naa maa daa bɔh o, Siɣimsiɣim bula ka n kul yɛr a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! Ahab shouted. What does the Lord really say.

dag: Di saha ka a yipa ni bɔri sara maligunima din tuhi ni sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la; di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan zaŋ naɣilahi m-mali sara a sara maligu bimbin la zuɣu.
en: Then you will again want sacrifices of righteousness— entirely burned offerings and complete offerings. Then bulls will again be sacrificed on your altar.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ din guli ba, ka faranim fara bahiri ba yoli.
en: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n ni teei n nuu chɛ ka alɔbo lu a min a niriba zaa zuɣu n-naai yi balibu zaa dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: In fact, he could already have sent a terrible disease and wiped you from the face of the earth.

dag: Jɔnatan tɔbu daa ʒi n-lab kuli ka pa ni o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ʒim mini kpiɔŋlaannim kpam n-varim li. Ka Sool mi takɔbi na ʒi n-chɛ n-ziŋ.
en: Jonathan's bow was deadly, the sword of Saul was merciless, striking down the mighty, killing the enemy.

dag: Ka o ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam, dama o yɛtɔɣa maa daa nyɛla din mali yiko.
en: His teaching amazed them because he spoke with power.

dag: Amaa n niriba dimnim yi bɔri ni n tiligi ba, dindina bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma, Iin, bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma.
en: But if the enemies of my people want my protection, let them make peace with me. Yes, let them make peace with me.

dag: So na ʒi n-zaɣis omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o dihiri li mi ka maani li kaman Masia ni niŋdi cheechi shɛm la.
en: No one ever hates his own body, but feeds it and takes care of it just like Christ does for the church.

dag: Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi n ni daa yɛl a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa jɛndi Izraɛlnim mini Judanima ni zuliya kam la niŋ di ni. N ni daa kul yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la.
en: Take a scroll and write in it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah, and all the nations from the time of Josiah until today.

dag: Di yi nyɛla piɛlaa sara, yin bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram ayi n-zaŋ kpam lita yini ni pirigili ŋmir li;.
en: And if the animal is a full-grown ram, you must offer two kilograms of flour mixed with one and a half liters of olive oil. One and a half liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti tim sandaani niŋ nandaamba, ka labisi bɛ buni ti ba.
en: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Shallum ba.
en: Zadok, Shallum.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri alizanda nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni daa mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu n-zan o ba Dauda zaani leei naa. O daa tɔŋya, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa deeg o noli.
en: Then Solomon sat on the Lord s throne as king. Solomon took his fathers place. He was very successful. All the Israelites obeyed him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo ti niŋ Izraɛlnim ni? Di chaŋ wula ka daŋ yini niriba ti ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni.
en: Lord God of Israel, why has this happened? Why is the tribe of Benjamin about to disappear from Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul yɛr o di yɛla dabisili kam, ka o zaɣisi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Haman ni bɛ nya Mɔdɛkai yɛligu maa ni zani, dama o daa pun yɛli ba ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nira.
en: day after day they urged him to give in, but he would not listen to them. I am a Jew, he explained, and I cannot bow to Haman. So they told Haman about this, wondering if he would tolerate Mordecai's conduct.

dag: O daa tiligi shɛba, ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa. O nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa. To, o siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti niŋ o yɛda.
en: He saved others, but he can't save himself. If he is the king of Israel, he should come down from the cross! Then we will believe him.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔŋ ma, bɛmaŋ ka bɛ tum barina maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa je ma nyɛla bɛn yuri kum.
en: Those who offend me injure themselves; all those who hate me love death.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria Gomnanim mini sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi bɛn zaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ bɛmaŋa ni bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kɔre. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla.
en: Oholibah also chased after good-looking Assyrian officers, uniformed soldiers, and cavalry troops.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa gbaai Sɔstɛniiz ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la m-bu o saria karibu duu maa dunol ni. Ka Gallio bi gbiligi lihi ba gba.
en: The crowd grabbed Sosthenes, the Jewish leader, and beat him up in front of the court. But none of this mattered to Gallio.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣa zaa, ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: And its porch was at the end of the gateway next to the outer courtyard. Carvings of palm trees were on the walls on either side of the gateway. There were eight steps leading up to the gate.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa kana ti kpe duu maa ni n-nya ka biŋŋmahindili maa do garo zuɣu, ka di zuɣu kuɣi bukɔbiri difiɛli.
en: When the messengers arrived, they found the idol in the bed with the goats hair on its head.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a ʒim zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani hal ti taɣi zoya, ka a ti pali kulibɔna.
en: I will pour your blood on the mountains, and it will soak down into the ground. The rivers will be full of you.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu kpaŋsimiya tab suhuri, ka niŋdi din ni sɔŋ yi taba ka bɛ zooi Naawuni dolibu ni kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: So continue encouraging each other and building each other up, just like you are doing already.

dag: N niriba ni ti be suhudoo mini alaafee ni vuhim ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: You, the Lord 's people, will live in peace, calm and secure.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam Balaam ni daa chani maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ ti zani sol ni n-gu o soli. Balaam daa barila buŋa, ka o tumtumdiba ayi be o sani.
en: God was angry that Balaam was going, and as Balaam was riding along on his donkey, accompanied by his two servants, the angel of the Lord stood in the road to bar his way.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni Timnatisɛra din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tiŋgban ni zaŋ labi Gaash Zoli nuzaa polo la.
en: He was buried in his own part of the land at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash.

dag: A daa yi alizanda ni n-siɣi Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka ti ba zaligu maŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: At Mount Sinai you came down from heaven; you spoke to your people and gave them good laws and sound teachings.

dag: N wahala ŋɔ mini n ni ka kpɛhili shee ŋɔ yɛla tɛha tomi kaman binsom la.
en: The thought of my pain, my homelessness, is bitter poison.

dag: Kumiya bɛ naɣilahi zaa. Kɔrimiya ba. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ biɛɣu neeya, bɛ tibidarigibo saha paaya.
en: Destroy all her bulls; prepare them for slaughter. How terrible for them! Their time has come, the day of reckoning.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ŋmanila lala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni tahima ni zani tariga.
en: Godless people are like those reeds; their hope is gone, once God is forgotten.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa shɛm m-bala.
en: You will apportion this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

dag: Naawuni daa tɔɣisiri ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa la anabinim noya ni siɣimsiɣim bu shɛm soya balibu pam ni;.
en: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.

dag: Amaa ka Ahaz daa yɛli, N ku yɛl o. N ku buɣisi Yawɛ ni n nya.
en: No, Lord , Ahaz answered. I won't test you.

dag: Ka nam din pah anahi gba ti deei. Di ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman kuriti din ŋmɛri burisiri ka kabiri binshɛɣukam la. Ka kuriti ni ŋmɛri burisiri binshɛɣukam shɛm la, lala ka di ni ti ŋme n-wurisi nam shɛŋa din daŋ di tooni.
en: Then will come a fourth kingdom, mighty like iron. Just as iron shatters and crushes everything; so like an iron that smashes, it will shatter and crush all these others.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bundaannima bɛ gom saha, amaa bɛ yi ti neei, bɛ ku lan mali shɛli.
en: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be a daalikauli la ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri duŋ taabu kul palila tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ zibisim shee.
en: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim maa sunsuuni; ka yi daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa vuri, amaa ka lee bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, kukoli kɔŋko n-daa kul beni.
en: Tell them how the Lord spoke to you from the fire, how you heard him speaking but did not see him in any form at all.

dag: Zaŋm o ti lih o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a niŋ o zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa niŋm o ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛli.
en: Find Jeremiah and look after him; dont harm him but do whatever he asks from you.

dag: Giliad nyɛla n dini, ka Manaasa nyɛ n dini; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurugu zuɣupiligu; ka Juda nyɛ n nam jaaŋgbee.
en: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.

dag: Amaa zom yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu mini dɔɣirikpamba yuya yɛla ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni zabili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni zaligu yɛla polo, dama di nyɛla yoli ni din ka buchi.
en: Avoid stupid controversies, genealogies, and fights about the Law, because they are useless and worthless.

dag: ka zaŋ n daanzinfa pipia la niŋ ŋun nyɛ bɛ zaa biasan la kpalaŋ nol ni m-pah o kawana liɣiri zuɣu. Ka o daa niŋ kaman Yisifu ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Put my silver cup in the top of the youngest brother's sack, together with the money for his grain. He did as he was told.

dag: O ni ti lan niŋ suhukpeeni n-laɣim tɔbbihi pam chaŋ ti liri Ijipti naa, ka Ijipti naa maa gba ni ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ lu tab zuɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yɔhim Ijipti naa maa ka o ku di nasara.
en: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed.

dag: n-daa zaŋ kuɣa maa me Yawɛ jɛmbu sara maligu bimbini maa zali, ka chɛ ka bɛ gaai bɔɣili gil li; ka bɔɣili maa ni tooi deei kom kaman lita pinaanahi laasabu.
en: With these stones he rebuilt the altar for the worship of the Lord . He dug a trench around it, large enough to hold about four gallons of water.

dag: O tuumba pinaayi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn ni.
en: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon and his brother Andrew; James and his brother John, the sons of Zebedee;.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ ya niŋ Naawuni nuu ni, ka lan zaŋ ya niŋ o daalibarika yɛtɔɣa din ni tooi kpaŋsi ya la ni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya tarili bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la ni.
en: And now I commend you to the care of God and to the message of his grace, which is able to build you up and give you the blessings God has for all his people.

dag: Peentɔriba ni ti lir o, ka di bi viɛla. Bɛ ni ti to o piɛma, ka nahim o pam.
en: They attacked him fiercely and fired arrows; the archers attacked him furiously.

dag: Nyin Firawuna suhu ni daa ti yiɣisi bah a tumtumdiba zuɣu, ka a zaŋ m min a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm ti kpɛhi duu a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛm yiŋ la.
en: Pharaoh was angry with his servants and put me and the chief baker under arrest with the commander of the royal guard.

dag: Bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti do yi sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Sool tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la daa zaŋ Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt n-zo chaŋ Mahanaim.
en: The commander of Saul's army, Abner son of Ner, had fled with Saul's son Ishbosheth across the Jordan to Mahanaim.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ kpaluhi alahiziba, ka bɛnkam zaa tumdi tuma deeri yɔri ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: weavers and skilled workers will be broken and depressed.

dag: Zaligu tanzaa yi wurim, wula ka wuntizɔra yɛn niŋ?.
en: What would good people do if the wicked destroyed all that is good?.

dag: Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin yɛlim ti. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi yɛli ya, yi ku niŋ yɛda;.
en: They said, Tell us! Are you the Messiah? Jesus replied, If I said so, you wouldn't believe me.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla, ka dunia ŋɔ nim wumdi tiri ba.
en: They are from the world. So they speak from the worlds point of view and the world listens to them.

dag: Dahin shɛli n ni daa yihi n niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la n daa bi pii tin shɛli Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ni bɛ me jɛmbu duu ti ma, m mi daa bi pii so ni o leei naa n-su n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: I led Israel out of Egypt long ago. And in all that time, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel for a place to build a house for my name. I have not chosen a man to lead my people, the people of Israel.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi ŋma nti ʒe sochira zuɣu n-gu ni yi gbahi bɛ ni shɛb bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la. Di mi daa bi simdi ni yi gbahi bɛn kpalim ti bɛ dimnima bɛ nandahima dabisili dali.
en: You should not have stood at the crossroads to catch those trying to escape. You should not have handed them over to the enemy on the day of their distress.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa tim tuumba luɣ shɛli polo Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli maa. Lala ka o daa yi pun daŋdi yɛr o n-chɛ ka o tilig omaŋ nimaani n-gari buyi.
en: So the king of Israel warned the people who lived in that place, and they were on guard. This happened several times.

dag: Paɣisarili ni tooi tam o salima yɛri yɛla? Bee amiliya ni tooi tam o daamiliya binyɛra yɛla? Amaa n niriba ŋɔ bɛn ni tam n yɛla dabisi shɛŋa ka kalinli.
en: Does a young woman forget her jewelry, or a bride her wedding dress? But my people have forgotten me for more days than can be counted.

dag: A yi niŋ Naawuni ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ, dindina a wumsim maa ni baligi. Ka niriba ŋɔ zaa ni lab bɛ biɛhigu shee ni suhudoo.
en: This is the way God wants it done. You won't be under nearly as much stress, and everyone else will return home feeling satisfied.

dag: mini Ɛburɔn ni Rɛhɔb ni Hamɔn ni Kana m-mali hal ti paai Sidɔn din nyɛ tin tital la.
en: as far as Great Sidon. They also owned Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Ijipti ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kuriba tusa anahi n-taai duŋ zo n-kpe mɔɣu la.
en: Then you are not the man I thought you were. I thought you were the Egyptian who started some trouble against the government not long ago and led four thousand terrorists out to the desert.

dag: Lala ka maligumaana maa yɛn niŋ m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara o zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaɣ yini kam polo, ka o nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. Ka din kpalim nyɛ maligumaaniba dini kaman chi bee kawana sara yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The priest will do this to make you pure, and God will forgive you. The part that is left will belong to the priest, just as the regular grain offering.

dag: Ka n daa nya Piɛbil maa ni tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ni zaɣ yini, ka wum ka binnɛma anahi maa ni zaɣ yino ŋun kukoli ŋmani saa tahigu kuhi yɛli, Kamina.
en: Then I looked on as the Lamb opened one of the seven seals. I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, Come.

dag: Ka Omri daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Omri did more evil things than any king before him.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla Yisa Masia zuɣu m paɣiri Naawuni yi zaa zuɣu, dama yi yɛda niŋbu moli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: First I want to say that I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you. I thank him because people everywhere in the world are talking about your great faith.

dag: n-yɛri malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu m-mali kikaa maa, Lɔrigim malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛ ni lo n-zali mɔɣ titali din yuli booni Yufretiiz ni la bahi.
en: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, Free the four angels who are tied at the great river Euphrates.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Neetan daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔro gbaai Yuria paɣ ni dɔɣi bidib so ti Dauda maa.
en: Then Nathan went back home. The Lord made David's young son very sick.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛli yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ o ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti na la:.
en: People of Israel, listen to this message which the Lord has spoken about you, the entire nation that he brought out of Egypt:.

dag: M bia, wummi n yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka luɣi a tiba wum m baŋsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: My child, pay attention and listen to my wisdom and insight.

dag: ka bɛ gahi bɛ kulipal tab nuu ni bɛ kana ti sɔŋ ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba, ka bɛ yihi zahim maa pali ŋarima ayi maa zaa hal ka di ti yɛn shim.
en: They signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. They filled both boats so full that they were about to sink.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim zaa daa laɣim chaŋ Shɛkɛm oki tia din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgban la gbini nti leei Abimilɛk nam.
en: Then all the men of Shechem and Bethmillo got together and went to the sacred oak tree at Shechem, where they made Abimelech king.

dag: Ka n zaŋ o tah a nyaandoliba ŋɔ sanna, ka bɛ bi tooi tib o.
en: I brought him to your disciples, but they couldnt heal him.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa na maa daa nyɛla din ni tooi zaŋ tum tuma maa zaa ka guui.
en: The people had brought more than enough things to finish the work of building Gods holy place.

dag: Ka sokam zaa daa dii kab dol o m-piɛbiri yuhi, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam, ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi bɛ vuri yɔbu zuɣu.
en: Then they played flutes and celebrated as they followed Solomon back to Jerusalem. They made so much noise that the ground shook.

dag: Yi ni daa bi kpuɣi li tuuli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi ti zuɣu n-darigi ti tibili la, dama ti daa bi niŋ li kaman di ni simdi ni ti niŋ li shɛm.
en: When you werent with us the first time, the LORD our God burst out against us because we didnt ask his advice properly.

dag: Yi chɛ ka bɛ dolila teeku chani dari Ijipti kawaan shɛli bɛ ni ŋahi Nail Mɔɣili duli la kɔhira. Yi nyɛla zuliya kam kɔhigɔriba.
en: across the sea to buy and sell the grain that grew in Egypt and to do business with all the nations.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa ŋmaligi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: So Assyrias King Sennacherib departed, returning to Nineveh, where he stayed.

dag: Di simdi ka daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpɛm be yi sani.
en: One man from each tribe will help you. This man will be the leader of his tribe.

dag: Bɛ yi ti sibigi li sa, di ni baai? Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di ku kuui zaa, di ku kuui bɛ ni daa biri li luɣ shɛli maa? .
en: The grapevine is strong and healthy, but as soon as the scorching desert wind blows, it will quickly wither.

dag: Yihim Naawuni yɛligu waazu: kul yirigim di zuɣu saha shɛlikam zaa; saɣisim niriba; kpahimi niriba zuɣu ni; kpammi niriba jaande; wuhimi niriba suɣilɔdibo pam puuni.
en: Tell everyone Gods message. Be ready at all times to do whatever is needed. Tell people what they need to do, tell them when they are doing wrong, and encourage them. Do this with great patience and careful teaching.

dag: O ni be alizanda ni ka timna ti tiligi ma. O ni chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn duri tamdi n zuɣu la di vi. Naawuni ni wuhi ma o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ n sani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: From heaven he helps me and saves me. He will punish the one who attacks me. Selah God will remain loyal to me and send his love to protect me.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋmanila asiba paɣili bee maligim din kpahi lu bi to la bee bɛ ni yɛli kabɔɣili ni wurigu shɛli bahi la bee nyɔhi din yiri takɔro ni la.
en: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.

dag: Di veeni ni nir nya wahala la o bilim ni.
en: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Siɣimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni ti pii kuɣa pinaayi maligumaaniba la ni ʒe luɣ shɛl la n-ʒi li ti sɔŋ yi ni ti yɛn gbe luɣ shɛli yuŋ ŋɔ. .
en: Command them, Pick up twelve stones from right here in the middle of the Jordan, where the feet of the priests had been firmly planted. Bring them across with you and put them down in the camp where you are staying tonight.

dag: Miriya ka yi zɔri ba, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ka be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm.
en: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.

dag: Musa daa gulila o deemba Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana la biŋkɔbbaligu maa. Ka o daa ti zaŋ ba ti kpe tiŋgban nɛli ni n-gari chaŋ Naawuni zoli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini.
en: Moses father-in-law was named Jethro. Jethro was a priest of Midian. Moses took care of Jethros sheep. One day Moses led the sheep to the west side of the desert. He went to a mountain called Horeb, the mountain of God.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa kpuɣila o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka gbaai Naawuni suhibu yɛra, M Ba, saha yipa paaya ni a chɛ ka a Bia nya jilima, ka a Bia maa gba chɛ ka a nya jilima.
en: When Jesus finished saying these things, he looked up to heaven and said, Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, so that the Son can glorify you.

dag: Biɛrim yi ti paai ba, bɛ ni bɔri suhudoo, amaa ka ku nya li.
en: Disaster! It has come! They seek peace, but there is none.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl bihi, o yuli n-lan nyɛ Yaakubu: Rubin mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: Jacob had twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim Izraɛlnim bɛ wahala zaa ni.
en: God, save the people of Israel from all their enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa saɣi n-chɛ ka o kpe bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka ŋariŋ maa dii mali ti to bɛ ni daa baari duri yaɣ shɛli polo maa.
en: Then they willingly took him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached land at the place they were heading for.

dag: O tahigu maa vuri ni gili dunia luɣilikam, dama Yawɛ mini zuliya kam malila yɛtɔɣa. O ni kari ninsalinim zaa saria, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn mali taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and the sound will echo to the ends of the earth. The Lord has a case against the nations. He will bring all people to trial and put the wicked to death. The Lord has spoken.

dag: ni bɛ daa saɣiya ni ŋunkam mali dabili ka o nyɛ Hiburu nira, doo bee paɣa, ŋun bahim o din ni chɛ ka Izraɛl nira ku lan zaŋ o mabia Izraɛl nira n-leeg o dabili.
en: everyone was to free their male and female Hebrew slaves and no longer hold a Judean brother or sister in bondage.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, amaa o ni kari o ni yɛli noli ti ninvuɣ shɛb la bahi.
en: Those who are blessed by the Lord will possess the land, but those who are cursed by him will be driven out.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti vuhi pam bahi mɔri zuɣu, di kuurimi, ka tipum kpahiri lura; yɛlimaŋli, ninsalinim shiri ŋmanila mɔri.
en: At the Lord 's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yuŋ ŋɔ yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Then Jesus said to them, This very night all of you will run away and leave me, for the scripture says, God will kill the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.

dag: amaa n nya zaligu shɛli n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni ka di mini n tɛha ni zaligu tuhiri taba n-zaŋ ma leeg alahichi din be n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni maa dabili.
en: but I see a different law at work in my body. It wages a war against the law of my mind and takes me prisoner with the law of sin that is in my body.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ kawaan daŋda bee ka daŋda na ni yi ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, yin zaŋmiya zaɣ maha n-chim li niɛm zim.
en: If you bring a grain offering from the first harvest to the Lord , you must bring roasted heads of grain. They must be crushed heads of fresh grain. This will be your grain offering from the first harvest.

dag: Yi daa bi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee n-nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You did not have bread to eat or wine or beer to drink, but the Lord provided for your needs in order to teach you that he is your God.

dag: Gbarigu napɔna ni bi shihiri tiŋ shɛm, lala ka jɛrigu ŋahili gba be.
en: A fool trying to say something wise is like a crippled person trying to walk.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, M paɣir a ni n suhu zaa, ka ni tibigir a yuli sahakam.
en: I give thanks to you, my Lord, my God, with all my heart, and I will glorify your name forever.

dag: Ŋunkam daa nya ba ŋubiri ba mi, ka bɛ dimnim yɛli, Ti ka taali, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun guli ba ni yɛlimaŋli la, bɛ yaannim ni daa mali tahima Yawɛ so san la.
en: All who found them devoured them; and their attackers said, Its not our fault, because they have sinned against the LORD, the true pasture, the hope of their ancestors—the LORD.

dag: Lihimiya ba kaman bɛn be kasi, dama bɛna n-zaŋdi yi Naawuni bindira maani sara. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun mali ya ka yi be kasi maa nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: A priest serves God in a special way. So you must treat him in a special way, because he carries holy things. He brings the holy bread to me, and I am holy. I am the Lord , and I make you holy.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai Yisa sani n-nya ka o pun kpimi, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi kabi ŋun gbaya.
en: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ ti baŋya ni alizin biɛɣu n-shiri ʒi a zuɣu, dama ti yab Ibrahimma min anabinim zaa kpiya, ka nyin ti yɛli ni nir yi dol a yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: The Jews said to Jesus, Now we know that you have a demon in you! Even Abraham and the prophets died. But you say, Whoever obeys my teaching will never die.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du ni bɛ ti tuhi Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka nandahima daa mal Izraɛlnim pam.
en: The Ammonites then went across the Jordan River to fight against the people of Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim. The Ammonites brought many troubles to the Israelites.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu tuma yi zahira. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni kɔr biɛri balibu kam.
en: The actions that are produced by selfish motives are obvious, since they include sexual immorality, moral corruption, doing whatever feels good.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa chɛ, ka Aduna labi Musa sani Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: So the terrible sickness was stopped, and Aaron went back to Moses at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-chani zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi ni ka yɛra, Tinima m-be kpe ŋɔ, ti ni kuli Yawɛ ni lo ti alikauli ni ti kuli tin shɛl maa ni, ti tum alahichi.
en: Early the next morning they started out to invade the hill country, saying, Now we are ready to go to the place which the Lord told us about. We admit that we have sinned.

dag: Amaa nyini malimi shili n-yiɣisi zani yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛli ba shɛlikam zaa. Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, di yi pa lala n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaag a pam bɛ sani.
en: As for you, Jeremiah, get ready. Stand up and speak to the people. Tell them everything that I tell you to say. Dont be afraid of the people. If you are afraid of them, I will give you good reason to be afraid of them.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa ʒini bɛ tinsi ni naai nyaaŋa, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka niriba maa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm naŋgban yini.
en: So by the seventh month, the Israelites had moved back to their own hometowns. At that time all the people met together in Jerusalem. They were all united as one people.

dag: Ka n ni ti ka nimaani na nti to piɛma ata kaman n zahimla binshɛli ka tɔr la.
en: I'll shoot three arrows at a target off to the side of the rock.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka o ti a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli.
en: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.

dag: Dama bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, di laara ka Naawuni yɛn ti ba, ka darigi bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God always treats everyone the way they deserve.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa dibu polo, di bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni yɛli ni buɣili kam ʒiɛla binshɛɣu din ka dunia ŋɔ ni zaani la, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pahila Naawuni yino ŋɔ ko.
en: So this is what I say about eating meat: We know that an idol is really nothing in the world, and we know that there is only one God.

dag: So kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya. Tim kani din ni tibi yi daŋ maa. Yi ku nya tibbu.
en: No one comes to your aid; no one attends to your wound; your disease is incurable.

dag: O ni ti di nasara o yɛŋkiŋkabina min o ninvuɣ yɔhimbo soya puuni. O ni ti duh omaŋa, ka ni ti bahi niriba pam yoli n-libigi ba. Hal o ni ti mo nanim zaa Naa, amaa o ni ti bahi yoli ka ninsal nuu ka di ni.
en: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu. Yɛlim ba, yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya maa tintarisi n-yɛn bɔŋɔ.
en: the following instructions for the people of Israel: When you enter Canaan, the land which I am giving you, the borders of your territory will be as follows.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa gbaai Reechɛl kpariŋ mɔɣisi ka kum suhupiɛlli kuhigu pam.
en: Then he kissed her and began to cry for joy.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka o saɣim pam. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa dolila so yini.
en: I saw that she was completely immoral, that the second sister was as bad as the first.

dag: Lɔɣimi li, di doli li, ŋmaligim chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: Stay away from that path; dont even go near it. Turn around and go another way.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni galisiya, ka ti ku tooi baŋ o yuma tariga.
en: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *.

dag: O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam tɔbu ni, ka gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli tinshee katiŋ ha. .
en: Here is what he is saying: Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country. .

dag: Bahi yoli mini wahala m-be bɛ ni doli so shɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Everywhere they go they cause trouble and ruin.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul tumdi tuumbiɛri, dindina o ni kpihim yi mini yi naa maa zaa birili.
en: But if you are stubborn and do evil, God will throw you and your king away, like dirt swept out with a broom.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm pahi ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pia nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pia maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham said, Please don't be angry, Lord, and I will speak only once more. What if only ten are found? He said, I will not destroy it if there are ten.

dag: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ a kɔbilinina ni; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli paɣ so a ni daa kpuɣi a nachimbilim saha la zuɣu.
en: May your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

dag: Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, zuliya shɛba bee na so n-kani ka n dan naa bi tim nimaani nti bɔ a; ka bɛ yi yɛli ni a kani, faashee ka dilan chɛ ka lala zuliya maa nim po ni bɛ shiri bi nya a.
en: As surely as the LORD your God lives, theres no nation or kingdom where my master Ahab hasnt looked for you. They would insist, Hes not here, but Ahab would make them swear that they couldnt find you.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun bo o kpee paɣa. Ŋunkam shihi paɣa maa ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: It is just as dangerous to sleep with another man's wife. Whoever does it will suffer.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi kom maa ni na maa ka ti Duuma Shia Kasi daa kpuɣi Filip chaŋ, ka namɔɣili maa bi lan nya o, ka mi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away; the official never saw him again. The official continued on his way home. He was very happy.

dag: Di saha ka Asa daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini nayil la n-tim ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Naa Bɛnhadad ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa, ka be Damaskus la ka yɛl o.
en: So Asa took silver and gold from the treasuries of the Temple and the palace and sent it to Damascus, to King Benhadad of Syria, with this message:.

dag: Ti tumdi din yiɣisiri ti Duuma suhu, ka o zabiri nyuli di zuɣu? Ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o?.
en: Doing that would make the Lord jealous. Do you really want to do that? Do you think we are stronger than he is?.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: Anyone who wouldnt bow and worship would be thrown into a furnace of flaming fire.

dag: Naa Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o daa chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka o tuma maa daa zani tariga.
en: When Baasha heard about these attacks, he stopped building up Ramah and went back to Tirzah. He stopped all the work he was doing.

dag: N kul malila shili n-guhiri sahakam ni n deei n niriba bɛn niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi din bi tuhi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli maa.
en: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.

dag: Ka yi ni so yi zaɣisi ti ni yɛli ya shɛm gbaŋ ŋɔ ni deebu, yin kpahimmiya dilana, ka di chɛliya ka yi min o lan mali jina, ka di ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: Take note of anyone who doesnt obey what we have said in this letter. Dont associate with them so they will be ashamed of themselves.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni ti yɛli bɛ mini bɛn sɔŋdi ba yɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa. Bɛ ni ti siɣi tiŋgban ni nti fo n-doya, bɛn bi guni ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba.
en: The greatest heroes and those who fought on the Egyptian side welcome the Egyptians to the world of the dead. They shout: The ungodly who were killed in battle have come down here, and here they lie.

dag: ka doli soli din tuhi ka di chɛ ka napɔn barinim naba ku ŋmirigi, amaa ka lee ni malila alaafee.
en: Make straight paths for your feet so that if any part is lame, it will be healed rather than injured more seriously.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpuɣi ba zuɣusaa bɛ yinsi n-ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: an east wind lifts them, and they are gone, removes them from their places.

dag: Naftali tiŋgbani zaa mini Ifriim tiŋgbani ni Manaasa tiŋgbani ni Juda tiŋgbani zaa zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili polo teeku noli.
en: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Dibɔnnim chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu bɛ buɣa duu nti kumda; ka Mɔabnim kumdi Nɛbo mini Mɛdɛba zuɣu; ka sokam pini bɛ zuɣuri ni bɛ teensi.
en: Dibon has gone up to the temple, to the shrines to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Every head is shaved, every beard cut off.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: This was the legacy of the Gadites—for their clans, their cities, and their settlements.

dag: Bɛ bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim, dama bɛ dɔɣi tinzun bihi. Pumpɔŋɔ yi gol paliga churi puhibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi puri zaa bahi yoli.
en: They have not been faithful to the Lord . Their children are from some stranger. And now, he will destroy them and their land again.

dag: O tiri biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka tiri kahiŋko bihi bindira bɛ yi ti kuhira.
en: God gives food to the animals— even to the baby ravens when they cry out.

dag: Musa ni daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa niŋ kundi ni naai zaa.
en: Once Moses had finished writing in their entirety all the words of this Instruction scroll.

dag: Ka salo bɛn zaa daa laɣim ʒe nimaani ni bɛ lihi ninliha maa daa nya din niŋ maa. Ka ŋmaligi buri bɛ nyɔri kuna.
en: When the people who had gathered there to watch the spectacle saw what happened, they all went back home, beating their breasts in sorrow.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, He must be saying this because we don't have any bread.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, so ka dunia ŋɔ ni n-nyɛ wuntizɔra ŋun kul tumdi tuun suma, ka na ʒi n-tum alahichi.
en: There is no one on earth who does what is right all the time and never makes a mistake.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋzaalan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: Nations will give you what you need, like a child drinking milk from its mother. But you will drink riches from kings. Then you will know that it is I, the Lord , who saves you. You will know that I, the Great God of Jacob, protect you.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya ni dabeenzɔbo mini ni sɔhibu, ka niŋmiya lala ni nimmoo kaman yi niŋdi li tirila Masia la.
en: As for slaves, obey your human masters with fear and trembling and with sincere devotion to Christ.

dag: Ka bɛ daa goog o yɛl o, Kpalimmi ya ŋɔ n-gbe ti sani, dama wuntaŋ luya ka yuŋ zibira. Ka o daa doli ba kpe bɛ yiŋa.
en: They begged him, Stay with us! It's already late, and the sun is going down. So Jesus went into the house to stay with them.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan kɔre ni be shɛli ni pam nyɛla din kur o. Dama vinnyaɣilana nuhi je tuma.
en: Lazy people will cause their own destruction because they refuse to work.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani m-bala, Cham ti yɛl a dana Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: Elijah answered, Yes, it is me. Now, go and tell your master, the king, that I am here.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli, Yawɛ n-tim ma na ni n ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mini tiŋ ŋɔ yi ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Jeremiah said to all the officials and to all the people, The LORD sent me to prophesy to this temple and this city everything you have heard.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini n-zaŋ doli Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo ni bɛ lɔɣi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ maa gari. Ka niriba maa suhuri daa ti yiɣisi pam soli maa ni.
en: The Israelites left Mount Hor by the road that leads to the Gulf of Aqaba, in order to go around the territory of Edom. But on the way the people lost their patience.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: But that very night Gods word came to Nathan.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka sokam zahim omaŋ pɔi ka naanyi ŋub bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyu pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ.
en: Before you eat the bread and drink the cup, you should examine your own attitude.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Kalidianim mini Sirianim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi kana ti liri Judanim ni bɛ ku ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The Lord sent armed bands of Babylonians, Syrians, Moabites, and Ammonites against Jehoiakim to destroy Judah, as the Lord had said through his servants the prophets that he would do.

dag: N daa kul fomi baalim ka bi yɛli shɛli, hal n daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ din viɛli gba polo! Amaa ka n wahala daa lee kul pahira;.
en: So I didnt say anything. I didnt even say anything good, but I became even more upset.

dag: ni suligu ni baŋtooŋa min o balibu zaa.
en: the kite, any kind of falcon.

dag: Aai! Hal ninsalinim zaa yi nyɛ ʒirinima, Naawuni ŋun kul nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Nyin Naawuni ku mali galimi a yɛtɔɣa ni, ka so mi ku ŋme a naŋgbankpeeni a saria karibu ni.
en: Absolutely not! God must be true, even if every human being is a liar, as it is written: So that it can show that you are right in your words; and you will triumph when you are judged. .

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: Abraham said to him, Be sure you dont take my son back there.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa daa zalila zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yiliyiiniba polo, ka sabi wuhi bɛ ni yɛn yiini yila maa shɛm dabisili kam.
en: There was a command from the king setting out the daily requirements of the singers.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka saa ku lan min ya, ka yi bindira ku niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kpi yomyom Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: Then the LORDs anger would burn against you. He will close the sky up tight. There wont be any rain, and the ground wont yield any of its crops. You will quickly disappear off the wonderful land the LORD is giving to you.

dag: ni bɛ ni nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la mini di nɛma zaa ni tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu la.
en: the altar for entirely burned offerings and all its equipment, and the washbasin with its stand.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuɣiri situr piɛla ni ti yihi tahima, ka bɛn ʒi kpalu dari ni ninni biɛhigu ti taɣi.
en: Workers with flax will be dismayed; carders and weavers will grow pale.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa kana ti nya shigbaŋ, ka shikpam do tiŋa.
en: The troops came across a honeycomb with honey on the ground.

dag: Tins ayɔbu ka yi yɛn yihi zali ka di nyɛ yi tiliginsim tinsi maa.
en: There are to be six of these Safe Towns.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi pa wɔhu gali n-gu tɔbu tuhibu dali, amaa nasara dibu bela Yawɛ sani.
en: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yi Bɛtɛl chani ti miri Ɛfirat ka Reechɛl piligi wolisibu ka o wolisibu maa daa kpɛm pam.
en: Jacob and his group left Bethel. Before they came to Ephrath, Rachel began giving birth to her baby.

dag: Yaa n Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa, ka tumdi din tuhi a sani shɛm la yɛla. Ka Hɛzɛkia daa kum pam.
en: Please, LORD, remember how I have walked before you in truth and sincerity. I have done what is right in your eyes. Then Hezekiah cried and cried.

dag: Bɛ ni tarigi lɛb lu, amaa tinim ni yiɣisimi ʒe tibi.
en: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.

dag: pakoli ŋɔ ni kaɣindi ma sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kari bɛ saria ŋɔ n-ti o nasara. Di yi pa lala, o waawaayili kandina ŋɔ ni nyɔni n nyee pam. .
en: But this woman is bothering me. If I give her what she wants, then she will leave me alone. But if I dont give her what she wants, she will bother me until I am sick.

dag: Yawɛ nam binshɛlikam la ni di daliri, hal ninvuɣ biɛri benila bɛ wahala nyabu dali zuɣu.
en: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.

dag: Yi bihi yuli ni ti du pam zuliya kam sani. Ka ŋunkam zaa ti nya ba ni baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni.
en: They will be famous among the nations; Everyone who sees them will know That they are a people whom I have blessed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa zaligu maa moli gili Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa ni, ka tuumba daa zaŋ di lahibali zo n-tahi yaɣili kam ni. Di saha maa Haman mini naa daa ʒimi nyuri dam, amaa ka Susa tiŋ puuninim zaa bɛn yɛma ŋma.
en: Driven by the kings order, the runners left Susa just as the law became public in the fortified part of Susa. While the king and Haman sat down to have a drink, the city of Susa was in total shock.

dag: Aduna bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: O bituuli Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi, bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ. Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: These are the descendants of Noah's sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. These three had sons after the flood.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ma pul ni na? M paɣiya ka n daa kpi ka so nini na bi nya ma.
en: Why, God, did you let me be born? I should have died before anyone saw me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔhi daanya shɛli tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi ni pisinaanu.
en: They gave more than / tons of bronze.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a gbaai n suhu. A nina lihibu min a nyiŋgokɔrigu yabiɛlim yini chɛ ka a gbaai n suhu.
en: You have captured my heart, my sister, my bride! You have captured my heart with one glance from your eyes, with one strand of your necklace.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei bintɔɣu, ka daai wuntia luhi tiŋa!.
en: Doom to you who turn justice into poison, and throw righteousness to the ground!.

dag: Shamga Anat bia saha la mini Jaɛl saha la, sochandiba bɛn daari doli taba daa bi lan chana, ka bɛn gɔri mi kpalim baɣisirila sokpansi.
en: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, and in the days of Jael, the main roads were empty. Caravans and travelers traveled on the back roads.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi n-chani ti nya Hiburunim maa niriba ayi ni zabira, ka o daa yɛli bɛ ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmɛr a mabia maa.
en: The next day he went back and saw two Hebrew men fighting. He said to the one who was in the wrong, Why are you beating up a fellow Hebrew.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti bɔhi Naawuni, Ti ni daŋ dini niriba n-simdi ni bɛ daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa? Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-ni daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: Then the Israelites marched up to Bethel to ask for direction from God. They inquired, Who should go up first to fight against the Benjaminites for us? And the LORD said, Let the tribe of Judah be first.

dag: Ka o daa zani, ka dunia dam. Ka o daa lihi, ka niriba ni sɔhira. Ka kurimbuni ha zoya la wurim, ka o kurimbuni ha daboya din nyɛ o so kurisi la firi.
en: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na ti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: So Jesus called them all together and said, You know that the rulers of the heathen have power over them, and the leaders have complete authority.

dag: Nir yi niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe yim naani a muɣisigu saha, di ŋmanila nyinvɔɣu bee napɔŋ din ka alaafee.
en: Trusting a treacherous person at a difficult time is like having a bad tooth or a wobbly foot.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu chihila Naawuni daalikaulinima? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Dama Naawuni yi daa zali fukumsi zaligu shɛli ni di tooi tahi nyɛvili na, dindina taali ni yibu Naawuni sani naan shiri yi fukumsi zaligu maa dolibu ni na.
en: Does this mean that the Law is against God's promises? No, not at all! For if human beings had received a law that could bring life, then everyone could be put right with God by obeying it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Arimatia tiŋbia ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ashilɔni Yɛhudianim zɔbu zuɣu la daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi. Ka o daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: After this Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate if he could take away the body of Jesus. Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but a secret one because he feared the Jewish authorities. Pilate gave him permission, so he came and took the body away.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka m bi biɛhim ka ka yi sanna yomyom maa, dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma yi ni boli ma na shɛli zuɣu.
en: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.

dag: Dinzuɣu Dimitirius min o tumtumditab maa yi zaŋla so taali, saria karibu duu beni ka sariakaritiba be di ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn zaŋm taba tahi ni.
en: If Demetrius and his workers have a case against these men, we have courts and judges. Let them take their complaints there.

dag: O daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun kul suhiri Naawuni sahakam, ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa zɔri Naawuni, ka o tiri nandaamba pina pam.
en: He was a religious man; he and his whole family worshiped God. He also did much to help the Jewish poor people and was constantly praying to God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi bɛ taba, ka maani ba ansarisi la ti ku lan beni. Bɛ ni ti ku tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: It will be the end of those who oppress others and show contempt for God. Every sinner will be destroyed.

dag: Dindali maa ka Ibrahimma min o bia Ishimail daa guni.
en: That same day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman bɛn mali fahim; yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Im talking to you like you are sensible people. Think about what Im saying.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali tahima ŋɔ timiya suhupiɛlli mini suhudoo zaa yi ni niŋ yɛda zuɣu, din ni chɛ ka yi mali tahima din galisi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bo bindirigu, ka niŋ kom niŋ kom koligu ni n-zaŋ li nyaɣili Haga, ka zaŋ bia maa pah o n-chɛ ka o chaŋ. Ka Haga daa chaŋ ti be Bɛrishiiba yɔɣu ni dari ginda.
en: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti yɛn bahi yoli ŋɔ zuɣu, di simdi ni yi nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔnima? Di niŋ kamaata ni yi bebu be kasi, ka yi nyɛ bɛn luri Naawuni sizuura binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Everything will be destroyed in this way. So what kind of people should you be? Your lives should be holy and devoted to God.

dag: So ku tooi yo omaŋmaŋ talima samli bee n-yo Naawuni o nyɛvili samli.
en: We can never redeem ourselves; we cannot pay God the price for our lives.

dag: N kɔre yi daa kpe paɣa ni, ka n do n kpee yiŋ dunol ni gul o.
en: If I have been attracted to my neighbor's wife, and waited, hidden, outside her door.

dag: Bilichiisi duri luya, amaa ti ni kpe kuɣa m-me shɛŋa zali di zaani. Sinsabisi tihi vuɣi lu, amaa ti ni bo sida tihi sa n-zali di zaani.
en: Yes, those bricks fell, but we will rebuild with strong stone. Yes, those little trees were chopped down, but we will plant new trees. And they will be large, strong trees.

dag: dindina maligumaana ni zali di daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, ka dilan ni yo di liɣiri dindali maa ka di leei din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: the priest shall estimate its value according to the number of years until the next Year of Restoration, and you must pay the price that very day; the money belongs to the Lord .

dag: Yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ, ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna, o ni ŋmaligi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu m-bahi ya yoli zaa; o ni pun niŋ ya din viɛl la nyaaŋa.
en: If you leave the Lord and serve other gods, he will cause terrible things to happen to you. He will destroy you. He has been good to you, but if you turn against him he will destroy you.

dag: Ka Tama daa chaŋ o tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa ka o ti domi. Ka o daa niŋ zim ŋɔri mahibiɛli m-mali maha o nini maa ni.
en: So Tamar went to the house of her brother Amnon. He was in bed. Tamar took some dough, pressed it together with her hands, and cooked the cakes. She did this while he watched.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Nir yi jɛmdi Naawuni, di ka anfaani.
en: Indeed he said, No one is rewarded for delighting in God.

dag: Yisa ni daa be Jɛrusalɛm Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha maa, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda bɛ nini ni daa nya shihir shɛŋa o ni wuhi la zuɣu.
en: While Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Passover Festival, many believed in his name because they saw the miraculous signs that he did.

dag: ka Uzi nyɛ Zɛrahia ba, ka Zɛrahia nyɛ Mɛrayɔt ba.
en: Uzzi was Zerahiahs father. Zerahiah was Meraioths father.

dag: Nyum amaŋmaŋ kɔduɣu ni kom din yi amaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga puuni na.
en: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe Odɛd bia Azaria ni.
en: The spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku labi n sanna maa zuɣu, bɛ ni labi Ijipti, ka Asiria naa ti leei bɛ naa.
en: They will return to the land of Egypt, and Assyria will be their king, because they have refused to return to me.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa be dunia ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti kpuɣi binshɛli din nyɛ shihirili bin la zuɣusaa zoya zuɣu, yin lihimiya! Bɛ yi ti piɛb kikaa, yin gbilisimiya tibili wum.
en: Listen, everyone who lives on earth! Look for a signal flag to be raised on the mountaintops! Listen for the blowing of the bugle!.

dag: So miri ka o ti chɛ ka o bipuɣiŋga leei pagɔrili n-dih o vi, di yi pa lala, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti leei pagɔra tiŋgbɔŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali pali di ni.
en: Do not defile your daughter by making her sexually promiscuous or else the land will become promiscuous and full of shame.

dag: N zɔr a mi, ka n ni sɔhira, ka zɔr a saria karibo.
en: My body shudders because I fear you; Im in awe of your rules.
