dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣim kaman yalim zim la yuɣisi sokam zuɣu, ka ti niŋ yalim yuɣisi sara kam gba zuɣu.
en: Everyone must be salted with fire.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ti gba, ti ni daa nyɛ bihi ka na bi zooi wuntia soli dolibu ni la, ti daa nyɛla bɛn be dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni.
en: In the same way, when we were minors, we were also enslaved by this worlds system.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ zaa nyu.
en: Then he took a cup, gave thanks to God, and handed it to them; and they all drank from it.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka Izraɛl nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Naawuni yi chɛ ka o niriba tɔŋ, Yaakubu zuliya ni mali suhupiɛlli; ka Izraɛlnim suhuri paligi.
en: How I pray that victory will come to Israel from Zion. How happy the people of Israel will be when God makes them prosperous again!.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Yawɛ ni bɛ tumd o tuma, ka yur o, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn zaa gbibi Vuhim Dabisili ka bi saɣindi di zaligunima, ka gbibi n daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Some foreigners have chosen to follow the Lord . They do this so that they can serve him and love his name and be his servants. They keep the Sabbath as a special day of worship, and they will continue to follow closely my agreement.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛriko naa maa daa tim ti yɛli Reehab, Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe a yili ŋɔ na la yina; dama bɛ kamina ni bɛ ti puɣisi baŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa daashili.
en: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: Do not hide the men who came and stayed in your house. Bring them out. They have come to spy on our country.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila lan shɛli kulipalinim ni zaŋ lab kom ni n-gbahi zahim balibu kam;.
en: Also, Gods kingdom is like a net that was put into the lake. The net caught many different kinds of fish.

dag: Taataa kpiŋkpama vibiri ni suhupiɛlli, amaa o ka kpiŋkpaŋkɔbiri kaman tɔrili la.
en: An ostrich gets excited and flaps its wings, but it cannot fly. Its wings and feathers are not like the wings of a stork.

dag: Zaŋm a nuu chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ ma, ka di lan chɛ ka a yɛla mali ma dabiɛm.
en: Remove your hand far from me and dont terrify me with your anger.

dag: Amaa ka o daa tim bɛ sunsuuni gari chaŋ o chandi.
en: But Jesus slipped through the crowd and got away.

dag: Di saha ka paɣipiɛlisi maa zaa daa yiɣisi malimali bɛ firilanima.
en: When the women got up and started getting their lamps ready.

dag: Di pa ni ti kuunimi ni tinim su yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm fukumsi, dama yi ʒiɛla dɛde yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm puuni, amaa tinim lee pahila yi zuɣu n-tumdi yi suhupiɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: It isnt that we are trying to control your faith, but we are working with you for your happiness, because you stand firm in your faith.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan bol a, Chɛ m-bahi, bee m-bol a tiŋgbani, Zaɣ nɛli. Amaa bɛ ni ti bol a la, Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so, ka boli a tiŋgbani, Dooyililana. Dama Yawɛ nini tiɣ a, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti mali yidana.
en: Your name will no longer be Deserted and Childless, but Happily Married. You will please the Lord ; your country will be his bride.

dag: N dan naa, ka pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnim zaa lihirila a ninni ni a wuhi ba ŋun yɛn zani a zaani n-di nam a kalinsi nyaaŋa ʒin a nam ʒiishee.
en: Your Majesty, everyone in Israel is waiting for you to announce who will be the next king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zaɣa zaa niŋ o ni, dama o daa pun chɛ ka o bukpahitali maa tabibi tuma niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka di wɔɣa.
en: He had their attention because he had baffled them with sorcery for a long time.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda lan ka saria karibu ni, amaa ŋunkam bi niŋ o yɛda, bɛ pun kar o saria, dilan ni bi niŋ Naawuni Bi gaŋ maa yɛda zuɣu.
en: Those who believe in the Son are not judged; but those who do not believe have already been judged, because they have not believed in God's only Son.

dag: Ka Samuɛl nini daa bi lan nya Sool hal ti kpi. Amaa ka o suhu daa lee saɣim pam Sool zuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli o ni daa pii Sool n-leei Izraɛlnim naa maa zuɣu.
en: As long as Samuel lived, he never again saw the king; but he grieved over him. The Lord was sorry that he had made Saul king of Israel.

dag: N niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ni n di di daanfaani.
en: I do all this to make the Good News known. I do it so that I can share in the blessings of the Good News.

dag: Pashihur daŋ ni: Ɛliɔnai mini Maasɛya so mi yaha ni Ishimail ni Nɛtanɛl ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlasa.
en: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Ti yaa nyaŋ ba kaman ti ni pun nyandi ba shɛm la. Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lo nia yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti ŋmaligi zɔri ka bɛ dol ti, ka ti zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa solɔri zuɣu ha.
en: The Benjaminites thought, Theyre being wiped out before us like the first time. But the Israelites had planned, Well retreat and draw them away from the city toward the main roads.

dag: N wumiya ni wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni, ka a mali ninneesim mini baŋsim ni yɛm.
en: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.

dag: Ɛhab daa lan mɛla buɣili Ashɛra gba binnani zali. O daa tum din ni yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ suhu n-gari Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: He also set up a sacred pole. Ahab did more to make the Lord , the God of Israel, angry than all the other kings who were before him.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be ʒilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Dont be like some senseless horse or mule, whose movement must be controlled with a bit and a bridle. Dont be anything like that!.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin dabisi shɛli din daŋ tooni dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli. Dindali maa, piɛbimiya kikahi.
en: There will be a special meeting on the first day of the seventh month. You will not do any work on that day. That is the day for blowing the trumpets.

dag: Yi ni daa niŋ Lɛbanɔn zaɣ biɛ shɛl la ni labi lu yi zuɣu. Biŋkɔbiri kubu la ni gbaai ya dabiɛm, yi ni daa ku ninsalinima mini yi ni daa tahi damli shɛli na dunia ni ni tinsi ni ni bɛnkam be di ni la zuɣu.
en: Because of the violence done to Lebanon, he will overwhelm you; the destruction of animals will terrify you, as will human bloodshed and violence throughout the land, the villages, and all their inhabitants.

dag: Dama Farisiinim mini Yɛhudianim zaa daa bi saɣiri diri bindirigu ka pa ni bɛ dol bɛ yaannim kali ni nyɛ shɛm paɣi bɛ nuhi pɔi.
en: For the Pharisees, as well as the rest of the Jews, follow the teaching they received from their ancestors: they do not eat unless they wash their hands in the proper way;.

dag: Amaa ka Zimiri ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin so ŋun su o chɛchɛbunsi pirigili fukumsi la daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo. Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛla daa ti chaŋ Tiriza, do so ŋun yuli booni Ariza ka o su nayili fukumsi la yiŋa nti nyu dam kuli.
en: Zimri, his officer who led half the chariots, plotted against him. Elah was at Tirzah, getting drunk at the house of Arza, who had charge over the palace at Tirzah.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali ka kum daa muɣisi tiŋ maa nim pam, ka bindirigu daa lan ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka niriba maa ni di.
en: By the ninth day of the fourth month of that year, the hunger in the city was very bad. There was no food left for the people in the city to eat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sukɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam din miri tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: They marched from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa;.
en: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.

dag: Teem a nuu zuɣusaa tirina. Yihim ma kom din galisi pam ŋɔ ni tiligi ma. Tiligim ma tinzunnim nuu ni.
en: Reach down from heaven and save me! Dont let me drown in this sea of enemies. Save me from these foreigners.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ni daa ti paai Hiburɔn na, Jɔab daa zaŋ o la niriba sunsuuni yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini ni o ti tɔɣis o ashili yɛtɔɣa, ka daa ti zaŋ sua n-kuh o pul ni ka o kpi nimaani. O daa ku o mi n-yo o mabia Asahɛl kubu la samli.
en: When Abner arrived in Hebron, Joab took him aside at the gate, as though he wanted to speak privately with him, and there he stabbed him in the stomach. And so Abner was murdered because he had killed Joab's brother Asahel.

dag: Dindali maa a ni ti yaag a noli tɔɣisi ŋun zo n-tiligi maa yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan shini yaha. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka a ni leei shihirili bɛ sani, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then you will be able to speak again, and the two of you will talk. You will be a warning sign to the people, and they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka o ba maa yɛl o, M bia, nyin kul bela n sani sahakam; ka n ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a dini.
en: My son, the father answered, you are always here with me, and everything I have is yours.

dag: ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum mini alɔbo ti luri pam; ka binyara din kpɛhiri niriba dabiɛm ti beni, ka shihir kara ti wuhiri zuɣusaa.
en: There will be terrible earthquakes, famines, and plagues everywhere; there will be strange and terrifying things coming from the sky.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpalim guhiri saha shɛli maa, ka Ɛhud daa chaŋ hal ti gari kuɣikpɛra shee la n-zo n-kuli Siɛra tiligi.
en: While the servants were waiting for the king, Ehud had time to escape. He passed by the statues and went toward the place named Seirah.

dag: ni bɛ niŋ o kaman a ni daa pun lo shɛm a yiko ni min a milinsi ni la, dama di daa ʒe o la lala.
en: They gathered to do everything that you by your power and will had already decided would happen.

dag: amaa naɣ zalimiyala yi daazichi alizanda ni; nimaani ka di bi zahinda, ka lɛla ku saɣim li, ka tayiɣisi mi ku kab kpe n-zu li.
en: Instead, store up riches for yourselves in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy, and robbers cannot break in and steal.

dag: Kamiyana, chɛliya ka ti teei dɔni ti puya zuɣu n-jɛm o; chɛliya ka ti gbani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti namda ŋɔ tooni!.
en: Come, let us bow down and worship him! Let us kneel before the Lord who made us.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa tum shɛm, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata bahi yoli dahin yin la.
en: Lets not practice sexual immorality, like some of them did, and twenty-three thousand died in one day.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When Lamech was years old, he had a son.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o suhu paligirila o zuɣu gari piɛ kɔbigayinika bɛn bi bɔrigi la.
en: I am sure that finding it would make you happier than having the that never wandered off.

dag: Bee miri ka a tum zina.
en: Do not commit adultery.

dag: Anabi Aizaia ni daa nya Yisa jilima zuɣu ka o daa yɛl o yɛla lala maa.
en: Isaiah said this, because he saw the glory of Jesus and spoke about him.

dag: A daa nam o ka o jilima pooi malaikanim jilima saha biɛla puuni; a daa chɛ ka o mali jiri mini jilima.
en: For a short time you made him lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani bɔh o, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ?.
en: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, Dont you have anything to say about these charges against you? Are they telling the truth.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi pirigili daa tɔɣisirila Ashidɔdnim yɛtɔɣa ka ku tooi tɔɣisi Judanim yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka daa naɣ tɔɣisirila zuliya balibu pam yɛtɔɣa.
en: And half of the children from those marriages didnt know how to speak the Jewish language. They spoke the language of Ashdod, Ammon, or Moab.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa na nti laɣisi bɛ ni ku shɛb maa kɔba m-pahi di zuɣu.
en: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there and collected the bones of the men who had been hanged by the Gibeonites.

dag: Ŋun kɔra, o ni mali bindirigu pam, amaa ŋun doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi, fara ni gbaag o pam.
en: Whoever works hard will have plenty to eat, but whoever wastes their time with dreams will always be poor.

dag: N yura, niŋm yomyom, be kaman molifu la bee kparibua ŋun be tulaale tihi zoya zuɣu.
en: Come to me, my lover, like a gazelle, like a young stag on the mountains where spices grow.

dag: Bundana n-su faralana, ka sandira mi nyɛ sandan dabili.
en: Poor people are slaves of the rich. Borrow money and you are the lender's slave.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi, ka pa ni Yisa.
en: But the leading priests persuaded the people to ask Pilate to free Barabbas, not Jesus.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ kurimbuni Naawuni. Ŋuna n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ zaa. Di bi wumd o, o mi bi gbarigira. So mi ku tooi baŋ o tɛha.
en: Dont you know? Havent you heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the creator of the ends of the earth. He doesnt grow tired or weary. His understanding is beyond human reach.

dag: Been shɛli daa be Jɛrusalɛm n-do m-miri duno shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Piɛri Dunol la. Hiburuli ni bɛ booni biaŋ maa la Bɛtizata, ka lunfanima anu daa be nimaani.
en: In Jerusalem there is a pool with five covered porches. In Aramaic it is called Bethzatha. This pool is near the Sheep Gate.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi po alizanda pola di mini Naawuni nam ʒiishee n-tabili ŋun Naawuni ŋun ʒi di ni maa.
en: Those who swear by heaven swear by Gods throne and by the one who sits on it.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn mi daa yi Saipurus mini Sairiini n-ka Antiɔk na mali Naawuni yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili, ka yihiri ba ti Duuma Yisa yɛla waazu.
en: Among them were some people from Cyprus and Cyrene. They entered Antioch and began to proclaim the good news about the Lord Jesus also to Gentiles.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John wore clothes made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

dag: Teeku noli tinsi la ni ti leela Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la dini, ka bɛ ti guli bɛ biŋkɔbiri nimaani, ka gbɛri Ashikɛlɔn tiŋ puuni yuŋ. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni mi bɛ yɛla, ka labisi bɛ daazichi la ti ba yaha.
en: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. *.

dag: N ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni nirilim, ka chɛ ka bɛ be n sani. Ŋunkam doli so shɛli din ka galimi, ŋuna n-ni tum n tuma.
en: I will approve of those who are faithful to God and will let them live in my palace. Those who are completely honest will be allowed to serve me.

dag: N ni kpe yi tiŋ ŋɔ ni n-chani ginda, n nya yi ni jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa, ka nya maligu malibu bimbin shɛli ka bɛ sab pa di zuɣu yɛli, Ti ni ʒi wun so ka jɛmd o la mi bimbini m-bɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu yi ni ʒi so ka jɛmd o maa yɛla ka n kahigiri wuhiri ya maa.
en: I was going through your city and I saw the things you worship. I found an altar that had these words written on it: to an unknown god . You worship a god that you dont know. This is the God I want to tell you about.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu Samaria; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam ʒin o nam ʒiishee.
en: Joash lay down with his ancestors, and Jeroboam followed him on the throne. Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

dag: lala n-nyɛ ti gba: Ti galisiya, amaa ti nyɛla niŋgbun yini Masia ni, ka ti zaa yinoyino nyɛ niŋgbuŋ yini maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: In the same way, though we are many, we are one body in union with Christ, and we are all joined to each other as different parts of one body.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lihi Kɛnnim gba, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛli, Yi biɛhigu shee nyɛla barina ni ka luɣ shɛli. Yi biɛhigu shee maa ŋmanila tiɛɣu din pa kuɣili zuɣu.
en: He looked at the Kenites and raised his voice and gave his address: Your dwelling is secure; your nest is set in the rock.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa suhi Yawɛ ti o paɣ maa, dama o daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo; ka Yawɛ daa deeg o suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka o paɣ Ribɛka niŋ pua.
en: Isaacs wife could not have children. So Isaac prayed to the Lord for her. The Lord heard Isaacs prayer, and he allowed Rebekah to become pregnant.

dag: Asha zuliya n-daa pah anu n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The fifth assignment made was for the families of the tribe of Asher.

dag: O ni daa yaɣindi li maa ka shɛŋa lu sol zuɣu, ka noonsi kana nti gahim li di.
en: As he was scattering seed, some fell on the path; and the birds came and ate it.

dag: Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa garigi yɛli naa, Nɛbukadnɛza, di bi kpa ni ti garig a shɛli yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered King Nebuchadnezzar: We dont need to answer your question.

dag: Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa nya ka o bia lan kani maa, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum Juda nabihi zaa.
en: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that.

dag: Babilɔnnim gbahibu maa vuri ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, ka zuliya kam ti wum bɛ kuhigu.
en: When Babylon falls, there will be such a noise that the entire earth will shake, and the cries of alarm will be heard by the other nations.

dag: Sool ni daa kuli ti tuhi Filistianim maa ka labina ka bɛ yɛl o, Nyama Dauda be Ɛngɛdi.
en: After Saul had chased the Philistines away, people told him, David is in the desert area near En Gedi.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋdi hal ti paai yuma ayi, ka Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka be Ɛsha daa wum ti Duuma yɛligu maa.
en: He did this for two years. Because of this work, everyone in Asia, Jews and Greeks, heard the word of the Lord.

dag: Bɛna nti yɛn be laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tooni n-tumdi tuma tir o mini niriba maa zaa ka tumdi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la gba tuma.
en: They will perform duties for him and for the entire community before the meeting tent, doing the work of the dwelling.

dag: ka yɛli, N dana, a nini yi tiɣi ma, yin zanim mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani.
en: Abraham said, Sirs, please stay a while with me, your servant.

dag: So ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa kul nyɛla din wuhiri ti alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: For no one is put right in God's sight by doing what the Law requires; what the Law does is to make us know that we have sinned.

dag: Amaa Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la daa bela Ofɛl, ka Ziha mini Gishipa daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba maa zuɣulaannima.
en: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.

dag: Ka salo zaa daa kpalim samban ni suhiri Naawuni tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu saha.
en: while the crowd of people outside prayed during the hour when the incense was burned.

dag: Ka di daa bili n-leela yɔɣili din zɔra, amaa ka lee bi do tiŋa, ka ŋmaligi kpala o polo. Ka di nyaɣa kul kpalim ʒe di zaashee. Lala zuɣu di daa leela yɔɣili n-niŋ wula mini vari.
en: The plant sprouted and became a low, wide-spreading grapevine. The branches grew upward toward the eagle, and the roots grew deep. The vine was covered with branches and leaves.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya li kɔhi deei liɣiri n-zaŋ liɣiri maa mali chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa.
en: then sell this part and take the money there instead.

dag: Zabili daa be Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni yuui pam, ka Dauda yaa daa kul pahira, ka Naa Sool niriba maa mi yaa daa kul gbarigiri pahira.
en: There was war for a long time between Sauls family and Davids family. David became stronger and stronger, but Sauls family became weaker and weaker.

dag: Ti ka soli ni ti kpuɣ paɣiba n-ʒiri ba kaman ti tuuntab mini ti Duuma tizɔbihi ni Pita ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: We have the right to bring a believing wife with us when we travel, dont we? The other apostles and the Lords brothers and Peter all do this.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ paɣisarili maa shɛli. Paɣisarili maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kubu; dama yɛlli ŋɔ ŋmanila doo ni yi chaŋ ti lir o kpee n-ku o la.
en: nothing is to be done to the woman, because she has not committed a sin worthy of death. This case is the same as when one man attacks another man and murders him.

dag: A shiri mi, dama di saha bɛ daa pun dɔɣ a ka a mi yuui pam!.
en: I am sure you can, because you're so old and were there when the world was made!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Zɛbulɔn zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Zebulun, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka naa zali zaligu kpeeni maa yomyom lala? Ka Ariok daa kahigi yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm yɛli Daniɛl.
en: and said, Why did the king order such a severe punishment? Then Arioch explained the whole story about the kings dreams, and Daniel understood.

dag: ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn timmi nti zaŋ n dabili Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza na ka o ti me o nam ʒiishee tam n ni pi kuɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka ti o sampaa gil li.
en: After that, say to the people: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Im sending for my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, who will set his throne over these stones and will spread his canopy over them.

dag: Lala ka Jɔshua daa niŋ tiligi Gibiɔnnim maa Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ bi ku ba.
en: So the Gibeonites became slaves, but Joshua let them live. He did not allow the Israelites to kill them.

dag: Kuɣa wurim bahi saha beni, ka kuɣa laɣisi sɔŋ saha beni. Tab nuhi tibu saha beni, ka tab nuhi tibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: There is a time to throw weapons down and a time to pick them up. There is a time to hug someone and a time to stop holding so tightly.

dag: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti, ka bɛ kana ti paai teeku ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim daa yiɣisi zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba n-kari bɛ naba na hal ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: When I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, they came to the Red Sea, and the men of Egypt were chasing them. There were chariots and men on horses.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm ŋɔ; fom ka n yɛl a.
en: Now, Job, listen to what I am saying; be quiet and let me speak.

dag: Yawɛ, mɔɣa zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi la bee kulibɔna zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bee teeku zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi saha shɛli a ni daa kpe a nasara dibu chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni ka yuri vɔri li la?.
en: Lord , were you angry at the rivers? Were you angry at the streams? Were you angry at the sea? Were you angry when you rode your horses and chariots to victory?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa chɛchɛbunduhiriba tusaayopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pihinahi. Ka o daa lan ku Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ Kamɔna kpɛm maa, ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: The Arameans ran away from the Israelites. David and his army killed Aramean chariot drivers and , Aramean soldiers. David and his army also killed Shophach, the commander of the Aramean army.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni maa Bia la zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ anfaani niŋ ti ni, ka ti ti suhudoo, ka chɛ ka di leei ti dini yɛlimaŋli mini yurilim puuni.
en: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us from God the Father and from his Son, Jesus Christ, as we live in truth and love.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛn la daa ti labina ti yɛra, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kparigim ka ti gari.
en: Later the other bridesmaids came and said, Lord, lord, open the door for us.

dag: Nyama, niriba yi nuzaa polo kanna. Zuliya din mali kpiɔŋ mini nanim pam yi dunia yaɣa din be katiŋa n-damdi li kanna.
en: People are coming from a country in the north, a mighty nation far away; many kings are preparing for war.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a mali yɛm, ka baŋsim yɛtɔɣa be a noli ni.
en: so you might remain discreet, and your lips might guard knowledge.

dag: Ka Haman daa zaŋ kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa chaŋ ti zaŋ kpariti maa yɛli Mɔdɛkai ka chɛ ka o ba wɔhu maa, ka ŋun Haman gari tooni zaŋ o doli tiŋ puuni solɔri, ka kuhiri yɛra, Nyamiya naa ni niŋ o ni yu ni o duhi ninvuɣ so shɛm.
en: So Haman took the robe and the horse and put the robe on Mordecai. He led him on horseback through the city square, shouting as he went, This is what the king does for the man he really wants to honor.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ammɔnnim mini bɛ vi tuma polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlima, Takɔbi, bɛ ŋooi takɔbi ni bɛ ku niriba! Bɛ nyɛhimi neei li ni di ku niriba, ka di nyaɣisiri kaman saa la.
en: You, human one, prophesy and say, The LORD God proclaims to the Ammonites concerning their disgrace. Say, Sword! Sword unsheathed for slaughter, burnished, battle-ready, flashing like lightning.

dag: Speen ŋariŋduhiriba, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama bɛ saɣim yi birininima.
en: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.

dag: Dama o daŋ maa pala din ni tibi kpaŋ. Di looi Judanima. Di paai n niriba dunɔdal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Indeed, Zion has been weakened by her wounds! It has come as far as Judah; he has struck as far as the gate of my people, as far as Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abigeel, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun tim a na ka a ti tuhi ma soli ŋɔ mali alibarika!.
en: David answered Abigail, Praise the Lord , the God of Israel. Praise God for sending you to meet me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, Fom baalim ʒini zibisim ni, bɛ ku lan bol a zuliya kam paɣiba naa.
en: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.

dag: Ka ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa zaŋ o ti, ka bɛ di o saria n-yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But our chief priests and our leaders handed him over to be sentenced to death, and they crucified him.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa ŋmari daɣu ka o lɛbiɛlim ti kpaai lu kom ni. Ka o kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Ndana! N suhi li mi na.
en: While one of the prophets was working, his ax head fell off and dropped into the water. Oh! he shouted. Sir, I borrowed this ax.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli.
en: With the commanders permission, Paul stood on the steps and gestured to the people. When they were quiet, he addressed them in Aramaic.

dag: N ni fo ka yi wuhi ma. Chɛliya ka m baŋ n ni tum gala shɛli.
en: So now, teach me, and I will be quiet. Show me what I have done wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, Chamiya ti sɔɣi do wain tihi pur la ni gu.
en: So the elders told the men of Benjamin about their idea. They said, Go and hide in the vineyards.

dag: Yi barinyubo ka gbinni. Yi bi mi ni dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita?.
en: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Jɔtam bia Naa Ahaz mi daa di Juda nam.
en: In the seventeenth year of the reign of Pekah son of Remaliah as king of Israel, Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah.

dag: Ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni mali binshɛɣukam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o. O yuli Mɛlikizɛdɛk gbinni nyɛla Wuntia Naa. O lan nyɛla Salɛm Naa, ka di mi gbinni nyɛla Suhudoo Naa.
en: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is King of Justice. But since Salem means peace, he is also King of Peace.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛn pa wuntizɔriba zaa ku kpe Naawuni nam ni? Di yɔhimya yimaŋa, dama bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma mini buɣijɛmdiba ni zinaniŋdiba ni dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba.
en: Surely you know that the wicked will not possess God's Kingdom. Do not fool yourselves; people who are immoral or who worship idols or are adulterers or homosexual perverts.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli Musa, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni niŋ nyini ti dan ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The Gadites and the Reubenites said to Moses, Your servants will do as my master has commanded.

dag: amaa bɛ daa bi tooi tɔɣisi luh o, dama o daa tɔɣisirimi ni yɛm mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko.
en: But the Spirit gave Stephen such wisdom that when he spoke, they could not refute him.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ yɛl ti mi ni bɛ bɔri ni ti teeri nandaamba bɛn be bɛ ni yɛla, ka n gba suhu ni daa pun ye shɛli niŋbu zuɣu n-daa bala.
en: They asked us to do only one thing—to remember to help those who are poor. And this was something that I really wanted to do.

dag: Bɛ gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti diri wahala, ka tumdi dabitim tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka bi nya vuhim shee. Bɛn daa kari doli ba maa zaa gbahi ba bɛ nandahima pam puuni.
en: Judah was exiled after suffering and hard service. She lives among the nations; she finds no rest. All who were chasing her caught her— right in the middle of her distress.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya yaa n-chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn du n-chaŋ ti ʒini maa ni.
en: So you must obey every command I tell you today. Then you will be strong. And you will be able to go across the Jordan River and take the land that you are ready to enter.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ yɛndan ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu Yisa Masia zuɣu! Ami!.
en: To the only God, who alone is all-wise, be glory through Jesus Christ forever! Amen.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yidan yipa ni zaŋ omaŋ tabili ma, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ata ti o; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Lɛvi.
en: Leah became pregnant again and had another son. She named this son Levi. She said, Now, surely my husband will love me. I have given him three sons.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din be nuzaa polo la gbini. Paɣiba n-daa ʒi nimaani n-kumdi Tammuz kuli.
en: So he took me to the north gate of the Temple and showed me women weeping over the death of the god Tammuz.

dag: O ni daa kpi kum shɛl la, o daa kpimi yim zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa nyɛvil shɛli o ni mali be ŋɔ, Naawuni zuɣu ka o be maa.
en: Yes, when Christ died, he died to defeat the power of sin one time—enough for all time. He now has a new life, and his new life is with God.

dag: Bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisiya, bɛ bi lan garigi shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli.
en: Words have failed them, Job; they have no answer for you.

dag: M bɔhirila n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tam n yɛla? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: I say to God, my Rock, Why have you forgotten me? Why must I suffer this sadness that my enemies have brought me.

dag: N ni tiligi m biŋkɔbiri maa, ka so ku lan nahim ba. Ka n ti woligi binshɛli din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni.
en: so I will save my flock. They will not be caught by wild animals anymore. I will judge between one sheep and another.

dag: O ni daa paai yiŋa Ifriim zoya ni tinsi maa ni, o daa piɛb la kikaa; ka Izraɛlnim daa yi zoya tinsi maa ni laɣim o sanna, ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: When he arrived there in the hill country of Ephraim, he blew a trumpet to call the people of Israel to battle; then he led them down from the hills.

dag: Naawuni lo nia ni o zaŋ ashil shɛli din wuhir o daazichi min o jilima pam zaŋ chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim polo n-kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda. Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Masia be yi ni! Dina n-nyɛ yi tahima ni yi min o ni ti laɣim mali Naawuni jilima.
en: God decided to let his people know just how rich and glorious that truth is. That secret truth, which is for all people, is that Christ lives in you, his people. He is our hope for glory.

dag: Ka a ni yɛn mali tulaale zim maa shɛm maa, miri ka a ti mali di tatabo n-leeg amaŋmaŋ dini. Zaŋm li leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.

dag: So bi piiri maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima o tolitoli; kulla Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-piiri nir leeri maligumaaniba zuɣulana kaman o ni daa piig Aduna shɛm la.
en: No one takes this honor for themselves but takes it only when they are called by God, just like Aaron.

dag: chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo ti suhuri ni niŋ yɛda, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paɣi neei ka ti yi taali ni ti suhuri ni tɛha puuni, ka su ti niŋgbuna mi ko viɛlli, ka vu m-miri Naawuni.
en: So let us come near to God with a sincere heart and a sure faith, with hearts that have been purified from a guilty conscience and with bodies washed with clean water.

dag: Ziɔnnima, Maliya suhupiɛlli pam! Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu! Nyamiya, Yi naa kani yi sanna! O nyaŋmi ka di nasara n-kanna maa, amaa o nyɛla siɣisimaŋlana, ka bari buŋa ŋun nyɛ buŋ polli.
en: Rejoice, rejoice, people of Zion! Shout for joy, you people of Jerusalem! Look, your king is coming to you! He comes triumphant and victorious, but humble and riding on a donkey— on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wurim maa daa chani gindi luɣilikam n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: Those who had been scattered moved on, preaching the good news along the way.

dag: Nir ni tooi di o ba min o ma yili mini bɛ buni fali, amaa yidaampaɣ so ŋun mali yɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: A man can inherit a house and money from his parents, but only the Lord can give him a sensible wife.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa ni daa yiri maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa n-kum pam. Ka Naa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ du, ka o min o niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: The whole countryside cried loudly as all the troops marched past. The king crossed the Kidron Valley, and all the troops passed by on the Olive road into the wilderness.

dag: Dinzuɣu tim man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛm din ni zaŋ gbib a niriba maa, ka tooi baŋ zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu; dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Please give your servant a discerning mind in order to govern your people and to distinguish good from evil, because no one is able to govern this important people of yours without your help.

dag: Amaa din sabi niŋ di ni ŋɔ sabimi ni yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia, ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili o yuli zuɣu.
en: But these are written so that you can believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God. Then, by believing, you can have life through his name.

dag: Dama n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla bindir maŋli, ka n ʒim mi nyɛ binnyur maŋli.
en: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di chɛ ka a nuzaa mi a nudirigu ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: But when you give to the poor, dont let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari shihira ŋɔ zaa, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: In the same way, when you see all these things happening, you will know that the time is very near, already present.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Kpahimmiya fiig tia: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: Learn a lesson from a fig tree. When its branches sprout and start putting out leaves, you know summer is near.

dag: Ka ti daa bi wum ti ba hal baabiɛla ni di chɛ ka ti ba yɛlimaŋli din be lahibal suŋ maa ni zali tin ya.
en: We didnt give in and submit to them for a single moment, so that the truth of the gospel would continue to be with you.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Chɛli di zaa ha ka chaŋ, dama o nyɛla n ni pii so ni o zaŋ n yuli wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini nazuɣuri ni Izraɛlnima.
en: But the Lord Jesus said to Ananias, Go! I have chosen Saul for an important work. I want him to tell other nations, their rulers, and the people of Israel about me.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Kunyanambɔzɔbo, dama n ku lan zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ taali hal biɛla gba.
en: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.

dag: Kalim Izraɛlnim kaman sokam min o malibu ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Sabimiya doo kam yuli.
en: You and Aaron are to take a census of the people of Israel by clans and families. List the names of all the men.

dag: Ka n garigi bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli ma, Man Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: Who are you, Lord? I asked. I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute, he said to me.

dag: ni zoli kam zuɣu mɔɣu ni la yɛla. N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ zaa ni n-yo yi daalahichi maa samli.
en: They remember those things on the mountains in the open country. The people of Judah have many treasures. I will give those things to other people. People will destroy all the high places in your country. You worshiped there, and that was a sin.

dag: Niriba anahi bɛn daa nyɛ kɔnsi daa do Samaria sambani polo dunol shee. Ka bɛ daa ti bɔhi taba, Bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ʒi kpe hal ti kpi?.
en: Now there were four men with skin disease at the entrance to the city. They said to each other, What are we doing sitting here until we die?.

dag: Di ni ʒiɛya lala sahakam, ni di chɛ ka niriba doli zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali mini din tuhi tumbu ni.
en: His commands will continue forever. They must be done with truth and honesty.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni Alikauli Adaka la tooni, n ni kani a sanna luɣ shɛl la.
en: Take them to the Tent of my presence and put them in front of the Covenant Box, where I meet you.

dag: ka o ti yɛl o din ni tilig o min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: He will speak words to you by which you and all your family will be saved.

dag: Sana yi be yi tiŋgban ni, yin di niŋy o zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Do not do bad things to foreigners living in your country.

dag: N ni zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ bɛ ni, ka niŋ ba din viɛla, ka ti lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zani, ka ku lan daai ba luhi. N ni zaŋ ba sa, ka ku lan sibigi ba.
en: I will protect them. I will bring them back to the land of Judah. I will not tear them down—I will build them up. I will not pull them up—I will plant them so that they can grow.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the twelfth month in the twelfth year of exile, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋmi bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa buɣisi n ni yɛli shɛm. Bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa yi be di ko ka chɛ n dini maa di wuhiya ni neesim bee yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ ni.
en: You should follow the teachings and the agreement. I swear, if you follow those other things, there is no future for you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ahija ŋun nyɛ Shilo nir la yɛli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam shɛm la palibu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Rɛhɔbɔam bi saɣi ti niriba maa.
en: It was the will of the Lord to bring about what he had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh. This is why the king did not pay any attention to the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ti chaŋ ka di ti paai yuun pisinaanu piligu ni goli biɛɣu pia dali. Bɛ ni daa wurim tiŋ maa ka di ti paai yuun pinaanahi saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: In the beginning of the twenty-fifth year of our exile, on the tenth day of the month, exactly fourteen years after the city was struck down, on that very day, the LORDs power was on me, and he took me there.

dag: Naawuni, kul niŋmi alibarika niŋmi ti ni. Niriba bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa jɛmm a.
en: God has blessed us; may all people everywhere honor him.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla saha din ka bahigu naa. Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim ni bahi yoli o tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Lord , you are King forever and ever, so I know you will remove the wicked nations from your land.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu n-siɣirina ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: On their way down from the mountain, Jesus warned his disciples not to tell anyone what they had seen until after the Son of Man had been raised from death.

dag: A daa yina ni a ti tilig a niriba, ka daa yina ni a ti tilig a ninvuɣ gahindili. Nyini n-ŋme wurim ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili, ka wurim di mɔpilli hal ti tabili di tanzaa.
en: You went out to save your people, to save your chosen king. You struck down the leader of the wicked and completely destroyed his followers.

dag: Ka naa daa po n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi ka nyɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then the king made a promise: The Lord has saved me from every danger. As surely as he lives, I make this promise to you.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Wummiya fabila yil shɛli n ni yiini niŋdi ya ŋɔ:.
en: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tizɔpaɣ Ribɛka min o yiŋ dab paɣa doli Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o maa.
en: So they allowed Rebekah to go with Abrahams servant and his men. Her nurse also went with them.

dag: Sagban tibisa lim o n-chɛ ka o bi nyara, ka be zuɣusaa kpaakpanyom ni chana.
en: Clouds conceal him so he cant see while he walks on heavens rim.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti dɔni o yaannim tooni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: David was king of Israel years. He ruled years from Hebron and years from Jerusalem. Then he died and was buried in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: O yihi ma gballi ni. O zaŋ yurilim maŋli min o nambɔzɔbo leei zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: He saves us from the grave, and he gives us love and compassion.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka niriba ni ti bɔhi, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be? Darigim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yih a daba ʒim maa tibili ka timaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: Why should nations ask us, Where is your God? Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yi ku nya pɔhim bee saa, amaa kom ni tɛli baa ŋɔ ni ka yi mini yi niɣi ni yi biŋkɔbiri nyu. .
en: Even though you will not see any rain or wind, this stream bed will be filled with water, and you, your livestock, and your pack animals will have plenty to drink.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi nya di yiko, ka pa ni Naawuni n-ti a li; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni ŋɔ daalahichi galisi gar a dini.
en: Jesus replied, If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira kpɛhi duu saha shɛl la nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ka Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nti yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee and told people the Good News from God.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa garita n-nya ka fiig tia la kuumi zaa nti tabili di tiŋ wula.
en: The next morning Jesus was walking with his followers. They saw the fig tree that he spoke to the day before. The tree was dry and dead, even the roots.

dag: N ni lo ni n tum din viɛli zuɣu, n dimnim zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma din viɛli niŋbu samli.
en: Those who give, repay good with evil; they oppose me for pursuing good.

dag: Bɛnhadad min o natab bɛn daa ʒe o nyaaŋa la daa bela bɛ suɣa ni nyuri dam, ka bɛ zaŋ o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa na ti yɛli Bɛnhadad. Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi ni bɛ malim shili n-chaŋ ti liri Samarianim maa, ka bɛ daa teei zani.
en: King Ben-Hadad was drinking in his tent with the other rulers when the messengers came back and gave him the message from King Ahab. King Ben-Hadad commanded his men to prepare to attack the city, so the men moved into their places for the battle.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛli ka di kul zaɣizaɣimi to n-yina pahi di zuɣu.
en: Then seven heads of grain sprouted, thin and scorched by the desert wind.

dag: Bɛ ka buchi, ka nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: They are worthless and should be despised; they will be destroyed when the Lord comes to deal with them.

dag: Ifriimnim daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, niriba niŋgbuna sɔhirimi, bɛ daa tibigi ba pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti jɛmdi Baal, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: The tribe of Ephraim made itself very important in Israel. Ephraim spoke and people shook with fear. But Ephraim sinned by worshiping Baal, so he must die.

dag: Saɣisigu kpɛri ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima pam n-gari bɛ fiɛbi jɛrigu fiɛbiga bukɔbiga.
en: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.

dag: Baanabas daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi pal o ka o mali yɛda pam. Ka niriba pam daa kpe ti Duuma jɛmbu ni pahi.
en: Barnabas was a good man of great faith, and he was filled with the Holy Spirit. Many more people turned to the Lord.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Yinim Dauda zuliya ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, yi ni niŋdi shɛm chɛ ka ninsalinim nyee nyooni la, lala ka yi bɔri ni yi niŋ chɛ ka n Naawuni ŋɔ gba nyee nyɔni.
en: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri maa so, ka zaŋ gabisi maa vili bɛ zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl naa maa sani ti yɛl o, A dabili Bɛnhadad yɛliya ni o suhirila o nyɛvili. Ka Naa Ɛhab daa garigi bɔhi ba, O na be o nyɛvil ni? O nyɛla m mabia.
en: So they put mourning clothes on their bodies and cords around their heads. They went to Israels king and said, Ben-hadad is your slave. He begs, Please let me live! Israels king said, Is he still alive? He is my brother.

dag: Noli ni ti din ya yi fɔntinsi ni, ka din ya yi puri ni.
en: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the field.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim tam ŋun nam ba yɛla, ka mɛla nanim yiya. Ka Judanim me fɔntinsi pam, ka me goondahi gil li. Amaa n ni chɛ ka buɣim lu bɛ fɔntinsi maa zuɣu n-di bɛ sɔɣisili shɛhi zaa.
en: Israel has forgotten his maker, and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied walled cities; but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it will devour his fortresses.

dag: Deemi ti suhigu, ka zaŋ a kpiɔŋ la n-ti ti nasara, ka lala chɛ ka a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la tiligi.
en: Save us by your might; answer our prayer, so that the people you love may be rescued.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Alizin birigu maa kul luhir o la waawaayili; ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni ni o di o nyɛvili. Ka a yi ni tooi sɔŋ ti, nyin zom ti nambɔɣu sɔŋ ti.
en: It has often thrown him into a fire or into water trying to kill him. If you can do anything, help us! Show us compassion.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ gari ti ni suhi shɛm tariga mini ti ni tɛhi shɛm zuɣu la yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma ti ni la zuɣu.
en: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.

dag: Nyamiya, di zuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: Look, Ive told you ahead of time.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anahi.
en: Evening came, then morning—that was the fourth day.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di suhi ma niriba ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to me, Do not ask me to help these people.

dag: dama naɣilahi mini buhi ʒim ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi.
en: For the blood of bulls and goats can never take away sins.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Lakishinim niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme n-deei li dabisi shɛli din pah ayi dali, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Libinanim shɛm la.
en: The Lord gave the Israelites victory over Lachish on the second day of the battle. Just as they had done at Libnah, they spared no one, but killed every person in the city.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi bɛ dooshee maa chana, Yawɛ sagban la daa kul ʒiɛla bɛ zuɣusaa dɛde wuntaŋ ni.
en: Now the LORDs cloud was over them by day when they marched from the camp.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ʒim m-bala. Nanim maa ŋ-ŋmaligi zabi n-ku tab maa! Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, chamiya ti di nɛma.
en: It's blood! they exclaimed. The three enemy armies must have fought and killed each other! Let's go and loot their camp.

dag: Musa daa zaŋla o paɣa Zipɔra labisi ka o deemba Jɛtro daa deeg o min o bidibis ayi la ʒili.
en: So Jethro went to Moses while Moses was camped near the mountain of God. Jethro brought Moses wife, Zipporah, with him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yi Jeemsi zuɣu, ka daa lan yi o tuumba la zaa gba zuɣu.
en: Then he appeared to James and later to all the apostles.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.

dag: Hal n yi kuhi, Famiya ma! so bi garigiri ma. N daa duhi n yee pam, amaa ka so daa bi ti ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: I protest his violence, but no one is listening; no one hears my cry for justice.

dag: saha shɛli n ni daa pii zuɣulaannim ka bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la. N ni nyaŋ a dimnim zaa. Din pahi nyɛla, n daa pun kahigi wuh a ni man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: Those bad things happened, but I chose leaders to care for my people Israel. And I will also defeat all your enemies. I tell you that the Lord will build a house for you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Pool, Di ni bɔŋɔ a tɛhiya ni a ni lɛbigi ma Kristiɛn saha biɛla ŋɔ puuni.
en: Agrippa asked Paul, In such a short time do you think you can talk me into being a Christian.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni daba ayopɔin dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the seventh day of the first month. He said:.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa na.
en: Jesus answered, How unbelieving and wrong you people are! How long must I stay with you? How long do I have to put up with you? Then he said to the man, Bring your son here.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti taai duŋ niŋ a n-zaɣis a noli; ka daa lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa bir a fukumsi zaligu la. Bɛ daa ku a daanabinim shɛb bɛn kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ lab a sanna la. Bɛ daa mo a pam.
en: But they were disobedient, rebelled against you, and turned their back on your Instruction. They killed your prophets who had warned them so that they might return to you. They held you in great contempt.

dag: Yi yaannim daa zahim ma, hal bɛ ni daa kul nya n ni tum shɛm yuun pihinahi puuni la zaa yoli.
en: There they put me to the test and tried me, says God, although they had seen what I did for forty years.

dag: N ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla maa, ka n teei ʒini gbaai kumsi. Dabisi gbaliŋ ka n daa zaŋ fabili ka lo noli n-suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim pam bɛn mini Mariama daa doli kana la daa nya Yisa ni tum shɛm maa, ka niŋ o yɛda.
en: Therefore, many of the Jews who came with Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa daa bɔrimi ni bɛ kpɛhi ti dabiɛm ka tɛhira, Bɛ kɔba ni ni chɔɣisi, ka bɛ kɔŋ tuma tumbu. Ka n daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, N Naawuni, kpaŋsim n kɔba ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi gbahi ba daba.
en: When you wage war against your enemies and the LORD hands them over to you and you take prisoners.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri chi zim viɛl shɛli; ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣila yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu.
en: Their grain offering will be fine flour mixed with oil. You will offer three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the ram.

dag: Chɛliya ka ŋunkam zaa be Ziɔn duh o yee yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka be kasi ŋɔ be o niriba sunsuuni.
en: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi ni nir dee li zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti tiligila alahichinima; mani mi n-nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam.
en: Here is a true statement that should be accepted without question: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, and I am the worst of them.

dag: O daa bi saɣi n-chɛ ka so nahim ba. O daa kpahi nanim zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: But the Lord did not let anyone mistreat them. He warned kings not to harm them.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di niŋ kamaata ni yi teei ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuumba ni daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zal la yɛla.
en: Dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said would happen.

dag: N naan wuh o n napɔna yaabu zaa, ka chaŋ o sani kaman naa la.
en: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi, dama yi yi bi niŋ yɛda ni n nyɛla n ni pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la, yi shiri ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi.
en: I told you that you would die in your sins. Yes, if you dont believe that I AM, you will die in your sins.

dag: Yulimiya zuliya shɛba n-nya alahiziba, ka di gari ya. Dama n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli yi ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni, ka yi yi wum li yi ku niŋ li yɛda.
en: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya Yila litaafi puuni: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: For David himself says in the book of Psalms, The Lord said to my Lord: Sit here at my right side.

dag: M bia Timoti, n zaŋ niriba zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛla ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo. Chɛ ka di yɛtɔɣa maa leeg a bidibbina ka a zaŋ li tuhi tuhiri suŋ.
en: Timothy, my child, I entrust to you this command, which is in accordance with the words of prophecy spoken in the past about you. Use those words as weapons in order to fight well.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi li buyopɔin n-yihi li Izraɛlnim daɣiri maa ni.
en: He will sprinkle some of the blood on the altar with his finger seven times. In this way, he will purify it and make it holy again from the Israelites pollution.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n yiŋa daa yɛra, Bɛnkam kpe yili ŋɔ na dirimi tiɣira.
en: The people in my house know that I have never let anyone go hungry.

dag: Amaa a dabili maa yi yɛl a, N ku chaŋ ka chɛ a, ka di nyɛla o ni yur a mini a yiŋnima yi ni gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But one of your slaves might say to you, I will not leave you. He might say this because he loves you and your family and because he has a good life with you.

dag: A ni yɛn kpi shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma. N yi chɛ ka binshɛli woligi m min a ka pa ni kum, Yawɛ ŋun darigim n tibili.
en: Where you die, I will die, and that is where I will be buried. I ask the Lord to punish me if I dont keep this promise: Only death will separate us.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n tiri ya jilima, ka yuri ya la zuɣu, n ni zaɣisi zuliya pam niriba, ka tiligi ya.
en: Because you are precious in my eyes, you are honored, and I love you. I give people in your place, and nations in exchange for your life.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛshua mini Bani ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛbania ni Bunni ni Shɛrɛbia ni Bani so mi ni Kɛnani daa yiɣisi zani Lɛvinim ni daa ʒe bimbin shɛli zuɣu ka duhi bɛ yee n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: On the stairs of the Levites stood Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani. They cried out with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, yinima n-tum tuumbiɛri ŋɔ zaa, amaa di zaa yoli, di ŋmaligiya ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu, amaa kul jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: Samuel answered, Dont be afraid. It is true that you did all these bad things, but dont stop following the Lord . Serve the Lord with all your heart.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ galisiya gari wuna zaa, o ni daa tiligi niriba maa Ijiptinim nuu ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa niŋdi ba fitiina la zuɣu.
en: Now I know that the Lord is greater than all the gods, because he did this when the Egyptians treated the Israelites with such contempt.

dag: Tiŋgbani, sɔhigim ti Duuma tooni. Sɔhigim ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: Earth: Tremble before the Lord! Tremble before the God of Jacob.

dag: bɛ yi bi niŋdi niriba din tuhi Zallakudura Naa tooni.
en: He knows when we are denied the rights he gave us;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahind o, ka tim niriba ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman bɛ nyɛla bɛn nini mooi yɛlimaŋli zuɣu la m-puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o niŋ gomnanti fukumsi ni.
en: So the Jewish leaders waited for the right time to get Jesus. They sent some men to him, who pretended to be sincere. They wanted to find something wrong with what Jesus said.

dag: Yinima n niriba Izraɛlnima, n ni lan zaŋ ya labisi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka yi ti be di ni n-su li yaha. Ka yi bihi ku lan kpi di ni.
en: I will bring you, my people Israel, back to live again in the land. It will be your own land, and it will never again let your children starve.

dag: Ka Dauda mini tɔbbi kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la ni kpamba zaa daa gbaai saawara.
en: King David consulted with all the officers in command of units of a thousand men and units of a hundred men.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi paŋ liɣiri so sani, bɛ je ni bɛ yo li, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyɛla bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ka tiri pini.
en: The wicked borrow money and never pay it back. But good people are kind and generous.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔshua sani Giligal sansani la ni nti yɛl o mini Izraɛlnima. Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na ni ti mini ya ti lo tab alikauli.
en: They went to Joshua at the camp at Gilgal. They said to him and to Israel, We have come from a distant country. So now, make a treaty with us.

dag: Hal yi ni maani sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la mini chi sara la, n ku deei li. M mi ku gbiligi lihi yi ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb kar shɛb na nti maani suhudoo sara la.
en: I won't accept your offerings or animal sacrifices— not even your very best.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N sara maligu dabisili maa dali, n ni ti darigi kpambaliba mini nabihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri tinduya ni binyɛra la tibili.
en: On that day of slaughter, says the Lord , I will punish the officials, the king's sons, and all who practice foreign customs.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Zakur bia Shammua, o daa yila Rubin zuliya ni na;.
en: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua, Zaccurs son.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa yɔri maa, ka salo laɣimna nti wum ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa tɔɣisirila bɛn bɛn laɣimna maa zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu, ka di gari ba pam.
en: A large crowd came together because they heard the noise. They were surprised because, as the apostles were speaking, everyone heard in their own language.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, Alikauli shɛli din be m mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni la shihirili m-bala.
en: The rainbow will be the sign of that solemn promise.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa dii baŋ ni yiko shɛli yi o ni, ka ŋmaligi salo maa ni bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi m binyɛrigu ŋɔ.
en: At once Jesus knew that power had gone out of him, so he turned around in the crowd and asked, Who touched my clothes.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na zo ma nambɔɣu kaman a ni pun niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli shɛm la.
en: Look at me, and be kind to me, just as you always are to those who love your name.

dag: N Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni bi wum o noli zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla bɛn dari gindi yɔɣu zuliyanim sunsuuni.
en: The God I serve will reject his people, because they have not listened to him. They will become wanderers among the nations.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake maa daa duh o yee kuhi yɛli Judanim yɛtɔɣa puuni, Wummiya Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then the official stood up and shouted in Hebrew, Listen to what the emperor of Assyria is telling you.

dag: Yɛm bi boonila niriba? Ka tɛhi zilima mi duhiri di yee?.
en: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out.

dag: Nyama di daba ata dali ka do so daa ti yi Sool sansan ni n-zo m-paana ka o binyɛra chahi, ka taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu. O ni daa ti paai Dauda sani, o daa lumi gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura.
en: Three days later, a soldier came from Saul's army. His clothes were torn, and dirt was on his head. He went to David and knelt down in front of him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ma la, chɛ ka bɛ noya ni yɛli yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa la lab ʒini bɛ zuɣu.
en: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya niŋdi yaa, di nyaaŋa ka o bahi ba yoli. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya yɛligira, di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ ba bahi.
en: God makes nations great, and then he destroys them. He makes nations grow large, and then he scatters their people.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba bi gbɛri kum, amaa o chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The LORD doesnt let the righteous starve, but he rejects the desires of the wicked.

dag: zalikpana ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Izraɛlnima bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be.
en: These are the laws and the regulations and the case laws that Moses spoke to the Israelites when they came out of Egypt.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ piim tiliginsim tinsi kaman n ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: to say to the people of Israel, Choose the cities of refuge that I had Moses tell you about.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ, ka piɛgul suŋ mi zaŋd o nyɛvili taɣir o piɛri dini.
en: I am the good shepherd, who is willing to die for the sheep.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni tahima lan kani, o kɔŋla o bia maa, ka o daa lan piig o bi so wums o ka o niŋ yaa.
en: His mother waited for him to return. But soon she lost all hope and raised another cub, who also became fierce.

dag: Nir nyamma yi pahi, bɛn diri li gba pahirimi. Ka di nyɔri nyɛ dini ŋun su li sani m-pahila o nini n-kul yɛn nya li?.
en: When good things flow, so do those who consume them. But what do owners benefit from such goods, except to feast their eyes on them?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ dunoli, ka so yi doli ma kpe, o ni tiligi. O ni doli ma kpɛri ka yira, ka nyari dihili.
en: I am the gate. Whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out and find pasture.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti ni daa woligi ya daba ayi la puuni, kulla ti niŋgbuna tab woligibu ko yɛla ka n yɛri maa, ka pa ni ti tɛha tab Woligibu. Ti naɣi ya nyabu, ka mi kul kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti lan nyan ya yaha.
en: As for us, friends, when we were separated from you for a little while—not in our thoughts, of course, but only in body—how we missed you and how hard we tried to see you again!.

dag: N dabisa maa zɔrimi gariti kaman ŋariŋ shɛli din zɔri pam la, di chanimi kaman tɔrili ni yi silim na ni o ti to binnɛɔŋ shɛm la.
en: They sweep by like ships made of reeds, as an eagle swoops on prey.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha n-niŋ yomyom chaŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa gbini.
en: At dawn the king got up and hurried to the pit.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ Kɛdɛmɔt mini Mɛfaat ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: Kedemoth with its pasturelands, and Mephaath with its pasturelands.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ niŋ nimmoo n-chɛ ka yi bolibu mini yi piibu la ba n-zani, dama yi yi niŋ lala yi ku lu.
en: My brothers and sisters, God called you and chose you to be his. Do your best to live in a way that shows you really are Gods called and chosen people. If you do all this, you will never fall.

dag: A yi gbib a noli min a zilinli, a ni yi yɛla ni.
en: People who are careful about what they say will save themselves from trouble.

dag: Du bihi atata n-daa be wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali maa yaɣa ayi zaa. Du bihi atata maa zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di daantalisi din be di luɣa zuɣu zaa barilim nyɛ yim.
en: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.

dag: Yisa daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba biɛɣukam, amaa ka daa lee duri Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu ti gbɛri yuŋ kam.
en: Jesus spent those days teaching in the Temple, and when evening came, he would go out and spend the night on the Mount of Olives.

dag: Bɛ muɣisigu maa saha, bɛ ni ti nya sɔŋsim biɛla, hal ka niriba pam ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali bɛ ni la yɔhiŋgu zuɣu.
en: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.

dag: A ʒiɛyimtali kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni. Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka di mi kul ni beni sahakam.
en: You are loyal forever and ever. You made the earth, and it still stands.

dag: O suhi ma mi ni n chɛ ka o doli kachɛriba maa nyaaŋa yihiri kayiha. Ka o kul bela o tuma ni asibaasi la zaa zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ, o na kul bi ʒini vuhi biɛla gba.
en: She said, Please let me glean so that I might gather up grain from among the bundles behind the harvesters. She arrived and has been on her feet from the morning until now, and has sat down for only a moment.

dag: Dapaɣili kam daa malila dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tuɣi taba. Bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: Each board had two pegs for joining them to each other. They did this for all the dwellings boards.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb tahiri yɛri ni ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka shɛb mi yɛri ni ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ. O ni daa bi tooi baŋ yɛlli maa zuɣu ni di naba maa zuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool tahi tɔbbihi maa yiŋ na.
en: Some in the crowd shouted one thing, others shouted something else. Because of the commotion, he couldnt learn the truth, so he ordered that Paul be taken to the military headquarters.

dag: Bɛ nini daa nya Yawɛ tuma din nyɛ o daalahiziba tuma la teeku bulli maa ni.
en: They saw what the Lord can do. They saw the amazing things he did at sea.

dag: N kul paɣiri Naawuni sahakam yi zuɣu, o ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I always give thanks to my God for you because of the grace he has given you through Christ Jesus.

dag: O boli o sapashin kpamba, ka bɛ kanna ka tuura, bɛ zo yomyom chaŋ gooni gbini, bɛ zaŋ nyɔtaɣirigu zali.
en: The officers are summoned; they stumble as they press forward. The attackers rush to the wall and set up the shield for the battering ram.

dag: Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa bol o o Duuma, ka di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: Since David calls him Lord, how can he be Davids son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa. Di bi be kaman yi yaannim ni daa di shɛli ka kpi la, amaa ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ dina, dilan ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa nya ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni alizini m-bala ka kuhi pam.
en: When they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost and they screamed.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-nyɛ yɛndana ni baŋda? Di simdi ni o zaŋ o biɛrisuntali n-wuh o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm tarimtali yɛm puuni.
en: Are any of you wise and understanding? Show that your actions are good with a humble lifestyle that comes from wisdom.

dag: Ka o daa lan saɣim Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni la ni di chɛ ka so ku lan zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga m-mali buɣili Molɛk.
en: Josiah sent some men to Hinnom Valley just outside Jerusalem with orders to make the altar there unfit for worship. That way, people could no longer use it for sacrificing their children to the god Molech.

dag: Alikauli kurili maa yi di daa be dɛde, di di bi lan kpa talahi ni din pah ayi kana.
en: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa piligi yihiri waazu n-yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina .
en: From that time Jesus began to tell people his message: Change your hearts and lives, because Gods kingdom is now very near. .

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi nya di yiko, ka pa ni Naawuni n-ti a li; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni ŋɔ daalahichi galisi gar a dini.
en: Jesus answered, You have authority over me only because it was given to you by God. So the man who handed me over to you is guilty of a worse sin.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A pun nya o, hal ŋuna n-dir a alizama ŋɔ.
en: You have already seen him, Jesus answered, and right now he is talking with you.

dag: amaa sagbani maa daa yi bi vuui, bɛ bi chani shɛli naɣila di yi ti vuui chana ka bɛ chana.
en: But if the cloud didnt rise, then they didnt set out until the day it rose.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ŋmaligi yɛli Adam mi, A ni deeg a paɣ noli, ka di ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la zuɣu, n yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; a yɛn tumdila tuun kpɛma di ni n-nyari bindirigu diri hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: And he said to the man, You listened to your wife and ate the fruit which I told you not to eat. Because of what you have done, the ground will be under a curse. You will have to work hard all your life to make it produce enough food for you.

dag: n yi daa yuli wuntaŋa saha shɛl o ni daa puhi na, bee n-nya goli ni chani ni jilima.
en: I have never worshiped the bright sun or the beautiful moon.

dag: Doo miri ka o kpuɣ o ba paɣa n-filim o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o nya o ba zaɣim.
en: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sinai tiŋgban nɛl maa ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Kiburɔtihataava.
en: They marched from the Sinai desert and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.

dag: Amaa luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni pii yi zuliya yini sani, nimaani kɔŋko ka yi ni ti maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa, ka niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa nimaani.
en: The Lord will choose his special place among your tribes. Offer your burnt offerings and do everything else I told you only in that place.

dag: N ni daa be Damaskus, Naa Arɛtas ni daa zali so ka o su Damaskus fukumsi la daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zan la tiŋ maa gooni dunoya ni ni bɛ gu soli gbaai ma.
en: When I was in Damascus, the governor under King Aretas placed guards at the city gates to arrest me.

dag: Yuri, chamiya tooni, chɛchɛbunsi, bilimmiya yomyom! Chɛ ka tɔbbihi cham tooni. Itiɔpianim mini Libianim n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi ka Lidianim mi nyɛ peentɔriba.
en: Go ahead, Egypt. Tell your chariots and cavalry to attack and fight hard. Order your troops to march out, with Ethiopians and Libyans carrying shields, and the Lydians armed with bows and arrows.

dag: Bɛ yi kul be luɣ shɛlikam, dabiɛm m-mali ba, ka kariti doli ba duri bɛ napɔŋkpahi.
en: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋ-ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni m-booni tab yɛra:.
en: You people are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bi be kasi ka ŋubi Yawɛ sara maligu nimdi ni daɣiri, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: but anyone who eats the flesh of a communal sacrifice of well-being that belongs to the LORD while in an unclean state will be cut off from their people.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mi a yuli zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋla a ni; ka a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi nyin Yawɛ.
en: Those who know you, Lord , will trust you; you do not abandon anyone who comes to you.

dag: O ni daa baŋ Pita kukoli, suhupiɛlli zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi yooi dunol maa, amaa ka naɣ zomi kpe nti yɛli ni Pita ʒe dunol ni.
en: When she heard Peter's voice, she was too excited to open the gate. She ran back into the house and said Peter was standing there.

dag: Amaa ka Barizillai daa yɛli, Yuma ala ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ dunia yili ŋɔ, ka lan doli nyin naa kuni Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: Barzillai answered: Your Majesty, why should I go to Jerusalem? I don't have much longer to live.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ deeg o suhigu, dama o daa nya nahiŋgu shɛli Siria naa ni nahindi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Then Jehoahaz begged the Lord to help them. The Lord listened to him because he had seen the terrible troubles that the king of Aram had caused the Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka a dol a soli ni alaafee, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui shɛli.
en: You will walk safely and never stumble;.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord told me.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ata.
en: Evening passed and morning came—that was the third day.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Yɛhudianim to jina n-naai noli ni bɛ suh a ka a sa zaŋ Pool tahi jintɔriba sanna biɛɣu ni, ka di be kaman bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: He said, The Jewish authorities have agreed to ask you tomorrow to take Paul down to the Council, pretending that the Council wants to get more accurate information about him.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayɔbu dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah anii mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: Ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, dama n labirila m Ba sani ka yi ku lan nya ma.
en: He will show them how wrong they are about how to be right with God. The Helper will do this, because I am going to the Father. You will not see me then.

dag: So yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi.
en: Suppose there is a truly good man who always does what is fair and right.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛlaa maa kul mal o yila maa n-ʒiɛri kpari wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo. Ka biŋkɔb so daa kani n-ni tooi taɣ o zali bee n-zo n-yi o nuu ni tiligi. Piɛlaa maa daa kul tumdila o suhuyubu, ka duhir omaŋa.
en: I saw the ram goring west, north, and south. No animal could resist the ram, and no one could stop it, rescuing others from its power. The ram did whatever it pleased. It became powerful.

dag: ŋun nyɛ Shamma ŋun daa nyɛ Harar nir la bia ni Ahiam ŋun daa nyɛ Sharar Harar nir la bia.
en: Shammahs son from Harar; Ahiam, Sharars son from Harar.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, nyini n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi n niriba ŋɔ na, a mi daa bi chɛ ka m baŋ a ni yɛn tim so na ka m min o ti chaŋ, amaa di zaa yoli ka a yɛli ma, M mi a viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n nini lan tiɣ a.
en: Moses said to the Lord , I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.

dag: Ka n yi vuɣi ba, di nyaaŋa n ni lan zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni.
en: And after I have dug them up, I will again have compassion on them and restore their inheritance and their land.

dag: O ŋmanila kɔhigɔriba ŋarima; o ʒir o bindirigu yirila katiŋ na.
en: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa, amaa ʒiŋmariba ʒiri ni zani tariga.
en: The mouth of the righteous flows with wisdom, but the twisted tongue will be cut off.

dag: Ka Iso daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka n ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa daliri lee nyɛla dini? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N zaŋ ba mi na ni n ti ti a m-maai nyini n dan suhu.
en: Esau asked Jacob, Why did you send those herds I met along the road? Master, Jacob answered, I sent them so you would be friendly to me.

dag: Itiɔpianim ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ biɛhigu bee jɛŋgbina ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuna bomaboma? Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn gba tum tuumbiɛri ka di mili ya ŋɔ, yi ku tooi lan tum tuun viɛla.
en: Can a Cushite change his skin or a leopard its spots? Neither can you do good when doing evil comes so naturally.

dag: Wuntia soli dolibu shiri nyɛla azichi din galisi, nir ŋun dee nini yi tiɣi o ni mali shɛli;.
en: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.

dag: Malimiya salima bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di naba anahi ni, yaɣ yini bans ayi yaɣ din la mi bansi ayi.
en: Make four gold rings for carrying the Box. Put the gold rings on the four corners, two rings on each side.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD because he is good, because his faithful love endures forever.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ku binshɛɣukam din be dunia ni zaa.
en: The Lord said, I am going to destroy everything on earth.

dag: Shɔbal bia Reeya n-daa nyɛ Jahat ba, ka Jahat daa nyɛ Ahumai mini Lahad ba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Zɔranim zuliya.
en: Shobals son was Reaiah. Reaiah was Jahaths father. Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. The Zorathites are descendants of Ahumai and Lahad.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, doliya dunoya yi. Malimiya soli sɔŋ niriba. Vuɣimiya kuɣa soli maa zuɣu. Lomiya tuuta n-kpuɣ li zuɣusaa ka niriba nya li baŋ li.
en: Come through the gates! Clear the way for the people! Prepare the road! Move all the stones off the road! Raise a flag as a sign for the nations!.

dag: Molimiy o jilima molo zuliya kam ni, ka yɛl o daalahizib tuma yɛla niriba zaa sani.
en: Tell every nation on earth, The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!.

dag: Di doli daadamnim bɛn vuhim kul be bɛ nyɛhi ni kɔŋko la yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ bukaata nyɛ bɔ?.
en: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?.

dag: ka Mɛshulam daa nyɛ Ɛzra daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Jɛhɔhanan daa nyɛ Amaria daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah.

dag: Tibili bi wumdila yɛtɔɣa ka zahindi li kaman zilinli ni lamdi bindirigu shɛm la?.
en: But just as your tongue enjoys tasting food, your ears enjoy hearing words.

dag: Dama zahimmiya: Bɔ n-lee kpalim? Yi yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga, lala ku niŋ? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am testing my people, and if they refuse to repent, all these things will happen to them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli fukumsi zaligunim ni be, ka bɛn lihi ʒiɛm li ni kpi.
en: Keep God's laws and you will live longer; if you ignore them, you will die.

dag: Yi niŋgbuna ni ti leei noombil kam mini dunia ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu, ka so ti ku beni ŋun ni kari ba.
en: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Miri ka a chɛ ka so suhu saɣim doo ŋɔ zuɣu, mani a dabili ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: Dont let anyone lose courage because of this Philistine! David told Saul. I, your servant, will go out and fight him.

dag: A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa pam. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ filim a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisi shɛŋa la ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father forced us to work very hard. Now, make it easier for us. Stop the heavy work that your father forced us to do and we will serve you.

dag: Ka Haga daa ti dɔɣi Ibram bidibiga, ka Ibram daa boli bi so Haga ni dɔɣi maa yuli Ishimail.
en: Hagar bore Abram a son, and he named him Ishmael.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be mɔɣu maa ni ka wum ni Nabal chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: and David, who was in the wilderness, heard about it.
