dag: Bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ alizanda polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ zilima yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: They speak evil of God in heaven and give arrogant orders to everyone on earth.

dag: Hal Kriitinim ni booni bɛ ni ninvuɣ so anabi la maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya, Kriitinim kul nyɛla ʒiŋmariba mini biŋkɔb biɛri ni diribarilimnima.
en: Even one of their own prophets said, Cretans are always liars. They are evil animals and lazy people who do nothing but eat.

dag: Yɛlima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni baai? O ku darigi vuɣi di mini di nyaɣa, ka di wala pooi ka kuui ka chɛ ka di va maha paligi? Di pala nuu din mali kpiɔŋ bee tɔbbihi pam ka bɛ yɛn bona ka bɛ ti sibigi di mini di nyaɣa.
en: Now tell me, Ezekiel, do you think this grapevine will live? Or will the first eagle pull it up by its roots and pluck off the grapes and let its new leaves die? The eagle could easily kill it without the help of a large and powerful army.

dag: Nir kul ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ka so ku garig o? Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ nyɛla din ni wuhi ni a ka galimi?.
en: So much foolish talk cannot go unanswered.

dag: Sabimi ti Filadɛlfia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana, ka mali Naa Dauda saafɛbia, ka nyɛ ŋun ni yooi ka so ku tooi daai yo, ka ni yo ka so ku tooi yoo la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: This is the message from the one who is holy and true. He has the key that belonged to David, and when he opens a door, no one can close it, and when he closes it, no one can open it.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku zaŋ amaŋ ti ba, Yawɛ ni kahigi shɛli wuhi ma ʒii puuni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But if you refuse to surrender to the army of Babylon, the Lord has shown me what will happen. This is what he has told me:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni maa zaa biɛlabiɛla; yi ku tooi kari ba naai yomyom, di yi niŋ lala mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni ti galisi nyaŋ ya.
en: The Lord your God will force those nations to leave your country little by little. You will not destroy them all at once. If you did, the wild animals would grow to be too many for you.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Ahaz was years old when he became king, and he ruled for sixteen years in Jerusalem. He didnt do what was right in the LORDs eyes, unlike his ancestor David.

dag: Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa kana ti yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a yɛtɔɣa n-viig a gbini.
en: A short time later those standing there went to Peter and said, We know you are one of them. Its clear from the way you talk.

dag: Dindali maa ka n daa po pɔri ni n ni yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni pun bo n-zali ba ka di nyɛ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa.
en: It was then that I promised to take them out of Egypt and lead them to a land I had chosen for them, a rich and fertile land, the finest land of all.

dag: Ka Aduna ti nyɔr li zaani Alikauli Adaka la gbini Yawɛ tooni pateesa la nyaaŋa jɛmbu suɣili maa puuni zaawuni hal ni asiba sahakam. Di ni ti nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Aaron will set up the gold lampstand in the holy place of the sacred tent. Then he will light the seven lamps that must be kept burning there in my presence, every night from now on. This law will never change.

dag: Bɛ daa suh o ka o ti ba kɔrinsi, ka ti ba bindir shɛli din yi zuɣusaa na pam.
en: They asked for food, and he sent them quail. He also gave them plenty of bread from heaven.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa nyɛla bɛn be o maligumaaniba kalinli ni. Samuɛl gba daa nyɛla ŋun be bɛn jɛmd o kalinli ni. Bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei bɛ suhigu.
en: Moses and Aaron were some of his priests, and Samuel was one of the men who called on his name. They prayed to the Lord , and he answered them.

dag: Di saha ka n daa zali ya zaligu yɛli, Hal Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ni yi su ŋɔ zaa yoli, lomiya kpara gari yi mabihi Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tooni chaŋ ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili.
en: Then I commanded you: Although the LORD your God has given you this land to possess, you must now cross over before the rest of your Israelite relatives as a fighting force ready for battle!.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa malila bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbila bɛn zaa daa labina maa mini bɛ maligumaanitaba ni bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: All the priests and the Levites had purified themselves and were ritually clean. The Levites killed the animals for the Passover sacrifices for all the people who had returned, for the priests, and for themselves.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o ma min o ni daa yuri nyaandol so la ʒe nimaani maa, ka o yɛl o ma, N-nyɛ a bia.
en: Jesus saw his mother and the disciple he loved standing there; so he said to his mother, He is your son.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa zaŋ Yisa n-tahi mɔɣu ni ni Sintani ti zahim o.
en: The Holy Spirit led Jesus into the desert, so that the devil could test him.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa taali, ka yɛra, Tim ti kom ka ti nyu. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Wula ka yi zaŋ ma taali? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi Yawɛ.
en: The people started complaining to Moses, Give us some water! Moses replied, Why are you complaining to me and trying to put the Lord to the test.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli Tomas, Zaŋm a nubil bɔbili n nuhi ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a nuu tim m puluɣili bɔbili ŋɔ ni, ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Then he said to Thomas, Put your finger here, and look at my hands; then reach out your hand and put it in my side. Stop your doubting, and believe.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa daŋ yiɣisi n-laɣisi tiŋ maa ni kpamba pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Early the next morning Hezekiah gathered the city leaders and went to the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka naa daa pirig o nintu shɛli zuɣu o dalinli ni daa dihi tabili, ka nyɛ o ni daa deei shɛli Haman san la ti Mɔdɛkai. Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ Haman yili maa ti Mɔdɛkai ni o su di fukumsi.
en: The king took off his ring with his seal on it and gave it to Mordecai. Esther put Mordecai in charge of Haman's property.

dag: Dama naa yɛtɔɣa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka so ku tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni.
en: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, Why are you doing this.

dag: dama daba ayopɔin dali yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli yɛli: Naawuni daa vuh o tuma zaa puuni daba ayopɔin dali.
en: For somewhere in the Scriptures this is said about the seventh day: God rested on the seventh day from all his work.

dag: Azuba ni daa ti kpi, Kalɛb daa kpuɣila Ɛfirat, ka o daa dɔɣi Hur.
en: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath. Caleb and Ephrath had a son. They named him Hur.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti suhuri piɛla, ka ti duh o ka tibig o, dama Piɛbil la amiliya lɔbu saha paaya, ka o daamiliya paɣ maa pun mali shili.
en: Let us rejoice and be happy and give God glory! Give God glory, because the wedding of the Lamb has come. And the Lambs bride has made herself ready.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm ka Ɛfurɔn ti zaŋ o tiŋgbani din daa be Makipɛla din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ti Ibrahimma m-bala. O daa zaŋ siliga mini tihi din zaa daa be tiŋgbani maa ni ti.
en: So the field of Ephron in Machpelah near Mamre—the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the fields boundaries—was officially transferred.

dag: Firawuna yi boli ya ti bɔhi ya, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tumda.
en: When Pharaoh calls you, he will ask, What work do you do.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni boli shɛb bɛn sani, bɛ yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, Masia yɛla nyɛla Naawuni yiko min o yɛm.
en: But to those who are called—both Jews and Greeks—Christ is Gods power and Gods wisdom.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum ʒiɛyimtali tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanima n-teei gili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntiŋ shɛŋa la, ka tɛhiri ni o ni di nasara ka zaŋ ba leeg o niriba.
en: After King Hezekiah had faithfully obeyed the Lord 's instructions by doing these things, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded Judah. He attacked the fortified cities and thought he would capture every one of them.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam dol o yɛligu, dilana n-nyɛ Naawuni yurilim ni niŋ dɛde so ni. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ ni ti be Naawuni ni.
en: But the love of God is truly perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know we are in him.

dag: Di saha paɣisara ni ti wari waa ni suhupiɛlli, ka nachimba mini ninkura ti mali suhupiɛlli. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ kumsi leei suhupiɛlli. N ni ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhugarigu leei suhupiɛlli.
en: Then the young women will dance and be happy, and men, young and old, will rejoice. I will comfort them and turn their mourning into joy, their sorrow into gladness.

dag: Ŋunkam wum yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ yɛligu wumla n yɛligu, ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ya zaɣisila mani; ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma zaɣisila ŋun tim ma na.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Whoever listens to you listens to me; whoever rejects you rejects me; and whoever rejects me rejects the one who sent me.

dag: ka yɛl o, M ba, pa lala; dama ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kpɛma. Zaŋm a nudirigu maa pala o zuɣu ni.
en: Joseph said to his father, You have your right hand on the wrong boy. Manasseh is the firstborn. Put your right hand on him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa deeg o mini Bashan naa Ogi bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanim ayi bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo maa tiŋgbɔna ʒini.
en: They took Sihons land to keep. They also took the land of King Og of Bashan. These two Amorite kings lived on the east side of the Jordan River.

dag: Bomiya yalim ti Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ka di ku yiɣi, dama di ni wurim; di fɔntinsi ni zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Spread salt on the ground to kill the crops. Leave its towns in ruins, with no one living there.

dag: Ɛrastus kpalim bela Kɔrinti; ka n daa chɛ Trɔfimus mi Milɛtus o ni daa ka alaafee zuɣu.
en: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus in Miletus because of his illness.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gballi ni. Ka bɛ daa kum o kuli yɛra, Mbaye, m mabia.
en: He placed the body in his own grave, and they mourned over him, Oh, my brother.

dag: Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: When it arrives, it finds the house cleaned up and decorated.

dag: Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi zaa ka o zaŋ niŋ teeku ni, ka o sapashin kpɛma zaa shim Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: He threw the chariots and army of Egypt's king into the Red Sea, and he drowned the best of the king's officers.

dag: A ni yɛn mal li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pihitanaata; ka chɛ ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka chɛ ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata.
en: This is how you should make it: four hundred fifty feet long, seventy-five feet wide, and forty-five feet high.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Asirianim sani a ni nyɛ pulaandan la zuɣu. A daa tum pagɔrisigu tuma bɛ sani, ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi li.
en: Because you were not satisfied by the others, you went running after the Assyrians. You were their prostitute, but they didn't satisfy you either.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zɔri, niŋm a ni kana ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Di saha ka salo maa dii kana ti gbaai Yisa.
en: Jesus replied, My friend, do what you came for. The men grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa dɔɣi Jarɛd maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Jareds birth, Mahalalel lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Wuntaŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka goli viɛlim be di ko, ka saŋmar so viɛlim be di ko ka chɛ saŋmar so mi viɛlim.
en: The sun has its own beauty, the moon another beauty, and the stars a different beauty; and even among stars there are different kinds of beauty.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zal o ni o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma ni daa be shɛm.
en: God made him high priest, just like Melchizedek.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu ku tɔŋ, amaa ŋunkam yihi li palɔni, ka zaɣisi li ni nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Whoever hides their sins will not be successful, but whoever confesses their sins and stops doing wrong will receive mercy.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba yi ti zaŋ bɛ nɛma bee kawana ni chi na Vuhim Dabisili dali ni bɛ ti kɔhi, ti ku da li Vuhim Dabisili dali bee dabisili kasi dali. Ti mi ku ko yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin puuni, ka ku ti sama zaa din dol ti taba.
en: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.

dag: Wuntizɔra ni mali shɛli ka di pɔra so ninvuɣ biɛri daazichi pam.
en: Better is the little that the righteous have than the overabundant wealth of the wicked.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi la, alahichi sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛba bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Tell Aaron and his sons: This is the law of the sin offering. The sin offering must be killed in the place where the burnt offering is killed before the Lord . It is most holy.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n nyari zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu mini yɛlimuɣisira? Saɣiŋgu mini damli dambu kul bela n tooni; ka zabili mini suhuyiɣisili kul yiɣisira.
en: Why do you show me injustice and look at anguish so that devastation and violence are before me? There is strife, and conflict abounds.

dag: Tiŋkpambila n-daa beni, ka di puuni niriba bi galisi. Ka na titali daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi na ti teei gili tiŋ maa, ka mɛri bindura gindi di gooni.
en: There was a little town without many people in it. A powerful king attacked it. He surrounded it and prepared to break through the walls.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yɛli Jɛrimia m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Chama. Di saha ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa zo n-kuli ti boli bia maa ma na.
en: The kings daughter said, Yes, please. So the girl went and brought the babys own mother.

dag: Ka yi ni duɣ li yaɣiri duɣ shɛl ni maa, di simdi ka yi ŋma li. Ka di yi nyɛ kurigu duɣu, di simdi ka yi nan li, ka niŋ kom suui li.
en: Any clay pot in which the meat is boiled must be broken, and if a metal pot is used, it must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa naai, o dii yiɣisimi yi; di daa nyɛla yuŋ.
en: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka di yɛli Yawɛ tɔbu tuhibu Litaafi ni, Wahɛb fɔntiŋ din be Sufa bɔbili mini vinvama ni Arinɔn Mɔɣili.
en: A song in The Book of the Lord 's Battles mentions the town of Waheb with its creeks in the territory of Suphah. It also mentions the Arnon River.

dag: Piɛguliba maa ni daa nya biliɛɣu maa, ka bɛ yɛli malaika la ni daa yɛli ba bia maa yɛla shɛm zaa.
en: When the shepherds saw him, they told them what the angel had said about the child.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kari ya bɛ jɛmbu duri ni. Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka ŋunkam ti kun ya ni tɛhi ni o tumla Naawuni yubu.
en: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun chɛri niriba taali ni di chɛ ka bɛ zɔr a.
en: But you forgive us, so that we should stand in awe of you.

dag: N ni daa be Damaskus, Naa Arɛtas ni daa zali so ka o su Damaskus fukumsi la daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zan la tiŋ maa gooni dunoya ni ni bɛ gu soli gbaai ma.
en: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani.
en: Between three and six oclock in the morning, Jesus followers were still in the boat. Jesus came to them. He was walking on the water.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yili Naawuni paɣibu yilli naai, ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu.
en: They all sang a song and then went out to the Mount of Olives.

dag: A ti o dimnim nasara; a chɛ ka o dimnim zaa suhuri paligi.
en: You made all the kings enemies happy and let his enemies win the war.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: Micah had four sons: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

dag: Ka di yi ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: The seventh day will be a holy occasion for you. You will not do any job-related work.

dag: N ni daa paai Troas ni n ti yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu, n Duuma daa mali soli ti ma.
en: I went to Troas to tell people the Good News of Christ. The Lord gave me a good opportunity there.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim Aduna bidibisi mini Lɛvi bidibisi na.
en: Next he sent for the descendants of Aaron and for the Levites.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn naa Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia daa biɛra, amaa ka nya alaafee, ka o daa sab gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: About that same time the king of Babylonia, Merodach Baladan, son of Baladan, heard that King Hezekiah had been sick, so he sent him a letter and a present.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Yaakubu, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini Bɛtɛl, ka me sara maligu bimbini zali man Naawuni ŋun daa yi a zuɣu saha shɛli a ni daa yi a biɛli Iso sani zɔri la.
en: God told Jacob, Return to Bethel, where I appeared to you when you were running from your brother Esau. Make your home there and build an altar for me.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, So n-shiri shihi ma, dama m baŋya ni yiko shɛli yi n ni.
en: But Jesus said, Someone touched me. I know that power has gone out from me.

dag: Di ŋmanila nam leebu kpa shɛli din daa yi Aduna zuɣu ni n-zo nti tɛl o teeŋa n-zo hal ti tɛl o binyɛrigu nyiŋgol la.
en: It is like expensive oil poured over the head, running down onto the beard— Aarons beard!— which extended over the collar of his robes.

dag: Ti daa chaŋmi ti ŋme Nɛgɛb din nyɛ Chɛrɛtinim tiŋ ka be Juda tiŋgban ni la, ka di bɛ nɛma. Ka ti daa lan chaŋ ti ŋme Nɛgɛb shɛli din nyɛ Kalɛb daŋ niriba tiŋ la gba ka di bɛ nɛma; ka nyo Zikilag yiya zaa buɣim.
en: We had raided the arid southern plain belonging to the Cherethites, the territory belonging to Judah, and the southern plain of Caleb. We also burned Ziklag down.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋdi ti ti chɔɣinsi ni, dama ti ʒi di ni simdi ni ti suhiri Naawuni shɛm, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-deeri suhiri Naawuni ni ŋuhibu din ka yɛtɔɣa tiri ti.
en: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yihi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda puuni sɔŋsim mini niriba ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ni bindira sɔŋsim zaa ni kom sɔŋsim zaa.
en: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *.

dag: Vinnyaɣinim ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma ni nimmoo ni nya buni din viɛla.
en: The lazy dont roast their prey, but hard workers receive precious riches.

dag: Masia zuɣu m mali suhupiɛlli chɔɣinsi ni mini ʒiɛmbu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni alaka nyabu ni ni wahala dibu puuni, dama n yi ti gbarigi, di saha ka n lan nyari yaa.
en: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛr ya shɛm ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi ti boli buɣili yuli n-jɛm li bee n-chɛ ka so wum lala yɛtɔɣa yi noya ni.
en: Listen to everything that I, the Lord , have said to you. Do not pray to other gods; do not even mention their names.

dag: Di pa shɛli a shiri paɣirila Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa di pala din ni kpaŋsi so suhu.
en: You may be thanking God in a good way, but others are not helped.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, Kpahimiya yi nuhi, duhimiya yi yɛhi yili suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: Everyone, clap your hands. Shout with joy to God!.

dag: Naawuni daa lola Ibrahimma min o yaaŋa alikaulinima. Naawuni daa bi yɛli Ibrahimma, N lo a min a yaansi alikaulinima, ka di wuhiri ni bɛ ninvuɣ bɔbili. Amaa o daa yɛl o mi, N lo a min a yaaŋa alikaulinima, ka di wuhirila ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Masia la.
en: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.

dag: Na so ŋun pahi n-nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛfaimnim ni yino ŋun kpalim ka be Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi;.
en: They also defeated King Og of Bashan, who was one of the last of the Rephaim; he ruled at Ashtaroth and Edrei.

dag: Bɛ ni ti leeni taŋkpaɣu kaman wahu la bee kaman tiŋgban ni biŋgbamda la. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa na ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ni dabiɛm pam. Bɛ ni ti zɔr a dabiɛm.
en: They will crawl in the dust like snakes; they will come from their fortresses, trembling and afraid. They will turn in fear to the Lord our God.

dag: ka di nyɛla ŋun Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli din so n-ti ti la zuɣu. Di daliri nyɛla, bɛ ku tooi mali be dɛde, ka pa ni Naawuni zaŋ ti mi pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: because God had decided on an even better plan for us. His purpose was that only in company with us would they be made perfect.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka yi tinzun tinsi balibu kam ni na la daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: There were pious Jews from every nation under heaven living in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani fabindi ka mali suhugarigu. Ka Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ tihi suui; ka Sharɔn vinvamli niŋ kaman tiŋgban nɛl la; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu tihi suura.
en: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.

dag: Fɔnisia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Speen ŋarima din be teeku ni, kummiya ni suhugarigu! Dama Taai luya ka lan ka yili bee kulinoli. Niriba daa yila Saipurus na nti wum di yɛla.
en: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli, M ba zaŋ muɣisigu zali tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima, nyamiya n ni di shiri biɛla ŋɔ ka nya yaa shɛm.
en: Jonathan answered, What a terrible thing my father has done to our people! See how much better I feel because I ate some honey!.

dag: Doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya so shɛŋa la zaa din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣila tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ti yɛn su maa ni.
en: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Ka o daa tim nachimbi pola pia ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Kamɛl nti chaŋ Nabal sani ti zaŋ n yuli puh o.
en: So he sent ten men to Carmel with this message for Nabal: I hope that you and your family are healthy and that all is going well for you.

dag: Amaa dabili maa yi zani yim yɛli, N yuri n dana maa mini m paɣa ni m bihi, dinzuɣu n ku chaŋ.
en: But suppose the slave loves his wife and children and his owner so much that he won't leave them.

dag: ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri duri din palipali la kpalim zaɣ kuma, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili din galisi zuɣu.
en: Those peaceful pastures will be ruined because of the Lord s anger.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa tahibu mini tiŋgbani dambu ni pɔhim biɛɣu ni buɣim biɛɣu kana nti fa a bahi.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.

dag: Ti ni daa zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihi tin ya la zuɣu ka Naawuni boli ya ni yi mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima.
en: God chose you to have that salvation. He chose you by using the Good News that we told you. You were chosen so that you can share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Kalimiya Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn be Lɛvinim puuni bɛ ko kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Find out how many men between the ages of and are in the four Levite clans of Kohath. Count only those who are able to work at the sacred tent.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla talahi ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim maa mali tarili, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛl zuliya daŋ yini niriba ku kpihim.
en: There must be a surviving line for those who remain from Benjamin, they continued, so that a tribe wont be erased from Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni dɔɣ ma dahin shɛli zaŋ na hal ni pɔŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ mmaŋ dalim, ka m ma ni dɔɣ ma hal ni zuŋɔ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: I have relied on you since the day I was born, and you have always been my God.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛdomnim daa yɛl o, Yi ku kpe ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gari, yi yi niŋ lala, ti ni ŋmɛn ya tɔbu.
en: But the king of Edom answered, No, I won't let you go through our country! And if you try, we will attack you.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋme n-wurim bɛ ni daa me binwɔɣila shɛŋa zal la, ka chɛ n-kabi buɣili Ashɛrim binnani luhi; ka zaŋ ninsalinim kɔba niŋ di zaashɛhi maa bɔɣa ni.
en: He smashed the sacred pillars and cut down the sacred poles, filling the places where they had been with human bones.

dag: Rama tiŋ puuni ka bɛ wum vuri din nyɛ fabila mini kumsi ni nandahima yɛla pam. Reechɛl kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka bɛ balim o je, dama bɛ zaa lan kani.
en: A sound was heard in Ramah— bitter crying and great sadness. Rachel cries for her children, and she cannot be comforted, because her children are gone. Jeremiah :.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa ka su li n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Naaran din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Gɛza din daa be wulinluhili polo la mini di tiŋkpansi ni Aya mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: These are the cities and lands where Ephraims descendants lived: Bethel and the villages near it, Naaran to the east, Gezer and the villages near it on the west, and Shechem and the villages near it all the way to Ayyah and the villages near it.

dag: Dama ti wumya ni ninvuɣ shɛb be yi ni n-nyɛ ʒinahigunima ka je ni bɛ tum shɛli, ka bɛ tuma naɣ kul nyɛla dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni kɔŋko.
en: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣ o, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o. Molimiy o daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: Sing to God, sing praises to him; dwell on all his wondrous works!.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili liri Alikauli Adaka maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: He brought the chest into the dwelling. He set up the veil as a screen to hide from view the chest containing the covenant, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Anabinim bɛn be di puuni naala noli n-lo nia biɛri. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣima n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa ka ŋumda. Bɛ di ninsalinim nyɛviya, ka fa azichi mini binviɛla, ka chɛ ka pakoya galisi.
en: The leaders are like lions roaring over the animals they have killed. They kill the people, take all the money and property they can get, and by their murders leave many widows.

dag: Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Kul yim chaŋ, dama n yɛn tim a la katiŋ ha bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani. .
en: Go, the Lord said to me, for I will send you far away to the Gentiles.

dag: ka bo zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram yini n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla.
en: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.

dag: ka tin yin nim ni ti yɛli tin shɛlinima, Ti chanimi ni ti ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. Kamiyana ka ti mini ya chaŋ.
en: Those from one city will say to those from another, We are going to worship the Lord Almighty and pray for his blessing. Come with us.

dag: ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka Yɛhudianim maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa yɛli ma o yɛla, ka yɛli ni n karim o saria n-luh o ti ba.
en: and when I went to Jerusalem, the Jewish chief priests and elders brought charges against him and asked me to condemn him.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab yɛli so yɛla ni Naawuni yɛliya, N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: He is the one of whom its written: Look, Im sending my messenger before you, who will prepare your way before you .

dag: Doli dimbɔŋɔnima, ka zaŋ amaŋ ti li, ka di chɛ ka sokam nya a tooni chandi a tuma puuni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Practice these things and devote yourself to them, in order that your progress may be seen by all.

dag: dama n suhu kul yɛmi ni n nyan ya n-zaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli kpaŋsi ya.
en: I really want to see you to pass along some spiritual gift to you so that you can be strengthened.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira balibu kam, ka dabiɛm daa kpe sokam.
en: A sense of awe came over everyone. God performed many wonders and signs through the apostles.

dag: dama yi zaa ni tooi tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka ti taba, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi bɔhim shɛli, ka lan nya kpaŋsibu.
en: You can all prophesy one after the other. This way everyone can be taught and encouraged.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔŋ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni kpɛbu sagbani maa ni daa sirigina ti pil li maa mini Yawɛ jilima ni daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣu.
en: And so, Moses could not enter the tent.

dag: Di simdi ka dari maa ti kpalim be adaka maa bansi maa ni, di ti yihiya li.
en: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa tim dunia ni n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala n-zaŋ li bahi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka titali ni.
en: So the angel swung his sickle into the earth, and cut the vineyard of the earth, and he put what he reaped into the great winepress of Gods passionate anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: So today you must remember and accept that the Lord is God. He is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other god!.

dag: Ka yi ni daa be Kadɛshibarinia, ka Yawɛ tim ya ka yɛli ya, Chamiya ti deei n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa, ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu maa, ka bi niŋ o yɛda bee n-deeg o yɛligu.
en: And then, when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, telling you: Go up and take possession of the land that Im giving you, you disobeyed the LORD your Gods command. You didnt trust him. You didnt obey Gods voice.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: When Jesus and his disciples came near Jerusalem, he went to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives and sent two of them on ahead.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya ka sapashinnim ʒiya tɔri jina, ka o yɛli, Sapashini, m malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Ti ni ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa? Ka o yɛli Jɛhu, N dana, nyini ka n yɛri maa.
en: where he found the army officers in a conference. He said, Sir, I have a message for you. Jehu asked, Which one of us are you speaking to? To you, sir, he replied.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Yawɛ di ma shɛhira, ka o ni pii na so ŋɔ gba di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi bi nya galimi shɛli m biɛhigu ni. Ka bɛ daa saɣi, Iin, o di shɛhira.
en: Samuel replied, The LORD and his anointed one are witnesses against you today that you havent found anything in my possession. Agreed, they said.

dag: Ka Amazia nam yiko ni daa ti ba jila zaa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku o kpambal shɛb bɛn daa ku o ba la.
en: As soon as Amaziah was firmly in power, he executed the officials who had killed his father, the king.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a fɔh a nuu ka chɛ ti, hal ka di nyɛla a nudirigu gba? Yihim a nuhi a jɔɣu ni na m-bahi ba yoli.
en: Why do you pull your hand back? Why do you hold your strong hand close to your chest?.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bee Farisiinim ni so niŋ o yɛda?.
en: Have you ever known one of the authorities or one Pharisee to believe in him?.

dag: dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi ni nabipuɣinsi ni Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaa be Ahikam bia Shafan san la chaŋ. Bɛ daa zaŋ anabi Jɛrimia mini Nɛria bia Baruk gba chaŋ.
en: men, women, children, the kings daughters, everyone Nebuzaradan the captain of the special guard had left with Gedaliah, Ahikams son and Shaphans grandson, including Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch, Neriahs son.

dag: M mabihi, yi ni so yi ti birigi ka chɛ yɛlimaŋli la, ka so ŋmalig o labisi di ni.
en: My brothers and sisters, if any of you wander from the truth and someone turns back the wanderer.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI poya o kasitali puuni yɛli, Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-vo n-chaŋ. Hal ziŋgɔhi ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ vo yi ni shɛb bɛn kpalim chaŋ.
en: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:.

dag: Ka di ni daa ti miig o pam saha shɛli ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, bidibiga n-lan bala.
en: When her labor pains were at their worst, the midwife said to her, Don't be afraid, Rachel; it's another boy.

dag: Naawuni ka n niŋ naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn tiri yimaŋ yɛlimaŋli niriba san la, amaa Naawuni mi din be yi suhuri ni. Ninsalinim ni tibigiri binshɛli pam nyɛla Naawuni ni chihiri shɛli.
en: Jesus said to them, You make yourselves look good in front of people. But God knows what is really in your hearts. What people think is important is worth nothing to God.

dag: Dama di ku lan yuui, ka n ni yɛn darigi yi tibili zali shɛm tariga paai, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu m-bahi ba yoli.
en: In a very short time my fury will end, and my anger at the world will be finished.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka ti daa mali shili n-yiɣisi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After this, we got ready and made our way up to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yiko niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ kana ti tum tuma maa zaa na.
en: Then Moses called Bezalel, Oholiab, and all the other skilled men who the Lord had given special skills to. And they came because they wanted to help with the work.

dag: Dinzuɣu o tumtumdiba yi lɛbigi bɛmaŋa m-be kaman wuntizɔriba n-nyɛ ba la, di bi simdi ni di gari ti. Bɛ bahigu ni ti bemi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So it does not surprise us if Satans servants make themselves look like servants who work for what is right. But in the end those people will get the punishment they deserve.

dag: m-pahi daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni daa yɔr o farigu shɛli zuɣu. Ka Areebia nanim zaa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gomnanim zaa daa ʒiri salima mini anzinfa na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: not including income from the traders and merchants. All the Arabian kings and the governors of the land also brought Solomon gold and silver.

dag: Nini ku tooi yɛli nuu, A ka ma buchi; ka zuɣu mi ku tooi yɛli napɔŋ, A ka ma buchi.
en: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu Jɛrusalɛm n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu biŋkɔbiri gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: King Josiah celebrated the Passover at Jerusalem in honor of the Lord ; on the fourteenth day of the first month they killed the animals for the festival.

dag: N daa lan bo tiŋguliba tin ya ka yɛli, Wummiya kikaa kumsi. Amaa ka yi yɛli, Ti ku wum.
en: Still, I have appointed watchmen to warn you. But you said, We wont listen.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu pam, amaa ka o bi garig o.
en: So Herod asked Jesus many questions, but Jesus made no answer.

dag: n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N Duuma Yawɛ, di ku a niriba bɛn nyɛ a dahalali ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa fa m-bahi a yiko ni, ka zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ yihi ba Ijipti maa na.
en: And I prayed, Sovereign Lord , don't destroy your own people, the people you rescued and brought out of Egypt by your great strength and power.

dag: Di nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana, ka bɔ ka a lee ni tooi niŋ? Di nyɛla din zilim gari kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka bɔ ka yɛn tooi baŋ?.
en: They are higher than the heavens—what can you do? Deeper than the underworld—what can you know?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Ayuba n-nyuri ansarisi malibo kaman kom la?.
en: Who is a man like Job? He drinks mockery like water.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o niriba maa, Sokam nyaɣim o takɔbi! Ka Dauda gba daa nyaɣ o takɔbi; ka niriba kɔbisinahi daa pah o zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka chɛ niriba kɔbisiyi ka bɛ mi kpalim guli bɛ nɛma.
en: Buckle on your swords! he ordered, and they all did. David also buckled on his sword and left with about four hundred of his men, leaving two hundred behind with the supplies.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn luri Yawɛ sizuura daa tɔɣisiri tab yɛtɔɣa, ka Yawɛ gbilisi tibili wum li, ka sabi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri ŋun Yawɛ, ka tir o yuli jilima maa yɛla niŋ yɛla teebu litaafi ni o sani.
en: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.

dag: Ka kuhigu pam ni ti be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ yaha.
en: The crying in Egypt will be worse than at any time in the past or any time in the future.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋgbuna zaa kul biɛrimi, ka n daalahichi mi zuɣu chɛ ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: Theres nothing in my body that isnt broken because of your rage; theres no health in my bones because of my sin.

dag: yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: He said, I will surely bless you. I will give you many descendants.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So these eleven men went to Gilead. They went to talk to the people of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh. The eleven men said to them.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka zama maa zaa daa paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Yawɛ maa, ka silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni, ka lu naa sizuura.
en: David then said to the people, Now it's your turn to praise the Lord , the God your ancestors worshiped! So everyone praised the Lord , and they bowed down to honor him and David their king.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma, ka zoya na kani, ka daboya gba na kani.
en: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.

dag: Dama saa ŋmaaya, ka kikaa gba gari.
en: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, palim a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kul ku kɔŋ a zuliya ni, a bihi yi ni lihi bɛ soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka doli ma kaman a ni daa doli ma shɛm la.
en: Now, Lord , God of Israel, keep the other promises you made to your servant David, my father. You said, David, if your sons carefully obey me as you did, you will always have someone from your family ruling the people of Israel.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli noli ti tikpiralana bee n-zaŋ kuɣili sɔŋ zom tooni ni o tuui li, amaa zom a Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa dii darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, O mɔri Naawuni! Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm.
en: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, Hes insulting God! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, youve heard his insult against God.

dag: Bɛ kul tumdila vi tuma, ka di kuri ma suli. Bɛ maanila maligu buɣa ni, ka tuɣindi tulaale buɣa maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: They shamelessly keep on making me angry. They offer pagan sacrifices at sacred gardens and burn incense on pagan altars.

dag: bɛ kpiŋkpama maa daa shihirila taba. Bɛ daa yi ti chana, bɛ zaɣ yino kam kul tuhimi chani tooni ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: The wings touched each other. The living beings did not turn when they moved. They went in the direction they were looking.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hanania, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kabigila dapua, amaa m bo kurigu dapua n-zali di zaani.
en: Go, say to Hananiah, The LORD proclaims: You have broken a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with an iron one.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha n-niŋ yomyom chaŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa gbini.
en: At dawn, at the first sign of light, the king rose and rushed to the lions pit.

dag: Bipolitali ni daa kul pali bɛ niŋgbuŋ shɛŋa ni maa; bɛ mini li ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: Their bodies used to be young and vigorous, but soon they will turn to dust.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa yɛliya ni doo yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.

dag: Maika bia Matania daa nyɛla Zabidi ŋun daa yi Asaf daŋ ni na la yaaŋa. Ŋuna n-daa gari ti tooni m-piligiri wumpaɣibo wunsuhigu. Bakibukia n-daa nyɛ o tab ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa o zuɣu. Shammua bia Abida daa nyɛla Galal yaaŋa ka nyɛ Jɛdutun yaantibichee.
en: Mattaniah , the director who led the people in singing songs of praise and prayer, Bakbukiah , and Abda son of Shammua .

dag: Ka Matitia mini Ɛlifɛlɛhu ni Mikinɛya ni Obɛdɛdom ni Jɛiɛl ni Azazia mi daa nyɛ bɛn be tooni ŋmɛri goonjɛnim kaman Shɛminit ŋmɛbu la.
en: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres tuned to the Sheminith.

dag: N ŋmanila sana dunia ŋɔ ni; di zaŋ a zaligunim sɔɣi ma.
en: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.

dag: N daa lo mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni n ni yɛn kana ti kaai ya kaari shɛl la ku nyɛla din ni tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: So I decided that my next visit to you would not be another visit to make you sad.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a ni so a taba? Bɔ ka a lee mali ka di pala pini ka Naawuni zaŋ li ti a? Ka a yi daa dee li mi o sani, di chaŋ wula ka a nyuri bara kaman pa pini ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li ti a la?.
en: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be nimaani maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di saha maa, ka puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi chuɣu daba ayopɔin.
en: The Israelites who were present celebrated the Passover at that time, and observed the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: They were very afraid and asked each other, What kind of man is this? Even the wind and the water obey him.

dag: Binshɛli ti ku pooi yi ni so, dama Yawɛ shiri niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini maa ni.
en: Of course there wont be any poor persons among you because the LORD will bless you in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess as an inheritance.

dag: Di saha ka n daa neei gom ni n-lihi ka n gom maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.

dag: Taɣimiya Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ yuli m bol o, Vuyɔra ŋun zaŋ o daalɔbo bahi.
en: Give the king of Egypt a new name— Noisy Braggart Who Missed His Chance.

dag: ka bɛn mi nuu be dunia ŋɔ dibu yɛla ni be kaman bɛn nuu ka di ni. Dama dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu garitimi maa.
en: Those who use the world should be like people who arent preoccupied with it, because this world in its present form is passing away.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa lan yi Libina n-gari chaŋ Lakishi ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: After this, Joshua and his army went on from Libnah to Lachish, surrounded it and attacked it.

dag: A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni. A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a yɛm. N daa daag a luhi tiŋa, n daa yih a palɔni nanim tooni ni bɛ lih a viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: It was your good looks that made you arrogant, and you were so famous that you started acting like a fool. That's why I threw you to the ground and let other kings sneer at you.

dag: O daa diya ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ata. O ma daa nyɛla Absalom bia, ka o yuli booni Maaka.
en: and he ruled from Jerusalem for three years. His mother was Maacah the daughter of Abishalom.

dag: Ka n daa niŋ kaman o ni daa zali ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa. N daa kahi n nɛma yina kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la. N daa zaŋ n nuhi chibi gooni voli n-zaŋ n nɛma yina liɣa nti zaŋ li buɣi m bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu bɛ ninni.
en: I did what the Lord told me to do. That day I packed a bundle as a refugee would, and that evening as it was getting dark I dug a hole in the wall with my hands and went out. While everyone watched, I put the pack on my shoulder and left.

dag: ni Magidiɛl ni Iram. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Ɛdom nanima.
en: Magdiel, and Iram. This is a list of the leaders of Edom.

dag: Mani n-nam neesim mini zibisim, mani n-tahiri alibarika na, ka lan tahiri tɔbu na. Man Yawɛ n-niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: I form light and create darkness, make prosperity and create doom; I am the LORD, who does all these things.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu ka niŋ ba nirilim; ka sɔŋ ba; o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la zuɣu ka o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpi. O mi daa bi zaɣisi ba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.

dag: ka yɛli Dauda, A nyɛla wuntizɔra pam gari ma, dama a tum ma din viɛla, ka man zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo a samli.
en: and said: David, you're a better person than I am. You treated me with kindness, even though I've been cruel to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛda niŋbu yirila bɛ ni wum shɛl ni na, ka bɛ ni wum shɛli maa mi yirila Masia yɛla waazu yihibu ni na.
en: So faith comes from hearing the Good News. And people hear the Good News when someone tells them about Christ.

dag: Amaa do so ŋun gbib omaŋa ka di bi muɣis o ni o lo amiliya, ka o lo omaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni o ku lo bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti o amiliya, o niŋ din viɛla.
en: But if a man, without being forced to do so, has firmly made up his mind not to marry, and if he has his will under complete control and has already decided in his own mind what to do—then he does well not to marry the young woman.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The message about the Lord spread all over this region.

dag: O zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔna ti o niriba n-wuhi ba o yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God proclaimed his powerful deeds to his people and gave them what had belonged to other nations.

dag: Nyama, niriba maa yiɣisirimi kaman gbuɣin nyaŋ la, ka bɛ ni nyamdi kaman gbuɣindaa la. O bi doona ka pa ni o ŋubila o ni gbaai binshɛɣu, ka nyu o ni ku binshɛɣu maa ʒim.
en: They are like angry lions ready to attack; and they won't rest until their victim is gobbled up.

dag: Ti jɛmbu duu maa ŋmanila nam ʒiishee din mali jilima, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa pun duhi shɛli piligu ni ha.
en: Splendid and exalted throne, the place of our sanctuary from the beginning!.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa du zuɣusaa ha la gbinni lee nyɛ wula? Di gbinni nyɛla ni o daa tuui siɣimi na hal n-gari siɣi tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: When it says, he went up, it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.

dag: Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, ti zaa ni laɣim mal liɣiri kolibil yini.
en: Come and join us, and we'll all share what we steal.

dag: Bɛ maanila nazuɣuri ansarisi, ka mali nanim diɛmda. Bɛ larila bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛŋa, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu duhiri ni bɛ dee li.
en: They treat kings with contempt and laugh at high officials. No fortress can stop them—they pile up earth against it and capture it.

dag: Fɔŋ kara anahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba. Dina n-nyɛ: Shɛkɛm din nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tin shɛli tiligiri la mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la ni Gɛza.
en: They were given four cities: Shechem and its pasture lands in the hill country of Ephraim , Gezer.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a sɔɣi ka zilinli fiɛbiga ku paag a, ka saɣiŋgu yi ti paag a, a ku zɔri li.
en: People might say bad things about you with their sharp tongues. But God will protect you. You will not be afraid when bad things happen!.

dag: N dana, a daa bɔhila tinim a daba ŋɔ, Yi mali ba bee tizo.
en: Sir, you asked us, Do you have a father or another brother.

dag: O zaŋla o nuzaa gbaai n zuɣu mali, ka zaŋ o nudirigu bɔbindi ma.
en: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand caresses me.

dag: Bɛ yi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka lo ni bɛ yi a nyaaŋa n-niŋ a shɛli, bɛ ku di nasara.
en: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra:.
en: Agrippa told Paul, You may now speak for yourself. Paul stretched out his hand and said:.

dag: Ka n-daa bɔhi ba, Pa tinzun paɣiba n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana tum alahichi? Zuliya pam nanim ni so daa bi ŋman o, ka o Naawuni daa yur o ka zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, amaa tinzun paɣiba n-daa ti chɛ ka o tum alahichi.
en: I told them, It was foreign women that made King Solomon sin. Here was a man who was greater than any of the kings of other nations. God loved him and made him king over all of Israel, and yet he fell into this sin.

dag: Yawɛ n-zali ni ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka ti yo yi daalahichi samli.
en: What was done today was commanded by the LORD, to make reconciliation for you.

dag: Di yɛliya di yɛla Gaat fɔŋ ni, di kul chɛliya ka nintam yi yi nina ni na. Bilimmiya taŋkpaɣu ni Bɛtiliafra tiŋ puuni.
en: In Gath tell it not; no need to weep there! In Beth-le-aphrah, roll yourself in the dust!.

dag: amaa n zɔrila bɛ dimnim ni yɛn kuri ma sul shɛli, dama bɛ dimnim maa ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ka ni yɛli, Ti nuhi n-ti ti nasara, pa Yawɛ n-daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord . .

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kpɛhi duu, ka guhiri ni Yawɛ ti yɛli ba o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The people held him as a prisoner and waited for the Lord s command to be made clear to them.

dag: Amaa Naawuni tiligim ma ka n nyu bara shɛli zuɣu ka pa ni ti Duuma Yisa Masia dapulli la kɔŋko zuɣu. Masia dapulli maa zuɣu dunia nyɛla binkpiŋ n sani, ka n gba nyɛ binkpiŋ dunia ŋɔ sani.
en: But as for me, God forbid that I should boast about anything except for the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. The world has been crucified to me through him, and I have been crucified to the world.

dag: Ka bɛ daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the people began to beg Jesus to leave their area.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmɛla binnɛma maa mini abie tihi pa sunsuuni duu maa dunoya zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa ŋme li pa dukpina maa zuɣu shɛm la. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ dari mali varanda zɔntua maa tooni sambani polo.
en: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.

dag: A nyɛla a ma ŋun daa zaɣis o yidana min o bihi la bipuɣiŋga. A nyɛla a biɛyanim bɛn daa zaɣisi bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi la tizo. A ma daa nyɛla Hiti paɣa, ka a ba mi nyɛ Amɔri doo.
en: You are your mothers daughter. You dont care about your husband or your children. You are like your sister. Both of you hated your husband and your children. You are like your parents. Your mother was a Hittite and your father was an Amorite.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Ibram sanna ti yɛl o, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Di saha ka Ibram daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani zali Yawɛ ŋun daa ka o sani maa na.
en: but the Lord appeared to Abram and promised, I will give this land to your family forever. Abram then built an altar there for the Lord .

dag: O ni daa kum o yidan kuli maa naai, ka Dauda daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o kul o yiŋ na ka o ti zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa ka Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: After the time of mourning was over, David sent for her and brought her back to his house. She became his wife and bore him a son. But what David had done was evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Ka Sintani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ zahinda la daa chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣa ŋɔ leei bindirigu ka a di.
en: The devil came to tempt him and said, If you are the Son of God, tell these rocks to become bread.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Gaad zuliya ni su tiŋgbani yini.
en: Along the boundary of Zebulun from the eastern border to the western border: Gad, one portion.

dag: ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi bi zaŋ yimaŋ zali bia zaani yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: Then he said: I promise you this. If you don't change and become like a child, you will never get into the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Hal saŋkpaliŋ zomi ka chɛ o biliɛɣu mɔɣu ni, dama mɔri lan kani.
en: Even the doe in the field abandons her newborn, for theres no grass.

dag: M mabiyurisi, di chɛliya ka binshɛli yɔhim ya.
en: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.

dag: Chɛ ka buɣim salinɛma lu bɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi bɔɣ zilima ni, ka bɛ ku lan tooi yi di ni na.
en: Pour burning coals on their heads. Throw them into the fire. Throw them into pits they can never escape.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Lala tuhiya! Hal alizin biɛri gba niŋdi yɛda lala, ka zɔri dabiɛm.
en: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.

dag: Bɛ saɣim ti wain tihi, ka ŋub ti fiig tihi. Bɛ ŋub puɣisi di tipaɣiri hal ka di wula zaa ti leela zaɣ piɛla.
en: It has destroyed my vines, splintered my fig trees, stripped off their bark and thrown it down; their branches have turned white.

dag: Di saha ka o daa wuhi ma Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulan la ka o ʒe Yawɛ malaika tooni, ka Sintani ʒe o nudirigu polo ni o fiɣis o.
en: In another vision the Lord showed me the High Priest Joshua standing before the angel of the Lord . And there beside Joshua stood Satan, ready to bring an accusation against him.

dag: Cham Rɛkabinim sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na nti zaŋ ba kpɛhi dubihi la yini puuni, ka niŋ wain ti ba ka bɛ nyu.
en: Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa duu maa ni, ka kpe naa dundɔŋ ni nti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa zaa yɛli naa.
en: After leaving the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe, they went to the kings court and told him everything.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? Ka Naa Sool garigi yɛl o, A ni daa zali dabisi shɛli maa ni paai ka n nya ka a bi kanna, ka Filistianim mi lo tɔbu n-do Mikimash ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani maa wurindi ka chɛri ma.
en: but Samuel said, What have you done? Saul answered, The people were deserting me, and you had not come when you said you would; besides that, the Philistines are gathering at Michmash.

dag: ni piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: ram skins dyed red, and fine leather; acacia wood;.

dag: Ninsalinim yi yɛn po pɔri, bɛ pɔrila ŋun gari ba; ka naŋgbankpeeni kam puuni, pɔri n-nyɛ din ŋmaari li.
en: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa tim ti boli Ɛliab bihi, Datan mini Abiram. Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ku kana.
en: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: We won't come!.

dag: Ka shihir karili daa puhi zani alizanda ni. Paɣ so n-daa ye wuntaŋa kaman chinchini la, ka goli be o naba tiŋli, ka nam zuɣupiligu din mali saŋmarisi pinaayi pil o zuɣu.
en: Then a great and mysterious sight appeared in the sky. There was a woman, whose dress was the sun and who had the moon under her feet and a crown of twelve stars on her head.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, Yɛlimaŋli, a Naawuni maa shiri nyɛla ŋun gari wuna zaa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa Duuma ni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka a tooi kahig ashili ŋɔ gbinni wuhi ma maa.
en: The king declared to Daniel, No doubt about it: your God is God of gods, Lord of kings, and a revealer of mysteries because you were able to reveal this mystery.

dag: Puhimiya tab yurilim puhigu! Naawuni tim yinim bɛn nyɛ Masia ni su shɛb la zaa suhudoo!.
en: Give each other a special greeting of love when you meet. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli.
en: They crossed the lake and came to land at Gennesaret.

dag: Yi yaannim ʒiɛman ni ka yi daa birigi ka chɛ n zaligunima, ka bi lan dol li. Labimiya n sanna ka n gba labi yi sanna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ labina.
en: But you never obeyed my laws. Even your ancestors stopped following me. Come back to me, and I will come back to you. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said. You say, How can we come back.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zali saha shɛli yi ti paai, n ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli kari saria.
en: God says, When I decide the time is right, I will establish justice just so.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti maa hal ka o mini ti yaannim maa zaa daa ti kpi nimaani.
en: So Jacob went down to Egypt. He and our other ancestors lived there until they died.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim maa, Di luhiya ni nir chɛ ka bara kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali bee di bi luhi.
en: Jesus asked the lawyers and Pharisees, Does the Law allow healing on the Sabbath or not.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun be di ni nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi; o bi tumdi din bie. O kariti saria asiba kam, ka ʒi n-naɣi li nolɔɣu kukoli kam. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi zɔri vi.
en: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.

dag: Di simdi ni yi mini yi yinsinim ti zaŋdi ba chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa nti kɔriti ba ŋubiri Yawɛ tooni yuuni kam.
en: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the Lord 's presence at the one place of worship.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum Gaad yɛligu maa ka chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: David obeyed the Lord 's command and went as Gad had told him to.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o zaŋ nɛma maa leeg o dini, di yi pa lala, niriba ni la ti; nyama, n-chɛ ka a zaŋ bubil polli maa ni a ti ti o, ka a bi tooi bo n-nya o.
en: If you couldn't find her, we'll just let her keep the things I gave her, Judah answered. And we'd better forget about the goat, or else we'll look like fools.

dag: tɔbu ni lu yi zuɣu, ka yi birininim la zaa ti wurim. Di ni ti bemi kaman Naa Shaliman ni daa ŋme Bɛtaribɛlnim tɔbu, ka wurim li, ka zaŋ bihi mini bɛ manim tɔri taba n-kuri ba shɛm la.
en: war will come to your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed. It will be like the day when King Shalman destroyed the city of Betharbel in battle, and mothers and their children were crushed to death.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim sani mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli malaika so ŋun daa be bɛ san la ni daa tɔɣis o mini ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli gbin la. Nimaani ka ŋun Anabi Musa daa deei Naawuni yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ nyɛvili yɛtɔɣa la ti ti.
en: This same Moses was with the gathering of Gods people in the desert. He was with the angel who spoke to him at Mount Sinai, and he was with our ancestors. He received life-giving words from God to give to us.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa wum lala maa ka o zo n-chaŋ Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Nimaani ka o daa be hal nti dɔɣi bidibis ayi.
en: When Moses heard this, he fled from Egypt and went to live in the land of Midian. There he had two sons.

dag: yɛlimaŋli, yi ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ninvuɣ so n-leei yi naa ka o sun ya. Yi ni tooi zaŋ yi zuliya ni nira n-leei yi naa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ tinzun nira ŋun pa yi mabia n-leei yi naa.
en: When that happens, you must be sure to choose the king that the Lord your God chooses. The king over you must be one of your own people. You must not make a foreigner your king.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti bi zan tuh o, hal di yi nyɛ Naawuni daadiini zuɣulana gba, o ni chɛ ka bɛ ku o.
en: Forces will be completely swept away and broken before him. The same is true for the leader of the covenant.

dag: Ka yɛla maa daa muɣisi man Daniɛl pam, ka dɔro gbaai ma ka n dɔni paai dabisa shɛm. Ka n daa ti yiɣisi n lan labi nti tumdi tuun shɛŋa naa ni daa zali ma ni n tumdi la, amaa ka ʒii maa yɛla daa gari ma ka m bi tooi baŋ li.
en: I was depressed and ill for several days. Then I got up and went back to the work that the king had assigned to me, but I was puzzled by the vision and could not understand it.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ puuni n-lir a min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa. A yiŋ mini Ijipti yili kam ni ti palila zɔhi; ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa gba ni ti palila zɔhi.
en: I warn you that if you refuse, I will punish you by sending flies on you, your officials, and your people. The houses of the Egyptians will be full of flies, and the ground will be covered with them.

dag: Malimiya shili kaman yi daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni daa piripiri ya kaman Izraɛl Naa Dauda ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la ni kaman o bia Sulemaana ni daa sabi wuhi shɛm la.
en: Get ready to do the work that David and Solomon assigned to you, according to your clans.

dag: amaa bɛ ni ti yɛrimi, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim o ni daa kari ba tahi nuzaa polo tin shɛŋa zaa ni la zuɣu. Di saha bɛ ni ti be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ fabila mini n suhigu ŋɔ. Gbilisim tibili wum a dabili fabila ni o suhigu shɛli o ni suhir a ŋɔ.
en: LORD, my God, listen to your servants prayer and request, and hear the cry and prayer that I your servant pray to you.

dag: Yisa daa ti lihi nya bundaannim ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu;.
en: Looking up, Jesus saw rich people throwing their gifts into the collection box for the temple treasury.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa piligi niriba maa kalibu, amaa o daa bi kali ba naai, ka alɔbo daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu niriba kalibu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa bi sabi bɛ kalinli maa niŋ Naa Dauda yɛla teebu litaafi ni.
en: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records.

dag: Ka pako so daa be tiŋ maa ni n-kul ʒe n-kan o sanna waawaayili nti yɛr o, Karimi ti saria ŋɔ ti ma nasara, ka chɛ n dim ŋɔ.
en: And there was a widow in that same town who kept coming to him and pleading for her rights, saying, Help me against my opponent.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N di pun bi yɛl a ni a yi niŋ yɛda a ni nya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus replied, Didn't I tell you that if you had faith, you would see the glory of God.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa mini Nɛbushaziban ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpem la ni Nɛrigalisharɛza ni Babilɔn naa sapashin kpamba zaa.
en: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the special guard, Nebushazban the chief officer, Nergal-sharezer the field commander, and all the commanders of the king of Babylon.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ yi mini yi ni pii yi na so ka o sun ya maa n-tahi yi mini yi yaannim ni daa bi mi zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa.
en: The Lord will take you and your king away to a foreign land, where neither you nor your ancestors ever lived before; there you will serve gods made of wood and stone.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ka biŋkɔb so ti tɔhi zanina. O daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, amaa ka kpiŋkpama anahi din ŋmani nooŋa kpiŋkpama lee sa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka o mali zuɣur anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yiko ti o.
en: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.

dag: A daa labisi ti taŋkpaɣu ni; ka yɛli, Yinim daadamnima, labimiya taŋkpaɣu ni yaha.
en: At your command we die and turn back to dust.

dag: Di simdi ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛlaa maa zuɣu nyɛla lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛbihi la zuɣu dina, o kul bom o ni bɔri ni o ti shɛm tariga, ka bo kpam lita ata tahili kam zuɣu.
en: He must give an ephah of grain offering with the ram. As for the grain offering with the lambs, the ruler can give as much as he wants. But he must give hin of olive oil for each ephah of grain.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ olivi tih ayi mini firilatamdis ayi din ʒe dunia tiŋgbani Duuma tooni la.
en: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Gibia ka anab bɔbili shiri tuh o soli ka Naawuni shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na pam, ka o pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Saul arrived at Gibeah, a group of prophets met him. The Spirit of God suddenly took control of him, and right there in the middle of the group he began prophesying.

dag: Inhii, n suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga bela Asirianim nuu ni.
en: Doom to Assyria, rod of my anger, in whose hand is the staff of my fury!.

dag: Firilatamdigu maa daa malila jaba ayɔbu: jaba ata daa bela yaɣ yini polo, ka jaba ata be yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: with three branches on each of its two sides.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the harvest with me, you scatter it.

dag: A zaŋ tuuta sa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura ka bɛ yi nya tuuta maa, di ni chɛ ka piɛma ku nyɔɣi ba.
en: You have warned those who have reverence for you, so that they might escape destruction.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa ni ti nyɛla Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu zuliya biriginsim maa lee nyɛ dini? Pa Samaria? Ka Judanim buɣijɛmbo shee lee nyɛ dini? Pa Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: All this will happen because the people of Israel have sinned and rebelled against God. Who is to blame for Israel's rebellion? Samaria, the capital city itself! Who is guilty of idolatry in Judah? Jerusalem itself!.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ka tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, paɣ maa ni yɛn dɔɣi bi so ti a maa ni kpi.
en: But you did things that made the Lord s enemies lose their respect for him, so your new baby son will die.

dag: N ni daa tuui tɔɣisi n-zabi mmaŋ zuɣu saha shɛl la, so daa bi zani n nyaaŋa; sokam zaa daa zomi ka chɛ ma. Naawuni di zaŋ di taali ʒili ba!.
en: The first time I defended myself, no one helped me. Everyone left me. I pray that God will forgive them.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlabil yino mali sara asiba, ka zaŋ piɛlabil so ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali sara zaawuni.
en: One lamb you will offer in the morning and the second at twilight.

dag: Binshɛli din ka buchi lan niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-nyɛ: bɛ zaŋdila bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri n-niŋdi ninvuɣ suma, ka zaŋdi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli niŋ ninvuɣ suma n-niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri. N yɛliya ni dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: There is something else that doesn't make sense to me. Good citizens are treated as criminals, while criminals are honored as though they were good citizens.

dag: wula ka din nyɛ Naawuni Shia din la ku gari lala?.
en: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa zal li shɛm o nia lɔbu min o milinsi puuni zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi mi daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o.
en: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o daa chani gindi alikauli tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni m-be kaman tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o be la. Ka o mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn daa ti yɛn di alikauli maa fal la daa kul bela tantinim ni.
en: By faith he lived in the land he had been promised as a stranger. He lived in tents along with Isaac and Jacob, who were coheirs of the same promise.

dag: Dunoli kam daa malila yoobu buyi, ka yoobu kam mali chɛulo diba ayi.
en: and each door had two turning panels, two for one door and two for the other.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, A yi doli ma, a yɛla ni ti muɣisi ma.
en: David said to him, You will be of no help to me if you come with me.

dag: Mɔabnima, mbusim be yi zuɣu! Yinim Chɛmɔshinima, Chɛmɔshi niriba ŋɔ ni bahi yoli zaa. O chɛ ka o bidibisi leei bɛn zo n-kpe yɔɣu, ka o bipuɣinsi mi leei Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn daba.
en: You Moabites are done for! Your god Chemosh deserted your people; they were captured, taken away by King Sihon the Amorite.

dag: Toondaannim ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa a zuɣu ka Naawuni ti a pin shɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la, miri ka a zaŋ li niŋ a baɣaka.
en: Dont neglect the spiritual gift in you that was given through prophecy when the elders laid hands on you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o paɣ Zara nti sɔɣi sil shɛli din daa be Makipɛla palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field.

dag: Ka Jɛfita yɛli ba, M mini n niriba ni Ammɔnnima n-daa mali naŋgbankpeen titali, ka n daa ŋme kuŋ boli ya, ka yi bi kana ti fa ma bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Jephthah answered them, The Ammonites have been giving us many problems. So my people and I fought against them. I called you, but you didnt come to help us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, amaa n naɣi yumi ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni ka be.
en: Do you think I enjoy seeing evil people die? asks the Sovereign Lord . No, I would rather see them repent and live.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti di bɛ ni daa ʒi kawaan shɛli Ijipti na maa naai saha shɛli ka bɛ ba yɛli ba, Labimiya ti da bindirigu biɛla na nti ti ti yaha.
en: The people ate all the grain they had brought from Egypt. When that grain was gone, Jacob said to his sons, Go to Egypt and buy some more grain for us to eat.

dag: N zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bɔhi n yɛla, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi bo ma nya ma. N yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn bi suhiri ma, Mani m-bɔŋɔ, mani m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord said, I was ready to answer my people's prayers, but they did not pray. I was ready for them to find me, but they did not even try. The nation did not pray to me, even though I was always ready to answer, Here I am; I will help you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Ka bɛ dimnim zaa puuni ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tooi zani bɛ tooni, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: There still were enemies around Israel, but the Lord kept his promise to let his people live in peace. And whenever the Israelites did have to go to war, no enemy could defeat them. The Lord always helped Israel win.

dag: Di saha ka waɣ biɛ titali maa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi paɣ maa zuɣu, ka o lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi paɣ maa zuliya bɛn kpalim n-nyɛ bɛn doli Naawuni zaligunima ka mali Yisa shɛhira la.
en: Then the dragon was very angry with the woman. It went away to make war against all her other children. Her children are those who obey Gods commands and have the truth that Jesus taught.

dag: Gbib a suhu n-gari binshɛɣukam, dama di ni ka nyɛvili bilisiri yirina.
en: Above all, be careful what you think because your thoughts control your life.

dag: Ka o daa ti wum ni Yisa yi Judia ka Galili na, ka o chaŋ o sani nti balim o ni o kana ti tib o bidibiga maa ti o, dama o daa tarigimi yɛn kpi.
en: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kariti saria luhiri so ka yiɣisiri so la sani ka di yirina.
en: Rather it is God who is the judge. He brings this person down, but that person he lifts up.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ lala. Shɛb daa pihi pampam, ka shɛb mi pihi biɛlabiɛla.
en: They did as they were told. Some gathered more and some gathered less.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul be lala dunia ŋɔ ni hal ti paai biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu.
en: A hundred fifty days later, the water started going down.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya ka o ba zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim zuɣu ni maa, di daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o daa gbaag o ba nuu ni o paai li Ifriim zuɣu ni n-zaŋ li pa Manaasa zuɣu ni;.
en: Joseph saw that his father put his right hand on Ephraims head. This didnt make Joseph happy. Joseph took his fathers hand because he wanted to move it from Ephraims head and put it on Manassehs head.

dag: ka baŋdi ŋaha mini yɛliŋmahima din nyɛ yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ saliŋlɔha.
en: These sayings will help you understand proverbs, stories with hidden meanings, words of the wise, and other difficult sayings.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zɔhi waɣi pam muɣisi ba, ka chɛ ka poloya gba waɣi n-saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: He sent swarms of flies that bit them. He sent the frogs that ruined their lives.

dag: Yi yi ti birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ soli, yi ni ti wum o kukoli yi nyaaŋa polo ka di yɛra, Soli maa m-bɔŋɔ, doliya li.
en: If you wander off the road to the right or the left, you will hear his voice behind you saying, Here is the road. Follow it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ifriim zuliya tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti Kɔhat daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: The tribe of Ephraim gave some of the Kohath families some towns. Those towns were chosen by throwing lots.

dag: Ka o lan tim so pah ata, ka bɛ ti bu n-ti o daŋa, ka kar o bahi.
en: The owner sent a third servant. He was also beaten terribly and thrown out of the vineyard.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, naa mini kpambaliba ti ku lan mali suhukpeeni. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi maligumaaniba, ka di niŋ anabinim alahiziba.
en: The Lord said, On that day kings and officials will lose their courage; priests will be shocked and prophets will be astonished.

dag: Dama n tɛhiya ni Naawuni zaŋ tinim tuumba ŋɔ zalila zaashe shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni, ka ti be kaman bɛ ni bahi noli ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb palɔni, ka leei malaikanim mini ninsalinim ni lihiri shɛb ninliha dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.

dag: O daa deei liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba sani anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu, ka di nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga la.
en: the , pieces of silver.

dag: dama bɛ yi kul lu buyopɔin, bɛ ni lan yiɣisi; amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti ŋme mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi kikahi ti kpe Yawɛ duu.
en: When they reached the city, they marched to the Temple to the music of harps and trumpets.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm mini maligumaaniba daa wum lala ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ bi mi yɛlli maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: The captain of the Temple guards and the leading priests heard this. They were confused and wondered what it all meant.

dag: Ka o nina maa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chani ka paɣiri Naawuni. Salo maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ gba daa gbaai Naawuni paɣibu.
en: At once he was able to see, and he followed Jesus, giving thanks to God. When the crowd saw it, they all praised God.

dag: Jilima mini dariza m-be o tuma ni, ka o wuntitali kul beni sahakam.
en: Gods deeds are majestic and glorious. Gods righteousness stands forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ matarika n-kuri salima chɛrubinim ayi tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: He made two winged creatures of hammered gold.

dag: N ni yili yil palli paɣi nyin Naawuni. N ni ŋme mɔɣilo din mali mihi pia paɣ a.
en: I will sing a new song to you, God. I will sing praises to you on a ten-stringed harp.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: Two women will be grinding at the mill. One will be taken and the other left.

dag: Yil anahi din daa bili yina n-zani tuuli yilli din daa kab la zaashee la wuhiri ni nama anahi ni ti yiɣisi n-zani nam zaɣ yini maa zaashee, ka di mi ti ku mali kpiɔŋ kaman tuuli nam maa.
en: The four horns that came up when the first horn was broken represent the four kingdoms into which that nation will be divided and which will not be as strong as the first kingdom.

dag: Daba ayi nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka ti lan niŋ nyɛvili, ka o yiɣisi ti daba ata dali maa n-chɛ ka ti min o lan be.
en: In two or three days he will revive us, and we will live in his presence.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-kpuɣ a bindoo chaŋ.
en: Then Jesus said, Stand up! Pick up your mat and walk.

dag: Musa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinii, ka Aduna mi yuma nyɛ yuun pihiniinaata saha shɛli bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Moses was years old and Aaron was when they spoke to Pharaoh.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ tiŋgbani maa nim zaa nyaɣisim, ka tiŋ maa daa maai, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Atalia maa nyaaŋa.
en: All the people of Judah were very happy, and the city of Jerusalem had peace because Athaliah was killed with a sword.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. N gba ni tooi yɛli ni binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani, amaa n ku saɣi chɛ ka di shɛli zaŋ ma leei di dabili.
en: Some of you say, We can do anything we want to. But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.

dag: N yɛri ya mi o ni kari saria yomyom ti ba nasara. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Daadam Bia yi lab dunia ŋɔ ni na, o ni nya bɛn mali yɛda.
en: I tell you, God will help his people quickly. But when the Son of Man comes again, will he find people on earth who believe in him.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu pam. So ku tooi baŋ o galisim maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The LORD is great and so worthy of praise! Gods greatness cant be grasped.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Pihahirɔt n-chaŋ ti tim teeku sunsuuni gari kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni n-daa chaŋ daba ata chandi Itam tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Mara.
en: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.

dag: O yi yɛli, Di viɛla, binshɛli ku lan niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; o mi suhu yi yiɣisi, dindina nyin baŋmi ni o lo zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: If he says, All right, I will be safe; but if he becomes angry, you will know that he is determined to harm me.

dag: ka mali tuuli biŋkɔbigu la yiko n-tumdi yiko tumtumsa tuma biŋkɔbigu maa tooni, ka muɣisiri dunia mini ŋunkam be di ni ni bɛ jɛmmi tuuli biŋkɔbigu ŋun daa mali dan titali din yɛn ku o ka daa lan tib la.
