en: It used the vast authority of the first beast in its presence. It forced the earth and all who live on it to worship the first beast, whose wound had healed.

dag: Di di daa simdi ni a zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni, n ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: Well, then, you should have deposited my money in the bank, and I would have received it all back with interest when I returned.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa ti mali salima binnani, ka di dubu nyɛ mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li zali palo ni Babilɔn luɣ shɛli din yuli daa booni Dura.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar had a gold statue made, ninety feet high and nine feet wide, and he had it set up in the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

dag: Sal ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla sala; ka Naawuni Shia mi ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla shia.
en: The only life people get from their human parents is physical. But the new life that the Spirit gives a person is spiritual.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla yɛm wuhibu ni be shɛli ni, ka maŋsiɣisibu be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: Wisdom teaches you to respect the Lord . You must be humbled before you can be honored.

dag: Ka Pɛntikɔst Chuɣu dali daa ti paai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim luɣ yini.
en: On the day of Pentecost all the Lord's followers were together in one place.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina zaashee ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuma zuɣu la n-ka yi sanna.
en: These people have devoted their lives to the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha maa ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ bɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini din daa nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpa viɛlli na ti niŋdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri maa ni.
en: After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom.

dag: Sokam dirila tiŋgbani daatam, hal naa gba dirila tiŋgbani daatam anfaani.
en: But the lands yield should be for everyone if the field is cultivated.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra.
en: Again Jesus asked them, Who is it you are looking for? Jesus of Nazareth, they said.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ daa yɛli ni a ni wurim kpe ŋɔ, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ku lan be di ni, ka kpe ti zani dabari sahakam. .
en: Then pray, Lord , you have said that you would destroy this place, so that there would be no living creatures in it, neither people nor animals, and it would be like a desert forever.

dag: Ka Naa Hiram ŋariŋ shɛli din daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima la na daa lan ʒi alimug dari pam mini kuɣ viɛla gba n-yi Ofiri maa na.
en: Hiram's fleet, which had brought gold from Ophir, also brought from there a large amount of juniper wood and jewels.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chaŋ zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi maa ni, hal Musa mini Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la ni daa kul kpalim be bɛ sansani maa ni la zaa yoli.
en: Yet they still dared to go up into the hill country, even though neither the Lord 's Covenant Box nor Moses left the camp.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ya yi ni daa nyari biɛrim shɛli mini wahala shɛŋa ni, ka yihi ya tuun kpɛma mini bɛ ni daa muɣisiri ya ka yi tumdi tuun shɛŋa la tumbu ni.
en: In the past, you were slaves. People forced you to work hard. But the Lord will take away the hard work you were forced to do.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun tiri dunianim bɛn tumd o yubu suhudoo ŋɔ.
en: Glory to God in heaven, and on earth peace among those whom he favors.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa yina ka bɛ mini Jɔab ti zaŋ nya taba, ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa shɛb daa lu nimaani, ka bɛ daa ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba nimaani.
en: When the men of the city came out, they fought and killed some of David's soldiers—Uriah the Hittite was one of them.

dag: Ka o daa kpe duu maa ni, ka vooi dunoli yo bɛ niriba ayi maa niŋ, ka suhi Yawɛ.
en: Elisha went into the room and shut the door. He and the child were alone in the room now. Then he prayed to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pah o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli Sinai Zoli gbin la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the terms of the covenant that the Lord commanded Moses to make with the people of Israel in the land of Moab; all this was in addition to the covenant which the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai.

dag: bɛn yɛli tia, Nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ka yɛli kuɣili, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi ti. Dama bɛ lɛbila bɛ nyaansi biri ma, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nini ka chɛ ma. Amaa muɣisigu yi ti paai ba, bɛ booni ma mi, Kamina ti tiligi ti.
en: You will all be disgraced—you that say that a tree is your father and that a rock is your mother. This will happen because you turned away from me instead of turning to me. But when you are in trouble, you ask me to come and save you.

dag: Nyama, zibisim ni ti be dunia ni, ka niriba be bumbɔn ni. Amaa Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o neesim neei gili ya, ka chɛ ka o jilima siɣi yi zuɣu na.
en: Other nations will be covered by darkness, But on you the light of the Lord will shine; The brightness of his presence will be with you.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bom yuma ata naɣilaa mini yuma ata bunyaŋ ni yuma ata piɛlaa ni ŋmanʒee ni yiŋ ŋmani ti ma.
en: God said to Abram, We will make an agreement. Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ka guhira, ka suhimiya Naawuni, dama yi bi mi di saha.
en: Be on watch, be alert, for you do not know when the time will come.

dag: ka chɛ ka sochandiba ku yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni! Ti suhir alibarika tiri ya Yawɛ yuli zuɣu.
en: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi dindali maa, ka yiɣimiya jɛmmi ni suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anabinim gba.
en: Long ago your own people did these same things to the prophets. So when this happens to you, be happy and jump for joy! You will have a great reward in heaven.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣimi do bɛ sɔɣibu shee kaman gbuɣinli la guhira. Bɛ domi gu tarimba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zana bari gbahi ba n-vo n-chaŋ.
en: They are like lions hiding in the bushes to catch weak and helpless animals. They lay their traps for the poor, who are caught in their nets.

dag: Ka naa maa gba suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o chɛ ka pirinsi kpɛh o duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o gba yo samli maa zaa.
en: His master was furious and handed him over to the guard responsible for punishing prisoners, until he had paid the whole debt.

dag: ni Lakishi ni Bɔzikat ni Ɛgilɔn.
en: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon.

dag: Ŋuna m-booi booli pa teeku kom zuɣu luɣ shɛli neesim mini zibisim ni chirigi taba.
en: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she zabba ka niŋ bimbomaboma niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she bantabiga ka she shɛlɔrigu n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu.
en: Weave Aaron's shirt of fine linen and make a turban of fine linen and also a sash decorated with embroidery.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa gbaag o n-kpaɣ o nina, ka zaŋ o tahi Gaza ti zaŋ daanya bandi baŋ o, ka chɛ ka o niɛmdi chi sarika ni.
en: So the Philistines captured him, put out his eyes, and took him down to Gaza. They bound him with bronze chains, and he worked the grinding mill in the prison.

dag: Bɛ daa nyuri binnyura maa dolila zaligu ni wuhi shɛm. Bɛ daa bi muɣisi so ni o nyu li; dama naa maa daa pun yɛl o yiŋbihi ni bɛ tim sokam wain maa kaman bɛ ni bɔri li shɛm tariga.
en: and said to them, Drink all you want! Then he told his servants, Keep their cups full.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; dabili mi bi garit o duuma.
en: Students are not better than their teacher. Servants are not better than their master.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Naawuni ni tum tuun shɛŋa, o tuma mali dabiɛm pam ninsalinim sani.
en: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!.

dag: Absalom dii yɛrila dilana, Nyama, a yɛtɔɣa viɛla ka tuhi, amaa naa bi bo so zal o zaani ni o wum a ni mali shɛli.
en: Absalom would say, Look, the law is on your side, but there is no representative of the king to hear your case.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ alikauli la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ dapuhi la niŋ adaka maa, ka zaŋ adaka maa yɔrigu yo li.
en: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.

dag: Di saha maa ka Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa la daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia biɛra, ka sabi gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi di zuɣu tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: At that time Merodach-baladan, son of Babylons King Baladan, sent messengers to Hezekiah with letters and a gift. This was because he had heard that Hezekiah was sick.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka o bihi deer o noli ka tir o jilima binshɛɣukam puuni;.
en: They should manage their own household well—they should see that their children are obedient with complete respect.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa mini nabihi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pia ni tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim zaa kul o ya; ka so daa bi kpalim naɣila bɛn nyɛ nandaamba kɔŋko n-daa kpalim be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then Nebuchadnezzar exiled all of Jerusalem: all the officials, all the military leaders—ten thousand exiles—as well as all the skilled workers and metalworkers. No one was left behind except the poorest of the lands people.

dag: Naawuni, guli ma; dama a sani ka n sɔɣi.
en: Protect me, God, because I take refuge in you.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N tum alahichi; dama m birigi Yawɛ zaligu, ka lan zaɣis a noli. N daa zɔrila niriba maa dabiɛm ka saɣi bɛ noli.
en: Saul said to Samuel, I have sinned because I disobeyed the LORDs command and your instructions. I was afraid of the troops and obeyed them.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi tahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din gbibi ya.
en: But Jesus turned and spoke sternly to them.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ ti paai di yuma anu saha, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa kana ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: After Rehoboam had been king for four years, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa kul muɣisiri ba ka yɛra, Tummiya yi tuma naari dabisili kam kaman bɛ ni yi tiri ya mɔri ka yi tumdi li shɛm maa.
en: The slave drivers kept trying to force them to make the same number of bricks every day as they had made when they were given straw.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ din guli ba, ka faranim fara bahiri ba yoli.
en: Wealth protects the rich; poverty destroys the poor.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pakoli ŋun su yili maa bidibiga maa daa ti biɛra, ka di muɣis o hal ka o ti tarigi.
en: Some time later the womans son became sick. He became worse and worse until he stopped breathing.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba bɛn miri ma na ŋɔ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi, di yi pa lala, man Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Also tell the priests who come near the Lord that they must prepare themselves for this special meeting. If they dont, I, the Lord , will punish them.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani di shɛhira jɛndi ba. Amaa ka bɛ bi ŋmaligi chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni sani bee n-suh o dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Israels pride is a witness against him; yet they dont return to the LORD their God, or seek him because of all this.

dag: Ka niriba ayi maa gba daa yɛli ba binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ sol ni mini bɛ ni daa lan baŋ o shɛm o bɔrɔbɔro ŋmahibu ni la yɛla.
en: Then the two disciples described what had happened along the road and how Jesus was made known to them as he broke the bread.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi dari chah o binyɛra, ka teei dɔni tiŋgban ni ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o sani gba dari chahi bɛ binyɛra.
en: The king got up, tore his garments, and lay on the ground. All his servants stood near him, their garments torn as well.

dag: Yawɛ sani, o daa nyɛla tɔha ŋun mali yaa pam; dinzuɣu ka niriba daa yi yɛra, Yawɛ chɛ ka a nyɛ tɔha so ŋun mali yaa kaman Nimrɔd.
en: The LORD saw him as a great hunter, and so it is said, Like Nimrod, whom the LORD saw as a great hunter.

dag: Amaa man ni lih a ninni wuntitali puuni; n yi ti neei n-lihi nya a kɔtomsi, di ni ti tiɣi n nini.
en: I have done only what is right, so I will see your face. And seeing you, I will be fully satisfied.

dag: Naa, ti gba ni nyar a nam daanfaani la zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi bɔri ni ti nya a filiŋ, dinzuɣu ka ti timna ti yɛl a.
en: We have a responsibility to the king. We dont want to see this happen, so we are sending this letter to inform the king.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din bɛ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, bɛ daa mɛla sara maligu bimbin titali zali nimaani.
en: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh reached the western side of the Jordan River valley and built a huge altar there beside the river. When the rest of the Israelites heard what these tribes had done.

dag: Bee a kul zaɣisi ti mi zaa, ka a suhuyiɣisili maa lan ka maabu?.
en: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ di mini bindir pala bɔrɔbɔro ni piɛbihi ayi n-gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara Yawɛ sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ zaŋ ti maligumaana maa.
en: The priest shall present the bread with the two lambs as a special gift to the Lord for the priests. These offerings are holy.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, ti naba ʒiɛla a dunoya ni.
en: Now our feet are standing in your gates, Jerusalem!.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni tiri n gba, ka Naawuni ti ma n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka n tooi tɔɣisiri li ni suhukpeeni n-kahigiri lahibal suŋ la ashili gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba.
en: As for me, pray that when I open my mouth, Ill get a message that confidently makes this secret plan of the gospel known.

dag: N daa wum a yɛligu, ka dee li, ka a yɛligu maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka ti ma suhupiɛlli, dama nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n su ma.
en: You spoke to me, and I listened to every word. I belong to you, Lord God Almighty, and so your words filled my heart with joy and happiness.

dag: O zaŋd o bumbil lɔri wain tia, ka zaŋd o bunsaa bia lɔri wain ti viɛlli. O zaŋdi wain paɣir o situra, ka zaŋdi wain wala kom paɣir o binyɛr titali.
en: He ties his donkeys to the best grapevines. He washes his clothes in the best wine.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni zali duri maa tooni zaŋ labi dundɔntitali polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: There was a wall outside that was parallel to the rooms and ran along the outer courtyard. It ran in front of the rooms for cubits.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni baŋ ni bɛ je ma zuɣu ka o ti ma bidibiga ŋɔ gba; ka daa bol o yuli Simiɔn.
en: She became pregnant again and gave birth to a son. She said, The LORD heard that I was unloved, so he gave me this son too, and she named him Simeon.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia hal ti paag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni yɛliya, Benya kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: The scripture says, Be holy because I am holy.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka a nya nirilim niŋbu mini yu suŋ Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: Then God will be pleased and think well of you and so will everyone else.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa kpe du shɛli din daa be puuni ha la ni nti buɣisi di dunoya pilanima, ka di nyɛ mita yiniyini, ka dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ata. Ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu.
en: Then the man went into the last room. He measured the walls on either side of the doorway. Each side wall was cubits thick and cubits wide. The doorway was cubits wide.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Bilichin tital so n-daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha nti di nam labina;.
en: So he said, A very important man was preparing to go to a country far away to be made a king. Then he planned to return home and rule his people.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, noli yɛlibu ni yi tiŋgban shɛli din yaai di noli n-deeg a tizo maa ʒim a nuu ni maa na di a.
en: You are placed under a curse and can no longer farm the soil. It has soaked up your brother's blood as if it had opened its mouth to receive it when you killed him.

dag: Bɛ chanila gbala ni yuŋ ti buɣiri kpiimba baɣiri, ka ŋubiri kuruchunim nimdi; ka piɛbiri buɣa maligu nimdi bim.
en: They sit among the graves, waiting to get messages from the dead. They eat the meat of pigs, and their pots are full of soup made from unclean meat.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa Jɔsia bia la ni daa di nam ti paai yuma anahi saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Judanim zaa polo.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, I received a message from the Lord concerning all the people of Judah.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni n-gbiri binyara ŋubira; ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni. Ka o daa bahi ba noli.
en: On that hill there was a big herd of pigs eating. The demons begged Jesus to allow them to go into the pigs. So he allowed them to do this.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ chaŋ ha nti lan gili Baala wulinluhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛdom zoya ni n-zaŋ chaŋ hal ti baɣisi Jiarim Zoli nuzaa polo gari bee din nyɛ Chɛsalɔn la, ka di lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-gari chaŋ ti baɣisi Timna gari.
en: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.

dag: Do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa bi tɔɣisi ti suhumahili yɛtɔɣa, ka yɛli ni ti nyɛla puɣisiriba bɛn kana ni ti ti puɣisi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: The governor of Egypt was rude and treated us like spies.

dag: Lala ka Sulemaana daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma zaa din nyɛ: salima sara maligu bimbini mini teebu shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: Solomon also made the dishes and things for Gods Temple. He made the golden altar and the tables where they put the bread of the Presence.

dag: Dama di pala ŋun paɣ omaŋa n-nyari paɣibu, amaa ti Duuma ni paɣ so n-nyari paɣibu.
en: For it is when the Lord thinks well of us that we are really approved, and not when we think well of ourselves.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Pa mani n-nyɛ ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnima, amaa a min a daŋ niriba n-nahindi Izraɛlnima. Dama yinima n-zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka jɛmdila Baal buɣa.
en: Elijah answered, I havent troubled Israel; you and your fathers house have! You did as much when you deserted the LORDs commands and followed the Baals.

dag: di chaŋ wula ka yi yɛli ni m Ba ni pii man ninvuɣ so n-tim dunia ŋɔ ni na maa mɔri Naawuni, n ni yɛli ni n nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu?.
en: As for me, the Father chose me and sent me into the world. How, then, can you say that I blaspheme because I said that I am the Son of God?.

dag: A sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o jilima galisi; ka a chɛ ka o yuli du ka o nam mali dariza.
en: The kings reputation is great because of your saving help; youve conferred on him glory and grandeur.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam tuma din pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sokam ŋmanila shilinshia. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam nyɛla yoli. Bɛ laɣindila bɛ nyamma sɔŋda, ka bi mi ŋun ti yɛn di li.
en: Yes, people wander around like shadows; yes, they hustle and bustle, but pointlessly; they dont even know who will get the wealth theyve amassed.

dag: Amaa hal Taitus ŋun daa be n san la ni daa kul nyɛ Giriiki maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi muɣis o ni o guni.
en: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: So the Lord said to me.

dag: ka yi gba nyɛ Masia dini, ka Masia mi nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab naa la daa ti yiɣisi lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa tim ti boli Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni o ti yɛl noli tin ya.
en: Then Moabs King Balak, Zippors son, set out to attack Israel. He summoned Balaam, Beors son, to curse you.

dag: Amaa yinim miriya ka yi niŋdi lala, dama yi Ba Naawuni pun mi din simdi ya hal ka yi na bi suh o li gba.
en: Do not be like them. Your Father already knows what you need before you ask him.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Ka bɔzuɣu ka yinim zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus answered, And why do you refuse to obey Gods command so that you can follow those traditions you have?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpi bela fɔŋ ni ŋuhira, ka bɛn mali dansi kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka Naawuni baɣa ka bɛ suhigu ni.
en: From the city, the dying cry out; the throat of the mortally wounded screams, but God assigns no blame.

dag: Kaman karakɔhi ni kul daari yiɣiri gindi shɛm bee sakpaleensi ni yiɣiri shɛm, lala ka noli yɛlibu din bi simdi gba bi chani shɛli.
en: Dont worry when someone curses you for no reason. Nothing bad will happen. Such words are like birds that fly past and never stop.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, di nyɛla talahi ni woligibu kpe yi sunsuuni n-chɛ ka di kahigi wuhi bɛn nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinim ni nyɛ shɛb yi ni.
en: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.

dag: ka zaŋ di mini di nɛma zaa pɔbi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni, ka zaŋ li tam amaŋka dapuhi zuɣu.
en: They will place it and its equipment in a covering of fine leather, and then place it on the carrying frame.

dag: Ka o ti kɔrigi taali sanyoo sara piɛbila maa, ka maligumaana maa zaŋ taali sanyoo sara maa ʒim shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tib nyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.
en: The priest will slaughter the sheep for the compensation offering and will take some of its blood and put it on the right earlobe, the right thumb, and the right big toe of the person needing purification.

dag: Farisiinim daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ saha ka Naawuni nam yɛn piligi? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni nam bi yɛn piligimi ni shihira ka niriba nya li ni bɛ nini;.
en: Some Pharisees asked Jesus when God's kingdom would come. He answered, God's kingdom isn't something you can see.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Kɔra, A min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni Aduna sa kam Yawɛ tooni na biɛɣuni.
en: Moses said to Korah, Tomorrow you and your followers must come to the Tent of the Lord 's presence; Aaron will also be there.

dag: Pɛka ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Pekahs kingship and all that he accomplished are written in the official records of Israels kings.

dag: Ka niriba tusaanahi niŋ dunɔguliba; ka niriba tusaanahi la mi zaŋdi n ni daa mali wumpaɣibo biŋkumdi shɛŋa la paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: will be gatekeepers, and will be musicians. I made special musical instruments for them. They will use them to praise the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Yiɣisima, cham Kɛila, dama n zaŋ Filistianim maa niŋ a nuu ni.
en: So David consulted the Lord again, and the Lord said to him, Go and attack Keilah, because I will give you victory over the Philistines.

dag: Dama n tumtumdiba n-nyɛ Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdi shɛba n ni daa yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Israelites cannot be permanent slaves, because the people of Israel are the Lord 's slaves. He brought them out of Egypt; he is the Lord their God.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti tim ti bɔri Pita ka bi nya o, ka o vihi duguliba maa yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka bahi noli ni bɛ kum ba. Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yiɣisi Judia chaŋ Siizaria nti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Herod called for a thorough search. When Peter didnt turn up, Herod interrogated the guards and had them executed. Afterward, Herod left Judea in order to spend some time in Caesarea.

dag: Bɛ daa tuui zaŋ o tahila Annas sani, dama Annas daa nyɛla Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la deemba.
en: and led him first to Annas. He was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year. .

dag: Binnui daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinuayika.
en: the descendants of Binnui:.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛbis o biɛyanim maa. Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ, ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ŋme tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni.
en: Then he sent his brothers off and told them, Don't argue on the way home.

dag: Ŋunkam zani sana nyaaŋa ka o paŋ binshɛli, yin deem dilan binyɛrigu, ŋunkam zaŋ binshɛli pa talima ka deei binshɛli ti tinzunnima, yin deemiy o ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima maa.
en: Any people stupid enough to promise to be responsible for a stranger's debts deserve to have their own property held to guarantee payment.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ba sɔɣi sɔɣibu shee a sani, ka ninsalinim ku tooi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu. A gbib ba a ni zaŋ ba niŋ a sani luɣ shɛli maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka so ku tooi paa ba tu ba.
en: Others make plans to hurt them. They say such bad things about them. But you hide your people in your shelter and protect them.

dag: Ka ti yab Yaakubu daa ti wum ni bindirigu be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o daa tuui tim ti yaannim maa ni bɛ chaŋ Ijipti ti da bindirigu na.
en: But Jacob heard that there was food in Egypt. So he sent our people there. This was their first trip to Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ nahim Izraɛlnim mini Judanima. Ka bɛn daa gbahi ba maa zaa kul gbib ba kirikiri, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The Lord Almighty says, The people of Israel and of Judah are oppressed. All who captured them are guarding them closely and will not let them go.

dag: Ti leela kpibisi bɛn ka banima; ti manim nyɛla pakoya.
en: We have become orphans. We have no father. Our mothers have become like widows.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ʒe Gomna Pailɛt tooni, ka Gomna Pailɛt maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Jesus stood before Pilate, the governor, who asked him, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus answered, Yes, thats right.

dag: Cham ti sab niŋ litaafi ni zali wuhi niriba maa ni nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri shɛm; ka di ti di ba shɛhira sahakam.
en: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.

dag: Bɛ ku zo n-yi zibisim ni, buɣim ni di bɛ wulimama, ka pɔhim ʒe bɛ puma bahi.
en: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Midian tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Labimi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku a maa zaa kpiya.
en: But even before this, the Lord had told Moses, Leave the land of Midian and return to Egypt. Everyone who wanted to kill you is now dead.

dag: Niriba yi diri ʒiɛvari kɔŋko ka mali yurilim ni taba, di so ni niriba ŋubiri naɣ kpaba ka je taba.
en: Better a meal of greens with love than a plump calf with hate.

dag: ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋɔri maha shɛŋa din ka dabindi ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka bɛ niŋ kpam pa di zuɣu. Zaŋmi alikama zim viɛlli mali di zaa.
en: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.

dag: Ka Yisa daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi chirimya, dama yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba.
en: Jesus responded, You are wrong because you dont know either the scriptures or Gods power.

dag: Ka wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Karim dab paɣa min o bia bahi, dama dab paɣ bia mini bilichin paɣ bia ku laɣim di fali.
en: But what does the scripture say? Throw out the slave woman and her son, because the slave womans son wont share the inheritance with the free womans son .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni ti laɣim tab kana ti kumdi bɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: In those days and at that time, declares the LORD, the people of Israel and Judah will come out of Babylon together; with weeping they will leave as they seek the LORD their God.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa yi tɔb maa ni kuni ka zaŋ doli yi Hɛrɛs kunkuni polo.
en: After the battle, Gideon set out for home. As he was going through Heres Pass.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yisa m-bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o.
en: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth.

dag: A chɛ ka n fabila leei waa. A piligi buɣu n zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Piimiya yi ni na yoli gbahi zahin shɛb maa ni na.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Bring some of the fish you have just caught.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb mi yi Kriit mini Areebia na, amaa ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla timaŋmaŋ ya yɛligu ni.
en: both Jews and Gentiles converted to Judaism, and some of us are from Crete and Arabia—yet all of us hear them speaking in our own languages about the great things that God has done.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi pam m-bɔhi, Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Naawuni Bia? A kamina ni a ti nahim ti ka saha na bi paai.
en: They cried out, What are you going to do with us, Son of God? Have you come to torture us before the time of judgment.

dag: Ibrahimma daa kurigiya pam, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Abraham was now very old, and the Lord had blessed him in everything he did.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di mooni li kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini pala zuɣu ni niriba nyari ba m-paɣiri ba la. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: Whenever you give to the poor, dont blow your trumpet as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets so that they may get praise from people. I assure you, thats the only reward theyll get.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti kurigi saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka tiŋgban shɛli yi ni na yɛn deei mi na galisi pam.
en: When Joshua was very old, the Lord said to him, Joshua you have grown old, but there is still much land for you to take control of.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tiri nir nyɛvili wɔɣinli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yuma ni nyɛla biɛla.
en: Obey the Lord , and you will live longer. The wicked die before their time.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, ka yi yi bɔri ba din viɛli niŋbu, yi ni tooi niŋ ba saha shɛlikam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have poor people with you, and any time you want to, you can help them. But you will not always have me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mmaŋmaŋ ni ŋmaai sida tia wulikpani nyoli ni n-zaŋ li sa. N ni lan ŋmaai di wul polli din wɔɣa pam nyoli ni n-zaŋ li mmaŋmaŋa ti sa zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will take a branch from a tall cedar tree. I will take a small branch from the top of the tree, and I myself will plant it on a very high mountain.

dag: Yɛligu maa ni ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛvili daa yina, ka nyɛvili maa daa nyɛ neesim ninsalinim sani.
en: In him there was life, and that life was light for the people of the world.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu! A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, wummi n fabila. A wuntitali puuni, deemi n suhigu!.
en: Lord , hear my prayer. Listen to my call for help and answer my prayer. Show me how good and loyal you are.

dag: N ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni nirilim, ka chɛ ka bɛ be n sani. Ŋunkam doli so shɛli din ka galimi, ŋuna n-ni tum n tuma.
en: My eyes focus on those who are faithful in the land, to have them close to me. The person who walks without blame will work for me.

dag: Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ wuh o ti shɛli wulli ka o daa zaŋ li na ti lɔhi kom maa ni, ka di niŋ nyaɣisim. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa zali ba zaligu, ka zahim ba.
en: Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD pointed out a tree to him. He threw it into the water, and the water became sweet. The LORD made a regulation and a ruling there, and there he tested them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dunia zaa ni yɛn mali suhupiɛlli saha shɛli ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: Everyone on earth will celebrate when I destroy you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ nyɛviya zan tariga kaman nir ni yi vuhi pɔhim bahi la; ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ba bɛ ni be yuun shɛŋa ni.
en: So God brought their days to an end, like a puff of air, and their years in total ruin.

dag: Maligumaaniba kɔŋko puri ka Yisifu daa bi da. Dama Firawuna daa tirila maligumaaniba maa laɣidira, dina ka bɛ daa mali dira, dinzuɣu ka bɛn daa bi kɔhi bɛ puri maa.
en: However, he didnt buy the farmland of the priests because Pharaoh allowed the priests a subsidy, and they were able to eat from the subsidy Pharaoh gave them. Therefore, they didnt have to sell their farmland.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa siɣina Sinai Zoli maa kpaakpaanyom ni nti boli Musa du zoli maa kpaakpaanyom maa ni, ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord came down on the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the top of the mountain. Moses went up.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ zilinli gba: di nyɛla din pɔra, amaa ka nyɛ din nyuri bara yɛri yɛl kara. Lihimiya buɣim biɛla ni yi taai tibɔŋ ni n-di li shɛm!.
en: In the same way, even though the tongue is a small part of the body, it boasts wildly. Think about this: A small flame can set a whole forest on fire.

dag: Ka yi ti mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di li nimaani, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni.
en: and there you are to sacrifice and eat your fellowship offerings and be grateful in the presence of the Lord your God.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilai, Ilai, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: At about three Jesus cried out with a loud shout, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani , which means, My God, my God, why have you left me.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni o nyɛla Anabi Jɛrimia bee anabinim la ni yino.
en: The disciples answered, Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.

dag: O daa lan yih o yabipaɣ Maaka napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me Ashɛra binnan shɛli din chihiri zal la zuɣu. Ka Asa daa ŋme n kab o binnani maa luhi n-zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ ni.
en: His own grandmother Maacah had made an idol of Asherah, and Asa took it and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.

dag: Ka Mɔab naa daa ti nya ka tɔb maa mii taɣ o na, ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ takɔbinyaɣiriba m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-tim Ɛdom naa polo ni o gari zo, amaa ka kɔŋ garibu.
en: King Mesha of Moab saw that he was about to be defeated. So he took along soldiers with swords and tried to break through the front line where the Edomite troops were positioned. But he failed.

dag: Dama ti ni daa naan ku tooi sɔŋ timaŋa saha shɛl la dɛde, ka Yisa Masia daa kpi alahichinim zuɣu.
en: For when we were still helpless, Christ died for the wicked at the time that God chose.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa na kul kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ maa, ka Musa daa chaŋ miri Naawuni ni daa be sagban sabili shɛli ni maa.
en: The people stood far away from the mountain while Moses went to the dark cloud where God was.

dag: Dinzuɣu kamina ka n ti tim a Firawuna sani ka a chaŋ ti yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Now I am sending you to the king of Egypt so that you can lead my people out of his country.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa be luɣ shɛli din miri Jɛriko maa, ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi nya do so ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe o tooni. Ka Jɔshua daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A lee bela ti polo bee a bela ti dimnim polo.
en: When Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up and saw a man standing in front of him. The man had a sword in his hand. Joshua went to the man and asked, Are you a friend to our people or are you one of our enemies.

dag: Nyin ŋun gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli ŋɔ. Yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-daa yaag a noli yɛl li, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: This is the covenant you kept with your servant David my father, which you promised him. Today you have fulfilled what you promised.

dag: Ka Ɛr daa nyɛ Jɔshua bia, ka Jɔshua nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza nyɛ Jɔrim bia, ka Jɔrim nyɛ Matat so bia, ka Matat maa mi nyɛ Lɛvi so bia.
en: Er was the son of Joshua. Joshua was the son of Eliezer. Eliezer was the son of Jorim. Jorim was the son of Matthat. Matthat was the son of Levi.

dag: Ka Dauda daa daŋ yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chɛ ka so guli piɛri maa, ka o zaŋ bindira maa chaŋ kaman o ba Jɛsi ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. O daa paai sansani maa shee la saha shɛli bɛ ni daa maani shili ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣ ni, ka buri zambu.
en: David got up early the next morning, left someone else in charge of the sheep, took the food, and went as Jesse had told him to. He arrived at the camp just as the Israelites were going out to their battle line, shouting the war cry.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba mini Kɔra daŋ niriba la daa yiɣisi zani ŋ-ŋme kuŋ pam paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli ŋɔɣu maa ni n yɛn karila alizin biɛri, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋ zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali n ni naai n tuma.
en: Jesus said to them: Go tell that fox, I am going to force out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and three days later I'll be through.

dag: N gbaala mmaŋ ni so biɛɣu kam dolibu, ni di chɛ ka n tooi gbib a yɛligu.
en: I have avoided every path that leads to evil so that I could obey your word.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la malimi yi luɣili pinaayi zaa ka di be kasi, ka gbibi yi niŋgbuna zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni yi shihi zaa ka di mali yaa ka ti ku mali taali hal baabiɛla ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dali.
en: We pray that God himself, the God of peace, will make you pure—belonging only to him. We pray that your whole self—spirit, soul, and body—will be kept safe and be blameless when our Lord Jesus Christ comes.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa bi neei kum ni, dindina ti waazu yihibu nyɛla yoli, ka yi yɛda niŋbu gba nyɛ yoli.
en: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.

dag: Kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu, ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna.
en: There was not enough water for the people at that place. So the people met together to complain against Moses and Aaron.

dag: O yiŋ nyɛla so shɛli din kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka nyɛ din kuni kum shee.
en: If you go to her house, you are on the way to the world of the dead. It is a shortcut to death.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, N ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni n ti karila saria ka di chɛ ka bɛn bi nyari nya, ka bɛn nyari mi leei zoomba.
en: Jesus said, I have come into the world to exercise judgment so that those who dont see can see and those who see will become blind.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm mali Aduna min o bidibisi ka bɛ tooi tum maligumaaniba tuma ti ma m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi naɣila polli mini piɛlah ayi bɛn ka galimi.
en: When you ordain Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests, choose a young bull and two rams that have nothing wrong with them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiini yila paɣiri ka puhiri Yawɛ yɛra: Dama o viɛla ka o yurilim zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo kul beni sahakam. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kul tahiri pampam paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ duu maa tampuɣili maa zuɣu.
en: They sang the Lord 's praises, repeating the refrain: The Lord is good, and his love for Israel is eternal. Everyone shouted with all their might, praising the Lord , because the work on the foundation of the Temple had been started.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni ka nyɛ o Ba ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ni o tin ya o Shia Kasi ŋun ni chɛ ka yi nya yɛm, ka kahigi Naawuni ni nyɛ so wuhi ya ka yi baŋ o.
en: I pray that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, will give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation that makes God known to you.

dag: dama yi mi ni buɣisibu shɛli din buɣisiri yi yɛda niŋbu chɛmi ka yi niŋdi ania.
en: You know that when your faith is tested, you learn to be patient in suffering.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mini ŋun laɣim suɣiri ʒiɛri ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa.
en: He answered, One of you men who has eaten with me from this dish will betray me.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, o dii nyami ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: As soon as Jesus came out of the water, he saw the sky open and the Holy Spirit coming down to him like a dove.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia maa daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa zaŋ ma chaŋ, ka n daa chaŋ ni suhugarigu pam mini suhuyiɣisili, dama Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu pam.
en: The power of the Lord came on me with great force, and as his spirit carried me off, I felt bitter and angry.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni chaɣisanima ni feensi ni dawulɛnim n-wari wahi ni bɛ yaa zaa ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: Some of the people of Israel were playing music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, castanets, and cymbals. David and the others were happy, and they danced for the Lord with all their might.

dag: Amaa ka n niriba zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu; Izraɛlnim zaɣisiya ni bɛ kul ku deei n noli.
en: But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not obey me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi daboli maa zuɣu kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindoo n-du pii zuɣu ti yɛrigi sɔŋ Sool, ka o daa dɔni nimaani gbihi.
en: When they came back from the shrine to the town, a bed was made for Saul on the roof, and he slept.

dag: Di biɛɣu pia nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa.
en: Ten days later Jeremiah received the LORDs word.

dag: Ka paɣisarili maa daa guui chaŋ ti zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛl o ma yiŋnima.
en: The young woman ran to her mother's house and told the whole story.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka bɛ be Mɔab naa maa sani saha shɛli zaa ŋun Dauda ni daa be vokabili maa ni maa.
en: So he brought his parents to the king of Moab, and they stayed with him while David was in hiding.

dag: Jɔra daŋ — kɔbiga ni pinaayi.
en: of Jorah.

dag: Kpambal so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna ka naa yura, amaa kpambal so ŋun tumdi vi tuma, o suhu yiɣisirimi bahir o zuɣu.
en: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm, ŋun baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ gbinni. Ŋun nyɛ baŋda, ŋun baŋmi li. Dama Yawɛ soya nyɛla yɛlimaŋli soya, ka wuntizɔriba dol li, amaa alahichinim bɛn tuuri la di zuɣu.
en: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord , and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, So beni m-me yili palli ka na bi suhi Naawuni ka kpe di ni? O labimi kul o yili maa ni, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so ti suhi Naawuni ka kpe o yili maa ni.
en: The Levite officials will say to the soldiers, Is there any man here who has built a new house but has not yet dedicated it? That man should go back home. He might be killed in the battle, and then another person will dedicate that mans house.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaayi dali ka ti daa yiɣisi Ahava Mɔɣili maa gbini n-kuni Jɛrusalɛm, ka ti Naawuni maa nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka o tiligi ti ti dimnim mini sɔguriba nuu ni ti chandi maa ni.
en: Then we left the Ahava River on the twelfth day of the first month to go to Jerusalem. The power of our God was with us; he saved us from the power of the enemy and ambushes along the way.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa bi paligi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu, ka o daa darigi Izraɛlnim tibili.
en: David's order to count the people made God angry, and he punished Israel.

dag: ni bɛ ni daa she binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa ni bɛ yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la mini binyɛr kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa she n-ti Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la min o bidibisi ni bɛ tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.

dag: Ka o napɔnvari be kaman daanya sun shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she zuɣiri buɣim ni m-paɣi ka di yi viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ka o kukoli mi vuri kaman kɔzɔrim vubu la.
en: His feet were like fine brass that has been purified in a furnace, and his voice sounded like rushing water.

dag: Dama n daa bi dee li la ninsal sani; pa so mi n-daa zaŋ li wuhi ma, amaa di yila Yisa Masia ŋun daa kahigi li wuhi ma la sanna.
en: I did not get my message from any other human. The Good News is not something I learned from other people. Jesus Christ himself gave it to me. He showed me the Good News that I should tell people.

dag: Ka sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la ni zaŋ yaɣ yini tariga hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: The middle crossbar, set halfway up the frames, is to extend from one end of the Tent to the other.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka wuntia luna kaman saa la. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi, ka tiliginsim yina; ka chɛ ka wuntia gba yina; Man Yawɛ n-nam li.
en: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord , create.

dag: Di ŋmanila nam leebu kpa shɛli din daa yi Aduna zuɣu ni n-zo nti tɛl o teeŋa n-zo hal ti tɛl o binyɛrigu nyiŋgol la.
en: It is like the precious anointing oil running down from Aaron's head and beard, down to the collar of his robes.

dag: bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya ba ni ti bɔhira, Bɛ lee be ya ni.
en: but they will be blown away like dust. Those who used to know them will wonder where they have gone.

dag: Ka yi daa vu m-mirina ti zani zoli maa gbini, ka zoli maa daa taai buɣim n-kpuɣi du sagbana ni, ka sagbana daa zibigi lim li.
en: Then you all came close and stood at the foot of the mountain. The mountain was blazing with fire up to the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick smoke!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab bɛ sanna pahi buta m-bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Di saɣ lala, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: When he came back the third time, he said to them, Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come! Look, the Son of Man is now being handed over to the power of sinners.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Pa yinima n-daa je ma hal ka kari ma m ba yiŋ la? Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kani n sanna yi wahala nyabu saha.
en: But Jephthah said to the elders of the land of Gilead, You forced me to leave my fathers house. You hate me. So why are you coming to me now that you are having trouble.

dag: Ŋun mali tɛha yuuni bɔrila yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun kul lihirila dunia luɣilikam.
en: Wisdom is right in front of those with understanding, but the eyes of fools are off to the edges of the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɛrari daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim la ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pinaayi.
en: In all, the last family of Levites, the Merari family, got towns.

dag: N ni na kul be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ, n nyɛla dunia ŋɔ neesim.
en: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Aai, n nyɛla Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, dina n-chɛ ka n kana maa. Ka Jɔshua daa lu n-gbani zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura ka bɔh o, N dana, ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ niŋ.
en: Neither, he answered. I am here because I am the commander of the Lord 's army. Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. I am your servant, he said. Tell me what to do.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tahiri kum na, amaa ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tiligiri ba.
en: The words of the wicked are a deathtrap, but the speech of those who do right rescues them.

dag: O tim a a suhu ni bɔri shɛli, ka chɛ ka a ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa pali.
en: May he give you what you really want. May he make all your plans successful.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ taali ni yibu Naawuni sani din yi yɛda niŋbu ni na polo di sabiya: Di bɔhi a suhi ni, Ŋuni n-lee ni du alizanda ni? .
en: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima m-mali binshɛŋa ni daanya lahi ni kuriti binyara din nyɛla binshɛŋa din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni zaŋ dina nti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: All silver and gold, along with bronze and iron equipment, are holy to the LORD. They must go into the LORDs treasury.

dag: Amaa Kɔra zuliya bɛn daa bi kpi.
en: But the Korahite clan wasn't destroyed.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia ŋɔ niŋ o nuu ni? Ka ŋuni n-lee zaŋ dunia zaa fukumsi ti o?.
en: Did God get his power from someone else? Did someone put him in charge of the world?.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi. .
en: So I will have him whipped and let him go.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti mooni Masia molo n-kpamdi sokam jaande, ka wuhiri sokam baŋsim zaa puuni ni di chɛ ka sokam zooi m-bi niriba Masia ni, ka ti zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino tahi Naawuni sani.
en: This is what we preach as we warn and teach every person with all wisdom so that we might present each one mature in Christ.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋchaŋ gil li, ka sab di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm niŋ litaafi ni, ka lan pirigi di fɔndi ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-zaŋ labi ti ti Jɔshua Shilo sansani maa ni.
en: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri suhuyubu niŋ; di chɛ ka bɛ di nasara bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: Lord , dont let the wicked have what they want. Dont let their plans succeed. Selah.

dag: Di zuɣu ka yi leei bɛn mali biɛrisuŋ yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn zaa be Masidɔnia mini Akaia la sani.
en: So you became an example to all believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

dag: M mabihi, m mi n suhu ni ka biɛhiŋ kani ni yi mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali baŋsim zaa, ka ni tooi wuhi taba.
en: My friends: I myself feel sure that you are full of goodness, that you have all knowledge, and that you are able to teach one another.

dag: Di pala lahibal sun shɛli n-shiri lan beni pahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb beni chirindi ya yi tɛha ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ taɣi Masia lahibal suŋ maa.
en: Its not really another gospel, but certain people are confusing you and they want to change the gospel of Christ.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa baŋ ni Yisa baŋya ni ŋuna n-shih o maa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o chaŋ ti gbani Yisa tooni salo maa zaa ninni, n-kahigi wuhi daliri din chɛ ka o shih o ka dii nya alaafee maa.
en: The woman saw that she had been found out, so she came trembling and threw herself at Jesus' feet. There in front of everybody, she told him why she had touched him and how she had been healed at once.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yi nimaani chaŋ Pɛnuɛl nti lan suhi bɛ gba bindirigu. Ka Pɛnuɛluɛlnim daa garigi yɛl o kaman Sukɔtinim ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Gideon left the city of Succoth and went to the city of Penuel. He asked the men of Penuel for food, just as he had asked the men of Succoth. But the men of Penuel gave Gideon the same answer that the men of Succoth had given.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tikpiranima, wummiya! Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoomba, duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya!.
en: Deaf people, listen to me! Blind people, look and see!.

dag: ni ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la.
en: and , women who hadnt known a man intimately by sleeping with him.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ ti kpuɣi pagɔrili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani.
en: A priest serves God in a special way, so he must not marry a woman who has had sexual relations with any other man. He must not marry a prostitute or a divorced woman.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka so kani, ka noonsi zaa yiɣi.
en: I saw that there were no people; even the birds had flown away.

dag: Bum ansarisimaana, ka bɛn bi mi bɔhim yɛm, kpahimi bɛn mali baŋsim zuɣu ni, ka bɛ nya baŋsim pahi.
en: Arrogance should be punished, so that people who don't know any better can learn a lesson. If you are wise, you will learn when you are corrected.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim di bindir yin shɛli Naawuni ni daa ti ba la.
en: All ate the same spiritual bread.

dag: Dinzuɣu nira daa yi yɛn kpe duri maa nudirigu polo dunoya maa ni, a ni dolila duu maa tariga so shɛli din baɣisiri gooni maa wulimpuhili polo.
en: There was a door under the rooms on the south side of the building, at the east end where the wall began.

dag: Dabisili din pah anu dali, Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the fifth day Simeons Chief Shelumiel, Zurishaddais son.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛri din nyɛ: saŋkpana.
en: These are the laws about dreaded skin diseases;.

dag: Yi yi wum zaligunim ŋɔ ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbib o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani la.
en: If you listen to these case laws and follow them carefully, the LORD your God will keep the covenant and display the loyalty that he promised your ancestors.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ piligi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages as the Spirit enabled them to speak.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: The LORD said to the Adversary, Where did you come from? The Adversary answered the LORD, From wandering throughout the earth.

dag: o ni bela a sani kaman padira bee tumtumda n-tumd a tuma hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: Instead, they will be like a hired laborer or foreign guest to you. They will work for you until the Jubilee year.

dag: Tahima ŋɔ puuni ka ti daa tiligi; amaa pa nir nini ni nya shɛli n-nyɛ tahima, dama ŋuni n-lee ni niŋ tahima o nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu?.
en: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.

dag: Bɛ kul malila kpiɔŋ chana; bɛ ni nya Naawuni ŋun gari wuna zaa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: The people travel from town to town on their way to Zion, where they will meet with God.

dag: Tɔbbi ŋuni m-mi n-chaŋ tɔbu ni nti su omaŋmaŋ bindirigu fukumsi? Ka ŋuni m-mi n-sa tihi ka ku di di wala? Bee ŋuni m-mi n-guli niɣi ka ku nyu bɛ bihim?.
en: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?.

dag: O wuhi kpiɔŋ, ka wurim karimbaannima bɛ suhuri ni tɛhi biɛri zuɣu.
en: He reached out his arm and showed his power. He scattered those who are proud and think great things about themselves.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli anabi Hanania maligumaaniba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa ʒe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni ninni.
en: Then the prophet Jeremiah answered the prophet Hananiah. They were standing in the Temple of the Lord . The priests and all the people there could hear Jeremiahs answer.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima n-ku ba pam; dindali maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ka bɛ daa ku.
en: Davids army defeated the Israelites. It was a great defeat because , men were killed that day.

dag: Di luhiya ni bɛ ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeen shɛli din ka nyɔri bee m-mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ku niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: Do you think a wise man would use empty words and meaningless speeches to win his arguments?.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka a chɛ ka saa bi lan mira, di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ti niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu ka ŋmaligi kpa kpe na m-bol a yuli ka suh a zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tibidarigibo maa polo.
en: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they stop sinning and turn toward this temple to pray in your name.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, Di yi nyɛla lala, hal n ni mali soli ni n da tiŋgbani maa la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ di dabu, dama di wuhiya ni mmaŋmaŋ bihi ti ku di li fali. Nyin dam li, man ku da li.
en: The man answered, If that's the case, I don't want to buy it! That would make problems with the property I already own. You may buy it yourself, because I cannot.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni bari ma tɔn shɛli gbaai ma, a mi di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba ni bari ma zana shɛli gbaai ma.
en: Protect me from the traps they have set for me, from the snares of those evildoers.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli niriba maa, Miligimiya ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ suɣa shee, ka di shihiya bɛ binshɛɣu, di yi pa lala bɛ daalahichi maa zaa ni ʒin ya chaŋ.
en: He spoke to the community: Move away from the tents of these wicked men and dont touch anything of theirs, lest you too be wiped out for all their sins.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili m-pali n ni, ka n ku lan tooi gbib li yaha. Kpaam li bahi bihi zuɣu sol ni, ka lan kpaai li bahi nachimba laɣiŋgu shee gba. Bɛ ni ti gbaai doo min o paɣa chaŋ, ka gbahi ninkura mini bɛn kurigi zaa chaŋ.
en: But I am full of the Lord s anger, and I am tired of holding it in! Pour out my anger on the children playing in the streets and on the young soldiers gathered there as well. A man and his wife will both be captured as well as all the old people.

dag: O zaŋ bin suma dihi ma n ni yɛn be saha shɛli puuni, ka di chɛ ka m bipolitali kpiɔŋ labina kaman tɔrili kpiɔŋ la.
en: He fills my life with good things, so that I stay young and strong like an eagle.

dag: Zomiya tiligi yi nyɛviya. Zomiya kaman mɔɣu ni buŋa m-be tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Quick, run for your lives! they say. Run like a wild desert donkey.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Pumpɔŋɔ Shiiba Bikiri bia ŋɔ ni niŋ ti barina pam n-gari Absalom ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la, dinzuɣu zaŋm a dan tɔbbihi ŋɔ m-biɛh o naba, di yi pa lala o ni ti kpe tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ ni me goondahi gili ni, ka muɣisi ti.
en: So the king said to Abishai, Sheba will give us more trouble than Absalom. Take my men and go after him, or else he may occupy some fortified towns and escape from us.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ ni o nyaandoliba maa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛtɔɣili maa zuɣu ka bɔhi ba, Yi suhuri miligimi yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew that the disciples were grumbling about this and he said to them, Does this offend you?.

dag: Bɛ daa yihila tinsi pinaayi Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba kaman bɛ daŋ maa niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Merarites received by lot according to their clans twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ti ni ti yihim waazu ti niriba, ka wuhi ba ni ŋuna ka Naawuni zaŋ leei nyɛvilinim mini kpiimba zaa sariakarita.
en: And he commanded us to preach the gospel to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God has appointed judge of the living and the dead.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. O daa nyɛla Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of the Jeremiah who lived in the city of Libnah.

dag: Amaa ka o yi bi bɔr ni o yo puu maa zuɣu ka dee li bee o yi pun zaŋla puu maa kɔhi so zuɣu, o ku lan tooi yo di zuɣu ka dee li yaha.
en: But if they do not buy it back or if it was sold to someone else, it is no longer able to be bought back.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ yɛda la polo, ti pun sab gbaŋ n-yɛli ba ni ti ni tɛhi shɛm nyɛla ni bɛ di diri buɣa maligu nimdi mini binʒim ni jifa, ka mi di niŋdi zina.
en: As for the Gentile believers, we wrote a letter about what we decided, that they avoid food offered to idols, blood, the meat from strangled animals, and sexual immorality.

dag: N daa zaɣis a la saha biɛla puuni, amaa n nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam puuni, n ni lan zaŋ a labisi n sanna.
en: For one brief moment I left you; with deep love I will take you back.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anahi.
en: Evening passed and morning came—that was the fourth day.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu maa paag a, gbilisim tibili wum n kuhigu shɛli n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: Please pay attention to my prayers. Listen to my prayers for mercy.

dag: Lala ka a yɛn niŋ woligi Lɛvinim maa Izraɛlnim ni, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: You will separate the Levites from the Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.

dag: Ka o Yɛhudia paɣ la mi daa dɔɣi Jarɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛdɔr ba la mini Hɛbɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Soko ba la ni Jɛkutiɛl ŋun mi daa nyɛ Zanɔa ba la.
en: His Judean wife gave birth to Jered, Gedors father; Heber, Socos father; and Jekuthiel, Zanoahs father. This is the family of Bithiah, Pharaohs daughter, whom Mered married.

dag: Yinim bɛn no n-taai nandaamba, ka nahindi tiŋgbani ŋɔ tarimba ŋɔ, wummiya.
en: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi tiligi o kandina dabisili maa dali? Ka o yi ti yi palo, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? Dama o ni ŋmanila saviɣu ni buɣim, ka ŋmani chibo din paɣiri yiri zaa.
en: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa min o ba malibu maa zaa, N ni chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, M ba min o malibu ni m biɛyanim bɛn be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kuli n sanna.
en: Joseph said to his brothers and to the rest of his fathers family, I will go and tell Pharaoh that you are here. I will say to Pharaoh, My brothers and the rest of my fathers family have left the land of Canaan and have come here to me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku a bihi. Alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo ni lu a zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu a zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will send famine and wild animals against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will come to you, and I will bring the sword against you. I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ daa baŋ li ka yiɣisi ni n-zo n-chaŋ Listra mini Dɛɛbi din be Laikɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tiŋkpansi din daa gil li zaa.
en: When they learned of it, these two messengers fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and the surrounding area.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli Ilaija, Pumpɔŋɔ n yipa baŋya ni a nyɛla Naawuni nira, ka Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli a ni mali tɔɣisiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: She answered, Now I know that you are a man of God and that the Lord really speaks through you.

dag: Ka yili maa ni paɣa daa zaŋ bini pa kɔbiliga maa noli n-yɛrigi chi diɛli di zuɣu, ka so daa bi baŋ ni shɛli be nimaani.
en: The man's wife put the cover on the well and poured grain on top of it, so the well could not be seen.

dag: Di saha nir yi ti tooi mali naɣisa yino mini piɛr ayi.
en: On that day, one will raise a young cow and two sheep.

dag: Ka zoya ti nyɛligi do o naba ni ka vinvama tahi bɔɣi kaman shigbaŋ m-miri buɣim la, bee kaman kom din kpaai bahi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ sirigili la.
en: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, a daa wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm yih a niriba Ijipti na, ka bɛ na kul teer a yiko tuma maa yɛla. Ti tum alahichi ka tum din bi tuhi.
en: Lord our God, you used your power and brought us out of Egypt. We are your people. You are famous because of that, even today. We have sinned and done terrible things.

dag: Ka dansarika gula maa daa yɛli Pool ni sariakaritib maa tim na ti yɛl o ni o yoom ba bahi ka bɛ chaŋ; dinzuɣu ni bɛ yim n-chaŋ ni suhuʒia.
en: The jailer told Paul, The officials have ordered me to set you free. Now you can leave in peace.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni.
en: The person in charge of the synagogue was also there. His name was Jairus, and when he saw Jesus, he went over to him. He knelt at Jesus' feet.

dag: Ka kurim n-zaŋ o nubila n-lan sabiri tiŋa.
en: Then he bent over again and wrote on the ground.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Sirianim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la nim sani nti zaŋ ba na, Ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la ti leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: As soon as the Syrians realized they had been defeated, they sent for their troops that were stationed on the other side of the Euphrates River. Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, led these troops to Ammon.

dag: Dindali maa mi yi ti ku bɔhi binshɛli yɛla n sani. Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: In that day, you wont ask me anything. I assure you that the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sool daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim mini suhudoo sara maligu pina la ti ma na.
en: Finally, Saul commanded, Bring me some animals, so we can offer sacrifices to please the Lord and ask for his help. Saul killed one of the animals.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri din nyɛ salima bee anzinfa, hal di zaŋya kɔbo gba n-niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: Do not carry any gold, silver, or copper money in your pockets;.

dag: Bɛn diri zalinsi nyɛla bɛn bɔri yɛla tiri bɛ yiŋnima, amaa bɛn je birapu dibu ni be.
en: Whoever takes money to do wrong invites disaster. Refuse such gifts, and you will live.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛn mali yɛm di nyuri bara bɛ yɛm zuɣu, ka bɛn mali yaa di nyuri bara bɛ yaa zuɣu. Ka bɛn gba mali buni di nyuri bara bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: The Lord says: Don't brag about your wisdom or strength or wealth.

dag: Ka so mi bi nyɔri firila n-zaŋdi lɔɣu pindi li, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni di ne sokam zaa yili maa ni.
en: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.

dag: Naftali ŋmanila walinyaŋ so ŋun gɔr o yubu, ka dɔɣi bi viɛla.
en: Naphtali is a deer that runs free, Who bears lovely fawns.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kana ti zani sansani maa dunɔdali ni ka yɛli, Ŋunkam be Yawɛ polo, ŋun kam n sanna. Ka Lɛvi bidibisi zaa daa laɣimna ti zani gil o.
en: So Moses stood at the camps gate and said, Whoever is on the LORDs side, come to me! All the Levites gathered around him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ibram daa vuɣ o tanti suɣili n-chaŋ ti kpa Mamri oki ti shɛŋa din be Hiburɔn la gbini; ka daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ.
en: So Abram packed his tent and went and settled by the oaks of Mamre in Hebron. There he built an altar to the LORD.

dag: Amaa ŋun pa piɛgula ka mi bi su piɛri ka nyɛla bɛ ni bu so paa ka o guli ba yi ti nya kunduŋ ka o kanna, o chɛrila piɛri maa bahi ka zo, ka kunduŋ maa gbahi piɛri maa ni shɛba, ka wurim bɛn kpalim bahi.
en: When the hired man, who is not a shepherd and does not own the sheep, sees a wolf coming, he leaves the sheep and runs away; so the wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka bi lan niŋ o tiliginsim yiko naani la zuɣu.
en: because they did not trust in him. They did not believe that God could save them.

dag: Bɛ daa me li tamla bimbin kurili la tanzaa zuɣu, hal bɛ ni daa kul zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab dabiɛm la zaa yoli. Ka bɛ daa maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu tiri Yawɛ asiba ni zaawuni.
en: Even though the returning exiles were afraid of the people who were living in the land, they rebuilt the altar where it had stood before. Then they began once again to burn on it the regular morning and evening sacrifices.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ so ni ti di nam, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be Iri.
en: Someone from Jacob will rule and destroy the survivors from Ir.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋmɛnditoya liri ba libigi ba, ka chɛ ka kunsi mɔni bɛ yinsi, dama bɛ gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ni n lu di ni, ka bari zana ni bɛ gbaai ma.
en: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord . Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.

dag: Yawɛ n-su zuɣusaa ha, amaa ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ ti ninsalinima.
en: Heaven belongs to the Lord , but he gave the earth to people.

dag: Ka Naawuni bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a bela a zaɣim? A dila ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la.
en: God said to the man, Who told you that you were naked? Did you eat fruit from that special tree? I told you not to eat from that tree.

dag: Nyin ka n kul zaŋ mmaŋ dalim n dɔɣibu saha hal ni wayo, nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma puli ni na. N kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: I depended on you even before I was born. I relied on you even in my mothers womb. I have always prayed to you.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, hal yi yi ti kurigi m-paligi gba, n ni gbib ya. Mani n-nam ya, ka ni gbib ya. N ni sɔŋ ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: until you grow old. I am the one, and until you turn gray I will support you. I have done it, and I will continue to bear it; I will support and I will rescue.

dag: Yawɛ ni yiɣisi tuhi kaman o ni daa niŋ shɛm Pɛrazim Zoli zuɣu mini Gibiɔn vinvamli ni la din ni chɛ ka o tum o ni lo ni o tum shɛm. O ni yɛn tum shɛli maa yi kul nyɛ yɛl saani kabo, o ni bahi tum o tuma din nyɛ alahiziba tuma maa naai.
en: Just as on Mount Perazim, the LORD will rise up; as in the Gibeon Valley he will rage to do his deed—strange is his deed!— And to work his work—foreign is his work!.

dag: Ti Naawuni a ku darigi bɛ tibili ti ti? Dama ti ka yiko din ni tooi tuhi salo pam bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi ti ŋɔ. Ti bi mi ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, amaa nyini ka ti kul lihira.
en: Our God, punish those people. We dont have the strength to stop this large army that is coming against us. We dont know what to do! We are looking to you for help.

dag: Zuliya kam wummi dimbɔŋɔ! Salinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!.

dag: O bia Yisahaku maa daba anii dali ka ŋun Ibrahimma daa gun o kaman Naawuni ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: and when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God had commanded.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi liɣiri chaŋ. N suhu n-yu ni n yo yi mini bɛn yoli kana maa zaa yim.
en: Take what belongs to you and go. I want to give to this one who was hired last the same as I give to you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalibarika min o yiko daa pali Stiivin ka o tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira pam niriba maa ni.
en: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa binʒim shɛli n-vie Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔpaɣira mini sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila bunahi zuɣu ni dundombila dunɔdali dunɔpaɣira la.
en: The priest will take some of the blood from the purification offering, and he will set it on the doorposts of the temple and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar and on the doorposts of the gate to the inner courtyard.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naaman kɔŋ maa ni lu a min a bihi zuɣu n-kul maliya sahakam! Ka Gɛhaazi daa ŋmalig o sani n-yi ni kɔŋa; ka o niŋgbuna dii paligi laɣilaɣi kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: Because of what you've done, Naaman's leprosy will now be on you and your descendants forever! Suddenly, Gehazi's skin became white with leprosy, and he left.

dag: Ka minya ni yi ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, dama yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Masia la zuɣu ka yi tumdi lala maa.
en: Remember that you will receive your reward from the Lord, who will give you what he promised his people. Yes, you are serving Christ. He is your real Master.

dag: ka o shih o nuu, ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ o saani.
en: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.

dag: Ka wuntia tuma maa tahi suhudoo mini biɛri baalimtali ni naani niŋbu na sahakam.
en: Because everyone will do what is right, there will be peace and security forever.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Bɛ gba ni ti dol li chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa nti pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku zuliya shɛba mini bɛ zɔnim la ni zuliya shɛb bɛn daa ʒi di mahim la zuɣu.
en: His allies, those among the nations who lived under his shade, these also went down with him to the underworld, to those who are slain by the sword.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa kul zaŋ di yɛla kaɣili Samsin biɛɣukam, ka kul mal li dol o hal ka o nyee ti nyɔni pam di zuɣu.
en: She kept on asking him, day after day. He got so sick and tired of her bothering him about it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya Yisifu ka o be katiŋ ha kanna, o daa ti yɛn paai bɛ sani, ka bɛ pun lo nia wuhi ni bɛ kum o.
en: They saw Joseph in the distance before he got close to them, and they plotted to kill him.

dag: Naawuni vuhim n-tahiri maasim na, nti chɛ ka ko titaŋa kilim.
en: By Gods breath ice forms; waters expanse becomes solid.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chani gindi tiŋkpan shɛŋa din be Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Jesus and his followers went to the towns in the area of Caesarea Philippi. While they were traveling, Jesus asked the followers, Who do people say I am.

dag: ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim guli Sur Dunɔdal la, ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim be dunɔdali din be guliba nyaaŋa la zaa n-guli nayili.
en: Another unit will guard Sur Gate, and the third unit will guard the palace gate and relieve the palace guards.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm, sɔɣirila o milinsi, amaa jɛra bɛn kul moonila bɛ jɛrilim.
en: Smart people dont tell everything they know, but fools tell everything and show they are fools.

dag: Amaa o yiko pam maa puuni, o nam maa ni ti wurim m-pirigi ʒii bunahi. Ka nanim bɛn bi yi o zuliya ni na ni ti deeg o nam maa di n-zan o zaani, amaa ka bɛ lee ti ku mali yiko shɛli o ni daa mali maa tatabo.
en: Just as he comes to power, his kingdom will be broken up and scattered in all directions. It will not be divided among his descendants. And it will not be ruled in the same way because that kingdom will be pulled up and given to other people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa zaŋ ŋariŋ shɛl o ni daa pun kpe n-ʒiya la duri duli. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛŋa ni dol o dura.
en: So they left the crowd, and his disciples started across the lake with him in the boat. Some other boats followed along.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zaɣa zaa niŋ o ni, dama o daa pun chɛ ka o bukpahitali maa tabibi tuma niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka di wɔɣa.
en: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli ninvuɣ shɛb sani mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika.
en: How wonderful to have such blessings! Yes, great blessings belong to those who have the Lord as their God.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli soli be katiŋa ka chɛ ti, ka din tuhi mi ku tooi miri ti. Yɛlimaŋli tuui niriba laɣiŋgu shee soli zuɣu, ka biɛhigu din tuhi kɔŋ kpɛhili shee nimaani.
en: We pushed Justice away. Fairness stands off in the distance. Truth has fallen in the streets. Goodness is not allowed in the city.

dag: Ka Naawuni sɔŋ Judanim gba n-ti ba naŋgbanyini ni bɛ niŋ naa min o kpambaliba ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm kaman Yawɛ yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: God was also at work in Judah and united the people in their determination to obey his will by following the commands of the king and his officials.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli ba, O ni daa na ne ka n lo noli ka kumd o zuɣu maa, n daa yɛlimi, Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni zo ma nambɔɣu ka chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: Yes, David answered, I did fast and weep while he was still alive. I thought that the Lord might be merciful to me and not let the child die.

dag: n-zaŋ di zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi maa gahigahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei nuhi gahibu sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Place all of these in the hands of Aaron and his sons, and lift them as an uplifted offering in the LORDs presence.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Vumiya miri Yawɛ, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o shɛm maa. .
en: Moses said to Aaron, Tell the whole community to come and stand before the Lord , because he has heard their complaints.

dag: Dinzuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuli n ya, amaa kamina ka n wuh a niriba ŋɔ ni ti yɛn niŋ a niriba shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: Now I am going back to my own people. But I will give you this warning. I will tell you what these Israelites will do to you and your people in the future.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni ti zaŋmi yɛda niŋbu maa saɣim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Ti lee ʒiɛla di nyaaŋa.
en: Does this mean that by this faith we do away with the Law? No, not at all; instead, we uphold the Law.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa laɣim tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara bahi, ka bo liɣiri ti siliga guliba maa.
en: So the chief priests met with the leaders and decided to bribe the soldiers with a lot of money.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka o ku lan tooi sɔɣ o yaha, ka o daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ kulikaɣa wuɣi piɛ shɛli n-zaŋ kootaali tanta li din ni chɛ ka kom ku tooi kpe di ni. Ka o daa zaŋ o bia maa niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti zali kaɣili ni mɔɣili duli.
en: When she couldnt hide him any longer, she took a reed basket and sealed it up with black tar. She put the child in the basket and set the basket among the reeds at the riverbank.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka m bi biɛhim ka ka yi sanna yomyom maa, dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma yi ni boli ma na shɛli zuɣu.
en: For this reason, when you sent for me, I came without objection. I want to know, then, why you sent for me.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd mini Gomna Pailɛt daa malila dimdi ni taba, amaa dindali maa zaŋ chana bɛ daa laɣila tab zɔri.
en: That same day Herod and Pilate became friends, even though they had been enemies before this.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa zaŋ niriba maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm ti ti naa. Izraɛl tiŋgban ni, dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii. Ka Juda tiŋgban ni mi nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: Joab reported to the king the number of the people who had been counted: in Israel there were eight hundred thousand strong men who could handle a sword; in Judah the total was five hundred thousand men.

dag: Naa ni daa nyo Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Baruk yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka o sabi li niŋ gban shɛli ni maa buɣim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: King Jehoiakim burned the scroll on which Baruch had written all the words that Jeremiah had spoken to him. Then this message from the Lord came to Jeremiah:.

dag: A daa ku m bihi nyo buɣim mali buɣa maa.
en: You slaughtered my children, so you could offer them as sacrifices.

dag: ni binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana binyɛra din be kasi ni o bidibisi ni yɛn yɛri binyɛr shɛŋa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma.
en: the woven clothing for ministering in the sanctuary, and the holy clothes for Aaron the priest and his sons for their service as priests.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labirila ŋun daa tim ma na maa sani, ka yi ni so mi bi bɔhi ma, Ya ka a chana.
en: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jɛdiayɛl daŋ ni niriba, ka daa nyɛ zuɣulaannima bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyi.
en: They were family leaders in their clan, which had , soldiers prepared to fight in battle.

dag: M puhiri Yuribanus ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpee Masia ni la mini Stachis n ni yuri so la.
