en: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.

dag: Izraɛl daa kul bela kasi Yawɛ sani. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o tiwala din daŋ moobu. Bɛnkam daa di li daa kpe taali ni, ka alɔbo daa lu bɛ zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The people of Israel were a holy gift to the Lord . They were the first fruit he gathered. Any people who tried to hurt them were judged guilty. Bad things happened to those wicked people. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Wuntizɔriba tiliginsim yirila Yawɛ sanna, ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani bɛ wahala saha.
en: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ lee niŋ ka yimaŋmaŋ bi baŋdi din tuhi?.
en: And why dont you judge for yourselves what is right?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni lan deei Juda n-su tiŋgbɔŋ kasi maa, ka lan pii Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: Once again Judah will be the special possession of the Lord in his sacred land, and Jerusalem will be the city he loves most of all.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ bɛ buɣa tooni, ka zaŋ yi kɔba yɛrigi gili yi maligu bimbina gbini.
en: Ill throw the Israelites corpses in front of their idols, and Ill scatter your bones all around your altars.

dag: Amaa nyamiya! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nyaannim ni ti leei toonnima, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ toonnim mi ti leei nyaannima.
en: Then those who are now last will be first, and those who are now first will be last.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Naawuni nam lee ŋmanila bɔ bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ li ŋmahindi?.
en: Jesus asked, What is Gods kingdom like? To what can I compare it?.

dag: Dandiɛɣu n-daa mali o bipuɣinsi ayi, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Tim ti, tim ti. Bina pam beni n-nyɛ din bi tiɣira. Di puuni diba anahi din kpɛm pam n-nyɛ:.
en: Greed has twins, each named Give me! There are three or four things that are never satisfied:.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa lo tab alikauli Bɛrishiiba. Di nyaaŋa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa lab kuli Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After they drew up a treaty at Beer-sheba, Abimelech, and Phicol commander of his forces, returned to the land of the Philistines.

dag: Ka ŋmalig o nyaandoliba maa polo yɛli ba ashilɔni, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nina nyari yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: Then Jesus turned to his followers. They were there alone with him. He said, It is a great blessing for you to see what you now see!.

dag: Yurilim mini ʒiɛyimtali n-nyɛ din gbibi naa, ka wuntitali mi nyɛ din chɛ ka o nam ʒiɛya.
en: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi wurim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbani ni la dina. Di zaa yoli, Asa daa kul ʒiɛla yim o biɛhigu ni zaa.
en: Even though Asa did not destroy all the pagan places of worship in the land, he remained faithful to the Lord all his life.

dag: Ka o daa lan me luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee, ka di wɔɣilim mini duu maa yɛliŋ nyɛ yim. Di daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ gba daa nyɛ mita awɛi. Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima alali, din tibisim gari mɛtiriki tɔn pisi n-dooi pa di zuɣu.
en: The inner room, called the Most Holy Place, was feet long and feet wide, which was the full width of the Temple. Twenty-five tons of gold were used to cover the walls of the Most Holy Place;.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din daa pahiri daba ayi maa dali, bɛ daa chaŋ gili tiŋ maa la napɔŋ yim ko, ka lan lab bɛ sansani maa ni yaha. Bɛ daa niŋ lala la daba ayɔbu.
en: They circled the city one time on the second day. Then they went back to the camp. They did this for six days.

dag: A niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni sahakam; a chɛ ka o mali suhupiɛlli din yi a sanna.
en: Your blessings are with him forever, and your presence fills him with joy.

dag: Ashidɔdnim ni daa nya di ni be shɛm maa ka bɛ yɛli, Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ku lan be ti sani, dama o darigi ti tibili n-tabili ti buɣili Dagɔn.
en: They saw what was happening and said, The Holy Box of the God of Israel cant stay here. God is punishing us and Dagon our god.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam, ka o binnamda zaa kul ni paɣir o sahakam.
en: I will praise the Lord ! Let everyone praise his holy name forever and ever!.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara maligu pam dindali maa, ka niriba maa suhuri paligi pam, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. Ka paɣiba mini bihi gba daa mali suhupiɛlli. Katiŋnim daa wum Jɛrusalɛmnim suhupiɛlli maa damli.
en: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ti ku ba, amaa bɛn ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, bɛn ni be. Bɛ ni ti leei bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba ka be.
en: that the Lord had said, If you stay here in Jerusalem, you will die in battle or from disease or hunger, and the Babylonian army will capture the city anyway. But if you surrender to the Babylonians, they will let you live.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Haman, To, zaŋm kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa yomyom chaŋ ti niŋ Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nira ka ʒi nayili dunol ni la lala. Niŋm o a ni kul wuhi shɛm maa zaa, ka di chɛ ka shɛli pooi.
en: Then the king said to Haman, Hurry, take the robe and the horse just as youve said and do exactly that for Mordecai the Jew, who works at the Kings Gate. Dont leave out a single thing youve said.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Lɛvi zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Isaka zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Simeon: , from the tribe of Levi: , from the tribe of Issachar: .

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino mi yi ni yɛn doli kasitali biɛhigu mini jilima soli shɛm n-kpuɣ omaŋmaŋ paɣa.
en: Each of you should know how to live with your wife in a holy and honorable way.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashee kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Everyone tries to gain the favor of important people; everyone claims the friendship of those who give out favors.

dag: Ka o lan yɛl o tumo maa, Yim doli pala mini puri soya n-dari niriba pahi na hal ka n yil ŋɔ ti pali niriba.
en: The master said to the servant, Go to the highways and back alleys and urge people to come in so that my house will be filled.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma min o kurigu gbaɣino yɛli Dauda, ka zaŋ kurigu zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: He gave his own armor to David for him to wear: a bronze helmet, which he put on David's head, and a coat of armor.

dag: Binzahi maa zaɣ yini kam daa malila bintaɣiris anahi di yaɣa anahi maa zaa. Bintaɣirisi maa mini binzahi maa zaa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: There were four supports at the bottom corners of each cart, which were of one piece with the cart.

dag: Naa Sool ni daa kul mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa naai, di daa bi yuui ka Samuɛl paai na. Ka Naa Sool daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli puh o.
en: As soon as Saul finished offering that sacrifice, Samuel arrived. Saul went out to meet him.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pa nyini n-yɛn me yili ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka fɔŋ ni vuri ni, so mi bi mali ba tumdi tuma ka bɛ wumd o tahigu.
en: They keep far away from the noisy cities, and no one can tame them and make them work.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Zin mɔɣu ni m-baɣisi Ɛdom tintariga chaŋ, ka yi tintariga piligu shee yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ wulimpuhili polo.
en: On the south, you will get part of the desert of Zin near Edom. Your southern border will start at the south end of the Dead Sea.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni kariti ninvuɣ biɛri saria shɛm m-pal a kɔbili ni, ka saria karibu mini yɛlimaŋli gbaag a.
en: But now you are being punished as you deserve.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛhab bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anu saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la daa di nam.
en: In the fifth year of Israels King Joram, Ahabs son, Jehoram, the son of Judahs King Jehoshaphat, became king.

dag: Lala zuɣu Masia ŋun daa zaŋ omaŋ mali sara yim ni o kpihim niriba pam daalahichi la ni lan labina pahi buyi, ka di pala alahichi zuɣu, amaa o yɛn labina ti tiligila bɛn suhuri kul ye o labbuna zuɣu ka guhir o la.
en: In the same manner Christ also was offered in sacrifice once to take away the sins of many. He will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are waiting for him.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ yi kpee ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nira, yin miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri, di yi nyɛ liɣiri nyɔri bee bindira nyɔri bee yi ni kul zaŋ binshɛlikam paŋ o nyɔri.
en: Dont charge your fellow Israelites interest—whether on money, provisions, or anything one might loan.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri Yawɛ jilima mal alibarika. Ŋun yu o zaligunim mali alibarika.
en: Praise the Lord ! Great blessings belong to those who fear and respect the Lord , who are happy to do what he commands.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir maa sanna yuŋ zahindi ni ti yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu.
en: In a dream that night God came to Laban and said to him, Be careful not to threaten Jacob in any way.

dag: ka m min o laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini. M bi lan mali mmaŋmaŋ wuntia, hal m bi lan mali wuntia din yi zaligunim dolibu ni na gba. Wunti shɛli n ni yipa mali pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ nyɛla din yi Masia yɛda niŋbu ni na. Di nyɛla wuntia din yi Naawuni sanna yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: I want to belong to him. In Christ I am right with God, but my being right does not come from following the law. It comes from God through faith. God uses my faith in Christ to make me right with him.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni daadamnim ni ti bɔri kum ka ku nya; bɛ ni ti bɔri ni bɛ kpi, ka kum zo ka chɛ ba.
en: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiya n dan naa ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla pali, mmaŋmaŋ zaŋ tabili n ni mali shɛlikam nyɛla o dini.
en: The king of Israel answered, Yes, my lord and king, I am yours now, and everything I have belongs to you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka di gari ya; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa Nazarɛt do so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la. O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni; nyamiya bɛ ni daa sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: Don't be alarmed, he said. I know you are looking for Jesus of Nazareth, who was crucified. He is not here—he has been raised! Look, here is the place where he was placed.

dag: Nachimbili ni kpuɣiri paɣipiɛliga shɛm la, lala ka bɛn me a zali yɛn kpuɣ a. Aŋgo suhu ni piɛl o daamiliya zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a Naawuni suhu yɛn piɛl a zuɣu.
en: Like a young man taking a virgin as his bride, He who formed you will marry you. As a groom is delighted with his bride, So your God will delight in you.

dag: Dinzuɣu mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini kunduna ni taatahi n-ni ti be Babilɔn. Niriba ti ku lan be di ni yaha, ka so mi ku lan ʒini di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: And so Babylon will be haunted by demons and evil spirits, and by unclean birds. Never again will people live there, not for all time to come.

dag: Chira ayɔbu zaa ka o daa zaŋ wuh o niriba maa azichi din be o nam puuni mini di jilima ni di dariza ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: For days he showed off his wealth and spent a lot of money to impress his guests with the greatness of his kingdom.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛnkam yɛn tuhi, ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka yi dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛn ya.
en: My terrifying reputation will precede you, and Ill throw all the people that you meet into a panic. Ill make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ ninsalinim yɛm mini yɛtɔɣ yoya din yi ninsalinim kaya yɛla ni na, ka pa Masia din la yɔhim ya n-zaŋ ya leei alizinnim bɛn su dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda fukumsi la daba.
en: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.

dag: ni Ibihar ni Ɛlishua ni Ɛlipɛlɛt.
en: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa n ni daa lihi ni di mali nyɔri la, n yipa lihi li ka di nyɛla yoli n sani Masia zuɣu.
en: At one time all these things were important to me. But because of Christ, I decided that they are worth nothing.

dag: N kuhiri boonila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ma binshɛlikam din simdi ma.
en: I pray to God Most High for help, and he takes care of me completely!.

dag: O bɔɣiri nyɛla salima, ka yɛri din viɛli dolibi pir o bɔɣiri maa. O niŋgbuna nyɛlisirimi kaman wɔbinyina mini safaya kuɣa la.
en: His arms are gold cylinders studded with jewels. His belly is smooth ivory encrusted with sapphires.

dag: Paɣ bee doo yi leei jinwara bee bukpaha bɛn kum o. Bɛn labimi ba kuɣa. Bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: Any man or woman who consults the spirits of the dead shall be stoned to death; any of you that do this are responsible for your own death.

dag: Ŋunkam mi deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani.
en: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me.

dag: Ka o ma yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn yɛl a no shɛli maa doli ma, nyin dee doli n ni wuh a shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti gbahi bubihi pola maa ti ma na.
en: Rebekah insisted, Let his curse fall on me! Just do what I say and bring me the meat.

dag: Dama molo yi Dan tiŋgbani polo na n-yɛra ni alɔbo yi Ifriim tiŋgbani zoli polo na.
en: Messengers from the city of Dan and from the hills of Ephraim announce the bad news.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya shɛli din niriba be ŋ-ŋɔ biɛri?.
en: But I, the Lord , will punish them for these things; I will take revenge on this nation.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ niriba maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ suhuri yula yɔɣu kpɛbu, ka bɛ ku tooi gbaai bɛmaŋa, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ bi deei ba. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: This is what the LORD proclaims about this people: Since they have loved to wander off and havent restrained themselves, I wont accept them. Now I will recall their wrongdoing and punish their sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaanu mini chi kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pihinu yo o zuɣu.
en: So I bought Gomer back for ounces of silver and bushels of barley.

dag: Tarim ŋɔ daa kuhiya, ka Yawɛ wum, ka yih o o muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: The helpless call to him, and he answers; he saves them from all their troubles.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tim ti boli Yisahaku na ti bɔh o, O nyɛla a paɣa; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa? Ka Yisahaku garigi yɛl o, N tɛhimi ni n yi yɛli ni m paɣa m-bala, bɛ ni ku ma o zuɣu.
en: Abimelech sent for Isaac and said, So she is your wife! Why did you say she was your sister? He answered, I thought I would be killed if I said she was my wife.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna Pailɛt yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: At every Passover Festival Pilate was in the habit of setting free any one prisoner the people asked for.

dag: Di saha ka dabipaɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi daa kana ti gban o tiŋa.
en: Then the two servant women and their children came and bowed down to Esau.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi gɔriti dama atam kpuɣibu saha paaya. Kamiyana ti siɣi no, dama wain bɔɣili paliya. Wain ni tɔɣiri niŋdi binshɛŋa ni maa palimi hal ti puuri bahira; dama bɛ tuumbiɛri galisiya pam.
en: Cut with the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Go and crush grapes, for the winepress is full. The jars overflow with wine, for their wickedness is great.

dag: Ka kokpɛɣu din galisi pam maa daa kul kpɛri pahiri hal ti paai biɛɣu pihinahi, ka kom maa kul zoori pahira, ka kpuɣi ŋariŋ maa zuɣusaa, ka di du ka chɛ tiŋgbani.
en: For days the rain poured down without stopping. And the water became deeper and deeper, until the boat started floating high above the ground.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yiɣisi doli Giliad kpamba maa kuli, ka Giliadnim ti zaŋ o leei bɛ zuɣulana ni bɛ sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɛfita daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛm zaa Yawɛ sani Mizipa.
en: So Jephthah went with Gileads elders, and the people made him leader and commander over them. At Mizpah before the LORD, Jephthah repeated everything he had said.

dag: Yu suŋ so tulaale viɛlli, ka kum dali so dɔɣibu dali.
en: A good reputation is better than expensive perfume; and the day you die is better than the day you are born.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo, yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim ka yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka a sabi yɛli gbaŋ maa puuni ni Babilɔn naa shiri ni kana ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri di ni? .
en: Then say to Judahs King Jehoiakim: The LORD proclaims: You burned that scroll because it declared that the king of Babylon will come and destroy this land and eliminate every sign of life from it.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-zaŋdi kom duri zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka di leeri sakom.
en: It is God who takes water from the earth and turns it into drops of rain.

dag: Ka nambɔɣu daa gbaai Yisa, ka o teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛl o, N saɣiya; di naama.
en: Incensed, Jesus reached out his hand, touched him, and said, I do want to. Be clean.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni yubu n-su yi dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu, ka pa ni daadamtali kɔr biɛri.
en: As a result, they dont live the rest of their human lives in ways determined by human desires but in ways determined by Gods will.

dag: ka ŋunkam kpuɣi bɛ zaɣ kpima, ŋun paɣim o situra ka kul be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani.
en: Anyone who carries one of their dead bodies must wash their clothes and will be unclean until evening; these animals are unclean for you.

dag: Yawɛ, yihim ma ʒirinim mini bɛn yɔhindi niriba nuu ni.
en: I said, Lord , save me from liars, from those who say things that are not true.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a mali yɛm, ka baŋsim yɛtɔɣa be a noli ni.
en: Then you will know how to behave properly, and your words will show that you have knowledge.

dag: Di ni sab zani so zuɣu ni o niŋ dabili ni bahi leei dabili; ka ŋunkam mali takɔbi kur o taba, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku o gba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mal ania ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Whoever is meant to be captured will surely be captured; whoever is meant to be killed by the sword will surely be killed by the sword. This calls for endurance and faith on the part of God's people.

dag: Di zaa yoli, n kul bela a sani sahakam, ka a gbibi n nudirigu.
en: But I was still always with you! You held my strong hand!.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun shihi lala bini maa ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ku di binyɛr kasinim la, faashee o su kom.
en: the person who touches these things will be unclean until evening. He must not eat of the holy things unless he has bathed his body in water.

dag: Bɛ kali ma pahila kpiimba ni; n ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka sɔŋsim.
en: I am like all others who are about to die; all my strength is gone.

dag: Amaa ka Ziɔnnim yɛli, Yawɛ chɛ ti bahi! O tam ti yɛla.
en: But now Zion says, The Lord has left me; the Lord has forgotten me.

dag: M mabiyurisi, n ni sabiri gban shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ pahirila diba ayi. Gbana maa zaa puuni, n loya ni n neela yi nimmoo tɛha la n-teei ya yɛla ŋɔ.
en: My dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both letters to stir up your sincere understanding with a reminder.

dag: Leeban daa lan yɛli, A yi nahim m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ bee a yi kpuɣi paɣiba pahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n ʒi di yɛla, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n nyɛ m min a shɛhiralana.
en: Then Laban said: If you mistreat my daughters or marry other women, I may not know about it, but remember, God is watching us!.

dag: Azɛl daa malila bidibis ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hanan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Azɛl bidibisi.
en: Azel had six sons. Their names were Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these sons were Azels children.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses. He said.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Sirianim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la nim sani nti zaŋ ba na, Ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la ti leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: The Arameans saw that they had been defeated by Israel. They sent out messengers to bring Aramean reinforcements from the other side of the river, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezers army at their head.

dag: Dama pagɔrili naŋgbampiba malisimi kaman shiri la, ka o yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari kpam.
en: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni me wuni bee n-kpe binnani zali ka di pa din mal o buchi?.
en: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?.

dag: dama di ŋmanila buɣim sala ka a zaŋ pa bɛ zuɣuri ni maa. Ka Yawɛ ni ti a di laara.
en: By doing this, you will heap burning coals on their heads, and the LORD will reward you.

dag: Yu suŋ so tulaale viɛlli, ka kum dali so dɔɣibu dali.
en: A good name is better than fine oil, and the day of death better than the birthday.

dag: Mani n-yɛli lala maa. Iin, mani m-bol o. Mani n-zaŋ o na, ka o mi ni di nasara o tuma ni.
en: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi mini bɛ sapashini ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba daa gbaai Yisa n-lo o mihi.
en: Then the company of soldiers, the commander, and the guards from the Jewish leaders took Jesus into custody. They bound him.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ di gula, ka yɔɣiri li kom sahakam. N kul gul li mi yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka so ku tooi niŋ li shɛli.
en: I, the LORD, am its guardian. Every moment I water it; night and day I guard it from attack.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bo naa ti ba. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Sokam labimi kul o ya.
en: Do what they want, the Lord answered. Give them a king. Samuel told the people to go back to their homes.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tinsi tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin di ti chɛnya binvuhirigu kam;.
en: But when you capture cities in the land that the Lord your God is giving you, kill everyone.

dag: O ni daa nya ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim pam gba kanna ni o ti baptaizi ba ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ Bia maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka ŋunkam mi bi deei Bia maa noli ku nya nyɛvili, amaa ka Naawuni suhu kul ni yiɣisiri bahir o zuɣu.
en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life; whoever disobeys the Son will not have life, but will remain under God's punishment.

dag: din galisi neei Masia kum ni n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo alizanda ni la nyɛla yim.
en: he used to raise Christ from death and put him at his right side in the heavenly places.

dag: Lee di taaya duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka di zɔriya tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba dabiɛm, ti ni nyaŋ ba. Binshɛli din guli ba vuuya ka chɛ ba; ka Yawɛ mi be ti sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: Do not rebel against the Lord and don't be afraid of the people who live there. We will conquer them easily. The Lord is with us and has defeated the gods who protected them; so don't be afraid.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛrɛz mini Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi ni Hur ni Shɔbal.
en: Judahs family: Perez, Hezron, Caleb, Hur, and Shobal.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, Ti ninkura mini ti bipola zaa ni ti bidibisi mini ti bipuɣinsi zaa zaŋ tabili ti biŋkɔbbaligu mini ti niɣi zaa. Dama ti yɛn chaŋmi ti puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Everyone, young and old, Moses answered. We will even take our sheep, goats, and cattle, because we want to hold a celebration in honor of the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa labi nti yɛli bɛ nyaandol tab la, amaa ka bɛ daa bi niŋ bɛ gba yɛda.
en: But when these disciples told what had happened, the others would not believe either.

dag: Amaa dindali maa, n ni woligi Goshɛn, n niriba ni be luɣ shɛli polo la, ka zɔhi maa ti ku be nimaani dina din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: But I will spare the region of Goshen, where my people live, so that there will be no flies there. I will do this so that you will know that I, the Lord , am at work in this land.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ti ni saɣi zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ya, ka ti gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi, ka kpalim be yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti mini ya leei ninvuɣ yinsi.
en: Then your families can marry into ours, and ours can marry into yours, and we can live together like one nation.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi nya nambɔzɔbo ka o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ya labisi ʒili yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Because I am merciful, I will make him have mercy on you and let you go back home. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa ŋme n-kpihim Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba dini. Di saha ka Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba maa daa yiɣisi naa sani yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti kali Izraɛlnim maa.
en: But the king made Joab and his officers obey his order; they left his presence and went out to count the people of Israel.

dag: Di simdi ka Aduna zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu ʒim niŋ di binyila maa zuɣu yim yuuni puuni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni. Di simdi ka o niŋdi lala yuuni kam din ni chɛ ka di yi daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla din be kasi zaa man Yawɛ sani.
en: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ yuli jilima din simd o, zaŋmiya pina ka o jɛmbu duu na!.
en: Give the Lord praise worthy of his glory! Come, bring your offerings into his courtyard.

dag: nti nya Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa, ka o naba tiŋli daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa safaya la mal li. Di daa kul nɛmi kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka zuɣusaa ne shɛm la.
en: On the mountain, these men saw the God of Israel. He was standing on something that looked like blue sapphires, as clear as the sky!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yɛli Kushi nir ŋun daa be o san la, Cham ti yɛli naa a nini ni nya shɛm. Ka Kush nir maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋ Jɔab tooni lu o sizuura ka ŋmaligi guui.
en: Then Joab said to a man from Ethiopia, Go, tell the king what you have seen. So the Ethiopian bowed to Joab and ran to tell David.

dag: Ka o gba daa fuɣ o situra zaa ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Samuɛl tooni, ka daa do o zaɣim dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Dindali maa ka bɔhigu ŋɔ daa piligi, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: He even took off all his clothes and fell into a prophetic frenzy in front of Samuel. He lay naked that whole day and night. Thats why people say, Is Saul also one of the prophets.

dag: Gooni maa ni daa me n-naai, ka m mali pununima n-kpɛhi di dunoya la zaa saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa pii dunɔguliba mini yiliyiiniba ni Lɛvinim n-ti ba bɛ tuma ni.
en: And now the wall had been rebuilt, the gates had all been put in place, and the Temple guards, the members of the sacred choir, and the other Levites had been assigned their work.

dag: Amaa di yi pa lala, buɣim din yim Abimilɛk ni na ti di yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnima; ka chɛ ka buɣim yi yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim gba ni na ti di Abimilɛk.
en: But if it was wrong to treat Gideon and his family the way you did, then I pray that Abimelech will destroy you with fire, and I pray that you will do the same to him.

dag: Ka n daa yiɣisi ni n yoog o ka o gari. N ni daa zaŋ n nuu gbaai bɛ ni gbaari binshɛli yoori dunoli ni n yooi, n nuhi daa puɣila mɛɛr zim, ka n nubihi daa tɔɣiri mɛɛr kom.
en: I rose; I went to open for my love, and my hands dripped myrrh, my fingers, liquid myrrh, over the handles of the lock.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka buɣim daa diri zoli maa, ka alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi la daa be n nuh ayi ni.
en: So I went down the mountain while it was blazing with fire. The two covenant tablets were in my two hands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Abinadab yiŋ din daa be zoli zuɣu la na nti tam naɣ tɔroko palli zuɣu; ka Yuza mini Ahio bɛn daa nyɛ Abinadab bidibisi la daa be tooni vɔri tɔroko palli maa;.
en: They loaded Gods chest on a new cart and carried it from Abinadabs house, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, Abinadabs sons, were driving the new cart.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Judanim tum alahichi n ninni. Bɛ zaŋ din chihiri kpe n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛl la ni n-ta li daɣiri.
en: The people of Judah have done an evil thing. They have placed their idols, which I hate, in my Temple and have defiled it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Piim Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ la n-zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu;.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Take Joshua, Nuns son, a man who has the spirit, and lay your hand on him.

dag: ka bɛ ti yihi tuuba niŋbu mini alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu ŋun Masia yul ni n-ti zuliya kam zaa, ka di piligu shee mi yɛn nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ nti kpa luɣilikam.
en: and a change of heart and life for the forgiveness of sins must be preached in his name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka salo maa daa nya Yisa ni chaŋ ti kpe Zakius yiŋ maa ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, O chaŋ ti kpe alahichilan la yiŋa.
en: Everyone who saw this grumbled, saying, He has gone to be the guest of a sinner.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ti Duuma tɛha bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ o saawaralana?.
en: Who has known the Lords mind? Or who has been his mentor? .

dag: n-yɛli, Man Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni bi mɔŋ ma a bigaŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni ŋmaligi po mmaŋa.
en: The angel said, You were ready to kill your only son for me. Since you did this for me, I make you this promise: I, the Lord , promise that.

dag: Ka bɛ daa biligi kuɣili maa bahi. Ka Yisa duh o zuɣu zuɣusaa ka yɛli, M Ba, m paɣir a a ni deeri n suhigu zuɣu.
en: So they moved the stone away from the entrance. Then Jesus looked up and said, Father, I thank you that you heard me.

dag: Ka Musa daa siɣina, ka boli Izraɛl kpamba na nti yɛli ba Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o yɛli ba yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: So Moses climbed down the mountain and called the elders of the people together. Moses told the elders everything the Lord had commanded him to tell them.

dag: O ni ti wuhi zuliya kam shihirili ni o lan laɣindi Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa wurim be dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ ni la.
en: The Lord will raise a signal flag to show the nations that he is gathering together again the scattered people of Israel and Judah and bringing them back from the four corners of the earth.

dag: Di saha n suhu ni ti paligi Yawɛ zuɣu, ka m mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: Then I will rejoice in the Lord . I will be happy when he saves me.

dag: Ka o daa ti bɔhi Yawɛ n-nya o yɛla ti o, ka ti o bindirigu, ka lan zaŋ Goliat Filistia doo la takɔb la ti o.
en: Ahimelech asked the Lord what David should do, and then he gave David some food and the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

dag: Hal lari puuni suhugarigu beni, ka suhupiɛlli bahigu mi nyɛ suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Laughter might hide your sadness. But when the laughter is gone, the sadness remains.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm din ni tooi kali sagbana? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbiligi zuɣusaa kom kola.
en: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water.

dag: O daa kamina ti nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim. O daa nyo yil karili kam buɣim.
en: He burned down the LORDs temple, the royal palace, and all of Jerusalems houses. He burned down every important building.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa be o mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti maa sani n-yuui pam, ka daa naanyi ti chɛbisi ba ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria; ka Akuila mini Prisila gba daa dol o chaŋ. Ka Pool daa ti pin o zuɣu Sɛnkiria, dama o daa pola pɔri.
en: Paul stayed with the believers for many days. Then he left and sailed for Syria. Priscilla and Aquila were also with him. At Cenchrea Paul cut off his hair, because he had made a promise to God.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa po pɔri ni bɛ ni gbibi alikauli maa, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni daalikauli maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: He made the people of Benjamin and everyone else present in Jerusalem promise to keep the covenant. And so the people of Jerusalem obeyed the requirements of the covenant they had made with the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Yuun pihinahinaayɔbu ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duu ŋɔ, ka nyin ti yɛli ni a ni labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: They answered, People worked years to build this Temple! Do you really believe you can build it again in three days.

dag: Bɛ ni voo li to ba ka di pili yi bɛ niŋgbuna ni. Ka di naŋgban dirili maa pili yi bɛ binsom ni; ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: It will go through his body and stick out of his back. Its shining point will pierce his liver, and he will be shocked with terror.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ ba la nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam na. Zoomba mini gbariti ni paɣipuhinim ni paɣ shɛb bɛn wolisiri ni bɛ dɔɣi zaa ni ti be bɛ ni. Bɛ ni ti galisi pam labi kpe na.
en: Im going to bring them back from the north; I will gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the disabled, expectant mothers and those in labor; a great throng will return here.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi bɛn guli naa sapashin kpɛm la daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulana Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: From the Temple, Nebuzaradan took Seraiah the high priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three men who guarded the entrance.

dag: A ni me goonda shɛŋa gil a tinsi zaa ŋmanila fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi. Bɛ yi kul gbaɣiri li, di lurila ŋun yɛn di li nol ni.
en: But Nineveh, all your strong places will be like fig trees. When new figs become ripe, people come and shake the tree. The figs fall into their mouths. They eat them, and the figs are gone.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe m-pali dunia, ka ŋariŋ maa du m-pa di zuɣu.
en: The water became deeper, and the boat drifted on the surface.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, vi mali ma pam ni n kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa a tooni. Dama n Naawuni, ti daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi ti zuɣuri zuɣu; ka ti taali du hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.

dag: Ka o chɛ, ka chaŋ ŋun paya sani ti yɛl o kaman o ni yɛl o bikpɛm maa shɛm maa. Ka o saɣi yɛli, M ba, n ni chaŋ; amaa ka bi chaŋ.
en: The man then told his younger son to go work in the vineyard. The boy said he would, but he didn't go.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma NAAWUNI na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka bi kahigi li wuh o daba bɛn nyɛ o daanabinima.
en: Surely the LORD God does nothing without revealing his secret to his servants the prophets.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ ti ku nyɛ yi duɣu, ka yi mi ti ku nyɛ nimdi be di ni. N ni kari ya saria la Izraɛl tintariga.
en: This city will not protect you the way a pot protects the meat in it. I will punish you wherever you may be in the land of Israel.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ dimdi niŋ a mini paɣ sunsuuni ni a zuliya min o zuliya sunsuuni, ka paɣ zuliya maa ni ti ŋme m-bɔr a zuɣu, ka a mi zuliya ti dim o zuliya napɔŋkpaa.
en: I will make you and the woman enemies to each other. Your children and her children will be enemies. You will bite her childs foot, but he will crush your head.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, Karimba, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini.
en: Peter spoke up and said to Jesus, Teacher, how good it is that we are here! We will make three tents, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Absalom ti bahi bɔɣ zilinli ni mɔɣu maa ni, ka kahi kuɣa na ti pa o zuɣu, ka di du pam. Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa yinoyino daa zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: They took Absalom and threw him into a big pit in the forest. They piled over him a huge heap of stones. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la kɔŋ nasara, ka di vi! Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo la birim ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: May those who try to kill me be defeated and disgraced! May those who plot against me be turned back and confused!.

dag: Ka n yi tumdila mmaŋmaŋ ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina n saɣiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tuhiya.
en: Since what I do is what I don't want to do, this shows that I agree that the Law is right.

dag: Shɛb daa bela tiŋgban nɛl ni n-dari ginda, ka bi nya tiŋ ʒiina.
en: Some of the redeemed had wandered into the desert, into the wasteland. They couldnt find their way to a city or town.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya so sani fɔŋ ni ti yɛl o, Ti karimba n-tim ti na ni ti ti yɛl a ni o saha miriya; ka o bɔri ni o min o nyaandoliba puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ a yili ŋɔ. .
en: He replied, Go into the city, to a certain man, and say, The teacher says,My time is near. Im going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.

dag: Tinsi maa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ luɣ shɛŋa ti Lɛvinim maa yɛn zaŋla tinsi maa goma gbini n-chaŋ ti paai mita kɔbisinahi ni pihinu tariga n-gili tinsi maa.
en: How much of your land should you give to the Levites? From the walls of the cities, go out feet —all of that land will belong to the Levites.

dag: Bɛ gahindila bindira pu shɛŋa din pa bɛ dina ni, ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha ninvuɣ biɛɣu wain tihi puu ni.
en: They gather their food in the field, glean in unproductive vineyards.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Lord , do good to those who are good, to those who obey your commands.

dag: Yihimiya ansarisimaana yi kɔbili ni, ka zabili naai, ka naŋgbankpeeni mini turi chɛ.
en: Get rid of a conceited person, and then there will be no more arguments, quarreling, or name-calling.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba daa lan tuhi deei Gaza ni di tintarisi mini Ashikɛlɔn ni di tintarisi ni Ɛkurɔn ni di gba tintarisi.
en: Judah also captured Gaza, Ashkelon, Ekron, and all their territories.

dag: N yi daa niŋ salima yɛda bee n-niŋ salima din viɛla naani.
en: I have never trusted in riches. I never said even to pure gold, You are my hope.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa ka o labi alizanda ni nti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: After the Lord Jesus had said these things to the disciples, he was taken back up to heaven where he sat down at the right side of God.

dag: ni ŋun saɣisiri jɛra ni bihi karimba, ka di nyɛla a ni mi ni baŋsim mini yɛlimaŋli zaa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni zuɣu.
en: an educator of the foolish; a teacher of infants.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔana ni Jeemsi ma Mariama ni paɣ shɛb bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Yisa tuumba maa di yɛla maa.
en: These women were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary, the mother of James, and some others. They told the apostles everything that happened.

dag: Ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ kpe kuɣ viɛla zaɣ kara ni bɛ zaŋ li me duu maa tanzaa m-pahi kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali ka di viɛla.
en: At the kings command, they quarried huge stones of the finest quality in order to lay the temples foundation with carefully cut stone.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ m birini, ka n Naawuni nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri tampiŋ shɛli gbini.
en: But the LORD is my fortress; my God is my rock of refuge.

dag: Man kul ku lihi yaɣi bɛ so zuɣu bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ tuma maa ʒili ba.
en: I most definitely wont spare or pity anyone! I will hold them accountable for their ways.

dag: Ka shɛb yi mali naŋgbankpeeni, bɛ kanimina ka n ti woligiri li tiri ba, ka wuhiri ba Naawuni zaligunim min o wuhibu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: They bring their complaints to me, and I make decisions on the basis of God's laws.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka niriba pam bɛn daa ka chuɣu maa ni na wum ni Yisa kani Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la mali zuɣusuŋ gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be bɛ nyɛviya ni.
en: I envy those who are dead and gone; they are better off than those who are still alive.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa yɛli, Ŋun be tooni zɔrina maa ŋmanila Zadok bia Ahimaaz. Ka naa daa yɛli, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, dinzuɣu lahibali suŋ ka o ʒirina maa.
en: The soldier on the roof shouted, The first one runs just like Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. This time David said, He's a good man. He must have some good news.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ a bihi tibili darigibu. A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, bɛ ku kpi.
en: Always correct children when they need it. If you spank them, it will not kill them.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa ku maai, faashee o niŋla o ni lo o suhu ni ni o niŋ shɛli maa. Dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ka yi ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni.
en: The Lord will be angry until he is through punishing them. He will be angry until he finishes the punishment he planned. When that day comes, you people of Judah will understand.

dag: Ti ni niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika zuɣu ka ti tiligi shɛm, lala n-nyɛ bɛ gba.
en: No, we believe that we and these people will be saved the same way—by the grace of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Dindina n naan lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ; n naan filim bɛ dimnim maa zaa ti ba.
en: then I would defeat their enemies. I would punish those who cause them trouble.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Mmaŋmaŋ kpiɔŋ puuni ka n niŋ lala. M mali yɛm, ka mali baŋsim. N daai tiŋgbana tintarisi nahi taba, ka va bɛ nɛma. N niŋmi kaman naɣilaa la n-ʒe n-yiɣisi nanima bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi.
en: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.

dag: A viɛli pam, ka a viɛlim maa mali kɔre, n yura ŋun nyɛ paɣ viɛlli.
en: You are so beautiful and so pleasant, a lovely, delightful young woman!.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ni daa nya ka o tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni. Ka o bia Jɛhoyakin daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Everything else Jehoiakim did while he was king, including all the disgusting and evil things, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah . His son Jehoiachin then became king.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Shunɛm paɣ so bia o ni daa neei kum ni la, Yiɣisim zaŋ a yiŋnim zaa kuli luɣ shɛli a ni yɛn tooi kuli; dama Yawɛ ni chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Now Elisha had told the woman who lived in Shunem, whose son he had brought back to life, that the Lord was sending a famine on the land, which would last for seven years, and that she should leave with her family and go and live somewhere else.

dag: M mabiyurisi, yi yi nyari wahala din be kaman buɣim ka di paari ya ni di buɣisi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya kaman di nyɛla din na ʒi n-niŋ so n-niŋdi ya maa.
en: My friends, dont be surprised at the painful things that you are now suffering, which are testing your faith. Dont think that something strange is happening to you.

dag: O chɛ ka n dooni momaha ni. O zaŋdi ma tahiri kom din do baalim shee.
en: He gives me green pastures to lie in. He leads me by calm pools of water.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab yɛli so yɛla ni Naawuni yɛliya, N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: For John is the one of whom the scripture says: God said, I will send my messenger ahead of you to open the way for you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know that those foreigners who call themselves kings like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over the people they rule.

dag: Yi kul lɔrila nia biɛri sahakam, ka jiɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu; ka niŋdi yomyom chani ti kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Yi yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, yi saɣindimi bahi.
en: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.

dag: yi yi niŋdi lala, yi bi yaala so yuri ka chɛ so, ka lan leei bɛn doli tɛhi biɛri soli kariti saria?.
en: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli Pita, Labisim takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni! Ka bɔh o, N di nyu pipi shɛli m Ba ni zaŋ ti ma la ni binnyurigu maa.
en: Jesus said to Peter, Put your sword back in its place! Do you think that I will not drink the cup of suffering which my Father has given me.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, a kul yɛn dola nimaani hal ni saha dini? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn neei a gom ni?.
en: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?.

dag: Paɣimiya yi situra daba ayopɔin dali din ni chɛ ka yi be kasi. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi kpe sansani ŋɔ ni na.
en: You must wash your clothes on the seventh day and you will be clean. Afterward you may enter the camp.

dag: ka bɛ bɔh o, A wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa bebɔ? Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Iin. Amaa yi na bi karim din sabi Naawuni Kundi ni? Di sabiya: Bihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu ni yɛlimaŋli. .
en: They asked Jesus, Do you hear what these children are saying? He answered, Yes. The Scriptures say, You have taught children and babies to give praise. Have you not read that Scripture.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi Samuɛl, Banima n-daa lee yɛli ni Sool ku tooi niŋ ti naa la? Chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba na ka ti ku ba.
en: The Israelite soldiers went to Samuel and demanded, Where are the men who said they didn't want Saul to be king? Bring them to us, and we will put them to death.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa yɛli Amɔs, Anabi, zom kuli Juda tiŋgban ni nti tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka nyari diri nimaani.
en: Amaziah said to Amos, You who see things, go, run away to the land of Judah, eat your bread there, and prophesy there.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisiyi.
en: Their enrollment, according to the number of males over one month old, was .

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, bahigu maa ʒila a zuɣu, ka n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi a zuɣu. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni darig a tibili a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: as punishment for your disgusting sins. I, the Lord , am so angry.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni lo shɛm ni niŋ, ka n ni zali shɛm ni niŋ pali.
en: The Lord All-Powerful made this promise: This will happen exactly as I meant for it to happen. It will happen just the way I planned.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka Pita ni daa yi duu maa ni shɛm yɛla gari duguliba maa pam, ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri di zuɣu.
en: The next morning the soldiers who had been on guard were terribly worried and wondered what had happened to Peter.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ ninkura, wummiya; yinim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na min niŋ yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni bee yi yaannim ʒiɛmana la ni?.
en: Leaders, listen to this message! Listen to me, all you people who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your life? Did anything like this happen during your fathers lifetime?.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, yiɣisim zani a naba zuɣu ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: The voice said, Son of man, stand up and I will speak with you.

dag: Teemiy o ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni kari saria shɛŋa la.
en: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.

dag: Amaa niriba biɛla be yinim Saadisinim ni n-na bi gabisi bɛ binyɛra. M mini ba ni ye binyɛr piɛla n-laɣim dol taba, dama bɛ simdi lala.
en: But a few of you there in Sardis have kept your clothes clean. You will walk with me, clothed in white, because you are worthy to do so.

dag: a nyɛla ŋun saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tumdi tuun kara. A nyari ninsal kam biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tiri bɛ zaa laara kaman bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: marvelous are your purposes, and mighty are your deeds. You are aware of all the ways of humanity, and you reward us for how we live and what we do even now.

dag: Di doli wumdi niriba ni yɛri shɛlikam, di yi pa lala, a ni ti wum ka a tumtumda tur a.
en: Dont listen to everything people say. You might hear your own servant saying bad things about you.

dag: Ka yi yi bɔhi Ti yi bi biri bee ti yi bi kpuɣi puri atam yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, bɔ ka ti ti yɛn dira.
en: But someone may ask what there will be to eat during the seventh year, when no fields are planted and no crops gathered.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o ni su binshɛlikam zaa ti Yisahaku.
en: Before Abraham died, he gave some gifts to his sons who were from his slave women. He sent them to the East, away from Isaac. Then Abraham gave everything he owned to Isaac.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be kasi la ʒi n-gbaai chandi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa ti sa pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai ni.
en: The Kohathites, who carried the holy things, marched. The dwelling would be set up before their arrival.

dag: Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli: Zallakudura Naa yi di daa bi chɛ ti shɛba, ti naan kpi zaa kaman Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim la.
en: It is just as Isaiah said: The Lord All-Powerful allowed some of our people to live. If he had not done that, we would now be like Sodom, and we would be like Gomorrah. Isaiah :.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ daba, paɣimiy o; paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: Praise the Lord ! Servants of the Lord , praise him! Praise the Lord s name.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ni daa kul timd o daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna la zaa yoli, yi daa zaɣisiya ni yi ku gbilisi tibili wum.
en: In fact, the LORD has tirelessly sent you all his servants, the prophets, but you wouldnt listen or pay attention.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Wula ka yinim bɛn bi bɔri jilima Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani, amaa ka bɔri jilima la yi tab sani ŋɔ lee yɛn tooi niŋ yɛda?.
en: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!.

dag: A viɛlim zuɣu ni chɛ ka naa bɔr a. Ka o ni nyɛ a duuma la zuɣu, lum o sizuura.
en: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.

dag: Ka dɔro daa ti gbaag o ka o kpi, ka bɛ suug o kom n-zaŋ o kpɛhi jirambisa zuɣusaa duu ti sɔŋ.
en: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.

dag: Tiŋgbɔna ŋɔ buɣa zaa banim, na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔna bahi, ka Yawɛ ti fari Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahira? .
en: When did any of the gods of all these countries ever save their country from our emperor? Then what makes you think the Lord can save Jerusalem.

dag: N ni be Izraɛlnim sani kaman maligim la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom la. Bɛ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman nyoo la.
en: I will be to the people of Israel like rain in a dry land. They will blossom like flowers; they will be firmly rooted like the trees of Lebanon.

dag: M mabihi, chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu kul be kaman m biɛhigu. Ti pun wuhi ya biɛrisuŋ soli, dinzuɣu kpahimmiya nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol li.
en: Keep on imitating me, my friends. Pay attention to those who follow the right example that we have set for you.

dag: Daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi ti wum ka n yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, nyin zaŋmi saɣisigu din yi n sanna saɣisi ba.
en: Mortal man, he said, I am making you a lookout for the nation of Israel. You will pass on to them the warnings I give you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya nam ʒiishe titali din nyɛ zaɣ piɛlli ka lan nya ŋun ʒi nimaani, ka tiŋgbani mini sagbana daa laligi ka chɛ o, ka so bi lan nya li yaha.
en: Then I saw a great white throne and the one who is seated on it. Before his face both earth and heaven fled away, and no place was found for them.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din tibigiri zuliya, amaa alahichi nyɛla din dihiri niriba vi.
en: Righteousness makes a nation great; sin is a disgrace to any nation.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli.
en: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest.

dag: tiri Timoti ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima, o noli ni ka yɛm yɛtɔɣa yirina. Amaa ŋun ka yɛm yaaŋa deerila fiɛbiga.
en: Intelligent people speak words of wisdom, but fools must be punished before they learn their lesson.

dag: Malimiya yimaŋ ti Yawɛ. Yinim Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, gunimiya yi suhuri ni, di yi pa lala n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu kaman buɣim la n-diri ka so ku tooi kpihi li, yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Keep your covenant with me, your Lord , and dedicate yourselves to me, you people of Judah and Jerusalem. If you don't, my anger will burn like fire because of the evil things you have done. It will burn, and there will be no one to put it out.

dag: N ni labisi yi sariakaritiba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni, ka labisi yi saawarimaaniba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan boli tiŋ maa wuntitali mini ʒiɛyimtali tiŋa.
en: Then I will restore your judges as in earlier times, and your counselors as at the beginning. After this you will be called Righteous City, Faithful Town.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ti chaŋ maa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia daba anu dali ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yi Jɛrusalɛm zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli ma, Tiŋ maa luya.
en: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, a refugee who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me on the fifth day of the tenth month. He told me that the city had fallen.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o ni o niŋm shɛm maa. Ka ŋun Balak mini Balaam daa kɔrigi naɣila yino mini piɛla yino m-mali sara pa bimbin yini kam zuɣu.
en: Balak did as Balaam had said. Then Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: Wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: What does the scripture say? Abraham had faith in God, and it was credited to him as righteousness .

dag: Dama o ʒiɛla nandaamba nudirigu polo ni o tiligi ba bɛn yɛn wuhi ni bɛ simdi kum la nuu ni.
en: Because God stands right next to the needy, to save them from any who would condemn them.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa po pɔri ni bɛ ni gbibi alikauli maa, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni daalikauli maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then he made everyone found in Jerusalem and Benjamin join in a similar promise. The citizens of Jerusalem lived according to the covenant made with God, the God of their ancestors.

dag: Yi zuɣuri ni zaŋ ti siɣi yi naba ni zaa ka alaafee. Amaa dansi mini yuma din kabiri ʒim m-beni; di bi paɣi bee m-pɔbi, kpam mi bi niŋ bɔbili li ka di maha.
en: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain.

dag: O kul gbibila bɛ kɔba zaa, ka di zaɣ yini gba ku kabigi.
en: the Lord preserves them completely; not one of their bones is broken.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti gbani bɛ buɣa la tooni bee n-jɛm ba bee n-tum kaman bɛ ni tumdi shɛm, amaa ti daamiya bɛ buɣa maa zaa luhi, ka wurim bɛ ni me buɣa maa binwɔɣil shɛŋa zaa zali.
en: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.

dag: N ni zaŋ Raba leei laakuma mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka zaŋ Ammɔnnim fɔntinsi leei biŋkɔbbaligu gariche. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Ill make Rabbah into pastureland for camels and Ammon a resting place for flocks. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tum din nyɛ Naawuni tuma.
en: What exactly does God want us to do? the people asked.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n kana ti kaag a, amaa n sabiri yɛl shɛŋa din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tir a mi.
en: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ min a maligumaanitab bɛn ʒiin a tooni ka nyɛ binsuma din ti yɛn kana shihirili la, wummiya: N ni yihi n dab so bɛ ni booni Tiwul polli la palo.
en: Now listen, High Priest Joshua, you and your companions sitting before you— for these men are a sign— look, I am about to bring my servant, Branch.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a bi chɛ n taali ka kpihim n daalahichi maa? Dama pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn dɔnila tiŋgban ni. A ni ti lihi bo ma, amaa ka n ku beni.
en: Why not forgive my sin, overlook my iniquity? Then I would lie down in the dust; you would search hard for me, and I would not exist.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun tum zina ka bɛ gbaag o n-tahina ti zaŋ o zali sunsuuni.
en: The teachers of the Law and the Pharisees brought in a woman who had been caught committing adultery, and they made her stand before them all.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Adam la alahichi tumbu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka alahichi kpe dunia ŋɔ ni, ka alahichi maa tahi kum na. Dina n-chɛ ka kum paari sokam, dama sokam zaa tum alahichi.
en: Sin came into the world through one man, and his sin brought death with it. As a result, death has spread to the whole human race because everyone has sinned.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa zaŋ o niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o o siliga ni m-pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi tahima ni na beni saha shɛl la, ka di yu ni bɛ bahi yoli.
en: Discipline your children while they are young enough to learn. If you don't, you are helping them destroy themselves.

dag: ka yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: He said, Don't tell anyone about this. Just go and show the priest that you are well. Then take a gift to the temple as Moses commanded, and everyone will know that you have been healed.

dag: Lala ka Jɔshua daa niŋ tiligi Gibiɔnnim maa Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ bi ku ba.
en: Joshua did not let the Israelites kill the Gibeonites.

dag: Bɛ ni bahi yoli yomyom n-chaŋ ti kpe luɣ shɛli din mali dabiɛm!.
en: Trouble can come suddenly, and they will be ruined. Terrible things can happen to them, and they will be finished.

dag: Di fɔntinsi leela dabiɛm shee. Di nyɛla saa ni bi miri tiŋgban shɛl ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgban nɛli. So lan ka tiŋgbani maa ni, ka so mi bi lan doli nimaani garita.
en: Babylon will be like a dry, desert land. Its cities will be empty ruins. No one will live in those cities. No one will even travel through them.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa pun niŋ yɛda kana nti kahigiri bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa wuhiri palɔni.
en: Many who were followers now started telling everyone about the evil things they had been doing.

dag: Bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ lihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini luɣ kasi shee maa, ka lan sɔŋdi bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni tuma ni.
en: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka wuntizɔriba zaa suh a bɛ muɣisigu saha, ka kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ ku paai ba.
en: So all your loyal people should pray to you in times of need; when a great flood of trouble comes rushing in, it will not reach them.

dag: Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm: Yiɣisimiya n-zaŋ yi yɛla maa fabili niŋ zoya, ka chɛ ka daboya wum yi kukoya.
en: Listen to the Lord 's case against Israel. Arise, O Lord , and present your case; let the mountains and the hills hear what you say.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ gbahi n niriba chaŋ ka bɛ bi baŋ. Kum ni ku yi zuɣulaannima, ka kɔnyuri ku yi tarimba mi.
en: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, N yi zaŋ o ti a, di so ni n zaŋ o ti do so, kpalimmi n sani.
en: Laban answered, I would rather give her to you than to anyone else; stay here with me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi lab me goon shɛli din daa lu n-dahim la zali. Yi ni me li tam di tanza kura zuɣu. Ka niriba ti wuhi ni yinima n-nyɛ bɛn lab me goma maa mini yiya shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la.
en: They will rebuild ancient ruins on your account; the foundations of generations past you will restore. You will be called Mender of Broken Walls, Restorer of Livable Streets.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba pinaayi la daa boli Yisa nyaandol bɔbili maa na ti yɛli ba, Di bi simdi ni tinim chɛ Naawuni yɛligu tɔɣisibu ka kpalim bindira taribu ni.
en: So the twelve apostles called the whole group of believers together and said, It is not right for us to neglect the preaching of God's word in order to handle finances.

dag: N nini nya n dimnim lubu; ka n tiba wum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn liriti ma azaaba nyabu kuhigu.
en: My eyes have seen my enemies defeat; my ears have heard the downfall of my evil foes.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa balim Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, chɛ ka a ni daa tim do so na la lan lab ti sanna nti wuhi ti ti ni ti yɛn niŋ bi so ti ni yɛn dɔɣi maa shɛm.
en: Then Manoah prayed, Our Lord , please send that prophet again and let him tell us what to do for the son we are going to have.

dag: N yi ti ŋari zuɣusaa kɔsoya ka saa bi lan mira bee toli yi ti ŋubiri yi bimbilima bee n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu n niriba maa zuɣu.
en: Whenever I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat up the crops or send an epidemic on my people.

dag: Ka Sool daa nya Dauda ni diri nasara shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pam pahi.
en: This made Saul even more afraid of David.

dag: Saimɔn Pita ni daa nya lala maa, ka o damdi Yisa tooni yɛr o, N Duuma, m bi simdi ni m mir a, dama n nyɛla alahichilana.
en: When Simon Peter saw the catch, he fell at Jesus knees and said, Leave me, Lord, for Im a sinner.

dag: Amaa n ni saɣi ni shɛli nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛl a ŋɔ: Adiini so shɛli bɛ ni booni adiini soli din bi tuhi la, dina ka n doli n-jɛmdi n yaannim Naawuni, ka niŋ dinkam be zaligu puuni min anabinim sabbu yɛda.
en: I admit that their leaders think the Lord's Way which I follow is based on wrong beliefs. But I still worship the same God that my ancestors worshiped. And I believe everything written in the Law of Moses and in the Prophets.

dag: Dama Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛli naa, Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria dunɔdal ni la.
en: Earlier, when the king was at Elisha's house, Elisha had told him that flour or barley would sell for almost nothing.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ kpam din be yiligu ni maa m-booi bah o zuɣu ni, o biɛyanim maa zaa tooni. Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi Dauda zuɣu na pam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi labi Rama.
en: Samuel took the horn with the oil in it, and poured the special oil on Jesses youngest son in front of his brothers. The Spirit of the Lord came on David with great power from that day on. Then Samuel went back home to Ramah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ wuhi ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni, amaa pa daliri suŋ zuɣu ka bɛ niŋdi lala. Bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ woligi m mini ya din ni chɛ ka yi baɣa be bɛ ni.
en: Those people are working hard to persuade you, but this is not good for you. They want to persuade you to turn against us and work hard for them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa yɛli Samuɛl, Cham ti dɔni, o yi ti lan bol a, nyin yɛlima, Yawɛ, yɛlima, a dabili wumda. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa lan lab ti dɔni o dooshee maa.
en: so he said to him, Go back to bed; and if he calls you again, say, Speak, Lord , your servant is listening. So Samuel went back to bed.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbala du shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ kalo paligi di nyaansi ka di lihibu viɛla, amaa ka kpiimba kɔba mini daɣiri balibu kam pali di puuni la.
en: You Pharisees and teachers are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You're like tombs that have been whitewashed. On the outside they are beautiful, but inside they are full of bones and filth.

dag: O daa kari dɔbba dagɔr tuma tiŋgbani maa ni, ka wurim buɣ shɛŋa zaa o yaannim ni daa me n-zal la.
en: During Asas time there were men who served other gods by selling their bodies for sex. Asa forced them to leave the country. He took away the idols that his ancestors had made.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a ka mi a zaligunim ka n sanna.
en: Let your followers come back to me so that they may learn your rules.

dag: M bi bɔri jilima ninsalinim sani.
en: I am not looking for human praise.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: There in the desert they all complained to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Nuhu shɛm; ka Naawuni daa yo Nuhu niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: as God had commanded. Then the Lord shut the door behind Noah.

dag: Ŋunkam shihi ya, n nimbiɛlim ka o shihi maa. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zaŋ o yɛligu tim ma ni n yɛli zuliya shɛb bɛn nahind o niriba la:.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims concerning the nations plundering you: Those who strike you strike the pupil of my eye.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Aminadab n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pinaayi pah o zuɣu.
en: and from the clan of Uzziel, Amminadab, in charge of .

dag: Teem a ni daa pun piig a ninvuɣ shɛb kurimbuni ha la yɛla, a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ nyɛ a ni su zuliya shɛb la. Teem Ziɔn Zo shɛli zuɣu a ni daa be la yɛla.
en: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa tim ti boli Jɔab ni o kana ka o tim o naa sani, amaa ka Jɔab daa zaɣisi kandina. Ka o lan tim pahi buyi, amaa ka Jɔab kul bahi zaɣisi kandina.
en: Then he sent for Joab, to ask him to go to the king for him; but Joab would not come. Again Absalom sent for him, and again Joab refused to come.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnim saliŋ lɔhili. Yɛlim ba yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ.
en: Son of man, I have a story with a hidden meaning for you to tell the family of Israel.

dag: Yi yi kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi ma, hal yi yi suhi ma kabo, n ku lihi yi polo na; m mi ku wum yi suhigu maa. Yi nuhi tim ʒim ni.
en: When you raise your arms to pray to me, I will refuse to look at you. You will say more and more prayers, but I will refuse to listen because your hands are covered with blood.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka yi yi gundi nira Vuhim Dabisili dali ni Anabi Musa zaligu maa di saɣim, di chaŋ wula ka yi je suli niŋ ma n ni chɛ ka ninsal niŋgbuŋ zaa nya alaafee Vuhim Dabisili dali zuɣu?.
en: This shows that someone can be circumcised on a Sabbath day to obey the Law of Moses. So why are you angry with me for healing a persons whole body on the Sabbath day?.

dag: N daa bi di bindir nyaɣisili bee ŋ-ŋub nimdi bee n-chɛ ka wain to n noli, m mi daa bi niŋ kpam ʒe n ni hal ka bakɔi muna ata maa ti gari.
en: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.

dag: Dama a sani ka nyɛvili kɔbilisirim be. A neesim zuɣu ka ti nyari neesim.
en: The fountain of life flows from you. Your light lets us see light.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ dina yi ti bi yɛn niŋ yomyom yi n-chaŋ bee n-yi n-guui. Yawɛ nti yɛn be yi tooni mali ya chana. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni nyɛ ŋun yɛn be yi nyaaŋa polo n-nyɛ yi gula.
en: You wont go out in a rush, nor will you run away, because the one going before you is the LORD; your rear guard is the God of Israel.

dag: ni Hɔrimanim ni Bɔrashannima ni Ataknima.
en: Hormah, Bor-ashan, Athach.

dag: Ka a nuu yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi ka ti kpe buɣim din bi kpiri ni .
en: So if your hand makes you lose your faith, cut it off! It is better for you to enter life without a hand than to keep both hands and go off to hell, to the fire that never goes out.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni yili a yurilim maŋli la yila sahakam, n ni moli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla molo ʒiɛmani kam zaa niriba sani.
en: I will sing forever about the Lord s love. I will sing about his faithfulness forever and ever!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhuyiɣisili puuni ka n yɛn chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒe, ka chɛ ka sa titali mi n sujee puuni, ka sakuɣ kara luna n suhuyiɣisili maa ni saɣim li.
en: Therefore, the LORD God proclaims: In my fury I will make a storm wind break out, and in my anger there will be flooding rains and hailstones in consuming wrath.

dag: ka di chɛ ka so ku tooi lan da shɛli bee n-kɔhi shɛli, shee o malila dalinli din nyɛ biŋkɔbigu maa yuli bee namba din ʒe o yuli zaani la.
en: It will not allow anyone to make a purchase or sell anything unless the person has the mark with the beasts name or the number of its name.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N yɛrila yinim bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, yumiya yi dimnima, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: This is what I say to all who will listen to me: Love your enemies, and be good to everyone who hates you.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nini daa kul kpa Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ daa bi tooi chɛ ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu hal ka di lahibali daa ti ti nti to Darius ka o daa sab o zilinkom gbaŋ ti na.
en: But God was watching over the Jewish leaders, and the Persian officials decided to take no action until they could write to Emperor Darius and receive a reply.

dag: Nyama, n ni ti tim bi so ka yɛl o, Cham ti bo piɛma maa shee. N yi ti yɛl o, Nyama, piɛma maa be a luɣili ŋɔ polo, kpuɣimi li na, di saha nyin yim na, dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛli ku lan niŋ a, ka barina shɛli mi lan kani.
en: and send my servant to find the arrows. You'll know if it's safe to come out by what I tell him. If it is safe, I swear by the living Lord that I'll say, The arrows are on this side of you! Pick them up.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa yɛl o lala ka chaŋ naai, ka o bol o yiŋbih ayi mini tɔbbi so ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka gul o sahakam la na.
en: When the angel who was speaking to him had gone, Cornelius summoned two of his household servants along with a pious soldier from his personal staff.

dag: Bɛ yi kar o saria, bɛn wuhimi ni o mali taali, ka chɛ ka o wunsuhigu leei alahichi.
en: Let even his prayer be used as evidence against him, and let the court find him guilty.

dag: Jɛrigu bi bɔri tɛhi zilima, amaa ka naɣ wuhirila omaŋmaŋ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Fools find no pleasure in understanding, but only in expressing their opinion.

dag: Sisɛra daa suh o la kom, amaa ka o ti o la bihim; o daa zaŋ bihim maa niŋla pipi viɛli ni na ti ti o.
en: Sisera asked for water, but Jael gave him milk— cream in a fancy cup.

dag: Di saha ka o daa laɣim bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihitanaayi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tusaayopɔin.
en: So Ahab gathered the young helpers of the government officials. There were of these young men. Then the king called together the army of Israel. The total number was .

dag: Amaa dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam, ka dabiɛm maa tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ. Dama man Naawuni ni to n-wurim ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba. Bɛ ni di vi, dama man Naawuni zaɣisi ba.
en: There, where there was nothing to fear, they will be in utter panic because God will scatter the bones of those who attacked you. You will put them to shame because God has rejected them.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi lan lo ni yi zaŋ Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa leei yi daba. Yi bi mi ni yi gba tumla alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani maa?.
en: And now you intend to make the men and women of Jerusalem and Judah your slaves. Don't you know that you also have committed sins against the Lord your God?.

dag: Ŋun yɛn zani n nyaaŋa mirina. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi n taali ni nyɛ shɛli? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun fiɣisiri ma maa? O chɛ ka m min o chaŋ ʒiishee, ka ti gbɛri ti kpa taba.
en: My protector is nearby; no one can stand here to accuse me of wrong.

dag: Ka tizɔra bi deeri tizɔbo laara naɣila o dolila tizɔbo zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Also in the same way, athletes dont win unless they follow the rules.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo;.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: I tell you not to worry about your life! Don't worry about having something to eat or wear.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o paɣ maa, N yɛlila Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la, Zaŋm a wain tihi puu ŋɔ n-kɔhi n zuɣu bee a yi bɔra, n ni taɣ a wain tihi pu shɛli, ka o yɛli ma, N ku zaŋ n wain tihi ti a. .
en: He answered her, I was talking to Naboth. I said, Sell me your vineyard. Or if you prefer, Ill give you another vineyard for it. But he said, I wont give you my vineyard.

dag: Amaa man tɛha ni, o yi kpalim ʒiya o ni mali suhupiɛlli gar o yi kuli doo, ka n tɛhi ni Naawuni Shia Kasi be n ni zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo.
en: But in my opinion, she will be happier if she stays the way she is. And I think that I have Gods Spirit too.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni palila ʒiŋmabo. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu. Naawuni ni ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ maligu bimbina maa, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila maa.
en: Their heart is false; now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will break down their altars and destroy their standing stones.

dag: Dama Farisiinim mini Yɛhudianim zaa daa bi saɣiri diri bindirigu ka pa ni bɛ dol bɛ yaannim kali ni nyɛ shɛm paɣi bɛ nuhi pɔi.
en: The Pharisees and all the Jews dont eat without first washing their hands carefully. This is a way of observing the rules handed down by the elders.

dag: nti zaŋ o leei naa ni o su Giliad mini Ashur ni Jɛziriil ni Ifriim ni Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: and made him king of Israel, including the areas of Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin.

dag: Ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsal la lan zaŋ o nuu shihi ma, ka n nya ka yaa maan niŋ n niŋgbuna ni pahi.
en: Once more he took hold of me, and I felt stronger.

dag: Hal o ni ti chaŋ ti liri Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la gba n-ku niriba tuhi pii nimaani. Amaa kulla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Ɛdom mini Mɔab ni Ammɔn zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn kpalim kɔŋko n-ni ti yi o nuu ni.
en: The northern king will attack the Beautiful Land. He will defeat many countries. But Edom, Moab, and the leaders of Ammon will be saved from him.

dag: n-doli Izraɛl doo maa ti kpe o duu puuni n-zaŋ kpani maa kuhi Izraɛl doo maa mini paɣ maa zaa puya ni ku ba. Ka alɔbo din daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu maa daa zani tariga.
en: went after the Israelite man into the chamber, and stabbed the two of them, the Israelite man and the woman, through the stomach. Then the plague stopped spreading among the Israelites.

dag: M bia, gbibi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka n ni zal a shɛm be a suhu ni.
en: My child, remember what I say and never forget what I tell you to do.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kliɔpas la bɔh o, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ sana Jɛrusalɛm ŋun na bi wum yɛl shɛŋa din yol niŋ nimaani daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni la.
en: The one named Cleopas said, You must be the only person in Jerusalem who doesnt know what has just happened there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pagɔra ayi daa ti kana ti gbani naa tooni.
en: One day two women came to King Solomon.

dag: Nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka yi labisi puu maa ti bɛ ni daa da li ninvuɣ so sani maa, ŋun daa su li, ka di nyɛla o di li la fali maa.
en: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin daa ʒe bɛ tooni, ka Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan bidibiga la be bɛ ni. Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa gbibila o tulaale zim tuɣilibu daaŋa o nuu ni, ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: Seventy Israelite leaders were there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each one was holding an incense burner, and smoke was rising from the incense.

dag: Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: Watch out for the legal experts. They like to walk around in long robes. They love being greeted with honor in the markets. They long for the places of honor in the synagogues and at banquets.

dag: Ka maligumaana leebu nimdi maa bee bɔrɔbɔro maa yi ti guui n-zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, dindina yin di lan ŋub li, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: If some of the meat or some of the bread is not eaten by morning, it is to be burned; it is not to be eaten, for it is sacred.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Bildad from Shuah responded.

dag: amaa di daa sabila ti gba zuɣu. Naawuni ni zaŋ tinim bɛn niŋ ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni yɛda ŋɔ gba zali wuntia zaani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: It was written also for our sake, because it is going to be credited to us too. It will be credited to those of us who have faith in the one who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

dag: Malaika so ŋun daa yihi ma yɛl biɛri ni la, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni! Naawuni chɛ ka bihi ŋɔ zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mini n yab Ibrahimma ni m ba Yisahaku yuya ku kpi! Naawuni tim ba bihi pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi.
en: may the divine messenger who protected me from all harm, bless the young men. Through them may my name be kept alive and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. May they grow into a great multitude throughout the land.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yaakubu leei bundana ka mali biŋkɔbiri pam, ka mali daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: In this way Jacob became very rich. He had large flocks, many servants, camels, and donkeys.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: These are the responsibilities of the Gershon clan in the Tent; they shall carry them out under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, Go to Pharaoh and tell him that the Lord says, Let my people go to worship me!.

dag: Ka o ni po pɔ shɛŋa bee o noli ni faag o ka o yɛli ni o niŋ shɛli, o yi ti kuli doo.
en: A woman might make a special promise to give something to the Lord and then get married.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bia, n daa tɔɣisirila bilim yɛtɔɣa, ka mali bia tɛha, ka buɣisiri yɛla bilim buɣisibu; amaa n ni daa ti bi doo, ka n chɛ bilim soya zaa.
en: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, and I made plans like a child. When I became a man, I stopped those childish ways.
