dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Labimiya yaɣ yini polo, ka m mini m bia Jɔnatan mi labi yaɣ yini polo. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Sool, A ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, nyin niŋmi li.
en: Then Saul said to all the Israelites, You stand on this side. I and my son Jonathan will stand on the other side. The soldiers answered, As you wish, sir.

dag: A yi ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ suhuri zɔhirimi. A yi deei bɛ vuhim, bɛ kpirimi n-lab taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: But when you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to dust.

dag: ka wuhiri ba ni bɛ doli n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la. Nyamiya, n kul ni be yi sani sahakam hal ti paai dunia yiɣisibu dali.
en: teaching them to obey everything that Ive commanded you. Look, I myself will be with you every day until the end of this present age.

dag: Ka Pool daa mirig o nina kpa jintɔriba maa ka yɛli, M mabihi, m bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: Paul looked straight at the council members and said, My friends, to this day I have served God with a clear conscience.

dag: Ka daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa n-labir o ba maa sani. O ni daa ti na be katiŋ ha kanna ka o ba maa nya o ka nambɔɣu gbaag o pam; ka o yiɣisi zo nti tuh o soli m-bɔbi gbaag o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: So he got up and went to his father. While he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion. His father ran to him, hugged him, and kissed him.

dag: Amaa ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka di ku moli gili m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛliya ka ti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pam ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani.
en: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.

dag: dama ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi yi alahichi dabitim ni.
en: For when we die, we are set free from the power of sin.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yɛhudianim maa daa to jina yɛli ni bɛ kum Sool.
en: After this had gone on for some time, the Jews hatched a plot to kill Saul.

dag: O chɛ ka buɣim sal nɛma mini chilibi buɣim kul luri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu; ka zaŋdi pɔhim tulli darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: God will rain fiery coals and sulfur on the wicked; their cups will be filled with nothing but a scorching hot wind.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa nyɛla bundana ni yɛndana n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: King Solomon became greater in riches and wisdom than any other king on earth.

dag: A ni tum tuun kpɛma ka woligu yiri a ni ka a nyari bindirigu diri hal ti lab tiŋgbani maa ni, dama di ni ka a daa yina. Taŋkpaɣu n-nyɛ a, ka a ni ti lan lab taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: You will sweat all your life to earn a living; you were made out of soil, and you will once again turn into soil.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ dundɔŋ gili di zaa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunɔdali.
en: Set up the wall of curtains around the courtyard. Then put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.

dag: Jɛra n-tɛhi ni bɛmaŋmaŋ soli n-tuhi, amaa yɛnnim bɛn gbilisirila tibili wumda.
en: Stupid people always think they are right. Wise people listen to advice.

dag: Ka Asiria naa daa wum Ahaz ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ Damaskus nti ŋme n-nyaŋ ba, ka ku Rɛzin; ka gbahi di niriba n-kuli Kɛɛr nti leei daba.
en: The king of Assyria listened to Ahaz and went to fight against Damascus. The king captured that city and took the people from Damascus as prisoners to Kir. He also killed Rezin.

dag: N yi chɛ a ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa maa taali, di ni chɛ ka a teei di yɛla ka di gar a, ka a ku lan yaag a noli a vi maa zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will remember me, and you will be so ashamed of the evil things you did that you will not be able to say anything. But I will make you pure, and you will never be ashamed again! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ayuba ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: O God, put a curse on the day I was born; put a curse on the night when I was conceived!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka kulibɔŋ maa kom maa nyuui, saa ni daa bi lan miri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la zuɣu.
en: After a while the brook dried up because of the lack of rain.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ tiligira ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun sɔɣ amaŋa.
en: You are the God people cannot see. You are the God who saves Israel.

dag: Ka Gɛza naa Hɔram daa kana ti sɔŋ Lakishinim maa, amaa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku o min o tɔbbihi zaa hal ka bɛ ni so bi tiligi.
en: King Horam of Gezer came to the aid of Lachish, but Joshua defeated him and his army and left none of them alive.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa wolig o piɛsah ayopɔin zali bɛ ko.
en: Abraham set aside, by themselves, seven female lambs from the flock.

dag: Bɛ no n-taai nandaamba niŋ taŋkpaɣu ni, ka daai bɛn diri wahala bahi, ka doo min o ba laɣindi mali dabipaɣ yino. Lala ka bɛ niŋ saɣim n yuli din be kasi la.
en: They trample down the weak and helpless and push the poor out of the way. A man and his father have intercourse with the same slave woman, and so profane my holy name.

dag: Chɛ ka n dimnim be kaman ninvuɣ biɛri la, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ma be kaman bɛn pa wuntizɔriba la.
en: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.

dag: Pa yinim m-bo yɛla ŋɔ ti yimaŋa yi ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun mali ya chana la zuɣu?.
en: Israel, you brought this on yourself! You deserted me, the Lord your God, while I was leading you along the way.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi a sani, dama ti chɛ nyini ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka jɛmdila buɣa Baalnima.
en: So the Israelites cried to the Lord for help. They said, God, we have sinned against you. We left our God and worshiped the false god Baal.

dag: Lala niriba n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmd o, bɛna n-lan nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Such are the people who come to God, who come into the presence of the God of Jacob.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Kɔnyuri m-mali ma. N suhir a, tim ma kom biɛla ka n nyu. Ka paɣ maa daa yooi bihim koligu m-booi bihim ti o ka o nyu, ka o lan zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: But first, Sisera asked Jael for a drink of water. Jael had some milk in a bottle made from animal skin. So she gave him a drink of the milk and then covered him up.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili; ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: So he went to her bed. Jesus held her hand and helped her stand up. The fever left her, and she was healed. Then she began serving them.

dag: Hal n yi bela kum vinvamli zibisim ni chana, n ku zo shɛli dabiɛm; dama a be n sani. A jaaŋgbee min a piɛgul jaaŋgbee la nyɛla din kpaŋsiri n suhu.
en: Even if I go through the deepest darkness, I will not be afraid, Lord , for you are with me. Your shepherd's rod and staff protect me.

dag: ka ashili yuli sab pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Babilɔn titali, pagɔra mini dunia chihi biɛri ma.
en: A name—a mystery—was written on her forehead: Babylon the great, the mother of prostitutes and the vile things of the earth.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ n yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, m paɣir a ka tir a jilima. A ni ti ma yɛm mini kpiɔŋ; ka kahigi ti ni suh a shɛl la wuhi ma, ka wuhi ti ni a deei ti suhigu, ka lan wuhi ti ti ni yɛn yɛli naa shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o ba yiŋ Ofira nti ku o ba bihi ninvuɣ pisopɔin bɛn nyɛ Gidiɔn bidibisi la tampin yini zuɣu. Amaa ka Jɔtam ŋun daa nyɛ Gidiɔn kaluɣ la ŋun daa sɔɣi, ka bɛ bi nya o ku o.
en: He went to his father's house at Ophrah, and there on top of a single stone he killed his seventy brothers, Gideon's sons. But Jotham, Gideon's youngest son, hid and was not killed.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Shɛbuɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma.
en: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Azariah died and was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Jotham succeeded him as king.

dag: ni di chɛ ka cheechi maa viɛla, ka ka liɣisibu bee gurimbu, ka ni bela kasi ka ka galimi, ka o zaŋ li ti omaŋa.
en: in order to present the church to himself in all its beauty—pure and faultless, without spot or wrinkle or any other imperfection.

dag: Ŋunkam zu ninsal ti kɔhi bee n-na gbib o ka bɛ gbaag o, bɛn kum o.
en: Anyone who kidnaps a person, whether they have been sold or are still being held, should be put to death.

dag: N ni niŋ Ɛhab yiŋnim kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim mini Ahija bia Baasha yiŋnim shɛm la.
en: I will treat his family as I did the families of King Jeroboam of Israel and of King Baasha of Israel.

dag: Dama Yawɛ sagbani maa daa kul bela o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣusaa wuntaŋ ni, yuŋ mi ka buɣim be sagbani maa puuni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni bɛ chandi maa zaa ni.
en: The LORDs cloud stayed over the dwelling during the day, with lightning in it at night, clearly visible to the whole household of Israel at every stage of their journey.

dag: Amaa man ni mali shɛli nyɛla, a chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Dan zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaa laɣim a sanna kaman teeku noli bihigu la, ka a maŋmaŋ yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: My advice is to gather all the fighting men of Israel from the town of Dan in the north down to the town of Beersheba in the south. You will have more soldiers than there are grains of sand on the seashore. Absalom, you should lead them yourself.

dag: ka mi bi simdi ni o ka Yisa sanna. Amaa ni o kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛn yɛli ka o dabili maa kpaŋ.
en: neither do I consider myself worthy to come to you in person. Just give the order, and my servant will get well.

dag: Ka Balaam garigi yɛl o, N di yɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni..
en: But Balaam answered, I must say the things that the Lord tells me to say.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali kpamba bɛn daa ʒiin o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba ŋɔ wula.
en: King Rehoboam consulted the older men who had served as his father Solomon's advisers. What answer do you advise me to give these people? he asked.

dag: ka din pah anu gbaai Malikija, ka din pah ayɔbu gbaai Mijamin.
en: The fifth was Malkijahs group. The sixth was Mijamins group.

dag: Ti min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini mini ti ni niŋ o yɛda la zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ naani ti ni nya soli ni ti tooi chaŋ Naawuni sani la zuɣu.
en: In Christ we have bold and confident access to God through faith in him.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naawuni, Wara ka chɛ ti. Bɔ ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa yɛn tooi niŋ ti?.
en: These are the ones who rejected God and believed that he could do nothing to them.

dag: Ka n ni ti zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim labisi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti lab me tin shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la m-be di ni. Bɛ ni ti ko tiwala puri ka nyu di wala kom. Bɛ ni ti ko tihi puri ka di di wala.
en: I will bring my people, Israel, back from captivity. They will rebuild the ruined cities, and they will live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink the wine they produce. They will plant gardens and eat the crops they produce.

dag: Di saha maa ka anab shɛb daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: During this time some prophets from Jerusalem came to Antioch.

dag: Ka Pita daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi; ka o gban tiŋ suhi Naawuni, ka naanyi ŋmaligi kpim maa polo yɛl o, Tabita, yiɣisima! Ka o neeg o nina nya Pita, ka dii yiɣisi ʒini.
en: Peter sent all the people out of the room. He knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to Tabithas body and said, Tabitha, stand up! She opened her eyes. When she saw Peter, she sat up.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm la ni daa bah o, ka o yi Rama chaŋ la nyaaŋa. Bɛ daa lo o la zoligɔnima m-pahi bɛ ni daa gbahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda ninvuɣ shɛb daba n-zaŋ ba kuni Babilɔn la zuɣu.
en: I was led away in chains along with the people of Judah and Jerusalem who were being taken to Babylonia. Nebuzaradan was the officer in charge of the guard, and while we were stopped at Ramah, the Lord caused him to set me free.

dag: Naftali zuliya n-daa pah ayɔbu n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The sixth part of land was given to the tribe of Naphtali. Each family in that tribe got its share of the land.

dag: amaa ka labina nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom luɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom la zuɣu, o ku chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ a sɔɣi pah a yaannim ni. .
en: He told you not to eat or drink anything here, but you came home and ate with me. And so, when you die, your body won't be buried in your family tomb.

dag: Ka a ti she jinjɛŋŋmahi ti ba ka di limsi bɛ zaɣim, ka di wɔɣilim ti zaŋ bɛ shɛhi ni hal ti paai bɛ gbalipina ni.
en: You should also make linen undergarments for them to cover their naked skin from their hips to their thighs.

dag: O nuu ni ka binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili mini ninsal kam vuhim be.
en: Every living creature is in the hands of God.

dag: Ka n daa bahi noli ni bɛ vihim yɛlli maa, ka bɛ daa vihi n-nya ka kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ tiŋ maa shiri nyɛla tin shɛli din bi zani tuhi nam fukumsi, ka duŋtaariba mini gadamanima n-kul pali di ni.
en: I issued an order; they searched and discovered that this city has revolted against kings over a long period of time. There has been much rebellion and revolt there.

dag: Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli.
en: At once the curtain in the temple tore in two from top to bottom.

dag: Ka so yi ti bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya a nyɔɣu ni dansi ŋɔ? O ni garigi yɛli, N zo yiŋ ka n nya dansi maa.
en: Then if someone asks him, What are those wounds on your chest? he will answer, I got them at a friend's house.

dag: Rɛzɔn daa nyɛla Izraɛlnim dima Naa Sulemaana ʒiɛman ni, ka daa tumdi ba din bie kaman Hadad ni daa niŋdi ba shɛm la; ka daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnima, ka di nam su Sirianima.
en: Throughout Solomons lifetime, Rezon was Israels opponent and added to the problems caused by Hadad. Rezon hated Israel while he ruled as king of Aram.

dag: Bɛ kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbani maa ti, ka sana daa bi gari bɛ ni.
en: to whom alone the earth was given and no stranger passed in their midst.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa laɣim lu Musa mini Aduna zuɣu saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa polo nya ka sagbani pun sirigina ti pani di zuɣu, ka Yawɛ jilima neesim neei.
en: After they had all gathered to protest to Moses and Aaron, they turned toward the Tent and saw that the cloud was covering it and that the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence had appeared.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Then Joab and his men attacked the Arameans. The Arameans ran away from Joab and his men.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha?.
en: When the high priest heard this, he tore his clothes in anger. He said, We dont need any more witnesses!.

dag: di lan nyɛla paɣ so ŋun nya sɔrilim zaligu ni binshɛli ni yiri do so bee paɣ so tooni na zaa zaligu, ka lan nyɛ do so ŋun mini paɣ so ŋun na be daɣiri ni dɔni gba zaligu.
en: a woman during her monthly period, or a man who has sexual intercourse with a woman who is ritually unclean.

dag: N ni tum shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ti kpalim yoli zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu kul zɔhirimi.
en: I am worried about you! Can it be that all my work for you has been for nothing?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vihi yɛlli maa n-nya ka bɛ ni wum shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ niriba ayi maa n-zaŋ ba yili dasara. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ sab yɛlli maa yɛla niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛlikura litaafi ni o ninni.
en: Then the report was checked out. It was learned that Mordecais report was true. The two guards who had planned to kill the king were hanged on a post. All these things were written down in a book of the kings histories in front of the king.

dag: Ka nanim mini bɛ tɔbbihi gbaai zɔbu! Ka paɣiba bɛn be yiŋa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa pirigi ti taba.
en: The armies of powerful kings ran away! At home, the women divide the things brought from the battle.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ŋun mini pagɔrili laɣim min o leela niŋgbun yini? Dama di sabiya ni niriba ayi ni leei niŋgbun yini.
en: Or perhaps you don't know that the man who joins his body to a prostitute becomes physically one with her? The scripture says quite plainly, The two will become one body.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa yubu nyɛla ni n di bahi o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ti ma la ni yino, amaa ni n ti neei ba kum ni zaadali.
en: I must not lose anyone God has given me. But I must raise them up on the last day. This is what the one who sent me wants me to do.

dag: N yi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, n ka bara nyubu di ni; dama di nyɛla n talahi tuuni, ka mbusim be n zuɣu n yi bi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu maa!.
en: I have no right to boast just because I preach the gospel. After all, I am under orders to do so. And how terrible it would be for me if I did not preach the gospel!.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ka o daa zaŋ kpihim Yɛhudianim zaligunim mini bɛ daadiini soli kaya ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba min omaŋmaŋ naai taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti sunsuuni.
en: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a baɣa be n ni ka garigi ma. Tim ma yaa yaha, di yi pa lala n ni kpi.
en: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, dabiɛm mini bɔɣ biɛri ni zana n-ʒe n-gun ya.
en: Terror, trench, and trap are upon you, ruler of the earth!.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yinima n-di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yinim pii ni yi ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋɔ. Ka bɛ yɛli, Tinima n-di timaŋ shɛhira maa.
en: So Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD. They said, We are witnesses.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋmahindi binneen so ŋun gbamdi tiŋgbani zuɣu bee ŋ-ŋmahindi zahim bɛn be kom ni tiŋgbani puuni ŋɔ.
en: reptile or fish.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: The Philistines arrived and spread out over the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ shɛɣuni, ka Bɛnhadad laɣim Siria tɔbbihi n-chaŋ Afɛk ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: In the spring, Benhadad got his army together, and they marched to the town of Aphek to attack Israel.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ, bɛ ni daa teei gili ma kaman tin shɛli bɛ ni liri, ka o tum ma o yurilim maŋli tuun shɛli din mali alahiziba la zuɣu.
en: Praise the Lord , because he showed me how wonderful his faithful love is when the city was surrounded by enemies.

dag: A yi ti jɛrigu jilima, di ŋmanila a ni lo kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni la.
en: Showing honor to a fool is as bad as tying a rock in a sling.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: Sing praise to the Lord , all his faithful people! Remember what the Holy One has done, and give him thanks!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛl a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe, ka o ku ma? .
en: Do you really want me to tell Ahab you're here? He will kill me!.

dag: Ka salo maa ni so daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, yɛlimi m biɛli ni o chɛ ka ti pirigi ti ba fali ti taba.
en: Someone from the crowd said to him, Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.

dag: ni yi kpe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni po pɔri lɔn ya alikauli shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni;.
en: You are here today to enter into this covenant that the Lord your God is making with you and to accept its obligations.

dag: Nyini ka n kul lihira, nyini ŋun nam ʒiishee be zuɣusaa ŋɔ!.
en: I raise my eyes to you— you who rule heaven.

dag: Amaa di lee bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛl la: Ti Duuma Naawuni, ninsal lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhir o yɛla bee daadam bia lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be o ni?.
en: Instead, as it is said somewhere in the Scriptures: What are human beings, O God, that you should think of them; mere human beings, that you should care for them?.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa sani, m bemi kaman ŋun ka yaa ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn ka yaa maa gba. N chɛ ka m biɛhigu mini sokam biɛhigu taɣilila taba ni di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi shɛba.
en: I act weak to the weak, so I can recruit the weak. I have become all things to all people, so I could save some by all possible means.

dag: Ishimail daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin, ka naanyi kpi m-pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: Ishmael lived to be years old. Then he died and went to be with his people.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Kɛdar zuliya mini Hazɔr nam sulinsi polo, Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa tuhi nyaŋ shɛb la, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, lirimiya Kɛdarinima, wurimmiya wulimpuhili zuliya maa.
en: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar defeated, the LORD proclaims: Get ready to attack Kedar; destroy the people from the east!.

dag: Ka a yi kali ninvuɣ so, di simdi ka dilan yo anzinfa laɣifu pirigili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ. .
en: Each man over , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ maa ni ti kpe Maika yiŋa.
en: From there they crossed into the Ephraim highlands and came to Micahs house.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni daa zaɣis o yɛligu zuɣu.
en: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.

dag: Daliri din ni chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋa n-yaɣi n ni daa nya kahigibunim pam shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka go shɛli din be kaman Sintani tumo la kuhi ma n-kpalim be n niŋgbuŋ ni ni di muɣisi ma n-chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋ yaɣi.
en: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.

dag: Amaa a ti ma kpiɔŋ ka di be kaman yɔnaɣilaa kpiɔŋ la. A booi kpa viɛlli bahi n zuɣu ni.
en: You have made me as strong as a wild ox; you have blessed me with happiness.

dag: tiri m biyurigu Timoti. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Timothy, a dear son to me. Grace, mercy, and peace to you from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu yi zuɣu, ka bɛ be yi sani n-gbahi yi bihi mini yi niɣi n-chɛ ka yi kalinli filim, ka yi soya bili mɔri.
en: I will send wild animals against you. They will take your children away from you. They will destroy your animals. They will kill many of your people. The roads will all be empty.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ a yuli kana ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa la, di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, o kul niŋdila a niriba maa putɔɣu, ka a bi niŋ shɛli ni a fa a niriba maa bahi.
en: I went to Pharaoh and said what you told me to say. But since that time he has made the people suffer, and you have done nothing to help them.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣiri ŋmanila gbal yari. Bɛ zaa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lee lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Timaŋmaŋ wum li o nol ni.
en: Then they said, Why do we need further testimony? Weve heard it from his own lips.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa pahi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni.
en: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.

dag: ka lan pii din bi ŋmani shɛli, ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm li ka tɛhi ni di pa shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni la, ni o zaŋ li chɛ ka binshɛŋa din beni niŋ yoli.
en: He chose what the world looks down on and despises and thinks is nothing, in order to destroy what the world thinks is important.

dag: Man Yisa n-tim m malaika ni o zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ na nti ti cheechinima. N nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa ni biɛŋmariga ŋun ne.
en: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to tell you these things for the churches. I am the descendant from the family of David. I am the bright morning star.

dag: Yi yi doli n noli, ka gbibi n zaligunima ka tumdi di tuma.
en: If you live according to my laws and obey my commands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa jɛm o, ka lan lab Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli.
en: After his disciples had worshiped him, they returned to Jerusalem and were very happy.

dag: Yi ni na mali neesim maa zuɣu, niŋmiya neesim maa yɛda, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi leei neesim maa bihi. Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa chaŋmi ti sɔɣi.
en: So put your trust in the light while you still have it. Then you will be children of light. When Jesus finished saying these things, he went away to a place where the people could not find him.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa nyɛ Simiɔn bia, ka Simiɔn nyɛ Juda bia, ka Juda nyɛ Yisifu so bia, ka Yisifu maa nyɛ Jɔnam bia, ka Jɔnam mi nyɛ Ɛliakim bia.
en: son of Simeon son of Judah son of Joseph son of Jonam son of Eliakim.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa lihi paɣiba maa yɛligu maa kaman lahibal kpɛma, ka daa bi dihi li tabili. .
en: But the apostles thought that what the women said was nonsense, and they did not believe them.

dag: o ni bela a sani kaman padira bee tumtumda n-tumd a tuma hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: They shall stay with you as hired workers and serve you until the next Year of Restoration.

dag: Ka na shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam gba pun di n-ʒini nimaani, ka daa su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣilinim zaa, ka deeri ba farigu.
en: However, there have been mighty kings over Jerusalem who also ruled over the whole province Beyond the River. Tribute and taxes and dues were paid to them.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dɔɣi bihi n-nabi ka yɛligi pam, ka mali yaa m-pali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: But the Israelites had many children, and their number grew until the country of Egypt was filled with them.

dag: Ka Sool tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la daa zaŋ Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt n-zo chaŋ Mahanaim.
en: Abner the son of Ner had been the general of Saul's army. He took Saul's son Ishbosheth across the Jordan River to Mahanaim.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni ti ni deei nam shɛli din ku tooi dam ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka chɛliya ka ti lan paɣi Naawuni ka zo o n-lu o sizuura ka jɛm o la jɛmbu shɛli din ni tiɣ o nini;.
en: So we should be thankful because we have a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And because we are thankful, we should worship God in a way that will please him. We should do this with respect and fear.

dag: Teemiya saha shɛli din gari la ha, yi ni daa bɔhim baŋ Naawuni yɛla la nyaaŋa, yi daa niŋ ania di wahala bina pam ni, amaa yi mɔbu puuni di daa bi nyaŋ ya.
en: But remember the earlier days, after you saw the light. You stood your ground while you were suffering from an enormous amount of pressure.

dag: N yaannim daa tuhi saɣim fɔntinsi din nyɛ Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ka daa ku Bɛtidɛn niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa, ka bɛ zaa naawuna daa bi tooi tiligi ba.
en: Did the gods of the nations that my ancestors destroyed save them, the gods of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, or the people of Eden in Telassar?.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko ka m mali, ka a tiri ma n ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka n dahin shɛli ha biɛhigu yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni.
en: You, Lord , are all I have, and you give me all I need; my future is in your hands.

dag: Di daa nyɛla chɛrubinim mini abie tihi kɔtomsi, chɛrubinima ayi sunsuuni abie tia n-daa beni. Chɛrubi yino kam daa malila ninni diba ayi.
en: of palm trees and winged creatures. Palm trees alternated with creatures, one following the other, all the way around the room. Each creature had two faces:.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: No one knows the day or hour. The angels in heaven don't know, and the Son himself doesn't know. Only the Father knows.

dag: ka tinzunnim vuri ŋmani tiŋgban kuŋ ni tulim la, a daa chɛ ka sagbana limsi li n-ku di tulim maa, ka putɔɣunim maa chɛ yila yilibu.
en: or like heat in the desert, you subdue the roar of foreigners. Like heat shaded by a cloud, the tyrants song falls silent.

dag: Niriba biɛla bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya maa ni ti lab bɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sanna.
en: A few of the people of Israel will come back to their mighty God.

dag: Ka zim shɛli din kpalim ni leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ maa zuɣu.
en: The rest of the grain offering belongs to the priests; it is very holy, since it is taken from the food offered to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Di chɛ ka a bia maa min a dab paɣ maa yɛla muɣis a. Zara ni kul yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm o ni yɛl a shɛm maa, dama Yisahaku zuɣu ka a zuliya yɛn yɛligi.
en: God said to Abraham, Dont be upset about the boy and your servant. Do everything Sarah tells you to do because your descendants will be traced through Isaac.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti ŋma bilichiisi n-nyo li buɣim viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka bɛ daa ŋma bilichiisi maa ka di be kaman kuɣa la, ka zaŋ kootaali mi n-leei tandi.
en: they said: Let's build a city with a tower that reaches to the sky! We'll use hard bricks and tar instead of stone and mortar. We'll become famous, and we won't be scattered all over the world.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa suhi o wunsuhigu ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa yiɣisi zan o ni daa gba luɣ shɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini maa gbini n-kpuɣ o nuhi duhi zuɣusaa.
en: After Solomon had finished praying to the Lord , he stood up in front of the altar, where he had been kneeling with uplifted hands.

dag: Niŋmiya kaman n ni niŋdi shɛm. N kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n tiɣi sokam nini n ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla niriba pam sɔŋsim zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: Just do as I do; I try to please everyone in all that I do, not thinking of my own good, but of the good of all, so that they might be saved.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi kom maa ni na maa ka ti Duuma Shia Kasi daa kpuɣi Filip chaŋ, ka namɔɣili maa bi lan nya o, ka mi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya maa yiɣisi yomyom kab ti kpe Gibia puuni n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be tiŋ maa ni.
en: These men ran quickly toward Gibeah; they spread out in the city and killed everyone there.

dag: Yi yi ti dɔɣi bihi, ka yi bihi maa mi dɔɣi bihi, ka yi nini ti tiɣi yimaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, yi yi ti mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛlikam n-tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: Once you have had children and grandchildren and have grown old on the land, if you ruin things by making an idol, in any form whatsoever, and do what is evil in the eyes of the LORD your God and anger him.

dag: nti kpuɣi Baal jɛmbu binnan shɛli din be di ni na nti nyo li buɣim.
en: brought out the sacred pillar that was there, and burned it.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, a zaɣis o, ka mal o ansarisi; a suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a ninvuɣ gahindili zuɣu.
en: But you, God, have rejected and despised him. Youve become infuriated with your anointed one.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri firila na mi n-kpi? Bɛ na mi n-nya ashaara? Ka Naawuni suhu na mi n-yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka biɛrim paai ba?.
en: But how often does God blow out their light? How often does trouble come to them? How often does God get angry with them and punish them?.

dag: O daa doli o ba ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa, ka jɛm o ba ni daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: Amon worshiped the idols Manasseh had made and.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi tiŋgbana mini di fɔntinsi ni di tintarisi ni di tiŋgbana maa puuni fɔntinsi zaa ti Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya ni Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: So Moses gave that land to the people of Gad, to the people of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh. That land included the kingdom of Sihon the Amorite and the kingdom of King Og of Bashan and all the cities around that area.

dag: Laɣimmiya tab na. Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa, vumiya mirina. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ dari ginda, ka jɛmdi wuna din ku tooi tiligi ba la nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni.
en: The Lord says, Come together, people of the nations, all who survive the fall of the empire; present yourselves for the trial! The people who parade with their idols of wood and pray to gods that cannot save them— those people know nothing at all!.

dag: Ŋuni ka Izraɛl naa lee yina kariti doli ŋɔ? Ŋuni ka a lee kariti doli ni a ku ŋɔ? A kariti dolila ba kpiŋ! A kariti dolila buduli zaɣ bila.
en: Who are you chasing? Did the king of Israel bring an army to chase a single flea or a dying dog?.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni ka jɛmdila Naawuni ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbani maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛ ʒini maa buɣa.
en: But the people were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and deserted him to worship the gods of the nations whom God had driven out of the land.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Judas, puhigu mini kpariŋ mɔɣisibu ka a yɛn zaŋ yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa.
en: But Jesus said to him, Judas, are you using the kiss of friendship to hand over the Son of Man to his enemies.

dag: Di tamya saamba saani niŋbu yɛla, dama shɛb daa niŋdi saani lala hal ti niŋ malaikanim saani ka bi baŋ ni malaikanim m-bala.
en: Dont neglect to open up your homes to guests, because by doing this some have been hosts to angels without knowing it.

dag: Bɛ daa kpiya ka bɛ saha na bi paai kaman kom ni ʒiri tanzaa chani shɛm la.
en: who were snatched prematurely when a river flooded their foundations.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa kpahiri yi zuɣu ni ŋɔ kun ya lari. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni chɛ ka yi tiligibu niŋ tom. Dama n wum ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zali ka wuhi ni o ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa shɛm.
en: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa lan me duri zali buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka pii niriba maa ni shɛb bɛn pa Lɛvi zuliya n-leei maligumaaniba.
en: Jeroboam also built places of worship on hilltops, and he chose priests from families who were not of the tribe of Levi.

dag: So yi zaŋ o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli ti Yawɛ, dindina di daa yɛn dolila di ni yɛn tooi deei bimbira shɛm. Pal shɛli din ni biri siŋkaafa tah ayi daa ni nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: You might dedicate a field to the Lord . The value of this field will depend on how much seed is needed to plant it. It will be shekels of silver for each homer of barley seed.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man niŋ naani.
en: I hate those who embrace what is completely worthless. I myself trust the LORD.

dag: ka o yɛl o, Dindina bɛn fiɣis a maa n-ni kana ka n naanyi wum a nol ni. Ka daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd yiŋa n-gul o.
en: he said, I will hear you when your accusers arrive. Then he gave orders for Paul to be kept under guard in the governor's headquarters.

dag: Bɛ naɣilahi kul durila viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ naɣinyama kul dɔɣira, ka na ʒi n-zaŋ bahi.
en: Their bulls never fail to mate. Their cows have healthy calves.

dag: Ka chɛ ka niriba maa zaa gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe nudirigu mini nuzaa polo zaa gili naa ka shɛb mi ʒe n-gili sara maligu bimbini la mini duu maa.
en: He positioned all the people, each with their weapons drawn, near the altar and the temple, stretching from the south side of the temple to the north side, so as to protect the king.

dag: Amaa baŋmi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi. Zomla ŋuna, ka chɛ ka a suhu zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: Remember that I, the Lord Almighty, am holy; I am the one you must fear.

dag: O ni mi bɛ tuma zuɣu, yuŋ ka o ŋmɛri paari ba, ka ŋmɛri kabisiri ba.
en: Because he knows what they do; he overthrows them and crushes them by night.

dag: Di simdi ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka nya faako. Di simdi ni n yaai n noli garigi.
en: I will speak and get relief; I will open my lips and respond.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn ni Jaza ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Heshbon and its pastures; Jazer and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: Ka chɛ ka niriba maa zaa gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe nudirigu mini nuzaa polo zaa gili naa ka shɛb mi ʒe n-gili sara maligu bimbini la mini duu maa.
en: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi so mi yaha, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a? Ka o yɛl o, Za ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ taɣi sab pihinii.
en: The manager asked someone else who was in debt to his master, How much do you owe? A thousand sacks of wheat, the man replied. The manager said, Take your bill and write . .

dag: A ni kpi zo shɛli a ni yɛn du maa zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣ a pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a mabia Aduna ni daa kpi Hɔr Zoli zuɣu ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: You will die on that mountain as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Ritima maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Rimɔnpɛrɛz.
en: They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmon Perez.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bɛnkam maani maligu buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri bɛ wuna Mɔab la chɛ li niŋbu.
en: I will get rid of anyone who burns incense to the gods of Moab or offers sacrifices at their shrines. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai nti suhi Naawuni ti ba ni bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: When they arrived, they prayed for the believers that they might receive the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ boli Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn nyɛ Naftali mini Asha ni Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa, ka bɛ kana ti doli Midiannim maa.
en: Gideon sent word for more Israelite soldiers to come from the tribes of Naphtali, Asher, and both halves of Manasseh to help fight the Midianites.

dag: Chɛ ka a ninni neesim neei niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Shine your face on your servant, and teach me your statutes.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n yur a zaligunim maa gari salima din viɛlli pam.
en: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.

dag: Tim ma yɛm mini baŋsim shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ gbib niriba ŋɔ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: and make me wise. Give me the knowledge I'll need to be the king of this great nation of yours.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa ʒii buta, ka zaŋ kikahi mini firilanim ni be duɣubihi shɛŋa ni ti bɛ zaa.
en: He divided the three hundred men into three units and equipped every man with a trumpet and an empty jar, with a torch inside each jar.

dag: Ti ka soli ni ti kpuɣ paɣiba n-ʒiri ba kaman ti tuuntab mini ti Duuma tizɔbihi ni Pita ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.

dag: Buri din tiri daŋa nyɛla din yihiri zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋmɛri nyɛ din maani ninsal niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: Blows and bruises remove evil; beatings cleanse the inner parts.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔyakim ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti teei gil li.
en: In the third year of the rule of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar came to Jerusalem and attacked it.

dag: ka zaŋ suhudoo lahibal suŋ molo molibu leei namdanim piri.
en: and put shoes on your feet so that you are ready to spread the good news of peace.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi ni n nuu yi yi zaa nyɛviya bahi yoli taali ni.
en: So today I can tell you one thing that I am sure of: God will not blame me if some of you are not saved.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Ka a paɣ Zara be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, O be tanti suɣili ŋɔ ni.
en: Then they asked him, Where is your wife Sarah? She is there in the tent, he answered.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka yi o daalikauli la nyaaŋa zaŋ tabili Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, ka zaɣisi li dolibu.
en: All this happened because they wouldnt listen to the LORD their God. They broke his covenant—all that the LORDs servant Moses had commanded them. They didnt listen, and they didnt do it.

dag: Yawɛ, n nyɛla a dabili. N nyɛla a dab bipuɣiŋga bia. A kabisi m bandi.
en: Oh yes, LORD, I am definitely your servant! I am your servant and the son of your female servant— youve freed me from my chains.

dag: Ka Leeban yɛl o, N yi zaŋ o ti a, di so ni n zaŋ o ti do so, kpalimmi n sani.
en: Laban said, Id rather give her to you than to another man. Stay with me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza naai Ijipti daazichi zaa.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, I will use King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to put an end to Egypt's wealth.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Shɛkɛmnim gba nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tibidarigibo kaman Gidiɔn bia Jɔtan la ni daa pun yɛli noli ti ba wuhi ni di ni niŋ ba shɛm la.
en: God also punished the people of Shechem for helping Abimelech. Everything happened just as Jotham's curse said it would.

dag: A ni zaŋ o bidibisi maa gba na ti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba.
en: Then put the clothes on his sons.

dag: Bɛ daai nandaamba baɣili palli kpaŋa, ka nandaamba zaa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: They force the poor to move out of their way and to get off the road.

dag: Ti mini ti nanim ni ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim tum vi tuma, ka tum alahichi nyin Yawɛ sani.
en: LORD, we are ashamed—we, our kings, our leaders, and our parents who sinned against you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa kul ni beni sahakam, amaa ʒiri yɛtɔɣa bi yuura.
en: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only for a moment.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa lab kuli, ka naa maa ti bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ŋmaligi labina.
en: The messengers returned to Ahaziah. He said to them, Why have you come back.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Bɛnkam doli di soli mali baŋsim viɛlli. O paɣibu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Respect and obey the Lord ! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Jona ŋun nyɛ Amitai bia la.
en: The Lord spoke to Jonah son of Amittai:.

dag: Waazuyihira maa pala yɛndana kɔŋko, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhi niriba baŋsim, ka bɔhim, ka kpahim yɛla baŋ li, ka ŋahi ŋaha pam.
en: But because the Philosopher was wise, he kept on teaching the people what he knew. He studied proverbs and honestly tested their truth.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni baŋ ni bɛ je ma zuɣu ka o ti ma bidibiga ŋɔ gba; ka daa bol o yuli Simiɔn.
en: She became pregnant again and gave birth to another son. She said, The Lord has given me this son also, because he heard that I was not loved; so she named him Simeon.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti gbani Yisa tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, sɔŋm ma.
en: Then the woman came over to Jesus and bowed before him. She said, Lord, help me.

dag: Shɛhiralan ŋun ʒe yim bi ŋmari ʒiri, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralan ŋun kul tuhirila ʒiri bahira.
en: A truthful witness doesnt lie, but a false witness spews lies.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa paɣ maa dɔɣir so ni ti di nam. Ka lala naa maa ni ti chaŋ ti liri Siria naa min o tɔbbihi n-kab kpe bɛ sansan ni nti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.

dag: Amaa a yi labi tiŋ maa puuni nti yɛli Absalom, N dan naa, n ni leeg a kpambala. Kaman n ni yi kul nyɛ a ba kpambala shɛm, lala ka n yɛn nyɛ a gba kpambala, dina n-ni chɛ ka a nyaŋ Ahitɔfɛl yikombiɛlim maa ti ma.
en: Go back into the city and tell Absalom, Your Majesty, I am your servant. I will serve you now, just as I served your father in the past. Hushai, if you do that, you can help me ruin Ahithophel's plans.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun me wuni bee m-mali binnani bee binshɛlikam din chihiri Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba tuma n-zaŋ li zali ashilɔni, noli din dim o. Ka sokam garigi yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is the one who makes a false god and puts it in its secret place. These false gods are only statues that some worker makes from wood, stone or metal. The Lord hates these things! Then all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Ka firila ti ku lan ne a ni; ka so mi ti ku lan wum amiliya aŋgo min o daamiliya kukoya a ni, dama a kɔhigɔriba daa nyɛla dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira, ka a daa zaŋ a baɣibuɣibo yɔhim zuliya kam.
en: Never again will the light of a lamp be seen in you; no more will the voices of brides and grooms be heard in you. Your merchants were the most powerful in all the world, and with your false magic you deceived all the peoples of the world.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka daa ku Filistianim maa Gɛba hal ti paai Gɛza.
en: David obeyed the Lord and defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Geba to the entrance to Gezer.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣirimi dooni tiŋkpansi n-guri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Bɛ kul lihirimi ni bɛ nya bɛn ku tooi sɔŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: They hide themselves in the villages, waiting to murder innocent people. They spy on their helpless victims;.

dag: Ka n daa su a kom, m-paɣ a ni ʒim maa bahi, ka ʒe a kpam.
en: I washed the blood off you and rubbed your skin with olive oil.

dag: ka taɣ o niɣi min o biŋkɔbbaligu shɛb zaa bɛn daa nyɛ o nyɔri m-pah o ni daa zali naɣ shɛb Mɛsopoteemia la zuɣu n-lu soli kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni o ba Yisahaku sani.
en: northern Syria for the home of his father Isaac in Canaan. Jacob took along all his flocks, herds, and other property.

dag: Yawɛ daa naan ku tooi lan deei yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa maa, dinzuɣu ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari ka bahi yoli doya ka bɛ turi li, ka so ka di ni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: The Lord hated the terrible things you did, and he could not be patient with you any longer. So he made your country an empty desert. No one lives there now. Other people say bad things about that country.

dag: Di saha ka Shɛkɛm gba daa yɛli Daina ba min o tizɔdɔbba maa, Yi yi saɣi ti ma, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni yi bɔri shɛlikam.
en: Shechem also talked to Jacob and to Dinahs brothers and said, Please accept me. I will do anything you ask me to do.

dag: Bɛna n-daa sɔŋ Dauda tuhi ŋmɛnditoya la, dama bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka lan nyɛ sapashin kpamba.
en: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya! Ka Na so ŋun mali jilima ŋɔ gari kpɛna.
en: Mighty gates: lift up your heads! Ancient doors: rise up high! So the glorious king can enter!.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisili, di kul kpɛrila ninsal niŋgbuna puuni.
en: Gossip is so tasty! How we love to swallow it!.

dag: zaŋ tabili bɛn tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba ni bɛn zaŋdi muɣisigu gbahiri niriba ni ʒiŋmariba ni bɛn zaa niŋdi din chihiri wuhibu maŋa la zuɣu.
en: for the immoral, for sexual perverts, for kidnappers, for those who lie and give false testimony or who do anything else contrary to sound doctrine.

dag: ni Mɛjarikɔn ni Rakɔn ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili chaŋ ti gili Jɔpa.
en: Mejarkon, and Rakkon, as well as the territory around Joppa.

dag: Paɣimiya yi situra daba ayopɔin dali din ni chɛ ka yi be kasi. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi kpe sansani ŋɔ ni na.
en: Wash your clothes on the seventh day, and after that, you will be clean and may return to the camp.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked the LORD, Should I attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me? Attack them, the LORD replied, because I will definitely hand the Philistines over to you.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni.
en: I am the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo mi di daa chaŋmi ti ŋmaligi kpa Hannatɔn polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Ɛfitahɛl Vinvamli ni.
en: On the north the border turned toward Hannathon, ending at Iphtahel Valley.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti yuri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni bihi. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti yuri Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima.
en: How do we know that we love Gods children? We know because we love God and we obey his commands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sairus ŋun nyɛ o ni pii so la, N niŋ a yiko ni a tuhi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka fa nanim yaa. N ni yooi dunoli kam ti a, ka bɛ ku kpari duno shɛli.
en: The Lord has chosen Cyrus to be king. He has appointed him to conquer nations; he sends him to strip kings of their power; the Lord will open the gates of cities for him. To Cyrus the Lord says.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti paai Sidɔn, ka sapashini Julius daa niŋ Pool nirilim wɔɣis o ka o chaŋ o zɔnim sani ka bɛ ti niŋ o saani.
en: The next day we arrived at Sidon. Julius was kind to Paul and allowed him to go and see his friends, to be given what he needed.

dag: Jɔshua daa ŋme nanim maa zaa tɔbu yuui pam.
en: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ka tumdi din doli zaligu soli mini din tuhi, bɛ ni be di zuɣu.
en: When someone evil quits sinning and does what is right and good, he has saved his life.

dag: Zɔfa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sua mini Harinɛfa ni Shual ni Bɛri ni Imira.
en: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Hanani daa ka Juda Naa Asa sanna ti yɛl o, A ni niŋla Siria naa naani ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ naani la zuɣu, Siria naa tɔbbihi maa ni ti zo ka chɛ a.
en: At that time the prophet Hanani went to King Asa and said, Because you relied on the king of Syria instead of relying on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Israel has escaped from you.

dag: M mabihi, doliya anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ ti Duuma yuli tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa la naba yi suɣilɔdibo din yuuri yi wahala dibu puuni la.
en: Brothers and sisters, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord as an example of patient resolve and steadfastness.

dag: So daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-viɛli paai Absalom. O daa ka dalinli o napɔnvari ni zaŋ hal ni o zuɣu ni.
en: People really bragged about how good-looking Absalom was. No man in Israel was as handsome as Absalom. Every part of his body was perfect—from his head to his feet.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔbiri ŋmani paɣiba zabiri, ka bɛ nyina be kaman gbuɣinli nyina la.
en: Their hair was like women's hair, their teeth were like lions' teeth.

dag: Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Adiɛl bia la n-daa su nayili azichi fukumsi, ka Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Uzia bia la mi daa nyɛ ŋun su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ fɔntinsi ni tiŋkpansi du shɛŋa din du pam azichi fukumsi.
en: This is the list of men who were responsible for the kings property: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the kings storerooms. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storerooms in the small towns, villages, fields, and towers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum zoli maa ka n sanna nti guhiri nimaani, ka n zaŋ n ni sabi n zaligunim niŋ kuɣ parilan shɛŋa ni niriba maa wuhibu zuɣu la ti a.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Come up to me on the mountain and wait there. Ill give you the stone tablets with the instructions and the commandments that Ive written in order to teach them.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Zoya tiŋgbani maa ku saɣ ti, ka Keenannim mi ʒi tintan ni, ka mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi. Bɛ ni shɛb bɛn be Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni bɛn be Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni la zaa mal li mi.
en: They replied, The hill country is not big enough for us, but the Canaanites in the plains have iron chariots, both those who live in Beth Shan and its surrounding towns and those who live in Jezreel Valley.

dag: Ka n yi vuɣi ba, di nyaaŋa n ni lan zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni.
en: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paag a n-kpims a zaa. N ni ku a daŋ ni doo kam ŋun nyɛ bilichina bee dabili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So this is what he says to you: I will make something bad happen to you. I will kill you and every male in your family.

dag: dama ŋun puh o gba leela ŋun pah o zuɣu tum o tuumbiɛri maa.
en: For anyone who wishes them peace becomes their partner in the evil things they do.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam. Di simdi ni ti lur o sizuura gari wuna zaa.
en: The Lord is great and worthy of praise. He is more awesome than any of the gods.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi yomyom bɛ tɛha ni ni ti leei baŋdiba, ka bɛn tɔri birilim ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa din niŋ kamaata ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They will not be impatient any longer, but they will act with understanding and will say what they mean.

dag: Yuuni maa puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣ pisiniyini dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai na ni o ti yɛl ti.
en: On the st day of the seventh month, this message from the Lord came to Haggai:.

dag: O daa darig o niriba maa tibili n-chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni. O suhuyiɣisili puuni, o daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kana ti ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: The Lord will settle his argument with Israel by sending the people far away. He will speak harshly to Israel. His words will burn like the hot desert wind.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, labimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, dama yi tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka yi daa tuui lu.
en: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord , your God. Sin has made you fall.

dag: Bɛ diri birapu ka kuri niriba a ni. Yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka niŋdi ba nyɔri, ka pahiri yi nɛma daa n-fari yi taba nyari buni ka tam n yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: There men accept bribes to kill people. You lend money and charge interest on the loans. You cheat your neighbors just to make a little money. You have even forgotten me. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ni Gomna Fɛstus ni bɛn zaa daa ʒi bɛ sani yiɣisi yi.
en: Then the king, the governor, Bernice, and all the others got up.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛl a, amaa m bi bɔri ni n zaŋ alikalimi mini tadabo -sab li ti a.
en: I have many things I want to tell you. But I dont want to use pen and ink.

dag: ka o ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na, ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi gbala polo na tuhir o soli.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man came to him from the caves where the dead are buried. This man had an evil spirit living inside him.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔsis ma Mariama daa nya bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw where he was buried.

dag: ka yihi bɛn daa be dabitim ni bɛ bebu puuni zaa kum dabiɛm zuɣu la bahi.
en: and in this way set free those who were slaves all their lives because of their fear of death.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa Masia wuh o suɣilɔdibo zaa ni nyɛ shɛm man ŋun nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam zaa ŋɔ sani; ka di leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn niŋ o yɛda n-nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la ni ni doli so shɛli.
en: But I was given mercy so that in me Christ Jesus could show that he has patience without limit. Christ showed his patience with me, the worst of all sinners. He wanted me to be an example for those who would believe in him and have eternal life.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Asahɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la mini Ɛlhanan ŋun daa nyɛ Dɔdo Bɛtilihɛm nir bia la.
en: The mighty warriors: Asahel, Joabs brother; Elhanan, Dodos son from Bethlehem.

dag: Binshɛli beni ka di daa simdi ni n niŋ di ni ka m bi niŋ li? N daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, ka bɔ n-chɛ ka di ti zaŋ walila wal biɛri?.
en: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia Yisa ŋun daa chaŋ ti be Naawuni san la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti daadiini ŋɔ kirikiri.
en: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.

dag: Bɛ yirimi chani bɛ tuma ni kaman mɔɣu ni bunsi m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la m-bɔri bindirigu tiŋgban shɛli din chaɣisi puuni ni bɛ ti ti bɛ bihi.
en: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri teeku maa n-chɛ ka kom maa nahi tab yaha n-lim Ijiptinim maa n-tabili bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛ chɛchɛbunduhiriba maa zaa.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Hold out your hand over the sea, and the water will come back over the Egyptians and their chariots and drivers.

dag: O ni daa baŋ Pita kukoli, suhupiɛlli zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi yooi dunol maa, amaa ka naɣ zomi kpe nti yɛli ni Pita ʒe dunol ni.
en: She was so overcome with joy when she recognized Peters voice that she didnt open the gate. Instead, she ran back in and announced that Peter was standing at the gate.

dag: Shɛli ka ti ni din ni chɛ ka ti yɛli ni ti nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum tuma ŋɔ. Din chɛ ka ti tooi tumdi li yila Naawuni sanna.
en: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.

dag: O ni daa tuui me sara maligu bimbini zali luɣ shɛl la; nimaani ka Ibram daa jɛm Yawɛ.
en: and had built an altar. There he worshiped the Lord .

dag: Ka m bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli, Man Yisa so a ni niŋdi alaka maa m-bala.
en: Then I said, Who are you, Lord? The Lord replied, I am Jesus, whom you are harassing.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣi bindira pam ti ba, ka bɛ di ka nyu n-naai, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ naa sani. Ka Sirianim daa bi lan kana ti liri Izraɛlnim yaha.
en: The king ordered a huge meal to be prepared for Syria's army, and when they finished eating, he let them go. For a while, the Syrian troops stopped invading Israel's territory.

dag: Anabinim mini karimbanim daa be Antiɔk cheechi ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ Baanabas mini Simiɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Naija la ni Lusius ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini tiŋbia la mini Manaɛn, bɛ ni daa laɣim wumsi so mini Naa Hɛrɔd la m-pahi Sool.
en: In the church at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon , Lucius , Manaen , and Saul.

dag: Di chɛ ka shɛli yɛla niŋ a nandahima bee n-chɛ ka shɛli ti a biɛrim a niŋgbuna ni. Dama bipolitali mini biɛhigu piligu nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Dont let your anger control you, and dont let your body lead you to sin. People do foolish things in the dawn of life while they are young.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Gbuɣinli yi gbaai piɛɣu ku o, ka piɛguliba kul tahiri pampam kabo, o ku zo ka chɛ piɛɣu maa. Lala n-nyɛ li; binshɛli kani din ni chɛ ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ku guli Ziɔn Zoli, ka tuhi fa li.
en: The Lord said to me, No matter how shepherds yell and shout, they can't scare away a lion from an animal that it has killed; in the same way, there is nothing that can keep me, the Lord Almighty, from protecting Mount Zion.

dag: O ni tiligi ma ni alaafee n ni tuhiri tɔb shɛŋa la ni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: He will bring me safely back from the battles that I fight against so many enemies.

dag: ka nya ka pako faralan so daa tɔhi pihinu diba ayi.
en: He also saw a poor widow throw in two small copper coins worth a penny.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ashpɛnaz ni daa zaŋ o min o tab niriba ata la niŋ so nuu ni ni o lihiri ba la sani ti yɛl o.
en: So Daniel went to the guard whom Ashpenaz had placed in charge of him and his three friends.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaligu kundi la n-gili Juda fɔntinsi ni zaa wuhi niriba.
en: They took the book of the Law of the Lord and went through all the towns of Judah, teaching it to the people.

dag: Ka sagbana mini sakuɣa ni sala buɣim daa puhi yi neesim din be o tooni maa ni na.
en: Out of the brightness before him, hail broke through the clouds with flashes of lightning.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu; dama niriba kul durimi tamdi n zuɣu; n dimnim kul nahindi ma mi dabisili kam puuni.
en: Be merciful to me, O God, because I am under attack; my enemies persecute me all the time.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, A yuma na bi paai yuun pihinu, ka wula ka a niŋ n-nya ti yab Ibrahimma.
en: You arent even years old! the Jewish opposition replied. How can you say that you have seen Abraham.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bihi, wummiya n yɛligu ka di zaɣisiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Now listen to me, sons, and never forget what I am saying.

dag: Yuuni kam puuni ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni tɔhiri anzinfa giram diba anu, ka bɛ mal li tumdi ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma.
en: Once a year we will each donate a small amount of silver to the temple of our God.

dag: Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti paŋ liɣiri n-yo farigu ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri zuɣu naa sani.
en: Still others said, We have had to borrow money against our fields and vineyards in order to pay the kings tax.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zuliya bɔbili sunsuuni; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: I will praise you, Lord , and I will honor you among the nations.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli tiŋgban kuŋ maa Tiŋgbani, ka boli kom din laɣim do luɣ yini maa mi Teeku. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: God named the dry ground Land, and he named the water Ocean. God looked at what he had done and saw that it was good.

dag: Di kari mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ saria, dama so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ka taali a sani.
en: Dont judge me, your servant. No one alive could be judged innocent by your standards.

dag: Tumo maa daa yɛlila Dauda, Ti dimnim maa daa gari ti la yaa ka yina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti polo ni, amaa ka ti daa lan daai ba labisi bɛ tiŋ maa dunɔdal ni.
en: The messenger told David, The men of Ammon attacked us in the field. We fought them and chased them all the way to the city gate.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli, Yinim Zɛruya bihi ŋɔ, wula ka n yɛn niŋ ya? Di yi nyɛla Yawɛ n-yɛl o, Tum Dauda, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi lala.
en: But the king said, My problems arent yours, you sons of Zeruiah. If he is cursing because the LORD told him to curse David, then who is to question, Why are you doing this.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zɛrubabɛl, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma; Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba, tummiya tuma maa, m be yi sani.
en: But cheer up! Because I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be here to help you with the work.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa du Galili Teeku maa duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus and his disciples came to the other side of the lake, to the region of the Gerasenes.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaɣisi Balaam ni bɔri ni o niŋ shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa naɣi zaŋla o noli yɛlibu maa leei alibarika tin ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa yuri ya zuɣu.
en: But the Lord your God would not listen to Balaam; instead he turned the curse into a blessing, because he loved you.

dag: Amaa di ku yuui ka yɛla ayi ŋɔ zaa paag a dahin yini puuni. A baɣibuɣibo min a tima la zaa yoli, a ni bahi kɔŋ yidana mini bihi.
en: Both of these will happen to you at once, on a single day: childlessness and widowhood will envelop you in full measure, despite your many sorceries, despite your very powerful spells.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ shi so niŋ o ni, ka di chɛ ka o wum ŋumaŋuma yɛla ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. .
en: Look, I will send a spirit against the king of Assyria. He will get a report warning him about a danger, so he will return to his own country. And I will cut him down with a sword in his own country.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan kuhi yɛli, Haliluya! Tin titali maa buɣim dibu nyɔhi kul ni tuɣiri hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: These people also said, Hallelujah! She is burning and her smoke will rise forever and ever.

dag: Amaa n yi ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, n ni chɛ ka a noli yaai ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya. Chɛ ka bɛn ni wum, wum. Ka chɛ ka bɛn zaɣisi wumbu, zaɣisi. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Then, when I speak to you again and give you back the power of speech, you will tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying. Some of them will listen, but some will ignore you, for they are a nation of rebels.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Nyin Saimɔn, Jona bia, a mal alibarika! Dama pa daadam ni o zabigu n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuh a, amaa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-kahigi li wuh a.
en: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.

dag: Ka ti yi kahigi ti daalahichi wuhi Naawuni, o nyɛla ŋun ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka ni chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, ka kul ni kpihindi dinkam zaa bi doli wuntia soli ti biɛhigu ni bahira.
en: But if we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and cleanse us from everything weve done wrong.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Shallum ŋun daa di nam zan o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni gbaai so kpe n-zaŋ o chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku lan labi kpe na yaha.
en: This is what the LORD says about Shallum son of Judahs King Josiah, who succeeded his father Josiah as king but who is now gone from this place: He will never return!.

dag: O daa tɛhimi ni Pool ni ti o liɣiri, dinzuɣu ka o daa kul timdi ti boon o na waawaayili ka o min o ti diri alizama.
en: At the same time, he was hoping that Paul would offer him some money, so he often sent for him and talked with him.

dag: Ka Sɛrafinim daa ʒe o zuɣusaa polo. Bɛ zaa yinoyino daa malila kpiŋkpama ayɔbuyɔbu. Bɛ daa zaŋla diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ nina, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ napɔnvari, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi yiɣira.
en: Around him flaming creatures were standing, each of which had six wings. Each creature covered its face with two wings, and its body with two, and used the other two for flying.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla tarimba ni yino bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-kpe taali ni.
en: Finally, one of you common people might sin without meaning to. You might break one of the commands of the Lord and become guilty of doing something he said must not be done.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa chibi soli teeku ni, ka daa ŋme solɔɣu sɔŋ kom pam puuni.
en: The Lord is making roads through the sea. He is making a path for his people, even through rough waters. The Lord says.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la daa bi pahi tipawumlinim zuɣu bahi yoli, o ni daa deei ninvuɣ puɣisiriba la ni suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.

dag: Ti ni daa nya so ka wum o yɛla maa yɛla ka ti yɛri ya maa ni di chɛ ka ti mini ya mali dolintabitali, ka ti mi dolintabitali maa bela ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia Yisa Masia sani.
en: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.

dag: ni Shabɛtai mini Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu Samban ni tuma fukumsi la.
en: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa chaŋ ti gbahi ŋɔri kɔbisita n-zaŋ bɛ zuya gbin taba ka zaŋ buɣim mokpala shɛbisishɛbisi di gbina maa ni.
en: So Samson went out and caught foxes. He took two foxes at a time and tied their tails together to make pairs. Then he tied a torch between the tails of each pair of foxes.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb tiri pini, amaa ka bɛ buni kul nabirimi pahira, ka shɛb mi vili bɛ ni su shɛli gbibi ka kɔŋda.
en: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai, nyin di mir o ni a bo o.
en: Do not have intercourse with a woman during her monthly period, because she is ritually unclean.

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu n fabila ŋɔ puuni. Fam n nyɛvili bahi, dama n zɔrila n dimnima.
en: God, listen to my complaint. Save me from the terrible threats of my enemies!.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa guui yomyom chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, do so ŋun daa ka n sanna la lan yi n zuɣu.
en: So the woman hurriedly ran and informed her husband. She said to him, The man who came to me the other day has just appeared to me.

dag: zaawuni yuŋ lihaliha saha ni yuŋ zibisim saha.
en: in the evening after it was dark.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba m-bala kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zali Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab maa samli ka bɛ yo, ka bɛ naanyi bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The authorities made Jason and the others pay the required amount of money to be released, and then let them go.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali, yin zaŋmiya naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka di niŋ kasi.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: In the first month, on the first day of the month, you will take a young bull that has nothing wrong with it. You must use that bull to make the Temple pure.

dag: N dabisa pala biɛla? Chɛli ma ka n suhu maai biɛla.
en: Isn't my life almost over? Leave me alone! Let me enjoy the time I have left.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana min o nyaaŋa bɛn nyɛ Sadusiinim la daa zab Yisa tuumba maa nyuli.
en: The high priest, together with his allies, the Sadducees, was overcome with jealousy.

dag: Teemi Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun daa neei kum ni kaman n ni daa wuhi shɛm n lahibal suŋ molo molibu ni la yɛla.
en: Remember Jesus Christ, who was raised from the dead and descended from David. This is my good news.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul kuhirimi ni n suhu zaa, garigim ma, n ni dol a zaligunima.
en: I pray to you, Lord ! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.

dag: Naawuni, a soli nyɛla din be kasi; wun ŋuni n-lee galisi paai ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: God, your way is holiness! Who is as great a god as you, God?.

dag: Ka ti yi mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam o deeri ti suhigu, dindina ti mi ni o tiri ti ti ni suhir o shɛlikam.
en: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu tuma yi zahira. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni kɔr biɛri balibu kam.
en: The wrong things the sinful self does are clear: committing sexual sin, being morally bad, doing all kinds of shameful things.

dag: Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Anabi Hagai.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month of the second year that Darius was emperor, the Lord Almighty spoke again to the prophet Haggai.

dag: Mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ti ŋubiri mɔri, o lan kumda? Bee nahu yi ti ŋubiri taɣitaɣi, o lan ŋumda?.
en: Does a donkey bray over grass or an ox bellow over its fodder?.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi niriba maa sani nti zaŋ li yɛli ba.
en: So Moses went down to the people and told them.

dag: Yawɛ alibarika ni yi Ziɔn na paag a. Naawuni chɛ ka a nya Jɛrusalɛm tɔŋbu a dunia yili bebu ni zaa.
en: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.

dag: ka Shɛfufam daŋ niriba nyɛ Shufamnima; ka Hufam daŋ niriba nyɛ Hufamnima.
en: from Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; from Hupham, the Huphamite clan.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa din daa be zolɔna ni n-nyɛ: Ɛshitaol mini Zɔra ni Ashina.
en: In the lowlands: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba, N kamina ni n ti niŋ buɣim juui dunia ŋɔ, ka n di bi zaɣisi ka di pun taai dira.
en: I came to set fire to the earth, and I wish it were already on fire!.

dag: Bɛ daa bela mɔɣu ni kuhiri kaman bunsi la, ka laɣim do gɔhi tihi gbinni.
en: They howl in the bushes and huddle together under thornbushes.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ n nandahima puuni. N Naawuni ka n daa boli maa. Ka o daa be o jɛmbu duu puuni ka wum n kukoli; ka n kuhigu maa daa lu o tiba ni.
en: In my distress I cried out to the LORD; I cried out to my God. God heard my voice from his temple; my cry for help reached his ears.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛl o maa, A shiri nya o? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a di bi chɛ o sua luhi tiŋ na nimaani? N suhu naan paligi ka n ti a anzinfa laɣibaligu pia mini gbaŋ din lɔr sheeni.
en: Joab said to the man who told him, You saw this? Why didnt you kill him on the spot? I would have given you ten pieces of silver and a belt.

dag: Ka o yɛli doo maa, Yihim li, ka o zaŋ o nuu tim ha yihi li.
en: Lift it out, Elisha said. So the man then reached out and grabbed it.

dag: Ka shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni chɛ ka bɛ zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: There may come another time when I speak about a nation that I will build up or plant.

dag: Mbusim be ti zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ti buɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nuu ni bahi? Buɣ shɛŋa din daa zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam luhi Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku ba mɔɣu ni la m-bala.
en: Were doomed! Who will deliver us from the grip of these powerful deities? They are the same gods who struck the Egyptians in the desert with every kind of wound.

dag: N ni chani ni yolisim, dama m bo n-nya a zaligunima.
en: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu! A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, wummi n fabila. A wuntitali puuni, deemi n suhigu!.
en: Listen, Lord , as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.

dag: N nuu kul ni pa o zuɣu sahakam; n nuu ni chɛ ka o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: My strength will always be with him, my power will make him strong.

dag: Dindali maa ŋun ti be dufahirili zuɣu ka o nɛma be duu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe n-kah o nɛma maa. Ka ŋun mi ti be puu ni di lan kuli yiŋa.
en: On that day someone who is on the roof of a house must not go down into the house to get any belongings; in the same way anyone who is out in the field must not go back to the house.

dag: Amaa di ŋmɛriya tab naŋgbankpeeni, so mi di galim o kpee. Yinim maligumaaniba ŋɔ ka n galim.
en: The Lord says, Let no one accuse the people or reprimand them—my complaint is against you priests.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ ka n kuhiri niŋda. Di zaɣisi n kuhigu maa wumbu! Dama a yi shini ma, n ni ŋmanila kpiimba bɛn do gbala ni la.
en: Only you, Lord , are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni yuli m-booni Pishɔn. Dina n-zɔri gindi Havila tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka salima be nimaani.
en: The name of the first river is the Pishon. It flows around the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba, ka bɛ yɔri farigu o sani. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda kul diri nasara o ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Then he set up military camps in their territory, and they became his subjects and paid taxes to him. The Lord made David victorious everywhere.

dag: Babilɔn daa ŋmanila salima pipia m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o daa chɛ ka dunia zuliya kam nyu o wain buɣi ka di zuɣu chɛ ka zuliya kam kpe yinyari.
en: Babylon was my golden cup, filled with the wine of my anger. The nations of the world got drunk on this wine and went insane.

dag: hal niriba ata maa yi di beni, hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko n-naan tiligi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If these three men were in that nation when I punished it, not even their children would be spared. Only the three men would live.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la yɛli, Ami! Ka kpamba la mi daa gban tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: The four living creatures said Amen, while the elders knelt down and worshiped.

dag: Ka nyin na bɔri yɛl kara ni a ti amaŋa? Di lan bɔ li, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ninsalinim zaa. Amaa n ni tilig a nyɛvili a ni yɛn chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Baruch, you are looking for great things for yourself. Dont look for them, because I will make terrible things happen to all the people. This is what the Lord said. You will have to go many places. But I will let you escape alive wherever you go.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord God said:.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti bi zan tuh o, hal di yi nyɛ Naawuni daadiini zuɣulana gba, o ni chɛ ka bɛ ku o.
en: Anyone who opposes him, even God's High Priest, will be swept away and wiped out.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi deei farigu yaɣi bɛ ni zali ya ni yi deemi shɛm tariga.
en: He replied, Collect no more than you are authorized to collect.

dag: Utai daa nyɛla Ammihud bia, ka Ammihud daa nyɛ Omri bia, ka Omri nyɛ Imri bia, ka Imri nyɛ Bani bia. Bani maa daa yila Pɛrɛz daŋ ni na, ka Pɛrɛz mi daa nyɛ Juda bia.
en: Uthai son of Ammihud son of Omri son of Imri son of Bani from the family of Perez, Judahs son.

dag: N daa bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ashilɔni bee bumbɔn ni. N daa bi yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom ma luɣ shɛli din ka nyam shee. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, n tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, ka wuhiri din tuhi.
en: I have spoken openly, not in secret. I did not hide my words in a dark and secret place. I did not tell the people of Jacob to look for me in empty places. I am the Lord , and I speak the truth. I say only what is right.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla tɔɣisibu bi mili jɛrigu, ka ʒiri gba yɛtɔɣa bi simdi nabia.
en: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, a ku di vi, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, a ku nya filiŋ. A ni tam a bipalitali saha vi yɛla, ka tam saha shɛli a ni daa nyɛ pakoli ka nya filiŋ shɛl la yɛla.
en: Dont fear, because you wont be ashamed; dont be dismayed, because you wont be disgraced. You will forget the shame of your youth; youll no longer remember the disgrace of your widowhood.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa paai yili maa ni nti nya ka bia maa kpi n-dola o garo zuɣu.
en: When Elisha arrived, he went alone into the room and saw the boy lying dead on the bed.

dag: Amaa pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Din pahi nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun daa chɛ ka simdi kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni maa zuɣu.
en: But that is not all; we rejoice because of what God has done through our Lord Jesus Christ, who has now made us God's friends.

dag: Bɛ wain nyɛla tinvura lɔɣu. Di nyɛla sapaɣu lɔɣu din bie pam.
en: Their wine is like the poison of deadly snakes.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ piɛguliba ŋɔ, kummiya, kummiya pampam, ka lunya bilim tampiligim ni, dama yi kubu biɛɣu neeya, ka yi wurim kpe yɔɣu biɛɣu neei, ka yi ni ti lu kaman duɣu viɛlli la.
en: Wail, you shepherds, cry out. Roll in the dust, you masters of the flock! The day of your slaughter has arrived. You will fall and shatter like a fragile vase.

dag: Ka di chɛliya ka ti naɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni chɛ ka di chandi zaɣisibu niŋ ba miligu shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti kpaŋsiri tab suhuri, di bahi bamdi yi ni nya ka ti Duuma Dabisili dal la vuri miriti la zuɣu.
en: We must not quit meeting together, as some are doing. No, we need to keep on encouraging each other. This becomes more and more important as you see the Day getting closer.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa paai Mahanaim. Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa mi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
