en: David arrived at Mahanaim just as Absalom and the Israelites who were with him crossed over the Jordan River.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool Zanimi ka n yɛl a Yawɛ ni sa yɛli ma shɛm yuŋ la. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Samuel said to Saul, Stop! Let me tell you what the Lord told me last night. Saul answered, Tell me what he said.

dag: Ka bina ayi ŋɔ nyɛla din ku tooi taɣi, ka Naawuni mi ku ŋma ʒiri di puuni. Lala zuɣu di simdi ni tinim bɛn nya sɔɣibu shee Naawuni sani ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni pam gbibi tahima shɛli din be ti tooni la kirikiri.
en: These two things cannot change: God cannot lie when he says something, and he cannot lie when he makes an oath. So these two things are a great help to us who have come to God for safety. They encourage us to hold on to the hope that is ours.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M ma, ka wula ka a yɛl ni n niŋ? N saha na bi paai.
en: Jesus replied, Mother, my time hasn't yet come! You must not tell me what to do.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali ka Yisa daa gari tandi n-zaŋ neeg o nina maa.
en: The day Jesus had made mud and healed the mans eyes was a Sabbath day.

dag: Ka Musa daa deei tiliginsim liɣiri maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kalinli daa pani, ka nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yɛn tiligi shɛb maa sani.
en: So Moses took the money from those rescued over and above the ones rescued by the Levites.

dag: O bi ŋme ba luhi kaman o ni daa ŋme bɛn ŋme ba luhi la shɛm la. O mi bi ku ba kaman o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku ba la shɛm la.
en: Did God strike Israel as he struck those who struck him? Was Israel killed as his killers were killed?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi ti kul chani suɣili maa ni niriba zaa yiɣisirimi, ka sokam ʒe o suɣili dunol ni lihir o hal ka o ti kpe suɣili maa puuni.
en: Any time Moses went out to the tent, all the people watched him. They stood at the entrance of their tents and watched Moses until he entered the meeting tent.

dag: Di saha ka paɣipiɛlisi maa zaa daa yiɣisi malimali bɛ firilanima.
en: Then all those bridesmaids got up and prepared their lamps.

dag: ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai zo shɛli din doya miri Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli din do Rɛfaim Vinvamli nuzaa polo ni, ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hinnom Vinvamli din be Jɛbusi nudirigu polo kuŋkuni zuɣu la m-mali lala hal ti sirigi Ɛnrɔgɛl polo ha.
en: It then went down to the foot of the mountain that overlooks Hinnom Valley, at the north end of Rephaim Valley. It then went south through Hinnom Valley, south of the Jebusite ridge, toward Enrogel.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi liɣiri chaŋ. N suhu n-yu ni n yo yi mini bɛn yoli kana maa zaa yim.
en: Take your money now and go! What business is it of yours if I want to pay them the same that I paid you?.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔb maa tuhibu dali, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Naa Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zaa so daa ka takɔbi bee kpani; amaa Naa Sool min o bia Jɔnatan n-daa naɣi mali.
en: And so on the day of battle none of the Israelite soldiers except Saul and his son Jonathan had swords or spears.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la zaa m-pirigi li tinti Izraɛlnima kaman bɛ zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm ni di nyɛ bɛ fali. Ka tɔb tuhibu daa chɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi.
en: Joshua captured the whole land, as the Lord had commanded Moses. Joshua gave it to the Israelites as their own and divided it into portions, one for each tribe. So the people rested from war.

dag: Yuma ata nyaaŋa ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti kaai Pita. Biɛɣ pinaanu ka n daa niŋ o sani.
en: Three years later I went to Jerusalem to meet Peter. I stayed with him days.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa kpi ti zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim be, di yi nyɛ ti bela ti nyɛviya ni bee ti yi gbihirila kum puuni.
en: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.

dag: Ijipti naa, a yɛnnim la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yɛl a Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm.
en: King of Egypt, where are those clever advisers of yours? Perhaps they can tell you what plans the Lord Almighty has for Egypt.

dag: Kubu saha beni, ka tibbu saha beni. Daai luhi saha beni, ka me n-zali saha beni.
en: the time for killing and the time for healing, the time for tearing down and the time for building.

dag: To, fukumsi zaligu ni, Anabi Musa yɛliya ni ŋun niŋ lala, ti n-labim o kuɣa. Ka wula ka a mi lee yɛli.
en: The Law of Moses commands us to stone to death any such woman. What do you say we should do.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, yi ni guhiri dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ mali biɛr kasi ka ku mali galimi Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka suhudoo be yi min o sunsuuni.
en: Dear friends, we are waiting for this to happen. So try as hard as you can to be without sin and without fault. Try to be at peace with God.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Masia be yi suhuri ni yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi ba nyaɣa zani ka me yimaŋ tam yurilim zuɣu.
en: I ask that Christ will live in your hearts through faith. As a result of having strong roots in love.

dag: Kuɣa pihi sɔŋ lihi nya nyɛla din ŋmaari naŋgbankpeeni, ka lan nyɛ din maani wɔɣira ayi bɛn mali taba yɛla.
en: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba n-tiligi Kɛilanim maa.
en: David asked the Lord , Should I attack these Philistines? Yes, the Lord answered. Attack them and rescue Keilah.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa tim tuumba ka bɛ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka Baal jɛmdiba zaa daa laɣimna, ka so daa bi kpalim ka bi kana. Ka bɛ daa kpe Baal duu maa ni hal ti pal li, ka di luɣilikam zaa ti nyɛla niriba.
en: and Jehu sent word throughout all the land of Israel. All who worshiped Baal came; not one of them failed to come. They all went into the temple of Baal, filling it from one end to the other.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, Izraɛlnim miri ka bɛ kana ti miri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: But the other Israelites must never go near that Meeting Tent. If they do, they must be put to death!.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi ba, Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ ti paag o lua saha pala awa pinaayi? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam chani wuntaŋ ni bi tuura, ka di nyɛla o ni nyari dunia ŋɔ neesim la zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, There are twelve hours of light in the day. Whoever walks in the day will not stumble and fall because they can see with the light from the sun.

dag: Yi ni daa kpalim be Kadɛshi n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ la nyaaŋa.
en: So you stayed at Kadesh for such a long time.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima din ni chɛ ka o ku tahi zibisim na, ka yi tuui zoya zuɣu wuntaŋ ni; yi yi ti bɔri neesim saha shɛli, o chɛrimi ka di niŋ zibisim titali, ka chɛ ka di niŋ bumbɔni.
en: Honor the LORD your God, before its too late, before you stumble on the mountain paths in the evening shadows. Then you will hope for light, only to find darkness and gloom.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu daa ti miri puhibu, ka Yisa baŋ ni o saha paaya ni o chɛ dunia ŋɔ ka lab o Ba sani. Amaa o ni daa pun yur omaŋmaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni la, o daa kul yuri ba la lala hal ti yi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Before the Festival of Passover, Jesus knew that his time had come to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them fully.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ishimail bidibisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yuya m-boli bɛ tiŋkpansi mini bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannim pinaayi bɛ zuliyanim ni.
en: They were the ancestors of twelve tribes, and their names were given to their villages and camping places.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord told me to say: Announce what will happen and don't leave anything out.

dag: Yawɛ tiligir o daba nyɛviya; ka bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani so ku nya tibidarigibo.
en: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.

dag: ka lan wum o ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim nanima ayi la shɛlikam zaa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Nanima ayi maa n-nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa be Ashitarɔt la.
en: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.

dag: bɔhira, Kpe ka Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la kpɛra.
en: They asked, Is Simon Peter staying here.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu daa dii kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni na nti kuhi bɔhi.
en: Suddenly a man with an evil spirit in him entered the synagogue and yelled.

dag: N Naawuni, nyini ka n niŋ naani. Di chɛ ka n di vi; a mi di chɛ ka n dimnim di nasara ka chɛ ma.
en: My God, I trust you. Please dont let me be put to shame! Dont let my enemies rejoice over me!.

dag: ka Uziɛl bia Ɛlizafan daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The leader of the Kohathite family groups was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ bɛ paɣiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba mali biɛrisuŋ, ka pa ni bɛn nyɛ munaafichinima, amaa di simdi ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa ka ʒe yim binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: In the same way, women who are servants in the church should be dignified and not gossip. They should be sober and faithful in everything they do.

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Niriba nahindi ma ka di ka soli. Sɔŋm ma!.
en: All your commandments are true, but people harass me for no reason. Help me!.

dag: Niŋm mani a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m be, ka doli a yɛligu.
en: Be good to your servant so I can go on living and keeping your word.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n jɛrigiya pam ni bɛ boli ma daadam. N ka daadam tɛhi zilima.
en: Actually, Im too stupid to be human, a man without understanding.

dag: Saha shɛli kanna, ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman tia la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma, ka wali wala. Ka bɛ zuliya ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: In coming days, Jacob will take root; Israel will blossom and sprout and fill the whole world with produce.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bo bindirigu, ka niŋ kom niŋ kom koligu ni n-zaŋ li nyaɣili Haga, ka zaŋ bia maa pah o n-chɛ ka o chaŋ. Ka Haga daa chaŋ ti be Bɛrishiiba yɔɣu ni dari ginda.
en: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar some food and a leather bag full of water. He put the child on her back and sent her away. She left and wandered about in the wilderness of Beersheba.

dag: Di ni sɔhigi kaman buɣim ni chɛ ka kom din tam di zuɣu kpeeri shɛm la. Kamina ti wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm a dimnim sani, ka zuliya kam zaa ni sɔhig a tooni.
en: The mountains would burst into flames like burning bushes. The mountains would boil like water on the fire. Then your enemies would learn about you. And all nations would shake with fear when they see you.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam, ka a ti ku lan beni. Hal bɛ yi ti bo a shee, bɛ ku lan nya a yaha. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make you a terrifying example, and that will be the end of you. People may look for you, but you will never be found. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Di biɛɣ pinaanahi dali yuŋ ti ni daa chani ka pɔhim kul ʒiɛri ti bahiri Adria teeku ni la, ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka kpatoonsi maa tɛhi ni ti mirila duli.
en: For days and nights we had been blown around over the Mediterranean Sea. But about midnight the sailors realized we were getting near land.

dag: Hal saŋkpaliŋ zomi ka chɛ o biliɛɣu mɔɣu ni, dama mɔri lan kani.
en: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.

dag: ni tanvoya binyɛra ni tan piɛl viɛlli binyɛra ni bantabisi ni sarisi.
en: the mirrors and linen garments; the turbans and the veils.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ka n diri wahala, ka bɛ ba ma bandi kaman tuumbiɛrilana n-nyɛ ma la, amaa so ku tooi ba Naawuni yɛligu bandi.
en: And because I tell that message, I am suffering. I am even bound with chains like someone who has really done wrong. But Gods message is not bound.

dag: Ti zaa chirindi pam, ka so yi bi chirim o yɛtɔɣa puuni, dilan nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu be dɛde, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali yiko din ni tooi gbib o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.

dag: A halli zuɣu ka n daa zo a dabiɛm, dama a bɔri ni a nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri a ni bi biri binshɛli.
en: I was afraid of you because you are a hard man. You even take money that you didnt earn and gather food that you didnt grow.

dag: N yi siɣisi mmaŋa n-lo noli, bɛ turi ma la n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: When I spend time crying and fasting, they make fun of me.

dag: Nyin Asiria naa, a piɛguliba gbihiya. A ninvuɣ zuɣuri ʒeei gom. A niriba wurimya be zoya zuɣu, ka so kani ŋun ni laɣim ba.
en: Your shepherds have fallen asleep, king of Assyria! Your officials are lying down. Your people are scattered across the mountains; there is no one to gather them.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, dama daba ayopɔin ka ti yɛn zaŋ leei ya maligumaaniba.
en: The ceremony for appointing the priests will last for seven days. You must not leave the entrance of the Meeting Tent until that time is finished.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli din wuhiri din be ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni: Di gbinni nyɛla ni pina mini biŋkɔbiri sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi maani maligu nyɛla din ku tooi chɛ ka ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni suhu ni tɛha niŋ dɛde.
en: This is an example for us today. It shows that the gifts and sacrifices the priests offer to God are not able to make the consciences of the worshipers completely clear.

dag: A daa yɛli ma, Wumma, ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣa; n ni bɔh a bɔhigu, ka a garigi ma.
en: You told me to listen and answer your questions.

dag: Amaa lee chɛliya di tigbirigu din firi tiŋ la, ka bo kurigu mini daanya zoligo vil li n-chɛ li niŋ mɔɣu ni mo maha ni. Chɛliya ka maligim lu dilan zuɣu, ka chɛ ka o mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni tihi laɣim be.
en: But leave its stump and roots in the ground, surrounded by grass and held by chains of iron and bronze. Make sure that this ruler lives like the animals out in the open fields, unprotected from the dew.

dag: Ka Azibuk bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtizur yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa zaŋla lala hal ti paai Dauda siliga la tooni hal ti paai bɛ ni daa gbi mɔɣ shɛl la mini tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Nehemiah son of Azbuk repaired the next section. This Nehemiah was the governor of half the district of Beth Zur. He made repairs up to a place that is across from the tombs of David. And he worked as far as the man-made pool and the House of Heroes.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yɛl o bia pakoli Tama, Kulim a ba yiŋ ti ʒini pakolim hal ka m bia Shɛla ti zooi. O daa zɔrimi ni Shɛla gba ti kpi kaman o biɛyanim maa ni daa kpi shɛm maa. Dinzuɣu ka Tama daa kul o ba yiŋ ti ʒiya.
en: Judah did not want the same thing to happen to his son Shelah, and he told Tamar, Go home to your father and live there as a widow until my son Shelah is grown. So Tamar went to live with her father.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa fa Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛlnima, ka a ti bɔri ni a fa li?.
en: It was the Lord , the God of Israel, who forced the Amorites to leave their land. And he gave the land to the Israelites. Do you think you can make the Israelites leave this land?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Izraɛl zuɣulana hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Samuel served as Israels judge his whole life.

dag: Amaa maligumaana Zadok mini Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ni anabi Neetan ni Shimɛi ni Rɛi ni Dauda ninvuɣ kpɛma la daa ka Adɔnija polo.
en: but several important men did not join Adonijah. They were Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and King Davids special guard.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa bɔh o, Ka paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o doli ma kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni be ŋɔ na, man zaŋm a bia maa kulis a ya maa.
en: But the servant asked, What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa ŋmɛnditoya shɛb daa ti yi bɛ suɣa maa ni m-piri tab ʒii buta zuɣu; ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa tin shɛli din yuli booni Ofira ka di be Shual tiŋgban ni la polo.
en: So their best soldiers began the attack. The Philistine army split into three groups. One group went north on the road to Ophrah, near Shual.

dag: N zahindi maa puuni, n daa lan nya ka kawana ayopɔin nyaɣi tam kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu n-kul ŋmɛlim baribara;.
en: I also dreamed that I saw seven heads of grain which were full and ripe, growing on one stalk.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun me wuni bee m-mali binnani bee binshɛlikam din chihiri Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba tuma n-zaŋ li zali ashilɔni, noli din dim o. Ka sokam garigi yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who makes an idol or an image—things detestable to the LORD, made by artisans—and sets it up secretly. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A nina maa neema. A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa.
en: Jesus said to him, Then see! Your faith has made you well.

dag: Dama naa yɛtɔɣa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka so ku tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni.
en: He has the authority to give commands, and no one can tell him what to do.

dag: Zɛdɛkia ni daa di Juda nam, di piligu ni yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anahi gol so ŋun pahir anu puuni ka Azur ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn nir la bia anabi Hanania daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maligumaaniba mini niriba zaa sani yɛli.
en: That same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, Hananiah son of Azzur, a prophet from the town of Gibeon, spoke to me in the Temple. In the presence of the priests and of the people he told me.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa boli Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda la na ti yɛl o, Sool min o daŋ zaa ni daa su shɛlikam zaa n ni zaŋ li ti a dan yaaŋa ŋɔ.
en: Then the king called Ziba, Saul's servant, and said, I am giving Mephibosheth, your master's grandson, everything that belonged to Saul and his family.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa paligi ti yaɣi, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ yihim Daniɛl bɔɣili maa ni na. Ka bɛ daa voog o yihi na n-nya ka o bi nya daŋa hal baabiɛla gba, o ni daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda zuɣu.
en: The king was thrilled. He commanded that Daniel be brought up out of the pit, and Daniel was lifted out. Not a scratch was found on him, because he trusted in his God.

dag: Dama n ni moli Yawɛ yuli. Yɛlimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ galisim yɛla!.
en: I will praise the name of the Lord , and his people will tell of his greatness.

dag: Iso zuliya ni nanim yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla kaman bɛ malibu mini bɛ biɛhigu shee ni daa nyɛ shɛm doli bɛ yuya. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: These are the names of Esaus tribal chiefs according to their families, their locations, and their names: Chief Timna, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa chaŋ na sɔasɔa ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni dindali maa kaman tɔbbi shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi guui tɔbu ni n-kuli ti kpɛri bɛ ya ni vi la.
en: The troops were sneaking into Mahanaim, just as if they had run away from a battle and were ashamed.

dag: m-pah o ni daa deeri salima shɛli daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nanim zaa ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gomnanim san la zuɣu.
en: in addition to the taxes paid by merchants, the profits from trade, and tribute paid by the Arabian kings and the governors of the Israelite districts.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni dini n-lee be asama ni nira yɛli: A yi yɛli so ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ.
en: Is it easier to say, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Get up and walk?.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: But Gods word came to Shemaiah the man of God.

dag: ka daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima sokam zaa zuɣu la. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din di Naawuni ni daa pun lo shɛm shɛhira, ka nyɛ din yi palo di saha dɛde.
en: gave himself to pay for everyone to be free. This is the message that was given to us at just the right time.

dag: Yawɛ be n sani, m bi zɔri dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: The Lord is with me, I will not be afraid; what can anyone do to me?.

dag: nti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ pirigiri li n-tiri bɛ ni sokam kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ zaa deei shɛm tariga.
en: and place them in the care and under the authority of the apostles. Then it was distributed to anyone who was in need.

dag: Ka Yisifu dan maa daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o ti niŋ sarika ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ naa sarikanim niŋ, ka o daa be sarika maa ni.
en: So Potiphar put Joseph into the prison where the kings enemies were held, and that is where Joseph remained.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ bɛ buɣa tooni, ka zaŋ yi kɔba yɛrigi gili yi maligu bimbina gbini.
en: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun kari zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam bahi ka chɛn ya, ka so na bi tooi zani yi tooni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord has driven great and powerful nations out as you advanced, and no one has ever been able to stand against you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛl yɛlli ŋɔ ka gbaaya yimaŋ ni Yisa tuumba maa, dama bɛ wuhibu ŋɔ mini bɛ tuma ŋɔ yi nyɛla salinim dini, di ni zan tariga;.
en: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.

dag: Di sab Naawuni zaligu ni ni ti Duuma yɛliya: N ni zaŋ niriba bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa mini tinzunnim noya ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ, amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ku bahi wum n yɛligu.
en: In the Law it is written: I will speak to this people with foreign languages and foreigners lips, but they will not even listen to me this way , says the Lord.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-nyɛ: Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nadab.
en: His oldest son was Abdon. Other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: N zɔnim maani ma la ansarisi, ka n kuhi ni nintam niŋ Naawuni.
en: my go-between, my friend. While my eyes drip tears to God.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi yɛn galim a, a ni mali yɛlimaŋli, amaa chɛ ka m bɔh a m bɔhigu ŋɔ. Bɔzuɣu ka tuumbiɛrilana tɔŋda? Bɔzuɣu ka ʒiŋmariba kul tɔŋda?.
en: Whenever I complain to you, Lord , you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?.

dag: Ka m biɛrimaŋtali tuma ni ti yi palo a yi ti kana ni a ti nya n yɔri maa dahin shɛli. Ka bu shɛb mini piɛbihi shɛb bɛn bi liɣisiliɣisi ka mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ sabila yi ti be m biŋkɔbiri ni, di wuhiya ni n zu ba mi maa.
en: In the future you can easily find out if I have been honest. When you come to check up on my wages, if I have any goat that isn't speckled or spotted or any sheep that isn't black, you will know that it has been stolen.

dag: Naawuni ni daa ti yɛn tim o Bikpɛm la dunia ŋɔ ni na o daa yɛlimi: Naawuni malaikanim zaa, jɛmmiy o.
en: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ deei Ammɔn nira bee Mɔab nira niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, soli kani ni bɛ deei bɛ zuliya niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord 's people.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti sa vuhim shee, kom ni be luɣ shɛli pam din ni chɛ ka di niŋ wula n-wali wala, ka niŋ yɔɣili din mali jilima.
en: But the vine was already growing in fertile soil, where there was plenty of water to produce healthy leaves and large grapes.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka o paɣ Ɛlizabɛt daa niŋ pua, ka sɔɣir omaŋa hal ti paai chira anu ka yɛra.
en: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya ni o ni kari Yaakubu zuliya saria, ka di kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord had warned the people of Israel.

dag: O daa yɛl ti Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tin ya yurilim shɛl la yɛla.
en: He also told us about the love you have from the Spirit.

dag: Ka o daa mali salima bans anahi n-niŋ di naŋgbaŋkuɣila anahi. Bans ayi yaɣ yini, bans ayi yaɣ din la gba.
en: He made four carrying rings of gold for it and attached them to its four feet, with two rings on each side.

dag: Di saha ka a niriba zaa ti leei bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka su tiŋgbani maa sahakam. Mani n-nam ba, ka zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani ni di chɛ ka n nya jilima.
en: Your people will all do what is right, And will possess the land forever. I planted them, I made them, To reveal my greatness to all.

dag: O nuu ni ka binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili mini ninsal kam vuhim be.
en: Every animal that lives and everyone who breathes— they are all under Gods power.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti laɣim kpe n-tɔɣisi, ka tɛhi ni di luhiya ni ti pii ti ni shɛba n-chɛ ka bɛ doli ti mabiyurisi Baanabas mini Pool.
en: And so we have met together and have all agreed to choose some messengers and send them to you. They will go with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zuɣu kul ʒiɛla ya n-gari n dimnim bɛn gil ma. Ka n ni mali sara o jɛmbu duu, ka tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu; n ni yili yila n-niɣim n-lɔŋni paɣi Yawɛ.
en: If he will help me defeat the enemies around me, I will offer sacrifices in his tent with shouts of joy. I will sing and play songs to honor the Lord .

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbani n-wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim neesim mi wuhiri ba soli yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Each day God led them with the tall cloud, and each night he led them with the light from the column of fire.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ n zɔnim ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi, di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi lan niŋ shɛli pahi.
en: Then Jesus said to the people, I tell you, my friends, dont be afraid of people. They can kill the body, but after that they can do nothing more to hurt you.

dag: Wain kurili mini wain palli niriba yɛm.
en: The Lord says, Wine, both old and new, is robbing my people of their senses!.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti diri wahala ka tumdi ti yaa tariga, dama ti zaŋ ti tahima zaa niŋla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Tiligira, di bahi bamdi bɛn niŋ o yɛda la.
en: We work and struggle for this: Our hope is set on the living God, who is the savior of all people, especially those who believe.

dag: O yoom ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ o polo ka ti dol o soya, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zali ti yaannim la.
en: May he draw our hearts to him to walk in all his ways and observe his commands, his laws, and his judgments that he gave our ancestors.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka bol o, Ibrahimma, Ibrahimma! Ka o saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: But the Lord 's angel shouted from heaven, Abraham! Abraham! Here I am! he answered.

dag: Bɛn daa po pɔri maa daa gari ninvuɣ pihinahi.
en: There were more than of them who made this plan.

dag: ka zaŋ niriba maa zaa labina ti ti a kaman amiliya n-kul o yidan yili la. Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko ka a bɔr ni a ku ka chɛ bɛnkam kpalim zaa ka bɛ suhu doya.
en: since he's the one you want to get rid of. Then I'll bring the whole nation back to you like a bride coming home to her husband. This way there won't be a civil war.

dag: So yi sɔɣi gbaai o Izraɛl kpee n-zaŋ o leei dabili bee n-zaŋ o kɔhi, dindina ŋun gbaag o maa simdi kubu, ka lala chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: If someone is caught kidnapping their fellow Israelites, intending to enslave the Israelite or sell them, that kidnapper must die. Remove such evil from your community!.

dag: Speen ŋarima n-daa ʒiri a daguya chana. Dinzuɣu a nɛma daa palila teeku bulli zaa.
en: Large, seagoing ships carried your goods wherever they needed to go. You were like a ship loaded with heavy cargo.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl kalinsi nyaaŋa Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia la mini Abiata n-daa zan o zaani. Ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ naa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma.
en: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi yɛlila din bi tuhi, nyin wuhim di ni nyɛ shɛli; ka n yi yɛlila din tuhi, di chaŋ wula ka a ŋme ma.
en: Jesus answered, If I said something wrong, tell everyone here what was wrong. But if what I said is right, then why do you hit me.

dag: dama yi daazichi ni be shɛli, nimaani ka yi suhuri gba ni be.
en: Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

dag: Jɛfita kalinsi nyaaŋa, Ibizan ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: After Jephthah, Ibzan from Bethlehem led Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ mi niŋmi ni di chɛ ka di ni sab shɛm bɛ zaligu ni ni bɛ kul je ma la yol la niŋ pali.
en: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, People hated me for no reason.

dag: zaŋ tabili Araba din daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la zaa hal ti taɣi Araba Teeku Pisiga zolɔŋ la ni.
en: It also included all the region east of the Jordan River as far south as the Dead Sea and east to the foot of Mount Pisgah.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la ti niŋ pali yi ni. Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Make sure what the prophets have said doesn't happen to you. They said.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi suhuri mini yi tɛha leela zaɣ pala zaa.
en: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking.

dag: O ti bom yuun yini piɛbila ŋun ka daŋa m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ dabisili kam, o niŋmi li asiba kam.
en: As a daily entirely burned offering for the LORD, you will provide a flawless year-old lamb. You will make the offering every morning.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Ti shihila kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka bɔzuɣu ka tinim ku tooi pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu n-zaŋ Yawɛ pini na ti ti o di tibu saha.
en: and said, We are unclean because we have touched a corpse, but why should we be excluded from presenting the Lord 's offering with the rest of the Israelites.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, a zaɣis o, ka mal o ansarisi; a suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a ninvuɣ gahindili zuɣu.
en: You are now angry, Lord , and you have turned your back on your chosen king.

dag: Jeemsi daa lan yɛli, Dinzuɣu n tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni ti nahim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ tuuba maa;.
en: So I think we should not make things hard for those who have turned to God from among the non-Jewish people.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒili ti n-daari ti chana; di wum ti, ka bɛ bi chɛ ka ti vuhi.
en: We are forced to wear a yoke on our necks. We get tired, and we have no rest.

dag: Dama dabisi shɛŋa din daa daŋ di saha maa tooni puuni, so daa naan ku tooi bu ninsal paa bee n-zaŋ biŋkɔbigu tum tuun shɛli; ka so daa yi yɛn yi bee n-yɛn lab kpe na, bɛ mini bɛ dimnim kul varimi. Mani n-daa tuɣindi ba maa.
en: Before that time, people didnt have the money to hire workers or to rent animals. And it was not safe for people to come and go. There was no relief from all the troubles. I had turned everyone against their neighbor.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa ka pii maa gbinna ni o ti tuhi ba, ka chaŋ ti miri di dunol ni ni o niŋ buɣim nyo li.
en: Abimelech and his men came to the tower to attack it. Abimelech went up to the door of the tower to burn it.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, Din kariya! A ku kpi. Nyama, m ba na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛla bin titali bee bimbila ka bi yɛli ma. Ka bɔ zuɣu ka m ba ni sɔɣi ma dimbɔŋɔ dina? Pa lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Jonathan said to him, No! You are not going to die! Listen: My father doesnt do anything big or small without telling me first. Why would my father hide this from me? It isnt true.

dag: Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: What do you think? The Jewish leaders answered, He is guilty, and he must die.

dag: Kulla sɔhila ka yi paai kpe na; ka n chɛ ka yi doli ma chani gindi ka m bi mi n ni kuni luɣ shɛli polo gba? Zaŋm a mabihi maa ka yi labi. Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim din bi naari min o ʒiɛyimtali.
en: You just got here yesterday. So today should I make you wander around with us while I go wherever I have to go? No. Go back, and take your relatives with you. May the LORD show you loyal love and faithfulness.

dag: Malimiya salima bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di naba anahi ni, yaɣ yini bans ayi yaɣ din la mi bansi ayi.
en: Make four carrying rings of gold for it and attach them to its four legs, with two rings on each side.

dag: Dabisili kam yɛrila dabisili din dolina di yɛla, ka yuŋ kam yɛri yuŋ din dolina di yɛla.
en: Each new day tells more of the story, and each night reveals more and more about Gods power.

dag: O zuɣu ka ti kpe alibarika shɛl ni ti ni be ŋɔ, ka mali suhupiɛlli ti tahima shɛli ti ni mali zaŋ chaŋ ti mini Naawuni ni laɣim nya jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: We have access by faith into this grace in which we stand through him, and we boast in the hope of Gods glory.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa lo Ibram alikauli yɛli, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Zaŋ Ijipti mɔɣili noli hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣ tital la noli.
en: Then and there the Lord made a covenant with Abram. He said, I promise to give your descendants all this land from the border of Egypt to the Euphrates River.

dag: Bɛ ŋma ʒiri pa Yawɛ, ka yɛli, O ku niŋ shɛli. Zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ti, tɔbu bee kum ku lu ti zuɣu.
en: Their prophets lie and say, The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee kawaan chimda bee zaɣ maha hal ni dindali maa, naɣila yi ti zaŋ Naawuni sara maligu maa na pɔi. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: Do not eat any of the new grain, whether raw, roasted, or baked into bread, until you have brought this offering to God. This regulation is to be observed by all your descendants for all time to come.

dag: Wuntia tuma mini din tuhi tumbu nyɛla Yawɛ ni deeri shɛli gari sara maligu.
en: Acting with righteousness and justice is more valued by the LORD than sacrifice.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zani Gibia kaman bɛ ni daa pun niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Then the next day, they took the same positions as twice before.

dag: Nyɛvili wɔɣinli bela yɛm nudirigu ni, ka buni mini jilima be di nuzaa ni.
en: Wisdom offers you long life, as well as wealth and honor.

dag: Ʒimiya tab ʒiya, ka di chɛ ka Masia zaligu niŋ pali.
en: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma dakuɣiri maa pam ti ma, dama n ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi pam ka viɛla.
en: in preparing large quantities of timber, because this temple I intend to build will be large and magnificent.

dag: ka o ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na, ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi gbala polo na tuhir o soli.
en: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, he was met by a man who came out of the burial caves there. This man had an evil spirit in him.

dag: Wummi n suhigu maa, ka garigi ma. N suhu bi doya ka n kul jiɣinda n fabila maa zuɣu.
en: Listen to me and answer me; I am worn out by my worries.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Maika ni daa mali dari binnan shɛl la n-leei bɛ dini zali nimaani, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mi daa kul ʒe Shilo di saha maa zaa.
en: They kept for themselves the sculpted image that Micah had made throughout the whole time that Gods sanctuary was in Shiloh.

dag: Ka do so daa be Maɔn ka o tuma shee nyɛ Kamɛl. Doo maa daa mali buni pam. O daa malila piɛri tusaata, ka mali buhi tuhili. Ka o daa ti chɛr o piɛri maa kɔbiri Kamɛl maa.
en: There was a man in Maon who did business in Carmel. He was a very important man and owned three thousand sheep and one thousand goats. At that time, he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

dag: Rabishake daa labiya nti wum ni Asiria naa yi Lakishi n-chaŋla Libina ka o mini ba ti tuhiri taba.
en: The Assyrian official learned that the emperor had left Lachish and was fighting against the nearby city of Libnah; so he went there to consult him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ka o ti ŋme n-di di nɛma, ka ʒe di nɛma n-zaŋ di daazichi chaŋ, ka di ti leeg o tɔbbihi yɔri.
en: So now I will hand over the nation of Egypt to him. He will take Egypt's valuable treasures and give them to his own troops.

dag: Dinzuɣu dahin yini ka alɔbo balibu paai shɛm ni ti lu o zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: Dɔro mini fabila ni kum. Ka buɣim ni ti di o, dama ŋun yɛn kar o saria lala maa n-nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Because of this, in one day she will be struck with plagues— disease, grief, and famine. And she will be burned with fire, because the Lord God, who judges her, is mighty.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Midiannima, ka bɛ ku lan tooi niŋ ba shɛli yaha. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi Gidiɔn ʒiɛman ni.
en: So Midian was defeated by the Israelites and was no longer a threat. The land was at peace for forty years, until Gideon died.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ni naa yuri ba, amaa Yawɛ sani ka nir nyari din niŋ kamaata.
en: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord .

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni tam pagɔr so yɛla ŋɔ, kpuɣim a mɔɣilo chaŋ gili tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛm biŋkumda ka di nyaɣisa, ka yili yila pam ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan teeg a yɛla.
en: Oh, woman who men forgot, take your harp and walk through the city. Play your song well and sing it often. Maybe someone will remember you.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun zɔr a nambɔɣu la yɛliya, Zoya mini kunkuna ni vuui, amaa n yurilim din bi naari la ku vuui ka chɛ a; ka n suhudoo alikauli la gba ku vuug a sani.
en: The mountains and hills may crumble, but my love for you will never end; I will keep forever my promise of peace. So says the Lord who loves you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Lɛvi maa yiŋa, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni farigudeeriba pam ni alahichinim laɣim ʒini diri bindirigu, dama bɛ pam n-daa doli Yisa na.
en: Later on Jesus was having a meal in Levi's house. A large number of tax collectors and other outcasts was following Jesus, and many of them joined him and his disciples at the table.

dag: M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn chɛ ka paɣ so ku a zuɣu, ka a ti bɔbili paɣ zinalana biha?.
en: Son, why should you give your love to another woman? Why should you prefer the charms of another man's wife?.

dag: Deemiya ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm Naawuni dolibu ni, amaa ka di niŋy o naŋgbankpeeni o ni chihiri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Welcome those who are weak in faith, but do not argue with them about their personal opinions.

dag: Amaa buɣisimiya binshɛɣukam nya, ka gbibiya din viɛla.
en: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Namɔɣili so ŋun gbibi n vuhim dabisa, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri n nini, ka gbibi n daalikauli.
en: The Lord says to such a man, If you honor me by observing the Sabbath and if you do what pleases me and faithfully keep my covenant.

dag: Ka Sɔdom naa maa daa yɛli Ibram, Zaŋm niriba ŋɔ ti ma, amaa ka mali nɛma ŋɔ zaa.
en: The king of Sodom said to Abram, All I want are my people. You can keep everything else.

dag: O zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka kul zaŋ o nina kpa n soya zaa.
en: ties up my feet, watches all my paths.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti bɔri bɛ biɛrisuŋ bee m-bɔri bɛ tɔŋbu saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi nyɛvili ni.
en: So dont be concerned with their health and well-being as long as you live.

dag: Ka Samsin daa zaŋ o nudirigu min o nuzaa n-gbaai sunsuuni daantalis ayi shɛŋa zuɣu duu maa ni tamya maa;.
en: Then Samson took hold of the two columns in the center of the temple that supported the whole temple. He braced himself between the two columns. One column was at his right side and the other at his left side.

dag: Ka o daa yi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋ Asiria nti me Ninive mini Rɛhɔbɔtir ni Kala ni.
en: From that land he went to Assyria and built the cities of Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yi chɛ ka so ni na ʒi n-nya yɛl shɛli niŋ ba, ka tiŋgbani yaai di noli vali ba tabili bɛ ni su binshɛɣukam zaa, ka bɛ kpe kpiimba biɛhigu shee zaɣ nɛma, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni bɛ ʒiɛm Yawɛ.
en: But if the Lord does something unheard of, and the earth opens up and swallows them with all they own, so that they go down alive to the world of the dead, you will know that these men have rejected the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn kul bela biɛrim ni bɛ nyɛviya ni zaa; yuun shɛŋa zaa din gari ka bɛ bi zɔri niriba nambɔɣu la ni.
en: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla anabi mini maligumaana bee niriba bɛn yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna la, n ni darigi bɛ mini bɛ yinsinim tibili.
en: I will punish anyone, including prophet or priest, who says, This is the LORDs message.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, ka bi deei n yɛligu mali sariakarita. Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni pun tɔɣisi la nti yɛn kar o saria zaadali.
en: But everyone who rejects me and my teachings will be judged on the last day by what I have said.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa.
en: Come, follow me, he said, and Ill show you how to fish for people.

dag: Amaa dɔro yi be situr shɛli ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli ni, ka yi paɣi li ka di yi, di simdi ka yi paɣi li pahi buyi, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: But if the infection disappears from the cloth, the weaving, or any item of skin that you washed, it must be washed again. Then it will be clean.

dag: Bɛ daa mali salima naɣibila n-zali Sinai Zoli gbini; ka daa jɛm salima binnani.
en: They made a calf at Horeb, bowing down to a metal idol.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Baasha daŋ ni nir yi kpi yiŋa, bahi n-yɛn ŋub o; ka ŋun mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri n-yɛn di o.
en: Any members of your family who die in the city will be eaten by dogs, and any who die in the open country will be eaten by vultures.

dag: Amaa ti yipa yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu lɔbu ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka kpi zaŋ chaŋ din daa kpɛhi ti dabitim ni la polo. Ka ti mi ku lan doli fukumsi zaligu kurili din daa sabi zal la sulinsi soli, amaa ka ni dolila Shia Kasi nyɛvili palli la sulinsi soli.
en: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku nanim maa n-zaŋ ba yili tih anu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa yili tihi maa zuɣu hal ti paai zaawuni.
en: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset.

dag: Maligumaana zuɣulana Ɛliashib bia Joyada bidibisi ni yino daa nyɛla Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la bipuɣiŋga yidana, ka n daa kar o n sani.
en: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi mini Jɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Saimɔn tumtumdi tab la gba alahiziba. Ka Yisa yɛli Saimɔn, Di zɔri dabiɛm, a nyɛla kulipal ŋun gbahiri zahim, amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a ni leela ŋun vɔri ninsalinim tiri Naawuni.
en: The same was true of Simon's partners, James and John, the sons of Zebedee. Jesus said to Simon, Don't be afraid; from now on you will be catching people.

dag: Pa wuuni m-bɔŋɔ? N yɛn suhila Yawɛ ka o chɛ ka saa kum ka mi, ka yi nya ka baŋ ni yi tum taali din galisi Yawɛ sani, yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔr naa maa zuɣu.
en: Isnt the wheat harvest today? I will call upon the LORD to send thunder and rain. Then you will know and will see for yourselves what great evil youve done in the LORDs eyes by asking for a king.

dag: Ti mi ni ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yil shɛl ni ŋɔ yi saɣim, ti mali yil shɛli Naawuni sani, ka di nyɛ din ni be alizanda ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka di mi pala ninsal nuhi ni me shɛli.
en: We know that if the tent that we live in on earth is torn down, we have a building from God. Its a house that isnt handmade, which is eternal and located in heaven.

dag: Ŋun pa maligumaana zuliya miri ka o di sara maligu kasi la. Sana yi be maligumaana yiŋa bee maligumaana yi bu so paa, o bi simdi ni o di sara maligu kasi maa.
en: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlabil yino mali sara asiba, ka zaŋ piɛlabil so ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali sara zaawuni.
en: Offer one of the lambs in the morning and the other lamb just before dark.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa yubu nyɛla ni n di bahi o ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ti ma la ni yino, amaa ni n ti neei ba kum ni zaadali.
en: And it is the will of him who sent me that I should not lose any of all those he has given me, but that I should raise them all to life on the last day.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: But if I use Satans power to force out demons, then what power do your people use when they force out demons? So your own people will prove that you are wrong.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni pam, dama lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn tuhi yi dimnim shɛb zaa.
en: and Joshua continued, Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.

dag: Yawɛ, a tuma galisiya pam! A tɛha zilim pam!.
en: Lord , you did such great things. Your thoughts are too hard for us to understand.

dag: Dinzuɣu Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, bɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lee bɔri yi sani? Lumiyala ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka dol o soya zaa ka yur o ka jɛmdi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ jilima baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: But the earth will be as full of the knowledge of the Lord 's glory as the seas are full of water.

dag: Dama ŋun saɣinda kana ni o ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ gbahi bɛ tɔbbihi, ka kabisi bɛ tɔburi, dama Yawɛ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun yɔri samli, o mi ni yo di zaa.
en: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.

dag: Ka bɛ daa baŋ li ka yiɣisi ni n-zo n-chaŋ Listra mini Dɛɛbi din be Laikɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tiŋkpansi din daa gil li zaa.
en: When Paul and Barnabas learned about this, they left the city. They went to Lystra and Derbe, cities in Lycaonia, and to the surrounding areas.

dag: Di bi kpa talahi ni n sabi n-wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yuri yi mabihi shɛm, dama Naawuni pun wuhi ya yimaŋmaŋ ni yɛn yuri tab shɛm.
en: We dont need to write to you about having love for your brothers and sisters in Christ. God has already taught you to love each other.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya li, di ni ti ba nyɛvili, ka ti bɛ niŋgbuna zaa alaafee.
en: They are life to those who find them, and healing for their entire body.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma alahiziba pam. Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: The girls parents were amazed. He told them not to tell anyone about what happened.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔhi ma bin suŋ yɛla? Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko n-nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ. Amaa a yi bɔri ni a ti nya nyɛvili, nyin doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima.
en: Jesus said to him, Why do you ask me about what is good? Only God is good. If you want to have eternal life, you must obey his commandments.

dag: Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla nimmoo saha ka di simdi ni yi neei gom ni, dama pumpɔŋɔ ka tiliginsim miri ti n-gari ti ni daa tuui niŋ yɛda saha shɛl la.
en: You must do this, because you know that the time has come for you to wake up from your sleep. For the moment when we will be saved is closer now than it was when we first believed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chɛ bɛ lansi maa ka dol o.
en: Right then the two brothers dropped their nets and went with him.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Galili Teeku maa yaɣili tiŋgban shɛli din yuli booni Gɛrasa.
en: Jesus and his disciples sailed to the Gerasenes land, which is across the lake from Galilee.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima ni o Ba Naawuni mini malaika kasinim jilima, o gba ni ti zo vi dilana zuɣu.
en: If you are ashamed of me and my message, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in his glory and in the glory of his Father and the holy angels.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun mi yɛl shɛli din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha piligu. Kurimbuni ha ka m pun mi yɛl shɛŋa din na bi niŋ yɛla. Mani n-yɛli, n ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa ni pali, ka n ni niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: who tells the end at the beginning, from ancient times things not yet done, saying, My plan will stand; all that I decide I will do.

dag: O sani ka dɔɣiri yini kam niriba bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa yu maŋli yina.
en: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o wuni Nisirok jɛmbu duu jɛmd o, ka o bidibisi Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.

dag: Anabinim zaa kpiya; ka nyin lee zaŋ amaŋ leela ŋuni? A gari ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa kpi maa.
en: Our father Abraham died; you do not claim to be greater than Abraham, do you? And the prophets also died. Who do you think you are.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zahin shɛrili ti o;.
en: They gave him a piece of broiled fish.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tuhi bɛn be tiŋ maa puuni hal ti luhi wuntaŋa n-daa ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, ka ku niriba bɛn be di ni, ka niŋ yalim bahi tiŋ maa tiŋgbani zaa zuɣu.
en: He and his troops fought in Shechem all day, until they had killed everyone in town. Then he and his men tore down the houses and buildings and scattered salt everywhere.

dag: So yi kabi o kpee kɔbili, bɛn kabim o dini labisi, ka ŋun fɔɣ o kpee nini bɛn fɔɣimi o dini labisi, ka ŋun ŋme n-kabi o kpee nyini bɛn ŋmɛm kab o dini labisi. O ni ti o kpee maa dalinli shɛm, di simdi ka bɛ niŋ o gba lala.
en: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth.

dag: ka n leei Yisa Masia tumo bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani ni n zaŋ Naawuni lahibal suŋ tum di tuma kaman maligumaana la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni deei bɛn pa Yɛhudianima kaman sara maligu shɛli din mali be kasi Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: It helps me to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles. Im working as a priest of Gods gospel so that the offering of the Gentiles can be acceptable and made holy by the Holy Spirit.

dag: A mi ni m ba Dauda min o dimnim bɛn gil o daa kul tuhirila taba hal ka Yawɛ daa ti chɛ ka o nyaŋ ba. Lala zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka o bi tooi me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu.
en: You know that my father David wasnt able to build a temple for the name of the LORD my God. This was because of the enemies that fought him on all sides until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn kpi daa suhi alibarika niŋ n ni, ka n daa chɛ ka pakoya yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni ti chɛ nyuli zabbu, ka Juda zuliya dimdi la ti kpi. Ifriim zuliya ti ku lan zab Juda zuliya nyuli; ka Juda zuliya mi ti ku lan nyɛ Ifriim zuliya dimnima.
en: The kingdom of Israel will not be jealous of Judah any more, and Judah will not be the enemy of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi sara maligu gbaliŋ la pa shɛli n sani. Yi ni zaŋdi piɛla bihi shɛb mini biŋkɔb suma kpa shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la, n nyee nyɔni li. N kɔre ka naɣilahi mini piɛla bihi ni buhi ʒim ni.
en: He says, Do you think I want all these sacrifices you keep offering to me? I have had more than enough of the sheep you burn as sacrifices and of the fat of your fine animals. I am tired of the blood of bulls and sheep and goats.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinu saha ka Mɛnahɛm bia Pɛkahia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi.
en: Pekahiah son of Menahem became king over Israel in Samaria during the th year that Azariah was king of Judah. Pekahiah ruled two years.

dag: Ka a lan yɛli ba: Yi ni ti yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam tiri Yawɛ ka di nyɛ yi sahakam sara n-nyɛ yuun yini piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi.
en: These are the food offerings that are to be presented to the Lord : for the daily burnt offering, two one-year-old male lambs without any defects.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ wuhi ni o nyɛla wuntizɔra ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Thats why Phinehas is considered righteous, generation after generation, forever.

dag: O gba daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, amaa ka kul dolila di soli maa.
en: He did what the Lord said was wrong. He did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat who caused Israel to sin. Jehoash continued to commit those sins.

dag: O yɛm puuni ka o nam zuɣusaa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who made the skies with skill— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Di saha maa, zuliya kam bɛn daa kana ti lu Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti chani Jɛrusalɛm yuuni kam ti jɛmdi Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka puhiri Suɣa Tibu chuɣu la.
en: Then all of the survivors from the nations that have attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the Lord Almighty as king and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi waɣa ti kpɛri sagbana ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri tɔri sagbana.
en: Though their height reaches heaven and their heads touch the clouds.

dag: dama yi niriba ayi maa daa bi ʒe ma yim Izraɛlnim sunsuuni Mɛribatikadɛshi kom la gbini Zin tiŋgban nɛl la ni, yi ni daa bi gbibi m biɛrikasitali Izraɛlnim sunsuuni la zuɣu.
en: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida dari ti ma, ka n chɛ ka n tumtumdiba kana ti pah a tumtumdiba maa zuɣu, ka n yo a a ni zali ni n yo a tumtumdiba maa zuɣu shɛm; dama a mi ni so ka ti ni m-mi dakuɣiri ŋmabu kaman Sidɔnnima.
en: I'd like you to send your workers to cut down cedar trees in Lebanon for me. I will pay them whatever you say and will even have my workers help them. We both know that your workers are more experienced than anyone else at cutting lumber.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so o yubu puuni n-leei Yisa Masia tumo la mini ti mabia Sɔstɛniiz.
en: Greetings from Paul. I was chosen to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. God chose me because that is what he wanted. Greetings also from Sosthenes, our brother in Christ.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Filistianim daa ti lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima. Ka Akishi daa yɛli Dauda, Baŋmi ni di simdi ka a min a niriba ŋɔ pahi n tɔbbihi ŋɔ zuɣu doli ma chaŋ.
en: Some time later the Philistines gathered their troops to fight Israel, and Achish said to David, Of course you understand that you and your men are to fight on my side.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ka n sanna nti zani baɣili ma ka yɛli, M mabia Sool, a nina maa neema! Ka n nina naa daa dii neei di saha maa, ka n nya o.
en: He came to me and said, Saul, my brother, look up and see again! Immediately I was able to see him.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka m biɛrim maa bi naara? Bɔzuɣu ka di zaɣisi naabu? Yɛlimaŋli a ŋmanila kulibɔn shɛli din nyɛ yɔhiŋ; ka ŋmani ko shɛŋa din nyuui.
en: I dont understand why I still hurt. I dont understand why my wound is not cured and cannot be healed. I think you have changed. You are like a spring of water that became dry. You are like a spring whose water has stopped flowing.

dag: Bɛ ku ninkura mini bihi sɔŋ solɔri zuɣu; bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku m paɣisara mini n nachimba. A suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛl la ka a daa ku ba maa. A daa kɔrikɔri ba, ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Young men and old men lie on the ground in the streets of the city. My young women and young men have been killed by the sword. You killed them on the day of your anger. You killed them without mercy!.

dag: O daa be ka binshɛɣukam na kani, ka binshɛɣukam tuɣ taba la o ni.
en: Christ existed before all things, and in union with him all things have their proper place.

dag: Amaa yin teemiya yi nuu n-zaŋ o ni bɔri shɛli maa paŋ o ni yi suhu zaa ka di saɣ o, hal di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam.
en: To the contrary! Open your hand wide to them. You must generously lend them whatever they need.

dag: bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: bɛ daa maani maligu ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi ka yi gba bi mi li.
en: They were destroyed because the people living in them did evil. They gave sacrifices to other gods, and that made me angry! Your people and your ancestors did not worship those gods in the past.

dag: ka di pala binnamda maa kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili tinim bɛn daŋ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋɔ gba kul ŋuhirimi ti suhuri ni n-guhiri saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti zal o bihi zaani, ka fa ti niŋgbuna zaa bahi la.
en: And its not only the creation. We ourselves who have the Spirit as the first crop of the harvest also groan inside as we wait to be adopted and for our bodies to be set free.

dag: M Ba, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n nya jilima a sani, jilima shɛli n ni daa pun mal a sani ka dunia na bi nam la.
en: And now, Father, give me glory with you. Give me the glory I had with you before the world was made.

dag: Zilim balli maari suhuyiɣisili, amaa yɛtɔɣ yoli yiɣisirila nir suhu.
en: A gentle answer quiets anger, but a harsh one stirs it up.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara mini kawana ni chi sara maligu ni alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ni taali sanyoo sara maligu ni maligumaana leebu sara maligu ni suhudoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, the sin offerings, the repayment offerings, the ordination offerings, and the fellowship offerings.

dag: Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya ka bɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la deei tiŋ maa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligina n-lu Ainim maa zuɣu n-dii ŋmɛri kuri ba.
en: Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had captured the city and that the smoke of the city was rising. So they turned and struck down the men of Ai.

dag: Yiɣisimiya gbaai soli chaŋ ti siɣi Arinɔn vinvamli ni du. Nyamiya, n zaŋ Sihɔn Amɔri nir ŋun nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa ŋɔ min o tiŋgbɔŋ niŋ yi nuu ni, ŋmɛmiy o tɔbu m-piligi li deebu.
en: The Lord told me, Get ready to go across Arnon Valley. I will let you defeat Sihon the Amorite, the king of Heshbon. I will let you take his country. So fight against him and take his land.

dag: Leeban daa chaŋla o piɛri kɔbiri chɛbu, ka Reechɛl daa zu n-kpuɣ o ba wuna.
en: While Laban was gone to cut the wool from his sheep, Rachel went into his house and stole the false gods that belonged to her father.

dag: M biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka yi mali dapaɣa ayɔbu niŋ li.
en: For the back of the dwelling on the west, make six boards.

dag: Ka gɔhi mini tutu shɛŋa din mali gɔhi ni bili tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; ka a ni diri tiŋgban ni tihi wala.
en: It will produce weeds and thorns, and you will have to eat wild plants.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa wum yɛlli maa, ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim Shilo na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: When the people of Israel heard this, the whole community came together at Shiloh to go to war against the eastern tribes.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naa? Yiɣisim di ni suhupiɛlli. N ni zaŋ Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa wain tihi puu maa ti a.
en: Jezebel answered, But you are the king over Israel! Get out of bed and eat something, and you will feel better. I will get Naboths vineyard for you.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yawɛ di saɣi ka n niŋ n dan ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ŋɔ lala. O di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shih o, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bihi so zuɣu ni.
en: The LORD forbid, he told his men, that I should do something like that to my master, the LORDs anointed, or lift my hand against him, because hes the LORDs anointed.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, So m-bi bu ti paa. Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma.
en: Because no one has hired us, they answered. Then he told them to go work in his vineyard.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni pa bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛb Naawuni daalikauli lɔbu puuni n-naɣ nyɛ o bi maŋa;.
en: This means that not all of Abrahams descendants are Gods true children. Abrahams true children are those who become Gods children because of the promise he made to Abraham.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa puuni niriba ata bee ayi tɔɣisi; ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim buɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: In the case of prophets, let two or three speak and have the rest evaluate what is said.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N Duuma, di yɛn be lala yuui hal ni bɔ saha? Ka o yɛli ma, Di ni be lala hal ka tinsi ti lu n-dahim, ka so ku lan be di yiya ni, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim tiŋgban nɛli doya.
en: I said, How long, Lord? And God said, Until cities lie ruined with no one living in them, until there are houses without people and the land is left devastated.

dag: Amaa ti doliyala ti Duuma Yisa Masia biɛrisuŋ la soli, ka di bo so shɛli ti ni ni doli n-tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma.
en: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, N wumya ni kawana be Ijipti, chamiya nimaani nti da li ti ti na, ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: I have heard there is grain in Egypt. Go down and buy some, so we won't starve to death.

dag: Yi ni ti biri yi bimbira yuma ayɔbu, ka wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi, ka pɔhi di wala hal ni yuma ayɔbu.
en: You will plant seed in your field for six years. You will trim your vineyards for six years and bring in its fruits.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ m piɛri ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti kari saria wuhi din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni, ka wuhi din be piɛlahi mini buhi sunsuuni.
en: As for you, my flock, the LORD God proclaims: I will judge between the rams and the bucks among the sheep and the goats.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim maa nyɛla din ʒe pɔhima anahi din yi Yawɛ ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa la sanna zaani.
en: Then he explained, These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.

dag: Chɛ ka o zabi niriba bɛn nyɛ tarimba zuɣu; ka fa nandaamba bahi ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ba tibili.
en: May the king judge the poor fairly; may he help the needy and defeat their oppressors.

dag: ka di be kaman n zo sumo bee m mabia zuɣu ka m mali nandahima maa. N daa kul gbami ni suhugarigu, ka chani gindi fabindi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ma kpi.
en: I would wander around like I was grieving a friend or a brother. I was weighed down, sad, like I was a mother in mourning.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb mi daa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-zo nti kpe Gaad mini Giliad tiŋgbana ni. Di saha Naa Sool ŋun daa na bela Giligal, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa niŋgbuna ti sɔhira.
en: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan River, going into the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul stayed at Gilgal, and the troops followed him anxiously.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zakaria zilinjila daa dii lɔrigi, ka o nya noli gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: At once, Zechariah started speaking and praising God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti suui bɛ wain wal kaha bahi kaman wain tia la; ka suui bɛ puma bahi kaman olivi tia la.
en: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.

dag: ni bɛ ni daa she binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa ni bɛ yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la mini binyɛr kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa she n-ti Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la min o bidibisi ni bɛ tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: Then they showed Moses the clothes that were made for the priests serving in the holy area. They showed him the special clothes for Aaron the priest and his sons to wear when they served as priests.

dag: O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam tɔbu ni, ka gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli tinshee katiŋ ha. .
en: Amos has said, Jeroboam will die by the sword, and the people of Israel will be taken as prisoners out of their country.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Mani n-nyɛ buzɔŋ dunoli.
en: So Jesus spoke again, I assure you that I am the gate of the sheep.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ti n yidan la zuɣu, Naawuni deei n suhigu; ka boli bia maa yuli Isaka.
en: Leah shouted, God has rewarded me for letting Jacob marry my servant, and she named the boy Issachar.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima nanima, niŋmiya yɛm, yinim dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannima, deemiya saɣisigu ŋɔ.
en: So kings, wise up! Be warned, you rulers of the earth!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi zɔŋ din daa be dunɔdali shee, ka di daa nyɛ mita anahi. Ka di daantalisi nyɛ mita yiniyini, ka zɔntua maa daa be puuni ha tariga.
en: It was cubits long. He measured the walls on either side of the gate. Each side wall was cubits wide. The porch was at the end of the gateway that faced the Temple.

dag: N ku tooi niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim kaman yaɣimɛra maa ni niŋ shɛm maa? Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yaɣiri maa ni kul be yaɣimɛra maa nuu ni shɛm maa, lala ka yinim Izraɛlnim gba be n nuu ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People of Israel, I, the Lord , have power over you, just as a potter has power over clay.

dag: O bi nyari n ni doli so shɛŋa, ka kaani n napɔna yaabu zaa?.
en: Doesnt he see my ways, count all my steps?.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yɛli doo maa ni yi mali tizo m-bo suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Israel said, Why did you tell him you had another brother? Why did you do such a bad thing to me.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ nimaani daba ayi, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-chani gindi Galɛshia mini Firijia tiŋgbana ni n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa suhuri.
en: Paul stayed in Antioch for a while. Then he left there and went through the countries of Galatia and Phrygia. He traveled from town to town in these countries, helping all the followers of Jesus grow stronger in their faith.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kaman o ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa. N ni daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, yim ka vuri ti mɔni karikari, ka kɔba maa daa tuɣi taba, ka kɔbili kam daa chaŋ ti tuɣi di kpee.
en: So I spoke to the bones for the Lord , as he said. I was still speaking, when I heard the loud noise. The bones began to rattle, and bone joined together with bone!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shihi zaa;.
en: Then they made an agreement to serve the Lord God with all their heart and with all their soul. He is the God their ancestors served.

dag: Bɛ ni so ti ku lan wuh o kpee bee n-yɛl o kpee, Baŋmi Yawɛ. Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ zaa ni ti baŋ ma, bibihi zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa. Dama n ni kpihim bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord , promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.

dag: Hal n yi nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni n nyu bara maa shɛm zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ fukumsi shɛli ti Duuma ni zaŋ niŋ ti nuu ni la polo, vi ku mali ma di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla fukumsi shɛli din yɛn mɛnya zali, ka pa ni din yɛn daai ya luhi.
en: For I am not ashamed, even if I have boasted somewhat too much about the authority that the Lord has given us—authority to build you up, not to tear you down.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, N ni be Hanun Nahash bia ŋɔ yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu kaman o ba ni daa be ma yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi Nahash kuli maa ti o. Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa ti paai Ammɔnnim maa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: David said, Nahash was kind to me, so I will be kind to his son Hanun. So David sent his officers to comfort Hanun about his fathers death. Davids officers went to the land of the Ammonites.

dag: Biɛɣ ti yɛn neei ka zibisim vuui. N ni zo yomyom du mɛɛr ni nyo zo shɛli zuɣu, ka zo n-du firanki tulaale zim ni nyo dabo shɛli zuɣu.
en: Before the day breeze blows and the shadows flee, I will be off to the mountain of myrrh, to the hill of frankincense.

dag: Yi yɛm bi yaɣi lala? Yinim bɛn daa piligi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ŋɔ, yi yɛn zaŋla yimaŋmaŋ yiko naai?.
en: Are you so irrational? After you started with the Spirit, are you now finishing up with your own human effort?.

dag: Hal n yi nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni n nyu bara maa shɛm zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ fukumsi shɛli ti Duuma ni zaŋ niŋ ti nuu ni la polo, vi ku mali ma di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla fukumsi shɛli din yɛn mɛnya zali, ka pa ni din yɛn daai ya luhi.
en: It may seem as though we boast too much about the authority the Lord gave us. But he gave us this authority to strengthen you, not to hurt you. So I will not be ashamed of whatever boasting we do.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N dabili Aizaia ni daa chaŋ o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa yuma ata la, di nyɛla din yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim mini Itiɔpianim shihirili.
en: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni chɛ ka a zani dabari, ka leei zuliya kam bɛn gil a ni yɛn maani so ansarisi bɛnkam gariti ninni.
en: Every passerby will laugh at your destruction. Foreign nations.

dag: N daa bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛŋa din ni sɔŋ ya, amaa ka daa zaŋ li wuhi ya niriba ni mini yili kam ni.
en: When I preached in public or taught in your homes, I didn't hold back from telling anything that would help you.

dag: Ka Shɛshan daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti o dabili Jariha maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Atai.
en: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to Jarha his servant, and she gave birth to Attai for him.

dag: Jɔram ni daa ti nya Jɛhu, o daa bɔh o mi, Jɛhu, alaafee? Ka Jɛhu garigi bɔh o, Wula ka alaafee lee yɛn niŋ beni, ka a ma Jɛzibɛl sotali min o buɣijɛmbo tuma la na kul beni pam.
en: Joram asked, Jehu, is this a peaceful visit? How can there be peace? Jehu asked. Your mother Jezebel has caused everyone to worship idols and practice witchcraft.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Kom din be foliŋga tiŋli ŋɔ laɣimmi dɔni luɣ yini, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban kuŋ yi n-dɔni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: God said, Let the waters under the sky come together into one place so that the dry land can appear. And thats what happened.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M ma, ka wula ka a yɛl ni n niŋ? N saha na bi paai.
en: You must not tell me what to do, Jesus replied. My time has not yet come.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ŋuni n-lee su a? Ka o garigi yɛli, N nyɛla Ijipti nachimbila, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi Amalɛk do so tuma. N daa kala alaafee, ka ŋun su ma maa chɛ ma bahi ka chaŋ, di zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Who is your master? David asked. And where do you come from? I'm from Egypt, the young man answered. I'm the servant of an Amalekite, but he left me here three days ago because I was sick.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bo niriba ashilɔni n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim ni bɛ wum ka Stiivin turi Anabi Musa ka mɔri Naawuni.
en: So they told some men to say, We heard Stephen say bad things against Moses and against God.

dag: Ŋum paya mi yuli n-daa booni Ɛliɛza, dama o daa yɛlimi, M banim Naawuni n-daa nyɛ n sɔŋda ka tiligi ma Firawuna takɔbi ni.
en: The other son was named Eliezer, because when he was born, Moses said, The God of my father helped me and saved me from the king of Egypt.

dag: Ka Pool daa kul kpɛri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka kul wuhiri ba hal ni chira ata.
en: Paul went into the synagogue and for three months spoke boldly with the people, holding discussions with them and trying to convince them about the Kingdom of God.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu, dama ti galisiya.
en: Jesus asked him, What is your name? He responded, Legion is my name, because we are many.

dag: Ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu, ka Ɛlhanan ŋun daa nyɛ Jair bia la daa ku Lahimi ŋun daa nyɛ Goliat Gaat nir la mabia, ka o kpani daɣu daa ŋmani kpalu daɣu.
en: In another war with the Philistines, Jairs son Elhanan killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite. The shaft of his spear was like a weavers beam.

dag: Gol maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Izraɛlnim daa laɣimna ti lo noli, ka pili buri ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of this month, the people of Israel were assembled. They fasted, wore funeral clothing, and had dirt on their heads.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya bee kuriti tum tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ piligim tuma maa, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: They are skilled in working with gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have more skilled workers than can be counted. Now begin the work. And may the Lord be with you.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ lala, wula ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni shee lala niŋya la yɛn niŋ pali.
en: But in that case, how could the Scriptures come true which say that this is what must happen.

dag: n yɛn zaŋ ya mi ti wulimpuhili polo nima ka bɛ sun ya. Ka bɛ ti ti bɛ suɣa yi sani n-ʒini yi sunsuuni. Bɛ ni ti di yi tiwala, ka nyu yi bihim.
en: Because you were glad, I will let the tribes from the eastern desert conquer you. They will set up their camps in your country and settle there. They will eat the fruit and drink the milk that should have been yours.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Pool ka yɛli ni bɛ lom o zoligɔnima ayi; di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔhi ni o baŋ Pool ni nyɛ so min o ni tum shɛli.
en: The army commander went over and arrested him and had him bound with two chains. Then he tried to find out who Paul was and what he had done.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Elihu said:.

dag: Ka Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira bini ti mini ya sunsuuni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka bɛ daa boli sara maligu bimbini maa yuli, Shɛhira.
en: The people of Reuben and Gad named the altar Proof That We Believe the Lord is God.

dag: A mini Ɛdomnim daa niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni a nɛma din galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋdi tɛkɔisi mini binʒiɛhi ni bɛ ni wuɣi situr shɛŋa ni tampiɛl viɛla ni kɔral ni rubinim na ti taɣiri yi nɛma maa.
en: Aram traded with you because you had so many good things. They traded emeralds, purple cloth, fine needlework, fine linen, coral, and rubies for the things you sold.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Bilichin tital so n-daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋ ha nti di nam labina;.
en: So he said, There was once a man of high rank who was going to a country far away to be made king, after which he planned to come back home.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa lo naa alikauli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Ka Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli ba, N-nyɛ nabia maa, chɛliya ka o di nam kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda zuliya polo la.
en: They all gathered in the Temple, and there they made a covenant with Joash, the king's son. Jehoiada said to them, Here is the son of the late king. He is now to be king, as the Lord promised that King David's descendants would be.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ma jɛmbu ka tuɣindila tulaale zim maani bɛ buɣa la zuɣu, bɛ chɛ ka bɛ nuhi tuma zaa ku ma suli ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi yaŋɔ nim zuɣu ka ku maai.
en: The people of Judah and Israel have rejected me. They have offered sacrifices to foreign gods and have worshiped their own idols. I can't stand it any longer. I am furious.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa pun bahi noli ni so yi mi Yisa ni be shɛli, ŋun nyihim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaag o.
en: But the leading priests and the Pharisees had given a special order about Jesus. They said that anyone who knew where he was must tell them so that they could arrest him.

dag: Kom ni ti zɔri yir o ŋmana ni na, ka o bimbira tiɣi kom pam. O naa ni ti gari Agag. O nam ni ti du pam.
en: You and your descendants will prosper like an orchard beside a stream. Your king will rule with power and be a greater king than Agag the Amalekite.

dag: Di saha ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa yɛli, Chɛ ka man guui kuli nti ti naa lahibali ni Yawɛ fa o o dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Then Zadoks son Ahimaaz said, Please let me run and take the news to the king that the LORD has vindicated him against his enemies power.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ li tila kapintanim mini tammɛriba ni bɛ da kuɣ kpɛra mini yɔɣira ni gurilɔnima m-mali Juda nanim ni daa chɛ ka shɛli polo lu la me.
en: and they gave the rest of it to the carpenters and builders, who used it to buy the stone and wood they needed to repair the other buildings that Judah's kings had not taken care of.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka bɛ ni bi zaŋdi so taali zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari jilima.
en: Experience makes you more patient, and you are most patient when you ignore insults.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave the following regulations to Moses.

dag: Dama Yawɛ viɛla. O yurilim maŋli kul ni beni sahakam, ka o ʒiɛyimtali mi kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Lord is good! There is no end to his faithful love. We can trust him forever and ever!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa n-gooi tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ daa chɛ Izraɛlnim maa kari doli ka labina.
en: Joab blew the trumpet and called the people to stop chasing Israelites.

dag: Ka yi suhi yi Naawuni maa, ka n gba suhi Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so ŋun chɛ ka buɣim taai nimdi maa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka Niriba maa zaa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla.
en: Then let the prophets of Baal pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord , and the one who answers by sending fire—he is God. The people shouted their approval.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yihimi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zaɣ yiha kaman bɛ ni yihiri wain tia wala yiha shɛm la, ka lan zaŋ a nuhi doli di wula kaman wain tiwalipɔhira la.
en: The Lord Almighty said to me, Israel will be stripped clean like a vineyard from which every grape has been picked. So you must rescue everyone you can while there is still time.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ka a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa taai duŋ niŋ maa. Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Aduna ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o.
en: When you complain against Aaron, it is really against the Lord that you and your followers are rebelling.

dag: dama ti Ba Naawuni sani ti teeri yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi yurilim tuma ni yi tahima shɛli din ʒe yim ti Duuma Masia ni la yɛla.
en: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka Asirianim ti kani Ijipti na, ka Ijiptinim gba kani Asiria na; ka Ijiptinim mini Asirianim ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ.
en: On that day, there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will come to Egypt, and the Egyptians to Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

dag: Ka o daa lee shini, ka ŋmaligi baalim kul o yiŋa nti tim bol o zɔnim na, ka bol o paɣa Zɛrɛshi na ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: But Haman held himself back and went on home. He sent word that his friends and his wife Zeresh should join him there.

dag: Hal a ni kul bi mi ma ŋɔ zaa yoli, mani m-piig a ni a sɔŋ n daba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb la. Mani m-bol a yuli.
en: For the sake of my servant Jacob and Israel my chosen, I called you by name. I gave you an honored title, though you didnt know me.
