dag: O daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la, ka zaɣis o zaligunim gba dolibu.
en: refused to be faithful to the Lord , the God his ancestors had worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool ka o lu n-teei dɔni tiŋa, Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zuɣu. O daa lan ka yaa, dama o daa bi di binshɛli dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa.
en: At once Saul fell down and lay stretched out on the ground, terrified by what Samuel had said. He was weak, because he had not eaten anything all day and all night.

dag: Varanda shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo la, niriba anahi n-daa ʒe di palli zuɣu, ka niriba ayi mi ʒe di samban ni gul li.
en: Near the western pavilion there were four guards by the road and two at the pavilion itself.

dag: Ijipti yiɣisirimi m-be kaman Nail mɔɣili; di bemi kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pali. Di yɛliya, Chɛ ka n yiɣisi, chɛ ka n yiɣisi lim dunia, chɛ ka n wurim tinsi tabili di niriba.
en: It is Egypt, rising like the Nile, like a river flooding its banks. Egypt said, I will rise and cover the world; I will destroy cities and the people who live there.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai bɛ daa laɣimla Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ha n-yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam zaa min o ni daa mali soli ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka bɛ niŋ yɛda shɛm yɛla.
en: When they arrived in Antioch, they gathered the people of the church together and told them about all that God had done with them and how he had opened the way for the Gentiles to believe.

dag: Bee yi na ʒi n-karim zaligu ni ni maligumaaniba tumdi tuun shɛŋa Naawuni jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ka ka galimi di zuɣu?.
en: Haven't you read in the Law of Moses that the priests are allowed to work in the temple on the Sabbath? But no one says they are guilty of breaking the law of the Sabbath.

dag: Bɛ daa sabirila maligumaaniba mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ bibihi ni bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa yuya, dama bɛna n-daa ʒe yim ka mali bɛmaŋ kasi.
en: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-nam binshɛɣukam din beni ŋɔ. N nini ni tiɣi ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛla bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa ka niŋdi tuuba, ka luri n yɛligu sizuura, ka doli n yɛligu maa.
en: I am the one who made all things. They are all here because I made them, says the Lord . These are the people I care for: the poor, humble people who obey my commands.

dag: Shia Kasi maa n-nyɛ Shi so o ni daa zaŋ niŋ ti ni pam Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira la zuɣu.
en: God poured out to us that Holy Spirit fully through Jesus Christ our Savior.

dag: Ka dim so ŋun biri piriŋkpana biɛlim maa nyɛla Sintani; ka chɛbu saha la nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu saha, ka malaikanim mi nyɛ bɛn chɛri li maa.
en: And the enemy who planted the bad seed is the devil. The harvest is the end of time. And the workers who gather are Gods angels.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ baɣisi mini zinaniŋdiba ni pagɔra bihi ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na.
en: Come here to be judged, you sinners! You are no better than sorcerers, adulterers, and prostitutes.

dag: ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda ku me n-tamla ninsalinim yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ni me n-tamla Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: I did this so that your faith would be in Gods power, not in human wisdom.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa tɔɣisi bɛ zuɣulaannim maa yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu maa hal ka yi ti me li naai.
en: We then asked the leaders of the people to tell us who had given them authority to rebuild the Temple and to equip it.

dag: Tinzun nira yi di a samli, a ni tooi bɔh o dee li, amaa a mabia ŋun be yi ʒilɛl ni ŋuna, di simdi ni a ku san shɛli din be a min o sunsuuni.
en: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi gbibi n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must keep all my rules and all my regulations, and do them; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Wahu n-yɔhim ma ka n di li.
en: The Lord God asked the woman, Why did you do this? She replied, The snake tricked me into eating it.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. N gba ni tooi yɛli ni binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani, amaa n ku saɣi chɛ ka di shɛli zaŋ ma leei di dabili.
en: I have the freedom to do anything, but not everything is helpful. I have the freedom to do anything, but I wont be controlled by anything.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kamina! Ka Pita daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni n-tam kom zuɣu chani Yisa sani;.
en: Come! answered Jesus. So Peter got out of the boat and started walking on the water to Jesus.

dag: hal ka bɛ ni so ti ku kpalim. Dama Anatɔtnim tibidarigibo yuuni yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: I have set a time for bringing disaster on the people of Anathoth, and when that time comes, none of them will survive.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tiŋgbana pihinuayika din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinima.
en: So the Levites were given a total of towns and some land around each town for their animals. All these towns were in areas that belonged to the other tribes.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli din yɛli ni Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la niŋ pali; dina n-chɛ ka Naawuni daa bol o o zo.
en: So the scripture was fulfilled that says, Abraham believed God, and God regarded him as righteous . What is more, Abraham was called Gods friend.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bidibiga kam ni tooi ŋub li, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Any male in a priests family may eat the sin offering. It is very holy.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Zalimɔna maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Punɔn.
en: They left Zalmonah and camped at Punon.

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣimla Mizipa, ka bɛ nanim daa lo tɔbu n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi ba. Ka Izraɛlnim daa wum li ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah, the five Philistine kings started out with their men to attack them. The Israelites heard about it and were afraid.

dag: Ti ni daa wum lala maa ka ti mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani balim Pool ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: When we heard this, we and the others there begged Paul not to go to Jerusalem.

dag: N yi daa yɛli, N kul ni tɔɣisiri lala, n naan nyɛla ŋun bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli a bihi puuni.
en: If I had said such things, I would not be acting as one of your people.

dag: Dama o daa lab me buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim la; ka lan lab me Baal mini Ashɛra bimbina zali kaman Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa niŋ shɛm la; ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi.
en: He rebuilt the shrines that his father Hezekiah had destroyed, set up altars for Baal, and made a sacred pole, just as Israels King Ahab had done. He bowed down to all the stars in the sky and worshipped them.

dag: Ka tulaale zim shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni kasia nyom be a situra ni; ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali a nam yil shɛl la ni biŋkumda chɛ ka a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.

dag: ka di chɛ ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin shɛŋa din be yi tooni la ha, ka di chɛ ka ti ku nyu bara ninvuɣ shɛb ni pun tum shɛm luɣ shɛŋa polo la zuɣu.
en: Then we can preach the Good News in other countries beyond you and shall not have to boast about work already done in someone else's field.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi lan lo ni yi zaŋ Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa leei yi daba. Yi bi mi ni yi gba tumla alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani maa?.
en: And now you plan to keep the people of Judah and Jerusalem as slaves. But you are as guilty as they are for sinning against the Lord your God.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti laɣimna ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: When the day came for the heavenly beings to appear before the Lord , Satan was there among them.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ gari ti ni suhi shɛm tariga mini ti ni tɛhi shɛm zuɣu la yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma ti ni la zuɣu.
en: With Gods power working in us, he can do much, much more than anything we can ask or think of.

dag: Ɛkurɔn mini di fɔndi ni di tiŋkpansi gba daa beni Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli daa nyɛla.
en: The people of Judah also got the town of Ekron and all the small towns and fields near it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya ba, ku lan nya ba, bɛ yanim ku lan nya ba.
en: Those who knew him before will not see him again. His family will never again get to see him.

dag: Ti yaannim mini ti nanim ni ti zuɣulaannim ni ti maligumaaniba daa zaɣis a fukumsi zaligu la dolibu, ka daa lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la mini zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛli m ba, A paɣa dɔɣi bidibiga ka o suhu paligi la zuɣu.
en: Curse the one who made my father glad by bringing him the news, It's a boy! You have a son.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu hal ti tarigi; amaa m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: My whole being yearns for your saving help! I wait for your promise.

dag: Bɛ valila azichi, ka lan ti li bahina, Naawuni n-yihi li bɛ puya ni bahina.
en: They swallow wealth and vomit it; God dislodges it from their belly.

dag: Di saɣiya Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm maa. Dama Asiria naa yɛliya, Kamiyana ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ma din ni chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino tooi di omaŋmaŋ tiwala min o fiig tia wala, ka nyu omaŋmaŋ kɔbiliga ni kom.
en: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns.

dag: N ni pii mmaŋmaŋ nini ni tiɣi zuɣulaan shɛb tin ya, ka bɛ zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim sun ya.
en: I will give you rulers who obey me, and they will rule you with wisdom and understanding.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka Musa daa piligi kahigiri zaligunim ŋɔ wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this Instruction. He said the following.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba, hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: who never tell the truth and lie even under oath.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Doli ma ka ti kuli n yiŋa, ka a ti di bindirigu.
en: Come home and have a meal with me, he said.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi piɛlabil ŋun la zuɣu mali sara zaawuni kaman asiba din la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: In the evening offer the second lamb in the same way as the morning offering, together with its wine offering. It also is a food offering, an odor pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Kaiafas maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛli Yɛhudianim ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu la.
en: This was the same Caiaphas who had told the Jewish leaders, It is better if one person dies for the people.

dag: Di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋ lala, di simdi ni a niŋ a ʒiʒiinikpee situra lala. A ʒiʒiinikpee binshɛɣukam yi bɔrigi, ka a nya li, di simdi ni a niŋ lala, di bi simdi ka a zaɣis o sɔŋbu.
en: You must do the same thing when you find anything that your neighbor might have lost. Dont try selling it to your neighbor—you must give it back.

dag: Amaa dilan yi bɔr ni o yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, ŋun yom daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zali da shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If you wish to buy it back, you must pay the price plus an additional percent.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛri ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la; dinzuɣu maliya yɛm kaman tinvura, ka benya baalim kaman ŋmana la.
en: Listen! I am sending you, and you will be like sheep among wolves. So be smart like snakes. But also be like doves and dont hurt anyone.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani ka chɛ ka o diri nasara o tuma ni. O daa bela o dana ŋun nyɛ Ijipti nir maa yiŋa.
en: The LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man and served in his Egyptian masters household.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Judanima, Wuhimiya ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Benya kaman ti shɛli din chɛ ka di mahim luri ti zuɣu wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha. Ti nyɛla bɛn zona ti kpɛn ya ni ti tiligi, zaŋmiya ti sɔɣi.
en: Consider carefully, act justly; at high noon provide your shade like night. Hide the outcasts; keep the fugitives hidden.

dag: Bɛ yi ti nya so, bɛ ni zaŋ bini kuh o ka di pili yi, ka bɛ mi yi ti gbaai so, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku o.
en: Whoever is found will be stabbed; whoever is caught will fall by the sword.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa dɔɣi Jarɛd maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Jared was born, Mahalalel lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Bɛ ni daa labir o kuɣa maa, o daa suhirila ti Duuma yɛra. N Duuma Yisa, deemi n nyɛvili.
en: As they were throwing the stones at him, Stephen was praying. He said, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o binyɛr piɛlli ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-va buɣim mini di sara maligu maa ka chɛ tampiligim shɛli sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini maa luɣili zuɣu.
en: The priest must change clothes and put on the special linen underwear and linen robe. Then he must gather up the ashes from the fire and burnt offerings and set them down by the altar.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka niriba ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ ma ʒiɛmbu? Hal n ni wuhi ba shihira shɛŋa la zaa yoli, bɛ kul zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ ma yɛda.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses and said, How long will these people continue to turn against me? They show that they dont trust me or believe in my power, in spite of the many miracles I have done among them.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala. Ka Ijiptinim maa biŋkɔbiri zaa daa kpi, amaa ka Izraɛlnim bɛn so biŋkɔbigu daa bi kpi.
en: And the next day the LORD did it. All of the Egyptian livestock died, but not one animal that belonged to the Israelites died.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ biɛri ku yi tibidarigibo ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn ni yi.
en: You can be sure that evil people will be punished, but the righteous will escape.

dag: Birim a bimbira asiba ni zaawuni, dama a ku tooi baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ, dimbɔŋɔ bee din la bee di zaa nti yɛn niŋ.
en: Do your planting in the morning and in the evening, too. You never know whether it will all grow well or whether one planting will do better than the other.

dag: Ka Atalia bia Jɛshaya daa nyɛ Ɛlam daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pisopɔin daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Elam: Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and other men;.

dag: Nimaani ka yi mini yi yinsinim ni ti di li Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuuni kam zaa ni zuɣu.
en: There, in the presence of the Lord your God, who has blessed you, you and your families will eat and enjoy the good things that you have worked for.

dag: Dama ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia la palɔni kɔŋko pala Yɛhudia alali, ka gunibu maŋli mi pala din niŋ niŋgbuŋ palɔni kɔŋko.
en: You are not a true Jew if you are only a Jew in your physical body. True circumcision is not only on the outside of the body.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ a bihi tibili darigibu. A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, bɛ ku kpi.
en: Don't fail to correct your children. You won't kill them by being firm.

dag: Di saha Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim pina ni lan tiɣiri Yawɛ nini kaman di ni daa pun tiɣir o nini shɛm kurimbuni ha mini yuun shɛŋa din gari ni la.
en: Then the Lord will accept the gifts from Judah and Jerusalem. It will be as it was in the past—as the time long ago.

dag: n-kpe bɛ tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li; dama yi Duuma NAAWUNI ni zaŋ li niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Then you will come out of hiding and capture the city. The Lord your God will give it to you.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ tiliginsim liɣiri maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ka zal o shɛm.
en: and gave them to Aaron and his sons.

dag: Ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi ni ti deela o ni tum din bi tuhi shɛli maa laara; dama Naawuni bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ suhukpeennim dolila soya kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, ka sandaantimdiba kuhiri pampam.
en: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.

dag: Amaa tarimba ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka tɔŋ pam, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: but the humble will possess the land and enjoy prosperity and peace.

dag: Di saha ka Gɛrasa tiŋkpannim zaa daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbahi ba pam. Ka o daa lan kpe ŋariŋ ni lab o nyaaŋa.
en: All those who lived in the area around Gerasa asked Jesus to go away because they were afraid. So Jesus got into the boat to go back to Galilee.

dag: Zaŋmiya li na nti yɛli ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ. Yɛlimiya ti kurimbuni ha yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti zahim li nya din yɛn niŋ di puuni bee wuhimiya ti ashili yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha.
en: Let the idols approach and tell us what will happen. The prior things—what are they? Announce them, and well think about them and know their significance. Or proclaim to us what is to come!.

dag: o ni bela a sani kaman padira bee tumtumda n-tumd a tuma hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free.

dag: dindina o mabia maa paɣa maa ŋun cham o sani kpamba maa ninni nti pirigi doo maa namdili o napɔŋ ni, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun je ni o me o mabia yili.
en: then his brothers wife must come to him in front of the leaders. She must take his sandal off his foot and spit in his face. She must say, This is being done to the man who will not give his brother a son.

dag: ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa. Ka dɔbba ayi maa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ kpiimba ni?.
en: The women were afraid and bowed to the ground. But the men said, Why are you looking in the place of the dead for someone who is alive?.

dag: Ka Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ m mini cheechi zaa yilikpɛrilan la puhiri ya. Ka Ɛrastus ŋun nyɛ tiŋ puuni laɣigul la mini ti mabia Kuatus gba puhiri ya. .
en: Gaius is letting me and the whole church here use his home. He sends his greetings to you. Erastus and our brother Quartus also send their greetings. Erastus is the city treasurer here.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti fabili niŋ o ka yɛl o, Wula ka a niŋdi tinim bɛn nyɛ a tumtumdiba ŋɔ lala?.
en: Finally, the men in charge of the slaves went to the king and said, Why are you treating us like this?.

dag: dindina yin ŋmaam paɣa maa nuu, di zɔny o nambɔɣu.
en: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy.

dag: Ibrahimma Naawuni mini Nahɔr Naawuni ni bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti ti. Ka Yaakubu daa po o ba Yisahaku ni jɛmdi Naawuni so maa.
en: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor will judge between us. Then, in the name of the God whom his father Isaac worshiped, Jacob solemnly vowed to keep this promise.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni daa zahim nya ka di be kaman n yɛn kɔŋ la n nyɛvili maa, ka n daa teeg a yɛla ka suh a, ka a be a jɛmbu du kasi la ni ka wum n suhigu.
en: When my endurance was weakening, I remembered the LORD, and my prayer came to you, to your holy temple.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Di lihir o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu bee o wɔɣilim, man pun zaɣis o, dama Yawɛ ŋun bi lihiri kaman ninsal ni lihiri shɛm, ninsal ŋun lihirila niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu, amaa Yawɛ ŋun lihirila suhu ni.
en: But the Lord said to Samuel, Eliab is tall and handsome, but dont judge by things like that. God doesnt look at what people see. People judge by what is on the outside, but the Lord looks at the heart. Eliab is not the right man.

dag: Bɛ tiɣila barina pua ka ni dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka bɛ suhuri mali ʒiri ŋmabu shili.
en: They conceive toil and give birth to sorrow; their belly establishes deceit.

dag: Shɛm bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram ni Uzi ni Hul ni Gɛta ni Mɛshɛk.
en: Shem was the ancestor of Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech; they were the ancestors of the kingdoms named after them.

dag: Ka Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ni ti yihi gili dunia ŋɔ zaa n-lee shɛhira zuliya kam sani pɔi ka dunia yiɣisibu saha naanyi paai.
en: And the Good News I have shared about Gods kingdom will be told throughout the world. It will be spread to every nation. Then the end will come.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia gba daa bɔhi, Shihirili dini n-lee wuhiri ni n ni chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord 's temple.

dag: Lala ka paɣ shɛb bɛn bebu daa be kasi, ka bɛ mali tahima Naawuni sani daa yi maani bɛmaŋa, ka deeri bɛ yidaannim noya.
en: For the devout women of the past who placed their hope in God used to make themselves beautiful by submitting themselves to their husbands.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli n zaligunima, ka gbibi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka saɣi li. Di saha bɛ ni ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: Lab kul a yiŋa nti yɛli tuun kar shɛl a Duuma Naawuni ni tum ti a ŋɔ yɛla. Ka o daa chaŋ ti moli Yisa ni tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla gili tiŋ maa zaa.
en: Return home and tell the story of what God has done for you. So he went throughout the city proclaiming what Jesus had done for him.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yiri muɣisigu ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn lee kpɛri di ni.
en: The righteous are protected from trouble; it comes to the wicked instead.

dag: Ka yi ni so yi zaɣisi ti ni yɛli ya shɛm gbaŋ ŋɔ ni deebu, yin kpahimmiya dilana, ka di chɛliya ka yi min o lan mali jina, ka di ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: If there are some there who refuse to do what we tell you in this letter, remember who they are. Dont associate with them. Then maybe they will feel ashamed.

dag: Ka Pita daa yaag o noli yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni shiri bi gaŋdi niriba;.
en: Peter said, I really am learning that God doesnt show partiality to one group of people over another.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa ni piɛbihi la zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, ram, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: ni Aijalɔn ni Gatirimɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: Aijalon with its pasturelands, Gath-rimmon with its pasturelands.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Hɛrɔdias lo Jɔn zaɣ biɛɣu m-bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka daa bi tooi.
en: Herodias had a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she could not do it.

dag: Nyin Firawuna suhu ni daa ti yiɣisi bah a tumtumdiba zuɣu, ka a zaŋ m min a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm ti kpɛhi duu a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛm yiŋ la.
en: You were angry with the baker and me, and you put us in prison.

dag: Bɛ puuni ka kuɣ tuuli ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka suɣili kpaa ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka tɔbutuhiri tɔbu ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka zuɣulan kam ti yɛn yina.
en: The cornerstone, the tent peg, and the bow used in battle will come from Judah. Every oppressor will leave Judah simultaneously.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn su n yili ŋɔ fukumsi, ka a yi kul yɛli shɛlikam, n niriba zaa ni niŋ li; kulla n nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ka n yɛn zaŋ gar a.
en: I will put you in charge of my country, and the people will obey all your commands. I will be the only one more powerful than you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ malimiya tɔroko palli, ka bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣira, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ʒi n-zaŋ dapuhi ga shɛba nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, amaa ka taɣiya bɛ bihi kuli yiŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: Get a new cart and two cows that have young calves and that have never pulled a cart. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take the calves back to their barn.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: I have heard words like that before; the comfort you give is only torment.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka a mini Haman kana yuŋ ŋɔ nti di bindira ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni pun niŋ zali nyin naa ŋɔ.
en: Esther answered, Your Majesty, please come with Haman to a dinner I will prepare for you later today.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri; ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la.
en: Consider a mustard seed. When scattered on the ground, its the smallest of all the seeds on the earth.

dag: Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinima n-zani Anabi Musa zaashee;.
en: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees have the authority to tell you what the Law of Moses says.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli yili maa ni bihi maa, Niŋmiya kom pali sinsi ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ kom pali di zaa ha nti paai di naŋgbanyɛra tarisi.
en: Jesus said to the servants, Fill the waterpots with water. So they filled them to the top.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri Yawɛ jilima mal alibarika. Ŋun yu o zaligunim mali alibarika.
en: Praise the LORD! Those who honor the LORD, who adore Gods commandments, are truly happy!.

dag: Yi gba maŋmaŋ daa bela zibisim ni, amaa ti Duuma ni, yi yipa leela bɛn be neesim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu benya kaman neesim ni niriba.
en: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa ti wum ni Jɛrɔbɔam kuna, ka bɛ daa laɣim ka tim ti bol o na nti zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa. Dinzuɣu Juda zuliya niriba la kɔŋko n-daa doli Dauda yilinim maa, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la zaa daa zaɣisi ba dolibu.
en: When the Israelites heard that Jeroboam was back, they called everyone together. Then they sent for Jeroboam and made him king of Israel. Only the people from the tribe of Judah remained loyal to David's family.

dag: Amaa zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu be asama gari Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibil fifinyiiŋa gba yiɣisibu.
en: Heaven and earth will disappear before the smallest letter of the Law does.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o wain booriba kpɛm la labis o tuma ni, ka o lan zaŋdi ŋun Firawuna binnyura pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o.
en: He returned the chief wine steward to his position, and he placed the cup in Pharaohs hand.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa lan yɛli niriba maa, N kɔŋko n-kul kpalim nyɛ Yawɛ daanabi, amaa ka Baal ŋun mali anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu.
en: So Elijah said, I am the only prophet of the Lord here, but there are prophets of Baal.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa yur o paɣ Maaka ŋun nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga maa n-gar o paɣ shɛb bɛn pahi min o mamanim zaa. .
en: Rehoboam had wives, but he also married other women, and he was the father of sons and daughters. Rehoboam loved his wife Maacah the most.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu; dama niriba kul durimi tamdi n zuɣu; n dimnim kul nahindi ma mi dabisili kam puuni.
en: God, people have attacked me, so be merciful to me. They have been chasing me all day, closing in to attack me.

dag: Daba n-su ti, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ti bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Yawɛ ni tum shɛm. Nyamiya o ni tum tuun shɛŋa ka di mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.

dag: Amaa kum daa nyaŋ sokam zaa Adam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ hal ti paai Anabi Musa ʒiɛman ni, hal ka nyaŋ bɛn daa bi tum alahichi shɛli Adam ni daa tum la tatabo. Adam daa nyɛla ŋun daa ti yɛn kana la ŋmahinli.
en: But death ruled from Adam until Moses, even over those who didnt sin in the same way Adam did—Adam was a type of the one who was coming.

dag: Ka a yɛli niriba maa, Yi yɛn kpɛla yi dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya ka be Ɛdom la tiŋgban ni gari, bɛ ni zɔri ya dabiɛm. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa.
en: Tell the people this: You will pass through the land of Seir. This land belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They will be afraid of you. Be very careful.

dag: N jɛmd a mi ni n suhu zaa, di chɛ ka m birig a zaligunima.
en: I have sought you with all my heart. Dont let me stray from any of your commandments!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim ni ti chaŋ ti be azaaba din ka bahigu ni; amaa ka wuntizɔriba la bɛn ti kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu ni.
en: These, then, will be sent off to eternal punishment, but the righteous will go to eternal life.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ saɣim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n-daa darigi di tibili, ka di gbuɣi di niriba maa bahi maa.
en: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋla n niriba n-leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord 's people.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ba Yaakubu sani.
en: So they left Egypt and returned to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bɔri ni bɛ ku o ka di lahibali ti nti to Rom sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa su nimaani ni Jɛrusalɛm zaa damya.
en: While they were trying to kill him, a report reached the commander of a company of soldiers that all Jerusalem was in a state of confusion.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli Neetan, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa simdila kubu.
en: David got very angry at the man, and he said to Nathan, As surely as the LORD lives, the one who did this is demonic!.

dag: Niriba daa mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa gba la Rɛfaim, dama Rɛfaimnima n-daa pun be nimaani, amaa Ammɔnnim daa yi booni ba la Zamzumimnima.
en: This territory is also known as the land of the Rephaim, the name of the people who used to live there; the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.

dag: Amaa wuhim Jɔshua ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama ŋuna n-yɛn leei niriba ŋɔ zuɣulana n-zaŋ ba du nti deei a ni yɛn nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Give Joshua his instructions. Strengthen his determination, because he will lead the people across to occupy the land that you see.

dag: Yawɛ poya ka ku lan taɣ o tɛha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na. Bɛ daa kul tahirimi ka piɛbiri kikahi ni piɛlahi yila, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka daa lan ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim pampam.
en: So all the Israelites joined in bringing up the Box of the Lord s Agreement. They shouted, they blew rams horns and trumpets, and they played cymbals, lyres, and harps.

dag: hal ka n ti paɣi ni bɛ mirisi n nyiŋgol ni ka n kpi n-gari m biɛhigu.
en: until I would rather be strangled than live in this miserable body.

dag: M-pahi, ŋuni ka n lan yɛn jɛm ka pa ni n dan Dauda bia? N ni daa kul jɛmd a ba shɛm, lala ka n yɛn jɛm a gba.
en: In the past, I served your father. So now I will serve you, Davids son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o zilima pam ka tur o.
en: And they said many other insulting things to him.

dag: Dama o mi o ni zaŋ binshɛli nam ti. O teeya ni ti nyɛla taŋkpaɣu.
en: He knows what we are made of; he remembers that we are dust.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim baŋ n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli din be kasi maa yaha. Ka zuliya kam ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi. .
en: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ɛlipaal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛba mini Misham ni Shɛmɛd ŋun daa me Ono mini Lɔd ni di tiŋkpansi la.
en: Elpaal was the father of Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who settled the towns of Ono and Lod, as well as the nearby villages.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Ayuba daa lan niŋ yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi pahi. Ka o nini daa nya o yaantibichahi mi yaansi.
en: So Job lived for years more. He lived to see his children, his grandchildren, his great-grandchildren, and his great-great-grandchildren.

dag: Zaadali Ninivenim gba ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama Anabi Jona ni daa yihi ba waazu la, bɛ daa niŋ tuuba; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Anabi Jona be kpe.
en: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah.

dag: So shɛŋa din kuni Ziɔn kumdimi, dama so bi lan kanna ti puhiri churi. Bɛ chɛ o dunɔdaya zaa bahi, ka o maligumaaniba ŋuhira. O paɣisara malila nandahima; o nya naŋgbantom pam.
en: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Ibrahimma pahi buyi.
en: The angel of the Lord called to Abraham from heaven a second time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Dan zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Dan, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: N ni ti gbaag a pahi zuliya shɛb ni n-zaŋ a chaŋ a ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka di muɣisi niriba pam.
en: I will make many people sad and upset when I bring an enemy to destroy you. Nations you dont even know will be upset.

dag: Di pa shɛli n ni ti kpalim yi sani hal ka kikaa ti gari, di nyaaŋa ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ luɣ shɛli n ni ti yɛn chaŋ.
en: Maybe I will stay with you for a time. I might even stay all winter. Then you can help me on my trip, wherever I go.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛl a, amaa m bi bɔri ni n zaŋ alikalimi mini tadabo -sab li ti a.
en: I have a lot to say to you, but I dont want to use pen and ink.

dag: Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma, Jɛrimia, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛli, N nyala alimɔnd tiwulli.
en: The LORD asked me, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, A branch of an almond tree.

dag: M biyurisi, ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi pumpɔŋɔ, ka di na bi kahigi wuhi ti ni ti yɛn be shɛm, amaa ti lee mi ni o yi ti yi palo, ti ni bemi kaman ŋuna, dama ti ni ti nya o kaman o ni kul be shɛm.
en: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ zaa saha shɛli, ka buɣim daa yi zuɣusaa na ti taai bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara shɛŋa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali duu maa.
en: As soon as Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and burned up the offerings. The Lord 's dazzling glory then filled the temple.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o mabia maa gba daa yina ka gali ʒee maa lo o nuu, ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Zɛra.
en: When the brother with the red thread was born, they named him Zerah.

dag: Dama o daa bi niŋ so nirilim, amaa ka daa naɣ lula faranim mini nandaamba ni suhugarigunim zuɣu n-ku ba.
en: All because this person didnt remember to demonstrate faithful love, but chased after the poor and needy— even the brokenhearted—with deadly intent!.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mini wɔɣira zaa nti pahi Naa Dauda bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim la zaa daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni doli Naa Sulemaana.
en: All the leaders, soldiers, and all of King Davids sons accepted Solomon as king and obeyed him.

dag: ka taɣi ma ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ liri ma la ku paa ma. Bɛna n-nyɛ n dimnim bɛn gili ma niŋ sunsuuni m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la;.
en: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali sara maa naai, ka naa mini bɛn zaa daa be o sani gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: After the sacrifices were finished, King Hezekiah and all the people with him bowed down and worshiped.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi daŋ Sool tooni chaŋ Zif. Di saha Dauda min o niriba daa bela Maɔn yɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Araba, ka di be Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la.
en: So they left and returned to Ziph ahead of Saul. David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in a desolate valley in the southern part of the Judean wilderness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri yi zuɣu la yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni vuui n ni zaŋ n suhuyiɣisili binnyuri shɛli tin ya la. Yi ku lan nyu li n suhuyiɣisili pipia maa ni n-chani laana.
en: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.

dag: ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ yiɣina ti lu bɛ sansani maa ni n-gili bɛ biɛhigu maa shee zaa.
en: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.

dag: Ŋuna n-yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa n-wuhi di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm n-zaŋ li tari ba; ka bɛ kul su li sahakam, ka be di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: God has cast the lot for them; Gods hand allotted it to them with the measuring line. They will possess it forever; they will live in it from generation to generation.

dag: Di tamiya, teemiya yi ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi shɛm tiŋgban nɛl ni la yɛla. Dahin shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni mali hal ti paai kpe na ŋɔ yi kul nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ.
en: Never forget how you made the Lord your God angry in the desert. From the day that you left Egypt until the day you arrived here, you have rebelled against him.

dag: A piɛma diri pam naa dimnim suhuri ni; ka niriba lur a tooni.
en: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.

dag: Di saha o ni tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ni suhuyiɣisili, ka kpɛhi ba dabiɛm o suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli.
en: He speaks to them in anger, and it fills them with fear.

dag: M puhiri cheechi shɛli din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ la gba. M puhiri n zo suŋ Ɛpainɛtus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa daŋ niŋ Masia yɛda Ɛsha la.
en: Also say hello to the church that meets in their house. Say hello to Epaenetus, my dear friend, who was the first convert in Asia for Christ.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni mali tumdi tuma Luɣ kasi shee la n-guri chinchin sabilitim ni, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li n-zaŋ li niŋ amaŋka maa ni.
en: They shall take all the utensils used in the Holy Place, wrap them in a blue cloth, put a fine leather cover over them, and place them on a carrying frame.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu bahi kom ni ni bɛ zahim kom maa ziliŋ, ka daa nya ka di nyɛla mita pihinahi. Ka bɛ daa tirisi tooni biɛla n-lan buɣisi n-nya ka di ziliŋ nyɛla mita pihita.
en: So they dropped a line with a weight tied to it and found that the water was one hundred and twenty feet deep; a little later they did the same and found that it was ninety feet deep.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa kul o yiŋa Samaria ni sujee ti fo n-ʒiya.
en: Ahab went back to Samaria, angry and depressed.

dag: Ka mɔɣili maa kɔsoya ni kom ni nyɔni, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui; ka kaɣili mini kulimɔri ti kuui zaa.
en: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka Ijipti do so muɣisir o mabihi maa ni yino ka di ka soli, ka o ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa.
en: He saw one of them being wronged so he came to his rescue and evened the score by killing the Egyptian.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Du shɛli din dunoli kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ nyɛla maligumaana ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa fukumsi duu.
en: He spoke to me: The chamber facing south is for the priests who keep watch over the temple.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tiŋgbana pihinuayika din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinima.
en: The people of the Levi tribe had a total of towns within Israel, and they had pastures around each one of their towns.

dag: Bɛ kabi kana kaman tɔbbihi n-doli gooni voli ni kpɛna la; binshɛɣukam ni daa luri saha shɛl la, ka bɛ daa kul kabirina.
en: They break a hole in the wall and come rushing through it, and the crashing rocks fall on me.

dag: Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni daa ŋmaai bihili, ka o lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga yaha.
en: After Gomer had finished nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she became pregnant again and gave birth to a son.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ n ni zuɣu, n kpamdi yi zaa jaande ni yi ni so di tɛhi ni omaŋmaŋ bebu gari o bebu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa lee tɛhimiyala nimmoo tɛha, ka zahimmiya yimaŋa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Naawuni ni ti sokam yɛda shɛm.
en: Because of the grace that God gave me, I can say to each one of you: dont think of yourself more highly than you ought to think. Instead, be reasonable since God has measured out a portion of faith to each one of you.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be! M paɣiri ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ maa! N kul ni tibigiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim maa.
en: The Lord lives! Praise my defender! Proclaim the greatness of the God who saves me.

dag: Tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa be nimaani, ka daba nya bɛmaŋ bɛ duumanim sani.
en: Everyone is there, the famous and the unknown, and slaves at last are free.

dag: ni salima alali firila tamdisi din diba anu daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi shee tooni nudirigu polo, ka diba anu mi ʒe di nuzaa polo la ni tipuma kɔtomsi ni firilanim ni salima gbabɔnima.
en: ten lampstands that went in front of the most holy place; flower designs; lamps and tongs;.

dag: A me binshɛŋa din dundu maa zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ a viɛlim maa tum pagɔrisigu tuma. A zaŋ amaŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋunkam garita, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam.
en: where you disgraced yourself by having sex with anyone who walked by. And you did that more and more every day!.

dag: Nira yi je yɛlimaŋli, o ni tooi su niriba? A ni galim ŋun nyɛ Wuntialana ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlana?.
en: Can someone be a ruler if he hates justice? Job, God is not only powerful, but he is fair. Do you think you can judge him guilty?.

dag: Ka Naomi daa ti wum ni Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋun Naawuni niriba ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ puri atam niŋ pam, ka o daa mali shili ni o min o bihi paɣiba la yiɣisi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kul o ya.
en: While Naomi was in the country of Moab, she heard that the Lord had helped his people. He had given food to his people in Judah. So Naomi decided to leave the hill country of Moab and go back home. Her daughters-in-law also decided to go with her.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.

dag: Bɛn daa be n sani daa nya neesim maa, amaa ka lee bi wum kukoli maa ni yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: The men who were with me did not understand the voice, but they saw the light.

dag: Tahimi pam, ka di shini! Duhim a kukoli kaman kikaa kumsi la n-yɛli n niriba Izraɛlnima bɛ tipawumli mini bɛ daalahichi yɛla.
en: The Lord says, Shout as loud as you can! Tell my people Israel about their sins!.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kpe Yaakubu suɣili ni n-yi nimaani kpe Liya suɣili ni, ka yi nimaani kpe dabipaɣiba ayi la suɣa ni, amaa ka bi nya shɛli di ni. Ka o daa yi Liya suɣili ni chaŋ ti kpe Reechɛl suɣili ni.
en: So Laban went and looked through Jacobs camp. He looked in Jacobs tent and then in Leahs tent. Then he looked in the tent where the two slave women stayed, but he did not find the gods from his house. Then he went into Rachels tent.

dag: Ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o yiŋa kana ti zan o sani ni bɛ kpuɣ o yiɣisi, amaa ka o bi saɣi bee n-chɛ ka o mini ba laɣim ʒini di bindirigu.
en: His officials stood beside him and tried to talk him into getting up. But he would not get up or eat with them.

dag: M pun saɣim Samaria mini di wuna, ka ni saɣim Jɛrusalɛm mini di binnana din be di ni gba lala.
en: I defeated Samaria and her gods. I will also defeat Jerusalem and the idols her people have made.

dag: O yi ti kana, o ni wuhi dunianima alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: When the Helper comes, he will show the people of the world how wrong they are about sin, about being right with God, and about judgment.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ka di ka daliri la mali kpiɔŋ pam; ka bɛn je ma ka di ka soli gba galisi pam.
en: Many deadly and powerful enemies hate me.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa suhuri daa yiɣisi bahi Jɛrimia zuɣu, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ bu o, ka zaŋ o ti kpɛhi duu Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la yiŋa, dama bɛ daa zaŋ o yiŋ maa leela jɛriyali.
en: They were furious with me and had me beaten and locked up in the house of Jonathan, the court secretary, whose house had been made into a prison.

dag: Ka Pita daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi; ka o gban tiŋ suhi Naawuni, ka naanyi ŋmaligi kpim maa polo yɛl o, Tabita, yiɣisima! Ka o neeg o nina nya Pita, ka dii yiɣisi ʒini.
en: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, Tabitha, get up! The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

dag: Ka di ti leei shihirili shɛli din yɛn lo yi nuu ni, ka be yi gbɛri zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi teeri di yɛla din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ zaligu maa yɛla kul be yi noya ni, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu ka o daa zaŋ yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: This observance will be a reminder, like something tied on your hand or on your forehead; it will remind you to continue to recite and study the Law of the Lord , because the Lord brought you out of Egypt by his great power.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ bi zaŋ o ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee na, di di kul simdi ni yi ŋub li luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee kaman n ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: That goats blood was not brought into the Holy Place. So you should have eaten the meat in the holy area, just as I commanded.

dag: ka bɛ gahi bɛ kulipal tab nuu ni bɛ kana ti sɔŋ ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba, ka bɛ yihi zahim maa pali ŋarima ayi maa zaa hal ka di ti yɛn shim.
en: So they motioned to their partners in the other boat to come and help them. They came and filled both boats so full of fish that the boats were about to sink.

dag: Ka daadam kam ŋun ti zaɣisi anab maa yɛligu wumbu ni ti bahi yoli zaa kahikahi.
en: And anyone who refuses to obey that prophet will die, separated from Gods people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Shuham zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: which numbered , men.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam mili mi bi bɔri da palli, dama o yɛrimi ni da kurili ko n-nyaɣisi o sani.
en: No one who drinks old wine wants new wine. They say, The old wine is just fine.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa.
en: Some Pharisees came to Jesus and tried to make him say something wrong. They asked him, Is it right for a man to divorce his wife.

dag: O zaani tiŋgbani zaligu, ka o ni yɛli shɛm niŋdi yomyom.
en: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.

dag: Alizanda ni nim mini dunia ni nim zaŋ tabili teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, paɣimiy o.
en: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ninivenim daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda ka yɛli ni sokam lom noli, ka wɔɣira zaŋ tabili tarimba zaa daa so buri.
en: The people of Nineveh believed God. They decided to stop eating for a time to think about their sins. They put on special clothes to show they were sorry. All the people in the city did this, from the most important to the least important.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa yi saha mini zibisim yiko saha m-paai.
en: I was with you in the Temple every day, and you did not try to arrest me. But this is your hour to act, when the power of darkness rules.

dag: Dama ŋunkam bo n-nya ma, o nya nyɛvili, ka Yawɛ ni niŋ o nirilim.
en: Those who find me find life, and the Lord will be pleased with them.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ paɣisaribil ti doo, ka na bi kulis o, ka do so ti chirig o tiŋ puuni n-zaŋ o dɔni.
en: If a young woman who is a virgin is engaged to one man and another man meets up with her in a town and has sex with her.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi yɛli, Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ pala alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu yɛtɔɣa. Alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi so zuɣu ni tooi neei zom nina.
en: But others said, How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person.

dag: Di saha maa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Naawuni be a sani a ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: At that time Abimelech, and Phicol commander of his forces, said to Abraham, God is with you in everything that you do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ahaz daa tim tuumba Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza sani nti yɛl o, N nyɛla a bia ni a dabili, kamina nti fa ma Siria naa mini Izraɛl naa bɛn kana ti liri ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: Ahaz sent messengers to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria with this message: I am your servant. I am like a son to you. Come and save me from the king of Aram and the king of Israel. They have come to fight me.

dag: So ni tooi wuhi Naawuni ŋun kariti wɔɣira saria ŋɔ yɛm?.
en: Will they instruct God— he who judges the most powerful?.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, gunibu mali buchi la a yi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm; amaa a yi bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, dindina a bemi kaman ŋun bi guni.
en: If you obey the Law, your circumcision is of value; but if you disobey the Law, you might as well never have been circumcised.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, Daadam Bia mini malaika kasinim yi ti labina o Ba jilima ni, o gba ni ti zo vi ni o zaŋ dilan pah o niriba ni.
en: Whoever is ashamed of me and my words in this unfaithful and sinful generation, the Human One will be ashamed of that person when he comes in the Fathers glory with the holy angels.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la. .
en: Two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shihi bia maa bee n-niŋ o shɛli; dama pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni a shiri zɔri Naawuni hal ka bi mɔŋ o a bigaŋ ŋɔ.
en: Don't hurt the boy or do anything to him, he said. Now I know that you honor and obey God, because you have not kept back your only son from him.

dag: Ka a bia yi ti bɔh a daliri shɛli din chɛ ka a doli zaligu maa, nyin yɛlim o, Ti ni daa nyɛ daba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Yawɛ n-daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-yihi ti dabitim ni, lala zuɣu ka ti doli zaligu maa.
en: In the future, your children will ask why you do this. They will say, What does all this mean? And you will answer, The Lord used his great power to save us from Egypt. We were slaves in that place, but he led us out and brought us here.

dag: Yisa daa wuhi shihira pam o nyaandoliba maa ninni, ka din yɛla bi sabi niŋ litaafi ŋɔ ni.
en: Then Jesus did many other miraculous signs in his disciples presence, signs that arent recorded in this scroll.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka buɣim daa diri zoli maa, ka alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi la daa be n nuh ayi ni.
en: Then I turned and came down from the mountain. The mountain was burning with fire. And the two stone tablets of the agreement were in my hands.

dag: Ka n daa labina nti nya chirimbu shɛli Ɛliashib ni chirim chɛ ka Tɔbaya be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni dundɔŋ ni nɛma duu maa ni maa.
en: and returned to Jerusalem. There I was shocked to find that Eliashib had allowed Tobiah to use a room in the Temple.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa jɛndi Ijiptinim maa, ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm, ka bɛ niŋ Yawɛ min o dabili Musa yɛda.
en: The Israelites saw the great power of the Lord when he defeated the Egyptians. So the people feared and respected the Lord , and they began to trust the Lord and his servant Moses.

dag: N dɔɣiriba mini n zɔnim zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: my relatives and friends are gone.

dag: Wuhim ma ka n niŋ a yubu, dama nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Chɛ ka a Shi suŋ maa wuhi ma soli din tuhi.
en: Show me what you want me to do. You are my God. Let your good Spirit lead me over level ground.

dag: ka o yɛl o dɔɣira maa, Naomi ŋun yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la mali tiŋgbani din nyɛ ti dɔɣira Ɛlimɛlɛk dini m-bɔri ni o kɔhi li.
en: Then Boaz spoke to Naomis close relative. He said, Naomi came back from the hill country of Moab. She wants to sell the land that belonged to our relative Elimelech.

dag: Dama ti yi di bi kpalim ʒiya, ŋ-ŋɔ ti di pun chaŋ pahi buyi ka labina.
en: If you had let us go before, we could have already made two trips for food.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila lala ni bɛ zahim o nya o taali ka fiɣis o. Ka Yisa daa silim n-zaŋ o nubila sabiri tiŋa.
en: They said this to test him, because they wanted a reason to bring an accusation against him. Jesus bent down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

dag: Amaa n ti ku darigi deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, dama n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini ti a bia maa n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii shɛli leegi n tiŋ la zuɣu.
en: Still, I will not tear away all the kingdom from your son. I will leave him one tribe to rule. I will do this for my servant David and for Jerusalem, the city I chose.

dag: A ni daa piligi balindi Naawuni saha shɛl la ka o daa garig a. Naawuni yur a pam. Lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti yɛl a o ni garig a yɛli shɛm. Dinzuɣu luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn wuh a ʒii maa gbinni shɛm.
en: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pii dɔbba zali ka bɛ gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam n-sɔɣiri bɛn daa kana ti liri ba maa kpiimba bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ mali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin vihi.
en: After the seven months are over, men will be chosen to travel through the land in order to find and bury those bodies remaining on the ground, so that they can make the land clean.

dag: A yi zab ti zuɣu, ka niriba wum zabili maa damli, bɛ zɔrimi.
en: Your powerful voice makes people run away in fear. Your greatness causes the nations to run away.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya biɛɣu mini mɔɣilo paɣ o.
en: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ ni yino, ka nyɛ ŋun daa pun chaŋ Yisa san la bɔhi ba.
en: One of the Pharisees there was Nicodemus, the man who had gone to see Jesus before. He said to the others.

dag: O yi kana, Kɛilanim ni gbaai ma ti o? O shiri nyɛla ŋun ni kana kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni wum shɛm maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, yɛlim mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛl o, O ni kana.
en: Would the leaders of Keilah turn me over to Saul? Or is he really coming? Please tell me, Lord . Yes, he will come, the Lord answered.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa teei Yawɛ dabili Musa ʒiɛman la yɛla ka bɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun daa tilig o niriba toondaannim teeku ni la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun daa zaŋ o shia kasi ti Musa la lee be ya?.
en: But then they remembered the past, the days of Moses, the servant of the Lord , and they asked, Where now is the Lord , who saved the leaders of his people from the sea? Where is the Lord , who gave his spirit to Moses?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya nasara saria karibu ni, ka alahichinim mi ku be wuntizɔriba ni.
en: And thats why the wicked will have no standing in the court of justice— neither will sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi be di ni maa ni.
en: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ daa chɛ ka Asa suhu yiɣisi bahi anab maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o kpɛhi duu nti ga o zoligɔnim zali, dama yɛlli maa daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi anabi maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Asa daa gbaai niriba maa shɛb nahimbu.
en: This made Asa so angry with the prophet that he had him put in chains. It was at this same time that Asa began treating some of the people cruelly.

dag: Zoomba nina neera, ka wɔbisi chana, ka kɔnsi tibiri kpaŋda, ka tikpiranim wumda, hal ka kpiimba gba neeri kum ni, ka lahibal suŋ waazu mi yihiri tiri tarimba.
en: Those who were blind are able to see . Those who were crippled are walking. People with skin diseases are cleansed. Those who were deaf now hear. Those who were dead are raised up. The poor have good news proclaimed to them .

dag: Di tamya zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu yɛla, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli sɔŋdi taba, dama dina n-nyɛ sara shɛŋa din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa yɛli, Di daa niŋla daliri ka n chaŋ Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu nti chirigi Sool ka o zaŋ omaŋ dalim o kpani, ka chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba daa kabiri kani o sanna.
en: The young man who brought the news replied, I just happened to be on Mount Gilboa and Saul was there, leaning on his spear, with chariots and horsemen closing in on him.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yi o ba bihi maa sani chaŋ ti be Tɔb tiŋgban ni. Ka nimaani bibiɛhi daa laɣim Jɛfita sanna ti dol o chani ŋ-ŋmɛri fari dira.
en: So Jephthah went away because of his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. In the land of Tob, some rough men began to follow Jephthah.

dag: Dama shɛlini so mi n-zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim ni tuumbaŋsim yɛm tum nya shɛli, ka ti chɛ li tila ŋun bi di di wahala ni o di di nyaɣisim. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣ silig shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni la, ka bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo siliga maa noli.
en: Joseph bought a linen cloth and took the body down from the cross. He had it wrapped in the cloth, and he put it in a tomb that had been cut into solid rock. Then he rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb.

dag: Yi ni ŋubiri mo viɛla ŋɔ di bi saɣi? Ka wula ka yi lan nɔri mo shɛŋa din kpalim ŋɔ sɔŋdi tiŋa? Yi yi nyu ko viɛlli, di lan kpami ni yi zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli din kpalim?.
en: Some of you are not satisfied with eating the best grass; you even trample down what you don't eat! You drink the clear water and muddy what you don't drink!.

dag: Naawuni daa kahig o daanfaani wuhi palɔni ni di chɛ ka sokam tooi nya tiliginsim.
en: The grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all people.

dag: Asha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣa Sɛra.
en: These are the descendants of Asher. He had four sons: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah; and one daughter, Serah.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Di simdi ni ti yili wumpaɣibo yilli paɣi ti Naawuni; dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim, ka di simdi ni ti yili yilli paɣ o.
en: Praise the LORD! Because it is good to sing praise to our God! Because it is a pleasure to make beautiful praise!.

dag: Amaa di yi pa lala, buɣim din yim Abimilɛk ni na ti di yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnima; ka chɛ ka buɣim yi yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim gba ni na ti di Abimilɛk.
en: But leaders of Shechem and the house of Millo, if you have not acted right, may Abimelech destroy you. And may Abimelech be destroyed too.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka a nya filiŋ zuliya kam sani, ka ninsalinim lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: The Lord is going to make you weak, and no one will respect you.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka bɛ gbiri yihiri kuriti, ka nyɛligiri tahiʒiɛɣu mi kuɣa ni.
en: Iron is dug out of the ground, and copper is melted out of the rocks.

dag: Ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun daa sabiri bina yɛla zaani la daa ka sapashin kpɛm maa sanna.
en: Three men from Jerusalem went out to talk with the commander. These men were Eliakim son of Hilkiah, Joah son of Asaph, and Shebna. Eliakim was the palace manager, Joah was the record keeper, and Shebna was the royal secretary.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul tahiri bindira na ti tiri Naa Sulemaana mini bɛnkam zaa dir o yiŋa, bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o ni su gol shɛli, bɛ mi daa bi chɛri ka binshɛli poor o.
en: And each month one of the twelve district governors gave King Solomon everything he needed for all the people who ate at the kings table.

dag: ka o daa tim Tɛkɔa nti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun mali yɛm na ti yɛl o, Niŋmi kaman a nira n-kpi ka a kumd o zuɣu la. Zaŋmi kuyili situra niŋ amaŋa ka di ʒe kpam, amaa kul niŋmi kaman paɣ so ŋun nir kpi ka o kumd o zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ la.
en: so he sent for a clever woman who lived in Tekoa. When she arrived, he said to her, Pretend that you are in mourning; put on your mourning clothes, and don't comb your hair. Act like a woman who has been in mourning for a long time.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ Naa Dauda kpana la min o nyɔtaɣiri kara ni zaɣibihi zaa din daa be Naawuni duu la ni n-ti sapashin kpamba bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga maa.
en: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ omaŋ pahi ninvuɣ nɛma zaa ni mali tahima, dama ba nɛɔŋ so gbuɣin kpiŋ.
en: As long as we are alive, we still have hope, just as a live dog is better off than a dead lion.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu kul ku paai wuntizɔriba, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri kul bela yɛla ni sahakam.
en: No harm happens to the righteous, but the wicked receive their fill of trouble.

dag: Ka Reechɛl dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayi ti Yaakubu.
en: Bilhah became pregnant again and bore Jacob a second son.

dag: ka o bɛhi nyɛ kuriti, ka o napɔnvari shɛli polo nyɛ kuriti, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri.
en: Its legs were of iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.

dag: So miri ka o ti zaŋ o ma dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa ka nyɛ o ma, di bi simdi ni o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: You must not uncover your fathers nakedness, which is your mothers nakedness. She is your mother; you must not have sexual contact with her.

dag: M mi ni Ijipti naa maa ku chɛ ka yi chaŋ, naɣila n zaŋla kiŋkansi niŋ o.
en: But I know that the Pharaoh will not let you go. Only a great power will force him to let you go.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka neesim shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa zaa niŋ liɣa a zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zibigi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The heavens will become black, leaving your country in total darkness. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kpalim be Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim sani o yiŋa chira ata. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim ni ni o ni daa mali binshɛlikam zaa ni.
en: Gods Holy Box stayed with Obed Edoms family in his house for three months. The Lord blessed Obed Edoms family and everything Obed Edom owned.

dag: ka di ti nyɛ shihirili yi sani. Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: These rocks will be a sign for you. In the future, your children will ask you, What do these rocks mean.

dag: Ka Pɛkahia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Pekahiahs deeds and all that he accomplished are written in the official records of Israels kings.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba daa yi Galili n-chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni ni Jɔn ti baptaiz o.
en: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa daa mali o kpamba saawara, ka tim ti yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia, ka nyɛ Jɛhu yaaŋa la ni o kana ti chɛ ka bɛ nina pali taba.
en: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his advisors. Then he sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel. Amaziah said to Jehoash, Lets meet face to face. Jehoash was Jehoahazs son. Jehoahaz was Jehus son.

dag: Dama jɛrigu tɔɣisirila jɛrilim yɛtɔɣa, ka tɛhiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu yɛla. O ni tumdi shɛm min o ni yɛri shɛm nyɛla biriginsim zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani. O mi na ʒi n-ti kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu bee n-niŋ kom ti kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Fools speak folly; their minds devise wickedness, acting irreverently, speaking falsely of the LORD, leaving the hungry empty, and depriving the thirsty of drink.

dag: Ka ti ni tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa bi yila chirimbu bee kɔr biɛri bee yɛmbimbiɛri yɔhiŋgu ni na;.
en: When we encourage people to believe the Good News, its not out of wrong motives. We are not trying to trick or fool anyone.

dag: ka lihi zuɣusaa, ka siɣim ka yɛli tikpiralan maa, Efata! Di gbinni nyɛla, Yooma.
en: Looking into heaven, Jesus sighed deeply and said, Ephphatha, which means, Open up.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din mali daŋa m-mali sara, dama n ku deei li yi sani.
en: If you offer any animal that has any defects, the Lord will not accept it.

dag: Sool ni daa ŋmaligi Samuɛl sani ni o chaŋ, ka Naawuni taɣ o suhu. Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa daa niŋ pali dindali maa.
en: And just as Saul turned to leave Samuels side, God gave him a different heart, and all these signs happened that very same day.

dag: Ti yab Naa Dauda nam din kanna ti Duuma yuli ni ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: Blessings on the coming kingdom of our ancestor David! Hosanna in the highest.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka di niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza alahiziba, ka o vaai yiɣisi zani ka bɔh o kpambaliba, Pa niriba ata ka ti lo mihi niŋ buɣim ŋɔ ni la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Naa, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Suddenly Nebuchadnezzar leaped to his feet in amazement. He asked his officials, Didn't we tie up three men and throw them into the blazing furnace? They answered, Yes, we did, Your Majesty.

dag: Ka Rubin mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn daa lo kpara la daa gari niriba maa tooni kaman Musa ni daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm la.
en: The people of Reuben, the people of Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh crossed over, organized for war ahead of the Israelites, exactly as Moses had told them.

dag: O daa poya yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka ti tiligi ti dimnim nuu ni, ka jɛmdi ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm;.
en: a promise to free us from the power of our enemies, so that we could serve him without fear.

dag: Naawuni ni be ti polo zuɣu, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn no n-taai ti dimnim maa ti ti.
en: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.

dag: Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa kul palila zinaniŋdiba. Noli yɛlibu la zuɣu, tiŋgbɔŋ maa kumdimi ka biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee kuui. Bɛ tuma nyɛla tuumbiɛri, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ tuma pala din tuhi.
en: The land is full of people unfaithful to the Lord ; they live wicked lives and misuse their power. Because of the Lord 's curse the land mourns and the pastures are dry.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi zaɣisi, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ kpi bɛmaŋmaŋ ʒilinsi zuɣu.
en: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Anduru, ka Anduru mini Filip daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: Philip told Andrew, and Andrew and Philip told Jesus.

dag: Di nyɛla ti ni pun wum binshɛŋa yɛla ka mi li. Di nyɛla ti yaannim ni daa pun yɛli ti shɛli yɛla.
en: These are things we learned from our ancestors.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi sokam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Anab titali ka dunia ŋɔ ni na nti be ti sani. Ka bɛ lan yɛli, Naawuni n-ka o niriba sani maa na.
en: They all were filled with fear and praised God. A great prophet has appeared among us! they said; God has come to save his people.

dag: Amaa zaawuni yi ti paai, ŋun sum kom, ka wuntaŋ yi ti lu, o ni tooi lan labi sansani maa ni na.
en: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.

dag: Amaa so ni yɛli, A malila yɛda, ka m mi mali tuma. N gba ni yɛli, Wuhim ma a yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma maa, ka m mi wuh a n yɛda niŋbu n tuma tumbu puuni.
en: Someone might claim, You have faith and I have action. But how can I see your faith apart from your actions? Instead, Ill show you my faith by putting it into practice in faithful action.

dag: Di pala zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to ka a ku tooi wum li. Biɛhiŋ kani n yi tim a bɛ sani, bɛ ni wum a yɛligu.
en: If I sent you to great nations that spoke difficult languages you didn't understand, they would listen to you.

dag: A ni zaŋ o bidibisi maa gba na ti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba.
en: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons.

dag: nti zaŋ li kpɛhi bɛ buɣili Dagɔn duu ti zali baɣili buɣili Dagɔn.
en: They carried Gods Holy Box into the temple of Dagon and put it next to the statue of Dagon.

dag: N daa yooi dunoli maa ti n yura maa, amaa ka o bi kpɛna ka ŋmaligi chaŋ. N ni daa kul wum o kukoli, ka n suhu kpe o ni. Ka n daa yina lihi bo o, amaa ka bi nya o. Ka n daa bol o, amaa ka o bi garigi.
en: I opened the door for my lover, but he had already gone. How I wanted to hear his voice! I looked for him, but couldn't find him; I called to him, but heard no answer.

dag: Sokam daa yola bɛkabɛka . Bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani maa, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: This amount equaled the total paid by all persons enrolled in the census, each one paying the required amount, weighed according to the official standard. There were , men twenty years old or older enrolled in the census.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n ni pɔbisi tinzunnim bɛn lir a zaa bahi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn zɔr dabiɛm zo yomyom kaman pɔhim n-ʒe wurigu chaŋ la. Nini pɔbbu ni neebu.
en: Jerusalem, all the foreigners who attack you will be blown away like dust, and their terrifying armies will fly away like straw. Suddenly and unexpectedly.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ jɛrigu niŋ tol ni pahi bɛ ni yɛn to shɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ tiliga to o, di zaa yoli, bɛ ku tooi to jɛrilim yih o ni.
en: Even if you pound fools to powder like grain in a bowl, you will never force the foolishness out of them.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Shilo n-lihi nya, ka daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnim kaman di ni daa simdi ni bɛ zuliya kam deei shɛm.
en: Joshua threw lots for them in front of the Lord at Shiloh. In this way Joshua divided the land and gave each tribe its part of the land.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: M Ba, a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma la, m bi chɛ ka bɛ ni yino bɔrigi.
en: He said this so that what he had said might come true: Father, I have not lost even one of those you gave me.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti di daa, ka bɛ saɣi ni o yom ba tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri; ka o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ o puu maa ni.
en: After he had agreed to pay them the usual amount for a day's work, he sent them off to his vineyard.

dag: Cham niriba ŋɔ sani ti yɛli ba: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: Go to this people and say: You will hear, to be sure, but never understand; and you will certainly see but never recognize what you are seeing. .

dag: Di saha maa tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn zaa kana ti liri tin shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la mini bɛ bidibbina ni bɛ tɔbutuhiri nɛma ni bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la bee nir ni nya binshɛli ʒii yuŋ shɛm la.
en: Many nations will fight against Ariel. It will be a nightmare. Armies will surround Ariel and punish her.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: But God told the prophet Shemaiah.

dag: Sool ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa, ka Naawuni shia siɣ o zuɣu na ni kpiɔŋ pam, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Gods spirit came over Saul when he heard those words, and he burned with anger.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ gballi maa gbini, ka o suhu ti lan saɣim pam. Gballi maa daa nyɛla siliga, ka kuɣili yo di noli.
en: Deeply moved once more, Jesus went to the tomb, which was a cave with a stone placed at the entrance.

dag: N ni daa bol a maa, a daa vu m-miri ma; a daa yɛli ma, Di zɔri dabiɛm.
en: You answered me and told me not to be afraid.

dag: Paɣisarili ni tooi tam o salima yɛri yɛla? Bee amiliya ni tooi tam o daamiliya binyɛra yɛla? Amaa n niriba ŋɔ bɛn ni tam n yɛla dabisi shɛŋa ka kalinli.
en: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.

dag: Gɛrishomnim mi, bɛ daa zaŋla Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti ba. Bɛ daa zaŋla Golan din be Bashan la mini Ashitarɔt ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The families of the clan of Gershon were assigned the following towns, with the surrounding pasture lands: In the territory of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan, and Ashtaroth.

dag: Ka naa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wum ba pam, ka o zani nimaani vuhi.
en: When David and those with him came to the Jordan River, they were tired out. But after they rested, they felt much better.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Di bi sabi yimaŋmaŋ zaligu ni ni Naawuni yɛliya ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ŋmahinli?.
en: Jesus replied, Isnt it written in your Law, I have said, you are gods?.

dag: Hal saŋkpaliŋ zomi ka chɛ o biliɛɣu mɔɣu ni, dama mɔri lan kani.
en: In the field the mother deer abandons her newborn fawn because there is no grass.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a yi dol ti chaŋ, Yawɛ yi ti niŋ ti zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam, lala ka ti gba ni niŋ a.
en: If you come with us, we will share with you all the good things that the Lord gives us.

dag: Amaa Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa bɛn be o sani ni daa wum Nɛtania bia Ishimail ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Johanan and all the army leaders with him heard of the crime that Ishmael had committed.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a mini so zabi ka di ka soli, ka di pala o tum a la taali.
en: Don't argue with others for no reason when they have never done you any harm.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ gbahi n niriba chaŋ ka bɛ bi baŋ. Kum ni ku yi zuɣulaannima, ka kɔnyuri ku yi tarimba mi.
en: Therefore, my people go into exile since they didnt understand— their officials are dying of hunger; so many of them are dried up with thirst.

dag: Kum ni kɔnyuri ti ku muɣisi ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim mini pɔhim tulli ti ku kpe ba. Dama ŋun yuri ba n-yɛn mali ba chana. O ni zaŋ ba tahi kɔzɔrim shee.
en: They wont hunger or thirst; the burning heat and sun wont strike them, because one who has compassion for them will lead them and will guide them by springs of water.

dag: Ka Maika maa daa ti yɛl o ma, A daanzinfa kpila tuhili ni kɔbiga shɛli bɛ ni daa zu ka a yɛli noli ti ŋun zu li, ka yɛli ma di yɛla la, nyama, di be n sani, mani n-daa kpuɣ li. Ka o ma yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ m bia ŋɔ ni.
en: One day he told his mother, Do you remember those , pieces of silver that were stolen from you? I was there when you put a curse on whoever stole them. Well, I'm the one who did it. His mother answered, I pray that the Lord will bless you, my son.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yiɣisi zani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini gbini Izraɛlnim zaa ninni n-kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: Solomon stood before the LORDs altar in front of the entire Israelite assembly and, spreading out his hands toward the sky.

dag: Ka n yi ti kana, ka yi pii yi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-sab gbana ti ba, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yi pini maa tahi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana, dama mani n-sun ya. N ni yihi yi ninvuɣ yinoyino yi fɔntinsi ni na, ka yihi yi niriba ayiyi yi daŋ kam ni na n-zaŋ ya ka Ziɔn na.
en: Return, rebellious children, declares the LORD, for Im your husband. Ill gather you— one from a city and two from a tribe— and bring you back to Zion.

dag: Amaa n ni daa yuuni bɔri zaɣ viɛlli saha shɛli, zaɣ biɛɣu n-daa paai ma; ka n ni daa guhiri neesim saha shɛli, zibisim n-daa ti kana.
en: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.

dag: Dama so ku tooi lan zali tanza shɛli pahila din pun zali maa, dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia.
en: No one can lay any other foundation besides the one that is already laid, which is Jesus Christ.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Ɛbɛl daa mali sara din so Keen dini, ka di daa tiɣi Naawuni nini, ka o deeg o pini maa ka lih o wuntizɔra. Ɛbɛl pun kpi, amaa o yɛda niŋbu puuni o na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: By faith Abel offered a better sacrifice to God than Cain, which showed that he was righteous, since God gave approval to him for his gift. Though he died, hes still speaking through faith.

dag: Ka a ti lan mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbambiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: Make two more gold rings and put them on the other two corners of the judgment pouch. This will be on the inside edge of the judgment pouch next to the ephod.

dag: Di doli daadamnim bɛn vuhim kul be bɛ nyɛhi ni kɔŋko la yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ bukaata nyɛ bɔ?.
en: Quit admiring the human race, who breathe through their nostrils. Why should they be admired?.

dag: O mi ni o daguya mali nyɔri, o firila bi kpiri yuŋ.
en: She works late into the night to make sure her business earns a profit.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mbaye, n yidan kpimi ka n kpalim pakoli.
en: King David said to her, Whats your problem? The woman said, I am a widow. My husband is dead.

dag: nti kurim lihi di ni nya ka bimpiɛlli doya, amaa ka o lee bi kpe di ni.
en: He bent over and saw the strips of linen cloth lying inside the tomb, but he did not go in.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka oki tihi laani ginda, ka chɛ ka nyɔŋ tihi vari suu. Ka bɛnkam zaa be o jɛmbu duu puuni yɛli, Timiya Naawuni jilima.
en: The Lord 's voice shakes the oaks and strips the leaves from the trees while everyone in his Temple shouts, Glory to God.

dag: A pun mali paɣa? Di bɔri soli ni a yih o. A na ka paɣa? Di bo paɣa.
en: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be a daalikauli la ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri duŋ taabu kul palila tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ zibisim shee.
en: Consider the covenant! Because the lands dark places are full of violence.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka niriba ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ ma ʒiɛmbu? Hal n ni wuhi ba shihira shɛŋa la zaa yoli, bɛ kul zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ ma yɛda.
en: The LORD said to Moses, How long will these people disrespect me? And how long will they doubt me after all the signs that I performed among them?.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi; di chɛ ka n di vi. A wuntitali puuni, tiligim ma!.
en: I come to you, Lord , for protection; never let me be defeated. You are a righteous God; save me, I pray!.

dag: Di nyɛla din ni tooi sɔŋ nira kaman liɣiri ni sɔŋdi nir shɛm. Baŋsim daanfaani nyɛla yɛm tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun mal li nyɛvili.
en: and will give you as much security as money can. Wisdom keeps you safe—this is the advantage of knowledge.

dag: Abana mini Faaripa mɔɣa din be Damaskus la bi so koma zaa din be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni? N naan dii ku chaŋ nimaani nti mim ka nya alaafee? Dinzuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: What about the Abana River or the Pharpar River? Those rivers in Damascus are just as good as any river in Israel. I could have washed in them and been cured.

dag: Ka yi yi puhirila yi zɔnim kɔŋko, tuun suŋ bɔ ka yi lee zaŋ gari yi taba? Pa lala ka zuliya kam gba niŋda?.
en: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing? Dont even the Gentiles do the same?.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla alizin biɛri n-chani dunia nanim zaa sani nti wuhiri shihira ni bɛ laɣim ba lo tɔbu gu Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ dabisi tital la dali.
en: These are demonic spirits that do signs. They go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for battle on the great day of God the Almighty. .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ti ni bo bin gbaliŋ shɛŋa zaa ni ti me jɛmbu duu n-ti a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din yi a nuu ni na, ka nyɛ a ni su shɛli.
