en: O Lord , our God, we have brought together all this wealth to build a temple to honor your holy name, but it all came from you and all belongs to you.

dag: Biŋkpil shɛŋa din daa tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu zɔŋ ni la daa nyɛla paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi, ka di dubu pooi mita ayi biɛla.
en: The caps for the columns of the porch were almost two meters high and were shaped like lilies.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag o ka o kpaag o nina kpa malaika maa ka bɔh o, N dana, wula? Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, What is this all about? The angel answered, God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.

dag: Deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani.
en: This will happen if you listen to the Lord your God—if you obey all his commands that I give you today. You must do what the Lord your God says is right.

dag: Amaa yi ni da dab so ka gun o, o ni tooi di bindirigu maa o gunibu nyaaŋa.
en: but any slave that you have bought may eat it if you circumcise him first.

dag: Di saha maa ka Gidiɔn daa baŋ ni Yawɛ malaika m-bala; ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, dama n nini nya Yawɛ malaika.
en: Gideon then realized that it was the Lord 's angel he had seen, and he said in terror, Sovereign Lord ! I have seen your angel face-to-face.

dag: nti kurim lihi di ni nya ka bimpiɛlli doya, amaa ka o lee bi kpe di ni.
en: Bending down to take a look, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he didnt go in.

dag: Dama ti yi daa nyɛ Naawuni dimnima, amaa ka simdi yipa kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni o Bia la kum zuɣu, dindina din gari lala nyɛla, simdi ni kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ maa zuɣu, ti ni tilig o bia maa nyɛvili zuɣu.
en: We were God's enemies, but he made us his friends through the death of his Son. Now that we are God's friends, how much more will we be saved by Christ's life!.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: The followers answered, The Master needs it.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi nahindi n niriba ka diri tarimba zuɣu nyɔri? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.

dag: Zaŋmi gbantolima mini dapua m-mali naɣikɔra dapua n-zaŋ pa a nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord said to me: Jeremiah, make a yoke out of straps and poles. Put that yoke on the back of your neck.

dag: O ni chɛ ka bidibbihi nyɛ bɛ nanima, ka biliɛri su ba.
en: The Lord will let the people be governed by immature boys.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o maani maligu tir o laŋ maa, ka zaŋdi pina tir o daasau maa, dama dina n-tir o azichi, ka chɛ ka o diri bindir viɛla.
en: They even worship their nets and offer sacrifices to them, because their nets provide them with the best of everything.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-wuhiri yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli: Di pala tinima n-daa yuri Naawuni, amaa ŋuna n-daa yuri ti ka tim o Bia na ni o ti leei sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi.
en: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.

dag: Dauda daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi yaha, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Ibihar mini Ɛlishama ni Ɛlifɛlɛt.
en: There were nine other sons. They were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

dag: Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn zaŋ saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisi ka o chɛ ka bɛ wum? Nyama, bɛ tiba ŋarimi, bɛ ku tooi wum. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla ansarisi bini bɛ sani. Bɛ baɣa ka di ni.
en: To whom can I speak and warn? How can I get someones attention? Their ears are shut tight, so they wont hear. They are ashamed of the LORDs word and take no pleasure in it.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa nyɛla wuntizɔriba, ka daa doli ti Duuma Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim mini adiini soli kaya zaa ka ka galimi shɛli.
en: They both lived good lives in God's sight and obeyed fully all the Lord's laws and commands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti baptaizibu deebu zuɣu wuhiya ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ ti, ka di bemi kaman Masia ni daa neei kum ni ti Ba Naawuni jilima yiko zuɣu shɛm la, lala zuɣu ka ti gba yipa mali nyɛvili palli biɛhigu.
en: Therefore, we were buried together with him through baptism into his death, so that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too can walk in newness of life.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me Nam ʒiishee zɔŋ, din nyɛ o ni yɛn kariti saria luɣ shɛli. Zɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ sariadibo shee. Sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali di tiŋ hal ti gbaai di yɔɣira.
en: He made the throne room the Hall of Justice, where he would judge. It was covered with cedar from the lower to the upper levels.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa garigi yɛli paɣ maa, N yi bɔh a bɔhigu nyin di sɔɣi ma shɛli. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dan naa, bɔhim ma.
en: Then David said to the woman, Now I'm going to ask you a question, and don't try to hide the truth! The woman replied, Please go ahead, Your Majesty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa ni, ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒɛbu.
en: When they got into the boat, the wind settled down.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna maa nyɛla Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋ tin ya ka o be yi ni la duu? Yi bi su yimaŋa.
en: You should know that your body is a temple for the Holy Spirit that you received from God and that lives in you. You dont own yourselves.

dag: ka o niŋ li pam niŋ ti ni la zuɣu. Naawuni yɛm min o ni nyari din be tooni zaa la zuɣu.
en: which he gave to us in such large measure! In all his wisdom and insight.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa yɛl ti, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba m-bɔŋɔ: chɛliya yi ni yino n sani, ka zaŋ kawana kuli ti ti yi yiŋnim shɛb kum ni muɣisi maa;.
en: Then the governor of Egypt told us, I'll find out if you really are honest. Leave one of your brothers here with me, while you take the grain to your starving families.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa duh o pam zaŋ o ʒili jilima ʒiishee, ka ti o yuli din tibisi gari yuli kam.
en: So God raised him up to the most important place and gave him the name that is greater than any other name.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun miligi naa suhu, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: Fear an angry king as you would a growling lion; making him angry is suicide.

dag: O ku chɛ ka n vuhi lu m puuni, ka chɛ ka naŋgbantom kul paari ma.
en: He would not let me catch my breath again. He would just give me more trouble.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ bahigu, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyu Kpiɔŋlan Naa suhuyiɣisili.
en: Let their own eyes witness their doom. Let them drink from the Almightys wrath.

dag: A wuntitali la zuɣu, yihim ma ka fa ma bahi. Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma.
en: Deliver me and rescue me by your righteousness! Bend your ear toward me and save me!.

dag: Asa daa tum din tuhi ka viɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Asa did what was right and good in the LORD his Gods eyes.

dag: Giriikinim shɛb daa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni chuɣu maa puhibu ni la kalinli ni.
en: Some Greeks were among those who had come up to worship at the festival.

dag: Ka o daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The spirits inside the man begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of that area.

dag: Bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma zaa la niriba nini zuɣu, ka niŋdi bɛ ni piriti sab shɛŋa mini din pari bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu ka di nyɛ zaɣ yɛlima, ka chɛri ka bɛ binyɛra naŋgbanzusa nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣila.
en: Everything they do is just to show off in front of others. They even make a big show of wearing Scripture verses on their foreheads and arms, and they wear big tassels for everyone to see.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n yihi Ijipti vi shɛli yi ni diri la ka chɛn ya. Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Giligal, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Today I have removed from you the disgrace of being slaves in Egypt. That is why the place was named Gilgal, the name it still has.

dag: Amaa benya kaman tihi la m-mali wala yi biɛhigu ni din ni wuhi ni yi shiri niŋ tuuba ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Change your hearts! And show by the way you live that you have changed.

dag: Bɛ malila bindirigu dibu shili, ka yɛrigi kpahisi sɔŋ nimaani, ka bɛ ʒini di ka nyu. Ka sapashin kpamba yiɣisi niŋ kpam mali bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: People are rushing around shouting their orders: Set the table! Post the guard! Get something to eat and drink! Officers, get up! Polish your shields.

dag: N ni zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi n-kɔhi Judanim zuɣu; ka bɛ mi zaŋ ba kɔhi Sabinim bɛn nyɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋ la nim zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will sell your sons and your daughters as a possession of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a nation far away; for the LORD has spoken.

dag: Juda ŋmanila gbuɣimbila. M bia, a ku a dima, ka ŋmaligi kpe a yiŋa. A teeg amaŋ dɔni kaman gbuɣinli la. A ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi dam a?.
en: My son, you are a lion ready to eat your victim! You are terribly fierce; no one will bother you.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-tahi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ duu na. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbaligu bihim duɣi bɛ bihi.
en: Each year bring to the house of the Lord the first grain that you harvest. Do not cook a young sheep or goat in its mother's milk.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma ka teeku na kani, ka kɔbilinina din bilisiri kom pampam gba daa na kani.
en: When there were no watery depths, I was brought forth, when there were no springs flowing with water.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ darigi cheei Izraɛl nam kparibu a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-zaŋ li yɛl a kpe so ŋun so a.
en: Then Samuel told him, The LORD has ripped the kingdom of Israel from you today. He will give it to a friend of yours, someone who is more worthy than you.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla shɛli ka pa shɛli, o yɔhindila omaŋa.
en: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa tim Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat sani ti yɛl o, Mɔab naa zaɣisi ma jɛmbu. A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuh o? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N ni chaŋ. A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: He sent word to Judahs King Jehoshaphat, Moabs king has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab? Jehoshaphat responded, Yes, Ill go. Well fight as one: you and I, our troops and our horses.

dag: ni Ɛlitolad ni Bɛtul ni Hɔrima.
en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah.

dag: Gbib amaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lihim a wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga. Kul niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima, dama a yi niŋdi lala, a ni tilig amaŋa zaŋ tabili bɛn wumd a wuhibu.
en: Watch yourself and watch your teaching. Keep on doing these things, because if you do, you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli ŋɔɣu maa ni n yɛn karila alizin biɛri, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋ zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali n ni naai n tuma.
en: Jesus said to them, Go, tell that fox, Look, Im throwing out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will complete my work.

dag: Naa ni daa wum Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbini maa shɛm maa, ka o zani bimbini maa gbini ka teeg o nuu tiri ka yɛli, Gbaamiy o! Ka o ni daa teeg o nu shɛli tir o ka yɛl lala maa dii kpaŋ dilinli ka o kɔŋ li pɔribu.
en: When King Jeroboam heard this, he pointed at him and ordered, Seize that man! At once the king's arm became paralyzed so that he couldn't pull it back.

dag: Dama m mi ni Yawɛ galisiya; ti Duuma maa gari wuna zaa.
en: I know that our Lord is great, greater than all the gods.

dag: Zaŋm dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba, ka zali ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: Command and teach these things.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la zuɣu; o kɔbili ni ka di yina. O nyɛla Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu toondana ni di chɛ ka o nyɛ ŋun gari binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: He is the head of the body, the church, who is the beginning, the one who is firstborn from among the dead so that he might occupy the first place in everything.

dag: ni Ɛliɛl ŋun daa yi Mahava na la ni Jɛribai mini Jɔshavia bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛlnaam bihi la ni Itima ŋun daa yi Mɔab na la.
en: Eliel the Mahavite; Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam; Ithmah the Moabite;.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa yɛli, Malimiya n chɛchɛbuŋ shili ti ma. Ka bɛ mal li shili ti o. Di saha ka ŋun Izraɛl Naa Jɔram mini Juda Naa Ahazia daa kpe bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli n-daa mali ti tuh o soli maa la Nabɔt Jɛziriil nir la puu ni.
en: Joram commanded, Get my chariot ready. Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ mali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: For seven days the priests are to consecrate the altar and make it ready for use.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti suh a, nyin gbilisim tibili wum, ka sɔŋ ma yomyom.
en: I pray to you, Lord ! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.

dag: amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba ŋub maa, so daa naan ku tooi baŋ ni bɛ zaŋ ba ŋubi, dama bɛ daa na kul gaŋsigaŋsimi, ka be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa yirigi neei.
en: but no one would have known it, because they looked just as bad as before. Then I woke up.

dag: Yɛlim o ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni ninvuɣ so bɛ ni booni Tiwulli la ni zoog o biɛhigu shee n-yiɣisi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: Say to him, The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Here is a man. His name is Branch, and he will branch out from his place; he will build the LORDs temple.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa maa daa gbaai ma dabiɛm, ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.

dag: Amaa ka Sisɛra daa guui hal ti paai Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir la paɣ Jaɛl tanti gbini; dama zabili daa lan ka Hazɔr Naa Jabin mini Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir maa yiŋnim sunsuuni.
en: Only Sisera escaped. He ran to Heber's camp, because Heber and his family had a peace treaty with the king of Hazor. Sisera went to the tent that belonged to Jael, Heber's wife.

dag: Ka Yisifu maa daa nyɛ Matatias bia, ka Matatias nyɛ Amɔs bia, ka Amɔs nyɛ Nahum bia, ka Nahum nyɛ Ɛsili bia, ka Ɛsili mi nyɛ Nagai bia.
en: Joseph was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Amos. Amos was the son of Nahum. Nahum was the son of Esli. Esli was the son of Naggai.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Nyama, biɛɣuni sa nyɛla goli palli dabisili, ka di simdi ni m mini naa sa laɣim ʒini di bindirigu; amaa chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi mɔɣu ni hal ti paai daba ata dali zaawuni.
en: Then David said, Look, tomorrow is the New Moon celebration. I am supposed to eat with the king, but let me hide in the field until the evening.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata naabu saha, ka di daa ti niŋ daliri ka Shimɛi daba niriba ayi yi o sani n-zo n-chaŋ Maaka bia Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat naa la sani. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Shimɛi, Nyama, a daba la be Gaat.
en: Three years later, however, two of Shimei's slaves ran away to the king of Gath, Achish son of Maacah. When Shimei heard that they were in Gath.

dag: M biyurigu, a ʒe yim a ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa tiri ti mabihi la puuni, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ saamba la.
en: Dear friend, you act faithfully in whatever you do for our brothers and sisters, even though they are strangers.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl.
en: He put up an altar there and named it for El, the God of Israel.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa moli gili. Miriya ka yi zaŋ yi noli naai ninvuɣ biɛɣu m-pah o zuɣu di shɛhira kpɛma.
en: Dont tell lies against other people. If you are a witness in court, dont agree to help a bad person tell lies.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti saha shɛli, Yaakubu zuliya ni daa yi tinzun tiŋ ni saha shɛli.
en: The people of Israel escaped from Egypt. Yes, Jacobs descendants left that foreign country.

dag: Dama Yawɛ viɛla. O yurilim maŋli kul ni beni sahakam, ka o ʒiɛyimtali mi kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Lord is good; his love is eternal and his faithfulness lasts forever.

dag: Zaŋ kpa pal shɛli din daa do dundɔŋ ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pia la ni zaŋ kpa bɛ ni daa zaŋ kuɣa mali samban ni luɣ shɛli polo la, duri maa daa mɛmi tam taba buta zuɣu, ka yaɣ yini labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ din la tiŋli.
en: On one side it faced the space feet wide which was alongside the Temple, and on the other side it faced the pavement of the outer courtyard. It was built on three levels, each one set further back than the one below it.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ŋmanila ŋahili shɛli din wuhi: Bindoo bi waɣa ka nir ni tooi teeg omaŋ dɔni di zuɣu, ka chinchini gba bi yɛlima, ka nir ni tooi zaŋ li pil omaŋa.
en: A man tried to sleep on a bed that was too short for him. He had a blanket that was not wide enough to cover him. The bed and blanket were useless, and so were your agreements. .

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum ni Yisa pun kpi maa ka di gar o pam, ka o daa boli sapashin la na nti bɔh o ni Yisa shiri kpiya?.
en: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead. He called the army officer and asked him if Jesus had been dead a long time.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri ti anzansi ka kpaŋsiri ti suhuri ŋɔ chɛ ka yi doli Yisa Masia ka mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: All patience and encouragement come from God. And I pray that God will help you all agree with each other, as Christ Jesus wants.

dag: Ninsal shia yi mali yaa di deeri dɔro, amaa nira kɔba ni yi chɔɣisi, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi gbibi li?.
en: A good attitude will support you when you are sick, but if you give up, nothing can help.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Gɛhaazi daa shiri yiɣisi kariti Naaman naba. Ka Naaman daa ti nya ka so zɔri dol o nyaaŋa na, ka o sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli bɔh o, Alaafee.
en: So Gehazi pursued Naaman. Naaman saw him running after him, so he got down off his chariot to meet him. He said, Is everything okay.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimiya doli solɔri m-boli yi ni kul nya shɛb zaa ka bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ ni na.
en: Therefore, go to the roads on the edge of town and invite everyone you find to the wedding party.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli Bolimiya Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la gba na ka ti ti wum o mi ni mali shɛli ni o yɛli.
en: But Absalom said, Call Hushai from Erek. Lets hear what he has to say as well.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Nyama, a yi ti paai Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, nyin tummi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa n ni niŋ a yiko ni a tum maa Firawuna tooni, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ pam, ka o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: On the way the Lord said to Moses: When you get to Egypt, go to the king and work the miracles I have shown you. But I will make him so stubborn that he will refuse to let my people go.

dag: Bɛn kpalim mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ, pa ti Duuma n-yɛli dina: Yi ni so yi mali paɣa ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda ka paɣ maa yu ni o be o sani, ŋun miri ka o yih o.
en: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.

dag: M malaika maa yi ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ya tahi Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Keenannim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n ti ku ba ka chɛ ka yi ʒini nimaani.
en: My angel will go ahead of you and take you into the land of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and I will destroy them.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bee na ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuh o kpee, ka ku ʒini niŋ laasabu nya o ni tooi zaŋ tɔbbihi tuhi pia chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ o kpee ŋun mali tɔbbihi tuhi pisi?.
en: If a king goes out with ten thousand men to fight another king who comes against him with twenty thousand men, he will sit down first and decide if he is strong enough to face that other king.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim yɛn chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa su, ka yi bɔri ni yi gbarigi ba?.
en: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.

dag: Saha paaya ni saria karibu piligi; Naawuni niriba mi n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn daŋ tooni saria karibu maa ni. Ka di yi piligi ti sani, wula ka di ni ti bahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri Naawuni lahibal suŋ la sani?.
en: The time has come for judgment to begin, and God's own people are the first to be judged. If it starts with us, how will it end with those who do not believe the Good News from God?.

dag: N dana, a daa bɔhila tinim a daba ŋɔ, Yi mali ba bee tizo.
en: When we were here before, you asked us, Do you have a father or a brother.

dag: Naawuni, n nyɛla ŋun ka yaa ni nandana. Kam n sanna yomyom. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira, di yuui.
en: But me? Im poor and needy. Hurry to me, God! You are my helper and my deliverer. Oh, LORD, dont delay!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiri pini mali alibarika, dama bɛ niŋdi bɛ bindirigu tiri nandaamba.
en: Be generous and share your food with the poor. You will be blessed for it.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ takɔbi, saha yuusim wula ka a lee kul yɛn ŋmara? Labimi kpe a tɔɣu ni ti dɔni baalim vuhi.
en: You cry out, Sword of the Lord ! How long will you go on slashing? Go back to your scabbard, stay there and rest.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi naa ŋɔ ni gul o niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima. Bɛ ni ti tahiri tɔb gɔɣu ni kaman danyuriba la, ka ti yihi bɛ dimnim ʒim, ka di zɔri kaman sara maligu ʒim ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ laa ni n-kpaai pa bimbini zuɣu la.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces will protect them. They will devour and subdue like sling stones. They will drink, mumbling like one having wine. They will be filled like a bowl, like the corners of the altar.

dag: dama saha shɛli Tiudas ni daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ omaŋ leei wɔɣirili ka niriba paai kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi daa dol o la, bɛ daa ti ku o, ka bɛn dol o maa zaa wurim, ka o tuma maa gba daa zan tariga.
en: Remember when Theudas appeared? He said he was an important man, and about men joined him. But he was killed, and all who followed him were scattered and ran away. They were not able to do anything.

dag: Nir ni tooi di bindir shɛli din be piti ka pa ni yalim be di ni? Bee nyaɣisim bɔ n-lee be no gal piɛlli ni?.
en: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or does egg white have taste?.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yil shɛl ni o ni daa yɛn be, ka di ʒe saria karibu zɔŋ nyaaŋa la, lala ka bɛ daa me di gba. Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me yil shɛli ka di be kaman o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ me zɔn shɛl la n-ti o ni daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣin so la.
en: Solomon's own quarters, in another court behind the Hall of Judgment, were made like the other buildings. He also built the same kind of house for his wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ paai ti? Di nyɛla yi tuumbiɛri ni galisi zuɣu ka bɛ darigi fuɣi yi situra, ka bili ya.
en: You might ask yourself, Why has this bad thing happened to me? It happened because of your many sins. Because of your sins, your skirt was torn off, and your sandals were taken away. They did this to embarrass you.

dag: A nam nyɛla saha din ka bahigu nam, ka a su binshɛɣukam zaa ʒiɛmani kam ni. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim o yɛtɔɣa zaa ni, ka nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma zaa ni.
en: Your kingdom is a kingship that lasts forever; your rule endures for all generations. The LORD is trustworthy in all that he says, faithful in all that he does.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli pahi, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli yaha, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee ka je a dima.
en: You have heard that it was said, Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.

dag: amaa ka ŋmani maa daa yiɣi chaŋ ti bi nya o ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu, dama kom maa daa na kul tɛlila tiŋgbani luɣilikam zaa. Ka o daa lab o sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka o ti zaŋ o nuu tiri takɔro maa ni n-gbaag o kpɛh o sani ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: but the dove found no place to set its foot. It returned to him in the ark since waters still covered the entire earth. Noah stretched out his hand, took it, and brought it back into the ark.

dag: Hal Kriitinim ni booni bɛ ni ninvuɣ so anabi la maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya, Kriitinim kul nyɛla ʒiŋmariba mini biŋkɔb biɛri ni diribarilimnima.
en: It is like one of their own prophets once said, The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi, Yɛlimiya yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti yɛli tu ma maa zuɣu.
en: he said to them, Give this message to your master, Hezekiah: The Lord says, Dont be afraid of what you heard from the commanders! Dont believe what those boys from the king of Assyria said to make fun of me.

dag: di simdi ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la.
en: The priest shall take this fat and burn it on the altar used for the burnt offerings, just as he does with the fat from the animal killed for the fellowship offering.

dag: Lɛmiya yuri galigɛnima bamiya tɔbutuhiri yuri, Pilimiya kuriti zuɣupila zani yi zaashɛhi. Sahimiya yi kpana, ka yɛn ya kuriti gbaɣinɔnima.
en: Harness your horses and mount them! Fall in line and put on your helmets! Sharpen your spears! Put on your armor.

dag: O daa tuhi deei Izraɛl tintariga tinsi Lɛbohamat dunol shee zaŋ hal ti paai Araba Teeku ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Jona Amitai bia ŋun daa yi Gatihɛfa la na yɛli shɛm la.
en: He reestablished Israels border from Lebo-hamath to the Dead Sea. This was in agreement with the word that the LORD, the God of Israel, spoke through his servant the prophet Jonah, Amittais son, who was from Gath-hepher.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka vi gbahi o dimnim zaa; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa suhuri daa paligi tuun kar shɛŋa o ni tum maa zuɣu.
en: Jesus' words made his enemies ashamed. But everyone else in the crowd was happy about the wonderful things he was doing.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zo n-daŋ bɛ tooni nti du sinsabiga ni o nya o, dama Yisa daa yɛn dolila ni gari.
en: So he ran ahead of the crowd and climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus, who was going to pass that way.

dag: ka bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛnyaŋ bee bunyaŋ na nti ti Yawɛ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli.
en: Then you must bring your guilt offering to the Lord for the sin you did. You must bring a female lamb or a female goat as a sin offering. The priest will do this to make you pure from your sin.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tam dapuhi zuɣu n-zaŋ li buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa ka o zali shɛm la.
en: The Levites carried Gods chest with poles on their shoulders, just as Moses had commanded according to the LORDs word.

dag: Di luhiya ni ti suhuri paligi ka ti diɛm, dama a tizɔbil maa kpimi ka lan neena; o daa bɔrigimi, ka ti lan nya o maa.
en: But we had to celebrate and be glad because this brother of yours was dead and is alive. He was lost and is found.

dag: Ka do so yi mali bidibiga ŋun nyɛ tipawumlilana ŋun bi deer o ba min o ma noli, ka bɛ yi darig o tibili o ni bi deeri bɛ yɛligu zuɣu.
en: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisifu dan maa paɣ ti lihir o kɔre lihigu, ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: After some time, the wife of Josephs master began to pay special attention to him. One day she said to him, Sleep with me.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulinluhili polo ti yɛli Yawɛ ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: Those who are left will begin shouting louder than the ocean. They will rejoice about the Lord s greatness.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni ni Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi tuun shɛŋa din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi.
en: Fools say in their hearts, Theres no God. They are corrupt and do horrible deeds; not one of them does anything good.

dag: Kum yi mali tayiɣisi ka bɛ zu bindirigu di, niriba ku lihi ʒiɛm ba di zuɣu.
en: People don't despise a thief if he steals food when he is hungry;.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim taali maa galisiya pam. Bɛ kul kurila niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli tiŋ maa ni. Dama bɛ yɛra, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. Yawɛ bi nyara.
en: The Lord answered, The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.

dag: Yi pun zaɣisi ma, ka chɛ ma jɛmbu ka di waɣa, ka yɛra, Ti ku jɛm a. Yi daa jɛm buɣa daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini.
en: Long ago I broke your yoke; I shattered your chains. But even then you said, I wont serve you. On every high hill and under every lush tree, you have acted like a prostitute.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bo bumbila m-ba kaman di ni daa sab shɛm la. Di sabiya:.
en: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, as the Scriptures say.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu bahi Pɛlusium din nyɛ Ijiptinim tɔbu tuhibu yaa shee la zuɣu, ka saɣim Tɛbisinim daazichi.
en: The fortress city of Pelusium will feel my fierce anger, and all the troops stationed at Thebes will be slaughtered.

dag: N ni lan labi ti be m biɛhigu shee hal ka bɛ ti saɣi ni bɛ tum taali, ka bo n shee. Bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, bɛ ni bo n shee.
en: I will abandon my people until they have suffered enough for their sins and come looking for me. Perhaps in their suffering they will try to find me.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ŋahiba paɣ dɔni, o ŋahiba maa zaɣim ka o nya maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili; bɛ ku dɔɣi bia hal ti kpi.
en: If a man has intercourse with his uncle's wife, he disgraces his uncle, and he and the woman will pay the penalty; neither one will have children.

dag: Yi tamla Naawuni ni zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ omaŋmaŋ bihi la yɛla? O yɛliya: M bia, a Duuma yi saɣis a, nyin wumma; ka o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu miligi.
en: Have you forgotten the encouraging words which God speaks to you as his children? My child, pay attention when the Lord corrects you, and do not be discouraged when he rebukes you.

dag: Binshɛli ti ku pooi yi ni so, dama Yawɛ shiri niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini maa ni.
en: The Lord your God will bless you in the land that he is giving you. Not one of your people will be poor.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛm yiya mini Juda nanim yinsi ni bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri zuɣusaa binyara yiya shɛŋa mɔpila zuɣu zaa ni bɛ ni maani binnyura maligu tiri buɣa yiya shɛŋa mɔpila zuɣu zaa ni ti saɣim kaman Tɔfɛt ni saɣim shɛm maa.
en: The houses of Jerusalem and those of Judahs kings will become as foul as Topheth—all the houses on whose roofs they made offerings to the heavenly force and poured out drink offerings to other gods.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi ti nya ka Naawuni bɔhi biɛri, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti siɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ʒim ni n-no n-gili.
en: The righteous will be glad when they see sinners punished; they will wade through the blood of the wicked.

dag: A daa nyaya ka o suhu ʒe a yim, ka a daa lo o alikauli ni a ni zaŋ Keenanim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Jɛbusinim ni Gɛrigashinim tiŋgbɔŋ ti o, ka a daa shiri pali a daalikauli maa, dama a nyɛla wuntialana.
en: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ku lan kum. Yi Duuma nyɛla nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi kum niŋ o, o ni wum ka garigi ya.
en: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.

dag: M mini Masia kpimi o dapulli zuɣu, ka di pala mani n-lan be maa, amaa di nyɛla Masia ŋun be n ni la m-be maa; ka n ni mali biɛhigu shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, m mal li la Naawuni Bia ŋun daa yuri ma ka kpi n zuɣu maa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: so that it is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me. This life that I live now, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave his life for me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a ba Ibrahimma Naawuni, di zɔri dabiɛm, n ni be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam n dabili Ibrahimma zuɣu.
en: That night the Lord appeared to him and said, I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid; I am with you. I will bless you and give you many descendants because of my promise to my servant Abraham.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi n zuɣu, a chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili maa ŋmanila kɔgbana, n-ŋme ma luhi.
en: Your anger lies heavy on me, and I am crushed beneath its waves.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti puhi di chuɣu, ka di pa ni ti zaŋ dabin kurili din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu mini tuumbiɛtali puhi li, amaa di simdi ni ti zaŋla bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ alali mini yɛlimaŋli la puhi li.
en: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n siɣisi mmaŋa n-niŋ tuuba ka do taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim ni ŋɔ.
en: And I am ashamed of myself. I am so sorry. As I sit in the dust and ashes, I promise to change my heart and my life.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛ ka binnɛma pam be kom ni, ka chɛ ka noonsi be zuɣusaa sagbana tiŋli yiɣiri gindi dunia ni.
en: Then God said, Let the water be filled with many living things, and let there be birds to fly in the air over the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, So m-bi bu ti paa. Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma.
en: No one hired us, they answered. Well, then, you go and work in the vineyard, he told them.

dag: Daba anii dali, di simdi ni o bo piɛlah ayi bɛn ka dansi mini piɛsaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛl ni kilɔgiram ata ni kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim zuɣu.
en: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring milliliters of olive oil and kilograms of your finest flour mixed with oil.

dag: Dahin shɛli tinzunnim ni daa kana ti ʒi bɛ daazichi chaŋ la, dindali maa yi daa kaɣimi ʒe kpaŋa. Saamba maa ni daa kpe bɛ dunɔdaya ni nti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn piri Jɛrusalɛm nɛma shɛm la, yi gba daa bemi kaman bɛ ni daa be shɛm.
en: You stood nearby, strangers carried off his wealth, and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem; you too were like one of them.

dag: Jɔahaz daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Jehoahaz did what the Lord said was wrong. He did all the same things that his ancestors had done.

dag: Ka a ti baɣisi di shɛli ka di niŋ zim balli, ka a zaŋ di shɛli ti zali Alikauli Adaka shɛli din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir a la gbini. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla din be kasi zaa a sani.
en: Beat some of it into a fine powder and put part of it in front of the covenant document in the meeting tent where I will meet with you. You should regard it as perfectly holy.

dag: Ŋun mali tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, o bi mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima, amaa o mal li tɔɣisirila Naawuni, dama o tɔɣisirila yɛlisɔɣira Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka so bi mi o ni tɔɣisiri yɛl shɛŋa maa gbinni.
en: I will explain why. Those who have the gift of speaking in a different language are not speaking to people. They are speaking to God. No one understands them—they are speaking secret things through the Spirit.

dag: ni Bɛtilɛbaut ni Sharuhɛn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaata m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen. In total: thirteen cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka o daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So thats why he was accepted as one who is right with God.

dag: N nini nya n dimnim lubu; ka n tiba wum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn liriti ma azaaba nyabu kuhigu.
en: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di karitiy o, dama ŋunkam bi galindi ya bela yi polo.
en: Don't stop him! Jesus said. Anyone who isn't against you is for you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, N ni duh a Izraɛlnim zaa ninni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; ka bɛ baŋ ni n ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, What I do today will make all the people of Israel begin to honor you as a great man, and they will realize that I am with you as I was with Moses.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun va naɣisaa maa tampiligim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni. Ka dimbɔŋɔ kul ni nyɛ Izraɛlnim mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ sani zaligu sahakam.
en: The one who gathers the ashes of the cow will wash his clothes but will be unclean until evening. This will be a permanent regulation for the Israelites and for the immigrant who lives among them.

dag: Kukol shɛli n-kuhiri yɛra: Malimiya soli mɔɣu ni ti Yawɛ! Malimiya soli maa tiŋgban nɛli ni ka di tuhi ti ti Naawuni maa!.
en: A voice is crying out: Clear the LORDs way in the desert! Make a level highway in the wilderness for our God!.

dag: Yim ka tiŋgbani daa ti dam pam, dama ti Duuma malaika n-daa yi alizanda ni siɣina nti biligi siliga maa nol ni kuɣili la n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu.
en: Suddenly there was a violent earthquake; an angel of the Lord came down from heaven, rolled the stone away, and sat on it.

dag: N daa mi do so ŋun be Masia ni yuun pinaanahi din gari ŋɔ puuni, ka Naawuni daa kpuɣ o du zuɣusaa m-mali ti paai alizanda puuni ha. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: I know a certain Christian man who fourteen years ago was snatched up to the highest heaven .

dag: Stɛfanas mini Fɔtunatus ni Akaikus ni daa ka n sanna la niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zani yi zaani n-niŋ ma yi ni naan niŋ ma shɛm.
en: Im so happy that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived; theyve made up for my missing you.

dag: Chɛ ka nanim zaa damd o tiŋa; ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa jɛm o.
en: All kings will bow down before him; all nations will serve him.

dag: Dama alikauli maa nyɛla yi mini yi bihi zaŋ tabili bɛn be katiŋ ha ka nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ni na yɛn boli ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dini.
en: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.

dag: Amaa n chɛmi ka n suhu be baalim kaman bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni be o ma sani baalim shɛm la. N suhu ŋmanila bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili suhu.
en: No, right now I am calm and quiet, like a child after nursing, content in its mothers arms.

dag: Ti daa wumya ka o yɛli ni o ni wurim bɛ ni daa zaŋ nuhi me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka me din pa nuhi mɛbu zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: We heard him say he would tear down this temple that we built. He also claimed that in three days he would build another one without any help.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Mani m-bala.
en: He said to them, I Am. Dont be afraid.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka yi shɛb kpimi kaman n ni daa chɛ ka Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim kpi shɛm la; ka yi ni shɛb mi daa tiligi ka di ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni. Di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I destroyed some of you, as when God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning coal plucked out of the fire; yet you didnt return to me, says the LORD.

dag: O lan ka kpe, o neei kum ni. Teemiya o ni daa na be Galili ka yɛli ya.
en: Jesus isn't here! He has been raised from death. Remember that while he was still in Galilee, he told you.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kpuɣi bihi maa o naba zuɣu, ka damdi n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph took the boys off Israels lap, and they bowed down in front of his father.

dag: Teeku bulli vali ba, ka bɛ siɣi kɔtiŋ kaman kuɣili la.
en: The deep sea covered them; they sank into the deep waters like a stone.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti di n-tiɣi, ka di wuhi ni bɛ tiɣiya ka bɛ daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛhi bɛ suhuri ni, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tam n yɛla.
en: But when you entered the good land, you became full and satisfied, and then you grew proud and forgot me.

dag: Bɛ ku kpalim be Yawɛ tiŋgbani maa ni. Amaa Ifriimnim ni labi Ijipti nti di bindir shɛli din bi be kasi Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord . Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.

dag: Ti ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la, lala ka n na kul yɛri ya yaha: So yi yihiri lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ yi ni daa pun deei shɛl la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: We have said it before, and now I say it again: if anyone preaches to you a gospel that is different from the one you accepted, may he be condemned to hell!.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ nya, bɛ suhuri ni daa ye bindir shɛli zuɣu la ni.
en: They tested God in their hearts, demanded food for their stomachs.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka bɛ gbibi n zaligunima, di yi pa lala bɛ yi birigi li, bɛ ni kpe alahichi ni di zuɣu ka kpi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: The priests must keep my requirement so that they dont become liable to punishment and die for having made it impure. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma ŋɔ? N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi n dimnim zuɣu, nyama, ka a ti bi niŋ ba shɛli, ka naɣ niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemy. But now youve blessed him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a jɛmbu duu shiri nyɛla luɣ shɛli din viɛli shee.
en: Lord All-Powerful, the place where you live is so beautiful!.

dag: Amaa o ba yi bi saɣ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa shɛli ku zani; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali o ba ni bi saɣi maa zuɣu.
en: But if her father expresses disapproval to her on the day that he hears her, none of her solemn promises nor any of her binding obligations for herself will stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father expressed disapproval to her.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa ni daa chaŋ ka chɛ Manɔa min o paɣ saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa baŋ ni Yawɛ malaika m-bala.
en: Although the angel didn't appear to them again, they realized he was one of the Lord 's angels.

dag: Naawuni, a tɛha nyɛla din viɛli pam n sani, di galisiya.
en: O God, how difficult I find your thoughts; how many of them there are!.

dag: Ka malaika so gba daa yi alizanda ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-gbibi gɔr dirili.
en: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.

dag: N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka m piɛma nyɔɣi ba:.
en: I will bring on them endless disasters and use all my arrows against them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bom tulaale shɛŋa din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛŋa stakiti mini onika ni galibanom ni tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni booni firanki tulaale la alali din nyom viɛla.
en: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni, yin puhimiya di chuɣu maa.
en: When you enter the land that the Lord has promised to give you, you must perform this ritual.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ zaliya ni yi zaŋ bindirigu maa lita ayi zuɣu zali yi bihi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka bɛ ti nya n ni daa zaŋ bindir shɛli dihiri ya tiŋgban nɛli ni saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: Moses told the people that the Lord had said, Store up two liters of this manna, because I want future generations to see the food I gave you during the time you were in the desert after I rescued you from Egypt.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ binnɛma balibu kam zaɣ lɔɣu ni zaɣ nyaŋ niŋ a sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka lala niŋbu chɛ ka bɛ tiligi.
en: Take into the boat with you a male and a female of every kind of animal and of every kind of bird, in order to keep them alive.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ kuliga ni nti kpaai yalim maa bahi kom maa ni ka yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, n chɛ ka kom maa leei ko viɛlli; ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, di ku lan ku so bee n-chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: and he carried it to the spring. He threw the salt into the water and said, The Lord has made this water pure again. From now on you'll be able to grow crops, and no one will starve.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi so mi yaha, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a? Ka o yɛl o, Za ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ taɣi sab pihinii.
en: Then the manager asked another one, How much do you owe my master? He answered, I owe him measures of wheat. Then the manager said to him, Here is your bill; you can make it less. Write measures.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ni kpaŋsi Jɛrusalɛm, ka sɔŋ o luɣ shɛli polo din lu n-dahim. N ni chɛ ka o tiŋgban nɛli be kaman Idɛn puu din nyɛ man Yawɛ puu la; ka chɛ ka suhupiɛlli mini wumpaɣibo yila be o ni.
en: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs.

dag: Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Di pahiya shɛli di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni.
en: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl tuun shɛb bɛn kana maa, Yi yi kuli yin yɛlimiya Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga maa nima, Biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ sa ti yɛn bii, yi ni nya faako. Tuumba maa ni daa lab kuli ti yɛli Jabɛshinim lala, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Saul and his officers sent the messengers back to Jabesh with this promise: We will rescue you tomorrow afternoon. The messengers went back to the people at Jabesh and told them that they were going to be rescued. Everyone was encouraged!.

dag: Niriba ata maa daa bi lan garigi Ayuba o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali maa zuɣu.
en: Then Jobs three friends gave up trying to answer him, because he was so sure that he was innocent.

dag: Ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam, n ni niŋ li ka m Ba nya jilima n zuɣu.
en: I will do whatever you ask for in my name, so that the Father can be glorified in the Son.

dag: Ti Duuma yoomi yi suhuri ka yi baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka yi mali ʒiɛyimtali din nyɛ Masia dini.
en: May the Lord lead you into a greater understanding of God's love and the endurance that is given by Christ.

dag: Romnim ni ti zaŋ bɛ sitimanim na nti lu o zuɣu ka dabiɛm gbaag o. Di saha maa o ni ti lab kuli ni suhuyiɣisili, ka lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ti yɛn dolila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa saɣisigu.
en: The Romans will come in ships and oppose him, and he will be frightened. Then he will turn back in a rage and try to destroy the religion of God's people. He will follow the advice of those who have abandoned that religion.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka ti Duuma daa kana nti zani baɣili Pool yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, dama a ni niŋ n shɛhiralana Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka a ni ti niŋ n shɛhiralana Rom gba.
en: The next night the Lord Jesus came and stood by Paul. He said, Be brave! You have told people in Jerusalem about me. You must do the same in Rome.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Pɛɛgamum Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: These are the words of the one who has the sharp, two-edged sword.

dag: Ka lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni. Ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has given me everything. No one knows the Son—only the Father knows the Son. And no one knows the Father—only the Son knows the Father. And the only people who will know about the Father are those the Son chooses to tell.

dag: Kpuɣim a kpan titali min a kpam bila n-lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kariti doli ma la zuɣu; ka yɛli ma, Mani n-nyɛ a tiligira.
en: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti saɣim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din be Avɛn, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim daalahichi la. Ka gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ti bili di maligu bimbina maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti yɛli zoya, Limsimiya ti. Ka yɛli daboya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na.
en: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ yinim Zɛruya bihi bɛn be kaman yi leela n dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Di simdi ni ti ku nira Izraɛl tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ? Pa mani n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: But David said to Abishai and his brother Joab, Who asked your opinion? Are you going to give me trouble? I am the one who is king of Israel now, and no Israelite will be put to death today.

dag: N chɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali sania mini ʒiri kpalaŋa n-zahind o nɛma?.
en: How can I forgive those who use false scales and weights?.

dag: N lola noli hal ka n duna ti gbarigi, ka n niŋgbuna ti kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: My knees are weak from lack of food; I am nothing but skin and bones.

dag: A chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi n sani guui, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You make my enemies run from me; I destroy those who hate me.

dag: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi, dapaɣili kam diba ayi.
en: and forty silver bases, two under each frame.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din daa lo ni di tahi nyɛvili na la, man sani di tahila kum na.
en: and I died. So the commandment that was intended to give life brought death.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila ninsalinim kaya mini bɛ wuhibu ni na, ka nir yi dol li di ni ti kpalim yoli.
en: These rules are talking about earthly things that are gone after they are used. They are only human commands and teachings.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o ma Mariama, Nyama, Izraɛlnim pam ni ti lula bia ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɛ pam mi ti yiɣisila o zuɣu. O lan nyɛla shihir shɛli niriba ni ni ti tɔɣisi jɛndi.
en: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, Many Jews will fall and many will rise because of this boy. He will be a sign from God that some will not accept.

dag: Bɛ sahirila bɛ zilima ka di be kaman takɔbiri la, ka mal li yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri din ŋmani piɛma.
en: They sharpen their tongues to use like swords. They aim their poisonous words like arrows.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣimna.
en: While Jesus and the twelve disciples were eating together that evening, he said, The one who will betray me is now eating with me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, m mi ni lala n-nyɛ li, Amaa wula ka ninsal lee yɛn tooi nyɛ ŋun ka taali Naawuni tooni?.
en: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti paai Zin yɔɣu ni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni n-ʒini Kadɛshi. Ka Miriam daa kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nimaani.
en: The people of Israel arrived at the Zin Desert during the first month and set up camp near the town of Kadesh. It was there that Miriam died and was buried.

dag: O ni nyɛ ŋun be kasi la zuɣu, o ŋmanila kuɣ shɛli Juda zuliya mini Izraɛl zuliya ni tuuri lura; ka ŋmani tɔn shɛli din gbahiri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Because of my awesome holiness I am like a stone that people stumble over; I am like a trap that will catch the people of the kingdoms of Judah and Israel and the people of Jerusalem.

dag: Yisahaku daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihinii dunia yili.
en: Isaac died at the ripe old age of , then his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

dag: Ka o daa ti miriti Jɛrusalɛm n-siɣiri Olivi Tihi zolɔŋni ha, ka salo bɛn nyɛ o nyaandoliba suhuri paligi pam, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛri pampam m-paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa nya alahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: When Jesus started down the Mount of Olives, his large crowd of disciples were happy and praised God because of all the miracles they had seen.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-pa o buŋ nyaampara, ka zaŋ o nachimba ayi min o bia Yisahaku pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bo dari pahi ni o ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-daa yi n-chaŋ katiŋa Naawuni ni daa wuh o luɣ shɛli maa.
en: In the morning Abraham got up and saddled his donkey. He took Isaac and two servants with him. He cut the wood for the sacrifice. Then they went to the place where God told them to go.

dag: Yi yi wali wala viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka m Ba nya jilima pam, di mi n-ni lan wuhi ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba.
en: Show that you are my followers by producing much fruit. This will bring honor to my Father.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir maa sanna yuŋ zahindi ni ti yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu.
en: That night, God appeared to Laban the Aramean in a dream and said, Be careful and dont say anything hastily to Jacob one way or the other.

dag: Naa Dauda daa tum Naawuni yubu o ʒiɛman ni, ka daa ti paɣi Naawuni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni ka o pooi;.
en: David did Gods will during the time he lived. Then he died and was buried like all his ancestors. And his body did rot in the grave!.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li girimgirim li, ka di bi niŋ.
en: Other seed fell among thorny plants. The thorny plants grew and choked the seeds, and they produced nothing.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa chaŋ Sukɔt ti yɛli ba, N-nyɛ Zɛba mini Zalimuna. Yi daa mɔŋ m mini n tɔbbi shɛb di ni daa wum pam la bindirigu, ka maani ma ansarisi yɛra, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna n-kpɛh a nuu ni, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu? .
en: Gideon went to the town officials and said, Here are Zebah and Zalmunna. Remember how you made fun of me? You said, We don't know if you really will defeat those two Midianite kings. So why should we feed your worn-out army? .

dag: ni yi kpe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni po pɔri lɔn ya alikauli shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni;.
en: ready to enter into the LORD your Gods covenant and into the agreement that the LORD your God is making with you right now.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa m-miri ba ka pa ni saa, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: He sent hail and lightning on their land instead of rain;.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tahima niŋbu tahirila suhupiɛlli na, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: What good people hope for brings happiness, but what the wicked hope for brings destruction.

dag: Ka yi ni tooi zaŋ paɣiba mini biliɛri ni niɣi ni binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ maa ni zaa leei yi ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa. Yi ni tooi di Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ yi dimnim neen shɛŋa tin ya maa.
en: You may, however, take for yourselves the women, the children, the livestock, and everything else in the city. You may use everything that belongs to your enemies. The Lord has given it to you.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ paɣ so ŋun sɔrilim na bi naai dɔni m-pirig o zaɣim, o yihila paɣ maa ʒi soya zahira, ka paɣ maa gba yih omaŋmaŋ ʒi soya zahira, di simdi ka bɛ yihi bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa bɛ daŋ ni.
en: If a man has intercourse with a woman during her monthly period, both of them are to be driven out of the community, because they have broken the regulations about ritual uncleanness.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Zakaria: Yɛlim ba.
en: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya bee bɔ n-leei niŋ ka yi biɛhindi yi suhuri ni?.
en: But Jesus said, Why are you troubled? Why do you doubt what you see?.

dag: Tiligim ma n daalahichi zaa ni, ka di chɛ ka jɛra mali ma ansarisi.
en: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa mi zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani nam ʒiishee, ka di biɛhigu ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛli safaya la. Ka binshɛli daa ʒi nam ʒiishee maa zuɣusaa, ka di kɔtomsi ŋmani daadam kɔtomsi.
en: There was something that looked like a throne on top of the bowl. It was blue like sapphire. There was also something that looked like a man sitting on the throne.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: So nini na bi nya, ka so mi tibili na bi wum bee so ti baŋ binshɛŋa Naawuni ni mali zali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o la.
en: But it is just as the Scriptures say, What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni zali shɛli ŋɔ yi ti yiɣisi n sani, dindina Izraɛl zuliya gba ku lan nyɛla zuliya n sani sahakam.
en: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm ni nimmoo, dama ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nyɛla ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu.
en: I mean that you should use every opportunity you have for doing good, because these are evil times.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni bah a yoli zaa; o ni to n-kpuɣ a a yiŋ puuni yi nti chɛris a; o ni yih a dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: So God will ruin you forever; he will take hold of you and snatch you from your home; he will remove you from the world of the living.

dag: Kpalimmi be n sani, ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o ku ma m-bɔri ni o ku a gba maa; a yi be n sani shɛli ku niŋ a.
en: Stay here. Isn't the same person trying to kill both of us? Don't worry! You'll be safe here with me.

dag: Yawɛ, a suhuyubu puuni ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kahigi yɛl kara ŋɔ zaa wuhi ma.
en: LORD, for your servants sake and according to your will, you have done this great thing in order to make all these great things known.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bi niŋ yɛda suhupiɛlli zuɣu ka biɛhindi maa ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mali bindir shɛli kpe ka n ni di.
en: The followers were amazed and very, very happy to see that Jesus was alive. They still could not believe what they saw. He said to them, Do you have any food here.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa guli ni o yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di yuŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni gbibi shɛli, ka di nyɛ Yawɛ guhibu yuŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: It was a night when the Lord kept watch to bring them out of Egypt; this same night is dedicated to the Lord for all time to come as a night when the Israelites must keep watch.

dag: Di chɛliya ka peentɔra nya soli to piɛm, yi mi di chɛliya ka o nya soli ye kuriti gbaɣino. Di chɛnya o nachimba. Kummiya o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: Don't give its soldiers time to shoot their arrows or to put on their armor. Do not spare the young men! Destroy the whole army!.

dag: Ŋunkam ʒiya kpahindi pɔhim ku biri binshɛli, ka ŋunkam mi ʒiya lihiri sagbana ku kpuɣi puu atam.
en: Those who watch the wind blow will never sow, and those who observe the clouds will never reap.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lab ti yɛli shɛm maa tiɣi Izraɛlnim maa nini, ka bɛ paɣi Naawuni, ka bi lan yɛli tɔbu lo n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba, ka saɣim Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni daa ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa yɛla.
en: The Israelites agreed and blessed God. They no longer spoke of going to war against them to destroy the land where the people of Reuben and Gad were living.

dag: Yɛm chɛ ka nir nyari jilima, amaa bɛn ka li soli nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: Good insight brings favor, but the way of the faithless is their ruin.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili maa dali ti yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku beni. Dindali maa ti shiri yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku be di ni.
en: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light.

dag: Dindali maa tikpiranim ni ti wum bɛ ni karindi litaafi puuni yɛri shɛm, ka zoomba bɛn be zibisim ni ti neei bɛ nina lihi nya.
en: On that day: The deaf will hear the words of a scroll and, freed from dimness and darkness, the eyes of the blind will see.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya suhudoo.
en: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa: Bɛnya kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bela kasi.
en: Tell all the Israelites: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, so you must be holy.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim maa ni maani a ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; ka jɛra gba ʒiɛm a yuli.
en: Lord , remember, the enemy insulted you! Those foolish people hate your name!.

dag: ka zaŋ ʒiri shɛhiranim maa na ka bɛ ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ kul galindila Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛli din be kasi shee la mini Anabi Musa zaligu;.
en: Then they brought in some men to tell lies about him. This man, they said, is always talking against our sacred Temple and the Law of Moses.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ Mizipa din be Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ti yɛli Mɔab naa, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka m ba mini m ma ʒini a sani hal ka n ti baŋ Naawuni ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli ti ma.
en: David went on from there to Mizpah in Moab and said to the king of Moab, Please let my father and mother come and stay with you until I find out what God is going to do for me.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi bɛn daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-daa nyɛ: Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt. Ham daa nyɛla Keenan ba.
en: The sons of Noah who went out of the boat were Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Inok daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu.
en: and God took him away at the age of .

dag: n-fa o o wahala zaa ni bahi, ka ti o baŋsim, ka chɛ ka o nya jilima Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la sani. Ka Firawuna daa leeg o nam, ka chɛ ka o guli ŋun Firawuna yili zaŋ tabili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: and rescued him from all his troubles. The grace and wisdom he gave Joseph were recognized by Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who appointed him ruler over Egypt and over his whole palace.

dag: Di bemi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm o litaafi ni la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi.
en: Isaiah the prophet wrote about John when he said, In the desert someone is shouting, Get the road ready for the Lord! Make a straight path for him.

dag: Yisa ni pun chaŋ ti kpe ti zuɣu la, dama o daa leei maligumaani titali ŋun tuma be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.

dag: Ka nambɔɣu daa gbaai Yisa, ka o teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛl o, N saɣiya; di naama.
en: Jesus felt sorry for the man. So he put his hand on him and said, I want to! Now you are well.

dag: Ka Midian mi bihi daa nyɛ Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura bihi min o yaansi.
en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were Keturah's descendants.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Yawɛ kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la m-mali sara.
en: Then Aaron will offer the goat chosen by the lot for the Lord . Aaron will make this goat a sin offering.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: Solomon made two hundred large shields, each of which was covered with about fifteen pounds of beaten gold.

dag: Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa zaa din be kasi puuni bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛlikam ti maligumaana, di nyɛla o dini.
en: Any gift offering from all the sacred donations that the Israelites offer will be the property of the priest.

dag: Ka Musa bɔɣiri daa ti ja, ka bɛ bo kuɣili na ti sɔŋ ka o ʒini di zuɣu, ka Aduna mini Hur daa gub gbaag o nuhi maa mali. Yino daa ʒiɛla o nudirigu polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe o nuzaa polo, ka o nuhi maa daa kul ʒe tibi hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: But Moses hands grew tired. So they took a stone and put it under Moses so he could sit down on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on each side of him so that his hands remained steady until sunset.

dag: Ka Farisiinim bɔh o, Nyama! Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees said to Jesus, Why are your followers doing this? It is against the law to pick grain on the Sabbath.

dag: di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali alikama mini chi ni wain tihi ni fiig tihi ni pumpɔrinchihi tihi. Di lan nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali olivi tihi mini shikpam.
en: a land of wheat and barley, vines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey.

dag: Wuhimi yɛnnima, ka bɛ nyari yɛm pahira. Wuhimi wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nyari anfaani bɔhimbu puuni.
en: Teach the wise, and they will become wiser; inform the righteous, and their learning will increase.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa Zin mɔɣu ni zaŋ hal ti paai Rɛhɔb din daa miri Lɛbohamat la.
en: So the men went north and explored the land from the wilderness of Zin in the south all the way to Rehob, near Hamath Pass in the north.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn jɛrigi ka ka yɛm. Bɛ buɣa maa ni wuhiri ba shɛli kul nyɛla dari wuhibu.
en: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!.

dag: Ka Pita ŋun daa kpalim ʒe samban dunol ni. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol so maa daa yi nti suhi soli yili maa ni bipuɣin so ŋun daa guli dunoli la sani n-zaŋ Pita kpe.
en: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in.

dag: N ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ saha shɛli, a daa beni? A yi mi, nyin yɛlim ma.
en: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?.

dag: Anabinim tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka maligumaaniba doli anabinim maa ni wuhiri ba shɛm n-tumdi bɛ tuma. N niriba maa n-yu lala. Amaa di yi ti paai di tariga, wula ka yi yɛn niŋ.
en: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?.

dag: A suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti kpe n tibili ni zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo tu a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige niŋ a nol ni ŋ-ŋmalig a bah a ni doli so shɛli kana zuɣu.
en: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.

dag: Nyamiya, n di kul guhirila yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, ka gbilisiri tibili ni n wum yi yɛtɔɣa, saha shɛli yi ni di na tɛhiri yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm la.
en: I waited patiently while you men talked. I listened to the answers you gave as you searched for the right words.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o pul zuɣu suhiri Naawuni ni di yi ni nani, saha ŋɔ din miligim o zuɣu.
en: Jesus went on a little farther away from them, fell to the ground, and prayed. He asked that, if possible, he would not have this time of suffering.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N yi bi chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa lo Dauda alikauli yɛli.
en: The Lord promised with an oath that he would take the kingdom away from Sauls family and give it to David. And I swear I will make sure that happens. God will make David king of Judah and Israel. He will rule from Dan to Beersheba. .

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa ŋme binshɛɣukam din daa be palo ni luhi tiŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa. Ka daa lu n-fiɛri puri ni bimbilima zaa, ka da tihi luhi.
en: All over Egypt the hail struck down everything in the open, including all the people and all the animals. It beat down all the plants in the fields and broke all the trees.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ omaŋ pahi ninvuɣ nɛma zaa ni mali tahima, dama ba nɛɔŋ so gbuɣin kpiŋ.
en: Whoever is among the living can be certain about this. A living dog is definitely better off than a dead lion.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima.
en: Mizraim was the father of the people of Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh.

dag: O yila Rimmon n-kana Aiyat. O chaŋ ti kpe Migirɔn gari. O chɛ o nɛma sɔŋla Mikimash.
en: come against Aiath, passed to Migron. At Michmash he stored his equipment.

dag: Chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat, bɛ daa yɛlimi, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lu o zuɣu ni bɛ tuh o, ka o daa kuhi, ka Yawɛ sɔŋ o n-kari ba bahi ka chɛ o.
en: During the battle, the commanders saw King Jehoshaphat and thought he was the king of Israel. So they went to kill him. Jehoshaphat started shouting, and the Lord helped him. God made the chariot commanders turn away from Jehoshaphat.

dag: ka mali tuuli biŋkɔbigu la yiko n-tumdi yiko tumtumsa tuma biŋkɔbigu maa tooni, ka muɣisiri dunia mini ŋunkam be di ni ni bɛ jɛmmi tuuli biŋkɔbigu ŋun daa mali dan titali din yɛn ku o ka daa lan tib la.
en: This beast stood before the first beast and used the same power the first beast had. He used this power to make everyone living on the earth worship the first beast. The first beast was the one that had the death wound that was healed.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ daba la, deemiya yi duumanim noya ka luri ba sizuura zaa, ka di pala bɛn niŋdi nirilim ka mali biɛribaalimtali la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili bɛn mali hal biɛɣu la gba.
en: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.

dag: Huram daa lan mali daanya taha pia, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita yini ni sɛntimita pihinii, ka di zaɣ yini kam daa deerila kom litanim kɔbisinii.
en: He made ten bronze washbasins, each able to hold forty baths. Every washbasin was six feet across, and there was one for each of the ten stands.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa yɛli do so ŋun kpaŋ maa, Zuŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali; di bi luhi ni a kpuɣ a bindoo maa n-ʒiri li chana.
en: so the Jewish authorities told the man who had been healed, This is a Sabbath, and it is against our Law for you to carry your mat.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri lu bɛ fɔntinsinim zuɣu ŋ-ŋme n-kabisi kur shɛŋa din kpari bɛ dunɔdaya la, ka ku ba bɛ birininim ni.
en: War will visit their cities, and their plans will fail.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila wɔbinyina ka bɛ zaŋ me pii zali. A nina ŋmanila Hɛshibɔn kom din do m-miri Batirabim dunol la. A nyee ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn pia din be Damaskus polo la.
en: Your neck is like a tower of ivory. Your eyes are like the pools in the city of Heshbon, near the gate of that great city. Your nose is as lovely as the tower of Lebanon that stands guard at Damascus.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Jɔshua, Ti nyɛla a daba. Ka Jɔshua bɔhi ba, Banima n-lee nyɛn ya? Ka ya ka yi lee yina.
en: They said to Joshua, We are at your service. Joshua asked them, Who are you? Where do you come from.

dag: Musa daa lan zali niriba maa zaligu dindali maa yɛli:.
en: That day Moses also told the people.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi niriba maa zuɣu ni ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla, amaa o ni daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bahi mol li gili.
en: Jesus gave the people strict orders not to tell anyone. But the more he tried to silence them, the more eagerly they shared the news.

dag: Ka a nudirigu mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini, di so ni a niŋgbuŋ zaa ti kpe buɣim ni.
en: If your right hand causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! It is better to lose one part of your body, than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa teemi gili ma, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: Many enemies were around me; but I destroyed them by the power of the Lord !.

dag: Ka yi ni zaɣisi n saɣisigu ka bi deei n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You have ignored all my advice and have not been willing to let me correct you.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi n nini ka chɛ ba ka bɛ ta n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ daɣiri. Ŋmɛnditoya ni ti kpe di ni nti ta li daɣiri.
en: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa niŋ yɛda maa laɣim be, ka laɣim su bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa.
en: All the believers were united and shared everything.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nuzaa tabila n zuɣu gbibi, ka a nudirigu mi bɔb gbaai ma mali.
en: His left arm is under my head, and his right hand holds me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zaawuni saha n-chaŋ Sirianim sansani maa ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Sirianim sansani maa ni n-nya ka so ka nimaani.
en: So they set out in the evening to the Aramean camp, and they came to the edge of the camp. But there was no one there because.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Joab and the army with him attacked the Aramean army. The Arameans ran away from Joab and his army.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni yihi ba yi ni daa zaŋ ba kɔhi luɣ shɛŋa maa ni na. N ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa lab lu yi zuɣu.
en: You sent my people to that faraway place, but I will bring them back. And I will punish you for what you did.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni bɛ tummi din viɛla, ka nyɛ bundaannim tuun suma tumbu ni; ka lan nyɛ bɛn tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli, ka yu ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛli n-sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: Tell those who are rich to do good—to be rich in good works. And tell them they should be happy to give and ready to share.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Jahinjɛya ayi bi kɔhirila siidi yini? Ka bɛ ni yino mi ku lu tiŋa ka di pala yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni.
en: For only a penny you can buy two sparrows, yet not one sparrow falls to the ground without your Father's consent.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, Naawuni ni deei ŋun Naawuni nam yi sani n-zaŋ li ti zuliya shɛb bɛn ni wali o nam maa wala. .
en: I tell you God's kingdom will be taken from you and given to people who will do what he demands.

dag: ka a je suli niŋ Naawuni, ka chɛ ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yir a nol ni na?.
en: You are expressing your anger against God when you say these things.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: But then the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Naɣilaa bee piɛlaa ŋun gbali bee o bɔɣu zaɣ yini wɔɣ gari di tab maa bee n-nyɛ zaɣ jia n-gari di tab maa, yi ni tooi zaŋ o na ti mali yi suhu yubu sara, amaa yi yi zaŋ o mali sara ni yi yo yi ni po pɔr shɛli samli, n ku deei li.
en: As a freewill offering you may offer an animal that is stunted or not perfectly formed, but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow.

dag: Dama ti kul nyɛla sɔhila niriba, ka bi mi shɛli; ti biɛhigu dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila mahim din vuura.
en: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb tiri pini, amaa ka bɛ buni kul nabirimi pahira, ka shɛb mi vili bɛ ni su shɛli gbibi ka kɔŋda.
en: Those who give generously receive more, but those who are stingy with what is appropriate will grow needy.

dag: Kuɣa pihi sɔŋ lihi nya nyɛla din ŋmaari naŋgbankpeeni, ka lan nyɛ din maani wɔɣira ayi bɛn mali taba yɛla.
en: The best way to settle an argument between two powerful people may be to use lots.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ni wuh a dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa zuɣu, so kani m-mali tɛhi wɔɣila ni yɛm kaman nyini.
en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, Since God has made all this known to you, no one is as intelligent and wise as you are.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan ŋubi niriba, yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you will not destroy people anymore or take away their children again. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pa lala ka Naawuni yɛn niŋ n zuliya? Dama o lo ma alikauli din ka bahigu; o chɛ ka di zani dɛde binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan ka taɣibu yaha. Dama o ni chɛ ka n sɔŋsim mini n suhu ni yu shɛli nya nasara.
en: I have ruled this way, and God will never break his promise to me. God's promise is complete and unchanging; he will always help me and give me what I hope for.

dag: amaa Yawɛ suhu daa yuri yi yaannim ka pii yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ŋɔ zuliya kam sunsuuni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord loved your ancestors very much. He loved them so much that he chose you, their descendants, to be his people. He chose you instead of any other nation, and you are still his chosen people today.

dag: Dibɔnnim chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu bɛ buɣa duu nti kumda; ka Mɔabnim kumdi Nɛbo mini Mɛdɛba zuɣu; ka sokam pini bɛ zuɣuri ni bɛ teensi.
en: The kings family and the people of Dibon go to the places of worship to cry. The people of Moab are crying for Nebo and Medeba. They have shaved their heads and beards to show their sadness.

dag: Bɛrɔtnim maa daa zo n-chaŋla Giteem nti ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The people of Beeroth had fled to Gittaim and even now live there as immigrants.

dag: hal n ni nyɛla ŋun daa yɛr o zilima ka niŋd o alaka ka tur o la zaa yoli. Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu, dama n daa niŋ li la ʒilinsi ni n ni daa na bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: even though I used to speak against him, attack his people, and I was proud. But I was shown mercy because I acted in ignorance and without faith.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, A kul ku paɣi n naba hal abada. Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi bi paɣi a naba maa, shɛl lan ka m min a sunsuuni.
en: You will never wash my feet! Peter replied. If I don't wash you, Jesus told him, you don't really belong to me.

dag: Dama n daa yi zabirila karimbaannim nyuli. N daa nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni tɔŋdi shɛm.
en: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o niŋ bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la ni, ka yo li n-kpar o niŋ di ni ni o di lan yɔhim zuliya kam hal ti paai yuun tuhili maa tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti lan yoog o bahi biɛla.
en: The angel threw him into the abyss, locked it, and sealed it, so that he could not deceive the nations any more until the thousand years were over. After that he must be set loose for a little while.

dag: Sɛnaa niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaata ni kɔbisiwɛi ni pihita.
en: from the town of Senaah:.

dag: ka n ti sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa wurim la zuɣu m-pa kuɣ parilana ayi maa zuɣu, ka a zaŋ li niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets—the ones you smashed—then you will place them in the chest.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ a min a mabihi bɛn zaa nyɛ Lɛvinim la mir omaŋa. Di zaa yoli ka yi lan bɔri maligumaanitali tuma gba?.
en: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli alizanda ni, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu bee saa ni yi tahiri shɛm la. N ni daa wum kukol shɛli maa daa ŋmanila mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba ni yi ŋmɛri bɛ mɔɣilɔnim ka di kumsi vuri shɛm la.
en: I heard a sound from heaven that was like the sound of rushing water and loud thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɛsi daa ti yɛl o bia Dauda, Zaŋmi kawaan chimda kpalaŋ ŋɔ mini bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia ŋɔ chaŋ sansan maa ni yomyom ti ti a biɛyanima.
en: One day, Jesse told David, Hurry and take this sack of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread to your brothers at the army camp.

dag: ka chɛ ka o su binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi. Di yɛliya ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ninsala n-leei ŋun su binshɛɣukam fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni shɛli kani ka Naawuni bi wuhi ni ninsal su li, amaa ti bi nya ka ninsal su binshɛɣukam zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: You put everything under his control. Psalm :- If God put everything under his control, then there was nothing left that he did not rule. But we dont yet see him ruling over everything.

dag: Saha paaya, dabisili maa vu m-miri, ŋun dari miri ka o mali suhupiɛlli, ka ŋun kɔhiri miri ka o fabinda, dama suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn lula bɛ zaa zuɣu.
