en: The time is coming! The day draws near! No buyer should rejoice, and no seller should mourn, because wrath overcomes the whole crowd.

dag: ka n naɣikɔra dapua yɛbu bi to, ka n ʒili mi bi tibisa.
en: For the yoke I will give you is easy, and the load I will put on you is light.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ni wuh a dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa zuɣu, so kani m-mali tɛhi wɔɣila ni yɛm kaman nyini.
en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, God showed these things to you, so you must be the wisest man.

dag: Ka wula ka a bɔhi ma lala? Bɔhimila bɛn wum n wuhibu maa m-baŋ n ni yɛli ba shɛm, dama bɛ mi n ni yi yɛri ba shɛm.
en: Why ask me? Ask those who heard what I told them. They know what I said.

dag: Ka Judanim shɛb bɛn kpalim ni lan zooi m-be kaman ti shɛli din nyaɣa ba tiŋa nti wali wala la;.
en: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.

dag: Di chɛliya ka peentɔra nya soli to piɛm, yi mi di chɛliya ka o nya soli ye kuriti gbaɣino. Di chɛnya o nachimba. Kummiya o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: The Babylonian soldiers will not get to use their bows and arrows. They will not even put on their armor. Dont feel sorry for the soldiers of Babylon. Destroy her army completely!.

dag: Dama ti yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa daa kpiya ka lan neei yaha, ti lan niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn gbihiri kum ni la ti doli ti Duuma Yisa labina.
en: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya N je paɣ yihibo, n je ni so niŋ o paɣa kiŋkansi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi nyɛ bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: I hate divorce, says the Lord God of Israel. I hate it when one of you does such a cruel thing to his wife. Make sure that you do not break your promise to be faithful to your wife.

dag: Mani n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka nam ninsalinim niŋ di ni. N nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa, ka su binshɛɣukam din be nimaani fukumsi.
en: I myself made the earth, and created humans upon it. My own hands stretched out the heavens. I commanded all their forces.

dag: Tun dunia piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ so na ʒi n-wum ni so neei zoondɔɣirili nina.
en: This is the first time we have ever heard of anyone healing the eyes of someone born blind.

dag: Pa bɛ takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa; pa bɛ mi maŋmaŋ yiko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi di nasara maa; amaa di daa nyɛla a yiko min a kpiɔŋ ni a ni daa be bɛ sani la zuɣu, dama a nini daa tiɣi ba.
en: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei yi zaa ha dabili m-be.
en: and if one of you wants to be first, you must be the slave of the others—.

dag: N ni ku bɛ naa, ka ku bɛ nabihi zaa pah o zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will remove their judge from them and slay all their officials with him, says the LORD.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti nya alahiziba tuuni zuŋɔ.
en: Everyone was amazed and praised God. What they saw surprised them, and they said, We have seen a great miracle today.

dag: Ka m mi ni n yi ti ka yi sanna n ni ʒi Masia daalibarika din galisi pam na.
en: When I come to you, I know that I shall come with a full measure of the blessing of Christ.

dag: Amaa ka n niriba bɛn tam n yɛla, ka mali binyara nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri binshɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ tuui bɛ so shɛli din nyɛ so kurili maa zuɣu, ka taɣi doli so kpansi, din pa so lɔɣu.
en: Yet my people have forgotten me; they have offered sacrifices to a lie. And so they have stumbled along the way, even along the ancient paths. They have taken side roads, not the main roads.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba suhiri Naawuni sɔŋdi ti, ka di chɛ ka niriba pam paɣi Naawuni o ni deei bɛ wunsuhigu gbaliŋ ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni la zuɣu.
en: And you can help us with your prayers. Then many people will give thanks for us—that God blessed us because of their many prayers.

dag: Zaŋmiya di zaɣ kuŋ tam sala buɣim zuɣu ka di bii, ka di tahiʒiɛɣu mooi, ka di daɣiri zaa nyɛligi niŋ di puuni, ka din zahimzahim la zaa di buɣim.
en: Let the pot stand empty on its coals until its so hot that its copper glows, its impurities melt in it, and its corrosion is consumed.

dag: N daa lan nya ka bɛ me bimbini gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa. Luɣa ni duri maa tanzahi buɣisibu daa nyɛla mita atata.
en: I also saw that the Temple had a raised base all the way around it. It was the foundation for the side rooms, and it was a full ruler high.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla anzinfa mali dapaɣa pisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu bini pihinahi. Dapaɣili kam daa malila di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka di dashɛbira ayi shɛb di ni.
en: and forty silver bases to go under them, two bases under each frame to hold its two projections.

dag: Ka so yi paŋ biŋkɔbigu o kpee sani, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa, ka bindana maa kani, di simdi ka ŋun paŋ o maa yo o samli zaa;.
en: Suppose you borrow an animal from a neighbor, and it gets injured or dies while the neighbor isn't around. Then you must replace it.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, neemiya, neemiya! Yiɣisimiya zani. Yi nyu Yawɛ ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo binnyur shɛl la buɣi. Yi nyu li, ka di chɛ ka yi chani laana.
en: Wake yourself, wake yourself! Rise up, Jerusalem, who drank the cup of wrath from the LORDs hand. You drank; you drained the goblet of reeling.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Lɛhi tiŋgban ni vinvamli tahi bɔɣi, ka kom yi di ni na, ka Samsin nyu ka o ni maai, ka o kpiɔŋ lan labina yaha. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbili nini maa yuli Ɛnhakɔr. Ka di na kul be Lɛhi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Samson was tired and weary, but God sent water gushing from a rock. Samson drank some and felt strong again. Samson named the place Caller Spring, because he had called out to God for help. The spring is still there at Jawbone.

dag: ninvuɣ yoya shɛb yila yi ni n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka tiŋ maa nim birigi ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti jɛm wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi.
en: certain wicked people have gone out from your community and theyve led the citizens of their town astray by saying: Come on! We should follow and worship other gods—ones you havent experienced before.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Bɛnaaya, Niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ŋmɛm ku o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi. Ka di chɛ ka ŋun Jɔab ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka di ka sol la ʒim yihibu taali ku lan ʒi m mini m ba yiŋnim zuɣu.
en: Do what Joab says, Solomon answered. Kill him and bury him. Then neither I nor any other of David's descendants will any longer be held responsible for what Joab did when he killed innocent men.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Gɛdalia Ahikam bia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la n-leei gomna ka o su o ni daa chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la fukumsi.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam to rule the few people still living in Judah.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku bɔh o bia maa, M bia, ka wula ka a lee niŋ nya li yomyom lala? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ n-ti ma di nasara maa.
en: But Isaac said to his son, How have you hunted and killed the animals so quickly? Jacob answered, Because the Lord your God allowed me to find the animals quickly.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be, ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ mali alibarika, Tibigimiya n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ.
en: The LORD lives! Bless God, my rock! Let my God, the rock of my salvation, be lifted high!.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi din niŋ ti la yɛla; lihimi ti ni nya filiŋ shɛm.
en: LORD, consider what has become of us; take notice of our disgrace. Look at it!.

dag: Ka niriba daa pili buri; ka shɛb du n-tam duri zuɣusaa, ka shɛb mi ʒe tiŋ puuni laɣiŋgu shee kumdi ka fabinda.
en: The people in the streets are dressed in sackcloth; in the city squares and on the rooftops people mourn and cry.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Paɣ ni tooi tam o bimɔɣirigu yɛla bee n-zaɣis o ni dɔɣi bi so nambɔɣu zɔbu? Hal o yi ni tam gba, man Yawɛ ku tam yi yɛla.
en: Can a woman forget her nursing child, fail to pity the child of her womb? Even these may forget, but I wont forget you.

dag: O yɛla ka n daa yɛri ni o doli n nyaaŋ na ka nyɛ ŋun gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: This is the one about whom I said, He who comes after me is really greater than me because he existed before me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni bee ti yi ka di ni, ti nia lɔbu nyɛla ni ti tiɣi o nini.
en: Our only goal is to always please the Lord, whether we are living here in this body or there with him.

dag: N tumdi tuun kpɛma ka nyari wahala, ka gaani gom waawaayili, ka kpiri kum ni kɔnyuri, ka kɔŋdi bindirigu waawaayili, ka chani gbinfini ka wari mali ma.
en: There has been work and toil; often I have gone without sleep; I have been hungry and thirsty; I have often been without enough food, shelter, or clothing.

dag: Man Daniɛl ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa, n daa kul bɔri ni m baŋ di gbinni. N nini nyabu yim ka n daa nya ka so ʒe n tooni ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ninsal kɔtomsi la.
en: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa yihi Izraɛlnim zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gbilligbilli.
en: On that precise day, the LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt in military formation.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli naa, Cham ti niŋ a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛm, Yawɛ ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Nathan replied, The Lord is with you, so do what you want.

dag: Dama Farisiinim mini Yɛhudianim zaa daa bi saɣiri diri bindirigu ka pa ni bɛ dol bɛ yaannim kali ni nyɛ shɛm paɣi bɛ nuhi pɔi.
en: The Pharisees and many others obey the teachings of their ancestors. They always wash their hands in the proper way before eating.

dag: Saawara niŋbu yi kani, nia lɔbu bi paana, amaa saawaranim pam yi beni, bɛ dirila nasara.
en: Plans fail with no counsel, but with many counselors they succeed.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labiri Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and went to the land of Israel.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni bari ma tɔn shɛli gbaai ma, a mi di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba ni bari ma zana shɛli gbaai ma.
en: Protect me from the traps of those violent people.

dag: Ka zama bɛn yɔri vuri yiriŋ gil a. Ka duŋtaariba pam daa zaŋ dɔbba bɛn nyɛ danyuriba n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ bansi piri paɣiba maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupili viɛla pili ba.
en: The sound of a carefree crowd could be heard, a group of men brought in from the desert. They put bracelets on the women's arms and beautiful crowns on their heads.

dag: O ni daa ti miri tiŋ maa ni kpɛbu, ka tiŋ maa ni nachimbil so kpi ka bɛ ʒir o yirina, ka tiŋ maa niriba kabiri doli. Kpim maa ma daa nyɛla pakoli; o mi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ pakoli maa bia.
en: As he approached the city gate, a dead man was being carried out. He was his mothers only son, and she was a widow. A large crowd from the city was with her.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa nya bɛ ni chani maa m-baŋ ba, ka yi tinsi ni zo bɛ naba zuɣu daŋ ba bɛ ni daa chani luɣ shɛli maa paabu.
en: Many people saw them leaving and recognized them, so they ran ahead from all the cities and arrived before them.

dag: Di saha maa Judanim zaa mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ biliɛri ni bɛ bi kura zaa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ tooni.
en: All the men of Judah, with their wives and children, were standing there at the Temple.

dag: O daa pirigi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu buyi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Siizaria ka bɛ zaŋ Pool ti zali Gomna maa tooni, ka zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti o.
en: The horsemen entered Caesarea, delivered the letter to the governor, and brought Paul before him.

dag: ni Sallu ni Amok ni Hilikia ni Jɛdaya so mi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini bɛ taba Jɛshua saha la.
en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These men were the leaders of the priests and their relatives in the days of Jeshua.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa wuhi ma nyɛvili kom mɔɣili, ka di zɔri yiri Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la gbin na n-doya nyaɣisiri kaman diɣi la.
en: The angel also showed me the river of the water of life, sparkling like crystal, and coming from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

dag: Di saha ka nachimba maa daa zaŋ pini maa mini liɣiri ʒiibuyi zuɣu ni Bɛnjamin n-yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti Yisifu sani.
en: The brothers took the gifts, twice the amount of money, and Benjamin. Then they hurried off to Egypt. When they stood in front of Joseph.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa gba daa lan beni yaha. Dina n-nyɛ: Ain mini Rimɔn ni Ɛta ni Ashan: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara anahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: They also got the towns of Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan. There were four towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinunaayi saha ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pisi.
en: In the fifty-second year of the reign of King Uzziah of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for twenty years.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka teeku kɔgbana puɣiri luri yɔri vuri. N yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of heavenly forces is his name.

dag: A lɛhu yi gbilim ka a bi sahi li, ka zaŋ li ni a tum tuma, a ni di wahala pam; amaa yɛm nyɛla din sɔŋdi nir ka o diri nasara.
en: If you don't sharpen your ax, it will be harder to use; if you are wise, you'll know what to do.

dag: Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti yɛli ni paɣiŋɔhi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi dɔɣi ni bihi ni bi mɔɣi paɣ shɛb biha mal alibarika.
en: Someday people will say, Women who never had children are really fortunate.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Babilɔn naa lo tɔbu na ti liri ba n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ bipola bɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee, ka bi zo nachimbil bee paɣisarili bee ninkurili bee barinim nambɔɣu. O daa zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: So God brought the Babylonian king against them. The king killed their young men with the sword in their temples sanctuary, and showed no pity for young men or for virgins, for the old or for the feeble. God handed all of them over to him.

dag: Yinim maligumaaniba, wummiya! Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbilisimiya tibili! Yinim nayilinima, luɣimiya yi tiba wum! Saria karibu maa ʒila yi zuɣu, dama yi leela zana Mizipa, ka leei laŋa n-yɛrigi pa Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Neesim ni be yi sani yuui biɛla. Ka yi ni mali neesim maa zuɣu, kul chamiya; di yi pa lala zibisim ni ti paai ya. Ŋun chani zibisim ni bi mi o ni kpari shɛli polo.
en: Jesus replied, The light is with you for only a little while. Walk while you have the light so that darkness doesnt overtake you. Those who walk in the darkness dont know where they are going.

dag: Naŋgban yini maa ni ka alibarika niŋbu mini turi zaa yirina. M mabihi, di bi niŋ kamaata ni di nyɛ lala!.
en: These praises and curses come from the same mouth. My brothers and sisters, this should not happen.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan boli Samuɛl yaha m-pahi buta, ka o lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Di saha ka Ɛli daa baŋ ni Yawɛ m-booni bia maa.
en: A third time the LORD called Samuel. He got up, went to Eli, and said, Im here. You called me? Then Eli realized that it was the LORD who was calling the boy.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe ha! Bee n-yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe! Ti miriya ka yi chaŋ bee nti doli ba.
en: People will say to you, Look, there it is! or Look, here it is! Stay where you are; dont go away and search.

dag: Ka Barak yɛli Dɛbɔra, A yi ni doli ma chaŋ, n ni chaŋ; amaa a yi ku doli ma chaŋ, dindina n gba ku chaŋ.
en: Barak replied to her, If youll go with me, Ill go; but if not, I wont go.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni be ti sani kaman o ni daa be ti yaannim maa sani shɛm la. O di chɛ ti bee n-zaŋ ti bahi.
en: I pray that the Lord our God will be with us, as he was with our ancestors. I pray that he will never leave us.

dag: A mi di bi puhi ma ka mɔɣisi n kpariŋ kaman ti kali ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa n ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na hal ni wayo, paɣ ŋɔ na bi chɛ n naba bɔbilibu.
en: You didnt greet me with a kiss, but she hasnt stopped kissing my feet since I came in.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dooni bɛ gom shee n-lɔri nia biɛri. Bɛ bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ zali so viɛlli zuɣu; bɛ mi bi zaɣisiri din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: They plot evil even while resting in bed! They commit themselves to a path that is no good. They dont reject what is evil.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni mali tahima so sani. Bɛnkam zaɣis a ni di vi. Bɛnkam zo ka chɛ a, bɛ ni sabi bɛ yuya niŋ tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ.
en: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.

dag: Ka kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛl o, Di garig o shɛli bee n-saɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But the elders and all the people said, Dont obey him or do what he says.

dag: Sunsuuni dunɔpaɣira daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa tooni, binshɛli daa beni ŋ-ŋmani.
en: In the main hall itself, there were square doorposts in front of the holy place, where there was the appearance of.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhi ma ka n niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ti ba, dina n-nyɛ n chɛ ka bɛ daadambiɛligu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will also let the family of Israel come to me and ask me to do these things for them. I will make them grow and become many people. They will be like flocks of sheep.

dag: Ka n ni kul booni ba waawaayili shɛm, lala ka bɛ kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma. Bɛ maanila buɣili Baalnima, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi binnana.
en: But the more I called the Israelites, the more they left me. The Israelites gave sacrifices to the false gods and burned incense to the idols.

dag: Yilimiya yila niŋ o. Yilimiya yila paɣ o. Yɛlimiya o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: Sing to him; sing praises to him. Tell about the amazing things he has done.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Libini ni Shimɛi ni Yuza.
en: These are Meraris sons: Mahli was Meraris son, Libni was Mahlis son, Shimei was Libnis son, and Uzzah was Shimeis son.

dag: Ka a ni ti na kul yɛn tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, n gba ni dol a nyaaŋa kpɛna nti di a shɛhira.
en: Then while you are still talking with him, I will come in. After you leave I will tell the king what has happened. This will show that what you said is true.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu kaman di ni daa sabi shɛm; ka daa maani sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Maligunim maa kalinli daa dolila zaligu ni wuhi ni bɛ maani li dabisili kam shɛm.
en: They celebrated the Festival of Booths, as prescribed. Every day they presented the number of entirely burned offerings required by ordinance for that day.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa ti maai, ka Pool laɣim Yisa nyaandoliba maa na nti kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka chɛbisi ba, ka zaŋ kpa Masidɔnia polo.
en: When the trouble stopped, Paul invited the Lords followers to come visit him. After encouraging them, he told them goodbye and left for Macedonia.

dag: Naa, a nyɛla na titali gari nanim zaa. Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-ti a nam maa; ka lan ti a yiko mini kpiɔŋ ni jilima.
en: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of all kings. The God of heaven has made you emperor and given you power, might, and honor.

dag: Amaa ka yi chɛ ka Nazarinim maa nyuri wain, ka yɛri anabinima ni bɛ miri ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: But you made the nazirites drink wine, and ordered the prophets not to speak my message.

dag: amaa ka je Iso. N daa chɛ ka o tiŋ din be zoya ni la leei dabari, ka o tiŋgbani leei tiŋgban nɛli din nyɛ yɔbahi biɛhigu shee.
en: and have hated Esau and his descendants. I have devastated Esau's hill country and abandoned the land to jackals.

dag: N ni yaai n noli yɛli a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na zaa yɛla.
en: I will declare out loud all the rules you have spoken.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili din be kasi, dama dindali maa ka Naawuni daa vuh o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa binshɛɣukam nambu ni maa jɛlinsi.
en: He blessed the seventh day and set it apart as a special day, because by that day he had completed his creation and stopped working.

dag: ni Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Paliti nir la ni Ira Ikɛsh ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa nir la bia.
en: Helez from Pelet; Ira, Ikkeshs son from Tekoa.

dag: kaman o ni daa lo ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli shɛli hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: just as he promised to our ancestors, to Abraham and to Abrahams descendants forever.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ fɔɣi Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi ni bɛ zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: Then Nebuchadnezzar tore out Zedekiahs eyes. He put bronze chains on Zedekiah and took him to Babylon.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa ysɛli Anabi Hosea litaafi ni: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa n niriba, n ni boli ba, N niriba. Ka zuliya shɛb n ni bi yura, n ni boli ba, N ninvuɣ yurisi.
en: As it says also in Hosea, I will call my people those who arent my people, and the one who isnt well loved, I will call loved one. .

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Kpihimmi ti daalahichi zaa, ka deei ti tuun shɛŋa din viɛla, ka ti paɣir a kaman di ni simdi ni ti paɣir a shɛm.
en: Return to the Lord , and let this prayer be your offering to him: Forgive all our sins and accept our prayer, and we will praise you as we have promised.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Biligimiya kuɣili maa bahi! Ka Maata ŋun tizɔdoo daa kpi maa yɛl o, N Duuma, ŋ-ŋɔ o pooya, dama o ni kpi maa daba anahi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Take the stone away! Jesus ordered. Martha, the dead man's sister, answered, There will be a bad smell, Lord. He has been buried four days.

dag: ka daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm li la.
en: They worshipped images about which the LORD had said, Dont do such things!.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi ʒiɛra, ka teeku maa kɔgbana kul puɣiri lura.
en: The wind was blowing very hard. The waves on the lake were becoming bigger.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka yi suhuri saɣim bee n-je suli niŋ taba, yi ni daa zaŋ ma kɔhi kpe ŋɔ maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa niriba nyɛviya bahi.
en: Now dont be worried. Dont be angry with yourselves for what you did. It was Gods plan for me to come here. I am here to save peoples lives.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa zuɣu, bɛ suhuri ku zɔhiri bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.

dag: Ka Pool daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ; dinzuɣu ka o daa guni Timoti, Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni la zuɣu, dama bɛ zaa daa mi ni Timoti ba nyɛla Giriiki doo.
en: Paul wanted Timothy to travel with him, but all the Jews living in that area knew that his father was a Greek. So Paul circumcised Timothy to please the Jews.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma, n ni garigi ba; n ni be bɛ sani bɛ muɣisigu nyabu saha, n ni tiligi ba ka ti ba jilima.
en: When they call to me, I will answer them; when they are in trouble, I will be with them. I will rescue them and honor them.

dag: Nyama, n ni dihi ya sɔŋ tiŋa yi biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni vari kabɔba m-marigiri taba tɔroko lɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: And now I will crush you to the ground, and you will groan like a cart loaded with grain.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-zɔri Yawɛ, ka deeg o dabili noli? Ŋun be zibisim ni ka neesim ka o sani, o niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o Naawuni.
en: People who respect the Lord also listen to his servant. That servant lives completely trusting in God without knowing what will happen. He really trusts in the Lord s name and depends on his God.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka niriba ti ku lan deeri wuhibu maŋli, amaa ka ni dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre soli n-kul bɔrila karimbanim bɛn ni wuhiri wuhibu shɛŋa din niŋdi ba nyaɣisim pahira.
en: There will come a time when people will not tolerate sound teaching. They will collect teachers who say what they want to hear because they are self-centered.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni sɔŋ o ni pii na so ŋɔ; o ni be o daalizanda din be kasi la ni ka garig o, ka chɛ ka o nudirigu sɔŋ o ka o di nasara din galisi.
en: Now I know that the Lord gives victory to his chosen king; he answers him from his holy heaven and by his power gives him great victories.

dag: M muɣisigu nyabu dali, n daa suhi n Duuma. N daa kpuɣila n nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Naawuni yuŋ zaa ka di bi wum ma, ka n suhu daa zaɣisi maabu.
en: In times of trouble I pray to the Lord; all night long I lift my hands in prayer, but I cannot find comfort.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi n zuɣu, a chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili maa ŋmanila kɔgbana, n-ŋme ma luhi.
en: Your anger smothers me; you subdue me with it, wave after wave. Selah.

dag: Ka Asiria naa Tiligatipilinɛza daa lee ti kana ti lir o mi n-nahim o, ka bi sɔŋ o.
en: The Assyrian emperor, instead of helping Ahaz, opposed him and caused him trouble.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi chɛ o yiya bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri n yuli zuɣu ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: All who have given up home or brothers and sisters or father and mother or children or land for me will be given times as much. They will also have eternal life.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zali dimbɔŋɔ ka niŋ li, ka wuhi ʒiɛmana yɛla piligu ni zaŋ kana? Man Yawɛ n-daa beni piligu ni, ka ni lan beni naabu ni.
en: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord . I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa goli palli dali, ka piɛbimi li goli maa yi ti niŋ goli muni ni ti chuɣu puhibu dali.
en: Blow the trumpet for the festival, when the moon is new and when the moon is full.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya, ka Na so ŋun mali jilima maa gari kpɛna.
en: Mighty gates: lift up your heads! Ancient doors: rise up high! So the glorious king can enter!.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa ka o sanna, amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o sani paabu.
en: Jesus mother and brothers came to him but were unable to reach him because of the crowd.

dag: Niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka shɛb yi nuzaa polo n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo n-zɔri gindi bɔri Yawɛ yɛligu, amaa ka ti ku nya li.
en: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord . But you won't find one.

dag: Ka o daa saɣisi ba yɛli, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu ni boonila zuliya kam wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: Then he taught the people and said, The Scriptures say, My house should be called a place of worship for all nations. But you have made it a place where robbers hide.

dag: Kum zana n-daa kul gili ma; ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee dabiɛm gbaai ma; ka wahala mini suhusaɣiŋgu gbaai ma pam.
en: Deaths ropes were around me. The grave was closing in on me. I was worried and afraid.

dag: Amaa n yɛlila yinima: N ni zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔn maa tin ya, ka yi di li fali n-su li. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun woligi ya ka chɛ zuliya shɛba.
en: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka binshɛli kani n-so m-pahila di simdi ni ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa di bɛ tuma nyɔri, bɛ tarili m-bala. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ ba labisina ka bɛ ti nya din yɛn be bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: So I saw that the best thing people can do is to enjoy what they do, because that is all they have. Besides, no one can help another person see what will happen in the future.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, A ba min a biɛyanim kul a sanna.
en: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, Your father and your brothers have come to you.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli Chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ nya zuɣusuŋ a sani. Di saha ka Hanna daa kuli ti di ka nyu, ka daa bi lan mali suhugarigu.
en: Please think well of me, your servant, Hannah said. Then the woman went on her way, ate some food, and wasnt sad any longer.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti zaŋ n yuli suhi Naawuni; ka m bi yɛli ni n ni ti suhi m Ba tin ya.
en: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.

dag: Ka sokam deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri pin shɛŋa maa niriba zaa sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu.
en: A demonstration of the Spirit is given to each person for the common good.

dag: M puhiri Andurɔnikus mini Junias bɛn nyɛ n zuliya mini n sarikakpɛritab la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali jilima tuumba ni, ka nyɛ bɛn daŋ ma Masia yɛda niŋbu.
en: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala ninsal yubu bee o ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu.
en: So then, everything depends, not on what we humans want or do, but only on God's mercy.

dag: Ka o dɔbilim maa yi shihi situra kam mini biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ kam, bɛn paɣimi li, ka di ni nyɛ din be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If the semen is on any clothing or leather, that clothing or leather must be washed with water. It will be unclean until evening.

dag: Daadam bahirila yoli kaman bin pɔŋ la, ka ŋmani lɛla ni yi ŋubi chahi situra shɛli.
en: As a result, I crumble like rotten wood, like a moth-eaten coat.

dag: Joɛl n-daa nyɛ zuɣulana ka Shafam nyɛ ŋun pa o zuɣu, ka Janai mini Shafat mi doli bɛ nyaaŋa Bashan tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Some of the clan leaders were Joel, Shapham, Janai, and Shaphat.

dag: Nandahima zuɣu chɛ ka n tarigimi; nintam kul mahigirila m bindoo yuŋ kam; ka n nintam maa chɛ ka n difiɛli kul mahigi gbati.
en: Im worn out from groaning. Every night, I drench my bed with tears; I soak my couch all the way through.

dag: Ka o ni daa tim shɛb maa chaŋ ti shiri nya o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: They went off and found everything just as Jesus had said.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa garigi yɛli ba, M mi Yisa, ka mi Pool; ka banima n-lee nyɛ yi mi.
en: when an evil spirit said to them, I know Jesus! And I have heard about Paul. But who are you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli ba, Chamiya Bɛtilihɛm nti bo bia maa viɛnyɛliŋga; yi yi ti nya o ni be shɛli, yin labimiyana ti yɛli ma, ka n gba chaŋ ti jɛm o.
en: He told them, Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

dag: So ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa kul nyɛla din wuhiri ti alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣa maa daa paligi Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa suhuri.
en: This seemed like good advice to Absalom and all the Israelite leaders.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: Any of you who try to save the life you have will lose it. But you who give up your life for me will save it.

dag: Amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o zaŋ kpe Yisa sani; ka daa dula duu zuɣusaa ti chib voli n-zaŋ o min amaŋka maa tiri voli maa ni siɣisi li ti sɔŋ Yisa tooni.
en: but they couldnt reach him because of the crowd. So they took him up on the roof and lowered him—cot and all—through the roof tiles into the crowded room in front of Jesus.

dag: din yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni la: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn ni di chɛ ka niriba tuui li; di nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Amaa ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: The Scriptures talk about that stone: Look, I put in Zion a stone that will make people stumble. It is a rock that will make people fall. But anyone who trusts in him will never be disappointed. Isaiah :; :.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din mali daŋa m-mali sara, dama n ku deei li yi sani.
en: You must not present anything that has an imperfection, because it will not be acceptable on your behalf.

dag: Teemiya Vuhim Dabisili yɛla, ka chɛ ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi.
en: Remember that the Sabbath Day belongs to me.

dag: O ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naai, o daa zaŋ ma mi doli duno shɛli din be wulimpuhili polo la yi nti buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa palo zaa gili.
en: When he finished making the interior measurements of the temple, he led me out toward the east gate, and he measured all the way around.

dag: hal ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ti niŋ pali; ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa wuhi ni o ka taali.
en: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinahi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zibia, o daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba nira.
en: Joash was only years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother Zibiah was from the town of Beersheba.

dag: dama dindali maa ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya, ka yihi ya daɣiri ni; yi ni ti yi yi daalahichi zaa daɣiri ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: On that day the ritual is to be performed to purify them from all their sins, so that they will be ritually clean.

dag: Kuɣ duli ŋɔ mini kuɣ shɛli din yɛn teeri ti ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira din wuhiri ni n ku yaɣ kuɣ duli maa zuɣu ka a sanna ti niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a gba ku yaɣ kuɣ duli maa zuɣu ka n sanna ti niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Both this pile and this memorial stone are reminders. I will never go beyond this pile to attack you, and you must never go beyond it or beyond this memorial stone to attack me.

dag: Ka n ni kul booni ba waawaayili shɛm, lala ka bɛ kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma. Bɛ maanila buɣili Baalnima, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi binnana.
en: But as the saying goes, The more they were called, the more they rebelled. They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli: Yawɛ, a yɛliya ni a ni bela zibisim tital ni.
en: Then Solomon said, The Lord caused the sun to shine in the sky, but he chose to live in a dark cloud.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali buŋa bee nahu ka o ti lu biliga ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku chaŋ ti yaag o yomyom.
en: Jesus said to the Pharisees and teachers of the law, If your son or work animal falls into a well on the Sabbath day, you know you would pull him out immediately.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan kari niriba maa tin ya. Bɛ ni leei yi dimnima; ka bɛ wuna leei zana gbahi ya.
en: Now I will tell you this, I will not force the other people to leave this land any longer. These people will become a problem for you. They will be like a trap to you. Their false gods will become like a net to trap you.

dag: N niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka niriba bɛn be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo baŋ ni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka so bi lan pahi n zuɣu.
en: I do this so that everyone from one end of the world to the other may know that I am the Lord and that there is no other god.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Izraɛl fɔntinsi ni ni ti yina m-mali buɣim nyo bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti va nyɔtaɣiri bihi mini zaɣ kara ni tɔbiri ni piɛma ni kpana n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim yuma ayopɔin.
en: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdib yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: They asked him, Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka suhukpeeni din ni zaŋ bɛmaŋ gari bɛ ni, amaa ka daa lee tiri ba jilima pam.
en: No one from outside the church dared to join them, even though the people spoke highly of them.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa zo nti kpe Afɛk, ka tiŋ maa gooni daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayopɔin bɛn kpalim. Ka Bɛnhadad gba daa zo nti kpe tiŋ maa ni sɔɣi.
en: The survivors ran away to the city of Aphek. The wall of the city fell on , of those soldiers. Ben-Hadad also ran away to the city and hid in a room.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti bi tumdi tuumbiɛri ni di tahi zaɣ viɛlli na? Lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb zuri nyaaŋa yɛri ni lala ka n shiri wuhiri niriba. Bɛn yɛl lala maa simdi tibidarigibo.
en: You might as well say, Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it! Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria ninvuɣ gahinda zaa nirilim, ka saɣim omaŋa o ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb kɔre maa buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: She was the whore for all the Assyrian officers, and her lust led her to defile herself by worshiping Assyrian idols.

dag: Suhugarigu so lari, dama nandahima nyɛla din tahiri suhukpaŋsibo na.
en: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.

dag: Ti mi ni o yila Juda zuliya ni na, ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda zuliya polo, Anabi Musa daa bi kali ba pahi maligumaaniba ni.
en: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.

dag: Ka a zaŋ o ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o yi tintariga ti kɔrig o o ninni.
en: and they will give it to Eleazar the priest. It is to be taken outside the camp and killed in his presence.

dag: Kaman Yawɛ ni daa kul chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni kpiri shɛm la, lala ka yi gba yɛn kpi, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: Just like the nations that the LORD is destroying before you, thats exactly how you will be destroyed—all because you didnt obey the LORD your Gods voice.

dag: Di zaɣisi zaɣ viɛlli niŋ ti di ni simdi ni a niŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛba, a yi mali yiko din ni niŋ li.
en: Do everything you possibly can for those who need help.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti ŋubi biŋkpam bee binʒim yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.

dag: Cham nuzaa polo ti moli yɛligu ŋɔ n-yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ku lan yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra. N ku je suli niŋ ya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord — come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.

dag: Ka Hiram daa tim ti yɛli Sulemaana, N wum a ni tim na nti yɛli ma shɛm la, ka m mali shili ni n-niŋ a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ sida dakuɣiri mini sipirɛs dakuɣuri ŋmabu polo la.
en: Then Hiram sent this message to Solomon: I heard what you asked for. I will give you all the cedar trees and the fir trees you want.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka saa kum ka mi dindali maa. Ka Yawɛ mini Samuɛl yɛla daa gbahi niriba maa zaa dabiɛm pam.
en: Samuel called upon the LORD, and God sent thunder and rain on that very day. Then all the people were in awe of the LORD and Samuel.

dag: Niriba daa tahirila bɛ zuɣu, Wariya, daɣirinim ŋɔ. Wariya, wariya, di shihiya ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa leei kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn dari ginda. Ka zuliya shɛb daa yɛri taba, Bɛ ku lan be kpe yaha.
en: People shouted, Go away! Go away! Dont touch us. They wandered around and had no home. People in other nations said, We dont want them to live with us.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kubiɛlima n-kuri takɔbiri, ka zaŋ yi su kara mi kuri kpana. Chɛliya ka ninvuɣ gbarima gba yɛli, Ti nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba.
en: Hammer the points of your plows into swords and your pruning knives into spears. Even the weak must fight.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisiyinika puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu daba ayopɔin dali, ka Babilɔn naa kpambal so ŋun daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi sapashin kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan la daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Nebuchadnezzar came to Jerusalem on the th day of the fifth month of his nineteenth year as king of Babylon. The captain of Nebuchadnezzars best soldiers was Nebuzaradan.

dag: Wain yi ti mɔha, ka be pipia ni kpeera, ka yiɣiri lɛbira, nyin di lihi li.
en: So be careful with wine. It is pretty and red as it sparkles in the cup. And it goes down so smoothly when you drink it.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ a nini sɔɣi, ka zaŋ ma leeg a dima?.
en: God, why do you avoid me and treat me like your enemy?.

dag: O yi lo ni o kul doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi kaman o ni doli li shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, n ni chɛ ka o nam mali yaa.
en: Ill establish his kingdom forever if he remains committed to keeping my commands and case laws as he does now.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn doli dundɔŋ ni polo dunɔdal la kpe, di simdi ni bɛ yɛla binyɛr piɛla. Bɛ di ti ye biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri binyɛra, bɛ yi ti be dundɔŋ ni dunoya ni bee di puuni n-tumdi tuma.
en: When they come through the gates to the inner courtyard, they will wear linen garments. They wont wear any wool when they minister at the gates of the inner courtyard or in the temple.

dag: Sool n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi Yisa nyaandoliba maa alaka maa; o daa dolila yiya n-gbahiri dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba nti kpɛhiri duu.
en: Saul began to wreak havoc against the church. Entering one house after another, he would drag off both men and women and throw them into prison.

dag: Paɣimiy o, o yiko tumtumsa zuɣu. Paɣimiy o, o ni galisi pam zuɣu.
en: Praise God in his mighty acts! Praise God as suits his incredible greatness!.

dag: N yiɣisirila nolɔɣu kukoli saha n kumdi niŋd a, n zaŋ n tahima niŋla a yɛligu ni.
en: I meet the predawn light and cry for help. I wait for your promise.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa niŋ a daalikaulinim yɛda, ka yili yila paɣ a.
en: So our ancestors trusted Gods words; they sang Gods praise.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pahi pinaayi n-su chir pinaayi ni mi n-daa nyɛ Hɛlidai ŋun daa yi Nɛtɔfa na ka nyɛ Otiniɛl daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The twelfth commander, for the twelfth month, was Heldai from Netophah and from Othniels family. There were , men in Heldais group.

dag: Pirigili din daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili maa piɛri mini buhi kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisita ni tuhi pihitanaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: The people got , sheep.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka nyɛ na titali ŋun gari wuna zaa.
en: The LORD is a great God, the great king over all other gods.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: This is the duty of the Merarite clans for all their work in the meeting tent under the supervision of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: If anyone asks why you are doing this, just say, The Lord needs it. .

dag: Ka Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ni daa wuh o di sol la zuɣu.
en: Throughout his life he did what pleased the Lord , because Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

dag: O daa zaŋla salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di nɛma zaa.
en: He used pounds of pure gold to make the lampstand and the things used with it.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa tumdila din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din viɛla, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: but all of them have turned bad. Everyone is corrupt. No one does good— not even one person!.

dag: Ka n gbaai yila yilibu n suhu ni yuŋ, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-suhi Naawuni, ka bɔhi n suhu:.
en: During the night, I thought about my songs. I talked to myself, trying to understand what is happening.

dag: O saria dibu dolila yɛlimaŋli soli ni din tuhi. O kari pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun zaŋ o zina niŋbu n-saɣim dunia la saria, ka bɔh o biɛri ti o ni daa yihi ŋun Naawuni dab shɛb ʒim la.
en: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a ni n suhu zaa; n ni yɛl a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I will praise you, Lord , with all my heart. I will tell about the wonderful things you have done.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, dindali maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

dag: Amaa di yi pala o pun lomi ni o ku o, ka di nyɛla Naawuni n-chɛ ka di niŋ, dindina n ni wuhi ya luɣ shɛli zali ka ŋun ku nir maa zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: But if you did not intend to kill someone, and I, the Lord , let it happen anyway, you may run for safety to a place that I have set aside.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina.
en: You have heard that it was said, You must not commit adultery.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka zɔri salo, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni Yisa nyɛla anabi.
en: They were trying to arrest him, but they feared the crowds, who thought he was a prophet.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka kɔbil nina puhigi zɔra; ka daa chɛ ka mɔɣa din kom kul zɔri sahakam la nyuui.
en: You split open springs and streams; you made strong-flowing rivers dry right up.

dag: Chɛli ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku birigi kpe mɔɣu ni bee n-tim yi wain tihi puri ni; ti mi ku nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu hal ti gari yi tintariga.
en: Let us pass through your land. We and our cattle will not leave the road and go into your fields or vineyards, and we will not drink water from your wells; we will stay on the main road until we are out of your territory.

dag: Siria naa maa saha tariga yi ti miri, Ijipti naa ni ti chaŋ ti lir o, ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba ni sitimanim pam tuh o ni o kpiɔŋ zaa. Siria naa maa ni ti ŋmanila kokpɛɣu n-chaŋ ti liri tin bɔbili.
en: At the end time, the southern king will attack him. The northern king will storm against him with chariots and horses and many ships. He will invade countries, sweeping over them like a flood.

dag: Dama ti mi ŋun yɛli, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi la. O lan yɛli, Yi Duuma ni kar o niriba saria.
en: We know that God said, I will punish people for the wrongs they do; I will repay them. And he also said, The Lord will judge his people.

dag: ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Buɣili ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na, ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama lala na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: the Philistines were afraid and said, A god has come into that camp! Were doomed, they said, because nothing like this has ever happened before.

dag: Di saha a mini Lɛvinim ni saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani zaa ni puhi chuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti a min a yiŋnim binshɛŋa zaa o nirilim puuni maa zuɣu.
en: Then you must have a meal together and enjoy all the good things that the Lord your God has given to you and your family. You must share them with the Levites and the foreigners living among you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni kpuɣi yi mini n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim ŋɔ zuɣusaa n sani n-zaŋ labi katiŋa.
en: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.

dag: Yawɛ gari zuliya kam zaa, ka o jilima yaɣi sagbana zuɣu.
en: The Lord rules over all nations; his glory is above the heavens.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Ɛdomnim zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka chɛ ka di kpalim zani dabari, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba Tɛman hal ni Dɛdan.
en: Now I announce that I will punish Edom and kill every person and animal there. I will make it a wasteland, from the city of Teman to the city of Dedan, and the people will be killed in battle.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ kaman n ni niŋ shɛm maa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini pɔbi yi zuɣusaa naŋgbampiba, yi mi di ti di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: But you will do the same things that I have done about my dead wife. You will not cover your mustache or eat the food people normally eat when someone dies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti bi nya Yisa tuumba maa sarika maa ni ka labina ti yɛli.
en: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said.

dag: Tuuli, o nam sulinsi tinsi n-daa nyɛ Babɛl mini Ɛrɛk ni Akad, ka di zaa daa bela Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Nimrods kingdom spread from Babylon to Erech, to Akkad, and then to Calneh in the land of Babylonia.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: This means that you must follow the same laws and the same rules. These laws and rules are for you Israelites and for the other people who are living among you.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi fa Naawuni? Amaa yinim fari ma mi. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee fa a? Yi binyara pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim tibu mini yi sara pina tibu puuni.
en: People should not steal things from God, but you stole things from me. You say, What did we steal from you? You should have given me one-tenth of your things. You should have given me special gifts.

dag: ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim, ka di dunoya kabisikabisi.
en: The city is in ruins, and its gates have been broken down.

dag: Paɣ yi zaɣisi ni o zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu, dindina di simdi ni o chɛ o zabiri m-bahi; amaa di yi nyɛ vi ni paɣ chɛ o zabiri bee m-pini, ŋun bom bini m-pil o zuɣu.
en: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ Ijiptinim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa tibidarigibo.
en: That will be the punishment for Egypt, and for any other nation that does not come to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: God is powerful; all must stand in awe of him; he keeps his heavenly kingdom in peace.

dag: mini dɔr biɛɣu din be situra ni bee yil ni.
en: sores, boils, or inflammations; and about mildew in clothes or houses.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi a ni na ka nyɛ ŋun lo Yawɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka wuhiri yikombiɛlim.
en: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ʒeei gom, ka sanʒiɛɣu ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni n-ʒiɛri kom niŋdi bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka di ti yɛn tum ba barina.
en: and while they were sailing across, he went to sleep. Suddenly a storm struck the lake, and the boat started sinking. They were in danger.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and its drink offering.

dag: Ka n ni ti ka nimaani na nti to piɛma ata kaman n zahimla binshɛli ka tɔr la.
en: I will then shoot three arrows at it, as though it were a target.

dag: Naa Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la nam dibu yuun tuuli la ni ka n daa yiɣisi n-niŋ nia kpaŋs o.
en: In the first year of Darius the Medes rule, I took my stand to strengthen and protect him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibiya wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni pun wuhi ya ti waazu yihibu ni mini ti ni sab gban shɛŋa tin ya la puuni la.
en: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold on to the traditions we taught you, whether we taught you in person or through our letter.

dag: Amaa ka Sisɛra daa guui hal ti paai Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir la paɣ Jaɛl tanti gbini; dama zabili daa lan ka Hazɔr Naa Jabin mini Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir maa yiŋnim sunsuuni.
en: But Sisera ran away to the tent where a woman named Jael lived. Jael was the wife of Heber the Kenite. His family was at peace with King Jabin of Hazor. That is why Sisera ran to Jaels tent.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi zani ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛlnim zaa po pɔri n-wuhi ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa shiri po.
en: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o suhu paligirila o zuɣu gari piɛ kɔbigayinika bɛn bi bɔrigi la.
en: When he finds it, I tell you, he feels far happier over this one sheep than over the ninety-nine that did not get lost.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ o ni lo o suhu ni ni o me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ mini du shɛŋa din yɛn me n-gil li ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni daazichi zaashee ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa maani sara tiri Naawuni zaashee zaa buɣisibu gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: He also gave him the plans for all he had in mind for the courtyards and the rooms around them, and for the storerooms for the Temple equipment and the gifts dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ niriba pam na ti lir a, ka bɛ ti lab a kuɣa, ka zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmahiŋmah a jilajila.
en: They will bring an army against you, pelt you with stones, and slaughter you with their swords.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka m ma daa gbani dɔɣi ma? Bee bɔzuɣu ka o daa mɔɣisi ma bihim?.
en: Why did my mother hold me on her knees? Why did her breasts feed me?.

dag: Di ni lan sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛm wuhibu mini wuntitali ni zaligu dolibu ni nimmaŋtali polo.
en: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.

dag: ka lan ʒi laɣ shɛl na ni ti ti lan da bindira maa. Ti mi bi mi ŋun daa zaŋ ti liɣiri maa labisi niŋ ti kpalansi maa ni.
en: together with enough money to buy more grain. We don't know who put the money in our sacks.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima da li, ka nir ku tooi zaŋ anzinfa buɣisi di daa.
en: It cannot be bought with silver or gold.

dag: Yinima ninsalinim ka m boona. Bɛnkam be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka m booni maa.
en: I am calling out to all of you. I am speaking to everyone.

dag: Yi zaŋ yimaŋ niŋ alaha n-chani ginda, ka taɣiri jɛmbu soya. Ijiptinim ni ti dihi ya vi kaman Asirianim ni daa dihi ya vi shɛm la.
en: You change sides so casually! But Egypt will shame you no less than Assyria.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa wuh o maa, ka Ibrahimma me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka zaŋ dari maa pa di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga. Di saha ka o daa lo o bia Yisahaku maa mihi n-zaŋ o pa bimbini maa zuɣu dari maa zuɣu.
en: When they came to the place which God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and arranged the wood on it. He tied up his son and placed him on the altar, on top of the wood.

dag: Ashaara doli alahichinima, amaa tɔŋbu n-nyɛ wuntizɔriba laara.
en: Trouble follows sinners everywhere, but righteous people will be rewarded with good things.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli, Di simdi ni ti ku Shimɛi o ni daa tu Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Abishai son of Zeruiah spoke up: Shimei should be put to death because he cursed the one whom the Lord chose as king.

dag: Ka Absalom daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, Naa nyama, a dabili yɛn chɛla o piɛri kɔbiri, ka bɔri ni naa min o kpamba zaa kana.
en: Then he went to David and said, My servants are cutting the wool from my sheep. Please come and join us.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi ka kuui kaman mɔri la, ka n kɔre ka bindirigu ni gba.
en: my heart is smashed like dried-up grass. I even forget to eat my food.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni garigi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti ni gbibila ti ni lo nia shɛŋa, ka sokam tumd o tipawumli tuumbiɛri.
en: But the people of Judah will answer, We dont care what you say. We will continue to do what we want. We will do the evil our stubborn hearts want.

dag: Zoya mini kunkuna ni tihi din wandi wala ni sida tihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedar trees.

dag: Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni ka naanyi kpi m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the blessing that Moses, the man of God, gave the Israelites before he died:.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold.

dag: Bɛ ni teei bɛ nuhi kaman kɔduɣiriba ni teeri bɛ nuhi ni bɛ duɣi kom shɛm la. Amaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ shɛm zaa yoli, bɛ ni bahi di vi.
en: They will reach out their hands as if they were trying to swim, but God will humiliate them, and their hands will sink helplessly.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, yi yi nya ka di simdi, yin yomiya ma n tuma yɔri. Ka yi yi ku yo ma, yin maliya li. Ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita yo ma.
en: I said to them, If you are willing, give me my wages. But if not, keep them. So they paid me thirty pieces of silver as my wages.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa baŋ ni Naa Sɛnachɛrib loya ni o tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnim maa.
en: When Hezekiah realized that Sennacherib also planned on fighting Jerusalem.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita, ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi ŋmɛmdi bɛ nuhi ni ŋubira.
en: One Sabbath when Jesus and his disciples were walking through some wheat fields, the disciples picked some wheat. They rubbed the husks off with their hands and started eating the grain.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ka nyɛ ŋun diri viɛnyɛla, hal ka ku saɣi zaŋ o napɔŋ no tiŋa, o gba ni ti mɔŋ o ni yur o yidaan so min o bidibiga ni o bipuɣiŋga bindirigu.
en: Even the most gentle and refined woman among you, who is so refined and gentle she wouldnt stomp her foot on the ground, will scowl at her own dear husband, her son, or her daughter.

dag: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba leei shihirili mini bɛ ni maani shɛba ansarisi, ka yihi ba n niriba sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.

dag: Bumbɔni nyɛla asiba bɛ zaa sani, dama bɛ nyɛla bumbɔni mini dabiɛm zɔnima.
en: Deep darkness is morning to them because they recognize the horror of darkness.

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun lo paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti o amiliya niŋ din viɛla, amaa ŋun bi lo amiliya n-nyɛ ŋun niŋ din so.
en: Therefore, the one who marries the unmarried woman does right, and the one who doesnt get married will do even better.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nya du kara ŋɔ zaa bebɔ? Di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, Do you see these great buildings? They will all be destroyed. Every stone will be thrown down to the ground. Not one stone will be left on another.

dag: Sanzali mini biisim ni chɛ ka maligim kuuri shɛm, lala ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee gba darigiri deeri alahichinima.
en: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu di wum bɛ yɛligu maa, dama bɛ niriba gari ninvuɣ pihinahi do sol ni gu o. Bɛ laɣimmi po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ guhirila a nol ni yɛligu.
en: Dont fall for it! More than forty of them are waiting to ambush him. They have solemnly promised not to eat or drink until they have killed him. They are ready now, awaiting your consent.

dag: Yɛl biɛri din ka kalinli n-kul gili ma, di galisiya pam. N daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi n zuɣu, ka n ku lan tooi lihi nya binshɛli; di galisi gari n zabiri; ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: Troubles have surrounded me. They are too many to count! My sins have caught me, and I cannot escape them. They are more than the hairs on my head. I have lost my courage.

dag: Dinzuɣu nir yi nya biɛla diri ka mali suhudoo, di so ni o niŋ wahala nya pam. Di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zuɣu kul ʒiɛla ya n-gari n dimnim bɛn gil ma. Ka n ni mali sara o jɛmbu duu, ka tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu; n ni yili yila n-niɣim n-lɔŋni paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Now my head is higher than the enemies surrounding me, and I will offer sacrifices in Gods tent— sacrifices with shouts of joy! I will sing and praise the LORD.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na la yɛli, Biilzibul n-ʒi o zuɣu. Alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o karit alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: Some teachers of the Law of Moses came from Jerusalem and said, This man is under the power of Beelzebul, the ruler of demons! He is even forcing out demons with the help of Beelzebul.

dag: Wula ka a tah o ʒiishee ka yɛra, O ku garigi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛli.
en: Why do you accuse God of never answering our complaints?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: and the Lord said to him.

dag: Yihim ma vi shɛli n ni zɔri ni, dama a zaligunim viɛla.
en: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.

dag: Jɛshua min o bidibisi ni o dɔɣiriba ni Kadimiɛl min o bidibisi ni Binnui mini Hɔdavia nti pahi Hɛnadad bidibisi ni Lɛvinim mini bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa laɣim su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni tumtumdiba fukumsi.
en: Then Jeshua with his sons and his kin, Kadmiel and his sons, Binnui and his sons, the sons of Judah, along with the sons of Henadad, the Levites, and their sons and kin, collaborated to supervise the workers in Gods house.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa teei o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la, ka yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla puɣisiriba, yi kamina ni yi ti nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Joseph remembered what he had dreamed about them and said, You're spies! You've come here to find out where our country is weak.

dag: A min a tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a sani zaa ni ti lu Izraɛl zoya maa ni. Ka n ti zaŋ ya ti juri balibu kam mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ di.
en: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh.

dag: Ka Jɛtro daa wum Yawɛ ni niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa min o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm maa, ka o suhu daa paligi pam.
en: Jethro was so pleased to hear this good news about what the Lord had done.

dag: N kahig a yuli wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb a ni zaŋ ti ma dunia ŋɔ ni la; nyini n-su ba ka daa zaŋ ba ti ma, ka bɛ mi deeg a yɛligu.
en: I have made you known to those you gave me out of the world. They belonged to you, and you gave them to me. They have obeyed your word.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N daa yihila liɣiri pam da Rom tiŋbitali. Ka Pool yɛl o, Bɛ kul dɔɣila mani Rom tiŋbia.
en: The commander said, I paid a lot of money to become a Roman citizen. But Paul said, I was born a citizen.

dag: Dunianim zaa ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋla Yawɛ yuli booni ya, ka bɛ ti zɔri ya.
en: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord , and they will be afraid of you.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni o ni bi zaɣisi n suhigu maa zuɣu, bee o ni bi vuui o yurilim maŋli ka chɛ ma la zuɣu.
en: Bless God! He didnt reject my prayer; he didnt withhold his faithful love from me.

dag: Yɛm tuma nyɛla din chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋdi nyaɣisim, ka di soya zaa nyɛ din tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihinahi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and then lived another years. He had other children.

dag: Dama Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛba bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi zaɣisi ma ka niŋ bɛ buɣa yɛda, amaa ka ka anabi maa sanna ni bɛ ti bɔh o baŋ binshɛli n sani, man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni garigi ba.
en: Whenever one of you Israelites or one of you foreigners who live in the Israelite community turn away from me and worship idols, and then go to consult a prophet, I, the Lord , will give you your answer!.

dag: O ni daa paai Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbani maa dunɔdali gbini, ka Shɛlɛmia bia Irija ŋun daa nyɛ Hanania yaaŋa ka nyɛ dunɔgul la daa be nimaani, ka o daa gbaai anabi Jɛrimia ka yɛra, A zɔrimi doli Babilɔnnim maa ni a chaŋ.
en: But when I reached the Benjamin Gate, the officer in charge of the soldiers on duty there, a man by the name of Irijah, the son of Shelemiah and grandson of Hananiah, stopped me and said, You are deserting to the Babylonians.

dag: Zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni.
en: Always remember these commands that I give you today.

dag: ka n ni lan ti o biɛŋmariga pahi.
en: just as I received authority from my Father. I will also give them the morning star.

dag: Nir yi ŋubiri ka kuma ka mali suhudoo, di so yil shɛli nim bɛn diri bindir nyaɣisa ka zabili be di yili maa ni.
en: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi mali buɣa n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim, ka tumdi bukpahigu tuma, ka buɣiri baɣisi, ka saɣim bɛmaŋa n-tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: They burned their sons and daughters alive. They practiced divination and sought omens. They gave themselves over to doing what was evil in the LORDs eyes and made him angry.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Di ku niŋ lala. So yi ku nyin Keen, bɛn kum niriba ayopɔin yo a kubu maa samli. Ka Yawɛ daa dalim Keen ni di chɛ ka so ti nya o, ka ku ku o.
en: But the Lord answered, No. If anyone kills you, seven lives will be taken in revenge. So the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn anyone who met him not to kill him.

dag: Jɔn daa nyɛla firila din diri ka ne, ka yi daa saɣi m-mali suhupiɛlli o neesim maa ni daba ayi.
en: John was like a lamp that burned and gave light, and you were happy to enjoy his light for a while.

dag: Tɔb daa yi ti lu Naa Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni saha shɛlikam, di saha Abinɛr nyarila yaa Sool niriba maa sani.
en: As the fighting continued between David's forces and the forces loyal to Saul's family, Abner became more and more powerful among Saul's followers.

dag: Chɛ ka n kpe a biŋkɔbiri maa ni zuŋɔ ti gahim piɛ shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi mini bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni piɛbihi sabila ni bu shɛb bɛn mali sabilimsabilim mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bubihi sabila; ka bɛ leei n yɔri.
en: I will go through the entire flock today, taking out all of the speckled and spotted sheep, all of the black male lambs, and all of the spotted and speckled female goats. That will be my price.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha; ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: But again Peter said, No, I was not with him! As soon as he said this, a rooster crowed.

dag: Riuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza.
en: Reuel was the father of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yi ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: Yet the house of Israel says, My Lords way doesnt measure up. Is it my ways that dont measure up? Isnt it your ways that dont measure up, house of Israel?.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: LORD, do good to people who are good, to people whose hearts are right.

dag: lala zuɣu ka man daa zo a dabiɛm, ka zaŋ a pɔŋ tuhili maa ti pi tiŋgban ni; dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a bini.
en: So I was afraid. I went and hid your money in the ground. Here is the one bag of money you gave me.

dag: Ka so yi wuhiri wuhibu shɛli din be di ko, ka bi saɣi deei ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛligu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli la mini wuhibu shɛli din mini din luri Naawuni sizuura taɣili tab la.
en: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Musa, Mmaŋmaŋ n yɛn dol a chaŋ, ka ti a vuhim.
en: The Lord said, I will go with you, and I will give you victory.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kul wum ni Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa kpiya maa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti deeg o puu maa su.
en: So Ahab went to the vineyard and took it for his own.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka man Pool nyɛ Yisa Masia dansarika yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zuɣu.
en: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.

dag: ni ago sabilifaa ni ago ʒiɛkpeein ni ago ʒiɛkpain ni ago piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: fine linen; blue, purple, and red wool; cloth made of goats' hair;.

dag: N ni chaŋ wɔɣira sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la. Amaa hal bɛ gba nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ fukumsi ka bi deeg o noli.
en: I will go to the people in power and talk with them. Surely they know what their God requires, what the Lord wants them to do. But all of them have rejected the Lord 's authority and refuse to obey him.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee kpalim dɔɣibu maa ni. O ni daa ti yɛn bahi saha shɛli ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Bɛnɔni, amaa ka o ba mi daa bol o yuli Bɛnjamin.
en: As her life faded away, just before she died, she named him Ben-oni, but his father named him Benjamin.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, M mi ni bɛ ni booni so Masia la ni kana; ka o yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ti binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The woman said to him, I know that the Messiah will come, and when he comes, he will tell us everything.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi yi nya n yura maa, yi ni yɛl o ni n lula bole o zuɣu.
en: Promise me, women of Jerusalem, that if you find my lover, you will tell him I am weak from passion.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu lomiya ania n-chɛ ka zaɣisuntali pahi yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka baŋsim pahi yi zaɣisuntali zuɣu.
en: This is why you must make every effort to add moral excellence to your faith; and to moral excellence, knowledge.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kumiya dɔbba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: Kill all the males, and also every woman who is not a virgin.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti miri lubu saha shɛli, ka gom daa gbaai Ibram pam ka o dɔni gbihi, ka zibisim titali din mali dabiɛm pam daa zibig o sani.
en: After the sun set, Abram slept deeply. A terrifying and deep darkness settled over him.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Doo yi kpi ka ka bidibiga, yin zaŋmiya o fali ti o bipuɣiŋga.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say: If a man dies and doesnt have a son, you must hand his inheritance over to his daughters.

dag: Dindali maa yi ti paai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni tiligi ba kaman piɛgul ni tiligir o piɛri barina ni shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti nyɛlisiri bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni kaman nam zuɣupiligu ni waya la.
en: When that day comes, the Lord will save his people, as a shepherd saves his flock from danger. They will shine in his land like the jewels of a crown.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti wum ni bɛ nya Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o san la. Di saha maa ŋun Sool daa ʒila ti shɛli din yuli booni tamarisik la gbini Gibia Zoli zuɣu, ka o kpani be o nuu ni ka o sapashin kpamba zaa ʒe n-gil o.
en: Saul learned that David and his soldiers had been located. Saul was sitting under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, spear in hand, with all his servants waiting on him.

dag: Ka n daa po n suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli, Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani! .
en: I was angry and made a solemn promise: They will never enter the land where I would have given them rest.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa la sani ti yɛl o, Ti suhir a, chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni gari kuli ti ya.
en: Then the Israelites sent messengers to King Sihon of the Amorites. Sihon was the king of the city of Heshbon. The messengers asked Sihon, Let the Israelites pass through your land. We want to go to our land.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini di biŋkpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi o ni yɛn yihi yaannin shɛŋa maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li mali sara.
en: He will also offer the two kidneys and the fat covering them near the lower back muscles. He will also offer the fat part of the liver. He must remove it with the kidneys.

dag: di saha maa n daa bela o luɣili zuɣu kaman tumtumdiba kpɛm la. O suhu daa piɛli n zuɣu dabisili kam, ka n kul mali suhupiɛlli o sani sahakam.
en: I grew up as a child by his side, laughing and playing all the time.

dag: Ka nimmoo tɔb daa bili dindali maa, ka Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa tuhi nyaŋ Abinɛr mini Izraɛlnim maa.
en: A fierce battle took place that day, and Abner and the Israelite troops were defeated by Davids soldiers.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul dolila yɛlimaŋli soli, ka bihi bɛn doli bɛ naba mali alibarika.
en: When people live good, honest lives, their children are blessed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Yisa ni kahig omaŋa wuhi o nyaandoliba m-pahi siɣim buta o kum ni neebu la nyaaŋa.
en: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his followers after he was raised from death.

dag: Ka salo bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa wum lala ka yɛli ni saa n-tahira. Ka shɛb mi yɛli ni malaika n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa shɛm maa.
en: The crowd standing there heard and said, Its thunder. Others said, An angel spoke to him.

dag: Dama ti ni daa naan ku tooi sɔŋ timaŋa saha shɛl la dɛde, ka Yisa Masia daa kpi alahichinim zuɣu.
en: Christ died for us when we were unable to help ourselves. We were living against God, but at just the right time Christ died for us.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nini ni nya ma zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? Amaa bɛn nini bi nya ma ka niŋ yɛda mal alibarika.
en: Jesus said to him, Do you believe because you see me? How happy are those who believe without seeing me.

dag: Shammai bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Maɔn, ka Maɔn daa nyɛ Bɛtizur ba.
en: Shammais son was Maon. Maon was Beth Zurs father.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tu o la, o daa bi tu so labisi; o ni daa di wahala la, o daa bi tɛhi biɛri bɔhibu yɛla, amaa o daa chɛla shɛlikam niŋ ŋun kariti saria dɛde la nuu ni.
en: People insulted him, but he did not insult them back. He suffered, but he did not threaten anyone. No, he let God take care of him. God is the one who judges rightly.

dag: Di dunoya zaa mini di takɔriti zaa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: and there were three doors on each side near the front of the hall.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ ti du Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka Abimilɛk ti zaŋ lɛhu ŋ-ŋma dabɔbili n-zaŋ li buɣi; ka yɛli bɛn be o sani, Yi ni nya ka n niŋ shɛm maa, yi gba niŋmiya lala yomyom.
en: He led his troops to Mount Zalmon, where he took an ax and chopped off a tree branch. He lifted the branch onto his shoulder and shouted, Hurry! Cut off a branch just as I did.

dag: Bɛ daa lihiya, amaa ka so daa kani ŋun ni tiligi ba. Bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o daa bi garigi ba.
en: They look for help, but no one saves them; they call to the Lord , but he does not answer.

dag: Ka ti daa ti laɣim bakɔi piligu dali ni ti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro n-laɣim di Ti Duuma Bindirigu, ka Pool ni daa lɔri ni biɛɣu neei ka o chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa tɔɣisi ba Naawuni soli yɛla hal ni yuntisuɣu.
en: On the first day of the week, as we gathered together for a meal, Paul was holding a discussion with them. Since he was leaving the next day, he continued talking until midnight.

dag: Ti sa bela puu ni lɔri kabɔba, yim ka n ti nya ka n kabɔbili yiɣisi zani, ka yi kabɔba laɣimna ti gili n kabɔbili maa n-damdi li tiŋa.
en: When we were binding stalks of grain in the field, my stalk got up and stood upright, while your stalks gathered around it and bowed down to my stalk.

dag: Ka Haga daa ti dɔɣi Ibram bidibiga, ka Ibram daa boli bi so Haga ni dɔɣi maa yuli Ishimail.
en: Abram was years old when Hagar gave birth to their son, and he named him Ishmael.

dag: Ka o mi buɣisi yɛli ba ni bɛ tim o gbaŋ; ka bɛ daa ti o gbaŋ maa ka o sab yɛli, Bia maa yuli Jɔn. Ka di daa gari sokam pam.
en: Zechariah asked for something to write on. Then he wrote, His name is John. Everyone was surprised.

dag: Yi yi po pɔri ni yi niŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, yin di pihigi di palibu, dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi di niŋbu yɛla yi sani ka di chɛ ka yi ku tum taali.
en: When you make a promise to the Lord your God, dont be slow to pay everything you promised. The Lord your God will demand that you pay it. You will sin if you dont pay what you promised.

dag: Ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili maa daa yi nimaani n-zaŋ hal ti sirigi Luz nudirigu polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Atarɔtada Zoli din daa be Bɛtihɔrɔn din be naɣiliŋga ni nudirigu polo la.
en: Then the border went south to Luz , then down to Ataroth Addar. Ataroth Addar is on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je man Yawɛ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni ka dabiɛm mali ba, ka bɛ tibidarigibo ti ku mali tariga.
en: Those who hate the Lord would shake with fear. They would be punished forever.

dag: Di chani a ʒiʒiinikpee yiŋa waawaayili, di yi pa lala, o nyee ni ti nyɔn a, ka o ku lan bɔr a.
en: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ bihi yiri chani kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la, ka bɛ bihi maa yiɣiri jamda.
en: their children play and dance safely by themselves.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul kpuɣ bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa, bɛ bi lan nya so n-naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi tɛr ni bahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Sujee mini suhuyiɣisili ni biɛr biɛɣu. Ka di chɛliya ka turi mini yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na.
en: But now you must get rid of all these things: anger, passion, and hateful feelings. No insults or obscene talk must ever come from your lips.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chamiya gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yihi tiliginsim lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti sokam.
en: He said to them, Go throughout the whole world and preach the gospel to all people.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba dii gbaai kumsi.
en: Jesus started crying.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma. Mani m-bala.
en: Jesus spoke to them at once. Courage! he said. It is I. Don't be afraid.

dag: nyin chɛl a sara maa nimaani, ka chaŋ a kpee maa sani ka yi ti mali yi yɛlli maa pɔi ka a naanyi labi nti zaŋ a sara maa ti Naawuni.
en: Leave your gift there and go make peace with that person. Then come and offer your gift.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim birigi n-tum alahichi pam gari Yawɛ ni daa ku zuliya shɛb ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani la ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa.
en: Manasseh led the people of Judah to commit even greater sins than those committed by the nations whom the Lord had driven out of the land as his people advanced.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun yɛli ya ka yi bi niŋ yɛda. N ni mali m Ba yuli tumdi tuun shɛŋa maa n-diri ma shɛhira;.
en: Jesus answered, I have already told you, but you would not believe me. The deeds I do by my Father's authority speak on my behalf;.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka kulibɔŋ maa kom maa nyuui, saa ni daa bi lan miri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la zuɣu.
en: After a while the brook dried up because there was no rain in the land.

dag: Pashihur daŋ — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayopɔin.
en: of Pashhur .

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya M poya, Bɔzira ni leei dabeenzɔbo mini ansarisimalibo tiŋa, ka zani dabari ni niriba ni yɛn turi shɛli, ka di fɔntinsi ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam.
en: I myself swear, declares the LORD, that Bozrah will become an object of horror and scorn, a wasteland and a curse. And all of its towns will lie in ruins forever.

dag: Mɔri yi ti naai, ka mɔ pala bili, di saha ka bɛ chɛri zoya ni mɔri sɔŋda.
en: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over.
