dag: Asha zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Naftali zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Manaasa zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: , from Asher, , from Naphtali, , from Manasseh.

dag: Maligumaaniba daa ʒi m-bɔhi, Yawɛ lee be ya? Zaligubaŋdiba daa bi mi ma, ka nanim tum din bi tuhi n-jɛndi ma. Ka anabinim daa mali Baal yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka doli binshɛŋa din ka ba nyɔri.
en: The priests didnt ask, Wheres the LORD? Those responsible for the Instruction didnt know me; the leaders rebelled against me; the prophets spoke in the name of Baal, going after what has no value.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pia daa lu Gibianim zuɣu, ka tɔb maa daa kpɛm pam. Amaa Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa bi baŋ ni yɛl biɛɣu n-yɛn paai ba maa.
en: , of Israels best-trained soldiers attacked the city of Gibeah. The fighting was very heavy. But the army of Benjamin did not know that a terrible thing was about to happen to them.

dag: N suh a ni n suhu zaa; zom ma nambɔɣu kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Ive sought your favor with all my heart; have mercy on me according to your word.

dag: O daa bi siɣis omaŋa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa siɣis omaŋ shɛm la, amaa Amɔn ŋɔ ŋun daa kul tumdila tuumbiɛri pahira.
en: Amon did not humble himself in front of the Lord like Manasseh his father humbled himself. But Amon sinned more and more.

dag: A ni ti tooi yɛli ni a nyɛla wuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku a maa tooni? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti a daŋ maa sani, a nyɛla ninsala, ka pa wuni.
en: When you face your enemies, will you still claim to be a god? They will attack, and you will suffer like any other human.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn di nam n-zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee su zuliya kam, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ to n-kpuɣ o bia maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ o tahi Naawuni sani o nam ʒiishee.
en: She gave birth to a son, a male child who is to rule all the nations with an iron rod. Her child was snatched up to God and his throne.

dag: mini Gɛbalnim tiŋgban la ni Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban la zaa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo ni Baaligad din be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni la ni zaŋ ti paai Lɛbohamat kpɛbu shee la.
en: You have not yet defeated the area of the Gebalites. And also there is the area of Lebanon east of Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali m biɛhigu shee dundɔŋ ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi n-yil li zaŋ labi nudirigu polo.
en: Make a courtyard for the Holy Tent. The south side should have a wall of curtains cubits long. These curtains must be made from fine linen.

dag: Bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni; dama nir na ʒi m-pɔhi fiig tia wala goo zuɣu, ka so mi na ʒi m-pɔhi gaya pirinkpaŋ zuɣu.
en: Every tree is known by the fruit it bears; you do not pick figs from thorn bushes or gather grapes from bramble bushes.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala ni kom mini Naawuni Shia, di yi pa lala o ku tooi kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Jesus answered, Believe me when I say that everyone must be born from water and the Spirit. Anyone who is not born from water and the Spirit cannot enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Naawuni, a mi n jɛrilim ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni pun tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bi sɔɣ a sani.
en: My sins, O God, are not hidden from you; you know how foolish I have been.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Pɛɛgamum Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: Here is a message from the one who has the sharp two-edged sword.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa, Ti chaŋ gili dunia zaa n-nya ka dunianim zaa malila suhudoo.
en: They reported to the angel: We have been all over the world and have found that the whole world lies helpless and subdued.

dag: N kɔŋko n-daa kul kpalim be nimaani n-lihiri alahiziba ʒii maa. Ya buriginli daa lan ka n ni, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi hal ka so ku lan tooi baŋ ni mani m-bala gba.
en: Only I saw this great vision. I became weak and pale.

dag: Daadam bahirila yoli kaman bin pɔŋ la, ka ŋmani lɛla ni yi ŋubi chahi situra shɛli.
en: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.

dag: O daa kamina ti nyo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm yiya zaa buɣim. O daa nyo yil karili kam buɣim.
en: He burned down the Temple, the palace, and the houses of all the important people in Jerusalem.

dag: Niŋmiya bindira tiri kum ni kuri shɛba, ka deemiya nandaamba bɛn ka kpɛhili shee niŋmi yi yinsi; ka timiya bɛn chani gbinfini situra; ka di zaɣisiya yi dɔɣiriba sɔŋbu.
en: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.

dag: Dama ŋunkam ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ biŋkpam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu maa yɛla ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni.
en: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samuɛl daa ti boli niriba ni bɛ laɣim Yawɛ sanna Mizipa.
en: Samuel summoned the people to the LORD at Mizpah.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kpɛhi ma kɔre, ka kɔre maa gbaa ma. A mali yaa gari ma, ka nyaŋ ma. N leela bɛ ni lari so asiba hal ni yuŋ; sokam maani ma la ansarisi.
en: LORD, you enticed me, and I was taken in. You were too strong for me, and you prevailed. Now Im laughed at all the time; everyone mocks me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka bɛ siɣisi bɛmaŋ maa ka o daa yɛli Shɛmaya, Bɛ ni saɣi ni bɛ tum taali maa, n ku lan ku ba, ka ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli, amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya faako n-yi Shishak nuu ni.
en: When the LORD saw that they had submitted, the LORDs word came to Shemaiah: Since they have submitted, I wont destroy them. I will deliver them in a little while, and I wont use Shishak to pour out my anger against Jerusalem.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa yɛli niriba maa, Yi tum alahichi titali. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n ni chaŋ Yawɛ sani nti suh o, di pa shɛli o ni chɛ yi daalahichi maa.
en: The next day Moses told the people, This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani la n-lo o ni o sɔŋ yuun tuhili.
en: The angel grabbed the dragon, that old snake, also known as the devil or Satan. The angel tied the dragon with the chain for years.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ɛdom zoli polo, n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Human one, face Mount Seir, and prophesy against it.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mini Dauda ŋun nyɛ bɛ na so n ni yɛn pii ti ba la.
en: Instead, they will serve me, the Lord their God, and a descendant of David, whom I will enthrone as king.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be kasi. Mani n-nam yinim Izraɛlnima, ka nyɛ yi naa.
en: I am the Lord , your holy God. I created you, Israel, and I am your king.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Jarɛd.
en: When Mahalalel was years old, he became the father of Jared.

dag: Dama o daa dolila Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam soli, ka tumdi alahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la.
en: He committed all the sins that Jeroboam son of Nebat had committed when he caused the Israelites to sin. They worshiped worthless idols, and this made the Lord , the God of Israel, very angry.

dag: Anabi yi zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli ka di bi niŋ bee ka shɛli bi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, di pala Yawɛ ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli: Anabi maa n-kul ŋme nyɔɣu n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa; yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya.
en: If a prophet says he is speaking for the Lord , but what he says does not happen, you will know that the Lord did not say it. You will know that this prophet was speaking his own ideas. You dont need to be afraid of him.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zɔri, niŋm a ni kana ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Di saha ka salo maa dii kana ti gbaai Yisa.
en: But Jesus said to him, Friend, do what you came to do. Then they came and grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

dag: Amaa n di yuya ni Naawuni yaag o noli n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: But I wish God would speak.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa niŋla Bɛtani din be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn ni daa baptaiziri niriba kom ni la.
en: This encounter took place across the Jordan in Bethany where John was baptizing.

dag: ka lan ʒi laɣ shɛl na ni ti ti lan da bindira maa. Ti mi bi mi ŋun daa zaŋ ti liɣiri maa labisi niŋ ti kpalansi maa ni.
en: We have also brought some more money with us to buy more food. We do not know who put our money back in our sacks.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Kɛdɛshi mini Dabɛrat ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa.
en: In the territory of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath.

dag: Yawɛ, zanimi n nyaaŋa ni n ka taali; dama galimi ka m biɛhigu ni. N niŋ Yawɛ naani ka bi tiriti gbini.
en: Declare me innocent, O Lord , because I do what is right and trust you completely.

dag: O ni ti zo n-dol o mamanima, amaa ka ku paai ba. O ni ti bo bɛ shee, amaa ka ku nya ba. Di saha o ni ti yɛli, N ni labi n yidaan taa la yiŋa; dama di daa so n zuɣu gari pumpɔŋɔ.
en: She will go after her lovers, but she wont catch up with them; she will seek them, but she wont find them. Then she will say, I will return to my first husband, for I had it better then than now.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɛ alahichi daba saha shɛl la, wuntia daa bi su yi fukumsi.
en: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.

dag: Naawuni yi Ziɔn din nyɛ tin suŋ la ni n-kanna ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines brightly.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni nti kurigi n ni daa zaŋ jinjɛŋŋmaa maa pi luɣ shɛli maa n-yihi li na. Amaa ka jinjɛŋŋmaa maa daa saɣim ka lan ka buchi.
en: So I went to the Euphrates and I dug up the linen undergarment from the place I had buried it. But it was ruined and good for nothing.

dag: A yi niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nirilim, bɛ bi bɔhindi din tuhi niŋbu. Hal bɛ ni kul be wuntizɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zaa yoli, bɛ bi niŋdi din tuhi. Bɛ bi saɣi ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi.
en: Evil people will not learn to do good, even if you show them only kindness. They will still do wrong, even if they live in a good world. They never see the Lord s greatness.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi ni bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛmuɛl daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛlnima; ka Jamin daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaminnima; ka Jachin daŋ niriba mi nyɛ Jachinnima.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Simeon; they were from the clans of Nemuel, Jamin, Jachin, Zerah, and Shaul.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun yiɣisiri zoya ka zoya maa bi mi di yɛla ŋɔ, o suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o lɛbiri li pilina.
en: Who removes mountains, and they are unaware; who overthrows them in anger?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku tinsi maa niriba zaa, ka bi chɛ ka paɣa bee doo kpalim; ka daa gbahi bɛ piɛri mini niɣi, ni bunsi ni laakumnima, ka va bɛ situra pahi n-lab Akishi sanna.
en: Whenever David and his men attacked a town, they took the sheep, cattle, donkeys, camels, and the clothing, and killed everyone who lived there. After he returned from a raid, David always went to see Achish.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa me Mɔabnim buɣili Chɛmɔshi din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Molɛk din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee zali Jɛrusalɛm wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu.
en: On the mountain next to Jerusalem, Solomon built a place for worshiping Chemosh, that horrible idol of the Moabites. On the same mountain, Solomon built a place for worshiping Molech, that horrible idol of the Ammonites.

dag: N ni kum ka fabili zoya zuɣu, ka fabili mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu, dama di bahila yoli doya ka so bi lan gariti nimaani. So bi lan wumdi niɣi kumsi nimaani. Noombihi mini biŋkɔbiri zaa yi nimaani zo.
en: I said, I will mourn for the mountains and weep for the pastures, because they have dried up, and no one travels through them. The sound of livestock is no longer heard; birds and wild animals have fled and gone.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn be afua ni la zuɣu. N suhu daa yiɣisila biɛla bahi n niriba maa zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ kpe di ni n-dihi ba wahala biɛri pahi.
en: and I am very angry with the nations that enjoy quiet and peace. For while I was holding back my anger against my people, those nations made the sufferings of my people worse.

dag: daa gili Yisa nyaaŋa nti shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka o dɔro maa dii naai.
en: The woman came behind Jesus and touched the bottom of his coat. At that moment, her bleeding stopped.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni yi baŋ ni ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli ni ti beni. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda la ansarisi.
en: Most important, know this: in the last days scoffers will come, jeering, living by their own cravings.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Jɔtam bia Naa Ahaz mi daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah during the th year that Pekah son of Remaliah was king of Israel.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Kadɛshi m-mali ti paai Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: The whole community of Israel left Kadesh and arrived at Mount Hor.

dag: ka zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: The third row should have a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

dag: Ka Musa daa shiri kpuɣi jaaŋgbee maa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: The walking stick was in the Holy Tent, in front of the Lord . Moses took the walking stick as the Lord said.

dag: nti kpe ŋariŋ ni bɛ baai du Kapɛrinium polo. Ka di daa mali ti zibi ka Yisa na bi ka bɛ sanna.
en: They got into a boat and were crossing the lake to Capernaum. It was already getting dark and Jesus hadnt come to them yet.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba ata daa yi Siizaria paai yil shɛli n ni daa be maa na. Bɛ daa tim ba la n sanna.
en: At that very moment three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea arrived at the house where I was staying.

dag: Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni nimaani, ka salo maa zaa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: Such large crowds gathered around him that he had to sit in a boat, while the people stood on the shore.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun darigiri zuliya kam tibili. Ŋuna ŋun zaŋdi baŋsim wuhiri daadamnima ŋɔ pala ŋun darigiri niriba tibili?.
en: He scolds the nations—won't he punish them? He is the teacher of us all—hasn't he any knowledge?.

dag: Nyaandoliba bɛn daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya ni na. Bɛnjamin mini Juda zuliya niriba shɛb daa chaŋ Dauda sani birini la ni.
en: Other men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah also came to David at the fortress.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa, ŋuna n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: Because the right to rule belongs to the LORD, he rules all nations.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di simdi ka yi teeri dabisili ŋɔ yɛla, di nyɛla yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛli ka yi dabitim bandi ni la, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu n-daa yihi ya nimaani maa. Di bi simdi ka yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi.
en: Moses said to the people, Remember this day which is the day that you came out of Egypt, out of the place you were slaves, because the LORD acted with power to bring you out of there. No leavened bread may be eaten.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni n-tim ti gba ka Naawuni mali soli ti ti ka ti tɔɣisi o yɛligu n-kahigi Masia ashili yɛtɔɣa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m be sarika ni ŋɔ.
en: Also pray for us. Pray that God will give us an opportunity to tell people his message. I am in prison for doing this. But pray that we can continue to tell people the secret truth that God has made known about Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Labimiya n sanna, ka n gba lab yi sanna.
en: So you must tell the people what the Lord All-Powerful says, Come back to me, says the Lord All-Powerful, and I will come back to you. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Bɛ saɣim Mɔab, ka di bihi kuhira.
en: Moab is shattered; its young cry for help.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali ka kum daa muɣisi tiŋ maa nim pam, ka bindirigu daa lan ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka niriba maa ni di.
en: On the ninth day of the fourth month of that same year, when the famine was so bad that the people had nothing left to eat.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka tɔbbihi maa chɛ Pool ti wɔribariba la ni bɛ zaŋ o tahi, ka bɛn daa ŋmaligi lab bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: The next day the foot soldiers returned to the fortress and let the soldiers on horseback take him the rest of the way.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka o daa ŋoli bɛ ni yi.
en: Once more they tried to seize Jesus, but he slipped out of their hands.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani palo ni daa galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ daa ŋmaai di shɛli polo ti Simiɔn zuliya niriba; ka Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa puuni.
en: Simeons share of land was within the area that Judah got. The people of Judah had more land than they needed, so the people of Simeon got part of their land.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni ti yɛli bɛ mini bɛn sɔŋdi ba yɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa. Bɛ ni ti siɣi tiŋgban ni nti fo n-doya, bɛn bi guni ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba.
en: Strong and powerful men were killed in battle. Those foreigners went down to the place of death. And from that place, those who were killed will speak to Egypt and his helpers.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi niŋ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la zaa. Yi lan niŋ n gba ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You have obeyed every command of the Lord your God and of his servant Moses. And you have done everything I've told you to do. It's taken a long time, but you have stayed and helped your relatives.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul bɛ ti sani; naɣila ti chaŋmi ti da bindirigu din ni saɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa na.
en: Jesus answered, You give them something to eat. But they replied, We have only five small loaves of bread and two fish. If we are going to feed all these people, we will have to go and buy food.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zuliya nabi.
en: May the Lord give you children— you and your descendants!.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi, ka bɛ mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaaniba ti dii tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: The Pharisees left. And at once they started making plans with Herod's followers to kill Jesus.

dag: ni Baɣibuk daŋ niriba ni Hakufa daŋ niriba ni Harihur daŋ niriba.
en: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa n-doli tuumba maa wuhibu, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni n-wuhiri bɛ dolintabitali ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ laɣimdi mini bɛ wunsuhigu ni.
en: The believers devoted themselves to the apostles teaching, to the community, to their shared meals, and to their prayers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi naai ka Jeemsi mi yɛli, M mabihi, wummiya n gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: When they finished speaking, James said, My brothers, listen to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.

dag: Dim liɣiri maa ka di doli soli. Zaŋm li da naɣilahi mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi ni kawana ni wain n-zaŋ di mini biŋkɔbiri maa zaa mali sara yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu sara maligu bimbini zuɣu Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ o Bia maa zali zaashe tital ni gari malaikanima kaman o ni daa ti o yuli din gari bɛ yuya shɛm la.
en: The Son became much greater than the angels, and God gave him a name that is much greater than any of their names.

dag: Doo kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu;.
en: So a man who prays or proclaims God's message in public worship with his head covered disgraces Christ.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buri pili, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba. Vi ni ti be bɛ zaa nina ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri zaa ti nyɛ zuɣukpina.
en: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi kɔhigɔriba galisi gari saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Toliga fuɣisiya ka yiɣi chaŋ.
en: You boasted more traders than the heavens have stars. The locust sheds its skin and flies away.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka Mariama kumda, ka Yɛhudianim bɛn dol o na maa gba kumdi maa, ka o suhu saɣim pam, ka o siɣim.
en: When Jesus saw Mary crying and the people with her crying too, he was very upset and deeply troubled.

dag: Dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita.
en: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Hazaɛl, Bom pini n-chaŋ ti puhi Naawuni nir maa, ka chɛ ka o bɔhi Yawɛ nya n ni kpaŋ m barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: he said to Hazael, Go meet with Elisha the man of God and get him to ask the Lord if I will get well. And take along a gift for him.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab daa baŋ lala ka zaŋ o tahi Siizaria nti chɛ ka o kul o ya Taasus.
en: When the believers learned about this, they took Saul to Caesarea, and from there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.

dag: Ka o mi ti yɛli ya yaha, N yɛri ya mi, n ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na. Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, wariya! .
en: He will respond, I dont know you or where you are from. Go away from me, all you evildoers.

dag: A daa pala shɛli ka n duh a ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka a mi ti dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli n-chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa tum alahichi, ka bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: Nobody knew who you were until I, the Lord , chose you to be the leader of my people Israel. And now you're acting exactly like Jeroboam by causing the Israelites to sin. What you've done has made me so angry.

dag: Ka o daa yi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋ Asiria nti me Ninive mini Rɛhɔbɔtir ni Kala ni.
en: Asshur left that land and built Nineveh, Rehoboth City, Calah.

dag: Ka di simdi ni yi yipa ŋmaligi chɛ m-paŋ o ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama di yi pa lala suhugarigu pam zuɣu ni chɛ ka o lu.
en: This is why you should try your best to forgive and to comfort this person now instead, so that this person isnt overwhelmed by too much sorrow.

dag: Dama n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla bindir maŋli, ka n ʒim mi nyɛ binnyur maŋli.
en: My body is true food, and my blood is true drink.

dag: Musa daa pirigi tiŋgbani shɛli ti Rubin zuliya ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses provided for the clans of the Reubenite tribe.

dag: O daa di tarimba mini nandaamba saria ka di viɛla. Pa nira ni yɛn niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o mi ma m-bala? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anahi.
en: There was evening and there was morning: the fourth day.

dag: Inok daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu.
en: He lived to be years old.

dag: M mali yɛla pam din ni tɔɣisi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka kari ya saria, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka n ni wum shɛli o sani, dina ka m mali yɛri dunianima.
en: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.

dag: Teeku n-nyɛ ma bee binneen titali ŋun be teeku ni n-nyɛ ma, ka a chɛ ka bɛ guli ma?.
en: Am I one of your enemies? Is that why you put a guard over me?.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya yaa n-chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn du n-chaŋ ti ʒini maa ni.
en: So keep every part of the commandment that I am giving you today so that you stay strong to enter and take possession of the land that you are crossing over to possess.

dag: Zɔŋ maa ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di daa mali dunɔdura pia din kpɛri di ni. Ka daantalisi daa be di yaɣa ayi zuɣu m-pahi pilanim zuɣu.
en: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.

dag: Di pala yinim bɛn ʒe ti sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni ŋɔ kɔŋko ka m po pɔri lɔri alikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You are not the only ones with whom the Lord is making this covenant with its obligations.

dag: ka bi lan tuɣi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la. Masia kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ mi zaa nyari dihili ka kpɛri n-saɣisiri tab ni di tuɣa mini di jila ni, ka zoori kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni di zoori shɛm.
en: and have stopped holding on to Christ, who is the head of the body. Under Christ's control the whole body is nourished and held together by its joints and ligaments, and it grows as God wants it to grow.

dag: Saɣimmiya yi ni yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa buɣa jɛmbu shee zaa, din be zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu ni ti maha gbina ni zaa.
en: You will take that land from the nations that live there now. You must completely destroy all the places where the people of these nations worship their gods. These places are on high mountains, on hills, and under green trees.

dag: Yɛm shɛli kani, tɛhi zilima shɛli kani, saawara shɛli mi kani din ni tooi nyaŋ Yawɛ.
en: There is no one wise enough to make a plan that can succeed if the Lord is against it.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛn mi, amaa ka zaɣisi ni bɛ saɣi ni tum dunia piligu ni ha, Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛtɔɣa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ. Kom ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam dunia tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka di yi kom ni na.
en: But they fail to notice that, by Gods word, heaven and earth were formed long ago out of water and by means of water.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi mɔɣu polo kanna ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o yura ŋɔ? Apil tia gbini ka n daa neeg a. Nimaani ka a ma daa be n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣ a; nimaani ka ŋun daa dɔɣ a daa be n-wolisira.
en: Who is this coming from the desert, arm in arm with her lover? Under the apple tree I woke you, in the place where you were born.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti zaŋ Dauda na, ka paɣ maa yɛli ba, O biɛrimi.
en: The next morning, Saul sent guards to arrest David. But Michal told them, David is sick.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd n-daa gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira n-lo o mihi kpɛhi duu ŋun Hɛrɔd tizo Filip paɣa Hɛrɔdias zuɣu.
en: Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison because of Herodias, the wife of Herods brother Philip.

dag: Ka o ni daa tum yiko mini kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa zaŋ tabil o ni daa duhi Mɔdɛkai n-zaŋ o zali zaashe tital ni la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Pɛriʒia mini Miidia nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Now some may want to know about all the kings mighty, great deeds. They may also want a full report about how important Mordecai became after the king honored him. Are they not written in the official records of the kings of Media and Persia?.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Joɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pihita pah o zuɣu.
en: from the clan of Gershon, Joel, in charge of ;.

dag: ka chɛ ka sokam baŋ Naawuni daashili nia shɛli o ni daa lo la ni yɛn pali shɛm. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binshɛɣukam zaa namda daa sɔɣ o daashili maa ʒiɛmana din gari la zaa puuni.
en: and of making all people see how God's secret plan is to be put into effect. God, who is the Creator of all things, kept his secret hidden through all the past ages.

dag: Ka o daa kuli n-daa ti chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti moli Yisa ni daa tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla zaa gili; ka di daa niŋ sokam zaa alahiziba.
en: The man went away and began to proclaim in the Ten Cities all that Jesus had done for him, and everyone was amazed.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni shɛb bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee tɔɣisiri ti yɛri ni di kpalim biɛla ka ti ku lan nya o; ka di ti tooi biɛla ka ti lan nya o yaha maa; ka lan yɛri ni dama o labirila o Ba sani.
en: Some of Jesus disciples said to each other, What does he mean: Soon you wont see me, and soon after that you will see me and Because Im going to the Father?.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela zuliya kam ni maani shɛb ansarisi; ka leei niriba ni lari shɛba.
en: You made us one of the stories that people love to tell. People all over the world laugh at us and shake their heads.

dag: Maliya biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi mali yolisim, amaa lee di zaŋya yi yolisim maa tumdi tuumbiɛri; kul maliyala biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi nyɛla Naawuni daba.
en: Do this as Gods slaves, and yet also as free people, not using your freedom as a cover-up for evil.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dama bɛ yɛri ya, Yi ŋubirila niriba, ka chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Because people say, You are a devourer of human beings and You are depriving your nation.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim karimbanim ni yino, ka ʒi dimbɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus answered, You are a teacher of Israel and you dont know these things?.

dag: Ka di daa bili n-leela yɔɣili din zɔra, amaa ka lee bi do tiŋa, ka ŋmaligi kpala o polo. Ka di nyaɣa kul kpalim ʒe di zaashee. Lala zuɣu di daa leela yɔɣili n-niŋ wula mini vari.
en: It grew and became a low-spreading vine. Its foliage turned toward him, and its roots developed under him. And so it became a vine, and it produced branches and sent out its shoots.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanu saha ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash bia Naa Jɛrɔbɔam daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihinahi ni yini.
en: Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel in the fifteenth year of Amaziah's rule in Judah. Jeroboam ruled years from Samaria.

dag: Ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ bom ŋariŋ zal o, salo maa ti muɣi m-miris o pam zuɣu;.
en: He even had to tell his disciples to get a boat ready to keep him from being crushed by the crowds.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛli Musa, Mani n-nyɛ Mani. Ka lan yɛli yaha, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Mani n-tim ma yi sanna. .
en: Then God said to Moses, Tell them, I AM WHO I AM. When you go to the Israelites, tell them, I AM sent me to you.

dag: nyama, n ni chɛ ka tinzunnim kana ti lir a. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri lu a yɛm din viɛl ŋɔ zuɣu, ka saɣim a jilima la.
en: I will bring strangers to fight against you. They are most terrible among the nations! They will pull out their swords and use them against the beautiful things your wisdom brought you. They will ruin your glory.

dag: Ka yɛla maa daa muɣisi man Daniɛl pam, ka dɔro gbaai ma ka n dɔni paai dabisa shɛm. Ka n daa ti yiɣisi n lan labi nti tumdi tuun shɛŋa naa ni daa zali ma ni n tumdi la, amaa ka ʒii maa yɛla daa gari ma ka m bi tooi baŋ li.
en: Then I, Daniel, was overwhelmed and felt sick for days. When I finally got up and went about the kings business, I remained troubled by the vision and couldnt understand it.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba maa nabi, ka a ti ba suhupiɛlli pam. Bɛ malila suhupiɛlli a sani kaman niriba ni kpuɣiri puu atam ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la bee kaman tɔbbihi ni yi pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: You have given them great joy, Lord; you have made them happy. They rejoice in what you have done, as people rejoice when they harvest grain or when they divide captured wealth.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba ni; ka chɛ ka a yurilim taɣi ba kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la.
en: You bless those who obey you, Lord ; your love protects them like a shield.

dag: O daa zaŋ zibisim din gil o leeg o sampaa, ka sagban tibisa leeg o kom dooshee.
en: He wrapped himself in darkness that covered him like a tent. He was hidden by dark clouds filled with water.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛli saha shɛli Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa ni dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa be o sulinsi ni ni o niriba ni daa tuhiri Jɛrusalɛmnim mini di fɔntinsi la m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word when Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, and all the countries and people he ruled, were attacking Jerusalem and all its towns.

dag: Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni ʒi shɛba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni mi shɛb viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti bemi kaman bɛn kpira, amaa nyamiya, ka lee nyɛ bɛn be. Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni darigi shɛb tiba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni bi ku shɛba.
en: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri tuma nyɛla zana gbahiri ba, ka bɛ daalahichi tuma gbahiri ba.
en: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.

dag: Ka Judanim maa zaa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naa ni nyɛ ti daŋ ni nir zuɣu. Ka wula ka yi suhuri yiɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu? Yi nya ka ti dila naa binshɛli? Bee o ti ti la pini.
en: All the people of Judah answered the Israelites, We did it because the king is our close relative. Why are you angry with us about this? We have not eaten food at the kings expense. The king did not give us any gifts.

dag: Di saha ka Amalɛknim mini Keenannim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi maa ni daa yina ti lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba n-kari ba hal ni Hɔrima.
en: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites, who lived in those mountains, descended, struck them down, and beat them all the way to Hormah.

dag: Dabisili maa ni ti bie pam! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la dali miriya. Di ni ti kana kaman zaɣ biɛɣu din yi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sanna.
en: The day of the Lord is near, the day when the Almighty brings destruction. What terror that day will bring!.

dag: Cheebu saha beni, ka shɛbu saha beni. Shinibu saha beni, ka tɔɣisibu saha beni.
en: There is a time to tear cloth and a time to sew it. There is a time to be silent and a time to speak.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, yin deem o binyɛrigu sɔŋ, deemiy o ni zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli maa, ka di leei saamba talima bini.
en: If someone promises to pay the debt of a stranger, get a coat or something from him to keep until the debt is paid.

dag: ni nabihi bɛn mali salima, ka zaŋ anzinfa pali bɛ yinsi la n-di vuhira.
en: Then I would be sleeping like princes who filled their houses with gold and silver.

dag: N yur a, n ni zaŋ a ŋmahindila Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi wɔridibiga.
en: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.

dag: Ti ni tɔɣisiri zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ daliri nyɛla ni di kpaŋsi yurilim din yiri suhu din ka daɣiri mini suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi ni yɛda niŋbu maŋli ni na.
en: The goal of instruction is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and a sincere faith.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb sani maa, luɣ shɛlikam zaa bɛ ni daa be, bɛ daa saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛri ba, Yawɛ niriba m-bɔŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ yi o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But then when they entered the other nations, they degraded my holy name because it was said of them, These are the LORDs people, yet they had to leave his land.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: He sinned against the Lord , for until the day of his death he followed the wicked example of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.

dag: Nandahima zuɣu chɛ ka n tarigimi; nintam kul mahigirila m bindoo yuŋ kam; ka n nintam maa chɛ ka n difiɛli kul mahigi gbati.
en: I am worn out with grief; every night my bed is damp from my weeping; my pillow is soaked with tears.

dag: Nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuntialana, ka mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni ŋɔ, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri zan tariga, ka niŋ wuntizɔriba zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Please let the evil of the wicked be over, but set the righteous firmly in place because you, the righteous God, are the one who examines hearts and minds.

dag: A dabili Jɔab bɔrimi ni o mali yɛla zali dɛde, dina n-chɛ ka o niŋ lala maa. Amaa n dan mali yɛm kaman Naawuni malaika ni mali yɛm shɛm la din ni tooi baŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But he did it in order to straighten out this whole matter. Your Majesty is as wise as the angel of God and knows everything that happens.

dag: Saimɔn Pita ni daa nya lala maa, ka o damdi Yisa tooni yɛr o, N Duuma, m bi simdi ni m mir a, dama n nyɛla alahichilana.
en: When Simon Peter saw this happen, he knelt down in front of Jesus and said, Lord, don't come near me! I am a sinner.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli.
en: The commander gave him permission, so Paul stood on the steps and motioned with his hand for the people to be silent. When they were quiet, Paul spoke to them in Hebrew:.

dag: ka o tiligi ti, ka di daa pala ti ni tum wuntia tuun shɛŋa zuɣu, amaa o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu ka o paɣ ti ka ti yi, ka ti ti nyɛvil palli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka ti nya biɛr palli saha shɛl la.
en: he saved us because of his mercy, not because of righteous things we had done. He did it through the washing of new birth and the renewing by the Holy Spirit.

dag: Naawuni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli ni bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ. Di daa pala o ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa lo o alikauli maa, amaa o ni daa niŋ yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la zuɣu.
en: The promise to Abraham and to his descendants, that he would inherit the world, didnt come through the Law but through the righteousness that comes from faith.

dag: Man Pool ŋun zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba puhiri ya.
en: With my own hand I write this: Greetings from Paul .

dag: N yura ŋmanila tipum din yirigi Ɛngɛdi wain tihi puu ni.
en: A cluster of henna flowers is my love to me in the desert gardens of En-gedi.

dag: Kum maa daa miiya pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The famine was very bad in that country.

dag: Ti Duuma kpalim ŋmanila ti dima. O wurim Izraɛl; O wurim di nanim yiya la zaa, ka wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. O chɛ ka Juda bipuɣiŋga fabila min o kuhigu maan pahi.
en: My Lord has become like an enemy. He devoured Israel; he devoured all her palaces; he made ruins of her city walls. In Daughter Judah he multiplied mourning along with more mourning!.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Magdol mini Tapanhɛs ni Mɛmfisi zaŋ tabili Patrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Jeremiah received a message from the Lord for all the people of Judah living in Egypt. The message was for the people of Judah living in the towns of Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis, and southern Egypt. This was the message:.

dag: Dama ti kul nyɛla sɔhila niriba, ka bi mi shɛli; ti biɛhigu dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila mahim din vuura.
en: Our life is short, we know nothing at all; we pass like shadows across the earth.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Jarɛd.
en: When Mahalalel was , he had a son, Jared.

dag: Ka buŋ maa nya ma, ka birigi siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa. O yi di bi birigi, yɛlimaŋli, ŋ-ŋɔ n di pun ku a, ka chɛ o.
en: If your donkey had not seen me and stopped those three times, I would have killed you and let the donkey live.

dag: Bɛna n-daa kana ti zani Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba ni salo zaa tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni yɛli.
en: These five women went to the Meeting Tent and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders, and all the Israelites. The five daughters said.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya maa yiɣisi yomyom kab ti kpe Gibia puuni n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be tiŋ maa ni.
en: Indeed, those in the ambush had dashed swiftly into Gibeah and killed all the people in the city with their swords.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu. Ti ni daa be yi san la ti daa pala gbinnyaɣinima.
en: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Anab Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ zuliya shɛb polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord spoke to me about the nations.

dag: Judanim mi Naawuni, o yuli tibisi pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: People in Judah know God. People in Israel respect his name.

dag: Naawuni, a ni daa be a niriba tooni m-mali ba chani la, a ni daa kpe mɔɣu ni gari la.
en: O God, when you led your people, when you marched across the desert.

dag: Daadam, malimi soya ayi ka di zaa yi tiŋgbɔn yin ni na, ka Babilɔn naa dol li kana. Sabimi pa dapaɣa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sa sochira zuɣu wuhi so shɛli din kpɛri tiŋ puuni.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, mark two roads for the king of Babylonia to follow when he comes with his sword. The roads will begin at the same place, but be sure to put up a signpost where the two roads separate and go in different directions.

dag: Ŋun maŋmaŋa n-lan nyɛ sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi, ka o pala ti kɔŋko daalahichi sara maligu, amaa o nyɛla dunianim zaa daalahichi sara maligu.
en: And Christ himself is the means by which our sins are forgiven, and not our sins only, but also the sins of everyone.

dag: N Naawuni, n Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ ma bahi? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a be katiŋ ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu n ŋuhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha.
en: My God, my God, why have you abandoned me? I have cried desperately for help, but still it does not come.

dag: Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa ni daa tuui ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisi, kaman nakpaa pirigili palo puuni.
en: In the first attack, Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed about twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

dag: hal ka n ti chɛ ka a dimnim leeg a napɔntamdigu.
en: until I put your enemies under your power. Psalm :.

dag: Yɛndan ni tɔɣisir yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa balimbalim wumbu so naa ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n-tahiri jɛra sani.
en: The calm words of the wise are better heeded than the racket caused by a ruler among fools.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa lan tɛhimi ni nyin naa yɛligu nyɛla din ni ti ma vuhim, dama nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika ŋun mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni be a sani.
en: Your servant thought, The word of my master the king will definitely comfort me, because my master the king is like one of Gods messengers, understanding good and evil. May the LORD your God be with you.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi nimaani gariti tooni, ka dɔbba ayi bɛn nyɛ zoomba dol o n-kuhiri pampam yɛra, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: As Jesus departed, two blind men followed him, crying out, Show us mercy, Son of David.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ba. Ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu;.
en: Some people brought their children to Jesus, so he could place his hands on them and pray for them. His disciples told the people to stop bothering him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a ni lihi ʒiɛm ma ka kpuɣi Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la paɣa maa zuɣu, ninvuɣ kubo kul ku milig a yili ŋɔ.
en: Because of that, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite as your own, the sword will never leave your own house.

dag: ka yɛli, Aai, ti ni ba yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zo n-tiligi, dindina zomiya tiligi. Yi tɛhiya ni yi yuri zɔri pam, amaa bɛn kariti doli ya maa yuri zɔri gari yi yuri.
en: said, No! We will safely escape on speedy horses. But those who chase you will be even faster.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana, ka bɛ daa yi yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama ni bɛ yiɣi tiŋgban ni du zuɣusaa, kalima din be bɛ luɣili zuɣu maa daa bi ŋmaligira.
en: and moved, the wheels went with them. Whenever they spread their wings to fly, the wheels still went with them.

dag: Ka dɔr biɛɣu yi mali ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun yɛm binchɛra, ka chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim, ka o pɔb o zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili ka kuhiri yɛra, Daɣiri! Daɣiri.
en: If you have a dreaded skin disease, you must wear torn clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and call out, Unclean, unclean.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wumdi ya anabi shɛb bɛn be yi sani ŋɔ yɛligu. Bɛ ŋmari ya la ʒiri; bɛ suhuyubu yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri maa. Di pala Yawɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: The LORD proclaims: Dont listen to the prophets who are speaking to you; they are deceiving you. Their visions come from their own hearts, not from the LORDs mouth.

dag: O teeg o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla Izraɛlnim sani. Dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa nim nya ti Naawuni nasara dibu maa.
en: God has remembered his loyal love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; every corner of the earth has seen our Gods salvation.

dag: Dama Masia daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu yim, ka di yɛla naai zaa. Ŋuna ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra daa kpi bɛn pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ti tahi Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa kula o niŋgbuŋ, amaa ka Naawuni Shia daa lee neeg o n-chɛ ka o mali nyɛvili.
en: Christ himself suffered on account of sins, once for all, the righteous one on behalf of the unrighteous. He did this in order to bring you into the presence of God. Christ was put to death as a human, but made alive by the Spirit.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋ nuu n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n dalindi n gbaŋ kam. N ni sabiri shɛm m-bala.
en: With my own hand I write this: Greetings from Paul . This is the way I sign every letter; this is how I write.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa yuya m-bala. Ka Musa daa taɣi Nan bia Hɔshia yuli Jɔshua.
en: These are the names of the men Moses sent to look at and study the land.

dag: Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma yomyom! Leemi n ni sɔɣiri tampin shɛli gbini mini birini shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ din ni tiligi ma.
en: Listen to me. Come quickly and save me. Be my Rock, my place of safety. Be my fortress and protect me!.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: You people who hear me, listen.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam mini zugbini kpam ni biŋkpam din zaa be namanama ni ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina ayi mini di biŋkpam ni nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili.
en: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat covering the internal organs, the best part of the liver, the kidneys with the fat on them, and the right hind leg.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla a dahalali niriba, ka nyɛ a ni daa teeg a bɔɣu ni yiko din galisi yihi shɛb na. .
en: But these are your people! Your own possession! The people you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm!.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka gbilisir o tibili wumdi bɛ kuhigu.
en: If you obey the Lord , he will watch over you and answer your prayers.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa ŋmaligi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Then the disciples went back home.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ko bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni biri n-daa ti kpuɣi di daatam ka di gari o ni daa zaŋ shɛm biri maa ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Isaac sowed crops in that land, and that year he harvested a hundred times as much as he had sown, because the Lord blessed him.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti kpe duu maa ni na, ka neesim neei duu maa puuni zaa; ka malaika maa daa chaŋ ti kpahi Pita luɣili n-neeg o yɛli, Yiɣisim yomyom! Ka zoligɔnim din daa lo o nuhi la surigi lu tiŋa.
en: Suddenly an angel of the Lord was standing there, and the room was filled with light. The angel tapped Peter on the side and woke him up. The angel said, Hurry, get up! The chains fell off Peters hands.

dag: Di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o nuhi pa nahu maa zuɣu ni ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini.
en: You must put your hand on the animals head and kill the animal at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. Then Aarons sons, the priests, will splash the blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Zomiya dinkam nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and avoid every kind of evil.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa yiɣisi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka yumaha gbaai Ayuba, o zuɣutaliga ni zaŋ hal ni o naba puuni.
en: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.

dag: A daa bi kpaai ma mi bahi kaman bihim la, ka kahim ma kaman waagasi la?.
en: You poured me out like milk. You spun me around and squeezed me like someone making cheese.

dag: Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa yi Mizipa kana ni o ti tuhi ba soli ka kumda. O ni daa tuhi ba soli maa ka o yɛli ba, Kamiya Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sanna.
en: Ishmael went out the town gate to meet them. He pretended to be weeping, and he asked them to come into Mizpah to meet with Gedaliah, the ruler of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ guli bɛn nyɛ tarimba. N daa be muɣisigu ni, ka o tiligi ma.
en: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni niŋ buɣim dabi yi yɔɣu maa, ka buɣim maa di binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: You will get the punishment you deserve. I will start a fire in your forests that will completely burn everything around you. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Di zaŋ a ŋmani nyɛvili niŋ mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛr la nuu ni; di tam a tarimba nyɛviya yɛla sahakam!.
en: Dont deliver the life of your dove to wild animals! Dont forget the lives of your afflicted people forever!.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o ŋmaligi yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth. So Jesus said to the man, Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Mɛrari daŋ niriba shɛb Musa mini Aduna ni daa kali kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: So these men from the Merari family group were given their special work. Moses and Aaron did this the way the Lord told Moses to do.

dag: Ka Yisa lih o yurilim lihigu ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a: Cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: Jesus looked straight at him with love and said, You need only one thing. Go and sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven; then come and follow me.

dag: O mali yɛm o suhu ni, ka o kpiɔŋ galisi; ŋuni n-na mi m-mo o ka di nasara?.
en: God is so wise and powerful; no one can stand up against him.

dag: Bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yo Yawɛ o ni niŋ ma nirilim shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu?.
en: What can I give the Lord for all that he has done for me?.

dag: Bihi kabirila dari, ka dɔbba maani buɣim, ka paɣiba mi ŋɔriti zim ni bɛ mali maha ti wuni so bɛ ni booni Zuɣusaa Paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa la, ka boori binnyura tiri wun shɛŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: The children gather firewood, the men build fires, and the women mix dough to bake cakes for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They also pour out offerings of wine to other gods, in order to hurt me.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, yi nyɛla wuna, yi zaa nyɛla Zallakudura Naa bihi.
en: I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛli.
en: Job began speaking again.

dag: Yi chaŋ gili zoya ni tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka di yuui, kpamiya yi nuzaa polo.
en: Youve been traveling around this mountain long enough. Head north.

dag: mini Pateesa shɛŋa din yili dundɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ ni dunol ni n-liri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili mini sara maligu bimbin la ni di mihi zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: the curtains of the courtyard, the screen for the entrance of the courtyard surrounding the meeting tent and the altar, and its cords—all these structures.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti niŋ lala, dama ti ni yɛn mali sara shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa nyɛla din chihiri Ijiptinim sani. Ka ti yi mali sara shɛli din chihiri bɛ sani bɛ ninni, bɛ ni lab ti kuɣa ku ti.
en: Moses replied, It wouldnt be right to do that, because the sacrifices that we offer to the LORD our God will offend Egyptians. If we openly offer sacrifices that offend Egyptians, wont they stone us to death?.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, Di deei bɛ sara maligu. N na ʒi n-deei bɛ so buŋa, m mi na ʒi n-niŋ bɛ ni so zaɣ biɛ shɛli.
en: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord , Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nti yɛn kari dunia ŋɔ nim saria? Ka yinima n-yi nyɛ bɛn ni ti kari dunianim saria, dindina yi ku tooi kari yimaŋmaŋ sunsuuni yɛtɔɣ bihi saria?.
en: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka nyɛ duŋtaariba, bɛ lɛbi bɛ nini biri ma, ka zo ka chɛ ma.
en: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.

dag: Adɔnija mini saamba bɛn zaa daa be o sani ni daa ti di bɛ bindira naari saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa wum vuri maa. Jɔab ni daa wum kikaa kumsi saha shɛli ka o bɔhi, Ka vu bɔ ka bɛ lee yɔri tiŋ puuni ŋɔ.
en: As Adonijah and all his guests were finishing the feast, they heard the noise. And when Joab heard the trumpet, he asked, What's the meaning of all that noise in the city.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka mɔɣu ni buŋ gɔr o yubu? Ka ŋuni n-lee gaai mɔɣu ni bun so ŋun zɔri pam naba ni tanachi?.
en: Who let the wild donkeys go free? Who untied their ropes and let them loose?.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa bɔhi Ilaija, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ nyini ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti teei ma n daalahichi yɛla ka chɛ ka m bidibiga ŋɔ kpi.
en: Then the woman said to Elijah, You are a man of God. Can you help me? Or did you come here only to remind me of my sins and to make my son die.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa, ka gba bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi; ka ŋun pah ata gba lala;.
en: The second married her and died without leaving any children. The third did the same.

dag: O bia Shɛmaya gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim pam.
en: To his son Shemaiah were born sons who ruled over their household, because they were valiant men.

dag: Ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba, ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri ye n-chaŋ Amɔz bia anab Aizaia sani.
en: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and the senior priests to the prophet Isaiah, Amozs son. They were all wearing mourning clothes.

dag: Ka suli daa ku bɛnkam zaa be jɛmbu duu maa ni n-wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: When they heard this, everyone in the synagogue was filled with anger.

dag: Dama ti mi ŋun yɛli, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi la. O lan yɛli, Yi Duuma ni kar o niriba saria.
en: For we know who said, I will take revenge, I will repay; and who also said, The Lord will judge his people.

dag: Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya ni nir la n-daa deei Arigɔb yaɣili din daa be Bashan maa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga, ka daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli boli Bashan, dina n-nyɛ Havɔtijairi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Jair, from the tribe of Manasseh, took possession of the entire Argob region, as far as the border with the Geshurites and the Maacathites. He named the Bashan area after himself, Jairs Settlement. Thats what its still called today.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, A ku lan yiɣis a ni do bindo shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, a ni kpi. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ.
en: Since you did this, the Lord says, You will not get up from your bed. You will die! Then Elijah left.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka doo maa ti zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ yi mabi ŋun la mini Bɛnjamin n-tin ya ka yi labina. Ka n yi ni kɔŋ m bihi maa, n kul ni kɔŋ ba mi.
en: I pray that God All-Powerful will help you when you stand before the governor. I pray that he will let Benjamin, and also Simeon, come back safely. If not, I will again be sad from losing my children.

dag: Di saha ka o daa mali chɛchɛbunsi shili, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: The king got his war chariot and his army ready.

dag: N yi paɣi Naawuni n ni yɛn di bindir shɛli zuɣu, di chaŋ wula ka so ni galim ma n ni paɣi Naawuni bindir shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If I participate with gratitude, why should I be blamed for food I thank God for?.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa lo naa alikauli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni. Ka Jɛhɔiada daa yɛli ba, N-nyɛ nabia maa, chɛliya ka o di nam kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda zuliya polo la.
en: All the people meeting together made an agreement with the king in Gods Temple. Jehoiada said to the people, The kings son will rule. That is what the Lord promised about Davids descendants.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ kpi. Zaŋm ba zaɣ nɛma nti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama zaɣ biɛɣu m-be bɛ yinsi puuni mini bɛ suhuri ni.
en: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka pii ya leeg o niriba;.
en: Brothers and sisters, God loves you. And we know that he has chosen you to be his people.

dag: N yi ti niŋ buɣim dabi Ijipti, ka bɛnkam sɔŋdi ba maa lu, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I set fire to Egypt and all her defenders are killed, then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Sairus daa ti zali zaligu o nam dibu yuun yini saha ni bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali.
en: However, in the first year of his rule, Babylons King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

dag: A daa zaŋ a shia suŋ ti ba ka o wuhi ba baŋsim, a daa bi mɔŋ ba manna, ka daa ti ba kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: You gave them your good Spirit to make them wise. You gave them manna for food. You gave them water for their thirst.

dag: Ka a lihi bɛ ni m-piig a nin ni tiɣi paɣisar so n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee. Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa tiɣi naa nini ka o shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then let the one who is pleasing to the king become the new queen in Vashtis place. The king liked this suggestion, so he accepted it.

dag: Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm; ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛli, dama ti bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.

dag: Deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani.
en: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so di yɛla.
en: Jesus told the followers, Dont tell anyone who I am.

dag: Dama o daa dolila Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam soli, ka tumdi alahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la.
en: He walked in all the ways and sins of Jeroboam, Nebats son, because he caused Israel to sin. They angered Israels God, the LORD, with their worthless idols.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba ni dinzuɣu bɛ chɛ ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ zuɣuri dol o chaŋ ti wuhi doo maa taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Some of your leaders can come down with me, he said. If hes done anything wrong, they can bring charges against him.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ŋma n-chihi ŋarin bil maa bahi kom maa ni ka di chaŋ.
en: So the soldiers cut the ropes that held the boat and let it go.

dag: Ka n daa pii yi bi shɛba n-leeg anabinima, ka pii yi nachimba shɛba n-leei Nazarinima. Izraɛlnima, bee pa lala n-nyɛ li? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka gɔhi mini tutu shɛŋa din mali gɔhi ni bili tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; ka a ni diri tiŋgban ni tihi wala.
en: Your food will be plants, but the ground will produce thorns and thistles.

dag: Dama di yi pa o zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya n-di bee n-di o tuma nyaɣisim?.
en: Who can eat and find enjoyment otherwise?.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ka Filip so ŋun daa yi Bɛtisaida Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti bɔri ni ti nyala Yisa.
en: They went to Philip and said, Sir, we want to see Jesus.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba salo maa ni ka sokam wum.
en: As all the people listened to him, Jesus said to his disciples.

dag: O ni daa kari ninsal yihi Idɛn puu maa ni maa, o daa zaŋla chɛrubinim mini takɔbi din nyɛ buɣim niɛm ka ŋmaligiri luɣilikam zali Idɛn puu maa wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ gu so shɛli din chani ti shɛli din tiri nyɛvil maa gbini.
en: Then God put winged creatures at the entrance to the garden and a flaming, flashing sword to guard the way to the life-giving tree.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ ba Riuɛl bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ti daŋ kundina lala.
en: When they went back home to their father Reuel, he asked, How were you able to come back home so soon today.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia daa talimla Nɛria bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Masɛya yaaŋa la ni o zaŋ lahibal shɛli chaŋ Babilɔn saha shɛl o ni daa doli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn o nam dibu yuma anahi ni la. Sɛraya daa nyɛla naa zo.
en: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔbbihi la, ka mali suhupiɛlli kaman wain nyuriba la. Bɛ bihi ni ti teei bɛ nasara dibu maa yɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord .

dag: Bɛ laakuma mini bɛ niɣi ni ti leei yi ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba. N ni ti wurim buɣijɛmdiba bɛn pindi zuɣukpina ŋɔ kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛɣu yi luɣilikam na ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Their camels will become plunder; their many cattle will be pillaged. I will scatter to the winds those who are clean-shaven, and I will bring disaster on them from every side, declares the LORD.

dag: Yi ni ti lan niŋ lala goli maa daba ayopɔin dali n-ti ŋunkam tum alahichi o chirimbu puuni bee o ʒilinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka yi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: You will do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins through inadvertence or ignorance. So you will purge the temple.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛlimi, To! Yawɛ shiri niŋmi lala. Yawɛ chɛ ka a ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ niŋ pali, ka o zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la shɛŋa mini ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛ ni daa gbahi n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn la labisi kpe na.
en: The prophet Jeremiah said: Indeed. May the LORD do just as you have said! May the LORD fulfill the words that you have prophesied and bring back from Babylon the equipment of the LORDs temple and all the exiles to this place.

dag: O ni daa ti yiɣisi o Naawuni suhibu maa shee o daa labila o nyaandoliba maa sani nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi, suhugarigu ni daa mali ba zuɣu.
en: When he finished praying, he went to his followers. He found them asleep, worn out from their grieving.

dag: yi ni zaŋdi nyɛvili yɛligu tiri ba la puuni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n-ti mali daliri din ni nyu bara Masia labbuna dabisili la dali, ka di wuhi ni n kpaŋmaŋtali mini n tuma bi kpalim yoli.
en: because you hold on to the word of life. This will allow me to say on the day of Christ that I havent run for nothing or worked for nothing.

dag: Babilɔn naa wum bɛ yɛla, ka o bɔɣiri ni cheei kom. Ka biɛrim gbaag o; biɛrim shɛli din be kaman paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: The king of Babylon has heard reports of them and is panic-stricken; distress overwhelms him, pain like that of a woman in labor.

dag: Lɛvi do so daa ti kpuɣi Lɛvi zuliya ni paɣa.
en: A man from the Levi tribe married a woman from the same tribe.

dag: Zuliya ayi ni pirigili maa daa pun deei bɛ tarili ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo.
en: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.

dag: ni bɛ zaa leei zaɣ yini kaman nyini m Ba ni be n ni ka n gba be a ni shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka bɛ gba be ti ni, ka dunianim niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I pray that they may all be one. Father! May they be in us, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they be one, so that the world will believe that you sent me.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Saha kanna, n ni niŋ li. N ku chɛ li niŋbu, n ku tilig a, n suhu ku maai. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma min a biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the LORD, have spoken! Its coming, and Ill do it. I wont relent or have any pity or compassion. Your punishments will fit your ways and your deeds! This is what the LORD God says.

dag: A daa pala shɛli ka n duh a ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka a mi ti dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli n-chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa tum alahichi, ka bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: I made you an important prince over my people Israel. But you have done the same things Jeroboam did. You have caused my people Israel to sin. Their sins have made me angry.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri gba daa zo ka chɛ niriba pam ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia! Alizin biɛri maa daa mi ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia, dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa tahiri bɛ zuɣu ka bi tiri ba soli ni bɛ yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: Demons came out of many people. The demons shouted, You are the Son of God. But Jesus gave a strong command for the demons not to speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.

dag: Dama saa ŋmaaya, ka kikaa gba gari.
en: Look, winter is past, the rains have come and gone.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ daa zali Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu saha shɛl o ni daa zali Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ sara maligunim na ti ti ŋun Yawɛ Sinai mɔɣu ni la.
en: which the LORD commanded Moses at Mount Sinai on the day when he ordered the Israelites to present their offerings to the LORD, in the Sinai desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin suhimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni, chɛ ka a yuli du;.
en: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ mi niŋmi ni di chɛ ka di ni sab shɛm bɛ zaligu ni ni bɛ kul je ma la yol la niŋ pali.
en: But this happened to make clear the full meaning of what is written in their law: They hated me for no reason.

dag: Ka n yi tumdila mmaŋmaŋ ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina n saɣiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tuhiya.
en: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.

dag: Amaa o daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali hal ka o ti dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga; ka Yisifu daa bol o yuli Yisa.
en: But he didnt have sexual relations with her until she gave birth to a son. Joseph called him Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N di pun bi yɛl a ni a yi niŋ yɛda a ni nya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus said to her, Didn't I tell you that you would see God's glory if you believed.

dag: ni Jɛrusalɛm naa ni Hiburɔn naa.
en: Jerusalem, Hebron.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tooi daaŋa ni tampiligim chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni, ka Musa daa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei bintɔra din puhigiri niŋdi yuma, ka di daa tɔri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: So Moses and Aaron took ashes from a furnace and went and stood before Pharaoh. Moses threw the ashes into the air, and sores began breaking out on people and animals.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ ba ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ di ba fali yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka bɛ leei bɛ ni su shɛba sahakam. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bɛna n-leei yi daba, amaa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛna, di zaŋya ninkuunsi su taba.
en: You can pass them on to your children as inheritance that they can own as permanent property. You can make these people work as slaves, but you must not rule harshly over your own people, the Israelites.

dag: Ti ni lan zaŋdi ti bidib kpamba mini ti niɣi ni ti biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ lo shɛba n-tahiri ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu na nti tiri maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm zaligu ni.
en: Just as it is also written in the law, this is what we will do: We will bring our firstborn sons and our firstborn cattle, sheep, and goats. We will bring these to the Temple of our God, to the priests who are serving there.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka mɔɣu ni damda. Yawɛ chɛ ka Kadɛshi mɔɣu ni dam.
en: The Lord s voice shakes the desert. The desert of Kadesh trembles at the Lord s voice.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ni bɛ mali baŋsim maa birigiya ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!.

dag: Amaa azichi ŋɔ m-be tinim bɛn ŋmani yaɣiri duɣiri ŋɔ ni ni di wuhi ni di yiko din galisi nyɛla Naawuni dini, ka pa ni ti dini.
en: But we have this treasure in clay pots so that the awesome power belongs to God and doesnt come from us.

dag: Amaa goli biɛɣ pinaanu dali ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Susa puuni maa bɛn daa zaŋ leei bɛ Vuhim Dabisili. Bɛ ni daa na kul be bɛ dimnim maa kubu ni biɛɣ pinaata mini biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, ka daa ti chɛ ba kubu la biɛɣ pinaanu dal la zuɣu.
en: The Jews in Susa had met together on the th and th days of the month of Adar. And then on the th day they rested. So they made the th day a happy day of feasting.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka dabiɛm mali ba ka di gari ba pahi, ka bɛ daa ŋmanila tuturi mini mɔri ni mɔ shɛŋa din sa mɔpila zuɣu, ka mɔri dɔro gbaai li ka di kɔŋ zoobu.
en: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or tender young grass growing on a flat roof, scorched before it matures.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi tuumbiɛri mini din chihiri shɛŋa ninvuɣ biɛri ni tumda, bɛ ni be? N ku lan teei bɛ ni daa tum wuntitali tuun shɛŋa maa yɛla. Dama bɛ bilikɔnsi taali mini bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu bɛ ni kpi.
en: But when good people start sinning and doing disgusting things, will they live? No! All their good deeds will be forgotten, and they will be put to death because of their sins.

dag: Yi bi niŋ tuuba bee n-lu ma sizuura hal ni zuŋɔ, yi mi bi doli n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim la.
en: Even to this day the people of Judah have not made themselves humble. They have not shown any respect for me, and they have not followed my teachings. They have not obeyed the laws I gave you and your ancestors.

dag: Amaa bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka di ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: And others are like the seed planted on the good ground. They hear the teaching and accept it. Then they grow and produce a good crop—sometimes times more, sometimes times more, and sometimes times more.

dag: Ti mi ni o yila Juda zuliya ni na, ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda zuliya polo, Anabi Musa daa bi kali ba pahi maligumaaniba ni.
en: It is well known that he was born a member of the tribe of Judah; and Moses did not mention this tribe when he spoke of priests.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛra daa ti tum birigi bɛ dan Ijipti naa maa.
en: Later, two of Pharaohs servants did something wrong to Pharaoh. These servants were the baker and the man who served wine to Pharaoh.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ daa pun niŋ anabinim bɛn daŋ yi tooni la gba alaka.
en: Be happy and excited! You will have a great reward in heaven. People did these same things to the prophets who lived long ago.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni paɣi ma. Hal yɔbahi mini taatahi gba ni paɣi ma, dama n ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni n-ti n ni pii ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: The beasts of the field, the jackals and ostriches, will honor me, because I have put water in the desert and streams in the wilderness to give water to my people, my chosen ones.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda.
en: While he was saying these things, many people believed in him.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Duuma; n ka bin sun shɛli pahila nyini.
en: Some of you have said to the Lord , You are my Lord. Every good thing I have comes from you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sandaantimdiba mal alibarika, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti boli ba o bihi.
en: Great blessings belong to those who work to bring peace. God will call them his sons and daughters.

dag: ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: but he warned them not to tell others who he was.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni ti zaŋ ba zali luɣ shɛli din sarigiri shee n-chɛ ka bɛ sarigi lu m-bahi yoli.
en: Clearly, you have put them in danger. You make it easy for them to fall and be destroyed.

dag: ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋɔri maha shɛŋa din ka dabindi ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka bɛ niŋ kpam pa di zuɣu. Zaŋmi alikama zim viɛlli mali di zaa.
en: Take unleavened bread, unleavened flatbread made with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil. Make them out of high-quality wheat flour.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe bɛ daazichi ka bɛ yiya wurim. Hal bɛ ni mɛri yiya ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku kpe di ni. Hal bɛ ni sari wain tihi ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku nyu di wain.
en: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards.

dag: Ka zoya tiŋgban la ni kul nyɛ nyɔŋ la zaa yoli, yi ni tooi ŋma n-neei li ka di leei yi dini di piligu shee zaŋ ti kpa di tariga. Ka Keenannim maa ni kul mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi ka mali kpiɔŋ la zaa yoli, yi ni tooi kari ba.
en: The highland will belong to you. Because it is a forest, you can clear it. Its farthest limits will be yours. You will definitely remove the Canaanites, even though they have iron chariots and are strong.

dag: N ni tim malaika na ka o ti be yi tooni n-guli ya yi chandi maa ni hal ti zaŋ ya paai n ni mali luɣ shɛli zali ya la ni.
en: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri piɛri kɔbiri mini gumdi shee, ka zaŋ o nuhi tumdi tuma ni o suhu zaa.
en: She keeps herself busy making wool and linen cloth.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔnyuri ni ti wum gbarigi nachimbihi kpɛma mini paɣisaribihi kpɛma, ka bɛ tarigi.
en: On that day the beautiful young women and the young men will faint with thirst.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni, ka tɛhiya din yɛn niŋ ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani yɛla nya. Yi ni daa na bi piligi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mɛbu tuma.
en: The Lord says, Can't you see what has happened to you? Before you started to rebuild the Temple.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni ninsalinim ni doli so shɛŋa maa, bɛ bi yurimi. Bɛ ni nyɛ daadamnim bɛn mali bahigu zuɣu bɛ ku tooi be viɛnyɛla.
en: Lord , I know that none of us are in charge of our own destiny; none of us have control over our own life.

dag: ka din pahi pisiniyini gbaai Jachin, ka din pahi pisinaayi gbaai Gamul.
en: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ni bari ma zana shɛl la ni; dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Keep me safe from the trap that has been set for me; shelter me from danger.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa lu Jɔash suhu ni ni o lan malimali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: Sometime later, Jehoash wanted to renovate the LORDs temple.

dag: Nyama, a du m-bala Ijiptinima bɛ mi nyɛla kaɣili jaaŋgbe kabili din ni kuhi ŋun dihiri li nuu. Lala ka Ijipti naa Firawuna be zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn du m-ba o polo. .
en: It appears that you are trusting in a staff—Egypt—thats nothing but a broken reed! It will stab the hand of anyone who leans on it! Thats all that Pharaoh, Egypts king, is to anyone who trusts in him.

dag: O bi galisi gari ma yili ŋɔ puuni, o mi bi mɔŋ ma shɛli naɣila nyini, dama a nyɛla o paɣa; ka wula ka n ni tooi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuun titali ŋɔ n-tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani.
en: No one is greater than I am in this household, and he hasnt denied me anything except you, since you are his wife. How could I do this terrible thing and sin against God.

dag: Yi Duuma lan yɛli yaha, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnima dabisi shɛŋa din kanna ni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ tɛha ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni; ka n ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi ti nyɛ n niriba.
en: Now, this is the covenant that I will make with the people of Israel in the days to come, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa be teeku duli, timiya Yawɛ jilima, ka paɣ o.
en: Let them announce his praises everywhere.

dag: Bɛ wuhibu ŋmanila yumaha din diri ninsal niŋgbuŋ la. Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Filɛtus.
en: Such teaching is like an open sore that eats away the flesh. Two men who have taught such things are Hymenaeus and Philetus.

dag: Ka wula ka n lan yɛn yɛli pahi? N lan ka dahima ni n yɛli Gidiɔn mini Barak ni Samsin ni Jɛfita ni Naa Dauda ni Samuɛl ni anabinim bɛn pahi la yɛla.
en: Do I need to give you more examples? I dont have enough time to tell you about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ ti.
en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

dag: Bɛ daa kul sɔŋ la kuɣa maa dolisi dundɔŋ maa n-zaŋ hal ti paai dunɔdaya maa wɔɣilim tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛ ni sɔŋ kuɣ shɛŋa tiŋli.
en: This was known as the lower sidewalk, and it was meters wide.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi daa ŋmanila biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bear la, ka o yiɣisi n-gbiligi ʒiɛya; ka sapir kɔba ata gbab o noli. Ka kuko shɛli daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim ŋubi nimdi pam.
en: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba maa yi nyɛla pihinahinaanu, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa niriba anu maa ni pooi maa zuɣu? Ka o yɛli, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinahinaanu tiŋ maa ni, n ku saɣim li.
en: what if there are five fewer innocent people than fifty? Will you destroy the whole city over just five? The LORD said, If I find forty-five there, I wont destroy it.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa daa zabir o nyuli di zuɣu, amaa ka o ba daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: Joseph's brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept thinking about the whole matter.

dag: Luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim biŋkɔbiri la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti taali sanyoo biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini luɣilikam.
en: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yiɣisi kpe duu, ka anab bil maa ti booi kpam maa bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa;.
en: So Jehu got up and went inside. The prophet poured olive oil on Jehu's head and told him: The Lord God of Israel has this message for you: I am the Lord , and I have chosen you to be king of my people Israel.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Doliya Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu, ka miriya ka yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma soli.
en: So I tell you, live the way the Spirit leads you. Then you will not do the evil things your sinful self wants.

dag: Amaa saŋkpambil maa yi kul kpalim bela luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi, di nyɛla bintɔrili maa wuliɛɣu m-bala, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
