en: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, You are now clean.

dag: Ka Pirɔs bia Sɔpata ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛria tiŋbia la mini Aristakus ni Sɛkundus bɛn daa nyɛ Tɛsalɔnaika tiŋbihi la ni Gaiɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Dɛɛbi tiŋbia la ni Timoti m-pahi Tikikus mini Trɔfimus bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la daa dol o chaŋ.
en: He was accompanied by Sopater, Pyrrhus son from Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.

dag: ka naanyi di bindirigu n-lan nya kpiɔŋ. Ka Sool daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Damaskus sani n-niŋ daba ayi;.
en: After he ate, he began to feel strong again. Saul stayed with the followers of Jesus in Damascus for a few days.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Kurimbuni ha bɛ daa yi yɛrila niriba, Chamiya Ɛbɛl n-ti bɔhi ka bɛ wuhi ya. Lala ka bɛ daa yi niŋdi maani yɛla.
en: Then the woman said, In the past people would say, Ask for help in Abel and you will get what you need.

dag: Ka nabihi kukoya daa fo, ka bɛ kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: and remained silent.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka o daa zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtisaida.
en: When the apostles returned, they described for Jesus what they had done. Taking them with him, Jesus withdrew privately to a city called Bethsaida.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko maa:.
en: There, the Lord spoke to Moses and said.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibi fifinyiiŋa gba ku yiɣisi fashee di zaa ti naɣ niŋla pali.
en: I say to you very seriously that as long as heaven and earth exist, neither the smallest letter nor even the smallest stroke of a pen will be erased from the Law until everything there becomes a reality.

dag: Tampiŋ yini daa dola nuzaa polo zaŋ labi Mikimash tooni poli, ka yini mi do nudirigu poli zaŋ labi Gɛba tooni polo.
en: One of the rocks faced north toward Micmash, and the other faced south toward Geba.

dag: Gunimiya bidibiga kam o dɔɣibu nyaaŋa daba anii dali yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni; di yi nyɛla yi yiŋa ka yi dɔɣ o bee yi yi zaŋla yi liɣiri n-da o tinzun nir sanna, ka o pala yimaŋmaŋ zuliya.
en: When the baby boy is eight days old, you will circumcise him. Every boy born among your people and every boy who is a slave of your people must be circumcised.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi n dan maa, Ka paɣ yi ti bi saɣi n-doli ma na.
en: I said to my master, Maybe the woman will not come back to this place with me.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Siizaria o daa chaŋla Jɛrusalɛm nti puhi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be nimaani ka naanyi gari chaŋ Antiɔk.
en: When he arrived at Caesarea, he went to Jerusalem and greeted the church, and then went to Antioch.

dag: Nyin daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi ni yɛri shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti biriginsim mini ti daalahichi tibisim marigi ti mi ka ti tarigi. Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ be.
en: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of Israel are complaining that the punishment for their sins is more than they can stand. They have lost all hope for survival, and they blame me.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn baŋ ka a pun chɛ ba luhi kaman mɔri la. Nyin Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni, a ni pɔbisi ba bahi ka bɛ na nɛmi.
en: Before your pots feel the thorns, whether green or burned up, God will sweep them away!.

dag: Yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zaa zuɣu, n ni niŋ ya n ni na ʒi n-niŋ ya shɛm, ka mi ku lan niŋ di kpee yaha.
en: Because of you, I will do what Ive never done before and will never do again—all because of your detestable practices.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n chaŋ tin shɛŋa gba ni ti yihi ba Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, dama di zuɣu ka Naawuni tim ma na.
en: But he said to them, I must tell the Good News about Gods kingdom to other towns too. This is why I was sent.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ, amaa ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalindi Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: You can even speak against the Son of Man and be forgiven. But anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven—not now or in the future.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa ʒe o yim ŋɔ, yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn mir o ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He made his people strong. His loyal followers praise him. Israel, his precious people, praise the Lord !.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-gbibi m biriginsim ashilɔni kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm, din nyɛ n zaŋ n tuumbiɛri sɔɣi n jɔɣu ni.
en: Others try to hide their sins, but I have never concealed mine.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi yira, ka shɛb gba zaŋ alizin birigu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu tahi Yisa sanna.
en: As the men were leaving, some people brought to Jesus a man who could not talk because he had a demon.

dag: Ka Yisifu maa daa nyɛ Matatias bia, ka Matatias nyɛ Amɔs bia, ka Amɔs nyɛ Nahum bia, ka Nahum nyɛ Ɛsili bia, ka Ɛsili mi nyɛ Nagai bia.
en: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai.

dag: Izraɛlnim ŋmanila gbuɣima ni kari doli piɛ shɛba n-wurim ba bahi. Tuuli, Asiria naa n-daa liri ba, ka pumpɔŋɔ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mi bahi naai ba.
en: Israel is a flock of sheep scattered by hungry lions. The king of Assyria first gobbled Israel up. Then Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylonia, crunched on Israel's bones.

dag: Cham yaɣimɛra yiŋa ka n ti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis a nimaani.
en: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; dama Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni. Amaa ka Ilaisha gba lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli chana.
en: Elijah then said to Elisha, Now the Lord wants me to go to the Jordan River, but you must stay here. Elisha replied, I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I will never leave you! So the two of them walked on together.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni ŋme n-saɣim Damaskus duno kara, ka kari Avɛn vinvamlinim mini Bɛtɛdɛn naa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Sirianim kuli Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: I will smash the city gates of Damascus and remove the inhabitants of Aven Valley and the ruler of Betheden. The people of Syria will be taken away as prisoners to the land of Kir.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul ye anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zuɣu, ka di zaɣisiya tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gba.
en: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim ni di saha ti paai ka yi teei ni n daa pun yɛli ya di yɛla. N daa bi pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnima piligu ni, ka di nyɛla n ni daa na be yi san la zuɣu.
en: I have told you all this now to prepare you. So when the time comes for these things to happen, you will remember that I warned you. I did not tell you these things at the beginning, because I was with you then.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Abimilɛk daa kpah o niriba zuɣu ni yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ doo ŋɔ bee o paɣ ŋɔ shɛli, bɛn kum o.
en: Abimelech gave orders to all of the people, Anyone who touches this man or his wife will be put to death.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be a niriba bɛn nyɛ a ni pii shɛba, ka bɛ galisi pam ka ka kalinli ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: But Im here, your servant, in the middle of the people you have chosen, a large population that cant be numbered or counted due to its vast size.

dag: Amaa do so ŋun gbib omaŋa ka di bi muɣis o ni o lo amiliya, ka o lo omaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni o ku lo bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti o amiliya, o niŋ din viɛla.
en: But another man might be more sure in his mind. There may be no need for marriage, so he is free to do what he wants. If he has decided in his own heart not to marry his fiancée, he is doing the right thing.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-nyɛ n tiligira; n ni niŋ o naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n yiliyiinili mini n kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiligira.
en: God is my savior; I will trust him and not be afraid. The Lord gives me power and strength; he is my savior.

dag: Ti nyɛviya dabisa nyɛla yuun pisopɔin, ka ti yi mali yaa, di ni niŋ yuun pihinii; amaa di yuma maa zaa tiri ti la wahala mini suhugarigu; ka di ku yuui ka di naai ka vuui.
en: Seventy years is all we have— eighty years, if we are strong; yet all they bring us is trouble and sorrow; life is soon over, and we are gone.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zahim ti biɛhigu nya, ka ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ sani.
en: Let us examine our ways and turn back to the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa daa shiri chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa su, ka a daa chɛ ka bɛ su Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim la, ka daa zaŋ bɛ nanim mini bɛ niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ni bɛ niŋ ba bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: Then their descendants conquered the land. You helped them defeat the kings and nations and treat their enemies however they wished.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa be bɛ ni galim Yisa nyaandoliba maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi diri ka nyura.
en: The Pharisees and their legal experts grumbled against his disciples. They said, Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Then Jesus asked, But who do you say I am.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri beni hal ti kurigi ka kul mali yiko pam?.
en: Why do evil people live long lives? Why do they grow old and successful?.

dag: Chɛ ka din ni bahi ba yoli kana nti bahi ba yoli libigi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa la ŋmaligi gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lu di ni bahi yoli!.
en: So let them fall into their own traps. Let them stumble into their own nets. Let some unknown danger catch them.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi jɛm wuna, dama man Yawɛ ŋun yuli booni Nyuli ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: Do not worship any other god, because I, the Lord , tolerate no rivals.

dag: Dauda daa bela Zif mɔɣu ni Hɔrɛshi maa. Di saha ka o daa wum ni Sool kana ni o ti ku o.
en: While David was at Horesh in the Ziph wilderness he learned that Saul was looking to kill him.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o ti kpuɣi paɣiba pam niŋ o paɣiba, di yi niŋ lala o suhu ni lɛbigi. O mi di ti va anzinfa bee salima pam mali.
en: The king is not to have many wives, because this would make him turn away from the Lord ; and he is not to make himself rich with silver and gold.

dag: O ni daa sɔɣ o maa nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, N yi ti kpi, yin zaŋmiya ma sɔɣi ti ni sɔɣi anabi ŋɔ gbal shɛli ni ŋɔ n-zaŋ n kɔba sɔŋ baɣil o kɔba.
en: After the old prophet buried him, he said to his sons, When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is. Put my bones beside his bones.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ bia, ka di zuɣulaannim diri ka nyuri yuŋ hal ka biɛɣ ti neera; mbusim be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: A country is in for trouble when its ruler is childish, and its leaders party all day long.

dag: Rubin zuliya m-bala; bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaata ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: ni shɛlɔr shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyara pa di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Then they made the cloth belt from fine linen and blue, purple, and red yarn. Designs were sewn into the cloth. These things were made as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ti yi ti nya saɣisigu, di saha maa di bemi kaman din to ka pa din tiri suhupiɛlli; amaa di nyaaŋa bɛn deei saɣisigu tibidarigibo puuni ti nyari suhudoo din nyɛ wuntia biɛhigu laara.
en: We dont enjoy discipline when we get it. It is painful. But later, after we have learned our lesson from it, we will enjoy the peace that comes from doing what is right.

dag: Ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira maa yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, di ku yuui ka n shiri kana! Ami! Chɛ ka di niŋ lala. Kamina, ti Duuma Yisa!.
en: He who gives his testimony to all this says, Yes indeed! I am coming soon! So be it. Come, Lord Jesus!.

dag: Ka kul kpalimmiya be yil yin ni n-diri ka nyuri bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam, dama tumtumda kam simdi yɔri. Ka miriya ka yi lɔhiri yiya.
en: Remain in this house, eating and drinking whatever they set before you, for workers deserve their pay. Dont move from house to house.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka di pala mani n-tim ba la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Amaa tɔbu mini kum ni ku anabinim maa.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD proclaims concerning the prophets who are speaking in my name when I didnt send them, and who are telling you that war or famine will never come to this land: Those very prophets will die in war and by famine!.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a yiko ni a niŋdi lala.
en: They said, Tell us! What authority do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ tamla nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima zuɣu. Naawuni ŋun ku ŋma ʒiri ŋɔ daa lo ti nyɛvili ŋɔ alikauli la ʒiɛmana din gari la ha ni.
en: This faith and knowledge make us sure that we have eternal life. God promised that life to us before time began—and God does not lie.

dag: Ka bina ayi ŋɔ nyɛla din ku tooi taɣi, ka Naawuni mi ku ŋma ʒiri di puuni. Lala zuɣu di simdi ni tinim bɛn nya sɔɣibu shee Naawuni sani ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni pam gbibi tahima shɛli din be ti tooni la kirikiri.
en: So these are two things that dont change, because its impossible for God to lie. He did this so that we, who have taken refuge in him, can be encouraged to grasp the hope that is lying in front of us.

dag: Mani n-yɛli lala maa. Iin, mani m-bol o. Mani n-zaŋ o na, ka o mi ni di nasara o tuma ni.
en: I told you that I would call him. I will lead him, and I will make him succeed.

dag: dimbɔŋɔ gba di yɛn nyɛla taali din simdi ni sariakaritiba darigi n tibili. Dama n daa naan nyɛla ʒiŋmara Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani.
en: This is also a sin that must be punished. If I had worshiped them, I would have been unfaithful to God All-Powerful.

dag: Ti wuhiri ti yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm, Naawuni ni daŋ n-yu ti la zuɣu.
en: We love because God loved us first.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin daa mali ti gari, Yawɛ ni daa fiɛbi Nail Mɔɣili maa nyaaŋa.
en: Seven days after the Lord had struck the Nile.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu.
en: And so your Temple will be abandoned and empty.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ mali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: For seven days the priests will purge the altar in order to purify it and to dedicate it.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: So nini na bi nya, ka so mi tibili na bi wum bee so ti baŋ binshɛŋa Naawuni ni mali zali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o la.
en: But as the Scriptures say, No one has ever seen, no one has ever heard, no one has ever imagined what God has prepared for those who love him. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka o laɣis o kpamba min o sapashinnima ni Galili ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa na ni bɛ ti puhi di chuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Hɛrɔdias katari.
en: Finally, Herodias got her chance when Herod gave a great birthday celebration for himself and invited his officials, his army officers, and the leaders of Galilee.

dag: Ka nanim maa zaa mini bɛ tɔbbihi daa laɣim kana ti dɔni Mɛrom kulibɔŋ ni ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: All of these kings joined forces and came together and set up camp at Merom Brook to fight against Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o niriba zaa na nti lo tɔbu ni bɛ chaŋ Kɛila ti teei gili Dauda min o niriba maa niŋ di ni.
en: So Saul called his troops to war, to march against Keilah and besiege David and his men.

dag: Nyini n-fa ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi. Yɛlimaŋli, a duhi ma ka n gari n dimnima; ka yihi ma duŋtaariba nuu ni.
en: He saves me from my enemies! You, Lord, help me defeat those who attack me. You save me from cruel people.

dag: Kpuɣim jaaŋgbee, ka a min a biɛli Aduna laɣim niriba maa na, ka a ti yɛli tampiŋ ŋɔ ni di chɛ ka kom yi di ni na bɛ zaa ninni. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ yihi kom tampiŋ maa ni na ti ba; ka bɛ mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri nyu.
en: You and Aaron your brother, take the staff and assemble the community. In their presence, tell the rock to provide water. You will produce water from the rock for them and allow the community and their animals to drink.

dag: ka Izraɛlnim zaa gba naanyi tiligi kaman di ni sab yɛli Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Tiligira ni ti yi Ziɔn na; o ni ti yihi Yaakubu zuliya tuumbiɛri zaa bahi.
en: In this way, all Israel will be saved, as it is written: The deliverer will come from Zion. He will remove ungodly behavior from Jacob. .

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chani Jɛriko nti sirigiri zolɔŋni ka ŋmɛnditoya lir o soli maa ni m-pirig o, ka bu o hal ka o ti tarigi, ka bɛ fa o nɛma zo ka chɛ o.
en: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Shunɛm paɣ so bia o ni daa neei kum ni la, Yiɣisim zaŋ a yiŋnim zaa kuli luɣ shɛli a ni yɛn tooi kuli; dama Yawɛ ni chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Elisha talked to the woman whose son he had brought back to life. He said, You and your family should move to another country, because the Lord has decided that there will be a famine here. It will last for seven years.

dag: O mi bi be kaman daadam ŋun bɔri shɛl o daadamkpee nuu ni la, dama ŋun Naawuni n-tiri daadam nyɛvili m-pahi vuhim ni shɛlikam.
en: Nor is God served by human hands, as though he needed something, since he is the one who gives life, breath, and everything else.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛli niriba yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum, dindina n ni vuɣi di zuliya maa zaa n-ku ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But if any nation will not obey, then I will completely uproot it and destroy it. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ka yi chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni asiba. Ka shɛli yi guui zani hal ni biɛɣ asiba, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: You must eat all the meat that night. If any of the meat is left until morning, you must burn it in the fire.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini. Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o, ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: Caesars, they replied. Then he said, Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar and to God what belongs to God.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ min o kpiɔŋ; ka suhimiy o sahakam.
en: Depend on the Lord for strength. Always go to him for help.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛnkam mali Naawuni ni ti ba pina balibubalibu shɛŋa tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga zaŋdi li sɔŋdi bɛ taba.
en: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ku o kpee, yin chɛ ka ŋun ku o kpee maa kul dari ginda hal ti kpi; ka di chɛliya ka so sɔŋ o.
en: A murderer will never have peace. Dont support such a person.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o gbaɣino maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣili Ashitarɔt jɛmbu duu, ka zaŋ o chaŋ Bɛtishan nti lo o tabili gooni.
en: Then they put his weapons in the temple of the goddess Astarte, and they nailed his body to the wall of the city of Beth Shan.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa boli doo maa m-bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee be.
en: But the Lord God called out to the man, Where are you.

dag: Gbaridɔɣirili so daa be Listra. Bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dahin shɛli hal ti paag o ninkurilim ni o daa na ʒi n-yiɣisi zani chaŋ.
en: In Lystra there was a man who had something wrong with his feet. He had been born crippled and had never walked.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni ka galindi niriba. Bɛ dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri soli, ka nyuri bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka zaŋ naŋgban malisim yɛtɔɣa ni be di niriba zuɣu nyɔri.
en: These are faultfinding grumblers, living according to their own desires. They speak arrogant words and they show partiality to people when they want a favor in return.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be o sani daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu. Ka niriba pam daa yi Lɛbɔhamat mini Ijipti kulibɔŋ polo kana.
en: For days, Solomon and the crowd celebrated the Festival of Shelters, and people came from as far away as the Egyptian Gorge in the south and Lebo-Hamath in the north.

dag: Molimiya Naawuni yiko yɛla; ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa, ka o yiko be sagbana ni.
en: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.

dag: Tim ba suhusaɣiŋgu; chɛ ka a noli di ba.
en: Give them a tortured mind—put your curse on them!.

dag: Di sabiya yaha, Ŋunkam yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ.
en: It was also said, Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a written notice of divorce.

dag: Bɛ mali bɛ bihi yiri chani kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la, ka bɛ bihi maa yiɣiri jamda.
en: They send forth their little ones like sheep; their infants bounce around.

dag: maligumaaniba deemi li bɛn zaŋdi li tahirina maa sani m-mal li maani Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛŋa din bɔri malibu la.
en: and use it to repair the temple whenever you see the need.

dag: Ka n daa dihi n nuu di gbana zuɣu, ka zaŋ n dalinli dihi tabili li, ka chɛ ka shɛhiranim kana ka n ti zahim liɣiri maa sania zuɣu.
en: I signed the deed and had a copy of the deed sealed up. I got some men to witness what I had done, and I weighed out the silver on the scales.

dag: Di chɛ ka m mali galimi n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a zaligunim maa polo, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka n ku di vi.
en: Let my heart be blameless in your statutes so that I am not put to shame.

dag: Ka Musa daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu zalizali, ka zaŋ di dapaɣa la tamtam di zuɣu, ka zaŋ di dapuhi la niŋ li, ka zaŋ di daantalisi la sa;.
en: Moses set up the Holy Tent just as the Lord had said. He put the bases down first. Then he put the frames on the bases. Then he put the braces on and set up the posts.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din niŋ kamaata yɛlibu, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣ kaha.
en: Righteous people know the kind thing to say, but the wicked are always saying things that hurt.

dag: Filistianima, yi zaa di maliya suhupiɛlli, jaaŋgbe shɛli din yi fiɛbiri ya la ni kabigi la zuɣu. Waɣ yino yi kpi, so n-yirina zan o zaashee. Ka o galli waɣiri waɣ biɛɣu.
en: People of Philistia, the rod that beat you is broken, but you have no reason to be glad. When one snake dies, a worse one comes in its place. A snake's egg hatches a flying dragon.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba ni nya li ka zo dabiɛm, di saha ka bɛ ni la a ka yɛli.
en: Good people will see this and learn to fear and respect God. They will laugh at you and say.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Shɛkɛmnim daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti do mɔɣu ni, ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: The next day Abimelech found out that the people of Shechem were planning to go out into the fields.

dag: Kulla niriba biɛla n-daa yi Asha zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni n-siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Even so, some people from Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun were submissive and came to Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha Luɣ Kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: The priests carried the chest into the most holy place and put it under the winged creatures.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, A ba min a biɛyanim kul a sanna.
en: The king said to Joseph, It's good that your father and brothers have arrived.

dag: N nya n niriba ni diri wahala shɛŋa Ijiptinim nuu ni, ka lan wum bɛ fabila la, lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti fa ba bahi. Ka yɛl o, Dinzuɣu kamina ka n tim a Ijipti.
en: I have clearly seen the oppression my people have experienced in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning. I have come down to rescue them. Come! I am sending you to Egypt .

dag: Tiŋgbani dina, bindirigu n-yiri di ni na, amaa tiŋgbani puuni din ŋmanila buɣim din diri binyara.
en: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛ ka n ʒim yi n-lu tiŋa tiŋgban shɛli din mini Yawɛ shee wɔɣa ni taba ŋɔ ni, dama Izraɛl naa kana ti kariti doli ma kaman nir ni kariti doli kɔriŋga zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Now dont make me die far away from the Lord s presence. The king of Israel has come out looking for a flea. You are like a man hunting partridges in the mountains.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kpɛhi ma kɔre, ka kɔre maa gbaa ma. A mali yaa gari ma, ka nyaŋ ma. N leela bɛ ni lari so asiba hal ni yuŋ; sokam maani ma la ansarisi.
en: Lord , you tricked me, and I certainly was fooled. You are stronger than I am, so you won. I have become a joke. People laugh at me and make fun of me all day long.

dag: A kul moola a nini lihiri bɔri n shee kaman gbuɣinli la, ka lan tumdi tuma jɛndiri ma.
en: If I have any success at all, you hunt me down like a lion; to hurt me you even work miracles.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra; dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: He said to them, There is a large harvest, but few workers to gather it in. Pray to the owner of the harvest that he will send out workers to gather in his harvest.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛla nimaani, ka naa ŋmaligi bɛ polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: The king turned around, and while the entire assembly of Israel was standing there, he blessed them.

dag: Yaakubu daa yɔhim Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Aram nir maa, o ni daa bi yɛl o ŋun Yaakubu ni daa lo ni o yiɣisi nimaani la zuɣu.
en: Jacob deceived Laban by not letting him know that he was leaving.

dag: Ka o ni ti ti yinim bɛn diri wahala ŋɔ zaŋ tabili ti gba vuhim. O ni ti niŋla lala saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o malaikanim yi ti yi palo zuɣusaa siɣirina o yiko mini buɣim din diri puuni.
en: and he will give relief to you who suffer and to us as well. He will do this when the Lord Jesus appears from heaven with his mighty angels.

dag: Yi yi yɛli Ti ni nahim o pam, dama yɛlli maa mi yila o kɔbili ni na.
en: Maybe you will say, How can we push Job a little harder and make him realize that he is the source of his problems.

dag: Kuɣ shɛŋa din be dukpina ni ni kuhi bahi ya na, ka dapua din be dari ni garigi saɣi.
en: A stone will cry out from a village wall, and a tree branch will respond.

dag: O daa me o jɛmbu duu ka di be kaman alizanda la, ka be kaman o ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ ka di kul beni sahakam shɛm la.
en: He built his holy Temple high on that mountain. Like the earth, God built his Temple to last forever.

dag: yi ti wum kikahi mini yuhi ni mɔɣilɔnim ni biɛri ni goonjɛnim ni alijeetanim ni biŋkumda balibu kam zaa kumsi, bɛn damdim tiŋa n-jɛm salima binnan shɛli Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni mali zali ŋɔ.
en: Trumpets, flutes, harps, and all other kinds of musical instruments will soon start playing. When you hear the music, you must bow down and worship the statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Balimmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa, ka suh o ti ma ka o chɛ ka n nuu ŋɔ lan lab di bebu ni yaha. Ka Naawuni nir maa daa suhi Yawɛ, ka naa maa nuu maa nya alaafee n-lan be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: King Jeroboam said to the prophet, Please pray for me to the Lord your God, and ask him to heal my arm! The prophet prayed to the Lord , and the king's arm was healed.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee chi ni chana, a ni tooi zaŋ a nuu ŋmɛm kazuɣuri maa ŋubi, amaa miri ka a zaŋ sua ŋ-ŋmah a kpee chi.
en: If you go into your neighbors grain field, you can pluck ears by hand, but you arent allowed to cut off any of your neighbors grain with a sickle.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka Jɔn Baptaizira sanna ka Jɔn ti baptaiz o Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: About that time Jesus came from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to the place where John was. John baptized Jesus in the Jordan River.

dag: Nyini n-daa wuhi shihira mini alahiziba tuma Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka na kul wuhiri li hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini daadamnim zaa sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a zali yuli hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa yi ti be o naba ni, di saha Naawuni Bia maa maŋmaŋ gba ni ti zaŋ omaŋ ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun zaŋ binshɛɣukam sɔŋ o naba ni maa, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni su binshɛɣukam zaa, ka nyɛ binshɛɣukam sokam zaa sani.
en: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri kabirila sida tihi luhira. Yawɛ kabi Lɛbanɔn sida tihi luhi.
en: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa bi saɣi lala, dina n-daa chɛ ka di kpama talahi ni n yɛli ni n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Naa Siiza sanna. Di mi pala n kamina ni n ti fiɣisi mmaŋmaŋ zuliya.
en: But the Jews there did not want that. So I had to ask to come to Rome to have my trial before Caesar. That doesnt mean I am accusing my people of doing anything wrong.

dag: Yawɛ poya ka ku lan taɣ o tɛha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord has made a promise with an oath and will not change his mind: You are a priest forever— the kind of priest Melchizedek was.

dag: Yisa ni daa du Galili Teeku duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu yi gbala polo n-tuhir o sol na. Bɛ nini daa tuli pam hal ka so ku tooi gari bɛ ni be shɛli polo maa.
en: When Jesus arrived on the other side of the lake in the country of the Gadarenes, two men who were demon-possessed came from among the tombs to meet him. They were so violent that nobody could travel on that road.

dag: Bom yɛm, bom tɛhi zilima. Mira ka a tam bee n-zaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n noli ni bahi.
en: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.

dag: Naawuni yi saɣi ti ni kpaŋ timaŋ chaŋla tooni.
en: Let's grow up, if God is willing.

dag: Bɛ yi daa yɛn ku niriba ayopɔin n-yo Keen kubu samli, so yi ku mani, yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka bɛ yɛn ku n-yo man kubu samli.
en: The punishment for killing Cain was very bad. But the punishment for killing me will be many times worse.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Yulimiya bo n-nya ŋun tooi ŋmɛri mɔɣilo viɛnyɛliŋga ti ma na.
en: Saul said to his servants, Find me a good musician and bring him to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu chamiya ti yɛli zuliya kam ka bɛ leei n nyaandoliba, ka yi baptaizi ba ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia ni o Shia Kasi yul ni;.
en: Go to the people of all nations and make them my disciples. Baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, ka m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab told his brother, If the Arameans are too much for me to handle, you can come and help me. If the Ammonites are too strong for you, I'll come and help you.

dag: Amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na yirila o suhu ni na; dina n-nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: But the bad things people say with their mouth come from the way they think. And thats what can make people wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gari nimaani n-lan gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ ti yɛn lu ka bɛ paai Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: So the Levite and those with him traveled on. The sun was going down just as they entered the city of Gibeah. Gibeah is in the area that belongs to the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa chɛ ka Dauda lan lo o yurilim alikauli yaha, dama o daa yur o mi kaman omaŋmaŋ la.
en: Jonathan thought as much of David as he did of himself, so he asked David to promise once more that he would be a loyal friend.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla. A nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, ŋmaligim m polo na.
en: Answer me, LORD, for your faithful love is good! Turn to me in your great compassion!.

dag: N daa bi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tiŋ maa ni, dama ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa mini Piɛbil la n-nyɛ di jɛmbu duu.
en: I did not see a temple in the city. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were the citys temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa pii fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni ti Lɛvinima kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: So in accordance with the Lord 's command the people of Israel gave the Levites certain cities and pasture lands out of their own territories.

dag: Gbib amaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lihim a wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga. Kul niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima, dama a yi niŋdi lala, a ni tilig amaŋa zaŋ tabili bɛn wumd a wuhibu.
en: Be careful in your life and in your teaching. Continue to live and teach rightly. Then you will save yourself and those who listen to your teaching.

dag: Ka juri daa ti kana ni bɛ ti di ba, ka Ibram kari ba.
en: And when birds came down to eat the animals, Abram chased them away.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo di ni ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: The Lord said to Satan, Where have you been? Satan answered the Lord , I have been roaming around the earth, going from place to place.

dag: Yawɛ dabili Musa kum nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nan bia Jɔshua, ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda la.
en: Moses was the Lord s servant, and Joshua son of Nun was Moses helper. After Moses died, the Lord spoke to Joshua and said.

dag: Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛli, dina ka n gba yɛra. .
en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I wouldnt be able to break the LORDs command for good or ill by my own will. Ill say whatever the LORD says?.

dag: Lala ka Dauda daa zaŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni kuɣili labi Filistia doo maa ku o, ka takɔbi daa ka Dauda nuu ni.
en: David defeated Goliath with a sling and a rock. He killed him without even using a sword.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi nuu be zibisim tuun yoya ni, amaa lee yihimiya tuun yoya maa la palɔni.
en: Have no part in the things that people in darkness do, which produce nothing good. Instead, tell everyone how wrong those things are.

dag: Ijiptinim ni ti di vi, bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo na nuu ni. .
en: Your people will be disgraced and captured by the enemy from the north.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma ti kpɛhi bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli ŋɔ ni? Ka ŋun n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma tahi Ɛdom?.
en: Who, O God, will take me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi ma ŋɔ? Ka bɛ zaa daa chihi ti tuui taba, ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, niriba maa m-muɣi pam daar a.
en: Then Jesus said, Who touched me? They all said they had not touched him. And Peter said, Master, people are all around you, pushing against you.

dag: Amaa ka Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba ni ti deei nam maa n-su li sahakam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: And the people of the Supreme God will receive royal power and keep it forever and ever.

dag: Di saha ka Gɛrasa tiŋkpannim zaa daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbahi ba pam. Ka o daa lan kpe ŋariŋ ni lab o nyaaŋa.
en: Then everyone gathered from the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave their area because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and returned across the lake.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi; di chɛ ka n di vi. A wuntitali puuni, tiligim ma!.
en: I take refuge in you, LORD. Please never let me be put to shame. Rescue me by your righteousness!.

dag: Amaa n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: But if I use God's power to force out demons, it proves that God's kingdom has already come to you.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ti shɛŋa bɛ ni sa m-baɣili kulibɔŋ din mali kom, ka di wandi wala di walibu saha, ka di vari bi suura. Bɛ kul dirila nasara bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: So they grow strong, like a tree planted by a stream— a tree that produces fruit when it should and has leaves that never fall. Everything they do is successful.

dag: Ka maligumaana Aduna daa du Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu nti kpi nimaani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu dahin yini dali n-daa bala.
en: At the command of the Lord , Aaron the priest climbed Mount Hor. At the age of he died there on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites had left Egypt.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya pam ka diri ti shɛhira biɛɣu a sani; ti tumdi tuumbiɛri, ka mi ti daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Lord , our crimes against you are many. Our sins accuse us. We are well aware of them all.

dag: Ka n lan nya shɛli dunia ni, ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Again I saw something else that didnt make sense:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti yi paɣ maa zuɣu yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi, amaa a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: The LORDs messenger appeared to the woman and said to her, Even though youve been unable to become pregnant and havent given birth, you are now pregnant and will give birth to a son!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa na, ka Aduna min o bidibisi ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then Moses brought the young bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.

dag: Kuɣili maa daa galisiya pam, amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai nya ka kuɣili maa pun biligimi doya.
en: Then the women looked and saw that the stone was moved. The stone was very large, but it was moved away from the entrance.

dag: ka Ahaz nyɛ o bia, ka Hɛzɛkia nyɛ o bia, ka Manaasa nyɛ o bia.
en: Jothams son was Ahaz. Ahazs son was Hezekiah. Hezekiahs son was Manasseh.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Bɛtisaida, ka bɛ zaŋ zoon so tah o sanna nti balim o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: As Jesus and his disciples were going into Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch the man.

dag: n-ti Gibiɔnnim maa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ti ku ba zoli maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa laɣim kpi. Puu atam kpuɣibu saha, kachɛɣu piligu ni ka bɛ daa ku ba maa.
en: David gave these seven men to the Gibeonites who then brought them to Mount Gibeah and hanged them in front of the Lord . Those seven men died together in the spring, during the first days of the barley harvest.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbuɣinli ni yi nyɔŋ ni na ti ku ba, ka kunduŋ yi mɔɣu ni na ti dari tɔhi ba, ka jɛŋgbini do bɛ fɔntinsi ni gu ba, ka ŋunkam yi di ni na, o ni dari tɔh o, dama bɛ daalahichi maa galisiya, ka bɛ kul lan zɔri ka chɛri ma, ka di ka tariga.
en: Therefore, a lion from the forest will attack them; a wolf from the desert will destroy them; a leopard prowling around their towns will tear to pieces anyone venturing out— because of their many crimes and countless acts of unfaithfulness.

dag: N lan nya ka bɛ mi n-sɔɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa kpɛri luɣ kasi shee ka yira; amaa ka niriba paɣiri ba tin shɛl ni bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zuɣu. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Yes, I have seen the wicked buried and in their graves, but on the way back from the cemetery people praise them in the very city where they did their evil. It is useless.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tiba mal alibarika, a ni zaŋ a zaligu wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb gba mal alibarika.
en: The people you discipline, LORD, are truly happy— the ones you teach from your Instruction.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi nya n ni tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa alizanda ni na shɛm.
en: The LORD said to Moses: Say this to the Israelites: You saw for yourselves how I spoke with you from heaven.

dag: ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi wuhi paɣisara ka bɛ yuri bɛ yidaannim mini bɛ bihi.
en: By doing this they will teach the younger women to love their husbands and children.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be a jɛmbu duu puuni? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi be Ziɔn a daboli din be kasi la zuɣu?.
en: Lord , who can live in your Holy Tent ? Who can live on your holy mountain?.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari nyɔri zaɣ maŋli, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biri wuntitali nyari laara maŋli.
en: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n dana, nyama, Adɔnija n-nyɛ naa, hal a ni kul bi mi di yɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: But Adonijah has already been made king, and you didn't know anything about it.

dag: amaa Yawɛ suhu daa yuri yi yaannim ka pii yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ŋɔ zuliya kam sunsuuni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But the Lord 's love for your ancestors was so strong that he chose you instead of any other people, and you are still his chosen people.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Anyone who violently hits their father or mother should be put to death.

dag: Dabili yi di nam ni jɛrigu yi di nti yaɣi.
en: at a servant when he becomes king and fools when they are full of food.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa shiri bi neei kum ni, dindina yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla yoli, ka yi na kul kpalim be yi daalahichi ni;.
en: And if Christ has not been raised, then your faith is a delusion and you are still lost in your sins.

dag: Di dunoya pinaayi la daa nyɛla waya pinaayi, waya zaɣ yiniyini ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali dunoli kam, ka tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-doya ne kaman takɔriti diɣisi la.
en: The twelve gates were twelve pearls; each gate was made from a single pearl. The street of the city was of pure gold, transparent as glass.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, di daa niŋ o muɣisigu pam, ka o kpaŋ omaŋa m-bɔri soli ni o yihi Daniɛl, ka daa kul be lala nia niŋbu ni hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When the king heard this report, he was very unhappy. He decided to rescue Daniel and did everything he could do to save Daniel before the sun went down.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni a ni mali yurilim shɛli din yi a yɛda niŋbu ni na maa ni kpaŋs a ka a baŋ bin sun shɛŋa zaa ti ni mali Masia ni la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.

dag: Di pala zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to ka a ku tooi wum li. Biɛhiŋ kani n yi tim a bɛ sani, bɛ ni wum a yɛligu.
en: I am not sending you to many different countries where people speak languages you cannot understand. If you went to those people and spoke to them, they would listen to you. But you will not have to learn those hard languages.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni zahim bɛn be teeku ni zaa ni zɔri ya. N zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: All of the animals on the earth will fear you and dread you—all the birds in the skies, everything crawling on the ground, and all of the seas fish. They are in your power.

dag: Sulemaana ŋaha shɛŋa din pahi m-bɔŋɔ, ka Juda naa Hɛzɛkia kpambaliba daa yaai li sabi sɔŋ.
en: These are some more wise sayings from Solomon. These proverbs were copied by servants of Hezekiah, the king of Judah.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: But listen to what I have to say to you and to all the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri lala maa ka Yisa maŋmaŋ dii zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: While Jesus' disciples were talking about what had happened, Jesus appeared and greeted them.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord told me:.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ka yi chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni asiba. Ka shɛli yi guui zani hal ni biɛɣ asiba, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: Eat what you want that night, and the next morning burn whatever is left.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kuɣ pinaayi, ka a ti zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu. Niŋmi li kaman bɛ ni niŋdi dalinli shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la din ni chɛ ka zuliya pinaayi maa yuya be di ni.
en: There will be twelve jewels on the judgment pouch—one stone for each of the sons of Israel. Each stone will be like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes cut into it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka baansi yiini yila yɛra, Kamiya Hɛshibɔn na, mɛmiya li. Chɛliya ka Sihɔn tiŋ maa zani.
en: Therefore, the poets say: Come to Heshbon, let it be built. Let the city of Sihon be established.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba la sani ti yɛl o, Di ku baŋdiba maa. Zaŋm ma tahi naa sani ka n ti wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: So Daniel went to Arioch, the man the king had appointed to wipe out Babylons sages. Daniel said to him, Dont wipe out the sages of Babylon! Bring me before the king, and I will explain the dreams meaning to him.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba, ka di yihiriya ba hal biɛɣu.
en: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi ni, Uriɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: From the Levite clan of Kohath came Uriel, in charge of members of his clan;.

dag: ka chɛ ka kahiŋkɔɣu doli nimaani yi. Kahiŋkɔɣu maa ni daa yiɣi yi, o daa kul yiɣirimi gindi hal ka kom maa ti nyuui.
en: Then he sent out a raven. The raven flew from place to place until the ground was dry and the water was gone.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa sani, m bemi kaman ŋun ka yaa ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn ka yaa maa gba. N chɛ ka m biɛhigu mini sokam biɛhigu taɣilila taba ni di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi shɛba.
en: Among the weak in faith I become weak like one of them, in order to win them. So I become all things to all people, that I may save some of them by whatever means are possible.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tum tuma ka o yuli du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa zaa ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana la, amaa o yuli daa lee bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: and certainly just as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was the commander of the Thirty Warriors, but he still did not become one of the Three Warriors.

dag: A ni daa na bi nam zoya bee a ni daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini dunia ŋɔ, nyini n-daa nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni.
en: You were God before the mountains were born, before the earth and the world were made. You have always been and will always be God!.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu soli ŋmanila kɔbilinini din bilisiri ko biɛɣu bee bɛ ni saɣim kɔbil shɛli kom.
en: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa tuui baptaiziri niriba la nti be nimaani.
en: Then he went back across the Jordan River to the place where John began his work of baptizing people. Jesus stayed there.

dag: Nyama, ka niriba daa gariti nya ka o do sol ni, ka gbuɣinli ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka bɛ daa ka anabi kurili maa ni be tin shɛli maa ni na nti yɛli bɛ ni nya shɛm.
en: Some people walked by and saw the body with the lion standing there. They ran into Bethel, telling everyone what they had seen.

dag: Hal yi ya ŋɔ taŋkpa shɛli din puɣ ti naba ŋɔ, ti ni pihi li bahi yi zuɣu, amaa lee baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam miri ya.
en: As a complaint against you, we brush off the dust of your city that has collected on our feet. But know this: Gods kingdom has come to you.

dag: Kumiya o bihi bɛ ba taali zuɣu. Di chɛliya ka bɛ so ti yiɣisina ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ bee m-me tinsi zali dunia ŋɔ ni yaha.
en: Let the slaughter begin! The sons of this king will die because of their ancestors' sins. None of them will ever rule the earth or cover it with cities.

dag: N ni ti yihi yi ni bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba la mini bɛn birigi n sani la bahi. N ni ti yihi ba bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nyɛ saamba la na, amaa bɛ ti ku kpe Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will remove all those who turned against me and sinned against me. I will remove them from your homeland. They will never again come to the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: N ni tilig a a niriba mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb sani n ni timd a maa nuu ni.
en: I will keep you safe from your own people and from the non-Jewish people, the ones I am sending you to.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti niŋ naani ni ti ni tooi kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la Yisa ʒim zuɣu.
en: Brothers and sisters, we have confidence that we can enter the holy of holies by means of Jesus blood.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmaai tiŋgban shɛli ti Yisifu bituuli Manaasa zuliya niriba shɛba. Makiri daa nyɛla Manaasa bidib kpɛma; ka Makiri mi bidib kpɛm yuli n-daa booni Giliad; Makiri daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Giliad mini Bashan ti o.
en: Land was determined by lot for the tribe of Manasseh, who was actually Josephs oldest son. Gilead and Bashan belonged to Machir, who was Manassehs oldest son and Gileads father. This was because he was a warrior.

dag: Niriba, niŋmiy o naani sahakam. Yɛlimiy o yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛlikam zaa, Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa Yawɛ, ti suhir a, ti yi yihi doo ŋɔ nyɛvili, nyin di bɔhi ti biɛri ku ti. Dama nyin Yawɛ zuɣu ka yɛlli maa ʒiya. A ni yu shɛm m-bala.
en: So they cried out to the Lord , O Lord , we pray, don't punish us with death for taking this man's life! You, O Lord , are responsible for all this; it is your doing.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, di bi maari biɛrim n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n yi fo, di sɔŋsim lee nyɛ ma dini?.
en: If I speak, my pain is not eased; if I hold back, what have I lost?.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, N yi kpi pumpɔŋɔ, m paɣiya, n ni nya a ni n nini ka baŋ ni a na be a nyɛvil ni maa zuɣu.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, I am ready to die, now that I have seen you and know that you are still alive.

dag: Nandaamba kul ku kɔŋ dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya, Teemiya yi nuu n-tim faranim mini yi ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni pina.
en: There will always be some Israelites who are poor and in need, and so I command you to be generous to them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu, ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani.
en: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue. In the synagogue there was a man with a crippled hand.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a ba Ibrahimma Naawuni, di zɔri dabiɛm, n ni be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam n dabili Ibrahimma zuɣu.
en: The LORD appeared to him that night and said, I am the God of your father Abraham. Dont be afraid because I am with you. I will bless you, and I will give you many children for my servant Abrahams sake.

dag: ka sua maa mini di sukpali zaa kpe nti lim. Ka o puli maa kpam mum li niŋ, dama o daa bi darigi ŋooi sua maa o puli maa ni, ka o puuni daɣiri daa zɔri yirina.
en: and even the handle went in after the blade. Since he did not pull the sword out of his stomach, the fat closed over the blade, and his guts spilled out.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa daa ti chirigi do so ka o yi tiŋ maa ni na, ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, wuhim ti so shɛli din kuni tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ka ti niŋ a nirilim.
en: While the spies were watching, they saw a man come out of the city. They said to the man, Show us a secret way into the city. If you help us, we will not hurt you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya paɣisar shɛb bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi kɔbisinahi Jabɛshigiliadnim maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Shilo sansani din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: The warriors attacked Jabesh in Gilead, and returned to their camp at Shiloh in Canaan with young women.

dag: Ka di gari bɛnkam zaa daa wum o baŋsim yɛtɔɣa min o ni daa garigiri ba shɛm maa.
en: All who heard him were amazed at his intelligent answers.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ o ninkuunsi takɔb titali din mali kpiɔŋ la n-darigi Lɛviatan ŋun nyɛ waɣ so ŋun pɔripɔri ka yiɣiri la tibili; ka ku teeku ni biŋkɔb biɛɣu la.
en: On that day the Lord will use his powerful and deadly sword to punish Leviathan, that wriggling, twisting dragon, and to kill the monster that lives in the sea.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa taɣ o biɛhigu bɛ sani n-niŋdi kaman o nyɛla yinyaa la, ka bo bini n-chihiri dunɔdali punu chiha, ka chɛ ka o nintɔri zɔri dolisir o teeŋkɔbiri.
en: So whenever David was around them, he pretended to be insane and acted like a madman when they tried to restrain him; he would scribble on the city gates and let spit drool down his beard.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu tuhi; o nyɛla n tampiŋ, ka dinkam pa wuntia tuuni ka o ni.
en: And they will say about you, The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa gba ti bɔh o yaha, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei? Ka o yɛli ba, O zaŋla tandi ʒe n nina maa, ka m paɣi li ka neei.
en: So Pharisees also asked him how he was able to see. The man told them, He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and now I see.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa duhi Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo n-zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the king gave Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego more important jobs in the province of Babylon.

dag: Ka din nyari niriba taali yi mali jilima ŋɔ tatabo, dindina din chɛ ka niriba yiri taali ni shiri ni mali jilima gari lala.
en: The system which brings condemnation was glorious; how much more glorious is the activity which brings salvation!.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a yaa ti paɣiba, a mi di zaŋ a soya ti bɛn kuri nanima.
en: Dont give your strength to women, your ways to those who wipe out kings.

dag: A zuɣu ŋmanila Kamɛl Zoli. A zabiri nyɛlisirimi kaman ago la. Di viɛlim ni tooi chɛ ka naa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu.
en: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel, and your hair, braided in royal purple— a king is bound by the tresses!.

dag: Masia zuɣu n yɛrila yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri. Ka n suhu ni tɛha diri ma shɛhira Naawuni Shia Kasi sani.
en: Im speaking the truth in Christ—Im not lying, as my conscience assures me with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, Judanim ni ti chaŋ ti pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka bɛ laɣim taba n-yi nuzaa polo tiŋgban ni n-ka n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yaannim ni bɛ su li la ni na.
en: In those days the people of Judah and Israel will leave the north together for the land that I gave their ancestors as an inheritance.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla Mɛmfisinim mini Tapanhɛsinim ŋme ŋ-ŋma yi zuɣuŋmana.
en: People from Memphis and Tahpanhes have smashed the top of your head.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim birigi n-tum alahichi pam gari Yawɛ ni daa ku zuliya shɛb ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini nimaani la ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa.
en: But the people of Judah and Jerusalem listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.

dag: Ka saha daa ti paai ka Yisa min o tuumba maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: When the time came, Jesus took his place at the table, and the apostles joined him.

dag: N chɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali sania mini ʒiri kpalaŋa n-zahind o nɛma?.
en: But I, the Lord , will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba, Yi yi ti zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa yi ni baŋ ni mani m-bala, ka lan baŋ ni m bi niŋdi shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ni wuhi ma shɛm, dina ka m mali tɔɣisira.
en: Jesus went on to say, When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Chɛ ka m bihi ŋɔ ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ti ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: Jesus asked her what she wanted, and she said, When you come into your kingdom, please let one of my sons sit at your right side and the other at your left.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna nti yɛli ba, Suhimiya Yawɛ ka o yihi poloya maa ka chɛ m mini n niriba ŋɔ, ka n chɛ ka yi niriba maa chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron and said, Ask the Lord to remove the frogs from me and my people. I will let the people go to offer sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: ka naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin shɛb bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi daa yina n-ka bɛ sanna, ka n nini daa na ʒi n-nya bɛ tatabo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then I saw seven more cows come up out of the river after them, but these cows were thin and looked sick. They were the worst cows I had ever seen anywhere in Egypt!.

dag: Amaa ka Iso yɛl o, M mabia, mal a bini; n gba bi kɔŋ.
en: But, brother, I already have plenty, Esau replied. Keep them for yourself.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nazari nir maa pini o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri maa niŋ biɛrisuŋ sara maligu la buɣim ni.
en: The Nazirites must go to the entrance of the Meeting Tent. There they must shave off their hair that they grew as a dedication to the Lord. That hair will be put in the fire that is burning under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ n tiliginsim; dina n-nyɛ ni ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku paag o sanna.
en: It may even be that my boldness will save me, since no wicked person would dare to face God.

dag: Mani n-daa nam li ka di viɛla, ka mali wula pam. Ka Idɛn tihi zaa din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa zabiri li nyuli.
en: I made it beautiful, with spreading branches. It was the envy of every tree in Eden, the garden of God.

dag: Ka Hamat Naa Tɔi daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa min o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's entire army.

dag: N yi zaŋ chibo paɣi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ bɔchaa paɣi n nuhi.
en: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap.

dag: Amaa o naɣ ni yɛlimi, M pala anabi, n nyɛla pukpara. Tiŋgbani zuɣu ka man kul kuriya nahindi m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Instead, he will say, I am not a prophet. I am a farmer—I have farmed the land all my life.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana maa zaŋ sida dari mini taaŋkɔro wulli ni mi ʒee bahi buɣim din diri nahu maa ni.
en: Then the priest must take a cedar stick, a hyssop branch, and some red string. He must throw these things into the fire where the cow is burning.

dag: Di ni lan tilig a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn soya golim ka bɛ biɛhigu bi tuhi nuu ni.
en: Their ways are crooked; they lie and cheat.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yɛri lala chani maa, yim, ka chɛchɛbuŋ din mali buɣim mini di yuri din mali buɣim dii kana ti kpe bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni n-woligi ba, ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ dii kpuɣi Ilaija du zuɣusaa.
en: Elijah and Elisha were walking along and talking, when suddenly there appeared between them a flaming chariot pulled by fiery horses. At once, a strong wind took Elijah up into heaven.

dag: N ni ti a niriba bɛn yɛn ŋma dakuɣiri maa alikama biɛlim din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi ni wain lita tuhi kɔbisinahi ni olivi kpam lita tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: This is what I will pay for your servants to cut down the trees for wood. I will give them , bushels of wheat for food, , bushels of barley, , gallons of wine, and , gallons of oil.

dag: Dama Musa ni daa mali Yawɛ biɛhigu shee du shɛli tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni daa nyɔri sara maligunim la daa bela jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn la di saha maa.
en: The Lord s Holy Tent and the altar of burnt offerings were at the high place in the town of Gibeon. Moses had made the Holy Tent while the Israelites were in the desert.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a zo bee a ba zo bahi, ka miri ka a ti chaŋ a dɔɣira yiŋa a muɣisigu saha. A ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun be yoma so a mabihi bɛn be katiŋa.
en: Dont forget your own friends or your fathers friends. If you have a problem, go to your neighbor for help. It is better to ask a neighbor who is near than a brother who is far away.

dag: Amaa ka namɔɣilisi maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Napaɣ Vashiti naa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o daa zaɣisi ni o ku kana. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa maa suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: But Queen Vashti refused to come as the king had ordered through the eunuchs. The king was furious, his anger boiling inside.

dag: Kumiya bɛ naɣilahi zaa. Kɔrimiya ba. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ biɛɣu neeya, bɛ tibidarigibo saha paaya.
en: Kill the soldiers of Babylonia, because the time has come for them to be punished.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: dama Masidɔnianim mini Akaianim yuya ni bɛ tɔhi tɔto ti Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba be Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: Macedonia and Achaia have been happy to make a contribution for the poor among Gods people in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di mali goon titali din du pam ka mali dunoya pinaayi, ka malaikanim pinaayi ʒe dunoya maa ni, ka Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la yuya sab pa dunoya maa zuɣu;.
en: The city had a large, high wall with twelve gates. There were twelve angels at the gates. On each gate was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria naa shiri bahi niriba pam mini bɛ tiŋgbɔna yoli.
en: It is true, our Lord , that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yihi li daɣiri ni naai, yin zaŋmiya naɣilaa ŋun ka daŋa mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara.
en: When you have completed the purification, you will present a flawless bull from the herd and a flawless ram from the flock.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka liɣiri yɔhim a, a mi di chɛ ka birapu pam dibu kpɛh a yɔɣu.
en: Dont let them lure you with wealth; dont let a huge bribe mislead you.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli;.
en: Other people are like the seeds that fall on rocky ground. As soon as they hear the message, they receive it gladly.

dag: Nyɛvili be wuntizɔbo soli ni, ka nir yi doli di soli maa o ku kpi.
en: Righteousness is the road to life; wickedness is the road to death.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, yi ni zaɣisi so zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi dolibu, amaa ka dolila zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya niŋ sunsuuni la zaligunim la zuɣu. .
en: You will know that I am the Lord and that while you were keeping the laws of the neighboring nations, you were breaking my laws and disobeying my commands.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa lan yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu, m bɔrimi ni n lan zaŋ piɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ buɣisi bin yini pahi. N suhir a, chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gili piɛ gbaŋ maa, amaa ka chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kuma.
en: Then Gideon said to God, Dont be angry with me. Let me ask just one more thing. Let me test you one more time with the sheepskin. This time let the sheepskin be dry, while the ground around it gets wet with dew.

dag: ka hal dɔro maa ni daa mali ma maa zaa yoli, di zuɣu daa bi chɛ ka yi zo ka chɛ ma, ka mi daa bi mali ma ansarisi n-ʒiɛm ma, amaa ka daa deei ma kaman Naawuni malaika bee kaman Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa.
en: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali dahima, yin chɛliya ka ti tum sokam zaa tuun suma, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ mabi yinsi yɛda niŋbu puuni la.
en: So then, lets work for the good of all whenever we have an opportunity, and especially for those in the household of faith.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul mal o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa puuni yɛla bilisir o suhu ni saha shɛli maa ka Kɔniilius tuumba maa bɔhi n-kana ti ʒe Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzab yiŋ maa dunol ni.
en: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli nabihi ni daa gbi. Kolibil shɛli niriba toondaannim ni daa gbi. Nam jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi yɔɣu maa ni chaŋ Matana.
en: Great men dug this well. Important leaders dug this well. They dug this well with their staffs and walking sticks. It is a gift in the desert.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ o kɔhimma nyɔri ti yaɣi ni o nya buni pam, o bɔri li zaanila ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi nandaamba nirilim.
en: If you get rich by charging interest and taking advantage of people, your wealth will go to someone who is kind to the poor.

dag: O wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu; ka di chɛ ka n ni tooi zaŋ n nuhi dahim daanya tɔbu.
en: He trains me for battle, so that I can use the strongest bow.

dag: Kummiya kaman paɣisar so ŋun so buɣu n-kumdi nachimbil so ŋun di yɛn lo o amiliya zuɣu la.
en: Cry like a young woman crying because the man she was ready to marry has died.

dag: A yi gbib a noli min a zilinli, a ni yi yɛla ni.
en: If you want to stay out of trouble, be careful what you say.

dag: ni Mijamin ni Maadia ni Biliga.
en: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku tim yi puri ni bee yi wain tihi ni gari bee n-nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari. Ti ku ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo hal ti yi a tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Please let us go through your country. We won't go near your fields or vineyards, and we won't drink any water from your wells. We will stay on the main road until we leave your territory.

dag: A nyɛla ŋun yuri din tuhi, ka je zaɣ biɛɣu. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ piig a, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli niŋ a ni n-gari a na taba.
en: You love what is right and hate what is wrong. So God, your God, chose you to be king, giving you more joy and honor than anyone like you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be tooni ŋɔ ha ka n ti yihi waazu nimaani gba; dama di zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus answered, We should go to another place. We can go to other towns around here, and I can tell Gods message to those people too. That is why I came.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla binshɛŋa din niŋbu chihira n-zali n jɛmbu duu n-ta li daɣiri.
en: They set up their disgusting idols in the temple that bears my name and violated it.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o mali buɣim shɛli din yɛn di Asiria naa sɔŋ ka di waɣa. Buɣim maa dari kul pumi, ka doya yɛlim ka zilim pam. Yawɛ ni vuhi o vuhim din ŋmani chilibi bahi di zuɣu, ka di taai buɣim.
en: Long ago a place was prepared where a huge fire will burn the emperor of Assyria. It is deep and wide, and piled high with wood. The Lord will breathe out a stream of flame to set it on fire.

dag: Di yi pala Yawɛ m-me yili, bɛn mɛri li dirila wahala yoli. Di yi pala Yawɛ n-guli tiŋa, tiŋguliba gul li la yoli.
en: If it is not the Lord who builds a house, the builders are wasting their time. If it is not the Lord who watches over the city, the guards are wasting their time.

dag: amaa Naawuni yɛl ti, Miriya ka yi di ti shɛli din be puu ŋɔ sunsuuni ŋɔ wala bee n-shihi li gba, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: But there is one tree we must not eat from. God told us, You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden. You must not even touch that tree, or you will die.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun daŋ tooni daa chaŋ ti kpaag o laa ni dini bahi dunia ni, ka yuma din bie ka kabiri ʒim daa niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biŋkɔbigu la dalinli ka jɛmd o binnan la.
en: So the first angel poured his bowl on the earth, and a nasty and terrible sore appeared on the people who had the beasts mark and worshipped its image.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Siizaria ka bɛ zaŋ Pool ti zali Gomna maa tooni, ka zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti o.
en: When they came to Caesarea, they gave the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ zaɣis a ka leeg a dima, ka wula a lan bɔhiri ma?.
en: Samuel said, The Lord left you and is now your enemy, so why are you asking me for advice?.

dag: Ka sokam daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o suhu ni kul yu ni o zaŋ shɛli na ti ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ tum Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tuma mini neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ tumdi tuma di puuni ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa she binyɛr kasi la.
en: and everyone who wished to do so brought an offering to the Lord for making the Tent of the Lord 's presence. They brought everything needed for use in worship and for making the priestly garments.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun shɛŋa bee n-lihi nya o nuhi tuma la zuɣu, o ni daai ba luhi ka ku lan yiɣisi ba zali.
en: They dont notice what the Lord does. They ignore all the good things he has made. So instead of building them up, he will destroy them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zuɣulaan yino kam zaŋm o pina na ti malimi sara dahin yini kam, sara maligu bimbini maa zaŋ ti Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: the Lord said to Moses, Tell them that each day for a period of twelve days one of the leaders is to present his gifts for the dedication of the altar.

dag: Di pa shɛli yi ni saɣi ni m bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya, amaa ka lee yɛli ni n nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana ŋun zaŋ yɔhiŋgu gbahi ya.
en: We all know that I didnt place a burden on you, but in spite of that you think Im a con artist who fooled you with a trick.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mariama daa yiɣisi chaŋ yomyom ti paai zoya ni tin shɛli din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Soon afterward Mary got ready and hurried off to a town in the hill country of Judea.

dag: Yi yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, yin malimiya li ka di nyɛ din ni chɛ ka o deei yi sara maa.
en: When you kill an animal for a fellowship offering, keep the regulations that I have given you, and I will accept the offering.

dag: ni Kɛriɔt ni Bɔzira ni Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ fɔntinsi zaa din be yoma mini katiŋa.
en: to Kerioth and Bozrah, to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

dag: dama bɛn kpalim maa ni ti yi Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na n-galisi pam. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o ni chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will see to it that some who live in Jerusalem will survive.

dag: Naawuni bi bela zuɣusaa ha? Nyam saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha ni be zuɣusaa ha shɛm!.
en: God lives in the highest part of heaven and looks down on the highest stars.

dag: ka sagbani maa zuɣu chɛ ka Maligumaaniba maa kɔŋ bɛ tuma tumbu, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa.
en: shining with the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence, and they could not go back in to perform their duties.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Itiɔpia ni mini bɛn mali Ijipti nyuri bara la, ka vi gbahi ba.
en: Those who looked to Ethiopia for help will be shattered. Those who were amazed by Egypts glory will be ashamed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa yaha, Yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni n-teei li tiri kulibɔna mini ko soya ni kopurim ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti n-yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam.
en: And the LORD said to Moses, Tell Aaron, Stretch out your hand with your shepherds rod over the rivers, the canals, and the marshes, and make the frogs crawl up all over the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin maa dali di simdi ni maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa yaha; ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi bi yɛligi, ka kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim mi ka di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni.
en: On the seventh day, the priest must look at it again. If the disease has not spread, and there are no yellow hairs growing in it, and the disease does not seem deeper than the skin.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam n-niŋ nam maa ni la yuun pisinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili; ka o bia Nadab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He was king of Israel for years, then he died, and his son Nadab became king.

dag: Naawuni yubu zaŋ chaŋ yi sani nyɛla ni yi mali m-be kasi, ka di niŋdiya zina.
en: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.

dag: ka bɛ nyu li ka tam bɛ fara yɛla, ka ku lan teei bɛ suhugarigu yɛla.
en: Let them drink to forget their troubles. Let them forget they are poor.

dag: Niriba yi zabira, ka yino ti zaŋ kuɣili lab o kpee bee n-kpilim o nuu ŋme o kpee, ka o nya daŋa ka bi kpi, amaa ka lee dɔni.
en: When two people are fighting and one hits the other with a stone or with his fist so that he is in bed for a while but doesnt die.

dag: ka daa kpaŋsi li ka di leei zaligu Yaakubu sani, ka lan leei alikauli din ka bahigu Izraɛl san la.
en: The Lord made a covenant with Jacob, one that will last forever.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhoyakim daa tim Akibɔr bia Ɛlnatan mini do shɛba Ijipti.
en: But King Jehoiakim sent Elnathan son of Acbor and some other men to Egypt.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa niŋ sapashin kpɛm maa ni wuhi ba shɛm maa n-zaŋ Pool yuŋ m-mali ti paai Antipatiris.
en: The soldiers did what they were told. They got Paul and took him to the city of Antipatris that night.

dag: M puhiri n zuliya Hɛrɔdiɔn. M puhiri Narisisus yiŋnim bɛn be ti Duuma ni la.
en: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ti chaŋ maa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia daba anu dali ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yi Jɛrusalɛm zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli ma, Tiŋ maa luya.
en: On the fifth day of the tenth month in the twelfth year of exile, a person who had escaped from the battle in Jerusalem came to me and said, The city has been taken.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ ni o ti bu padiriba paa niŋ o puu ni.
en: Gods kingdom is like a man who owned some land. One morning, the man went out very early to hire some people to work in his vineyard.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Faashee a nya shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa, di yi pa lala, a ku niŋ yɛda.
en: Jesus said to him, Unless you see miraculous signs and wonders, you wont believe.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn biriti ka kumdi ti chɛ bɛ ni biri shɛli maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Let those who plant with tears reap the harvest with joyful shouts.

dag: Baalihanan ni daa ti kpi, Hadad n-daa di nam zan o zaani, o ya yuli n-daa booni Pai, o paɣ yuli n-daa booni Mɛhɛtabɛl, Mɛhɛtabɛl ma yuli n-daa booni Matirɛd, ka o yabipaɣa mi yuli daa booni Mɛzahab.
en: When Baal-hanan died, Hadad succeeded him; his city was called Pai. His wifes name was Mehetabel, Matreds daughter and Me-zahabs granddaughter.

dag: A zaligunim kul nyɛla din tuhi sahakam. Tim ma baŋsim din ni chɛ ka m be.
en: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ha ka ŋmani maa daa ŋmaai olivi tia vamahili n-gbab o noli lab o sanna ŋariŋ maa ni; ka Nuhu daa baŋ ni kom maa yipa nyuuya tiŋgban ni.
en: The dove came back to him in the evening, grasping a torn olive leaf in its beak. Then Noah knew that the waters were subsiding from the earth.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaai Lɛviatan n-labi duli na bee n-zaŋ mia lo o zilinli?.
en: Can you catch Leviathan with a fishhook or tie his tongue down with a rope?.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa ka pii maa gbinna ni o ti tuhi ba, ka chaŋ ti miri di dunol ni ni o niŋ buɣim nyo li.
en: When Abimelech came to attack the tower, he went up to the door to set the tower on fire.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla talahi ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim maa mali tarili, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛl zuliya daŋ yini niriba ku kpihim.
en: The men of Benjamin who are still alive must have children to continue their families. This must be done so that a tribe in Israel will not die out!.

dag: Yawɛ, a nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Lord , you are very kind. You always do what is right, so let me live.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka doo kpuɣi paɣa, amaa ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, ka di nyɛla binshɛli ka o nya ka di bi viɛl o sani, ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka o sabi paɣ yihibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa ka o chaŋ.
en: Suppose a man marries a woman and later decides that he doesn't want her, because he finds something about her that he doesn't like. So he writes out divorce papers, gives them to her, and sends her away from his home.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi ni zaŋ doo ŋɔ tahi n sanna nti yɛli ni o birigirila yi zuliya la, n vih o yi zaa ha ninni, amaa ka bi nya o taali ni yi ni fiɣis o shɛlikam zaa zuɣu maa.
en: He told them, You brought Jesus to me and said he was a troublemaker. But I have questioned him here in front of you, and I have not found him guilty of anything that you say he has done.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus said to him, I assure you that, before the rooster crows tonight, you will deny me three times.

dag: Ka niriba daa ʒe kpaŋ lihir o; amaa ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra, O daa tiligi shɛba, dinzuɣu o yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili ŋun nyɛ ŋun Naawuni Masia, ŋun tiligim omaŋa.
en: The people stood there watching while the Jewish leaders made fun of him: He saved others; let him save himself if he is the Messiah whom God has chosen.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, ti sa pun lab li mi yuŋ la zaa ka bi gbaai hal zin yino gba; amaa a ni kul yɛli ma shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni lab li.
en: Simon replied, Master, weve worked hard all night and caught nothing. But because you say so, Ill drop the nets.

dag: M mabia Failimɔn, n yi ti suhiri Naawuni tir a, n kul paɣir o mi sahakam.
en: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.

dag: Pool mini Baanabas ni daa be Aikɔnium maa ka bɛ daa ti doli taba chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti yihi waazu, ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim pam daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Paul and Barnabas went to the city of Iconium. As they did in Antioch, they entered the Jewish synagogue. They spoke to the people there. They spoke so well that many Jews and Greeks believed what they said.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba garigi yɛli.
en: Why do you keep tormenting me with words?.

dag: Yiɣisim zani, dama daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi a zuɣu ni n zal a ka a leei n tumo, ka niŋ a ni nya ma ni shɛlikam ŋɔ mini n ni na yɛn wuh a shɛli shɛhiralana.
en: Now stand up. I have appeared to you, because I have chosen you to be my servant. You are to tell others what you have learned about me and what I will show you later.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anabinim sabbu niŋ pali. Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But all this has happened so that what the prophets said in the scriptures might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left Jesus and ran away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛn me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun kpe di kpɛbu shee m-me li, ka di chɛ ka so daa bi wum matarika bee lɛhu bee kuribini vuri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ ni daa mɛri li maa.
en: When the temple was built, they did all the stonecutting at the quarry. No hammers, axes, or any iron tools were heard in the temple during its construction.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋdi bimbira tiri ŋun birita, ka chɛ ka o nyari bindirigu, ni tiri yi gba m-pahiri yi ni mali shɛli zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi nirilim niŋbu zooi pahi.
en: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.

dag: Teeku dulinim nyaya ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ kab laɣimna.
en: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near.

dag: Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn turi jilima yu shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ boli ya la?.
en: Arent they the ones who insult the good name spoken over you at your baptism?.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni ka o yihi ma bɛn bi niŋ yɛda ka be Judia la nuu ni, ka n ni ti yɛn tum tuun shɛli Jɛrusalɛm la ti tiɣi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be nimaani la nini.
