en: Pray that I will be rescued from the people in Judea who dont believe. Also, pray that my service for Jerusalem will be acceptable to Gods people there.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai saha shɛli maa, ka o dii wuɣiri duri zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kul lihir o hal ka sagbani ti lim o, ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: After Jesus had said this and while they were watching, he was taken up into a cloud. They could not see him.

dag: Sool mini Jɔnatan, n yurinima bɛn veeni yurilim. Bɛ daa bi woligi taba bɛ nyɛviya ni mini bɛ kum ni. Bɛ daa valim gari tɔrili. Bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari gbuɣima.
en: Saul and Jonathan, so wonderful and dear; together in life, together in death; swifter than eagles, stronger than lions.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa mi zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋmani nam ʒiishee, ka di biɛhigu ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛli safaya la. Ka binshɛli daa ʒi nam ʒiishee maa zuɣusaa, ka di kɔtomsi ŋmani daadam kɔtomsi.
en: Above the dome there was something that looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure that looked like a human being.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa tum din bie, dama o daa bi zaŋ o suhu zaa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu ni.
en: but he still did wrong and refused to obey the Lord .

dag: N kuhi pam boli Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o be o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu ka garigi ma.
en: I will pray to the Lord , and he will answer me from his holy mountain. Selah.

dag: Timiya sokam zaa jilima. Yumiya mabihili. Lumiya Naawuni sizuura. Timiya Nazuɣu jilima.
en: Honor everyone. Love the family of believers. Have respectful fear of God. Honor the emperor.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma mi tuhi pia. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba du Sɛla Zoli zuɣu nti daai ba Sɛla Zoli maa zuɣu luhi zolɔŋni, ka bɛ zaa chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: The Judean forces captured another ten thousand alive, brought them to the top of a cliff, and threw them off so that all were dashed to pieces.

dag: Bundana tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm omaŋ duhibu ni, amaa faralan ŋun mali fahim ni nya li o biɛhigu ni.
en: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia hal ti paag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah, captured him in the plains near Jericho, and all his soldiers deserted him.

dag: Jɔn daa di o shɛhira kuhi yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni daa yɛli so yɛla ni ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: John spoke about him and shouted, This is the one I told you would come! He is greater than I am, because he was alive before I was born.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋmaligim na tiligi ma; fam ma bahi a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu.
en: Come back to me, LORD! Deliver me! Save me for the sake of your faithful love!.

dag: Di saha maa ka Daadam Bia shihirili ni ti be zuɣusaa, ka zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti fabili, ka nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then a sign will appear in the sky. And there will be the Son of Man. All nations on earth will weep when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa tumbu, ka doli n zaligunima zaa, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: But if the wicked turn away from all the sins that they have committed, keep all my regulations, and act justly and responsibly, they will surely live and not die.

dag: M bia, chɛ ka a baɣa be n yɛligu ni. Gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛr a shɛm.
en: My child, pay attention to what I say. Listen to my words.

dag: N yura maa n su ma ka n gba su o. O chɛ ka o biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom shee.
en: I belong to my lover, and my lover belongs to me. He is the one feeding among the lilies.

dag: Joyakim saha la, maligumaaniba dunoya dɔɣirikpamba n-daa bɔŋɔ: Mɛraya n-daa nyɛ Sɛraya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Hanania daa nyɛ Jɛrimia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi doli buzɔŋ dunoli kpe, ka dula gooni kpe dilan nyɛla tayiɣa ni ŋmɛnditoli;.
en: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.

dag: A zaligu maa yi di pala n suhu ni yu shɛli, n naan bahi yoli n nandahima ŋɔ ni.
en: If I had not found joy in your teachings, my suffering would have destroyed me.

dag: Zuliya kam kul taarila duŋ ka nam kam damda. O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, tiŋgbani nyɛligirimi.
en: Nations roar; kingdoms crumble. God utters his voice; the earth melts.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpiɔŋ hal ti liri la zuɣusaa tɔbbihi, bɛna n-nyɛ saŋmarisi n-daa vooi bɛ shɛb bahi tiŋ na n-du tam bɛ zuɣu nɔra.
en: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, nir yi doli n yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: I assure you that whoever keeps my word will never die.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani zo n-chaŋ Adulam vokabili ni, ka o biɛyanim min o ba yiŋnim zaa daa ti wum o yɛla nimaani ka kahi chaŋ o sani.
en: David left Gath and ran away to the cave of Adullam. Davids brothers and relatives heard that David was at Adullam and went to see him there.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku lan nyɛ yi neesim wuntaŋ ni. Ka goli gba ku lan nyɛ yi neesim yuŋ. Man Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam, ka mani ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima neesim ni nɛn ya.
en: The sun will no longer be your light during the day. The light from the moon will no longer be your light at night. The Lord will be your light forever. Your God will be your glory.

dag: Bɛ malila ka shɛŋa din bi simdi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ Romnim ŋɔ doli n-wuhiri niriba.
en: who promote customs that we Romans cant accept or practice.

dag: Ka anab so ŋun daa goog o labisina maa daa wum li, ka yɛli, Anab so ŋun zaɣisi Yawɛ nol la m-bala. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yawɛ zaŋ o niŋ gbuɣinli maa nuu ni ka o gbaag o ku kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: The old prophet heard the story and said, This is the man of God who did not obey the Lord s command, so the Lord sent a lion to attack him. The lion has killed him, just as the Lord said would happen.

dag: Naawuni, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu ŋɔ; di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Hear my prayer, O God; don't turn away from my plea!.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa be kaman taŋkuɣibihi la lurina, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo di wari?.
en: God throws his hail down like crumbs— who can endure Gods freezing cold?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti dɔni o yaannim tooni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: David died and was buried in David's City.

dag: Di saha maa ka Gidiɔn daa baŋ ni Yawɛ malaika m-bala; ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, dama n nini nya Yawɛ malaika.
en: Then Gideon realized that he had been talking to the angel of the Lord . So he shouted, Oh, Lord GOD! I have seen the angel of the Lord face to face.

dag: Ka Yisifu dan maa daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o ti niŋ sarika ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ naa sarikanim niŋ, ka o daa be sarika maa ni.
en: and had Joseph arrested and put in the prison where the king's prisoners were kept, and there he stayed.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa nyaaŋa, ka Sintani kpe ŋun Judas suhu ni. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋmi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛli maa yomyom.
en: When Judas took the bread, Satan entered him. Jesus said to Judas, What you will do—do it quickly.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Cham Juda nayili nti zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ba.
en: The Lord said, Jeremiah, go down to the kings palace. Go to the king of Judah and tell this message there:.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ, gbaam amaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-malila biɛr kasi mini wuntitali ni yɛda ni yurilim ni ania niŋbu ni biɛribaalimtali.
en: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.

dag: N niŋdi lala ni di chɛ ka bɛ malila suhukpeeni ka laɣim zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili taba yurilim puuni, ka lan mali yɛlimaŋli baŋsim din tahiri tahima zaa din ŋmani azichi na. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ baŋ Naawuni ashili din nyɛ Masia maŋmaŋ la.
en: I want them to be strengthened and joined together with love and to have the full confidence that comes from understanding. I want them to know completely the secret truth that God has made known. That truth is Christ himself.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o ni bi yiɣisiri o suhu darigiri niriba tibili, ka mi bi doli bɛ ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Even though his anger is now held back, a person doesnt know its only delayed.

dag: Dinzuɣu n wum Izraɛlnim maa fabila zaŋ chaŋ Ijiptinim ni zaŋ ba leei daba maa polo, ka teei n ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Now I have seen how the people of Israel are suffering because of the Egyptians, and I will keep my promise.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa, yin zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni be kuɣu shɛŋa ni ŋɔ ti sa Ɛbal zoli zuɣu, ka niŋ tari ta li.
en: After you go across the Jordan River, you must do what I command you today. You must set up the stones on Mount Ebal. You must cover these stones with plaster.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, o di chɛ ka n nini nya o. Dinzuɣu ka Absalom daa be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, ka bi chani naa sani.
en: The king, however, gave orders that Absalom should not live in the palace. I don't want to see him, the king said. So Absalom lived in his own house and did not appear before the king.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa ʒini bɛ tinsi ni naai nyaaŋa, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka niriba maa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm naŋgban yini.
en: When the seventh month came and the Israelites were in their towns, the people gathered together as one in Jerusalem.

dag: Alɔbo maa lubu nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza.
en: After the epidemic the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi kana nti yɛl o, N dana, n-nyɛ a pɔŋli la. N daa zaŋ li gbinila binchɛra ni sɔɣi.
en: Another servant came and said, Sir, here is your money. I kept it safe in a handkerchief.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa vaai yiɣisi kaman o neela gom ni la bee m-be kaman tɔbutuhira ni yi nyu wain buɣi n-tahiri shɛm la.
en: Finally, our Lord got up like a man waking from his sleep, like a soldier after drinking too much wine.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ bɛ paɣiba ti shɛba, ka zaŋ bɛ puri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyaŋ ba maa, dama bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa suhu kul yɛla alaha dibu zuɣu. Anabinim zaŋ tabili maligumaaniba zaa bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli.
en: So I will give their fields to new owners and their wives to other men. Everyone, great and small, tries to make money dishonestly. Even prophets and priests cheat the people.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Firawuna, A zahima maa nyɛla zaɣ yini, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuhi nyin Firawuna maa.
en: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, Both of these dreams have the same meaning. God is telling you what will happen soon.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, So m-bi bu ti paa. Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma.
en: They said, No one gave us a job. The man said to them, Then you can go and work in my vineyard.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha.
en: As surely as I live, says the LORD God, no longer will you use this proverb in Israel!.

dag: ni Jokim ni Kɔzɛbanima ni Jɔash ni Saraf ŋun daa di nam su Mɔabnima; ka daa ti lan labi Lɛhɛm la.
en: Jokim and the people who lived in the town of Cozeba; and Joash and Saraph, who married Moabite women and then settled in Bethlehem.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ tibig a yuli ʒiɛmani kam ni ka yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka a chɛ ka mani a dabili Dauda zuliya nya zaashee zani a tooni.
en: Your fame will be great, and people will forever say, The Lord Almighty is God over Israel. And you will preserve my dynasty for all time.

dag: Be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi alizanda ni ka lihi tiŋ na n-niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim min a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannima ni di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam la.
en: Look down from your holy place in heaven and bless your people Israel; bless also the rich and fertile land that you have given us, as you promised our ancestors.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe dundombila din be wulimpuhili polo ni nti buɣisi dunɔdali, ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.

dag: Man Naa Atazɛrikisɛs zali laɣiguliba zaa bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili la zaligu ni bɛ tim nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la a ni kul bɔri shɛlikam bɛ sani kaliŋkaliŋ.
en: I command all the treasury officials in West-of-Euphrates Province to provide promptly for Ezra, the priest and scholar in the Law of the God of Heaven, everything he asks you for.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ niriba maa kuli Yisifu yiŋa kaman o ni daa wuh o shɛm maa.
en: The man did as Joseph told him and brought the men to Josephs house.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba benya kaman kuɣ nɛma la kana, ka Naawuni zaŋ ya me o jɛmbu duu ka yi leei Naawuni maligumaaniba bɛn be kasi, ka maani sara maligu shɛŋa Naawuni ni deeri Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.

dag: Ka Filip daa bɔ n-nya Nataniɛl yɛl o, Ti nya Anabi Musa ni daa sab so yɛla o zaligu kundinim ni min anabinim gba ni daa sab so yɛla la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Yisifu bia ŋun yi Nazarɛt na la.
en: Philip found Nathanael and told him, We have found the man that Moses wrote about in the law. The prophets wrote about him too. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph. He is from Nazareth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka shiri zaŋ Keenannim maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni; ka bɛ daa ku ba ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Hɔrima.
en: The Lord answered their prayer and helped them wipe out the Canaanite army and completely destroy their towns. That's why one of the towns is named Hormah, which means Destroyed Place.

dag: ni di chɛ ka Sulemaana yɛm maa gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa yɛm zaŋ tabili Ijiptinim zaa yɛm.
en: He was wiser than anyone in the East or in Egypt.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ wuhi ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni, amaa pa daliri suŋ zuɣu ka bɛ niŋdi lala. Bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ woligi m mini ya din ni chɛ ka yi baɣa be bɛ ni.
en: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man kul suhira. Naawuni, garigim ma a ni zali saha shɛli a yurilim maŋli din galisi la puuni min a ʒiɛyimtali sɔŋsim la puuni.
en: As for me, Lord , this is my prayer to you: Please accept me! God, I want you to answer me with love. I know I can trust you to save me.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam! Dama nandahima pam ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka Naawuni suhu ti yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: During that time it will be hard for women who are pregnant or have small babies, because very bad times will come to this land. God will be angry with these people.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛɣ asiba, o yi sa chani mɔɣili ni, nyin sa zaŋm a jaaŋgbe shɛli din daa leei wahu la niŋ a nuu ni chaŋ ti zani mɔɣili maa duli gul o.
en: In the morning Pharaoh will go out to the river. Go to him by the edge of the Nile River. Take the walking stick that became a snake.

dag: Di saha ka o daa teeg omaŋ pa bia maa zuɣu napɔŋ buta, ka suhi Yawɛ, yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka bia ŋɔ nyɛvili lab o ni na yaha.
en: Then Elijah lay on top of the boy three times. He prayed, Lord my God, let this boy live again.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala, kola maa ni chɛhichɛhi, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli n-lɛrila kol pala ni, ka di bina ayi maa zaa shɛli ku saɣim.
en: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa nya buŋ yɛno kɔbili kpuɣ li n-zaŋ li ku ninvuɣ tuhili.
en: Samson found a jawbone of a dead donkey and killed Philistine men with it.

dag: Taɣimi gban shɛli n-sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa kul be tuuli gban shɛli Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa nyo buɣim la puuni la niŋ di ni.
en: Get another scroll. Write all the messages on it that were on the first scroll that King Jehoiakim of Judah burned.

dag: Di saha ka Filistianim daa kana ti dɔni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti liri Lɛhinima.
en: The Philistines marched up, made camp in Judah, and released their forces on Lehi.

dag: O daa bi tum alahichi, ka yɛmbimbiɛri yɛtɔɣa mi daa ka o nol ni.
en: He committed no sin, and no one ever heard a lie come from his lips.

dag: Bɛ tɛhirila bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni tamiya. O ŋmaligila o nini bahi kpaŋa, o kul ku nya li sahakam.
en: The wicked say to themselves, God doesn't care! He has closed his eyes and will never see me.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim baŋ n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli din be kasi maa yaha. Ka zuliya kam ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi. .
en: I will make sure that my people Israel know my holy name, and I will not let my name be disgraced any more. Then the nations will know that I, the Lord , am the holy God of Israel.

dag: Amaa kul zoomiyala ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia daanfaani min o baŋbu puuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnkam ʒe Ijipti nyaaŋa ni ti lu, ka di ni mali yaa shɛli nyuri bara la naai. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, From Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south, all Egypt's defenders will be killed in battle. Egypt's proud army will be destroyed. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dunɔguliba bɛn ʒiya m-bi gbihiri hal ka bɛ duuma ti paana mal alibarika. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o gba ni ti mali shili chɛ ka bɛ ʒini, ka o kpuɣi bindirigu na ti zali ba ka bɛ di.
en: Servants are fortunate if their master finds them awake and ready when he comes! I promise you he will get ready and let his servants sit down so he can serve them.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Antiɔk, ka niriba pam daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ yihiri waazu ka wuhiri niriba ti Duuma yɛligu.
en: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch. They and many others taught the believers and told other people the Good News about the Lord.

dag: Amaa fɔntinsi maa ni biŋkɔbiri mini di nɛma zaa, ti daa zaŋ li ka di leei ti ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.

dag: Dunɔguliba: Akub mini Talimɔn ni bɛ taba bɛn daa guli dunoya la zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: These are the gatekeepers who moved into Jerusalem: Akkub, Talmon, and of their brothers. They watched and guarded the gates of the city.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani ti pihiri li asiba kam sokam dibu tariga, amaa wuntaŋ daa yi ti bii, di nyɛligirimi.
en: Every morning they gathered it, as much as each person could eat. But when the sun grew hot, it melted away.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko; bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi.
en: Six days later Jesus took Peter, James, and John, and brought them to the top of a very high mountain where they were alone. He was transformed in front of them.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnana bee n-zaŋ dari kpe biŋŋmahima bee n-sa daantalisi bee n-zaŋ kuɣa biŋŋmahima sa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi li, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God! So don't make or worship idols or images.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees said, Why are you doing that? It is against the Law of Moses to do that on the Sabbath day.

dag: Amaa ka Leeban yɛl o, Chɛ ka n yɛl a, n vihiya nya ka di nyɛla a zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni;.
en: Laban said to him, Do me this favor. Ive discovered by a divine sign that the LORD has blessed me because of you.

dag: Yɛndana niŋdila binshɛɣukam ni yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun wuhirila jɛrilim palo ni.
en: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.

dag: Amaa Sool min o niriba maa daa bi ku Agag mini piɛ viɛla ni naɣ viɛla ni naɣibihi viɛla ni piɛbihi viɛla. Binshɛɣukam din daa viɛla, bɛ daa bi saɣim li, amaa binshɛɣukam din daa bi viɛla, bɛ daa saɣim di zaa.
en: Saul and his army let Agag live, and they also spared the best sheep and cattle. They didn't want to destroy anything of value, so they only killed the animals that were worthless or weak.

dag: yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli ti Duuma shiri neei kum ni; hal o yi Saimɔn zuɣu.
en: said, The Lord really has risen from death! He appeared to Simon.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nir yi bɔri tiwal suma, faashee o malila ti suŋ; amaa o yi malila ti biɛɣu, tiwal biɛri ka o ni nya, dama bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni.
en: To have good fruit you must have a healthy tree; if you have a poor tree, you will have bad fruit. A tree is known by the kind of fruit it bears.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim taba n-ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a daŋ niriba.
en: Israel's leaders met with David at Hebron and said, We are your relatives.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka doo kpuɣi paɣa, amaa ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, ka di nyɛla binshɛli ka o nya ka di bi viɛl o sani, ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka o sabi paɣ yihibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa ka o chaŋ.
en: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa chɛ ka Tarishish ŋarima tatabo chaŋ Ofiri ni bɛ ti ʒi salima na; amaa ka di daa bi paai, dama ŋarima maa daa saɣimla Ɛziɔngɛba.
en: King Jehoshaphat had ocean-going ships built to sail to the land of Ophir for gold; but they were wrecked at Eziongeber and never sailed.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti sa zahimla zahima ka bi nya ŋun ni wuhi ti di gbinni. Ka Yisifu bɔhi ba, Pa Naawuni n-wuhiri zahindi gbinni? N suhiri ya, yɛlimiya ma yi zahima maa.
en: They answered, Weve both had dreams, but theres no one to interpret them. Joseph said to them, Dont interpretations belong to God? Describe your dreams to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn wuhi ba mi, n ni wuhi ba n yaa mini n yiko, ka bɛ baŋ ni n yuli m booni Yawɛ.
en: So I will teach those who make idols. Right now I will teach them about my power and my strength. Then they will know that I am God. They will know that I am the Lord .

dag: A mi bɛ ni turi ma, ka dihiri ma vi, ka filindi ma shɛm yɛla; a mi n dimnim zaa.
en: You know the shame I have suffered. You know all my enemies. You saw how they humiliated me.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn lola yi mini yi zuliya.
en: I am now making my covenant with you and with your descendants.

dag: Yuma maa yi galisi, nyin pahimi liɣiri, ka yuma maa yi bi galisi, nyin filimmi liɣiri maa, dama a ni yɛn kpuɣi atam shɛm ka o kɔhiri tir a maa.
en: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma ŋɔ zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka Ijipti Naa Nɛko daa chaŋ Karikɛmish din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la ni o ti tuhi tɔbu; ka Jɔsia gba daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Naa Nɛko.
en: Some time later, King Neco of Egypt led his army to the city of Carchemish on the Euphrates River. And Josiah led his troops north to meet the Egyptians in battle.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman wurigu la pɔhim tooni, ka Yawɛ malaika kari ba bahi.
en: May they be like straw blown by the wind as the angel of the Lord pursues them!.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya o ni nam binshɛɣukam maa zaa, ka di viɛl pam. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayɔbu.
en: God looked at everything he had made. And he saw that everything was very good. There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the sixth day.

dag: Chɛ ka a ba min a ma mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka paɣ ŋun dɔɣ a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Let your father and mother be proud of you; give your mother that happiness.

dag: Ti dimnim maa ni daa wum ni ti baŋ bɛ ni lɔri nia shɛli maa yɛla, ka baŋ ni Naawuni nyaŋ ba bɛ ni lo nia shɛli maa ni, ka ti zaa daa lan lab gooni maa gbini, ka sokam ti tumd o tuma.
en: Our enemies heard that we had found out what they were plotting, and they realized that God had defeated their plans. Then all of us went back to rebuilding the wall.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛl ti ni ti chɛ ka ti bebu doli zaligu shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim la, amaa ka ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum ti a.
en: and rejected your teachings that came to us from your servants the prophets.

dag: O daa chɛ ka dɔro be o tooni chana, ka alɔbo doli nyaaŋa.
en: Pestilence walks in front of him. Plague marches at his feet.

dag: N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Taasus, Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa n zoola Gamaliɛl sani ya ŋɔ; ka bɔhim n yaannim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya yɛla o sani, ka n suhu ye Naawuni zuɣu kaman yi zaa ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia, but brought up here in Jerusalem as a student of Gamaliel. I received strict instruction in the Law of our ancestors and was just as dedicated to God as are all of you who are here today.

dag: Tinzunnima, Laɣimmiya, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Tin shɛŋa din be katinsinima, wummiya. Lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Iin, lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm shiri mali ya.
en: Gather together in fear, you nations! Listen, you distant parts of the earth. Get ready to fight, but be afraid! Yes, get ready, but be afraid!.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi ŋubi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din nyɛ kasi zaa. Naawuni zaŋ li mi tin ya ni yi yihi niriba maa taali ni ka mali bɛ taali ni yibu maa sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Why didnt you eat the purification offering in the holy area? Its most holy, and it was assigned to you for bearing the communitys punishment by making reconciliation for them before the LORD.

dag: M puhir a a ni deei n suhigu ka leei n tiligira ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.

dag: Ka dabili mi na ʒi n-kpalim be ŋun su o yiŋa sahakam, amaa yilibia ŋun kul ni beni sahakam.
en: A slave isnt a permanent member of the household, but a son is.

dag: Miri ka a fiɣisi dabili o dan sani, di yi niŋ lala dabili maa ni tu a, ka a leei ŋun mali taali.
en: Never say bad things about a slave to his master. If you do, he will curse you, and you will suffer for it.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni.
en: So, since we have such a hope, we act with great confidence.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma, n jilima zoya kaman pɔhim n-ʒe li chaŋ la, ka n tɔŋsim zo kaman sagbani n-fuɣi gari la.
en: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud.

dag: Ka nambɔɣu daa gbaai Yisa, ka o teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛl o, N saɣiya; di naama.
en: These last words made Jesus angry. But he touched him and said, I want to heal you. Be healed.

dag: Zɛrubabɛl n-sɔŋ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu ŋɔ tampuɣili. O mi ni me li naai. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n niriba maa baŋ ni mani n-shiri tim a bɛ sanna.
en: The hands of Zerubbabel laid the foundation of this house, and his hands will finish it so that you will know that the LORD of heavenly forces has sent me to you.

dag: So ti ku me o yili ka shɛb deei li kpe m-beni, ka so mi ti ku sa tihi ka shɛb deei di wala di. N niriba maa ni di bɛ nuhi tuma daanfaani. Tihi ni yɛn yuuri shɛm, lala ka n niriba maa gba yɛn yuura.
en: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.

dag: dindina n ni niŋ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm la, ka chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ leei noli ni di shɛli dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam sani.
en: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name Jerusalem as a curse word.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali du shɛli din be puuni la mini du titali maa dukpina ka ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi ŋmahima pa di zuɣu.
en: The walls of the main room and of the inner room were all decorated with carved figures of winged creatures, palm trees, and flowers.

dag: Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ nya paɣiba ti bɛ ni shɛb bɛn kpalim la? Dama ti pun po Yawɛ sani ni ti ni so di zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti ba.
en: We made a promise with an oath before the Lord . We promised not to allow our daughters to marry a man from Benjamin. How can we make sure that the men of Benjamin will have wives.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a sujee saha, bee n saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: Please, LORD, dont punish me when you are mad; dont discipline me when you are furious.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garig o bɔhigunim maa zaa, ka binshɛɣu daa kani din sɔɣi ka Sulemaana bi tooi kahigi li wuhi paɣ maa.
en: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.

dag: Di simdi ni a guni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so a yiŋa min a ni zaŋ a liɣiri da so na zaa. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n daalikauli maa be yi niŋgbuna ni n-nyɛ alikauli din ni be sahakam.
en: Each one must be circumcised, and this will be a physical sign to show that my covenant with you is everlasting.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga nudirigu polo, yi tiŋgbani maa tintariga yɛn pilila Tama zaŋ hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi kulibɔŋ ni n-zaŋ nimaani doli Ijipti tintariga hal ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: amaa ka Pool ŋun daa bi tɛhi ni di luhiya ni bɛ lan ʒi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zani Pamfilia ŋ-ŋmaligi lab ka chɛ ba ka bi doli ba paai bɛ tuma tariga la.
en: But Paul did not want to, because Mark had left them in Pamphylia and had stopped working with them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirigi bɛ ni yɛn kpa tiŋgbani maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo ti taba. Ɛhab kɔŋko daa kpala yaɣ yini polo; ka Obadia mi kɔŋko kpa yaɣ din la polo.
en: They decided where each of them would go to look for water. Ahab went in one direction by himself, and Obadiah went in another direction by himself.

dag: Naawuni ŋun yihi ya Ijipti na ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yila yi sani. Yi nyandi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi dimnima. Yi kabiri bɛ kɔba. O ni to ba o piɛma.
en: God brought them out of Egypt. They are as strong as a wild ox. They will defeat all their enemies. They will break their bones and shatter their arrows.

dag: Ka kum daa wum o pam ka o bɔri bindirigu ni o di, amaa ka bɛ daa na duɣirimi; di saha maa ka o daa nya ʒii.
en: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli naa N ni daa be n ya ka wum a tuma min a yɛm yɛla shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: She said to the king, What I heard in my own country about you and your wisdom is true!.

dag: Wɔr ʒiɛhi n-daa vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din daŋ tooni, ka wɔr sabila vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi.
en: Red horses were pulling the first chariot. Black horses were pulling the second chariot.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Daadam Bia labina ni o nam.
en: I assure you that some standing here wont die before they see the Human One coming in his kingdom.

dag: yin yɛlimiya: Ti yab daa nyɛla Aram nira ŋun chani ginda, ka o daa ti chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti n-nyɛ sana, bɛ kalinli daa bi yaɣi lala. Nimaani ka o zuliya daa ti nabi n-galisi ka mali yaa pam.
en: Then, in the Lord 's presence you will recite these words: My ancestor was a wandering Aramean, who took his family to Egypt to live. They were few in number when they went there, but they became a large and powerful nation.

dag: Tim ka Giliad? Dɔɣite ka nimaani? Ka bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ bi nya alaafee?.
en: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then have my people not been restored to health?.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia daa mali buni pam ka niriba daa tir o jilima. O daa mɛla omaŋmaŋ nɛma zalibu shee duri, n-zaŋdi o da anzinfa min o salima ni o kuɣ viɛla ni o tulaale ni o nyɔtaɣirisi ni o binshɛɣukam din mali shaara pam.
en: Hezekiah had many riches and much honor. He made places to keep silver, gold, valuable jewels, spices, shields, and all kinds of things.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tiligi ti ka boli ti ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi, ka di pala ti ni tum shɛli zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ni lo shɛm min o daanfaan shɛl o ni daa pun niŋ niŋ ti ni Yisa Masia zuɣu ʒiɛmana din gari la ni ha la zuɣu.
en: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Ti yaannim Naawuni m-piig a ni a baŋ o yubu ka nya ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana n-wum o nol ni yɛligu;.
en: Then Ananias told me, The God that our ancestors worshiped has chosen you to know what he wants done. He has chosen you to see the One Who Obeys God and to hear his voice.

dag: n ni ti zaŋ li niŋ zuliya shɛb naa nuu ni, ka o ti niŋ li kaman di tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm. N ni ti yihi li bahi.
en: So I let a powerful king have that tree. That ruler punished the tree for the bad things it did. I took that tree out of my garden.

dag: N yi bol o ka o saɣi, m bi niŋ yɛda ni o ni gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: If I were to call and he answered me, I couldnt believe that he heard my voice.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa moori buɣim mini lahi. Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa mali binshɛŋa zaa kuli.
en: Nebuzaradan took all the firepans and bowls. He took all the things made of gold for the gold. And he took everything made of silver for the silver.

dag: Ka n daa galim ba ka yɛli noli ti ba, ka bu bɛ ni shɛba ka dari sibi bɛ zabiri. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa chɛ ka bɛ po pɔri Naawuni yuli ni yɛli ni bɛmaŋmaŋ bee bɛ bihi ku lan kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba bee n-zaŋ bɛ bipuɣinsi n-ti ba ka bɛ niŋ bɛ paɣiba.
en: I reprimanded the men, called down curses on them, beat them, and pulled out their hair. Then I made them take an oath in God's name that never again would they or their children intermarry with foreigners.

dag: Bɛ daa ti tahi alizin biɛɣu ni ʒi zoom bir so zuɣu Yisa sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ zaa, ka o nina maa gba neei, hal ka o lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira.
en: Then some people brought to Jesus a man who was blind and could not talk because he had a demon. Jesus healed the man, so that he was able to talk and see.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu tuhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ni Anduru bɔh o ashilɔni.
en: Later, Jesus was sitting at a place on the Mount of Olives. He was alone with Peter, James, John, and Andrew. They could all see the Temple, and they said to Jesus.

dag: N ni tooi tam ninvuɣ biɛtali azichi din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi mini bɛ ni mali kuruwabihi shɛŋa zahindi binyara ka niriba galindi ba la yɛla?.
en: You store up stolen treasures and use dishonest scales.

dag: Adam daa bol o paɣ maa yul la Awa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninsalinim zaa ma.
en: Adam named his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all human beings.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi sokam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Anab titali ka dunia ŋɔ ni na nti be ti sani. Ka bɛ lan yɛli, Naawuni n-ka o niriba sani maa na.
en: Everyone was filled with fear. They began praising God and said, A great prophet is here with us! and God is taking care of his people.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna Pailɛt yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: The soldiers led Jesus away into the courtyard of the palace known as the governors headquarters, and they called together the whole company of soldiers.

dag: Nyama, n Duuma NAAWUNI daa wuhi ma, ka n nya ka o namla toli ka bɛ galisi pam, bɛ ni daa chɛ nayili wɔrimɔri, ka mɔri maa lan piligi puhirina saha shɛli.
en: I had a vision from the Sovereign Lord . In it I saw him create a swarm of locusts just after the king's share of the hay had been cut and the grass was starting to grow again.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti yihi alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa kpam zaa, kpam din pili namanama la mini namanama maa ni kpam zaa.
en: Then he will remove all the fat from the bull for the purification offering: the fat that covers and surrounds the insides.

dag: N yɛliya, Timiya ma pini? Bee Piimiya yi buni shɛli m-pa talima ti ma?.
en: Have I said, Give me something? Offer a bribe from your wealth for me?.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni bitali maa mi bi yila ninsalinim ni dɔɣi ba la ni na bee n-yi ninsalinim yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni yubu ni ka di yina.
en: They were not God's children by nature or because of any human desires. God himself was the one who made them his children.

dag: Miri ka a bɔh a kpee biɛri bee n-je suli niŋ o, amaa yum a kpee kaman amaŋ la. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord , and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kul shini, ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama Naa Hɛzɛkia daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: But the people kept quiet and didnt answer him with a single word, because King Hezekiahs command was, Dont answer him.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa daa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa yɛli ba shɛm la, Labimiyana dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali.
en: Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam on the third day, just as the king had specified when he said, Come back in three days.

dag: Dauda ni daa tuhi Amalɛknim maa ka labina Naa Sool kum maa nyaaŋa, o daa kpalimla Zikilag daba ayi.
en: After Saul's death David came back from his victory over the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag for two days.

dag: Deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani.
en: if you obey all his commands that I have given you today, and do what he requires.

dag: nti duɣi n ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Cook some of that tasty food that I love so much and bring it to me. I want to eat it once more and give you my blessing before I die.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa kari doli Jɛrɔbɔam nti ŋme n-deeg o tinsi; Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛshana mini di tiŋkpansi ni Ɛfurɔn mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi paɣ maa ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches anything on which she has sat must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa maa o gbaɣino min o nyɔtaɣirigu tuɣibu shee, di saha ka o daa yɛli tɔbbi so ŋun daa duhir o chɛchɛbuŋ maa, Ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni, dama n nya daŋa. .
en: By chance, however, a Syrian soldier shot an arrow which struck King Ahab between the joints of his armor. I'm wounded! he cried out to his chariot driver. Turn around and pull out of the battle.

dag: Zatu daŋ — kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: the descendants of Zattu:.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Hilikia maa mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Maika bia Abidɔn ni Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni naa kpambala Asaaya.
en: The king ordered Hilkiah, Shaphans son Ahikam, Micahs son Abdon, the secretary Shaphan, and the royal officer Asaiah as follows.

dag: N dabili Musa kpiya, dinzuɣu a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa yiɣisim pumpɔŋɔ n-chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-kuli n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yinim Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni.
en: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini ka bi garigi shɛli. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa lan bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Alibarikalan Bia la.
en: But Jesus was silent and didnt answer. Again, the high priest asked, Are you the Christ, the Son of the blessed one.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa maani o tuumba maa ansarisi, ka zaɣis o yɛligu wumbu, ka lar o daanabinima, ka Yawɛ suhu ti yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu pam hal ka di ti kɔŋ tim.
en: But they made fun of Gods messengers, treating Gods words with contempt and ridiculing Gods prophets to such an extent that there was no hope of warding off the LORDs rising anger against his people.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim maa daa yɛli Dauda, Anzinfa bee salima din pala din ni mali ti mini Sool ni o zuliya maa yɛlli maa, di mi pala ti bɔrimi ni ti ku Izraɛl ninvuɣ so. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: The Gibeonites answered, Silver and gold from Saul and his family are not enough. On the other hand, we don't have the right to put any Israelite to death. David said, I'll do whatever you ask.

dag: Ninsal niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa ka mali yaɣ bɔbili ka di zaa tuma bi nyɛ yim la.
en: Each one of us has one body, and that body has many parts. These parts dont all do the same thing.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔbiri ŋmani paɣiba zabiri, ka bɛ nyina be kaman gbuɣinli nyina la.
en: Their hair was like womens hair. Their teeth were like lions teeth.

dag: Amaa yi yi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so, yi tum alahichi, ka Naawuni zaligu nya yi taali ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla zaligusaɣindiba.
en: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.

dag: N daa ti lihi n yiŋ takɔro voya ni.
en: When from the window of my house, from behind the screen, I gazed down.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa Zin mɔɣu ni zaŋ hal ti paai Rɛhɔb din daa miri Lɛbohamat la.
en: They went up and explored the land from the Zin desert to Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe Odɛd bia Azaria ni.
en: The Spirit of God came on Azariah, who was Obeds son.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu deeri birapu ashilɔni ni di chɛ ka o taɣi zaligu soya.
en: A wicked judge will accept a bribe, and that keeps justice from being done.

dag: Ka di ʒiɛmani maa niriba zaa gba daa ti kpi. Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din paya niriba daa yiɣisina. Bɛn daa bi mi Yawɛ bee m-mi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: After a while the people of Joshua's generation died, and the next generation did not know the Lord or any of the things he had done for Israel.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili liri Alikauli Adaka maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: Then Moses put the Holy Box into the Holy Tent. He hung the curtain in the right place to protect it. In this way he protected the Box of the Agreement behind the curtain just as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm. Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka sokam yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: Youve heard his insult against God. What do you think? They all condemned him. He deserves to die.

dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ashidɔd nayiya mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nayiya, Laɣimmiya Samaria zoya zuɣu nti nya taawaaye niŋbu mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din tumdi nimaani.
en: Announce to those who live in the palaces of Egypt and Ashdod: Gather together in the hills around Samaria and see the great disorder and the crimes being committed there.

dag: Ka ŋunkam saɣim Naawuni zaligu zaɣ yini ni mali di zaa saɣimbu taali.
en: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.

dag: Diribarilimlan nyɛla ŋun bɔri zabili, amaa ŋunkam niŋ Yawɛ naani ni tɔŋ.
en: Greedy people stir up conflict, but those who trust the LORD become prosperous.

dag: Man Yawɛ m-bol a wuntitali puuni. Mani n-gbaag a nuu ni ka gbib a. N zaŋ a mi lo niriba alikauli, ni a nyɛ zuliya kam neesim.
en: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi piapia chani Lɛbanɔn nti niŋdi goli yiniyini ka tiri taba. Bɛ daa niŋdila goli yiniyini Lɛbanɔn, ka niŋdi chira ayiyi yiŋ mi. Adɔniram n-daa nyɛ niriba maa zuɣulana.
en: He chose a man named Adoniram to be in charge of them. Solomon divided the men into three groups with , men in each group. Each group worked one month in Lebanon and then went home for two months.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n je anabi shɛb bɛn mali bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisiri ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: Im against the prophets who carelessly deliver oracles, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Afɛk la, ka Izraɛlnim mi laɣim biliga din be Jɛziriil tiŋgban ni la gbini.
en: Meanwhile, the Philistines had gathered all of their army camps at Aphek. The Israelites were camped by the spring near Jezreel.

dag: N ku lan chɛ ka yi wum zuliya shɛb turi, yi mi ku lan nya filiŋ zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya maa lu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You wont have to listen anymore to the taunts of the nations or endure the scorn of the peoples. And you will no longer deprive your nation of anything. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Pumpɔŋɔ Shiiba Bikiri bia ŋɔ ni niŋ ti barina pam n-gari Absalom ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la, dinzuɣu zaŋm a dan tɔbbihi ŋɔ m-biɛh o naba, di yi pa lala o ni ti kpe tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ ni me goondahi gili ni, ka muɣisi ti.
en: So David said to Abishai, Sheba will hurt us more than Absalom ever did. Take my best soldiers and go after him. We don't want him to take over any walled cities and get away from us.

dag: Sana bee tinzun nir yi be yi sani ka ti leei bundana, ka yi mabia mi leei faralana, ka zaŋ omaŋa pa talima san maa bee tinzun nir maa bee san maa yiŋ ninvuɣ so sani.
en: Suppose a foreigner living with you becomes rich, while some Israelites become poor and sell themselves as slaves to that foreigner or to a member of that foreigner's family.

dag: Hal o yi kari ma o tuma maa ni pumpɔŋɔ, m mi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka m mini niriba be.
en: I know what Ill do so that, when I am removed from my management position, people will welcome me into their houses.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dɔɣi bihi n-nabi ka yɛligi pam, ka mali yaa m-pali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: But the Israelites were fertile and became populous. They multiplied and grew dramatically, filling the whole land.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi jɛmd a la zuɣu. Dama bɛna n-vali Yaakubu zuliya. Bɛ vali Yaakubu zuliya n-naai ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni daŋ tila Judanim nasara, din ni chɛ ka Naa Dauda zuliya mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni yɛn nya jilima shɛli ku gari Judanim dini.
en: The LORD will first deliver the tents of Judah so that the splendor of Davids house and the splendor of Jerusalems inhabitants wont overshadow Judah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, N dana, a tiligi ti nyɛviya; ka di yi niŋ a nyaɣisim, ti ni leei Firawuna daba.
en: Sir, you have saved our lives! they answered. We are glad to be slaves of the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Izraɛlnim maa tooni guui kpa mɔɣu polo, amaa bɛ daa bi tooi zo n-tiligi. Bɛn daa yi tiŋ maa puuni na la daa taɣi ba niŋ sunsuuni n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: So the army of Benjamin ran away from the army of Israel. They ran toward the desert. But they could not escape the fighting. And the men of Israel came out of the cities and killed them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya Nyini karimbaandan ŋɔ, n yi n-zan a zuɣu. A biɛɣu neeya, n ni yɛn darig a tibili saha shɛli maa paaya.
en: Babylonia, you are filled with pride, so I, the Sovereign Lord Almighty, am against you! The time has come for me to punish you.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu ka taari duŋ, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha dii paami maa.
en: When you hear about wars and riots, don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but this isn't the end.

dag: N nyɛla sana m-be yi sani, timiya ma luɣ shɛli ka n zaŋ li leei n kpiimba sɔɣibu shee n-zaŋ n kpim ŋɔ ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: I am only a foreigner staying in your country. I have no place to bury my wife. Please give me some land so that I can bury her.

dag: N daa bi zaɣisi ka m mali ŋun ni wum n yɛtɔɣa. M bi zaɣisi ka n dim maa di sabi o ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ma ŋɔ sɔŋ.
en: Oh, that I had someone to hear me! Heres my signature; let the Almighty respond, and let my accuser write an indictment.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna, ka Balaam daa yɛl o, M me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaa zuɣu.
en: God granted Balaam an appearance. Balaam said to him, I have arranged seven altars and I have sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: Ka Anduru daa dii chaŋ ti bo n-nya o mabia Saimɔn n-yɛl o, Ti nya Masia la.
en: He first found his own brother Simon and said to him, We have found the Messiah .

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa wuh o maa, ka Ibrahimma me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka zaŋ dari maa pa di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga. Di saha ka o daa lo o bia Yisahaku maa mihi n-zaŋ o pa bimbini maa zuɣu dari maa zuɣu.
en: When they came to the place where God told them to go, Abraham built an altar. He carefully laid the wood on the altar. Then he tied up his son Isaac and laid him on the altar on top of the wood.

dag: Aduna zuliya, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let the house of Aaron say it: Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: N ni yirigi n zana pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni; amaa o nini ti ku nya li, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: He will try to escape, but I will catch him! He will be caught in my trap. Then I will bring him to Babylonia—the land of the Chaldeans. But he will not be able to see where he is going.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li niŋ salima bintaɣindisi la ni.
en: and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti gbarigi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suma tumbu polo dama ti yi bi gbarigi, chɛbu saha yi ti paai, ti ni chɛ ti ni biri shɛli.
en: We must not get tired of doing good. We will receive our harvest of eternal life at the right time. We must not give up.

dag: A ni varisi pɔhim ni ʒe n-tɔhigi va shɛli bahi, ka kari doli wurigu din kuui?.
en: Are you trying to scare me? I am only a leaf blowing in the wind. You are attacking a piece of straw!.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ pala ŋun ka yiko din ni tooi tiligi ya bee ŋun nyɛ tikpiralana, ka ku tooi wum yi suhigu.
en: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tiba mal alibarika, a ni zaŋ a zaligu wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb gba mal alibarika.
en: Our Lord , you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.

dag: Bɛ ni kul galisi pam shɛm, lala ka bɛ tumdi alahichi pam n sani. N ni chɛ ka bɛ jilima nyabu leei vi.
en: They became proud. They sinned more and more against me, so I will change their honor to shame.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi o ninni Ribila maa; Babilɔn naa maa daa lan ku Juda kpambaliba zaa.
en: and gave orders for him to be punished. Zedekiah's sons were killed there in front of him, and so were the leaders of Judah's ruling families.

dag: N ka yi sani, amaa n suhu din be yi sani, ka n gba pun kari ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa saria ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu kaman m bela yi san la. Yi yi ti laɣim ka n suhu pahi yi zuɣu ti Duuma Yisa yiko ni.
en: I am with you only in my thoughts. But in the name of our Lord Jesus I have already judged this man, as though I were with you in person. So when you meet together and the power of the Lord Jesus is with you, I will be there too.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ baɣisi mini zinaniŋdiba ni pagɔra bihi ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na.
en: Come here, you children of sorcery, offspring of adultery and prostitution!.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ bukɔbiri wuɣi tani n-zaŋ pili m biɛhigu shee maa. Wuɣimiya li tan tolima piniyini.
en: Make a cover for the Tent out of eleven pieces of cloth made of goats' hair.

dag: Di yi daa nyɛla n zaɣisila n daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba bee paɣiba fabila wumbu.
en: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.

dag: Yisa ni daa ka o nyaandoliba maa sanna saha shɛli maa o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ jaa, ka o yuli booni Tomas la daa ka o tab maa sani.
en: Thomas, the one called Didymus, one of the Twelve, wasnt with the disciples when Jesus came.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa: Yɛlim a mabia Aduna ni o di kanna luɣ kasi shee din be pateesa ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ waawaayili nti zaani Alikauli Adaka pindigu la gbini, di yi pa lala o ni kpi, dama n yirila zahira sagban ni di pindigu maa zuɣu.
en: Tell your brother Aaron that he cannot come whenever he wants into the holy area inside the inner curtain, to the front of the cover that is on the chest, or else he will die, because I am present in the cloud above the cover.

dag: Ka bɛ daa moli molo gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda ni bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn daa lab kulina la laɣimmi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: An order was then circulated throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the returned exiles should gather in Jerusalem.

dag: Abija tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o yɛtɔɣa ni o tuma zaa, bɛ sabi li niŋ anab Iddo yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Abijahs deeds, what he did and what he said, are written in the account of the prophet Iddo.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku labi n sanna maa zuɣu, bɛ ni labi Ijipti, ka Asiria naa ti leei bɛ naa.
en: The Israelites will not go back to Egypt. The king of Assyria will become their king, because they refused to turn back to God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Gidiɔn daa bɔhi Zɛba mini Zalimuna, Ninvuɣ banim ka yi daa lee ku Tabo la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Bɛ zaa daa bela a ni be shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ daa ŋmanila nabihi.
en: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, What kind of men were those whom you killed at Tabor? They replied, They were just like you; each one looked like a kings son.

dag: Di saha ka kpambaliba maa daa yɛli Baruk, Cham ka a mini Jɛrimia ti sɔɣi, ka di chɛnya ka so baŋ yi ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: Then they told him, You and Jeremiah must go and hide. Don't let anyone know where you are.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi yi yaannim ni daa ku anab shɛb gbala.
en: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi di bi lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli, ka zali zuɣusaa mini dunia zaligunima.
en: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa tuɣindi tulaale zim kaman Yawɛ ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba la ni daa niŋdi shɛm la. Bɛ daa tum tuumbiɛri pam n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi;.
en: At every shrine they burned incense, just as the nations did that the LORD sent into exile before them. They did evil things that made the LORD angry.

dag: Dindina, bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋmahindi bee bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ o buɣisi?.
en: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?.

dag: Taainim ni zaŋ pina na ti ti a m-bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim, ka bundaannim gba ni zaŋ pina balibu kam na ti ti a.
en: The people of Tyre will bring you gifts; rich people will try to win your favor.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi nɔzaɣisibo mini yi daalahichi tumbu zuɣu.
en: In the past you were spiritually dead because of your sins and the things you did against God.

dag: Juda zuliya bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihiniinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinahi. Bɛna nti yɛn be tooni chana.
en: All those enlisted in Judahs camp with their military units are . They will march first.

dag: Ŋum mali Yawɛ yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka ti be ka puhiri ya maa.
en: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord ! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa tim Izraɛl nachimba ka bɛ chaŋ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa kɔri naɣilahi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ.
en: He appointed certain young Israelite men to offer entirely burned offerings and slaughter oxen as well-being sacrifices to the LORD.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ti laɣim taba, ka bɛ ni ti malila zuɣulaan yino, ka bɛ biɛhigu ti chaŋ tooni tiŋgbani maa ni, dama Jɛziriil dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali.
en: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.

dag: Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa kul nahindila Izraɛlnima Naa Jɛhɔahaz ʒiɛman ni zaa.
en: Arams King Hazael had oppressed Israel throughout Jehoahazs rule.

dag: Ka ti zaa bɛn nyɛ chinchini ni bi pili liri shɛb ninni ŋɔ lihirila ti Duuma jilima ŋɔ, ka jilima maa mi nyɛla din kul pahiri jilima, ka nyɛ din taɣiri ti biɛhigu ni ti mal o ŋmahinli, dama dimbɔŋɔ yirila ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Shia la sanna.
en: And our faces are not covered. We all show the Lords glory, and we are being changed to be like him. This change in us brings more and more glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu zalim zaligu maa, ka dih a nuu di gbɔŋ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka di tum tuma. Di mi nyɛla Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu, di bi taɣira.
en: Now, King, make the law and sign the paper it is written on so that it cannot be changed, because the laws of the Medes and Persians cannot be canceled or changed.

dag: ka daa gari n salalaantab tooni Yɛhudianim adiini soli dolibu ni; ka di nyɛla n suhu ni daa kul ye n yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka malaika so ŋun daa pun yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa la kana ti zani, ka malaika so daa ka o sanna.
en: Then the angel who was speaking to me left, and another angel went out to talk to him.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa ti so yuli Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Jeemsi mini Jɔn ni Filip mini Baatolomiu.
en: Simon and his brother Andrew; James and John, Philip and Bartholomew.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir daa ti ka Ɛli sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa kahigi mmaŋ wuh a yab yiŋnim bɛ ni daa nyɛ Ijipti naa daba m-be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la.
en: One day a prophet came to Eli and gave him this message from the Lord : When your ancestors were slaves of the king of Egypt, I came and showed them who I am.

dag: Ka vuri daa mɔni, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim daa yiɣisi zani n-zaɣisi ka yɛli, Ti bi nya doo ŋɔ galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di pa shɛli shi so bee malaika n-shiri tɔɣis o di yɛla.
en: The shouting became louder, and some of the teachers of the Law who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and protested strongly: We cannot find a thing wrong with this man! Perhaps a spirit or an angel really did speak to him.

dag: ka yɛli o suhu ni, N ka luɣ shɛli din yɛn zaŋ m bindira ŋɔ sɔŋ, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ?.
en: He began to think to himself, I don't have a place to keep all my crops. What can I do?.

dag: ni yi paɣiba ni yi bihi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani, ka nyɛ bɛn wɔriti yi dari bee bɛn ŋɔŋdi kom tiri ya.
en: Your wives and children are here and also the foreigners living among you—the people who cut your wood and bring you water.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla binshɛli din yi o tooni na ka nyɛ daɣiri maa zaligu. O tooni yi yiɣisi bee di yi bi yiɣisi, di nyɛla daɣiri o sani.
en: whether it is stopped up or keeps dripping.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm o na.
en: Jesus said, You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyari daadamnim tuma zaa, ka mi bɛ soya zaa.
en: The LORDs eyes watch over every persons path, observing all their ways.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Ɛliada bia Rɛzɔn ŋun daa zo o lan Zɔba Naa Hadadɛza san la leei Sulemaana dima.
en: God also caused Rezon son of Eliada to turn against Solomon. Rezon had fled from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka Sairiini do so ŋun yuli daa booni Saimɔn yi tinshee garita, ka bɛ gbaag o nti zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li doli Yisa.
en: The soldiers led Jesus away, and as they were going, they met a man from Cyrene named Simon who was coming into the city from the country. They seized him, put the cross on him, and made him carry it behind Jesus.

dag: ka bɛ mabih ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bihi ka kpi; di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: and then to the rest: all seven brothers married the woman and died without having children. Last of all, the woman died.

dag: Ka o daa lan guhi daba ayopɔin pahi, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi n-chaŋ yaha, dindina, ka ŋmani maa daa bi lan labina.
en: He waited seven more days before sending the dove out again, and this time it did not return.

dag: Di saha suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ni ti zooi lim wain tihi din mali wula tuhilituhili, ka di zaɣ yini kam ni tooi da anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: On that day, there will be thorns and thistles in every place where a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels once grew.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Kadɛshi maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hɔr Zoli gbini din miri Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ tintariga la shee.
en: They left Kadesh and camped at Hor. This was the mountain at the border of the country of Edom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa n-zaŋ mɛɛr maa mini aloosi tia sum maa n-niŋ o, ka bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o kaman Yɛhudianim kum sɔɣibu kali ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Isaka zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Issachar was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Ka Lidanim mini Sharɔnnim zaa daa nya doo maa, ka niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: All the people living in Lydda and on the plain of Sharon saw him, and they decided to follow the Lord.

dag: Mahalalɛl daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Mahalalel lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni. So ku tooi fa nira n nuu ni bahi; so ku tooi gu n ni yɛn tum shɛli soli.
en: From the dawn of time, I am the one. No one can escape my power. I act, and who can undo it?.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri niriba yɛligu, o ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali; doli yɛnnim ni yɛn wuh a so shɛli n-tuhi tɔbu.
en: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.

dag: ka o yi ti zal o ni yɛn pirig o ni su shɛli ti ba dahin shɛli, o ka soli ni o niŋ o ni yuri paɣ so maa bidibiga kaman o bikpɛm sani, ka chɛ o ni bi yuri o paɣ so maa bia ŋun nyɛ kpɛm maa.
en: When the man decides how he is going to divide his property among his children, he is not to show partiality to the son of his favorite wife by giving him the share that belongs to the first-born son.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim yirila gbinni polo na, ka wari yiri kikaa pɔhim ni na.
en: The storm comes from its chamber, the cold from the north wind.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa malila binshɛli bɛ kpiŋkpama lɔna ni ka di ŋmani ninsal nuhi.
en: I saw that each creature had what looked like a human hand under each of its wings.

dag: Ka ŋun diri binshɛɣukam miri ka o ʒiɛm ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni di dibu, ka ŋun gbaar omaŋ maa mi miri ka o ti ŋun diri shɛlikam zalige; dama Naawuni deei dilana gba.
en: The person who will eat anything is not to despise the one who doesn't; while the one who eats only vegetables is not to pass judgment on the one who will eat anything; for God has accepted that person.

dag: Ka tumo so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ Mikaya maa na yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa naala noli n-yɛli naa ni yu shɛm, a gba kul yɛlimila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ŋmani bɛ ni yino dini, ka nyɛ o yubu.
en: While this was happening, the officer went to find Micaiah. When he found him, the officer told him, All the other prophets have said that the king will succeed, so you should say the same thing.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N suhir a, di chɛ ti, dama nyini m-mi ti ni yɛn dooni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, leemi ti sowuhira.
en: Please go with us! Moses said. You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka dab paɣ bia maa gba nam zuliya, dama o gba nyɛla a zuliya.
en: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.

dag: Ka Naa Darius daa dih o nuu zaligu gbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.

dag: O daa yɛl o mi, Zaŋm nɛma maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu la ni, ka lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: Cyrus said to him, Take this equipment and go and put it in Jerusalems temple, and let Gods house be rebuilt on its original site.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ m mali suhupiɛlli n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu ŋɔ puuni; dama n ni diri wahala shɛŋa maa nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ naai wahala shɛŋa din kpalim ka nyɛ Masia ni daa diri shɛl o niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ cheechi la zuɣu la.
en: And now I am happy about my sufferings for you, for by means of my physical sufferings I am helping to complete what still remains of Christ's sufferings on behalf of his body, the church.

dag: N gbibila n wuntitali kirikiri ka ku wɔɣisi li; n suhu bi wuhi ni m mali galimi m biɛhigu ni dahin shɛli.
en: I will hold on to my innocence and never let go! My conscience will always be clear!.

dag: N saha yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni; tiligim ma n dimnim mini bɛn niŋdi ma alaka nuu ni.
en: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.

dag: M mabihi, baŋmiya ni so ku tooi nya yolisim Anabi Musa zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka ti yihiri ya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu doo ŋɔ zuɣu maa, ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya yolisim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: My friends, the message is that Jesus can forgive your sins! The Law of Moses could not set you free from all your sins.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, duumanim shɛba n-yi su ti, amaa a kɔŋko ka ti mi.
en: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.

dag: Baŋmiya yi suhuri ni ni nir ni saɣisir o bidibiga shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ gba saɣisiri ya.
en: You must remember that the Lord your God teaches and corrects you as a father teaches and corrects his son.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu ni tɛha bi kpɛma yi nya nyin ŋun mali baŋsim ŋɔ ka a ʒi buɣili maligu shee diri bindirigu, di ku kpaŋsi dilan maa suhu ka o di bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa?.
en: Suppose a person whose conscience is weak in this matter sees you, who have so-called knowledge, eating in the temple of an idol; will not this encourage him to eat food offered to idols?.

dag: A bɔri ni yɛlimaŋli be nir suhu ni; dinzuɣu wuhim ma yɛm n suhu ni.
en: You want me to be completely loyal, so put true wisdom deep inside of me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Naawuni, Ti tum alahichi, amaa ti suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, fam ti bahi; ka niŋ ti a ni bɔri ni a niŋ ti shɛm.
en: The Israelites responded to the LORD, Weve sinned. Do to us whatever you see as right, but please save us this time.

dag: O daa yɛl o mi, Zaŋm nɛma maa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu la ni, ka lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: Then Cyrus said to Sheshbazzar, Take these gold and silver things and put them back in the Temple in Jerusalem. Rebuild Gods Temple in the same place it was in the past.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtishɛmɛshinim maa daa yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tooni? Ka o yi yi ti sani, banim sani ka o lee yɛn chaŋ.
en: So the men of Beth Shemesh said, Who can stand before the Lord , this holy God? Where can we send him to get him away from us.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti nya alahiziba tuuni zuŋɔ.
en: They were all completely amazed! Full of fear, they praised God, saying, What marvelous things we have seen today.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi zaa naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛgulibo ni na ni a ti leegi n niriba Izraɛlnim toondana n-su ba.
en: So tell my servant David that I, the Lord Almighty, say to him, I took you from looking after sheep in the fields and made you the ruler of my people Israel.

dag: Bɛ zuya daa ŋmanila nɔnsi zuya, ka bɛ dimdi kaman nɔnsi la, ka bɛ dimbu lɔɣu din yɛn nahim niriba chira anu la do bɛ zuya maa ni.
en: The locusts had tails with stingers like scorpions. The power they had to give people pain for five months was in their tails.

dag: bomiya kom na ti ti kɔnyuri ni mali shɛba. Yinim Tɛma tiŋgbɔŋnima, bomiya bindira ti kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba.
en: give water to the thirsty people who come to you. You people of the land of Tema, give food to the refugees.

dag: Dama mɔɣu ni ka o daa nya o, ka bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti doo maa daa naan tooi kuhi ni bɛ sɔŋ o, amaa so daa kani ŋun ni fa o bahi.
en: The man found the engaged girl out in the field and attacked her. Maybe she called for help, but there was no one to help her.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o kpambaliba ni o bidibisi ni o naazɔnim daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn naa. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa gbaai Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun Babilɔn naa maa nam dibu yuma anii saha kuli Babilɔn.
en: Judahs King Jehoiachin, along with his mother, his servants, his officers, and his officials, came out to surrender to the Babylonian king. The Babylonian king took Jehoiachin prisoner in the eighth year of Jehoiachins rule.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa diɛhi duɣubihi mini kikahi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn kpalim la sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa lab kuli ka chɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa. Ka Midiannim daa zaŋ bɛ tantinim kpa n-do bɛ ni daa be zo shɛli zuɣu maa vinvamli ni.
en: So Gideon sent all the Israelites home, except the three hundred, who kept all the supplies and trumpets. The Midianite camp was below them in the valley.

dag: Ka n daa kahigi n daalahichi wuh a; ka bi sɔɣi n ni tum taal shɛŋa. N daa yɛliya, Yawɛ, n ni kahigi n daalahichi maa wuh a, ka a daa chɛ n daalahichi maa zaa.
en: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins. Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.

dag: Zibisim titali n-nyɛ bɛ daazichi n-doya guli ba, ka buɣim din pa so ni mali shɛli ni ti di ba. Ka binshɛlikam din ti kpalim bɛ yinsi ni ti di buɣim.
en: Complete darkness waits for their treasured possessions; fire that no one stoked consumes them; whats left in their tent is ruined.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli Masia ni zali ti. Dina n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yuri Naawuni, di simdi ni o yur o mabia gba.
en: God gave us this command: If we love God, we must also love each other as brothers and sisters.

dag: Naawuni, ninʒeensinim yiɣisi lu n zuɣu; ninkuunsinim laɣimya m-bɔri ni bɛ yihi n nyɛvili, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi lihi nya a.
en: The arrogant rise up against me, God. A gang of violent people want me dead. They dont give a thought for you.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Paɣiŋoo ŋun bi dɔɣi, mali suhupiɛlli! Nyin ŋun ʒi bia dɔɣibu wolisibu biɛrim ŋɔ, yaam a noli n-tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu! Dama bɛ ni chɛ paɣ so bahi mali bihi pam n-gari ŋun mali yidana.
en: The Scriptures say about her, You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.

dag: Ka n ti wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the earth, they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm a yɛm tuma puuni, amaa lee di chɛ ka o zuɣu ti paligi ka o kpi ni suhudoo.
en: in the way you think best. Whatever you do, don't let him die peacefully in his old age.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tikpiralan so ŋun tɔri birilim ka o sanna nti suh o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk. They begged Jesus just to touch him.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Naa Ɛhab. Kum daa mii Samarianim pam di saha maa.
en: So Elijah went to meet with Ahab. The famine was very bad in Samaria.

dag: Amaa yɛda niŋbu soli maa ni yipa kana pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, ti bi lan be gula maa sulinsi ni yaha.
en: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a custodian.

dag: Daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi ti wum ka n yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, nyin zaŋmi saɣisigu din yi n sanna saɣisi ba.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.

dag: M bi suhir a ni a yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa n suhir a mi ni a gbib ba ka Sintani ku paai ba.
en: I do not ask you to take them out of the world, but I do ask you to keep them safe from the Evil One.

dag: Naawuni ni mali soli ti ba, ka yihi ba dabitim ni. Bɛ ni ti kabi dunɔdali n-dol li gari yi. Bɛ naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ maŋmaŋa ni ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: God will open the way for them and lead them out of exile. They will break out of the city gates and go free. Their king, the Lord himself, will lead them out.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili liri Alikauli Adaka maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: Then he put the Box in the Tent and hung up the curtain. In this way he screened off the Covenant Box, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Isaka zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tola daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Tolanima; ka Puva daŋ niriba nyɛ Puvanima.
en: The tribe of Issachar: the clans of Tola, Puah.

dag: ni Bɛnhɛsɛd tiŋgbɔŋ zaa la.
en: The son of Hesed was in charge of the towns of Arubboth and Socoh, and the region of Hepher.

dag: N yi lih a ni nam sagban shɛŋa ŋɔ, ka lihi goli mini saŋmar shɛb a ni nam ŋɔ.
en: When I look up at your skies, at what your fingers made— the moon and the stars that you set firmly in place.

dag: Niŋmi li la ashilɔni, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni ŋɔ ti a di laara.
en: Your giving should be done in private. Your Father can see what is done in private, and he will reward you.

dag: Ka Ibram daa pirigipirig o tɔbbihi maa n-chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ ŋ-ŋme n-kari ba hal ti paai Hɔba din be Damaskus nuzaa polo la.
en: During the night, he and his servants divided themselves up against them, attacked, and chased them to Hobah, north of Damascus.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti lu Dɛbirinim zuɣu. Dɛbir tuuli yuli n-daa nyɛ Kiriatisɛfa.
en: From there he went to attack the people living in Debir.

dag: O ni daa niŋ lala maa ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli ni yi gbib la shɛhira ʒim.
en: While he did it, he said, This is the blood of the covenant that God established for you. .

dag: Di nyaaŋa di tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ hal ti paai Zifurɔn, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Hazarɛnan; yi nuzaa polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: and to Ziphron, and will end at Hazar Enan.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be baalim, ka chɛ ka yi zaɣa be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka bɔnya yimaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma tummi kaman ti ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la.
en: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.

dag: Dama bɛ kul bɔr o mi kaman dɔbba ni bɔri pagɔrili shɛm la. Lala ka bɛ daa bɔri Ohola mini Oholiba bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri dɔbba pam maa.
en: But they kept going to her as they would go to a prostitute. Yes, they went again and again to Oholah and Oholibah, those wicked women.

dag: O daa niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ naani, ka so daa ka Juda nanim zaa ni bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn dol o nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman o.
en: Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, Israels God. There was no one like him among all of Judahs kings—not before him and not after him.

dag: Amaa sabimi Aduna min o bidibisi maa yuya n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi maligumaanitali tuma, ka ninvuɣ zino yi ka bɛ sanna, yin kum o.
en: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.

dag: Pa wuuni m-bɔŋɔ? N yɛn suhila Yawɛ ka o chɛ ka saa kum ka mi, ka yi nya ka baŋ ni yi tum taali din galisi Yawɛ sani, yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔr naa maa zuɣu.
en: Now is the time of the wheat harvest. I will pray to the Lord and ask him to send thunder and rain. Then you will know you did a very bad thing against the Lord when you asked for a king.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Ti dan Yisa, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: But the men shouted, Jesus! Master! Please help us.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib daa ʒe nimaani kul fiɣisir o ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law stepped forward and made strong accusations against Jesus.

dag: ka yi ti bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman zoma ni bɔbindi gindi zibisim ni shɛm la, amaa ka ku nya soli ka bɛ naɣ ti kul filindi ya mi, ka fari yi nɛma waawaayili, ka so ku beni ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: You will fumble around at high noon as blind people fumble around in darkness. Your plans wont prosper. Instead, you will be constantly oppressed and taken advantage of without any savior.

dag: O duhir o yee zama pam ni, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa fɔntinsi dunɔdaya gbini.
en: She is calling out where the noisy crowd gathers:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tɔb nɛma maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣ shɛli jɛmbu duu, ka daa zaŋ o zuɣu maa ti yili bɛ buɣili Dagɔn jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: They put Saul's armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of their god Dagon.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa kaman pagɔrili n-nyɛ o maa.
en: They answered, Was it right to let our own sister be treated that way.

dag: Kulla pumpɔŋɔ ka n nam yɛla maa. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi wum di yɛla maa; dinzuɣu yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi pun mi li.
en: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.

dag: Yisa daa ti be soli n-chani Jɛrusalɛm ka daa ti zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi la yi kpaŋa nti yɛli ba.
