en: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside and spoke to them privately, as they walked along.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa maa naai ka ŋmaligi, ka Ibrahimma gba daa ŋmaligi kuli.
en: After he had finished speaking with Abraham, the Lord went away, and Abraham returned home.

dag: Bɛ ni daa du duli maa ha, ka Ilaija yɛli Ilaisha, Yɛlim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ti a pɔi ka bɛ naanyi kpuɣ ma chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, N suhir a, chɛ ka a shia ŋun be a ni ŋɔ ʒiibuyi zuɣu be n ni.
en: When they had crossed, Elijah said to Elisha, What do you want me to do for you before Im taken away from you? Elisha said, Let me have twice your spirit.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Amɔrinim dahin shɛli maa, ka Jɔshua daa tɔɣisi Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋmaligi yɛli Izraɛlnim ninni: Wuntaŋa, kpalimmi zani luɣ yini Gibiɔn dɛde, ka nyin Goli gba, kpalim zani Aijalɔn vinvamli dɛde.
en: On the day the LORD gave the Amorites into the power of Israel, Joshua spoke to the LORD in the presence of the Israelites: Sun, stand still at Gibeon! and Moon, at the Aijalon Valley.

dag: Nam zuɣupiligu yi ti zuɣu ni lu. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti tum alahichi.
en: The crown has fallen from our head. Things have gone bad for us because we sinned.

dag: O ni vuui suhugarigu sagban shɛli din sirigina ti pili zuliya kam zaa maa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: He will swallow up on this mountain the veil that is veiling all peoples, the shroud enshrouding all nations.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, yi nyɛla wuna, yi zaa nyɛla Zallakudura Naa bihi.
en: I hereby declare, You are gods, children of the Most High—all of you!.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka o saɣim pam. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa dolila so yini.
en: I saw that both women were going to ruin their lives with the same mistakes.

dag: Anabi Aizaia ni daa nya Yisa jilima zuɣu ka o daa yɛl o yɛla lala maa.
en: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus glory; he spoke about Jesus.

dag: Yuma ata nyaaŋa ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti kaai Pita. Biɛɣ pinaanu ka n daa niŋ o sani.
en: It was three years later that I went to Jerusalem to obtain information from Peter, and I stayed with him for two weeks.

dag: Bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni zaŋdi bɛ noya saɣindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, amaa baŋsim chɛ ka wuntizɔriba nyari faako.
en: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.

dag: Nashɔn daa nyɛla Salima ba, ka Salima daa nyɛ Bɔaz ba.
en: Nahshon was Salmons father. Salmon was Boazs father.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a jɛmbu duu n-kul yiini yila paɣir a sahakam mal alibarika.
en: How happy are those who live in your Temple, always singing praise to you.

dag: Ofiri ni Havila ni Jɔbab. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-daa laɣim nyɛ Jokitan daŋ niriba.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All of them were descended from Joktan.

dag: Leedan daa malila bidibisi ata, Jɛhiɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Zɛtam pa, ka Joɛl daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ata.
en: Ladan had three sons: Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.

dag: dama o daa tib barinim pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ŋunkam mali dɔro ŋaɣisiri niriba maa ni ni o ti shih o.
en: He had healed many people, and all the sick kept pushing their way to him in order to touch him.

dag: Naawuni, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu ŋɔ; di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: God, listen to my prayer; dont avoid my request!.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli booni Judas la mini salo daa paana. Ka Judas daa chaŋ Yisa sani nti puh o ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, a crowd appeared, and the one called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him.

dag: Ka di puuni zaa daa palila biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini tinvura ni biŋgbamda ni noonsi.
en: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a nya alibarika, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ a lala labisi. Amaa ka a lee ti nya laara wuntizɔriba kum ni neebu dali.
en: They cannot pay you back. But God will bless you and reward you when his people rise from death.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ tiligi Izraɛlnima, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim din ku naai; ka bɛ kul ku lan di vi yaha. .
en: But Israel, I, the Lord , will always keep you safe and free from shame.

dag: Yawɛ, wun ŋuni n-lee lan ŋman a? Ŋun nam dariza min o kasitali n-lee ŋman a, ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm ni jilima, ka o tumd alahiziba tuma?.
en: Our Lord , no other gods compare with you— Majestic and holy! Fearsome and glorious! Miracle worker!.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ lala, ka daa bo niɣ ayi bɛn bihi na mɔɣiri na nti zaŋ tɔroko maa ga ba, ka zaŋ naɣibihi maa niŋ duu n-yo ba niŋ di ni.
en: The rulers did just that. They took two nursing cows and harnessed them to the cart, penning their calves up at home.

dag: A shiri mi, dama di saha bɛ daa pun dɔɣ a ka a mi yuui pam!.
en: Surely you know these things, since you are so old and wise. You were alive when I made them, werent you?.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti bɛn suhir o o Shia Kasi maa.
en: If you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him.

dag: Tɛra daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Tɛra daa nyɛla Ibram mini Nahɔr ni Haran ba; ka Haran mi daa nyɛ Lɔt ba.
en: These are Terahs descendants. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya alikauli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi di nasara yi tuuni kam ni.
en: If you obey all the commands in this agreement, you will continue to succeed in everything you do.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali yi daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: You must also sacrifice a male goat to make you pure.

dag: Ka o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zaa daa kana ni bɛ ti maag o suhu, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ni kum m bia maa zuɣu hal ti paag o kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Lala ka o ba daa kum o zuɣu.
en: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted and said, I will go down to the world of the dead still mourning for my son. So he continued to mourn for his son Joseph.

dag: Shɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram.
en: Shems sons: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

dag: Gbuɣinli chɛ ŋumbu, gbuɣindaa kukoli foya, ka gbuɣimpola nyina kabisi.
en: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth.

dag: Amaa n ni tiligi yi shɛba, ka yi ni shɛba zo n-tiligi takɔbi kum ni zuliya shɛb sani, ka wurim kpe tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: But I will spare a few. Some of you will escape the nations swords when you are scattered throughout the lands.

dag: kaman tɔŋ la, dama di ni ti paai ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: It will come as a surprise to everyone on earth.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yi fa Lɔdɛba. Ka lan nyuri bara yɛri ni yi kpiɔŋ ka yi zaŋ fa Karinaim.
en: You are so excited about defeating Lo Debar. And you boast, We have taken Karnaim by our own strength.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina, n yi lan niŋ Filistianim zaɣ biɛɣu, di pala n taali.
en: This time, Samson answered, I have a good reason for really hurting some Philistines.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni tihi zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Mani n-zaŋdi ti wɔɣinli leeri ti jia. Mani zaŋdi ti jia leeri ti wɔɣinli. Mani n-chɛ ka ti mahili leeri ti kuŋ, ka chɛ ka ti kuŋ leeri ti mahili. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka shiri ni niŋ li.
en: All the trees in the land will know that I am the Lord . I cut down the tall trees and make small trees grow tall. I wither up the green trees and make the dry trees become green. I, the Lord , have spoken. I will do what I have said I would do.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa bɔh o mabihi maa, Ti yi ku ti tizo ŋɔ ka wuhi ni pa tinima n-ku o, nyɔ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn nya di ni?.
en: Judah said to his brothers, What do we gain if we kill our brother and hide his blood?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi Musa sani kuli.
en: Moses finished speaking, and everyone left.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni tum alahiziba tuma niriba ŋɔ sani, ka di gari ba ka niŋ ba alahiziba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ni leei jɛra, ka bɛ yɛm maa leei din ka buchi.
en: I will go on doing amazing things to these people, shocking and startling things. The wisdom of their wise will perish, and the discernment of their discerning will be hidden.

dag: Naa Sool ni daa kul mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa naai, di daa bi yuui ka Samuɛl paai na. Ka Naa Sool daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli puh o.
en: The very moment Saul finished offering up the entirely burned offering, Samuel arrived. Saul went out to meet him and welcome him.

dag: Malimiya dapaɣa niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo dapaɣa pisi.
en: Make twenty boards for the dwellings southern side.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ayɔbu mi nyɛ Itiriam, o ma n-daa nyɛ Ɛgila ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la, Hiburɔn ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bɛ zaa.
en: and the sixth was Ithream, by Davids wife Eglah. These are Davids sons that were born in Hebron.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri ni tɛha ka galimi, ka lan nyɛ bɛn gbib yɛlimaŋa din yi zahira ti wuhibu puuni la.
en: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lab o nachimba maa sani ka o mini ba ti lab kuli Bɛrishiiba, ka Ibrahimma ti kpalim be nimaani.
en: After Abraham returned to the young men, they got up and went to Beer-sheba where Abraham lived.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa ti bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: Jesus followers asked him, What does this story mean.

dag: M bia, dol a ba zaligu, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: Son, do what your father tells you and never forget what your mother taught you.

dag: ka yɛl o, N dana, di zaŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali bee n-lan teei n ni daa tum gala shɛm dahin shɛli nyini n dan ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm n-zɔrila yɛla. Naa, di zaŋ li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: and said, Your Majesty, please forget the wrong I did that day you left Jerusalem. Don't hold it against me or think about it any more.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi daa pala ninvuɣ maŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nyɛla Naawuni niriba; ka saha shɛli ha yi daa bi nya Naawuni nambɔzɔbo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nya nambɔzɔbo o sani.
en: At one time you were not God's people, but now you are his people; at one time you did not know God's mercy, but now you have received his mercy.

dag: Lala ka niriba ŋɔ zahindi zahima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu, ka turi bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la.
en: In the same way also, these people have visions which make them sin against their own bodies; they despise God's authority and insult the glorious beings above.

dag: ka sakuɣ kara din tibisim sania zuɣu nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram pihinahi ni anu daa yi zuɣusaa n-luri niriba zuɣu na hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni alɔbo sakuɣa maa zuɣu. Di daalɔbo maa daa mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Giant hailstones fell on the people from the sky. These hailstones weighed almost pounds each. People cursed God because of this plague of the hail. It was terrible.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nuzaa tabila n zuɣu gbibi, ka a nudirigu mi bɔb gbaai ma mali.
en: His left arm is beneath my head, and his right embraces me!.

dag: Ka niŋya kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: You must put oil and frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.

dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka Babilɔnnim bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim mini bɛn tahiri damli dambu na, ka nyɛ bɛn chani gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa ni bɛ tuhi fa yiya din pa bɛ dini ŋɔ nya yaa.
en: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa boli Jɔshua na ti yɛl o Izraɛlnim zaa ninni, Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ niriba ŋɔ chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni nti chɛ ka bɛ dee li su.
en: Then Moses called Joshua and said to him in the presence of all the people of Israel, Be determined and confident; you are the one who will lead these people to occupy the land that the Lord promised to their ancestors.

dag: Ŋmam nudirigu polo, ka ŋma nuzaa polo! Bɛ ni kul zaŋ a noli kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: It will slash right and left, wherever the blade is pointed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaanii ni kɔbisinu ni pihinii.
en: their enrollment was .

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu n-siɣirina ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As Jesus and the followers were coming down the mountain, he gave them this command: Dont tell anyone about what you saw on the mountain. Wait until the Son of Man has been raised from death. Then you can tell people about what you saw.

dag: ka daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima sokam zaa zuɣu la. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din di Naawuni ni daa pun lo shɛm shɛhira, ka nyɛ din yi palo di saha dɛde.
en: God showed us this at the right time.

dag: Dama pagɔrili samli yɔri nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, amaa so paɣ bɔbu nyɛla din diri nir nyɛvili.
en: A man can hire a prostitute for the price of a loaf of bread, but adultery will cost him all he has.

dag: Ka a ba yi ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, nyin yɛlim o, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ o ya Bɛtilihɛm, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛn malila yuuniyuuni sara.
en: If your father notices that I am not at the table, tell him that I begged your permission to hurry home to Bethlehem, since it's the time for the annual sacrifice there for my whole family.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tahima la ni zal li shɛm la puuni n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.

dag: Ka o bidibis ayi maa daa kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba. Paɣiba maa yuya n-daa booni: Opa ni Rut.
en: They took wives for themselves, Moabite women; the name of the first was Orpah and the name of the second was Ruth. And they lived there for about ten years.

dag: Yi nuzaa polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli hal ni Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: This will be your northern border: From the Mediterranean Sea you will mark out your boundary to Mount Hor.

dag: Bɛ daa kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi niŋ bɛ paɣiba, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi; ka jɛmdi bɛ wuna.
en: But the Israelites intermarried with them and served their gods.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛl o pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: The voice spoke a second time, Never consider unclean what God has made pure.

dag: Sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa, di nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi; ka sagbani maa daa yi ti kpalim zani luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka Izraɛlnim maa tiri bɛ suɣa doona.
en: Whenever the cloud lifted, the people of Israel broke camp, and they set up camp again in the place where the cloud came down.

dag: N daa kul darigila yi niriba ŋɔ tibili yoli; bɛ daa bi deei saɣisigu. Yimaŋmaŋ takɔbiri ka yi daa zaŋ ku yi daanabinima kaman gbuɣinli ŋun kuri niriba.
en: I punished you, but it did no good; you would not let me correct you. Like a raging lion, you have murdered your prophets.

dag: Ka o daa kpɛri bɛ jɛmbu duri ni ti wuhiri ba, ka sokam zaa daa tibigir o pam.
en: He taught in the synagogues and was praised by everyone.

dag: O ni daa suhiri Naawuni maa, ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ti taɣi, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: While Jesus was praying, his face began to change. His clothes became shining white.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa maa o gbaɣino min o nyɔtaɣirigu tuɣibu shee, di saha ka o daa yɛli tɔbbi so ŋun daa duhir o chɛchɛbuŋ maa, Ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni, dama n nya daŋa. .
en: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab between two pieces of his armor. He shouted to his chariot driver, I've been hit! Get me out of here.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Juda n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn la yi ti yɛn yɛli noli ti so, bɛ ni yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm a kaman Babilɔn Naa ni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Zɛdɛkia mini Ɛhab she buɣim ni shɛm la.
en: When the people who were taken away as prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylonia want to bring a curse on someone, they will say, May the Lord treat you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylonia roasted alive.

dag: N ni lan labisi bɛ daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba, ka labisi Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi a gba maŋmaŋ daazichi ti a pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Jerusalem, I will make them prosperous again—Sodom and her villages and Samaria and her villages. Yes, I will make you prosperous too.

dag: Ka n daa lihi n-nya Piɛbila ka o ʒe Ziɔn zol zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi ʒe o sani, ka o yuli min o Ba yuli sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Then I looked, and there was the Lamb standing on Mount Zion; with him were , people who have his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi niŋ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la zaa. Yi lan niŋ n gba ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: He said to them, You obeyed everything that Moses the LORDs servant commanded you. You have also obeyed me in everything that I have commanded you.

dag: Bɔbu saha beni, ka kɔŋbu saha beni. Gbibbu saha beni, ka zaŋ bahi saha beni.
en: a time for searching and a time for losing, a time for keeping and a time for throwing away.

dag: Nahiŋgu mini biɛrim pam m-mali ba dabiɛm. Di lula bɛ zuɣu kaman naa ni mali shili ni o chaŋ tɔb tuhibu shɛm la.
en: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.

dag: Ka Judianim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kabi chaŋ o sani nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: Many people from the province of Judea and the city of Jerusalem went out to hear John. They confessed their sins, and he baptized them in the Jordan River.

dag: Yisifu ni daa ti kuna, ka bɛ zaŋ pin shɛli din be bɛ sani maa kpɛhi ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: When Joseph came home, they gave him the gifts they had brought, and they bowed down to him.

dag: Nir yi daŋ tooni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa o malila yɛlimaŋli, faashee o mini ŋun mali taba maa ti kana ti bɔh o bɔhigunima.
en: The first person to testify seems innocent, until the other comes and cross-examines him.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi biɛɣu zuɣu, dama biɛɣu gba jiɣindila dimaŋ zuɣu. Dabisili kam wahala saɣiri li mi.
en: So dont worry about tomorrow. Each day has enough trouble of its own. Tomorrow will have its own worries.

dag: Hal ka di lan ka buchi ni nir zaŋ li niŋ kulim gba n-zaŋ bah o puu ni n-naɣ pahila bɛ kpaa li mi bahi. Ka daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: It is no good for the soil or for the manure pile; it is thrown away. Listen, then, if you have ears.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti zaŋ li mir o na ni o di ka o dii gɔh o nuu ni ka yɛl o, N tizɔpaɣa, chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: But as she was taking it over to him, he grabbed her and said, Come to bed with me.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi bɛn mini bɛ malibu daa kuli Ijipti yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the names of the Israelites who came to Egypt with Jacob along with their households.

dag: Ʒiɛmiya anzinfa! Ʒiɛmiya salima! Azichi maa ka tariga, ka bin suma pam beni.
en: Take the silver! Take the gold! There are many things to take. There are many treasures.

dag: Amaa n yi ti yɛli bia maa, Nyama, piɛma maa be a tooni ha; dindina nyin zoma, dama Yawɛ n-wuh a ni a zom maa.
en: But if I yell to the young man, Hey! The arrow is past you, then run for it, because the LORD has sent you away.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-deeri o ba saɣisigu, amaa ansarisimaana bi deeri zuɣu ni kpahibu.
en: A wise son listens to his fathers advice, but a proud son will not listen to correction.

dag: Lihimi n nahiŋgu mini n wahala ŋɔ, ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu ni saa tahibu la yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa n-su nam!.
en: Then I heard something that sounded like a large crowd of people. It was as loud as crashing waves or claps of thunder. The people were saying, Hallelujah! Our Lord God rules. He is the All-Powerful.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka n ti be yi sani ka yi muɣisi ma ni n wuhi dɔbilim, dama m mi ni n ni tooi wuhi n dɔbilim ni nyɛ shɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhiri ni ti dolila dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ka mal li kuuni la sani.
en: I beg you not to force me to be harsh when I come; for I am sure I can deal harshly with those who say that we act from worldly motives.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa yoobu maa ni, bɛ daa zaŋla naɣilahi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi kɔbisiyi ni piɛbihi kɔbisinahi mali sara, ka lan zaŋ bulahi pinaayi mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi zuɣu; kaman bɛ zuliya maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: For the dedication they offered bulls, sheep, and lambs as sacrifices, and goats as offerings for sin, one for each tribe of Israel.

dag: N ni nyaŋ o dimnim ti o, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je o.
en: I will crush all his foes in front of him. I will strike down all those who hate him.

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu; wummi n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: God! Hear my prayer; listen to the words of my mouth!.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri, di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; dama momaha niŋ mɔɣu ni; ka tihi wali, ka fiig tihi mini wain tihi wali pam.
en: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.

dag: A lɛhu yi gbilim ka a bi sahi li, ka zaŋ li ni a tum tuma, a ni di wahala pam; amaa yɛm nyɛla din sɔŋdi nir ka o diri nasara.
en: But wisdom will make any job easier. It is very hard to cut with a dull knife. But if you sharpen the knife, the job is easier.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kuri niriba chihiri bɛn ka taali, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi.
en: Bloodthirsty people hate anyone who's honest, but righteous people will protect the life of such a person.

dag: Imɛr daŋ — tuhili ni pihinunaayi.
en: the descendants of Immer:.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu; n ku beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Miligim ka chɛ ma, dama n dabisa kul nyɛla vuhim.
en: I give up; I am tired of living. Leave me alone. My life makes no sense.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ vinnyaɣilana o duu yɔɣira gɔŋdimi, ka o baɣa yi ka di ni, o duu maa ti yindimi.
en: Some people are too lazy to fix a leaky roof— then the house collapses.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan kɔre ni be shɛli ni pam nyɛla din kur o. Dama vinnyaɣilana nuhi je tuma.
en: Lazy people who refuse to work are only killing themselves;.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ, ka bɔ nti yɛn nyɛ a kandina mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu shihira? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, his disciples came to him in private and asked, When will this happen? What will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the world.

dag: Di saha ka o daa wuhi ma Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulan la ka o ʒe Yawɛ malaika tooni, ka Sintani ʒe o nudirigu polo ni o fiɣis o.
en: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord 's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama n yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam ni ti bɔri ni bɛ dol li kpe ka ku tooi.
en: The door to heaven is narrow. Try hard to enter it. Many people will want to enter there, but they will not be able to go in.

dag: Ka pirinsi maa daa lab ti yɛli sariakaritib maa Pool ni yɛli shɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba bɛ ni daa wum ni Pool mini Silas nyɛla Rom tiŋbihi maa zuɣu;.
en: When the police told the officials that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, the officials were afraid.

dag: Bɛ daa lan ʒini wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli din mini bihigu shee bi wɔɣ ni taba, ka di be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi tiŋgban nɛli ŋ-ŋɔ polo na la. Dama bɛ niɣi daa yɛligiya m-pali Giliad zaa.
en: They had large herds in the land of Gilead, and so they occupied the land as far east as the desert that stretches all the way to the Euphrates River.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Izraɛl bidibisi maa yuya din sabi pa sariakaribo nyolɔrigu zuɣu la n-ye m-pa o nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee la, ka di nyɛ bɛ yɛla teebu shihirili Yawɛ sani sahakam.
en: In this way, Aaron will carry the names of Israels sons on the chest pendant for making decisions over his heart when he goes into the sanctuary as a reminder before the LORD at all times.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu, darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. Darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ nuhi tuma ni simdi shɛm; tim ba bɛ tuma laara.
en: Treat them as they deserve! Punish them for their sins.

dag: Man Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn wurim kpe tinzun tinsi ni m-be Pɔntus mini Galɛshia ni Kapadɔsia ni Ɛsha ni Bitinia.
en: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

dag: Bɛ ku leei bundaannima, ka bɛ nyamma pala din ni zani yuui; ka bɛ daazichi mi ku yɛligi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.

dag: Bɛ ni mɔɣisi sapaɣ lɔɣu; gariŋga zilinli ni ku ba.
en: What he drank will be like a snakes poison; it will kill him like the bite of a deadly snake.

dag: Ka Reechɛl dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayi ti Yaakubu.
en: Rachels servant Bilhah became pregnant again and gave birth to a second son for Jacob.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa pihi bɛ napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka yi ni chaŋ Aikɔnium.
en: So Paul and Barnabas shook the dust off their feet. Then they went to the city of Iconium.

dag: Amaa yinim lihi ʒiɛmla nandaamba. Pa bundaannima n-nahindi ya la? Pa bɛna n-dariti ya tahiri ʒiishee la?.
en: But you have dishonored the poor. Dont the wealthy make life difficult for you? Arent they the ones who drag you into court?.

dag: Ka paɣa maa daa lan yɛli, N dan naa, n suhir a, chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Then the woman said, May your female servant say something to my master the king? Speak! he said.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ Yawɛ leei bɛ ni ni niŋ so naani, ka shiri niŋ o naani mal alibarika.
en: But those who trust in the Lord will be blessed. They know that the Lord will do what he says.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan zaŋ o nuu tim saɣ ŋman ni, ka wumsim mal o pam ni o zaŋ li ti kpar o noli ni.
en: Some people are too lazy to put food in their own mouths.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa wum bɛ wuhibu maa niŋ yɛda. Dɔbba kɔŋko daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu laasabu.
en: But many who heard the message believed; and the number grew to about five thousand.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N daa tɛhimi ni so ka kpe n-zɔri Naawuni, ka tɛhi ni bɛ ni ku ma m paɣ maa zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka n niŋ lala maa.
en: Then Abraham said, I thought no one in this place respected God. I thought someone would kill me to get Sarah.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa din be kasi ti ma zaa, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi zaa ni di nyɛ yi dini sahakam. Di nyɛla yalim alikauli shɛli din yi man Yawɛ sanna ka n lo a min a zuliya maa sahakam.
en: From now on, the sacred offerings that the Israelites give to me will belong to you, your sons, and your daughters. This is my promise to you and your descendants, and it will never change.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pihitanaayɔbu saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka me goma gili Rama ni di chɛ ka so ku tooi yi Juda Naa Asa tiŋgban ni bee n-kana ti kpe di ni.
en: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa's rule, King Baasha of Israel invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, and he put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.

dag: ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni o daanfaani zuɣu, ka leeg o falidiriba zaŋ chaŋ nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima niŋbu la polo.
en: so that by his grace we might be put right with God and come into possession of the eternal life we hope for.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛ nuhi gbaag a, a bɔɣirimi ŋ-ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣusapima. Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛmaŋ jɛm a, a kabigirimi ka chɛ ka bɛ naba kɔŋ zanibu.
en: The people of Israel leaned on Egypt for support, but Egypt only pierced their hands and shoulder. They leaned on you for support, but you broke and twisted their back.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa chɛ bɛ ni gbahi shɛb maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa zaa zali kpamba maa mini zama maa zaa tooni.
en: So then the army handed the prisoners and the loot over to the people and their leaders.

dag: di saha n nyarila Naawuni tuma zaa, ka baŋ ni so ku tooi baŋ din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni. Bɛ yi bɔra, bɛn kpaŋm bɛmaŋ kabo, bɛ ku tooi baŋ li. Hal yɛnnim ni wuhiri ni bɛ mi li la, bɛ kul ku tooi baŋ li.
en: I observed all the work of God—that no one can grasp what happens under the sun. Those who strive to know cant grasp it. Even the wise who are set on knowing are unable to grasp it.

dag: Isaka zuliya ni, Zua bia Nɛtanɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Issachar—Nethanel son of Zuar;.

dag: Nyama, ti vihi dimbɔŋɔ nya, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Wummi li, ka baŋ li amaŋmaŋa.
en: We have studied this and know it is true. So listen to us, and learn for yourself.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli daa maan du pam chaŋ haliya, ka salo pam daa laɣimna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛtɔɣa, ka nya bɛ dɔriti tib kpaŋ.
en: But the news about Jesus spread more and more. Many people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

dag: Zaŋmiya tampiɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia m-mali m biɛhigu shee, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain, n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.

dag: Yi ni sokam lum o ma min o ba sizuura, ka gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Each of you must respect your mother and your father, and must keep the Sabbath, as I have commanded. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dapuhi maa n-tuntu ban shɛŋa din daa be sara maligu bimbini maa luɣa zuɣu la ni, ka bɛ mal li kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa. O daa zaŋla taabo dari mal li, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu.
en: He put the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar to carry it. He used boards to make the sides of the altar. It was hollow, like an empty box.

dag: Di saha n ni ti yihi n nuu maa ka chɛ ka a nya n nyaaŋa polo. Amaa n ninni din bi nyara.
en: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa baɣisi mɔɣu maa tariga zaŋ kpa Nɔba mini Jɔgbɛha wulimpuhili polo nti lu bɛ tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, dama tɔbbihi maa daa bi mali shili gu.
en: Gideon marched up the caravan road east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and attacked the camp while it was off-guard.

dag: Yinim bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, niŋmiy o naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: All of you worship the Lord , so you must trust him to help and protect you.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pihitanaayɔbu saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka me goma gili Rama ni di chɛ ka so ku tooi yi Juda Naa Asa tiŋgban ni bee n-kana ti kpe di ni.
en: In Asas th year as king, Baasha attacked Judah and then built up the city of Ramah to keep Asa from leaving Judah on any kind of military campaign.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi ni, Shɛbuɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma.
en: Gershoms oldest son was Shubael.

dag: Dama o kul chɛrila o gala sɔŋ tiŋa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani biisim kpɛr li.
en: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni daalikauli zaligunim zaa yɛla yɛli niriba zaa la nyaaŋa, o daa zaŋla naɣibihi mini buhi ʒim ni kom n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro vari mini piɛkɔb ʒɛhi tim di ni n-zaŋ li mihi Naawuni Zaligu Kundi la mini niriba maa zaa.
en: First, Moses told the people every command in the law. Then he took the blood of young bulls and mixed it with water. He used red wool and a branch of hyssop to sprinkle the blood and water on the book of the law and on all the people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Gibia ka anab bɔbili shiri tuh o soli ka Naawuni shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na pam, ka o pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Saul and his servant came to Gibeath Elohim, Saul met a group of prophets. Gods Spirit came on Saul with great power, and Saul prophesied with the prophets.

dag: Chɛ ka di leei liɣa, ka zibisim titali be di ni. Chɛ ka sagbana zibigi niŋ di ni. Chɛ ka zibisim nyaŋ di neesim.
en: I wish that bitter day had remained as dark as death, covered with the darkest clouds.

dag: Turi mini putɔɣu m-pali bɛ noya ni.
en: Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness. .

dag: Amaa ka o daa tim bɛ sunsuuni gari chaŋ o chandi.
en: But he passed through the crowd and went on his way.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛla yi zuɣu, ka bɛ suhiri Naawuni tiri ya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi pam yi ni la zuɣu.
en: They will also pray for you, and they will care deeply for you because of the outstanding grace that God has given to you.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zuliya nabi.
en: May the Lord give more and more to you and to your children.

dag: N kul dolila o ni wuhi ma shɛm; n kul dolila o soli ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: My feet have stayed right in his tracks. I have kept his way and not left it.

dag: Nyamiya! N ni siɣisi ya m Ba Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la na, dinzuɣu kul benya Jɛrusalɛm hal ti deei yiko shɛli din yɛn yi alizanda ni na maa.
en: Remember that I will send you the one my Father promised. Stay in the city until you are given that power from heaven.

dag: Ka Kiriatijiarimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-kuli ti zaŋ li tahi do so ŋun yuli daa booni Abinadab ka o yili be daboli zuɣu la yiŋa. Ka bɛ daa piig o bia Ɛliɛza ni o yuuni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: So the people of Kiriath Jearim got the Lord 's Covenant Box and took it to the house of a man named Abinadab, who lived on a hill. They consecrated his son Eleazar to be in charge of it.

dag: Bɛ lɔri ʒi tibisa din ʒibu to ʒiini niriba, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ bɛ nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: For they tie together heavy packs that are impossible to carry. They put them on the shoulders of others, but are unwilling to lift a finger to move them.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ ti ni daa nya wahala shɛli Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla; di daa nyɛla wahala din ka buɣisibu, hal ka ti daa yihi bebu tahima gba.
en: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, n ni chɛ ka zuliya shɛb kana ti lu yi zuɣu. Bɛ ni nahim ya Lɛbohamat dunol la shee zaŋ hal ni Araba kulibɔŋ la ni.
en: The Lord God Almighty himself says, People of Israel, I am going to send a foreign army to occupy your country. It will oppress you from Hamath Pass in the north to the Brook of the Arabah in the south.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn mali yɛm ŋɔ, wummiya: Din kariya ka Naawuni tum tuumbiɛri! Din kariya ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa tum taali!.
en: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa sani maa daa daai goon shɛŋa din zaa daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la luhi.
en: All the Babylonian soldiers that were with the commander broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa yihiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla waazu, ka wuhiri ba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛla palɔni, ka so daa bi kar o lala niŋbu ni.
en: Unhindered and with complete confidence, he continued to preach Gods kingdom and to teach about the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: ka m mi ni a kul deeri n suhigu sahakam; amaa niriba bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ zuɣu ka n suhir a maa ni di chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I know that you always answer my prayers. But I said this, so the people here would believe you sent me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi darigiri bɛ bihi tibili je ba mi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri bɛ bihi saɣisiri ba mi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima mali bans ayi n-zaŋ li goli sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ yini naŋgbaŋkuɣila salima din kɔɣili li maa lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba, ka bɛ ti zaŋ dapuhi turi di ni kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.

dag: dama bɛ suhutuntali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ bɔrɔbɔro la alahiziba tuuni la gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: They could not believe what happened. It was like the miracle he did with the bread. They still didnt understand what that meant.

dag: Amaa hal yi yi di wahala wuntia zuɣu, yi mal alibarika. Di zɔriya ninsalinima bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: But happy are you, even if you suffer because of righteousness! Dont be terrified or upset by them.

dag: Paɣimiy o; ŋuna n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum tuun kara din mali dabiɛm ka yi nina nya maa.
en: Praise him—he is your God, and you have seen with your own eyes the great and astounding things that he has done for you.

dag: Naawuni lan yɛli yaha: A nyɛla Duuma ŋun daa nam dunia ŋɔ piligu ni, ka zuɣusaa mi nyɛ a nuhi ni tum tuun shɛli.
en: The Scriptures also say, In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.

dag: ti yɛl o, Amiliya lɔbu ni sokam daŋdila wain viɛlli tibu pɔi, ka niriba yi ti nyu n-tiɣi, di saha ka bɛ naanyi zaŋdi wain piti na, amaa nyin zaŋla wain nyaɣisili sɔɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: and said, The best wine is always served first. Then after the guests have had plenty, the other wine is served. But you have kept the best until last.

dag: Ka Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be o ko la bemi kaman tihi puu ni suɣili bee puu ni sampaa la; ka be kaman be ni teei gili tin shɛli.
en: Daughter Zion is left like a small shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a cucumber field, like a city besieged.

dag: Tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini mini di dapuhi ni kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili dunol la.
en: the incense altar with its poles, the anointing oil and the sweet-smelling incense, the entrance screen for the dwellings entrance.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Izraɛl kpambaliba daa yiɣisi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni chani gindi.
en: Two days later their leaders went through the camp.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ shi so niŋ o ni, ka di chɛ ka o wum ŋumaŋuma yɛla ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. .
en: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.

dag: N yaa paai kuɣili yaa? Bee n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla daanya?.
en: Is my strength that of rocks, my flesh bronze?.

dag: Yihim ma sarika ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka m paɣ a yuli. Wuntizɔriba ni laɣim gili ma, dama a ni niŋ ma nirilim pam.
en: Help me escape this trap, so that I can praise your name. Then good people will celebrate with me, because you took care of me.

dag: Dama bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛliya, Ti mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi galisiya pam. Di simdi ni ti nya chi din ni chɛ ka ti di n-tiligi.
en: Some said, With our sons and daughters we are many, and we all need grain to eat and stay alive.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani din vuhiri leei wubilim tiŋgbani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.

dag: Nyini n-su wuntaŋ ni, ka lan su yuŋ gba; nyini n-zali wuntaŋ mini goli.
en: You control the day and the night. You made the sun and the moon.

dag: ka daa boli bia maa yuli Yisifu ka yɛli, Yawɛ tim ma bidib so pahi.
en: May the Lord give me another son; so she named him Joseph.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya bɛn daa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa zali ba ni bɛ deem zaka Izraɛlnim sani. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni bɛ deem li la bɛmaŋmaŋ mabihi sani, hal bɛ mabihi maa gba ni daa kul nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya la zaa yoli.
en: Now the law says that those from the tribe of Levi who become priests must get a tenth from their own people, even though they and their people are both from the family of Abraham.

dag: Di saha Zɛba mini Zalimuna ni bɛ tɔbbihi daa bela Karikɔr. Wulimpuhili polɔnim maa tɔbbihi bɛn daa kpalim kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pinaanu, dama bɛ daa pun ku bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi bɛn daa gbib takɔbiri la.
en: Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with an army of , troops. They were all that was left of the army of the eastern nations, because , of their warriors had been killed in the battle.

dag: Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa mini lɔndo din daa gili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa kpahi zaa daa nyɛla daanya.
en: All the tent pegs for the Holy Tent and for the curtains around the courtyard were made from bronze.

dag: dama di naan nyɛla buɣim din ni di hal ni gballi puuni ka di naan di m puu atam zaa.
en: indeed, its a fire that consumes to the underworld, uprooting all my harvest.

dag: Yawɛ ni tuhi ba tin ya, kul ʒiɛnya baalim.
en: The LORD will fight for you. You just keep still.

dag: N ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaa yɛla. Dama bɛ ni tum wuntitali tuun shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni be. .
en: All his sins will be forgiven, and he will live, because he did what is right.

dag: O ni nya dansi, ka kɔŋ jilima, ka o filiŋ maa ku lan naai;.
en: He will suffer disease and disgrace and never be free from the shame.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun nya nahiŋgu pam, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga fiɛbbu ni maa.
en: I am someone who saw the suffering caused by Gods angry rod.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya kɔniŋdi bini ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli, ka di naŋgbanyɛra zaŋ ti tuui tab nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: He also gave orders to make a large metal bowl called the Sea. It was . meters across, just over two meters deep, and . meters around.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti lihi bo Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka yi yi ti bo o ni yi suhu zaa ni yi shia zaa, yi ni nya o.
en: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord . And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha mini tiŋgban ni; dina n-nyɛ: ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi din tuɣiri sagbana ni.
en: I will give signs in the heavens and on the earth—blood and fire and columns of smoke.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li n-girimgirim li.
en: Some other seed fell among thorny weeds. The weeds grew and stopped the good plants from growing.

dag: amaa paɣ kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu, ka di bemi kaman o pin la o zuɣu maa la.
en: And any woman who prays or proclaims God's message in public worship with nothing on her head disgraces her husband; there is no difference between her and a woman whose head has been shaved.

dag: Ka bɛnkam nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛba pun zaŋ bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu mini di kɔre ni di yubu zaa n-kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified their sinful self. They have given up their old selfish feelings and the evil things they wanted to do.

dag: ka ŋun pa o zuɣu mini.
en: Then the second brother married the woman, and he died.

dag: ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni;.
en: They love the best seats at banquets and the front seats in the synagogues.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Malaki ni o yɛli Izraɛlnima.
en: This is the message that the Lord gave Malachi to tell the people of Israel.

dag: nti nya ka di nyɛla bɛ zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka bɛ daa fiɣis o, amaa ka o mi bi tum taal shɛli din simdi ni bɛ ku o bee n-kpɛh o duu.
en: I discovered that they were accusing him about questions related to their Law. I found no charge deserving of death or imprisonment.

dag: Yiɣisima, dama di nyɛla a tuma, ka ti gba ʒe a nyaaŋa, mali yaa, ka niŋ li.
en: Get up, Ezra. This is your responsibility, but we will support you. So be brave and do it.

dag: amaa di sabiya ni ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma sani, chinchini maa piligirimi.
en: But whenever someone turns back to the Lord, the veil is removed.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kpani lu ninvuɣ kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku ba ka zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed men with his spear. He was as famous as the Three Warriors.

dag: Amaa bɛn baɣa daa ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa ni bɛn daa chɛla bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri niŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Others who didnt take the LORDs word to heart left their servants and livestock out in the open field.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni wum n suhigu ka deei n suhigu maa.
en: But God did listen to me; he heard my prayer.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, Ka a luɣ shɛli ka galimi.
en: You are utterly beautiful, my dearest; theres not a single flaw in you.

dag: N dabili Dauda ni ti nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ zaa ti mali piɛgul yino. Bɛ ni ti doli n zaligunim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A king like my servant David will be their king. They will all be united under one ruler and will obey my laws faithfully.

dag: Ka n daa wum yɛtɔɣa kukolibil ni, ka n tibili daa wum di ni sɔɣiri yɛra.
en: I happened to hear a message. My ears caught a whisper of it.

dag: Judas daa nyɛla ti ni yino, ka o nuu daa be ti tuma ŋɔ ni.
en: Judas was a member of our group, for he had been chosen to have a part in our work. .

dag: Dindali maa ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli.
en: David was frightened by God that day. How will I ever bring Gods chest home to me? he asked.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Akishi, Di viɛla, a ni ti nya man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka Akishi daa yɛli Dauda, Mbo, n ni zaŋ a leei ŋun ni be n sani n-guli ma hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: Excellent, David answered Achish. Now youll see for yourself what your servant can do. Excellent, Achish replied. I will make you my permanent bodyguard.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Di simdi ka yi zɔri Yawɛ ka tum tuma maa ni ʒiɛyimtali ni yi suhu zaa.
en: He told them: Faithfully serve the Lord !.

dag: Ka di daa muɣis o pam asibaasi, ka o tim ti boli Ijipti timanim mini baŋdiba zaa na, ka ŋun Firawuna daa yɛli ba o zahima maa, amaa ka so daa kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi Firawuna o zahima maa gbinni.
en: The next morning the king was upset. So he called in his magicians and wise men and told them what he had dreamed. None of them could tell him what the dreams meant.

dag: Hal bɛ daa timla tuumba katinsi ni bɛ ti boli dɔbba ti ba, ka bɛ daa shiri kana. Bɛ zuɣu ka a su kom, ka bali chilo, ka zaŋ yɛ viɛla ye.
en: They have sent for men from faraway places. You sent a messenger to these men, and they came to see you. You bathed for them, painted your eyes, and put on your jewelry.

dag: Bɛ taɣi kpibiga buŋ chaŋ, ka deei pakoli nahu talima.
en: They take donkeys that belong to orphans, and keep a widow's ox till she pays her debts.

dag: Di ni leei tim tib a niŋgbuŋ, ka chɛ ka a niŋgbuna maai.
en: If you do, it will be like good medicine, healing your wounds and easing your pains.

dag: Bɛ daa yila Ifriim tiŋgban ni, ka vinvamli ni na, n-doli nyin Bɛnjamin min a daŋ niriba. Ka sapashin kpamba daa yi Makiri na, ka sapashim bihi mi daa yi Zɛbulɔn na.
en: They came from Ephraim into the valley, behind the tribe of Benjamin and its people. The commanders came down from Machir, the officers down from Zebulun.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Jɛriko, ka bɛ mini salo pam daa ti yiri Jɛriko maa, ka Timius bia Baatimius ŋun daa nyɛ zoma, ka nyɛ barimaana ʒi sokpaŋa.
en: They came to Jericho, and as Jesus was leaving with his disciples and a large crowd, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus son of Timaeus was sitting by the road.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa sɔhigiya ka dam, dama Yawɛ ni lo nia ni o chɛ ka Babilɔn zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni la n-yɛn niŋ pali.
en: The earth quakes and trembles because the LORDs plans against Babylon are fulfilled: to reduce Babylon to a wasteland, with no one left in it.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa gbahi bɛ mabihi Judanim maa niriba tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣiba mini bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi, ka di nɛma pam n-zaŋ kuli Samaria.
en: The Israelites took captive two hundred thousand women, boys, and girls from their Judean relatives and seized enormous amounts of plunder, which they took back to Samaria.

dag: Bɛ nyuri dam kuuna n-chani tumdi yolimyolim. Bɛ paɣila vidibo gari jilima nyabu.
en: Ephraim has joined their drunkenness. Let them continue to be prostitutes. Let them be with their lovers.

dag: Tuuni kam tumbu mali nyɔri, amaa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu kɔŋko nyɛla din tahiri fara na.
en: There is profit in hard work, but mere talk leads to poverty.

dag: Yɛhudianim bi be bɛ ko ka chɛ bɛn pa Yɛhudianima; kulla Duuma yino n-nyɛ bɛ zaa Duuma, ka o niŋdi alibarika din galisi n-niŋdi bɛnkam kuhiri boon o ni.
en: It says this because there is no difference between those who are Jews and those who are not. The same Lord is the Lord of all people. And he richly blesses everyone who looks to him for help.

dag: n-daa kpalim ni niŋ chira ata. Ka daa ti yɛn yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria ka wum ni Yɛhudianim gu o soli, ka o daa lo nia ni o ni zaŋ doli Masidɔnia polo chaŋ.
en: and stayed there three months. Paul was ready to sail for Syria, but some Jews were planning something against him. So he decided to go back through Macedonia to Syria.

dag: Bɛn guli Izraɛlnim zaa nyɛla zoomba, bɛ ka baŋsim. Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn doya gbihiri ka bi wahira. Bɛ kul domi gbihiri ka zahindi zahima.
en: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.

dag: ka yɛli, N dana, a nini yi tiɣi ma, yin zanim mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani.
en: he said, Sirs, please do not pass by my home without stopping; I am here to serve you.

dag: Ti chaŋya ka duu maa dunoya zaa kparimi kirikiri, ka dansarika guliba ʒe dunoya ni gu, amaa ka ti kparigi ka bi nya so duu maa ni.
en: We found the prison locked and well-secured, with guards standing at the doors, but when we opened the doors we found no one inside.

dag: Ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la; ka chib shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni din ni tooi paɣ li ka di piɛl lala.
en: and his clothes became shining white—whiter than anyone in the world could wash them.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so leei niriba maa toondana.
en: Let the LORD, the God of all living things, appoint someone over the community.

dag: O teem a pina zaa yɛla, ka chɛ ka o nini tiɣ a sar shɛŋa zaa a ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim.
en: Let God recall your many grain offerings; let him savor your entirely burned offerings. Selah.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zali sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zaligu ka zuɣusaa dunoya daa yooi;.
en: God gave orders to the skies above, opened heavens doors.

dag: O zaŋ saa nyaɣisibu gbib o nuu ni n-chɛ ka di nyaɣisir o ni zal li luɣ shɛli polo.
en: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash kum nyaaŋa.
en: King Amaziah of Judah lived fifteen years after the death of King Jehoash of Israel.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Yinima n-tum birigi chaŋ ti kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim taali galisi.
en: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka saa ku n-zibigi, ka pɔhim gbaai ʒiɛbu, ka sa kurili dii piligi mibu. Ka Ɛhab daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-zo nti kpe Jɛziriil.
en: In a little while the sky was covered with dark clouds, the wind began to blow, and a heavy rain began to fall. Ahab got in his chariot and started back to Jezreel.

dag: Di chɛ ka a nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpɛh a alahichi ni. A mi miri ka a ti yɛli adiini karimba ni pa lala ka a di yɛli. Di chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu a yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka a tuma bahi yoli.
en: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, I didn't mean what I said. God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.

dag: Iso daa kpuɣila Keenan paɣiba. Bɛ yuya n-nyɛ: Ada ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛlɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir bipuɣiŋga la mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Zibiɔn ŋun nyɛ Hivi nir bia Ana bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Esau married Canaanite women: Adah the daughter of the Hittite Elon; Oholibamah the daughter of Anah son of the Hittite Zibeon.

dag: Teeku bula mini biŋkɔb kara bɛn be di ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ dunia ni.
en: Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all you ocean depths!.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum a niriba Izraɛlnim maa suhigu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi ka lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni na.
en: listen to them in heaven. Forgive the sins of your people and bring them back to the land which you gave to their ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun mi daa yi Kamɛl na la chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: So David and his two wives moved to Hebron.

dag: Amaa duŋtaariba mini alahichinim zaa ni ti bahi yoli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ mi ni ti kpi.
en: But he will crush everyone who sins and rebels against him; he will kill everyone who forsakes him.

dag: Anabinim bɛn be di puuni naala noli n-lo nia biɛri. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣima n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa ka ŋumda. Bɛ di ninsalinim nyɛviya, ka fa azichi mini binviɛla, ka chɛ ka pakoya galisi.
en: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi yaha, ka do so daa zɔna ti damd o tooni m-bɔh o, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: As Jesus was starting on his way again, a man ran up, knelt before him, and asked him, Good Teacher, what must I do to receive eternal life.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti sa vuhim shee, kom ni be luɣ shɛli pam din ni chɛ ka di niŋ wula n-wali wala, ka niŋ yɔɣili din mali jilima.
en: a good field with plentiful water where it was planted to grow branches, bear fruit, and become a splendid vine.

dag: amaa kom daa puhiri yirila tiŋ na m-mahigiri tiŋgbani zaa.
en: But streams came up from the ground and watered the earth.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni kul du shɛm, ka tiŋgbani mi zilim shɛm, lala n-nyɛ nanim tɛha, di ka vihi baŋ.
en: You never know what a king is thinking; his thoughts are beyond us, like the heights of the sky or the depths of the ocean.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka yi nimaani; ka niriba pam daa dol o, ka o chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni zaa kpaŋ.
en: Jesus knew what they intended to do, so he went away from there. Large crowds followed him, and he healed them all.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ yino alahichi tumbu zuɣu yi chɛ ka Naawuni nya sokam taali, lala mi n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino wuntia tuma zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka sokam yi taali ni ka nya nyɛvili.
en: So then, as the one sin condemned all people, in the same way the one righteous act sets all people free and gives them life.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka teeku vuri fɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔgbana vuri fɔra; nyini n-lan chɛ ka niriba bɛn taai duŋ gba fɔra.
en: You calm the roar of the seas and the noise of the waves; you calm the uproar of the peoples.

dag: Ka Ɛli bɔh o, Wula ka o sa lee yɛl a? Di sɔɣ ma shɛli, a yi sɔɣ ma yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa puuni, Naawuni ŋun zaŋm o ni di yɛn niŋ ma shɛm maa niŋ a, hal ŋun niŋm a gari lala gba.
en: Eli said, What did God say to you? Tell me everything. I'll ask God to punish you terribly if you don't tell me every word he said.

dag: Ka Midian mi bihi daa nyɛ Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura bihi min o yaansi.
en: Midians sons were Ephah, Epher, Enoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were Keturahs sons.

dag: Ka di daa gar o pam bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chani gindi tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba.
en: He was surprised that the people there had no faith. Then he went to other villages in that area and taught.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa, ka lan mali suhukpeeni pam, ka daa chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni hal ka o saha ti paai, ka o naanyi yih omaŋ palo Izraɛlnim sani.
en: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Firijia mini Galɛshia tiŋgbana ni garita, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa bi saɣi ni bɛ yihi waazu Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the regions of Phrygia and Galatia because the Holy Spirit kept them from speaking the word in the province of Asia.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o lee suhimi ni yɛda ka bi biɛhinda, dama ŋun biɛhindi ŋmanila teeku kɔgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri ka di laŋsira.
en: But when you pray, you must believe and not doubt at all. Whoever doubts is like a wave in the sea that is driven and blown about by the wind.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn nina ti ku ne, ka bɛ ti ku mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛŋa zo n-tiligi, ka bɛ tahima ti yɛn nyɛla bɛ vuhim ŋmaabu.
en: The eyes of the wicked will grow faint; flight has vanished from them; their hope is a dying gasp.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnim yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ŋmɛmiya mɔɣilɔnima, ka zaŋ biŋkumda kumsi paɣ o.
en: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ tum Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa zaa.
en: All the work on the Tent of the Lord 's presence was finally completed. The Israelites made everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N nyɛla n ni daa pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so piligu ni la.
en: They asked, Then who are you? Jesus answered, I am what I have told you from the beginning.

dag: N yura maa n su ma ka n gba su o. O chɛ ka o biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom shee.
en: I am his, and he is mine, as he feeds his sheep among the lilies.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa zɔri Sulemaana, ka yiɣisi chaŋ ti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Adonijah was afraid of Solomon, so he got up and went to grab hold of the horns of the altar.

dag: Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda; di mi bi miri gumdi. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: Look how the wild flowers grow! They don't work hard to make their clothes. But I tell you Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of these flowers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be nimaani maa ka ninkur so ti yi o puuni na zaawuni. Doo maa daa yila Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni tiŋ ni na ti be Gibia maa. Amaa nimaaninim daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: While they were there, an old man came by at the end of a day's work on the farm. He was originally from the hill country of Ephraim, but he was now living in Gibeah.

dag: So miri ka o kpuɣ o paɣ mabia pah o zuɣu saha shɛl o paɣ maa ni na be o nyɛvili ni maa.
en: You must not marry your wifes sister as a rival and have sexual contact with her while her sister is alive.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋub nimdi ka ʒim na be di ni. Di ti bɔhimya baɣitali bee sotali.
en: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi ninvuɣ bɔbigu zuɣu tum tuumbiɛɣu bee m-pahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ʒiri shɛhira dibu ni.
en: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daansi ŋɔ ni ka bɛn tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni yɛn duɣiri niriba maa sara maligu binyara.
en: The man said, These are the kitchens where the temple workers will boil the meat that worshipers offer as sacrifices.

dag: Ka niriba pam ni ti doli karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ kɔr biɛri soya, ka bɛ biɛhigu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalim yɛlimaŋli sol la.
en: Even so, many will follow their immoral ways; and because of what they do, others will speak evil of the Way of truth.

dag: Bɛn su bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ku lan di o baɣibuɣibo maa nyɔri maa ka bɛ daa gbaai Pool mini Silas n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani daa puuni.
en: When her owners realized that their chance of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them to the authorities in the public square.

dag: Yi bi yɛli ni di kpalim chira anahi ni puu atam kpuɣibu? Amaa n yɛri ya mi, kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi puri ni, di daatam maa biya zaa, ka di kpalimla chɛbu.
en: When you plant, you always say, Four more months to wait before we gather the grain. But I tell you, open your eyes, and look at the fields. They are ready for harvesting now.

dag: Filip mini Baatolomiu ni Tomas ni Matiu ŋun daa nyɛ farigudeera la ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni.
en: Philip; and Bartholomew; Thomas; and Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; and Thaddaeus.

dag: M mabiyurisi, wummiya! Pa Naawuni m-pii ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba dunia ŋɔ ni ni bɛ nyɛ azichinima zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu polo, ka lan nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn di nam shɛli o ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la?.
en: Listen, my dear brothers and sisters. God chose the poor people in the world to be rich in faith. He chose them to receive the kingdom God promised to those who love him.

dag: ka mali dapaɣa ayi niŋ di nyaaŋa lɔrisi la ni.
en: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.

dag: Di nahindiya yimaŋ bindir shɛli din ni saɣim zuɣu, amaa bomiyala bindir shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Dina n-nyɛ Daadam Bia ni mali shɛli tiri ya la, dama ŋuna ka ti Ba Naawuni zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili.
en: Dont work for the food that doesnt last but for the food that endures for eternal life, which the Human One will give you. God the Father has confirmed him as his agent to give life.

dag: Nyama, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n zaŋ a leei zuliya pam mini nanim zuɣulana, ni a vuɣi, ka daai luhi, ni a wurim ka ŋme m-paai, ni a me ka sa.
en: This very day I appoint you over nations and empires, to dig up and pull down, to destroy and demolish, to build and plant.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din daa sabi kurimbuni ha daa sabila ti wuhibu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daanzansi niŋbu mini Naawuni Kundi suhukpaŋsibo chɛ ka ti mali tahima.
en: Whatever was written in the past was written for our instruction so that we could have hope through endurance and through the encouragement of the scriptures.

dag: ni Zikilag ni Mɛkɔna ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: They lived in the city of Ziklag, in Meconah and its villages.

dag: O daa chɛ ka mɔɣa leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina kuui.
en: He changed rivers into a desert. He stopped springs from flowing.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu gbaŋ maa puuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ mali shili gu dindali maa.
en: A copy of the order was to become law in each province and to be posted in public for all peoples to read. The people were to be ready for this day to do as the order commanded.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri wuna ni birim. Di ni gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ di vi.
en: Many people make false gods, but they will be disappointed. All of them will go away ashamed.

dag: Zuliya shɛb tiŋgbana n yaannim ni daa tuhi nyaŋ la buɣa daa tooi fa ba bahi? Di tiŋgbana maa n-nyɛ: Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ni Ɛdin niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa la.
en: My ancestors destroyed the cities of Gozan, Haran, and Rezeph, and killed the people of Betheden who lived in Telassar, and none of their gods could save them.

dag: Ka naa daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina m-mali nam ʒiishee zaɣ titali, ka chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaa m-pa di zuɣu.
en: He also had a large throne made. Part of it was covered with ivory and the rest of it was covered with the finest gold.

dag: niriba mini nanim yi ti laɣim ni bɛ jɛm Yawɛ.
en: when nations gather together and kingdoms come to serve the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: The priests, the teachers of the law, and the Jewish leaders all talked about this. They said to each other, If we answer, Johns baptism was from God, then he will say, Then why did you not believe John.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣ a yuli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm ŋɔ. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.

dag: Di nahindiya pakoya mini kpibisi ni tinzunnim bɛn be yi ni zaŋ tabili nandaamba. Yi mi di lɔnya yi kpee zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. .
en: Do not oppress widows, orphans, foreigners who live among you, or anyone else in need. And do not plan ways of harming one another.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli maa n-chɛ ka n yiɣisi zani m ba Dauda zaani n-ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: And now the Lord has kept his promise. I have succeeded my father as king of Israel, and I have built the Temple for the worship of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni sahakam, ka bɛ zuliya kul ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The LORD is intimately acquainted with the lives of the blameless; their heritage will last forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa daa gbaai Firawuna kpamba maa shɛb dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ daba mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri zo n-kuli yiŋ yomyom.
en: Some of Pharaohs officials paid attention to the Lord s message. They quickly put all of their animals and slaves into houses.

dag: nyama, n ni chɛ ka tinzunnim kana ti lir a. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi bɛ takɔbiri lu a yɛm din viɛl ŋɔ zuɣu, ka saɣim a jilima la.
en: Ill bring foreigners, the most ruthless nations, against you. They will let loose their swords against your fine wisdom, and they will degrade your splendor.

dag: Di chaŋya; di chɛliya ka yi dimnim maa ti kun ya, dama Yawɛ ka yi sani.
en: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.

dag: Tumtumdiba ni bɔri bindirigu zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi tuma, ka kum nyɛ din kpaŋsiri ba ka bɛ tumda.
en: A laborer's appetite makes him work harder, because he wants to satisfy his hunger.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be mɔɣu maa ni ka wum ni Nabal chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: While in the wilderness, David heard that Nabal was shearing his sheep.

dag: Maligumaaniba daa ʒi m-bɔhi, Yawɛ lee be ya? Zaligubaŋdiba daa bi mi ma, ka nanim tum din bi tuhi n-jɛndi ma. Ka anabinim daa mali Baal yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka doli binshɛŋa din ka ba nyɔri.
en: The priests did not ask, Where is the Lord ? The people who know the law did not want to know me. The leaders of the people of Israel turned against me. The prophets spoke in the name of the false god Baal. They worshiped worthless idols.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin suhimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni, chɛ ka a yuli du;.
en: Pray like this: Our Father who is in heaven, uphold the holiness of your name.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa doli ti mini Pool kuhiri yɛra, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Zallakudura Naa daba bɛn wuhiri ya tiliginsim soli.
en: She followed Paul and us, shouting, These men are servants of the Most High God! They announce to you how you can be saved.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Ibram biŋkɔbiguliba mini Lɔt biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni. Di saha maa Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima n-daa be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Conflicts broke out between those herding Abrams livestock and those herding Lots livestock. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land.

dag: M mabihi n yi ka yi sanna ti tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa, buchi bɔ ka di yɛn kun ya, ka pa ni n zaŋla yɛla kahigibu bee baŋsim yɛtɔɣa bee anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee wuhibu yɛla tɔɣisi ya.
en: So when I come to you, my friends, what use will I be to you if I speak in strange tongues? Not a bit, unless I bring you some revelation from God or some knowledge or some inspired message or some teaching.

dag: Chɛ ka a ninni neesim neei niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Bless me with your presence and teach me your laws.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tinima bee malaika so ŋun yi alizanda ni na yi yihi lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ ti ni daa pun yihi shɛli waazu tin ya la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel that is different from the one we preached to you, may he be condemned to hell!.

dag: Anabi Musa daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba zaa sani kaman yilibia la ni o di Naawuni ni ti yɛn yɛli binshɛŋa yɛla la shɛhira;.
en: Moses was faithful as a servant in Gods whole house. He told people what God would say in the future.

dag: Naawuni tamla o nirilim niŋbu la yɛla? O suhuyiɣisili chɛ ka o zaɣisila nambɔɣu zɔbu.
en: Has God forgotten how to be gracious? Has he angrily stopped up his compassion? Selah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni Babilɔn zuɣu shɛm, lala ka di simdi ni Babilɔnnim gba kpi bɛ ni ku lzraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.

dag: Amaa nyini n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi, ka ʒi a nam ʒiishee, ka Izraɛlnim paɣir a.
en: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ lala n-yiɣisi chaŋ Shilo nti chaŋ Ahija yiŋa. Di saha maa Ahija ni daa kurigi zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina niŋla liti ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: She got ready and left for Ahijah's house in Shiloh. Ahijah was now old and blind.

dag: Masia ni daa di wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni shɛm la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi gba zaŋ o tɛha maa tatabo kpaŋsi yimaŋa, dama ŋunkam diri wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni, o bi lan zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri alahichi tumbu ni.
en: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka saha daa ti paai ni bɛ zaŋ o ti bahi, ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa pihi bia maa ni o ti wums o n-zaŋ o leeg omaŋmaŋ bia.
en: When they put him outside, Pharaohs daughter took him. She raised him as her own son.

dag: Musa daa woligi pirigili shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili ka chɛ tɔbbihi la dini.
en: The share of the community was the same as that for the soldiers: , sheep and goats, , cattle, , donkeys, and , virgins.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yina n-na kul yɛla kpar ʒiɛɣu la, ka pili gɔhi zuɣupiligu maa. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya doo maa.
en: Then Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to the Jews, Here is the man.

dag: Wɔr fufuhisi la ni daa ti yina, bɛ ni daa kul ŋmɛrimi ni bɛ kaai gili dunia ŋɔ. Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya kaai gili dunia ŋɔ, ka bɛ daa chaŋ.
en: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, Start patrolling the earth. When they had gone on their way.

dag: Amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tuma maa daa lan pahi, ka o lan teeg o bilim saha o ni daa tumdi pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla.
en: Oholibah didn't stop there, but became even more immoral and acted as she had back in Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina. Ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣ yihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: I say to you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual unfaithfulness, and marries another woman commits adultery.

dag: Bahiyoli mini kum yɛliya, Ti tiba daa wum di ŋumaŋuma.
en: Death and destruction say, We have never seen wisdom; we have only heard rumors about it.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka a kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli a ni daa ʒi n-yi Ijipti na la zani tariga. Ka a kɔre ku lan kpe bɛ ni bee n-lan teei bɛ yɛla.
en: Thats how I will put an end to your lewdness and your Egyptian-styled promiscuity. Never again will you stare at them, and you wont remember Egypt anymore.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yihi yɛli ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu ka wumdi tirila shi biɛri bɛn yɔhindi niriba la ka ni dolila alizin biɛri wuhibu.
en: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.

dag: Ka yɛm shia daa pali Nan bia Jɔshua, dama Musa daa zaŋla o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa deeg o noli, ka niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Joshua son of Nun was filled with wisdom, because Moses had appointed him to be his successor. The people of Israel obeyed Joshua and kept the commands that the Lord had given them through Moses.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anu ni gol so ŋun pahir awɛi ni ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Juda fɔntinsi ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na zaa daa moli nolɔbo molo Yawɛ tooni.
en: In the ninth month of the fifth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the people fasted to gain the Lord 's favor. The fast was kept by all who lived in Jerusalem and by all who came there from the towns of Judah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum baŋdiba zaa bɛn be Babilɔn.
en: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N suhu kul yɛla Ziɔn sɔŋbu zuɣu, ka n zabiri nyuli ni suhuyiɣisili di zuɣu. .
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: I care passionately about Zion; I burn with passion for her.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lar o. Amaa ka o daa kari bɛ zaa yihi, ka zaŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma pahi bɛn daa be o san la zuɣu kpe bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa do du shɛli ni maa.
en: But everyone laughed at him. Jesus told the people to leave the house. Then he went into the room where the child was. He brought the childs father and mother and his three followers into the room with him.

dag: Tuunkpɛmalana ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din tahiri nyamma pam na, amaa ŋunkam bɔri yomyom ni nyari shɛlikam poor o mi.
en: The plans of the diligent end up in profit, but those who hurry end up with loss.

dag: Bɛ ni ti fabili a zuɣu, ka yɛl a: Nyin tin shɛli din yuli daa du ŋɔ, bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a lan ka teeku ni? Tin shɛli din min a niriba daa mali yaa teeku ni ŋɔ, nyini ŋun daa zal a kpiɔŋ a tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa sani ŋɔ!.
en: They will sing a lament for you, and they will say: How you have perished, queen of the sea, city once praised, who once dominated the sea, she and her rulers, who spread their terror abroad, every one of them.

dag: A nyari paɣibu bibihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni a dimnim zuɣu. A chɛ ka a dima mini ŋun nyɛ biɛribɔhira fo bɛ noya.
en: it is sung by children and babies. You are safe and secure from all your enemies; you stop anyone who opposes you.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, O be ya? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, O be Ammiɛl bia Makiri la yiŋa Lɔdɛba.
en: The king said to Ziba, Where is this son? Ziba said to the king, He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni lan kpalim be alizanda ni hal ka binshɛɣukam zaa ti niŋ pali kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: But Jesus must stay in heaven until the time when all things will be made right again. God told about this time when he spoke long ago through his holy prophets.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti yiri Jɛriko ka salo pam dol o.
en: When Jesus and his followers were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

dag: Ti Duuma ni yihi Ziɔn paɣiba daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ saria karibu mini buɣim paɣi ʒim din yi n-do Jɛrusalɛm puuni la ka di yi.
en: When the Lord washes the filth from Zions daughters, and cleanses Jerusalems bloodguilt from within it by means of a wind of judgment and a searing wind.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni lu ka ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba yiŋ ni zani.
en: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.

dag: Bɛ bihi yi nya jilima, bɛ bi mi; ka bɛ yi nya filiŋ, so baɣa ka di ni.
en: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.

dag: Lala ka niriba ŋɔ zahindi zahima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu, ka turi bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la.
en: It is the same way with these people who have entered your group. They are guided by dreams. They make themselves dirty with sin. They reject Gods authority and say bad things against the glorious ones.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnima, di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ; amaa n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ yi ni daa saɣim shɛli zuliya shɛb sani yi ni daa be la zuɣu.
en: Therefore, say to the house of Israel, The LORD God proclaims: House of Israel, Im not acting for your sake but for the sake of my holy name, which you degraded among the nations where you have gone.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali bans anahi tam daanya kurupooti maa naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu din yɛn gbibi di dapuhi.
en: Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya! Ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: Show me a silver coin. Whose name and picture are on it? They said, Caesars.

dag: Buɣa palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ jɛmdi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: Their land is full of idols, and they worship objects that they have made with their own hands.

dag: Bɛ dari ba yihi bɛ ni niŋ yili shɛli yɛda ni, ka zaŋ ba tahi na so ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm sani.
en: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be du shɛl ni ka kpari di dunoya, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima. Ka Yisa ti puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: It was late that Sunday evening, and the disciples were gathered together behind locked doors, because they were afraid of the Jewish authorities. Then Jesus came and stood among them. Peace be with you, he said.

dag: Naawuni, n niŋ a naani zaa; n shiri niŋ a naani zaa! N ni yili yila ni kukoli nyaɣisili niŋ a.
en: God, I am ready, heart and soul, to sing songs of praise.

dag: Yɛlim Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Sulemaana bia ka nyɛ Juda naa la mini Juda zuliya niriba ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba zaa ni man Yawɛ yɛliya.
en: to give Rehoboam and everyone from Judah and Benjamin this warning:.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Jabɛshi bia Shallum daa di nam maa. O mi daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la gol yini Samaria.
en: Shallum, Jabeshs son, became king in the thirty-ninth year of Judahs King Uzziah. He ruled for one month in Samaria.
