dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Yawɛ, ninsal yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu ti Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: If a solemn promise involves livestock that can be offered to the LORD, any such animal given to the LORD will be considered holy.

dag: Di saha ka zuliya bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn gili ya la zaa ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali luɣ shɛŋa din daa wurim maa me, ka labi biri luɣ shɛŋa din daa leei tiŋgban nɛl la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka ni niŋ li.
en: Then the neighboring nations that have survived will know that I, the Lord , rebuild ruined cities and replant waste fields. I, the Lord , have promised that I would do this—and I will.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi mali buɣa n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim, ka tumdi bukpahigu tuma, ka buɣiri baɣisi, ka saɣim bɛmaŋa n-tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: They sacrificed their sons and daughters as burnt offerings to pagan gods; they consulted mediums and fortunetellers, and they devoted themselves completely to doing what is wrong in the Lord 's sight, and so aroused his anger.

dag: Pinimiya zuɣukpina, yi ni yuri yi bi shɛb la zuɣu. Pinimiya zuɣukpina ka di be kaman juɣu zuɣu la, dama bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni.
en: People of Judah, cut off your hair in mourning for the children you love. Make yourselves as bald as vultures, because your children will be taken away from you into exile.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn boli niriba ka bɛ ka a yiŋ na ti di bindira, nyin bolimila nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni gbariti mini zoomba.
en: When you give a feast, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind;.

dag: Ka a zaŋ di zaa tuɣi taba ka di leei da yini n-nyɛ zaɣ yini a nuu ni.
en: Then hold the two sticks end to end in your hand so that they look like one stick.

dag: Masia yɛlimaŋli din be n ni la zuɣu, binshɛli kani din ni tooi yihi barinyubo shɛli din be n ni ŋɔ Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinsi ni.
en: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.

dag: Yɔnahu ni saɣi tum a tuma? O ni saɣi gbe a naɣikpahi ni yuŋ?.
en: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?.

dag: N nya n dabili Dauda, m booi n kpam din be kasi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ yɔhim o? Ka shia maa garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti leei ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Cham ti niŋ lala n-yɔhim o; a ni di nasara.
en: The spirit answered, I will go to Ahabs prophets and cause them to tell lies. So the Lord said, Yes, that will fool Ahab. Go out and do that.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli foliŋga maa Zuɣusaa. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayi.
en: and named it Sky. Evening came, then morning—that was the second day.

dag: Di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, kul teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zaa shɛm la yɛla.
en: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.

dag: dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli ka bɛ gbib a ka gul a.
en: for its written: He will command his angels concerning you, to protect you.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi n-dol o kaman naɣilaa ka bɛ vɔri chani ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la bee n-nyɛ tɔŋtɔŋ kaman molifu n-zɔri chani tɔŋ ni la.
en: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ o ti ti, ka ti ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa.
en: But the LORD our God gave him to us. We struck him down, along with his sons, and all his forces.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Chimham ni doli ma kuli ka n ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, ka a suhu ni kul yu ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: David said, I'll take Chimham with me, and whatever you ask me to do for him, I'll do. And if there's anything else you want, I'll also do that.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanima, yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya yila paɣi ti Duuma.
en: Sing to God, all kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to my Lord. Selah.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbala du shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ kalo paligi di nyaansi ka di lihibu viɛla, amaa ka kpiimba kɔba mini daɣiri balibu kam pali di puuni la.
en: It will be bad for you teachers of the law and you Pharisees! You are hypocrites! You are like tombs that are painted white. Outside they look fine, but inside they are full of dead peoples bones and all kinds of filth.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba zuɣu yi chɛ ka simdi kpe o mini dunianim sunsuuni, o yi lan deei ba, wula ka di lee ni be? Di ni ŋmanila kpiimba n-neei kum ni.
en: God turned away from the Jews. When that happened, he became friends with the other people in the world. So when he accepts the Jews, it will be like bringing people to life after death.

dag: Di maliya karimbaani ti yaɣi bee n-tɔɣisiri kapirichi yɛtɔɣa.
en: I tell them to stop their boasting.

dag: Daadamnim bi malila tuun kpɛma tumbu dunia ŋɔ ni? Ka bɛ dabisa bi ŋmanila bɛ ni bu so paa dabisa?.
en: People have a hard struggle on earth. Their life is like that of a hired worker.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi niŋ hal ko mahim biɛla ti n nyaandoliba ni yino, hal ŋun pɔri bɛ ni gba, o ni nyɛ n nyaandol zuɣu, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: You can be sure that whoever gives even a drink of cold water to one of the least of these my followers because he is my follower, will certainly receive a reward.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sandaantimdiba mal alibarika, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti boli ba o bihi.
en: Happy are people who make peace, because they will be called Gods children.

dag: Kum daa ti lan lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di daa nyɛla kum din pahi din daa pun lu Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la zuɣu. Ka Yisahaku daa chaŋ Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk sani Gɛra.
en: Now there was a famine. This was like the famine that happened during Abrahams life. So Isaac went to the town of Gerar, to King Abimelech of the Philistines.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun tiri ti nasara ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: But thanks be to God who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!.

dag: Yi ni daa yi Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka n daa pun lɔnya alikauli ni n kul ni be yi sani. Di zɔriya dabiɛm. .
en: As with our agreement when you came out of Egypt, my spirit stands in your midst. Dont fear.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Lala n-nyɛ ŋun bo n-nya bun la omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, lala nir pala bundana.
en: This is how it will be for anyone who saves things only for himself. To God that person is not rich.

dag: Yi yi ti biri yi bimbira, o ni chɛ ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ, ka yi kpuɣi atam pam, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nya mɔri pam ŋubira.
en: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.

dag: ka zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: The third row will be a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Sukɔt nti me o yili ka ti o biŋkɔbiri suɣa zali. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Sukɔt.
en: but Jacob traveled to Succoth. He built a house for himself but made temporary shelters for his animals; therefore, he named the place Succoth.

dag: Karimbaannim gbi ma la bɔɣ biɛri. Bɛ maanila a zaligu ansarisi.
en: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni, di simdi ni yi bahi yi ni da Hiburu dab so kam ŋun tum yi tuma hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu ka o chaŋ. Di bi lan simdi ka yi chɛ ka bɛ tum yi tuma yaha. Amaa ka yi yaannim maa daa zaɣisi li wumbu.
en: every seven years they were to set free any Hebrew slave who had served them for six years. But your ancestors would not pay any attention to me or listen to what I said.

dag: Ka di yi pa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni nini ku tiɣi nira. Dama ŋunkam chaŋ Naawuni sani, di niŋ kamaata ni o niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni beni ka deeri bɛn bɔr o ni bɛ suhuri zaa suhigu.
en: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.

dag: Gbuɣinli ni ŋum yɔɣu ni ka pa ni o nyala binshɛɣu? Ka gbuɣimbil ni ŋum vol ni ka pa ni o gbaala binshɛɣu?.
en: A lion will roar in the forest only if it catches its prey. A young lion roaring in his cave means he has caught something to eat.

dag: Di ni simdi ni yi yɛli shɛm nyɛla: Ti Duuma yi saɣi, ti ni be ka niŋ dimbɔŋɔ bee dini ŋɔ.
en: So you should say, If the Lord wants, we will live and do this or that.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa be mɔɣu ni la bɛ daa malila Naawuni shɛhira tanti kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa wuhi Anabi Musa ni o malim li kaman o ni daa nya li ka di be shɛm la.
en: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.

dag: Dama zuliya kam zaa wuna nyɛla binnana, amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: The gods of all other nations are only idols, but the Lord created the heavens.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun mi yɛl shɛli din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha piligu. Kurimbuni ha ka m pun mi yɛl shɛŋa din na bi niŋ yɛla. Mani n-yɛli, n ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa ni pali, ka n ni niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: In the beginning, I told you what would happen in the end. A long time ago, I told you things that have not happened yet. When I plan something, it happens. I do whatever I want to do.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ yɔhindiba pam be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣi ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na. Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛl lala nyɛla ninvuɣ yɔhinda ni Masiachihira.
en: Many deceivers have gone into the world who do not confess that Jesus Christ came as a human being. This kind of person is the deceiver and the antichrist.

dag: Ya ka n lee yɛn nya nimdi ti niriba ŋɔ zaa? Dama bɛ kumdimi niŋdi ma ka yɛra, Tim ti nimdi ka ti ŋubi.
en: Where could I get enough meat for all these people? They keep whining and asking for meat.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa kuli Nabal sani nti nya ka o puhirila chuɣu o yiŋa, ka di ŋmanila naa m-puhiri chuɣu. Ka ŋun Nabal daa kul mali suhupiɛlli, dama o daa nyula dam buɣi. Ka o paɣ maa daa bi yɛl o shɛli dindali maa hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Abigail went back to Nabal, who was in the house. He had been eating like a king, and he was drunk and feeling good. So Abigail told Nabal nothing until the next morning.

dag: Naa daa ʒinila o ʒiishee din tab dukpini kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka Jɔnatan ʒiɛya, ka Abinɛr mi ʒini baɣili Sool, amaa ka Dauda ŋun ʒiishee daa nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ.
en: and sat in his usual place by the wall. Abner sat next to him, and Jonathan sat across the table from him. David's place was empty.

dag: Di saha ka anabi ninkurili maa yɛl o, Man gba nyɛla anabi kaman a ni nyɛ anabi shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ chɛ ka malaika yɛli ma, Cham ti zaŋ anab maa n-lab a yiŋa ka o ti di bindirigu ka nyu kom. .
en: The old prophet said to the man of God, Im also a prophet like you. A messenger spoke to me with the LORDs word, Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat food and drink water. But the old prophet was lying to him.

dag: mini nolɔɣu ŋun cheena ni bulaa ni na so ŋun be o niriba tooni gamdi giŋgaani.
en: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.

dag: Yuuni puuni gol so ŋun be tooni biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka n daa ʒe Tigiris Mɔɣ tital la duli.
en: On the th day of the first month of the year, I was standing beside the great Tigris River.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Din yiri ninsal suhu ni na, dina n-tar o daɣiri.
en: And Jesus said, The things that make people wrong are the things that come from the inside.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi lee tɛhi? Do so n-daa mali bidibis ayi nti chaŋ o bikpɛm sani ti yɛl o, M bia, cham m puu ni ti tum tuma zuŋɔ.
en: Now, what do you think? There was once a man who had two sons. He went to the older one and said, Son, go and work in the vineyard today.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni ti zaa ti zani Masia tooni ka o kari ti saria, ka sokam ti deeg o ni daa tum shɛm o niŋgbuŋ ni nyɔri, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: For all of us must appear before Christ, to be judged by him. We will each receive what we deserve, according to everything we have done, good or bad, in our bodily life.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu lihi binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka yuŋ ni daa zibira ka o min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi ni lab Bɛtani.
en: Jesus entered Jerusalem, went into the Temple, and looked around at everything. But since it was already late in the day, he went out to Bethany with the twelve disciples.

dag: Teemiya yi ni daa wum shɛli mini yi ni daa deei shɛl la yɛla, ka niŋya tuuba ka gbib li. Yi yi ku neei, n ni ka yi sanna kaman tayiɣa la, ka yi ku baŋ n kandina saha.
en: Remember, then, what you were taught and what you heard; obey it and turn from your sins. If you do not wake up, I will come upon you like a thief, and you will not even know the time when I will come.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumdiba ni ti gbani ninvuɣ suma tooni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri ti baɣi wuntizɔriba dunɔdaya.
en: Evil people will have to bow down to the righteous and humbly beg their favor.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ! Ŋun Naawuni nambɔzɔbo din galisi la puuni ka ti nya nyɛvili palli o ni daa neei Yisa Masia kum ni la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka ti mali tahima nɛɔŋ.
en: May the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ be blessed! On account of his vast mercy, he has given us new birth. You have been born anew into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

dag: Izraɛlnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Aduna zuliya, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord ! All the family of Aaron.

dag: Niriba ayi bee niriba ata yi di shɛhira yin kumiy o. Miriya ka yi ku nira ninvuɣ yino kɔŋkɔ shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: Capital punishment must be decided by two or three witnesses. No one may be executed on the basis of only one testimony.

dag: ka din pahi pisaayika daa gbaai Hanani min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Eighteenth, there were men chosen from Hananis sons and relatives.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun bɔhim o yɛla, ka yi ni nyɛ o nyaandoliba la zuɣu, bɛ daa pun wuhiya yɛlimaŋ shɛli din be Yisa ni maa.
en: You certainly heard about him, and as his followers you were taught the truth that is in Jesus.

dag: N ni tim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣindi na ka bɛ ti saɣim a. Bɛ zaa gbibila bɛ bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti ŋmahi yi sida da viɛl la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: I am sending men to destroy it. They will all bring their axes, cut down its beautiful cedar pillars, and throw them into the fire.

dag: M puhiri Apɛlees ŋun wuh o ʒiɛyimtali Masia ni ni nyɛ shɛm la. M puhiri Aristɔbulus yiŋnim zaa.
en: Greetings to Apelles, whose loyalty to Christ has been proved. Greetings to those who belong to the family of Aristobulus.

dag: Di chɛliya ka sam shɛli doli ya n-naɣ pahila tab yubu samli, dama ŋunkam yur o ʒiʒiinikpee nyɛla ŋun pali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.

dag: Bɛ daa piripirila taba, ka zuliya ŋɔ tuhiri zuliya ŋɔ, ka tiŋ ŋɔ nim mi tuhiri tiŋ ŋɔ nima, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka suhugarigu balibu kam ŋɔ paai ba.
en: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Kapɛrinium ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto deeriba kana ti bɔhi Pita, A karimba ŋɔ bi tɔhiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto la.
en: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, Does your teacher pay the temple tax.

dag: Ka n daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu n-lihi nya binyila anahi ʒii shɛl ni yaha.
en: In another vision I saw four ox horns.

dag: Ti ni daa bi tooi yih o di ni maa ka ti chɛ o ka yɛli, Ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm, di niŋmi lala.
en: We could not convince him, so we gave up and said, May the Lord's will be done.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu, ka o dii teei zaa zani ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she was able to stand up straight. She began praising God.

dag: Ti dimnim maa kpiya, ka buɣim di bɛ ni kani ka chɛ shɛli.
en: All that the wicked own is destroyed, and fire burns up anything that is left.

dag: Naa ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-yihiri ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋdi kaburi dari buri ba.
en: A wise king sifts out the wicked, and runs them over with a wheel.

dag: Yɛm tuma nyɛla din chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋdi nyaɣisim, ka di soya zaa nyɛ din tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Wisdom will lead you to a life of joy and peace.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa zani Ariɔpagus jintɔriba maa sunsuuni yɛli, Yinim Atɛnsinim ŋɔ, n nyaya ka yi doli yi jɛmbu soli viɛnyɛliŋga shɛlikam puuni.
en: Paul stood up in front of the city council and said, I see that in every way you Athenians are very religious.

dag: Ka yi ti sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga m-pa kuɣa maa zuɣu.
en: You must write all these teachings on the stones that you set up. Write clearly so that they are easy to read.

dag: Ka do so yi bi yuri ka di bin kasi maa, ŋun bom di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ bin kasi maa ti ti maligumaana.
en: Whoever eats some of the holy food by mistake must give the priest the price of that food and add another one-fifth of the price as a fine.

dag: O daa yɛli ma mi, Daadam, n nam ʒiishee mini n napɔŋ tambu shee m-bɔŋɔ. Nimaani ka n yɛn be Izraɛlnim sani sahakam. Izraɛlnima bee bɛ nanima ku lan jɛm buɣa, bɛ mi ku lan zaŋ na shɛb bɛn kpi niŋgbuna saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ bɛ kpibu ni.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, this temple is my throne on earth. I will live here among the people of Israel forever. They and their kings will never again disgrace me by worshiping idols at local shrines or by setting up memorials to their dead kings.

dag: N ni na be yi sani ŋɔ ka n yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: I have told you all these things while I am with you.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goondaa la luhi, ka nyo nayili zaa buɣim, ka saɣim duɣuri mini la viɛl shɛŋa din daa be nayili maa zaa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar's troops burned down the temple and destroyed every important building in the city. Then they broke down the city wall.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi mali buɣa n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim, ka tumdi bukpahigu tuma, ka buɣiri baɣisi, ka saɣim bɛmaŋa n-tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: They used magic and witchcraft and even sacrificed their own children. The Israelites were determined to do whatever the Lord hated.

dag: Muɣisigu nyabu dali, o ni zaŋ ma sɔɣ o sɔɣisili shee, o ni zaŋ o tanti pili ma; ka zaŋ ma tam tampin shɛli din du zuɣu.
en: Because he will shelter me in his own dwelling during troubling times; he will hide me in a secret place in his own tent; he will set me up high, safe on a rock.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ni yɛn zo n-kuli luɣ shɛli tiligi. So yi bi yuri ka ku o kpee ka di mi pala dimdi pun bela bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni.
en: Here is the rule concerning a person who killed someone and is permitted to escape to one of these cities and live: If it is someone who killed his neighbor accidentally, without having hated that person previously.

dag: Di yi nyɛla din viɛla bee din bie, ti ni deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti timd a o sani ŋɔ noli. Ti yi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli, di ni chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛla ti sani.
en: Whether it pleases us or not, we will obey the Lord our God, to whom we are asking you to pray. All will go well with us if we obey him.

dag: Yi mi di ŋmariya tab ʒiri, dama yi pun yihi biɛr kurili la mini di miligu yɛla bahi.
en: Dont lie to each other. You have taken off those old clothes—the person you once were and the bad things you did then.

dag: Ka yi yi bi doli zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ n-luri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli din mali jilima mini dabiɛm ŋɔ sizuura.
en: If you do not obey faithfully all of God's teachings that are written in this book and if you do not honor the wonderful and awesome name of the Lord your God.

dag: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa o yi tiri gbini, n suhu ku piɛl o zuɣu.
en: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.

dag: A bahi ti dimnim yoli zaa; ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: Every enemy is wiped out, like something ruined forever. Youve torn down their cities— even the memory of them is dead.

dag: Yawɛ viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani muɣisigu saha; o guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣir o sani.
en: The Lord is good; he protects his people in times of trouble; he takes care of those who turn to him.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kana ti zani sansani maa dunɔdali ni ka yɛli, Ŋunkam be Yawɛ polo, ŋun kam n sanna. Ka Lɛvi bidibisi zaa daa laɣimna ti zani gil o.
en: So Moses stood at the entrance to the camp and said, Anyone who wants to follow the Lord should come to me. Everyone from the tribe of Levi ran to Moses.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa kul ni beni sahakam, amaa ʒiri yɛtɔɣa bi yuura.
en: A lie has a short life, but truth lives on forever.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti birigi ka chɛ a soli? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka ti niŋ tipawumli n-zo a sani? Labimi ti sanna, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba la mini zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ a niriba la zuɣu.
en: Why do you let us stray from your ways? Why do you make us so stubborn that we turn away from you? Come back, for the sake of those who serve you, for the sake of the people who have always been yours.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ paɣir o yɛtɔɣ suma din yi o nol ni na maa zuɣu, ka bɔhiri taba, Pa Yisifu dapal la m-bala.
en: Everyone there said good things about Jesus. They were amazed to hear him speak such wonderful words. They said, How is this possible? Isnt he Josephs son.

dag: Yisa ni daa niŋ li Vuhim Dabisili dali maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim maa muɣisi Yisa pam.
en: So they began to persecute Jesus, because he had done this healing on a Sabbath.

dag: Yuuni kam o ma daa yi shɛrila binyɛr bila m-mali chani ti tir o saha shɛl o min o yidana daa yi ti chaŋ ni bɛ ti mali yuuniyuuni sara maa.
en: His mother would make a small robe for him and take it to him every year when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

dag: Yaa n Duuma Yawɛ, a kul yoli piligimi n-wuhir a dabili a galisim min a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, wuni ŋuni n-lee be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani zuɣu n-ni tooi tum yiko tuma mini tuun kar shɛŋa a ni tum ŋɔ?.
en: Sovereign Lord , I know that you have shown me only the beginning of the great and wonderful things you are going to do. There is no god in heaven or on earth who can do the mighty things that you have done!.

dag: Amaa man ŋmanila olivi ti mahili din sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni. N niŋla Naawuni yurilim maŋli la naani sahakam.
en: But I am like an olive tree growing in the house of God; I trust in his constant love forever and ever.

dag: ka su Hɛrimɔn Zoli mini Salɛka ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga ni Giliad pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn tintariga la.
en: Og ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, and all the area of Bashan. His land ended where the people of Geshur and Maacah lived. Og also ruled half of the land of Gilead. This land ended at the land of King Sihon of Heshbon.

dag: Ninvuɣ so sa di dol a duna, miri ka a chɛ ka ninvuɣ so sa be zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Miri ka a sa chɛ ka biŋkɔbbaligu bee niɣi ŋub mɔri zoli maa gbini.
en: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.

dag: Ka yi yi bi pal alikauli ni so bini, ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ yimaŋmaŋ dini ni nyɛ shɛli tin ya?.
en: And if you cannot be trusted with what belongs to someone else, who will give you something that will be your own?.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa bɔri ni bɛ zahim o, ka yɛl o ni o wuhim ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.

dag: ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa ti ni tɛhiri ni di buchi bi yaɣ lala la nyɛla ti ni lihiri shɛŋa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din bi viɛl la, dina ka ti lee niŋdi din tu kamaata shɛli.
en: And the parts that we think are not worth very much are the parts we give the most care to. And we give special care to the parts of the body that we dont want to show.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini; ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But Jesus still did not answer, and this really surprised Pilate.

dag: Di lan yɛli: Kuɣili maa nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka niriba tuui; di lan nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Din chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu maa nyɛla bɛ ni bi niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda la zuɣu, ka di mi nyɛla Naawuni ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: And another scripture says, This is the stone that will make people stumble, the rock that will make them fall. They stumbled because they did not believe in the word; such was God's will for them.

dag: Zaŋm ninvuɣ so ŋun tu ma maa yihi sansani maa kpaŋa nti chɛ ka bɛn zaa wum o ni tu ma shɛm maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa lab o kuɣa.
en: Take that man out of the camp. Everyone who heard him curse shall put his hands on the man's head to testify that he is guilty, and then the whole community shall stone him to death.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N tin ya nyina din viɛla, ka chɛ ka kum lu yi tiŋ kam ni, di zaa yoli ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I was the one who brought famine to all your cities, yet you did not come back to me.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kurigi, o daa zaŋla o bidibisi n-leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: When Samuel grew old, he made his sons judges in Israel.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kpe Ijipti teeku ni ni bɛ gari, n ni chɛ ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni, ka Nail Mɔɣili bulli la leei tiŋ kuŋ. Ka Asirianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la ti nya filiŋ, ka Ijiptinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ la mi kɔŋ yiko.
en: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa dol o tab maa gbin na duh o yee pam yɛra, Ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛm biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ka deeg o dalinli la pa o gbiɛɣu zuɣu bee o nuu ni.
en: A third angel followed the first two angels. This third angel said in a loud voice, God will punish all those who worship the beast and the beasts idol and agree to have the beasts mark on their forehead or on their hand.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-nyɛ n tiligira; n ni niŋ o naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n yiliyiinili mini n kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiligira.
en: God is indeed my salvation; I will trust and wont be afraid. Yah, the LORD, is my strength and my shield; he has become my salvation.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du ni bɛ ti tuhi Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka nandahima daa mal Izraɛlnim pam.
en: Then the Ammonites began crossing the Jordan and attacking the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, and Ephraim. Life was miserable for the Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa daa yɛl ti, Yi mi ni m paɣ daa dɔɣ ba la bidibis ayi ti ma.
en: Sir, our father then reminded us that his favorite wife had given birth to two sons.

dag: Bɛ yi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka lo ni bɛ yi a nyaaŋa n-niŋ a shɛli, bɛ ku di nasara.
en: They make their plans, and plot against him, but they will not succeed.

dag: Ka o mini Mariama so bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti o ka o mali puu la kuli bɛ ya Bɛtilihɛm ni bɛ ti sab bɛ yuya.
en: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: But Jesus gave the spirits a strong warning not to tell anyone who he was.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Naa Sulemaana, Jɔab zo nti bela Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, nyama, o be sara maligu bimbini luɣili ni. Ka Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka yɛl o, Cham ti ŋme o luhi.
en: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, Why did you run to the altar? Joab sent back his answer, I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection. Then Solomon shouted, Benaiah, go kill Joab.

dag: Ka a boli Jɛsi ka o ka sara maligu maa shee na, ka n ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka a ti booi kpam maa bahi n ni yɛn wuh a ninvuɣ so maa zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice. Then I will show you what to do. You must anoint the person I show you.

dag: Bɛ tim a anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi, ka ti a alikama din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pia, ka ti a wain lita tusaayi, ka ti a kpam lita tusaayi, ka ti a yalim pam kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: Give this much to Ezra: / tons of silver, bushels of wheat, gallons of wine, gallons of olive oil, and as much salt as Ezra wants.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kum dɔro n-gbaag o maa. O ku lan yiɣisi o dooshee maa yaha.
en: and they say, You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, A na ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba balibu pam mini zuliya pam ni tinzun yɛligu pam nima ni nanim pam polo.
en: Then I was told, Once again you must proclaim God's message about many nations, races, languages, and kings.

dag: Yɛndana nyarila baŋsim pahira. Amaa jɛrigu yɛtɔɣ yoya tahirila saɣiŋgu na.
en: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a ka a yɛli ma.
en: Now stand up straight and answer my questions.

dag: Nyamiya Yawɛ sanʒiɛɣu, suhuyiɣisili titali. Di ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, di ni lu ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu.
en: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab Ɛnmishipat bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Kadɛshi la. Ka bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛk tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Amɔrinim bɛn daa be Hazazɔntarima la zaa.
en: They went back to the city of Enmishpat, better known as Kadesh. Then they captured all the land that belonged to the Amalekites, and they defeated the Amorites who were living in Hazazon-Tamar.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, amaa n naɣi yumi ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni ka be.
en: The Lord GOD says, I dont want evil people to die. I want them to change their lives so that they can live!.

dag: Mani n-yiɣisi Sairus n wuntia puuni. N ni mal o soya ka di tuhi. O ni me n tiŋ la, ka ti n niriba yolisim. O bi yɛn niŋ li ka deei shɛli. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I was right to give power to Cyrus, and I will make his work easy. He will rebuild my city, and he will set my people free without bribes or payment. The Lord All-Powerful said this.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋun yɛn wurim Mɔabnim fɔntinsi ka ku bɛ nachimbihi viɛla la kana.
en: The enemy will attack Moab. The enemy will enter its towns and destroy them. Its best young men will be killed in the slaughter. This message is from the King. The Kings name is the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa yina kuli naai, ka naazɔnim daa kpe nti nya ka dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntua maa dunoya yomi kpari, ka bɛ tɛhi ni naa maa kpɛla zɔntua maa ni du bil ni ni o ti wɔɣis omaŋa.
en: Ehud then left the main room, and the servants went back in. The servants found the doors to the upper room locked, so they said, The king must be relieving himself in his private toilet.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Parinak bia Ɛlizafan.
en: from the tribe of the Zebulunites, a chief, Elizaphan, Parnachs son.

dag: Ko zurili nyaɣisa, ka nir ni sɔɣi di bindir shɛli nyaɣisa.
en: Stolen water is sweet. Stolen bread tastes good.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ŋunkam chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi n-tum alahichi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni ka kom di o, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: If anyone should cause one of these little ones to lose his faith in me, it would be better for that person to have a large millstone tied around his neck and be drowned in the deep sea.

dag: Bɛ dari ba yihi bɛ ni niŋ yili shɛli yɛda ni, ka zaŋ ba tahi na so ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm sani.
en: They are snatched from the safety of their tent; it parades them before the king of terrors.

dag: A dabisa bemi kaman daadam dabisa ni be shɛm bee a yuma bemi kaman daadam yuma ni be shɛm.
en: Is your life as short as ours? Is your life as short as a mans life?.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, bee n-chɛ ka bɛ kari ba saria n-wuhi ni bɛ kum ba.
en: but the Lord will not abandon them to their enemy's power or let them be condemned when they are on trial.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani yi zahira, ka bɛ nini nya li. Izraɛlnim ni ti tuui lu bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni. Ka Judanim gba ni ti tuui lu m-pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.

dag: N ni kum ka fabili zoya zuɣu, ka fabili mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu, dama di bahila yoli doya ka so bi lan gariti nimaani. So bi lan wumdi niɣi kumsi nimaani. Noombihi mini biŋkɔbiri zaa yi nimaani zo.
en: I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the grazing lands in the wilderness. They are dried up and deserted; no sound of the flocks is heard; no sign of birds or animals is seen; all have vanished.

dag: Ti mali bimbin shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi sara maligu malibu tuma tanti jɛmbu duu la ni ka soli ni bɛ di binshɛli din pa di zuɣu.
en: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.

dag: N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi lee m bia. N ti ku yihi n yurilim maŋli o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n yurilim ŋun daa daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: I will become his father and he will become my son, and Ill never withdraw my faithful love from him as I did from the one before you.

dag: Nyin Musa kɔŋko n-ni miri man Yawɛ; bɛ ni so di ti mirina; niriba maa di pah a zuɣu du na.
en: Then only Moses will come close to the Lord . The other men must not come close, and the rest of the people must not even come up the mountain.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa zo Dauda sani n-chaŋ ti doli Shiiba Bikiri bia maa, amaa ka Judanim daa doli bɛ naa maa ni ʒiɛyimtali n-yi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So they stopped following David and went off with Sheba. But the people of Judah stayed close to David all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Ijipti Firawuna Nɛko daa yi n-chani Asiria naa sani Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka Naa Jɔsia daa chaŋ ti lir o sol ni, amaa ka Firawuna Nɛko daa nya o Mɛgido n-ku o.
en: While Josiah was king, King Neco of Egypt led an army to the Euphrates River to help the emperor of Assyria. King Josiah tried to stop the Egyptian army at Megiddo and was killed in battle.

dag: Puhimiya tab puhiri suŋ. Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa puhiri ya.
en: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa je ma sɔɣirimi yɛri taba n yɛla. Bɛ kul tɛhirila zaɣ biɛɣu tiri ma.
en: My enemies whisper about me. They think the worst.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura, ka dol o soli mali alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who fear and respect the Lord and live the way he wants.

dag: Yi ni di vi pam, ka pa ni jilima. Yimaŋmaŋ gba nyumiya ka chani ʒiɛhira. Yawɛ nudirigu ni pipia la ni paai ya, ka yi jilima ti leei vi.
en: But they will know the Lords anger. It will be like a cup of poison in the Lord s right hand. They will taste that anger, and then they will fall to the ground like drunks. Evil ruler, you will drink from that cup. You will get shame, not honor.

dag: Yawɛ moli molo gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yɛli: Yɛlimiya Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, nyama, a tiligira kana, ka laara mini yɔri be o sani.
en: Listen, the Lord is speaking to all the faraway lands: Tell the people of Zion, Look, your Savior is coming. He is bringing your reward to you. He is bringing it with him.

dag: Ka Jɔab min o niriba zaa daa kana ti teei gili Ɛbɛl Bɛtimaaka n-kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gili tiŋ maa ka di du nti saɣisi di gooni zuɣusaa, ka gbiri di gbinni ni bɛ daai li luhi.
en: When Joab and his men came to Abel Beth Maacah, they surrounded the town. They piled dirt up against the city wall and began breaking stones out of the wall to make it fall down.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni ti dee li su n-ʒini di ni ka yɛli, Ti ni bo naa ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam bɛn gil ti ŋɔ ni mali nanim shɛm.
en: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, We want a king, just like the nations around us.

dag: Dama nir yi kpi, o ku lan teeg a yɛla; ka ŋuni n-ni tooi paɣ a gballi ni?.
en: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.

dag: Dama o suhuyiɣisili bi yuura, ka o nyɛ ŋun kul niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam. Di pa shɛli kuhigu ni beni yuŋ, amaa ka suhupiɛlli mi be biɛɣ neebu ni.
en: His anger lasts only a moment, his goodness for a lifetime. Tears may flow in the night, but joy comes in the morning.

dag: Nyama, niriba maa yiɣisirimi kaman gbuɣin nyaŋ la, ka bɛ ni nyamdi kaman gbuɣindaa la. O bi doona ka pa ni o ŋubila o ni gbaai binshɛɣu, ka nyu o ni ku binshɛɣu maa ʒim.
en: The nation of Israel is like a mighty lion: It doesn't rest until it has torn and devoured, Until it has drunk the blood of those it has killed.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi ba, Buɣ din ni ka yi lee chani maa? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni nimaani yuli Bama hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: I asked them: What are these high places where you go? So they have been called High Places ever since.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa niŋ Ibram nirilim viɛnyɛliŋga Zarai zuɣu. O daa ti Ibram piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni bundibisi ni bunnyama ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnima.
en: Because of her the king treated Abram well and gave him flocks of sheep and goats, cattle, donkeys, slaves, and camels.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Bia m-bɔŋɔ, n ni pii so m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: From the cloud a voice spoke, This is my chosen Son. Listen to what he says.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ti o bɛ ni zaŋ fiig tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa mini wain wal kuma yila ayi. O ni daa di n-naai ka o nini neei, dama o daa bi di shɛli bee n-nyu kom wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ dabisi muna ata.
en: The Egyptian had not had any food or water for three days and nights, so they gave him a piece of fig cake and two clusters of raisins. He felt better after eating.

dag: Pɛriʒia nabia n-daa taɣ ma zali sol ni biɛɣ pisiniyini. Amaa ka Maikil ŋun nyɛ malaikanim nabia la daa kana ti sɔŋ ma, ka n daa chɛ o mini Pɛriʒia nabia maa nimaani.
en: But the prince of Persia has been fighting against me for days. Then Michael, one of the most important princes, came to help me because I was stuck there with the king of Persia.

dag: Harim ni Mɛrɛmɔt ni Obadia ni.
en: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah.

dag: Bɛ yi daa yɛn ku niriba ayopɔin n-yo Keen kubu samli, so yi ku mani, yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaayopɔin ka bɛ yɛn ku n-yo man kubu samli.
en: Anyone who tries to get even with me will be punished ten times more than anyone who tries to get even with Cain.

dag: Di dunoli yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka o daa buɣisi du titali maa puuni wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: The entrance was fifteen feet wide, and the facades on either side of the entrance were seven and a half feet. When he measured its length, it was sixty feet, and its width was thirty feet.

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundi na, ka piligi bur o tab bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka diri ka nyuri dam kuuna.
en: But suppose that these servants should say to themselves, My master is taking his time about coming. And suppose they began to beat the servants, both men and women, and to eat, drink, and get drunk.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Then make poles for carrying the Box. These poles should be made from acacia wood and covered with gold.

dag: Zaŋmiya wumpaɣibo mali sara ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ yi ni lo alikauli ni yi zaŋ binshɛŋa ti Zallakudura Naa ti o.
en: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n daa zaŋla n kpiɔŋ zaa niŋ gooni maa mɛbu tuma ni. Ka n tumtumdiba zaa daa laɣim nimaani tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma. N daa bi gbaai mmaŋmaŋ palo.
en: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.

dag: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: When it turns green, you know that summer is very near.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi mini niriba lala tatabo be.
en: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni. Yi shiri chirimya pam.
en: He isn't the God of the dead, but of the living. You Sadducees are all wrong.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ li chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili maa ni ti pi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: So I went and buried it at the Euphrates, as the LORD instructed.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Yɛlim a biɛyanim maa ni bɛ ʒilim bɛ bunsi ʒiya n-lab Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, Give your brothers these instructions: Load your pack animals and go back to the land of Canaan.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, yimiyana. Nyamiya Naa Sulemaana ni pili nam zuɣupil shɛli, di nyɛla o ma ni daa zaŋ nam zuɣupil shɛli pil o, o daamiliya lɔbu dali din daa nyɛ o suhupiɛlli dabisili dal la.
en: Women of Zion, come and see King Solomon. He is wearing the crown that his mother placed on his head on his wedding day, on the day of his gladness and joy.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Kamiya kpe na nti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Then Joshua said to the Israelites, Come and listen to the words of the Lord your God.

dag: Bundana n-su faralana, ka sandira mi nyɛ sandan dabili.
en: The wealthy rule over the poor; a borrower is a slave to a lender.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali oniɣisi kuɣa n-zaŋ li tam salima bintaɣindisi ni, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, cham ti nya guliŋguhi biɛhigu, ka niŋ yɛm.
en: You lazy people, you should watch what the ants do and learn from them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli ba na nti yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani baabiɛla gba.
en: So the Jewish leaders called Peter and John in again. They told the apostles not to say anything or to teach anything in the name of Jesus.

dag: Ka ti ni tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa bi yila chirimbu bee kɔr biɛri bee yɛmbimbiɛri yɔhiŋgu ni na;.
en: Our appeal to you is not based on error or impure motives, nor do we try to trick anyone.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni so n ni jɛmdi n suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi puuni kaman n yaannim ni daa jɛm o shɛm la. N kul teer a yɛla n wunsuhigu ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka paɣiri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.

dag: Ifriimnim daa ŋmanila bɛ ni wuhi naɣisa so ka o bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ o bu chi, ka n daa bi zaŋ binshɛli pa o nyiŋgoli din viɛl la zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zaŋ dapua n-ga Ifriimnim nyiŋgoya ni. Judanim ni jari, ka Yaakubu zuliya yɛbisi bɛmaŋmaŋ puu.
en: Ephraim is like a trained young cow that loves to walk on grain on the threshing floor. I will put a good yoke on her neck. I will put the ropes on Ephraim. Then Judah will begin plowing. Jacob will break the ground himself.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o, o ni pa ti ni yino zuɣu.
en: John said, Teacher, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But he wasn't one of us, and we told him to stop.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka Naawuni deei li ka di leeg o daalahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.

dag: Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa yi ti niŋ a nyin niŋm a nuu ni ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: Once these signs have happened to you, do whatever you would like to do, because God is with you.

dag: M mali yɛla pam din ni tɔɣisi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka kari ya saria, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka n ni wum shɛli o sani, dina ka m mali yɛri dunianima.
en: I have much more I could say to judge you. But I tell people only what I have heard from the one who sent me, and he speaks the truth.

dag: Niriba ayi noya yi bi pa taba, bɛ ni tooi laɣim doli?.
en: Two people will not walk together unless they have agreed to do so.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zani dubil yini nyaaŋa m-buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti paai dubil din la nyaaŋa, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili zaŋ goon yini hal ti paai goon dini la.
en: He measured the gate through the room openings that faced each other. From the outer ceiling edge of one room to the outer ceiling edge of the other, the gate was thirty-seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi n-dol o kaman naɣilaa ka bɛ vɔri chani ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la bee n-nyɛ tɔŋtɔŋ kaman molifu n-zɔri chani tɔŋ ni la.
en: Suddenly he was going with her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, like a deer prancing into a trap.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tuhi nyaŋ Judanim maa, ka sokam zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home.

dag: N ni tir a jilima dabisili kam, ka kul ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.

dag: Ti Duuma, teemi bɛ ni maani mani a dabili ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; teemi niriba ni turi ma tu shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ chira ata saha ka so daa ti yɛli Juda, Tama ŋun nyɛ a bia pakol la gɔrila pagɔrisigu, ka din pahi di zuɣu nyɛla, o niŋla pua o pagɔrisigu maa gɔbu ni. Ka Juda daa yɛli, Zaŋmiy o na ti niŋ buɣim nyo o.
en: About three months later, someone told Judah, Your daughter-in-law Tamar sinned like a prostitute, and now she is pregnant. Then Judah said, Take her out and burn her.

dag: N ni daa suh a dahin shɛli, a daa deei n suhigu, ka pahi ma kpiɔŋ.
en: When I called to you for help, you answered me and gave me strength.

dag: N ni yɛri ya yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda.
en: I am telling you the truth, and thats why you dont believe me.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: That is why I am sending him to you, in order to cheer you up by telling you how all of us are getting along.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa ti tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayopɔin saha shɛli, di daa niŋ kaman awa pirigili ka alizanda ni binshɛɣukam kul fomi chichi.
en: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa ʒi ma n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka n ti nya paɣ so ka o ʒi biŋkɔb ʒiɛɣu zuɣu, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya nyaɣim biŋkɔbigu maa luɣilikam, ka o mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia.
en: Then he brought me in a Spirit-inspired trance to a desert. There I saw a woman seated on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names. It had seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A tizɔdoo maa ni neei kum ni yaha.
en: Jesus said, Your brother will rise and be alive again.

dag: o yi bi diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛmdi Izraɛlnim buɣa, ka mi bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni bee m-bo paɣ so ŋun nya puuni ka di na bi naai.
en: They dont eat on the hills or give their attention to the idols of the house of Israel. They dont defile the wives of their neighbors or approach menstruating women.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naaman kɔŋ maa ni lu a min a bihi zuɣu n-kul maliya sahakam! Ka Gɛhaazi daa ŋmalig o sani n-yi ni kɔŋa; ka o niŋgbuna dii paligi laɣilaɣi kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: And now Naaman's disease will come upon you, and you and your descendants will have it forever! When Gehazi left, he had the disease—his skin was as white as snow.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔhim ba biɛri, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Give them back what they deserve, Lord . Pay them back for what they have done.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi ka Izraɛl kpamba daa dol o ka bɛ chaŋ Datan mini Abiram sani.
en: Moses stood and went to Dathan and Abiram. All the elders of Israel followed him.

dag: hal ti yi tuui, ti ku lu n-doya, dama Yawɛ nuu n-gbib ti.
en: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.

dag: Naawuni wuhiya ni o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee din nyɛ tiŋ puuni birininim la ni.
en: God is in its fortifications, revealing himself as a place of safety.

dag: Zaadali Ninivenim ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama Anabi Jona ni daa yihi ba waazu la, bɛ daa niŋ tuuba; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Anabi Jona be kpe!.
en: On the Judgment Day the people of Nineveh will stand up and accuse you, because they turned from their sins when they heard Jonah preach; and I tell you that there is something here greater than Jonah!.

dag: Ɛli ni daa wum kuhigu maa, ka o bɔhi, Ka bo vuri n-lee bala? Ka doo maa daa zɔna yomyom ti yɛli Ɛli di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Eli heard the sound of the cry and said, Whats all this noise about? The man hurriedly went and told Eli the news. .

dag: Dahin shɛli yuŋ ka o daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti mi ni a nyɛla karimba ŋun yi Naawuni sanna, dama so kani ŋun ni tooi wuhi shihir shɛŋa a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ka pa ni Naawuni m-be o sani.
en: One night he went to Jesus and said to him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher sent by God. No one could perform the miracles you are doing unless God were with him.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa kul zaŋ di yɛla kaɣili Samsin biɛɣukam, ka kul mal li dol o hal ka o nyee ti nyɔni pam di zuɣu.
en: Delilah started nagging and pestering him day after day, until he couldn't stand it any longer.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilahi pinaata maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛlah ayi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu;.
en: Their grain offering will be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each of the two rams.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li; ka daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa ni di naa ni di fɔndi ni niriba zaa. Bɛ daa bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino gba kpalim. Bɛ ni daa niŋ Ɛgilɔnnim shɛm la, lala ka bɛ daa saɣim Hiburɔn, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be di ni.
en: They captured it and struck it down without mercy, along with its king, all its towns, and everyone in it. He left no survivors, just exactly as he had done to Eglon. He wiped out the city and everyone in it as something reserved for God.

dag: o min o bidibis ayi la ʒili. Bɛ ni yino yuli n-daa booni Gɛrishom, dama o daa yɛlimi, N nyɛla sana m-be saan tiŋa.
en: Jethro also brought Moses two sons with him. The first son was named Gershom, because when he was born, Moses said, I am a stranger in a foreign country.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa nya ka Leeban bi lan bɔr o yɛla kaman o ni daa pun bɔr o yɛla shɛm la.
en: He also saw that Laban was no longer as friendly as he had been earlier.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni tɛha bi wuhi ma ni m mali galimi, amaa dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni m bebu tuhiya zaa. N Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun kariti ma saria.
en: I dont know of any wrong I have done, but that does not make me right. The Lord is the one who must decide if I have done well or not.

dag: Ka hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ na kul dolila bɛ kal kura maa. Bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ bee n-doli o zalikpana la min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ ni daa zali Yaakubu so o ni daa boli Izraɛl la bihi ni bɛ dol la.
en: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord , and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.

dag: Wummiya satahiŋga din yi o kukoli ni na mini vu shɛli din yir o nol ni na.
en: Listen closely to the rumble of his voice, the roar issuing from his mouth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zali saha shɛl o ni yɛn niŋ li maa ka yɛli, Biɛɣuni ka man Yawɛ sa yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Tomorrow is the day the Lord has set to do this.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ so daa tuhir o soli na. O daa yɛla nɛma kaman pagɔrili la, ka o lihibu mali kɔre ni kukolimahim.
en: All of a sudden a woman approaches him, dressed like a prostitute and with a cunning mind.

dag: Baptaizibu shɛli n-na ʒe n-guli ma; di mi nyɛla din chɛ ka n suhu bi doya shee di ti niŋ naai.
en: I am going to be put to a hard test. And I will have to suffer a lot of pain until it is over.

dag: Masia ni daa kpe tanti duu la puuni n-gari ti kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee yim ka di naai zaa la, pa buhi mini naɣibihi ʒim ka o daa zaŋ mali sara, amaa omaŋmaŋ ʒim ka o daa zaŋ mali sara n-deei tiliginsim din ka bahigu Naawuni sani ti ti.
en: Christ entered the Most Holy Place only one time—enough for all time. He entered the Most Holy Place by using his own blood, not the blood of goats or young bulls. He entered there and made us free from sin forever.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bidibiga kam ni tooi ŋub li, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Any male of the priestly families may eat this offering; it is very holy.

dag: Nyamiya, m mali bipuɣins ayi bɛn na ʒi dɔbba, chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm; ka di niŋ ya niriba ŋɔ shɛli, bɛ ni kpe n yili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Ive got two daughters who are virgins. Let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them whatever you wish. But dont do anything to these men because they are now under the protection of my roof.

dag: nti bɔhi, Ya polo ka bɛ ni dɔɣi Yɛhudianim Na so la lee be? Ti daa nyala o saŋmariga wulimpuhili polo, ka kana ni ti ti jɛm o.
en: They asked, Where is the newborn king of the Jews? Weve seen his star in the east, and weve come to honor him.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Daadam Bia yi ti labina ni o jilima m-pahi malaikanim zaa, o ni ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee din mali jilima pam.
en: Now when the Human One comes in his majesty and all his angels are with him, he will sit on his majestic throne.

dag: O daa lan wurim dagɔra du shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛli paɣiba ni daa wuɣiri Ashɛra jɛmbu binyɛra la.
en: The king tore down the shrines for the consecrated workers that were in the LORDs temple, where women made woven coverings for Asherah.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛ mali taali alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa lo Masia san la puuni.
en: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.

dag: Ka Makiri bia Giliad ŋun daa nyɛ Yisifu bia Manaasa yaaŋa la daŋ puuni dunoya dɔɣirikpamba daa ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim dunoya dɔɣirikpamba sanna.
en: Manasseh was Josephs son. Makir was Manassehs son. Gilead was Makirs son. The leaders of Gileads family went to talk to Moses and the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Jɔn Baptaizira gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ŋun pɔri alizanda nam ni galisi gar o.
en: I assure you that no one who has ever been born is greater than John the Baptist. Yet whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

dag: Naawuni bi zaɣis o ni pun piig o ninvuɣ shɛb la. Yi bi mi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anabi Ilaija ni daa yɛli shɛm n-galim Izraɛlnima Naawuni san la yɛla?.
en: God chose the Israelites to be his people before they were born. And he did not force them to leave. Surely you know what the Scriptures say about Elijah. The Scriptures tell about Elijah praying to God against the people of Israel. He said.

dag: bɛ yi ti baŋ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛli maa saha shɛli, bɛ laɣiŋgu maa bɛn zaŋmi naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu. Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini na.
en: once the sin that they committed becomes known, the assembly must present a bull from the herd as a purification offering. They will bring it before the meeting tent.

dag: M min ya, ka lan mi ni yi bi yuri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: But I know you—I know that you have no love for God.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu maa di puhibu saha yuuni kam.
en: So you should follow this regulation at its appointed time every year.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpilli n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka ŋmahiŋmahi li tari ba.
en: After he took his seat at the table with them, he took the bread, blessed and broke it, and gave it to them.

dag: Bum ansarisimaana, ka bɛn bi mi bɔhim yɛm, kpahimi bɛn mali baŋsim zuɣu ni, ka bɛ nya baŋsim pahi.
en: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.

dag: Kɔŋ maa daa kul malila naa Uzia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o ni daa nyɛ kɔŋlan maa zuɣu, o daa kul bela o kɔŋko yili ni ka ku lan tooi kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili maa n-su nayili maa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: For the rest of his life King Uzziah was ritually unclean because of his disease. Unable to enter the Temple again, he lived in his own house, relieved of all duties, while his son Jotham governed the country.

dag: Ka yɛli Izraɛlnima, Zaŋmiya bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ naɣibil ŋun paai yuuni mini piɛbil ŋun paai yuuni m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la;.
en: Tell the Israelites, Take a male goat for a sin offering, and take a calf and a lamb for a burnt offering. The calf and the lamb must each be one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Dama n yidana ka yiŋa. O go n-chaŋla katiŋa.
en: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.

dag: O daa boli nimaani yul la Bɛtɛl. Amaa nimaani yuli daa pun boonila Luz.
en: He named that sacred place Bethel, though Luz was the citys original name.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa chaŋ teeku ni.
en: That evening Jesus followers went down to the lake.

dag: Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn ba la daa bela Gibiɔn, ka o paɣa yuli daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel founded the city of Gibeon and settled there. His wife was named Maacah.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa chɛ ka Dauda lan lo o yurilim alikauli yaha, dama o daa yur o mi kaman omaŋmaŋ la.
en: Once again Jonathan made David promise to love him, for Jonathan loved David as much as he loved himself.

dag: Dama a yi ti yi ya ŋɔ n-chaŋ ti baai du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani, ka a ʒim yihibu taali kpalim ʒi amaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ, mani n-zaŋ li zali zuliya pam sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔna pam gil li.
en: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.

dag: dama nyɛvili samli galisiya pam, ka so ku tooi nya liɣiri din ni saɣi di zuɣu yɔbu;.
en: because the payment for a human life is too great. What we could pay would never be enough.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pa liɣiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ dan ya leei daba maa. Dinzuɣu pa liɣiri ka n yɛn zaŋ yo yi zuɣu n-yihi ya dabitim maa ni.
en: The LORD proclaims: You were sold for nothing, and you will be redeemed without money.

dag: n-chaŋ Taai birini la mini Hivinim ni Keenannim tinsi zaa ni. Ka bɛ daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ Nɛgɛb din be Juda tiŋgban ni Bɛrishiiba polo la.
en: Then they went south to the fortified city of Tyre, on to all the cities of the Hivites and the Canaanites, and finally to Beersheba, in the southern part of Judah.

dag: Ka so yi wuhiri wuhibu shɛli din be di ko, ka bi saɣi deei ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛligu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli la mini wuhibu shɛli din mini din luri Naawuni sizuura taɣili tab la.
en: Some people will teach what is false and will not agree with the true teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ. They will not accept the teaching that produces a life of devotion to God.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Malɔn pakoli Rut ŋun nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba ni leegi m paɣa. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa, ka o yuli ni be o niriba ni min o ya. Ka yinim mi n-di di shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: I also take Ruth to be my wife. Then the dead mans property will continue to belong to his family. And he will always be remembered by his family and the people in his hometown. You are all witnesses of what I am doing today.

dag: N di yɛlimi, Chɛ ka ninkura tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka bɛn yuma galisi pam mi wuhi yɛm.
en: I told myself that you ought to speak, that you older men should share your wisdom.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: Surely you have read this scripture? The stone which the builders rejected as worthless turned out to be the most important of all.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kul birigiri Yawɛ zaligu? Dama lala ku nani.
en: But Moses said, Why are you not obeying the Lord s command? You will not be successful!.

dag: O daa yɛliya: Yawɛ daa yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na, ka yi Siɛr ka ti sanna; o daa yi Paran Zoli zuɣu n-niŋ neesim bahi ti na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi tuhi pia be o sani; ka omaŋmaŋ dini din galisi be o nudirigu polo.
en: He said: The LORD came from Sinai: from Seir he shone like the dawn on us, from Paran Mountain he beamed down. Thousands of holy ones were with him; his warriors were next to him, ready.

dag: O fa n jilima, ka piligi n nam zuɣupiligu.
en: stripped my honor from me, removed the crown from my head.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi yɛm, ka vihiri baŋdi salinim suhuri, ka tiri sokam zaa ka di doli bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ni bɛ tuma nyɔri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I, the Lord , search the minds and test the hearts of people. I treat each of them according to the way they live, according to what they do.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn be n san la puhiri ya.
en: Greetings to each one of God's people who belong to Christ Jesus. The believers here with me send you their greetings.

dag: Kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu, ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna.
en: There was no water where they camped, so the people gathered around Moses and Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa yiɣisi bo tɔbutuhiri biinsi niriba tusaata Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Zif mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee Zif mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul gathered of the best soldiers in Israel and went down to the desert of Ziph to search for David there.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dari tɔhi binyara din ni saɣ o bihi, ka dim kabi binyara nyiŋgoya n-zaŋ ti ti gbuɣinnyaŋ. O zaŋ o ni gbahi binneen shɛba ti pal o ni be vokab shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ o ni dari tɔhi nim shɛli ti pal o ni do luɣ shɛŋa.
en: The lion was able to catch plenty of food to feed his cubs and his mate. He filled his cave with the animals he killed. He filled his den with the meat he gathered.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi di ka nyu, ka bindirigu maa daa ti o kpiɔŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o chaŋ hal ti paai Sinai Zoli din nyɛ Naawuni zol la zuɣu.
en: So Elijah got up. He ate and drank and felt strong. Then Elijah walked for days and nights to Mount Horeb, the mountain of God.

dag: O yidana Yisifu daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ suŋ pam, dinzuɣu ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yihi li palɔni n-dihi Mariama vi, amaa ka daa lee lo ni o ku lan kpuɣ o.
en: Marys husband, Joseph, was a good man. He did not want to cause her public disgrace, so he planned to divorce her secretly.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kpɛhi duu, ka guhiri ni Yawɛ ti yɛli ba o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He was put under guard until they could determine the LORDs verdict.

dag: A zaɣis a ni daa lo a dabili alikauli shɛl la; ka zaŋ o nam zuɣupiligu bahi tiŋa.
en: You ended the agreement you made with your servant. You threw the kings crown into the dirt.

dag: Tɔrokɔnim maa zaa daa malila daanya gbaya mini daanya spindilinima, ka di yaɣa anahi maa zaa mali taha tambu shee. Ka o daa niŋ biŋgolima niŋ taha maa tambu shee kam polo.
en: Each cart had four bronze wheels with bronze axles. At the four corners were bronze supports for a basin; the supports were decorated with spiral figures in relief.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul yɛr o lala saha shɛli maa, ka nayili namɔɣilisi paana nti zaŋ Haman yomyom chaŋ Ɛsta ni daa pun duɣi bindir shɛŋa la dibu.
en: They were still discussing this with him when several royal eunuchs arrived. They quickly hurried Haman off to the feast that Esther had prepared.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani mini bɛ malibu na ka bɛ ti ʒini Hiburɔn fɔndi ni.
en: David also took the soldiers who were with him, each with his family, and they lived in the towns around Hebron.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri wuntitali mini nirilim niŋbu ni nya nyɛvili mini jilima.
en: Those who pursue righteousness and kindness will find life, righteousness, and honor.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa ti wum ni kawana be Ijipti, ka o bɔh o bihi, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri taba.
en: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, Why are you staring blankly at each other?.

dag: ni Jɛturi ni Nafish ni Kɛdɛma. Ishimail bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bala.
en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. This was Ishmaels family.

dag: yin chɛliya ka o mal o ni daa kɔhi li yuun shɛli maa zaŋ kana di saha maa laasabu, ka yo laɣ shɛli din pahi ti o ni daa kɔhi li ti so maa, ka bɛ labis o tiŋgbani ti o.
en: Then the years must be counted since the land was sold. That number must be used to decide how much to pay for the land. The person must then buy back the land, and it will be their property again.

dag: A ni neei zoomba nina, ka yihi dansarikanim bɛn be zibisim ni la bahi.
en: to open blind eyes, to lead the prisoners from prison, and those who sit in darkness from the dungeon.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zani naŋgban yini yɛli, Ti ni so ku lab kul o tanti ni bee o yiŋa.
en: Then all the people stood up at the same time. They said together, None of us will go home. No, not one of us will go back to his house.

dag: Teeku, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa zo? Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa ŋmaligi lab a nyaaŋa?.
en: Red Sea, why did you run away? Jordan River, why did you turn and run away?.

dag: A ni zaŋ ti yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni na ni a ti ku ti yɔɣu ŋɔ ni la nyɛla yɛlibila, ka a ti lan bɔri ni a zaŋ amaŋ leei naa su ti?.
en: Isn't it enough that you have brought us out of the fertile land of Egypt to kill us here in the wilderness? Do you also have to lord it over us?.

dag: Ka do so yi nyɛla faralana ka ku tooi yo yi ni zali da shɛli maa, dindina yin zaŋmi dilan chaŋ maligumaana sani, ka o ti zal o daa, maligumaana ni zal o daa maa ka di dolila ŋun po pɔri maa dahima ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If any of you make a vow and are too poor to pay the standard price, you shall bring the person to the priest, and the priest will set a lower price, according to your ability to pay.

dag: Malimiya pipih anahi din ŋmani alimɔnd pum ka mali bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: Make four more flowers for the lampstand. These flowers must be made like almond flowers with buds and petals.

dag: Di chaŋya ti tuhi Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, n sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka lab kuli kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: Do not attack your own relatives, the people of Israel. Go home, all of you. What has happened is my will. They all obeyed the Lord 's command and went back home.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be yi sani ninvuɣ so yi go piɛli gbaai biŋkɔbigu bee nooŋa ŋun ŋubbu bi chihira, dilan ŋun kɔrigim bini maa ʒim bahi tiŋa, ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu pa di zuɣu.
en: If any Israelites or any foreigners living in the community catch an animal or a bird which is ritually clean, they must pour its blood out on the ground and cover it with dirt.

dag: dindina yi m-baŋmiya ni Naawuni n-zaŋ ma niŋ chirimbu maa ni, ka chɛ ka o zana gbaai ma maa.
en: I want you to know it was God who did this. He set this trap for me.

dag: Naawuni, a nam nyɛla din kul ni beni sahakam. A nam jaaŋgbee tumdila din tuhi.
en: The kingdom that God has given you will last forever and ever. You rule over your people with justice;.

dag: Ka n daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a kpalim be n sani dabisi gbaliŋ. Di bi simdi ka a lan go pagɔrisigu bee n-chɛ ka do so su a yaha. N gba ni be a sani lala.
en: I said to her, You must stay with me for many days; you wont act like a prostitute; you wont have sex with a man, nor I with you.

dag: N nyari baŋsim a zaligunim maa puuni, dinzuɣu n je ʒiri soli kam.
en: Im studying your precepts— thats why I hate every false path.

dag: N kul ni paɣir a, dama a wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: I will always praise you, because you teach me your laws.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi ni damdi tiŋa n-jɛm ma, n ni zaŋ di zaa ha ti a.
en: The devil said to him, I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee sɔŋ ya ka yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ? Ka ŋuni shia n-lee yi yi sanna maa.
en: Who do you think will hear all your words? Who inspired you to speak like this?.

dag: Ɛlifaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfo ni Gatam ni Kɛnaz.
en: Eliphaz had five sons: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

dag: ka o mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya mali binyɛra.
en: He can design and make things with gold, silver, and bronze.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya Yisifu ka o be katiŋ ha kanna, o daa ti yɛn paai bɛ sani, ka bɛ pun lo nia wuhi ni bɛ kum o.
en: They saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted against him and decided to kill him.

dag: Di saha ka n daa zaŋ wain duɣuri mini pipihi zali Rɛkabinim maa ka yɛli ba, Nyumiya wain.
en: Then I placed cups and bowls full of wine before the Rechabites, and I said to them, Have some wine.

dag: Bɛ laɣindimi sɔɣiri dooni ni bɛ nya n ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka maani tahima ni bɛ ku ma.
en: They gather in hiding places and watch everything I do, hoping to kill me.

dag: n di bi zaɣisi ni m be yi sani pumpɔŋɔ n-taɣ zilinli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama n suhu zɔhiri yi zuɣu.
en: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled.

dag: Niriba yi diri ʒiɛvari kɔŋko ka mali yurilim ni taba, di so ni niriba ŋubiri naɣ kpaba ka je taba.
en: Better to eat vegetables with people you love than to eat the finest meat where there is hate.

dag: Amaa di yi ti niŋ a viɛnyɛla, n suhir a, nyin teemi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Firawuna; ka lala chɛ ka n yi sarika ŋɔ ni.
en: But when these good things happen, please don't forget to tell the king about me, so I can get out of this place.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka o daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Therefore, it was credited to him as righteousness.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla din ti yɛn kana la shilinshia, amaa din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli m-be Masia ni la yipa paana.
en: These religious practices are only a shadow of what was coming—the body that cast the shadow is Christ.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ lala ni o kahigila o daanfaani din galisi pam la wuhi palɔni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna ni, ka di yila o ni wuhi ti yurilim shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la ni na.
en: He did this to demonstrate for all time to come the extraordinary greatness of his grace in the love he showed us in Christ Jesus.

dag: Di ni naɣ simdi ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya tab yɛlimaŋli, ka karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka lan nyɛ din tiri suhudoo yi kootunim ni.
en: But you must do this: Tell the truth to your neighbors. When you make decisions in your cities, be fair and do what is right. Do what brings peace.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli hal ti paai di tariga, ka Izraɛl laɣiŋgu maa zaa wum li.
en: Then Moses recited in their entirety the words of this poem in the hearing of the entire assembly of Israel.

dag: Firilatamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni firilanima ni firila kpam.
en: the lampstand for the light and its equipment; the lamps with their oil;.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni ŋɔ ni shɛba, amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba maa mali m-be kasi. Lala mi ka di yɛn be hal ti paai di tariga kaman Naawuni ni zali di saha shɛm.
en: Some of those wise leaders will be killed, but as a result of this the people will be purified. This will continue until the end comes, the time that God has set.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi puhina m-bii ni tulim n-kpe mɔri, di puma kpahirimi lu ka di viɛlim gba kpaai. Lala ka azichilana gba ni ti kpaai o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: The sun rises with its scorching heat and dries up the grass so that its flowers fall and its beauty is lost. Just like that, in the midst of their daily lives, the wealthy will waste away.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi zaa ni nti laɣim Lɛvinim mini Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba, ka bɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: They went around in Judah and gathered the Levites from all the towns of Judah. They also gathered the leaders of the families of Israel. Then they went to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Simiɔn zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbuyinika ni kɔbisita.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Simeon were .

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa ni shɛb yɛli, Dindina doo maa pala Naawuni nira, dama o bi doli Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu. Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Ka wula ka alahichilana ni tooi wuhi shihira ŋɔ tatabo? Ka bɛ noya woli.
en: Some of the Pharisees said, This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath. Others asked, How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle? Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves.

dag: Yi wulimpuhili polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Hazarɛnan hal ni Shɛfam.
en: You will mark out your eastern border from Hazar-enan to Shepham.

dag: O daa lan yɛli di yɛla yaha: Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: This same matter is spoken of again: They will never enter that land where I would have given them rest.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti nahiŋgu mini ti wahala dibu puuni, ti nya suhukpaŋsibo yi zuɣu. Yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri ti.
en: Because of this, brothers and sisters, we were encouraged in all our distress and trouble through your faithfulness.

dag: Bɛ daa paaya nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi ka chɛ di noli maa.
en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani hal abada, amaa o daalahichi maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But whoever insults the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven. That person is guilty of a sin with consequences that last forever.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa dolila wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni.
en: The dazzling light passed through the east gate and went into the Temple.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛla gbaai dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam dabiɛm, Hɛzɛkia bia Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa la ni daa tum shɛm Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu.
en: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima naɣibil yino zali Bɛtɛl, ka zaŋ yino mi zali Dan.
en: Then he put one of the gold calves in the town of Bethel and the other in the town of Dan.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya bahi kaman pɔhim din yi tiŋgban nɛli polo na ni ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri shɛm la.
en: So I will scatter you like straw that is blown away by the desert winds.

dag: Zuliya kam ni niriba, kamiyana ti wum! Daadamnima, Wummiya! Dunia mini bɛnkam be di ni zaŋ tabili binshɛɣukam zaa, kamiyana ti wum!.
en: All you nations, come near and listen! Listen, all you people. The earth and everyone on it should listen to these things. Everything in this world should hear this.

dag: Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ saɣim yimaŋa.
en: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.

dag: Wamiya waa paɣ o yuli. Ŋmɛmiya biŋkumda mini guŋgombihi ni mɔɣilɔnim ni chaɣisa paɣ o.
en: Let them praise him by dancing and playing their tambourines and harps.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku anab shɛb zaa, tum dunia piligu ni la ha taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba.
en: As a result, this generation will be charged with the murder of all the prophets since the beginning of time.

dag: Nyin Naawuni zuɣu ka ti kul nyuri bara, ka ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: We will always praise you and give thanks to you forever.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ n zɔnim ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi, di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi lan niŋ shɛli pahi.
en: I tell you, my friends, dont be terrified by those who can kill the body but after that can do nothing more.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi nyɛ Obɛd bia, ka Obɛd nyɛ Bɔaz bia, ka Bɔaz nyɛ Sala bia, ka Sala mi nyɛ Nashɔn bia.
en: son of Jesse son of Obed son of Boaz son of Sala son of Nahshon.

dag: Ka kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛl o, Di garig o shɛli bee n-saɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Don't listen to him! they answered. You don't have to do what he says.

dag: Di yi pa lala a yi paɣiri Naawuni la a shia ni kɔŋko, wula ka ŋun ka yi kalinli ni ka lan ʒi a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni ni tooi yɛli, Ami, a Naawuni paɣibu maa zuɣu?.
en: When you give thanks to God in spirit only, how can ordinary people taking part in the meeting say Amen to your prayer of thanksgiving? They have no way of knowing what you are saying.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na be soli kuna ka lahibali ti nti to Dauda, Absalom ku nabihi la zaa, hal bɛ yino bi lan kpalim.
en: While they were on the way, the report came to David: Absalom has killed all of the princes! Not one remains.

dag: Di ŋubiya sooŋa, dama o gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa o ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, o nyɛla ŋun nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: the hare—though it rechews food, it does not have divided hoofs, so it is unclean for you.

dag: Dama di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sab o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will die as the Scriptures say he will; but how terrible for that man who will betray the Son of Man! It would have been better for that man if he had never been born.

dag: O ni daa paɣi bɛ naba maa naai, ka o zaŋ o kparibu ye n-lab ti ʒini ka bɔhi ba, Yi baŋ n ni niŋ ya shɛm ŋɔ gbinni?.
en: After he washed the disciples feet, he put on his robes and returned to his place at the table. He said to them, Do you know what Ive done for you?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, N ni yihi n niriba bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la.
en: I will rescue my people from the lands where they have been taken.

dag: di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi Izraɛlnim zuliya shɛb zaa sani bɛ ni be na, ka yihi ba luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Tell the people that this is what the Lord GOD says: I will gather the people of Israel from among the nations. I will gather them from all around and bring them back to their own land.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka lihiri n ni doli so shɛŋa zaa; ka zahindi n napɔna bɔba.
en: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;.
