dag: Dama yimaŋmaŋ nina daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: It was you, not your children, who saw all the great things the Lord did.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ n-daa yɛli ma.
en: I answered: The Lord God says.

dag: A zaŋla neesim ye kaman binyɛrigu la. A teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman tanti la.
en: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent.

dag: bee m-mirigi bɛ nina kpa tiŋgban ni, amaa bɛ ni nyala suhusaɣiŋgu mini zibisim ni bumbɔni din mali barina ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli puuni bɛ ni yɛn kari ba ti kpɛhi.
en: or stare at the ground, but they will see nothing but trouble and darkness, terrifying darkness into which they are being driven.

dag: Yisa ni daa neei kum ni bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi maa o daa tuui yila Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa kari alizin biɛri ayopɔin so zuɣu la.
en: After Jesus rose from death early on Sunday, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had driven out seven demons. The women went to Peter and his friends and gave them a brief account of all they had been told.

dag: bɛn kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka deeri birapu niriba san la.
en: those who do evil all the time and are always ready to take bribes.

dag: Naawuni yiko ni o daa tɔɣisi luhi Yɛhudianima niriba ni, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni Kundi n-kahigiri wuhiri niriba ni Yisa shiri nyɛla Masia.
en: He got into fierce arguments with the Jewish people, and in public he used the Scriptures to prove that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ nandaamba alaka ka bɛ baɣa ka bɛ ni, bɛ fa yili shɛli din pa bɛ ni me shɛl la.
en: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.

dag: Dindali maa, Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe niriba maa, ka sokam ni ti gbaag o kpee nuu ni ka bɛ ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti laɣim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni luɣ shɛl o ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la, yin karimmi zaligu ŋɔ ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum.
en: Read it to the people of Israel when they come to worship the Lord your God at the one place of worship.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee chi ni chana, a ni tooi zaŋ a nuu ŋmɛm kazuɣuri maa ŋubi, amaa miri ka a zaŋ sua ŋ-ŋmah a kpee chi.
en: When you go through another persons field of grain, you may eat all the grain you can pick with your hands. But you cannot use a sickle to cut that persons grain and take it with you.

dag: Dahin shɛli n ni daa yihi n niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la n daa bi pii tin shɛli Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ni bɛ me jɛmbu duu ti ma, m mi daa bi pii so ni o leei naa n-su n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: From the time I brought my people out of Egypt until now, I did not choose any city in the land of Israel as the place to build a temple where I would be worshiped, and I did not choose anyone to lead my people Israel.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa yihi nabi yino n-lo o alikauli, ka chɛ ka o po pɔri. Ka o daa zaŋ tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa chaŋ.
en: He took one of the king's family, made a treaty with him, and made him swear to be loyal. He took important men as hostages.

dag: Miri ka a bo a piriba bee a mapira, dama nir yi niŋ lala o dɔɣira ka o bo maa, di simdi ni bɛ darigi bɛ tibili.
en: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.

dag: Ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yɛhudianima ni Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ la.
en: The man went and proclaimed to the Jewish leaders that Jesus was the man who had made him well.

dag: Yi yi ti piligi kachɛɣu dahin shɛli, yin piligimiya kali dindali maa hal ni bakɔi ayopɔin.
en: You must count seven weeks from the time you begin to harvest the grain.

dag: ka di nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku daadam ka zo n-kuli luɣ shɛli. Ŋun bi yuri ka ku o kpee ka di pala dimdi m-pun be bɛ sunsuuni, ŋun ku nira maa ni tooi zo n-kuli fɔntinsi maa zaɣ yin ni tilig o nyɛvili.
en: Any person who killed someone by accident and not out of hate could run away to one of these three cities and not be put to death.

dag: Ka ti daa bi wum ti ba hal baabiɛla ni di chɛ ka ti ba yɛlimaŋli din be lahibal suŋ maa ni zali tin ya.
en: but in order to keep the truth of the gospel safe for you, we did not give in to them for a minute.

dag: Ka sokam zaa daa dii kab dol o m-piɛbiri yuhi, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam, ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi bɛ vuri yɔbu zuɣu.
en: All the people followed him playing flutes and celebrating. The ground shook at their noise.

dag: hal ka ti ti paai ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la mini ti Naawuni Bia baŋbu la m-bi niriba ka ti biɛhigu buɣisibu saɣisi Masia biɛhigu zaa la.
en: This work must continue until we are all joined together in what we believe and in what we know about the Son of God. Our goal is to become like a full-grown man—to look just like Christ and have all his perfection.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka bɛ daa bi sɔɣi ma kaman bɛ ni dɔɣi bi so zaɣ kpiŋ la, bee kaman biliɛ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-nya neesim la?.
en: Why wasnt I a child who died at birth and was put in the ground? I wish I had been buried like a baby who never saw the light of day.

dag: Amaa m mali piɛ shɛba ka bɛ ka buzɔŋ ŋɔ ni, faashee m bahi zaŋ ba na ka bɛ gba ti baŋ n kukoli, ka di chɛ ka piɛgul yino mini buzɔn yini kɔŋko beni.
en: I have other sheep too. They are not in this flock here. I must lead them also. They will listen to my voice. In the future there will be one flock and one shepherd.

dag: Ka n ni darigi Dauda zuliya tibili, amaa m bi yɛn darigi li hal ni saha din ka bahigu. .
en: I will humble Davids descendants by means of all this, though not forever.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɛ alahichi daba saha shɛl la, wuntia daa bi su yi fukumsi.
en: In the past you were slaves to sin, and you did not even think about doing right.

dag: Saha paaya ni nyin Yawɛ niŋ shɛli, dama niriba saɣim a zaligu.
en: Lord , it is time for you to act, because people are disobeying your law.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti zaa ni ti kahigi ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi Naawuni.
en: So then, each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa ku chɛ hal ka o ti niŋ o suhu ni lo ni o niŋ shɛli maa naai. Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti baŋ di gbinni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: and it will not end until he has done everything he intends to do. In days to come his people will understand this clearly.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa, amaa ʒiŋmariba ʒiri ni zani tariga.
en: Those who live right say wise things, but people stop listening to troublemakers.

dag: Dama wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n niriba ka mbusim ŋɔ tatabo paai ba? Bee wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n dɔɣiriba ka bɛ kuri ba.
en: How can I endure it if this disaster comes on my people, and my own relatives are killed.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ ku bihi laamba bɛ bihi zuɣu bee n-ku bihi bɛ laamba zuɣu; kulila sokam maŋmaŋ tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ ni ku o.
en: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Saimɔn n-chaŋ Yisa sani. Ka Yisa daa ti yul o ka yɛl o, Nyini n-nyɛ Saimɔn, Jɔn bia la. Ka lan yɛl o, Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, a yuli m-booni Siifas. Yuli ŋɔ mini Pita nyɛla zaɣ yini. Di gbinni nyɛla Kuɣili.
en: Then Andrew brought Simon to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, You are Simon, the son of John. You will be called Cephas.

dag: O daa lan mali salima firilatamdisi pia kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, diba anu nudirigu polo, diba anu din la mi nuzaa polo.
en: He made ten lampstands of gold. He followed the plans made for these lampstands. He put the lampstands in the Temple. There were five lampstands on the right side and five lampstands on the left side.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa guui, ka bɛ kari dol o ti gbaag o ŋ-ŋmah o nubihilɔri min o napombihilɔri bahi.
en: Adoni-bezek fled, but they chased after him, captured him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɛn yihi yili maa daɣiri ni, ŋun zaŋmi noombihi tintiins ayi mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro.
en: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.

dag: Bɛ pun chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛl la, ka malila naɣibila n-jɛmdi li, ka maani maligu tiri li, ka yɛli, Izraɛlnima, yi buɣili ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: Theyve already abandoned the path that I commanded. They have made a metal bull calf for themselves. Theyve bowed down to it and offered sacrifices to it and declared, These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka naa Sulemaana mini Hiram ni Gɛba tumtumdiba daa kpe kuɣa, ka ŋma dakuɣiri m-mal li ni bɛ zaŋ me duu maa.
en: Solomon's and Hiram's men worked with men from the city of Gebal, and together they got the stones and logs ready for the temple.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ Bɛtɛl maa hal ni Luz n-gari chaŋ hal ti paai Atarɔt din nyɛ Arikinim tiŋgban la.
en: Then the border continued from Bethel to the Arkite border at Ataroth.

dag: N yɛn yuuni bɔrila bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni bɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Juda ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, tɔbu mini kum ni ku ba hal ka bɛ ni yino ti ku kpalim.
en: Im watching over them for harm and not for good. Everyone from Judah who is living in the land of Egypt will die by the sword and by famine, until all are gone.

dag: Dindali maa vi ti ku din ya yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka zaɣisi n noli la zuɣu; dama di saha n ni ti yihi karimbaannim bɛn be yi ni ka mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu la, ka yi ti ku lan mali karimbaani n zoli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: On that day, you wont be ashamed of all your deeds with which you sinned against me; then I will remove from your midst those boasting with pride. No longer will you be haughty on my holy mountain.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ ba jila yi suhuri ni, ka yi ti ku zani ni yi tɛhi pɔi ka naanyi garigi;.
en: Make up your minds ahead of time not to worry about how you will defend yourselves.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa tirila naa suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ biɛriyoli maa tiri bɛ kpamba suhupiɛlli.
en: Their evil makes their king happy. Their false gods please their leaders.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛl o, N nyala tiwal moma ni be piɛ shɛl ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim biɛɣu yipa neeya. N ku lan chɛ ba.
en: He said, Amos, what do you see? I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then the LORD said to me, The end has come upon my people Israel; I will never again forgive them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Bɔhim maligumaana m-baŋ zaligu ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɔhigu ŋɔ polo.
en: He said, Ask the priests for a ruling on this question:.

dag: n ni ʒe kɔbiliga ŋɔ gbini, ka paɣisar so yi ti kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom, ka n yɛl o, N suhir a, niŋm a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ti ma ka n nyu.
en: when Im standing by the spring and the young woman who comes out to draw water and to whom I say, Please give me a little drink of water from your jar.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔ puuni jilima din galisi la zuɣu chɛ ka din gba daa mali jilima la jilima maa naai.
en: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.

dag: Ka takɔr kɔrikɔɣa mini abie tihi daa be zɔntua maa luɣa zuɣu dukpina zuɣu.
en: There were windows with frames around them and palm trees on the walls on both sides of the porch, on the roof over the porch, and on the rooms around the Temple.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa kul zaŋ kpan la tiri Ai, o daa bi zaŋ o nuu siɣisi tiŋ hal ka bɛ ti ku Ainim maa zaa.
en: Joshua didnt pull back the hand that was stretched out holding a dagger until he had wiped out the whole population of Ai as something reserved for God.

dag: O daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Sool, O daa nyɛla nachimbil viɛlli. Do so daa ka Izraɛl n-viɛl gar o; ka o daa lan wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: Kish had a son named Saul, who was better looking and more than a head taller than anyone else in all Israel.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti fiɛb o gba n-dih o vi, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: So the man sent another servant. They beat this servant too and showed no respect for him. They sent the servant away with nothing.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti sab pa yuri buɣilimbuɣilinsi zuɣu yɛli, Ti woligi li di ko n-zaŋ tila Yawɛ. Ka saɣiduɣuri din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni ti leei din be kasi kaman la shɛŋa din ʒe sara maligu bimbini gbin la.
en: At that time even the harnesses on the horses will have the label, holy to the lord . And all the pots used in the Lord s Temple will be just as important as the bowls used at the altar.

dag: ka n yɛli, n di bi zaɣisi ka m mali kpiŋkpama kaman ŋmani la. N naan yiɣi chaŋ ka vuhi.
en: Oh, I wish I had wings like a dove. I would fly away and find a place to rest.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa ni, ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒɛbu.
en: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pii dɔbba zali ka bɛ gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam n-sɔɣiri bɛn daa kana ti liri ba maa kpiimba bɛn kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ mali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti zaŋla chira ayopɔin vihi.
en: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.

dag: M biyurisi, ti suhuri yi bi wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, ti ni mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: My dear friends, if we dont feel that we are doing wrong, we can be without fear when we come to God.

dag: Man Yawɛ je ŋmɛndintoli tuma mini alahichi, amaa m bɔrila yɛlimaŋli soli. N ʒiɛyimtali puuni, n ni tin ya laara, ka lɔn ya alikauli din ku zani tariga.
en: I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and dishonesty. I will faithfully give them their wage, and make with them an enduring covenant.

dag: Ka paɣ maa mi daa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa mali zal o tiŋgban nɛli ni ni o be nimaani ka o dihir o hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu la.
en: Then the woman fled into the desert, where God has prepared a place for her. There she will be taken care of for one thousand two hundred sixty days.

dag: Dabiɛm chɛmi ka ti ŋumdi kaman biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bee la, ka nandahima mi chɛ ka ti kumdi kaman ŋmana la. Ti kul guhirila yɛlimaŋli, ka bi nyari li; ka bɔri ŋun ni fa ti bahi, ka bi nyara.
en: We are frightened and distressed. We long for God to save us from oppression and wrong, but nothing happens.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiligira ŋɔ, chɛ ka n nol ni yɛtɔɣa mini n suhu ni tɛha zaa nyɛ din tiɣi a nini.
en: May my words and my thoughts be acceptable to you, O Lord , my refuge and my redeemer!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni zali zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili be kom ni ni binnamda kam bɛn mali nyɛvili gbamdi tiŋgban ni.
en: These are the rules about all the tame animals, birds, all the animals in the sea, and all the animals that crawl on the ground.

dag: Ka n gbaai yila yilibu n suhu ni yuŋ, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-suhi Naawuni, ka bɔhi n suhu:.
en: I spend the night in deep thought; I meditate, and this is what I ask myself:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Itam maa ŋ-ŋmaligi labi Pihahirɔt din be Baalizɛfɔn wulimpuhili polo la nti dɔni miri Migidol.
en: They marched from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which faces Baal-zephon, and they camped before Migdol.

dag: Dama niriba maa ni daa laɣim maa, Jabɛshigiliad ninvuɣ so daa ka nimaani.
en: When the peoples attendance was taken, not one of those who lived in Jabesh-gilead had been there.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya li, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya n laɣifu din daa bɔrigi la.
en: Then she will call in her friends and neighbors and say, Let's celebrate! I've found the coin I lost.

dag: Tuuni kam tumbu mali nyɔri, amaa yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu kɔŋko nyɛla din tahiri fara na.
en: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.

dag: Yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zaa, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to the LORDs word, people of Judah, all you families of the Israelite household.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye wuntia zuɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: Happy are people who are hungry and thirsty for righteousness, because they will be fed until they are full.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa yoli, bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ʒiri mabihi maa daa bi labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa ka naɣ ŋmarila ʒiri. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And after all this, Judah, Israel's unfaithful sister, only pretended to return to me; she was not sincere. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: O paɣ ŋun yuli daa booni Hɔdɛsh la daa dɔɣi bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Jɔbab mini Zibia ni Mɛsha ni Malikam.
en: Shaharaim had Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam, Jeuz, Sakia, and Mirmah with his wife Hodesh. They were leaders of their families.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi puu atam di kpuɣibu saha nyɛla yɛndana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun doya gbihiri atam kpuɣibu saha nyɛla vi dira.
en: A son who works hard while it is harvest time will be successful, but one who sleeps through the harvest is worthless.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa guui chaŋ ti yɛli Musa, Ɛldad mini Mɛdad be yiŋa n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: A young man ran and told Moses. The man said, Eldad and Medad are prophesying in camp.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu maa naai, ka o zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni;.
en: then he blessed the people in the name of the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka o daa bahi ba noli. Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni; ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba. Kuruchunim maa daa nyɛla kaman tusaayi laasabu.
en: Jesus gave them permission, so the unclean spirits left the man and went into the pigs. Then the herd of about two thousand pigs rushed down the cliff into the lake and drowned.

dag: Amaa ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa zɔri Naawuni ka bi niŋdi Ijipti naa ni daa yɛli ni bɛ niŋm shɛm maa, bɛ daa bi kuri bidibbihi maa.
en: But the midwives were God-fearing and so did not obey the king; instead, they let the boys live.

dag: Niŋmiya binshɛɣukam ka kparima ni ŋumbu bee naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu kani.
en: Do everything without grumbling and arguing.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka yi shɛb kpimi kaman n ni daa chɛ ka Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim kpi shɛm la; ka yi ni shɛb mi daa tiligi ka di ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni. Di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I destroyed some of you as I destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah. Those of you who survived were like a burning stick saved from a fire. Still you did not come back to me, says the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni ku bɛ naa min o kpambaliba, ka zali n nam ʒiishee Ɛlam.
en: I will destroy their kings and leaders, and set up my throne there.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the message that was given to Habakkuk the prophet.

dag: N yura ŋmanila molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ polli. Nyama, ŋuna n-ʒe ti gooni nyaaŋa n-vɔbisiri lihiri ti takɔriti ni, ka lihiri dari din puli gabi tab voya ni ŋɔ.
en: My lover is like a gazelle or a young stag. Here he stands now, outside our wall, peering through the windows, peeking through the lattices.

dag: daa ti lo tɔbu bɛ ʒiɛman ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Sɔdom Naa Bɛra mini Gomɔra Naa Birisha ni Adima Naa Shinab ni Zɛbɔiim Naa Shɛmɛba ni Bɛla bee Zɔa naa.
en: declared war on Sodoms King Bera, Gomorrahs King Birsha, Admahs King Shinab, Zeboiims King Shemeber, and the king of Bela, that is, Zoar.

dag: O daa tum din chihira n-chaŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa kaman Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni daa niŋdi shɛm ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Yawɛ kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini di ni la.
en: Ahab committed the terrible sin of worshiping those filthy idols, just as the Amorites did. And that is why the Lord took the land from them and gave it to the Israelites.

dag: dama di naan nyɛla buɣim din ni di hal ni gballi puuni ka di naan di m puu atam zaa.
en: Such sin is like a fire that burns until it destroys everything. It would completely ruin my lifes work.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli suhi Naawuni ka o niŋ o yiko, ka o kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: So those who have the gift of speaking in a different language should pray that they can also interpret what they say.

dag: Kish daŋ ni, Kish bia Jɛramiil n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: from Kish and his family: Jerahmeel.

dag: ni Kɛila ni Akizib ni Marɛsha ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara awɛi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Keilah, Achzib, and Mareshah: nine cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nir la daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu azichi sɔŋbu shee mini bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti tiri Naawuni la fukumsi.
en: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of Gods temple and the treasuries of the dedicated gifts.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla tila suŋ, amaa suhugarigu din nyɛla din kuuri kɔba.
en: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.

dag: Ka bɛ ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: So yi bi lih o dɔɣiriba, di bahi bamdi omaŋmaŋ malibu, dindina o tum din chihir o daadiini soli zuɣu, ka leei ŋun bie n-gari ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda.
en: But if any do not take care of their relatives, especially the members of their own family, they have denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira zaa ni ti gbani n-jɛm o; bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni ni ti gban o tooni, ka n ti beni sahakam.
en: All proud people will bow down to him; all mortals will bow down before him.

dag: Peentɔriba ni ti lir o, ka di bi viɛla. Bɛ ni ti to o piɛma, ka nahim o pam.
en: People attacked him and made life hard for him. Men with arrows became his enemies.

dag: Ɛlam beni, ka di tɔbbihi zaa gili di gballi. Takɔbi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi guni ka kpe tiŋgban ni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ di vi chaŋ ti pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee zuɣu.
en: Elam is there and all its army is around her grave. All of them were killed in battle. Those foreigners went deep down into the ground. When they were alive, they made people afraid. But they carried their shame with them down to that deep hole.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ni mani m-bɔŋɔ; dinzuɣu yi yi bɔrila mani, yin chɛ ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa chaŋ.
en: This time Jesus replied, I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ Hadadɛza ni su fɔn shɛŋa din nyɛ Tibihat mini Kun la ni nti va daanya pam nimaani. Dina ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ mali daanya ko niŋdi bini la mini daantalisi ni daanya taha la.
en: He also took a great quantity of bronze from Tibhath and Kun, cities ruled by Hadadezer.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ mali suhupiɛlli; dama nyini ka n kul suhira.
en: My Lord, I put my life in your hands. I am your servant, so make me happy.

dag: ni Ira ŋun daa nyɛ Ikɛsh Tɛkɔa nir bia la ni Abiɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Anatɔt nir la.
en: Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa; Abiezer from Anathoth;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaɣis o ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: Finally, Lord , you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.

dag: Taibɛrius Siiza ni daa diri nam, ka di ti paai yuun pinaanu saha shɛl la, ka Pɔntius Pailɛt daa nyɛ Judia Gomna, ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa diri Galili, ka o tizo Filip daa su Ituria mini Trakɔnaitis, ka Naa Laisanias diri Abiliin.
en: It was the fifteenth year of the rule of Emperor Tiberius; Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod was ruler of Galilee, and his brother Philip was ruler of the territory of Iturea and Trachonitis; Lysanias was ruler of Abilene.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, yiɣisim ka ti chaŋ. Amaa ka o bi garigi. Ka o daa kpuɣi paɣ maa pa o buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kul o ya.
en: Get up! he said. It's time to leave. But his wife didn't move. He lifted her body onto his donkey and left.

dag: Jɛra n-tɛhi ni bɛmaŋmaŋ soli n-tuhi, amaa yɛnnim bɛn gbilisirila tibili wumda.
en: Fools always think their own way is best, but wise people listen to what others tell them.

dag: Ka a zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ zuɣupil shɛli din be kasi pil o pa bantabiga maa zuɣu.
en: Put the turban on him and tie on it the sacred sign of dedication engraved Dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri yi palo a sani, ka a niŋ ba kaman a ni niŋ ma shɛm n tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu ŋɔ. Dama n ŋuhibu maa yaɣiya; ka n suhu saɣim.
en: Condemn them for all their wickedness; Punish them as you punished me for my sins. I groan in misery, and I am sick at heart.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim pam daa ka Maata mini Mariama sanna ni bɛ ti maai bɛ suhuri bɛ tizɔdoo Lazarɔs kum maa zuɣu.
en: and many Judeans had come to see Martha and Mary to comfort them about their brother's death.

dag: Dauda yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihita ka o naanyi di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi.
en: David was years old when he began to rule. He was king for years.

dag: Yinim bɛn je din viɛla ka bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ, yinim bɛn dariti tɔhiri n niriba niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka dariti tɔhiri bɛ nimdi ka chɛri bɛ kɔba ŋɔ.
en: But you hate good and love evil. You tear the skin off the people and tear the flesh off their bones.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta din nyɛ Babilɔn liribu shihirili la zuɣusaa. Bomiya guliba pahi; zalimiya tiŋ guliba, ka chɛ ka shɛb sɔɣi doya gu. Dama Yawɛ lo nia ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm la.
en: Give the signal to attack Babylon's walls. Strengthen the guard! Post the sentries! Place troops in ambush! The Lord has done what he said he would do to the people of Babylonia.

dag: Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: This Passover was celebrated in the eighteenth year of Josiahs rule.

dag: Yisa daa yɛli salo maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la ŋaha puuni, hal o daa bi wuhiri ba shɛli ka pa ni yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Jesus used stories to tell all these things to the people. He always used stories to teach them.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yaakubu leei bundana ka mali biŋkɔbiri pam, ka mali daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: The man Jacob became very, very rich: he owned large flocks, female and male servants, camels, and donkeys.

dag: Sulemaana wain tihi puu daa bela Baalihamɔn ka pukpariba daa haayi li o sani, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yɔrila anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: Solomon has a vineyard in a place called Baal Hamon. There are farmers who rent it from him; each one pays a thousand silver coins.

dag: Amaa ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim ʒe siliga maa gbini kumda. O ni daa kumdi maa ka o ti vɔbisi lihi siliga maa puuni.
en: Mary Magdalene stood crying outside the tomb. She was still weeping, when she stooped down.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba bɛn daa leei bundaannim paɣ maa zuɣu la ni ti kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋa o ni nya nahiŋgu shɛli din mali dabiɛm maa zuɣu, ka kuhiri ka fabindi.
en: The merchants will be afraid of her suffering and will stand far away from her. They are the ones who became rich from selling those things to her. They will cry and be sad.

dag: Teeku n-nyɛ ma bee binneen titali ŋun be teeku ni n-nyɛ ma, ka a chɛ ka bɛ guli ma?.
en: Am I Sea or the Sea Monster that you place me under guard?.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ninvuɣ tusa ayopɔin bɛn zaa na bi gbani jɛm Baal bee n-zaŋ bɛ noya mɔɣis o kuɣa la Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I still have people in Israel who have never bowed down to Baal or kissed that idol.

dag: A mi ni lan zo ti nambɔɣu, a ni zaŋ ti daalahichi sɔŋ a naba ni no li. A ni zaŋ ti daalahichi zaa bahi teeku bulli ni.
en: You will be merciful to us once again. You will trample our sins underfoot and send them to the bottom of the sea!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-yɛra, ka booni dunianim zaa bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo.
en: The Lord God Most Powerful has spoken. He calls to everyone on earth, from where the sun rises to where it sets.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan kana ti zani nimaani m-boon o kaman o ni di pun boon o shɛm la, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlima, a dabili wumda.
en: The Lord came and stood there. He called as he did before, saying, Samuel, Samuel! Samuel said, Speak. I am your servant, and I am listening.

dag: Ŋun Naawuni daa fa alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bidibbina, ka zaŋ ba wuhi palɔni o dari dibu chandi puuni ni o nyaŋ ba Masia dapulli la zuɣu.
en: He defeated the rulers and powers of the spiritual world. With the cross he won the victory over them and led them away, as defeated and powerless prisoners for the whole world to see.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣila dab paɣ bia maa kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bia kam shɛm, ka daa dɔɣi bilichin paɣ bia maa mi alikauli lɔbu puuni.
en: Abrahams son from the slave woman was born in the normal human way. But the son from the free woman was born because of the promise God made to Abraham.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma labi Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la, ka di yomi.
en: He brought me back to the outer sanctuary gate that faces east. It was closed.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn wuhi ba mi, n ni wuhi ba n yaa mini n yiko, ka bɛ baŋ ni n yuli m booni Yawɛ.
en: Then the Lord replied, That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord .

dag: Di bemi kaman Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli ni yɛli shɛm la: N niŋ yɛda, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisira. Ti gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ŋun daa sab sabbu maa zuɣu, ka ti gba tɔɣisira.
en: We have the same faithful spirit as what is written in scripture: I had faith, and so I spoke. We also have faith, and so we also speak.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la ni yino daa zaŋ salima lah ayopɔin din pali Naawuni ŋun be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili n-ti malaikanima ayopɔin maa.
en: Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven gold bowls full of the anger of the God who lives forever and always.

dag: Ka o daa boli bipuɣin kpɛm sani yuli Jɛmaima, ka boli ŋun paya yuli Kɛzia, ka boli ŋun pah ata maa mi yuli Kɛrɛnhapuk.
en: He named one Jemimah, a second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa polo n-nyɛ ni bɛ kulim bɛ suhuri ni yu dɔbba shɛba, amaa ni bɛ lee kulimila bɛmaŋmaŋ daŋ puuni dɔbba.
en: and so the Lord says that the daughters of Zelophehad are free to marry anyone they wish but only within their own tribe.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka Manaasa daa zaŋ niriba maa m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ birigi n-tum tuumbiɛri hal gari zuliya shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka Naawuni ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa ʒin nimaani la.
en: But the people of Judah disobeyed the Lord . They listened to Manasseh and did even more sinful things than the nations the Lord had wiped out.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa bɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ tusaata bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi n-chaŋ ni o ti bɔ Dauda min o niriba maa shee Yɔbuhi Tampima tooni polo.
en: Saul took three thousand of the best soldiers in Israel and went looking for David and his men east of Wild Goat Rocks.

dag: M mabihi, di daa kpami ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Naa Dauda yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Judas ŋun daa zaŋ niriba chaŋ ka bɛ ti gbaai Yisa la polo la niŋ pali.
en: Brothers and sisters, the scripture that the Holy Spirit announced beforehand through David had to be fulfilled. This was the scripture concerning Judas, who became a guide for those who arrested Jesus.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ ku wuhi ya ka yi tum bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa tiri bɛ buɣa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ti tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka di chɛ ka yi ni pun tum shɛli zuɣu la ku yi yi nuu ni, amaa ka di lee chɛ ka yi ti deela di laara zaa.
en: Watch yourselves so that you dont lose what weve worked for but instead receive a full reward.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun mali takarifiɛma, ka o takarifiɛma maa wɔrigi, ka o gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiya lala biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: If an animal has hooves that are split into two parts, and if that animal also chews the cud, then you may eat the meat from that animal.

dag: Daadam ni daa tahi kum na shɛm, lala ka daadam lan tahi kpiimba kum ni neebu gba na;.
en: Death comes to people because of what one man did. But now there is resurrection from death because of another man.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ o ti ti, ka ti ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa.
en: but the Lord our God put him in our power, and we killed him, his sons, and all his men.

dag: Amaa ka o yanim daa je o, ka tim tuumba nti yɛli ŋun daa yɛn leeg o nam maa ni bɛ je ni doo maa niŋ bɛ naa.
en: But the people in the kingdom hated the man. They sent a group to follow him to the other country. There they said, We dont want this man to be our king.

dag: Nyini n-nam zibisim, ka di nyɛ yuŋ, ka biŋkɔbiri bɛn be yɔɣu ni yirina gɔra.
en: You made the night, and in the darkness all the wild animals come out.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ku tooi niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni neeri kpiimba?.
en: Why should any of you doubt that God raises the dead to life?.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Aai, n suhir a, a suhu yi shiri maai ni mani, nyin deemi m pini maa, dama n ni nya a ka a deei ma ni suhumahili maa, di ŋmanila n nini nyala Naawuni.
en: Jacob said, No, please, do me the kindness of accepting my gift. Seeing your face is like seeing Gods face, since youve accepted me so warmly.

dag: N ni bɔri nolɔbo shɛli n-nyɛ: Yi lɔrigi yi ni nahindi shɛb la mihi, ka suui yi ni mɔŋ shɛb yɛlimaŋli ka ʒili ba ʒi tibisa la ʒiya; ka bahi yi ni nahindi shɛb la.
en: I will tell you the kind of day I want—a day to set people free. I want a day that you take the burdens off others. I want a day when you set troubled people free and you take the burdens from their shoulders.

dag: Ka Matania mini Bakibukia ni Obadia ni Mɛshulam ni Talimɔn ni Akub bɛn nyɛ dunɔguliba la daa ʒe n-guli nɛma du shɛŋa din daa be dunɔdaya shee la.
en: The gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms next to the gates were Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub.

dag: Sida dari n-nyɛ ti yiŋ dapuhi, ka ti yɔɣira nyɛ timaha.
en: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.

dag: Bom binshɛli n-zaŋ pili ŋariŋ maa, ka chɛ ka di zuɣusaa dubu polo nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi; ka chibi di dunoli di luɣili ni, ka kpahi li tambu buta tam taba.
en: Make a roof for the ark and complete it one foot from the top. Put a door in its side. In the hold below, make the second and third decks.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Bɛ dolila Keen biɛhigu soli. Liɣiri zuɣu ka bɛ doli Balaam biriginsim sol la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn taai duŋ kaman Kɔra ni daa taai duŋ shɛm la; bɛ ni bahi yoli kaman o ni daa bahi yoli shɛm.
en: It will be bad for them. They have followed the way that Cain went. To make money, they have given themselves to following the wrong way that Balaam went. They have fought against God like Korah did. And like Korah, they will be destroyed.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi zani n-chani doli ba hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka kul gbaai chandi ka yiɣiri jɛmdi ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: He jumped up, stood on his feet, and began to walk. He went into the Temple area with them. He was walking and jumping and praising God.

dag: Lala ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa, ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa nyɛ din viɛla ni din tuhi ka lan wuh o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: So King Hezekiah did those good things in all Judah. He did what was good and right and faithful before the Lord his God.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa balim ba pam; ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi dol o kpe o yiŋa; ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi, ka o zaŋ li niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di.
en: He pleaded earnestly with them, so they went with him and entered his house. He made a big meal for them, even baking unleavened bread, and they ate.

dag: Tim o o nuhi tuma tarili, ka chɛ ka o tuma paɣ o tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni.
en: Let her share in the results of her work; let her deeds praise her in the city gates.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a bi niŋ tulaale niŋ n zuɣu, amaa paɣ ŋɔ ŋun zaŋ tulaale niŋ n naba.
en: You didnt anoint my head with oil, but she has poured perfumed oil on my feet.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, n-nyɛ yi ni pii na so maa, dama yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔri so maa ka Yawɛ zaŋ leei naa n-tin ya maa.
en: You asked for a king, and you chose one. Now he stands here where all of you can see him. But it was really the Lord who made him your king.

dag: Di wuhir o ni daa di nam shɛm min o kpiɔŋ ni binshɛŋa din daa niŋ o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zaŋ tabili dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa yɛla.
en: They wrote about his powerful rule and about the things that happened not only to him, but also to Israel and the other nations.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmahiŋmahi yimaŋa kpiimba zuɣu bee n-chihi yimaŋ chiha. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not cut your body as a way to remember the dead. You must not make any tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the Lord .

dag: O yaar o noli n-tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka nirilim niŋbu wuhibu be o noli ni.
en: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi, ka bɛ mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaaniba ti dii tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: So the Pharisees left the synagogue and met at once with some members of Herod's party, and they made plans to kill Jesus.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni n-nyɛ n tiligira; n ni niŋ o naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n yiliyiinili mini n kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiligira.
en: God is the one who saves me. I trust him, and I am not afraid. The Lord YAH is my strength. He saves me, and I sing songs of praise about him. .

dag: Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, Nyɛvili bi ʒir ka dimsira! Ninsal ni zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa taɣi o nyɛvili.
en: Satan answered, There's no pain like your own. People will do anything to stay alive.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: If anyone asks you why you are taking the donkey, you should say, The Master needs it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma dabisili kam.
en: Jesus continued to say to all of them, Any of you who want to be my follower must stop thinking about yourself and what you want. You must be willing to carry the cross that is given to you every day for following me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Saɣisimiya miri ma na. Ka bɛ daa saɣisi mir o. Ka o yɛli ba, Mani yi tizo Yisifu so yi ni daa zaŋ kɔhi Ijipti ŋɔ la m-bala.
en: So Joseph said to his brothers again, Come here to me. I beg you, come here. When the brothers went to him, he said to them, I am your brother Joseph. I am the one you sold as a slave to Egypt.

dag: ni Bɛngɛba ŋun daa be Ramɔtigiliad la.
en: Ben-geber in Ramoth-gilead, who controlled the villages of Jair, Manassehs son, which were in Gilead, and who had the Argob region that was in Bashan—sixty large walled cities with bronze bars.

dag: Anabi Musa daa sab taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli din yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na yɛla n-wuhi ni ŋunkam doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa ni nya nyɛvili di zuɣu.
en: Moses wrote this about being put right with God by obeying the Law: Whoever obeys the commands of the Law will live.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Gɛra bia Ɛhud ŋun daa yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ gɔbigalan la. Ŋuna ka Izraɛlnim daa timdi ka o zaŋdi bɛ farigu ti yɔri Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn.
en: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD. So the LORD raised up a deliverer for them, Ehud, Geras son, a Benjaminite, who was left-handed. The Israelites sent him to take their tribute payment to Moabs King Eglon.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yaakubu daa ti saɣi kum ka niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu bidibisi zaa yinoyino ni, o ni daa zaŋ omaŋ dalim o jaaŋgbee n-jɛmdi Naawuni saha shɛl la.
en: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.

dag: Bɛ bihi yi nya jilima, bɛ bi mi; ka bɛ yi nya filiŋ, so baɣa ka di ni.
en: Their children achieve honor, and they dont know it; their children become insignificant, and they dont see it.

dag: Ka anab maa daa viligi tan shɛli o ni zaŋ lo o ninni maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa baŋ ni o nyɛla anabinim ni yino.
en: The prophet tore the cloth from his face, and at once the king recognized him as one of the prophets.

dag: Din bi tuhi tumbu zaa nyɛla alahichi, amaa alahichi shɛŋa tumbu beni m-pala din tahiri nir kum ni.
en: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.

dag: Tumo ni daa kana ti yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ naa bidibisi maa zuɣuri na, o daa yɛlimi, Zaŋmiya li sɔŋ duya ayi tiŋ ŋɔ dunol ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: The messenger came to Jehu and told him, They have brought the heads of the kings sons. Then Jehu said, Lay the heads in two piles at the city gate until morning.

dag: Ka ŋunkam deeri anabi o ni nyɛ anabi zuɣu ni ti deeg anabi laara; ka ŋunkam deeri wuntizɔra o ni nyɛ wuntizɔra zuɣu ni ti deei wuntizɔra laara.
en: Those who receive a prophet as a prophet will receive a prophets reward. Those who receive a righteous person as a righteous person will receive a righteous persons reward.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu maa di puhibu saha yuuni kam.
en: Celebrate this festival at the appointed time each year.

dag: So yi buɣisi ni o yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛli a suhu ni miligi? Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu?.
en: If one tries to answer you, will you be annoyed? But who can hold words back?.

dag: Ŋun su amiliya n-nyɛ aŋgo; amaa aŋgo zo so ŋun be o sani wumd o yɛtɔɣa nyari suhupiɛlli pam di zuɣu; lala zuɣu ka n suhupiɛlli galisi pam maa.
en: The bride always belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who helps the bridegroom just waits and listens. He is happy just to hear the bridegroom talk. Thats how I feel now. I am so happy that he is here.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti nyɛla gandammoya ka nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Men of Moab, why do you claim to be heroes, brave soldiers tested in war?.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ saha shɛli yin ni nya o. Suhimiy o saha shɛli o ni miri ya.
en: Turn to the Lord ! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuma awɛi ni, gol so ŋun pahiri chir pia puuni ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛm n-teei gil li.
en: In the tenth month of the ninth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia came with his whole army and attacked Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋuna n-su teeku, dama ŋuna n-daa nam li; ŋuna n-su tiŋgbani din nyɛ o nuhi tuma la.
en: the sea, which he made, is his along with the dry ground, which his own hands formed.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisiya, di nyɛla sanʒiɛ biɛɣu din ʒiɛri gariti ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣuri zuɣu.
en: The Lord was very angry! He punished the people. The punishment came like a storm. It came like a tornado against those wicked people.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu daa dii kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni na nti kuhi bɔhi.
en: While Jesus was in the synagogue, a man was there who had an evil spirit inside him. The man shouted.

dag: A mini Judanim ni Izraɛlnim daa niŋdila daabiligu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi alikama din yi Minnɛt na mini za ni shiri ni kpam ni ti shɛli din niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ka di bi poori la na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: Judah and the land of Israel were your agents, trading the finest wheat, millet, honey, oil, and balm for your wares.

dag: O ni daa yi zahira tumd o pagɔrisigu tuma, ka yihir omaŋ fini shɛm maa daa chɛ ka n ŋmalig o sani ni suhuyiɣisili kaman n ni daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o biɛli shɛm la.
en: She let everyone see her naked body and didn't care if they knew she was a prostitute. That's why I turned my back on her, just as I had done with her older sister.

dag: Lan gbilisim tibili wum a dabili min a niriba Izraɛlnim fabila; saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋmaligi kpa kpe na ka suhir a nyin gbilisim tibili a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni n-wum ti suhigu ka chɛ ti taali.
en: And please listen to our prayers in the future when I and your people Israel turn to this place and pray to you. We know that you live in heaven. We ask you to hear our prayer there and forgive us.

dag: Tihi pum puma mɔɣu ni. Noonsi kumbu saha paaya, ka ti wumdi ŋmambihi kumsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: in the countryside the flowers are in bloom. This is the time for singing; the song of doves is heard in the fields.

dag: Dinzuɣu tuma ŋɔ fukumsi ni ʒi ti zuɣu Naawuni nambɔzɔbo puuni ŋɔ zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi gbarigira.
en: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n yɛl lala? M bi yuri ya mi zuɣu ka n yɛl lala maa? Naawuni gba mi ni n yuri ya!.
en: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira gba daa bela Ɛnɔn tin shɛli din miri Salim la m-baptaiziri niriba, dama kom daa be nimaani pam; ka niriba chani o sani ka o ti baptaiziri ba.
en: John was also baptizing people in Aenon, a place near Salim with plenty of water. People were going there to be baptized.

dag: N daa gbi kɔbilisi, ka nyu tinzun tinsi kom, ka daa siɣi Ijipti kulibɔna ni, ka n naba chɛ ka di kom zaa nyuui.
en: You boasted that you dug wells and drank water in foreign lands and that the feet of your soldiers tramped the Nile River dry.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi dimnim maani ya ansarisi yɛra, To, pumpɔŋɔ zo kura la leela ti dini.
en: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: The enemy said bad things against you. They said, Hurray! Now the ancient mountains will be ours.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, Yawɛ chu shɛli bɛ ni puhiri yuuni kam la beni, ka bɛ ni puhi li Shilo din be Bɛtɛl nuzaa polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo solɔɣu din yi Bɛtɛl kuni Shɛkɛm, ka be Lɛbɔna nudirigu polo la.
en: However, they said, the annual festival of the LORD is under way in Shiloh, which is north of Bethel, east of the main road that goes up from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Tell the people to build a chest of acacia wood centimeters long, centimeters wide, and centimeters high.

dag: ni di pindigu din daa nyɛ bɛ ni nani piɛlahi gban shɛŋa n-niŋ moonsi mɔhi li la mini di pindigu shɛli din nyɛ teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana la ni pateesa la.
en: the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain;.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi m be duu, amaa suɣili ni ka n kul be ka yi mali ma ginda.
en: I did not live in a house at the time I took the Israelites out of Egypt. No, I traveled around in a tent. I used the tent for my home.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa maa daa ti boli paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bi kuri bidibbihi maa ka chɛ ba.
en: The king of Egypt called for the nurses and asked them, Why did you do this? Why did you let the baby boys live.

dag: Ka so ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga. N ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la. N ku chɛ ka a ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, m mi ku chɛ a.
en: No one will be able to stand up against you during your lifetime. I will be with you in the same way I was with Moses. I wont desert you or leave you.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni yeei n nam nɛma ŋɔ ka taɣi nɛma ye n-chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam nɛma. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa taɣi nɛma ye, ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, Disguise yourself when you go into battle, but wear your own clothes. And I will disguise myself. The king of Israel went into battle dressed like an ordinary soldier.

dag: Dama Masia bi tim ma ni n ti baptaizi niriba, amaa o tim ma ni n ti yihila lahibal suŋ waazu, ka di mi pala baŋsim yɛtɔɣa puuni; dama di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, dindina Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yiko ni gbarigi.
en: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yawɛ daa yɛli nyini n dan Musa ni a pihim kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari Izraɛlnima. Yawɛ daa lan yɛli nyini n dana ni a zaŋm ti mabia Zɛlɔfɛhad tarili ti o bipuɣinsi.
en: and said, Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.

dag: Nashɔn daa nyɛla Salima ba, ka Salima daa nyɛ Bɔaz ba.
en: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz.

dag: Lala ka o daa yih o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ daa yiini yila.
en: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.

dag: Ka sokam daa nya o ni chani ka paɣiri Naawuni maa.
en: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti baŋ ni Naawuni daa zaŋla o nol ni yɛligu nam dunia ŋɔ; dinzuɣu Naawuni daa zaŋla ti nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa n-nam ti nina ni nyari binshɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: By faith we understand that the universe has been created by a word from God so that the visible came into existence from the invisible.

dag: Ʒiɛman shɛŋa din gari la ni, o daa chɛ ka zuliya kam doli bɛ suhu yubu.
en: In the past, he permitted every nation to go its own way.

dag: ka zaŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla n-tuɣili di zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: and burned the sweet-smelling incense, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: O ni ti zan a zaani n-tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ti a, ka a mi ti zani Naawuni zaani o sani.
en: So Aaron will speak for you. Like God, you will speak to him, and he will tell the people what you say.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Kalidianim mini Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-dee li.
en: I am going to give this city over to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army; they will capture it.

dag: Dama bɛnkam zaa tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim mini bɛnkam zaa bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bi bɔri shɛba.
en: Whats more, all who do such things, all who do business dishonestly, are detestable to the LORD your God.

dag: ni Maharai ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la ni Hɛlɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Baana Nɛtɔfa nir bia la.
en: Maharai from Netophah; Heled son of Baanah from Netophah;.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: He made the poles of acacia wood, and he covered them with gold.

dag: Hal bɛ yi ti zoori kaman momaha la, Yawɛ pɔhim ni yi wulimpuhili polo mɔɣu ni na nti ʒe nyuui bɛ kɔbilnina, ka bɛ kɔzɔrima nyuui. Ka di ʒe bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni daazichi zaa chaŋ.
en: Israel grows among his brothers, but a powerful east wind will come—the Lord s wind will blow from the desert. Then his well will dry up. His spring of water will be dry. The wind will take away anything of value.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la .
en: When they came to a place called Golgotha, which means Skull Place.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Nyama, n ni kana kaman tayiɣ la! Ŋum bi gbihiri ka mal o binyɛra zali ni o di ti chaŋ o zaɣim n-dih omaŋ vi mal alibarika.
en: Listen! I will come at a time you dont expect, like a thief. Great blessings belong to those who stay awake and keep their clothes with them. They will not have to go without clothes and be ashamed for people to see them.

dag: O wurim o suɣili la kaman ʒiɛvari puu la. O wurim o jɛmbu duu la. Yawɛ chɛ ka Ziɔnnim tam bɛ churi puhibu mini bɛ vuhim dabisa yɛla. O suhu ni yiɣisi pam zuɣu, o zaɣisila naa mini maligumaana.
en: He smashed to pieces the Temple where we worshiped him; He has put an end to holy days and Sabbaths. King and priest alike have felt the force of his anger.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du nti guhiri mɔɣu ni hal ka yi ti tim na ti yɛli ma lahibali din beni.
en: I will be waiting in the desert plains until you send word telling me what to do.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni maa zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛli n-kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ka nimaani na, bɛ ni yihi binyoya mini binshɛŋa din chihiri la zaa di ni.
en: When they return, they are to get rid of all the filthy, disgusting idols they find.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim paɣi yi naba, ka yi bahi mi lɛli yi dimnim maa ʒim.
en: so that you can wash your feet in their blood, so that your dogs tongues can lap up their share of your enemies.

dag: Nyama, ti vihi dimbɔŋɔ nya, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Wummi li, ka baŋ li amaŋmaŋa.
en: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni leei ti sariakarita, o ni woligi ti m min a. O ni lihi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka zani n nyaaŋa n-fa ma a nuu ni bahi.
en: Let the Lord be the judge. Let him decide between you and me. He will support me and show that I am right. He will save me from you.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Jɔn Baptaizira, ka shɛb yɛri ni a nyɛla Anabi Ilaija, ka shɛb mi yɛri ni a nyɛla anabinim la ni yino.
en: They answered, Some people say you are John the Baptizer. Others say you are Elijah. And others say you are one of the prophets.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ zaligu sahakam. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni maa mihi so, ŋun paɣim o binyɛra; ka ŋun mi shihi kom maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: This rule will be for you forever. And whoever sprinkled the special water must wash their clothes because they will be unclean until evening.

dag: O daa lan bo naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabil yino mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: one bull from the herd, one ram, and one year-old male lamb for an entirely burned offering.

dag: O daa lan bo bula yino so bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: one male goat for a purification offering.

dag: O daa laɣisi m biriginsim zaa n-lo li kaman naɣikɔra dapua la. O nuhi ka o daa zaŋ lo li tabili taba n-zaŋ li pa n nyiŋgoli zuɣu, ka n yaa daa naai. N Duuma daa zaŋ ma tila n ni ku tooi zabi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: My sins were tied up like a yoke. My sins were tied up in the Lords hands. His yoke is on my neck. He has made me weak. He has given me to those who I cannot stand up against.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yihi wuntizɔriba bɛ zahimbu nyabu ni, ka lan mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka tuumbiɛrinim be tibidarigibo shee guli saria karibu dali.
en: These things show that the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from their trials, and how to keep the unrighteous for punishment on the Judgment Day.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi li suɣili maa ni n-zaŋ li na ti ti Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa mini Samarianim zaa ni nya li. Amaa bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ duhimaŋtali zuɣu, bɛ ni yɛli.
en: So all the people in Ephraim, including the ruler in Samaria, learned their lesson. Those people are very proud and boastful now. They say.

dag: O ni daa karim gbaŋ maa naai ka o bɔhi ni luɣ dini ka Pool lee yina. O ni daa wum ni o yila Kilikia na.
en: After he read the letter, he asked Paul about his home province. When he learned that he was from Cilicia.

dag: Ka Pool daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛ zuɣu na, ka bɛ tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa min anabitali yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: Paul placed his hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came upon them; they spoke in strange tongues and also proclaimed God's message.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Filistianim mini Ammɔnnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: The LORD became angry with Israel and handed them over to the Philistines and the Ammonites.

dag: ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro na ti tam di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: Then he put the bread on the table before the Lord . He did this just as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: A yuri din tuhi, ka je din bi tuhi; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa piig a, ka ti a jilima pam din tiri suhupiɛlli gar o ni ti a tab shɛm la.
en: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa shiri ni niŋ pali ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba. Ti nya bɛ tiŋgbani maa ka di vuhiri pam. Di ʒin ya kpe yoli. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti deei bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: Come on, they replied, lets march up against them! Indeed, weve seen the land, and its very good. Right now youre doing nothing! Dont hold back from going and taking possession of the land.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni kpi. Yawɛ dimnim ni ŋmanila tipuma din viɛla. Bɛ ni vuui yom, bɛ ni vuui kaman nyɔhi la.
en: But the wicked will die, the LORDs enemies will disappear— disappear like the beauty of a meadow—in smoke.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di kana, di niŋya. Dabisili ŋɔ yɛla ka n daa yɛl la.
en: Look, it has come! It has happened! This is what the LORD God says. This is the day that I spoke about.

dag: Bɛ yi wum ka jɛmd o, bɛ ni mali buni ni suhudoo hal ni bɛ nyɛvili tariga.
en: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, tinim tɔɣisirila ti ni mi shɛli yɛla, ka diri ti nini ni nya shɛli shɛhira; amaa ka yi bi niŋdi ti shɛhira maa yɛda.
en: The truth is, we talk about what we know. We tell about what we have seen. But you people dont accept what we tell you.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ. Ka Itiɔpia namɔɣili so ŋun daa su Kandɛse ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia napaɣ la azichi fukumsi daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti jɛm Naawuni.
en: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship.

dag: N daa yɛli bɛ bihi tiŋgban nɛli maa ni, Miriya ka yi doli yi banim zaligunim la bee n-gbibi bɛ kaya la bee n-zaŋ bɛ buɣa la jɛmbu saɣim yimaŋa.
en: I spoke to their children and told them, Dont be like your parents. Dont make yourselves filthy with their filthy idols. Dont follow their laws or obey their commands.

dag: Daadam, sabimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yuli sɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Babilɔn naa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Mortal man, he said, write down today's date, because this is the day that the king of Babylonia is beginning the siege of Jerusalem.

dag: ka baŋ ni dilana nyɛla tɛhitilimalana ni alahichilana ŋun maŋmaŋ tuma kar o saria. Wuhibu shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: You know that such people are corrupt, and their sins prove that they are wrong.

dag: Dama bɛ birila pɔhim, bɛ ni chɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga. Bɛ chi ni saai ʒiɛya ka ku niŋ bindirigu. Ka di yi niŋ bindirigu, tinzunnima n-ni di li.
en: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nam kana, ka chɛ ka a yubu niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni ka di ni niŋdi alizanda ni shɛm la.
en: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.

dag: Yi gba lihimiya yimaŋ kaman yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: In the same way, you should see yourselves as being dead to the power of sin and alive for God through Christ Jesus.

dag: Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni la zaa daa ka Gɛdalia sanna Mizipa.
en: Johanan, Kareahs son, and all the army officers in the countryside approached Gedaliah at Mizpah.

dag: Di simdi ka firilatamdigu maa ti mali jaba ayɔbu di luɣa zuɣu; jaba ata yaɣ yini polo, jaba ata yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: Six branches shall extend from its sides, three from each side.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ti Duuma suɣilɔdibo la nyɛla din tin ya dahima ni yi tiligi kaman ti mabiyurigu Pool ni daa sab shɛm tin ya Naawuni ni ti o yɛn shɛl la puuni la.
en: Remember that we are saved because our Lord is patient. Our dear brother Paul told you that same thing when he wrote to you with the wisdom that God gave him.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ zula biŋkɔbigu maa dilan sani, dindina di simdi ni o yo o zuɣu.
en: But if the animal was stolen while in your care, you must replace it.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi dari pam duhi.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: The city of murderers is doomed! I myself will pile up the firewood.

dag: Kamiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kuɣ nɛɔŋ shɛli ninsalinim ni zaɣisi ka lih o ka o ka buchi, amaa ka Naawuni ŋun piig o ka lih o ka o mali buchi la sanna.
en: Now you are coming to him as to a living stone. Even though this stone was rejected by humans, from Gods perspective it is chosen, valuable.

dag: dama yuri maa yiko daa bela bɛ noya ni mini bɛ zuya ni. Ka bɛ zuya ŋmani tinvura ka mali zuɣuri; dina ka bɛ daa mali dimdi niriba.
en: The horses power was in their mouths and also in their tails. Their tails were like snakes that have heads to bite and hurt people.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani tariga daa nyɛla Jaza zaŋ tabili Giliad tin kara zaa ni Amɔrinim tiŋgbani pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Aroa din be Raba wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Their territory was Jazer, all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer near Rabbah.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha, ka Omri bia Ɛhab daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya ʒinila Samaria n-su Izraɛlnim la yuun pisinaayi.
en: Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel during the th year that Asa was king of Judah. Ahab ruled Israel from the town of Samaria for years.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu yi be situra ni, di yi nyɛla ago ni bee bimpiɛlli ni.
en: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina, n yi lan niŋ Filistianim zaɣ biɛɣu, di pala n taali.
en: But Samson said to him, Now I have a good reason to hurt you Philistines. No one will blame me now.

dag: Du shɛli din daa nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di dubu nyɛ mita awɛi; ka o dooi salima din nyɛ alali pa di luɣ shɛlikam zuɣu; ka daa lan zaŋ sida dari m-mali sara maligu bimbini.
en: This inner room was feet long, feet wide, and feet high, all covered with pure gold. The altar was covered with cedar panels.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi suɣili maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ zaɣ yini.
en: They made fifty bronze hooks to join the two sets, so as to form one cover.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o, o ni tu o ba bee o ma maa zuɣu, o ʒim yihibu maa taali ʒila o zuɣu.
en: If anyone curses their father or mother, they must be executed. They have cursed their own father and mother; that persons blood is on their own heads.

dag: Ka bɔ n-daa lee niŋ ka a bi zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni? N ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan ku nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: Why didn't you put my money in the bank? On my return, I could have had the money together with interest.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi binshɛli din ka daɣiri binshɛli din mali daɣiri ni na? So ku tooi.
en: Nothing clean can ever come from anything as unclean as human beings.

dag: Tiliginsim mi lan ka so sani yaha, dama Naawuni bi lan zaŋ so yuli ti ti dunia ŋɔ ni ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Salvation is to be found through him alone; in all the world there is no one else whom God has given who can save us.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o. Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: So they had a problem accepting him. But Jesus said to them, People everywhere give honor to a prophet, but in his own town or in his own home a prophet does not get any honor.

dag: Fɔnisia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Speen ŋarima din be teeku ni, kummiya ni suhugarigu! Dama Taai luya ka lan ka yili bee kulinoli. Niriba daa yila Saipurus na nti wum di yɛla.
en: This is a message about Tyre: Ships traveling from Cyprus heard this message: Cry, you ships from Tarshish ! Your harbor has been destroyed.

dag: ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Amaria ba, ka Amaria nyɛ Ahitub ba.
en: Amariah, Ahitub.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali tahima ŋɔ timiya suhupiɛlli mini suhudoo zaa yi ni niŋ yɛda zuɣu, din ni chɛ ka yi mali tahima din galisi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in faith so that you overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yi ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi viɛla. Di simdi ni yi zɔri Naawuni ka tumdi din tuhi. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ku ti zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ ti dimnim la soli ka bɛ mali ti ansarisi.
en: So I continued, What you are doing isnt good! Why dont you walk in the fear of our God? This will prevent the taunts of the nations that are our enemies!.

dag: Di daa nyɛla di daanabinim mini di maligumaaniba bɛn daa ku wuntizɔriba di puuni la daalahichi mini bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: This happened because the prophets of Jerusalem sinned. This happened because the priests of Jerusalem did evil things. They were shedding the blood of good people in the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Din daŋ tooni nyɛla n kpamdi sokam jaande ni bɛ suhimi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔri shɛli zuɣu, ka kul suhimi Naawuni din simdi ba gba zuɣu, ka timmi sandaani niŋmi Naawuni tiri niriba; ka paɣimi Naawuni sokam zaa zuɣu.
en: First of all, I ask that you pray for all people. Ask God to bless them and give them what they need. And give thanks.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be ti ni, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa.
en: Once there were seven brothers who lived here. The first one married, but died without having any children. So his wife was left to his brother.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o tizɔpaɣa, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who has sexual relations with his sister or half sister! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: N lo n suhu ni ni n ni dol a zaligunim maa sahakam.
en: More than anything I want to obey your laws always, until the end of my life.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa piligi galindi tin shɛŋa nim bɛn daa nya o daalahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa o ni daa tum bɛ tinsi ni ka bɛ bi niŋ tuuba la.
en: Then he began to scold the cities where he had done his greatest miracles because they didnt change their hearts and lives.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ yino alahichi tumbu zuɣu yi chɛ ka Naawuni nya sokam taali, lala mi n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino wuntia tuma zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka sokam yi taali ni ka nya nyɛvili.
en: So that one sin of Adam brought the punishment of death to all people. But in the same way, Christ did something so good that it makes all people right with God. And that brings them true life.

dag: O tiri biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka tiri kahiŋko bihi bindira bɛ yi ti kuhira.
en: He gives food to the animals. He feeds the young birds that cry out.

dag: Dahin shɛli o yi ti yɛn kpe luɣ kasi shee dundɔŋ ni ti tum tuma, di simdi ka o mali o daalahichi sara luɣ kasi maa shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On the day that he comes into the holy place, the inner courtyard, to minister in the holy place, he will present his purification offering. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu? A noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ŋmanila pɔhim.
en: How long will you mouth such things such that your utterances become a strong wind?.

dag: Saha shɛli ha o daa ka a buchi, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun mali buchi m min a zaa sani.
en: In the past he was useless to you. But now he has become useful for both you and me.

dag: Faranim mini nandaamba yi ti bɔri kom ka bi nya, ka kɔnyuri chɛ ka bɛ lɔna kuui, man Yawɛ ni deei bɛ suhigu. Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ku bahi ba.
en: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.

dag: O bia Shɛmaya gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim pam.
en: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi; bɛ ni ŋun daa pɔri mini tɔbbihi kɔbiga daa saɣimi, ka ŋun daa gari bɛ zaa mi mini tɔbbihi tuhili daa saɣi.
en: These men were leaders of the Gadite army. The weakest from that group was worth men, and the strongest was worth men.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu, bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu bɛ ni kpi.
en: When a righteous person stops doing good and starts doing evil and then dies, he dies because of the evil he has done.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o.
en: Judas had told them ahead of time, Arrest the man I greet with a kiss.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani miri Gibia.
en: So the Israelites started out the next morning and camped near the city of Gibeah.

dag: Ka Sool daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa, Havila zaŋ hal ti kpa Shur tin shɛli din be Ijipti wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites from Havilah all the way to Shur, which is near Egypt.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zo n-chaŋ o biŋkɔbiri sani nti gbaai naɣilabil polli ŋun viɛla n-ti o tumtumda, ka o kɔrig o mal o yomyom.
en: Then Abraham ran to his cattle. He took his best young calf and gave it to the servant there. He told the servant to quickly kill the calf and prepare it for food.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Yawɛ wuhiri ya la zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe ni biɛlifu kpe. O niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka yi lɛb lu yi kpaya zuɣu n-nya dansi, ka zana gbahi ya, ka bɛ zaŋ ya chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: So the LORDs word will be for them: tsav letsav, tsav letsav; qav leqav, qav leqav, a little of this, a little of that. So that they will go and stagger backward, they will be broken, snared, and captured.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna! Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: Bring us back, Almighty God! Show us your mercy, and we will be saved!.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ku zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara ti Yawɛ, dindina doo maa ŋun zaŋm biŋkɔbigu maa chaŋ maligumaana sani.
en: The animal you promised might be one that is not acceptable as an offering to the Lord . If you promised one of these unclean animals, you must bring it to the priest.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhirila bɔ? Di wuhirimi ni bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣili nyɛla shɛli bee buɣili maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ shɛli?.
en: So, am I saying that sacrifices to idols are the same as those Jewish sacrifices? No, because an idol is nothing, and the things offered to idols are worth nothing.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn luri Yawɛ sizuura daa tɔɣisiri tab yɛtɔɣa, ka Yawɛ gbilisi tibili wum li, ka sabi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri ŋun Yawɛ, ka tir o yuli jilima maa yɛla niŋ yɛla teebu litaafi ni o sani.
en: Then those revering the LORD, each and every one, spoke among themselves. The LORD paid attention and listened to them. Then a scroll of remembrance was written before the LORD about those revering the LORD, the ones meditating on his name.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dɔbba zaa.
en: The LORD your God will hand it over to you; you must kill all the citys males with the sword.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim maa daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni shɛm ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: The Pharisees and the experts began arguing, Jesus must think he is God! Only God can forgive sins.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti zal o niriba bɛn be o tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaɣ shɛŋa din daa be teeku polo zaŋ tabili bɛn daa be kukɔɣu polɔnim zaa ni bɛ yo farigu.
en: King Ahasuerus taxed the entire kingdom, including the islands of the Mediterranean.

dag: Dama Mani Naawuni m-mɔŋ o yɛm, ka mɔŋ o baŋsim.
en: It was I who made her foolish and did not give her wisdom.

dag: Zaŋm a nuhi shih o, ka tɛhi a min o ni yɛn va shɛm, a ku lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: If you ever lay a hand on Leviathan, you will never do it again! Just think about the battle that would be!.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama yiɣi n ninni. Bɛ ni daa yiɣi maa, ka kalima maa doli ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: While I watched, the winged creatures raised their wings and rose from the ground to leave, with their wheels beside them. They stopped at the entrance to the east gate of the temple, and the glory of Israels God was up above them.

dag: ka zo n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim niŋ amaŋkanim ni ʒiri chani bɛ ni daa wum ni o be luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: So they ran throughout the whole region; and wherever they heard he was, they brought to him the sick lying on their mats.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Tɛman n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Bɔzira la.
en: So I will send fire upon the city of Teman and burn down the fortresses of Bozrah.

dag: Mɔri shiri kuura, ka tipum kpahiri lura, amaa ti Naawuni maa ŋun yɛligu kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Yes, grass withers and flowers fade, but the word of our God endures forever.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, A tiŋgbani ku vuhira, ka maligim mi ku lur a tiŋgban ni.
en: His father Isaac responded and said to him, Now, you will make a home far away from the olive groves of the earth, far away from the showers of the sky above.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima n-fa nam maa ti ŋun Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: When Rehoboam arrived at Jerusalem, he assembled the whole house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin—one hundred eighty thousand select warriors—to fight against the house of Israel and restore the kingdom for Rehoboam, Solomons son.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kabiri kpɛri fɔntinsi ni, ka duri goma, ka duri kpɛri yiya puuni ka duri kpɛri takɔriti ni kaman tayiɣisi la.
en: They rush upon the city; they run upon the walls. They climb into the houses; they enter through the windows like thieves.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Aai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, n na ʒi n-saɣim mmaŋa. M bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi ŋ-ŋubi biŋkɔb kpiŋ bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku biŋkɔb so. Ka nimdi din pooi mi na ʒi n-lu n noli ni.
en: And I said: Ah, LORD God! Ive never been unclean! From my childhood until now Ive never eaten anything that wasnt properly slaughtered, and no unclean meat has ever entered my mouth.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri karimbaani puuni bɛ niŋdi nandaamba alaka. Chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The wicked are proud and make evil plans to hurt the poor, who are caught in their traps and made to suffer.

dag: Ka yi ni so yɛl o ni o cham ni suhudoo; ka lan yɛl o ni Naawuni ni chɛ ka o nya n-ye ka di n-tiɣi, amaa ka bi ti o binshɛl din simd o niŋgbuŋ, di buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: What good is there in your saying to them, God bless you! Keep warm and eat well!—if you don't give them the necessities of life?.

dag: So ni tooi fa tɔbbihi ni tuhi tɔbu di binshɛŋa bɛ sani bee n-fa daba na biɛɣu nuu ni?.
en: Can loot be taken from warriors? Can a tyrants captives escape?.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛlana bee m-be kaman Iso ŋun baɣa daa ka Naawuni yɛla ni ka zaŋ o kpamdi taɣi saɣiŋmani yin la.
en: Be careful that no one commits sexual sin. And be careful that no one is like Esau and never thinks about God. As the oldest son, Esau would have inherited everything from his father. But he sold all that for a single meal.

dag: Bɛ niŋdi yomyom chani ni bɛ ti ku niriba.
en: Their feet are quick to shed blood; .

dag: Doliya duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama so shɛli din kuni bahi yoli shee dolibu be asama ka di dunoli yɛlima, ka niriba pam dol li.
en: Go in through the narrow gate. The gate that leads to destruction is broad and the road wide, so many people enter through it.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. He said to those who were with him, The truth is, this man has more faith than anyone I have found, even in Israel.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili n-wumm o yɛligu ka di zaɣisiy o noli, dama yi yi birigi, o ku chɛ yi taali, dama n yuli be o ni.
en: Obey the angel and follow him. Be careful in his presence, and dont rebel against him. The angel will not forgive the wrong things you do to him. He has my power in him.

dag: Ka bɛ noya daa wol taba, ka Pool tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ka bɛ naanyi wurim. Pool daa yɛli ba mi, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia yɛli ti yaannim shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Anabi Aizaia daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya.
en: They had an argument among themselves and were ready to leave. But Paul said one more thing to them: The Holy Spirit spoke the truth to your fathers through Isaiah the prophet. He said.

dag: Hal putɔɣulaannim yi kul zoori kaman mɔri la, ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul tɔŋda, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: the wicked may grow like weeds, those who do wrong may prosper; yet they will be totally destroyed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Jɛrɔbɔam daa na kul bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o daalahichi tumbu soli maa, amaa ka na kul lihirila niriba maa zaa ni m-piiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni saɣi n-leei buɣa tindaannima.
en: Even after this happened, Jeroboam didnt change his evil ways. Instead, he continued to appoint all sorts of people as priests of the shrines. Anyone who wanted to be a priest Jeroboam made a priest for the shrines.

dag: Maika daa malila binnana jɛmbu duu; ka daa she mukuru laasabu din nyɛ bɛ ni daa lihiri shɛli ni buɣiri baɣa niŋ di ni, ka daa zaŋ o bidib yino leeg o maligumaana.
en: He had a shrine for worshiping God there at his home, and he had made some idols and a sacred priestly vest. Micah chose one of his own sons to be the priest for his shrine.

dag: Leeban daa malila bipuɣins ayi; ŋun daa nyɛ kpɛm yuli n-daa booni Liya, ka biasani mi yuli daa booni Reechɛl.
en: Now Laban had two daughters: the older was named Leah and the younger Rachel.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kuli m ba sani ti yɛl o, A bia Yisifu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana, dinzuɣu niŋmi yomyom yiɣisi kuli n sanna.
en: Now hurry back and tell my father that his son Joseph says, God has made me ruler of Egypt. Come here as quickly as you can.
