dag: Ka n ni ti yɛli ni n suhu zaa, Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee beni ŋ-ŋman a? Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fari bɛn ka yaa kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun fari nandaamba bɛn nahindi ba nuu ni bahira.
en: With all my heart I will say to the Lord , There is no one like you. You protect the weak from the strong, the poor from the oppressor.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: When Lamech was years old, he became the father of a son.

dag: Kaman kom ni chɛ ka nir nyar o ninni shɛm la, lala ka ninsal suhu nyari di kpee.
en: As water reflects the face, so the heart reflects one person to another.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa yɛla garila wulinluhili polɔnima, ka dabiɛm gbahi wulimpuhili polɔnima.
en: People in the west will be shocked at what happened to them. People in the east will be numb with fear.

dag: ka daa lee yɛli, Ti di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu maa zuɣu.
en: But they agreed that it shouldnt happen during the festival; otherwise, there would be an uproar among the people.

dag: Ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi lihi bɛ luɣa zuɣu, ka bi lan nya so naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: Suddenly, looking around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ daa be alizanda ni ka tahi bahina, ka bɛ daa wum Zallakudura Naa kukoli.
en: The Lord thundered from the sky. God Most High let his voice be heard.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di kari Ayuba saria hal ti naai, dama o garigibu maa ŋmanila ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni garigiri yɛtɔɣa shɛm.
en: I wish Job would be tested to the limit because he responds like evil people.

dag: A zaŋ a ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi niŋ bɛ nuu ni:.
en: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti lan kana ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Then another day came for the angels to meet with the Lord . Satan joined them for this meeting with the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi takɔro maa ni ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee be m polo? Ka m ba namɔɣilis ayi bee ata ŋmaligi lih o na.
en: He looked up toward the window and asked, Is anyone up there on my side? A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti gari, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsi ma Mariama ni Salomi daa da tulaale viɛlli ni bɛ chaŋ siliga maa ni ti mihi Yisa.
en: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they could go and anoint Jesus dead body.

dag: N wum Naawuni ni yɛli siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni ŋun Naawuni n-su yiko.
en: More than once I have heard God say that power belongs to him.

dag: Ka ŋun Yaakubu maŋmaŋ daa daŋ bɛ tooni n-chaŋ ti damdi tiŋ napɔŋ buyopɔin hal ti mir o biɛli maa tooni.
en: Jacob himself went out before them. While he was walking toward his brother Esau, he bowed down to the ground seven times.

dag: Chɛ ka a maligumaaniba zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kpɛhi bɛ kɔbili ni, ka chɛ ka a niriba bɛn ʒe a yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: May your priests do always what is right; may your people shout for joy!.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba zaa kalinli pirigibu buta puuni ʒii buyi kpi.
en: Throughout all the land, says the LORD, two-thirds will be cut off and die; but one-third will be left in it.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yiri tiŋ maa tariga, ka Samuɛl yɛli Sool, Yɛlim a tumtumda maa ni o cham ti tooni, o yi chaŋ naai nyin zanim kpe biɛla, ka n yɛl a Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Saul, his servant, and Samuel were walking together near the edge of town. Samuel said to Saul, Tell your servant to go on ahead of us. I have a message for you from God. So the servant walked ahead of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka m pun piligi kuri ya ni m bahi ya yoli yi daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: So I have already begun your ruin and destruction because of your sins.

dag: Karimbaannim maani ma la ansarisi ka di ka yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka m bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ a zaligu maa dolibu.
en: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam, ka o binnamda zaa kul ni paɣir o sahakam.
en: My mouth will proclaim the LORDs praise, and every living thing will bless Gods holy name forever and always.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nyɛnya jɛra, amaa bomiya baŋ ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.

dag: N lan nya binshɛli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam dunia ŋɔ ni. Niriba bɔri nyari liɣiri m-mal li sɔŋda, ka di mali ba barina.
en: I have seen a sickening tragedy under the sun: people hoard their wealth to their own detriment.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni kari zuliya shɛb zaa bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ bahi, ka yi ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya tinsi su.
en: Then he will drive out all those nations as you advance, and you will occupy the land belonging to nations greater and more powerful than you.

dag: Ka anab maa daa bo tani n-lo o nini n-taɣ o biɛhigu ŋ-ŋmaligi yi sol ni ti ʒiɛya guhiri naa.
en: The prophet bandaged his face with a cloth, to disguise himself, and went and stood by the road, waiting for the king of Israel to pass.

dag: Naawuni, a daa chɛ ka saa mi pam luɣilikam; a chɛ ka a tiŋgbani din gbarigi la neei.
en: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.

dag: Teemiya saha shɛli din gari la ha, yi ni daa bɔhim baŋ Naawuni yɛla la nyaaŋa, yi daa niŋ ania di wahala bina pam ni, amaa yi mɔbu puuni di daa bi nyaŋ ya.
en: Remember the days when you first learned the truth. You had a hard struggle with much suffering, but you continued strong.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu yuŋ. Nyini ka n suhu zaa kul bɔra. Dama a yi kari dunia mini niriba bɛn be di ni saria, di chɛmi ka bɛ baŋdi din tuhi.
en: At night my soul longs to be with you, and the spirit in me wants to be with you at the dawn of every new day. When your way of justice comes to the world, people will learn the right way of living.

dag: Di saha piɛri ni ti ŋubiri mɔri nimaani kaman bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka piɛbihi mini bubihi ti ŋubiri mɔri dabari maa ni.
en: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu, Fom a noli ka wara.
en: Jesus, his voice full of warning, said, Be quiet, and come out of him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dikili, ka di barilim nyɛ mita ata. Ka du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣa zuɣu gil la zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi.
en: The man measured the wall of the temple, and it was three meters thick. Storage rooms two meters wide were built against the outside of the wall.

dag: Amaa ka Hanna yɛl o, N dana, Aai, n nyɛla paɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni pam. M bi nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ, amaa n zaŋdila n suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira zaa wuhiri Yawɛ.
en: No, I'm not drunk, sir, she answered. I haven't been drinking! I am desperate, and I have been praying, pouring out my troubles to the Lord .

dag: Ka Asa daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried in the City of David, his ancestor. Then Asas son Jehoshaphat became the new king after him.

dag: Adam zuliya yuya n-sab kpe ŋɔ. Naawuni ni daa nam ninsala, o daa nam o ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa.
en: This is the record of Adams descendants. On the day God created humanity, he made them to resemble God.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri bee n-tu so labisi, amaa lee niŋmiyala alibarika niŋmi bɛn niŋdi ya zaɣ biɛɣu ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya ni di chɛ ka yi tooi nya o daalibarika.
en: Dont do wrong to anyone to pay them back for doing wrong to you. Or dont insult anyone to pay them back for insulting you. But ask God to bless them. Do this because you yourselves were chosen to receive a blessing.

dag: Ti ni lo kpara du Yawɛ ninni n-chaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti yɛn su li maa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli ŋɔ na.
en: Under his command we will cross into the land of Canaan and go into battle, so that we can retain our property here east of the Jordan.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka shihir bɔ ka a yɛn wuhi ka ti nya ka niŋ a yɛda? Alahiziba tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda?.
en: They asked, What miraculous sign will you do, that we can see and believe you? What will you do?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kahi kuɣa m-pa Akan zuɣu hal ti duhi li sɔŋ, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Akɔr Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa naanyi maai.
en: They put a huge pile of stones over him, which is there to this day. That is why that place is still called Trouble Valley. Then the Lord was no longer furious.

dag: Ka o kpee maa garigi yɛl o, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Jɔash bia Gidiɔn ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nir la takɔbi. Naawuni pun zaŋ Midiannim mini bɛ tɔbbihi ŋɔ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The other soldier answered, Your dream must have been about Gideon, the Israelite commander. It means God will let him and his army defeat the Midianite army and everyone else in our camp.

dag: Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and has no children, his brother should marry the widow. Their first son would then be thought of as the son of the dead brother.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, yinim Ibrahimma zuliya mini yinim bɛn pa ti zuliya ka be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri Naawuni, tinim ka Naawuni daa tahi tiliginsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ na ti ti.
en: Now listen, you descendants of Abraham! Pay attention, all of you Gentiles who are here to worship God! Listen to this message about how to be saved, because it is for everyone.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka o daa teeg o daalikauli la yɛla, ka daa taɣi o tɛha o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: You kept your agreement and were so merciful.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a saɣimya teeku puuni, kɔbulli ni. Ka a min a daguya ni a tumtumdiba zaa laɣim shim.
en: Now you are shattered by the seas; your cargoes, as well as everyone in your company, are sunk into the waters depths.

dag: Bɛ daa lan malila ninsal nuhi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔŋni bɛ luɣa anahinahi zuɣu. Bɛba anahi maa ninani mini bɛ kpiŋkpama maa ni daa be shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.

dag: ka so ku baŋ ni a lɔri noli naɣila a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: Then you wont look like you are fasting to people, but only to your Father who is present in that secret place. Your Father who sees in secret will reward you.

dag: A kul malila shɛhira pala jɛndiri ma, ka a suhuyiɣisili kul pahiri zaŋ chaŋ m polo; ka a kul zaŋdi tɔbbi pala liriti ma.
en: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.

dag: Ka bɛ daa she Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛri maa kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka duɣi sara maligu kasi biŋkɔbiri nimdi mi duɣuri ni mini ankɔraŋmahi ni ni taha ni n-zaŋ li yomyom ti tari niriba maa zaa.
en: They sacrificed the Passover animals on the altar and boiled the meat for the other offerings in pots, kettles, and pans. Then they quickly handed the meat to the people so they could eat it.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-daa zaŋ a ba Nɛbukadnɛza leei na titali, ka ti o di viɛlim mini di tibiginsim ni di jilima.
en: Listen, Your Majesty: The Most High God gave kingship, power, glory, and majesty to your father Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔhi Ilaisha, N daa yɛli nyini n dana ni a tim ma bia? N daa pun bi yɛl a ni a di yɔhim ma.
en: She said, Did I ask you for a son, sir? Didnt I say, Dont raise my hopes.

dag: Ka maligumaana so ŋun ti zaŋ li mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa ni ti ŋub li. O ti ŋubim li luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: The priest who offers it as a purification offering will eat it. It must be eaten in a holy place, in the meeting tents courtyard.

dag: ka ba bɛ nanim bandi, ka zaŋ zoligɔnim lo bɛ nabihi.
en: to bind their kings in chains, their leaders in chains of iron;.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa tiligi ya nimaani; dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ maa.
en: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.

dag: ka zaŋ di mini di nɛma zaa pɔbi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni, ka zaŋ li tam amaŋka dapuhi zuɣu.
en: Then wrap everything in fine leather. Then they must put all these things on poles used for carrying them.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb yihiri Masia yɛla waazu la nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zuɣu, amaa ka shɛb mi yihiri li la dalir suŋ zuɣu.
en: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.

dag: dama anabitali yɛtɔɣa daa bi yirila ninsal suhu yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi n-daa be ninsalinim ni n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa yir o sanna maa.
en: because no prophecy ever came by human will. Instead, men and women led by the Holy Spirit spoke from God.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yɛli doo maa ni yi mali tizo m-bo suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Jacob said, Why did you cause me so much trouble by telling the man that you had another brother.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabi shɛb mini laasabuniŋdib shɛb bɛn be yi san la yɔhim ya. Di gbilisiya tibili wumdi bɛ ni zahindi zahin shɛŋa la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says, Dont let your prophets and those who practice magic fool you. Dont listen to the dreams they have.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, Bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili ma yurilim puuni, n ni fa ba bahi. Bɛn mi n yuli, n ni guli ba.
en: The Lord says, If someone trusts me, I will save them. I will protect my followers who call to me for help.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun doli wuntitali soli o tuma zaa ni, ka zɔri nambɔɣu o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa ni.
en: Our Lord , everything you do is kind and thoughtful.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim lan ka bidibisi? Bɛ lan ka falidiriba? Bɔzuɣu ka Milikom niriba kari Gaad zuliya ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni.
en: This message is about the Ammonites. This is what the Lord says: Ammonites, do you think that the people of Israel dont have children? Do you think there are no children to take the land when the parents die? Maybe that is why Milcom took Gads land.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, n ni chɛ ka poloya yina yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: If you refuse, I will punish your country by covering it with frogs.

dag: Bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o ninni nyaɣisiri kaman wuntaŋ la, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: While these followers watched him, Jesus was changed. His face became bright like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa bahi yoli, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila kol pala ni.
en: No one pours new wine into old leather wineskins; otherwise, the wine would burst the wineskins and the wine would be lost and the wineskins destroyed. But new wine is for new wineskins.

dag: ni Shimiɔn ni Bɛnjamin ni Maluk ni Shɛmaria.
en: Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, a mi ni bihi ŋɔ ka yaa, ka biŋkɔb bihi bɛn mɔɣiri be biŋkɔbiri maa ni, ka di simdi ni n chɛ ka n zaɣa be bɛ ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti yi taɣi ba chaŋ pam dahin yini, bɛ zaa ni kpi.
en: Jacob answered, You know that the children are weak, and I must think of the sheep and livestock with their young. If they are driven hard for even one day, the whole herd will die.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a mɔgɔr nɛma min a tɔbu ni a lɔɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti ku mɔɣu ni valiga na.
en: So now, take your hunting gear, your bow and quiver of arrows, go out to the field, and hunt game for me.

dag: N kul zaŋ n nina kpala Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-ni yihi n naba zana ni.
en: I look to the Lord for help at all times, and he rescues me from danger.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Jeemsi maa mabia la pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko.
en: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.

dag: Ka Jɛsi lan chɛ ka Shamma kana ti gari, ka o lan yɛli, Yawɛ bi pii ŋumbɔŋɔ gba.
en: Next, Jesse sent his son Shammah to him, and Samuel said, The Lord hasn't chosen him either.

dag: Saha shɛli Sulemaana ni daa ti kurigi, o paɣiba maa daa shiri ŋmalig o suhu n-labisi buɣa jɛmbu polo; ka o daa bi lan doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ o suhu ni ni yɛlimaŋli kaman o ba Dauda la.
en: and by the time he was old they had led him into the worship of foreign gods. He was not faithful to the Lord his God, as his father David had been.

dag: Hal a ni kul yɛn nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di do katiŋ maa zaa yoli, a ku kpe n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri Izraɛlnim maa ni.
en: You will look at the land from a distance, but you will not enter the land that I am giving the people of Israel.

dag: n-yɛli, Man Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni bi mɔŋ ma a bigaŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni ŋmaligi po mmaŋa.
en: I make a vow by my own name—the Lord is speaking—that I will richly bless you. Because you did this and did not keep back your only son from me.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa yɛli ba, So na ʒi n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman doo maa.
en: The guards answered, No one has ever spoken the way he does.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti zaŋ n niriba maa chaŋ n ni daa wuh a luɣ shɛli maa. Nyama, m malaika ni be a tooni. Amaa bɛ tibidarigibo biɛɣu yi ti neei, n ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli din wuhiri din be ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni: Di gbinni nyɛla ni pina mini biŋkɔbiri sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi maani maligu nyɛla din ku tooi chɛ ka ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni suhu ni tɛha niŋ dɛde.
en: This is a symbol which points to the present time. It means that the offerings and animal sacrifices presented to God cannot make the worshiper's heart perfect.

dag: Di saha ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mi ni bɛ paɣiba maanila buɣa mini paɣiba bɛn zaa daa ʒe nimaani, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Patrɔs Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa garigi yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: There were many people from Judah living in southern Egypt. Many of the women from Judah were meeting together in a large group and making sacrifices to other gods, and their husbands knew what they were doing. Those men said to Jeremiah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa kuli Rama, ka Sool gba kul o ya Gibia.
en: Samuel went home to Ramah, and Saul returned to his home in Gibeah.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Saimɔn, o daa warila bukpahigu ka wuhir omaŋa ni o nyɛla wɔɣirili, ka o yɛla daa mali Samarianim alahiziba pam.
en: Before Philips arrival, a certain man named Simon had practiced sorcery in that city and baffled the people of Samaria. He claimed to be a great person.

dag: Naawuni pin gahindi shɛl o ni daa ti ma o yiko puuni la zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ma leei lahibal suŋ la tumtumda.
en: By Gods special gift of grace, I became a servant to tell that Good News. He gave me that grace by using his power.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sidɔn, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni nya jilima a ni. N yi kar a saria a ni, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira a ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Say, This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Sidon! Your people will learn to respect me. I will punish Sidon. Then people will know that I am the Lord . Then they will learn that I am holy, and they will treat me that way.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, ka anabi Neetan mi kpɛna.
en: While Bathsheba was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came to see him.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa daa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa yɛli ba shɛm la, Labimiyana dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali.
en: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to King Rehoboam, as he had instructed them.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli. O gbaar omaŋa o sujee puuni waawaayili, ka bi chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili dii chani tooni.
en: But God, being compassionate, kept forgiving their sins, kept avoiding destruction; he took back his anger so many times, wouldnt stir up all his wrath!.

dag: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab daa zal o zuliya ni bɛ di nyu wain, ka bɛ na ʒi n-nyu wain hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dama bɛ dolila bɛ yabidoo ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛli. Amaa mmaŋmaŋ kul tɔɣisiri ya la yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka yi bi deeri n noli.
en: Jonadab, Rechabs son, commanded his descendants not to drink wine, and to this very day they have not drunk wine, obeying their ancestors instruction. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you havent listened to me.

dag: Naa, baŋmi ni bɛ yi me tiŋ la mini di goma maa naai, bɛ ku lan yo farigu balibu kam ti a, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka a nam farigu liɣiri filim.
en: Your Majesty, if this city is rebuilt and its walls are completed, the people will stop paying taxes, and your royal revenues will decrease.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yɛri Yisifu lala dabisili kam maa zaa yoli, Yisifu daa bi saɣi ni o min o dɔni.
en: She kept begging Joseph day after day, but he refused to do what she wanted or even to go near her.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛhab min o daŋ zaa polo la shɛli ku yiɣisi. Yawɛ niŋmi kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija yɛli shɛm la.
en: You should know that everything the Lord says will happen. The Lord used Elijah to say these things about Ahabs family. Now the Lord has done what he said he would do.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa yi nti mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: But they left and spread the news about Jesus all around that area.

dag: Shia maa daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛ gba chanimi, ka kalima maa gba wuɣi du n-doli ba. Dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela kalima maa ni.
en: Wherever the wind would appear to go, the wind would make them go there too. The wheels rose up beside them, because the spirit of the creatures was in the wheels.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka zaŋ li yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta, ka o mi yɛli Naa Ahasivɛrɔs Mɔdɛkai ni wum shɛm ka yɛl o.
en: But Mordecai learned about these plans and told Queen Esther. Then she told the king. She also told him that Mordecai was the one who had learned about the evil plan.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o doli yuri dunoli polo nti kpe nayili n-ku o nimaani.
en: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma ni n yɛl a ni o ni niŋ a shɛm la ka o niŋ a maa, dama o darigi deei nam maa a nuu ni n-zaŋ ti Dauda ŋun nyɛ a kpee la.
en: I've already told you: The Lord has sworn to take the kingdom from you and give it to David. And that's just what he's doing!.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Naawuni ka bɔhi, Naawuni ni tooi ti ti bindirigu tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni?.
en: They spoke against God! Can God set a dinner table in the wilderness? they asked.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam Naa ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ku lu a sizuura? Dama lala n-simd a. Zuliya kam yɛnnim mini bɛ nanim zaa so m-bi ŋman a.
en: Everyone should respect you, King of all the nations. You deserve their respect. There are many wise men among the nations, but not one of them is as wise as you.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni mali yiko wuhiri shihir shɛŋa tuuli biŋkɔbigu la tooni maa n-yɔhindi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni; ka zali niriba ni bɛ malimi binnani ŋ-ŋmahindi biŋkɔb so ŋun daa mali takɔb daŋa ka tib kpaŋ la.
en: It deceives those who live on earth by the signs that it was allowed to do in the presence of the beast. It told those who live on earth to make an image for the beast who had been wounded by the sword and yet came to life again.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ni daa chaŋ ni o ti di ka nyu saha shɛli maa, ka Ilaija daa du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti kurim n-zaŋ o nini kpa o duna;.
en: So King Ahab went to eat. At the same time Elijah climbed to the top of Mount Carmel. At the top of the mountain, Elijah bent down. He put his head between his knees.

dag: Ka ti daa bo n-nya Yisa nyaandoliba n-kpalim nimaani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin. Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛli Pool Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni o di chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: We found the disciples there and stayed with them for a week. Compelled by the Spirit, they kept telling Paul not to go to Jerusalem.

dag: Naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin bɛn daa yina n-kul gaŋsigaŋsi la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din daa nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛl la gba gbinni nyɛla kum lubu yuma ayopɔin.
en: And the seven thin, sick-looking cows and the seven thin heads of grain mean that there will be seven years of hunger in this area. These seven bad years will come after the seven good years.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ni o tiligi ti ti tuumbiɛri zaa ni ka mali ti ka ti be kasi, ka zaŋ ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba bɛn suhuri ye tuun suma tumbu zuɣu.
en: He gave himself for us in order to rescue us from every kind of lawless behavior, and cleanse a special people for himself who are eager to do good actions.

dag: Mabihi yi laɣim be ka mali naŋgban yini, di viɛli ka nyaɣisi pam!.
en: How wonderful it is, how pleasant, for God's people to live together in harmony!.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti zaɣisi zuɣulaannim maa noli; ka kul jɛmdila wuna. Di daa bi yuui ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ yaannim bɛn daa doli Yawɛ zaligunim ni daa doli so shɛl la, ka shiri bi dol li.
en: But the Israelites paid no attention to their leaders. Israel was unfaithful to the Lord and worshiped other gods. Their fathers had obeyed the Lord 's commands, but this new generation soon stopped doing so.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-chɛ ka bɛ mi bɛ ni chani luɣ shɛli, amaa jɛra bɛn jɛrilim kpɛhiri ba la yɔɣu.
en: Wisdom lets smart people know what they are doing, but stupid people only think they know.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi. A baɣiri ni ka n yɛn sɔɣi hal ka din tahiri saɣiŋgu ŋɔ na ti gari.
en: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ di zaa niŋ piɛ yin ni n-zaŋ di mini naɣilaa maa mini piɛlah ayi maa na.
en: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu maa n-wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: So in this way Moses gave the people of Israel the regulations for observing the religious festivals to honor the Lord .

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu.
en: this is my blood, which seals God's covenant, my blood poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mi daa bo oniɣisi kuɣa mini kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie tab binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyolɔrigu la zuɣu na.
en: The leaders brought carnelians and other jewels to be set in the ephod and the breastpiece.

dag: N ni bahi nyu bara. Di naɣ kala buchi, amaa n na kul ni tɔɣisi ʒiinim mini kahigibunim shɛŋa ti Duuma ni daa zaŋ ti ma la yɛla.
en: I have to boast, even though it doesn't do any good. But I will now talk about visions and revelations given me by the Lord.

dag: Gɛrishomnim mi, bɛ daa zaŋla Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti ba. Bɛ daa zaŋla Golan din be Bashan la mini Ashitarɔt ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti tim Judas mini Silas ni bɛ ti yɛli ya ti ni sab yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ bɛmaŋmaŋ nol ni pahi.
en: We are also sending Judas and Silas, who will tell you in person the same things that we are writing.

dag: N Naawuni maa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o ni ka n sanna; n Naawuni maa ni chɛ ka n nyaŋ n dimnima.
en: My God loves me and will come to me; he will let me see my enemies defeated.

dag: Nyin Lɛbanɔn nira ŋun me a yili zali sida tihi sunsuuni ŋɔ, biɛrim yi ti paag a, a ni ŋuhi pam kaman paɣa ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la.
en: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni, dama ŋun sani bɛ zaa kul bemi.
en: So the Lord isn't the God of the dead, but of the living. This means that everyone is alive as far as God is concerned.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ. Ka o daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ kurigu pinaayi saha ni kurig ata saha ti nya shɛba n-lan yɛli bɛ gba lala.
en: So they went to work in the vineyard. The man went out again about twelve oclock and again at three oclock. Both times he hired some others to work in his vineyard.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhu daa na kul bi maai. O suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi Judanim zuɣu Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam la zuɣu.
en: But the Lord 's fierce anger had been aroused against Judah by what King Manasseh had done, and even now it did not die down.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi nyɛla n ni dihiri m piɛ shɛba, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.

dag: dama ti nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ yaɣa.
en: for we are members of his body.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa daa nyɛla ti gula hal ka Masia ti kana ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: I mean the law was the guardian in charge of us until Christ came. After he came, we could be made right with God through faith.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinahi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zibia, o daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba nira.
en: Jehoash was years old when he became king, and he ruled for forty years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Zibiah; she was from Beer-sheba.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka kum dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: My heart is pounding inside me. I am afraid to die.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa mali yaa mini suhukpeeni, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin ni kɔbiga.
en: from Simeon, mighty warriors, .

dag: Jɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o tuhi nintɔri bahi tiŋa n-niŋ taŋkpaɣu garigari di ni n-zaŋ ʒe zom maa nina;.
en: After Jesus said this, he spit on the dirt, made some mud and put it on the mans eyes.

dag: Naawuni nyari jilima o ni sɔɣiri yɛla zuɣu; amaa nanim bɛn nyari jilima la bɛ ni vihiri yɛla n-yihiri li palo ni zuɣu.
en: We honor God for what he conceals; we honor kings for what they explain.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim bɛn daa be o sani maa na nti piripiri ba, ka niriba tuhili kam bee niriba kɔbiga kam mali di sapashin kpɛma.
en: King David brought all his men together, divided them into units of a thousand and of a hundred, and placed officers in command of them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be kasi sani, binshɛɣukam nyɛla din be kasi; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu bi be kasi ka nyɛ bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, binshɛli kani n-nyɛ din be kasi, dama bɛ suhuri ni tɛha malila daɣiri.
en: Everything is clean to those who are clean, but nothing is clean to those who are corrupt and without faith. Instead, their mind and conscience are corrupted.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ninkura maa yɛligu maa wumbu, ka dolila o bipalitab bɛn min o laɣim zooi ka bɛ be o san la yɛligu.
en: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.

dag: dama m mi ni di ku lan yuui ka n kani kaman ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni kahigi wuhi ma shɛm.
en: After all, our Lord Jesus Christ has shown me that I am about to depart from this life.

dag: Ti ni mali dunia ŋɔ ni doo la kɔtomsi shɛm, lala ka ti ni ti mali do so ŋun yi alizanda ni na la gba kɔtomsi.
en: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.

dag: N yi daa niŋ kpibiga zaɣ biɛɣu, n ni mali nyaanzaaniba dunɔdali gbini zuɣu.
en: If I have ever cheated an orphan, knowing I could win in court.

dag: amaa yi ni kpi kaman sal kam ni kpiri shɛm; ka yi nyɛviya zani tariga kaman naa kam la.
en: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.

dag: Ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun kpuɣ a nɛma, nyin di lan bɔh o di yɛla.
en: Give to everyone who asks you for something, and when someone takes what is yours, do not ask for it back.

dag: m-pahi o yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma tinim bɛn niŋ yɛda ŋɔ ni ni galisi shɛm la. Yiko shɛli din be ti ni ŋɔ mini Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko shɛli.
en: And you will know that Gods power is very great for us who believe. It is the same as the mighty power.

dag: Naawuni, hal n yi ti kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi, nyin di chɛ ma bahi! Be n sani hal ka n ti zaŋ a yiko min a kpiɔŋ yɛla moli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim zaa sani.
en: So, even in my old age with gray hair, dont abandon me, God! Not until I tell generations about your mighty arm, tell all who are yet to come about your strength.

dag: O yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn chɛ saria karibu din bi doli zaligu soli mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyaaŋa zanibu?.
en: How long will you judge unjustly by granting favor to the wicked? Selah.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa nudirigu polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi nudirigu polo maa, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Nɛgɛb nyɔŋ.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, turn toward the south and warn the forests.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n zaŋ n ni daa zaŋ n takɔb mini n tɔbu tuhi Amɔrinim ka fa bɛ tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ Shɛkɛm la ti a, ka a mabihi la nuu ka di ni.
en: Meanwhile, I'm giving you the hillside I captured from the Amorites.

dag: Bɛ yi ti gbahi tinvura bee n-nyu binshɛli din nyɛ lɔɣu, di ku niŋ ba shɛli; ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa barinim zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: They will pick up snakes with their hands. If they drink anything poisonous, it will not hurt them. They will place their hands on the sick, and they will get well.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara, n ni ti chɛ ka o di nyɛvili ti shɛli din be Naawuni yil la wala.
en: If you can hear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. I will allow those who emerge victorious to eat from the tree of life, which is in Gods paradise.

dag: Daadam, ŋah bɔ ka yi leei ŋahira zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo din yɛra, Dabisa maa yuuya, ka ʒii kam kpalim yoli.
en: Son of man, why do people quote this saying about the land of Israel: Trouble will not come soon; what is seen in visions will not come?.

dag: Di saha ka n daa moli molo Ahava Mɔɣili duli ni ti siɣisi timaŋ ti Naawuni sani, ka suh o ni o tim ti mini ti bihi ni ti ni su shɛlikam zaa napɔŋ suŋ ti chandi ni.
en: There by the Ahava Canal I gave orders for us all to fast and humble ourselves before our God and to ask him to lead us on our journey and protect us and our children and all our possessions.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa suhi ti Naawuni maa, ka bo niriba zali gu ba wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: But we prayed to our God. And we put guards on the walls to watch day and night so that we could be ready to meet them.

dag: Ka Musa daa kana ti yɛli niriba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm min o ni zali shɛm zaa, ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li.
en: Moses went and told the people all the Lord 's commands and all the ordinances, and all the people answered together, We will do everything that the Lord has said.

dag: Kokpɛɣu, yom vuri kaman nuhi kpahibu vuri la. Kunkuna, laɣimmiya yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ tooni.
en: Clap your hands, you rivers; you hills, sing together with joy before the Lord .

dag: Ŋuni n-na mi n-zaŋ o nuu tooi teeku kom m-buɣisi di ni nyɛ shɛm bee n-zaŋ o nutali buɣisi sagbana yɛliŋ, bee n-va tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu niŋ bini puuni, bee n-zaŋ zoya mini kuŋkuna pa sania zuɣu buɣisi li?.
en: Who has measured the waters in the palm of a hand or gauged the heavens with a ruler or scooped the earths dust up in a measuring cup or weighed the mountains on a scale and the hills in a balance?.

dag: Juda Naa Manaasa ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa, hal ka tum tuumbiɛri gari Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka chɛ ka Judanim jɛm o buɣa n-tum alahichi la zuɣu.
en: King Manasseh has done these disgusting things, things far worse than what the Canaanites did; and with his idols he has led the people of Judah into sin.

dag: Di simdi ni paɣiba shini baalim, ka bɔhim baŋ din tuhi maŋsiɣisibu puuni.
en: Women should learn in silence and all humility.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi sara maligu gbaliŋ la pa shɛli n sani. Yi ni zaŋdi piɛla bihi shɛb mini biŋkɔb suma kpa shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la, n nyee nyɔni li. N kɔre ka naɣilahi mini piɛla bihi ni buhi ʒim ni.
en: Your sacrifices mean nothing to me. I am sick of your offerings of rams and choice cattle; I don't like the blood of bulls or lambs or goats.

dag: Waɣ biɛ titali maa ni daa nya ka bɛ yih o bahi dunia ŋɔ ni na maa, ka o gbaai kariti doli paɣ so ŋun daa dɔɣi bidibiga la.
en: When the dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth, he chased the woman who had given birth to the male child.

dag: Gbilisim a tibili wum sarikanim ŋuhibu, ka tiligi bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la a yiko din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: Listen to the groans of the prisoners, and by your great power free those who are condemned to die.

dag: A zaŋ tuuta sa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura ka bɛ yi nya tuuta maa, di ni chɛ ka piɛma ku nyɔɣi ba.
en: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo kpara m-mali shili zani Yawɛ tooni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pihinahi laasabu n-chaŋ Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: Approximately forty thousand armed for war crossed over in the LORDs presence to the plains of Jericho, ready for battle.

dag: ni Vania ni Mɛrɛmɔt ni Ɛliashib so yaha.
en: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli Bolimiya Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la gba na ka ti ti wum o mi ni mali shɛli ni o yɛli.
en: Then Absalom said, Bring in Hushai the Archite. Let's hear what he has to say.

dag: Wulinluhili polɔnim ni lu Yawɛ yuli sizuura, ka wulimpuhili polɔnim mi lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu; dama dimnim maa yi ti kana kaman kokpɛɣu mini sanʒiɛɣu la, Yawɛ Shia ni ti yiɣisi tuhi ba.
en: People from the west to the east will fear the Lord and respect his Glory. He will come quickly, like a fast-flowing river driven by a wind from the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ wuntizɔriba pahi paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuyanim pam daa dihi bɛ yɛligu maa tabili, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool mini Silas.
en: Some of them were convinced and joined Paul and Silas; so did many of the leading women and a large group of Greeks who worshiped God.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa gba ti bɔh o yaha, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei? Ka o yɛli ba, O zaŋla tandi ʒe n nina maa, ka m paɣi li ka neei.
en: So the Pharisees asked the man, How did you get your sight? He answered, He put mud on my eyes. I washed, and now I can see.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni ŋɔ ni shɛba, amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba maa mali m-be kasi. Lala mi ka di yɛn be hal ti paai di tariga kaman Naawuni ni zali di saha shɛm.
en: Some of the wise people will stumble and make mistakes. But the persecution must come so that they can be made stronger and purer until the time of the end. Then, at the right time, that time of the end will come.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Bahim niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di ka gbe nimaani, dama kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni.
en: When the sun was beginning to set, the twelve disciples came to him and said, Send the people away so that they can go to the villages and farms around here and find food and lodging, because this is a lonely place.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dundɔŋ ni dunoli din kpa wulimpuhili polo la din kul yɛn yomi ʒiɛya dabisa ayɔbu din nyɛ tuma tumbu dabisa la ni. Amaa Vuhim Dabisili dali mini goli palli tuuli dabisili dali, di simdi ni di yooi.
en: The LORD God proclaims: The east-facing gate of the inner courtyard will remain closed for the six days of the workweek. But on the Sabbath and on the day of the new moon it will be opened.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bihi balisi laakumnima.
en: Then Jacob, his wives, and his children got on camels and left.

dag: Ka a ti lan mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbambiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: Make two gold rings and attach them to the two ends of the chest pendant on its inside edge facing the vest.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni din niŋ ma la shiri sɔŋ chɛ ka lahibal suŋ la tuma chaŋ tooni.
en: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.

dag: Amaa dɔro yi be situr shɛli ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli ni, ka yi paɣi li ka di yi, di simdi ka yi paɣi li pahi buyi, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: If he washes the object and the spot disappears, he shall wash it again, and it will be ritually clean.

dag: Nanim maa ni yino n-nyɛ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn, ka su Aroa din daa baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la mini vinvamli maa sunsuuni zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok Mɔɣili din nyɛ Ammɔnnim tintariga ka nyɛ Giliad pirigili la.
en: One was Sihon, the Amorite king who ruled at Heshbon. His kingdom included half of Gilead: from Aroer and from the city in the middle of that valley, as far as the Jabbok River, the border of Ammon;.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib shɛb daa yɛli, Karimba, a yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses said, Teacher, you have given a good answer.

dag: N dimnim kul yɛri ma la zilima dabisili kam puuni; ka bɛn maani ma ansarisi zaŋ n yuli leei turi.
en: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti wum ni be gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli.
en: The LORD spoke through his servants the prophets.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba du n-tam ti zuɣu; ti kpe buɣim mini kom ni gari yi, amaa a zaŋ ti tahi luɣ shɛli din galisi na.
en: You let our enemies run over us. We went through fire and water, but you brought us to a safe place.

dag: Ʒirilana nyɛla ŋun sɔɣiri jɛlinsi. Ka ŋunkam zuri niriba nyaaŋa nyɛ jɛrigu.
en: People sometimes lie to hide their hatred, but saying bad things about someone is even more foolish.

dag: Ka Samsin daa chaŋ ka o mini paɣisarili maa ti nya taba, ka Samsin suhu daa yu o pam.
en: So Samson went down to the city and talked to the Philistine woman. She pleased him.

dag: ni dundɔŋ din gil la pilanim mini di binzahi ni kpahi ni mihi ni di nɛma zaa ni di neen kparisi zaa; ka a boli sokam zaa yuli n-wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn ʒi neen shɛŋa.
en: the pillars of the courtyard all around, with their bases, pegs, cords, and all the equipment used with them. You will list by name the objects they are required to carry.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa niŋ Yisa saani pam o yiŋa, ka farigudeeriba pam mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa.
en: Then Levi had a big feast in his house for Jesus, and among the guests was a large number of tax collectors and other people.

dag: Ka m mi ni ŋun piligi tuun suŋ ŋɔ yi ni maa ni tum li hal ti naai li ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: And so I am sure that God, who began this good work in you, will carry it on until it is finished on the Day of Christ Jesus.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba Lɛvi zuliya maa ni kaman bɛ zuliya maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm, bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannima ka be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: These were the heads of the households of the Levites, according to descent. They lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka sapashin maa yɛl o, N Duuma, m pɔri ni a ka n yiŋ na; amaa kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛn yɛli, ka n yiŋbia maa kpaŋ.
en: But the centurion replied, Lord, I dont deserve to have you come under my roof. Just say the word and my servant will be healed.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, A ni lo shɛm maa viɛla.
en: And you said, That is a good thing to do.

dag: Been shɛli daa be Jɛrusalɛm n-do m-miri duno shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Piɛri Dunol la. Hiburuli ni bɛ booni biaŋ maa la Bɛtizata, ka lunfanima anu daa be nimaani.
en: In Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate in the north city wall is a pool with the Aramaic name Bethsaida. It had five covered porches.

dag: Dama Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia daa ti la niriba maa naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tusaayopɔin ni bɛ kɔri. Ka kpamba gba daa ti ba naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tuhi pia. Ka maligumaaniba pam daa mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi.
en: King Hezekiah of Judah gave bulls and sheep to the assembly to kill and eat. The leaders gave bulls and , sheep to the assembly. Many priests prepared themselves for holy service.

dag: Dama di daa nyɛla jirambisa tambu buta. Di daa ka pilanima kaman dundɔntitali ni pilanim la. Lala zuɣu du shɛŋa din daa be zuɣusaa maa daa labi nyaaŋa n-gari tiŋ mini sunsuuni dina la.
en: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.

dag: Di saha ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a niriba ni a ni gul shɛb kaman piɛgul ŋɔ kul ni puhir a sahakam ka paɣir a ʒiɛmani kam puuni.
en: Then we, your people, the sheep of your flock, will thank you forever and praise you for all time to come.

dag: Kalima maa biɛhigu mini bɛ ni daa mal li shɛm. Di zaa kɔtomsi daa nyɛla zaɣ yinsi, ka nyɛlisira kaman vakahili la. Di malibu maa daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla kalinli yini kpɛhi din la ni.
en: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it.

dag: ka tooi chi zim maa nukurigu pali kaman di ni wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li niŋ buɣim ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka paɣ maa zaŋ kom maa nyu.
en: Then he shall take a handful of it as a token offering and burn it on the altar. Finally, he shall make the woman drink the water.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so ŋun daa ʒe nimaani nya Yisa ni daa kuhi lala ka bahi maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: When the centurion, who stood facing Jesus, saw how he died, he said, This man was certainly Gods Son.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman tuŋ wula ni be mɔɣu ni tihi ni ka n zaŋ li ti ka bɛ maani buɣim shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: I, the Lord God, promise that just as the wood of a grapevine is burned as firewood.

dag: O daa bi tum tuun kara pam nimaani, bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Jesus did not do many miracles there, because the people did not believe in him.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka pagɔrisigu tuma naai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di leei saɣisigu ti paɣiba zaa, ka bɛ ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma kaman yi ni daa tum shɛm maa.
en: So I will put an end to betrayal in the land. Taking warning, no woman will betray as you have done.

dag: dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-ku la.
en: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa nyɛ Arab mini Duma ni Ɛshan.
en: The people of Judah were also given these towns: Arab, Dumah, Eshan.

dag: Ka bɛn yi dɔɣim kam zaa ni mini zuliya balibu kam ni ni niriba balibu kam ni ni tinzun yɛligu kam nim ni na ni ti lihiri ba ka zaɣisi ba sɔɣibu, ka bɛ ni do nimaani dabisi muna ata ni pirigili.
en: People from all nations, tribes, languages, and races will look at their bodies for three and a half days and will not allow them to be buried.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ jɛlinsi lu a zuɣu n-fa a ni tum tuma nya binshɛŋa la zaa, ka chɛ a zaɣ nɛli. Ka a pagɔrisigu tuma la yi palo. A kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuma maa.
en: They will deal hatefully with you: They will seize your pay and leave you completely naked. Your promiscuity, betrayal, and seductions will be exposed.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mini noon shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Noah built an altar where he could offer sacrifices to the Lord . Then he offered on the altar one of each kind of animal and bird that could be used for a sacrifice.

dag: Amaa yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa saria n-doli yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Yet you say, My Lords way doesnt measure up. I judge each one of you according to your ways, house of Israel!.

dag: Ninsal yi tum o ninsal kpee taali, Yawɛ ni tim di sandaani. Amaa ninsal yi tum Yawɛ taali, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tim di sandaani? Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ ba yɛligu maa wumbu, dama Yawɛ daa pun lo ni o ni ku ba.
en: If you sin against other people, God might protect you. But who can help you if you sin against the Lord ? Elis sons refused to listen to him, so the Lord decided to kill them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Naawuni, ti puhir a ka paɣir a yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ.
en: Now, our God, we thank you, and we praise your glorious name!.

dag: Dindali maa, yɛlimiya yi bihi Yawɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa tin ya shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la, di zuɣu ka yi puhiri di chuɣu maa.
en: On this day you should tell your children, We are having this festival because the Lord took me out of Egypt.

dag: Hal paɣ shɛb bɛn nini zɔri nambɔɣu gba daa ti zaŋdila bɛ bihi duɣira. Bɛna n-daa leei bɛ bindirigu, bɛ ni daa kuri n niriba maa saha shɛli maa.
en: The hands of loving women boiled their own children to become their food during the destruction of the daughter of my people.

dag: Din beni nyɛla: Zaligu kurili la leela din daai baɣili kpaŋa di gbariginsim mini di ni ka buchi zuɣu.
en: On the one hand, an earlier command is set aside because it was weak and useless.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni bi tum di tuun shɛli mini fɔntin shɛŋa yi ni bi me n-tin ya, ka yi be di ni diri ti shɛŋa yi ni bi sa mini olivi ti shɛŋa yi ni bi sa wala. .
en: I gave you land on which you hadnt toiled and cities that you hadnt built. You settled in them and are enjoying produce from vineyards and olive groves that you didnt plant.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti Ijiptinim daŋ pam, ka lan tib ba. Bɛ ni ti lab Yawɛ sanna, ka o deei bɛ suhigu ka tib ba.
en: The Lord will punish the Egyptians, but then he will heal them. They will turn to him, and he will hear their prayers and heal them.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tintariga nti yɛn nyɛ Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli zaŋ hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din be Lɛbɔhamat samban ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ wulinluhili polo yaɣili.
en: On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea will be the border all the way to the area in front of Lebo Hamath. This will be your western border.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kuhi pam yɛli.
en: A man in the synagogue had the spirit of an unclean demon. He screamed.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee n-zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: But some of the seed fell on good ground. There it grew and made grain. Some plants made times more grain, some times more, and some times more.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa nyɛ anab maa daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: So the young prophet went to Ramoth.

dag: Amaa miriya! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranim bɛ sani.
en: You must be careful! There are people who will arrest you and take you to be judged for being my followers. They will beat you in their synagogues. You will be forced to stand before kings and governors. You will tell them about me.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla, ka malila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini kɔŋko bɛ ŋariŋ ni.
en: The disciples had forgotten to bring enough bread and had only one loaf with them in the boat.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na be soli kuna ka lahibali ti nti to Dauda, Absalom ku nabihi la zaa, hal bɛ yino bi lan kpalim.
en: The kings sons were still on their way into town. But King David got a message about what happened. But the message was, Absalom has killed all the kings sons! Not one of the sons was left alive.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu gbaŋ maa puuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ mali shili gu dindali maa.
en: The contents of the proclamation were to be made public in every province, so that everyone would be prepared when that day came.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nam binshɛɣukam ŋɔ yi shihi tiŋgbani, di tahirimi bɔɣira, ka bɛnkam be di ni fabinda, ka di kpuɣi zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la, ka lab lu kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun be sarika ŋɔ ni pahi n zuɣu Yisa Masia zuɣu la puhir a.
en: Epaphras, who is in prison with me for the cause of Christ Jesus, greets you.

dag: Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Bɔ ka yi lee du m-ba ka na kul be ti ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛli ŋɔ puuni maa.
en: They said, King Sennacherib of Assyria says this: What do you trust in that makes you stay under attack in Jerusalem?.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgbani daa kuui zaa.
en: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day, the earth was dry.

dag: Obadia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ daa tim o tumo zuliya shɛb sani, ka ti wum o yɛligu maa. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Malimiya shili ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnima.
en: This is the vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord GOD says about Edom: We heard a report from the Lord . A messenger was sent to the nations. He said, Lets go fight against Edom.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: How can this be? asked Nicodemus.

dag: dama binshɛɣukam din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ mini din tuhi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yirila neesim ni na.
en: This light produces every kind of goodness, right living, and truth.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba ni di pala Romnim kali ni bɛ kari so saria ka dilan maŋmaŋ kani n-ni zani ka o mini bɛn fiɣisir o maa gbiɛri kpa taba, ka o tɔɣisi chihi o noli bɛ ni fiɣisir o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa.
en: I told them it is contrary to Roman practice to hand someone over before they have faced their accusers and had opportunity to offer a defense against the charges.

dag: ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ŋmani la ti tam o zuɣu. Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu n-nyɛ a; n nini tiɣ a pam.
en: and the Holy Spirit came down on him. The Spirit looked like a real dove. Then a voice came from heaven and said, You are my Son, the one I love. I am very pleased with you.

dag: Nir yi niŋ binshɛli tahima ka ti bi nya li, di damdila o suhu, amaa nir yi bɔri shɛli ka nya li, di nyɛla nyɛvili tia.
en: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.

dag: Di yuuni maa puuni, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni, ka anabi Hanania daa shiri kpi.
en: The prophet Hananiah died in the seventh month of that year.

dag: Jɛhoyakim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛkɔnia mini Zɛdɛkia.
en: Jehoiakim had two sons: Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛlabihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You must also give the right amount of grain and drink offerings with the bulls, rams, and lambs.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋuna, di simdi ni a mali suhukpeeni, di chɛ ka a kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama a nya a ni tum tuun shɛli maa laara.
en: But you must be strong and not be discouraged. The work that you do will be rewarded.

dag: Dama saha shɛl o ni daa nya tibiginsim mini jilima o Ba Naawuni sani la ka kukoli daa yi Zallakudura Naa Jilima Biɛhigu Shee na n-di o shɛhira yɛli, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala.
en: We were there when he was given honor and glory by God the Father, when the voice came to him from the Supreme Glory, saying, This is my own dear Son, with whom I am pleased.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else that King Josiah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka o daa to piɛma n-wurim ba bahi; ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi niŋ ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: God shot arrows, scattering the enemy; he sent the lightning and whipped them into confusion.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ya tim tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm, ka nyɛ tiŋgban kuŋ puuni gari wɔɣ biɛri mini nɔnsi ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni. O daa chɛ ka kom yi chɛribo kuɣa ni na ka yi nyu.
en: the one who led you through this vast and terrifying desert of poisonous snakes and scorpions, of cracked ground with no water; the one who made water flow for you out of a hard rock.

dag: A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa pam. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ filim a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisi shɛŋa la ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A ba mi ni a yuri ma, ka tɛhi ni di bi simdi ni a baŋ di yɛla, dama a yi baŋ di yɛla, di ni saɣim a suhu pam. Amaa yɛlimaŋli, hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu ni nyin ŋumbɔŋɔ gba zuɣu, m mini kum kul chɛla tab kpe ni kpe.
en: But David solemnly promised in response, Your father knows full well that you like me. He probably said, Jonathan must not learn about this or hell be upset. But I promise you—on the LORDs life and yours!—that I am this close to death.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa kpi yuun shɛli ka n daa nya n Duuma ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee din du pam ka mali jilima; ka o binyɛrigu pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaa.
en: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a very high and wonderful throne. His long robe filled the Temple.

dag: Kɔŋ maa daa kul malila naa Uzia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o ni daa nyɛ kɔŋlan maa zuɣu, o daa kul bela o kɔŋko yili ni ka ku lan tooi kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili maa n-su nayili maa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: Uzziah had leprosy the rest of his life. He was no longer allowed in the temple or in his own palace. That's why his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Uzziah died and was buried in the royal burial ground in David's City, and his son Jotham succeeded him as king.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti tɔɣisiri kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Naawuni ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu la yɛla. Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Some people were talking about the beautiful stones used to build the temple and about the gifts that had been placed in it. Jesus said.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya Gibia ninvuɣ galima bɛn tum lala maa na ka ti ku ba, ka lala tuuni maa vuui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim maa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Now hand over those perverse men in Gibeah so that we can execute them and remove the evil from Israel. But the Benjaminites refused to comply with the demand of their own relatives the Israelites.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi yaha ni ŋunkam guni, di nyɛla talahi ni o doli fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: Once more I warn any man who allows himself to be circumcised that he is obliged to obey the whole Law.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ daa chɛ ka Asa suhu yiɣisi bahi anab maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o kpɛhi duu nti ga o zoligɔnim zali, dama yɛlli maa daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi anabi maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Asa daa gbaai niriba maa shɛb nahimbu.
en: Asa was angry with the seer. Asa was so mad he threw Hanani in jail and took his anger out on some of the people.

dag: Ti lomiya tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba; yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba wuntaŋ zuɣusaa dɛde. Mbusim paai ti, dama wuntaŋ luya, ka yuŋ zibira.
en: Kings will tell their troops, If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later.

dag: Yawɛ moli molo gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yɛli: Yɛlimiya Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, nyama, a tiligira kana, ka laara mini yɔri be o sani.
en: This is what the LORD announced to the earths distant regions: Say to Daughter Zion, Look! Your deliverer arrives, bringing reward and payment.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ n dimnima ka daliri shɛli kani la, daa yimi teei bɔri ma kaman n nyɛla noombil la.
en: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa yi ni chaŋ Taasus ni o ti bo Sool shee.
en: Barnabas went to Tarsus in search of Saul.

dag: ka zaŋ li tu bansi maa ni din ni chɛ ka dapuhi maa be sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ ayi polo saha shɛli yi yi ti ʒiri li chana.
en: and put them in the rings on each side of the altar when it is carried.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Jɛfita, Kamina ti leei ti zuɣulana n-zaŋ ti chaŋ ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima.
en: They told him, Come and lead us, so that we can fight the Ammonites.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli Yawɛ sani, ka o ni niŋ binshɛŋa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o kpe taali ni maa kpihim.
en: Then the priest will go to the Lord to make you pure, and God will forgive you for whichever of these things you did that made you guilty.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-nam binshɛɣukam din beni ŋɔ. N nini ni tiɣi ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛla bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa ka niŋdi tuuba, ka luri n yɛligu sizuura, ka doli n yɛligu maa.
en: I myself created the whole universe! I am pleased with those who are humble and repentant, who fear me and obey me.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun lo amiliya yɛla buɣisi li: Zaligu kul lo paɣ ŋun kuli doo mi tabil o yidana hal ni o yidana maa nyɛvili tariga; amaa o yidana maa yi ti kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni zaŋ chaŋ o yidana maa sani.
en: Its like what the law says about marriage: A woman must stay married to her husband as long as he is alive. But if her husband dies, she is made free from the law of marriage.

dag: Zoomba nina neera, ka wɔbisi chana, ka kɔnsi tibiri kpaŋda, ka tikpiranim wumda, hal ka kpiimba gba neeri kum ni, ka lahibal suŋ waazu mi yihiri tiri tarimba.
en: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.

dag: O daa tum din chihira n-chaŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa kaman Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni daa niŋdi shɛm ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Yawɛ kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini di ni la.
en: He committed the most shameful sins by worshiping idols, as the Amorites had done, whom the Lord had driven out of the land as the people of Israel advanced.

dag: A kari pakoya bahi ni nuzaŋa, ka kabisi kpibisi bɔɣiri.
en: You not only refused to help widows, but you also robbed and mistreated orphans.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn ti kana.
en: Before John came, the Law of Moses and all the prophets told about the things that would happen.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wulimpuhili polo tintariga daa kpuɣi chaŋ. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini maa, ka tintarisi ŋɔ zaa daa gili niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.

dag: Ka n kurim n-teei dɔni m puli zuɣu, ka kul chani gindi n-fabindi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I am hunched over, completely down; I wander around all day long, sad.

dag: O nyari bina pam, amaa ka bi baŋdi li; o tiba mali voya, amaa di bi wumda.
en: My people see what they should do, but they do not obey me. They can hear with their ears, but they refuse to listen to me.

dag: Yawɛ, n yur a jɛmbu duu din nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛli, ka a jilima be nimaani la.
en: Lord , I love the house where you live, the place where your glory is.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa laɣim Yisa sani maa ka o bɔhi ba.
en: While the Pharisees were still there, Jesus asked them.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam chani yuŋ tuurimi, ka di nyɛla neesim ni kani zuɣu.
en: But whoever walks in the night does stumble because the light isnt in them.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi bindir shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ.
en: The officiating priest shall burn all this on the altar as a food offering to the Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛli doo maa, Yihim li, ka o zaŋ o nuu tim ha yihi li.
en: Elisha said, So pick up the ax head. Then the man reached out and took the ax head.

dag: Adaya daa nyɛla Jɛrɔham bia, ka Jɛrɔham nyɛ Pashihur bia, ka Pashihur nyɛ Malikija bia, ka Maasai daa nyɛ Adiɛl bia, ka Adiɛl nyɛ Jazɛra bia, ka Jazɛra nyɛ Mɛshulam bia, ka Mɛshulam nyɛ Mɛshilɛmit bia, ka Mɛshilɛmit nyɛ Imɛr bia.
en: Also there was Jerohams son, Adaiah. Jeroham was Pashhurs son. Pashhur was Malkijahs son. And there was Adiels son, Maasai. Adiel was Jahzerahs son. Jahzerah was Meshullams son. Meshullam was Meshillemiths son. Meshillemith was Immers son.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa zo Yawɛ dabiɛm pam, ka mali sara n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd o.
en: This made the sailors so afraid of the Lord that they offered a sacrifice and promised to serve him.

dag: M mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma ni. Di pala yɛl tibisili n sani ni n lab sabi n ni daa pun sab yɛl shɛŋa tin ya la n-lan tin ya, dama di nyɛla din ni gbibi ya.
en: In conclusion, my friends, be joyful in your union with the Lord. I don't mind repeating what I have written before, and you will be safer if I do so.

dag: A ni daa nya ti shɛli maa daa wɔɣ pam ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka di zuɣusaa mali hal ti tɔri sagbana, ka ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣili kam tooi nyari li.
en: The tree you saw that grew in size and strength, that was as high as the sky, that could be seen from every corner of the earth.

dag: Di zaŋya bɛ ni ja biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmahim biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni chahi biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai biŋkɔb so lana m-mali sara ti Yawɛ bee m-mali sara yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: As long as you live in this land, don't offer an animal with injured testicles.

dag: Ka Naa Ahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Ahazs son Hezekiah became the new king after him.

dag: Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Uzia bia Jɔtam mi daa di Juda nam.
en: Jotham son of Uzziah became king of Judah. This was during the second year that Pekah son of Remaliah was king of Israel.

dag: Ka Ifriim min o paɣ maa daa lan dɔni ka o niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Bɛraya, zaɣ biɛɣu din daa niŋ o yiŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: Then Ephraim had sexual relations with his wife. She became pregnant and had a son. Ephraim named this new son Beriah because something bad had happened to his family.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba. Sool daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was the father of Kish, and Kish was the father of King Saul. Saul had four sons: Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-dɔni ninkurigu maa yiŋ dunol ni Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni daa kpe shɛl la biɛkaali saha n-do nimaani hal ka di ti neei.
en: and it was almost daybreak when she went back to the house where her husband was staying. She collapsed at the door and lay there until sunrise.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan mali ʒiʒiriba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣikpɛriba tuhi pihinii zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: Solomon had , laborers and , stonecutters in the highlands.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka yɛdaniŋdib maa daa chɛ ka Pool mini Silas dii yi nimaani yuŋ chaŋ Bɛria. Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Bɛria, bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: That same night the believers sent Paul and Silas to another city named Berea. When they arrived there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa ti paai yuun pihitayinika saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Tɛra.
en: When Nahor was years old, he had a son, Terah;.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti kurigi saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka tiŋgban shɛli yi ni na yɛn deei mi na galisi pam.
en: Joshua was now very old. The Lord said to him, You are very old, but there is still much land to be taken:.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi tum a taal shɛli, amaa nyini n-lee tum ma taali a ni lo tɔbu na ni a ti tuhi ma maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ sariakarita ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti Izraɛlnim mini Ammɔnnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: I haven't done anything to you, but it's certainly wrong of you to start a war. I pray that the Lord will show whether Israel or Ammon is in the right.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ wain ti maŋli la, ka m Ba mi nyɛ di gula.
en: Jesus said, I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋgbani ti dam pam hal ka duu maa gbinni ti sɔhira, ka sarika duu maa dunoya zaa dii yooi, ka sokam bandi baai.
en: Suddenly there was an earthquake so strong that it shook the foundation of the jail. All the doors of the jail opened, and the chains on all the prisoners fell off.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni di n-su shɛb kalinli ku mali tariga, amaa bɛn doli nyaaŋa na nini ku tiɣ o. Yɛlimaŋli dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: There was no counting the number of people he ruled, but those who came later arent happy with him. This too is pointless and a chasing after wind.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ka yi yi ti nya ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli din chihira ʒe di ni bi simdi ni di ʒe luɣ shɛli polo, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm! Di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: You will see The Awful Horror standing in the place where he should not be. Then those who are in Judea must run away to the hills.

dag: Ti dana, wummi ti ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, A nyɛla zuɣulaan titali ti sani. Ti ni so ku mɔŋ a o siliga bee n-yɛl a ni a di sɔɣ a kpima. Dinzuɣu piim a ni bɔri ti silisi ŋɔ ni shɛli n-zaŋ a kpim maa sɔɣi di ni.
en: Listen to us, sir. We look upon you as a mighty leader; bury your wife in the best grave that we have. Any of us would be glad to give you a grave, so that you can bury her.

dag: Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl bituuli maa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi.
en: The family of Reuben, Israels oldest son: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: Yisifu ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Ijipti daa nyɛla bidibis ayi. Yaakubu yiŋnim zaa bɛn daa kuli Ijipti kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin.
en: Jacob's two grandsons who were born there made it a total of members of Jacob's family in Egypt.

dag: Shɛkɛm ni daa dihi Yaakubu bidibisi maa tizɔpaɣ Daina vi maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa garigi Shɛkɛm min o ba Hamɔr yɔhiŋgu garigibu.
en: Jacobs sons decided to lie to Shechem and his father because Shechem had done such a bad thing to their sister Dinah.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni, ka paɣi ni ti yi ti niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ ti be ti Duuma sani.
en: We are full of courage and would much prefer to leave our home in the body and be at home with the Lord.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zo o nambɔɣu. Amaa yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer!.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu, ka Ilaisha lab Giligal na. Ka anabinim daa ti ʒi o sani, ka o yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm duɣ titali tam n-duɣi ʒiɛri ti anabinim ŋɔ.
en: Later, Elisha went back to Gilgal, where there was almost nothing to eat, because the crops had failed. One day while the prophets who lived there were meeting with Elisha, he said to his servant, Prepare a big pot of stew for these prophets.

dag: Ijiptinim nyɛla ninsalinima ka pa Naawuni, ka bɛ yuri nyɛ biŋkɔbiri ka pa lahizibu binyara. Yawɛ yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu, bɛn nyɛ sɔŋdiba maa ni ti tuui, ka bɛ ni sɔŋdi shɛb maa lu, ka bɛ zaa laɣim bahi yoli.
en: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.

dag: Noombihi bɛn gbahiri binnɛma dira bi mi di soli ni be shɛli, ka suligu nini na ʒi n-nya li.
en: No hawk sees the roads to the mines, And no vulture ever flies over them.

dag: Di niŋdiya li la saha shɛli bɛ nini ni beni zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiyala din tiɣiri Naawuni nini ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nyɛ Masia daba la zuɣu.
en: Do this not only when they are watching you, because you want to gain their approval; but with all your heart do what God wants, as slaves of Christ.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli ka bi chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: But the LORD made Pharaoh stubborn so that he wasnt willing to let them go.

dag: Ka Dauda yɛl o, Yɛlim ma din niŋ. Ka o yɛl o, Tɔbbihi maa ŋmaligimi guui, ka bɛ pam lu tɔb maa ni, ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan gba lu tɔb maa ni.
en: Who won the battle? David asked. The man said, Our army turned and ran, but many were wounded and died. Even King Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.

dag: Ka Nɛria bia Baruk daa niŋ anabi Jɛrimia ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu gbaŋ maa karimbu polo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni maa.
en: Baruch, Neriahs son, did everything the prophet Jeremiah instructed him: he read all the LORDs words from the scroll in the temple.

dag: Nyin daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahigu! Tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa anahi bahigu saha paaya.
en: Mortal man, he said, this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to the land of Israel: This is the end for the whole land!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dikili, ka di barilim nyɛ mita ata. Ka du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣa zuɣu gil la zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi.
en: When he measured the wall of the temple, it was nine feet, and the side chambers that went all the way around the temple were six feet.

dag: N ni ti je suli niŋ a, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhuyiɣisili pam lu a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ŋmah a nyee min a tiba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku a bi shɛb bɛn kpalim. Bɛ ni ti gbah a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi nti zaŋ ba zaɣ nɛma nyo buɣim.
en: I will show you how jealous I am. They will become angry and hurt you. They will cut off your nose and ears. They will kill you with a sword. Then they will take your children and burn whatever is left of you.

dag: Daadam, Taainim ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba maa dunɔdaya kabisiya n-yooi yali ti ti pumpɔŋɔ. Mbo! di ni wurim doya ŋɔ zuɣu, ti ni tɔŋ.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of the city of Tyre have celebrated Jerusalem's defeat by singing, Jerusalem has fallen! It used to be powerful, a center of trade. Now the city is shattered, and we will take its place.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Amalɛknim maa sani ka bɛ ʒi ba na, niriba maa n-daa chɛ piɛ viɛla mini naɣ viɛla maa n-zaŋ ba na ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ; amaa ti daa saɣim dinkam kpalim zaa.
en: Saul said, The soldiers took them from the Amalekites. They saved the best sheep and cattle to burn as sacrifices to the Lord your God. But we destroyed everything else.

dag: ka Aduna bihi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa mali buɣim, ka malimali dari viɛnyɛla niŋ buɣim maa ni.
en: Aarons sons, the priests, will put the fire on the altar and arrange the wood on the fire.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Let's go out to the fields, Jonathan answered. So they went.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi neesim maa ne sokam zaa sani, ka bɛ nyari yi tuun suma ka tiri yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: In the same way your light must shine before people, so that they will see the good things you do and praise your Father in heaven.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti piɛbi zaɣ yini kɔŋko, di saha zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba la bɛn laɣimm a sanna.
en: But when only one trumpet is sounded, then only the leaders of the clans are to gather around you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ba ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ bɔh o, Rabai, ya polo ka a kpɛra.
en: When Jesus turned and saw them following, he asked, What are you looking for? They said, Rabbi , where are you staying.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la jɛmbu duu ni kpɛbu, ka jɛmdila buɣili Ashɛra binyɛra mini binnana. Ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu bɛ taali tumbu maa zuɣu.
en: And so the people stopped worshiping in the Temple of the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and began to worship idols and the images of the goddess Asherah. Their guilt for these sins brought the Lord 's anger on Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni sokam zaa kpi yim, ka saria karibu lee be di nyaaŋa.
en: Everyone must die once. Then they are judged.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi tɛr ni bahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Sujee mini suhuyiɣisili ni biɛr biɛɣu. Ka di chɛliya ka turi mini yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na.
en: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma mi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala salima firilatamdigu, ka laa tam di zuɣu; ka firilanima ayopɔin tam di zuɣu; ka firila kam mali mihi ayopɔin.
en: What do you see? he asked. A lampstand made of gold, I answered. At the top is a bowl for the oil. On the lampstand are seven lamps, each one with places for seven wicks.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be o sani, ka o daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa o dirila nasara. O daa zaɣisi Asiria naa jɛmbu.
en: The Lord was with Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. Hezekiah broke away from the king of Assyria and stopped serving him.

dag: Di saha ka Pool daa yɛli sapashin la min o tɔbbihi, Niriba ŋɔ yi yi ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni; yi ku tiligi.
en: Paul said to the centurion and his soldiers, Unless they stay in the ship, you cant be saved from peril.

dag: bee gurugulana bee diɣili bee do so ŋun nina bi ne viɛnyɛla bee ŋun mali dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri niŋgbuŋ ni bee ŋun mali yu kaɣima bee bɛ ni yihi do so lana.
en: men with bent backs, men who are dwarfs, men who are cross-eyed, men with rashes or bad skin diseases, and men with crushed testicles.

dag: Daadam, a ni kari ba saria? A ni kari ba saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ yaannim ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Are you willing to warn them, Ezekiel? Then remind them of the disgusting sins of their ancestors.

dag: Dama a yihi ma muɣisigu kam ni, ka chɛ ka n nini nya n dimnim nasara kɔŋbu.
en: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔyakim ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti teei gil li.
