en: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and surrounded it with his army. This happened during the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim ka di na bi naai, nyin di mir o ni a bo o.
en: You must not go near a woman to have sexual relations with her during her monthly time of bleeding. She is unclean during this time.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bɔŋɔ? Wuhiri palli m-bala! Doo ŋɔ mali yiko mi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli.
en: The people were all so amazed that they started saying to one another, What is this? Is it some kind of new teaching? This man has authority to give orders to the evil spirits, and they obey him.

dag: dindina wula ka tinim ni tooi zo n-yi tibidarigibo maa ni, ti baɣa yi ka tiliginsim din galisi ŋɔ ni? Ti Duuma maŋmaŋ daa tuui yɛli tiliginsim maa yɛla, ka bɛn daa wum o yɛligu di o shɛhira ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: How, then, shall we escape if we pay no attention to such a great salvation? The Lord himself first announced this salvation, and those who heard him proved to us that it is true.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ɛdom zoli polo, n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Son of man, look toward Mount Seir and speak against it for me.

dag: Yi zuɣulaannim zaa daa laɣimmi guui. Pa piɛma ka bɛ daa zaŋ to n-gbahi ba. Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ ni daa nya yi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa hal bɛ ni daa kul zo n-chaŋ katiŋ la zaa yoli.
en: All your officers ran away together, but they have all been captured without bows. All the leaders ran away together, but they were found and captured.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la mali zuɣusuŋ gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be bɛ nyɛviya ni.
en: So I declare that the dead, who have already died, are more fortunate than the living, who are still alive.

dag: Ka ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa zaŋ o ti, ka bɛ di o saria n-yɛli ni bɛ kum o, ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then the chief priests and our leaders had him arrested and sentenced to die on a cross.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kul chani Bɛrishiiba hal ni Ifriim zoya ni tinsi la zaa ni niriba sani nti lan labisi ba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ni yaha.
en: Even though King Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, he traveled regularly among the people, from Beersheba in the south to the edge of the hill country of Ephraim in the north, in order to call the people back to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

dag: ka ŋmaligi yɛli mmaŋa n suhu ni, M mali nɛma pam din ni gbib ma yuun bɔbigu; n ni ʒini vuhi n-dira ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Then I'll say to myself, You have stored up enough good things to last for years to come. Live it up! Eat, drink, and enjoy yourself. .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din ti yɛn niŋ maa shihirili. Yuuni ŋɔ mini yuuni din paya na, kayari chi ka yi yɛn dira; ka yuun shɛli din pahir ata ni mi, yi ni biri ka chɛ, ka sa wain tihi n-di di wala.
en: Now this will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: This year you will eat what grows by itself. Next year you will eat what grows from that. But in the third year, sow seed and harvest it; plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-chaŋ ti kum; ka lan lab bɛ sanna nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Ka o daa gbaai Simiɔn n-chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Joseph turned away from them and cried, but soon he turned back and spoke to them again. Then he had Simeon tied up and taken away while they watched.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya niriba ayi ka bɛ ʒe m-baɣi mɔɣili, yino daa ʒɛla yaɣ yini polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe yaɣ din la polo.
en: Then I saw two men standing by a river, one on each bank.

dag: Ka din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yurilim din lɔri binshɛɣukam laɣindi taba ka di leeri zaɣ yin la pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: And over all these things put on love, which is the perfect bond of unity.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli la ni ti mali jilima n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboli kam. Zuliya kam ni ti zo n-ka di gbinna.
en: In days to come the mountain where the Temple stands will be the highest one of all, towering above all the hills. Many nations will come streaming to it.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim chɛ ka daboya mini vinvama yi palo ni, kaman binyɛrigu kpabbu bɔba la, ka ne n-doya kaman bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli dihi yaɣiri zuɣu ka yihi li ka di bɔbili doya shɛm la.
en: Do you turn it over like clay for a seal, so it stands out like a colorful garment?.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka yɛli bɔɣukpiŋlan maa, Mirimina ti zani kpe. Ka o dii yiɣisi zani niriba maa ni.
en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking. He said to the man with the crippled hand, Get up and stand here where everyone can see. The man got up and stood there.

dag: Lala ka Lɛvi zuliya ni so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ o gari.
en: In the same way a Levite also came there, went over and looked at the man, and then walked on by on the other side.

dag: Yawɛ, labisim ti na kaman saa ni miri n-zaŋdi kom na ti niŋdi Nɛgɛb mɔɣ kuma ni shɛm la.
en: So, Lord , bring back the good times, like a desert stream filled again with flowing water.

dag: Dama niriba maa pam daa bi mali bɛmaŋ kasi. Dinzuɣu Lɛvinim n-daa kɔriti bɛnkam bi be kasi maa Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbihi, ni di chɛ ka sara maa be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Because many of the people were not ritually clean, they could not kill the Passover lambs, so the Levites did it for them and dedicated the lambs to the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini di ni ka me a luɣ kasi shee ni bɛ jɛmd a ka yɛra.
en: Our ancestors lived in this land and built a temple to honor you.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛl o, Ka doo mini paɣ yɛla yi nyɛla lala, dindina di bi simdi ni nir kpuɣi paɣa.
en: The followers said to Jesus, If that is the only reason a man can divorce his wife, it is better not to marry.

dag: Timiya yi banim mini yi manim jilima din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni.
en: Respect your father and your mother, and you will live a long time in the land I am giving you.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma polo ka o kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: Change your hearts and lives! Turn back to God so that your sins may be wiped away.

dag: Amaa o daa tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la tatabo. O daa bi lɔɣ li.
en: But he nevertheless clung to the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit. He didnt deviate from them.

dag: Lan zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din kpalim la n-niŋ a min a dɔɣiriba ni nya ka di simdi shɛm, ka lee chɛ ka di nyɛla din doli yi Naawuni maa yubu.
en: Then you and the other Jews may spend the silver and gold left over any way you want to. Use it in a way that is pleasing to your God.

dag: Amaa mani n-daa wuhi Ifriimnim chandi. Mani n-daa kpuɣi ba gbibi n nuhi ni. Amaa bɛ daa bi baŋ ni mani n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ maa.
en: But I was the one who taught Ephraim to walk. I took the Israelites in my arms. I healed them, but they dont know that.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Di kpalim biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma yaha dama n labirila m Ba sani.
en: After a short time you wont see me. Then after another short time you will see me again.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm. Naa ni tooi niŋ o ni bɔr shɛm, dinzuɣu o tooni zanibu yi ti mali barina, nyin zom yomyom.
en: Dont be dismayed; leave his presence. Dont linger in a harmful situation because he can do whatever he wants!.

dag: Amaa ti yi bɔri ni bɛ be ti sani ka ti mini ba nyɛ ninvuɣ yinsi, faashee ka ti dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: We have to do only one thing before they will agree to stay here and become one nation with us. Our men will have to be circumcised just like theirs.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ niriba maa chaŋ kuliga ni, ka Yawɛ ti yɛli Gidiɔn, Ŋunkam mal o zilinli nyuri kom kaman baa la, nyin woligim o zal o ko; ka ŋunkam mi ti gban tiŋ nyura, nyin woligim o gba zal o ko.
en: Gideon took the men down to the water, and the Lord told him, Separate everyone who laps up the water with his tongue like a dog, from everyone who gets down on his knees to drink.

dag: Saŋmarisi bɛn laɣim gbilligbilli be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ti ku ne; ka wuntaŋ ti ku ne o puhibu na saha, ka goli ti ku piɛla.
en: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka anzinfa mini salima galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba galisi kaman sinsabisi dari ni galisi shɛm Shɛfɛla la.
en: During his reign silver and gold became as common in Jerusalem as stone, and cedar was as plentiful as ordinary sycamore in the foothills of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ miri ŋunkam zaa suh o mini ŋunkam zaa suh o ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: He is near to those who call to him, who call to him with sincerity.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti ni labisi bɛ binshɛɣukam ti ba, ka ku lan bɔhi ba shɛli yɛla. Ka n daa boli maligumaaniba na nti chɛ ka bɛ po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni lo alikauli ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: They replied, Well return everything, and we wont charge anything else. Well do what youve asked. So I called the priests and made them swear to do what they had promised.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam tuma din pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that King Rehoboam did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be ti ni, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa.
en: There were seven brothers among us. The first brother married but died. He had no children. So his brother married the woman.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku la, n ni zaŋ li ti a, ka ni lan zaŋ li ti a zuliya a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: I will give you the land that I promised Abraham and Isaac, and it will belong to your family forever.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bikpamba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka Napaɣ Ɛsta ŋun daa nyɛ Abiheel bia la daa pahi Mɔdɛkai zuɣu ka bɛ sab gban shɛli din pah ayi zaŋ chaŋ Purim chuɣu puhibu maa yɛla polo.
en: So Queen Esther daughter of Abihail, along with Mordecai the Jew, wrote an official letter about Purim. They wrote with full authority of the king to prove that the second letter was true.

dag: Amaa di chaŋya Bɛrishiiba ni yi ti jɛm ma bee n-chaŋ Bɛtɛl ni yi ti nya ma, dama Bɛtɛl ni kpalim yoli. Yi mi di chaŋya Giligal, dama bɛ ni gbahi Giligalnim kuli tinduli ni.
en: But dont look in Bethel. Dont go to Gilgal. Dont cross the border and go down to Beersheba. The people of Gilgal will be taken away as prisoners, and Bethel will be destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni chɛ ka bindirigu yi zuɣusaa luna, ka sokam chani ti pihir o dahin yini dibu tariga dabisili kam, ka n kpahim ba nya bɛ ni tooi doli n zaligu bee bɛ ku tooi dol li.
en: The Lord said to Moses, I will send bread down from heaven like rain. Tell the people to go out each day and gather only enough for that day. That's how I will see if they obey me.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya suhupiɛlli ŋun nyɛ yi namda ŋɔ zuɣu. Ziɔnnima, maliya suhupiɛlli yi Naa zuɣu.
en: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.

dag: Amaa ka o yidan maa daa dol o kuhiri hal ni Bahurim. Ka Abinɛr daa ti yɛl o, Ŋmaligi lab kuli, ka o daa lab kuli.
en: Her husband went with her all the way to Bahurim, crying as he followed her. Go home! Abner told him. So he went home.

dag: Dabisili din pah anahi dali, zaŋmiya naɣilahi pia mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: Ka Pita daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la doli ba. Nyaandol maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒi n-tab Yisa bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu ka bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi a nyaaŋ la.
en: Peter turned around and saw behind him that other disciple, whom Jesus loved—the one who had leaned close to Jesus at the meal and had asked, Lord, who is going to betray you.

dag: Dama di naan tibisi gari teeku bihigu. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri yiriŋ maa.
en: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba pam tooni ka n yɛn zaŋ laŋa n-labi pir a n-vo a n laŋ maa ni du na.
en: King of Egypt, listen to me. I, the Lord God, will catch you in my net and let a crowd of foreigners drag you to shore.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka mɔɣu ni damda. Yawɛ chɛ ka Kadɛshi mɔɣu ni dam.
en: the LORDs voice shakes the wilderness— yes, the LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: If David calls him Lord, how can he be Davids son.

dag: ka bɔhi Musa, Gbala n-daa lee ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti na ni ti ti kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ ti yi Ijipti na?.
en: They also complained to Moses, Wasn't there enough room in Egypt to bury us? Is that why you brought us out here to die in the desert? Why did you bring us out of Egypt anyway?.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabia, n suhir a, Niŋm ma nirilim ŋɔ ti Duuma zuɣu. Kpaŋsimi n suhu Masia ni.
en: Yes, brother, I want this favor from you in the Lord! Refresh my heart in Christ.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus replied, Havent you read what David and his companions did when they were hungry?.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka Filistianim maa daa yɛli, Nyamiya, Hiburunim la yiri bɛ ni sɔɣi bɛmaŋ vo shɛŋa la ni na.
en: So they let the Philistines see them, and the Philistines said, Look! Some Hebrews are coming out of the holes they have been hiding in.

dag: Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi me duu ti o, dama alizanda mini di galisim zaa ku saɣ o? Ka m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni nti mɛri duu tir o? N kul yɛn mɛla luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim o tooni.
en: But who is able to build such a temple when even the highest heaven cant contain God? And who am I that I should build this temple for God, except as a place to burn incense in his presence?.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa kpɛla Baalnim jɛmbu ni.
en: So the Israelites did something very evil before the Lord . They began serving the false god Baal.

dag: amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda hal ti kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Nyama, hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm bi paai di pirigili gba. A yɛm min a tɔŋbu yɛla gari n ni wum di yɛla shɛm.
en: But I couldn't believe it until I had come and seen it all for myself. But I didn't hear even half of it; your wisdom and wealth are much greater than what I was told.

dag: Lɛvinim ni gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-zani gili naa, ka ŋunkam kpe nayili maa na, bɛn kum o. Kul benya naa sani, o yi ti yɛn yina, yin benya o sani, ka o yi ti labiri kpɛra yin benya o sani.
en: The Levites must stay near the king. Every man must have his sword with him. If anyone tries to enter the Temple, kill that person. You must stay with the king everywhere he goes.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb malila bɛ chɛchɛbunsi nyuri bara; ka shɛb mi mali bɛ yuri nyuri bara, amaa tinim malila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli nyuri bara.
en: Some trust in their war chariots and others in their horses, but we trust in the power of the Lord our God.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa niriba daa be kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ yaannim maa n-daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Mɛshulam ni Shiiba ni Jɔrai ni Jakan ni Zia ni Ɛba. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: The other members of the tribe belonged to the following seven clans: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.

dag: Mani m-mi o, amaa yinim kul ʒi o. Ka n yi yɛli ni n ʒi o, n ni leei ʒirilana kaman yinim la. M mi o, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.

dag: A ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu, ka a nudirigu sɔŋ ma. A chɛ ka n leei ninvuɣ titali a sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: Lord, you have given me your shield to protect me. You support me with your right hand. It is your help that has made me great.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so n-niŋ amaŋka ni n-ʒi o ka Yisa sanna; ka Yisa daa nya bɛ ni niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: Some people soon brought to him a man lying on a mat because he could not walk. When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, My friend, don't worry! Your sins are forgiven.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lura, ka sokam zaŋ bɛ bar shɛb dɔro balibu kam ni mali tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: When the sun was setting, everyone brought to Jesus relatives and acquaintances with all kinds of diseases. Placing his hands on each of them, he healed them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee. Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ lala.
en: And the commander of the Lord 's army told him, Take your sandals off; you are standing on holy ground. And Joshua did as he was told.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la, ka ti ti a tiliginsim.
en: Show us your constant love, O Lord , and give us your saving help.

dag: Ka kpiimba mini tampiligim vinvamli ni zaa ni pu shɛŋa din be Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli zaa ni Wɔhu Dunɔdali din be gooŋgɔŋ shee zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo la ni ti nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan wurim li bee n-saɣim li yaha.
en: The entire valley defiled by corpses and ashes, and all the fields as far as the Kidron Valley and the Horse Gate on the east, all this will be set apart for the LORD. And the city will never again be dug up or overthrown.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ŋmaai di puuni palo din nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di leei Naawuni jɛmbu duu palo, ka di yaɣili kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu. Ka yi ŋmaai palo din yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu gili di zaa.
en: In this area there is to be a square plot of land for the Temple, feet on each side, entirely surrounded by an open space feet wide.

dag: Ti ni daa ti miriti Saipurus ka ti chɛ li bahi ti nuzaa polo ka chaŋ Taai din be Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa yɛn yihi nɛma ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: We came to where we could see Cyprus, and then sailed south of it on to Syria. We went ashore at Tyre, where the ship was going to unload its cargo.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni; ka shɛb mi ŋahiri mɔɣu ni tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: Many people spread out their clothes on the road while others spread branches cut from the fields.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tampiŋ bi be kaman ti Tampiŋ ŋɔ. Hal ti dimnim maa gba mi lala.
en: But, no, their rocks cant compare to our rock! Our enemies are completely stupid.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi, ka bɛ mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaaniba ti dii tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: Then the Pharisees left and made plans with the Herodians about a way to kill Jesus.

dag: ka pɔb o nina ka yɛl o, A daanabitali puuni, wuhim ti bɛn ŋmɛr a ŋɔ.
en: They covered his eyes so that he could not see them. Then they hit him and said, Be a prophet and tell us who hit you.

dag: bee n-ni suh o zahim ka o gbaai wahu ti o?.
en: Or give them a snake when they ask for fish?.

dag: Stiivin daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim suhutunanim ŋɔ, yi nyɛla tipawumlinim yi suhuri ni; yi kul zaɣisirila Naawuni Shia Kasi. Yi yaannim biɛhigu maa ka yi gba kul doli.
en: How stubborn you are! Stephen went on to say. How heathen your hearts, how deaf you are to God's message! You are just like your ancestors: you too have always resisted the Holy Spirit!.

dag: A daa lan zaŋ n ni ti a salima min anzinfa yɛ viɛli shɛŋa la m-mali binnana din nyɛ dɔbba n-zaŋ ba tum pagɔrisigu tuma.
en: Then you took your beautiful jewelry that I gave you, and you used the gold and silver to make statues of men, and you had sex with them too!.

dag: Man Daniɛl ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa, n daa kul bɔri ni m baŋ di gbinni. N nini nyabu yim ka n daa nya ka so ʒe n tooni ka o kɔtomsi be kaman ninsal kɔtomsi la.
en: I, Daniel, saw this vision and tried to understand what it meant. While I was thinking about the vision, someone who looked like a man suddenly stood in front of me.

dag: Lala ka Ɛdomnim daa niŋ n-zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan su ba, o ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Duuma Naawuni jɛmbu la zuɣu.
en: Since that time and until now the country of Edom has been rebellious against Judah. The people from the town of Libnah also turned against Jehoram. This happened because Jehoram left the Lord God. He is the God Jehorams ancestors followed.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɛ ŋmanila zahindi shɛli nir ni yi zahim ka neei la, o yi neei di bemi kaman shilinshia la.
en: Then they will be like a dream that we forget when we wake up. You will make them disappear like the monsters in our dreams.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli naa, N suhir a mi, a yi ku chaŋ, nyin lee chɛ ka ti mini m mabia Amnɔn chaŋ. Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔri ni yi min o chaŋ.
en: Absalom said, If you dont want to go, please let my brother Amnon go with me. King David asked Absalom, Why should he go with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi tahi sara sara malibu shee ka ti teei ni a mali taali a kpe so sani.
en: Therefore, if you bring your gift to the altar and there remember that your brother or sister has something against you.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be alizanda ni la daa yooi ka o Daalikauli Adaka la be di puuni; ka saa daa nyaɣisiri ka tahira, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda, ka sakuɣ kara luri na.
en: Then Gods temple in heaven was opened. The Box of the Agreement could be seen in his temple. Then there were flashes of lightning, noises, thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi biɛhigu shee wɔɣa, ka yi ku tooi zaŋ li chaŋ nimaani, ka di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii tin shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani wɔɣilim maa zuɣu.
en: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest.

dag: Tinsi maa yɛn nyɛla nir ni yɛn zo n-kuli shɛli n-yi ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri nuu ni, ka lala chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ku kpi hal ti zani salo ni ka bɛ kar o saria.
en: The cities will be for you a place of refuge from the close relative of the dead. The person who killed someone may not be put to death until he stands before the community for judgment.

dag: ka Jarɛd nyɛ Ɛnok ba, ka Ɛnok nyɛ Mɛtusɛla ba, ka Mɛtusɛla nyɛ Lamɛk ba, ka Lamɛk mi daa nyɛ Nuhu ba.
en: Jared was the father of Enoch, who was the father of Methuselah; Methuselah was the father of Lamech.

dag: O nyaya ka nimaani vuhim shee viɛla, ka di tiŋgbani biɛhigu mali kɔre. Dinzuɣu ka o deei talahi n-tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: He will see his land is pleasant and that his resting place is good. But he will agree to carry heavy loads; he will agree to work as a slave.

dag: ka di me yiya m-be di ni la. Ti ka wain tihi bee puri bee bimbira.
en: We never build houses to live in, we never own vineyards or fields, and we never plant crops.

dag: Dama Aram mini Ifriim zuliya ni Rɛmalia bia maa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka yɛra.
en: Syria, together with Israel and its king, has made a plot.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Pita mini Jɔn daa ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni kurig ata saha din nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naawuni jɛmbu saha la.
en: One day Peter and John went to the Temple area. It was three oclock in the afternoon, which was the time for the daily Temple prayer service.

dag: ka leei ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ka di pala o yila maligumaaniba zuliya ni na kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu, amaa ka nyɛla maligumaana nyɛvil shɛli din ku bahi yol la yiko zuɣu.
en: He has become a priest by the power of a life that cant be destroyed, rather than a legal requirement about physical descent.

dag: Ti yi ti suhuri Naawuni tiri ya, ti kul paɣirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Malimiya nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ bihi mini zaɣ kara n-chaŋ tɔb tuhibu.
en: Get your large and small shields ready. March out for battle.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba tiŋ maa puuni Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad.
en: The king sent messengers to King Ahab of Israel who was inside the city.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa chaŋ Tɛbiz ti teei gil li ŋ-ŋme n-deei li.
en: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, surrounded that city, and captured it.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baai bɛ bandi la, ka chihi bɛ mihi la ti niŋgbuna ni.
en: Let us free ourselves from their rule, they say; let us throw off their control.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ bihi kpi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti be tinduya ni.
en: He promised to scatter them among the nations and to let other people defeat their descendants.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka tarimba mali tahima, ka putɔɣunim fo bɛ noya.
en: He gives hope to the poor and silences the wicked.

dag: Sana yi be yi sani, yin zaŋmiy o leei tiŋbia yi sani, ka yur o kaman yimaŋmaŋ la. Dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Any immigrant who lives with you must be treated as if they were one of your citizens. You must love them as yourself, because you were immigrants in the land of Egypt; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ka wahu maa daa tuhi kom o nol ni na kaman mɔɣili kom la ni di zo n-doli paɣ maa ti di o.
en: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shih o bindoo, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches her bed must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim daa chaŋ ti to jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm puɣisi gbaai Yisa o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: Then the Pharisees left the place where Jesus was teaching. They made plans to catch him saying something wrong.

dag: Ka Sulemaana yɛli, A daa yur a dabili m ba Dauda pam, o ni daa dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali mini wuntitali ni biɛritibitali o suhu ni la zuɣu, ka a daa yu o yurilim maa tatabo, ka ti o bidibiga ni o ʒin o nam ʒiishee zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Solomon answered, You were very kind and loyal to your servant, my father David. He was faithful to you and lived a good, honest life. And you showed him the greatest kindness when you let his son take his place as king.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli naa maa ni biɛhiŋ kani, o ni kpaŋ; amaa Yawɛ lee kahigi wuhi ma ni o ni bahi kpi.
en: Elisha answered, The Lord has revealed to me that he will die; but go to him and tell him that he will recover.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee din mali kpiɔŋ; ka chɛ ka barina shɛli ka n soli zuɣu.
en: Only God! My mighty fortress, who makes my way perfect.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yihi ti dabitim ni labisi Ziɔn na, di daa ŋmanila zahindi ka ti zahinda.
en: It will be like a dream when the Lord comes back with the captives of Zion.

dag: Dunɔdali zɔntua maa ni, teebuya ayi daa ʒiɛla yaɣ yini polo ka teebuya ayi ʒe yaɣ din la polo. Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛn kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la min alahichi sara ni alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: In this entrance room there were four tables, two on each side of the room. It was on these tables that they killed the animals to be offered as sacrifices, either to be burned whole or to be sacrifices for sin or as repayment offerings.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-niŋ ya alaka, ka kun ya; ka zuliya kam ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: Then you will be arrested and handed over to be punished and killed. People all over the world will hate you because you believe in me.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa zaa ni daa yiri tiŋ maa ni, bɛ daa zanila yili shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: The king left with everyone in his house following him on foot. They stopped at the last house.

dag: Amaa ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa bi tooi kari tinsi maa nima; ka Keenannim maa daa kul kpalim be tinsi maa ni.
en: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.

dag: Naa, di gbinni m-bala. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm m-bala.
en: King, this is the meaning of the dream. God Most High has commanded these things to happen to my lord the king:.

dag: Ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, pa lala n-nyɛ li. So n-yi di neei kum ni chaŋ bɛ sani nti yɛli ba, bɛ naan niŋ tuuba.
en: The rich man said, No, Father Abraham! But if someone from the dead goes to them, they will change their hearts and lives.

dag: Ka o daa dihiri Izraɛlnim vi, ka Dauda mabia Shimɛi bia Jɔnatan mi daa ku o.
en: This man challenged Israel and made fun of them, but Jonathan killed this man.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma n wuntitali laara, n ni ka galimi o sani la zuɣu.
en: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari n-dahim doya, ka bɛ ni daa mali yiko shɛli nyuri bara maa zani tariga; ka Izraɛl zoya zaa ti kpalim zaɣ nɛya hal ka so ku lan gari di gbini.
en: I will make the whole country an empty wasteland and crush the power in which you take such pride. Even the mountains will be bare, and no one will try to cross them.

dag: Cham ti sab niŋ litaafi ni zali wuhi niriba maa ni nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri shɛm; ka di ti di ba shɛhira sahakam.
en: Now write this on a sign so that all people can see it, and write this in a book. Write these things for a future time. This will be far, far in the future:.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Yɛla ŋɔ yipa niŋ pali yi sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: as he said to them, This passage of scripture has come true today, as you heard it being read.

dag: o ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim bɛ sani, ka be kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka wuntaŋ puhi na asiba ka o neesim be shɛm la; ka be kaman saa ni yi mi ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni yina shɛm la.
en: is like the sun shining on a cloudless dawn, the sun that makes the grass sparkle after rain.

dag: N ni zaŋ kuɣ yini shɛli din mali nina ayopɔin sɔŋ Jɔshua tooni; ka sab sabbu shɛli pa di zuɣu yɛli, Dahin yini puuni, n ni ti yihi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daalahichi bahi.
en: I am placing in front of Joshua a single stone with seven facets. I will engrave an inscription on it, and in a single day I will take away the sin of this land.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim deei nam maa ti o.
en: When Rehoboam arrived at Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand select warriors, to fight against Israel and to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka saha daa ti paai ni bɛ zaŋ o ti bahi, ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa pihi bia maa ni o ti wums o n-zaŋ o leeg omaŋmaŋ bia.
en: After he was abandoned, Pharaohs daughter adopted and cared for him as though he were her own son.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋ chaŋ yuntisuɣu saha, n ni kpe Ijipti tiŋ puuni.
en: Moses then said to the king, The Lord says, At about midnight I will go through Egypt.

dag: Anabi Musa daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba zaa sani kaman yilibia la ni o di Naawuni ni ti yɛn yɛli binshɛŋa yɛla la shɛhira;.
en: Moses was faithful in all Gods house as a servant in order to affirm the things that would be spoken later.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa nya gariŋga maa ni kaai vil o nuu maa ka yɛli taba, Biɛhiŋ kani, doo ŋɔ nyɛla ninvuɣ kura; hal o ni tiligi kom dibu ni teeku ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, biɛr bɔhibu na kul bi saɣi ni o be.
en: When the islanders saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, This man must be a murderer! He was rescued from the sea, but the goddess Justice hasnt let him live.

dag: Nir yi gbilisi tibili wum saɣisigu viɛnyɛliŋga, bɛ ni kal o pahi yɛnnim ni.
en: If you pay attention when you are corrected, you are wise.

dag: Amaa dindali maa, n ni woligi Goshɛn, n niriba ni be luɣ shɛli polo la, ka zɔhi maa ti ku be nimaani dina din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: But I will not treat the Israelites the same as the Egyptians. There will not be any flies in Goshen, where my people live. In this way you will know that I, the Lord , am in this land.

dag: Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba daa mali niɣi pam. Bɛ ni daa nya ka Jaza mini Giliad tiŋgbana simdi niɣi biɛhigu shee.
en: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.

dag: Dama bɛnkam ti tum din chihiri maa, bɛn yihim ba bɛ daŋ ni.
en: Whoever does any of these terrible sins must be separated from their people!.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa suhuri daa kpaŋ ka bɛ gba zaŋ bindirigu di.
en: They took courage, and every one of them also ate some food.

dag: Ka so yi muɣis a ni a ʒi o ʒili n-tah o tin shɛli din pa a ya zuɣu kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm tariga, nyin ʒim li yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.

dag: Amaa bɛ gul maa yi nya ka tɔbu kanna, ka o bi piɛbi kikaa maa, ka niriba maa bi baŋ ka tɔbu maa di ba, bɛ daalahichi zuɣu ka tɔbu maa di ba maa, amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ kum maa taali ʒilila bɛ gula maa.
en: If the lookout sees the sword coming but doesnt blow the trumpet to warn the people, when the sword comes and takes away any of them, they are taken away in their sin, but Ill hold the lookout responsible for their blood.

dag: A zaŋ pɔhim leeg a tuumba, ka zaŋ buɣim mini buɣim niɛm leeg a tumtumdiba.
en: You make the winds your messengers and flames of fire your servants.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma tuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: Tychicus is my dear brother in Christ. He is a faithful helper and he serves the Lord with me. He will tell you everything that is happening with me.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ baŋ? Zallakudura Naa malila baŋsim.
en: And what they say is this: How could God possibly know! Does the Most High know anything at all.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka kum ku bɛ bihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ paɣiba leei pakoya ni bɛn kɔŋ bɛ bihi. Chɛ ka alɔbo ku bɛ dɔbba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ nachimba tɔbu ni.
en: Enough! Let their children starve; let them die by the sword. Let their wives be barren widows; let their men be slaughtered and their youth struck down in battle.

dag: Tiŋgban ni bindira niŋya pam; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni.
en: God, our God, bless us. Let our land give us a great harvest.

dag: Naawuni tamla o nirilim niŋbu la yɛla? O suhuyiɣisili chɛ ka o zaɣisila nambɔɣu zɔbu.
en: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has anger taken the place of his compassion.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ mi ni n nya yi taali, dama m pun yɛli ya ni yi yɛla be ti suhuri ni, ka ti mini ya nyɛla zaɣ yini, di yi nyɛ nyɛvil ni bee kum puuni.
en: Im not saying this to make you feel guilty. Ive already said that you are in our hearts so that we die and live together with you.

dag: N ni bɔhim so shɛli din ka galimi yɛla. Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn ka n sanna? N ni mali biɛhigu din viɛla n suhu ni n yiŋa.
en: I want to study the way of integrity— how long before it gets here? I will walk with a heart of integrity in my own house.

dag: A mali tumtumdiba pam; kuɣikpɛriba mini tammɛriba ni kapintanima ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim balibu kam zaa tumtumdiba bɛn ka kalinli.
en: You have many stonecutters and carpenters. You have men skilled in every kind of work.

dag: Ka pako faralaan so daa kana nti tɔhila pihinu diba ayi din nyɛ kɔbo.
en: Finally, a poor widow came up and put in two coins worth only a few pennies.

dag: Di simdi ni di ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛi, ka di mini di binyila zaa ti nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini.
en: You must make the altar square— cubit long and cubit wide. It must be cubits high. There will be horns at the four corners. These horns must be made as one piece with the altar.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa, ka a wuntia zaligunim zaa nyɛla din kul ni be sahakam.
en: The heart of your law is truth, and all your righteous judgments are eternal.

dag: Siɣisimiya yimaŋ be baalim, ka mali suɣilo sahakam. Dimiya suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi tab polo yurilim puuni.
en: Be always humble, gentle, and patient. Show your love by being tolerant with one another.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz leei naa zal o ba zaani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The people of Judah chose Jehoahaz to be the new king in Jerusalem. Jehoahaz was Josiahs son.

dag: Ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, dama n labirila m Ba sani ka yi ku lan nya ma.
en: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.

dag: Di yi pa lala bɛ ni nyuli kuli, ka tam zaligu yɛla, ka mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zaa yɛlimaŋli.
en: Otherwise, they will drink and forget the law, and violate the rights of the needy.

dag: ni buɣijɛmbo ni baɣibuɣibo ni dimdi ni zabili ni nyuli zabbu ni suhuyiɣisili ni zunyuŋ ni naŋgbankpeeni ni tab woligibu.
en: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are.

dag: N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni zoya sunsuuni tiŋgban kuŋ ni, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina yooi vinvama ni. N ni chɛ ka kom puhigi mɔɣu ni zɔra, ka chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgban kuŋ ni na zɔra.
en: I will open streams on treeless hilltops and springs in valleys. I will make the desert into ponds and dry land into cascades of water.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam mi zaɣ suŋ tumbu ka bi tum li, di nyɛla alahichi o sani.
en: So then, if we do not do the good we know we should do, we are guilty of sin.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa dol o naɣikɔra yi puuni kunna ti wum kuhigu maa ka bɔhi, Ka bɔ n-niŋ niriba maa ka bɛ zaa ti kuhiri lala? Ka bɛ daa yɛl o Jabɛshinim ni ʒi lahiba shɛli maa na.
en: At just that moment, Saul was coming back from keeping the cattle in the fields. Whats wrong with everybody? he asked. Why are they crying? Saul was then told what the men from Jabesh had said.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii niriba maa zuliyazuliya n-zali gooni maa nyaaŋa Palɔni naɣilima ni mini paliyari ni, ka bɛ gbibi takɔbiri mini kpana ni tɔbiri.
en: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.

dag: Dama n zal a la dabisa kɔbisita ni pihiwɛi, ka di mini bɛ tibidarigibo yuma kalinli saɣi. Dinzuɣu lala ka a yɛn ʒi Izraɛlnim tibidarigibo maa.
en: I appoint to you three hundred ninety days, one day for each year of their guilt. So you will bear the punishment of the house of Israel.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa piripiri tinsi maa ni di momaha tiŋgbana maa tari Lɛvinima.
en: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.

dag: min o ni daa lan ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali n-chɛ ka bɛ ʒim zo n-tiɛli Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ taali.
en: He did this because Manasseh killed many innocent people and filled Jerusalem with their blood. The Lord would not forgive these sins.

dag: Dinzuɣu Iso ni daa nya ka o ba Yisahaku nini bi tiɣi Keenan paɣiba maa.
en: Esau then understood that his father Isaac did not approve of Canaanite women.

dag: Di saha ka buɣim daa yi Yawɛ sanna ti di ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu bɛn daa tuɣili tulaale zim maa.
en: Then a fire came from the Lord and destroyed the men who were offering the incense.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n wumya. A nini shiri ku lan nya ma.
en: You are right, Moses answered. You will never see me again.

dag: Ninvuɣ pihita maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Asahɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la mini Ɛlhanan ŋun ba daa nyɛ Dɔdo Bɛtilihɛm nir la.
en: Among the Thirty were: Asahel, Joabs brother; Elhanan, Dodos son from Bethlehem.

dag: Anabinima n-su bɛmaŋmaŋ shihi fukumsi.
en: The gift of proclaiming God's message should be under the speaker's control.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu nyaaŋa nyɛla vi dibu, amaa bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm.
en: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.

dag: Ka Pita daa nya lala ka bɔhi niriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, bɔ n-niŋ ka yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba bee wula ka yi ti yuuni ti kaman tinim maŋmaŋ yiko ni bee ti wuntitali zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu ŋɔ yiɣisi leei ŋun chani maa.
en: When Peter saw this, he said to the people, My Jewish brothers, why are you surprised at this? You are looking at us as if it was our power that made this man walk. Do you think this was done because we are good?.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋda maa yɛl o, Karimba, achiika! A yɛli yɛlimaŋli; dama Naawuni yino n-shiri beni, ka Naawuni so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The man answered, That was a good answer, Teacher. You are right in saying that God is the only Lord and that there is no other God.

dag: Mira! Di lan tum tuumbiɛri; di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ wahala zahim a maa.
en: Take care; dont turn to evil because youve chosen it over affliction.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o yɛm zali dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o baŋsim nam zuɣusaa.
en: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.

dag: Ŋun daa ʒiya maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa jasipa ni kanɛlian la; ka sagani din ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli ɛmɛrald la booi gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: The one sitting there was as beautiful as precious stones, like jasper and carnelian. All around the throne was a rainbow with clear colors like an emerald.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti lan yiɣisi ni o kuli, ka o deemba maa lan balim o hal ka o ti lan gbe yaha.
en: The Levite got up to go, but the father urged him to stay, so he spent another night there.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di shihi ma; dama n na bi chaŋ m Ba sani. Amaa cham m mabihi la sani nti yɛli ba ni n chanila m Ba ŋun nyɛ yi gba Ba la ni n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi gba Naawuni la sani.
en: Jesus told her, Don't hold on to me! I have not yet gone to the Father. But tell my disciples I am going to the one who is my Father and my God, as well as your Father and your God.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣi, ka chɛ ka amiliya niŋbu dakulo maa naai, ka Leeban daa lan zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So Jacob did this and finished the week. Then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as a wife.

dag: Ka kpiin shɛb bɛn kpalim bɛn bi neei kum ni hal ti paai yuun tuhili maa tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kum ni neebu din daŋ tooni la.
en: This is the first raising of the dead.

dag: Pakoli maa ni da kpɛri ni o ti tooi kom maa na, ka o lan bol o yɛli, Piim mahili mali ma na.
en: She went to get some water. He then said to her, Please get me a piece of bread.

dag: Baŋdiba maa ni daa kuli maa ka ti Duuma malaika la ka Yisifu sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ biliɛɣu maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti ʒini nimaani hal ka n ti lan ti a zilinli, dama Naa Hɛrɔd bɔri ni o bola bia maa shee ku o.
en: When the magi had departed, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, Get up. Take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod will soon search for the child in order to kill him.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa wuhi ma, ka m baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa wuhi ma bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.

dag: Dama di saha a ti ku lan kaani n napɔna yaabu, a ti ku lan yuuni n daalahichi.
en: Though you now number my steps, you would not keep a record of my sin.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuun kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He alone performs great miracles; his love is eternal.

dag: Ka Omri mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa yi Gibɛtɔn n-chaŋ ti teei gili Tiriza.
en: At once, Omri and his army marched to Tirzah and attacked.

dag: Ka Aduna bia Ɛliɛza gba daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Gibia fɔntin shɛli din be Ifriim zoya tiŋgban ni, ka o daa zaŋ li ti o bia Finɛhas la.
en: Eleazar son of Aaron died. They buried him at Gibeah, which belonged to his son Phinehas. It had been given to him in the highlands of Ephraim.

dag: Tim Yawɛ jilima a ni mali shɛlikam ni, ka zaŋ a puu bindir daŋda zaa gba ti o jilima.
en: Honor the LORD with your wealth and with the first of all your crops.

dag: M muɣisigu puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: In tight circumstances, I cried out to the LORD. The LORD answered me with wide-open spaces.

dag: O yi vuhi, buɣim taarila sala, ka buɣim zibizibi yir o noli ni na.
en: His breath starts fires burning; flames leap out of his mouth.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi, ka chɛ ka di tahi bɔɣi; liɣimi di tahibu maa, dama di kul sɔhirimi.
en: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn, ka zo n-yi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-be kaman bulahi m-be tooni mali bɛ tab chan la.
en: Escape from Babylonia, my people. Get out of that country! Don't wait for anyone else.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo wuhiri ni di bi tuhi ni nir kpuɣ paɣa bee n-diri bindira balibu shɛŋa Naawuni ni nam ti salinima ni bɛn niŋ yɛda ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli la diri li ka paɣiri ŋun Naawuni di zuɣu la.
en: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti ka lu ti zuɣu; a je suli niŋ ti. Labisim ti zali yaha!.
en: God, you have rejected us— shattered us. Youve been so angry. Now restore us!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Jesus said to them, All of you will run away and leave me, for the scripture says, God will kill the shepherd, and the sheep will all be scattered.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi Chɛrubinim zuɣusaa ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa fukumsi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa.
en: Almighty Lord , God of Israel, seated above the winged creatures, you alone are God, ruling all the kingdoms of the world. You created the earth and the sky.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka niŋdi n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka doli n zaligunim zaa.
en: You must serve me with a pure and honest heart, just as your father David did. You must obey my laws and do everything that I commanded you. If you obey all I have commanded, and if you obey my laws and rules.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: the Lord asked, Satan, where have you been? Satan replied, I have been going all over the earth.

dag: Di daa sabila Hiburuli ni mini Latinli ni ni Giriikili ni. Ka Yɛhudianim pam daa karim di ni sab shɛm maa, dama bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa daa mirila tiŋ maa.
en: Many people read it, because the place where Jesus was crucified was not far from the city. The notice was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a jɛmbu duu shiri nyɛla luɣ shɛli din viɛli shee.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!.

dag: Ijiptinim yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Yawɛ ni ʒini sagbani din zɔri yomyom zuɣu n-ka Ijipti na; ka Ijipti wuna nya o ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka Ijiptinim yɛma ŋma.
en: A message about Egypt: Look, the Lord is coming on a fast cloud. He will enter Egypt, and all the false gods of Egypt will shake with fear. Egypts courage will melt away like hot wax.

dag: Vihiriba maa yi ti gindi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti nya ninsal kɔba luɣ shɛli, ŋun bom bini dalim nimaani hal ka kasiɣiriba ti kana ti zaŋ li sɔɣi Hamɔngɔg.
en: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in The Valley of Gog's Army.

dag: Yɛm malibu so salima nɛma zaa, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa shɛli buɣisi li.
en: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni tia maa gbini gbihi. Ka malaika daa shih o ka yɛl o, Yiɣisim di bindirigu.
en: Then he lay down in the shade and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel woke him up and said, Get up and eat.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ku Midian paɣ so maa mi yuli daa boonila Kɔzibi. O daa nyɛla Zur bipuɣiŋga, ka Zur daa nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba dɔɣirikpɛma Midian.
en: The name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi the daughter of Zur, a tribal leader of a Midianite household.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o lan nyɛla ninvuɣ so cheechinim ni pii n-zal o ni o doli ti ka ti tumdi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ti Duuma jilima nyabu zuɣu, ka dimbɔŋɔ wuhi ni ti yuya ni ti sɔŋ ti taba.
en: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman kuɣ tibisili la, ka zuliya shɛli niriba bɛn ti bɔri ni bɛ kpuɣ li ni nya yɛlli. Ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini kana ni bɛ ti liri li.
en: But I will make Jerusalem like a heavy rock—those who try to take it will hurt themselves. They will be cut and scratched. All the nations on earth will come together to fight against Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ omaŋ pahi ninvuɣ nɛma zaa ni mali tahima, dama ba nɛɔŋ so gbuɣin kpiŋ.
en: But anyone who is alive in the world of the living has some hope; a live dog is better off than a dead lion.

dag: n-yɛli, So miri ka o shihi n ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ. Di niŋya n daanabinim ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and telling them, Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu yomyom; n gbarigiya zaa. Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma. Di yi niŋ lala, n ni bemi kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: Please hurry, Lord , and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.

dag: Ka n nyee daa ti nyɔni piɛguliba ata shɛb bɛn daa je ma, ka n kari ba gol yini puuni.
en: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.

dag: Samarianim maa ni daa wum Filip yɛligu ka nya o ni wuhiri shihir shɛŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa ni suhu yini.
en: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.

dag: ni salima sara maligu bimbin ni bɛ ni yɛn boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini suɣili maa dunoli.
en: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-lihiri bɔri paɣisar viɛlli, ka daa ti nya Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣisarili n-zaŋ o na ti ti naa.
en: So they looked in every corner of Israel until they found Abishag from Shunem. They brought her to the king.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kawaan daŋda mini yi wain daŋda ni yi kpa daŋda ni yi ni tuui chɛ biŋkɔbiri kɔb shɛŋa ti o.
en: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.

dag: Di saha maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Filistia Teeku noli ni ti yɛli, Nyamiya din niŋ ti ni zaŋ ti tahima niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni la mini ti ni daa zo nti paai shɛb ni bɛ fa ti Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tiligi? .
en: People living along the coast will say, We trusted those countries to help us. We ran to them so that they would rescue us from the king of Assyria. But look at them. They have been captured, so how can we escape.

dag: Ka Leeban daa laɣim nimaaninim zaa na ka bɛ ti puhi chuɣu.
en: So Laban gave a party for all the people in that place.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ŋmanila Izraɛlnim zaa. Bɛ yɛra, Ti kɔba kuuya zaa, ka ti lan ka tahima; ti yɛla naaya zaa.
en: Then he said to me, Son of man, these bones are like the whole family of Israel. The people of Israel say, Our bones have dried up; our hope is gone. We have been completely destroyed.

dag: N ni tilig a a niriba mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim shɛb sani n ni timd a maa nuu ni.
en: I will rescue you from the people of Israel and from the Gentiles to whom I will send you.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ Midiannim nanim niŋ yi nuu ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Orɛb mini Ziib. Ka n ni tum shɛli lee nyɛla dini, ka n-ni tooi zaŋ li buɣisi yi dini? Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ o sani maa kpi.
en: Besides, God chose you to capture Raven and Wolf. I didn't do a thing compared to you. By the time Gideon had finished talking, the men of Ephraim had calmed down and were no longer angry with him.

dag: Dama bɛ ni zaɣi kaman mɔri la; ka suui kaman vari la.
en: They will soon disappear like grass that dries up; they will die like plants that wither.

dag: Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma anu, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu maa zuɣu.
en: During the fifth year that Rehoboam was king, Shishak king of Egypt came to attack Jerusalem. This happened because Rehoboam and the people of Judah rebelled against the Lord .

dag: Yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni guli ya o yiko puuni n-gu tiliginsim shɛli din mali shili gu ni di ti kahigi wuhi palo ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni la.
en: Gods power protects you through your faith, and it keeps you safe until your salvation comes. That salvation is ready to be given to you at the end of time.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Nyamiya, o boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: Some of the people standing there heard this. They said, Listen! He is calling Elijah.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum maa ni daa ti lu n-gili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa puuni saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ yooi bindira duri maa zaa n-kɔhiri bindira maa Ijiptinim zaa zuɣu, dama kum maa daa miiya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: There was famine everywhere, so Joseph gave the people grain from the warehouses. He sold the stored grain to the people of Egypt. The famine was bad in Egypt.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ya, Yi paai Amɔrinim zoya ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ti la ni.
en: Then I said to you, You have now come to the hill country of the Amorites. The Lord our God will give us this country.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa.
en: The prophet Jeremiah addressed all the people of Judah and all those living in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tuhi nyaŋ Judanim maa, ka sokam zo n-kul o yiŋa.
en: Judah was defeated by Israel, and everyone ran home.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti a tɛhi zilima mini baŋsim, ka o yi ti zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni, a ni doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: And may the Lord your God give you insight and wisdom so that you may govern Israel according to his Law.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa mini Nɛbushaziban ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpem la ni Nɛrigalisharɛza ni Babilɔn naa sapashin kpamba zaa.
en: Nebuzaradan, Nebushazban, Nergal Sharezer, and the other officers of King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: N yilikpɛrilaannima, n nya ka sarati ni paai ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni, ka di pala neen shɛŋa din be ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni bee ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ kɔŋko m-be barina ni, amaa timaŋmaŋ gba nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: Men, I can see that there will be a lot of trouble on this trip. The ship, everything in it, and even our lives may be lost.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛl o, Labim a lan maa sani nti zaŋ amaŋ ti o.
en: He said, Go back to her and be her slave.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ka Filip so ŋun daa yi Bɛtisaida Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti bɔri ni ti nyala Yisa.
en: Philip from Bethsaida in Galilee was there too. So they went to him and said, Sir, we would like to meet Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun su buɣim fukumsi gba daa yi bimbini gbin na n-duh o yee pam yɛli malaika so ŋun gbib gɔr dirili maa, Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala, dama di wala maa mooya zaa.
en: And then another angel, one with power over the fire, came from the altar. He called to the angel with the sharp sickle and said, Take your sharp sickle and gather the bunches of grapes from the earths vine. The earths grapes are ripe.

dag: O ni daa di nam Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, o daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi nira. O daa dila nam maa n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma anii.
en: Jehoram was years old when he began to rule. He ruled eight years in Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu, dama Naawuni n-daa niŋ lala ni o zaŋ ba niŋ Jɛhɔash nuu ni bɛ ni daa jɛmdi Ɛdomnim buɣa la zuɣu.
en: God made Amaziah stubborn because he was planning to punish him for worshiping the Edomite gods. Amaziah refused to listen to Jehoash's warning.

dag: dama yi yɛtɔɣa puuni ka yi ni ti yi taali ni, yi yɛtɔɣa puuni mi ka yi ni ti lan mali taali.
en: Your words will be used to judge you. What you have said will show whether you are right or whether you are guilty.

dag: Ka Siria naa ni ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti teei gili tiŋ shɛli din goma mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Ijipti tɔbbihi ni ti kɔŋ tuhibu, hal bɛ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi gba ti ku lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: So the king of Syria will lay siege to a fortified city and capture it. The soldiers of Egypt will not continue to fight; even the best of them will not have enough strength.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lab Ilaisha sanna Jɛriko o ni daa be luɣ shɛli, ka o bɔhi ba, N daa pun bi yɛli ya ni yi di chaŋ.
en: They returned to Jericho, and Elisha said, I told you that you wouldn't find him.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu maa daa nya yiko n-tɔɣisiri duhimaŋtali mini Naawuni mɔbu yɛtɔɣa, ka mali soli ni o wuh o fukumsi yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm chira pihinahinaayi.
en: The beast was allowed to make proud claims which were insulting to God, and it was permitted to have authority for forty-two months.

dag: Ka a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba tɔbu ni, bɛ yi ŋmaligi lab a sanna n-kuhi bol a yuli ka suh a duu ŋɔ ni.
en: When your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you, and then when they turn to you and come to this Temple, humbly praying to you for forgiveness.

dag: Amaa yinim ni ti mali suhupiɛlli ka yili yila kaman Naawuni chuɣu puhibu dali yuŋ. Yi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn piɛbiri yuhi yiini yila chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim tampiŋ ŋɔ zoli zuɣu.
en: The Lord 's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.

dag: O daa maani maligunima ka tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Manɔa suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka Naawuni malaika maa lan lab paɣ maa sanna saha shɛl o ni daa yi mɔɣ kpaŋ ti ʒiya. Amaa o yidan Manɔa daa ka o sani.
en: God answered Manoah's prayer, and the angel went back to Manoah's wife while she was resting in the fields. Manoah wasn't there at the time.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Paɣ yi niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.

dag: Ka binyɛra maa zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu binshɛli zuɣu di ni leei zaɣ daɣiri, di yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro duu bee daaŋa yin wurimmiya li, di leei daɣiri, ka kul ni nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: Anything on which the dead bodies fall is unclean; a clay stove or oven shall be broken.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛ vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ! A mi ni n dirila n ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri n ni bi di atam shɛli wahala bebɔ?.
en: The master answered, You are a bad and lazy servant! You say you knew that I harvest what I did not plant and that I gather crops where I did not put any seed.

dag: Ka timanim gba daa niŋ bɛ tabibi ni bɛ chɛ ka pɔri yina, ka wolim je. Ka pɔri maa daa kul dimdi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: The magicians used their magic and tried to do the same thing. But the magicians could not make lice come from the dust. The lice remained on the animals and the people.

dag: dama ninsal sujee mini Naawuni wuntia tuma bi dol taba.
en: This is because an angry person doesnt produce Gods righteousness.

dag: M bɔhiri ya, Masia pirigimi ʒii bu shɛm? Pool ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli yi zuɣu la? Bee Pool yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya?.
en: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?.

dag: Amaa Rubin ni daa wum li, ka o fa o bɛ nuu ni ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka ti di o nyɛvili.
en: Reuben heard them and tried to save Joseph. Let's not kill him, he said.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim ni di saha ti paai ka yi teei ni n daa pun yɛli ya di yɛla. N daa bi pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnima piligu ni, ka di nyɛla n ni daa na be yi san la zuɣu.
en: But I have told you this, so that when the time comes for them to do these things, you will remember what I told you. I did not tell you these things at the beginning, for I was with you.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum li, ka kari a daba saria, ka zaŋ taali maa galimi ʒili bɛn tum taali maa, ka bahi bɛn ka taali, ka ti ba laara bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: then listen from heaven, act, and decide which of your servants is right. Condemn the guilty party, repaying them for their conduct, but justify the innocent person, repaying them for their righteousness.

dag: Di saha ka yi ni baŋ ni m be Izraɛlnim sani, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka so lan kani. Ka n niriba mi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa ni yi yaa zaa.
en: Love the LORD your God with all your heart, all your being, and all your strength.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni ti ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day she shall take two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: ka sab bɛ puhigu gbaŋ ti ba. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba mini cheechi kpamba puhiri yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn pa Yɛhudianima m-be Antiɔk mini Siria ni Kilikia zaa ha.
en: They wrote a letter that said: We apostles and leaders send friendly greetings to all of you Gentiles who are followers of the Lord in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, amaa n naɣi yumi ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni ka be.
en: Do I take pleasure in the death of the wicked? says the LORD God. Certainly not! If they change their ways, they will live.

dag: M bi chɛ a zaligu shɛŋa dim pahi la dolibu, dama nyini n wuhi ma li.
en: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti yili yila mali ya ansarisi, ka kum ni fabila pam yɛli, Ti bahi yoli zaa, Yawɛ taɣi n niriba fali ti shɛba. O deei li n sani. O piripiri ti puri tari bɛn gbahi ti maa. .
en: When that time comes, people will use the story about you as an example of disaster, and they will sing this song of despair about your experience: We are completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land away And given it to those who took us captive.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa pa bimbiha zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Aarons sons put these fat parts on the breasts of the bull and the ram. Aaron burned them on the altar.

dag: Yawɛ ni tuhi ba tin ya, kul ʒiɛnya baalim.
en: The Lord will fight for you, and all you have to do is keep still.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi nabi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi galisim ŋmanila saŋmarisi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord our God has blessed us, and so now there are as many of us as there are stars in the sky.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni so yi ni tooi saɣim n ni lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli shɛl la, ka biɛɣu ku lan neei bee ka yuŋ ku lan zibi n ni zal li saha shɛli maa.
en: I, the Lord , have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them.

dag: Judanim daa tum din bie Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa tum alahichi gari bɛ yaannim ni daa tum shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: The people of Judah disobeyed the Lord and made him even angrier than their ancestors had.

dag: Man gba ni garigi, Man gba ni yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: I will answer. Indeed, I will state my piece; I too will declare my view.

dag: A ku ŋmaligi a nini bahi kpaŋ biɛla, ka chɛ ma hal ka n ti vali n nintɔri?.
en: Why not look away from me; let me alone until I swallow my spit?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani Masia ʒim zuɣu maa, din gari lala nyɛla, o zuɣu ka ti ni tiligi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni yaha.
en: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ, ka daa piig o biŋkɔbiri maa ni shɛb ni o ti o biɛli Iso.
en: Jacob spent that night there. From what he had acquired, he set aside a gift for his brother Esau.

dag: Amaa n wuhiri n yurilim ni galisi shɛm niriba tusatusa bɛn yuri ma ka doli n zaligunim sani.
en: But I am loyal and gracious to the thousandth generation of those who love me and keep my commandments.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ Yisifu yiŋ tumtumda maa sani yili maa dunol ni.
en: So when they arrived at Joseph's house, they said to the servant in charge.

dag: m-booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti chani bɛ chandi shee.
en: When people walk by, she calls out to them. They show no interest in her, but still she says.

dag: Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla, ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: and Peter remembered what Jesus had told him: Before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me. He went out and wept bitterly.

dag: Ka nanim mini bɛ tɔbbihi gbaai zɔbu! Ka paɣiba bɛn be yiŋa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa pirigi ti taba.
en: Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri miligi n ni diri wahala shɛli yi zuɣu la zuɣu; di nyɛla din yɛn sɔŋ ya kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: I beg you, then, not to be discouraged because I am suffering for you; it is all for your benefit.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari ninkura, dama n kul gbibila a zaligunim maa.
en: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, so ti ku lan be nimaani, amaa di ni ti kpalimla dabari. Ŋunkam ti gari Babilɔn di ni gar o, ka niŋ o alahiziba di ni wurim shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord will show his anger, so no one will live there. Babylon will be completely empty. Everyone who passes by Babylon will be afraid. They will shake their heads when they see how badly it has been destroyed.

dag: O ni daa tuui me sara maligu bimbini zali luɣ shɛl la; nimaani ka Ibram daa jɛm Yawɛ.
en: that is, to the place at which he had earlier built the altar. There he worshipped in the LORDs name.

dag: Ka bɛ ba Yaakubu yɛli ba, Yi chɛ ka n kɔŋ m bihi. Yisifu lan kani, ka Simiɔn gba kani, ka yi yɛn zaŋ Bɛnjamin mi chaŋ pumpɔŋɔ, n zuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa ʒini.
en: Their father Jacob said to them, Youve taken my children from me. Josephs gone. Simeons gone. And you are taking Benjamin. All this cant really be happening to me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti gari dunoya ayi shɛŋa dunɔguliba ni daa ʒiɛya guli maa zuɣu, bɛ daa mali ti paala kurigu dunoli din yiri kpɛri tiŋ maa puuni. Ka di daa yooi di toli, ka bɛ yi n-doli solɔɣu chaŋ ha ka malaika maa ti dii chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself. After leaving the prison, they proceeded the length of one street, when abruptly the angel was gone.

dag: Di saha ka Rimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nir la bihi bɛn daa nyɛ Rɛkab mini Baana daa yiɣisi lu soli n-daa ti paai Ishibɔshɛt yiŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha din nyɛ saha shɛl o ni daa dɔni ni o vuhi wuntaŋ ni.
en: One day about noon, Rechab and Baanah went to Ishbosheth's house. It was a hot day, and he was resting.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi a suhu ni ni a gba tur a tab pam.
en: And you know that many times you too have said bad things about other people.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ o sɔɣi, bɛ daa bi lan nya o, ka naɣ nyala o zuɣuŋmaŋ min o napɔnvari ni o nuchɛhi.
en: They went to bury her, but they couldnt find her body. Only her skull was left, along with her hands and feet.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti faai siɣi o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Then he died and was buried in the city of David, his father. Then Solomons son Rehoboam became the next king.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tu o la, o daa bi tu so labisi; o ni daa di wahala la, o daa bi tɛhi biɛri bɔhibu yɛla, amaa o daa chɛla shɛlikam niŋ ŋun kariti saria dɛde la nuu ni.
en: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.

dag: ni Mishima ni Duma ni Masa.
en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa.

dag: Ka bɛ daa go n-gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa n-daa mali ti paai tin shɛli din yuli booni Pafɔs. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chirigi do so ŋun nyɛ bukpaha ka o yuli booni Baajiisɛs. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia nira ŋun nyɛ anab ʒirilana.
en: They went all the way across the island to Paphos, where they met a certain magician named Bar-Jesus, a Jew who claimed to be a prophet.

dag: Ka n lan zaŋ Dauda zuliya saafe ti o, ka o ti yooi, ka so ku tooi yo bee ka o ti yo, ka so ku tooi yooi.
en: I will give him complete authority under the king, the descendant of David. He will have the keys of office; what he opens, no one will shut, and what he shuts, no one will open.

dag: Ka Liya bɔh o, A ni fa n yidan maa nyɛla yɛli bila? Ka a lan bɔri ni a fa n ŋmaankpihiga gba pahi? Ka Reechɛl yɛl o, Kpɛm o sani zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa zuɣu.
en: Leah answered, Isn't it enough that you have taken away my husband? Now you are even trying to take away my son's mandrakes. Rachel said, If you will give me your son's mandrakes, you can sleep with Jacob tonight.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lihiri Izraɛl zuliya. Zikiri bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya ni kpɛma, ka Maaka bia Shɛfatia nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya ni kpɛma n-lihiri ba.
en: In charge of the tribes of Israel: for the Reubenites—the leader was Eliezer, Zichris son; for the Simeonites—Shephatiah, Maacahs son.

dag: Bɛ yi bɔri ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, bɛn bɔhimi bɛ yidaannim yiŋa, dama di nyɛla vi ni paɣ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa cheechi ni.
en: If they want to learn something, they should ask their husbands at home. It is disgraceful for a woman to talk during the meeting.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini paɣ shɛba ni Yisa ma Mariama ni Yisa tizɔbihi zaa daa malila tɛhi yini n-laɣim suhiri Naawuni.
en: all were united in their devotion to prayer, along with some women, including Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.

dag: dama anabitali yɛtɔɣa daa bi yirila ninsal suhu yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi n-daa be ninsalinim ni n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa yir o sanna maa.
en: No prophecy ever came from what some person wanted to say. But people were led by the Holy Spirit and spoke words from God.

dag: Yawɛ, daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa ti be bɛ ni bee ninsalinim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla?.
en: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord ? Why do you care about us?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul beni n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma, ka mali tampiɛlli din be kaman mukur la lɔr o shee ni.
en: The boy Samuel served the Lord and wore a special linen garment.

dag: Ka n timdi m mabihi ŋɔ na pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu shɛm la ku kpalim yoli, ka di chɛ ka yi mali shili kaman n ni yɛli ni yi pun mali shili shɛm la.
en: But I am sending these brothers to you. I dont want our bragging about you in this to be for nothing. I want you to be ready just as I said you would be.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ kɔŋko ka buchi; shia n-nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ka n ni pun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la mi nyɛla shia mini nyɛvili yɛla.
en: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulinluhili polo ti yɛli Yawɛ ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: They raise their voice; they sing with joy; from the west they will shout about the LORDs majesty.

dag: Ŋun Yisa n-daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu ka lan neei kum ni ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: He was handed over because of our mistakes, and he was raised to meet the requirements of righteousness for us.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zabila yi zuɣu, ka bɔhi biɛri tin ya. N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn teeku kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka di kɔbilisirim gba nyuui.
en: So this is what the Lord says: I will defend you, Judah. I will make sure that Babylon is punished. I will dry up Babylons sea. And I will make her water springs become dry.

dag: Naawuni daa bi zaŋ dunia shɛli din ti yɛn kana ka nyɛ ti ni tɔɣisiri shɛli yɛla ŋɔ subu fukumsi niŋ malaikanim nuu ni.
en: God has not placed the angels as rulers over the new world to come—the world of which we speak.

dag: M mabiyurisi, hal ti ni kul yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ maa zaa yoli, ti niŋ ya naani. Ti mi ni yi mali bin suma din yi yi tiliginsim ni na ka nyɛ din so binshɛɣukam.
en: Dear friends, I am not saying this because I think it is happening to you. We really expect that you will do better—that you will do the good things that will result in your salvation.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti miri Jɛrusalɛm n-nya li o dii gbaala kuhigu ka fabindi di zuɣu.
en: Jesus came near Jerusalem. Looking at the city, he began to cry for it.

dag: N chaŋmi kaman zaawuni shilinshia la. Bɛ pihigi ma mi bahi kaman sakɔɣu la.
en: I feel my life is over, fading like a shadow at days end. I feel like a bug that someone brushed away.

dag: Ka yi ni pam ni daa naai noli n-darig o tibili shɛm la saɣ lala.
en: It is enough that this person has been punished in this way by most of you.

dag: Duri maa tooni, so shɛli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ puuni. Di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu, ka di dunoya daa be nuzaa polo.
en: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and meters long.

dag: N ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla maa, ka n teei ʒini gbaai kumsi. Dabisi gbaliŋ ka n daa zaŋ fabili ka lo noli n-suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: When I heard this about the people of Jerusalem and about the wall, I sat down and cried. I was very sad. I fasted and prayed to the God of heaven for several days.

dag: Di ŋubiya bɛ nimdi, yi mi di shihiya bɛ zaɣ kpima. Bɛ nyɛla daɣiri bina yi sani.
en: You must not eat the flesh of these animals or touch their dead bodies; they are unclean for you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab Galili tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna din nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kom leei wain la. Ka gomnanti tuma zuɣulan so bidibiga ŋun daa be Kapɛrinium biɛra.
en: He returned to Cana in Galilee where he had turned the water into wine. In Capernaum there was a certain royal official whose son was sick.

dag: N zali zaligu n nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa ni sokam lum Daniɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be, ka ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu. O nam maa kul ku saɣim, ka o yiko mi ku mali tariga.
en: I now issue this command: In every region of my kingdom, all people must fear and revere Daniels God because: He is the living God. God stands firm forever. His kingship is indestructible. Gods rule will last until the end of time.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba kaman Masia ni yuri cheechi maa ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima di zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Husbands, love your wives the same as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.

dag: dindina n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan zɔr o dabiɛm, dama m mi ni m pala bɛ ni tɛhi ni n nyɛ so maa.
en: I am not afraid. I am going to talk because I know my own heart.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, niriba maa na kul galisiya. Zaŋm ba chaŋ kuliga ni ka n ti buɣisi ba nimaani ti a; ka n yi yɛl a ni so ni dol a chaŋ, dilana n-ni dol a chaŋ; ka m mi yi ti yɛl a ni so ku dol a chaŋ, dilan shiri ku dol a chaŋ.
en: Gideon, the Lord said, you still have too many soldiers. Take them down to the spring and I'll test them. I'll tell you which ones can go along with you and which ones must go back home.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o ni daa zaŋ o nubil sabi sabbu shɛli pa kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa zuɣu la ti ma, ka Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa buɣim sunsuuni zoli la gbini laɣiŋgu dal la sabi pa di zuɣu.
en: The LORD gave me the two stone tablets, written by Gods finger, and on them were all the words that the LORD had said to you on the mountain, out of the very fire itself, on the day we assembled.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛ ka din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ a sani leei niriba ni galindi shɛli.
en: Dont allow what is good for you to become something they say is evil.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti tim Adɔram ŋun daa su o tuun kpɛma tumbu fukumsi la Izraɛlnim sani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa pihi kuɣa lab ku o. Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa niŋ yomyom kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-zo kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: A man named Adoniram was one of the men who directed the workers. King Rehoboam sent Adoniram to talk to the people, but the Israelites threw stones at him until he died. King Rehoboam ran to his chariot and escaped to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa, ka tummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ni yi tum shɛm maa, ka miriya ka yi birigi kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo.
en: So you must carefully do exactly what the LORD your God commands you. Dont deviate even a bit!.

dag: M pun zaŋ n naa maa ʒili Ziɔn din nyɛ n zo kasi la zuɣu.
en: I hereby appoint my king on Zion, my holy mountain.

dag: Nimaani daa mali momaha pam, ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa ni bɛ ʒinima. Ka dɔbba bɛn daa ʒini kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu.
en: Jesus said, Tell everyone to sit down. This was a place with a lot of grass, and about men sat down there.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ku vuui, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ku kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Good people will always be safe, but the wicked will be forced out of the land.

dag: O ni daa wum lala maa ka o dii yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to Jesus.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Yi daa bi mi Naawuni so, naɣila mani. Ka tiligira so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: Yet I have been the LORD your God ever since the land of Egypt; and you will know no other gods but me; there is no savior besides me.

dag: Amaa Sɔŋda so n ni yɛn tim ka o yi m Ba sani n-ka yi sanna la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni be so ni. O yi ti kana, o ni leei n shɛhiralana.
