en: When the Companion comes, whom I will send from the Father—the Spirit of Truth who proceeds from the Father—he will testify about me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunɔdal la, ka daa lan me Ofɛl goondaa la pahi.
en: It was Jotham who built the North Gate of the Temple and did extensive work on the city wall in the area of Jerusalem called Ophel.

dag: Naawuni, sara shɛli a ni deeri nyɛla siɣisimaŋtali; a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ so ŋun siɣis omaŋ niŋ tuuba o suhu ni.
en: The sacrifice that God wants is a humble spirit. God, you will not turn away someone who comes with a humble heart and is willing to obey you.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ naɣilaa la na nti mal o min o yiŋnim daalahichi sanyoo sara, ka o ti kɔrigi naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara.
en: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yiɣisi yi nti tɔri jina ni bɛ gbaai bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku Yisa.
en: The Pharisees left and started making plans to kill Jesus.

dag: Ka Akishi daa niŋ Dauda naani pam ka yɛli, O chɛ ka o niriba Izraɛlnim bi lan bɔr o yɛlli zaa, dinzuɣu o kul ni nyɛ n tumtumda sahakam.
en: But Achish trusted David and said to himself, He is hated so much by his own people the Israelites that he will have to serve me all his life.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Di chaŋ wula ka yi baŋdi dunia ŋɔ mini sagbana shihira, ka lee bi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ din shihira.
en: You hypocrites! You can understand the weather. Why dont you understand what is happening now?.

dag: Yɛlim Ziɔnnima, Nyamiya! Yi naa kani yi sanna. O nyɛla maŋsiɣisibulana, ka bari buŋ min o bia.
en: Tell the city of Zion, Look, your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

dag: M bihi, miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa!.
en: Little children, guard yourselves from idols!.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ti shɛŋa bɛ ni sa m-baɣili kulibɔŋ din mali kom, ka di wandi wala di walibu saha, ka di vari bi suura. Bɛ kul dirila nasara bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: They are like a tree replanted by streams of water, which bears fruit at just the right time and whose leaves dont fade. Whatever they do succeeds.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: yi pirigibu buta puuni yim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali yɛn nyɛla dunɔguliba.
en: This is what you must do: A third of you priests and Levites coming on sabbath duty will guard the gates.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-wurindi Babilɔn, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ vuri yɔbu. Bɛ dimnim ni lu bɛ zuɣu kaman kɔgbana la. Bɛ vuri yɔbu maa ka buɣisibu.
en: The shouts of the enemy, like crashing ocean waves, will drown out Babylon's cries as I level the city.

dag: Filistianim ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa, bɛ daa zaŋ li yi Ɛbɛnɛza n-tahila Ashidɔd.
en: The Philistines carried Gods Holy Box, from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ niriba ŋɔ shɛlikam zaa ŋɔ yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: My God, remember all the good I have done for these people.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo, o ʒiɛm a, ka mal a ansarisi; Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga be a nyaaŋa polo n-gbaɣisir o zuɣu niŋd a.
en: Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis di nachiinsi pam, ka bɛ mini sapashinnim mini tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ ti kpe bɛ laɣiŋgu duu. Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ Pool na.
en: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came with great pomp and ceremony and entered the audience hall with the military chiefs and the leading men of the city. Festus gave the order, and Paul was brought in.

dag: Yuuni puuni gol so ŋun be tooni biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka n daa ʒe Tigiris Mɔɣ tital la duli.
en: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Abija daa di nam n-zan o zaani.
en: Rehoboam died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City and his son Abijah succeeded him as king.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni yulilaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Pubilius ka o puri do m-miri nimaani la n-daa deei ti kpɛhi o yiŋa n-niŋ ti saani dabisi muna ata.
en: There were some fields around that same area. They were owned by a man named Publius, the most important Roman official on the island. He welcomed us into his home and was very good to us. We stayed in his house for three days.

dag: Amaa ka so daa zaŋ Ribɛka bituuli Iso ni yɛli shɛm maa ti yɛli Ribɛka, ka o daa tim ti bol o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa na ti yɛl o, A biɛli Iso ni zaŋ shɛli maag omaŋ suhu nyɛla, o lɔrila nia ni o ku a.
en: When Rebekah found out what Esau planned to do, she sent for Jacob and told him, Son, your brother Esau is just waiting for a chance to kill you.

dag: Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka boli di yuli Ɛlbɛtɛl, Naawuni ni daa kahig omaŋ wuh o saha shɛl o ni daa yi o biɛli sani zɔri la zuɣu.
en: He built an altar there and named the place El-bethel, because God had revealed himself to him there when he ran away from his brother.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan yɛl o, N tiŋgbani n-kul do a tooni maa, ʒinimi a ni bɔri ni a ʒini di ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: He said to Abraham, Here is my whole land; live anywhere you like.

dag: Amaa ka wahu maa yɛli paɣ maa, Yi ku kpi.
en: The snake replied, That's not true; you will not die.

dag: Niŋmiya shɛlikam zaa ni yurilim!.
en: Do all your work in love.

dag: Saha shɛli di ni daa wum ya ka gbarigi ya, ka bɛ liri ya n-ku yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nyaaŋa la. Bɛ daa bi zo Naawuni.
en: They had no fear of God, and so they attacked you from the rear when you were tired and exhausted, and killed all who were straggling behind.

dag: N di suɣilo guhi Yawɛ, ka o gbilis o tibili wum n kuhigu.
en: I patiently waited, Lord , for you to hear my prayer. You listened.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino gbib bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe n-gil naa, ka ŋunkam kani bɛ sanna, bɛn kum o. Naa yi ti chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛn kul be o sani.
en: You must stay with him wherever he goes. The whole group must surround the king. Each guard must have his weapon in his hand, and you must kill anyone who comes too close to you.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnim zaŋ chaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa polo, Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim noya woligi la zuɣu.
en: The people felt sorry for the Benjaminites because the Lord had broken the unity of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka Shafan mi daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti naa ka yɛl o, A ni zal a kpambaliba maa ni bɛ tum tuun shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ be di tumbu ni.
en: and Shaphan took it to the king. He reported, We have done everything that you commanded.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi niriba ŋaha yɛli.
en: Once again Jesus used stories to teach the people:.

dag: Yilimiya yila jɛm Yawɛ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o tiligi tarimba nyɛviya tuumbiɛrinim nuu ni.
en: I sing praises to you, Lord . You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.

dag: Ka di daa bi niŋ Ibrahimma nyaɣisim, dama o gba daa nyɛla o bia.
en: This troubled Abraham very much, because Ishmael also was his son.

dag: O mɛla gooni gili ma ni di chɛ ka n ku tooi zo. O zaŋla zoligo titaŋa lo ma.
en: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayɔbu bɛ tinsi maa ni na nti pahi Gibianim zuɣu.
en: The Benjamin tribe had , soldiers, not counting the who were Gibeah's best warriors.

dag: ni Bɛsai daŋ niriba ni Miunim daŋ niriba ni Nɛfushɛsim daŋ niriba.
en: Besai, Meunim, Nephussim.

dag: Bɛ deei kulibɔna dubu shee la, ka nyo bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la buɣim, ka tɔbbihi suhuri fuŋ.
en: The river crossings are blocked; the marshes are on fire; the soldiers are terrified.

dag: Ka wula ka man Dauda ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lee lan yɛn yɛli yaha zaŋ chaŋ a ni tibigi ma shɛm ŋɔ polo? A mi a dabili.
en: What more can I say to you for honoring your servant? You yourself know your servant.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mɛri tandi mi daa zaŋla takɔbi n-so o shee ni ka mɛra. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa piɛbiri kikaa gba daa kul baɣi ma.
en: The builders built with swords fastened in their belts, and the trumpeter stayed by my side.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai bɛ daa laɣimla Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ha n-yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam zaa min o ni daa mali soli ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka bɛ niŋ yɛda shɛm yɛla.
en: When Paul and Barnabas arrived, they gathered the church together. They told them everything God had used them to do. They said, God opened a door for the non-Jewish people to believe.

dag: Ka mɔɣili maa kɔsoya ni kom ni nyɔni, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui; ka kaɣili mini kulimɔri ti kuui zaa.
en: The rivers will stink; the streams will shrink and dry; reeds and rushes will decay.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin.
en: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, Seven small loaves of bread.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Aduna maligumaana leebu piɛlaa nyɔɣu polo n-gahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka di leeg a tarili.
en: Take the breast of the ram for Aarons ordination and lift it as an uplifted offering in the LORDs presence. It will be your portion.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ kurimbuni ha, a nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa.
en: In the beginning, Lord , you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.

dag: Ka o daa mali binyila tam di naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o daa niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: He made a horn for each of the four corners of the altar. He joined each horn to its corner so that everything was one piece. He covered the altar with bronze.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka o zaŋ ya leeg o niriba zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka leei yi Naawuni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu shɛm la.
en: With this agreement he is making you his own special people, and he himself will become your God. He told you this. He promised this to your ancestors—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri niriba yɛligu, o ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali; doli yɛnnim ni yɛn wuh a so shɛli n-tuhi tɔbu.
en: Get good advice when you make your plans. Before you start a war, find good advisors.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-su nam sahakam. A nam kul ʒiɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: You will rule forever, Lord ! You are King for all time.

dag: A du zoli din du pam zuɣu ka zaŋ daba pam mali chaŋ; ka deei pina niriba sani hal zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn je ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be nimaani la sani.
en: He goes up to the heights, taking many captives with him; he receives gifts from rebellious people. The Lord God will live there.

dag: Daadam, n kabi Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ bɔɣu, ka bɛ bi tar li moya bee n-lo li tani din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yaa, ka o zaŋ li gbaai takɔbi yaha.
en: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh, king of Egypt. No one will wrap his arm with a bandage. It will not heal, so his arm will not be strong enough to hold a sword.

dag: Di saha maa Hɛbɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daa woligimi ka chɛ Kɛnnim bɛn daa nyɛ Hɔbab, Musa deemba daŋ niriba la, ka zaŋ o tanti yi kpaŋ ha ti kpa Zaananim oki tia la gbini miri Kɛdɛshi.
en: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses father-in-law, and had settled as far away as Elon-bezaanannim, which is near Kedesh.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi sabbu shɛli sɔŋ. Sabimi li bachibihi kara n yɛli, Mahɛshalalihashibaz dini.
en: The LORD said to me, Take a large tablet, and write on it in ordinary letters, For Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

dag: Amaa ka o ba maa yɛl o yiŋ bihi, Zaŋmiya kpar suŋ na yomyom ti yɛl o, ka zaŋ nintua na ti pir o, ka zaŋ namda na ti pir o pahi.
en: But the father said to his servants, Quickly, bring out the best robe and put it on him! Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kum kana, ka n ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka zaŋ ba labisina. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ doli kulibɔna din mali kom, ka doli soli din tuhi ka ku tuura. Dama n leela Izraɛlnim ba, ka Ifriim nyɛ m bi kpɛma.
en: With tears of joy they will come; while they pray, I will bring them back. I will lead them by quiet streams and on smooth paths so they dont stumble. I will be Israels father, Ephraim will be my oldest child.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Jahat ni Zimma.
en: Gershon's descendants included Libni, Jahath, Zimmah, Joah, Iddo, Zerah, and Jeatherai.

dag: Dɔro di bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa, kum bituuli di bɛ nuhi min bɛ naba.
en: It eats some of their skin. Deaths firstborn consumes their limbs.

dag: Din pahi, o daa lan me fɔntinsi zali Juda zoya ni, ka daa lan me yiya mini du wɔɣila n-zali yɔɣu puuni, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: He built towns in the mountains of Judah and built fortresses and defense towers in the forests.

dag: Shɛma daa nyɛla Raham ba, ka Raham nyɛ Jokiam ba, ka Rɛkɛm mi daa nyɛ Shammai ba.
en: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka chaŋ ti kpe do so ŋun yuli daa booni Taitius Justus la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka o yiŋ daa baɣi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: Paul left the synagogue and moved into the home of Titius Justus, a man who was a worshiper of the true God. His house was next to the synagogue.

dag: Ka hal bɛn daa lu maa yi chɛ biɛhiŋ, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba labisi tuɣi, dama o mali yiko din ni tooi lan labisi ba tuɣi yaha.
en: And if the Jews will believe in God again, he will accept them back. He is able to put them back where they were.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika Yalim vinvamli ni ka labina, ka o yuli daa maan du pam.
en: So David made a name for himself. When he returned, he killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Salt Valley.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a ba Naawuni. Di zɔri dabiɛm ni a kuli Ijipti, dama n ni chɛ ka a daŋ niriba ti leei zuliya bɛn galisi pam.
en: I am God, the God of your father, he said. Do not be afraid to go to Egypt; I will make your descendants a great nation there.

dag: Dinzuɣu nira daa yi yɛn kpe duri maa nudirigu polo dunoya maa ni, a ni dolila duu maa tariga so shɛli din baɣisiri gooni maa wulimpuhili polo.
en: to the chambers on the south side was identical as well. One entered from the east at the beginning of the corresponding wall.

dag: Nir yi garigi bɔhigu viɛnyɛla di nyɛla suhupiɛlli nir kam sani. Ka nir yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di tɔɣisibu saha, di viɛla.
en: To give an appropriate answer is a joy; how good is a word at the right time!.

dag: Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa pa buŋ maa nyaampara ti o ka o ba.
en: The old prophet said to his sons, Saddle my donkey. So they saddled his donkey, and he got on it.

dag: ka yeeg o dabitim binyɛrigu, ka o niŋ a yiŋa goli muni n-kum o banim min o manim kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni tooi zaŋ o niŋ a paɣa, ka a leeg o yidana ka o mi leeg a paɣa.
en: and change her clothes. She is to stay in your home and mourn for her parents for a month; after that, you may marry her.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Ibrahimma, Di simdi ni a min a zuliya maa gbibi n daalikauli maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni.
en: Then God said to Abraham, Now, this is your part of the agreement: You and all your descendants will obey my agreement.

dag: Zuɣusaa, gbilisim tibili wum ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani wum n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Skies, listen and I will speak. Earth, hear the words of my mouth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ijipti do so n-fa ti piɛguliba maa nuu ni bahi hal ka ŋɔŋ kom ti ti ka ti nyuhi ti biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: They answered, An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds, and he even watered our sheep and goats.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizo maa na ka n ti nya o, ka di wuhi ni yi yɛligu maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka yi tiligi. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: But bring your youngest brother back to me so that your words will prove true and you wont die. So they prepared to do this.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Ka bɔzuɣu ka yinim zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya dolibu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus replied, Why do you break the command of God by keeping the rules handed down to you?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi lo tɔbu ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi bɛ dimnim saha shɛlikam, Yawɛ paarila o nuu bɛ zuɣu bɛ daalahichi tumbu zuɣu kaman o ni daa pun kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ka po n-yɛli ba shɛm la. Ka nandahima daa mali ba pam.
en: Whenever the Israelites marched out, the LORDs power worked against them, just as the LORD had warned them. And they were very distressed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi zɔnim zaa yɔhim ya. Bɛ kari ya tahi yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga. Yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi ka taali nyaŋ ya. Yi mini yi zɔnim bɛn laɣindi timdi diri bari ya zana, ka yi ku tooi baŋ li.
en: All those who were your allies have driven you to the border. Those who were on your side tricked you and triumphed over you. They are setting your own bread as a trap under you, but you dont see it coming.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu pam. So ku tooi baŋ o galisim maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You are wonderful, Lord , and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.

dag: Yi na bi bɔhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sochandiba? Yi bi saɣi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Everyone, near and far, agrees.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli din be nuzaa polo katiŋ ha la du pam ka viɛla; di nyɛla na titali tiŋa din tiri dunianim zaa suhupiɛlli.
en: Zion, the mountain of God, is high and beautiful; the city of the great king brings joy to all the world.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa zaŋ niriba maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm ti ti naa. Izraɛl tiŋgban ni, dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii. Ka Juda tiŋgban ni mi nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: Joab came and told David, In Israel there are , who can serve in the army, and in Judah there are .

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba mabia ŋun nyɛ doo paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ma.
en: You will not uncover the nakedness of your fathers brother—that is, you will not approach his wife for sex; she is your aunt.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya tahima Yawɛ sani! Dama yurilim maŋli be Yawɛ sani, ka o mali yiko pam din ni tiligi niriba.
en: Israel, wait for the LORD! Because faithful love is with the LORD; because great redemption is with our God!.

dag: Ka n ni ti saɣim yi jɛmbu shɛhi zaa, ka wurim yi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina, ka ti zaŋ ya zaɣ kpima pa yi buɣ kpima zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ya ni n suhu zaa.
en: I will destroy your places of worship on the hills, tear down your incense altars, and throw your dead bodies on your fallen idols. In utter disgust.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ; chɛliya ka niriba wum o paɣibu maa yɛla.
en: People, praise our God. Sing loud songs of praise to him.

dag: Leeban daa malila bipuɣins ayi; ŋun daa nyɛ kpɛm yuli n-daa booni Liya, ka biasani mi yuli daa booni Reechɛl.
en: Laban had two daughters; the older was named Leah, and the younger Rachel.

dag: ka salo ŋɔ zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋdila takɔbi bee kpani n-tiligir o niriba, dama tɔb ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ tɔbu, ka o mi ni zaŋ ya niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: Everybody here will see that the Lord doesn't need swords or spears to save his people. The Lord always wins his battles, and he will help us defeat you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Patrɔs zani dabari. N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Zɔan, ka ti kari Tɛbisinim saria.
en: The city of Pathros will be left in ruins, and Zoan will be burned to the ground. Thebes, your capital city, will also be destroyed!.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawuni, ka kɔrinsi kana ti lu bɛ suɣa maa gbini luɣ shɛlikam zaa. N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka maligim lu suɣa maa shee.
en: That evening a lot of quails came and landed everywhere in the camp, and the next morning dew covered the ground.

dag: Na so ŋun doli zaligu soli, o tiŋ ni mali suhudoo, amaa na so ŋun yu liɣiri pam ni wurim o tiŋa.
en: A nation will be strong when it has a fair and just king. A nation will be weak when it has a king who is selfish and demands gifts.

dag: O wuɣir omaŋmaŋ garo bimpara. O situra nyɛla tampiɛl viɛlli mini tan ʒiɛkpeein.
en: She makes bedspreads and wears clothes of fine purple linen.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ. Di saha ka ti daa chaŋ ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa.
en: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali tipuma kɔtomsi mini firilanima ni gbabɔnima.
en: the flower decorations, the lamps, and the tongs;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jahaziɛl zuɣu na niriba maa ni. Jahaziɛl daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka Zakaria nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia, ka Bɛnaaya nyɛ Jɛiɛl bia, ka Jɛiɛl mi nyɛ Matania ŋun daa yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Asaf daŋ ni nir la bia.
en: The spirit of the Lord came upon a Levite who was present in the crowd. His name was Jahaziel son of Zechariah; he was a member of the clan of Asaph and was descended from Asaph through Mattaniah, Jeiel, and Benaiah.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga dunia ŋɔ ni. O ni nya yiya mini mabi dɔbba ni tizɔpaɣiba ni banima ni manima ni bihi ni puri m-pahi muɣisigu, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will receive one hundred times as much now in this life—houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and farms —and in the coming age, eternal life.

dag: N ni daa tuui tɔɣisi n-zabi mmaŋ zuɣu saha shɛl la, so daa bi zani n nyaaŋa; sokam zaa daa zomi ka chɛ ma. Naawuni di zaŋ di taali ʒili ba!.
en: No one stood by me the first time I defended myself; all deserted me. May God not count it against them!.

dag: Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, ti zaa ni laɣim mal liɣiri kolibil yini.
en: So join us, and you can share everything we get.

dag: Iso ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi saha shɛli ka o daa kpuɣi Judit ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Bɛri la bipuɣiŋga mini Basɛmat ŋun gba nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛlɔn la bipuɣiŋga.
en: When Esau was years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima mali bans ayi niŋ di yaɣ ayi zuɣu salima din kɔɣili li gili la lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba ni bɛ zaŋdi dapuhi la turi di ni n-kpuɣiri bimbini maa.
en: Then below the edging on opposite sides he attached two gold rings through which he put the poles for carrying the altar.

dag: Bɛ daa mali bɛ ni shɛb ansarisi ka fiɛb ba, ka daa ga shɛb zoligɔnima n-zaŋ ba kpɛhi duu.
en: Some were laughed at and beaten. Others were tied up and put in prison.

dag: O daa lan ti o niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni bihim ni waagasi ni piɛri mini piɛlahi kpam ni Bashan naɣilahi mini buhi ni alikama viɛlli. Yi daa nyu wain tiwala wain viɛlli.
en: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa mi a ni nya la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni laɣim je pagɔrili maa, bɛ ni bah o yoli zaa hal ka o ti kpalim o zaɣim. Bɛ ni ti dari tɔh o ŋ-ŋubi ka chɛ din kpalim n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: The ten horns you saw and the beast will hate the prostitute; they will take away everything she has and leave her naked; they will eat her flesh and destroy her with fire.

dag: Bɛ ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: They dont know how to live in peace. Isaiah :-.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka paɣ maa nyu Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mini bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba Yisa dolibu zuɣu la ʒim n-kuli. N ni daa nya o lala maa, ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: I saw that the woman was drunk on the blood of the saints and the blood of Jesus witnesses. I was completely stunned when I saw her.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la dolibu.
en: If by accident you dont obey all these commands that the LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Fɔnisia, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya. Zomiya kuli Speen.
en: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi yaag o noli? Dabiɛm n kul be o nyina ni ti gili.
en: No one can force him to open his jaws. The teeth in his mouth scare people.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di shiri niŋ kaman o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: The Lord GOD All-Powerful really will destroy this land.

dag: Shɛli daa bi poori bɛ ni so, dama bɛnkam daa mali puri bee yiya daa kɔhi li mi n-zaŋ di liɣiri maa zaa na.
en: There were no needy persons among them. Those who owned properties or houses would sell them, bring the proceeds from the sales.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka dansarika gula maa daa tom ba kpɛhi duu din be puuni ha ni nti ba ba bandi ʒili.
en: Upon receiving this order, the jailer threw them into the inner cell and fastened their feet between heavy blocks of wood.

dag: Pa a Naawuni zɔbo zuɣu n-chɛ ka a niŋ o naani? Pa a nimmaŋtali zuɣu n-chɛ ka a mali tahima?.
en: Isnt your religion the source of your confidence; the integrity of your conduct, the source of your hope?.

dag: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa ka so bi lan mi o yɛla soli, luɣ shɛli neesim ni bemi kaman zibisim la. .
en: a land of darkness, shadows, and confusion, where the light itself is darkness.

dag: Ka din kpalim leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni.
en: The rest of that grain offering will belong to Aaron and his sons. This gift to the Lord is very holy.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro zim kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: The only bread I have is the sacred bread, the priest told David. You can have it if your soldiers didn't sleep with women last night.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli ma ni n doli ba chaŋ ka di chɛ ka n suhu zɔhira. Ka m mabih ayɔbu ŋɔ gba daa doli ma chaŋ, ka ti daa mali ti kpe doo maa yiŋa.
en: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi ni zaŋ Abimilɛk n-leei yi naa la, yɛlimaŋli soli ka yi doli maa? Yi teei Gidiɔn yɛla, ka niŋ o malibu viɛnyɛla kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm?.
en: Now if you were completely honest when you made Abimelech king, may you be happy with him. And if you have been fair to Gideon and his family, and if you have treated him as you should, this is also good.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka niriba bɛn daa kpalim duli din la polo kpahim baŋ ni ŋariŋ yini kɔŋko n-sa ʒe nimaani, ka lan mi ni Yisa sa bi kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu, amaa kulla bɛ kɔŋko n-sa kpe li chaŋ.
en: Next day the crowd which had stayed on the other side of the lake realized that there had been only one boat there. They knew that Jesus had not gone in it with his disciples, but that they had left without him.

dag: Ka ŋunkam siɣis omaŋ leei kaman bibil ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: Those who humble themselves like this little child will be the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi daa palila Yisa ka o yi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo na, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa zaŋ o chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Jesus returned from the Jordan River full of the Holy Spirit, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness.

dag: ka o bɛhi nyɛ kuriti, ka o napɔnvari shɛli polo nyɛ kuriti, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri.
en: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.

dag: Sokam zaa wum yi ni deei Naawuni noli shɛm yɛla, ka n suhu paligi yi zuɣu; amaa m bɔri ni yi niŋ yɛnnim zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛlli tumbu polo, ka nyɛ bɛn bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.

dag: Ti yipa baŋya ni a mi binshɛɣukam zaa, ka di bi lan simdi ni so vih a; dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka ti baŋ ni a shiri yila Naawuni sanna.
en: We can see now that you know all things. You answer our questions even before we ask them. This makes us believe that you came from God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chani ti miri Jɛriko, ka zoon so daa ʒi sokpaŋ maani bara.
en: When Jesus was coming close to Jericho, a blind man sat begging beside the road.

dag: ni Bɛtigiligal ni Gɛba ni Azimavɛt polo na, dama yiliyiiniba maa daa mɛla bɛ tiŋkpansi gili Jɛrusalɛm.
en: and from Bethgilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.

dag: O ni daa paai Rom na, o daa bo n shee ni nimmoo hal ti nya ma.
en: but as soon as he arrived in Rome, he started looking for me until he found me.

dag: O malaikanim zaa, paɣimiy o! O tɔbbihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise God, all of you who are his messengers! Praise God, all of you who comprise his heavenly forces!.

dag: Amaa yi mali kali din ti ma soli ni n yihi dansarika yino so yi ni bɔri bahi Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha; dinzuɣu yi bɔri ni n yihi Yɛhudianim Naa maa bahi.
en: You have a custom that I release one prisoner for you at Passover. Do you want me to release for you the king of the Jews.

dag: ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku Yisa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba.
en: The chief priests and the legal experts were looking for a way to kill Jesus, because they were afraid of the people.

dag: Gbarigu napɔna ni bi shihiri tiŋ shɛm, lala ka jɛrigu ŋahili gba be.
en: A fool can use a proverb about as well as crippled people can use their legs.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la maani maha, dama dabindi daa ka di ni, bɛ mi daa bi ʒi bindir shɛli mali chaŋ, bɛ ni daa kari ba yihi Ijipti yomyom shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: They baked unleavened cakes from the dough they had brought out of Egypt. The dough didnt rise because they were driven out of Egypt and they couldnt wait. In fact, they didnt have time to prepare any food for themselves.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee na ti di ba ka bɛ kpi Yawɛ tooni.
en: Suddenly the Lord sent fire, and it burned them to death there in the presence of the Lord .

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa luɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: Make fifteen crossbars of acacia wood, five for the frames on one side of the Tent.

dag: hal niriba ata ŋɔ yi be nimaani, hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibisi bee bɛ bipuɣinsi, bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko n-naan tiligi. Amaa tiŋgbani maa naan kpalim zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If these three men lived there, as surely as I live, proclaims the LORD God, they wouldnt be able to rescue even their sons or daughters. They alone would be rescued, but the land would become a ruin.

dag: Ninsal dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu zaa puuni, o tuma zaa nyɛla din tir o biɛrim mini suhugarigu, hal ka o bi tooi vuhir o yubu yuŋ gba. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Throughout their life, they have pain, frustrations, and hard work. Even at night, a persons mind does not rest. This is also senseless.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yi dabitim ni n-labina maa zaa daa tila suɣa n-kpe m-be di ni. Ka sokam daa mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia la saha zaŋ na hal ti paai di saha maa, Izraɛlnim daa na ʒi n-lan niŋ lala.
en: All the people who had come back from captivity built shelters and lived in them. This was the first time it had been done since the days of Joshua son of Nun, and everybody was excited and happy.

dag: Tummiya din viɛla ka chɛ din bie, ka tiligi. Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm.
en: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu o suhu ni ka o bɔh omaŋa, Padiriba ala n-lee be m ba yiŋa m-mali bindira diri tiɣiri ka chɛra, ka man ti be kpe kpiri kum?.
en: The son realized that he had been very foolish. He thought, All my fathers hired workers have plenty of food. But here I am, almost dead because I have nothing to eat.

dag: Di saha maa n daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Yi mini sɔŋdiba zaa kpalimmi gbɛm Jɛrusalɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ guli ti yuŋ ka tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni.
en: At that time I also said this to the people, Every builder and his helper must stay inside Jerusalem at night. Then they can be guards at night and workers during the day.

dag: Dama Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia daa ti la niriba maa naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tusaayopɔin ni bɛ kɔri. Ka kpamba gba daa ti ba naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛri tuhi pia. Ka maligumaaniba pam daa mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi.
en: So Hezekiah gave the people , bulls and , sheep to be offered as sacrifices and to be used as food for the sacred meals. His officials gave , bulls and , sheep, and many more priests agreed to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: Abraham answered, Make sure that you don't send my son back there!.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: The Pharisees and teachers of the law could say nothing against what he said.

dag: A me binshɛŋa din dundu maa zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ a viɛlim maa tum pagɔrisigu tuma. A zaŋ amaŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋunkam garita, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam.
en: At every crossroad you built your platform and degraded your beauty by spreading your legs to all comers. And so you encouraged even more promiscuity.

dag: Amaa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka bɛ daa lan puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: They celebrated this Passover for the Lord in Jerusalem during Josiahs th year as king.

dag: Di simdi ni ti mabi so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka Naawuni duh o mali suhupiɛlli;.
en: Believers who are poor should be glad that God considers them so important.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli Zɛrubabɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Pa a kpiɔŋ bee a yiko zuɣu, amaa n Shia yiko zuɣu.
en: He said, This is the message from the Lord to Zerubbabel: Your help will not come from your own strength and power. No, your help will come from my Spirit. This is what the Lord All-Powerful says.

dag: nti yɛl o ni o tim o gbana ka o zaŋ chaŋ Damaskus Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yi ti nya sokam ŋun doli soli ŋɔ, bɛ yi nyɛla dɔb bee paɣiba, ka o gbahi ba n-lo ba mihi tahi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa zaŋ o nuhi ni o naba n-gbam du, ka o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa dol o nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔnatan daa ti ŋmɛri ba luhiri ka o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa mi dol o nyaaŋa kuri ba.
en: Jonathan crawled up the hillside with the soldier right behind him. When they got to the top, Jonathan killed the Philistines who attacked from the front, and the soldier killed those who attacked from behind.

dag: A ni daa darigi n tibili maa, di viɛla. Di ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: My suffering was good for me, because through it I learned your statutes.

dag: Ka nachimbil ŋun daa ʒir o tɔbutuhiri nɛma maa yɛl o, Niŋm a suhu ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, dama m be a sani, ka a suhu ni kul be shɛm, lala ka n gba suhu be.
en: Go ahead with whatever youre planning, his armor-bearer replied. Im with you, whatever you decide.

dag: O daa maani maligunima ka tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini.
en: Ahaz offered sacrifices and burned incense in the high places, on the hills, and under every green tree.

dag: Mani n-yi di nyɛ niriba ŋɔ toondana, n naan kpimsi Abimilɛk birili zaa. N naan yɛl o, Bom tɔbbihi pam pahi kana. .
en: If only this people were under my command! I would push Abimelech aside! I would tell Abimelech, Build up your army and march out for battle.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa ʒin o ba nam ʒiishee n-nya yaa naai, o daa zaŋla takɔbi ku o tizɔbihi maa zaa, ka daa lan ku Izraɛl kpambal shɛb gba.
en: When Jehoram had taken control of his fathers kingdom, he established his rule by killing all his brothers, along with some other leaders of Israel.

dag: Yɛlim naa min o ma, Ʒinimiya tariŋ ʒiishee, dama yi nam zuɣupila din viɛl la yi yi zuɣu ni lu tiŋa.
en: The Lord said to me, Tell the king and his mother to come down from their thrones, because their beautiful crowns have fallen from their heads.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o, o ni tu o ba bee o ma maa zuɣu, o ʒim yihibu maa taali ʒila o zuɣu.
en: The Lord gave the following regulations. Any of you that curse your father or mother shall be put to death; you are responsible for your own death.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa pirigi ʒii buyi: Bɛ shɛb daa dolila Yɛhudianim maa; ka bɛn la mi doli Yisa tuumba maa.
en: The people of Iconium did not know what to think. Some of them believed the Jewish group, and others believed the apostles.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka chɛ ka di leei shɛhira m min a sunsuuni.
en: I am ready to make an agreement with you. Let us make a pile of stones to remind us of our agreement.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tam Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi maa ni la yɛla, dama bɛ ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: But dont forget the Levites living in your town. Share your food with them because they dont have a share of the land like you have.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka anabi shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka tɔɣisiri bɛ suhuyubu anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ yɔhiŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ lala niŋbu?.
en: How long will deceitful prophecies dominate the minds of the prophets? Those prophets are treacherous.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa ni m-pahila kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa Musa ni daa zaŋ niŋ di ni Sinai Zoli gbini luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la.
en: The only things inside the Holy Box are the two tablets that Moses put there at Mt. Horeb. This is where the Lord made his agreement with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

dag: Bɛ ka zuɣulana bee sapashin kpɛma.
en: Ants have no ruler, no boss, and no leader.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Kpihimmi ti daalahichi zaa, ka deei ti tuun shɛŋa din viɛla, ka ti paɣir a kaman di ni simdi ni ti paɣir a shɛm.
en: Think about what you will say, and come back to the Lord . Say to him, Take away our sin, and accept these words as our sacrifice. We offer you the praise from our lips.

dag: Ibram daa mali buni pam. O daa mali biŋkɔbiri mini anzinfa ni salima.
en: At this time Abram was very rich. He had many animals and much silver and gold.

dag: Nyamiya Yawɛ sanʒiɛɣu, suhuyiɣisili titali. Di ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, di ni lu ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu.
en: Look! The LORDs angry storm breaks out; it whirls around the heads of the wicked.

dag: Amaa ka o yanim daa je o, ka tim tuumba nti yɛli ŋun daa yɛn leeg o nam maa ni bɛ je ni doo maa niŋ bɛ naa.
en: His citizens hated him, so they sent a representative after him who said, We dont want this man to be our king.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri; ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la.
en: It is like what happens when a mustard seed is planted in the ground. It is the smallest seed in all the world.

dag: Yi daa lan nya bɛ binyoya din nyɛ buɣa din mali daɣiri ka nyɛ dari mini kuɣa ni anzinfa ni salima din daa be bɛ san la.
en: You saw their disgusting idols made of wood, stone, silver, and gold.

dag: Daba ayɔbu dali bɛ daa yi pihirila ʒii buyi zuɣu. Bɛ daa pihirila lita anahi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana ti yɛli Musa di yɛla.
en: On Friday the people gathered twice as much food—two baskets for every person. So all the leaders of the people came and told this to Moses.

dag: Ŋunkam ka dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tɛhijihilana ni zoma, ka lan nyɛla ŋun tam ni o daalahichi pun kpihim.
en: But those who dont grow in these blessings are blind. They cannot see clearly what they have. They have forgotten that they were cleansed from their past sins.

dag: Stiivin yɛligu ŋɔ ni daa lu bɛ tiba ni maa, ka di dim bɛ nyinyɛhi ni ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi pam, ka bɛ je suli niŋ o.
en: When those in the council meeting heard this, they became very angry. They were so mad they were grinding their teeth at him.

dag: bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒii bunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahi.
en: though each had four faces and four wings.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ba sɔɣi gballi ni, bɛ gulila bɛ gballi maa.
en: When they are carried to the grave, they will have someone to watch over the place they are buried.

dag: Ka niriba anahi daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so niŋ amaŋka ni ʒi o ka Yisa sanna.
en: when four men arrived, carrying a paralyzed man to Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka zuliya shɛli niriba yi katiŋa dunia ŋɔ tariga n-kabina ti lu yi zuɣu kaman tɔrili la, bɛ ni ti nyɛla yi ni bi wumdi zuliya shɛb yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord will bring against you a nation from the ends of the earth, a nation whose language you do not know. They will swoop down on you like an eagle.

dag: Kɔz daa nyɛla Anub mini Zɔbɛba ba, ka daa lan nyɛ Harum bia Aharihɛl daŋ niriba yaba.
en: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.

dag: Dɛdannima, ŋmaligimiya guui, sɔɣimiya; dama n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu niŋ Iso zuliya saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili.
en: People of Dedan, turn and run! Hide! I am going to destroy Esau's descendants because the time has come for me to punish them.

dag: Ka yi ni shɛb mi doli Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba wuhibu din nyɛ n ni je shɛl la.
en: In the same way you have people among you who follow the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya Yawɛ, ka gbaamiya yimaŋ yi tuma ni; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi bɔri ŋaribu bee gaŋbu bee yi bɔri ni niriba tiri ya birapu.
en: Therefore, respect the LORD and act accordingly, because there can be no injustice, playing favorites, or taking bribes when it comes to the LORD our God.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli, Kalidianim laɣimla tab ʒiibuta zuɣu n-kana ti lu laakumnim la zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn guli ba maa, ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: While this messenger was speaking, another arrived and said: Chaldeans set up three companies, raided the camels and took them, killing the young men with swords. I alone escaped to tell you.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba;.
en: He went on to say, Countries will fight each other; kingdoms will attack one another.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ba ni bɛ deem kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa balim Pita ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: So Peter told them to baptize Cornelius and his relatives and friends in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.

dag: Bɛn daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba pahi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: There were priests. They were leaders of their families. They were responsible for the work of serving in Gods Temple.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisima n-lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba. Zaŋm a takɔbi n-fa n nyɛvili ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi.
en: Get up, LORD! Confront them! Bring them down! Rescue my life from the wicked— use your sword!.

dag: amaa di zaa yoli, o kul tumdi tuun suma din wuhiri ni o beni. O tiri ya saa ka di chɛ ka yi bindira niŋdi ka yi diri tiɣiri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But he has always given evidence of his existence by the good things he does: he gives you rain from heaven and crops at the right times; he gives you food and fills your hearts with happiness.

dag: amaa ŋun mali shili ni o kari nyɛvilinim mini bɛn kpi saria la ni ti bɔhi ba di zuɣu.
en: But they will have to face God to explain what they have done. He is the one who will soon judge everyone—those who are still living and those who have died.

dag: Ʒiɛman biɛɣu ŋɔ nim ninvuɣ yino gba nini ku nya n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli ti yi yaannim maa.
en: Not even one of these people—this wicked generation!—will see the wonderful land that I promised to give to your ancestors.

dag: dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ a ni yɛn niŋ so naani, ka o mi ku chɛ ka tɔŋ gbaag a napɔŋ.
en: The Lord will keep you safe. He will not let you fall into a trap.

dag: Piɛ yini daa malila fiig tiwal viɛla kaman fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi, amaa piɛ din la din daa malila fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: The first basket contained good figs, those that ripen early; the other one contained bad figs, too bad to eat.

dag: Ka Halɔhɛshi bia Shallum ŋun gba daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la min o bipuɣinsi daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of the other half of the Jerusalem District, built the next section.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yiko daa kpe Ilaija ni, ka o voog o shɛlɔrigu lo n-zo n-daŋ Ɛhab tooni ti paai Jɛziriil dunɔdali gbini.
en: The power of the Lord came to Elijah. He used his belt to hold up the bottom of his robe away from his feet. Then he ran ahead of King Ahab all the way to Jezreel.

dag: Du shɛli din daa nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di dubu nyɛ mita awɛi; ka o dooi salima din nyɛ alali pa di luɣ shɛlikam zuɣu; ka daa lan zaŋ sida dari m-mali sara maligu bimbini.
en: This room was cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high. Solomon covered this room with pure gold. He also covered the cedar altar with gold.

dag: Yiɣisim kpuɣi bia maa n-gbib o a nuu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n ni chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: Get up, pick up the boy, and take him by the hand because I will make of him a great nation.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni ni o chɛ ka gomna maa ku niŋ yɛda.
en: But the magician Elymas spoke against them, trying to stop the governor from believing in Jesus.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla piɛ polli ni o mali sara maa, dindina ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If you present a sheep as the offering, you must present it before the LORD.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, ka ti zaa ti ŋma dari na nti me duri pahi beni. Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Chamiya.
en: Give us permission to go to the Jordan and cut down some trees, so that we can build a place to live. All right, Elisha answered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli, Yɛlimiya noli ti Mɛrɔz, yɛlimiya no biɛɣu ti di niriba, bɛ ni bi kana ti sɔŋ Yawɛ n-tuhi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ sɔŋ o la zuɣu.
en: The Lord 's angel said, Put a curse on Meroz Town! Its people refused to help the Lord fight his powerful enemies.

dag: Naawuni, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma; n Naawuni, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: God, dont leave me! My God, hurry and help me!.

dag: Zaŋmiya wumpaɣibo mali sara ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ yi ni lo alikauli ni yi zaŋ binshɛŋa ti Zallakudura Naa ti o.
en: You made promises to God Most High, so give him what you promised. Bring your sacrifices and thank offerings.

dag: Dama yi zaŋ yi nyɔri mini yi bɔɣusapima ni yi yila daai biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la zaa hal ti wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu katiŋa.
en: You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak.

dag: ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mali suhukpeeni daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti zaŋ Sool min o bihi maa niŋgbuna maa chaŋ Jabɛshi nti zaŋ ba sɔɣi Jabɛshi oki tia gbini, ka daa lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: the bravest men went and got the bodies of Saul and his sons and took them to Jabesh. They buried them there under an oak and fasted for seven days.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa sahakam, dama yi yɛn niŋdila din viɛl mini din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful.

dag: Bɛ sahirila bɛ zilima ka di be kaman takɔbiri la, ka mal li yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri din ŋmani piɛma.
en: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim cruel words like arrows.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni naa yɛliya, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ kpɛhi duu ka tir o bindirigu biɛlabiɛla mini kom biɛlabiɛla hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them to throw him in prison and to put him on bread and water until I return safely.

dag: Ka zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni, ka baansi yiini yila, ka kikapiɛbiriba piɛbira hal ka buɣim ti di sara maligu binyara maa naai.
en: and everyone worshiped the Lord . This continued until the last animal was sacrificed.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina shee n zuɣu, ka m puhiri ba pam di zuɣu, ka di pala n kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim cheechinim zaa gba puhiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: who risked their own necks for my life. Im not the only one who thanks God for them, but all the churches of the Gentiles do the same.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni no n-taai ninvuɣ shɛb la di vi; chɛ ka tarimba mini nandaamba paɣ a yuli.
en: Don't let the oppressed be put to shame; let those poor and needy people praise you.

dag: Amaa niriba pam bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti leei nyaannima, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima.
en: But many who are now first will be last, and many who are now last will be first.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛri noya tiri niriba, amaa nyin niŋdila alibarika niŋdi niriba ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛn nahindi ma maa di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka a dabili mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Let them curse—but you, bless me! If they rise up, let them be disgraced, but let your servant celebrate!.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee tum tuuni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ daa vihi di zuɣu hal ka so ti yɛli ba ni Gidiɔn Jɔash bia la n-tum tuuni maa.
en: Who could have done such a thing? they asked. And they kept on asking, until finally someone told them, Gideon the son of Joash did it.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa siɣi teeku maa ni n-doli tiŋ kuŋ maa chana, ka koma maa be kaman goma la n-ʒe bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: and the Israelites walked through on dry land with a wall of water on each side.

dag: Barinyuriba ku zan a tooni; a mi je tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: You cannot stand the sight of the proud; you hate all wicked people.

dag: Bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni zaŋdi bɛ noya saɣindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, amaa baŋsim chɛ ka wuntizɔriba nyari faako.
en: You can be ruined by the talk of godless people, but the wisdom of the righteous can save you.

dag: A ni zaŋ binshɛli biri maa kul nyɛla bimbiɛlli ka pa ni bimbilli maŋmaŋa, di pa shɛli di ni nyɛla kabiɛlli bee bimbiɛl shɛli.
en: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri kum, ka kum bi kanna, ka o gbi m-bo di shee n-gari azichi sɔɣirili;.
en: I keep longing for death more than I would seek a valuable treasure.

dag: Dindali zaŋ chana Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then from that day on, the family of Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n tuui; di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n sarigi.
en: But I almost stumbled and fell.

dag: ka Inan bia Ahira mi nyɛ Naftali zuliya zuɣulana.
en: Then came the tribe of Naphtali. Ahira son of Enan was the commander of that group.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛri pampam, Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku ŋɔ simdi ni o mali yiko mini azichi ni yɛm ni kpiɔŋ, ka nya tibiginsim mini jilima ni alibarika.
en: The angels said in a loud voice, All power, wealth, wisdom, and strength belong to the Lamb who was killed. He is worthy to receive honor, glory, and praise.

dag: Ka o pii ninvuɣ pinaayi ni bɛ be o sani, ka o timdi ba ka bɛ ti yihiri waazu.
en: He appointed twelve and called them apostles. He appointed them to be with him, to be sent out to preach.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini?.
en: None of you can add any time to your life by worrying about it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim a niriba ŋɔ suhuri kpa a polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni mali nia shɛŋa mini tɛhi shɛŋa ŋɔ kul ni be bɛ suhuri ni sahakam.
en: LORD, God of our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, keep these thoughts in the mind of your people forever, and direct their hearts toward you.

dag: Anabinim tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka maligumaaniba doli anabinim maa ni wuhiri ba shɛm n-tumdi bɛ tuma. N niriba maa n-yu lala. Amaa di yi ti paai di tariga, wula ka yi yɛn niŋ.
en: The prophets prophesy falsely, the priests rule at their sides, and my people love it this way! But what will you do when the end comes?.

dag: Di saha maa n daa ʒiɛla yi mini Yawɛ sunsuuni ni n zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisi ya, dama yi daa zɔrila dabiɛm buɣim maa zuɣu, ka daa bi du zoli maa zuɣu. Ka o daa yɛli.
en: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:.

dag: Pool min o nyaaŋa maa ni daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka niriba maa daa balim ba ni bɛ lan labimina Vuhim Dabisili din kanna dali nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people begged them to say more about these same things on the next Sabbath.

dag: Ka Naaman yɛl o, Chɛ ka n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi ti a. Ka o daa balim o zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra maa n-niŋ kpalans ayi ni lo n-zaŋ ʒil o tumtumdiba ayi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ʒi m-be Gɛhaazi tooni.
en: Please take six thousand pieces of silver, Naaman replied. He insisted on it, tied up the silver in two bags, gave them and two changes of fine clothes to two of his servants, and sent them on ahead of Gehazi.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Yɛlim ma a ni niŋ shɛli. Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, N di zaŋla jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni n-suɣi shiri di, dinzuɣu n-nyɛ ma, m mali shili ni n kpi.
en: Saul said to Jonathan, Tell me what you have done. Jonathan told Saul, I only tasted a little honey from the end of my stick. Should I die for doing that.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfi ni Onam. Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana.
en: Shobals sons were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam. Zibeons sons were Aiah and Anah.

dag: Miri ka a di shɛhira jɛnd a kpee ka di ka daliri, ka miri ka a yɔhim so.
en: Dont be a witness against your neighbor without reason; dont deceive with your lips.

dag: Di chɛ ka n ni yɛl a ni faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣ a yaha maa niŋ a alahiziba.
en: Don't be surprised when I say that you must be born from above.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N dima n-niŋ ma lala maa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka daɣila a bɔri ni ti chaŋ ti sib li bahi.
en: An enemy did this, he replied. His servants then asked, Do you want us to go out and pull up the weeds.

dag: ka yɛra, Yawɛ bi nya; Yaakubu Naawuni maa ku baŋ.
en: saying all the while, The LORD cant see it; Jacobs God doesnt know whats going on.

dag: Wuhimi yɛnnima, ka bɛ nyari yɛm pahira. Wuhimi wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nyari anfaani bɔhimbu puuni.
en: Teach the wise, and they will become wiser. Instruct those who live right, and they will gain more knowledge.

dag: Tola bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Rɛfaya ni Jɛriɛl ni Jamai ni Ibisam ni Shɛmuɛl, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Tola zuliya maa dɔɣirikpamba, ka daa lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi. Dauda ʒiɛman ni, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Tolas family: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel—the heads of their households in Tolas line, mighty warriors of their generations. In Davids time they numbered .

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida mini sipirɛs ni ɛligum dakuɣiri ti ma na. N ni chɛ ka n niriba kana ti pah a niriba zuɣu, dama m mi ni a niriba maa mi Lɛbanɔn dakuɣiri maa ŋmabu pam.
en: I know how skillful your lumbermen are, so send me cedar, cypress, and juniper logs from Lebanon. I am ready to send my men to assist yours.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Pa ŋuna nti yɛn di a fali; amaŋmaŋ bia nti yɛn di a fali.
en: The Lord replied, No, he won't! You will have a son of your own, and everything you have will be his.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi galisim maa pahi ʒii tuhili zuɣu, ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi yi yaannim ni daa ku anab shɛb gbala.
en: How terrible for you! You built memorials to the prophets, whom your ancestors killed.

dag: Ka bɔ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛn niŋ? Niriba yi niŋdi lala ni tɛhi biɛri bee tɛhi suma, Masia yɛla molo kul bahi mooni ginda, ka m mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu. Iin, n shiri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta din nyɛ Babilɔn liribu shihirili la zuɣusaa. Bomiya guliba pahi; zalimiya tiŋ guliba, ka chɛ ka shɛb sɔɣi doya gu. Dama Yawɛ lo nia ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm la.
en: Set up a flag on the walls of Babylon, fortify the guards, post watchmen, prepare an ambush, because the LORD has a plan against the inhabitants of Babylon. He will accomplish it, just as he said he would.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la ni yɛn su tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛŋa polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm.
en: The Lord had commanded Moses long ago how he wanted the people to choose their land. The people of the nine and a half tribes threw lots to decide which land they would get.

dag: Dauda ni daa kul yɛli Sool lala naai, ka Jɔnatan suhu dii gbaai Dauda, ka o daa yur o kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm.
en: Saul and David finished their conversation. After that, Saul's son Jonathan was deeply attracted to David and came to love him as much as he loved himself.

dag: N kul ni be yi sani chana, ka nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi nyɛ n niriba.
en: I will walk around among you; I will be your God, and you will be my people.

dag: Tɔbbi ŋuni m-mi n-chaŋ tɔbu ni nti su omaŋmaŋ bindirigu fukumsi? Ka ŋuni m-mi n-sa tihi ka ku di di wala? Bee ŋuni m-mi n-guli niɣi ka ku nyu bɛ bihim?.
en: No soldier ever serves in the army and pays his own salary. No one ever plants a vineyard without eating some of the grapes himself. No one takes care of a flock of sheep without drinking some of the milk himself.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soli nyɛla din be tibi. Yawɛ daalikauli niŋdi pali. O nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr kpɛr o yuli.
en: Gods way is perfect. The Lord s promise always proves to be true. He protects those who trust in him.

dag: Niriba maa zaa ni daa du duli naai saha shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa mi naanyi du duli na n-gari niriba maa tooni.
en: As soon as all the people had finished crossing, the LORDs chest crossed over. The priests then moved to the front of the people.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba maa na ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: So Jesus called the children over to him and said, Let the children come to me! Don't try to stop them. People who are like these children belong to God's kingdom.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli yili wumpaɣibo yila.
en: Shout triumphantly to the LORD, all the earth! Be happy! Rejoice out loud! Sing your praises!.

dag: ni binnamda maa maŋmaŋ ti yi poobu dabitim ni kpe Naawuni ni zaŋ yolisim shɛli din mali jilima n-ti o bihi la ni.
en: That the creation would be made free from ruin—that everything God made would have the same freedom and glory that belong to Gods children.

dag: Daadam, n yɛn zaŋla a ni yuri ninvuɣ so pam yim ka chɛ a. Amaa miri ka a ti fabili bee n-kum bee n-chɛ ka nintam yi a ninni.
en: Human one, I am about to take the delight of your eyes away from you in a single stroke. Dont mourn or weep. Dont even let your tears well up.

dag: Di saha suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ni ti zooi lim wain tihi din mali wula tuhilituhili, ka di zaɣ yini kam ni tooi da anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: When that time comes, the fine vineyards, each with a thousand vines and each worth a thousand pieces of silver, will be overgrown with thorn bushes and briers.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti gari, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsi ma Mariama ni Salomi daa da tulaale viɛlli ni bɛ chaŋ siliga maa ni ti mihi Yisa.
en: After the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices to go and anoint the body of Jesus.

dag: ni Bɛtiharam vinvamli ni Bɛtinimira ni Sukɔt ni Zafɔn ni Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli daa nyɛ di tiŋgbani tariga zaŋ chaŋ ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku tariga ha sirigili zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la.
en: the valley of Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth and Zaphon, including the rest of the kingdom of King Sihon of Heshbon, along the Jordan all the way up to Lake Galilee on the eastern side of the river.

dag: Ka sariakaritiba maa ti vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, shɛhira maa yi nyɛla ʒiri shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ o kpee maa polo.
en: The judges will investigate the case thoroughly; and if you have made a false accusation.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa bahi, ka di yi n nuh ayi maa ni lu tiŋ ŋ-ŋma yi ninni.
en: So there in front of you I threw the stone tablets down and broke them to pieces.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ nini kul mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛra, O piligila o wuhibu maa Galili n-wuhi li Judia tinsi zaa ni zaŋna hal ti paai kpe, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba taari duŋ.
en: But they all kept on saying, He has been teaching and causing trouble all over Judea. He started in Galilee and has now come all the way here.

dag: So yi lab a tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o; ka so yi fa a binyɛrigu, nyin di mɔŋ o a chinchini gba.
en: If someone slaps you on one cheek, don't stop that person from slapping you on the other cheek. If someone wants to take your coat, don't try to keep back your shirt.

dag: So bi yɛn teeri yɛndana bee jɛrigu yɛla sahakam; dama saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti tam bɛ zaa yɛla, dama bɔzuɣu ka yɛnnim mini jɛra zaa yɛn kpi kpiri yini?.
en: Wise or foolish, we all die and are soon forgotten.

dag: Malaika so ŋun daa yihi ma yɛl biɛri ni la, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni! Naawuni chɛ ka bihi ŋɔ zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mini n yab Ibrahimma ni m ba Yisahaku yuya ku kpi! Naawuni tim ba bihi pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi.
en: and his angel has kept me safe. Now I pray that he will bless these boys and that my name and the names of Abraham and Isaac will live on because of them. I ask God to give them many children and many descendants as well.

dag: Naomi ni daa nya ka Rut shiri bɔri ni o dol o kuli ni o suhu zaa maa zuɣu, ka o daa shini ka bi lan yɛli shɛli.
en: When Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped speaking to her about it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n sɔɣila a sani; fam ma bɛn zaa kariti doli ma la nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma.
en: O Lord , my God, I come to you for protection; rescue me and save me from all who pursue me.

dag: ni n daalaka nyabu ni n wahala dibu. A mi dinkam zaa daa niŋ ma mini alaka biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa nya Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium ni Listra la gba yɛla; amaa ti Duuma daa fa ma di zaa ni bahi.
en: my persecutions, and my sufferings. You know all that happened to me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra, the terrible persecutions I endured! But the Lord rescued me from them all.

dag: Di saha Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛla bɛ alichɛbbanim ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi kabɔɣili din daa be Samaria dunɔdali gbin la ni ka anabinim maa zaa daa ʒe bɛ tooni n-tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: The two kings, dressed in their royal robes, were sitting on their thrones at the threshing place just outside the gate of Samaria, and all the prophets were prophesying in front of them.

dag: n ni zaŋ shɛli zali gu muɣisigu saha mini zabili ni tɔbu tuhibu dal la?.
en: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, Kpahimiya yi nuhi, duhimiya yi yɛhi yili suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: Clap your hands for joy, all peoples! Praise God with loud songs!.

dag: Bɛ daa lan chɛ ka Hashabia mini Jɛshaya bɛn daa yi Mɛrari daŋ ni na la ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ni bɛ bidibisi ninvuɣ pisi gba kana.
en: They also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, along with their brothers and nephews. In all there were men.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi yɛnnim vi. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba chaŋ ka di gari ba. Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu ŋɔ, yɛm bɔ ka bɛ lan mali?.
en: Your wise men are put to shame; they are confused and trapped. They have rejected my words; what wisdom do they have now?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa, ka chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm. Ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa kana ti tuh o soli ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana.
en: Samuel did what the Lord told him to do and went to Bethlehem. The elders of Bethlehem shook with fear. They met Samuel and asked, Do you come in peace.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal; ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathans son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was Micahs father.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ paɣila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o yurilim maŋli la naani.
en: No. The LORD treasures the people who honor him, the people who wait for his faithful love.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Yi mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni gul li; chamiya ti niŋ yi ni ni niŋ shɛm gul li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Take a guard, Pilate told them; go and make the tomb as secure as you can.

dag: So ku lan be nimaani saha shɛlikam yaha. Laribunim ku lan ti bɛ suɣa zali nimaani. Piɛguliba mi ku lan chɛ ka bɛ piɛri dɔni nimaani.
en: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ lee ŋmanila bɔ?.
en: Jesus continued, Now to what can I compare the people of this day? What are they like?.

dag: A tintarisi bela teeku puuni. Bɛn daa me a, daa me a ka a viɛl zaa.
en: Your home is the sea. Your builders made you like a beautiful ship;.

dag: Ka Yisifu maa daa nyɛ Matatias bia, ka Matatias nyɛ Amɔs bia, ka Amɔs nyɛ Nahum bia, ka Nahum nyɛ Ɛsili bia, ka Ɛsili mi nyɛ Nagai bia.
en: son of Mattathias son of Amos son of Nahum son of Esli son of Naggai.

dag: N ni zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ barina shee, ka zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu ni.
en: I will put myself in danger and take my life in my own hands.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ soya maa ni ti nyɛla sariginli soya din be zibisim ni, bɛ ni ti yɛn kari ba bahi so shɛli zuɣu ka bɛ ti lu. Dama n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili yuun shɛli n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun ti bi lo noli dindali maa, bɛn yihim o n niriba ni.
en: Anyone who refuses to fast on this day must be separated from their people.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di yipa kahigi wuhi ti Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tiligira kandina la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa nyaŋ kum zaa, ka kahigi wuhi ni nyɛvili mini niŋgbun shɛli din bi poori beni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu.
en: but now it has been revealed to us through the coming of our Savior, Christ Jesus. He has ended the power of death and through the gospel has revealed immortal life.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Yawɛ yihi anabinim ti ti Babilɔn.
en: Yet you say, The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon.

dag: Pa a ninvuɣ biɛtali ni galisi zuɣu? A tuumbiɛri ka tariga.
en: No, it is because you sin so much. You never stop sinning.

dag: Di simdi ka yi chɛ ka buɣim kul be sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira sahakam, di bi simdi ni di kpi.
en: That fire must always be kept burning on the altar. It must never be allowed to stop burning.

dag: Di saha maa ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Ɛdom naa sani ti yɛl o, Ti suhir a, chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni gari; amaa ka Ɛdom naa maa daa zaɣisi. Ka bɛ daa lan tim ti yɛli Mɔab naa lala, ka o gba zaɣisi. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa kpalim be Kadɛshi.
en: Then they sent messengers to the king of Edom to ask permission to go through his land. But the king of Edom would not let them. They also asked the king of Moab, but neither would he let them go through his land. So the Israelites stayed at Kadesh.

dag: ka Uziɛl bia Ɛlizafan daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: with Elizaphan son of Uzziel as chief of the clan.

dag: Naawuni di wuhi gba! Wula ka tinim bɛn kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo ŋɔ na kul ni kpalim be di tumbu ni?.
en: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?.

dag: Di luhiya ni bɛ ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeen shɛli din ka nyɔri bee m-mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ku niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: Will they argue with a word that has no benefit and with unprofitable words?.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔb maa tuhibu dali, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Naa Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zaa so daa ka takɔbi bee kpani; amaa Naa Sool min o bia Jɔnatan n-daa naɣi mali.
en: So, whenever the Israelite soldiers had to go into battle, none of them had a sword or a spear except Saul and his son Jonathan.

dag: Yɔbuhi bela zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka sisirisi sɔɣiri di kuɣa lɔna ni.
en: The high mountains are a home for wild goats. The large rocks are hiding places for rock badgers.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yi yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla: Iin bee Aai, dama shɛli yi lan pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di nyɛla biriginsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Let your yes mean yes, and your no mean no. Anything more than this comes from the evil one.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi o nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka o shia kasi suhu saɣim pam. Dinzuɣu ka o daa leei bɛ dima, ka ŋmaligi tuhi ba o toli.
en: But they rebelled, and made Gods holy spirit terribly sad, so that he turned into their enemy— he fought against them!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ Nan bia Jɔshua zali ka yɛl o, Mali kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni, dama nyini n-yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, n ni be a sani.
en: The Lord told Joshua, Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.

dag: N dabeenzɔbo puuni n daa yɛliya, Bɛ kari ma a sani tahi katiŋa. Amaa ka n daa kuhi niŋ a bɔri sɔŋsim, ka a daa wum n ni kuhi niŋ a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu maa.
en: When I was panicked, I said, Im cut off from your eyes! But you heard my request for mercy when I cried out to you for help.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni farigudeera maa daa yi n-kuli ka yi taali ni gari ŋun la; dinzuɣu ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ; ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: Then Jesus said, When the two men went home, it was the tax collector and not the Pharisee who was pleasing to God. If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.

dag: Ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo, ka daa zaŋ Giliadnim ninvuɣ pihinu chaŋ Samaria nti kpe nayili puuni birini ni nti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: An officer of Pekahiah's forces, Pekah son of Remaliah, plotted with fifty men from Gilead, assassinated Pekahiah in the palace's inner fortress in Samaria, and succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lihi lzraɛlnim maa, ka baŋ ni bɛ be muɣisigu ni.
en: He saw the slavery of the Israelites and was concerned for them.

dag: Bɛ teebuya zuɣu zaa nyɛla tiri, ka di luɣ shɛli ka nyam.
en: All the tables are covered with vomit; filth overruns the place.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ammɔnnim na so ŋun yuli daa booni Nahash la daa ti lo tɔb na nti teei gili Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga la nima. Ka Jabɛshi dɔbba zaa daa yɛli naa Nahash, Chɛ ka ti min a tɔɣisi ka a zali ti zaligu ka ti jɛmd a.
en: About a month later, Nahash the Ammonite and his army surrounded Jabesh Gilead. All the people of Jabesh said to Nahash, If you will make a treaty with us, we will serve you.

dag: O zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni niŋ a nuu ni ni a su. Dina n-nyɛ: ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni noonsi. Nyini n-nyɛ zuɣu din nyɛ salima la.
en: He has made you ruler of all the inhabited earth and ruler over all the animals and birds. You are the head of gold.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Jɛriko chaŋ Ai din daa miri Bɛtavɛn, ka be Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo la. O daa yɛli ba mi, Chamiya ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa. Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kaai Ai;.
en: Joshua sent some men from Jericho to Ai, a city east of Bethel, near Bethaven, with orders to go and explore the land. When they had done so.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni n-zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpira n-nyo wurigu mi.
en: He has his winnowing shovel with him to thresh out all the grain. He will gather his wheat into his barn, but he will burn the chaff in a fire that never goes out.

dag: O daa kurigiya zaa, ka mali azichi mini jilima, ka o dabisa daa ti pali, ka o naanyi kpi, ka o bia Sulemaana daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died at a ripe old age, wealthy and respected, and his son Solomon succeeded him as king.

dag: Di bi simdi ni ti be kaman Keen ŋun daa nyɛ Sintani nira ka ku o mabia la. Bɔzuɣu ka o daa lee ku o? Di nyɛla o tuma ni daa bi tuhi ka o mabia maa ŋun tuma tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Dont behave like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he kill him? He killed him because his own works were evil, but the works of his brother were righteous.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa be bia maa sani hal ka o mali ti zooi. O daa bela mɔɣu ni n-daa ti leei tɔha ŋun mi piɛm tɔbu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: God was with the boy as he grew up; he lived in the wilderness of Paran and became a skillful hunter.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ o lala, dama niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: Thats exactly what happened to him. The people trampled him at the city gate, and he died.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba salo maa ni ka sokam wum.
en: While everyone was listening to Jesus, he said to his disciples:.

dag: Dauda yɛligu din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim zaa bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana.
en: From now on, all Levites at least years old.

dag: Dama nyini ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni a ni chɛ ka n zuliya yɛligi. Dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a ŋɔ.
en: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.

dag: Bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidib dɔɣirisi shɛb chaŋ ka bɛ ti leei namɔɣilisi be Babilɔn naa yiŋa.
en: The Babylonians will take your own sons, and your sons will become officers in the palace of the king of Babylon.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba niŋ zuliya shɛb nuu ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ba su ba.
en: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa niŋ Naa Ahaz ni yɛli ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Uriah did as the king commanded.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa pa Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba la daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisinahi bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Not counting the tribe of Benjamin, the Israelites gathered , trained soldiers.

dag: N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: promising, I hereby give you the land of Canaan as your allotted inheritance.

dag: O yi tihim, buɣim n-nyaɣisira, ka o nina ŋmani wuntaŋ m-puhirina asiba la.
en: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.

dag: A nyɛla ŋun yuri din tuhi, ka je zaɣ biɛɣu. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ piig a, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli niŋ a ni n-gari a na taba.
en: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnani zali bee m-mali binshɛli ŋ-ŋmahindi binshɛli din be zuɣusaa bee tiŋgbani puuni bee binshɛli din be kom puuni.
en: Do not make an idol for yourself—no form whatsoever—of anything in the sky above or on the earth below or in the waters under the earth.

dag: Tɔɣisimiya Jɛrusalɛmnim suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa. Yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ di wahala saɣi lala. N darigi bɛ tibili ka di saɣi, ka yipa chɛ bɛ daalahichi taali zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Speak compassionately to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her compulsory service has ended, that her penalty has been paid, that she has received from the LORDs hand double for all her sins!.

dag: N dana, ka so yi ti dol a ni o ku a, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun zaŋm a nyɛvili ŋɔ pahi nyɛviya pam zuɣu n-gul li, amaa o ni ti zaŋ a dimnim nyɛviya labi kaman kuɣilɔŋ kuɣili ka bɛ labi la.
en: The Lord your God will keep you safe when your enemies try to kill you. But he will snatch away their lives quicker than you can throw a rock from a sling.

dag: Doo ŋɔ daa bɔhim ti Duuma soli yɛla pam. O ni daa jɛmdi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisiri ka wuhiri Yisa yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa kulla Jɔn Baptaizira kom baptaizibu la yɛla kɔŋko ka o daa mi.
en: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord and spoke as one stirred up by the Spirit. He taught accurately the things about Jesus, even though he was aware only of the baptism John proclaimed and practiced.

dag: Ka n ni pii ninvuɣ so jaaŋgbee ni puhi vari. Lala ka n yɛn niŋ ka Izraɛlnim chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumbu shɛli bɛ ni ŋumdi niŋdi ya sahakam maa.
en: Then the stick of the man I have chosen will sprout. In this way I will put a stop to the constant complaining of these Israelites against you.

dag: Aai! N yɛri ya mi ni shee yi niŋ tuuba, di yi pa lala yi zaa gba ni ti bahi yoli.
en: They were not. But I tell you if you dont decide now to change your lives, you will all be destroyed too.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa boli Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda la na ti yɛl o, Sool min o daŋ zaa ni daa su shɛlikam zaa n ni zaŋ li ti a dan yaaŋa ŋɔ.
en: Then King David called Sauls servant Ziba and said, I have given Sauls family and everything he owns to your masters grandson, Mephibosheth.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa bi lɛbira, ka Yawɛ daa zo ba nambɔɣu n-chɛ ka malaikanim maa gbah o min o paɣ ni o bipuɣins ayi maa nuhi ni n-vo ba yihi tiŋ maa tariga ti zali.
en: When Lot did not move fast enough, the two men grabbed his hand. They also took the hands of his wife and his two daughters. The two men led Lot and his family safely out of the city. The Lord was kind to Lot and his family.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋzaalan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: Nations and kings will care for you As a mother nurses her child. You will know that I, the Lord , have saved you, That the mighty God of Israel sets you free.

dag: Nam din ti yɛn doli a nam ŋɔ nyaaŋa ti ku paag a dini ŋɔ. Di nyaaŋa, ka nam din pah ata n-nyɛ daanya ka ti yɛn su dunia zaa la deei.
en: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judianim zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kab chaŋ o sani.
en: People from Jerusalem, throughout Judea, and all around the Jordan River came to him.

dag: O lan yɛli luɣ shɛli yaha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: He also said in another place, You will be a priest forever, in the priestly order of Melchizedek.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kom niŋ o sagban tibisa ni, ka sagbana maa bi cheei.
en: It is God who fills the clouds with water and keeps them from bursting with the weight.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira maa ni bɛn ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba, di ŋubiya laakum, dama o gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa o ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, o nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
