en: But of animals that rechew food and have divided hoofs you must not eat the following: the camel—though it rechews food, it does not have divided hoofs, so it is unclean for you.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su tahi shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa din be kasi la fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su bɔrɔbɔro zim mini wain ni kpam ni tulaale zim ni tulaalɛnim zaa fukumsi.
en: Others were responsible for the temple furnishings and its sacred objects, as well as the flour, wine, olive oil, incense, and spices.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka toli mini sakɔri bɛn ka kalinli waɣi yɛrigi.
en: He gave the command, and the locusts and grasshoppers came. There were too many to count!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi galisim maa pahi ʒii tuhili zuɣu, ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: May the Lord , the God of your ancestors, make you increase a thousand times more and make you prosperous, as he promised!.

dag: Chɛliya ka amiliya lɔbu mali jilima sokam sani, ka chɛliya ka yidan min o paɣa ʒe tab yim bɛ daamiliya lɔbu puuni; dama Naawuni ni kari niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛnim mini bɛn niŋdi zina saria.
en: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.

dag: Naawuni, guli ma; dama a sani ka n sɔɣi.
en: Protect me, God, because I depend on you.

dag: Yiɣisimiya chaŋ, dama kpe pala vuhim shee, daɣ shɛli din tahiri saɣiŋgu na ni tahi saɣiŋgu shɛli din bie na zuɣu.
en: Get up and leave! This will not be your place of rest, because you ruined it. You made it unclean, so it will be destroyed! It will be a terrible destruction!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhi ni m mali taali; ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan tumdi tuma yoli?.
en: I will be found guilty, so why should I even think about it?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia mini tia kam:.
en: Then Jesus told this story: Look at all the trees. The fig tree is a good example.

dag: dindina n ni tin ya sakom saa mibu saha, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bindira niŋ pam, ka yi puri ni tihi wali wala.
en: If you do these things, I will give you rains at the time they should come. The land will grow crops and the trees of the field will grow their fruit.

dag: Yisa Masia zuɣu m mali daliri din ni chɛ ka n nyu bara n ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti Naawuni la puuni.
en: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.

dag: Do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Yisifu. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia tin shɛli din yuli booni Arimatia la nira, ka daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jintɔriba ni yino ŋun nyɛ bilichina ni wundabili.
en: There was a man named Joseph, who was from Arimathea in Judea. Joseph was a good and honest man, and he was eager for God's kingdom to come. He was also a member of the council, but he did not agree with what they had decided.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa lan ka o sanna pahi buyi kaman o ni daa pun ka o sanna shɛm Gibiɔn la.
en: the Lord appeared to him again, as he had in Gibeon.

dag: Kɛlub bia Ɛzri n-daa su kpariba fukumsi.
en: Ezri son of Kelub was in charge of the field workers.

dag: A yɛliya, N lo n ni pii ninvuɣ so alikauli, n daa poya yɛli n dabili Dauda;.
en: You said, I made an agreement with my chosen king. I made this promise to my servant David:.

dag: Naawuni, Wummi n kuhigu; ka deei n suhigu!.
en: God, listen to my cry; pay attention to my prayer!.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhiri pampam n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ni yɛlimaŋlilana ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka a yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ku ti ka na be dunia ni ŋɔ saria m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti ti.
en: They shouted, Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us.

dag: Ka Sintani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ zahinda la daa chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣa ŋɔ leei bindirigu ka a di.
en: Then the Devil came to him and said, If you are God's Son, order these stones to turn into bread.

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, di bi maari biɛrim n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n yi fo, di sɔŋsim lee nyɛ ma dini?.
en: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.

dag: Ka Kɔnania min o mabihi Shɛmaya ni Nɛtanɛl ni Hashabia ni Jɛiɛl ni Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba la gba daa ti Lɛvinim piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tusaanu ni naɣilahi kɔbisinu ni bɛ zaŋ puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: Conaniah, his two brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, as well as Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad were leaders of the Levites, and they gave the other Levites , sheep and goats, and bulls to offer as sacrifices.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya daantalis ayi, zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaanu, ka bɛ daa mali zuɣuri tamtam di zuɣu, ka zuɣu yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sa duu maa tooni.
en: He put two columns in front of the Temple. The columns were cubits tall. The top part of the two columns was cubits long.

dag: Di kpala talahi ni ti chɛ ba ti ni lo ba alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu; di yi pa lala, ti ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: This is what well do with them. Well let them live so that wrath wont come down on us because of the solemn pledge that we made to them.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la daa bi pahi tipawumlinim zuɣu bahi yoli, o ni daa deei ninvuɣ puɣisiriba la ni suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: It was faith that kept the prostitute Rahab from being killed with those who disobeyed God, for she gave the Israelite spies a friendly welcome.

dag: Ka bɛ noya daa wol taba, ka Pool tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ ka bɛ naanyi wurim. Pool daa yɛli ba mi, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia yɛli ti yaannim shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Anabi Aizaia daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya.
en: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, pa nyini n-daa kari tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka zaŋ li ti a zo Ibrahimma zuliya sahakam la?.
en: You, our God, drove out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and gave this land to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.

dag: A yi ti yɛn kali Izraɛlnim maa, nyin chɛ ka sokam yo shɛli ti man Yawɛ bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka alɔbo ku lu bɛ zuɣu saha shɛli a yi ti kaani ba.
en: Count the Israelites so that you will know how many people there are. Every time this is done, each man must make a payment for himself to the Lord so that nothing terrible will happen to the people.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, pahim ti yɛda.
en: The apostles said to the Lord, Make our faith stronger.

dag: Naawuni daa pun daŋ piig o mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam dunia ŋɔ, amaa ka o daa lee ti yi palo la ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni yi zuɣu.
en: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm gari niriba ayopɔin bɛn ni tooi garigi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Lazy people think they are wiser than seven people who answer sensibly.

dag: amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn bemi kaman paɣipuulan wolisibu piligu biɛrim la.
en: All these things are like the first pains of childbirth.

dag: amaa biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni tim n tuumba na ka bɛ ti kpe a min a kpambaliba yinsi nti vihi, ka bɛ yi kul nya binshɛlikam ka di tiɣi bɛ nini, bɛn kpuɣim li. .
en: But tomorrow at this time, I will send my officials into your city to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will take everything else that you own.

dag: Bɔ ka Yɛhudianim lee zaŋ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim? Bee gunibu buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: What good is it to be a Jew? What good is it to be circumcised?.

dag: Nyin daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahigu! Tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa anahi bahigu saha paaya.
en: He said, Now, son of man, here is a message from the Lord GOD. This message is for the land of Israel: The end! The end is coming. The whole country will be destroyed.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti yɛn bahi yoli ŋɔ zuɣu, di simdi ni yi nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔnima? Di niŋ kamaata ni yi bebu be kasi, ka yi nyɛ bɛn luri Naawuni sizuura binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what sort of people ought you to be? You must live holy and godly lives.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa guhirila tin shɛli Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni zali di tanzaa ka lan nyɛ ŋun me li, ka di ku vuui.
en: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.

dag: Ka o daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma ata. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mikaya, o daa nyɛla Uriɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia nir la bipuɣiŋga. Ka tɔb daa ti lu Abija mini Jɛrɔbɔam sunsuuni.
en: He ruled for three years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Micaiah; she was Uriels daughter from Gibeah. When war broke out between Abijah and Jeroboam.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Riu.
en: When Peleg was years old, he had a son, Reu;.

dag: N kul ni yiini yila yɛr a yɛligu yɛla, dama a zaligunim zaa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Let my voice sing about your word, because all your commands are good.

dag: Niriba soya yi tiɣi Yawɛ nini, hal o ni chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ dimnim be ni suhudoo.
en: When you please the Lord , you can make your enemies into friends.

dag: Yi yi ti laɣim taba, di pala ti Duuma bindirigu dibu zuɣu ka yi laɣim;.
en: When you all come together, it is not really the Lords Supper you are eating.

dag: Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o bia Yisahaku ni. Yisahaku daa bela Bɛrilahairoi.
en: After Abrahams death, God blessed his son Isaac, and Isaac lived in Beer-lahai-roi.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpuɣ a nuu zuɣusaa, amaa bɛ bi nya li. Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ a ni yur a niriba shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi. Zaŋm a ni yɛn zaŋ buɣim shɛli wɔb a dimnim la wɔb ba.
en: Lord , your arm is raised to punish them, but they dont see it. Show them how strong your love is for your people. Then those who are evil will be ashamed. Yes, your fire will destroy your enemies.

dag: N ni lo ba alikauli din ka bahigu din ni chɛ ka n ku lan chɛ ba zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura bɛ suhuri ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ ma.
en: I will make an eternal covenant with them. I will never stop doing good things for them, and I will make them fear me with all their heart, so that they will never turn away from me.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ teebul la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nuzaa polo pateesa la nyaaŋa.
en: He put the table in the Tent, on the north side outside the curtain.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi zo Firawuna suhuyiɣisili. O daa bi saɣi ni o lab o nyaaŋa; o daa bemi kaman o nini nyala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nir ni ku tooi nya so ŋɔ.
en: By faith he left Egypt without being afraid of the kings anger. He kept on going as if he could see what is invisible.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zana ni, amaa ka chɛ ka man kɔŋko tiligi.
en: May the wicked fall into their own traps while I go by unharmed.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinu saha ka Mɛnahɛm bia Pɛkahia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi.
en: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.

dag: Biɛrim yi ti paai ba, bɛ ni bɔri suhudoo, amaa ka ku nya li.
en: You will shake with fear. You will look for peace, but there will be none.

dag: Di bahigu ti ŋmanila wɔɣ dimli, ka dimda kaman gariŋga la.
en: In the end, it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.

dag: Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko mini fahim niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn tumdi tuma shɛm luɣ kasi shee la malibu ni ti tum bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm.
en: So Bezalel, Oholiab, and all the other skilled men must do the work the Lord has commanded. The Lord has given these men the wisdom and understanding to do all the skilled work needed to build this holy place.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Dauda na. Ka bɛ daa paai ti nya anab bɔbili, ka bɛ tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka Samuɛl nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣi Sool tuumba maa zuɣu na ka bɛ gba tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Saul sent a few soldiers to bring David back. They went to Ramah and found Samuel in charge of a group of prophets who were all prophesying. Then the Spirit of God took control of the soldiers and they started prophesying too.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi, N ni ti kpila n tiɛɣu ni, ka ni ti chɛ ka n dabisa galisi kaman bihigu la.
en: I always expected to live a long life and to die at home in comfort.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini, hal o daa bi garigi bɛ ni fiɣis o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa zaɣ yini gba. Ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But Jesus did not say anything, and the governor was greatly amazed.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntitali be o ʒiɛman ni, ka chɛ ka suhudoo pam beni kaman goli ni beni ka o neesim be shɛm la sahakam.
en: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.

dag: Gaal ni daa nya niriba maa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli Zɛbul, Nyama, niriba n-yiri zoya ŋɔ zuɣu sigirina! Ka Zɛbul garigi yɛl o, Pa niriba m-bala. Zoya maa shilinshihi ka a nya ka di ŋmani ninsalinim maa.
en: When Gaal saw the soldiers, he said to Zebul, Look, there are people coming down from the mountains. But Zebul said, You are only seeing the shadows of the mountains. The shadows just look like people.

dag: Niŋmi ba kaman buɣim ni diri nyɔŋ shɛm la, bee kaman buɣim niɛm ni taari diri zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Just like a fire consumes a forest, just like flames set mountains ablaze.

dag: Ŋunkam tiri nandaamba pini, shɛli ku poog o, amaa ŋunkam lab o nini kpaŋa, noli ni di o.
en: Whoever gives to the poor will have plenty. Whoever refuses to help them will get nothing but curses.

dag: yɛra, Sabimi a ni yɛn nya shɛli maa niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ tim ti ti cheechinima ayopɔin la. Di tinsi n-nyɛ: Ɛfɛsus mini Smɛɛna ni Pɛɛgamum ni Taiatira ni Saadis ni Filadɛlfia ni Laodisia.
en: The voice said, Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Kalidianim mini Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-dee li.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: Im handing this city over to the Babylonians and King Nebuchadnezzar, who will capture it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi ni chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha yaha; ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna ka o ti gbaai ba wuhibu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm.
en: Jesus left that place and went beyond the Jordan and into the region of Judea. Crowds gathered around him again and, as usual, he taught them.

dag: di saha ka naa daa yɛli anab Neetan, Nyama, m bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ dim be suɣili ni.
en: Then one day, as David was talking with Nathan the prophet, David said, Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest has to stay in a tent.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛl ti ni ti chɛ ka ti bebu doli zaligu shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim la, amaa ka ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum ti a.
en: We have not obeyed the Lord our God. He used his servants, the prophets, and gave us laws, but we have not obeyed his laws.

dag: Zakai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu.
en: the descendants of Zaccai:.

dag: Judanim mi Naawuni, o yuli tibisi pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: God is known in Judah; his name is great in Israel.

dag: Ifriim zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi ni kɔbisinu. Yisifu zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba m-bala.
en: These clans numbered , men. These are the clans descended from Joseph.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zani bɛ zaashɛhi n-zaŋ awa muna ata karim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ litaafi dabisili maa puuni, ka zaŋ awa muna ata kahigi bɛ daalahichi wuhi, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: For about three hours the Law of the Lord their God was read to them, and for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord their God.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam n niŋgbuŋ luɣilikam zaa; nyini n-daa zaŋ ma tuɣi taba m ma pul ni.
en: You created every part of me; you put me together in my mother's womb.

dag: Uzi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Izirahia, ka Izirahia bidibisi daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Obadia ni Joɛl ni Ishia, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu; bɛ zaa daa nyɛla zuɣulaannima.
en: Uzzis son was Izrahiah. Izrahiahs sons were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah. All five of them were leaders of their families.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku labi nyaaŋa alakanim ŋɔ nyabu zuɣu. Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ti nya alakanim ŋɔ tatabo.
en: so that none of you should turn back because of these persecutions. You yourselves know that such persecutions are part of God's will for us.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o tumtumdiba bɛn mi teeku kom yɛtɔɣa mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa zaŋ ŋariŋ din zɔri pam.
en: King Hiram sent some experienced sailors from his fleet to serve with Solomon's men.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa; chɛliya ka daadamnim zo dabiɛm! O ʒila o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu. Chɛliya ka tiŋgbani dam!.
en: Our Lord , you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.

dag: Ka o daa bo Ijipti bin suma n-ʒili bunsi pia ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti o ba, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ su kawana mini bɔrɔbɔro ni di ti nyɛ o ba sol ni bindira n-ʒili bunnyama pia pahi.
en: To his father he sent ten male donkeys carrying goods from Egypt, ten female donkeys carrying grain and bread, and rations for his father for the road.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti kul kpalimmi be alahichi tumbu ni ka di chɛ ka Naawuni daalibarika zooi?.
en: So do you think we should continue sinning so that God will give us more and more grace?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, N ni yihi n niriba bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Im about to deliver my people from the land of the east and the land of the west.

dag: Amaa a min a niriba yi lɛbi yi nyaaŋa biri ma, ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali ya ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti gbani wun shɛŋa tiŋa n-jɛmdi li.
en: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods.

dag: ka Shimɛi nyɛ Jahat bia, ka Jahat nyɛ Gɛrishom bia, ka Gɛrishom mi nyɛ Lɛvi bia.
en: Shimei was Jahaths son. Jahath was Gershons son. Gershon was Levis son.

dag: Di mi pala din be teeku duli ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du teeku duli ti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: This command is not on the other side of the sea so that you should say, Who will go across the sea for us and bring it to us, so that we can hear it and do it.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ata, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ata yɛli, Kamina! Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr sabinli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi sania o nuu ni.
en: The Lamb opened the third seal. Then I heard the third living being say, Come! I looked, and there before me was a black horse. The rider on the horse held a pair of scales in his hand.

dag: Ka bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kulina maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm. Ka Ɛzra daa pii daŋ kam zuɣulaannim ni niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ sab bɛ yuya sɔŋ. Ka bɛ daa piligi yɛlli maa vihibu gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali.
en: The returned exiles accepted the plan, so Ezra the priest appointed men from among the heads of the clans and recorded their names. On the first day of the tenth month they began their investigation.

dag: Yɛndaannim bela neesim ni, ka jɛra mi be zibisim ni. Amaa m mi ni yɛl yini n-ʒe n-guli bɛ zaa.
en: The wise have eyes in their head, but fools walk around in darkness. But I also realized that the same fate happens to both of them.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yɛli ma, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: I heard a voice say to me, Get up, Peter. Kill anything here and eat it.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a me jɛmbu duu ti ma maa, a niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a ni lo lala a suhu ni maa zuɣu.
en: but the Lord said to him, You were right in wanting to build a temple for me.

dag: M Ba, m bɔri ni a chɛ ka a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba ti ma la ti be n sani n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛl la n-nya jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛla a ni daa pun yuri ma ka dunia na bi nam la zuɣu.
en: Father! You have given them to me, and I want them to be with me where I am, so that they may see my glory, the glory you gave me; for you loved me before the world was made.

dag: Ʒirilana nyɛla ŋun sɔɣiri jɛlinsi. Ka ŋunkam zuri niriba nyaaŋa nyɛ jɛrigu.
en: Lying lips conceal hate, and those who spread slander are fools.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm, tiŋ maa zaa daa dammi ka bɛ bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was thrown into an uproar. Who is he? the people asked.

dag: dama Yawɛ je tuumbiɛrinima, amaa wuntizɔriba nyɛla o zɔsimnima.
en: Such crooked people are disgusting to the Lord . But he is a friend to those who are good and honest.

dag: Dama Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim daa yiɣisimi lu Ɛdom Zoli zuɣunim maa zuɣu kuri ba. Bɛ ni daa ti ku ba naai, ka bɛ lan ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu n-ku taba.
en: The Ammonites and the Moabites turned on those from Mount Seir, completely destroying them. Once they had finished off the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy each other!.

dag: Naawuni daa tum alahiziba tuun gahinda n-chɛ ka yiko be Pool nuhi ni.
en: God gave Paul the power to work great miracles.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namba. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: but you must mourn quietly. Dress as you normally do; wear your turban and sandals; dont cover your mustache, and dont eat the food people normally eat when someone dies.

dag: Ka Anabi Musa daa bɔhim Ijiptinim maa baŋsim n-leei ninvuɣ titali o yɛtɔɣa min o tuma ni.
en: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam Ziɔn; bɛ duh o gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: The LORD is great in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

dag: Ka Musa daa lo alikauli dindali maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli a ni ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim maa zuɣu, a napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ ni ti leeg a min a bihi ni yɛn su shɛli sahakam.
en: So Moses pledged on that day, The land on which you have walked will forever be a legacy for you and your children. This is because you remained loyal to the LORD my God.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o ni lo Izraɛlnim alikauli sun shɛŋa la zaa zaɣ yini gba bi yiɣisi. O daa chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: The Lord kept every one of the promises that he had made to the people of Israel.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Karimba, mami daba ayi ŋɔ ni ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔri ni bɛ lab a kuɣa la, ka a ti lan yɛn lab nimaani yaha.
en: Teacher, the disciples answered, just a short time ago the people there wanted to stone you; and are you planning to go back.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa laɣim o niriba zaa na nti lo tɔbu ni bɛ chaŋ Kɛila ti teei gili Dauda min o niriba maa niŋ di ni.
en: So Saul called up all his troops for war, to go down to Keilah and attack David and his soldiers.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋdi kaman yi ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ niŋdi shɛm la. Ka miriya ka yi ti niŋdi kaman n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kulisi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ŋɔ nim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Miriya ka yi ti niŋ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: You must not follow the customs of Egypt where you lived, and you must not follow the customs of the Canaanites where I am leading you. You must not live the way they do.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bu jɛrigu ŋun gariti paa bee m-bu ŋun nyu dam kuli paa ŋmanila peentɔra ŋun tɔri sokam piɛma tiri ba dansi.
en: Like an archer who wounds someone randomly, so is one who hires a fool or a passerby.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tahirila Naawuni suhuyiɣisili na, dama zaligu yi kani di chihibu gba ku beni.
en: The Law brings down God's anger; but where there is no law, there is no disobeying of the law.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la kul be n sani wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka a yilli mi be n sani yuŋ. Di nyɛla n suhigu zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n nyɛvil la sani.
en: By day the LORD commands his faithful love; by night his song is with me— a prayer to the God of my life.

dag: Chɛ ka nanim zaa damd o tiŋa; ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa jɛm o.
en: Let all the kings bow down before him; let all the nations serve him.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi ti nya ka Naawuni bɔhi biɛri, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti siɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ʒim ni n-no n-gili.
en: Good people will be happy when they see the wicked getting the punishment they deserve. They will feel like soldiers walking through the blood of their enemies!.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa saɣim a zaligunima, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm. Ti tum alahichi a sani, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a chɛ ka nopoli yɛtɔɣa din sab a dabili Musa zaligu ni la di ti.
en: All the people of Israel disobeyed your teachings and turned away from you. They did not listen to you. We sinned, so you did what you promised to do. All the curses and promises in the Law of Moses, your servant, happened to us.

dag: Di saha ka Gɛrasa tiŋkpannim zaa daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbahi ba pam. Ka o daa lan kpe ŋariŋ ni lab o nyaaŋa.
en: Everyone from around Gerasa begged Jesus to leave, because they were so frightened. When Jesus got into the boat to start back.

dag: Ka bɛ ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then they will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Amaa bɛ kul domi gu ni bɛ ŋmaligi ku bɛmaŋa. Bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya ka bɛ doya gu maa.
en: But these sinners set up a deadly ambush; they lie in wait for their own lives.

dag: Naomi yidan Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣir so daa beni ka o yuli booni Bɔaz, o daa nyɛla bundana ni yulilana.
en: There was a rich man named Boaz living in Bethlehem. Boaz was one of Naomis close relatives from Elimelechs family.

dag: Amaa ka wahu maa yɛli paɣ maa, Yi ku kpi.
en: But the snake said to the woman, You will not die.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka n yɛl lala? M bi yuri ya mi zuɣu ka n yɛl lala maa? Naawuni gba mi ni n yuri ya!.
en: And why do I not burden you? Do you think it is because I dont love you? God knows that I love you.

dag: Chɛ ka Mɔabnim nyu dam kuli bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ pam niŋ Yawɛ la zuɣu. Bɛ ni dɔni bɛmaŋmaŋ tiri ni bilim. Bɛ gba ni leei niriba ni yɛn lari shɛba.
en: Get Moab drunk, because it has exalted itself above the LORD. Moab will collapse in its vomit and become the butt of every joke.

dag: Kamiyana ka ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Chɛliya ka ti yo suhupiɛlli vuri m-paɣi ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ!.
en: Come, let us sing praise to the Lord ! Let us shout praises to the Rock who saves us.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Ka m mi lee nyɛla ŋuni ka n Duuma ma ti kani n sanna?.
en: You are the mother of my Lord, and you have come to me! Why has something so good happened to me?.

dag: N sabi yɛtɔɣa biɛla din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tin ya la Silvanus ŋun nyɛ n ni lihi so m mabia ŋun ʒe yim la sɔŋsim ni. M bɔri ni n kpaŋsila yi suhuri, ka lan yɛli ya ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daanfaani maŋli yɛla. Dinzuɣu ʒiɛnya di ni dɛde.
en: I write you this brief letter with the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful Christian. I want to encourage you and give my testimony that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

dag: Bɛ yihiri waazu yɛra ma, Di yihiri waazu. Di yihiri waazu yɛri binyara ŋɔ yɛla; vi ku di ti.
en: Enough of your preaching! That's what you tell me. We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ paɣisarili maa shɛli. Paɣisarili maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kubu; dama yɛlli ŋɔ ŋmanila doo ni yi chaŋ ti lir o kpee n-ku o la.
en: You must do nothing to the girl. She did nothing that deserves the punishment of death. This is like someone attacking their neighbor and killing them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri pun birigi ka na bela bɛ manim puya ni. Bɛ dɔɣibu saha ka bɛ pun birigi; ka nyɛ ʒiŋmariba.
en: Those wicked people started doing wrong as soon as they were born. They have been liars from birth.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti niŋ yɛda ka deei baptaizibu ni tiligi, amaa ŋun ti bi niŋ yɛda ni mali taali.
en: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever doesnt believe will be condemned.

dag: N kul ni paɣir a, dama a wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you.

dag: Bɛna n nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Juda fɔntinsinim ni di nanima ni bɛ kpambaliba ni di chɛ ka di leei dabari, ka niriba maani ba ansarisi ka turi ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ di ma shɛhira ni n daa yɛliya ni pa mani n-nyɛ Masia maa, amaa Naawuni n-tim ma ni n daŋ o tooni na.
en: You yourselves can testify that I said that Im not the Christ but that Im the one sent before him.

dag: Chɛl niriba ŋɔ taali a yurilim din galisi la min a ni daa pun chɛ bɛ taali Ijipti zaŋ na hal ni pumpɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: Please forgive the wrongs of these people because of your absolute loyalty, just as youve forgiven these people from their time in Egypt until now.

dag: ka daa lee yɛli, Ti di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu maa zuɣu.
en: We must not do it during the festival, they said, or the people might riot.

dag: Bina anahi m-beni damdi dunia ŋɔ, ka di ku tooi deei li. Dina n-nyɛ:.
en: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:.

en: When Enoch was , he had a son named Methuselah.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini Izraɛl kpamba ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi daa chaŋ Obɛdɛdom yiŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: David, the elders of Israel, and the generals went to get the Box of the Lord s Agreement. They brought it out from Obed Edoms house. Everyone was very happy!.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka Naawuni nir bebu mali m-be viɛnyɛliŋga zaa, ka o mali din ni chɛ ka o tooi tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: Using the Scriptures, those who serve God will be prepared and will have everything they need to do every good work.

dag: N daa niŋ ninvuɣ titali gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa pun daŋ n tooni di Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa lan mali yɛm pam.
en: Yes, I was great, greater than anyone else who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and my wisdom never failed me.

dag: O chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa be viɛnyɛliŋga yi ʒiɛman ni. Tiliginsim mini yɛm ni baŋsim din galisi bela o sani. Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ Ziɔn azichi.
en: and give stability to the nation. He always protects his people and gives them wisdom and knowledge. Their greatest treasure is their reverence for the Lord .

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ mɔɣa kom leei ʒim, ka bɛ ku tooi lan nyu bɛ kulibɔna kom.
en: God turned the rivers into blood, and the Egyptians could not drink the water.

dag: A nya bɛ ni bɔhi ma biɛri, ka lɔri ma nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa shɛm.
en: Look at all of my enemies vengeance, all of their scheming against me.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti chɛ ba ka leei dabari dɔni n-di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim saha shɛli bɛ ni ti lan ka di ni maa, dama bɛ ʒiɛm n zaligunima ka zaɣisi n zaligunim maa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ kpiɔŋ jilima. A nirilim zuɣu ka ti di nasara.
en: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.

dag: nti nya ka o nyaandol shɛb bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: They saw that some of his followers ate food with hands that were not clean, meaning that they did not wash their hands in a special way.

dag: ka a ni tooi zaŋ li zali di tuma shee ka mi so shɛŋa din kuni di yiŋa?.
en: Can you take it to its territory; do you know the paths to its house?.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa; ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin maa niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li tari salo maa zaa.
en: Jesus told the people to sit on the ground. Then he took the seven loaves and gave thanks to God. He broke the bread into pieces and gave them to his followers. He told them to give the bread to the people, and they did as he said.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi yi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di ni gbuɣi ya bahi kaman di ni daa gbuɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be yi tooni la bahi shɛm la.
en: If you do these things, you will make the land filthy. And it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were there before you.

dag: N zɔnim maani ma la ansarisi, ka n kuhi ni nintam niŋ Naawuni.
en: My friend speaks for me, while my eyes pour out tears to God.

dag: Miriya ka yi zu.
en: Do not steal.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zaŋ a leei zuliya pam yaba. Dinzuɣu alikauli maa nyɛla din kul ʒiɛya ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa niŋ Naawuni so yɛda maa sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa din kani be.
en: As the Scriptures say, I have made you a father of many nations. This is true before God, the one Abraham believed—the God who gives life to the dead and speaks of things that dont yet exist as if they are real.

dag: yin ti piimiya yi ni yɛn tuui kpuɣi puu atam shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni zaa niŋ piɛri puuni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli ni o yuli be nimaani la.
en: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped.

dag: Naawuni daa pun lo lahibal suŋ ŋɔ alikauli o daanabinim noya ni ka di yuui, hal ka di yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni.
en: that he promised long ago by what his prophets said in the holy Scriptures.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dol o chana. Ka salo daa muɣ o sani kabiri dol o.
en: Then Jesus started off with him. So many people were going along with Jesus that they were crowding him from every side.

dag: Naa bi diri nasara tɔb ni la o tɔbbihi galisim zuɣu, ka tɔbutuhiri biiŋa mi bi diri nasara la o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: A king does not win because of his powerful army; a soldier does not triumph because of his strength.

dag: ka din pahi pisiniyini daa gbaai Hɔtir min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Twenty-first, there were men chosen from Hothirs sons and relatives.

dag: Di simdi ni yi baŋ ni yi gba daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa teeg o yiko nuu yihi ya nimaani na. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa.
en: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.

dag: Kamiyana ti di m bindira ŋɔ, ka nyu n ni zaŋ wain shɛli gabi tab ŋɔ.
en: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di saha n ti ku kpihim yi birili zaa.
en: This message is from the Lord : But, Judah, when these terrible days come, I will not fully destroy you.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba shɛb daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli salo bɛn daa laɣim maa zaa.
en: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ mali maligu ti Naawuni la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti beni.
en: The governor ordered them not to eat any of the holy food until there was a priest who could use the Urim and Thummim to ask God what to do.

dag: ka din pahi pisiniyini daa gbaai Hɔtir min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the twenty-first to Hothir, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zɛbida. O daa nyɛla Ruma nir ŋun yuli daa booni Pɛdaya la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoiakim was years old when he was appointed king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother Zebidah was the daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.

dag: Ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni Wulimpuhili polo nim la zaa daa laɣim do vinvamli maa ni, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Bɛ laakumnim daa ka kalinli; bɛ galisim daa ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu.
en: The Midianites, the Amalekites, and the desert tribesmen were spread out in the valley like a swarm of locusts, and they had as many camels as there are grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni daa pii ti yaannima n-chɛ ka bɛ nab pam hal saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nyɛ tinzunnima m-be Ijipti la. Ka o daa ti yihi ba nimaani o yiko ni.
en: The God of Israel chose our ancestors, and he let our people prosper while they were living in Egypt. Then with his mighty power he led them out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, niriba maa ni ŋubiri nimdi maa shɛm maa, bɛ tumdila alahichi Yawɛ sani maa, dama bɛ bi kɔri ba viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka o yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla nyaanyiriba, bilimmiya kuɣ titali sɔŋ ma kpe na.
en: When it was reported to Saul, The troops are sinning against the LORD by eating meat with blood in it, Saul said, All of you are traitors! Roll a large stone over here right now.

dag: Yulimiya zuliya shɛba n-nya alahiziba, ka di gari ya. Dama n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli yi ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni, ka yi yi wum li yi ku niŋ li yɛda.
en: Then the Lord said to his people, Keep watching the nations around you, and you will be astonished at what you see. I am going to do something that you will not believe when you hear about it.

dag: Bɛ kul tuhirila bɛ karimbaan yɛtɔɣa bahira, tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul nyurila bara.
en: They spew arrogant words; all the evildoers are bragging.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela o jɛmbu duu din be kasi puuni, chɛliya ka dunianim zaa fo o tooni.
en: But the Lord is in his holy temple, so the whole earth should be silent in his presence and show him respect.

dag: Gɔhi mini zana m-be ninvuɣ biɛri sol zuɣu; yɛnnim bɛn ni laligi ka chɛ li.
en: Evil people are trapped by many troubles, but those who want to live avoid them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini zo yomyom, dama di daa gari ba mi pam ka bɛ ni sɔhira; bɛ mi daa bi yɛli so shɛli sol ni, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba. .
en: Overcome with terror and dread, they fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. .

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Naa Hɛziɛl yiŋa, ka chɛ ka buɣim di n-saɣim Naa Bɛnhadad ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: So I will start a fire at Hazaels house that will destroy the great palaces of Ben-Hadad.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi; dunianim zaa lumiy o sizuura.
en: Bow down to the LORD in his holy splendor! Tremble before him, all the earth!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyaya ni di nyɛla bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi tooi nya vuhim maa.
en: We see that they couldnt enter because of their lack of faith.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Juda zuliya yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gari lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Judah, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: Ka o daa tim nachimbi pola pia ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Kamɛl nti chaŋ Nabal sani ti zaŋ n yuli puh o.
en: So David sent ten servants, telling them, Go up to Carmel. When you get to Nabal, greet him for me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Labimiya nti yɛli Jɔn yi ni nya ka wum shɛm:.
en: Jesus answered, Go back and tell John what you are hearing and seeing:.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni daazichi zaa mini di nyamma zaa ni di binshɛɣukam zaa din mali anfaani ni Juda nanim daazichi zaa niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme n-di li n-zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn.
en: I will hand over all the wealth of this city, all its goods and valuables, including the treasures of the kings of Judah, to their enemies, who will ransack and pillage and carry it all off to Babylon.

dag: Hal bɛ ni kul yɛra, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, di zaa yoli bɛ pɔri maa nyɛla ʒiri pɔri.
en: Even when making a pledge—As the LORD lives— they swear falsely.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim, n suhigu paar a asiba.
en: Lord , I am asking you to help me! Early each morning I pray to you.

en: The wise gain respect, but fools receive shame.

en: Mortal man, he said, now that those Israelite rebels are asking you what you're doing.

dag: Yi ni bo biŋkɔb shɛb mali sara kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, yin bomiya binyɛra maa pahi biŋkɔbigu kam zuɣu.
en: When more than one animal is offered, the accompanying offering is to be increased proportionately.

dag: N ni niŋ di tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ di polo la ka di nyɛ n ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi zuliya kam zaa, ka di sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni la.
en: I said many bad things will happen to Babylon, and all of them will happen. Jeremiah spoke about those foreign nations. And all the warnings are written in this book.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o suhu saɣim pam ka o yɛli, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: After Jesus said these things, he felt very troubled. He said openly, Believe me when I say that one of you will hand me over to my enemies.

dag: dama o daa wuhirila o nyaandoliba yɛri ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni ka bɛ ti ku o; amaa bɛ yi ti ku o, o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: because he was teaching the disciples that the Son of Man would be handed over to people who would kill him. But three days later he would rise to life.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ni tɔŋda, ka bɛ bihi ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.

en: All the tools, tent pegs, and other things used in the Holy Tent must be made from bronze. And all the pegs for the curtains around the courtyard must be made from bronze.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ka dɔro maa niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, o zuɣu ni hal ni o naba ni, ka maligumaana maa nya li.

en: They spoke the Lords word to him and everyone else in his house.

en: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ n yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, m paɣir a ka tir a jilima. A ni ti ma yɛm mini kpiɔŋ; ka kahigi ti ni suh a shɛl la wuhi ma, ka wuhi ti ni a deei ti suhigu, ka lan wuhi ti ti ni yɛn yɛli naa shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I praise you and honor you, God of my ancestors. You have given me wisdom and strength; you have answered my prayer and shown us what to tell the king.

dag: Yɛlimiya m ba n ni nya jilima shɛli zaa Ijipti ŋɔ mini yimaŋmaŋ nini ni nya shɛlikam zaa. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti zaŋ m ba kuli kpe na.
en: Tell my father how powerful I am here in Egypt and tell him about everything that you have seen. Then hurry and bring him here.

en: If only I had a place in the desert— a house where travelers spend the night— so I could leave my people. I could go away from them, because they are all unfaithful to God. They have all turned against him.

dag: Amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n ni laɣim yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ zaa na kaman piɛri bɛn yi mɔɣu ni na ni bɛ ti kpe buzɔŋ ni la. Niriba ni ti lan pali yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni kaman biŋkɔbbaligu ni be mɔri ŋubbu shee shɛm la.
en: Ill surely gather Jacob—all of you! Ill surely assemble you, those who are left of Israel! Ill put them together like sheep in Bozrah, like a flock in its pen, noisy with people.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nol ni yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka o zaŋ yɛli zali zuɣusaa mini dunia tiŋgbani din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni buɣim ti saɣim li ŋɔ. Di ʒiɛya gulila dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri ŋun Naawuni sizuura saria la.
en: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.

dag: ni bunsi tuhi pihiyɔbu ni yini.

en: Prepare the food that I love. Bring it to me, and I will eat it. Then I will bless you before I die.

dag: M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi ni niriba pam bɔri ni yi niŋ karimbanima, dama yi mi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ karimbanim ni ti nya saria karibu gari sokam.
en: My friends, not many of you should become teachers. As you know, we teachers will be judged with greater strictness than others.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Zaŋm a kabɔɣili ŋɔ palo ŋɔ ti ma ka m me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, kɔhimi li ti ma kaman di daa ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ miligi ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: David said to Ornan, Give me the site of the threshing floor, charging me full price, so that I may build an altar to the LORD, and the plague among the people may come to an end.

dag: A yi nya li tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni so sani, yin kum o, ka tinim bɛn kpalim zaa mi leei ti dan daba.
en: If you find the silver cup in any of our sacks, let that man die. You can kill him, and we will be your slaves.

dag: Bɛ pala dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm.
en: They dont belong to the world, just as I dont belong to the world.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ tiligi n shia kum ni, ka nyɛhi n nintam, ka tiligi n naba tuubu ni.
en: You, God, have delivered me from death, my eyes from tears, and my foot from stumbling.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni lu ka ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba yiŋ ni zani.
en: The wicked are destroyed and are no more, but the family of the righteous will endure.

dag: Bɛ tum vi tuma, ka tum din chihira, amaa ka vi bi mali ba hal baabiɛla gba. Bɛ daa bi mi vidibo ni nyɛ shɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti lu m-pahi bɛn ti yɛn lu zuɣu. N yi ti darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli, bɛ ni ŋme m-paai ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They should be ashamed of their detestable practices, but they have no shame; they dont even blush! Therefore, they will fall among the fallen and stumble when disaster arrives, declares the LORD.

dag: ni Ashan mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi mini di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: Ashan with its pasturelands, Juttah with its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh with its pasturelands.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili nyɛla kum tumo, ka ŋun mali yɛm ni maai li.
en: The kings anger is a messenger of death; the wise will calm him.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Lɛvinim yi baɣaka saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Be sure, also, not to neglect the Levites, as long as you live in your land.

dag: Juda Naa Ahazia bia Naa Jɔash ni daa di Juda nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaata saha, ka Jɛhu bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di Izraɛl nam n-ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayopɔin.
en: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled years from Samaria.

dag: Lala ka n daa shiri niŋ Jɛrusalɛm. Maligumaaniba kpamba daa ti ma yiko, ka n gbahi Yisa nyaandoliba pam ti kpɛhi duu, amaa pa lala kɔŋko ka n daa niŋ. Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn ku bɛ ni shɛb la n gba daa ʒiɛla bɛn yɛn ku ba maa nyaaŋa.
en: And thats what I did, beginning in Jerusalem. The leading priests gave me the authority to put many of Gods people in jail. And when they were being killed, I agreed that it was a good thing.

dag: ka yipa zaŋla biɛr palli kpɛhi yi ni, Dina n-nyɛ: Biɛr pal shɛli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ di namda la ni zaŋd omaŋmaŋ ŋmahinli n-kul lɛbigiri li zaɣ palli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ŋun Naawuni la.
en: and have put on the new self. This is the new being which God, its Creator, is constantly renewing in his own image, in order to bring you to a full knowledge of himself.

dag: N tuumbiɛri dumi yaɣi n zuɣu, di tibisim bemi kaman ʒi shɛli din tibisi nyaŋ ma.
en: My guilt is like a heavy burden. I am sinking beneath its weight.

dag: Ka dansarika gula maa daa yɛli Pool ni sariakaritib maa tim na ti yɛl o ni o yoom ba bahi ka bɛ chaŋ; dinzuɣu ni bɛ yim n-chaŋ ni suhuʒia.
en: The jailer said to Paul, The officials have sent these soldiers to let you go free. You can leave now. Go in peace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba pahi Yisa zuɣu ni bɛ ti ku ba.
en: They also led two other criminals to be executed with Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka doo sabirila amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ pɔi ka naanyi yih o paɣa.
en: Their answer was, Moses gave permission for a man to write a divorce notice and send his wife away.

dag: N yiko din galisi puuni ka n daa teei n nuu nam dunia mini ninsalinima ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni, ka zaŋdi li tiri n nini ni tiɣi so.
en: I made the earth and all the people on it. I made all the animals on the earth. I did this with my great power and my strong arm. I can give the earth to anyone I want.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim suhuri daa yiɣisi ka bɛ ŋmɛr o ni yɛli shɛm maa naŋgbankpeeni ka bɔhiri taba, Wula ka doo ŋɔ ni tooi zaŋ o niŋgbuŋ ti ti ka ti ŋubi.
en: Then the Jews began to argue among themselves. They said, How can this man give us his body to eat.

dag: A ku zɔri yuŋ varisigu bee peen shɛŋa din yiɣiri wuntaŋ ni.
en: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila yɛndaan so ŋun daa me o yili tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri diri ma shɛhira biɛri, ka wuhi ni n tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa, ka n ʒi di yɛla.
en: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan kana ti zani nimaani m-boon o kaman o ni di pun boon o shɛm la, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlima, a dabili wumda.
en: Then the LORD came and stood there, calling just as before, Samuel, Samuel! Samuel said, Speak. Your servant is listening.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ daa zali Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu saha shɛl o ni daa zali Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ sara maligunim na ti ti ŋun Yawɛ Sinai mɔɣu ni la.
en: There on Mount Sinai in the desert, the Lord gave these commands to Moses on the day he told the people of Israel to make their offerings.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; cham ti niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee daŋ mali mahili zaɣ bila n-ti ma na, ka naanyi chaŋ ti mal a min a bidibiga maa mi dini.
en: Don't worry, Elijah said to her. Go on and prepare your meal. But first make a small loaf from what you have and bring it to me, and then prepare the rest for you and your son.

dag: Chɛ ka a maligumaaniba zaŋ wuntia biɛhigu kpɛhi bɛ kɔbili ni, ka chɛ ka a niriba bɛn ʒe a yim yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: May your priests be clothed in victory and your loyal followers be filled with joy.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ nandaamba alaka ka bɛ baɣa ka bɛ ni, bɛ fa yili shɛli din pa bɛ ni me shɛl la.
en: because they oppressed and neglected the poor and seized houses someone else had built.

dag: Hal yi ni maani sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la mini chi sara la, n ku deei li. M mi ku gbiligi lihi yi ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb kar shɛb na nti maani suhudoo sara la.
en: If you bring me your entirely burned offerings and gifts of food— I wont be pleased; I wont even look at your offerings of well-fed animals.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun nyɛ yɛndana ni shini tuumbiɛri ŋɔ saha; dama tuumbiɛri saha n-shiri bala!.
en: At that time wise teachers will be quiet, because it is a bad time.

dag: Kpahimmiya m-baŋ yi galimi ni yi shɛl na, ka niŋ tuuba n-lan lab yi tuuli yurilim la ni yaha. Di yi pa lala n ni kana nti kpuɣi yi firilatamdigu la di zaashee.
en: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi chuɣu yila yilibu mal alibarika. Yawɛ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tooni neesim ni mal alibarika.
en: Our Lord , you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka bɛ bi lan tiri Lɛvinim bɛ dihili ni nyɛ shɛli, dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim mini yiliyiiniba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma maa daa chɛ li ka chaŋ bɛ puri ni.
en: I also heard that the people had not given the Levites their share. So the Levites and singers had gone back to work in their own fields.

dag: Yi yi ti suhiri Naawuni, yi boon o la yi Ba. Ŋun Naawuni n-nyɛ sariakarita ŋun kariti sokam zaa yinoyino saria kaman o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bi yaari so yuri ka chɛ so, dinzuɣu lumiy o sizuura saha shɛli yi ni be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: Since you call upon a Father who judges all people according to their actions without favoritism, you should conduct yourselves with reverence during the time of your dwelling in a strange land.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ me gooni gili ya, ka teei gili ya. Bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbee fiɛbi Izraɛl naa tapaɣa.
en: People of Jerusalem, gather your forces! We are besieged! They are attacking the leader of Israel!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bundaannim mini karimbaannim mali ti ansarisi ti yaɣi.
en: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.

dag: Pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi maa daa nyɛla bini pihiwɛinaayɔbu m-be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka pumpɔrinchihi din daa gɔhigɔhi kur shɛŋa din gabigabi taba gili maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga.
en: On the grillwork of each column there were a hundred pomegranates in all, and ninety-six of these were visible from the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka wuntizɔriba zaa suh a bɛ muɣisigu saha, ka kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ ku paai ba.
en: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa zaŋ kpani to o ni o ku o; di saha ka Jɔnatan daa baŋ ni o ba shiri loya ni o ku Dauda.
en: At that, Saul threw his spear at Jonathan to kill him, and Jonathan realized that his father was really determined to kill David.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-jiɣiri yi ni wum ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali pun gari la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli so n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee n-yihi waazu yɛl lala bee ŋ-ŋɔ so n-yɛli ni tinima n-sabi gbaŋ puuni yɛl lala.
en: We dont want you to be easily confused in your mind or upset if you hear that the day of the Lord is already here, whether you hear it through some spirit, a message, or a letter supposedly from us.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda ka o yuli booni Ziba la daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa bol o ti Naa Dauda ka o ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Ziba? Ka o garigi yɛli, Naa, mani.
en: There was a servant of Saul's family named Ziba, and he was told to go to David. Are you Ziba? the king asked. At your service, sir, he answered.

dag: Fɔŋ kara din daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin daŋ niriba tinsi n-nyɛ: Jɛriko mini Bɛtihɔgila ni Ɛmɛkɛziiz.
en: Each family got its land. These are their cities: Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz.

dag: ni Aijalɔn ni Gatirimɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: Aijalon, and Gath Rimmon. They also got fields with those towns. Those towns were in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ni alaafee, ka dabiɛm bi mali ba, ka teeku daa zaŋ bɛ dimnim la vali.
en: He led them safely, and they were not afraid; but the sea came rolling over their enemies.

dag: A ni ti kpi ni suhudoo. Bɛ ni daa tuɣili a yaannim bɛn daa daŋ a tooni n-nyɛ nanim la tulaale zim shɛm, lala ka bɛ ni ti tuɣili a gba tulaale zim, ka fabili a zuɣu yɛli, Mbaye ti dana. Dama mani n yɛli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: you will die a peaceful death. As burial incense was burned to honor your ancestors, the kings who came before you, so it will be burned to honor you as people mourn, Oh, master! I myself promise this, declares the LORD.

dag: dama bɛ yi kul lu buyopɔin, bɛ ni lan yiɣisi; amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: No matter how often honest people fall, they always get up again; but disaster destroys the wicked.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ nabia Jɔash n-yina ti booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam; ka zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o; ka zaŋ Naawuni kundi ti o; ka bɛ kpahi bɛ nuhi ka yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: Jehoiada then brought out the kings son, crowned him, gave him the royal law, and made him king and anointed him, as everyone applauded and cried out, Long live the king.

dag: kaman Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la mini Mɔabnim bɛn be Ar la ni daa niŋ ma shɛm hal ka n ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti la ni.
en: until we cross the Jordan River into the land that the Lord our God is giving us. The descendants of Esau, who live in Edom, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, allowed us to pass through their territory.

dag: ni vikpiluɣu mini viɣu zaɣ titali ni kulinoo.
en: the small owl and the large owl, the water hen.

dag: Ka di tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo pateesanim wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisinaayi.
en: On the east side, where the entrance was, the enclosure was also yards wide.

dag: Mani n-daa yi piiri bɛ ni bɔri shɛli tiri ba. Mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. N daa bemi kaman naa m-be o tɔbbihi san la, ka be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun maari bɛn fabindi suhuri la.
en: I decided their path, sat as chief. I lived like a king with his troops, like one who comforts mourners.

dag: Sokam daa yul o tuma maa, sokam daa ʒiɛla katiŋa ka yuuni li.
en: Everyone has seen what he has done; but we can only watch from a distance.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti wum niriba ni yɔri vuri, ka o yɛli Musa, Niriba yɔrila tɔb tuhibu vuri sansani maa ni.
en: When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, It sounds like war in the camp.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o ku o nimaani sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa luɣili ni o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: At once the Lord God became angry with Uzzah and killed him because of his irreverence. Uzzah died there beside the Covenant Box.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpuɣ a nuu zuɣusaa, amaa bɛ bi nya li. Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ a ni yur a niriba shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi. Zaŋm a ni yɛn zaŋ buɣim shɛli wɔb a dimnim la wɔb ba.
en: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni ka o daa chɛ di zaa, ka zaŋ omaŋa leei dabili. Ka daa leei daadam m-mali daadam niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu.
en: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin bapira Matania n-leei naa zali ŋun Jɛhoyachin zaani, ka taɣ o yuli Zɛdɛkia.
en: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah the new king. Mattaniah was Jehoiachins uncle. He changed his name to Zedekiah.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala.
en: Then the prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey, and they did so.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti nya ka Ijipti do so muɣisir o mabihi maa ni yino ka di ka soli, ka o ŋme n-ku Ijipti doo maa.
en: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.

dag: Ka Zifinim daa ti ka Sool sanna Gibia nti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela Hachila Zoli din mini Jɛshimɔn nin tuhi tab la zuɣu.
en: The people of Ziph went to see Saul at Gibeah and said to him, David is hiding on Hakilah Hill, across from Jeshimon.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni yi ti bi filim di dabisa maa, so ti ku tiligi, amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda la zuɣu ka o ni ti filim di dabisa maa.
en: But God has decided to make that terrible time short. If it were not made short, no one would continue living. But God will make that time short to help the people he has chosen.

dag: N ni be a sani yuun pisi shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zaa, a piɛri min a buhi ni zaɣ yino gba na ʒi m-mali baɣili nti zaŋ li bahi, ka m mi na ʒi n-gbaag a piɛlaa kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: I have been with you now for twenty years; your sheep and your goats have not failed to reproduce, and I have not eaten any rams from your flocks.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Pa ninvuɣ pia n-di kpaŋ maa? Ka niriba awɛi la, bɛn kpalim ya?.
en: Jesus asked, Weren't ten men healed? Where are the other nine?.

dag: Ka gomna maa daa nya din niŋ maa ka niŋ yɛda, dama ti Duuma yɛligu maa wuhibu daa gar o pam.
en: When the governor saw what had happened, he was amazed at this teaching about the Lord. So he put his faith in the Lord.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila anzinfa viɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun tɛha buchi bi yaɣi lala.
en: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked lacks value.

dag: Bɛ bihi ʒiɛla bɛ tooni, ka bɛ nina nya bɛ yaansi.
en: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn ku niriba me tiŋ zali, ka tum tuumbiɛri zali fɔntiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: You are doomed! You founded a city on crime and built it up by murder.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je man Yawɛ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni ka dabiɛm mali ba, ka bɛ tibidarigibo ti ku mali tariga.
en: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni o ni daa ku Galilinim shɛb maa daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari Galilinim zaa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpi maa?.
en: Jesus replied: Do you think that these people were worse sinners than everyone else in Galilee just because of what happened to them?.

dag: Anabinim yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla pɔhim, dama yɛligu maa ka bɛ ni. Lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ ba.
en: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o yuri ninvuɣ so ŋun doli wuntitali soli.
en: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.

dag: ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa ti Bia maa jilima kaman bɛ ni tir o Ba maa jilima shɛm. Ŋunkam bi tiri Bia maa jilima bi tirila o Ba ŋun tim o maa na jilima.
en: so that all will honor the Son in the same way as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa lab ti yɛli Naawuni daanab maa. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ kpam maa kɔhi n-yo yi samli maa, ka chɛ din kpalim ka a min a bidibisi maa dira.
en: After she told Elisha what had happened, he said, Sell the oil and use part of the money to pay what you owe the man. You and your sons can live on what is left.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛla mal a dabiɛm; sɔhigima, kul di chɛ ka binshɛli be a ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Skies, be shocked at what happened! Shake with great fear! This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni ku zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara ti Yawɛ, dindina doo maa ŋun zaŋm biŋkɔbigu maa chaŋ maligumaana sani.
en: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛndana saɣisigu, di so ni o wum jɛrigu yila.
en: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi, Ka di chaŋ wula ka n wumdi piɛri kumsi mini niɣi ŋumbu.
en: But Samuel said, Then what is that sound I hear? Why do I hear sheep and cattle.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ni biŋgbamda bɛn be tiŋgban ni alikauli tin ya, ka kpihim tɔbiri mini takɔbiri ni tɔb tuhibu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: At that time I will make a covenant with all the wild animals and birds, so that they will not harm my people. I will also remove all weapons of war from the land, all swords and bows, and will let my people live in peace and safety.

dag: Ka Jɔn yɛli ba, So ku tooi mali shɛli ka di pa ni Naawuni n-ti o li.
en: John answered, No one can have anything unless God gives it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Matiu maa yiŋa n-daa ti ʒini ni o di bindirigu, ka farigudeeriba pam mini alahichinim kana nti ʒini pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: Jesus ate dinner at Matthews house. Many tax collectors and others with bad reputations came and ate with him and his followers.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni nyɛla Naawuni dima, dama o bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, hal ka shiri ku tooi dol li.
en: Why is this true? Because anyone whose thinking is controlled by their sinful self is against God. They refuse to obey Gods law. And really they are not able to obey it.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya yɛla: Hal Izraɛl yaansi ni galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni niriba bɛn kpalim biɛla kɔŋko n-ni tiligi;.
en: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.

dag: Dama so ku tooi lan zali tanza shɛli pahila din pun zali maa, dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia.
en: The foundation that has already been built is Jesus Christ, and no one can build any other foundation.

dag: nti nya ka di nyɛla bɛ zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka bɛ daa fiɣis o, amaa ka o mi bi tum taal shɛli din simdi ni bɛ ku o bee n-kpɛh o duu.
en: I found out that he had not done a thing for which he deserved to die or be put in prison; the accusation against him had to do with questions about their own law.

dag: Bɛ yi kuhi boli ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni saɣi. Bɛ yi suhiri ma, bɛ noli ti yɛn lu tiŋa, n ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: Before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will hear.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dindali maa, nayili yila ni ti leei fabila kuhigu. Niriba ni ti kpi n-do luɣ shɛlikam. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba labi ka fo baalim.
en: On that day, the people will wail the temple songs, says the LORD God; there will be many corpses, thrown about everywhere. Silence.

dag: Ka o yiŋbihi maa daa yi n-doli solɔri maa laɣim bɛ ni nya ninvuɣ shɛb zaa na; ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma hal ka amiliya lɔbu duu maa ti tiɣi salo.
en: So the servants went into the streets. They gathered all the people they could find, good and bad alike, and brought them to where the wedding feast was ready. And the place was filled with guests.

dag: ka nyɛ Keenannim ni daa su tiŋgban shɛl la zaa mini Miara din nyɛ Sidɔnnim ni daa su luɣ shɛl la zaŋ ti paai Afɛk ni zaŋ hal ti paai Amɔrinim tintariga la.
en: There is still all the Canaanite country, and Mearah , as far as Aphek, at the Amorite border;.

dag: Ka yi mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: Make two gold rings and fasten them on the front of the lower part of the two shoulder pieces of the vest, at its seam just above the vests belt.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa dii zaŋ Yisa tahi mɔɣu ni.
en: Then the Spirit sent Jesus into the desert alone.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛgilɔn daa laɣim Ammɔnnim mini Amalɛknima m-pah o min o niriba zuɣu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka fa dɔbino tihi tiŋ la bɛ sani.
en: Eglon got help from the Ammonites and the Amalekites. They joined him and attacked the Israelites. Eglon and his army defeated the Israelites and forced them to leave the City of Palm Trees.

dag: Ka di tooi biɛla ka so lan nya o n-yɛli, A gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino! Ka Pita yɛli, Zɔri, m pala bɛ ni yino.
en: After a little while a man noticed Peter and said, You are one of them, too! But Peter answered, Man, I am not.

dag: O daa shiri kpila sokam zaa zuɣu ni bɛn mali nyɛviya la di lan be bɛmaŋmaŋ yubu tumbu zuɣu, amaa ka ni bela ŋun daa kpi bɛ zuɣu ka lan neei maa yubu tumbu zuɣu.
en: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Gibiɔnnim maa, Bɔ ka n lee yɛn niŋ tin ya? Bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yɔn ya ti ni daa tum ya taal shɛli maa samli, ka yi suhi alibarika niŋ Yawɛ ni su shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: David said to the Gibeonites, What can I do for you? How can I fix matters so you can benefit from the LORDs inheritance.

dag: Dama Keenannim mini bɛnkam be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yi wum li, bɛ ni kana ti teei gil ti, ka kpihim ti birili dunia ŋɔ ni; ka di yi niŋ lala, wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ a yuli din galisi ŋɔ.
en: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.

dag: Di simdi ni dapaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Each board will be fifteen feet long and twenty-seven inches wide.

dag: Bɛ maanila nazuɣuri ansarisi, ka mali nanim diɛmda. Bɛ larila bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛŋa, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu duhiri ni bɛ dee li.
en: He makes fun of kings; rulers are ridiculous to him. He laughs at every fortress, then he piles up dirt and takes it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa piɛbi kikahi; ka niriba maa tahira. Niriba maa ni daa kul wum kikahi maa kumsi; bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee tahiri pampam, ka tiŋ maa goondaa maa dii kabi ti lu tiŋa; ka niriba maa dii zɔri tuhi bɛ tooni dɛde n-kab kpe tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li.
en: So then the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the trumpets, they began shouting. The walls fell down, and the people ran up into the city. So the Israelites defeated that city.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe Tɛman tɔbbi biinsi, ka bɛ dimnim ti kpimsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Iso Zoli maa zuɣu zaa.
en: Your warriors will be shattered, Teman, and everyone from Mount Esau will be eliminated.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, A na ʒi n-di ti ni so bini zalinsi bee n-nahim ti bee n-fa ti ni so bini.
en: No, the Israelites answered. You've never cheated us in any way.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa ni shɛb yɛli, Dindina doo maa pala Naawuni nira, dama o bi doli Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu. Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Ka wula ka alahichilana ni tooi wuhi shihira ŋɔ tatabo? Ka bɛ noya woli.
en: Some of the Pharisees said, The man who did this cannot be from God, for he does not obey the Sabbath law. Others, however, said, How could a man who is a sinner perform such miracles as these? And there was a division among them.

dag: Nam jaaŋgbee ti ku yi Juda nuu ni. Nam jaaŋgbee mi ti ku yi o zuliya nuu ni hal ka ŋun su li ti kana. Ka niriba ni ti deer o noli.
en: The scepter wont depart from Judah, nor the rulers staff from among his banners. Gifts will be brought to him; people will obey him.

dag: Bɛ kul tumdila vi tuma, ka di kuri ma suli. Bɛ maanila maligu buɣa ni, ka tuɣindi tulaale buɣa maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.

dag: Dunia salinim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ!.
en: Earth, sing to the Lord !.

dag: Bɛ zaa kalinsi nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: At last the woman died.

dag: Pa ti yaannim kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ŋɔ, amaa tinim bɛn zaa na be ti nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The LORD didnt make this covenant with our ancestors but with us—all of us who are here and alive right now.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ yɛm mini baŋsim azichi zaa ni sɔɣi so ni.
en: He is the key that opens all the hidden treasures of God's wisdom and knowledge.

dag: ka yi bi lan chɛ ka o gbib o ba min o ma maa gba.
en: they are excused from helping their father or mother.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ʒili marigi yi dim buŋ sɔŋ tiŋa, yin di chɛ o mini ʒili maa sɔŋ, amaa yin sɔŋm o yiɣisi buŋ maa zali.
en: If you see an animal that cannot walk because it has too much to carry, you must stop and help that animal. You must help that animal even if it belongs to one of your enemies.

dag: Ka na shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam gba pun di n-ʒini nimaani, ka daa su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣilinim zaa, ka deeri ba farigu.
en: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbib o nuu ni n-du Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: So Moses cut two more stone tablets, and early the next morning he carried them up Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔ puuni jilima din galisi la zuɣu chɛ ka din gba daa mali jilima la jilima maa naai.
en: That old agreement had glory. But it really loses its glory when it is compared to the much greater glory of the new agreement.

dag: Ka salo maa galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bara maa zaŋ paai Yisa sani, ka daa dula duu maa zuɣusaa nti chib voli Yisa zuɣusaa dɛde. Bɛ ni daa chib voli maa, ka bɛ zaŋ bara maa mini amaŋka maa siɣisi li ti sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: But because of the crowd, they could not get him to Jesus. So they made a hole in the roof above him and let the man down in front of everyone.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi n-lab o sapashin tab maa sani ka bɛ ti bɔh o, Alaafee? Ka lan bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka yinyaa maa lee kana ti bɔr a sani? Ka Jɛhu yɛli ba, Yi pun mi o ni o yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: Jehu went out to his masters officers. They said to him, Is everything okay? Why did this fanatic come to you? Jehu said to them, You know the man and the nonsense he talks.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, doliya dunoya yi. Malimiya soli sɔŋ niriba. Vuɣimiya kuɣa soli maa zuɣu. Lomiya tuuta n-kpuɣ li zuɣusaa ka niriba nya li baŋ li.
en: Pass through, pass through the gates; prepare the way for the people! Build, build the road; clear away the stones! Raise up a signal for the peoples.

dag: Nir yi gbaag omaŋa ka chɛ zabili, di tir o jilima, amaa jɛrigu kam ŋun bɔrila zabili yomyom.
en: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n niŋ li. N ku chɛ ka bɛ galim n yuli maa. N ku zaŋ n jilima ti so.
en: What I do is done for my own sake— I will not let my name be dishonored or let anyone else share the glory that should be mine and mine alone.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A pun nya o, hal ŋuna n-dir a alizama ŋɔ.
en: Jesus said to him, You have already seen him, and he is the one who is talking with you now.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya o ka bɛ jɛm o; amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb biɛhim o.
en: When they saw him, they worshipped him, but some doubted.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni wuh a Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ʒii maa wuhirila di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yɛla maa naabu saha.
en: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nir alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi tum alahichi zuɣu!.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: There will always be something that causes people to sin. But anyone who causes them to sin is in for trouble. A person who causes even one of my little followers to sin.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ n-yiɣisi be kaman Nail mɔɣili la, ka be kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pal la?.
en: What nation is this, that rises like the Nile River overflowing its banks?.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, bɛ ni ti mi o niriba la, Bɛ ni pirigi so namdili yiŋnima.
en: From then on, that man's family will be known as the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.

dag: Yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam zaa, n ni niŋ li tin ya.
en: I will do whatever you ask me to do.

dag: Ti daa tɛhiya ni di bemi kaman bɛ bahila noli ni bɛ kum ti la. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka ti ku zaŋ timaŋa n-dalim timaŋmaŋa, amaa ka ni zaŋ timaŋa n-dalimla Naawuni ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni la.
en: We felt that the death sentence had been passed on us. But this happened so that we should rely, not on ourselves, but only on God, who raises the dead.

dag: O daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana bi nyar o suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa, amaa ŋun tumdi tuun kpɛma ŋun nyar o suhu ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa.
en: No matter how much a lazy person may want something, he will never get it. A hard worker will get everything he wants.

dag: N chɛ ka a nya jilima dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tum tuun shɛlikam a ni daa ti ma ni n tum la naai.
en: I have shown your glory on earth; I have finished the work you gave me to do.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: Ahimaaz insisted, I don't care what happens; please let me take the news also. Why do you want to do it, my son? Joab asked. You will get no reward for it.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o ni su binshɛlikam zaa ti Yisahaku.
en: Abraham gave everything he owned to Isaac.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, malimi shili n-kahi a nɛma zo. A ni yi amaŋmaŋ biɛhigu shee n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la bɛ ninni. Di pa shɛli bɛ ni baŋ di gbinni, hal bɛ ni kul nyɛ duŋtaariba maa zaa yoli.
en: But you, human one, prepare a backpack for going into exile. In the daytime while they watch, go into exile; while they watch, go out from your place to another. Even though they are a household of rebels, perhaps they will understand.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti nya filiŋ Ijipti zo n-kuli maa ni, ka Firawuna ti chɛ ka bɛ di vi bɛ ni bɔri sɔŋsim shɛli maa puuni.
en: But I tell you, hiding in Egypt will not help you. Pharaoh will not be able to protect you.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi duɣuri mini soobuya ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa n-kpihindi firilanima ni tulaale zim lahi ni daanya la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni la.
en: They also took the pots, the shovels, the wick trimmers, the dishes, and all the bronze items that had been used in the temple.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be salo maa ni yɛli Yisa, Karimba, kpahim a nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni ka bɛ fo.
en: Some of the Pharisees said to Jesus, Teacher, tell your followers not to say these things.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli booni Judas la mini salo daa paana. Ka Judas daa chaŋ Yisa sani nti puh o ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, a crowd came up. It was led by Judas, one of the twelve apostles. He went over to Jesus and greeted him with a kiss.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sin tiŋgban nɛli maa ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Dofika.
en: They left there and camped at Dophkah.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari. Lɛvi daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: These were the Levites names by their generations: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Levi lived years.

dag: Sool min o bidibis ata ni o neen ʒira ni o yiŋnim zaa ni daa laɣim kpi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Saul and his three sons died; his whole household died together.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, A ni saɣi tahi ma ŋmɛnditoya maa sani? Ka o garigi yɛli Dauda, Pom Naawuni ni a ku ku ma bee n-zaŋ ma niŋ n dan maa nuu ni pɔi, ka n naanyi zaŋ a tahi bɛ sani.
en: David asked the Egyptian, Will you lead me to the people who took our families? The Egyptian answered, If you make a special promise before God, I will help you find them. But you must promise that you will not kill me or give me back to my master.

dag: A dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ a. Bɛ chahirimi, ka dimdi bɛ nyina, ka kuhiri yɛra, Ti naag o zaa. Ti ni daa guhiri dabisi shɛl la m-bala, ti bahi nya li.
en: All your enemies open wide their mouths against you; they whistle, grinding their teeth. They say, We have devoured! This is definitely the day weve been waiting for. Weve seen it come to pass.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N wum Mɔabnim ni maani ansarisi shɛm yɛla, ka wum Ammɔnnim turi yɛla. Bɛ maani n niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara ni bɛ ni fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The Lord says, I know what the people of Moab and Ammon did. They embarrassed my people. They took their land to make their own countries larger.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Bɛnaaya, Niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ŋmɛm ku o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi. Ka di chɛ ka ŋun Jɔab ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka di ka sol la ʒim yihibu taali ku lan ʒi m mini m ba yiŋnim zuɣu.
