en: The king commanded Benaiah, Do as he says! Kill him there and take him out to bury him. Then my family and I will be free of Joabs guilt from killing innocent people.

dag: Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi zuliya kam niriba zuɣu. O suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zali ni o ni ku ba.
en: The Lord is angry with all the nations and all their armies. He has condemned them to destruction.

dag: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu bini pihinahi. Dapaɣ yini daa malila di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka dapaɣ yini gba mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi.
en: They made silver bases for the frames—two bases for each frame.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be nam ʒiishee maa tooni ŋ-ŋmani teeku kom din be kaman takɔriti diɣisi kɔtomsi la, ka lan be kaman diɣi la. Ka binnɛma anahi bɛn nyɔri zaŋ tabili bɛ puya mini bɛ nyaansi daa pali nina gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: Also before the throne there was something that looked like a sea of glass, as clear as crystal. In front of the throne and on each side of it there were four living beings. They had eyes all over them, in front and in back.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi dol o lab kul o yiŋa nti di bindirigu ka nyu kom.
en: So the prophet from Judah went home with the old prophet and had a meal with him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi Musa mini Aduna yɛtɔɣa ka zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim mini Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa polo n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yihim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord commanded Moses and Aaron: Tell the Israelites and the king of Egypt that I have ordered you to lead the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma alahiziba pam. Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni n-yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: Her parents were beside themselves with joy, but he ordered them to tell no one what had happened.

dag: Yinim yi mali kpiɔŋ ka tinim gbarigi, ti mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka ti ni suhiri Naawuni shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni yi nya kpaŋsibu.
en: We are happy to be weak if you are strong. And this is what we pray—that your lives will be made completely right again.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Ziba, Ka a dan bia la lee be ya polo? Ka Ziba garigi yɛli naa, Nyama, o kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, dama o yɛlimi, Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ n yab nam ŋɔ ti ma. .
en: Then the king asked, And where is Mephibosheth ? Ziba answered the king, Mephibosheth is staying in Jerusalem. He said, Today the Israelites will give my fathers kingdom back to me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa neei biɛɣu, ka bɛ daa tuui di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu din nyɛ kawaan shɛra mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: On the very next day after Passover, they ate food produced in the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

dag: yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima ka saɣim tiŋ maa zaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni hal ka zaŋ takɔb ku bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: then you must kill all the people of that city and their animals too. You must destroy that city completely.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yi bi sɔŋ a, wula ka man ni tooi sɔŋ a? M malila chi bee wain.
en: Let the Lord help you! the king said. Do you think I have grain or wine to give you.

dag: Jilima mini nam dariza bela o sani, ka kpiɔŋ ni suhupiɛlli be o biɛhigu shee.
en: Glory and majesty surround him, power and joy fill his Temple.

dag: Hal a ni daa mali shɛm piligu ni la, a ni ti mali gari lala dahin shɛli.
en: Then you will have a lot more than you had in the beginning!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya zuɣu, miriya ka yi ʒi ʒiya Vuhim Dabisili dali bee n-ʒi li doli dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: This is what the Lord says: Be careful that you dont carry a load on the Sabbath day. And dont bring a load through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma, n ni garigi ba; n ni be bɛ sani bɛ muɣisigu nyabu saha, n ni tiligi ba ka ti ba jilima.
en: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bɛ fabila maa, ka teeg o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: and God heard their loud cries. He did not forget the promise he had made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Yumakaʒe din garila ka o daa nam ma, mani ka o daa daŋ nambu pɔi ka naanyi nam dunia ŋɔ.
en: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Ti tɔŋya; ti nyɛla azichilaannima ka bi lan bɔri shɛli. Amaa ka bi mi ni yi nyɛla nandahimanim mini nambɔ niriba ni faranima ni zoomba ni bɛn chani bɛ zaɣim.
en: After all, you say, Im rich, and Ive grown wealthy, and I dont need a thing. You dont realize that you are miserable, pathetic, poor, blind, and naked.

dag: Miriya ka yi muɣisi sana, dama yi mi sana suhu ni be shɛm, dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, dahin shɛli kanna ka n ni ti pali n ni daa lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli shɛl la.
en: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.

dag: Barabas daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ tiŋ maa ni yino, ka daa lan nyɛ ŋun ku nir ka bɛ kpɛh o duu di zuɣu.
en: Now Barabbas was in jail because he had started a riot in the city and had murdered someone.

dag: Ka tin tital la daa bɔɣi ʒii buta, ka zuliya kam tinsi daa lu n-dahim zaa. Ka Naawuni daa teei Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la yɛla, ka zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili wain pipia la n-ti Babilɔnnima ni bɛ nyu di zaa.
en: The great city was split into three parts, and the cities of all countries were destroyed. God remembered great Babylon and made her drink the wine from his cup—the wine of his furious anger.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, tiŋ maa ni zo ma dabiɛm, ka deei saɣisigu, ka ku tam n ni niŋ li shɛlikam zaa la yɛla. Amaa ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tuma zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: I thought that then my people would have reverence for me and accept my discipline, that they would never forget the lesson I taught them. But soon they were behaving as badly as ever.

dag: Di saha chɛrubinim maa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nudirigu polo, doo maa ni daa chaŋ ti kpe di ni saha shɛli maa. Ka sagbani daa pali di puuni dundɔŋ la ni.
en: Now the winged creatures were standing to the right of the temple when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner courtyard.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ leei Naawuni zaligu karimbanima, amaa ka lee bi baŋdi bɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-tɔɣisiri maa gbinni bee m-mi bɛ ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ka tɔɣisiri di yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They want to be teachers of Law without understanding either what they are saying or what they are talking about with such confidence.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-tuhiri tɔb tiri ya.
en: Dont fear the kings of these lands, because the Lord your God will fight for you.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa, Gbahimiya Baal daanabinim maa, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ ni so zo n-tiligi. Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba, ka Ilaija zaŋ ba sirigi Kishɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti ku ba nimaani.
en: Then Elijah said, Get the prophets of Baal! Dont let any of them escape! So the people captured all the prophets. Then Elijah led them down to Kishon Creek and killed them all.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna: Ŋunkam yɛli ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyɛ ŋum mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna;.
en: This is how you will be able to know whether it is God's Spirit: anyone who acknowledges that Jesus Christ came as a human being has the Spirit who comes from God.

dag: Lee miriya ka yi ŋubi nimdi din ʒim bi yi di ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: But life is in the blood, and you must not eat any meat that still has blood in it.

dag: Ŋun maŋmaŋa n-lan nyɛ sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi, ka o pala ti kɔŋko daalahichi sara maligu, amaa o nyɛla dunianim zaa daalahichi sara maligu.
en: He is Gods way of dealing with our sins, not only ours but the sins of the whole world.

dag: O mali ninkuunsi ni o bihi, di bi ŋman o bihi n-nyɛ ba; hal o wahala ni yɛn bahi yoli maa o baɣa kani.
en: An ostrich leaves her little babies. She treats them as if they were not her own. If her babies die, she does not care that all her work was for nothing.

dag: Ka wula ka a bɔhi ma lala? Bɔhimila bɛn wum n wuhibu maa m-baŋ n ni yɛli ba shɛm, dama bɛ mi n ni yi yɛri ba shɛm.
en: Why, then, do you question me? Question the people who heard me. Ask them what I told them—they know what I said.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi gbilligbilli ʒini momaha zuɣu.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Tell everyone to sit in groups on the green grass.

dag: Di simdi ni di ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛi, ka di mini di binyila zaa ti nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini.
en: The altar should be square, eighteen inches long and eighteen inches wide. It should be three feet high. Its horns should be permanently attached.

dag: Dindali maa yi ti paai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni tiligi ba kaman piɛgul ni tiligir o piɛri barina ni shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti nyɛlisiri bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni kaman nam zuɣupiligu ni waya la.
en: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the Lord told Joshua.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ gahindili shɛli Naawuni ni pii ka lihi li ka di mali buchi. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: The Scriptures say, Look, I have chosen a cornerstone of great value, and I put that stone in Zion. Anyone who trusts in him will never be disappointed. Isaiah :.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dabili bi gar o duuma; tumo mi bi gari ŋun tim o.
en: I am telling you the truth: no slaves are greater than their master, and no messengers are greater than the one who sent them.

dag: Yɛm mali biɛhigu shee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛhi zilima tɛha ni, amaa di ka jɛra bɛn suhuri ni.
en: A wise person is always thinking wise thoughts, but a fool knows nothing about wisdom.

dag: Gaad bihi n-daa ʒini bɛ nyaaŋa baɣili ba Bashan tiŋgban ni zaŋ lala hal ni Salɛka.
en: Gads family lived opposite them in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah.

dag: Di simdi ka a chibi di nyiŋgoli ka o zuɣu ni tooi kpe di ni, ka a ti niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili kaman bɛ ni niŋdi kur tolinli niŋdi gbaɣino nyiŋgoli shɛm la ni kaman teela ni niŋdi shɛm la din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: The opening for the head should be in the middle of it. The opening should be reinforced by a woven binding, a strong border so that it doesnt tear.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas mini Pool bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba la daa wum lala ka dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka zo nti kpe salo maa ni kuhiri yɛra.
en: When the Lords messengers Barnabas and Paul found out about this, they tore their clothes in protest and rushed out into the crowd. They shouted.

dag: Tiliginsim ŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka anabinim daa vihi, ka bo ni bɛ baŋ li. Bɛ daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛlila anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya la yɛla.
en: The prophets, who long ago foretold the grace that youve received, searched and explored, inquiring carefully about this salvation.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ o Bia maa zali zaashe tital ni gari malaikanima kaman o ni daa ti o yuli din gari bɛ yuya shɛm la.
en: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu ni nahim tin shɛli, ka di bi nya sɔŋsim ŋɔ, n ni zaŋ kuɣ viɛla me a zali, ka zaŋ safaya kuɣa sɔŋ a tanzaa.
en: The Lord says, O Jerusalem, you suffering, helpless city, with no one to comfort you, I will rebuild your foundations with precious stones.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa kuli ti gbaai bubil kɔrigi, ka tooi zim kilɔgiram pia m-mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi. Ka daa zaŋ nimdi maa n-niŋ piɛɣu ni, ka zaŋ ʒiɛri mi niŋ ʒɛduɣu ni n-zaŋ li ka oki tia maa gbinna ti ti o.
en: So Gideon went and prepared a young goat and used an ephah of flour for unleavened bread. He put the meat in a basket and the broth in a pot and brought them out to him under the oak and presented them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa bi lan saɣi yiri palo gɔri Yɛhudianim maa ni, amaa ka daa yi nimaani chaŋla luɣ shɛli din miri yɔɣu ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Ifriim la, ka o min o nyaandoliba ti be nimaani.
en: Because of this plot against him, Jesus stopped going around in public. He went to the town of Ephraim, which was near the desert, and he stayed there with his disciples.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya biɛrim, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam. Biɛrim maa ni ti ŋmanila paɣ ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ni ti lihiri tab ninni ka dabiɛm mali ba. Bɛ nini ni ti mooi.
en: and they will be terrified. Like a woman writhing in labor, they will be seized by spasms and agony. They will look at each other aghast, their faces blazing.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa nyo nayili mini niriba yiya buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goma luhi.
en: Meanwhile, the Babylonians burned down the royal palace and the houses of the people and tore down the walls of Jerusalem.

dag: Niriba pam daa ti yi tinsi gari shɛm ni laɣim Yisa sanna, ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: People kept coming to Jesus from one town after another; and when a great crowd gathered, Jesus told this parable:.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be a son of King David.

dag: Ka o daa kpab litaafi maa zaŋ li labisi ti jɛmbu duu maa sɔŋda so ŋun ʒe nimaani ka naanyi ʒini. Ka bɛnkam daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni kpaai bɛ nina kpa o.
en: He rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the synagogue assistant, and sat down. Every eye in the synagogue was fixed on him.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Din ku tooi nani ninsalinim sani nyɛla din ni tooi nani Naawuni ŋun sani.
en: Jesus answered, What is humanly impossible is possible for God.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋchaŋ gil li, ka sab di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm niŋ litaafi ni, ka lan pirigi di fɔndi ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-zaŋ labi ti ti Jɔshua Shilo sansani maa ni.
en: So the men went and passed through the land and wrote about it in a document, city by city, in seven sections. They came back to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

dag: Tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni leela yi ni yɛn saɣim shɛli ti Yawɛ. Kulla Reehab ŋun nyɛ pagɔrili la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ kɔŋko ka di simdi ni yi tiligi, o ni daa zaŋ ti tuumba la sɔɣi la zuɣu.
en: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord . The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bun shɛb bɛn bɔrigi zuŋɔ daba ata la bɛna, di lan chɛ ka bɛ yɛla muɣis a, dama bɛ nya ba. Ka ŋuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa lee yuuni bɔra? Pa a min a zuliya zaa.
en: And dont worry about the donkeys that you lost three days ago. They have been found. Now, there is something that everyone in Israel is looking for and that something is you and your family.

dag: Ifriim zuliya bɛn daa gbibi tɔbiri daa ŋmaligi guui tɔbu tuhibu dali.
en: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku ti a daŋa dabisili puuni, ka goli gba ku ti a dɔro yuŋ.
en: The sun will not hurt you during the day, nor the moon during the night.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tɔbu daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba n-tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: Once again there was war with the Philistines, and David went out to fight. He defeated them badly, and they ran away.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla din tuhi ninvuɣ so ŋun baŋ di gbinni sani, ka nyɛ din tuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim sani.
en: These things are clear to any intelligent person. They are right to anyone with knowledge.

dag: Yi daa lan nya bɛ binyoya din nyɛ buɣa din mali daɣiri ka nyɛ dari mini kuɣa ni anzinfa ni salima din daa be bɛ san la.
en: You saw the horrific things, the filthy idols of wood and stone, silver and gold, that they had with them.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan lab pahi buta ti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: But he left them and again went and prayed the same words for the third time.

dag: A yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, nyaɣisim bɔ ka di lee tiri Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Bee a yi nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, nyo bɔ ka o yɛn nya di zuɣu?.
en: Does the Almighty delight in your innocence? Does he gain when you perfect your ways?.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni na, tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛn malila di vuhim yuuni Yawɛ sani.
en: Tell the Israelites: When you enter the land that I am giving to you, you must let the land have a special time of rest. This will be a special time of rest to honor the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan kpe ŋariŋ maa m-baai du dul din la ha.
en: Leaving them, he got back in the boat and crossed to the other side of the lake.

dag: Ka Hɔsa ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi ni yino la gba daa mali bidibisi; Shimri n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: From the clan of Merari there was Hosah, who had four sons: Shimri .

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni nya li ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi; bɛ ni ti dim bɛ nyina ka bahi yoli; ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu ni kpalim yoli.
en: The wicked see this and are angry; they glare in hate and disappear; their hopes are gone forever.

dag: Ka daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa n-labir o ba maa sani. O ni daa ti na be katiŋ ha kanna ka o ba maa nya o ka nambɔɣu gbaag o pam; ka o yiɣisi zo nti tuh o soli m-bɔbi gbaag o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: So he got up and started back to his father. He was still a long way from home when his father saw him; his heart was filled with pity, and he ran, threw his arms around his son, and kissed him.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti darigi yiko shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa tibili, ka darigi dunia ŋɔ nanim tibili.
en: On that day, the LORD will punish the forces of heaven in heaven, and the kings of the earth on earth.

dag: dama Naawuni deeri zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔr o ka tumdi din tuhi.
en: Those who fear him and do what is right are acceptable to him, no matter what race they belong to.

dag: Ka Ananias daa wum yɛligu ŋɔ ka dii lu n-kpi, ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛnkam zaa daa wum li.
en: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.

dag: Ka o daa vaai yiɣisi n-lɛb lu tiŋa n-fo n-do paɣ maa naba ni. Paɣ maa naba maa ni ka o daa yiɣ lɛb lu. O ni daa yiɣ lɛb lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka o daa dii kpi.
en: He sank down between Jaels feet. He fell, and there he lay. He sank down between her feet. He fell there. Where Sisera sank, he fell, and there he lay, dead!.

dag: A yi ti chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu, bɛn suɣa be wulimpuhili polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi.
en: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.

dag: So ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba Naawuni ŋun tim ma na maa n-vo o tahina; ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: People cannot come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them to me; and I will raise them to life on the last day.

dag: Yi mi ni ti daa niŋdi ya mi kaman ba ni niŋd o bihi shɛm la: Ti daa kpam ya jaande ka kpaŋsi ya, ka zali ya.
en: Likewise, you know how we treated each of you like a father treats his own children.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa bol o kpambal so na ti yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya maa na yomyom.
en: So King Ahab told one of his officers to go and find Micaiah.

dag: Di saha ka Dilaila daa bɔhi Samsin, Wula ka a yɛri ni a yuri ma ka a suhu ka n ni? Siɣimsiɣim buta zaa ka a boli ma jɛrigu, ka bi saɣi yɛli ma a kpiɔŋ din galisi pam maa ni be a luɣ shɛli.
en: Then Delilah said to Samson, How can you say, I love you, when you dont even trust me? You refuse to tell me your secret. This is the third time you made me look foolish. You havent told me the secret of your great strength.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim maa, Di luhiya ni nir chɛ ka bara kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali bee di bi luhi.
en: Jesus turned and asked the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses, Is it right to heal on the Sabbath.

dag: A ʒinila gar shɛli din mali jilima zuɣu, ka zaŋ teebuli zali di tooni n-zaŋ n tulaale zim mini n kpam tam di zuɣu.
en: They would sit on a beautiful couch, and in front of them they would have a table covered with good things, including the incense and the olive oil that I had given them.

dag: Kaman sala buɣim ni tahiri biisim na, ka dari chɛ ka buɣim diri shɛm, lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili chɛ ka zabili neera.
en: Troublemakers start trouble, just as sparks and fuel start a fire.

dag: Miriya ka yi be kaman yi yaannim mini yi mabihi bɛn daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ yim, ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya naŋgbantom yi zaa ninni la.
en: Don't follow the example of your ancestors and your Israelite relatives in the north. They were unfaithful to the Lord , and he punished them horribly.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi ŋmanila yalim dunia ŋɔ ni. Yalim mi yi ti niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha; bɛ ni kpaa li mi bahi ka niriba nɔri li, dama di lan ka buchi.
en: You are like salt for the whole human race. But if salt loses its saltiness, there is no way to make it salty again. It has become worthless, so it is thrown out and people trample on it.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita, ka o nyaandoliba maa piligi kabisiri chi ŋmɛmdi bɛ nuhi ni ŋubira.
en: Jesus was walking through some wheat fields on a Sabbath. His disciples began to pick the heads of wheat, rub them in their hands, and eat the grain.

dag: N tɛha ni daa labi n ni na saha shɛli maa, ka n jilima mini n dariza ni n nam maa tibiginsim gba daa lan labi n sanna. Ka n jintɔriba mini n kpambaliba daa lan deei ma, ka n nam maa yiko mini di jilima din gari di ni daa pun be shɛm lan labi n sanna.
en: When my sanity returned, my honor, my majesty, and the glory of my kingdom were given back to me. My officials and my noblemen welcomed me, and I was given back my royal power with even greater honor than before.

dag: Nir yi gbaag omaŋa ka chɛ zabili, di tir o jilima, amaa jɛrigu kam ŋun bɔrila zabili yomyom.
en: People who refuse to argue deserve respect. Any fool can start an argument.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom bɛ ni dooi olivi kpa shɛli din nyɛ alali na nti niŋdi firilanim maa puuni din ni chɛ ka firilanim maa diri saha shɛlikam.
en: to give the following orders to the people of Israel: Bring pure olive oil of the finest quality for the lamps in the Tent, so that a light might be kept burning regularly.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya, ka a kari dol ti n-kuri ti ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: You wrapped yourself up in wrath and hunted us; you killed, showing no compassion.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni daadamnim ni ti bɔri kum ka ku nya; bɛ ni ti bɔri ni bɛ kpi, ka kum zo ka chɛ ba.
en: In those days people will seek death, but they wont find it. They will want to die, but death will run away from them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ti Sinai, Yi be zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka di yuui saɣi lala.
en: At Horeb, the LORD our God told us: Youve been at this mountain long enough.

dag: Di zɔntua daa kpala dundɔntitali polo. Ka bɛ daa ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣili kam. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini.
en: And its porch was at the end of the gateway next to the outer courtyard. Carvings of palm trees were on the walls on either side of the gateway. There were eight steps leading up to the gate.

dag: N kuhirila pampam niŋdi Yawɛ. N kul suhirila Yawɛ pampam ni o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I cry out loud for help from the LORD. I beg out loud for mercy from the LORD.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa saɣim bɛ mihi mini bɛ chi zaa, dama bɛ chi maa daa bimi ka mihi maa pum puma.
en: Meanwhile, the flax and barley crops had been destroyed by the storm because they were ready to ripen.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa ni daa wum li, ka tinzunnim bɛn gili ti zaa daa nya li, ka bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni ti Naawuni sɔŋsim ni ka tuma maa tum naai maa.
en: When our enemies in the surrounding nations heard this, they realized that they had lost face, since everyone knew that the work had been done with God's help.

dag: Ka Shɛshan daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti o dabili Jariha maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Atai.
en: to whom he gave one of his daughters in marriage. They had a son named Attai.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di dabisa maa puuni ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the time will come when the groom will be taken away from them. Then his friends will fast.

dag: Ka wuntia tuma maa tahi suhudoo mini biɛri baalimtali ni naani niŋbu na sahakam.
en: The fruit of righteousness will be peace, and the outcome of righteousness, calm and security forever.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tabilakpihi daŋ yi tooni nti dim kari Hivinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinima ka chɛ soli tin ya.
en: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.

dag: amaa ŋun mali paɣa baɣa bela dunia ŋɔ yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o paɣ nini.
en: But a married man concerns himself with worldly matters, because he wants to please his wife;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm piɛgul so ŋun ka buchi nɛma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Now, get the things a foolish shepherd might use.

dag: Kaman nir ni ku tooi kali saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ bee teeku noli bihigu shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya mini Lɛvinim bɛn tumdi n tuma maa nabi.
en: I will increase the number of descendants of my servant David and the number of priests from the tribe of Levi, so that it will be as impossible to count them as it is to count the stars in the sky or the grains of sand on the seashore.

dag: di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi Izraɛlnim zuliya shɛb zaa sani bɛ ni be na, ka yihi ba luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: speak to them, This is what the LORD God says: I will take the Israelites from among the nations where theyve gone, I will gather them from all around, and I will bring them to their fertile land.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim zuɣu. A wuntitali puuni, tim ma nyɛvili.
en: Look how I desire your precepts! Make me live by your righteousness.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara naɣilaa la mini alahichi sanyoo sara bua la, bɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee la n-yi bɛ sansani maa ni kpaŋa nti nyo bɛ gbana mini bɛ nimdi ni bɛ bina buɣim.
en: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti dooi salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li, ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapuhi maa zuɣu.
en: Cover the boards with gold. Make gold rings to house the bars. Cover the bars with gold.

dag: Naawuni di saɣi ka n nyɛ sana m-be Mɛshɛk. O mi di saɣi ka m be Kɛdar suɣa ni.
en: Living among you is as bad as living in Meshech or among the people of Kedar.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini kom na ti tuhi ya soli saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la zuɣu mini bɛ ni daa lan da Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr ŋun yi Pɛtɔr din be Mɛsopoteemia na bia la ni o ti yɛli noli tin ya la zuɣu.
en: They refused to provide you with food and water when you were on your way out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor, from the city of Pethor in Mesopotamia, to curse you.

dag: Hiburɔn daŋ ni bɛ daa piila Hashabia min o mabihi niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ni bɛ lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la Yawɛ tuma zaa mini naa tuma.
en: Hashabiah from the Hebron clan and , of his skilled relatives were the officials in charge of all religious and government business in the Israelite territories west of the Jordan River.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pakoli ŋun su yili maa bidibiga maa daa ti biɛra, ka di muɣis o hal ka o ti tarigi.
en: After these things, the son of the widow, who was the matriarch of the household, became ill. His sickness got steadily worse until he wasnt breathing anymore.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ yɛli ba ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The Israelites went and did exactly what the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron to do.

dag: Sɔɣim ma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa ashilɔni zaŋ chaŋ m polo la, ka sɔɣi ma ka chɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba ni lɔri yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛriya mi, Wummiya; chɛliya ka n gba yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: So please listen to me, and I will tell you what I think.

dag: Ka n daa deei litaafi bila maa malaika maa nuu ni n-zaŋ ŋubi; ka di shiri malisi n nol ni kaman shir la, ka n ni daa ti ŋub li naai, ka di shiri to m puuni.
en: I took the little scroll from his hand and ate it, and it tasted sweet as honey in my mouth. But after I swallowed it, it turned sour in my stomach.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali wun shɛŋa pahi n zuɣu.
en: You must not worship any other gods except me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan kana ti zani nimaani m-boon o kaman o ni di pun boon o shɛm la, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlima, a dabili wumda.
en: The Lord then stood beside Samuel and called out as he had done before, Samuel! Samuel! I'm listening, Samuel answered. What do you want me to do.

dag: Dama ti ni daa naan ku tooi sɔŋ timaŋa saha shɛl la dɛde, ka Yisa Masia daa kpi alahichinim zuɣu.
en: While we were still weak, at the right moment, Christ died for ungodly people.

dag: ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam, ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: The stars will fall from the sky, and the planets and other heavenly bodies will be shaken.

dag: Ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la daa nyɛla ŋun su tɔbbihi pihita fukumsi, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kpani lu ninvuɣ kɔbisita zuɣu n-ku ba ka zali yuli pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of The Famous Thirty. He fought with his spear against three hundred men and killed them, and became famous among The Thirty.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli, zaɣ biɛɣu ku milig o yiŋa.
en: If you repay good with evil, you will never get evil out of your house.

dag: To, bidibis ayi maa ni ŋuni n-daa lee tum o ba yubu? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Kpɛm san la. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, farigudeeriba mini pagɔra daŋ ya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Which one of these two did his fathers will? They said, The first one. Jesus said to them, I assure you that tax collectors and prostitutes are entering Gods kingdom ahead of you.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa niŋdila binyari viɛla mini situr sabilifaa shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi ni duu puuni tiŋgban ni kuntu shɛŋa bɛ ni liɣisiliɣisi, ka zaŋ mihi wuɣi ka di mali yaa daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: They paid with the finest clothing, blue cloth, cloth with fine needlework, rugs of many colors, and the strongest ropes. These were the things they traded with you.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa labi ti yɛl o dana maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Ka o daa je suli pam, ka yɛl o yiŋbia maa ni o yim yom doli solɔri mini sobihi m-boli nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni zoomba mini gbariti na.
en: So the servant returned and told his master what happened. The master was angry. He said, Hurry! Go into the streets and alleys of the town. Bring me the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino mi yi ni yɛn doli kasitali biɛhigu mini jilima soli shɛm n-kpuɣ omaŋmaŋ paɣa.
en: God wants each one of you to learn to control your own body. Use your body in a way that is holy and that gives honor to God.

dag: Piɛm ku tooi kar o ka o guui, ka kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa ŋmani wurigu o sani.
en: There is no arrow that can make him run; rocks thrown at him are like bits of straw.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn biriti ka kumdi ti chɛ bɛ ni biri shɛli maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, O yi nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ, hal o zabigu zaɣ yini gba ku lu tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be o kɔbili ni, o ni kpi.
en: Solomon said, If he shows himself to be an honorable person, then not a hair of his head will be harmed. But if any evil is found in him, he will die.

dag: Sunsuuni dunɔpaɣira daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa tooni, binshɛli daa beni ŋ-ŋmani.
en: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like.

dag: Bɛn daa kari doli ti maa daa guuri gari tɔrili ni yiɣiri zuɣusaa shɛm la. Bɛ daa kari doli ti la zoya zuɣu, bɛ daa gu ti la soli mɔɣu ni.
en: Swifter than eagles swooping from the sky, they chased us down. They tracked us down in the hills; they took us by surprise in the desert.

dag: Amaa ka daa naɣ piila Juda zuliya mini Ziɔn Zoli din nyɛ o ni yuri shɛl la.
en: No, he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.

dag: Ka o daa lan daai Pɛnuɛluɛlnim pii la luhi, ka ku tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: He also tore down the tower at Penuel and killed the men of that city.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha yi ti paai ni di dabisa maa, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni ti laɣim tab kana ti kumdi bɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord says, When that time comes, the people of both Israel and Judah will come weeping, looking for me, their God.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus answered, The scripture says, Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.

dag: N yura yɛli ma, N ni yuri so pam, ŋun viɛli pam n sani, Yiɣisim ka n sanna.
en: My lover speaks to me. Come then, my love; my darling, come with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka di chɛ ka yi ni pun tum shɛli zuɣu la ku yi yi nuu ni, amaa ka di lee chɛ ka yi ti deela di laara zaa.
en: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.

dag: Amaa maligumaana yi zaŋ o liɣiri da dabili ka o leeg o ni su so, dabili maa ni tooi di li; ka bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb o yiŋ gba ni tooi di o bindirigu maa.
en: But if the priest buys a person as a slave with his own money, that person may eat some of the holy things. Slaves who were born in the priests house may also eat some of the priests food.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣu ŋmanila wahu lɔɣu. Bɛ ŋaritila bɛ tiba kaman sapaɣu ŋun ŋar o tiba.
en: Their anger is as deadly as the poison of a snake. They shut their ears like a deaf cobra.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tuhi lu di saha maa, ka Judanim di nasara, dama bɛ daa niŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la naani.
en: Israel was subdued on that occasion, and Judah succeeded because they relied on the LORD, the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa zali Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ bom tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma, ka bɛ ni daa bo tumtumdib shɛb na kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: King Solomon forced , men of Israel to help in this work.

dag: Zaŋmi dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba; ka kpammi ba jaande, ka kpahimi bɛn wumd a wuhibu zuɣu ni a fukumsi zaa subu puuni. Di chɛ ka so ʒiɛm a.
en: These are the things you should tell people. Encourage them, and when they are wrong, correct them. You have full authority to do this, so dont let anyone think they can ignore you.

dag: Sool daa bela zoli maa yaɣi yini polo, ka Dauda min o niriba mi be yaɣi din la polo, ka Dauda daa kpaŋ zɔri yomyom ni o yi Sool nuu ni saha shɛli Sool ni daa ti chɛ ŋun Dauda min o niriba maa kpe ni kpe ni o gbahi ba la.
en: Saul and his men were on one side of the hill, separated from David and his men, who were on the other side. They were hurrying to get away from Saul and his men, who were closing in on them and were about to capture them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka o yiɣiri kaman toli la? O nyeeni firisibu din mali jilima la mali dabiɛm.
en: Did you make it able to jump like a locust or snort so loudly that it scares people?.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan kpe ŋariŋ maa m-baai du dul din la ha.
en: He left them, got back into the boat, and started across to the other side of the lake.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi shɛm maa daa viɛli n sani, ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni ninvuɣ yinoyino, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka yi ni ti lo noli goli maa daba awɛi dali zaawuni. Yi ni ti gbibila yi Vuhim Dabisili maa zaawuni hal ti lan paai zaawuni.
en: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth.

dag: Di pala m bɔrimi ni n ʒili ya ʒitibisa ka suui shɛb dini;.
en: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani; Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.

dag: N ku zaŋ n nuu kpɛhi bɛ yɛla ni. M mi ku be bɛ laɣiŋgu ni; dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ kuri niriba, ka chɛri chihiri naɣilahi jila ni di ti ba suhupiɛlli.
en: I will not join in their secret talks, Nor will I take part in their meetings, For they killed people in anger And they crippled bulls for sport.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim kpi ka yi yi alizinnim bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni la, di chaŋ wula ka yi lan be kaman dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba? Bɔzuɣu ka yi doli zaligunim din yɛli:.
en: You died with Christ and were made free from the powers that influence this world. So why do you act as if you still belong to the world? I mean, why do you follow rules like these:.

dag: Amaa a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu, n ni tooi kpe a jɛmbu duu nti gbani a duu din be kasi maa puuni ni sizuura.
en: But me? I will enter your house because of your abundant, faithful love; I will bow down at your holy temple, honoring you.

dag: Ka so mi daa ti lan yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, n ni dol a; amaa lee chɛ ka n kuli nti chɛbisi n yiŋnim pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Then someone said to Jesus, I want to follow you, Lord, but first let me go back and take care of things at home.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani palo daa zaŋla Mahanaim hal ti paai Bashan tiŋgbani zaa din daa nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa la ni Jair fɔntinsi zaa din be Bashan ka di kalinli nyɛ pihiyɔbu.
en: The land started at Mahanaim. The land included all of Bashan, all the land ruled by King Og of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair in Bashan.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kpe Ijipti teeku ni ni bɛ gari, n ni chɛ ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni, ka Nail Mɔɣili bulli la leei tiŋ kuŋ. Ka Asirianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la ti nya filiŋ, ka Ijiptinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ la mi kɔŋ yiko.
en: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the sea with waves. All the depths of the river will dry up. The pride of Assyria will be brought down; the scepter of Egypt will turn away.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o zali ka yɛl o, Yiɣisima! Man gba kul nyɛla ninsala kaman nyin la.
en: But Peter told him to get up. Peter said, Stand up! I am only a man like you.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni no n-taai ninvuɣ shɛb la di vi; chɛ ka tarimba mini nandaamba paɣ a yuli.
en: Dont let the oppressed live in shame. No, let the poor and needy praise your name!.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti zaŋ o puu ni bindira na nti mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: One day, Cain gave part of his harvest to the Lord .

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba na ti yɛli ba, Saha shɛli din gari la puuni, yi daa kul bɔri ni Naa Dauda n-leei yi naa.
en: Abner sent this message to the leaders of Israel. He said, For a long time you have wanted to make David your king.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali Jɔshua shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o ŋmaai Juda zuliya la tiŋgbani yaɣ shɛli polo bɛ ni booni Hiburɔn la ti Jɛfune bia Kalɛb. Kiriatariba, di gbinni nyɛla Hiburɔn.
en: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.

dag: Timiya o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima. Chɛliya ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmdi Yawɛ mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Be glad that we belong to him; let all who worship him rejoice.

dag: Wummi bɛ ni bɔhiri ma shɛm, Yawɛ yɛligu maa lee be ya? Chɛ ka ti wum li.
en: The people of Judah continue to ask me questions. They say, Jeremiah, what about the message from the Lord ? Lets see that message come true.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la, ka so ku lan nya ba. Bɛ ni kari ba kaman yuŋ ʒii la.
en: They will be forgotten like a dream.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, Daadam Bia ni ti ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo.
en: But from now on, the Human One will be seated on the right side of the power of God. .

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa tooi baai du Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ n-nyɛ li la; amaa ka Ijiptinim daa kana ti tɔɣisi ba niŋ lala ka kom di ba.
en: It was faith that made the Israelites able to cross the Red Sea as if on dry land; when the Egyptians tried to do it, the water swallowed them up.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa miligi Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee maa. Datan mini Abiram ni bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bisarinsi ni bɛ bibihi daa yimina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni.
en: So the men moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram went to their tents. They stood outside of their tents with their wives, children, and little babies.

dag: Yurilim mini ʒiɛyimtali n-nyɛ din gbibi naa, ka wuntitali mi nyɛ din chɛ ka o nam ʒiɛya.
en: A king will remain in power as long as his rule is honest, just, and fair.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyam Babilɔn ŋɔ ni galisi shɛm! Mani m-me li zali ni di nyɛ n tin titali, ka di wuhi n yiko mini n kpiɔŋ ni n nam dariza ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: he said, Look how great Babylon is! I built it as my capital city to display my power and might, my glory and majesty.

dag: Ka chuɣu maa daa ti puhi naai ka bɛ labiri kuna, ka Yisa ŋun daa na nyɛ bisariŋga la kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ba min o ma bi mi.
en: After the festival was over, they were returning home, but the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. His parents didnt know it.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun gbibi tɔbu ti ku tooi zani, ka ŋun tooi zɔri pam ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa, ka wɔribara gba ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: People with bows and arrows will not survive. Fast runners will not escape. People on horses will not escape alive.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ninsalitab naani, ka zaŋ bɛ ninsalitab maa leei bɛ kpiɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri ka chɛ man Yawɛ la.
en: This is what the Lord says: Bad things will happen to those who put their trust in people. Bad things will happen to those who depend on human strength. That is because they have stopped trusting the Lord .

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be samban ni, o ni ku ma sol ni.
en: Lazy people stay at home; they say a lion might get them if they go outside.

dag: Ŋun su amiliya n-nyɛ aŋgo; amaa aŋgo zo so ŋun be o sani wumd o yɛtɔɣa nyari suhupiɛlli pam di zuɣu; lala zuɣu ka n suhupiɛlli galisi pam maa.
en: The bridegroom is the one to whom the bride belongs; but the bridegroom's friend, who stands by and listens, is glad when he hears the bridegroom's voice. This is how my own happiness is made complete.

dag: Bɛ zuliya ni mali kpiɔŋ bɛ tiŋgban ni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun be tibi zuliya ni mali alibarika.
en: The good man's children will be powerful in the land; his descendants will be blessed.

dag: ka tiŋkpaŋ maa nim daa ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg o, o ni daa pun lo nia ni o gari chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu.
en: But the people there would not welcome Jesus because he was going toward Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni tiŋa, bɛ yɛli binshɛŋa din mali jilima zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛla.
en: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa chɛ ka tɔbbi shɛb lɔɣi gilila Judanim maa nyaaŋa nti sɔɣi dɔni gu ba, ka bɛn kpalim mi be bɛ tooni polo.
en: Meanwhile, Jeroboam had sent troops around behind them for an ambush so that the main force was in front of Judah while the ambush was behind.

dag: Ka Naa Sairus maŋmaŋ daa zaŋ neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la nti niŋ o buɣa duu la na.
en: Emperor Cyrus gave them back the bowls and cups that King Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his gods.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti kuhi pam niŋ a, nyin wummi n kuhigu maa! Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka garigi ma!.
en: Hear me, Lord , when I call to you! Be merciful and answer me!.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi zuliya balibu kam ni mini dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa pun wum Sulemaana yɛm maa yɛla sani n-ka o sanna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: Kings all over the world heard about Solomon's wisdom and sent people to listen to him teach.

dag: Yinim Filipainim mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni lahibal suŋ molo molibu piligu ni saha, n ni daa yiɣisi Masidɔnia la, yi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ cheechi shɛli niriba bɛn pahi n zuɣu baŋ deebu mini tibu yɛla.
en: You Philippians know from the time of my first mission work in Macedonia how no church shared in supporting my ministry except you.

dag: ka zaŋ sida dari maa mini taaŋkɔro ni mi ʒee la m-pahi noombil nɛɔŋ la zuɣu tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so maa ʒim mini ko viɛlli maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi yili maa buyopɔin.
en: He will then take the cedarwood, hyssop, and crimson yarn, along with the wild bird, and will dip all of this into the fresh water and into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered. He will then sprinkle the house seven times.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin puhimiya ba puhiri suŋ.
en: When you go into a house, say, Peace.

dag: Yawɛ, mɔɣa zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi la bee kulibɔna zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bee teeku zuɣu ka a suhu daa yiɣisi bahi saha shɛli a ni daa kpe a nasara dibu chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni ka yuri vɔri li la?.
en: Was it the rivers that made you angry, Lord ? Was it the sea that made you furious? You rode upon the clouds; the storm cloud was your chariot, as you brought victory to your people.

dag: Kpammi bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ binyara bundaannim la jaande ni bɛ di mali karimbaani, ka mi di zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ buni din nyɛ din kul ku be sahakam ŋɔ ni, amaa ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ tahima niŋla Naawuni ŋun tiri ti binshɛɣukam ni ti mali maani ti bukaata ŋɔ ni.
en: Give this command to those who are rich with the things of this world. Tell them not to be proud. Tell them to hope in God, not their money. Money cannot be trusted, but God takes care of us richly. He gives us everything to enjoy.

dag: Ka Judas daa bɔh o, N Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka a ni kahig amaŋ wuhi ti, ka ku kahig amaŋ wuhi dunianim bɛna.
en: Then Judas said, Lord, how will you make yourself known to us, but not to the world.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu ni bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba bahi yoli.
en: In just the same way your Father in heaven does not want any of these little ones to be lost.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples left the city.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb la ni daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli na tibisim daa nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni pihita kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: and the silver that was collected when the people were counted came to . tons.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pahi pinaayi n-su chir pinaayi ni mi n-daa nyɛ Hɛlidai ŋun daa yi Nɛtɔfa na ka nyɛ Otiniɛl daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The twelfth for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite from Othniel. His division numbered .

dag: N ni daa be shɛm daa pala din sɔɣi a sani. Bɛ ni daa nam ma ashilɔni saha shɛli, bɛ daa zaŋ ma tuɣila tab alahizibu tuɣibu tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: When my bones were being formed, carefully put together in my mother's womb, when I was growing there in secret, you knew that I was there—.

dag: Nyin ŋun be Zallakudura Naa sani sɔɣibu shee mini ŋun kpalim be Kpiɔŋlan Naa mahim ni.
en: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.

dag: Bɛnkam mali ba mini bɛnkam niŋ ba naani ni be kaman bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa maa.
en: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.

dag: Yi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa nyɛla tampiligim ŋaha, ka yi ni zaŋ shɛli taɣi yimaŋ nyɛla yaɣiri.
en: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust.

dag: Dama buɣim daa yi Hɛshibɔn na, ka buɣim niɛm daa yi Sihɔn fɔŋ ni na. Di daa di Ar din be Mɔab la, ka di Arinɔn zoya zuɣu.
en: Once from this city of Heshbon Sihon's army went forth like a fire; It destroyed the city of Ar in Moab And devoured the hills of the upper Arnon.

dag: Bɛ bili paɣiba Ziɔn tiŋ puuni, ka bili paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Juda fɔntinsi ni.
en: Women have been raped in Zion, young women in Judahs cities.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa bɔhi Naa Zɛdɛkia, Taali bɔ ka n lee tum a bee a kpambaliba bee niriba ŋɔ ka yi chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ma duu maa?.
en: Then I asked, What crime have I committed against you or your officials or this people, to make you put me in prison?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli ba, O ni daa na ne ka n lo noli ka kumd o zuɣu maa, n daa yɛlimi, Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni zo ma nambɔɣu ka chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: David replied, While the child was alive I fasted and wept because I thought, Who knows? The LORD may have mercy on me and let the child live.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilahi maa zuɣuri ni, ka yi zaŋ zaɣ yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ Lɛvinim maa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Tell the Levites to put their hands on the heads of the bulls. One bull will be a sin offering and the other bull will be used as a burnt offering to the Lord . These offerings will make the Levites pure.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yɛn saɣim la yimaŋa kaman yi yaannim ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋ shɛm maa, ka gba birigi jɛmdi n ni je bɛ binshɛŋa maa?.
en: So now say to the house of Israel, The LORD God proclaims: Will you defile yourselves as your ancestors did, and will you prostitute yourself after their disgusting things?.

dag: O yi daa tum a taali bee n-di a samli, nyin chɛ ka di dolila mani.
en: If he has done any wrong to you or owes you anything, charge that to me.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa du Zoli maa zuɣu, ka sagbani limsi li.
en: Then Moses went up the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

dag: Hakalia bia Nɛhimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pisi puuni gol so bɛ ni booni Kisilɛv ni, man Nɛhimia daa bela Susa tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin zuɣu la ni.
en: These are the words of Nehemiah, Hacaliahs son. In the month of Kislev, in the twentieth year, while I was in the fortress city of Susa.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili maa ni daa ti yi palo, ti daa nya o ka di o shɛhira, ka yɛri ya ŋuna ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu ka daa be ti Ba Naawuni sani, ka ŋun Naawuni daa kahig o wuhi ti la yɛla.
en: When this life became visible, we saw it; so we speak of it and tell you about the eternal life which was with the Father and was made known to us.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mali suhupiɛlli bɛn je ma daashaara nyabu zuɣu bee m mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu ni paai ba zuɣu.
en: If I have rejoiced over my foes ruin or was excited when evil found them.

dag: O ni daa ti piligi maani di laasabu maa ka bɛ zaŋ do so ŋun daa di naa maa laɣ gbaliŋ samli na.
en: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him . silver coins.

dag: hal ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu daa ti di Ijipti nam.
en: Then a different king began to rule Egypt, one who knew nothing about Joseph.

dag: Din lan nyɛ yi dini m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni yihi shɛlikam pin shɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la puuni, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi ni di nyɛ yi tarili, ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa, ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: You will also receive part of the special gifts and offerings that the Israelites bring to me. Any member of your family who is clean and acceptable for worship can eat these things.

dag: Ka a ni wuhi Izraɛlnim zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ka o mi zaŋ ti ba la.
en: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha nti ku o. Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ ba?.
en: So the farmers threw the son out of the vineyard and killed him. What will the owner of the vineyard do?.

dag: Dauda ni daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka bi zaɣis o noli o ni zal o zaligu shɛŋa zaa ni, naɣila Yuria Hiti nir la yɛla la zuɣu ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: The Lord did this because David had done what pleased him and had never disobeyed any of his commands, except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.

dag: Ka o bia maa yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani; hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba.
en: Then his son said, Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I no longer deserve to be called your son.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni bɛ nya, ka daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi.
en: Again and again they tested his patience. They really hurt the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Ŋun mali tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, o bi mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima, amaa o mal li tɔɣisirila Naawuni, dama o tɔɣisirila yɛlisɔɣira Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka so bi mi o ni tɔɣisiri yɛl shɛŋa maa gbinni.
en: Those who speak in strange tongues do not speak to others but to God, because no one understands them. They are speaking secret truths by the power of the Spirit.

dag: n-yɛra, O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ maani niriba maa yɛla saha shɛlikam. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ kpeeni kam ka a sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, di simdi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn mal li shɛm din ni chɛ ka tuma maa niŋ valimbo a sani, ka a mini ba zaa laɣim ʒiri ʒili maa.
en: Let them sit as judges for the people at all times. They should bring every major dispute to you, but they should decide all of the minor cases themselves. This will be much easier for you, and they will share your load.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul bɛ ti sani; naɣila ti chaŋmi ti da bindirigu din ni saɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa na.
en: But Jesus said to them, You yourselves give them something to eat. They answered, All we have are five loaves and two fish. Do you want us to go and buy food for this whole crowd.

dag: Zuliya kam, yi zaa wummiya! Dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, wummiya! Chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ka be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ŋɔ ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Listen, all you people! Earth and everyone on it, listen! The Lord GOD will be a witness against you. The Lord will come from his holy temple.

dag: Paɣ maa daa zaŋ ba duhila o yiŋ maa dufahirili zuɣusaa ti sɔɣi n-va kaɣ shɛŋa o ni daa pun malimali sɔŋ nimaani pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the flax stalks that she had laid out on the roof.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ti doli n ni kariti zuliya shɛb ka chɛri ya ŋɔ kaya, dama bɛ daa tumdila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, dinzuɣu ka n zaɣisi ba.
en: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ nayil guliba kpɛm Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa la sani nti zaŋ yɛm yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣis o.
en: Then Daniel went to Arioch, commander of the king's bodyguard, who had been ordered to carry out the execution. Choosing his words carefully.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋm nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa pa tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kpaai ʒiɛri maa pol li. Ka Gidiɔn daa niŋ lala.
en: The angel told him, Put the meat and the bread on this rock, and pour the broth over them. Gideon did so.

dag: Bɛn daa ʒi bindirigu maa dibu shee maa ni so daa bi baŋ din chɛ ka o yɛli Judas lala maa.
en: No one at the meal understood what Jesus meant.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni n yula pina deebu hali, amaa n lee bɔrimi ni yi nya laara pahi.
en: It is not that I just want to receive gifts; rather, I want to see profit added to your account.

dag: O lan tim ma mi na ni n ti moli ni o ni yɛn tilig o niriba saha shɛl la paaya, ka moli ni o ni yɛn bɔhi biɛri saha shɛl la paaya; o lan tim ma mi na yaha ni n ti maai bɛn fabindi la suhuri.
en: He has sent me to proclaim That the time has come When the Lord will save his people And defeat their enemies. He has sent me to comfort all who mourn.

dag: N kpuɣila n nuhi wuh a n-suhir a, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ ni bɔri kom shɛm la.
en: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.

dag: O daa yɛli Naftali zuliya: Yinim Naftalinima, yi nya yurilim tiɣi, ka Yawɛ daalibarika pali yi ni. Yinima n-su wulinluhili mini nudirigu polo.
en: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, dabiɛm mini bɔɣ biɛri ni zana n-ʒe n-gun ya.
en: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.

dag: Shɛli daa bi poori bɛ ni so, dama bɛnkam daa mali puri bee yiya daa kɔhi li mi n-zaŋ di liɣiri maa zaa na.
en: There was no one in the group who was in need. Those who owned fields or houses would sell them, bring the money received from the sale.

dag: So bi piiri maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima o tolitoli; kulla Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-piiri nir leeri maligumaaniba zuɣulana kaman o ni daa piig Aduna shɛm la.
en: No one chooses for himself the honor of being a high priest. It is only by God's call that a man is made a high priest—just as Aaron was.

dag: Ka Maligumaaniba daa mali me Wɔhu Dunɔdali zuɣusaa polo. Sokam daa mali mɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋ tooni.
en: From the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each one opposite his own house.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o bɔri ni yi nabi ka tɔŋ la, lala ka di ni lan niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o chɛ ka yi lu m-bahi yoli zaa, ka bɛ ti yihi ya yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti deei li su maa ni.
en: The Lord was happy to be good to you and to make your nation grow. In the same way the Lord will be happy to ruin and destroy you. You are going to take that land to be yours. But people will take you out of that land!.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋubi ba tiɣi; dama o daa ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu.
en: So the people ate and were satisfied; God gave them what they wanted.

dag: O ni ti taɣi ti niŋgbuna din poori ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di be kaman omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ din bi poori la. O yiko din chɛ ka o tooi su binshɛɣukam zaa la puuni ka o yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: He will change our weak mortal bodies and make them like his own glorious body, using that power by which he is able to bring all things under his rule.

dag: Atɛnsinim mini saamba bɛn daa be nimaani daa bi tumdi tuun shɛli pahila yɛtɔɣ pala tɔɣisibu mini yɛl pala wumbu zuɣu.
en: They said this because all Athenians as well as the foreigners who live in Athens used to spend their time doing nothing but talking about or listening to the newest thing.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa buɣisi bɔh o ba Zakaria ni bɛ baŋ o ni bɔri ni bɛ bol o bia maa yu shɛli.
en: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.

dag: Pool ni daa na do Atɛnsi n-guli Silas mini Timoti maa ka o suhu daa ti saɣim pam o ni daa nya ka tiŋ maa luɣilikam kul nyɛla buɣa la zuɣu.
en: While Paul was waiting in Athens, he was upset to see all the idols in the city.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la, alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa saɣim la, hal n ni daa kul gbib ba kaman yili yidana maa zaa yoli. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: It will not be like the old covenant that I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. Although I was like a husband to them, they did not keep that covenant.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka a zaŋ naɣ bindi she bɔrɔbɔro maa ka chɛ ninsal bindi maa.
en: Then God said to me, Very well, I will let you use dry cow dung to cook your bread. You dont have to use dry human dung.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya kam kpamba: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:.

dag: Jɛhoyakim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim zaa ni daa tum shɛm.
en: Jehoiakim disobeyed the Lord by following the example of his ancestors.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, n suhir a, a nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin be ti sani ti chandi maa ni, hal ti ni kul nyɛ tipawumlinim maa zaa yoli, chɛl ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi maa taali, ka zaŋ ti leeg a niriba.
en: He prayed, Lord , if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔŋda ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi ni m mali taali? Bɛ zaa ni kpi kaman siturili la. Lɛla ni ŋub ba zaa.
en: Look! The LORD God will help me. Who will condemn me? Look, they will wear out like clothing; the moth will eat them.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a. Ka bɔ ka ti lee ti yɛn nya di zuɣu.
en: Peter said to him, We left everything we had and followed you. So what will we have.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam lan ŋmanila kɔhigɔr so ŋun gɔri bɔri waya zaɣ suma.
en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant in search of fine pearls.

dag: Naa, nyini n-nyɛ ti shɛli din wɔɣa ka mali kpiɔŋ maa. A galisiya hal ti tɔr la sagbana, ka su dunia ŋɔ zaa yiko.
en: Your Majesty, that tree is you. Your glorious reputation has reached heaven, and your kingdom covers the earth.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ o tahi bɛ sani, ŋmɛnditoya maa daa woliwolila taba ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka wari wahi, bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa Filistia mini Juda tiŋgbana ni maa zuɣu.
en: The Egyptian led David to the Amalekites. They were lying around on the ground, eating and drinking. They were celebrating with the many things they had taken from the Philistines and from Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, zomiya buɣijɛmbo!.
en: So, my dear friends, stay away from worshiping idols.

dag: Dama Naawuni lihi sokam zaa la yim.
en: God doesn't have any favorites!.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ daa ti kari bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bahi kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka bɛ na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: and the LORD finally removed Israel from his presence. That was exactly what he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So Israel was exiled from its land to Assyria. And thats still how it is today.

dag: So bi piiri maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima o tolitoli; kulla Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-piiri nir leeri maligumaaniba zuɣulana kaman o ni daa piig Aduna shɛm la.
en: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.

dag: Saɣisigu kpɛri ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima pam n-gari bɛ fiɛbi jɛrigu fiɛbiga bukɔbiga.
en: Smart people learn more from a single correction than fools learn from a hundred beatings.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna ti bɔh o, Banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ.
en: God came to Balaam and asked, Who are these men with you.

dag: A ni tooi yɛli saŋmarisi bɛ ni yɛn yina saha shɛli? Bee a ni tooi wuhi saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Baa min o bihi la soli?.
en: Can you guide the stars season by season and direct the Big and the Little Dipper?.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli: N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor motioned for Paul to speak, and he began: I know that you have judged the people of our nation for many years, and I am glad to defend myself in your court.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa yi Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na. O daa nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira m-be nimaani.
en: At that same time there was a young Levite who had been living in the town of Bethlehem in Judah.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: But he told Peter, James, and John to come with him. He began to be very distressed and troubled.

dag: ni nyaanyiriba ni bɛn baɣa ka shɛl ni ni maŋduhiriba ni bɛn yuri niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim gari Naawuni.
en: They will be people who are disloyal, reckless, and conceited. They will love pleasure instead of loving God.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti bɔhi, Sool daŋ ni ninvuɣ so na beni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: One day David asked, Is there anyone left of Saul's family? If there is, I would like to show him kindness for Jonathan's sake.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ba yina ti bɔhi ba, N duumanima, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ tiligi.
en: Then he brought them outside and said, Men, what must I do to be saved.

dag: N kuhi pam boli Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o be o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu ka garigi ma.
en: I call to the Lord for help, and from his sacred hill he answers me.

dag: Ka zuliya gari ni kana ti be Ashidɔd. Ka n siɣisi Filistianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la.
en: People of mixed race will live in Ashdod. The Lord says, I will humble all these proud Philistines.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛl niriba bɛn zaa daa laɣim o sani maa daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni. Bɛ daa kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi mali sara hal ka so daa naan ku tooi lan kali ba bee m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm yaha.
en: King Solomon and all the people of Israel assembled in front of the Covenant Box and sacrificed a large number of sheep and cattle—too many to count.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu ni saa tahibu la yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa n-su nam!.
en: Then I heard what sounded like a crowd, like the sound of a roaring waterfall, like loud peals of thunder. I heard them say, Praise God! For the Lord, our Almighty God, is King!.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti dooi salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li, ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapuhi maa zuɣu.
en: Cover the frames with gold and fit them with gold rings to hold the crossbars, which are also to be covered with gold.

dag: O daa lan mali teebuya pia n-zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, diba anu nudirigu polo, diba anu din la mi nuzaa polo, ka mali salima taha kɔbiga.
en: He also made ten tables and put them in the sanctuary, five on the south and five on the north, as well as a hundred gold bowls.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ahaz daa tim tuumba Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza sani nti yɛl o, N nyɛla a bia ni a dabili, kamina nti fa ma Siria naa mini Izraɛl naa bɛn kana ti liri ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.

dag: Asha zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Imna daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Imnanima; ka Ishivi daŋ niriba nyɛ Ishivinima; ka Bɛraya daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛrayanima.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Asher; they were from the clans of Imnah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and from the two clans of Heber and Malchiel, the sons of Beriah. Asher's daughter was Serah.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka niriba maa lab kuli bɛ ya gol so ŋun daa pahir ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pisinaata dali, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa wuh o nirilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda mini Sulemaana ni o niriba Izraɛlnim zaa san la zuɣu.
en: and on the following day, the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent the people home. They were happy about all the blessings that the Lord had given to his people Israel, to David, and to Solomon.

dag: Dama o daa zali zaligu n-chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi n-kpuɣi teeku kɔgbana zuɣusaa.
en: He commanded, and a mighty wind began to blow and stirred up the waves.

dag: a kul lɔrila saɣiŋgu nia. A zilinli ŋmanila piliŋ. A kul dolila ʒiŋmabo soli sahakam.
en: You are nothing but a hired killer, making plans to hurt people and making up lies!.

dag: ka me Tadimɔr din daa be tiŋgban nɛli ni la mini tin shɛŋa din daa be Hamat ka nɛma be di ni la zaa.
en: He fortified Tadmor in the wilderness, along with all the storage cities he had built in Hamath.

dag: Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ni ti neei kum ni. Yinim bɛn zaa kpi m-be gbala ni, yiɣisimiya yili suhupiɛlli yila. Maligim ni luri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm la, lala ka tiŋgbani yɛn chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la neei.
en: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.

dag: Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: He did what was pleasing to the Lord as long as Jehoiada the priest was alive.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama maa mahim luri adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Adaka yɔrigu maa dɛde ka chɛrubinim maa nina daa kpa.
en: The winged heavenly creatures spread out their wings above, shielding the cover with their wings. The winged heavenly creatures faced each other toward the covers center.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Yawɛ yiko malila tariga? To, a ni nya n yɛligu maa ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli yi sani bee di ku niŋ.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Is the LORDs power too weak? Now you will see whether my word will come true for you or not.

dag: Tiŋgbani maŋmaŋ n-chɛ ka di niŋdi maa: Tuuli, di tɔrimi duna niŋ vari; din paya, ka di ti va puya n-naanyi dɔɣi;.
en: The earth produces crops all by itself, first the stalk, then the head, then the full head of grain.

dag: Dama bɛ daa kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa hal ka tiŋgbani ti ku n-sabigi. Ka bɛ daa ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim bimbil shɛŋa la mini tiwala zaa, ka va mahali bee tihi vari bee puri ni bimbilima daa lan ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: They covered the whole landscape so that the land turned black with them. They ate all of the lands grain and all of the orchards fruit that the hail had left. Nothing green was left in any orchard or in any grain field in the whole land of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini tiŋa o sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛl o shɛli, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka o be biɛrim pam ni.
en: They sat with Job on the ground seven days and seven nights, not speaking a word to him, for they saw that he was in excruciating pain.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa lu solɔɣu chana, ka Shimɛi daa be zolɔŋni m-baɣisir o luɣili polo dol o chani tur o, ka labir o kuɣa, ka toori taŋkpaɣu chɛr o.
en: So David and his men kept walking, while Shimei went along on the hillside next to him, cursing as he went, throwing rocks and dirt at him.

dag: ka zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛr ayi ʒil tuh o; ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɣis o yɛli, A turi Naawuni mini naa; di saha ka yi zaŋ o yi nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: Get a couple of scoundrels to accuse him to his face of cursing God and the king. Then take him out of the city and stone him to death.

dag: N yi be a jɛmbu duu dahin yini, di so ni m be luɣ shɛli polo m-paai biɛɣ tuhili; m paɣiya ni n nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔgula n-gari m be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi.
en: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim a la ni zo, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn me a kana ti me a zali.
en: Those who will rebuild you are coming soon, and those who destroyed you will leave.

dag: Ŋunkam mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, noli din dim o! Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who does not give fair judgment for the foreigners, orphans, and widows! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm kul bɔhindila baŋsim pahira, ka yɛnnim tiba kul bɔri ni di wumdi baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.

dag: O ni daa yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi bɛ naba ni.
en: As soon as he had finished speaking, the ground under Dathan and Abiram split open.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yihi o niriba maa; ka bɛ daa ʒi anzinfa mini salima yi, bɛ ni so daa bi tuui.
en: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.

dag: ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pahi zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo. Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa kul nyɛ Sool dima di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: So Saul became even more afraid of David and was against him all that time.

dag: Niŋmiya bindira tiri kum ni kuri shɛba, ka deemiya nandaamba bɛn ka kpɛhili shee niŋmi yi yinsi; ka timiya bɛn chani gbinfini situra; ka di zaɣisiya yi dɔɣiriba sɔŋbu.
en: I want you to share your food with the hungry. I want you to find the poor who dont have homes and bring them into your own homes. When you see people who have no clothes, give them your clothes! Dont hide from your relatives when they need help.

dag: Ka di daa gari Ɛdom nanima; ka Mɔab zuɣulaannim niŋgbuna sɔhira ka Keenannim zaa kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: The leaders of Edom and of Moab were terrified. Everyone in Canaan fainted.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim kpi ka yi yi alizinnim bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni la, di chaŋ wula ka yi lan be kaman dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba? Bɔzuɣu ka yi doli zaligunim din yɛli:.
en: You have died with Christ and are set free from the ruling spirits of the universe. Why, then, do you live as though you belonged to this world? Why do you obey such rules as.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan deei Filistianim ni daa tuhi fa tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ sani zaa. Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti kpa Gaat, bɛ daa fa bɛ tiŋgbana zaa Filistianim sani. Ka suhudoo daa lan niŋ bɛn Izraɛlnim maa mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines had taken some cities from Israel, but the Israelites won them back. They recovered those cities throughout the Philistine area, from Ekron to Gath. There was also peace between Israel and the Amorites.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram bidibisi ni, Shubaɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shubaɛl bidibisi ni, Jɛdɛiya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: The rest of the Levites included: from Amrams family: Shubael; from Shubaels family: Jehdeiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa chaŋ ni o ti niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Gaad yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: David followed the Lord 's instructions.

dag: Ka bɛ tintariga daa zaŋ chaŋ hal ti paai Tabo mini Shahazuma ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-zaŋ ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: The border of their land touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth Shemesh. It ended at the Jordan River. In all, there were towns and the fields around them.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka yi nyamma tɔŋ pam. Zuliya shɛb azichi ni zo na kaman mɔɣili kom la nti kpɛn ya; ka yi be kaman bi so ŋun ma kpuɣ o ʒili o naba zuɣu, n gbib o ni yurilim m-mɔɣisir o bihim la.
en: The Lord says, I will bring you lasting prosperity; the wealth of the nations will flow to you like a river that never goes dry. You will be like a child that is nursed by its mother, carried in her arms, and treated with love.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Yulimiya bo n-nya ŋun tooi ŋmɛri mɔɣilo viɛnyɛliŋga ti ma na.
en: So Saul said to his servants, Find someone who plays music well and bring him to me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni gari yi tooni n-zaŋ ya du li. O ni ku zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ, ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su. Jɔshua gba ni gari yi tooni n-zaŋ ya du kaman Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm maa.
en: The Lord your God himself will go before you and destroy the nations living there, so that you can occupy their land; and Joshua will be your leader, as the Lord has said.

dag: Yi pun lan wum ka di sab yɛli, So yi fɔɣ a nini, a gba nyin fɔɣim o dini labisi, ka so yi ŋme n-kab a nyini, a gba nyin ŋmɛm kab o dini labisi.
en: You know you have been taught, An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.

dag: Naawuni, di simdi ni ti paɣ a Ziɔn. Ka zaŋ ti ni lo alikauli ni ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa ti a la ti a.
en: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni chɛ ka n ni niŋ n tɔbbi shɛb naani, ka mali ba nyuri bara la tuhi n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu.
en: The Lord has called out his proud and confident soldiers to fight a holy war and punish those he is angry with.

dag: Leeban daa malila bipuɣins ayi; ŋun daa nyɛ kpɛm yuli n-daa booni Liya, ka biasani mi yuli daa booni Reechɛl.
en: Laban had two daughters. Leah was older than Rachel, but her eyes didn't sparkle, while Rachel was beautiful and had a good figure.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi halli zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka yi yihiri yi paɣiba, amaa piligu ni ha, pa lala n-daa nyɛ li.
en: Jesus replied, Moses allowed you to divorce your wives because your hearts are unyielding. But it wasnt that way from the beginning.

dag: ka o ninni biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔba ni ti dii chɔɣisichɔɣisi, ka o duna ŋmɛri taba.
en: He turned pale and was so frightened that his knees began to shake.

dag: dama m bi yɛri shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa n-zali ma n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ka tɔɣisi shɛm.
en: That is because what I taught was not from myself. The Father who sent me told me what to say and what to teach.

dag: Luɣ dini ka n lee yɛn zo n-chaŋ ka chɛ a Shia? Bee ya ka n lee yɛn zo n-kuli n-yi a sani?.
en: Your Spirit is everywhere I go. I cannot escape your presence.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa laɣim taba n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama.
en: So all the elders of Israel met together and went to Ramah to meet with Samuel.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni ŋme n-wurim o dimnim la zuɣuri, o ni saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ka kul doli bɛ daalahichi soya la zuɣutalisi.
en: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli yaha, Goli palli kam chuɣu dali mini Vuhim Dabisili dali kam di simdi ni zuliya kam zaa kana ti jɛm ma.
en: Everyone will come to worship me on every worship day; they will come every Sabbath and every first day of the month. This is what I, the Lord , have said.

dag: bee so binshɛli yi bɔrigi ka o pihi li ka ŋma ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ di polo bee m-pɔri ʒiri pɔri zaŋ chaŋ niriba ni tumdi binshɛŋa zaa ka di nyɛ alahichi polo.
en: or by lying about something that has been lost and swearing that you did not find it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bɔri naa, ka Naawuni daa pii Kish bia Sool leei bɛ naa, ka o daa di nam maa yuun pihinahi. Sool daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira.
en: The Israelites requested a king, so God gave them Saul, Kishs son, from the tribe of Benjamin, and he served as their king for forty years.

dag: O daa zaŋla o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ ti gbaai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ o zuɣu kpa zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la polo.
en: So Jacob and his entire household left. He got up, crossed the river, and set out directly for the mountains of Gilead.

dag: Nyin bilikɔɣindan ŋɔ! Vuɣim daantal shɛli din sa a ninni maa ka nyari viɛnyɛliŋga pɔi, ka naanyi yihi bimburigin shɛli din be a mabia ninni.
