en: You are a hypocrite! First, take the wood out of your own eye. Then you will see clearly to get the dust out of your friends eye.

dag: Ti bi zaŋ binshɛli sɔŋ gu so soli ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka so ku tooi nya ti taali ti tuma puuni.
en: We dont give anyone any reason to be offended about anything so that our ministry wont be criticized.

dag: Amaa so yi ti yihi yɛli ya, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa, yin di dinya li ŋun yɛli ya maa zuɣu mini suhu ni tɛha zuɣu;.
en: But if someone tells you, That food was offered to idols, then dont eat it. Thats because some people think it is wrong, and it might cause a problem for the person who told you that.

dag: Ka kuriti nyɔtaɣirisi din ŋmani zahim paɣiri pɔb bɛ nyɔri, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama vuri kaman chɛchɛbunsi wɔr bɔbili ni yi zɔri chani tɔbu tuhibu shɛm la.
en: Their chests were covered with what looked like iron breastplates, and the sound made by their wings was like the noise of many horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmahi abie tihi wula din mali vari n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli ka kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Izraɛlnim Naa ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika.
en: They took branches of palm trees and went out to meet Jesus. They shouted, Praise Him! Welcome! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! Psalm :- God bless the King of Israel.

dag: daba ayopɔin m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di nyɛla laɣiŋgu tibisili; di ti tumiya tuma dindali maa.
en: You will bring offerings as gifts to the Lord for seven days. On the eighth day, you will have another holy meeting. You must not do any work. You will bring an offering as a gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba pahi, Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When you are welcomed into a home, stay there until you leave that town.

dag: A ni yɛn mal li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pihitanaata; ka chɛ ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka chɛ ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata.
en: Make it feet long, feet wide, and feet high.

dag: Nyama pumpɔŋɔ ŋ-ŋɔ o sɔɣi vol shɛl ni bee luɣ shɛli polo. Ka niriba maa shɛb yi chaŋ ti lir o tuuli liribu ŋɔ ka o ku ba, ŋunkam wum di yɛla ni yɛli ni bɛ ku Absalom niriba pam.
en: He has probably already found a hiding place in a cave or somewhere else. As soon as anyone hears that some of your soldiers have been killed, everyone will think your whole army has been destroyed.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka saha daa ti paai ni bɛ zaŋ o ti bahi, ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa pihi bia maa ni o ti wums o n-zaŋ o leeg omaŋmaŋ bia.
en: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe fɔntiŋ ni bee tiŋkpaŋa, yin bɔhimiya n-nya ninvuɣ chirichi n-kpe o yiŋa m-be nimaani hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: Whatever city or village you go into, find somebody in it who is worthy and stay there until you go on your way.

dag: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bi galisi, ka nyɛ saamba di ni la.
en: God's people were few in number, strangers in the land of Canaan.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee kum pam a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka dɔni tampiligim ni bilim.
en: They will be very sad about you. They will cry, throw dust on their heads, and roll in ashes.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa, amaa ʒiŋmariba ʒiri ni zani tariga.
en: Righteous people speak wisdom, but the tongue that speaks evil will be stopped.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni a saria karibu nyɛla din tuhi. Ʒiɛyimtali puuni ka a daa darigi n tibili maa.
en: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.

dag: Yi yi kali ninvuɣ so ka o yuma paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, di simdi ka o yo man Yawɛ ni zali farigu shɛli maa.
en: Every man who is at least years old must be counted. And every man who is counted must give the Lord this offering.

dag: Lɔd mini Hadid ni Ono — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisinaanu.
en: of Lod, Hadid, and Ono.

dag: N daa ti o dahima ni o niŋ tuuba o zina niŋbu maa zuɣu, amaa ka o zaɣisi tuuba maa niŋbu.
en: I gave her time to change her heart and life, but she refuses to change her life of prostitution.

dag: Miriya anab ʒirinim bɛn kani yi sanna m-be kaman piɛri n-nyɛ ba, amaa ka lee nyɛ kunduna bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Watch out for false prophets. They come to you dressed like sheep, but inside they are vicious wolves.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim yi ti niŋ ka yi bi deei n noli, di saha n ni darigi yi tibili ʒiibuyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: If even after all of this you still do not obey me, I will increase your punishment seven times.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n tooi zani Ziɔn dunɔdaya ni n-yɛli n ni paɣir a shɛlikam zuɣu shɛm yɛla, n ni mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma la zuɣu.
en: Then, at the gates of Jerusalem, I can sing praises to you. I will be so happy because you saved me.

dag: ka duh o yee suhi Naawuni bɔh o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n ni kana ti be pako so sani ŋɔ bidibiga ŋɔ kpi n-ti o suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Elijah cried out to the LORD, LORD my God, why is it that you have brought such evil upon the widow that I am staying with by killing her son.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni tinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ di suɣilo n-sɔŋ bɛn ka yaa, ka di bɔri ni ti tum din ni tiɣi timaŋmaŋ nini.
en: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ninvuɣ biɛri biɛhigu shee ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, lala n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: That is the fate of evil people, the fate of those who care nothing for God.

dag: N Duuma n-teegi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma ŋ-ŋɔ ni o yihi ma vi ni niriba sani maa.
en: What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni Jɛrusalɛm suhudoo zuɣu yɛra, Chɛ ka bɛn yuri li tɔŋ.
en: Pray that Jerusalem has peace: Let those who love you have rest.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zoya ŋɔ nim zaa zaŋ takɔbiri ti lu Gɔg zuɣu. O tɔbbihi ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord , will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.

dag: Amaa dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ piɛɣu, dindina ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi na ti ti Yawɛ o ni tum taal shɛli maa zuɣu. Ka yino ti nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ so nyo buɣim mali sara.
en: If you cant afford an animal from the flock, you can bring to the LORD as compensation for your sin two doves or two pigeons, one as a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ nimaani chaŋ hal ti du Ɛkurɔn nuzaa polo kuŋkuni. Ka di tariga maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ hal ni Shikɛrɔn n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti baɣisi Baala Zoli gari, ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jabiniil; ka di daa naanyi kana ti paai di tariga teeku ni.
en: It continued along to the hillside north of Ekron, curved around to Shikkeron, and then went to Mount Baalah. After going to Jabneel, the border finally ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a mini so zabi ka di ka soli, ka di pala o tum a la taali.
en: Dont take people to court without good reason, especially when they have done nothing to harm you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi Taai doli yi Sidɔn mini tin shɛli din yuli booni Tinsi Pia la ni mali ti paai Galili Teeku ni.
en: Jesus then left the neighborhood of Tyre and went on through Sidon to Lake Galilee, going by way of the territory of the Ten Towns.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Hanna ni, ka o lan dɔɣi bidibis ata mini bipuɣins ayi. Ka Samuɛl daa kul be Yawɛ tooni hal ti zooi.
en: The Lord was kind to Hannah, and she had three sons and two daughters. The boy Samuel grew up at the holy place near the Lord .

dag: Yi ni so miri ka o ti zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga nyo buɣim mali sara bee n-ŋmɛri bihigu bee m-buɣiri baɣa bee n-nyɛ bɔha bee bukpaha.
en: There must not be anyone among you who passes his son or daughter through fire; who practices divination, is a sign reader, fortune-teller, sorcerer.

dag: N ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla maa, ka n teei ʒini gbaai kumsi. Dabisi gbaliŋ ka n daa zaŋ fabili ka lo noli n-suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: When I heard this news, I sat down and wept. I mourned for days, fasting and praying before the God of heaven.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ yalim gari biŋkuma sara kam zaa ni, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini Naawuni yalim alikauli la ti pooi yi sara maligu maa ni, dinzuɣu yi sara maligu kam ni di simdi ka yi chɛ ka yalim be di ni.
en: Put salt on every grain offering, because salt represents the covenant between you and God.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, pahim ti yɛda.
en: The apostles said to the Lord, Make our faith greater.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu lahi la, miriya ka yi shihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri. Malimiya yimaŋ be kasi. Yimiya Babilɔn chaŋ.
en: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Unclean! Dont touch! Get out of that place; purify yourselves, carriers of the LORDs equipment!.

dag: Ŋunkam ʒiya kpahindi pɔhim ku biri binshɛli, ka ŋunkam mi ʒiya lihiri sagbana ku kpuɣi puu atam.
en: If you worry about the weather and don't plant seeds, you won't harvest a crop.

dag: O daa nyaya ka so kani, ka di daa gar o pam o ni daa nya ka so kani ŋun ni mali yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yiko tiligi ba, ka di nasara.
en: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.

dag: M mali yɛla pam din ni tɔɣisi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka kari ya saria, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka n ni wum shɛli o sani, dina ka m mali yɛri dunianima.
en: I have much to say about you, much to condemn you for. The one who sent me, however, is truthful, and I tell the world only what I have heard from him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka sapashinnim maa mini bɛ tɔbbihi ni niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ tarimba ni wɔɣira daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Babilɔnnima.
en: Then all the people, young and old, along with the army officers, departed for Egypt because they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda zuɣu ka Naawuni daa ŋmahi ba bahi, amaa nyin gba kpalim ʒiɛla a yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu. Dinzuɣu di nyuri bara; amaa chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: Fine. They were broken off because they werent faithful, but you stand only by your faithfulness. So dont think in a proud way; instead be afraid.

dag: Ka bɛn daa gariti nimaani gba yɛri Yisa zilima, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd o ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ.
en: People who passed by said terrible things about Jesus. They shook their heads and shouted, Ha! So you're the one who claimed you could tear down the temple and build it again in three days.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ka di yɛri malaikanima ayopɔin la, Zaŋmiya Naawuni suhuyiɣisili ni pali lah ayopɔin shɛŋa la n-chaŋ ti kpaai bahi dunia ni.
en: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, Go and pour out the seven bowls of Gods anger on the earth.

dag: ka yi ti yɛn bahi ka ŋuhira, ka yi niŋgbuna zaa sheei;.
en: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan.

dag: Dama Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛba bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi zaɣisi ma ka niŋ bɛ buɣa yɛda, amaa ka ka anabi maa sanna ni bɛ ti bɔh o baŋ binshɛli n sani, man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni garigi ba.
en: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm wahala mini o yɔɣu dabu dabisa la puuni, ka o teei o ni daa mali bin viɛl shɛŋa kurimbuni ha la yɛla. Saha shɛli o dimnim ni daa nyaŋ o niriba ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ba la, ka o dimnim maa daa yuun o ni lu maa, ka maani o ansarisi.
en: A lonely ruin now, Jerusalem recalls her ancient splendor. When she fell to the enemy, there was no one to help her; Her conquerors laughed at her downfall.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Ka bɛ dimnim zaa puuni ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tooi zani bɛ tooni, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: The LORD gave them rest from surrounding danger, exactly as he had pledged to their ancestors. Not one of all their enemies held out against them. The LORD gave all their enemies into their power.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa zɔri Sulemaana, ka yiɣisi chaŋ ti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Adonijah, in great fear of Solomon, went to the Tent of the Lord 's presence and took hold of the corners of the altar.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali saŋmarisi kalinli ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka mi bɛ yuya.
en: He has decided the number of the stars and calls each one by name.

dag: Naawuni n-nam zuɣusaa n-teei li pa. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Ŋuna n-ti ninsalinim zaa nyɛvili ni vuhim. Ka pumpɔŋɔ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa yɛl o dabili.
en: God the LORD says— the one who created the heavens, the one who stretched them out, the one who spread out the earth and its offspring, the one who gave breath to its people and life to those who walk on it.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla shia, ka di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn jɛmd o, jɛmd o ni bɛ shihi ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.

dag: N daa fabindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zuɣu, ka m puu biɛri nandaamba zuɣu.
en: Didn't I weep with people in trouble and feel sorry for those in need?.

dag: Deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani.
en: You must definitely obey the LORD your Gods voice, keeping all his commandments that I am giving you right now, by doing what is right in the LORD your Gods eyes!.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ niɣi, ka chɛ ka saa tahi ku bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: He killed their cattle with hail and their flocks with lightning.

dag: ka Azarɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrɔham bia la mi nyɛ Dan zuliya ni kpɛma. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya zuɣulaannima.
en: for Dan—Azarel, Jerohams son. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

dag: N ni kari ya n sani bahi kaman n ni daa kari yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya la zaa bahi shɛm la.
en: I will cast you out of my sight, just as I cast out the rest of your family, all the people of Ephraim.

dag: O zaŋd o naba kɔrisiri tiŋa ni yaa, o mali suhupiɛlli pam o yaa maa zuɣu, ka zɔri tuhiri bidibbina soli.
en: He paws in the valley, prances proudly, charges at battle weapons.

dag: ka gbihiri yuŋ kam, ka yiɣisiri asiba kam, ka bimbira maa mali hal nti bilina zooi, ka o bi mi din chɛ ka di niŋ lala maa.
en: The seed begins to grow. It grows night and day. It doesnt matter whether the man is sleeping or awake, the seed still grows. He doesnt know how it happens.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yi ni ti nya ti yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni anabinim zaa ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ni, amaa ka Naawuni ti kari yinim di ni bahi. Yinim ni ti fabili ka dim yi nyina.
en: You will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in Gods kingdom. But you will be left outside. There you will cry and grind your teeth with pain.

dag: Di ti maliya buɣim yi biɛhigu shee zaa Vuhim Dabisili maa dali.
en: Do not even light a fire in your homes on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka o daa boli bibil so na nti zaŋ o zali bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Jesus called for a child to come over and stand near him.

dag: Ka kpatoon kpɛm daa vihi hal ti nya o nimaani m-bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka nyin doya gbihira? Yiɣisim suh a wuni ka o sɔŋ ti. Di pa shɛli ka o zo ti nambɔɣu tiligi ti nyɛviya.
en: The captain of the boat saw Jonah and said, Wake up! Why are you sleeping? Pray to your god! Maybe your god will hear your prayer and save us.

dag: A situra tulimi, pɔhim tulli ni ʒiɛri zuɣu.
en: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti paɣa maa? Ka Gɛhaazi garigi yɛl o, To, paɣ maa ka bidibiga, ka o yidana mi kurigi.
en: Elisha asked Gehazi, What can I do for her then? He answered, Well, she has no son, and her husband is an old man.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: M Ba, a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma la, m bi chɛ ka bɛ ni yino bɔrigi.
en: This was so that the word he had spoken might be fulfilled: I didnt lose anyone of those whom you gave me.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi, ka pa ni Yisa.
en: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to ask, instead, that Pilate set Barabbas free for them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kum o kuli, ka zaŋ o ti sɔɣi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Ahija yɛli shɛm la.
en: Everyone in Israel came and mourned at his funeral, just as the Lord 's servant Ahijah had said.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zaadali Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni be kɔŋkɔba zuɣu n-chɛ ka Yisa leeg alikauli din so nyaanzaana.
en: This difference, then, also makes Jesus the guarantee of a better covenant.

dag: A daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhi shihira Firawuna min o tumtumdiba zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa sani, a ni mi bɛ ni daa niŋ ti fitiina shɛm la zuɣu. A daa zali yuli ti amaŋa, ka di kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri.
en: They were pleased and offered to pay him money.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa bɔɣi litaafi maa niriba maa zaa ninni, dama o ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa daa du n-gari niriba maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli. O ni daa bɔɣi litaafi maa, niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisimi zani.
en: Standing above all of the people, Ezra the scribe opened the scroll in the sight of all of the people. And as he opened it, all of the people stood up.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti di ka nyu n-naai, ka o suhu dɔni luɣ yini, ka o chaŋ kaʒee gbini ti dɔni ni o gbihi. Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Rut ti puɣisi chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli.
en: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking, he was in a good mood. He went to the pile of barley and lay down to sleep. Ruth slipped over quietly, lifted the covers and lay down at his feet.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ shia ni siɣi a zuɣu na pam, ka a pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka a biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Then the Lord s Spirit will come on you with great power. You will be changed. You will be like a different man. You will begin to prophesy with these prophets.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣis o, ka nahim o, amaa ka o bi yaag o noli. Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi chaŋ kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛbil chani kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛɣu kɔbiri ka o fo shɛm la. O daa bi yaag o noli.
en: He was oppressed and tormented, but didnt open his mouth. Like a lamb being brought to slaughter, like a ewe silent before her shearers, he didnt open his mouth.

dag: Dama n wum ka niriba pam sɔɣiri yɛra; ka dabiɛm kul be luɣilikam zaa. Bɛ laɣimmi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma.
en: I hear the crowds whisper, Everyone is afraid! They are plotting and scheming to murder me.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli kpamba maa, Yinim kpalimmiya be kpe n-guhi ti hal ka ti ti lab yi sanna. Aduna mini Hur be yi sani, ka ŋunkam mali yɛl shɛli, ŋun cham bɛ sani.
en: Moses said to the elders, Wait here for us until we come back to you. While I am gone, Aaron and Hur will rule over you. Go to them if anyone has a problem.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yinim bɛn yiɣisiri asiba n-gbaai dam nyubu la, yi kul niŋdila lala hal ni yuŋ n-nyu li buɣi.
en: You are doomed! You get up early in the morning to start drinking, and you spend long evenings getting drunk.

dag: Ka o daa moli molo gili Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm zaa ni bɛ yo Yawɛ farigu shɛli Naawuni dabili Musa ni daa zali Izraɛlnim tiŋgban nɛli ni ni bɛ yo la.
en: Then the Levites made an announcement in Judah and Jerusalem. They told the people to bring in the tax money for the Lord . That tax money is what Moses the servant of God had required the Israelites to give while they were in the desert.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋla chirachira biɛhigu ti ba, ka bɛ chɛ ka Ijiptinim laani gindi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni kaman danyura m-be o tiri ni laani gindi la.
en: The Lord has made them give confusing advice. As a result, Egypt does everything wrong and staggers like a drunk slipping on his own vomit.

dag: Chɛ ka di zambu ʒi Jɔab min o ba daŋ zuɣu. Chɛ ka Jɔab daŋ ni kul ku kɔŋ ʒim ni yiri ninvuɣ so ni bee niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali so bee do so ŋun miri gumdi bee bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee ninvuɣ so ŋun kpiri kum.
en: Joab and his family are responsible for this, and they will be cursed. Many troubles will come to his family. His people will be sick with leprosy, crippled, killed in war, and not have enough food to eat.

dag: Yi pun wum ka n yɛli ya ni n ni chaŋ ka ti lan lab yi sanna yaha. Yi yi di yuri ma, yi naan mali suhupiɛlli n ni chani m Ba sani maa zuɣu, dama m Ba maa gari ma.
en: You heard me say to you, I am leaving, but I will come back to you. If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father; for he is greater than I.

dag: Kom maa kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la, ka teeku bulli ni kom zuɣusaa kilim.
en: Water hardens like stone; the surface of the deep thickens.

dag: A yɛla gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli maa tinsi ni zaa, ka dabiɛm pam gbahi bɛ nanima a zuɣu, ka bɛ nina ni maligi.
en: Now the inhabitants of the coastlands shudder on account of you. And as for their kings, their hair stands on end; their faces betray their horror.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n wum Ifriim daŋ ni fabindi yɛra, A darigi ti tibili, ka ti saɣi ti tibidarigibo maa. Ti daa ŋmanila naɣisa so bɛ ni bi baligi. Zaŋmi ti labisina, ka chɛ ka ti ka a sanna, dama nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: I hear, yes, I hear Ephraim lamenting: You disciplined me, and I learned my lesson, even though I was as stubborn as a mule. Bring me back, let me return, because you are the LORD my God.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi tooi kom maa m-mali bɛ zilima nyur li kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisita, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa daa gbanila tiŋ nyura.
en: There were three hundred men who scooped up water in their hands and lapped it; all the others got down on their knees to drink.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, ka kari mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti be mɔɣu maa ni, ka gbɛri nimaani ka barina shɛli kani.
en: I will make a covenant with them that guarantees their security. I will get rid of all the dangerous animals in the land, so that my sheep can live safely in the fields and sleep in the forests.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa daa kana ti paala salo, ka bɛ ni do so daa kana ti damdi Yisa tooni yɛli.
en: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee be a nuu ni ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Jaaŋgbee.
en: The LORD said to him, Whats that in your hand? Moses replied, A shepherds rod.

dag: Ka n daa bahi noli ni bɛ vihim yɛlli maa, ka bɛ daa vihi n-nya ka kurimbuni ha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ tiŋ maa shiri nyɛla tin shɛli din bi zani tuhi nam fukumsi, ka duŋtaariba mini gadamanima n-kul pali di ni.
en: I gave orders for an investigation to be made, and it has indeed been found that from ancient times Jerusalem has revolted against royal authority and that it has been full of rebels and troublemakers.

dag: O ni zaŋ tɔbutuhira piɛma din noya diri mini sɔɣu tia sala buɣim darigi yi tibili.
en: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiya ba Izraɛlnim ni daa chaŋ taŋkpa kuŋ zuɣu Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni n-du li shɛm yɛla.
en: Tell them, The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea.

dag: Buɣim yirila o sani n-chani ti diri o dimnim bɛn gil o luɣilikam zaa.
en: Fire goes in front of him and burns up his enemies around him.

dag: Di simdi ka bansi maa miri naŋgbaŋkuɣila din ti yɛn gbibi dapu shɛŋa yi ni ti yɛn zaŋ buɣiri teebuli maa la.
en: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba n-tum kaman Ɛhab min o daŋ ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o paɣ daa nyɛla Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga. O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: His wife was Ahab's daughter, and like the family of Ahab he followed the evil ways of the kings of Israel. He sinned against the Lord .

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga yin doliya zaligu ŋɔ.
en: If the ox gores a boy or a girl, this same case law applies to the owner.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha: Ti Duuma mi ka yɛnnim tɛha nyɛla yoli.
en: And also, The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are silly .

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Naawuni nira n-ka n sanna, o biɛhigu ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, ka o ninni lihibu mali dabiɛm pam. M bi bɔh o o ni yi luɣ shɛl na, ka o mi bi wuhi ma o yuli.
en: Then the woman went to her husband and told him what had happened. She said, A man of God came to me. He looked like the angel of God. He frightened me. I didnt ask him where he was from, and he didnt tell me his name.

dag: Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa bi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la, dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The tribe of Benjamin could not force the Jebusites to leave Jerusalem. So even today, the Jebusites live with the people of Benjamin in Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tir nir nyɛvili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di yi be nir kɔbili ni, o ni mali alaafee, ka barina shɛli ku paag o.
en: Respect the Lord and you will have a good life, one that is satisfying and free from trouble.

dag: M biɛhigu ni be kaman Masia biɛhigu la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi gba biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: Follow my example, just like I follow Christs.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na ka tiŋ maa nim dii baŋ o.
en: and came ashore. People immediately recognized Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛli Firawuna, Tinim a daba ŋɔ kamina ni ti ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dama kum maa miiya pam Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti biŋkɔbiri bi nyari mɔri ŋubira; ka pumpɔŋɔ ti suhir a mi ni a chɛ ka ti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni.
en: They continued, Weve come to the land as immigrants because the famine is so severe in the land of Canaan that there are no more pastures for your servants flocks. Please allow your servants to settle in the land of Goshen.

dag: Yisifu saha ka o daa zali zaligu maa, saha shɛl o ni daa liri Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ la. N wumla n ni ʒi kukol shɛli, ka di yɛra:.
en: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam mi zaɣ suŋ tumbu ka bi tum li, di nyɛla alahichi o sani.
en: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi n-gbaai chandi, zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali ka bɛ paai Gibiɔnnim ni daa be tin shɛŋa maa ni. Bɛ tinsi maa n-nyɛ Gibiɔn mini Chɛfira ni Bɛrɔt ni Kiriatijiarim.
en: So the people of Israel started out and three days later arrived at the cities where these people lived: Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath Jearim.

dag: A chɛ ka puri atam niŋdi pam yuuni puuni; ka a naɣikɔra tɔroko lɔɣu pali bindira hal ti puuri bahira.
en: You crown the year with your goodness; your paths overflow with rich food.

dag: N ni darigi dunia ŋɔ nim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, ka darigi ninvuɣ biɛri tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. N ni siɣisi karimbaannim mini bɛnkam duhiri bɛmaŋa ni putɔɣunima.
en: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.

dag: N nya ka Kushan suɣa be muɣisigu ni, ka nya ka Midian tiŋgbɔŋ suɣa pateesanim sɔhira.
en: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.

dag: Ka o mam ŋun daa be Shɛkɛm gba daa dɔɣ o bidib yino, ka o bol o yuli Abimilɛk.
en: He even had a wife who lived at Shechem. They had a son, and Gideon named him Abimelech.

dag: N ni sabiri shɛli ŋɔ puuni, n niŋ naani ni a ni niŋ n ni suh a ni a niŋ shɛli ŋɔ hal n-niŋ li yaɣi lala zuɣu gba.
en: I am sure, as I write this, that you will do what I ask—in fact I know that you will do even more.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ni ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti Maika ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔrɛshɛt nir la m-bɔŋɔ. Di daa nyɛla Jɔtam mini Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni. O ni daa nya binshɛŋa maa daa nyɛla Samaria mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: During the time that Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah, the Lord gave this message to Micah, who was from the town of Moresheth. The Lord revealed to Micah all these things about Samaria and Jerusalem.

dag: Dindali maa, niriba ni ti yili yilli ŋɔ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yɛli, Ti tiŋ ŋɔ mali yaa! Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun guli di goma!.
en: At that time people will sing this song in Judah: We have a strong city with strong walls and defenses. But God gives us our salvation.

dag: Dama yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ni yi ti deei li su maa bi be kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni na la, nimaani yi daa yi biri yi bimbira, yi chanila yi naba zuɣu ti ŋɔŋ kom na ti yɔɣi li kaman ʒiɛvari puu la.
en: The land that you are about to occupy is not like the land of Egypt, where you lived before. There, when you planted grain, you had to work hard to irrigate the fields;.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ bɛ ʒim paɣi yi naba, ka yi bahi mi lɛli yi dimnim maa ʒim.
en: so that you may wade in their blood, and your dogs may lap up as much as they want.

dag: Di saha ka wuntizɔriba maa ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum mal a, ka ti ti a bindirigu? Bee ka kɔnyuri daa mal a, ka ti ti a kom?.
en: The righteous will then answer him, When, Lord, did we ever see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo di ni ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: and the Lord asked, Satan, where have you been? Satan replied, I have been going all over the earth.

dag: Paɣ shɛb gba daa ʒe kpaŋ ha yuuni Yisa; Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsibila ni Jɔsis ma Mariama ni Salomi daa be bɛ ni.
en: Some women were watching from a distance, including Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and Salome.

dag: N daa tɛhila n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kpɛhi m bihi ni shɛm, ka tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli. Tiŋgban shɛli din viɛli gari dunia tiŋgbana zaa. Ka n daa tɛhi ni yi ni boli ma yi ba ka ku zo ka chɛ ma dolibu.
en: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me Father and not turn from me.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Biŋgbamda zaa bɛn be tiŋgban ni gbamda nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira, di bi simdi ka yi di ba.
en: Don't eat any of those disgusting little creatures that crawl or walk close to the ground.

dag: Timoti yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli, dama o tumdila ti Duuma tuma kaman n ni tumdi shɛm.
en: If Timothy comes your way, be sure to make him feel welcome among you, because he is working for the Lord, just as I am.

dag: Hal paɣ shɛb bɛn nini zɔri nambɔɣu gba daa ti zaŋdila bɛ bihi duɣira. Bɛna n-daa leei bɛ bindirigu, bɛ ni daa kuri n niriba maa saha shɛli maa.
en: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ hal ti paai o lubu saha, kul paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: From the east to the west praise the name of the Lord !.

dag: Bɛ ku lan labi bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa nim ku lan baŋ ba yaha.
en: They dont come back to their old homes. The people there would not know them.

dag: ni Hilikia bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Zadok mini Mɛrayɔt ni Ahitub ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah and grandson of Meshullam. His ancestors included Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who was the High Priest.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha waɣa? Kurimbuni ha ka m pun lo lala, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ maa. Dina n-nyɛ: Ni a saɣim fɔntin kara, ka di leei dabari.
en: Have you never heard that I planned all this long ago? And now I have carried it out. I gave you the power to turn fortified cities into piles of rubble.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan kuhi yɛli, Haliluya! Tin titali maa buɣim dibu nyɔhi kul ni tuɣiri hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Again they shouted, Praise God! The smoke from the flames that consume the great city goes up forever and ever.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ka bɛ ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛl la niŋ pali: So m-birita, ka so mi chɛra.
en: It is true when we say, One person plants, but another person harvests the crop.

dag: Ka Ibram daa be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Lɔt mi be vinvamli maa ni fɔntinsi ni, ka daa ti yiɣisi n-zaŋ o tanti suɣili chaŋ ti kpa Sɔdom.
en: Abram stayed in the land of Canaan. But Lot settled near the cities of the valley and put up his tents not far from Sodom.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi baŋ hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: yet they did not realize what was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. That is how it will be when the Son of Man comes.

dag: A pun mali paɣa? Di bɔri soli ni a yih o. A na ka paɣa? Di bo paɣa.
en: If you are married, dont get a divorce. If you are divorced, dont try to find a spouse.

dag: Yi ni ti lan ko yi wain tihi puri Samaria zoya zuɣu. Ka bɛn ti sa tihi maa ni ti di di wala.
en: You farmers of Israel will plant vineyards again. You will plant the vineyards on the hills around the city of Samaria. The farmers will enjoy the fruit from the vineyards.

dag: Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ pisi bɛn daa dol o la ni daa ti paai Naa Dauda sani Hiburɔn, Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣila bindira ti Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa ka bɛ laɣim tab di ka nyu.
en: When Abner came to David at Hebron with twenty men, David gave a feast for them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paya ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi Tɛlimɛla mini Tɛliharisha ni Kɛrub ni Addɔn ni Imɛr n-lab kuli na la, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi tooi wuhi bɛ yaannim ni nyɛ shɛba bee bɛ ni yi shɛli na din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya.
en: Some people came to Jerusalem from these towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon, and Immer. But these people could not prove that their families really came from the Israelites:.

dag: Ka Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti be zuliya pam sunsuuni kaman maligim n-yi Yawɛ sanna la. Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila saa ŋun miri bahiri mɔri zuɣu ka di baɣa ka niriba ni bee n-lihiri daadam ninni la.
en: But those from Jacob who are still living and scattered among the nations will be like dew from the Lord that does not depend on anyone. They will be like rain on the grass that does not wait for anyone.

dag: Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani, pumpɔŋɔ kul mali we!.
en: Israel, trust in the Lord . Trust in him now and forever!.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin di dabisa maa ni. Di bi simdi ka yi chɛ ka so nya dabindi bɔrɔbɔro yi sani yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: So for seven days, you must not eat any bread made with yeast. There must be no bread with yeast any place in your land.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu daa ti zahim zahindi ka zaŋ li yɛl o biɛyanim maa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani maan pahi.
en: One time Joseph had a dream, and when he told his brothers about it, they hated him even more.

dag: O doli zaligu soli n-zabiri kpibisi mini pakoya zuɣu, ka yuri saamba, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini situra.
en: He enacts justice for orphans and widows, and he loves immigrants, giving them food and clothing.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti na maa ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yilli bɛ sani.
en: God has brought them out of Egypt; He fights for them like a wild ox.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tin ya ko mahim biɛla yi ni nyɛ Masia nyaandoliba la zuɣu, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: I assure you that whoever gives you a cup of water to drink because you belong to Christ will certainly be rewarded.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino kpiŋkpan yini wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni chɛrubi kpiŋkpan yini nyol ni zaŋ ti kpa o kpiŋkpan din la nyol ni wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: Both Cherub angels were the same size and built the same way. Each one had two wings. Each wing was cubits long. From the end of one wing to the end of the other wing was cubits. And each Cherub angel was cubits tall.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ŋɔ simdi paɣibu pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: To our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisa; di kul chanimi ti dooni niŋgbina ni.
en: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.

dag: Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee. Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ ka kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: Then it says, Ill go back to the house I left. When it arrives, it finds the place vacant, cleaned up, and decorated.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi la ni.
en: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courts of the temple.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Zarɛfat din be Sidɔn tiŋgban ni la nti be ni. Nyama, n yɛli pako so ŋun be nimaani ni o tim a bindirigu.
en: Now go to the town of Zarephath, near Sidon, and stay there. I have commanded a widow who lives there to feed you.

dag: N Naawuni, n yɛrimi, di zaŋ ma n nyɛvili sunsuuni, nyini ŋun kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni ŋɔ.
en: I said, My God, dont take me away in the prime of life— your years go on from one generation to the next!.

dag: ansarisimaaniba mini ninvuɣ turiba ni yɛri ti shɛm ti dimnim mini bɛn bɔri ni bɛ bɔhi ti biɛri ninni la zuɣu.
en: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.

dag: Puhimiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ duumanim zaa Duuma ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the Lord of lords! His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka yi ni ti wurim zo n-kuli yi yinsi ka chɛ ma n ko, amaa m pala n ko, dama m Ba maa be n sani.
en: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu saha kanna ka bɛ ti ku lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: So the time is coming, says the Lord , when people will not make a promise by saying, As surely as the Lord lives, the one who brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt ....

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi n-lab o sapashin tab maa sani ka bɛ ti bɔh o, Alaafee? Ka lan bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka yinyaa maa lee kana ti bɔr a sani? Ka Jɛhu yɛli ba, Yi pun mi o ni o yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: Jehu went back to his officers, and one of them asked, What did that crazy prophet want? Is everything all right? You know him and how he talks, Jehu answered.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa du Galili Teeku maa duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus and his followers went across the lake to the area where the Gerasene people lived.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhiri li ka di lɛbiri li ginda, ni o chɛ ka di tum o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: traveling across the sky.

dag: O daa kul kahigila dimbɔŋɔ gbinni zaa viɛnyɛliŋga wuhi ba. Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni.
en: Then Jesus explained clearly what he meant. Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi nayili pu shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Manasseh died and was buried in the palace garden, the garden of Uzza, and his son Amon succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ pihita la puuni niriba ata daa ti chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni saha shɛli Filistia tɔbbihi ni daa lo tɔbu n-do Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni la.
en: Once David was at the cave of Adullam, and three of the Thirty Heroes went down to meet him by a rock near the cave. At the same time the Philistine army was camped in the Valley of Rephaim.

dag: Ka Aduna daa zaŋ li guui ti kpe niriba maa sunsuuni kaman Musa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa, ka alɔbo maa daa pun lu niriba maa zuɣu, ka o daa niŋ tulaale zim maa pa buɣim maa zuɣu m-mali sara ti niriba maa.
en: Aaron took it as Moses said and ran into the middle of the assembly, for the plague had already begun among the people. He burned incense and sought reconciliation for the people.

dag: Dauda ni daa kpe o yili la ni naai, ka o daa ti yɛli anabi Neetan, Nyama, man bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ din be suɣili ni.
en: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɔri nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa duŋtaabo dirila nyɛvili.
en: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yaakubu daa ti duɣi ʒiɛri, ka Iso yi mɔɣu ni na ka kum wum o pam.
en: One day, when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came home hungry.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Gɛhaazi daa shiri yiɣisi kariti Naaman naba. Ka Naaman daa ti nya ka so zɔri dol o nyaaŋa na, ka o sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli bɔh o, Alaafee.
en: So he hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw Gehazi running after him, he got out of his chariot to meet him. Naaman asked, Is everything all right.

dag: O ni daa ti miri tiŋ maa ni kpɛbu, ka tiŋ maa ni nachimbil so kpi ka bɛ ʒir o yirina, ka tiŋ maa niriba kabiri doli. Kpim maa ma daa nyɛla pakoli; o mi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ pakoli maa bia.
en: As they came near the gate of the town, they saw people carrying out the body of a widow's only son. Many people from the town were walking along with her.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti dana, ti bɔri ni a neela ti nina ŋɔ ti ti.
en: Lord, we want to see, they replied.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni lo ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o o niriba zaa sani.
en: Ill keep the promises I made to the LORD in the presence of all Gods people.

dag: Kaman kuɣikpɛra ni zaŋdi chiriga n-chirigiri binyɛra pari kuɣa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka a ti yɛn zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya, ka zaŋ li taɣili di salima bintaɣindisi ni.
en: Cut the names of the sons of Israel into these stones. Do this the way a worker makes a seal. Put the jewels in gold settings.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka bɛ daa to jina bɔri so shɛli bɛ yɛn doli ku o.
en: From that day on they plotted to kill him.

dag: Toondaannim bɛn tumdi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga simdi ni niriba lihiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga, di bahi bamdi bɛn tumdi waazu yihibu mini wuhibu tuma la.
en: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Asha mini Mikimɛtat din be Shɛkɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka di tintariga bɔbili daa zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Ɛntapuanima.
en: The border of Manasseh ran from Asher to Michmethath, which is opposite Shechem. The border went south to the population of En-tappuah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan kpuɣi Ahinɔam ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la pahi, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa leeg o paɣiba.
en: David had married Ahinoam from Jezreel, and now Abigail also became his wife.

dag: Niŋmi Yawɛ naani ni a suhu zaa, ka miri ka a niŋ amaŋmaŋ milinsi naani.
en: Trust in the Lord with all your heart. Never rely on what you think you know.

dag: Amaa yi yi gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum o yɛligu ka niŋ n ni yɛli ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dindina n ni zaŋ yi dimnim leei n dimnima, ka tuhi bɛn tuhiri ya.
en: But if you obey him and do everything I command, I will fight against all your enemies.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi pam takɔbi n-yɛn ku bɛ zaa, ka bɛ bihi ka bindirigu din ni di n-tiɣi.
en: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yilimiya yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli ti Yaakubu, ka duhiya yi yee m-paɣi ŋuna ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam naa ŋɔ. Molimiya, ka paɣimiy o yɛra, Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: The LORD proclaims: Sing joyfully for the people of Jacob; shout for the leading nation. Raise your voices with praise and call out: The LORD has saved his people, the remaining few in Israel.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun lihiri tiŋgbani ka di sɔhiri ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun shihi zoya, ka di tuɣiri nyɔhi.
en: He looks at the earth, and it trembles; he touches the mountains, and they pour out smoke.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ n-su di fukumsi; ka su teeku puuni zahim mini noonsi ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God blessed them and said to them, Have many children. Fill the earth and take control of it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the air. Rule over every living thing that moves on the earth.

dag: dama dɔbba anu ka a pun kuli ka yi, ka hal a ni na be so yiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gba pala a yidana; dindina a shiri yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Thats because, although you have had five husbands, the man you live with now is not your husband. That much was the truth.

dag: So yi sɔɣi gbaai o Izraɛl kpee n-zaŋ o leei dabili bee n-zaŋ o kɔhi, dindina ŋun gbaag o maa simdi kubu, ka lala chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: If any of you kidnap Israelites and make them your slaves or sell them into slavery, you are to be put to death. In this way your nation will get rid of this evil.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul suhim Naawuni ka o chɛ ka di ku yuui ka n lab yi sanna.
en: Im particularly asking you to do this so that I can be returned to you quickly.

dag: Amaa yinim ni ti mali suhupiɛlli ka yili yila kaman Naawuni chuɣu puhibu dali yuŋ. Yi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn piɛbiri yuhi yiini yila chani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim tampiŋ ŋɔ zoli zuɣu.
en: But you, God's people, will be happy and sing as you do on the night of a sacred festival. You will be as happy as those who walk to the music of flutes on their way to the Temple of the Lord , the defender of Israel.

dag: ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: and he gave this message: This message is from Balaam son of Beor. I am speaking about things I see clearly.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli paya. Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: Next, those under the banner of the division led by the tribe of Ephraim would start out, company by company, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma n wuntitali laara, n ni ka galimi o sani la zuɣu.
en: And so he rewards me because I do what is right, because he knows that I am innocent.

dag: Bɛ daa dala chɛchɛbunsi tuhi pihitanaayi, ka daa lan da Maaka naa min o tɔbbihi pahi, ka bɛ daa kana ti dɔni Mɛdɛba tooni. Ka Ammɔnnim daa yi bɛ tinsi ni na ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Thirty-two thousand troops, as well as the king of Maacah and his army, came and camped near Medeba. The Ammonite troops also left their towns and came to prepare for battle.

dag: ka niŋ tipawumli n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi din tibisa n-zɔri na ni bɛ ti tuh o.
en: They run toward him aggressively, with a massive and strong shield.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yum ayi saha ka o daa ti zahim zahindi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔŋ gom.
en: During Nebuchadnezzars second year as king, he had dreams. They bothered him, and he could not sleep.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yi Tɔfɛt din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o chaŋ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa labina, o daa zanila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni yɛli niriba.
en: When Jeremiah returned from Topheth where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, he stood in the court of the LORDs temple and said to all the people.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Yi yɛda niŋbu bi yaɣi lala.
en: He said to his followers, Why are you afraid? Do you still have no faith.

dag: Bee o yi shihi daadam daɣiri, din dee yi kul nyɛ daɣ shɛlikam din chɛ ka ninsal bi be kasi ka bi baŋ li, o yi ti baŋ li o mali taali.
en: If you unintentionally touch anything of human origin that is unclean, whatever it may be, you are guilty as soon as you realize what you have done.

dag: Niŋmiya siɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinitaba polo, ka miriya ka yi niŋ yi mabia kam naani, dama mabihi zaa nyɛla yɔhindiba, ka ʒiʒiinikpee kam nyɛ ŋun chani saɣindi niriba yuya.
en: Watch your neighbors! Dont trust your own brothers, because every brother is a cheat. Every neighbor talks behind your back.

dag: N ni tooi tam ninvuɣ biɛtali azichi din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi mini bɛ ni mali kuruwabihi shɛŋa zahindi binyara ka niriba galindi ba la yɛla?.
en: In the houses of evil people are treasures which they got dishonestly. They use false measures, a thing that I hate.

dag: ka Yaakubu kɔbiliga daa do nimaani. Di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ na ka di ti wum o, ka o chaŋ ti ʒini kɔbiliga maa gbini ni o vuhi.
en: Jacobs well was there. Jesus was tired from his journey, so he sat down at the well. It was about noon.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi po pɔri, yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: Now if you simply dont make any promises, you wont be guilty of anything.

dag: Bɛ ni mɛri yiya shɛŋa maa ŋmanila tɛri, ka ŋmani puguliba suɣa.
en: The wicked build houses like a spider's web or like the hut of a slave guarding the fields.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Hanna ni, ka o lan dɔɣi bidibis ata mini bipuɣins ayi. Ka Samuɛl daa kul be Yawɛ tooni hal ti zooi.
en: The LORD paid attention to Hannah, and she conceived and gave birth to three sons and two daughters. Meanwhile, the boy Samuel grew up in the LORDs service.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ yɛlima kɔbisiyi. Ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayopɔin.
en: Solomon made gold shields that weighed over three kilograms each.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛlnim daa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-chaŋ ti dɔni Giligal din daa be Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la.
en: The people came up out of the Jordan on the tenth day of the first month. They camped at Gilgal on the east border of Jericho.

dag: Kul kpalimmiya be Naawuni yurilim la puuni, ka guhimiya saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu la.
en: and keep yourselves in the love of God, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ in his mercy to give you eternal life.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Now, you shepherds, listen to what I, the Lord , am telling you.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa wuhi ma, ka m baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa wuhi ma bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: The LORD informed me and I knew. Then he helped me see what they were up to.

dag: Yi ni ti biri, amaa ka ku kpuɣi atam. Yi ni ti kahim olivi kpam, amaa ka ku zaŋ kpam maa ʒe yimaŋa. Yi ni ti tɔɣi wain, amaa ka ku nyu wain maa.
en: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ. Di saha ka ti daa chaŋ ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa.
en: The Lord told me, Now, go to the other side of Zered Valley. So we crossed Zered Valley.

dag: Dauda ni daa ku Filistia doo maa ka labina ka bɛ kuni yiŋa, ka paɣiba daa yi Izraɛl tinsi zaa ni na n-yiini suhupiɛlli yila, ka ŋmɛri biŋkumda ka chaɣisiri chaɣisanim wari waa kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi Naa Sool soli.
en: After David came back from killing the Philistine, and as the troops returned home, women from all of Israels towns came out to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with tambourines, rejoicing, and musical instruments.

dag: Sagbana mini zibisim zaa gil o mi; wuntitali mini zaligu soli n-nyɛ o nam ʒiishee tanzaa.
en: Clouds and darkness surround him; he rules with righteousness and justice.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm; ka niriba booni ba tarimba sɔŋdiba.
en: So Jesus told them: Foreign kings order their people around, and powerful rulers call themselves everyone's friends.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ bɛ daa yɛlimi, Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ din kpɛm pam; ŋuni n-lee ni tooi deei li.
en: Many of his disciples who heard this said, This message is harsh. Who can hear it.

dag: Yi bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli. Yi soya nyɛla sɔgolima, ka ŋunkam zaa dol li ka suhudoo, dama yi ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: You dont know how to live in peace. You dont do what is right and fair. You are crooked, and anyone who lives like that will never know true peace.

dag: ka daa suhi ti Duuma n-yɛli, Nyin ti Duuma ŋun mi niriba zaa suhuri ŋɔ, wuhim ti a ni pii so niriba ayi ŋɔ ni.
en: They prayed, Lord, you know everyones deepest thoughts and desires. Show us clearly which one you have chosen from among these two.

dag: Ka niriba zaa wum di yɛla, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan niŋ tipawumli yaha.
en: All the people will hear about this and be afraid. They wont act arrogantly anymore.

dag: bɛ yi tiri yɛlimaŋgɔba, yi tɛhiya ni ti Duuma bi nyari li?.
en: When justice is perverted in court, he knows.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; dama Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni. Amaa ka Ilaisha gba lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli chana.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, Please stay here, because the Lord told me to go to the Jordan River. Elisha answered, I promise, as the Lord lives and as you live, I will not leave you! So the two men went on.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa bi saɣi shɛli o sani. O bi lihi ba ka bɛ nyɛ shɛli o sani.
en: Compared to God, all the nations of the world are nothing. Compared to him, they are worth nothing at all.

dag: ni Hilikia bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Zadok mini Mɛrayɔt ni Ahitub ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: and Seraiah son of Hilkiah , who was the supervisor in the Temple of God.

dag: N nyɛvili kul bela barina ni sahakam, amaa m bi tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: My life is always in danger, but I have not forgotten your teachings.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa niŋ o nu yin ni, ka kpuɣi zali niŋ o nudirigu ni n-zaŋ tanti kpaa maa ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋa.
en: Then Jael reached out and took a tent peg. Her right hand reached for a workmans hammer. She put the peg against the side of Siseras head and hit it with the hammer.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ gabisi maa vo Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni yihina. Ka Jɛrimia daa kpalim be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni.
en: the men pulled me out. And from then on, I was kept in the courtyard of the palace guards.

dag: A na mi n-kpe bɛ ni zaŋ saa ŋun noli maai pam zali du shɛŋa ni, bee a na mi n-nya bɛ ni zaŋ sakuɣa zali du shɛŋa ni.
en: Have you ever gone into the storerooms where I keep the snow and the hail?.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ maŋdahimbu mali nyɔri shɛli di ni, amaa wuntia soli puuni maŋdahimbu malila nyɔri shɛlikam ni, dama di lo ti nyɛvili alikauli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili saha din ka bahigu puuni.
en: As the saying goes, Exercise is good for your body, but religion helps you in every way. It promises life now and forever. These words are worthwhile and should not be forgotten.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim deei nam maa ti o.
en: After Rehoboam returned to Jerusalem, he decided to attack Israel and regain control of the whole country. So he called together , soldiers from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi ni doli Galili tiŋgbɔŋ polo. Ka o bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o be nimaani.
en: Then Jesus and his followers left there and went through Galilee. Jesus did not want the people to know where they were.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ jɛrigu niŋ tol ni pahi bɛ ni yɛn to shɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ tiliga to o, di zaa yoli, bɛ ku tooi to jɛrilim yih o ni.
en: Even if you beat fools half to death, you still can't beat their foolishness out of them.

dag: Dinzuɣu kamina ka n ti tim a Firawuna sani ka a chaŋ ti yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Now go to the king! I am sending you to lead my people out of his country.

dag: Ka Leeban daa zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha ti Reechɛl gba ni o sɔŋd o.
en: Laban gave his slave woman Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maid.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti labi me tiŋ maa ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi li la Hananɛl Du wɔɣinli la shee hal ti paai Gooŋgɔŋ Dunɔdal la shee.
en: This message is from the Lord , The days are coming when the city of Jerusalem will be rebuilt for the Lord . The whole city will be rebuilt—from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Naawuni zali Vuhim Dabisili dali tila ninsalinima, amaa o bi nam ninsalinim ti Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Jesus finished by saying, People were not made for the good of the Sabbath. The Sabbath was made for the good of people.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka zama maa zaa daa paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Yawɛ maa, ka silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni, ka lu naa sizuura.
en: Then David commanded the people, Praise the Lord your God! And the whole assembly praised the Lord , the God of their ancestors, and they bowed low and gave honor to the Lord and also to the king.

dag: Ka Sɛrafinim daa ʒe o zuɣusaa polo. Bɛ zaa yinoyino daa malila kpiŋkpama ayɔbuyɔbu. Bɛ daa zaŋla diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ nina, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ napɔnvari, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi yiɣira.
en: Winged creatures were stationed around him. Each had six wings: with two they veiled their faces, with two their feet, and with two they flew about.

dag: Ŋunkam maani o kpee ansarisi nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm, amaa yɛndana ŋun kul shinila o noli.
en: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba bɛn ʒe nimaani ni yino lab o tapaɣa ka bɔh o, Lala ka a garigi maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa.
en: As soon as Jesus said this, one of the temple police hit him and said, That's no way to talk to the high priest.

dag: A kul moola a nini lihiri bɔri n shee kaman gbuɣinli la, ka lan tumdi tuma jɛndiri ma.
en: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judianim zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kab chaŋ o sani.
en: People came to John from Jerusalem and the rest of Judea and from all the areas along the Jordan River.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Wummiya, ka kpahi Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu ni yɛli.
en: Listen now, and warn the descendants of Jacob, says the Sovereign Lord Almighty.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa nya Yisifu bihi maa, o daa bɔhimi, Ka banima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: When Israel saw Josephs sons, he said, Who are these.

dag: Hiburɔn yuli piligu ni ha daa nyɛla Kiriatariba; Ariba ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Anakinim ni wɔɣirili. Ka tɔbu daa chɛ tuhibu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the land rested from war.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa mali sara maligunim Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then the king and all the people sacrificed to the LORD.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa ti tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayopɔin saha shɛli, di daa niŋ kaman awa pirigili ka alizanda ni binshɛɣukam kul fomi chichi.
en: When the Lamb broke open the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: Anyone who is not for me is really against me; anyone who does not help me gather is really scattering.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa tim Izraɛlnim maa sani ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka bɛn biŋkɔbigu zaɣ yino gba bi kpi. Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: When the king found out, he was still too stubborn to let the people go.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zuliya bɔbili sunsuuni; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: Lord , that is why I praise you among the nations. That is why I sing songs of praise to your name.

dag: Gbaya anahi daa bela dapaɣa maa lɔŋni; ka gbaya maa spindilinim mi mini binzahi maa nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini, ka gbaya maa zaɣ yini kam dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: The wheels were inches high; they were under the panels, and the axles were of one piece with the carts.

dag: Bɛ puuni ka kuɣ tuuli ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka suɣili kpaa ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka tɔbutuhiri tɔbu ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka zuɣulan kam ti yɛn yina.
en: The cornerstone, the tent peg, the war bow, and the advancing soldiers will all come from Judah together.

dag: Bɛ ni yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, amaa yinima ni kum ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: My servants will shout for joy, but you will cry out in pain. Your spirits will be broken, and you will be very sad.

dag: Zikiri bia Joɛl la n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Hasɛnua bia Juda mi nyɛ zuɣulaan so ŋun pah ayi n-su tiŋ maa fukumsi.
en: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command.

dag: Jɔshua daa yɛla binyɛr daɣiri ʒe malaika maa tooni.
en: Joshua's clothes were filthy.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-kari alizin biɛri maa, ka tib ŋunkam daa biɛra.
en: When evening came, people brought to Jesus many who had demons in them. Jesus drove out the evil spirits with a word and healed all who were sick.

dag: Baŋmiya yi suhuri ni ni nir ni saɣisir o bidibiga shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ gba saɣisiri ya.
en: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa jɛmd a mi; bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a, bɛ yiinila yila paɣir a yuli.
en: Everyone on earth worships you; they sing praises to you, they sing praises to your name.

dag: Ka Naa Ahaz daa wurim tɔroko shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu la naba, ka yihi tahi shɛŋa din tamtam di zuɣu; ka yihi kɔniŋdi bini din daa tam daanya naɣilahi bɛn be di lɔŋni zuɣu n-zaŋ li tam tanzaa kuɣili zuɣu.
en: King Ahaz took apart the bronze carts used in the Temple and removed the basins that were on them. He also took the bronze tank from the backs of the twelve bronze bulls and placed it on a stone foundation.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N suhir a, na di kuli, ka ti gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi niŋ bindirigu ti a.
en: Please, Manoah said, stay here with us for just a little while, and we'll fix a young goat for you to eat.

dag: Ti paɣiba mini ti bihi ni ti piɛri ni buhi ni ti niɣi zaa ni kpalim be Giliad tinsi maa ni.
en: Our children, wives, livestock, and all of our animals will remain in the cities of Gilead.

dag: Bɛ ni pam daa yɛlimi, Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu! O kpɛla yinyari! Bɔzuɣu ka yi wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Many of them were saying, He has a demon! He is crazy! Why do you listen to him.

dag: Di ni kpamba kul ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka di sariakaritiba be kaman zaawuni kunduna bɛn bi guuri binshɛli zaana hal ni asiba la.
en: Its officials are like roaring lions; its judges are like hungry wolves, too greedy to leave a bone until morning.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti ni o ti ʒini nimaani n-niŋ daba ayi, dama kum maa daa miiya pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The crops failed, and there was no food anywhere in Canaan. So Abram and his wife Sarai went to live in Egypt for a while. But just before they got there, Abram said, Sarai, you are really beautiful!.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan n-zaŋd o nuu timdi laa ni hal ka bi bɔri ni o ŋmaai bindirigu ti kpar o nol ni.
en: Some people are too lazy to put food in their own mouths.

dag: O tuumba pinaayi maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru ni Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn ni.
en: Here are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, who is called Peter; and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee; and John his brother.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni ʒiɛm tuma biɛla dabisili? Niriba yi ti nya tammɛri bimbuɣisirigu Zɛrubabɛl nuu ni, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Firilanima ayopɔin la wuhirila Yawɛ nina din lihiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa la.
en: The angel said to me, The seven lamps are the seven eyes of the Lord , which see all over the earth. They are disappointed because so little progress is being made. But they will see Zerubbabel continuing to build the Temple, and they will be glad.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, amaa ka daari ninvuɣ biɛri luhira.
en: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yi wuhiri ya soli, dindina yi lan pala bɛn be fukumsi zaligu la sulinsi ni.
en: If the Spirit leads you, then you are not subject to the Law.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Jɛzibɛl mi polo, Naawuni yɛliya, Bahi ni ŋub o Jɛziriil tiŋ puuni.
en: And concerning Jezebel, the Lord says that dogs will eat her body in the city of Jezreel.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa yila Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o niriba daa ku ba.
en: These Philistine men were sons of the giants from the town of Gath. David and his servants killed those giants.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim polo shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Uzia mini Jɔtam ni Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni n-daa bala.
en: This is the vision of Isaiah son of Amoz. God showed Isaiah what would happen to Judah and Jerusalem. Isaiah saw this during the time when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.

dag: dama pa yinima nti yɛn tɔɣisi, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni Shia n-yɛn be yi ni tɔɣisira.
en: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni shɛb dolila Balaam wuhibu. Ŋuna n-daa wuhi Balak ka o bo kuɣituurili sɔŋ Izraɛlnim sol zuɣu ni bɛ di buɣa maligu nimdi ka tum zina la.
en: But I have a few things against you. You have people there who follow the teaching of Balaam. Balaam taught Balak how to make the people of Israel sin. They sinned by eating food offered to idols and by committing sexual sins.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Anabi Joɛl ni daa yɛli shɛm la. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Rather, this is what was spoken through the prophet Joel.

dag: ni Bɛtilɛbaut ni Sharuhɛn: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaata m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Beth Lebaoth, and Sharuhen: thirteen cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Daadam Bia labina ni o nam.
en: I assure you that there are some here who will not die until they have seen the Son of Man come as King.

dag: Pa omaŋmaŋa n-yɛli ma ni o nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa? Ka paɣ maa maŋmaŋ gba yɛli ma ni o nyɛla o tizɔdoo. M bi tum taali n tɛha ni, ka mi bi zaŋ n nuhi tum taal shɛli.
en: Abraham himself said that she was his sister, and she said the same thing. I did this with a clear conscience, and I have done no wrong.

dag: Yisa daa ti be o nyaandoliba tooni ka bɛ yi soli chani Jɛrusalɛm, ka di gar o nyaandoliba maa pam; ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛn zaa dol o maa. Ka o lan zaŋ bɛ pinaayi maa yi kpaŋa nti piligi wuhiri ba yɛl shɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ o.
en: The disciples were confused as Jesus led them toward Jerusalem, and his other followers were afraid. Once again, Jesus took the twelve disciples aside and told them what was going to happen to him. He said:.

dag: ka kana ni nti chɛ ka a baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ a niriba dahin shɛli ha. Dahin shɛli ha yɛla ʒii m-bala.
en: I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the future. This is a vision about the future.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yisa daa yi yiŋ chaŋ ti ʒini teeku duli.
en: That same day Jesus left the house and went to the lakeside, where he sat down to teach.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa zaa daa kana ti gar o zuɣu, ka Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim ni Gaatinim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa doli naa yi Gaat la na zaa daa gar o tooni.
en: Then David stood there and watched while his regular troops and his bodyguards marched past. The last group was the soldiers who had followed him from Gath. Their commander was Ittai.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida dari ti ma, ka n chɛ ka n tumtumdiba kana ti pah a tumtumdiba maa zuɣu, ka n yo a a ni zali ni n yo a tumtumdiba maa zuɣu shɛm; dama a mi ni so ka ti ni m-mi dakuɣiri ŋmabu kaman Sidɔnnima.
en: So send your men to Lebanon to cut down cedars for me. My men will work with them, and I will pay your men whatever you decide. As you well know, my men don't know how to cut down trees as well as yours do.

dag: Amaa a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu, n ni tooi kpe a jɛmbu duu nti gbani a duu din be kasi maa puuni ni sizuura.
en: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord , and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.

dag: A bɔhiya, N wuntitali maa nyɔri lee nyɛ dini? Ka n ni bi tum alahichi maa, di nyɔri lee nyɛ ma dini.
en: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa ka yi ti taɣi yi tɛha, ka bi lan tiri n yuli jilima, ka yi ni yino kam lan zaŋ yi ni daa bahi yi dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bɛ cham bɛ chandi kaman bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm la n-lan leei yi daba yaha.
en: But now you have changed your minds. You have shown that you do not honor my name because each of you has taken back the male and female slaves that you had set free. You have forced them to become slaves again.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ yi niŋ ti mahili ŋ-ŋɔ, ka di yi kuui, wula ka di ni be.
en: For if such things as these are done when the wood is green, what will happen when it is dry.

dag: Yi yi po pɔri ni yi niŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, yin di pihigi di palibu, dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɔhi di niŋbu yɛla yi sani ka di chɛ ka yi ku tum taali.
en: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord , then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.

dag: Kpɛmiya tampima voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni saha shɛl o yi ti kana ni o ti dam dunia ŋɔ.
en: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.

dag: Saimɔn Pita mini Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la ni Nataniɛl ŋun daa yi Kɛna din be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la ni Zɛbidii bihi la m-pahi nyaandoliba ayi n-daa laɣim taba.
en: Simon Peter, Thomas , Nathanael , the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples of Jesus were all together.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi li ka di leei Naawuni chuɣu yuuni puuni. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka di simdi ka yi gbib li la gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa ni.
en: Celebrate it for seven days. This regulation is to be kept by your descendants for all time to come.

dag: N yuri bɛn yuri ma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ma ni nimmoo nyari ma.
en: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ mi bɛ yudua mini bɛ barikuma nyubu ni bɛ ʒiri tuma yɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But I also know bragging will never save you.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali bimparilani, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi pa di zuɣu yɛli, O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani. Chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la.
en: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: Dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋ maa yiya pia kam puuni zaɣ yini lu, ka ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin daa kpi tiŋgbani dambu maa ni, ka dabiɛm gbahi bɛn kpalim, ka bɛ ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: At that same time there was a great earthquake. A tenth of the city was destroyed. And people were killed in the earthquake. Those who did not die were very afraid. They gave glory to the God of heaven.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka ti be barina ni sahakam?.
en: And as for us—why would we run the risk of danger every hour?.

dag: O bidibisi maa daa yi chanila tab yinsi ti puhiri churi sokam dabisili dali, ka daa yi timdi booni bɛ tizɔpaɣiba maa na ka bɛ mini ba ti diri ka nyura.
en: Job's sons used to take turns giving a feast, to which all the others would come, and they always invited their three sisters to join them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Hazɛrɔt saha shɛli maa ka Miriam mini Aduna daa galim Musa o ni daa kpuɣi Itiɔpia paɣ so la zuɣu, dama o daa kpuɣila Itiɔpia zuliya ni paɣa.
en: Miriam and Aaron began to talk against Moses. They criticized him because he married an Ethiopian woman.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛlnim daa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-chaŋ ti dɔni Giligal din daa be Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la.
en: The people crossed the Jordan River on the tenth day of the first month and camped at Gilgal, east of Jericho.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpahimiya yi nuhi, ka zaŋ yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yɛra: Mbaye! Izraɛlnim ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛli din chihiri la zuɣu. Dama bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ shɛba, ka kum ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka alɔbo mi ti di bɛ shɛba.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Clap your hands, stamp your feet, and cry Horror over all the detestable practices of the house of Israel. They will fall by the sword, famine, and plague.

dag: Kpambaliba bɛn be di ni ŋmanila kunduna n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa, ka kuri niriba ni bɛ doli bibiɛlim soya nya buni.
en: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi be kaman nɛl la. N ni chɛ ka yi nyina nyɛ zaɣ pala ka dira. Yi ni niɛm zoya n-wurim li, ka niŋ daboya kaman wurigu la.
en: Look, I have made you like a new threshing board with many sharp teeth. You will trample mountains and crush them. You will make the hills like chaff.

dag: Kpahimmiya m-baŋ yi galimi ni yi shɛl na, ka niŋ tuuba n-lan lab yi tuuli yurilim la ni yaha. Di yi pa lala n ni kana nti kpuɣi yi firilatamdigu la di zaashee.
en: Think how far you have fallen! Turn from your sins and do what you did at first. If you don't turn from your sins, I will come to you and take your lampstand from its place.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lihi lzraɛlnim maa, ka baŋ ni bɛ be muɣisigu ni.
en: God looked at the Israelites, and God understood.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn kalinli pɔri ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama di nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni o tin ya nam.
en: Dont fear, little flock. Your Father wants to share his kingdom with you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi gbaai bɛ tuuli chandi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba shɛm.
en: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namba. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Don't let your sobbing be heard. Do not go bareheaded or barefoot as a sign of mourning. Don't cover your face or eat the food that mourners eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bihi, wummiya n yɛligu ka di zaɣisiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Now, my sons, listen to me. Dont forget the words I say.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi Naawuni kaman Naawuni maa zuɣu ka o chɛ ba bahi, ka bɛ tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri ka tumdi din chihiri tumbu.
en: Since they didnt think it was worthwhile to acknowledge God, God abandoned them to a defective mind to do inappropriate things.

dag: A me dunia tamla di tanzaa zuɣu, ka shɛli kul ku tooi dam li sahakam.
en: You have set the earth firmly on its foundations, and it will never be moved.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk, A ka takɔbi bee kpani kpe n-zaŋ ti ma? Dama naa tuma maa ni bɔri yomyom shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka m bi tooi zaŋ n takɔbi bee m bidibbin shɛli.
en: David said to Ahimelech, Do you have a spear or a sword you can give me? The king's orders made me leave in such a hurry that I didn't have time to get my sword or any other weapon.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ yi niŋ ti mahili ŋ-ŋɔ, ka di yi kuui, wula ka di ni be.
en: If this can happen to someone who is good, what will happen to those who are guilty? .

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Bɛrishiiba n-zaŋ kpa Haran polo.
en: Jacob left Beersheba and went to Haran.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli.
en: Then that servant's master will come back one day when the servant does not expect him and at a time he does not know.

dag: Bina anahi m-beni damdi dunia ŋɔ, ka di ku tooi deei li. Dina n-nyɛ:.
en: There are three things that make trouble on the earth—really, four that the earth cannot bear:.

dag: M mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma ni. Di pala yɛl tibisili n sani ni n lab sabi n ni daa pun sab yɛl shɛŋa tin ya la n-lan tin ya, dama di nyɛla din ni gbibi ya.
en: And now, my brothers and sisters, be filled with joy in the Lord. It is no trouble for me to write the same things to you again. I want to be sure that you are prepared.

dag: di simdi ni yi bo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu din nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaligu ni wuhi anzinfa laɣibaligu shɛm tariga.
en: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di lihibu daa mali dabiɛm hal ka Anabi Musa ti yɛli, N ni sɔhirimi dabiɛm zuɣu.
en: What they saw was so terrible that Moses said, I am shaking with fear.

dag: N kul ni yiini yila yɛr a yɛligu yɛla, dama a zaligunim zaa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: I will sing about your law, because your commands are just.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin din kanna puuni, bindira ni niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: For seven years Egypt will have more than enough grain.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nina neei, ka o nya ka kɔbiliga doya, ka o daa chaŋ di ni nti tooi kom pal o kom koligu maa na nti booi li ti bia maa ka o nyu.
en: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well. She went over, filled the water flask, and gave the boy a drink.

dag: Ka Jɛrikɔnim daa me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Imri bia Zakur daa me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: The men of Jericho built the next section. Zaccur son of Imri built the next section.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan nya ka Yɛhudianim kpuɣila Ashidɔdnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Mɔabnim bipuɣinsi n-niŋ bɛ paɣiba.
en: In those days I also noticed that some Jewish men had married women from the countries of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sidɔn, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni nya jilima a ni. N yi kar a saria a ni, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira a ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and tell its people: I, the Lord God, am your enemy! People will praise me when I punish you, and they will see that I am holy.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ ti ni daa nya wahala shɛli Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla; di daa nyɛla wahala din ka buɣisibu, hal ka ti daa yihi bebu tahima gba.
