en: Brothers and sisters, we want you to know about the trouble we suffered in Asia. We had great burdens there, which were greater than our own strength. We even gave up hope for life.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu, dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋkpansi nti da bindira di.
en: That evening his disciples came and said to him, This is an isolated place and its getting late. Send the crowds away so they can go into the villages and buy food for themselves.

dag: Ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam, dama yɛtɔɣa maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ tuhi piapia ti Dauda, ka zaŋla tuhilituhili ti m mi, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ka pa ni n nam ŋɔ ka o yɛn deei.
en: This song made Saul very angry, and he thought, They are saying that David has killed ten times more enemies than I ever did. Next they will want to make him king.

dag: Amaa dabili maa yi zani yim yɛli, N yuri n dana maa mini m paɣa ni m bihi, dinzuɣu n ku chaŋ.
en: However, if the slave clearly states, I love my master, my wife, and my children, and I dont want to go free.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla, ka malila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini kɔŋko bɛ ŋariŋ ni.
en: The followers had only one loaf of bread with them in the boat. They forgot to bring more bread.

dag: Sagbani maa mini teeku maa ni ka bɛ zaa daa deei baptaizibu din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yi yi ku wum n ni yɛli shɛm, Naawuni ni chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ tinzun yɛtɔɣa wuhi ya.
en: With derisive speech and a foreign tongue, he will speak to this people.

dag: Dama yi ni so yi yɛli, Man dolila Pool; ka so mi yɛli, N dolila Apolɔs; di yi nyɛ lala, yi gba bi bemi kaman dunianima?.
en: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?.

dag: A zo yi ti a dansi di mali daliri, amaa a dim ŋun kul yɛn mɔɣisirila a kpariŋ bushɛm.
en: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, ti di nasara yaɣi Masia ŋun yuri ti la zuɣu.
en: No, in all these things we have complete victory through him who loved us!.

dag: Ka Makiri daa bo paɣiba ti Hupim mini Shupim. O tizɔpaɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka. O bidib so ŋun daa pahi ayi n-daa nyɛ Zɛlɔfɛhad, ŋun daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi noli.
en: Machir married Huppite and Shuppite women. His sisters name was Maacah. The second descendants name was Zelophehad, who had only daughters.

dag: zaŋ tabili tiŋkpan shɛŋa zaa din gil li zaŋ hal ti paai Baalatibeer . Simiɔn zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: This included all the towns around these cities as far as Baalath Beer , in the south. This was the land which the families of the tribe of Simeon received as their possession.

dag: N daa gbihimi, amaa ka n suhu lee ne. Wumma, n yura n-kpahiri n dunoli maa. N yura ni n tizɔpaɣa, yoomi ka n kpɛna. N ŋmani ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi. Maligim lumi mahigi n zuɣu, ka yuŋ paɣili kpe m-mahigi n zabiri.
en: I was sleeping, but my heart was awake. A sound! My love is knocking: Open for me, my sister, my dearest, my dove, my perfect one! My head is soaked with dew, my hair, with the night mists.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni ti ti suhudoo; dama yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-chɛ ka ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You will give us peace, Lord , because everything we have done was by your power.

dag: Lɛmuɛl, wumma, di bi simdi ni nanim nyuri wain bee ka nanim chɛ ka bɛ kɔre be dam din kpɛm nyubu ni.
en: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ tiligi n shia kum ni, ka nyɛhi n nintam, ka tiligi n naba tuubu ni.
en: Lord, you saved my soul from death. You stopped my tears. You kept me from falling.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi Bɔzira din be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ye binyɛr ʒee kanna ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ye binyɛr viɛlli n-kanna ni yiko ni o kpiɔŋ ŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun mali yiko ka ni tooi tiligi niriba la n-kanna ni o ti mol o nasara dibu la molo.
en: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah in bright red garments, this splendidly dressed one, striding with great power? It is I, proclaiming righteousness, powerful to save!.

dag: Yi bi yɛli ni di kpalim chira anahi ni puu atam kpuɣibu? Amaa n yɛri ya mi, kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi puri ni, di daatam maa biya zaa, ka di kpalimla chɛbu.
en: You have a saying, Four more months and then the harvest. But I tell you, take a good look at the fields; the crops are now ripe and ready to be harvested!.

dag: Tibikpara viɛl a tapaɣisi zuɣu ka nyiŋgokɔriti viɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Your hair is beautiful upon your cheeks and falls along your neck like jewels.

dag: O ni daa niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni saha shɛli maa ka o daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni.
en: As he was blessing them, he departed from them and was taken up into heaven.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛla gbaai dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam dabiɛm, Hɛzɛkia bia Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa la ni daa tum shɛm Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu.
en: Because of what Judahs King Manasseh, Hezekiahs son, has done in Jerusalem, I will make them an object of horror to all nations on earth.

dag: Ka ti daa ti yiɣisi ni n-yi biɛɣu paai Kiɔs n-naanyi yi biɛɣu paai Samɔs n-kaai biɛɣu paai Milɛtus.
en: We sailed from there and arrived off Chios the next day. A day later we came to Samos, and the following day we reached Miletus.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa nanima ayi maa ni ti laɣim ʒini n-di, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu tɛha din be bɛ suhuri ni zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim taba. Ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛm mi ti ku niŋ, dama di saha na bi paai.
en: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa suhi ti Naawuni maa, ka bo niriba zali gu ba wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: but we prayed to our God and kept men on guard against them day and night.

dag: O daa mali nyolɔrigu ka di be kaman bɛ ni daa she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm la. Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: They made the embroidered chest pendant in the style of the vest, using gold, blue, purple, and deep red yarns, and fine twisted linen.

dag: Ka o daa kpabigi li n tooni, di daa sabila di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa. Ka sabbu din daa be di ni daa nyɛla fabila mini kuyila ni mbusim.
en: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.

dag: Ka Hadad daa ti kpi, ka Samla ŋun daa nyɛ Masirɛka nir la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Hadad died, Samlah ruled that country. Samlah was from Masrekah.

dag: Yuuni puuni gol so ŋun be tooni biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka n daa ʒe Tigiris Mɔɣ tital la duli.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month of the year I was standing on the bank of the mighty Tigris River.

dag: Di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisiri yomyom, dama jɛra suhuri ni ka suhuyiɣisili be.
en: Dont be too quick to get angry because anger lives in the fools heart.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli Ziɔn, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi dama di nyɛla tin shɛli Zallakudura Naa ni daa zali.
en: Of Zion it will be said that all nations belong there and that the Almighty will make her strong.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa yi tɔb maa ni kuni ka zaŋ doli yi Hɛrɛs kunkuni polo.
en: When Gideon was returning from the battle by way of Heres Pass.

dag: bɛna n-ni tiligi. Bɛ biɛhigu shee ni ti nyɛla zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣibu shee ti nyɛ kuɣa birininim puuni, ka bɛ ti tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: Then you will be safe; you will be as secure as if in a strong fortress. You will have food to eat and water to drink.

dag: Paɣ ŋuni pul ni ka maasim kpikpikpi lee yina? Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi ko shɛli din kilim yiri alizanda ni na ŋɔ?.
en: Who is the mother of the ice and the frost.

dag: Ka di daa muɣis o pam asibaasi, ka o tim ti boli Ijipti timanim mini baŋdiba zaa na, ka ŋun Firawuna daa yɛli ba o zahima maa, amaa ka so daa kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi Firawuna o zahima maa gbinni.
en: The next morning Pharaoh was worried about these dreams, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told these men the dreams, but none of them could explain the dreams.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kumiya dɔbba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: Heres what you should do: Exterminate every man and every woman who has slept with a man.

dag: M pun yɛli ya di yɛla zali ka di wɔɣa pɔi ka di naanyi ti niŋ maa ni di chɛ ka yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi wuna bee yi dari binnana mini anzinfa binnana n-niŋ li.
en: And so I predicted your future long ago, announcing events before they took place, to keep you from claiming that your idols and images made them happen.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛli Tama, Zaŋmi bindirigu maa kpɛhi n dugbɛrili puuni nti gbib li a nuu ni ka n di. Ka Tama daa zaŋ o ni mali mahi shɛŋa maa kpɛh o tizɔdoo Amnɔn dugbɛrili maa ni.
en: Then Amnon said to Tamar, Bring the food into the bedroom and feed me by hand. So Tamar took the cakes she had made and went into her brothers bedroom.

dag: N kahigi n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi; n suhu saɣimya n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: I confess my sins; they fill me with anxiety.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka o daa paɣi bɛ fiɛbbu dansi la, ka Pool mini Silas daa baptaizi dansarika gula maa min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: Right then, in the middle of the night, the jailer welcomed them and washed their wounds. He and everyone in his household were immediately baptized.

dag: Dama Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili wain din mali kpiɔŋ pam pipia m-be o nuu ni kpeera, ka o booi li ni o ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri zaa ka bɛ nyu li hal ti naai di zaa kahikahi.
en: The Lord holds a cup in his hand, filled with the strong wine of his anger. He pours it out, and all the wicked drink it; they drink it down to the last drop.

dag: O niŋgbuŋ kul kpɛla tab ni, di kpɛmmi kirikiri, ka so ku tooi dam li.
en: The folds of his flesh stick together; on him they are tough and unyielding.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa mali shili n-kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni chaŋ Goshɛn ni o ti nya o ba Izraɛl. Bɛ ni daa ti nya taba, ka Yisifu chaŋ o sani nti zaŋ o nuhi m-bɔb gbaag o ba n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu n-kum yuui.
en: Joseph hitched up his chariot and went to meet his father Israel in Goshen. When he arrived, he threw his arms around his neck and wept, embracing him for a long time.

dag: ni Abialibɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Araba nir la ni Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Bahurim nir la.
en: Abi-albon from the desert plain; Azmaveth from Bahurim.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asiba ka Jɔnatan zaŋ bia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni kaman o mini Dauda ni daa pun tɔɣisi shɛm la.
en: In the morning, Jonathan went out to the field for the meeting with David, and a young servant boy went with him.

dag: Ti daa wolisirimi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu, amaa ka ti lee bi dɔɣi shɛli. Ti bi di nasara; ti mi bi dɔɣi so ni o zani ti zaani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.

dag: Miriya daadamnima! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: Watch out for people—because they will hand you over to councils and they will beat you in their synagogues.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi nini tiɣi yi yɛm pam, ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla yɛnnima.
en: Doom to those who consider themselves wise, who think of themselves as clever.

dag: ni Dibɔn ni Nɛbo ni Bɛtidibilateem.
en: Dibon, Nebo, Beth Diblathaim.

dag: Do so yi niŋ marisamarisa n-zaŋ paɣipiɛl so bɛ ni bi zaŋ ti doo dɔni, di simdi ka o yo paɣ maa paɣibɔr liɣiri zaa, ka kpuɣ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: If a man seduces a virgin who is not engaged, he must pay the bride price for her and marry her.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna yɛra, Yinima n-ku Yawɛ niriba maa.
en: The next day all the Israelites complained against Moses and Aaron. They said, You killed the Lord s people.

dag: Ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Sool lo o la zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu, ka daa yɛli Abiata ŋun nyɛ maligumaana maa, Zaŋmi tan la na.
en: David learned that Saul was making plans against him. David then said to Abiathar the priest, Bring the ephod.

dag: dama pa yinima nti yɛn tɔɣisi, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni Shia n-yɛn be yi ni tɔɣisira.
en: It will not really be you speaking; the Spirit of your Father will be speaking through you.

dag: Kamiyana pumpɔŋɔ ka ti ku o n-zaŋ o ti bahi bɔɣa ŋɔ zaɣ yin ni, ka yɛli ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o ŋubi, ka ti nya o ni zahim zahin shɛŋa maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: Let's kill him and throw him into a pit and say that some wild animal ate him. Then we'll see what happens to those dreams.

dag: Di saha ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa daa yɛli o suhu ni, N dana yi yihi ma o tuma ŋɔ ni, wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N lan ka yaa din ni tooi tum tuun kpɛma, ka mi zɔri vi ni m mali bara.
en: The household manager said to himself, What will I do now that my master is firing me as his manager? Im not strong enough to dig and too proud to beg.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi gba chamiya m puu ŋɔ ni ha ti tum tuma, ka n ti yɔn ya din niŋ kamaata.
en: He said to them, You also go into the vineyard, and Ill pay you whatever is right.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so maa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi baŋ ti chɔɣinsi yɛla ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa nya zahimbu kaman ti gba ni nyari zahimbu shɛm, amaa o daa bi tum alahichi di puuni.
en: Our High Priest is not one who cannot feel sympathy for our weaknesses. On the contrary, we have a High Priest who was tempted in every way that we are, but did not sin.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi niriba maa, ka bɛ zaa lab kuli bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Then Joshua sent the people away, and everyone returned to their own part of the land.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai luɣ shɛli ka wuntaŋ lu ka o kpalim gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ. O daa piila kuɣ yini nimaani sɔŋ n-dɔni zaŋ o zuɣu kuɣ li gbihi.
en: He reached a certain place and spent the night there. When the sun had set, he took one of the stones at that place and put it near his head. Then he lay down there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka tia kam din lihibu viɛla ka simdi dibu bili yi tiŋgban ni na. Ka nyɛvili tia mini tia din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu gba daa be puu maa sunsuuni.
en: Then the Lord God caused all the beautiful trees that were good for food to grow in the garden. In the middle of the garden, he put the tree of life and the tree that gives knowledge about good and evil.

dag: yin ti piimiya yi ni yɛn tuui kpuɣi puu atam shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni zaa niŋ piɛri puuni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli ni o yuli be nimaani la.
en: take some of the early produce of the fertile ground that you have harvested from the land the LORD your God is giving you, and put it in a basket. Then go to the location the LORD your God selects for his name to reside.

dag: Biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka zibisim zo la, n yura, nyin ŋmaligim niŋ kaman molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ la n-zo n-yi Bɛtɛr zoya zuɣu na.
en: until the morning breezes blow and the darkness disappears. Return, my darling, like a gazelle, like a stag on the mountains of Bether.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya Masia niŋ yi suhuri ni ka o nyɛ yi Duuma. Ka kul malimiya shili guri ni yi garigi ŋunkam bɔhi ya bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni mali tahima shɛli yi ni la polo.
en: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, ka so daa kani n-nyɛ dabili bee bilichina ka bi nya nahiŋgu ŋɔ; ka so mi daa kani din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord saw the terrible suffering of the Israelites; there was no one at all to help them.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa piligi galindi tin shɛŋa nim bɛn daa nya o daalahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa o ni daa tum bɛ tinsi ni ka bɛ bi niŋ tuuba la.
en: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:.

dag: Ka yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo hal ni Gatihɛfa m-mali hal ni Ɛtikazin nti ŋmaligi kpa Niya polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Rimɔn.
en: From there it passed on the east side, running eastward to Gath-hepher and Eth-kazin. Going to Rimmon, it bent toward Neah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Bɔ ka n niŋ? Pa bɔhigu yini kɔŋko ka m bɔhi.
en: Now what have I done? David asked. Can't I even ask a question.

dag: Sintani daa pun niŋ tɛha niŋ Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la suhu ni ni o yi Yisa nyaaŋa. Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti laɣim diri yuŋ bindirigu saha shɛli.
en: Jesus and his followers were at the evening meal. The devil had already persuaded Judas Iscariot to hand Jesus over to his enemies.

dag: N Duuma, n nyɛla faralana ni nandana; amaa a bi tam n yɛla. N Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira. Niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: But me? Im weak and needy. Let my Lord think of me. You are my help and my rescuer. My God, dont wait any longer!.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zaŋ tuhi Juda Naa Amazia la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Joashs deeds, all that he accomplished, and his powerful acts—how he fought against Judahs King Amaziah—arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Kulla niriba biɛla n-daa yi Asha zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni n-siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: But, some men from the areas of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.

dag: O daa ku Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Sihon, the Amorite king— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa boli nimaani yuli, Yawɛ ni tahi na. Ka niriba na kul booni li lala hal ni zuŋɔ. Yawɛ zol la zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni tahi na.
en: Abraham named that place the LORD sees. That is the reason people today say, On this mountain the LORD is seen.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa nti kɔŋ gom dindali maa yuŋ. O daa bi di shɛli bee n-saɣi ka so ŋme biŋkumdi shɛli n-niŋ o.
en: The king then went home to his palace and fasted through the night. No pleasures were brought to him, and he couldnt sleep.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun daŋ Jɛbusinim ŋɔ kubu ni leei toondana, ka lan leei sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɔab ŋun nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa daŋ chaŋ, ka daa leei toondana.
en: David said, The one who leads the attack on the Jebusites will become the commander over all my army. So Joab led the attack. He was Zeruiahs son. Joab became the commander of the army.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku tiŋgbani leei zaɣ kuŋ, ka o niriba daa chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu mɔɣili tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du. Ka ti daa mali suhupiɛlli o sani nimaani.
en: He turned the sea into dry land so they could cross the river on foot. Right there we rejoiced in him!.

dag: Bɛ naɣ zaŋdi li mi maani buɣim. Ka di zuɣu polo mini di nyoya polo yi di buɣim ka chɛ di sunsuuni ka di leei sala doya, di ni tooi lan ku buchi yaha?.
en: It is only good for building a fire. And when the ends are burned up and the middle is charred, can you make anything out of it?.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, M Ba kul tumdimi, ka n gba tumda.
en: But he said to them, My Father never stops working, and so I work too.

dag: Chɛ ka naa maa yuli ku kpi, ka chɛ ka o yul kul beni kaman wuntaŋ ni beni shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa nya alibarika o zuɣu. Ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa bol o alibarika naa.
en: May the king be famous forever. May people remember his name as long as the sun shines. May all nations be blessed through him, and may they all bless him.

dag: Niriba daa mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa gba la Rɛfaim, dama Rɛfaimnima n-daa pun be nimaani, amaa Ammɔnnim daa yi booni ba la Zamzumimnima.
en: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi ka ku Yisa.
en: The chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask Pilate to set Barabbas free and have Jesus put to death.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindira bɛ sani di, ka lan zaŋ liɣiri da kom bɛ sani nyu.
en: Of course you may buy food from them with money so you can eat, and also water with money so you can drink.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo faralan maa piɛr anahi, o ni tum shɛm maa min o ni bi zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: For having done such a cruel thing, he must pay back four times as much as he took.

dag: Dinzuɣu cheechi zaa yi ti laɣim ka sokam tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka bɛn ka yi kalinli ni mini bɛn bi niŋ yɛda kpɛna, bɛ ku yɛli ni yi kpɛla yinyari?.
en: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?.

dag: So shɛli daa be duri maa tiŋa, ka nira ni tooi yi dundɔntitali ni wulimpuhili polo n-dol li kpe duri maa ni.
en: These chambers were entered from the outer courtyard at the end of the courtyard wall, because the entrance was at the end of the chambers at the east. South of the yard and the building, there were more chambers with a passage.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka chɛ ka bɛ kuli.
en: Then Joshua blessed them. He sent them away, and they went home.

dag: A mini bɛn laɣim tum tuma a bilim ni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni yɛn tooi niŋ shɛli ti a zaa m-bala. Bɛ zaa ni chɛ a ka zaŋ kpa bɛ ni chani shɛli polo, ka bɛ so ku tooi tilig a.
en: Those with whom you have wearied yourself are like this, those with whom you were in business from your youth: each has wandered off on their own way; none will save you.

dag: ka yɛli o suhu ni, N ka luɣ shɛli din yɛn zaŋ m bindira ŋɔ sɔŋ, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ?.
en: He said to himself, What will I do? I have no place to store my harvest!.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa lan ka o sanna pahi buyi kaman o ni daa pun ka o sanna shɛm Gibiɔn la.
en: the LORD appeared to him a second time in the same way he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

dag: Ka Amasa daa zaŋ Judanim maa zaa suhuri laɣim taba ka bɛ be kaman ninvuɣ yino la, ka daa tim ti yɛli Naa A min a kpamba zaa labimina.
en: So he won over the hearts of everyone in Judah as though they were one person, and they sent word to the king: Come back—you and all your servants.

dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kana ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ ni ti pie tab zani liri li n-ŋme n-deei li. Bɛ piɛma tɔbu ŋmanila tɔbbi yɛndaan so ŋun na ʒi n-to n-ziŋ.
en: In the north I am bringing great nations together. They will attack Babylon and capture it. The arrows they shoot are like the best soldiers, always finding their target.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi zaɣis a zaligu dolibu di chɛrimi ka n suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.

dag: Ka o daa lan nya ka Yaakubu deeg o ba min o ma noli ka shiri kuli Mɛsopoteemia.
en: and that he had obeyed his father and mother.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a fɔh a nuu ka chɛ ti, hal ka di nyɛla a nudirigu gba? Yihim a nuhi a jɔɣu ni na m-bahi ba yoli.
en: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Hanna ni, ka o lan dɔɣi bidibis ata mini bipuɣins ayi. Ka Samuɛl daa kul be Yawɛ tooni hal ti zooi.
en: The Lord did bless Hannah, and she had three more sons and two daughters. The boy Samuel grew up in the service of the Lord .

dag: Izraɛl yaɣili polɔnima: Parɔsh daŋ ni: Ramia mini Izia ni Malikija ni Mijamin ni Ɛliɛza ni Malikija so mi ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Of Israel: of the family of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah.

dag: Ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam, Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba polo nim zaa daa baŋ ni Samuɛl nyɛla Yawɛ daanabi maŋli.
en: From the town of Dan in the north to the town of Beersheba in the south, everyone in the country knew that Samuel was truly the Lord 's prophet.

dag: Cham biŋkɔbiri la sani ti gbahi bubihi pol ayi ti ma na ka n zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli a ba ni yuri pam;.
en: Go and kill two of your best young goats and bring them to me. I'll cook the tasty food that your father loves so much.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n suhu piɛla, ka m paɣiri Naawuni pam. Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, n niŋgbuŋ gba mali tahima;.
en: Therefore, my heart was glad and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover, my body will live in hope, .

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi, bɛ kanimina nti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: Those evil men are like dogs that come into town in the evening, growling and roaming the streets.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ o bia Yisahaku mali sara bimbini zuɣu la, pa o tuma tumbu zuɣu ka o daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani?.
en: Our father Abraham was made right with God by what he did. He offered his son Isaac to God on the altar.

dag: Di yi pa lala, n ni chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ puuni n-lir a min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa. A yiŋ mini Ijipti yili kam ni ti palila zɔhi; ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa gba ni ti palila zɔhi.
en: If you refuse to let my people go, Ill send swarms of insects on you, your officials, your people, and your houses. All Egyptian houses will be filled with swarms of insects and also the ground that they cover.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi Judanim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihinahinaanu daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ. Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: In Nebuchadnezzars rd year as king, Nebuzaradan took people of Judah into captivity. Nebuzaradan was the commander of the kings special guards. In all, people were taken captive.

dag: Dauda daa lan zali Lɛvi kpamba maa ni bɛ bom bɛ daŋ maa ni baansi mini biŋkumdiŋmɛriba bɛn ni tooi ŋme biŋkumda pampam, kaman mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa din ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli biŋkumda beni.
en: David told the Levite leaders to get their brothers, the singers. The singers were to take their lyres, harps, and cymbals and sing happy songs.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini yɛm zaa bela o sani, ŋuna n-su ŋun yɔhindi niriba min o ni yɔhindi shɛb zaa.
en: God is strong and always victorious; both deceived and deceiver are in his power.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu boli zaɣ viɛlli, ka zaŋ zaɣ viɛlli boli zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ zibisim leei neesim, ka zaŋ neesim leei zibisim, ka zaŋ bintɔɣu boli binnyaɣisili, ka zaŋ binnyaɣisili boli bintɔɣu.
en: Look at those people! They say good is bad and bad is good. They think light is dark and dark is light. They think sour is sweet and sweet is sour.

dag: Ka a zaŋ firanki tulaale zim alali pahi kul yini kam zuɣu, ka yi ti zaŋ li pahi bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di leei shɛhira.
en: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.

dag: Piim a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi Izraɛlnim ni, n-chɛ ka bɛ yi n ka a sanna ti leei m maligumaaniba, n-tumdi n tuma; Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn yuya booni Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Summon your brother Aaron and his sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Separate them from the people of Israel, so that they may serve me as priests.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi chaŋ jinwariba sani bee bukpahinim sani nti doli ba, n ni pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: If any of you go for advice to people who consult the spirits of the dead, I will turn against you and will no longer consider you one of my people.

dag: Amaa a min a niriba yi lɛbi yi nyaaŋa biri ma, ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali ya ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti gbani wun shɛŋa tiŋa n-jɛmdi li.
en: But if any of you ever turn away from and abandon the regulations and commands that I have given you, and go to serve other gods and worship them.

dag: Ka Ɛdom mɔɣa leei kootaali, ka di tiŋgbani leei chilibi, ka di tiŋgbani maa taai buɣim di kaman kootaali la.
en: Edoms rivers will be like hot tar. Edoms ground will be like burning sulfur.

dag: Ka o di yɛl a baŋsim ashili yɛtɔɣa! Dama baŋsim mali yaɣa pam. Baŋmi ni Naawuni ni darig a tibili shɛm ŋɔ bi paag a ni tum taali shɛm.
en: and tell you secrets of wisdom; for sound insight has two sides. Know that God lets some of your sin be forgotten.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka di yi n-chaŋ ti kpe tayiɣ mini ŋun ŋmari ʒiri m-pɔri n yuli yinsi n-saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaŋ tabili dari mini kuɣa. .
en: The Lord Almighty says that he will send this curse out, and it will enter the house of every thief and the house of everyone who tells lies under oath. It will remain in their houses and leave them in ruins.

dag: Di saha maa, zuliya kam bɛn daa kana ti lu Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti chani Jɛrusalɛm yuuni kam ti jɛmdi Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka puhiri Suɣa Tibu chuɣu la.
en: Some of the people who came to fight Jerusalem will survive. And every year they will come to worship the king, the Lord All-Powerful. They will come to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Use acacia wood and build a special box. This Holy Box must be / cubits long, / cubits wide, and / cubits high.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianima. Ka Filistianim maa daa doli ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: When the Philistines attacked the Israelites, the Israelites ran away from the Philistines, and many fell dead on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Hal putɔɣulaannim yi kul zoori kaman mɔri la, ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa kul tɔŋda, bɛ ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.

dag: N shia faai siɣi, n dabisa naaya, gballi malila shili guli ma.
en: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.

dag: So di yɔhim omaŋa! So yi be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni yɛndana, ŋun leemi jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka o leei yɛndana.
en: Dont fool yourselves. Whoever thinks they are wise in this world should become a fool. Thats the only way they can be wise.

dag: Yi mi ni di daa nyɛla n daalaafee kalinsi zuɣu ka n daa be yi sani n-tuui yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya;.
en: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, binshɛl lan yina chana.
en: The angel appeared again and said, Look! Something else is coming.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ niɣi, ka chɛ ka saa tahi ku bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.

dag: Yi gba nyɛla n shɛhiranima, yi ni pun be n sani piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: And you, too, will speak about me, because you have been with me from the very beginning.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb bɛn laɣim lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ n sani maa lala. Bɛ biɛhigu ni zan tariga, ka bɛ kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: I swear that I will do this to you wicked people who have gathered together against me. Here in the wilderness every one of you will die. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba maa, Yi shiri galisiya pam, ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka di simdi ni yi mali tiŋgbani yaɣ bɔbili.
en: Joshua said to the tribes of Ephraim and West Manasseh, There are indeed many of you, and you are very powerful. You shall have more than one share.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa zaŋ alikama biɛlim suma bir o puu ni;.
en: Jesus told them another parable: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. A man sowed good seed in his field.

dag: Dinzuɣu chira awɛi ni biɛɣ pisi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: It took them nine months and days for them to go through the country. After nine months and days they came back to Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ishimail bidibisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yuya m-boli bɛ tiŋkpansi mini bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ daa nyɛla toondaannim pinaayi bɛ zuliyanim ni.
en: These are Ishmaels sons. These are their names by their villages and their settlements: twelve tribal leaders according to their tribes.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka zaŋ fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinim kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: By drawing lots, the people of Israel assigned these cities and their pasture lands to the Levites, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan boli do so ŋun daa nyɛ zom maa na m-pahi buyi nti yɛl o, Paɣimi Naawuni; amaa ti lee mi ni doo ŋɔ nyɛla alahichilana.
en: Therefore, they called a second time for the man who had been born blind and said to him, Give glory to God. We know this man is a sinner.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o sani ka bɛ bɔri bindirigu la yɛla?.
en: He said to them, Havent you ever read what David did when he was in need, when he and those with him were hungry?.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣ asiba, ka bɛ nya ka Dagɔn lan lumi n-do o puli zuɣu Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka o zuɣu min o nuhi ŋmahi do dunɔbia zuɣu, ka o zaɣ mundili kɔŋko n-kpalim.
en: Early the following morning they saw that the statue had again fallen down in front of the Covenant Box. This time its head and both its arms were broken off and were lying in the doorway; only the body was left. .

dag: Yi barinyubo ka gbinni. Yi bi mi ni dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita?.
en: Your bragging isnt good! Dont you know that a tiny grain of yeast makes a whole batch of dough rise?.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛli Mariama, A mal alibarika paɣiba ni, ka bi so ŋun be a pul ni ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: With a loud voice she blurted out, God has blessed you above all women, and he has blessed the child you carry.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ka o daa zaŋ kpihim Yɛhudianim zaligunim mini bɛ daadiini soli kaya ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba min omaŋmaŋ naai taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti sunsuuni.
en: Christ ended the law with its many commands and rules. His purpose was to make the two groups become one in him. By doing this he would make peace.

dag: Nyin ka n kuhiri niŋda. Tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: I call to you. Save me, and I will obey your rules.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Aduna ni o kpuɣim o jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa fiɛbi taŋkpaɣu, ka taŋkpaɣu maa leei pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Tell Aaron to strike the ground with his stick, and all over the land of Egypt the dust will change into gnats.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan zaŋ nimaani kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti du Bɛtihɔgila kuŋkuni, ka di tintariga maa daa zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Yalim Teeku duli nuzaa polo zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili nudirigu polo. Di nudirigu polo tintariga n-daa bala.
en: The border passed on to the slope of Beth-hoglah on the north. The border ended at the north bay of the Dead Sea, at the southern mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.

dag: Kɛlub ŋun daa nyɛ Shuha mabia la daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Mɛhir. Mɛhir maa n-daa nyɛ Ɛshitɔn ba.
en: Kelub was Shuhahs brother. Kelub was Mehirs father. Mehir was Eshtons father.

dag: Hal yinim Izraɛlnim ni tum bi ʒe yim tuma maa zaa yoli, di bi simdi ni di zuɣu chɛ ka Judanim gba kpe taali ni. Di kpɛnya Giligal tiŋ puuni bee n-kpɛnya Bɛtavɛn, ka miriya ka yi po n-yɛli Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Israel, even though you act like a prostitute, dont let Judah become guilty. Dont enter into Gilgal, or go up to Beth-aven, and dont swear, As the LORD lives.

dag: Ɛba ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanahi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg.
en: When Eber was , he had a son named Peleg.

dag: Yuun shɛli din nyɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa puuni, sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su binshɛɣukam.
en: In this year all property that has been sold shall be restored to its original owner.

dag: Niriba yi chaŋ bɛ tuma ni, bɛ tumdimi hal ni zaawuni.
en: Then people go out to do their work and keep working until evening.

dag: A yi yi zahira kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di so ashilɔni yurilim.
en: A public correction is better than hidden love.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tumtumdiba bɛn daa ʒe o yiŋ dunol ni daa bɔhi Mɔdɛkai, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaɣisi naa zaligu dolibu.
en: When the other officials asked Mordecai why he disobeyed the king's command.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋ o nuu duhi zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim nyarila yaa n-tuhiri nyandi Amalɛknim maa, o mi daa yi ti zaŋ o nuu siɣisi tiŋa, Amalɛknim maa nyarila yaa n-tuhir nyɛndi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Whenever Moses held up his hand, Israel would start winning the battle. Whenever Moses lowered his hand, Amalek would start winning.

dag: Di ti ŋubiya niŋkaha bee n-duɣ li, amaa ti shɛmiya binzuɣuri ni biɛhi zaa n-tabili puuni nɛma zaa.
en: Do not eat any of it raw or boiled, but eat it roasted whole, including the head, the legs, and the internal organs.

dag: Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa wum Filistia doo maa yɛtɔɣa maa, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba pam.
en: Saul and the Israelite soldiers heard what Goliath said, and they were very afraid.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Ishibɔshɛt Sool bia maa polo na, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi mi yi Dauda tɔbbihi maa polo na.
en: So the young soldiers got up. The two groups counted their men for the contest. They chose twelve men from the tribe of Benjamin to fight for Ish Bosheth son of Saul, and they chose twelve men from Davids officers.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ŋun Sool, ka bela Dauda sani.
en: The Lord had left Saul and was now with David, so Saul was afraid of David.

dag: Shɛb mali bɛ tab paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi tumdi daɣiri tuma, ka mali bɛ bihi paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi mali bɛ tizɔpaɣiba bɛn nyɛ bɛ manim nyintahi bipuɣinsi doon a ni.
en: One man commits a terrible sin against his own neighbors wife. Another man has sex with his daughter-in-law and makes her unclean. Another man rapes his fathers daughter—his very own sister.

dag: Filistianima, yi zaa di maliya suhupiɛlli, jaaŋgbe shɛli din yi fiɛbiri ya la ni kabigi la zuɣu. Waɣ yino yi kpi, so n-yirina zan o zaashee. Ka o galli waɣiri waɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken, because from the snakes root a viper will grow, and it will produce a winged creature.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi ti kul biri bimbirili kam, Midiannim maa mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim kanimina ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Every time the Israelites planted crops, the Midianites invaded Israel together with the Amalekites and other eastern nations.

dag: Gɛmaria bia Mikaya ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la ni daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa gbaŋ maa puuni.
en: Gemariah's son Micaiah was there and heard Baruch read what the Lord had said.

dag: Musa daa yi ti kpe suɣili maa puuni, sagban daantaliga sirigirimina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka Yawɛ tɔɣisiri Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent.

dag: ka n niriba bɛn nyɛ n ni su shɛb maa yi siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-suhi ma, ka niŋ tuuba, ka bo sɔŋsim n sani, ka zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni, n ni be alizanda ni ka wum bɛ suhigu maa, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka tibi bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: and if my people who are called by my name become humble and pray, and look for me, and turn away from their evil ways, then I will hear them from heaven. I will forgive their sin and heal their land.

dag: Hal jɛra yi doli soli, bɛ bi tumdi yɛm tuma, bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋdi ni bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: Fools lack all sense even when they walk down the street; they show everyone that they are fools.

dag: Nyamiya, pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi wuhi ya ni yi ti dol li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ma shɛm.
en: I have taught you all the laws, as the Lord my God told me to do. Obey them in the land that you are about to invade and occupy.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima n-chɛ ka a neesim neei; dama a neesim kana. Yawɛ jilima neeg a sani.
en: Arise, Jerusalem, and shine like the sun; The glory of the Lord is shining on you!.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm maa daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli pam. Ka Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba daa kul yiini yila ka ŋmɛri Yawɛ biŋkumda din kumdi pampam m-paɣiri Yawɛ dabisili kam.
en: So the Israelites in Jerusalem joyfully celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days, with the Levites and the priests praising the LORD every day, accompanied by the LORDs mighty instruments.

dag: Yawɛ n-teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai di nanima, ka zali ni bɛ saɣimmi Keenan birininima.
en: Gods hand is extended over the sea, shaking nations. The LORD gave the command to destroy Phoenicias fortresses.

dag: Suhu n-nyɛ din mali yɔhiŋgu gari binshɛɣukam; di bi ʒe yim. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li?.
en: Who can understand the human heart? There is nothing else so deceitful; it is too sick to be healed.

dag: Bɛ ni mɔɣisi sapaɣ lɔɣu; gariŋga zilinli ni ku ba.
en: They suck cobras poison; a vipers tongue kills them.

dag: dabisi shɛli din kanna ni di ti di Filistianim zaa ka mɔŋ Taainim mini Sidɔnnim sɔŋsim shɛŋa din kpalim la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ yɛn kula Filistianim bɛn kpalim be Kriit teeku duli la.
en: The time has come to destroy Philistia, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon all the help that remains. I, the Lord , will destroy the Philistines, all who came from the shores of Crete.

dag: Nir ni dɔɣi bi shɛb o bipolitali ni ŋmanila piɛma din be tɔbutuhira nuu ni.
en: The children born when one is young are like arrows in the hand of a warrior.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim maa ni daa chaŋ, n daa na mi m-bɔhi sariakaritib shɛb n ni daa pii zali ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me duu ti ma? .
en: Throughout my traveling around with the Israelites, did I ever ask any of Israels tribal leaders I appointed to shepherd my people: Why havent you built me a cedar temple?.

dag: Bɛn daa fiɣis o maa ni daa yiɣisi zani bɛ daa bi zaŋ yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa tɛhi ni bɛ ni zaŋ o tɔɣisi.
en: But when the men stood up to make their charges against him, they did not accuse him of any of the crimes that I thought they would.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta mini Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir maa, Nyama, m pun chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Haman yili gar dari, o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la zuɣu, ka zaŋ o yiŋ ti Ɛsta.
en: King Xerxes answered Queen Esther and Mordecai the Jew, Because Haman was against the Jews, I have given his property to Esther. And my soldiers have hanged him on the hanging post.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri chi zim viɛl shɛli; ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣila yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu.
en: Offer the proper grain offering of flour mixed with olive oil: pounds with each bull, pounds with the ram.

dag: Ka ŋun Musa daa zaŋ o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu n-zaŋ o leei toondana kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: then he placed his hands on Joshua and appointed him Israel's leader.

dag: Amaa yi yi taɣi yi suhuri ka zaɣisi wumbu ka birigi n-jɛmdi wuna.
en: But if you disobey and refuse to listen, and are led away to worship other gods.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni maa zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛli n-kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: Then the High Priest shall take some of the bull's blood and carry it into the Tent.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, bɛn labimi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka di bi simdi ka so ŋubi nahu maa nimdi, ka nahu maa lana ku mali taali.
en: If a mans bull kills a man or woman, then you should use stones and kill that bull. You should not eat the bull. The owner of the bull is not guilty.

dag: Di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-diri ti shɛhira ti suhuri ni ni ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi.
en: God's Spirit joins himself to our spirits to declare that we are God's children.

dag: hal ka ti ti paai ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la mini ti Naawuni Bia baŋbu la m-bi niriba ka ti biɛhigu buɣisibu saɣisi Masia biɛhigu zaa la.
en: And so we shall all come together to that oneness in our faith and in our knowledge of the Son of God; we shall become mature people, reaching to the very height of Christ's full stature.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Keep the Sabbath, and honor the place where I am worshiped. I am the Lord .

dag: Di saha maa ka Hagai daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya ni lala n-nyɛ yi zuliya ŋɔ niriba mini bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum shɛlikam; dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam m-mali sara pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu nyɛla din pa kasi n sani.
en: Then Haggai said, The Lord says that the same thing applies to the people of this nation and to everything they produce; and so everything they offer on the altar is defiled.

dag: Ka Hilliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la bia Abidɔn maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Piratɔn Ifriim tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ Amalɛknim zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: then he died and was buried at Pirathon in the territory of Ephraim in the hill country of the Amalekites.

dag: Ka maligumaana yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti so, ŋun maligumaana maa n-su o ni mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ.
en: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni ka nyɛ o Ba ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ ni o tin ya o Shia Kasi ŋun ni chɛ ka yi nya yɛm, ka kahigi Naawuni ni nyɛ so wuhi ya ka yi baŋ o.
en: I always pray to the great and glorious Father, the God of our Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that he will give you the Spirit, who will let you know truths about God and help you understand them, so that you will know him better.

dag: ka Jɔram nyɛ o bia, ka Ahazia nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔash nyɛ o bia.
en: Jehoshaphats son was Jehoram. Jehorams son was Ahaziah. Ahaziahs son was Joash.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Nyam bɛn je ma ni chɛ ka n di wahala shɛŋa! Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yihiri ma kum ni.
en: I said this prayer: Lord , be kind to me. See how my enemies are hurting me. Save me from the gates of death.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya ni kpamba.
en: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa daa kuhi pam yɛl li Judanim yɛligu ni bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim bɛn daa tam goondaa zuɣu la ha ni bɛ varisi ba kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, ka ŋme n-deei bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: The officials said all these things in Hebrew, so that everyone listening from the city wall would understand and be terrified and surrender.

dag: N daa bi deei n karimbanim yɛtɔɣa bee n-luɣi n tiba wum n karimbanim maa wuhibu.
en: I didnt listen to the voice of my instructor. I didnt obey my teacher.

dag: O ni daa di nam yuun shɛli maa goli so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni ka o daa kparigi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la dunoya n-chɛ ka bɛ malimali di zaa.
en: In the very first year of his rule, during the first month, Hezekiah reopened the doors of the LORDs temple, having repaired them.

dag: Alahichi nyɛla din tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa bɛ suhuri puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ suhuri ni.
en: I know the sinful utterance of the wicked: No fear of God confronts their own eyes.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha, ka Zimiri daa di nam ʒini Tiriza daba ayopɔin. Di saha maa Izraɛl tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti teei gilila Gibɛtɔn din be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Zimri became king of Israel during the th year that Asa was king of Judah. Zimri ruled in Tirzah only seven days. This is what happened: The army of Israel was at Gibbethon, which was under Philistine control.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yino maa n-tiri yiko din tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri sokam yinoyino kaman o ni yu ni o ti o pin shɛli.
en: But it is one and the same Spirit who does all this; as he wishes, he gives a different gift to each person.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka di niŋdiya shɛli bɛ nini yi beni zuɣu ni bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiya lala ni suhu yini Naawuni zɔbu zuɣu.
en: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? Ka Naa Sool garigi yɛl o, A ni daa zali dabisi shɛli maa ni paai ka n nya ka a bi kanna, ka Filistianim mi lo tɔbu n-do Mikimash ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani maa wurindi ka chɛri ma.
en: What have you done? Samuel asked. Saul answered, My soldiers were leaving in all directions, and you didn't come when you were supposed to. The Philistines were gathering at Michmash.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ o bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la n-leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah and made him king after his father Amaziah. He was years old.

dag: Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim ni so daa ʒi yɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama bɛ yi di daa mi li, bɛ daa naan ku kpahi ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ jilimalan la tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: It is a wisdom that none of the present-day rulers have understood, because if they did understand it, they would never have crucified the Lord of glory!.

dag: Yi bi mi m mini n yaannim ni daa niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba zaa shɛm la yɛla? Tiŋgbɔna maa buɣa daa tooi tiligi di niriba n nuu ni?.
en: Of course, you know what my ancestors and I have done to all the peoples in other countries. The gods of the other countries could not save their people. Those gods could not stop me from destroying their people.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ ni niriba ayi daa kuni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Ɛmaus, ka di mini Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛ kaman maali ayopɔin la.
en: That same day two of Jesus followers were going to a town named Emmaus. It is about seven miles from Jerusalem.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashe kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Everyone tries to gain the favor of important people; everyone claims the friendship of those who give out favors.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a ni a niŋ alibarika niŋ man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni din ni chɛ ka n daŋ kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni nyin Naawuni sani; dama nyini Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka a daalibarika kul ni be man a dabili ŋɔ daŋ ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: So now willingly bless your servants dynasty so that it might continue forever before you, because you, LORD God, have promised. Let your servants dynasty be blessed forever by your blessing.

dag: A zaŋ tuuta sa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura ka bɛ yi nya tuuta maa, di ni chɛ ka piɛma ku nyɔɣi ba.
en: Give a flag to those who honor you, so they can rally around it, safe from attack. Selah.

dag: kuhi pam yɛli, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a Naawuni yuli zuɣu, di nahim ma.
en: and screamed in a loud voice, Jesus, Son of the Most High God! What do you want with me? For God's sake, I beg you, don't punish me! .

dag: Ka wɔribar maa daa chaŋ ti tuhi Jɛhu soli yɛl o, Naa ni n ti bɔh a, Alaafee? Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Alaafee yɛla lee nya a ya? Garim doli n nyaaŋa! Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan yɛli, Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina.
en: So the driver went to meet him and said, The king asks, Do you come in peace? Jehu replied, What do you care about peace? Come around and follow me. Meanwhile, the tower guard reported, The messenger met them, but he isnt returning.

dag: Ti Duuma, neema! Bɔ n-niŋ ka a gbihira? Neema! Di chɛ ti bahi sahakam!.
en: Wake up! Why are you sleeping, Lord? Get up! Dont reject us forever!.

dag: So miri ka o ʒiɛm o, ka chɛliya ka o ti yi yi sani ni suhudoo lab n sanna, dama n kul lihirila o mini ti mabihi la soli.
en: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o.
en: She answered, I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so please give me some spring-fed ponds for a water supply. Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds named Higher Pond and Lower Pond.

dag: N yuya ni n ʒe yim n soya ni, ka lala chɛ ka n tooi dol a zaligunima!.
en: How I hope that I shall be faithful in keeping your instructions!.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan damdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim tiŋa.
en: Once again, Abraham bowed down.

dag: Safaya kuɣa be tiŋgbani puuni, ka salima be di taŋkpazim ni.
en: The stones of the earth contain sapphires, And its dust contains gold.

dag: Yawɛ ni ka o niriba sanna; o ni to o piɛma ka di be kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ni ti piɛb kikaa; ka ni ti be nudirigu polo pɔhim ni kanna.
en: The LORD will appear above them; his arrow will go forth like lightning. The LORD God will blow the horn; he will march forth on the stormy winds of the south.

dag: Ti kpamba mini ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa yɛlimi, Bomiya bindira niŋ yi nuu ni n-gbaai soli chaŋ ti nya ba yɛli ba, Ti nyɛla yi daba, ka chɛ m-bɔri ni ti mini ya lo tab alikauli.
en: So our elders and our people said to us, Take enough food for your journey. Go and meet with the Israelites. Tell them, We are your servants. Make a peace agreement with us.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka bɛ nyuri bara la bɛ ni baŋ ma, ka mi n ni nyɛ so la zuɣu. Bɛ baŋya ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka m mali yurilim din galisi mini zaligu soli ni nimmaŋtali tumdi tuma dunia ni. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m mali suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord . What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka alahichi su yi niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ n-chɛ ka yi deei yi niŋgbuna maa noli tum di kɔr biɛri tuma.
en: Sin must no longer rule in your mortal bodies, so that you obey the desires of your natural self.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi Sintani, A tɛhi n dabili Ayuba yɛla? So bi ŋman o dunia ni. O nyɛla ŋun ka galimi ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: The LORD said to the Adversary, Have you thought about my servant Job; surely there is no one like him on earth, a man who is honest, who is of absolute integrity, who reveres God and avoids evil.

dag: Ka Ɛli bɔh o, Wula ka o sa lee yɛl a? Di sɔɣ ma shɛli, a yi sɔɣ ma yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa puuni, Naawuni ŋun zaŋm o ni di yɛn niŋ ma shɛm maa niŋ a, hal ŋun niŋm a gari lala gba.
en: What did he say to you? Eli asked. Dont hide anything from me. May God deal harshly with you and worse still if you hide from me a single word from everything he said to you.

dag: ni Bɛtinimira ni Bɛtiharan, ka me buzɔna zali bɛ piɛri mini buhi, ka me goondahi gil li.
en: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran. They built cities with strong walls, and they built barns for their animals.

dag: N je yi chu shɛŋa yi ni puhiri la. M mi baɣa ka yi jɛma laɣiŋgunim ni.
en: I hate, I reject your festivals; I dont enjoy your joyous assemblies.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tɔbiri mini bɛ piɛma n-to n-ku bipola. Bɛ ku zo biliɛri mini bibihi nambɔɣu.
en: With their bows and arrows they will kill the young men. They will show no mercy to babies and take no pity on children.

dag: Ka Filistianim shɛb daa ʒiri pina mini anzinfa na ti jɛmdi Jɛhɔshafat. Ka Laribunim gba daa zaŋ piɛlahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini bulahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin na ti ti o.
en: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat a large amount of silver and other gifts, and some Arabs brought him , sheep and , goats.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa ni ti nyɛla Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu zuliya biriginsim maa lee nyɛ dini? Pa Samaria? Ka Judanim buɣijɛmbo shee lee nyɛ dini? Pa Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: All this is for the crime of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel. Who is responsible for the crime of Jacob? Isnt it Samaria? Who is responsible for the shrines of Judah? Isnt it Jerusalem?.

dag: o daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini puri bee n-sɔŋ dunia tampuɣili.
en: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.

dag: dindina o mabia maa paɣa maa ŋun cham o sani kpamba maa ninni nti pirigi doo maa namdili o napɔŋ ni, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun je ni o me o mabia yili.
en: his brother's widow is to go up to him in the presence of the town leaders, take off one of his sandals, spit in his face, and say, This is what happens to the man who refuses to give his brother a descendant.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, a kul darigirila n tibili; ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai kaman wuuni saha tulim ni nyuuri mahili shɛm la.
en: because your hand was heavy upon me. My energy was sapped as if in a summer drought. Selah.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Ninive din nyɛ tin tital la ni nti kuhi yɛli ba ni man Naawuni nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma la.
en: He said, Go to Nineveh, that great city, and speak out against it; I am aware of how wicked its people are.

dag: Di zɔriya yi ni yɛn nya nahiŋgu shɛli. Nyamiya, Sintani ni ti kpɛhi yi ni shɛb sarika n-zahim ya, ka yi ni nya nahiŋgu biɛɣ pia. Ka ŋun ʒe yim hal ti paai kum, n ni ti o nyɛvili nam zuɣupiligu.
en: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa ti chaŋmi ti liri Judanima, ka me Rama zali ni o chɛ ka so ku lan tooi yi Juda Naa Asa sani chaŋ luɣ shɛli bee n-yi shɛli polo ka o sanna.
en: Israels King Baasha attacked Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent Judahs King Asa from moving into that area.

dag: Ifriimnim jilima ni ti yiɣi bɛ sani chaŋ kaman noombil la. Bɛ ti ku lan dɔɣi bihi, paɣipuulan ti ku lan beni, bɛ paɣiba ti ku lan zali puhi.
en: Israel's greatness will fly away like a bird, and there will be no more children born to them, no more women pregnant, no more children conceived.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Juda nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka bɛ daa kul ʒe Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam maa nyaaŋa hal ni yuma ata, dama yuma ata maa ni zaa bɛ daa kul dolila Dauda mini Sulemaana naba.
en: For the next three years, they lived in Judah and were loyal to Rehoboam and his kingdom, just as they had been loyal to David and Solomon.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka yi ku tum alahichi, amaa yi ni so yi tum alahichi, ti mali sandaantimda ŋun be ti Ba Naawuni sani: ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ wuntialan la.
en: My little children, Im writing these things to you so that you dont sin. But if you do sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous one.

dag: Yiɣisim doli tiŋgbɔŋ maa wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ nya, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: Now, go and look over the whole land, because I am going to give it all to you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo kuɣ shɛŋa zali bɛ ni daa yihi kuɣ shɛŋa la zaani, ka lan bo tari na ti ta yili maa.
en: Then new stones must be put in the walls, and the walls must be covered with new plaster.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi mini niriba lala tatabo be.
en: So have nothing at all to do with such people.

dag: Paɣimiy o yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ sahakam. O chɛ ka o jilima pali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa. Ami! Ami!.
en: Bless Gods glorious name forever; let his glory fill all the earth! Amen and Amen!.

dag: Ka Naaman daa zaŋ o yuri min o chɛchɛbuŋa ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ ti zani Ilaisha yiŋ dunol ni.
en: Naaman arrived with his horses and chariots. He stopped at the door of Elishas house.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, N ni daa tim ya ka yi bi ʒi liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanim la, shɛli daa ti pooi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, shɛli daa bi pooi ti.
en: Then Jesus asked his disciples, When I sent you out that time without purse, bag, or shoes, did you lack anything? Not a thing, they answered.

dag: Gidiɔn maŋmaŋ bidibisi daa nyɛla pisopɔin, dama o daa malila paɣ bɔbili.
en: Gideon had sons of his own. He had so many sons because he had many wives.

dag: ka Farigudeeriba kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Zakius ka o nyɛ bundana daa be nimaani.
en: In Jericho there was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a wealthy, very important tax collector.

dag: Niŋmiya saani ka kparima ni ŋumbu ka di puuni.
en: Open your homes to each other and share your food without complaining.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni shɛb bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee tɔɣisiri ti yɛri ni di kpalim biɛla ka ti ku lan nya o; ka di ti tooi biɛla ka ti lan nya o yaha maa; ka lan yɛri ni dama o labirila o Ba sani.
en: Some of his disciples asked among themselves, What does this mean? He tells us that in a little while we will not see him, and then a little while later we will see him; and he also says, It is because I am going to the Father.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti pirigi Yisa binyɛra ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: They took off Jesus clothes and put a red robe on him.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di yɛn niŋ? Dim suɣilo. Zom a daba nambɔɣu.
en: Lord , come back to us. Be kind to your servants.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zaawuni saha n-chaŋ Sirianim sansani maa ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Sirianim sansani maa ni n-nya ka so ka nimaani.
en: So that evening the four lepers went to the Aramean camp. When they came to the edge of the camp, no one was there!.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Wula ka yinim bɛn bi bɔri jilima Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani, amaa ka bɔri jilima la yi tab sani ŋɔ lee yɛn tooi niŋ yɛda?.
en: How can you believe when you receive praise from each other but dont seek the praise that comes from the only God?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ ania di suɣilo hal ti shiri nya alikauli maa palibu.
en: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba daa yɛli niriba maa zaa. Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Moses and the elders of Israel spoke to the people. Moses said, Obey all the commands that I give you today.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini. .
en: When the renters saw the owner's son, they said to one another, Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba m-bɔŋɔ: Libini daŋ niriba mini Hiburɔn daŋ niriba ni Mahili daŋ niriba ni Mushi daŋ niriba ni Kɔra daŋ niriba. Amiram ba n-daa nyɛ Kɔhat.
en: as well as the clans of Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, and Korah. Kohath the Levite was the father of Amram.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naa ni n Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya di nasara gbaliŋ ŋɔ.
en: Its you, God! You who are my king, the one who orders salvation for Jacob.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti bi nya o, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti bo o shee.
en: When they could not find him with their relatives and friends, they went back to Jerusalem and started looking for him there.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o Bia maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: A nyɛla Naawuni, a nam ʒiishee kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Wuntia jaaŋgbee n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni a nam fukumsi tam la wuntia zuɣu.
en: But this is what he said about his Son: God, your kingdom will last forever and ever. You use your authority for justice.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ka o ti ŋme n-di di nɛma, ka ʒe di nɛma n-zaŋ di daazichi chaŋ, ka di ti leeg o tɔbbihi yɔri.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: I will give Egypt to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, and he will carry away the people. He will take the many valuable things in Egypt to pay his army.

dag: Pɔhim ni ʒe ba chaŋ, ka bɛ maligu bimbina zuɣu ti chɛ ka vi gbahi.
en: They went to those gods for safety, and they have lost their ability to think. Their altars will bring them shame.

dag: Bɛ yi galim ya Masia yuli zuɣu, yi mal alibarika, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi min o jilima be yi ni. Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri Masia, amaa yinim sani o nyɛla ŋun nyari tibigibu.
en: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Gɛhaazi na ti yɛl o, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa na. Ka o bol o. Ka paɣ maa kana, ka o ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a bia.
en: Elisha called out to Gehazi, Ask the boy's mother to come here. Gehazi did, and when she was at the door, Elisha said, You can take your son.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛb ni. Ifriimnim nyɛla bɛn dɔni yaɣ yini tabili, ka bɛ lɛbigi.
en: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn ku niriba me tiŋ zali, ka tum tuumbiɛri zali fɔntiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Pity the one building a city with bloodshed and founding a village with injustice.

dag: Yi ŋmanila firila dunia ŋɔ ni. Tin shɛli din me n-tam zoli zuɣu mi bi sɔɣira.
en: You are like light for the whole world. A city built on a hill cannot be hid.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli yi yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: And you are nothing but show-offs! Isaiah the prophet was right when he wrote that God had said.

dag: Di saha ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsala teeg o nuu na ti shihi n naŋgbampiba, ka n yɛl o, N dana, n ni nya ʒii shɛli maa chɛmi ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: Then the angel, who looked like a human being, reached out and touched my lips. I said to him, Sir, this vision makes me so weak that I can't stop trembling.

dag: dama tiŋgbani kuumi tahi la, saa ni bi lan miri maa zuɣu, ka di niŋ pukpariba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: Because the ground is cracked due to lack of rain, the farmers too are ashamed; they cover their heads.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni. O nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim sahakam.
en: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianim bɛn guni gunibu shɛli bɛ ni niŋdi niŋgbuŋ ni la ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni. Teemiya yi bebu ni daa nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: You were not born as Jews. You are the people the Jews call uncircumcised. Those Jews who call you uncircumcised call themselves circumcised.

dag: Yi ŋmanila lala n sani pumpɔŋɔ, Yi nya n nahiŋgu maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ya.
en: Thats what you are like; you see something awful and are afraid.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Naa Hɛzɛkia sani ti yɛl o, Ti mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bimbini mini di lahi zaa; ni bɛ ni zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro kasi tamdi teebuli shɛli zuɣu la mini di lahi zaa.
en: Then they went to King Hezekiah and said to him, King Hezekiah, we cleaned all the Lord s Temple and the altar for burning offerings and all the things in the Temple. We cleaned the table for the rows of bread with all the things used for that table.

dag: Amaa di niŋ kamaata ni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu yihi ti zuliya kam pɔi.
en: Before the end comes, the Good News must be told to all nations.

dag: Amaa ti yipa yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu lɔbu ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka kpi zaŋ chaŋ din daa kpɛhi ti dabitim ni la polo. Ka ti mi ku lan doli fukumsi zaligu kurili din daa sabi zal la sulinsi soli, amaa ka ni dolila Shia Kasi nyɛvili palli la sulinsi soli.
en: In the past the law held us as prisoners, but our old selves died, and we were made free from the law. So now we serve God in a new way, not in the old way, with the written rules. Now we serve God in the new way, with the Spirit.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaɣisi kpamba la ni daa wuh o shɛm la, ka zaŋla yɛtɔɣ yoli yɛli niriba maa.
en: The king ignored the advice of the older men and spoke harshly to the people.

dag: N-nyɛ kuɣ duli shɛli n ni pihi sɔŋ m min a sunsuuni.
en: Laban said to Jacob, Here is this mound and here is the sacred pillar that Ive set up for us.

dag: Di ni kpamba kul ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka di sariakaritiba be kaman zaawuni kunduna bɛn bi guuri binshɛli zaana hal ni asiba la.
en: Jerusalems leaders are like roaring lions. Her judges are like hungry wolves that come in the evening to attack the sheep—and in the morning nothing is left.

dag: N yi dɔni tiŋa m bɔhirimi, Bɔ saha ka n lee yɛn yiɣisi? Amaa ka biɛɣu neebu wɔɣa. Ka n kul mali mmaŋ wolisiri hal ka biɛɣu ti miri neebu.
en: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni Hɔshaya bia Azaria ni niriba maa zaa, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura daa chaŋ.
en: Johanan, Jezaniah, the other army officers, and everyone else in the group, came to me.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka yi leei nyɛviyanima, ka n zaŋ ya niŋ yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka mi shiri ni niŋ li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I will put my breath in you, and you will live. I will plant you on your fertile land, and you will know that I am the LORD. Ive spoken, and I will do it. This is what the LORD says.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi mɔɣu polo kanna ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o yura ŋɔ? Apil tia gbini ka n daa neeg a. Nimaani ka a ma daa be n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣ a; nimaani ka ŋun daa dɔɣ a daa be n-wolisira.
en: Who is this woman coming from the desert, leaning on her lover? I woke you under the apple tree, where your mother gave birth to you, where you were born.

dag: Daadam, a bela duŋtaariba sunsuuni, bɛn mali nina din ni nya, amaa ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba din ni wum, amaa ka bi wumda, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.

dag: N ni yihi ba Ijipti mini Asiria labisina ti ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni zaŋ ba ʒili Giliad mini Lɛbanɔn, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ti pali niriba hal ka palo ti ku lan beni.
en: I will bring them back from the land of Egypt; I will collect them from Assyria. I will bring them to the land of Gilead and Lebanon until there is no more room for them.

dag: Bɛ daai nandaamba baɣili palli kpaŋa, ka nandaamba zaa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: The poor are trampled and forced to hide.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnima bɛ mabihi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yɛli, Daŋ yini niriba ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Israelites were sad about what had happened to the Benjamin tribe, and they said, One of our tribes was almost wiped out.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla shɛli ka pa shɛli, o yɔhindila omaŋa.
en: If anyone thinks they are important when they arent, theyre fooling themselves.

dag: Amaa di niŋ kamaata ni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu yihi ti zuliya kam pɔi.
en: But before the end comes, the good news must be preached to all nations.

dag: Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suhi alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni ka naanyi kpi m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the blessings that Moses, the man of God, pronounced on the people of Israel before he died.

dag: Amaa yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka gbibiya yi maŋ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi ku tam yi nina ni daa nya binshɛŋa la bee n-chɛ ka di yi yi suhuri ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni be yi nyɛviya ni ŋɔ; zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi.
en: Be on your guard! Make certain that you do not forget, as long as you live, what you have seen with your own eyes. Tell your children and your grandchildren.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu piligu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋma gbaŋ fiɣisi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa bɛ buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛŋa.
en: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.

dag: Amaa pa sokam zaa m-mali dimbɔŋɔ baŋsim, dama yɛdaniŋdib bɛn pun mili buɣa yi di bindirigu ŋɔ tatabo, bɛ tɛhirimi ni di nyɛla bɛ ni shiri zaŋ shɛli mali buɣili, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu chɛ ka di nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: But not everybody knows this. Some are eating this food as though it really is food sacrificed to a real idol, because they were used to idol worship until now. Their conscience is weak because it has been damaged.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n nya a jilima.
en: Then Moses said, Now, please show me your Glory.

dag: Gbaai yihila Goshɛn, Izraɛlnim ni daa be yaɣ shɛli polo maa, ka sakuɣa maa daa bi lu.
en: The region of Goshen, where the Israelites lived, was the only place where there was no hail.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tiŋgbani fabinda, ka ŋunkam be di ni kɔba ni chɔɣisi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣira ni teeku ni zahim gba ku lan beni.
en: So the country is like someone crying for the dead, and all of its people are weak. Even the animals of the field, the birds of the sky, and the fish in the sea are dying.

dag: Jɛdiayɛl bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan, ka Bilihan mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Bɛnjamin ni Ɛhud ni Chɛnaana ni Zɛtan ni Tarishish ni Ahishahar.
en: Jediaels son was Bilhan. Bilhans sons were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka Lɛvinim su n daalikauli suɣili la mini di nɛma zaa ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni fukumsi. Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa, ka ti bɛ suɣa gil li.
en: Tell the Levites that they are responsible for the Tent of the Agreement. They must take care of that tent and everything that is with it. They must carry the Holy Tent and everything in it. They must make their camp around it and take care of it.

dag: Ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili maa daa yi nimaani n-zaŋ hal ti sirigi Luz nudirigu polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Atarɔtada Zoli din daa be Bɛtihɔrɔn din be naɣiliŋga ni nudirigu polo la.
en: The border passed on from there to Luz, to the slope of Luz on the south . The border went down to Ataroth-adar on the mountain that is south of Lower Beth-horon.

dag: Simiɔn mini Lɛvi nyɛla nir ni o mabia. Bɛ malila bɛ bidibbina tumdi barina.
en: Simeon and Levi, you are brothers, each a gruesome sword.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hanania, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kabigila dapua, amaa m bo kurigu dapua n-zali di zaani.
en: to go and tell Hananiah: The Lord has said that you may be able to break a wooden yoke, but he will replace it with an iron yoke.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa ti kpe yili maa ni dahin shɛli ni o ti tum o tuma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be yili maa ni kani.
en: One day, Joseph went to Potiphar's house to do his work, and none of the other servants were there.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bɔŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi bɛ taba alaka ni deeri pin shɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the wickeds portion with God, the inheritance that the ruthless receive from the Almighty.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ bɔ n-lee tuhi ya soli n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: What did the man look like? the king asked.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla alikauli palibu sara maligu bee o suhuyubu sara maligu, bɛ ni tooi ŋubi di nimdi maa o ni mali sara maa dahin shɛli maa, ka shɛli yi guui zani neei biɛɣu bɛ ni tooi ŋub li;.
en: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day.

dag: N yi ti teei n nuu darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili ka yihi Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Egyptians will then know that I am the Lord , when I raise my hand against them and bring the Israelites out of their country.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu maa shee, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sin tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: Their next camp was in the desert of Sin.

dag: O ti zaŋm ba na ti ti maligumaana, ka o ti daŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maa malibu. O ti ŋmɛlimi kabi ŋmani maa nyiŋgoli, amaa o di ti ŋmɛli ŋmaag o zuɣu.
en: You shall bring them to the priest, who will first offer the bird for the sin offering. He will break its neck without pulling off its head.

dag: Naa yi doli zaligu soli n-kariti nandaamba saria, o nam ni zani yuui.
en: If a king judges the poor honestly, his throne will be established forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ŋmanila ŋahili shɛli din wuhi: Bindoo bi waɣa ka nir ni tooi teeg omaŋ dɔni di zuɣu, ka chinchini gba bi yɛlima, ka nir ni tooi zaŋ li pil omaŋa.
en: The bed is too short to stretch out, and the shroud is too narrow to cover oneself.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai bɛ sansani maa ni, Izraɛlnim zaa daa yola vuri hal ka tiŋgbani ti damda.
en: When the Lord s Box of the Agreement came into the camp, all the Israelites gave a great shout loud enough to make the ground shake.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa lab mali me Hɛshibɔn mini Ɛliale ni Kiriataim.
en: The people of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N nyala so shia ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Don't be afraid! the king said to her. What do you see? I see a spirit coming up from the earth, she answered.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan pii Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba ni Izraɛl daŋ kam puuni kpɛma n-leei Jɛrusalɛm sariakaritiba ni bɛ kariti saria tiri Yawɛ, ka maani niriba yɛla. Bɛ daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed Levites, priests, and some of the leading citizens as judges in cases involving a violation of the Law of the Lord or legal disputes between inhabitants of the city.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri ni o saɣim o yuli yɛra, N daa kpuɣila paɣ ŋɔ, amaa ka m min o ti dɔni, ka m bi nya o paɣipalitali shihira.
en: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa nyɛ Manaasa ba, ka Manaasa nyɛ Ɛmɔn ba, ka Ɛmɔn mi nyɛ Jɔsia ba.
en: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amos. Amos was the father of Josiah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, o yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Yes, YAHWEH is the God of the armies. His name is YAHWEH.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Karim dab paɣ ŋɔ min o bia ŋɔ, dama dab paɣ maa bia maa mini m bia Yisahaku ku laɣim di fali.
en: Sarah said to Abraham, Get rid of that slave woman and her son. Send them away! When we die, our son Isaac will get everything we have. I dont want that slave womans son sharing these things with my son Isaac.

dag: Ka Bɛtuɛl mi daa dɔɣi Ribɛka. Bih anii ŋɔ ka Milika daa dɔɣi ti Nahɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Ibrahimma mabia maa.
en: Bethuel was the father of Rebekah. Milcah was the mother of these eight sons, and Nahor was the father. Nahor was Abrahams brother.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbɛbil fiɛb ma; ka lab ma kuɣa yim. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n ŋariŋ saɣim teeku puuni; ka m be teeku puuni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.

dag: Kaman sagbana ni yi wurim naai shɛm la, lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ku lan labina.
en: Like a cloud that fades and is gone, we humans die and never return; we are forgotten by all who knew us.
