dag: Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun bi be lala, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim nyɛ o ni su zuliya shɛba. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: But Jacobs God is not like the idols. He made everything, and Israel is the family that God chose to be his own people. His name is Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi di mi Naawuni pini, ka mi ŋun suhir a ni a niŋ kom ti o ka o nyu ŋɔ, a gba naan suh o ka o ti a nyɛvili kom.
en: Jesus answered, If you only knew what God gives and who it is that is asking you for a drink, you would ask him, and he would give you life-giving water.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba suhiri Naawuni sɔŋdi ti, ka di chɛ ka niriba pam paɣi Naawuni o ni deei bɛ wunsuhigu gbaliŋ ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni la zuɣu.
en: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers.

dag: Leeban daa zaŋla o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Liya ni o sɔŋd o.
en: Laban also gave Zilpah to Leah as her servant woman.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anahi daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi wuntaŋ zuɣu, ka ti o yiko ni o tulim be kaman buɣim la n-wɔb daadamnima;.
en: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun. The sun was given power to burn the people with fire.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ: Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni tintani din zaa daa baɣi Mɛdɛba la.
en: Their territory ran from Aroer by the rim of the Arnon Valley and the city in the middle of the ravine, and the whole plateau as far as Medeba.

dag: Siria naa maa saha tariga yi ti miri, Ijipti naa ni ti chaŋ ti lir o, ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba ni sitimanim pam tuh o ni o kpiɔŋ zaa. Siria naa maa ni ti ŋmanila kokpɛɣu n-chaŋ ti liri tin bɔbili.
en: At the time of the end, the southern king will fight a battle against the northern king. The northern king will attack him with chariots and soldiers on horses and many large ships. The northern king will rush through the land like a flood.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o. Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: And so they rejected him. Jesus said to them, A prophet is respected everywhere except in his hometown and by his own family.

dag: Amaa di ni chɛri ka daadamnim tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni doo kam mal o dahalali paɣa, ka paɣ kam mi mal o dahalali yidana.
en: But sexual sin is a danger, so each man should enjoy his own wife, and each woman should enjoy her own husband.

dag: dama dindali maa ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya, ka yihi ya daɣiri ni; yi ni ti yi yi daalahichi zaa daɣiri ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: On that day reconciliation will be made for you in order to cleanse you. You will be clean before the LORD from all your sins.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlila Sulemaana, M bia, m pun lo n suhu ni ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jilima.
en: He said: My son, I wanted to build a temple where the Lord my God would be worshiped.

dag: O daa bela tiŋ maa gomna ŋun yuli daa booni Sɛrigius Poolus ŋun mali yɛm pam la yiŋa. Ka gomna maa daa boli Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti tɔɣis o Naawuni yɛligu.
en: He kept company with the governor of that province, an intelligent man named Sergius Paulus. The governor sent for Barnabas and Saul since he wanted to hear Gods word.

dag: Bɛ ni daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa neei biɛɣu, ka bɛ daa tuui di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu din nyɛ kawaan shɛra mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields.

dag: Amaa nyini Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ku kpi tɔbu ni.
en: Zedekiah, I promise that you won't die in battle.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ni malaika gahinda zuɣu, n zal a ni a gbib wuhibunim ŋɔ, ka di zo so vi dimbɔŋɔ ni bee n-yaai so yuri ka chɛ so a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli:.
en: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed to the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Iin, lala n-nyɛ ma; ka yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: I am, answered Jesus, and you will all see the Son of Man seated at the right side of the Almighty and coming with the clouds of heaven.

dag: Lala ka Sulemaana daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma zaa din nyɛ: salima sara maligu bimbini mini teebu shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: Solomon also gave orders to make the following temple furnishings out of gold: the altar, the tables that held the sacred loaves of bread.

dag: Di ŋubiya li, ka binshɛɣukam ti niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, yi ni tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani zuɣu.
en: If you obey this command, the Lord will be pleased, and all will go well for you and your descendants.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa nya li yɛli, yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ bee ti nini na ʒi n-nya lala Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ. Ti tɛhimi di yɛla. Ti gbaamiya saawara baŋ ti ni yɛn yɛli di yɛla shɛm.
en: Everyone who saw it said, Has such a thing ever happened or been seen since the time when the Israelites came up from the land of Egypt until today? Think about it, decide what to do, and speak out.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pia daa lu Gibianim zuɣu, ka tɔb maa daa kpɛm pam. Amaa Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa bi baŋ ni yɛl biɛɣu n-yɛn paai ba maa.
en: Ten thousand men, specially chosen out of all Israel, attacked Gibeah, and the fighting was hard. The Benjaminites had not realized that they were about to be destroyed.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa doli yiini yila ka ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni chaɣisanima ni feensi ni dawulɛnim n-wari wahi ni bɛ yaa zaa ni suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: David and all the Israelites were dancing and singing with all their might to honor the Lord . They were playing harps, lyres, drums, rattles, and cymbals.

dag: Amaa man Naawuni bɔhiri ninvuɣ biɛri, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul tɔɣisiri n zaligunim yɛla sahakam? Bee bɔzuɣu ka yi tɔɣisiri n daalikauli yɛla?.
en: But to the wicked I say: You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!.

dag: Dindali maa o ni ti lan boli ma o yidana yaha, ka pa ni o Baal.
en: Then once again she will call me her husband—she will no longer call me her Baal.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: Then they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

dag: Hal bɛmaŋmaŋ nam puuni min a ni niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli pam shɛl la puuni ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn tital shɛli din mali kulim ti ba la zaa yoli, bɛ daa zaɣis a jɛmbu, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.

dag: dindina, n ni zaŋ jaaŋgbee bu ba n-darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ fiɛbiga n-fiɛbi ba darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: then I will punish their sin with a stick, and I will punish their wrongdoing with a severe beating.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ŋun duɣi bindirigu maa, Zaŋmi n ni di zaŋ nim shɛli ti a ka yɛl a ni a zaŋ li zali di ko la na.
en: Samuel said to the cook, Serve the portion I gave you—the one I told you to set aside.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu ŋmanila mɔri. Bɛ zoorimi kaman mɔɣu ni tipum la;.
en: The days of a human life are like grass: they bloom like a wildflower.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli yi sariakaritiba maa, Wummiya yi niriba yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka karimiya yɛtɔɣa din be nir min o kpee sunsuuni zaŋ tabili saamba bɛn be yi sani saria ka di tuhi.
en: At that time I told these judges, Listen to the arguments between your people. Be fair when you judge each case. It doesnt matter if the problem is between two Israelites or between an Israelite and a foreigner. You must judge each case fairly.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni du ka chɛ tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani.
en: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa ni ti nyɛla Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu zuliya biriginsim maa lee nyɛ dini? Pa Samaria? Ka Judanim buɣijɛmbo shee lee nyɛ dini? Pa Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: This will happen because of Jacobs sin, because of the sins of the nation of Israel. What caused Jacob to sin? It was Samaria. Where is the high place in Judah? It is Jerusalem.

dag: Jɔram ni daa ti nya Jɛhu, o daa bɔh o mi, Jɛhu, alaafee? Ka Jɛhu garigi bɔh o, Wula ka alaafee lee yɛn niŋ beni, ka a ma Jɛzibɛl sotali min o buɣijɛmbo tuma la na kul beni pam.
en: Joram saw Jehu and asked, Do you come in peace, Jehu? Jehu answered, There is no peace as long as your mother Jezebel does many acts of prostitution and witchcraft.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɛli ya, Biɛhiŋ kani Yawɛ ni fa ti bahi, ka ku zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni, ka yi shiri niŋ Yawɛ naani di zuɣu.
en: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni Sinai mɔɣu maa ni. Yawɛ ni daa kul zali Musa shɛlikam zaa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: At twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month they kept the Passover in the Sinai desert. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ paɣibu shɛli din nyɛ o dini o wuntitali zuɣu, ka yili yila paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ yuli.
en: I thank the Lord for his justice; I sing praises to the Lord , the Most High.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ayi nyɛ Chiliab. O ma n-daa nyɛ Abigeel ŋun nyɛ Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la. Ka ŋun pah ata nyɛ Absalom. O ma n-daa nyɛ Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛshur Naa Talimai bipuɣiŋga la.
en: the second was Chileab, by Abigail, Nabals widow from Carmel; the third was Absalom, by Maacah, who was the daughter of Geshurs King Talmai.

dag: Amaa Dauda tɔbbihi maa bɛn daa kula Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Abinɛr tɔbbihi maa ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: David's men had killed of Abner's men from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni niŋ wuhi ni o yuri ti: O daa tim o Bi gaŋ na ni o ti chɛ ka ti nya nyɛvili o zuɣu.
en: This is how the love of God is revealed to us: God has sent his only Son into the world so that we can live through him.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la zaa m-pirigi li tinti Izraɛlnima kaman bɛ zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm ni di nyɛ bɛ fali. Ka tɔb tuhibu daa chɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya nyee vuhi.
en: So Joshua took the whole land, exactly as the LORD had promised Moses. Joshua gave it as a legacy to Israel according to their tribal shares. Then the land had a rest from war.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani yinima n-nyɛ niriba maa, ka yi yi kpi, yɛm ni kpi.
en: You think you are so great, with all the answers.

dag: Di doli daadamnim bɛn vuhim kul be bɛ nyɛhi ni kɔŋko la yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ bukaata nyɛ bɔ?.
en: Put no more confidence in mortals. What are they worth?.

dag: A teei teeku pa di zuɣu kaman binyɛrigu la, ka chɛ ka kom lim zoya.
en: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.

dag: Amaa ka Jona suhu daa miligi pam, ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: Jonah was not happy that God saved the city. Jonah became angry.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa daa garigi yɛl o, O ni ku padir biɛri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa ti padir shɛb bɛn ni zaŋ di daatam maa ti o di kpuɣibu saha.
en: The chief priests and leaders answered, He will kill them in some horrible way. Then he will rent out his vineyard to people who will give him his share of grapes at harvest time.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wurim buɣa, ka saɣim Mɛmfisi binnana la naai. Naa ti ku lan be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu n ni ti zaŋ dabiɛm niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The LORD God proclaims: I will destroy the idols and bring an end to the images in Memphis. Never again will there be a prince from the land of Egypt; so I will kindle fear in the land of Egypt.

dag: ka chɛ ka di ku pali mɔchɛriba nukura bee n-saɣi mɔbɔbilɔriba mɔbɔɣu.
en: no one gathers it up or carries it away in bundles.

dag: Ka ti daa lan yiɣisi nimaani m-be teeku maa ni chaŋ ti baɣisi Saipurus gari, dama ti daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: When we left Sidon, the winds were blowing against us, and we sailed close to the island of Cyprus to be safe from the wind.

dag: Niriba maa tɛha daa zommi; ka di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Naawuni daalikauli kurili la yɛla, lala chinchin yini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha, dama Masia kɔŋko zuɣu ka di ni tooi piligi.
en: But their minds were closed. Right up to the present day the same veil remains when the old covenant is read. The veil is not removed because it is taken away by Christ.

dag: Napombihi maa shɛli polo ni nyɛ kuriti, ka di shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri la, lala ka di nam maa yaɣ shɛli polo ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, ka di yaɣ shɛli polo mi gbarigi.
en: so that the toes were made from a mixture of iron and clay. Part of the kingdom will be mighty, but part of it will be fragile.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan yi o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu Taibɛrias Teeku ni. O ni daa yi bɛ zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: After this, Jesus appeared once more to his disciples at Lake Tiberias. This is how it happened.

dag: Ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ ti Duuma ni yuri shɛb la, di kpala talahi ni ti kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam, dama piligu ni ha ka Naawuni daa zali ya ni yi nya tiliginsim, yi ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli la yɛda ka Naawuni Shia Kasi mali ya ka yi be kasi la zuɣu.
en: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.

dag: Dama ti ŋmanila tulaale zim shɛli Masia ni zaŋ ti Naawuni ka di nyom gili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi la mini bɛn bɔrigi sani:.
en: Our offering to God is to be the perfume of Christ that goes out to those who are being saved and to those who are being lost.

dag: Teeku Ʒiɛɣu daa nyaya ka zo; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋmaligi lab di nyaaŋa.
en: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.

dag: Yiɣisim kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni ka bɛ ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: But get up and go into the city, where you will be told what you must do.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Lala tuhiya! Hal alizin biɛri gba niŋdi yɛda lala, ka zɔri dabiɛm.
en: You believe there is one God. Thats good, but even the demons believe that! And they shake with fear.

dag: Mani n-daa tiɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa pua bee mani n-daa dɔɣi ba, ka a ni yɛli ma, Kpuɣim ba buɣi kaman biyol ni buɣiri bimɔɣiriga shɛm la tahi a ni daa lo alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: I didn't create them or bring them to birth! Why should you ask me to act like a nurse and carry them in my arms like babies all the way to the land you promised to their ancestors?.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa nya alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum maa, ka lan wum ka bihi yɛriti saɣiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, Paɣimiya Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ! Ka di daa ku ba suli pam.
en: But when the chief priests and legal experts saw the amazing things he was doing and the children shouting in the temple, Hosanna to the Son of David! they were angry.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N ni yɛl a ni n nya a fiig tia gbin la zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? A ni ti nya binshɛŋa din gari lala.
en: Jesus said to him, Do you believe this just because I said I saw you under the fig tree? You will see much greater things than that.

dag: N kul ni yiini yila yɛr a yɛligu yɛla, dama a zaligunim zaa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Let my tongue declare your word, because all your commandments are righteous.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sab yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ niŋ Naawuni zaligu litaafi ni; ka bo kuɣ titali sɔŋ oki tia gbini nimaani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: and wrote them down in The Book of the Law of God . Then he set up a large stone under the oak tree at the place of worship in Shechem.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, bimmɔriŋ piɛlli yi be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu din chɛ ka nimaani kɔbiri leei zaɣ piɛla ka mari na be bimmɔriŋ maa ni.
en: who will examine you. If there is a white sore on your skin which turns the hairs white and is full of pus.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, yil yini puuni niriba anu noya ni ti woli. Niriba ata ni ti naai noli zaɣisi niriba ayi, ka niriba ayi mi ni ti zaɣisi niriba ata maa.
en: A family of five will be divided, with two of them against the other three.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Jɛhɔshafat, ka o niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ, ka moli molo ni sokam lom noli Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa.
en: Frightened, Jehoshaphat decided to seek the LORDs help and proclaimed a fast for all Judah.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o niriba maa chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti jɛm o. Amaa ka a na kul bi saɣi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Tell him, The Lord God of the Hebrews sent me to order you to release his people, so they can worship him in the desert. But until now, you have paid no attention.

dag: Ka teeku daa yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka o daa zaŋ bɛ zaa ni tum tuun shɛŋa n-kari ba saria.
en: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. All these people were judged by what they had done.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim maa daa gbaai tab naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu, ka jintɔriba maa noya daa woli taba.
en: These words aroused a dispute between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti ŋmaligi bɔhi yimaŋa, Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi bihi ŋɔ zaa ti ti? N daa kɔŋ m bihi. Bɛ daa zaŋ ma kulila tinzun tiŋa, ka ŋuni n-lee wumsi bihi ŋɔ zaa? N daa kpalimla n ko, ka ya ka bihi ŋɔ zaa lee yina? .
en: And you will think to yourself, Who bore me these? I was bereaved and desolate, exiled and sent off. So who raised these? I was left behind, I was alone; where were these?.

dag: saha shɛli n ni daa pii zuɣulaannim ka bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la. N ni nyaŋ a dimnim zaa. Din pahi nyɛla, n daa pun kahigi wuh a ni man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings.

dag: Wummi bɛ ni bɔhiri ma shɛm, Yawɛ yɛligu maa lee be ya? Chɛ ka ti wum li.
en: The people say to me, Where are those threats the Lord made against us? Let him carry them out now.

dag: Yinim tinvura ŋɔ! Yinim garinsi ŋɔ! Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ nti zo n-yi buɣim ni?.
en: You snakes! You children of snakes! How will you be able to escape the judgment of hell?.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti yili yila mali ya ansarisi, ka kum ni fabila pam yɛli, Ti bahi yoli zaa, Yawɛ taɣi n niriba fali ti shɛba. O deei li n sani. O piripiri ti puri tari bɛn gbahi ti maa. .
en: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.

dag: Ti Duuma yoomi yi suhuri ka yi baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka yi mali ʒiɛyimtali din nyɛ Masia dini.
en: May the Lord lead your hearts to express Gods love and Christs endurance.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yuri so, dilan zuɣu ni ka o kpahira kaman doo ni kpahir o ni yur o bidib so zuɣu ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa ŋub maa zaɣ chɛhi pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: So they gathered them all and filled twelve baskets with the pieces left over from the five barley loaves which the people had eaten.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka yi niŋ, ka n shini, ka yi tɛhi ni m bemi kaman yinim la. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n wuhi ya yi taali, ka galim ya.
en: Youve done these things and Ive kept quiet. You thought I was just like you! But now Im punishing you; Im laying it all out, right in front of your face.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti nabi n-yɛligi pali tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di saha bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka. Di yɛla ti ku lan be bɛ tɛha ni bee ka bɛ ti teei di yɛla. Bɛ ti ku lan zaŋ di yɛla muɣisi bɛmaŋa bee nti lan mali shɛli yaha.
en: Then when you have become numerous in that land, people will no longer talk about my Covenant Box. They will no longer think about it or remember it; they will not even need it, nor will they make another one.

dag: Tizɔriba kul zɔrimi doli taba, ka tuumba kul zɔri doli taba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Babilɔn naa ni bɛ deeg o tiŋ la zaa.
en: One messenger after another announces to the king, Babylon has been captured!.

dag: O daba maa bihi ni ti su li, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ti be nimaani.
en: The descendants of his servants will get that land. Those who love his name will live there.

dag: Di saha a yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, n ni garig a, bee chɛ ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, ka a garigi ma.
en: Speak first, O God, and I will answer. Or let me speak, and you answer me.

dag: Yi pala shɛli, ka yi tuma gba pa shɛli. Ŋunkam pii ya tum din chihira.
en: You and all you do are nothing; those who worship you are disgusting!.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kaman o ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa. N ni daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, yim ka vuri ti mɔni karikari, ka kɔba maa daa tuɣi taba, ka kɔbili kam daa chaŋ ti tuɣi di kpee.
en: I prophesied just as I was commanded. There was a great noise as I was prophesying, then a great quaking, and the bones came together, bone by bone.

dag: Amaa bɛ dɔɣila ninsalinim niŋ yɛlimuɣisira ni, kaman buɣim ni yi tahi yiɣi zuɣusaa shɛm la.
en: it's all part of life, like sparks shooting skyward.

dag: Ka dim pahi nyɛla: Bɛ daa lan ta n jɛmbu duu la daɣiri dindali maa, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa.
en: They also did this to me: On the same day, they made my sanctuary unclean and made my sabbaths impure.

dag: N ka galimi o sani; ka gbaai mmaŋa zaŋ chaŋ taali tumbu polo.
en: He knows that I am faultless, that I have kept myself from doing wrong.

dag: Niriba maa kanimina, ka bɛ chandi vuri ŋmani kom pam vuri, amaa o ni tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ zo n-chaŋ katiŋa. Bɛ ni zo kaman zoya zuɣu wurigu ni taŋkpa shɛli pɔhim mini sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe m-bahi.
en: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi Azimɔn maa n-zaŋ hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni m-mali lala hal ni teeku ni.
en: The border will then turn from Azmon to the Egypt ravine. Its limit will be at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Judanima, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Judanim maa nyaŋ ba.
en: The Israelites ran away, and God helped Judah's soldiers slaughter.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria ninvuɣ gahinda zaa nirilim, ka saɣim omaŋa o ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb kɔre maa buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: She sought them out to seduce them, all of them men of the highest rank of Assyria. She defiled herself by everyone she lusted after and also by all their idols.

dag: Di nyɛnya gbinnyaɣinima, amaa lee tummiya ni yi suhuri zaa, ka jɛmmiya ti Duuma.
en: As you serve the Lord, work hard and dont be lazy. Be excited about serving him!.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, A ni nya kulisi ko shɛŋa ka pagɔrili la du n-ʒi di zuɣu la nyɛla salo bɛn yi niriba balibu pam ni mini zuliyanim pam ni ni tinzun yɛligu pam nim ni na.
en: The angel also said to me, The waters you saw, on which the prostitute sits, are nations, peoples, races, and languages.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI poya o kasitali puuni yɛli, Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti gbahi ya n-vo n-chaŋ. Hal ziŋgɔhi ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ vo yi ni shɛb bɛn kpalim chaŋ.
en: The LORD God has solemnly promised by his holiness: The days are surely coming upon you, when they will take you away with hooks, even the last one of you with fishhooks.

dag: Ka o chɛ, ka chaŋ ŋun paya sani ti yɛl o kaman o ni yɛl o bikpɛm maa shɛm maa. Ka o saɣi yɛli, M ba, n ni chaŋ; amaa ka bi chaŋ.
en: The father said the same thing to the other son, who replied, Yes, sir. But he didnt go.

dag: Ka yi kul ni mali pam din ni chɛ ka yi tiri nirilim niŋbu pina, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni nya paɣibu ti ni niŋdi shɛm puuni;.
en: God will make you rich in every way so that you can always give freely. And your giving through us will make people give thanks to God.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ cheechi sɔŋdiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ mali biɛrisuŋ, ka di yɛri naŋgbanvoya ayiyi, ka di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyuri dam kuuna bee bɛn suhuri ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: Church helpers must also have a good character and be sincere; they must not drink too much wine or be greedy for money;.

dag: Salima pipihi din diba ayi kam daa bi ŋman taba ka bɛ daa mali nyuri binnyura. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ni nyuri wain shɛli pam ti niriba maa.
en: They served the drinks in cups made of gold, and each cup was different. The king made sure there was plenty of royal wine.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ ni yɛri Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim daalahichi yɛla shɛm galisiya.
en: Then the LORD said, The cries of injustice from Sodom and Gomorrah are countless, and their sin is very serious!.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa yi ninvuɣ yino so o ni daa nam la ni na, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka zali ʒiɛmana balibu kɔŋkɔba mini tiŋgbana tarisi.
en: From one person God made all nations who live on earth, and he decided when and where every nation would be.

dag: A nini ti yɛn nya li la, ka di chaŋ; dama yim ka di yɛn bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la.
en: When your eyes fly to wealth it is gone; it grows wings like an eagle and flies heavenward.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi maa daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia nti gbaag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: but the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. The Babylonians arrested Zedekiah, but his soldiers scattered in every direction.

dag: Ti daa tɛhiya ni di bemi kaman bɛ bahila noli ni bɛ kum ti la. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka ti ku zaŋ timaŋa n-dalim timaŋmaŋa, amaa ka ni zaŋ timaŋa n-dalimla Naawuni ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni la.
en: In fact, it seems like God has been telling us we are going to die. But this is so that we will not trust in ourselves but in God, who raises people from death.

dag: Ka tuuli malaika daa piɛb o kikaa, ka sakuɣa mini buɣim ni ʒim daa gari taba luri dunia ni, ka dunia tiŋgbani pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka tihi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka momaha zaa di buɣim.
en: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni naɣila o Bi gaŋ ŋun ʒi n-dalim o Ba Naawuni nyɔɣu la kɔŋko. Ŋuna n-wuhi ti Naawuni ni nyɛ so.
en: No one has ever seen God. The only Son is the one who has shown us what God is like. He is himself God and is very close to the Father.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Kɛdɛshi mini Dabɛrat ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa.
en: from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its pasturelands and Daberath with its pasturelands.

dag: A niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba, amaa di nyaaŋa ka bɛ labina ti bol a yuli, ka fabili niŋ a, ka suh a, duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: When your people Israel are defeated by their enemies because they have sinned against you and then when they turn to you and come to this Temple, humbly praying to you for forgiveness.

dag: Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛli, dina ka n gba yɛra. .
en: that even if you offered me a palace full of silver or gold, I would still obey the Lord . And I explained that I would say only what he told me.

dag: O min o niriba bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. O ni ti zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi takɔbiri lu Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku niriba yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Nebuchadnezzar and his people are the most terrible of the nations, and I will bring them to destroy Egypt. They will pull out their swords against Egypt. They will fill the land with dead bodies.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa vaai yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee ni suhuyiɣisili pam, ka daa bi di bindirigu goli palli daba ayi dali maa, dama Dauda yɛla daa muɣis o pam ni o ba ni daa dih o vi shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Jonathan got up from the table in a rage. He didnt eat anything on the second day of the new moon because he was worried about David and because his father had humiliated him.

dag: Ka Aduna daa kpuɣi Aminadab bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa nyɛ Nashɔn tizɔpaɣa ka o yuli booni Ɛlishɛba la, ka o daa dɔɣi Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron married Elisheba. Aaron and Elisheba gave birth to Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim chaŋ a vuhim shee, a min a kpiɔŋ alikauli adaka maa.
en: Get up, LORD, go to your residence— you and your powerful covenant chest!.

dag: N ku tooi niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim kaman yaɣimɛra maa ni niŋ shɛm maa? Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yaɣiri maa ni kul be yaɣimɛra maa nuu ni shɛm maa, lala ka yinim Izraɛlnim gba be n nuu ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: House of Israel, cant I deal with you like this potter, declares the LORD? Like clay in the potters hand, so are you in mine, house of Israel!.

dag: N yi zaŋ chibo paɣi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ bɔchaa paɣi n nuhi.
en: If I wash myself with snow, purify my hands with soap.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ pina tari nandaamba ni bɛ suhuri zaa, bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam. Bɛ ni duhi ba ti ba jilima.
en: He gives generously to the needy, and his kindness never fails; he will be powerful and respected.

dag: Dabiɛm vuri kul bela bɛ tiba ni, azichi pam puuni ka bahiyolilan yɛn liri ba.
en: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi ni Izraɛlnim zaa ni man Yawɛ ni zali shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Say to Aaron, to his sons, and to all the Israelites: This is what the LORD has commanded.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli biriginsim soli, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba pahi tuumbiɛrinim zuɣu n-darigi bɛ tibili. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: But as for those people who turn to their own twisted ways— may the LORD march them off with other evildoers! Peace be on Israel!.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bidibbila ka na pɔra m-be m ba sani, ka nyɛ m ma ni daa yuri so pam.
en: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father.

dag: Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, Pa mani n-nyɛ ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnima, amaa a min a daŋ niriba n-nahindi Izraɛlnima. Dama yinima n-zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka jɛmdila Baal buɣa.
en: Elijah answered, I have not made trouble for Israel. You and your fathers family caused all the problems when you stopped obeying the Lord s commands and began following the false gods.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ni daa di Izraɛl nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha ka Juda Naa Jɔash bia Naa Amazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ka bɛ daa daŋ tiŋgbani tibu kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa dola Juda mini Yisifu zuliya niriba tiŋgbana sunsuuni.
en: The territory belonging to the families of the tribe of Benjamin was the first to be assigned. Their land lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph.

dag: O zahindila puu pɔi ka naanyi da li. O zaŋdila o ni tum tuma nya laɣ shɛli n-ko wain tihi puu.
en: She surveys a field and acquires it; from her own resources, she plants a vineyard.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ ti vili baŋtab piɛla, ka so jinjɛm piɛla. Di bi simdi ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka woligu puhi ba lo bɛmaŋa.
en: They will have linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They wont wear anything that makes them sweat.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa gbani zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka suhi alibarika niŋ naa ni ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋya ni nyini n dan naa baɣa be n ni, a ni saɣi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni bɔri shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Joab bowed with his face on the ground. He blessed King David, and said, Today I know that you are pleased with me. I know because you have done what I asked.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, o daa gbahila Judanim ninvuɣ tusaata ni pisinaata.
en: This is the number of people whom Nebuchadnezzar deported: In the seventh year, , Judeans.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim Juda zuɣulaannima n-zaŋ ba du n-tam gooni maa zuɣu m-pirigi ba gbilligbilli ʒii buyi n-chɛ ka bɛ chani gindi gooni maa zuɣu m-paɣiri Naawuni. Bɛn daŋ tooni daa zaŋ kpala gooni maa zuɣu nudirigu polo n-zaŋ doli Saɣiri Dunɔdal la polo.
en: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.

dag: Ka n ti ka a sanna nimaani, chɛrubinim ayi bɛn be Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu la sunsuuni nti tɔɣis a n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti a ka a ti Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will meet you there, and from above the lid between the two winged creatures I will give you all my laws for the people of Israel.

dag: Banima n-lee be kaman mani? Bɛ wuhim li, bɛ wuhim li n tooni. Banima n-daa lee yɛli binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ yɛla zali kurimbuni ha. Bɛ yɛlim ti binshɛŋa din na yɛn niŋ yɛla.
en: Could anyone else have done what I did? Who could have predicted all that would happen from the very beginning to the end of time?.

dag: ni Magidiɛl ni Iram. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Ɛdom nanima.
en: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were Edoms tribal chiefs.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sanna. O saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ yɛm zaalana.
en: This lesson comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who gives wonderful advice. He is very wise.

dag: Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; dama n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ piɛlabihi ayi bɛn paai yuun yini m-mali suhudoo sara.
en: You will also offer one male goat for a sin offering and two one-year-old male lambs as a fellowship offering.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛl o dinkam niŋ o mini Haman ni daa yɛli ni o ni yo laɣ shɛli tariga ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ naa kpanjɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ ku Yɛhudianim zaa la yɛla.
en: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him. He spelled out the exact amount of silver that Haman promised to pay into the royal treasury. It was in exchange for the destruction of the Jews.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Magadan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Then Jesus sent the people away, got into a boat, and went to the territory of Magadan.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ daa naan ku chɛ li malibu? Ka niriba bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni lala yi daa shiri yi bɛ daalahichi ni, bɛ suhuri daa naan ku lan chihiri alahichi zuɣu.
en: If the law could make people perfect, those sacrifices would have already stopped. They would already be clean from their sins, and they would not still feel guilty.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Adɔnija saamba maa zaa, ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi, ka bɛ zaa yinoyino zaŋ kpa o kpabu polo.
en: All of Adonijahs guests were afraid and left very quickly.

dag: dindina yi ni nya suhupiɛlli man Yawɛ sani, ka n chɛ ka yi nya jilima dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa; ka chɛ ka yi di n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yab Yaakubu la daanfaani. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you could enjoy the Lord . As the Lord himself says, I could carry you up to the highest mountain and let you enjoy the land that I gave to your father Jacob.

dag: Bɛn mali kpiɔŋ tɔbiri kabisiya, ka ninvuɣ gbarima nya yaa.
en: Our Lord , you break the bows of warriors, but you give strength to everyone who stumbles.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lo a dabili alikauli ni a ni niŋ o zaɣ viɛlli ŋɔ.
en: You, Lord , are God, and you have made this wonderful promise to me.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanim maa daa yi bɛ sani lab alizanda ni, ka piɛguliba maa yɛli taba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti nya yɛl shɛli din niŋ ka ti Duuma yɛli ti ŋɔ.
en: When the angels returned to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, Lets go right now to Bethlehem and see whats happened. Lets confirm what the Lord has revealed to us.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabi kam maŋmaŋ yanim pun bi deer o.
en: I tell you this, Jesus added, prophets are never welcomed in their hometown.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa paɣi Yawɛ zama maa zaa ninni ka yɛli, Ti paɣiri nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yab Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: There in front of the whole assembly King David praised the Lord . He said, Lord God of our ancestor Jacob, may you be praised forever and ever!.

dag: Yɛm shɛli kani, tɛhi zilima shɛli kani, saawara shɛli mi kani din ni tooi nyaŋ Yawɛ.
en: Human wisdom, brilliance, insight—they are of no help if the Lord is against you.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɛli ya, Biɛhiŋ kani Yawɛ ni fa ti bahi, ka ku zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni, ka yi shiri niŋ Yawɛ naani di zuɣu.
en: Dont let Hezekiah persuade you to trust the LORD by saying, The LORD will certainly rescue us. This city wont be handed over to Assyrias king.

dag: Nyama, di pun sabimi ʒiɛya n sani, m bi yɛn shini, amaa n ni darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Look, here is a letter that lists all your sins. I will not be quiet until I pay you back for these sins. I will do it by punishing you.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Continuing, Elihu said.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan labina nya ka o nyaandoliba maa lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa wum ba pam, ka bɛ daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm.
en: Then he came back to the disciples and found them asleep; they could not keep their eyes open. And they did not know what to say to him.

dag: Dama n yɛn lumi maa, ka be biɛrim pam ni sahakam.
en: I know I am guilty of doing wrong. I cannot forget my pain.

dag: Man maŋmaŋ ni ti pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni, o ni zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk n-ta m biɛhigu shee daɣiri, ka dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi zuɣu.
en: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.

dag: dama yi yi gbihira, o ni ti paana libigi ya.
en: But if he comes suddenly, don't let him find you asleep.

dag: Ka a yi ti kanna, nyin zaŋmi m binyɛr tibisi shɛli n ni daa chɛ n-sɔŋ Kaapus sani Troas la m-mali ma na; ka zaŋ litaafinim la gba pahi na, di bahi bamdi gbandi la.
en: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o ni da pu shɛli ti Yawɛ, ka di pala o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli palo.
en: If you dedicate a field to the Lord that you had bought, and it is not a part of your familys property.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim sansan ni ka n yi n-zo na maa.
en: David asked, Where did you come from? The man answered, From Israel's army. I barely escaped with my life.

dag: Bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma zaa la niriba nini zuɣu, ka niŋdi bɛ ni piriti sab shɛŋa mini din pari bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu ka di nyɛ zaɣ yɛlima, ka chɛri ka bɛ binyɛra naŋgbanzusa nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣila.
en: The only reason they do what they do is for other people to see them. They make the little Scripture boxes they wear bigger and bigger. And they make the tassels on their prayer clothes long enough for people to notice them.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Tɔrokɔnima ayɔbu mini naɣilahi pinaayi din daa nyɛ bɛ sara na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Zuɣulaannim ayi kam daa laɣim sula tɔroko yini, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam su naɣila yino. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili tooni.
en: brought their offerings to the Lord : six wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for every two leaders and an ox for each leader. After they had presented them.

dag: Yisifu ni daa ti kuna, ka bɛ zaŋ pin shɛli din be bɛ sani maa kpɛhi ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ li ti o.
en: When Joseph came into the house, they presented him the gift they had brought with them into the house, and they bowed low in front of him.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ kɔhigɔriba gba ni ti kum ka fabili paɣ maa zuɣu, so ni bi lan dari bɛ nɛma zuɣu.
en: The merchants of the earth also cry and mourn for her, because no one buys their goods any longer;.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ni o buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni dol o zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa ka o ti bɛ yaannim la bee bɛ ku dol li.
en: Moses had told the Israelites what the Lord had commanded them to do, and now the Lord was using these nations to find out if Israel would obey.

dag: Teemiya Amalɛknim ni daa niŋ ya shɛm yi ni daa yi Ijipti na m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: Remember what the Amalekites did to you when you were coming from Egypt.

dag: Ka Juda daa bɔh o, N dana, wula ka ti lee lan yɛn yɛl a? Ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Bee wula ka ti yɛn tooi niŋ tɔɣisi yi? Naawuni nya tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ taali ni nyɛ shɛli; ti mini bɛ ni nya pipia ŋɔ so sani maa zaa leela nyini n dan daba.
en: Judah said, Sir, there is nothing we can say. There is no way to explain. There is no way to show that we are not guilty. God has judged us guilty for something else we have done. So all of us, even Benjamin, will be your slaves.

dag: N ku guhi, n ni niŋ yomyom dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I hurry to keep your commandments— I never put it off!.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛliya ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mɛbu saha na bi paai. .
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: These people say, The time hasnt come, the time to rebuild the LORDs house.

dag: Timiya pini, ka Naawuni ti yi gba; ka yi ni yɛn deei shɛli maa ni pali yi nuhi hal ti puuri bahira; dama yi ni zahindi binyara shɛm tiri yi taba, lala ka Naawuni ni ti zahim ti yi gba.
en: Give to others, and God will give to you. Indeed, you will receive a full measure, a generous helping, poured into your hands—all that you can hold. The measure you use for others is the one that God will use for you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yi ni baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ be yi sani, ka ni kari Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Hivinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Gɛrigashinim ni Amɔrinim ni Jɛbusinima.
en: Then Joshua said, This is how you will know that the living God is among you and will completely remove the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites before you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yiɣis o suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu pam ka ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: The LORDs anger blazed against them, and they went back.

dag: M mabihi, n daa naan ku tooi tɔɣisi ya kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, amaa n daa tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dolila daadam biɛhigu bee kaman bɛn na nyɛ biliɛri Masia dolibu ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I couldnt talk to you like spiritual people but like unspiritual people, like babies in Christ.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛli yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ o ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti na la:.
en: Hear this word that the LORD has spoken against you, people of Israel, against the whole family that I brought out of the land of Egypt.

dag: N ni zaŋ n jaaŋgbee taɣi ya, ka lɔn ya alikauli.
en: I will force each of you to obey the regulations of our solemn agreement.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul puɣisirila wuntizɔriba m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: The wicked are always looking for ways to kill good people.

dag: Rubin zuliya m-bala; bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaata ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: The total number of men in these family groups from the tribe of Reuben was .

dag: Nimaani ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa yi wulimpuhili polo kanna, di vuri daa ŋmanila kom din mali yaa vuri, ka o jilima daa neei tiŋgban ni.
en: where I saw the brightness of the glory of Israel's God coming from the east. The sound I heard was as loud as ocean waves, and everything around was shining with the dazzling brightness of his glory.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛtali yi suhuri ni ka tiligi. Nia biɛri maa kul yɛn bela yi ni sahakam?.
en: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans.

dag: Ŋuni ka m mal alizanda ni pah a zuɣu? Ka binshɛli mi ka dunia ŋɔ ni ka m bɔri li pah a zuɣu.
en: In heaven, God, I have only you. And if I am with you, what on earth could I want?.

dag: Ashaaranim kul yɛn tuɣila taba, ka bɛ kul wumdi ŋumaŋuma luɣilikam. Bɛ ti kul yɛn bɔrila ʒii nyabu anabinim sani. Maligumaaniba wuhibu ni ti naai, ka ninkura kpamli yɛtɔɣa ti naai.
en: You will hear one sad story after another. You will hear nothing but bad news. You will look for a prophet and ask him for a vision. The priests will have nothing to teach you, and the elders will not have any good advice to give you.

dag: N zaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ yiŋa, ka zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din ka kulim ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: I let the wild donkey have the desert for a home. I gave the salt lands to them for a place to live.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli buŋ maa, A ni dihi ma vi zuɣu. N yi di gbibi takɔbi n nuu ni, n naan ku a pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Balaam answered, Because you have made a fool of me! If I had a sword, I would kill you.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ bi wuhiri ni n zaani ya la zaligu, amaa n zaŋdila shɛb nini ni mooi bɛ tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla n-wuhiri ya ni n nya ni yi gba yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli.
en: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni bah a yoli zaa; o ni to n-kpuɣ a a yiŋ puuni yi nti chɛris a; o ni yih a dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But God will take you down permanently; he will snatch you up, tear you out of your tent, and uproot you from the land of the living! Selah.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya biɛri paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim din mali mihi piapia paɣ o.
en: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre! Sing praises to him with the ten-stringed harp!.

dag: Amaa ka yuŋ daa ti paai ka o zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Liya nti ti Yaakubu ka o zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: But that evening he brought Leah to Jacob, who married her and spent the night with her.

dag: A ni tum tuun kpɛma ka woligu yiri a ni ka a nyari bindirigu diri hal ti lab tiŋgbani maa ni, dama di ni ka a daa yina. Taŋkpaɣu n-nyɛ a, ka a ni ti lan lab taŋkpaɣu maa ni yaha.
en: by the sweat of your face you will eat bread— until you return to the fertile land, since from it you were taken; you are soil, to the soil you will return.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ li ka maligumaana sanna, ka maligumaana maa ti too li nukurigu pali n-yihi di chihili maa n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la zuɣu; di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You must bring the flour to the priest. The priest will take a handful of the flour as the memorial offering and bring it to the altar as a gift to the Lord . It is a sin offering.

dag: A ni tooi sɔŋ o yɛrigi sagbana ka di kpɛm kaman bɛ ni dooi diɣi la?.
en: Can you help God spread out the sky and make it shine like polished brass?.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nya ma, o nya ŋun tim ma na maa.
en: And everyone who has seen me has seen the one who sent me.

dag: Bɛ daa pun nyala o mini Trɔfimus Ɛfɛsus tiŋbia la tiŋ puuni, ka tɛhi ni Pool ʒi o kala Naawuni jɛmbu duu na.
en: They said this because they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian in the city with him earlier, and they assumed Paul had brought him into the temple.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, Yɛlimaŋli, a Naawuni maa shiri nyɛla ŋun gari wuna zaa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa Duuma ni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka a tooi kahig ashili ŋɔ gbinni wuhi ma maa.
en: The king said, Your God is the greatest of all gods, the Lord over kings, and the one who reveals mysteries. I know this because you have been able to explain this mystery.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din ni tiɣi Yawɛ nini gari nir yi zaŋ naɣila lantabili bee naɣilaa ni yila ni takarifiɛma mali sara.
en: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.

dag: Pukpara maa daa yaɣindila Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The farmer is like someone who plants Gods teaching in people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kul kpe Samaria puuni, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem niriba ŋɔ nina n-chɛ ka bɛ nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei bɛ nina maa, ka bɛ lihi nya ka bɛ bela Samaria puuni.
en: When all the soldiers were inside the city, Elisha prayed, Lord , now let them see again. The Lord let them see that they were standing in the middle of Samaria.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Timna ti nya Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga;.
en: One day Samson went down to Timnah, where he noticed a certain young Philistine woman.

dag: siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na tilig amaŋa.
en: So save yourself! Come down from that cross.

dag: Yisa daa ti be tin shɛl ni, ka kɔŋ ni daa wuligi do so niŋgbuŋ zaa ka o sanna ti damd o tooni balind o yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: One time Jesus was in a town where a very sick man lived. This man was covered with leprosy. When the man saw Jesus, he bowed before Jesus and begged him, Lord, you have the power to heal me if you want.

dag: Bɛ yi nahindi sarikanim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Don't trample prisoners under your feet.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hazɔrinima, zomiya chaŋ katiŋa, sɔɣimiya voya ni. Dama Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, ka mali shili gun ya.
en: Run away quickly! People in Hazor, find a good place to hide. This message is from the Lord . Nebuchadnezzar has made plans against you. He thought of a smart plan to defeat you.

dag: Ka a zaŋ o ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza, ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o yi tintariga ti kɔrig o o ninni.
en: Give that cow to Eleazar, and he will take it outside the camp and kill it there.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When you go into a house, stay there until it is time to leave.

dag: Ŋun yɛn fa ba bahi maa nyɛla kpiɔŋlana. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni lihi bɛ yɛlli maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka o ti dunianim vuhim, amaa o ku ti Babilɔnnim bɛn vuhim.
en: Yet their redeemer is strong; the LORD of heavenly forces is his name. He will surely defend their cause and give them rest in the land. But he will unsettle the people of Babylon.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣisiri nachimba ka bɛ niɛmdi zim, ka chɛ ka bidibisi ʒiri dabɔb kara chani ʒiɛhira.
en: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tirila yinim bɛn zaa be Rom n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka boli ya ni yi leeg o ninvuɣ gahinda la: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: And so I write to all of you in Rome whom God loves and has called to be his own people: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o paɣ Jɛzibɛl Ilaija ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa min o ni zaŋ takɔbi ku Baal daanabinim zaa shɛm yɛla.
en: King Ahab told his wife Jezebel everything that Elijah had done and how he had put all the prophets of Baal to death.

dag: Naa ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-yihiri ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋdi kaburi dari buri ba.
en: Like a farmer who separates wheat from the chaff, a wise king will decide who is wrong and crush them.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa ti ma. Ka o daa deei bia maa paɣ maa sani n-zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa o ni daa be du shɛl ni nti zaŋ o sɔŋ omaŋmaŋ garo zuɣu;.
en: Elijah replied, Give your son to me. He took her son from her and carried him to the upper room where he was staying. Elijah laid him on his bed.

dag: O ʒi n-niŋ zuliya shɛb lala; bɛ ʒi o zaligunima. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: God hasnt done that with any other nation; those nations have no knowledge of Gods rules. Praise the LORD!.

dag: Ijiptinim ni guui ka niŋdi vuri kaman wahu la, dama bɛ dimnim kabirimi kanna. Bɛ gbibila kpandi kanna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmari tihi la ni bɛ ti liri ba.
en: Egypt is like a snake hissing and trying to escape. The enemy comes closer and closer, and the Egyptian army is trying to slither away. The enemy will attack Egypt with axes, like men cutting down trees.

dag: Nyama, o garitila n sani, ka m bi nyar o; o chana, amaa ka m bi mi ni o beni.
en: God walks right past me, without making a sound.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi be o tooni, dabiɛm m-mali ma, ka n yi tɛhi o yɛla, dabiɛm m-mali ma.
en: Merely the thought of God All-Powerful.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ o niriba kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gul o ni pii na so la, ka tiligir o.
en: You give strength to your people, Lord , and you save and protect your chosen ones.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Hal man bi mi do so yi ni yɛri maa gba.
en: Then Peter said, I swear that I am telling the truth! May God punish me if I am not! I do not know the man you are talking about.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!.

dag: mini Jɛrusalɛm ni Idumia ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli polo hal zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn laɣim o sanna, bɛ ni daa wum o ni tumdi tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla zuɣu.
en: Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, beyond the Jordan, and the area surrounding Tyre and Sidon.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni fa yi ni gbibi yi bidibbin shɛŋa ni yi zaŋ tuhi Babilɔn naa mini Kalidianim bɛn teei gili ya yi gooni ŋɔ nyaaŋa ŋɔ labisi yi ya ŋɔ tiŋ puuni na.
en: The LORD, the God of Israel, says: Im going to turn your own weapons against you, yes, the weapons you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who have surrounded you! I will round them up in the center of the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi piim fɔntins ata maa.
en: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la daa wum ni Samarianim deei Naawuni yɛligu, ka daa tim Pita mini Jɔn bɛ sani.
en: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi gbilligbilli ʒini momaha zuɣu.
en: Jesus then told his disciples to make all the people divide into groups and sit down on the green grass.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn niŋ tipawumli kaman Ijiptinim mini Firawuna ni daa niŋ tipawumli shɛm la? O ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum jɛrilim la nyaaŋa, pa bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa ti chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ?.
en: Why be stubborn like the Egyptians and Pharaoh? After God had dealt harshly with them, didnt they send the Israelites on their way?.

dag: Bɔ ka Yɛhudianim lee zaŋ so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim? Bee gunibu buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: Do the Jews then have any advantage over the Gentiles? Or is there any value in being circumcised?.

dag: O tiligi n shia ka di bi faai siɣi gballi ni, ka n nyɛvili ni lan nya neesim.
en: He ransomed me from crossing into the pit; my life beholds light.

dag: Ka amiliya aŋgo maa daa ti yuui kandina, ka gom gbahi bɛ zaa ka bɛ gbihi.
en: The groom was late arriving, and the young women became drowsy and fell asleep.

dag: ka a daa wum n ni fabindi niŋd a maa. Di ŋar a tiba ka bi wum n ni kuhiri niŋd a ni a sɔŋ ma ŋɔ.
en: And when I begged you to listen to my cry, you heard.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yil shɛl ni o ni daa yɛn be, ka di ʒe saria karibu zɔŋ nyaaŋa la, lala ka bɛ daa me di gba. Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me yil shɛli ka di be kaman o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ me zɔn shɛl la n-ti o ni daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣin so la.
en: The royal residence where Solomon lived was behind this hall. It had a similar design. Solomon also made a similar palace for his wife, Pharaohs daughter.

dag: N dimnim zaa ni di vi, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam; di ku yuui ka bɛ di vi maa, ka ŋmaligi zo.
en: All my enemies will be filled with fear and shame. They will be sorry when disgrace suddenly comes upon them.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi dim bindirigu n-nya kpiɔŋ, dama yi ni so zabigu zaɣ yini ku bɔrigi.
en: I beg you, then, eat some food; you need it in order to survive. Not even a hair of your heads will be lost.

dag: Dauda ʒiɛman maa ni kum daa ti lu yuma ata doli taba. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ din tahi li. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Ninsalinim ʒim yihibu taali n-ʒi Naa Sool min o daŋ zuɣu, dama o daa ku Gibiɔnnima.
en: While David was king, there were three years in a row when the nation of Israel could not grow enough food. So David asked the Lord for help, and the Lord answered, Saul and his family are guilty of murder, because he had the Gibeonites killed.

dag: Bɛna n-daa su Alikauli Adaka la mini teebuli ni firilatamdigu ni sara maligu bimbina ni la shɛŋa maligumaaniba ni daa zaŋdi tumdi tuma la zaŋ tabili Pateesa la ni di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: Their job was to take care of the Holy Box, the table, the lampstand, the altars, and the dishes of the Holy Place. They also cared for the curtain and all the things that were used with the curtain.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋubi ba tiɣi; dama o daa ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu.
en: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.

dag: ka mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Then make a frame handbreadth wide around the table. And put gold trim on the frame.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla yi ni zaŋ yimaŋ ti so n-deer o noli daba? Di yi nyɛla alahichi tumbu din tahiri nir kum ni bee Naawuni noli deebu din zaŋdi nir zaani wuntia zaani, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Surely you know that you become the slaves of whatever you give yourselves to. Anything or anyone you follow will be your master. You can follow sin, or you can obey God. Following sin brings spiritual death, but obeying God makes you right with him.

dag: Amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda naɣila n ni kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Hal bɛ daa bi yɛli ma a yɛm din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla pirigili gba; a biɛhigu maa gari n ni daa wum a yɛla shɛm maa.
en: I did not believe it until I came and saw it with my own eyes. Now I see that it is even greater than what I heard. Your wealth and wisdom is much greater than people told me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va ba duhiduhi, ka bɛ nyɔni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: They began to rot, and the whole country began to stink.

dag: Yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali ni tuhi taba soli; ka wuntitali mini suhudoo mi puhi taba.
en: Gods love will come together with his faithful people. Goodness and peace will greet them with a kiss.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɔri maligunim buɣim, ka tumdi alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka bi deer o noli bee n-dol o zaligunim zaa la zuɣu ka yɛlibiɛɣu ŋɔ paai ya kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: This present disaster has come on you because you offered sacrifices to other gods and sinned against the Lord by not obeying all his commands.

dag: Ŋuna n-tuhi nyaŋ sokam zaa, ka chɛ ka ti su zuliya kam zaa.
en: He helped us defeat other nations. He put those people under our control.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni sa nya Nabɔt min o bihi ʒim sɔhila shɛm la, n ni bɔh a di biɛri puu ŋɔ ni labisi. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm o bahi puu maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Yesterday I saw Naboths blood and his sons blood, declares the LORD. I swear that I will pay you back on this very plot of ground, declares the LORD. Now pick him up, and throw him on that plot of ground, in agreement with the LORDs word.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka Babilɔn naa bɔɣiri niŋ kpiɔŋ, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna bɔɣiri niŋ bɔɣ zalima, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. N ni ti zaŋ n takɔbi niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o ti zaŋ li lu Ijiptinim zuɣu.
en: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall. They will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he uses it against the land of Egypt.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla neen yinsi din nyɛ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛli viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tum tuun yinsi maa n wuɣi shɛlɔrigu niŋ di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: The vests belt was attached to it and made in the same way of gold, of blue, purple, and deep red yarns, and of fine twisted linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla o yiko yaɣ shɛli polo, ka ti ni wumd o yɛla shɛm pɔra pam. Amaa o yiko din galisi ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li.
en: These are only a few of the amazing things God has done. We hear only a small whisper of Gods thundering power.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ doli Naawuni ni daa yɛli shɛm la: Yaakubu ka n yura, ka je Iso.
en: As it is written, I loved Jacob, but I hated Esau .

dag: ni Makɛda naa ni Bɛtɛl naa.
en: Makkedah, Bethel.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb la ni daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli na tibisim daa nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni pihita kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The silver from the census of the community weighed , pounds, weighed according to the official standard.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee n-garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Then the whole group who met together answered Ezra. They shouted, Ezra, you are right! We must do what you say.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va bɛ kɔba ti sɔɣi Jabɛshi tiŋ puuni tamarisik tia gbini, ka lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: They buried the bones under a small tree in Jabesh, and for seven days, they went without eating to show their sorrow.

dag: Naawuni, n ni zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ shɛli ti a la ti a. N ni zaŋ wumpaɣibo pini ti a.
en: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.

dag: Ka o daa zom dabisi muna ata, ka bi di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: For three days he was not able to see, and during that time he did not eat or drink anything.

dag: Yawɛ dabisi titali la miriya. Di miriya, ka kanna yomyom. Ka Yawɛ dabisili maa kandina ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu pam, ka tɔbbihi ni ti ŋme tɔbuchiriga dindali maa.
en: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ni o binyɛri bɔribɔri n-kpɛhi naa sani; ka o zɔnim bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi dol o.
en: In robes of many colors, she is led to the king. Her attendants, the young women servants following her, are presented to you as well.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa zo ka chɛ Yisa, ka malaikanim kana ti kpaŋs o suhu.
en: Then the Devil left Jesus; and angels came and helped him.

dag: Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa ka di galisi pam, di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi zahim baŋ bɛ ni zaŋ daanya shɛm tariga mal li.
en: Due to the very large number of objects, Solomon didnt even try to weigh the bronze.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nti yɛn kari dunia ŋɔ nim saria? Ka yinima n-yi nyɛ bɛn ni ti kari dunianim saria, dindina yi ku tooi kari yimaŋmaŋ sunsuuni yɛtɔɣ bihi saria?.
en: Dont you know that Gods people will judge the world? So if you will judge the world, then surely you can judge small arguments like this.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli ka di yɛri nam ʒiishee maa gbini, Nyama, Naawuni biɛhigu shee bela ninsalinim sani. Ka o ni be bɛ sani, ka bɛ nyɛ o niriba, ka ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ mi ni be bɛ sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni;.
en: I heard a loud voice from the throne. It said, Now Gods home is with people. He will live with them. They will be his people. God himself will be with them and will be their God.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m paɣa duɣi dihi do so, ka chɛ ka do so dɔn o.
en: then may my wife grind for another and others kneel over her.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛr ya shɛm ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi ti boli buɣili yuli n-jɛm li bee n-chɛ ka so wum lala yɛtɔɣa yi noya ni.
en: Be careful to obey everything that I have said to you. Dont call on the names of other gods. Dont even mention them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa teeg o nuu kpuɣi sua ni o kɔrig o bia maa.
en: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi lee tɛhi? Do so n-daa mali bidibis ayi nti chaŋ o bikpɛm sani ti yɛl o, M bia, cham m puu ni ti tum tuma zuŋɔ.
en: Tell me what you think about this: There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first son and said, Son, go and work today in the vineyard.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni nya yi daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I write to you, my children, because your sins are forgiven for the sake of Christ.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni n yula pina deebu hali, amaa n lee bɔrimi ni yi nya laara pahi.
en: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daai di gooni din gil li la luhi, ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa gariti nimaani pɔhiri di wala?.
en: So why have you now torn down its walls so that all who come along can pluck its fruit.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pa liɣiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ dan ya leei daba maa. Dinzuɣu pa liɣiri ka n yɛn zaŋ yo yi zuɣu n-yihi ya dabitim maa ni.
en: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.

dag: N ni yiɣisi labi m ba sani nti yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani.
en: I will get up and go to my father, and say to him,Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

dag: Alikizanda ŋun nyɛ daanya doora la daa tum ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam; ti Duuma ni bɔh o biɛri labisi o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.

dag: N kɔre lan ka di zaa ni, di nyɛla bindir shɛŋa din bi luhi n kpaɣa.
en: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia nyɛla ŋun nyandi dunia ŋɔ. Ti yɛda niŋbu mi n-nyɛ din nyandi dunia ŋɔ.
en: because everyone who is a child of God has the power to win against the world. It is our faith that has won the victory against the world.

dag: Ka Obadia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab, ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti nya Ilaija.
en: Obadiah left and told Ahab where to find Elijah. Ahab went to meet Elijah.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun yɛli ya ka yi bi niŋ yɛda. N ni mali m Ba yuli tumdi tuun shɛŋa maa n-diri ma shɛhira;.
en: Jesus answered, I have told you, but you dont believe. The works I do in my Fathers name testify about me.

dag: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi maa daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm, ka bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba tusaata.
en: The people from the tribe of Levi obeyed Moses. That day about of the people died.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti nya Yisa duli din maa polo bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ saha ka a ka kpe na.
en: When the people found Jesus on the other side of the lake, they said to him, Teacher, when did you get here.

dag: Babilɔnnima n-daa niŋ lala maa; pa Asirianim n-daa zaŋ Taai leei mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri biɛhigu shee. Babilɔnnim n-daa me bimbina din du n-tabili bɛ goma, ka daai Taai birini mini di nayiya luhi; ka di lu n-dahim.
en: Look at the land of the Chaldeans, the people who are no more. Assyria destined it for wild animals: they raised up their siege towers, stripped its palaces, and made it a ruin.

dag: Yi pun wum n ni daa mali biɛhigu shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa doli Yɛhudianim adiini sol la yɛla. N daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka pam, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n saɣim li.
en: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi lee ŋmɛri maa.
en: Jesus asked, What are you arguing about.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun saɣisiri ma ŋɔ, ka n suhu ni tɛha mi wuhiri ma yuŋ.
en: I praise the Lord , because he guides me, and in the night my conscience warns me.

dag: Benya yɛm biɛhigu bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm.
en: Be wise in the way you act toward those who are not believers, making good use of every opportunity you have.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa ti nya ka Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so ti Ibrahimma la min o bia Yisahaku diɛmda.
en: Sarah saw Hagars son playing.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Musa taali, ka yɛra, Tim ti kom ka ti nyu. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Wula ka yi zaŋ ma taali? Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi Yawɛ.
en: So they turned against Moses and started arguing with him. They said, Give us water to drink. Moses said to them, Why have you turned against me? Why are you testing the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni zɔri ti Duuma zuɣu ka ti kpamdi niriba jaande; amaa Naawuni mi ti biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka ti mali tahima ni yi gba mi li yi suhuri ni.
en: So we try to persuade people, since we know what it means to fear the Lord. We are well known by God, and I hope that in your heart we are well known by you as well.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a niriba yi yuŋ chaŋ mɔɣu ni nti sɔɣ dɔni gu ba.
en: So now you and your men should come tonight and hide in the fields outside the city.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba tah o tiŋgbɔn kasi ni zoya tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ o nudirigu tuhi fa la ni.
en: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.

dag: Niriba kul paɣir a mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka a yuli du pam dunia ŋɔ zaa ni; ka a doli yɛlimaŋli soli su nam.
en: You are praised by people everywhere, and your fame extends over all the earth. You rule with justice;.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dundɔŋ ni dunoli din kpa wulimpuhili polo la din kul yɛn yomi ʒiɛya dabisa ayɔbu din nyɛ tuma tumbu dabisa la ni. Amaa Vuhim Dabisili dali mini goli palli tuuli dabisili dali, di simdi ni di yooi.
en: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.

dag: Daba anii dali, di simdi ni o bo piɛlah ayi bɛn ka dansi mini piɛsaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛl ni kilɔgiram ata ni kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim zuɣu.
en: On the eighth day, that person must take two flawless male sheep, one flawless one-year-old ewe, a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of choice flour mixed with oil, and one log of oil.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla tarimba ni yino bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-kpe taali ni.
en: If any of you people sin and become guilty of breaking one of the Lord 's commands without intending to.

dag: O chɛ ka Lɛbanɔn zoya yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman naɣibil la; ka chɛ ka Siriɔn Zoli gba yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman yɔnaɣila bil la.
en: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa paɣ o binyɛra ka su kom, ka naanyi kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee; amaa ka maligumaana maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: After the ceremony, the priest is to take a bath and wash his clothes. Only then can he go back into the camp, but he remains unclean and unfit for worship until evening.

dag: N daa kuhi boli n zɔnima, amaa ka bɛ yɔhim ma. M maligumaaniba mini n kpamba daa kpila tiŋ maa ni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bɔri bindirigu ni bɛ di n-nya yaa la.
en: I called out to my lovers, but they tricked me. My priests and my elders have died in the city. They were looking for food for themselves. They wanted to keep themselves alive.

dag: Dama ti yi di bi kpalim ʒiya, ŋ-ŋɔ ti di pun chaŋ pahi buyi ka labina.
en: If we had not wasted all this time, we could already have been there and back twice.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni yɛn nam zuɣusaa zaɣ palli shɛli mini dunia palli shɛl la ni yɛn yuui shɛm, lala ka yi zuliya ni yi yuli yɛn yuui.
en: The Lord says, I will make a new world—new heavens and a new earth—that will last forever. In the same way, your names and your children will always be with me.

dag: Di saha ka waɣ biɛ titali maa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi paɣ maa zuɣu, ka o lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi paɣ maa zuliya bɛn kpalim n-nyɛ bɛn doli Naawuni zaligunima ka mali Yisa shɛhira la.
en: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.

dag: Mani n-su anzinfa mini salima zaa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All the silver and gold of the world is mine.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa sanna Kadɛshi Paran mɔɣu ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ chandi yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli bɛ mini niriba maa zaa, ka zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwala wuhi ba.
en: They went directly to Moses, Aaron, and the entire Israelite community in the Paran desert at Kadesh. They brought back a report to them and to the entire community and showed them the lands fruit.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa shiri niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza.
en: All these things happened to King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛlnim zuliya dunoli kam dɔɣirikpamba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: So Moses, Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and all the leaders of the tribes of Israel heard them make that promise.

dag: kaman bɛ yaannim la, bɛ daa bemi kaman tɔb shɛli din naɣilimnaɣilim.
en: They turned against him and were unfaithful just like their ancestors. They changed directions like a boomerang.

dag: Dama bɛ ku Yaakubu zuliya, ka wurim bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: For they have killed your people; they have ruined your country.

dag: A bidibisi yi ni gbibi n daalikauli maa mini n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa wuhi ba, bɛ bidibisi gba ni ti ʒiini a nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu sahakam.
en: If your sons are true to my covenant and to the commands I give them, their sons, also, will succeed you for all time as kings.

dag: ka di yi ti lan puhi situra maa ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli maa ni yaha, di yɛligirimi maa, yin zaŋmiya dɔro maa ni be binshɛli ni maa nyo buɣim.
en: Then, if the mildew reappears, it is spreading again, and the owner shall burn the object.

dag: Saipurusinim ni ti kpe ŋarima kana ti liri ya. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ashurinim mini Ɛbanima. Amaa bɛ gba ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Ships from Kittim will attack Asshur; they will attack Eber, and even he will perish forever.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi yi nya n yura maa, yi ni yɛl o ni n lula bole o zuɣu.
en: I tell you, women of Jerusalem, if you find my lover, tell him I am weak with love.

dag: Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ; amaa ka yalim yi ti niŋ piti, wula ka yi lee yɛn niŋ chɛ ka di lan nyaɣisi yaha? Chɛliya ka yalim be yi ni, ka yi mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: Salt is good; but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have the salt of friendship among yourselves, and live in peace with one another.

dag: Di saha ka Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la daa zaŋ bɛ tulaale zim tuɣindi bina m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ buɣim din bi be kasi mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di pa o ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: Now Nadab and Abihu, two of Aarons sons, each took an incense pan. They put fire and incense on them and offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, which he had not commanded them.

dag: Yɛnnim gbaarila bɛmaŋa n-yiri zaɣ biɛɣu ni, amaa jɛra bɛn baɣa kani, ka bi gbaari bɛmaŋa.
en: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.

dag: N lee bɔrila paɣibu ninsalinim sani bee Naawuni sani? Bee n kpaŋdi mmaŋ ni n tiɣila ninsalinim nini? N yi na kul tiɣiri ninsalinim nini, dindina n ku tooi nyɛ Masia dabili.
en: Does this sound as if I am trying to win human approval? No indeed! What I want is God's approval! Am I trying to be popular with people? If I were still trying to do so, I would not be a servant of Christ.

dag: Amaa benya kaman tihi la m-mali wala yi biɛhigu ni din ni wuhi ni yi shiri niŋ tuuba ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Produce fruit that shows you have changed your hearts and lives.

dag: Yi ni tooi bɔhi yimaŋa, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bi yɛli.
en: You might be thinking, How can we know if something a prophet says is not from the Lord .

dag: Ka sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la ni zaŋ yaɣ yini tariga hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: The middle brace should pass through the frames from one end to the other.

dag: Hal o ni ti chaŋ ti liri Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la gba n-ku niriba tuhi pii nimaani. Amaa kulla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ Ɛdom mini Mɔab ni Ammɔn zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn kpalim kɔŋko n-ni ti yi o nuu ni.
en: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.

dag: n ni daa po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛl a A bia Sulemaana ni ti di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-zani n zaani ʒini n nam ʒiishee la, n ni niŋ lala zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: that today I will keep the promise I made to you in the name of the Lord , the God of Israel, that your son Solomon would succeed me as king.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka di zanila dabari, ka di nyɛ dabari n-fabindi niŋdi ma. Tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zanila dabari, amaa ka so baɣa kani.
en: They have devastated her; desolate, she cries out to me in distress: The whole land is desolate, and no one seems to care.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni a mali taali, pa mani n-yɛli. Amaŋmaŋ naŋgbampiba n-di shɛhira jɛnd a.
en: I dont need to prove to you that you are wrong. The words from your own mouth show that you are wrong. Your own lips speak against you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa zali ya zaligu yɛli, Hal Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ni yi su ŋɔ zaa yoli, lomiya kpara gari yi mabihi Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tooni chaŋ ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili.
en: At that time I gave those tribes this command: The Lord your God has given you the land on this side of the Jordan River to live in. But now your fighting men must take their weapons and lead the other Israelite tribes across the river.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ piɛbil so ŋun ka galimi bee liɣisibu la ʒim din mali shaara la ka o daa zaŋ pa talima tiligi ya.
en: it was the costly sacrifice of Christ, who was like a lamb without defect or flaw.

dag: Fam ma gbuɣinli nol ni bahi! Fam ma yɔnaɣilahi yila ni bahi.
en: Rescue me from these lions; I am helpless before these wild bulls.

dag: Di saha maa kpariba daa chɛla bɛ tuma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ka nyin Dɛbɔra ti yiɣisi. O daa yiɣisiya m-bemi kaman Izraɛlnim ma la.
en: and villagers couldn't work in their fields. Then Deborah took command, protecting Israel as a mother protects her children.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lihi nya ka dɔbba ata ʒiɛya mir o. O ni daa nya ba maa, ka o yiɣis o tanti suɣili dunoli maa ni n-zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti damdi ba tiŋa.
en: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. He quickly ran to meet them, bowed with his face to the ground.
