dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bini paligi li la ni di ni lu. Sa titali ni mi, ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe.
en: Tell them that I will send hail and a strong rain. The wind will blow hard, and a tornado will come. Then the wall will fall down.

dag: Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna ni bɛ su li. Pina sara shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi mali nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la n-daa nyɛ bɛ tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛl o shɛm.
en: The tribe of Levi is the only tribe that did not get any land. Instead, the Levites were given all the animals offered by fire to the Lord , the God of Israel. That is what the Lord promised them.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpansi mi n-daa nyɛ Itam mini Ain ni Rimɔn ni Tochɛn ni Ashan, di daa nyɛla tins anu.
en: They also lived in five other places: Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Judanima, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi zo n-kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home.

dag: Naawuni daa pun daŋ piig o mi pɔi ka naanyi ti nam dunia ŋɔ, amaa ka o daa lee ti yi palo la ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni yi zuɣu.
en: Christ was chosen before the creation of the world, but was only revealed at the end of time. This was done for you.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu yi ti ʒiɛra, ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.

dag: bee n-suh o galli, ka o gbaai nɔŋa ti o?.
en: If a child asked for an egg, what father would give the child a scorpion?.

dag: Dimiya binnɛɔŋ kam. N ni zaŋ ʒiɛvari tin ya shɛm lala ka n zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa tin ya.
en: Now you can eat them, as well as green plants; I give them all to you for food.

dag: Naa Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa ti wum ni o bia Ahazia kpiya, ka o dii yiɣisi gbaai nabihi kubu.
en: As soon as King Ahaziah's mother Athaliah learned of her son's murder, she gave orders for all the members of the royal family to be killed.

dag: Ka Abishai daa yɛli Dauda, Naawuni zaŋ a dim maa niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ; dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n kul zaŋ kpani ŋɔ kuh o yim tabili tiŋa, m bi yɛn kuh o buyi.
en: Abishai said to David, God has handed your enemy over to you today! Let me pin him to the ground with my spear. One stroke is all I need! I wont need a second.

dag: Buɣim ni ti din ya nimaani, ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ŋmahi ya. Di ni ti din ya kaman toli la. Nabimiya kaman toli la, ka nabiya kaman sakɔri la.
en: No matter what you do, you will still be burned to death or killed in battle. You will be wiped out like crops eaten up by locusts. You multiplied like locusts!.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai luɣ shɛli ka wuntaŋ lu ka o kpalim gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ. O daa piila kuɣ yini nimaani sɔŋ n-dɔni zaŋ o zuɣu kuɣ li gbihi.
en: At sunset he stopped for the night and went to sleep, resting his head on a large rock.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Doliya Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu, ka miriya ka yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma soli.
en: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.

dag: Di chaŋ wula ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaani kpiimba zaani n-deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba? Kpiimba yi bi neeri kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka shɛb deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba?.
en: If no one will ever be raised from death, then what will the people do who are baptized for those who have died? If the dead are never raised, then why are people baptized for them?.

dag: M bɔhirila bɔhigu ŋɔ: Bɛ daa bi wum? Bɛ daa wumya ni yɛlimaŋli; dama di sabiya: Bɛ kukoya damli gili dunia ŋɔ zaa; ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ tarisi zaa.
en: But I ask, Did those people not hear the Good News? Yes, they heard—as the Scriptures say, Their voices went out all around the world. Their words went everywhere in the world. Psalm :.

dag: N ŋmanila Sharɔn tutuɣu din pum viɛli pam, ka ŋmani vinvamli ni Paɣiviɛligakushihikom.
en: Im a rose of the Sharon plain, a lily of the valleys.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na ni ti kɔri bɛ puri nimaani.
en: Anyone who lives in the city, no matter which tribe he comes from, may farm that land.

dag: Dama o daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ o sɔŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I caused the king of Egypt to terrorize the living, but he and all his army will be killed and laid to rest with all the uncircumcised who die in battle. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti paai Jɔnatan ni to piɛm maa bahi luɣ shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan bol o n-yɛl o, Pa piɛm maa m-be a tooni maa ha.
en: When the boy reached the place where the arrow had fallen, Jonathan shouted to him, The arrow is farther on!.

dag: Kum mihi daa vili ma, ka kokpɛɣu din ni di nir varisi ma.
en: The danger of death was all around me; the waves of destruction rolled over me.

dag: dama o zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim pam daa chɛ bɛ zuɣulaannima ka niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: It was because of Lazarus that many of the Jews had deserted them and come to believe in Jesus.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Yawɛ di ma shɛhira, ka o ni pii na so ŋɔ gba di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi bi nya galimi shɛli m biɛhigu ni. Ka bɛ daa saɣi, Iin, o di shɛhira.
en: Samuel said to the Israelites, The Lord and his chosen king are witnesses today. They heard what you said—that you found nothing wrong with me. The people answered, Yes, the Lord is witness.

dag: Ti ni zaŋ alikama din bi viɛli kɔhi shaara, ka zaŋ liɣiri da tarimba, ka zaŋ namda diba ayiyi n-taɣi nandaamba.
en: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.

dag: Izraɛl daa yuri Yisifu pam gar o bihi bɛn kpalim maa zaa, o ni daa nyɛ o ni dɔɣi bi so o kuriginsim saha la zuɣu. O daa shɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din baɣiri wɔɣa n-ti o.
en: Jacob loved Joseph more than all his other sons, because he had been born to him when he was old. He made a long robe with full sleeves for him.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Yinim Dauda zuliya ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, yi ni niŋdi shɛm chɛ ka ninsalinim nyee nyooni la, lala ka yi bɔri ni yi niŋ chɛ ka n Naawuni ŋɔ gba nyee nyɔni.
en: To that Isaiah replied, Listen, now, descendants of King David. It's bad enough for you to wear out the patience of people—do you have to wear out God's patience too?.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Shihira ni ti be wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni; ka wahala ni ti be dunia ni hal ka zuliya kam ti birim teeku kɔgbana vubu zuɣu;.
en: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars. On the earth, there will be dismay among nations in their confusion over the roaring of the sea and surging waves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Zɛrɛd vinvamli ni.
en: and then in the Zered Gorge.

dag: amaa ka di ni nyɛla bɛ ni nyari yi biɛrisuŋ zaŋ tabili yi ni luri ba sizuura Naawuni zuɣu shɛm la zuɣu.
en: because they will see how pure and reverent your conduct is.

dag: Molimiya nolɔbo molo; laɣimmiya salo maa zaa na! Laɣimmiya kpamba mini bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la ni nti kum niŋ ŋun Yawɛ.
en: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa o ni daa suh o shɛlikam m-pahi ŋun Naa Sulemaana ni daa pun niŋ o nirilim ti o pin shɛŋa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o min o niriba daa lab kul o ya Shiiba.
en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she asked for. He gave her more than she brought to give him. Then the queen of Sheba and her servants left and went back to their own country.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa lan yɛli niriba maa, N kɔŋko n-kul kpalim nyɛ Yawɛ daanabi, amaa ka Baal ŋun mali anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu.
en: Elijah said to the people, I am the last of the LORDs prophets, but Baals prophets number four hundred fifty.

dag: Amaa bɛ buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛŋa.
en: Their gods are made of silver and gold, formed by human hands.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni labisi yi daazichi tin ya ka zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka laɣim ya yihi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb zaa ni la na.
en: Then the Lord your God will be kind to you. The Lord your God will make you free again! He will bring you back from the nations where he sent you.

dag: N kul ku tam a zaligunim maa yɛla; dama di zuɣu ka a ti ma nyɛvili.
en: I will never forget your precepts because through them you gave me life again.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka Musa daa piligi kahigiri zaligunim ŋɔ wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: It was while the people were east of the Jordan in the territory of Moab that Moses began to explain God's laws and teachings. He said.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa yɛli ba, Aai, n duumanima, n suhiri ya.
en: But Lot said to them, No, my lords, please.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni tuɣili Ijiptinima, ka bɛ tuhi taba. Nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee ni tuhi taba, ka tins ayinim tuhi taba, ka nanim tuhi taba.
en: I will punish Egypt with civil war— neighbors, cities, and kingdoms will fight each other.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Zɔri, wula ka a lee niŋ hal ti kpe kpe na ni ka bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ binyɛrigu? Ka o kɔŋ garigibu.
en: The king said, Friend, how were you allowed to come in here? You are not wearing the right clothes. But the man said nothing.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa chaŋ ti neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti; tiligim ti.
en: The disciples went to him and woke him up. Save us, Lord! they said. We are about to die.

dag: Kiriatibaal mini Raba gba daa beni: di daa nyɛla fɔntiŋ kara ayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: The people of Judah were also given the two towns of Rabbah and Kiriath Baal .

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya niriba ayi ka bɛ ʒe m-baɣi mɔɣili, yino daa ʒɛla yaɣ yini polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe yaɣ din la polo.
en: I, Daniel, looked and suddenly saw two other figures—one standing on each side of the stream.

dag: Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa yɛli Karia bia Jɔhanan, Di niŋ lala, dama ʒiri ka a ŋma m-pa Ishimail maa.
en: Gedaliah answered, Don't kill Ishmael! What you've said about him can't be true.

dag: Dama naa yɛtɔɣa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka so ku tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Because the kings word has authority, no one can say to him, What are you doing.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ti Duuma suɣilɔdibo la nyɛla din tin ya dahima ni yi tiligi kaman ti mabiyurigu Pool ni daa sab shɛm tin ya Naawuni ni ti o yɛn shɛl la puuni la.
en: Look on our Lord's patience as the opportunity he is giving you to be saved, just as our dear friend Paul wrote to you, using the wisdom that God gave him.

dag: dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun kul tumdi lala yi ni ni o chɛ ka yi saɣ o yubu, ka tin ya yiko ka yi tooi tum o ni yu shɛm.
en: because God is always at work in you to make you willing and able to obey his own purpose.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli pam daa be Jɛrusalɛm; dama Naa Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman nyaaŋa, bɛ daa bi lan laɣim laɣiŋgu maa tatabo Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: The city of Jerusalem was filled with joy, because nothing like this had happened since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.

dag: Dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni ku n-naai n ni kari ya tahi zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa balibu. Amaa yinim bɛna, n ku naai yi balibu. N kul ni darigila yi tibili kaman di ni simdi shɛm. N kul ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu.
en: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: A daa zaŋ a situra maa shɛli n-dih a buɣa jɛmbu shee nachiinsi n-dɔni di zuɣu n-tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: You took your beautiful clothes and used them to decorate your places for worship. And you acted like a prostitute there. You gave yourself to every man who came by!.

dag: Dama zuliya kam jɛmdila bɛ wuna, amaa tinim ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Each nation worships and obeys its own god, but we will worship and obey the Lord our God forever and ever.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, labisim doo maa paɣa ti o; dama o nyɛla anabi, ka o suhi Naawuni ti a ka a be. Amaa a yi bi labis o ti o, nyin baŋmi ni biɛhiŋ kani a min a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni kpi.
en: So give Abraham his wife again. He is a prophet. He will pray for you, and you will live. But if you dont give Sarah back to him, I promise that you will die. And all your family will die with you.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali gali sabilifaa bee gali ʒiɛkpeein bee gali ʒiɛkpain bee tan piɛl viɛlli bee buhi kɔbiri bee bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛ gban shɛŋa bee teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana daa zaŋ li na.
en: And everyone who had blue or purple or deep red yarn or fine linen or goats hair or rams skins dyed red or beaded leather brought them.

dag: N lan nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhiri binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla. Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa mi n-zaŋ o yaa maa n-nahind o taba.
en: I saw all this. I thought very hard about the things that happen in this world. I saw that people always struggle for the power to rule others, and this is bad for them.

dag: Ti piligima n-lan tibigiri timaŋ yaha? Bee di nyɛla talahi ni ti tin ya shɛhira gbana bee n-deei shɛhira gbana yi sani kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.

dag: N kahigi n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi; n suhu saɣimya n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Yes, I confess my wrongdoing; Im worried about my sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni yihi ya Ijiptinim dabitim maa ni. N ni teei n nuu tum tuun kara n-darigi bɛ tibili ka tiligi ya.
en: Here is my message for Israel: I am the Lord ! And with my mighty power I will punish the Egyptians and free you from slavery.

dag: Ka o mi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba, dama o nyɛla ŋun mi shɛlikam. O bi yɛri ka labiri nyaaŋa. O ni darigi tuumbiɛtumdiba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋdi ba ka bɛ tumdi tuumbiɛri maa tibili.
en: But God also knows how to bring disaster; he has not taken back his words. God will rise up against the house of evildoers and against the help of those who do wrong.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa maa niriba maa ninni.
en: Aaron told them everything that the Lord had said to Moses, and then Moses performed all the miracles in front of the people.

dag: ka ku yɛl o mi ni o malim shili n-zaŋ a bindirigu na ti zal a, ka a di ka nyu pɔi ka o mi naanyi chaŋ ti ʒini di ka nyu?.
en: Wouldnt you say instead, Fix my dinner. Put on the clothes of a table servant and wait on me while I eat and drink. After that, you can eat and drink?.

dag: Ka Pool daa yɛli ba, Jɔn daa baptaizirila niriba tuuba niŋbu zuɣu, ka yɛri ba ni bɛ niŋm Yisa ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa na la yɛda.
en: Paul explained, John baptized with a baptism by which people showed they were changing their hearts and lives. It was a baptism that told people about the one who was coming after him. This is the one in whom they were to believe. This one is Jesus.

dag: Ka Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma.
en: Ephron answered Abraham.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi be yi ni?.
en: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.

dag: Shɛhira diba ata m-be alizanda ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini bɛ ni booni so Yɛligu la ni Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka bɛba ata ŋɔ nyɛla yino. Ka shɛhira diba ata be dunia ŋɔ ni:.
en: The three are testifying.

dag: O wuhiya ni n chɛ ka bɛn fabindi Ziɔn ka mali nandahima la mali suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn mali suhugarigu la yili wumpaɣibo yila. Bɛ ni ŋmanila Yawɛ ni sa oki ti shɛŋa. Bɛ zaa ni tum din tuhi, ka Yawɛ nya paɣibu bɛ ni tum shɛm zuɣu.
en: To give to those who mourn in Zion Joy and gladness instead of grief, A song of praise instead of sorrow. They will be like trees That the Lord himself has planted. They will all do what is right, And God will be praised for what he has done.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la.
en: Greetings from Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church of those in Thessalonica, who are in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yini maa tɔɣis o yɛra, A ni zaŋ Hiburu dab so na ti gari ti ni la kpɛmina ni o ti lihi ʒiɛm ma;.
en: Then she told him the same story: That Hebrew slave that you brought here came into my room and insulted me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm; ka niriba booni ba tarimba sɔŋdiba.
en: But Jesus said to them, The kings of the world rule over their people, and those who have authority over others want to be called the great providers for the people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi dimnim maani ya ansarisi yɛra, To, pumpɔŋɔ zo kura la leela ti dini.
en: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.

dag: Sulemaana bihi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Abija daa nyɛla o bihi, ka Asa nyɛ o bia, ka Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ o bia.
en: This is the line of King Solomon's descendants from father to son: Solomon, Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat.

dag: Dindali maa, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yiri Jɛrusalɛm na. Di pirigili ti yɛn zɔri ti lurila wulimpuhili polo teeku ni, ka di pirigili din kpalim mi zɔri ti luri wulinluhili polo teeku ni. Ka di kul ni zɔri lala wuuni kaman di ni zɔri shɛm shɛɣuni.
en: On that day, running water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it to the Dead Sea and half of it to the Mediterranean; this will happen during the summer and the fall.

dag: Amaa Amasa daa bi nya takɔbi maa Jɔab nuu ni, di saha ka Jɔab zaŋ takɔbi maa kuh o pul ni, ka o nyɔri daa yina ka o kpi. O daa bi lan kuh o pahi buyi. Di saha ka Jɔab min o mabia Abishai daa lan gbaai Bikiri bia Shiiba la naba biɛhibu.
en: But Amasa didnt notice the sword in Joabs hand. Joab struck him in the stomach with it so that Amasas intestines spilled out on the ground. He died without Joab striking him a second time. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba, Bichris son.

dag: O ba ŋun ni daa ŋariti niriba, ka fari o mabihi, ka tumdi din bi viɛla o niriba sani la zuɣu, o ni kpi o tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: It is his father who will die for cheating and robbing and doing evil.

dag: Ka n daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti yɛli ba, N tumdila tuun shɛli din niŋ kamaata, n ku tooi kana. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ tuma maa ka di kpalim zani, ka ka yi sanna.
en: So I sent messengers to them with this answer: I am doing important work, so I cannot come down. I dont want the work to stop just so I can come down and meet with you.

dag: Ka Mɔab naa daa ti nya ka tɔb maa mii taɣ o na, ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ takɔbinyaɣiriba m-pah omaŋ zuɣu n-tim Ɛdom naa polo ni o gari zo, amaa ka kɔŋ garibu.
en: Moabs king saw that he was losing the battle. So he took seven hundred soldiers with him, each with sword in hand, to break through to Edoms king. But they failed.

dag: Ka yi ni bi mi ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti di yi puri ni bindira ni yi tuma zaa daanfaani. Yi ti kul ni bela turi mini nahiŋgu ni sahakam.
en: The produce of your land and all your hard work will be consumed by people you dont know. You will be nothing but oppressed and mistreated constantly.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba maa na ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: But Jesus called the little children to him and said to his followers, Let the little children come to me. Dont stop them, because Gods kingdom belongs to people who are like these little children.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni, di yi nyɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bee tuma ni, yin niŋmiya di zaa ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, ka paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: Whatever you do, whether in speech or action, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus and give thanks to God the Father through him.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini buɣa sunsuuni? Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ jɛmbu duu kaman ŋun Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm la: N ni be bɛ ni, ka chani gindi bɛ sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: A daa pahi gili di zaashee ka di nyaɣa ba tiŋa, ka di zooi yɛligi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: You cleared a place for it to grow; its roots went deep, and it spread out over the whole land.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Pa ŋunkam dii booni ma, N Duuma, n Duuma, n-ni ti kpe alizanda nam ni, naɣila ŋun tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu.
en: Not everyone who calls me Lord, Lord will enter the Kingdom of heaven, but only those who do what my Father in heaven wants them to do.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla n naba firila mini n soli neesim.
en: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.

dag: Amaa mbusim be ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu! Bɛ pala zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni niŋ niriba shɛm, lala ka bɛ yɛn niŋ bɛ gba.
en: But it will be very bad for wicked people, because they, too, will get what they deserve. They will get what they did to others.

dag: Ka luɣ shɛli n ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ pala n niriba la, nimaani ka niriba ni boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bihi.
en: Once they were told, You are not my people. But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa kpuɣ o Mɛgido maa niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ siliga ni. Ka Judanim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: Josiahs servants took his body from Megiddo in a chariot. They brought him to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz, Josiahs son, anointed him, and made him king after his father.

dag: Jaande, ŋmaligimiya, ka di tumiya taali. Ŋmaligimiya pumpɔŋɔ, yi zilisi n nimmaŋtali.
en: Turn! Dont be faithless. Turn now! I am righteous.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunɔdal la, ka daa lan me Ofɛl goondaa la pahi.
en: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple and did a lot of work to repair the wall near Mount Ophel.

dag: Buni palila wuntizɔriba yinsi, amaa ashaara kul lurila ninvuɣ biɛri nyamma zuɣu.
en: Righteous people keep their wealth, but the wicked lose theirs when hard times come.

dag: Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: Jesus from Nazareth, what do you want with us? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are! You are God's Holy One.

dag: Ka dabili maa yi niŋ a ni wuh o shɛm maa, a ni puh o di zuɣu? Aai!.
en: The servant should not get any special thanks for doing his job. He is only doing what his master told him to do.

dag: Pool ni daa ti gbaai dunɔdura dubu, tɔbbihi maa daa kpuɣ o mi buɣi salo maa ni daa na kul bi chɛ o zuɣu.
en: The whole crowd was following them. When the soldiers came to the steps, they had to carry Paul. They did this to protect him, because the people were ready to hurt him. The people were shouting, Kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lan lo tab alikauli Yawɛ tooni, ka Jɔnatan daa kuli, ka Dauda mi kpalim be Hɔrɛshi.
en: They both promised the Lord that they would always be loyal to each other. Then Jonathan went home, but David stayed at Horesh.

dag: A ni ti tam a nandahima ŋɔ yɛla, a ni ti teei di yɛla ka di ŋmanila ko shɛli din pun zo n-gari.
en: Then all your troubles will fade from your memory, like floods that are past and remembered no more.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ya ti ʒili yi yaannim ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli la ni, ka yi ti su li, ka o chɛ ka yi tɔŋ, ka yi kalinli galisi gari yi yaannim maa kalinli.
en: so that you may again take possession of the land where your ancestors once lived. And he will make you more prosperous and more numerous than your ancestors ever were.

dag: Ka a niŋgbuŋ zaa yi nɛmi hal ka zibisim biɛla ka di ni, dindina di ni nɛmi zaa kaman firila ni ne a shɛm la.
en: If your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, it will be bright all over, as when a lamp shines on you with its brightness.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣirimi dooni tiŋkpansi n-guri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Bɛ kul lihirimi ni bɛ nya bɛn ku tooi sɔŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: They hide outside villages, waiting to strike and murder some innocent victim.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti laɣim Shilo n-zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu tanti suɣili la kpa nimaani; ka bɛ ni daa tuhi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa kul doya ka bɛ lihiri li.
en: The whole community of the Israelites assembled at Shiloh and set up the meeting tent there. The conquered land lay before them.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn tiri yimaŋ yɛlimaŋli niriba san la, amaa Naawuni mi din be yi suhuri ni. Ninsalinim ni tibigiri binshɛli pam nyɛla Naawuni ni chihiri shɛli.
en: Jesus said to them, You are the ones who make yourselves look right in other people's sight, but God knows your hearts. For the things that are considered of great value by people are worth nothing in God's sight.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbaai bɛ naa ka o guui, ka o kpamba gba ti zaŋ bɛ tuutanim bahi ka guui dabiɛm zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun buɣim diri Ziɔn, ka o sara maligu buɣim shee be Jɛrusalɛm la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In horror they will flee from their stronghold; their officers will be terrified at the signal, says the LORD, whose fire is in Zion and whose oven is in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Gomna Gɛdalia daa lo ba alikauli yɛli, Di zɔriya Babilɔn sapashinnim dabiɛm, kpalimmiya be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka binshɛlikam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Gedaliah said to them, Everything will be fine, I promise. We don't need to be afraid of the Babylonian rulers, if we live here peacefully and do what Nebuchadnezzar says.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiya ni o tɔɣisi zab omaŋ zuɣu. O zaniya ni o kari o niriba saria.
en: The Lord is ready to state his case; he is ready to judge his people.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ wain tihi, ka chɛ ka maligim din leeri sakuɣa luna saɣim bɛ fiig tihi wala zaa.
en: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.

dag: Dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun taɣ ma ka m bi niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi kana yomyom ti nya ma, biɛɣuni asiba doo zaɣ yino gba sa naan ku lan guui Nabal yiŋa.
en: The Lord has kept me from harming you. But I swear by the living God of Israel that if you had not hurried to meet me, all of Nabal's men would have been dead by morning.

dag: Amaa m Ba ni yɛn tim Sɔŋda so ŋun nyɛ o Shia Kasi, ka o zaŋ n yuli kana la ni ti wuhi ya binshɛɣukam zaa; ka n ni daa wuhi ya shɛlikam zaa la, o ni ti teei ya li.
en: The Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything and make you remember all that I have told you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o doli yuri dunoli polo nti kpe nayili n-ku o nimaani.
en: So the soldiers grabbed Athaliah and killed her as soon as she went through the horses entrance to the palace.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi mini binyila n-yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naa ŋɔ tooni.
en: Blow the pipes and horns, and shout for joy to the Lord our King!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib gba zuɣu! Dama yi ʒiini niriba ʒi tibisi shɛŋa din ʒibu to, amaa ka yimaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ yi nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: Jesus said, How terrible for you legal experts too! You load people down with impossible burdens and you refuse to lift a single finger to help them.

dag: Ka Balak yɛl o, Kamina ka ti chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo a ni yɛn nya ba; a ku tooi nya bɛ zaa, a kul ni nyala bɛ ni shɛb kɔŋko; ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, Come with me, please, to another place where youll see them. Youll see only part of them. You wont see all of them. Then curse them for me from there.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la daa yina ni o ti tuhi naa soli. Naa ni daa kul yi Jɛrusalɛm dahin shɛli maa Mɛfibɔshɛt daa bi lan paɣ o naba bee m-mal o teeŋa bee m-paɣ o situra hal ka o ti labina ni alaafee maa.
en: Then Mephibosheth, Saul's grandson, came down to meet the king. He had not washed his feet, trimmed his beard, or washed his clothes from the time the king left Jerusalem until he returned victorious.

dag: gol so ŋun daa pahir ayɔbu biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali, Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi la saha.
en: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was emperor.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Dama sokam kul yɛri ma la yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa yɛla.
en: Eli said to his sons, Why are you doing these terrible things that Im hearing about from everybody?.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi. O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino jɛm o ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: You cannot serve two masters at the same time. You will hate one master and love the other. Or you will be loyal to one and not care about the other. You cannot serve God and Money at the same time.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Di tamya ni m bela bandi ni. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: Heres my greeting in my own handwriting— Paul . Remember me in prison. Gods grace be with you.

dag: N ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla saha shɛli maa, ka bula so daa yi wulinluhili polo na n-kul kpaŋ zɔri yomyom hal ka o naba bi shihiri tiŋ gba. Ka o daa mali yil gahindili ka di sa o nina ayi sunsuuni.
en: I thought about the ram. While I was watching, I saw a male goat come from the west. It had one large horn that was easy to see. It ran so fast its feet barely touched the ground.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti yi mɔɣu ni na zaawuni, ka Liya yi nti tuh o soli yɛl o, N yɛn kpɛla a sanna zuŋɔ, dama n zaŋla m bia ŋmaankpihiga yo a zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu min o daa dɔni dindali maa yuŋ.
en: That evening when Jacob came in from the fields, Leah told him, You're sleeping with me tonight. I hired you with my son's love flowers. They slept together that night.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa boli Yaakubu na ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Isaac called in Jacob, then gave him a blessing, and said: Don't marry any of those Canaanite women.

dag: A nyɛvoya ni pɔhim daa kahi kom duhi, ka kɔgbana daa yiɣisi zani zuɣusaa, ka teeku bulli maa sunsuuni daa kpaŋ diɣinli.
en: You were so furious that the sea piled up like a wall, and the ocean depths curdled like cheese.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na maa.
en: Make me live again according to your faithful love so I can keep the law youve given!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham Juda tin shɛl ni ti ʒini? Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Chama. Ka Dauda lan bɔhi, N cham tiŋ kani? Ka o yɛl o, Cham Hiburɔn.
en: Some time later, David questioned the LORD, Should I go to one of the towns in Judah? Yes, go, the LORD told him. Which one should I go to? David asked. To Hebron, the LORD replied.

dag: ka lan ka bikpamba bɛn yuya sabi alizanda ni la laɣiŋgu ni na. Yi lan kala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ sokam zaa sariakarita mini wuntizɔriba bɛn mali m-be tibi la shihi sanna.
en: You have come to the joyful gathering of God's first-born, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, who is the judge of all people, and to the spirits of good people made perfect.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: Their grain offering will be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram.

dag: Ka kikaa maa kumsi vuri daa maan pahi, ka Musa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka Naawuni garig o satahiŋga puuni.
en: The trumpet blew louder and louder. Moses spoke, and God answered him with thunder.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o binyɛrigu ti mɔhi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nɔri wain tiwala binyɛrigu la?.
en: Why are your clothes bright red? They are like the clothes of someone who tramples grapes to make wine.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: Now they were more afraid than ever and said to each other, Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sagban piɛlli, ka so ʒi di zuɣu ŋ-ŋmani daadam ka pil salima nam zuɣupiligu, ka gbib gɔr dirili o nuu ni.
en: Then I looked, and there was a white cloud, and sitting on the cloud was what looked like a human being, with a crown of gold on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

dag: Ifriimnim jilima ni ti yiɣi bɛ sani chaŋ kaman noombil la. Bɛ ti ku lan dɔɣi bihi, paɣipuulan ti ku lan beni, bɛ paɣiba ti ku lan zali puhi.
en: Like a bird, Ephraims glory will fly away. There will be no more pregnancies, no more births, and no more babies.

dag: Ka biɛɣuni asiba, wuntaŋ yi sa kul puhi na, yin kamiyana ti liri ba tiŋ maa ni. Gaal min o niriba maa yi sa yina ni yi mini ba zaŋ nya taba, yin niŋmiya ba yi ni bɔri shɛm.
en: When the sun comes up in the morning, attack the city. Gaal and his men will come out of the city to fight you. When they come out to fight, do what you can to them.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tibigir omaŋa ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisiri omaŋa ni nya tibiginsim.
en: All who lift themselves up will be brought low. But all who make themselves low will be lifted up.

dag: Kalimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chana kaman bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Take a census by families of the whole community of Israel, of all men twenty years old or older who are fit for military service.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale zim pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa, ka tulaale zim shɛli daa kani n-viɛl paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Naa Sulemaana maa.
en: She presented to King Solomon the gifts she had brought: almost five tons of gold and a very large amount of spices and jewels. There have never been any other spices as fine as those that the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon. .

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi bi maha, yi mi bi tula. N di bɔri ka yi mahimi bee n-tula!.
en: I know your works. You are neither cold nor hot. I wish that you were either cold or hot.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti dooi salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li, ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapuhi maa zuɣu.
en: Cover the frames with gold. And make rings for the frames to hold the braces. Make these rings from gold. Also cover the braces with gold.

dag: amaa ka daa bi boli anabi Neetan mini Bɛnaaya bee o tizo Sulemaana bee naa ninvuɣ kpɛma la bɛna.
en: But he did not invite Nathan, Benaiah, David's bodyguards, or his own brother Solomon.

dag: ni Bɛnabinadab ŋun daa su Nafatido tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka daa kpuɣi Sulemaana bipuɣiŋga Tafat la.
en: Benabinadab, who was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath: the whole region of Dor.

dag: Di luɣa ni barilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni pirigili, ka palo din daa do Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini luɣa zuɣu duri la sunsuuni.
en: The width of the outer wall of the side chambers was seven and a half feet. The space left free between the temples side chambers and.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan niŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuhi me bimbin shɛŋa la yɛda. Bɛ mi ti ku lihi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa din nyɛ dari mini bɛ ni tuɣindi tulaale zim Ashɛrim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: They will no longer rely on the altars they made with their own hands, or trust in their own handiwork—symbols of the goddess Asherah and altars for burning incense.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa, ŋuna n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: because the Lord is the King. He rules all nations.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi yila vuri la zo n sani. M mi ku wum yi biŋkumda kumsi.
en: Take your noisy songs away from here. I will not listen to the music from your harps.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ di puuni maa n-nyɛ nimdi, ka tiŋ maa mi nyɛ duɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yihi yinim di puuni.
en: So this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to you. This city is a cooking pot all right, but what is the meat? The corpses of those you have killed! You will not be here—I will throw you out of the city!.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka lihi bɛmaŋ suhupiɛlli niriba, ka bɛ paɣiri ba bɛ nasara dibu zuɣu la.
en: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn lola yi mini yi zuliya.
en: I am going to make a solemn promise to you and to everyone who will live after you.

dag: Hal fiig tihi ni bi pum puma, ka wain tihi bi wali, ka olivi tihi bi wali, ka puri ni bindira bi niŋ, ka biŋkɔbbaligu lan ka buzɔna ni, ka niɣi lan ka naɣikpahi ni maa zaa yoli.
en: Figs might not grow on the fig trees, and grapes might not grow on the vines. Olives might not grow on the olive trees, and food might not grow in the fields. There might not be any sheep in the pens or cattle in the barns.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni Jɔn gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pɔri Naawuni nam ni galisi gar o.
en: I tell you that no greater human being has ever been born than John. Yet whoever is least in Gods kingdom is greater than he.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛra, Tiliginsim yila ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni mini Piɛbil ŋɔ sanna.
en: as they shouted, Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.

dag: Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: The men in the boat were amazed and said, Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni chani ginda.
en: and Jesus was in the temple, walking in the covered porch named for Solomon.

dag: Chɛ ka di be kaman chinchin la, ka o zaŋ li vil omaŋa, ka chɛ ka di be kaman shɛlɔrigu la, ka o zaŋ li lɔri dabisili kam.
en: So let curses cover him like the robe he wears and always surround him like a belt.

dag: Tan tolli kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu daa nyɛla yim.
en: Each piece was the same size, yards long and yards wide.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa chaŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti be o sani pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: I decided to stay with the people of Judah, and I went to live near Gedaliah in Mizpah.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra.
en: He asked them again, Who are you looking for? They said, Jesus from Nazareth.

dag: O ni daa leei ŋun be tibi maa zuɣu, ka o leei bɛnkam zaa deer o noli tiliginsim din ka bahigu ni yiri so sanna.
en: When he was made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all those who obey him.

dag: Di simdi ka suhuyiɣisililan nya tibidarigibo, amaa a yi fa o bahi, shee ka a lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: Angry people must pay the penalty; if you rescue them, then you will have to do it again.

dag: Tinzunnim ni kana ti me yi goma tin ya, ka bɛ nanim jɛm ya. N daa yiɣisila n suhu bahi yi zuɣu n-darigi yi tibili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ka o ti ŋme n-di di nɛma, ka ʒe di nɛma n-zaŋ di daazichi chaŋ, ka di ti leeg o tɔbbihi yɔri.
en: So now this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: I am giving the land of Egypt to King Nebuchadnezzar. He will loot and plunder it and carry off all the wealth of Egypt as his army's pay.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe dundombila din be wulimpuhili polo ni nti buɣisi dunɔdali, ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then the man led me into the inner courtyard on the east side. He measured the gate. It measured the same as the other gates.

dag: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la daa lan mali bidib shɛba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Haroi ŋun zuliya nyɛ Mɛnuhɔtinim pirigili la.
en: Shobal, Kiriath-jearims father, had a family: Haroeh, and the ancestor of half of the Menuhoth.

dag: Ka yaɣ yini yi biɛra, yaɣa maa zaa biɛrimi; ka yaɣ yini yi nya jilima, yaɣa maa zaa malila suhupiɛlli.
en: If one part of the body suffers, all the other parts suffer with it; if one part is praised, all the other parts share its happiness.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin mini zahim maa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: He took the seven loaves of bread and the fish. After he gave thanks, he broke them into pieces and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbilli kam din maha n-ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn mali nyɛvili zaŋ tabili noonsi balibu kam ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ni bɛ dira. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: And I am giving all the green plants to the animals. These green plants will be their food. Every animal on earth, every bird in the air, and all the little things that crawl on the earth will eat that food. And all these things happened.

dag: Ka Nɛria bia Baruk daa niŋ anabi Jɛrimia ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu gbaŋ maa karimbu polo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni maa.
en: So Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do. Baruch read aloud the scroll that had the Lord s messages written on it. He read it in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka bɛ daa lee baptaizi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu ka ti daa deei.
en: Well, then, what kind of baptism did you receive? Paul asked. The baptism of John, they answered.

dag: Anabi yi zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli ka di bi niŋ bee ka shɛli bi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, di pala Yawɛ ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli: Anabi maa n-kul ŋme nyɔɣu n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa; yin di chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya.
en: If a prophet speaks in the name of the Lord and what he says does not come true, then it is not the Lord 's message. That prophet has spoken on his own authority, and you are not to fear him.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me Nam ʒiishee zɔŋ, din nyɛ o ni yɛn kariti saria luɣ shɛli. Zɔŋ maa ni n-daa nyɛ sariadibo shee. Sida dari ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali di tiŋ hal ti gbaai di yɔɣira.
en: Solomon's throne was in Justice Hall, where he judged cases. This hall was completely lined with cedar.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba, ka Sool nyɛ Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish of Saul, Saul of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

dag: A daa ko pini zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka mali binshɛŋa din dundu zali niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam. A daa bi be kaman pagɔrili la, dama a je liɣiri.
en: You had sex on every street corner, and when you finished, you refused to accept money. That's worse than being a prostitute!.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: Peter answered, I will never say that, even if I have to die with you! And all the other disciples said the same thing.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn daa doli Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɛshua kulina la: Sɛraya mini Jɛrimia ni Ɛzra.
en: These are the priests and Levites who came back to the land of Judah. They came back with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua. This is a list of their names: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra.

dag: Kpiimba shihi sɔhirimi, ka bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee sɔhira.
en: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna ti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Some Pharisees came to him. In order to test him, they said, Does the Law allow a man to divorce his wife for just any reason.

dag: Siliga maa bela Makipɛla pu shɛli din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ibrahimma n-daa da siliga maa Ɛfurɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la sani n-leeg o dini ni di nyɛ o ni yɛn sɔɣir o kpiimba luɣ shɛli.
en: at Machpelah east of Mamre in the land of Canaan. Abraham bought this cave and field from Ephron for a burial ground.

dag: Amaa kum daa nyaŋ sokam zaa Adam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ hal ti paai Anabi Musa ʒiɛman ni, hal ka nyaŋ bɛn daa bi tum alahichi shɛli Adam ni daa tum la tatabo. Adam daa nyɛla ŋun daa ti yɛn kana la ŋmahinli.
en: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ nimaani daanya sara maligu bimbini din daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti kɔri biŋkɔbiri tuhili m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu.
en: In front of the Tent the king worshiped the Lord by offering sacrifices on the bronze altar; he had a thousand animals killed and burned whole on it.

dag: Neesim viɛla, ka nina yi nya wuntaŋa, di viɛla.
en: Nothing on earth is more beautiful than the morning sun.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm.
en: If you have ears, then, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches!.

dag: Ŋuna n-yiɣisiri tarimba taŋkpaɣu ni, ka kpuɣiri nandaamba tampuli zuɣu ni o chɛ ka bɛ mini nabihi laɣim ʒini n-di kuɣ din mali jilima fali. Dama Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ daantalisi, ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ n-tam di zuɣu.
en: You lift the poor and homeless out of the garbage dump and give them places of honor in royal palaces. You set the world on foundations, and they belong to you.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa lan nya alahiziba shihir titali alizanda ni. Malaikanima ayopɔin n-daa mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din kpalim nyaaŋa, dina n-daa nyɛ Naawuni suhuyiɣisili alɔbɔnim din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: Then I saw in the sky another mysterious sight, great and amazing. There were seven angels with seven plagues, which are the last ones, because they are the final expression of God's anger.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga kɔhi ka o leei dabili, di bi simdi ka o ti chaŋ kaman dɔbba ni chani shɛm.
en: A young woman who was sold by her father doesn't gain her freedom in the same way that a man does.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A shiri yɛn laɣimla wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku?.
en: And Abraham asked him, Lord , when you destroy the evil people, are you also going to destroy those who are good?.

dag: Ka yi yi puhirila yi zɔnim kɔŋko, tuun suŋ bɔ ka yi lee zaŋ gari yi taba? Pa lala ka zuliya kam gba niŋda?.
en: And if you speak only to your friends, have you done anything out of the ordinary? Even the pagans do that!.

dag: Ka o daa lan sabi gbana n-ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daɣiri, ka tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ yoya pam jɛnd o yɛra, Tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba buɣa ni daa bi tooi tiligi bɛ niriba n nuu ni shɛm, lala ka Hɛzɛkia Naawuni ŋɔ gba ku tooi tilig o niriba n nuu ni.
en: Sennacherib's letter even made fun of the Lord . It said, The gods of other nations could not save their people from Assyria's army, and neither will the God that Hezekiah worships.

dag: Yawɛ nudirigu nya duhibu, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: His power has brought us victory— his mighty power in battle.

dag: Nyini n-nam ba, ka bɛ beni, ka zooi n-dɔɣi bihi, ka a yɛla kul be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni nyini.
en: You plant them, and they take root; they grow and bear fruit. They always speak well of you, yet they do not really care about you.

dag: O ni daa gbaag o maa o daa kpɛh o la duu, ka chɛ ka duguliba pinaayɔbu ʒe n-gul o, dama o daa lɔrila nia ni Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhi gari ka o zaŋ o niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: After his arrest Peter was put in jail, where he was handed over to be guarded by four groups of four soldiers each. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after Passover.

dag: N ku guhi, n ni niŋ yomyom dol a zaligunim maa.
en: Without wasting any time, I hurried back to obey your commands.

dag: Di saha ka Filip daa zaŋ litaafi maa ni luɣ shɛli o ni karim maa n-gbaag o Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu.
en: Philip began to speak. He started with this same Scripture and told the man the Good News about Jesus.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N yaaŋa, teemi ni a ni daa be a nyɛvil ni la, a daa nyar a suhu yubu, ka Lazarɔs mi daa nyari wahala, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o suhu maaya, ka a mi be azaaba ni.
en: But Abraham said, My child, remember when you lived? You had all the good things in life. But Lazarus had nothing but problems. Now he is comforted here, and you are suffering.

dag: Ŋun daa pa Ɛhud zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Anat bia Shamga ŋun daa zaŋ naɣikpar kpaa ku Filistianim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la. Ŋun gba daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: Shamgar the son of Anath was the next to rescue Israel. In one battle, he used a sharp wooden pole to kill Philistines.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni yi kummi ka fabili, ka pini zuɣukpina, ka pili buri.
en: The LORD God of heavenly forces called on that day for weeping and mourning, and shaven heads, and wearing of mourning clothes.

dag: ni ninsalinim tuhi pinaayɔbu.
en: and , women.

dag: Ti daa bi deei shɛli so sani ka bi yo di zuɣu, amaa ti daa kul tumdila wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku ʒi yi ni so zuɣu.
en: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.

dag: Di daba anu nyaaŋa ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Ananias daa zaŋ kpeen shɛba mini bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira ŋun yuli daa booni Tɛɛtulus la pah omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Siizaria. Bɛ daa chaŋmi ti zaŋ bɛ mini Pool yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli Gomna Filiksi.
en: Five days later Ananias the high priest, together with some of their leaders and a lawyer named Tertullus, went to the governor to present their case against Paul.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni vili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba labi. N ni chɛ ka nandahima gbaai ba hal ka bɛ ni ti mii.
en: This is what the Lord says: This time, I will throw the people of Judah out of this country. I will bring pain and trouble to them. I will do this so that they will learn their lesson.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tam dapuhi zuɣu n-zaŋ li buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa ka o zali shɛm la.
en: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ba lala maa, ka zaŋ o nuhi min o puluɣili wuhi ba, ka di niŋ o nyaandoliba maa suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa nya bɛ Duuma maa zuɣu.
en: and showed them his hands and his side. When the disciples saw the Lord, they became very happy.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma nyɛvili mini yurilim maŋli ka nyɛ ŋun guli n nyɛvili.
en: Life and kindness you gave me, and you oversaw and preserved my breath.

dag: A mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni; zaŋmi n nintam niŋ a luɣuluɣu ni. Bee di yɛla bi sab be a litaafi ni?.
en: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.

dag: O ni daa paai Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbani maa dunɔdali gbini, ka Shɛlɛmia bia Irija ŋun daa nyɛ Hanania yaaŋa ka nyɛ dunɔgul la daa be nimaani, ka o daa gbaai anabi Jɛrimia ka yɛra, A zɔrimi doli Babilɔnnim maa ni a chaŋ.
en: He got as far as the Benjamin Gate in Jerusalem when the guard there named Irijah, Shelemiahs son and Hananiahs grandson, arrested the prophet Jeremiah, saying, You are deserting to the Babylonians.

dag: Yi duri zoya din du pam zuɣu nti maani maligu, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni nimaani.
en: You make your bed on every hill and high mountain. You go up to those places and offer sacrifices.

dag: Pini nyɛla din maani soli tiri nira, di nyɛla din chɛ ka nir tooi nyari ninvuɣ wɔɣira.
en: Do you want to meet an important person? Take a gift and it will be easy.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi yaag o noli? Dabiɛm n kul be o nyina ni ti gili.
en: Who can open the doors of his mouth, surrounded by frightening teeth?.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka o daa tim Azalia bia Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara, ka nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɛl o.
en: In the eighteenth year of King Josiahs rule, he sent the secretary Shaphan, Azaliahs son and Meshullams grandson, to the LORDs temple with the following orders.

dag: Ka pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Ribɛka ni daa zaŋ jahi pua ti yab Yisahaku sani.
en: And this is not all. For Rebecca's two sons had the same father, our ancestor Isaac.

dag: O daa nyɛla ŋun yuli du ninvuɣ pihita maa puuni, amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli ŋun Dauda la zuɣulana.
en: He was famous among the Thirty, but didnt become one of the Three. David placed him in command of his own bodyguard.

dag: Di tɛhiriya ni n ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla m Ba sani; ŋun ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla o sani beni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa yi ni zaŋ yi tahima zaa niŋ so ni la.
en: Dont think that I will be the one to stand before the Father and accuse you. Moses is the one to accuse you. And he is the one you hoped would save you.

dag: M biɛhigu ni be kaman Masia biɛhigu la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi gba biɛhigu be kaman m biɛhigu.
en: Follow my example, just as I follow the example of Christ.

dag: Ka ti daa ti laɣim bakɔi piligu dali ni ti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro n-laɣim di Ti Duuma Bindirigu, ka Pool ni daa lɔri ni biɛɣu neei ka o chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa tɔɣisi ba Naawuni soli yɛla hal ni yuntisuɣu.
en: On the first day of the week we met to break bread together. Paul spoke to the people until midnight because he was leaving the next morning.

dag: A ni yɛn deei pin shɛŋa bɛ sani m-bɔŋɔ: Salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: These are the gift offerings that you should receive from them: gold, silver, and copper.

dag: ka gbilisiri tibili wumdi n ni timdi n dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ anabinim yi sanna la yɛligu, dama yi pun bi gbilisiri tibili wumdi li.
en: if you dont listen to the words of the prophets that I have sent to you time and again, though you havent listened.

dag: Isaka bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tola mini Pua ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi.
en: Issachars family: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron—four in all.

dag: So kani n-nyɛ ŋun mi, so mi kani n-nyɛ ŋun bɔri Naawuni.
en: There is no one who understands. There is no one who is trying to be with God.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daanfaani din nyɛ pin la n-chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: But by the free gift of God's grace all are put right with him through Christ Jesus, who sets them free.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali yi sara maa ti yi Naawuni maa yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: So Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron and told them, Offer sacrifices to your God here in this country.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣ asibaasi sara maligu saha, ka kom daa yi Ɛdom polo n-zo na ti tɛli tiŋgbani zaa.
en: In the morning, at the time for the morning sacrifice, water began flowing from the direction of Edom and filled the valley.

dag: Chɛ ka n wunsuhigu be kaman tulaale zim la a sani, ka chɛ ka n nuhi zuɣusaa kpuɣibu be kaman zaawuni sara maligu la.
en: Receive my prayer as incense, my uplifted hands as an evening sacrifice.

dag: Chɛ ka suhudoo be di puuni, ka alaafee be di nanim yinsi.
en: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.

dag: Di viɛl ni ti paɣi nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa, ka yili yila paɣ a yuli;.
en: It is good to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High.

dag: amaa cheechi ni m paɣi ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa diba anu m milinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka n wuhi niriba gari ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa tuhi pia tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: But in the church meetings I would rather speak five words that I understand than thousands of words in a different language. I would rather speak with my understanding, so that I can teach others.

dag: Amaa nyin Daniɛl, kul ʒe yim hal ni di bahigu ni. A ni ti vuhi, ka ni ti zani a zaashee zaadali.
en: As for you, Daniel, go and live your life until the end. You will get your rest. At the end you will rise from death and receive your share of the promise.

dag: Yi ni ti di biŋkpam hal ti tiɣi, ka nyu ʒim hal ti buɣi sara maligu chu shɛli shili n ni maani tiri ya maa ni.
en: Gorge yourselves on their fat, and get drunk on their blood, from the sacrifice that I have made for you.

dag: Ka o gba daa duɣi o ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti o ba. O daa yɛlila o ba, M ba, yiɣisim ŋub a bia mɔɣu ni nimdi ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: He also cooked some tasty food and took it to his father. He said, Please, father, sit up and eat some of the meat that I have brought you, so that you can give me your blessing.

dag: Alizanda ni nim mini dunia ni nim zaŋ tabili teeku mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, paɣimiy o.
en: Praise God, O heaven and earth, seas and all creatures in them.

dag: Juda zuliya bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihiniinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinahi. Bɛna nti yɛn be tooni chana.
en: These , troops will march into battle first.

dag: A zuɣu, n ni tooi nyaŋ n dimnima. N Naawuni maa zuɣu, n ni tooi yiɣi yaɣi gooni.
en: With you I can charge into battle; with my God I can leap over a wall.

dag: Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni Izraɛlnim ni n-zani n zaani mahi n suhu, ka m bi chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili di Izraɛlnima.
en: Because of what Phinehas has done, I am no longer angry with the people of Israel. He refused to tolerate the worship of any god but me, and that is why I did not destroy them in my anger.

dag: Dama a yi ti yi ya ŋɔ n-chaŋ ti baai du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani, ka a ʒim yihibu taali kpalim ʒi amaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If you try to leave, be advised that on the day you cross the Kidron Valley you will most certainly die. Your bloodguilt will be on your own head.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan yɛli, Tumo maa paai bɛ sani, amaa ka lee bi labirina. Ka ŋun kani maa na mi chandi ŋmanila Jɛhu, Nimshi yaaŋa la, dama o chandi maa ŋmanila yinyaa.
en: The tower guard reported, The messenger met them, but he isnt returning. And the style of chariot driving is like Jehu, Nimshis son. Jehu drives like a madman.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli neesim maa n-daa yi palo dunia ni di saha maa ni o neei sokam zaa nina.
en: The true light was coming into the world. This is the true light that gives light to all people.

dag: Hal ŋun nyɛ n zo simo, ka n niŋ o yɛda, ka m min o laɣindi diri la gba yila n nyaaŋa.
en: My best friend, the one I trusted, the one who ate with me—even he has turned against me.

dag: Ka o daa siɣim pam ka yɛli, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim bɔri shihirili? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ku nya shihirili hal baabiɛla.
en: Jesus groaned and said, Why are you always looking for a sign? I can promise you that you will not be given one.

dag: ka yɛl o, Aai! Ti ni dol a kul a niriba sani.
en: and said to her, No! We will go with you to your people.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka saa ku n-zibigi, ka pɔhim gbaai ʒiɛbu, ka sa kurili dii piligi mibu. Ka Ɛhab daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-zo nti kpe Jɛziriil.
en: A few minutes later, it got very cloudy and windy, and rain started pouring down. So Elijah wrapped his coat around himself, and the Lord gave him strength to run all the way to Jezreel. Ahab followed in his chariot.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ni be Hɛshibɔn mini Aroa ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili fɔntin shɛŋa din zaa ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili la zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ yuun kɔbisita m-bɔŋɔ, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa pun bi deei li di saha maa zaa?.
en: Why didnt you take back this territory while the Israelites lived in Heshbon and its villages, in Aroer and its villages, and in all the towns along the branches of the Arnon for three hundred years?.

dag: Dɛdan mini Tɛma ni Buz ni bɛn zaa pindi bɛ zuɣuri bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri puuni;.
en: I made the people of Dedan, Tema, and Buz drink from the cup. I made all those who cut their hair at their temples drink from the cup.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni kabi naɣikɔra dapua o nyiŋgoli zuɣu bahi, ka kabisi o bandi maa, ka tinzunnim ku lan zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.

dag: ni bɛ ni nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la mini di nɛma zaa ni tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu la.
en: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.

dag: N ni zaŋ daɣiri lab a, ka dih a vi, ka chɛ ka niriba lih a ka mal a ansarisi.
en: I will treat you with contempt and cover you with filth. People will stare at you in horror.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ ti Lɛvi bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka nyɛ bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: Then Moses wrote this Instruction down and gave it to the priests—the Levites who carry the chest containing the LORDs covenant—and to all of the Israelite elders.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka n ni baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma. Dina n-nyɛ: a bi chɛ ka n dimnim nyaŋ ma.
en: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.

dag: Wuntia tuma mini din tuhi tumbu nyɛla Yawɛ ni deeri shɛli gari sara maligu.
en: Do what is right and fair. The Lord loves that more than sacrifices.

dag: Yawɛ, viim sagbana ka sheena. Shihimi zoya n-chɛ ka nyɔhi yi di ni na.
en: Lord , tear open the skies and come down. Touch the mountains, and smoke will rise from them.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tum alahichi pam, dinzuɣu ka o leei tabizahim niriba sani. Bɛnkam zaa daa tiri o jilima lihimi ʒiɛm o, dama bɛ nya o gbini. Omaŋmaŋ ŋuhirimi, ka ŋmalig o nini labi kpaŋa.
en: Her honor is gone; she is naked and held in contempt. She groans and hides her face in shame. Jerusalem made herself filthy with terrible sin.

dag: Chɛ ka Mɔabnim nyu dam kuli bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ pam niŋ Yawɛ la zuɣu. Bɛ ni dɔni bɛmaŋmaŋ tiri ni bilim. Bɛ gba ni leei niriba ni yɛn lari shɛba.
en: The Lord said, Make Moab drunk, because it has rebelled against me. Moab will roll in its own vomit, and people will laugh.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o ti o bidibiga ni o niŋ o paɣa, di simdi ka o gbib o kaman o bipuɣiŋga la.
en: If he selects her as a wife for his son, he must treat her as his own daughter.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni! Ami!.
en: Brothers and sisters, may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ibram, Yim a ya ŋɔ min a ba yiŋa ni a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ sani n-chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The Lord said to Abram, Leave your country, your relatives, and your father's home, and go to a land that I am going to show you.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Bɛ zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita shɛli Izraɛlnim shɛb ni daa zal o daa shɛm la.
en: This fulfilled the words of Jeremiah the prophet: And I took the thirty pieces of silver, the price for the one whose price had been set by some of the Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni.
en: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, Jesus must think he is God.

dag: Lala zuɣu yinim paɣiba, deemiya yi yidaannim noya, ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn bi deei Naawuni yɛligu la ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda bɛ paɣiba biɛhigu zuɣu, ka pa ni yi ni yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: Wives, likewise, submit to your own husbands. Do this so that even if some of them refuse to believe the word, they may be won without a word by their wives way of life.

dag: Amaa o daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kom di Ijipti naa min o tɔbbihi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka o daa bo Ijipti bin suma n-ʒili bunsi pia ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti o ba, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ su kawana mini bɔrɔbɔro ni di ti nyɛ o ba sol ni bindira n-ʒili bunnyama pia pahi.
en: Joseph also sent gifts to his father. He sent ten donkeys with bags full of many good things from Egypt. And he sent ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and other food for his father on his trip back.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla m min a ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛl la dina, Yawɛ ni be m min a sunsuuni sahakam.
en: Either way, the LORD is witness between us forever regarding the promise we made to each other.

dag: Zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ pin shɛŋa Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya bɛn yi Babilɔn na la ni zaŋ ti la n-chaŋ Zɛfania bia Jɔsia yiŋa yomyom.
en: Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah have returned from Babylonia. Collect enough silver and gold from them to make a crown. Then go with them to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah and put the crown on the head of the high priest Joshua son of Jehozadak.

dag: Miri ka a deei anab shɛb bɛn yɛr a ni a di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu, dama bɛ tɔɣisir a la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Do not listen to the prophets who tell you not to surrender to him. They are deceiving you.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Masia mini Sintani sunsuuni? Bee yɛdaniŋdiba mini bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba yɛla kpɛri tab ni?.
en: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa chɛ naɣikɔra maa, ka guui doli Ilaija nti yɛl o, Chɛ ka n chɛbisi m ba mini m ma pɔi ka naanyi dol a. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labima, ka n yɛl a la wula?.
en: Elisha immediately left his oxen and ran after Elijah. Elisha said, Let me kiss my mother and father goodbye. Then I will follow you. Elijah answered, You can do that. I will not stop you. .

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim zuɣu wuhim ma a wuntia soli; malim a soli maa ka di tuhi ti ma.
en: LORD, because of many enemies, please lead me in your righteousness. Make your way clear, right in front of me.

dag: ka Azarɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrɔham bia la mi nyɛ Dan zuliya ni kpɛma. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya zuɣulaannima.
en: Azarel son of Jeroham, leader of the tribe of Dan. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ o bia Yisahaku mali sara bimbini zuɣu la, pa o tuma tumbu zuɣu ka o daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani?.
en: What about Abraham, our father? Wasnt he shown to be righteous through his actions when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi jɛmdi buɣa bo wahala pam ti bɛmaŋa. N ku pahi bɛ ni n-kɔrigi binyara ʒim vie buɣa maa; m mi kul ku yaai n noli boli di yuya.
en: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa yɛl o, Miri ka a chɛ ka ti niriba ŋɔ wum a damli, ka bɛ puuni suhuyiɣisilinim lu a zuɣu n-ku a min a yiŋnima.
en: The Danites told him, You had better not say anything else unless you want these men to get angry and attack you. You and your whole family would die.

dag: ka o puhirina m-be kaman aŋgo ŋun yi amiliya sampaa ni na bee kaman kpiɔŋlana ni yi yina n-zɔr o tia ni suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: It comes out like a happy bridegroom from his bedroom. It begins its path across the sky like an athlete eager to run a race.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm yaɣi ti ni tɛhi ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu: Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋa n-ti ti Duuma ka naanyi zaŋ bɛmaŋa n-ti ti gba Naawuni yubu puuni.
en: And they gave in a way that we did not expect: They gave themselves to the Lord and to us before they gave their money. This is what God wants.

dag: Mikilɔt daa nyɛla Shimiam ba. Bɛmbɔŋɔ mini bɛ malibu daa ʒimi miri bɛ dɔɣiriba Jɛrusalɛm.
en: the father of Shimeah. Their descendants lived in Jerusalem near other families of their clan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma pahi.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka teeku vuri fɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔgbana vuri fɔra; nyini n-lan chɛ ka niriba bɛn taai duŋ gba fɔra.
en: You calm the roaring seas; calm the roaring waves, calm the noise of the nations.

dag: Ka o daa ŋme chɛrubinim mini gbuɣima ni abie tihi kɔtomsi pa di bintaɣirisi mini di dapaɣa zuɣu kaman di zaɣ yini kam ni ni tooi deei palo shɛm tariga, ka mali biŋgolima gil li.
en: The supports and panels were decorated with figures of winged creatures, lions, and palm trees, wherever there was space for them, with spiral figures all around.

dag: dindina n ni yihi ya n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni, ka zaɣisi n ni daa pii jɛmbu du shɛli ni yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ŋɔ gba, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam mal li ansarisi ka ʒiɛm li.
en: I will pull you out of this land I gave you. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped, so that people everywhere will think it is only a joke and will make fun of it.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din daa sabi kurimbuni ha daa sabila ti wuhibu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daanzansi niŋbu mini Naawuni Kundi suhukpaŋsibo chɛ ka ti mali tahima.
en: And the Scriptures were written to teach and encourage us by giving us hope.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli, Bilimmiya kuɣ kara ti ŋari voli maa noli, ka bo niriba zali di gbini ka bɛ gul li.
en: He said, Cover the entrance to the cave with large rocks. Put some men there to guard the cave.

dag: Ahazia gba daa dolila Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba n-tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o daa nyɛla Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa deemba.
en: Since Ahaziah was related to Ahab's family, he acted just like them and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia daa mali buni pam ka niriba daa tir o jilima. O daa mɛla omaŋmaŋ nɛma zalibu shee duri, n-zaŋdi o da anzinfa min o salima ni o kuɣ viɛla ni o tulaale ni o nyɔtaɣirisi ni o binshɛɣukam din mali shaara pam.
en: Hezekiah was very rich, and everyone respected him. He built special rooms to store the silver, the gold, the precious stones and spices, the shields, and the other valuable possessions.

dag: Dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa piɛma nyɔɣi ma, ka di lɔɣu kpe n ni. Naawuni zaŋla dabiɛm sɔŋ tuɣi tab gu ma.
en: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa tɔɣisi bɛ zuɣulaannim maa yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhi ba, Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu maa hal ka yi ti me li naai.
en: We asked those elders, Who authorized you to build this house and to complete the preparation of this material.

dag: Lɛvinim tuma kpɛm ŋun daa be Jɛrusalɛm n-daa nyɛ Bani bia Uzi, ŋun daa nyɛ Hashabia yaaŋa la. O yaannim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pahi n-daa nyɛ Matania mini Maika. O daa yila Asaf daŋ ni na. Bɛ daa nyɛla yiliyiiniba bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi.
en: The officer over the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi. Uzzi was the son of Bani . Uzzi was a descendant of Asaph. Asaphs descendants were the singers who were responsible for the service in Gods Temple.

dag: Dindali maa, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yiri Jɛrusalɛm na. Di pirigili ti yɛn zɔri ti lurila wulimpuhili polo teeku ni, ka di pirigili din kpalim mi zɔri ti luri wulinluhili polo teeku ni. Ka di kul ni zɔri lala wuuni kaman di ni zɔri shɛm shɛɣuni.
en: At that time water will flow continually from Jerusalem. That stream will split and part of it will flow east, and part of it will flow west to the Mediterranean Sea. And it will flow all year long, in the summer as well as in the winter.

dag: Jilima mini nam dariza bela o sani, ka kpiɔŋ ni suhupiɛlli be o biɛhigu shee.
en: Give honor and praise to the Lord , whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.

dag: Ka Hanani ŋun daa nyɛ m mabihi ni yino la mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti yi Juda na, ka m-bɔhi ba Yɛhudianim bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba la mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: Hanani, one of my brothers, arrived from Judah with another group, and I asked them about Jerusalem and about the other Jews who had returned from exile in Babylonia.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya Pita mini Jɔn suhukpeeni, ka mi ni bɛ nyɛla tarimba ni zuɣusabila maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛ mini Yisa n-daa be.
en: The members of the Council were amazed to see how bold Peter and John were and to learn that they were ordinary men of no education. They realized then that they had been companions of Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: And now send some men to Joppa for a certain man whose full name is Simon Peter.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani mini bɛnkam jɛmd o zaɣ viɛlli.
en: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun darigiri zuliya kam tibili. Ŋuna ŋun zaŋdi baŋsim wuhiri daadamnima ŋɔ pala ŋun darigiri niriba tibili?.
en: The one who disciplines nations, cant he punish? The one who teaches humans, doesnt he know?.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn mini ba daa be m-miri taba ni daa kana, bɛ daa yɛli ti siɣimsiɣim bupia, Ti dimnim maa ni yi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kana ti liri ti.
en: But time after time Jews who were living among our enemies came to warn us of the plans our enemies were making against us.

dag: dindina a ni baŋ Yawɛ zɔbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka nya baŋsim din nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: If you do, you will know what it means to fear the Lord and you will succeed in learning about God.

dag: Ka o dii siɣina ti puh o, ka deeg o ni suhupiɛlli.
en: So Zacchaeus came down at once, happy to welcome Jesus.

dag: M bia, di tam n ni wuh a shɛli, amaa gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli maa a suhu ni.
en: My son, dont forget my teaching. Remember what I tell you to do.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-sa tihi balibu kam, di wala ni ti nyɛla din dibu chihiri yi sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din chihiri dibu yi sani hal ni yuma ata, ka di bi simdi ni yi di li.
en: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, mbusim be a zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: After all your wickedness—doom, doom to you, proclaims the LORD God.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi ni noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋ zaa bɛba ayiyi, zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: He obeyed God and took a male and a female of each kind of animal and bird into the boat with him.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Miriya ka yi ʒiɛm bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba, dama n yɛri ya mi ni bɛ malaikanim kul chola m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ninni. .
en: Be careful that you dont look down on one of these little ones. I say to you that their angels in heaven are always looking into the face of my Father who is in heaven.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, amaa alahichi nyɛla din bahiri ninvuɣ biɛri yoli.
en: Righteousness protects the innocent; wickedness is the downfall of sinners.

dag: Bɛ wain nyɛla tinvura lɔɣu. Di nyɛla sapaɣu lɔɣu din bie pam.
en: their wine is snake poison, venom from a cruel cobra.

dag: Yisifu bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ: Manaasa mini Ifriim.
en: Josephs descendants according to their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: Whoever is not with me is against me. And anyone who does not work with me is working against me.

dag: Di saha ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni bɛ zuɣulan Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ nya suhupiɛlli o ni daa nyaŋ bɛ dimnim ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: Jehoshaphat led his troops back to Jerusalem in triumph, because the Lord had defeated their enemies.

dag: Ŋarimiya yiliŋ kam, ka gbi zoya mini kuŋkuna ka di siɣi n-leei tintani, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli.
en: Every valley must be filled. Every mountain and hill should be made flat. The crooked roads should be made straight, and the rough ground made smooth.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛl Yawɛ sani, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn be tibi yi suhuri ni mi, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu.
en: You who are righteous, rejoice in the LORD and be glad! All you whose hearts are right, sing out in joy!.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ ŋun Yisa yɛda ni daa ti yɛn deela yɛla ka o daa yɛri ba maa; dama Naawuni daa na bi tim o Shia Kasi na, Yisa ni daa na bi nya jilima shɛli din doli o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la zuɣu.
en: Jesus said this about the Spirit, which those who believed in him were going to receive. At that time the Spirit had not yet been given, because Jesus had not been raised to glory.

dag: ka di be kaman n daa na ʒi m-be, ka bɛ daa kul dɔɣi ma n-zaŋ ma ti niŋla gballi ni.
en: and been carried to the grave without ever breathing.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa ʒe bimbini maa gbini ni o tuɣili tulaale zim maa saha shɛli ka anab so daa yi Juda n-zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu ka Bɛtɛl na.
en: At the Lord 's command a prophet from Judah went to Bethel and arrived there as Jeroboam stood at the altar to offer the sacrifice.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa daa garigi yɛl o, O ni ku padir biɛri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa ti padir shɛb bɛn ni zaŋ di daatam maa ti o di kpuɣibu saha.
en: He will certainly kill those evil men, they answered, and rent the vineyard out to other tenants, who will give him his share of the harvest at the right time.

dag: Sujee nyɛla putɔɣu, ka suhuyiɣisili kɔŋ tim, amaa nyuli zabbu m-bie n-gari di zaa.
en: Wrath is cruel and anger is a flood, but who can withstand jealousy?.

dag: Yɛlimiya yi bihi di yɛla; ka bɛ mi ti zaŋ di yɛla maa n-yɛli bɛ bihi, ka bɛ gba ti zaŋ di yɛla n-yɛli ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna niriba.
en: Tell our children! Let it be told to our grandchildren and their children too.

dag: A ni lari saɣiŋgu mini kum, ka ti ku zɔri dunia ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri dabiɛm.
en: You will laugh at destruction and hunger; you wont be afraid of wild beasts.

dag: Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli lan yɛli, Bɛ ni ti lihiri bɛ ni daa zaŋ kpani kuhi so la.
en: And there is another scripture that says, People will look at him whom they pierced.

dag: N nintam kul zɔrimi, niriba ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.

dag: ni jɛra ni bɛn bi ʒe yim ni ninkuunsinima ni bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: They are stupid, unreliable, and don't have any love or pity for others.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam kpalim bo ti Duuma, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn zaa kpe n yuli gba bo ma.
en: And so all the rest of the human race will come to me, all the Gentiles whom I have called to be my own.

dag: Chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana dol a fukumsi zaligunim min a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ni o suhu zaa, ka tumdi di tuma din ni chɛ ka o tooi me a jɛmbu du shɛli n ni pun bo nɛma zali ni di me ŋɔ.
en: As for Solomon my son, give him the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, laws, and regulations—observing all of them—and to build the temple that I have prepared.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zan o nyaaŋa n-yɛli ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Jewish crowd spoke up and agreed with what Tertullus had said.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ mal o ansarisi ka dih o vi, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o.
en: He will be handed over to the foreigners, who will laugh at him, insult him, and spit on him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛlikana daa lab kul o ya Rama, ka bia maa daa be Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma.
en: Elkanah and his family went home to Ramah, but the boy stayed in Shiloh and served the Lord under Eli the priest.
