dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus answered, The truth is, tonight you will say you dont know me. You will deny me three times before the rooster crows.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu n-lɔri ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu nia zuɣu. Biɛɣu yi ti neera, bɛ tumdila tuumbiɛri maa, dama bɛ mali di tumbu yiko.
en: Trouble will come to those who make plans to sin. They lie on their beds making their evil plans. Then when the morning light comes, they do what they planned, because they have the power to do what they want.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na ka tiŋ maa nim dii baŋ o.
en: As they left the boat, people recognized Jesus at once.

dag: Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛsi bia Dauda daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ ni duhi ninvuɣ so, Yaakubu Naawuni ni pii ninvuɣ so ka o ŋma yil nyaɣisa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the last words of David the son of Jesse. The God of Jacob chose David and made him a great king. The Mighty God of Israel loved him. When God told him to speak, David said:.

dag: Di saha ka tumo daa kana ti yɛli Sool, Kulimina yomyom, dama Filistianim kana ti liri ti.
en: when a messenger came to Saul and said, Come quickly! The Philistines are attacking Israel and taking everything.

dag: Kum ni kɔnyuri ti ku muɣisi ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim mini pɔhim tulli ti ku kpe ba. Dama ŋun yuri ba n-yɛn mali ba chana. O ni zaŋ ba tahi kɔzɔrim shee.
en: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka baansi yiini yila yɛra, Kamiya Hɛshibɔn na, mɛmiya li. Chɛliya ka Sihɔn tiŋ maa zani.
en: That's why the Amorites had written this poem about Heshbon: Come and rebuild Heshbon, King Sihon's capital city!.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa pam pahi, ka di yɛla bi sabi niŋ kpe. Di zaa yi di sabi, n tɛhi n suhu ni ni di litaafinim naan ku nya palo dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus did many other things. If they were all written in books, I don't suppose there would be room enough in the whole world for all the books.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka di vi. Amaa di chɛ ka man di vi. Chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, amaa di chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba pam.
en: Let my tormentors be disgraced, but not me; let them be terrorized, but not me. Bring on them the time of disaster, as they deserve; destroy them repeatedly.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ŋmaligi chaŋ jinwariba sani bee bukpahinim sani nti doli ba, n ni pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti nyɛ o ni dihiri shɛba, ka nyɛ kaman piɛri be o nuu ni. Di di simdi ni yi wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa lab ti yɛli Naawuni daanab maa. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ kpam maa kɔhi n-yo yi samli maa, ka chɛ din kpalim ka a min a bidibisi maa dira.
en: and she reported this to the man of God. He said, Go! Sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what remains.

dag: ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni booni kasia la kilɔgiram ayɔbu, ka yi ti zaŋ luɣ kasi shee sania la zahim di zaa. Ka a bo olivi kpam lita anahi pahi di zuɣu.
en: five hundred of cassia—measured by the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.

dag: O zaŋ li bahi sagbana tiŋli zaa, ka chɛ ka o saanyaɣisibu paai dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.

dag: Yiɣisima, dama di nyɛla a tuma, ka ti gba ʒe a nyaaŋa, mali yaa, ka niŋ li.
en: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chaŋ ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa pipihi ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa kpuɣi Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu na maa, ka naa min o kpambaliba ni o paɣiba ni o mamanim ti mal li nyuri wain maa;.
en: When the gold cups were brought in, everyone at the banquet drank from them and praised their idols made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.

dag: Niriba yi turi ya ka niŋdi ya alaka, ka ŋmari ʒi biɛri balibu kam pari ya n zuɣu, yi mal alibarika.
en: Happy are you when people insult you and harass you and speak all kinds of bad and false things about you, all because of me.

dag: ka o zaŋ li ŋubi bɛ zaa nini maa ni.
en: which he took and ate in their presence.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa din daa be bɛ sani ka bɛ booni li Baalnim la mini buɣili Ashitarɔt labi, ka jɛmdila Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: So the Israelites threw away their statues of Baal and Ashtoreth. The Israelites served only the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɔn daa bi bɔri ni o saɣi ka yɛl o, Mani n-naan ka a sanna ka a ti baptaizi ma, amaa ka nyini nti lee kani n sanna.
en: But John tried to stop him. John said, Why do you come to me to be baptized? I should be baptized by you.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nini kpa tiŋa.
en: The followers with Jesus heard this voice. They were very afraid, so they fell to the ground.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka ŋmaligi doli buɣa n-jɛmdi li la zuɣu ka Yawɛ chɛ ka yɛl biɛri ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa. .
en: The answer will come: Because they deserted the LORD their God, who brought their ancestors out of Egypts land. They embraced other gods, worshipping and serving them. That is why the LORD brought all this disaster on them.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya m biɛhigu shee din be Shilo ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni daa zaŋ leei n jɛmbu shee la nti nya n ni daa niŋ li shɛm n niriba Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Just go to my sanctuary in Shiloh, where I let my name dwell at first, and see what I did to it because of the evil of my people Israel.

dag: N daa fabili niŋ a n wahala dabisili dali, ka a garigi ma.
en: I call to you in times of trouble, because you answer my prayers.

dag: Ti Duuma, teemi bɛ ni maani mani a dabili ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; teemi niriba ni turi ma tu shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: Remember your servants abuse, my Lord! Remember how I bear in my heart all the insults of the nations.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi tin ya vuhim yi dimnim bɛn gili ya ŋɔ sani tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya ni yi su li maa ni, yin kpihimmiya Amalɛknim maa birili dunia ŋɔ ni, Miriya ka yi ti tam.
en: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.

dag: Ka n daa tɛhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la mali zuɣusuŋ gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be bɛ nyɛviya ni.
en: I said to myself, The dead are better off than the living.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bol o na ka o min o ti di ka nyu, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka o nyu dam kuli, ka di daa ti niŋ yuŋ ka o yi samban ni nayili guliba maa sani nti dɔni o bindoo zuɣu, ka daa bi kul o yiŋa.
en: Then David called Uriah to come and see him. Uriah ate and drank with David. David got him drunk, but Uriah still did not go home. That evening, Uriah again slept at the palace with the rest of the kings servants.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gbahi Midian paɣiba mini bɛ bihi, ka gbahi bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu zaa, ka di bɛ nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: The Israelites took the Midianite women and children as prisoners. They also took all their sheep, cattle, and other things.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa daa guni yomyom, dama o suhu daa yu Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa hal ti yaɣi. O daa nyɛla yulilana o daŋ ni.
en: Shechem was very happy to do what Dinahs brothers asked. Shechem was the most honored man in his family.

dag: Bɔ ka n niŋ ya ka di be di ko ni cheechi shɛŋa din kpalim la n-naɣ pahila n ni bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya la? Chɛliya dimbɔŋɔ taali paŋ ma!.
en: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.

dag: Ti mabihi, yi daa nya wahala mi kaman Naawuni cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la niriba bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Yi daa nya alaka yimaŋmaŋ zuliya sani mi kaman bɛ gba ni daa nya alaka Yɛhudianim sani shɛm.
en: Brothers and sisters, you are just like Gods churches in Judea. I mean that you were treated badly by your own people, just as those believers in Christ Jesus were treated badly by other Jews—.

dag: A chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi n sani guui, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You made my enemies turn tail from me; I destroyed my foes.

dag: Jɔn daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John wore clothes made of camels hair, with a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

dag: Ka o ni ti yɛn bahi nyaŋ o dim so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla kum.
en: The last enemy to be defeated will be death.

dag: Yi yi doli Naawuni nam zaligu kaman di ni wuhi shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la, yi niŋ din tuhi. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: You do well when you really fulfill the royal law found in scripture, Love your neighbor as yourself. .

dag: Niŋm ania zaŋ amaŋ wuhi ni a nyɛla tumtumdi so Naawuni ni di shɛhira, ka a ku di vi a tuma ni, ka ni nyɛla ŋun wuhiri Naawuni yɛligu yɛlimaŋtali dɛde.
en: Do your best to win full approval in God's sight, as a worker who is not ashamed of his work, one who correctly teaches the message of God's truth.

dag: Dama di simdi ni ninvuɣ kura maa kul kpalim be tiliginsim tiŋ maa ni hal ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ti kpi, amaa maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa kum nyaaŋa, ninvuɣ kura maa ni tooi lab omaŋmaŋ ya.
en: You must stay inside the town until the high priest dies; only then can you go back home.

dag: Bɛ shihi vu m-miri gballi ni, ka bɛ nyɛviya miri bɛn tahiri kum na.
en: they are about to go to the world of the dead.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Manaasa min o niriba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they wouldnt listen.

dag: N suhir a mi, chɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ taali. Dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni me a yili a ni tuhiri ŋun Yawɛ tɔb shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu; ka a ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: Please forgive any offense by your servant. The LORD will definitely make an enduring dynasty for my master because my master fights the LORDs battles, and nothing evil will be found in you throughout your lifetime.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni mali tahima so sani. Bɛnkam zaɣis a ni di vi. Bɛnkam zo ka chɛ a, bɛ ni sabi bɛ yuya niŋ tiŋgban ni, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ.
en: Lord , you are the hope of Israel. You are like a spring of living water. Those who stop following the Lord will have a very short life.

dag: N ni tim malaika na ka o ti be yi tooni n-guli ya yi chandi maa ni hal ti zaŋ ya paai n ni mali luɣ shɛli zali ya la ni.
en: Im about to send a messenger in front of you to guard you on your way and to bring you to the place that Ive made ready.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim; bɛ ku zo dabiɛm. Di bahigu ni, bɛ ni ti di nasara bɛ dimnim sani.
en: They remain confident and without fear, so they defeat their enemies.

dag: Amaa ka ti yaannim ni daa ku Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sul la zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Kalidia nir la daa kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba; ka wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka gbahi niriba maa n-ʒi ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: But because our ancestors angered the God of heaven, he gave them over into the power of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar, the Chaldean, who destroyed this house and deported the people to Babylonia.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pɔri Samaria buɣili Ashima yɛra, Dan, a buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu, bee n-yɛra, Bɛrishiiba buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu; bɛ ni lu ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.

dag: Amaa yi zuɣu ka n daa ku Amɔrinima daa wɔɣawɔɣa kaman sida tihi, ka mali yaa kaman oki tihi la. N daa ku bɛ mini bɛ bihi zaa.
en: And yet, my people, it was for your sake that I totally destroyed the Amorites, who were as tall as cedar trees and as strong as oaks.

dag: Chamiya ti tum tuma maa, dama bɛ bi lan yɛn tin ya mɔri, amaa yi mi kul yɛn ŋmarila bilichiisi maa kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga la.
en: Now, go back to work! We will not give you any straw. And you must still make as many bricks as you did before.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa nyɛ Manaasa ba, ka Manaasa nyɛ Ɛmɔn ba, ka Ɛmɔn mi nyɛ Jɔsia ba.
en: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh. Manasseh was the father of Amon. Amon was the father of Josiah.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua maa daa boli maligumaaniba na nti yɛli ba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka la, ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: Joshua called the priests and told them, Take the Covenant Box, and seven of you go in front of it, carrying trumpets.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa yɛl o, A ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: Moses father-in-law said to him, What you are doing isnt good.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zuliya bahila yoli zaŋ Hɛshibɔn hal ni Dibɔn, ka ti ŋmani saɣiri doya hal ka buɣim ti di m-paai Mɛdɛba.
en: But now their descendants are destroyed, All the way from Heshbon to Dibon, From Nashim to Nophah, near Medeba.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi tiligira. Mani n-daa nam ya. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa. N kɔŋko n-daa nam zuɣusaa. Mani n-daa lan nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ.
en: I am the Lord , your savior; I am the one who created you. I am the Lord , the Creator of all things. I alone stretched out the heavens; when I made the earth, no one helped me.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi ka naabu? Bee bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya ka yi na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Your long speeches never end! Why do you continue arguing?.

dag: . Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli n ni zali ya, Yumiya taba! .
en: This is my command: Love each other.

dag: M biyurigu, n suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka shɛlikam be viɛnyɛla a sani, ka a lan mal alaafee a niŋgbuŋ ni gba kaman n ni mi ni a shia mal alaafee shɛm.
en: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Nir yi jɛmdi Naawuni, di ka anfaani.
en: I know this because he says, You will gain nothing if you try to please God.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then I gave this message to King Zedekiah in Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chɛ Filistianim kari doli; ka Filistianim maa daa labi bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Saul did not chase the Philistines. The Philistines went back to their place.

dag: Bɛ fa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni nɛma, ka bɛ kpalim gbihirimi; ka tɔbbi so ku lan tooi zaŋ o nuu ku buchi shɛli.
en: The bravehearted lie plundered. They sank into deep lethargy. All the strong troops couldnt even lift their hands!.

dag: A paɣibu yɛla kul bela n nol ni, ka n yɛr a tibiginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa.
en: I am always singing about the wonderful things you do.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi po alizanda pola di mini Naawuni nam ʒiishee n-tabili ŋun Naawuni ŋun ʒi di ni maa.
en: Whoever uses heaven to make a promise is using Gods throne and the one who is seated on it.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi ti paai ti, kaman tibidarigibo tɔbu bee alɔbo bee fifali, ka ti ka a duu ŋɔ gbin na nti zani a tooni n-fabili niŋ a ti muɣisigu saha a ni wum ti fabila maa ka tiligi ti dama a be duu ŋɔ ni. .
en: that if any disaster struck them to punish them—a war, an epidemic, or a famine—then they could come and stand in front of this Temple where you are worshiped. They could pray to you in their trouble, and you would hear them and rescue them.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka m bɔhi biɛri. N chɛ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim pa tampiŋ maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: I have left the blood there, where it cannot be hidden, where it demands angry revenge.

dag: nti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo piɛɣu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o mali alahichi sanyoo sara luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la.
en: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.

dag: ka Gidiɔni bia Abidan daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.

dag: Lihimi Bɛhɛmɔt so n ni nam kaman n ni nam a shɛm ŋɔ; o ŋubirila mɔri kaman naɣilaa la.
en: Look at the behemoth. I made the behemoth, and I made you. He eats grass like a cow.

dag: Tiŋgbɔna ŋɔ buɣa zaa banim, na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔna bahi, ka Yawɛ ti fari Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahira? .
en: Which one of any of the gods of those lands has rescued their country from my power? Why should the LORD rescue Jerusalem from my power.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa saɣi, ka zahim Ɛfurɔn ni daa yɛli anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisinahi shɛli Hitinim maa ninni maa ti Ɛfurɔn; ka di nyɛ kaman kɔhigɔriba ni daa zahindi li shɛm.
en: Abraham agreed and weighed out the amount that Ephron had mentioned in the hearing of the people—four hundred pieces of silver, according to the standard weights used by the merchants.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan yɛli Yisifu, N daa bi tɛhi ni n ni lan nya a ni n nini, amaa ka Naawuni mi ti chɛ ka n nya a bihi gba.
en: Jacob turned to Joseph and told him, For many years I thought you were dead and that I would never see you again. But now God has even let me live to see your children.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo nambɔɣu, di ni ti nyɛla nyɛvil la nyɛvili, nin la nini, nyin la nyini, nuu la nuu, napɔŋ la napɔŋ.
en: Show no mercy on this point: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti tiligi saɣi bɛ daalahichi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa tum ma bɛ yɔhiŋ puuni la mini bɛ ni zaɣisi ma dolibu.
en: But maybe the people will confess their sins. And maybe they will confess the sins of their ancestors. Maybe they will admit that they turned against me. Maybe they will admit that they sinned against me.

dag: Dama di daa nyɛla jirambisa tambu buta. Di daa ka pilanima kaman dundɔntitali ni pilanim la. Lala zuɣu du shɛŋa din daa be zuɣusaa maa daa labi nyaaŋa n-gari tiŋ mini sunsuuni dina la.
en: The rooms at all three levels were on terraces and were not supported by columns like the other buildings in the courtyard.

dag: O daa shiri kpila sokam zaa zuɣu ni bɛn mali nyɛviya la di lan be bɛmaŋmaŋ yubu tumbu zuɣu, amaa ka ni bela ŋun daa kpi bɛ zuɣu ka lan neei maa yubu tumbu zuɣu.
en: He died for all, so that those who live should no longer live for themselves, but only for him who died and was raised to life for their sake.

dag: Yuza ni Pasia ni Bɛsai ni.
en: Uzza, Paseah, Besai.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o deemba maa soli lu o sizuura, ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ. Ka bɛ daa puhi tab bɔhi tab daalaafee yɛla; ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Musa suɣili ni.
en: So Moses went out to meet his father-in-law. Moses bowed down before him and kissed him. The two men asked about each others health. Then they went into Moses tent to talk more.

dag: Ka ninsalinim daa ti tumdi tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka duŋ taabo daa kul be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: In Gods sight, the earth had become corrupt and was filled with violence.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo, bɛ daa piila Bɛza din be Rubin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la mini Ramɔt din be Giliad Gaad zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la ni Golan din be Bashan Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la.
en: East of the Jordan, on the desert plateau east of Jericho, they chose Bezer in the territory of Reuben; Ramoth in Gilead, in the territory of Gad; and Golan in Bashan, in the territory of Manasseh.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ baɣisi fiig tia wala ta bintɔrigu maa ka a nya alaafee.
en: Then Isaiah told Hezekiah, Crush figs together and put them on your sore. Then you will get well.

dag: Ka Taainim shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni daa ʒi zahim mini nɛma balibu kam na ti kɔhi Judanim zuɣu ka kɔhi li Jɛrusalɛm puuni Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.

dag: ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ la mini sida dari la ni mi ʒee la ni taaŋkɔro la ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa zaa tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so kɔzɔrim kom ni la ʒim ni.
en: He shall take the other bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the red cord, and the hyssop, in the blood of the bird that was killed.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa daŋ tooni na la o daa yihirila waazu yɛri Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ niŋm tuuba ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Before Jesus appearance, John proclaimed to all the Israelites a baptism to show they were changing their hearts and lives.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pina yɛla polo, m bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni.
en: Now, concerning what you wrote about the gifts from the Holy Spirit. I want you to know the truth about them, my friends.

dag: Di saha maa n daa ʒiɛla yi mini Yawɛ sunsuuni ni n zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisi ya, dama yi daa zɔrila dabiɛm buɣim maa zuɣu, ka daa bi du zoli maa zuɣu. Ka o daa yɛli.
en: I stood between you and the Lord at that time to tell you what he said, because you were afraid of the fire and would not go up the mountain. The Lord said.

dag: Dama yi yi niŋdi ba alaka ka bɛ fabili niŋ ma, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni gbilisi tibili wum bɛ fabila maa.
en: If you do, they will beg for my help, and I will come to their rescue.

dag: Jakim mini Zikiri ni Zabidi.
en: Shimei's descendants included Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi, Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel, Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Jɛrusalɛm; ka Yisa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti kariti bɛn kɔhiri mini bɛn dari nɛma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daari laɣitaɣiriba teebuya mini ŋmaŋkɔhiriba kuɣisi luhira;.
en: After Jesus and his disciples reached Jerusalem, he went into the temple and began chasing out everyone who was selling and buying. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and the benches of those who were selling doves.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi ni be n yurilim maa ni kaman n gba ni doli m Ba zaligu ka be o yurilim ni shɛm.
en: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.

dag: dindina n ni yihi ya n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni, ka zaɣisi n ni daa pii jɛmbu du shɛli ni yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ŋɔ gba, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam mal li ansarisi ka ʒiɛm li.
en: then I will take the Israelites out from my land that I gave them. And I will leave this Temple that I have made holy for my name. I will make this Temple something that all the nations will speak evil about.

dag: ni alahichi sanyoo sara bula yino m-pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and drink offerings.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbihi, ka maligumaaniba maa daa taɣi bɛ ʒim n-zaŋ li mihi sara maligu bimbini maa, ka Lɛvinim mi shiri biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: Then they slaughtered the Passover lambs, and the priests splashed the blood while the Levites skinned the animals.

dag: N ni ti ŋme a tɔbu a nuzaa ni bahi, ka a piɛma yi a nudirigu ni lu.
en: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand.

dag: Daadam, n yɛn zaŋla a ni yuri ninvuɣ so pam yim ka chɛ a. Amaa miri ka a ti fabili bee n-kum bee n-chɛ ka nintam yi a ninni.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, I will suddenly take the life of the person you love most. But I don't want you to complain or cry.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim ni ti lan jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tibigi bɛ Naa Dauda, ka bɛ ti zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri zaɣ viɛlli o sani dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king; they will come trembling to the LORD and to the LORDs goodness in the latter days.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun pa a niriba Izraɛlnim ni yino yi ti yi katiŋ na a yuli zuɣu.
en: When a foreigner who lives in a distant land hears of your fame and of the great things you have done for your people and comes to worship you and to pray at this Temple.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa ti buŋ maa noli ka o bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ a ka a fiɛb ma buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: When that happened, the Lord told the donkey to speak, and it asked Balaam, What have I done that made you beat me three times.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya paya. Bɛnjamin niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Gidiɔni bia Abidan.
en: On the other side, the tribe of Benjamin: the chief of the people of Benjamin is Abidan, Gideonis son.

dag: Yi yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba, dunianim naan yuri ya, amaa yi pala dunia ni su shɛba, dama mani m-pii ya, dinzuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim jɛn ya maa.
en: If you belonged to the world, the world would love you as its own. However, I have chosen you out of the world, and you dont belong to the world. This is why the world hates you.

dag: Farisiinim daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ saha ka Naawuni nam yɛn piligi? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Naawuni nam bi yɛn piligimi ni shihira ka niriba nya li ni bɛ nini;.
en: Some Pharisees asked Jesus when the Kingdom of God would come. His answer was, The Kingdom of God does not come in such a way as to be seen.

dag: Balinte a ti yɛli ni a bi nyar o; amaa yɛla maa kpalimla o sani, kul guhim o.
en: So, Job, God will not listen to you when you say that you dont see him. You say you are waiting for your chance to meet with him and prove that you are innocent.

dag: Ka o daa kpah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ miri ka bɛ yɛli so ni ŋun Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah.

dag: O zuli kpɛmmi kaman sida tia la; ka o gbalipina ni jila kpɛnkpe tab ni.
en: His tail stands strong like a cedar tree. His leg muscles are very strong.

dag: Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahinahi, ka binshɛli din ŋmani ninsal nuhi be bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔna ni.
en: Each had four faces and four wings, with the form of a human hand under their wings.

dag: Wumpaɣibo yila ni ti yiri di puuni na, ka bɛn puhiri chuɣu ni ti yɔri vuri di puuni. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ nabi, ka ku lan pɔra. N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima, ka so ku lan mali ba ansarisi.
en: There will be laughter and songs of thanks. I will add to their numbers so they dont dwindle away. I will honor them so they arent humiliated.

dag: Tulaale mɔri chɛ ka di nyom chani ginda, ka tiwal viɛla zaa ʒe m-baɣi ti dunoya. N yura, di zaɣ kura mini zaɣ pala ka n zaŋ zal a.
en: Perfume from the magic flower fills the air, my darling. Right at our doorstep I have stored up for you all kinds of tasty fruits.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ni ninsal shia durila zuɣusaa, ka biŋkɔbigu shia siɣiri tiŋgban ni?.
en: Who knows if a human beings life-breath rises upward while an animals life-breath descends into the earth?.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu n-nyɛ: piɛbihi ayi bɛn paai yuuni dabisili kam, ka kul niŋdi lala sahakam.
en: Every day for all time to come, sacrifice on the altar two one-year-old lambs.

dag: Karimbaandan ŋun nyɛ nyarimaŋlana yuli m-booni Ansarisimaana. O kul tumdila karimbaani duhimaŋtali tuma.
en: Show me a conceited person and I will show you someone who is arrogant, proud, and inconsiderate.

dag: mini niɣi tuhi pisopɔinnaayi.
en: , oxen.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi zaa n-yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ Zairi, ka o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim ti lu Ɛdomnim bɛn daa teei gil o zuɣu n-niŋ ba buɣim; amaa ka o tɔbbihi daa zo n-kuli.
en: So Jehoram and his cavalry marched to Zair, where the Edomite army surrounded him and his commanders. During the night he attacked the Edomites, but he was defeated, and his troops escaped to their homes.

dag: Hɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrɛt mini Izar ni Ɛtinan.
en: Helahs family: Zereth, Zohar, and Ethnan.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa garigi yɛli Jɔab, Hal anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili yi kpe n nuu ni gba, n ku zaŋ n nuu shihi nabia maa, dama ti di wum naa ni yɛl a mini Abishai ni Itai, N zuɣu miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom maa shɛli.
en: The man answered, Even if you paid me , pieces of silver here and now, I still wouldn't touch the king's son. We all heard King David tell you and Abishai and Ittai not to harm Absalom.

dag: Ayuba ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: He said.

dag: Yuma shɛm nyaaŋa ha, Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Pɛriʒia Naa saha shɛl la, do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Ɛzra. Ɛzra daa nyɛla Sɛraya bia, ka Sɛraya nyɛ Azaria bia, ka Azaria nyɛ Hilikia bia.
en: After these things, during the rule of King Artaxerxes of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylon. Ezra was the son of Seraiah. Seraiah was the son of Azariah. Azariah was the son of Hilkiah.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim, ka tɛhi ni shɛli bi mali ya la, yiɣisimiya wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Women of leisure, stand up! Hear my voice! Carefree daughters, listen to my word!.

dag: Ka ti yi zaɣisila Yawɛ ka me sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ni ti zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee n-zaŋdi bindira sara bee suhudoo sara pari di zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ŋun darigim ti tibili.
en: and we ask the Lord to punish us if we are lying. We didn't build it so we could turn our backs on the Lord . We didn't even build it so we could offer animal or grain sacrifices to please the Lord or ask his blessing.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mi a sujee yiko ni nyɛ shɛm? A suhuyiɣisili galisimi kaman bɛ ni lur a sizuura shɛli ni galisi shɛm.
en: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.

dag: Di yuri gbihibu, di yi pa lala fara ni gbaag a. Neem a nina, a ni nya bindirigu pam.
en: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.

dag: ka zaŋ namda kura din chahi ka bɛ shɛnshe li piri; ka zaŋ binyɛr chɛra ye, ka bɛ bindira zaa kul kuui mili ka kpe yue.
en: The men put old sandals on their feet and wore old clothes. They found some old bread that was dry and moldy.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa be luɣ shɛli din miri Jɛriko maa, ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi nya do so ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe o tooni. Ka Jɔshua daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A lee bela ti polo bee a bela ti dimnim polo.
en: While Joshua was near Jericho, he suddenly saw a man standing in front of him, holding a sword. Joshua went up to him and asked, Are you one of our soldiers, or an enemy.

dag: ka daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli katiŋa din nyɛ daba ata soli chandi ka chɛ Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa gbib ŋun Leeban biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la.
en: So the sons took all the spotted animals and led them to another place. They traveled for three days. Jacob stayed and took care of all the animals that were left.

dag: Yi sɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yiko pam; yi tiligi bɔɣu din ka yaa ŋɔ.
en: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tam dapuhi zuɣu n-zaŋ li buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa ka o zali shɛm la.
en: The Levites carried it on poles on their shoulders, as the Lord had commanded through Moses.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim beni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ sani, di pa shɛli ka yi tɛhi ni yɛlli ŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa man sani, di ni tooi nani.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Even though it may seem to be a miracle for the few remaining among this people in these days, should it seem to be a miracle for me? says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na nti zali pal shɛli din labiri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ni vuri yɔbu mini bana piɛbbu.
en: David and all the Israelites were excited—they shouted and blew the trumpet as they brought the Lord s Holy Box into the city.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri pa o pumpɔŋɔ yɛra, N daa bi nya paɣipalitali shihirili yi bia maa sani. Amaa n-nyɛ m bipuɣiŋga maa paɣipalitali shihira. Di saha ka bɛ zaŋ tani yɛrigi sɔŋ tiŋ maa kpamba maa tooni.
en: He has made false charges against her, saying that she was not a virgin when he married her. But here is the proof that my daughter was a virgin; look at the bloodstains on the wedding sheet.

dag: Waɣ biɛ titali maa ni daa nya ka bɛ yih o bahi dunia ŋɔ ni na maa, ka o gbaai kariti doli paɣ so ŋun daa dɔɣi bidibiga la.
en: When the dragon realized that he had been thrown down to the earth, he began to pursue the woman who had given birth to the boy.

dag: Yi bi niŋ tuuba bee n-lu ma sizuura hal ni zuŋɔ, yi mi bi doli n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim la.
en: Even now, your pride keeps you from respecting me and obeying the laws and teachings I gave you and your ancestors.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu, nyini n-nyɛ n jilima, ka chɛ ka n zuɣu ʒe ya.
en: But you, O Lord , are always my shield from danger; you give me victory and restore my courage.

dag: Dama yɛm ni ka a suhu ni na, ka baŋsim niŋ a nyaɣisim.
en: Wisdom will enter your mind, and knowledge will fill you with delight.

dag: Amaa duŋtaariba mini alahichinim zaa ni ti bahi yoli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ mi ni ti kpi.
en: But God will shatter rebels and sinners alike; those who abandon the LORD will be finished.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaayopɔin daa gbaai Jɔshibɛkasha min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Seventeenth, there were men chosen from Joshbekashahs sons and relatives.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ ku tooi zo n-yi di ni, hal bɛ yi kuhi niŋ ma gba n ku garigi ba.
en: So now I, the Lord , warn them that I am going to bring destruction on them, and they will not escape. And when they cry out to me for help, I will not listen to them.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim bɛn daa niŋ zina o sani ni kɔr biɛr la yi ti nya o buɣim dibu nyɔhi, bɛ ni kum ka fabili pam.
en: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality with her and shared her loose and extravagant ways, will weep and mourn over her when they see the smoke from her burning.

dag: O daa kul niŋd o la lala yuuni kam. Bɛn dee daa yi kul chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, o ni bahi miligi Hanna suhu ka o kum hal ti bi di bindirigu.
en: especially when the family went to the house of the Lord each year. One day, Elkanah was there offering a sacrifice, when Hannah began crying and refused to eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be a ni.
en: Now then, I, the Sovereign Lord , am telling you that I will have troops attack you with swords, and they will kill your people and your animals.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ka o tooni na ni wumpaɣibo; ka chɛ ka ti yɔnya suhupiɛlli vuri yili yila paɣ o!.
en: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.

dag: Yi yi di daa pun doli n zaligunima, yi naan nya alibarika, ka di be kaman kɔzɔrim din bi ŋmaara. Ka yi nasara dibu mi be kaman teeku kɔgbana la.
en: If you would pay attention to my commands, your well-being would be like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.

dag: Daba anii dali ka Musa daa boli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛl kpamba na.
en: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔriti taŋkpaɣu m-puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri, ka kumdi ka fabindi kuhiri yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali ŋɔ daazichi zuɣu ka bɛn mali ŋarima mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa leei bundaannim la, ka di ti zani awa yini puuni n-lu n-dahim zaa.
en: They threw dust on their heads and cried loudly to show the deep sorrow they felt. They said, Terrible! How terrible for the great city! All those who had ships on the sea became rich because of her wealth! But she has been destroyed in one hour!.

dag: Farigudeeriba mini alahichinim zaa daa kul laɣindila Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti wum o wuhibu;.
en: Many tax collectors and sinners came to listen to Jesus.

dag: Di tiɣi Yawɛ nini o wuntitali zuɣu ni o tibig o zaligunima, ka chɛ ka di mali jilima.
en: The Lord wants them to do what is right. He wants them to honor his wonderful teachings.

dag: Azɛl daa malila bidibis ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hanan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Azɛl bidibisi.
en: as well as Azel's six sons: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti baptaizibu deebu zuɣu wuhiya ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ ti, ka di bemi kaman Masia ni daa neei kum ni ti Ba Naawuni jilima yiko zuɣu shɛm la, lala zuɣu ka ti gba yipa mali nyɛvili palli biɛhigu.
en: So when we were baptized, we were buried with Christ and took part in his death. And just as Christ was raised from death by the wonderful power of the Father, so we can now live a new life.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa nyɛ Arab mini Duma ni Ɛshan.
en: There were Arab, Dumah, Eshan.

dag: Rabishake daa labiya nti wum ni Asiria naa yi Lakishi n-chaŋla Libina ka o mini ba ti tuhiri taba.
en: The commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish. He found him at Libnah, fighting against that city.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti ka alahichi, ti yɔhimla timaŋa ka yɛlimaŋli ka ti ni.
en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and there is no truth in us.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Then the ruler said, Ive kept all of these things since I was a boy.

dag: O daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Sool, O daa nyɛla nachimbil viɛlli. Do so daa ka Izraɛl n-viɛl gar o; ka o daa lan wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: He had a son named Saul, a handsome man in the prime of life. Saul was a foot taller than anyone else in Israel and more handsome as well.

dag: Amaa pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Din pahi nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun daa chɛ ka simdi kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni maa zuɣu.
en: And not only that: we even take pride in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, the one through whom we now have a restored relationship with God.

dag: Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm; ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛli, dama ti bela ʒilinsi ni.
en: Job, tell us what we should say to God! We cannot think of what to say because of our ignorance.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim nuu ni ka bɛ su ba yuun pihinahi.
en: The Israelites again did things that the LORD saw as evil, and he handed them over to the Philistines for forty years.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari n karimbanima, dama n kul tɛhirila a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: I understand more than all my teachers, because I meditate on your instructions.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma sahakam. Bɛ ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka nyɛ bɛn suhuri ye n soli baŋbu zuɣu; ka bi tam bɛ Naawuni zaligu yɛla. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ baŋ n saria karibu soli din tuhi yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni Naawuni miri ba.
en: They seek me day after day, desiring knowledge of my ways like a nation that acted righteously, that didnt abandon their God. They ask me for righteous judgments, wanting to be close to God.

dag: Bɛ bi yɛli nyini n dana Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la ka n niŋ shɛm? N daa zaŋla anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka niŋdi bindirigu mini kom ti tiri ba.
en: Surely you have heard what I did when Jezebel was killing the Lord s prophets. I hid of the Lord s prophets in caves. I put prophets in one cave and in another. I brought them food and water.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Arinɔn Mɔɣili yaɣili yɔ shɛli din zaŋ hal ni Amɔrinim tintariga la ni; dama Arinɔn Mɔɣili n-nyɛ Mɔabnim tintariga m-be Mɔabnim mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: After that, they crossed the Arnon River gorge and camped in the Moabite desert bordering Amorite territory. The Arnon was the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, yi daa bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: But you still would not trust the Lord .

dag: Wummiya, yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ nanim bɛn zaɣisi zaligu, ka tiri nimmira yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ.
en: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel, you that hate justice and turn right into wrong.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa paai bɛ kpalansi yomyom sɔŋ tiŋa, ka lɔrigilɔrigi di noya.
en: Each of the brothers quickly put his sack on the ground and opened it.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali bimparilani, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi pa di zuɣu yɛli, O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani. Chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la.
en: Make a strip of pure gold and carve these words into the gold like the writing on a seal: holy to the lord .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o bidibisi pini, di simdi ni di leeg o bidibisi maa dini, ka di nyɛ bɛ fali shɛli bɛ ni yɛn su.
en: The Lord God said: If the ruler of Israel gives some of his land to one of his children, it will belong to the ruler's child as part of the family property.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n nyee nyɔni biɛhigu, dama binshɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla din tiri ma suhugarigu, dinzuɣu di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmani nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gari yi zaa la zuɣu.
en: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.

dag: Di teeri ya binshɛŋa din daa niŋ ka di yuui yɛla bee n-lihiri binshɛŋa din daa pun niŋ kurimbuni ha la.
en: Dont remember the prior things; dont ponder ancient history.

dag: Dama chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa baŋ ni pa Izraɛl naa maa m-bala maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: And when they realized he wasn't Ahab, they left him alone.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn daa guli naa la sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba tahi Babilɔn naa sani Ribila.
en: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard took all of these people and brought them to the Babylonian king at Riblah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla ka o lan tim tuun shɛba, ka bɛ gba ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Ka Sool daa lan tim tuun shɛb yaha m-pahi buta, ka bɛ gba daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: This was reported to Saul, and he sent different messengers, but they also fell into a prophetic frenzy. So Saul sent a third group of messengers, and they did the very same thing.

dag: Dama yi ni so yi yɛli, Man dolila Pool; ka so mi yɛli, N dolila Apolɔs; di yi nyɛ lala, yi gba bi bemi kaman dunianima?.
en: One of you says, I follow Paul, and someone else says, I follow Apollos. When you say things like that, you are acting like people of the world.

dag: Dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita.
en: It takes only a little yeast to make the whole batch of dough rise, as they say.

dag: Bɛ daa kpala tanti, ka booni di puuni luɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni Luɣ Kasi Shee. Firilatamdigu mini teebuli shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro shɛli bɛ ni mali maani sara Naawuni sani m-pari di zuɣu la n-daa be nimaani.
en: They pitched the first tent called the holy place. It contained the lampstand, the table, and the loaves of bread presented to God.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti doli soya ŋɔ n-jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: You must not worship the Lord your God in the same way these people worship their gods.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbiri. Laakumnim daa nyɛla tuhi pihinu, ka piɛri nyɛ tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinu, ka bunsi mi daa nyɛ tusaayi, ka daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma tuhi kɔbiga.
en: They took the animals that belonged to the Hagrites. They took , camels, , sheep, donkeys, and , people.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilahi maa zuɣuri ni, ka yi zaŋ zaɣ yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ Lɛvinim maa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: The Levites shall then put their hands on the heads of the two bulls; one is to be offered as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, in order to perform the ritual of purification for the Levites.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Failimɔn ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpe so ti ni yuri la.
en: From Paul, who is a prisoner for the cause of Christ Jesus, and our brother Timothy. To Philemon our dearly loved coworker.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Ijipti ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kuriba tusa anahi n-taai duŋ zo n-kpe mɔɣu la.
en: Then you are not that Egyptian fellow who some time ago started a revolution and led four thousand armed terrorists out into the desert.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya bee kuriti tum tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ piligim tuma maa, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: with gold, silver, bronze, and iron. Now begin the work, and may the Lord be with you.

dag: O yuri wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ yurilim maŋli kul palila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord loves what is righteous and just; his constant love fills the earth.

dag: Buɣim daa di n-ku bɛ nachimbihi, ka paɣisara daa kɔŋ amiliya lɔbu yila.
en: Young men were killed in war, and young women had no one to marry.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti dɔni Zalimɔna.
en: The Israelites left Mount Hor and headed toward Moab. Along the way, they camped at Zalmonah, Punon, Oboth, Iye-Abarim in the territory of Moab, Dibon-Gad, Almon-Diblathaim, at a place near Mount Nebo in the Abarim Mountains.

dag: Noombihi zaa daa tɛrila bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu; ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa dɔɣiri bɛ bihi di mahim, ka zuliya pam ʒiini di mahim.
en: Birds built nests in its branches, and animals were born beneath it. People from all nations lived in the shade of this strong tree.

dag: O min o biɛyanim maa ni daa na mali alizama saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim tiyaawumya ŋun yuli booni Goliat ka o nyɛ Gaat nir la daa yi Filistianim maa sanna nti lan yɛr o ni daa pun yɛri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la. Ka Dauda daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: As he was talking with them, Goliath came forward and challenged the Israelites as he had done before. And David heard him.

dag: ka suhi Naawuni yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka m bihi ni yino ʒini n nam ʒiishee zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka mmaŋmaŋ nini nya li ŋɔ.
en: and said, Praise the Lord , the God of Israel. He has put one of my own sons on my throne, and he has let me live to see it.

dag: Ka yi ni gahi yi bimbɔba dahin shɛli maa, zaŋmiya piɛlaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dindali.
en: You must also offer a sacrifice to please me. So bring the priest a one-year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma yaha, Di pun niŋ! N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla, Piligu ni Bahigu. Kɔnyuri ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la, n ni ti ba nyɛvili kom din nyɛ kɔbilisirim la yoli.
en: Then he said to me, All is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. To the thirsty I will freely give water from the life-giving spring.

dag: Ka Pool daa kul kpɛri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka kul wuhiri ba hal ni chira ata.
en: Paul went to the synagogue and spoke confidently for the next three months. He interacted with those present and offered convincing arguments concerning the nature of Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o sani palli naŋgbanyee ti yɛl o, Kamina ti chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Dama o daa bi mi ni o bia pakoli maa m-bala. Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma ka chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: He turned to her beside the road and said, Let me sleep with you, because he didnt know she was his daughter-in-law. She said, What will you give me for sleeping with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Mɛriba kom, luɣ shɛli Izraɛlnim mini Yawɛ ni daa yɛl tab finafina ni luɣ shɛli o ni daa wuhi ni o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: This happened at Meribah, where the people of Israel complained against the Lord and where he showed them that he is holy.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi sani, din kariya, ka n chɛ Yawɛ suhi tin ya, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. N ni wuhi ya so shɛli din viɛli ka tuhi.
en: And as for me, I would never stop praying for you. If I stopped praying for you, I would be sinning against the Lord . I will continue to teach you the right way to live a good life.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mi daa bo alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini kpa viɛlli lita tuhi kɔbisinahi n-ti Hiram min o yiŋnima. Lala ka Sulemaana daa kul niŋdi tiri Hiram yuuni kam.
en: In return, Solomon gave Hiram over , tons of wheat and almost , liters of pure olive oil each year.

dag: Ka naa daa yi ti kul chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli nayili dunoli maa kpuɣirila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, ka ti lan zaŋ li ti niŋ bɛ duu yaha.
en: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord 's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he was finished.

dag: A zaŋ a niriba kɔhi alaha, a bi zali ba da kpiɔŋ.
en: You sold your people for nothing. You did not even argue over the price.

dag: Bɛn mali suhupiɛlli, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu m-mali suhupiɛlli; bɛn fabinda, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu fabili.
en: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: But Ahimaaz son of Zadok begged Joab again, No matter what happens, please let me also run after the Ethiopian! Joab said, Son, why do you want to carry the news? You will not get any reward for the news you bring.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Labisim a takɔb maa su di tɔɣu ni, dama ŋunkam ŋoori takɔbi ti kpirila takɔb kum.
en: Then Jesus said to him, Put the sword back into its place. All those who use the sword will die by the sword.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa ʒii nyabu ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ bini dihi litaafi shɛli noli tabili puuni yɛtɔɣa, ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ku tooi karim li, bini ka bɛ zaŋ dihi di noli tabili.
en: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, We can't read it, because it's sealed.

dag: Dama Naawuni ŋun daa yɛli ni neesim neem zibisim ni la, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka o neesim neei ti suhuri ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ Naawuni jilima neesim din neeri yiri Masia ninni na la.
en: God once said, Let light shine out of the darkness! And this is the same God who made his light shine in our hearts to let us know that his own divine greatness is seen in the face of Christ.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: It is not right, Job, for you to say that you are innocent in God's sight.

dag: Niŋmi ba kaman buɣim ni diri nyɔŋ shɛm la, bee kaman buɣim niɛm ni taari diri zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa labina, di saha maa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Jabɛshigiliad paɣ shɛb bɛ ni daa bi kula ti ba. Amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi saɣi ba.
en: So the Benjaminites returned at that time, and they gave them the women from Jabesh-gilead that they had allowed to live. Even so, there werent enough for them.

dag: N daa bela yi sani ni chɔɣinsi mini dabeenzɔbo ni ni sɔhibu.
en: I stood in front of you with weakness, fear, and a lot of shaking.

dag: ka di pa ni yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli kaman bɛn bi doli Naawuni zaligu ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Dont be controlled by your sexual urges like the Gentiles who dont know God.

dag: Ninsalinima m-be o sani maa, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ m-be ti sani ni o sɔŋ ti ka tuhi ti tɔb kam ti ti. Ka Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpaŋsi niriba maa suhuri pam.
en: because the Lord our God fights on our side. The Assyrians must rely on human power alone. These words encouraged the army of Judah.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ Ribɛka yiŋ dabipaɣ la daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o oki ti shɛli din daa be Bɛtɛl tiŋli la gbini. Ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Kumsi tia.
en: Deborah, Rebekahs nurse, died there. They buried her under the oak tree at Bethel. They named that place Allon Bacuth.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ Shunɛm ka paɣ bundaan so daa be nimaani m-balim o ni o dim bindirigu. Dinzuɣu o daa yi ti doli nimaani polo saha shɛlikam, o kpɛrila yili maa ni ti diri bindirigu.
en: One day Elisha went to Shunem. A rich woman lived there. She urged him to eat something, so whenever he passed by, he would stop in to eat some food.

dag: Yɛlim ti a ni tɛhiri shɛm: Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: Tell us what you think! Should we pay taxes to the Emperor or not.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini di niriba zuɣu din nyɛ yɛl biɛ shɛŋa zaa din sabi kundi shɛli bɛ ni karim wuhi Juda naa maa ni la.
en: This is what the LORD says: I am about to bring disaster on this place and its citizens—all the curses written in the scroll that they have read to Judahs king.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba na ti yɛli ba, Saha shɛli din gari la puuni, yi daa kul bɔri ni Naa Dauda n-leei yi naa.
en: Abner talked with the leaders of the tribes of Israel and told them, You've wanted to make David your king for a long time now.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli.
en: Through his servants the prophets the Lord said.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu na saha ka Yaakubu daa yi Pɛnuɛl chana ka luri wɔbiliwɔbili, o sakpuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: Then the sun came up as Jacob left Peniel. He was limping because of his leg.

dag: A daalikauli nyɛla din tiri ma nyɛvili; dina n-nyɛ n suhu kpaŋsibo n wahala dibu puuni.
en: You comfort me in my suffering, because your promise gives me new life.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ku bɛ nachimba zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Babylons young men will be killed in the streets. All her soldiers will die on that day. This is what the Lord says.

dag: Ka nyin daadam, bɛ ni ti niŋ mihi niŋ a n-zaŋ li lo a, ka a ku lan tooi yina niriba ni.
en: Look at you, human one! Theyve now put cords on you and bound you up so that you cant go out among them.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Asaaya n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi ni pisi pah o zuɣu.
en: Asaiah, the leader of Meraris family, and of his relatives.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti Ijiptinim daŋ pam, ka lan tib ba. Bɛ ni ti lab Yawɛ sanna, ka o deei bɛ suhigu ka tib ba.
en: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Naawuni daa be Masia ni n-zaŋdi dunianim naari ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa, ka bi lan niŋdi bɛ daalahichi laasabu, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni yɛla niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: Our message is that God was making all human beings his friends through Christ. God did not keep an account of their sins, and he has given us the message which tells how he makes them his friends.

dag: Gibar daŋ — pihiwɛinaanu.
en: of Gibbar.

dag: Mbusim din be kaman kokpɛɣu la vuri niŋdi ma, ka a kɔgbana zaa min a kopaliga kana ti du ma gari.
en: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka n kuhira, ka nintam zɔri n ninni maa; dama ŋun yɛn maai n suhu be katiŋa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ma suhukpeeni. Bɛ zaɣisi m bihi; dama n dim nyaŋ ma.
en: I cry about all these things. Tears are flowing down my cheeks. There is no one near to comfort me. There is no one who can make me feel better. My children are like a wasteland, because the enemy won.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ o yurilim maŋli min o ni tumdi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa tiri daadamnim la zuɣu.
en: Thank the Lord for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana malila biɛrisuŋ; di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino; ka di mi simdi ni o bihi nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba, ka pa ni niriba ni ni tooi galim shɛba bɛ ni bi gbaari bɛmaŋ shɛm bee bɛ tipawumli zuɣu.
en: an elder must be without fault; he must have only one wife, and his children must be believers and not have the reputation of being wild or disobedient.

dag: Ka Tɛra daa ti niŋ ŋun kani Haran tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Tɛra daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaanu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: Terah lived to be years old. He died in Haran.

dag: Niŋmiya lala pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara zuɣu n-zaŋ di mini di binnyura sara mali sara. Di bi simdi ni bɛ mali dansi.
en: You will offer these in addition to the regular entirely burned offering, its grain offering and drink offerings. They will be flawless.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nachimba ni ti lu di zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka bɛ ti ku di tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On that day her young men will be killed in the city streets, and all her soldiers destroyed.

dag: O nam dibu yuma ata saha ka o daa laɣim o kpambaliba min o tuma zuɣulaannim na ni bɛ ti puhi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu chuɣu. Pɛriʒia mini Miidia tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim gba daa beni nti pahi gomnanim mini tiŋgbana maa nabihi.
en: In the third year of his reign he gave a banquet for all his officials and administrators. The armies of Persia and Media were present, as well as the governors and noblemen of the provinces.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, Di chaŋya Ijipti. Baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni n wuhi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You who survive from Judah, the LORD has told you: Dont go to Egypt. Know without a doubt that I have warned you this day.

dag: Amaa man Naawuni bɔhiri ninvuɣ biɛri, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul tɔɣisiri n zaligunim yɛla sahakam? Bee bɔzuɣu ka yi tɔɣisiri n daalikauli yɛla?.
en: But God says to the wicked, Why should you recite my commandments? Why should you talk about my covenant?.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li yomyom ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The seeds that fell on rocky ground stand for those who receive the message gladly as soon as they hear it.

dag: Ka yili maa ni paɣa daa zaŋ bini pa kɔbiliga maa noli n-yɛrigi chi diɛli di zuɣu, ka so daa bi baŋ ni shɛli be nimaani.
en: The mans wife spread a sheet over the mouth of the well and covered it with grain. The well looked like a pile of grain, so no one would know to look there.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: And the report about Jesus spread everywhere in that region.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali dabili, ka o nyɛla ŋun kɔri bee ŋun guli biŋkɔbiri ka ti kuna, ka a dii yɛl o, Kamina ti ʒini di bindirigu.
en: Suppose one of you has a servant who is plowing or looking after the sheep. When he comes in from the field, do you tell him to hurry along and eat his meal?.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o dɔɣiriba ni o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: Jesus said to them, Prophets are honored everywhere except in their own hometowns, among their relatives, and in their own households.

dag: Pagɔrili noli ŋmanila bɔɣ zilinli; Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu n-yɛn lu di puuni.
en: The mouth of a mysterious woman is a deep pit; those under the LORDs wrath will fall in it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chɛ bɛ lansi maa ka dol o.
en: Simon and Andrew immediately left their nets and followed him.

dag: Ka din lan pahi nyɛla, ninvuɣ biɛri yi zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, bɛ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: And if evil people change and become good and fair, they will save their lives. They will live!.

dag: Ŋun daa ʒiya maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa jasipa ni kanɛlian la; ka sagani din ŋmani bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli ɛmɛrald la booi gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: The one seated there looked like jasper and carnelian, and surrounding the throne was a rainbow that looked like an emerald.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yi ni baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ be yi sani, ka ni kari Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Hivinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Gɛrigashinim ni Amɔrinim ni Jɛbusinima.
en: Here is proof that the living God is really with you and that he will surely defeat your enemies. He will defeat the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites, and Jebusites; he will force them to leave their land.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman wurigu la pɔhim tooni, ka Yawɛ malaika kari ba bahi.
en: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ zaa mi ni n daa kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni nti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ a yɛda m-bu ba ka kpɛhi ba duu.
en: I said, But, Lord, the people know that I was the one who put the believers in jail and beat them. I went through all the synagogues to find and arrest the people who believe in you.

dag: Bɛ ku leei bundaannima, ka bɛ nyamma pala din ni zani yuui; ka bɛ daazichi mi ku yɛligi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He will not be rich for long. His wealth will not last. His crops will not grow large.

dag: Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi me duu ti o, dama alizanda mini di galisim zaa ku saɣ o? Ka m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni nti mɛri duu tir o? N kul yɛn mɛla luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim o tooni.
en: No one can really build a house to put our God in. The whole sky and the highest heaven cannot contain our God, so I cannot build a temple to put him in. I can only build a place to burn incense to honor him.

dag: Bɛ bo n-nya ma pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ teemi gili ma, bɛ lihirimi bɔri bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli n-voo ma luhi.
en: They track me down— suddenly, they surround me! They make their plans to put me in the dirt.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku yi nahu sɔŋ yi ninni, amaa ka yi ku ŋub o nimdi, ka bɛ ti fa yi buŋa yi ninni chaŋ, ka ku lan zaŋ o labisina ti tin ya. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi piɛri ti yi dimnima, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: People will kill your cattle in front of you, but you will not eat any of the meat. People will take your donkeys, and they will not give them back to you. Your enemies will get your sheep, and there will be no one to help you.

dag: ni bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ alahichinim nuu ni ka bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu, amaa ni di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni la.
en: that the Human One must be handed over to sinners, be crucified, and on the third day rise again.

dag: A zal a zaligunima ni niriba dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Lord , you have given us your laws and told us to obey them faithfully.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli o tuun viɛla yɛla n-sani, ka daa zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o. Ka Tɔbaya daa kul sabiri gbana tiri ma na ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm.
en: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.

dag: Di saha ka o buɣisi dundɔŋ ni dunɔdali puuni tooni din be tiŋli polo la tooni zaŋ hal ni sambani dunɔdali gbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: When he measured the width from the inside of the lower gate to the outer edge of the inner courtyard, it was one hundred fifty feet. After he measured the east gate, he measured the north gate.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi ni a chɛli bɛ taali, ka a yi ku chɛ bɛ taali maa, dindina nyin kpihimmi n yuli a ni sab li niŋ litaafi shɛl ni la.
en: Please forgive their sin; but if you won't, then remove my name from the book in which you have written the names of your people.

dag: Bɛ daa tuui zaŋ o tahila Annas sani, dama Annas daa nyɛla Kaiafas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la deemba.
en: They took him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, A ni nya ka salo daar a ŋ-ŋɔ, ka a ti bɔhi ni ŋuni n-lee shih a.
en: His disciples said to him, Dont you see the crowd pressing against you? Yet you ask, Who touched me.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa kul mɔhiri vuri yɛra, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But they shouted back, Crucify him! Crucify him.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti zaŋ li mir o na ni o di ka o dii gɔh o nuu ni ka yɛl o, N tizɔpaɣa, chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: She started to feed Amnon, but he grabbed her hand. He said to her, Sister, come and sleep with me.

dag: ka chɛliya ka barinim bɛn be nimaani kpaŋ, ka yɛliya ba ni Naawuni nam miri ba.
en: Heal the sick people who live there, and tell them, Gods kingdom is now very near you .

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, a mi ni anabinim kul be kpe n-yɛri ba, Tɔbu ku lan ŋmɛn ya, ka kum mi ku lan lu yi zuɣu, amaa n kul yɛn tin ya la suhudoo ni yɛlimaŋli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: Then I said, Sovereign Lord , you know that the prophets are telling the people that there will be no war or starvation, because you have promised, they say, that there will be only peace in our land.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu, ka yi yi di baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni, yi naan ku zaŋ bɛn ka galimi taali.
en: The scripture says, It is kindness that I want, not animal sacrifices. If you really knew what this means, you would not condemn people who are not guilty;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbiri. Laakumnim daa nyɛla tuhi pihinu, ka piɛri nyɛ tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinu, ka bunsi mi daa nyɛ tusaayi, ka daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma tuhi kɔbiga.
en: These Israelite tribes captured , camels, , sheep, , donkeys, and , people.

dag: Ka Maika yɛl o, Kpalimmi n sani leei m ba ni m maligumaana. N ni tir a anzinfa kpila pia yuuni kam, ka tir a situra mini bindirigu pahi.
en: Micah said, Why don't you stay here with me? You can be my priest and tell me what God wants me to do. Every year I'll give you ten pieces of silver and one complete set of clothes, and I'll provide all your food. The young man went for a walk.

dag: Di saha maa, naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu sokam zaa daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: There was no king in Israel at that time. Everyone did whatever they pleased.

dag: Bɛ yi yɛl a, Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, chɛ ka ti dɔni gu n-ku so, ka chɛ ka ti liri bɛn ka taali.
en: when they say: Come with us. Lets set up a deadly ambush. Lets secretly wait for the innocent just for fun.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Ti yaannim Naawuni m-piig a ni a baŋ o yubu ka nya ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana n-wum o nol ni yɛligu;.
en: Ananias told me, The God of our fathers chose you long ago to know his plan. He chose you to see the Righteous One and to hear words from him.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a sujee saha, bee n saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: O Lord , don't punish me in your anger!.

dag: Zoya zuɣu tinsi mi n-daa nyɛ: Shamir mini Jatir ni Soko.
en: The people of Judah were also given these towns in the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa, ka n zaŋ o niŋ m-paɣa? Dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a paɣa! Zaŋm o chaŋ.
en: Why did you make me believe she was your sister? Now I've married her. Take her and go! She's your wife.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa, ka zaŋ dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: The priest must look at it and put it in a separate place for seven days.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti tiligira. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.

dag: Yɛlim Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda gomna la ni di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: Speak to Judahs governor Zerubbabel: I am about to make the heavens and the earth quake.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o na kpee maa yi ti na be katiŋ kanna o ni tim ti balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku zabili maa.
en: If he isn't, he will send messengers to meet the other king to ask for terms of peace while he is still a long way off.

dag: Wuntaŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka goli viɛlim be di ko, ka saŋmar so viɛlim be di ko ka chɛ saŋmar so mi viɛlim.
en: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti tiligi saɣi bɛ daalahichi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa tum ma bɛ yɔhiŋ puuni la mini bɛ ni zaɣisi ma dolibu.
en: But if they confess their and their ancestors guilt for the wrongdoing they did to me, and for their continued opposition to me.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan maa mini anzinfa ni binyɛrigu maa ni salin kpilli maa ni o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi ni o niɣi ni o bunsi ni o piɛri ni o suɣili ni o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa n-chaŋ Akɔr Vinvamli ni.
en: Joshua, along with all the people of Israel, seized Achan, the silver, the cloak, the bar of gold, together with Achan's sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else he owned; and they took them to Trouble Valley.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi lee tɛhi? Do so n-daa mali bidibis ayi nti chaŋ o bikpɛm sani ti yɛl o, M bia, cham m puu ni ti tum tuma zuŋɔ.
en: What do you think? A man had two sons. Now he came to the first and said, Son, go and work in the vineyard today.

dag: O yɛm puuni ka o nam zuɣusaa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the one who used wisdom to make the skies! His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Nyini n-daa ŋme m-bɔri Lɛviatan zuɣuri ka zaŋ bɛ nimdi ti tiŋgban nɛli ni niriba.
en: You crushed Leviathans heads. You gave it to the desert dwellers for food!.

dag: Fam ma gbuɣinli nol ni bahi! Fam ma yɔnaɣilahi yila ni bahi.
en: Save me from the mouth of the lion. From the horns of the wild oxen you have answered me!.

dag: A daa nya ti yaannim ni diri wahala shɛm Ijipti; ka daa wum bɛ fabila Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mbusim be piɛgul shɛb bɛn ku m piɛri, ka wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Watch out, you shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture, declares the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa ni daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee kum.
en: When the angel had said this, all the people of Israel began to cry.

dag: N daa kabisi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina ka chɛ ka bɛ ni daa ŋubiri shɛb la yi n-luna.
en: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka Bɔaz yɛli Rut, Kamina ti deei bɔrɔbɔro suɣi kpam. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini kachɛriba maa sani, ka Bɔaz zaŋ chi bɔrɔbɔro ti o. Ka o daa ŋub li tiɣi ka guui shɛli.
en: At mealtime Boaz said to her, Come over here, eat some of the bread, and dip your piece in the vinegar. She sat alongside the harvesters, and he served roasted grain to her. She ate, was satisfied, and had leftovers.

dag: Ka bɛ banim bee bɛ tizɔdɔbba yi ti kana ti yɛl ti di yɛla, ti ni yɛli ba, Pahimiya suɣilo ka chɛ ba ti ba, dama ti bi tuhila tɔbu gbahi ba n-ti bɛ zaa yinoyino ni bɛ niŋ bɛ paɣiba maa, ka di mi pala yinima n-zaŋ ba ti ba, ka ni mali taali di zuɣu. .
en: If their fathers or brothers come to you and protest, you can tell them, Please let us keep them, because we did not take them from you in battle to be our wives. And since you did not give them to us, you are not guilty of breaking your promise.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛnkam be yoma ni katiŋ zaa wum n ni niŋ shɛm ka baŋ ni m mali yiko.
en: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa kul o yiŋa Samaria ni sujee ti fo n-ʒiya.
en: Then the king went back home to Samaria. He was worried and upset.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka ŋun ti yab Ibrahimma ba daa ti kpi, ka Naawuni lan zaŋ o nimaani tahi yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ na.
en: So Abraham left the country of Chaldea. He went to live in Haran. After his father died, God sent him to this place, where you live now.

dag: Yi ŋmanila lala n sani pumpɔŋɔ, Yi nya n nahiŋgu maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ya.
en: You are like those streams to me, you see my fate and draw back in fear.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu bi dalimla yɛda niŋbu, dama di sabiya: Ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun tum tuun suma, dama a daa wurim Ashɛra ŋmahima zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a suhu zaa niŋla Naawuni jɛmbu ni.
en: But even so, there is some good in you. You have removed all the symbols of the goddess Asherah which people worshiped, and you have tried to follow God's will.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ti Mɔrɛshɛtigatinim chɛbisibu pina, ka Akizibnim ni ti nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi Izraɛl nanima.
en: And now, people of Judah, say good-bye to the town of Moresheth Gath. The kings of Israel will get no help from the town of Achzib.

dag: Amaa Amnɔn daa mal o zo so ka o yuli booni Jɔnadab, o daa nyɛla Dauda mabia Shamma dapala, ka daa mali yɛm pam.
en: Amnon had a friend named Jonadab son of Shimeah. Jonadab was a very clever man.

dag: Ka binyɛra maa zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu binshɛli zuɣu di ni leei zaɣ daɣiri, di yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro duu bee daaŋa yin wurimmiya li, di leei daɣiri, ka kul ni nyɛla daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.

dag: Amaa o fari nandaamba bɛ noya ni bahira, ka fara ba kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira.
en: But God saves the poor from death; he saves the needy from oppression.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim daa yɛli Midian kpamba, Salo ni gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni naai binshɛlikam din gili ti zaa kaman naɣilaa ni ŋubiri mɔri mɔɣu ni shɛm la. Zipɔr bia Balak n-daa nyɛ Mɔab naa di saha maa.
en: They said to the Midianite leaders, That huge mob of Israelites will wipe out everything in sight, like a bull eating grass in a field. So King Balak.

dag: Daadam, malimi soya ayi ka di zaa yi tiŋgbɔn yin ni na, ka Babilɔn naa dol li kana. Sabimi pa dapaɣa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sa sochira zuɣu wuhi so shɛli din kpɛri tiŋ puuni.
en: You, human one, mark two roads for the coming of the sword of the king of Babylon. They should diverge from a single country. Where the road to the city begins, set up a sign.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, A deemba Jɛtro min a paɣa ni a bidibis ayi la kanna.
en: He sent word to Moses: I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you along with your wife and her two sons.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ man Naa Sulemaana ni, ka chɛ ka Dauda nam nya zaashee zani ŋun Yawɛ sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But he will bless me, and he will make David's kingdom secure forever.

dag: Amaa o yi ka yiko din ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, dindina o ni kɔhi shɛli maa kul ni kpalim be ŋun da li maa nuu ni hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni. Di yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka bɛ deei li n-labisi ti o.
en: If they cannot afford to make a refund to the buyer, whatever was sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Jubilee year. It will be released in the Jubilee year, at which point it will return to the family property.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla, ka malila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini kɔŋko bɛ ŋariŋ ni.
en: Jesus disciples had forgotten to bring any bread, so they had only one loaf with them in the boat.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi niŋ hal ko mahim biɛla ti n nyaandoliba ni yino, hal ŋun pɔri bɛ ni gba, o ni nyɛ n nyaandol zuɣu, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ti ku kɔŋ di laara.
en: Whoever helps any of these little ones because they are my followers will definitely get a reward, even if they only give them a cup of cold water.

dag: Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daa bela tiŋgbani maa ni; bɛ daa galisiya pam n-ʒini Bashan zaŋ hal ni Baalihɛrimɔn ni Sɛnir zaŋ kpa Hɛrimɔn Zoli polo.
en: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

dag: N daa yɛli bɛ bihi tiŋgban nɛli maa ni, Miriya ka yi doli yi banim zaligunim la bee n-gbibi bɛ kaya la bee n-zaŋ bɛ buɣa la jɛmbu saɣim yimaŋa.
en: In the desert, I said to their children, Dont follow your parents regulations or observe their case laws or become defiled by their idols.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dari tɔhi binyara din ni saɣ o bihi, ka dim kabi binyara nyiŋgoya n-zaŋ ti ti gbuɣinnyaŋ. O zaŋ o ni gbahi binneen shɛba ti pal o ni be vokab shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ o ni dari tɔhi nim shɛli ti pal o ni do luɣ shɛŋa.
en: The lion killed his prey and tore it to pieces for his mate and her cubs; he filled his den with torn flesh.

dag: Amaa di sabiya ni ninsalinim nambu piligu ni, Naawuni daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: But when God made the world, he made people male and female.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ni zaŋ suhudo shɛli tin ya la su yi suhuri, dama suhudoo maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya n-laɣim ya niŋgbun yin la ni. Ka paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: The peace that Christ gives is to guide you in the decisions you make; for it is to this peace that God has called you together in the one body. And be thankful.

dag: Ka n ti darig o min o bihi ni o kpambaliba tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. N ni ti chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli ba alɔbo shɛŋa zaa yɛla la lu bɛ mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni Judanim zuɣu, dama bɛ kul zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum.
en: I will punish him and his family and his attendants for their wrongdoing. I will bring upon them, as well as the residents of Jerusalem and the people of Judah, every disaster I pronounced against them. But they wouldnt listen.

dag: Yi ni so yi zaŋ o mabia tahi ʒiishee, yi dihila yimaŋ vi maa. Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ku dihi yɛla sɔŋ yi suhuri ni? Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ni so yi din ya zalinsi ka yi ku chɛ di yɛla bahi?.
en: The fact that you have lawsuits against each other means that youve already lost your case. Why not be wronged instead? Why not be cheated?.

dag: Shɛla ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛba.
en: When Shelah was , he had a son named Eber.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti zaɣisi nyin Yawɛ ka jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashitarɔt. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ fam ti ti dimnim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi, ka ti jɛmd a.
en: But your ancestors cried to the Lord for help. They said, We have sinned. We left the Lord , and we served the false gods Baal and Ashtoreth. But now save us from our enemies, and we will serve you.

dag: Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira.
en: Build houses and live in them. Settle in the land. Plant gardens and eat the food you grow.

dag: ka o yina nti yɔhim zuliya kam bɛn be dunia luɣ anahi ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛb Gɔg mini Magɔg. O ni ti laɣim ba lo tɔbu; ka bɛ kalinli ni ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu.
en: He will go out to trick the nations in all the earth, the nations known as Gog and Magog. Satan will gather the people for battle. There will be more people than anyone can count, like sand on the seashore.

dag: Bɛ yi kɔhi a ʒilɛl ni Yɛhudia doo bee paɣa a zuɣu, ka o tum tuma ti a yuma ayɔbu, yuun shɛli din pahira ayopɔin ni, nyin bahimi dilana ka o chaŋ.
en: If any Israelites, male or female, sell themselves to you as slaves, you are to release them after they have served you for six years. When the seventh year comes, you must let them go free.

dag: Nabɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la daa mal o wain tihi puu Jɛziriil, ka di miri Samaria Naa Ɛhab yiŋa.
en: Now it happened sometime later that Naboth from Jezreel had a vineyard in Jezreel that was next to the palace of King Ahab of Samaria.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya Masidɔnia do so ʒii yuŋ ka o ʒiɛya m-balindi ŋun Pool yɛra, Kam Masidɔnia na ti sɔŋ ti.
en: During the night, Paul had a vision of someone from Macedonia who was standing there and begging him, Come over to Macedonia and help us.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka Babilɔn naa bɔɣiri niŋ kpiɔŋ, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka Firawuna bɔɣiri niŋ bɔɣ zalima, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. N ni ti zaŋ n takɔbi niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o ti zaŋ li lu Ijiptinim zuɣu.
