en: So I will make the arms of the king of Babylon strong, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall. Then they will know that I am the Lord . I will put my sword in the hand of the king of Babylon. Then he will stretch the sword out against the land of Egypt.

dag: Ti yi kul mal ania, ti min o ni ti laɣim di nam. Ti yi zaɣis o, o gba ni ti zaɣisi ti.
en: If we continue to endure, we shall also rule with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya Naawuni daalibarika tuma, di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o kpam bɛ zaa jaande ni bɛ kul ʒe yim Naawuni sani, ka di birigi.
en: When he arrived and saw how God had blessed the people, he was glad and urged them all to be faithful and true to the Lord with all their hearts.

dag: Yi yaannim ʒiɛman ni ka yi daa birigi ka chɛ n zaligunima, ka bi lan dol li. Labimiya n sanna ka n gba labi yi sanna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ labina.
en: You, like your ancestors before you, have turned away from my laws and have not kept them. Turn back to me, and I will turn to you. But you ask, What must we do to turn back to you.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn, ka di ti kpalim be nimaani hal ti paai dabisi shɛli n ni lan yɛn zaŋ n zaŋsim labisi di polo. Di saha ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ li nimaani na ti zali kpe yaha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will be taken to Babylonia and will remain there until I turn my attention to them. Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋ kara zani dabari; ka saɣim bɛ ni me bin shɛŋa taɣi bɛmaŋa. Tinzunnim ni me nayiya shɛŋa luya, ka so ku lan lab me li zali yaha.
en: And you destroyed the city that was protected by strong walls. Now it is only a pile of rocks. The foreign palace has been destroyed. It will never be rebuilt.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli neesim maa n-daa yi palo dunia ni di saha maa ni o neei sokam zaa nina.
en: The true light that shines on all people was coming into the world.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa boli Obadia ŋun daa su nayili tuma fukumsi la na. Obadia daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛmdi Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: so Ahab called in Obadiah, who was in charge of the palace. Obadiah was a devout worshiper of the Lord .

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛ ka yi suhuri doya, dama yi ni so ku kɔŋ o nyɛvili, amaa naɣila ŋariŋ ŋɔ kɔŋko n-naɣ ni saɣim.
en: But now I tell you to be happy. None of you will die, but the ship will be lost.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus answered, I will ask you a question too. If you answer me, then I will tell you what authority I have to do these things.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni o kpalim n-niŋ daba ayi bɛ sani, ka o daa bi saɣi.
en: They asked him to stay longer, but he refused.

dag: Dama zuŋɔ o chaŋmi ti kɔri naɣilalantaba mini naɣibihipol kpaba ni piɛri pam mali sara, ka boli nabihi zaa mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Jɔab ni maligumaana Abiata. Nyama, bɛ be o sani n-diri ka nyuri ka yɛra, Naawuni dolimi Naa Adɔnija nyɛvili.
en: Indeed, today he went down and prepared oxen, fattened cattle, and lamb in large numbers. He invited all the royal princes, the generals, and Abiathar the priest. They are eating and drinking with him, and they said, Long live King Adonijah.

dag: Amaa nyin pun kpahim baŋ n wuhibu mini m biɛhigu ni n ni lo shɛm m bebu ni ni n yɛda niŋbu yɛla zaŋ tabili n daania niŋbu ni n yurilim ni n ʒiɛyimtali.
en: But you have paid attention to my teaching, conduct, purpose, faithfulness, patience, love, and endurance.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛri din nyɛ: saŋkpana.
en: This concludes the Instruction concerning every infection of skin disease: for scabies.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, m ba Sool nuu ku shih a. Nyini nti yɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka m mi nyɛ wulana. M ba Sool gba mi lala.
en: Jonathan told David, Dont be afraid. My father Saul wont hurt you. You will become the king of Israel, and I will be second to you. Even my father knows this.

dag: A nuhi ka a zaŋ me ma, ka lan ŋmaligi kuri ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Will you now destroy someone you created?.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔb maa tuhibu dali, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Naa Sool mini Jɔnatan sani maa zaa so daa ka takɔbi bee kpani; amaa Naa Sool min o bia Jɔnatan n-daa naɣi mali.
en: So on the day of battle, none of the Israelite soldiers with Saul had iron swords or spears. Only Saul and his son Jonathan had such weapons.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani, ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na; dama ŋun pɔri yi zaa ha ni, dilana n-nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Whoever welcomes this child in my name welcomes me. Whoever welcomes me, welcomes the one who sent me. Whoever is least among you all is the greatest.

dag: Ka suhudoo daa be Naa Jɛhɔshafat ʒiɛmani maa ni, dama o Naawuni daa ti o vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: That is why there was peace for Jehoshaphats kingdom—his God brought him rest from the enemies that were all around him.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa daa kuhi pam yɛl li Judanim yɛligu ni bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim bɛn daa tam goondaa zuɣu la ha ni bɛ varisi ba kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, ka ŋme n-deei bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: The officials shouted this in Hebrew in order to frighten and discourage the people of Jerusalem who were on the city wall, so that it would be easier to capture the city.

dag: Jɔn daa bi sɔɣ ba shɛli, o mi daa bi chihi. O daa yɛli ba, M pala Masia.
en: John confessed , Im not the Christ.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi n ni be fitiina shɛli ni, di biɛri m puuni, ka n suhu dam, n ni daa nyɛ ŋun zaɣis a noli zuɣu. Bɛ daa malila takɔbiri be soya zuɣu kuri niriba, ka kpibu be yiŋa.
en: Pay attention, LORD, for I am in trouble. My stomach is churning; my heart is pounding inside me because I am so bitter. In the streets the sword kills; in the house it is like death.

dag: Ka Jabɛz daa ti suhi Izraɛlnim Naawuni yɛli, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka a daalibarika be n ni, ka chɛ ka n tiŋgbani galisi, ka a zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu n-tiligi ma zaɣibiɛɣ kam zaa ni, ka zaɣibiɛɣ ku niŋ ma. Ka Naawuni daa ti o o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Jabez called on Israels God: If only you would greatly bless me and increase my territory. May your power go with me to keep me from trouble, so as not to cause me pain. And God granted his request.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna yiŋa n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: So Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD.

dag: Ka o bi so yi ti leei maligumaana n-zan o ba zaani, o yi ti yɛn ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni na nti tum o tuma luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee, ŋun yɛm binyɛra maa daba ayopɔin.
en: The son who is priest in his place should wear them seven days when he comes into the meeting tent to minister in the sanctuary.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord also said to Moses.

dag: Bɛ zaa ni ti yaai bɛ noli yɛl a, A gba gbarigimi kaman ti ni gbarigi shɛm. Ti min a zaa niŋla yim.
en: They all call out to him, Now you are as weak as we are! You are one of us!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Viligim a baŋtabiga, ka piligi a nam zuɣupiligu. Binyara bi la yɛn be kaman di ni daa be shɛm. Duhimiya tarimba, ka siɣisi bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa.
en: this is what the LORD God says: Remove the turban, take off the crown! Nothing will be as it was. Bring down the exalted, and exalt the lowly.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ a yuli kana ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa la, di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, o kul niŋdila a niriba maa putɔɣu, ka a bi niŋ shɛli ni a fa a niriba maa bahi.
en: Ever since I first came to Pharaoh to speak in your name, he has abused this people. And youve done absolutely nothing to rescue your people.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni daa zaɣis o yɛligu zuɣu.
en: God sent darkness on the country, but the Egyptians did not obey his command.

dag: Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam ni o ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else that Manasseh did, including the sins he committed, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Dama niriba ŋɔ leela suhutunanima. Bɛ ŋari bɛ tiba ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum. Bɛ pɔb bɛ nina ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku nya. Di yi pa lala, bɛ nina ni nya, ka bɛ tiba wum, ka bɛ baŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna, ka n tib ba.
en: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you. .

dag: ka o daa dihi bɛn nahindi ba vi, ka chɛ ka bɛ dari gindi tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ kɔŋko ka buchi; shia n-nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ka n ni pun tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la mi nyɛla shia mini nyɛvili yɛla.
en: What gives life is God's Spirit; human power is of no use at all. The words I have spoken to you bring God's life-giving Spirit.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn darigiri gbabigiri kpibisi bɛ manim biha ni, ka deeri nandaamba biliɛri talima.
en: The orphan is stolen from the breast; the infant of the poor is taken as collateral.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbihi, ka maligumaaniba maa daa taɣi bɛ ʒim n-zaŋ li mihi sara maligu bimbini maa, ka Lɛvinim mi shiri biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: After the lambs and goats had been killed, the Levites skinned them, and the priests sprinkled the blood on the altar.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-zaŋ ziŋgɔhi ga a yɛno n-vo a min a tɔbbihi zaa ni a yuri ni a wɔribariba bɛn zaa ye gbaɣinɔnima, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam ka gbibi nyɔtaɣiri kara mini nyɔtaɣiri bihi ni takɔbiri ŋɔ zaa yina.
en: I will turn him around, put hooks in his jaws, and drag him and all his troops away. His army, with its horses and uniformed riders, is enormous, and every soldier carries a shield and is armed with a sword.

dag: Bɛ bi yɛli nyini n dana Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la ka n niŋ shɛm? N daa zaŋla anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka niŋdi bindirigu mini kom ti tiri ba.
en: I even hid of the Lord 's prophets in caves when Jezebel was trying to kill them. I also gave them food and water.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣ o mabia paɣa, o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, ka nya o mabia zaɣim, bɛ ku dɔɣi bia.
en: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa ni noonsi balibu kam ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛn chani gindi dunia ni balibu kam zaa daa dol taba yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: All the animals, everything that crawls, and every bird left the boat. All the animals came out of the boat in family groups.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi n-chaŋ ti da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbiga na ti pahi.
en: Amaziah also hired , soldiers from Israel. He paid / tons of silver to hire these soldiers.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Balimmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa, ka suh o ti ma ka o chɛ ka n nuu ŋɔ lan lab di bebu ni yaha. Ka Naawuni nir maa daa suhi Yawɛ, ka naa maa nuu maa nya alaafee n-lan be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: The king said to the man of God, Plead before the LORD your God and pray for me so that I can bend my hand back again. So the man of God pleaded before the LORD, and the kings hand returned to normal and was like it used to be.

dag: Ka mmaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ o ʒili tiŋgbani maa ni. Ka Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni ti nya nambɔzɔbo n sani, ka n ni ti yɛli Panniriba, Yi nyɛla n niriba; ka bɛ mi ni ti yɛli, Nyini n-nyɛ ti Naawuni. .
en: I will sow him for myself in the land; and I will have compassion on No Compassion, and I will say to Not My People, You are my people; and he will say, You are my God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zuɣulaan yino kam zaŋm o pina na ti malimi sara dahin yini kam, sara maligu bimbini maa zaŋ ti Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpuɣim a jaaŋgbɛ shɛli a ni daa zaŋ fiɛbi Nail la n-niŋ a nuu ni, ka zaŋ Izraɛl kpamba pah amaŋ zuɣu, ka yi gari niriba maa tooni chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Go before the Israelites. Take some of the elders of the people with you. Carry your walking stick with you. This is the stick that you used when you hit the Nile River.

dag: Ka o ni yuri ya shɛm o suhu ni kul pahirimi, di bahi bamdi o yi teei yi zaa nɔdeebo mini yi ni daa deeg o ni sizuura lubu la yɛla.
en: And so his love for you grows stronger, as he remembers how all of you were ready to obey his instructions, how you welcomed him with fear and trembling.

dag: Bɛ miri ka bɛ yɔhim bɛmaŋa n-niŋ din ka buchi naani, dama din ka buchi maa n-ni ti nyɛ bɛ sanyoo.
en: They shouldnt trust in what has no worth, for their reward will be worthless.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti bo ma ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nya ma.
en: You will search for me, and when you search for me with all your heart, you will find me.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino daa yɛl o, A yi di saɣi n-dol ti chaŋ. Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ.
en: One of them urged him to go with them; he agreed.

dag: ni Bɛtiharam vinvamli ni Bɛtinimira ni Sukɔt ni Zafɔn ni Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli daa nyɛ di tiŋgbani tariga zaŋ chaŋ ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku tariga ha sirigili zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la.
en: In the valley were Beth-haram, Beth-nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon. This was the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon. It included the Jordan and the territory next to it up to the tip of the Chinnereth Sea on the east side of the Jordan.

dag: Ka Salɛm Naa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun daa lan nyɛ Zallakudura Naa maligumaana la daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini wain na nti ti Ibram;.
en: And Melchizedek, who was king of Salem and also a priest of the Most High God, brought bread and wine to Abram.

dag: Bɛnkam suhuri ye buni zuɣu, ka zaŋ kiŋkansi bɔrili bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Di dirila bɛn su li nyɛviya.
en: These are the ways of all who seek unjust gain; it costs them their lives.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli suhiri Naawuni. O ni daa ti suhi naai ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti ti ni yɛn suhiri Naawuni shɛm kaman Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba shɛm la.
en: One time Jesus was out praying, and when he finished, one of his followers said to him, John taught his followers how to pray. Lord, teach us how to pray too.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti bi nya Yisa tuumba maa sarika maa ni ka labina ti yɛli.
en: When the men went to the jail, they could not find the apostles there. So they went back and told the Jewish leaders about this.

dag: O yuli yiko n-ti gbarigu ŋɔ alaafee maa; o yuli yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi nya ka wum din niŋ ŋɔ. Yɛda niŋbu zaŋ chaŋ Yisa sani zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu maa nya alaafee zaa yi zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: His name itself has made this man strong. That is, because of faith in Jesus name, God has strengthened this man whom you see and know. The faith that comes through Jesus gave him complete health right before your eyes.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya biɛr biɛɣu zaa mini yɛmbimbiɛri ni bilikɔnsi ni nyuli zabbu zaa ni munaafichi niŋbu zaa yi biɛhigu ni.
en: Therefore, get rid of all ill will and all deceit, pretense, envy, and slander.

dag: Aai! N ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa chɛfirinim ni zaŋdi maani maligu, bɛ zaŋdi li maanila alizin biɛri, pa ni Naawuni. Ka m mi bi bɔri ni yi mini alizin biɛri yɛla kpɛri tab ni.
en: But I am saying that when food is sacrificed to idols, it is an offering to demons, not to God. And I dont want you to share anything with demons.

dag: Naa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka nyɛ ŋun yuri zaligu soli, a nyɛla ŋun zali yɛlimaŋli soli. A nyɛla ŋun doli zaligu mini wuntia soli din be Yaakubu zuliya ni kari saria.
en: Strong king who loves justice, you are the one who established what is fair. You worked justice and righteousness in Jacob.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, So di dam o kɔba; kul chɛliya li ka di doya baalim. Ka bɛ daa chɛ o mini anab so ŋun daa yi Samaria la na kɔba.
en: Josiah replied, Then leave it alone. Don't dig up his bones. So they did not disturb his bones or the bones of the old prophet from Israel who had also been buried there.

dag: N ni gɔŋ Juda kaman tɔb la, ka zaŋ Ifriim mi leei di piɛma. N ni zaŋ Ziɔn leei takɔbi n-tuhi Giriisinima.
en: Indeed, I myself will bend Judah as a bow; I will fill it with Ephraim. Zion, I will rouse your sons against your sons. Greece, I will make you like a warriors sword.

dag: Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa bi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la, dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the people of Benjamin didnt drive out the Jebusites who lived in Jerusalem. So the Jebusites still live with the people of Benjamin in Jerusalem today.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu zalim zaligu maa, ka dih a nuu di gbɔŋ zuɣu; ka chɛ ka di tum tuma. Di mi nyɛla Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu, di bi taɣira.
en: Now, Your Majesty, issue the law and sign the document so that it cannot be changed, as per the law of Media and Persia, which cannot be annulled.

dag: Ŋuna m-pii ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ti, din nyɛ Yaakubu so o ni yuri la ni nyuri bara shɛli zuɣu la.
en: He chose for us the land where we live, the proud possession of his people, whom he loves.

dag: ka yɛli, N tum alahichi, dama n yi ŋun ka taali nyaaŋa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka dimbɔŋɔ nya ti ya? A yɛla m-bala.
en: Judas said, I sinned. I handed over to you an innocent man to be killed. The Jewish leaders answered, We dont care! Thats a problem for you, not us.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o yeeg o binyɛra maa ka taɣi binyɛr shɛŋa ye n-zaŋ tampiligim maa yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa nti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: Then he must take off the special clothes and put on the other clothes and carry the ashes outside the camp to a special place that is pure.

dag: Dama ti yab Ibrahimma yi daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani la o tuma zuɣu, o daa naan mal li kuuna, amaa ka pa ni Naawuni sani.
en: If Abraham was made right by the things he did, he had a reason to boast about himself. But God knew different.

dag: amaa ka daa ti wum ni Arikilɔs n-di nam zan o ba Hɛrɔd zaani Judia, ka dabiɛm daa mal o ni o kul ni; ka Naawuni daa lan wuh o zahindi ni ni o ŋmaligim chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But when he heard that Archelaus ruled over Judea in place of his father Herod, Joseph was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he went to the area of Galilee.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ti ti, Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni kana ti liri ti la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni tum alahiziba tuma ti ti kaman o ni pun niŋdi shɛm la, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka o zo ka chɛ ti.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.

dag: Yinim yi mali kpiɔŋ ka tinim gbarigi, ti mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka ti ni suhiri Naawuni shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni yi nya kpaŋsibu.
en: We are happy when we are weak but you are strong. We pray for this: that you will be made complete.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini pagɔrili ŋɔ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Now then, Jerusalem, you whore! Hear what the Lord is saying.

dag: Buɣim ni di li wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa sahakam. Ka di tiŋgbani ni leei tiŋgban nɛli doya ʒiɛmani kam ni; ka so ku lan ka di ni na.
en: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi nya bula shɛb zaa bɛn duri buhi ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri, dama n nya Leeban ni niŋd a shɛm.
en: and he said, Notice that all the rams are either spotted or speckled. I know everything Laban is doing to you.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ mi ni daa nyu tibidarigibo binnyur shɛli zoli din be kasi zuɣu shɛm la, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya la zaa gba ni nyu li. Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti chani jeena, ka leei bɛn be kaman bɛn kani.
en: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tahima na be a biɛhigu ni. A bihi maa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Theres hope for your future, declares the LORD. Your children will return home!.

dag: Ka o sɔŋda maa daa zaŋ li ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri ŋub li ka guui kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So the servant set the food before them, and as the Lord had said, they all ate, and there was still some left over.

dag: Zaŋmiya zaligu kundi ŋɔ ti sɔŋ baɣili Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la, ka di be nimaani nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Take this book of God's Law and place it beside the Covenant Box of the Lord your God, so that it will remain there as a witness against his people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ buɣim dabi tiŋ maa, ka di di tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, naɣila anzinfa mini salima ni daanya kuriti la kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma biɛhigu shee.
en: They burned the city and everything in it. But they put the silver and gold, along with the bronze and iron equipment, into the treasury of the LORDs house.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni daa nya ka n ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka n daa tim Timoti yi sanna ni di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛda niŋbu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Dama n suhu daa kul zɔhirimi ni di pa shɛli ka Sintani ti zahim ya ka ti tuma la zaa kpalim yoli.
en: This is why I sent Timothy to you, so that I could know about your faith. I sent him when I could not wait anymore. I was afraid that the devil who tempts people might have defeated you with temptations. Then our hard work would have been wasted.

dag: Ka niriba ayi maa gba daa yɛli ba binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ sol ni mini bɛ ni daa lan baŋ o shɛm o bɔrɔbɔro ŋmahibu ni la yɛla.
en: Then the two men told what had happened on the road. They talked about how they recognized Jesus when he shared the bread with them.

dag: Yi pun wum n ni daa mali biɛhigu shɛli saha shɛli n ni daa doli Yɛhudianim adiini sol la yɛla. N daa niŋ Naawuni cheechi alaka pam, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni n saɣim li.
en: You heard about my previous life in Judaism, how severely I harassed Gods church and tried to destroy it.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila gomna Rɛhum mini Shimshai ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaɣili polo gbaŋŋmar la ni bɛ taba bɛn kpalim ni sariakaritiba ni tuma zuɣulaannim ni kpamba ni Pɛriʒianim ni Ɛrɛknim ni Babilɔnnim ni Susa din be Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nima.
en: From Rehum the commanding officer and Shimshai the secretary, and from the judges and important officials over the men from Tripolis, Persia, Erech, and Babylon, and from the Elamites from Susa.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun daa kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, Sool kpiya, ka daa tɛhi ni o ʒila lahiba suŋ na ti ti ma la, n daa gbaag o mi n-ku o Zikilag, ka di leeg o yɔri o ni ti ma lahiba shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: The messenger who came to me at Ziklag and told me of Saul's death thought he was bringing good news. I seized him and had him put to death. That was the reward I gave him for his good news!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Yisa ni kahig omaŋa wuhi o nyaandoliba m-pahi siɣim buta o kum ni neebu la nyaaŋa.
en: This was the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from death.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo, ka di kpihim tuun sun shɛŋa n ni tum ti n Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di tuma ŋɔ.
en: My God, please remember me for these things I have done. Dont forget all I have faithfully done for the Temple of my God and for its services.

dag: Anabinima n-su bɛmaŋmaŋ shihi fukumsi.
en: The spirits of prophets are under the control of the prophets themselves.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ŋunkam niŋ a naani mal alibarika!.
en: LORD of heavenly forces, those who trust in you are truly happy!.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi niŋ fawɔɣili zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa ku tum naa barina.
en: Be sure to carry out this order! Why should danger grow and threaten the king?.

dag: M mabihi, fiig tia ni tooi wali olivi tia wala bee gaa ni tooi wali fiig tia wala? Lala ka ko nyaɣisili ku tooi yi ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ ni na.
en: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water?.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi la ni.
en: Manasseh built altars for the stars of heaven in the two courtyards of the Lord s Temple.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli Bɛtipɛɔr tooni vinvamli din daa be Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ŋuna ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim daa tuhi nyaŋ saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti na la.
en: This took place across the Jordan River, in the valley opposite Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon the Amorite king who ruled in Heshbon, whom Moses and the Israelites defeated when they came out of Egypt.

dag: N daa yooi dunoli maa ti n yura maa, amaa ka o bi kpɛna ka ŋmaligi chaŋ. N ni daa kul wum o kukoli, ka n suhu kpe o ni. Ka n daa yina lihi bo o, amaa ka bi nya o. Ka n daa bol o, amaa ka o bi garigi.
en: I opened for my lover, but my lover had turned away and was gone! I nearly died when he came and went. I looked for him, but I couldnt find him. I called for him, but he didnt answer me.

dag: Dama n suhu bi doya, ka n lan ka alaafee. M bi nyari nyee vuhira, amaa ka muɣisigu n-kul paari ma.
en: I had no ease, quiet, or rest, and trembling came.

dag: Mbusim be yinim gba zuɣu sokam yi ti paɣiri ya saha shɛli, dama lala ka bɛ yaannim daa pun niŋ anab ʒirinim la.
en: You are in for trouble when everyone says good things about you. That is what your own people said about those prophets who told lies.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ; chɛliya ka niriba wum o paɣibu maa yɛla.
en: All you nations, bless our God! Let the sound of his praise be heard!.

dag: saha shɛli Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa tuhiri Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntin shɛŋa zaa din daa kpalim ka nyɛ Lakishi mini Azɛka la, dama di kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa ka di na kpalim ʒiɛya.
en: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured.

dag: bee do so ŋun napɔŋ bee o nuu mali daŋa.
en: men with broken feet or hands.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee n-garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The people shouted in answer, We will do whatever you say.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ ni: Jɛhɔhanan mini Hanania ni Zabai ni Atilai.
en: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened to you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu maa. Ka ŋunkam ka n sanna, kum ku lan gbaag o; ka ŋunkam mi niŋ ma yɛda, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada.
en: I am the bread of life, Jesus told them. Those who come to me will never be hungry; those who believe in me will never be thirsty.

dag: ka di daa niŋ niriba maa suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zaŋ li ti Yawɛ ni suhu yini ka di nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu. Ka di daa niŋ Naa Dauda gba nyaɣisim pam.
en: The people had given willingly to the Lord , and they were happy that so much had been given. King David also was extremely happy.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalibarika min o yiko daa pali Stiivin ka o tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira pam niriba maa ni.
en: Stephen received a great blessing. God gave him power to do great wonders and miraculous signs among the people.

dag: M bɔrila suhudoo, amaa n yi yɛli shɛli, bɛ zaŋdi li mi leei zabili.
en: I ask for peace, but they want war.

dag: ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: and gave them orders not to tell others about him.

dag: Taainim kurimbuni ha suhupiɛlli tiŋ la m-bala? Tiŋ maa ni ka niriba daa yi n-du teeku duli ti ʒini la?.
en: Can this be the joyful city of Tyre, founded so long ago? Is this the city that sent settlers across the sea to establish colonies?.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi yɛli, Alaafee. N dana n-tim ma na ni nti yɛl a ni nachimbih ayi bɛn nyɛ anabinima n-yi Ifriim zoya tiŋ ni kana; ni o suhir a ni a ti ba anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra na.
en: Gehazi answered, Yes, but my master sent me to say, Two young men who are members of a group of prophets have just now come to me from the hills of Ephraim. Give them a kikkar of silver and two changes of clothing.

dag: N dabisa gariya, n ni daa lo nia shɛŋa ka di nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛŋa la saɣimya.
en: My days have passed; my plans have failed; my hope is gone.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Laodisia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ Ami, ka be tibi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana ni ŋun daa tab Naawuni binshɛɣukam nambu ni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of Gods creation.

dag: Abimilɛk min o tɔbbihi pirigili yim bɛn daa be o sani daa kab chaŋ ti zanila tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka bɛ pirigili ʒii buyi mi kab ti lu bɛn be mɔɣu ni maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: Abimelech and the troops with him ran to the town gate and took control of it, while two other groups attacked and killed the people who were in the fields.

dag: Pallu zuliya n-daa nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: Pallus son was Eliab.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa niŋ yomyom kpe o tanti suɣili ni Zara sani nti yɛl o, Toom a zim viɛlli la lita pisinaayi ŋ-ŋɔri li mali maha yomyom.
en: So Abraham hurried to Sarah at his tent and said, Hurry! Knead three seahs of the finest flour and make some baked goods.

dag: Jɔn daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: Johns clothes were made from camels hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. For food, he ate locusts and wild honey.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ tin ya n-yɛli ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma laɣim be.
en: In the letter that I wrote you I told you not to associate with immoral people.

dag: Deemiya tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ʒin di ni, dama mani n-zaŋ li tin ya ni yi su li.
en: You will take possession of the land and live in it, because Ive given the land to you to possess.

dag: Teeku noli tinsi la ni ti leela Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la dini, ka bɛ ti guli bɛ biŋkɔbiri nimaani, ka gbɛri Ashikɛlɔn tiŋ puuni yuŋ. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni mi bɛ yɛla, ka labisi bɛ daazichi la ti ba yaha.
en: The people of Judah who survive will occupy your land. They will pasture their flocks there and sleep in the houses of Ashkelon. The Lord their God will be with them and make them prosper again.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nir niŋ siɣa dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Ŋunkam mali kookali ni tooi baŋ biŋkɔbigu maa namba maa, dama di nyɛla ninsal namba. O namba maa nyɛla kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: This calls for wisdom. Let the one who understands calculate the beasts number, for its a human beings number. Its number is six hundred sixty-six.

dag: N ni ti yɛn chɛ a yiŋ ŋɔ ni do so ka o be n sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nya biɛrim o suhu ni, ka kum hal ka o nina ti fulim, ka niriba ti zaŋ takɔbi ku a yiŋnim zaa.
en: Yet I will keep one of your descendants alive, and he will serve me as priest. But he will become blind and lose all hope, and all your other descendants will die a violent death.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi Troas kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Samɔtirɛsi n-yi biɛɣu n-naanyi paai Niapolis.
en: We left by ship from Troas and sailed straight across to Samothrace, and the next day to Neapolis.

dag: Ka n lu tiŋa ka wum kukol shɛli damli ka di booni ma yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice asking, Saul, Saul, why are you so cruel to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa pa bimbiha zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: on top of the choice ribs.

dag: Na so ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana yi su tarimba, o ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun ŋumda bee jɛŋgbini ŋun yiɣina ni o gbaai so.
en: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa wurim Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma sɔŋ, ka Gɛrishɔn mini Mɛrari zuliya bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma la daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi.
en: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zana ni, amaa ka chɛ ka man kɔŋko tiligi.
en: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.

dag: ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu ka bi lan jɛmd o bee m-bɔhir o binshɛli yɛla la birili.
en: those turning away from the LORD, those who dont seek the LORD and dont pursue him.

dag: O ni ti nyu bara o nasara dibu maa min o ni gbahi tɔbbihi pam ku ba zuɣu, amaa o kul ku nyɛ ŋun diri nasara sahakam.
en: When the army is carried off, he will become confident. He will kill tens of thousands, but he will not stand strong.

dag: Yi yi ti piligi kachɛɣu dahin shɛli, yin piligimiya kali dindali maa hal ni bakɔi ayopɔin.
en: Count seven weeks from the time that you begin to harvest the grain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Naa Dauda tiŋ la ni nanim silisi ni, dama o daa tum tuun suma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lan tum tuun suma ti Naawuni min o jɛmbu duu.
en: The people buried Jehoiada in the City of David where the kings are buried. The people buried Jehoiada there because in his life he did much good in Israel for God and for Gods Temple.

dag: Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.

dag: A deei ti suhigu ka tiligi ti alahizibu tuun kara puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, binnamda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa zaŋ tabili bɛn be teeku ni katiŋ ha mali tahima la a sani.
en: You answer us by giving us victory, and you do wonderful things to save us. People all over the world and across the distant seas trust in you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa boli dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi maa ni niriba, ka nyɛ o ni daa pun pii shɛb zuliya yini kam ni la na.
en: Joshua called for the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one man per tribe.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni maligumaaniba bɛn daa deeri zaka niriba san la daa nyɛla bɛn kpira, amaa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun gba daa deeri zaka la, ŋun daa nyɛla ŋun kul be nyɛvili ni kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: In addition, in one case a tenth is received by people who die, and in the other case, the tenth is received by someone who continues to live, according to the record.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Ɛgilɔn gari chaŋ Hiburɔn ti liri ba.
en: After this, Joshua and his army went from Eglon up into the hills to Hebron, attacked it.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ hal ti paai o lubu saha, kul paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni zaŋ kuɣituurili sɔŋ bɛ soli zuɣu, ka bɛ ti tuui li; bihi mini bɛ laamba zaa, ka ʒiʒiinikpee min o zo zaa ti kpi.
en: So this is what the Lord says: I will give the people of Judah problems. They will be like stones that make people fall. Fathers and sons will stumble over them. Friends and neighbors will die.

dag: Hal o nini ni bi nya wuntaŋa, ka o mi ʒi shɛli maa, o so ŋun pun beni maa.
en: It never sees the light of day or knows what life is like, but at least it has found rest—.

dag: A daa yɛli ma, Wumma, ka n yɛl a yɛtɔɣa; n ni bɔh a bɔhigu, ka a garigi ma.
en: You told me to listen while you spoke and to try to answer your questions.

dag: Yi ni ti yi n-chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli, ka ti lab kuli ni suhudoo. Zoya mini kunkuna ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka mɔɣu ni tihi mi ti kpahi di nuhi.
en: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.

dag: Di saha Ɛzɛkiɛl ni ti leei shihirili yi sani. Yi ni ti niŋ kaman o ni kul niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Di yi ti niŋ lala, yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Duuma.
en: I am a warning sign—everything I have done, you will also do. And then you will know the Lord God has made these things happen.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for the sins of the people.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lihi lzraɛlnim maa, ka baŋ ni bɛ be muɣisigu ni.
en: and because he knew what was happening to his people, he felt sorry for them.

dag: Tiliginsim ŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka anabinim daa vihi, ka bo ni bɛ baŋ li. Bɛ daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛlila anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya la yɛla.
en: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Firijia mini Galɛshia tiŋgbana ni garita, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa bi saɣi ni bɛ yihi waazu Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Paul and his friends went through Phrygia and Galatia, but the Holy Spirit would not let them preach in Asia.

dag: ka Arɔd daŋ niriba nyɛ Arɔdnima; ka Arɛli mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Arɛlinima.
en: Arodi—the Arodite family group; Areli—the Arelite family group.

dag: Shimɛi daa malila bidibisi pinayɔbu mini bipuɣins ayɔbu. Amaa o mabihi maa bɛn daa bi dɔɣi bihi pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ zuliya maa daa bi yɛligi kaman Judanim ni daa yɛligi shɛm la.
en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but Shimeis brothers did not have many children. Shimeis brothers did not have large families. Their families were not as large as the other tribes in Judah.

dag: amaa ka daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, dama sokam zaa zaɣa daa kul bela o wuhibu maa ni.
en: But they could not find a way to do it, because everyone else was eager to listen to him.

dag: Ka n ni di paai kɔbiliga maa gbinna zuŋɔ, ka n yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, a yi ni ti ma nasara n chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: Today I came to this well and said, Lord , God of my master Abraham, please make my trip successful.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-laɣim tɔbbihi pahi Izraɛlnim kpamba zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ Ai.
en: Early the next morning he got his troops ready to move out, and he and the other leaders of Israel led them to Ai.

dag: So yi tum o kpee taali, ka kana ni o ti po pɔri duu ŋɔ ni sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini.
en: Suppose someone accuses a person of a crime, and the accused has to stand in front of the altar in your temple and say, I swear I am innocent.

dag: Yisifu daa nyɛla yuun pihita nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpe Ijipti Firawuna tuma ni maa. Ka Yisifu daa yiri Naa Firawuna sani n-chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: Joseph was when the king made him governor, and he went everywhere for the king.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee gbi kɔsoli n-ti sa titali bee m-mali soli ti sakpani?.
en: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain.

dag: Bɛn zɔr o, bɛna ka o mi zɔri nambɔɣu ʒiɛmani zaŋ ti kpa ʒiɛmani.
en: He shows mercy to everyone, from one generation to the next, who honors him as God.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ baŋya ni binshɛɣukam a ni zaŋ ti ma la yila a sanna;.
en: They know that you gave me everything I have.

dag: N kul je ba la jɛri maŋli; n zaŋ ba leela n dimnima.
en: I hate them completely! Your enemies are also my enemies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD said to Moses.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ dabisa shɛm ka ti nini bi nya wuntaŋa bee saŋmarisi ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul bi chɛ ti ʒiɛbu la zuɣu daa chɛ ka ti yihi ti nyɛviya tahima.
en: For many days we could not see the sun or the stars. The storm was very bad. We lost all hope of staying alive—we thought we would die.

dag: Yawɛ, a suhuyubu puuni ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kahigi yɛl kara ŋɔ zaa wuhi ma.
en: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ni lih o, ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, di bi lan simdi ni maligumaana yuli ni o nya kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim maa, dilan nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: the priest shall examine you again. If the sore has spread, he need not look for yellowish hairs; you are obviously unclean.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Di karitiya tab saria, ka Naawuni ti ku kari yi gba saria; di zaŋdiya tab taali, ka Naawuni ti ku zaŋ yi gba taali; chɛliya yi tab taali paŋmi ba, ka Naawuni ti chɛ m-paŋ yi gba.
en: Dont judge others, and God will not judge you. Dont condemn others, and you will not be condemned. Forgive others, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Ka Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi tarimba shɛba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim tiŋ maa ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zo n-labi Babilɔn naa polo la ni nuhi tuumbaŋdiba bɛn daa kpalim la n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ahija ŋun nyɛ Shilo nir la yɛli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam shɛm la palibu zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Rɛhɔbɔam bi saɣi ti niriba maa.
en: So the king did not do what the people wanted. The Lord caused this to happen. He did this in order to keep the promise he made to Jeroboam son of Nebat when he sent the prophet Ahijah from Shiloh to speak to him.

dag: Waɣ biɛ titali maa ni daa nya ka bɛ yih o bahi dunia ŋɔ ni na maa, ka o gbaai kariti doli paɣ so ŋun daa dɔɣi bidibiga la.
en: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.

dag: Ka n jilima yi ti garita, n ni zaŋ a niŋ tampiŋ maa lɔŋni, ka zaŋ n nuu pɔb a hal ti gari naai.
en: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.

dag: man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Sɛnnachɛrib, Jɛrusalɛm lar a mi ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: this is the message that the LORD has spoken against him: The young woman, Daughter Zion, despises you and mocks you; Daughter Jerusalem shakes her head behind your back.

dag: din nyɛ sagbana ni kpaari shɛli bahira, ka di luri ninsalinim zuɣu na pampam.
en: So the clouds pour out the water, and the rain falls on many people.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhoyakim min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o nabihi zaa daa wum li, ka naa daa bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka Yuria daa wum o yɛtɔɣa maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o daa zo n-kuli Ijipti.
en: When King Jehoiakim and his soldiers and officials heard what Uriah had said, the king tried to have him killed. But Uriah heard about it; so he fled in terror and escaped to Egypt.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalikaulinim zaa niŋdi palila o ni. Dina n-chɛ ka ti yɛri Ami, ka paɣiri Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: Christ says Yes to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say Amen for us to the glory of God.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa ʒe o yim ŋɔ, yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn mir o ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Dindali maa yuntisuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti ku Ijipti bikpamba zaa. Firawuna ŋun daa ʒi o nam ni la bidib kpɛm daa kpiya, hal dansarika so ŋun daa be vol ni sarika ni bidibituuli gba daa kpiya zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi biŋkɔb dib shɛb zaa.
en: At midnight the Lord killed all the first-born sons in Egypt, from the king's son, who was heir to the throne, to the son of the prisoner in the dungeon; all the first-born of the animals were also killed.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n suhira.
en: Lord , I put my life in your hands.

dag: Niriba pam ni nyuri bara dunia ŋɔ binyara zuɣu shɛm, n gba ni nyu bara lala.
en: Others are boasting about their lives in the world. So I will boast too.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kabi chaŋ buɣili Baal duu nti daai li luhi ka wurim di maligu bimbina la mini di binnana la n-chɛrisichɛrisi di zaa, ka ku Matan ŋun daa nyɛ Baal tindan la maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o gbaɣino maa ti niŋ bɛ buɣili Ashitarɔt jɛmbu duu, ka zaŋ o chaŋ Bɛtishan nti lo o tabili gooni.
en: They put Sauls armor in the temple of Astarte, and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan.

dag: Wummiya! Baansi bɛn be kɔbilisi gbini yɛri Yawɛ nasara dibu yɛla nimaani, nasara din nyɛ Izraɛl kpariba nasara! Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ niriba daa chaŋ dari dibu chandi yi bɛ tinsi ni na.
en: To the sound of instruments at the watering places, there they repeat the LORDs victories, his villagers victories in Israel. Then the LORDs people marched down to the city gates.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir anahi puuni Ziv gol ni ka bɛ daa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa.
en: Work began on the temple during Ziv, the second month of the year, four years after Solomon became king of Israel.

dag: Ka Bɛtitɔgarimanim daa zaŋdi yuri mini tɔbutuhiri yuri ni buntaansi na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: and those from Beth-Togarmah traded work horses, war horses, and mules.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu. N ni kari ya saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka darigi yi tibili yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: And now its near! Against you I will pour out my wrath, and my anger will be satisfied. Ill judge you according to your ways, and turn all your detestable practices against you.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti lan yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la jɛmbu, ka taɣi deela wuna n-gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi li la zuɣu ka o chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa. .
en: Then they will answer, It was because the people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.

dag: Bɛ yooi mɔɣili dunɔdaya, ka nayili dam.
en: But the gates by the rivers are open, and the enemy comes flooding in and destroys the kings palace.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa kpahiri yi nuhi, ka mali yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yi suhuri paligi yi ni lo zaɣ biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo la zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: You were happy that Jerusalem was destroyed. You clapped your hands and stamped your feet. You had fun insulting the land of Israel.

dag: Nyamiya, Balaam ni daa wuhi yikombiɛlim so shɛl la ni, bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum din bie zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani Pɛɔr yɛla la ni, ka alɔbo daa lu Yawɛ niriba zuɣu la.
en: They are the ones who followed Balaam's advice and invited our people to worship the god Baal Peor. That's why the Lord punished us by killing so many of our people.

dag: Ka yi ti ku Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni la zaa, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu. Miriya ka yi ti jɛm bɛ wuna, dama di ni ti leei zana yi sani.
en: You must destroy all the people the Lord your God helps you defeat. Dont feel sorry for them, and dont worship their gods! They will trap you—they will ruin your life.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo;.
en: Jesus said to his followers, So I tell you, dont worry about the things you need to live—what you will eat or what you will wear.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ni be Hɛshibɔn mini Aroa ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili fɔntin shɛŋa din zaa ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili la zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ yuun kɔbisita m-bɔŋɔ, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa pun bi deei li di saha maa zaa?.
en: For three hundred years Israel has occupied Heshbon and Aroer, and the towns around them, and all the cities on the banks of the Arnon River. Why haven't you taken them back in all this time?.

dag: Ka n daa chɛ ka tabilakpihi lu bɛ zuɣu n-dim kari Amɔrinim nanima ayi la bahi; ka di daa pala yi takɔbiri bee yi tɔbiri zuɣu.
en: Your enemies ran from you, but not because you had swords and bows and arrows. I made your enemies panic and run away, as I had done with the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.

dag: Yawɛ sani, o daa nyɛla tɔha ŋun mali yaa pam; dinzuɣu ka niriba daa yi yɛra, Yawɛ chɛ ka a nyɛ tɔha so ŋun mali yaa kaman Nimrɔd.
en: By the Lord 's help he was a great hunter, and that is why people say, May the Lord make you as great a hunter as Nimrod.

dag: Daadam, malimi soya ayi ka di zaa yi tiŋgbɔn yin ni na, ka Babilɔn naa dol li kana. Sabimi pa dapaɣa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sa sochira zuɣu wuhi so shɛli din kpɛri tiŋ puuni.
en: Mortal man, he said, mark out two roads by which the king of Babylonia can come with his sword. Both of them are to start in the same country. Put up a signpost where the roads fork.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zo dabiɛm n-kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha o nahimbu biɛrim nyabu maa zuɣu ka yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye! Nyin tin titali ŋɔ, nyin Babilɔn ŋun nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ, awa yini puuni ka a zani lu n-dahim zaa.
en: The rulers will be afraid of her suffering and stand far away. They will say, Terrible! How terrible, O great city, O powerful city of Babylon! Your punishment came in one hour.

dag: ka zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be Alikauli Adaka maa luɣa ni la ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: He put the poles into the rings on the chests sides to use to carry the chest.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Ɛfɛsus ka nyɛ bɛn ʒe yim Yisa Masia san la.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by Gods will. To the holy and faithful people in Christ Jesus in Ephesus.

dag: paɣipiɛl so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la sani. Bɛ daa zaŋ Mariama tila Naa Dauda zuliya ni do so ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la.
en: He had a message for a young woman promised in marriage to a man named Joseph, who was a descendant of King David. Her name was Mary.

dag: Zaŋm a gbaɣino min a nyɔtaɣirigu yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ma.
en: Shield me and help me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, duumanim shɛba n-yi su ti, amaa a kɔŋko ka ti mi.
en: Lord our God, we have been ruled by others, but you alone are our Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri di yɛla chani maa ka Yisa chirigi ba sol ni, ka bɛ min o doli chana;.
en: As they talked and discussed, Jesus himself drew near and walked along with them;.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni zaŋ n suhuyubu pini mali sara ti a. Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a yuli, dama a nyɛla ŋun viɛla.
en: I will sacrifice to you freely; I will give thanks to your name, LORD, because its so good.

dag: O daa kul lu n-gbala o tooni ka yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka taali ŋɔ ʒi n kɔŋko zuɣu. N suhir a mi, gbilisim tibili wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: Then she said: Sir, please let me explain!.

dag: Di bi tu ka maligumaana Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun mali dalinli ti mirina ni o ti zaŋ Yawɛ pina maa nyo buɣim mali sara; o ni mali dalinli zuɣu, di bi simdi ni o mirina ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has an imperfection will be allowed to offer the LORDs food gifts; since he has an imperfection, he will not be allowed to offer his Gods food.

dag: N ni ti kul yɛn niŋ niriba maa shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ maligumaaniba maa gba. N ni ti darigi bɛ tibili yo bɛ tuumbiɛri maa samli.
en: The priest will be just like the people; I will punish them for their ways, and judge them for their deeds.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu ka n nyɛ n ni nyɛ so ŋɔ, ka o daalibarika zaŋ chaŋ m polo pala yoli, dama n tumiya gari bɛ zaa, amaa pa mani n-tum li, Naawuni daalibarika din be n ni maa n-tum li.
en: I am what I am by Gods grace, and Gods grace hasnt been for nothing. In fact, I have worked harder than all the others—that is, it wasnt me but the grace of God that is with me.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa baŋ ni Aduna kpiya, ka bɛ zaa daa zaŋ biɛɣ pihita n-kum o kuli.
en: All the Israelites learned that Aaron was dead. So everyone in Israel mourned for days.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa laɣim zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔn palli la ni, ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kana ti zani bɛ sani.
en: Jehoshaphat was in the new courtyard of the Lord s Temple. He stood up in the meeting of the people from Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: God has joined them together, so no one should separate them.

dag: Di simdi ni yi bo kulagaa niŋ yi nɛma ni, ka yi yi ti yi kpaŋa ni yi ti damdi yɔɣuni, ka yi zaŋ li gbi bɔɣili pi yi bindi maa.
en: Carry a stick as part of your equipment, so that when you have a bowel movement you can dig a hole and cover it up.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus ni daa ʒini naai di daba ata dali ka o daa yi Siizaria chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Festus became governor, and three days later he went from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka yi tum alahichi ni yɛlimaŋli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Yi daa ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi doli so shɛli maa, ka doola naɣibil kɔtomsi zali yimaŋa.
en: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.

dag: Nyam n dimnim ni galisi shɛm; ka nya bɛ ni je ma pam shɛm.
en: See how many enemies I have; see how much they hate me.

dag: nti kahigi yɛla maa zaa wuhi ba, ka naanyi tim ba Jɔpa maa.
en: He explained everything to them, then sent them to Joppa.

dag: Bɛ lɛbila yɛla pili ma. Yaɣimɛra mini yaɣiri pala yim. Bɛ ni mali binshɛli ku tooi yɛli ŋun mal li, Pa nyini m-mali ma; bee bɛ ni nam bin so ku tooi yɛli ŋun nam o, A bi nam ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, You didn't make me. You don't even know how.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim karimbanim ni yino, ka ʒi dimbɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus answered, You are a great teacher in Israel, and you don't know this?.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi, bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ. Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: This is the history of the families of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. They are Noahs sons. These men had children after the flood.

dag: ka kɔŋlan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: Then a man suffering from a dreaded skin disease came to him, knelt down before him, and said, Sir, if you want to, you can make me clean.

dag: Zoya ni fɔntinsi ni mini Shɛfɛla fɔntinsi ni ni Nɛgɛb fɔntinsi ni ni Bɛnjamin zuliya fɔntinsi ni ni luɣ shɛŋa din gili Jɛrusalɛm la ni Juda fɔntinsi ni piɛguliba ni ti lan kaani bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Shepherds will again count their flocks in the towns of the highlands, the western foothills and the arid southern plain, in the land of Benjamin, as well as in the outlying areas of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, says the LORD.

dag: Wain yi ti mɔha, ka be pipia ni kpeera, ka yiɣiri lɛbira, nyin di lihi li.
en: Don't let wine tempt you, even though it is rich red, and it sparkles in the cup, and it goes down smoothly.

dag: dama a tahi yɛl pal shɛŋa ti ni na ʒi n-wum di yɛla na. Dinzuɣu ti bɔri ni ti baŋ yɛla maa gbinni.
en: We have heard you say some strange things, and we want to know what you mean.

dag: Malimi tɔbbihi ni teei gili shɛm kɔtomsi tabili li, ka booi tɔbbihi ni me bindura tabili gooni shɛm gil li, ka mali goma din sirigina tabili li, ka lan mali tɔbutuhiriba bimbina baɣilibaɣili li gili ti tuui.
en: And then pretend you are an army surrounding the city. Build a dirt wall around the city to help you attack it. Build a dirt road leading up to the city wall. Bring battering rams and set up army camps around the city.

dag: Di daa nyɛla binnɛma la kpiŋkpama din daa shihiri taba la mini kalima din baɣi li la vuri. Di daa vurimi kaman tiŋgbani n-damdi pampam la.
en: Then the wings of the living beings began moving. The wings made a very loud noise as they touched each other, and the wheels in front of them began making a noise as loud as thunder.

dag: A kari ma saria ka di doli soli; a ʒini nam ʒiishee n-kari ma saria, ka nya ka m-mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: You listened to me from your throne like a good judge, and you decided that I was right.

dag: ka o baŋ ni o Ba pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni, ka lan mi ni o daa yila Naawuni sanna ka ni lan lab o sani.
en: Jesus knew the Father had given everything into his hands and that he had come from God and was returning to God.

dag: Di saha maa Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ anabi, ka nyɛ Lapidɔt paɣ la n-daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: Deborah the wife of Lappidoth was a prophet and a leader of Israel during those days.

dag: Ka Tama daa chaŋ o tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa ka o ti domi. Ka o daa niŋ zim ŋɔri mahibiɛli m-mali maha o nini maa ni.
en: So Tamar went to her brother Amnons house where he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made heart-shaped cakes in front of him, and then cooked them.

dag: Zaŋmiya dari mali sara maligu bimbini maa, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu. Malimiya li kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm din ni tooi kali sagbana? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbiligi zuɣusaa kom kola.
en: Who is wise enough to count the clouds, and who can tilt heavens water containers.

dag: Di saha ka o daa dii zaŋ sapashinnim mini tɔbbihi zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani. Bɛ ni daa ti nya sapashin kpɛm maa mini tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ chɛ Pool bubu.
en: So he quickly took some soldiers and officers and ran to where the crowd had gathered. As soon as the mob saw the commander and soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa lola alikauli din ka lɔrigibu n-zaŋ nam ti Dauda min o bidibisi ni bɛ su Izraɛlnim ʒiɛmani kam ni?.
en: Don't you know that the Lord , the God of Israel, made an unbreakable covenant with David, giving him and his descendants kingship over Israel forever?.

dag: So ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaag o bee n-zaŋ tɔŋ nyini kuh o nyee?.
en: No one can blind his eyes and capture him. No one can catch him in a trap.

dag: O zaŋ kuɣikpɛra me ŋ-ŋari n soli. O chɛ ka n soya niŋla so gɔna.
en: I stagger as I walk; stone walls block me wherever I turn.

dag: Amaa di yɛliya tammɛriba zuɣulaannim maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di laɣ shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti ba maa laasabu n-wuhi ya, dama bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: But theres no need to check on them regarding the money they receive, because they are honest workers.

dag: N ku bɔri ni n yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ninsal na mi m-bɔri ni binshɛli val o?.
en: I would not tell God that I wanted to talk to him. That would be like asking to be destroyed.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim karimbanim ni yino, ka ʒi dimbɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus said, You are an important teacher of Israel, and you still dont understand these things?.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Jotham did what was right in the LORDs eyes, just as his father Uzziah had done.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya taba kaman Masia ni daa deei ti shɛm Naawuni paɣibu zuɣu la.
en: Christ accepted you, so you should accept each other. This will bring honor to God.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni yiɣisi n suhu darigi bɛ tibili, n ku chɛ ba bee n-zo ba nambɔɣu, hal bɛ yi kuhiri pampam niŋdi ma ni n wum, n ku wum.
en: They will feel all the force of my anger. I will not spare them or show them any mercy. They will shout prayers to me as loud as they can, but I will not listen to them.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Bɔaz maŋmaŋ gba yi Bɛtilihɛm paana nti puhi kachɛriba maa n-yɛli, Yawɛ kul kpalimmi be yi sani! Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: When Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and went out to his field, he said to the harvest workers, The Lord bless you! They replied, And may the Lord bless you.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb mi Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shimia mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi, o paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua, ka o nyɛ Ammiɛl bipuɣiŋga la bihi.
en: These are the children born to David in Jerusalem: There were four sons from Bathsheba, the daughter of Ammiel. They were Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Baruk, Bɛ bi lan saɣi ni n kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, Im confined here and cant go to the LORDs temple.

dag: O yi ti nya wɔribariba ayiyi bee bumbariba bee laakumbariba ka bɛ kanna, ŋun gbilisim o tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready.

dag: Yawɛ, a wum bɛ ni maani ma ansarisi shɛm zaa mini bɛ ni lɔri ma nia biɛri shɛm.
en: Hear their jeering, LORD, all of their scheming against me.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli. Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ nti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: He used parables to tell them many things. Once there was a man who went out to sow grain.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia gba daa bɔhi, Shihirili dini n-lee wuhiri ni n ni chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Whats the sign that Ill be able to go up to the LORDs temple.

dag: Di ni gu a ka chɛ pagɔrili, ka gu a ka chɛ paɣ zinalan naŋgbammalisim.
en: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa yɛn chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pita tah o sanna dahin shɛli dazɔhigu dali yuŋ, Pita daa dola dansarika guliba ayi sunsuuni gbihira. Bɛ daa zaŋla zoligɔnim ayi lo o, ka dugul shɛb ʒe n-guli dunoli.
en: One night, Peter, bound with two chains, was sleeping between two of the soldiers. More soldiers were guarding the door of the jail. Herod was planning to bring Peter out before the people the next day.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni yi zuɣu.
en: In the same way, he took the cup after the meal and said, This cup is the new covenant by my blood, which is poured out for you.

dag: N ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ sɔŋda; n ni lab yi sanna.
en: I will not leave you all alone like orphans. I will come back to you.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka sokam buɣis omaŋmaŋ tuma nya, di nyaaŋa o ni mali dalir shɛli ni o nyu bara ni bela omaŋmaŋ tuma ni, ka pa ni o ʒiʒiinikpee tuma ni.
en: Dont compare yourself with others. Just look at your own work to see if you have done anything to be proud of.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Ti ni tooi nya ninvuɣ so ka o be kaman Naawuni Shia ni be do so ni ŋɔ.
en: and he said to them, We will never find a better man than Joseph, a man who has God's spirit in him.

dag: Dama Masia n-chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ʒiɛmani zan tariga ni di chɛ ka ŋunkam niŋ yɛda yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Christ is the goal of the Law, which leads to righteousness for all who have faith in God.

dag: Dama zuliya tital dini n-lee beni m-mali wuni ka di wuni maa miri ba kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni miri ti shɛm saha shɛli ti yi ti suh o ŋɔ?.
en: No other nation, no matter how great, has a god who is so near when they need him as the Lord our God is to us. He answers us whenever we call for help.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe fɔntiŋ ni bee tiŋkpaŋa, yin bɔhimiya n-nya ninvuɣ chirichi n-kpe o yiŋa m-be nimaani hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.

dag: Ka Yisa chɛbis o ni o kulima ka yɛl o, Di lan lab tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus then sent him home with the order, Don't go back into the village.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim Naawuni sani, dama di sabiya: Naawuni gbahiri yɛnnim la bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina puuni.
en: I say this because the wisdom of this world is foolishness to God. As the Scriptures say, He catches those who think they are wise in their own clever traps.

dag: ka maligumaana maa zaŋ ba mali sara; yino ni nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Ka maligumaana maa yo din yi o tooni na maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest will offer them, one as a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for him before the LORD because of his emission.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then this message from the Lord came to Jeremiah:.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaanii ni kɔbisiyɔbu, ka bɛ daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni.
en: The number of males over one month old, who would perform duties for the sanctuary, was .

dag: Dama Yawɛ zali biɛri bɔhibu dabisili. O mi ni bɔhi biɛri maa ti Ziɔn.
en: This will happen because the Lord has chosen a time for punishment. He has chosen a year when people must pay for the wrong they did to Zion.

dag: ka a bahi noli ka bɛ vihi litaafi shɛŋa a yaannim ni daa chɛ ka bɛ sabi zal la ni. A yi chɛ ka bɛ vihi li, a ni nya ka lala tiŋ maa bi zani tuhi nanim mini tiŋgbɔna yaɣa, ka duŋtaabo pun be nimaani ka di wɔɣa. Dina n-chɛ ka bɛ daa wurim li maa.
en: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir ti nya binshɛŋa o ni niŋdi tahima ni o ni ti nya la; di lan nyɛla din ni chɛ ka o shiri mi ni o nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa beni.
en: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Malimiya shili, ka nyo yi firilanim zali ka di dira;.
en: Be ready and keep your lamps burning.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnkam ʒe Ijipti nyaaŋa ni ti lu, ka di ni mali yaa shɛli nyuri bara la naai. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what the Lord says: Those who support Egypt will fall! The pride in her power will end. The people in Egypt will be killed in battle, all the way from Migdol to Aswan. This is what the Lord GOD said!.

dag: M biɛhigu din ka buchi ŋɔ puuni, n nya binshɛɣukam zaa. Wuntizɔriba kpiri bɛ wuntitali tuma puuni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: I have seen everything in my pointless lifetime: the righteous person may die in spite of their righteousness; then again, the wicked may live long in spite of their wickedness.

dag: ka o daa yɛli Yaakubu, Niŋm a ʒiɛri din mɔhi ŋɔ ti ma ka m piɛbi, dama kum wum ma pam. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o Ɛdom.
en: and said to Jacob, I'm starving; give me some of that red stuff.

dag: Yawɛ daalibarika chɛ ka nir leeri bundana, ka o bi zaŋdi suhugarigu pahiri di zuɣu.
en: It is the Lord s blessing that brings wealth, and no hard work can add to it.

dag: O tim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlana ŋun yi o dabili Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ka bi chaŋ.
en: But you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God, and you would not enter the land.

dag: Hal binshɛŋa din ka nyɛvili kaman yua bee mɔɣilo, ka pa ni bɛ piɛb li mi bee ŋ-ŋme li ka di doli soli, wula ka nir ni tooi baŋ di ni kum yɛli shɛm?.
en: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?.

dag: Bɛ saɣim ti wain tihi, ka ŋub ti fiig tihi. Bɛ ŋub puɣisi di tipaɣiri hal ka di wula zaa ti leela zaɣ piɛla.
en: It destroyed my grapevine. Its good vines withered and died. It destroyed my fig tree, stripped off the bark and threw it away.

dag: Ka Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ m mini cheechi zaa yilikpɛrilan la puhiri ya. Ka Ɛrastus ŋun nyɛ tiŋ puuni laɣigul la mini ti mabia Kuatus gba puhiri ya. .
en: My host Gaius, in whose house the church meets, sends you his greetings; Erastus, the city treasurer, and our brother Quartus send you their greetings.

dag: N ni tooi tam ninvuɣ biɛtali azichi din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi mini bɛ ni mali kuruwabihi shɛŋa zahindi binyara ka niriba galindi ba la yɛla?.
en: Are the treasures of wickedness still in the house of wickedness, while the shorted basket is denounced?.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisi zaŋ Yisa tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Everyone in the council got up and led Jesus off to Pilate.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu; wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Lord , hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for mercy.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi daa yi Bɛnjamin mini Ishibɔshɛt Sool bia maa polo na, ka ninvuɣ pinaayi mi yi Dauda tɔbbihi maa polo na.
en: and twelve of Ishbosheth's men from the tribe of Benjamin got up to fight twelve of David's men.

dag: Faralan tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa ni sizuura lubu, amaa bundan ŋun kul tuhirimi bahira.
en: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ daba ayi ha, n ni lan labisi Ɛlamnim nyamma ti ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But in the future I will make good things happen to Elam. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Di bi simdi ni tinzun nir ŋun niŋ Yawɛ yɛda ti yɛli, Yawɛ ku saɣi ka m pah o niriba ŋɔ ni. Di mi bi simdi ni namɔɣili ti yɛli, Man nyɛla ti kuŋ.
en: Some foreigners will choose to follow the Lord . They should not say, The Lord will not really accept me like the rest of his people. A eunuch should not say, I am only a dry piece of wood. I cannot have any children. .

dag: Izraɛl ni daa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saha shɛli maa ka Rubin daa zaŋ ŋun o ba dabipaɣa Biliha dɔni, ka ŋun Izraɛl wum li. Yaakubu bidibisi daa nyɛla pinaayi.
en: During their time there, Jacob's oldest son Reuben slept with Bilhah, who was one of Jacob's other wives. And Jacob found out about it.

dag: Yi yi ti piligi kachɛɣu dahin shɛli, yin piligimiya kali dindali maa hal ni bakɔi ayopɔin.
en: Count out seven weeks, starting the count from the beginning of the grain harvest.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sin tiŋgban nɛli maa ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Dofika.
en: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.

dag: A nina ni nya alahiziba binyara, ka a tɛha yɛtɔɣa gabi.
en: Your eyes will see strange things, and your heart will speak distorted words.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zaa daa labi Giligal sansani maa ni.
en: After this, Joshua and his army went back to the camp at Gilgal.

dag: A ni yɛli ti yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ yuli ni ŋɔ, ti ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Were not going to listen to a word you have said to us in the LORDs name!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali binshɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ binzahindigu zahim li, ka daa sabi binshɛɣukam tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ di saha maa.
en: We counted and weighed everything and we wrote down the total weight.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi tinzun buɣa maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka Izraɛlnim nandahima yɛlli maa daa muɣis o pam.
en: Then the Israelites threw away the foreign gods and began to worship the Lord again. So he felt sorry for them when he saw them suffering.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka bɛ daa doli ka tiri bɛ suɣa doona, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu yiɣisiri chana. Bɛ daa dolila Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Musa zali ba zaligu shɛli n-tumdi Yawɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: They camped at the LORDs command and they marched at the LORDs command. They followed the LORDs direction according to the LORDs command through Moses.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa ŋme binshɛɣukam din daa be palo ni luhi tiŋa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa. Ka daa lu n-fiɛri puri ni bimbilima zaa, ka da tihi luhi.
en: The hail beat down everything that was in the open field throughout the entire land of Egypt, both people and animals. The hail also beat down all the grain in the fields, and it shattered every tree out in the field.

dag: Yihimiya putɔɣu mini suhuyiɣisili ni sujee ni zabili ni nyaanzubo ni biɛr biɛɣu zaa yi bebu ni.
en: Never be bitter, angry, or mad. Never shout angrily or say things to hurt others. Never do anything evil.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti bɔhi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Yinim ku tooi bɔhim yɛm ka gba deei n noli? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Go and tell the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem: Cant you learn a lesson about what it means to obey me? declares the LORD.

dag: Bɛn mali kpiɔŋ tɔbiri kabisiya, ka ninvuɣ gbarima nya yaa.
en: The bows of mighty warriors are shattered, but those who were stumbling now dress themselves in power!.

dag: Dama saa ŋmaaya, ka kikaa gba gari.
en: The winter is over; the rains have stopped;.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, benya kaman mani, dama n gba bemi kaman yinima. Yi bi tum ma taali.
en: Brothers and sisters, I became like you. So please become like me. You were very good to me before.

dag: Amaa ya polo ka nir lee yɛn bɔ n-nya yɛm? Ka luɣ dini ka baŋsim be?.
en: But where can wisdom be found? Where can we learn to understand?.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa piligi ŋ-ŋmaari Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ bahira. Hazaɛl daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be bɛ tintarisi tinsi la ni zaa.
en: At that time the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria conquered all the Israelite territory.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat daa tim o tumtumda na m-pahi bunu ni o zilin yini maa. O daa sabila gbaŋ din bi kpabi ka o gbibi li o nuu ni na.
en: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his helper to me with the same message. And he had a letter in his hand that was not sealed.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yɛri sakuɣa, Lum tiŋgban ni, ka yɛli sa titali ŋɔ, Lumina pam.
en: He commands snow to fall on the earth, and sends torrents of drenching rain.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka sanzali zani tiŋgban ni mini di zoya zuɣu ni puri ni zaŋ tabili tihi puri ni ni olivi kpam tihi puri ni ni binshɛɣukam din yiri tiŋgban ni na; ka chɛ ka di miisim maa tabili ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ nuhi tuuni kam. .
en: I have brought drought on the land—on its hills, grainfields, vineyards, and olive orchards—on every crop the ground produces, on people and animals, on everything you try to grow.

dag: O yi ti zaŋ o paai yiŋa, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya m piɛ so ŋun daa bɔrigi la.
en: When he arrives home, he calls together his friends and neighbors, saying to them, Celebrate with me because Ive found my lost sheep.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi lahibali maa na garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim vaami guui ka chɛ Filistianima; bɛ ku niriba pam, hal bɛ ku a bih ayi la Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la chaŋ.
en: The Benjamite man answered, Israel ran away from the Philistines. The Israelite army has lost many soldiers. Your two sons are both dead, and the Philistines took Gods Holy Box.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ka binyila ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Yila maa nyɛla din ʒe dunia ŋɔ yikonim bɛn daa wurim Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ni Jɛrusalɛmnima kpɛhi yɔɣu la zaani.
en: So I asked the angel who was talking with me, What do these horns mean? He said, These are the horns that forced the people of Israel, Judah, and Jerusalem to go to foreign countries.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi chɛ ka m mɔɣisi n yaansi maa mini m bipuɣinsi maa kparima n-chɛbisi ba? A tum gala.
en: You didn't even give me a chance to kiss my own grandchildren and daughters goodbye. That was really foolish.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun darigiri zuliya kam tibili. Ŋuna ŋun zaŋdi baŋsim wuhiri daadamnima ŋɔ pala ŋun darigiri niriba tibili?.
en: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha.
en: From noon until three in the afternoon the whole earth was dark.

dag: ka Ɛlam daa pah anu ka Jɛhɔhanan pah ayɔbu, ka Ɛliɛhɔinai daa pah ayopɔin.
en: Elam was the fifth son. Jehohanan was the sixth son. And Eliehoenai was the seventh son.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔnnim naa Nahash daa yɛl ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n fɔɣi yi nudiriti polo nimbihi zaa din ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa nya filiŋ, n ni chɛ ka m mini ya tɔɣisi.
en: Nahash answered, I will make a treaty with you on one condition: I will put out everyone's right eye and so bring disgrace on all Israel.

dag: Toondaannim bɛn tumdi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga simdi ni niriba lihiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga, di bahi bamdi bɛn tumdi waazu yihibu mini wuhibu tuma la.
en: Elders who lead well should be paid double, especially those who work with public speaking and teaching.

dag: Dinzuɣu taɣimiya biɛhigu yi suhuri ni, ka di lan nyɛnya tipawumlinima.
en: So circumcise your hearts and stop being so stubborn.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa teei bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka maa zaashee maa, ka di daa chɛ ka bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi.
en: The winged creatures spread their wings over the place where the chest rested, covering the chest and its carrying poles.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o kpambaliba bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba la nuu ni. Di nyaaŋa niriba ni ti lan be Ijipti kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni la. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will hand them over to those who seek to kill them, namely Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar and his servants. But afterward Egypt will dwell like it did a long time ago, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla Manaasa daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali pam hal ka bɛ ʒim ti kul zɔri doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri, di yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ din la polo m-pah o ni daa chɛ ka Judanim tum alahichi mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la.
en: And Manasseh killed many innocent people. He filled Jerusalem from one end to another with blood. And all these sins are in addition to the sins that caused Judah to sin. Manasseh caused Judah to do what the Lord said was wrong.

dag: Yim ka bɛ ti wum vu shɛli damli, ka di yi zuɣusaa na kaman pɔhim tital la nti pali bɛ ni daa ʒi du shɛli ni maa zaa.
en: Suddenly there was a noise from the sky which sounded like a strong wind blowing, and it filled the whole house where they were sitting.

dag: Ka ŋun Haman daa nyu bara o daazichi min o ni mali bidibisi shɛm zuɣu bɛ sani. O daa lan nyu bara zaŋ chaŋ naa ni duh o n-zaŋ o zali zaashe shɛl ni la min o ni nyɛ ninvuɣ titali n-gar o tab bɛn nyɛ naa tuma zuɣulaannim la gba zuɣu.
en: and started bragging about his great wealth and all his sons. He told them the many ways that the king had honored him and how all the other officials and leaders had to respect him.

dag: Ka ninsalinim yi yi dunia ŋɔ binyara din tari ba daɣiri ni, bɛ ni baŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia la puuni, di yi lan gbahi ba nyaŋ ba, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni be barina ni di saha maa gari di piligu ni.
en: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa ŋmaligi lab Dɛbir ti liri ba.
en: Joshua along with all Israel turned back to Debir and attacked it.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi mini Amiliya maa yɛli, Kamina! Ŋunkam wum dimbɔŋɔ, ŋun gba yɛlima, Kamina! Ka kɔnyuri ni mali sokam mini ŋun bɔri nyɛvili kom, ŋun kamina nti dee li yoli.
en: The Spirit and the Bride say, Come! Everyone who hears this must also say, Come! Come, whoever is thirsty; accept the water of life as a gift, whoever wants it.

dag: Di zɔrimi duri zoya, ka zɔri siɣiri vinvama ni n-chani ti dooni a ni zali ni di dɔni luɣ shɛli.
en: The water flowed down from the mountains into the valleys, to the places you made for it.

dag: O peentɔriba tari gili ma, ka o bɔɣibɔɣi n yaannina, ka bi zo ma nambɔɣu. O puhigi m binsom bahi tiŋa.
