en: With his archers all around me, he shoots arrows into my kidneys. He shows no mercy and spills my gall on the ground.

dag: Amaa ka Kalɛb daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa fo baalim Musa tooni, ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ yomyom ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini; dama ti ni tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it.

dag: yi nina ni daa nya zahimbu kar shɛŋa mini shihiri shɛŋa ni alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa teeg o nuu din mali yaa yihi ya na shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛn niŋ yi ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm maa zaa.
en: You saw the great troubles he gave them and the amazing things he did. You saw the Lord use his great power and strength to bring you out of Egypt. The Lord your God will use that same power against all the people you fear.

dag: ni Hazɔrihadata ni Kiriɔtihɛzirɔn.
en: Hazor-hadattah, Kerioth-hezron.

dag: Ka wula ka n lan yɛn yɛli pahi? N lan ka dahima ni n yɛli Gidiɔn mini Barak ni Samsin ni Jɛfita ni Naa Dauda ni Samuɛl ni anabinim bɛn pahi la yɛla.
en: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti lan deei Yawɛ noli, ka doli o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But you will change and obey the LORDs voice and do all his commandments that Im commanding you right now.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba. Lala zuɣu ka yi chirim maa.
en: Jesus answered, How could you be so wrong? Its because you dont know what the Scriptures say. And you dont know anything about Gods power.

dag: ka doo maa gba ti lan je o ka sabi amiliya larigibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa bee do so ŋun kpuɣ o maa yi kpi.
en: and he also decides that he doesn't want her, so he also writes out divorce papers, gives them to her, and sends her away from his home. Or suppose her second husband dies.

dag: Nyama, ka Kush nir la gba daa ti paana nti yɛli, Lahibal suŋ ka n ʒina ni n ti ti nyini n dan naa, dama zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ fa a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: The Ethiopian arrived and said, News for my lord and king. Today the Lord has punished all those who were against you.

dag: ka baŋ ni dilana nyɛla tɛhitilimalana ni alahichilana ŋun maŋmaŋ tuma kar o saria. Wuhibu shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: You know that people like that are evil and sinful. Their sins prove they are wrong.

dag: Shɛm ni daa dɔɣi Aripakishad maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: Bɛ ni teei wula, ka bɛ viɛlim ti ŋman olivi tihi viɛlim. Ka bɛ nyom ti viɛl kaman Lɛbanɔn nyom la.
en: His branches will spread out; his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like that of Lebanon.

dag: Shɛhira maa n-nyɛ ni Naawuni ti ti nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka nyɛvili maa mi bela o Bia maa ni.
en: The testimony is this: God has given us eternal life, and this life has its source in his Son.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi be kaman nɛl la. N ni chɛ ka yi nyina nyɛ zaɣ pala ka dira. Yi ni niɛm zoya n-wurim li, ka niŋ daboya kaman wurigu la.
en: Look, Ive made you into a new threshing tool with sharp teeth. You will thresh mountains and pulverize them; you will reduce hills to straw.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Ishia ni Azarɛl ni Jɔɛza ni Jashɔbiam bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ niriba la.
en: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam the Korahites.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili. A wuntitali zuɣu, yihim ma n wahala ŋɔ ni.
en: Lord , let me live so that people will praise your name. Show me how good you are and save me from my trouble.

dag: Dabisili din pahir ayi dali ka niriba maa zaa dunoya dɔɣirikpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim daa laɣim chaŋ Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ zaligubaŋda la sani ni bɛ ti bɔhim baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu maa ni.
en: On the second day, the heads of the families of all the people, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered together around Ezra the scribe in order to study the words of the Instruction.

dag: Ka Absalom sapashinnim daa kana yili maa ni nti bɔhi paɣ maa, Ahimaaz mini Jɔnatan be ya? Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛli ba, Bɛ du kulibɔŋ ŋɔ ha. Ka bɛ lihilihi ka bi nya ba, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When Absaloms servants came to the woman at the house they demanded, Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan? The woman told them, They crossed over the stream. They looked for them but found nothing, so they returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yina ti lu Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu, ka bɛ ŋmaligi n-zaŋdi ba yiri kpaŋa, ka bɛ yaa doli Izraɛlnim maa n-kuri bɛ ni shɛb sɔŋdi palɔni Bɛtɛl mini Gibia solɔri zuɣu. Ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi pihita daa kpi di ni.
en: The Benjaminites came out to fight and were led away from the city. As they had before, they began killing some Israelites in the open country, on the road to Bethel and on the road to Gibeah. They killed about thirty Israelites.

dag: Ka Dauda mini tɔbbi kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la ni kpamba zaa daa gbaai saawara.
en: Some time later, David talked with his army commanders.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa be teeku duli, timiya Yawɛ jilima, ka paɣ o.
en: Let them give the LORD glory and declare Gods praise in the coastlands.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, dabiɛm yi ti mali ma, nyini ka n ni niŋ naani.
en: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa deei tiŋgbana taribu maa bupia m-pahi Giliad mini Bashan din daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din la polo la zuɣu;.
en: So the tribe of Manasseh had ten areas of land west of the Jordan River and two more areas of land, Gilead and Bashan, on the other side of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka bintɔrili yi to so nti naai.
en: If any of you have a boil that has healed.

dag: Bɛ yi gbaai jɛŋgbin nyaŋ bia ka chɛ o ka o chirig a, di so ni a zaŋ a nyɔɣu yo jɛrigu o jɛrilim tuma saha.
en: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim ni daa nya ka Yisa mini alahichinima ni farigudeeriba laɣim diri maa, ka bɛ bɔh o nyaandoliba, Bɔzuɣu ka o mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira ka nyura.
en: Some of the teachers of the Law of Moses were Pharisees, and they saw Jesus eating with sinners and tax collectors. So they asked his disciples, Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners.

dag: Naa, a dooshee ka tɛha daa ti ka a sanna zaŋ chaŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla polo; ka Naawuni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba ŋɔ daa wuh a din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: As you lay in bed, Your Majesty, your thoughts turned to what will happen in the future. The revealer of mysteries has revealed to you what will happen.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka alɔbo din daa lu Ijiptinim zuɣu la tatabo lu yi zuɣu; ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi n-ku yi nachimba; ka gbahi yi yuri zaa chaŋ; ka chɛ ka yi sansan ni nyo luɣiluɣi kpɛri ya; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I sent a plague against you like the one in Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword. I carried away your horses. I made the stink of your camp go up into your nostrils; yet you didnt return to me, says the LORD.

dag: n-zaŋ Hilikia pa, ka Tɛbalia daa pah ata, ka Zakaria pah anahi: Hɔsa mabihi min o bidibisi zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaata.
en: Hilkiah was Hosahs second son, Tebaliah his third, and Zechariah his fourth son. In all Hosah had sons and relatives who were gatekeepers.

dag: dama yi yi gbihira, o ni ti paana libigi ya.
en: If he comes suddenly, he must not find you asleep.

dag: Lihimiya daboya zuɣusaa nya, luɣ dini ka yi mini so lee bi dɔni? Yi daa ʒila soya naŋgban kpansi n-guhiri yi mamanima kaman Laribu m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la. Yi zaŋ zina niŋbu mini yi ninvuɣ biɛtali n-ta tiŋgbani maa daɣiri.
en: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.

dag: Tuumba ayi maa ni daa ti yɛn dɔni gbihi saha shɛli, ka Reehab du bɛ sani dufahirili maa zuɣusaa.
en: Before the spies settled down for the night, Rahab went up on the roof.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la niŋ naa tɔɣino yɛli, Ami! Ka lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan naa Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: Benaiah answered, We will do it, Your Majesty. I pray that the Lord your God will let it happen.

dag: Di simdi ka yi lo biŋkɔbigu maa zali hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, dindali zaawuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni ti kɔri bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: Then, on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, the whole community of Israel will kill the animals.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ suɣilo doli naa, o ni ti saɣ o ni yɛl o shɛm, ka zilim balli ni tooi kabisi kɔba.
en: With patience, you can make anyone change their thinking, even a ruler. Gentle speech is very powerful.

dag: N Naawuni, niŋm ba kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga taŋkpagbiligu la; ka niŋ ba kaman pɔhim n-ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri la.
en: Make them like weeds blown by the wind. Scatter them the way wind scatters straw.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Ti tɔŋya; ti nyɛla azichilaannima ka bi lan bɔri shɛli. Amaa ka bi mi ni yi nyɛla nandahimanim mini nambɔ niriba ni faranima ni zoomba ni bɛn chani bɛ zaɣim.
en: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as Jehoiakim had done.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya nia nyɛla nia biɛri, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila buɣim nyoori niriba.
en: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.

dag: Ka yi yi puhirila yi zɔnim kɔŋko, tuun suŋ bɔ ka yi lee zaŋ gari yi taba? Pa lala ka zuliya kam gba niŋda?.
en: And if you are nice only to your friends, you are no better than anyone else. Even the people who dont know God are nice to their friends.

dag: Ti zaa nyɛla alahichinima, ka ti wuntia tuma zaa ŋmanila binchɛr biɛri. Ti daalahichi zuɣu chɛ ka ti ŋmanila vari din kuui n-suui lu ka pɔhim ʒe li bahi.
en: We have all become like the unclean; all our righteous deeds are like a menstrual rag. All of us wither like a leaf; our sins, like the wind, carry us away.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala yɛnnima, amaa o daari bɛn bi ʒe yim yɛtɔɣa bahira.
en: The LORDs eyes protect knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the treacherous.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, yuma ayopɔin din yɛn dolina puuni, kum ni ti lu, ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, kum maa ni ti dam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim pam.
en: But then there will be seven years of hunger. The people will forget how much food there had been in Egypt before. This famine will ruin the country.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa yi sarika duu maa ni n-chaŋ Lidia yiŋa nti puh o; ka daa nya bɛ yɛdaniŋditab bɛn be nimaani n-kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ.
en: Paul and Silas left the prison and went to Lydia's house. There they met the believers, spoke words of encouragement to them, and left.

dag: Yisa mabihi maa ni daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni nyaaŋa ka o gba daa ti yiɣisi chaŋ chuɣu maa ni ashilɔni.
en: So his brothers left to go to the festival. After they left, Jesus went too, but he did not let people see him.

dag: Bɛ yi duɣi nimdi maa, Maligumaana ŋun yihim piɛ bɔɣu, ka pii maha din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini piɛɣu ni, ka pii karikaasi din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li niŋ Nazari nir maa nuhi ni o ni zaŋ o zuɣu shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri pinibu nyaaŋa.
en: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛb daa bɔhi, Pa doo ŋɔ ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku la?.
en: Then some of the people who lived in Jerusalem said, This is the man they are trying to kill.

dag: Saha shɛli Rom naa ni daa zaŋ Gallio leei Akaianim gomna la, ka Yɛhudianim daa niŋ naŋgban yini n-chaŋ ti gbaai Pool n-vo o tahi saria karibu shee.
en: While Gallio was governor of Achaia, some of the Jewish leaders got together and grabbed Paul. They brought him into court.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N suhu paligiya! Dama paɣiba ni boli ma suhupiɛlli; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Asha.
en: Leah said, I am very happy! Now women will call me happy. So she named that son Asher.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Yaakubu je Liya maa, ka o ti Liya nama, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl nyɛ paɣiŋoo.
en: The Lord knew that Jacob loved Rachel more than he did Leah, and so he gave children to Leah, but not to Rachel.

dag: Bɛna nti yɛn be laɣiŋgu suɣili maa tooni n-tumdi tuma tir o mini niriba maa zaa ka tumdi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la gba tuma.
en: and will work at the sacred tent for him and for all the Israelites.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya kul diri nam sahakam, ka chɛ ka a nam kul ʒiɛya ʒiɛmani kam ni. .
en: I will establish your offspring forever; I will build up your throne from one generation to the next. Selah.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinim.
en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites.

dag: Ka Shiiba daa chaŋ yaɣi Izraɛl tinsi zaa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti kpe Ɛbɛl fɔŋ din be Bɛtimaaka la ni. Ka Bikiri daŋ ni niriba zaa daa laɣim dol o kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: Sheba went through all the Israelite tribes up to Abel of Beth-maacah. All the Bichrites assembled and followed Sheba in.

dag: O yi yɛli, Di viɛla, binshɛli ku lan niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; o mi suhu yi yiɣisi, dindina nyin baŋmi ni o lo zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: If Saul says Fine, then I, your servant, am safe. But if he loses his temper, then youll know for certain that he intends to harm me.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: To replace them, King Rehoboam made bronze shields and entrusted them to the officers responsible for guarding the palace gates.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Makɛda n-gari chaŋ Libina ti liri Libinanima.
en: Then Joshua and all the Israelites traveled from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked that city.

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni bɛ booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka Filistia tɔbbihi zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti bo o shee. Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka yi n-chaŋ ni o ti liri ba.
en: The Philistines heard that David had been chosen to be the king of Israel, so all the Philistines went to look for him. When David heard about it, he went out to fight them.

dag: Yawɛ yi di bi sɔŋ ma, ŋ-ŋɔ n shia di be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: If you had not helped me, Lord , I would soon have gone to the land of silence.

dag: Ka o daa kpe vokabili puuni zoli maa zuɣu nti gbe nimaani. Ka Yawɛ daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: There he went into a cave and spent the night. The LORDs word came to him and said, Why are you here, Elijah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣimna, ka o yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mani n-daa yihi yinim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka fan ya Ijiptinim mini na shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi ya fitiina la zaa nuu ni bahi.
en: Samuel told the Israelites, The Lord , the God of Israel says, I led Israel out of Egypt. I saved you from Egypts control and from the other kingdoms that tried to hurt you.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa pun yɛli Ɛsta shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi saɣi wuh o ni nyɛ zuliya shɛli bee o niriba ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: Esther didnt tell anyone she was a Jew. She didnt tell anyone about her family background, because Mordecai had told her not to.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ taali galisi pahi; di chɛ ka bɛ nya gaafara a sani.
en: Punish them for the bad things they have done. Dont show them how good you can be.

dag: ka yɛl o, M ba, pa lala; dama ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kpɛma. Zaŋm a nudirigu maa pala o zuɣu ni.
en: He said to his father, Not that way, father. This is the older boy; put your right hand on his head.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: I assure you that this generation wont pass away until everything has happened.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro la ti ba, ka daa zaŋ zahim la gba pahi ba.
en: Jesus walked over to get the bread and gave it to them. He also gave them the fish.

dag: Kaman sara maligu biŋkɔbbaligu ni galisi shɛm ni kaman Jɛrusalɛm churi puhibu ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni beni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa maa ni ti pali daadambiɛligu. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Like the holy flock, like the flock of Jerusalem at its festivals, the ruined cities will be filled with a human flock. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: What is it? Jesus asked them.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya o ni nam binshɛɣukam maa zaa, ka di viɛl pam. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayɔbu.
en: God saw everything he had made: it was supremely good. There was evening and there was morning: the sixth day.

dag: Asiba zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni bɛ pun kpi. Bɛ kul kpirimi zaa, ka bi mi di yɛla.
en: Born after daybreak, you die before nightfall and disappear forever.

dag: O ku lan tooi zaŋ binshɛli zal o zaani bee n-zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o n-zaŋ zaɣ suŋ taɣi zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu taɣi zaɣ suŋ. Ka o yi zaŋla biŋkɔbigu ni o taɣi biŋkɔbigu, dindina o ni zaŋ so na ni o ti taɣ o maa min o zaa ni leei bɛn be kasi.
en: and you may not substitute another animal for it. If you do, both animals belong to the Lord .

dag: Di nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli nyin Firawuna shɛm la, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuh a.
en: Its just as I told Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi na mi n-nya ka nir nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, ka pa ni firila tamdigu zuɣu?.
en: Then Jesus said to them, You dont take a lamp and hide it under a bowl or a bed, do you? Of course not. You put it on a lampstand.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Lakishi gari chaŋ Ɛgilɔn ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: Next, Joshua and his army went on from Lachish to Eglon, surrounded it and attacked it.

dag: ka daa ti yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti lab Judia.
en: and then said to his followers, We should go back to Judea.

dag: Ka Amasa daa zaŋ Judanim maa zaa suhuri laɣim taba ka bɛ be kaman ninvuɣ yino la, ka daa tim ti yɛli Naa A min a kpamba zaa labimina.
en: Soon the tribe of Judah again became followers of David, and they sent him this message: Come back, and bring your soldiers with you.

dag: n-zaŋ a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a ka nyɛ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm la nuu ni. Hal n naan zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza mini Kalidianim nuu ni.
en: Jehoiachin, I will give you to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and the Babylonians. Those are the people you are afraid of. They want to kill you.

dag: ka bɛ nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni.
en: Count all the men from to years old who come to serve. These men will work in the Meeting Tent.

dag: Bakibuk ni Hakufa ni Harihur ni.
en: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka teeku kɔgbana puɣiri luri yɔri vuri. N yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni lan me Ziɔn, o ni kana ni o jilima.
en: The Lord will rebuild Zion, and people will again see her glory.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Saimɔn, Saimɔn, Sintani lo nia ni o kpɛhi ya nuu ni yɛli ya kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la.
en: Satan has asked to test you men like a farmer tests his wheat. O Simon, Simon.

dag: Yi yi yuri taba, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba. .
en: If you have love for one another, then everyone will know that you are my disciples.

dag: Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Rehoboam and Jeroboam were always fighting against each other.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni ti kum ka fabili. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun pirig o zaɣim ka ʒi tiŋa.
en: Her gates will lament and mourn; desolate, she will sit on the ground.

dag: Binshɛli bi lan kpalim bɛ yiŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ chilibi yaɣiri bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa.
en: Nothing they own remains in their tent; sulfur is scattered over their home.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli, Naawuni bo lari ti ma, ka ŋunkam zaa wum di yɛla ni la n-sɔŋ ma.
en: and Sarah said, God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.

dag: Ka bɛn daa daŋ puu maa ni la ti kana n-tɛhiri ni bɛn ni deei gari lala; amaa ka o ti yo bɛ gba la tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: Now when those hired first came, they thought they would receive more. But each of them also received a denarion.

dag: Dabiɛm ka bɛ yinsi puuni, ka Naawuni bi darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: their houses safe from dread, Gods punishing stick not upon them.

dag: Ka o mini gbuɣima daa doli, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu ka ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: He hunted with other lions and learned to eat people.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi biɛɣu zuɣu, dama biɛɣu gba jiɣindila dimaŋ zuɣu. Dabisili kam wahala saɣiri li mi.
en: So do not worry about tomorrow; it will have enough worries of its own. There is no need to add to the troubles each day brings.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ ka di ti paag a sanna, ka nyin ka suɣilo? Di shihir a mi, ka nyin yihi tahima.
en: But now trouble comes to you, and you are discouraged. Trouble hits you, and you are upset.

dag: Dama bɛ birila pɔhim, bɛ ni chɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga. Bɛ chi ni saai ʒiɛya ka ku niŋ bindirigu. Ka di yi niŋ bindirigu, tinzunnima n-ni di li.
en: The Israelites did a foolish thing—it was like trying to plant the wind. But they will get only troubles—they will harvest a whirlwind. The grain in the fields will grow, but it will give no food. Even if it grew something, strangers would eat it.

dag: O ni ti nyu wain ka o nina mɔhi; ka nyu bihim ka o nyina paligi.
en: His eyes are red from drinking wine. His teeth are white from drinking milk.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛl o, Biɛɣu neera, chɛ ka n chaŋ. Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N ku chɛ ka a chaŋ, faashee ka a niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Then the man said to Jacob, Let me go. The sun is coming up. But Jacob said, I will not let you go. You must bless me.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn pun lo amiliya, n zali ya zaligu, amaa pa mani n-zali ya lala, ti Duuma n-zali ya li. Dina n-nyɛ: Paɣ miri ka o yi o yidana yiŋa.
en: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband.

dag: Tɔbu lu di yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn be sunsuuni zaa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei paɣiba. Tɔbu lu bɛ daazichi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di li.
en: Sword, kill the horses and chariots of Babylon. Sword, kill all the soldiers hired from other countries. They will be like frightened women. Sword, destroy the treasures of Babylon. Those treasures will be taken away.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes. He didnt deviate from the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bimmɔrima mini yuma ni nyinvɔɣu ni saŋkpana la lu yi zuɣu, ka yi ku kpaŋ.
en: The Lord will send boils on you, as he did on the Egyptians. He will make your bodies break out with sores. You will be covered with scabs, and you will itch, but there will be no cure.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi galisim maa pahi ʒii tuhili zuɣu, ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: May the LORD, your ancestors God, continue to multiply you—a thousand times more! And may God bless you, just as he promised.

dag: Dama di saha a ti ku lan kaani n napɔna yaabu, a ti ku lan yuuni n daalahichi.
en: You would still watch every step I take, but you would not remember my sins.

dag: Hal yi ya ŋɔ taŋkpa shɛli din puɣ ti naba ŋɔ, ti ni pihi li bahi yi zuɣu, amaa lee baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam miri ya.
en: We are shaking the dust from our feet as a warning to you. And you can be sure that God's kingdom will soon be here.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, sokam ŋun cham ti jɛm o buɣa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana. Amaa miriya ka yi lan zaŋ yi buɣa mini yi pina ta n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ daɣiri.
en: But to you, house of Israel, the LORD God proclaims: Go ahead and serve your idols, all of you! But afterward, if any of you are left to listen to me, you will no longer make my holy name impure with your gifts or your idols!.

dag: Dama Yisa ni daa be Galili la, bɛna n-daa dol o ka sɔŋd o; ka paɣiba pam bɛn daa dol o na hal ni Jɛrusalɛm la gba beni.
en: They had followed Jesus while he was in Galilee and had helped him. Many other women who had come to Jerusalem with him were there also.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tibig o niriba laɣiŋgu ni, ka paɣ o kpamba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: They must proclaim his greatness in the assembly of the people and praise him before the council of the leaders.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A zaŋla amaŋmaŋ yuli sabi gbaŋ ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be Jɛrusalɛm mini maligumaana Zɛfania ŋun nyɛ Maasɛya bia la ni maligumaaniba zaa n-yɛra.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims:You sent letters on your own accord to all the people in Jerusalem, to the priest Zephaniah, Maaseiahs son, and to the rest of the priests.

dag: Di saha Dauda zuliya ni so ni ti leei naa, ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini yurilim su niriba. O ni ti niŋ din tuhi yomyom. Ka chɛ ka niriba doli din tuhi soli.
en: Then a new king will come. He will be from Davids family. He will be loyal, loving, and kind. He will be a king who judges fairly. He will do what is right and good.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom so yo o zuɣu, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever kills an animal must pay for the animal. But whoever kills another person must be put to death.

dag: Dama m mi ni n tiligira nyɛla ŋun be, o nyɛla ŋun kul ni ti bahi ka dunia ni na.
en: But I know that my redeemer is alive and afterward hell rise upon the dust.

dag: ka Jɛrimia daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ni o kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni nti deeg o tarili nimaani niriba maa sani.
en: So I decided to leave Jerusalem and go to the territory of the Benjamin tribe to claim my share of my family's land.

dag: Dimiya li luɣ kasi shee, dama di nyɛla a min a bidibisi maa dihili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dama lala ka o zali ma.
en: Eat it in a holy place; it is the part that belongs to you and your sons from the food offered to the Lord . That is what the Lord commanded me.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake daa yiɣisi zani n-kuhi pam yɛli Judanim yɛligu ni, Wummiya na titali ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa la ni yɛli shɛm! O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!.

dag: Bɛ wurim m biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni sibigiri piɛgul tanti suɣili shɛm la. N daa kpabi la n nyɛvili kaman kpalua ni kpabiri tana shɛm la, ka bɛ ŋmaai ma yihi kpalu dari ni. Wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul wuhirila n nyɛvili tariga.
en: My home, my shepherds tent, is being pulled down and taken from me. I am finished like the cloth someone rolls up and cuts from the loom. You ended my life in such a short time.

dag: N yi ti yɛn darig a tibili dahin shɛli, a ni tooi mali suhukpeeni bee a nuhi ni tooi mali yaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka mi ni niŋ li.
en: When I'm finished with you, your courage will disappear, and you will be so weak that you won't be able to lift your hands. I, the Lord , have spoken and will not change my mind.

dag: O maari suhugarigunim suhuri, ka tibiri bɛ dansi.
en: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ti di nasara man Yawɛ zuɣu ka paɣi ma.
en: All the Israelites will be victorious and rejoice.

dag: Ti ni daa ti miriti Saipurus ka ti chɛ li bahi ti nuzaa polo ka chaŋ Taai din be Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa yɛn yihi nɛma ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: We spotted Cyprus, but passed by it on our left. We sailed on to the province of Syria and landed in Tyre, where the ship was to unload its cargo.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa deei tɔrokɔnim maa mini naɣilahi maa n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim maa.
en: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.

dag: Tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa yi ti sɔhira, mani n-nyɛ ŋun gbib di daantalisi.
en: The earth and all its inhabitants will melt, but I will keep its pillars steady. Selah.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn darigila Babilɔn naa tibili n-tabil o tiŋgbɔŋ kaman n ni daa darigi Asiria naa tibili shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, punished the king of Assyria, and I will also punish the king of Babylonia.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri kum, ka kum bi kanna, ka o gbi m-bo di shee n-gari azichi sɔɣirili;.
en: Such people want to die, but death does not come. They search for death more than for hidden treasure.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda, ka niŋ man gba yɛda.
en: Jesus said, Dont be troubled. Trust in God, and trust in me.

dag: bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni ka lan mali suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu ni la nuu ni.
en: those who find pleasure in doing wrong and who enjoy senseless evil.

dag: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɛza mini Finɛhas ni Abishua.
en: These were Aarons sons: Eleazar was Aarons son. Phinehas was Eleazars son. Abishua was Phinehas son.

dag: Amaa di saha wuntizɔriba ni ti bela bɛ Ba Naawuni nam ni n-ne kaman wuntaŋ la. Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Then the godly people will shine like the sun. They will be in the kingdom of their Father. You people who hear me, listen!.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli malaika maa ka o labis o takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni.
en: The Lord told the angel to put his sword away, and the angel obeyed.

dag: Ka hal n yi kari so saria gba, n saria karibu maa nyɛla din tuhi, dama pa n kɔŋko n-kariti saria maa, amaa m mini ŋun tim ma na maa n-kariti li.
en: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa shiri niŋ lala n-kpuɣi paɣiba wawariba maa ni saɣisi bɛ kalinli tariga n-ʒi ba lab kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni nti lab me bɛ tinsi ʒini di ni yaha.
en: And that is what the Benjaminites did. They took wives for their whole group from the dancers whom they abducted. They returned to their territory, rebuilt the cities, and lived in them.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara ka so ku tooi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: We cannot understand the great things he does, and to his miracles there is no end.

dag: Dama zaligu maa nyɛla firila, ka wuhibu maa mi nyɛ neesim, ka zuɣu ni kpahibu din wuhiri biɛrisuŋ la mi nyɛ nyɛvili.
en: The commandment is a lamp and instruction a light; corrective teaching is the path of life.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa bɔh o, Ka daɣila a shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia? Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: They all said, Are you, then, the Son of God? He answered them, You say that I am.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini Masia ni laɣim neei kum ni la zuɣu, bomiyala binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni Masia ni ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo luɣ shɛl la.
en: You have been raised to life with Christ, so set your hearts on the things that are in heaven, where Christ sits on his throne at the right side of God.

dag: Di saha maa ka o nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ ni Jɔn Baptaizira yɛla ka o yɛri ba maa.
en: Then the disciples realized he was telling them about John the Baptist.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim di ni sabi Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli shɛm la yɛla? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: Jesus said to them, Surely you have read this in the Scriptures: The stone that the builders refused to accept became the cornerstone. The Lord did this, and it is wonderful to us. Psalm :-.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa nyɛ Hitinim mini Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pa Izraɛlnim.
en: Any non-Israelite people who remained of the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So na ʒi n-tooi binyɛr palli tani n-liɣi binyɛr kurili; dama o yi niŋ lala o cheei binyɛr palli maa, ka tam palli din liɣi binyɛr kurili maa mi ku ŋman li.
en: Jesus then told them these sayings: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and make the hole even bigger.

dag: Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la n-daa su tɔbbihi Fukumsi, ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la daa nyɛ ŋun sabiri gbana sɔŋda.
en: Zeruiahs son Joab was in command of the army; Ahiluds son Jehoshaphat was recorder.

dag: Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din kul tuhi, ka tiri suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din do palo ni; ka neeri niriba nini.
en: The Lord 's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.

dag: Yi yi ti kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, yin chɛliya ka yi buɣa maa tiligi ya. Pɔhim ni ʒe ba chaŋ. Hal ninsal vuhibu pɔhim gba ni ʒe ba chaŋ. Amaa ŋunkam zaa kana ti kpe n yuli, o ni su tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka jɛm ma n zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you.

dag: Ka ŋun Firawuna daa pirig o nuu ni nintu shɛli o ni mali dalindi binyara n-zaŋ li piri Yisifu, ka zaŋ bimpiɛl viɛlli kparibu yɛl o, ka zaŋ salima dolibi yɛl o;.
en: Pharaoh took his signet ring from his hand and put it on Josephs hand, he dressed him in linen clothes, and he put a gold necklace around his neck.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpahimmiya yi ni be shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di benya kaman bɛn be ʒilinsi ni, amaa ka lee bemi kaman yɛnnima.
en: So be careful to live your life wisely, not foolishly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛl ni: A ku chɛ ka a ninvuɣ gahindili niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: And in another psalm it says, God will never let the body of his Holy One decay.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa yɛli do so ŋun kpaŋ maa, Zuŋɔ nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali; di bi luhi ni a kpuɣ a bindoo maa n-ʒiri li chana.
en: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti neei bɛ nina, ka gbilisi bɛ tiba wum niriba yɛlimuɣisira.
en: Then the eyes of those who can see will no longer be blind, the ears of those who can hear will listen.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔri ni o bahi Yisa, dinzuɣu ka o daa lan lab tɔɣisi ba di yɛla maa;.
en: Pilate wanted to set Jesus free, so he appealed to the crowd again.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ Ninivenim dini. Nahum ŋun nyɛ Ɛlikɔsh nir la ni daa nya ʒii shɛli litaafi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: An oracle about Nineveh: the scroll containing the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi maa yi zooi mɔɣu maa ni n-niŋ yaa, bɛ chanimi ka ku lan labi bɛ sani yaha.
en: Their young are healthy; they grow up in the open country, leave and never return.

dag: Naa daa yi ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, bɛ zaŋdila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan zaŋ li labisi ti niŋ di duu.
en: Every time the king went to the Lord s Temple, the guards took out the shields and went with him. After they were finished, they put the shields back on the wall in the guardroom.

dag: Ti ni lo kpara du Yawɛ ninni n-chaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti yɛn su li maa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli ŋɔ na.
en: Well cross into the land of Canaan before the LORD, equipped for war. But the property we inherit will be across the Jordan.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋbihi ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Pita ni daa chɛ n-shɛligi so tibili la dɔɣim bɔh o, N di bi nya a o sani tihi puu la ni.
en: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, Didn't I see you in the garden with that man.

dag: Adam daa bol o paɣ maa yul la Awa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninsalinim zaa ma.
en: Adam named his wife Eve. He gave her this name because Eve would be the mother of everyone who ever lived.

dag: lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun yɔhim o kpee ka yɛli, N diɛmdimi.
en: than to cheat someone and say, I was only fooling.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaɣisi Balaam ni bɔri ni o niŋ shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa naɣi zaŋla o noli yɛlibu maa leei alibarika tin ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa yuri ya zuɣu.
en: But the LORD your God wasnt interested in listening to Balaam. The LORD your God turned that curse into a blessing because the LORD your God loves you.

dag: Bolimi ma, ka n garig a, ka yɛl a yɛl kara mini binshɛŋa din sɔɣi ka a bi mi li.
en: Judah, pray to me, and I will answer you. I will tell you important secrets. You have never heard these things before.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli salo maa, Di zabiriya so nyuli o buni zuɣu, dama ninsal nyɛvili bi dolila o ni mali shɛli.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Watch out! Guard yourself against all kinds of greed. After all, ones life isnt determined by ones possessions, even when someone is very wealthy.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, Daadam Bia ni ti ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo.
en: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right side of God All-Powerful.

dag: Tɛra ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ibram mini Nahɔr so ni Haran.
en: After Terah was years old, his sons Abram, Nahor, and Haran were born.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus went to Capernaum, a city in Galilee. On the Sabbath day he taught the people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-she binyɛr shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la viɛnyɛliŋga, ka daa lan she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti Aduna kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Di yɛliya di yɛla Gaat fɔŋ ni, di kul chɛliya ka nintam yi yi nina ni na. Bilimmiya taŋkpaɣu ni Bɛtiliafra tiŋ puuni.
en: Don't tell our enemies in Gath about our defeat; don't let them see you weeping. People of Beth Leaphrah, show your despair by rolling in the dust!.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anahi, ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah anahi yɛli, Kamina.
en: Then the Lamb broke open the fourth seal; and I heard the fourth living creature say, Come.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani, ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na; dama ŋun pɔri yi zaa ha ni, dilana n-nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni.
en: and said to them, Whoever welcomes this child in my name, welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me, also welcomes the one who sent me. For the one who is least among you all is the greatest.

dag: ka daa boli bia maa yuli Yisifu ka yɛli, Yawɛ tim ma bidib so pahi.
en: She named him Joseph, saying to herself, May the LORD give me another son.

dag: Amaa ka o yi bi bɔr ni o yo puu maa zuɣu ka dee li bee o yi pun zaŋla puu maa kɔhi so zuɣu, o ku lan tooi yo di zuɣu ka dee li yaha.
en: but you cannot buy it back once someone else has bought it.

dag: Malim a tuma shili samban ni, ka tum a pu tuma naai, di nyaaŋa ka a naanyi me a yili.
en: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.

dag: Ka Barak daa kari doli chɛchɛbunsi maa mini tɔbbihi maa hal ni Harɔshɛtihagɔim nti ku Sisɛra tɔbbihi maa zaa hal ka bɛ ni yino gba bi tiligi.
en: Barak continued fighting Siseras army. He and his men chased Siseras chariots and army all the way to Harosheth Haggoyim. They used their swords to kill all of Siseras men. Not one of Siseras men was left alive.

dag: Zaŋm ma mali kuli, chɛ ka ti niŋ yomyom. Naa zaŋ ma kpe o duu. Ti ni di dari ka mali suhupiɛlli a zuɣu; ti ni paɣ a yurilim maa gari wain; dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yur a maa.
en: Take me with you, and we'll run away; be my king and take me to your room. We will be happy together, drink deep, and lose ourselves in love. No wonder all women love you!.

dag: Ti ŋmanila zoomba bɛn chani baɣisiri dukpini ka tuuri wuntaŋ zuɣusaa kaman di nyɛla yuŋ la. Bɛn mali yaa sunsuuni, ti ŋmanila kpiimba.
en: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.

dag: Noombihi zaa daa tɛrila bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu; ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa dɔɣiri bɛ bihi di mahim, ka zuliya pam ʒiini di mahim.
en: Every kind of bird built nests in its branches; The wild animals bore their young in its shelter; The nations of the world rested in its shade.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun yiɣisiri zoya ka zoya maa bi mi di yɛla ŋɔ, o suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o lɛbiri li pilina.
en: When God is angry, he moves mountains before they know what happened.

dag: Wuntizɔra tɛhirila o ni yɛn garigi shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni zaɣ biɛɣu n-yirina.
en: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked do not, and what they say causes trouble.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n yi lab m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa sani, ka bia maa bi dol ti labi, dindina o nyɛvili ni tab bia maa nyɛvil la zuɣu.
en: That's why Benjamin must be with us when I go back to my father. He loves him so much.

dag: O tiligiri niriba, ka lan fari niriba bahira; o wuhiri shihira, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa alizanda ni mini dunia ŋɔ ni. O fa Daniɛl gbuɣima nuu ni bahi.
en: God helps and saves people. He does amazing miracles in heaven and on earth. He saved Daniel from the lions.

dag: Tiŋbunsi nyɛla bɛn ka yiko, amaa bɛ maani bɛ biɛhigu shee la kuɣa ni.
en: Badgers as creatures arent powerful, but they make their homes in the rocks.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pinaanu dali chuɣu maa puhibu daba ayopɔin puuni, di simdi ka o lan bo lala bina maa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni chi mini kawana ni kpam sara.
en: For the Festival of Shelters, which begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, the prince will offer on each of the seven days the same sacrifice for sin, the same offerings to be burned whole, and the same offerings of grain and olive oil.

dag: Ŋunkam vuɣi o kpee palo tariga kpaa, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who moves a neighbor's property line. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni cheechi din be Kɔrinti mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, and from our brother Timothy— To the church of God in Corinth, and to all God's people throughout Achaia:.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yo yi puri atam pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim naai yuuni din pahir ata, ka nyɛ yuun shɛli puuni yi ni yɔri pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim tiri Lɛvinim mini saamba ni kpibisi ni pakoya ni bɛ gba di n-tiɣi yi tinsi ni la.
en: Every third year is the Year of Tithes. In that year, you must give one-tenth of your harvest to the Levites, to the foreigners living in your country, and to the widows and orphans. Then they will have plenty to eat in every city.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti diri bindirigu saha shɛli, bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ galima shɛb daa ti kana ti teei gili yili maa kpahiri di dunoli ka yɛri ninkurigu ŋun nyɛ yil maa lan maa, Zaŋm do so ŋun kpe a yili ŋɔ na la ti ti ka ti gol o.
en: While they were relaxing, suddenly the men of the city, a perverse bunch, surrounded the house and started pounding on the door. They said to the old man, the owner of the house, Send out the man who came to your house, so we can have sex with him.

dag: Yawɛ zal o nam ʒiishee la alizanda ni. O nyɛla naa ŋun su sokam zaa.
en: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim maa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu duli n-chaŋ ti kpe Shur tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka bɛ daa chaŋ dabisi muna ata chandi ka bi nya kom.
en: Then Moses had Israel leave the Reed Sea and go out into the Shur desert. They traveled for three days in the desert and found no water.

dag: O ni ti fa yi puri mini yi wain tihi ni yi Olivi tihi puri zaa din mali vuhim n-zaŋ ti o tumtumdiba.
en: He will take your best fields, vineyards, and olive groves, and give them to his officials.

dag: Ti Naawuni daalibarika nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Shɛrɛbia ŋun yi Mahili ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi bia ni Izraɛl yaaŋa zuliya ni na la ti ti. O min o dɔɣiriba ni o bidibisi kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Bɔaz maŋmaŋ gba yi Bɛtilihɛm paana nti puhi kachɛriba maa n-yɛli, Yawɛ kul kpalimmi be yi sani! Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: Some time later Boaz himself arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the workers. The Lord be with you! he said. The Lord bless you! they answered.

dag: O ni ti ʒini kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun paɣiri neeri anzinfa la; o ni ti paɣi neei Lɛvi zuliya kaman bɛ ni paɣiri neeri salima mini anzinfa shɛm la, hal ka bɛ ti zaŋ pina din tuhi ti Yawɛ.
en: He will make the Levites clean. He will make them pure, like silver is made pure with fire! He will make them pure like gold and silver. Then they will bring gifts to the Lord , and they will do things the right way.

dag: Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa yi ti niŋ a nyin niŋm a nuu ni ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: After these things happen, do whatever you think is right! God will help you.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ nyɛvili din bi naari ni be so ni; ka nyɛ ŋun be neesim shɛl ni so ni ku tooi miri. So na ʒi n-nya o, ka so mi ku tooi nya o. Ŋuna n-simdi jilima tibu mini yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: God is the only one who never dies. He lives in light so bright that people cannot go near it. No one has ever seen him; no one is able to see him. All honor and power belong to him forever. Amen.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Hal tumtumda chira anii yɔri ku tooi da bindirigu ka niriba ŋɔ zaa paai biɛlabiɛla gba di.
en: Philip answered, For everyone to have even a little, it would take more than two hundred silver coins to buy enough bread.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter answered, All the other followers may lose their faith in you. But my faith will never be shaken.

dag: O ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi o piligu ni hal ni o bahigu ni, bɛ sabi li niŋ Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Ahaz did, from the beginning to the end, is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Mɛriba kom la gbini bɛ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, ka yɛla daa paai Musa bɛ zuɣu.
en: At the springs of Meribah the people made the Lord angry, and Moses was in trouble on their account.

dag: Ŋunkam daa nya ba ŋubiri ba mi, ka bɛ dimnim yɛli, Ti ka taali, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun guli ba ni yɛlimaŋli la, bɛ yaannim ni daa mali tahima Yawɛ so san la.
en: I am your true pastureland, the one who gave hope to your ancestors. But you abandoned me, so when your enemies found you, they felt no guilt as they gobbled you up.

dag: Yawɛ, n daa bela gballi din zilim pam puuni, ka suh a.
en: Lord , I called your name from the bottom of the pit.

dag: Amaa o daa timdi anabinim bɛ sani ni bɛ ti chɛ ka bɛ labi ŋun Yawɛ sanna. Ka anabinim maa daa saɣisi ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: God sent prophets to the people to bring them back to the Lord . The prophets warned them, but they refused to listen.

dag: Dama bɛnkam zaa tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim mini bɛnkam zaa bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bi bɔri shɛba.
en: The Lord your God hates people who cheat with false weights and measures. Yes, he hates all people who do wrong.

dag: Ka ŋun pah anahi nyɛ Adɔnija. O ma n-daa nyɛ Haggit; ka ŋun pah anu nyɛ Shɛfatia, o ma n-daa nyɛ Abital.
en: The fourth son was Adonijah. Adonijahs mother was Haggith. The fifth son was Shephatiah. Shephatiahs mother was Abital.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima, yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din tuhi? Yi kariti niriba saria ka di doli soli?.
en: You judges are not being fair in your decisions. You are not judging people fairly.

dag: Nyin ŋun be Zallakudura Naa sani sɔɣibu shee mini ŋun kpalim be Kpiɔŋlan Naa mahim ni.
en: Living in the Most Highs shelter, camping in the Almightys shade.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa nya Dauda ka ʒiɛm o, dama o daa kul nyɛla bisariŋga ka mal alaafee, ka viɛli pam.
en: When Goliath saw that David was just a healthy, good-looking boy, he made fun of him.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ zaɣis a ka leeg a dima, ka wula a lan bɔhiri ma?.
en: Why do you ask me, Samuel said, since the LORD has turned away from you and has become your enemy?.

dag: N ni tib n niriba maa, ka ti bɛn be yoma mini bɛn be katinsi zaa suhudoo. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord , will heal you and give you peace.

dag: O daa di wahala pam timanim sani n-saɣim o ni daa mali shɛlikam zaa ha, ka di bi niŋd o soochi ka kul maan pahirimi.
en: She had gone to many doctors, and they had not done anything except cause her a lot of pain. She had paid them all the money she had. But instead of getting better, she only got worse.

dag: ka doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: and by keeping the LORDs commandments and his regulations that Im commanding you right now. Its for your own good!.

dag: Ka shihir shɛli daa lan puhi zani alizanda ni yaha. Waɣ ʒiɛ biɛ titali ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin mini yila pia, ka nam zuɣupilis ayopɔin pil o zuɣuri maa daa yina ʒiɛya.
en: Then another sign appeared in heaven: it was a great fiery red dragon, with seven heads and ten horns, and seven royal crowns on his heads.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan kpi yaha; bɛ biɛhigu mini malaikanim biɛhigu ti kul yɛn nyɛla yim. Bɛ ti yɛn nyɛla Naawuni bihi bɛ ni nyɛ kum ni neebu bihi maa zuɣu.
en: They can no longer die, because they are like angels and are Gods children since they share in the resurrection.

dag: N daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman taŋkpa zim la. N daa burisi ba ka no n-taai ba kaman soli zuɣu batibati la.
en: I beat my enemies to pieces like dust on the ground. I smashed them and walked on them like mud in the streets.

dag: Niriba pam kul yɛri ma mi, Naawuni ku sɔŋ a.
en: So many are talking about me: Even God wont help him. Selah.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima m-be nandaamba sani, di so ni a mini karimbaannim pirigiri bɛ ni ŋmɛri diri neen shɛŋa.
en: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.

dag: Bɛ daa bela nimaani kaman yuun pia, ka Malɔn mini Kiliɔn gba daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi ka o kpalim o kɔŋko ka lan ka yidana bee bihi.
en: then Mahlon and Kilion also died. So Naomi was left alone without her husband or her two sons.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka nyɛ bɛn daa be Ɛfɛsus daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, ka dabiɛm kpe bɛ zaa, ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli daa du n-chaŋ haliya.
en: This became known to the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus. Everyone was seized with fear and they held the name of the Lord Jesus in the highest regard.

dag: N nuu kul ni pa o zuɣu sahakam; n nuu ni chɛ ka o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: My hand will sustain him— yes, my arm will strengthen him!.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni zibigi ka saŋmarisi gba ni zaɣisi peebu.
en: The sun and the moon are darkened; the stars have ceased shining.

dag: O daa lan mali pipih anahi ka di ŋmani alimɔnd pum mini di bintira kɔtomsi ni tipuma kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: In addition, on the lampstand itself there were four cups shaped like almond blossoms, each with its flower and petals.

dag: N ni yirigi n zana pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni; amaa o nini ti ku nya li, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni asiba m-mal lala hal ti paai saha shɛl o ni daa zal li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin.
en: So the Lord sent a disease against Israel. It began in the morning and continued until the chosen time to stop. From Dan to Beersheba , people died.

dag: Di simdi ni yi lihi ti kaman Masia tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ o daashili yɛlimaŋa fukumsi niŋ shɛb nuu ni.
en: So a person should think about us this way—as servants of Christ and managers of Gods secrets.

dag: N ŋmaligi pola mmaŋa, n yɛligu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli; di bi taɣira. Sokam ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni ʒe ma yim.
en: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.

dag: Yi bindiri pala din daŋ niŋbu dabisili din nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi kapala tiri Yawɛ yi dakulɔdakulo churi puhibu ni la dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya yi tuun shɛli.
en: On the first day of the Harvest Festival, when you present the offering of new grain to the Lord , you are to gather for worship, and no work is to be done.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni dabiɛm mini ni sɔhibu.
en: Serve the Lord with fear and trembling.

dag: Bina anahi yɛla n-niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: There are four things that are too mysterious for me to understand:.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: Then he returned to the three disciples and found them asleep; and he said to Peter, How is it that you three were not able to keep watch with me for even one hour?.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bihi, wummiya n yɛligu ka di zaɣisiya n noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.

dag: A yi paai nimaani, nyin lihim bo Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la shee n-kpe nti bol o o tab sani n-zaŋ o kpe duu ashilɔni.
en: and when you get there look for Jehu, the son of Jehoshaphat and grandson of Nimshi. Take him to a private room away from his companions.

dag: Dama bɛ zo n-kpɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka niŋ yomyom ni bɛ ku niriba.
en: They run to do something evil, and they cannot wait to kill someone.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni n ni ti zaŋ n Shia Kasi niŋ daadam kam ni. Ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi nachimba ti nya ʒii; ka yi ninkura mi ti zahim zahima.
en: This is what I will do in the last days, God says: I will pour out my Spirit on everyone. Your sons and daughters will proclaim my message; your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ni bɛ boli ya karimbanima, dama karimba yino ka yi mali, ka yinim bɛn zaa kpalim nyɛla mabihi ni taba.
en: But none of you should be called a teacher. You have only one teacher, and all of you are like brothers and sisters.

dag: Ka Pita daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, N Duuma, bula ka m mabia lee yɛn tum ma taali ka n kul chɛri paŋd o? N chɛli paŋ o hal ti paai ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, Lord, if my brother keeps on sinning against me, how many times do I have to forgive him? Seven times.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, maliya suɣilo hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha. Kpahimmiya pukpara ni diri suɣilo n-guhir o puu atam din mali buchi hal ka saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa gba ti mi la.
en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, you must be patient as you wait for the coming of the Lord. Consider the farmer who waits patiently for the coming of rain in the fall and spring, looking forward to the precious fruit of the earth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, naa kumdimi ka fabindi Absalom zuɣu.
en: People told Joab what had happened, Look, the king is crying and mourning for Absalom.

dag: Dama m bi timd a la zuliya shɛb bɛn yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to sani, amaa n timd a la Izraɛlnim sani.
en: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.

dag: Duri pam be m Ba yiŋa. N chanimi ni n ti mali biɛhigu shee zali ya. Di yi di pa lala n naan ku yɛli ya di yɛla.
en: My Fathers house has room to spare. If that werent the case, would I have told you that Im going to prepare a place for you?.

dag: Bɛ bi niŋ yɛda ni bɛ ni lan yi zibisim ni yaha, bɛ nyɛla takɔbi ni yɛn ku shɛba.
en: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.

dag: N kuhimi ka n nina mɔhi, ka zibisim titali limsi n niŋkari.
en: My face is red from crying, and dark gloom hangs on my eyelids.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilo paɣi ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.

dag: Ka yi ti lan zaŋ lala binyɛra maa m-pahi piɛbil ŋun la zuɣu m-mali sara zaawuni kaman yi ni pun mali shɛm asiba la. Ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim, ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: With the second lamb offered at twilight, again include a grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning as a soothing smell, a gift offering for the LORD.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni n-tim ti gba ka Naawuni mali soli ti ti ka ti tɔɣisi o yɛligu n-kahigi Masia ashili yɛtɔɣa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m be sarika ni ŋɔ.
en: At the same time, pray for us also. Pray that God would open a door for the word so we can preach the secret plan of Christ—which is why Im in chains.

dag: A deei ti suhigu ka tiligi ti alahizibu tuun kara puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, binnamda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa zaŋ tabili bɛn be teeku ni katiŋ ha mali tahima la a sani.
en: God, you answer our prayers and do what is right. You do amazing things to save us. People all over the world know they can trust in you, even those who live across the sea.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga n-yo suhupiɛlli vuri paɣ o!.
en: Sing a new song to him. Play it well and sing it loud!.

dag: Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa nyɛla bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni. Hal n jɛmbu duu puuni n nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, The prophets and the priests are godless; I have caught them doing evil in the Temple itself.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn timmi boli kulipalinim pam na ka bɛ ti gbahi ba. Di nyaaŋa ka n lan tim boli tɔhinim pam na, ka bɛ ti bo bɛ shee zoli kam mini daboli kam zuɣu, ka yihi ba tampima voya ni na.
en: Im going to send hordes of fishermen to catch them, declares the LORD. Afterward I will send a party of hunters to hunt them down on every mountain, hill, and cave.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee paligi pam, ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-zo yomyom ni bɛ ti ti o nyaandoliba di lahibali.
en: The women were frightened and yet very happy, as they hurried from the tomb and ran to tell his disciples.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti nyɛla juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindira, ka so ti ku kari ba.
en: Then the bodies of the dead people will become food for the birds of the sky. Wild animals will eat the bodies of those people. There will be no one left alive to chase the birds or animals away.

dag: ka tiŋgbani ti damdi bɔb shɛŋa polo, ka kum mini alɔbo ti luri pam; ka binyara din kpɛhiri niriba dabiɛm ti beni, ka shihir kara ti wuhiri zuɣusaa.
en: There will be great earthquakes and wide-scale food shortages and epidemics. There will also be terrifying sights and great signs in the sky.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ mali suhu yini, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli so yini din ni chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura sahakam bɛmaŋmaŋ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu mini bɛ bihi bɛn yɛn doli bɛ nyaaŋa gba zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: I will give them a single purpose in life: to honor me for all time, for their own good and the good of their descendants.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-nyɛ: Jɛramiil mini Ram ni Kɛlubai.
en: Hezrons family, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

dag: O tiri bɛn gbarigi yaa, ka tiri bɛn ka yaa yiko.
en: He helps tired people be strong. He gives power to those without it.

dag: Nyin daadam, yɛlim a niriba maa, Wuntizɔriba yi birigi, bɛ wuntitali ku tooi tiligi ba. Ka ninvuɣ biɛri yi zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni, bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ku luhi ba. Ka wuntizɔriba yi kpe alahichi tumbu ni, bɛ ku tiligi.
en: Tell them that when good people start sinning, all the good they did in the past cannot save them from being punished. And remind them that when wicked people stop sinning, their past sins will be completely forgiven, and they won't be punished.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl zoya anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Son of man, speak to the mountains of Israel for me. Tell them to listen to the word of the Lord !.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti ka Damaskus na. Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa biɛra. Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Naawuni nir la be yaŋɔ.
en: Now Elisha had gone to Damascus when Arams King Ben-hadad became sick. The king was told, The man of God has come all this way.

dag: Lala ka bɛ yɛn ku yi gba m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni la zuɣu.
en: That is how the Egyptians will lie crushed among the uncircumcised who were killed in battle.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa lan kpuɣi daanya pam Bɛta mini Bɛrɔtai din daa nyɛ Hadadɛza ni su fɔntin shɛŋa la ni.
en: He also took a great quantity of bronze from Betah and Berothai, cities ruled by Hadadezer.

dag: Iso ni daa nya ka Yisahaku niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni ka chɛ ka o kuli Mɛsopoteemia ni o ti kpuɣi paɣ nimaani maa, ka lan baŋ ni o ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni maa o daa yɛl o mi, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Esau learned that his father Isaac blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram to find a wife there. He also learned that Isaac commanded Jacob not to marry a Canaanite woman.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ moli gili nyaandoliba maa ni ni nyaandol ŋɔ ŋun ku kpi; amaa Yisa daa bi yɛli Pita ni nyaandol maa ku kpi. O daa yɛl o mi, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti lan labina, di lee nya a ya.
en: So the rumor spread among the other disciples that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He simply said, What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti sɔɣi ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni o zuɣu salo maa ni: Shɛb daa yɛrimi, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ. Ka shɛb mi yɛra, Aai! O nyɛla ŋun birigiri niriba.
en: There was a large group of people there. Many of them were talking secretly to each other about Jesus. Some people said, He is a good man. But others said, No, he fools the people.

dag: Ka o ni daa kul tum tuun shɛlikam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni min o ni daa gbibi Naawuni zaligu shɛm ni o ni daa bo Naawuni shɛm, o daa niŋ li mi ni o suhu zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka o di nasara.
en: Everything that Hezekiah began to do for the service of Gods temple, whether by the Instruction or the commands, in order to seek his God, he did successfully and with all his heart.

dag: ni Ɛliaba ŋun daa nyɛ Shaalibɔn nir la ni Jashɛn bihi ni Jɔnatan.
en: Eliahba the Shaalbonite; the sons of Jashen; Jonathan.

dag: Ka Judanim maa ninvuɣ tusaata daa chaŋ Ɛtam tampiŋ lɔŋ maa ni ti bɔhi Samsin, A bi mi ni Filistianima n-su ti? Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti ŋɔ? Ka Samsin garigi yɛli ba, N niŋ ba la bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm labisi.
en: So three thousand people from Judah traveled down to the cave in the rock at Etam and said to Samson, Dont you realize that the Philistines rule over us? What have you done to us? But he told them, I did to them just what they did to me.

dag: Ti Duuma ni darig a tibili n-chɛ ka a zom, ka di ni niŋ daba ayi ka a ku lan nya wuntaŋa. Ka paɣili mini zibisim dii kana ti to o, ka o go m-bɔhindi gindi bɔri so ni o vo o.
en: Now the Lord will touch you and you will be blind. For a time you will not be able to see anything—not even the light from the sun. Then everything became dark for Elymas. He walked around lost. He was trying to find someone to lead him by the hand.

dag: Hal bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni tuma zuɣulaannim mini gomnanim ni kpambaliba ni bɛnkam zaa daa ʒe nam fukumsi zaashee daa sɔŋla Yɛhudianim maa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Mɔdɛkai.
en: And all the officials of the provinces, the satraps, the governors, and the kings administrators helped the Jews. All the leaders helped them because they were afraid of Mordecai.

dag: ni o ti kari sokam zaa saria, ka nya bɛnkam zaa bi luri Naawuni sizuura la taali, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi tuun biɛ shɛŋa mini bɛna bɛn nyɛ alahichinim maa ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa dalim ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus went to the town of Capernaum in Galilee and taught the people on the Sabbath.

dag: m-balind o yɛra, M bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi yɛn kpi. Kamina nti zaŋ a nuhi pa o zuɣu ka o kpaŋ n-lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: He begged Jesus again and again, saying, My little daughter is dying. Please come and lay your hands on her. Then she will be healed and will live.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Iso daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ɛdom zoya tiŋ ni. Iso ka bɛ lan booni Ɛdom la.
en: So Esau lived in the hill country of Edom.

dag: Ʒim la ni ti nyɛla shihirili din wuhiri yi ni be yi yiya shɛŋa ni. Ka n yi ti kuri Ijiptinim na ti paai ya ka nya ʒim maa, n ni kpahi yaɣ ya gari, ka yinim yi alɔbo maa ni.
en: The blood on the doorposts will be a sign to mark the houses in which you live. When I see the blood, I will pass over you and will not harm you when I punish the Egyptians.

dag: Din chɛ ka ti niŋ lala maa nyɛla, ti jɛmi ni yi yaansi ti bɔhi ti yaansi dahin shɛli ha, Yi mi nuu lee yi wula ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla ni?.
en: No! We did it because we were afraid that in the future your descendants would say to ours, What do you have to do with the Lord , the God of Israel?.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima ni.
en: Mizraim was the father of the people of Lud, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh.

dag: Amaa Naawuni shiri ni tooi be ninsalinim sani dunia ŋɔ ni? Dama zuɣusaa zaa ku tooi deeg a bɛ ti yɛri n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: But can you, O God, really live on earth among men and women? Not even all of heaven is large enough to hold you, so how can this Temple that I have built be large enough?.

dag: Ka Manaasa zuliya mini Ifriim zuliya ni ti lu tab zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti laɣim lu Juda zuliya zuɣu. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ku chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zan tariga. O na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: The people of Manasseh and the people of Ephraim attack each other, and together they attack Judah. Yet even so the Lord 's anger is not ended; his hand is still stretched out to punish.

dag: O daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun kul suhiri Naawuni sahakam, ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa zɔri Naawuni, ka o tiri nandaamba pina pam.
en: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.

dag: A mabihi maa, Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ni labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi ti labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka a gba min a bipuɣinsi zaa ni ti labi yi biɛri kurili ni.
en: When that day comes, you and Sodom and Samaria will once again be well-off, and all nearby villages will be restored.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa lan tɛhimi ni nyin naa yɛligu nyɛla din ni ti ma vuhim, dama nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika ŋun mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni be a sani.
en: I said to myself that your promise, sir, would make me safe, because the king is like God's angel and can distinguish good from evil. May the Lord your God be with you.

dag: ka a bɔri ni a nya n taali, ka vihiri ni a baŋ n daalahichi.
en: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?.

dag: Ziɔnnim ni ti yɛli, Naawuni bɔhimi Babilɔnnim biɛri ti niŋgbuna dari tɔhi ŋɔ zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛmnim ni ti yɛli, Naawuni bɔhimi Babilɔnnim biɛri ti ʒim yihibu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The people of Babylonia harmed some of us and killed others. Now, Lord , make them pay.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ man Naa Sulemaana ni, ka chɛ ka Dauda nam nya zaashee zani ŋun Yawɛ sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: However, may King Solomon be blessed and Davids throne be secure before the LORD forever.

dag: Ram daa nyɛla Aminadab ba, ka Aminadab daa nyɛ Nashɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Juda bidibisi ni asanza nir la ba.
en: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, tribal chief of the Judeans.

dag: Dama din yɛn niŋ ninsalinima, dina n-yɛn niŋ biŋkɔbiri gba. Ninsalinim kpirimi ka biŋkɔbiri gba kpira. Vuhim yini ka bɛ zaa mali. Ka ninsal bi so biŋkɔbigu. Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: After all, the same fate awaits human beings and animals alike. One dies just like the other. They are the same kind of creature. A human being is no better off than an animal, because life has no meaning for either.

dag: Zo kpima chɛ ka tulaale nyom niŋdila biɛribiɛri; lala ka jɛrilim biɛla saɣindi yɛm mini jilima.
en: A few dead flies in perfume make all of it stink, and a little foolishness outweighs a lot of wisdom.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi duɣu n-doori anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim titali n-doori salima shɛm, lala ka bɛ buɣisiri ninsal gba o paɣibu ni.
en: People use fire to purify gold and silver. In the same way, you are tested by the praise people give you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vooi li kpɛhi di puuni; ka bo mihi lo ŋarin titali maa gba kiŋkiŋ. Bɛ ni daa zɔri ni bɛ ti chaŋ ti firi Libia kulinol bihigu ni zuɣu ka bɛ daa sirigi tanti din sɔŋdi ŋariŋ maa ka di chanila lo tiŋli, ka pɔhim daa ʒiɛri ti chana.
en: They brought the lifeboat aboard, then began to wrap the ship with cables to hold it together. Fearing they might run aground on the sandbars of the Gulf of Syrtis, they lowered the anchor and let the ship be carried along.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o maani maligu tir o laŋ maa, ka zaŋdi pina tir o daasau maa, dama dina n-tir o azichi, ka chɛ ka o diri bindir viɛla.
en: Therefore, he sacrifices to his net; he burns incense to his fishing nets, because due to them his portion grows fat and his food becomes luxurious.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim suhuri je o niriba maa, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛmbimbiɛri soli n-nahim o daba maa.
en: So the Egyptians began to hate his people. They made plans against his servants.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa wuh o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, amaa man ni ʒili ya ʒi tibisa gari lala. M ba daa malila barazim saɣisiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi saɣisiri ya.
en: and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested. He said: My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal.

dag: Yawɛ, amaa a miri ma, ka a zaligunim zaa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi yuntisuɣu n-kpuɣi man a dab paɣ ŋɔ bia ŋun do m-baɣi maa nti sɔŋ o tooni, ka zaŋ o bi kpiŋ maa na nti sɔŋ n tooni saha shɛli n ni daa gbihira.
en: She got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I was asleep. She laid him on her chest and laid her dead son on mine.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee tiri kahiŋkɔɣu nimdi saha shɛli kum yi ti mal o bihi ka bɛ kumdi niŋdi man Naawuni, ka chani bɔri bindirigu?.
en: Who is it that feeds the ravens when they wander about hungry, when their young cry to me for food?.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa guui kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn tampiŋ la gbini nti kpalim be nimaani chira anahi.
en: Six hundred men turned back and fled toward the desert to the rock of Rimmon. They stayed at the rock of Rimmon for four months.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, Naawuni biɛhigu ni be o ni ka o nyɛ Naawuni bia maa zuɣu ka o ku tooi tum alahichi.
en: Those born from God dont practice sin because Gods DNA remains in them. They cant sin because they are born from God.

dag: Yɛhudianim kpeen so daa beni ka o yuli booni Nikɔdimus. O daa nyɛla Farisiinim ni yino.
en: There was a man named Nicodemus who was a Pharisee and a Jewish leader.

dag: ti kuli do so.
en: She leaves his house and ends up marrying someone else.

dag: Ŋuna n-yihiri teeku bulli puuni zibisim, ka chɛ ka neesim neeri zibisim titali ni.
en: He exposes even the darkest secrets. He sends light into places that are as dark as death.

dag: ka di yi ti bi, o dii piinila di chɛbu, di chɛbu saha ni paai zuɣu.
en: When the grain is ripe, the man starts cutting it with his sickle, because harvest time has come.

dag: Di simdi ka Izraɛlnim zaa dol li.
en: The whole community of Israel must celebrate this festival.

dag: N kuhi niŋ a m-bɔri sɔŋsim ka a bi garigi ma, ka n ʒiɛya ka a baɣa ka n ni.
en: God, I cry out to you for help, but you dont answer. I stand up and pray, but you dont pay attention to me.

dag: Ka o daa sabi yɛtɔɣ yinsi shɛŋa o ni daa tuui sab la pa kuɣ parilana maa zuɣu. Yɛtɔɣa maa n-nyɛ fukumsi zalikpana pia shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛli ya buɣim sunsuuni yi laɣiŋgu dal la, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ li ti ma.
en: Then the Lord wrote on those tablets the same words that he had written the first time, the Ten Commandments that he gave you when he spoke from the fire on the day you were gathered at the mountain. The Lord gave me the tablets.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Otiniɛl Kɛnaz bia maa daa kpi.
en: So the land was at peace for years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.

dag: mini Salima ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm ba la ni Harɛf ŋun mi daa nyɛ Bɛtigadɛr ba la.
en: Salma, the founder of Bethlehem, and Hareph, the founder of Beth Gader.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ ŋun maŋmaŋ nuzaa ni.
en: Then the priest will take some of the log of oil and pour it into his left palm.

dag: O ni ti lan chɛ ka yi ni daa zɔri Ijipti dɔr shɛŋa la zaa labina ti gbahi ya n-kul be yi ni.
en: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Hal n yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli, dama m mi n ni yi shɛl na, ka lan mi n ni chani shɛli, amaa yinim ʒi n ni yi shɛl na bee n ni chani shɛli.
en: No, Jesus answered, even though I do testify on my own behalf, what I say is true, because I know where I came from and where I am going. You do not know where I came from or where I am going.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni; ka shɛb mi ŋahiri mɔɣu ni tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: Many people spread their coats on the road for Jesus. Others cut branches in the fields and spread the branches on the road.

dag: Yaɣimɛr ka yiko ni o zaŋ yaɣ kpil yini me duɣ shɛli din ni ku buchi zama ni, ka lan zaŋ li me duɣ shɛli din ku yi zama ni?.
en: After all, the man who makes the pots has the right to use the clay as he wishes, and to make two pots from the same lump of clay, one for special occasions and the other for ordinary use.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira nyɛla din gbarigiri nira, amaa yɛtɔɣ viɛlli nyɛla din kpaŋsiri nira.
en: Worry can rob you of happiness, but kind words will cheer you up.

dag: ni Ira ni Garɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Jatir niriba la.
en: Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite;.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛsta Mɔdɛkai ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Hathach went back and told Esther everything Mordecai had said.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, chamiya ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛlimuɣisir shɛli ŋɔ. Bɛ tiŋ maa ka dunɔdaya bee dunokparitisi. Di ʒiɛla di ko.
en: You have no city walls and no neighbors to help, yet you think you're safe— so I told him to attack.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Manaasa min o niriba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: Although the Lord warned Manasseh and his people, they refused to listen.

dag: Zaadali Ninivenim gba ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama Anabi Jona ni daa yihi ba waazu la, bɛ daa niŋ tuuba; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Anabi Jona be kpe.
en: On the Judgment Day the people of Nineveh will stand up and accuse you, because they turned from their sins when they heard Jonah preach; and I assure you that there is something here greater than Jonah!.

dag: Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, zuliya shɛba bee na so n-kani ka n dan naa bi tim nimaani nti bɔ a; ka bɛ yi yɛli ni a kani, faashee ka dilan chɛ ka lala zuliya maa nim po ni bɛ shiri bi nya a.
en: As surely as the Lord your God lives, the king has been looking for you everywhere. He has sent people to every country to find you. He even made the rulers of those countries swear that you were not there.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa tim ba maa bɛ daa chaŋla Sɛlusia nti yi ni kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus teeku kom ni do n-gili tiŋgban shɛl la.
en: Barnabas and Saul were sent out by the Holy Spirit. They went to the city of Seleucia. Then they sailed from there to the island of Cyprus.

dag: Sintani ni daa zahim Yisa zahimbu balibu kam ŋɔ zaa naai ka o daa na chɛ o, ka lan bɔri so shɛli yaha.
en: After finishing every temptation, the devil departed from him until the next opportunity.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N chɛ ka biisim ku yi bindira, ka chɛ ka toli saɣim yi puri mini yi tihi puri ni yi fiig tihi ni yi olivi tihi, di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I made your crops die from heat and disease. I destroyed your gardens and your vineyards. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive trees. But you still didnt come to me for help. This is what the Lord said.

dag: A yi di niŋ din simdi, n naan ku deei li? Ka a yi bi niŋ din simdi, alahichi do a dunol ni m-bɔri ni di nyaŋ a, amaa di niŋ kamaata ni a nyaŋ li.
en: If you do the right thing, wont you be accepted? But if you dont do the right thing, sin will be waiting at the door ready to strike! It will entice you, but you must rule over it.

dag: Filistianim ni daa ti wum ni Dauda ka bɛ zaŋ leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka bɛ zaa daa yi n-gbaai Dauda shee bɔbu, amaa ka Dauda daa wum di yɛla ka chaŋ ti be birini la ni.
en: When the Philistines heard that the Israelites had anointed David to be the king of Israel, all the Philistines went up to kill him. David heard about this and went down into the fort at Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu yɛli, Fom a noli ka wara! Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa bɛ sunsuuni, ka chaŋ ka chɛ o, ka bi ti o daŋa.
en: Silence! Jesus said, speaking harshly to the demon. Come out of him! The demon threw the man down before them, then came out of him without harming him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa yi bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la n-tum alahichi, ka di taali maa ʒi bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: If it is the whole community of Israel that sins and becomes guilty of breaking one of the Lord 's commands without intending to.

dag: Nyama, a wuhi niriba pam, ka kpaŋsi bɛn nuhi ka yaa.
en: Job, you have taught many people. You encouraged those who were ready to quit.

dag: Amaa n ni kpalim be Ɛfɛsus hal ti paai Pɛntikɔst dali;.
en: I will stay here in Ephesus until the day of Pentecost.
