dag: Amaa ka Farisiinim daa yɛli ni alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But the Pharisees said, The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ŋunkam chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi n-tum alahichi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni ka kom di o, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!.

dag: Yisa daa bi be kaman o wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka naɣ yɛlila Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda.
en: But Jesus did not care what the men said. He said to the synagogue leader, Dont be afraid; just believe.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yɛda niriba bɛn dir o nuu ni nti yɛn luh o; ka o tɔbbihi ti wurim, ka bɛ ku bɛ ni pam mi.
en: People who were supposed to be good friends of the southern king will try to destroy him. His army will be defeated. Many of his soldiers will be killed in battle.

dag: Amaa o yidana yi wum pɔri maa yɛla ka bi yɛl o shɛli dabisili din paya dali, dindina di wuhiya ni o saɣ o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o niŋ shɛli maa, o ni daa wum di yɛla saha shɛli ka bi yɛl o shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: But if, by the day after he hears of the vow, he has raised no objection, she must do everything that she has vowed or promised. He has affirmed the vow by not objecting on the day he heard of it.

dag: Ka Jɛfita lan bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Yi yi zaŋ ma kuli ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka n nyaŋ ba, yi ni saɣi ka n leei yi zuɣulana.
en: And Jephthah said to Gileads elders, If you bring me back to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gives them over to me, I alone will be your leader.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛl o mi, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yɛlim Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa n ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa.
en: he said, I am the Lord . Tell the king of Egypt everything I tell you.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchinima; din kul ka buchi mi din ka buchinima! Di zaa shiri ka buchi.
en: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka yi yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: John the Baptist came, and he fasted and drank no wine, and you said, He has a demon in him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣil o lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: But Jesus said: Leave her alone! Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing for me.

dag: Tumo maa daa yɛlila Dauda, Ti dimnim maa daa gari ti la yaa ka yina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti polo ni, amaa ka ti daa lan daai ba labisi bɛ tiŋ maa dunɔdal ni.
en: The men overpowered us, the messenger told David. They came out against us in the open field, but we fought against them up to the entrance of the city gate.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin dumiya zoli ŋɔ n-ka n sanna nti zani kpaŋ jɛm ma.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and of Israel's leaders. They must worship me at a distance.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai tinsi maa ni nti zaŋ Yisa tuumba maa mini Jɛrusalɛm cheechi kpamba ni daa tɔɣisi gbaai yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la wuhi ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: As Paul and his companions traveled through the cities, they instructed Gentile believers to keep the regulations put in place by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem.

dag: Shɛm zuliya mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ tiŋgbana ni bɛ zuliyazuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the people from the family of Shem. They are arranged by families, languages, countries, and nations.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa lan yɛli, Molimiya Baal jɛmbu dabisili molo. Ka bɛ daa moli di molo maa.
en: Jehu said, Prepare a holy meeting for Baal. So the priests announced the meeting.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim sani mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli malaika so ŋun daa be bɛ san la ni daa tɔɣis o mini ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli gbin la. Nimaani ka ŋun Anabi Musa daa deei Naawuni yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ nyɛvili yɛtɔɣa la ti ti.
en: This is the one who was in the assembly in the wilderness with our ancestors and with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai. He is the one who received life-giving words to give to us.

dag: Ka Daadam Bia ti kana, ka o mini niriba laɣindi diri ka nyura ka bɛ yɛra, Nyama, ŋun kpiri kum pam, ka lan nyɛ danyura mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim zo. Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la di tumtumsa ni.
en: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and people say, Look at him! He eats too much and drinks too much wine. Hes a friend of tax collectors and other sinners. But wisdom is shown to be right by what it does.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli; dama o noli ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam ba.
en: Let all of these praise the LORDs name because God gave the command and they were created!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi yi ti boli ma n-suhi ma, n ni wum yi suhigu maa.
en: When you call me and come and pray to me, I will listen to you.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yi bihi zaa bɛn be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni so yi ti mali daɣiri ka miri binyɛr kasi shɛŋa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ ti man Yawɛ la, n ni yihi dilana n sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Say to them: If any descendant of yours should ever come near the holy things that the Israelites have dedicated to the LORD while he is in an unclean state, he will be cut off from before me; I am the LORD.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la, dina n-nyɛ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋla tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya ni di leei yi vuhim shee.
en: Remember how the Lord 's servant Moses told you that the Lord your God would give you this land on the east side of the Jordan as your home.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ gɔhi n-wuɣi zuɣupiligu zaŋ pili Yisa, ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: The soldiers made a crown out of thorny branches and put it on his head; then they put a purple robe on him.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya bee kuriti tum tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ piligim tuma maa, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: whether in gold, silver, bronze, or iron. So get to work, and may the LORD be with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, Naawuni malaikanim gba malila suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: In the same way, I tell you, joy breaks out in the presence of Gods angels over one sinner who changes both heart and life.

dag: Yawɛ, a mi binshɛɣukam, teemi n yɛla, ka sɔŋ ma, ka bɔhi bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ŋɔ biɛri ti ma. Di di suɣilo hal ka bɛ ti di n nyɛvili. Baŋmi ni a zuɣu ka bɛ turi ma maa.
en: You understand, LORD! Remember me and act on my behalf. Bring judgment on those who torment me. In your mercy, spare my life. Consider how Im insulted on your account.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni shɛb daa shihila kpima, ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa dindali maa. Bɛna n-daa ka Musa mini Aduna sanna dindali maa.
en: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord , and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa pun bela Naawuni sani piligu ni ha.
en: He was there with God in the beginning.

dag: Di zaŋya bɛ ni ja biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmahim biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni chahi biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai biŋkɔb so lana m-mali sara ti Yawɛ bee m-mali sara yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: You must not offer to the LORD anything with bruised, crushed, torn, or cut-off testicles. You must not do that in your land.

dag: Musa daa lan zali niriba maa zaligu dindali maa yɛli:.
en: That same day Moses commanded the people.

dag: M biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nyaaŋa zaŋ lab wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka yi mali dapaɣa ayɔbu niŋ li.
en: For the back of the Tent on the west, make six frames.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa nti kɔŋ gom dindali maa yuŋ. O daa bi di shɛli bee n-saɣi ka so ŋme biŋkumdi shɛli n-niŋ o.
en: Then the king returned to the palace and spent a sleepless night, without food or any form of entertainment.

dag: Naawuni nyari jilima o ni sɔɣiri yɛla zuɣu; amaa nanim bɛn nyari jilima la bɛ ni vihiri yɛla n-yihiri li palo ni zuɣu.
en: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.

dag: Hɛzirɔn bia Kalɛb min o paɣiba Azuba ni Jɛriɔt daa dɔɣi bihi. O bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛshɛr mini Shɔbab ni Aridɔn.
en: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan po pɔri tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ni wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: So I made another vow in the desert. I vowed that I would scatter them all over the world.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini nam shɛŋa din niriba bi jɛmd a la zuɣu.
en: Pour out your wrath on the nations who dont know you, on the kingdoms that havent called on your name.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam n-niŋ nam maa ni la yuun pisinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili; ka o bia Nadab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam ruled twenty-two years and he lay down with his ancestors. His son Nadab succeeded him as king.

dag: Amaa niriba pam bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti leei nyaannima, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima.
en: Many people who have the highest place now will have the lowest place in the future. And the people who have the lowest place now will have the highest place then.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa kul o ba Yisahaku sani Mamri bee Kiriatariba luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Hiburɔn ka di nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni daa be shɛl la.
en: Jacob went to his father Isaac at Mamre, near Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had lived.

dag: Zaŋmiya jilima din simdi Yawɛ yuli ti o. Zaŋmiya pina tah o sanna, Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni tibiginsim din be kasi.
en: Give to the LORD the glory due his name! Bring gifts! Enter his presence! Bow down to the LORD in his holy splendor!.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-nyaŋ Kiriatisɛfanim ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣipini.
en: Caleb said, I will give Achsah my daughter in marriage to whoever strikes Kiriath-sepher and captures it.

dag: O daa bi niŋ bɛ sani n-gari biɛɣ pia bee biɛr anii, ka yiɣisi lab Siizaria. N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o chaŋ ti ʒin o sariadibo ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pool na.
en: Festus spent another eight or ten days with them and then went to Caesarea. On the next day he sat down in the judgment court and ordered Paul to be brought in.

dag: Yawɛ Yɛliya, Tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni ti kpalim dabari, amaa n ti ku saɣim di zaa.
en: The LORD proclaims: The whole earth will become a desolation, but I will not destroy it completely.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa tim tuumba Jɛsi sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋm a dapala Dauda ŋun guli piɛri la ti ma na.
en: So Saul sent messengers to Jesse to say, Send me your son David, the one who takes care of the sheep.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli ka bi chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The Lord made the king stubborn, and he would not let them go.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu hal ti tarigi; amaa m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: I am worn out, Lord , waiting for you to save me; I place my trust in your word.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Mahili mini Mushi ni Jaazia n-daa nyɛ kpamba Mɛrari daŋ ni.
en: Merari was the father of Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal di saha n ti ku kpihim yi birili zaa.
en: Yet even in those days, declares the LORD, I wont completely destroy you.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bee yi bi nya li? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: He responded, Do you see all these things? I assure that no stone will be left on another. Everything will be demolished.

dag: Ŋun Naa Dauda daa daŋ nya Masia kum ni neebu ka tɔɣisi di yɛla yɛli: O ti ku kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee o niŋgbuŋ ti pooi. .
en: David knew this before it happened. That is why he said this about that future king: He was not left in the place of death. His body did not rot in the grave. David was talking about the Messiah rising from death.

dag: n yi yɛli gballi, M ba n-nyɛ a, ka yɛli zunzuli, M ma n-nyɛ a, bee, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a.
en: I will call the grave my father, and the worms that eat me I will call my mother and my sisters.

dag: ni Ira ni Garɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Jatir niriba la.
en: Ira from Ither; Gaeb from Ither.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa lan yɛl o ba, Bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suh a. Dina n-nyɛ: chɛl ma ka n niŋ chira ayi pahi, ka n chɛ ka m mini n tab du zoya zuɣu n-fabili n ni yɛn kpi ni m paɣipiɛlital ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But first, please let me spend two months, wandering in the hill country with my friends. We will cry together, because I can never get married and have children.

dag: Ka ʒiri mi ka bɛ ni so nol ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka galimi hal baabiɛla.
en: They never tell lies, and they are innocent.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi anabinim yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka bɛ nya ʒiinim pam. Mani n-daa chɛ ka anabinim maa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha.
en: I spoke to the prophets and gave them many visions, and through the prophets I gave my people warnings.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni sokam ʒi omaŋmaŋ ʒili.
en: You must each accept the responsibilities that are yours.

dag: N ni zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ bɛ ni, ka niŋ ba din viɛla, ka ti lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zani, ka ku lan daai ba luhi. N ni zaŋ ba sa, ka ku lan sibigi ba.
en: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.

dag: Ka Sool daa baŋ Dauda kukoli maa ka bɔh o, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Dauda garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n kukoli m-bala.
en: Saul recognized David's voice and asked, David, is that you, my son? Yes, Your Majesty, David answered.

dag: Ka ti mi yi yihi yɛli ni ti bi tum alahichi, dindina ti zaŋ Naawuni leela ʒirilana, ka o yɛligu ka ti ni.
en: If we claim, We have never sinned, we make him a liar and his word is not in us.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla Naawuni yɛla, amaa man kul nyɛla ŋun mali ninsalitali biɛhigu ka nyɛ alahichi dabili.
en: We know that the Law is spiritual, but Im made of flesh and blood, and Im sold as a slave to sin.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi zo, ka o yiŋ nim zaa daa yiɣisi dol o. Naa daa naɣ chɛla o mamanim pia niŋ nayili maa puuni ni bɛ maani li.
en: David left behind ten of his wives to take care of the palace, but the rest of his family and his officials and soldiers went with him. They stopped at the last house at the edge of the city.

dag: Zuɣusaa, gbilisim tibili wum ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani wum n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Earth and sky, hear my words, listen closely to what I say.

dag: Hal mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa kul kumdimi n-niŋd a, kulibɔna ni koma zaa ni nyuui, ka buɣim di mɔɣu ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: Wild animals also need your help. The streams are dry—there is no water! Fire has changed our green fields into a desert.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Gɛrishom mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levis family: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi ti niŋ pali, di mi nyɛla din ni niŋ pali, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi daa be bɛ ni.
en: Soon they will be punished, just as you warned, and they will know that a prophet has been among them.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, M Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni bi sa ti shɛlikam ni vuɣi lu.
en: Jesus answered, Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.

dag: Buni mini jilima zaa yirila a sanna, nyini n-su binshɛɣukam zaa. A nuu ni ka yiko ni kpiɔŋ be, ka a zaŋ a nuu maa namdi wɔɣira, ka tiri sokam yaa.
en: You are the source of wealth and honor, and you rule over all. In your hand are strength and might, and it is in your power to magnify and strengthen all.

dag: Harim daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni pinaayopɔin.
en: the descendants of Harim:.

dag: O tab ni daa nya lala maa ka di niŋ ba yoli, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli naa doo maa ŋun ni niŋ shɛm.
en: All the other servants saw what happened. They felt very sorry for the man. So they went and told their master everything that happened.

dag: Pɛrɛz daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi ni pisopɔinayika. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: All of the family of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled courageous people.

dag: Daadam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be Izraɛl tiŋgban shɛŋa din bahi yoli la puuni na kul yɛrimi, Ibrahimma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yino, amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o ni o su. Amaa tinim galisiya, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ zaŋla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti ni ti su li.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in the ruined cities of Israel are saying, Abraham was just one man, and the Lord gave him this whole land of Israel. There are many of us, and so this land must be ours.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ŋariŋ maa tumtumdiba ka bɛ zaa yinoyino gbaai bɛ wuna kabu, ka kpuɣiri ŋarin titali maa ni nɛma bahiri kom ni ni di chɛ ka ŋarin titali maa tibisim filim. Amaa ka Jona ŋun daa kpɛla ŋarin titali maa puuni ha nti doya gbihira.
en: The sailors were terrified and cried out for help, each one to his own god. Then, in order to lessen the danger, they threw the cargo overboard. Meanwhile, Jonah had gone below and was lying in the ship's hold, sound asleep.

dag: m-pahi fɔn shɛŋa mini tiŋkpan shɛŋa din daa be Manaasa min o zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ daa lee zaŋ li n-ti Ifriim min o zuliya niriba maa la.
en: It included cities set apart for the people of Ephraim within the legacy of the people of Manasseh, all the cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyar maa, daŋmi n tooni chaŋ daboli ŋɔ zuɣu, dama zuŋɔ m min a ni laɣim di bindirigu, ka n sa yɛl a din be a zuɣu ni biɛɣuni asiba ka chɛ ka a kuli.
en: Samuel answered, I am the seer. Go on up ahead of me to the place for worship. You and your servant will eat with me today. I will let you go home tomorrow morning. I will answer all your questions.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi ka n sanna, yi daa bi je ma mi ka kari ma yi ya.
en: Isaac said to him, Why have you come after me? You resented me and sent me away from you.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Dinzuɣu a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela neesim ni;.
en: The eyes are like a lamp for the body. If your eyes are sound, your whole body will be full of light;.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti lan labina nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N daa timna ti yɛl a ni a zaŋ a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣiba ni a bihi ti ma na.
en: The messengers came back again: This is what Ben-hadad says: I sent you the message: Give me your silver and gold, your wives and your sons.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ ŋuni maa yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka a bia nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ! Ka paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni maa yɛli, Aai! A bia n-nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, ka m bia nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ! Lala ka bɛ daa yɛri naa maa tooni.
en: The other woman said, No! My son is alive! Your son is the dead one. But the first woman objected, No! Your son is dead! My son is alive! In this way they argued back and forth in front of the king.

dag: Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nimaani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyɔbu. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn kpalim nyaaŋa doli gbilligbilli ni bɛ tuuta.
en: All those enlisted in the camp of Dan are . They will march last under their banners.

dag: Ka ti daa yi Taai m-be kom maa ni m-mali ti paai Tolɛmais n-daa chaŋ ti puhi ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani, ka gbe bɛ sani dahin yini.
en: We continued our voyage, sailing from Tyre to Ptolemais, where we greeted the believers and stayed with them for a day.

dag: zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi paag a, ka alɔbo shɛli mi ku tooi mir a yiŋ na.
en: and so no disaster will strike you, no violence will come near your home.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti chana, di yuma ayi nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses in the Meeting Tent. This was in the desert of Sinai. It was on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites left Egypt. He said to Moses:.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun pah ayi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka Amazia bia Uzia daa di Juda nam.
en: In the twenty-seventh year of the reign of King Jeroboam II of Israel, Uzziah son of Amaziah became king of Judah.

dag: Kɔbulli yɛliya, Di ka n ni, ka teeku yɛli, Di ka n sani.
en: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *.

dag: Amaa m bi lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ shɛli, man dee yi ni tooi naai tuun shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni ti ma la; dina n-nyɛ ni m moli Naawuni daalibarika lahibal suŋ hal ti paai n nyɛvili tariga.
en: But I reckon my own life to be worth nothing to me; I only want to complete my mission and finish the work that the Lord Jesus gave me to do, which is to declare the Good News about the grace of God.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya n-daa pah ayi n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa bela Juda zuliya tiŋgban ni.
en: Then Joshua gave all the families in the tribe of Simeon their share of the land. The land they got was inside the area that belonged to Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔhi tɔto shɛli maa ti ba naai, n ni doli yi yi sanna gari chaŋ Speen.
en: So then after I have finished this job and have safely delivered the final amount of the Gentiles offering to them, I will leave for Spain, visiting you on the way.

dag: Bɛ daa mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli o muɣisigu maa ni. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli o zuliya yɛla? Dama bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He was humiliated, and justice was denied him. No one will be able to tell about his descendants, because his life on earth has come to an end.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din pahir anahi ni ka bɛ ni ti lab kpe na, dama Amɔrinim tuumbiɛri na bi galisi yaɣi.
en: It will be four generations before your descendants come back here, because I will not drive out the Amorites until they become so wicked that they must be punished.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam po sara maligu bimbini pola di mini binshɛɣukam din pa di zuɣu.
en: So then, when a person swears by the altar, he is swearing by it and by all the gifts on it;.

dag: N daa loya ni n yi ka yi sanna, n ku zaŋ yɛli shɛli yɛla wuhi ya n-naɣ pahila Masia min o dapulli zuɣu kpahibu la yɛla.
en: For while I was with you, I made up my mind to forget everything except Jesus Christ and especially his death on the cross.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli, N dana, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili. Ka lan yɛli, N dana, mani n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun daa ʒe a tooni kpe n-suhiri Yawɛ la.
en: Excuse me, sir! Hannah said. As surely as you live, sir, I am the woman who stood here next to you, praying to the LORD.

dag: Ka Musa daa lo alikauli dindali maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli a ni ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim maa zuɣu, a napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ ni ti leeg a min a bihi ni yɛn su shɛli sahakam.
en: So that day Moses made a promise to me. He said, The land where you went will become your land. Your children will own that land forever. I will give you that land because you really believed in the Lord , my God.

dag: dama dindali maa ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya, ka yihi ya daɣiri ni; yi ni ti yi yi daalahichi zaa daɣiri ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: Because on this day, the priest will do this to make you pure and wash away your sins. Then you will be clean to the Lord .

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisiya, di nyɛla sanʒiɛ biɛɣu din ʒiɛri gariti ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣuri zuɣu.
en: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa niŋ wɔɣirili, dama o daa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa soli.
en: Jotham remained faithful to the Lord his God and became a very powerful king.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa mali nti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani ni o nya di bahigu.
en: Peter followed him from a distance until he came to the high priests courtyard. He entered that area and sat outside with the officers to see how it would turn out.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa nya bɛ ni chani maa m-baŋ ba, ka yi tinsi ni zo bɛ naba zuɣu daŋ ba bɛ ni daa chani luɣ shɛli maa paabu.
en: But many people saw them leave and knew who they were. So people from every town ran to the place where they were going and got there before Jesus.

dag: Jɛra n-wuhiri bɛ suhuyiɣisili yomyom, amaa yɛnnim baɣa ka turi ni.
en: When a fool is annoyed, he quickly lets it be known. Smart people will ignore an insult.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la Yawɛ nam ʒiishee, ka zuliya kam zaa ti laɣim ka Yawɛ tooni na Jɛrusalɛm maa, ka bɛ ti ku lan niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ maŋmaŋ suhuyubu din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Kulim ni suhudoo. Naaman ni daa chaŋ, o daa na bi paai shɛli.
en: Then Elisha said to Naaman, Go in peace. So Naaman left Elisha and went a short way.

dag: M bela n dimnim bɛn be kaman gbuɣima bɛn ŋubiri ninsalinim la sunsuuni. Bɛ nyina ŋmanila kpana mini piɛma; ka bɛ zilima mi ŋmani takɔbiri din diri pam.
en: My life is in the middle of a pack of lions. I lie down among those who devour humans. Their teeth are spears and arrows; their tongues are sharpened swords.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piri tɔbbihi maa ʒii buta zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Jɔab su yim zuɣu, ka Abishai Zɛruya bia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab tizo la su yim zuɣu, ka Itai Gaat nir la mi daa su bɛn kpalim la. Ka naa daa yɛli niriba maa, Mmaŋmaŋ gba ni yina pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ.
en: David sent out the army—a third under Joabs command, a third under the command of Abishai, Zeruiahs son, and a third under the command of Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, I will march out with you myself.

dag: Bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn nyari tibidarigibo ni biɛrim bɛ bindoo zuɣu, ka kul nyari biɛrim bɛ kɔba ni.
en: Or a person may be disciplined by pain while in bed, bones ever aching.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu ka lihi nya Ishimail zuliya sochandiba, ka bɛ yi Giliad n-taɣiri bɛ laakumnim bɛn ʒiri taansuri mini kpam ni mɛɛr, bɛ ni zaŋdi shɛŋa maani tima kuni Ijipti.
en: As Joseph's brothers sat down to eat, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with all kinds of spices that they were taking to Egypt.

dag: Di pa shɛli ti yi niŋ lala, Naawuni ni taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa polo; ka ku o suhuyiɣisili maa; ka chɛ ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: Perhaps God will change his mind; perhaps he will stop being angry, and we will not die.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Aduna, Wula ka niriba maa lee niŋ a, ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ.
en: Moses asked Aaron, What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi nyaɣa kpe o ni m-ba n-zani kaman tia la. Ka me yimaŋ tam o zuɣu, ka ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga yi yɛda niŋbu puuni kaman bɛ ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la. Ka chɛliya ka wumpaɣibo pali yi suhuri hal nti puuri bahira.
en: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Batishiiba daa chaŋ naa sani o dudoonigu ni. Di saha maa naa daa kurigiya pam, ka Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣ la m-be o sani gbib o.
en: So Bathsheba went in to see the king in his bedroom. The king was very old. Abishag, the girl from Shunem, was caring for him there.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni fa ninvuɣ kura maa ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa nuu ni bahi, ka zaŋ o labisi o ni daa pun be tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka bɛ ni daa booi kpam din be kasi bahi maligumaaniba zuɣulaan so zuɣu ni ti kpi.
en: The community will protect the killer from the hand of the close relative and return him to the refuge city where he fled. He will live there until the death of the high priest who was anointed with holy oil.

dag: Naftali zuliya ni, Ɛnan bia Ahira n-yɛn sɔŋ ya.
en: from the tribe of Naphtali—Ahira son of Enan.

dag: Chɛliya ma vuri ka n yɛli, ka chɛ ka din yɛn niŋ ma niŋ ma.
en: Be quiet and let me talk! I accept whatever happens to me.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, wummi dimbɔŋɔ, zanimi tɛhi Naawuni daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: Job, stop for a minute and listen. Think about the wonderful things God does.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa gbaai bubil polli kɔrigi m-bo chi pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti pa sara maligu tampiŋ bimbini zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma ŋɔ.
en: So Manoah took a young goat and some grain, and offered them on the rock altar to the Lord who works wonders.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni bunsi, ka zaŋ binshɛlikam zaa din be tiŋ maa puuni mini din be mɔɣu ni.
en: They took sheep, goats, donkeys, and everything else that was in the town or the countryside.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ yɛda; dama Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: Isaiah explains why they couldnt believe.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya bɛ mini Bɛnjamin, o daa yɛlila o yiŋ tumtumda, Zaŋm niriba maa kuli yiŋa, ka gbaai biŋkɔbigu kɔrigi m-mal o duɣi bindirigu, dama m mini niriba maa n-yɛn laɣim di wuntaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the servant in charge of his house, Take these men to my house. They are going to eat with me at noon, so kill an animal and prepare it.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti kpe ŋariŋ ni ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du teeku ŋɔ duli ha. Ka bɛ dii gbaai chandi.
en: One day Jesus and his disciples boarded a boat. He said to them, Lets cross over to the other side of the lake. So they set sail.

dag: Yinim dee yi ti deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din sab zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ, ka ŋmaligi labi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: and because you will be obeying the LORD your Gods voice, keeping his commandments and his regulations that are written in this Instruction scroll, and because you will have returned to the LORD your God with all your heart and all your being.

dag: Di lihi ʒiɛm ma, n ni sabigi maa zuɣu. Wuntaŋa n-kpe ma ka n sabigi maa. N tizɔdɔbba jɛla suli niŋ ma; bɛ chɛ ka n gulila wain tihi puu, ka kɔŋ dahima maani mmaŋa.
en: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Malimiya soli ti n niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ labi n sanna. Vuɣimiya tigbirigu kam din be bɛ soli zuɣu.
en: Clear the road! Clear the road! Make the way clear for my people!.

dag: bɛ ni yɛn yo ti sam shɛli nyɛla bɛ kana ni bɛ ti kari ti a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ni ti su maa ni.
en: here they are, returning the favor by coming to drive us out of your possession that you gave to us!.

dag: bee n-niŋdi shiriku bee n-nyɛ dɔdihira bee kpilikparisilana.
en: Dont let anyone try to put magic spells on other people. Dont let any of your people become a medium or a wizard. And no one should try to talk with someone who has died.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Naawuni daa pola pɔri zal li.
en: And this was not done without a solemn pledge! The others have become priests without a solemn pledge.

dag: dunɔdaya ata. Rubin zuliya dunɔdali mini Juda zuliya dunɔdali ni Lɛvi zuliya dunɔdali. Bɛ ti yɛn zaŋla Izraɛl zuliya maa yuya boli tiŋ maa dunɔdaya.
en: The gates of the city go by the names of the tribes of Israel. There are three gates on the north side: one gate for Reuben, one gate for Judah, and one gate for Levi.

dag: N daa zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ baŋsim bɔbu ni ni m bo n-nya yɛm mini binyara pam, ka m baŋ ni ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla jɛrilim, ka jɛrilim nyɛ yinyari.
en: But I devoted myself to knowledge and study; I was determined to find wisdom and the answers to my questions, and to learn how wicked and foolish stupidity is.

dag: Bumbɔni nyɛla asiba bɛ zaa sani, dama bɛ nyɛla bumbɔni mini dabiɛm zɔnima.
en: The darkest night is their morning. They are friends with the terrors of darkness.

dag: N yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa ku nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: If I tell people about myself, they cannot be sure that what I say is true.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla shihirili ni shɛhira Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ yi ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ niriba bɛn nahindi ba la, o ni tim ŋun ni fa ba bahi bɛ sani ka o ti fa ba bahi.
en: This will be a sign to show that the Lord All-Powerful does amazing things. Any time the people cry for help from the Lord , he will send help. He will send someone to save and defend the people—to rescue the people from those who hurt them.

dag: Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ pahi asiba sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la zuɣu.
en: You will offer these in addition to the entirely burned offering of the morning, which is the regular entirely burned offering.

dag: O daa kul lu n-gbala o tooni ka yɛli, N dana, chɛ ka taali ŋɔ ʒi n kɔŋko zuɣu. N suhir a mi, gbilisim tibili wum mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: Abigail fell at his feet and said, Sir, please let me talk to you. Listen to what I say. Blame me for what happened.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di nyɛ lala yinim sani; amaa chɛliya ka ŋun nyɛ yi zaa kpɛma lee zaŋ omaŋa zalila bia zaani, ka yi zaa zuɣulana zaŋ omaŋa leei ŋun tumdi bia tuma yi zaa ha sani.
en: But thats not the way it will be with you. Instead, the greatest among you must become like a person of lower status and the leader like a servant.

dag: Amaa niriba maa galisiya pam ka saa mi miri pampam, ka ti ku tooi ʒe palo ŋɔ ni lala. Di mi pala dahin yini bee daba ayi tuuni n-nyɛ li, dama ti pam n-tum birigi yɛlli maa ni.
en: But they added, The crowd is too big, and it's raining hard. We can't stand here in the open like this. This isn't something that can be done in one or two days, because so many of us are involved in this sin.

dag: N kpamd a jaande ni a kul kpalimmi be Ɛfɛsus kaman n ni daa gariti chani Masidɔnia ka yɛl a shɛm la, ka di chɛ ka a kpahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhiri ʒiri wuhibu la zuɣu ni ka bɛ chɛ li.
en: When I went to Macedonia, I asked you to stay in Ephesus. Some people there are teaching things that are not true, and I want you to tell them to stop.

dag: Ka kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛl o, Di garig o shɛli bee n-saɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: All of the elders and the people said to him, Dont obey and dont give in.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ salima da li, ka nir ku tooi zaŋ anzinfa buɣisi di daa.
en: It cant be bought with gold; its price cant be measured in silver.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ŋubi nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din be piɛɣu puuni la Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili ŋɔ dunol ni.
en: Then Aaron and his sons must eat the meat at the front door of the Meeting Tent. And they must also eat the bread that is in the basket.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi kaman o ni daa kpi shɛm, dindina ti shiri ni pah o zuɣu neei kum ni kaman o ni daa neei kum ni shɛm la.
en: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmahi abie tihi wula din mali vari n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli ka kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Izraɛlnim Naa ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika.
en: So they took branches of palm trees and went out to meet him, shouting, Praise God! God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord! God bless the King of Israel.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: at the age of twenty, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. He did not follow the good example of his ancestor King David; instead, he did what was not pleasing to the Lord his God.

dag: A zaligu din yi a nol ni na nyɛla bin viɛlli n sani gari salima mini anzinfa kpila tusa shɛm.
en: The law that you gave means more to me than all the money in the world.

dag: Ŋun Naa Dauda daa daŋ nya Masia kum ni neebu ka tɔɣisi di yɛla yɛli: O ti ku kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee o niŋgbuŋ ti pooi. .
en: David saw what God was going to do in the future, and so he spoke about the resurrection of the Messiah when he said, He was not abandoned in the world of the dead; his body did not rot in the grave.

dag: A ni mali sida dari pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a nyɛ naa maa? A ba daa pala ŋun diri ka nyura, ka niŋdi din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli? Dinzuɣu ka shɛlikam daa niŋ viɛnyɛla o sani.
en: Does it make you a better king if you build houses of cedar, finer than those of others? Your father enjoyed a full life. He was always just and fair, and he prospered in everything he did.

dag: Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛligu zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda pahi.
en: Many more believed because of his word.

dag: Dindali maa niriba ni ti yi Asiria zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tinsi ni n-ka yi sanna, ka shɛb mi yi Ijipti zaŋ hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni na, ka shɛb yi teeku shɛl ni zaŋ ti kpa teeku shɛl ni na, ka shɛb mi yi zo shɛli gbini zaŋ ti kpa zo shɛli gbini na.
en: On that day, they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, from Egypt to the River, from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tum tuun shɛli dindali, dama di nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Do no work on that day, because it is the day for performing the ritual to take away sin.

dag: Dunɔguliba: Akub mini Talimɔn ni bɛ taba bɛn daa guli dunoya la zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: Akkub, Talmon, and their relatives, in all.

dag: Ka n daa kpahim yɛlli maa nti baŋ ni di pala Naawuni n-wuh o ni o yɛli lala, amaa ka daa baŋ ni Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat n-daa ti o liɣiri m-puh o ni o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me.

dag: amaa Yawɛ suhu daa yuri yi yaannim ka pii yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ŋɔ zuliya kam sunsuuni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.

dag: Di kul nyɛla zaɣ palli asiba kam. A ʒiɛyimtali galisiya.
en: They are renewed every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli din be nuzaa polo katiŋ ha la du pam ka viɛla; di nyɛla na titali tiŋa din tiri dunianim zaa suhupiɛlli.
en: His city is such a pleasant place. It brings joy to people from around the world. Mount Zion is the true mountain of God. It is the city of the great King.

dag: nti zaŋ Izraɛlnim ni daa zaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma maa ti ba. Ka niriba maa daa na kul zaŋdi pina na ni bɛ suhuyubu asiba kam nti tir o.
en: Moses gave them all the gift offerings that the Israelites had contributed to the work on the sanctuary. They kept bringing him spontaneous gifts, morning after morning.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa mini ʒii ŋɔ yɛla zaa kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Nathan told David exactly what he had heard in the vision.

dag: Lala zuɣu bindir shɛli dibu yi nyɛla din ni luhi m mabia, dindina n kul ku ŋubi nimdi ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mabia lu.
en: This is why, if food causes the downfall of my brother or sister, I wont eat meat ever again, or else I may cause my brother or sister to fall.

dag: O ti ku kuhi bee n-duh o yee bee n-chɛ ka so wum o kukoli damli solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: He will not cry out or shout or try to make himself heard in the streets.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni, o daa gbahila ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pihitanaayi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, he took people from Jerusalem.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ɛdom zoli zani dabari bahi yoli. Ka n chɛ ka bɛn zaa daa yi kanna ka chana ku lan kana.
en: I will turn Mount Seir into a desolate wasteland, when I cut off from it both passerby and homecomer.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ lala. Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni daa chaŋ maa nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ mi ʒee maa lo n-tabil o takɔro maa.
en: She said, These things will happen just like you said. She sent them away and they went off. Then she tied the red cord in the window.

dag: Bɛ daa sɔɣila Abinɛr Hiburɔn, ka naa daa yaag o noli kum pam Abinɛr gballi maa gbini, ka niriba maa zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: Abner was buried in Hebron, while David and everyone else stood at the tomb and cried loudly.

dag: Ka a daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa m bela a sani n-nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a. N ni chɛ ka a yuli du kaman dunia ŋɔ ni wɔɣira yuya ni daa du shɛm la.
en: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.

dag: Kum doli ti takɔriti ni kpe na. Di kpe ti nanim yinsi ni di ku bihi solɔri zuɣu ka ku nachimba mi zama laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Death has come in through our windows and entered our palaces; it has cut down the children in the streets and the young men in the marketplaces.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti zaɣisi nyin Yawɛ ka jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashitarɔt. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ fam ti ti dimnim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi, ka ti jɛmd a.
en: Then your ancestors cried out to the LORD and said: We have sinned because we have abandoned the LORD and have worshipped the Baals and the Astartes. But now deliver us from the power of our enemies, and we will worship you.

dag: O dunɔdaya firi tiŋgban ni. Naawuni kabisi o dunokparita n-saɣim li. O naa mini nabihi bela tinzunnim sani. So bi lan wuhiri ba Naawuni yɛla, ka o daanabinim bi lan nyari ʒii Yawɛ sani.
en: Zions gates sank into the ground; he broke and shattered her bars; her king and her officials are now among the nations. There is no Instruction! Even her prophets couldnt find a vision from the LORD.

dag: Anabi Ilaisha saha la kɔnsi pam daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa bɛ so daa bi nya tibbu; Siria do so ŋun yuli daa booni Neeman la kɔŋko n-daa nya tibbu.
en: And there were many people suffering from a dreaded skin disease who lived in Israel during the time of the prophet Elisha; yet not one of them was healed, but only Naaman the Syrian.

dag: Di saha yi neesim ni neei kaman biɛkaali neesim la, ka yi nya alaafee yomyom, ka ŋun yɛn zabi yi zuɣu ni be yi tooni; ka Yawɛ jilima ni nyɛ yi gula m-be yi nyaaŋa polo.
en: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.

dag: N daa tɛhila n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kpɛhi m bihi ni shɛm, ka tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli. Tiŋgban shɛli din viɛli gari dunia tiŋgbana zaa. Ka n daa tɛhi ni yi ni boli ma yi ba ka ku zo ka chɛ ma dolibu.
en: The Lord says, Israel, I wanted to accept you as my child and give you a delightful land, the most beautiful land in all the world. I wanted you to call me father and never again turn away from me.

dag: Dan zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Jɔgili bia Buki.
en: from the tribe of Dan—Bukki son of Jogli;.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi bɛ zuɣu, ka ti Duuma jilima neesim neei gil ba ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam.
en: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone over them. They were terribly afraid.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-sa tihi balibu kam, di wala ni ti nyɛla din dibu chihiri yi sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din chihiri dibu yi sani hal ni yuma ata, ka di bi simdi ni yi di li.
en: In the future, when you enter your country, you will plant many kinds of trees for food. After planting a tree, you must wait three years before you can use any of the fruit from that tree. You must not use that fruit.

dag: di bahi bamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre daɣiri tuma soli ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu la. Karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ nyɛla suhukpeendaannima ni bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa. Bɛ bi zɔri ni bɛ tu bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la, amaa ka naɣ lee ʒiɛmdi ba mi.
en: especially those who follow their filthy bodily lusts and despise God's authority. These false teachers are bold and arrogant, and show no respect for the glorious beings above; instead, they insult them.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka bɛ daa lee baptaizi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu ka ti daa deei.
en: Paul asked them, So what kind of baptism did you have? They said, It was the baptism that John taught.

dag: Ka n yi ti lan ka yi sanna yaha, yi ni mali daliri din ni chɛ ka yi maan paɣi Yisa Masia n ni lab yi sanna maa zuɣu.
en: so that when I am with you again, you will have even more reason to be proud of me in your life in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti ni mali tahima shɛli yɛda la kirikiri ka di viini ginda, dama ŋun lo ti alikauli maa nyɛla ŋun kul ʒe yim.
en: Let us hold on firmly to the hope we profess, because we can trust God to keep his promise.

dag: Mɔabnim dula bɛ buɣa zoya, ka chaŋ ti kpe bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri ni n-fabili niŋ ba je, ka di bi sɔŋ ba.
en: Even if Moab presents himself, and Moab wears himself out going to the shrine, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, he wont prevail.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ zaa ha daa gbaai bɛ daliri ni nyɛ shɛm wuhibu. Ŋun daŋ tooni daa yɛlila tumo maa, N dala puu, ka yɛn chaŋ ti nya li, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: One by one, they all began to make excuses. The first one told him, I bought a farm and must go and see it. Please excuse me.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa lola alikauli din ka lɔrigibu n-zaŋ nam ti Dauda min o bidibisi ni bɛ su Izraɛlnim ʒiɛmani kam ni?.
en: Surely you know that the LORD, Israels God, made an unbreakable covenant with David and his descendants that they would rule Israel forever.

dag: Wuna maa ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋa. Bɛ gbahi ba kaman daba la chaŋ. Babilɔn wuna maa bahigu m-bala!.
en: But they all bowed down and fell to the ground. They couldnt escape; they were all carried away like prisoners.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti taai duŋ niŋ a n-zaɣis a noli; ka daa lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa bir a fukumsi zaligu la. Bɛ daa ku a daanabinim shɛb bɛn kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ lab a sanna la. Bɛ daa mo a pam.
en: But your people rebelled and disobeyed you; they turned their backs on your Law. They killed the prophets who warned them, who told them to turn back to you. They insulted you time after time.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ŋmaŋkɔhiriba la mi, Zaŋmiya yi binyara yi! Di zaŋya m Ba duu leei daa.
en: Then he said to those who were selling pigeons, Take these things out of here! Dont make my Fathers house a place for buying and selling.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li; ka daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa ni di naa ni di fɔndi ni niriba zaa. Bɛ daa bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino gba kpalim. Bɛ ni daa niŋ Ɛgilɔnnim shɛm la, lala ka bɛ daa saɣim Hiburɔn, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be di ni.
en: They captured the city and all the small towns near Hebron. The Israelites killed everyone in the city, just as they did to Eglon. No one was left alive there. They destroyed the city and killed all the people in it as an offering to the Lord.

dag: O wuɣir omaŋmaŋ garo bimpara. O situra nyɛla tampiɛl viɛlli mini tan ʒiɛkpeein.
en: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.

dag: Yawɛ, tibimi ma, ka n kpaŋ, tiligim ma, ka n tiligi, dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni paɣiri so.
en: Heal me, LORD, and Ill be healed. Save me and Ill be saved, for you are my hearts desire.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa niŋ yomyom kpe o tanti suɣili ni Zara sani nti yɛl o, Toom a zim viɛlli la lita pisinaayi ŋ-ŋɔri li mali maha yomyom.
en: Abraham hurried into the tent and said to Sarah, Quick, take a sack of your best flour, and bake some bread.

dag: Tiŋgbani dina, bindirigu n-yiri di ni na, amaa tiŋgbani puuni din ŋmanila buɣim din diri binyara.
en: Earth—from it comes food— is turned over below ground as by fire.

dag: O daa me n-gili Bɛtilihɛm mini Ɛtam ni Tɛkɔa.
en: He repaired the cities of Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa.

dag: Yi Duuma lan yɛli yaha, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnima dabisi shɛŋa din kanna ni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ tɛha ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni; ka n ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi ti nyɛ n niriba.
en: This is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says the Lord. I will place my laws in their minds, and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people. .

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ tooni ha ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, Sit here while I go over there and pray.

dag: O ni daa ti nya o, ka o zaŋ o lab Antiɔk. Ka bɛ daa be nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba sani yuun muni zaa n-wuhiri niriba pam Naawuni yɛligu. Antiɔk maa ka bɛ daa tuui boli Yisa nyaandoliba Kristiɛnnima.
en: When he found him, he took him to Antioch, and for a whole year the two met with the people of the church and taught a large group. It was at Antioch that the believers were first called Christians.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Anɛr mini Biliam ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti Kɔhat ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim la mi.
en: And from West Manasseh they received Aner and Bileam, together with their pastureland.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Yawɛ, ninsal yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu ti Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: You might promise to give an animal to the Lord. If it is a clean animal—one that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord —then the animal you bring will become holy.

dag: Ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihiri ba, ka tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛn ti o la shɛli.
en: He looked at them; he thought they would give him some money.

dag: N ni kari toli ka chɛn ya, ka bɛ ku lan saɣim yi puri ni bindira, ka yi puri ni wain tihi ku lan kɔŋ wala walibu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.

dag: Sagbana mini zibisim zaa gil o mi; wuntitali mini zaligu soli n-nyɛ o nam ʒiishee tanzaa.
en: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.

dag: Hal Balak yi zaŋ o yiŋ anzinfa mini salima zaa ti ma gba, n ku tooi niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n di niŋ shɛli; n ku tooi niŋ zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu mmaŋmaŋ yubu ni. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛli, dina ka n gba yɛra. .
en: Even if Balak gives me his most beautiful house filled with silver and gold, I can still say only what the Lord commands me to say. I cannot do anything myself, good or bad. I must say what the Lord commands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba na nti zali jintɔriba maa tooni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa gbaai ba vihibu ka yɛli ba.
en: They brought the apostles in, made them stand before the Council, and the High Priest questioned them.

dag: M ma, mbusim be n zuɣu a ni daa dɔɣi ma zuɣu. Tiŋ maa nim zaa kul mali ma la naŋgbankpeeni mini zabili. N na ʒi n-dihi so samli bee n-di so samli, amaa bɛ zaa kul turi ma mi.
en: I wish I had never been born! I have become a source of conflict and dissension in my own country. Even though I havent lent or borrowed, still everyone curses me.

dag: Nyama, n niriba ni ti yi katiŋa nuzaa polo mini wulinluhili polo ni Asiwan din be nudirigu polo la na.
en: My people will come from far away, from the north and the west, and from Aswan in the south.

dag: Abigeel ni daa ti kul nya Dauda, o dii sheela o buŋ maa zuɣu na yom lu n-gbani Dauda tooni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Just then Abigail arrived. When she saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and bowed down with her face to the ground in front of him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla o yiko yaɣ shɛli polo, ka ti ni wumd o yɛla shɛm pɔra pam. Amaa o yiko din galisi ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li.
en: Look, these are only the outer fringe of his ways; we hear only a whispered word about him. Who can understand his thunderous power?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka so daa ti niŋdi amiliya Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la. Yisa ma daa be amiliya maa ni.
en: Two days later there was a wedding in the town of Cana in Galilee, and Jesus mother was there.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: Those who heard this said, Then who can be saved.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Haman, To, zaŋm kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa yomyom chaŋ ti niŋ Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nira ka ʒi nayili dunol ni la lala. Niŋm o a ni kul wuhi shɛm maa zaa, ka di chɛ ka shɛli pooi.
en: Then the king said to Haman, Hurry and get the robes and the horse, and provide these honors for Mordecai the Jew. Do everything for him that you have suggested. You will find him sitting at the entrance of the palace.

dag: Jɛhu daa dila Izraɛl nam maa ʒini Samaria yuun pihitaayika.
en: Jehu had ruled over Israel for twenty-eight years in Samaria.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na nti zaŋ li mali kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: He brought the burnt offering and offered it, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka lala ka yi shiri yuri yi mabihi zaa bɛn be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa; amaa ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: In fact, you are doing loving deeds for all the brothers and sisters throughout Macedonia. Now we encourage you, brothers and sisters, to do so even more.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binyar shɛŋa sɔŋ gbilligbilli maa polo.
en: The king spoke to the priests and the Levites about these gifts.

dag: bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: You could never pay enough to buy back your life.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n daa sabi gbaŋ la tin ya ni m buɣisi ya nya yi deeri noli binshɛɣukam ni.
en: This is why I wrote to you. I wanted to test you and see if you obey in everything.

dag: Nir yi niŋ yomyom yɛli, N zaŋ bini yaakaza ti Naawuni, ka naanyi ti piligi tɛhir o ni po pɔri shɛli maa yɛla, di ni leei tɔŋ gbaag o.
en: It is a snare to say rashly, It is holy, and only reflect after making the promise.

dag: Ziɔnnima, Maliya suhupiɛlli pam! Yinim Jɛrusalɛmnima, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu! Nyamiya, Yi naa kani yi sanna! O nyaŋmi ka di nasara n-kanna maa, amaa o nyɛla siɣisimaŋlana, ka bari buŋa ŋun nyɛ buŋ polli.
en: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni pa bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛb Naawuni daalikauli lɔbu puuni n-naɣ nyɛ o bi maŋa;.
en: That means it isnt the natural children who are Gods children, but it is the children from the promise who are counted as descendants.

dag: Amaa doo yi chirigi paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti doo mɔɣu ni n-gbaag o goli, dindina do so ŋun gol o maa kɔŋko ka bɛ ni ku.
en: But if a man finds an engaged girl out in the field and forces her to have sexual relations with him, only the man must die.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni zali shɛli ŋɔ yi ti yiɣisi n sani, dindina Izraɛl zuliya gba ku lan nyɛla zuliya n sani sahakam.
en: The descendants of Israel will never stop being a nation. That would happen only if I lost control of the sun, moon, stars, and sea.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-wuhiri yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli: Di pala tinima n-daa yuri Naawuni, amaa ŋuna n-daa yuri ti ka tim o Bia na ni o ti leei sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi.
en: This is what love is: it is not that we have loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the means by which our sins are forgiven.

dag: O yirimina kaman tipum la, ka lan kpi, o vuurila yomyom kaman shilinshia la, o bi yuura.
en: Like a flower, we bloom, then wither, flee like a shadow, and dont last. .

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Yɛhudianim to jina n-naai noli ni bɛ suh a ka a sa zaŋ Pool tahi jintɔriba sanna biɛɣu ni, ka di be kaman bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: The young man said, Some Jews have decided to ask you to bring Paul down to their council meeting tomorrow. They want you to think that they plan to ask Paul more questions.

dag: Ɛlizafan bidibisi ni, Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi pah o zuɣu.
en: Shemaiah, the leader of Elizaphans family, and of his relatives.

dag: ni Kɔra ni Gatam ni Amalɛk. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ɛlifaz bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Ada yaansi.
en: Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, and Chief Amalek. These are the tribal chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; they are Adahs sons.

dag: N zaŋ ya tahi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bindira pam ni ni yi ti di di tiwala mini di bin viɛla. Amaa ka yi ni kpe di ni yi saɣimla n tiŋgbani maa, ka zaŋ m pini maa leei zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni pala din yi ti Ba Naawuni sanna, amaa di nyɛla din yi dunia ŋɔ ni na. Dina n-nyɛ: Niŋgbuŋ kɔre mini nini kɔre ni barinyubo dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: Everything that belongs to the world—what the sinful self desires, what people see and want, and everything in this world that people are so proud of—none of this comes from the Father; it all comes from the world.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n noli paɣi Yawɛ pam; n ni paɣ o salo sunsuuni.
en: I will give loud thanks to the Lord ; I will praise him in the assembly of the people.

dag: Ka m biɛrimaŋtali tuma ni ti yi palo a yi ti kana ni a ti nya n yɔri maa dahin shɛli. Ka bu shɛb mini piɛbihi shɛb bɛn bi liɣisiliɣisi ka mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ sabila yi ti be m biŋkɔbiri ni, di wuhiya ni n zu ba mi maa.
en: In the future you can easily see if I am honest. You can come to look at my flocks. If I have any goat that isnt spotted or any sheep that isnt black, you will know that I stole it.

dag: o yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka bi niŋdi nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka bi zaŋdi o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tuma ni, ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli m-maani niriba bɛn zabi yɛtɔɣa.
en: and doesn't charge interest when lending money. He refuses to do anything evil; he is fair to everyone.

dag: So be yi ni m-biɛra? O bolimi cheechi toondaannima, ka bɛ ti zaŋ kpam ʒe o ti Duuma yuli zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni ti o.
en: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.

dag: ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: I saw seven fat, healthy cows come up out of the river, and they began feeding on the grass.

dag: Yi biɛhigu ni ti nyɛla biɛhiŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka dabiɛm mali ya ka yi nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: Your life will always be in danger. Day and night you will be filled with terror, and you will live in constant fear of death.

dag: N ni lan yɛli yaha, so di tɛhi ni n nyɛla jɛrigu, ka yi yi tɛhi lala, yin shiri lihimiya ma kaman jɛrigu din ni chɛ ka n gba tooi nyu bara biɛla.
en: I repeat: no one should think that I am a fool. But if you do, at least accept me as a fool, just so I will have a little to boast of.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan bindoo maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches such a bed must wash their clothes, bathe in water, and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Yɛl tibisili fukumsi n-ʒi n zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa polo: Bɛn mi biɛhigu soli mini bɛn ʒi biɛhigu soli ni bɛn mi gbaŋ mini bɛn ʒi gbaŋ.
en: For I have an obligation to all peoples, to the civilized and to the savage, to the educated and to the ignorant.

dag: Niɣi mi bɛ lana, ka bunsi mi bɛ lan ni dihiri ba luɣ shɛli. Amaa Izraɛlnim bi mi lala, n niriba maa bi baŋ.
en: An ox knows its owner, and a donkey its masters feeding trough. But Israel doesnt know; my people dont behave intelligently.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, N ni chaŋ ti liri tiŋgbɔn shɛli nim bɛn bi me goma gili bɛ tiŋkpansi ŋɔ. N ni chaŋ ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim ni suhudoo, ka bɛ zaa so bi me goma gili bɛ tinsi, ka mi ka dunokparita bee dunoyɔriti ŋɔ.
en: You will decide to invade a helpless country where the people live in peace and security in unwalled towns that have no defenses.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi nyeei, so ku tooi lih o, ka pɔhim yi ʒe sagbana chaŋ ka chɛ o, o kul nyaɣisirimi.
en: A person cannot look at the sun. It is too bright as it shines in the sky after the wind blows the clouds away.

dag: Ka chɛliya ka ti chɛ ka ti biɛhigu be dɛde kaman bɛn be neesim ni, ka pa ni bɛn tumdi yoliyoli bee n-nyuri dam kuuna. Ti miri ka ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma mini zina balibu kam. Ti mi miri ka ti bɔri zabili bee n-zabiri nyuli.
en: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.

dag: Been shɛli daa be Jɛrusalɛm n-do m-miri duno shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Piɛri Dunol la. Hiburuli ni bɛ booni biaŋ maa la Bɛtizata, ka lunfanima anu daa be nimaani.
en: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan yih a wahala ni n-zaŋ a tahi palo ni be luɣ shɛli ka muɣisigu kani, ka nim kpaba daa pali a ŋman ni.
en: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa bɔhi Napaɣ Ɛsta, Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee buɣisi lala niŋbu maa? Ya ka lala nir maa lee be.
en: King Ahasuerus said to Queen Esther, Who is this person, and where is he? Who would dare do such a thing.

dag: Dama niriba lala tatabo bi doli ti Duuma Yisa Masia, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre ka bɛ doli, ka mali yɛtɔɣ suma mini naŋgbammalisim yɔhindi bɛn tɛha bi zilima.
en: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yi bɛ manim puya ni na ni nuzaŋa shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni ni nuzaŋa. Bɛ ti ku ʒi bɛ tuma binshɛli bɛ nuu ni yi.
en: People come into the world with nothing. And when they die, they leave with nothing. They might work hard to get things, but they cannot take anything with them when they die.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga jilima zaa naaya. O nanim ŋmanila bambu dibisi bɛn bi nyari mɔri. Bɛ bela bɛn kariti ba tooni n-zɔri ka yaa kani.
en: The beauty of Daughter Zion has gone away. Her princes were like deer that cannot find a meadow to feed in. They walk away without strength from those who chased them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: Jesus said to them, Watch out and be on your guard for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: N dɔɣiriba mini n zɔnim zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: My relatives have left me. My friends have forgotten me.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-nyɛ bɛ zuɣupila, amaa jɛrilim n-nyɛ jɛra dolibi.
en: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a tim ma na?.
en: Then Moses prayed to the Lord and said, Lord, why have you done this terrible thing to your people? Why did you send me here?.

dag: Di gbihi bee m-pɔb a nini.
en: Don't let yourself go to sleep or even stop to rest.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Itiɔpia kirisolait la buɣisi li, ka nir mi ku tooi zaŋ salima alali buɣisi li.
en: The topaz from Ethiopia cannot match its value, which is greater than the purest gold.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka n lan ka tahima yaha.
en: They pay me back evil for good, leaving me stricken with grief.

dag: N ni darigi bɛn be Ijipti maa tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili ka chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: I punished Jerusalem with war, hunger, and disease, and that's how I will punish you.

dag: N ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla maa, ka n teei ʒini gbaai kumsi. Dabisi gbaliŋ ka n daa zaŋ fabili ka lo noli n-suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: When I heard all this, I sat down and wept. For several days I mourned and did not eat. I prayed to God.

dag: Pirigimiya bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa na maa ʒiibuyi n-zaŋ yim ti tɔbbihi bɛn chaŋ tɔbu ni maa, ka zaŋ yim la mi ti Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: Then divide these things between the soldiers who went to war and the rest of the Israelites.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ku yi Kalidianim maa nuu ni; amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag o ti Babilɔn Naa, ka o min o nina pali taba, ka bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa garigi taba.
en: King Zedekiah will be captured and taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who will speak with him face to face.

dag: dama anabitali yɛtɔɣa daa bi yirila ninsal suhu yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi n-daa be ninsalinim ni n-chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa yir o sanna maa.
en: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.

dag: Di saha maa ka nyuli daa gbaai Yawɛ o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu, ka o zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu.
en: Then the LORD became passionate about this land, and had pity on his people.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ni o bɔri shɛli ka di shiri niŋ, ka di pala ti Duuma n-zal li?.
en: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.

dag: Di saha ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma!.
en: So I called on the LORDs name: LORD, please save me.

dag: O nyɛla tampiŋ ŋun ka ŋmali. O tuma nyɛla din viɛl zaa, ka o soya zaa nyɛ din tuhi. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ka ka galimi. O nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi ka be tibi.
en: The Lord is your mighty defender, perfect and just in all his ways; Your God is faithful and true; he does what is right and fair.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di daanya kurupooti la ni di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni di tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar for entirely burned offerings with its copper grate, its poles, and all its equipment, the washbasin with its stand.

dag: N daa lan lo ba alikauli ni n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba, bɛ ni daa nyɛ saamba be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la.
en: I made an agreement with them. I promised to give them the land of Canaan. They lived in that land, but it was not their own.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o paɣiba ni o kpambaliba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon as a prisoner. He also took the kings mother, his wives, officers, and the leading men of the land. He took them from Jerusalem to Babylon as prisoners.

dag: Zalim ba dimbɔŋɔ lala, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku mali galimi.
en: Give them these instructions, so that no one will find fault with them.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa goli palli dali, ka piɛbimi li goli maa yi ti niŋ goli muni ni ti chuɣu puhibu dali.
en: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti gari, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsi ma Mariama ni Salomi daa da tulaale viɛlli ni bɛ chaŋ siliga maa ni ti mihi Yisa.
en: The next day after the Sabbath day, Mary Magdalene, Salome, and Mary the mother of James bought some sweet-smelling spices to put on Jesus body.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbihi bee niɣi mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ luɣ shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la.
en: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa, wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani? Dama yi yɛri ni Biilzibul yiko ni ka n kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: If Satan is at war with himself, how will his kingdom endure? I ask this because you say that I throw out demons by the authority of Beelzebul.

dag: a yi be kasi ka a biɛhigu be tibi zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni ka a sanna nti labisi din simd a ti a.
en: If you are pure and good, he will quickly come to help you. He will give your family back to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba maa mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋa ni bɛ kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest.

dag: Bɛ daa piripirila taba, ka zuliya ŋɔ tuhiri zuliya ŋɔ, ka tiŋ ŋɔ nim mi tuhiri tiŋ ŋɔ nima, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka suhugarigu balibu kam ŋɔ paai ba.
en: One nation oppressed another nation, and one city oppressed another city, because God was bringing trouble and distress on them.

dag: N ni wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni.
en: and I will scatter the Egyptians all over the world.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋma ti shɛŋa yi ni mi ka di bi wandi wala. Yi ni tooi ŋma li n-zaŋ li mali bindura tabili tiŋ maa gooni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi kpe di ni ti nyaŋ ba.
en: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool ka o lu n-teei dɔni tiŋa, Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zuɣu. O daa lan ka yaa, dama o daa bi di binshɛli dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa.
en: At once, Saul collapsed and lay stretched out on the floor, terrified at what Samuel had said. He was weak because he had not eaten anything since the day before.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa du Galili Teeku maa duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus and his disciples arrived on the other side of Lake Galilee, in the territory of Gerasa.

dag: Hazɔr ni ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam, ka yɔbahi ti gɔri di ni. So ti ku lan be nimaani bee ka so ti lan ʒini di ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Hazor will be made a desert forever, a place where only jackals live. No one will ever live there again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daantalisi sa zɔŋ, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka kazala din mali daantalisi daa be di tooni, ka pateesa yili di tooni.
en: Pillar Hall was meters long and . meters wide. A covered porch supported by pillars went all the way across the front of the hall.

dag: Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla tiŋŋmara ni ninvuɣ tuɣinda Yɛhudianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka lan nyɛ bɛ ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb Nazarinim la adiini soli toondana.
en: We have found this man to be a troublemaker who stirs up riots among all the Jews throughout the empire. Hes a ringleader of the Nazarene faction.

dag: O ni daa yaɣindi li maa ka shɛŋa lu sol zuɣu, ka noonsi kana nti gahim li di.
en: As he scattered the seed in the field, some of it fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ kura maa yi ti chaŋ yaɣi o ni zo n-kuli tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa tiŋgbani tariga.
en: But if you ever leave the Safe Town.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ yi ti puhina, bɛ zɔrimi ti kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: When the sun rises, they leave and go back to their dens to rest.

dag: ka n yi suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam, n kul suhirimi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: and every time I pray for you all, I pray with joy.

dag: Niŋm yomyom zo nti kpe di ni, dama ka pa ni a paala nimaani, ti ku tooi niŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Zɔa.
en: But run there quickly. I cannot destroy Sodom until you are safely in that town.

dag: Yawɛ, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, n sɔŋda, kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ma.
en: Don't stay far away, Lord ! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Kpihimmi ti daalahichi zaa, ka deei ti tuun shɛŋa din viɛla, ka ti paɣir a kaman di ni simdi ni ti paɣir a shɛm.
en: Return to the Lord and say, Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.

dag: Bɛ yaannim ninni ka o daa tum alahiziba tuma Zɔan bɔpiɛligu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.

dag: Dama Judanima, yi wuna kul galisimi kaman yi fɔntinsi ni galisi shɛm, ka yi sara maligu bimbin shɛŋa yi ni me n-zali m maani maligu tiri Baal ka di nyɛ vi la mi galisi kaman Jɛrusalɛm pala ni galisi shɛm.
en: The people of Judah have as many gods as they have cities, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem have set up as many altars for sacrifices to that disgusting god Baal as there are streets in the city.

dag: Bɛ kpaai ma mi bahi kaman kom la, ka n kɔbituɣa zaa miligimiligi; ka n suhu be kaman kpam din nyɛligi la n nyɔɣu ni.
en: My strength is gone, like water poured out on the ground. My bones have separated. My courage is gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ Yisifu yiŋ tumtumda maa sani yili maa dunol ni.
en: They approached the man who was Josephs household manager and spoke to him at the houses entrance.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Zaŋm a kabɔɣili ŋɔ palo ŋɔ ti ma ka m me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, kɔhimi li ti ma kaman di daa ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ miligi ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: David said, Would you sell me your threshing place, so I can build an altar on it to the Lord ? Then this disease will stop killing the people. I'm willing to pay whatever you say it's worth.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb yi niŋdi din wuhiri ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni ka di nyɛla daliri suŋ zuɣu, din nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli sahakam, din dee yi pala n yi ti be yi sani kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o mi zuɣu nyɛ Shamma Agee ŋun daa nyɛ Hara nir la bia. Filistianim daa ti laɣim tab lo tɔb Lɛhi luɣ shɛli tuya balibu pam ni daa be la, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa.
en: Next was Shammah the son of Agee the Hararite. One time the Philistines brought their army together to destroy a crop of peas growing in a field near Lehi. The rest of Israel's soldiers ran away from the Philistines.

dag: dama bɛn nyuri dam kuuna mini pulaannim ni leei faranima; ka bɛ gɔ gbihibo nyɛ din ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ gbinfini.
en: because drunks and gluttons will be impoverished; their stupor will clothe them in rags.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, Judanim ni ti chaŋ ti pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka bɛ laɣim taba n-yi nuzaa polo tiŋgban ni n-ka n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yaannim ni bɛ su li la ni na.
en: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri n-nya chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi, yuri mi tuhi pinaayi. Ka o daa zaŋ shɛb ti niŋ chɛchɛbunsi tinsi ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be o sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Solomon started gathering horses and chariots for his army. He had chariots and , horse soldiers. He kept them in the chariot cities and in Jerusalem where he lived.

dag: O daa wurim bɛ ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu ka wurim bɛ fɔntinsi. O daa yi ŋum, dabiɛm gbaarila sokam zaa bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He destroyed fortresses and ruined towns; his mighty roar terrified everyone.

dag: O pun baai du mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti gbe Gɛba; ka dabiɛm gbaai Ramanima; ka Sool ya Gibianim yi n-zo.
en: They crossed at the pass: Well camp at Geba! Ramah trembles; Gibeah of Saul has fled.

dag: Dama wuhibu din viɛla ka n zaŋ tiri ya maa, miriya ka yi zaɣisi n wuhibu.
en: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.

dag: Yi ni chani bɔri mamanim maa, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! Lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi wuhi paɣ yoya yi soya.
en: So skilled are you at pursuing lovers that you instruct even the most wicked.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihiri laɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la saha shɛli ka maligumaana Hilikia daa nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ni o ti o niriba la kundi.
en: The Levites brought out the money that was in the Lord s Temple. At that time Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the Lord that was given through Moses.

dag: Teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi ni salima alali firila tamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛli zuɣu.
en: the table and everything on it; the pure gold lampstand and everything used with it; the altar for burning incense;.

dag: N wumla n yura kukoli. Nyama, o yila zoya zuɣu zɔrina. O zɔrimi duri kunkuna kani n sanna.
en: I hear my lovers voice. Here it comes, jumping over the mountains, skipping over the hills.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ Reechɛl niŋ o paɣa, ka yur o gari Liya; ka daa lan tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti Leeban.
en: So Jacob had sexual relations with Rachel also. And Jacob loved Rachel more than Leah. Jacob worked for Laban for another seven years.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Tiŋ Kasi la ni nti du n-tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha.
en: Next, the devil took Jesus into the holy city to the highest part of the temple.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Ŋuna m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Aai, o ŋman o mi. Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛli ba, Mani m-bala.
en: Some people said, Yes! He is the one. But others said, No, he cant be the same man. He only looks like him. So the man himself said, I am that same man.

dag: Dabiɛm ka yurilim puuni, ka yurilim din niŋ dɛde nyɛla din yihiri dabiɛm bahira. Dama dabiɛm mini tibidarigibo n-dol taba; dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm, yurilim na bi niŋ dɛde o ni.
en: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ liɣiri paŋ n niriba bɛn be yi ni ŋɔ nandaan so, yin di zaŋ yimaŋ leeg o sandihiriba, yi mi miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri di zuɣu.
en: If you lend money to my people who are poor among you, dont be a creditor and charge them interest.

dag: Naawuni ʒin o ʒiishee saria karibu ni; o kari saria wuna sunsuuni.
en: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔash ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin saha, ka Jɛhɔahaz bia Jɛhɔash daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: Joash, Jehoahazs son, became king of Israel in Samaria in the thirty-seventh year of Judahs King Jehoash. He ruled for sixteen years.

dag: Bɛ nuhi mi tuumbiɛri tumbu pam; kpambaliba mini bɛ sariakaritiba diri birapu. Yikolaannim zaŋdi bɛ suhuyubu zaana, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ naari noli lɔri nia biɛri.
en: People cooperate to commit crime. Judges and leaders demand bribes, and rulers cheat in court.

dag: O mɛla gooni gili ma ni di chɛ ka n ku tooi zo. O zaŋla zoligo titaŋa lo ma.
en: He walled me in so I couldnt escape; he made my chains heavy.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa shiri zaŋ chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gibiatihaaralɔt la.
en: So Joshua made knives from flint rocks and circumcised the men of Israel at Gibeath Haaraloth.

dag: Teemi Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ ŋun daa neei kum ni kaman n ni daa wuhi shɛm n lahibal suŋ molo molibu ni la yɛla.
en: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.

dag: Deemiya bɛ suɣa mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu ni bɛ pateesanima ni bɛ nɛma zaa. Taɣimiya bɛ laakuma chaŋ ti leei yi dini. Ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Yɛlibiɛɣu gili ti luɣilikam zaa.
en: Their tents and flocks will be taken away. Their tents and all their riches will be carried off. Their enemy will take away the camels. Men will shout this to them: Terrible things are happening all around us.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa dɔɣi Nuhu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Noahs birth, Lamech lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Yi ni nya ka so ku tooi chihi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa zuɣu di simdi ni yi gbaai yimaŋa ka di niŋ shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: No one can deny this, and so you should calm down and not do anything foolish.

dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda daa di nam n-sula Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: David the son of Jesse was king of Israel.
