dag: dama yi na bi paai vuhim shee mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ luɣ shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: This is because we have not yet entered the peaceful land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Nyama, n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka ŋunkam ti wum li tiba puuni ni chahira.
en: The LORD said to Samuel, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of all who hear it tingle!.

dag: Dama wuhibu din viɛla ka n zaŋ tiri ya maa, miriya ka yi zaɣisi n wuhibu.
en: Ill teach you well. Dont abandon my instruction.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa zaŋ tabili paɣiba maa zaa, Yinim Judanim zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then I told the men and their wives, that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: Here in Egypt you still keep your promises to burn incense and offer sacrifices of wine to the so-called Queen of Heaven.

dag: N zɔnim larila mani ŋun suhi Naawuni ka o deei n suhigu ŋɔ, mani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun ka galimi ŋɔ, ka bɛ lari ma.
en: My friends laugh at me now. They say, He prayed to God and got his answer. I am a good, innocent man, but still they laugh at me.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ya mi tahiri tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali kulibɔna din kom zɔri mini kɔbil nina ni tiŋgbani puuni kom din puhiri yiri vinvama ni mini daboya ni na;.
en: because the LORD your God is bringing you to a wonderful land, a land with streams of water, springs, and wells that gush up in the valleys and on the hills.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Malimiya shili zaŋ chaŋ dali, so di chɛ ka o mini paɣa dɔni.
en: He told them to be ready in three days and not to have sex in the meantime.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɔmam. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotans sons were Hori and Homam. Lotan had a sister named Timna.

dag: Kush daa mali bidib so ka o yuli booni Nimrɔd. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ tuuli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa pam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Cush fathered Nimrod, the first great warrior on earth.

dag: Amaa o yi bi paɣ o situra bee n-su kom, o taali maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you dont wash your clothes and bathe your whole body, you will be responsible for your guilt.

dag: Ka Rubin daa bɔhi ba, N daa bi yɛli ya ni yi di niŋ bia maa shɛli? Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi wumbu. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, o kubu maa biɛri m-bɔhiri ti maa.
en: Then Reuben said to them, I told you not to do anything bad to that boy, but you refused to listen to me. Now we are being punished for his death.

dag: O daa piila tumtumdiba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣ kpɛriba bɛn be zoya ni tuhi pihinii, ka pii niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumda.
en: He assigned , men to carry building supplies and , to cut stone from the hills. And he chose , men to supervise these workers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum zoli maa ka n sanna nti guhiri nimaani, ka n zaŋ n ni sabi n zaligunim niŋ kuɣ parilan shɛŋa ni niriba maa wuhibu zuɣu la ti a.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Come up the mountain to me, and while you are here, I will give you two stone tablets which contain all the laws that I have written for the instruction of the people.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni yi taali ni Naawuni sani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la n-chɛ ka suhudoo niŋ ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.

dag: Sool n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi Yisa nyaandoliba maa alaka maa; o daa dolila yiya n-gbahiri dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba nti kpɛhiri duu.
en: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail.

dag: Amaa man ni mali shɛli nyɛla, a chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Dan zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaa laɣim a sanna kaman teeku noli bihigu la, ka a maŋmaŋ yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: My advice is that you bring all the Israelites together from one end of the country to the other, as many as the grains of sand on the seashore, and that you lead them personally in battle.

dag: Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ pisi bɛn daa dol o la ni daa ti paai Naa Dauda sani Hiburɔn, Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣila bindira ti Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa ka bɛ laɣim tab di ka nyu.
en: Then Abner came up to David at Hebron. Abner brought men with him. David gave a party for Abner and for all the men who came with him.

dag: Yɛm puuni ka nir mɛri yili, tɛhi zilima puuni ka yili mɛri zaana.
en: Homes are built on the foundation of wisdom and understanding.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ha, ka bundaan so ŋun daa yi Arimatia na ka o yuli booni Yisifu, ka o nyɛ Yisa nyaandol la.
en: That evening a man named Joseph came. He was a rich man from Arimathea who had become a disciple of Jesus.

dag: Jahat n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka Ziza pa o zuɣu. Amaa Jɛushi mini Bɛraya bɛn daa bi dɔɣi bidibisi pam, dinzuɣu bɛ daa zaŋ ba leela daŋ yini niriba.
en: Jahath was the oldest son and Ziza was the second son. But Jeush and Beriah did not have many children. So Jeush and Beriah were counted like one family.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan chɛ ka bɛ pii kuɣ pinaayi n-sɔŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni luɣ shɛli maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒiɛya la. Ka kuɣa maa na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua also put twelve rocks in the middle of the Jordan River. He put them at the place where the priests had stood while carrying the Holy Box. These rocks are still there today.

dag: o yi bi diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛmdi Izraɛlnim buɣa, ka mi bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni bee m-bo paɣ so ŋun nya puuni ka di na bi naai.
en: He doesnt go to the mountains to share food offered to idols. He doesnt pray to those filthy idols in Israel. He doesnt commit adultery with his neighbors wife or with a woman during her period.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛli Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa, Nyama, a mini Abiata zaŋmiya yi bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ a bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan n-labi tiŋ maa puuni ni suhudoo.
en: Do you understand? the king said to the priest Zadok. Go back to the city in safety—you and Abiathar with your two sons, your son Ahimaaz and Abiathars son Jonathan.

dag: Ka yɛndana ŋun nyɛ nandana daa be tiŋ maa ni; ka daa zaŋ o yɛm maa fa tiŋ maa nim bahi. Amaa ka so daa bi teei nandana maa yɛla.
en: Someone lived there who was poor, but so clever that he could have saved the town. But no one thought about him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni niŋ ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ na bi vuui.
en: You can be sure that some of the people of this generation will still be alive when all this happens.

dag: O ni daa mali Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni la, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zali.
en: In the rear of the Temple an inner room was built, where the Lord 's Covenant Box was to be placed.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ la.
en: But David did capture their fortress of Zion, and it became known as David's City.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛhab daa ti yɛli Nabɔt, Zaŋm a puu ŋɔ ti ma ka n zaŋ niŋ n ʒiɛvari puu, dama di miri n yiŋa; ka n ti a pu shɛli din viɛli gari dimbɔŋɔ bee a yi bɔra, n ni yo a di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: One day Ahab said to Naboth, Give me your vineyard that is near my palace. I want to make it a vegetable garden. I will give you a better vineyard in its place. Or, if you prefer, I will pay you for it.

dag: N nya o, amaa pa pumpɔŋɔ. N nya o, amaa ka o shee na waɣa. Saŋmariga ni ti puhi yi Yaakubu zuliya ni na. Naa ni ti yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na; O ni ti ku Mɔab zuɣulaannima, ka ku Sɛt zuliya zaa.
en: I see him coming, but not now. I see him coming, but not soon. A star will come from the family of Jacob. A new ruler will come from the Israelites. He will smash the heads of the Moabites and crush the heads of all the sons of Sheth.

dag: M birimmi zaa n dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛli zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɔri vu shɛli zuɣu. Dama bɛ niŋ ma muɣisigu pam, ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka je n yɛlli.
en: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛbil yino mali sara asiba, ka ti zaŋ piɛbil ŋun la mi mali zaawuni.
en: Offer one lamb in the morning and the other in the evening.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla bɛ ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu maa yɛla ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu zaŋ bɛ tɛha niŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni.
en: People who live following their sinful selves think only about what they want. But those who live following the Spirit are thinking about what the Spirit wants them to do.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa yi niriba maa sani n-chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni ti gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei bɛ sani.
en: So Moses and Aaron left the crowd of people and went to the entrance of the Meeting Tent. They bowed down to the ground, and the Glory of the Lord appeared to them.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibisi ni daa nyɛ kpamba gari Itama bidibisi zuɣu ka bɛ daa piri ba la ʒiibupinaayɔbu zuɣu kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm, ka daa piri Itama bidibisi mi ʒiibunii zuɣu.
en: The descendants of Eleazar were organized into sixteen groups, while the descendants of Ithamar were organized into eight; this was done because there were more male heads of families among the descendants of Eleazar.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛlimi, M Ba, chɛ ka a yuli nya jilima. Di saha ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi alizanda ni na yɛra, M pun chɛ ka di nya jilima; amaa n ni lan chɛ ka di nya jilima pahi.
en: Father, glorify your name! Then a voice came from heaven, I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuhi nyaŋ na shɛb maa n-nyɛ: Jɛriko naa mini Ai.
en: the king of Jericho, the king of Ai near Bethel.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mi daa bo oniɣisi kuɣa mini kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie tab binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyolɔrigu la zuɣu na.
en: The leaders brought onyx stones and other jewels. These stones and jewels were put on the ephod and judgment pouch of the priest.

dag: Ŋunkam kpɛri kuɣa ni nya daŋ di ni, ka ŋunkam mi wɔriti dari ni be di daŋ nyabu barina ni.
en: If you work in a stone quarry, you get hurt by stones. If you split wood, you get hurt doing it.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl. Kɔhat daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaata dunia yili.
en: Kohath lived years. His sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Yu suŋ so tulaale viɛlli, ka kum dali so dɔɣibu dali.
en: A good reputation is better than expensive pleasures. The day someone dies is better than the day they were born.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila! Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi ti naa maa. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila!.
en: Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yiɣisi chaŋ Naa Sulemaana sani ni o ti tɔɣis o di yɛtɔɣa ti Adɔnija. Ka naa daa yiɣisi ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa, ka lab ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ na nti ti naa ma ka o ʒin o nudirigu polo.
en: So Bathsheba went to the king to speak to him on behalf of Adonijah. The king stood up to greet his mother and bowed to her. Then he sat on his throne and had another one brought in on which she sat at his right.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni yɛl o, Man ni niŋ o naŋgban malisim. Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, So dini ka a lee yɛn doli.
en: Then a spirit went and stood before the Lord . He said, I will fool him! The Lord asked, How will you do it.

dag: ka n ti labiri kuni yiŋ na, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti kul yi n yiŋa n-daŋ ma soli tuhibu na, dilana ni leei nyin Yawɛ dini, ka n zaŋ o mali sara n-nyo o buɣim ti a.
en: then whatever comes out the doors of my house to meet me when I return victorious from the Ammonites will be given over to the LORD. I will sacrifice it as an entirely burned offering.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo, Naawuni yɛliya: Biɛɣ asiba zaŋ hal ni yuŋ ka n kul teegi n nuhi n-gahiri booni tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duntaariba ŋɔ.
en: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ ka gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga ni nya alibarika. Ŋunkam gbibi Vuhim Dabisili viɛnyɛliŋga ka bi saɣim li, ka mi bi tumdi din bie ni nya alibarika.
en: I will bless those who always observe the Sabbath and do not misuse it. I will bless those who do nothing evil.

dag: Ka n teei n nuu jɛndi ba n-saɣim tiŋgbani ka di bahi yoli, bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ti paai Ribila. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord , have done these things.

dag: O chɛ ka buɣim sal nɛma mini chilibi buɣim kul luri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu; ka zaŋdi pɔhim tulli darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: He will make hot coals and burning sulfur fall like rain on the wicked. They will get nothing but a hot, burning wind.

dag: Amaa din beni nyɛla, saria karibu mini buɣim din mali dabiɛm ka nyɛ din ti yɛn bahi bɛn tuhiri Naawuni yol la n-naɣ kpalim.
en: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi Firawuna sani yi tiŋ maa tariga nti duh o nuhi zuɣusaa suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi maa mini sakuɣa maa daa chɛ, ka saa maa baai.
en: Moses left the king, went out of the city, and lifted up his hands in prayer to the Lord . The thunder, the hail, and the rain all stopped.

dag: Ka ŋun daa yɛl o niriba, Nyamiya, Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zooya, ka lan mali yaa gari ti.
en: and he told the Egyptians: There are too many of those Israelites in our country, and they are becoming more powerful than we are.

dag: Din beni nyɛla, chɛliya ka ti kul chani tooni doli so shɛŋa ti ni pun doli hal ni pɔŋɔ la.
en: Only lets live in a way that is consistent with whatever level we have reached.

dag: A mali tumtumdiba pam; kuɣikpɛriba mini tammɛriba ni kapintanima ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim balibu kam zaa tumtumdiba bɛn ka kalinli.
en: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi nya doo maa, dabiɛm gbaari ba mi pam ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: The Israelite soldiers saw Goliath and ran away. They were all afraid of him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi ŋariŋ maa chaŋ kaman maal anahi bee ata nti nya Yisa ka o tam kom zuɣu chanina ti miriti bɛ ŋariŋ maa, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam.
en: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti kul kpalimmi be alahichi tumbu ni ka di chɛ ka Naawuni daalibarika zooi?.
en: So what are we going to say? Should we continue sinning so grace will multiply?.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia bi tumd alahichi, Naawuni biɛhigu ni be o ni ka o nyɛ Naawuni bia maa zuɣu ka o ku tooi tum alahichi.
en: Those who are children of God do not continue to sin, for God's very nature is in them; and because God is their Father, they cannot continue to sin.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim yirila gbinni polo na, ka wari yiri kikaa pɔhim ni na.
en: The windstorms of winter strike.

dag: O miri ka o di binshɛlikam din yi wain tia zuɣu na bee n-nyu wain bee n-nyu binnyuri kpiɔŋ bee n-di binshɛli din chihiri dibu. Chɛ ka o doli n ni zal o shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine; she must not drink any wine or beer, or eat any forbidden food. She must do everything that I have told her.

dag: Bɛ tum vi tuma, ka tum din chihira, amaa ka vi bi mali ba hal baabiɛla gba. Bɛ daa bi mi vidibo ni nyɛ shɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti lu m-pahi bɛn ti yɛn lu zuɣu. N yi ti darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli, bɛ ni ŋme m-paai ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti sahi o takɔbi maa naai alizanda ni, o ni zaŋ li lu Ɛdomnim bɛn nyɛ o ni zali ni o ku shɛb la zuɣu.
en: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.

dag: Dama ŋunkam ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ biŋkpam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: Whoever eats the fat from an animal that was offered as a gift to the Lord must be separated from their people.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m birini mini n yurilim din bi naara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini n tiligira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani. O nyaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: He is my protector and defender, my shelter and savior, in whom I trust for safety. He subdues the nations under me.

dag: Ti Duuma, nyini n-nyɛ ti ni pun be so sani ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Lord, you have been our help, generation after generation.

dag: Ka n wurim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa kpɛhi luɣilikam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋd o min o tɔbbihi zaa, ka ŋooi takɔbi doli ba.
en: As for all those who are in league with him, I will scatter his helpers and all his troops to the winds and let the sword loose after them.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei zaa ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ tiŋgban shɛli din bala, amaa ka bɛ lee nya kulinol shɛli ka di duli viɛla, ka bɛ daa lɔri nia ni di yi ni nani bɛ ni zaŋ ŋariŋ maa du ni.
en: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o zuu ŋun ti yɛn di nam zan o zaani mali maligu gooni zuɣu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim. Ka suli daa gbaai Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab bɛ ya ka chɛ o.
en: So he took his oldest son, who was to succeed him as king, and offered him on the city wall as a sacrifice to the god of Moab. The Israelites were terrified and so they drew back from the city and returned to their own country.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul no di luɣ shɛlikam di ni leei yi dini. Yi tintariga ni ti zanila Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban nɛl ni n-zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni hal ti paai Wulinluhili polo teeku la ni.
en: Every place you set foot on will be yours: your territory will run from the wilderness all the way to the Lebanon range, and from the Euphrates River all the way to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Iso ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahi saha shɛli ka o daa kpuɣi Judit ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Bɛri la bipuɣiŋga mini Basɛmat ŋun gba nyɛ Hiti nir ŋun yuli daa booni Ɛlɔn la bipuɣiŋga.
en: When Esau was years old, he married two Hittite women. One was Judith the daughter of Beeri. The other was Basemath the daughter of Elon.

dag: Kahimiya yi nɛma ka bɛ gbahi ya daba chaŋ, yinim bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ. Dama Mɛmfisi ni ti leei dabari n-wurim doya, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: Get what you need for deportation, you inhabitants of Egypt. Memphis will be reduced to a wasteland, a ruin with no one left.

dag: Di saha paɣisara ni ti wari waa ni suhupiɛlli, ka nachimba mini ninkura ti mali suhupiɛlli. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ kumsi leei suhupiɛlli. N ni ti maai bɛ suhuri, ka chɛ ka bɛ suhugarigu leei suhupiɛlli.
en: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.

dag: ka o daa po pɔri n-lo alikauli ni bipuɣiŋga maa yi suh o shɛlikam zaa, o ni ti o li.
en: So he promised that he would give her anything she wanted.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli yi tahima niŋbu puuni; ka maliya suɣilo yi muɣisigu nyabu ni; ka kul suhimiya Naawuni.
en: Be happy because of the hope you have. Be patient when you have troubles. Pray all the time.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi ni bɛ malibu.
en: Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei.

dag: Amaa di daa bi yuui ka bɛ tam a tuma maa yɛla, ka daa bi guhi n-deeg a wuhibu.
en: But how quickly they forgot what he had done! They wouldnt wait for his advice.

dag: Daabi so ŋun mali ʒiri kuruwa nyɛla ŋun bɔri niriba ŋaribu.
en: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.

dag: Yawɛ dimnim ni chɛrisichɛrisi. Zallakudura Naa ni be alizanda ni ka tahi bɛ zuɣu na. Yawɛ ni kari dunia ŋɔ nim zaa saria. O ni ti o naa yaa, ka ti o ninvuɣ gahindili yiko.
en: Our Lord , those who attack you will be broken in pieces when you fight back with thunder from heaven. You will judge the whole earth and give power and strength to your chosen king.

dag: N ni labisi Izraɛlnim ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ ti di bindir shɛli din be Kamɛl mini Bashan, ka di Ifriim zoya ni bindira ni Giliad bindira tiɣi.
en: But I will restore Israel to their pasture; they will graze on Carmel and Bashan; they will eat their fill in the highlands of Ephraim and Gilead.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la nira n-nyɛ ma: N nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun be mɔɣu ni m-mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma soli ka di tuhi. .
en: John replied, I am a voice crying out in the wilderness, Make the Lords path straight, just as the prophet Isaiah said.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli. Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ nti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: He said many things to them in parables: A farmer went out to scatter seed.

dag: Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani, ka Ɛdom nyɛ n ni pirigiri n namda sɔŋdi luɣ shɛli; n ni ŋme nasaridibo kuŋa m-bahi Filistianim zuɣu.
en: But I will use Moab as my washbowl, and I will throw my sandals on Edom, as a sign that I own it. I will shout in triumph over the Philistines.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa maa daa gbaai ma dabiɛm, ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: Now this caused me, Daniel, to worry. My visions disturbed me greatly.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi bɛn daa guli naa la sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba tahi Babilɔn naa sani Ribila.
en: Then Nebuzaradan took all these people to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the area of Hamath. The king of Babylon killed them there at Riblah. And the people of Judah were led away as prisoners from their land.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi jɛm wuna, dama man Yawɛ ŋun yuli booni Nyuli ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: You must not bow down to another god, because the LORD is passionate: the LORDs name means a passionate God.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu, ka yo pirigibu ʒiibunu zuɣu vaabu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti maligumaana, ka maligumaana maa ni zaŋ piɛlaa maa mali taali sanyoo sara maligu n-yo o daalahichi maa samli, ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: You must make the payments you have failed to hand over and must pay an additional percent. You shall give it to the priest, and the priest shall offer the animal as a sacrifice for your sin, and you will be forgiven.

dag: ni Gɛdɛrɔt ni Bɛtidagɔn ni Naama ni Makɛda: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Gederoth, Bethdagon, Naamah, and Makkedah: sixteen cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka o sɔŋda maa daa zaŋ li ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri ŋub li ka guui kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So the servant gave the food to them. They ate and had leftovers, in agreement with the LORDs word.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya saŋmariga maa ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: They were very happy and excited to see the star.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛr ayi maa daa kana ti ʒin tuh o, ka fiɣisi Nabɔt yɛli, Nabɔt turila Naawuni mini naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: The two scoundrels publicly accused him of cursing God and the king, and so he was taken outside the city and stoned to death.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi di ka nyu, ka bindirigu maa daa ti o kpiɔŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o chaŋ hal ti paai Sinai Zoli din nyɛ Naawuni zol la zuɣu.
en: Elijah got up, ate and drank, and went refreshed by that food for forty days and nights until he arrived at Horeb, Gods mountain.

dag: O zuliya daa bela Havila mini Shur luɣ shɛli din daa tuhi Ijipti dɛde zaŋ labi Asiria polo la. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti be ka chɛ Ibrahimma zuliya bɛn zaa kpalim la.
en: He established camps from Havilah to Shur, which is near Egypt on the road to Assyria. He died among all of his brothers.

dag: Hal bɛ ku tooi kahigi yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni fiɣisi ma ŋɔ wuh a.
en: Nor can they give you proof of the accusations they now bring against me.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa duu maa dukpina mini di yɔɣira ni di dunɔbihi ni di pundi zaa zuɣu, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ kpe chɛrubinima n-zaŋ tabili dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: to decorate the ceiling beams, the doors, the door frames, and the walls. Solomon also told the workers to carve designs of winged creatures into the walls.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Manaasa min o niriba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu.
en: The Lord spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they refused to listen.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa ŋmalig o sani o ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa n-lab alizanda ni.
en: Then God left him.

dag: Amaa n kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o mi ni tiligi ma.
en: But I call to the Lord God for help, and he will save me.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Gbɛmiya kpe, ka n sa zaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm yɛli ya. Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa gbe Balaam sani.
en: Balaam said to them, Spend the night here, and tomorrow I will report to you whatever the Lord tells me. So the Moabite leaders stayed with Balaam.

dag: Amaa a yi nya a wuna maa so sani, bɛn kum o. Lihimi n nɛma ŋɔ ni nya, a bini yi be di ni, nyin yihim li ti dɔɣiriba ŋɔ zaa ninni. Yaakubu daa bi mi ni Reechɛl n-zu n-kpuɣi wuna maa.
en: But if you find that anyone here has your gods, he will be put to death. Here, with our men as witnesses, look for anything that belongs to you and take what is yours. Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen Laban's gods.

dag: ka dabiɛm mini niŋgbuŋ sɔhibu daa paai ma din daa dam n kɔba ni zaa.
en: I trembled with fear.

dag: Ka Leeban daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-mɔɣis o yaansi min o bipuɣinsi maa kparima, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka lab kuli.
en: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters goodbye. He blessed them and went back home.

dag: N daamiliya, a naŋgbampiba tɔɣirila binnyuri nyaɣisili ka shiri mini bihim be a zilinli ni. A situra ʒiɛɣu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn ʒiɛɣu.
en: My bride, your lips drip honey. Honey and milk are under your tongue. Your clothes smell as sweet as perfume.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa fiɣis o pam;.
en: The chief priests brought many charges against Jesus.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma daa zani n nyaaŋa, ka ti ma yaa ka m mol lahibal suŋ molo zaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa wum li. Ti Duuma daa yihi ma gbuɣinli nol ni.
en: But the Lord stayed with me and gave me strength, so that I was able to proclaim the full message for all the Gentiles to hear; and I was rescued from being sentenced to death.

dag: Ŋun Naawuni daa fa alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi bidibbina, ka zaŋ ba wuhi palɔni o dari dibu chandi puuni ni o nyaŋ ba Masia dapulli la zuɣu.
en: When he disarmed the rulers and authorities, he exposed them to public disgrace by leading them in a triumphal parade.

dag: Amazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛhɔadan. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Amaziah was years old when he became king. He ruled for years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jehoaddin. Jehoaddin was from Jerusalem.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ n-yɛn teei n nuu din mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ ni sujee mini suhuyiɣisili pam n-tuhi ya.
en: Then I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and strong arm in fierce anger and rage.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Sool, ka o daa tim ti bol o na.
en: Some men heard David talking. They took David to Saul and told him what David had said.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ so bahi maa so, dama zibisim ni ka o ŋmaligi labi, ka so ʒi o yɛla.
en: Because that child arrives pointlessly, then passes away in darkness. Darkness covers its name.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhi pateesanim maa tuɣ taba din ni chɛ ka m biɛhigu shee maa ti nyɛ zaɣ muni yini.
en: Then make fifty gold clasps. Join the curtains to each other with the clasps so that the dwelling becomes one whole structure.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa wolig o piɛsah ayopɔin zali bɛ ko.
en: Abraham also put seven female lambs in front of Abimelech.

dag: Ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi tam daantalisi maa zuɣusaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-naai daantalisi maa tuma.
en: The lily-shaped caps were on top of the columns. This completed the work on the columns.

dag: Ɛrastus kpalim bela Kɔrinti; ka n daa chɛ Trɔfimus mi Milɛtus o ni daa ka alaafee zuɣu.
en: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣili maa maŋmaŋ kuli Asiria nti zaŋ li ti na titali, ka di leei bɛ farigu yɔbu o sani. Bɛ ni ti dihi Ifriimnim vi, ka vi ti gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛ buɣili maa zuɣu.
en: The idol will be carried off to Assyria as tribute to the great emperor. The people of Israel will be disgraced and put to shame because of the advice they followed.

dag: A ni wuhi Yaakubu ʒiɛyimtali, ka wuhi Ibrahimma ʒiɛyimtali din bi taɣira kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannim shɛm kurimbuni ha la.
en: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.

dag: Yinim Yawɛ daba bɛn ʒe o jɛmbu duu yuŋ ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Come, praise the Lord , all his servants, all who serve in his Temple at night.

dag: Hal n yi yɛli ni n nya wahala pam, n kul gbibila yɛda.
en: I was faithful to you when I was suffering.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni saɣim n luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ yi ni mali shɛli nyuri bara, ka yi nini tiɣi li, ka yi suhuri yu li la, ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin shɛba yi ni chɛ yiŋ la.
en: he is ready to destroy the temple in which you take such pride and which makes you feel so safe. Your children who now live in Jerusalem will be killed.

dag: Musa daa zali ti zaligu, ka di nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ni su shɛli.
en: We obey the Law that Moses gave us, our nation's most treasured possession.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa di nam maa su Izraɛlnim yuma ata.
en: Abimelech ruled over Israel for three years.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi yiɣisiri bɛ sani chani mɔɣu ni ti suhiri Naawuni.
en: Jesus often went away to other places to be alone so that he could pray.

dag: Chibimi gooni voli bɛ ninni n-kahi a nɛma doli nimaani yi.
en: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.

dag: Ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ a yuli kana nti tɔɣisi ti nanim mini ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim zaŋ tabili ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa la yɛligu.
en: We havent listened to your servants, the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our leaders, our parents, and to all the lands people.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o, Cham gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kulibɔna mini vinvama zaa ni nti lihi nya ti ni nya mɔri ti ti yuri mini ti buntaansi ŋɔ n-tiligi ba din ni chɛ ka ti ku kɔŋ bɛ shɛba.
en: Ahab said to Obadiah, Let us go and look at every spring and every stream bed in the land to see if we can find enough grass to keep the horses and mules alive. Maybe we won't have to kill any of our animals.

dag: Bɛ daa malila salima bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi pateesanim maa tuɣi taba, ka di daa chɛ ka Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa niŋ zaɣ mun yini.
en: They made fifty gold hooks, with which to join the two sets into one piece.

dag: Ba maa ni neeri kpiimba kum ni ka tiri ba nyɛvili shɛm, lala ka Bia maa gba tiri o ni bɔri so nyɛvili.
en: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, in the same way the Son gives life to those he wants to.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili salima sara maligu bimbin la, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They must spread a blue cloth over the golden altar. They must cover that with fine leather. Then they must put the poles for carrying it in the rings on the altar.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N wumla a damli puu ŋɔ ni ka dabiɛm gbaai ma, dama m bela n zaɣim, dina n-chɛ ka n sɔɣi maa.
en: The man replied, I heard your sound in the garden; I was afraid because I was naked, and I hid myself.

dag: Sana yi be yi sani, yin zaŋmiy o leei tiŋbia yi sani, ka yur o kaman yimaŋmaŋ la. Dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti yɛli yi suhuri ni, Timaŋmaŋ yiko mini ti nuhi kpiɔŋ ka ti zaŋ nya azichi ŋɔ.
en: So then, you must never think that you have made yourselves wealthy by your own power and strength.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam. Bɛ ni daa kana shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi n-chaŋ. Ka nyɔ bɔ ka bɛ lee di bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti pɔhim maa ni?.
en: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.

dag: M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu nti be zoya zaa mini daboli kam zuɣu dari ginda. M piɛri maa daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni, ka so kani ŋun ni lihi bo bɛ shee.
en: My flock wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. My flock was scattered over all the face of the earth. There was no one to search or to look for them.

dag: Amaa n ni kpalim be Ɛfɛsus hal ti paai Pɛntikɔst dali;.
en: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla o yiko yaɣ shɛli polo, ka ti ni wumd o yɛla shɛm pɔra pam. Amaa o yiko din galisi ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li.
en: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!.

dag: N yi di daa bi tum daadam ni na ʒi n-tum tuun shɛli bɛ sani, bɛ naan ku mali taali; amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ nya n ni tum shɛlikam maa, ka yaɣ di zuɣu zaɣisi m mini m Ba zaa.
en: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.

dag: Di saha ka o buɣisi dundɔŋ ni dunɔdali puuni tooni din be tiŋli polo la tooni zaŋ hal ni sambani dunɔdali gbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was meters.

dag: Dama ti ku tooi niŋ din ni chihi yɛlimaŋli; faashee din kul ni doli yɛlimaŋli maa ka ti ni niŋ.
en: We cant do anything against the truth but only to help the truth.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni o naba tiŋli maa, amaa ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha shɛli so ni ku tooi nya o baŋ o, dama Bɔaz daa bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o ka nimaani na.
en: So she lay there at his feet, but she got up before it was light enough for her to be seen, because Boaz did not want anyone to know that she had been there.

dag: Ka Ɛdom mɔɣa leei kootaali, ka di tiŋgbani leei chilibi, ka di tiŋgbani maa taai buɣim di kaman kootaali la.
en: Edoms streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpe Dauda suhu ni pam, ka dabiɛm gbaag o zaŋ chaŋ Gaat Naa Akishi maa polo.
en: David thought about what they were saying, and it made him afraid of Achish.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Ti noya ni yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali nyari ti ni bɔri shɛlikam. Ti noya maa mi kul be ti sani, ka ŋuni n-leei nyɛ ti duuma.
en: With our words we get what we want. We will say what we wish, and no one can stop us.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ni malaika gahinda zuɣu, n zal a ni a gbib wuhibunim ŋɔ, ka di zo so vi dimbɔŋɔ ni bee n-yaai so yuri ka chɛ so a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus and of the holy angels I solemnly call upon you to obey these instructions without showing any prejudice or favor to anyone in anything you do.

dag: Wummiya n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu la kuhigu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam, Yawɛ lan kala Ziɔn? Di Naa maa lan ka di ni.
en: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king? I hear the Lord reply, Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols.

dag: ka daa ti yi Matana maa chaŋ Nahaliɛl n-daa ti lan yiɣisi Nahaliɛl maa chaŋ Bamɔt.
en: from Mattanah to Nahaliel; from Nahaliel to Bamoth.

dag: Ka biɛɣuni asiba, wuntaŋ yi sa kul puhi na, yin kamiyana ti liri ba tiŋ maa ni. Gaal min o niriba maa yi sa yina ni yi mini ba zaŋ nya taba, yin niŋmiya ba yi ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Get up tomorrow morning at sunrise and make a sudden attack on the city. Then when Gaal and his men come out against you, hit them with all you've got.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa taɣ o biɛhigu bɛ sani n-niŋdi kaman o nyɛla yinyaa la, ka bo bini n-chihiri dunɔdali punu chiha, ka chɛ ka o nintɔri zɔri dolisir o teeŋkɔbiri.
en: So right there in front of everyone, he pretended to be insane. He acted confused and started making scratches on the doors of the town gate, while drooling in his beard.

dag: Di simdi ni cheechi sɔŋdiba malila paɣ yinoyino, ka tooi gbib bɛ bihi mini bɛ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The men who are special servants must be faithful in marriage. They must be good leaders of children and their own families.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa zo n-kuli Bɛr nti be nimaani, dama o daa zɔrila o biɛli Abimilɛk.
en: Then because he was afraid of his brother Abimelech, Jotham ran away and went to live at Beer.

dag: M Ba ŋun nyɛ wuntialan ŋɔ, dunianim bi mi a, amaa man mi a, ka bɛmbɔŋɔ gba mi ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: Righteous Father! The world does not know you, but I know you, and these know that you sent me.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nir yi bɔri tiwal suma, faashee o malila ti suŋ; amaa o yi malila ti biɛɣu, tiwal biɛri ka o ni nya, dama bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni.
en: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit. You can tell what a tree is like by the fruit it produces.

dag: Di dunoya zaa mini di takɔriti zaa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: All the doorframes were rectangular, facing each other in three sets.

dag: Ti Duuma zaɣis o sara maligu bimbini, ka chɛ o jɛmbu duu bahi. O zaŋ di nayili goma la niŋ bɛ bɛ dimnim nuu ni. Bɛ ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɔri nasara dibu vuri kaman chuɣu dal la.
en: The Lord rejected his altar and deserted his holy Temple; He allowed the enemy to tear down its walls. They shouted in victory where once we had worshiped in joy.

dag: Ŋariŋ kara pala di kom zuɣu chana, ka Lɛviatan be di ni diɛmda.
en: There go the ships on it, and Leviathan, which you made, plays in it!.

dag: Ka neesim maa nyaɣisibu zuɣu daa chɛ ka m bi lan ne, ka bɛ daa gbaala n nuu ni n-vo ma tahi Damaskus.
en: I couldnt see because of the brightness of that light, so my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin maa daa ti gari, ka paɣ maa yi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-lab o ya nti chaŋ ni o ti yɛli naa ka o zaŋ o yili min o tiŋgbani labisi ti o.
en: At the end of the seven years she returned to Israel and went to the king to ask that her house and her land be restored to her.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yuli ba ti tuui taba ni suli, ka o suhu daa lan saɣim pam bɛ ninkuunsi zuɣu, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa! Ka o daa tee li ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus was angry as he looked around at them, but at the same time he felt sorry for them, because they were so stubborn and wrong. Then he said to the man, Stretch out your hand. He stretched it out, and it became well again.

dag: Bundana tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm omaŋ duhibu ni, amaa faralan ŋun mali fahim ni nya li o biɛhigu ni.
en: Rich people think they are wise, but an insightful poor person sees through them.

dag: Ana daa nyɛla Dishɔn ba. Dishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamiran mini Ɛshiban ni Itiran ni Kɛran.
en: Anahs family: Dishon. Dishons family: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisiri di yɛla chani maa ka Yisa chirigi ba sol ni, ka bɛ min o doli chana;.
en: Jesus came near and started walking along beside them.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-tiligi amaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: dama a kpe a ʒiʒiinikpee maa nuu ni, cham yomyom ti balim a ʒiʒiinikpee maa.
en: Well then, my child, you are in that person's power, but this is how to get out of it: hurry to him, and beg him to release you.

dag: Ka zom maa ʒiʒiinitab mini bɛn daa pun mi ka o nyɛ barimaana la ti bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi ʒiya maani bara la.
en: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.

dag: Di saha ka zaligubaŋdib ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, a ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni a galindila ti gba.
en: One of the teachers of the Law said to him, Teacher, when you say this, you insult us too.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa;.
en: Jesus told the people to sit on the ground.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhoyakim min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o nabihi zaa daa wum li, ka naa daa bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka Yuria daa wum o yɛtɔɣa maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o daa zo n-kuli Ijipti.
en: King Jehoiakim, his army officers, and the leaders of Judah heard Uriah and became angry. King Jehoiakim wanted to kill Uriah, but Uriah heard about it. Uriah was afraid, so he escaped to the land of Egypt.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu maa mini alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmanila taba. Di zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini. Maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: The guilt offering is like the sin offering. The same rules are for both offerings. The priest who does the sacrificing will get the meat for food.

dag: ka ti Duuma daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari tiliginsim kul pahiri bɛ ni biɛɣukam.
en: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.

dag: N daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi kaman n ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tuuli la. Ka Yawɛ daa lan deei n suhigu, ka daa bi lan lo ni o kun ya.
en: I stayed on the mountain days and nights, like the first time. The Lord also listened to me at that time. He decided not to destroy you.

dag: Ka minya ni yi ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, dama yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Masia la zuɣu ka yi tumdi lala maa.
en: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.

dag: Ka mɔɣili maa kɔsoya ni kom ni nyɔni, ka mali lala hal ti nyuui; ka kaɣili mini kulimɔri ti kuui zaa.
en: The channels of the river will stink as they slowly go dry. Reeds and rushes will wither.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ dabisili dali kanna ka bɛ ni ti pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ti taba yi ninni.
en: Look, the Lord has a special day of judgment coming, when the riches you have taken will be divided in your city.

dag: n ni niŋ binshɛli din ni teer o yɛla zali n jɛmbu duu ni n niriba sunsuuni, ka ti o yuli din gari bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. N ni ti o yu shɛli din kul ni beni sahakam ka ku kpi.
en: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.

dag: Di simdi ka daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpɛm be yi sani.
en: Ask one clan chief from each tribe to help you.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛl o ni daa guni;.
en: Abraham was years old when he was circumcised.

dag: Yinim bɛn mi din tuhi ŋɔ, wummiya! Yinim bɛn gbibi n wuhibu yi suhuri ni ŋɔ, di zɔriya niriba ni maani ya ansarisi shɛli. Ka bɛ yi turi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di muɣisi ya.
en: You people who understand goodness should listen to me. You people who follow my teachings should hear the things I say. Dont be afraid of evil people. Dont let their insults upset you.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninsalinim ni tooi nya alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: I want you to know that people can be forgiven for all the sinful things they do. They can even be forgiven for the bad things they say against God.

dag: Ka Midiannim maa daa zaŋ Yisifu chaŋ Ijipti nti kɔhi Pɔtifa ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm zuɣu.
en: Meanwhile the Midianites had sold Joseph to the Egyptians, to Potiphar, Pharaohs chief officer, commander of the royal guard.

dag: O yaa bela o shee polo, ka o yiko be o pugbana puuni.
en: But he has great strength in his body. The muscles in his stomach are powerful.

dag: Nyama, bihi ayi bɛn nyɛ Zadok bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan be bɛ sani nimaani, a ni tooi tim ba ka bɛ kana ti yɛli ma a ni wum shɛlikam zaa. .
en: Their two sons, Zadoks son Ahimaaz and Abiathars son Jonathan, are also there. Use them to report to me everything you hear.

dag: Ka anabinim bɛn daa be Jɛriko maa daa chaŋ Ilaisha sani ti bɔh o, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: A group of prophets who lived there went to Elisha and asked him, Do you know that the Lord is going to take your master away from you today? Yes, I know, Elisha answered. But let's not talk about it.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa vaai yiɣisi kaman o neela gom ni la bee m-be kaman tɔbutuhira ni yi nyu wain buɣi n-tahiri shɛm la.
en: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.

dag: Naŋgban yini maa ni ka alibarika niŋbu mini turi zaa yirina. M mabihi, di bi niŋ kamaata ni di nyɛ lala!.
en: Blessing and cursing come from the same mouth. My brothers and sisters, it just shouldnt be this way!.

dag: Dama di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sab o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will suffer what the Scriptures say will happen to him. But it will be very bad for the one who hands over the Son of Man to be killed. It would be better for him if he had never been born.

dag: Chɛ ka karimbaannim di vi bɛ ni ŋmari ʒiri pari ma la zuɣu, amaa n kul ni tɛhir a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: But let the arrogant be ashamed because they oppressed me with lies— meanwhile, I will be contemplating your precepts!.

dag: Siria naa maa ni ti kpuɣi Ijipti azichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni bin suma shɛŋa din zaa pahi. O ni ti nyaŋ Libianim mini Itiɔpianima.
en: He will take away Egypt's hidden treasures of gold and silver and its other prized possessions. He will conquer Libya and Ethiopia.

dag: N ni zaŋ o wain tihi puu la labisi ti o, ka chɛ ka Akɔr Vinvamli leei tahima dunoli. Nimaani o ni ti saɣi ti ma kaman o paɣisarilim saha la ni kaman o ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la.
en: From there I will give her vineyards, and make the Achor Valley a door of hope. There she will respond to me as in the days of her youth, like the time when she came out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Bihi, wummiya yi ba wuhibu, wummiya li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi nya tɛhi zilima.
en: Children, listen to your fathers teaching. Pay attention and you will learn how to learn.

dag: Di saha ka Ijiptinim zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. A ni daa leei kariŋmaaŋa jaaŋgbee Izraɛlnim sani maa zuɣu.
en: Then all the people of Egypt will know that I am the Lord . The Lord says, The Israelites relied on you Egyptians for support, but you were no better than a weak stick.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ me gooni gili ya, ka teei gili ya. Bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbee fiɛbi Izraɛl naa tapaɣa.
en: Now strong city, gather your soldiers! They are surrounding us for the attack! They will hit the Judge of Israel on the cheek with a stick.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses. He said.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi nya soli kpe ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Masia nam din ka bahigu la ni.
en: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la daa wum ni Samarianim deei Naawuni yɛligu, ka daa tim Pita mini Jɔn bɛ sani.
en: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that the people of Samaria had accepted the word of God. So they sent Peter and John to the people in Samaria.

dag: N kul tɛhirila di yɛla sahakam ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: I remember well all my troubles, and I am very sad.

dag: Nir yi zɔri Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu. N je karimbaani mini maŋduhibu ni zaɣ biɛɣu ni ʒiŋmabo yɛtɔɣa.
en: To respect the Lord means to hate evil. I hate pride and boasting, evil lives and hurtful words.

dag: Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa yɛli Karia bia Jɔhanan, Di niŋ lala, dama ʒiri ka a ŋma m-pa Ishimail maa.
en: But Gedaliah answered, Don't do it! What you are saying about Ishmael is not true.

dag: bee m-mirigi bɛ nina kpa tiŋgban ni, amaa bɛ ni nyala suhusaɣiŋgu mini zibisim ni bumbɔni din mali barina ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli puuni bɛ ni yɛn kari ba ti kpɛhi.
en: and look to the earth, but they will see only distress and darkness, random movement, and the anguish and doom of banishment.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali ninkur shɛb bɛn daa pun ʒiini o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba maa la wula.
en: King Rehoboam consulted the older men who had served as his father Solomon's advisers. What answer do you advise me to give these people? he asked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti dan ti yɛl o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ? Naawuni di wuhi gba, ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ti tum tuuni ŋɔ tatabo!.
en: But the brothers said to the servant, Why does the governor say these things? We wouldnt do anything like that!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi tiŋgbani maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka noli din yɛla zaa sab be kundi ŋɔ ni di li maa.
en: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law . Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.

dag: Bɛ ka buchi, ka nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna, di saha ti ni du n-chaŋ, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ ti nuu ni. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ shihirili ti sani.
en: But we will go if they tell us to come up the hill and fight. That will mean the Lord is going to help us win.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o dimnim di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka o nam mali jilima.
en: I will dress his enemies in shame, but the crown he wears will shine.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Samsin, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo a mihi n-zaŋ a ti ti Filistianim maa. Ka Samsin yɛli ba, Pomiya ni yimaŋmaŋ ku ku ma.
en: Then the people of Judah said to him, Weve come down to take you prisoner so we can turn you over to the Philistines. Samson responded to them, Just promise that you wont attack me yourselves.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛm la. O daa lan ka bidibisi yaha, amaa Rɛhabia ŋun bidibisi daa galisiya pam.
en: Eliezers family: Rehabiah the first; Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah had many children.

dag: O tɔbbihi ni shɛb ni ti kana ti daɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sansani. Ka o ni ti kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu din tahiri saɣiŋgu na zali di zaani.
en: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that Horrible Thing that causes destruction.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, ka niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ suhuyubu soli ka jɛmdi wun shɛŋa la ni ti bemi kaman jinjɛŋŋmaa din lan ka buchi ŋɔ ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.

dag: Yi yi jɛmdi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi bindira mini yi kom ni, ka yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi kɔbili ni.
en: If you worship the LORD your God, the LORD will bless your bread and your water. Ill take sickness away from you.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, A yi ti labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛlli ŋɔ. Ka daa lan yɛli, Sokam zaa, wummiya.
en: If you ever return safely, Micaiah replied, then the LORD wasnt speaking through me. Then he added, Mark my words, every last one of you.

dag: Din dali maa wain ni ti tɔɣiri zoya zuɣusaa luri na; ka bihim ti zɔri daboya zuɣu; ka Juda kulibɔna zaa ti pali kom zɔra. Ka kɔbil nini ti yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka kom zɔri ti luri Akasia Vinvamli ni.
en: At that time the mountains will be covered with vineyards, and cattle will be found on every hill; there will be plenty of water for all of Judah. A stream will flow from the Temple of the Lord , and it will water Acacia Valley.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee paligi pam, ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-zo yomyom ni bɛ ti ti o nyaandoliba di lahibali.
en: With great fear and excitement, they hurried away from the tomb and ran to tell his disciples.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered them, Haven't you read what David did when he and his men were hungry?.

dag: O ni daa ti yɛn kpe Ijipti saha shɛli ka o yɛl o paɣ Zarai, M mi ni a nyɛla paɣ viɛlli, ka a lihibu mali kɔre.
en: Just before they arrived in Egypt, Abram told Sarai, Look, I know that you are a very beautiful woman.

dag: Naa Dauda daa tum Naawuni yubu o ʒiɛman ni, ka daa ti paɣi Naawuni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni ka o pooi;.
en: When David was alive, he obeyed God. Then after he died, he was buried in the family grave, and his body decayed.

dag: Anabi Jona ni daa nyɛ Ninivenim shihirili shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim shihirili.
en: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga nira, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ gbarigi zaa, ka o paɣa Zara daa nyɛ paɣiŋoo, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa bi chɛ ka o yɛda gbarigi di zuɣu.
en: Without losing faith, Abraham, who was nearly years old, took into account his own body, which was as good as dead, and Sarahs womb, which was dead.

dag: Di saha ka Filip daa zaŋ litaafi maa ni luɣ shɛli o ni karim maa n-gbaag o Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu.
en: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na maa.
en: Because of your constant love be good to me, so that I may obey your laws.

dag: N suhir a, kul tim ti la tarim bindirigu mini kom ka ti diri ka nyuri zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu pia, ka a zahim ti nya.
en: He said, Please give us this test for ten days: Dont give us anything but vegetables to eat and water to drink.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Iin, Alaafee; N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, malimiya yimaŋa n-kana ti pahi n zuɣu sara maligu maa shee. Ka o daa chɛ ka Jɛsi min o bidibisi gba mali bɛmaŋa, ka o boli ba ni bɛ ka sara maligu maa shee na.
en: Samuel answered, Yes, I come in peace. I come to make a sacrifice to the Lord . Prepare yourselves and come to the sacrifice with me. Samuel prepared Jesse and his sons. Then he invited them to come and share the sacrifice.

dag: Amaa Naawuni pun zaŋ niŋgbuŋ yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa n-niŋ niŋgbun yini kaman o ni yu shɛm.
en: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee tiri zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka satahiŋga mini sakuɣa ni buɣim lu tiŋgban ni na. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Moses pointed his walking stick toward the sky, and hailstones started falling everywhere. Thunder roared, and lightning flashed back and forth, striking the ground. This was the worst storm in the history of Egypt.

dag: Jilima mini dariza m-be o tuma ni, ka o wuntitali kul beni sahakam.
en: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.

dag: Ka niŋya kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.

dag: n ni teei n ni lo yi mini binnɛma zaa alikauli shɛli maa yɛla; ka kom mi ku lan niŋ kokpɛɣu n-di binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: When I see this rainbow, I will remember the agreement between me and you and every living thing on the earth. This agreement says that a flood will never again destroy all life on the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn niŋ yɛda la sani, amaa anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu nyɛla shihirili bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, ka pa ni bɛn bi niŋ yɛda la sani.
en: And from this we see that the use of different languages shows how God deals with those who dont believe, not with those who believe. And prophecy shows how God works through those who believe, not through unbelievers.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nudirigu polo dunɔdali n-kpe dundombil ni nti buɣisi nudirigu polo dunɔdali maa, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: When he brought me to the inner courtyard by way of the south gate, he took the same measurements of the south gate.

dag: N zaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ yiŋa, ka zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din ka kulim ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n sani n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, saha shɛli bɛ yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti na hal ni zuŋɔ la zuɣu. .
en: This is because my people did what I said was wrong. They have made me angry with them since the day their ancestors came up out of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa, ka ti a a ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Eli answered, Go in peace. May the God of Israel give you what you asked for.

dag: Ka ya polo ka n lee yɛn zaŋ vi ŋɔ kpe? Ka sokam ni bol a jɛrigu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu jaande, yɛlim naa, o ni zaŋ ma ti a.
en: Think about me—where could I hide my shame? And you—you would become like some fool in Israel! Please, just talk to the king! He wont keep me from marrying you.

dag: So di bɔr omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko sɔŋsim nyabu, amaa o bom o tab gba sɔŋsim nyabu.
en: Try to do what is good for others, not just what is good for yourselves.

dag: ka yɛli a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba, ka yɛli a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla yuŋ.
en: to proclaim your constant love every morning and your faithfulness every night.

dag: Anabi Habakuk wunsuhigu. Di dolila Shigiɔnɔt ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The prayer of Habakkuk the prophet.

dag: Di saha ka Mɛmukan daa yɛli naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa, Pa naa kɔŋko ka Napaɣ Vashiti lihi ʒiɛm maa, amaa o tuma zuɣulaannim gba hal zaŋ tabili doo kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa!.
en: Then Memucan answered the king with the other officials listening, Queen Vashti has done wrong. She has done wrong against the king and also against all the leaders and people of all the provinces of King Xerxes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tahi pina pam na nti ti ti. Ka ti daa ti yɛn yiɣisi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, ka bɛ zaŋ ti ni bɔri shɛlikam niŋ ti ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: They honored us in many ways. When we were getting ready to sail again, they supplied us with what we needed.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tum din nyɛ Naawuni tuma.
en: The people asked Jesus, What does God want us to do.

dag: A ti ti tibidarigibo balibu kam zaa din sab Musa zaligu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, ti na kul bi saɣi ni ti balim a bee ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ti daalahichi ka dol a yɛlimaŋli maa.
en: All those terrible things happened to us. This happened just as it is written in the Law of Moses, but we still have not asked the Lord our God for help. We still have not stopped sinning. We still do not pay attention to your truth, Lord.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri kpalim zani luɣ yini, ka goli gba kpalim zani hal ka Izraɛlnim ti bɔhi bɛ dimnim maa biɛri naai. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛla sab be Jashar Litaafi ni. Wuntaŋ daa kpalim zani zuɣusaa dɛde ka bi bɔri yomyom ni o lu hal ti paai dabisi muni.
en: The sun stood still and the moon stood motionless until a nation took revenge on its enemies. Isnt this written in the Jashar scroll? So the sun stood motionless in the middle of the sky. For a whole day, it was in no hurry to go down.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naa ŋɔ ni deei n suhigu, ka nyaŋ ba ti ma, dama bɛ bi taɣi, ka mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: God, who has always ruled as king, will hear me and punish my enemies. Selah But they will never change. They dont fear and respect God.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Have them make an acacia-wood chest. It should be forty-five inches long, twenty-seven inches wide, and twenty-seven inches high.

dag: Aai! N yɛri ya mi ni shee yi niŋ tuuba, di yi pa lala yi zaa gba ni ti bahi yoli.
en: No, I tell you, but unless you change your hearts and lives, you will die just as they did.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa ti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na.
en: Send some men now to the city of Joppa to get a man named Simon, who is also called Peter.

dag: Wummi n suhigu maa, ka garigi ma. N suhu bi doya ka n kul jiɣinda n fabila maa zuɣu.
en: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning.

dag: N ku guhi, n ni niŋ yomyom dol a zaligunim maa.
en: Without delay I hurry to obey your commands.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sagban piɛlli, ka so ʒi di zuɣu ŋ-ŋmani daadam ka pil salima nam zuɣupiligu, ka gbib gɔr dirili o nuu ni.
en: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi li ka di leei Naawuni chuɣu yuuni puuni. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka di simdi ka yi gbib li la gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa ni.
en: You will celebrate this festival to the Lord for seven days each year. This law will continue forever. You will celebrate this festival in the seventh month.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi so mi yaha, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a? Ka o yɛl o, Za ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ taɣi sab pihinii.
en: Then the manager said to another, How much do you owe? He said, One thousand bushels of wheat.He said, Take your contract and write eight hundred.

dag: Amaa nyin suhu min a nini kul mirigila a nyamma din bi doli so shɛli din tuhi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka a kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali, ka doli kiŋkansi soli nahindi niriba.
en: Jehoiakim, your eyes look only for what benefits yourself. You are always thinking about getting more for yourself. You are willing to kill innocent people. You are willing to steal things from other people.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ yi yɛn me duu maa dikili, bɛn zaŋm kuɣa me kulis ata, ka zaŋ dari mi n-niŋ kuliga zaɣ yini n-tam di zuɣu. Ka yihi nam fukumsi kpanjɔɣu ni liɣiri n-yo duu maa mɛbu tuma samli.
en: with three layers of dressed stones and one layer of timber. The cost will be paid from the royal treasury.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa nudirigu polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi nudirigu polo maa, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Nɛgɛb nyɔŋ.
en: Mortal man, he said, look toward the south. Speak against the south and prophesy against the forest of the south.

dag: Yisa daa ti chani Jɛrusalɛm n-zaŋ doli Samaria mini Galili sunsuuni garita.
en: On the way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

dag: Dinzuɣu, daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli Gɔg, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa n niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti be ni alaafee, amaŋmaŋ ni ti yiɣisi.
en: Son of man, speak to Gog for me. Tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: You will come to attack my people while they are living in peace and safety.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa gbaala o binyɛra n-dari tɔhi, ka zaŋ buɣu ye, ka lo noli. O daa kul yɛrila buɣu maa doona, ka chani gindi ni nandahima.
en: When Elijah finished speaking, Ahab tore his clothes, took them off, and put on sackcloth. He refused food, slept in the sackcloth, and went about gloomy and depressed.

dag: Mɛrari daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim, bɛ daa zaŋla Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni tinsi kaman Rimɔno mini Tabo ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: To the remaining Merarites from the tribe of Zebulun: Jokneam with its pasturelands, Rimmon with its pasturelands, Tabor with its pasturelands, and Nahalal with its pasturelands.

dag: Dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zaa niŋ pali la yɛtɔɣ yini puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: The whole law is made complete in this one command: Love your neighbor the same as you love yourself.

dag: ni ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi baŋ dɔbba la.
en: and , women.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bikpamba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians; his love is eternal.

dag: Di simdi ka tan tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi, di simdi ka tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu nyɛ yim.
en: Each curtain should be forty-two feet long and each curtain six feet wide. All the curtains should be the same size.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fiɛb ba pam ka zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu, ka yɛli dansarika gula ni o guli ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They were beaten severely and thrown into jail. The officials told the jailer, Guard them very carefully.

dag: A ni tooi gbahi binnɛma ti gbuɣinli bee n-dihi gbuɣimbihi ka bɛ tiɣi.
en: Do you find food for the lions? Do you feed their hungry babies?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka niŋmiya nirilim, ka zomiya tab nambɔɣu.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Make just and faithful decisions; show kindness and compassion to each other!.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ninsalinim zaa Naawuni, ka binshɛli m-beni n-kpɛm nyaŋ ma.
en: I am the LORD, the God of all living things! Is anything too hard for me?.

dag: ka ŋmaligi yɛli mmaŋa n suhu ni, M mali nɛma pam din ni gbib ma yuun bɔbigu; n ni ʒini vuhi n-dira ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Then I can say to myself, I have many good things stored. I have saved enough for many years. Rest, eat, drink, and enjoy life.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu. Yɛlim ba, yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya maa tintarisi n-yɛn bɔŋɔ.
en: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:.

dag: Yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita maa naabu dali, ka Yawɛ niriba gbilligbilli maa zaa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: After years, to the very day, all the armies of the Lord left Egypt.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli tumo maa, A ni yɛn chaŋ ti yɛli Jɔab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ kpaŋs o suhu, Di chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ muɣis a, dama takɔb bi chihiri so kubu, mali suhukpeeni ka liri tiŋ maa nim ni nimmoo n-nyaŋ ba. .
en: David said to the messenger, Say this to Joab: Dont be upset about this because the sword is that way: taking the life of this person or that person. Continue attacking the city and destroy it! Encourage Joab.

dag: Ka bɛn daa mali Pool tahiri maa daa zaŋ o hal ti paai Atɛnsi, ka Pool yɛli ba ni bɛ yi lab kuli bɛn yɛlimi Silas mini Timoti ni bɛ yi nya soli bɛn paam o na yomyom. Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: Those who escorted Paul led him as far as Athens, then returned with instructions for Silas and Timothy to come to him as quickly as possible.

dag: A yi di niŋ din simdi, n naan ku deei li? Ka a yi bi niŋ din simdi, alahichi do a dunol ni m-bɔri ni di nyaŋ a, amaa di niŋ kamaata ni a nyaŋ li.
en: If you had done the right thing, you would be smiling. But you did the wrong thing, and now sin is waiting to attack you like a lion. Sin wants to destroy you, but don't let it!.

dag: M mɛla yili shɛli din mali jilima ti o, ka di nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: Now I have built a majestic temple for you, a place for you to live in forever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ ti Lɛvi bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka nyɛ bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: So Moses wrote down God's Law and gave it to the levitical priests, who were in charge of the Lord 's Covenant Box, and to the leaders of Israel.

dag: Ka niriba pam tah o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: Many people criticized the blind man and told him to be quiet. But he shouted more and more, Son of David, please help me.

dag: Dama a daba yuri di kuɣa pam, bɛ zɔri di taŋkpaɣu nambɔɣu.
en: Your servants cherish Zions stones; they show mercy even to her dirt.

dag: N kul kuhirimi bɔri sɔŋsim hal ni asiba. O bemi kaman gbuɣinli la n-kul ŋmari n kɔba wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul ŋmaarila n nyɛvili.
en: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.

dag: N daa zaŋla nirilim mihi vo ba chaŋ. N daa zaŋla yurilim mihi niŋ ba, ka leei ŋun yihi bin tibisi shɛŋa din ga bɛ noya la, ka silim tiŋa n-dihi ba bindirigu.
en: I led them with bands of human kindness, with cords of love. I treated them like those who lift infants to their cheeks; I bent down to them and fed them.

dag: Nyama, karimbaannima! Bɛ suhuri ni tɛha bi tuhi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni bela bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: This message cannot help those who refuse to listen to it, but those who are good will live because they believe it.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul guhirila a tiliginsim, ka dol a zaligunima.
en: I wait for you to save me, Lord , and I do what you command.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n fabili niŋ a ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a tib ma.
en: Lord my God, I prayed to you, and you healed me.

dag: Ka zuliya biɛɣu ŋɔ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn kpalim, ka be n ni kari ba bahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa, bɛ ni ti paɣi kum gari biɛhigu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And the people of this evil nation who survive, who live in the places where I have scattered them, will prefer to die rather than to go on living. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Amaa n niriba Izraɛlnim bɛna, baa bi yɛn ŋuhi bɛ biŋkɔbigu gba bee daadam din ni chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ woligi Izraɛlnim ka chɛ Ijiptinima.
en: But there won't be any need for the Israelites to cry. Things will be so quiet that not even a dog will be heard barking. Then you Egyptians will know that the Lord is good to the Israelites, even while he punishes you.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi, di chɛ ka n di vi dahin shɛlikam.
en: I run to you, Lord , for protection. Don't disappoint me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka pɔhim yi zuɣusaa yaɣa anahi ŋɔ na ti ʒe Ɛlamnima, ka n chɛ ka pɔhim maa ʒe ba bahi luɣilikam, ka Ɛlam kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ti zo n-kuli zuliya kam ni.
en: I will bring against Elam four winds from the four corners of heaven, and I will scatter them to the winds. Those banished from Elam will migrate to every nation.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, o kul kumdila pampam, ka nintam zo n-tiɛl o kparima. O mamanim la zaa so lan kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. O zɔnim zaa yila o nyaaŋa; bɛ leela o dimnima.
en: All night long she cries; tears run down her cheeks. Of all her former friends, not one is left to comfort her. Her allies have betrayed her and are all against her now.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m mi ni n ni gili yihi Naawuni nam waazu yi ninvuɣ shɛb sani zaa ŋɔ ku lan nya ma ni yi nini yaha.
en: I have gone about among all of you, preaching the Kingdom of God. And now I know that none of you will ever see me again.

dag: Amaa o yi zaŋ omaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka di wuhi ni o ka daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka dɔro maa yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ŋun lan cham maligumaana maa sani yaha.
en: But if the sore spreads after the priest has examined you and pronounced you clean, you must appear before the priest again.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, nir yi doli n yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: I promise you, whoever continues to obey my teaching will never die.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daamiy o bahina. Ka bɛ daa daai Jɛzibɛl bahina, ka o ʒim yiɣ vie dukpini mini yuri, ka bɛ du n-tam o zuɣu n-nɔnno o.
en: Then he said, Throw her out! So they threw her out of the window. Some of her blood splattered against the wall and on the horses, and they trampled her.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Kitirɔn bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Nahalol, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu; amaa ka bɛ daa lee muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The tribe of Zebulun did not drive out the people living in the cities of Kitron and Nahalal, and so the Canaanites continued to live there with them and were forced to work for them.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti miri Jɛrusalɛm n-nya li o dii gbaala kuhigu ka fabindi di zuɣu.
en: When Jesus came closer and could see Jerusalem, he cried.

dag: ka daa tim ni bɛ cham sarika ni nti ŋma Jɔn zuɣu na.
en: So he had John beheaded in prison.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o me du titali, ka ku ʒini mali laasabu nya o mal liɣiri din ni tooi me li naai?.
en: If one of you wanted to build a tower, wouldnt you first sit down and calculate the cost, to determine whether you have enough money to complete it?.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o bɔh o nyaandoliba, Niriba lee yɛri ni Daadam Bia nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Jesus went to the area of Caesarea Philippi. He said to his followers, Who do people say I am .

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali zoligɔnim kaman nyiŋgokɔriti la n-zaŋ li pa daantalisi maa zuɣusaa, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi bini kɔbiga n-zaŋ li yiliyili zoligɔnim maa.
en: Then he made chains like a necklace and placed them on the tops of the columns. He made a hundred pomegranates and placed them into the chains.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mal o ansarisi maa naai, ka bɛ pirigi kpar ʒiɛɣu maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu yɛl o n-zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: When the soldiers had finished making fun of Jesus, they took off the robe. They put his own clothes back on him and led him off to be nailed to a cross.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ sani.
en: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord .

dag: N ni kpe yi tiŋ ŋɔ ni n-chani ginda, n nya yi ni jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa, ka nya maligu malibu bimbin shɛli ka bɛ sab pa di zuɣu yɛli, Ti ni ʒi wun so ka jɛmd o la mi bimbini m-bɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu yi ni ʒi so ka jɛmd o maa yɛla ka n kahigiri wuhiri ya maa.
en: For as I walked through your city and looked at the places where you worship, I found an altar on which is written, To an Unknown God. That which you worship, then, even though you do not know it, is what I now proclaim to you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒiɛri zuɣusaa. O yiko puuni ka o daa chɛ ka nudirigu polo pɔhim ʒɛna;.
en: He also caused the east wind to blow, and by his power he stirred up the south wind;.

dag: O daa chɛ ka mɔɣa leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina kuui.
en: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o nyari bin viɛla, ka o nuhi tuma mi mali di nyɔri.
en: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.

dag: Maligumaaniba: Jɛdaya daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah, that is, of the house of Jeshua.

dag: Yawɛ nini ni tiɣi piɛlahi tusa shɛm mini kpam pam din be kaman mɔɣa tuhi pia kom la? N zaŋmi mmaŋmaŋ bituuli ŋun nyɛ n niŋgbuŋ nyɔri n-yo m biriginsim mini n daalahichi samli?.
en: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni. Bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.

dag: Kpuɣim a nɛma maa buɣi a bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu bɛ ninni, ka zaŋ bini pɔb a nina n-ʒi li yi liɣa din ni chɛ ka a nini ku nya tiŋgbani. Dama n zaŋ a leela shihirili Izraɛlnim sani.
en: At night, put your bag on your shoulder and leave. Cover your face so that you cannot see where you are going. You must do these things so that the people can see you, because I am using you as an example to the family of Israel.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni la shiri yi a zuɣu.
en: Then God said, Use your stick in this way, and the people will believe that you saw the Lord , the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

dag: Bɛ yi kul be luɣ shɛlikam, dabiɛm m-mali ba, ka kariti doli ba duri bɛ napɔŋkpahi.
en: All around them terror is waiting; it follows them at every step.

dag: Ka Sool daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa, Havila zaŋ hal ti kpa Shur tin shɛli din be Ijipti wulimpuhili polo la.
en: and Saul attacked the Amalekites from Havilah to Shur, which is just east of Egypt.

dag: Taainim ni zaŋ pina na ti ti a m-bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim, ka bundaannim gba ni zaŋ pina balibu kam na ti ti a.
en: The city of Tyre, the wealthiest of all, will seek your favor with gifts.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba ayi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti doli Yisa.
en: The two disciples heard what he said, and they followed Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Mbusim be yinim zaligubaŋdib gba zuɣu! Dama yi ʒiini niriba ʒi tibisi shɛŋa din ʒibu to, amaa ka yimaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ yi nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaɣisi lahibal suŋ la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni dimnima ni di chɛ ka yi wum lahibal suŋ maa; amaa zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni pii ba la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ yurisi bɛ yaannim zuɣu.
en: Because they reject the Good News, the Jews are God's enemies for the sake of you Gentiles. But because of God's choice, they are his friends because of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Paɣ maa yi ʒinila bindoo zuɣu bee binshɛlikam zuɣu, ka dilan shihi li, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: It doesnt matter if they touched the womans bed or if they touched something she sat on, they will be unclean until evening.

dag: ti yɛl o, A bi mi ni Ammɔnnim naa Baalis timla Nɛtania bia Ishimail na ni o ti ku a? Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: and said to him, Are you aware that King Baalis of Ammon has sent Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, to kill you? But Gedaliah, Ahikams son, wouldnt believe them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ti zaŋ tihi maa da shɛŋa m-mali buɣim wuɣisi; ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim she bɔrɔbɔro. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ di shɛŋa mali wuna mini binnana zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li.
en: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.

dag: m-bol o yuli Nuhu ka yɛli, Bia ŋɔ ni sɔŋ ti ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni, Yawɛ ni yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: and named him Noah, saying, This one will give us relief from our hard work, from the pain in our hands, because of the fertile land that the LORD cursed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti niŋ nyini n dana zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam zaa o ni yɛli ni o ni niŋ a la, ka chɛ ka a leei Izraɛl naa.
en: When the LORD has done for my master all the good things he has promised you, and has installed you as Israels leader.
