dag: Ka daba ayopɔin maa dali di simdi ni maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa yaha; ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi bi yɛligi, ka kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim mi ka di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni.
en: On the seventh day the priest will examine the infection again. If the scabies has not spread, there is no yellow hair in it, and it does not appear to be deeper than the skin.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa lan yɛli Izraɛl naa maa, Daŋ bɔhi baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm pɔi.
en: But first lets ask the Lord for advice.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛri gulibu ni na ni a ti leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Now, tell this to my servant David: The Lord All-Powerful says, I took you from the fields and from taking care of the sheep. I made you king of my people Israel.

dag: Ka yi mi nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ zuliya shɛba shɛlikam zaa yi zuɣu la; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi ba tin ya.
en: You have seen what the Lord did to our enemies. He did this to help us. The Lord your God fought for you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ nya kpiɔŋ Yawɛ sani, ka bɛ ni ti n yuli jilima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make my people strong; they will worship and obey me. The Lord has spoken.

dag: ni Bɛza ni Hɔd ni Shamma ni Shilisha ni Itiran ni Bɛra.
en: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

dag: A bi saɣi n-chɛ ka n dimnim gbaai ma; a zaŋ ma zali palo ni.
en: You didnt hand me over to the enemy, but set my feet in wide-open spaces.

dag: Ka doo maa dii nya alaafee, ka kpuɣ o bindoo chaŋ o chandi. Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Immediately the man was well, and he picked up his mat and walked. Now that day was the Sabbath.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo n-doli wuna n-jɛmdi li, ka tumdi di tuma. Ka miriya ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa din ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.

dag: Bɛn zaa be n san la puhir a. Puhimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ti daadiini soli zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu ni la ti ma. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!.

dag: A mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛl daŋ kam dunoli dɔɣirikpamba niŋmi bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa din nyɛ ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri maa na laasabu.
en: You and Eleazar, together with the other leaders of the community, are to count everything that has been captured, including the prisoners and the animals.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan chɛ ka bɛ pii kuɣ pinaayi n-sɔŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni luɣ shɛli maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒiɛya la. Ka kuɣa maa na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan where the feet of the priests had stood while carrying the covenant chest. They are still there today.

dag: Tinim a daba ŋɔ zaa nyɛla do yino bihi, ti nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, ti pala puɣisiriba.
en: We are all brothers—we all have the same father. We are honest men. We have come only to buy food.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n yɛma ŋma; kpaŋsim ma kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: My spirit sags because of grief. Now raise me up according to your promise!.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa deei Naawuni noli o ni daa yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ti o la ni; ka o daa yiɣisi omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbaai chandi, hal ka ʒi o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim ti polo na! Be alizanda ni ka lihina nya; tiligim wain tia ŋɔ.
en: Please come back, God of heavenly forces! Look down from heaven and perceive it! Attend to this vine.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ yi biɛhigu shee bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ zim kuruwa ayi malina, ka bɛ ti zaŋ gahi. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka yi ti niŋ dabindi niŋ di ni, ka di leei bindir tuuli shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni zuɣu ka ti be kum barina ni asiba hal nti paai yuŋ; bɛ lihi ti mi kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: As it is written, We are being put to death all day long for your sake. We are treated like sheep for slaughter. .

dag: Nyama, n ni kpihim nyin Baasha min a daŋ niriba zaa birili; ka niŋ a yiŋa kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋ shɛm la.
en: and so I will do away with you and your family, just as I did with Jeroboam.

dag: N daanfaani so salima, hal salima alali gba. Ka n ni tiri niriba binshɛli gari anzinfa viɛlli.
en: My fruit is better than gold, even fine gold; my crops are better than choice silver.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi gbilisi tibili wum, ka chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu bee buɣa jɛmbu.
en: But they didnt listen to the prophets or pay attention to them. They didnt stop doing wicked things. They didnt stop making sacrifices to other gods.

dag: Ti wum vuri zoya zuɣu. Di nyɛla Izraɛlnim fabila kuhigu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu. Bɛ tamla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla.
en: A voice is heard on the well-traveled paths; its the crying and pleading of the people of Israel, who have lost their way and forgotten the LORD their God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, sokam ŋun cham ti jɛm o buɣa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana. Amaa miriya ka yi lan zaŋ yi buɣa mini yi pina ta n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ daɣiri.
en: Go ahead and worship your idols for now, you Israelites, because soon I will no longer let you dishonor me by offering gifts to them. You will have no choice but to obey me!.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni di n-su shɛb kalinli ku mali tariga, amaa bɛn doli nyaaŋa na nini ku tiɣ o. Yɛlimaŋli dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Many people will follow this young man. But later, those same people will not like him. This is also senseless. It is like trying to catch the wind.

dag: ka yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun yu n dan maa yurilim maŋli din ka kpee, ka ʒe o yim ŋɔ. Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi polo, Yawɛ kul zaŋ ma mi na ti kpɛhi n dan maa dɔɣiriba yiŋa.
en: Bless the LORD, God of my master Abraham, who hasnt given up his loyalty and his faithfulness to my master. The LORD has shown me the way to the household of my masters brother.

dag: M bia, chɛ ka a baɣa be n yɛligu ni. Gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛr a shɛm.
en: My son, pay attention to my words. Bend your ear to my speech.

dag: ni Ofiri ni Havila ni Jɔbab; bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jokitan bidibisi.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were Joktans family.

dag: Yisa ʒim zuɣu ka ti nya yolisim. Dina n-nyɛ alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka di mi nyɛla o daanfaan shɛli din galisi.
en: For by the blood of Christ we are set free, that is, our sins are forgiven. How great is the grace of God.

dag: Bɛ yuri sara maligu pam. Bɛ zaŋdi nimdi maani sara ka ŋubiri li. Amaa Yawɛ ŋun baɣa ka di ni. Pumpɔŋɔ o ni teei bɛ tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛ ni labi Ijipti.
en: Though they offer choice sacrifices, though they eat flesh, the LORD doesnt accept them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins; they will return to Egypt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o lab kuli o ya Rama. Ŋuna n-daa lan maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani gba. O daa lan me sara maligu bimbini nimaani ti Yawɛ.
en: Then he would go back to his home in Ramah and do the same thing there. He also had an altar built for the Lord at Ramah.

dag: Amaa yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa nyɛla zoya mini vinvama tiŋgbɔŋ, ka saa miri nimaani.
en: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven.

dag: Kukoli maa ni daa tɔɣisi naai ka bɛ nya ka Yisa kɔŋko n-kpalim. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa shini ka bi yɛli so bɛ ni daa nya shɛli maa yɛla di saha maa.
en: When the voice stopped, there was Jesus all alone. The disciples kept quiet about all this and told no one at that time anything they had seen.

dag: Bia ŋɔ ka n daa suhi maa, ka Yawɛ daa deei n suhigu ka shiri ti ma n ni daa suh o bɔri shɛli maa.
en: I prayed for this child, and the Lord answered my prayer. He gave me this child.

dag: Dishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛmdan mini Ishiban ni Itiran ni Kɛran.
en: Dishon's sons were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

dag: Zilim balli maari suhuyiɣisili, amaa yɛtɔɣ yoli yiɣisirila nir suhu.
en: A sensitive answer turns back wrath, but an offensive word stirs up anger.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, dama di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani ni bɛ di baŋ li, ka bɛ mi daa zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: They didnt understand this statement. Its meaning was hidden from them so they couldnt grasp it. And they were afraid to ask him about it.

dag: Ka Simiɔn bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la.
en: Simeons sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, whose mother was a Canaanite.

dag: Amaa ka Rabishake bɔhi ba, Yi mini naa kɔŋko ka n dan tim ti na ni ti ti yɛli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka pa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu maa gba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛn pahi yi zuɣu di bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi ka nyu bɛmaŋmaŋ dulim.
en: He replied, Do you think you and the king are the only ones the emperor sent me to say all these things to? No, I am also talking to the people who are sitting on the wall, who will have to eat their excrement and drink their urine, just as you will.

dag: Ka maligumaana ni mali sara ti ninvuɣ so ŋun chirim maa, o yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, o ni mali sara ti o Yawɛ sani, ka o nya taali chɛ m-paŋ.
en: The priest will make purification before the Lord for the one who sinned, and that person will be forgiven.

dag: Di nyaaŋa Naa Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla o daa yɛlimi, M mini n nam ŋɔ ka taali shɛli Yawɛ sani zaŋ chaŋ Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ŋɔ polo hal baabiɛla gba.
en: David heard how Joab had killed Abner, and he said, I swear to the Lord that I am completely innocent of Abner's death!.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo n-doli wuna n-jɛmdi li, ka tumdi di tuma. Ka miriya ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa din ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont follow or worship other gods and dont anger me by what you make with your hands. Then I wont bring disaster upon you.

dag: Ka o daa baŋ li ka yɛli, M bia maa binyɛrigu m-bala; mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o maa. Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋ-ŋɔ o kul dari tɔhitɔhila Yisifu zaa.
en: His father saw the coat and knew that it was Josephs. He said, Yes, that is his! Maybe some wild animal has killed him. My son Joseph has been eaten by a wild animal.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ tɔrili ŋun yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini tinvurigu ni chani shɛm tampiŋ zuɣu, ni ŋariŋ din be teeku bulli ni biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni doo mini paɣa tab laɣimbu yɛla.
en: the way of an eagle in the sky, the way of a snake on the rock, the way of a ship out on the open sea, and the way of a man with a young woman.

dag: Yi ni ŋmaligi yomyom ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun boli ya Masia daalibarika puuni, ka lan ŋmaligi n-doli lahibal sun shɛli din be di ko ka chɛ Masia lahibal suŋ la yɛla gari ma pam.
en: I am surprised at you! In no time at all you are deserting the one who called you by the grace of Christ, and are accepting another gospel.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ la o ni daa lo nia shɛli ka chɛ ka di pali ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la puuni.
en: God did this according to his eternal purpose, which he achieved through Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tahi yɛli, Di bemi kaman n ni pun tɛhi shɛm! Yi bɔrila saha, dama yi baŋya ni n lo n suhu ni.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar answered, I know that you are trying to get more time. You know that I meant what I said.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa fiɣis o pam;.
en: The chief priests were accusing Jesus of many things.

dag: Ka o yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash, Malim shili n-vooi tɔb maa to; ka o vooi li. Ka Ilaisha zaŋ o nuhi pa naa maa nuhi zuɣu;.
en: Then Elisha said to the king of Israel, Put your hand on the bow. Jehoash put his hand on the bow. Then Elisha put his hands on the kings hands.

dag: a ni niŋ tuuba a suhu ni, ka siɣis amaŋ Naawuni sani n-darigi cheeg a binyɛrigu ka kum niŋ ma zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum ka n yɛli ni n ni niŋ Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba shɛm la polo, man Yawɛ yɛliya, N gba wumya.
en: and you repented and humbled yourself before me, tearing your clothes and weeping, when you heard how I threatened to punish Jerusalem and its people. I have heard your prayer.

dag: ni di chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣa maa zaa ku gaŋdi taba, amaa ka di baɣa lee ni bela tab ni.
en: so that there wont be division in the body and so the parts might have mutual concern for each other.

dag: Di simdi ni yi dɔbba zaa kani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sanna buta yuuni puuni.
en: Three times each year all your men must go to be with the Lord GOD, the God of Israel.

dag: A ni nya saŋmaris ayopɔin shɛba n nudirigu ni la mini salima firilatamdis ayopɔin shɛŋa la gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Saŋmaris ayopɔin maa nyɛla cheechinima ayopɔin la malaikanima, ka salima firilatamdis ayopɔin la mi nyɛ cheechinima ayopɔin la.
en: Here is the hidden meaning of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and the seven golden lampstands that you saw: The seven lampstands are the seven churches. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa laɣim tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara bahi, ka bo liɣiri ti siliga guliba maa.
en: They met with the elders and decided to give a large sum of money to the soldiers.

dag: Dama ti Duuma NAAWUNI lan yɛli, N niriba daa tuui kulila Ijipti ti be nimaani. Nyama, di nyaaŋa ka Asirianim gba daa ti nahim ba yoli.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Long ago my people went down to reside in Egypt. Moreover, Assyria has oppressed them without cause.

dag: Pa kapinta bia la m-bala? Pa o ma yuli m-booni Mariama la? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ni Saimɔn ni Judas la?.
en: Isnt he just the son of the carpenter we know? Isnt his mothers name Mary, and arent his brothers James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo:.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Moab plains by the Jordan across from Jericho.

dag: N daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛli Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa tim ma ka n yi Kadɛshibarinia n-kana ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; ka daa ʒi di lahiba maŋli ti yɛl o.
en: I was forty years old when the Lord 's servant Moses sent me from Kadesh Barnea to spy out this land. I brought an honest report back to him.

dag: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maa binʒim mini biŋkpam mali sara maa ni ti su nudirigu gbali, ka di leeg o tarili.
en: That part of the fellowship offering will belong to the priest who carries the blood and fat to the altar.

dag: Yi yi ti yɛn sibigi suɣili maa chaŋ, Lɛvinim n-yɛn sibigi li; ka yi yi ti yɛn sa li, Lɛvinim maa n-yɛn zaŋ li sa. Ka ninvuɣ zino yi miri suɣili maa na, yin kum o.
en: Whenever you move your camp, the Levites shall take the Tent down and set it up again at each new campsite. Anyone else who comes near the Tent shall be put to death.

dag: O darigi deei m binyɛrigu, o ʒe n-dila m binyɛrigu nyiŋgoli mali.
en: God seizes me by my collar and twists my clothes out of shape.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni, ka paɣi ni ti yi ti niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ ti be ti Duuma sani.
en: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.

dag: dama bɛ tiligira nyɛla ŋun mali yaa. O ni zab bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord will be against you. He is powerful and protects orphans.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ nabia alali, ka di zuɣulaannim diri di ni simdi ni bɛ diri saha shɛli ni bɛ nya kpiɔŋ ka pa ni bɛ nyu m-buɣi, di tiŋgbɔŋ maa mal alibarika.
en: Happy is the land whose king is dignified and whose princes feast at the right time for energy, not for drunkenness.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sara maligu bimbini zaligunim m-bɔŋɔ: dahin shɛli di yi ti naai, ka yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu, ka zaŋ ʒim vie li.
en: He said to me, Human one, the LORD God proclaims: These are the regulations established for the altar on the day when it is prepared for making entirely burned offerings and dashing blood on it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa yi yi ni wum n yɛligu, ka ku ʒi ʒiya doli yaŋɔ dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpɛna Vuhim Dabisili dali, amaa ka ni gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi, ka bi tum tuma dindali.
en: Tell these people that they must obey all my commands. They must not carry any load in through the gates of this city on the Sabbath. They must observe the Sabbath as a sacred day and must not do any work at all.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa nyɛla nachimbil so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka Sulemaana daa kpahim nya o ni nyɛ tumtumdi biiŋa maa, ka zaŋ o leei Yisifu zuliya niriba tuun kpɛma zaa zuɣulana.
en: Jeroboam was an able young man, and when Solomon noticed how hard he worked, he put him in charge of all the forced labor in the territory of the tribes of Manasseh and Ephraim.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi pam m-bɔhi, Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Naawuni Bia? A kamina ni a ti nahim ti ka saha na bi paai.
en: They came to Jesus and shouted, What do you want with us, Son of God? Did you come here to punish us before the right time.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni duri duli, ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi tiŋ maa puuni tuhir o sol na; o daa chɛ situra yɛbu ka di yuui, o mi daa bi gbɛri yiŋa; gbal kaba ni ka o daa kul gbɛra.
en: As Jesus was getting out of the boat, he was met by a man from this town. The man had demons in him. He had gone naked for a long time and no longer lived in a house, but in the graveyard.

dag: Ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Then the cloud covered the Meeting Tent and the Glory of the Lord filled the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n nya a jilima.
en: Then Moses requested, Please, let me see the dazzling light of your presence.

dag: Yɛhudianim shɛb a ni zaŋ zali ni bɛ su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaɣ shɛŋa fukumsi la be kpe ka bi lihi nya a, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku jɛm a wuna maa bee n-damdi tiŋ jɛm salima binnan shɛl a ni mali zal la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo.
en: Sir, you appointed three men to high positions in Babylon Province, but they have disobeyed you. Those Jews, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, refuse to worship your gods and the statue you have set up.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yaakubu daa ti duɣi ʒiɛri, ka Iso yi mɔɣu ni na ka kum wum o pam.
en: Once when Jacob was boiling stew, Esau came in from the field hungry.

dag: dama Naawuni yɛligu mini wunsuhigu nyɛla din chɛ ka di leeri din be kasi Naawuni sani.
en: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat.

dag: ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛha bie ka lan nyɛ bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli la sanna. Bɛ tɛhiri ni wuntia soli dolibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir nya azichi. Gbaam amaŋa ni niriba ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo.
en: There is constant bickering between people whose minds are ruined and who have been robbed of the truth. They think that godliness is a way to make money!.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gɔri gindi ka nyɛ bɛn gba kariti alizin biɛri daa zaŋ ti Duuma Yisa yuli n-yɛri alizin biɛri bɛn ʒi niriba zuɣu, Pool ni yihiri Yisa so waazu la yuli zuɣu, wariya ka chɛ ba.
en: There were some Jews who traveled around throwing out evil spirits. They tried to use the power of the name of the Lord Jesus against some people with evil spirits. They said, In the name of the Jesus whom Paul preaches, I command you.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n yipa leela yi dima n ni yɛli ya yɛlimaŋli zuɣu?.
en: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri kabirila sida tihi luhira. Yawɛ kabi Lɛbanɔn sida tihi luhi.
en: The LORDs voice breaks cedar trees— yes, the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Dauda ni man Yawɛ yɛliya: Bin diba ata ka n zal a ni a pii di ni zaɣ yini, ka n niŋ li ti a.
en: Go and tell David that I am giving him three choices. I will do whichever he chooses.

dag: Amaa n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: But I use the power of God to force out demons. This shows that Gods kingdom has now come to you.

dag: Maliya biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi mali yolisim, amaa lee di zaŋya yi yolisim maa tumdi tuumbiɛri; kul maliyala biɛhigu din wuhiri ni yi nyɛla Naawuni daba.
en: Live like free people, but dont use your freedom as an excuse to do evil. Live as those who are serving God.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi o kpee zabili ni ŋmanila ŋun gbaai ba so ŋun gariti tiba.
en: Getting involved in an argument that is none of your business is like going down the street and grabbing a dog by the ears.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan bɔrila shɛlikam pahi ni a zaŋ tum a Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin yihim li nayili kpanjɔɣu la ni.
en: And you may get any other things that you need for the Temple of your God. Use the money in the kings treasury to buy anything you need.

dag: Do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias ka o nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la daa nyɛla ŋun mali yu suŋ nimaani Yɛhudianim zaa sani.
en: In that city there was a man named Ananias, who faithfully obeyed the Law of Moses and was well liked by all the Jewish people living there.

dag: Sool daa bi yɛli shɛli dindali maa, dama o daa tɛhimi, Binshɛli n-niŋ o ka o bi be kasi, biɛhiŋ kani, o shiri bi bela kasi.
en: Saul didn't say anything that day, because he was thinking, Something must have happened to make David unfit to be at the Festival. Yes, something must have happened.

dag: Amaa lɛhu ni tooi wuhi ni di gari ŋun mal li tumdi tuma? Sua gari ŋun mal li ŋmari binyara? Jaaŋgbee bi kpuɣiri ninsal gbibi, amaa ninsala n-kpuɣiri jaaŋgbee gbibi.
en: But the Lord says, Can an ax claim to be greater than the one who uses it? Is a saw more important than the one who saws with it? A club doesn't lift up a person; a person lifts up a club.

dag: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɛza mini Finɛhas ni Abishua.
en: This is the line of Aaron's descendants: Eleazar, Phinehas, Abishua.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni tiligi ya. M bolila yi yuli, mani n-sun ya.
en: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord , created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ŋmanila lala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni tahima ni zani tariga.
en: So are the paths of all who forget God. Hope perishes for the godless.

dag: Miri ka a deei anab shɛb bɛn yɛr a ni a di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu, dama bɛ tɔɣisir a la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim daa chaŋ ti chɛ ka Sulemaana ba Naa Dauda buntaaŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
en: Zadok the priest, the prophet Nathan, Jehoiadas son Benaiah, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites went down and put Solomon on King Davids mule. They led him to Gihon.

dag: Dahin shɛli a yi ti yɛn tuhi a dimnima, a tɔbbihi ni ti saɣi ti a. A nachimba ni ti ŋmanila asiba maligim n-laɣimna ti gil a sheeni zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.

dag: Amaa ka Pita na kul ʒiɛya niŋdi gaafara, ka bɛ daa kana ti yooi dunoli maa nya o, ka di gari ba pam.
en: Meanwhile Peter kept on knocking. At last they opened the door, and when they saw him, they were amazed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Nimaani ka ŋun gbibi yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ min o naan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n sariakarita maa naan bahi ma zaa.
en: I am honest; I could reason with God; he would declare me innocent once and for all.

dag: A yiko ni ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima. A yuli zuɣu ka ti no n-taai bɛn kana ti lir ti la.
en: Weve pushed our foes away by your help; weve trampled our enemies by your name.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Naɣila yi ni yɛn be Babilɔn yuun pisopɔin la saha ti gari, ka n naanyi ka yi sanna nti chɛ ka n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali, ka n zaŋ ya labisi kpe na.
en: This is what the Lord says: Babylon will be powerful for years. After that time, I will come to you people who are living in Babylon. I will keep my good promise to bring you back to Jerusalem.

dag: N ŋmanila dabili ŋun ʒe o dan tooni. Wula ka n ni tooi tɔɣisi n dan yɛtɔɣa? Ya buriginli bee vuhim lan ka n ni.
en: So how can I, my lords servant, speak with you, my lord? Even now theres no strength in me, and I can barely breathe.

dag: N yi tɛhi Naawuni yɛla, n kul ŋuhirimi, ka n yi kul zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋ suhir o, gbariginsim nti kpɛri n ni.
en: I thought about you, God, and tried to tell you how I felt, but I could not.

dag: Kul paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni binshɛɣukam zaa puuni sahakam ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu.
en: Always give thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Bidib bil so n-naɣ be kpe m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi, amaa ka bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ salo ŋɔ zaa.
en: A youth here has five barley loaves and two fish. But what good is that for a crowd like this.

dag: Ka bɛ kukoya maa vuri daa chɛ ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli tanzaa sɔhigi, ka nyɔhi pali duu maa zaa.
en: The sound was so loud that it caused the frame around the door to shake, and the Temple was filled with smoke.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani kpa shɛli din boori bahiri niriba zuɣu mini tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni ku o bee o kum dali yi paai, o ni kpi bee ŋun chaŋ tɔb ni ka bɛ ti ku o.
en: As surely as the Lord lives, the Lord will kill Saul, or Saul will die a natural death or be killed in battle.

dag: Hal bɛ daa gbaai Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Ibram tizo bia la gba, ka zaŋ o nɛma pahi chaŋ.
en: They also took Lot, Abrams nephew who lived in Sodom, and everything he owned, and took off.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋla chirachira biɛhigu ti ba, ka bɛ chɛ ka Ijiptinim laani gindi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni kaman danyura m-be o tiri ni laani gindi la.
en: The Lord confused them, so they wander around and lead Egypt the wrong way. Everything they do is wrong. They are like drunks rolling in their vomit.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm? A nya Izraɛlnim ni tumdi din chihiri pam shɛm kpe ni bɛ kari ma bahi katiŋa ka chɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ? Amaa a na ni nya din chihiri shɛŋa din galisi pam gari lala.
en: He said to me: Human one, do you see what they are doing, the terribly detestable practices that the house of Israel is doing here that drive me far from my sanctuary? Yet you will see even more detestable practices than these.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, M ba Sool bɔrimi ni o ku a, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni asiba sa miri ka a yi palo; sa sɔɣimi luɣ shɛli polo.
en: and he warned David, My father is trying to have you killed, so be very careful. Hide in a field tomorrow morning, and I'll bring him there. Then I'll talk to him about you, and if I find out anything, I'll let you know.

dag: Dama n niriba maa tumla tuumbiɛri buyi zuɣu. Bɛ zaɣisi mani ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ, ka gbi bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi, kɔbil kaba din ku tooi deei kom.
en: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.

dag: Nir yi niŋ yomyom yɛli, N zaŋ bini yaakaza ti Naawuni, ka naanyi ti piligi tɛhir o ni po pɔri shɛli maa yɛla, di ni leei tɔŋ gbaag o.
en: Think carefully before you promise an offering to God. You might regret it later.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Never forget that you were slaves in Egypt; that is why I have given you this command.

dag: O yɛliya, N niriba, gbilisimiya tibili ka n yɛli ya ka yi wum. Izraɛlnima, n ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya. Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la.
en: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa la o ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni liɣiri tɔhibu shee la; amaa ka so daa bi gbaag o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: He spoke these words while he was teaching in the temple area known as the treasury. No one arrested him, because his time hadnt yet come.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be man Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, yɛlimiy o ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa.
en: Josiah, listen to what I am going to do.

dag: ni o wuh o kpambaliba o ni bɔri shɛm, ka wuh o kpamba mi yɛm.
en: Joseph gave instructions to the other leaders. He taught the older men.

dag: Bɛ ni yi gbaai tayiɣa ka o di vi shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim gba yɛn di vi; bɛ mini bɛ nanima ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim.
en: The Lord says, Just as a thief is disgraced when caught, so all you people of Israel will be disgraced—your kings and officials, your priests and prophets.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi lu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ ni daa nya binneen shɛb zaa; ka daa niŋ buɣim nyo fɔntin shɛŋa din daa kpalim zaa.
en: The men of Israel went back to the land of Benjamin. They killed the people and all the animals in every city. They destroyed everything they could find and burned every city they came to.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila taba, Zahin zahinda la n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: They said to one another, Here comes that dreamer.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi ti Masia yurilim ni? Muɣisigu bee wahala bee alaka bee fifali bee gbinfini bee barina bee takɔbi ni tooi yihi ti di ni?.
en: Who, then, can separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble do it, or hardship or persecution or hunger or poverty or danger or death?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yi Mɔab bɔpiɛligu maa ni n-du Nɛbo Zoli nti paai Pisiga Zo shɛli din be Jɛriko tooni polo la zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa wuh o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa, zaŋ Giliad hal ni Dan.
en: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛ ka yi suhuri doya, dama yi ni so ku kɔŋ o nyɛvili, amaa naɣila ŋariŋ ŋɔ kɔŋko n-naɣ ni saɣim.
en: Now I urge you to be encouraged. Not one of your lives will be lost, though we will lose the ship.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaɣisi Naawuni, ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, A ku kari ti saria di zuɣu.
en: How can the wicked despise God and say to themselves, He will not punish me?.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Do so n-daa mal o bidibis ayi.
en: Jesus told them yet another story: Once a man had two sons.

dag: Di saha ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a niriba ni a ni gul shɛb kaman piɛgul ŋɔ kul ni puhir a sahakam ka paɣir a ʒiɛmani kam puuni.
en: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa ti zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilalantaba ni naɣibihi pol kpaba n-kɔri ba Wahu Kuɣili din daa do m-baɣi Ɛnrɔgɛl la, ka boli nabihi bɛn nyɛ o mabihi zaa mini Juda nabihi zaa na.
en: One day, at Zoheleth Rock near En Rogel, Adonijah sacrificed some sheep, cattle, and fat calves as a fellowship offering. He invited his brothers and all the officers from Judah.

dag: Binzusa maa yi be yi sani, yi ni lihiri li ka teeri Yawɛ zaligunim yɛla ka dol li, ka ku doli yi suhuyubu ni yi nini ni tiɣi shɛli.
en: The tassels will serve as reminders, and each time you see them you will remember all my commands and obey them; then you will not turn away from me and follow your own wishes and desires.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛl yɛlli ŋɔ ka gbaaya yimaŋ ni Yisa tuumba maa, dama bɛ wuhibu ŋɔ mini bɛ tuma ŋɔ yi nyɛla salinim dini, di ni zan tariga;.
en: Heres my recommendation in this case: Distance yourselves from these men. Let them go! If their plan or activity is of human origin, it will end in ruin.

dag: N daa jɛmdi ti Duuma ni maŋsiɣisibu mini nintam m-pahi muɣisigu shɛŋa n ni daa nyari Yɛhudianim ni daa dooni guri ma sol la zuɣu.
en: Some of the Jews plotted against me and caused me a lot of sorrow and trouble. But I served the Lord and was humble.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin kul nyɛla naa sahakam; ka a yuli kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But you, O Lord , are king forever; all generations will remember you.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba tizɔpaɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your fathers sister. She is your fathers close relative.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa tu Naawuni maa yi bɛ sansani maa kpaŋa nti lab o kuɣa. Izraɛlnim maa daa tum Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the man who cursed to a place outside the camp. Then they killed him with stones. So the Israelites did just what the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Ti ku tooi zaŋ ti tizɔpaɣ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun bi guni, dama lala nyɛla vi ti sani.
en: So they tricked them by saying: You're not circumcised! It would be a disgrace for us to let you marry Dinah now.

dag: Ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee zuɣusaa ha n-daa nam li, ka ninsalinim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila salinsahi. O teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman sɔŋ la bee kaman tanti shɛl ni nir ni yɛn kpe m-beni.
en: God inhabits the earths horizon— its inhabitants are like locusts— stretches out the skies like a curtain and spreads it out like a tent for dwelling.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mɔabnim yɛliya, Judanim kul bemi kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Because Moab and Seir say, Aha! The house of Judah has become like all the nations.

dag: Di pala o ni daa saɣi ti ni daa kpam o jaande shɛm la kɔŋko, amaa omaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu ka o gba suhu daa ye yi sani kandina zuɣu.
en: Not only did he welcome our request; he was so eager to help that of his own free will he decided to go to you.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim Farisiinim paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka yi puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali.
en: The Lord said to him, The washing you Pharisees do is like cleaning only the outside of a cup or a dish. But what is inside you? You want only to cheat and hurt people.

dag: daa ti lo nia n tɛha puuni ni n vihi baŋ binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ni. Di nyɛla Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti daadamnim ka bɛ tumdi ka di tiri ba suhugarigu.
en: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu bimbir shɛŋa yi ni yɛn biri zuɣu, bimbira maa ni viɛla.
en: If any part of these animals dead bodies falls on seed that is to be planted, the seed is still clean.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ŋun guli Izraɛlnim pala gom ni gbaari so bee ŋun ni gbihi.
en: No! Israels protector never sleeps or rests!.

dag: Amaa o ni daa zaŋ li yɛl o ba min o biɛyanim maa, o ba daa tahila o zuɣu ka bɔh o, Zahim bɔ ka a lee zahim maa? M min a ma ni a biɛyanim ŋɔ shiri ti yɛn damdila a tooni.
en: He also told the dream to his father, and his father scolded him: What kind of a dream is that? Do you think that your mother, your brothers, and I are going to come and bow down to you.

dag: Ka n daa wum bɛ ni tabili ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli, ka bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi bɛn nyɛ bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na:.
en: Then I heard how many people had Gods mark on their foreheads. There were . They were from every tribe of the people of Israel:.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa boli sapashinnima ayi na ti yɛli ba, Malimiya shili n-zaŋ tɔbbihi kɔbisiyi mini wɔribariba pisopɔin ni kpan ŋmɛriba kɔbisiyi m-pa yimaŋ zuɣu ka yiɣisi kpe kurigu awɛi saha yuŋ ŋɔ n-chaŋ Siizaria.
en: The commander called two centurions and said, Prepare two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen to leave for Caesarea at nine oclock tonight.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri lu bɛ fɔntinsinim zuɣu ŋ-ŋme n-kabisi kur shɛŋa din kpari bɛ dunɔdaya la, ka ku ba bɛ birininim ni.
en: The sword will swing against their cities and kill their strong men. It will destroy their leaders.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni piligi niŋdi shɛli maa leei bɛ kali kaman Mɔdɛkai ni daa sab yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: So the Jews agreed to do what Mordecai had written to them. And they agreed to continue the celebration they had begun.

dag: Jɛra yi bɔhi jɛrilim bɔhigu, nyin di garigi ba jɛrilim garigibu, di yi pa lala a gba ni leei jɛrigu.
en: If you answer a silly question, you are just as silly as the person who asked it.

dag: Jilima mini dariza m-be o tuma ni, ka o wuntitali kul beni sahakam.
en: The things he does are great and glorious! There is no end to his goodness.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum lala maa di daa muɣis o mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya.
en: When King Herod heard about this, it upset him as well as everyone else in Jerusalem.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ pin kasinim maa, ka di kpɛhi ba alahichi ni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: or make themselves liable to punishment requiring compensation by eating their own holy offerings. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.

dag: Amaa ka di daa mali ti paai Naa Jɔash nam dibu yuun pisinaata saha ka maligumaaniba maa na bi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣ shɛli.
en: But by the twenty-third year of King Jehoash, the priests still hadnt repaired the temple.

dag: Ka ninsalinim yi yi dunia ŋɔ binyara din tari ba daɣiri ni, bɛ ni baŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia la puuni, di yi lan gbahi ba nyaŋ ba, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni be barina ni di saha maa gari di piligu ni.
en: People can be made free from the evil in the world. They can be made free by knowing our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. But if they go back into those evil things and are controlled by them, then it is worse for them than it was before.

dag: Ŋunkam ti zɔri ni o yi dabiɛm maa ni ni ti lu bɔɣili ni. Ka ŋunkam ti yiri bɔɣili maa ni na, tɔŋ ni gbaag o. Dama Mɔabnim tibidarigibo dali, n ni ti chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim niŋ ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Those who flee from terror will fall into a pit; those who escape the pit will be captured by the trap. I will bring upon Moab the year of its punishment, declares the LORD.

dag: Ti bi nyu dam kuli kaman yi ni tɛhiri shɛm maa, dama yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ na kul nyɛla asiba kurig awɛi.
en: These people are not drunk, as you suppose; it is only nine o'clock in the morning.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi, amaa duhimiya n yuli Izraɛlnim sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: You must not make my holy name impure so that I will be treated as holy by the Israelites. I am the LORD—the one who makes you holy.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka o zabi nyuli tinzun wuna zuɣu, ka daa lan niŋ binshɛŋa din chihira n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi.
en: They made him jealous by worshiping other gods. They made him angry with those disgusting idols.

dag: ka zaŋ n daanzinfa pipia la niŋ ŋun nyɛ bɛ zaa biasan la kpalaŋ nol ni m-pah o kawana liɣiri zuɣu. Ka o daa niŋ kaman Yisifu ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Put my cup, the silver cup, on top of the youngest brothers sack, together with the silver for his grain. So he did just as Joseph told him to do.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya n saɣisigu; Izraɛlnima, n di yuya ni yi wum n yɛligu!.
en: My people, I am warning you. Israel, listen to me!.

dag: Izraɛlnima, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ni Yawɛ ʒi yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli bee bɛ yi ŋari ya, yi Naawuni baɣa kani?.
en: You people of Israel say, God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly. But how can you say that?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Nyamiya, Jɔab puu m-baɣi m puu ka siŋkaafa be di ni la, chamiya ti niŋ buɣim nyo li. Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri chaŋ ti niŋ buɣim nyo puu maa.
en: Finally, Absalom told his servants, Joab's barley field is right next to mine. Go set it on fire! And they did.

dag: Niŋm yomyom zo nti kpe di ni, dama ka pa ni a paala nimaani, ti ku tooi niŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Zɔa.
en: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you get there. Because Lot called it small, the town was named Zoar.

dag: Kush bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Raama bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: The descendants of Cush were the people of Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah were the people of Sheba and Dedan. .

dag: Ka man Yawɛ kul ni wuhiri ya soli sahakam, ka tiri ya binshɛŋa din simdi ya wuntaŋ tulim pam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka tin ya yaa; ka chɛ ka yi be kaman pu shɛli din puuni mali kom; ka lan chɛ ka yi be kaman kɔbil nini din kom bi ŋmaara.
en: The Lord will always lead you and satisfy your needs in dry lands. He will give strength to your bones. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water, like a spring that never goes dry.

dag: Izraɛl yaɣili polɔnima: Parɔsh daŋ ni: Ramia mini Izia ni Malikija ni Mijamin ni Ɛliɛza ni Malikija so mi ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jɔshɛbashɛbɛt Tachɛmɔn nira ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la naa, ŋun daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisinii zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa tɔb tuhibu yim puuni la.
en: These are the names of Davids special soldiers: Josheb Basshebeth the Tahkemonite was captain of the kings special forces. He used his spear to kill men at one time.

dag: N ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ n ni ti ba binshɛli, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛli bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ba.
en: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.

dag: Wuntizɔra tɛhirila o ni yɛn garigi shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni zaɣ biɛɣu n-yirina.
en: Good people think before they answer. Evil people have a quick reply, but it causes trouble.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n zaligunima, ka miriya ka yi ti doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaya din chihiri la, ka miriya ka yi ti zaŋ li saɣim yimaŋa: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Other people have done these terrible sins, but you must obey my laws. You must not do any of these terrible sins. Do not make yourself filthy with these terrible sins. I am the Lord your God.

dag: N ni ti lo a alikauli ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So I will make my agreement with you, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Shɛbɛr mini Tirihana.
en: Maacah, Calebs secondary wife, gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.

dag: N na bi birigi zaligu shɛli din daa yi o noli ni na, n zaŋ o noli ni yɛligu niŋ n suhu ni.
en: I always do what God commands; I follow his will, not my own desires.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti chana, di yuma ayi nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ayi dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: On the first day of the second month in the second year after the people of Israel left Egypt, the Lord spoke to Moses there in the Tent of his presence in the Sinai Desert. He said.

dag: ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya, ka yi paɣiba kpalim pakoya, ka yi bihi gba leei kpibisi.
en: Ill be furious, and Ill kill you with the sword. Then your wives will be widows, and your children will be orphans.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi sara shɛli din kpihindi alahichi la mini yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa tuuli la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi la gba naŋgbambili, ka di zaa doya tuhi taba.
en: Make fifty loops on the one curtain in the first set and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is in the second set. The loops should be opposite each other.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ li yɛl a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba, ka chɛ ka bɛ be kasi din ni chɛ ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka di niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza alahiziba, ka o vaai yiɣisi zani ka bɔh o kpambaliba, Pa niriba ata ka ti lo mihi niŋ buɣim ŋɔ ni la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Naa, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar jumped to his feet. He was very surprised and he asked his advisors, We tied only three men, and we threw only three men into the fire. Is that right? His advisors said, Yes, King.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidibisi maa daa yi mɔɣu ni na ti wum li ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi ka bɛ je suli; Shɛkɛm ni daa tum jɛrilim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga saɣim maa zuɣu. Dama di daa bi simdi ni lala niŋ.
en: just as Jacob's sons were coming in from the fields. When they heard about it, they were shocked and furious that Shechem had done such a thing and had insulted the people of Israel by raping Jacob's daughter.

dag: Liya ni daa nya ka o bi lan dɔɣiri maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Yaakubu ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Leah saw that she could have no more children. So she gave her slave girl Zilpah to Jacob.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi dimnim ti nyaŋ ya, ka sun ya. Ka yi ti guura ka so bi kariti ya.
en: I will turn against you, so that you will be defeated, and those who hate you will rule over you; you will be so terrified that you will run when no one is chasing you.

dag: N daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ka yi sanna, ka daa lan chɛ ka ti mabi so pah o zuɣu na. Taitus daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri? Pa biɛhigu yini ka ti mali? Pa so yini ka ti doli?.
en: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.

dag: Dama Naawuni bindirigu nyɛla din yi alizanda ni na, ka nyɛ din tiri dunianim nyɛvili.
en: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.

dag: N yi tɛhi ni n yiŋ nyɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka n yi zaŋ m bindoo yɛrigi zibisim ni.
en: I might hope for the grave to be my new home. I might hope to make my bed in the dark grave.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Smɛɛna Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu ka nyɛ ŋun daa kpi ka lan nee la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: These are the words of the one who is the first and the last, who died and came back to life.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun ti o niriba Izraɛlnim vuhim kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la; ka o yɛtɔɣ yini gba bi kɔŋ palibu kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o dabili Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: Praise the Lord who has given his people peace, as he promised he would. He has kept all the generous promises he made through his servant Moses.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun gbib o nuu vɔr o, Chɛ ka m bɔbili gbaai duu ŋɔ ni tam daantal shɛŋa zuɣu n-zaŋ mmaŋ dalim li.
en: A young man was leading Samson by the hand, and Samson said to him, I need to lean against something. Take me over to the columns that hold up the roof.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be yi tooni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni tuhi tɔbu maa tin ya kaman o ni daa kul niŋ shɛm Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ninni la.
en: The Lord your God will lead you, and he will fight for you, just as you saw him do in Egypt.

dag: Gɛrishomnim mi, bɛ daa zaŋla Manaasa zuliya pirigili tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti ba. Bɛ daa zaŋla Golan din be Bashan la mini Ashitarɔt ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: To the Gershomites from the clan of half the tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan with its pasturelands and Ashtaroth with its pasturelands.

dag: Naawuni noli ni di binshɛɣukam ti ku be tiŋ maa ni. Kulla Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la n-yɛn beni, ka o daba ni jɛmd o.
en: Nothing that God judges guilty will be there in that city. The throne of God and the Lamb will be in the city. Gods servants will worship him.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa ni yihiri bindiri sun shɛŋa zaa na nyɛla a ni chɛ ka na shɛb su ti maa dini ti daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛna n-lan su ti niŋgbuna yiko zaŋ tabili ti binnɛma n-niŋdi bɛ suhuyubu, ka ti be nandahima pam ni.
en: What the land produces goes to the kings that you put over us because we sinned. They do as they please with us and our livestock, and we are in deep distress.

dag: Dama yɛlikpan shɛli n ni daa zaŋ tin ya la nyɛla n gba ni daa tuui deei shɛli. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa kpila ti daalahichi zuɣu kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm;.
en: I gave you the message that I received. I told you the most important truths: that Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say;.

dag: dama m mabih anu na beni, ka o chaŋ ti lee saɣisi bɛna, ka bɛn ti ku kana ti kpe azaaba shɛl ni n ni be ŋɔ.
en: Let him warn my five brothers, so they won't come to this horrible place.

dag: Amaa ka o ba daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, M bia, m mi ni Manaasa gba zuliya ni ti galisi; amaa o tizo ŋɔ ni ti gar o, ka o zuliya ni ti galisi pam.
en: But his father refused and said, I know, son. I know. Manasseh is the firstborn. He will be great and will be the father of many people. But his younger brother will be greater than he is. And the younger brothers family will be much larger.

dag: Nir yi niŋ binshɛli tahima ka ti bi nya li, di damdila o suhu, amaa nir yi bɔri shɛli ka nya li, di nyɛla nyɛvili tia.
en: When hope is crushed, the heart is crushed, but a wish come true fills you with joy.

dag: ka o yi ti zal o ni yɛn pirig o ni su shɛli ti ba dahin shɛli, o ka soli ni o niŋ o ni yuri paɣ so maa bidibiga kaman o bikpɛm sani, ka chɛ o ni bi yuri o paɣ so maa bia ŋun nyɛ kpɛm maa.
en: On the day when the man decides what will go to each of his children as an inheritance, he isnt allowed to treat his loved wifes son as the oldest male rather than his unloved wifes son, who is the real oldest male.

dag: pakoli ŋɔ ni kaɣindi ma sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kari bɛ saria ŋɔ n-ti o nasara. Di yi pa lala, o waawaayili kandina ŋɔ ni nyɔni n nyee pam. .
en: yet because of all the trouble this widow is giving me, I will see to it that she gets her rights. If I don't, she will keep on coming and finally wear me out.

dag: Kulla pumpɔŋɔ ka n nam yɛla maa. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi wum di yɛla maa; dinzuɣu yi ku tooi yɛli ni yi pun mi li.
en: Only now am I making them happen; nothing like this took place in the past. If it had, you would claim that you knew all about it.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mali tahima o yuli zuɣu.
en: and on him all peoples will put their hope.

dag: Bɛ piɛma diri pam, bɛ tɔbiri gba guri viɛla. Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ŋmanila pilima, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi kalima zɔri gindi yomyom kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la.
en: their arrows are sharp; all their bows drawn; their horses hooves are like flint; their wheels like the whirlwind.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Mɔdɛkai Ɛsta ni yɛli shɛm.
en: When Mordecai was told what Esther had said.

dag: Nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali ni di ti tum tuma o kalinsi nyaaŋa, di bi tumdi tuma naɣila o ti shiri kpimi;.
en: When someone dies and leaves a will, there must be proof that the one who wrote the will is dead.

dag: Ka a mi o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛŋa Ɛfɛsus la gba yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti Duuma chɛ ka o ti nya nambɔzɔbo o sani ŋun ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: May the Lord allow him to find his mercy on that day .

dag: ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He raised his voice and made his address: The oracle of Balaam, Beors son; the oracle of a man whose eye is open.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni chɛ ka tinvura bɛn nyɛ garinsi lu yi zuɣu n-dimdi ya, ka yi ku tooi niŋ ba tim.
en: Watch out! the Lord says. I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, ka dimbɔŋɔ na nyɛla din pɔra a sani, ka a lan yɛli n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm saha shɛli din na kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a lan wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm yuma din kanna.
en: Yet now you are doing even more; you have made promises about my descendants in the years to come, and you, Lord God, are already treating me like someone great.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu sa ti yɛn neei ka n yi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, hal do yino gba, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma n ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm maa, hal ŋun niŋm ma gari lala gba.
en: May God deal harshly with me, David, and worse still if I leave alive even one single one who urinates on a wall belonging to him come morning.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba garigi yɛli.
en: Then Job answered:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo:.
en: In the plains of Moab across the Jordan from Jericho the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbib piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin m-be Alikauli Adaka la tooni. Ka dabisi shɛli din ti pahir ayopɔin dali, nyin chɛ ka maligumaaniba maa zaŋ kikahi m-piɛbira, ka yi chaŋ gili Jɛriko maa napɔŋ buyopɔin.
en: Seven priests, each carrying a trumpet, are to go in front of the Covenant Box. On the seventh day you and your soldiers are to march around the city seven times while the priests blow the trumpets.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie taba binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: onyx stones or other gems for the sacred vest and breastpiece.

dag: Ka n ni kpaŋ mmaŋ niŋ di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm, ka di chɛ ka yi ti tooi teeri dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla sahakam n kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: I will try my best to make sure you remember these things even after I am gone.

dag: Dinzuɣu Samarianim maa ni daa paai Yisa sani bɛ daa balim o mi ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani; ka o daa kpalim niŋ dabisi muna ayi nimaani.
en: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them, and Jesus stayed there two days.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋ bɛ nɛma pam n-zɔri ni bɛ du kulitihi kulibɔŋ tiligi.
en: Therefore, they carry what they had stored up, all their provisions to the Valley of the Willows.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba m-bɔŋɔ: Libini daŋ niriba mini Hiburɔn daŋ niriba ni Mahili daŋ niriba ni Mushi daŋ niriba ni Kɔra daŋ niriba. Amiram ba n-daa nyɛ Kɔhat.
en: These are also family groups from the tribe of Levi: the Libnite family group; the Hebronite family group; the Mahlite family group; the Mushite family group; the Korahite family group. Amram was from the Kohath family group.

dag: A chɛ ka n dolintab kaɣiri ma mi, a chɛ ka n leela bɛ ni zaɣisi so. Bɛ kpari ma mi niŋ duu, ka n ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: Youve made my friends distant. Youve made me disgusting to them. I cant escape. Im trapped!.

dag: Yinim Speennima, labimiya yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni. Kpe lan pala teeku kulinoli.
en: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti tim Adɔniram ŋun daa su tuma fukumsi la Izraɛlnim sani, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lab o kuɣa ku. Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa yiɣisi n-niŋ yomyom kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-zo kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When King Rehoboam sent Hadoram to them , the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam quickly got into his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.

dag: Niriba biɛla bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya maa ni ti lab bɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sanna.
en: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi li ka di leei Naawuni chuɣu yuuni puuni. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka di simdi ka yi gbib li la gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa ni.
en: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka tirisi tooni biɛla ha kaman nira ni ni tooi lab kuɣili paai shɛl tariga nti gbani tiŋa n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra.
en: Jesus walked on a little way before he knelt down and prayed.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ilaisha, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Bɛtɛl. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Bɛtɛl.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, Stay here, because the LORD has sent me to Bethel. But Elisha said, As the LORD lives and as you live, I wont leave you. So they went down to Bethel.

dag: Naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb kɔŋko n-ni nya li, ka n ni ti zaŋ o napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ti o min o bihi, o ni ʒe Yawɛ yim ni o suhu zaa zuɣu.
en: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.

dag: Ka Sintani yi kariti Sintani bahira, o ŋmaligimi tuhir omaŋa m-bala; ka wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani?.
en: So if one group is fighting another in Satan's kingdom, this means that it is already divided into groups and will soon fall apart!.

dag: N daa zaŋ ya bela tiŋgban nɛl ni yuun pihinahi, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba ni namda gba daa bi chahi.
en: He led you through the desert for years, and in all that time, your clothes and sandals did not wear out.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Baalipɛrazim nti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa nimaani ka yɛli, Yawɛ kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baal Pɛrazim maa.
en: So David arrived at Baal-perazim and defeated the Philistines there. He said, The LORD has burst out against my enemies, the way water bursts out! That is why that place is called Baal-perazim.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After the Israelites had settled in the Amorite territory.

dag: O ni ti niŋ ninvuɣ titali, ka bɛ ni ti boon o la Zallakudura Naa Bia, ka ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti zaŋ o yab Naa Dauda nam ti o.
en: He will be great and he will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of David his father.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyin daadam, yilimi kuyilli bahi Taai zuɣu.
en: Mortal man, sing a funeral song for Tyre.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa chɛ ka o bidibis ayopɔin maa kana ti gari Samuɛl tooni, ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Jɛsi, Yawɛ bi pii bɛmbɔŋɔ ni so.
en: One by one, Jesse told all seven of his sons to go over to Samuel. Finally, Samuel said, Jesse, the Lord hasn't chosen any of these young men.

dag: Suhu n-nyɛ din mali yɔhiŋgu gari binshɛɣukam; di bi ʒe yim. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ li?.
en: The most cunning heart— its beyond help. Who can figure it out?.

dag: nti suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili. Ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: They begged him just to let them touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.

dag: Yɛnnim ni nya jilima, amaa tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni di vi.
en: Wise people will gain an honorable reputation, but stupid people will only add to their own disgrace.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi ni, Mahili mini Mushi ni Jaazia n-daa nyɛ kpamba Mɛrari daŋ ni.
en: Mahli, Mushi, and Jaaziah, descendants of Merari.

dag: Daadam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be Izraɛl tiŋgban shɛŋa din bahi yoli la puuni na kul yɛrimi, Ibrahimma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yino, amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o ni o su. Amaa tinim galisiya, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ zaŋla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti ni ti su li.
en: Son of man, there are Israelites who live in the ruined cities in Israel. They are saying, Abraham was only one man, and God gave him all this land. Now, we are many people, so surely this land belongs to us! It is our land.

dag: Nyin naa ni bɔri ni ti wuh a shɛli ŋɔ to pam, ka so ku tooi wuh a li naɣila wuna din mini ninsalinim bi laɣim bela n-ni tooi niŋ lala.
en: What Your Majesty is asking for is so difficult that no one can do it for you except the gods, and they do not live among human beings.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri pali ninvuɣ biɛtali balibu kam. Dina n-nyɛ: Tuumbiɛri mini bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni biɛr biɛɣu ni nyuli ni ninvuɣ kubo ni naŋgbankpeeni ni yɔhiŋ ni jɛlinsi. Bɛ nyɛla munaafichinim mini.
en: They are filled with all kinds of wickedness, evil, greed, and vice; they are full of jealousy, murder, fighting, deceit, and malice. They gossip.

dag: Ka Nagai daa nyɛ Maat bia, ka Maat nyɛ Matatias so bia, ka Matatias maa nyɛ Sɛmɛin bia ka Sɛmɛin nyɛ Josɛk bia, ka Josɛk mi nyɛ Jɔda bia.
en: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba na ti ʒili, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ku lan tooi yihi ba n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa ni yaha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!.

dag: Yi nyɛla ti shɛhiranima, ka Naawuni gba di ti shɛhira m-pahi yi zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛdaniŋdiba ŋɔ polo, ti biɛhigu wuhiya ni ti dolila wuntia soli ka tumdi din tuhi ka ka galimi.
en: You and God are witnesses of how holy, just, and blameless we were toward you believers.

dag: ka lan nyɛ nanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn niriba anu pun lu, ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn kpalim maa ni yino be nam ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka yino la ŋun na bi di, amaa o yi ti di, o ku yuui.
en: Five kings have fallen, the one is, and the other hasnt yet come. When that king comes, he must remain for only a short time.

dag: Ti mabihi, di bi kpa talahi ni ti lan sab dabisa mini saha yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli polo;.
en: Now, brothers and sisters, we dont need to write to you about times and dates.

dag: Zaŋm taaŋkɔro paɣi ma ka n yi daɣiri ni, ka paligi laɣilaɣi gari gumbɔrigu.
en: Remove my sin, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛ mali taali alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa lo Masia san la puuni.
en: Then they will be judged for setting aside their earlier commitment.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali takɔriti niŋ li, ka di sambani polo yɛlima, ka di puuni polo nyɛ zaɣ muɣilinga.
en: He made recessed and latticed windows for the temple.

dag: N yɛr a mi, Yiɣisim zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: I tell you, stand up. Take your mat and go home.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n wum Ifriim daŋ ni fabindi yɛra, A darigi ti tibili, ka ti saɣi ti tibidarigibo maa. Ti daa ŋmanila naɣisa so bɛ ni bi baligi. Zaŋmi ti labisina, ka chɛ ka ti ka a sanna, dama nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: The people of Israel moan and say to me, We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord , broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa ka bɔhir o, Bɔ ka ti yɛn nyu.
en: The people complained to Moses and asked, What are we going to drink.

dag: Hal yinim Izraɛlnim ni tum bi ʒe yim tuma maa zaa yoli, di bi simdi ni di zuɣu chɛ ka Judanim gba kpe taali ni. Di kpɛnya Giligal tiŋ puuni bee n-kpɛnya Bɛtavɛn, ka miriya ka yi po n-yɛli Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Even though you people of Israel are unfaithful to me, may Judah not be guilty of the same thing. Don't worship at Gilgal or Bethaven, or make promises there in the name of the living Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni ka gahim kuɣ polipoli diba anu n-niŋ o piɛgul koligu ni, ka o kuɣilɔŋ be o nuu ni ka o vu m-miri Filistia doo maa ha.
en: He took his walking stick in his hand and went to find five smooth stones from the stream. He put the five stones in his shepherds bag and held his sling in his hand. Then he went out to meet the Philistine.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Naawuni nam kana ni yiko.
en: And he went on to say, I tell you, there are some here who will not die until they have seen the Kingdom of God come with power.

dag: A ko pin titali zali amaŋa, ka me binshɛŋa din dundu zal amaŋa niriba laɣiŋgu shee kam.
en: After all those things, you made a mound for worshiping that false god. You built those places for worshiping false gods on every street corner.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti ni bɔh o nya.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Isnt there any other prophet of the LORD whom we could ask.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni o zahim o, dama omaŋmaŋ daa mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: He said this to test Philip, since he already knew what he was going to do.

dag: Dinzuɣu n kumdila Sibima mini Jaza wain tihi zuɣu. N kumdila Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim zuɣu, dama bɛ bi kpuɣi puu atam din ni chɛ ka bɛ suhuri piɛla.
en: Now I weep for Sibmah's vines as I weep for Jazer. My tears fall for Heshbon and Elealeh, because there is no harvest to make the people glad.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa baŋ ni bɛ kɔŋ nasara. Izraɛlnim maa ni daa niŋ bɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn sɔɣ do n-gu Gibia la naani zuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa sani zo.
en: Then the Benjaminites saw that they had been defeated. The Israelites had given ground to the Benjaminites because they relied on the ambush that they had set around Gibeah.

dag: Ashili pini nyɛla din maari suhuyiɣisili, ka ashilɔni birapu tibu gba nyɛ din maari suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: A secret gift calms anger, and a hidden bribe removes furious wrath.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ ni ninsalinim zaa baŋ Yawɛ yiko ni galisi shɛm. Ka di chɛ ka yi lu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura sahakam.
en: Because of this everyone on earth will know how great the Lord 's power is, and you will honor the Lord your God forever.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi la.
en: the table with all its equipment and the bread of the presence.

dag: zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: The total number of men counted was , men.

dag: Bɛ yi di daa tɛhirila bɛ ni daa pun yi tin shɛl na la yɛla, bɛ daa naan nya soli n-lan lab nimaani.
en: If they were thinking about the country they had left, they could have gone back.

dag: Ti Naawuni, wumma, bɛ ʒiɛm ti; chɛ ka bɛ daansarisi maa ŋmaligi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔn shɛli kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: Nehemiah prayed and said, Our God, listen to our prayer. These men hate us. Sanballat and Tobiah are insulting us. Make bad things happen to them. Make them ashamed, like people taken away as prisoners.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, nyama, n niriba Izraɛlnim maa fabila maa paai ma, ka n nya Ijiptinim maa ni tiri ba wahala shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: I have indeed heard the cry of my people, and I see how the Egyptians are oppressing them.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga. Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: The rest of the seeds fell on good ground where they grew and produced a hundred times as many seeds. When Jesus had finished speaking, he said, If you have ears, pay attention.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn polo ni o ni yɛn niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla ti gbaai bɛ tiŋ maa nim dabiɛm.
en: So listen to the plan that I have made against the city of Babylon and to what I intend to do to its people. Even their children will be dragged off, and everyone will be horrified.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ bini pɔbi goli muni ninni, ka yɛrig o sagbani pa di zuɣu.
en: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu min o bidibisi maa.
en: Then God said to Noah and his sons.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti niŋ o yɛda nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.

dag: Naawuni kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinim dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: God looks down from heaven at people to see if there are any who are wise, any who worship him.

dag: Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nimaani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinunaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyɔbu. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn kpalim nyaaŋa doli gbilligbilli ni bɛ tuuta.
en: These , troops will march into battle last.

dag: Ka ti gba biɛhigu ŋmani zuliya shɛb biɛhigu, ti naa maa ni su ti, ka ni yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ti tuhi tɔb kam.
en: so that we will be like other nations, with our own king to rule us and to lead us out to war and to fight our battles.

dag: O yi niŋ ya kaman o daba n-nyɛn ya la bee n-saɣim yi bini bee n-din ya zalinsi bee n-ʒiɛm ya bee ŋ-ŋmɛn ya tapaɣa, yi dir o suɣilo.
en: I say this because you are even patient with someone who forces you to do things and uses you. You are patient with those who trick you, or think they are better than you, or hit you in the face!.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n ku lan niŋ yinim bɛ kpalim ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ kurimbuni ha niriba maa shɛm maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.

dag: N niriba ŋmanila wubiga ka tɔra laɣim gili ni bɛ di o. Cham ti laɣim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa, n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti ŋub o.
en: My own people have become like a dying animal surrounded by vultures. These birds are circling around her. Come on, wild animals. Come get something to eat.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti zaŋ o puu ni bindira na nti mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Some time later, Cain presented an offering to the LORD from the lands crops.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee kabiɛlli kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di yi pa lala, di kul ni nyɛla kabiɛl yini maa ko; amaa di yi kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di ni nabi.
en: I tell you for certain that a grain of wheat that falls on the ground will never be more than one grain unless it dies. But if it dies, it will produce lots of wheat.

dag: O daa tɛhimi ni Pool ni ti o liɣiri, dinzuɣu ka o daa kul timdi ti boon o na waawaayili ka o min o ti diri alizama.
en: But Felix had another reason for talking with Paul. He hoped Paul would pay him a bribe, so he sent for Paul often and talked with him.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ. Ibram daa nyɛla yuun pisopɔinnaanu nira saha shɛl o ni daa yiɣisi Haran maa.
en: When Abram was seventy-five years old, he started out from Haran, as the Lord had told him to do; and Lot went with him.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n yi ni tooi? A bi mi ni binshɛɣukam zaa nandi ŋun niŋ yɛda sani.
en: Jesus said to him, If you can do anything? All things are possible for the one who has faith.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bol o yaha, Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka o yɛl o, M bia, m bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni.
en: Again the Lord called, Samuel! Again Samuel ran to Eli and said, Here I am. You called me. Eli said, I didnt call you. Go back to bed.

dag: Amaa o yi ka yiko din ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, dindina o ni kɔhi shɛli maa kul ni kpalim be ŋun da li maa nuu ni hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni. Di yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka bɛ deei li n-labisi ti o.
en: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu kaman di ni daa sabi shɛm; ka daa maani sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Maligunim maa kalinli daa dolila zaligu ni wuhi ni bɛ maani li dabisili kam shɛm.
en: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.

dag: M mini bɛn be n sani yi ti kul piɛb ti kikahi; yi gba yin piɛbimiya yi kikahi bɛ sansani maa luɣilikam zaa ka kuhi yɛli, Tuhimiya ti Yawɛ mini Gidiɔn.
en: You men surround the enemy camp. I and all the men with me will blow our trumpets. When we blow our trumpets, you blow your trumpets too. Then shout these words: For the Lord and for Gideon.

dag: Doli wuhibu maŋ shɛŋa n ni daa zaŋ wuh a la yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la puuni.
en: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.

dag: ka ninvuɣ yino bee a niriba Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino yi ti baŋ din muɣis o o suhu ni, ka teeg o nuu tiri duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: listen to their prayers. If any of your people Israel, out of heartfelt sorrow, stretch out their hands in prayer toward this Temple.

dag: n-yiini wumpaɣibo yila pampam, ka yɛr a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I sing a hymn of thanksgiving and tell of all your wonderful deeds.

dag: Ka ti daa lan nya Nɛfilimnima ; ka tinim ŋmanila sakɔri bɛ sani. Lala n-shiri nyɛ ti bɛ sani.
en: We saw there the Nephilim . We saw ourselves as grasshoppers, and thats how we appeared to them.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mali suhupiɛlli bɛn je ma daashaara nyabu zuɣu bee m mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu ni paai ba zuɣu.
en: I have never been glad when my enemies suffered, or pleased when they met with disaster;.

dag: N ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu ŋɔ wuhiri ni lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ashiya din be ninsalinim suhuri ni saria Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: on the day when, according to my gospel, God will judge the hidden truth about human beings through Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka biasani ti yɛl o ba, M ba, tim ma fal shɛli n ni ti yɛn di a kalinsi nyaaŋa pumpɔŋɔ. Ka doo maa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛli m-pirigi ti o bihi maa.
en: The younger son said to his father, Give me now the part of your property that I am supposed to receive someday. So the father divided his wealth between his two sons.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Masia be yi suhuri ni yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi ba nyaɣa zani ka me yimaŋ tam yurilim zuɣu.
en: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.

dag: N yuun kɔbiga ni pisi m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. N lan ka yaa din ni chaŋ shɛli. Ka Yawɛ pun yɛli ma, A ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: I am years old, and I am no longer able to be your leader. And besides that, the Lord your God has told me that he won't let me cross the Jordan River.

dag: Ka a ti niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ li pa di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di binyila maa zaa zuɣu, ka mali salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover the top, the horns, and all four sides of the altar with pure gold. Then put gold trim all around the altar.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli nanim mini zuɣulaannim ni niriba bɛn pahi, Tuma maa galisiya ka di shɛhi wɔɣ ni taba, ka ti woliwoli taba gooni maa gbini.
en: Then I spoke to the leading families, the officials, and the rest of the people. I said, This is a very big job and we are spread out along the wall. We are far from one another.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kawaan daŋda mini yi wain daŋda ni yi kpa daŋda ni yi ni tuui chɛ biŋkɔbiri kɔb shɛŋa ti o.
en: You must also give the priest the first portions of your grain, wine, and oil, and the first of your sheeps shearing.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ŋme ma, amaa m bi nya daŋa. Bɛ bu ma, amaa di bi biɛra. Bɔ saha ka n nini yɛn neei? N lan bɔrila wain ni n nyu.
en: You will say, They hit me, but I never felt it. They beat me, but I dont remember it. Now I cant wake up. I need another drink.

dag: ka di pala binnamda maa kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili tinim bɛn daŋ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋɔ gba kul ŋuhirimi ti suhuri ni n-guhiri saha shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti zal o bihi zaani, ka fa ti niŋgbuna zaa bahi la.
en: But it is not just creation alone which groans; we who have the Spirit as the first of God's gifts also groan within ourselves as we wait for God to make us his children and set our whole being free.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la gari wain ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: There they gave him some wine mixed with myrrh, but he refused to drink it.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba je ni so kpahi bɛ zuɣuri ni; bɛ ku chaŋ yɛnnim sani.
en: Conceited people do not like to be corrected; they never ask for advice from those who are wiser.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛriko la ni daa nya Ilaisha ka o miri ba na ka bɛ yɛli, Ilaija shia la shiri be Ilaisha ni. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa.
en: When the prophets from Jericho saw what happened, they said to each other, Elisha now has Elijah's power. They walked over to him, bowed down.

dag: Amaa n wuhiri n yurilim ni galisi shɛm niriba tusatusa bɛn yuri ma ka doli n zaligunim sani.
en: But I will be very kind to people who love me and obey my commands. I will be kind to their families for thousands of generations.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisifu daa ti yɛn kpi ka teei n-tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm yɛla zali; ka daa wuhi ba bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sɔɣibu polo.
en: It was faith that made Joseph, when he was about to die, speak of the departure of the Israelites from Egypt, and leave instructions about what should be done with his body.

dag: Ka n daa nya shi biɛr ata bɛn ŋmani poloya, ka bɛ yiri waɣ biɛ tital la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni anabi ʒirilan la noya ni na.
en: Then I saw three unclean spirits that looked like frogs. They were coming out of the mouth of the dragon, the mouth of the beast, and the mouth of the false prophet.

dag: Daadam, sabimi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yuli sɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Babilɔn naa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, write down today's date, because the king of Babylonia has just begun attacking the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla shihirili ni shɛhira Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ yi ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ niriba bɛn nahindi ba la, o ni tim ŋun ni fa ba bahi bɛ sani ka o ti fa ba bahi.
en: They will be symbols of the Lord Almighty's presence in Egypt. When the people there are oppressed and call out to the Lord for help, he will send someone to rescue them.

dag: Naa, nyini n-nyɛ ti shɛli din wɔɣa ka mali kpiɔŋ maa. A galisiya hal ti tɔr la sagbana, ka su dunia ŋɔ zaa yiko.
en: King, you are that tree! You have become great and powerful. You are like the tall tree that touched the sky—your power reaches to the far parts of the earth.

dag: O chɛ ka ti tahi a nasara dibu suhupiɛlli tahigu, ka sa ti tuutanim ti Naawuni yuli zuɣu. Yawɛ deem a suhigu zaa.
en: Then we will rejoice that youve been helped. We will fly our flags in the name of our God. Let the LORD fulfill all your requests!.

dag: Pa yinim m-bo yɛla ŋɔ ti yimaŋa yi ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun mali ya chana la zuɣu?.
en: Havent you brought this on yourself by abandoning the LORD your God, who has directed your paths?.

dag: Teem a ni daa zal a dabili Musa zaligu shɛl la yɛla. A daa yɛl o, Yi yi bi ʒe ma yim, n ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni.
en: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.

dag: M mali n yɛtɔɣa shili, m mi ni bɛ ni wuhi ni n ka galimi.
