en: I am ready now to defend myself. I will carefully present my arguments. I know I will be shown to be right.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Dol o chaŋ ka di zɔr o dabiɛm. Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi dol o chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o.
en: The Lord s angel said to Elijah, Go with the captain. Dont be afraid of him. So Elijah went with the captain to see King Ahaziah.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa guhi daba ayopɔin, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ.
en: Seven days later Noah sent the dove out again.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti leei bukpahinima. Di ti bɔnya bɛ shee din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ya daɣiri ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not go for advice to people who consult the spirits of the dead. If you do, you will be ritually unclean. I am the Lord your God.

dag: ni Hilɛn mini di momaha tiŋgbani ni Dɛbir mini di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: Hilen with its pasturelands, Debir with its pasturelands.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛtali lɔɣu lɛbigirila bɛ puya ni, ka leei sapaɣ binsom bɛ puya maa ni.
en: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.

dag: O kɔrila naɣilahi mini naɣ pol kpaba ni piɛri pam mali sara, ka boli nabihi zaa mini maligumaana Abiata ni tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Jɔab, amaa ka bi bol a bia Sulemaana ŋuna.
en: He has offered a sacrifice of many bulls, sheep, and fattened calves, and he invited your sons, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the commander of your army to the feast, but he did not invite your son Solomon.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, di zɔri dabiɛm. Naawuni pun deeg a suhigu dabisi shɛli dali a ni daa tɛhi baŋ ka siɣis amaŋa ni di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛla maa la. A suhigu maa deebu zuɣu ka n kana maa.
en: Then the man said to me, Dont be afraid, Daniel, because from the day you first set your mind to understand things and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. Ive come because of your words!.

dag: Yi yi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o shiri ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ, amaa yi yi bi chɛ so daalahichi paŋ o, o daalahichi maa na kul ni ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you forgive anyones sins, they are forgiven; if you dont forgive them, they arent forgiven.

dag: Yi bi mi ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu ka ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ti ku bahi yoli.
en: It is better for one man to die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed. But you dont realize this.

dag: Sool ni daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka kpi shɛm m-bala. O daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka bi doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka daa lan chaŋ ti buɣi baɣa m-bɔr sɔŋsim.
en: Saul died because he was not faithful to the Lord . He did not obey the Lord s word. Saul also went to a medium and asked her for advice.

dag: Saamba bɛn be n yiŋa tamla n yɛla. Ka paɣ sara bɛn nyɛ n tumtumdiba zaŋ ma leei sana. N leela tinzun nira bɛ sani.
en: My servant girls and visitors in my home look at me as if I am a stranger and a foreigner.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka tinim bɛn daa tuui mali tahima Masia ni la chɛ ka ti biɛhigu nyɛ din tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: Let us, then, who were the first to hope in Christ, praise God's glory!.

dag: Ti suhuri fuŋmi, ka ti luri bɔɣa ni, yɛl biɛɣu paai ti, ka ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: We have been frightened. We have fallen into a pit. We have been badly hurt. We have been broken.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhu yini, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun mali suhu yini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinima, a nyɛla ŋun nyandi ba.
en: You never do wrong to those who have done no wrong. But you outsmart the wicked, no matter how clever they are.

dag: Gbaai yihila Goshɛn, Izraɛlnim ni daa be yaɣ shɛli polo maa, ka sakuɣa maa daa bi lu.
en: The only place where hail didnt fall was in the land of Goshen where the Israelites lived.

dag: Naawuni, Fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi. Fam ma ninkuunsinim mini bɛn bi doli zaligu la nuu ni bahi.
en: My God, rescue me from wicked people, from the power of cruel and evil people.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣili paɣ maa lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: But Jesus knew what happened. He said, Why are you bothering this woman? She did a very good thing for me.

dag: Ŋunkam kahindi nini nyɛla ŋun lo zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋun dimd o naŋgbampiba nyɛ tuumbiɛtumda.
en: Those who wink their eye plot destruction; those who purse their lips plan evil.

dag: N ku chɛ ka n suhu ŋmaligi ka chɛ din tuhi. N ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, a zaɣis o, ka mal o ansarisi; a suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a ninvuɣ gahindili zuɣu.
en: But now, Lord, you have become angry with your chosen king, and you have left him all alone.

dag: Jɛhalɛlɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zif mini Zifa ni Tiria ni Asarɛl.
en: Jehallelels sons were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Biŋkɔb kara anahi maa wuhirila nanima anahi bɛn ti yɛn yiɣisi zani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: The four beasts are four earthly kingdoms.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa bɔhim Yawɛ jɛmbu yila, ka mi li yilibu viɛnyɛliŋga kalinli daa nyɛla niriba kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛiayika.
en: There were of these men, and all of them were skilled musicians.

dag: Niriba pam ni nyuri bara dunia ŋɔ binyara zuɣu shɛm, n gba ni nyu bara lala.
en: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.

dag: O vuui Izraɛlnim yaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni. O daa yih o nuu ka chɛ ba bɛ dimnim ninni. O ŋmanila buɣim niɛm din diri Yaakubu zuliya sunsuuni n-di n-gili luɣilikam.
en: He was angry, and he destroyed all the strength of Israel. He took away his right hand from Israel. He did this when the enemy came. He burned like a flaming fire in Jacob. He was like a fire that burns all around.

dag: Wummiya! Man Pool yɛri ya mi ni yi yi gunda, Masia ku mali ya buchi.
en: Listen! I, Paul, tell you that if you allow yourselves to be circumcised, it means that Christ is of no use to you at all.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ. Bɛ daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, n ni chɛ ka poloya yina yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: If you refuse to let them go, then Ill send a plague of frogs over your whole country.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun leei maligumaana ni o zan o zaani la ni mali sara maa ti Yawɛ kaman zaligu din nyɛ din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim.
en: The priest who is anointed from among Aarons sons to succeed him will prepare the offering as a permanent portion for the LORD. It will be completely burned as a complete offering.

dag: O daa zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: and put him in charge of everything he owned.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-ni be nimaani. Ka viri mini taatahi kpe m-be bɛ yinsi; ka mɔɣu ni buhi be nimaani n-yiɣiri jamda.
en: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.

dag: Ka Naara daa dɔɣi Ahuzam mini Hɛfa ni Tɛmɛni ni Haahashitari; bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naara bidibisi.
en: Naarah had Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons Naarah had with Ashhur.

dag: Zaŋmiya gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka salima pa di zuɣu.
en: Make carrying poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun mi din be salinim suhuri ni daa di ba shɛhira n-ti ba Shia Kasi kaman o ni daa ti ti gba shɛm la.
en: And God, who knows the thoughts of everyone, showed his approval of the Gentiles by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he had to us.

dag: Amaa ka Nabal nachimba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti yɛli Nabal paɣ Abigeel, Nyama, Dauda timla tuumba ka bɛ yi o sani mɔɣu maa ni na ni bɛ ti puhi ti kpɛm maa, ka o tu ba.
en: One of Nabals servants spoke to Nabals wife Abigail. The servant said, David sent messengers from the desert to meet our master, but Nabal was rude to them.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan dɔɣ o tizo Ɛbɛl gba. Ɛbɛl daa nyɛla piɛgula, ka Keen mi nyɛ pukpara.
en: She gave birth a second time to Cains brother Abel. Abel cared for the flocks, and Cain farmed the fertile land.

dag: Ka ti dimnim maa daa yɛli, Bɛ ku baŋ bee n-nya binshɛli pɔi, ka ti kana ti liri ba ku ba, ka tuma maa zani tariga.
en: Meanwhile, our enemies were saying: Before they know or see anything, we can be in their midst and start to kill them. Well stop the work.

dag: Kaman salima baŋa ni be kuruchu nyee ni shɛm, lala n-nyɛ paɣ viɛlli ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Beauty in a woman without good judgment is like a gold ring in a pig's snout.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam bia Zakaria daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ayɔbu.
en: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.

dag: Izraɛlnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Aduna zuliya, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: House of Israel, bless the LORD! House of Aaron, bless the LORD!.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; ka kum wum o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ piligi kabisiri chi ŋubiri chana.
en: One Sabbath, Jesus and his disciples were walking through some wheat fields. His disciples were hungry and began picking and eating grains of wheat.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni n nyɛla a dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun su a gbibbu fukumsi, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ dɔɣim maa puuni nira ka miri dɔɣim maa gari ma gba beni.
en: It is true that I am a close relative and am responsible for you, but there is a man who is a closer relative than I am.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa bɔhi bɔhigu shɛlikam min o ni daa zaŋ yɛlimuɣisir shɛlikam na puuni, nachimbih anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn mi di yɛla paai siɣimsiɣim bu pii zuɣu n-gari timlan kam bee saŋmaribaŋda kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: Whenever the king consulted them about any aspect of wisdom and understanding, he found them head and shoulders above all the dream interpreters and enchanters in his entire kingdom.

dag: Ayuba bipuɣinsi maa viɛlim kpee daa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Ka bɛ ba daa ti ba fali pahi bɛ tizɔdɔbba maa zuɣu.
en: There were no other women in the whole world as beautiful as Job's daughters. Their father gave them a share of the inheritance along with their brothers.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim, ka di pa dari zuɣu m-be sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: Then Aarons sons will bring the fat to the altar and put it on the burnt offering that is on the wood on the fire. It is a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni. Ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li.
en: Suddenly a strong wind blew up, and the waves began to spill over into the boat, so that it was about to fill with water.

dag: O chanimi kahind o nimbihi ka mal o napɔna vuri tiŋa, ka mal o nubihi tirita.
en: They use secret signals to cheat people; they wink their eyes, shuffle their feet, and point a finger.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti do tin tital shɛl ni bɛ ni daa kpahi bɛ Duuma tabili dapulli zuɣu la solɔɣu zuɣu. Tiŋ maa yupaa n-nyɛ Sɔdom bee Ijipti.
en: The bodies of the two witnesses will lie in the street of the great city. This city is named Sodom and Egypt. These names for the city have a special meaning. This is the city where the Lord was killed.

dag: Ŋun pa Yisa yɛdaniŋda yi boli ya ni yi ka o yiŋ na nti di bindirigu ka yi yu ni yi chaŋ, bɛ yi ti kul zaŋ shɛlikam zaa zali yi tooni, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya di zuɣu.
en: If an unbeliever invites you to eat with them and you want to go, eat whatever is served, without asking questions because of your conscience.

dag: ka zaŋya n vuhim dabisa la leei dabisa kasi, ka di leei shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Make my sabbaths holy, and let them be a sign between us that I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ŋma li n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa, ka o daa zaŋ li nti ti o ma.
en: And the men brought Johns head on a plate and gave it to the girl. Then she took the head to her mother, Herodias.

dag: Ka di daa ti Yɛhudianim suhupiɛlli mini tahima din wuhi ni bɛ di nasara.
en: It was an especially happy day for the Jews, a day of great joy and happiness.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛl o, Nyama, n kurigiya, m mi ku tooi baŋ n kum dali.
en: Isaac replied, I am old and might die at any time.

dag: Dinzuɣu karimbaani n-nyɛ bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dolibi, ka duŋ taabo mi nyɛ bɛ kparibu.
en: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi, di ni daa na bi neei zaa saha shɛli ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi doya.
en: Early in the morning of the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

dag: nti gbaag o nuu ka yɛl o, Talita kumi! Di gbinni nyɛla, Bipuɣiŋga, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: He took the twelve-year-old girl by the hand and said, Talitha, koum! which means, Little girl, get up! The girl got right up and started walking around. Everyone was greatly surprised.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi n ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yɛla ni n ni daa kpaŋ mmaŋ shɛm niŋ li, ka di zaa kul nyɛla din ka buchi. Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim, ka binshɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni mali buchi.
en: But then I looked at everything I had done and the wealth I had gained. I decided it was all a waste of time! It was like trying to catch the wind. There is nothing to gain from anything we do in this life.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛlimi, M Ba, chɛ ka a yuli nya jilima. Di saha ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi alizanda ni na yɛra, M pun chɛ ka di nya jilima; amaa n ni lan chɛ ka di nya jilima pahi.
en: Father, bring glory to your name! Then a voice spoke from heaven, I have brought glory to it, and I will do so again.

dag: Dum Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi bahi wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo, lihim li viɛnyɛliŋga, dama a ku du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Go to the peak of Mount Pisgah and look to the north and to the south, to the east and to the west. Look carefully at what you see, because you will never go across the Jordan.

dag: Ninsal ni kul ni niŋ shɛli nyɛla o di ka nyu, ka di o tuma nyaɣisim. N nyaya ka dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us.

dag: n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be Jɛrusalɛm; ka bɛ nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka n zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini wuntitali su ba.
en: and will bring them back from east and west to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, ruling over them faithfully and justly.

dag: N niriba bahi yoli bɛ ʒilinsi zuɣu. Yi ni zaɣisi baŋsim zuɣu n gba zaɣisi ya, yi lan pala m maligumaaniba. Ka yi ni tam n zaligu yɛla zuɣu, n gba ni tam yi bihi yɛla.
en: My people are destroyed from lack of knowledge. Since you have rejected knowledge, so I will reject you from serving me as a priest. Since you have forgotten the Instruction of your God, so also I will forget your children.

dag: Ka Musa yɛl o, A yi ku doli ti chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka ti yiɣisi kpe.
en: Moses replied, If you wont go yourself, dont make us leave here.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa wum yi yɛligu maa ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o po pɔri yɛli.
en: The Lord heard what you said, and he was angry. He made a vow. He said.

dag: Bɛ dimi ŋmɛlim, ka bɛ niŋgbuna be polipoli. Bɛ tuumbiɛri ka tariga. Bɛ bi doli zaligu soli n-kariti kpibisi saria tiri ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔŋ, bɛ mi bi zabiri nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: and have grown fat and sleek! To be sure, their evil deeds exceed all limits, and yet they prosper. They are indifferent to the plight of the orphan, reluctant to defend the rights of the poor.

dag: Ka yi ni ti zaŋ o ʒim shɛli niŋ sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila anahi la, ka niŋniŋ di tariga kɔnanim anahi la zuɣu, ka niŋniŋ di baŋa din kɔɣili li gil la. Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi, ka yi zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.

dag: Ka a yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, bɔ ka a yɛn ti o? Bee bɔ ka o yɛn nya di ni?.
en: If you are righteous, what do you give to him? Or what does he receive from your hand?.

dag: Di zaŋ pako so ŋun na bi paai yuun pihiyɔbu yuli pahi pakoya kalinli ni. Ka din pahi nyɛla, di simdi ni ŋun yuli ni tooi pahi bɛ kalinli ni nyɛla ŋun daa pun kulila do yino kɔŋko;.
en: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least years old, and she must have been faithful in marriage.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka ti niŋ o shɛli, dama o nyɛla ti tizo ni timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ. Ka o mabihi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Come on, lets sell him to the Ishmaelites. Lets not harm him because hes our brother; hes family. His brothers agreed.

dag: Di nyɛla din chihiri ni nanim tum zaɣ biɛɣu, dama wuntitali soli ka bɛ doli zali nam.
en: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa kul o ba Yisahaku sani Mamri bee Kiriatariba luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Hiburɔn ka di nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni daa be shɛl la.
en: Jacob went to his father Isaac at Hebron, also called Mamre or Kiriath-Arba, where Isaac's father Abraham had lived as a foreigner.

dag: Amaa ka a daa lan pɔbisi a pɔhim, ka teeku kom lim ba, ka bɛ shim ko tiŋa kaman kurigu n-lu kopurim ni la.
en: You blew with your wind; the sea covered over them. They sank like lead in the towering waters.

dag: Saha shɛli Musa ni daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa la, ka o daa wum kukol shɛli Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu la zuɣusaa chɛrubinim ayi la sunsuuni ka di tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord , he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord 's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma daa zani n nyaaŋa, ka ti ma yaa ka m mol lahibal suŋ molo zaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa wum li. Ti Duuma daa yihi ma gbuɣinli nol ni.
en: But the Lord stayed with me. The Lord gave me strength so that I could tell the Good News everywhere. He wanted all those who are not Jews to hear that Good News. So I was saved from the lions mouth.

dag: Kaman anzinfa ni nyɛligiri binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara puuni shɛm la, lala ka yi ni ti nyɛligi di puuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu maa.
en: like silver in a furnace. Then they will know that I, the Lord , have punished them in my anger.

dag: Chamiya ti kum niŋ yi ni pii buɣ shɛŋa jɛmdi maa, ka bɛ fan ya bahi yi muɣisigu ŋɔ saha.
en: Go cry out to the gods youve chosen. Let them rescue you in the time of your distress.

dag: O ni yɛn wolig omaŋ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o miri ka o di wain tia binshɛlikam, hal o miri ka o di di biɛlim bee di paɣiri.
en: As long as you are a nazirite, you shall not eat anything that comes from a grapevine, not even the seeds or skins of grapes.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira jɛnd o kpee, dilan ŋmanila tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu bee takɔbi bee piɛm din dira.
en: A false accusation is as deadly as a sword, a club, or a sharp arrow.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ ka yi nya, yi suhu ni paligi, ka yi nya kpiɔŋ mini alaafee, ka zoori kaman momaha la; ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deeri n noli; ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisiri bahiri n dimnim zuɣu.
en: When you see this happen, you will be glad; it will make you strong and healthy. Then you will know that I, the Lord , help those who obey me, and I show my anger against my enemies.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya o biɛyanim maa, o daa baŋ ba, amaa ka niŋ ba kaman saamba n-nyɛ ba la, ka daa bi tɔɣisi ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa. O daa bɔhi ba mi, Ya ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti yila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni ti ti da bindirigu.
en: Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he acted like he didnt know them. He was rude when he spoke to them. He said, Where do you come from? The brothers answered, We have come from the land of Canaan to buy food.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli zaɣisi wumbu.
en: But they refused to pay attention. They turned a cold shoulder and stopped listening.

dag: Di simdi ka dari maa ti kpalim be adaka maa bansi maa ni, di ti yihiya li.
en: The poles should stay in the chests rings. They shouldnt be taken out of them.

dag: Lɛvi mabia Asaf ŋun daa be o nudirigu polo jɛmbu duu maa ni la daa nyɛla Bɛrɛkia bia, ka Bɛrɛkia nyɛ Shimia bia.
en: Hemans relative was Asaph. Asaph served by Hemans right side. Asaph was Berekiahs son. Berekiah was Shimeas son.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ ni daa kul moli gili, Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla bɛ puri atam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpam ni shiri pam ni bɛ puri ni bindira zaa na. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ binshɛɣukam pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu pam na.
en: As soon as the order was issued, the Israelites generously gave the best of their grain, new wine, oil, honey, and all their crops—a tenth of everything, a huge amount.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli ni bɛ bɔri naa, ka Naawuni daa pii Kish bia Sool leei bɛ naa, ka o daa di nam maa yuun pihinahi. Sool daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira.
en: And when they asked for a king, God gave them Saul son of Kish from the tribe of Benjamin, to be their king for forty years.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti labina, salo maa zaa daa yiɣisimi m-puh o ni o paabuna, dama bɛ daa pun yuun o la soli.
en: When Jesus went back to Galilee, the people welcomed him. Everyone was waiting for him.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa; chɛliya ka daadamnim zo dabiɛm! O ʒila o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu. Chɛliya ka tiŋgbani dam!.
en: The Lord is king, and the people tremble. He sits on his throne above the winged creatures, and the earth shakes.

dag: Man kul ku lihi yaɣi bɛ so zuɣu bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Amaa n ni zaŋ bɛ tuma maa ʒili ba.
en: But I will not have pity on them; I will do to them what they have done to others.

dag: Hɛbɛr ŋun nyɛ Kɛn nir la paɣa Jaɛl mal alibarika pam paɣiba ni. Paɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa puuni, ŋuna m-mal alibarika.
en: May Jael be blessed above all women; may the wife of Heber the Kenite be blessed above all tent-dwelling women.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la maani maha, dama dabindi daa ka di ni, bɛ mi daa bi ʒi bindir shɛli mali chaŋ, bɛ ni daa kari ba yihi Ijipti yomyom shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: They baked unleavened bread from the dough that they had brought out of Egypt, for they had been driven out of Egypt so suddenly that they did not have time to get their food ready or to prepare leavened dough.

dag: Ka yi yi bɔhi Ti yi bi biri bee ti yi bi kpuɣi puri atam yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, bɔ ka ti ti yɛn dira.
en: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali ba pam mali alibarika. O yi ʒe o dimnim tooni saria karibu shee o ku di vi.
en: The person who fills a quiver full with them is truly happy! They wont be ashamed when arguing with their enemies in the gate.

dag: Kamiyana, chɛliya ka ti teei dɔni ti puya zuɣu n-jɛm o; chɛliya ka ti gbani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti namda ŋɔ tooni!.
en: Come, lets worship and bow down! Lets kneel before the LORD, our maker!.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ nyaŋ ninvuɣ maŋa pam, chɛliya ka ti chɛ ba ka bɛ be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-gɔri kɔhigu bɛ yubu, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ galisiya pam; ka chɛ ka ti kpuɣiri bɛ bipuɣinsi; ka ti gba zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ba.
en: These people want to be friends with us. We want to let them live in our land and be at peace with us. We have enough land for all of us. We are free to marry their women, and we are happy to give them our women to marry.

dag: Ka Aduna zaŋ Lɛvinim maa zali Yawɛ tooni kaman Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahi zuɣusaa, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi tum Yawɛ tuma.
en: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti liri Izraɛlnima; tɔb maa ni daa ti mii, ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi tusa anahi tɔb maa ni.
en: The Philistines lined up their soldiers in front of the Israelites and began the attack. The Philistines defeated the Israelites. They killed about soldiers from Israels army.

dag: Naawuni, a nam nyɛla din kul ni beni sahakam. A nam jaaŋgbee tumdila din tuhi.
en: Your divine throne is eternal and everlasting. Your royal scepter is a scepter of justice.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn wuhiri binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din bi be kasi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri mini binshɛŋa din pa daɣiri.
en: You must distinguish between what belongs to God and what is for general use, between what is ritually clean and what is unclean.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka n lan ka tahima yaha.
en: They pay me back evil for good, and I sink in despair.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima, ka a tahima maa ni niŋ pali.
en: This will give you something to hope for that will not disappoint you.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kul birigiri Yawɛ zaligu? Dama lala ku nani.
en: But Moses said, Then why are you disobeying the Lord now? You will not succeed!.

dag: Ka o ni ti kpuɣi bɛ wuna mini bɛ binnana ni neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa mali n-zaŋ ti bɛ wuna la n-lab kuli Ijipti. Ka yuma biɛla din ti nyɛ suhudoo saha puuni.
en: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒi m-baɣi kom pam ka mali buni pam ŋɔ, yi bahigu saha paaya. Yi shihi siɣiya.
en: You live beside a great river, and you are rich in treasures. But your time has come; your cruelty has caught up with you.

dag: ka a ti yeei Aduna kpariti n-zaŋ li yɛl o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna kpi nimaani n-chaŋ o yaannim sani.
en: and there remove Aaron's priestly robes and put them on Eleazar. Aaron is going to die there.

dag: Dama bɛ daa yi zaŋdila bɛ tantinim mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ laakumnim kanna ti luri bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Ka bɛ mini laakumnim maa daa ka kalinli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daa yi ti kana bɛ saɣindila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam.
en: The Midianites came with their families, animals, and tents. They were like a swarm of locusts! They and their camels were too many to count. They came into the land and ruined it.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi woligi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni noombihi shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbigu bee noombil bee binshɛli n ni wuhi ni di nyɛla daɣiri la kpɛhi yimaŋ daɣiri ni.
en: So you must separate between clean and unclean animals, and between clean and unclean birds. Do not become detestable through some animal, bird, or anything that moves on the fertile ground that I have separated from you as unclean.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi m piɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim maa n ni kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa na nti zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee, ka bɛ dɔɣi bihi ka nabi.
en: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shihi zaa;.
en: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped.

dag: ka bɔhi Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa, Ka ŋuni n-lee be kpe ha palo ni n-chani tuhiri ti soli ŋɔ na? Ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N dana m-bala. Ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ sariga pa n-lims o ninni.
en: She said to the servant, Who is that young man walking in the field to meet us? The servant said, That is my masters son. So Rebekah covered her face with her veil.

dag: Ka din nyari niriba taali yi mali jilima ŋɔ tatabo, dindina din chɛ ka niriba yiri taali ni shiri ni mali jilima gari lala.
en: This is what I mean: That old agreement judged people guilty of sin, but it had glory. So surely the new agreement that makes people right with God has much greater glory.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti suui li zali, o yɛrimi, Yawɛ labimi Izraɛlnim tuhituhi zuɣa ŋɔ sanna.
en: And when the Holy Box was put in its place, Moses always said, Come back, Lord , to the millions of Israelites.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ba sɔɣi gballi ni, bɛ gulila bɛ gballi maa.
en: When they are carried to the graveyard, to their well-guarded tombs.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, bahigu maa ʒila a zuɣu, ka n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi a zuɣu. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni darig a tibili a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Even now the end is upon you! Ill send my anger against you, Ill judge you according to your ways, and Ill turn all your detestable practices against you.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari shihira ŋɔ zaa, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: In the same way, when you see all these things, you know that the Human One is near, at the door.

dag: Gbuɣima ti ku be nimaani, biŋkɔb biɛɣu mi ti ku doli soli maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi kɔŋko nti yɛn dol li.
en: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.

dag: Isaka ŋmanila bun so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ piɛri sunsuuni.
en: Issachar, you are a strong donkey resting in the meadows.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi tamdi teebuli maa zuɣu n-zaani n tooni sahakam.
en: Put the special bread before me on the table. It must always be there in front of me.

dag: Ka a yi kali ninvuɣ so, di simdi ka dilan yo anzinfa laɣifu pirigili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ. .
en: Every one who is counted should pay a half shekel according to the official shekel of the sanctuary . The half shekel is a gift offering to the LORD.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following regulations.

dag: Di saha ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa yiɣisi zani suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ niriba maa ni, ka Naawuni daa be alizanda ni o biɛhigu shee din nyɛ kasi la ka deei bɛ suhigu maa.
en: The priests and the Levites stood up and asked God to bless the people, and he heard them. Their prayer came up to heaven, the holy place where he lives.

dag: Amaa bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ di ni bi simdi ni yi ŋubi shɛba: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: Heres a list of those you are not allowed to eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey.

dag: Ka ŋun vo bua la tahi Azazɛl sani la, di simdi ka o paɣ o nɛma ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: The man who led the goat to Azazel must wash his clothes and his whole body with water. After that he may come into the camp.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Anabi Aizaia ni daa pun yɛli yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli kaman di ni daa sab shɛm ni Naawuni yɛliya: Niriba ŋɔ tiri ma la jilima bɛ nyina zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni mani.
en: He replied, Isaiah really knew what he was talking about when he prophesied about you hypocrites. He wrote, This people honors me with their lips, but their hearts are far away from me.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ chɛ ka Naawuni yɛligu bi tumdi di tuma yi ni, yi yaannim kal shɛŋa yi ni mali wuhiri niriba la zuɣu. Ka yi lan tumdi tuun shɛŋa din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnim pam.
en: And you ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching. You do a lot of other things just as bad.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi la zaa ni firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu tuma nɛma zaa ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini la.
en: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul kpuɣ bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa, bɛ bi lan nya so n-naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: So they looked up and saw no one there but Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ka mali nia biɛri la mirina. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋa ka chɛ a zaligu.
en: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me.

dag: Yisa daa ti chani Jɛrusalɛm n-zaŋ doli Samaria mini Galili sunsuuni garita.
en: On his way to Jerusalem, Jesus went along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili din galisi pam la ni, ka di kom nyuui zaa ni di mali soli ti wulimpuhili polo nanima.
en: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani Samaria. O be Nabɔt wain tihi puu la ni ni o deei li su.
en: Go to King Ahab of Samaria. You will find him in Naboth's vineyard, about to take possession of it.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya yi putarisi zaa daatam bee ka yi ti lan labi ti yihi binyiha yi daatam kpuɣibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: When you harvest your fields, do not cut the grain at the edges of the fields, and do not go back to cut the heads of grain that were left.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ti mali biɛhigu shee maa zali ya, n ni labina nti zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu shee, ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yi gba ni ti be.
en: And after I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to myself, so that you will be where I am.

dag: Ka daa kari alizin biɛri pam niriba zuɣu bahi, ka zaŋ kpam ʒe barinim pam gbiɛri n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: They forced out many demons and healed a lot of sick people by putting olive oil on them.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi mini Amiliya maa yɛli, Kamina! Ŋunkam wum dimbɔŋɔ, ŋun gba yɛlima, Kamina! Ka kɔnyuri ni mali sokam mini ŋun bɔri nyɛvili kom, ŋun kamina nti dee li yoli.
en: The Spirit and the bride say, Come! Everyone who hears this should also say, Come! All who are thirsty may come; they can have the water of life as a free gift if they want it.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mali kpiɔŋ, ka bɛ fɔntinsi nyɛ tiŋ kara, ka bɛ me goma gil li, ka din pahi nyɛla, ti nya Anaki zuliya nimaani.
en: But the people living there are very powerful. The cities are very large and strongly defended. We even saw some Anakites there.

dag: Pool daa bɔri ni o baɣisila Ɛfɛsus gari, dama o daa bi bɔri ni sangal shɛli ti taɣ o zali Ɛsha. O daa niŋdila yomyom ni di yi ni tooi nani ka o paai Jɛrusalɛm Pɛntikɔst dali.
en: Paul had decided to sail on by Ephesus, so as not to lose any time in the province of Asia. He was in a hurry to arrive in Jerusalem by the day of Pentecost, if at all possible.

dag: Ka nimaaninim daa nya o m-baŋ o, ka tim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋkpan shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim zaa tahi o sanna.
en: When the people who lived in that place recognized him, they sent word throughout that whole region, and they brought to him everyone who was sick.

dag: n gba ni lan ya yi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu saha, ka mali ya ansarisi yi dabiɛm saha.
en: So I will laugh at your troubles and make fun of you when what you fear happens.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni zaŋla bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu maa sɔŋ gu bɛ bihi; chɛ ka o zaŋ li labisi yo ba ka bɛ baŋ li.
en: You claim God punishes a child for the sins of his father. No! Let God punish the sinners themselves; let him show that he does it because of their sins.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi yɔhim yimaŋ yɛra, Babilɔnnim maa shiri zoya ka chɛ ti, dama bɛ ku zo ka chɛn ya.
en: The LORD proclaims: Dont let yourself be deceived into thinking that the Babylonians will withdraw for good. They wont!.

dag: Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi ka paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, o ni zaŋ tiŋgban viɛli shɛli tin ya maa zuɣu.
en: You will have all you want to eat, and you will give thanks to the Lord your God for the fertile land that he has given you.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi puuni, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili n-deei li.
en: In the fourteenth year that Hezekiah was king of Judah, Sennacherib, the emperor of Assyria, attacked the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee maa ni ni o ti yo alahichi samli, di bi simdi ka so kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni hal ka o ti yo omaŋmaŋ min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli ni Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi samli, ka naanyi yina.
en: Only you are allowed in the sacred tent from the time you enter until the time you come out.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ku Chɛmɔshi niriba, ka gbahi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi daba chaŋ.
en: Pity the people of Moab! The people who worshiped Chemosh have been destroyed, and their sons and daughters have been taken away as prisoners.

dag: Dama Yɛhudianim bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihira, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi bɔri yɛm.
en: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-chaŋ gili tiŋ maa napɔŋ yim, ka zaŋ li lab bɛ sansani maa ni ti gbe.
en: So he had this group of men take the Lord 's Covenant Box around the city one time. Then they came back to camp and spent the night there.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma pal yɛlinli ka n yaari n naba chana, ka n naba daa bi sarigi.
en: You cleared a path for my feet so that I could walk without stumbling.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa wum naa ni kari saria maa ŋ-ŋmaai li shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa lu naa maa sizuura, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni Naawuni yɛm be o ni, ka o ni kariti saria ka di doli zaligu soli.
en: All Israel heard about the judgment that the king made. Their respect for the king grew because they saw that Gods wisdom was in him so he could execute justice.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, Di ku lan yuui ka n kpi, amaa Naawuni ni be yi sani, ka ti zaŋ ya labisi yi yaannim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni yaha.
en: Then Israel said to Joseph, Im about to die. God will be with you and return you to the land of your fathers.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim ni daa nya ka Yisa mini alahichinima ni farigudeeriba laɣim diri maa, ka bɛ bɔh o nyaandoliba, Bɔzuɣu ka o mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira ka nyura.
en: When some of the legal experts from among the Pharisees saw that he was eating with sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples, Why is he eating with sinners and tax collectors.

dag: Yɛhudianima adiini kali soli dolibu puuni kɔsins ayɔbu daa ʒe nimaani bɛ ni paɣibu zuɣu, ka di zaa zaɣ yiniyini daa naan tooi deei ko guŋgɔna ayɔbuyɔbu bee ayopɔinpɔin.
en: The Jews have rules about ritual washing, and for this purpose six stone water jars were there, each one large enough to hold between twenty and thirty gallons.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi ti paai tiŋ shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya maa ni nti kpuɣi di tiŋgbani maa daatam, yin zaŋmiya yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli maa bindir tuuli kam bɔbili na ti ti maligumaana;.
en: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti teei yi biɛhigu mini yi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-saɣim yimaŋ la yɛla, ka galim yimaŋa yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: In that country you will remember all the evil things you did that made you filthy, and you will be ashamed.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni fabili aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: Jesus answered, Do you expect the guests at a wedding party to be sad as long as the bridegroom is with them? Of course not! But the day will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

dag: Ka bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli yi puri ni, yin di ti kpuɣiya di daatam, ka yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni ka di wali wala, yin di pɔhiya li, di ni ti nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni.
en: You must not cut the crops that grow by themselves after your harvest. You must not gather the grapes from your vines that are not trimmed. The land will have a year of rest.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanima; yi mi di puhiya daadam kam sol ni.
en: Carry no wallet, no bag, and no sandals. Dont even greet anyone along the way.

dag: Dama bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ku tooi puh a, bɛ mi ku tooi paɣ a. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be gbala ni ku tooi mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ a ʒiɛyimtali polo.
en: The dead cannot praise you. People in Sheol cannot sing praises to you. Those who have died and gone below are not trusting in your faithfulness.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa m-mali ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani wuɣisiri buɣim.
en: Peter followed Jesus but stayed back at a distance. He followed him to the yard of the high priests house. He went into the yard and sat there with the guards, warming himself by their fire.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kaɣili fiɛb o zuɣu ni, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka damdir o tooni puhir o.
en: Again and again, they struck his head with a stick. They spit on him and knelt before him to honor him.

dag: M pun saɣim Samaria mini di wuna, ka ni saɣim Jɛrusalɛm mini di binnana din be di ni gba lala.
en: just as I did to Samaria and her false gods, wont I also do this to Jerusalem and her idols?.

dag: Ka ŋun Haman daa nyu bara o daazichi min o ni mali bidibisi shɛm zuɣu bɛ sani. O daa lan nyu bara zaŋ chaŋ naa ni duh o n-zaŋ o zali zaashe shɛl ni la min o ni nyɛ ninvuɣ titali n-gar o tab bɛn nyɛ naa tuma zuɣulaannim la gba zuɣu.
en: He boasted to them about how rich he was, how many sons he had, how the king had promoted him to high office, and how much more important he was than any of the king's other officials.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham ti tuhi, mali kpiɔŋ tɔb maa tuhibu ni. Di yi pa lala Naawuni ni ŋme a luh a dimnim maa tooni. Dama Naawuni mali yiko din ni sɔŋ nira bee n-ŋme o luhi.
en: and so he will let your enemies defeat you, even if you fight hard. He is the one who brings both victory and defeat.

dag: Hadadɛza kpambaliba ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Dauda, ka leeg o ni su shɛba. Dinzuɣu ka Sirianim maa daa bi lan bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋ Ammɔnnim maa yaha.
en: When the kings who had been under Hadadezer's rule saw that Israel had defeated them, they made peace with David and accepted him as their new ruler. The Syrians never helped the Ammonites again.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ko bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni biri n-daa ti kpuɣi di daatam ka di gari o ni daa zaŋ shɛm biri maa ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Isaac planted grain and had a good harvest that same year. The Lord blessed him.

dag: Dabisa ŋɔ yi ti gari, di nyaaŋa daba anii zaŋ chana maligumaaniba ni tooi mali yi sara shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini yi suhudoo saranim di zuɣu, ka n deei ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When the seven days are completed, the priests will offer your entirely burned offerings and your well-being sacrifices on the altar from the eighth day on, and I will accept you with pleasure. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Zakaria, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka a paɣ Ɛlizabɛt ni niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a ti bol o yuli Jɔn.
en: The angel said, Dont be afraid, Zechariah. Your prayers have been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will give birth to your son and you must name him John.

dag: Yihimiya ansarisimaana yi kɔbili ni, ka zabili naai, ka naŋgbankpeeni mini turi chɛ.
en: Remove the mocker and conflict disappears; judgment and shame also stop.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya ni suhudoo. Yawɛ nuu pa yi zuɣu yi chandi maa ni.
en: Don't worry, answered the priest. The Lord is pleased with what you are doing.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla Manaasa daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali pam hal ka bɛ ʒim ti kul zɔri doli Jɛrusalɛm solɔri, di yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ din la polo m-pah o ni daa chɛ ka Judanim tum alahichi mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la.
en: Manasseh killed so many innocent people that the streets of Jerusalem were flowing with blood; he did this in addition to leading the people of Judah into idolatry, causing them to sin against the Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Doli ma ka ti kuli n yiŋa, ka a ti di bindirigu.
en: So the old prophet said, Please come home and eat with me.

dag: ka yi tiŋgbani mi ti be kaman tahiʒiɛɣu. Yi ni ti yihi yi yaa tum tuma yoli, ka yi tiŋgbani ku niŋ bindirigu, ka di tihi gba ti ku wali wala.
en: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ŋmanila lala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni tahima ni zani tariga.
en: People who forget God are like that. Those who oppose him have no hope.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Absalom, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din bi viɛla.
en: Hushai answered, The advice Ahithophel gave you this time is no good.

dag: yurilim zuɣu chɛ ka n naɣ suhir a mi. Man Pool ŋun nyɛ ninkurigu ka lan nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: But I am not commanding you; I am asking you to do it out of love. I, Paul, am an old man now, and I am a prisoner for Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, To, n kana! Ka m malila yiko din ni tooi yɛli shɛli? Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni, dina ka n yɛn tɔɣisi.
en: Balaam answered, I came, didn't I? But now, what power do I have? I can say only what God tells me to say.

dag: O daa ʒila niriba pam pahi laakumnim bɛn ʒiri tulaale zim mini salima pam ni kuɣ viɛla n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na. O ni daa paai Sulemaana sani, o daa yɛl o din be o suhu ni zaa.
en: She traveled to Jerusalem with a very large group of servants. There were many camels carrying spices, jewels, and a lot of gold. She met Solomon and asked him all the questions that she could think of.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul beni n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma, ka mali tampiɛlli din be kaman mukur la lɔr o shee ni.
en: But Samuel served the Lord . He was a helper who wore the linen ephod.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n niŋ ya yiko din ni chɛ ka yi no tinvura mini nɔnsi, ka lan pahi ya yiko din ni tooi nyaŋ yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani ŋɔ min o nyaaŋa zaa; ka binshɛɣu ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: I have given you the power to trample on snakes and scorpions and to defeat the power of your enemy Satan. Nothing can harm you.

dag: Binnani maa zuɣu daa nyɛla salima din nyɛ alali; ka o nyɔɣu min o bɔɣiri nyɛ anzinfa; ka o puli min o gbalipina nyɛ daanya;.
en: The head of the statue was made from pure gold. Its chest and the arms were made from silver. The belly and upper part of the legs were made from bronze.

dag: Tumtumdiba yi di n-tiɣi bee bɛ yi bi di n-tiɣi, bɛ yi dɔni, bɛ gbihirimi pali bɛ nina, amaa bundana ŋun buni zuɣu chɛmi ka o gaani gom.
en: Workers may or may not have enough to eat, but at least they can get a good night's sleep. The rich, however, have so much that they stay awake worrying.

dag: Liya ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb min o bipuɣiŋga Daina ti Yaakubu Mɛsopoteemia la m-bala. O mini Liya zuliya bɛn nyɛ bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihitanaata.
en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun were Jacobs sons from his wife Leah. Leah had these sons in Paddan Aram. She also had a daughter named Dinah. There were people in this family.

dag: Amaa nyama, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn tibi Izraɛlnima, Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri yirila palo, ka Samarianim ninvuɣ biɛtali yi zahira; dama bɛ ŋmari ʒiri, ka tayiɣisi kabiri yiya n-kpɛri ti zura, ka ninvuɣ fariba mi be samban ni fara.
en: When I would heal Israel, the evil acts of Ephraim are exposed, and the wicked deeds of Samaria; for they deceive and steal, a thief breaks in; a group of bandits raid outside.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela sarika ni, ka wum Yisa Masia tuma yɛla, ka daa tim o nyaandoliba.
en: Now when John heard in prison about the things the Christ was doing, he sent word by his disciples to Jesus, asking.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Listen to the word that the LORD has spoken to you, people of Israel!.

dag: Pa lala ka yi daa bɔhim Masia yɛla.
en: But that way of life is nothing like what you learned when you came to know Christ.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri.
en: Shouldnt I punish them for this? declares the LORD; shouldnt I avenge such a nation?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zaadali Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I can assure you that on the judgment day it will be worse for that town than for the people of Sodom and Gomorrah.

dag: Yawɛ tooni, dama o kanna. O kanimina ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O mi yɛn zaŋla wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli kari niriba saria.
en: when the Lord comes to rule the earth. He will rule the peoples of the world with justice and fairness.

dag: ka di nyɛla o chaŋmi ti jɛm wuna, di yi nyɛla wuntaŋa bee goli bee saŋmarisi din nyɛ din chihiri n san la.
en: by following and serving other gods, and by bowing down to them, to the sun or the moon or any of the heavenly bodies that I havent permitted.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ti na kpalim ʒi kpe? Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa la ni nti kpi di ni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaliya ni ti ni kpi, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nti ti ni ti nyu, ti ni tum alahichi o sani zuɣu.
en: The people of Judah say to each other, What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord , and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Jeremiah received this message from the Lord :.

dag: Hal Naa Hɛrɔd gba bi nya o taali, dama o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o lab ti sanna. Nyamiya, o bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum.
en: Herod didnt find him guilty either. He sent him back to us. Look, he has done nothing bad enough for the death penalty.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu zaa saɣimla Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman bɛ ni zaŋ mɔɣilo ŋmɛri nandahima yil shɛli.
en: Therefore, my heart plays sadly like a harp for Moab, my inner being for Kir-heres.

dag: Ka o mini Mariama so bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti o ka o mali puu la kuli bɛ ya Bɛtilihɛm ni bɛ ti sab bɛ yuya.
en: Joseph registered with Mary because she was engaged to marry him.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti di li la yili yin ni ka di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ di nimdi yi samban ni bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili.
en: The whole meal must be eaten in the house in which it was prepared; it must not be taken outside. And do not break any of the animal's bones.

dag: O zuliya kul ni beni sahakam, ka n chɛ ka o nam kul ba n-ʒe n sani kaman wuntaŋ la.
en: His family will continue forever. His kingdom will last as long as the sun.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam m-pahi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣiba bɛn nyɛ yuyanima mini dɔbba daa niŋ yɛda.
en: The result was that many of them believed, including many important Greek women and men.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo ŋmanila kulibɔŋ kuma mini sagban shɛŋa sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒiɛri chana, ka Naawuni mali biɛhigu shee bumbɔn ni zali gu ba.
en: These people are like dried-up springs, like clouds blown along by a storm; God has reserved a place for them in the deepest darkness.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namda. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Sigh inwardly; be deathly still. Dont perform mourning rites, but bind on your turban and put your shoes on your feet. And dont cover your upper lip or eat in human company.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pia dali, yin lomiya noli ka laɣim jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: There will be a special meeting on the tenth day of the seventh month. During that day you must not eat any food, and you must not do any work.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛdomnima, Nyamiya, n ni filim ya zuliya kam sani; ka chɛ ka sokam ʒiɛm ya.
en: Edom, I will make you the smallest nation. Everyone will hate you very much.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa fa Amɔrinim maa fɔntinsi zaa n-ʒini Hɛshibɔn zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: The Israelites took all these cities. Then the Israelites settled in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and all its villages.

dag: Rubin zuliya m-bala; bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaata ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: These are the Reubenite clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: Pa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-chɛ ka niriba tumdi tuma ka buɣim diri li, ka niriba diri wahala yol la?.
en: Look, isnt this from the LORD of heavenly forces? Peoples grow weary from making just enough fire; nations become tired for nothing.

dag: Ka doo maa min o paɣa Awa daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Keen ka yɛli, N nya ninsala Yawɛ sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: Adam and Eve had a son. Then Eve said, I'll name him Cain because I got him with the help of the Lord .

dag: Ti mi zɔri niriba ni ti yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But we cant say Johns baptism was from someone else. We are afraid of the people, because they all believe John was a prophet.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Chɛliya ka yi ni shɛb lo kpara n-chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannima m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti Yawɛ.
en: So Moses said to the people, Get ready for war, so that you can attack Midian and punish them for what they did to the Lord .

dag: Amaa yinim ni kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Your bodies, however, will fall in this desert.

dag: Amaa o ni daa yɛri lala maa, ka naa yɛl o, Fom a noli, ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei naa saawaralana? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn bo kum ti amaŋa? Ka anabi maa daa fo, amaa ka lee yɛli, M mi ni Naawuni n-lo ni o ku a a ni tum shɛm ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu maa zuɣu.
en: Since when do you give me advice? Amaziah interrupted. You better quit before you end up dead! So the prophet stopped, but not until he said, I know God plans to destroy you because youve done this and because youve refused to listen to my advice.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, O be ya? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, O be Ammiɛl bia Makiri la yiŋa Lɔdɛba.
en: Where is he? David asked. Ziba replied, He lives in Lo-Debar with Machir the son of Ammiel.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee kum pam a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka dɔni tampiligim ni bilim.
en: Loudly they cry, bitterly they wail, and they put dust on their heads and cover themselves with ashes.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya, Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner yelled to Joab, Let's get some of our best soldiers to stand up and fight each other! Joab agreed.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ ŋun galisi sahakam.
en: because you, Lord , are supreme forever.

dag: Ka so yi mal o suhu n-yi din nyɛ daɣiri ni ka be kasi, dindina o ni leei la shɛli din mali jilima, ka mali shili ni di tum tuun suŋ kam, ka yil yidana ni woligi li n-zali di ko ni o zaŋ li tumd o tuma.
en: Those who make themselves clean from all those evil things, will be used for special purposes, because they are dedicated and useful to their Master, ready to be used for every good deed.

dag: Naad mini safurɔn ni kalamɔsi ni sinnamɔn ni firanki tulaale zim tihi zaa ni mɛɛr ni aloosi ni tulaale suma zaa be di ni.
en: nard, saffron, calamus, and cinnamon. Your limbs are like a garden filled with trees of frankincense, myrrh, and aloe.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Judia n-ka Antiɔk na n-daa ti gbaai Yisa nyaandoliba wuhibu yɛri ni shee bɛ guniya kaman Anabi Musa ni daa zali shɛm la ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku tiligi.
en: Then some men came to Antioch from Judea and began teaching the non-Jewish believers: You cannot be saved if you are not circumcised as Moses taught us.

dag: N yi ti teei n nuu darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili ka yihi Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When this happens, the Egyptians will know that I am the Lord .

dag: A ni sɔɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Zallakudura Naa sani ka zaŋ o leeg a biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: Because youve made the LORD my refuge, the Most High, your place of residence.

dag: Ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda wunsuhigu maa yi malaika ŋun daa ʒe Naawuni tooni maa nuu ni n-kpuɣ du zuɣusaa.
en: The smoke of the burning incense went up with the prayers of God's people from the hands of the angel standing before God.

dag: N ni wuh o o ni yɛn di wahala shɛm n yuli zuɣu.
en: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.

dag: Ka sokam daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o suhu ni kul yu ni o zaŋ shɛli na ti ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ tum Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tuma mini neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ tumdi tuma di puuni ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa she binyɛr kasi la.
en: Everyone who was excited and eager to participate brought the LORDs gift offerings to be used for building the meeting tent and all its furnishings and for the holy clothes.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋdi yi ni tuui ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini tiri Yawɛ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: All your descendants must follow this law and offer part of the first batch of bread dough.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋmaligi yɛl o, Mani n-tim a, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ŋɔ chaŋ ti fa Izraɛlnim Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: Then the Lord himself said, Gideon, you will be strong, because I am giving you the power to rescue Israel from the Midianites.

dag: O daa zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: He put him in charge of his government and made him ruler over all the land.

dag: Ka Barak daa laɣim Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba maa Kɛdɛshi, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pia daa dol o mini Dɛbɔra chaŋ.
en: He summoned Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh, and ten thousand men marched out behind him. Deborah marched out with him too.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti tabili Pɛɔr tiŋgbɔŋ ni Baal, ka diri kpiimba maligu nimdi.
en: Then at Peor, God's people joined in the worship of Baal and ate sacrifices offered to dead gods.

dag: Naa Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o daa chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka o tuma maa daa zani tariga.
en: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. A yi di saɣi, n naan ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini, Anabi Ilaija gba zaɣ yini.
en: Peter reacted to all of this by saying to Jesus, Lord, its good that were here. If you want, Ill make three shrines: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn be a ni zaŋla bɛmaŋmaŋ yiko kuri niriba.
en: Look, all the leaders in Israel are using their strength just to kill other people.

dag: N daa dolila Vinvamli Dunɔdal la yi yuŋ chaŋ ti gari Wɔɣ Kurili kɔbilinini la shee n-chaŋ Saɣiri Dunɔdal la ni. N daa chanimi n-kaari ni n nya Jɛrusalɛm goma maa ni lunlu shɛm mini buɣim ni daa di n-saɣimsaɣim di dunɔdaya la shɛm.
en: I went out by night through the Valley Gate past the Dragons Spring to the Dung Gate so that I could inspect the walls of Jerusalem that had been broken down, as well as its gates, which had been destroyed by fire.

dag: Yawɛ, zahimmi ma, ka buɣisi ma nya; buɣisim n suhu mini n tɛha.
en: Examine me and test me, Lord ; judge my desires and thoughts.

dag: Di saha ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli. Ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka tampima bɔɣi.
en: Then the curtain hanging in the Temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split apart.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Nahɔr daa kpuɣi paɣiba. Ibram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Zarai, ka Nahɔr mi paɣ yuli booni Milika. Milika mini Isika ba n-daa nyɛ Haran.
en: Abram married Sarai, but she was not able to have children. And Nahor married Milcah, who was the daughter of Haran and the sister of Iscah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Jɛziriil, dama di ku lan yuui, n ni darigi Jɛhu zuliya tibili o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Jɛziriil la ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Izraɛl nam zani tariga.
en: Then the Lord said, Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom.

dag: Ka bipuɣimbil maa daa ti yɛli Naaman paɣa, N di bi zaɣisi ka n dana chaŋ anab so ŋun be Samaria ŋɔ sani! O naan tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: She said to his wife, I wish that my master would meet the prophet who lives in Samaria. He could heal Naaman of his leprosy.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nya ti ni be yɛlimuɣisir shɛl ni. Jɛrusalɛm lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di n-saɣim di dunɔdaya. Dinzuɣu kamiyana ka ti lan lab me di gooni maa din ni chɛ ka ti yi vi shɛl ni ti ni be maa.
en: But when I got back, I said to them, Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.

dag: Bɛ daa yi bela Naawuni biɛhigu shee tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yiini yila hal ka Sulemaana daa ti naanyi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm la. Bɛ daa kul tumdila bɛ tuma maa n-doli di soli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: They ministered with song before the dwelling of the meeting tent, until Solomon built the LORDs temple in Jerusalem. They carried out their usual duties.

dag: ka di daa ti paag o ni o kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti tuɣili tulaale zim kaman bɛ daadiini soli ni daa zali shɛm.
en: The priests always chose one priest to offer the incense, and Zechariah was the one chosen this time. So he went into the Temple of the Lord to offer the incense.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses and said.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Itiɔpia ni mini bɛn mali Ijipti nyuri bara la, ka vi gbahi ba.
en: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl.
en: The Lord said to Samuel.

dag: Di daa ʒiɛla Ijipti tɔbbihi mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi sunsuuni. Sagbani maa daa nyɛla zibisim Ijiptinim polo, ka nyɛ neesim Izraɛlnim polo yuŋ zaa ka bɛ so daa bi tooi mir o kpee yuŋ maa zaa.
en: It stood between Egypts camp and Israels camp. The cloud remained there, and when darkness fell it lit up the night. They didnt come near each other all night.

dag: Ka a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba tɔbu ni, bɛ yi ŋmaligi lab a sanna n-kuhi bol a yuli ka suh a duu ŋɔ ni.
en: If your people Israel are defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, but then they change their hearts and lives, give thanks to your name, and ask for mercy before you at this temple.

dag: Nyama, Na so ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni ti di nam, ka o kpambaliba nyɛ bɛn tumdi din tuhi.
en: A king and his leaders will rule with justice.

dag: Nazari nir ŋun po pɔri zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Nazari nir ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli ti Yawɛ simdi ka di dolila o pɔri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di be di ko ka chɛ o ni ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli ka di dol o ni wolig omaŋ ti Naawuni la zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: These are the requirements for Nazirites. However, if you can afford to offer more, you must do so.

dag: N daa pii chɛrubi zali ka o gul a, ka a be Naawuni zoli din be kasi zuɣu. A daa bela buɣim kuɣa ni chana.
en: You were one of the chosen Cherubs who spread your wings over my throne. I put you on the holy mountain of God. You walked among the jewels that sparkled like fire.

dag: Ka doo maa dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni n-kuni ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: At once the man stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and went home, giving thanks to God.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa ti maai, ka Pool laɣim Yisa nyaandoliba maa na nti kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka chɛbisi ba, ka zaŋ kpa Masidɔnia polo.
en: After the uproar died down, Paul called together the believers and with words of encouragement said good-bye to them. Then he left and went on to Macedonia.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-nya salo maa ka bɛ yɛla daa niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, ka o daa chɛ ka barinim bɛn be bɛ ni kpaŋ.
en: When Jesus got out of the boat, he saw the large crowd. He felt sorry for them and healed everyone who was sick.

dag: Bɛ daa leela zoomba n-dari gindi soya zuɣu, ka ʒim varim ba hal ka so ti ku tooi shihi bɛ binyɛra.
en: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o mapira dɔni, dama o nyɛla a ma dɔɣira ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your mothers sister. She is your mothers close relative.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa sɔhigi ka dam; ka zuɣusaa tanzahi daa sɔhigi ka dam o suhuyiɣisili zuɣu.
en: Then the earth trembled and shook; the foundations of the sky rocked and quivered because God was angry!.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛl niriba bɛn zaa daa laɣim o sani maa daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni. Bɛ daa kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi mali sara hal ka so daa naan ku tooi lan kali ba bee m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm yaha.
en: Solomon and a crowd of people stood in front of the chest and sacrificed more sheep and cattle than could be counted.

dag: O suh a nyɛvili, ka a ti o li; ka di nyɛ nyɛvil wɔɣinli din ka bahigu.
en: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, all right— long days, forever and always!.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi yɛn galim a, a ni mali yɛlimaŋli, amaa chɛ ka m bɔh a m bɔhigu ŋɔ. Bɔzuɣu ka tuumbiɛrilana tɔŋda? Bɔzuɣu ka ʒiŋmariba kul tɔŋda?.
en: Lord , if I argue with you, you are always right. But I want to ask you about some things that dont seem right. Why are wicked people successful? Why do people you cannot trust have such easy lives?.

dag: Kum n-yi di mali ma, n naan ku yɛli ya, dama mani n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.

dag: N dabisa pala biɛla? Chɛli ma ka n suhu maai biɛla.
en: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *.

dag: Itiɔpianim ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ biɛhigu bee jɛŋgbina ni tooi taɣi bɛ niŋgbuna bomaboma? Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn gba tum tuumbiɛri ka di mili ya ŋɔ, yi ku tooi lan tum tuun viɛla.
en: Can people change the color of their skin, or a leopard remove its spots? If they could, then you that do nothing but evil could learn to do what is right.

dag: Ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: we finally turned and went into the desert, on the road to the Gulf of Aqaba, as the Lord had commanded, and we spent a long time wandering about in the hill country of Edom.

dag: amaa chamila n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Instead, go to my father's people, to my relatives, and choose a wife for him.

dag: Vi bi mali ma lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu, dama lahibal suŋ maa nyɛla Naawuni yiko din tiligiri ŋunkam niŋ li yɛda; Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: I have complete confidence in the gospel; it is God's power to save all who believe, first the Jews and also the Gentiles.

dag: Ka o daa kpe n-chaŋ ti zan o dan Ilaisha tooni, ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Gɛhaazi, ya polo ka a lee chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: Gehazi came in and stood before his master. Elisha said to Gehazi, Where have you been Gehazi? Gehazi answered, I didnt go anywhere.

dag: Dauda ni daa labi Zikilag, o daa piila o ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa maa shɛli nti ti o zɔnim bɛn daa nyɛ Juda kpamba la ka yɛli ba, N ni tuhi Yawɛ dimnim ka di neen shɛŋa ka m pii tin ya na maa.
en: When David got to Ziklag, he sent some of the things he took from the Amalekites to his friends, the leaders of Judah. David said, Here is a present for you that we took from the Lord s enemies.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din bi tuhi ni yi nahim niriba.
en: You are doomed! You make unjust laws that oppress my people.

dag: M mini Masia kpimi o dapulli zuɣu, ka di pala mani n-lan be maa, amaa di nyɛla Masia ŋun be n ni la m-be maa; ka n ni mali biɛhigu shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, m mal li la Naawuni Bia ŋun daa yuri ma ka kpi n zuɣu maa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So I am not the one living now—it is Christ living in me. I still live in my body, but I live by faith in the Son of God. He is the one who loved me and gave himself to save me.

dag: Ka nambɔɣu daa gbaai Yisa, ka o teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛl o, N saɣiya; di naama.
en: Jesus was filled with pity, and reached out and touched him. I do want to, he answered. Be clean.

dag: Bɛ ni kpɛhi shɛb duu yɛla daa niŋ ya nambɔɣu, ka bɛ ni daa fa yi nɛma zaa la, yi daa niŋ suɣilo dee li ni suhupiɛlli, yi ni mi ni yi mali binshɛŋa din so ka nyɛ din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu.
en: You shared the sufferings of prisoners, and when all your belongings were seized, you endured your loss gladly, because you knew that you still possessed something much better, which would last forever.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini. Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o, ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: They answered, It is Caesars picture and Caesars name. Then Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God.

dag: Nimaani ka ŋun gbibi yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ min o naan tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n sariakarita maa naan bahi ma zaa.
en: There those who do the right thing can argue with him; I could escape from my judge forever.

dag: Ti ni nya nɛma balibu kam din mali shaara, ka ŋme n-di nɛma pam ti pali ti yinsi.
en: Well find all sorts of precious wealth; well fill our houses with plunder.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa: Gbilisim tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni wuhir a shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn su n yili ŋɔ fukumsi, ka a yi kul yɛli shɛlikam, n niriba zaa ni niŋ li; kulla n nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ka n yɛn zaŋ gar a.
en: You will be in charge of my kingdom, and all my people will obey your command. Only as the enthroned king will I be greater than you.

dag: Yi ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa piligu ni ha la nyɛla ni ti yum taba.
en: This is the message that you heard from the beginning: love each other.

dag: Di saha ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa yɛli, Chɛ ka man guui kuli nti ti naa lahibali ni Yawɛ fa o o dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said to Joab, May I run and take the news to King David? Ill tell him the Lord has destroyed the enemy for him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n lan ka yaburiga n niŋgbuŋ ni. N sɔŋsim zaa zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: and I have finally reached the end of my rope.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa paɣ o ninni ka yina nti maag o ni ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya bindirigu ti ti na.
en: He washed his face, came back, pulled himself together, and said, Set out the dinner.

dag: m ba daa wuhiri ma, ka yɛri ma, Chɛ ka n yɛligu kpe a suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga; gbibi n ni wuh a shɛli ka be.
en: my father taught me this: Pay attention to what I say. Obey my commands and you will have a good life.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa ʒi nimaani m-bɔhiri bɛ suhuri yɛra.
en: Some legal experts were sitting there, muttering among themselves.

dag: Naawuni Bia Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the Good News about Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Ibram sanna ti yɛl o, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Di saha ka Ibram daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani zali Yawɛ ŋun daa ka o sani maa na.
en: The Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, This is the country that I am going to give to your descendants. Then Abram built an altar there to the Lord , who had appeared to him.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛri Naawuni mini Musa finafina, Bɔzuɣu ka yi yihi ti Ijipti na ni ti ti kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni? Dama bindirigu mini kom ka kpe, ka ti nyee nyɔni bindir chɔɣima ŋɔ.
en: that they complained against God and said to Moses, Did you bring us out of Egypt, just to let us die in the desert? There's no water out here, and we can't stand this awful food.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ kpiɔŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: He alone protects and saves me; he is my defender, and I shall never be defeated.

dag: Di saha ka Sɛrafinim maa ni yino ŋun daa gbib buɣim sal nɛɔŋ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ gbabo gbabi yihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu daaŋa ni n-yiɣi ka n sanna.
en: Then one of the creatures flew down to me, carrying a burning coal that he had taken from the altar with a pair of tongs.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi suhuri mini yi tɛha leela zaɣ pala zaa.
en: Your hearts and minds must be made completely new.

dag: Chɛ ka o paɣa leei pakoli, ka o bihi leei kpibisi.
en: May his children become orphans, and his wife a widow!.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti kaman o ni lo shɛm o suhu ni, ka pa ni yolitim bee muɣisigu zuɣu, dama Naawuni yurila ŋun tiri pini ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka Naawuni nir bebu mali m-be viɛnyɛliŋga zaa, ka o mali din ni chɛ ka o tooi tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, dindina ŋun yom di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi ka di leeg o dini.
en: If the one who dedicates the land wishes to buy it back, they must add one-fifth to its valued price, and it will be theirs again.

dag: Samarianim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda paɣ la ni daa yɛli ni Yisa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa o ni pun niŋ la zuɣu.
en: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, This man told me everything I have ever done.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Jɔshua zaŋ takɔbi tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: So Joshua and his men defeated the Amalekites in this battle.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ma maa ŋun chaŋ, ka a gbahi zaɣ bihi maa kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: You must let the mother go, though you may take the young for yourself so that things go well for you and so you can prolong your life.

dag: Yi ni daa kpalim be Kadɛshi n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ la nyaaŋa.
en: So then, after we had stayed at Kadesh for a long time.

dag: O daa lan bɔhi, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: Why do you see the splinter in your brothers or sisters eye but dont notice the log in your own eye?.

dag: Yilimiya yila ka ŋmɛm guŋgombihi, ka ŋmɛm goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnim din kumsi nyaɣisa.
en: Take up a song and strike the drum! Sweet lyre along with harp!.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Judanima n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: So I will send a fire on Judah, and it will devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsala teeg o nuu na ti shihi n naŋgbampiba, ka n yɛl o, N dana, n ni nya ʒii shɛli maa chɛmi ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: Then the one who looked like a man touched my lips. I opened my mouth and started to speak. I said to the one standing in front of me, Sir, I am upset and afraid because of what I saw in the vision. I feel helpless.

dag: Hal yi ni kul zaŋ bɔchaa mini chibo pam paɣi yimaŋ maa zaa yoli, man sani yi taali maa na kul beni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Even though you scrub yourself with soap or strong powder, the stain of your sin is still before me, declares the LORD God.

dag: Ka so yi tum Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la ni shɛli n-tum alahichi, hal o yi kul bi mi gba, o mali taali, ka di taali maa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If any of you sin unintentionally by breaking any of the Lord 's commands, you are guilty and must pay the penalty.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa naai Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min omaŋmaŋ yili maa tuma zaa. Naa Sulemaana ni daa lo nia ni o tum tuun shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni min omaŋmaŋ yili maa ni maa daa tum naai zaa.
en: So Solomon finished building the Lord s Temple and the kings palace. Solomon did everything that he had planned to do in building a house for the Lord and for himself.

dag: Ka Rut daa yɛl o, N dana, a niŋ ma nirilim pam. Hal m biɛhigu ni kul bi paag a paɣisara bɛn tumd a tuma ŋɔ ni yino gba biɛhigu maa zaa yoli, a kpaŋsi ma a ni tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛm maa puuni.
en: Ruth answered, You are very kind to me, sir. You have made me feel better by speaking gently to me, even though I am not the equal of one of your servants.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu ka leei tipawumlinim kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ tipawumlinim shɛm ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛda la.
en: But the people would not listen. They were very stubborn like their ancestors. Their ancestors did not believe the Lord their God.

dag: ni o kpaŋsi yi suhuri zaa, ka chɛ ka yi mali kpiɔŋ yi zaɣ suŋ kam tumbu mini yi yɛtɔɣ suŋ kam tɔɣisibu ni.
en: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.

dag: Nina neesim chɛ ka nir suhu piɛla, ka lahibali viɛlli tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali yi mabihi ansarisi bɛ nandahima dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali suhupiɛlli Judanim zuɣu bɛ kpimsibu dabisili dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi nyu bara n-niŋ ba bɛ wahala dibu dabisili dali.
en: But you should have taken no pleasure over your brother on the day of his misery; you shouldnt have rejoiced over the people of Judah on the day of their devastation; you shouldnt have bragged on their day of hardship.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma. Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac said to his father Abraham, Father! Abraham answered, Yes, son? Isaac said, I see the wood and the fire. But where is the lamb we will burn as a sacrifice.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nyɛ anabi zuɣu ka o daa mi ni Naawuni pun lo o alikauli ni o ni ti zaŋ o zuliya ni ninvuɣ so leei naa ka o zani o zaani.
en: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.

dag: Ti chamiya ʒiishee ka yi ti wuhi ma yi ni zaŋ ma taali shɛli zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi tɔɣisi wuhi ni yi mali yɛlimaŋli na.
en: Let us go to court; bring your accusation! Present your case to prove you are in the right!.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a daai di gooni din gil li la luhi, ka di chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa gariti nimaani pɔhiri di wala?.
en: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔhi Jɛsi, A bidibisi maa zaa m-be kpe ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Di kpalimla biasani, amaa ŋun gulila piɛri. Ka Samuɛl yɛli Jɛsi, Timmi ti zaŋ o na, dama ti ku ʒini ka pa ni o paala kpe na.
en: Then he asked him, Do you have any more sons? Jesse answered, There is still the youngest, but he is out taking care of the sheep. Tell him to come here, Samuel said. We won't offer the sacrifice until he comes.

dag: Amaa o yɛla ni ti niŋ niriba pam alahiziba ka nanim ti kɔŋ bɛ noya yaabu o zuɣu. Dama bɛ nini ni ti nya bɛ ni daa bi yɛli ba shɛli yɛla; ka baŋ bɛ ni daa pun bi wum shɛli yɛla.
en: But it is also true that many nations will be amazed at him. Kings will look at him and be unable to speak. They will see what they had never been told. They will understand what they had never heard. .

dag: Ka Musa deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daŋ niriba daa yiɣisi abie tihi tiŋ la ni n-dol Juda zuliya niriba maa ti ʒini Juda tiŋgban ni din lab Nɛgɛb polo m-miri Arad la. Bɛ daa ʒini pahila nimaani nim zuɣu.
en: The descendants of Moses father-in-law the Kenite went up with the people of Judah from Palm City into the Judean desert, which was in the southern plain near Arad. They went and lived with the Amalekites.
