dag: Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin saɣisim o; o yi deeg o galimi, nyin chɛl o taali paŋ o.
en: So be careful what you do. Correct any followers of mine who sin, and forgive the ones who say they are sorry.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋa chaŋ ti ŋmaligi zolɔŋni n-tuhi Dauda min o niriba maa soli ka bɛ kanna.
en: She was riding her donkey around a bend on a hillside when suddenly she met David and his men coming toward her.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Din kariya ka ti chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna.
en: Then the people answered, God forbid that we ever leave the LORD to serve other gods!.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni yihi Judanim gba n sani bahi kaman n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim bahi shɛm la, ka zaɣisi Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni daa pii tiŋ shɛl la mini du shɛli n ni daa yɛli, Kpe n yɛn nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la. .
en: The Lord said, I will do to Judah what I have done to Israel: I will banish the people of Judah from my sight, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and the Temple, the place I said was where I should be worshiped.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bɔhi ba, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa? Yi bi mi ni nir kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ tooi nyari ashilɔni yɛla.
en: Joseph said to them, Whats this youve done? Didnt you know someone like me can discover Gods plans.

dag: Ka n daa nya Piɛbil maa ni tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ni zaɣ yini, ka wum ka binnɛma anahi maa ni zaɣ yino ŋun kukoli ŋmani saa tahigu kuhi yɛli, Kamina.
en: Then I saw the Lamb break open the first of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice that sounded like thunder, Come.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ daa nya Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Pɛɔr Baal polo la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa ku yi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Pɛɔr Baal maa.
en: You saw how he killed everyone who worshiped the god Baal Peor.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ di ni bɛ zaa ninni, ka zaŋ li ŋubi.
en: After he said this, Paul took some bread and thanked God for it before all of them. He broke off a piece and began eating.

dag: Do so yi niŋ marisamarisa n-zaŋ paɣipiɛl so bɛ ni bi zaŋ ti doo dɔni, di simdi ka o yo paɣ maa paɣibɔr liɣiri zaa, ka kpuɣ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Suppose a young woman has never had sex and isn't engaged. If a man talks her into having sex, he must pay the bride price and marry her.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ; yi nyɛla n-daba. Mani n-nam ya ni yi nyɛ n daba. N ku tam yi yɛla.
en: Remember these things, Jacob; Israel, for you are my servant. I formed you; you are my servant! I wont forget you, Israel.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa di nam maa su Izraɛlnim yuma ata.
en: Abimelech ruled the Israelites for three years.

dag: N yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu, mbusim be n zuɣu! Ka n yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, n ku tooi kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa, dama n yi lihi n wahala ŋɔ vi m-mali ma.
en: As soon as I sin, I'm in trouble with you, but when I do right, I get no credit. I am miserable and covered with shame.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yiɣisi kpɛri dunoli maa zuɣusaa duu puuni ka kumda. O ni daa chani ni o ti kpe maa o daa yɛrimi, Mbaye, m bia Absalom, m bia, m bia Absalom! Mani n-yi di kpi ka chɛ a ŋɔ, di di so. Mbaye, Absalom. M bia, m bia.
en: The king was overcome with grief. He went up to the room over the gateway and wept. As he went, he cried, O my son! My son Absalom! Absalom, my son! If only I had died in your place, my son! Absalom, my son.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga gooni, kuhimi pampam niŋ ti Duuma. Chɛ ka a nintam zɔri yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni kaman kɔpaliga la. Miri ka a ti amaŋ vuhim, di chɛ ka a nina vuhi.
en: Cry out to my Lord from the heart, you wall of Daughter Zion; make your tears run down like a flood all day and night. Dont relax at all; dont rest your eyes a moment.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun daa tiligi Ibrahimma o muɣisigu puuni la yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, Yi ku lan di vi, yi mi ninni biɛhigu ku lan taɣi.
en: Therefore, proclaims the LORD, the God of the house of Jacob, who redeemed Abraham: Jacob wont be ashamed now, and his face wont grow pale now.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri mini alɔbo dɔriti ni daa mali shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka kari alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahi, ka neei zoomba pam gba nina.
en: Right then, Jesus healed many of their diseases, illnesses, and evil spirits, and he gave sight to a number of blind people.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun chɛri niriba taali ni di chɛ ka bɛ zɔr a.
en: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka zaŋ li yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta, ka o mi yɛli Naa Ahasivɛrɔs Mɔdɛkai ni wum shɛm ka yɛl o.
en: When Mordecai got wind of it, he reported it to Queen Esther. She spoke to the king about it, saying the information came from Mordecai.

dag: amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni daba ata dali ka chɛ ka o yi palo.
en: But on the third day after his death, God raised him to life and let him be seen openly.

dag: N zaɣisi n yiŋa. N zaŋ n ni su shɛli bahi. N zaŋ n suhu ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb pam niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The Lord says, I have abandoned Israel; I have rejected my chosen nation. I have given the people I love into the power of their enemies.

dag: Yi ku tooi nyu ti Duuma pipia ni binnyurigu, ka lan nyu alizin biɛri pipia ni binnyurigu. Yi mi ku tooi di ti Duuma bindirigu, ka lan di alizin biɛri bindirigu.
en: You cant drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons; you cant participate in the table of the Lord and the table of demons.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim daa ti chɛ Naawuni maŋli jɛmbu ka di yuui pam, ka mi ka maligumaana ŋun ni wuhiri ba; ka daa bi lan doli zaligu yaha.
en: For a long time Israel was without the true God, without a priest to teach them, and without the Instruction.

dag: Ka o zaŋ li mihi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa buyopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka o yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ maa bahi ka o yiɣi.
en: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, You are now clean. Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.

dag: Yi yi bi birigi Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu, ka bi tumdi yi suhuyubu dindali maa, ka tiri li jilima, ka bi chani soya, ka bi tumdi tuma bee n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya dindali maa.
en: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ma jɛmbu ka tuɣindila tulaale zim maani bɛ buɣa la zuɣu, bɛ chɛ ka bɛ nuhi tuma zaa ku ma suli ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi yaŋɔ nim zuɣu ka ku maai.
en: I will do this because the people left me and burned incense to other gods. They made me angry because of all the bad things they have done. So I will pour out my anger on this place. Like a hot burning fire, my anger will not be put out.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa deei ti dɔriti mini ti suhugarigu ʒi. Amaa ka ti daa tɛhi ni Naawuni n-darig o tibili ka ti o biɛrim maa.
en: But he endured the suffering that should have been ours, the pain that we should have borne. All the while we thought that his suffering was punishment sent by God.

dag: Ka yi yi ni zɔr Yawɛ ka jɛmd o, ka deer o noli ka ku zaɣisi ŋun Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka yi mini yi na so ŋun sun ya maa zaa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, dindina shɛlikam ni niŋ viɛnyɛla yi sani.
en: If you and your king want to be followers of the Lord , you must worship him and do what he says. Don't be stubborn!.

dag: Tiligim ma ninsalinim nahiŋgu ni, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: Redeem me from the people who oppress me so I can keep your precepts.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a tim ma na?.
en: Then Moses turned to the Lord again and said, Lord, why do you mistreat your people? Why did you send me here?.

dag: Ŋun biriti mini ŋun mihiri kom zaa nyɛla yim, ka bɛ zaa ni ti deei bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm laara.
en: There is no difference between the one who plants and the one who waters; God will reward each one according to the work each has done.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti ka Damaskus na. Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa biɛra. Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Naawuni nir la be yaŋɔ.
en: Some time later Elisha went to the capital city of Damascus to visit King Benhadad of Syria, who was sick. And when Benhadad was told he was there.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda pahila ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa niŋ yɛda maa zuɣu nya alibarika.
en: Abraham believed this, and because he believed, he was blessed. All people who believe are blessed the same as Abraham was.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛbihi ni ti laɣindi dira, ka gbuɣima ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman niɣi la, ka tinvura bindirigu ni nyɛla taŋkpaɣu. Bɛ ti ku lan dim so bee n-ku so n zoli din be kasi maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Wolves and lambs will eat together; lions will eat straw, as cattle do, and snakes will no longer be dangerous. On Zion, my sacred hill, there will be nothing harmful or evil.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa ti doli tiŋ maa gooni zuɣusaa n-chani garita, ka paɣ so kuhi yɛl o, N dan naa, sɔŋm ma.
en: The king of Israel was walking on the wall around the city. A woman shouted out to him. She said, My lord and king, please help me.

dag: Ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha maa ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba.
en: So Edom has been independent of Judah to this day. Libnah rebelled at the same time.

dag: Niriba daa chɛla vuri ka gbilisiri tibili guhiri n ni yɛn di ba kpamli alizam shɛli.
en: When I gave advice, people were silent and listened carefully to what I said;.

dag: Ka n daa gbi mɔɣa ŋ-ŋɔŋdi di kom yɔɣiri li.
en: I made reservoirs for myself to water my lush groves.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo, Naawuni yɛliya: Biɛɣ asiba zaŋ hal ni yuŋ ka n kul teegi n nuhi n-gahiri booni tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duntaariba ŋɔ.
en: But concerning Israel he says, All day long I held out my hands to welcome a disobedient and rebellious people.

dag: Shɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Jafɛt biɛlikpɛma ka nyɛ Ɛbanim zaa yab la gba daa dɔɣi bihi.
en: Children were also born to Shem the father of all Ebers children and Japheths older brother.

dag: N ni chaŋ wɔɣira sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la. Amaa hal bɛ gba nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ fukumsi ka bi deeg o noli.
en: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands. But even they had decided not to obey the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa paag o sani nti balim o pam yɛra, Sapashini maa simdi ni a sɔŋ o.
en: They came to Jesus and begged him earnestly, This man really deserves your help.

dag: Manna maa daa ŋmanila tiwal shɛli din biɛlim pɔripɔra, ka di kɔtomsi nyɛ zaɣ piɛlifaa kaman dɔzim la.
en: The manna was like coriander seed and its color was like resin.

dag: Niriba pam n-nyɛ naa jilima, amaa niriba yi kani, naa pala shɛli.
en: A king's greatness depends on how many people he rules; without them he is nothing.

dag: Ka yi yi tum taali ka bɛ fiɛbi ya di zuɣu, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya di zuɣu? Amaa yi yi tum din tuhi ka bɛ niŋ ya wahala di zuɣu ka yi niŋ suɣilo dee li, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani di zuɣu.
en: But what praise comes from enduring patiently when you have sinned and are beaten for it? But if you endure steadfastly when youve done good and suffer for it, this is commendable before God.

dag: dama yi na bi paai vuhim shee mini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ luɣ shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: because up to this point you havent yet reached the place of rest or the inheritance the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bi galisi, ka nyɛ saamba di ni la.
en: At the time God said this, there were only a few of his people, and they were strangers there.

dag: Yidaampaɣ suŋ nyɛla o yidan nam zuɣupiligu, amaa paɣ so ŋun dihir o yidan vi ŋmanila dɔro o yidan kɔbili ni.
en: A good wife is her husband's pride and joy; but a wife who brings shame on her husband is like a cancer in his bones.

dag: Lihimi n nudirigu polo nya, so bi bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli. N ka sɔɣibu shee; so baɣa ka n ni.
en: Look right beside me: See? No one pays attention to me. Theres no escape for me. No one cares about my life.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Taai nti zaŋ Huram na.
en: King Solomon sent for a man named Huram who lived in Tyre and brought him to Jerusalem.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha: Ti Duuma mi ka yɛnnim tɛha nyɛla yoli.
en: and another scripture says, The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are worthless.

dag: Ka Midiannim daa nyaŋ Izraɛlnima; ka Izraɛlnim maa zo nti sɔɣi bɔɣa din daa be zoya zuɣu puuni mini tampima voya ni ni luɣ shɛŋa bɛ n-ni tooi sɔɣi zani tuhi tɔbu.
en: The Midianites were stronger than Israel, and the people of Israel hid from them in caves and other safe places in the hills.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Yawɛ ni zali ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Then Moses said to them, This is what the Lord has commanded must be done.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yisifu na be o nyɛvil ni, ka nyɛla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana. Ka Yaakubu yɛma daa ŋma, dama o daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: They announced to him, Josephs still alive! Hes actually ruler of all the land of Egypt! Jacobs heart nearly failed, and he didnt believe them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Gaad zuliya paya. Gaad niriba maa toondan n-yɛn nyɛ Riuɛl bia Ɛliasaf.
en: On the other side, the tribe of Gad: the chief of the people of Gad is Eliasaph, Reuels son.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka lari mini suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu naai, ka lan chɛ ka aŋgo mini amiliya kukoya vuri naai kpe yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Before your very eyes and in your own lifetime, I will silence in this place the sounds of joy and gladness and the voices of the bridegroom and the bride.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim dolibu zuɣu sahakam.
en: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.

dag: Tiŋkpambila n-daa beni, ka di puuni niriba bi galisi. Ka na titali daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi na ti teei gili tiŋ maa, ka mɛri bindura gindi di gooni.
en: There was a small town with only a few residents. A mighty king came against it, surrounded it, and waged a terrible war against it.

dag: Amaa tiŋ maa nim yi bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ tin ya ni suhumahili, ka lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ya, dindina yin teemiya gili tiŋ maa.
en: However, if the city does not negotiate peacefully with you but makes war against you, you may attack it.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, ŋun pah ata n-daa nyɛ Jahaziɛl, ŋun pah anahi n-daa nyɛ Jɛkamiam.
en: Jeriah, Amariah, Jehaziel, and Jekameam, sons of Hebron, in order of age;.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa wum li, ka o chaŋ ti du n-tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu n-kuhi yɛli ba, Yinim Shɛkɛmnima, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, ka Naawuni wum yi gba ni yɛn yɛli shɛm!.
en: When Jotham heard about this, he went and stood on top of Mount Gerizim and shouted out to them, Listen to me, you men of Shechem, and God may listen to you!.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni na yɛli, Man ni yɔhim o.
en: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord , I can trick Ahab. How? the Lord asked.

dag: Ka yi tɛhiya ni tibidarigibo bɔ n-lee simdi ninvuɣ so ŋun no n-taai Naawuni Bia, ka lihi ʒiɛm alikauli ʒi shɛli din daa mal o ka o be kasi, ka niŋdi din dihiri Naawuni daalibarika Shia la vi la?.
en: How much worse punishment do you think is deserved by the person who walks all over Gods Son, who acts as if the blood of the covenant that made us holy is just ordinary blood, and who insults the Spirit of grace?.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn Baptaizira ti kana; di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛ kul mooni Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ, ka ŋunkam suhu ye di zuɣu kul zaŋdila kpiɔŋ ni o ti kpe di ni.
en: Until John, there was only the Law and the Prophets. Since then, the good news of Gods kingdom is preached, and everyone is urged to enter it.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahigi alizanda nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa o bi kahigi li wuhi bɛn kpalim bɛna.
en: Jesus answered, Only you can know the secret truths about Gods kingdom. Those other people cannot know these secret truths.

dag: n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ka yɛli, N niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu m-bala. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ teemi n yɛla.
en: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.

dag: Yi ni ti yi nimaani gba n-kahi yi nuhi pa yi zuɣuri ni zɔna. Dama man Yawɛ zaɣisi yi ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb naani maa, ka yi ku tɔŋ bɛ sani.
en: You will turn away from Egypt, hanging your head in shame. I, the Lord , have rejected those you trust; you will not gain anything from them.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti leei yi zɔnim la yi ti leei yi zuɣulaannima, wula ka yi lee yɛn yɛli? Di biɛrim maa ku ŋmanila paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: What will you say when people you thought were your friends conquer you and rule over you? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.

dag: Pa ŋun Hɛzɛkia n-daa wurim o buɣa maligu shee min o sara maligu bimbina zaa, ka zali Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima yɛli Bimbini yini kɔŋko gbini ka yi ni jɛmdi Naawuni ka maani sara di zuɣu la.
en: He is the one who destroyed the Lord 's shrines and altars and then told the people of Judah and Jerusalem to worship and burn incense at one altar only.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam nam maa ni daa nya zaa zani ka niŋ yaa, di daa bi yuui ka o mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu.
en: As soon as Rehoboam had established his authority as king, he and all his people abandoned the Law of the Lord .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋmanila nyee ni pɔhim, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mi ka buchi. Nir yi zaŋ ba pa sania zuɣu, bɛ tibisim bi yaɣ lala; hal bɛ zaa tibisim yi laɣim, di bi paai nyee ni pɔhim tibisim gba.
en: Human beings are nothing but a breath. Human beings are nothing but lies. They dont even register on a scale; taken all together they are lighter than a breath!.

dag: nti yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu nimaani.
en: where they continued to proclaim the good news.

dag: Bɔ n-lee yi tiŋgban nɛli polo kanna kaman nyɔhi din kpuɣi du zuɣusaa ka mɛɛr mini firanki tulaale zim ni kɔhigɔriba ni mali tulaale zim shɛŋa zaa nyom be di ni ŋɔ?.
en: Who is this, coming up from the wilderness, like pillars of smoke? She is perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, selected from all the spice merchants powders.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni kpi. Yawɛ dimnim ni ŋmanila tipuma din viɛla. Bɛ ni vuui yom, bɛ ni vuui kaman nyɔhi la.
en: But evil people are the Lord s enemies, and they will be destroyed. Their valleys will dry up and burn. They will be destroyed completely.

dag: Bɛ daa piligila Naawuni jɛmbu duu malibu tuma maa gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali. Goli maa daba anii dali ka bɛ daa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni zaŋ tabili di zɔŋ la gba. Gol tuuli maa biɛɣ pinaayɔbu dali ka bɛ daa naai di tuma zaa.
en: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month.

dag: Yawɛ, di zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛb ŋɔ taali; ka di chɛ ka ŋun ka taali ŋɔ ʒim yihibu taali be a niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Di saha ka bɛ ni yi ʒim yihibu taali ni.
en: Lord , you saved your people Israel. Now make us pure. Dont blame us for killing an innocent person. In this way these men will not be blamed for killing an innocent person.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti miri tiŋkpan shɛli bɛ ni kuni maa, ka o ŋmani ŋun bɔri ni o garila tooni.
en: They came near the town of Emmaus, and Jesus acted as if he did not plan to stop there.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, To, di pa taali! Amaa Yawɛ yi zaŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna niŋ n nuu ni, n ni zaŋ ya pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n du n-tam yi zuɣu nɔn ya.
en: So Gideon said, All right! When the Lord has handed Zebah and Zalmunna over to me, I will beat you with thorns and briers from the desert.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: That's when the Lord told me to say to the people:.

dag: Anabi Ilaisha saha la kɔnsi pam daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa bɛ so daa bi nya tibbu; Siria do so ŋun yuli daa booni Neeman la kɔŋko n-daa nya tibbu.
en: And there were many people with leprosy living in Israel during the time of the prophet Elisha. But none of them were healed; the only one was Naaman. And he was from the country of Syria, not Israel.

dag: Amaa o ni daa duh omaŋa ka niŋ karimbaani, ka mali hali yoli ni ninkuunsi la zuɣu ka Naawuni daa vuug o o nam ʒiishee, ka o kɔŋ o jilima zaashee maa.
en: But when he became arrogant, acting in stubborn pride, he was pulled off his royal throne and the glory was taken from him.

dag: Bɛ daa yiɣi du zuɣusaa ha n-lab ti lu bulli ni, ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba bɛ barina maa puuni.
en: The ships were lifted high in the air and plunged down into the depths. In such danger the sailors lost their courage;.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim maa daa yiɣis asibaasi, ka wuntaŋ nyeei kpe kom maa, ka bɛ nya ka di do bɛ tooni ha m-mɔhi kaman ʒim la.
en: When they got up the following morning, the sun was shining on the water, making it look as red as blood.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima, yiɣisima, niŋmi yaa! Naawuni tiŋ kasi ŋɔ, zaŋm a situr suma ye. Chɛfirinim mini daɣirinim ku lan kpe a puuni yaha.
en: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.

dag: Amaa ka Onan daa mi ni o bi yɛn su bihi maa. Dinzuɣu o min o biɛli pakoli maa daa yi ti dɔni, o daa yihirila o kom bahi tiŋa ni di chɛ ka o ku dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Onan knew that the children from this union would not belong to him. He had sexual relations with Tamar, but he did not allow himself to stay inside her.

dag: ka yɛli ni di simdi ka bɛ wuhi Judanima ni di sabi Jashar litaafi puuni yɛli.
en: David ordered everyone in Judah to learn the Song of the Bow.

dag: ka Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Hivi nira, ka lan nyɛ tiŋ maa ni naa la bia Shɛkɛm daa nya o gbaag o ti zaŋ o saɣim dih o vi.
en: She was seen by Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite, who ruled that area. Shechem took Dinah and raped her.

dag: Paɣiba, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Chɛliya ka o nol ni yɛligu kpe yi tiba ni. Wuhimiya yi bipuɣinsi kuyila, ka sokam wuh o ʒiʒiinikpee fabila.
en: Women, hear the LORDs word. Listen closely to the word from his mouth: teach your daughters to mourn; teach each other to grieve.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia, Asiria na tital la ni bɔhir a shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: The commander told them, Tell Hezekiah this is what the great king, the king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in to help you?.

dag: Ŋunkam bo n-nya yɛm nyɛla ŋun bɔri omaŋa, ka ŋunkam nyɛ tɛhi zilimalana nyɛla ŋun tɔŋda.
en: Those who acquire good sense love themselves; those who keep understanding find success.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa do bɛ sansana ni n-lihiri taba daba ayopɔin. Ka bɛ daa ti gbaai tab tuhibu daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Sirianim tɔbbihi bɛn chan tiŋ tuhi kɔbiga dindali maa.
en: The armies were camped across from each other for seven days. On the seventh day the battle began. The Israelites killed , Aramean soldiers in one day.

dag: ka zaŋ a nubil suɣi naɣilaa maa ʒim n-zaŋ niŋ sara maligu bimbini binyila la; ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la lɔŋni.
en: Take some of the bulls blood and smear it on the altars horns with your finger. Pour out the rest of the blood at the altars base.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti kari ninvuɣ biɛri bahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Because evildoers will be eliminated, but those who hope in the LORD— they will possess the land.

dag: Ŋuna n-tiri dansi, ŋuna n-lan lɔri dansi maa yuma. Ŋuna n-ŋmɛri tiri dansi, amaa ka o nuu tibiri dansi maa.
en: He injures, but he binds up; he strikes, but his hands heal.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yuli ka n zaŋ kana, ka yi ti bi deei ma, amaa so yi ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli kana, ŋuna ka yi ni deei.
en: I have come in my Fathers name, and you dont receive me. If others come in their own name, you receive them.

dag: Di saha maa Babilɔn Naa tɔbbihi daa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa kpari anabi Jɛrimia niŋ guliba dundɔŋ din daa be Juda nayili la ni.
en: At that time the army of the king of Babylon was surrounding the city of Jerusalem, and Jeremiah was under arrest in the courtyard of the guardhouse. This courtyard was at the palace of the king of Judah.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ka lihimiya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka paɣimiy o di puuni.
en: Be persistent in prayer, and keep alert as you pray, giving thanks to God.

dag: Bunni ni Azigad ni Bɛbai ni.
en: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai.

dag: O daa lan ʒila o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba hal ti yaɣi.
en: But Peter and the others were terribly frightened, and he did not know what he was talking about.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe ma yim maa wuhiya ni bɛ taali bi paai Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa taali.
en: Then the Lord told me that, even though Israel had turned away from him, she had proved to be better than unfaithful Judah.

dag: Ka o daa bol o yidana n-yɛl o, Chɛ ka tumtumdi yino zaŋ bun yino ti ma na, ka n chaŋ yomyom ti nya Naawuni nir ŋɔ ka labina.
en: She called her husband and said, Send me one of the young men and one of the donkeys so that I can hurry to the man of God and come back.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, a bahiyoli paag a, di saha paaya, di biɛɣu neeya, di ti yɛn nyɛla suhusaɣiŋgu dabisili, ka pa ni suhupiɛlli vuri yɔbu zoya zuɣu.
en: You people living in Israel, disaster is coming. It is time for punishment. Those are not shouts of joy in the mountains. Those are cries of panic.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi nti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: Again, he left them and prayed, repeating the same words.

dag: Bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu, darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm. Darigim bɛ tibili kaman bɛ nuhi tuma ni simdi shɛm; tim ba bɛ tuma laara.
en: They do bad things to others, so make bad things happen to them. Give them the punishment they deserve.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, Dinzuɣu bɔ ka a lee lan guhira? Yiɣisima n-deei kom baptaizibu ka kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ka a daalahichi kpihim. .
en: What are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized, and wash away your sins as you call on his name.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale din ni mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or.

dag: Yawɛ, a bi lihiri bɔrila yɛlimaŋli? A ŋme ba, amaa di bi mii ba, a darigi bɛ tibili, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg a saɣisigu. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpɛm gari kuɣili. Bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba.
en: Surely the Lord looks for faithfulness. He struck you, but you paid no attention; he crushed you, but you refused to learn. You were stubborn and would not turn from your sins.

dag: Do so yi niŋ marisamarisa n-zaŋ paɣipiɛl so bɛ ni bi zaŋ ti doo dɔni, di simdi ka o yo paɣ maa paɣibɔr liɣiri zaa, ka kpuɣ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: If a man has sexual relations with a virgin who he is not engaged to, then he must pay her father the full amount necessary to marry her.

dag: Hal ka di lan ka buchi ni nir zaŋ li niŋ kulim gba n-zaŋ bah o puu ni n-naɣ pahila bɛ kpaa li mi bahi. Ka daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: It is no longer good for the soil or even for the manure pile. People simply throw it out. If you have ears, pay attention!.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa ka dol o soya ka zɔr o.
en: Keep the commandments of the LORD your God by walking in his ways and by fearing him.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ m bia duɣi ŋubi n-kaai biɛɣu, ka n yɛl o, Zaŋm a bidibiga la na ka ti duɣi ŋub, ka ŋun zaŋ o bidibiga maa ti sɔɣi. .
en: So yesterday we cooked my son and ate him. But today when I went to her house to eat her son, she had hidden him.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela o jɛmbu duu din be kasi puuni, chɛliya ka dunianim zaa fo o tooni.
en: But the LORD is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him.

dag: Niŋm man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim; ka tiligi ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Look on your servant with kindness; save me in your constant love.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa tɛhi ni di luhiya ni n tum shɛlikam chihi Yisa Nazarɛt nira yuli.
en: I myself thought that I should do everything I could against the cause of Jesus of Nazareth.

dag: O chɛ ka ti kul be ti nyɛvili ni, ka bi chɛ ka ti sarigi.
en: He continues to give us life, and he keeps us from falling.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ ti paai di yuma anu saha, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa kana ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: During King Rehoboams fifth year, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

dag: Tuuli alikauli la daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu soli zaligunim mini luɣ shɛli ninsalinim ni daa mali zali Naawuni jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yiko puuni o kuri wɔɣira. O yi tum o tuma, ninvuɣ biɛri kpirimi.
en: God, in his strength, destroys the mighty; God acts—and the wicked die.

dag: Di yi daa nyɛla n zaɣisila n daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba bee paɣiba fabila wumbu.
en: If Ive rejected the just cause of my male or female servant when they contended with me.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa gba daa lan beni yaha. Dina n-nyɛ: Ain mini Rimɔn ni Ɛta ni Ashan: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara anahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔh o mi, A yi pala Masia bee Anabi Ilaija bee bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la, di chaŋ wula ka a baptaiziri niriba.
en: then asked John, If you are not the Messiah nor Elijah nor the Prophet, why do you baptize.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa. Di bi be kaman yi yaannim ni daa di shɛli ka kpi la, amaa ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ dina, dilan ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: This, then, is the bread that came down from heaven; it is not like the bread that your ancestors ate, but then later died. Those who eat this bread will live forever.

dag: Sool ni daa nya ka Dauda chani ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, ka o bɔhi Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ nachimbil maa? Ka Abinɛr garigi yɛli, Naa, nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi mi.
en: After King Saul had watched David go out to fight Goliath, Saul turned to the commander of his army and said, Abner, who is that young man? Your Majesty, Abner answered, I swear by your life that I don't know.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ni ŋmahiŋmahi nim shɛŋa maa mini binzuɣu ni biŋkpam nti pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim tahima; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi ba bɛ muɣisigu saha. Wula ka a be kaman sana n-nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee kaman yuŋ ni sabigi sochanda so ka o yɛn zani gbe luɣ shɛli maa?.
en: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum maa ni daa ti lu n-gili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa puuni saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ yooi bindira duri maa zaa n-kɔhiri bindira maa Ijiptinim zaa zuɣu, dama kum maa daa miiya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The famine grew worse and spread over the whole country, so Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus daa zaŋ li n-tila Mitrɛdat ŋun daa nyɛ laɣiguliba kpɛm ŋun daa niŋ di laasabu n-ti Juda gomna Shɛshibaza la.
en: Persias King Cyrus handed them over to Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

dag: Ka ti Duuma ŋun ʒi alizanda ni la lara, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: The one who rules in heaven laughs; my Lord makes fun of them.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama tuun kar shɛŋa din daa tum yi tinsi maa ni la yi di daa tumla Sɔdom, di naan na kpalim ʒiɛya hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: And you, Capernaum, will you be honored by being raised up to heaven? No, you will be thrown down to the place of the dead. After all, if the miracles that were done among you had been done in Sodom, it would still be here today.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wun shɛŋa din pa din daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ zaa ni ti naai dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ku lan be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na.
en: You people must tell them that the gods who did not make the earth and the sky will be destroyed. They will no longer exist anywhere on earth.

dag: Hal ŋun nyɛ n zo simo, ka n niŋ o yɛda, ka m min o laɣindi diri la gba yila n nyaaŋa.
en: Even my good friend, the one I trusted, who shared my food, has kicked me with his heel—a betrayer!.

dag: N yi yɛli ni n ku lan bol a bee n-zaŋ a yuli tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di saha a yɛligu maa ŋmanila buɣim be n kɔba ni dira, ka di gbibbu ti wum ma, ka n ku lan tooi gbib li.
en: I thought, Ill forget him; Ill no longer speak in his name. But theres an intense fire in my heart, trapped in my bones. Im drained trying to contain it; Im unable to do it.

dag: Zom jɛrigu sani, dama a ku nya baŋsim yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: Stay away from fools, for you wont learn wise speech there.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o dabili zooi kaman bimbilin shɛli din jila ba tiŋa tiŋkuŋ ni. Ti ni daa nya o, o daa ka dariza bee viɛlim. Shɛli daa ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu lihibu ni din ni chɛ ka ti bɔr o.
en: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord . He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.

dag: ka din pah anu nyɛ oniɣisi, ka din pah ayɔbu nyɛ kanɛlian, ka din pah ayopɔin nyɛ kirisolait, ka din pah anii nyɛ bɛril, ka din pah awɛi nyɛ tɔpaz, ka din pahi pia nyɛ kirisɔpirɛz, ka din pahi piniyini nyɛ jɛsint ka din pahi pinaayi mi nyɛ amɛtisit.
en: The fifth was sardonyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, and the eighth was beryl. The ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.

dag: Dama di nyɔri so anzinfa, ka di nyɔri lan so salima.
en: Her profit is better than silver, and her gain better than gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti gbahi ya tahi saria karibu shee, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri yi ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm bee n-tɔɣisi shɛm zuɣu; di saha maa yi ni ti baŋ yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: When they bring you to trial, do not worry about what you are going to say or how you will say it; when the time comes, you will be given what you will say.

dag: Babilɔn nyɛla nam tiŋgban suŋ gari nam tiŋgbana zaa. Di nyɛla Kalidianim jilima ni bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara. Man Naawuni ni wurim li kaman n ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra shɛm la.
en: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.

dag: Ninsal shia yi mali yaa di deeri dɔro, amaa nira kɔba ni yi chɔɣisi, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi gbibi li?.
en: Your will to live can sustain you when you are sick, but if you lose it, your last hope is gone.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔhi tihi din yi Sɛnir na m-mali a dapaɣa zaa. Bɛ daa ŋmahila Lɛbanɔn sida tihi daantalisi na ti sa a ni.
en: Your builders used cypress trees from the mountains of Senir to make your planks. They used cedar trees from Lebanon to make your mast.

dag: A ni ti wum bɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Ka di nyaaŋa a ni nya kpiɔŋ chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka o min o tumtumda Pura daa chaŋ ti zani miri bɛ dimnim maa tɔbbi shɛb bɛn lo kpara do sansan maa tariga.
en: You will hear what they are saying, and then you will have the courage to attack. So Gideon and his servant Purah went down to the edge of the enemy camp.

dag: ni Basɛmat ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ka nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt tizɔpaɣ la.
en: the third was Basemath, who was Ishmael's daughter and Nebaioth's sister.

dag: Chɛ ka so ku niŋ o nirilim. So di zo o kpibisi maa nambɔɣu.
en: Let no one extend faithful love to him; let no one have mercy on his orphans.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di yɛra, N na nyɛla bia, dama a ni chaŋ n ni tim a ni a chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa sani nti yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛlim ba shɛlikam.
en: But the Lord said to me, Do not say that you are too young, but go to the people I send you to, and tell them everything I command you to say.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa naɣila jaaŋgbɛhi kɔŋko; di ʒin ya bindira bee adiikunima; yi mi di zaŋya liɣiri niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: He told them, You may take along a walking stick. But don't carry food or a traveling bag or any money.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ me luɣ kasi shee ti ma din ni chɛ ka m be bɛ sani.
en: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.

dag: N sa ni doli m ba kana nti zani baɣil o a ni sɔɣi luɣ shɛli maa ka yɛl o a yɛla, ka o yi sa yɛli shɛlikam, n ni yɛl a.
en: I will go and stand by my father in the field where you are hiding, and I will speak to him about you. If I find out anything, I will let you know.

dag: Ka Huram daa zaŋ daanya daantalisi maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ ni. O daa zaŋla daantal yini zali nudirigu polo, ka boli di yuli Jachin; ka zaŋ daantal yini zali nuzaa polo, ka boli di mi yuli Bɔaz.
en: Hiram placed the two columns on each side of the main door of the temple. The column on the south side was called Jachin, and the one on the north was called Boaz.

dag: So ka ti sunsuuni ŋun ni tooi gooi ti.
en: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa daa kul chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa yomyom kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ bɔ n-lee tuhi ya soli n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: What did the man look like? Ahaziah asked.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: Where did John's right to baptize come from: was it from God or from human beings? They started to argue among themselves, What shall we say? If we answer, From God, he will say to us, Why, then, did you not believe John.

dag: A dabili Dauda zuɣu, di zaɣis a ni pii na so ŋɔ.
en: You made a promise to your servant David; do not reject your chosen king, Lord .

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti vuhi ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣ o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaashee.
en: Then he died and was buried in the city of David, his father. Then Solomons son, Rehoboam, became the next king after him.

dag: Ka bɛn ti zo n-tiligi ni ti bela zoya zuɣu kaman vinvamli ni ŋmana la. Ka bɛ zaa ti fabindi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: And those who flee? They will turn up on the hills like valley doves, all of them moaning, those guilty ones.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino bɔhi ma, Bɛn ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒiɛya ŋɔ lee nyɛla banima, ka ya polo ka bɛ lee yina.
en: One of the elders asked me, Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from.

dag: M biyurisi bɛn nyɛ n ni lan wolisiri shɛb zuɣu ni Masia be yi ni ŋɔ.
en: My little children, Im going through labor pains again until Christ is formed in you.

dag: Zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ pin shɛŋa Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya bɛn yi Babilɔn na la ni zaŋ ti la n-chaŋ Zɛfania bia Jɔsia yiŋa yomyom.
en: He said, Take the gifts given by the exiles Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, and go at once to the home of Josiah son of Zephaniah. All of them have returned from exile in Babylonia.

dag: O tiri bɛn gbarigi yaa, ka tiri bɛn ka yaa yiko.
en: The Lord gives strength to those who are weary.

dag: ka zaŋ n ni daa be muɣisigu ni ka yaai n noli yɛli binshɛli yɛla, ka lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ li ti a la ti a.
en: when I was in trouble.

dag: ni Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa diri ʒi Hɛshibɔn la tin kara zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Ammɔnim tintariga.
en: All the towns that King Sihon of the Amorites ruled were in that land. He ruled in the city of Heshbon. The land continued to the area where the Ammonites lived.

dag: Amaa yi yi gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum o yɛligu ka niŋ n ni yɛli ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dindina n ni zaŋ yi dimnim leei n dimnima, ka tuhi bɛn tuhiri ya.
en: But if you listen carefully to what he says and do all that I say, then Ill be an enemy to your enemies and fight those fighting you.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bo biŋkɔbiri maa mini ŋmana maa zaa na nti kɔri ba m-pirigipirigi ba buyiyi n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ tuhi taba. Amaa o daa bi pirigi ŋmana la bɛn buyiyi.
en: He took all of these animals, split them in half, and laid the halves facing each other, but he didnt split the birds.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, Kpahimiya yi nuhi, duhimiya yi yɛhi yili suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.

dag: Ibrahimma ni daa deei n noli ka doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: I will bless you, because Abraham obeyed me and kept all my laws and commands.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, labisimiya bɛ puri mini bɛ wain tihi puri ni bɛ olivi tihi puri ni bɛ yiya ti ba. Ka labisi yi ni niŋdi ba nyɔri shɛli yi liɣiri mini yi chi ni yi wain ni yi kpam zuɣu la ti ba.
en: Give it back to them, right now. Return their fields, their vineyards, their olive orchards, and their houses. And give back the interest on money, grain, wine, and oil that you are charging them.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di ku yuui ka yi du n-tam Sintani zuɣu n-no m-bɔr o. Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan nyɛ ŋun maari ti suhuri ti wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka ti gba tooi zaŋ suhumaabo shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni mali maari ti suhuri maa m-maari bɛn zaa nyari wahala balibu kam suhuri.
en: He helps us in all our troubles, so that we are able to help others who have all kinds of troubles, using the same help that we ourselves have received from God.

dag: So yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, ŋun bom yuun yini bunyaŋ mali alahichi tumbu sara.
en: If any of you sin unintentionally, you are to offer a one-year-old female goat as a sin offering.

dag: ka Shɛmida daŋ niriba nyɛ Shɛmidanima, ka Hɛfa daŋ niriba nyɛ Hɛfanima.
en: Shemida—the Shemidaite family group; Hepher—the Hepherite family group.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ daa bi yu ni o bahi Judanim yoli o dabili Dauda zuɣu, dama o daa pun lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ firila ti o min o bidibisi.
en: but the Lord was not willing to destroy Judah, because he had promised his servant David that his descendants would always continue to rule.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi halibiɛri zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa zali ya lala.
en: Jesus said, Moses wrote that command for you because you refused to accept Gods teaching.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din na kpalim ka yi yɛn deei maa n-nyɛ: Filistianim tiŋgbani zaa mini Gɛshurinim tiŋgbani.
en: all the territory of Philistia and Geshur.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi ŋma nti ʒe sochira zuɣu n-gu ni yi gbahi bɛ ni shɛb bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la. Di mi daa bi simdi ni yi gbahi bɛn kpalim ti bɛ dimnima bɛ nandahima dabisili dali.
en: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni baansi. Bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni duri ni tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa bi lan tumdi tuun shɛli pahi di zuɣu.
en: The Levite family leaders who were the musicians also lived at the temple. They had no other responsibilities, because they were on duty day and night.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, nyama, n-nyɛ takɔbir ayi! Ka o yɛli ba, Di ni saɣi.
en: The disciples said, Look! Here are two swords, Lord! That is enough! he replied.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka naanyi ŋmaligi chaŋ.
en: Then he blessed the children and went away from there.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa labina di saha maa ti ŋme n-deei Hazɔr, ka zaŋ takɔb ku di naa, dama Hazɔr n-daa nyɛ nama maa zaa tin zuɣu.
en: Joshua turned back at that time. He captured Hazor and struck down its king with the sword. Hazor had been the head of all those kingdoms in the past.

dag: amaa ka Maata ŋun tɛha kul bela bindirigu niŋbu ni, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti bɔh o, N Duuma, a baɣa ka n tizo maa ni chɛ tuma jɛli ma ŋɔ ni? Yɛlim o ni o sɔŋm ma.
en: But her sister Martha was busy doing all the work that had to be done. Martha went in and said, Lord, dont you care that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to help me.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ ni sabbu bachibi fifinyiiŋa gba ku yiɣisi fashee di zaa ti naɣ niŋla pali.
en: Remember that as long as heaven and earth last, not the least point nor the smallest detail of the Law will be done away with—not until the end of all things.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro maa m-paɣi Naawuni di zuɣu, ka zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka lan niŋ zahim la gba lala hal ka bɛ zaa ti nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛm tariga.
en: Jesus took the bread, gave thanks to God, and distributed it to the people who were sitting there. He did the same with the fish, and they all had as much as they wanted.

dag: N teei dabisa shɛŋa din gari ha yɛla; N tɛhir a tuma zaa yɛla. N kul tɛhir a nuhi tuma zaa yɛla.
en: But I remember what happened long ago. I am thinking about all you have done. I am talking about what you made with your hands!.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa zaa tooni, ka kuhi yɛli, Sokam yiɣisim n sani yi. Dinzuɣu so daa ka Yisifu sani saha shɛl o ni daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa o ni nyɛ so.
en: Joseph could no longer control himself in front of all his attendants, so he declared, Everyone, leave now! So no one stayed with him when he revealed his identity to his brothers.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m piɛma varim ʒim. N ni chɛ ka n takɔbi ŋmahi n ni ku shɛba mini n ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb nimdi mini ʒim din yi n dimnim bɛn nyɛ zab wɔɣilanim la ni na.
en: My enemies will be killed and taken as prisoners. My arrows will be covered with their blood. My sword will cut off the heads of their soldiers.

dag: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni puhiri chuɣu yili shɛli ni ka a mini ba ti ʒini n-di ka nyu.
en: Dont enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ni ti nya ka vi gbahi ba ka bɛ yaa zaa naai, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuhi tabi bɛ noya, ka bɛ tiba ti kpiri.
en: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear.

dag: Nir yi zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, di tahirila yɛla na, amaa o yi zaɣisi lala niŋbu, o ni yi yɛla ni.
en: You will be sorry if you promise to pay a strangers debt. Refuse to make such promises and you will be safe.

dag: So miri ka o laɣim paɣ min o bipuɣiŋga dɔni, ka miri ka o bo o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga, bɛ nyɛla paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ o dɔɣiriba ni yɛlimaŋli. Lala nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: You must not have sexual contact with a woman and her daughter. You will not marry her sons daughter or her daughters daughter, thereby uncovering her nakedness. They are her blood relatives; it is shameful.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa chaŋ Yisa sani yuŋ la gba daa bo mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la mini bɛ ni booni ti shɛli aloosi la sum gari taba n-zaŋ na. Di tibisim daa nyɛla kaman kilɔgiram pihita laasabu.
en: Nicodemus also came with about kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni daa taai duŋ niŋ ma Zin mɔɣu ni la, a daa zaɣisi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka niriba maa bi nya n kasitali kom la shee. .
en: because in the Zin desert, when the community confronted you, you rebelled against my command to show them my holiness by means of the water.

dag: Ka o daa mali ti paai yili maa ni n-zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu kpe yili maa ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni so dol o kpe naɣila bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma.
en: When he arrived at the house, he would not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John, and James, and the child's father and mother.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai tinsi maa ni nti zaŋ Yisa tuumba maa mini Jɛrusalɛm cheechi kpamba ni daa tɔɣisi gbaai yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la wuhi ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: Then Paul and those with him traveled through other cities. They gave the believers the rules and decisions from the apostles and elders in Jerusalem. They told them to obey these rules.

dag: ka pihi kuɣa sɔŋ n-lihi nya bulah ayi maa sunsuuni, kuɣ yini ni ti nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka kuɣ yini ti nyɛ Azazɛl dini.
en: Aaron will throw lots for the two goats. One lot will be for the Lord . The other lot will be for Azazel.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kuhi niŋ Musa; ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ka buɣim maa kpi.
en: When the people cried out to Moses, Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire subsided.

dag: M muɣisigu nyabu dali, n daa suhi n Duuma. N daa kpuɣila n nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Naawuni yuŋ zaa ka di bi wum ma, ka n suhu daa zaɣisi maabu.
en: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.

dag: ka doli soli din tuhi ka di chɛ ka napɔn barinim naba ku ŋmirigi, amaa ka lee ni malila alaafee.
en: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman daba anii dali ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: About eight days later Jesus took Peter, John, and James with him and went up on a mountain to pray.

dag: Ti mali bimbin shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi sara maligu malibu tuma tanti jɛmbu duu la ni ka soli ni bɛ di binshɛli din pa di zuɣu.
en: We have an altar, and those who serve as priests in the meeting tent dont have the right to eat from it.

dag: Amaa Abija ŋun yaa daa kul kirisimi. O daa kpuɣila paɣiba pinaanahi n-dɔɣi bidibisi pisinaayi mini bipuɣinsi pinaayɔbu.
en: Abijah, however, grew strong. He married fourteen wives; he had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei ka bɛ daŋ yiɣisibu lo tab alikauli, ka Yisahaku daa chɛbisi ba ka bɛ kuli ni suhudoo.
en: Early the next morning Isaac and the others made a solemn agreement, then he let them go in peace.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Filistianim ni doli dimdi din bi naara mini nia biɛri din be bɛ suhuri ni n-ku niriba la zuɣu.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, The Philistines have taken cruel revenge on their agelong enemies and destroyed them in their hate.

dag: Barinim pam bɛn gbarigi n-daa kul do lunfanim maa ni: Zoomba mini gbariti ni bɔɣukpimanima ni gbalikpimanima. Bɛ daa doya gulila kom maa dambu.
en: A large crowd of sick people were lying on the porches—the blind, the lame, and the paralyzed.

dag: A ni sɔɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Zallakudura Naa sani ka zaŋ o leeg a biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli duno shɛli din daa be dunɔdali luɣili zuɣu la yi n-chaŋ nuzaa polo du kasi shɛŋa din nyɛ maligumaaniba duri la ni, nimaani ka n daa nya luɣ shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo tariga la.
en: The man led me through the entrance at the side of the gate. He led me to the holy rooms for the priests on the north side. There I saw a place at the west end of the path.

dag: nya ka Pita ʒiya wuɣisiri buɣim, ka o lih o ka yɛli, A gba yi bela Yisa Nazarɛt doo ŋɔ sani.
en: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked straight at him and said, You, too, were with Jesus of Nazareth.

dag: N yɛm puuni ka n zaŋ baŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa. N daa yɛliya, N ni niŋ yɛndana, amaa ka m mini di shee ti wɔɣa.
en: I used my wisdom to test all of this. I was determined to be wise, but it was beyond me.

dag: Amaa Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛn tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba shɛm.
en: Moses did not give any land to the tribe of Levi. The Lord , God of Israel, promised that he himself would be the gift for the tribe of Levi.

dag: O daa zaŋla dabipaɣiba ayi maa mini bɛ bihi bahi tooni, ka chɛ ka Liya min o bihi paya, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl mini Yisifu be nyaaŋa.
en: He put the concubines and their children first, then Leah and her children, and finally Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni wum ti paɣ so ŋun bol omaŋa anabi ka o yuli booni Jɛzibɛl la zuɣu. O nyɛla ŋun yɔhindi n jɛmdiba n-wuhiri ba ka bɛ niŋdi zina, ka diri buɣa maligu nimdi.
en: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka soya niŋ Mɔab luɣili zuɣu tintariga tinsi din nyɛ Bɛtijɛshimɔt mini Baalimiɔn ni Kiriataim din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa jilima tinsi la ni.
en: I will cut into Moabs shoulder—I will take away the cities that are on its borders—the glory of the land, Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim.

dag: ni Shammɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Harɔd nir la ni Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛlɔn nir la.
en: Shammoth from Haror; Helez from Pelon.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ mini bɛ bidibisi n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoli maa fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: They and their descendants continued to guard the gates to the Temple.

dag: Piligu ni ka Naawuni ni booni so Yɛligu la daa be. Yɛligu maa daa bela Naawuni sani. Yɛligu maa daa nyɛla Naawuni.
en: In the beginning the Word already existed; the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tiŋgbani fabinda, ka ŋunkam be di ni kɔba ni chɔɣisi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣira ni teeku ni zahim gba ku lan beni.
en: And so the land will dry up, and everything that lives on it will die. All the animals and birds, and even the fish, will die.

dag: Amaa ka a niriba maa yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Ka di mi nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi shɛm n-lee bi doli zaligu soli.
en: And your people say that what I do isn't right! No, it's their way that isn't right.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib gba daa maan o ansarisi ka yɛri taba, O daa tiligi shɛba ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the Law made fun of Jesus, saying to one another, He saved others, but he cannot save himself!.

dag: Ti wum vuri zoya zuɣu. Di nyɛla Izraɛlnim fabila kuhigu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu. Bɛ tamla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla.
en: You can hear crying on the bare hills. The people of Israel are crying and praying for mercy. They became very evil. They forgot the Lord their God.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-su nam sahakam. A nam kul ʒiɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But you, O Lord , are king forever and will rule to the end of time.

dag: Ka bindirigu kam din be di puuni ka nyɛ kom ni kpaai bahi shɛli zuɣu nyɛla din ni leei daɣiri, ka binnyurigu kam din yi duɣu maa puuni na ni leei daɣiri.
en: Any food which could normally be eaten, but on which water from such a pot has been poured, will be unclean, and anything drinkable in such a pot is unclean.

dag: Dinzuɣu di lan ŋmariya tab ʒiri! Sokam yɛlim o mabia yɛlimaŋli, dama ti zaa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: Therefore, after you have gotten rid of lying, Each of you must tell the truth to your neighbor because we are parts of each other in the same body.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Sagbana yi ti mɔhi zaawun mahili, yi yɛrimi ni di sa ni neei biɛɣu ni.
en: But he replied, At evening you say, It will be nice weather because the sky is bright red.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan nya ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri ŋɔ bee n-tum buɣijɛmbo tuma. N ni tiligi n niriba yi nuu ni. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So you will not see any more useless visions or do any more magic. I will save my people from your power, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔhi daanya shɛli tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi ni pisinaanu.
en: Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given.

dag: Zɔnim shɛb zaŋla zɔtali yɛla niŋ asahi, amaa zɔ maŋli so beni gari nir mabia gba.
en: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.

dag: N zaŋla yurilim din bi naari gbibi niriba tuhilituhili ka chɛri bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi taali, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ biɛri bihi tibili mini bɛ yaansi tibili zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmana din pahir ata mini anahi ni.
en: showing great loyalty to a thousand generations, forgiving every kind of sin and rebellion, yet by no means clearing the guilty, punishing for their parents sins their children and their grandchildren, as well as the third and the fourth generation.

dag: Zaŋmi kuɣ kara niŋ a nuu ni n-chaŋ ti zaŋ li pi bɛ ni zaŋ yaɣiri malimali duno shɛli bɛ ni doli kpɛri Firawuna yili shɛli din be Tapanhɛs maa la ni. Chɛ ka Judanim maa nya a ni piri li shɛm.
en: Jeremiah, get some large stones. Take them and bury them in the clay and brick sidewalk in front of Pharaohs official building in Tahpanhes. Do this while the people of Judah are watching you.

dag: O mabia Hɛlɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔfa mini Imna ni Shɛlɛsh ni Amal.
en: Shomers brother was Helem. Helems sons were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ti teei zani ni bɛ zaŋ nya taba.
en: The Israelites and Philistines were lined up and ready for battle.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri din gari lala n-jɛndi ti Duuma NAAWUNI min o dabili Hɛzɛkia.
en: The officers of the king of Assyria said worse things against the Lord God and against Hezekiah, Gods servant.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa sanʒiɛɣu puuni yɛli.
en: Then out of the storm the Lord spoke to Job.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia la biɛɣu pia dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the ninth year, on the tenth day of the tenth month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Di saha ka n ni daa pun wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na la lan yɛli ma yaha, Cham ti deei litaafi bil shɛli din bɔɣi be malaika so ŋun tam teeku kom zuɣu mini duli zuɣu ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Then the voice I heard from heaven spoke to me again and said, Go, take the opened scroll from the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Alɔbo zaɣ yini n-kpalim ka n yɛn chɛ ka di lu Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, o ni kari ya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The Lord said to Moses: I am going to punish the king of Egypt and his people one more time. Then the king will gladly let you leave his land. In fact, he will even chase you out.

dag: Di pala lahibal sun shɛli n-shiri lan beni pahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb beni chirindi ya yi tɛha ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ taɣi Masia lahibal suŋ maa.
en: Actually, there is no other gospel, but I say this because there are some people who are upsetting you and trying to change the gospel of Christ.

dag: Bɛ daa malila yuri kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihitanaayɔbu, ni buntaansi kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: They had horses, mules, camels, and donkeys.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dɛbɔra mini Barak Abinɔam bia la daa yili yilli ŋɔ:.
en: On the day that the Israelites defeated Sisera, Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:.

dag: Ka n daa bɔri ni m baŋ bɛ ni gbaag o shɛli zuɣu, ka zaŋ o tahi bɛ jintɔriba sani.
en: I wanted to find out what they had against him. So I brought him before their council.

dag: Yisa Masia yɛla ba jila yi sunsuuni ka yi palɔni.
en: in the same way that the testimony about Christ was confirmed with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa yuui ha, ka Ammɔnnim daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: Sometime afterward, the Ammonites made war against Israel.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa yi Taiatira na n-nyɛ ago chinchin kɔha, ka o yuli booni Lidia, ka o daa nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni la daa be nimaani. Ka ti Duuma daa yoog o suhu ka o niŋ Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm yɛda.
en: One of them was Lydia, who was from the city of Thyatira and sold expensive purple cloth. She was a worshiper of the Lord God, and he made her willing to accept what Paul was saying.

dag: Chɛ ka o bihi chanimi gindi maani bara, ka bɛ kari ba yihi bɛ yili chɛra ni.
en: Let his children wander aimlessly, begging, driven out of their ruined homes.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi daŋ Sool tooni chaŋ Zif. Di saha Dauda min o niriba daa bela Maɔn yɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Araba, ka di be Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la.
en: The people from Ziph went back ahead of Saul, and they found out that David and his men were still south of Jeshimon in the Maon Desert.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Nɔb nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la sani. Ka Ahimɛlɛk daa kana ti tuhi Dauda soli ka o niŋ sɔhira; ka o bɔhi Dauda, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ka kpe na, ka so bi dol a na.
en: Then David left and Jonathan went back to the town. David went to the town named Nob to see Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech went out to meet David. He was afraid of David and asked, Why are you alone? Why isnt anyone with you.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bantab viɛlli vil o zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bantab viɛlli maa vil o zuɣu maa, ka zaŋ binyɛr suŋ yɛl o; ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛya.
en: I spoke up and said, Also put a clean priestly turban on his head. Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord 's angel stood there watching.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli. Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ nti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: Then he taught them many things by using stories. He said: A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Judanim la mini bɛ yaansi su n zoya ni tiŋgbana la. N ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn jɛmdi ma n-yɛn be nimaani.
en: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bemi kaman Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So, as the Holy Spirit says, Today, if you hear his voice, .

dag: Nyama di daba ata dali ka do so daa ti yi Sool sansan ni n-zo m-paana ka o binyɛra chahi, ka taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu. O ni daa ti paai Dauda sani, o daa lumi gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura.
en: The next day a young man arrived from Saul's camp. To show his grief, he had torn his clothes and put dirt on his head. He went to David and bowed to the ground in respect.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ o kpiya, ka bɔ zuɣu ka n lee lan yɛn lo noli yaha? N ni tooi lan chɛ ka o labina? Mani n-naɣi ni ti chaŋ o sani, amaa ŋun ku lan labi n sanna. .
en: But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Could I bring the child back to life? I will some day go to where he is, but he can never come back to me.

dag: m-booni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti chani bɛ chandi shee.
en: and calls out to people passing by, who are minding their own business:.

dag: Ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam, n ni niŋ li ka m Ba nya jilima n zuɣu.
en: And if you ask for anything in my name, I will do it for you. Then the Fathers glory will be shown through the Son.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣimi do bɛ sɔɣibu shee kaman gbuɣinli la guhira. Bɛ domi gu tarimba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zana bari gbahi ba n-vo n-chaŋ.
en: They lie in ambush in secret places, like a lion in its lair. They lie in ambush so they can seize those who suffer! They seize the poor, all right, dragging them off in their nets.

dag: O teeg o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla Izraɛlnim sani. Dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa nim nya ti Naawuni nasara dibu maa.
en: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ o tahi bɛ sani, ŋmɛnditoya maa daa woliwolila taba ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka wari wahi, bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa Filistia mini Juda tiŋgbana ni maa zuɣu.
en: He led David to the Amalekites. They were eating and drinking everywhere, celebrating because of what they had taken from Philistia and Judah.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yisifu biɛyanim maa, Tuun bɔ n-lee nyɛ yi tuma? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ mini ti yaannim nyɛla piɛguliba.
en: who asked them, What do you do for a living? Sir, we are shepherds, was their answer. Our families have always raised sheep.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa di nasara n-yɛligi gili luɣilikam.
en: So the Lord's message spread and became even more powerful.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka Miidianim maani shili ni bɛ liri ba. Bɛ je anzinfa, bɛ mi baɣa ka salima ni.
en: Look! Im rousing the Medes against them; the Medes pay no mind to silver, no desire for gold.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ma paai nimaani, do so daa be nimaani ka o niŋgbuŋ daa nyɛlisira kaman daanya la. O daa gbibila mi piɛlli mini bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli buɣisiri binyara la o nuu ni. O daa ʒiɛla dunɔdali gbini.
en: He took me to that place. There was a man there who looked like polished bronze. He had a cloth tape measure and a measuring rod in his hand. He was standing by the gate.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be n ni, nyin wuhim ma so shɛli din tuhi, ka nyɛ din ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Find out if there is any evil in me and guide me in the everlasting way.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri n nasara dibu la suhuri paligi ka bɛ tahiri suhupiɛlli tahigu yɛri sahakam, Yawɛ ŋun bɔr o dabili nasara dibu ŋɔ galisiya pam.
en: But let those who want things to be set right for me shout for joy and celebrate! Let them constantly say, The LORD is great— God wants his servant to be at peace.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm, ka ŋmari ma ʒiri, ka bi lan tɛhiri n yɛla yi suhuri ni? N ni shini ya ka di yuui, ka ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi lan zɔri ma maa.
en: You did not remember me. You did not even notice me! So who were you worrying about? Who were you afraid of? Why did you lie? Look, I have been quiet for a long time. Is that why you didnt honor me?.

dag: Ibram mini Lɔt ni daa woligi maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo.
en: After Abram and Lot had gone their separate ways, the Lord said to Abram: Look around to the north, south, east, and west.

dag: Bɛ daa dolila bɛ kɔribiɛri soli mɔɣu maa ni, ka daa buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: They were overcome with craving in the desert; they tested God in the wastelands.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni Jɛrusalɛm suhudoo zuɣu yɛra, Chɛ ka bɛn yuri li tɔŋ.
en: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.

dag: Ka o yi ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yaai zaligu ŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ninni ti o.
en: Instead, when he sits on his royal throne, he himself must write a copy of this Instruction on a scroll in the presence of the levitical priests.

dag: N ni labisi yi sariakaritiba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni, ka labisi yi saawarimaaniba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan boli tiŋ maa wuntitali mini ʒiɛyimtali tiŋa.
en: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be Justice and Faithfulness.

dag: O ni daa nya ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim pam gba kanna ni o ti baptaizi ba ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: When John saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming to him to be baptized, he said to them, You snakes—who told you that you could escape from the punishment God is about to send?.

dag: A yiko puuni, cham ti di nasara; ka taɣi yɛlimaŋli mini din tuhi zali. Chɛ ka a nudirigu tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm.
en: Go out in your greatness to win the victory for what is true and right. Let us see the amazing things you can do with your powerful right arm.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla yi bibihi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni ŋme ŋ-gbahi ba la, yi bi shɛb bɛn bi mi din viɛla ni din bie zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-ni ti kpe di ni, bɛna ka n ni ti zaŋ li ti ka bɛ deei li su.
en: Now as for your toddlers, those you said would be taken in war, and your young children who dont yet know right and wrong—they will enter the land. I will give it to them. They will possess it!.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi niŋ ania din ni chɛ ka yi tum Naawuni yubu, ka nya o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la palibu.
en: You need to endure so that you can receive the promises after you do Gods will.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa n-gooi tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ daa chɛ Izraɛlnim maa kari doli ka labina.
en: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped chasing the Israelites, because Joab held them back.

dag: Nuhu daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinu, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Noah lived years; then he died.

dag: ka di shiri niŋ pali, ka bɛ yɛli ya, Chɛliya ka ti doli wun shɛŋa ka jɛmdi li.
en: in order to lead you to worship and serve gods that you have not worshiped before. Even if what they promise comes true.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yisifu kɔba m-mali chaŋ kaman ŋun Yisifu ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm la. Dama Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Naawuni yi ti ka yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti tiligi ya, ka yi yɛn chaŋ, yin zaŋmiya n kɔba mali chaŋ.
en: Moses took with him Josephs bones just as Joseph had made Israels sons promise when he said to them, When God takes care of you, you must carry my bones out of here with you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli ni bɛ ni niriba tuhi pisinaanahi n-yɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi, ka niriba tusaayɔbu nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini sariakaritiba.
en: David said, , will supervise the work of building the Lord s Temple. will be court officers and judges.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛɣ asiba, o yi sa chani mɔɣili ni, nyin sa zaŋm a jaaŋgbe shɛli din daa leei wahu la niŋ a nuu ni chaŋ ti zani mɔɣili maa duli gul o.
en: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. As he is going out to the water, make sure you stand at the bank of the Nile River so you will run into him. Bring along the shepherds rod that turned into a snake.

dag: N suh a ni n suhu zaa; zom ma nambɔɣu kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa suhuri daa yiɣisi bahi Jɛrimia zuɣu, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ bu o, ka zaŋ o ti kpɛhi duu Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la yiŋa, dama bɛ daa zaŋ o yiŋ maa leela jɛriyali.
en: Those officials were very angry with Jeremiah. They gave an order for Jeremiah to be beaten. Then they put him in a prison. The prison was in the house of Jonathan, a scribe for the king of Judah. His house had been made into a prison.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ suŋ la pun tin ya Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa baŋ din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: You have the gift that the Holy One gave you. So you all know the truth.

dag: Di yɛla daa naɣ ti yila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa ti mabi maŋa la sanna. Bɛ daa kamina nti kpe ti ni ni bɛ puɣisi baŋ ti ni mali yolisim shɛli Yisa Masia ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ti dabitim ni.
en: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binnɛma balibu kam, bɛnya tiŋgbani zuɣu; niɣi mini binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam. Ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then God commanded, Let the earth produce all kinds of animal life: domestic and wild, large and small—and it was done.

dag: Yi mi di maliya li ŋmahindi biŋkɔbigu ŋun be dunia ŋɔ ni bee ŋ-ŋmahindi nooŋa ŋun mali kpiŋkpama yiɣiri zuɣusaa.
en: or any likeness whatsoever, whether of a land animal, a bird that flies in the sky.

dag: Shɛm bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram ni Uzi ni Hul ni Gɛta ni Mɛshɛk.
en: Shem's sons—Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshek—were the ancestors of the peoples who bear their names.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya niriba maa ka bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Ive been watching these people, and Ive seen how stubborn they are.

dag: Ka anab maa daa bo tani n-lo o nini n-taɣ o biɛhigu ŋ-ŋmaligi yi sol ni ti ʒiɛya guhiri naa.
en: The prophet went and stood before the king by the road. He disguised himself by putting a bandage over his eyes.

dag: Di zuɣu ka m boli ya na ni n ti nyan ya ka m mini ya tɔɣisi, dama Izraɛlnim zaa ni mali tahima shɛl la zuɣu ka bɛ lo ma zoligo ŋɔ.
en: This is why I asked to see you and speak with you: its because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain.

dag: Deem o wuhibu din yir o nol ni na, ka zaŋ o yɛligu niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Receive instruction from his mouth; put his words in your mind.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka kpiɔŋnim zaŋ takɔbiri na ti ku a tɔbbihi. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ ni ti saɣim Ijiptinim ni mali binshɛŋa nyuri bara la, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa.
en: I will let soldiers from cruel nations draw their swords and kill all your people. All your people and everything else that you are proud of will be destroyed.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; dabili mi bi garit o duuma.
en: No pupil is greater than his teacher; no slave is greater than his master.

dag: Bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa yinoyino baɣa kul bela bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka pa ni Yisa Masia yɛla ni.
en: Others are interested only in their own lives. They dont care about the work of Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Hasɛnaa bidibisi daa mali me Zahim Dunɔdal la ka zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: The clan of Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They put the beams and the gates in place, and put in the bolts and bars for locking the gate.

dag: Chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi gili luɣilikam wurim a dimnima. Zaŋm a piɛma to ba ka bɛ guui.
en: Send the lightning and make my enemies run away. Shoot your arrows and make them run away.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ ti zani baɣil o n-ku o, ka pilig o zuɣupiligu din be o zuɣu ni, ka lan pirigi baŋ din be o nuu ni na, dama n daa baŋya ni o ni lu n-doya shɛm maa, o ku lan gali. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o nɛma maa na ni n ti ti nyini n dana.
en: So I killed him. I knew he was too badly wounded to live much longer. Then I took his crown and his arm-band, and I brought them to you, Your Majesty. Here they are.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa mini bɛ fiilinima ni sipuɣisinim ni bɛ kpiŋkpama ni kalima maa zaa daa malila nina ti tuui.
en: There were eyes all over their bodies. There were eyes on their backs, on their arms, on their wings, and on their wheels—on all four wheels!.

dag: Naa maa ni ti lihi ʒiɛm o yaannim wuna, ka lihi ʒiɛm paɣiba ni yuri wun shɛŋa gba. Hal o baɣa ti ku be wuni kam ni, dama o ni ti tɛhi ni ŋuna n-gari di zaa.
en: He will give no thought to the gods of his fathers, nor to the god cherished by women. He will give no thought to any god, because he will make himself greater than all of them.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa lan ka o sanna pahi buyi kaman o ni daa pun ka o sanna shɛm Gibiɔn la.
en: Some time later the Lord appeared to him again in a dream, just as he had done at Gibeon.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jehorams deeds and all that he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yihi yi ni kpuɣi atam shɛli yi puri ni pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu zali yuuni kam.
en: Every year you must be sure to save one-tenth of all the crops that grow in your fields.

dag: Dama di nyɔri so anzinfa, ka di nyɔri lan so salima.
en: Profit that comes from wisdom is better than silver and even the finest gold.

dag: Duuma yino m-beni, amaa ka o tuma soya lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: and there are different ministries and the same Lord.

dag: Sulemaana yiŋ dahin yini mɔni daa yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro zim viɛlli lita tusaanu zim maŋli lita tuhi pia.
en: The supplies Solomon needed each day were bushels of fine flour and bushels of meal;.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim mini maligumaaniba bɛn kpalim ni Lɛvinim bɛn kpalim daa bela Juda fɔntinsi zaa ni. Bɛ zaa daa bela bɛ tiŋgbana ni.
en: The other Israelites, and the other priests and Levites, lived in all the towns of Judah. Everyone lived on the land that their ancestors had owned.

dag: ni Yuria ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la ni Zabad ŋun daa nyɛ Ahilai bia la.
en: Uriah the Hittite; Zabad son of Ahlai;.

dag: Dama yi je saɣisigu; ka zaŋ n yɛligu labisi yi kpali nyaaŋa.
en: You hate discipline, and you toss my words behind your back.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, zaɣ biɛɣu kul lurila zuliya, zuliya zuɣu kanna, ka sanʒiɛ titali yiɣisi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛŋa polo katiŋ na.
en: The Lord Almighty says that disaster is coming on one nation after another, and a great storm is gathering at the far ends of the earth.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa la daa nya lala ka yiɣisi niriba maa ni kpuɣi kpani.
en: Phinehas, the grandson of Aaron the priest, saw the couple and left the crowd. He found a spear.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord .

dag: Ka yi ti lan zaŋ lala binyɛra maa m-pahi piɛbil ŋun la zuɣu m-mali sara zaawuni kaman yi ni pun mali shɛm asiba la. Ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim, ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Sacrifice the second lamb in the evening, and offer with it the same amounts of flour, olive oil, and wine as in the morning. This is a food offering to me, the Lord , and its odor pleases me.

dag: Teem a niriba la, ka kpam ba jaande Naawuni zuɣu ni bɛ zom yi yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu din tahiri naŋgbankpeeni na la ni. Di ka buchi, di naɣ saɣindila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li.
en: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.

dag: Dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni daa be Gɛshur Aram tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa lo alikauli yɛli, Yawɛ yi ti chɛ ka n labi Jɛrusalɛm, n ni jɛm o Hiburɔn. .
en: Your servant made this promise when I lived in Geshur, in Aram. I promised that if the LORD would bring me back to Jerusalem, then I would worship the LORD in Hebron.

dag: Miri ka a di shɛhira jɛnd a kpee ka di ka daliri, ka miri ka a yɔhim so.
en: Don't give evidence against others without good reason, or say misleading things about them.

dag: A yi niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nirilim, bɛ bi bɔhindi din tuhi niŋbu. Hal bɛ ni kul be wuntizɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zaa yoli, bɛ bi niŋdi din tuhi. Bɛ bi saɣi ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi.
en: Even though you are kind to the wicked, they never learn to do what is right. Even here in a land of righteous people they still do wrong; they refuse to recognize your greatness.

dag: ni bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛlahi gban shɛŋa ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: rams' skin dyed red; fine leather; acacia wood;.

dag: dindina nyin bom peeŋkpaa n-zaŋ o tibili tabili dunoli naŋgbanyee n-chib li voli, ka o nyɛ a dabili sahakam. Zaŋ chaŋ a dabili ŋun nyɛ paɣ gba polo, di simdi ni a niŋ o lala.
