en: Make this servant put his ear against your door and use a sharp tool to make a hole in his ear. This will show that he is your slave forever. You must do this even to the women slaves who want to stay with you.

dag: Ka Jɔab mini Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim ni wɔɣira zaa daa pahi Abishai zuɣu ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ni bɛ ti biɛhi Bikiri bia Shiiba maa naba.
en: Abishai left Jerusalem to try and capture Sheba. He took along Joab and his soldiers, as well as David's bodyguard and best troops.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Zaŋm tɔbbihi zaa yiɣisi chaŋ Ai; nyama, n zaŋ Ai naa min o niriba ni o tiŋ maa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Dont be afraid; dont give up. Lead all your fighting men to Ai. I will help you defeat the king of Ai. I am giving you his people, his city, and his land.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo pam laɣim gil o maa ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ baami n-du duli ha.
en: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he told his followers to go to the other side of the lake.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini ninvuɣ kubo ni zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ʒiri shɛhiradibo ni nyaanzubo.
en: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.

dag: M mi ni yi ni be luɣ shɛli nimaani ka Sintani nam ʒiishee be. Hal ka bɛ daa ti gbaai n shɛhiralana Antipas ŋun daa ʒe ma yim yi ni la n-ku o Sintani biɛhigu shee, amaa ka yi na kul ʒe ma yim ka bi chɛ ma dolibu.
en: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.

dag: N nya mbusim ni be Izraɛl tiŋgban ni; Ifriimnim tum yolimyolim, ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: I have seen a terrible thing in the nation of Israel. Ephraim was unfaithful to God. Israel is dirty with sin.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ʒini Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita.
en: The Israelites had lived in Egypt for years.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli ni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ni suhuyiɣisili pam. Yawɛ bɔhir o dimnim biɛri, ka yiɣisir o suhu pam bahir o dimnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord God demands loyalty. In his anger, he takes revenge on his enemies.

dag: ŋun di kpihim man Jɔnatan yuli nyin Dauda daŋ ni. Yawɛ bɔhimi nyin Dauda dimnim biɛri ti a.
en: may our promise to each other still be unbroken. If it is broken, the Lord will punish you.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka biriginsim yiko kpe bɛ ni birigi ba, ka bɛ doli ʒiri soli.
en: So God will send them something powerful that leads them away from the truth and causes them to believe a lie.

dag: Ka naa mini Judanim zaa ni Jɛrusalɛmnim ni maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni sokam zaa bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira ni tarimba zaa daa laɣim Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka Naa Jɔsia ti karim Naawuni kundi shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni la yɛtɔɣa zaa ka bɛ wum.
en: Then he went to the Lord 's temple, together with all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, the priests, and the Levites. Finally, when everybody was there, he read aloud The Book of God's Law that had been found in the temple.

dag: Ka Shimɛi yɛli naa, N dana, a ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla. Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm ka di yuui pam.
en: Shimei answered, Yes, my king. I will obey you. So Shimei lived in Jerusalem for a long time.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Ti Duuma, o yi gbihirimi dindina o ni nya alaafee.
en: The disciples answered, If he is asleep, Lord, he will get well.

dag: Yinim zoya mini dunia ŋɔ tanza kurisi la, wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama Yawɛ min o niriba mali yɛtɔɣa; o mini Izraɛlnima m-mali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.

dag: A mini naa yi ʒini ni yi di bindirigu, nyin kpahimmi baŋ din ʒe a tooni maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: When you sit and eat with an important person, remember who you are with.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi ni zaŋ doo ŋɔ tahi n sanna nti yɛli ni o birigirila yi zuliya la, n vih o yi zaa ha ninni, amaa ka bi nya o taali ni yi ni fiɣis o shɛlikam zaa zuɣu maa.
en: He said to them, You brought this man before me as one who was misleading the people. I have questioned him in your presence and found nothing in this mans conduct that provides a legal basis for the charges you have brought against him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ku binshɛɣukam din be dunia ni zaa.
en: The Lord says, I will destroy everything on earth.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, bɔ ka n lee niŋ ya? Bimbɔ ka n zaŋ muɣisi ya? Garigimiya ma!.
en: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.

dag: amaa pirimiya namda, ka di yɛn ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: He told them to wear sandals but not to put on two shirts.

dag: Di saha o min o bihi ni yi a sani n-lab o dɔɣiriba sani ti ʒin o yaannim tiŋgban ni.
en: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni sɔŋdi ma zuɣu, n ku di vi. Dinzuɣu ka n zuɣu ʒe ya. M mi ni n ku di vi.
en: The LORD God will help me; therefore, I havent been insulted. Therefore, I set my face like flint, and knew I wouldnt be ashamed.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm pahi ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pia nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pia maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham said, Dont be angry with me, my Lord, but let me speak just once more. What if there are ten? And the LORD said, I will not destroy it because of those ten.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ o zuu ŋun ti yɛn di nam zan o zaani mali maligu gooni zuɣu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim. Ka suli daa gbaai Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab bɛ ya ka chɛ o.
en: Then he took his oldest son, who was to succeed him as king, and he offered him on the wall as an entirely burned offering. As a result, outrage was expressed by Israel. So they pulled back from Moabs king and returned to their own country.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa nahim ba pam, ka zaŋ bɛ yiko su ba.
en: They were oppressed by their enemies and were in complete subjection to them.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ daa nya Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Pɛɔr Baal polo la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa ku yi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Pɛɔr Baal maa.
en: You have seen what the Lord did at Baal Peor. The Lord your God destroyed all your people who followed the false god Baal at that place.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tahirila Naawuni suhuyiɣisili na, dama zaligu yi kani di chihibu gba ku beni.
en: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.

dag: O yaa bela o shee polo, ka o yiko be o pugbana puuni.
en: Look, his strength is in his thighs, his power in stomach muscles.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni, ka ŋmaligi kpa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa polo ti bo o, bɛ daa nya o.
en: But when trouble came, they turned to the Lord , the God of Israel. They searched for him and found him.

dag: Buni nyɛla din taɣiri nir nyɛvili, amaa so bi varisiri faralana.
en: The rich might have to pay a ransom to save their lives, but the poor never receive such threats.

dag: Niriba soya yi tiɣi Yawɛ nini, hal o ni chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ dimnim be ni suhudoo.
en: When people draw favor from the LORD, even their enemies are at peace with them.

dag: N daa kuhi pam niŋ o, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣ o.
en: I cried to him for help; I praised him with songs.

dag: Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti paŋ liɣiri n-yo farigu ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri zuɣu naa sani.
en: Then others said, We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa lan me duri zali buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka pii niriba maa ni shɛb bɛn pa Lɛvi zuliya n-leei maligumaaniba.
en: Jeroboam also built temples at the high places and chose priests from among the different tribes of Israel.

dag: Masia ni daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima ti zuɣu la puuni ka ti baŋ yurilim ni nyɛ shɛli, ka di simdi ni ti gba zaŋ ti nyɛviya pa talima ti mabihi zuɣu.
en: This is how we know what real love is: Jesus gave his life for us. So we should give our lives for each other as brothers and sisters.

dag: Amaa ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka di ku moli gili m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛliya ka ti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pam ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani.
en: But we must make them afraid to talk to anyone again using that name. Then this problem will not spread among the people.

dag: kaman o ni daa lo ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli shɛli hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Asiria naa, A ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb na nti ʒili Samaria fɔntinsi ni la bi mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu, dinzuɣu ka o chɛ ka gbuɣima kana nti be nimaani kuri ba; bɛ ni bi mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu zuɣu.
en: The emperor of Assyria was told that the people he had settled in the cities of Samaria did not know the law of the god of that land, and so the god had sent lions, which were killing them.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Dauda bidibisi nti pahi o mamanim bidibisi zuɣu, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Tama.
en: In addition to all these sons, David had sons by his concubines. He also had a daughter, Tamar.

dag: Hɛzɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Abija, o daa nyɛla Zakaria bipuɣiŋga.
en: Hezekiah became king of Judah at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years. His mother was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanima, yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya yila paɣi ti Duuma.
en: Kings on earth, sing to God! Sing songs of praise to our Lord! Selah.

dag: Ka n daa ta ba daɣiri bɛmaŋmaŋ pina tibu ni din nyɛ bɛ bidib tuuli kam zaŋ mali sara puuni ni di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri saɣim din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I let them defile themselves with their own offerings, and I let them sacrifice their first-born sons. This was to punish them and show them that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka o yi ti liri tinsi maa, hal Ijipti gba ti ku tiligi.
en: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ bɔhi, Zom ni tooi vo o zoon kpee ka bɛ zaa ti ku lula bɔɣili ni?.
en: Jesus also used some sayings as he spoke to the people. He said: Can one blind person lead another blind person? Won't they both fall into a ditch?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛl o ni o bom naa ti ba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: Samuel told the people who were asking him for a king everything that the Lord had said to him.

dag: amaa di yi yila Naawuni sanna, dindina yi ku tooi nyaŋ ba; hal yi yi dol li gba, di pa shɛli yi ni ti nya ka di nyɛla Naawuni ka yi tuhiri maa. Ka bɛ daa deeg o yɛligu maa.
en: but if it comes from God, you cannot possibly defeat them. You could find yourselves fighting against God! The Council followed Gamaliel's advice.

dag: Jɛrimia daa sabila yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn lu Babilɔnnim zuɣu mini yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa sabi zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo la.
en: Jeremiah had written on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon. He had written all these things about Babylon.

dag: N yura nyɛla n ni su so, ka n gba nyɛ o ni su so. O zaŋd o biŋkɔbbaligu chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni.
en: My lover is mine, and I am his! My lover feeds among the lilies.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim birim, ka saɣim bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ni bɔhi bɛ wuna mini bɛ kpiimba ni bukpahinima ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Egypts spirit will fail from within; I will frustrate their plans. They will consult the idols and spirits and ghosts and fortune-tellers.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpɛhili shee yili; ka yihiri sarikanim mi kpɛhiri yolisim suhupiɛlli ni. Amaa duŋtaariba bɛn ni bela tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: God provides homes for those who are lonely. He frees people from prison and makes them happy. But those who turn against him will live in the desert.

dag: Ŋuna ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti daalahichi zuɣu ni o fa ti ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni bahi kaman ti Ba Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus gave himself for our sins to free us from this evil world we live in. This is what God our Father wanted.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa wum yɛla ŋɔ zaa o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam.
en: When David heard what had happened to Tamar, he was very angry. But Amnon was his oldest son and also his favorite, and David would not do anything to make Amnon unhappy.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka bɛ laɣim yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa din kanna ŋɔ ni bindira din yɛn niŋ pam maa zaa zali, ka di nyɛ a ni zaŋ bindir shɛli niŋ fukumsi fɔntinsi ni ka bɛ gbib li.
en: Give them the power to collect the grain during those good years and to store it in your cities.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili ŋme ma mi gari, ka a ni lu n zuɣu ka di mali dabiɛm shɛm bahi jahi ma.
en: Your fiery anger has overwhelmed me; your terrors have destroyed me.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Iso ka o mini ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi kanna. Ka o daa pirigi bihi ti Liya mini Reechɛl ni dabipaɣiba ayi la.
en: Jacob looked and saw Esau coming with men. Jacob divided his family into four groups. Leah and her children were in one group, Rachel and Joseph were in one group, and the two maids and their children were in two groups.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya do so ŋun yɛli ma binshɛɣukam zaa n ni pun niŋ. Pa ŋuna n-ni nyɛ Masia la.
en: A man told me everything I have ever done. Come see him. Maybe he is the Messiah.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ pala yaɣ yini ko, amaa di nyɛla yaɣ bɔbili.
en: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Naftali zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their surrounding areas are the legacy for the clans of the Naphtali tribe.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, o suhu paligirimi, ka o zaŋ o buɣi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When you find it, you are so happy that you put it on your shoulders.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ nabihi bɛn daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo bɛ kpamba tuma.
en: The men from Tekoa repaired the next section of the wall, but the leaders from Tekoa refused to work for Nehemiah their governor.

dag: Neesim din be bɛ suɣili ni leei zibisim, ka firila din yili bɛ zuɣusaa kpi.
en: The light in their tent becomes dark, and their lamp above doesnt shine.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba daa yɛli niriba maa zaa. Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a ti zaŋ li leei niŋgbina kpaʒiɛrim, di mi bi simdi ka a lan niŋ di tatabo yaha. Di nyɛla din be kasi, ka kul ni be kasi a sani.
en: This oil is holy and you must treat it as something special. Dont use the same formula for making perfume and dont let people use this oil like an ordinary perfume.

dag: Dama Jɛrɔbɔam min o bidibisi daa kari ba mi ni bɛ di lan tum Yawɛ maligumaaniba tuma. Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ tiŋgbana ni n-chɛ bɛ binshɛɣukam ka kuli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The Levites left their pastures and property to come to Judah and Jerusalem because Jeroboam and his sons had refused to let them serve as the LORDs priests.

dag: Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa ni daa wum bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: When the servant of Abraham heard this, he bowed down and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb leei daba n-ʒi n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la ni yino. Di saha maa, Jɛhoyachin n-daa nyɛ Juda naa.
en: Mordecai had been carried into captivity from Jerusalem by King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon. He was with the group that was taken into captivity with King Jehoiachin of Judah.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa gbaala o binyɛra n-dari tɔhi, ka zaŋ buɣu ye, ka lo noli. O daa kul yɛrila buɣu maa doona, ka chani gindi ni nandahima.
en: When Ahab heard what Elijah said, he tore his clothes to show how sad he was. Then he put on sackcloth and refused to eat. He even slept in these clothes. He was very sad and upset.

dag: O ni ka yaa maa zuɣu, di nyɛla talahi ni o maani maligu omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu kaman o ni maani niriba daalahichi zuɣu shɛm.
en: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.

dag: Ka din nyɛ yɛlikpeeni nyɛla, baŋmiya ni anabitali yɛtɔɣa din be Naawuni Kundi ni pala ninsal ni ni tooi kahigi shɛli gbinni wuhi omaŋmaŋ baŋsim puuni;.
en: Most important of all, you must understand this: No prophecy in the Scriptures comes from the prophets own understanding.

dag: nti yɛli ba, M mi ni Yawɛ zaŋ ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka dabiɛm pun gbahi ti pam yi zuɣu; ka bɛnkam zaa be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni suhuri fuŋmi.
en: and said to them, I know that the Lord has given you this land. Everyone in the country is terrified of you.

dag: Ka zim maa daa shiri bi naai di duɣu maa ni; ka kpam la gba daa bi naai di ŋmani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The Lord kept the promise that his prophet Elijah had made, and she did not run out of flour or oil.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli Izraɛlnim maa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni nasara la.
en: The LORD made Pharaoh, Egypts king, stubborn, and he chased the Israelites, who were leaving confidently.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, di ni lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bimbilima din be puri ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Raise your hand toward the sky, and hail will fall over the whole land of Egypt—on the people, the animals, and all the plants in the fields.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa m-bala.
en: near the town of Gog's Army. After that, the land will be pure again.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samsin daa ti bɔri paɣ so ŋun be Sɔrɛk Vinvamli ni ka o yuli booni Dilaila.
en: Later, Samson fell in love with a woman named Delilah, who was from Sorek Valley.

dag: Yi ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa piligu ni ha la nyɛla ni ti yum taba.
en: The message you heard from the very beginning is this: we must love one another.

dag: Ka Jɛhu yɛl o niriba, Gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma! Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba zaɣ nɛma n-ku ba Bɛtɛkɛd bɔɣili gbini. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinahinaayi. Ka bɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ ni zaɣ yino gba.
en: Take them alive! Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all of them.

dag: Ka sabi Aduna yuli pa Lɛvi jaaŋgbee zuɣu. Di simdi ni dunoli kam kpɛm malila jaaŋgbe yini.
en: On the stick from Levi, write Aarons name. There must be one stick for the head of each of the twelve tribes.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di zɔr o dabiɛm, dama n zaŋ o min o niriba maa zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ a nuu ni. Niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn shɛm la.
en: The Lord said to me, Dont be afraid of Og. I have decided to give him to you. I will give you all his men and his land. You will defeat him just as you defeated Sihon, the Amorite king who ruled in Heshbon.

dag: Kawana bee chi sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ti zaŋ li mali sara Yawɛ sani sara maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa nya li yɛli, yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ bee ti nini na ʒi n-nya lala Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ. Ti tɛhimi di yɛla. Ti gbaamiya saawara baŋ ti ni yɛn yɛli di yɛla shɛm.
en: Everyone who saw it said, We have never heard of such a thing! Nothing like this has ever happened since the Israelites left Egypt! We have to do something about this! What will it be.

dag: Bɛ bi diri wahala kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni diri wahala shɛm. Alɔbo mi bi luri bɛ zuɣu kaman di ni luri ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu shɛm.
en: They do not suffer as other people do; they do not have the troubles that others have.

dag: Ŋunkam ti di binʒim kam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni. .
en: Any person who consumes any blood whatsoever will be cut off from their people.

dag: O zaŋ yɛm din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yɛm zali wuntizɔriba, ka leei nyɔtaɣirigu gu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi.
en: He provides help and protection for those who are righteous and honest.

dag: Ti daa bi bɔri paɣibu so sani, di yi nyɛla yi sani bee shɛb sani, hal ti di mali soli ni ti tooi suhi ya binshɛŋa ti ni nyɛ Masia tuumba la zuɣu.
en: We were not trying to get you or anyone else to praise us.

dag: Amaa maligumaana yi zaŋ o liɣiri da dabili ka o leeg o ni su so, dabili maa ni tooi di li; ka bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb o yiŋ gba ni tooi di o bindirigu maa.
en: However, any slave that you own, including those born into your household, may eat this food.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋla chirachira biɛhigu ti ba, ka bɛ chɛ ka Ijiptinim laani gindi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni kaman danyura m-be o tiri ni laani gindi la.
en: The LORD has poured into them a spirit of confusion. They will make Egypt stumble in everything it does, just as a drunk stumbles in his vomit.

dag: Ka Hushai daa kana, ka Absalom ti yɛl o, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛl ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ti niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa? Di yi pa lala, nyin yɛlim ti.
en: When Hushai from Erek arrived, Absalom said to him, This is what Ahithophel has advised. Should we follow it or not? What do you say.

dag: Dama ti Duuma n-daa chɛ ka Siria tɔbbihi maa wum tɔbbihi pam chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri kandina vuri ka bɛ yɛli taba, Izraɛl naa dala Hiti nanim mini Ijipti nanim bahi ti na.
en: The Lord had caused the Aramean army to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a large army. So the soldiers said to each other, The king of Israel has hired the kings of the Hittites and Egyptians to come against us.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa tim ni bɛ kuli ti yɛli Dauda tɔb maa lahibali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Joab sent a messenger to tell David everything that was happening in the war.

dag: Yawɛ, wula ka a yɛn niŋ ba? Chɛ ka bɛ paɣiba zaŋdi bahira, ka bɛ biha nyuui.
en: Our Lord , do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies.

dag: Ka yi zaa daa ka n sanna ti yɛli, Chɛ ka ti tim niriba ka bɛ daŋ ti tooni chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti, ka ʒi lahibali labina ti yɛli ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa ni ti ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: Then all of you came to me and said, Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.

dag: Kum yuma maa daa ti yɛn kana, ka Yisifu pun zaŋ Asɛnat ŋun daa nyɛ Pɔtifɛra ŋun nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga la dɔɣila bidibis ayi.
en: Josephs wife, Asenath, was the daughter of Potiphera, the priest in the city of On. Before the first year of hunger came, Joseph and Asenath had two sons.

dag: Daadam, paɣiba ayi n-daa beni, bɛ daa nyɛla paɣ yino bihi.
en: Son of man, listen to this story about Samaria and Jerusalem. There were two sisters, daughters of the same mother.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba;.
en: Nations will go to war against one another, and kingdoms will attack each other.

dag: bɛn ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ yuli.
en: All you who stand in the LORDs house— who stand in the courtyards of our Gods temple.

dag: lala nti yɛn nyɛ Daadam Bia gba yi ti labina yi palo.
en: The same will happen on the day when the Son of Man appears.

dag: O daa tɛhiya ni o mabihi maa baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o na ni o ti fa ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ lala.
en: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dahin shɛli n yi ti lan kpihim yi daalahichi, n ni ti lan chɛ ka niriba be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day that I wash away your sins, I will bring people back to your cities. The ruined cities will be rebuilt.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam m-pahi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣiba bɛn nyɛ yuyanima mini dɔbba daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Many of them believed; and many Greek women of high social standing and many Greek men also believed.

dag: A tintarisi bela teeku puuni. Bɛn daa me a, daa me a ka a viɛl zaa.
en: The Mediterranean Sea is the border around your city. Your builders made you perfectly beautiful, like the ships that sail from you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So kul ku kɔŋ Dauda daŋ ni ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee.
en: I, the Lord , promise that there will always be a descendant of David to be king of Israel.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma ni deei bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa maa. Naawuni ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa bahi teeku ni, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim ka di di n-lu n-dahim.
en: but the LORD will take her possessions away and knock her wealth into the sea. She will be devoured with fire.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti labisi n niriba Izraɛlnim mini Judanim daazichi ti ba, ka zaŋ ba labisi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni na ka bɛ ti deei li su.
en: Someday I will let my people from both Israel and Judah return to the land I gave their ancestors.

dag: Dama nir yi bɔri ni o yuli yi palo, o ku tumd o tuma ashilɔni. A yi tumdi tuma ŋɔ tatabo, nyin yihim amaŋ palɔni ka sokam baŋ a.
en: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim ni daa nya ka Yisa mini alahichinima ni farigudeeriba laɣim diri maa, ka bɛ bɔh o nyaandoliba, Bɔzuɣu ka o mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira ka nyura.
en: When some teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw Jesus eating with such bad people, they asked his followers, Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋla o ni daa nyaŋ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa diri ʒi Ashitarɔt din be Ɛdirɛi la nyaaŋa.
en: This was after the Lord had defeated King Sihon of the Amorites, who ruled in the town of Heshbon, and King Og of Bashan, who ruled in the towns of Ashtaroth and Edrei.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli ninvuɣ shɛb sani mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika.
en: The people who have it like this are truly happy! The people whose God is the LORD are truly happy!.

dag: Bɛ ni niŋ shɛli naani ka yaa, di ŋmanila kpatinariga yili.
en: whose confidence is a fragile thing, their trust, a spiders web.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgbani daa kuui zaa.
en: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.

dag: ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka lan tam o ni lihi nya omaŋ shɛm maa kɔtomsi.
en: They take a good look at themselves and then go away and at once forget what they look like.

dag: Ʒim bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia mini maha ni shi luɣuluɣu n-chaŋ o sani, o ni ti yɛl a din yɛn niŋ bia maa.
en: Take ten loaves of bread, cakes, and a bottle of honey with you. Go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy.

dag: Di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni ti yɛn di bindirigu tiɣi, ka binshɛli ku pooi ya. Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kuɣa nyɛ kuriti, ka yi ni ti gbiri tahiʒiɛɣu di daboya zuɣu.
en: a land where you will eat food without any shortage—you wont lack a thing there—a land where stone is hard as iron and where you will mine copper from the hills.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni bɛ pɔri Naawuni sani mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Happy are people who are hopeless, because the kingdom of heaven is theirs.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n fabindi Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman kalambua ka bɛ piɛbiri la, dama bɛ ni daa nya bun shɛli zaa la naaya.
en: I am very sad for Moab. My heart cries like the sad sound of a flute playing a funeral song. I am sad for the people from Kir Hareseth. Their money and riches have all been taken away.

dag: Yi ni yɛli ba bahi, ka pɔhim ʒi ba chaŋ, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-wurim ba. Di saha yi suhuri ni paligi man Yawɛ zuɣu; ka yi paɣi mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord , the holy God of Israel.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ, n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala.
en: A voice from heaven said, This is my Son, the one I love. I am very pleased with him.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu daa na bi dɔɣi bihi, ka daa lan daŋ bɛ ba kpibu, ka Ɛliɛza mini Itama daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, without having sons, and so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

dag: Bɛ yuri zɔri gari jɛŋgbina, ka mali suhuyiɣisili gari kunduna bɛn gɔri zaawuni. Ka bɛ yuri ni nyam. Bɛ wɔribariba yila katiŋ na. Bɛ yiɣirimi kaman tɔrili ni yiɣiri yomyom ni o ti to binshɛli shɛm la.
en: His horses are faster than leopards; they are quicker than wolves of the evening. His horsemen charge forward; his horsemen come from far away. They fly in to devour, swiftly, like an eagle.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali yi sara maa ti yi Naawuni maa yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then Pharaoh called in Moses and Aaron and said, Go, offer sacrifices to your God within the land.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi ni chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha yaha; ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna ka o ti gbaai ba wuhibu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm.
en: After Jesus left, he went to Judea and then on to the other side of the Jordan River. Once again large crowds came to him, and as usual, he taught them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nazari nir maa pini o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri maa niŋ biɛrisuŋ sara maligu la buɣim ni.
en: At the entrance of the Tent you nazirites shall shave off your hair and put it on the fire on which the fellowship offering is being burned.

dag: Suhimiya alibarika tim bɛn yɛri ya zilima; ka suhimiya Naawuni tim bɛn turi ya la.
en: Ask God to bless the people who ask for bad things to happen to you. Pray for the people who are mean to you.

dag: ka Oholibama mi dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-bala.
en: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are Esaus sons born to him in the land of Canaan.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli yili wumpaɣibo yila.
en: Everyone on earth, shout with joy to the Lord . Start singing happy songs of praise!.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mini Yisa nyaandoliba ni so daa doli Yisa chaŋ. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol ŋuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka ŋun doli Yisa kpe maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni.
en: Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. Because this other disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priests courtyard.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛli Kushi bia Zɛfania yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Juda Naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni. Zɛfania yaannim n-daa nyɛ: Gɛdalia mini Amaria ni Naa Hɛzɛkia.
en: The LORDs word that came to Zephaniah, Cushis son, Gedaliahs grandson, Amariahs great-grandson, and Hezekiahs great-great-grandson in the days of Judahs King Josiah, Amons son.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tim ti boli Jɛrɔbɔam na, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa ti chaŋ Rɛhɔbɔam sani ti yɛl o.
en: The people sent and called for Jeroboam, who along with the entire Israelite assembly went and said to Rehoboam.

dag: O daa chaŋ nti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni o mini bɛn daa be o sani ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la.
en: He went into Gods house and broke the law by eating the bread of the presence, which only the priests were allowed to eat.

dag: O ni daa karindi litaafi shɛli maa daa sabi yɛlila ŋ-ŋɔ: Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi tahi kaman bɛ ni tahiri piɛɣu o kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛbil so kɔbiri, ka o bi yaar o nol la.
en: The part of the Scriptures that he was reading was this: He was like a sheep being led to the butcher. He was like a lamb that makes no sound as its wool is being cut off. He said nothing.

dag: Di saha ka anabi ninkurili maa yɛl o, Man gba nyɛla anabi kaman a ni nyɛ anabi shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ chɛ ka malaika yɛli ma, Cham ti zaŋ anab maa n-lab a yiŋa ka o ti di bindirigu ka nyu kom. .
en: The old prophet said, I'm a prophet too. One of the Lord 's angels told me to take you to my house and give you something to eat and drink. The prophet from Judah did not know that the old prophet was lying.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka anabinim zaa yɛli ni o Masia ni ti di wahala pam la n-niŋ pali maa.
en: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o ka o kabiri dari maa daa zaŋ o tahi Musa mini Aduna ni niriba maa zaa sani.
en: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Maika ni chɛ ka n niŋdi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O bu ma la paa ka n nyɛ o maligumaana.
en: Micah has done a lot for me, he replied to them. He hired me to be his personal priest.

dag: Mɛriba kom la gbini bɛ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, ka yɛla daa paai Musa bɛ zuɣu.
en: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa daŋ yibu asiba n-chaŋ ni o ti bu padiriba paa niŋ o puu ni.
en: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. Once there was a man who went out early in the morning to hire some men to work in his vineyard.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa zali o ni daa mali luɣ shɛli zal li maa.
en: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring the LORDs chest to the place he had prepared for it.

dag: Yi ni ti mali olivi tihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, amaa yi ti ku ʒe di kpam, dama di wala zaa ni ti wɔbi lu.
en: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi Sarid n-zaŋ kpa di wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Chisilɔtabo n-zaŋ gari hal ni Dabɛrat n-chaŋ hal ti paai Jafia.
en: On the other side of Sarid it went east to the border of Chisloth Tabor, then to Daberath and up to Japhia.

dag: Ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika n-kuri chɛrubinim ayi n-zaŋ ba tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: Make two winged heavenly creatures of hammered gold, one for each end of the cover.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chaŋ ti doli bɛ naba hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-nya ka Sirianim maa situra mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zo ka chɛ m-bahi kul dɔndo sol ni. Ka tuumba maa daa labina ti yɛli naa.
en: The men went after the Aramean army as far as the Jordan River. All along the road there were clothes and weapons. The Arameans had thrown these things down when they hurried away. The messengers went back to Samaria and told the king.

dag: Yawɛ, hal a ni kul be zuɣusaa ha maa zaa yoli, a baɣa be tarimba ni, amaa a be katiŋ ka chɛ karimbaannima.
en: Even though the LORD is high, he can still see the lowly, but God keeps his distance from the arrogant.

dag: Ka nyɔhi yir o nyɛvoya ni kaman mɔri ka bɛ zaŋ mali buɣim n-zaŋ duɣu tam la.
en: Smoke comes pouring out of his nose, like smoke from weeds burning under a pot.

dag: A yi chɛ ka nahu buri a chi, nyin miri ka a zaŋ bini pɔb o noli.
en: Dont muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain.

dag: Bɛ yi shiri nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ yɛligu maa be bɛ sani, dindina bɛn suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni o di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ la shɛŋa din kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini Juda nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm la kuli Babilɔn.
en: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.

dag: Di tahigu maa nyɛla din yɛr o yɛla, ka niɣi gba mi ni saa kanna.
en: The thunder warns that a storm is coming. So even the cattle know it is near.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa dolila ʒiri, ka doli yɔhiŋ soli yomyom.
en: I swear I have never acted wickedly and never tried to deceive others.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zuɣu. Chɛliya ka dunia zaa baŋ di yɛla.
en: Sing songs of praise about the Lord , because he has done great things. Spread this news about God throughout the whole world. Let all people know these things.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ a niŋ a ni je ninvuɣ shɛba ka ŋmaligi ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la nuu ni.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: I will hand you over to people you hate and are disgusted with.

dag: Dama o ʒiɛla nandaamba nudirigu polo ni o tiligi ba bɛn yɛn wuhi ni bɛ simdi kum la nuu ni.
en: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.

dag: Mɛfibɔshɛt dapala daa nyɛla bidibbil sariŋga ka o yuli booni Maika, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ziba yiŋa daa leei Mɛfibɔshɛt tumtumdiba.
en: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica. All the people in Zibas family became Mephibosheths servants.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣiriba daa wum lala, ka kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o, dama niriba daa yɛliya ni o zuɣu n-lɛbigi.
en: His family heard about all these things. They went to get him because people said he was crazy.

dag: nti yɛl o, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kali ti ni su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi n-nya ka ti zaa beni.
en: and reported, Sir, we have counted the soldiers under our command and not one of them is missing.

dag: O dolila wuntia soli kariti dunianim saria; o bi gaŋdi so o saria karibu ni.
en: He will establish justice in the world rightly; he will judge all people fairly.

dag: Ka Yisifu Arimatia tiŋbia ŋun daa nyɛ bilichin titali ka lan nyɛ Yɛhudianim jintɔriba ni yino ka daa guli Naawuni nam kandina saha la daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: A man named Joseph from Arimathea was brave enough to ask Pilate for the body of Jesus. Joseph was a highly respected member of the Jewish council, and he was also waiting for God's kingdom to come.

dag: Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buyi. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buyi. Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buta. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buta.
en: Do it a second time! he said. So they did it a second time. Do it a third time! And so they did it a third time.

dag: Izar bidibisi ni, Shɛlomit n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Izhars oldest son was Shelomith.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, pa Yawɛ milinsi ni ka n kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbani ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma, Cham ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa. .
en: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa tim ti boli Jɔab ni o kana ka o tim o naa sani, amaa ka Jɔab daa zaɣisi kandina. Ka o lan tim pahi buyi, amaa ka Jɔab kul bahi zaɣisi kandina.
en: He wanted Joab to talk to David for him. So one day he sent a message asking Joab to come over, but Joab refused. Absalom sent another message, but Joab still refused.

dag: Yuun pisinaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Twenty-seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the first month. He said:.

dag: Bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu la gbariginsim puuni, amaa ka o lan be Naawuni yiko zuɣu. Ti gba nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima o ni, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo ti min o ni ti laɣim be Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.

dag: Di saha ka paɣipiɛlisi maa zaa daa yiɣisi malimali bɛ firilanima.
en: Then all the girls woke up. They made their lamps ready.

dag: Bɛ daa kulila Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya daŋ ni dɔbba, ka bɛ fali tarili daa kpalim bɛ yaannim daŋ puuni.
en: They married into the clan of Manasseh, Josephs son. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of their fathers clan.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Zara daa nya yaa niŋ pua, hal o ni daa yaɣi dɔɣibu saha shɛl la, dama o daa niŋ ŋun lo o alikauli maa naani.
en: It was faith that made Abraham able to become a father, even though he was too old and Sarah herself could not have children. He trusted God to keep his promise.

dag: Ka sagban shɛli daa sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ! Wummiy o noli.
en: Then a cloud came and covered them. A voice came from the cloud and said, This is my Son, the one I love. Obey him.

dag: N ku zaŋ binshɛli naɣila n nachimba ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli ma chaŋ la ni pun di shɛl la; amaa naɣ chɛ ka Anɛr mini Ɛshikol ni Mamri n-yihi bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli di ni.
en: I will take nothing for myself. I will accept only what my men have used. But let my allies, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre, take their share.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa gari Mariama pam ka o bɔhir o suhu, ka bɔ puhigu n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Mary was deeply troubled by the angel's message, and she wondered what his words meant.

dag: N ni zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi n-kɔhi Judanim zuɣu; ka bɛ mi zaŋ ba kɔhi Sabinim bɛn nyɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋ la nim zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa na bi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni faashee o ni daa ti lab o jilima shee la nyaaŋa, ka bɛ naanyi teei ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa pun sabimi zan o zuɣu, ka di mi shiri niŋ o lala.
en: At first, Jesus' disciples did not understand. But after he had been given his glory, they remembered all this. Everything had happened exactly as the Scriptures said it would.

dag: Ŋmaligim n suhu niŋ a zaligunim dolibu ni, ka chɛ azichi yoya bɔbu.
en: Turn my heart to your laws, not to greedy gain.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun mi din be salinim suhuri ni daa di ba shɛhira n-ti ba Shia Kasi kaman o ni daa ti ti gba shɛm la.
en: God, who knows peoples deepest thoughts and desires, confirmed this by giving them the Holy Spirit, just as he did to us.

dag: Paɣ maa yi dɔɣila bipuɣiŋga, o ni be daɣiri ni biɛɣu pinaanahi kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la. Di nyaaŋa o paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another days.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa nimdi min o gbaŋ ni o nyɔri dina, zaŋm li yi yi sansani maa kpaŋa nti nyo li buɣim, dama din nyɛla alahichi sara maligu.
en: But burn the bull's flesh, its skin, and its intestines outside the camp. This is an offering to take away the sins of the priests.

dag: Yi ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa bemi kaman gariŋga gala la. Nir yi ŋma di gal yini wahu n-yiri di ni na. Amaa yi nia biɛri maa ku kun ya buchi. Di nyɛla din ka buchi kaman kpatinari zana chinchini la, di bi galisi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ni tooi zaŋ li pili.
en: You hatch evil, like eggs from a poisonous snake. Anyone who eats the eggs will die. And if you break one of them open, a poisonous snake will come out. Your lies are like spider webs.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, tinzun yɛligu balibu paai shɛm be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di shɛli mi kani ka bi mali gbinni.
en: It will be as if you are speaking into the air! There are probably many language families in the world, and none of them are without meaning.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ni o yihi ba sansani maa ni hal ka bɛ zaa daa ti shiri kpi.
en: The Lord kept on opposing them until he had destroyed them all.

dag: Ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba diri ma shɛhira. Yi na ʒi n-wum o kukoli bee n-nya o ni be shɛm ni yi nini;.
en: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimaŋli soli be ti katiŋa, ka din tuhi gba bi paari ti. Ti bɔrila firila, amaa ka zibisim n-gil ti, ti bɔri neesim, amaa ka bela bumbɔn ni.
en: The people say, Now we know why God does not save us from those who oppress us. We hope for light to walk by, but there is only darkness.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa zani, ka chɛ Jɔab dini maa. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-kali niriba maa, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: But the king overruled Joab, who left and traveled throughout all Israel. When he returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu kul yɛmi ni n chɛ ka o lab kuli yi sanna, ka yi ti nya o ka yi suhuri paligi yaha, ka man gba nandahima vuui.
en: Therefore, I am sending him immediately so that when you see him again you can be glad and I wont worry.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum n Duuma kukoli ka di yɛra, Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn tim, ka ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti ti? Ka n daa yɛli, N-nyɛ ma; timmi ma.
en: Then I heard the Lord say, Whom shall I send? Who will be our messenger? I answered, I will go! Send me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ʒe Jɛhɔshafat nyaaŋa, dama o daa kul bemi kaman o ba ni daa tuui di nam ka be shɛm la, o daa bi jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: The Lord was with Jehoshaphat because in his young life he did the good things his ancestor David did. Jehoshaphat did not follow the Baal idols.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhi, N napɔŋ yɛn sarigi la, Yawɛ, ka a yurilim maŋli la gbaai ma zali.
en: I know I was ready to fall, but, Lord , your faithful love supported me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu gba daa mali shili ni o yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Dauda ya la, dama o daa yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.

dag: Kahigim a daalahiziba yurilim la wuhi, nyin ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kanna ti sɔɣiri a sani a nudirigu polo tiligiri bɛ dimnim nuu ni tiligira ŋɔ.
en: Reveal your wonderful love and save me; at your side I am safe from my enemies.

dag: Ti zaligu wuhiya ni ti karimi nir saria ka na bi bɔh o baŋ o ni niŋ shɛli.
en: Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ka mali nia biɛri la mirina. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be katiŋa ka chɛ a zaligu.
en: My cruel persecutors are coming closer, people who never keep your law.

dag: N yila m Ba sani n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na; ka lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni labi m Ba maa sani.
en: I left the Father and came into the world. I tell you again: I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hiburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: The Kohath family groups were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: yi ni zaŋdi nyɛvili yɛligu tiri ba la puuni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n-ti mali daliri din ni nyu bara Masia labbuna dabisili la dali, ka di wuhi ni n kpaŋmaŋtali mini n tuma bi kpalim yoli.
en: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.

dag: Daadam, fabilim Taai naa zuɣu ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini n-daa nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri din ka galimi ka mali baŋsim pam, ka viɛl zaa.
en: Son of man, sing this sad song about the king of Tyre. Say to him, This is what the Lord GOD says: You were the perfect man— so full of wisdom and perfectly handsome.

dag: m-mali Naawuni jilima, ka nyɛlisiri kaman bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la, ka lan ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.

dag: Amaa bɔhimi biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ wuh a; ka bɔhi noonsi ka bɛ yɛl a;.
en: But ask Behemoth, and he will teach you, the birds in the sky, and they will tell you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-yɛn daŋ chandi, m pun zaŋ tiŋgbani maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni.
en: The Lord answered, The tribe of Judah will go first. I am giving them control of the land.

dag: Toli maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila yuri bɛn mali shili gu tɔbu tuhibu, ka binshɛŋa din be kaman salima nam zuɣupila la pil bɛ zuɣuri, ka bɛ ninani ŋmani daadam ninni.
en: The locusts looked like horses ready for battle; on their heads they had what seemed to be crowns of gold, and their faces were like human faces.

dag: Di ŋmanila yu biɛɣu m-be n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n dimnim maani ma ansarisi, ka kul bɔhiri ma, ka a Naawuni maa lee be ya?.
en: Their constant insults are killing me. They never stop asking, Where is your God.

dag: Ka o daa lan tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Mbaye, Naawuni yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni be?.
en: He raised his voice and made his address: How terrible! Who will live when God does this?.

dag: Ka a ti deei nyɛviya tiliginsim liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim sani n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni, ka di leei yi nyɛviya tiligibu sara maligu, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri di yɛla Yawɛ sani.
en: Gather this money from the Israelites. Use the money for the service in the Meeting Tent. This payment will be a way for the Lord to remember his people. They will be paying for their own lives.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani gindi pihiri li na nti niɛmdi li nɛya zuɣu bee n-zaŋ li niŋdi toya ni tɔra, ka zaŋdi li niŋdi duɣuri ni duɣira, ka mal li maani maha; ka di nyaɣisim ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ kpam mali mahi shɛŋa.
en: and tasted like something baked with sweet olive oil. It appeared at night with the dew. In the morning the people would collect the manna, grind or crush it into flour, then boil it and make it into thin wafers.

dag: N yi tumdi li la mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina n simdi yɔri yɔbu; amaa di yi pala mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm m-bala.
en: If I did my work as a matter of free choice, then I could expect to be paid; but I do it as a matter of duty, because God has entrusted me with this task.

dag: Ka yi beni duhiri yimaŋa! Di di bi simdi ni yi fabindimi? Yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa yi ni.
en: How, then, can you be proud? On the contrary, you should be filled with sadness, and the man who has done such a thing should be expelled from your fellowship.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan ka tuun shɛli yaɣa ŋɔ ni, ka n suhu mi pun ye yi sani kandina zuɣu yuma pam puuni la zuɣu.
en: But now that I have finished my work in these regions and since I have been wanting for so many years to come to see you.

dag: ka o niŋgbuna ni ti do tiŋa Jɛziriil tintariga kaman saɣiri la; ka so ti ku tooi yɛli, Jɛzibɛl m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: Her body will be like dung on the field in the area of Jezreel. No one will be able to recognize her body.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ni daa kul timd o daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna la zaa yoli, yi daa zaɣisiya ni yi ku gbilisi tibili wum.
en: You would not listen or pay attention, even though the Lord has continued to send you his servants the prophets.

dag: Ka Musa mini Nan bia Jɔshua daa kana ti zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ wum li.
en: So Moses came and recited all the words of this poem in everyones hearing; Joshua, Nuns son, joined him.

dag: Ka Iso daa ŋmaligi kuli Ɛdom dindali maa.
en: So that day Esau started on his way back to Edom.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi bɔh o.
en: Eliphaz from Teman answered:.

dag: Amaa a min a niriba yi lɛbi yi nyaaŋa biri ma, ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali ya ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti gbani wun shɛŋa tiŋa n-jɛmdi li.
en: But if you and your people ever disobey the laws and commands I have given you and worship other gods.

dag: Kaman salima baŋa ni be kuruchu nyee ni shɛm, lala n-nyɛ paɣ viɛlli ŋun ka yɛm.
en: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli, Naawuni bo lari ti ma, ka ŋunkam zaa wum di yɛla ni la n-sɔŋ ma.
en: Sarah said, God has brought me joy and laughter. Everyone who hears about it will laugh with me.

dag: Zaŋmiya di binnyura lita yini sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu, ka booi binnyuri kpiɔŋ bahi luɣ kasi shee m-mali binnyura sara ti Yawɛ.
en: As the wine offering with the first lamb, pour out at the altar pints of wine.

dag: Wummiya! Man Pool yɛri ya mi ni yi yi gunda, Masia ku mali ya buchi.
en: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.

dag: Ka nir yi zaŋ kuɣili din be o nuu ni ka nyɛ din ni ku nir lab so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, bɛn kum o.
en: If someone strikes another with a stone in hand that could cause death and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer must definitely be put to death.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam po sara maligu bimbini pola di mini binshɛɣukam din pa di zuɣu.
en: Whoever uses the altar to make a promise is really using the altar and everything on the altar.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa laɣim niriba maa tampiŋ maa gbini ka Musa ti yɛli ba, Yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ, wummiya pumpɔŋɔ, ti chɛ ka kom yi kuɣili ŋɔ ni na n-tin ya.
en: After he and Aaron had gathered the people around the rock, he said, Look, you rebellious people, and you will see water flow from this rock.

dag: n-saɣim di tinsi maa mini di vinvamli zaa ni tinsi maa niriba zaa ni tiŋgban ni bimbilli kam zaa.
en: The LORD destroyed these cities, the entire valley, everyone who lived in the cities, and all of the fertile lands vegetation.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa chaŋ Kɛila nti tuhi Filistianim maa n-ku ba pam, ka fa bɛ niɣi. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ fa Kɛilanim maa bahi.
en: Then David and his soldiers went to Keilah and fought the Philistines, driving off their cattle and defeating them decisively. And thats how David saved the residents of Keilah.

dag: Hal kawana ni lan kani, ka wain tihi mini fiig tihi ni yɔɣa ni olivi tihi na bi wal la zaa yoli, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: Although there is no grain left, and the grapevines, fig trees, pomegranates, and olive trees have not yet produced, yet from now on I will bless you.

dag: Dama Naawuni yuri dunianim hal ti zaŋ o Bi gaŋa ti ba ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ti ku bahi yoli, amaa o ni ti nyala nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: For God loved the world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who believes in him may not die but have eternal life.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni zali shɛli ŋɔ yi ti yiɣisi n sani, dindina Izraɛl zuliya gba ku lan nyɛla zuliya n sani sahakam.
en: If the created order should vanish from my sight, declares the LORD, only then would Israels descendants ever stop being a nation before me.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli din be nuzaa polo katiŋ ha la du pam ka viɛla; di nyɛla na titali tiŋa din tiri dunianim zaa suhupiɛlli.
en: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.

dag: Dindali maa, maasim bee sakuɣa ti ku beni.
en: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee yɛli ba, Bin shɛli ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suhi ya, Yi zaa piim tibikpara yi ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa la ni ti ma. .
en: But I will ask you to do one thing: Give me all the earrings you took from the enemy. The enemy soldiers had been Ishmaelites, and they wore gold earrings.

dag: Yisa Masia yɛla ba jila yi sunsuuni ka yi palɔni.
en: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa pii kuɣ pinaayi shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la na n-sɔŋ Giligal maa.
en: Joshua set up at Gilgal those twelve stones they had taken from the Jordan.

dag: Baa ni yi gbuɣi, ka lan labi ti dir li shɛm la, lala ka jɛrigu labir o jɛrilim tuma ni.
en: Like a dog that returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats foolish mistakes.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ti ni ti kari malaikanim gba saria? Ka di yi nyɛ lala, dindina ti ni tooi kari ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu yɛla saria gari lala!.
en: Do you not know that we shall judge the angels? How much more, then, the things of this life!.

dag: O ni daa ti paai ti Asɔs ka ti zaŋ o niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ Mitilin.
en: When he met us in Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mali bindir shɛli ka yi bi mi li.
en: But Jesus told them, I have food you don't know anything about.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Ashaara niŋbu din doli taba, nyama, dina n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Nyamiya, n saɣi yi ni daa yɛli ma shɛlikam zaa la, ka pii naa tin ya.
en: Samuel said to all Israel: Listen: I have done everything you asked of me and have placed a king over you.

dag: Ɛhab daa lan mɛla buɣili Ashɛra gba binnani zali. O daa tum din ni yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ suhu n-gari Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. Ahab did more to make the Lord God of Israel angry than any king of Israel before him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: until the Lord said: Moses.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu daa kuli Sukɔt nti me o yili ka ti o biŋkɔbiri suɣa zali. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Sukɔt.
en: But Jacob went to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and set up shelters for his animals. That's why the place is called Succoth.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ bɛ sɔɣimi do n-gu ni bɛ di n nyɛvili; kpiɔŋlaannim taala duŋ bahi n zuɣu. Yawɛ, di mi pala n tuumbiɛri bee n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Look! They are waiting to kill me; cruel people are gathering against me. It is not because of any sin or wrong I have done.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, A ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: Jonathan said, I'll do anything you want.

dag: Ka piɛguliba shɛb daa kana ti kari ba, amaa ka Musa daa yiɣisi zab bɛ zuɣu ka niŋ kom ti bɛ piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: Some shepherds tried to chase them away, but Moses came to their rescue and watered their animals.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli ka chɛ ka m biɛhigu niŋ tom ŋɔ.
en: God All-Powerful has been unfair to me; he has made my life bitter. But I swear by his life.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti suui yi noli. O nyaandoliba maa ni so daa bi buɣisi ni o bɔh o, Ŋuni n-nyɛ a? Bɛ daa mi ni bɛ Duuma m-bala.
en: Jesus said to them, Come and eat. None of the disciples dared ask him, Who are you? because they knew it was the Lord.

dag: Bɛ tibidarigibo ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ karimbaani zuɣu m-bala, dama bɛ maani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara niŋdi ba.
en: That is how the people of Moab and Ammon will be punished for their pride and arrogance and for insulting the people of the Lord Almighty.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila chɛchɛbuŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu, ka dari wɔhu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga ni pihinu. Lala ka bɛ gba daa kɔhiri ba tiri Hitinim mini Siria nanim zaa.
en: They also bought chariots from Egypt for shekels of silver each and horses for shekels of silver each. They then sold the horses and chariots to the kings of the Hittites and Arameans.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli wuntia soli m-me o yili mini ŋun bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli m me o jirambisa, ka chɛ ka o taba tum o tuma yoli ka o bi yo ba zuɣu.
en: Doomed is the one who builds his house by injustice and enlarges it by dishonesty; who makes his people work for nothing and does not pay their wages.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi anabinim gbala, ka maani wuntizɔriba yɛla teebu binyara zaana.
en: You Pharisees and teachers are nothing but show-offs, and you're in for trouble! You build monuments for the prophets and decorate the tombs of good people.

dag: Amaa ka putɔɣulaannim mini ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa pahi doli Dauda chaŋ maa yɛli, Ti bi yɛn ti ba ti ni tuhi fa neen shɛŋa ŋɔ shɛli, naɣila bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ka ti ni zaŋ ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ, dama bɛ daa bi dol ti chaŋ.
en: But then all the evil and despicable individuals who had accompanied David said, We wont share any of the plunder we rescued with them because they didnt go with us. Each of them can take his wife and children and go—but thats it.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi ka yinsi din ni di ka nyu nimaani bee yi ʒiɛmla Naawuni cheechi ka dihiri bɛn ka shɛl la gba vi? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn yɛli ya? N ni paɣi ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Aai! N ku paɣi ya!.
en: Don't you have homes where you can eat and drink? Do you hate God's church? Do you want to embarrass people who don't have anything? What can I say to you? I certainly cannot praise you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A ni tɛhi ni a mali yɛm kaman wuni maa zuɣu.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: Because you claim to have the mind of a god.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Pashihur chɛ ka bɛ baai Jɛrimia bandi maa, ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Yawɛ daa bi bol a yuli Pashihur, amaa o daa bol a yuli la Dabiɛm be luɣilikam zaa .
en: The next morning, after Pashhur had released me from the chains, I said to him, The Lord did not name you Pashhur. The name he has given you is Terror Everywhere.

dag: Naawuni, bambua suhu ni ye kulibɔŋ ni kɔzɔrim zuɣu shɛm la, lala ka n gba suhu kul ye a zuɣu.
en: As a deer longs for a stream of cool water, so I long for you, O God.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yino maa n-tiri yiko din tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri sokam yinoyino kaman o ni yu ni o ti o pin shɛli.
en: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us.

dag: ni Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la ni Hiddai ŋun daa yi Gaash kulibɔŋ duli na la.
en: Benaiah the Pirathonite; Hiddai from the Brooks of Gaash;.

dag: A ni ti wum bɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Ka di nyaaŋa a ni nya kpiɔŋ chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka o min o tumtumda Pura daa chaŋ ti zani miri bɛ dimnim maa tɔbbi shɛb bɛn lo kpara do sansan maa tariga.
en: Listen to what they are saying. After that you will not be afraid to attack them. So Gideon and his servant Purah went down to the edge of the enemy camp.

dag: Ti mi doo ŋɔ ni yi shɛl na, amaa Masia ŋun yi ti yi palo, so ku mi o ni yi shɛl na.
en: But when the real Messiah comes, no one will know where he comes from. And we know where this mans home is.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihira, di ti ku be ka bɛ zaŋ li na ni nia biɛɣu.
en: The LORD detests the sacrifices of the wicked, especially when brought with devious motives.

dag: Kaman chɛulɔnim ni kul gbibi punu ka di viini gindi shɛm la, lala ka vinnyaɣilan gba be o garo zuɣu.
en: Lazy people turn over in bed. They get no farther than a door swinging on its hinges.

dag: N yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu, mbusim be n zuɣu! Ka n yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, n ku tooi kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa, dama n yi lihi n wahala ŋɔ vi m-mali ma.
en: Guilty or innocent, I am condemned and ashamed because of my troubles.

dag: Tim ti suhupiɛlli dabisi gbaliŋ kaman a ni daa chɛ ka ti nya suhugarigu shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paligi yuun gbaliŋ kaman ti ni daa nya zaɣ biɛɣu shɛm.
en: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaɣisi Balaam ni bɔri ni o niŋ shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa naɣi zaŋla o noli yɛlibu maa leei alibarika tin ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa yuri ya zuɣu.
en: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.

dag: Absalom daa dɔɣila bidibis ata ni bipuɣin yino ŋun yuli daa booni Tama, o daa nyɛla paɣisar viɛlli.
en: Absalom had three sons and one daughter named Tamar, a very beautiful woman.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka Yisa yɛl lala maa nyɛla, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu la.
en: Jesus said this because some people were saying, He has an evil spirit in him.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Vumiya miri Yawɛ, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o shɛm maa. .
en: Moses turned to Aaron and said, Bring the people together, because the Lord has heard their complaints.

dag: Di saha n ni ti zaŋ firilanim lihi Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka shɛli ni ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Yawɛ ku niŋ din viɛla bee din bie la tibili.
en: At that time I will take a lamp and search through Jerusalem. I will find all those who are satisfied to live their own way. They say, The Lord does nothing. He does not help, and he does not hurt! I will find them, and I will punish them.

dag: N ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ya kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka lala maa chɛ ka m paɣi yi ni daɣiri maa bahi.
en: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you throughout the lands, and so I will remove your uncleanness from you.

dag: N ni yɛli nuzaa polo nim ni bɛ bahimi ba ka bɛ kuna; ka yɛli nudirigu polo nim ni bɛ di gbibi ba. Chɛliya ka m bidibisi bɛn be katiŋ ha kuna, ka chɛ ka m bipuɣinsi bɛn be dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ ni zaa kuna.
en: I will tell the north to let them go and the south not to hold them back. Let my people return from distant lands, from every part of the world.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni bi tum di tuun shɛli mini fɔntin shɛŋa yi ni bi me n-tin ya, ka yi be di ni diri ti shɛŋa yi ni bi sa mini olivi ti shɛŋa yi ni bi sa wala. .
en: I gave you a land that you had never worked and cities that you had not built. Now you are living there and eating grapes from vines that you did not plant, and olives from trees that you did not plant.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom bɛ ni dooi olivi kpa shɛli din nyɛ alali na nti niŋdi firilanim maa puuni din ni chɛ ka firilanim maa diri saha shɛlikam.
en: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.

dag: Ka Yisa daa deei komihigu maa ka yɛli, Di naaya! Ka silim o zuɣu tiŋa n-dii bahi.
en: When he had received the sour wine, Jesus said, It is completed. Bowing his head, he gave up his life.

dag: O daa zaŋla omaŋ tabil o ka bɛ be Ɛziɔngɛba m-maani ŋarima ni bɛ zaŋdi li chani Speen.
en: At the port of Eziongeber they built ocean-going ships.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpabikpabi kaman gbaŋ la n-wurim zaa, ka zoli kam mini teeku puuni tiŋgban bihi daa vuui di biɛhigu shee.
en: The sky disappeared like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

dag: Sana daa ʒi n-gbe samban ni, n daa kul yoola n dunoya ti sochandiba.
en: I always invited strangers into my home so that they would not have to sleep in the streets.

dag: O ni daa ti saɣim o buni maa zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka kum titali daa lu tiŋ maa ni; ka kum wum o pam.
en: After he spent everything he had, there was a terrible famine throughout the country. He was hungry and needed money.

dag: Ka Omri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa wuhi kpiɔŋ shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Omri did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Yawɛ yi ti vuhi pam bahi mɔri zuɣu, di kuurimi, ka tipum kpahiri lura; yɛlimaŋli, ninsalinim shiri ŋmanila mɔri.
en: The grass dries up and the flower withers when the LORDs breath blows on it. Surely the people are grass.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ku a min a niriba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm jɛndi zuliya shɛli din zaɣisi ni di ku jɛm Babilɔn Naa la?.
en: If you dont agree to serve the king of Babylon, you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease. This is what the Lord said would happen.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka tarimba mali tahima, ka putɔɣunim fo bɛ noya.
en: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced.

dag: Amaa ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka di ku moli gili m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛliya ka ti kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pam ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan boli Yisa yuli n-tɔɣisi o yɛla so sani.
en: But to keep this matter from spreading any further among the people, let us warn these men never again to speak to anyone in the name of Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔh o, N zuɣu ka a zabiri nyuli maa? N di bi zaɣisi ka Yawɛ niriba zaa nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ di zaŋ o shia niŋ bɛ ni.
en: But Moses answered, Are you afraid the people will think that I am not the leader now? I wish that all the Lord s people were able to prophesy. I wish that the Lord would put his Spirit on all of them.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa yi tɔɣisi viɛnyɛliŋga, di ŋmanila salima zaɣ kpil shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ kpɛh anzinfa binyara ni.
en: Saying the right thing at the right time is like a golden apple in a silver setting.

dag: Yi yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, yin niŋmiya ania n-zaŋ li ti Laodisianim gba ka bɛ karim. Ka yi gba niŋ ania n-karim gban shɛli Laodisianim ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya na la.
en: After this letter has been read to you publicly, make sure that the church in Laodicea reads it and that you read the one from Laodicea.

dag: Ka yi ti bu chi hal ni wain tihi wala pɔhibu saha, ka pɔhi wain tihi wala hal ni biribu saha. Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi, ka be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka yɛl shɛli kani.
en: Your threshing season will last until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will last until planting time. You will eat your fill of food and live securely in your land.

dag: ni m ba daa yɛli ma, N saɣi kpibu; ka n yi ti kani, nyin zaŋm ma ti sɔɣi n ni daa gbi sil shɛli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ ma sɔɣi di ni la puuni; ka daa chɛ ka m-po di pɔri. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n-suhir o ni o chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi m ba ka labina.
en: When my father was about to die, he made me promise him that I would bury him in the tomb which he had prepared in the land of Canaan. So please let me go and bury my father, and then I will come back.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka bɛ ni bi zaŋdi so taali zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari jilima.
en: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka suhukpeeni din ni zaŋ bɛmaŋ gari bɛ ni, amaa ka daa lee tiri ba jilima pam.
en: Nobody outside the group dared join them, even though the people spoke highly of them.

dag: Biɛɣuni asiba, yi sa ni nya Yawɛ jilima, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ŋun Yawɛ shɛm maa. Dama ti mi lee nyɛla banima, ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ti?.
en: And in the morning you will see his glorious power, because he has heard your complaints against him. Why should you grumble to us? Who are we.

dag: Yi nyɛla neesim mini wuntaŋ ni niriba. Ti pala yuŋ bee zibisim ni niriba.
en: All of you are children of light and children of the day. We dont belong to night or darkness.

dag: Asha zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: These were the family groups in the tribe of Asher. The total number of men was .

dag: Di doli wumdi niriba ni yɛri shɛlikam, di yi pa lala, a ni ti wum ka a tumtumda tur a.
en: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu zaligu din wuhiri ni di nyɛla daɣiri bee di pala daɣiri.
en: These rules teach when something is clean and when something is unclean. These are the rules about these kinds of disease.

dag: ka zaŋ nintua n-tu a nyee, ka zaŋ tibikpara kpa a tiba ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli pil a zuɣu.
en: I gave you a nose ring, earrings, and a beautiful crown to wear.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa, Malimiya yimaŋ kasi gu biɛɣuni. Yi sa ni ŋubi nimdi, dama yi kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛra, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi. Ti ni daa be Ijipti la daa so. Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni tin ya nimdi ka yi ŋubi.
en: To the people you will say, Make yourselves holy for tomorrow; then you will eat meat, for youve cried in the LORDs hearing, Who will give us meat to eat? It was better for us in Egypt. The LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

dag: Ka Barak daa kari doli chɛchɛbunsi maa mini tɔbbihi maa hal ni Harɔshɛtihagɔim nti ku Sisɛra tɔbbihi maa zaa hal ka bɛ ni yino gba bi tiligi.
en: Barak pursued the chariots and the army to Harosheth-of-the-Gentiles, and Sisera's whole army was killed. Not a man was left.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Zadok ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la min o maligumaanitab la mi su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee din daa be Gibiɔn Jɛmbu shee la fukumsi.
en: Zadok the priest and his fellow priests, however, were in charge of the worship of the Lord at the place of worship in Gibeon.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa paɣir o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ.
en: My soul, praise the Lord ! Every part of me, praise his holy name!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim bɛn wumdi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa anabinim ni daa yɛli bɛ ni daa zali n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ tanzaa saha shɛl la wuhiya ni n jɛmbu duu maa ni me, kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, Be strong! You people are hearing the same message today that the prophets gave when the Lord All-Powerful first laid the foundations to rebuild his Temple.

dag: Ka Jɔn yɛli ba, So ku tooi mali shɛli ka di pa ni Naawuni n-ti o li.
en: John replied, No one can receive anything unless it is given from heaven.

dag: N nyɛla a dabili; tim ma baŋsim, din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: I am your servant; give me understanding, so that I may know your teachings.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yɛlimi n dabili Dauda: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: Mani n-daa yih a mɔɣu ni piɛri gulibu ni na ni a ti leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: So tell my servant David that I, the Lord Almighty, say to him, I took you from looking after sheep in the fields and made you the ruler of my people Israel.

dag: Di simdi ka tan tolinli kam wɔɣilim ti nyɛ mita pinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi, di simdi ka tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu nyɛ yim.
en: Make each curtain the same size. Each curtain should be cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Ka o mi ti yɛli ya yaha, N yɛri ya mi, n ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na. Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, wariya! .
en: Then he will say to you, I dont know you. Where did you come from? Get away from me! You are all people who do wrong.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni daa yihi tin shɛŋa mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba n-daa nyɛ Ramɔt din daa be Giliad la mini Mahanaim ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: In the territory of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di zuɣu kɔbiri maa bi paligi, ka di mi bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, amaa ka nyɛla din sabigi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ ni niriba ayi daa kuni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Ɛmaus, ka di mini Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛ kaman maali ayopɔin la.
en: On that same day two of Jesus' followers were going to a village named Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa dɔɣi Nuhu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Lamech lived another years. He had other children.

dag: So be yi ni m-biɛra? O bolimi cheechi toondaannima, ka bɛ ti zaŋ kpam ʒe o ti Duuma yuli zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni ti o.
en: Are you sick? Ask the elders of the church to come and rub oil on you in the name of the Lord and pray for you.

dag: n gba ni lan ya yi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu saha, ka mali ya ansarisi yi dabiɛm saha.
en: So when you get into trouble, I will laugh at you. I will make fun of you when terror strikes—.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku shɛb tɔb ni la daa so kum ni daa ku shɛba la. Bɛ daa mɔŋ ba puri ni bindirigu, ka kum ʒi ba chaŋ.
en: Things were better for those stabbed by the sword than for those stabbed by famine— those who bled away, pierced, lacking food from the field.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, ŋun bom ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi n-ka Yawɛ tooni na Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni nti zaŋ ba ti maligumaana.
en: On the eighth day, he must take for himself two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. He will give the two birds to the priest.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo, Naawuni yɛliya: Biɛɣ asiba zaŋ hal ni yuŋ ka n kul teegi n nuhi n-gahiri booni tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duntaariba ŋɔ.
en: But about the people of Israel God says, All day long I stood ready to accept those people, but they are stubborn and refuse to obey me. Isaiah :.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Saadis Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun mali Naawuni shih ayopɔin mini saŋmaris ayopɔin la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi mali yuli din wuhiri ni yi ne, amaa yi kpimi.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis: Here is a message from the one who has the seven spirits and the seven stars. I know what you do. People say that you are alive, but really you are dead.

dag: Dunia ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la, ka Naawuni daa pun pii ti leeg o niriba Masia zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi ka ka galimi ŋun Naawuni sani. Naawuni yurilim zuɣu.
en: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.

dag: N ni daa nya binneen shɛba ka bɛ be Izraɛl Naawuni naba tiŋli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la m-bala. Ka n daa baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla chɛrubinima.
en: I recognized them as the same creatures which I had seen beneath the God of Israel at the Chebar River.

dag: Dama jɛrigu tɔɣisirila jɛrilim yɛtɔɣa, ka tɛhiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu yɛla. O ni tumdi shɛm min o ni yɛri shɛm nyɛla biriginsim zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani. O mi na ʒi n-ti kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu bee n-niŋ kom ti kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: A fool speaks foolishly and thinks up evil things to do. What he does and what he says are an insult to the Lord , and he never feeds the hungry or gives thirsty people anything to drink.

dag: Bɛ ni niriba anu daa nyɛla yɛnnima, ka niriba anu la mi nyɛ jɛra.
en: Five of the girls were foolish, and five were wise.

dag: Dama o kul wuhirila zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe, biɛlifu kpe.
en: He is trying to teach us letter by letter, line by line, lesson by lesson.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kul yiɣisir o, ka o yi bembe o ti kuhirimi; ka alizin biɛɣu maa darigir o hal ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋariti o noli, ka o kul nahind o ka bi bɔr o bahibu.
en: A spirit attacks him with a sudden shout and throws him into a fit, so that he foams at the mouth; it keeps on hurting him and will hardly let him go!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri pini nyarimi pahira, ka ŋun tiri kom gba nyari kom.
en: Be generous, and you will be prosperous. Help others, and you will be helped.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa kuri su shɛli din mali naŋgbana ayi, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kaman sɛntimita pihinu ka o zaŋ li lo n-tabil o nudirigu gbalipini n-ye o binyɛrigu limsi li.
en: Ehud made himself a sword with two sharp edges that was about inches long. He tied the sword to his right thigh and hid it under his uniform.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka zuliya shɛli niriba yi katiŋa dunia ŋɔ tariga n-kabina ti lu yi zuɣu kaman tɔrili la, bɛ ni ti nyɛla yi ni bi wumdi zuliya shɛb yɛtɔɣa.
en: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa ni baŋsim pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika be o ni.
en: The child Jesus grew. He became strong and wise, and God blessed him.
