dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Balaam sanna ti yɛl o, Zipɔr bia Balak ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka binshɛli gu a soli ka a bi ka n sanna.
en: They went to Balaam and gave him this message from Balak: Please don't let anything prevent you from coming to me!.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ti mali taɣitaɣi mini mɔri, ka palo beni ka yi ni gbe.
en: She continued, We have plenty of straw and feed for the camels, and a place to spend the night.

dag: Di yi zahira ni daɣiri tuma be yi sunsuuni, hal ka di tatabo ka chɛfirinim sunsuuni gba; dina n-nyɛ ni yi ni so zaŋ o ba paɣa dɔni.
en: I dont want to believe what I am hearing—that there is sexual sin among you. And it is such a bad kind of sexual sin that even those who have never known God dont allow it. People say that a man there has his fathers wife.

dag: Zaŋmiya daanya mali kurupooti, ka zaŋ daanya mali bans anahi niŋ di tarisi bunahi zuɣu.
en: Make for the altar a grate made of copper mesh. Make four copper rings for each of the four corners of the mesh.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi buɣa maa maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani zaa n-ku ba pa bimbina zuɣu, ka daa nyo ninsalinim kɔba buɣim bimbina maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He killed the priests who served at them and burned their bones on the altars. After all that, Josiah went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka yi yi niŋ yɛda ka suhi binshɛɣukam, yi ni nya li.
en: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba min o chɛchɛbunsi zaa chaŋ yuŋ ti tuhi Ɛdomnim bɛn daa gil o min o chɛchɛbunsi sapashinnim niŋ sunsuuni la.
en: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night.

dag: Bee n yi di zaŋ takɔbi lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu ka yɛli, Takɔbi, lum tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: Or I might bring war on that country and send destructive weapons to wipe out people and animals alike.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb yi nya filiŋ, a yɛrimi ni bɛ malila karimbaani, dama o tiligiri tarimba.
en: When theyre humbled, you will say: Cheer up; God will rescue the lowly.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ? Ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: Who defeats the world? Isnt it the one who believes that Jesus is Gods Son?.

dag: Di saha ka shɛb dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka pɔb o nina ka ŋmɛr o ka yɛra, Wuhim ti a daanabitali ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa gba ŋmɛr o.
en: Some of the people started spitting on Jesus. They blindfolded him, hit him with their fists, and said, Tell us who hit you! Then the guards took charge of Jesus and beat him.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb suhuri daa kpɛm pam ka bɛ zaɣisi yɛda niŋbu, ka tari Yisa soli maa daɣiri salo maa ni. Di saha ka Pool daa chɛ ba, ka woligi Yisa nyaandoliba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ Tairanus kariŋ duu nti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla dabisili kam.
en: But some of them were stubborn and would not believe, and before the whole group they said evil things about the Way of the Lord. So Paul left them and took the believers with him, and every day he held discussions in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa laɣim dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa n-zali luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Hiburuli ni Aamagɛdɔn la.
en: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.

dag: Dama a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ, biɛɣuni n sa ni tahi toli a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na.
en: Do this by tomorrow, or I will cover your country with so many locusts.

dag: Ŋunkam ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛlimaŋli mini ŋunkam galim wuntizɔra, di zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: The Lord hates these two things: punishing the innocent and letting the guilty go free.

dag: Nir yi nya yɛm, di so salima, ka nir yi pii tɛhi zilima, di so anzinfa.
en: It is better—much better—to have wisdom and knowledge than gold and silver.

dag: Nyin Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, ŋmɛlim amaŋ ka ŋuhimi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisira, dama pumpɔŋɔ a ni yi fɔntiŋ ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti be mɔɣu ni. Ka di nyaaŋa, a ni ti kuli Babilɔn. Nimaani ka a ni ti nya faako. Nimaani ka Yawɛ ni ti tilig a a dimnim nuu ni.
en: Twist and groan, people of Jerusalem, like a woman giving birth, for now you will have to leave the city and live in the open country. You will have to go to Babylon, but there the Lord will save you from your enemies.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni niŋ di shɛli nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la shihirili.
en: The priest will take part of it as a token that it has all been offered to the Lord , and he will burn it on the altar. The odor of this food offering is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n sɔɣi n kpim maa kpe, yin wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Balimmiya Zɔhar bia Ɛfurɔn.
en: He said to them, If you really want to help me bury my dead wife, speak to Ephron the son of Zohar for me.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa, ka zaŋ dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: The priest will examine the infection and quarantine the infected item seven days.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ti Duuma suɣilɔdibo la nyɛla din tin ya dahima ni yi tiligi kaman ti mabiyurigu Pool ni daa sab shɛm tin ya Naawuni ni ti o yɛn shɛl la puuni la.
en: Consider the patience of our Lord to be salvation, just as our dear friend and brother Paul wrote to you according to the wisdom given to him.

dag: Bi so ŋun bɔri yɛm, o tirila o ba bee o ma suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun doli pagɔra ni bahi o buni yoli.
en: A son who loves wisdom makes his father happy. One who wastes his money on prostitutes will lose his wealth.

dag: Amaa lee ti wurimmiya bɛ maligu bimbina, ka kabisi bɛ binwɔɣila, ka wurim bɛ buɣili Ashɛra la.
en: Instead, tear down their altars, destroy their sacred pillars, and cut down their symbols of the goddess Asherah.

dag: Ka dabiɛm ni gbaai sokam zaa, ka bɛ yɛli Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla, ka zaŋ o ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla niŋ bɛ suhuri ni.
en: They will all be afraid; they will think about what God has done and tell about his deeds.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim puuni zana m-beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiinila yila, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.

dag: O ni daa mali binzahi pia maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O daa mali di zaa ŋ-ŋmahindila taba n-chɛ ka di buɣisibu nyɛ yim, ka di biɛhigu gba nyɛ yim.
en: Hiram made the ten bronze stands from the same mold, so they were exactly the same size and shape.

dag: Ka o daa lan nya ka Yaakubu deeg o ba min o ma noli ka shiri kuli Mɛsopoteemia.
en: Esau learned that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother and went to Paddan Aram.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga la paana, ka koyuli tam o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Ibrahimma tizo Nahɔr min o paɣ Milika bidibiga.
en: Even before he finished speaking, Rebekah—daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah wife of Nahor, Abrahams brother—was coming out with a water jar on her shoulder.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so n-daa ti boli niriba pam ni bɛ ka o yiŋ na ti di bindira;.
en: Jesus replied, A certain man hosted a large dinner and invited many people.

dag: dindina yin zomiya takɔbi dabiɛm, dama suhuyiɣisili tahiri tibidarigibo din nyɛ takɔbi na ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni sariakaribo din tuhi beni.
en: You ought to fear the sword yourselves, for wrath brings punishment by the sword. You should know that there is judgment.

dag: O tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi nyɛla zaɣ ʒiɛhi, ka o tɔbbihi ye gbaɣino ʒiɛhi. Bɛ yi mali bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shili zali dahin shɛli kur shɛŋa din tab li nyaɣisirimi. Ka sapashinnim yuri yiɣira.
en: The shields of his soldiers are red. Their uniforms are bright red. Their chariots are shining like flames of fire and are lined up for battle. Their horses are ready to go.

dag: wuhim ma a samli ka n yo a.
en: so name your price and I will pay it.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ ni, n lan nya shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yɛm polo, ka di nyɛ yɛlikpeeni n sani.
en: Once I saw what people really think of wisdom, and it made an impression on me.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka a nam ʒiishee pun mali ʒiɛya. Kurimbuni ha ka a pun be.
en: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi daalahichi tumbu mini yi ni pa bɛn doli gunibu kali sol la zuɣu. Amaa ka Naawuni neei yi mini Masia kum ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka chɛ ti daalahichi zaa paŋ ti.
en: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.

dag: ka dɔbba gba chɛ paɣiba golibu ka ŋmaligi doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri n-gɔndila bɛ dɔtaba, ka bɛ kɔr biɛri tuma maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari tibidarigibo din simdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa.
en: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tiŋgbani fabinda, ka ŋunkam be di ni kɔba ni chɔɣisi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣira ni teeku ni zahim gba ku lan beni.
en: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish.

dag: Yi ni ti mali alibarika gari zuliya kam. Ka dɔɣibu kalinsi ti ku be yi ni bee yi biŋkɔbiri ni.
en: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.

dag: dama bikpamba zaa nyɛla n ni su shɛba; n ni daa ku bikpamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka n daa zaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni bikpamba bɛn nyɛ ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba zaa leei n ni su shɛba. Bɛ nyɛla n ni su shɛba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: because all the oldest males are mine. When I killed all the oldest males in the land of Egypt, I reserved for myself all the oldest males in Israel, both humans and animals. They are mine; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ ma Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni nti tam zo titali din du pam zuɣu n-wuhi ma tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina.
en: The angel carried me away by the Spirit to a very large and high mountain. The angel showed me the holy city, Jerusalem. The city was coming down out of heaven from God.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi ni a chɛli bɛ taali, ka a yi ku chɛ bɛ taali maa, dindina nyin kpihimmi n yuli a ni sab li niŋ litaafi shɛl ni la.
en: Now, forgive them of this sin. If you will not forgive them, then erase my name from your book. .

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, tiŋ maa ni zo ma dabiɛm, ka deei saɣisigu, ka ku tam n ni niŋ li shɛlikam zaa la yɛla. Amaa ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tuma zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again.

dag: Ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha maa ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba.
en: Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time.

dag: Lihimiya ma ka chɛ ka di gari ya, ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi pɔb yi noya.
en: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya din be di ni maa tim nandaamba; ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ nyam yi sani.
en: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.

dag: bɛn ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ yuli.
en: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God.

dag: Di pala yi kalinli n-daa zooi gari zuliya shɛb zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu gbaai ya ka o pii ya maa, dama yinima n-daa pɔri gari zuliya kam zaa.
en: Why did the Lord love and choose you? It was not because you are such a large nation. You had the fewest of all people!.

dag: Wummiya! Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: Listen! A farmer went out to sow seed.

dag: Ŋunkam ti di binʒim kam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni. .
en: Anyone who breaks this law will no longer be considered one of God's people.

dag: Iso paɣ Oholibama bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso paɣ Oholibama Ana bipuɣiŋga la ni daa dɔɣi na shɛba m-bala.
en: Esaus wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These three men were the leaders of their families.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi, ka bɛ ŋmaag o bihili, ka Ibrahimma daa puhi chuɣu dahin shɛli Yisahaku ni daa ŋmaai bihili maa.
en: The boy grew and stopped nursing. On the day he stopped nursing, Abraham prepared a huge banquet.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yinim laɣila kum zɔri, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee lo tab alikauli. Yi niŋ yɛda ni alɔbo yi lu, di ku din ya, dama yi tɛhiya ni ʒiri mini yɔhiŋgu ni tiligi ya.
en: You have said, We have made an agreement with death. We have a contract with death. So we will not be punished. Punishment will pass us without hurting us. We will hide behind our tricks and lies.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; cham ti niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee daŋ mali mahili zaɣ bila n-ti ma na, ka naanyi chaŋ ti mal a min a bidibiga maa mi dini.
en: Elijah said to her, Dont be afraid! Go and do what you said. Only make a little loaf of bread for me first. Then bring it to me. You can make something for yourself and your son after that.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ n-yiɣisi be kaman Nail mɔɣili la, ka be kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pal la?.
en: Who is this that rises like the Nile, like a river flooding its banks?.

dag: Pɛdaya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrubabɛl mini Shimɛi. Zɛrubabɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam mini Hanania, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Shɛlomit.
en: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa laɣim dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa n-zali luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Hiburuli ni Aamagɛdɔn la.
en: Then the spirits brought the kings together in the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

dag: Ka n daa kahigi n daalahichi wuh a; ka bi sɔɣi n ni tum taal shɛŋa. N daa yɛliya, Yawɛ, n ni kahigi n daalahichi maa wuh a, ka a daa chɛ n daalahichi maa zaa.
en: But then I decided to confess my sins to the Lord . I stopped hiding my guilt and told you about my sins. And you forgave them all! Selah.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti kpa di naba dali yaha, ka o nyaandoliba maa lan laɣim be duu puuni, ka Tomas gba beni. Duu maa dunoya daa kparimi, ka Yisa daa ti lan puhi zani bɛ sunsuuni na ka yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: A week later the disciples were together again indoors, and Thomas was with them. The doors were locked, but Jesus came and stood among them and said, Peace be with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ maa gba chɛmi ka n suhu dam, ka yiɣi yi di biɛhigu shee.
en: The thunder and lightning frighten me; my heart pounds in my chest.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: The disciples asked him, Where will we find enough food in this desert to feed this crowd.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Aduna, Wula ka niriba maa lee niŋ a, ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ.
en: He said to Aaron, What did these people do to you, that you have made them commit such a terrible sin.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam. N nam yi di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nam, n niriba naan zabi n zuɣu ka so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni. Amaa n nam pala dunia ŋɔ nam.
en: Jesus said, My kingdom does not belong to this world. If it did, my servants would fight so that I would not be handed over to the Jewish leaders. No, my kingdom is not an earthly one.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yi wuhiri ya soli, dindina yi lan pala bɛn be fukumsi zaligu la sulinsi ni.
en: But if you let the Spirit lead you, you are not under law.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N yɛn zaŋla Ijipti Naa Hɔfira niŋ o dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku o nuu ni kaman n ni daa kul zaŋ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia niŋ o dim Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa bɔri ni o ku o la nuu ni shɛm la.
en: I will hand over King Hophra of Egypt to those who want to kill him, just as I handed Zedekiah over to Nebuchadnezzar, who wanted to kill him.

dag: Mani n-daa nam li ka di viɛla, ka mali wula pam. Ka Idɛn tihi zaa din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa zabiri li nyuli.
en: As for its beauty—I made it so, with its abundant foliage. All the trees of Eden envied it, all that were in Gods garden.

dag: o ni daa zali teeku di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka di kom ku zo n-yaɣi o ni zal li shɛli tariga, o ni daa booi tiŋgbani tarisi saha shɛli.
en: I was there when he set the limits on the sea to make it stop where he said. I was there when he laid the foundations of the earth.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi niŋ fawɔɣili zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa ku tum naa barina.
en: Be careful not to overlook this matter. We should not let the building of Jerusalem continue. If that work continues, I will not get any more money from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa yɛl o, A di amaŋ shɛhira; dinzuɣu a shɛhira maa pala shɛhira maŋli.
en: The Pharisees said to him, Now you are testifying on your own behalf; what you say proves nothing.

dag: Ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Ʒimiy o ka n sanna ka n ti nya o.
en: You ordered us to bring him here, so you could see him for yourself.

dag: Ka Judanim daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana ti liri ti? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo Samsin mihi n-zaŋ o chaŋ ti niŋ o o ni niŋ ti shɛm labisi.
en: The people of Judah asked, Why have you invaded our land? The Philistines answered, We've come to get Samson. We're going to do the same things to him that he did to our people.

dag: Amaa binneembihi zaa bɛn mali paɣiri, ka mali nab anahi nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: But every other flying insect that has four feet is detestable to you.

dag: Bɛ chaŋ Ijipti nti bɔri sɔŋsim, ka bi niŋ ma saawara. Bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Firawuna yuli ni bɛ nya sɔɣibu shee Ijipti.
en: They are going down to Egypt for help, but they did not ask me if that was the right thing to do. They hope they will be saved by the Pharaoh. They want Egypt to protect them.

dag: Tiŋ maa niriba zaa bɔrila bindirigu ka kul ŋuhira. Bɛ zaŋ bɛ daazichi zaa taɣi bindirigu ni bɛ lan nya yaa. Yawɛ, lihimi nya n ni bahi yoli shɛm.
en: All the people of Jerusalem are groaning. All of her people are looking for food. They are giving away all their nice things for food to stay alive. Jerusalem says, Look, Lord . Look at me! See how people hate me.

dag: Masia maŋmaŋ ni lo alikauli ni o ti ti shɛli nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: The Son has promised us eternal life.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi waɣa ti kpɛri sagbana ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri tɔri sagbana.
en: They may grow great, towering to the sky, so great that their heads reach the clouds.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus called his twelve disciples together and gave them authority to drive out evil spirits and to heal every disease and every sickness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a baɣa be n ni ka garigi ma. Tim ma yaa yaha, di yi pa lala n ni kpi.
en: Lord my God, look at me and give me an answer. Make me feel strong again, or I will die.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili ni wurim, amaa ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suɣili kul ni ʒiɛya.
en: An evil persons house will be destroyed, but a good persons family will do well.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛligu daa maan chaŋ tooni, ka nyaandoliba maa kalinli daa zooi pahi Jɛrusalɛm puuni hal ka maligumaaniba pam gba daa niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: Gods word continued to grow. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased significantly. Even a large group of priests embraced the faith.

dag: Bee miri ka a di ʒiri shɛhira jɛndi a kpee.
en: You must not tell lies about other people.

dag: Ka Shimɛi daa kul turi ba ka yɛra, Wara, wara, nyin ninvuɣ kur ŋɔ, nyin ninvuɣ yoli ŋɔ.
en: Shimei cursed him and said, Get out! Get out! Murderer! Criminal!.

dag: Di nyɛla yaɣ kɔŋkɔba, amaa ka nyɛ niŋgbun yini.
en: So there are many parts, but only one body.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ. Ka Yisa daa ʒi omaŋmaŋ dapulli maa hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: and he carried his cross to a place known as The Skull. In Aramaic this place is called Golgotha.

dag: Ti teei ti ni daa yi ŋubiri zahim shɛli yoli Ijipti la mini kukombanim ni watamilo ni gabo ni alibarisa ni tafarinom la yɛla;.
en: We remember the fish we ate in Egypt. That fish cost us nothing. We also had good vegetables like cucumbers, melons, chives, onions, and garlic.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ku mali taali, ka naɣ ni bela kasi, ka nyɛ Naawuni bihi bɛn be tibi m-be ʒiɛmaan biɛɣunim mini ʒiɛman golimanim sunsuuni ŋɔ. Di simdi ni yi be bɛ sunsuuni dunia ŋɔ ni n-ne kaman saŋmarisi ni ne shɛm la.
en: so that you may be blameless and pure, innocent children of God surrounded by people who are crooked and corrupt. Among these people you shine like stars in the world.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli zuɣu, dolimi n nyɛvili. A wuntitali zuɣu, yihim ma n wahala ŋɔ ni.
en: Be true to your name, Lord , and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti niŋ naani ni ti ni tooi kpe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la Yisa ʒim zuɣu.
en: We have, then, my friends, complete freedom to go into the Most Holy Place by means of the death of Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dahin shɛli tɛha ni yɛm n-zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla niŋ o nuu ni.
en: So, Pharaoh, you should choose a wise, intelligent man and put him in charge of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Farisii, ka o yuli booni Gamaliɛl ka o daa nyɛ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu karimba so sokam ni tiri jilima la daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ni bɛ na zaŋmi Yisa tuumba maa yi kpaŋ pɔi.
en: One council member, a Pharisee and teacher of the Law named Gamaliel, well-respected by all the people, stood up and ordered that the men be taken outside for a few moments.

dag: hal ka a ninvuɣ biɛtali ti yi palo? Pumpɔŋɔ a nyɛla Ɛdomnim mini Filistianim ni bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba ni maani ninvuɣ so ansarisi, ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: But now everyone has learned how wicked you really are. The countries of Syria and Philistia, as well as your other neighbors, hate you and make insulting remarks.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla ŋun paai yuma anu zaŋ hal ni yuun pisi, doo daa yɛn nyɛla bini pisi, ka paɣ mi nyɛ bini pia.
en: If the age of the person is between and years, the value for a male is twenty shekels, for a female ten shekels.

dag: N lihila a daalikauli soli hal ka n nina ti fulim; ka m bɔhira, Ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: I keep looking for what you promised, but my eyes are feeling tired. When will you comfort me?.

dag: Ka salo bɛn zaa daa laɣim ʒe nimaani ni bɛ lihi ninliha maa daa nya din niŋ maa. Ka ŋmaligi buri bɛ nyɔri kuna.
en: A crowd had gathered to see the terrible sight. Then after they had seen it, they felt brokenhearted and went home.

dag: Ti yaannim maa ni daa be Ijipti saha shɛl la, bɛ baɣa daa ka a daalahiziba tuma ni. Bɛ daa tam a yurilim maŋli din galisi la yɛla, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ nyin Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Zuliya ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka zaɣisi saɣisigu; yɛlimaŋli vuuya, di lan ka bɛ noya ni.
en: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.

dag: Ɛli bidibisi daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yoya; bɛ baɣa daa ka Yawɛ ni.
en: Elis sons were evil men who did not care about the Lord .

dag: O daa jɛmdila Baal, ka dol o ba ni daa niŋ shɛlikam la soli n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Ahaziah served Baal and worshipped him. He angered the LORD, Israels God, by doing all the same things his father had done.

dag: Ka o daa tuhi deei bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔn ni la zaa m-mali lala hal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Shishak defeated the strong cities of Judah. Then Shishak brought his army to Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti dɔni o yaannim tooni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: Then David lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Davids City.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni, ka zaŋdi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa ti mini ti yaannim ni bi tooi ʒi ni yi ʒili ba?.
en: So now, why are you putting a heavy burden around the necks of the non-Jewish followers of Jesus? Are you trying to make God angry? We and our fathers were not able to carry that burden.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu! Yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani la kul chanimi gindi ŋumdi kaman gbuɣinli la m-bɔri ni o gbaai so ŋubi.
en: Control yourselves and be careful! The devil is your enemy, and he goes around like a roaring lion looking for someone to attack and eat.

dag: Di saha paɣisarili maa ba min o ma bɛn zaŋmi paɣ maa paɣipalitali shihira na ti wuhi tiŋ maa kpamba dunɔdali gbini.
en: If this happens, the girls father and mother must bring the proof that the girl was a virgin to the town elders at the meeting place of the town.

dag: Di puuni ninvuɣ zuɣuri tim bɛ tumtumdiba ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka bɛ chaŋ kɔbilisi ni nti bi nya kom, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ bɛ kɔŋɔŋdi biŋkuma labi kuli. Vi gbahi ba ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: The rich send their servants for water, but the wells run dry. They return with empty jars, ashamed, bewildered, and in despair.

dag: Dama Masia daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu yim, ka di yɛla naai zaa. Ŋuna ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra daa kpi bɛn pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ti tahi Naawuni sani. Bɛ daa kula o niŋgbuŋ, amaa ka Naawuni Shia daa lee neeg o n-chɛ ka o mali nyɛvili.
en: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.

dag: N shia, Neema! Mɔɣilo mini goonje, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: Wake up, my soul! Wake up, my harp and lyre! I will wake up the sun.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni tutuɣu, ka faako yi ti kana, bɛ ku nya li. Bɛ ni ti bela tiŋgban nɛli tiŋ kuŋ ni. Tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ yalim tiŋgbani, ka so ka di ni.
en: They are like a bush in a desert where no one lives. It is in a hot and dry land. It is in bad soil. That bush does not know about the good things that God can give.

dag: Yaakubu mini ba ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri saha shɛli maa, ka Reechɛl taɣ o ba piɛri paa na; dama ŋuna n-daa guli ba.
en: While Jacob was still talking with them, Rachel arrived with the flock.

dag: Deemi ti suhigu, ka zaŋ a kpiɔŋ la n-ti ti nasara, ka lala chɛ ka a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la tiligi.
en: Use your great power and give us victory! Answer our prayer and save the people you love.

dag: Ka naa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wum ba pam, ka o zani nimaani vuhi.
en: The king and all his men were worn out when they reached the Jordan, and there they rested.

dag: Amaa biɛɣu yi neei bee di yi niŋ daba ayi ka dabili maa kpaŋ, di bi simdi ni bɛ darig o tibili dama ŋuna n-su dabili maa.
en: But if the slave does not die for a day or two, the master is not to be punished. The loss of his property is punishment enough.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa mirig o nina kpa Hazaɛl n-kul lihir o hal ka vi ti gbaag o. Ka Ilaisha kumda.
en: Then Elisha stared at him with a horrified look on his face until Hazael became ill at ease. Suddenly Elisha burst into tears.

dag: O daa zaŋ o niriba kpe mɔɣu ni gari. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He led his people through the desert. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim noya lan woli.
en: Again the Jews were divided over what Jesus was saying.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: That same day some Sadducees came to Jesus. The Sadducees asked Jesus a question.

dag: Gidiɔn ni daa wum doo maa zahindi maa mini di gbinni ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka o daa paɣi Naawuni pam, ka ŋmaligi lab Izraɛlnim sani ti yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ, Yawɛ zaŋ Midiannim maa zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: When Gideon heard the telling of the dream and its meaning, he worshipped. Then he returned to the Israelite camp and said, Get up! The LORD has handed over the Midianite camp to you.

dag: Bɛ bihi kul bela barina ni, ka bɛ mɔŋ ba nasara dunɔdali shee, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi.
en: Their children are far from safety, crushed in the gate without a deliverer.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu yubu mini Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu yubu nyɛla din tuhiri tab tɔbu; dama di nyɛla din chihi taba ka guri ya soli n-chɛ ka yi bi niŋdi yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛm.
en: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.

dag: A ni mi shɛli, n gba mi li. M pala ŋun pooi daadam a sani.
en: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.

dag: Yɛlim Ziɔnnima, Nyamiya! Yi naa kani yi sanna. O nyɛla maŋsiɣisibulana, ka bari buŋ min o bia.
en: Say to Daughter Zion, Look, your king is coming to you, humble and riding on a donkey, and on a colt the donkeys offspring. .

dag: Amaa ka Zarai daa lee nyɛ paɣiŋoo; o daa ka bia.
en: Sarai was unable to have children.

dag: Ka dabili mi na ʒi n-kpalim be ŋun su o yiŋa sahakam, amaa yilibia ŋun kul ni beni sahakam.
en: A slave does not belong to a family permanently, but a son belongs there forever.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa ti paai Mariama sani o yɛl o mi, M puhir a nyin ŋun mal alibarika pam ŋɔ, ti Duuma be a sani! A mal alibarika paɣiba ni.
en: The angel greeted Mary and said, You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.

dag: Di saha n dima ni ti nya li, ka vi ti gbaai ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhiri ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni la lee bela ya? N nini ni ti nya o lubu, ka bɛ ti no o sɔŋ kaman palli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: You, my enemies, said, The Lord God is helpless. Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street.

dag: Amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa n-yi beni pahi, di ni tooi mali jintɔriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Is there something else you want to talk about? Then come to the regular town meeting of the people. It can be decided there.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba chaŋ, ka n lan zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu. N ku chɛ bɛ ni so bahi.
en: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.

dag: Di ŋubiya li, ka binshɛɣukam ti niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, yi ni tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani zuɣu.
en: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam, ka o biɛhigu zaa mali kɔre pam. Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n yura ni n zo maa ni be shɛm m-bala.
en: Yes, women of Jerusalem, my lover is everything I desire. His mouth is the sweetest of all. This is my lover; this is my darling.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Binnui son of Henadad, who ruled the other half of the district of Keilah;.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa wurim Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma sɔŋ, ka Gɛrishɔn mini Mɛrari zuliya bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma la daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi.
en: The dwelling was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites, who carried the dwelling, marched.

dag: Nam zuɣupiligu yi ti zuɣu ni lu. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti tum alahichi.
en: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.

dag: Zaŋm taaŋkɔro paɣi ma ka n yi daɣiri ni, ka paligi laɣilaɣi gari gumbɔrigu.
en: Purify me with hyssop and I will be clean; wash me and I will be whiter than snow.

dag: ni Abidɔn ni Zikiri ni Hanan.
en: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan.

dag: Naawuni simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ŋuna n-su yɛm mini yiko.
en: Gods name be praised from age to eternal age! Wisdom and might are his!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Midiannim nuu ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Then once again the Israelites started disobeying the Lord , so he let the nation of Midian control Israel for seven years.

dag: N daa mooi n nini n-yɛri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ niŋm tuuba Naawuni sani ka niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda.
en: To Jews and Gentiles alike I gave solemn warning that they should turn from their sins to God and believe in our Lord Jesus.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihiri laɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la saha shɛli ka maligumaana Hilikia daa nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ni o ti o niriba la kundi.
en: While the money was being taken out of the storeroom, Hilkiah found the book of the Law of the Lord , the Law that God had given to Moses.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi Gibia na ti tuhi ku Izraɛlnim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayi dindali maa.
en: But the Benjaminites marched out from Gibeah and cut down twenty-two thousand Israelite men that day.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ka yuri ti, ka nyɛ ŋun ti ti suhukpaŋsibo din ka bahigu mini tahima suŋ o daanfaani puuni la.
en: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and in his grace gave us unfailing courage and a firm hope.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ti ma noli din ni tooi wuhi niriba ni di chɛ ka n tooi kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi suhuri. O neeri ma la asiba kam, ka yoori n tiba ni n wum kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri wuhibu.
en: The Sovereign Lord has taught me what to say, so that I can strengthen the weary. Every morning he makes me eager to hear what he is going to teach me.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla wuntialana ka a saria karibu nyɛ din tuhi.
en: You are righteous, Lord , and your laws are just.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yɛhudianim shɛb lo nia ni bɛ ku Pool, ka daa laɣim po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu.
en: The next morning some Jews met together and made a plan. They took a vow that they would not eat or drink anything until they had killed Paul.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara ti ku lan kpi kum din pahi buyi la yaha.
en: If you have ears, then, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches! Those who win the victory will not be hurt by the second death.

dag: Ka Yaakubu suhu daa yu Reechɛl ka o yɛli, N ni tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti a, Reechɛl ŋun nyɛ a bipuɣiŋga biasani ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Since Jacob was in love with Rachel, he answered, If you will let me marry Rachel, I'll work seven years for you.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be salo maa ni yɛli Yisa, Karimba, kpahim a nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni ka bɛ fo.
en: Then some of the Pharisees in the crowd spoke to Jesus. Teacher, they said, command your disciples to be quiet.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa gbaai mɔɣili du ni o ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ daa shiri zaŋ ba niŋ o nuu ni.
en: From Mizpah, Jephthah attacked the Ammonites, and the Lord helped him defeat them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaɣisi n yɛligu ka dolila kiŋkansi mini yɔhiŋ soli, ka niŋ li naani.
en: Therefore, the holy one of Israel says: Because you reject this word and trust in oppression and cunning and rely on them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lo noli, ka kpe duu nti teei dɔni tiŋgban ni suhiri Naawuni bia maa zuɣu din dali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: David prayed to God that the child would get well. He refused to eat anything, and every night he went into his room and spent the night lying on the floor.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Pa ŋuna nti yɛn di a fali; amaŋmaŋ bia nti yɛn di a fali.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Abram and said, That slave will not be the one to get what you have. You will have a son who will get everything you own.

dag: Dama maligumaaniba zuɣulana daa yi zaŋdila biŋkɔbiri ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la ti maani sara alahichi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maa zaɣ muna yiri tin tariga ti nyɔri buɣim.
en: The blood of the animals is carried into the holy of holies by the high priest as an offering for sin, and their bodies are burned outside the camp.

dag: Di zaa ni ti saɣim, amaa nyin kul ni beni sahakam. Di ni ti kpi kaman siturili la. A taɣiri li mi kaman situra la, ka di kul kpira.
en: The earth and sky will end, but you will live forever! They will wear out like clothes, and like clothes, you will change them.

dag: N ni daa mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka n daa daŋ lo nia ni n ka yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka yi nya suhupiɛlli buyi:.
en: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—.

dag: Yi yi niŋ lala, yi tum alahichi yi mabihi sani ka gbarigi bɛ suhuri ni tɛha din ka kpiɔŋ la, ka lala niŋbu nyɛla alahichi tumbu Masia sani.
en: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ di kahigi wuhi ni so ku tooi yi taali ni Naawuni sani fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu, dama di sabiya: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So it is clear that no one can be made right with God by the law. The Scriptures say, The one who is right with God by faith will live forever.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yino sani nti yɛl o ni o wuhim ma yɛla maa zaa gbinni. Ka o daa wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: So I asked one of those standing there, and he explained.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubiri la bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi la hal ni daba ayɔbu, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, di simdi ni yi ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka di ti tumiya tuun shɛli dindali maa.
en: For the next six days you are to eat bread prepared without yeast, and on the seventh day assemble to worship the Lord your God, and do no work on that day.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paɣ o chɛchɛbuŋ maa sɔŋ miri Samaria biaŋ, ka bahi daa kana ti lɛl o ʒim; ka pagɔra gba kana nti su di kom kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: They cleaned the chariot at the pool of Samaria. The dogs licked up the kings blood and the prostitutes bathed in it, just as the LORD had spoken.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋdi bimbira tiri ŋun birita, ka chɛ ka o nyari bindirigu, ni tiri yi gba m-pahiri yi ni mali shɛli zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi nirilim niŋbu zooi pahi.
en: The one who supplies seed for planting and bread for eating will supply and multiply your seed and will increase your crop, which is righteousness.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: These were the family groups from the tribe of Zebulun. The total number of men was .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be kurimbuni ha la, so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla. Lala n-nyɛ li ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn yi dunia palo ŋɔ ni na nyaaŋa ti ku teei bɛ gba yɛla.
en: Theres no remembrance of things in the past, nor of things to come in the future. Neither will there be any remembrance among those who come along in the future.

dag: Bɛ kpari Nɛgɛbinim niŋ bɛ fɔntinsi ni, ka so kani ŋun ni kparigi ba. Bɛ gbahi Judanim zaa chaŋ.
en: The towns of southern Judah are under siege; no one can get through to them. All the people of Judah have been taken away into exile.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋd a. Dama buɣim di mɔɣu zaa, ka buɣim zilima di mɔɣu ni tihi zaa.
en: I cry out to you, Lord . Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.

dag: Gbilisim tibili wum n saɣisigu ŋɔ; n ni yɛl a din be n suhu ni, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni yɛli shɛm.
en: You should respond when I correct you. Look, Ill pour out my spirit on you. Ill reveal my words to you.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Pul daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-ti Asiria Naa Pul ni o sɔŋ o ka o kul su o nam maa.
en: When Assyrias King Tiglath-pileser marched against the land, Menahem gave Tiglath-pileser one thousand silver kikkars in order to become his ally and to strengthen his hold on the kingdom.

dag: Taɣimi gban shɛli n-sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa kul be tuuli gban shɛli Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa nyo buɣim la puuni la niŋ di ni.
en: to get another scroll and write down everything that had been on the first one.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka o zaŋ ya leeg o niriba zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka leei yi Naawuni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu shɛm la.
en: so that the Lord may now confirm you as his people and be your God, as he promised you and your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋ-ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni m-booni tab yɛra:.
en: What can I say about the people who live today? What are they like? The people today are like children sitting in the marketplace. One group of children calls to the other group.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Amazia ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa daa mali o kpamba saawara, ka tim ti yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia, ka nyɛ Jɛhu yaaŋa la ni o kana ti chɛ ka bɛ nina pali taba.
en: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: Come out and face me in battle.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii Lɛvi yi zuliya zaa ni ni o min o bihi zani zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ yuli tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: This is because the Lord your God looked at all your tribes and chose Levi and his descendants to serve him as priests forever.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa n-doli tuumba maa wuhibu, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ bali bɛ ni n-wuhiri bɛ dolintabitali ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ laɣimdi mini bɛ wunsuhigu ni.
en: The believers spent their time listening to the teaching of the apostles. They shared everything with each other. They ate together and prayed together.

dag: Heei! Kɔnyuri ni mali sokam, ŋun kam kom ŋɔ gbin na! Ka yinim bɛn mi ka liɣiri, kamiyana ti da bindirigu di! Kamiyana ti da wain mini bihim nyu ka di yɔnya shɛli!.
en: All of you who are thirsty, come to the water! Whoever has no money, come, buy food and eat! Without money, at no cost, buy wine and milk!.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti kpe ŋariŋ ni ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du teeku ŋɔ duli ha. Ka bɛ dii gbaai chandi.
en: One day Jesus and his followers got into a boat. He said to them, Come with me across the lake. And so they started across.

dag: Gbaya anahi daa bela dapaɣa maa lɔŋni; ka gbaya maa spindilinim mi mini binzahi maa nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini, ka gbaya maa zaɣ yini kam dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: and the wheels and axles were underneath them. The wheels were about centimeters high.

dag: Nyini n-daa ŋme m-bɔri Lɛviatan zuɣuri ka zaŋ bɛ nimdi ti tiŋgban nɛli ni niriba.
en: you crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan and fed his body to desert animals.

dag: Bɛ karimbaani biɛhigu zuɣu, bɛ yɛrimi, Naawuni ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo; ka bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla, Naawuni kani.
en: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.

dag: Bɛ ni mi ni Naawuni zaligu wuhiya ni bɛn tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim simdi kum maa zaa yoli, bɛmaŋmaŋ gba kul tumdi li mi hal ka ʒe bɛn gba tumdi li nyaaŋa.
en: Though they know Gods decision that those who persist in such practices deserve death, they not only keep doing these things but also approve others who practice them.

dag: Dama yi mi wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa ni zali ti shɛm puuni la yɛla.
en: You know the instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda nachimba maa ŋmaligi labi ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: Davids men went back and told him everything that Nabal had said.

dag: ka su wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ, ka woligi neesim ka chɛ zibisim. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: to rule over the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God was pleased with what he saw.

dag: Doli wuhibu maŋ shɛŋa n ni daa zaŋ wuh a la yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la puuni.
en: Hold firmly to the true words that I taught you, as the example for you to follow, and remain in the faith and love that are ours in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn pun lo amiliya, n zali ya zaligu, amaa pa mani n-zali ya lala, ti Duuma n-zali ya li. Dina n-nyɛ: Paɣ miri ka o yi o yidana yiŋa.
en: Im passing on the Lords command to those who are married: A wife shouldnt leave her husband.

dag: Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino ni Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa la.
en: Simon the Patriot, and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: Simon Peter said, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zooi yomyom kaman kuliga ni mɔri la, ka lan zooi yomyom kaman mo shɛŋa din ʒe baa din kom zɔri ni la.
en: They will thrive like well-watered grass, like willows by streams of running water.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka bɛ zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi li pa tampiŋ zuɣu, ka di kul beni sahakam!.
en: with an iron instrument and lead, forever engraved on stone.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la daa yi Bahurim kana yomyom ti pahi Judanim maa zuɣu ni bɛ tuhi Naa Dauda soli.
en: Geras son Shimei, the Benjaminite from Bahurim, hurried down with the people of Judah to meet King David.

dag: dindina di simdi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, ka o ti po pɔri wuhi ni o nuu bi tim o kpee maa azichi maa ni, ka di simdi ni biŋkɔbigu maa lan saɣi pɔri maa, ka samli yɔbu lan kani.
en: the man must go to the place of worship and take an oath that he has not stolen the other man's animal. If the animal was not stolen, the owner shall accept the loss, and the other man need not repay him;.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpambaliba nini daa tiɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: This seemed like a very good idea to Pharaoh, and all his officials agreed.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna nti ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni m-bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: The Pharisees showed up and began to argue with Jesus. To test him, they asked for a sign from heaven.

dag: Asa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything Asa did, from the beginning to the end, is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Dauda bia Absalom daa mali tizɔpaɣ viɛlli ka o yuli booni Tama. Dahin shɛli ka Dauda bia Amnɔn kɔre daa ti kpe o ni.
en: Some time later, Davids son Amnon fell in love with Tamar the beautiful sister of Absalom, who was also Davids son.

dag: Huram daa lan me duɣuri ka mali soobuya mini taha. Lala ka Huram daa niŋ tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa zaa ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: Hiram made pans for hot ashes, and also shovels and sprinkling bowls. This is a list of the bronze items that Hiram made for the Lord 's temple:.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛsta Mɔdɛkai ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Hathach did this.

dag: Dindali maa ka yi ni ti baŋ ni n shiri be m Ba ni, ka yi mi be n ni, ka n gba be yi ni.
en: When that day comes, you will know that I am in my Father and that you are in me, just as I am in you.

dag: Ka Huram daa mali daanya daantalis ayi sɔŋ. Zaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii. Ka booi booli pa di naŋgbanyɛhi zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anii. Ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla, ka daantaliga din pah ayi gba be lala.
en: He cast two bronze pillars. Each one was twenty-seven feet high and required a cord of eighteen feet to reach around it.

dag: Mani n-daa zaŋ sagbana pil li, ka zaŋ zibisim titali vil li.
en: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.

dag: O ni nyɛ ŋun be kasi la zuɣu, o ŋmanila kuɣ shɛli Juda zuliya mini Izraɛl zuliya ni tuuri lura; ka ŋmani tɔn shɛli din gbahiri Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Run to me for protection. I am a rock that will make both Judah and Israel stumble and break their bones. I am a trap that will catch the people of Jerusalem—they will be captured and dragged away.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yo Yaakubu zuliya samli, ka tiligi ba bɛn mali yaa gari ba nuu ni.
en: The LORD will rescue the people of Jacob and deliver them from the power of those stronger than they are.

dag: O daa dolila solɔɣu m-miri paɣa maa lɔndo polo. O daa dolila soli chani o yiŋa.
en: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.

dag: m-bɔh o, Zarai dabili Haga, ya ka a lee yina bee ya ka a lee chana? Ka o yɛli, N yila n lan Zarai sani zɔra.
en: and said, Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from and where are you going? She answered, I am running away from my mistress.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, n-nyɛ yi ni pii na so maa, dama yi ni yɛli ni yi bɔri so maa ka Yawɛ zaŋ leei naa n-tin ya maa.
en: Now, here is the king you chose. The Lord put this king over you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sujee kuri jɛrigu, ka nyuli zabbu mi kuri ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Surely anger can kill the foolish; fury can kill the simple.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba je ni so kpahi bɛ zuɣuri ni; bɛ ku chaŋ yɛnnim sani.
en: Mockers dont like those who correct them. They wont go to the wise.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni ka tur o zuɣu chɛ ka o daa pihipihi o binyɛrigu taŋkpaɣu bahi ka yɛli ba, Yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya bahi yoli taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu! Man nuu yiya. Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ni chaŋla bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: When they opposed and slandered him, he shook the dust from his clothes in protest and said to them, You are responsible for your own fates! Im innocent! From now on Ill go to the Gentiles.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yoya yɔhim ya, dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhu kul yiɣisiri bahiri bɛn bi deer o noli zuɣu.
en: Dont let anyone fool you with words that are not true. God gets very angry when people who dont obey him talk like that.

dag: Ka bɛ daa goog o yɛl o, Kpalimmi ya ŋɔ n-gbe ti sani, dama wuntaŋ luya ka yuŋ zibira. Ka o daa doli ba kpe bɛ yiŋa.
en: but they held him back, saying, Stay with us; the day is almost over and it is getting dark. So he went in to stay with them.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ba leei zuliya yini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Izraɛl zoli zuɣu, ka na yino ti nyɛ bɛ zaa naa. Bɛ ti ku lan nyɛ zuliya diba ayi, bɛ mi ti ku lan pirigi n-nyɛ nam buyi.
en: I will make them one nation in their land among the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over them all. They will no longer be two nations. They will not be split into two kingdoms anymore.

dag: ka tiri kum ni kuri shɛb bindira, ka tiri nandaamba bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli, dindina yi neesim ni neei zibisim ni m-be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim la.
en: if you give food to the hungry and satisfy those who are in need, then the darkness around you will turn to the brightness of noon.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Do so ŋun tib ma maa n-yɛli ma ni n kpuɣimi m bindoo maa chaŋ.
en: But he answered, The man who made me well told me, Pick up your mat and walk.

dag: Pur maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ booni vuhim dabisa chuɣu maa Purim. Bɛ ni daa sab gban shɛl la mini dinkam daa niŋ ba la zuɣu.
en: Mordecai's letter had said that the Jews must celebrate for two days because of what had happened to them. This time of celebration is called Purim, which is the Hebrew word for the lots that were cast.

dag: Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira.
en: I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat.

dag: Amaa o yi ka yiko din ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li, dindina o ni kɔhi shɛli maa kul ni kpalim be ŋun da li maa nuu ni hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni. Di yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka bɛ deei li n-labisi ti o.
en: But if you do not have enough money to buy the land back, it remains under the control of the one who bought it until the next Year of Restoration. In that year it will be returned to its original owner.

dag: amaa ka dolila Izraɛl nanim naba n-chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim bi lan ʒe yim kaman Ɛhab ni daa niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bi lan ʒe Naawuni yim la, m-pah a ni daa lan ku a tizɔbihi bɛn so a ka nyɛ a ba bihi la.
en: but have walked in the ways of Israels kings and have encouraged Judah and Jerusalems citizens to be unfaithful, just as the house of Ahab did, and because you have even murdered your own brothers, your fathers family, who were better than you.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila anzinfa viɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun tɛha buchi bi yaɣi lala.
en: Words from good people are like pure silver, but thoughts from the wicked are worthless.

dag: Nyama, a tɔbbihi zaa ŋmanila paɣiba. A tiŋgbani maa dunɔdaya yɔhimi ti a dimnima. Ka buɣim di a dunɔdaya dapuhi.
en: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ piɛla yino n-chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Take one of the rams and tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on its head.

dag: O daa ti lan ku Ijipti do viɛl so gba. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni, amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa kpani maa o nuu ni n-zaŋ omaŋmaŋ kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: Another time, he killed an Egyptian, as big as a giant. The Egyptian was armed with a spear, but Benaiah only had a club. Benaiah grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.

dag: bɔzuɣu ka nyini zo shɛli dim mali chunchuna ŋɔ lihiri Naawuni ni bɔri ni zo shɛli nyɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ nyuli zabbu lihigu? Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bɔri ni o be sahakam.
en: You many-peaked mountain: Why do you look with envy at the mountain God desired for his dwelling, the mountain where the LORD dwells forever?.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni di binshɛɣukam zaa naai.
en: So the heavens and the earth and everything else were created.

dag: O daa lan nyo tindaannim kɔba buɣim bɛ bimbina zuɣu, ka daa yihi Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm daɣiri ni.
en: He burned the bones of the pagan priests on the altars where they had worshiped. By doing all this, he made Judah and Jerusalem ritually clean again.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa ni daa wum li, ka tinzunnim bɛn gili ti zaa daa nya li, ka bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni ti Naawuni sɔŋsim ni ka tuma maa tum naai maa.
en: Then all our enemies heard that we had completed the wall, and all the nations around us saw that it was finished. So they lost their courage, because they understood that this work had been done with the help of our God.

dag: Di chɛ ka munaafichinim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu di bɛn yuri duŋ taabu pam!.
en: May those who accuse others falsely not succeed; may evil overtake violent people and destroy them.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o dan Ibrahimma laakumnim pia, ka deei pin suma balibu kam o sani n-yiɣisi chaŋ Nahɔr ya din be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka ŋumdi kaman gbuɣimbihi la.
en: The people of Babylon are like roaring young lions. They growl like baby lions.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi mini teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: Then for the tent, make a covering of rams skins dyed red and an outer covering of beaded leather.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kɔr biɛri tuma min a ni daa be a zaɣim a mamanim sani a pagɔrisigu tuma tumbu ni ni a buɣ shɛŋa din chihiri min a ni daa zaŋ a bihi ʒim mali ba la.
en: The LORD God proclaims: You were in a constant state of arousal and exposed yourself when you acted like a prostitute with your lovers and with the idols to which you gave your childrens blood.

dag: N daa mali suhupiɛlli o dunia din pali binnɛma ŋɔ zuɣu, ka mali suhupiɛlli ninsalinim zuɣu.
en: I played in the world he made and enjoyed the people he put there.

dag: Bɛ yi galim ya Masia yuli zuɣu, yi mal alibarika, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi min o jilima be yi ni. Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri Masia, amaa yinim sani o nyɛla ŋun nyari tibigibu.
en: Happy are you if you are insulted because you are Christ's followers; this means that the glorious Spirit, the Spirit of God, is resting on you.

dag: Zinaniŋda gba kul guhirila wuntaŋ lubu ka yɛra, N je ni so nya ma. Ka zaŋ bini pili limsi o ninni.
en: A man who commits adultery waits for the night to come. He thinks, No one will see me, but still, he covers his face.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wuni ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni m-be ka nyini. Dama nyini n-gbib a alikauli ni yurilim din bi naara zaŋ chaŋ a daba bɛn dol a ni bɛ suhuri zaa sani.
en: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Batishiiba daa chaŋ naa sani o dudoonigu ni. Di saha maa naa daa kurigiya pam, ka Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣ la m-be o sani gbib o.
en: Meanwhile, David was in his bedroom where Abishag was taking care of him because he was so old. Bathsheba went in.

dag: So yi yɛn zaŋ chi bee kawana na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋm li niɛm zim, ka bo kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pahi di zuɣu.
en: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ʒi tibisa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, o ni sɔŋ ya; o kul ku chɛ wuntizɔra bahi.
en: Cast your burden on the LORD— he will support you! God will never let the righteous be shaken.

dag: Ka saha shɛlikam ti suhuri yi ti wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, Naawuni gari ti suhuri maa, ka mi binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: If our conscience condemns us, we know that God is greater than our conscience and that he knows everything.

dag: Ka o daa lan daai Pɛnuɛluɛlnim pii la luhi, ka ku tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: Gideon also pulled down the tower in the city of Penuel and killed the men living in that city.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ zaligu sahakam. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni maa mihi so, ŋun paɣim o binyɛra; ka ŋun mi shihi kom maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: You are to observe this rule for all time to come. The person who sprinkles the water for purification must also wash his clothes; anyone who touches the water remains ritually unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Haman daa zaŋ kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa chaŋ ti zaŋ kpariti maa yɛli Mɔdɛkai ka chɛ ka o ba wɔhu maa, ka ŋun Haman gari tooni zaŋ o doli tiŋ puuni solɔri, ka kuhiri yɛra, Nyamiya naa ni niŋ o ni yu ni o duhi ninvuɣ so shɛm.
en: Haman got the king's robe and put it on Mordecai. He led him through the city on the horse and shouted as he went, This is how the king honors a man.

dag: ka maligumaana maa lan lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali. O yi lihi nya ka dɔro maa bi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, dindina ŋun lan zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: The priest shall examine you again on the seventh day, and if in his opinion the sore looks the same and has not spread, he shall isolate you for another seven days.

dag: Ŋuna n-fuɣiri maligumaaniba situra ka mali ba chana, ka luhiri wɔɣira.
en: He strips priests of their power and removes those who feel so secure in their position.

dag: Tɔŋ gbaai bɛ napɔŋkpahi, zana gbaai ba gbibi.
en: A trap catches them by the heel, and it holds them tight.

dag: Ɛdomnima mini Ishimail zuliya ni Mɔabnima ni Hagirinima ni.
en: the people of Edom and the Ishmaelites; the people of Moab and the Hagrites;.

dag: Ka sapashin maa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb maa daa lab yiŋa nti nya ka sapashini maa dabili maa shiri kpaŋmi zaa.
en: When the centurions friends returned to his house, they found the servant restored to health.

dag: Dindali maa Ijiptinim ni ti ŋmanila paɣiba, dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti yɛn doli so shɛli liri ba zuɣu.
en: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.

dag: Hal Yisa ni daa yuri Lazarɔs mini Maata ni Mariama pam la zaa yoli.
en: Jesus loved Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.

dag: Ka Yisa boli ba na ti bɔhi ba; Wula ka Sintani ni tooi kari Sintani? Ka ŋahi ba ŋaha yɛli.
en: So Jesus called them to him and spoke to them in parables: How can Satan drive out Satan?.

dag: Ti ku lab ti yinsi faashee ka Izraɛlnim zaa ti nya bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana.
en: We will not return to our homes until all the other Israelites have taken possession of the land assigned to them.

dag: ka yɛl o, N dana, di zaŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali bee n-lan teei n ni daa tum gala shɛm dahin shɛli nyini n dan ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm n-zɔrila yɛla. Naa, di zaŋ li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Shimei said to the king, My lord, dont think about the wrong things I did. My lord and king, dont remember the bad things I did when you left Jerusalem.

dag: Shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni vuɣi ba bee n-wurim ba ka ku ba.
en: If at any time I say that I am going to uproot, break down, or destroy any nation or kingdom.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla kaman awa yini laasabu yaha ka so lan yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa sani, dama o nyɛla Galili nira.
en: And about an hour later another man insisted strongly, There isn't any doubt that this man was with Jesus, because he also is a Galilean.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni ka Pool ti kpaŋsiri yɛdaniŋdiba suhuri.
en: He traveled through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

dag: Dama sɔtim ku tooi gbaai Yaakubu zuliya, ka so mi ku tooi wa Izraɛlnim bukpahigu. Niriba ni ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu mini Izraɛlnim yɛla ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni ni tum shɛm.
en: There is no magic charm, no witchcraft, That can be used against the nation of Israel. Now people will say about Israel, Look what God has done.

dag: ka ŋun pa o zuɣu mini.
en: The second.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa suhu daa yu Yisifu pam, ka Yisifu daa tumd o tuma, ka o zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ tumtumdiba zuɣulana, ka zaŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Potiphar liked Joseph and made him his personal assistant, putting him in charge of his house and all of his property.

dag: A ni ti tooi yɛli ni a nyɛla wuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku a maa tooni? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti a daŋ maa sani, a nyɛla ninsala, ka pa wuni.
en: That person will kill you. Will you still say, I am a god? No, he will have you in his power! You will see that you are a man, not God!.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti naa maa daa yɛli ba, Musa mini Aduna, bɔzuɣu ka yi chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa bi tumdi bɛ tuma? Chamiya ti tum yi tuma.
en: The king of Egypt said to them, Moses and Aaron, why are you making the people slack off from their work? Do the hard work yourselves.

dag: Amaa o ni daa duh omaŋa ka niŋ karimbaani, ka mali hali yoli ni ninkuunsi la zuɣu ka Naawuni daa vuug o o nam ʒiishee, ka o kɔŋ o jilima zaashee maa.
en: But because he became proud, stubborn, and cruel, he was removed from his royal throne and lost his place of honor.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb gba niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbiri pam bɛn nyɛ piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi n-doli ba chaŋ.
en: Many other people went with them as well, and there were also a lot of sheep, goats, and cattle.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ti a jilima. Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ putɔɣunim ni lu a sizuura.
en: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ nini kul mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛra, O piligila o wuhibu maa Galili n-wuhi li Judia tinsi zaa ni zaŋna hal ti paai kpe, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba taari duŋ.
en: But they objected strenuously, saying, He agitates the people with his teaching throughout Judea—starting from Galilee all the way here.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnima, N ni darigi yi tibili, ka n ni yɛn niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu, malimiya shili gu man ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: So then, people of Israel, I am going to punish you. And because I am going to do this, get ready to face my judgment.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti Yawɛ zaa, di yi nyɛla daadam bee biŋkɔbigu bee o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali, di bi simdi ni bɛ kɔhi li bee n-yo di zuɣu ka dee li, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Yawɛ nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: There is a special kind of gift that people give to the Lord . It belongs only to him, and it cannot be bought back or sold. This gift belongs to the Lord . This type of gift includes people, animals, and fields from the family property.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla sokam dim ka nyuma, ka diri bɛ tuma nyaɣisim. Di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: God wants everyone to eat, drink, and enjoy their work. These are gifts from God.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni garigi yɛli, Di ka buchi, ti ni gbibila ti ni lo nia shɛŋa, ka sokam tumd o tipawumli tuumbiɛri.
en: But they said, Whats the use! We will follow our own plans and act according to our own willful, evil hearts.

dag: ka bi di bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛm Izraɛlnim buɣa la, ka bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni.
en: He doesn't worship the idols of the Israelites or eat the sacrifices offered at forbidden shrines. He doesn't seduce another man's wife.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshɛzabɛl yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Baana bia Zadok daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Meremoth son of Uriah repaired the next section of the wall. Meshullam son of Berekiah repaired the next section of the wall. Zadok son of Baana repaired the next section of the wall.

dag: Ka Naa Akishi kpambaliba daa bɔh o, Pa Dauda ŋɔ n-nyɛ o ya naa la? Pa o yɛla ka bɛ daa wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Naa Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku tuhi piapia la? .
en: The officers of King Achish were also there, and they asked Achish, Isn't David a king back in his own country? Don't the Israelites dance and sing, Saul has killed a thousand enemies; David has killed ten thousand.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimiya sochira zuɣu lihi, bɔhimiya baŋ kurimbuni ha soya la, ka bɔhi baŋ so viɛlli ni nyɛ shɛli n-dol li ka nya suhudoo. Amaa ka bɛ yɛli, Ti ku dol li.
en: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace. But you refused.

dag: Yɛlim Yaakubu zuliya dimbɔŋɔ, molimi li Juda:.
en: Tell this message to the family of Jacob, and tell it in the nation of Judah.

dag: Yi ʒiɛri kpam, ka niŋdi tulaale pam niŋdi yimaŋ chani ti jɛmdi Molɛk. Buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu, yi timdi tuumba katinsi hal ka timdi ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: You use your oils and perfumes to look nice for Molech. You sent your messengers to faraway lands, and this will bring you down to the place of death.

dag: Chamiya chuɣu maa ni. Man na ku chaŋ di ni, dama n saha na bi paai.
en: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tinsi maa ni nɛma zaa tabili di niɣi. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tinsi maa ni zaa; ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba.
en: The people of Israel took all the valuables and livestock from these cities and kept them for themselves. But they put every person to death; no one was left alive.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, yimiyana. Nyamiya Naa Sulemaana ni pili nam zuɣupil shɛli, di nyɛla o ma ni daa zaŋ nam zuɣupil shɛli pil o, o daamiliya lɔbu dali din daa nyɛ o suhupiɛlli dabisili dal la.
en: Women of Zion, come out and see King Solomon. See the crown his mother put on him the day he was married, the day he was so happy!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa chaŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti be o sani pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: So Jeremiah went to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah. He stayed with Gedaliah among those who were left behind in the land of Judah.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni paɣ a. Nyini n nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni tibig a.
en: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ sunsuuni, ka lan me binwɔɣinli zali bɛ tintariga ka di teeri ba Yawɛ yɛla.
en: On that day, there will be an altar to the LORD within the land of Egypt, and a standing stone for the LORD at its border.

dag: O bi nyari n ni doli so shɛŋa, ka kaani n napɔna yaabu zaa?.
en: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Antiɔk Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri.
en: But the Lords followers in Antioch were happy and filled with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n naan zaŋ li buɣi m bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, n naan zaŋ li pili kaman nam zuɣupiligu la.
en: I would wear it around my neck. I would put it on my head like a crown.

dag: Ninsalinim pihiri kuɣa sɔŋda ni bɛ baŋ din beni, amaa Yawɛ kɔŋko n-zaan o ni bɔri shɛli.
en: People cast lots to learn God's will, but God himself determines the answer.

dag: N ni daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ n daalahichi polo, n kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka n kul ŋuhiri hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: Lord, I prayed to you again and again, but I did not talk about my sins. So I only became weaker and more miserable.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku ti a daŋa dabisili puuni, ka goli gba ku ti a dɔro yuŋ.
en: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.

dag: Amaa ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa zɔri Naawuni ka bi niŋdi Ijipti naa ni daa yɛli ni bɛ niŋm shɛm maa, bɛ daa bi kuri bidibbihi maa.
en: But the nurses trusted God, so they did not obey the kings command. They let all the baby boys live.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ ti Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la, o daa kula Hɔrinima ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.

dag: Bɛ ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: They have not known the path of peace.

dag: N ku gbihi bee n-ʒeei gom.
en: I will not sleep or let my eyes rest.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ti doli n ni kariti zuliya shɛb ka chɛri ya ŋɔ kaya, dama bɛ daa tumdila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, dinzuɣu ka n zaɣisi ba.
en: You must not follow the practices of the nations that I am throwing out before you, because they did all these things and I was disgusted with them.

dag: Yinim yɛnnim ŋɔ, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ. Yinim baŋdiba ŋɔ, gbilisimiya tibili.
en: Hear my words, wise ones; knowledgeable ones, listen to me.

dag: Dama Adam ka Naawuni daa daŋ nam ka naanyi ti nam Awa.
en: Adam was formed first, and then Eve.

dag: di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yihi Izraɛlnim zuliya shɛb zaa sani bɛ ni be na, ka yihi ba luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Then tell them that I, the Sovereign Lord , am going to take all my people out of the nations where they have gone, gather them together, and bring them back to their own land.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi, ka ŋunkam ti tum tuma dindali, bɛn kum o.
en: There are six days for working, but the seventh day will be a very special day of rest for you. You will honor the Lord by resting on that special day. Anyone who works on the seventh day must be killed.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum lala maa di daa muɣis o mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya.
en: When King Herod heard this, he was troubled, and everyone in Jerusalem was troubled with him.

dag: Aripakishad daa nyɛla Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arpachshad was Shelahs father, and Shelah was Ebers father.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Yɛla ŋɔ yipa niŋ pali yi sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: He began to explain to them, Today, this scripture has been fulfilled just as you heard it.

dag: Faranim mini nandaamba yi ti bɔri kom ka bi nya, ka kɔnyuri chɛ ka bɛ lɔna kuui, man Yawɛ ni deei bɛ suhigu. Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ku bahi ba.
en: The poor and the needy seek water, and there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. I, the LORD, will respond to them; I, the God of Israel, wont abandon them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka anabi yi yimaŋmaŋ niriba ni na kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ti wummiya anabi maa yɛligu.
en: The Lord your God will send to you a prophet. This prophet will come from among your own people, and he will be like me. You must listen to him.

dag: Tulaale mɔri chɛ ka di nyom chani ginda, ka tiwal viɛla zaa ʒe m-baɣi ti dunoya. N yura, di zaɣ kura mini zaɣ pala ka n zaŋ zal a.
en: The mandrakes give off their scent, and at our doorways is every delicacy— fresh or ripened— my love, I have kept them hidden for you.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi po alizanda pola di mini Naawuni nam ʒiishee n-tabili ŋun Naawuni ŋun ʒi di ni maa.
en: To swear by heaven is the same as swearing by God's throne and by the one who sits on that throne.

dag: Dama Atalia ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ putɔɣulan la bidibisi daa kabila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa kpe, hal ka daa lan zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen kasinim zaa ti jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: Now wicked Athaliah and her followers had broken into Gods temple and used all the holy objects of the LORDs temple in their worship of the Baals.

dag: O bi paɣi wɔr so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. O mi bi paɣi ninvuɣ so ŋun tooi zɔri pam.
en: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa guli dunoli maa bɔhi Pita, A pala doo ŋɔ nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, M pala o nyaandola.
en: but asked him, Aren't you one of that man's followers? No, I am not! Peter answered.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la yiko, amaa ka lee chɛ ba ni bɛ be saha biɛla pahi.
en: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.

dag: Ka Pirɔs bia Sɔpata ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛria tiŋbia la mini Aristakus ni Sɛkundus bɛn daa nyɛ Tɛsalɔnaika tiŋbihi la ni Gaiɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Dɛɛbi tiŋbia la ni Timoti m-pahi Tikikus mini Trɔfimus bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la daa dol o chaŋ.
en: Sopater son of Pyrrhus, from Berea, went with him; so did Aristarchus and Secundus, from Thessalonica; Gaius, from Derbe; Tychicus and Trophimus, from the province of Asia; and Timothy.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ, amaa yalim yi niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha.
en: Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, there is no way to make it salty again.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔ puuni jilima din galisi la zuɣu chɛ ka din gba daa mali jilima la jilima maa naai.
en: We may say that because of the far brighter glory now the glory that was so bright in the past is gone.

dag: N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔɣi bihi n-nabi pahi, ka n kul gbibi n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la.
en: I will turn my face to you, will make you fruitful and numerous, and will keep my covenant with you.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ zula biŋkɔbigu maa dilan sani, dindina di simdi ni o yo o zuɣu.
en: But if the animal was stolen, the person must make full payment to its owner.

dag: Jɛkɔnia so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shialtiɛl mini.
en: The family of Jeconiah the prisoner: Shealtiel his son.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa biŋkpam ni zugbini kpam ni kpam din pili namanama ni binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla.
en: Aarons sons also brought him the fat of the bull and the ram. They brought the fat tail, the fat covering the inner parts, the kidneys, and the fat part of the liver.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, a daa zo n kuŋa. A daa tiligi n nyɛvili.
en: My Lord! Plead my desperate case; redeem my life.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti liri Midiannim maa, dama n zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: That night, the Lord said to Gideon. Get up! Attack the Midianite camp. I am going to let you defeat them.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shihi o kɔbili min o niŋgbuŋ pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: Try striking Job's own body with pain, and he will curse you to your face.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka Judanim zaa daa kanna ti tir o pina. Ka o daa mali buni pam, ka niriba tir o jilima.
en: The LORD gave him firm control over the kingdom, and all Judah brought Jehoshaphat tribute, so that he had abundant riches and honor.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ninsalitab naani, ka zaŋ bɛ ninsalitab maa leei bɛ kpiɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri ka chɛ man Yawɛ la.
en: The Lord says, I will condemn those who turn away from me and put their trust in human beings, in the strength of mortals.

dag: Daadam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na be Izraɛl tiŋgban shɛŋa din bahi yoli la puuni na kul yɛrimi, Ibrahimma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yino, amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti o ni o su. Amaa tinim galisiya, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ zaŋla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti ni ti su li.
en: Mortal man, he said, the people who are living in the ruined cities of the land of Israel are saying: Abraham was only one man, and he was given the whole land. There are many of us, so now the land is ours.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ Ziɔn, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: David gave his permission, and Absalom went to Hebron.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N chɛ ka biisim ku yi bindira, ka chɛ ka toli saɣim yi puri mini yi tihi puri ni yi fiig tihi ni yi olivi tihi, di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: N ni zaŋ Ijiptinim niŋ na biɛɣu ŋun mali putɔɣu nuu ni ka o su ba. Man yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will hand the Egyptians over to a tyrant, to a cruel king who will rule them. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Man ŋuna, di pala m malila baŋsim gari sokam zuɣu ka Naawuni kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ma maa, amaa o niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka nyin naa baŋ zahindi maa gbinni mini tɛhi shɛŋa din daa ka a sanna maa gbinni.
en: God also told this secret to me, not because I have greater wisdom than other men, but so that you, king, may know what it means. In that way you will understand what went through your mind.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya, Yi ni niŋdi shɛli ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla dini.
en: When your children ask you, Why are we doing this ceremony.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ wurim kpe yɔɣu maa, bɛ leela mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa bindirigu.
en: Without a shepherd, my flock was scattered; and when it was scattered, it became food for all the wild animals.

dag: Bomiya yalim ti Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ka di ku yiɣi, dama di ni wurim; di fɔntinsi ni zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Give wings to Moab, and it would fly away because its towns lie in ruins, with no one left in them.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋ na nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka di sabi ni faashee Daadam Bia bahi di wahala balibu kam ka bɛ lan ʒiɛm o?.
en: Jesus answered: Elijah certainly will come to get everything ready. But don't the Scriptures also say that the Son of Man must suffer terribly and be rejected?.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa bahi yoli, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila kol pala ni.
