en: Also, no one ever pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would break them, and the wine would be ruined along with the wineskins. You always put new wine into new wineskins.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka n ti be yi sani ka yi muɣisi ma ni n wuhi dɔbilim, dama m mi ni n ni tooi wuhi n dɔbilim ni nyɛ shɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhiri ni ti dolila dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ka mal li kuuni la sani.
en: They think our motives for what we do are like those of the world. I plan to be very bold against those people when I come. I hope I will not need to use that same boldness with you.

dag: Ka Yisifu min o ba yiŋnim daa kul be Ijipti. Yisifu daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pia dunia yili ŋɔ.
en: Joseph continued to live in Egypt with his fathers family. He died when he was years old.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ nayil guliba kpɛm Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa la sani nti zaŋ yɛm yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣis o.
en: Arioch was the commander of the kings guards. He was going to kill the wise men of Babylon, but Daniel talked to him. Daniel spoke politely to Arioch.

dag: N ni daa kul tɛhiri ʒii maa yɛla saha shɛli, ka n daa nya malaika ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣina. O daa nyɛla ŋun niŋ shili gu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: In my mind, as I lay in bed, I saw another vision: A holy watcher came down from heaven.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, m baŋya ni ʒilinsi zuɣu ka yi mini yi kpamba daa niŋ Yisa lala maa.
en: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N shia kul ku kpalim be ninsal ni sahakam, o nyɛla ŋun ni kpi, ka o yuma ni nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi.
en: The LORD said, My breath will not remain in humans forever, because they are flesh. They will live one hundred twenty years.

dag: ka hal dɔro maa ni daa mali ma maa zaa yoli, di zuɣu daa bi chɛ ka yi zo ka chɛ ma, ka mi daa bi mali ma ansarisi n-ʒiɛm ma, amaa ka daa deei ma kaman Naawuni malaika bee kaman Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa.
en: But even though my physical condition was a great trial to you, you did not despise or reject me. Instead, you received me as you would an angel from heaven; you received me as you would Christ Jesus.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni zaŋ o piɛma to ba; bɛ ni nya dansi ka di libigi ba.
en: But God will shoot them with an arrow! Without warning, they will be wounded!.

dag: amaa Yawɛ suhu daa yuri yi yaannim ka pii yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ŋɔ zuliya kam sunsuuni kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But the LORD adored your ancestors, loving them and choosing the descendants that followed them—you!—from all other people. Thats how things still stand now.

dag: Jɛra noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-saɣindi ba, ka bɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛ zana din gbahiri bɛmaŋmaŋa.
en: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣisi mir o ba Yisahaku, ka o shih o ka yɛli, Kukoli ŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu kukoli, amaa nuhi ŋɔ nyɛla Iso nuhi.
en: Jacob moved closer to his father, who felt him and said, Your voice sounds like Jacob's voice, but your arms feel like Esau's arms.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: So the LORD raised up their foes against them, and stirred up their enemies.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnhur ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la.
en: The following are the names of these twelve officers and the districts they were in charge of: Benhur: the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ bia, ka di zuɣulaannim diri ka nyuri yuŋ hal ka biɛɣ ti neera; mbusim be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Too bad for you, land, whose king is a boy and whose princes feast in the morning.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zabiri zibigi. Di simdi ka bɛ wahiri bɛ zabiri.
en: Priests must neither shave their heads nor let their hair grow long. They are to keep it a proper length.

dag: Niriba ni daa nya Pool ni niŋ shɛm maa ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee kuhi yɛli pam Laikɔnia yɛligu ni, Ti buɣa n-leei ninsalinim ka ti sanna ŋɔ.
en: When the people saw what Paul did, they shouted in their own Lycaonian language. They said, The gods have come down to us in the form of humans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim ka niŋ ba alaka pam di yuuni maa ni. Yuun pisaayika ka bɛ daa nahim Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Amɔrinim tiŋgban shɛli din be Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: For eighteen years they oppressed and persecuted all the Israelites who lived in Amorite country east of the Jordan River in Gilead.

dag: So tuma yi ti kpalim be o ni zaŋ shɛli me n-tam duu gbinni tanzaa maa zuɣu, o ni deei di laara.
en: If what was built on the foundation survives the fire, the builder will receive a reward.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo n-chaŋ Gɛshur Naa Ammihud bia Talimai sani. Ka Naa Dauda daa kul kumd o bia Amnɔn zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: David was sad for a long time because Amnon was dead. Absalom had run away to Geshur, where he stayed for three years with King Talmai the son of Ammihud.

dag: Ka dilan yi yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim pɔi, ka a naanyi ŋmaag a ni bɔri shɛm tariga. O yɛrimi, Aai, ŋmaam ti ma pumpɔŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni zaŋ kiŋkansi ŋmaai li.
en: If the person answered, Let us do what is right and burn the fat first; then take what you want, the priest's servant would say, No! Give it to me now! If you don't, I will have to take it by force.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ biɛri ka yɛlibiɛri paara? Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri n-nyari ashaara?.
en: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa wurim ba nimaani n-kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka bɛ daa chɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu.
en: So the people had to stop building the city, because the Lord confused their language and scattered them all over the earth. That's how the city of Babel got its name.

dag: Bɛ ba n-daa wuhiri bɛ zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu biŋkumda din daa nyɛ: guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisanim mini mɔɣilɔnim ni goonjɛnima Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm. Naa n-daa wuhiri Asaf mini Jɛdutun ni Hɛman bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: They were all under their fathers direction when singing in the LORDs temple with cymbals, harps, and lyres to provide service in Gods temple, by order of the king. As for Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti leei bukpahinima. Di ti bɔnya bɛ shee din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ya daɣiri ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not go to mediums or wizards for advice—they will only make you unclean. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Yinim Galɛshianim bɛn tum jɛrilim ŋɔ, timalaan ŋuni n-lee birim ya? Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yɛla daa kahigi wuhi palɔni yimaŋmaŋ ninni.
en: You people in Galatia are so foolish! Why do I say this? Because I told you very clearly about the death of Jesus Christ on the cross. But now it seems as though you have let someone use their magical powers to make you forget.

dag: N ni dɔni gbihi ni suhudoo; dama nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-chɛ ka n dooni ni alaafee.
en: When I lie down, I go to sleep in peace; you alone, O Lord , keep me perfectly safe.

dag: , m-pahi tin shɛŋa din daa be Avim zaŋ lab nudirigu polo.
en: as well as all the territory of the Avvim to the south.

dag: ka bi lan tuɣi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la. Masia kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ mi zaa nyari dihili ka kpɛri n-saɣisiri tab ni di tuɣa mini di jila ni, ka zoori kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni di zoori shɛm.
en: They dont stay connected to the head. The head nourishes and supports the whole body through the joints and ligaments, so the body grows with a growth that is from God.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn ku wum a yɛligu, dama bɛ bi bɔri ni bɛ wum n yɛligu maa; Izraɛlnim zaa ni nyɛ bɛn suhuri kpɛma mini tipawumlinim zuɣu.
en: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi ma ŋɔ? Ka bɛ zaa daa chihi ti tuui taba, ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, niriba maa m-muɣi pam daar a.
en: Who touched me? Jesus asked. When everyone denied it, Peter said, Master, the crowds are surrounding you and pressing in on you.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi wumbu. Ka o ni daa mali yaa gari Tama maa zuɣu, ka o zaŋ kpeengarigu dɔn o.
en: But Amnon refused to listen to her. He was stronger than she was, and so he raped her.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi lan wuhimiy o yi yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: So I encourage you to show your love for this person.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ti laɣim o tɔbbihi m-pahi nanim pihitanaayi bɛn ʒe o nyaaŋa ni bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi n-kana ti liri Samarianima n-teei gili ba ni bɛ tuhi ba.
en: King Ben-hadad of Aram brought together all his army along with thirty-two kings plus horses and chariots. He went up, surrounded Samaria, and made war against it.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, bɔhim Naawuni nya ti ni di nasara ti chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: Please talk to God for us, the men said. Ask God if we will be successful in what we are trying to do.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zahim laɣ shɛli tibisim sania zuɣu n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa fukumsi ni bɛ mal li yɔri kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim bɛn tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Itai, Dindina garim ka ti chaŋ. Di saha ka Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir maa min o niriba zaa ni bibihi bɛn daa be o sani zaa gari tooni.
en: Then come on! David said. So Ittai and all his men and their families walked on past David.

dag: Di saha gom daa wum Pita min o tab la pam, amaa ka bɛ lee ne n-ʒiya, ka daa ti nya Yisa jilima ni niriba ayi bɛn daa ʒe o sani maa.
en: Peter and the other two disciples had been sound asleep. All at once they woke up and saw how glorious Jesus was. They also saw the two men who were with him.

dag: ka bantabiga din daa vili Yisa zuɣu la gba kpabikpabi do di ko ha ka chɛ bimpiɛlli maa.
en: He also saw the piece of cloth that had been used to cover Jesus' face. It was rolled up and in a place by itself.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa ti lan lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Dauda daa pah o tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti tuhi hal ka di ti gbarigi Dauda.
en: The Philistines started another war with Israel. David and his men went out to fight the Philistines, but David became very tired and weak.

dag: Timiya ba jilima, ka yuri ba pam bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛli maa zuɣu; ka maliya suhudoo ni taba.
en: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.

dag: Bɛ zaa gbibila takɔbiri, bɛ nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ takɔbiri maa baɣi bɛ gbalipina; bɛ malila shili gu yuŋ bimbiɛri.
en: All of them are skillful with the sword; they are battle-hardened veterans. Each of them is armed with a sword, on guard against a night attack.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya maa tin shɛli ni.
en: Slaughter the Passover animals at the one place of worship—and nowhere else in the land that the Lord your God will give you. Do it at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.

dag: Yidaampaɣ zinalana ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka a mini saamba n-doona ka chɛ a yidana.
en: You are nothing but an unfaithful wife who would rather have sex with strangers than with your own husband.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ m bɔri ni n teei ya n ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya la. Yi daa dee li ka ʒe di ni.
en: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.

dag: A mi ti yaannim ni daa kuli Ijipti, ka ti be nimaani yuui pam, ka Ijiptinim maa daa nahim ti mini ti yaannim maa pam shɛm la yɛla.
en: Many years ago our ancestors went down into Egypt, and we lived there for many years. The people of Egypt were cruel to us.

dag: Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun chɛ ka Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: Because of his stubbornness, Pharaoh refused to let the Israelites go, just as the LORD had told Moses.

dag: Kɔhigɔriba bɛn be niriba maa ni ni mal a ansarisi. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie, ka a ku lan beni yaha.
en: The merchants in other nations whistle about you. What happened to you will frighten people, because you were destroyed. You are gone forever.

dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda wunsuhigunim tariga m-bala.
en: The prayers of David, Jesses son, are ended.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ya dabitim bandi ni.
en: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla mini Yisa so ŋun daa kpi ka Pool yɛli ni o ne la yɛla tɔɣisi.
en: Their charges were all about their own religion and about a man named Jesus. Jesus died, but Paul said that he is still alive.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi nabi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi galisim ŋmanila saŋmarisi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

dag: ka zaŋ gbana lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka vili baŋtab viɛla, bɛ zaa daa ŋmanila sapashinnima. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔnnima bɛn daa nyɛ Kalidia tiŋbihi la.
en: They wore belts around their waists and long turbans on their heads. All those men looked like chariot officers. They all looked like native-born Babylonian men.

dag: Di saha ka n ni chaŋ nyin Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la gbini, luɣ shɛli din nyɛ nyin Naawuni ŋun tiri ma suhupiɛlli pam ŋɔ sani la; ka ŋme m mɔɣilo paɣi nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A tuhi tɔbu pam, ka ku niriba pam, di bi simdi ka a me jɛmbu duu n-ti ma jilima, dama a ku niriba pam dunia ŋɔ ni n ninni.
en: But the LORD told me: Youve shed much blood and waged great wars. You wont build a temple for my name because youve spilled so much blood on the ground before me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lo noli n-jɛmdi ti Duuma ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛli ba, Piimiya Baanabas mini Sool ti ma, ka n chɛ ka bɛ tum n ni yɛn ti ba tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: These men were all serving the Lord and fasting when the Holy Spirit said to them, Appoint Barnabas and Saul to do a special work for me. They are the ones I have chosen to do it.

dag: Jɛramiil daa lan mali paɣ so ka o yuli booni Atara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Onam ma.
en: Ram had three sons: Maaz, Jamin, and Eker. Jerahmeel had another wife, a woman named Atarah, and they had a son, Onam.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni o ni ku ba, ka Musa ŋun nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahindili daa zan o tooni n-taɣ o ni o maag o suhu; ka o ku ku ba.
en: When God said that he would destroy his people, his chosen servant, Moses, stood up against God and kept his anger from destroying them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o zuli n-vooi saŋmarisi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim zuɣu bahi dunia ni; ka daa chaŋ ti ʒe paɣ so ŋun yɛn dɔɣi maa tooni ni o ti dɔɣi ka o di bia maa nyɛvili.
en: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.

dag: Dama lala ni chɛ ka yi bihi maa chɛ ma dolibu ka jɛmdi binnana, di saha Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kun ya yomyom.
en: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord . That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.

dag: Niriba tusatusa m-be Saria Karibu Vinvamli maa ni. Dama Yawɛ dabisili la miriya Saria Karibu Vinvamli la ni.
en: Thousands and thousands are in the Valley of Judgment. It is there that the day of the Lord will soon come.

dag: Ka ya polo ka n lee yɛn zaŋ vi ŋɔ kpe? Ka sokam ni bol a jɛrigu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu jaande, yɛlim naa, o ni zaŋ ma ti a.
en: I would never get rid of my shame, and people would think that you are just a common criminal. Please, talk with the king. He will let you marry me.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuma ayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa kana ti ʒini n tooni ni bɛ bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ binshɛli.
en: In the seventh year, on the tenth day of the fifth month, some of Israels elders came to inquire of the LORD. As they were sitting with me.

dag: Amaa Abija ŋun yaa daa kul kirisimi. O daa kpuɣila paɣiba pinaanahi n-dɔɣi bidibisi pisinaayi mini bipuɣinsi pinaayɔbu.
en: Abijah, however, grew more powerful. He had fourteen wives and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa, ka niriba maa kpalim zani ka bi lan kariti doli Izraɛlnim maa bee n-lan tuhiri ba.
en: Joab blew the trumpet, and all the soldiers stopped. They didnt pursue Israel anymore, nor did they continue to fight.

dag: Chɛl niriba ŋɔ taali a yurilim din galisi la min a ni daa pun chɛ bɛ taali Ijipti zaŋ na hal ni pumpɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: Now, show your great love to these people. Forgive their sin. Forgive them the same way you have been forgiving them since the time they left Egypt until now.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N niriba m-bala, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku yɔhim ma. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba.
en: The Lord said, They are my people; they will not deceive me. And so he saved them.

dag: dama bɛ tɛha zaa nyɛla duŋtaabo, ka bɛ noya tɔɣisiri barina yɛtɔɣa.
en: Causing trouble is all they ever think about; every time they open their mouth someone is going to be hurt.

dag: O daa zaŋla dabipaɣiba ayi maa mini bɛ bihi bahi tooni, ka chɛ ka Liya min o bihi paya, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl mini Yisifu be nyaaŋa.
en: Jacob put the maids with their children first. Then he put Leah and her children behind them, and he put Rachel and Joseph in the last place.

dag: Sapashini maa ni daa wum Pool ni yɛli shɛm maa ka o chaŋ ti bɔhi sapashin kpɛm la, Tuun bɔ ka a lee yɛn tum ŋɔ? Doo maa nyɛla Rom tiŋbia.
en: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and reported it. He asked, What are you about to do? This man is a Roman citizen.

dag: Naftali zuliya tintariga wulimpuhili polo zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, Manaasa zuliya ni su tiŋgban yini.
en: Along the boundary of Naphtali from the eastern border to the western border: Manasseh, one portion.

dag: Lom mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ alikauli ni a ni gbib ma viɛnyɛliŋga. Di chɛ ka karimbaannim nahim ma.
en: Promise to be good to me, your servant. Dont let those proud people do harm to me.

dag: Hashum daŋ ni: Matɛnai mini Matata ni Zabad so mi ni Ɛlifɛlɛt ni Jɛrɛmai ni Manaasa so mi ni Shimɛi.
en: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;.

dag: Ka Keen daa yi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti be tiŋgban shɛli din be Idɛn puu la wulimpuhili polo, ka di yuli booni Nɔd la.
en: And Cain went away from the Lord 's presence and lived in a land called Wandering, which is east of Eden.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa dɔɣi Lamɛk maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiniinaayi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and then lived another years. He had other children.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti zaŋ anzinfa mali wuni pahi n zuɣu bee n-zaŋ salima mali wuni zali yi sani.
en: So you must never make idols of silver or gold to worship in place of me.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba la sani ti yɛl o, Di ku baŋdiba maa. Zaŋm ma tahi naa sani ka n ti wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: So Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had commanded to execute the royal advisers. He said to him, Don't put them to death. Take me to the king, and I will tell him what his dream means.

dag: Di saha ka bia maa tizɔpaɣ maa daa bɔhi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa, N cham ti boli Hiburu paɣ so ŋun mali bihim na ka o ti mɔɣis a bia maa bihim ti a.
en: The babys sister was still hiding. She stood and asked the kings daughter, Do you want me to go find a Hebrew woman who can nurse the baby and help you care for it.

dag: Di saha ka Ijiptinim zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. A ni daa leei kariŋmaaŋa jaaŋgbee Izraɛlnim sani maa zuɣu.
en: Then all the people living in Egypt will know that I am the Lord ! Why will I do these things? Because the people of Israel leaned on Egypt for support, but Egypt was only a weak blade of grass.

dag: O lan ka kpe; o neei kum ni kaman o ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kamiyana ti nya o ni daa do luɣ shɛli.
en: He isn't here! God has raised him to life, just as Jesus said he would. Come, see the place where his body was lying.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim shɛb bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: Then some Sadducees, who say that people will not rise from death, came to Jesus and said.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a kpuɣim a bindoo chaŋ maa.
en: They asked him, Who is the man who told you to pick up your mat and walk.

dag: Dama o ni ti ti sokam o tuma ni simdi shɛli:.
en: For God will reward each of us according to what we have done.

dag: Ka bia maa yɛl o, A tizɔbil la n-kuna, ka a ba chɛ ka ti kɔrigi naɣila kpabili, o ni labina ni alaafee maa zuɣu.
en: The boy said, Your brother has come back, and your father killed the best calf to eat. He is happy because he has his son back safe and sound.

dag: Bɛ kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbani maa ti, ka sana daa bi gari bɛ ni.
en: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.

dag: Ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Paɣ ŋɔ n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm a bidibiga ŋɔ ka ti duɣi ŋubi zuŋɔ; ka sa zaŋ m mi bidibiga duɣi ŋubi biɛɣuni.
en: Then he asked, What's the matter anyway? The woman answered, Another woman and I were so hungry that we agreed to eat our sons. She said if we ate my son one day, we could eat hers the next day.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nabia la leei Sulemaana dima n-yiɣisi lu o zuɣu.
en: Hadad was from the royal family of Edom, and here is how the Lord made him Solomon's enemy:.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Jabɛshi bia Shallum daa di nam maa. O mi daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la gol yini Samaria.
en: Shallum son of Jabesh became king of Israel during the th year that Uzziah was king of Judah. Shallum ruled for one month in Samaria.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi ni Hazɔr ni Itinan.
en: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri pali ninvuɣ biɛtali balibu kam. Dina n-nyɛ: Tuumbiɛri mini bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni biɛr biɛɣu ni nyuli ni ninvuɣ kubo ni naŋgbankpeeni ni yɔhiŋ ni jɛlinsi. Bɛ nyɛla munaafichinim mini.
en: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni nya suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli maa paai ma la n sɔŋsim zuɣu. A tiligi n nyɛvili barina kam ni; ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: Look, my troubles are gone! I now have peace. You love me very much. You did not let me rot in the grave. You took my sins and threw them away.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yiɣisim taŋkpaɣu ni n-dam amaŋa. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yihim mii din be a nyiŋgol ni bahi.
en: Jerusalem, get up and shake off the dust! Daughter Zion, you were a prisoner, but take the chains off your neck.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka bɛ daa to jina bɔri so shɛli bɛ yɛn doli ku o.
en: That day the Jewish leaders began planning to kill Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ, a nirilim niŋbu puuni, ka a daa ba ma zali kaman zo shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ la; a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma, ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam.
en: You, Lord , were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ti tooi biŋkuma sara maligu maa zim viɛlli nukurigu pali mini di kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim din be biŋkuma sara maligu maa ni nti nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu n-yihi di chihili maa, ka di leei din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Amaa n kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o mi ni tiligi ma.
en: I will call to God for help, and the Lord will save me.

dag: Ilaija ni daa wum li saha shɛli, o daa zaŋla o binyɛrigu pɔb o nina yi nti ʒe vokabili maa dunol ni. Nyama, ka kukoli maa daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: When Elijah heard it, he wrapped his face in his coat. He went out and stood at the caves entrance. A voice came to him and said, Why are you here, Elijah.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni boli shɛb bɛn sani, bɛ yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, Masia yɛla nyɛla Naawuni yiko min o yɛm.
en: But Christ is Gods power and wisdom to the people God has chosen, both Jews and Greeks.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa vuɣi li ni suhuyiɣisili n-daai li luhi tiŋa. Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim daa ʒe li ka di kuui. Ka di wala zaa daa suui, ka di mundili din mali yaa la daa kuui, ka buɣim di li.
en: So she was struck down in anger, thrown down to the ground. The east wind dried her out and destroyed her fruit; it sapped the branch of its strength, and fire consumed it.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: The next section of walls was repaired by the priests who lived in that area.

dag: Mɔab Naa Mɛsha daa wumsirila piɛri, ka di daa kpala talahi ni o tahiri piɛbihi polo tuhi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi tuhi kɔbiga kɔbiri yuuni kam nti tiri Izraɛl naa.
en: Mesha was the king of Moab. He owned many sheep. He gave the wool of , lambs and , rams to the king of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka bɛ baŋ o nasara dibu yɛla. O kahig o tiliginsim yiko wuhi zuliya kam.
en: The Lord announced his victory; he made his saving power known to the nations.

dag: Amalɛknim mini Keenannim ni gunya soli n-zaŋ takɔbiri kun ya; yi ni chɛ Yawɛ dolibu maa zuɣu, Yawɛ ku be yi sani.
en: The Amalekites and Canaanites will fight against you there. You have turned away from the Lord , so he will not be with you when you fight them. And you will all be killed in battle.

dag: Yihim ma n suhuyubu alahichi tumbu ni; ka di chɛ ka di su ma. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n ku mali galimi, ka yi taali din galisi pam ni.
en: Dont let me do what I know is wrong. Dont let sin control me. If you help me, I can be pure and free from sin.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim Aduna bidibisi mini Lɛvi bidibisi na.
en: David also gathered Aarons family and the Levites.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-mali sara ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla taali sanyoo sara maligu.
en: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.

dag: Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma yomyom! Leemi n ni sɔɣiri tampin shɛli gbini mini birini shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ din ni tiligi ma.
en: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri, di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; dama momaha niŋ mɔɣu ni; ka tihi wali, ka fiig tihi mini wain tihi wali pam.
en: Animals of the field, dont be afraid. The desert pastures will grow grass. The trees will grow fruit. The fig trees and the vines will grow plenty of fruit.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanima, yilimiya yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya yila paɣi ti Duuma.
en: Sing to God, kingdoms of the world, sing praise to the Lord.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zali pateesa shɛli din yili Alikauli Adaka tooni la mi tooni. Alikauli Adaka maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuh a.
en: Put this altar outside the curtain which hangs in front of the Covenant Box. That is the place where I will meet you.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa ka bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ti cham ba takɔbiri.
en: When Jesus' disciples saw what was about to happen, they asked, Lord, should we attack them with a sword.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni laɣim a mamanim maa zaa, a mini bɛn diri nyaɣisim maa, a ni daa yuri shɛb zaa min a ni daa je shɛb la zaa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi luɣilikam laɣimna ti lir a, ka m pirig a a zaɣim wuhi ba, ka bɛ nya a zaɣim zaa.
en: Because of this I will bring all your former lovers together—the ones you liked and the ones you hated. I will bring them around you in a circle, and then I will strip off your clothes and let them see you naked.

dag: Asa mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: All during the time that Baasha ruled over Israel, he was fighting wars against King Asa of Judah.

dag: n-yi nimaani n-zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Ka Mikimɛtat daa be bɛ nuzaa polo; ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili daa zaŋ chaŋ wulimpuhili polo ha nti ŋmaligi kpa Taanatishilo polo n-chaŋ ti gari di zuɣu wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Janɔa.
en: The border goes to the sea. Michmethath is on the north. The border turns east of Taanath-shiloh and passes along beyond it east of Janoah.

dag: O bi labir o nini kpaŋ ka chɛri wuntizɔriba, amaa o zaŋdi ba mi ʒiini bɛ nanim sani bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi, ka niriba duhiri ba sahakam.
en: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.

dag: Kum chɛ ka ti niŋgbuna biimi kaman duduhugu puuni la.
en: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.

dag: Ka biɛrisuntal maŋa din nyɛ Masia kɔŋko ni tiri shɛl la kpe m-pali yi bebu ni zaa Naawuni tibigibu min o paɣibu zuɣu.
en: Your lives will be filled with the truly good qualities which only Jesus Christ can produce, for the glory and praise of God.

dag: Amaa ti daa bi chaŋ miri Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni zaŋ tabili Jabok kulibɔŋ dul la mini fɔntin shɛli din daa be zoya tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: But you did not go near the land that belongs to the people of Ammon. You did not go near the shores of the Jabbok River or the cities of the hill country. You did not go near any place that the Lord our God would not let us have.

dag: Yawɛ, wula ka a yɛn niŋ ba? Chɛ ka bɛ paɣiba zaŋdi bahira, ka bɛ biha nyuui.
en: Lord , give them what you will. Give them a womb that loses babies and breasts that cannot give milk.

dag: M mi daa bi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti nya Masia tuun shɛb bɛn daa be n tooni la, amaa ka daa naɣ chaŋla Areebia. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti yi nimaani n-lan lab Damaskus.
en: I didnt go up to Jerusalem to see the men who were apostles before me either, but I went away into Arabia and I returned again to Damascus.

dag: m-mali maligu zaŋ li nyo buɣim, ka zaŋ chi mali maligu di zuɣu; ka booi binnyura mali sara di zuɣu; ka lan kɔrig o suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu n-yih o ʒim bahi bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: so he burned animal sacrifices and grain offerings on it and poured a wine offering and the blood of a fellowship offering on it.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa deei da shɛŋa o ni daa bo ni o ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ʒil o bia Yisahaku; ka omaŋmaŋ mi kpuɣi buɣim mini sua n-gbib o nuu ni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli tab chana.
en: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along.

dag: Kul doliya zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka ti ʒini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you.

dag: Yi yi kpe kom puuni ni yi gari, n ni be yi sani, ka yi yi siɣila mɔɣa ni, di ku niŋ ya shɛli. Ka yi yi kpɛla buɣim ni, di ku din ya; di buɣim niɛm ku tooi din ya.
en: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; when through the rivers, they wont sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you wont be scorched and flame wont burn you.

dag: Dindina wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yi lo ni yi chaŋla Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani.
en: People of Judah, you survived when the Babylonian army attacked. Now you are planning to move to Egypt, and if you do go, this is what will happen.

dag: Yawɛ m-paɣir a, dama nyini n-yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka chɛ ka n dimnim bi di dari niŋ ma.
en: I will praise you, Lord ! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.

dag: Chi ni ti pali kaburi bɔɣa ni; ka wain mini kpam ti pali di tɔɣibu bɔɣa ni hal ti puuri bahira.
en: The threshing floors will be filled with wheat, and the barrels will overflow with wine and olive oil.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi dii pali ma, ka n nya ka nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni ka so ʒi nimaani.
en: Immediately the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven was a throne with someone sitting on it.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka kpaŋsir o bɔɣiri n-tumdi kpiɔŋ tuma.
en: She works very hard. She is strong and able to do all her work.

dag: Chɛ ka n naba yaabu doli soli ka n chani kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka di chɛ ka tuumbiɛri nyaŋ ma.
en: Guide me, as you promised. Dont let evil rule over me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a zuɣu n ni tooi nyaŋ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ. N Naawuni zuɣu, n ni tooi kpahi yaɣi gooni.
en: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.

dag: Dama o daa lab mɛla o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim buɣa jɛmbu shee luɣ shɛŋa la zaa, ka me maligu bimbina zali Baalnima, ka lan lab me Ashɛranim ŋmahima zali, ka daa gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi saŋmarisi zaa.
en: Manasseh rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had broken down. Manasseh built altars for the Baal gods and made Asherah poles. He bowed down to the constellations and worshiped those groups of stars.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ku yi Kalidianim maa nuu ni; amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag o ti Babilɔn Naa, ka o min o nina pali taba, ka bɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa garigi taba.
en: and King Zedekiah will not escape. He will be handed over to the king of Babylonia; he will see him face-to-face and will speak to him in person.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti duhi do so ŋun yuli booni Haman n-zaŋ o leei zuɣulaampaa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: After these things happened, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite. The king promoted Haman and gave him a place of honor more important than any of the other leaders.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham miri ha ti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a shɛm zaa, ka ti wum ka niŋ li.
en: You go and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then tell us all that the LORD our God speaks to you. Well listen and well do it.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Sagbana yi ti mɔhi zaawun mahili, yi yɛrimi ni di sa ni neei biɛɣu ni.
en: Jesus answered, When you people see the sunset, you know what the weather will be. If the sky is red, you say we will have good weather.

dag: Dinzuɣu doli ninvuɣ suma soli, ka doli wuntizɔriba soli.
en: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.

dag: Ka dim maa daa yɛli, N ni kari gbahi ba; n ni di bɛ nɛma, ka zaŋ n ni bɔri shɛlikam. N ni zaŋ n nuu ŋooi takɔbi n-ku ba.
en: Your enemies boasted that they would pursue and capture us, divide up our possessions, treat us as they wished, then take out their swords and kill us right there.

dag: Sool daa bela Gibia tintariga pumpɔrinchihi tia din be Migirɔn la gbini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: Saul was sitting under a pomegranate tree at the threshing floor at the edge of the hill. Saul had about men with him.

dag: Shɛkania bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya. Ka Shɛmaya bidibisi daa nyɛ Hatush mini Igal ni Baria ni Niaria ni Shafat, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayɔbu.
en: Shecaniah had one son, Shemaiah, and five grandsons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai naa maa n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn naa sani Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka o ti di o saria.
en: Zedekiah was taken to King Nebuchadnezzar, who was in the city of Riblah in the territory of Hamath, and there Nebuchadnezzar passed sentence on him.

dag: Yɛndana niŋdila binshɛɣukam ni yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun wuhirila jɛrilim palo ni.
en: The prudent all act intelligently, but fools display their stupidity.

dag: Di saha ka n daa galim Judanim zuɣulaannim la, ka bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tumdi Vuhim Dabisili dali n-tari li daɣiri maa?.
en: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni nini daa tiɣi kurimbuni ha niriba.
en: God was pleased with the people who lived a long time ago because they had faith like this.

dag: Hal yi ni kul zaŋ bɔchaa mini chibo pam paɣi yimaŋ maa zaa yoli, man sani yi taali maa na kul beni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa niŋ buɣim dab li; ka zaŋ ba bahi ka bɛ zo nti kpe Filistianim kawana ni. Ka buɣim maa taai bɛ kawaan puri maa n-di bɛ ni pun ŋahi luɣ shɛŋa mini bɛ ni na bi ŋahi shɛŋa n-tabili bɛ olivi tihi puri.
en: He lit the torches and released the foxes into the Philistines grain fields. So he burned the stacked grain, standing grain, vineyards, and olive orchards.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yɛhudianim chu shɛli daa ti yɛn puhi, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti timanim gba daa tum bɛ tabibi tuma n-gba daa niŋ lala. Ka di daa kpaŋsi Firawuna suhu, ka o daa bi wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: But the Egyptian magicians used their secret powers to do the same thing. The king did just as the Lord had said—he stubbornly refused to listen.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Galili do so ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la gba daa ti yiɣisi daadam biɛligu yuya sabbu saha la n-laɣim niriba pah omaŋ zuɣu, amaa o gba ni daa ti kani, bɛn dol o maa zaa daa wurimmi.
en: Afterward, at the time of the census, Judas the Galilean appeared and got some people to follow him in a revolt. He was killed too, and all his followers scattered far and wide.

dag: Chɛ ka n gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti nya zoya ni tiŋgban viɛlli din be duli maa mini Lɛbanɔn.
en: Let me cross the Jordan River, Lord , and see the fertile land on the other side, the beautiful hill country and the Lebanon Mountains.

dag: Naawuni, ninʒeensinim yiɣisi lu n zuɣu; ninkuunsinim laɣimya m-bɔri ni bɛ yihi n nyɛvili, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi lihi nya a.
en: Proud people are coming against me, O God; a cruel gang is trying to kill me— people who pay no attention to you.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba maa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa.
en: The people from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh answered the eleven men. They said.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa lahibali moli gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini tin shɛŋa din gili nimaani zaa.
en: This news about Jesus spread all over Judea and to all the other places around there.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda mabia Shamma dapala Jɔnadab daa yɛli, N dana, di tɛhi ni bɛ ku nabihi maa zaa, Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi. Absalom n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla o ni pun lo shɛli dahin shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔn o tizɔpaɣa Tama la zuɣu.
en: But then Jonadab, the son of Davids brother Shimeah, said, Dont think that all the kings sons were killed! Only Amnon is dead. Absalom has been planning this from the day that Amnon raped his sister Tamar.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ ti Lɛvi bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka nyɛ bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: Then Moses wrote this Book of Teachings and gave it to the priests, who are from the tribe of Levi. They have the work of carrying the Lord s Box of the Agreement. Moses also gave it to all the elders of Israel.

dag: Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la n-daa su tɔbbihi Fukumsi, ka Jɛhɔshafat Ahilud bia la daa nyɛ ŋun sabiri gbana sɔŋda.
en: Abishai's brother Joab was commander of the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was in charge of the records;.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa gbaala o binyɛra n-dari tɔhi, ka zaŋ buɣu ye, ka lo noli. O daa kul yɛrila buɣu maa doona, ka chani gindi ni nandahima.
en: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes and put mourning clothes on his body. He fasted, even slept in mourning clothes, and walked around depressed.

dag: Ka Makiri bia Giliad ŋun daa nyɛ Yisifu bia Manaasa yaaŋa la daŋ puuni dunoya dɔɣirikpamba daa ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim dunoya dɔɣirikpamba sanna.
en: The leaders of the households of the clans of Gilead, Machirs son and Manassehs grandson, of Josephs clans, approached and spoke before Moses and the chiefs, who were the leaders of the Israelite households.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka di niŋdiya shɛli bɛ nini yi beni zuɣu ni bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiya lala ni suhu yini Naawuni zɔbu zuɣu.
en: Slaves, obey your masters on earth in everything. Dont just obey like people pleasers when they are watching. Instead, obey with the single motivation of fearing the Lord.

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi la zaa ni firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu tuma nɛma zaa ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini la.
en: Pour the oil on the table and on all the dishes on the table. And pour this oil on the lamp and on all its tools. Pour the oil on the incense altar.

dag: Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a yɛla tɔɣisi m mabihi maa; n ni paɣ a salo laɣiŋgu ni.
en: He says to God, I will tell my people what you have done; I will praise you in their meeting.

dag: Bihim ka n daa mali dihiri ya, pa saɣim; dama yi daa naan na kul ku tooi di li; hal ka na kul tooi di li pumpɔŋɔ gba.
en: I gave you milk to drink instead of solid food, because you werent up to it yet.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrimia Libina nir bia ka o yuli booni Hamutal.
en: Jehoahaz was years old when he became king, and he ruled for three months in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hamutal; she was Jeremiahs daughter and was from Libnah.

dag: Ka Pita garigi yɛli ba, Niŋmiya tuuba ka deeya kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yul ni, ka Naawuni chɛ yi daalahichi paŋ ya, ka yi deeg o Shia Kasi ŋun nyɛ pin la.
en: Peter said to them, Each one of you must turn away from your sins and be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, so that your sins will be forgiven; and you will receive God's gift, the Holy Spirit.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a liɣiri paŋ o ka bɔri ni a niŋ nyɔri bee n-kɔhi bindirigu ti o ka niŋ nyɔri.
en: Do not lend a poor Israelite money with interest or lend food at a profit.

dag: Hal o ni daa ti ti wahala maa zaa yoli, o ni zo ti nambɔɣu, o yurilim maŋli din galisi pam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: He may bring us sorrow, but his love for us is sure and strong.

dag: A gba ni ti nyu dam kuli, a ni ti zo n-sɔɣi. A ni ti bɔri sɔɣisili shee a dim sani.
en: Nineveh, you too will fall into a drunken stupor! You too will try to escape from your enemies.

dag: Dindali maa, Izraɛlnim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka kɔɣisi yi fini zaa.
en: On that day, Jacobs glory will dwindle; his sleek body will waste away.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa ti paana yɛli naa, Bɛ zaa mal alaafee, Ka silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je nyini n dan naa niŋ ti nuu ni ŋɔ simdi paɣibu.
en: Ahimaaz called out, We won! We won! Then he bowed low to David and said, Your Majesty, praise the Lord your God! He has given you victory over your enemies.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu, N lo nia ni n kpihim ninsalinim zaa birili, dama bɛna n-chɛ ka tuumbiɛri pali dunia ŋɔ ni. Nyama, n ni kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: God said to Noah, The end has come for all creatures, since they have filled the earth with violence. I am now about to destroy them along with the earth.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa kum niŋ o bɛ daamiliya chuɣu daba ayopɔin maa ni zaa. Ka paɣ maa daa muɣisi Samsin hal ka o ti bahi wuh o ŋahili maa gbinni di daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti yɛl o niriba maa.
en: But she cried on his shoulder for the rest of the seven days of the feast. Finally, on the seventh day, he told her the answer, for she had nagged him. And she told her people the answer to the riddle.

dag: Bɛ malila shili n-kariti doli ma, ka di pala n taali zuɣu. Yiɣisim kana ti sɔŋ ma ka nya.
en: I have done nothing wrong, but they are rushing to attack me. Come and see for yourself!.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kummiya ka fabili dabisili maa zuɣu.
en: Human one, prophesy and say, The LORD God proclaims: Howl! Horror for the day!.

dag: Zɛbadia mini Arad ni Ɛda.
en: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder.

dag: O daa wuhi ba: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli n dan Iso shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A dabili Yaakubu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N daa chaŋ ti bela Leeban sani hal ti paai pumpɔŋɔ.
en: He instructed them to say: I, Jacob, your obedient servant, report to my master Esau that I have been staying with Laban and that I have delayed my return until now.

dag: ka zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be Alikauli Adaka maa luɣa ni la ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: and put them through the rings on each side of the Box.

dag: ka maligumaana maa lan lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali. O yi lihi nya ka dɔro maa bi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, dindina ŋun lan zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: If the disease hasn't spread by that time, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Yinim Yaakubu zuliya zuɣulaannima ni yinim Izraɛl nanim ŋɔ, wummiya! Pa yinima n-di simdi ni yi mi zaligu ni wuhi ni shɛli tuhiya?.
en: Then I said, Listen, leaders of Jacob and officers of the nation of Israel! You should know what justice is.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka suhugarigu mini suhusaɣiŋgu daa gbaag o pam.
en: Jesus took along Peter, James, and John. He was sad and troubled and.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisima m-bu ba kaman chi la, dama n ni chɛ ka a yiligu leei kurigu, ka chɛ ka a takarifiɛma leei daanya, ka a ti bu n-chɛrisi niriba pam, ka zaŋ bɛ nyamma ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ bɛ daazichi ti dunia zaa Duuma.
en: Arise and thresh, Daughter Zion, for I will make your horn out of iron; your hooves I will make out of bronze. You will crush many peoples; you will dedicate their ill-gotten gains to the LORD, their wealth to the LORD of all the earth.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, Alikauli shɛli din be m mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni la shihirili m-bala.
en: God said to Noah, This is the symbol of the covenant that I have set up between me and all creatures on earth.

dag: Mbaye tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu!.
en: Land, land, land of Judah! Listen to this message from the Lord !.

dag: Sabimi binshɛŋa a nini ni nya maa: Binshɛŋa din be mini binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: So write down what you have seen, both the scene now before you and the things that are about to unfold after this.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: A ni suhi ma yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah: The Lord , the God of Israel, says, You prayed to me about the message that came from King Sennacherib of Assyria. I have heard you. .

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum ka o tɔɣisiri ba Hiburuli ni maa ka bɛ maan fo baalim; di saha ka o yɛli.
en: When they heard him address them in Aramaic, they became even more quiet.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Maika yiŋ maa chaŋ ha, ka Maika daa kuhi bol o ʒiʒiinitaba n-chɛ ka bɛ pah o zuɣu ka bɛ kari Dan zuliya niriba maa naba.
en: The men from the tribe of Dan went a long way from that place. But the people living near Micah met together. Then they began chasing the men of Dan and caught up with them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yihi salima nɛma din be bɛ ni zaa Sinai Zoli gbini, ka bi lan zaŋ li niŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry.

dag: N yi yihi ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa na, n ni ti deei ya kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl la, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira yi sani yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa ninni.
en: When I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you are scattered, I will accept you as a pleasing aroma. Through you I will be made holy in the sight of the nations.

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli niriba maa zaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa ti o ka tim o ni o ti yɛli ba la naai.
en: When Jeremiah finished telling the people all the words of the LORD their God—he didnt omit anything the LORD sent him to convey.

dag: M bɔri ni dɔbba bɛn be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kpuɣiri bɛ nuhi din be kasi zuɣusaa n-suhiri Naawuni, ka sujee bee naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ka di puuni.
en: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni dɔɣirikpamba, yi mini yi mabihi zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-yi daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ti zali luɣ shɛli n ni mali ni n zaŋ li zal la.
en: David said to them, You are the leaders from the tribe of Levi. You and the other Levites must make yourselves holy. Then bring the Holy Box of the Lord , the God of Israel, to the place I have made for it.

dag: ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ŋuna n-kul yɛn wuhiri ti soli sahakam.
en: This is God, our God, forever and always! He is the one who will lead us even to the very end.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn su n yili ŋɔ fukumsi, ka a yi kul yɛli shɛlikam, n niriba zaa ni niŋ li; kulla n nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ka n yɛn zaŋ gar a.
en: I'm putting you in charge of my palace, and everybody will have to obey you. No one will be over you except me.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yɛla, dama o yuli daa duya pam. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛli, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-lan neei kum ni na, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: King Herod heard about Jesus, because Jesus was now famous. Some people said, He is John the Baptizer. He must have risen from death, and that is why he can do these miracles.

dag: N ni daa be shɛm daa pala din sɔɣi a sani. Bɛ ni daa nam ma ashilɔni saha shɛli, bɛ daa zaŋ ma tuɣila tab alahizibu tuɣibu tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Paɣa, man bi mi a ni yɛri so maa.
en: But Peter denied it, saying, Woman, I dont know him.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka bɛ daa bi sɔɣi ma kaman bɛ ni dɔɣi bi so zaɣ kpiŋ la, bee kaman biliɛ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-nya neesim la?.
en: I wish I had been born dead and then buried, never to see the light of day.

dag: N kumdila Mɔabnim zuɣu! Bɛ zo n-kuli Zɔa mini Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama shɛb lu soli kuni Luhit, ka kumdi chana; ka shɛb mi zo n-kuli Hɔrɔnaim ni suhugarigu pam.
en: My heart cries out for Moab! The people have fled to the town of Zoar, and to Eglath Shelishiyah. Some climb the road to Luhith, weeping as they go; some escape to Horonaim, grieving loudly.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yɛhi tahi pampam m-po pɔri Yawɛ sani, ka piɛbi kikahi mini binyila.
en: In a loud voice they took an oath in the Lord 's name that they would keep the covenant, and then they shouted and blew trumpets.

dag: Mɛshɛzabɛl bia Pɛtahia ŋun daa yi Zɛra daŋ ni na, ka nyɛ Juda zuliya nir la n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒe niriba zaani Pɛriʒia Naa sani saria dibu shee bɛ yɛlli kam ni.
en: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe.

dag: Ka Hur bia Rɛfaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of half of the Jerusalem District, built the next section.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ yurilim maŋli la yɛla. O ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti ti la zuɣu, n ni paɣ o. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Izraɛlnim ni.
en: I will recount the LORDs faithful acts; I will sing the LORDs praises, because of all the LORD did for us, for Gods great favor toward the house of Israel. God treated them compassionately and with deep affection.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya do so ŋun yɛli ma binshɛɣukam zaa n ni pun niŋ. Pa ŋuna n-ni nyɛ Masia la.
en: Come and see a man who has told me everything Ive done! Could this man be the Christ.

dag: Kpambal so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna ka naa yura, amaa kpambal so ŋun tumdi vi tuma, o suhu yiɣisirimi bahir o zuɣu.
en: Kings are pleased with competent officials, but they punish those who fail them.

dag: Ka Bɛzalɛl daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali Alikauli Adaka la. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Bezalel made the chest of acacia wood. It was forty-five inches long, twenty-seven inches wide, and twenty-seven inches high.

dag: Doo mini paɣ yi dɔni, bɛ niriba ayi maa bɛn sum kom, ka nyɛ bɛn ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If a man lies with a woman and has an emission of semen, both of them must bathe in water and will be unclean until evening.

dag: N ni suhi m Ba ka o tin ya Sɔŋda so na ka o ti be yi sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa tim ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb la daa ti labina ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛl o, Ti Duuma, hal ti nyaŋ alizin biɛri gba a yuli zuɣu.
en: When the followers came back from their trip, they were very happy. They said, Lord, even the demons obeyed us when we used your name.

dag: ni suhuyiɣisili, Yisa nyaandoliba ayi maa ni daa wuhiri niriba n-yɛri ni Yisa ni neei kum ni maa zuɣu kum ni neebu beni la zuɣu.
en: They were incensed that the apostles were teaching the people and announcing that the resurrection of the dead was happening because of Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-nyɛ n sɔŋda ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi ni m mali taali? Bɛ zaa ni kpi kaman siturili la. Lɛla ni ŋub ba zaa.
en: But look, the Lord GOD helps me, so no one can prove me guilty. As for them, they will all be like worthless old clothes, eaten by moths.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla alahichi dabili.
en: Jesus answered, I assure you that everyone who sins is a slave to sin.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Ŋmaligim zani kpaŋ kpe. Ka o daa ŋmaligi zani kpaŋa.
en: David told him, Stand over there and wait. Ahimaaz went over and stood there.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn simdi ni bɛ ti neei kum ni n-kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee ti ku kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: But those who are considered worthy to participate in that age, that is, in the age of the resurrection from the dead, wont marry nor will they be given in marriage.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Wurimmiya Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ, ka n lan labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: Jesus answered, Destroy this temple and in three days Ill raise it up.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so; n lo alikauli ni n ni gbib a yɛligu.
en: The LORD is my possession. I promise to do what you have said.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt paɣ ŋun daa be o nyaaŋa daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka leei yalim kuɣili.
en: Lots wife was following behind him and looked back at the city. When she did, she became a block of salt.

dag: Ka minya ni yi ni ti deei di laara ti Duuma sani, dama yi Duuma ŋun nyɛ Masia la zuɣu ka yi tumdi lala maa.
en: You know that you will receive an inheritance as a reward. You serve the Lord Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka anabinim daa kana ti saɣisi ba. Ka n zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa ku ba, n saria karibu kul nɛmi kaman neesim la.
en: I used the prophets and made laws for the people. The people were killed at my command, but good things will come from those decisions.

dag: Di tam a dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛl la yɛla; a mi di tam bɛ ni na kul tahiri yɔri vu shɛŋa sahakam la gba yɛla.
en: Dont forget the shouts of your enemies. They insulted you again and again.

dag: Di saha ka Taai Naa Hiram daa sabi gbaŋ ti Sulemaana n-garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni yur o niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka o zaŋ a leei bɛ naa maa.
en: Hiram sent his answer back to Solomon: I know that the Lord must love his people, because he has chosen you to be their king.

dag: Yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam zaa, n ni niŋ li tin ya.
en: If you ask me for anything in my name, I will do it.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ, nyamiya doo ŋɔ ni bɔri ti vuri shɛm. O daa pun timna nti yɛli ma ni o bɔrila m paɣiba mini m bihi ni n daanzinfa ni n salima, ka m bi mɔŋ o.
en: So King Ahab called a meeting of all the elders of his country and said, Look, Ben-Hadad is looking for trouble. First he told me that I must give him my wives and children and my silver and gold. I agreed to give them to him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim Farisiinim mini Naa Hɛrɔd nyaanzaanib shɛb Yisa sani ni bɛ ti puɣisi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: The Pharisees got together with Herod's followers. Then they sent some men to trick Jesus into saying something wrong.

dag: Tim Yawɛ jilima a ni mali shɛlikam ni, ka zaŋ a puu bindir daŋda zaa gba ti o jilima.
en: Honor the Lord with your wealth and the first part of your harvest.

dag: Ka sandira maa daa damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, N dana, na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: The official got down on his knees and began begging, Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe.

dag: O ni daa yɛli do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa ni o moomi buɣim maa kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni maa, ka o daa kpe di puuni ti zani baɣili kalinli yini.
en: When he instructed the man clothed in linen to take fire from between the winged creatures and their wheels, the man went and stood next to the wheel.

dag: Bɛ gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti diri wahala, ka tumdi dabitim tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka bi nya vuhim shee. Bɛn daa kari doli ba maa zaa gbahi ba bɛ nandahima pam puuni.
en: Judah suffered very much, and then she was taken into captivity. She lives among other nations but has found no rest. The people who chased her caught her where there was no way out.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa yɛl o niriba, Zaŋmiya maligumaaniba shɛb yi ni daa ʒi nimaani na la yino n-labisi ni, ka o ti be nimaani wuhiri ba tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu.
en: The king replied, Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.

dag: Ka o daa va bɛ nɛma zaa, ka zaŋ o dɔɣim Lɔt min o nɛma gba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni paɣiba m-pahi labina.
en: Then Abram brought back everything the enemy had stolen, as well as the women and servants, his nephew Lot, and everything Lot owned.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa daa saɣi ni o ni be Maika sani m-be kaman o bidibisi ni yino.
en: The young Levite agreed to stay with Micah and became like a son to him.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ dansarika n ni tumdi n Duuma tuma la zuɣu kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali biɛhigu din doli Naawuni ni daa zali ya biɛhigu so shɛl o ni daa boli ya boligu shɛl la puuni.
en: I urge you, then—I who am a prisoner because I serve the Lord: live a life that measures up to the standard God set when he called you.

dag: dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa baɣisi Misia gari chaŋ Troas.
en: So they went on through Mysia until they came to Troas.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ tulaale zim tuɣindi laa m-mooi buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu Yawɛ tooni m-pal li, ka niŋ tulaale zim din nyom viɛla nukurigu pali buyi ŋ-ŋmiri li biɛlabiɛla n-zaŋ li kpe pateesa maa puuni.
en: Then he will take a firepan full of coals of fire from the altar before the Lord . Aaron will take two handfuls of sweet incense that has been ground into powder and take it into the room behind the curtain.

dag: Nimaani ka ti daa zaŋ ti mɔɣilɔnim yili tihi.
en: We hung our lyres up in the trees there.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa bol o yiŋbihi na ni o ti mal o liɣiri din be bɛ sani laasabu.
en: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛn zɔr o ni, bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa.
en: He will bless everyone who honors him, the great and the small alike.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, nir yi doli n yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ be kaman fiig tiwal poma din bie pam ka so ku tooi di li la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I will soon bring war, hunger, and disease against those who are still in Jerusalem. And I will make them the same as bad figs that are too rotten to eat.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni o ni daa ku Galilinim shɛb maa daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari Galilinim zaa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpi maa?.
en: He replied, Do you think the suffering of these Galileans proves that they were more sinful than all the other Galileans?.

dag: Zaŋ kpa Manaasa tintarisi polo, Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia la mi bidibisi n-daa ʒini nimaani n-su Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni Taanak mini di tiŋkpansi ni Mɛgido mini di tiŋkpansi ni Dɔri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages.

dag: A chɛ ka puri atam niŋdi pam yuuni puuni; ka a naɣikɔra tɔroko lɔɣu pali bindira hal ti puuri bahira.
en: You start the new year with a good harvest. You end the year with many crops.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔ kul yɛn beni? A kul yɛn sɔɣimi sahakam? A yɛn chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili be kaman buɣim la hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: How much longer, Lord ? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?.

dag: Ka Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana ka lan nyɛ Musa deemba la daa wum Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ti Musa mini Izraɛlnima ni Yawɛ ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti shɛm la yɛla.
en: Moses' father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, heard about everything that God had done for Moses and the people of Israel when he led them out of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ salima niŋ dapaɣa maa, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima niŋ dapuhi maa.
en: The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through.

dag: Ka ŋun diri binshɛɣukam miri ka o ʒiɛm ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni di dibu, ka ŋun gbaar omaŋ maa mi miri ka o ti ŋun diri shɛlikam zalige; dama Naawuni deei dilana gba.
en: Those who know they can eat any kind of food must not feel that they are better than those who eat only vegetables. And those who eat only vegetables must not decide that those who eat all foods are wrong. God has accepted them.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti mi? A bi lan zaŋdi ti tɔbbihi chani tɔbu ni?.
en: Have you really rejected us? Aren't you going to march out with our armies?.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Wummiya pukpar bimbira ŋahili la gbinni:.
en: So listen to the meaning of that story about the farmer:.

dag: Goli palli dabisili dali, o ni ti bo naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa mini piɛbihi pola ayɔbu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi.
en: For the day of the new moon, the offering will be a flawless young bull from the herd, six lambs, and a flawless ram.

dag: Yawɛ galim Judanima. O ni darigi Yaakubu tibili ka di dol o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yo o o tuma samli.
en: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banim mi di yihiriya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka bɛ ti yihi tahima.
en: Parents, do not irritate your children, or they will become discouraged.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya zuɣusa palli mini dunia palli; dama tuuli zuɣusaa mini tuuli dunia la daa vuuya, ka teeku gba lan kani.
en: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the former heaven and the former earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tahirila Naawuni suhuyiɣisili na, dama zaligu yi kani di chihibu gba ku beni.
en: The Law brings about wrath. But when there isnt any law, there isnt any violation of the law.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti liri Izraɛlnima; tɔb maa ni daa ti mii, ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi tusa anahi tɔb maa ni.
en: The Philistines attacked, and after fierce fighting they defeated the Israelites and killed about four thousand men on the battlefield.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Kulimi ni suhudoo.
en: Jesus said to her, My daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dauda daa yɛli, Ŋunkam bɔr ni o ku Jɛbusinim ŋɔ ŋun yim na nti doli ko bɔbili ŋɔ chaŋ ti ku zoomba mini gbariti ŋɔ, dama man Dauda suhu je bɛ yɛlli zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli ni zoomba mini gbariti ku tooi kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu la.
en: That day David said to his men, Does anybody here hate the Jebusites as much as I do? Enough to kill them? Then go up through the water tunnel and attack those poor blind cripples.

dag: Wummiya, di simdi ni n wuhi ya shihir shɛŋa min alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Zallakudura Naa ni kahigi wuhi ma.
en: Listen to my account of the wonders and miracles which the Supreme God has shown me.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi bi nyari soli din ni tooi ka yi sanna.
en: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa wum Yisa ŋaha ŋɔ, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛna ka o ŋahi li dalim maa.
en: When the leading priests and the Pharisees heard these stories, they knew that Jesus was talking about them.

dag: A nini daa nya ma n nambu saha. N dabisa zaa daa pun sabila a litaafi ni pɔi ka di naanyi piligi.
en: you saw me before I was born. The days allotted to me had all been recorded in your book, before any of them ever began.

dag: Liya nina daa dii ka alaafee, amaa ka Reechɛl ŋun daa viɛli pam ka o ninni kul nyɛlisira.
en: Leahs eyes were gentle, but Rachel was beautiful.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Iin, Alaafee; N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, malimiya yimaŋa n-kana ti pahi n zuɣu sara maligu maa shee. Ka o daa chɛ ka Jɛsi min o bidibisi gba mali bɛmaŋa, ka o boli ba ni bɛ ka sara maligu maa shee na.
en: Yes, he answered. I have come to offer a sacrifice to the Lord . Purify yourselves and come with me. He also told Jesse and his sons to purify themselves, and he invited them to the sacrifice.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daag a niŋ gballi ni, ka a kpi gadama niŋbu kum teeku bulli maa ni.
en: They will kill you and send you to a watery grave.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka naŋgbammalisimnim maa yɛtɔɣa zan tariga. Chɛ ka barinyuriba fo bɛ noya.
en: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali buɣim sɔŋ dundɔŋ sunsuuni ʒiya wuɣisira, ka Pita daa chaŋ ti ʒini pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Some people built a fire in the middle of the courtyard and were sitting around it. Peter sat there with them.

dag: ni di tintan ni tinsi din be Halak Zoli gbin la zaŋ ti paai Ɛdom n-zaŋ hal ti paai Baaligad din be Lɛbanɔn vinvamli ni Hɛrimɔn Zolɔŋni la. Ka o daa gbahi bɛ nanima ŋ-ŋme n-ku ba.
en: He took land stretching from Mount Halak, which goes up toward Seir, as far as Baal-gad at the foot of Mount Hermon in the Lebanon Valley. He captured all their kings. He struck them down and killed them.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni bi baptaizi yi ni so maa zuɣu, naɣ gbaai yihila Krispus mini Gaiɔs kɔŋko.
en: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.

dag: A daŋ maa nyɛla din ni ku nira, ka binshɛli din maari biɛrim mi kani. Bɛnkam zaa wum a yɛla, bɛ kpahirila bɛ nuhi. Dama bɛ ni ŋuni ka a lee bi niŋ a ninkuunsi din ka naabu ŋɔ?.
en: There is no remedy for your injuries, and your wounds cannot be healed. All those who hear the news of your destruction clap their hands for joy. Did anyone escape your endless cruelty?.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa malila anzinfa bee daanya daa zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Ka doo kam ŋun daa mali gɔpiɛliga dari din ni tooi tum tuma daa zaŋ li na.
en: All who were able to contribute silver or bronze brought their offering for the Lord , and all who had acacia wood which could be used for any of the work brought it.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa dɔɣirikpamba zaa daa laɣimna ti pahi Naawuni niriba laɣiŋgu maa ni, ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ tinchandiba ka gbibi takɔbiri kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: The leaders of all the tribes of Israel were there. They took their places in the public meeting of Gods people. There were , soldiers with swords in that place.

dag: n-chaŋ omaŋmaŋ ya n-daa ti kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba, ka di daa gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ya ka doo ŋɔ lee nya yɛm ŋɔ mini tuun kara ŋɔ?.
en: and went back to his hometown. He taught in the synagogue, and those who heard him were amazed. Where did he get such wisdom? they asked. And what about his miracles?.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya ma ka boli ma, ka n garigi yɛl o, N-nyɛ ma.
en: Then he turned around, saw me, and called to me. I answered, Yes, sir.

dag: O daa bi biɛhim Naawuni daalikauli hal baabiɛla. O ni daa kul tibigiri Naawuni maa puuni ka o yɛda daa kul niŋdi kpiɔŋ pahira.
en: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu maa n-wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: So Moses told the Israelites about all the special meetings to honor the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan tirisi tooni ha nti nya Zɛbidii min o bih ayi: Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni n-liɣiri bɛ lansi. Ka Yisa daa boli bɛ gba;.
en: He went on and saw two other brothers, James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in their boat with their father Zebedee, getting their nets ready. Jesus called them.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa bi zaɣisi ni omaŋmaŋ Bia kpi, amaa ka daa zaŋ o ti ti zaa ŋɔ, o ku zaŋ binshɛɣukam din kpalim zaa gba pah o zuɣu ti ti?.
en: He even let his own Son suffer for us. God gave his Son for all of us. So now with Jesus, God will surely give us all things.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ yi niŋ ti mahili ŋ-ŋɔ, ka di yi kuui, wula ka di ni be.
en: If they do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry.

dag: Ti mi ni ti pun yi kum ni n-kpe nyɛvil ni ti ni yuri ti mabihi la zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia bela kum ni.
en: We know that we have transferred from death to life, because we love the brothers and sisters. The person who does not love remains in death.

dag: Yɛlim Juda nayilinima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.

dag: To, n yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ pali ka yi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: I have told you before it happens so that when it happens you will believe.

dag: Binshɛɣukam neesim ni yihi palɔni, di biɛhigu maŋli gba yirimi do palɔni; dama binshɛɣukam din yi n-do palɔni gba leela neesim.
en: And when all things are brought out to the light, then their true nature is clearly revealed;.

dag: dama nyini n Duuma Naawuni, a ku chɛ ma ka n kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee; ka a mi ku chɛ ka a Ninvuɣ suŋ niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.

dag: Yɛlimiya ti din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ka di chɛ ka ti baŋ ni yi shiri nyɛla wuna. Niŋmiya zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe ti ka ti tarigi.
en: Report things that will happen in the future, then well know that you are gods. Do good! Or do bad! Then we will all be afraid and fearful.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla naɣilahi tuhi pisinaayi mini piɛri tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi mali sara. Naa min o niriba maa zaa ni daa zaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni shɛm m-bala.
en: King Solomon offered , bulls and , sheep. So the king and the people showed that they had dedicated the Temple to God.

dag: luɣ shɛli o ni daa be n-lihir o piɛ shɛb bɛn mali bihi la ni o ti leei ŋun su Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim la.
en: where he looked after his flocks, and he made him king of Israel, the shepherd of the people of God.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaɣisi lahibal suŋ la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni dimnima ni di chɛ ka yi wum lahibal suŋ maa; amaa zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni pii ba la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ yurisi bɛ yaannim zuɣu.
en: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini Sapashin kpamba, Chamiya ti kali Izraɛlnim zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ti kpa Dan, ka labina ti yɛli ma di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka m baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: David told Joab and the army commanders, Count everyone in Israel, from the town of Beersheba in the south all the way north to Dan. Then I will know how many people can serve in my army.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛlnim Kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ yɛliya: To, n ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi yinim bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɔhi ya biɛri.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ gba ni tuhi lala zuliyanim maa tɔbu kaman o ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tɔbu tuhibu dal la.
en: Then the Lord will go out and fight against those nations, as he has fought in times past.

dag: Ka o daa tuhi deei bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔn ni la zaa m-mali lala hal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He captured every one of the fortified cities in Judah and then marched to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka yi yi ku saɣi jɛm Yawɛ, yim piimiya yin ni jɛm so, yi yi ni jɛmla wun shɛŋa yi yaannim ni daa jɛmdi Mɔɣili dul la bee yi yi ni jɛmla Amɔrinim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ni be ŋɔ wuna la, yin piimiya, amaa man mini n yiŋnim ni jɛmla Yawɛ.
en: If you are not willing to serve him, decide today whom you will serve, the gods your ancestors worshiped in Mesopotamia or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are now living. As for my family and me, we will serve the Lord .

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa yɛl o, M ba, a yi pun yaag a noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, nyin niŋm ma kaman a ni pun yɛli shɛm maa, Yawɛ ŋun dee ni bɔh a dimnim Ammɔnnim biɛri ti a ŋɔ.
en: Then his daughter said to Jephthah, Father, you have made a promise to the Lord , so keep your promise. Do what you said you would do. After all, the Lord did help you defeat your enemies, the Ammonites.

dag: Ka m bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ya ka bɛ lee mal li chana.
en: Then I asked the angel who was speaking with me, Where are they carrying the bucket.

dag: Lala ka paɣ shɛb bɛn bebu daa be kasi, ka bɛ mali tahima Naawuni sani daa yi maani bɛmaŋa, ka deeri bɛ yidaannim noya.
en: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di zaŋ Izraɛl zuliya shɛli fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli n-tom ti Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli nima; dama di simdi ni Izraɛlnim zaa kul gbibila bɛ yaannim daŋ fali tarili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.

dag: dindina n ni yihi ya n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni, ka zaɣisi n ni daa pii jɛmbu du shɛli ni yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ŋɔ gba, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam mal li ansarisi ka ʒiɛm li.
en: then I will remove you from the land that I gave you, and I will abandon this Temple that I have consecrated as the place where I am to be worshiped. People everywhere will ridicule it and treat it with contempt.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin mi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi pɔhim ni, ka kukol shɛli daa yi jɛmbu duu nam ʒiishee la na n-tahiri pampam yɛra, Di naaya.
en: Then the seventh angel poured his bowl into the air, and a loud voice came out from the temple, from the throne, saying, It is done.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni ka yi teeri di yɛla, ka yɛli Jɔshua ka di kpe o tibili ni ni n ni kpihim Amalɛknim maa birili dunia yili.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Write an account of this victory, so that it will be remembered. Tell Joshua that I will completely destroy the Amalekites.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul dari gindila luɣ shɛlikam, ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu kul be daadamnim biɛhigu ni.
en: The wicked are all around us, and everyone thinks evil is something to be praised!.

dag: Dama zuliya shɛli yi nuzaa polo na ti lir o. Bɛ ni ti chɛ ka o tiŋgbani maa leei dabari, ka so ku lan be nimaani. Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa ni ti yi nimaani zo.
en: A nation from the north has come to attack Babylonia and will make it a desert. People and animals will run away, and no one will live there.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ni nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm, ka ninvuɣ suma nya bɛ laara kaman bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: Bad people will get what they deserve. Good people will be rewarded for their deeds.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Gɛra bia Ɛhud ŋun daa yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na, ka nyɛ gɔbigalan la. Ŋuna ka Izraɛlnim daa timdi ka o zaŋdi bɛ farigu ti yɔri Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn.
en: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord , and he sent someone to free them. This was Ehud, a left-handed man, who was the son of Gera, from the tribe of Benjamin. The people of Israel sent Ehud to King Eglon of Moab with gifts for him.

dag: Ka niŋya kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: You must put oil and frankincense on it; it is a grain offering.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm zo saha shɛli Firawuna tɔbbihi ni daa kanna la.
en: The Babylonian army retreated from Jerusalem because the Egyptian army was approaching.

dag: O daa lan mali pipih anahi ka di ŋmani alimɔnd pum mini di bintira kɔtomsi ni tipuma kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: The shaft of the lampstand had four decorative flowers shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.

dag: Ka ti daa lan yiɣisi nimaani m-be teeku maa ni chaŋ ti baɣisi Saipurus gari, dama ti daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: From there we sailed off. We passed Cyprus, using the island to shelter us from the headwinds.

dag: Ka yi yaannim maa be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka anabinim maa mi, bɛ gba na kul beni?.
en: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.

dag: Dama bɛ ni ti zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bɛ mal o ansarisi ka dih o vi, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o.
en: He will be handed over to the Gentiles. He will be ridiculed, mistreated, and spit on.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ zali ya ni sokam pihim o dimma tarig la. Di simdi ka sokam baŋ o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm tariga, ka pihi lita ayi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: The Lord has commanded that each of you is to gather as much of it as he needs, two quarts for each member of his household.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be tintan zuɣu nya saria karibu. Dina n-nyɛ: Holɔn mini Jaaza ni Mɛfaat.
en: I will punish every town that belongs to Moab, but especially Holon, Jahzah, Mephaath.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Neesim, neema! Ka neesim dii neei.
en: Then God commanded, Let there be light—and light appeared.

dag: Saipurusinim ni ti kpe ŋarima kana ti liri ya. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ashurinim mini Ɛbanima. Amaa bɛ gba ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Ships will come from Cyprus, bringing people who will invade the lands of Assyria and Eber. But finally, Cyprus itself will be ruined.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi zoli maa zuɣu na nti chɛ ka niriba maa paɣi bɛ situra, ka o mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: So Moses went down the mountain to the people. He made sure the people were holy and that they washed their clothes.
