dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mi n ni yɛn nya o luɣ shɛli polo, ka n di chaŋ hal ni o biɛhigu shee.
en: If I knew where to find God, I would go there.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa saɣisi miri buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ha ka boli, Shadirak! Mɛshak! Abɛdnɛgo! Yinim Zallakudura Naa daba ŋɔ, yimiyana ka kpe na! Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa dii yi buɣim maa ni na.
en: Then Nebuchadnezzar went to the opening of the hot furnace. He shouted, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, come out! Servants of the Most High God, come here! So Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came out of the fire.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din laŋsiri ginda, ka bɛ vi tuma ŋmanila kɔfuɣifuɣi. Bɛ lan ŋmanila saŋmar shɛb bɛn chani ginda. Naawuni pun mali biɛhigu shee zali ba bumbɔn ni.
en: They are like wild waves of the sea, with their shameful deeds showing up like foam. They are like wandering stars, for whom God has reserved a place forever in the deepest darkness.

dag: Nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka yi labisi puu maa ti bɛ ni daa da li ninvuɣ so sani maa, ŋun daa su li, ka di nyɛla o di li la fali maa.
en: At the Year of Restoration the field shall be returned to the original owner or to the descendants.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu, ka yi yi di baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni, yi naan ku zaŋ bɛn ka galimi taali.
en: Don't you know what the Scriptures mean when they say, Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others? If you knew what this means, you would not condemn these innocent disciples of mine.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Ŋuna m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Aai, o ŋman o mi. Ka omaŋmaŋ yɛli ba, Mani m-bala.
en: Some said, He is the one, but others said, No he isn't; he just looks like him. So the man himself said, I am the man.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus and said:.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Gaad ni o yɛlim Dauda ni o cham ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Aruna ŋun nyɛ Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili ni.
en: The LORDs messenger ordered Gad to tell David that he should go up to the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite in order to set up an altar for the LORD.

dag: Nyama, buɣim pun yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku sapashinnima ayi la mini bɛ tɔbbihi pihinunu, amaa tiligim man nyɛvili.
en: The two other officers and their men were killed by fire from heaven; but please be merciful to me.

dag: Ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal maa daa bi dɔɣi bia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Michal, Sauls daughter, had no children to the day she died.

dag: Dama Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ti o niriba suhudoo, ka ni kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: David said, The Lord God of Israel has given peace to his people, and he himself will live in Jerusalem forever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, kum n-nyɛ a sanyoo, ka a mi ku tooi yi di ni. Ninvuɣ kubo taali ʒi a zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ kubo maa ni dol a.
en: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.

dag: N ku zaŋ n nuu kpɛhi bɛ yɛla ni. M mi ku be bɛ laɣiŋgu ni; dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ kuri niriba, ka chɛri chihiri naɣilahi jila ni di ti ba suhupiɛlli.
en: I will not join their secret meetings. I will not take part in their evil plans. They have killed people out of anger and crippled animals for fun.

dag: N ni daa lo o alikauli shɛli daa nyɛla nyɛvili mini alaafee alikauli din nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti o ka di wuhiri jilima tibu, ka o daa tiri ma jilima ka luri n yuli sizuura la.
en: In my covenant I promised them life and well-being, and this is what I gave them, so that they might respect me. In those days they did respect and fear me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpaai bɛ kawana, bɛ zaa liɣiri daa lɔnlomi be bɛ kpalansi ni, bɛ mini bɛ ba ni daa nya liɣiri maa, ka di gari ba.
en: Then when they emptied out their sacks, every one of them found his bag of money; and when they saw the money, they and their father Jacob were afraid.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya o ni be luɣ shɛli ka n tim ka bɛ ti gbaag o na. Ka bɛ daa ti yɛl o, O be Dɔtan.
en: Find out where he is! the king ordered. I'll send soldiers to bring him here. They learned that Elisha was in the town of Dothan and reported it to the king.

dag: A guri a tɔbu, ka zali zaligu, ka piɛma pani di zuɣu. A zaŋ mɔɣa bɔɣi tiŋgbani.
en: You raise up your empty bow, uttering curses for the arrows. Selah With rivers you split open the earth.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba ni dinzuɣu bɛ chɛ ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ zuɣuri dol o chaŋ ti wuhi doo maa taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Let your leaders go to Caesarea with me and accuse the man if he has done anything wrong.

dag: M bia, wumm a ba ni wuhir a shɛli, ka miri ka a zaɣisi a ma ni wuh a shɛli.
en: My child, obey the teachings of your parents.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul zoori ka mali zuɣu Yawɛ mini salinim sani.
en: Meanwhile, the boy Samuel kept growing up and was more and more liked by both the LORD and the people.

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Akan.
en: Ezer had three sons. They were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Lɛvinim zuliya kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Merari family groups were Mahli and Mushi. These are the families that belonged to Levis family group.

dag: Ti zaŋdi galigɛnima n-lɛri yuri ni bɛ tum ti yubu, ka ti ŋmaligiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ zaa kpari ti ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ba n-yɛn deei Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini di tooni ha tiŋgbana maa su, tinim ni yɛn deei tiŋgban shɛŋa su bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ na.
en: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.

dag: O ni daa ti yiɣisi o Naawuni suhibu maa shee o daa labila o nyaandoliba maa sani nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi, suhugarigu ni daa mali ba zuɣu.
en: Rising from his prayer, he went back to the disciples and found them asleep, worn out by their grief.

dag: Ka Manaasa bia Jair daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei tiŋkpan shɛŋa, ka bol li Havɔtijairi.
en: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them Villages of Jair.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Elihu continued.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paag o sani nti balim o pam yɛra, Sapashini maa simdi ni a sɔŋ o.
en: The leaders went to Jesus and begged him to do something. They said, This man deserves your help!.

dag: Ka ŋunkam deeri anabi o ni nyɛ anabi zuɣu ni ti deeg anabi laara; ka ŋunkam deeri wuntizɔra o ni nyɛ wuntizɔra zuɣu ni ti deei wuntizɔra laara.
en: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N zabirila nyuli tiri nyin ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama Izraɛlnim yi a mini ba daalikauli la nyaaŋa, ka daag a sara maligu bimbina luhi, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku a daanabinim zaa, ka n kɔŋko nti kpalim, ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku man gba.
en: He answered, Lord God Almighty, I have always served you—you alone. But the people of Israel have broken their covenant with you, torn down your altars, and killed all your prophets. I am the only one left—and they are trying to kill me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa laɣim naa sani chu shɛli din daa puhiri chira ayopɔin ni la dali.
en: Everyone in Israel assembled before the king in the seventh month, during the festival.

dag: Jɔshua daa yɛla binyɛr daɣiri ʒe malaika maa tooni.
en: Joshua was wearing filthy clothes and standing before the messenger.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni daa taai duŋ niŋ ma Zin mɔɣu ni la, a daa zaɣisi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka niriba maa bi nya n kasitali kom la shee. .
en: because both of you disobeyed me at Meribah near the town of Kadesh in the Zin Desert. When the Israelites insulted me there, you didn't believe in my holy power.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu saha shɛli n ni daa wum yi ni niŋ ti Duuma yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm yɛla, di chɛ ka.
en: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Zaŋ chaŋ yuun yini saha din nyɛ kaman bɛ ni bu tumtumda so paa tuma yuma tariga saha, Kɛdar jilima ni zan tariga.
en: So the Lord said to me: Within a year, according to the number of years for which a laborer is hired, all the glory of Kedar will end.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Keenan Naa Jabin ŋun daa diri ʒi Hazɔr, ka o sapashin kpɛm nyɛ Sisɛra ŋun daa be Harɔshɛtihagɔim la nuu ni.
en: So the Lord allowed King Jabin of Canaan to defeat the Israelites. Jabin ruled in a city named Hazor. A man named Sisera was the commander of King Jabins army. Sisera lived in a town called Harosheth Haggoyim.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ yɛli Baruk, Yɛlim ti a ni niŋ shɛm sabi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa. Jɛrimia n-daa yɛr a yɛtɔɣa maa ka a sabira.
en: Then they asked Baruch, Tell us, how did you write all these words? Did they come from Jeremiah.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaayopɔin daa gbaai Jɔshibɛkasha min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the Lord your God who led you out of Egypt.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a chani baɣisi mini bukpahinim bɛn sɔɣiri yɛr la sani ni bɛ ti yɛl a a zuɣu ni yɛlli? Miri ka a wum bɛ ni sɔɣiri yɛri shɛli maa. Ŋun ne ni tooi vihi baŋ o zuɣu ni yɛlli kpiimba sani? A bi bɔhir a Naawuni?.
en: But people will tell you to ask for messages from fortunetellers and mediums, who chirp and mutter. They will say, After all, people should ask for messages from the spirits and consult the dead on behalf of the living.

dag: ka sua maa mini di sukpali zaa kpe nti lim. Ka o puli maa kpam mum li niŋ, dama o daa bi darigi ŋooi sua maa o puli maa ni, ka o puuni daɣiri daa zɔri yirina.
en: that even the handle was buried in his fat. Ehud left the dagger there. Then after closing and locking the doors to the room, he climbed through a window onto the porch.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Leeban ni Yaakubu yiɣisiya zo.
en: Three days later Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

dag: ka yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba maa, Ti bia ŋɔ nyɛla tipawumlilana ni nɔzaɣisira; o bi deeri ti noli; o nyɛla pulaandana ni danyura.
en: The parents will tell the leaders, This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.

dag: Jɛrilim tuma tirila ŋun ka yɛm suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun mali tɛhi zilima ŋun tumdila din tuhi.
en: Doing foolish things makes a fool happy, but a wise person is careful to do what is right.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam je Ziɔn di vi, ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: May those who hate Zion be put to shame. May they be stopped and chased away.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni yi kul ŋmari bilichiisi shɛm maa, lala ka bɛ na kul yɛn ŋmari li, di filimya li; bɛ nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm ti Naawuni.
en: but they must make the same number of bricks as before. They are lazy, or else they would not beg me to let them go and sacrifice to their God.

dag: Hal bihi siŋdi ma mi, n yi yiɣisi, bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa jɛndiri ma.
en: Even the young despise me; I get up, and they rail against me.

dag: A leela ninkuunsilana zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka niŋ ma alaka ni a yaa zaa.
en: You have become cruel to me; you use your power to hurt me.

dag: Bɛ nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, bɛ kpalim bela zuliyanim maa sani kaman duɣu kpiŋ din lan ka buchi la.
en: Israel is swallowed up; among the nations, they are now like a useless jar.

dag: Yɛnnim bɛn sani, nyɛvili soli durila zuɣusaa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku siɣi tiŋgban ni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: For those with insight, life is an upward path, avoiding the grave below.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N Duuma Naawuni, bɛ ku a daanabinima, ka wurim a sara malibu bimbina, ka n kɔŋko n-kpalim ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yihi man gba nyɛvili.
en: Lord, they have killed your prophets, and they have torn down your altars. Im the only one left, and they are trying to take my life. .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Siɣimi ti zaŋ Aduna pah amaŋ zuɣu duna, amaa di chɛ ka maligumaaniba mini niriba maa kab ka man Yawɛ sanna, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, Go down and bring Aaron back here with you. But the priests and people must not try to push their way through, or I will rush at them like a flood.

dag: M bɔrila suhudoo, amaa n yi yɛli shɛli, bɛ zaŋdi li mi leei zabili.
en: When I speak of peace, they are for war.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa nyɛla wuntizɔriba, ka daa doli ti Duuma Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim mini adiini soli kaya zaa ka ka galimi shɛli.
en: They were both righteous before God, blameless in their observance of all the Lords commandments and regulations.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋda maa yɛl o, Karimba, achiika! A yɛli yɛlimaŋli; dama Naawuni yino n-shiri beni, ka Naawuni so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The man replied, Teacher, you are certainly right to say there is only one God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka Judanim zaa daa kanna ti tir o pina. Ka o daa mali buni pam, ka niriba tir o jilima.
en: The Lord gave Jehoshaphat firm control over the kingdom of Judah, and all the people brought him gifts, so that he became wealthy and highly honored.

dag: Lihimiya nya din niŋdi gili ya; sokam zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yi bidibisi ni yi katiŋ na, ka bɛ kpuɣi yi bipuɣinsi buɣ na nti tin ya.
en: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛlimuɣisira polo, n tɛhiya ni nir yi kpalim be kaman o ni pun be shɛm, di so.
en: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.

dag: Kum mini kɔnyuri n-daa yɛn ku ba, hal ka bɛ daa ti yihi tahima.
en: They were hungry and thirsty; their lives were slipping away.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa daa mali zim bihi biɛla pahi, ka o daa zaŋ di gba niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm li tari ba pahi.
en: The followers also had a few small fish. Jesus gave thanks for the fish and told them to give the fish to the people.

dag: Di daa tuhiya ni Naawuni ŋun nam shɛlikam ka nyɛ ŋun gbib binshɛɣukam ŋɔ chɛ ka Yisa be tibi o wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ Naawuni bihi pam ka bɛ min o ti laɣim nya jilima; dama Yisa n-nyɛ bɛ toondana ŋun tahiri ba tiliginsim shee.
en: It was only right that God, who creates and preserves all things, should make Jesus perfect through suffering, in order to bring many children to share his glory. For Jesus is the one who leads them to salvation.

dag: di saha doo ŋun paai yuun pisi zaŋ hal ni yuun pihiyɔbu, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihinu kaman jɛmbu duu liɣiri zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The price for a man from to years old is shekels of silver.

dag: Pɛrɛz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ zaŋ ti na ti bahi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti? Bɛ ni gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bihi chaŋ; ti yi di lab Ijipti, di di bi so.
en: Why is the Lord taking us into that land? We will be killed in battle, and our wives and children will be captured. Wouldn't it be better to go back to Egypt.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yo yi puri atam pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim naai yuuni din pahir ata, ka nyɛ yuun shɛli puuni yi ni yɔri pirigibu bupia kam zuɣu yim tiri Lɛvinim mini saamba ni kpibisi ni pakoya ni bɛ gba di n-tiɣi yi tinsi ni la.
en: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord . But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo nti zaŋ ma kpe du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani tooni polo mini du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo tooni.
en: Then the man led me through the north gate out into the outer courtyard. He led me to a building with many rooms that was west of the restricted area and the building on the north side.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni; ka din pahi nyɛla, n ni chɛ ka o dɔɣi bidibiga ti a. N shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o leei zuliya pam yabipaɣa; ka nanim ni ti yi o zuliya ni na.
en: I will bless her. I will give her a son, and you will be the father. She will be the mother of many new nations. Kings of nations will come from her.

dag: O ni zaŋ tɔbutuhira piɛma din noya diri mini sɔɣu tia sala buɣim darigi yi tibili.
en: With a soldier's sharp arrows, with red-hot coals!.

dag: Saɣimmi ninvuɣ biɛri mini tuumbiɛtumdiba yiko; darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu hal ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ti ku lan beni yaha.
en: Break the arms of those who are wicked and evil. Punish them for the evil they have done, and stop them from doing any more.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa bee o ku tib o, dama bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ nyala o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees were watching Jesus closely. They were waiting to see if he would heal on the Sabbath day. They wanted to see him do something wrong so that they could accuse him.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma a yuli zuɣu. Wuhim ni n ka taali a kpiɔŋ zuɣu!.
en: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti labisi n niriba Izraɛlnim mini Judanim daazichi ti ba, ka zaŋ ba labisi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni na ka bɛ ti deei li su.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will bring back my people Israel and Judah from captivity, says the LORD. I will bring them home to the land that I gave to their ancestors, and they will possess it.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Ramatimizipa mini Bɛtɔnim ni zaŋ hal ti paai Mahanaim zaŋ chaŋ Dɛbir tintariga.
en: It also ran from Heshbon as far as Ramath-mizpeh and Betonim, and from Mahanaim as far as the territory of Lidebir.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be nam ʒiishee maa tooni ŋ-ŋmani teeku kom din be kaman takɔriti diɣisi kɔtomsi la, ka lan be kaman diɣi la. Ka binnɛma anahi bɛn nyɔri zaŋ tabili bɛ puya mini bɛ nyaansi daa pali nina gili nam ʒiishee maa.
en: Also in front of the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. Surrounding the throne on each of its sides, were four living creatures covered with eyes in front and behind.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba min o biɛyanim maa ʒili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ŋmaai tiŋgban viɛlli Ramɛsis tiŋgban ni ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa yɛl o shɛm.
en: Joseph obeyed the king's orders and gave his father and brothers some of the best land in Egypt near the city of Rameses.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni ka yiɣisi kuli.
en: Jacob gave the king a farewell blessing and left.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia yɛla dabisi muni puuni dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: My tongue will sing about your goodness all the time, because those who wanted to kill me have been defeated and disgraced.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Sintani, wara! Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus responded, Go away, Satan, because its written, You will worship the Lord your God and serve only him .

dag: Naawuni, kabisim bɛ nyina; Yawɛ, kabisim gbuɣim pola maa nyin wɔɣila la.
en: Break the teeth of these fierce lions, O God.

dag: Ka daa kari ba yihi.
en: So Gallio made them leave the court.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɛ pulaannim zuɣu, bɛ suhuri yi kul bɔr shɛli, bɛ dir li mi;.
en: didnt know contentment in their belly; couldnt escape with their treasure.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma: Bɛ paɣiba ŋmaligi n-gɔndila bɛ paɣ taba;.
en: Thats why God abandoned them to degrading lust. Their females traded natural sexual relations for unnatural sexual relations.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bia ka kpi;.
en: There were once seven brothers. The first one married, but died without having any children.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni Izraɛlnim kpe o tiŋgbani maa ni gari, ka daa laɣim o tɔbbihi na ti dɔni Jahaz n-tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: Yet Sihon didnt trust the Israelites to pass through his territory. He assembled his entire army, set up camp at Jahaz, and went to war with the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti do yi sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Your people will be killed, and then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Jarɛd ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiyɔbunaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Inok.
en: When Jared was , he had a son, Enoch.

dag: Yɛhudianim maa daa bi niŋ yɛda ni doo maa daa nyɛla zoma ka ti neei maa faashee bɛ ni daa ti bol o ba min o ma na.
en: The Jewish leaders didnt believe the man had been blind and received his sight until they called for his parents.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu ka zuliya kam kul jiɣindi biɛɣukam, amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ mi ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Gentiles long for all these things. Your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

dag: Di saha ka sokam daa ŋmah o dabɔbili n-zaŋ li doli Abimilɛk ti sɔŋ baɣili bɛ sɔɣisili shee maa n-niŋ buɣim nyo li pa bɛ zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be di ni kpi. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba mini paɣiba tuhili.
en: When they all had branches, they followed Abimelech back to Shechem. They piled the branches against the fortress and set them on fire, burning down the fortress and killing about , men and women.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni mini bɛn doli nyaaŋa zaa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: The people who were in front and those who followed behind began to shout, Praise God! God bless him who comes in the name of the Lord!.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri sunsuuni bee n-kɔrisi taɣi bɛ teensi bee n-chihi chiha bɛ niŋgbuna ni.
en: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi ni damdi tiŋa n-jɛm ma, n ni zaŋ di zaa ha ti a.
en: The devil said, If you will bow down and worship me, I will give you all these things.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ din tuhi. O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn niŋdi ya wahala la gba di wahala.
en: After all, its right for God to pay back the ones making trouble for you with trouble.

dag: ka Shammua daa nyɛ Biliga daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Jɛhɔnatan so mi daa nyɛ Shɛmaya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Toomiya daaŋa ni tampiligim nukurigu palipali ka Musa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa Firawuna ninni.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron: Take a few handfuls of ashes from a stove and you, Moses, throw them into the air. Be sure the king is watching.

dag: Bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o bela bɛ sochandi tab sani, ka daa chaŋ dabisi muni chandi zaa ka naanyi ti gbaag o bɔbu bɛ dɔɣiriba mini bɛ nimmiriba sani.
en: Supposing that he was among their band of travelers, they journeyed on for a full day while looking for him among their family and friends.

dag: Amaa nyini Bɛtilihɛm din be Ɛfirata, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din pɔri Juda tinsi puuni ŋɔ, a ni ka n ninvuɣ so ŋun ni su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ti yina. O piligu yila kurimbuni na.
en: As for you, Bethlehem of Ephrathah, though you are the least significant of Judahs forces, one who is to be a ruler in Israel on my behalf will come out from you. His origin is from remote times, from ancient days.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, M ba Sool bɔrimi ni o ku a, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni asiba sa miri ka a yi palo; sa sɔɣimi luɣ shɛli polo.
en: So Jonathan warned David, My father Saul is trying to kill you. Be on guard tomorrow morning. Stay somewhere safe and hide.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, Di ku lan yuui ka n kpi, amaa Naawuni ni be yi sani, ka ti zaŋ ya labisi yi yaannim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni yaha.
en: After that, Jacob said, Joseph, you can see that I won't live much longer. But God will be with you and will lead you back to the land he promised our family long ago.

dag: N wum Izraɛlnim ni ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni shɛm maa. Yɛlim ba ni yi yɛn ŋubirila nimdi yuŋ, ka diri bindirigu mi tiɣiri asiba, ka baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I have heard the complaints of the Israelites. So tell them, Tonight you will eat meat. And in the morning you will have all the bread you want. Then you will know you can trust the Lord , your God.

dag: M biyurigu, a ʒe yim a ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa tiri ti mabihi la puuni, di bahi bamdi bɛn nyɛ saamba la.
en: My dear friend, it is good that you continue to help the believers. They are people you dont even know.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun vihiri ninsalinim suhuri mi din be o Shia Kasi tɛha ni, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-deeri suhiri tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda kaman Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni tilig a, ka bɛ ku zaŋ a niŋ a ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb la nuu ni.
en: But on that day, declares the LORD: I will rescue you; you wont be handed over to those you dread.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab nya a ni niŋ ti shɛm maa, ka maani ti ansarisi, ka bɛn gili ti lari ti.
en: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nirilim yɛla, ka kuhi yɛl a wuntia yɛla.
en: They will rave in celebration of your abundant goodness; they will shout joyfully about your righteousness.

dag: Ka biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi ni noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋ zaa bɛba ayiyi, zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: All the clean animals, all the other animals on the earth, the birds, and everything that crawls on the earth.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi jɛrigu nya yɛla; jɛrigu ba ka suhupiɛlli.
en: A man who has a fool for a son will be disappointed. A fool brings no joy to his father.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; kul niŋmila yɛda, o ni nya alaafee.
en: But Jesus heard it and said to Jairus, Don't be afraid; only believe, and she will be well.

dag: Di simdi ni ti ŋme goonje mini mɔɣilo paɣ a, ka ŋme biɛɣu paɣ a.
en: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ŋumaŋuma jɛndiri ma? Yi zaa taala duŋ zaɣisi ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Why do you argue with me? You have all turned against me. This message was from the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim galisiya pam, bɛn yiɣisi lu n zuɣu galisiya pam!.
en: I have a lot of enemies, Lord . Many fight against.

dag: Dama n niriba maa tumla tuumbiɛri buyi zuɣu. Bɛ zaɣisi mani ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ, ka gbi bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi, kɔbil kaba din ku tooi deei kom.
en: for my people have committed two sins: they have turned away from me, the spring of fresh water, and they have dug cisterns, cracked cisterns that can hold no water at all.

dag: N yi lih a ni nam sagban shɛŋa ŋɔ, ka lihi goli mini saŋmar shɛb a ni nam ŋɔ.
en: When I look at the sky, which you have made, at the moon and the stars, which you set in their places—.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: But Jesus warned the spirits not to tell who he was.

dag: ka lan nyɛ zuɣusaa neesim din ne dunia ni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: they will shine in the sky to give light to the earth—and it was done.

dag: dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na sani mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di.
en: So send the people away. They need to go to the farms and towns around here to buy some food to eat.

dag: Amaa di lee nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din ŋmani bin chɔɣima la nyɛla din ku tooi kɔŋ niŋgbuŋ ni;.
en: On the contrary, we cannot do without the parts of the body that seem to be weaker;.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani, o pun zaŋ li ti Naawuni, ka di bi lan kpa ni o lu o ba sizuura gba.
en: But you teach that a person can say to their father or mother, I have something I could use to help you. But I will not use it for you. I will give it to God.

dag: ka o zaŋ omaŋ wuhi bɛn daa dol o yi Galili chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm la dabisi gbaliŋ. Bɛna n-nyɛ o shɛhiranim niriba sani pumpɔŋɔ.
en: He appeared over many days to those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to the people.

dag: N niriba, niŋmiy o o ni daa niŋ ya shɛm labisi, ka yɔny o o tuma samli siɣimsiɣim buyi! Niŋmiy o binnyurigu ka di to n-gari o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-tin ya la!.
en: Give that city the same as she gave to others. Pay her back twice as much as she did. Prepare wine for her that is twice as strong as the wine she prepared for others.

dag: N daamiliya, a naŋgbampiba tɔɣirila binnyuri nyaɣisili ka shiri mini bihim be a zilinli ni. A situra ʒiɛɣu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn ʒiɛɣu.
en: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ kpam din be yiligu ni maa m-booi bah o zuɣu ni, o biɛyanim maa zaa tooni. Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi Dauda zuɣu na pam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi labi Rama.
en: Samuel poured the oil on David's head while his brothers watched. At that moment, the Spirit of the Lord took control of David and stayed with him from then on. Samuel returned home to Ramah.

dag: Ŋunkam yɔhindi niriba, dilan ku be n yiŋa; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi ŋmari ʒiri, m mini dilan gba ku kpe.
en: But the person who acts deceitfully wont stay in my house. The person who tells lies wont last for long before me.

dag: Di saha maa Saimɔn Pita daa ʒiɛmi wuɣisiri buɣim. Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba pala o nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka o daa chihi yɛli, M pala o nyaandola.
en: Peter was still standing there keeping himself warm. So the others said to him, Aren't you also one of the disciples of that man? But Peter denied it. No, I am not, he said.

dag: N ni woligi n niriba ka chɛ a niriba. Biɛɣuni ka alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ sa yɛn tum. .
en: So tomorrow I will treat my people differently from your people. This will be my proof.

dag: yurilim zuɣu chɛ ka n naɣ suhir a mi. Man Pool ŋun nyɛ ninkurigu ka lan nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: I would rather appeal to you through love. I, Paul—an old man, and now also a prisoner for Christ Jesus.

dag: Dama o daa yɛlimi, ka di niŋ. O daa zal li zaligu, ka di ba n-zani.
en: because when he speaks, things happen. And if he says, Stop!—then it stops.

dag: Ka di saha dɛde daa ti paai ka o kahigi li wuhi palɔni o lahibal sun shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni, ka m mol li kaman ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ ni zal li shɛm la.
en: and at the right time he revealed it in his message. This was entrusted to me, and I proclaim it by order of God our Savior.

dag: Ka naa maa baŋdiba daa kana ti zani, amaa ka so daa ka bɛ ni ŋun ni tooi karim sabbu maa bee n-wuhi di gbinni.
en: So all the kings wise men came in, but they could not read the writing or understand what it meant.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛli, Di viɛla, amaa a yi da tiŋgbani maa Naomi sani, shee ka a zaŋ Rut ŋun nyɛ pakoli ka lan nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba pahi, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa.
en: Then Boaz said, If you buy the land from her, you must also marry the dead mans wife, Ruth, the Moabite woman. Then the first child will get the land, and it will stay in the dead mans family.

dag: O bi ŋmani wun so tuumbaŋdiba ni mali zali, ka salindoora dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ anzinfa zoligɔnim yɛliyɛl li la?.
en: No, but some people make statues from rock or wood, and they call them gods. One worker makes a statue. Then another worker covers it with gold and makes silver chains for it.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Naa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ niŋ sarika ni, ka tir o bɔrɔbɔro biɛlabiɛla mini kom hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them, The king says: Put this man in prison and feed him minimum rations of bread and water until I return safely.

dag: Bɛ ni bi nyari saɣisigu zuɣu ka bɛ kpira, ka bɛ jɛrilim din galisi zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zuɣuri kpi.
en: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa lo Dauda alikauli, dama o daa yur o mi kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm la.
en: And Jonathan and David made a covenant together because Jonathan loved David as much as himself.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be ʒilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Dont be like a stupid horse or mule that will not come to you unless you put a bit in its mouth and pull it with reins.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim polo, bɛ saɣisiri ti ka ti luri ba sizuura. Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni ti deei ti Ba Naawuni saɣisigu ka be.
en: In the case of our human fathers, they punished us and we respected them. How much more, then, should we submit to our spiritual Father and live!.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.

dag: Ka n yi tumdi n ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: If I do what I don't want to do, this means that I am no longer the one who does it; instead, it is the sin that lives in me.

dag: Naawuni yino m-beni, ka sandaantimda yino kɔŋko mi m-be Naawuni mini salinim sunsuuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ daadam.
en: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ŋunkam tum alahichi n sani, dilan yuli ka n ni kpihim litaafi maa ni.
en: The Lord answered, It is those who have sinned against me whose names I will remove from my book.

dag: ka zaŋ o bidibisi maa na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba;.
en: Then bring Aarons sons to that place. Put the white woven robes on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmi laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini Baal anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu ni Ashɛra anabinim kɔbisinahi bɛn diri Jɛzibɛl yiŋ la n-zaŋ ba ka n sanna Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: Call together everyone from Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel. Be sure to bring along the prophets of Baal and the prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel's table.

dag: Saŋmarisi bɛn laɣim gbilligbilli be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ti ku ne; ka wuntaŋ ti ku ne o puhibu na saha, ka goli ti ku piɛla.
en: The skies will be dark. The sun, the moon, and the stars will not shine.

dag: Ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. A yi di saɣi, n naan ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini, Anabi Ilaija gba zaɣ yini.
en: So Peter spoke up and said to Jesus, Lord, how good it is that we are here! If you wish, I will make three tents here, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Doo yi na yoli niŋ amiliya, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka o doli tɔbbihi chaŋ tɔb ni bee n-chɛ ka o tum tuma lala tatabo, amaa di simdi ni bɛ chɛ o ka o be yiŋ yuun yini, ka o min o ni kpuɣi paɣ so maa laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: A newly married man doesnt have to march in battle. Neither should any related duties be placed on him. He is to live free of such responsibilities for one year, so he can bring joy to his new wife.

dag: Nyam ti bɔrɔbɔro, di daa na kul tulimi ka ti zaŋ li yi yiŋ na ti ni daa yiɣisina dahin shɛli ni ti ti diri sol ni, amaa nyam di ni kuui ka kpe yue shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Look at our bread. When we left home, it was warm and fresh. But now you can see that it is dry and old.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a tɔɣisiri niriba maa la yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni.
en: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked him, Why do you use parables when you talk to the people.

dag: A dabisa bemi kaman daadam dabisa ni be shɛm bee a yuma bemi kaman daadam yuma ni be shɛm.
en: Is your life as short as ours?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuɣulaannima, Yi zaa yinoyino kum yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe Pɛɔr Baal jɛmbu ni maa.
en: Moses said to the officials, Each of you is to kill every man in your tribe who has become a worshiper of Baal of Peor.

dag: Ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mali yiko pam. O baŋsim galisiya yaɣi.
en: Great and mighty is our Lord; his wisdom cannot be measured.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Tabɛra, Yawɛ buɣim ni daa di bɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: So the place was named Taberah, because there the fire of the Lord burned among them.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ zina.
en: Be faithful in marriage.

dag: Zaŋm nɛkaŋa n-niɛm zim. Paam a sariga sɔŋ, ka kahi a mukuru ka chɛ a biɛhi n-siɣi mɔɣa kom ni du.
en: Get the millstones ready and grind the grain into flour. Take off your veil and fancy clothes. Lift your skirt and get ready to cross the rivers.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: False christs and false prophets will appear, and they will offer signs and wonders in order to deceive, if possible, those whom God has chosen.

dag: Yawɛ po Yaakubu zuɣu n-yɛli, N kul ku tam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla.
en: The LORD has sworn by the pride of Jacob: Surely I will never forget what they have done.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu pahi yi Naawuni sizuura lubu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi yurilim mi pahi yi mabihili nirilim niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: to your godliness add Christian affection; and to your Christian affection add love.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga m-bol o yuli Daina.
en: After this, she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

dag: N ni daa deei shɛli n Duuma san la, dina ka m mali wuhiri ya ŋɔ: Dahin shɛli yuŋ bɛ ni daa yi ti Duuma nyaaŋa la, ka o daa kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro.
en: For I received from the Lord the teaching that I passed on to you: that the Lord Jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took a piece of bread.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan labina nya ka o nyaandoliba maa lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa wum ba pam, ka bɛ daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm.
en: And, again, when he came back, he found them sleeping, for they couldnt keep their eyes open, and they didnt know how to respond to him.

dag: Yawɛ daa booni ya la olivi ti mahali din mali wal viɛla, amaa sanʒiɛ titali puuni o ni niŋ buɣim dab li, ka di di di wula.
en: I once called them a leafy olive tree, full of beautiful fruit; but now, with a roar like thunder I will set its leaves on fire and break its branches.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n niŋ ya yiko din ni chɛ ka yi no tinvura mini nɔnsi, ka lan pahi ya yiko din ni tooi nyaŋ yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani ŋɔ min o nyaaŋa zaa; ka binshɛɣu ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: Listen! I have given you authority, so that you can walk on snakes and scorpions and overcome all the power of the Enemy, and nothing will hurt you.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ paai ti? Di nyɛla yi tuumbiɛri ni galisi zuɣu ka bɛ darigi fuɣi yi situra, ka bili ya.
en: If you ask why all this has happened to you—why your clothes have been torn off and you have been raped—it is because your sin is so terrible.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, ka o daa yɛl o, Di yi kpe chaŋ ti liri ba, amaa gilim bɛ nyaaŋa chaŋ ti liri ba tulaale tihi la tooni polo.
en: Once more David consulted the Lord , who answered, Don't attack them from here, but go around and get ready to attack them from the other side, near the balsam trees.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali bɛ bidibisi bɛn nyɛ goli yini bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura, ka bɛ kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata; dama bɛ daa bi zaŋ Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni, bɛ ni daa bi pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa pal shɛli ti ba la zuɣu.
en: The male Levites who were one month old or older numbered . They were listed separately from the rest of the Israelites, because they were not given any property in Israel.

dag: ni Janim ni Bɛtitapua ni Afɛka.
en: Janim, Beth-tappuah, Aphekah.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔsia daa zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ o, ka daa bo binyara niŋ omaŋa n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. O daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Nɛko yɛl o shɛm maa; ka daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti lir o Mɛgido bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: But Josiah ignored Neco's warning, even though it came from God! Instead, he disguised himself and marched into battle against Neco in the valley near Megiddo.

dag: Dauda daa lan bo kuriti pam ni bɛ mali kpahi din ni kpahi dunɔdaya pundi mini chɛulɔnima. O daa lan bo daanya pam, hal nir daa naan ku tooi zaŋ li pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: He got a large supply of iron to make into nails and hinges for the doors, and he provided so much bronze that it could not be weighed.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka ti kpɛh o tanti suɣili ni. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka n-leeg o paɣa, ka yur o pam, ka di daa chɛ ka o nya suhukpaŋsibo o ma kum la nyaaŋa.
en: Isaac brought Rebekah into his mother Sarahs tent. He received Rebekah as his wife and loved her. So Isaac found comfort after his mothers death.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam, ka o binnamda zaa kul ni paɣir o sahakam.
en: I will always praise the Lord ; let all his creatures praise his holy name forever.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumda gbilisiri tibili wumdi ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiŋmara mi gbilisiri tibili wumdi yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: People who do evil listen to evil ideas. Liars listen to liars.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔro gbaai Naa Uzia m-mal o hal ka o ti kpimi ni dina. O daa yi nayili n-taɣi ti bela yil shɛli. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili n-lihiri li, ka gbibi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: The Lord caused King Azariah to become sick with leprosy. He was a leper until the day he died. Azariah lived in a separate house. His son Jotham was in charge of the kings palace, and he judged the people.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ ya niŋ Naawuni nuu ni, ka lan zaŋ ya niŋ o daalibarika yɛtɔɣa din ni tooi kpaŋsi ya la ni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya tarili bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la ni.
en: Now I am putting you in Gods care. I am depending on the message about his grace to make you strong. That message is able to give you the blessings that God gives to all his holy people.

dag: Ka paɣ maa bɔhi Ilaisha, N daa yɛli nyini n dana ni a tim ma bia? N daa pun bi yɛl a ni a di yɔhim ma.
en: Then she said, Sir, I never asked for a son. I told you, Dont trick me.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa mii pam dindali maa, ka naa maa daa ʒiya dalim o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo. Ka o daŋ maa ʒim daa yi n-zo n-tiɛli chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa puuni zaa. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun mahili saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: While the battle raged on, King Ahab remained propped up in his chariot, facing the Syrians. The blood from his wound ran down and covered the bottom of the chariot, and at evening he died.

dag: A ŋmaag o bipolitali saha dabisa jia, ka chɛ ka o di vi.
en: You have made him old before his time and covered him with disgrace.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti garigi zuɣusaa ka di mi garigi tiŋgbani.
en: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, dindina ka tim ma kom maa ka n nyu, ka kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ma bee ka n ti lan ka kpe na ni n ti ŋɔŋ kom yaha.
en: Sir, the woman said, give me that water! Then I will never be thirsty again, nor will I have to come here to draw water.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni paɣi ma. Hal yɔbahi mini taatahi gba ni paɣi ma, dama n ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni n-ti n ni pii ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.

dag: O daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa a ba ni daa ʒili ti la? .
en: What do you advise me to do? he asked. What shall I say to the people who are asking me to make their burdens lighter.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun chaŋ alizanda ni nti be Naawuni nudirigu polo n-su malaikanim mini bɛn su fukumsi ni bɛn nyɛ yikolaannim la.
en: Now he has gone into heaven. He is at Gods right side and rules over angels, authorities, and powers.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim birim, ka saɣim bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ni bɔhi bɛ wuna mini bɛ kpiimba ni bukpahinima ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: I am going to frustrate the plans of the Egyptians and destroy their morale. They will ask their idols to help them, and they will go and consult mediums and ask the spirits of the dead for advice.

dag: ni Arivadnim ni Zɛmarinim ni Hamatinima. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Keenannim daa ti yɛligi chaŋ katiŋa.
en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. The different tribes of the Canaanites spread out.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nira niŋ siɣa ni yɛm dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Zuɣur ayopɔin maa nyɛla zoya ayopɔin shɛŋa zuɣu paɣ maa ni du n-ʒiya;.
en: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin m-pahi zim bihi biɛla.
en: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe.

dag: Ka Musa daa kana ti yɛli niriba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm min o ni zali shɛm zaa, ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa, ti ni niŋ li.
en: Moses came and told the people all the LORDs words and all the case laws. All the people answered in unison, Everything that the LORD has said we will do.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun vihiri ninsalinim suhuri mi din be o Shia Kasi tɛha ni, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-deeri suhiri tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda kaman Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God already knows our deepest thoughts. And he understands what the Spirit is saying, because the Spirit speaks for his people in the way that agrees with what God wants.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N sa zahimla zahindi ka di yɛla muɣisi ma pam ka m bɔri ni m baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then the king said to them: I had a dream, and Im anxious to know its meaning.

dag: Ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti dol o ba chaŋ puu ni kachɛriba sani.
en: One day while the boy was still young, he was out in the fields with his father, where the workers were harvesting the crops.

dag: ka Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Next came the tribe of Manasseh. Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the commander of that group.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Ɛfɛsus ka nyɛ bɛn ʒe yim Yisa Masia san la.
en: Greetings from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. I am an apostle because that is what God wanted. To Gods holy people living in Ephesus, believers who belong to Christ Jesus.

dag: Pahimiya n zuɣu ka ti tibigi Yawɛ, ka chɛliya ka ti laɣim duh o.
en: Proclaim with me the Lord 's greatness; let us praise his name together!.

dag: bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒii bunahi zuɣu, ka mali kpiŋkpama anahi.
en: But each one of them had four faces and four wings.

dag: Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔ yɛla ka man Dauda lee lan yɛn yɛl a yaha? Dama a mi man a dabili Dauda.
en: What more can I say to you! You know me, your servant.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka o biɛhigu be tibi, di so ni o nyɛ bundana ka nyɛ bilikɔɣino o tuma ni.
en: Better to be poor and honest than rich and dishonest.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ kuruwa shɛli zahindi biŋkuma mini yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛli zahindi binshɛŋa din nyɛ zaɣ kom saɣila taba. Kuruwa pia n-nyɛ tahili. Tahili n-nyɛ sokam ni yɛn zaŋdi shɛli zahindi binyara.
en: The ephah and the bath must be the same size: A bath and an ephah must both equal / homer. Those measures will be based on the homer.

dag: Ka Jabɛshinim maa daa yɛli Naa Nahash, Biɛɣuni ti sa ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a, ka a niŋ ti a ni bɔri shɛm.
en: So they told the Ammonites, We will surrender to you tomorrow, and then you can do whatever you want to.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa bela o ko ka chɛ shɛba? Bɔ ka a yura maa lee zaŋ gar o taba ka a ti yɛli ti lala?.
en: Most beautiful of women, is your lover different from everyone else? What is there so wonderful about him that we should give you our promise?.

dag: din galisi neei Masia kum ni n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo alizanda ni la nyɛla yim.
en: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.

dag: N ni ti lan zaŋ nyin Izraɛl leei m paɣa sahakam ni wuntizɔbo mini yɛlimaŋli ni yurilim pam ni nambɔzɔbo.
en: I will take you for my wife forever; I will take you for my wife in righteousness and in justice, in devoted love, and in mercy.

dag: Niriba, niŋmiy o naani sahakam. Yɛlimiy o yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛlikam zaa, Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: People, always put your trust in God! Tell him all your problems. God is our place of safety. Selah.

dag: Yi yi da Yɛhudia nira ka o leei dabili, o ni tum yi tuma yuma ayɔbu, ka yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, di simdi ka yi chɛ ka o chaŋ yoli, ka ku yo shɛli.
en: If you buy a Hebrew slave, then that slave will serve for only six years. After six years, he will be free, and he will have to pay nothing.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni dabiɛm mini ni sɔhibu.
en: Serve and honor the Lord ; be glad and tremble.

dag: ka yɛli ma, Kɔniilius, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina shɛm la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: He said, Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.

dag: amaa ka o daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa. Bɛ daa kul ʒiɛla tiŋ maa dunol kam ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa gu ni bɛ ku o.
en: However, he found out about their scheme. They were keeping watch at the city gates around the clock so they could assassinate him.

dag: Ka kom zo n-tiɛli n zuɣu, ka n yɛli, N ku be.
en: Water began to close over me, and I thought death was near.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, ka ti leei n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Then you will live in the land I gave your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: M bia, alahichinim yi kpɛhir a kɔre, nyin di saɣi.
en: My child, when sinners tempt you, don't give in.

dag: Dama bia maa yi bi doli ma kuli, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi labi m ba sani? N zɔri ni n nini nya zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn paai m ba maa.
en: I cannot go back to my father if the boy is not with me. I am very afraid of what would happen to my father.

dag: N ni bɔhim so shɛli din ka galimi yɛla. Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn ka n sanna? N ni mali biɛhigu din viɛla n suhu ni n yiŋa.
en: My conduct will be faultless. When will you come to me? I will live a pure life in my house.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela daɣiri mini saɣiri zuliya shɛb sani.
en: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: Hezekiah prayed before the Lord and said, Lord , God of Israel, you sit as King above the Cherub angels. You alone are the God who rules all the kingdoms on earth. You made heaven and earth.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima ka tummiya di tuma; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.

dag: Lihim pakoya bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: Show respect for widows who really are all alone.

dag: Di niŋya niriba bina fabu naani; yi mi di zaŋya tahima yoli niŋ ŋmɛnditoli tuma ni. Hal yi daazichi yi zoori pahira, yin di niŋya li naani.
en: Dont trust in violence; dont set false hopes in robbery. When wealth bears fruit, dont set your heart on it.

dag: Lala ka a daa yu pagɔrisigu tuma a bilim ni, ka Ijiptinim daa tabisi a paɣisari biha ka zaŋ a saɣim la.
en: And she longed for the days when she was a young prostitute, when men enjoyed caressing her body.

dag: Bɛ yi ti bi niŋ a yɛda bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ dihi a ni tuui niŋ shɛli ŋɔ tabili; di pa shɛli bɛ ni niŋ din pahi ayi ŋɔ yɛda.
en: The Lord said, If they will not believe you or be convinced by the first miracle, then this one will convince them.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba pahi, Ka daɣila yi na kul bi baŋ.
en: And you still don't understand? he asked them.

dag: ka daa zaŋ a dan maa yili ti a, ka zaŋ o paɣiba ti a, ka zaŋ Izraɛl mini Juda ti a pahi. Ka dimbɔŋɔ yi di pɔra, n naan ti a din gari lala pahi.
en: and even gave you his house and his wives. I let you rule Israel and Judah, and if that had not been enough, I would have given you much more.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bah o niriba zuɣu, ka o zaŋ o nuu ŋme n-ku ba, ka zoya sɔhigi, ka bɛ kpi n-do solɔri zuɣu kaman saɣiri la. Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa na kul bi chɛ, amaa ka o na kul kpuɣ o nuu gu.
en: This is why the LORDs anger burned against the people: he extended his hand to strike them, the mountains trembled, and their corpses lay in the middle of the streets like dung. Even then Gods anger didnt turn away; Gods hand was still extended.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, o mali buchi; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda la sani, o nyɛla bɛ ni booni so: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi, ka di yipa leei kuɣ gahindili la.
en: This stone is of great value for you that believe; but for those who do not believe: The stone which the builders rejected as worthless turned out to be the most important of all.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu pam. So ku tooi baŋ o galisim maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Lord is great and is to be highly praised; his greatness is beyond understanding.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani ŋun yɔhim dunia zaa la min o malaikanima m-bahi dunia ni na.
en: So the great dragon was thrown down. The old snake, who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world, was thrown down to the earth; and his angels were thrown down with him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ti yɛli Jɛzibɛl, Ti lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o.
en: It was then reported to Jezebel, Naboth was stoned. Hes dead.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi kpi, bɛ tahima naaya; ka bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: When the wicked die, their hope perishes. Yes, any hope based on money perishes.

dag: Di saha ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli naa Bɔ n-niŋ ka ba kpiŋ ŋɔ doli yɛri n dan naa zilima lala? Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: Zeruiahs son Abishai said to the king, Why should this dead dog curse my master the king? Let me go over and cut his head off.

dag: Dama a zaŋ alibarika pam na ti ti o; ka zaŋ salima alali nam zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ka a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa taai duŋ niŋ maa. Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Aduna ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o.
en: Thus you and your entire community have assembled against the LORD. But Aaron, what is he that you complain about him.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bɔŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi bɛ taba alaka ni deeri pin shɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Here is what God has planned for those who are evil. This is what cruel people will get from God All-Powerful.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Dolintab biɛr biɛɣu dolibu saɣindi biɛrisuŋ.
en: Do not be fooled. Bad companions ruin good character.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa. Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la ni bɛ so miri ka o chaŋ o dɔɣiri so kuyili nti kpe daɣiri ni.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Say to the priests, Aarons sons: None of you are allowed to make yourselves unclean by any dead person among your community.

dag: dama di naan nyɛla buɣim din ni di hal ni gballi puuni ka di naan di m puu atam zaa.
en: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.

dag: Ka a bih ayi shɛb a ni pun dɔɣi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni pɔi ka n naanyi kul a sanna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na la nyɛla m bihi. Ifriim mini Manaasa nyɛla m bihi kaman Rubin mini Simiɔn ni nyɛ m bihi shɛm la.
en: Now, your two sons born to you in the land of Egypt before I arrived in Egypt are my own. Ephraim and Manasseh are just like Reuben and Simeon to me.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Malɔn pakoli Rut ŋun nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba ni leegi m paɣa. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa, ka o yuli ni be o niriba ni min o ya. Ka yinim mi n-di di shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You are also witnesses that I have agreed to marry Mahlon's widow Ruth, the Moabite woman. This will keep the property in his family's name, and he will be remembered in this town.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu Izraɛl fɔntinsi zuɣu n-daa tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni nɛma ni daa be fɔntin shɛŋa ni zaa Naftali tiŋgban ni.
en: Ben-hadad agreed with King Asa and sent his army commanders against the cities of Israel, attacking Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, and all the store-cities of Naphtali.

dag: saha shɛl o ni daa zali saa ni yɛn miri shɛm, ka zali saa nyaɣisibu ni yɛn chani shɛm la.
en: He decided where to send the rain and where the thunderstorms should go.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N tɛha pala yi tɛha, ka yi soya mi pala n soya.
en: My plans arent your plans, nor are your ways my ways, says the LORD.

dag: Chɛ ka Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu nim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka Juda tinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, a saria karibu zuɣu.
en: Mount Zion is happy, and the towns of Judah rejoice, because your decisions are fair.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛli, M mabihi, m bi mi ni o nyɛla maligumaaniba zuɣulana; dama di sabiya, Miri ka a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalim a zuliya zuɣulana. .
en: Paul replied, Oh! I didn't know he was the high priest. The Scriptures do tell us not to speak evil about a leader of our people.

dag: Bɛ kul mɛrila buɣili Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Vinvamli ni la jɛmbu shee ni bɛ zaŋdi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyɔri buɣim, ka di pala n ni zali shɛli, ka mi pala din yi n tɛha ni na.
en: They have built shrines at Topheth in the Ben-hinnom Valley to burn their sons and daughters in the fire, although I never commanded such a thing, nor did it ever cross my mind.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ zuɣuri chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi pɔbi bɛ noya.
en: The leaders of the people would stop talking;.

dag: A yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a ni baŋ ni n ni daa niŋ shɛlikam maa, pa yoli ka n daa niŋ lala di ni maa, ka a suhu ni maai. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Seeing their ways and their deeds will bring you some consolation, because then you will understand what Ive done, and that I didnt do any of these things without cause. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, tiligim ma, ka n dol a zaligunim din yi a nol ni na maa.
en: Show me your faithful love and let me live. I will do whatever you say.

dag: O ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma ata saha shɛli, ka o daa tim o kpambaliba, Bɛnheel mini Obadia ni Zakaria ni Nɛtanɛl ni Mikaya ni bɛ chaŋ Juda fɔntinsi ni ti wuhi niriba.
en: In the third year of Jehoshaphat's rule, he chose five officials and gave them orders to teach the Lord 's Law in every city and town in Judah. They were Benhail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi deei farigu yaɣi bɛ ni zali ya ni yi deemi shɛm tariga.
en: He told them, Dont take more taxes from people than you have been ordered to collect.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman awa muna ata saha, ka Ananias paɣ daa kpɛna ka bi mi din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: About three hours later his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli. O gbaar omaŋa o sujee puuni waawaayili, ka bi chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili dii chani tooni.
en: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn kpalim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ba yuri Yisifu pam gari bɛn nyɛ o biɛyanim maa zaa maa, ka bɛ daa je Yisifu di zuɣu, ka bi tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ni suhumahili.
en: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of his brothers, they hated him and couldnt even talk nicely to him.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim Jɛhudi ni o ti zaŋ gbaŋ maa na. Ka o daa zaŋ li Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa duu maa ni na nti karim li wuhi naa mini kpambaliba bɛn zaa daa ʒe naa sani maa.
en: So King Jehoiakim sent Jehudi to get the scroll. Jehudi brought the scroll from the room of Elishama the scribe. Then Jehudi read the scroll to the king and all the servants who stood around the king.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niɣi kpe baɣa pam, ka di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi bahira. Di chɛ ka ti doli solɔri kuhiri nandahima kumsi.
en: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.

dag: So yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi.
en: Suppose there is a truly good man, righteous and honest.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka n sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa ŋma la ni m-pa di zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Make two more stone tablets like the first two that were broken. I will write the same words on these stones that were written on the first two stones.

dag: Obil ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la daa lihirila laakumnima, ka Jɛdɛiya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrɔnɔt nir la daa lihiri bunsi, ka Jaziz ŋun daa nyɛ Hagiri nir la mi daa lihiri piɛri mini buhi.
en: in charge of the camels—Obil the Ishmaelite; in charge of the female donkeys—Jehdeiah the Meronothite.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn daa yi Damaskus na ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Zobahs King Hadadezer, David killed twenty-two thousand of them.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o chɛ ka mahim maa lab nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia kaman Ahaz ni daa buɣisi wuntaŋ chandi yɛla zali shɛm la.
en: Then Isaiah prayed, and the Lord made the shadow move back ten steps. It went back up the steps that it had already been on.

dag: n-yiini Naawuni dabili Musa mini Piɛbil la yilli n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa, a tuma nyɛla tuun kara ni alahiziba tuma! Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa ŋɔ, a soya nyɛla din tuhi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli!.
en: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: Great and wonderful are the things you do, Lord God All-Powerful. Right and true are your ways, Ruler of the nations.

dag: Yinim danyuriba, yiɣisimiya kum; yinim wain nyuriba zaa, kummiya wain nyaɣisili la zuɣu, dama yi noli ŋmaala di nyubu maa.
en: Wake up and weep, you drunkards; cry, you wine-drinkers; the grapes for making new wine have been destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa yiɣisi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei la ka bɛ zaa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka bɛ yino bi kpalim ka bi du.
en: So David and all the troops who were with him got up and crossed the Jordan River. By daybreak there was no one left who hadnt crossed the Jordan.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ daa malila bidibis ayi, ka bɛ daa ti chaŋ puu ni ti zabi, ka so kani ŋun ni goo ba, ka yino daa ŋme n-ku ŋun la.
en: Your servant had two sons, but the two of them fought in the field. No one could separate them, and one struck the other and killed him.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi tuumbiɛri galisiya, ka yi daalahichi gba galisi pam. Yi nahindi wuntizɔriba, ka diri birapu, ka kariti tarimba bahira.
en: I know how many are your crimes, and how numerous are your sins— afflicting the righteous, taking money on the side, turning away the poor who seek help.

dag: Ka n ni yɛn ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni maa zuɣu, n takɔbi ni yi di tɔɣu ni n-ku sokam bɛn be nudirigu polo mini nuzaa polo zaa.
en: I will use my sword against everyone from south to north.

dag: Ka o mini Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni, ka bɛ to jina m-bɔri soli ni bɛ ku o.
en: He also talked and disputed with the Greek-speaking Jews, but they tried to kill him.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ n di domi baalim; ŋ-ŋɔ n di gbihiya; di nyaaŋa ka n di vuhi.
en: If I had died when I was born, I would be at peace now. I wish I were asleep and at rest.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be salo maa ni yɛli Yisa, Karimba, kpahim a nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni ka bɛ fo.
en: Some of the Pharisees from the crowd said to Jesus, Teacher, scold your disciples! Tell them to stop.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yawɛ di saɣi ka n niŋ n dan ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ŋɔ lala. O di saɣi ka n zaŋ n nuu shih o, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bihi so zuɣu ni.
en: He said to his men, I pray the Lord never lets me do anything like that to my master again. I must not do anything against Saul, because he is the Lord s chosen king. .

dag: Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim ni daa nya ka bɛ kumdi Atad kabɔɣili maa shee maa, ka bɛ yɛli, Nandahima titali kumsi ka Ijiptinim ŋɔ kumdi ŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛbɛl Mizraim; ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli.
en: The Canaanites saw this and said, The Egyptians are in great sorrow. Then they named the place Egypt in Sorrow.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani; dinzuɣu ka n chɛ o niŋ sarika ni hal ni saha shɛli n ni ni ti tooi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Naa Siiza sani.
en: However, Paul appealed that he be held in custody pending a decision from His Majesty the emperor, so I ordered that he be held until I could send him to Caesar.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa luri Naawuni sizuura ŋɔ, kamiyana ka n ti yɛli ya o ni tum shɛli ti ma ka yi wum.
en: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa dɔɣi Nahɔr maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Serug had more children and died at the age of .

dag: Ka Balaam garigi yɛl o, N di yɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni..
en: He answered and said, Dont I have to take care to speak whatever the LORD gives me to say.

dag: Amaa niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi bɛna, di deeya binshɛli zali bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaashee n-tiligi ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi. Niŋmiya bɛ ʒim mihi sara maligu bimbini, ka zaŋ bɛ kpam nyo buɣim mali sara; di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: However, all first-born cattle, sheep, and goats belong to me and cannot be bought back. Splatter their blood on the altar and send their fat up in smoke, so I can smell it and be pleased.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli. Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: Yes, God even knows how many hairs you have on your head. Dont be afraid. You are worth much more than many birds.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o suhu ni, Di simdi ni n zaŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli sɔɣi Ibrahimma?.
en: when the LORD said, Will I keep from Abraham what Im about to do?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: When this was reported to David, he sent men to meet them because they were completely ashamed. The king said, Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown. Then you can come back.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: they do not need to honor their father. In this way you disregard God's command, in order to follow your own teaching.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira balibu kam, ka dabiɛm daa kpe sokam.
en: Many wonders and miraculous signs were happening through the apostles, and everyone felt great respect for God.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan maa mini anzinfa ni binyɛrigu maa ni salin kpilli maa ni o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi ni o niɣi ni o bunsi ni o piɛri ni o suɣili ni o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa n-chaŋ Akɔr Vinvamli ni.
en: Then everyone took Achan and the things he had stolen to Trouble Valley. They also took along his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else that belonged to him.

dag: Ti Duuma niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba. .
en: The Lord did this, and it is wonderful to us. Psalm :-.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin maa ni yino kana nti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun du n-ʒi kulisi koma zuɣu ŋɔ saria karibu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls spoke with me. Come, he said, I will show you the judgment upon the great prostitute, who is seated on deep waters.

dag: To, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ sunsuuni, a tɛhiya ni ŋuni n-lee lihi ŋmɛnditoya ni daa liri do so maa kaman o ʒiʒiinikpee.
en: Then Jesus said, Which one of these three men do you think was really a neighbor to the man who was hurt by the robbers.

dag: Sulemaana daa diri n-sula na shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli zaŋ hal ti paai Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ti kpa Ijiptinim tiŋgbɔŋ tariga; ka bɛ daa yɔri farigu o sani ka jɛmd o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Solomon ruled over all the states from the Euphrates River through the Philistines land and as far as the border of Egypt. These areas brought tribute to Solomon and served him all the days of his life.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ku chaŋ. Amaa di nyaaŋa ka o suhu ti lɛbigi ka o chaŋ.
en: His son told him he would not do it, but later he changed his mind and went.

dag: O wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu; ka di chɛ ka n ni tooi zaŋ n nuhi dahim daanya tɔbu.
en: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.

dag: Ka din pahi pinaayɔbu daa gbaai Hanania min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Ŋun pah anu n-daa nyɛ Abital bia Shɛfatia. Ŋun pah ayɔbu n-daa nyɛ Itiriam o paɣ Ɛgila bia.
en: The fifth son was Shephatiah. His mother was Abital. The sixth son was Ithream. His mother was Eglah, Davids wife.

dag: A yiŋ bindira din galisi la ka bɛ dira; ka a tiri ba bin suma din be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔra ka bɛ nyura.
en: They get strength from all the good things in your house. You let them drink from your wonderful river.

dag: Ka di daa shiri niŋ o lala, dama niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: And that is just what happened to him—he died, trampled to death by the people at the city gate.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu;.
en: It was now very late in the day. Jesus followers came to him and said, No one lives around here, and it is already very late.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri galisiya gari n zabiri. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ ku ma galisiya pam, ka n dimnim ŋmari ʒiri pari ma. Bɛ chɛ ka n yola n ni bi zu neen shɛŋa samli.
en: More numerous than the hairs on my head are those who hate me for no reason. My treacherous enemies, those who would destroy me, are countless. Must I now give back what I didnt steal in the first place?.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋ kam ni daa laɣimmi mali shili gu ni bɛ mini ŋunkam kana ni o ti liri ba zaŋ nya taba. Ka niriba bɛn daa be luɣ shɛlikam daa zɔri ba ka so ku tooi zani bɛ tooni.
en: The Jews met together in their cities in all the provinces of King Xerxes so that they would be strong enough to attack the people who wanted to destroy them. No one was strong enough to stand against them. They were afraid of the Jews.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a shɛm polo, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli, bɛ daa bi ŋmaag a nyuɣu; bɛ daa bi su a kom n-yihi a biɛri ni bee n-niŋ kpam ʒe a bee n-zaŋ chinchini pil a.
en: Jerusalem, on the day you were born, there was no one to cut your navel cord. No one put salt on you and washed you to make you clean. No one wrapped you in cloth.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda gba daa tɔɣisi ŋun Yisa yɛla n-yɛli: N kul nyarila n Duuma n sani sahakam; o bela n nudirigu polo ni di chɛ ka n suhu ku zɔhira:.
en: What David said are really the words of Jesus, I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ti naai ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa Masia zuɣu la sanna, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni tuma niŋ ti gba nuu ni.
en: All of these new things are from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and who gave us the ministry of reconciliation.

dag: Zɔn tital la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zaŋ tabili di kazala la zaa mɛbu ni, bɛ daa yi zaŋla kuɣikpɛra m-me kulis ata, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: The walls around the palace courtyard were made out of three layers of cut stones with one layer of cedar beams, just like the front porch and the inner courtyard of the temple.

dag: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maa binʒim mini biŋkpam mali sara maa ni ti su nudirigu gbali, ka di leeg o tarili.
en: to the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpuɣi puri maa atam, yin pum li sɔŋ ʒiibunu n-vaai di yim zuɣu ti Firawuna, ka yi mi zaŋ di ʒiibunahi la ka yi mini yi yiŋnim ni yi bihi di, ka chɛ di shɛli zali nti biri.
en: At harvest time, you must give one-fifth of your crops to Pharaoh. You can keep four-fifths for yourselves. You can use the seed you keep for food and planting the next year. Now you can feed your families and your children.

dag: Ka Sintani daa ti yiɣisi lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, m-piɛli Dauda ni o kali Izraɛlnima.
en: Satan was against the Israelites. He encouraged David to count the Israelites.

dag: M mabiyurisi, yi yi nyari wahala din be kaman buɣim ka di paari ya ni di buɣisi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya kaman di nyɛla din na ʒi n-niŋ so n-niŋdi ya maa.
en: Dear friends, dont be surprised about the fiery trials that have come among you to test you. These are not strange happenings.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan yɛli Kɔra, Yinim Lɛvi zuliya ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Moses continued to speak to Korah. Listen, you Levites!.

dag: yin karimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa mini kuriti mali wun shɛŋa zaa, ka wurim bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars.

dag: Ka n yi ti lan ka yi sanna yaha, yi ni mali daliri din ni chɛ ka yi maan paɣi Yisa Masia n ni lab yi sanna maa zuɣu.
en: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ teebul la na ti mal li zali di zaashee di puuni; ka zaŋ firilatamdigu la na nti zaŋ di firilanim la tam di zuɣu.
en: Bring in the table and place the equipment on it. Also bring in the lampstand and set up the lamps on it.

dag: ka tiŋgbani daa bɔɣi, ka bɛ mini Kɔra zaa lu di ni ka buɣim di bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ kpi, ka tiŋgbani maa mum ba niŋ; ka di leei saɣisigu yɛlli ʒiɛya la.
en: The ground opened and swallowed them, and they died with Korah and his followers when fire destroyed men; they became a warning to the people.

dag: Daadamnim mini yɔnaɣila kara ni naɣila pola zaa ni ti lu n-doya. Bɛ ʒim ni ti zo n-tiɛli bɛ tiŋgbani, ka tiŋgbani maa nyu bɛ kpam tiɣi.
en: Wild oxen will fall with them, steers with mighty bulls, and their land will be drenched with blood; its soil soaked with fat.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul kuhirimi ni n suhu zaa, garigim ma, n ni dol a zaligunima.
en: With all my heart I call to you; answer me, Lord , and I will obey your commands!.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri gadamanim nyuli, a mi di pii bɛ soya shɛli doli.
en: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.

dag: Di saha paɣisarili maa ba min o ma bɛn zaŋmi paɣ maa paɣipalitali shihira na ti wuhi tiŋ maa kpamba dunɔdali gbini.
en: If this happens, the young woman's parents are to take the blood-stained wedding sheet that proves she was a virgin, and they are to show it in court to the town leaders.

dag: Bɛ gahindila bindira pu shɛŋa din pa bɛ dina ni, ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha ninvuɣ biɛɣu wain tihi puu ni.
en: They have to work in the fields, harvesting grain. They work for the rich, gathering grapes in their vineyards.

dag: yinim bɛn zaŋ ʒim me Ziɔn, ka zaŋ tuumbiɛri me Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: You are building God's city, Jerusalem, on a foundation of murder and injustice.

dag: Din ni chɛ ka n tooi nyaŋ niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul tumdi ka mɔra, yiko shɛli Masia ni ti ma ka di tumdi di tuma pam n ni la zuɣu.
en: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn be n san la puhiri ya.
en: Greet all Gods people in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters with me send you their greeting.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ gba na yoli niŋla tuuba, ka tum din tuhi n sani din nyɛ yi ni daa ti tab yolisim ka daa lo alikauli n sani n jɛmbu duu puuni la.
en: Just a few days ago you changed your minds and did what pleased me. All of you agreed to set all Israelites free, and you made a covenant in my presence, in the Temple where I am worshiped.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti tam Taai yɛla yuun pisopɔin din nyɛ naa yuusim tariga la. Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti paai, Taai ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ pagɔr so yɛla yili yilli.
en: The city of Tyre will be forgotten for years, which is the lifetime of a king. Then Tyre will be like that evil woman in the song:.

dag: nti suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili. Ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: They begged him to let the sick at least touch the edge of his cloak; and all who touched it were made well.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ayuba bidibisi maa min o bipuɣinsi maa daa ti be bɛ biɛlikpɛm yiŋa n-diri bindira ka nyuri wain;.
en: One day Jobs sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brothers house.

dag: O chɛ ka n niŋgbuŋ nya wahala, ka kabi n kɔba.
en: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka o daa ŋoli bɛ ni yi.
en: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped.

dag: Di saha ka kpambaliba daa yɛli naa, Doo ŋɔ simdila kubu, o ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-chɔɣisiri tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim tiŋ ŋɔ ni mini niriba zaa kɔba ni maa zuɣu. Dama doo ŋɔ bi bɔri niriba maa zaɣ viɛlli, bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu ka o naɣ bɔra.
en: So the four of them went to the king and said, You should put Jeremiah to death, because he is making the soldiers and everyone else lose hope. He isn't trying to help our people; he's trying to harm them.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Napaɣ Ɛsta ka o ʒe zɔŋ maa ni maa, ka o suhu gbaag o, ka o kpuɣ o salima nam jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni maa tir o. Ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ ti shihi jaaŋgbee maa zuɣu ni.
en: When the king saw Queen Esther standing outside, she won his favor, and he held out to her the gold scepter. She then came up and touched the tip of it.

dag: Bɛ yi ti muɣisi ya tin shɛl ni, yin yimiya ni n-taɣi tiŋa; dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi na ku chaŋ tuui Izraɛl tinsi zaa ka Daadam Bia labina.
en: When you are treated badly in one city, go to another city. I promise you that you will not finish going to all the cities of Israel before the Son of Man comes again.

dag: Ka ti daa ku bɛ zaa, ka ku tiŋ kam nima dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi zaa kaman ti ni daa niŋ Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn shɛm la.
