en: We placed them under the ban, just as we did with Sihon, Heshbons king. Every town—men, women, and children—was under the ban.

dag: Amaa doo yi chirigi paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti doo mɔɣu ni n-gbaag o goli, dindina do so ŋun gol o maa kɔŋko ka bɛ ni ku.
en: Suppose a man out in the countryside rapes a young woman who is engaged to someone else. Then only the man is to be put to death;.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya ba, ku lan nya ba, bɛ yanim ku lan nya ba.
en: The wicked will disappear from the place where they used to live;.

dag: Yi ni ti yi n-chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli, ka ti lab kuli ni suhudoo. Zoya mini kunkuna ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka mɔɣu ni tihi mi ti kpahi di nuhi.
en: Yes, you will go out with celebration, and you will be brought back in peace. Even the mountains and the hills will burst into song before you; all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kul ka fahim?.
en: Jesus said to them, You are still no more intelligent than the others.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn mali wumpaɣibo sara ti man Yawɛ, yin malimiya li din ni chɛ ka n deei li yi sani.
en: When you offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the Lord , follow the rules so that you will be accepted;.

dag: Pita noli daa na bi lu tiŋa ka sagban piɛlli dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: While he was talking, a shining cloud came over them, and a voice from the cloud said, This is my own dear Son, with whom I am pleased—listen to him.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani m-pah o zuɣu.
en: Then every nation will know that the Lord is the only true God.

dag: O daa kul kahigila dimbɔŋɔ gbinni zaa viɛnyɛliŋga wuhi ba. Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni.
en: He said this plainly. But Peter took hold of Jesus and, scolding him, began to correct him.

dag: M bi tɛhi ni n nyɛla ŋun pɔri tuun shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I do not think that I am the least bit inferior to those very special so-called apostles of yours!.

dag: Di saha ka nyaandol so ŋun daa daŋ siliga maa gbini paabu la gba kpe di ni nti nya ka niŋ yɛda.
en: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛn puhi chu shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu Yoobu Chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, di daa nyɛla kikaa saha.
en: That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival.

dag: O daa yɛli ba ni bɛ suhim Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu n-kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ ba pahi Babilɔn baŋdiba shɛb bɛn kpalim la zuɣu ku.
en: He told them to pray to the God of heaven for mercy and to ask him to explain the mystery to them so that they would not be killed along with the other advisers in Babylon.

dag: Asiba kurig awɛi saha ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu maa.
en: It was nine o'clock in the morning when they crucified him.

dag: Ka Ahazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Ahaziah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka a min a bihi ni a tumtumdiba zaa yɛn kɔrila o yaaŋa ŋɔ puri din ni chɛ ka a dan yaaŋa maa nyari bindirigu dira. Amaa m min a dan yaaŋa Mɛfibɔshɛt n-yɛn laɣindi diri sahakam. Ziba daa malila bidibisi pinaanu ni tumtumdiba pisi.
en: You, your sons, and your servants will farm the land for your master Saul's family and bring in the harvest, to provide food for them. But Mephibosheth himself will always be a guest at my table.

dag: Amaa ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa bi tooi kari tinsi maa nima; ka Keenannim maa daa kul kpalim be tinsi maa ni.
en: The people of Manasseh were not able to defeat those cities. So the Canaanites continued to live there.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa, amaa filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee.
en: They replied, This is what you should tell them: My little finger is thicker than my father's waist.

dag: Dama Adam ka Naawuni daa daŋ nam ka naanyi ti nam Awa.
en: For Adam was created first, and then Eve.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni Judanim ni ti tiligi, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mi ti be ni alaafee. Ka bɛ ni ti yɛn booni li yu shɛli n-nyɛ: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia.
en: When he rules, Judah will be saved. The people of Jerusalem will live in safety. This will be his name: The Lord Makes Things Right For Us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka gbaai mal o ka o ba.
en: and they took the colt to Jesus. Then they threw their cloaks over the animal and helped Jesus get on.

dag: Bɛn lihi ʒiɛm bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba nyɛla alahichinima, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ nandana nirilim mali alibarika.
en: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha bɔh o, N shia di ka a sani saha shɛli doo la ni di yi o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-kana ti tuh a sol la? Pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla saha shɛli di ni simdi ni a deeri liɣiri mini binyɛra ni olivi tihi ni tihi puri ni piɛri ni niɣi ni dabidɔbba ni dabipaɣiba?.
en: Elisha asked, Don't you know that my spirit was there when Naaman got out of his chariot to talk with you? Gehazi, you have no right to accept money or clothes, olive orchards or vineyards, sheep or cattle, or servants.

dag: ka kul fo n-ʒiya saha shɛli ti Duuma ni chɛ ka di paag o maa.
en: When we suffer, we should sit alone in silent patience;.

dag: Miri ka a va n-zani naa tooni bee n-zani wɔɣira zaashee.
en: Dont brag about yourself before the king and pretend you are someone important.

dag: Hiburu paɣ yi lan yɛn dɔɣi ka yi chaŋ ni yi ti deei bia, ka nya ka bia maa nyɛla bidibiga, yin kumiy o, amaa di yi nyɛ bipuɣiŋga, yin chɛliy o.
en: When you help the Hebrew women give birth, he said to them, kill the baby if it is a boy; but if it is a girl, let it live.

dag: N daa nyɛla nachimbila, ka pumpɔŋɔ n kurigiya, amaa n na ʒi n-nya ka Yawɛ chɛ wuntizɔriba bahi bee n-nya ka bɛ bihi chani maani bara bɔri bindirigu.
en: I was young, and now I am old, but I have never seen good people left with no one to help them; I have never seen their children begging for food.

dag: Ka Aduna ti nyɔr li zaani Alikauli Adaka la gbini Yawɛ tooni pateesa la nyaaŋa jɛmbu suɣili maa puuni zaawuni hal ni asiba sahakam. Di ni ti nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Aaron will keep the light burning in the Meeting Tent before the Lord from evening until morning. This light will be outside the curtain that hangs in front of the Box that holds the Agreement. This law will continue forever.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaɣisi lahibal suŋ la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni dimnima ni di chɛ ka yi wum lahibal suŋ maa; amaa zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni pii ba la polo, bɛ nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ yurisi bɛ yaannim zuɣu.
en: According to the gospel, they are enemies for your sake, but according to Gods choice, they are loved for the sake of their ancestors.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Then they began shouting, Welcome, king of the Jews.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buri pili, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba. Vi ni ti be bɛ zaa nina ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri zaa ti nyɛ zuɣukpina.
en: They will put on sackcloth and they will tremble all over. Their heads will be shaved, and they will all be disgraced.

dag: Yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm, lala ka yi ni ti ŋub ba, bɛn ka kasi mini bɛn be kasi zaa ni tooi ŋub li.
en: Anyone, ritually clean or unclean, may eat that meat, just as he would eat the meat of deer or antelope.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kpe pam pali dunia hal ka zoya din du pam zaa ti lim.
en: It became so deep that it covered the highest mountains;.

dag: Di bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni tin shɛŋa din kɔɣili li niriba ni daa tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kul tumdi din chihiri la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka saha din ka bahigu buɣim bahi ba yoli, ka di leei din kpahiri sokam zaa zuɣu ni.
en: Remember Sodom and Gomorrah, and the nearby towns, whose people acted as those angels did and indulged in sexual immorality and perversion: they suffer the punishment of eternal fire as a plain warning to all.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu maa ni benibu zuɣu hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala. N niŋgbuŋ yaɣa pinaayi kul yiinila yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣiri nyin Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ.
en: Lord , I cannot wait to enter your Temple. I am so excited! Every part of me cries out to be with the Living God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Malimiya soli ti n niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ labi n sanna. Vuɣimiya tigbirigu kam din be bɛ soli zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, Let my people return to me. Remove every obstacle from their path! Build the road and make it ready!.

dag: Yawɛ n-tim ba ni bɛ cham gili kaai dunia ŋɔ nya.
en: The man standing among the myrtles responded, These are the ones the LORD sent to patrol the earth.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ tɔrili ŋun yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini tinvurigu ni chani shɛm tampiŋ zuɣu, ni ŋariŋ din be teeku bulli ni biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni doo mini paɣa tab laɣimbu yɛla.
en: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.

dag: Dama a daba yuri di kuɣa pam, bɛ zɔri di taŋkpaɣu nambɔɣu.
en: Your servants love her stones. They love even the dust of that city!.

dag: a ni zaŋ zali zuliya kam zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: You prepared this salvation in the presence of all peoples.

dag: Dama dabisili maa miriya. Yawɛ dabisili maa miriya; di ni ti nyɛla sagbana dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla mbusim dabisili zuliya kam sani.
en: That day is near! Yes, the Lord s day for judging is near. It will be a cloudy day, the time for judging the nations.

dag: Ka Musa daa deei tiliginsim liɣiri maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kalinli daa pani, ka nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yɛn tiligi shɛb maa sani.
en: Moses obeyed and took.

dag: N niŋ yɛda ni n ni be hal ti nya Yawɛ ni yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o niriba ni shɛm.
en: But I really believe that I will see the Lord s goodness before I die.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mɛri wuna pa shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri ni yuri binshɛŋa bi kuri ba buchi. Bɛ shɛhiranim ku tooi nya shɛli bee m-baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni di vi.
en: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.

dag: Sulemaana daa piila zuɣulaannim pinaayi ni bɛ su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa. Bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ bɔri bindira na nti tiri ŋun naa min o yiŋnima, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yi sula bindira maa bɔbu goli yiniyini yuuni kam puuni.
en: Solomon chose twelve regional officers, who took turns bringing food for him and his household. Each officer provided food from his region for one month of the year.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, Amaa n ni daa ti be soli chana nti miriti Damaskus kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka neesim titali daa ti dii yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili ma.
en: During that journey, about noon, as I approached Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven encircled me.

dag: O daa nya o la tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka lan nya o tiŋgban nɛli din ka buchi ni. O leei bintaɣirigu taɣ o. O gul o mi kaman o nimbil biɛlim la.
en: He found them wandering through the desert, a desolate, wind-swept wilderness. He protected them and cared for them, as he would protect himself.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di yi pala wunsuhigu mini nolɔbo zuɣu so ku tooi kari alizini ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Jesus answered, Throwing this kind of spirit out requires prayer.

dag: Laakumnim maa ni daa nyu kom maa naai, ka nachin kpɛm maa zaŋ nyee ni baŋa din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu pirigili mini bans ayi din nyɛ salima ka di tibisim nyɛ binzahindigu bupia ti o ni o pir o nuhi ni.
en: When she had finished, the man took an expensive gold ring and put it in her nose and put two large gold bracelets on her arms.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.

dag: ka n dimnim yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o. Ka n dimnim suhuri ni paligi n lubu zuɣu.
en: If that happens, my enemy will say, I beat him! He will be so happy that he won.

dag: N ni bo biɛhigu shee ti n niriba Izraɛlnima n-zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani, ka bɛ be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka so ku lan muɣisi ba, ka putɔɣunim ku lan liri ba kaman bɛ ni daa yi liriti ba shɛm.
en: I am giving this place to my people Israel. They will plant their trees, and they will sit in peace under those trees. They will not be bothered anymore. Evil people will not hurt them as they did at first.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka chɛ a daba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ taali ka deei bɛ suhigu; ka wuhi ba di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so viɛl shɛli; ka chɛ ka saa mi a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti a niriba maa ka bɛ di li fali ŋɔ ni.
en: listen to them in heaven. Forgive the sins of the king and of the people of Israel, and teach them to do what is right. Then, O Lord , send rain on this land of yours, which you gave to your people as a permanent possession.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga jilima zaa naaya. O nanim ŋmanila bambu dibisi bɛn bi nyari mɔri. Bɛ bela bɛn kariti ba tooni n-zɔri ka yaa kani.
en: The splendor of Jerusalem is a thing of the past. Her leaders are like deer that are weak from hunger, Whose strength is almost gone as they flee from the hunters.

dag: ni Lɔd ni Ono din daa nyɛ Nuhi Tuumbaŋdiba Vinvamli la ni.
en: in Lod and Ono, and in the Valley of the Craftsmen.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yawɛ bɛ yɛlimuɣisira zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim taai bɛ sani n-di bɛ suɣa maa gulinyaansi luɣ shɛŋa.
en: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Some time later the Lord said to Moses and Aaron:.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa yɛli Amɔs, Anabi, zom kuli Juda tiŋgban ni nti tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka nyari diri nimaani.
en: Amaziah then said to Amos, That's enough, prophet! Go on back to Judah and do your preaching there. Let them pay you for it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya nasara saria karibu ni, ka alahichinim mi ku be wuntizɔriba ni.
en: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.

dag: Amaa ka Pita mini Jɔn bɔhi ba, Naawuni sani, di luhiya ni ti wumla yi noli bee ŋun Naawuni dini? Yɛlimiya ti!.
en: Peter and John responded, Its up to you to determine whether its right before God to obey you rather than God.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-chɛ ka ti doli Masia o nasara dibu dari dibu chandi ni m-be kaman o ni ŋme tɔbu gbahi dab shɛba, ka chɛ ka ti moli Masia yɛla ka di be kaman tulaale nyom la gili luɣilikam.
en: But thank God, who is always leading us around through Christ as if we were in a parade. He releases the fragrance of the knowledge of him everywhere through us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha nti liri ba, saha shɛli Bɛnhadad mini nanim pihitanaayi bɛn daa sɔŋd o la ni daa nyu dam buɣi be bɛ suɣa ni.
en: The attack began at noon, as Benhadad and his thirty-two allies were getting drunk in their tents.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Then Jesus said to the chief priests and the officers of the Temple guard and the elders who had come there to get him, Did you have to come with swords and clubs, as though I were an outlaw?.

dag: O ni balim a pam? O ni tɔɣis a suhumahili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will it beg for mercy?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya ni yi yi kul bɔri binshɛɣukam ka suhi Naawuni, yin niŋmiya yɛda ni yi ni nya li, ka yi shiri ni nya li.
en: For this reason I tell you: When you pray and ask for something, believe that you have received it, and you will be given whatever you ask for.

dag: ka zaŋ namda kura din chahi ka bɛ shɛnshe li piri; ka zaŋ binyɛr chɛra ye, ka bɛ bindira zaa kul kuui mili ka kpe yue.
en: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses:.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti tim Kɛdɛshi din be Naftali tiŋgban ni la ti boli Barak Abinɔam bia na ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛli nyin Barak, Cham ti laɣim a niriba Tabo Zoli zuɣu m-pii ninvuɣ tuhi pia Naftali mini Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba ni.
en: She sent word to Barak, Abinoams son, from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, Hasnt the LORD, Israels God, issued you a command? Go and assemble at Mount Tabor, taking ten thousand men from the people of Naphtali and Zebulun with you.

dag: Ti suhupiɛlli la naaya. Ti wahi wabu la leela kuyila.
en: We have no more joy in our hearts. Our dancing has changed to crying for the dead.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubila n-niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni, ka lan zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni buyopɔin.
en: He shall take some of the bull's blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the lid and then sprinkle some of it seven times in front of the Covenant Box.

dag: O daa kul dolila Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o, ka kul dol o zaligu kpan shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la.
en: He clung to the LORD and never deviated from him. He kept the commandments that the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka n daa nya Piɛbil maa ni tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ni zaɣ yini, ka wum ka binnɛma anahi maa ni zaɣ yino ŋun kukoli ŋmani saa tahigu kuhi yɛli, Kamina.
en: Then I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living beings speak with a voice like thunder. It said, Come.

dag: Binshɛɣukam bɛn vuri bɛ puya zuɣu bee bɛn mali nab anahi zaa chana bee binshɛɣukam bɛn mali napɔn bɔbili, biŋgbamda zaa bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni, di dinya ba, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira.
en: whether they crawl, or walk on four legs, or have many legs.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim lan pala tinzunnim ni saamba yaha; yi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa yipa laɣim nyɛla tiŋbi yinsi ka nyɛ Naawuni yiŋnima.
en: So now you non-Jewish people are not visitors or strangers, but you are citizens together with Gods holy people. You belong to Gods family.

dag: O daa deei bɛ yɛligu hal ti dolila Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab bia Jɔram ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa la chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad nti tuhi Siria naa Hazaɛl. Ka Sirianim maa daa ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle.

dag: O yi ti dɔni, nyin kpahimmi baŋ o ni dɔni luɣ shɛli maa, ka o ti ʒeei gom bahi ka a chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli. O ni ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Be sure to notice where he lies down, and after he falls asleep, go and lift the covers and lie down at his feet. He will tell you what to do.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, o ni pɔbilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirigi o kpiŋkpama na ti to Mɔabnima.
en: The Lord says, Look! An eagle is diving down from the sky. It is spreading its wings over Moab.

dag: ka ŋun chaŋ ti bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee nyari azaaba, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ti yab Ibrahimma katiŋ ha, ka Lazarɔs be o sani.
en: While being tormented in the place of the dead, he looked up and saw Abraham at a distance with Lazarus at his side.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, dama o niriba maa suhuri daa yiɣisimi, ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ ni lab o kuɣa. Dama sokam daa kul fabindila o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zuɣu. Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Dauda Naawuni ŋɔ daa kpaŋs o suhu.
en: David was in deep trouble because the troops were talking about stoning him. Each of the soldiers was deeply distressed about their sons and daughters. But David found strength in the LORD his God.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a nya ma ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: Your followers will see me and be happy, because I trust in your word.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa bahi Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa noli yɛli Zaŋmi niriba ata kpe m-pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti yihi anabi Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ka o ku kpi.
en: Then the king ordered Ebedmelech to take with him three men and to pull me out of the well before I died.

dag: ni zuɣu nachintɛri ni bɔɣugbina bansi ni shɛlɔriti ni tulaale adakanima ni gurima.
en: the scarves, the ankle chains, the cloth belts worn around their waists, the bottles of perfume, the charms.

dag: N ni ŋuhiri pampam zuɣu, n kpalimla kɔba noli.
en: because of my intense groans. My bones are protruding from my skin.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o tim o tɔbbihi ni bɛ chaŋ ti ku ninvuɣ kuriba maa, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: This made the king so furious that he sent an army to kill those murderers and burn down their city.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Gɛshur nti zaŋ Absalom kuli Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Then he got up and went to Geshur and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.

dag: Gadamanim yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba n-zaŋdi ba doli so shɛli din bi viɛla.
en: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ daadamnim sariakarita. Yawɛ, karim ma saria ka di doli n wuntitali mini n galimi kalinsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The LORD will judge the peoples. Establish justice for me, LORD, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ni o binyɛri bɔribɔri n-kpɛhi naa sani; ka o zɔnim bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi dol o.
en: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.

dag: Amaa Yaakubu daa bi chɛ ka Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ Yisifu tizo la dol o biɛyanim maa chaŋ, dama o daa zɔrimi ni binshɛli ti niŋ o.
en: Jacob did not send Benjamin. Jacob was afraid that something bad might happen to Benjamin.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti miri Jɛrusalɛm n-nya li o dii gbaala kuhigu ka fabindi di zuɣu.
en: He came closer to the city, and when he saw it, he wept over it.

dag: Bɛ kpibu bi to, yuntisuɣu ka niriba maa tabitabi kpi, ka bɛ zaŋ wɔɣira maa chaŋ ka di pala daadam nuu n-niŋ li.
en: We may suddenly die at night. God strikes us down and we perish; he kills the mighty with no effort at all.

dag: Filistianim maa ni daa ti nya Samsin, bɛ daa dii gbaala bɛ buɣili maa paɣibu, ka yɛra, Ti buɣili maa n-zaŋ ti dim ŋun bahi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yoli, ka ku ti niriba la niŋ ti nuu ni maa.
en: When the people saw him, they praised their god, for they said, Our god has handed us our enemy, the very one who devastated our land and killed so many of our people.

dag: Ninsal yi tum o ninsal kpee taali, Yawɛ ni tim di sandaani. Amaa ninsal yi tum Yawɛ taali, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tim di sandaani? Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ ba yɛligu maa wumbu, dama Yawɛ daa pun lo ni o ni ku ba.
en: If you harm another person, God can help make things right between the two of you. But if you commit a crime against the Lord , no one can help you! But the Lord had already decided to kill them. So he kept them from listening to their father.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu daa ti miri puhibu, ka Yisa baŋ ni o saha paaya ni o chɛ dunia ŋɔ ka lab o Ba sani. Amaa o ni daa pun yur omaŋmaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni la, o daa kul yuri ba la lala hal ti yi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: It was now the day before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. He had always loved those in the world who were his own, and he loved them to the very end.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ tiligira ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun sɔɣ amaŋa.
en: Surely you are a god who hides himself, Israels God and savior.

dag: Yuuni kam puuni ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni tɔhiri anzinfa giram diba anu, ka bɛ mal li tumdi ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma.
en: We pledge ourselves to keep the commandment and pay one-third of a shekel each year for the service of our Gods house.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di bi kpan ya ni yi baŋ di dabisa bee saha shɛli m Ba Naawuni ni zal li o yiko ni.
en: Jesus said to them, The Father is the only one who has the authority to decide dates and times. They are not for you to know.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ kpam din be yiligu ni maa m-booi bah o zuɣu ni, o biɛyanim maa zaa tooni. Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Yawɛ shia daa siɣi Dauda zuɣu na pam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi labi Rama.
en: Samuel took the olive oil and anointed David in front of his brothers. Immediately the spirit of the Lord took control of David and was with him from that day on. Then Samuel returned to Ramah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpaai bɛ kawana, bɛ zaa liɣiri daa lɔnlomi be bɛ kpalansi ni, bɛ mini bɛ ba ni daa nya liɣiri maa, ka di gari ba.
en: When the brothers started emptying their sacks of grain, they found their moneybags in them. They were frightened, and so was their father Jacob.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini niriba maa daa lo alikauli dindali maa; ka o daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn doli Shɛkɛm.
en: So that day Joshua made an agreement for the people. He made this agreement at the town called Shechem. It became a law for them to follow.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa be o mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti maa sani n-yuui pam, ka daa naanyi ti chɛbisi ba ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria; ka Akuila mini Prisila gba daa dol o chaŋ. Ka Pool daa ti pin o zuɣu Sɛnkiria, dama o daa pola pɔri.
en: Paul stayed on with the believers in Corinth for many days, then left them and sailed off with Priscilla and Aquila for Syria. Before sailing from Cenchreae he had his head shaved because of a vow he had taken.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila yuri Ijipti mini tiŋgban shɛŋa din pahi zaa ni na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: Solomon imported horses from Musri and from every other country.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la kuna. Ka Jɔab daa chɛ ka Yuria kuli Dauda sani.
en: David sent a message to Joab. Send Uriah the Hittite to me. So Joab sent Uriah to David.

dag: N yi yi mɔɣ kpaŋa, n nyarila bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛb sɔŋ. Ka n yi kpe tiŋ puuni, n nyarila kum ni gbarigi shɛb sɔŋ. Ka anabinim mini maligumaaniba kul tumdi bɛ tuma tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni, ka bi mi ni binshɛli niŋda.
en: If I go into the country, I see the bodies of those killed in war. If I go into the city, I see people sick from hunger. The priests and prophets continue their work, but they dont understand what is happening.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a niriba ni, ka yili yila paɣ a zuliya kam ni.
en: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among all the peoples; I will make music to you among the nations.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pa lala ka Naawuni yɛn niŋ n zuliya? Dama o lo ma alikauli din ka bahigu; o chɛ ka di zani dɛde binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan ka taɣibu yaha. Dama o ni chɛ ka n sɔŋsim mini n suhu ni yu shɛli nya nasara.
en: Yes, my house is this way with God! He has made an eternal covenant with me, laid out and secure in every detail. Yes, he provides every one of my victories and brings my every desire to pass.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa luri tiŋgban ni, ka chɛ ka kom zɔri teeni puri.
en: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.

dag: Naawuni bi lihi ti ka ti be ti ko ka chɛ ba; dama bɛ gba yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: God treated them in the same way that he treated us. They put their faith in him, and he made their hearts pure.

dag: Jɔn daa lan wuhi niriba maa yɛla pam pah o lahibal suŋ waazu maa puuni.
en: In many different ways John preached the Good News to the people and urged them to change their ways.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa sabi tibidarigibo maa yɛla niŋ litaafi ni m-paɣ li niŋ kɔtɔɣu maa ni.
en: Then the priest shall write this curse down and wash the writing off into the bowl of bitter water.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya Yisifu ka o be katiŋ ha kanna, o daa ti yɛn paai bɛ sani, ka bɛ pun lo nia wuhi ni bɛ kum o.
en: Josephs brothers saw him coming from far away. They decided to make a plan to kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi jintɔriba maa sani n-yi ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni ni kali ba pahi bɛn simdi ni bɛ di vi Yisa yuli zuɣu kalinli ni maa zuɣu.
en: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.

dag: Lala nti yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu dali. Malaikanim ni ti kana nti gahim ninvuɣ suma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: It will be the same at the end of time. The angels will come and separate the evil people from the godly people.

dag: ni zuɣu nachintɛri ni bɔɣugbina bansi ni shɛlɔriti ni tulaale adakanima ni gurima.
en: the hats, bangles, and sashes; the amulets and charms.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya nira ni o mabia: Saimɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: As Jesus walked alongside the Galilee Sea, he saw two brothers, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, throwing fishing nets into the sea, because they were fishermen.

dag: Yi suhuri yi ye din tuhi tumbu zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ ya shɛli?.
en: If you are always trying to do good, no one can really harm you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu n-zaŋ o noli min o nina kpa bia maa noli ni o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o nuhi zuɣu; ka teeg omaŋ dolisi bia maa, ka o niŋgbuna piligi biibu.
en: Then he got on the bed and stretched out over the dead body, with his mouth on the boy's mouth, his eyes on his eyes, and his hand on his hands. As he lay there, the boy's body became warm.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu.
en: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many so that their sins may be forgiven.

dag: Mɔɣili maa kom yi zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam, binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gbamda ni niŋ nyɛvili, kom maa yi paai nimaani zahim pam ni beni. Di ni niŋ nyaɣisim. Ka mɔɣili maa kom yi paai luɣ shɛlikam binshɛɣukam ni niŋ nyɛvili.
en: This water flows into the Dead Sea so that the water in that sea becomes fresh and clean. There are many fish in this water, and all kinds of animals live where this river goes.

dag: Ka o daa kpaai kom maa n-niŋ laakumnim maa kɔnyuribin ni yomyom, ka lan guui lab kɔbiliga maa ni ni o ti ŋɔŋ na yaha n-daa ŋɔŋ kom ti o laakumnim maa zaa.
en: She emptied her water jar quickly into the watering trough, ran to the well again to draw water, and drew water for all of the camels.

dag: A mini naa yi ʒini ni yi di bindirigu, nyin kpahimmi baŋ din ʒe a tooni maa ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.

dag: n-zaŋ li bɔhi zuliya shɛb niriba biɛri, ka darigi niriba tibili;.
en: to defeat the nations and to punish the peoples;.

dag: Nabipuɣiŋga, a naba viɛli namda ni pam! A gbalipina bela polipoli kaman nyiŋgokor shɛli tuumbaŋda ni mali.
en: What a magnificent young woman you are! How beautiful are your feet in sandals. The curve of your thighs is like the work of an artist.

dag: M be a sani, ka so ku tooi niŋ a shɛli, dama m mali niriba pam tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: I am with you, and you won't be harmed. Many people in this city belong to me.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa malila anzinfa bee daanya daa zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Ka doo kam ŋun daa mali gɔpiɛliga dari din ni tooi tum tuma daa zaŋ li na.
en: Everyone who wanted to give silver or bronze brought that as a gift to the Lord . Everyone who had acacia wood came and gave it to the Lord.

dag: ka nya ka do so ŋun yuli booni Ananias kpe o sanna nti zaŋ o nuu pa o zuɣu ni o nina neei.
en: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come in and place his hands on him so that he might see again.

dag: N ni niŋ a daŋ niriba kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba mini Ahija bia Baasha daŋ niriba shɛm la, a ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi, ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu.
en: Your family will become like the family of King Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the family of King Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have stirred up my anger by leading Israel into sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu shia ni ka niŋgbun shɛl ni ni nyɛ niŋgbuŋ kpiŋ shɛm la, lala ka yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma gba nyɛ yɛda kpiŋ.
en: A persons body that does not have a spirit is dead. It is the same with faith—faith that does nothing is dead!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ bee anabi bee maligumaana yi ti bɔh a, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna lee nyɛ dini?, nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya: Yinima n-nyɛ yɛlimuɣisirili maa. N ni kari ya bahi. .
en: The Lord said to me, Jeremiah, when one of my people or a prophet or a priest asks you, What is the Lord 's message? you are to say, You are a burden to the Lord , and he is going to get rid of you.

dag: A ni me goonda shɛŋa gil a tinsi zaa ŋmanila fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi. Bɛ yi kul gbaɣiri li, di lurila ŋun yɛn di li nol ni.
en: All your fortifications are fig trees with ripe fruit; when the trees are shaken, the fruit falls into the mouth of the eater.

dag: A ni ti yɛli n ni zal a ni a yɛlim shɛlikam zaa, ka a mabia Aduna mi ti yɛli Firawuna ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: You will tell Aaron everything that I command you. Then he will tell the king what I say. And Pharaoh will let the Israelites leave this country.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va ba duhiduhi, ka bɛ nyɔni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The Egyptians piled them up in great heaps, until the land stank with them.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, hal bɛ yi yɛn kpɛh a la duu, m min a ni laɣim kpe duu maa; di mi yi nyɛla kum, m min a ni laɣim kpi.
en: But Peter said to Jesus, Lord, I am ready to go to jail with you. I will even die with you.

dag: Ka Judas mini Silas bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini la daa lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa pam kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri pahi.
en: Judas and Silas were prophets, and they spoke a long time, encouraging and helping the Lord's followers.

dag: Ka a niriba yi bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ lee niŋ ti dimbɔŋɔnim zaa? Nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi ni daa zaɣisi ma, ka jɛmdi tinzun wuna yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, lala ka yi yɛn jɛm saamba tiŋgbɔn shɛli din pa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni. .
en: When they ask why I did all these things, tell them, Jeremiah, that just as they turned away from me and served foreign gods in their own land, so they will serve strangers in a land that is not theirs.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul bela a tooni kumdi niŋd a yuŋ mini wuntaŋ ni zaa.
en: Lord God, you are my Savior. I have been praying to you day and night.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ m birini, ka n Naawuni nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri tampiŋ shɛli gbini.
en: But the Lord is my place of safety, high on the mountain. God, my Rock, is my safe place!.

dag: Ŋunkam mali maligu ti buɣili ka pa ni Yawɛ kɔŋko, yin kum dilana.
en: Whoever makes a sacrifice to a false god should be destroyed. The Lord is the only one you should make sacrifices to.

dag: ni Kɔra ni Gatam ni Amalɛk. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Ɛlifaz bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Ada yaansi.
en: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. These and Esau's other descendants lived in the land of Edom.

dag: So yi bɔhi ya, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔri ba, ka o ni chɛ ka yi dii zaŋ ba na.
en: And if anyone says anything, tell him, The Master needs them; and then he will let them go at once.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku ni daa dii sɔhiri ka o bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee pun go mɔɣu ku nimdi n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n ŋub di zaa, ka pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni pɔi ka a naanyi kana ŋɔ? O mi shiri nya alibarika.
en: Isaac was so shocked that he trembled violently. He said, Who was the hunter just here with game? He brought me food, and I ate all of it before you came. I blessed him, and he will stay blessed.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa saai kpani maa ka kpuɣi ko gaɣili maa Sool zuɣusaa ka bɛ chaŋ. So daa bi nya ba bee m-baŋ di yɛla bee so ti neei, bɛ zaa daa gbihirimi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka go titali gbahi ba.
en: David took the spear and the water jar, then left the camp. None of Saul's soldiers knew what had happened or even woke up—the Lord had made all of them fall sound asleep.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba ni bɛ labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali shɛm la.
en: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to King Rehoboam, as he had instructed them.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi mali yurilim yi bebu ni kaman Masia ni daa yu ti ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti zuɣu, ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl ŋun Naawuni san la.
en: Live a life of love. Love others just as Christ loved us. He gave himself for us—a sweet-smelling offering and sacrifice to God.

dag: Wain tiwal pɔhiriba yi ka yi sanna, bɛ ku pɔhi ka guui zaɣ yiha niŋ? Tayiɣisi yi kana yuŋ, bɛ ni kpuɣila bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko.
en: If workers would come to you to pick grapes, they would at least leave a few on the vine. If thieves would come in the night, they would take only what they needed.

dag: n-doli Izraɛl doo maa ti kpe o duu puuni n-zaŋ kpani maa kuhi Izraɛl doo maa mini paɣ maa zaa puya ni ku ba. Ka alɔbo din daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu maa daa zani tariga.
en: followed the man and the woman into the tent, and drove the spear through both of them. In this way the epidemic that was destroying Israel was stopped.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu palli bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na, dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: Good people do good things because of the good in their hearts, but bad people do bad things because of the evil in their hearts. Your words show what is in your heart.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Cham tiŋgban nɛli ni ti tuhi Musa soli. Ka o daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Naawuni zol la gbini m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Meanwhile the Lord had said to Aaron, Go into the desert to meet Moses. So he went to meet him at the holy mountain; and when he met him, he kissed him.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu; dama niriba kul durimi tamdi n zuɣu; n dimnim kul nahindi ma mi dabisili kam puuni.
en: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.

dag: Dama a suui ʒitibisi shɛli din wum ba la; ka kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli bɛ ni mali fiɛbiri bɛ bɔɣusapima la. A nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nahind a niriba kaman a ni daa nyaŋ Midian tɔbbihi shɛm la.
en: As on the day of Midian, youve shattered the yoke that burdened them, the staff on their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.

dag: dindina yi ni zɔri tɔb shɛli maa ni liri ya nimaani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka yi ni zɔri kum shɛl la ni doli ya kpe Ijipti, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: You are afraid of the sword of war, but it will defeat you there. And you are worried about hunger, but you will be hungry in Egypt. You will die there.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ piɛbil so ŋun ka galimi bee liɣisibu la ʒim din mali shaara la ka o daa zaŋ pa talima tiligi ya.
en: Instead, you were liberated by the precious blood of Christ, like that of a flawless, spotless lamb.

dag: Jɛfita ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim daa bi fa Mɔabnim tiŋgbani bee Ammɔnnim tiŋgbani.
en: and said to him, Jephthah states: Israel didnt seize the land of the Moabites or the land of the Ammonites.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim baŋ n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli din be kasi maa yaha. Ka zuliya kam ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi. .
en: I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. They will never again degrade my holy name, and the nations will know that I, the LORD, am holy in Israel.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a saɣisigu wuhiri ma soli, ka dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, a ni ti deei ma ni jilima.
en: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.

dag: O ni daa duh omaŋa o tuumbiɛri zuɣu la zuɣu, niŋmiy o nahiŋgu ka o fabili lala! Dama o yɛli o suhu ni: N dila nam ʒiya! M pala pakoli! Lala zuɣu n ku nya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Give her as much suffering and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. For she keeps telling herself: Here I sit, a queen! I am no widow, I will never know grief.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha. Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla, ka bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a nyɛla Galili tiŋbia.
en: No, I'm not! Peter replied. A little while later some of the people said to Peter, You certainly are one of them. You're a Galilean.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Doli yɛlimaŋli soli ka tummi din tuhi, dama di ku yuui ka n tiligi ya.
en: The LORD says: Act justly and do what is righteous, because my salvation is coming soon, and my righteousness will be revealed.

dag: ni Areebia nanim zaa ni zuliya gari bɛn be tiŋgban nɛli ni la nanim zaa.
en: I made all the kings of Arabia drink from the cup. These kings live in the desert.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yi ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi viɛla. Di simdi ni yi zɔri Naawuni ka tumdi din tuhi. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ku ti zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ ti dimnim la soli ka bɛ mali ti ansarisi.
en: So I continued speaking. I said, What you people are doing is not right! You know that you should fear and respect our God. You should not do the shameful things other people do!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm? A nya Izraɛlnim ni tumdi din chihiri pam shɛm kpe ni bɛ kari ma bahi katiŋa ka chɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ? Amaa a na ni nya din chihiri shɛŋa din galisi pam gari lala.
en: God then said, Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:.

dag: Di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni ti yɛn di bindirigu tiɣi, ka binshɛli ku pooi ya. Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kuɣa nyɛ kuriti, ka yi ni ti gbiri tahiʒiɛɣu di daboya zuɣu.
en: There you will have plenty of food and everything you need. It is a land where the rocks are iron. You can dig copper out of the hills.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim laɣim pahi Ibrahimma Naawuni la niriba zuɣu. Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa. Ŋuna n-simdi duhibu pam.
en: The rulers of the nations assemble with the people of the God of Abraham. More powerful than all armies is he; he rules supreme.

dag: Kpuɣimiya paɣiba n-dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bomiya paɣiba ti yi bidibisi, ka zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti dɔbba; nabimiya pahi nimaani, ka di filimya.
en: Get married and have children; then help your sons find wives and your daughters find husbands in order that they too may have children. Increase in number there so that you dont dwindle away.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa paɣi Yawɛ zama maa zaa ninni ka yɛli, Ti paɣiri nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yab Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Then David praised the Lord in front of all the people who were gathered together. David said, Lord , the God of Israel, our Father, may you be praised forever and ever!.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan bɔri ni o zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa ka daa zaŋ li ŋmaligi tahi la Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la yiŋa.
en: So David would not move the Lord s Holy Box into the City of David. He put the Holy Box at the house of Obed Edom from Gath.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn kul deeri yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa din ka buchi.
en: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Hazɛrɔt maa chaŋ ti dɔni Ritima.
en: They marched from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.

dag: Dama yi yi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni mi ni chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: If you forgive others their sins, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum lala ka saɣi ti li.
en: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. Nyin nyɛbiga ŋun bahibahi amaŋ be ko sunsuuni ka yɛra, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli. Mani n-daa gbi li.
en: Speak and say, The LORD God proclaims: Im against you, Pharaoh, Egypts king, great crocodile lurking in the Niles canals, who says, The Nile is all mine; I made it for myself.

dag: Di nyɛla ashil shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ sɔɣi niriba ʒiɛmana din gari la ha puuni, amaa ka yipa kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda pumpɔŋɔ.
en: This message is the secret truth that was hidden since the beginning of time. It was hidden from everyone for ages, but now it has been made known to Gods holy people.

dag: Sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu daaŋa ni ti nyɛla mita ayi, ka daaŋa maa zuɣu zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ti nyɛ mita ayi, ka mali binyila anahi.
en: The hearth is seven feet high, with four horns projecting upward from the hearth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti paai ya saha shɛli yi nandahima maa ni, yi ni ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani nti deeg o yɛligu.
en: When you are in trouble and all those things happen to you, then you will finally turn to the Lord and obey him.

dag: Ka Musa daa sabi Yawɛ yɛligu maa zaa sɔŋ, ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asiba me sara maligu bimbini zali zoli maa gbini, ka sa bin wɔɣila pinaayi ka di zani Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la zaani.
en: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Yi ni zaŋ suɣilo n-niŋ ania gbibi n yɛligu maa zuɣu, n ni ti yihi ya muɣisigu shɛli din yɛn paai dunia ŋɔ nim zaa la ni.
en: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.

dag: Kɛnaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Otiniɛl mini Sɛraya, ka Otiniɛl mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hatat mini Mɛɔnɔtai.
en: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai.

dag: Amaa a min a bihi yi zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka bi doli fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zali ya la, ka ŋmaligi doli buɣa jɛmdi li.
en: However, if you or your sons turn away from following me and dont observe the commands and regulations that I gave you, and go to serve other gods, and worship them.

dag: Masia yurilim n-gbibi ti, dama ti tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ yino yi daa kpi sokam zaa zuɣu, dindina sokam zaa kpimi m-bala.
en: We are ruled by the love of Christ, now that we recognize that one man died for everyone, which means that they all share in his death.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa lo Gibiɔnnim alikauli maa nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka bɛ ti wum ni Gibiɔnnim maa nyɛla bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, ka bɛ mini ba kul bela luɣ yini.
en: Three days later the Israelites learned that these men lived very near their camp.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, amaa ka daari ninvuɣ biɛri luhira.
en: The LORD helps the poor, but throws the wicked down on the dirt!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti ku yi ni chani ni yi ti deei zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka chɛ ka yi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, yi yi ti deei li ʒini bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Once the LORD your God has removed from before you all the nations that you are entering and taking possession of, and you have displaced them and are living in their land.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ti maa? Di pa shɛli ka yaŋɔnim ni so di zaŋ a paɣ maa dɔni. A naan chɛ ka di taali ʒin ti zuɣu.
en: What have you done to us? Abimelech said. One of my men might easily have slept with your wife, and you would have been responsible for our guilt.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani yi sansani maa ni chana ni o tiligi ya, ka zaŋ yi dimnim niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi sansani maa ni be kasi din ni chɛ ka o ku nya binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani ka zo ka chɛn ya.
en: Keep your camp ritually clean, because the Lord your God is with you in your camp to protect you and to give you victory over your enemies. Do not do anything indecent that would cause the Lord to turn his back on you.

dag: N kpahimya nya ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri yɛm pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhuyiɣisili. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɔri baŋsim pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhugarigu.
en: With much wisdom comes frustration. The one who gains more wisdom also gains more sorrow.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, N wumya ni kawana be Ijipti, chamiya nimaani nti da li ti ti na, ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: I hear that there is grain in Egypt; go there and buy some to keep us from starving to death.

dag: So miri ka o ti chɛ ka o bipuɣiŋga leei pagɔrili n-dih o vi, di yi pa lala, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti leei pagɔra tiŋgbɔŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali pali di ni.
en: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi biɛɣ asiba, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anab Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la n-yɛl o.
en: Before David even got up the next morning, the Lord had told David's prophet Gad.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa. Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la ni bɛ so miri ka o chaŋ o dɔɣiri so kuyili nti kpe daɣiri ni.
en: The Lord commanded Moses to tell the Aaronite priests, No priest is to make himself ritually unclean by taking part in the funeral ceremonies when a relative dies.

dag: Goli ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ goya piligu goli yi sani, dina n-yɛn nyɛ gol tuuli yi sani yuuni puuni.
en: This month is to be the first month of the year for you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ salima niŋ dapaɣa maa, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima niŋ dapuhi maa.
en: They covered the frames with gold and fitted them with gold rings to hold the crossbars, which were also covered with gold.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, ka o garigi ma. N daa bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee din zilim pam la ka kuhi bol a, ka a wum n kuhigu maa.
en: When I was in trouble, Lord , I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu maa labisi niŋ a binyɛrigu maa ni. Ka o daa lan zaŋ o nuu maa labisi niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na ka di min o niŋgbuŋ zaa lan nyɛla yim.
en: Then the Lord said, Put your hand inside your robe again. He did so, and when he took it out this time, it was healthy, just like the rest of his body.

dag: n-zaŋ o dalinli tabili ti, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: who has placed his mark of ownership upon us, and who has given us the Holy Spirit in our hearts as the guarantee of all that he has in store for us.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Bɛlishaaza nam dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa zahim zahindi n dooshee n-nya ʒii yuŋ, ka sabi zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ.
en: During the first year that Belshazzar was king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream. He saw these visions while he was lying on his bed, and he wrote what he had dreamed.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bidibis ata daa be nimaani, bɛna n-nyɛ Jɔab mini Abishai ni Asahɛl. Asahɛl daa guurimi kaman molifu la.
en: Zeruiah had three sons, Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was a fast runner, as fast as a wild deer.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Zaŋmi duɣu n-zahim manna maa lita ayi n-kpaai niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka di be nimaani yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Then Moses told Aaron, Put some manna in a jar and store it in the place of worship for future generations to see.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ bi zaŋ tulaale ŋɔ kɔhi kaman tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri n-zaŋ ti nandaamba.
en: That perfume was worth a full years pay. It should have been sold, and the money should have been given to the poor people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ka lala tɛhi zilima.
en: Good people want to do what is right for the poor, but the wicked dont care.

dag: N yuya ni yi baŋ ni timaŋ buɣisibu pala din nyaŋ ti.
en: But I hope you will see that we have not failed the test.

dag: Chɛliya ka dunianim zaa ni sɔhiri o tooni. Dunia nyɛla din ba n-ʒiɛya, ka ku lan vuui.
en: Everyone on earth, now tremble! The world stands firm, never to be shaken.

dag: dama Naawuni pala ŋun tumdi chirachira, amaa o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun tumdi din doli soli. Zaŋ chaŋ di ni be Yisa nyaandoliba cheechinim zaa ni shɛm la polo.
en: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church.

dag: Amaa bɛ daalikama mini bɛ ni daa yi booni alikama shɛli sipɛlit la, din daa bi saɣim, dama di daa bi daŋdi niŋbu.
en: But the wheat crops ripen later, and they were not damaged.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zabiri zibigi. Di simdi ka bɛ wahiri bɛ zabiri.
en: These priests will not shave their heads or let their hair grow long. The priests may only trim the hair of their heads.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be nimaani maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di saha maa, ka puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi chuɣu daba ayopɔin.
en: For seven days all the people of Israel who were present celebrated the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli sapashin maa, Kulima! A ni niŋ yɛda shɛm maa zuɣu, di ni niŋ lala. Ka o yiŋbia maa daa shiri kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Jesus said to the centurion, Go; it will be done for you just as you have believed. And his servant was healed that very moment.

dag: N di yuya ni yi ni so kpari Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoya, ka yi ku lan mali buɣim pa n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ka di ka buchi. N nini bi lan tiɣi ya, ka n ku lan deei yi ni maani sara shɛli tiri ma. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I wish one of you would close the Temple doors to stop the lighting of useless fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you. I will not accept your gifts. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli palli n ʒim ni. Kul nyumiya li waawaayili teemi n yɛla.
en: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.

dag: Riuɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza.
en: And Reuel became the ancestor of the tribes of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

dag: N daa niŋdi ba alaka waawaayili Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu kam ni, ka kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m muɣisi ba ka bɛ tu Yisa. N suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu pam maa zuɣu ka n daa du tin duya ni ni m paai ba nimaani ti niŋ ba alaka.
en: I visited all the synagogues and punished them, trying to make them curse Jesus. My anger against these people was so strong that I went to other cities to find them and punish them.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Mmaŋmaŋ kpiɔŋ puuni ka n niŋ lala. M mali yɛm, ka mali baŋsim. N daai tiŋgbana tintarisi nahi taba, ka va bɛ nɛma. N niŋmi kaman naɣilaa la n-ʒe n-yiɣisi nanima bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi.
en: The king of Assyria said, I am very wise. By my own wisdom and power I have done many great things. I have defeated many nations. I have taken their wealth and their people as slaves. I am a very powerful man.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa naan ku lan tooi zani Musa tooni yaha bintɔra maa zuɣu, dama bintɔra maa daa tola timanim maa mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: The magicians were suffering so much from the sores, that they could not even come to Moses.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔgila n-yi nimaani zaŋ gari hal ti paai Bɛtaraba nuzaa polo. Ka di tariga maa zaŋ lala hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini;.
en: Then the northern border went to Beth Hoglah and continued north of Beth Arabah. The border continued to the stone of Bohan.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a galisiya pam. A zaŋla jilima mini nam yiko ye kaman situra la.
en: Let my whole being bless the LORD! LORD my God, how fantastic you are! You are clothed in glory and grandeur!.

dag: Amaa ka yi niŋ tipawumli, ka zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi baɣaka. Yi tum tuumbiɛri pam n-gari yi yaannim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: Yet no one listened or paid any attention. Instead, you became more stubborn and rebellious than your ancestors.

dag: Asha zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: These are the clans of Ashers descendants. Their enrollment was .

dag: Yawɛ, guli n noli, gbibi n naŋgbampiba.
en: Lord , help me control what I say. Dont let me say anything bad.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o Izraɛl nanim Silisi la ni. Ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tarimba, bɛ ka yɛm, dama bɛ bi mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la.
en: Then I thought to myself, These are the poor who dont know better! They dont understand the LORDs way or the justice of their God.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ ti nya Shafat bia Ilaisha maa ka o malila naɣikɔra siɣimsiɣim bupinaayi zuɣu ka bɛ be o tooni kɔra; omaŋmaŋ n-daa mali bɛn pahiri bupinaayi maa kɔra. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti gar o sani ka pirig o binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing with a team of oxen; there were eleven teams ahead of him, and he was plowing with the last one. Elijah took off his cloak and put it on Elisha.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa doli ba na ti siɣi teeku maa sunsuuni, Firawuna yuri zaa min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la zaa.
en: Then all of Pharaohs chariots and horse soldiers followed them into the sea.

dag: Yi ni daa kpalim be Kadɛshi n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ la nyaaŋa.
en: And so you stayed in Kadesh-barnea for quite some time.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha.
en: But the Lord GOD says, By my life, I swear that people in Israel will not think this proverb is true anymore!.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ tiŋgbani kɔhi ti so ka o su li sahakam, dama tiŋgbani maa nyɛla n dini, yi nyɛla tinzunnim mini saamba n sani.
en: The land must not be permanently sold because the land is mine. You are just immigrants and foreign guests of mine.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Anyone who curses their father or mother should be put to death.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri din gari lala n-jɛndi ti Duuma NAAWUNI min o dabili Hɛzɛkia.
en: The Assyrian officials said terrible things about the Lord God and his servant Hezekiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni deei n noli ka gbibi n daalikauli, n ni zaŋ ya leei n dahalali niriba zuliya kam sunsuuni, dama mani n-su dunia zaa.
en: Now if you will faithfully obey me, you will be my very own people. The whole world is mine.

dag: Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbala din kabi, ka bɛ mali bɛ zilima yɔhindi niriba. Tinvura lɔɣu be bɛ naŋgbampiba ni.
en: Their words are full of deadly deceit; wicked lies roll off their tongues, and dangerous threats, like snake's poison, from their lips;.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu ŋun Naawuni sani; lala zuɣu di simdi ni ti maligumaana ŋɔ gba mali shɛli din ni zaŋ mali maligu.
en: Every high priest has the work of offering gifts and sacrifices to God. So our high priest must also offer something to God.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya Naawuni nam.
en: You can be sure some of the people standing here will not die before they see God's kingdom.

dag: Ka Dauda paɣiba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ti o Hiburɔn; o bidib kpɛm sani n-daa nyɛ Amnɔn, o ma n-daa nyɛ Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la.
en: The following six sons, in order of their birth, were born to David at Hebron: Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam, from Jezreel;.

dag: Di saha maa o bikpɛm sani la ŋun daa na bela puu polo nti kun na miri yiŋ na wum diɛma biŋkumda kumsi.
en: The older son had been out in the field. When he came near the house, he heard the sound of music and dancing.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba mini naa daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: The king and the leaders admitted that they had sinned, and they said, What the Lord is doing is just.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa garigi yɛli ba ni Pool be duu Siizaria, ka omaŋmaŋ mi lɔri nia ni o lab nimaani daba ayi sunsuuni.
en: But Festus told them, Paul will be kept in Caesarea, and I am soon going there myself.

dag: mini Jatir ni Ɛshitɛmɔa.
en: Jattir, Eshtemoa.

dag: yɛlimaŋli m Ba, dama lala n-viɛl a sani.
en: Yes, Father, you did this because its what you really wanted to do.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ha ka ŋmani maa daa ŋmaai olivi tia vamahili n-gbab o noli lab o sanna ŋariŋ maa ni; ka Nuhu daa baŋ ni kom maa yipa nyuuya tiŋgban ni.
en: It returned to him in the evening with a fresh olive leaf in its beak. So Noah knew that the water had gone down.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili. Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nia biɛri ŋmaligi di ba. Karim ba a sani, bɛ daalahichi din galisi pam la zuɣu; dama bɛ bi zan tuh a.
en: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, so daa yi mali sara, ka na bi yihi biŋkpam nyo buɣim, maligumaana yiŋbia kanimina ti yɛl o, Ŋmaam nim kahili ti ma ka n ti ti maligumaana ka o she, dama o ku deei nin duɣirili a sani, naɣila nim kahili.
en: But that is not what the sons of Eli did. Even before the fat was burned on the altar, their servant would go to the people offering sacrifices and say, Give the priest some meat to roast. The priest wont accept boiled meat from you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chana nti nya Matiu, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma. Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, Follow me. Matthew got up and went with him.

dag: Zoya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la? Daboya, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la?.
en: Mountains, why did you leap away like rams? Hills, why did you leap away like lambs?.

dag: Amaa yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi ni shɛb dolila Balaam wuhibu. Ŋuna n-daa wuhi Balak ka o bo kuɣituurili sɔŋ Izraɛlnim sol zuɣu ni bɛ di buɣa maligu nimdi ka tum zina la.
en: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yɛli Jɛrimia m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message from the Lord :.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ; ka paɣimiy o yuli; yɛlimiya o tiliginsim lahibali suŋ yɛla dabisili kam.
en: Sing to the Lord and praise his name! Tell the good news every day about how he saves us!.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn ʒi, ka lan ka baŋsim; yi bela zibisim ni, dunia ŋɔ tiŋgbani tanzahi zaa dammi.
en: How ignorant you are! How stupid! You are completely corrupt, and justice has disappeared from the world.

dag: Kum maa ni daa ti mii Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa saha shɛli, ka niriba daa kuhiri niŋdi Firawuna ni o tim ba bindira. Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Ijiptinim zaa, Chamiya Yisifu sani, o yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛli, yin niŋmiya li.
en: The famine began, and the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Pharaoh said to the Egyptian people, Go ask Joseph what to do.

dag: Bani daŋ — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinahinaayi.
en: of Bani.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ. Ka Judas ŋun yi o nyaaŋa maa ʒiɛya m-pahi niriba maa zuɣu.
en: They answered, Jesus from Nazareth. He said, I am Jesus.

dag: Zuliya shɛb Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ni o zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn zaa nini daa bi nya tɔb shɛŋa din tuhi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: And the Lord had another reason for letting these enemies stay. The Israelites needed to learn how to fight in war, just as their ancestors had done. Each new generation would have to learn by fighting.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛliya: N Duuma Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛ bindiriyubo leei zana mini tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ lu ka nya tibidarigibo.
en: And David says, Let those people be caught and trapped at their own feasts. Let them fall and be punished.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, dama bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli leei bɛ bin jɛmdili nyɛla be niŋgbuŋ kɔre; bɛ nyuri bara la di ni simdi ni vi mali ba shɛli zuɣu, ka bɛ baɣa kul bela dunia ŋɔ binyara ni kɔŋko.
en: The way they live is leading them to destruction. They have replaced God with their own desires. They do shameful things, and they are proud of what they do. They think only about earthly things.

dag: Nuhu nini ni daa ti neei, ka bɛ yɛl o o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani maa ni niŋ o shɛm.
en: When Noah sobered up and learned what his youngest son had done to him.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni nir maa daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka di lu? Ka o wuh o di shee, ka Ilaisha ŋmaai daɣu n-zaŋ bahi nimaani n-chɛ ka lɛbiɛlim maa puhi pan na.
en: The man of God said, Where did it fall? He showed Elisha the place. Elisha then cut a piece of wood, threw it into the river there, and the ax head floated up.

dag: Dama lala ka ti Duuma daa zali ti kaman di ni sabi yɛli shɛm la: N zal a mi ni a leei bɛn pa Yɛhudianim firila, ka zaŋ tiliginsim yɛla ŋɔ gili dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam hal ti kpa di tarisi zaa. .
en: The Lord has given us this command, I have placed you here as a light for the Gentiles. You are to take the saving power of God to people everywhere on earth.

dag: Ka Iso daa nya paɣiba mini bihi maa ka bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Naawuni ni niŋ mani a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ti ma bi shɛba m-bala.
en: When Esau looked around and saw the women and the children, he asked, Who are these people with you? These, sir, are the children whom God has been good enough to give me, Jacob answered.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bimbihili gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni. Dina n-daa nyɛ Musa tarili maligumaana leebu piɛlaa maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Next Moses took the breast from the ram for the ordination offering and lifted it as an uplifted offering before the LORD. It belonged to Moses as his portion, just as the LORD had commanded him.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But those tenant farmers said to each other, This is the heir. Lets kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam ti Duuma zuɣu, dama di ni yuui pam la nyaaŋa yi lan wuhi ni yi baɣa be n ni. M bi yɛlimi ni yi chɛ ma la lihibu, amaa yi yi bi nyala soli din ni doli niŋ li.
en: I was very glad in the Lord because now at last you have shown concern for me again.

dag: Zanimiya luɣ kasi shee kaman yi daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka Lɛvinim be bɛ ni piripiri yi zuliya daŋ niriba maa pirigibu kam puuni.
en: Stand in the sanctuary, according to the family divisions of your relatives the laypeople, so that there can be Levites for each family division.

dag: Sɛgub daa nyɛla Jair ba, ka Jair daa nyɛ ŋun su tinsi pisinaata fukumsi Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: Segub was the father of Jair, who owned twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshɛzabɛl yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Baana bia Zadok daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Next to them Meremoth, Uriahs son and Hakkozs grandson, made repairs. Meshullam, Berechiahs son and Meshezabels grandson, made repairs next to them, and Zadok, Baanas son, made repairs next to them.

dag: Dama yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya kɔŋko, laara bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Pa lala ka farigudeeriba gba niŋda?.
en: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi ni be hal ti kurigi n-kpi ni suhudoo, ka bɛ sɔɣ a.
en: You yourself will live to a ripe old age, die in peace, and be buried.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin daŋmi yili maa nim puhibu ŋ-ŋɔ: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ yili ŋɔ nim ni.
en: Whenever you go into a house, first say, Peace be with this house.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam bɛ zaa suhuri, ka mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: He forms all their thoughts and knows everything they do.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlima, kpiimba ni ti doya kaman naɣibina n-do mɔɣu ni la, bee kaman chi ni dɔndo kachɛriba nyaaŋa shɛm la, ka so ti ku kpuɣi ba.
en: This is what you should say: The Lord says, Dead bodies will lie in the fields like dung. Their bodies will lie on the ground like grain a farmer has cut. But there will be no one to gather them.

dag: ka ŋun pahi ayɔbu daa nyɛ Ozɛm, ka Dauda daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ayopɔin.
en: Ozem, and David.

dag: Ka sokam zaa ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu.
en: Everyone will hate you because of me.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ni suhudoo, man dee min a ni daa pun lo tab alikauli Yawɛ yuli ni, ka yɛli ni Yawɛ be ti sani, ka ni ti lan be ti bihi gba sani sahakam ŋɔ saɣiya. Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ, ka Jɔnatan mi lab kuli.
en: Then Jonathan said to David, Go in peace because the two of us made a solemn pledge in the LORDs name when we said, The LORD is witness between us and between our descendants forever. Then David got up and left, but Jonathan went back to town.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-pa chɛrubinima ayi maa luɣilikam zaa zuɣu.
en: The two Cherub angels were covered with gold.

dag: Jɛshua daa nyɛla Joyakim ba; ka Joyakim nyɛ Ɛliashib ba, ka Ɛliashib nyɛ Joyada ba;.
en: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa gba daa yi Galili n-chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni ni Jɔn ti baptaiz o.
en: At that time Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River so that John would baptize him.

dag: ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ salima alali, ka o zaŋ matarika kuri li.
en: Their flowers and their branches were attached to it. The whole lampstand was one piece of pure hammered gold.

dag: N yura n-su ma, ka o kɔre be n ni.
en: I belong to my lover, and his longing is only for me.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi gbaai biŋkɔbigu maa, di simdi ka o zaŋ o chɛra na ti wuhi shɛhira, ka di bi simdi ni o yo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so maa zuɣu.
en: If the animal was attacked and killed by a wild animal, and you can show the remains of the dead animal to its owner, you do not have to replace it.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa shiri di o ʒiri shɛhira, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi nya o galimi. Di nyaaŋa ka niriba ayi daa tɔhi zanna.
en: Many people came and told lies about him. But the council could find no real reason to kill him. Then two people came.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bɔrigi maa sani, di nyɛla nyom din tahiri kum na; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn tiligi la sani, di nyɛla nyom din tahiri nyɛvili na. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi su tuuni ŋɔ tatabo fukumsi?.
en: To those who are being lost, this perfume smells like death, and it brings them death. But to those who are being saved, it has the sweet smell of life, and it brings them life. So who is good enough to do this work?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Zaŋmi Lɛvinim zaa ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣibihi shɛb zaa.
en: I am the Lord . I will take the Levites instead of all the firstborn men and boys of Israel. I will also take the animals from the Levites instead of taking all the firstborn animals from the other people in Israel.

dag: ka lɔri zaɣ biɛɣu o tɛha puuni, ka tahiri tuɣiligu na sahakam.
en: Their hearts are corrupt and determined to do evil; they create controversies all the time.

dag: Amaa ka o lee yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Dinzuɣu miri ka a nyu wain bee binnyuri kpiɔŋ; a mi miri ka a di binshɛli din chihiri dibu; dama bia maa ti yɛn nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani o dɔɣibu dali zaŋ hal ti paag o kum dali. .
en: But he did tell me that I would become pregnant and have a son. He told me not to drink any wine or beer, or eat any forbidden food, because the boy is to be dedicated to God as a nazirite as long as he lives.

dag: Bɛ yi gbaai jɛŋgbin nyaŋ bia ka chɛ o ka o chirig a, di so ni a zaŋ a nyɔɣu yo jɛrigu o jɛrilim tuma saha.
en: It is better to meet a mother bear robbed of her cubs than to meet some fool busy with a stupid project.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kamina! Ka Pita daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni n-tam kom zuɣu chani Yisa sani;.
en: Jesus said, Come, Peter. Then Peter left the boat and walked on the water to Jesus.

dag: Do so daa be Siizaria ka o yuli booni Kɔniilius. O daa nyɛla sapashini n-su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Italinim Bɔŋ la.
en: There was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, a centurion in the Italian Company.

dag: Zaŋmiya zuliya kam na, ka chɛ ka niriba laɣimna. Bɛ ni ŋuni m-pun yɛl ti dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka yɛl ti kurimbuni ha yɛla zali? Bɛ zaŋm bɛ shɛhiranim na ka bɛ ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wum ka yɛli ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, We told you so! If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.

dag: N ni chɛ n niriba bɛn kpalim la bahi, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba ka di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nɛma zaa.
en: Whatever survives of my inheritance, Ill leave behind, handing them over to their enemies. They will be nothing but plunder and loot for every one of their enemies.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti zaŋ li mir o na ni o di ka o dii gɔh o nuu ni ka yɛl o, N tizɔpaɣa, chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: As she offered them to him, he grabbed her and said, Come to bed with me.

dag: Ŋun daa pa Ɛhud zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Anat bia Shamga ŋun daa zaŋ naɣikpar kpaa ku Filistianim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la. Ŋun gba daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: The next leader was Shamgar son of Anath. He too rescued Israel, and did so by killing six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad.

dag: Ka yi ti pirigi li ka di saɣisi taba. N daa poya ni n ni zaŋ li ti yi yaannima, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti leei yi dini ni yi fali.
en: You will divide the land equally. I promised to give this land to your ancestors, so I am giving this land to you.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mi n ni yɛn nya o luɣ shɛli polo, ka n di chaŋ hal ni o biɛhigu shee.
en: Oh, that I could know how to find him— come to his dwelling place.

dag: O tizo Oholiba daa nya dimbɔŋɔ, amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tumbu min o kɔre daa bie n-gar o biɛli maa dini.
en: Her sister Oholibah saw it, and she proceeded to outdo her sister in her lust and in her seductions.

dag: A bela n tooni ni n nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu.
en: You are all around me on every side; you protect me with your power.

dag: O palo yibu maa mi ni ti niŋla di saha dɛde kaman Naawuni ni zal li shɛm. Ŋun Naawuni kɔŋko n-nyɛ alibarika Natitamlana mini nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: His appearing will be brought about at the right time by God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and the Lord of lords.

dag: Di niŋ zuɣulaannim naani, a mi di niŋ daadamnim bɛn ka sɔŋsim ŋɔ naani.
en: Dont depend on your leaders for help. Dont depend on people, because they cannot save you.

dag: O nyari bina pam, amaa ka bi baŋdi li; o tiba mali voya, amaa di bi wumda.
en: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni booni tab yɛra, Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: They are like children sitting in the marketplace calling out to each other, We played the flute for you and you didnt dance. We sang a funeral song and you didnt cry.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n suhir a, taɣimi tim so.
en: But Moses answered, No, Lord, please send someone else.

dag: Bɛ daa zaliya ni di saha maa zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din kanna puuni, Yɛhudia nir kam min o yiŋnim bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni mini tiŋ kam ni bɛn kul teemi puhimi Purim dabisa chuɣu maa, ka kul niŋmi lala zaŋ chana.
en: From now on, all Jewish families must remember to celebrate Purim on these two days each year.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ n ni chɛ ka n daalɔbɔnim lu amaŋmaŋ min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni n kpee ka dunia yili zaa.
en: This time, I will use my full power against you, your officials, and your people. Then you will know that there is no god in the world like me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di pala dimbɔŋɔnim kɔŋko, n shiri lihi binshɛɣukam zaa la yoli binshɛli din mali buchi pam la zuɣu; dina n-nyɛ n Duuma Yisa Masia baŋbu. O zuɣu ka n chɛ binshɛɣukam zaa bahi; n lihi di zaa ha la saɣiri ni di chɛ ka m mali Masia.
en: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli Zɛrubabɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Pa a kpiɔŋ bee a yiko zuɣu, amaa n Shia yiko zuɣu.
en: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa wum yɛla ŋɔ zaa o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam.
en: When King David heard about all this he got very angry, but he refused to punish his son Amnon because he loved him as his oldest child.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a mini so zabi ka di ka soli, ka di pala o tum a la taali.
en: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Hal Musa mini Samuɛl yi di ʒe n tooni, n naan ku ŋmaligi n suhu kpa niriba ŋɔ polo. Zaŋmi ba miligi n sani n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The LORD said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel stood before me, I wouldnt change my mind about these people. Send them away from me. Let them go!.

dag: Ka so yi wuhiri wuhibu shɛli din be di ko, ka bi saɣi deei ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛligu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli la mini wuhibu shɛli din mini din luri Naawuni sizuura taɣili tab la.
en: Whoever teaches a different doctrine and does not agree with the true words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with the teaching of our religion.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyo naɣisaa maa buɣim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka su kom; o gba ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: The man who burns that cow must wash himself and his clothes in water. He will be unclean until evening.

dag: Di chɛliya ka ti gbarigi zaŋ chaŋ tuun suma tumbu polo dama ti yi bi gbarigi, chɛbu saha yi ti paai, ti ni chɛ ti ni biri shɛli.
en: So let us not become tired of doing good; for if we do not give up, the time will come when we will reap the harvest.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililana tumdila jɛrilim, ka yɛndan mi nyɛ ŋun be baalim.
en: Short-tempered people make stupid mistakes, and schemers are hated.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, o dii nyami ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: While he was coming up out of the water, Jesus saw heaven splitting open and the Spirit, like a dove, coming down on him.

dag: A bemi kaman tampiŋ la ka n sɔɣir a sani. Nyini n-nyɛ m birini din mali kpiɔŋ ni a tiligi ma; dama nyini n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini.
en: Be my secure shelter and a strong fortress to protect me; you are my refuge and defense.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi tiŋ maa ni dɔbba, Ka jɛmbu duu pagɔr so ŋun yi ʒiini Inaim palli naŋgbanyee ŋɔ la lee be ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: He asked some men at Enaim, Where is the prostitute who was here by the road? There has never been a prostitute here, they answered.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered the chest with pure gold inside and out, and made a gold molding all around it.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din yiri kpaŋ na nti kpɛri ninsal ni ku tooi ta o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri. .
en: The food that you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.
