dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m biri ka so ti di li; ka shɛb ti gbi m puu bindira.
en: then let me sow and another reap; let my offspring be uprooted.

dag: O yee daa kpɛm pam ka o bi zɔri vi. O daa bi ʒiini yiŋa.
en: She was a bold and shameless woman who always walked the streets.

dag: ni Janim ni Bɛtitapua ni Afɛka.
en: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah.

dag: N suhiri ti Duuma ni o zom Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnim nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa kul kpaŋsiri n suhu waawaayili; ka vi bi mal o zoligɔnim din lo ma la zuɣu.
en: I pray that the Lord will show mercy to the family of Onesiphorus. Many times Onesiphorus encouraged me. He was not ashamed that I was in prison.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛli taba, Ti bi niŋ din tuhi. Zuŋɔ nyɛla lahiba suŋ dabisili. Ka ti yi zaŋ li shini hal ni biɛɣu ti neei, tibidarigibo shɛli ni ti paai ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti yɛli nayilinima.
en: But then they said to each other, We shouldn't be doing this! We have good news, and we shouldn't keep it to ourselves. If we wait until morning to tell it, we are sure to be punished. Let's go right now and tell the king's officers.

dag: Yɛlim Lɛvinima, Yi yi ti deei zaka bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini Izraɛlnim sani, din nyɛ n ni deei shɛli bɛ sani tin ya ka di nyɛ yi tarili la, yin yihimiya di bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini ti man Yawɛ, ka di nyɛ zaka binyɛra puuni mi zaka.
en: to say to the Levites: When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that the Lord gives you as your possession, you must present a tenth of it as a special contribution to the Lord .

dag: Yi ŋmanila lala n sani pumpɔŋɔ, Yi nya n nahiŋgu maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ya.
en: Now, you are like those streams. You see my troubles and are afraid.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: You have kept your promise, Lord , and you are good to me, your servant.

dag: Ka Siria naa ni ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti teei gili tiŋ shɛli din goma mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Ijipti tɔbbihi ni ti kɔŋ tuhibu, hal bɛ ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi gba ti ku lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni ka ti a nama, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi; ka a leei zuliya pam yaba.
en: I pray that God All-Powerful will bless you with many descendants and let you become a great nation.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu yi yi bi chɛri yi mabihi taali paŋdi ba yi suhuri ni, lala ka m Ba Naawuni gba ti yɛn niŋ yi zaa yinoyino.
en: My heavenly Father will also do the same to you if you dont forgive your brother or sister from your heart.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim ninvuɣ yoya pah omaŋ zuɣu n-leei bɛ salo maa zuɣulana. Dauda ni daa ku o dimnim Sirianim la nyaaŋa ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa. Ka Rɛzɔn min o niriba maa daa chaŋ ti ʒini Damaskus, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o leei Damaskus naa.
en: and had become the leader of a gang of outlaws. Rezon and his gang went and lived in Damascus, where his followers made him king of Syria.

dag: Di nyɛla ashil shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ sɔɣi niriba ʒiɛmana din gari la ha puuni, amaa ka yipa kahigi li wuh o ninvuɣ gahinda pumpɔŋɔ.
en: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ n nina kpa n Duuma Naawuni ni nimmoo m-balim o ni nolɔbo, ka pili buɣu n-teei ʒi tampiligim ni.
en: Then I turned to the Lord God. I prayed to him and asked him for help. I did not eat any food. I put ashes on my head and put on the clothes that showed I was sad.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa tim tuumba Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Ŋuni n-lee lan su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ? Chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n sɔŋ a n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim zaa na ti ti a.
en: Abner sent messengers to David and said, Who do you think should rule this country? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you become the ruler of all the people of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa zaŋ ŋariŋ shɛl o ni daa pun kpe n-ʒiya la duri duli. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛŋa ni dol o dura.
en: So they left the crowd behind and went with Jesus in the boat he was already in. There were also other boats that went with them.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: but the Lord made the king so stubborn that he still refused to let the Israelites go.

dag: Ŋuni ka m mal alizanda ni pah a zuɣu? Ka binshɛli mi ka dunia ŋɔ ni ka m bɔri li pah a zuɣu.
en: What else do I have in heaven but you? Since I have you, what else could I want on earth?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni yini ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihita.
en: So the total number of men of Israel was .

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, piimiya yi ni niriba ayopɔin shɛb Shia Kasi ni pali, ka bɛ mali shɛhira suma ka lan mali yɛm pam, ka ti chɛ ka bɛ su tuma ŋɔ fukumsi;.
en: So, brothers and sisters, choose seven of your men who have a good reputation. They must be full of wisdom and the Spirit. We will give them this work to do.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa laɣim ka Shunɛm na nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani; ka Sool gba daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ mi ti bɛ suɣa do Gilibɔa.
en: The Philistine troops assembled and camped near the town of Shunem; Saul gathered the Israelites and camped at Mount Gilboa.

dag: Dama yi tam yi Naawuni ŋun tiligi ya, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe n-taɣi ya kaman tampiŋ din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛla. Dinzuɣu ka yi sa tihi ni yi jɛmdi tinzun wuna.
en: because you forgot the God who saves you, and didnt remember the rock who shelters you. Therefore, plant your pleasant plants, and set out exotic sprouts.

dag: Yi booni ma la yi karimba ni yi Duuma; yɛlimaŋli mi n-shiri nyɛ li, dama lala n-nyɛ ma.
en: You call me Teacher and Lord, and you speak correctly, because I am.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa da bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣ silig shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni la, ka bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo siliga maa noli.
en: Joseph bought some linen cloth. He took the body from the cross, wrapped it in the linen, and put the body in a tomb that was dug in a wall of rock. Then he closed the tomb by rolling a large stone to cover the entrance.

dag: Nir yi doli ʒiri soli bo n-nya buni, di nyɛla kaman gulisigu mini kum zana.
en: The riches you get by dishonesty soon disappear, but not before they lead you into the jaws of death.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa boli, Samuɛl! Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: the Lord called Samuel. He answered, Yes, sir.

dag: Tumtumdiba ni bɔri bindirigu zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi tuma, ka kum nyɛ din kpaŋsiri ba ka bɛ tumda.
en: The appetite of workers labors for them, for their hunger presses them on.

dag: Niriba pam daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ ti sani.
en: Many people have already applied themselves to the task of compiling an account of the events that have been fulfilled among us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, n yi zaŋ n nuhi tum taali.
en: I am innocent, Lord God!.

dag: Ka daa siɣis omaŋ doli nɔdeebo soli ti paai kum, hal kum din nyɛ dapulli zuɣu kum gba.
en: He was humble and walked the path of obedience all the way to death— his death on the cross.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ku lan kana ti ŋme ba tɔbu ka di bɛ nɛma, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni biŋkɔbiri ku lan gbahi ba. Bɛ ni ti beni ni alaafee ka so ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.

dag: Bɛn muɣisiri ya ni yi guni la nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ duhi bɛmaŋa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu puuni, ka di daliri kul nyɛla ni bɛ di nya nahiŋgu Masia dapulli yɛla zuɣu;.
en: Whoever wants to look good by human standards will try to get you to be circumcised, but only so they wont be harassed for the cross of Christ.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: a voice shouting in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight .

dag: Ka n daa galim zuɣulaannim la pam ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa bahi? Ka n daa laɣim ba na nti zaŋ ba zali bɛ zaashɛhi.
en: So I scolded the officials, asking, Why is Gods house being neglected? I gathered them together and set them in their stations.

dag: N suh a ni n suhu zaa; zom ma nambɔɣu kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I beg you with all my heart, be kind to me, as you promised.

dag: Ka bɔh o di saha maa, Di luhiya ni ti yo farigu Naa Siiza sani bee di bi luhi.
en: Does the Law allow people to pay taxes to Caesar or not.

dag: Tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ŋmari li mi luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: Every tree that does not produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

dag: N lan nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhiri binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla. Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa mi n-zaŋ o yaa maa n-nahind o taba.
en: I saw all this when I thought about the things that are done in this world, a world where some people have power and others have to suffer under them.

dag: Dɔb ŋɔ zaa daa kpuɣila tinzun paɣiba, ka bɛ daa kari bɛ paɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: All these men had foreign wives. They divorced them and sent them and their children away.

dag: yɛra, Bɛn yoli ka tuma ŋɔ ni na kul tumla awa yini kɔŋko, ka tinim bɛn lee di tuma ŋɔ wahala ka wuntaŋ kpe ti biɛɣu zaa pahi ŋɔ mini ba zaa yɔri ti nyɛ yim.
en: These men who were hired last worked only one hour, they said, while we put up with a whole day's work in the hot sun—yet you paid them the same as you paid us.

dag: Ka nudirigu polo tintariga mi kpuɣi Kiriatijiarim tintariga n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛfurɔn m-mali hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔŋ ni.
en: The southern border started near Kiriath Jearim and went to the River of Nephtoah.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka mi bi lan niŋ di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ. Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa wum ninsal ni yɛli shɛm, dama Yawɛ daa tuhi ti Izraɛlnima.
en: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o. Mɔabnim daa kul chanila Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛɣuni nti fari bɛ bindira yuuni kam.
en: So Elisha died, and he was buried. Sometimes Moabite raiding parties used to come into the land each spring.

dag: Wula ka ti lee ni yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma so zuliya ni ti ni yila na yɛla?.
en: So what are we going to say? Are we going to find that Abraham is our ancestor on the basis of genealogy?.

dag: Bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti do yi sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord , did these things.

dag: Zuɣusaa daantalisi sɔhigimi, ka di gari ba o ni kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zuɣu.
en: When he threatens the pillars that hold up the sky, they shake and tremble with fear.

dag: Ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa.
en: the cloud covered the meeting tent and the LORDs glorious presence filled the dwelling.

dag: Mɛmiya duɣuri n-zaŋdi tampiligim niŋdi di puuni, ka mali soobuya mini taha ni dirijaba ni lahi din ni niŋdi buɣim. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali di lahi mini duɣuri zaa.
en: Use bronze to make all the tools and dishes that will be used on the altar. Make pots, shovels, bowls, forks, and pans. These will be used for cleaning ashes from the altar.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba na ti zali maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Zomiya tiligi! Yi mi miriya ka yi ŋmaligi lihi yi nyaaŋa bee n-zani vinvamli ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli. Kul zomiya ti du zoya ŋɔ ha, di yi pa lala, buɣim ni din ya.
en: When they were outside, one of the angels said, Run for your lives! Don't even look back. And don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, where you'll be safe.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu; n ni nyahi ya ka yi yi daɣiri ni kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi buɣim maani anzinfa ka di yiri shɛm la.
en: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni nyɛ Naawuni biyurisi la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi bebu be kaman o bebu.
en: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yolitim zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni maa polo.
en: I then gave myself up to despair, as I thought about all my laborious hard work under the sun.

dag: Ka o ni ti ti yinim bɛn diri wahala ŋɔ zaŋ tabili ti gba vuhim. O ni ti niŋla lala saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o malaikanim yi ti yi palo zuɣusaa siɣirina o yiko mini buɣim din diri puuni.
en: And he will bring relief to you who are troubled. He will bring it to you and to us when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven for all to see, together with his powerful angels.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai mɔɣu ni bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la nyaaŋa yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni la ni n-yɛli.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses in the Sinai Desert in the first month of the second year after the people of Israel had left Egypt. He said.

dag: Amaa ti yipa yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu lɔbu ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka kpi zaŋ chaŋ din daa kpɛhi ti dabitim ni la polo. Ka ti mi ku lan doli fukumsi zaligu kurili din daa sabi zal la sulinsi soli, amaa ka ni dolila Shia Kasi nyɛvili palli la sulinsi soli.
en: But now we have been released from the Law. We have died with respect to the thing that controlled us, so that we can be slaves in the new life under the Spirit, not in the old life under the written Law.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi ma pahi buyi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala duɣu ni bini ni kpeera, ka gbiligi yi nuzaa polo na.
en: Then the Lord spoke to me again. What else do you see? he asked. I answered, I see a pot boiling in the north, and it is about to tip over this way.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɛman. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotan was the ancestor of the clans of Hori and Heman.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Nuhu, Alikauli shɛli din be m mini dunia ŋɔ binnɛma zaa sunsuuni la shihirili m-bala.
en: That is the sign of the promise which I am making to all living beings.

dag: Mani n-daa nyɛ zoomba nina, ka nyɛ gbariti napɔna.
en: I was eyes to the blind, feet to the lame.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa nya o n-to o piɛm ti o daŋ pam.
en: The fighting was heavy around Saul, and he himself was hit by enemy arrows and badly wounded.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi bela n sani ka n zaŋ bini dihi tabili li sɔŋ?.
en: The Lord says, I am saving that punishment. I have it locked up in my storehouse!.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisa lan lab Kapɛrinium ka di mol gili ni o lab yiŋ na.
en: Jesus went back to Capernaum, and a few days later people heard that he was at home.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai ti gbɛbu shee n-yooi ti kpalansi nya ka ti zaa yinoyino liɣiri noli bela ti kpalansi maa noya ni, dinzuɣu ka ti ʒi li mali na.
en: When we set up camp on the way home, we opened our sacks, and each man found his money in the top of his sack—every bit of it. We have brought it back to you.

dag: bomiya kom na ti ti kɔnyuri ni mali shɛba. Yinim Tɛma tiŋgbɔŋnima, bomiya bindira ti kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba.
en: They gave water to some thirsty travelers. The people of Tema gave them food.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Vumiya miri Yawɛ, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o shɛm maa. .
en: Then Moses said to Aaron, Tell the whole community of Israelites to come together before the Lord , because he has heard their complaints.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: All of Jesus' disciples ran off and left him.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti liri ba Mɛrom kulibɔŋ maa ni libigi ba.
en: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond.

dag: Ka Kɔnania min o mabihi Shɛmaya ni Nɛtanɛl ni Hashabia ni Jɛiɛl ni Jɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba la gba daa ti Lɛvinim piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tusaanu ni naɣilahi kɔbisinu ni bɛ zaŋ puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: The leaders of the Levites—Conaniah, Shemaiah and his brother Nethanel, Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad—contributed , lambs and young goats and bulls for the Levites to offer as sacrifices.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim yɛn chaŋ ti deei Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa su, ka yi bɔri ni yi gbarigi ba?.
en: Why are you trying to discourage the Israelites? You will make them not want to cross the river and take the land that the Lord has given to them!.

dag: N ni zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ barina shee, ka zaŋ n nyɛvili niŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu ni.
en: For what reason will I take my flesh in my teeth, put my life in jeopardy?.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: He asked me, Don't you know? No, I don't, sir, I answered.

dag: Ka o daa kpe n-chaŋ ti zan o dan Ilaisha tooni, ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Gɛhaazi, ya polo ka a lee chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: Gehazi then went and stood before his master. Elisha said to Gehazi, Where did you come from, Gehazi? Your servant didnt go anywhere, Gehazi replied.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛli, Di viɛla, amaa a yi da tiŋgbani maa Naomi sani, shee ka a zaŋ Rut ŋun nyɛ pakoli ka lan nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba pahi, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa.
en: If you do buy it from Naomi, Boaz told him, you must also marry Ruth. Then if you have a son by her, the property will stay in the family of Ruth's first husband.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb tiŋgbani n-ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o pahi.
en: She said, Give me a blessing. Since the land youve given me is in the arid southern plain, you should also give me springs of water. So he gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Ahimaaz daa garigi yɛl o, Jɔab ni di tim ma saha shɛli na maa, n di nya zama ni laɣim yo vuri, amaa n di bi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Is my son Absalom all right? David asked. Ahimaaz said, When Joab sent your personal servant and me, I saw a noisy crowd. But I don't know what it was all about.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: A message from the Lord came to Jeremiah. It came during the fourth year that Zedekiah son of Josiah was king of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soli, ka n dol a yɛlimaŋli la; tim ma suhuyini, ka n tibigir a yuli.
en: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chani kpari Sɔdom polo, amaa ka Ibrahimma na kul ʒe Yawɛ tooni.
en: The men turned and started toward Sodom. But the Lord stayed with Abraham.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi ʒiɛra, ka teeku maa kɔgbana kul puɣiri lura.
en: and a strong wind was making the water rough.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo wuhiri ni di bi tuhi ni nir kpuɣ paɣa bee n-diri bindira balibu shɛŋa Naawuni ni nam ti salinima ni bɛn niŋ yɛda ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli la diri li ka paɣiri ŋun Naawuni di zuɣu la.
en: They say that it is wrong to marry. And they say that there are some foods that people must not eat. But God made these foods, and those who believe and who understand the truth can eat them with thanks.

dag: Nia biɛri nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din viɛla.
en: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but he is pleased with kind words.

dag: A dim ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ maŋa ti a, amaa ka di lee nyɛla yɔhiŋ o suhu ni.
en: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans.

dag: ni Ain ni Juta ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti ba. Fɔntiŋ kara awɛi ka bɛ daa yihi Juda mini Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Ain and its pastures; Juttah and its pastures; and Beth-shemesh and its pastures. Total from these two tribes: nine cities.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni darigi a tibili ka di dol a suhuyiɣisili min a nyuli zabbu ni a ni je ba shɛm la soli. N yi kar a saria, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni nyɛ so.
en: Therefore, the LORD God proclaims: As surely as I live, I will act according to the anger and zeal you displayed when you dealt with them so hatefully. When I judge you, I will make myself known to them.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, O be wula? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O mal alaafee; ka lan yɛli, O bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl n-taɣiri piɛri kanna ŋɔ.
en: How is he? Jacob asked. He's fine, they answered. And here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, so ka dunia ŋɔ ni n-nyɛ wuntizɔra ŋun kul tumdi tuun suma, ka na ʒi n-tum alahichi.
en: No one in this world always does right.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ me bimbin shɛŋa tabili jɛmbu duu maa dukpina mini di puuni dubila zaŋ tabili luɣ kasi shee la. Ka lan me dubihi ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla tabili di luɣa ni ti gili.
en: Then Solomon built a row of rooms around the main part of the Temple. This row of rooms was three stories tall with the rooms built one above the other.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naawuni yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli.
en: That day David began to fear what God might do to him. So he said, Should I really be the one in charge of Gods Holy Box.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka bol li, Yawɛ nyɛla suhudoo. Ka di na kul ʒe Ofira Abiɛzanim ni su luɣ shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Gideon built an altar to the Lord there and named it The Lord is Peace.

dag: A mi zaligu shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa? A ni tooi zaŋ lala zaligunim zali dunia ŋɔ ni?.
en: Do you know the laws that govern the skies, and can you make them apply to the earth?.

dag: Di nyɛla din chihiri ni nanim tum zaɣ biɛɣu, dama wuntitali soli ka bɛ doli zali nam.
en: Kings cannot tolerate evil, because justice is what makes a government strong.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka n lee nya ka di do tooni ŋɔ ha? Ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl o, Naawuni daanabi ŋun daa yi Juda na nti yɛl a ni niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbini ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla siliga m-bala.
en: Josiah said, What is that monument I see? The people of the city told him, It is the grave of the man of God who came from Judah. This man of God told about the things you have done to the altar at Bethel. He said them a long time ago.

dag: Di di daa simdi ni a zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni, n ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: So you should have put my money in the bank. Then, when I came home, I would get my money back. And I would also get the interest that my money earned.

dag: Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala, ka o gba yuli daa du m-pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Benaiah did these things. He never became one of the Three Warriors, but he was just as famous as they were and certainly just as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. David made him the leader of his bodyguard.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yɛri lala chani maa, yim, ka chɛchɛbuŋ din mali buɣim mini di yuri din mali buɣim dii kana ti kpe bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni n-woligi ba, ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ dii kpuɣi Ilaija du zuɣusaa.
en: They kept talking as they walked on; then suddenly a chariot of fire pulled by horses of fire came between them, and Elijah was taken up to heaven by a whirlwind.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa vaai yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee ni suhuyiɣisili pam, ka daa bi di bindirigu goli palli daba ayi dali maa, dama Dauda yɛla daa muɣis o pam ni o ba ni daa dih o vi shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Jonathan got up from the table in a rage and ate nothing that day—the second day of the New Moon Festival. He was deeply distressed about David, because Saul had insulted him.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka di simdi ni paɣ zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu malaikanim zuɣu, ka di wuhi ni so su o fukumsi.
en: Because of this a woman should have authority over her head, because of the angels.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Ammɔnnim tintariga, yin di muɣisiya ba bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tin ya ni yi su li, dama n daa pun zaŋ li tila Lɔt zuliya ni bɛ su li. .
en: You will then be near the land of the Ammonites, the descendants of Lot. Don't trouble them or start a war against them, because I am not going to give you any of the land that I have given them. .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yi samban ni ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa n-kali saŋmarisi, a yi ni tooi kali ba. Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Lala ka a zuliya ti yɛn be.
en: Then God led Abram outside and said, Look at the sky. See the many stars. There are so many you cannot count them. Your family will be like that.

dag: bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba shɛb bɛn daa gbibi kikahi la daa pa bɛ zuɣu. Ka Jɔnatan bia Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛmaya yaaŋa la pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: There were also some young priests with trumpets—Zechariah son of Jonathan son of Shemaiah son of Mattaniah son of Micaiah son of Zaccur son of Asaph.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: Zedekiah disobeyed the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.

dag: ka zaŋ o yiko niŋ dabitim ni, ka chɛ o jilima ti ti dimnima.
en: He allowed our enemies to capture the Covenant Box, the symbol of his power and glory.

dag: Ka Midian mi bihi daa nyɛ Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura bihi min o yaansi.
en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these sons came from the marriage of Abraham and Keturah.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd kum nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika so daa lan chaŋ Yisifu sani zahindi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.

dag: ninvuɣ yoya shɛb yila yi ni n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka tiŋ maa nim birigi ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti jɛm wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi.
en: some troublemakers from your own nation are persuading the people of their city to do bad things. They might say to the people of their city, Lets go and serve other gods.

dag: Ka zim shɛli din kpalim ni leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ li nyo buɣim m-mali sara ti Yawɛ maa zuɣu.
en: The rest of that grain offering will belong to Aaron and his sons. This gift to the Lord is very holy.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ daba la, deemiya yi duumanim noya ka luri ba sizuura zaa, ka di pala bɛn niŋdi nirilim ka mali biɛribaalimtali la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili bɛn mali hal biɛɣu la gba.
en: Slaves, be willing to serve your masters. Do this with all respect. You should obey the masters who are good and kind, and you should obey the masters who are bad.

dag: N ni yuri shɛba, bɛna ka n saɣisiri ka darigiri bɛ tiba; dinzuɣu moomiya yi nini niŋ tuuba.
en: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.

dag: Di saha Ɛzɛkiɛl ni ti leei shihirili yi sani. Yi ni ti niŋ kaman o ni kul niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Di yi ti niŋ lala, yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Duuma.
en: So Ezekiel is an example for you. You will do all the same things he did. That time of punishment will come, and then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yiri muɣisigu ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn lee kpɛri di ni.
en: Trouble goes right past the Lord 's people and strikes the wicked.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ yiko shiri galisi kaman a ni daa pun lo alikauli yɛli.
en: Now let my masters power be as great as you declared when you said.

dag: Zaadali paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ naa n-yi nudirigu polo la na ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama o daa yi katiŋa n-kana ni o ti wum Sulemaana yɛm yɛtɔɣa; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Sulemaana be kpe.
en: The queen of the South will rise up at the judgment with the people of this generation and condemn them, because she came from a distant land to hear Solomons wisdom. And look, someone greater than Solomon is here.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛl Yawɛ sani, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn be tibi yi suhuri ni mi, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu.
en: And so your good people should celebrate and shout.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ na kul tumdila alahichi pahira. Bɛ zaŋ kuriti mali binnana, ka baŋsimnim dooi anzinfa mali buɣa, ka di zaa nyɛ machɛl ni mali shɛli, ka bɛ yɛri niriba, Malimiya buɣa ŋɔ. Ka ninsalinim jɛmdi naɣibihi.
en: And now they keep on sinning; they have made metal images, idols of silver, as a result of their skill, all of them the work of craftsmen. Sacrifice to these, they say. People are kissing calves!.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti lo nia ni o ku Jɛrɔbɔam, amaa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zo n-kuli Ijipti Naa Shishak sani nti be Ijipti maa hal ka Sulemaana ti kpi.
en: And so Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but he escaped to King Shishak of Egypt and stayed there until Solomon's death.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N ku tooi zaŋ n ni tum shɛm buɣisi yi ni tum shɛm. Hal yinim Ifriim zuliya niriba ni tum biɛla shɛli maa gari tinim Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni tum shɛm zaa.
en: But he told them, What I was able to do is nothing compared with what you have done. Even the little that you people of Ephraim did is worth more than what my whole clan has done.

dag: ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba sanna ti yɛli ba.
en: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa kul zoori ka mali zuɣu Yawɛ mini salinim sani.
en: The boy Samuel kept growing. He was pleasing to the Lord and to the people.

dag: dama nyini n Duuma Naawuni, a ku chɛ ma ka n kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee; ka a mi ku chɛ ka a Ninvuɣ suŋ niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: because you will not leave me in the place of death. You will not let the body of your Holy One rot in the grave.

dag: Ka o daa bol o yidana n-yɛl o, Chɛ ka tumtumdi yino zaŋ bun yino ti ma na, ka n chaŋ yomyom ti nya Naawuni nir ŋɔ ka labina.
en: The woman called to her husband, I need to see the prophet. Let me use one of the donkeys. Send a servant along with me, and let me leave now, so I can get back quickly.

dag: ka o daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu o tɔbbihi bɛn daa gul o la sapashin kpɛm yiŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yisifu ti niŋ maa.
en: and put them in prison in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same place where Joseph was being kept.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛli ma pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: But the voice from heaven answered again, God has made these things pure. Dont say they are unfit to eat.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-tahi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ duu na. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbaligu bihim duɣi bɛ bihi.
en: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.

dag: ka lihi zuɣusaa, ka siɣim ka yɛli tikpiralan maa, Efata! Di gbinni nyɛla, Yooma.
en: Jesus looked up toward heaven, and with a groan he said, Effatha! which means Open up.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti lan yi Samuɛl zuɣu Shilo, dama Yawɛ daa kahig omaŋa wuhi Samuɛl Shilo ŋun Yawɛ yɛligu ni. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa gbilisiri tibili wumdi Samuɛl yɛligu.
en: The Lord often appeared to Samuel at Shiloh and told him what to say.

dag: Kuɣili maa daa galisiya pam, amaa ka bɛ daa ti paai nya ka kuɣili maa pun biligimi doya.
en: But when they looked, they saw that the stone had already been rolled away. And it was a huge stone!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yɛli, Yɛm so kpiɔŋ. Amaa bɛ daa lihi ʒiɛm doo maa yɛm maa, ka bi deeg o yɛligu.
en: But I still say that wisdom is better than strength. They forgot about the poor mans wisdom, and the people stopped listening to what he said. But I still believe that wisdom is better.

dag: Nanim ŋɔ ʒiɛmana maa ni, Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni ti zali nam shɛli ka so ku tooi nyaŋ li. Ka nam maa mi ti ku looi ninvuɣ shɛb sani. Di ni ti wurimwurim nam shɛŋa din beni zaa, ka zani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: At the time of those rulers the God of heaven will establish a kingdom that will never end. It will never be conquered, but will completely destroy all those empires and then last forever.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus answered, Be careful! Dont let anyone fool you.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka n tɛhi kurimbuni ha yɛla, ka teei yuun shɛŋa din gari la yɛla.
en: I kept thinking about the past, about things that happened long ago.

dag: Ka Yaakubu mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani la daa ka Luz din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: Jacob and all of the people with him arrived in Luz, otherwise known as Bethel, in the land of Canaan.

dag: N yɛr a mi, Yiɣisim zaŋ a daamaŋka maa kuli.
en: Get up, take your mat, and go home.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, dama n ni niŋ a nirilim a ba Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yab Sool ni daa su tiŋgban shɛli zaa ti a, ka lan chɛ ka m min a laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam.
en: David said to Mephibosheth, Dont be afraid. I will be kind to you because of your father Jonathan. I will give back to you all the land of your grandfather Saul. And you will always be able to eat at my table.

dag: Shɛli kani din ni lan ti ma suhupiɛlli gari n yi ti wum ni m bihi doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Nothing makes me happier than to hear that my children live in the truth.

dag: Bɛnkam niŋ bɛ buni naani ni lu, amaa wuntizɔriba ni zoori kaman vamaha la.
en: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n yɛn zaŋla nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam ka di nyɛ yi naa sun ya.
en: This is what the LORD God says: As surely as I live, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and with wrath poured out, I will be your king!.

dag: Daba bɛn yi n-zo bɛ laamba sani n-ka yi sanna, yin di lan zaŋ ba labisi ti bɛ laamba maa.
en: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi kpamba maa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka lan mal o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒiin o tooni la saawara.
en: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.

dag: N daa chɛ a Kriit ni a niŋla binshɛŋa din simdi niŋbu la, ka pii cheechi toondaannima n-zali tiŋ kam ni kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm la.
en: I left you in Crete so that you could finish doing what still needed to be done. And I also left you there so that you could choose men to be elders in every town.

dag: Ka naa maa daa pirig o nintu shɛli o ni daa yi mali dihiri zaligu gbana zuɣu ka di leeri naa ni zali zaligu shɛli ti Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: So the king took the official ring off his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite. Haman was the enemy of the Jews.

dag: Yawɛ, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma, n sɔŋda, kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ma.
en: But you, LORD! Dont be far away! You are my strength! Come quick and help me!.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa zaŋ Ahazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔram kaluɣi la n-leei naa zal o ba zaani; dama ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa doli Laribunim maa ka sansani maa ni na daa ku Jɛhɔram bikpamba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa leei Juda naa maa.
en: The inhabitants of Jerusalem made his youngest son Ahaziah succeed him as king because the raiding party that had invaded the camp with the Arabs had killed all the older sons. So Ahaziah, Jehorams son, became king of Judah.

dag: ni n daalaka nyabu ni n wahala dibu. A mi dinkam zaa daa niŋ ma mini alaka biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa nya Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium ni Listra la gba yɛla; amaa ti Duuma daa fa ma di zaa ni bahi.
en: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛ ʒiʒiinitab maa zaa, ka yɛlli ŋɔ daa moli gili Judia zoya zuɣu tinsi zaa.
en: And all their neighbors were afraid. In all the hill country of Judea, people continued talking about these things.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga dunia ŋɔ ni. O ni nya yiya mini mabi dɔbba ni tizɔpaɣiba ni banima ni manima ni bihi ni puri m-pahi muɣisigu, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will be rewarded. In this world they will be given times as many houses and brothers and sisters and mothers and children and pieces of land, though they will also be mistreated. And in the world to come, they will have eternal life.

dag: Ka ti Duuma garigi yɛli, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlan zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: The Lord answered, Who, then, is the faithful and wise servant? He is the one that his master will put in charge, to run the household and give the other servants their share of the food at the proper time.

dag: Ka o mabia Ɛshɛk mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ulam n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛushi, ka Ɛlifɛlɛt mi daa pah ata.
en: Azel's brother Eshek had three sons: Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Naawuni zaŋ alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: Jesus came near and spoke to them, Ive received all authority in heaven and on earth.

dag: Ijiptinim ni tiri niriba sɔŋsim shɛli ka buchi, dinzuɣu man ni pa Ijipti yupaa m-bol li la Rahab ŋun nyɛ ʒinahigulana.
en: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.

dag: Ka napaɣ kuro daa wum naa min o kpambaliba ni tɔɣisiri yɛlli maa yɛla ka kpe bɛ chuɣu puhibu duu maa ni na ti yɛli, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Di chɛ ka yɛla maa muɣis a ti yaɣi, ka a chɛ ka a ninni biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Upon hearing the commotion coming from the king and his princes, the queen entered the banqueting hall and declared, Long live the king! Dont be so disturbed. Dont be so frightened.

dag: Bɛ kpiya ka ku lan be yaha. Bɛ shihi ku lan yiɣisi, dama a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi; so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim Yawɛ ni zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Moses told the Israelites everything that the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti liri Izraɛlnim fɔntinsi n-tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Kinɛrɔt zaa zaŋ tabili Naftali tiŋgbani zaa.
en: Ben-hadad agreed with King Asa and sent his army commanders against the cities of Israel, attacking Ijon, Dan, Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth, along with all the land of Naphtali.

dag: Ka n daa ti yɛli piɛri maa, N ku lan nyɛ yi gula. Yi ni bɛn yɛn kpi, kpima; ka bɛn yɛn bahi yoli, bahi yoli; ka chɛ bɛn kpalim ka bɛ ŋmaligi ŋub taba.
en: Then I said, I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ni yɛn zo n-kuli luɣ shɛli tiligi. So yi bi yuri ka ku o kpee ka di mi pala dimdi pun bela bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni.
en: If you accidentally kill someone who is not your enemy, you may escape to any of these cities and be safe.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu yi ti paai ya kaman sanʒiɛɣu la, ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ya kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la, ka biɛrim mini nandahima yi ti paai ya;.
en: Disasters will strike you like a storm. Problems will pound you like a strong wind. Trouble and misery will weigh you down.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bimmɔrima mini yuma ni nyinvɔɣu ni saŋkpana la lu yi zuɣu, ka yi ku kpaŋ.
en: The Lord will punish you with boils, like those he sent on the Egyptians. He will punish you with tumors, sores that run, and an itch that cannot be cured.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni chɛ ka bindirigu yi zuɣusaa luna, ka sokam chani ti pihir o dahin yini dibu tariga dabisili kam, ka n kpahim ba nya bɛ ni tooi doli n zaligu bee bɛ ku tooi dol li.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Im going to make bread rain down from the sky for you. The people will go out each day and gather just enough for that day. In this way, Ill test them to see whether or not they follow my Instruction.

dag: Ka o daa bol o yidana n-yɛl o, Chɛ ka tumtumdi yino zaŋ bun yino ti ma na, ka n chaŋ yomyom ti nya Naawuni nir ŋɔ ka labina.
en: Then she called her husband and said to him, Send a servant here with a donkey. I need to go to the prophet Elisha. I'll be back as soon as I can.

dag: Di ni leei tim tib a niŋgbuŋ, ka chɛ ka a niŋgbuna maai.
en: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni ha nti nya Alifius bia Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma! Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: As he continued along, he saw Levi, Alphaeus son, sitting at a kiosk for collecting taxes. Jesus said to him, Follow me. Levi got up and followed him.

dag: Dama Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim daa yiɣisimi lu Ɛdom Zoli zuɣunim maa zuɣu kuri ba. Bɛ ni daa ti ku ba naai, ka bɛ lan ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu n-ku taba.
en: The Ammonites and the Moabites attacked the Edomite army and completely destroyed it, and then they turned on each other in savage fighting.

dag: Yɛl shɛŋa n ni pun wuhi ya la n-chɛ ka yinim mali zaa ka ka daɣiri ŋɔ.
en: You have already been prepared to produce more fruit by the teaching I have given you.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Ofiri salima bee kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni oniɣisi la bee safaya buɣisi li.
en: cant be weighed against gold from Ophir, with precious onyx or lapis lazuli.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn su laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nɛma fukumsi, ka tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni, ka lan tumdi tuma tiri Izraɛlnima.
en: The Israelites should protect everything in the Meeting Tent; it is their duty. But the Levites will serve the Israelites by caring for these things. This will be their way of serving at the Holy Tent.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa ka di leei bɛ dini naai, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tin shɛli ti Nan bia Jɔshua ka di leeg o dini.
en: When the people of Israel finished dividing up the land, they gave Joshua son of Nun a part of the land as his own.

dag: Zuliya kam wum a vidibo yɛla, ka a kuhigu gili dunia zaa. Dama tɔbbia tuug o tɔbbi kpee, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu.
en: Nations have heard of your shame; everyone has heard you cry. One soldier trips over another, and both of them fall to the ground.

dag: O daa yihi tinzun buɣa mini binnana zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka lan wurim o ni daa me bimbin shɛŋa zaa zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm la n-zaŋ li ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga.
en: Manasseh also removed the idols and the stone image of the foreign god from the temple, and he gathered the altars he had built near the temple and in other parts of Jerusalem. He threw all these things outside the city.

dag: amaa m bi bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ka di pala a yubu ni, dama m bɔri ni a tuun suŋ yila amaŋmaŋ yubu ni na, ka pa ni muɣisigu ni na.
en: However, I do not want to force you to help me; rather, I would like for you to do it of your own free will. So I will not do anything unless you agree.

dag: Ka toli daa yi nyɔhi maa ni lu tiŋgban ni na, ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nɔnsi yiko tatabo ti ba.
en: Locusts came down out of the smoke upon the earth, and they were given the same kind of power that scorpions have.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampima bɔɣi yɔɣu sunsuuni, ka o daa ti ba kom pam din be kaman teeku kɔbulli ni kom la, ka bɛ nyu.
en: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.

dag: Ka Midian kɔhigɔriba daa garita, ka bɛ yihi Yisifu bɔɣili maa ni na n-zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya maa zuɣu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti.
en: When the Midianite merchants came by, Joseph's brothers took him out of the well, and for pieces of silver they sold him to the Ishmaelites who took him to Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn dindali maa yuŋ, Gbaam a ba naɣilaa, ka bo naɣila so ŋun pah ayi ka nyɛ yuma ayopɔin ka daag a ba ni me Baal bimbin shɛl la luhi, ka ŋmaai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi;.
en: That same night the Lord said to Gideon, Choose your fathers best bull, the one that is seven years old. First, use it to pull down the altar your father built to worship Baal. Also, cut down the Asherah pole beside the altar.

dag: Ka piɛri maa zaa daa yi ti laɣim nimaani na, piɛguliba maa paarila kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu sɔŋ ka ŋɔŋ kom ti piɛri maa, ka lan labisi kuɣili maa pa kɔbiliga maa noli zuɣu.
en: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the rock away from the well. Then all the sheep could drink from the water. After the sheep were full, the shepherds would put the rock back in its place.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-doli dinkam sabi Musa zaligu ni la, ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: So be careful to obey and do everything that is written in the book of the Law of Moses. Do not neglect any part of it.

dag: Ham bidibisi mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ tinsi ni bɛ zuliyazuliya yɛtɔɣ kɔŋkɔba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: All these people were descendants of Ham. They are arranged by families, languages, countries, and nations.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan yi o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu Taibɛrias Teeku ni. O ni daa yi bɛ zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jesus later appeared to his disciples along the shore of Lake Tiberias.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi yil yidan ni ti yɛn kuna saha shɛli, amii zaawuni bee yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli bee biɛɣ asiba;.
en: So be alert! You don't know when the master of the house will come back. It could be in the evening or at midnight or before dawn or in the morning.

dag: Sɛgub daa nyɛla Jair ba, ka Jair daa nyɛ ŋun su tinsi pisinaata fukumsi Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: Segub was Jairs father. Jair had cities in the country of Gilead.

dag: m-pahi maligumaaniba, Ɛliakim mini Maasɛya ni Miniamin ni Mikaya ni Ɛliɔnai ni Zakaria ni Hanania bɛn daa piɛbiri kikahi la.
en: my group included the following priests, blowing trumpets: Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah;.

dag: O zaŋ o piɛm pa o tɔbu zuɣu n-darigi li kpa ma.
en: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.

dag: N ni daa nya biŋkɔb so maa daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, ka o naba mali nyinyɛ wɔɣila, ka ŋmani bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la naba, ka o noli ŋmani gbuɣinli noli. Ka waɣ biɛ tital la daa zaŋ o yiko min o nam ʒiishee ni o fukumsi din galisi pam la ti o.
en: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.

dag: Miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa n-kpɛh amaŋ daɣiri ni o sani.
en: You must not have sexual relations with the wife of your fellow Israelite, becoming unclean by it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu bihi mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ni bɛ ti da bindira maa, dama kum maa daa lula Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni gba.
en: Israels sons came to buy grain with others who also came since the famine had spread to the land of Canaan.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti miri kum saha shɛli, ka o daa saɣis o bia Sulemaana yɛli.
en: When David was about to die, he called his son Solomon and gave him his last instructions:.

dag: dama m mi ni yi wunsuhigu mini Yisa Masia Shia sɔŋsim ni fa ma bahi.
en: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.

dag: dama di saha maa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: At that time the Holy Spirit will tell you what to say.

dag: Yawɛ dunoli m-bɔŋɔ; wuntizɔriba kɔŋko n-ni tooi dol li kpe.
en: This is the gate of the Lord ; only the righteous can come in.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tarili ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni sani m-bɔŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi bɛ taba alaka ni deeri pin shɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is how Almighty God punishes wicked, violent people.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka a yɛligu nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, ka a lo a dabili bin suŋ ŋɔ.
en: And now, Sovereign Lord , you are God; you always keep your promises, and you have made this wonderful promise to me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ilaija suhigu, ka chɛ ka bia maa nyɛvili lab o ni na ka o neei.
en: The LORD listened to Elijahs voice and gave the boy his life back. And he lived.

dag: Bɛ yɛla mali dabiɛm pam, bɛ karimbaani zuɣu bɛ zalila bɛmaŋmaŋ zaligunima.
en: They spread fear and terror, and in their pride they are a law to themselves.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔahaz bia la daa lab deei tin shɛŋa Naa Bɛnhadad Hazaɛl bia ni daa tuh o ba Jɛhɔahaz ka fa la. Siɣimsiɣim buta ka Jɛhɔash daa tuhi nyaŋ Bɛnhadad ka fa Izraɛlnim tinsi o sani.
en: Before he died, Hazael had taken some cities in war from Jehoahaz, Jehoashs father. But now Jehoash took back these cities from Hazaels son Ben-Hadad. Jehoash defeated Ben-Hadad three times and took back the cities of Israel.

dag: Lɛmiya yuri galigɛnima bamiya tɔbutuhiri yuri, Pilimiya kuriti zuɣupila zani yi zaashɛhi. Sahimiya yi kpana, ka yɛn ya kuriti gbaɣinɔnima.
en: Get the horses ready. Soldiers, get on your horses. Go to your places for battle. Put your helmets on. Sharpen your spears. Put your armor on.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zahim maa m-mali chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: So the priests and Levites accepted the silver, gold, and special things that Ezra had weighed and given to them. They were told to take them to Gods Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa ti kpe n-zani dunol ni ha, ka Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Nyin Zimiri ŋun ku a dan ŋɔ, Alaafee.
en: When Jehu came through the gate, she said, Do you come in peace, Zimri, you master murderer.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣa maa daa paligi Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa suhuri.
en: This plan seemed good to Absalom and all the leaders of Israel.

dag: Amaa bɛ nyina ni daa na gbab nimdi maa ka di na bi lu bɛ puuni saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi niriba maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: While the meat was still between their teeth and not yet consumed, the LORDs anger blazed against the people. The LORD struck the people with a very great punishment.

dag: Isaka zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaanahi ni kɔbisita.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛm n-zaŋ o bidibisi maa shɛba tahi Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana yaɣa zaa ni ti ʒili bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa ni, ka ti ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka lan bo paɣiba pam ti ba.
en: Rehoboam wisely assigned responsibilities to his sons and stationed them throughout Judah and Benjamin in the fortified cities. He provided generously for them and also secured many wives for them.

dag: Filistianim ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa, bɛ daa zaŋ li yi Ɛbɛnɛza n-tahila Ashidɔd.
en: The Philistines took the sacred chest from near Ebenezer to the town of Ashdod.

dag: Buni mini azichi ni be bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam.
en: wealth and riches will be in their houses. Their righteousness stands forever.

dag: ni piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: rams' skin dyed red; fine leather; acacia wood;.

dag: ka Zɛfania nyɛ Tahat bia, ka Tahat nyɛ Asir bia, ka Asir nyɛ Ɛbiasaf bia, ka Ɛbiasaf nyɛ Kɔra bia.
en: son of Tahath son of Assir son of Ebiasaph son of Korah.

dag: Tayiɣisi yi ka yi yinsi na bee ŋmɛnditoya yi kana yuŋ, pa bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko ka bɛ zura? Ka puri tumtumdib yi kana ni bɛ ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, bɛ ku chɛ binyiha bahi? Amaa yi dimnim bɛn ni kpimsi ya zaa!.
en: You really will be ruined! Thieves will come to you. Robbers will come in the night, and they will take all they want. When workers gather grapes in your vineyards, they will leave a few grapes behind.

dag: ni binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana binyɛra din be kasi ni o bidibisi ni yɛn yɛri binyɛr shɛŋa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma.
en: and the special woven clothes for the priest to wear in the Holy Place. These are the special clothes for Aaron the priest and his sons to wear when they serve as priests.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ya Yawɛ maligumaaniba, ka lan boli ya Naawuni tumtumdiba. Yi ni ti di zuliya shɛb azichi daanfaani, ka nyu bara di ni nyɛ yi dini maa zuɣu.
en: And you will be known as the priests of the Lord , The servants of our God. You will enjoy the wealth of the nations And be proud that it is yours.

dag: Juda zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti ba n-zani kaman tia din ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga wali wala.
en: Those in Judah who survive will flourish like plants that send roots deep into the ground and produce fruit.

dag: Di yɔhimya yimaŋa; Naawuni pala bɛ ni maani so ansarisi, dama ninsal ni biri binshɛli, dina ka o ni ti chɛ.
en: Make no mistake, God is not mocked. A person will harvest what they plant.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan me omaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi zali. O daa mali niɣi mini piɛri pam, dama Naawuni daa ti o buni pam.
en: He acquired towns for himself and many flocks and herds because God had given him great wealth.

dag: N lɔn ya alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka kom di binnɛma zaa, ka m mi ku lan chɛ ka kom di dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: This is my promise to you: All life on the earth was destroyed by the flood. But that will never happen again. A flood will never again destroy all life on the earth.

dag: ka kari ba saria kaman di ni sab zali shɛm. Naawuni niriba bɛn ʒe yim nasara dibu m-bala. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: achieving the justice written against them. That will be an honor for all Gods faithful people. Praise the LORD!.

dag: Kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ni ti tarigi n-kpalim zani Hɛshibɔn, dama buɣim yi Hɛshibɔn na ka buɣim niɛm yi naa Sihɔn yiŋ na. Di di Mɔabnim ninvuɣ zuɣuri, ka di duŋtaariba zuɣuŋmana.
en: In Heshbon tired refugees seek shelter. But fire is raging in Heshbon, flames from the house of Sihon. It has burned up part of Moab, including the leader of this rebellious nation.

dag: Ti Duuma, wuna puuni, wun so kani m-be ka nyini, ka tuun shɛli mi kani ŋ-ŋman a tuma.
en: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.

dag: Ka Sintani lan zaŋ o chaŋ nti du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu n-wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama mini di jilima zaa.
en: Then the devil led Jesus to the top of a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and all the wonderful things in them.

dag: N zaŋ n faako tibu mirina yomyom. N tiliginsim be soli, n ni bo yɛlimaŋli soli ti niriba. Bɛn be katiŋ ha kul guhiri ma mi, ka niŋ n yaa naani.
en: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.

dag: Amaa Gibiɔnnim ni daa wum Jɔshua ni niŋ Jɛriko mini Ai shɛm la zuɣu.
en: The people of Gibeon had also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.

dag: ka Susi bia Gaddi daa yi Josɛf zuliya ni na, ;.
en: from the tribe of Manasseh —Gaddi son of Susi;.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni yiɣisi n suhu darigi bɛ tibili, n ku chɛ ba bee n-zo ba nambɔɣu, hal bɛ yi kuhiri pampam niŋdi ma ni n wum, n ku wum.
en: I will show them my anger! I will not show them any mercy or feel sorry for them! They will shout to me—but I refuse to listen to them.

dag: Ti mini ti yaannim zaa tum alahichi. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri, ka tum tuumbiɛri.
en: We sinned just as our ancestors did. We were wrong; we did bad things!.

dag: Ka ninsalinim daa nyɛ tuhi pinaayɔbu. Ka Yawɛ zaka niriba kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ pihitanaayi.
en: Humans were . of which the LORDs tribute was persons.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: Wherever there is a dead body, the vultures will gather.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa lan pihi kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa.
en: Again the Jews there picked up stones to kill Jesus.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma pam. Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n ni guhiri shɛm yɛn zan tariga?.
en: and my whole being is deeply troubled. How long, O Lord , will you wait to help me?.

dag: Di pala ti daa kala soli ni ti deei shɛli yi sani zuɣu ka ti daa niŋdi lala maa, amaa ti daa bɔrimi ni ti niŋ li ka yi nya, ka di chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu.
en: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia ka di ʒe sokpaŋa; ka o chaŋ di gbini nti bi nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu n-naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko. Ka Yisa daa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga a ku lan wali wala hal abada! Ka tia maa daa dii zani yim kuui.
en: and along the way he saw a fig tree. But when he came to it, he found only leaves and no figs. So he told the tree, You will never again grow any fruit! Right then the fig tree dried up.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi pam ka Ijiptinim ti wum o kuhigu maa, hal ka Firawuna yiŋnim gba ti wum o kuhigu maa.
en: Joseph continued to cry, and all the Egyptian people in Pharaohs house heard it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim ni daa mali zali naai maa, ka maligumaaniba daa kul kpɛri tanti duu din daŋ tooni la ni nti tumdi bɛ maligumaanitali tuma dabisili kam;.
en: Everything in the tent was made ready in the way I have explained. Then the priests went into the first room every day to do their worship duties.

dag: O ku ŋme naŋgbankpeeni bee n-yo vuri, ka so ku wum o kukoli solɔri zuɣu.
en: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.

dag: M mabihi, lala n-nyɛ li. Yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu polo, yi ni nyɛ Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛl la zuɣu ni di chɛ ka yi tooi leei Masia ŋun daa neei kum ni la ni su shɛba din ni chɛ ka ti tum tuun suma ti Naawuni.
en: That is how it is with you, my friends. As far as the Law is concerned, you also have died because you are part of the body of Christ; and now you belong to him who was raised from death in order that we might be useful in the service of God.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ kaman n ni niŋ shɛm maa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini pɔbi yi zuɣusaa naŋgbampiba, yi mi di ti di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Then you will do what I have done. You will not cover your faces or eat the food that mourners eat.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ninsalinim zaa Naawuni, ka binshɛli m-beni n-kpɛm nyaŋ ma.
en: I am the Lord , the God of all people. Nothing is too difficult for me.

dag: Lɛvi do so daa ti kpuɣi Lɛvi zuliya ni paɣa.
en: Now a man from Levis household married a Levite woman.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa ti be mɔɣu ni Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la ka o daa yihiri waazu yɛra.
en: At that time John the Baptist came to the desert of Judea and started preaching.

dag: A yi di niŋ din simdi, n naan ku deei li? Ka a yi bi niŋ din simdi, alahichi do a dunol ni m-bɔri ni di nyaŋ a, amaa di niŋ kamaata ni a nyaŋ li.
en: If you had done the right thing, you would be smiling; but because you have done evil, sin is crouching at your door. It wants to rule you, but you must overcome it.

dag: Bini bahigu so di piligu; ka suɣilo so karimbaani.
en: The end of something is better than its beginning. Patience is better than arrogance.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka Aduna kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee fiɛb taŋkpaɣu, ka pɔri daa yi n-lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zuɣu, taŋkpaɣu maa zaa daa leela pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: So Aaron struck the ground with his stick, and all the dust in Egypt was turned into gnats, which covered the people and the animals.

dag: Ka shɛb daa yiɣisi zani dir o shɛhira kpɛma yɛra.
en: Then some men stood up and told this lie against Jesus:.

dag: Amaa nyin kpuɣim a jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa n-teeg a nuu tiri teeku maa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du.
en: As for you, lift your shepherds rod, stretch out your hand over the sea, and split it in two so that the Israelites can go into the sea on dry ground.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa ka o sanna, amaa ka salo galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ o sani paabu.
en: Jesus mother and brothers came to visit him. But they could not get close to him, because there were so many people.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o puli zuɣu suhiri Naawuni yɛra, M Ba, di yi ni nani, nyin chɛ ka pipia ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu, amaa chɛ ka a yubu n-niŋ, pa n dini.
en: Jesus walked on a little way. Then he knelt with his face to the ground and prayed, My Father, if it is possible, don't make me suffer by drinking from this cup. But do what you want, and not what I want.

dag: Hal a yɛn yɛlimi ni m mali galimi? A wuhimi ni m mali galimi din ni wuhi ni a mali yɛlimaŋli?.
en: Would you question my justice, deem me guilty so you can be innocent?.

dag: Shɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Jafɛt biɛlikpɛma ka nyɛ Ɛbanim zaa yab la gba daa dɔɣi bihi.
en: Shem was Japheths older brother. One of Shems descendants was Eber, the father of all the Hebrew people.

dag: Buɣim di yi tinsi, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ nyɛ zaɣ nɛli. Tinzunnim fa yi tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li yi ninni, ka di kpalimla zaɣ nɛli.
en: Your country has been devastated, and your cities have been burned to the ground. While you look on, foreigners take over your land and bring everything to ruin.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya puuni niriba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda. Ka Shimɛi daŋ puuni niriba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: The men in Levis family will cry by themselves, and their wives will cry by themselves. The men in Simeons family will cry by themselves, and their wives will cry by themselves.

dag: A daalikauli min a suhu yubu zuɣu, ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa ni a chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋ li.
en: It was your will and purpose to do this; you have done all these great things in order to instruct me.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o zali ni bɛ be kaman o Bia la, ka di chɛ ka o Bia maa leei bikpɛma o mabihi pam ni.
en: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.

dag: ka o zaŋ omaŋ wuhi bɛn daa dol o yi Galili chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm la dabisi gbaliŋ. Bɛna n-nyɛ o shɛhiranim niriba sani pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then for many days Jesus appeared to his followers who had gone with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. Now they are telling our people about him.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li niŋ salima bintaɣindisi la ni.
en: The fourth row had a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. All these jewels were set in gold.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul no di luɣ shɛlikam di ni leei yi dini. Yi tintariga ni ti zanila Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban nɛl ni n-zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni hal ti paai Wulinluhili polo teeku la ni.
en: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma ti niriba ŋɔ bee n-kum bee n-zani bɛ zaani suhi ma, dama bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma bɛ muɣisigu saha, n ku garigi ba.
en: As for you, Jeremiah, dont pray for these people of Judah. Dont beg for them. Dont say prayers for them. I will not listen. They will suffer and then call to me for help, but I will not listen.

dag: Yi lihirila binyara niŋgbuŋkom. So be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla Masia nira? Di simdi ni dilan teeg omaŋa ni ti gba nyɛla Masia niriba kaman o ni nyɛ Masia nir shɛm.
en: You must look at the facts before you. If you feel sure you belong to Christ, you must remember that we belong to Christ the same as you do.

dag: Yi ni chɛ so taali paŋ o, n gba chɛ m-paŋ dilana. N yi pun chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, ka di yi shiri nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni n chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, yi zuɣu ka n chɛ li paŋ o zaŋ chaŋ Masia sani.
en: If you forgive anyone for anything, I do too. And whatever Ive forgiven , I did it for you in the presence of Christ.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti yi kpaŋa chaŋ luɣ shɛli ti vuhi biɛla. Dama niriba daa kul kanila o sanna ka chana, hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ dahima diri bindirigu.
en: There were so many people coming and going that Jesus and his disciples didn't even have time to eat. So he said to them, Let us go off by ourselves to some place where we will be alone and you can rest a while.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛl ti shɛlikam maa zaa, ka ni chaŋ a ni kul yɛl ti ni ti cham luɣ shɛlikam.
en: They answered Joshua, We will do everything you have told us and will go anywhere you send us.

dag: O yihiri nanim nam ni, ka chɛri ka bɛ leeri bɛn pa shɛli.
en: He takes away the power of rulers. He makes the worlds leaders completely worthless.

dag: Dan ni ti nyɛla o niriba naa kaman Izraɛl zuliyanim ni yino.
en: Dan will rule his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu yul o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, Yinim bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla yi dini.
en: Jesus raised his eyes to his disciples and said: Happy are you who are poor, because Gods kingdom is yours.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: He placed the rest of his troops under the command of his brother Abishai, who put them in position facing the Ammonites.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka mali Nazari nir maa daalahichi sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: The priest will give these things to the Lord , and then the priest will make the sin offering and the burnt offering.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka biɛrim yiɣisi n niŋgbuna ni m-be kaman paɣa ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la, ka n ni daa wum ka nya ʒii shɛli maa puuni maa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: I saw those terrible things, and now I am afraid. My fear makes my stomach hurt like the pain of giving birth. What I hear frightens me. What I see makes me shake with fear.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinunaayi ka ti daa zaŋ tum gooni maa mɛbu tuma zaa n-naai li gol so bɛ ni booni Ɛlul la biɛɣ pisinaanu dali.
en: So the wall was finished on the twenty-fifth day of the month of Elul. It took fifty-two days.

dag: n-yɛra, O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: The Lord made a covenant with Jacob, one that will last forever.

dag: N ni zaŋ o wain tihi puu la labisi ti o, ka chɛ ka Akɔr Vinvamli leei tahima dunoli. Nimaani o ni ti saɣi ti ma kaman o paɣisarilim saha la ni kaman o ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na saha shɛl la.
en: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say Yes to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi ka po pɔri yɛli, Man ʒi doo maa.
en: Again, Peter said he was never with Jesus. He said, I swear to God I dont know the man.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ Jɔshua sani Giligal sansani la ni nti yɛl o mini Izraɛlnima. Ti yila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ na ni ti mini ya ti lo tab alikauli.
en: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa, ka di bi lu la, dama o daa me li tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the wind blew and beat against that house. It didnt fall because it was firmly set on bedrock.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka lihiri n ni doli so shɛŋa zaa; ka zahindi n napɔna bɔba.
en: You have put chains on my feet. You watch every step I take. You see every move I make.

dag: Naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin bɛn daa yina n-kul gaŋsigaŋsi la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din daa nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛl la gba gbinni nyɛla kum lubu yuma ayopɔin.
en: The seven thin and frail cows, climbing up after them, are seven years. The seven thin ears of grain, scorched by the east wind, are seven years of famine.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma ni ti Naawuni, nyini n-simdi tibigibu ni jilima tibu ni yiko malibu, dama nyini n-nam binshɛɣukam zaa, a yubu ni ka a daa nam li, ka chɛ ka di be.
en: Our Lord and God! You are worthy to receive glory and honor and power. You made all things. Everything existed and was made because you wanted it.

dag: N Naawuni maa yɛliya, Alahichinim ka suhudoo.
en: My God says, There is no peace for evil people.

dag: Azigad daŋ — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pisinaayi.
en: of Azgad .

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa chaŋ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Mordecai did everything Esther told him to do.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam yi bi mali bɛmaŋ niŋ nyam ta Yawɛ sara maligu shee daɣiri, bɛ ni bi niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni mihi ba la zuɣu, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi ba Naawuni niriba ni.
en: Any person who is unclean and didnt cleanse himself will be cut off from the assembly, because he has defiled the LORDs sanctuary. He didnt have the water of purification sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

dag: A ni daa nya ka kuriti mini yaɣiri gari tab shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni ti kpuɣiri tab bipuɣinsi n-lɔri ba amiliya ni di chɛ ka bɛ laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa kuriti mini yaɣiri ni ku tooi gari taba n-leei zaɣ yini shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba ku tooi leei zaɣ yini.
en: Just as you saw the iron mixed with earthy clay, they will join together by intermarrying, but they will not bond to each other, just as iron does not fuse with clay.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti kpe yil shɛli, ka bi bɔri ni so baŋ o yɛla, amaa ka daa bi tooi sɔɣ omaŋa.
en: Jesus went from there to the area around Tyre. He did not want the people in that area to know he was there, so he went into a house. But he could not stay hidden.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpuɣi ba zuɣusaa bɛ yinsi n-ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: the east wind will sweep them from their homes;.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa bi lan saɣi chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, Yɛhudianim bɛn be nimaani ni daa lo ni bɛ ku o la zuɣu.
en: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu gba. Bɛ ni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛli sɔɣi nyɛla din poora, ka din neerina mi nyɛ din bi poora.
en: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta duu bihi mini namɔɣilisi ni daa kana ti yɛl o Mɔdɛkai yɛla, di daa niŋ o suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka o daa bo binyɛra n-ti ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Mɔdɛkai ka o ye ka chɛ buɣu maa, ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: Esthers slave women and eunuchs came to her and told her about Mordecai. This made Queen Esther very sad and upset. She sent clothes for Mordecai to put on instead of the sackcloth, but he would not accept them.

dag: Ka ti daa lan yiɣisi nimaani m-be teeku maa ni chaŋ ti baɣisi Saipurus gari, dama ti daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: We went on from there, and because the winds were blowing against us, we sailed on the sheltered side of the island of Cyprus.

dag: Dama m mini Silvanus ni Timoti ni daa yihi Naawuni Bia ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla waazu shɛli yi sani la daa pala Iin mini Aai yɛla, amaa o ni, di kul nyɛla Iin.
en: The Son of God, Jesus Christ, the one that Silas, Timothy, and I told you about was not yes and no. In Christ it has always been yes.

dag: bɛn nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: All the men from to years old who qualified to serve were counted. These men were given their special work to do for the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋma n-chihi kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kom maa ni, ka daa lan ŋma n-chihi mi shɛŋa din daa lo da shɛŋa din ŋmaligiri ŋariŋ maa, ka zaŋ ŋariŋ maa tanti lo n-tuhi pɔhim, ka pɔhim maa daa ʒe ba duhi duli.
en: So they cut the ropes to the anchors and left the anchors in the sea. At the same time, they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Then they raised the front sail into the wind and sailed toward the beach.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim la zali di ko, ka daa tar li ka di doli bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ naɣilahi la gba lala.
en: Next they divided the entirely burned offerings among the laypeople by their families to sacrifice to the LORD as written in the scroll from Moses, and they did the same with the bulls.

dag: O yɛla ka Anabi Aizaia daa sabi yɛl la. O daa yɛlimi: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: He was the one of whom Isaiah the prophet spoke when he said: The voice of one shouting in the wilderness, Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight. .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔabnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu; bɛ ni daa zaŋ Ɛdom naa kɔba nyo buɣim la zuɣu.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of Moab, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because he burned to lime the bones of the king of Edom.

dag: Teemi ni n nyɛvili nyɛla vuhim kɔŋko, n nini ku lan nya din viɛla.
en: God, remember, my life is like a breath. I will not get a second chance to enjoy it.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbani maa zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo mi daa kpuɣi Tapua m-mali hal ti paai Kana kulibɔŋ n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai di tariga Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dina n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim min o daŋ niriba ni bɛ su la.
en: The border went west from Tappuah to the stream Kanah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was the land given to the families of the tribe of Ephraim as their possession.

dag: ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum alahichi a sani maa mini biriginsim shɛli bɛ ni birig a sani maa zaa taali, ka zo ba nambɔɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbahi ba leei daba maa sani, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gba zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: and forgive your people who have sinned against you. Forgive all their wrong that they have done against you. See to it that those who captured them show them mercy.

dag: Zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Giliad tiŋgbani ni Gaad niriba mini Rubin niriba ni Manaasa niriba tiŋgbana zaa n-lan zaŋ Aroa din baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la hal ti paai Giliad mini Bashan tiŋgbana.
en: from the Jordan River eastward, throughout the land of Gilead , and from Aroer by the Arnon Valley and Bashan.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n yɛn zaŋla nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini bɔɣu din teei ni suhuyiɣisili pam ka di nyɛ yi naa sun ya.
en: As surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God, I warn you that in my anger I will rule over you with a strong hand, with all my power.

dag: Ti ni daa nya filiŋ la o daa bi tam ti yɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun deeri wuhibu zaŋdi bin suma balibu kam tiri ŋun wuhir o.
en: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.

dag: Teemiya bin shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ piligu ni ha la yɛla; dama mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka so kani ŋmani ma.
en: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.

dag: Yi ni daa paai kpe na, Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi daa kana ti liri ti n-tuhi ti, amaa ka ti daa nyaŋ ba.
en: You came to this place, and King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan came out to fight against us. But we defeated them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli mini bɛn be katiŋa, wummiya! Yawɛ daa pun pii ma ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma; n daa na bela m ma pul ni, ka o pun boli n yuli.
en: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.

dag: Ka so yi ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ni yo ka deei li, dindina omaŋmaŋ yi nya liɣiri ka ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ŋun ʒi m-baɣ a, ka o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima a sani, nyin di chɛ ka o tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: If one of your fellow Israelites faces financial difficulty with you and sells themselves to you, you must not make him work as a slave.

dag: Dama yimaŋmaŋ nina daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Yes, you are the ones who have seen all these great things that the Lord has done.

dag: Poloya maa ni ti lir a min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa. .
en: The frogs will crawl up on you, your people, and all your officials.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Labisim a takɔb maa su di tɔɣu ni, dama ŋunkam ŋoori takɔbi ti kpirila takɔb kum.
en: But Jesus told him, Put your sword away. Anyone who lives by fighting will die by fighting.

dag: A yi mali Lɛvinim maa kasi, ka zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni tooi kpe laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni ti tum tuma.
en: The Levites will enter to serve the meeting tent, after you have cleansed them and presented them as an uplifted offering.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛlikam zaa maa.
en: So Aaron and his sons did everything that the Lord had commanded through Moses.

dag: n-yi nimaani n-zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Ka Mikimɛtat daa be bɛ nuzaa polo; ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili daa zaŋ chaŋ wulimpuhili polo ha nti ŋmaligi kpa Taanatishilo polo n-chaŋ ti gari di zuɣu wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Janɔa.
en: and from there to the Mediterranean Sea. Michmethath was on their north. East of there the border bent toward Taanath Shiloh and went past it on the east to Janoah.

dag: Yawɛ guli saamba, ka gbibi pakoya mini kpibisi. Amaa o saɣindi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo nia shɛŋa.
en: The Lord protects strangers in our country. He cares for widows and orphans, but he destroys the wicked.

dag: ka di leei nyɛvili a sani, ka leei nachiinsi bini a nyiŋgol ni.
en: They will bring you a long life filled with honor.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be Damaskus daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: The Arameans from the city of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah. But David defeated and killed , Aramean soldiers.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ nimaani daanya sara maligu bimbini din daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti kɔri biŋkɔbiri tuhili m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu.
en: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the Lord at the Meeting Tent and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ya Yawɛ maligumaaniba, ka lan boli ya Naawuni tumtumdiba. Yi ni ti di zuliya shɛb azichi daanfaani, ka nyu bara di ni nyɛ yi dini maa zuɣu.
en: You will be called The Priests of the LORD; Ministers of Our God, they will say about you. You will feed on the wealth of nations, and fatten yourself on their riches.

dag: Ka yi ti boori li mihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni mini Alikauli Adaka la zuɣu.
en: for dedicating the tent and chest.

dag: To, m mabihi, n chɛbisiri ya mi ŋɔ. Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be dɛde! Doliya n saɣisigu; maliya naŋgban yini; maliya suhudoo ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yurilimlana mini suhudoolana ŋɔ be yi sani.
en: Finally, brothers and sisters, good-bye. Put things in order, respond to my encouragement, be in harmony with each other, and live in peace—and the God of love and peace will be with you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la nimdi pahi yi sara maligunim nimdi zuɣu ŋubi.
en: My people, some sacrifices you burn completely on the altar, and some you are permitted to eat. But what I, the Lord , say is that you might as well eat them all.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ pun niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuma zaa puuni. O mi yi ni be tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ŋɔ ni chani ŋɔ yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul bela yi sani yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa, ka binshɛli bi pooi ya.
