en: Remember that the Lord your God has blessed you in everything you have done. He knows about everything that happened on the trip through this great desert. The Lord your God has been with you these years. You have always had everything you needed.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni san la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu. Sokam zaa nyɛla yim.
en: God treats everyone alike. He accepts people only because they have faith in Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka so mi bi nyɔri firila n-zaŋdi lɔɣu pindi li, amaa o naɣ ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛl zuɣu ni di ne sokam zaa yili maa ni.
en: People dont hide a lamp under a bowl. They put it on a lampstand. Then the light shines for everyone in the house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan kuhi yɛli, Haliluya! Tin titali maa buɣim dibu nyɔhi kul ni tuɣiri hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then they said a second time, Hallelujah! Smoke goes up from her forever and always.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ʒini Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita.
en: The Lord 's people left Egypt exactly years after they had arrived.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saha shɛli maa ka Rubin daa zaŋ ŋun o ba dabipaɣa Biliha dɔni, ka ŋun Izraɛl wum li. Yaakubu bidibisi daa nyɛla pinaayi.
en: Israel stayed there for a short time. While he was there, Reuben slept with Israels slave woman Bilhah. Israel heard about this, and he was very angry. These are the names of Jacobs twelve sons:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Rubin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Bɛza mini Jahaz.
en: From the tribe of Reuben: Bezer and its pastures, Jahaz and its pastures.

dag: Dama Masia ni, nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa yɛda niŋbu din tumdi di tuma yurilim ni n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: Being circumcised or not being circumcised doesnt matter in Christ Jesus, but faith working through love does matter.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi, di chɛ ka n di vi dahin shɛlikam.
en: Lord , I have come to you for protection; never let me be defeated!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli, Yɛlimiya noli ti Mɛrɔz, yɛlimiya no biɛɣu ti di niriba, bɛ ni bi kana ti sɔŋ Yawɛ n-tuhi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ sɔŋ o la zuɣu.
en: The angel of the Lord said, Curse the city of Meroz. Curse its people! They did not come to help the Lord fight. They did not help the Lord against his powerful enemies.

dag: N daa fabili niŋ a n wahala dabisili dali, ka a garigi ma.
en: Whenever I am in trouble, I cry out to you, because you will answer me.

dag: Nir ni tooi di o ba min o ma yili mini bɛ buni fali, amaa yidaampaɣ so ŋun mali yɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: People receive houses and money from their parents, but a good wife is a gift from the Lord .

dag: Ti Duuma lan yɛli: Dinzuɣu yimiya buɣa ni na n-woligi yi ko ka chɛ ba; ka di niŋya din ni ta nir daɣiri, ka n deei ya.
en: Therefore, come out from among them and be separated, says the Lord. Dont touch what is unclean. Then I will welcome you. .

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhirila bɔ? Di wuhirimi ni bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣili nyɛla shɛli bee buɣili maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ shɛli?.
en: Do I imply, then, that an idol or the food offered to it really amounts to anything?.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa tim ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini anabinim maa na Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: Ahab sent the message to all the Israelites. He gathered the prophets at Mount Carmel.

dag: N daa zaŋ yɛ viɛla dih a paɣisarilim, ka zaŋ bansi pir a nuhi ni, ka zaŋ dolibi yɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: I put jewels on you—bracelets and necklaces.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a nuu n-tum lala maa.
en: And let them know that this is by your hand— that you have done it, LORD!.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbibi ŋariŋtuurisi daa yi bɛ ŋarima ni na. Ka kpatoonsi mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa bɛn be teeku ni du nti ʒe duli.
en: Your whole crew will jump ship. The sailors and pilots will jump ship and swim to the shore.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paag a min a niriba ni a yaannim zuliya, ka nyɛ zaɣ biɛ shɛli din tatabo na ʒi m-paai ya, Izraɛl zuliya ni daa woligi ka chɛ Juda zuliya dahin shɛl la zaŋ kana zuŋɔ. O yɛn chɛmi ka Asiria naa kana ti liri ya.
en: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you.

dag: Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya ni nir la n-daa deei Arigɔb yaɣili din daa be Bashan maa zaŋ hal ti paai Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim tintariga, ka daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli boli Bashan, dina n-nyɛ Havɔtijairi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Jair, from the tribe of Manasseh, took the whole area of Argob. That area went all the way to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites. It was named for Jair, and even today, people call Bashan the Towns of Jair.

dag: Yawɛ daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli.
en: The Lord used his servants the prophets to say this:.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o tim o tɔbbihi ni bɛ chaŋ ti ku ninvuɣ kuriba maa, ka nyo bɛ tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: The king was very angry. He sent his army to kill those who murdered his servants. And the army burned their city.

dag: Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun biri biɛla ni ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi biri pam ni ti kpuɣ atam pam.
en: Remember that the person who plants few seeds will have a small crop; the one who plants many seeds will have a large crop.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi Bɔzira din be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ye binyɛr ʒee kanna ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ye binyɛr viɛlli n-kanna ni yiko ni o kpiɔŋ ŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun mali yiko ka ni tooi tiligi niriba la n-kanna ni o ti mol o nasara dibu la molo.
en: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? It's me, the Lord ! I have won the battle, and I can save you.

dag: Tulaale mɔri chɛ ka di nyom chani ginda, ka tiwal viɛla zaa ʒe m-baɣi ti dunoya. N yura, di zaɣ kura mini zaɣ pala ka n zaŋ zal a.
en: You can smell the scent of mandrakes, and all the pleasant fruits are near our door. Darling, I have kept for you the old delights and the new.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ takɔbiri maa ni ŋmaligi ku ba; ka Naawuni kabisi bɛ tɔbiri maa.
en: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ba.
en: The wicked plan bad things for those who are good. They show their teeth in anger at them.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, m mi n ni lɔn ya nia shɛŋa. Di nyɛla nia shɛŋa n ni lo zaŋ chaŋ yi zaɣ viɛlli polo ka pa ni yi zaɣ biɛɣu polo. N ni chɛ ka yi kul mali dahin shɛli biɛhigu tahima.
en: I know the plans I have in mind for you, declares the LORD; they are plans for peace, not disaster, to give you a future filled with hope.

dag: N kul dolila a soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.

dag: O zaŋ yɛm din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yɛm zali wuntizɔriba, ka leei nyɔtaɣirigu gu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi.
en: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bɔhi maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpamba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o maa, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders who had come to get him, Have you come with swords and clubs to arrest me, as though I were a thief?.

dag: Ka Jabɛshi kpamba daa yɛl o, Tim ti daba ayopɔin ka ti tim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ti yɛl ba, ka so yi kani ŋun ni fa ti bahi, di saha ti ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a.
en: The leaders of Jabesh said, Give us seven days to send messengers throughout the land of Israel. If no one will help us, then we will surrender to you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili wain din mali kpiɔŋ pam pipia m-be o nuu ni kpeera, ka o booi li ni o ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri zaa ka bɛ nyu li hal ti naai di zaa kahikahi.
en: The Lord has a cup in his hand. It is filled with the poisoned wine of his anger. He will pour out this wine, and the wicked will drink it to the last drop.

dag: Yawɛ daa wuhi ti shihira ka tum alahiziba tuun kara din mali dabiɛm pam jɛndi Ijipti mini Firawuna ni o yiŋnim zaa ti ninni.
en: Before our own eyes, the LORD performed great and awesome deeds of power against Egypt, Pharaoh, and his entire dynasty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, bɛ ni nyɛ zuliya yini ka mali zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini maa zuɣu ka bɛ tumdi lala maa, ka bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm piligu n-na bɔŋɔ; ka binshɛli kani ka bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ niŋ li ka di ku nani.
en: The Lord said, These people all speak the same language. And I see that they are joined together to do this work. This is only the beginning of what they can do. Soon they will be able to do anything they want.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Filistianim zuɣu. N ni ku Chɛrɛtinima, ka ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be teeku dul la.
en: So the Lord GOD said, I will punish the Philistines. Yes, I will destroy those people from Crete. I will completely destroy those people who live on the seacoast.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnim ti a, ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord God said to my Lord: Sit by me at my right side, and I will put your enemies under your control. Psalm :.

dag: Ka niŋmiya tab nirilim, ka mali nambɔzɔbo biɛhigu, ka chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba Masia zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Be kind, compassionate, and forgiving to each other, in the same way God forgave you in Christ.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be zaashe kara ni, ka ŋun tiri pini nyɛla sokam zo.
en: Many people are nice to a generous person. Everyone wants to be friends with someone who gives gifts.

dag: So yi yɛn zaŋ chi bee kawana na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋm li niɛm zim, ka bo kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pahi di zuɣu.
en: When you give a grain offering to the Lord , your offering must be made from fine flour. You must pour oil on this flour and put frankincense on it.

dag: ni yi doli niriba ŋɔ tatabo niŋsim maa mini ŋunkam pahi bɛ zuɣu tumdi bɛ ni tumdi shɛm maa naba.
en: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.

dag: Amaa ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: But if I throw out demons by the power of Gods Spirit, then Gods kingdom has already overtaken you.

dag: Bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi Masia tuma, ka bi deei sɔŋsim shɛli bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdib la sani.
en: They went on their trip to serve Christ. They did not accept any help from people who are not believers.

dag: Siɣisimiya yimaŋ be baalim, ka mali suɣilo sahakam. Dimiya suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi tab polo yurilim puuni.
en: Conduct yourselves with all humility, gentleness, and patience. Accept each other with love.

dag: Ka yɛlli maa daa muɣisi Siria naa maa pam ka o bol o sapashinnim na nti bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee be Izraɛl naa polo.
en: The Syrian king became greatly upset over this; he called in his officers and asked them, Which one of you is on the side of the king of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ neem o nina lihi ya ka tin ya suhudoo.
en: May the Lord look on you with favor and give you peace.

dag: Du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaanu.
en: This building was cubits long and cubits wide. People entered it from the courtyard on the north side.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun va naɣisaa maa tampiligim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni. Ka dimbɔŋɔ kul ni nyɛ Izraɛlnim mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ sani zaligu sahakam.
en: The man who collects the ashes must wash his clothes, but will remain unclean until evening. This law must always be obeyed by the people of Israel and the foreigners living among them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa chaŋ ti zani wain tihi puri sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din bi yɛlim shee ka goma be di yaɣa ayi zaa.
en: Later, the Lord s angel stood at a place where the road became narrow. This was between two vineyards. There were walls on both sides of the road.

dag: ka o ti kɔrig o sara maligu bimbini la nuzaa polo Yawɛ tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa ti zaŋ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔh o, M mabia, tin bɔnim ka a lee zaŋ ti ma ŋɔ? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tinsi maa yuli Keebal tiŋgbɔŋ hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So he said to Solomon, So these, my brother, are the towns you have given me! For this reason the area is still called Cabul.

dag: yin yɛlimiya: Ti yab daa nyɛla Aram nira ŋun chani ginda, ka o daa ti chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti n-nyɛ sana, bɛ kalinli daa bi yaɣi lala. Nimaani ka o zuliya daa ti nabi n-galisi ka mali yaa pam.
en: Then you should solemnly state before the LORD your God: My father was a starving Aramean. He went down to Egypt, living as an immigrant there with few family members, but that is where he became a great nation, mighty and numerous.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛshikol vinvamli, Izraɛlnim ni daa ŋmaai tiwala yilli nimaani maa zuɣu.
en: That place is called the Eshcol Valley, because there the men of Israel cut off the bunch of grapes.

dag: O suhu daa lan yiɣisi bahi Ayuba zɔnim ata la gba zuɣu bɛ ni daa bi tooi garigi Ayuba maa zuɣu; hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ni Ayuba mali galimi maa zaa yoli.
en: He was also angry with Job's three friends. They could not find any way to answer Job, and this made it appear that God was in the wrong.

dag: Ŋuna n-yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa n-wuhi di tarisi ni nyɛ shɛm n-zaŋ li tari ba; ka bɛ kul su li sahakam, ka be di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn be a tooni, o ni be a sani, o ku chɛ ka a kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛ a bahi. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: But the LORD is the one who is marching before you! He is the one who will be with you! He wont let you down. He wont abandon you. So dont be afraid or scared.

dag: M mabihi, lala zuɣu sokam kul kpalimmi be Naawuni sani kaman o ni daa pun be shɛm ka Naawuni ti bol o.
en: Brothers and sisters, in your new life with God, each one of you should continue the way you were when God chose you.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ zina, ka ku niriba. Bɛ niŋ zina bɛ buɣa sani, ka zaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣi m bi shɛb la ku n-ti ba ni bɛ ŋubi.
en: They have committed adultery and murder—adultery with idols and murder of the children they bore me. They sacrificed my children to their idols.

dag: N ni yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi suhuri saɣim.
en: You are very sad from hearing all of this.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni daa baptaizi ti la wuhiya ni ti be Yisa Masia ni, ka lan wuhi ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi gba?.
en: Did you forget that all of us became part of Christ Jesus when we were baptized? In our baptism we shared in his death.

dag: Ti Duuma zaɣis o sara maligu bimbini, ka chɛ o jɛmbu duu bahi. O zaŋ di nayili goma la niŋ bɛ bɛ dimnim nuu ni. Bɛ ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɔri nasara dibu vuri kaman chuɣu dal la.
en: My Lord rejected his altar, he abandoned his sanctuary; he handed Zions palace walls over to enemies. They shouted in the LORDs own house as if it were a festival day.

dag: Ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli tɔbbihi bɛn yi tɔb maa na, Yawɛ ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Eleazar the priest said to the men of battle who had gone out to war, This is the regulation in the Instruction that the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ Hadadɛza ni su fɔn shɛŋa din nyɛ Tibihat mini Kun la ni nti va daanya pam nimaani. Dina ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ mali daanya ko niŋdi bini la mini daantalisi ni daanya taha la.
en: From Tibhath and Cun, Hadadezers cities, David took large amounts of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze basin, the pillars, and the bronze equipment.

dag: Labimiya kuli, dama n kurigiya pam ni doo kulibu. Ka hal n yi tɛhi ni tahima na ni beni, ka kul doo yuŋ ŋɔ gba n-dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: Go back home. I am too old to have a new husband. Even if I thought I could be married again, I could not help you. If I became pregnant tonight and had two sons.

dag: ni Hilikia bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Zadok mini Mɛrayɔt ni Ahitub ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan la.
en: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni fabili Mɔabnim zuɣu. N ni kum Mɔabnim zaa zuɣu pam, ka fabili Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu.
en: But Ill still wail for Moab; Ill cry out for all Moab; Ill sob for the people of Kir-heres.

dag: ni kahiŋkɔɣu balibu kam zaa.
en: any kind of raven.

dag: Dauda daa gbahila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili mini wɔribariba tusaayopɔin ni tɔbbi tinchandiba tuhi pisi. O daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali, ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa napɔn jila.
en: David took chariots, chariot drivers, and , soldiers from Hadadezer. David also crippled most of Hadadezers horses that were used for pulling chariots. But David saved enough horses to pull chariots.

dag: Zuliya shɛb buɣili na mi n-fa o tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi?.
en: Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. A yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Izraɛlnima; ka lan yɛli ma ni m miri ka n lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa dalim Yisahaku zuliya.
en: So now listen to what the Lord says. You tell me to stop prophesying, to stop raving against the people of Israel.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti di li la yili yin ni ka di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ di nimdi yi samban ni bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili.
en: The entire meal must be eaten inside, and no one may leave the house during the celebration. No bones of the Passover lamb may be broken.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi teeku la tula yuŋ maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim n-chɛ ka Lɛviatan suhu yiɣisir la.
en: Let those with magic powers place a curse on that day.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ yi be ka soli wuhibu ka di ni, di lurimi, amaa saawarimaaniba ni galisi luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka niriba be ni alaafee.
en: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.

dag: m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana tuma zuɣulaannim tusaata ni kɔbisita shɛb bɛn daa lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma la.
en: There were men to supervise the workers.

dag: Zilinli ŋmanila buɣim. Zilinli lan ŋmanila dunia ŋɔ yɛl biɛri m-be ti niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-tari ti niŋgbuna maa zaa daɣiri, ka zaŋdi buɣim n-juuri ti dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu, ka buɣim din bi kpiri la mi taari li.
en: And the tongue is like a fire. It is a world of wrong, occupying its place in our bodies and spreading evil through our whole being. It sets on fire the entire course of our existence with the fire that comes to it from hell itself.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa laɣim ʒiya kumdi ka fabindi la ni Yisa neei kum ni.
en: After Mary saw Jesus, she went and told his followers. They were very sad and were crying.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi lu soli gbaai chandi m-mali hal ti paai wulimpuhili polɔnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jacob got to his feet and set out for the land of the easterners.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri moli nolɔbo molo, ka zaŋ Nabɔt ʒili jilima ʒiishee niriba maa ni.
en: They proclaimed a day of fasting, called the people together, and gave Naboth the place of honor.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa tim ti deeg o o yidan Palitiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Laishi bia la sanna.
en: Ishbosheth sent some of his men to take Michal away from her new husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

dag: O daa piila tumtumdiba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣ kpɛriba bɛn be zoya ni tuhi pihinii, ka pii niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumda.
en: He put , men to work transporting materials, and , to work cutting stone in the hill country. There were , others responsible for supervising the work.

dag: Dama yi ni ti di vi yi ni yuri buɣa oki ti shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka yi suhuri ti saɣim yi ni pii yi sambani pu shɛŋa ti yi wuna la zuɣu.
en: In the future, you will be ashamed of the oak trees and special gardens you chose to worship.

dag: Naɣila biŋkɔbiri ka ti daa zaŋ leei ti ni ŋme tɔb di shɛli m-pahi ti ni daa ŋme n-fa neen shɛŋa fɔntin shɛŋa ti ni daa dee la ni.
en: We took only the cattle and the valuable things from those cities.

dag: Ka Sirianim maa daa kana ni bɛ ti liri Ilaisha, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N suhir a, chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ zom! Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ shiri zom kaman Ilaisha ni daa suh o yɛli shɛm maa.
en: These horses and chariots of fire came down to Elisha. He prayed to the Lord and said, I pray that you will cause these people to become blind. So God did what Elisha asked. He caused the Aramean army to become blind.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya malaika so ka o ʒe wuntaŋa n-kuhiri pampam booni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ha yɛra: Laɣimmiya na nti di Naawuni ni tin ya bindir shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: Then I saw an angel standing in the sun, and he called out with a loud voice and said to all the birds flying high overhead, Come and gather for Gods great supper.

dag: ni zoli kam zuɣu mɔɣu ni la yɛla. N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ zaa ni n-yo yi daalahichi maa samli.
en: Because you have committed such sins throughout your country, I will give to your enemies my mountain in the land, as well as your wealth and all that you treasure.

dag: Ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ n dan maa ni pam ka o leei bundana. O ti o piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni anzinfa mini salima ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnim ni bunsi.
en: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.

dag: dama n suhu kul yɛmi ni n nyan ya n-zaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli kpaŋsi ya.
en: For I want very much to see you, in order to share a spiritual blessing with you to make you strong.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka di shɛli kpalim ka biɛɣu neei paai li bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili. Bɛ doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa zaligu puhi li.
en: They must not leave any of that food until the next morning. And they must not break any of the bones of the lamb. They must follow all the rules about Passover.

dag: Naawuni ka n niŋ naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: In him I trust, and I will not be afraid. What can a mere human being do to me?.

dag: Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya ha ka ti wum binyiɣira kpiŋkpama vubu damli.
en: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a nya ma ka mali suhupiɛlli, dama m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: Then those who honor you will see me and be glad because I have waited for your promise.

dag: Ka bɛ daa moli molo gili Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda ni bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn daa lab kulina la laɣimmi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: A message was sent throughout Jerusalem and Judah that all those who had returned from exile were to meet in Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli vuhim, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin vuhim, yim luɣa anahi zuɣu n-kana ti kpe bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima. .
en: God said to me, Mortal man, prophesy to the wind. Tell the wind that the Sovereign Lord commands it to come from every direction, to breathe into these dead bodies, and to bring them back to life.

dag: Amaa a min a bihi yi zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka bi doli fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zali ya la, ka ŋmaligi doli buɣa jɛmdi li.
en: But if you or any of your descendants disobey my commands or start worshiping foreign gods.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o ni o niŋm shɛm maa. Ka ŋun Balak mini Balaam daa kɔrigi naɣila yino mini piɛla yino m-mali sara pa bimbin yini kam zuɣu.
en: Balak did as he was told, and he and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: Nyin ŋun tɛha bi zilimmi ŋɔ, a bɔri ni so n-wuh a ni yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma nyɛla yɛda ŋoli?.
en: You fool! Do you want to be shown that faith without actions is useless?.

dag: Chɛ ka zuɣusaanim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka dunianim mali suhupiɛlli. Yɛlimiya zuliya kam ni, Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa.
en: Let the heavens rejoice and the earth be happy! Let people everywhere say, The Lord rules.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pita, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus replied, Peter, I tell you that before a rooster crows tomorrow morning, you will say three times that you don't know me.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani binnɛma anahi. Bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa ŋmanila ninsalinima.
en: At the center of the storm I saw what looked like four living creatures in human form.

dag: Alahichinima chɛli bɛ daalahichi soli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri chɛ bɛ tɛhi biɛri, ka ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ka o ti zo ba nambɔɣu, dama o ni chɛ bɛ taali zaa.
en: Evil people should stop living evil lives. They should stop thinking bad thoughts. They should come to the Lord again, and he will comfort them. They should come to our God because he will freely forgive them.

dag: Ka kum bee kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim bee biisim shɛli mi ku lan kpe ba.
en: They wont hunger or thirst anymore. No sun or scorching heat will beat down on them.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo li buɣim.
en: When the Philistines fled, they left their idols behind, and David gave orders for them to be burned.

dag: Ninsal yi tum o ninsal kpee taali, Yawɛ ni tim di sandaani. Amaa ninsal yi tum Yawɛ taali, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tim di sandaani? Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ ba yɛligu maa wumbu, dama Yawɛ daa pun lo ni o ni ku ba.
en: If anyone sins against someone else, God can defend the one who is wrong; but who can defend someone who sins against the Lord ? But they would not listen to their father, for the Lord had decided to kill them.

dag: Di yuri gbihibu, di yi pa lala fara ni gbaag a. Neem a nina, a ni nya bindirigu pam.
en: If you love to sleep, you will become poor. Use your time working and you will have plenty to eat.

dag: Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni nimaani, ka salo maa zaa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: A large crowd gathered around him. So he got into a boat and sat down. All the people stayed on the shore.

dag: ka bi nahindi saamba mini kpibisi ni pakoya bee n-kuri bɛn ka taali kpe, ka bi jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ barina zaŋ chaŋ yi sani ŋɔ.
en: if you stop taking advantage of the immigrant, orphan, or widow; if you dont shed the blood of the innocent in this place, or go after other gods to your own ruin.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulinluhili polo ti yɛli Yawɛ ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: Those who survive will sing for joy. Those in the West will tell how great the Lord is.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli ba, Yihimiya salima tibikpara din be yi paɣiba tiba ni mini yi bipuɣinsi tiba ni ni din be yi bidibisi sani n-zaŋ na ti ti ma.
en: Aaron told them, Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.

dag: Ka n ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa shɛli yɛla. Bɛ tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be.
en: I will forgive the sins he has committed, and he will live because he has done what is right and good.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. M bɔri ni a kpaŋsi yɛla ŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka bɛn niŋ Naawuni yɛda tooi zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma. Dimbɔŋɔnim viɛla, ka mali buchi ninsalinim sani.
en: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa siɣi tiŋgban kuŋ ni du, ka kom maa daa kul pirigi ʒiɛya kaman goma la bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: But the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground, with walls of water on both sides.

dag: Be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi alizanda ni ka lihi tiŋ na n-niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim min a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ŋɔ ni kaman a ni daa po pɔri yɛli ti yaannima ni di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam la.
en: Our Lord , look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise.

dag: M mabihi, n daa naan ku tooi tɔɣisi ya kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla, amaa n daa tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dolila daadam biɛhigu bee kaman bɛn na nyɛ biliɛri Masia dolibu ni.
en: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anii puuni ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti Bɛrɛkia bia Anabi Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la yɛli.
en: In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was emperor of Persia, the Lord gave this message to the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and grandson of Iddo.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa ni noonsi balibu kam ni binshɛɣukam zaa bɛn chani gindi dunia ni balibu kam zaa daa dol taba yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: the living creatures left in groups of their own kind.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla a dahalali niriba, ka nyɛ a ni daa teeg a bɔɣu ni yiko din galisi yihi shɛb na. .
en: After all, these are the people whom you chose to be your own and whom you brought out of Egypt by your great power and might.

dag: ka ʒiɛm n zaligunim ka zaɣisi li yi suhu ni, ka bi niŋ n zaligunim maa zaa ni yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm, amaa ka saɣim n daalikauli.
en: if you reject my rules and despise my regulations, not doing all my commands and breaking my covenant.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa pun wuhi niriba maa shɛm la zuɣu, maligumaaniba ayopɔin bɛn gbibi piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin n-ʒe Yawɛ tooni la n-daa gari tooni chani ka piɛbiri kikahi maa, ka bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa doli ba.
en: As soon as Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying seven rams horn trumpets moved forward in front of the LORD. They blew the trumpets. The LORDs covenant chest followed.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi zo Firawuna suhuyiɣisili. O daa bi saɣi ni o lab o nyaaŋa; o daa bemi kaman o nini nyala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nir ni ku tooi nya so ŋɔ.
en: It was faith that made Moses leave Egypt without being afraid of the king's anger. As though he saw the invisible God, he refused to turn back.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa kuri su shɛli din mali naŋgbana ayi, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kaman sɛntimita pihinu ka o zaŋ li lo n-tabil o nudirigu gbalipini n-ye o binyɛrigu limsi li.
en: Ehud had made himself a double-edged sword about a foot and a half long. He had it fastened on his right side under his clothes.

dag: Amaa ka Sool ŋun yiko daa kul pahirimi, ka o kahigiri wuhiri ni Yisa nyɛla Masia; ka o yɛligu maa daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Damaskus maa birim.
en: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: O miri ka o di biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dari tɔhi biŋkɔb so, ka di kpɛh o daɣiri ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Di saha ka Juda zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini Bɛnjamin zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni sokam bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni daa neei shɛb suhuri daa mali shili ni bɛ kuli nti lab me Yawɛ duu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then the heads of the clans of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and Levites, and everyone else whose heart God had moved got ready to go and rebuild the Lord 's Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi suhuri mini yi tɛha leela zaɣ pala zaa.
en: You must be made new in your hearts and in your thinking.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mi Leeban Nahɔr bia la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti mi o.
en: He asked, Do you know Laban, grandson of Nahor? Yes, we do, they answered.

dag: Anfaani maa wuhiri ti ni ti zaɣisim din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini dunia ŋɔ kɔr biɛri, amaa ka lee gbibi timaŋa ka mali bebu din tuhi, ka mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: That grace instructs us to give up ungodly living and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright, and godly lives in this world.

dag: ka o daa po pɔri n-lo alikauli ni bipuɣiŋga maa yi suh o shɛlikam zaa, o ni ti o li.
en: Then he swore to give her anything she asked.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zooi yomyom kaman kuliga ni mɔri la, ka lan zooi yomyom kaman mo shɛŋa din ʒe baa din kom zɔri ni la.
en: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.

dag: Di saha maa ka Daadam Bia shihirili ni ti be zuɣusaa, ka zuliya kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti fabili, ka nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then the sign of the Human One will appear in the sky. At that time all the tribes of the earth will be full of sadness, and they will see the Human One coming in the heavenly clouds with power and great splendor.

dag: dama yi niriba ayi maa daa bi ʒe ma yim Izraɛlnim sunsuuni Mɛribatikadɛshi kom la gbini Zin tiŋgban nɛl la ni, yi ni daa bi gbibi m biɛrikasitali Izraɛlnim sunsuuni la zuɣu.
en: because both of you were unfaithful to me in the presence of the people of Israel. When you were at the waters of Meribah, near the town of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin, you dishonored me in the presence of the people.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu;.
en: When it was getting late, his disciples came to him and said, It is already very late, and this is a lonely place.

dag: Naa maa daa yɛli ba, Man Naa Ahasivɛrɔs n-tim nayili bihi Napaɣ Vashiti sani nti yɛl o yɛligu ka o zaɣisi n noli! Ka wula ka zaligu lee wuhi ni ti niŋm o.
en: The king said to them, Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that.

dag: Ka Tɔi ŋun daa nyɛ Hamat naa daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa;.
en: When Hamaths King Toi heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer.

dag: Ŋunkam chɛri ŋun turi niriba taali paŋd o nyɛla ŋun bɔri zɔtali, amaa ŋunkam teeri zabili nyɛla ŋun saɣindi zɔtali.
en: One who seeks love conceals an offense, but one who repeats it divides friends.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni mi, bɛ daa yihila Mashal mini Abidɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: In the territory of Asher: Mashal, Abdon.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka Samaria wurim n-leei mɔɣu ni, ka nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni yɛn sari wain tihi. Ka n ni ti va di kuɣa zaa ti bahi vinvamli ni, ka chɛ ka di tanzahi la yi n-do palo ni.
en: So I will change Samaria into a pile of rocks in the field, a place ready for planting grapes. I will push Samarias stones down into the valley, leaving nothing but the foundations.

dag: Ka n daa paai Jɛrusalɛm m-be nimaani dabisi muna ata.
en: I went to Jerusalem and stayed there three days. Then at night I started out with a few men. I had not said anything to anyone about what my God had put on my heart to do for Jerusalem. There were no horses with me except the horse I was riding.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: His disciples replied, Where are we going to get enough food in this wilderness to satisfy such a big crowd.

dag: Ka Sool daa po Yawɛ yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a ku nya tibidarigibo shɛli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Saul used the Lord s name to make a promise to the woman. He said, As surely as the Lord lives, you wont be punished for doing this.

dag: Yaa be o nyiŋgoli ni, ka dabiɛmnim ʒe o tooni ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: His neck is so powerful that all who meet him are terrified.

dag: Ti ni daa chɛbisi ba bahi ka ti ŋariŋ yiɣisi n-zaŋ sochibiga nti paai Koos n-naanyi neei biɛɣu m-paai Rodis n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Patara.
en: After we said goodbye to the elders, we sailed away straight to Cos island. The next day we went to the island of Rhodes, and from there we went to Patara.

dag: Paɣimiya ti Duuma ŋun kul gbib ti dabisili kam ŋɔ. Naawuni n-nyɛ ti tiliginsim.
en: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di chɛ ka n ʒim yi n-lu tiŋa tiŋgban shɛli din mini Yawɛ shee wɔɣa ni taba ŋɔ ni, dama Izraɛl naa kana ti kariti doli ma kaman nir ni kariti doli kɔriŋga zoya zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Don't let me be killed on foreign soil, away from the Lord . Why should the king of Israel come to kill a flea like me? Why should he hunt me down like a wild bird.

dag: ni Nan ni Jɔshua.
en: Nun, and Joshua.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu biɛyanim ninvuɣ pia la daa chaŋ Ijipti ni bɛ ti da kawana.
en: Ten of Joseph's brothers went to Egypt to buy grain.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M ma, ka wula ka a yɛl ni n niŋ? N saha na bi paai.
en: Jesus answered, Dear woman, why are you telling me this? It is not yet time for me to begin my work.

dag: O chɛ ka n noli bemi kaman takɔbi dirili la. O daa zaŋ ma sɔɣila o nuu mahim ka daa chɛ ka m be kaman peen dirili la, ka o zaŋ ma su o lɔɣu ni.
en: He used me to speak for him. He used me like a sharp sword, but he also held me in his hand to protect me. He used me like a sharp arrow, but he also kept me safe in his arrow bag.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛm; baŋsim ka bɛ sani.
en: Israel is a nation without sense; they have no wisdom at all.

dag: Yawɛ, ŋmaligim na tiligi ma; fam ma bahi a yurilim din galisi la zuɣu.
en: Come and save me, Lord ; in your mercy rescue me from death.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni nir doli ŋun be nam fukumsi ni yɛligu, ka di pa ni o yi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ni kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa o suhu ni tɛha gba dɔnibu zuɣu.
en: For this reason you must obey the authorities—not just because of God's punishment, but also as a matter of conscience.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yiɣisim lu m piɛgul ŋɔ zuɣu ku o, ka piɛri maa wurim, ka n lu bɛ zaɣ bihi gba zuɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.

dag: ka daa kpihi buɣim din mali dabiɛm, ka daa tiligi takɔb kum ni. Bɛ daa nya kpiɔŋ bɛ gbariginsim saha. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhir biinsi bɛn tuhi nyaŋ tinzun tinsi tɔbbihi.
en: put out fierce fires, escaped being killed by the sword. They were weak, but became strong; they were mighty in battle and defeated the armies of foreigners.

dag: A yi nya noombil tiɛɣu tia kam zuɣu bee tiŋa, ka o bihi bee o gala be di ni, ka o ŋuni noombihi maa zuɣu bee gala maa zuɣu, nyin di gbaai nooŋa maa min o bihi maa.
en: If you come across a birds nest along your way, whether in a tree or on the ground, with baby birds or eggs, and the mother is sitting on the baby birds or eggs, do not remove the mother from her young.

dag: Bɛ daa leela zoomba n-dari gindi soya zuɣu, ka ʒim varim ba hal ka so ti ku tooi shihi bɛ binyɛra.
en: Her leaders wandered through the streets as though blind, so stained with blood that no one would touch them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ, mani n-zaŋ li zali zuliya pam sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔna pam gil li.
en: Then the Lord GOD said to me, The brick is a picture of Jerusalem. I put Jerusalem in the middle of other nations with countries all around her.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa daa niŋ Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm nyaɣisim pam.
en: This agreement made Hamor and Shechem very happy.

dag: Lala niriba n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmd o, bɛna n-lan nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: because they worship and serve the God of Jacob.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka mali Nazari nir maa daalahichi sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: The priest shall present all these to the Lord and offer the sin offering and the burnt offering.

dag: ka m mi ni a kul deeri n suhigu sahakam; amaa niriba bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ zuɣu ka n suhir a maa ni di chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I know that you always listen to me, but I say this for the sake of the people here, so that they will believe that you sent me.

dag: Yihim yɛlimuɣisira n suhu ni, ka yihi ma n nandahima ni.
en: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.

dag: ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ku bɛ ni bɛn mali kpiɔŋ. O daa booi Izraɛl nachimbihi gahinda kalinli.
en: So Gods anger came up against them: he killed the most hearty of them; he cut down Israels youth in their prime.

dag: dindina n ni chɛ ka a ʒi Izraɛl nam ʒiishee sahakam kaman n ni daa pun lo a ba Dauda alikauli yɛli, N kul ku chɛ ka ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kɔŋ o zuliya ni.
en: I will keep the promise I made to your father David when I told him that Israel would always be ruled by his descendants.

dag: Hɛbɛr ŋun nyɛ Kɛn nir la paɣa Jaɛl mal alibarika pam paɣiba ni. Paɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa puuni, ŋuna m-mal alibarika.
en: The most fortunate of women is Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite— the most fortunate of women who live in tents.

dag: Ka a ni ti lan nya ka a zuliya galisi. Ka a bihi ti galisi kaman mɔri ni galisi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: You will know that youll have many children. Your offspring will be like the grass of the earth.

dag: O zahindila puu pɔi ka naanyi da li. O zaŋdila o ni tum tuma nya laɣ shɛli n-ko wain tihi puu.
en: She looks at land and buys it, and with money she has earned she plants a vineyard.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ dabisa shɛm ka ti nini bi nya wuntaŋa bee saŋmarisi ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul bi chɛ ti ʒiɛbu la zuɣu daa chɛ ka ti yihi ti nyɛviya tahima.
en: For several days we could not see either the sun or the stars. A strong wind kept blowing, and we finally gave up all hope of being saved.

dag: O zaŋla dunia ŋɔ niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; o pɔbila di sariakaritiba nina; di yi pala ŋuna, ka ŋuni?.
en: Is it God who keeps the leaders from seeing when an evil person takes control? If it is not God, then who is it?.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa garigi yɛli, Biɛɣu ni neei, amaa yuŋ ni lan zibi yaha. A yi bɔri ni a bɔhi, nyin lan labimina ti bɔhi.
en: The guard answered, Morning is coming, but then night will come again. If you have something else to ask, then come back later and ask.

dag: Di simdi ni o ŋmaligi ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu ka tumdila din tuhi. Di simdi ni o bola suhudoo, ka kul biɛhiri di naba hal ti nya li.
en: They should shun evil and do good; seek peace and chase after it. .

dag: Ka yi yi zaŋ ŋumbɔŋɔ gba chaŋ, ka binshɛli ti niŋ o, yi ni chɛ ka n kpi ni n zab piɛla ŋɔ ni suhugarigu.
en: And if you take this one from me too, something terrible will happen to him, and you will send me—old as I am—to my grave in despair.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa, ka lan nya bɛ ni ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka o taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni daa lo ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa polo, ka daa shiri bi niŋ li.
en: God saw what they were doing—that they had ceased their evil behavior. So God stopped planning to destroy them, and he didnt do it.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ o niriba kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gul o ni pii na so la, ka tiligir o.
en: The Lord protects his chosen one. He saves him and gives him strength.

dag: Ka Jɛbusi tiŋbihi maa daa yɛli Dauda, A ku kuli ya ŋɔ na. Amaa ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: The Jebusites said, You won't be able to get in here! But David captured the fortress of Mount Zion, which is now called the City of David.

dag: Ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa ka teeg o bɔɣu n-tum yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm, ka tum alahiziba tuma ka wuhi shihira n-yihi ti Ijipti maa.
en: Then the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his great power and strength. He used great miracles and wonders and did amazing things.

dag: Vi bi mali ma lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu, dama lahibal suŋ maa nyɛla Naawuni yiko din tiligiri ŋunkam niŋ li yɛda; Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: Im not ashamed of the gospel: it is Gods own power for salvation to all who have faith in God, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, ka yi zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, dinzuɣu n ku lan fan ya bahi yaha.
en: But you still left me and worshiped other gods, so I am not going to rescue you again.

dag: ka filim ya, ka yi di vi din ka naabu, ka ku tam di yɛla.
en: and I will make you a disgrace forever. You will never forget your shame.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, Bɛ mal li kunila Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti me di duu zali nimaani. Bɛ yi ti me di duu maa naai, bɛ ni zaŋ piɛɣu maa zali di ni.
en: He said to me, To build a house for it in the land of Shinar. It will be firmly placed there on its base.

dag: O daa mɛla buɣili Baal maligu bimbini zali o ni daa me Baal jɛmbu du shɛli zali Samaria la puuni.
en: He built a temple and an altar in Samaria for worshiping Baal.

dag: N ni ti ŋooi takɔb lu yi zuɣu wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari, ka chɛ ka yi fɔntinsi ti bahi yoli.
en: I will scatter you among the nations. I will pull out my sword and destroy you. Your land will become empty, and your cities will be destroyed.

dag: So nahu yi ʒe n-ti o kpee nahu daŋa ka o kpi, bɛn kɔhimi naɣ nɛɔŋ maa m-pirigi liɣiri maa ti taba, ka lan pirigi naɣ kpiŋ maa gba ti taba.
en: When someones ox hurts someone elses ox and it dies, then they should sell the live ox and divide its price. They should also divide the dead animal between them.

dag: dama Naawuni yɛligu mini wunsuhigu nyɛla din chɛ ka di leeri din be kasi Naawuni sani.
en: Everything he created is made holy by what he has said and by prayer.

dag: Di saha ka Barakɛl bia Ɛlihu suhu daa yiɣisi. O daa nyɛla Buz daŋ ni nira, ka yi Ram malibu ni na. O suhu daa yiɣisimi bahi Ayuba zuɣu, o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali, amaa ni Naawuni m-mali taali la zuɣu.
en: Elihu son of Barachel the Buzite from the clan of Ram was angry, angry with Job because he considered himself more righteous than God.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, dama n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n Naawuni.
en: Why am I so sad? Why am I so upset? I tell myself, Wait for Gods help! You will again have a chance to praise him, your God, the one who will save you.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi Yawɛ ni daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Yuza zuɣu shɛm maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛrɛzuza hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: and so that place has been called Perez Uzzah ever since. David was furious because the Lord had punished Uzzah in anger.

dag: Daliri dini zuɣu ka ti lee ni nyu bara? Daliri shɛli kani. Bɔ n-niŋ ka di kani? Ti ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu? Aai! Di nyɛla ti ni niŋ yɛda la zuɣu!.
en: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.

dag: Dama ʒiɛmana pam din gari la ha zaŋ kana ni pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ kul karindila Anabi Musa zaligu Yɛhudianim tiŋ kam jɛmbu duu ni Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka karimbanima naanyi yihir o yɛligu waazu.
en: After all, Moses has been proclaimed in every city for a long time, and is read aloud every Sabbath in every synagogue.

dag: Ka n ti darigi Mɔabnim tibili, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will punish Moab, and they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: So miri ka o ti zaŋ o ma dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa ka nyɛ o ma, di bi simdi ni o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: You must never have sexual relations with your father or mother. She is your mother, so you must not have sexual relations with her.

dag: Shihira ŋɔ ni ti be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ lahibal suŋ maa yɛda yɛligu ni: Bɛ ni ti mali n yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ni ti tɔɣisi tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa.
en: These signs will be associated with those who believe: they will throw out demons in my name. They will speak in new languages.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, alizin birigu n-ʒi m bia zuɣu, ka n zaŋ o tah a sanna.
en: Someone from the crowd answered, Teacher, I brought my son to you. A demon keeps him from talking.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus heard them and answered, People who are well do not need a doctor, but only those who are sick.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake daa yiɣisi zani n-kuhi pam yɛli Judanim yɛligu ni, Wummiya na titali ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa la ni yɛli shɛm! O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then the field commander stood up and shouted in Hebrew at the top of his voice, saying, Listen to the message of the great king, Assyrias king.

dag: dama dina n-ni chɛ ka ti Duuma niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tim Yisa Masia so o ni daa pun lo ni o ni tim yi sanna la.
en: Then the Lord will provide a season of relief from the distress of this age and he will send Jesus, whom he handpicked to be your Christ.

dag: Ka o daa be bɛ sani hal ni yuma ayɔbu n-kul sɔɣila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka Atalia daa leei naa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, so yi po pɔri n-zaŋ daadam ti Yawɛ kaman yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me.

dag: Ka Abinɛr min o niriba maa daa chaŋ yuŋ maa zaa n-gari Araba ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn zani zuɣu ni ka bɛ paai Mahanaim.
en: Abner and his troops marched through the Jordan River valley all that night. Then they crossed the river and marched all morning until they arrived back at Mahanaim.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Mɔabnim dindali maa, ka nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinii.
en: Moab was so badly defeated that it was a long time before they were strong enough to attack Israel again. And Israel was at peace for years.

dag: ni nyaanyiriba ni bɛn baɣa ka shɛl ni ni maŋduhiriba ni bɛn yuri niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim gari Naawuni.
en: People will turn against their friends. They will do foolish things without thinking and will be so proud of themselves. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi gbana ŋɔ, ti ni dihi ti dalinli tabili dabu gban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ mini gban shɛli din pahi ŋɔ nti niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni ka di ku saɣim yoma.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: Take both copies of the deed—the sealed copy and the copy that was not sealed—and put them in a clay jar. Do this so that these deeds will last a long time.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, M min a ku labi, dama a zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu, ka Yawɛ gba zaɣisi ni a ku lan nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: No! Samuel replied, You disobeyed the Lord , and I won't go back with you. Now the Lord has said that you can't be king of Israel any longer.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ wuntizɔriba pahi paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuyanim pam daa dihi bɛ yɛligu maa tabili, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool mini Silas.
en: Some were convinced and joined Paul and Silas, including a larger number of Greek God-worshippers and quite a few prominent women.

dag: Ka Shafan daa lab Naa Jɔsia sanna nti yɛl o, A tumtumdiba yihi laɣ shɛli zaa din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa.
en: then went back to Josiah and reported, Your officials collected the money in the temple and gave it to the men supervising the repairs.

dag: Din lan nyɛ yi dini m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni yihi shɛlikam pin shɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la puuni, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi ni di nyɛ yi tarili, ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa, ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: This will also belong to you, your sons, and your daughters: Im giving you the gift offerings and all the Israelites uplifted offerings. This is a permanent regulation. Anyone who is clean in your household may eat it.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti nya kpiɔŋ, ka muɣisi Keenannim maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba, amaa ka lee bi kari ba.
en: Later, the Israelites grew stronger and forced the Canaanites to work as slaves for them. But the Israelites could not force all the Canaanites to leave their land.

dag: Ʒim la ni ti nyɛla shihirili din wuhiri yi ni be yi yiya shɛŋa ni. Ka n yi ti kuri Ijiptinim na ti paai ya ka nya ʒim maa, n ni kpahi yaɣ ya gari, ka yinim yi alɔbo maa ni.
en: But the blood on your houses will be a special sign. When I see the blood, I will pass over your house. I will cause bad things to happen to the people of Egypt. But none of these bad diseases will hurt you.

dag: A soli daa timla teeku ni gari, ka a sɔbil mi tim ko titaŋa ni gari, amaa ka so daa bi nya ka a napom bɔba doya.
en: You walked through the water and crossed the deep sea, but you left no footprints.

dag: Di dabisi tuuli dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka miriya ka yi tum tuma.
en: On the first day of this festival, you will have a special meeting. You must not do any work on that day.

dag: Ka niriba maa yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka saa bi mira, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na n-kuhi bol a yuli ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa ka suh a.
en: Sometimes they will sin against you, and you will stop the rain from falling on their land. Then they will pray toward this place and praise your name. You make them suffer, and they will be sorry for their sins.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n diri wahala ŋɔ. Amaa vi bi mali ma, dama m mi n ni niŋ so yɛda, ka mi ni o ni tooi gbibi n ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ o nuu ni la hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: And I suffer now because of that work. But I am not ashamed, because I know the one I have put my trust in. And I am sure that he is able to protect what I have put into his care until that Day.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ zali ya ni sokam pihim o dimma tarig la. Di simdi ka sokam baŋ o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm tariga, ka pihi lita ayi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, Each of you should gather what you need, a basket of manna for everyone in your family.

dag: Hal o ni da tɔbbi shɛb ka bɛ be o sani maa ŋmanila naɣisa kpaba, bɛn gba ŋmaligimi guui doli taba. Bɛ bi zani, dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili paaya din nyɛ bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: The foreign soldiers you hired will turn and run. But they are doomed, like well-fed calves being led to the butcher. *.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali saŋmarisi zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔna ayi ni.
en: and the stars. He placed these altars in both courtyards of the temple.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla kum, amaa nir yi zaŋ o tɛha niŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi yɛla ni, di bahigu ti nyɛla nyɛvili mini suhudoo.
en: To be controlled by human nature results in death; to be controlled by the Spirit results in life and peace.

dag: ka yɛli ma, N ni wuh a Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ʒii maa wuhirila di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yɛla maa naabu saha.
en: He said, Now, I am going to tell you what will happen during the time of doom that is coming, because at the appointed time there will be an end.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu yi ti ʒiɛra, ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Storms come, and the wicked are blown away, but honest people are always safe.

dag: Di niŋya tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Mɛriba mini bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Masa tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Don't be stubborn, as your ancestors were at Meribah, as they were that day in the desert at Massah.

dag: ni zaŋdi ya tahiri maa, ka yi ti di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindirigu, yin zaŋmiya di shɛli ti Yawɛ.
en: When any food produced there is eaten, some of it is to be set aside as a special contribution to the Lord .

dag: Ka yi yi ni zɔr Yawɛ ka jɛmd o, ka deer o noli ka ku zaɣisi ŋun Yawɛ zaligunim dolibu, ka yi mini yi na so ŋun sun ya maa zaa doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa, dindina shɛlikam ni niŋ viɛnyɛla yi sani.
en: If you will fear the LORD, worship him, obey him, and not rebel against the LORDs command, and if both you and the king who rules over you follow the LORD your God—all will be well.

dag: Di saha maa ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti bɔhi Pool, Yɛlim ma, a shiri nyɛla Rom tiŋbia? Ka Pool saɣi, Iin.
en: The commander went to Paul and asked, Tell me, are you a Roman citizen? Yes, Paul answered.

dag: ka yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti ni chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni m-puɣisi nya li maa tiŋgbani viɛli pam.
en: and said to the people, The land we explored is an excellent land.

dag: Taainim mini Sidɔnnim ni tin shɛŋa din zaa be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni yi niŋ ma maa? Yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri binshɛli zuɣu? Yi yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri, n ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu yomyom!.
en: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.

dag: Fukumsinim yi bɔhi ti zuŋɔ taabu ŋɔ gbinni, ti ni kpe yɛla ni di zuɣu, dama ti ka daliri yɛlli ŋɔ puuni din ni zaŋ wuhi ba.
en: We could easily be accused of starting a riot today. There is no excuse for it! We cannot even give a reason for this uproar.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku nyini Ahimɛlɛk min a daŋ zaa.
en: But the king said, You will be executed, Ahimelech—you and all of your fathers household.

dag: Ya polo ka Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva buɣa la lee be? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Have they rescued Samaria from my power?.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti yi mɔɣu ni na zaawuni, ka Liya yi nti tuh o soli yɛl o, N yɛn kpɛla a sanna zuŋɔ, dama n zaŋla m bia ŋmaankpihiga yo a zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu min o daa dɔni dindali maa yuŋ.
en: When Jacob came in from the fields in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, You are going to sleep with me tonight, because I have paid for you with my son's mandrakes. So he had intercourse with her that night.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka saa kum ka mi dindali maa. Ka Yawɛ mini Samuɛl yɛla daa gbahi niriba maa zaa dabiɛm pam.
en: Samuel prayed, and that same day the Lord sent a thunderstorm. Everyone was afraid of the Lord and of Samuel.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ taɣimiya yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma, ka deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu, ka ŋun Yawɛ ni taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛn chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli paai ya maa polo.
en: You people, change your lives! You must start doing good! You must obey the Lord your God. If you do that, he will change his mind. He will not do the bad things he told you about.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirits.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, n ni chɛ ka poloya yina yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: If he refuses, I will cover his entire country with frogs.

dag: Adiini alali din nyɛ din ka galimi ti Ba Naawuni sani nyɛla kpibisi mini pakoya lihibu bɛ wahala ni mini maŋgbaabu zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gabisiri niriba la polo.
en: True devotion, the kind that is pure and faultless before God the Father, is this: to care for orphans and widows in their difficulties and to keep the world from contaminating us.

dag: Aduna mini Musa zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛba saha shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli zuɣu la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa bi tɔɣisi ti suhumahili yɛtɔɣa, ka yɛli ni ti nyɛla puɣisiriba bɛn kana ni ti ti puɣisi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: The governor of Egypt spoke harshly to us and accused us of spying against his country.

dag: N nya n dabili Dauda, m booi n kpam din be kasi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: I have made my servant David king by anointing him with holy oil.

dag: Yi ʒiɛri kpam, ka niŋdi tulaale pam niŋdi yimaŋ chani ti jɛmdi Molɛk. Buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu, yi timdi tuumba katinsi hal ka timdi ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: You went down to Molech with oil, and you slathered on your ointments; you sent your messengers far away, sent them down to the underworld.

dag: ka daa ʒi nimaani gul o.
en: They sat there, guarding him.

dag: ka kuhiri yɛri zoya maa mini tampima maa, Lumiya ti zuɣu na n-lim ti ka ti sɔɣi yi ni, ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni nini ku lan nya ti, ka Piɛbil ŋɔ mi suhuyiɣisili yɛlli ŋɔ ku paai ti.
en: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.

dag: Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa soya ka m bɔhim baŋ a daalahiziba tuma.
en: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti tim Judas mini Silas ni bɛ ti yɛli ya ti ni sab yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ bɛmaŋmaŋ nol ni pahi.
en: Therefore, we are sending Judas and Silas. They will confirm what we have written.

dag: O chɛ ka tom pali n ni, ka chɛ ka n di wahala.
en: He saturated me with grief, made me choke on bitterness.

dag: Yi ni ti mali alibarika gari zuliya kam. Ka dɔɣibu kalinsi ti ku be yi ni bee yi biŋkɔbiri ni.
en: You will be more blessed than any other group of people. No one will be sterile or infertile—not among you or your animals.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Ka sɔŋsim bɔ ka a leei bɔra? Ka n daa suhi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ.
en: The king asked, What is it that you need? I prayed to the God of heaven.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Sisɛra min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o tɔbbihi zaa birim Barak tooni, ka Barak daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ba. Ka Sisɛra daa sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu na guui.
en: Barak and his men attacked Sisera. During the battle, the Lord confused Sisera and his army and chariots. They did not know what to do. Barak and his men defeated Siseras army, but Sisera left his chariot and ran away on foot.

dag: Amaa ka o lee yɛli ma, Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Dinzuɣu miri ka a nyu wain bee binnyuri kpiɔŋ; a mi miri ka a di binshɛli din chihiri dibu; dama bia maa ti yɛn nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani o dɔɣibu dali zaŋ hal ti paag o kum dali. .
en: but he did say that I'm going to have a baby boy. I'm not supposed to drink any wine or beer or eat any food forbidden by God's laws. Our son will belong to God for as long as he lives.

dag: tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa mi Sinai Zoli zuɣu nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ninni.
en: The ground shook and rain poured from the sky when God, the God of Israel, came to Sinai.

dag: N kul zaŋ n nina kpala Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-ni yihi n naba zana ni.
en: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayi, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ayi yɛli, Kamina.
en: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, Come out.

dag: Ka o daa boli maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba na nti bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka bɛ daa lee yɛli ni bɛ ni ti dɔɣi Masia la.
en: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, Where will the Messiah be born.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa garigi yɛli bɛ ni yino, Zɔri, m bi din ya zalinsi. Ka bɔh o, Bee yi di bi saɣi ni yi ni deei tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: But the man who owned the field said to one of them, Friend, I am being fair with you. You agreed to work for one silver coin. Right?.

dag: O bihi nyurila ʒim. Bɛ ni ku binyara luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka o be.
en: and their young lap up blood; where carcasses lie, there they are.

dag: Yi mi ni Masia daa kana ni o ti kpihimla ninsalinim daalahichi, ka alahichi ka o ni.
en: You know that Christ appeared in order to take away sins, and that there is no sin in him.

dag: Teemiya n dabili Musa wuhibu la yɛla; n ni daa zal o zali kpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi Sinai Zoli gbini ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim zaa la.
en: Remember the Instruction from Moses, my servant, to whom I gave Instruction and rules for all Israel at Horeb.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zalizali.
en: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ti kpɛna n-gbaai salo maa yulibu nti nya do so ka o bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa binyɛrigu.
en: The king went in to look at the guests and saw a man who was not wearing wedding clothes.

dag: Tummiya tuma daba ayɔbu, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la dali, yin vuhimiya, ka chɛ ka yi niɣi mini yi bunsi ni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb yi yinsi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa vuhi dindali maa.
en: Do your work in six days. But on the seventh day you should rest so that your ox and donkey may rest, and even the child of your female slave and the immigrant may be refreshed.

dag: Puhimiya n churi siɣimsiɣim buta yuuni puuni.
en: You should observe a festival for me three times a year.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n sɔɣila a sani; fam ma bɛn zaa kariti doli ma la nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma.
en: I take refuge in you, LORD, my God. Save me from all who chase me! Rescue me!.

dag: A mali pal yɛlinli ti n naba, ka m bi sarigi.
en: You cleared a path for my feet so that I could walk without stumbling.

dag: Dindina, ka bɔ ka nir lee yɛn zaŋ Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ buɣisi? So bi ŋman o.
en: So to whom will you compare me, and who is my equal? says the holy one.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi ka dɔro maa bi yɛligi situra maa ni bee kpalua ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ mali shɛli maa ni.
en: But if the priest sees that the infection has not spread in the clothing, the weaving, or on any skin item.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa shiri bi neei kum ni, dindina yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla yoli, ka yi na kul kpalim be yi daalahichi ni;.
en: And if Christ has not been raised from death, then your faith is for nothing; you are still guilty of your sins.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋmi alikama mini chi ni tuya ni sima ni za ni alikama bali shɛli n-niŋ ŋman yini ni m-mali amaŋmaŋ bɔrɔbɔro. Dabisa shɛŋa a ni yɛn do a luɣili zuɣu maa, di nyɛla dabisa kɔbisita ni pihiwɛi, dina ka a ti yɛn ŋubira.
en: Now take some wheat, barley, beans, peas, millet, and spelt. Mix them all together and make bread. That is what you are to eat during the days you are lying on your left side.

dag: ka tiŋgbani daa bɔɣi, ka bɛ mini Kɔra zaa lu di ni ka buɣim di bɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ kpi, ka tiŋgbani maa mum ba niŋ; ka di leei saɣisigu yɛlli ʒiɛya la.
en: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, along with Korah, when the community died and fire devoured persons. They became a warning sign.

dag: Di ʒiɛman maa ni Ahitɔfɛl daa yi kul yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ŋmanila Naawuni maŋmaŋ yɛligu n-nyɛ li. Ka Dauda min o bia Absalom zaa daa yi bi zaŋd o yɛligu niŋd asahi.
en: So in those days Ahithophels advice was very important. Both David and Absalom accepted his advice as though it were the word of God.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa yi n-chaŋ ti yɛl o deennim bɛn daa yɛn kpuɣ o bipuɣinsi la, Yiɣisimiya n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, dama Yawɛ yɛn saɣim li mi. Amaa ka o deennim maa daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ asahi.
en: Then Lot went to the men that his daughters were going to marry, and said, Hurry up and get out of here; the Lord is going to destroy this place. But they thought he was joking.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛdaniŋdib shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Farisiinim la yiɣisi zani yɛli, Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka niŋ Yisa yɛda maa guni, ka lan niŋ kamaata ni ti yɛli ba ni bɛ doli Anabi Musa zaligu.
en: But some Pharisees had become followers of the Lord. They stood up and said, Gentiles who have faith in the Lord must be circumcised and told to obey the Law of Moses.

dag: Amaa ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: No, it is not Beelzebul, but God's Spirit, who gives me the power to drive out demons, which proves that the Kingdom of God has already come upon you.

dag: Yuŋ yi ti zibi bɛ kanimina ti chani gindi tiŋ puuni ŋ-ŋuhiri kaman bahi la.
en: They come back in the evening, snarling like dogs as they go about the city.

dag: Nir yi be tiŋgban nɛl ni, di so ni o mali paɣ so ŋun mali suhuyiɣisili ka bɔri zabili.
en: Better to live out in the desert than with a nagging, complaining wife.

dag: Amaa yinim ŋmaligimiya labi yi nyaaŋa kpe tiŋgban nɛl ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo.
en: But you—you must turn around, take the road to the Red Sea and go back into the desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli ya zuŋɔ, amaa yi bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tim ma na ni n ti yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa maa ni shɛli.
en: And now I have told you, but you are disobeying everything that the Lord our God sent me to tell you.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋ kam ka bɛ deei ya, yin dimiya bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam;.
en: Whenever you go into a town and are made welcome, eat what is set before you.

dag: M paɣiri ya, dama yi teeri n yɛla binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka doli kal shɛŋa n ni zaŋ wuhi ya la.
en: I praise you because you remember me in all things. You follow closely the teachings I gave you.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi la, alahichi sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛba bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Say to Aaron and his sons: This is the Instruction for the purification offering: The purification offering must be slaughtered before the LORD at the same place the entirely burned offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaai Lɛviatan n-labi duli na bee n-zaŋ mia lo o zilinli?.
en: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?.

dag: Dabisa shɛŋa puuni zaa o ni wolig omaŋ maa, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: As long as you are a nazirite, you are consecrated to the Lord .

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zan o sani nimaani ka yɛli, N yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: The Lord God came down in a cloud and stood beside Moses there on the mountain. God spoke his holy name, the Lord .

dag: Taainim mɛla birini gili bɛmaŋa, ka va anzinfa mini salima puli kaman taŋkpaɣu la!.
en: Tyre has built fortifications for herself and has piled up so much silver and gold that it is as common as dirt!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa mali naɣibil so maa nyo buɣim m-baɣisi li ka di niŋ zim, ka o zaŋ li niŋ kom ni n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nyu li.
en: He took the bull-calf which they had made, melted it, ground it into fine powder, and mixed it with water. Then he made the people of Israel drink it.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ li tila kapintanim mini tammɛriba ni bɛ da kuɣ kpɛra mini yɔɣira ni gurilɔnima m-mali Juda nanim ni daa chɛ ka shɛli polo lu la me.
en: the carpenters and the builders to buy the stones and the timber used to repair the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to decay.

dag: Ka yi yi bi doli zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ n-luri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli din mali jilima mini dabiɛm ŋɔ sizuura.
en: You must obey all the commands and teachings that are written in this book. And you must respect the wonderful and awesome name of the Lord your God. If you dont obey.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka o nyu n-naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan yɛl o, N ni ŋɔŋ kom ti a laakumnim ŋɔ ka bɛ gba nyu hal ti tiɣi.
en: When he had finished, she said, I will also bring water for your camels and let them have all they want.

dag: Firawuna yi ti yɛli ya ni yi tummi alahiziba tuuni din wuhiri ni mani n-shiri tim ya na, nyin yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee bahi tiŋa Firawuna tooni ka di leei wahu.
en: Pharaoh will ask you to prove your power. He will ask you to do a miracle. Tell Aaron to throw his walking stick on the ground. While Pharaoh is watching, the stick will become a snake.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bapira Uziɛl bidibisi la na n ti yɛli ba, Mirimiya na ti kpuɣi yi mabihi maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ yi ti biɛhigu shee ŋɔ kpaŋa.
en: Then Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan the sons of Uzziel, Aarons uncle, and told them, Go carry your relatives out from the front of the sanctuary to a place outside the camp.

dag: Amaa o cham maligumaana Ɛliɛza sani ka o lihi Urim puuni Yawɛ sani m-baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm ti o. O mini Izraɛlnim zaa doli Ɛliɛza ni yɛli ba shɛm, o yi yɛli ni bɛ yima, bɛn yima, ka o yi yɛli ni bɛ labimina, bɛn labimina.
en: He will depend on Eleazar the priest, who will learn my will by using the Urim and Thummim. In this way Eleazar will direct Joshua and the whole community of Israel in all their affairs.

dag: N ni gbilisi tibili labila yɛtɔɣ ŋaha polo, ka ŋme mɔɣilo n-kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.

dag: Dinzuɣu kamina ka n ti tim a Firawuna sani ka a chaŋ ti yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So get going. Im sending you to Pharaoh to bring my people, the Israelites, out of Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛligi kaman o ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la, ka yi ti bɔri ni yi ŋubi nimdi, dama nimdi kɔre ni ti mali ya, yi ni tooi ŋubi yi ni bɔri li saha shɛli.
en: Once the LORD your God has enlarged your territory, as he promised you, and you think to yourself, Id like to eat some meat , feel free to do so whenever you want.

dag: Yi ni ti be suɣa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin. Izraɛl tiŋbihi zaa ni ti bela suɣa ni.
en: For seven days you must live in huts. Every citizen of Israel must live in huts.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, bɛ tahima lee nyɛ dini saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti chɛ ba bahi, saha shɛli Naawuni yi ti deei bɛ nyɛviya?.
en: What hope is there for the godless in the hour when God demands their life?.

dag: ni Sidɔnnim ni Amalɛknim ni Maɔnim ni daa nahindi ya, ka yi kum niŋ ma la, n daa bi fan ya bɛ nuu ni bahi?.
en: Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to me, didnt I rescue you from their power?.

dag: Saha shɛli kanna, ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman tia la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma, ka wali wala. Ka bɛ zuliya ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, Izraɛlnima, yi ŋmanila Itiɔpianima n sani? Pa mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na? Pa mani n-daa yihi Filistianim Kafitɔr na, ka daa yihi Aramnim Kiri na?.
en: The Lord says, People of Israel, I think as much of the people of Ethiopia as I do of you. I brought the Philistines from Crete and the Syrians from Kir, just as I brought you from Egypt.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pakoli ŋun su yili maa bidibiga maa daa ti biɛra, ka di muɣis o hal ka o ti tarigi.
en: Several days later, the son of the woman who owned the house got sick, and he kept getting worse, until finally he died.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋdimi ni di chɛ ka tiŋgbani tiɣi kom, tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ dabari ka ka buchi, ni di chɛ ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni.
en: The rain gives that dry empty land all the water it needs, and grass begins to grow.

dag: Asiria naa Sarigɔn ni daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi zuɣulana chaŋ ti liri Ashidɔdnima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba yuun shɛl la.
en: Sargon was the king of Assyria. He sent his military commander to fight against Ashdod. The commander went there and captured the city.

dag: Ka ŋun diri binshɛɣukam miri ka o ʒiɛm ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni di dibu, ka ŋun gbaar omaŋ maa mi miri ka o ti ŋun diri shɛlikam zalige; dama Naawuni deei dilana gba.
en: Those who eat must not look down on the ones who dont, and the ones who dont eat must not judge the ones who do, because God has accepted them.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ n-saɣim bɛ nanim yinsi.
en: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.

dag: Ka Abiata daa yina, nyama, ka Zadok gba mini Lɛvinim zaa daa kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na ti zaŋ li zali hal ka niriba maa zaa ti yi tiŋ maa ni na.
en: Zadok was there too, along with all the Levites carrying the chest containing Gods covenant. They set Gods chest down, and Abiathar offered sacrifices until all the troops had finished marching out of the city.

dag: Yi yi saɣi li, ka deei n noli, yi ni di tiŋgbani ŋɔ bin suma anfaani.
en: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.

dag: ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa bi kpuɣi li kuli Babilɔn saha shɛl o ni daa gbaai Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin ŋun daa nyɛ Juda Naa la min o kpambaliba zaa ni Jɛrusalɛm kpambaliba zaa kuli Babilɔn la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: which Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar didnt plunder when he deported Jeconiah the son of Judahs King Jehoiakim from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the officials of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Tuuli Adam nyɛla Naawuni ni daa nam so ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ, ka Adam ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa mi nyɛ Shi so ŋun tiri nyɛvili.
en: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.

dag: Bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisiya, bɛ bi lan garigi shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli.
en: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.

dag: M paɣiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun ti ma yaa ni n tum ŋɔ. M paɣir o o ni lihi ma ka n simdi ni o pii ma ka n tum o tuma.
en: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.

dag: ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni kum ni daa yɛn lu la piligi kaman Yisifu ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kum maa daa lula luɣilikam zaa tiŋgbɔna ni; amaa ka bindira daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ din zaa ni.
en: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in every other country, but there was food throughout Egypt.

dag: Ka naa maa daa tim ti boli Haman na yomyom ni bɛ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ Ɛsta sani ni bɛ ti di ka nyu binnyura maa.
en: The king said to his servants, Hurry and get Haman, so we can accept Esther's invitation. The king and Haman went to Esther's dinner.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Jɛriko nti tim di tiŋ puuni garita.
en: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through town.

dag: Yinim bɛn yɔhindi niriba ŋɔ, wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ ya? O ku darigi yi tibili?.
en: What more will be given to you, what more will be done to you, you dishonest tongue?.

dag: Ka sapashinnim bɛn daa su chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi maa ni daa nya ka di pala Izraɛl naa maa ka bɛ ŋmaligi ka chɛ o.
en: they realized he wasn't Ahab, and they left him alone.

dag: Bɛ chanila bɛ zaɣim, ka ka situra, ka ʒiri kabɔba, ka kum mali ba.
en: But the poor must go out with no clothes to protect them; they must go hungry while harvesting wheat.

dag: Ka n garigi bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli ma, Man Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: Who are you? I answered. The Lord replied, I am Jesus from Nazareth! I am the one you are so cruel to.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛmaŋ naani mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani.
en: That is what happens to all who trust in themselves and to anyone who accepts their way of life. Selah.

dag: Di simdi ni yi dɔbba zaa kani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sanna buta yuuni puuni.
en: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.

dag: ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni o daanfaani zuɣu, ka leeg o falidiriba zaŋ chaŋ nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima niŋbu la polo.
