en: We were made right with God by his grace. God saved us so that we could be his children and look forward to receiving life that never ends.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhi, N napɔŋ yɛn sarigi la, Yawɛ, ka a yurilim maŋli la gbaai ma zali.
en: Whenever I feel my foot slipping, your faithful love steadies me, LORD.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri pini nyarimi pahira, ka ŋun tiri kom gba nyari kom.
en: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ bɔhir o, A yɛn mɛla duu ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: to go to David and give him this message: David, you are my servant, so listen to what I say. Why should you build a temple for me?.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa mali binshɛŋa daa galisiya pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi laɣim be luɣ yini. Bɛ niɣi zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛli maa bi saɣi ba.
en: They had so many possessions that they couldnt live together. The land where they lived as immigrants couldnt support all of their livestock.

dag: A ni kul yiɣisina, a na mi n-zali asiba di ni yɛn piligi saha shɛli? Ka chɛ ka biɛɣu neebu mi di biɛhigu shee?.
en: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?.

dag: Yisifu bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ: Manaasa mini Ifriim.
en: Josephs two sons were Manasseh and Ephraim. Each son became a tribe with its own family groups.

dag: Ka o lan tim so pah ata, ka bɛ ti bu n-ti o daŋa, ka kar o bahi.
en: Then he sent a third slave; the tenants wounded him, too, and threw him out.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lo a dabili alikauli ni a ni niŋ o zaɣ viɛlli ŋɔ.
en: Lord , you are God, and you yourself promised to do these good things for me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri bi viɛla, lala biɛhigu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o suhu piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The Lord hates evil-minded people, but loves those who do right.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina, n yi lan niŋ Filistianim zaɣ biɛɣu, di pala n taali.
en: Samson said, This time I'm not going to be responsible for what I do to the Philistines.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi ni jɛm niriba maa zuŋɔ, ka zaŋ zilin balli yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: They replied, If you want to serve this people well, give a favorable answer to their request, and they will always serve you loyally.

dag: O daa lan mali kpa shɛli din be kasi shɛli bɛ ni yɛn mali boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni, ka lan mali tulaale zim alali din nyom viɛla kaman tulaale duɣira ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: He also made the holy anointing oil and the pure sweet-smelling incense like a skilled perfume maker.

dag: Nyin ʒe samban ni, ka a ni yɛn paŋ so bini maa zaŋ a ni yɛn deei binshɛli ti sɔŋ maa yina ti ti a.
en: You must stand outside. Then the person who you gave the loan to will bring out the security to you.

dag: Niriba ni ti laɣim be Juda tiŋgbɔn ni mini di fɔntinsi zaa ni. Ka pukpariba mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu ti beni.
en: People in all the towns of Judah will live together in peace. Farmers and those who move around with their flocks will live peacefully together in Judah.

dag: O daa lan wuh o o ni ti yɛn piri maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma zaa shɛm ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋdi tumdi tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: David also gave him the plans for organizing the priests and Levites to perform their duties, to do the work of the Temple, and to take care of all the Temple utensils.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mali taali. Yi ŋmanila goon wɔɣinli din tahi bɔɣi, di ku yuui ka di lu n-libigi niriba.
en: your sin will be like a crack in a high wall; it bulges, about to fall: suddenly, in an instant, it breaks!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu kpari, dama bɛ daa na bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.

dag: Amaa n ti ku yihi n suhu o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n suhu Sool ŋun daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: But I will never take my faithful love away from him like I took it away from Saul, whom I set aside in favor of you.

dag: Di saha Chɛmɔshi yɛla ni ti gbaai Mɔabnim vi kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl naani ka di yɛla ti gbahi ba vi shɛm la.
en: And Moab will be put to shame on account of Chemosh, just as the people of Israel were put to shame on account of Bethel, in which they trusted.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani ti pihiri li asiba kam sokam dibu tariga, amaa wuntaŋ daa yi ti bii, di nyɛligirimi.
en: Every morning each one gathered as much as he needed; and when the sun grew hot, what was left on the ground melted.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa nyarila o ninni ni nyaɣisira, ka o zaŋ sariga pili lir li, naɣila o ti lan chaŋ ni o mini Yawɛ ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: The people would see that Moses face was shining bright, so he would cover his face again. He kept his face covered until the next time he went in to speak with the Lord.

dag: Anabi Musa daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba zaa sani kaman yilibia la ni o di Naawuni ni ti yɛn yɛli binshɛŋa yɛla la shɛhira;.
en: Moses was faithful in God's house as a servant, and he spoke of the things that God would say in the future.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi tɛha ni.
en: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it.

dag: ni o deei Judas ni daa tum birigi n-chaŋ o chandi shee ka chɛ tinim tuumba ŋɔ tuun shɛl la.
en: to take the place of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas turned away to go to his own place.

dag: ka yɛli li, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, nyini Seir Zoli. N teela n nuu jɛnd a ni n chɛ ka a zani dabari bahi yoli.
en: Say to it, This is what the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Mount Seir! I will punish you and make you an empty wasteland.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini.
en: You cannot add any time to your life by worrying about it.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, Jahaziɛl n-daa pah ata, ka Jɛkamiam pah anahi.
en: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sujee kuri jɛrigu, ka nyuli zabbu mi kuri ŋun ka yɛm.
en: A fools anger will kill him. His jealousy will destroy him.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛl o, A mi amaŋmaŋ suhu ni a ni daa tum m ba Dauda tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa, dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni labis a tuumbiɛri maa zaa ʒil a.
en: You know all the bad things you did to my father David. Now the Lord will punish you for it.

dag: M bi saɣi ni paɣiba nyɛ karimbanima bee n-su dɔbba fukumsi; di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ shini baalim.
en: I dont allow a woman to teach a man or tell him what to do. She must listen quietly.

dag: tɔbu ni lu yi zuɣu, ka yi birininim la zaa ti wurim. Di ni ti bemi kaman Naa Shaliman ni daa ŋme Bɛtaribɛlnim tɔbu, ka wurim li, ka zaŋ bihi mini bɛ manim tɔri taba n-kuri ba shɛm la.
en: Therefore, the noise of war will rise against your people; all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth-arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed into pieces with their children.

dag: Dama o zaɣisila Naawuni m-pah o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O bela ti sani m-maani Naawuni ansarisi, ka yɛr o zilima pahira.
en: To his sins he adds rebellion; in front of us all he mocks God.

dag: Ti mabihi, teemiya ti ni daa tum ni ti yaa tariga ka di wahala shɛm la yɛla. Ti daa kul tumdimi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku muɣisi ya ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ din yi Naawuni sanna la waazu tin ya.
en: Surely you remember, our friends, how we worked and toiled! We worked day and night so that we would not be any trouble to you as we preached to you the Good News from God.

dag: Ka n kurim n-teei dɔni m puli zuɣu, ka kul chani gindi n-fabindi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I am bent over, I am crushed; I mourn all day long.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla nini, wula ka di di yɛn niŋ wum? Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla tibili, wula ka di di yɛn wum nyom?.
en: If the whole body were an eye, it would not be able to hear. If the whole body were an ear, it would not be able to smell anything.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti, dama ti niŋ yɛda ni ti ka galimi ti suhuri tɛha ni; ka di nyɛla ti ni bɔri ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka di tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Continue praying for us. We feel right about what we do, because we always try to do what is best.

dag: Di saha ka nu shɛli daa gbaai ma n-kpuɣi ma gbani n duna zuɣu ka n nuhi dihi tiŋa, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: But then a hand touched me, lifting me up to my hands and knees.

dag: Ka ŋunkam be Masia ni, o bi tumd alahichi; ka ŋunkam kul tumd alahichi, dindina o na bi nya o bee m-mi o.
en: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.

dag: Miri ka a di zunyuŋnim bindira bee n-chɛ ka a kɔre kpe di ni di nyaɣisim zuɣu;.
en: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi jɛmd a la zuɣu. Dama bɛna n-vali Yaakubu zuliya. Bɛ vali Yaakubu zuliya n-naai ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: If you are angry, then punish the other nations. They dont know or respect you. They dont worship you. Those nations destroyed Jacobs family. They destroyed Israel completely. They destroyed Israels homeland.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm gbaŋ maa ni m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs, a bihi bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ ti a.
en: This is a copy of the letter they sent to him. To King Artaxerxes from your servants, the people of the province Beyond the River.

dag: Ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba maa daa lab yiŋa.
en: Moses and Israels elders were assembled in the camp.

dag: Wuhim ma n ni bi nyari shɛli, di yi nyɛla n tumla tuumbiɛri, n ku lan tum lala yaha?.
en: Have you asked God to show you your faults, and have you agreed to stop doing evil?.

dag: Nir yi be tiŋgban nɛl ni, di so ni o mali paɣ so ŋun mali suhuyiɣisili ka bɔri zabili.
en: It is better to live alone in the desert than with a quick-tempered wife who loves to argue.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli, Neesim, neema! Ka neesim dii neei.
en: God said, Let there be light. And so light appeared.

dag: Bihi n-nahindi n niriba, ka paɣiba su ba. N niriba, yi zuɣulaannima m-birigi ya, ka chɛ ka yi tum yi soya.
en: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o wum n suhigu maa.
en: I cried out to the LORD when I was in trouble.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn bi mi din sa yɛn niŋ yi nyɛviya biɛɣuni; dama yi ŋmanila paɣili din yi kpe, ka di bi yuui ka di lan yi la.
en: You dont know what will happen tomorrow. Your life is like a fog. You can see it for a short time, but then it goes away.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti tɔɣisiri kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Naawuni ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu la yɛla. Ka Yisa yɛli ba.
en: Some of the disciples were talking about the Temple, how beautiful it looked with its fine stones and the gifts offered to God. Jesus said.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa ku chɛ hal ka o ti niŋ o suhu ni lo ni o niŋ shɛli maa naai. Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti baŋ di gbinni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The LORDs fierce anger wont turn back until it accomplishes all that he has planned. In the days to come, you will understand what this means.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul yɛr o di yɛla dabisili kam, ka o zaɣisi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Haman ni bɛ nya Mɔdɛkai yɛligu maa ni zani, dama o daa pun yɛli ba ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nira.
en: he said, Because I am a Jew. They spoke to him for several days about kneeling down, but he still refused to obey. Finally, they reported this to Haman, to find out if he would let Mordecai get away with it.

dag: Ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim polo pɔhim ni ŋme shɛli ka di zaɣi daa to n-yina pahi kawaan kara maa zuɣu.
en: Then seven other heads of grain sprouted, thin and scorched by the desert wind.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinu saha ka Mɛnahɛm bia Pɛkahia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi.
en: Pekahiah, Menahems son, became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Judahs King Azariah. He ruled for two years in Samaria.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai Saimɔn Pita sani, ka Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, a yɛn paɣila n naba.
en: When Jesus came to Simon Peter, Peter said to him, Lord, are you going to wash my feet.

dag: Yi mal alibarika saha shɛli niriba yi ti jɛn ya, ka gaŋdi ya, ka turi ya, ka saɣindi yi yuya yɛri ni ninvuɣ biɛri n-nyɛn ya Daadam Bia zuɣu.
en: God will bless you when others hate you and won't have anything to do with you. God will bless you when people insult you and say cruel things about you, all because you are a follower of the Son of Man.

dag: M mi ni yi niŋ ania n-saɣi nahiŋgu n yuli zuɣu, ka na bi tiri gbini.
en: You have shown endurance and put up with a lot for my names sake, and you havent gotten tired.

dag: Ka naa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka Chimham daa dol o chaŋ; ka Judanim zaa mini Izraɛlnim pirigili gba daa zaŋ naa lu soli.
en: The king crossed the Jordan River to Gilgal. Kimham went with him. All the people of Judah and half the people of Israel led David across the river.

dag: Di saha ka o buɣisi dundɔŋ ni dunɔdali puuni tooni din be tiŋli polo la tooni zaŋ hal ni sambani dunɔdali gbini, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: There was a gateway at a higher level that led to the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the two gateways, and it was feet.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba pahi, Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.

dag: N ni puh a salo laɣiŋgu ni; n shiri ni paɣ a salo ni.
en: I will praise you in the great assembly. I will praise you there among the crowds.

dag: n ku lan kari zuliya shɛb Jɔshua ni daa bi kari ka kpi la ti ba.
en: So I will no longer defeat the nations and clear the way for the Israelites. Those nations were still in this land when Joshua died, and I will let them stay in this land.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn zaŋ tuuli piɛbil maa mali sara maa, yin zaŋmiya zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini mini kpa viɛlli lita yini gari taba n-zaŋ wain shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ booi bahi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu lita yini m-pahi mali sara maa.
en: With the first lamb, add one-tenth of a measure of the high-quality flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from crushed olives and a quarter of a hin of wine for a drink offering.

dag: M paɣiri ya, dama yi teeri n yɛla binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka doli kal shɛŋa n ni zaŋ wuhi ya la.
en: I praise you because you always remember me and follow the teachings that I have handed on to you.

dag: Ka o bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala? Ka o garigi yɛli, N dana, man Rut m-bala. Kpuɣim ma leeg a paɣa, dama a nyɛla n dɔɣira ŋun ni tooi gbib ma.
en: Who are you? he asked. Sir, I am Ruth, she answered, and you are the relative who is supposed to take care of me. So spread the edge of your cover over me.

dag: Bɛ daa lan bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri duu maa yuya lee booni bɔ.
en: They also asked for the names of all the men who were helping build the Temple.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ nyɛla bɛn birigi n niriba ka yɛra, Suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani. Ka n niriba maa yi me gooni, anabinim ŋɔ zaŋdila bimpiɛlli paligi li.
en: Without a doubt, they led my people astray, saying Peace when there was no peace, and He is building a wall when they were the ones who laid on the plaster.

dag: Ka Sool daa tɛh o suhu ni, N ni zaŋ o ti Dauda ka o leei tɔŋ gbaag o, ka Filistianim ku o. Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa lan yɛli Dauda pahi buyi, Pumpɔŋɔ a yi pa ni leei n deemba.
en: and he thought, I'll tell David he can marry Michal, but I'll set it up so that the Philistines will kill him. He told David, I'm going to give you a second chance to marry one of my daughters.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Pɛka ʒiɛman ni ka Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza daa kana nti tuhi fa Ijɔn mini Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Janɔa ni Kɛdɛshi ni Hazɔr ni Giliad ni Galili ni Naftali tiŋgbani zaa, ka gbahi di niriba kuli Asiria ti leei daba.
en: It was while Pekah was king that Tiglath Pileser, the emperor of Assyria, captured the cities of Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, and the territories of Gilead, Galilee, and Naphtali, and took the people to Assyria as prisoners.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim, ka gbib alikauli ni yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim sani zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani tuhili niriba.
en: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yi nyɛ suhutunanima, amaa chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋ yɛda ka mali suɣilo la biɛhigu, ka di chɛ ka yi nya Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la palibu.
en: We dont want you to be lazy. We want you to be like those who, because of their faith and patience, will get what God has promised.

dag: Amaa a yi nya a wuna maa so sani, bɛn kum o. Lihimi n nɛma ŋɔ ni nya, a bini yi be di ni, nyin yihim li ti dɔɣiriba ŋɔ zaa ninni. Yaakubu daa bi mi ni Reechɛl n-zu n-kpuɣi wuna maa.
en: If you find that any one of us has taken your idols, I'll have that person killed. Let your relatives be witnesses. Show me what belongs to you, and you can take it back. Jacob did not realize that Rachel had stolen the household idols.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ Bɛtani ti gbe nimaani.
en: Then Jesus left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ gbaai tab bɔhibu, Ka ŋuni n-lee ti yɛn biligi kuɣ shɛli din yo siliga maa nol la ti ti?.
en: On the way they said to one another, Who will roll away the stone for us from the entrance to the tomb? Then they looked up and saw that the stone had already been rolled back.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi binnana ka mali wun shɛŋa din ka buchi nyuri bara la zaa di vi; dama wuna maa gbaanila o tooni.
en: Everyone who worships idols is put to shame; all the gods bow down before the Lord .

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣa me binwɔɣinli zali, dimbɔŋɔnim nyɛla Naawuni ni je shɛŋa.
en: Dont set up any sacred stone either, because the LORD your God hates such things.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n wumpaɣibo pini ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunim la.
en: Accept my prayer of thanks, O Lord , and teach me your commands.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun nyɛ yaalan nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma bɛn je ma nuu ni, dama bɛ daa gari ma yaa.
en: You rescued me from enemies who were hateful and too powerful for me.

dag: Ka di ti kpalimla omaŋmaŋ biyurigu ko, ka o ti bahi tim o gba bɛ sani ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia maa ŋun jilima.
en: The man had only one person left to send to the farmers. It was his son. He loved his son, but he decided to send him. He said, The farmers will respect my son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti gbaai niŋbu, di saha yin kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa, dama yi tiliginsim saha ti miritimi maa.
en: Now when these things begin to happen, stand up straight and raise your heads, because your redemption is near.

dag: Amaa n daa bi lan niŋ lala, dama n daa je ni n yuli saɣim lala zuliyanim maa sani. Dama bɛ ninni ka n da yihi ba na.
en: But I stopped myself. The other nations saw me bring Israel out of Egypt. I did not want to ruin my good name, so I did not destroy Israel in front of those other people.

dag: Di saha maa ka teeku puuni daa yi palɔni, ka tiŋgbani tanzaa daa yi palɔni. Yawɛ, a tahigu min a suhuyiɣisili tuma m-bala.
en: Lord , you shouted your command, and a powerful wind began to blow. Then the bottom of the sea could be seen, and the earths foundations were uncovered.

dag: Ninsalinim wurindi chɛribo kuɣa, ka lɛbiri zoya sɔŋda.
en: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.

dag: Ka Musa daa du zoli maa zuɣu Naawuni sani. Ka Yawɛ ti bol o zoli maa zuɣu yɛl o, A ni ti yɛn yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: and Moses went up the mountain to meet with God. The Lord called to him from the mountain and told him to say to the Israelites, Jacob's descendants:.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba birigi n-dari gindi yɔɣu n-chaŋ hal ti kpi.
en: Caravans get lost looking for water; they wander and die in the desert.

dag: ka kari saria din tuhi n-sɔŋ kpibisi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka lala chɛ ka dabiɛm ku lan mali daadamnim yaha.
en: You will hear the cries of the oppressed and the orphans; you will judge in their favor, so that mortal men may cause terror no more.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so n-niŋ amaŋka ni n-ʒi o ka Yisa sanna; ka Yisa daa nya bɛ ni niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: where some people brought to him a paralyzed man, lying on a bed. When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the paralyzed man, Courage, my son! Your sins are forgiven.

dag: ka Tɔa nyɛ Zuf bia, ka Zuf nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Mahat bia, ka Mahat nyɛ Amasai bia.
en: Toah was Zuphs son; Zuph was Elkanahs son; Elkanah was Mahaths son; Mahath was Amasais son;.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: Simon Peter answered, You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti zo n-tiligi tɔb maa ni ni ti yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Bɛ ni ti nyɛla niriba biɛla. Ka Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa kpalim, ka chaŋ ti be Ijipti la ti baŋ ŋun yɛligu yɛn niŋ pali, n dini bee bɛ dini.
en: Only a few will escape and return to Judah. Then everyone who went to live in Egypt will know that when I say something will happen, it will—no matter what you say.

dag: n-chɛ ka o suhu ni daashiya zaa yi zahira. Ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka o gban tiŋ jɛm Naawuni, ka yihi yɛli ni Naawuni shiri be yi sani.
en: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, We are certain that you are with these people.

dag: N ni yirigi n zana pil o gbaag o n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni; amaa o nini ti ku nya li, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: But I will spread my net over him, catch him in my trap, and bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans. He wont see it, but he will die there.

dag: N ni daa lo o alikauli shɛli daa nyɛla nyɛvili mini alaafee alikauli din nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti o ka di wuhiri jilima tibu, ka o daa tiri ma jilima ka luri n yuli sizuura la.
en: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, a ni lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti, ka chɛ ka ti di wahala shɛŋa di ni bi simdi ni ti di?.
en: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee wain tihi puu ni chana, a ni tooi pɔhi di wala maa a suhu ni bɔri shɛm tariga di, amaa miri ka a pɔhi shɛli niŋ a nɛma ni.
en: When you walk along a path in someone else's vineyard, you may eat all the grapes you want, but you must not carry any away in a container.

dag: Ibrahimma bidibisi daa nyɛla Yisahaku mini Ishimail.
en: Abraham was the father of Isaac and Ishmael.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni m pun nya dimbɔŋɔnima bee ni n nyɛla ŋun be tibi, amaa n na kul kpaŋdila mmaŋ chani tooni ni n nya Masia ni gbaai ma kpɛhi nuu ni ni n nya shɛl la.
en: I dont mean that I am exactly what God wants me to be. I have not yet reached that goal. But I continue trying to reach it and make it mine. Thats what Christ Jesus wants me to do. It is the reason he made me his.

dag: Kpahimmiya m-baŋ yi galimi ni yi shɛl na, ka niŋ tuuba n-lan lab yi tuuli yurilim la ni yaha. Di yi pa lala n ni kana nti kpuɣi yi firilatamdigu la di zaashee.
en: So remember the high point from which you have fallen. Change your hearts and lives and do the things you did at first. If you dont, Im coming to you. I will move your lampstand from its place if you dont change your hearts and lives.

dag: Ka niɣi maa daa dii zaŋ li lu solɔɣu n-kpa Bɛtishɛmɛshi polo, bɛ daa bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, bɛ daa kul chanimi ka kuhira. Ka Filistia nanim daa dol ba hal ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi tintariga.
en: The cows went straight up the road toward Beth-Shemesh, mooing as they went. The Philistine rulers followed them until they got close to Beth-Shemesh.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ti baŋdiba maa salima mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli.
en: Tell the men to use gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda yɛli Yuria, Kulimi yiŋ ti paɣ a naba. Ka Yuria daa yiɣisi nayili maa yi, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini dol o nyaaŋa ni bɛ ti ti o.
en: Then David told Uriah, Go down to your house and wash your feet. Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

dag: Daadam Bia ni ti tim o malaikanim na, ka bɛ ti yaa binshɛɣukam din chɛ ka niriba tumd alahichi mini tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa bɛn be o nam ni.
en: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather from his kingdom everyone who does wrong or causes others to sin.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Pa ŋunkam dii booni ma, N Duuma, n Duuma, n-ni ti kpe alizanda nam ni, naɣila ŋun tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu.
en: Not everybody who says to me, Lord, Lord, will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only those who do the will of my Father who is in heaven will enter.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa pii Izraɛlnim dahin shɛli la, n daa po pɔri bɛn Yaakubu zuliya maa sani, ka zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N daa po pɔri yɛli ba, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Say to them, The LORD God proclaims: On the day I chose Israel, I swore a solemn pledge to the descendants of Jacobs household. When I made myself known to them in the land of Egypt, I swore a solemn pledge: I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka n ni ti chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka di mi pala bindirigu kum bee kɔnyuri, amaa di ti yɛn nyɛla Yawɛ yɛligu wumbu kum.
en: The Lord GOD says, Look, the days are coming when I will cause a famine in the land. The people will not be hungry for bread. They will not be thirsty for water. No, they will be hungry for words from the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm mini maligumaaniba daa wum lala ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ bi mi yɛlli maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: When they received this news, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were baffled and wondered what might be happening.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi ni n nuu yi yi zaa nyɛviya bahi yoli taali ni.
en: I tell you today I am no longer responsible for any of you!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaɣisi n yɛligu ka dolila kiŋkansi mini yɔhiŋ soli, ka niŋ li naani.
en: But this is what the holy God of Israel says: You ignore what I tell you and rely on violence and deceit.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi gbibi n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must remember all my laws and rules. And you must obey them. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka maligumaana maa lan zaŋ kpa shɛli din be o nuu ni maa shɛli ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun niŋ alahichi sanyoo sara binʒim ʒe la.
en: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.

dag: A ni ti yɛn diri bindir shɛli tibisim ti yɛn nyɛla giram kɔbisiyi ni pihita dahin yini kam. A ni ti diri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a di li saha shɛli.
en: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan ka tuun shɛli yaɣa ŋɔ ni, ka n suhu mi pun ye yi sani kandina zuɣu yuma pam puuni la zuɣu.
en: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.

dag: Zaligu shɛŋa yi ni yɛn doli viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini di ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be dunia yili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the laws and rules that you must obey in your new land. You must carefully obey them as long as you live in this land. The Lord is the God of your ancestors, and he is giving this land to you.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ li n dabili Musa sani, n zaŋla n niriba zaa fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni.
en: But not with my servant Moses. He has proved to be reliable with all my household.

dag: Tuuli alikauli la daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu soli zaligunim mini luɣ shɛli ninsalinim ni daa mali zali Naawuni jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: The first agreement had rules for worship and a place for worship here on earth.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord 's glory, the Lord said:.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm n-ni saɣi po pɔri n-zan o kpee nyaaŋa ni o di samli.
en: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma daa pii ninvuɣ pisopɔin n-tim ba niriba ayiyi ni bɛ daŋ o tooni chaŋ tin shɛŋa zaa omaŋmaŋ gba ni daa yɛn chaŋ.
en: Later the Lord chose other followers and sent them out two by two to every town and village where he was about to go.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N suhu kul yɛla Ziɔn sɔŋbu zuɣu, ka n zabiri nyuli ni suhuyiɣisili di zuɣu. .
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I have a very strong love for Mount Zion. I love her so much that I became angry when she was not faithful to me.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili nɛma duu la zaa ti o.
en: Hezekiah sent him all the silver in the Temple and in the palace treasury;.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Ŋunkam chɛ ka bibihi bɛn niŋ ma yɛda ŋɔ ni yino birigi n-tum alahichi, bɛ yi di zaŋ nɛ karili lo dilan nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni ka kom di o, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: As for whoever causes these little ones who believe in me to trip and fall into sin, it would be better for them to have a huge stone hung around their necks and be drowned in the bottom of the lake.

dag: Juda Naa Ahazia ni daa nya din niŋ maa, ka o guui kpa Bɛtihagan polo. Ka Jɛhu daa kariti dol o ka yɛra, Tomiy o gba! Ka bɛ daa to o piɛm chɛchɛbuŋ ni o ni daa duri Gur din miri Ibiliam la. Ka o daa zo n-kuli Mɛgido nti kpi nimaani.
en: Judahs King Ahaziah saw this and fled on the road to Beth-haggan. Jehu chased after him. Do the same to him! he commanded. They shot him in his chariot on the way up to Gur, near Ibleam. Ahaziah fled to Megiddo and died there.

dag: Hal n ni kul wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni la zaa yoli, bɛ ni be katinsi maa ha ka teeri n yɛla. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni tiligi, ka ni ti laɣim tab labina.
en: Yes, I have been scattering my people throughout the nations. But in those faraway places, they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will come back.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Chamiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa gbini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti pii kuɣ yiniyini m-pa yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu, ka di kalinli saɣisi yi Izraɛlnim zuliya pinaayi ŋɔ kalinli.
en: Joshua said to them, Cross over into the middle of the Jordan, up to the LORD your Gods chest. Each of you, lift up a stone on his shoulder to match the number of the tribes of the Israelites.

dag: N ni zaŋ suhu palli tin ya, ka zaŋ shi palli niŋ yi ni. N ni yihi yi suhu din be ka kuɣili ŋɔ yi ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ yi ni.
en: I will also put a new spirit in you to change your way of thinking. I will take out the heart of stone from your body and give you a tender, human heart.

dag: N zɔr a mi, ka n ni sɔhira, ka zɔr a saria karibo.
en: Because of you I am afraid; I am filled with fear because of your judgments.

dag: Judas ni daa yiɣisi yi n-naai, ka Yisa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ ka Daadam Bia jilima yipa yi palo, ka Naawuni gba jilima yi palo o zuɣu;.
en: When Judas was gone, Jesus said, Now the Human One has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa dam, ka salo kabi chaŋ ti gbaai Gaiɔs mini Aristakus bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na ka nyɛ Pool dolintab la n-dari ba tahi tiŋ maa nim laɣiŋgu shee.
en: The whole city was thrown into confusion. The people grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, men from Macedonia who were traveling with Paul, and rushed all together into the stadium.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Yɛlim ti a zahindi maa ka ti wuh a di gbinni.
en: The Chaldeans answered the king in Aramaic: Long live the king! Tell your servants the dream, and we will explain its meaning.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kuhi pam yɛli, ŋmamiya tia maa luhi; ka ŋmahi di wula bahi; ka wɔbi di vari bahi; ka wɔbi di wala gba bahi. Karimiya biŋkɔbiri la di gbini ka kari noonsi la di wula maa zuɣu.
en: He spoke very loud and said, Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches. Strip off its leaves. Scatter its fruit around. The animals that are under the tree will run away. The birds that are in its branches will fly away.

dag: N kul guhima, bɛ ni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli maa zuɣu? Bee bɛ ni ʒiɛya ka bi lan garigi n-yɛli shɛli zuɣu?.
en: I waited, but they didnt speak, for they stood but answered no more.

dag: Yɛm me o yili, ka sa daantalisi ayopɔin.
en: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.

dag: N daa darigi bɛ tibili ka di dolila bɛ daɣiri mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba.
en: I gave them what they deserved for their uncleanness and their wickedness, and I turned away from them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli Jona pahi buyi.
en: Once again the Lord spoke to Jonah.

dag: Ka Uzia daa chɛ ka bɛ kuri nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana ni kuriti woliɣisi ni kuriti gbaɣinɔnima ni tɔbiri ni kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa n-ti tɔbbihi maa zaa.
en: Uzziah supplied his army with shields, spears, helmets, armor, bows, and stones used for slinging.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn darigiri bɛ tibili saha shɛli maa ti yɛn nyɛla o niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgɔna mini mɔɣilɔnim saha shɛli. Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni tuhi Asirianim maa.
en: As the Lord strikes them again and again, his people will keep time with the music of drums and harps. God himself will fight against the Assyrians.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka di shiri niŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti yi nya li so sani, dilan ni leei n dabili, ka yinim bɛn kpalim ku mali taali.
en: The servant said, I agree, except that only the man who is found to have the cup will be my slave. The others will be free.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti bo n-nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ jinwara ni be luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ o sani ti kari saria. Ka o tumtumdiba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, jinwara be Ɛndo.
en: Then Saul ordered his officials, Find me a woman who is a medium, and I will go and consult her. There is one in Endor, they answered.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn niŋ tipawumli kaman Ijiptinim mini Firawuna ni daa niŋ tipawumli shɛm la? O ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum jɛrilim la nyaaŋa, pa bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa ti chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ?.
en: Don't be like the Egyptians and their king. They were stubborn, but when Israel's God was finished with them, they had to let Israel go.

dag: Amaa n nahindila n niŋgbuŋ ni n nyaŋ li su, dama di yi pa lala, n ni yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti niriba ŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naawuni ni ti daai ma baɣili kpaŋa.
en: It is my own body I fight to make it do what I want. I do this so that I wont miss getting the prize myself after telling others about it.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri kpalim zani luɣ yini, ka goli gba kpalim zani hal ka Izraɛlnim ti bɔhi bɛ dimnim maa biɛri naai. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛla sab be Jashar Litaafi ni. Wuntaŋ daa kpalim zani zuɣusaa dɛde ka bi bɔri yomyom ni o lu hal ti paai dabisi muni.
en: The sun stood still and the moon did not move until the nation had conquered its enemies. This is written in The Book of Jashar . The sun stood still in the middle of the sky and did not go down for a whole day.

dag: ni muli ni wolisi ni kparibuhi ni bambuhi.
en: deer, gazelle, roebuck, wild goat, ibex, antelope, and mountain sheep.

dag: Judanim naa Jɔtam mini Izraɛl naa Jɛrɔbɔam ʒiɛmana ni ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba ŋɔ yuya maa sɔŋ.
en: These records were compiled in the days of King Jotham of Judah and King Jeroboam II of Israel.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ a yuli kana ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa la, di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, o kul niŋdila a niriba maa putɔɣu, ka a bi niŋ shɛli ni a fa a niriba maa bahi.
en: Ever since I went to the king to speak for you, he has treated them cruelly. And you have done nothing to help them.

dag: Bɛraya mini Shɛma.
en: Beriah, and Shema. They were heads of households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath.

dag: Ka duɣuri mini lahi din zaa ʒe zaɣiyari ka binshɛli bi pil li, di gba ni leei din bi be nyam.
en: And every jar or pot without a lid becomes unclean.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti liri Izraɛlnim fɔntinsi n-tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Kinɛrɔt zaa zaŋ tabili Naftali tiŋgbani zaa.
en: King Benhadad agreed to Asa's proposal and sent his commanding officers and their armies to attack the cities of Israel. They captured Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah, the area near Lake Galilee, and the whole territory of Naphtali.

dag: Din yɛn ku Jɛrusalɛmnim maa yɛn yila nudirigu polo na, ka o ti me tɔbutuhiri bimbina din sirigi tiŋa. O ni ti moli ninvuɣ kubo molo, ka bu tɔbu zambu. O ni kɔri tɔbutuhiri bimbina duhiduhi dunɔdaya ni, ka me bimbina, ka me teei gili binwɔɣila.
en: Now! His right hand holds the arrow marked Jerusalem! It tells him to go and set up battering rams, to shout the battle cry, to place battering rams against the gates, to throw up earthworks, and to dig trenches.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii kpamba cheechi kam puuni ti ba, ka daa lo noli n-suhi ti Duuma ka zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni so bɛ ni niŋ yɛda maa nuu ni.
en: They appointed elders for each church. With prayer and fasting, they committed these elders to the Lord, in whom they had placed their trust.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋ yi Samaria chaŋ maa ni yino daa labi nti ʒini Bɛtɛl n-wuhiri ba Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: So one of the priests who had been exiled from Samaria went back. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the LORD.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ matarika ŋ-ŋmɛnŋme li mal li; ka yi mal li piɛbiri laɣindi niriba, ka mal li piɛbiri ka bɛ yiɣisira chana.
en: Make two trumpets of hammered silver to use for calling the people together and for breaking camp.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi ku dunia ŋɔ ni kɔr biɛri din be yi ni la. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni tɛhi biɛri ni binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu la. Binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: You must put to death, then, the earthly desires at work in you, such as sexual immorality, indecency, lust, evil passions, and greed .

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi bɔb gbaai Pool, ka kum ni nintam, ka puh o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They were all crying as they hugged him and kissed him good-bye.

dag: Amaa n chɛmi ka n suhu be baalim kaman bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni be o ma sani baalim shɛm la. N suhu ŋmanila bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili suhu.
en: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ni binshɛɣukam ni niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ sani, ka yɛri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ tipawumli doli bɛ tipawumli suhuyubu maa mi ni zaɣ biɛɣu ku paai ba.
en: To the people who refuse to listen to what I have said, they keep saying that all will go well with them. And they tell everyone who is stubborn that disaster will never touch them.

dag: Bɛ ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la. Bɛ ŋumdimi, ka gbahiri bɛ ni yɛn gbahi biŋkɔb shɛba m-mali ba chana ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: Their roaring is like the lion; they roar like young lions; they growl, seize their prey, and carry it off, with no one to rescue.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛlikam zaa kaman anabinim ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm zaa la, ka bɛ daa siɣis o dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi siliga ni.
en: These Jews did all the bad things that the Scriptures said would happen to Jesus. Then they took Jesus down from the cross and put him in a tomb.

dag: Onam bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shammai mini Jada. Shammai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abishur.
en: Onams sons were Shammai and Jada. Shammais sons were Nadab and Abishur.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Samaria, o daa kula Ɛhab daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim Samaria zaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Ilaija shɛm la.
en: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah.

dag: Doo maa min o paɣ maa daa bela bɛ zaɣim, amaa ka di bi mali ba vi.
en: The two of them were naked, the man and his wife, but they werent embarrassed.

dag: So shɛli daa be duri maa tiŋa, ka nira ni tooi yi dundɔntitali ni wulimpuhili polo n-dol li kpe duri maa ni.
en: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.

dag: Ka n daa paai Jɛrusalɛm m-be nimaani dabisi muna ata.
en: When I reached Jerusalem and had been there for three days.

dag: N ni daa bi baŋ n ni yɛn gbaai yɛlli maa shɛm zuɣu ka n daa bɔhi Pool ni o bɔri ni o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti kar o saria nimaani.
en: I did not have any idea about how to judge these matters. So I asked Paul, Do you want to go to Jerusalem and be judged there.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti kul zaŋdi wumpaɣibo kaman sara la paɣiri Naawuni, dina n-nyɛ ti yaai ti noya kahigi wuhi ni ti tibigir o yuli.
en: Let us, then, always offer praise to God as our sacrifice through Jesus, which is the offering presented by lips that confess him as Lord.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever hits his father or his mother is to be put to death.

dag: Rubin zuliya nti yɛn ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli be nudirigu polo. Rubin niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu.
en: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The , troops of the tribe of Reuben will be arranged by divisions and led by Elizur son of Shedeur.

dag: ka daa bi lan saɣi ni so ʒi binshɛɣu gari kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: He didnt allow anyone to carry anything through the temple.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Bee yi tɛhiya ni Sailom du shɛli din daa du pam la ni daa lu n-ku ninvuɣ pisaayika shɛb la daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm la?.
en: And what about those people who died when the tower of Siloam fell on them? Do you think they were more sinful than everyone else in Jerusalem?.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa, ka tummiya di tuma din ni chɛ ka yi ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: You will observe my rules, and you will keep my regulations and do them so that you can live securely on the land.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋ maa n-yi soli chani ha ka gbuɣinli chirig o n-gbaag o ku o, ka vu o sɔŋ sol ni; ka buŋ maa ʒe m-baɣ o; ka gbuɣinli maa gba ʒe m-baɣ o.
en: who rode off. On the way a lion met him and killed him. His body lay on the road, and the donkey and the lion stood beside it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Izraɛlnim maa, Ijiptinim mini Amɔrinim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim.
en: The LORD replied to the Israelites, When the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines.

dag: Amaa n dabili Kalɛb ni mali tɛhi shɛl la min o ni doli ma ni o suhu zaa la zuɣu, n ni zaŋ o kulis o ni daa chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka o zuliya ti su li.
en: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.

dag: Ka Samsin daa zaŋ o nudirigu min o nuzaa n-gbaai sunsuuni daantalis ayi shɛŋa zuɣu duu maa ni tamya maa;.
en: Samson was standing between the two middle columns that held up the roof. He felt around and found one column with his right hand, and the other with his left hand.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim ni ti fabili. Daŋ kam puuni niriba ni ti fabili kɔŋkɔba. Dauda daŋ puuni niriba dɔbba ti yɛn bela bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda. Ka Neetan daŋ puuni niriba dɔbba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: Each and every family will cry by itself. The men in Davids family will cry by themselves, and their wives will cry by themselves. The men in Nathans family will cry by themselves, and their wives will cry by themselves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbiri. Laakumnim daa nyɛla tuhi pihinu, ka piɛri nyɛ tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinu, ka bunsi mi daa nyɛ tusaayi, ka daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma tuhi kɔbiga.
en: They captured from the enemy , camels, , sheep, and , donkeys, and took , prisoners of war.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Haga daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua. Haga ni daa nya ka o mali puu maa, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Zarai ŋun daa su o maa.
en: Abram slept with Hagar, and she became pregnant. When Hagar realized this, she became very proud and began to feel that she was better than Sarai her owner.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi kari Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinima, lala zuɣu Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim maa na kul be Izraɛlnim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the Israelites didnt remove the Geshurites or the Maacathites. So Geshur and Maacath still live among Israel today.

dag: Di pala m bɔrimi ni n ʒili ya ʒitibisa ka suui shɛb dini;.
en: It isnt that we want others to have financial ease and you financial difficulties, but its a matter of equality.

dag: Dinzuɣu di yi nyɛla n dan ni yɛli ma chi mini alikama ni wain ni kpa shɛli yɛla la dina, zaŋmi li ti tinim bɛn nyɛ n dan tumtumdiba ŋɔ na.
en: So once my master sends the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine he has promised.

dag: Ŋunkam doli yɛlimaŋli soli nyɛla ŋun yi barina ni. Amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli, o gbini ni vii.
en: Those who walk in innocence walk with confidence, but those on crooked paths will be found out.

dag: Gban shɛli Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa sabi ti Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni gbansabira ni baŋda so ŋun daa mi Yawɛ zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ o ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la viɛnyɛliŋga m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is a copy of the letter that Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest and scribe, a scholar of the text of the LORDs commandments and his requirements for Israel.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yihi tinzunnim zaa bɛn be Izraɛlnim ni.
en: When the people heard this law, they separated out from Israel all those of mixed descent.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa be niriba maa ni zaa ni daa ti kpi n-naai saha shɛli.
en: Now as soon as all those of fighting age had died.

dag: ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: In front of me, seven fattened, stout cows climbed up out of the Nile and grazed on the reeds.

dag: Ka Sintani daa yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣili ŋɔ leei bindirigu.
en: The devil said to Jesus, If you are God's Son, tell this stone to turn into bread.

dag: Amaa yi ni ti yɛn niŋ ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti daamiya bɛ maligu bimbina luhi, ka wurim bɛ binwɔɣila la, ka chɛ ŋ-ŋmaai bɛ Ashɛrim la luhi tiŋa, ka nyo bɛ wuna buɣim.
en: So then, tear down their altars, break their sacred stone pillars in pieces, cut down their symbols of the goddess Asherah, and burn their idols.

dag: Ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Mɔab. O yaansi n-nyɛ Mɔabnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The older daughter gave birth to a son and named him Moab. He is the ancestor of todays Moabites.

dag: Di simdi ka yi dɔbba zaa laɣindi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ tooni buta yuuni puuni.
en: So three times each year all the men will come to the special place to be with the Lord GOD.

dag: Tizɔra ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka yaalana ti kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka kpiɔŋlana ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: Fast runners will find no refuge; the strong will lose their strength; the mighty will be unable to save their lives.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: The king said, People who use what they have will get more. But those who do not use what they have will have everything taken away from them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kom din kpe nti taɣi ninsal yɛno tariga n-kpe Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ. Bɛ ni ti yɛrigi nyin Imanuɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: They will sweep through Judah in a flood, rising shoulder high and covering everything. God is with us! His outspread wings protect the land.

dag: Ibram ni daa wum ni bɛ tuhi gbaag o dɔɣim maa chaŋ maa, ka o daa zaŋ o tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o yiŋ puuni, ka bɛ nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi la ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisaayika n-kari bɛ naba hal ti paai Dan.
en: When Abram learned that Lot was captured, he called all of his family together. There were trained soldiers. He led the men and chased the enemy all the way to the town of Dan.

dag: di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: The people in Judea at that time should run away to the mountains.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: This is the command of the Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt in order to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni deei n kawana, kawana ŋahibu saha, ka deei n wain, wain tɔɣibu saha, ka deei n daago mini atampa shɛli n ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o lir o gbin la.
en: So now I will take back my corn in its time, and my wine in its season; and I will take away my wool and my linen cloth, which were to cover her nakedness.

dag: Ka sagbani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka maligumaaniba ku tooi tum bɛ tuma, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pali jɛmbu duu maa zaa.
en: The Lord 's glory was in that cloud, and the light from it was so bright that the priests could not stay inside to do their work.

dag: A yi nyɛ yɛndana, nyini n-yɛn di a yɛm maa nyɔri, a mi yi maani ansarisi, a kɔŋko n-yɛn di wahala.
en: If you become wise, it will be for your own good. If you are rude and show no respect, you are the one who will suffer.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a teei doya zaŋ a nina kpa tiŋa? Yiɣisima!.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Why are you down there with your face on the ground? Stand up!.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba chaŋ, ka n lan zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu. N ku chɛ bɛ ni so bahi.
en: They will know that I am the Lord their God. That is because I made them leave their homes and go as prisoners to other countries. But then I gathered them together again and brought them back to their own land.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔh o, N zuɣu ka a zabiri nyuli maa? N di bi zaɣisi ka Yawɛ niriba zaa nyɛla anabinima, ka Yawɛ di zaŋ o shia niŋ bɛ ni.
en: But Moses replied, Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.

dag: lala ka a gba bi yi a pagɔrisigu tuma daɣiri ni. A ku lan yi a daɣiri maa ni hal ka n ti tum a n suhuyiɣisili tuma.
en: Jerusalem is so full of sin and evil that I can't get it clean, even though I have tried. It will stay filthy until I let loose my fierce anger against it.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpil shɛli din daŋ tooni ti Naawuni yi be kasi, dindina bɔrɔbɔro maa zaa ni be kasi. Ka tia nyaɣa yi be kasi, di wula gba ni be kasi.
en: But if part of a batch of dough is offered to God as holy, the whole batch of dough is holy too. If a root is holy, the branches will be holy too.

dag: Di kul nyɛla zaɣ palli asiba kam. A ʒiɛyimtali galisiya.
en: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi niŋ ka yi nya, yi suhu ni paligi, ka yi nya kpiɔŋ mini alaafee, ka zoori kaman momaha la; ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deeri n noli; ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisiri bahiri n dimnim zuɣu.
en: When you see these things, you will be happy. You will be free and grow like grass. The Lord s servants will see his power, but his enemies will see his anger.

dag: Ti ni so bi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti ni so mi bi kpiri omaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.

dag: Yawɛ ni bi tooi zaŋ niriba ŋɔ kulisi o ni daa po ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni zuɣu, ka o ku ba mɔɣu maa ni maa.
en: The LORD wasnt able to bring these people to the land that he solemnly promised to give them. So he slaughtered them in the desert.

dag: Ka Neetan bia Azaria nyɛ tuma kpamba zuɣulana. Ka Neetan bia Zabud nyɛ maligumaana ni naa zɔsimo.
en: Azariah, Nathans son, who was in charge of the officials; Zabud, Nathans son, a priest and royal friend.

dag: Amaa yum maa yi ti lan taɣi m-paligi, di saha ŋun kam maligumaana sanna.
en: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, You are now clean.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zadok ti zaŋ kpam yiligu din daa be suɣili ni nimaani m-booi kpam maa bahi Sulemaana zuɣu ni. Di saha ka bɛ daa piɛb kikaa, ka niriba maa zaa dii kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: Zadok the priest brought some olive oil from the sacred tent and poured it on Solomon's head to show that he was now king. A trumpet was blown and everyone shouted, Long live King Solomon.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa laɣim taba n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama.
en: One day the nation's leaders came to Samuel at Ramah.

dag: Sokam zaa wum yi ni deei Naawuni noli shɛm yɛla, ka n suhu paligi yi zuɣu; amaa m bɔri ni yi niŋ yɛnnim zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛlli tumbu polo, ka nyɛ bɛn bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: The news of your obedience has reached everybody, so Im happy for you. But I want you to be wise about whats good, and innocent about whats evil.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu: N nya Naawuni ni ʒi o nam ʒiishee, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo.
en: Micaiah said, Hear the message from the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne. All of heavens army was standing around him, some on his left side and some on his right side.

dag: O daa kari dɔbba dagɔr tuma tiŋgbani maa ni, ka wurim buɣ shɛŋa zaa o yaannim ni daa me n-zal la.
en: He forced the prostitutes at the shrines to leave the country, and he got rid of the idols his ancestors had made.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Asahɛl chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti sɔɣ o o ba siliga din daa be nimaani la puuni. Ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa ŋmaligi doli tab yuŋ labi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei, ka bɛ paai Hiburɔn.
en: Davids officers took Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father at Bethlehem. Joab and his men marched all night. The sun came up just as they reached Hebron.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti lan nya wuntizɔra mini ninvuɣ biɛɣu biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm, ka lan nya ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni mini ŋun bi jɛmd o biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm.
en: You will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, between those serving God and those not serving him.

dag: Ibram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihiniinaayɔbu saha shɛli Haga ni daa dɔɣi Ishimail ti o maa.
en: Abram was years old when Hagar gave birth to Ishmael for Abram.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya ni kpamba anahi daa beni, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Jɔhanan bia Azaria mini Mɛshilɛmɔt bia Bɛrɛkia ni Shallum bia Jɛhizikia ni Hadilai bia Amasa; bɛna n-daa yiɣisi zani galim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa yi tɔb tuhibu yɔɣu kuli maa na.
en: About the same time, four of Israel's leaders arrived. They were Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai. They agreed with Oded that the Israelite troops were wrong.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa tuhi bɛn be tiŋ maa puuni hal ti luhi wuntaŋa n-daa ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, ka ku niriba bɛn be di ni, ka niŋ yalim bahi tiŋ maa tiŋgbani zaa zuɣu.
en: Abimelech fought against the city that entire day. He captured the city and killed its people. Then he leveled the city and scattered salt over it.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni ti yɛli bɛ mini bɛn sɔŋdi ba yɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa. Bɛ ni ti siɣi tiŋgban ni nti fo n-doya, bɛn bi guni ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba.
en: The mighty chieftains, those who once came to his aid, will speak to him from the middle of the underworld, for the uncircumcised have gone down and have lain down, slain by the sword.

dag: Dauda ni daa ku Filistia doo maa naai ka labina, ka Abinɛr daa zaŋ o chaŋ Sool sani, ka o na kul gbibi Filistia doo maa zuɣu la o nuu ni.
en: When David came back from fighting Goliath, he was still carrying Goliath's head. Abner took David to Saul.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Mahili bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza mini Kish.
en: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir daa ti ka Ɛli sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa kahigi mmaŋ wuh a yab yiŋnim bɛ ni daa nyɛ Ijipti naa daba m-be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la.
en: A man of God came to Eli and said, The Lord says, I appeared to your ancestors when they were slaves of Pharaoh.

dag: M mini m Ba maa nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: and I am one with the Father.

dag: Ka tuuli malaika daa piɛb o kikaa, ka sakuɣa mini buɣim ni ʒim daa gari taba luri dunia ni, ka dunia tiŋgbani pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka tihi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka momaha zaa di buɣim.
en: The first angel blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood appeared, and was thrown down to the earth. A third of the earth was burned up. A third of the trees were burned up. All the green grass was burned up.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ya yi ni daa nyari biɛrim shɛli mini wahala shɛŋa ni, ka yihi ya tuun kpɛma mini bɛ ni daa muɣisiri ya ka yi tumdi tuun shɛŋa la tumbu ni.
en: The Lord will give the people of Israel relief from their pain and suffering and from the hard work they were forced to do.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun pah ata la ŋun daa zaŋ o yiŋlan maa ni ti o laɣ shɛli maa ti gaai bɔɣili zaŋ li pi.
en: But the servant with , coins dug a hole and hid his master's money in the ground.

dag: Amaa yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa nyɛla zoya mini vinvama tiŋgbɔŋ, ka saa miri nimaani.
en: But the land that you will soon get is not like that. In Israel there are mountains and valleys, and the land gets its water from the rain that falls from the sky.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o yi pil li mɛbu ka bi tooi me n-naai, ŋunkam nya li lala ni mal o ansarisi.
en: If you dont do that, you might begin the work, but you would not be able to finish. And if you could not finish it, everyone would laugh at you.

dag: Yawɛ niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba.
en: The Lord made this happen, and we think it is wonderful!.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, hal n ni kul yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni kpi maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi zo n-yi bɛ daalahichi ni, ka tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi.
en: And even if I have pronounced a death sentence on the wicked, if they turn from sin and do what is just and right.

dag: Kaman tampiŋ sabinli ni kpɛm gari chɛribo kuɣili shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Di zɔri ba bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: You will be so determined to speak my message that nothing will stop you. I will make you hard like a diamond, and you'll have no reason to be afraid of those arrogant rebels.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol la ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o yih o daɣiri ni dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali.
en: On the eighth day, they must bring these items for their purification to the priest at the meeting tents entrance before the LORD.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a, ka a garigi ma.
en: Prepare yourself for an attack! Get ready to answer the questions I will ask you.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ti ku lan tum tuumbiɛri, bɛ mi ti ku ŋma ʒiri, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa mi ti ku be bɛ noya ni. Di saha bɛ ni ti di ka dɔni, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: The few remaining from Israel wont commit injustice; they wont tell lies; a deceitful tongue wont be found on their lips. They will graze and lie down; no one will make them afraid.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be ti ni, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kpuɣ o pakoli maa.
en: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married, then died. Because he had no children he left his widow to his brother.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: Someone is shouting in the desert, Get the road ready for the Lord; make a straight path for him to travel.

dag: Di nahindiya pakoya mini kpibisi ni tinzunnim bɛn be yi ni zaŋ tabili nandaamba. Yi mi di lɔnya yi kpee zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. .
en: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.

dag: ka kari ba saria kaman di ni sab zali shɛm. Naawuni niriba bɛn ʒe yim nasara dibu m-bala. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: They will punish those nations as God commanded. This is an honor for all his followers. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o yɛli Bɛtɛl bimbin la mini buɣa jɛmbu duri din be Samaria tinsi ni shɛm la shiri ni ti niŋ pali.
en: I'm sure that everything he said about the altar in Bethel and the shrines in Samaria will happen.

dag: Ti mabihi, di kpala talahi ni ti kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam. Di tuhiya ni ti niŋ lala, dama yi yɛda kul zoorimi, ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab sani gba kul zoori pahira.
en: Brothers and sisters, we thank God for you always. And thats what we should do, because you give us good reason to be thankful: Your faith is growing more and more. And the love that every one of you has for each other is also growing.

dag: Tɛra daŋ niriba yɛla m-bɔŋɔ. Tɛra daa nyɛla Ibram mini Nahɔr ni Haran ba; ka Haran mi daa nyɛ Lɔt ba.
en: This is the history of Terahs family. Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran was the father of Lot.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Ɛdomnim tiŋa n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Kɛriɔt la. Ka Mɔabnim ni kpi tɔbu tuhibu vuri mini tɔbbihi tahigu ni kikahi kumsi zuɣu.
en: I will send fire upon the land of Moab and burn down the fortresses of Kerioth. The people of Moab will die in the noise of battle while soldiers are shouting and trumpets are sounding.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Hiburu paɣiba bɛn bi be kaman Ijipti paɣiba ni be shɛm, bɛ mali yaa pam. Paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda ti yɛn paai ka bɛ pun dɔɣi.
en: They answered, Hebrew women have their babies much quicker than Egyptian women. By the time we arrive, their babies are already born.

dag: Di yi pa lala n ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o shɛm. N ni niŋ o kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din tam chaai la, ka chɛ ka kɔnyuri ku o.
en: If she does not, I will strip her as naked as she was on the day she was born. I will make her like a dry and barren land, and she will die of thirst.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kuli m ba sani ti yɛl o, A bia Yisifu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana, dinzuɣu niŋmi yomyom yiɣisi kuli n sanna.
en: Joseph said, Hurry up and go to my father. Tell him his son Joseph sent this message: God made me the governor of Egypt. So come here to me quickly. Dont wait.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku ba sɔŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka shɛb mi diɛhi dansi do di solɔri zuɣu.
en: They will fall wounded in the land of Babylon, struck down in her streets.

dag: Dauda ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛma yila fukumsi bɛ ni daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la labisina la nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛ dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ zuɣuri m-be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: All these men were leaders of their families. They were listed in their family histories as leaders. They lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa;.
en: When Jesus finished speaking, the people were amazed at his teaching.

dag: Bɛ daa yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi bɛn bi tum taali ʒim, bɛ daa kɔri ba m-mal la Keenan wuna; ka bɛ ʒim maa daa ta tiŋgbɔŋ maa daɣiri.
en: They killed their innocent sons and daughters and offered them to the false gods of Canaan. So the land was polluted with the sin of murder.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Mɔdɛkai Ɛsta ni yɛli shɛm.
en: When they told Mordecai Esthers words.

dag: O ʒila o nam ʒiishee, ka lihirina n-nyari ninsalinim zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: From his high throne he looked down at all the people living on earth.

dag: Di saha maa ka o nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ ni Jɔn Baptaizira yɛla ka o yɛri ba maa.
en: Then the followers understood that when Jesus said Elijah, he was really talking about John the Baptizer.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: Jesus said to the followers, Be careful! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.

dag: Ka niriba maa ti labi ba kuɣa, ka zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba. Bɛ ni ti ku bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi, ka nyo bɛ yiya buɣim.
en: They will throw stones at these women and kill them. They will cut the women to pieces with their swords. They will kill their children and burn their houses.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tum Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: They followed Jeroboam and continued to practice all the sins he had committed.

dag: Sapashinnim maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat bɛ daa yɛlimi, Biɛhiŋ kani, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuh o; ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kuhi pam.
en: So when they saw Jehoshaphat in his robe, they thought he was Ahab and started to attack him. But when Jehoshaphat shouted out to them.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi puuni, ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili n-deei li.
en: Hezekiah had been king of Judah for years when King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city.

dag: shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim maa. Timmi bɛ zuliya kam puuni ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Send out men to explore the land of Canaan, which Im giving to the Israelites. Send one man from each ancestral tribe, each a chief among them.

dag: N ni daa be Damaskus, Naa Arɛtas ni daa zali so ka o su Damaskus fukumsi la daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zan la tiŋ maa gooni dunoya ni ni bɛ gu soli gbaai ma.
en: At Damascus the governor under King Aretas was guarding the city of Damascus in order to capture me.

dag: ni Shimia ni Hagia ni Asaaya.
en: Shimea, Haggiah, Asaiah.

dag: Ka Maika daa zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa leeg o maligumaana, ka o daa kpalim be ŋun Maika yiŋa.
en: Micah appointed the Levite so that the young man became his personal priest and lived in Micahs sanctuary.

dag: Jɛfita ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim daa bi fa Mɔabnim tiŋgbani bee Ammɔnnim tiŋgbani.
en: and they told him that Jephthah had said: Israel hasn't taken any territory from Moab or Ammon.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti suui yi noli. O nyaandoliba maa ni so daa bi buɣisi ni o bɔh o, Ŋuni n-nyɛ a? Bɛ daa mi ni bɛ Duuma m-bala.
en: Jesus said, Come and eat! But none of the disciples dared ask who he was. They knew he was the Lord.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chaŋ ti doli bɛ naba hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-nya ka Sirianim maa situra mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni zo ka chɛ m-bahi kul dɔndo sol ni. Ka tuumba maa daa labina ti yɛli naa.
en: The men rode as far as the Jordan River. All along the way they saw clothes and equipment that the Syrians had thrown away as they escaped. Then they went back to the king and told him what they had seen.

dag: O palo yibu maa mi ni ti niŋla di saha dɛde kaman Naawuni ni zal li shɛm. Ŋun Naawuni kɔŋko n-nyɛ alibarika Natitamlana mini nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi. A baɣiri ni ka n yɛn sɔɣi hal ka din tahiri saɣiŋgu ŋɔ na ti gari.
en: God, be merciful to me. Be kind because my soul trusts in you. I have come to you for protection, while the trouble passes.

dag: Di veeni ni nir kul maag o ni baalim guhiri Yawɛ tiliginsim.
en: So it is best for us to wait in patience—to wait for him to save us—.

dag: Lala ka Zara daa be; o daa deei ti yab Ibrahimma noli, hal ka boon o la o duuma. Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi yi tumdi din viɛla ka bi chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri shɛli zuɣu, dina n-ni wuhi ni yi nyɛla Zara yaansi.
en: For example, Sarah accepted Abrahams authority when she called him master . You have become her children when you do good and dont respond to threats with fear.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi puu atam di kpuɣibu saha nyɛla yɛndana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun doya gbihiri atam kpuɣibu saha nyɛla vi dira.
en: A wise son harvests in the summer; a disgraceful son sleeps right through the harvest.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpa nudirigu polo, ka dunɔdali daa be nudirigu polo maa, ka o daa buɣisi di pilanima mini di zɔntua, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.

dag: Di zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim jintɔriba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ? Dama doo ŋɔ wuhiri shihira pam.
en: Then the chief priests and Pharisees called together the council and said, What are we going to do? This man is doing many miraculous signs!.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋdi mahili niŋdi sagban tibisa ni, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri yiri sagbana maa ni na.
en: He fills the clouds with water and scatters his lightning through them.

dag: Bɛ bi fabindi niŋdi ma ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa bɛ dola bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu kuhira. Dama bɛ zaŋ bini ŋma bɛmaŋa bɛ kawana mini bɛ wain zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ma.
en: They never call to me from their hearts. Yes, they cry on their beds. And they cut themselves when they ask for grain and new wine. But in their hearts, they have turned away from me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zuɣu ka o daa zali sokam o ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli bee o ni yɛn ʒi ʒi shɛli. Lala ka o daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Each man was counted just as the Lord commanded Moses. Each man was given his own work and told what he must carry just as the Lord had said.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ zaɣis a ka leeg a dima, ka wula a lan bɔhiri ma?.
en: Samuel said: If the Lord has turned away from you and is now your enemy, don't ask me what to do.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nuzaa polo ŋɔ na. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tin ya ka yi nyuri bara bɛ zuɣu la lee be ya?.
en: Jerusalem, look! Your enemies are coming down from the north! Where are the people entrusted to your care, your people you were so proud of?.

dag: dama Yawɛ zabiri bɛ zuɣu, ka ni ku bɛnkam bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: The Lord is on their side. He supports the poor, and he will take from those who take from them.

dag: N daa zaŋ salima min anzinfa dih a paɣisarilim. Ka a mali tan viɛlli liiga mini tan nyɛlisirili chinchina ni bɛ ni wuɣi chinchin shɛli. A bindirigu daa nyɛla zim viɛla mini shiri ni kpam, ka a daa niŋ viɛlim pam, ka simdi ni a niŋ napaɣa.
en: I adorned you with gold and silver, and your garments were made of the finest linen and brocade. You ate the finest flour, honey, and oil. You became very beautiful, fit for royalty.

dag: Naɣikɔra yi ka luɣ shɛli, bindirigu gba kani, naɣikɔra yaa puuni ka bindirigu pam yirina.
en: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.

dag: A buhi bihim ni saɣ a min a yiŋnim bindirigu, ka dih a daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba.
en: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-kun ya bɔhi biɛri alikauli la zuɣu. Ka yi yi ti zo n-kuli yi fɔntinsi ni, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ yi dimnim nuu ni.
en: You will have broken my agreement, so I will punish you. I will bring armies against you. You will go into your cities for safety, but I will cause diseases to spread among you. And your enemies will defeat you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ Hadadɛza ni su fɔn shɛŋa din nyɛ Tibihat mini Kun la ni nti va daanya pam nimaani. Dina ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ mali daanya ko niŋdi bini la mini daantalisi ni daanya taha la.
en: David also took much bronze from the towns of Tebah and Cun. These towns belonged to Hadadezer. Later, Solomon used this bronze to make the bronze tank, the bronze columns, and other things made from bronze for the Temple.

dag: yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: I, the Lord God, am your enemy.

dag: ni Baalat ni Tama din be Juda tiŋgban ni mɔɣu ni la.
en: Baalath, Tamar in the wilderness of Judah.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: When the people heard this, they said, Then who can be saved.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa lan lab gbi kɔbil shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun gbi o ba Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la, dama Filistianim n-daa ŋar li Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ yu shɛŋa bol kɔbilisi maa la n-lan bol li.
en: He dug once again the wells which had been dug during the time of Abraham and which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham's death. Isaac gave the wells the same names that his father had given them.

dag: Ninkur teempiɛla be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn kurigi gar a ba.
en: We learned our wisdom from gray-haired people— those born before your father.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba, ka daa tumdi kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa tumdi shɛm, dama Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ o paɣa. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: He walked in the ways of Israels kings, just as Ahabs dynasty had done, because he married Ahabs daughter. He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Ti wum ti dimnim yuri napɔnchichiba Dan tiŋgban ni. Ka bɛ wɔridibisi kumsi chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zaa sɔhigi. Bɛ kana ni bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka saɣim tiŋ maa n-tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni.
en: Our enemies are already in the city of Dan; we hear the snorting of their horses. The whole land trembles when their horses neigh. Our enemies have come to destroy our land and everything in it, our city and all its people.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini turi ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani ŋ-ŋuhiri dɔɣiri ba.
en: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.

dag: Bɛ daa zab Musa nyuli bɛ sansan ni, ka zab Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ kasi la gba nyuli.
en: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.

dag: Amaa nyin suhu min a nini kul mirigila a nyamma din bi doli so shɛli din tuhi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka a kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali, ka doli kiŋkansi soli nahindi niriba.
en: But you can only see your selfish interests; you kill the innocent and violently oppress your people. The Lord has spoken.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu ni yi zaa gbib naŋgban yini ka woligibu ku kpe yi sunsuuni, amaa ka yi naɣ ni zaŋla yi noya naai taba m-mali tɛhi yini ni naŋgban yini.
en: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.

dag: Wummi nyaɣisim a ni yuri paɣ so sani a ni mali nyɛvili shɛli din ka buchi dunia puuni ŋɔ, dama dina n-nyɛ a biɛhigu min a dunia ŋɔ ni tuma wahala tarili.
en: Life is short, and you love your wife, so enjoy being with her. This is what you are supposed to do as you struggle through life on this earth.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka toli yina nti ŋubi bimbil shɛŋa zaa sakuɣa la ni daa bi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord told Moses, Raise your hand over the land of Egypt and the locusts will come! They will spread all over the land of Egypt and will eat all the plants that the hail did not destroy.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-zaŋ Vuhim Dabisili maa tin ya, lala zuɣu ka n tiri ya daba ayi bindirigu daba ayɔbu dali maa din ni chɛ ka sokam be o yiŋa, ka ku yi n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: Remember that I was the one who gave you the Sabbath. That's why on the sixth day I provide enough bread for two days. Everyone is to stay home and rest on the Sabbath.

dag: Di buɣisibu wɔɣilim gari dunia ŋɔ wɔɣilim. Ka di yɛliŋ gari teeku.
en: Its measurement is longer than the earth and broader than the sea.

dag: Yinim dee yi ti deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din sab zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ, ka ŋmaligi labi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: but you will have to obey him and keep all his laws that are written in this book of his teachings. You will have to turn to him with all your heart.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ma ʒili m ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka me yili ti ma kaman o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la zuɣu, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku Adɔnija zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord made me the king of Israel. He gave me the throne of my father David. The Lord kept his promise and gave the kingdom to me and my family. Now, as surely as the Lord lives, I swear Adonijah will die today.

dag: lala ka n yɛligu shɛli din yiri n nol ni na gba ku labi n sanna yoli. Di ni tum n ni lo ni di tum shɛli. Ka di nasara n ni tim li ni di ti tum shɛm puuni.
en: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa, dama m mi a, ka n nini tiɣ a.
en: So the Lord told him, I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.

dag: Amaa so yi kani ŋun ni wuhi di gbinni, yin chɛliya ka bɛ shini baalim cheechi puuni, ka naɣ mal li tɔɣisiri li mi ni Naawuni mini bɛmaŋmaŋa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: However, if there is no interpreter, then they should keep quiet in the meeting. They should speak privately to themselves and to God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa ti lan tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka fa Gaat mini di tiŋkpansi zaa Filistianim maa sani.
en: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its villages from Philistine control.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam po sara maligu bimbini pola di mini binshɛɣukam din pa di zuɣu.
en: Anyone who swears by the altar also swears by everything on it.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Miri ka a chɛ ka so suhu saɣim doo ŋɔ zuɣu, mani a dabili ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: Your Majesty, he said, this Philistine shouldn't turn us into cowards. I'll go out and fight him myself.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka biŋkɔbigu la mini dunia nanima ni bɛ tɔbbihi laɣim lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ŋun ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa min o tɔbbihi.
en: Then I saw the beast and the rulers of the earth. Their armies were gathered together to make war against the rider on the horse and his army.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu daa na bi dɔɣi bihi, ka daa lan daŋ bɛ ba kpibu, ka Ɛliɛza mini Itama daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
