en: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

dag: A mi dunia ŋɔ yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm? A yi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa, nyin yɛlim ma!.
en: Have you any idea how big the world is? Answer me if you know.

dag: A daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhi shihira Firawuna min o tumtumdiba zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa sani, a ni mi bɛ ni daa niŋ ti fitiina shɛm la zuɣu. A daa zali yuli ti amaŋa, ka di kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You worked amazing miracles against the king, against his officials and the people of his land, because you knew how they oppressed your people. You won then the fame you still have today.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ni yi mali tɛhi yini mini yurilim yini, ka mali suhu yini tɛhi yini puuni, ka di chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa.
en: I urge you, then, to make me completely happy by having the same thoughts, sharing the same love, and being one in soul and mind.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa wurim Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma sɔŋ, ka Gɛrishɔn mini Mɛrari zuliya bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma la daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi.
en: Then the Tent would be taken down, and the clans of Gershon and Merari, who carried it, would start out.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-yɛn daŋ chandi, m pun zaŋ tiŋgbani maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni.
en: The LORD said, The tribe of Judah will go up. Ive handed over the land to them.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa lan lab Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni chani ginda, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: Jesus and his disciples entered Jerusalem again. As Jesus was walking around the temple, the chief priests, legal experts, and elders came to him.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni kpɛbu, o jilima ni daa pal o jɛmbu duu maa puuni maa zuɣu.
en: The priests could not enter the Lord s Temple because the Glory of the Lord filled it.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa yiɣisi zan o nyaandolitab maa sunsuuni. Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisi laasabu ka o yɛli ba.
en: A few days later there was a meeting of the believers, about a hundred and twenty in all, and Peter stood up to speak.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi m-mali sara maligu shɛlikam, kpam yi be di ni bee kpam yi ka di ni, di nyɛla Aduna bidibisi la zaa dini, di ni kul nyɛ yino dini shɛm, lala ka di nyɛ ŋun la gba dini.
en: But all uncooked grain offerings, whether mixed with oil or dry, belong to all the Aaronite priests and must be shared equally among them.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ yoya ŋmanila takɔbi n-kuhiri niriba, amaa yɛndana yɛtɔɣa tahirila tibbuna.
en: Speak without thinking, and your words can cut like a knife. Be wise, and your words can heal.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Dauda zuliya ni so di nam nimaani. A ni guli n ni pii na so maa.
en: It is there that I will make Davids strength thrive. I will prepare a lamp for my anointed one there.

dag: Amaa ŋun zaŋ omaŋa tabili ti Duuma min o leela shi yino.
en: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi mini bɛ sapashini ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba daa gbaai Yisa n-lo o mihi.
en: Then the soldiers with their commander and the Jewish guards arrested Jesus. They tied him.

dag: Ka Idɛn mini Miniamin ni Jɛshua ni Shɛmiya ni Amaria ni Shɛkania daa nyɛ bɛn pah o zuɣu n-sɔŋd o ni ʒiɛyimtali maligumaaniba tinsi ni m-pirigiri nɛma maa tiri bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa kaman bɛ ni daa piripiri ba shɛm.
en: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah faithfully assisted him regarding the priests by distributing the portions to their relatives, old and young alike, by divisions.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi nya ma ka m mini so ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni bee ka n tuɣindi niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bee Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni bee tiŋ maa puuni.
en: The Jews did not find me arguing with anyone in the Temple, nor did they find me stirring up the people, either in the synagogues or anywhere else in the city.

dag: Pool ni daa ti gbaai dunɔdura dubu, tɔbbihi maa daa kpuɣ o mi buɣi salo maa ni daa na kul bi chɛ o zuɣu.
en: As they reached the steps, the crowd became so wild that the soldiers had to lift Paul up and carry him.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a.
en: Peter said to him, Look, weve left everything and followed you.

dag: Ti zaa chirindi pam, ka so yi bi chirim o yɛtɔɣa puuni, dilan nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu be dɛde, ka lan nyɛ ŋun mali yiko din ni tooi gbib o niŋgbuŋ zaa.
en: We all make mistakes often, but those who dont make mistakes with their words have reached full maturity. Like a bridled horse, they can control themselves entirely.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daai ba luhi kaman bɛ ni yi ŋma tia wula ka di lu shɛm la. O ni luhi karimbaannim mini wɔɣira bɛn be bɛ ni n-dihi ba vi.
en: Look, the Lord GOD All-Powerful will use his great power and chop down that great tree. Their highest officials will be brought down. Their most important leaders will be humbled.

dag: Ka yi ni daa tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di yipa nyɛ vi yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, nyɔ bɔ ka yi daa lee nya di ni? Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahigu nyɛla kum.
en: What did you gain from doing the things that you are now ashamed of? The result of those things is death!.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam Naawuni tiŋ la ni, o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: The Lord is great! He is praised throughout the city of our God, his holy mountain.

dag: Zaŋm daba ayopɔin mali alahichi sanyoo sara, sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini maa leei din be kasi zaa. Ka binshɛɣukam yi ti shihi sara maligu bimbini maa, di ni leei din be kasi.
en: Seven days you should perform the ritual of reconciliation for the altar and make it holy. In this way, the altar will become most holy, and whatever touches the altar will also become holy.

dag: Bɛ gbala n-nyɛ bɛ yinsi sahakam. Nimaani ka bɛ kul yɛn be ʒiɛmani kam ni hal bɛ ni daa kul deei tiŋgbani paliti n-leei bɛ din la zaa yoli.
en: Their graves are their eternal homes, the place they live for all generations, even if they had counties named after them!.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ nandan nirilim dihila Yawɛ samli, ka o ni ti yo o di zaa.
en: When you give to the poor, it is like lending to the Lord , and the Lord will pay you back.

dag: Yi ni ti tuuri wuntaŋ ni, ka anabinim pahi yi zuɣu ka yi tuuri yuŋ. N ni saɣim yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: You priests will fall in the daytime. And at night the prophet will also fall with you. I will also destroy your mother.

dag: N daa loya n yɛm puuni ni n nyu dam n-nya suhupiɛlli, ka tum jɛrilim; ka yɛm daa kul be n tɛha ni. N daa tɛhiya ni di ni simdi ni nir zaŋ o dunia ŋɔ yili saha biɛla ŋɔ tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: So I decided to fill my body with wine while I filled my mind with wisdom. I tried this foolishness because I wanted to find a way to be happy. I wanted to see what was good for people to do during their few days of life.

dag: N yi tɛhi di yɛla, di gariti ma mi, ka dabiɛm mali ma, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.

dag: ka tiligi bɛ shihi ka di ku kpe gballi ni; ka chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: He will not let them be destroyed; he saves them from death itself.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa kpalim be Jɛhɔshɛba sani n-sɔɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu, ka Atalia daa diri nam su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: He remained hidden with his nurse in the LORDs temple for six years while Athaliah ruled the country.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa luhi, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the wind blew and beat against that house. It fell and was completely destroyed.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi la. N ni zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a zuliya maa, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: I will give you as many descendants as the stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all of these lands. All of the nations of the earth will be blessed because of your descendants.

dag: Bɛ ni nya alibarika Yawɛ sani, ka yi taali ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiliginsim ŋɔ sani.
en: That kind of person receives blessings from the LORD and righteousness from the God who saves.

dag: ni ashaara dali ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tiligirimi, ka nyari faako suhuyiɣisili dali?.
en: On the day God is angry and punishes, it is the wicked who are always spared.

dag: Naa maa yi ti yɛn kpe, ŋun doli zɔntua din be dunɔdal la ni kpe, ka ti lan doli nimaani yi.
en: When the prince enters, he comes in by way of the porch of the gate and goes out in the same direction.

dag: Sool ni daa nya ka Dauda chani ni o ti tuhi Filistia doo maa, ka o bɔhi Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la, Ŋun bia n-lee nyɛ nachimbil maa? Ka Abinɛr garigi yɛli, Naa, nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi mi.
en: When Saul saw David going out to fight Goliath, he asked Abner, the commander of his army, Abner, whose son is he? I have no idea, Your Majesty, Abner answered.

dag: Ka Izraɛl paɣ bia maa daa tu Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi Musa sani. O ma yuli n-daa booni Shɛlomit, o daa nyɛla Dibiri bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nira.
en: The Israelite womans son began cursing, using the Lords name in a bad way, so the people brought him to Moses.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ dimbɔŋɔnim leela bɛn birigi yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu puuni.
en: But some have missed this key point in their teaching and have gone off in another direction. Now they talk about things that help no one.

dag: Ka siɣili saha din nyɛ nanim ni daa yi tuhiri tɔbu saha shɛli la daa ti paai, ka Dauda daa tim Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Ammɔnnima, ka chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda ŋun daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In the spring, when kings go out to war, David sent Joab, his officers, and all the Israelites out to destroy the Ammonites. Joabs army surrounded their capital city, Rabbah. David stayed in Jerusalem.

dag: O nam maa dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa ti karindi litaafi kasinim ni, ka tɛhiri Jɛrusalɛm ni wurim doya yuun pisopɔin kaman Naawuni ni daa pun yɛli anabi Jɛrimia shɛm la yɛla.
en: In the first year of his reign I was studying the sacred books and thinking about the seventy years that Jerusalem would be in ruins, according to what the Lord had told the prophet Jeremiah.

dag: Dauda daa laɣimla Izraɛl kpamba mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima zaa.
en: He then gathered together all Israels leaders along with the priests and the Levites.

dag: Dinzuɣu, a yi yɛn tum shɛlikam, nyin tummi li ni a kpiɔŋ zaa; dama kpiimba biɛhigu shee din nyɛ a ni kuni luɣ shɛli maa, tuun shɛli bee tɛhi shɛli bee baŋsim bee yɛm ka nimaani.
en: Whatever you are capable of doing, do with all your might because theres no work, thought, knowledge, or wisdom in the grave, which is where you are headed.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag o ka o kpaag o nina kpa malaika maa ka bɔh o, N dana, wula? Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: Startled, he stared at the angel and replied, What is it, Lord? The angel said, Your prayers and your compassionate acts are like a memorial offering to God.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mi daa bo alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini kpa viɛlli lita tuhi kɔbisinahi n-ti Hiram min o yiŋnima. Lala ka Sulemaana daa kul niŋdi tiri Hiram yuuni kam.
en: and Solomon provided Hiram with , bushels of wheat and , gallons of pure olive oil every year to feed his men.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka ŋmaligi doli buɣa n-jɛmdi li la zuɣu ka Yawɛ chɛ ka yɛl biɛri ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa. .
en: Then they will answer, We know why the Lord did this. The people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.

dag: N yi bi tumdi m Ba tuma, yin di niŋ ma yɛda;.
en: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Zin mɔɣu ni m-baɣisi Ɛdom tintariga chaŋ, ka yi tintariga piligu shee yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ wulimpuhili polo.
en: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kana ti mɛhim vinvama din be gbirimagbirima ni, ni tampima voya ni, ka mɛhim gɔhi tuturi mini mɔri ni.
en: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim Malikia bia Pashihur mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la o sani la. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi.
en: King Zedekiah of Judah sent to me Pashhur son of Malchiah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah with this request:.

dag: Bee miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye a kpee yili zuɣu bee o puu zuɣu bee o dabili ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa bee o naɣilaa bee o buŋa bee a kpee ni su binshɛlikam zuɣu.
en: You must not want another mans wife. You must not want his house, his fields, his men and women servants, his cattle, or his donkeys. You must not want to take anything that belongs to another person.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mi a yuli zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋla a ni; ka a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi nyin Yawɛ.
en: Those who know your name trust you because you have not abandoned any who seek you, LORD.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka niriba mini bɛ paɣiba daa ti piligi kumdi pampam niŋdi bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim la.
en: Some of the men and their wives complained about the Jews in power.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk bia Abiata ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la, Zaŋmi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la ti ma na. Ka Abiata daa zaŋ tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa na ti ti Dauda.
en: David said to Abiathar the priest, Bring the ephod. So Abiathar brought it.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa mini ʒii ŋɔ yɛla zaa kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Nathan told David about that vision. He told David everything God had said.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Izraɛlnim maa tooni guui kpa mɔɣu polo, amaa bɛ daa bi tooi zo n-tiligi. Bɛn daa yi tiŋ maa puuni na la daa taɣi ba niŋ sunsuuni n-ku bɛ zaa.
en: They retreated from the Israelites and ran toward the open country, but they could not escape. They were caught between the main army and the men who were now coming out of the city, and they were destroyed.

dag: Dama wulimpuhili zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili, n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani, ka bɛ kul tuɣindi tulaale zim ka maani sara din be kasi tiri ma luɣilikam, dama n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People all around the world respect my name. All around the world they bring good gifts to me and burn good incense as a gift to me, because my name is important to all of them. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Not long before the Jewish festival of Passover, Jesus went to Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab yɛli so yɛla ni Naawuni yɛliya, N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: In the Scriptures, God calls John his messenger and says, I am sending my messenger ahead of you to get things ready for you.

dag: O chɛ ka tɔbu tuhibu chɛ dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam. O kab tɔbiri ka saɣim kpana, ka nyo nyɔtaɣirisi buɣim.
en: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa kul ni beni sahakam, amaa ʒiri yɛtɔɣa bi yuura.
en: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti maa na, bɛ daa kpɛla yɔɣu ni chaŋ na hal ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu n-gbaai li du n-ka Kadɛshi na.
en: When they were coming up from Egypt, the Israelites went through the desert to the Reed Sea and came to Kadesh.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn mi daa yi Saipurus mini Sairiini n-ka Antiɔk na mali Naawuni yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili, ka yihiri ba ti Duuma Yisa yɛla waazu.
en: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka di sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.

dag: Miri ka a tam ka bi paɣi Naawuni o tuma zuɣu, dama niriba pun yiinila wumpaɣibo yila zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: He has always been praised for what he does; you also must praise him.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa suhuri daa paligi bɛ pɔri maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa pola pɔri maa ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka suhi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔr shɛli zaa, ka Naawuni daa deei bɛ suhigu maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: All Judah was delighted with the solemn pledge because they had sworn it with all their hearts. When they enthusiastically sought God, he was found by them, and the LORD gave them peace on every side.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn chɛ ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ kpuɣi Ilaija chaŋ alizanda ni saha shɛli, o mini Ilaisha daa yila Giligal m-be soli zuɣu chana.
en: Now the LORD was going to take Elijah up to heaven in a windstorm, and Elijah and Elisha were leaving Gilgal.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Gidiɔn zuɣu na, ka o zaŋ kikaa piɛb boli Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni bɛ kana ti dol o.
en: The Lord 's Spirit took control of Gideon, and Gideon blew a trumpet as a signal for the men in the Abiezer clan to follow him.

dag: O ni gbilisiri tibili wumdi n suhigu zuɣu, n kul ni suhir o hal ni n nyɛvil tariga.
en: Ill call out to him as long as I live, because he listens closely to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu wuhim ti ka ti kaani ti dabisa, din ni chɛ ka ti niŋ yɛm ti suhuri ni.
en: Teach us to number our days so we can have a wise heart.

dag: Nir ni tooi gbaai baandɔɣu niŋ o nuu ni, amaa o bela nanim yinsi.
en: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dahin shɛli kanna, ka ŋun kɔri ni ti niŋdi yomyom gari ŋun kpuɣiri puu atam, ka ŋun kahindi wain wala kom ni ti niŋdi yomyom gari ŋun biriti li. Wain nyaɣisili ni ti yi zoya zuɣu n-tɔɣiri lurina, ka di ni ti zo n-tiɛli daboya zaa.
en: The days are surely coming, says the LORD, when the one who plows will overtake the one who gathers, when the one who crushes grapes will overtake the one who sows the seed. The mountains will drip wine, and all the hills will flow with it.

dag: Chɛliya yi kpibisi; n ni gbib ba, ka chɛ ka yi pakoya niŋ ma naani.
en: Leave me your orphans, and Ill look after them; trust your widows into my care.

dag: Ka naa lan bɔhi ba, Ka ŋuni n-lee be zɔŋ ni? Di saha maa ka Haman mi daa kpɛna ti ʒe zɔŋ ni. O daa kamina ni o ti yɛli naa ka o bah o noli ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Mɔdɛkai ti yili gar da shɛli o ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ sa n-zal la.
en: About this time, Haman came in to ask the king to have Mordecai hanged on the gallows he had built. The king saw him and asked, Who is that man waiting in front of the throne room.

dag: Tim ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu.
en: Give us the food we need for today.

dag: O kurimmi, ka dɔni kaman gbuɣindaa la. O ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yiɣis o? Ŋunkam niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, o ni nya alibarika; ka ŋunkam yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi yi zuɣu, yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu maa din dim o.
en: The nation is like a mighty lion; When it is sleeping, no one dares wake it. Whoever blesses Israel will be blessed, And whoever curses Israel will be cursed.

dag: Ka o daa me yiya Millo polo hal ti gil di zaa. Ka Jɔab mi daa mali tiŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din kpalim me.
en: He also built up the city on all sides, including its own foundations and the surrounding areas, while Joab restored the rest of the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zanimiya baalim ka m mini ya laɣim suhi Yawɛ o ni tum tiliginsim tuun shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim zaa la zuɣu.
en: Now stand where you are, and I will accuse you before the Lord by reminding you of all the mighty actions the Lord did to save you and your ancestors.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, o daa nyɛla Dɔdo bia, ka Dɔdo mi nyɛ Aho bia. Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani saha shɛli bɛ ni daa filim Filistianim bɛn lo tɔbu n-laɣim nimaani na, ka Izraɛlnim nya ba ka tiri gbin la.
en: The next one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite. One time when the Philistines were at war with Israel, he and David dared the Philistines to fight them. Every one of the Israelite soldiers turned and ran.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim wum li, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka tuumbiɛɣu lala tatabo ku lan tum yi sunsuuni yaha.
en: The rest of the people will hear about this and be afraid. They wont do that sort of evil thing among you again.

dag: Saha shɛli di ni daa wum ya ka gbarigi ya, ka bɛ liri ya n-ku yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nyaaŋa la. Bɛ daa bi zo Naawuni.
en: The Amalekites did not respect God. They attacked you when you were weak and tired. They killed all your people who were slow and walking behind everyone else.

dag: Dama ti mi ŋun yɛli, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi la. O lan yɛli, Yi Duuma ni kar o niriba saria.
en: We know the one who said, Judgment is mine; I will pay people back. And he also said, The Lord will judge his people. .

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe ha! Bee n-yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe! Ti miriya ka yi chaŋ bee nti doli ba.
en: There will be those who will say to you, Look, over there! or, Look, over here! But don't go out looking for it.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa zaa daa kana ti gar o zuɣu, ka Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim ni Gaatinim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa doli naa yi Gaat la na zaa daa gar o tooni.
en: All the kings servants marched past him, as did all the Cherethites, all the Pelethites, and the six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.

dag: O daa piila tumtumdiba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣ kpɛriba bɛn be zoya ni tuhi pihinii, ka pii niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumda.
en: He got , laborers and , stonemasons to cut stones in the mountains. He chose foremen to supervise the workers.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabiya: Man Naawuni duu ni boonila wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu.
en: He told them, The Scriptures say, My house should be called a place of worship. But you have turned it into a place where robbers hide.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, doliya dunoya yi. Malimiya soli sɔŋ niriba. Vuɣimiya kuɣa soli maa zuɣu. Lomiya tuuta n-kpuɣ li zuɣusaa ka niriba nya li baŋ li.
en: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tiligi tɔb ni la daa nya nambɔzɔbo tiŋgban nɛl la ni. Izraɛlnim ni daa bɔri vuhim shee la.
en: In the desert I showed mercy to those people who had escaped death. When the people of Israel longed for rest.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi yiri palo ka kpɛhiri ba saria karibu ni; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb mi daalahichi sɔɣiri ni di ti yi palo dahin shɛli ha.
en: The sins of some people are plain to see, and their sins go ahead of them to judgment; but the sins of others are seen only later.

dag: A daŋ maa nyɛla din ni ku nira, ka binshɛli din maari biɛrim mi kani. Bɛnkam zaa wum a yɛla, bɛ kpahirila bɛ nuhi. Dama bɛ ni ŋuni ka a lee bi niŋ a ninkuunsi din ka naabu ŋɔ?.
en: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tiligim ti o nuu ni, ka di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam nanim baŋ ni nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: But you are our Lord and our God! We ask you to keep us safe from the Assyrian king. Then everyone in every kingdom on earth will know that you are the only God.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni jilima daa yi di ni be chɛrubi so zuɣu la n-chaŋ ti tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa boli do so ŋun ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka binshɛli din sabira be o luɣili zuɣu la.
en: the glory of Israels God rose from above the winged creatures where he had been and moved toward the temples threshold. The LORD called to the man who was dressed in linen with the writing case at his side.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋ na nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka di sabi ni faashee Daadam Bia bahi di wahala balibu kam ka bɛ lan ʒiɛm o?.
en: His answer was, Elijah is indeed coming first in order to get everything ready. Yet why do the Scriptures say that the Son of Man will suffer much and be rejected?.

dag: Bɛ naala noli n-lu wuntizɔriba zuɣu, ka kari saria n-zali ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali.
en: They attack those who do right. They say innocent people are guilty and put them to death.

dag: Bɛ yi kul be luɣ shɛlikam, dabiɛm m-mali ba, ka kariti doli ba duri bɛ napɔŋkpahi.
en: On every side terrors frighten them. Fears follow every step they take.

dag: ka ninvuɣ pihinii daa yi Shɛkɛm mini Shilo ni Samaria paana. Bɛ daa pinila bɛ teensi, ka chahichahi bɛ situra, ka zaŋ bini ŋmaŋŋma bɛ niŋgbuna. Bɛ daa zaŋla kawana mini tulaale zim na ni bɛ ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: eighty men arrived from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria. They had shaved off their beards, torn their clothes, and gashed themselves. They were taking grain and incense to offer in the Temple.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zalizali.
en: The rest of the Israelites shall set up camp, company by company, each man with his own group and under his own banner.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dooni bɛ gom shee n-lɔri nia biɛri. Bɛ bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ zali so viɛlli zuɣu; bɛ mi bi zaɣisiri din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.

dag: Malim a tuma shili samban ni, ka tum a pu tuma naai, di nyaaŋa ka a naanyi me a yili.
en: Get your outside work done; make preparations in the field; then you can build your house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Ahitɔfɛl gba pahila Absalom zuɣu. Ka Dauda yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛn wuhi yikombiɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa leei jɛrilim.
en: David was told that Ahithophel was also among the conspirators with Absalom, so he prayed, Please, LORD, make Ahithophels advice foolish.

dag: Yɛlim din beni, karimi saria ni wuntizɔbo. Zabimi faranim mini nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Stand up for what you know is right, and judge all people fairly. Protect the rights of the poor and those who need help.

dag: Amaa yinim ni kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: As for you people, you will die in this desert.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ziɔnnima, paɣimiya yi Naawuni!.
en: Worship the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!.

dag: Dama n dimnim kul tɔɣisirila n yɛla, ka bɛn puɣisiri ni bɛ ku ma laɣindi gbaari saawara.
en: Yes, my enemies have been talking about me; those who stalk me plot together.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-sa tihi balibu kam, di wala ni ti nyɛla din dibu chihiri yi sani. Di ni ti nyɛla din chihiri dibu yi sani hal ni yuma ata, ka di bi simdi ni yi di li.
en: When you come into the land of Canaan and plant any kind of fruit tree, consider the fruit ritually unclean for the first three years. During that time you must not eat it.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm bɛ wuna, ka di daa leei zana gbahi ba.
en: They began worshiping the false gods those people worshiped. And their idols became a trap.

dag: Ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa yɛli, Nyama, m mali binshɛɣukam zaa ka di niŋ zaɣ pala! Ka lan yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nira ni ni niŋ shɛli naani, ka lan nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Then the one seated on the throne said, Look! Im making all things new. He also said, Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.

dag: Ŋunkam di nasara ni deei pini ŋɔ n sani, ka n ni nyɛ o Naawuni, ka o mi nyɛ m bia.
en: All those who win the victory will receive all this. And I will be their God, and they will be my children.

dag: O darigi n tibili siɣimsiɣim bushɛm dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: And beat me again and again with merciless blows.

dag: Amaa o zuɣu palo maa ni bee gbɛ palo maa ni yi mali dɔr biɛɣu bimmɔriŋ zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu m-piligir o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni maa.
en: But whenever there is a reddish-white infection in the bald spot or in the receding hairline, it is a case of skin disease breaking out there.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋum o lɔŋni, ka zaŋ o jilima kukoli ŋɔ tahi, ka o bi goori saanyaɣisibu saha shɛli ti yi wum o kukoli maa.
en: Then the roar of his voice is heard, the majestic sound of thunder, and all the while the lightning flashes.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ a gula. O nyɛla a nudirigu polo mahim.
en: The Lord is your Protector. The Lord stands by your side, shading and protecting you.

dag: Yi yurinim zaa tam yi yɛla, bɛ baɣa lan ka yi ni; dama n ŋmɛn ya mi kaman n nyɛla yi dim la; n darigila yi tibili kaman dim so ŋun bi zɔri nambɔɣu, dama yi taali galisiya pam, ka yi daalahichi mi galisi yaɣi.
en: All your lovers disregard you; they write you off as a lost cause, because I have dealt harshly with you as an enemy would, because your guilt is great and your sins are many.

dag: Ka zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni, ka baansi yiini yila, ka kikapiɛbiriba piɛbira hal ka buɣim ti di sara maligu binyara maa naai.
en: Everyone who was there joined in worship, and the singing and the rest of the music continued until all the sacrifices had been burned.

dag: Ka bɛ daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So they asked Jesus to leave their territory.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu kam nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani. Baŋmiya ni bɛ ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: The Lord hates those who are proud. You can be sure he will punish them all.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi pahi ʒiibukɔbiga zuɣu, ka bɛ zaa ni nyɛla n dan naa tɔbbihi. Ka bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa lan bɔr ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha? Bɔzuɣu ka n dan naa bɔri ni o bo taali ti Izraɛlnima.
en: But Joab answered, May the Lord make his nation times as large! Sir, all the Israelites are your servants. Why do you want to do this thing, my lord and king? You will make all the Israelites guilty of sin.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti kpamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala maa jaande, ka zaani ba zaligu ni bɛ be baalim ka tummi tuma lihiri bɛmaŋa.
en: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ we command these people and warn them to lead orderly lives and work to earn their own living.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Nyama, n ni kari Amɔrinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima, ka chɛ palo tin ya.
en: Obey the laws that I am giving you today. I will drive out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, as you advance.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina, ka gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi ka sabbu be di yaɣa ayi. Di daa sab niŋla di tooni mini di nyaaŋa zaa.
en: Then Moses went down the mountain. He had the two stone tablets with the agreement on them. The commandments were written on both sides of the stone, front and back.

dag: Bini bahigu so di piligu; ka suɣilo so karimbaani.
en: It is better to finish something than to start it. It is better to be gentle and patient than to be proud and impatient.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba maa mini Keenannim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbani maa ni la kul laɣim be, bɛ ni daa bi kari ba maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Asher settled among the Canaanites in the land because they couldnt drive them out.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pa lala ka Naawuni yɛn niŋ n zuliya? Dama o lo ma alikauli din ka bahigu; o chɛ ka di zani dɛde binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan ka taɣibu yaha. Dama o ni chɛ ka n sɔŋsim mini n suhu ni yu shɛli nya nasara.
en: God made my family strong and secure. He made an agreement with me forever. God made sure this agreement was good and secure in every way. So surely he will give me every victory. He will give me everything I want!.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim kuli. A napɔŋ yi ti kul zani tiŋ puuni, bia maa ni leei Naawuni dini.
en: That's the Lord 's message to your husband. As for you, go back home, and right after you get there, your son will die.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul jiɣindimi biɛɣu kam ni o nya pam pahi, ka wuntizɔra mi kul tiri pini ka bi vil o ni su shɛli gbini.
en: all they do is think about what they would like to have. The righteous, however, can give, and give generously.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka bol li, Yawɛ nyɛla suhudoo. Ka di na kul ʒe Ofira Abiɛzanim ni su luɣ shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Gideon built an altar there to the LORD and called it The LORD makes peace. It still stands today in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

dag: Gumiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka chɛ niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka di ku lu yi zuɣu. Doliya Lɛvi maligumaaniba la ni wuhiri ya shɛlikam la viɛnyɛliŋga kaman n ni zali ba shɛm.
en: When you have a very bad skin disease, be very careful to follow everything the Levite priests teach you. You must follow carefully what I told the priests to do.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dari tɔhi binyara din ni saɣ o bihi, ka dim kabi binyara nyiŋgoya n-zaŋ ti ti gbuɣinnyaŋ. O zaŋ o ni gbahi binneen shɛba ti pal o ni be vokab shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ o ni dari tɔhi nim shɛli ti pal o ni do luɣ shɛŋa.
en: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.

dag: Sulemaana daa di nam m-be Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa la yuun pihinahi.
en: The amount of time Solomon ruled over all Israel in Jerusalem was forty years.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya, A ku lan yiɣis a ni do bindo shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, a ni kpi. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ.
en: Tell him that because he has done this, he's on his deathbed! And Elijah did what he was told.

dag: ka kul suhiri Naawuni ni di yi nyɛ o yubu, ŋun malim soli ti ma ka m bahi ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ;.
en: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣiri ŋmanila gbal yari. Bɛ zaa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Their archers are mighty soldiers who kill without mercy.

dag: Shɛm bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram ni Uzi ni Hul ni Gɛta ni Mɛshɛk.
en: Shems family: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram. Arams family: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

dag: N Duuma, a mi n suhu ni ye shɛli zuɣu zaa, a mi n siɣimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: My Lord, you heard my groaning. You can hear my sighs.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chana, ka n wum bɛ kpiŋkpama maa vuri ka di be kaman kokpɛɣu vuri la; di daa ŋmanila Kpiɔŋlan Naa kukoli, ka di vuri ŋmani tɔbbihi pam vuri. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: Then I heard the sound of their wings when they moved forward. It was like the sound of mighty waters, like the sound of the Almighty, like the sound of tumult or the sound of an army camp. When they stood still, their wings came to rest.

dag: Chɛ ka karimbaannim di vi bɛ ni ŋmari ʒiri pari ma la zuɣu, amaa n kul ni tɛhir a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs yuli ka Mɔdɛkai daa zaŋ sab gbana maa, ka zaŋ ŋun naa nintua dalinli dihi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li tim wɔribariba bɛn daa bari nayili wɔrikpaa ni wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam, ka bɛ zaŋ li tahi.
en: They wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus and sealed the order with the kings royal ring. He sent letters with riders mounted on royal horses bred from mares known to run fast.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: So always be ready! You don't know when the Son of Man will come.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be tinsi maa ni kɔŋ kpiɔŋ, ka dabiɛm mali ba ka di gari ba pahi, ka bɛ daa ŋmanila tuturi mini mɔri ni mɔ shɛŋa din sa mɔpila zuɣu, ka mɔri dɔro gbaai li ka di kɔŋ zoobu.
en: The people who lived there were powerless; they were frightened and stunned. They were like grass in a field or weeds growing on a roof when the hot east wind blasts them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋum o lɔŋni, ka zaŋ o jilima kukoli ŋɔ tahi, ka o bi goori saanyaɣisibu saha shɛli ti yi wum o kukoli maa.
en: After it, a voice roars; he thunders with a mighty voice, and no one can stop it when his voice is heard.

dag: Absalom ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm dol o chaŋ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi, bɛn daa kul chaŋla bɛ tariŋ chandi, ka bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Absalom invited men to go with him. They left Jerusalem with him, but they did not know what he was planning.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama n niŋ ya naani zaa.
en: Im happy, because I can completely depend on you.

dag: A daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna gari tooni n-zaŋ a niriba bɛn ŋmani piɛri la chaŋ.
en: You led your people like sheep under the care of Moses and Aaron.

dag: Masia zuɣu m mali suhupiɛlli chɔɣinsi ni mini ʒiɛmbu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni alaka nyabu ni ni wahala dibu puuni, dama n yi ti gbarigi, di saha ka n lan nyari yaa.
en: Yes, I am glad to have weaknesses if they are for Christ. I am glad to be insulted and have hard times. I am glad when I am persecuted and have problems, because it is when I am weak that I am really strong.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba daa be Ofɛl, ka daa mali me hal ti paai Kom Dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la mini pia din daa du pam la shee.
en: The Temple servants lived on Ophel Hill. They repaired the next section all the way to the east side of the Water Gate and the tower near it.

dag: ka di chɛ ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin shɛŋa din be yi tooni la ha, ka di chɛ ka ti ku nyu bara ninvuɣ shɛb ni pun tum shɛm luɣ shɛŋa polo la zuɣu.
en: We want to tell the Good News in the areas beyond your city. We dont want to boast about work that has already been done in someone elses area.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi zaa daa bela Dan zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: All these cities and fields around them were given to the tribe of Dan. Each family got its share of the land.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛlnim sani, ka nyɛ bɛn bi guni bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ niŋgbuna ni la bi simdi ni bɛ kpe n jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , declare that no uncircumcised foreigner, no one who disobeys me, will enter my Temple, not even a foreigner who lives among the people of Israel.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim zim shɛli mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi. Ka naa daa zaŋ li niŋ Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yil la ni.
en: and three hundred small shields of hammered gold, using sixty ounces of gold in each shield. The king placed these in the Forest of Lebanon Palace.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛn zɔr o ni, bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa.
en: All who worship the Lord , no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.

dag: Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la be nimaani. Dinzuɣu a yi ti kul wum shɛlikam nayili maa, nyin yɛlim Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa.
en: The priests Zadok and Abiathar will be with you there. So report everything you hear in the kings palace to the priests Zadok and Abiathar.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra. Ijipti yɛnnim nyɛla jɛra bɛn wuhi niriba din bi viɛla. Bɛ ku tooi yɛli Firawuna ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnim mini na kura zuliya.
en: The leaders of the city of Zoan are fools! Egypt's wisest people give stupid advice! How do they dare to tell the king that they are successors to the ancient scholars and kings?.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaija daa garigi yɛli ba, N yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni nira, Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa luna n-di a min a tɔbbihi pihinu ŋɔ. Di saha ka Naawuni buɣim daa shiri yi zuɣusaa luna n-di sapashini maa min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa.
en: If I am a man of God, Elijah answered, may fire come down from heaven and kill you and your men! At once the fire of God came down and killed the officer and his men.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛn be kpaŋa lun ya sizuura, ka yi mi ku lihiri so ninni ni o dihi ya.
en: If you do these things, then those who are not believers will respect the way you live. And you will not have to depend on others for what you need.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin dali daa ti yɛn paai, ka Naawuni pun naai o ni daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa maa tuma; ka vuhi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zaa vuhim daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: By the seventh day God had finished his work, and so he rested.

dag: a ni niŋ tuuba a suhu ni, ka siɣis amaŋ Naawuni sani n-darigi cheeg a binyɛrigu ka kum niŋ ma zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum ka n yɛli ni n ni niŋ Jɛrusalɛm mini di niriba shɛm la polo, man Yawɛ yɛliya, N gba wumya.
en: Because your heart was broken and you submitted before the LORD when you heard what he said against this place and its citizens, and because you ripped your clothes and cried before me, I have listened to you, declares the LORD.

dag: Yi nyɛla neesim mini wuntaŋ ni niriba. Ti pala yuŋ bee zibisim ni niriba.
en: You are all people who belong to the light. You belong to the day. We dont belong to the night or to darkness.

dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bini paligi li la ni di ni lu. Sa titali ni mi, ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe.
en: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom nyɛla tɛhi zilimalana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu yiɣisiri yomyom kpaŋsirila jɛrilim.
en: If you stay calm, you are wise, but if you have a hot temper, you only show how stupid you are.

dag: bee so yi gbib kuɣili din ni tooi ku nira, ka di faai lu o kpee zuɣu ku o, ka di mi pala o dima n-nyɛ o, ka o mi di bi pun lo ni o ti o daŋa.
en: or accidentally drops any stone on him that could cause death and he dies—even though they werent enemies and no evil was intended.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa, ka po ni o ni chɛ ka bɛ kpi yɔɣu maa ni.
en: So he gave them a solemn warning that he would make them die in the desert.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yɛli, Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo.
en: If the LORD hadnt been for us— let Israel now repeat!.

dag: Ka a ti yihi kpa shɛli din zaa be naɣilaa maa binnyɔri ni mini binsaba ni yaannina mini kpam din be di ni n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then take all the fat from inside the bull, the fatty part of the liver, both kidneys, and the fat around them. Burn this fat on the altar.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti zaŋ anzinfa mali wuni pahi n zuɣu bee n-zaŋ salima mali wuni zali yi sani.
en: So you must not make idols using gold or silver to compete with me. You must not make these false gods.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu yuŋ. Nyini ka n suhu zaa kul bɔra. Dama a yi kari dunia mini niriba bɛn be di ni saria, di chɛmi ka bɛ baŋdi din tuhi.
en: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.

dag: O ni deei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima suhigu, o ku zaɣisi bɛ suhigu.
en: God will turn to the prayer of the impoverished; he wont despise their prayers.

dag: Ka naa maa daa pirig o nintu shɛli o ni daa yi mali dihiri zaligu gbana zuɣu ka di leeri naa ni zali zaligu shɛli ti Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: The king took off his ring, which was used to stamp proclamations and make them official, and gave it to the enemy of the Jewish people, Haman son of Hammedatha, the descendant of Agag.

dag: Di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So pa wuntizɔra, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: As it is written, There is no righteous person, not even one. .

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa to jina naai noli, ka lo Yisa mihi zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Very early in the morning, the leading priests, the older Jewish leaders, the teachers of the law, and the whole high council decided what to do with Jesus. They tied him, led him away, and handed him over to Governor Pilate.

dag: Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Ziɔn ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya sɔŋ la, yɛlimaŋli, bɛn nyɛ bɛn kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm la, bɛ ni boli ba bɛn be kasi.
en: And all those who are left in Zion and Jerusalem will be called holy. Their names were on the list of people in Jerusalem who were allowed to live.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Zophar from Naamah said:.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari shihira ŋɔ zaa, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: In the same way, when you see all these things, you will know that the time is near, ready to begin.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba;.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Nations and kingdoms will fight against each other.

dag: N ku chɛ a bee n-zo a nambɔɣu, n ni darigi a tibili a tuma zuɣu saha shɛli a ni tum din chihiri shɛli ni na be a kɔbili ni maa. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I wont shed a tear for you or show any pity. Instead, Ill turn your ways against you, and your detestable practices will stay with you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: O ni daa ti miri tiŋ maa ni kpɛbu, ka tiŋ maa ni nachimbil so kpi ka bɛ ʒir o yirina, ka tiŋ maa niriba kabiri doli. Kpim maa ma daa nyɛla pakoli; o mi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ pakoli maa bia.
en: Just as he arrived at the gate of the town, a funeral procession was coming out. The dead man was the only son of a woman who was a widow, and a large crowd from the town was with her.

dag: Man Pool ŋun zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba puhiri ya.
en: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.

dag: Mbusim yi tahi kum libigirili na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali la nya wahala, o maani ba la ansarisi.
en: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Shaaf ŋun daa nyɛ Madimanna ba la mini Shɛva ŋun daa nyɛ Makibɛna mini Gibia ba la. Kalɛb bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Akisa.
en: Later she had two more sons: Shaaph, who founded the town of Madmannah; and Shevah, who founded the towns of Machbenah and Gibea. In addition, Caleb had a daughter named Achsah.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaŋ bini pɔbi goli muni ninni, ka yɛrig o sagbani pa di zuɣu.
en: He covers the face of the full moon. He spreads his clouds over it and hides it.

dag: Ɛlihu daa guhirimi ni bɛ naai pɔi ka o naanyi tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa, dama bɛna n-daa nyɛ ninkura.
en: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋdi binyɛra paŋdi ya, amaa yinim ti ku zaŋ shɛli paŋ ba. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ zuɣu, ka yi nyɛ zuli.
en: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers.

dag: Bɛn kpalim mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ, pa ti Duuma n-yɛli dina: Yi ni so yi mali paɣa ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda ka paɣ maa yu ni o be o sani, ŋun miri ka o yih o.
en: Im telling everyone else : If a believer has a wife who doesnt believe, and she agrees to live with him, then he shouldnt divorce her.

dag: Di saha maa Judanim zaa mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ biliɛri ni bɛ bi kura zaa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ tooni.
en: While every man, woman, and child of Judah was standing there at the temple.

dag: O chɛ ka n dooni momaha ni. O zaŋdi ma tahiri kom din do baalim shee.
en: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water.

dag: ka boli Yisa tuumba maa na ti fiɛb ba, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ miri ka bɛ lan zaŋ Yisa yuli tɔɣisiri niriba, ka daa bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: After calling the apostles back, they had them beaten. They ordered them not to speak in the name of Jesus, then let them go.

dag: N ni ti ku binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ ŋɔ ni, ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri. Alɔbo titali nti yɛn lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: I will strike down those within this city—both people and animals—and they will die of a terrible plague.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi wumdi yi daanabinim mini yi laasabuniŋdiba bee yi zahinzahindiba ni yi baɣisi bee yi bukpahinim bɛn yɛri ya ni yi di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu.
en: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yɛl o, Yɛlim ti Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n-shiri nyɛ Masia Naawuni Bia la.
en: But Jesus was silent. The high priest said, By the living God, I demand that you tell us whether you are the Christ, Gods Son.

dag: Dama ʒiɛmana pam din gari la ha zaŋ kana ni pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ kul karindila Anabi Musa zaligu Yɛhudianim tiŋ kam jɛmbu duu ni Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka karimbanima naanyi yihir o yɛligu waazu.
en: For the Law of Moses has been read for a very long time in the synagogues every Sabbath, and his words are preached in every town.

dag: Ka naa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni ka di wum ba pam, ka o zani nimaani vuhi.
en: The king and all the people who were with him reached the Jordan River exhausted, and he rested there.

dag: ka a ku a dan Ɛhab daŋ niriba, ka di chɛ ka m bɔhi Jɛzibɛl biɛri o ni daa ku n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim mini n dab shɛb zaa bɛn pahi la zuɣu.
en: You are to kill your master the king, that son of Ahab, so that I may punish Jezebel for murdering my prophets and my other servants.

dag: Birimiya wuntitali ti yimaŋa, ka ti kpuɣi atam din nyɛ yurilim din ka ŋmali. Komiya yi tiŋgbani din doya ka bi ko la, dama saha paaya ni yi bo Yawɛ ka o kana ti tiligi ya.
en: I said, Plow new ground for yourselves, plant righteousness, and reap the blessings that your devotion to me will produce. It is time for you to turn to me, your Lord , and I will come and pour out blessings upon you.

dag: Bɛ kuhirimi niŋdi bɛ manima, Bindirigu mini wain be ya? Bɛ tarigiri luri tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu kaman bɛ nyala dansi la, saha shɛli bɛ ni kpiri niŋdi bɛ manim nuhi ni la.
en: They ask their mothers, Where is the bread and wine? as they pour out their life in their mothers laps.

dag: Naawuni daa sɔŋ o ka o tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Guribaal la ni Miunnima.
en: God helped him against the Philistines, the Arabs who inhabited Gur, and the Meunites.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yooi n tiba, ka m mi bi niŋ tipawumli bee n-lab nyaaŋa.
en: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kpi m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu. Bɛ zaŋ Ijiptinim tila takɔbi ni bɛ gbahi bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: The people of Egypt will fall with those who are killed in battle. A sword is ready to kill them all.

dag: ninvuɣ yoya shɛb yila yi ni n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka tiŋ maa nim birigi ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti jɛm wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi.
en: that some worthless people of your nation have misled the people of their town to worship gods that you have never worshiped before.

dag: O chɛ ka n noli bemi kaman takɔbi dirili la. O daa zaŋ ma sɔɣila o nuu mahim ka daa chɛ ka m be kaman peen dirili la, ka o zaŋ ma su o lɔɣu ni.
en: He made my mouth like a sharp sword, and hid me in the shadow of Gods own hand. He made me a sharpened arrow, and concealed me in Gods quiver.

dag: Yi gba ni nyɛ Naawuni bihi maa zuɣu ka Naawuni tim o Bia maa Shia ka o kana ti be ti suhuri ni kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: Because you are sons and daughters, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

dag: O daa kul muɣisirila sokam. Wɔɣira mini tarimba ni bundaannim mini faranim ni bilichinnim mini daba ni o dalim ba bɛ nudiriti ni bee bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: The beast forced all the people, small and great, rich and poor, slave and free, to have a mark placed on their right hands or on their foreheads.

dag: Bɛ bɔhira, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti lɔri noli ka a bi nyara? Bee bɔ n-niŋ ka ti nahim timaŋa, ka a baɣa kani. Nyama, yi ni lɔri noli dahin shɛli maa yi niŋdila din ni sɔŋ yimaŋa, ka nahindi yi tumtumdiba.
en: Why do we fast and you dont see; why afflict ourselves and you dont notice? Yet on your fast day you do whatever you want, and oppress all your workers.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma so shɛŋa din kuni nyɛvili shee, ka chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa, n ni be a san la zuɣu. .
en: You have shown me the paths of life; your presence will fill me with happiness. .

dag: Dama nimaani ka saria karibu ʒiishɛhi be, saria karibu ʒiishɛhi din nyɛ Dauda zuliya dini.
en: because the thrones of justice are there— the thrones of the house of David!.

dag: Ka n daa wum ninvuɣ so kukoli ka di yi Ulai Mɔɣili la ni na m-booni yɛra, Gabirɛl, wuhim o o ni nya shɛli maa gbinni.
en: Then I heard a mans voice. This voice came from above the Ulai River. The voice called out, Gabriel, explain the vision to this man.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi tɔbu kikaa, o kumdimi ni suhupiɛlli. Tɔbu yi be katiŋa, o taɣirila di ʒiɛɣu, ka wumdi sapashin kpamba ni tahira kaman saa tahigu la.
en: At a trumpets sound, he says, Aha! smells the battle from afar, hears officers shouting and the battle cry.

dag: yi ma ni ti di vi pam, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi ya ti nya filiŋ. Nyama, o ni ti be zuliya kam nyaaŋa. O ni ti bemi kaman tiŋgban nɛli din kuui ka kom ka di ni la.
en: The city of Babylon was like a mother to you. But it will be disgraced and become nothing but a barren desert.

dag: Dama o suhu bi yu ni o nahim ti bee n-ti ti ni so suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: He does not enjoy causing people pain. He does not like to make anyone unhappy.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ya, ka tumdi bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni; amaa bɛ di miri sara maligu shee lahi la bee sara maligu bimbini maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala, yi mini ba ni kpi.
en: They are to fulfill their duties to you and their responsibilities for the Tent, but they must not have any contact with sacred objects in the Holy Place or with the altar. If they do, both they and you will be put to death.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zal o dabili Musa shɛm, lala ka Musa gba daa zali Jɔshua; ka Jɔshua mi daa niŋ kaman o ni zal o shɛm. O daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka bi chɛ di shɛli bahi.
en: What the LORD had commanded Moses his servant, Moses had commanded Joshua, and Joshua did exactly that. He didnt deviate a bit from any command that the LORD had given Moses.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul bi niŋ tuuba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun darigi bɛ tibili maa sani bee ŋ-ŋmaligi lab o sanna.
en: The people of Israel have not repented; even though the Lord Almighty has punished them, they have not returned to him.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ nina neei ka bɛ baŋ o, ka o daa dii bɔrigi ka chɛ ba ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, but he disappeared from their sight.

dag: O ni daa paai nimaani, Ɛli daa ʒila o kuɣ zuɣu sɔnaŋgbanyee lihira, dama o suhu daa bi doya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Doo maa ni daa kpe tiŋ puuni nti moli lahibali maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa.
en: He went into town and told the news about the battle, and everyone started crying. Eli was afraid that something might happen to the sacred chest. So he was sitting on his chair beside the road, just waiting.

dag: Hal bɛ yi ti zoori kaman momaha la, Yawɛ pɔhim ni yi wulimpuhili polo mɔɣu ni na nti ʒe nyuui bɛ kɔbilnina, ka bɛ kɔzɔrima nyuui. Ka di ʒe bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni daazichi zaa chaŋ.
en: Although he may flourish among rushes, the east wind will come— the breath of God rising from the wilderness; and his spring will dry up; his fountain will be dried up. It will strip his household of every cherished possession.

dag: Wuntizɔriba wuntitali n-tiligiri ba, amaa bilikɔɣinim nia biɛri nyɛla din gbahiri ba.
en: Those who do right are saved by their righteousness, but the untrustworthy are caught by their own desires.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni jɛmbu ka buchi. Ka o zaligunim dolibu bee ti yi be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani kaman ti kumdila kuli la, di daanfaani nyɛ ti dini?.
en: Here is what you have said: It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?.

dag: Amaa di daa bi yuui ka bɛ tam a tuma maa yɛla, ka daa bi guhi n-deeg a wuhibu.
en: But they quickly forgot about what he did. They did not listen to his advice.

dag: Bɛ gbala maa bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa puuni ha. Di tɔbbihi zaa laɣimmi gili di gballi. Takɔbi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa. Bɛna n-daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: who were assigned graves in the deepest region of the pit. His assembly surrounded his grave, all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.

dag: Bahi yoli mini wahala m-be bɛ ni doli so shɛŋa zuɣu.
en: they leave ruin and destruction wherever they go.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ baŋsim piligu, jɛra bɛn lihi ʒiɛmla yɛm mini wuhibu.
en: Wisdom begins with the fear of the LORD, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi paŋ liɣiri so sani, bɛ je ni bɛ yo li, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyɛla bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ka tiri pini.
en: The wicked borrow and dont pay it back, but the righteous are generous and giving.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ bindira maa zali ŋun daa guli bɛ nɛma sani, ka guui ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni chaŋ ti puh o biɛyanim maa.
en: David left his things with an attendant and ran to the front line. When he arrived, he asked how his brothers were doing.

dag: Yi na bi bɔhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sochandiba? Yi bi saɣi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Haven't you talked with people who travel? Don't you know the reports they bring back?.

dag: Di zaa yoli Lɛvinim bɛn tinsi dina, yiya shɛŋa din be bɛ ni su fɔntin shɛŋa ni, bɛn Lɛvinim maa ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛlikam.
en: But about the cities of the Levites: The Levites can buy back at any time their houses in the cities that belong to them.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ niŋgbuna ni paɣibu kal la m-paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: Why do your followers not obey the traditions we have from our great leaders who lived long ago? Your followers dont wash their hands before they eat.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa man yɛligu ku yiɣisi.
en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will certainly not pass away.

dag: O ni daa paai Rom na, o daa bo n shee ni nimmoo hal ti nya ma.
en: No, he was not ashamed. When he came to Rome, he looked and looked for me until he found me.

dag: Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.

dag: Di ŋmariya ʒiri ka mali n yuli pɔri pɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi dihi yi Naawuni yuli vi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not swear falsely by my name, desecrating your Gods name in doing so; I am the LORD.

dag: Chɛ ka ti me dubil tam ti yil ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka bo garo mini teebuli ni kuɣa ni firila zali di ni, o yi ti lan ka ti sanna ka o kpe nimaani.
en: Please, lets make a little room on the roof for him. Lets put a bed in this room and a table, a chair, and a lampstand. Then when he comes to our house, he can have this room for himself.

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli kul ni beni sahakam. Yawɛ, a niriba kul ni mi a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi niŋ yɛda ka bi biɛhim, pa n ni niŋ fiig tia ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko ka yi ni niŋ, amaa hal yi yi yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ ti lu teeku ni ha, di ni niŋ lala.
en: Jesus responded, I assure you that if you have faith and dont doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree. You will even say to this mountain, Be lifted up and thrown into the lake. And it will happen.

dag: N tiŋ kasi maa ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun dɔɣi ka bi wolisi.
en: Before she was in labor, she gave birth. Before her pangs came upon her, she delivered a boy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord gave Moses.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti niŋ yuun shɛŋa, ka Ijipti naa maa daa kpi. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul be bɛ dabitim maa ni fabinda, ka kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka bɛ dabitim ni kuhigu maa daa paai Naawuni.
en: After the death of the king of Egypt, the Israelites still complained because they were forced to be slaves. They cried out for help.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni ka gahim kuɣ polipoli diba anu n-niŋ o piɛgul koligu ni, ka o kuɣilɔŋ be o nuu ni ka o vu m-miri Filistia doo maa ha.
en: He took his shepherd's stick and then picked up five smooth stones from the stream and put them in his bag. With his sling ready, he went out to meet Goliath.

dag: amaa chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu nyɛla binshɛli din be yi suhuri ni, ka pa ni din saɣinda. Dina n-nyɛ tarimtali mini suhumahili, dama dimbɔŋɔnima m-mali buchi pam Naawuni sani.
en: Instead, make yourselves beautiful on the inside, in your hearts, with the enduring quality of a gentle, peaceful spirit. This type of beauty is very precious in Gods eyes.

dag: A ŋmanila kom din bi do baalim, a mi ku gari sokam, dama a daa zaŋ a ba paɣ dɔni o bindoo zuɣu n-ta li daɣiri. A daa dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: But your passion was like a flood you couldnt control. So you will not remain my most honored son. You climbed into your fathers bed and slept with one of his wives. You brought shame to my bed, to the bed you lay on.

dag: Ohola ni daa kul nyɛ m paɣa maa zaa yoli, o daa na kul tumdila pagɔrisigu tuma. O kɔre daa kul bela o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim.
en: Although she was mine, Oholah continued to be a prostitute and was full of lust for her lovers from Assyria.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa sabi zaligu ŋɔ ti Lɛvi bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka nyɛ bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord .

dag: Zaŋmiya dari mali sara maligu bimbini maa, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu. Malimiya li kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Make the altar like an empty box with the sides made from boards. Make the altar just as I showed you on the mountain.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Alizin birigu maa kul luhir o la waawaayili; ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni ni o di o nyɛvili. Ka a yi ni tooi sɔŋ ti, nyin zom ti nambɔɣu sɔŋ ti.
en: The demon has often tried to kill him by throwing him into a fire or into water. Please have pity and help us if you can.

dag: Amaa n ni zo Juda zuliya nambɔɣu. Ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni fa ba bahi. M bi yɛn zaŋ tɔbiri bee takɔbi bee yuri bee wɔribariba fa ba bahi.
en: But I will show mercy to the nation of Judah. I will save them, but I will not use bows or swords or war horses and soldiers to save them. I will save them by my own power. .

dag: A chɛ ka ti lu zana ni, ka a zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒil ti.
en: You let us fall into a trap and placed heavy burdens on our backs.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi ti dɔɣirikpamba bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la zuliya ni na. Ka Masia gba yila bɛ zuliya maa ni na o daadamtali puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa ŋɔ simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbibi ŋariŋtuurisi daa yi bɛ ŋarima ni na. Ka kpatoonsi mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa bɛn be teeku ni du nti ʒe duli.
en: Every ship is deserted; rowers and sailors and captains all stand on shore.

dag: Ka a ti yihi kpa shɛli din zaa be naɣilaa maa binnyɔri ni mini binsaba ni yaannina mini kpam din be di ni n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then take all the fat that covers the inner organs, the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys along with the fat that is on them, and burn them up in smoke on the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka Izraɛlnim gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka di leei alikauli din kul ni beni sahakam shihirili.
en: The people of Israel are to keep this day as a sign of the covenant.

dag: Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ti, o ni zaŋ ti tahi tiŋgban shɛli din vuhiri maa ni nti zaŋ li ti ti.
en: It is a land filled with many good things. If the Lord is pleased with us, he will lead us into that land. And he will give that land to us.

dag: bɛ na ʒi n-di ka guui binshɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daazichi ku zani yuui.
en: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Ti kulimi n yiŋa ka n ti niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di, ka n ti a yɔri.
en: Then the king said to the man of God, Please come home with me. Come and eat with me. I will give you a gift.

dag: O daa deei bɛ yɛligu hal ti dolila Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab bia Jɔram ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa la chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad nti tuhi Siria naa Hazaɛl. Ka Sirianim maa daa ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: Ahaziah was following their advice when he went with Israels King Joram, Ahabs son, to fight against Arams King Hazael at Ramoth-gilead, where the Arameans wounded Joram.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɔhiri taba kum ni neebu maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: They obeyed his order, but among themselves they started discussing the matter, What does this rising from death mean.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri zabili nyɛla ŋun yuri alahichi. Ŋun me dunɔbia din du pam nyɛla ŋun bɔri kɔb kaba.
en: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.

dag: Ŋuna m-booi booli pa teeku kom zuɣu luɣ shɛli neesim mini zibisim ni chirigi taba.
en: He divided light from darkness by a circle drawn on the face of the sea.

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka yɛli fiig tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Then the trees said to the fig tree, Come and be our king.

dag: N zaŋdi buni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ma, ka chɛ ka bɛ daazichi duri paana.
en: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.

dag: Bɛ sani binshɛli din nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ bin jɛmdili la zomla bɛn bɛn bi niŋ yɛda maa nina, ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku nya lahibal suŋ la neesim din kahigiri Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋmaŋ ŋmahinli ŋɔ jilima wuhiri la.
en: The god of this age has blinded the minds of those who dont have faith so they couldnt see the light of the gospel that reveals Christs glory. Christ is the image of God.

dag: Bɛ daa zab Musa nyuli bɛ sansan ni, ka zab Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ kasi la gba nyuli.
en: There in the desert they were jealous of Moses and of Aaron, the Lord 's holy servant.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Sool daa yiɣisi bo tɔbutuhiri biinsi niriba tusaata Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ Zif mɔɣu ni ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee Zif mɔɣu maa ni.
en: So Saul got up and went down to the Ziph wilderness to look for David there. He had three thousand handpicked soldiers from Israel with him.

dag: ka bo wain lita yini ni pirigili din nyɛ binnyura sara shɛli din ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: together with pints of wine. The odor of these sacrifices is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Mbusim yi tahi kum libigirili na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali la nya wahala, o maani ba la ansarisi.
en: Is it God who laughs when a disaster kills innocent people?.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Izraɛlnima, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la deebu niŋ yi baɣaka hal ni wayo?.
en: So Joshua said to the Israelites, Why do you wait so long to take your land? The Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given this land to you.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira zaa ni ti gbani n-jɛm o; bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni ni ti gban o tooni, ka n ti beni sahakam.
en: Indeed, all the earths powerful will worship him; all who are descending to the dust will kneel before him; my being also lives for him.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi ŋubi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din nyɛ kasi zaa. Naawuni zaŋ li mi tin ya ni yi yihi niriba maa taali ni ka mali bɛ taali ni yibu maa sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ zaa ha daa gbaai bɛ daliri ni nyɛ shɛm wuhibu. Ŋun daŋ tooni daa yɛlila tumo maa, N dala puu, ka yɛn chaŋ ti nya li, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: One guest after another started making excuses. The first one said, I bought some land, and I've got to look it over. Please excuse me.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi nyuri bara yi suhuri ni yi yab ni nyɛ Ibrahimma la zuɣu; dama n yɛri ya mi ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi zaŋ kuɣa ŋɔ nam ninsalinima, ka bɛ leei Ibrahimma zuliya.
en: And don't start telling yourselves that you belong to Abraham's family. I tell you that God can turn these stones into children for Abraham.

dag: Dama wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n niriba ka mbusim ŋɔ tatabo paai ba? Bee wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n dɔɣiriba ka bɛ kuri ba.
en: I am begging the king because I could not bear to see these terrible things happen to my people. I could not bear to see my family killed.

dag: A dabili Dauda zuɣu, di zaɣis a ni pii na so ŋɔ.
en: For the sake of your servant David, dont reject your chosen king.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-ni tooi wuhi n daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n yi tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda?.
en: Can any of you prove that I am guilty of sin? If I tell the truth, why dont you believe me?.

dag: Wain kalinsi zuɣu chɛ ka niriba doli soya kumda, ka suhupiɛlli kam naai, ka dunia ŋɔ suhupiɛlli zo;.
en: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, We're out of wine.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kurigi, bɛ na kul ni wandi wala; ka mali sum, ka bɛ vari kul nyɛ vamaha.
en: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni kari zuliya shɛb zaa bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ bahi, ka yi ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ gari ya tinsi su.
en: Then, when you go into the land, the Lord will force all those other nations out. You will take the land from nations that are larger and more powerful than you.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpaai kom bahina; ka saa daa tahira, ka a saa nyaɣisibu piɛma nyaɣisiri gindi luɣilikam zaa.
en: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ni Gomna Fɛstus ni bɛn zaa daa ʒi bɛ sani yiɣisi yi.
en: King Agrippa, Governor Festus, Bernice, and all the people sitting with them stood up.

dag: amaa Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa zaɣisi Naawuni ni zali ba shɛm, ka bɛn daa bi deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani.
en: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law rejected God's purpose for themselves and refused to be baptized by John.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim ka a min a yiko Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kpe a vuhim shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a maligumaaniba ŋɔ nya tiliginsim, ka chɛ ka bɛn ʒe a yim mali suhupiɛlli a ninvuɣ suntali puuni.
en: And now go, LORD God, to your resting place, you and your mighty chest. May your priests, LORD God, be clothed with salvation; may those loyal to you rejoice in what is good.

dag: N dimnim zaa maani ma la ansarisi, ka n ʒiʒiinitab kaɣiri ma, ka n leei binzɔrigu bɛnkam mi ma sani; ka bɛnkam mi nya ma sol ni guurimi ka chɛri ma.
en: All my enemies, and especially my neighbors, treat me with contempt. Those who know me are afraid of me; when they see me in the street, they run away.

dag: nti chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni nimaani ka o leei Izraɛlnim naa, ka yi piɛb kikaa ka yɛli, Naawuni dolimi Naa Sulemaana nyɛvili.
en: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet will anoint him to be the new king of Israel. Blow the trumpet and announce, This is the new king, Solomon.

dag: Ka o daa yooi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga maa, ka nyɔhi yi di ni na kaman buɣim daaŋkpa tital ni buɣim nyɔhi la, ka di nyɔhi maa daa sabigi wuntaŋ mini zuɣusaa zaa.
en: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.

dag: Bɛ yurilim mini bɛ jɛlinsi ni bɛ nyuli zabbu zaa ku lan beni, ka bɛn nuu kul ku lan be yɛl shɛlikam zaa niŋbu ni dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: After people are dead, their love, hate, and jealousy are all gone. And they will never again share in what happens on earth.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, Di ku lan yuui ka n kpi, amaa Naawuni ni be yi sani, ka ti zaŋ ya labisi yi yaannim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni yaha.
en: Then Jacob said to Joseph, As you see, I am about to die, but God will be with you and will take you back to the land of your ancestors.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka a min a bidibisi maa kpe yi duu ka yo yimaŋ niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ kpam maa m-boori niŋdi ŋmana maa ni; ŋman yini yi ti pali, ka yi vuui li zali kpaŋa.
en: Then go in and close the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all those containers. Set each one aside when its full.

dag: Ka bi shɛb a ni yɛn dɔɣi ka bɛ doli bɛ nyaaŋa n-yɛn nyɛ a bihi. Bɛ biɛyanim maa yuya ka bɛ ti yɛn zaŋ nya bɛ tarili.
en: Your family who is born to you after them are yours, but their inheritance will be determined under their brothers names.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Izraɛl tampiŋ la yɛli ma: So yi doli yɛlimaŋli soli n-su o niriba, ka su ba ni Naawuni zɔbo.
en: The God of Israel has spoken; the protector of Israel said to me: The king who rules with justice, who rules in obedience to God.

dag: A yɛm n-chɛ ka wubiga pa zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka teeg o kpiŋkpama kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ?.
en: Did you teach the hawk how to spread its wings and fly south ?.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kuli nti di ka nyu, ka niŋ shɛli tari, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa baŋ bɛ ni karim shɛli n-wuhi ba maa gbinni la zuɣu.
en: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them.

dag: O bi labir o nini kpaŋ ka chɛri wuntizɔriba, amaa o zaŋdi ba mi ʒiini bɛ nanim sani bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi, ka niriba duhiri ba sahakam.
en: He protects those who are righteous; he allows them to rule like kings and lets them be honored forever.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri piniyini ka bɛ boon o Shɛbat la biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti man Anabi Zakaria Bɛrɛkia bia ŋun nyɛ Iddo yaaŋa la.
en: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month in the second year of Darius, the LORDs word came to Zechariah the prophet, Berechiahs son and Iddos grandson.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ kurimbuni Naawuni. Ŋuna n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ zaa. Di bi wumd o, o mi bi gbarigira. So mi ku tooi baŋ o tɛha.
en: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kpa duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni; luɣ shɛli a ni daa yɛli, N yuli ni be nimaani la. Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ n nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deemi n suhigu.
en: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun niŋdi sokam zaa zaɣ viɛlli, ka zɔri o ni nam binshɛɣukam zaa nambɔɣu.
en: He is good to everyone and has compassion on all he made.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Yisa nyaandoliba maa ansarisi yɛra, Bɛ nyula dam kuli.
en: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, They are drunk.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti ŋmaligi labi n sanna ka doli n zaligunima, ka tumdi di tuma, n ni lan labisi ya luɣ shɛli n ni pii zali ni di nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la na, hal yi yi kul wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ tarisi luɣ shɛlikam zaa ha.
en: But if you return to me and keep my commandments by really doing them, then, even though your outcasts live under distant skies, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place that I have chosen as a dwelling for my name.

dag: Ka Sintani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ zahinda la daa chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin chɛ ka kuɣa ŋɔ leei bindirigu ka a di.
en: The tempter came to him and said, Since you are Gods Son, command these stones to become bread.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ o nuu pa paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa zuɣu, ka niriba maa daa lan nab pahi ka niŋ yaa.
en: Because the midwives were God-fearing, God was good to them and gave them families of their own. And the Israelites continued to increase and become strong.

dag: ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam, ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: The stars will fall, and the powers in the sky will be shaken.

dag: O daa lan mali bintamdisi, ka mali taha tam di zuɣu.
en: the stands and the small bowls.

dag: A ni ti nya suhupiɛlli ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, ka niriba pam gba suhuri ti paligi bia maa dɔɣibu zuɣu;.
en: You will be very happy, and many others will share your joy over his birth.

dag: Taai Naa Hiram n-daa bo sida mini sipirɛs dari ni salim shɛli Naa Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o zaŋ tum o tuma maa ti o. Ka Sulemaana mi daa zaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntinsi pisi ti Naa Hiram.
en: Later, Solomon gave King Hiram of Tyre towns in the region of Galilee to repay him for the cedar, pine, and gold he had given Solomon.

dag: Dauda daa lan zali Lɛvi kpamba maa ni bɛ bom bɛ daŋ maa ni baansi mini biŋkumdiŋmɛriba bɛn ni tooi ŋme biŋkumda pampam, kaman mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa din ni chɛ ka suhupiɛlli biŋkumda beni.
en: Then David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint some of their relatives as singers to raise their voices joyfully, accompanied by musical instruments, including harps, lyres, and cymbals.

dag: amaa Masia ŋun daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba san la o ni nyɛ Naawuni Bia la zuɣu. Ka ti gba nyɛla o niriba, tinim dee yi kul mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ ti ni mali tahima shɛl la naani hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi, ka piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ sɔɣi gbaag o salo ni ka o sani saha shɛli.
en: He agreed. Then he waited for the best time to hand him over to them. He wanted to do it when no one was around to see it.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yi Abinɛr karibu maa yɔɣu labina nti laɣim Dauda tɔbbihi maa zali ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ pisiyinika daa kani m-pahi Asahɛl zuɣu.
en: When Joab gave up the chase, he gathered all his men and found that nineteen of them were missing, in addition to Asahel.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibiya wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni pun wuhi ya ti waazu yihibu ni mini ti ni sab gban shɛŋa tin ya la puuni la.
en: So then, our friends, stand firm and hold on to those truths which we taught you, both in our preaching and in our letter.

dag: Di saha yɛlimaŋtali ni ti be tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka wuntitali mi ti be tiŋgban shɛli din vuhir ni.
en: That is, what is now a desert will be filled with right decisions, and what is now a farmland will be filled with justice.

dag: Hal Juda ni daa kul mali kpiɔŋ gar o mabihi maa zaa, ka nabia lan yi o zuliya ni na maa zaa yoli, Yisifu n-daa kul nyɛ dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: It was the tribe of Judah, however, that became the strongest and provided a ruler for all the tribes.

dag: Di saha ka Mariama yɛli malaika maa, N na ʒi doo. Ka wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: Then Mary said to the angel, How will this happen since I havent had sexual relations with a man.
