dag: Saha yuusim wula ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn fabili? Ka saha yuusim wula ka luɣilikam mɔri yɛn kuui? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri zuɣu chɛ ka biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi zaa kpira; ka din pahi nyɛla, niriba yɛra, O nini bi nyari ti ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: How long will the land mourn and the grass in the fields dry up? The animals and birds are swept away due to the evil of those in the land. The people say, God doesnt see what were up to.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi; bɛ ni ŋun daa pɔri mini tɔbbihi kɔbiga daa saɣimi, ka ŋun daa gari bɛ zaa mi mini tɔbbihi tuhili daa saɣi.
en: Some of these men from the tribe of Gad were senior officers in command of a thousand men, and others were junior officers in command of a hundred.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔri ni bɛ nya a.
en: Someone said to Jesus, Your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to see you.

dag: Amaa n ni ti teei n ni daa lo a alikauli shɛli a bipolitali saha la yɛla, ka lan lo a alikauli shɛli din ku naai.
en: But I will honor the covenant I made with you when you were young, and I will make a covenant with you that will last forever.

dag: Ka Jɔshua tuumba maa daa kpa zoya maa polo nti be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn daa biɛhi bɛ naba la ti lab kuli; dama bɛ daa vihimi m-bo ba sol ni zaa ka bi nya ba.
en: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ nanim maa zaa, ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔna maa yim, dama ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa tuhi ti bɛn Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Joshua captured all these cities and their kings in one series of battles. He did this because the Lord , the God of Israel, was fighting for Israel.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa yɛli, Ŋun ni tooi chaŋ ti liri Kiriatisɛfanima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa, n ni zaŋ m bipuɣiŋga Akisa ti o paɣ pini.
en: One of them, called Caleb, said, I will give my daughter Achsah in marriage to the man who succeeds in capturing Kiriath Sepher.

dag: Yɛnnim ni nya jilima, amaa tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni di vi.
en: The way the wise live will bring them honor, but the way fools live will bring them shame.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti nya ka ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali galisi pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha zaa kul nyɛla din bie sahakam.
en: The Lord saw how bad the people on earth were and that everything they thought and planned was evil.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa piligi ŋ-ŋmaari Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ bahira. Hazaɛl daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be bɛ tintarisi tinsi la ni zaa.
en: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila nudirigu polo n-chaŋ gili hal ti paai nuzaa polo n-kul chani gindi hal ti paai di piligu shee yaha.
en: The wind blows to the south, goes around to the north; around and around blows the wind; the wind returns to its rounds again.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Hur daa chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli maa zuɣu.
en: Joshua obeyed Moses and went to fight the Amalekites the next day. At the same time Moses, Aaron, and Hur went to the top of the hill.

dag: O daa zaŋla Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni niriba tuhili pa omaŋ zuɣu na. Ka Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool daŋ niriba tumtumda la daa zaŋ o bidibisi pinaanu min o tumtumdiba pisi n-zo n-daŋ naa tooni chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: He had with him a thousand men from the tribe of Benjamin. And Ziba, the servant of Saul's family, also came with his fifteen sons and twenty servants, and they arrived at the Jordan before the king.

dag: Yawɛ be katiŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa o deeri wuntizɔriba suhigu.
en: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.

dag: Ka naa daa bah o bia Jɛramiil mini Aziriɛl bia Sɛraya ni Abidiil bia Shɛlɛmia noli ni bɛ gbaam Baruk ŋun nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa mini anabi Jɛrimia na. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba sɔɣi.
en: Then he ordered Prince Jerahmeel, together with Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to arrest me and my secretary Baruch. But the Lord had hidden us.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi nayili pu shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Manasseh died and was buried with his ancestors. He was buried in the garden at his house. It was called the Garden of Uzza. His son Amon became the new king after him.

dag: M puhir a a ni deei n suhigu ka leei n tiligira ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I thank you because you answered me, because you were my saving help.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali Jɔshua shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o ŋmaai Juda zuliya la tiŋgbani yaɣ shɛli polo bɛ ni booni Hiburɔn la ti Jɛfune bia Kalɛb. Kiriatariba, di gbinni nyɛla Hiburɔn.
en: In agreement with the LORDs command to him, Joshua gave a portion among the Judahites to Caleb, Jephunnehs son. It was Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron .

dag: O daa niŋ lala la o ni daa zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu kaman kom paɣ li m-mal li ka di be kasi la puuni.
en: He did this to make her holy by washing her in a bath of water with the word.

dag: Naa maa daa yɛli ba, Man Naa Ahasivɛrɔs n-tim nayili bihi Napaɣ Vashiti sani nti yɛl o yɛligu ka o zaɣisi n noli! Ka wula ka zaligu lee wuhi ni ti niŋm o.
en: He said to these men, I, King Xerxes, sent my servants to Queen Vashti with a command, and she refused to obey it! What does the law say that we should do with her.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ ba jila yi suhuri ni, ka yi ti ku zani ni yi tɛhi pɔi ka naanyi garigi;.
en: Don't worry about what you will say to defend yourselves.

dag: ni man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai yiya ŋɔ nima mini di niriba kaman kundi maa puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam zaa, ka Juda naa karim li maa.
en: Josiah, I am the Lord ! And I will see to it that this country and everyone living in it will be destroyed. It will happen just as this book says.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi chaŋ Rama m-mali lala hal ti paai Taai fɔŋ din nyɛ bɛ ni me birini gili shɛl la. Ka lan ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ hal ni Hɔsa m-mali lala hal ti paai di tariga Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Ka Mahalab mini Akizib.
en: Then the border went back south to Ramah. It continued to the strong city of Tyre. Then the border turned and went to Hosah. It ended at the sea, near Aczib.

dag: Nyin daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahigu! Tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa anahi bahigu saha paaya.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed.

dag: Ka o daa kpe n-chaŋ ti zan o dan Ilaisha tooni, ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Gɛhaazi, ya polo ka a lee chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: Gehazi went in and stood in front of Elisha, who asked, Gehazi, where have you been? Nowhere, sir, Gehazi answered.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ ti tooni chaŋ Troas nti gul ti.
en: They went ahead and waited for us in Troas.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ŋmanila asiba paɣili bee maligim din kpahi lu bi to la bee bɛ ni yɛli kabɔɣili ni wurigu shɛli bahi la bee nyɔhi din yiri takɔro ni la.
en: Therefore, they will be like the morning mist, like the dew that passes away early, like husks that swirl from the threshing floor, or like smoke from a window.

dag: Ka n daa wum ninvuɣ so kukoli ka di yi Ulai Mɔɣili la ni na m-booni yɛra, Gabirɛl, wuhim o o ni nya shɛli maa gbinni.
en: I then heard a human voice coming out of the center of the Ulai canal. It called out: Gabriel, help this person understand what he has seen.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: After John's messengers had gone, Jesus began speaking to the crowds about John: What kind of person did you go out to the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Nyama, a biɛli Ɛlizabɛt so bɛ ni yi booni paɣiŋoo la gba mali pua o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; di chira ayɔbu m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: Remember your relative Elizabeth. It is said that she cannot have children, but she herself is now six months pregnant, even though she is very old.

dag: bee n-zo nandan nambɔɣu o saria karibu ni o ni nyɛ nandan zuɣu.
en: Do not show partiality to a poor person at his trial.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm. Naa ni tooi niŋ o ni bɔr shɛm, dinzuɣu o tooni zanibu yi ti mali barina, nyin zom yomyom.
en: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.

dag: Jɛrigu bi bɔri tɛhi zilima, amaa ka naɣ wuhirila omaŋmaŋ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.

dag: Amaa yinim Izraɛl zoya, yi ni teei wula n-wali yi wala ti n niriba Izraɛlnima. Dama di ku yuui, bɛ ni kuna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But on the mountains of Israel the trees will again grow leaves and bear fruit for you, my people Israel. You are going to come home soon.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisiri neesim la, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn bi mili di soya ka bi ʒe di soya zuɣu la.
en: They rebel against light, dont acknowledge its direction, dont dwell in its paths.

dag: Ka niriba daa nya o, ka bo nachimba pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ kana ti be o sani.
en: When the Philistines saw him, they sent thirty young men to stay with him.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti kpɛri n jɛmbu duu, bɛna n-ni ti kani n sara maligu bimbini gbini na nti tumdi n tuma, ka doli n zaligunima.
en: They will come into my sanctuary, and they will approach my table to minister to me. They will keep my charge.

dag: Yi ni ti lan ko yi wain tihi puri Samaria zoya zuɣu. Ka bɛn ti sa tihi maa ni ti di di wala.
en: Once again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria, and those who plant them will eat what the vineyards produce.

dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda daa di nam n-sula Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: David son of Jesse ruled over all Israel.

dag: Di yi zahira ni daɣiri tuma be yi sunsuuni, hal ka di tatabo ka chɛfirinim sunsuuni gba; dina n-nyɛ ni yi ni so zaŋ o ba paɣa dɔni.
en: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Filistianim ni doli dimdi din bi naara mini nia biɛri din be bɛ suhuri ni n-ku niriba la zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: The Philistines tried to get even. They were very cruel. They let their anger burn inside them too long.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ti naba bari zaana, o nini yi tiɣi ti soli;.
en: The Lord shows us how we should live, and he is pleased when he sees people living that way.

dag: lala zuɣu ka man daa zo a dabiɛm, ka zaŋ a pɔŋ tuhili maa ti pi tiŋgban ni; dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a bini.
en: So I was afraid. And I hid my valuable coin in the ground. Here, you have whats yours.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ laɣimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la na nti tuhi deei tiŋ maa amaŋmaŋa, di yi pa lala n yi tuhi deei tiŋ maa, bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli bol li.
en: Now gather the rest of your forces, attack the city and take it yourself. I don't want to get the credit for capturing it.

dag: ka di yi ti lan puhi situra maa ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli maa ni yaha, di yɛligirimi maa, yin zaŋmiya dɔro maa ni be binshɛli ni maa nyo buɣim.
en: But the mildew might come back to that piece of leather or cloth. If that happens, the mildew is spreading, and the object must be burned.

dag: Ŋunkam maani o kpee ansarisi nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm, amaa yɛndana ŋun kul shinila o noli.
en: Stupid people say bad things about their neighbors. Wise people know to be quiet.

dag: Di saha, ti ku lan ŋmalig a sani zo yaha, tim ti nyɛvili, ka ti jɛmd a!.
en: Then we will never leave you. Let us live, and we will worship you.

dag: Ɛzɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan mini Zaavan ni Akan.
en: Ezer's sons were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

dag: Zanimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa zaani n-tɔɣisi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ti ba. Zabimi bɛn ka yaa yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Speak up for people who cannot speak for themselves. Help people who are in trouble.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la n-garita.
en: Some people told him that Jesus from Nazareth was passing by.

dag: ka bɛ ti yihi tuuba niŋbu mini alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu ŋun Masia yul ni n-ti zuliya kam zaa, ka di piligu shee mi yɛn nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ nti kpa luɣilikam.
en: You saw these things happen—you are witnesses. You must go and tell people that they must change and turn to God, which will bring them his forgiveness. You must start from Jerusalem and tell this message in my name to the people of all nations.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa di nam ʒila Pɛriʒianim tinzuɣu din yuli daa booni Susa la. O daa di nam maa n-sula tiŋgbana kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Ŋuna n-daa su India tiŋgbɔŋ zaŋ hal ni Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: King Xerxes of Persia lived in his capital city of Susa and ruled provinces from India to Ethiopia.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri yi zuɣu la yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni vuui n ni zaŋ n suhuyiɣisili binnyuri shɛli tin ya la. Yi ku lan nyu li n suhuyiɣisili pipia maa ni n-chani laana.
en: Your God is the one who fights for his people. He is your Lord GOD, and he says to you, Look, I am taking this cup of poison away from you. It is full of my anger, and I am taking it out of your hand. You will not be punished by my anger again.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ vuui yomyom kaman kɔzɔrim la; ka chɛ ka bɛ no n-taai ba kaman sol zuɣu mɔri la ka bɛ kpi.
en: Let them dissolve like water flowing away. When they bend the bow, let their arrows be like headless shafts.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba kuhigu, wummiya bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu kuhigu, dama Yawɛ saɣindi bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord 's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ ni so bee bɛ dɔɣiriba yi shihi kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi bee bɛ yi gomi chaŋ katiŋa, bɛ ni tooi puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.

dag: Naawuni, a wuntitali zaŋmi hal ti paai sagbana ni. Nyini n-tum tuun kara ŋɔ. Ŋuni n-lee be kaman nyini?.
en: God, your goodness reaches far above the skies. You have done wonderful things. God, there is no one like you.

dag: Azigad daŋ — tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pisinaayi.
en: the descendants of Azgad:.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa na nti laɣisi bɛ ni ku shɛb maa kɔba m-pahi di zuɣu.
en: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from Jabesh Gilead and buried them with the bodies of the seven men who were hanged.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl min o bia Bɛnhadad kul tuhiri nyandi ba waawaayili.
en: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.

dag: Elɔn mi kalinsi yaaŋa, Hilliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la bia Abidɔn n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: After Elon died, a man named Abdon son of Hillel was a judge for the Israelites. Abdon was from the city of Pirathon.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa ti kurigi ka o dabisa pali ka o kpi. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛl o ni daa kpi maa.
en: Jehoiada became old. He had a very long life, and he died when he was years old.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa tim ti boli Ɛliab bihi, Datan mini Abiram. Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ku kana.
en: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they said, We will not come!.

dag: Ziɔnnima, di zɔriya dabiɛm! Nyamiya! Yi naa bari bumbil kani yi sanna.
en: Do not be afraid, people of Zion ! Look! Your king is coming. He is riding on a young donkey. Zechariah :.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi salo maa naai ka o kɔŋko chaŋ ti du zoli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o kɔŋko na kul be nimaani.
en: After Jesus said goodbye to the people, he went up into the hills by himself to pray. It was late, and he was there alone.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kɔr biɛri tuma min a ni daa be a zaɣim a mamanim sani a pagɔrisigu tuma tumbu ni ni a buɣ shɛŋa din chihiri min a ni daa zaŋ a bihi ʒim mali ba la.
en: You chased after lovers, then took off your clothes and had sex. You even worshiped disgusting idols and sacrificed your own children as offerings to them.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so cheechinim zaa ni luri sizuura o lahibal suŋ molo molibu zuɣu la n-dolisir o na.
en: We are sending the brother who is famous in all the churches because of his work for the gospel along with him.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, tinim kul yɛn maanila alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa ka boori kom bahir o. A tɛhiya ni ti ni daa maani maha, ka niŋd o kɔtomsi niŋdi di ni, ka boori kom bahir o la, ti yidaannim nuu daa ka di ni.
en: And the women added, Do you think that we burn incense to the queen of heaven and pour drink offerings to her without our husbands support when we make cakes in her image and pour drink offerings to her.

dag: Niriba kul pɔrila pɔri, ka ŋmari ʒiri, ka kuri niriba, ka zura, ka niŋdi zina. Bɛ baɣa lan ka shɛlikam ni, kubu n-naɣ kul beni.
en: They make promises and break them; they lie, murder, steal, and commit adultery. Crimes increase, and there is one murder after another.

dag: Di saha o ni suhi Naawuni ka o deeg o suhigu, ka o ni tooi chaŋ Naawuni tooni ni suhupiɛlli, ka Naawuni ti o wuntia tuma maa laara.
en: when they pray, God will answer; they will worship God with joy; God will set things right for them again.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa luɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: Use acacia wood and make braces for the frames of the Holy Tent. There should be five braces for the first side of the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bia Jɔnatan min o tumtumdiba zaa ni bɛ kum Dauda. Amaa o bia Jɔnatan daa yuri Dauda yɛla pam.
en: Saul ordered his son Jonathan and all his servants to kill David, but Jonathan, Sauls son, liked David very much.

dag: Chɛli n ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bipalital ni la taali. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli min a nirilim zuɣu, teemi n yɛla!.
en: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, mali yaa anfaan shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi mi Yawɛ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛ bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli, bɛ mi bi mi ni o laɣim ba mi kaman kabɔba ka bɛ lo n-sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni la.
en: They have their plans, but they dont know what the Lord is planning. He brought them here for a special purpose. They will be crushed like grain on a threshing floor.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa be yiliguliba dundɔŋ la ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o.
en: The LORDs word came to Jeremiah when he was still confined to the prison quarters.

dag: Dama Ayuba yɛliya, N ka taali, ka Naawuni mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.

dag: O yi je suli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? O suhi yi yiɣisi pam, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi beni? O suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka tampima wurind o zuɣu.
en: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na ti zali di zaashee Dauda ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni. Ka Dauda daa mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: The LORDs chest was brought in and put in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it. Then David offered entirely burned offerings in the LORDs presence in addition to well-being sacrifices.

dag: Dinzuɣu tuma ŋɔ fukumsi ni ʒi ti zuɣu Naawuni nambɔzɔbo puuni ŋɔ zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti bi gbarigira.
en: This is why we dont get discouraged, given that we received this ministry in the same way that we received Gods mercy.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni o ni ʒi a puu atam labina ti sɔŋ a kabɔɣili ni?.
en: Do you expect him to bring in your harvest and gather the grain from your threshing place?.

dag: Ŋuna ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Juda naa Amɔn bia Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pinaata saha la.
en: The Lord spoke to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year that Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah.

dag: ka yɛl o, N dana, di zaŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ taali bee n-lan teei n ni daa tum gala shɛm dahin shɛli nyini n dan ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm n-zɔrila yɛla. Naa, di zaŋ li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: He said, Your Majesty, I beg you not to punish me! Please, forget what I did when you were leaving Jerusalem. Don't even think about it.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua.
en: and they had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

dag: Dama n loya ni n niŋla tiŋ ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu ka pa ni zaɣ viɛlli. N ni ti zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord , have spoken. *.

dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka Babilɔnnim bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim mini bɛn tahiri damli dambu na, ka nyɛ bɛn chani gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa ni bɛ tuhi fa yiya din pa bɛ dini ŋɔ nya yaa.
en: I am bringing the Babylonians to power, those fierce, restless people. They are marching out across the world to conquer other lands.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim bɛ nyaandoliba mini Hɛrɔd nyaanzaaniba o sani; ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti mi ni a nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛra, ka wuhiri Naawuni soli ni yɛlimaŋli, ka bi zɔri sal kam nini, dama a bi zɔri niriba nini bɛ ni ʒe zaashe shɛŋa ni zuɣu.
en: They sent some of their followers and some of Herod's followers to say to him, Teacher, we know that you are honest. You teach the truth about what God wants people to do. And you treat everyone with the same respect, no matter who they are.

dag: Di saha n ni ti taɣi niriba yɛtɔɣa ka di leei alali yɛtɔɣa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaa ti laɣim booni Yawɛ yuli n-jɛmd o ni naŋgban yini.
en: Then I will change people from other nations so that they can speak the language clearly and call out the name of the Lord . They will all worship me together, shoulder to shoulder, as one people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii kpamba cheechi kam puuni ti ba, ka daa lo noli n-suhi ti Duuma ka zaŋ ba niŋ Naawuni so bɛ ni niŋ yɛda maa nuu ni.
en: In each church they appointed elders, and with prayers and fasting they commended them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni chɛ ka n ni niŋ n tɔbbi shɛb naani, ka mali ba nyuri bara la tuhi n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu.
en: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.

dag: Bɛ yɛrila Naawuni, Zom ka chɛ ti! Ti bi bɔri ni ti baŋ a soli.
en: They say to God, Leave us alone! We dont care what you want us to do.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ be kasi bɛ Naawuni sani ka miri ka bɛ dihi bɛ Naawuni yuli vi; dama bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn zaŋdi bɛ Naawuni bindira n-nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ, dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛ be kasi.
en: He must be holy and must not disgrace my name. He offers food offerings to me, and he must be holy.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi, ti niŋ yɛda ni ti min o ni lan laɣim mali nyɛvili.
en: Since we have died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.

dag: Yi tumdila yi ba tuma. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti pala dagɔribihi; ti malila ba yino, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: You are doing what your father did. God himself is the only Father we have, they answered, and we are his true children.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, man Nɛbukadnɛza paɣiri alizanda Naa, ka tir o jilima; ka tibigir o. O ni tumdi shɛlikam zaa nyɛla din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli, ka o ni tooi siɣisi ŋunkam mali karimbaani.
en: That's why I say: Praise and honor the King who rules from heaven! Everything he does is honest and fair, and he can shatter the power of those who are proud.

dag: Amaa yinim ka la Ziɔn Zoli mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ tiŋ din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm m-be alizanda ni la ni malaikanim bɛn ka kalinli suhupiɛlli laɣiŋgu ni na;.
en: But you have drawn near to Mount Zion, the city of the living God, heavenly Jerusalem, to countless angels in a festival gathering.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: Jesus then warned them, Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanu dali din daa nyɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu puhi kaai biɛɣu dal la, ka Izraɛlnim daa yi Ramɛsis n-chani nasara dibu chandi Ijiptinim zaa ninni.
en: On the th day of the first month, they left Rameses. That morning after Passover, the Israelites marched out of Egypt with their arms raised in victory. All the people of Egypt saw them.

dag: ni Ifidɛya ni Pɛnuɛl mi daa nyɛ Shashak bidibisi.
en: Iphdeiah, and Penuel.

dag: Ishimail daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin, ka naanyi kpi m-pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: Ishmael lived to the age of . He took his last breath and died, and was placed with his ancestors.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa yina tuhi Sisɛra soli yɛl o, N dana, ŋmaligim kpe kpe na, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa ŋmaligi kpe o sani tanti maa ni; ka paɣ maa ti zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, Come in, sir, come in here. Dont be afraid. So he went with her into the tent, and she hid him under a blanket.

dag: Ka o daa mooni molo yɛra, Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n ti damd o tooni gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi.
en: John also told the people, Someone more powerful is going to come. And I am not good enough even to stoop down and untie his sandals.

dag: ni Ɛgilɔn naa ni Gɛza naa.
en: Eglon, Gezer.

dag: Din yɛn niŋ maa shihirili m-bɔŋɔ: Yuuni ŋɔ mini yuuni din pahir ayi puuni, dimiya bindir shɛŋa din niŋ di toli be mɔɣu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi ko m-biri ka sa wain tihi yuuni din pah ata puuni n-kpuɣi di daatam di.
en: Now this will be the sign for you, Hezekiah: This year you will eat what grows by itself. Next year you will eat what grows from that. But in the third year, plant seed and harvest it; plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

dag: Bidɔɣirisurigu tam bɛ yɛla, ka zunzuya di ba ka bɛ nyaɣisa; ka so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla; dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛtali lurimi kaman tia la.
en: Not even their mothers remember them now; they are eaten by worms and destroyed like fallen trees.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ti a jilima. Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ putɔɣunim ni lu a sizuura.
en: That is why powerful nations will honor you. Powerful people from strong cities will fear you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: After they listened to Paul, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni o daanfaani zuɣu, ka leeg o falidiriba zaŋ chaŋ nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima niŋbu la polo.
en: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a pala ŋun pun nyɛ ti naa la, ka lan niŋ ti kaman ti pun pala a niriba la.
en: You treat us as though you had never been our ruler, as though we had never been your people.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ʒin o yiŋa ka Yawɛ ti o vuhim o dimnim bɛn daa gil o zaa sani.
en: After King David moved into his new house the Lord gave him some relief from all of his enemies around him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ yi ti yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ ni yɛli paɣ ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ teer o yɛla.
en: Now, I assure you that wherever the gospel is preached all over the world, what she has done will be told in memory of her.

dag: tarimtali ni maŋgbibbutali. Ka zaligu shɛli kani din galindi dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.

dag: Yurilim maa nyɛla ni ti doli Naawuni zaligunima. Ka o zaligu maa dolibu nyɛla ni ti yum taba kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm piligu ni la.
en: This is love: that we live according to his commands. This is the command that you heard from the beginning: live in love.

dag: Ka n ti bahi yi fɔntinsi yoli, ka chɛ ka yi jɛmbu shɛhi leei dabari, ka m baɣa ku lan be yi binyɛra din nyom viɛl ni.
en: I will destroy your cities. I will make your holy places empty. I will stop smelling your offerings.

dag: M ba Dauda daa lo o suhu ni ni o ni me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: And Solomon continued, My father David planned to build a temple for the worship of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: Ka yi yi di wahala ka di yuui biɛla, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ anfaanizaalana ka boli ya ni yi mini Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima din ka bahigu la maŋmaŋ chɛ ka yi nya din simdi ya sɔŋbu zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ʒe yim, ka tin ya yiko mini kpiɔŋ.
en: But after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who calls you to share his eternal glory in union with Christ, will himself perfect you and give you firmness, strength, and a sure foundation.

dag: Ka di daa bi niŋ Ibrahimma nyaɣisim, dama o gba daa nyɛla o bia.
en: This upset Abraham very much. He was worried about his son Ishmael.

dag: Ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛli yɛli, Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab Naa la n-zaŋ ma Siria wulimpuhili polo zoya ni tiŋ la ni na nti yɛli ma: Kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu ti ma. Wuhim ni Izraɛlnim simdi tibidarigibo.
en: Balaam said: King Balak of Moab brought me from the hills of Syria to curse Israel and announce its doom.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa chɛ o kɔchuɣu zali nimaani ka lab fɔŋ ni ti yɛli niriba.
en: Then the woman left her water jar and went back to town. She told the people there.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi ni jɛm ma, di zaa ni leeg a dini.
en: Therefore, if you will worship me, it will all be yours.

dag: Amaa n daa ŋmanila piɛ tarim so bɛ ni zaŋ chaŋ ni bɛ ti kɔrigi. N daa bi baŋ ni mani ka bɛ lɔri nia biɛɣu maa yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti ŋmaai tia maa mini di wala luhi. Chɛliya ka ti yih o dunia ni, ka so ku lan teeg o yuli yɛla.
en: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.

dag: Saɣimi ti Naawuni, ka tim sandaani niŋ o, ka bin viɛla lan ka a sanna.
en: Now, Job, give yourself to God and make peace with him. Do this, and you will get many good things.

dag: Ka yuri daa balisira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma tɔri tiŋ yɔri vuri.
en: Then the horses hooves pounded with the galloping, galloping of their stallions.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛ zaa.
en: He said, I assure you that this poor widow has put in more than them all.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Darius ka ti sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tira. Naawuni ti ma suhudoo zaa!.
en: To Emperor Darius, may you rule in peace.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiri ya, N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be yomayoma ka pa Naawuni ŋun be katiŋ gba.
en: The LORD declares, Am I a God who is only nearby and not far off?.

dag: Amaa ka kɔnyuri daa wum ba pam nimaani, ka bɛ ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka a yihi ti Ijipti na ni kɔnyuri ti ku ti mini ti bihi ni ti biŋkɔbiri.
en: But the people were thirsty and kept on complaining, Moses, did you bring us out of Egypt just to let us and our families and our animals die of thirst.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ bia, ka di zuɣulaannim diri ka nyuri yuŋ hal ka biɛɣ ti neera; mbusim be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: It is very bad for a country if the king is like a child. And it is very bad for a country if its rulers use all their time eating.

dag: Ŋmɛnditoya kana ti bela tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zoya zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ tɔbu n-lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam; ka so ku tiligi.
en: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.

dag: Naawuni, guli ma; dama a sani ka n sɔɣi.
en: Protect me, O God; I trust in you for safety.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka o lu n-kpi nimaani Naawuni tooni, o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.

dag: Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam, ka bɛ yɛli, Nyama, nanima ayi bi tooi nyaŋ o, ka wula ka tinim ni tooi nyaŋ o.
en: But the rulers and leaders of Jezreel were very afraid. They said, The two kings could not stop Jehu. So we cannot stop him either.

dag: O daa ti lan ku Ijipti do viɛl so gba. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni, amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa kpani maa o nuu ni n-zaŋ omaŋmaŋ kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: He also killed a giant Egyptian who had a spear in his hand. Benaiah went against him armed with a staff. He grabbed the spear out of the Egyptians hand and killed him with his own spear.

dag: Ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam, dama yɛtɔɣa maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ tuhi piapia ti Dauda, ka zaŋla tuhilituhili ti m mi, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ka pa ni n nam ŋɔ ka o yɛn deei.
en: Saul did not like this, and he became very angry. He said, For David they claim tens of thousands, but only thousands for me. They will be making him king next.

dag: Dunɔguliba maa daa ʒiɛla luɣ anahi zuɣu, wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa ni nudirigu polo.
en: There was a gate facing in each direction, north, south, east, and west, and each had a chief guard.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa nya Ilaija, o daa bɔh o mi, Nyin ŋun nahindi Izraɛlnim maa m-bala.
en: and when he saw him, Ahab shouted, There you are, the biggest troublemaker in Israel.

dag: O daa zaŋla o bipalitab la ni daa wuh o shɛm la yɛli ba. O daa yɛli ba mi: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisa, amaa man ni ʒili ya ʒi tibisa gari lala. M ba daa malila barazim saɣisiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi saɣisiri ya.
en: as the younger men had advised. He said, My father placed heavy burdens on you; I will make them even heavier. He beat you with whips; I'll flog you with bullwhips.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ti yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Salo pam yi Ɛdom kanna ni bɛ ti lir a, bɛ yila teekubil duli yaɣ din la polo kanna, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela Hazazɔntarima.
en: Jehoshaphat was told, A large army from beyond the sea, from Edom, is coming to attack you. They are already at Hazazon-tamar! .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ʒiishee la tooni n-jɛmd o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ o jɛmbu duu puuni maa; ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee mahim kul ni luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: That is why they stand before God's throne and serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will protect them with his presence.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Samsin zuɣu na pam, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Ashikɛlɔn ti ku ninvuɣ pihita, ka di bɛ nɛma na nti zaŋ bɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa baŋ ŋahili maa gbinni maa; ka daa je suli pam ŋ-ŋmaligi kul o ba yiŋa.
en: Suddenly the power of the Lord made him strong, and he went down to Ashkelon, where he killed thirty men, stripped them, and gave their fine clothes to the men who had solved the riddle. After that, he went back home, furious about what had happened.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pa Anabi Musa n-daa tin ya bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa; amaa m Ba n-tiri ya bindiri maŋli din yiri alizanda ni na maa.
en: I am telling you the truth, Jesus said. What Moses gave you was not the bread from heaven; it is my Father who gives you the real bread from heaven.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ni goli ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali yiliyidan kam ŋun bom piɛbila o min o malibu zuɣu, ka yili kam ti mali piɛbila.
en: This command is for the whole community of Israel: On the tenth day of this month each man must get one lamb for the people in his house.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ daba ayi ha, n ni lan labisi Ɛlamnim nyamma ti ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But in the days to come I will bring back the captives of Elam, declares the LORD.

dag: Di saha Pita daa ʒila maligumaaniba zuɣulana Kaiafas yiŋ maa dundɔŋ ni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋ bipuɣin so ti kana.
en: Peter was still down in the courtyard when one of the High Priest's servant women came by.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri ti anzansi ka kpaŋsiri ti suhuri ŋɔ chɛ ka yi doli Yisa Masia ka mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.

dag: Ka o kul zaɣisira, amaa di nyaaŋa ka o ti yɛli o suhu ni, Wun ni m bi zɔri Naawuni ka mi bi lihiri nyari daadam kam ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: For a while the judge refused to do anything. Finally, he said to himself, Even though I don't fear God or care about people.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku tooi su niriba, bee m-bariti niriba zana.
en: There would be nothing that nations could do to keep godless oppressors from ruling them.

dag: Dama n wumla kuhigu kaman paɣa n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la. Ka di biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn tuui dɔɣi la. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi vuhibu ka kuhira, ka teeg o nuhi ka yɛra, Mbusim paai ma! N tarigiri lurila bɛn yɛn ku ma tooni. .
en: I heard a cry, like a woman in labor, a scream like a woman bearing her first child. It was the cry of Jerusalem gasping for breath, stretching out her hand and saying, I am doomed! They are coming to kill me.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ma ʒili m ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka me yili ti ma kaman o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la zuɣu, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku Adɔnija zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Now, as surely as the LORD lives—the one who supported me, put me on the throne of my father David, and provided a royal house for me exactly as he promised—Adonijah will be executed today.

dag: Siɣisimiya yimaŋ ti Duuma sani, ka o duhi ya.
en: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ yɛndaan so daa be tiŋ maa ni ka kuhi yɛl ba na, Wummiya! Wummiya! Yɛlimiya Jɔab ni o kana ka n ti yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: There was a wise woman in the city who shouted from the wall, Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come here; I want to speak with him.

dag: N ni di bɛ nɛma ʒi li chaŋ, ka liri luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yoli, ka niriba be di ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi zuliya shɛb ni na, ka mali niɣi mini nɛma, ka nyɛ bɛn be tiŋgbani maa ni ŋɔ.
en: to take plunder and seize loot, to use my power against the resettled waste places, against a people gathered from the nations, who are acquiring goods and cattle, and who live at the center of the earth.

dag: Bɛ daa mali karimbaani, ka tum din chihiri n sani ka n nya li, dinzuɣu ka n daa ku ba.
en: They became haughty and did detestable things in front of me, and I turned away from them as soon as I saw it.

dag: Ka Zilipa daa lan dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu pahi.
en: Zilpah gave birth to another son.

dag: Doo ŋɔ daa bɔhim ti Duuma soli yɛla pam. O ni daa jɛmdi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisiri ka wuhiri Yisa yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga, amaa kulla Jɔn Baptaizira kom baptaizibu la yɛla kɔŋko ka o daa mi.
en: He had been instructed in the Way of the Lord, and with great enthusiasm he proclaimed and taught correctly the facts about Jesus. However, he knew only the baptism of John.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli soli be katiŋa ka chɛ ti, ka din tuhi mi ku tooi miri ti. Yɛlimaŋli tuui niriba laɣiŋgu shee soli zuɣu, ka biɛhigu din tuhi kɔŋ kpɛhili shee nimaani.
en: Justice is driven away, and right cannot come near. Truth stumbles in the public square, and honesty finds no place there.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun yuri yɛm, amaa bɛn je ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ galimi nyɛla jɛra.
en: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.

dag: Ti Duuma kul yɛn zaɣisi ti mi pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani ka kul ku lan niŋ ti nirilim sahakam?.
en: Will my Lord reject me forever? Will he never be pleased again?.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuɣusaa duri maa daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi, dama folinsi maa daa di palo pam zuɣusaa n-gari sunsuuni mini tiŋ duri la.
en: The rooms at the upper level of the building were narrower than those at the middle and lower levels because they were set further back.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti ninvuɣ shɛba yi ninni, ka yi yuli ba soli ka yi nina ti fulim dindali maa zaa, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.

dag: Bɛ ŋari n soli, ka luhi ma, ka bi bɔri so sɔŋsim.
en: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: The soldiers took Jesus to Golgotha, which means Place of a Skull.

dag: Amaa teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, dama ŋuna n-niŋdi ya yiko ka yi nyari buni maa ni di chɛ ka o pal o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la kaman o ni niŋdi shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Remember that it is the Lord your God who gives you the power to become rich. He does this because he is still faithful today to the covenant that he made with your ancestors.

dag: ni Adaya ni Bɛraya ni Shimirat daa nyɛla Shimɛi bidibisi.
en: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa laɣim lu Musa mini Aduna zuɣu saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa polo nya ka sagbani pun sirigina ti pani di zuɣu, ka Yawɛ jilima neesim neei.
en: When the community assembled against Moses and Aaron, they turned toward the meeting tent. At that moment the cloud covered it, and the LORDs glory appeared.

dag: Di biɛɣu pia nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa.
en: At the end of ten days, the message from the Lord came to Jeremiah.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Joab and his soldiers attacked the Arameans, and the Arameans ran from them.

dag: O daa piila bunyama kɔbisiyi mini bulahi pisi ni piɛnyama kɔbisiyi mini piɛlahi pisi.
en: He took female goats and male goats, female sheep and male sheep.

dag: Ʒii shɛli gbinni bɛ ni daa kahigi wuh a zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni min asiba sara maligu shɛŋa yɛla polo la nyɛla din ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli. Amaa lee gbib li ashilɔni, dama di ni yɛn niŋ pali saha shɛli maa na wɔɣ pam.
en: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.

dag: Ti Naawuni la kanna, o mi bi fo, ka buɣim din diri ni nimmoo be o tooni, ka sanʒiɛ titali ʒiɛri gind o.
en: Our God is coming and will not keep quiet. Fire burns in front of him. There is a great storm around him.

dag: A tumd alahiziba tuma tiri kpiimba? Kpiimba ni tooi yiɣisi zani paɣ a?.
en: Do you perform miracles for the dead? Do they rise up and praise you?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Oholiba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka a ni ŋmalig a mamanim shɛb sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili la suhuri yiɣisi bahi a zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ yi luɣilikam na ti lir a.
en: Now then, Oholibah, this is what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to you. You are tired of those lovers, but I will make them angry with you and bring them to surround you.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun wum ni Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka o zaŋ tuuni ŋɔ ti ma ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu.
en: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, di zɔri ba bee n-zɔri bɛ yɛtɔɣa dabiɛm. Hal di yi nyɛla suligunyinyari bee gɔhi gil a, ka a be nɔnsi sunsuuni, nyin di zɔri bɛ yɛtɔɣa bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: But you, mortal man, must not be afraid of them or of anything they say. They will defy and despise you; it will be like living among scorpions. Still, don't be afraid of those rebels or of anything they say.

dag: Ka yi gba be biɛr yoli n-gari yi yaannim maa ni daa be shɛm maa. Yinim m-bɔŋɔ: yi zaɣ yino kam niŋla tipawumli n-doli zaɣ biɛɣu soli, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu.
en: And you, you have acted worse than your ancestors, each of you following your own willful, evil hearts and paying no attention to me.

dag: Ka ti daa kpe Adiramitium ŋarin shɛli din daa yɛn yiɣisi doli yi Ɛsha tinsi din ʒi m-baɣi teeku nol la polo; ka Masidɔnia do so ŋun daa yi Tɛsalɔnaika na ka o yuli booni Aristakus la daa biɛl ti.
en: We boarded a ship from Adramyttium that was about to sail for ports along the coast of the province of Asia. So we put out to sea. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, came with us.

dag: M bɔri ni yi yi yɛla muɣisigu puuni. Ŋun ka paɣa baɣa bela ti Duuma yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o nini;.
en: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.

dag: mini naɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu.
en: , cattle.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam binshɛɣukam, ka binshɛli daa kani ka o nam li ka Yɛligu maa nuu ka di ni.
en: Everything was made through him, and nothing was made without him.

dag: Ninkur teempiɛla be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn kurigi gar a ba.
en: The old, gray-haired men agree with us. People older than your father are on our side.

dag: Ka pɔhim daa muɣisi ti ka ti kul chani biɛlabiɛla n-niŋ dabisa shɛm hal ti miri Kɛnaidus, ka ti ni daa tuhi pɔhim zuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ doli Kriit teeku noli polo n-chaŋ ti baɣisi Salimɔne gari.
en: After many days of slow and difficult sailing, we arrived off the coast of Cnidus. The wind wouldnt allow us to go farther, so we sailed under the shelter of Crete off Salmone.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka mahim tirisi yaɣi dunɔdura shɛŋa Ahaz ni daa me la dura pia zuɣu lab nyaaŋa. Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri tirisi lab nyaaŋa dunɔdura pia maa.
en: once the shadow cast by the sun descends on the steps of Ahaz, I will make it back up ten steps. And the sun went back ten of the steps that it had already descended.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi yɛli teeku ni di nyuuma. N ni chɛ ka yi mɔɣa kom nyuui.
en: who says to the ocean depths, Dry up; I will dry your streams.

dag: Bɛna n-daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni din la n-leei ti dini.
en: All of them said, We'll take God's valuable land.

dag: Shɛb yi nya azichi, nyin di chɛ ka di yɛla muɣis a, hal bɛ yinsi daazichi maa yi kul zoori pahiri gba.
en: Dont be afraid of people just because they are rich. Dont be afraid of people just because they have big, fancy houses.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti kpe li ka di zaɣi kpi, di ni dii bi ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But when the sun came up, it burned the young plants; and because the roots had not grown deep enough, the plants soon dried up.

dag: ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Hɔrinim nanima kaman bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan, and they lived in the land of Seir.

dag: Tin shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari dunia zaa lu n-dahim. Babilɔn leela tin shɛli din yɛla mali zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: Babylon was called The Hammer of the Whole Earth. But now the Hammer is shattered. Babylon is the most ruined of the nations.

dag: Daadam yi kpi o ni lan tooi be? Amaa n kul ni guhi n ni tumdi tuma dabisi shɛŋa ŋɔ ni zaa hal ti nya faako.
en: If a man dies, can he come back to life? But I will wait for better times, wait till this time of trouble is ended.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nahiri tintarisi vulɔnima, ka fari biŋkɔbbaligu n-zaŋdi ba chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri bɛmaŋmaŋ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: People move property lines to get more land; they steal sheep and put them with their own flocks.

dag: O kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam zoori kpɛri tab ni, ka niŋgbuŋ maa zaa kpe n-saɣisi tab ni di tuɣili kam shee. Ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam yi tumdi di tuma viɛnyɛliŋga kaman di ni simdi ni di tumdi shɛm, niŋgbuŋ maa zaa zoorimi yurilim puuni.
en: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love.

dag: Ka yi ni zaŋ yi bimbɔba maa na ti mali gahibu sara vuhim dabisi shɛli dali maa neei biɛɣu, yin kalimiya dabisa hal ti paai bakɔi ayopɔin dɛde.
en: From that Sunday morning , count seven weeks.

dag: Yɛlim Ziɔnnima, Nyamiya! Yi naa kani yi sanna. O nyɛla maŋsiɣisibulana, ka bari buŋ min o bia.
en: Announce to the people of Jerusalem: Your king is coming to you! He is humble and rides on a donkey. He comes on the colt of a donkey. .

dag: A mini Ɛdomnim daa niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni a nɛma din galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋdi tɛkɔisi mini binʒiɛhi ni bɛ ni wuɣi situr shɛŋa ni tampiɛl viɛla ni kɔral ni rubinim na ti taɣiri yi nɛma maa.
en: Aram was your agent for many products. They traded turquoise, purple cloth, colorful brocades, linen, coral, and rubies for your wares.

dag: Dinzuɣu doo maa ni daa yɛli Bɔaz ni o dam li maa, o daa pirigila o namdili ti Bɔaz.
en: So when the close relative said to Boaz, You buy the land, he took off his sandal and gave it to Boaz.

dag: Bɛn zaa be n san la puhir a. Puhimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri ti daadiini soli zaŋ chaŋ yɛda niŋbu ni la ti ma. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni!.
en: Everyone with me greets you; greet those who love us faithfully. Grace be with all of you.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be zilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Dont be like some senseless horse or mule, whose movement must be controlled with a bit and a bridle. Dont be anything like that!.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam binshɛɣukam, ka binshɛli daa kani ka o nam li ka Yɛligu maa nuu ka di ni.
en: Everything came into being through the Word, and without the Word nothing came into being. What came into being.

dag: Bom sipirɛs dari din mali kpiɔŋ mali ŋariŋ, ka niŋ duri niŋ di ni, ka bo diɣiri n-tabilitabili di puuni mini di nyaaŋa.
en: so make a wooden ark. Make the ark with nesting places and cover it inside and out with tar.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl kalinsi nyaaŋa Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia la mini Abiata n-daa zan o zaani. Ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ naa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma.
en: Jehoiada and Abiathar later took Ahithophels place as the kings counselor. Jehoiada was Benaiahs son. Joab was the commander of the kings army.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei bintɔɣu, ka daai wuntia luhi tiŋa!.
en: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin mi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi pɔhim ni, ka kukol shɛli daa yi jɛmbu duu nam ʒiishee la na n-tahiri pampam yɛra, Di naaya.
en: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, It's done.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dɔɣi bihi n-nabi ka yɛligi pam, ka mali yaa m-pali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: the people of Israel became so numerous that the whole region of Goshen was full of them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a yihi li bɛ nuhi maa ni n-zaŋ li pahi sara shɛli din yɛn nyo buɣim maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Ka doo kam ŋun bi guni, bɛn yihim o o daŋ ni, o ni bi gbibi n daalikauli maa zuɣu.
en: Any male who has not been circumcised will no longer be considered one of my people, because he has not kept the covenant with me.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma bahi. N Naawuni, di be ma katiŋa!.
en: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.

dag: ka daa lan mali kɔniŋdi bini ni naɣilahi pinaayi shɛb zuɣu di ni daa tamya la.
en: one Sea; twelve oxen beneath the Sea.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum paɣ maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o darigi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka doli gooni maa zuɣu garita. Ka niriba nya o ka o yɛla buɣu ka di be o binyɛrigu tiŋli.
en: When the king heard the womans words, he tore his clothes to show he was upset. As he passed by on the wall, the people saw the king was wearing the rough cloth under his clothes to show he was sad and upset.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa yi zaani Musa tooni n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa kaman nir ni tɔɣisir o zo yɛtɔɣa shɛm la. Musa daa yi ti yi suɣili maa ni n-labi sansani maa ni, o sɔŋda Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia, ka nyɛ nachimbil la n-daa yi kpalindi be suɣili maa ni.
en: In this way the LORD used to speak to Moses face-to-face, like two people talking to each other. Then Moses would come back to the camp. But his young assistant Joshua, Nuns son, wouldnt leave the tent.

dag: Zaligu shɛli din gbibi niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so daɣiri ni yibu saha zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: the following regulations about the ritual purification of those of you cured of a dreaded skin disease. On the day you are to be pronounced clean, you shall be brought to the priest.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul zɔrimi, ka nyaandol ŋun maa daa zo ŋ-ŋma Pita zuɣu daŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: They were running together, but the other disciple ran faster than Peter and was the first to arrive at the tomb.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal bɛ ni ti fa tɔbbihi daba, ka fa na biɛɣu ni di neen shɛŋa. N ni tuhi yi mini bɛn tuhira, ka fa yi bihi bahi.
en: Here is the Lord s answer: The prisoners will escape. Those captured by the strong soldier will be set free. Thats because I will fight your battles, and I will save your children.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni paɣi ma. Hal yɔbahi mini taatahi gba ni paɣi ma, dama n ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni n-ti n ni pii ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: The wild animals will thank me. The large animals and birds will honor me when I put water in the desert and make rivers flow through that dry land. I will do this to give water to my chosen people.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a ʒe katiŋa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a sɔɣ amaŋ yɛlimuɣisira saha?.
en: Why are you so far away, O Lord ? Why do you hide yourself when we are in trouble?.

dag: Amaa Rɛhɔbɔam daa sula Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tinsi ni la kɔŋko.
en: But Rehoboam still ruled over the Israelites who lived in the cities of Judah.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, so baɣa kani bee m-baŋdi din tahi lala na. Amaa bɛ yi kpi, bɛ yila zaɣ biɛɣu ni kpe suhudoo ni.
en: The righteous person perishes, and no one takes it to heart. Loyal people are gathered together, and no one understands that because of evil the righteous one passed away.

dag: Amaa nir yi daag o kpee luhi, ka di pala o dima n-nyɛ o bee n-zaŋ binshɛli lab o kpee ka di pala o dɔnimi gu o.
en: You might accidentally kill someone, maybe by pushing or by accidentally hitting them with a tool or weapon.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Zanimi piɛgul zaani n-gul piɛ shɛb bɛ ni yɛn ku ŋɔ.
en: The Lord my God said to me, Act the part of the shepherd of a flock of sheep that are going to be butchered.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa m-me bimbini zali Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa, ka booi wain mini kpam bahi di zuɣu ti Naawuni.
en: Jacob set up a large rock, so that he would remember what had happened there. Then he poured wine and olive oil on the rock to show that it was dedicated to God.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli puuni Ishimail ni daa zaŋ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa niŋ maa daa nyɛla kɔbil titali shɛli Naa Asa ni daa gbi n-gu omaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛl Naa Baasha la. Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ti pali kɔbiliga maa.
en: The well into which Ishmael threw the bodies of the men he had killed was the large one that King Asa had dug when he was being attacked by King Baasha of Israel. Ishmael filled the well with the bodies.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka Ashidɔdnim daŋ yiɣisibu n-nya ka buɣili Dagɔn lu m-pilila o puli zuɣu Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi buɣili Dagɔn n-lan zal o zaashee.
en: Early the next morning the people of Ashdod saw that the statue of Dagon had fallen face downward on the ground in front of the Lord 's Covenant Box. So they lifted it up and put it back in its place.

dag: O darigiri deera, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu o soli? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi maa.
en: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?.

dag: Bum ansarisimaana, ka bɛn bi mi bɔhim yɛm, kpahimi bɛn mali baŋsim zuɣu ni, ka bɛ nya baŋsim pahi.
en: Strike someone who scoffs, and a naive person will become clever; correct someone with understanding, and they will gain knowledge.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni ti dee li su n-ʒini di ni ka yɛli, Ti ni bo naa ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam bɛn gil ti ŋɔ ni mali nanim shɛm.
en: After you have taken possession of the land that the Lord your God is going to give you and have settled there, then you will decide you need a king like all the nations around you.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: Why, then, do you look at the speck in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the log in your own eye?.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ʒi tibisa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, o ni sɔŋ ya; o kul ku chɛ wuntizɔra bahi.
en: Leave your troubles with the Lord , and he will defend you; he never lets honest people be defeated.

dag: Vinvamli din yuli booni Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ? Bɔzuɣu ka tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa tam mɔpila zuɣu puhiri chuɣu?.
en: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba. Naawuni mi daa bi yɛli malaika so: Man Naawuni ni leeg a Ba, ka a mi leegi m Bia.
en: God has never said to any of the angels, You are my Son, because today I have become your Father! Neither has God said to any of them, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son.

dag: Yisa daa ti be soli n-chani Jɛrusalɛm ka daa ti zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi la yi kpaŋa nti yɛli ba.
en: Jesus was going to Jerusalem. His twelve followers were with him. While they were walking, he gathered the followers together and spoke to them privately. He said to them.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali sania balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ karili mini zaɣ bila yi kola ni.
en: Don't try to cheat people by having two sets of weights or measures, one to get more when you are buying, and the other to give less when you are selling.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ni bɛ bari zana gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa puuni.
en: They were trying to find a way to catch Jesus saying something wrong.

dag: hal a ni kul mi ni n ka taali, ka so kani ŋun ni tooi fa ma a nuu ni bahi maa zaa yoli?.
en: You know that I am not guilty, that no one can save me from you.

dag: Kɔbiliga ni kul gbibi di kom shɛm, lala ka Jɛrusalɛm nim gbibi bɛ tuumbiɛri. Duŋtaabo mini ninvuɣ kubo yɛla ka n kul wumdi di puuni; dɔriti mini dansi ka n nini kul nyara.
en: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.

dag: Tuhimi yɛda tɔbu la tuhiri suŋ; gbib nyɛvili din ka bahigu shɛli zuɣu Naawuni ni daa bol a, ka a niŋ shɛhira suŋ ka kahigi di yɛla wuhi shɛhiranim pam san la.
en: Compete in the good fight of faith. Grab hold of eternal life—you were called to it, and you made a good confession of it in the presence of many witnesses.

dag: Tɛha maa ni daa be bɛ suhuri ni saha shɛli maa ka Yisa baŋ li ka dii bɔhi ba, Wula ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: Jesus immediately recognized what they were discussing, and he said to them, Why do you fill your minds with these questions?.

dag: Amaa n yɛlila yinima: N ni zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔn maa tin ya, ka yi di li fali n-su li. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun woligi ya ka chɛ zuliya shɛba.
en: But I have told you that you will get their land. I will give their land to you. It will be your land! It is a land filled with many good things. I am the Lord your God. I have treated you differently from other people.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, pahimiya o niriba zuɣu paɣ o. Dama o ni bɔhi biɛri o daba ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka bɔhi o dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je o tibili ka mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di viɛl ti o niriba.
en: Nations, you must praise the Lord 's people— he punishes all who kill them. He takes revenge on his enemies and forgives the sins of his people.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ, amaa yalim yi niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha.
en: Salt is good. But if salt loses its flavor, how will it become salty again?.

dag: Amaa lee chɛliya di tigbirigu din firi tiŋ la, ka bo kurigu mini daanya zoligo vil li n-chɛ li niŋ mɔɣu ni mo maha ni. Chɛliya ka maligim lu dilan zuɣu, ka chɛ ka o mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni tihi laɣim be.
en: But leave its deepest root in the earth, bound with iron and bronze in the field grass. Dew from heaven is to wash it, and it must live with the animals in the earths vegetation.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba n-daa nyɛ: Ziha daŋ niriba mini Hasufa daŋ niriba ni Tabayɔt daŋ niriba.
en: The temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth, Keros, Sia, Padon.

dag: Bɛ ku di vi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu ni, ka kum yi ti lu, bɛ ni mali bindira pam.
en: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.

dag: Yuri, chamiya tooni, chɛchɛbunsi, bilimmiya yomyom! Chɛ ka tɔbbihi cham tooni. Itiɔpianim mini Libianim n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi ka Lidianim mi nyɛ peentɔriba.
en: Horse soldiers, charge into battle. Chariot drivers, drive fast. March on, brave soldiers. Soldiers from Cush and Put, carry your shields. Soldiers from Lydia, use your bows.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pia saha shɛli din daa nyɛ Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was also the eighteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia.

dag: Zɔntuhi daa kul gilila di luɣilikam, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili.
en: The porch was cubits wide and cubits long.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɛri ŋma n-saɣim a jɛmbu duu maa ni da shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi la.
en: It looked like axes raised against a thicket of trees.

dag: Sirianim daa ti chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka gbaai bipuɣimbil so kuli ka o ti tumdi tuma sɔŋdi Naaman paɣa.
en: One day while the Syrian troops were raiding Israel, they captured a girl, and she became a servant of Naaman's wife.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a tiligira la yɛliya, N suhu n-daa yiɣisi pam saha biɛla puuni, ka n chɛ a bahi. Amaa n yurilim din bi naari la zuɣu, n ni zo a nambɔɣu.
en: I was so angry that for a while I did not want to see you. But now I want to comfort you with kindness forever. The Lord your Savior said this.

dag: Naa Dairus nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ti anabi Zakaria, gol so ŋun pah awɛi la daba anahi dali.
en: In the fourth year that Darius was emperor, on the fourth day of the ninth month , the Lord gave me a message.

dag: Shallum mini Akub ni Talimɔn ni Ahiman ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa nyɛ dunɔguliba .
en: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, and Ahiman. Their brother Shallum was the leader.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi ti ŋmaai bɔrɔbɔro suɣ ʒiɛri n-zaŋ ti so, ŋuna m-bala. Ka daa ŋmaai bɔrɔbɔro suɣ ʒiɛri n-zaŋ ti Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la.
en: Jesus answered, I will dip some bread in the sauce and give it to him; he is the man. So he took a piece of bread, dipped it, and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

dag: ka o yɛl o dɔɣira maa, Naomi ŋun yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la mali tiŋgbani din nyɛ ti dɔɣira Ɛlimɛlɛk dini m-bɔri ni o kɔhi li.
en: he said to the man: Naomi has come back from Moab and is selling the land that belonged to her husband Elimelech.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bimbihili gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni. Dina n-daa nyɛ Musa tarili maligumaana leebu piɛlaa maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Moses took the breast and lifted it to show he had presented it to the Lord . It was Moses share of the ram for appointing the priests. This was just as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: N kul ni niŋdi n ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka bɛn yɛli ni ti mini ba dolila so yini n-tumdi la ku nya daliri nyu bara.
en: I will go on doing what I am doing now, in order to keep those other apostles from having any reason for boasting and saying that they work in the same way that we do.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ daadam kam ni, ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi ninkura ti zahim zahima; ka yi nachimba mi ti nya ʒii.
en: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.

dag: hal ka a ninvuɣ biɛtali ti yi palo? Pumpɔŋɔ a nyɛla Ɛdomnim mini Filistianim ni bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba ni maani ninvuɣ so ansarisi, ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: before your wickedness was exposed. You are now the reproach of all the daughters of Edom and all those around her, including the daughters of the Philistines. They mock you on every side.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya sani. Wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm ka kana ti tiligi ti!.
en: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh! Wake up your power! Come to save us!.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N yɛn leela ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A shiri ni tooi niŋ o naŋgban malisim, cham ti niŋ lala, a ni di nasara. .
en: I'll make Ahab's prophets lie to him. Good! the Lord replied. Now go and do it. You will be successful.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga saha shɛli bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o bia Yisahaku maa.
en: Abraham was years old when his son Isaac was born.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be adaka maa luɣa ni la ni n-kpuɣiri li.
en: Put the poles through the rings on the corners of the Box. Use these poles to carry the Box.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum li, ka kari a daba saria, ka zaŋ taali maa galimi ʒili bɛn tum taali maa, ka bahi bɛn ka taali, ka ti ba laara bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: Listen from heaven and decide who is right. Then punish the guilty person and let the innocent one go free.

dag: Teem a nuu zuɣusaa tirina. Yihim ma kom din galisi pam ŋɔ ni tiligi ma. Tiligim ma tinzunnim nuu ni.
en: Reach down from above, pull me out of the deep water, and rescue me; save me from the power of foreigners.

dag: Dandiɛɣu n-daa mali o bipuɣinsi ayi, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Tim ti, tim ti. Bina pam beni n-nyɛ din bi tiɣira. Di puuni diba anahi din kpɛm pam n-nyɛ:.
en: Greedy people know only two things : Give me, and Give me. There are three other things that are never satisfied—really, four things that never have enough:.

dag: A daa ku ba Ɛndo, ka bɛ niŋgbuna dɔni tiŋgban ni ti pooi.
en: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛlikam maa zaa gbinni; di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi baŋ di gbinni maa.
en: But the disciples did not understand any of these things; the meaning of the words was hidden from them, and they did not know what Jesus was talking about.

dag: Sulemaana daa yuri Yawɛ, ka dol o ba Dauda ni daa zal o shɛm, o daa naɣ maanila sara maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: Solomon loved the Lord and followed the instructions of his father David, but he also slaughtered animals and offered them as sacrifices on various altars.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa yɛr o bia Iso maa, ka Ribɛka beni wumda. Dinzuɣu saha shɛli Iso ni daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti ku nimdi maa na, ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o bia Yaakubu.
en: Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau went out to the field to hunt game to bring back.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni, o daa gbahila ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pihitanaayi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In Nebuchadnezzars th year as king of Babylon, people were taken from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka doo ŋɔ lee yɛli ŋɔ? O mali yiko ka su fukumsi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: They all were amazed and kept saying to each other, What kind of teaching is this? He has power to order evil spirits out of people.

dag: Jɔab min o mabia Abishai ni daa ku Abinɛr shɛm m-bala. O ni daa ku bɛ mabia Asahɛl Gibiɔn tɔb la ni zuɣu.
en: Joab and his brother Abishai killed Abner because he had killed their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.

dag: Miriya ka yi zɔri ba, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ka be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm.
en: Dont dread these nations because the LORD your God, the great and awesome God, is with you and among you. .

dag: Ka n daa yɛli nanim mini zuɣulaannim ni niriba bɛn pahi, Tuma maa galisiya ka di shɛhi wɔɣ ni taba, ka ti woliwoli taba gooni maa gbini.
en: I told the people and their officials and leaders, The work is spread out over such a distance that we are widely separated from one another on the wall.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Wurimmiya Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ, ka n lan labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: Jesus answered, Tear down this Temple, and in three days I will build it again.

dag: Di saha maa Filistianim maa daa chaŋmi ti tuhi Rɛfaim tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli ni la nima, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.

dag: Yaɣimɛr ka yiko ni o zaŋ yaɣ kpil yini me duɣ shɛli din ni ku buchi zama ni, ka lan zaŋ li me duɣ shɛli din ku yi zama ni?.
en: Doesnt the potter have the power over the clay to make one pot for special purposes and another for garbage from the same lump of clay?.

dag: Bɛ ku di vi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu ni, ka kum yi ti lu, bɛ ni mali bindira pam.
en: They wont be ashamed in troubling times, and in a period of famine they will eat their fill.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka shiri zaŋ Keenannim maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni; ka bɛ daa ku ba ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Hɔrima.
en: The LORD heard the voice of Israel and handed the Canaanites over. They completely destroyed them and their cities, so the name of the place is called Hormah.

dag: Miri ka a doli ninvuɣ biɛri soli. Miri ka a doli tuumbiɛtumdiba soli.
en: Dont take the path of the wicked; dont follow those who do evil.

dag: A kpahiri karimbaannim bɛn mali taali ka bi dol a zaligunim la zuɣu ni.
en: You tell the proud how angry you are with them. All those who refuse to obey your word are cursed.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani m-pah o zuɣu.
en: and so that all the earths peoples may know that the LORD is God. There is no other God!.

dag: N kuhi pam boli Yawɛ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o be o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu ka garigi ma.
en: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina nti paala salo pam.
en: The next day Jesus and the three disciples went down from the hill, and a large crowd met Jesus.

dag: Ka neesim maa nyaɣisibu zuɣu daa chɛ ka m bi lan ne, ka bɛ daa gbaala n nuu ni n-vo ma tahi Damaskus.
en: I was blind because of the bright light, and so my companions took me by the hand and led me into Damascus.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ha, ka bundaan so ŋun daa yi Arimatia na ka o yuli booni Yisifu, ka o nyɛ Yisa nyaandol la.
en: That evening a rich man named Joseph came to Jerusalem. He was a follower of Jesus from the town of Arimathea.

dag: Ka Pɛntikɔst Chuɣu dali daa ti paai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim luɣ yini.
en: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, daboya mini zoya zuɣu buɣa jɛmbu nyɛla yɔhiŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛlnim tiliginsim bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛli polo? Ka di simdi ni n zaŋ Masia niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli leei pagɔrili dini? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: Surely you know that your bodies are parts of Christ himself. So I must never take what is part of Christ and join it to a prostitute!.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: Use fine linen and make a special curtain for the inside of the Holy Tent. Use blue, purple, and red yarn and sew pictures of Cherub angels into the curtain.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni doo be o ko, n ni nam sɔŋda ŋun simd o ti o.
en: Then the LORD God said, Its not good that the human is alone. I will make him a helper that is perfect for him.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu, dilana kpɛhil o paɣ maa zina niŋbu ni, ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣ paɣiyihiŋ maa gba niŋ zina.
en: But I tell you not to divorce your wife unless she has committed some terrible sexual sin. If you divorce her, you will cause her to be unfaithful, just as any man who marries her is guilty of taking another man's wife.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ; kulimi ni suhudoo, a yipa kpaŋya zaa.
en: He responded, Daughter, your faith has healed you; go in peace, healed from your disease.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni laɣim a mamanim maa zaa, a mini bɛn diri nyaɣisim maa, a ni daa yuri shɛb zaa min a ni daa je shɛb la zaa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi luɣilikam laɣimna ti lir a, ka m pirig a a zaɣim wuhi ba, ka bɛ nya a zaɣim zaa.
en: So I, the Lord God, will gather every one of your lovers, those you liked and those you hated. They will stand around you, and I will rip off your clothes and let all of those lovers stare at your nakedness.

dag: Dama tia mali tahima, bɛ yi ŋmaai li luhi, di ni lan kpiri, ka ku chɛ zoobu.
en: There is always hope for a tree. If it is cut down, it can grow again. It will keep sending out new branches.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli naa maa, Daniɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda daba la ni yino la bi lihi nya a bee n-dol a ni zali zaligu shɛli maa. O kul suhirila o Naawuni siɣimsiɣim butata dahin yini puuni.
en: Then they said to the king, That man Daniel is not paying any attention to you. He is one of the captives from Judah, and he is not paying attention to the law you signed. Daniel still prays to his God three times every day.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai Zikilag daba ata dali n-nya ka Amalɛknim kamina ti liri Nɛgɛbinim mini Zikilagnima n-nyaŋ Zikilagnim maa, ka nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: Three days later, David and his soldiers reached Ziklag. The Amalekites had raided the arid southern plain and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it down.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Hur daa chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli maa zuɣu.
en: Joshua did as Moses commanded him and went out to fight the Amalekites, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

dag: Chɛli ma ka n ku ba n-kpihim bɛ yuli dunia ni, ka chɛ ka a nam zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka galisi gari ba.
en: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti kabisi Izraɛlnim bidibbina zaa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: On that day I will break the bow of Israel in the Jezreel Valley.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi ni bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛmuɛl daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛlnima; ka Jamin daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaminnima; ka Jachin daŋ niriba mi nyɛ Jachinnima.
en: Simeons descendants according to their clans: from Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; from Jamin, the Jaminite clan; from Jachin, the Jachinite clan.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛl o, Zɔri, m bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: But Peter said, Man, I dont know what you are talking about! Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ yino nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu yi chɛ ka niriba pam leeg alahichinima, lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino mi nɔdeebo zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: And just as all people were made sinners as the result of the disobedience of one man, in the same way they will all be put right with God as the result of the obedience of the one man.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la pahi maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa tim salo pam shɛba ka bɛ nyaɣiri takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi la dii paana.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, came. With him was a large crowd carrying swords and clubs. They had been sent by the chief priests and elders of the people.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee kpalim ya.
en: Where are the kings of the cities of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah.

dag: ka wuɣi gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ kaɣili gbibil o nudirigu ni; ka damdir o tooni maan o ansarisi yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: They made a crown out of thorn branches and placed it on his head, and they put a stick in his right hand. The soldiers knelt down and pretended to worship him. They made fun of him and shouted, Hey, you king of the Jews.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N dabili Aizaia ni daa chaŋ o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa yuma ata la, di nyɛla din yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim mini Itiɔpianim shihirili.
en: The LORD said, Just as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years, as a sign and omen against Egypt and Cush.

dag: Bihim ka n daa mali dihiri ya, pa saɣim; dama yi daa naan na kul ku tooi di li; hal ka na kul tooi di li pumpɔŋɔ gba.
en: I had to feed you milk, not solid food, because you were not ready for it. And even now you are not ready for it.

dag: Vinvamli din yuli booni Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ? Bɔzuɣu ka tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa tam mɔpila zuɣu puhiri chuɣu?.
en: This is a message about the Valley of Vision : Jerusalem, what is wrong? Why has everyone gone up to hide in their upper rooms?.

dag: Ti tum tuumbiɛri, ka yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa, ka zaɣisi ti Naawuni jɛmbu. Ti nahindi ti taba, ka taari duŋ. Ti nyɛla bɛn ŋmari ʒiri din yiri ti suhuri ni na.
en: defying and denying the LORD, turning away from our God, planning oppression and revolt, muttering lying words conceived in our minds.

dag: Tinim a daba ŋɔ zaa nyɛla do yino bihi, ti nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, ti pala puɣisiriba.
en: We are all sons of one man. We are honest men. Your servants arent spies.

dag: Di buɣisibu wɔɣilim gari dunia ŋɔ wɔɣilim. Ka di yɛliŋ gari teeku.
en: God's greatness is broader than the earth, wider than the sea.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nyari tibigibu o yiko puuni. Karimba ŋuni n-lee paag o?.
en: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka chaŋ ti kpe do so ŋun yuli daa booni Taitius Justus la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka o yiŋ daa baɣi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: He left the synagogue and went next door to the home of Titius Justus, a Gentile God-worshipper.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni na yɛli, Man ni yɔhim o.
en: until a spirit stepped forward, approached the Lord , and said, I will deceive him.

dag: Ka chɛ ka ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa so buri; ka sokam zaa duh o yee suhi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o tuumbiɛri soya mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa o nuhi ni tumda.
en: All persons and animals must wear sackcloth. Everyone must pray earnestly to God and must give up their wicked behavior and their evil actions.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi tahima ni na beni saha shɛl la, ka di yu ni bɛ bahi yoli.
en: Discipline your children while there is still hope. Avoiding it can be deadly.
