dag: Ka Yɛhudianim daa ti bɔr o shee chuɣu maa ni, ka bɔhir o yɛla yɛra, Ya polo ka o lee be.
en: The Jewish authorities were looking for him at the festival. Where is he? they asked.

dag: Ka o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ maa ba yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni o kpalimmi gbe, ka o daa kpalim gbe daba ata. Ka bɛ daa laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka o gbɛri nimaani.
en: Since his father-in-law, the young womans father, insisted, he stayed with him three days, eating, drinking, and spending the night there.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Naawuni ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di kari doli bɛ gbini, amaa ŋmam bɛ noli nti liri ba balisam tihi la tooni.
en: Once more David consulted God, who answered, Don't attack them from here, but go around and get ready to attack them from the other side, near the balsam trees.

dag: Pɛrɛz daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi ni pisopɔinayika. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Of the descendants of Perez, outstanding soldiers lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, n niriba maa pirigili n-daa tumdi mɛbu maa tuma, ka pirigili mi ye gbaɣinɔnima ka gbib kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni tɔbiri. Ka zuɣulaannim la daa kul ʒe Judanim zaa bɛn mɛri gooni maa nyaaŋa.
en: From that day on, half of my men worked on the wall. The other half of my men were on guard, ready with spears, shields, bows, and armor. The army officers stood behind all the people of Judah who were building the wall.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan wuhi ma binshɛli. Nyama, o daa wuhi ma la tiwal moma ni pali piɛ shɛli.
en: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ wumya ni Sool ni ka Kɛila ŋɔ na nti wurim li n zuɣu.
en: David prayed, Lord God of Israel, I was told that Saul is planning to come here. What should I do? Suppose he threatens to destroy the town because of me.

dag: Chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa nyin Naawuni sani sahakam. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali kul gul o.
en: Let him be enthroned forever before God! Make it so love and faithfulness watch over him!.

dag: M paɣiri ya, dama yi teeri n yɛla binshɛɣukam zaa puuni, ka doli kal shɛŋa n ni zaŋ wuhi ya la.
en: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.

dag: N ni guhi Yawɛ ŋun lɛb o nyaaŋa biri Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, ka niŋ o naani.
en: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord , even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Ɛkan, Bɔzuɣu ka a bo wahala ti ti? Yawɛ ni ti a wahala zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa lab o kuɣa, ka lab o malibu gba kuɣa, ka niŋ buɣim nyo ba.
en: Then Joshua said, You caused much trouble for us, but now the Lord will bring trouble to you. Then all the people threw stones at Achan and his family until they died. Then the people burned them and everything he owned.

dag: Ka yiliyiiniba mini wawariba zaa yɛra, N kɔbilinina zaa bela a ni.
en: At the festivals, people will dance and sing, All good things come from Zion.

dag: ni Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kriitinima .
en: Pathrus, Casluh, and Caphtor.

dag: N ni darigi Bɛl din be Babilɔn ŋɔ tibili, ka chɛ ka o gbuɣ o ni daa vali binshɛŋa la bahi. Zuliya kam ku lan jɛm o. Babilɔn goma luya.
en: I will punish Bel, the god of Babylonia, and make him give up his stolen goods; the nations will not worship him any more. Babylon's walls have fallen.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa gbaag o chaŋ ka o leei dabili, ka ŋme n-chɛrisi o biliɛri sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu. Bɛ daa to tɛte o ninvuɣ zuɣuri zuɣu, ka zaŋ bandi ba o kpambaliba.
en: Yet the people of Thebes were carried off into exile. At every street corner their children were beaten to death. Their leading men were carried off in chains and divided among their captors.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni!.
en: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord , my soul!.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yisifu ni tɔɣisi ba n-yɛl o, ka o nya tɔroko shɛŋa Yisifu ni daa zaŋ ti na ni bɛ ti kpuɣ o na la, ka o suhu daa kpaŋ;.
en: But when they told him all that Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to take him to Egypt, he recovered from the shock.

dag: Naawuni ni saɣiri ka suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli paari nir nyɛla din chɛ ka o niŋdi tuuba n-nyari tiliginsim, ka di pa din tahiri suhumiligibo na; amaa dunia ŋɔ ni chɛ ka nir nyari suhusaɣiŋgu shɛli nyɛla din tahiri kum na.
en: The kind of sorrow God wants makes people decide to change their lives. This leads them to salvation, and we cannot be sorry for that. But the kind of sorrow the world has will bring death.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda mini ʒiɛman golimanim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛl o, Zaŋm a bia maa na.
en: Jesus answered, You people today have no faith. Your lives are all wrong. How long must I be with you and be patient with you? Then Jesus said to the man, Bring your son here.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa yi gbaag a piɛɣu, m bi zaŋd o na ti wuhir a, amaa n daa yi gbaarila mmaŋmaŋ piɛɣu zal o zaani. Bɛ daa yi zu binshɛli wuntaŋ ni bee yuŋ, a chɛrimi ka n yo a li.
en: When animals were killed, I didnt bring them to you but took the loss myself. You demanded compensation from me for any animals poached during the day or night.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka lahibal suŋ waazu daa yihi ti bɛn kpi la, ka hal bɛ ni nya saria karibu bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman daadam kam la zaa yoli, bɛ shihi lee ni nya nyɛvili m-be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm.
en: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni n teeg a Naawuni ni daa ti a pin shɛli ka di be a ni n ni daa zaŋ n nuhi pa a zuɣu saha shɛl la yɛla. Tiɣisim li niŋ kaman nir ni tiɣisiri buɣim ka di taari diri shɛm la;.
en: For this reason I remind you to keep alive the gift that God gave you when I laid my hands on you.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi be di ni maa ni.
en: the following regulations for the people of Israel to observe in the land that he was going to give them.

dag: Bia ŋɔ ka n daa suhi maa, ka Yawɛ daa deei n suhigu ka shiri ti ma n ni daa suh o bɔri shɛli maa.
en: to give me a child. Here he is! The Lord gave me just what I asked for.

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, Ti ninkura mini ti bipola zaa ni ti bidibisi mini ti bipuɣinsi zaa zaŋ tabili ti biŋkɔbbaligu mini ti niɣi zaa. Dama ti yɛn chaŋmi ti puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Moses said, Well go with our young and old, with our sons and daughters, and with our flocks and herds, because we all must observe the LORDs festival.

dag: Naawuni daazichi min o yɛm ni o baŋsim galisiya pam! Naawuni ni maani yɛla shɛm to ni baŋbu, ka o soya yɛla gariti sokam!.
en: Yes, Gods riches are very great! His wisdom and knowledge have no end! No one can explain what God decides. No one can understand his ways.

dag: Ka niriba maa mini bɛ malibu zaa daa yina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni kumda, ka Musa daa wum bɛ kumsi maa; ka Yawɛ suhi daa yiɣisi pam, ka di daa bi niŋ Musa nyaɣisim.
en: Moses heard the people complaining. People from every family were sitting by their tents and complaining. The Lord became very angry, and this made Moses very upset.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni zaa hal ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba; ka daa nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: They struck down everyone there without mercy, wiping them out as something reserved for God. Nothing that breathed was left. Hazor itself he burned.

dag: dama saha shɛli Tiudas ni daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ omaŋ leei wɔɣirili ka niriba paai kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi daa dol o la, bɛ daa ti ku o, ka bɛn dol o maa zaa wurim, ka o tuma maa gba daa zan tariga.
en: Some time ago, Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and some four hundred men joined him. After he was killed, all of his followers scattered, and nothing came of that.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yomyom? Jɛrigu mali tahima gari dilana.
en: Do you see people who are quick to speak? There is more hope for fools than for them.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ku ba Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Di saha ka bɛ daa gbahi Judanim daba n-yi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋ.
en: in the territory of Hamath. There the king had them beaten and put to death. So the people of Judah were carried away from their land into exile.

dag: N daa loya ni n yi ka yi sanna, n ku zaŋ yɛli shɛli yɛla wuhi ya n-naɣ pahila Masia min o dapulli zuɣu kpahibu la yɛla.
en: I had made up my mind not to think about anything while I was with you except Jesus Christ, and to preach him as crucified.

dag: ka yi chaŋ Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli ni n-chaŋ ti zani salichɛhi dunɔdali ni m moli n ni yɛn yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ nimaani.
en: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:.

dag: Yinim Chɛrɛti zuliya bɛn be teeku noli ŋɔ, mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din jɛndi nyini Keenan din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; n ni saɣim a zaa hal ka so ti ku lan kpalim be a ni.
en: Doom, inhabitants of the seacoast, nation of Cretans. The LORDs word is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines. I will exterminate you, leaving no inhabitant.

dag: A mi ti yaannim ni daa kuli Ijipti, ka ti be nimaani yuui pam, ka Ijiptinim maa daa nahim ti mini ti yaannim maa pam shɛm la yɛla.
en: Our ancestors settled in Egypt and lived there a long time. But later the Egyptians were cruel to us.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yuri ya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka a lee yuri ti? Yawɛ yɛliya, Iso daa pala Yaakubu mabia? Di zaa yoli, n daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: Israel, I, the Lord , have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob.

dag: Ŋun zaŋ omaŋ tabili tayiɣa je omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili; o yi wumdi niriba ni yɛri zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn niŋ tayiɣ maa, amaa ka o bi viir o gbini.
en: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.

dag: ka taɣi ma ka ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bɔri ni bɛ liri ma la ku paa ma. Bɛna n-nyɛ n dimnim bɛn gili ma niŋ sunsuuni m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la;.
en: from the attacks of the wicked. Deadly enemies surround me;.

dag: nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni, ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba;.
en: Please listen to their prayers from your home in heaven, and do what is right.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ishimail sani maa ni daa nya Karia bia Jɔhanan ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa be o sani, bɛ suhuri daa paligimi.
en: When the captives that Ishmael had taken saw Johanan and the army officers, they were very happy.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya shɛb bɔhira, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be.
en: Why do the nations say, Wheres their God now.

dag: Ka a daa kul lihir o hal ka kuɣili din pa ninsal nuu ni ŋme ŋ-ŋmaai shɛli bahi na daa ti kana ti lu binnani maa napɔnvari din daa nyɛ kuriti mini yaɣiri la zuɣu n-wurisiwurisi li buɣibuɣi.
en: As you watched, a stone was cut from a mountain—but not by human hands. The stone struck the feet, completely shattering the iron and clay.

dag: Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo gili Ninive zaa yɛli, Naa min o kpambaliba ni zali zaligu shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛliya ka ninsalinim bee niɣi ni piɛri ni buhi zaa di binshɛli bee n-nyu kom.
en: Then he announced, In Nineveh, by decree of the king and his officials: Neither human nor animal, cattle nor flock, will taste anything! No grazing and no drinking water!.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi leei yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ bihi, dama ŋuna n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ neeri ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zaa zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka saa miri ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri tinsi ni.
en: so that you will be acting as children of your Father who is in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both the evil and the good and sends rain on both the righteous and the unrighteous.

dag: Ka Shimɛi yɛli naa, N dana, a ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla. Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm ka di yuui pam.
en: Very well, Your Majesty, Shimei answered. I will do what you say. So he lived in Jerusalem a long time.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka o daa kpam Otiniɛl jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na, ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: When she arrived, she convinced Othniel to ask her father for a certain piece of land. As she got down from her donkey, Caleb said to her, What do you want.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ yiko shiri galisi kaman a ni daa pun lo alikauli yɛli.
en: So now, Lord, show your strength! Show it the way you said you would.

dag: M biyurigu, di chɛ ka a bebu doli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa chɛ ka a bebu dolila din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyɛla ŋun mi Naawuni, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyɛla ŋun ʒi Naawuni.
en: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.

dag: N teei dabisa shɛŋa din gari ha yɛla; N tɛhir a tuma zaa yɛla. N kul tɛhir a nuhi tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm. Salima machɛlinim zaa ni di vi bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu; dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binnana ka bi vuhira.
en: Everyone is too foolish to understand; every smith is shamed by his idols, for their images are shams; they arent alive.

dag: Ka dunia nanim mini tiŋgbana zuɣulaannima ni sapashinnima ni bundaannima ni yikolaannima ni sokam zaa bɛn nyɛ daba bee bilichinnima zo nti sɔɣi zoya voya ni mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.

dag: Di saha suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ni ti zooi lim wain tihi din mali wula tuhilituhili, ka di zaɣ yini kam ni tooi da anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: Vineyards that had , vines and were worth , pieces of silver will turn into thorn patches.

dag: Banima n-lee zɔri yomyom kaman sagbana ŋɔ bee n-zɔri yomyom kaman ŋmani n-yiɣiri chani ni o ti kpe o tiɛɣu ni ŋɔ?.
en: What are these ships that skim along like clouds, Like doves returning home?.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, a daa zo n kuŋa. A daa tiligi n nyɛvili.
en: You defended me and brought me back to life.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan zaŋ o nuu tim saɣ ŋman ni, ka wumsim mal o pam ni o zaŋ li ti kpar o noli ni.
en: Lazy people are too lazy to lift the food from their plate to their mouth.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu; n ni nyahi ya ka yi yi daɣiri ni kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi buɣim maani anzinfa ka di yiri shɛm la.
en: People use lye to clean silver. In the same way, I will clean away all your wrongs. I will remove all the impurities from you.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn zaŋ noombihi nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋmila ŋmanʒiɛhi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi.
en: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.

dag: Amaa a yi kpuɣ paɣa, a bi tum alahichi; ka paɣisarili gba yi kuli doo, o bi tum alahichi. Amaa bɛ lee ni di wahala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla zuɣu. M mi bɔrimi ni n yihi ya wahala shɛli lala niriba ni diri maa ni.
en: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.

dag: O nyaandoliba ni daa nya li lala ka di niŋ ba alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka fiig tia maa dii zani yim kuui lala.
en: The disciples were shocked when they saw how quickly the tree had dried up.

dag: Ka suhusaɣiŋgu zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa Bɛlishaaza ninni biɛhigu maan taɣi pahi, ka o kpambaliba bi lan mi bɛ ni yɛn gbaai shɛm.
en: In his distress King Belshazzar grew even paler, and his noblemen had no idea what to do.

dag: Ka Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ m mini cheechi zaa yilikpɛrilan la puhiri ya. Ka Ɛrastus ŋun nyɛ tiŋ puuni laɣigul la mini ti mabia Kuatus gba puhiri ya. .
en: Gaius, who is host to me and to the whole church, says hello to you. Erastus the city treasurer says hello to you, along with our brother Quartus.

dag: Bɛnkam chaŋ o sani bi lan labina bee n-lan nya nyɛvili soli.
en: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.

dag: N suhu ŋmanila wain koligu din pali wain, ka n yi bi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, di ni tahi.
en: If I don't get a chance to speak, I will burst like a wineskin full of new wine.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa n ni daa lihi ni di mali nyɔri la, n yipa lihi li ka di nyɛla yoli n sani Masia zuɣu.
en: These things were my assets, but I wrote them off as a loss for the sake of Christ.

dag: Amaa n daa kul pii ya mi kaman wain ti viɛlli bira la n-zaŋna ti sa, ka bɔzuɣu ka yi taɣi n-lee mɔɣu ni wain tia?.
en: Judah, I planted you like a special vine. You were all from good seed. How did you turn into a different vine that grows bad fruit?.

dag: O ti o naa nasara pam, ka wuh o yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili Dauda min o zuliya sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: God gives great victories to his king; he shows constant love to the one he has chosen, to David and his descendants forever.

dag: Damli dambu zooya n-leei ninvuɣ biɛtali jaaŋgbee. Bɛ ni so ku kpalim, bɛ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ maa zaa mini bɛ daazichi ni bɛ jilima ku kpalim.
en: Violence rises up as a wicked master. It isnt from others or their armies or their violence. It hasnt loomed up because of them.

dag: Dama Naawuni jɛrilim nyɛla yɛm gari ninsalinim yɛm, ka Naawuni chɔɣinsi mi nyɛ kpiɔŋ gari ninsalinim kpiɔŋ.
en: Even the foolishness of God is wiser than human wisdom. Even the weakness of God is stronger than human strength.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ li ti sa tiŋgban nɛli ni, luɣ shɛli kom ni kani, ka di tiŋgbani kuui.
en: So now she is planted in the desert, in a parched and thirsty land.

dag: Ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Bɔzuɣu ka a ŋari ma zaŋ m bipuɣinsi zo kaman tɔbu ka a tuhi gbahi ba maa? Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma maa?.
en: and said: Look what you've done! You've tricked me and run off with my daughters like a kidnapper.

dag: Di chɛ ka a baɣa be kurimbuni lahibaya din bi luri Naawuni sizuura ka nyɛ din pa yɛlimaŋli la ni. Kul zaŋm amaŋ niŋla wuntia soli yɛla bɔhimbu ni.
en: But stay away from the godless myths that are passed down from the older women. Train yourself for a holy life!.

dag: M mabia, a yurilim maa zuɣu chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli mini suhukpaŋsibo, dama Yisa nyaandoliba nyari suhukpaŋsibo a sani.
en: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu kpaŋsimiya tab suhuri, ka niŋdi din ni sɔŋ yi taba ka bɛ zooi Naawuni dolibu ni kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: And so encourage one another and help one another, just as you are now doing.

dag: Bɛ yi kpe Baka vinvamli la ni ni bɛ gari, bɛ chɛrimi ka di puhigir kom zɔra; ka siɣili saa ŋun daŋ mibu chɛri ka di kpɛri paana.
en: As they pass through the dry valley of Baca, it becomes a place of springs; the autumn rain fills it with pools.

dag: Dama saha shɛl o ni daa nya tibiginsim mini jilima o Ba Naawuni sani la ka kukoli daa yi Zallakudura Naa Jilima Biɛhigu Shee na n-di o shɛhira yɛli, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala.
en: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, di simdi ka yi lo noli ka di tumiya tuma dindali, yinim bɛn nyɛ tiŋbihi bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani.
en: This law will always continue for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month, you must not eat food. You must not do any work. None of the travelers or foreigners living in your land can do any work either.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka ninvuɣ so labisi ya nyaaŋa o ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa zuɣu bee o ni kpaŋsiri ʒiri maŋsiɣisibu soli dolibu mini malaikanim jɛmbu yɛla zuɣu. Lala nir nyɛla ŋun duhir omaŋa o ninsalitali tɛha puuni ka di ka daliri.
en: Do not allow yourselves to be condemned by anyone who claims to be superior because of special visions and who insists on false humility and the worship of angels. For no reason at all, such people are all puffed up by their human way of thinking.

dag: Dama m bi timd a la zuliya shɛb bɛn yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to sani, amaa n timd a la Izraɛlnim sani.
en: I am not sending you to some foreigners you cannot understand. You dont have to learn another language. I am sending you to the family of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka n yura maa yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanima, Nyamiya m mini n tihi puu ŋɔ yɛla ŋɔ.
en: So now my friend says, You people who live in Jerusalem and Judah, judge between my vineyard and me.

dag: Yi daa be muɣisigu ni ka kuhi boli ma, ka n tiligi ya. N daa bela n daashili biɛhigu shee din nyɛ saa tahibu la puuni, ka garigi ya. N daa zahim ya Mɛriba kom la shee.
en: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.

dag: Jɛhalɛlɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zif mini Zifa ni Tiria ni Asarɛl.
en: Jehallelel was the father of Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

dag: Di ku yuui ka nyɔŋ puuni leei kɔbu shee kɔbu shee mi leei nyɔŋ.
en: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.

dag: N suhiri ti Duuma ni o zom Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnim nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa kul kpaŋsiri n suhu waawaayili; ka vi bi mal o zoligɔnim din lo ma la zuɣu.
en: May the Lord show mercy to the family of Onesiphorus, because he cheered me up many times. He was not ashamed that I am in prison.

dag: Yawɛ ni bi maani ninvuɣ shɛb taali laasabu mini yɔhiŋgu ni ka ninvuɣ shɛb biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: The one the LORD doesnt consider guilty— in whose spirit there is no dishonesty— that one is truly happy!.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn zaɣisi ma, ka tam n zoli din be kasi la yɛla, ka puhiri churi ka jɛmdi zuɣusuŋ wuna la.
en: What will I, the Lord , do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call Good Luck and Fate?.

dag: Dama bɛ yi ti kpi, bɛ ku tooi zaŋ li mali chaŋ. Bɛ daazichi maa ku doli ba siɣi gballi ni.
en: he cannot take it with him when he dies; his wealth will not go with him to the grave.

dag: Yi niŋdi wain paani pipihi n-nyura, ka niŋdi tulaale viɛla n-niŋdi yimaŋa, amaa ka yi baɣa ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli din paai Yisifu zuliya ŋɔ ni.
en: You drink wine in fancy cups. You use the best perfumes. And it doesnt even bother you that Josephs family is being destroyed.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpɛhili shee yili; ka yihiri sarikanim mi kpɛhiri yolisim suhupiɛlli ni. Amaa duŋtaariba bɛn ni bela tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: God settles the lonely in their homes; he sets prisoners free with happiness, but the rebellious dwell in a parched land.

dag: Ka Balak yɛl o, Kamina ka ti chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo a ni yɛn nya ba; a ku tooi nya bɛ zaa, a kul ni nyala bɛ ni shɛb kɔŋko; ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma.
en: Then Balak said to him, So come with me to another place. At that place you can see more of these people. You cannot see all of them—you can only see part of them. Maybe from that place you can curse them for me.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana ni zali di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di doli yuun shɛŋa din na kpalim ni bɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa, ka yi ni tooi yihi shɛli yi daa maa ni.
en: If you dedicate it any time later, the priest shall estimate the cash value according to the number of years left until the next Year of Restoration, and set a reduced price.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira, ka yi Bahurim na la gba beni. O daa tu ma tu biɛri dahin shɛli n ni daa chaŋ Mahanaim la, amaa o ni daa kana nti tuhi ma soli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la, n daa po Yawɛ yɛl o, N ku zaŋ takɔb ku a.
en: Be sure to do something about Shimei son of Gera from Bahurim in the territory of Benjamin. He cursed and insulted me the day I went to Mahanaim. But later, when he came to meet me at the Jordan River, I promised that I wouldn't kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa silim zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Yaa Naawuni, nyin ŋun su vuhirigu kam zaa nyɛvili ŋɔ, wula ka ninvuɣ yino tum alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zaa zuɣu.
en: But Moses and Aaron bowed to the ground and cried out, God, you know what people are thinking. Please dont be angry with all these people. Only one man really sinned.

dag: Naawuni Shi yino maa zuɣu ka ti zaa deei baptaizibu niŋgbun yini maa ni, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka di yi nyɛla daba bee bilichinnima, Shi yino maa ka ti zaa daa laɣim deei.
en: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.

dag: Jɛhiɛl bidibisi ni, Zɛtam min o mabia Joɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Azichi fukumsi.
en: Ladan's two other sons, Zetham and Joel, had charge of the Temple treasury and storerooms.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumdiba, Chamiya ti bo n-nya paɣ so ŋun nyɛ jinwara ni be luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ o sani ti kari saria. Ka o tumtumdiba maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, jinwara be Ɛndo.
en: Finally, Saul said to his officers, Find me a woman who is a medium. Then I can go ask her what will happen. His officers answered, There is a medium at Endor. .

dag: N teeg a ni mali yɛda maŋli shɛl la yɛla. Di nyɛla yɛda shɛli a yabipaɣa Lɔis mini a ma Yunis ni daa mal la tatabo, ka m mi ni a gba shiri mal li.
en: I remember your true faith. That kind of faith first belonged to your grandmother Lois and to your mother Eunice. I know you now have that same faith.

dag: Kumiya dokura, ka ku nachimba mini paɣisara ni bihi ni paɣiba. Amaa miriya ka yi ti shihi bɛ ni zaŋ bini dalim ninvuɣ shɛb gbɛri zuɣu la. Pilimiya n jɛmbu duu la shee. Di saha ka bɛ daa piligi zuɣulaannim bɛn daa be o jɛmbu duu samban ni la kubu.
en: Kill them all, old men, young men and women, babies and mothers. Only dont touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary. So they began with the men, the elders in front of the temple.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm ti o maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana ni.
en: The following children were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ mali suhupiɛlli; dama nyini ka n kul suhira.
en: Make your servant glad, O Lord, because my prayers go up to you.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa mali sara maligunim Yawɛ tooni.
en: Solomon and the people dedicated the temple to the Lord by sacrificing , cattle and , sheep.

dag: Ka timaŋmaŋ gba baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka niŋ yɛda. Naawuni nyɛla yurilim, ka ŋunkam kul be yurilim puuni nyɛla ŋun be Naawuni ni, ka Naawuni gba be o ni.
en: We have known and have believed the love that God has for us. God is love, and those who remain in love remain in God and God remains in them.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she pateesa, ka chɛ ka tuumbaŋda wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: They made a curtain of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered it with figures of winged creatures.

dag: Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko mini fahim niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn tumdi tuma shɛm luɣ kasi shee la malibu ni ti tum bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm.
en: Let Bezalel, Oholiab, and every other skilled worker whom the LORD has given skill, ability, and knowledge for the work of building the sanctuary do all that the LORD has commanded.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yimiya! Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi. Ka bɛ lar o.
en: he said, Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep. Everyone started laughing at Jesus.

dag: Ka Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Amaŋmaŋ yiɣisim ku ti. Dama doo ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ o kpiɔŋ gba. Ka Gidiɔn daa yiɣisi ku Zɛba mini Zalimuna, ka yihi bɛ laakumnim nyiŋgoya ni nachiinsi binyara.
en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said to Gideon, Come on, kill us yourself. It takes a man to do a man's job. So Gideon killed them and took the ornaments that were on the necks of their camels.

dag: O daa ku Ijipti ninsalinim bikpamba zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri bikpamba.
en: God struck down the Egyptians oldest offspring— both human and animal!.

dag: Yɛligim a suɣili. Di niŋ zinchili. Kpam a kpahi ka di kpɛma, ka voog a mihi ka di kpaŋ.
en: Make your tents larger! Spread out the tent pegs; fasten them firmly.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din be tooni naŋgbambili, ka lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa gba naŋgbambili.
en: They put loops along the edge of the end curtain of one group. And they did the same on the end curtain of the other group.

dag: Ninkur teempiɛla be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn kurigi gar a ba.
en: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ nyɛla, faashee ka bɛ ŋme n-wurisi chɛfirinim maligu malibu bimbina la buɣibuɣi kaman zim la; ka saɣim Ashɛra ŋmahinli binyara mini di tulaale tuɣilibu bimbina la zaa.
en: By this Jacobs guilt is reconciled, and this was how his sins were finally removed: he made all the altar stones like shattered chalk, sacred poles and incense altars that couldnt stand.

dag: Ka Amnɔn daa zaŋ di yɛla muɣis omaŋ hal ti gbaai dɔro o tizɔpaɣ Tama maa zuɣu. Dama Tama daa na ʒi doo, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Amnɔn kɔŋ o ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: But Tamar was a virgin, and Amnon could not think of a way to be alone with her. He was so upset about it that he made himself sick.

dag: Yawɛ tooni, dama o kanna. O kanimina ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O mi yɛn zaŋla wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli kari niriba saria.
en: to the Lord . He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihita ni yini saha, ka Omri daa leei Izraɛl naa maa. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi. O daa diya ʒinila Tiriza yuma ayɔbu.
en: in the thirty-first year of Asa's rule in Judah. Omri ruled Israel for twelve years. The first six years he ruled from Tirzah.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum paɣ maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o darigi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka doli gooni maa zuɣu garita. Ka niriba nya o ka o yɛla buɣu ka di be o binyɛrigu tiŋli.
en: Hearing this, the king tore his clothes in dismay, and the people who were close to the wall could see that he was wearing sackcloth under his clothes.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa a ni daa nya la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn na bi di nam, amaa bɛ ni ti ti ba yiko ka bɛ di nam pahi biŋkɔbigu la zuɣu awa yini.
en: The ten horns you saw are ten rulers. These ten rulers have not yet received their kingdom, but they will receive power to rule with the beast for one hour.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka o niŋ a nyɔri bee m-pah a binshɛli, amaa zom a Naawuni, ka chɛ ka a mabia maa kul be a sani.
en: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi lu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ ni daa nya binneen shɛb zaa; ka daa niŋ buɣim nyo fɔntin shɛŋa din daa kpalim zaa.
en: But the Israelites turned their attention to the rest of the Benjaminites and massacred them entirely—the city, the people, even the animals, and everything else they found. They also burned down every city they came across.

dag: Ʒiɛmana kanimina ka vuura, amaa dunia ŋɔ din kul ni beni sahakam.
en: A generation goes, and a generation comes, but the earth remains as it always has.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibubalibu kpe bɛ suhuri ni nti ku yɛligu maa, ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: but their lives become full of other things: the worries of this life, the love of money, and everything else they want. This keeps the teaching from growing, and it does not produce a crop in their lives.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nuhu, A min a malibu zaa kpɛm ŋariŋ maa ni, dama n nyaya ka nyini n-nyɛ wuntizɔra n sani ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: The LORD said to Noah, Go into the ark with your whole household, because among this generation Ive seen that you are a moral man.

dag: N tɔɣisi jɛrilim m barinyubo ni, amaa yinima m-muɣisi ma ka n niŋ lala. Di di simdi ni yinim paɣi ma, dama hal n yi kul pa shɛli, n lee pala ŋun pɔri tuum shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I am acting like a fool—but you have made me do it. You are the ones who ought to show your approval of me. For even if I am nothing, I am in no way inferior to those very special apostles of yours.

dag: Ka Shupim mini Hupim daa nyɛ Iri bidibisi, ka Hushim mi daa nyɛ Ahɛr bidibiga.
en: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir. Hushim was the son of Aher.

dag: Ifriimnim ni daa nya bɛ dɔro maa, ka Judanim mi nya bɛ daŋ la, di saha ka Ifriimnim daa chaŋ Asiria natital la sani ti bo sɔŋsim. Amaa o ku tooi chɛ ka yi kpaŋ bee n-tibi yi daŋ maa.
en: Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, so they went to Assyria for help. They told their problems to the great king, but he cannot heal you or cure your wound.

dag: Ka n daa su a kom, m-paɣ a ni ʒim maa bahi, ka ʒe a kpam.
en: Then I took water and washed the blood off you. I rubbed olive oil on your skin.

dag: Ka Musa daa yeei Aduna kpariti maa n-zaŋ li yɛli o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna daa shiri kpi zoli maa zuɣu. Ka Musa mini Ɛliɛza daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina.
en: Moses stripped Aaron of his clothes and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there at the top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar descended from the mountain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi zaa ni nti laɣim Lɛvinim mini Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba, ka bɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: They traveled to all the cities of Judah and brought back with them to Jerusalem the Levites and all the heads of the clans.

dag: Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun ni ti kari bɛn ne mini bɛn kpi saria la sani n zal a, Yisa Masia labbuna min o nam dibu la zuɣu, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima:.
en: Im giving you this commission in the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who is coming to judge the living and the dead, and by his appearance and his kingdom.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul mi wuntizɔriba soli ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bahi yoli.
en: The righteous are guided and protected by the Lord , but the evil are on the way to their doom.

dag: Timoti ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee la puhiri ya; ka Lusius mini Jeesɔn ni Sɔsipata bɛn nyɛ n zuliya la gba puhiri ya.
en: Timothy, a worker together with me, sends you his greetings. Also Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater send their greetings.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa chɛbis o deemba maa, ka o lab o ya.
en: After Moses and his father-in-law Jethro had said goodbye to each other, Jethro returned home.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛl o yiŋ nachin kpɛm ŋun su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ n gbalipina lɔŋni.
en: Abraham said to the oldest servant of his household, who was in charge of everything he owned, Put your hand under my thigh.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A shiri yɛn laɣimla wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku?.
en: Abraham approached the Lord and asked, Are you really going to destroy the innocent with the guilty?.

dag: N lo a alikauli, a ni niŋ zuliya pam yaba.
en: This is my part of our agreement: I will make you the father of many nations.

dag: ni yi ni yɛn nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di lahi zaa ni tahili ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar for burning offerings and the things used at the altar; the bowl and the base under it;.

dag: Ti ba daa kpila mɔɣu la ni. O daa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim pahi Kɔra zuɣu taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ la kalinli ni, amaa omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa kpi; ka mi ka bidibisi.
en: Our father died while we were traveling through the desert. He died a natural death. He was not one of the men who joined Korahs group. But our father had no sons.

dag: Pa ninsal yɛm yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali wuhiri yɛla ŋɔ maa, amaa di nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ wuhi ti, ka ti mi mal li kahigiri Naawuni Shia yɛla wuhiri bɛn mali Naawuni Shia.
en: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.

dag: ka daa bol o yiŋbihi pia na nti ti bɛ zaa pɔŋlipɔŋli, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ mal li gom kɔhigu hal ka o ti labina.
en: So he called ten of his servants together. He gave a bag of money to each servant. He said, Do business with this money until I come back.

dag: Pahatimɔab daŋ — tusaayi ni kɔbisinii ni pinaayi.
en: the descendants of Pahath Moab of the family of Jeshua and Joab:.

dag: Niriba tusatusa m-be Saria Karibu Vinvamli maa ni. Dama Yawɛ dabisili la miriya Saria Karibu Vinvamli la ni.
en: There are many, many people in the Valley of Decision. The Lord s special day is near in the Valley of Decision.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o biɛhigu shee. O yɛliya, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm, ka pirigi Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: Our God, you solemnly promised, I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.

dag: Masia dapulli zuɣu kum puuni ka o daa kpihim dimdi din be ti sunsuuni la, ka zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba leei zaɣ yini n-zaŋ ba labisi Naawuni sani.
en: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.

dag: dama bɛn nyuri dam kuuna mini pulaannim ni leei faranima; ka bɛ gɔ gbihibo nyɛ din ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ gbinfini.
en: Those who eat and drink too much become poor. They sleep too much and end up wearing rags.

dag: Jɛhoyakim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim zaa ni daa tum shɛm.
en: Jehoiakim did what the Lord said was wrong. He did all the same things his ancestors had done.

dag: Di chɛ ka n lihiri binshɛŋa din ka buchi. Tim ma nyɛvili a soli zuɣu.
en: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.

dag: Naawuni zom ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n ni wuhi so shɛli ŋɔ min o niriba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima alali la zaa nambɔɣu, ka ti ba suhudoo!.
en: As for those who follow this rule in their lives, may peace and mercy be with them—with them and with all of God's people!.

dag: ka bo wain lita ayi din nyɛ binnyura sara la ni sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.

dag: Bɛ kari ba niriba ni bahi; niriba yɔhiri ba mi kaman tayiɣ la.
en: They are forced away from other people, who shout at them as if they were thieves.

dag: Na so ŋun ka tɛhi zilima nyɛla putɔɣulana ŋun niŋdi niriba fitiina, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun je zalinsi bini ni mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: A foolish ruler hurts the people under him, but a ruler who hates wrong will rule for a long time.

dag: Ka bɛ yiŋlan maa daa yuug o gɔrim maa polo hal ti kuna, ka bɛ min o daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mal o liɣiri maa laasabu.
en: Some time later the master of those servants returned. He called them in and asked what they had done with his money.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli, N tum taali, m bia Dauda, labimina, n ku lan niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu yaha, dama a lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; nyama, n tum jɛrilim ka birigi pam.
en: Saul answered, I have done wrong. Come back, David, my son! I will never harm you again, because you have spared my life tonight. I have been a fool! I have done a terrible thing.

dag: Mahila mini Tiriza ni Hɔgila ni Milika ni Nɔa bɛn daa nyɛ Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa daa kulila bɛ ba tizɔbihi bidibisi.
en: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, Zelophehads daughters, married their cousins.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Hiram.
en: Solomon sent a message back to Hiram:.

dag: Sokam diri Dimitirius shɛhira suŋ, hal yɛlimaŋli maŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira suŋ. Ka timaŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira pahi; ka a mi ni ti ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius; truth itself speaks well of him. And we add our testimony, and you know that what we say is true.

dag: Tulaale viɛlli nyom ku be bɛ sani, naɣila nyom biɛɣu. Bɛ ku mali shɛlɔri viɛla lɔra, naɣila gabisi, bɛ ku mali zab viɛla, naɣila zuɣukpina, bɛ ku mali binyɛr viɛla yɛra, naɣila buri. Bɛ viɛlim ni ŋmaligi leei vi.
en: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.

dag: M bia, zom Yawɛ ka zom naa, ka miri ka a zaɣisi bɛ so noli;.
en: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.

dag: Ka Maika daa zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nachimbil maa leeg o maligumaana, ka o daa kpalim be ŋun Maika yiŋa.
en: Micah appointed him as his priest, and he lived in Micah's home.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa ŋmaligi guui ka kuhi yɛli Ahazia, Nyaanyibo yɛtɔɣa m-bala.
en: Joram turned the horses to run away. He said to Ahaziah, It is a trick, Ahaziah.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di nyɛ lala yinim sani; amaa chɛliya ka ŋun nyɛ yi zaa kpɛma lee zaŋ omaŋa zalila bia zaani, ka yi zaa zuɣulana zaŋ omaŋa leei ŋun tumdi bia tuma yi zaa ha sani.
en: But this is not the way it is with you; rather, the greatest one among you must be like the youngest, and the leader must be like the servant.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bɛ fabila maa, ka teeg o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: who heard their groaning and remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: dama Naawuni deeri zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔr o ka tumdi din tuhi.
en: He accepts anyone who worships him and does what is right. It is not important what nation they come from.

dag: o ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la; o ni daa po pɔri n-lo Yisahaku alikauli shɛli.
en: which he made with Abraham, the solemn pledge he swore to Isaac.

dag: Zaŋmi n talima ni nyɛ shɛli zal a sani. Ŋuni n-lee beni ŋun ni zani n nyaaŋa?.
en: God, give me some support. No one else will!.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o ni buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini di dubihi ni di nɛma ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni ni di zuɣusaa duri ni di puuni duri ni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo kuɣ ni ti yɛn be du shɛl ni gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: David gave Solomon the plans for all the Temple buildings, for the storerooms and all the other rooms, and for the Most Holy Place, where sins are forgiven.

dag: Ka din pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun mali shɛhira suŋ bɛn be kpaŋ sani, di yi pa lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti tum vi tuma, ka Sintani zana gbaag o.
en: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil.

dag: A yi lo Naawuni alikauli, nyin palimi li yomyom, dama o je jɛra yɛlli. Niŋm a ni lo alikauli ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: When you make a promise to God, fulfill it without delay because God has no pleasure in fools. Fulfill what you promise.

dag: Zikiri bia Joɛl la n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Hasɛnua bia Juda mi nyɛ zuɣulaan so ŋun pah ayi n-su tiŋ maa fukumsi.
en: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was the second ranking official in the city.

dag: Piim a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi Izraɛlnim ni, n-chɛ ka bɛ yi n ka a sanna ti leei m maligumaaniba, n-tumdi n tuma; Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn yuya booni Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Summon to you your brother Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites to serve me as priests—Aaron and Aarons sons, Nadab and Abihu, and Eleazar and Ithamar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zahim maa m-mali chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa teei bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka maa zaashee maa, ka di daa chɛ ka bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi.
en: The Cherub angels stood with their wings spread over the Box of the Agreement and the poles that were used to carry it.

dag: Lala maa ni chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili zani tariga zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka n ŋmaligi n nyuli zabbu ka chɛ a, ka fo, ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi.
en: When Ive satisfied my anger, and my rage has turned away from you, I will be calm and no longer angry.

dag: Di yi pa lala Masidɔnianim shɛb yi nyɛla bɛn doli ma kana nti nya ka yi bi mali shili, ti ni di vi zaŋ chaŋ ti ni niŋ ya naani shɛm la polo, amaa di bahi bamdi yinima.
en: If some Macedonians should come with me and find out that you arent ready, we would be embarrassed as far as this project goes.

dag: Farisiinim bɛn yuri liɣiri pam la ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ maan o ansarisi.
en: The Pharisees, who were money-lovers, heard all this and sneered at Jesus.

dag: Nyama, n niriba ni ti yi katiŋa nuzaa polo mini wulinluhili polo ni Asiwan din be nudirigu polo la na.
en: Look! These will come from far away. Look! These from the north and west, and these from the southland.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o ku dih o bihi vi o niriba sunsuuni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mal o ka o be kasi.
en: Otherwise, his children, who ought to be holy, will be ritually unclean. I am the Lord and I have set him apart as the High Priest.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la malimi yi luɣili pinaayi zaa ka di be kasi, ka gbibi yi niŋgbuna zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni yi shihi zaa ka di mali yaa ka ti ku mali taali hal baabiɛla ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dali.
en: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.

dag: A bi mi ni kurimbuni, saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ daadam niŋ dunia ni la.
en: You know that the joy of the wicked does not last long. That has been true a long time, ever since Adam was put on earth. Those who dont know God are happy for only a short time.

dag: Ka o gba ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: Then he asked, Don't you know? No sir, I replied.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini yɛm zaa bela o sani, ŋuna n-su ŋun yɔhindi niriba min o ni yɔhindi shɛb zaa.
en: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ o leei n niriba zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o nam kul beni sahakam.
en: I will put him in charge of my people and my kingdom forever. His dynasty will never end.

dag: ka Naomi yɛli ba, Labimiya kuli yi manim sani. Yawɛ ŋɔ niŋmi ya nirilim kaman yi ni niŋ m mini yi yidaannim bɛn kpi la nirilim shɛm la.
en: she said to them, Go back home and stay with your mothers. May the Lord be as good to you as you have been to me and to those who have died.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛl o niriba maa, Mani n-daa wurim ya bahi ka yi chaŋ ti be luɣ shɛlikam, dinzuɣu yinim bɛn be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa, Zomiya yi Babilɔn n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The Lord said to his people, I scattered you in all directions. But now, you exiles, escape from Babylonia and return to Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ ni daa karim gbaŋ maa, di yɛligu maa daa paligi bɛ suhuri pam.
en: When the letter was read, everyone was pleased and greatly encouraged.

dag: Nyama, ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa kabina ni bɛ ti nya Yisa; bɛ ni daa ti nya o, ka bɛ balim o ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So everyone from the town went out to meet Jesus; and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their territory.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ pahi: Izraɛlnim daa bi baŋ? Anabi Musa n-nyɛ ŋun tuui garigi. O daa yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: N ni chɛ ka yi zab zuliya shɛb bɛn pa zuliya maŋli nyuli; ka chɛ ka yi suhuri yiɣisi bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra zuɣu.
en: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa darig a niriba maa tibili la, bɛ nandahima puuni, bɛ daa suh a pam.
en: LORD, in distress they sought you out; they poured out prayers to you when you disciplined them.

dag: Samarianim daa bi tum a daalahichi ŋɔ pirigili, a tum din chihiri gari ba. Ka a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka a mabihi maa ŋmanila wuntizɔriba.
en: You people of Jerusalem have sinned twice as much as the people of Samaria. In fact, your evil ways have made both Sodom and Samaria look innocent.

dag: Lala ka n ti yɛn yiɣisi n suhu bahi gooni maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ya, Gooni maa lan kani, ka bɛn daa zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa gba lan kani.
en: The wall and those who covered it with whitewash will feel the force of my anger. Then I will tell you that the wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it—.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini kpamba maa daa zali Lɛvinim maa ni bɛ zaŋm Dauda mini anabi Asaf yɛtɔɣa la yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa yili wumpaɣibo yila maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord .

dag: M be yi sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm. N ni laɣim yi zuliya bɛn be wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo zaa na.
en: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim chɛ ka daboya mini vinvama yi palo ni, kaman binyɛrigu kpabbu bɔba la, ka ne n-doya kaman bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli dihi yaɣiri zuɣu ka yihi li ka di bɔbili doya shɛm la.
en: The morning light makes the hills and valleys easy to see. When the daylight comes to the earth, the shapes of these places stand out like the folds of a coat. They take shape like soft clay that is pressed with a stamp.

dag: n-yiini wumpaɣibo yila pampam, ka yɛr a daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: proclaiming out loud my thanks, declaring all your wonderful deeds!.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Jahat ni Zimma.
en: These were Gershons descendants: Libni was Gershons son. Jahath was Libnis son. Zimmah was Jahaths son.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Itiɔpia kirisolait la buɣisi li, ka nir mi ku tooi zaŋ salima alali buɣisi li.
en: The finest topaz and the purest gold Cannot compare with the value of wisdom.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu; ka o chɛ ka bɛ ŋme ba tɔbu, ka di be kaman buɣim la gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ di daliri, ka di di ba kaman buɣim la, amaa ka bɛ bi lihi li ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: So God poured out on Jacob the heat of his anger and the fury of battle. It scorched him, and he didnt know it; it burned him, but he didnt give it much thought.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul be lala dunia ŋɔ ni hal ti paai biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu.
en: The water did not start going down for a hundred and fifty days.

dag: Di saha o daa yɛla saalo bɔɣiwɔɣila, dama di saha maa nabipuɣinsi bɛn daa na ʒi dɔbba ni daa yi yɛri saalo shɛŋa m-bala. Ka o tumtumda maa daa daag o yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: The servant put her out and locked the door. Tamar was wearing a long robe with full sleeves, the usual clothing for an unmarried princess in those days.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi n-nya ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri ka loori maa naai, ka kɔbiri bili di ni, o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni, di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if the priest thinks that the disease has stopped, and black hair is growing in it, the disease has healed. The person is clean, and the priest must announce this.

dag: Tiliginsim ŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka anabinim daa vihi, ka bo ni bɛ baŋ li. Bɛ daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛlila anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya la yɛla.
en: The prophets studied carefully and tried to learn about this salvation. They spoke about the grace that was coming to you.

dag: Amaa a yi bi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba maa, dindina bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, ka bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka a ku tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: If you dont surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, the city will be handed over to the Babylonians, who will burn it down, and you wont escape from them.

dag: Teeku bulli vali ba, ka bɛ siɣi kɔtiŋ kaman kuɣili la.
en: The deep sea covered them; they sank to the bottom like a stone.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti lɔri nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo Jɛrusalɛm, o daa zo n-kulila Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chɛ ka shɛb kar o naba Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: There was a plot in Jerusalem to assassinate Amaziah, so he fled to the city of Lachish, but his enemies followed him there and killed him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga zaani yu suma, ka tooi mali suhukpeeni n-tɔɣisiri bɛ ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda shɛm yɛla palɔni.
en: Those helpers who do their work well win for themselves a good standing and are able to speak boldly about their faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti be o ni ka o gba be ti ni. Dina n-nyɛ: O ni zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Shia ti ti la zuɣu.
en: We are sure that we live in union with God and that he lives in union with us, because he has given us his Spirit.

dag: Noli ŋɔ zaa ni ti doli ya n-din ya hal ti kun ya, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm niŋ pali ti bebu puuni; dama ti nyɛla bɛn bi lan doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu, amaa ka naɣ dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ti shɛm.
en: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli wahu, A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni yɛli noli ti a n-gari yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa; a ni nyɛritila a puli zuɣu, ka diri taŋkpaɣu hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: So the Lord God said to the snake, You did this very bad thing, so bad things will happen to you. It will be worse for you than for any other animal. You must crawl on your belly and eat dust all the days of your life.

dag: Pirigim a ni mali shɛlikam ʒii buyopɔin bee bunii zuɣu, dama a ku tooi baŋ barina shɛli din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Share what you have with seven or eight others, because you never know when disaster may strike.

dag: Mɛfibɔshɛt dapala daa nyɛla bidibbil sariŋga ka o yuli booni Maika, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ziba yiŋa daa leei Mɛfibɔshɛt tumtumdiba.
en: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica. All who lived in Zibas household became Mephibosheths servants.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣili maa daa gar o nyaandoliba maa pam. Ka o lan yɛli ba, M bihi, nyamiya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu ni to shɛm bɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ daazichi naani sani!.
en: The followers were amazed at what Jesus said. But he said again, My children, it is very hard to enter Gods kingdom!.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara naɣilaa la mini alahichi sanyoo sara bua la, bɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee la n-yi bɛ sansani maa ni kpaŋa nti nyo bɛ gbana mini bɛ nimdi ni bɛ bina buɣim.
en: The bull and the goat for the sin offerings will be taken outside the camp. The skins, bodies, and body waste of those animals will be burned in the fire.

dag: Ba ni zɔr o bihi nambɔɣu shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o la nambɔɣu.
en: Like a parent feels compassion for their children— thats how the LORD feels compassion for those who honor him.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni Mɛdɛba tintan zaŋ hal ti paai Dibɔn.
en: It ran from Aroer by the rim of the Arnon Valley and the city in the middle of the valley through the whole Medeba plateau as far as Dibon.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be ʒilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Don't be stupid like a horse or a mule, which must be controlled with a bit and bridle to make it submit.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka niriba maa daŋ yiɣisibu me bimbini zali nimaani, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara.
en: Early the next morning the people got up and built an altar there. They offered fellowship sacrifices and burned some sacrifices whole.

dag: Bɛ suhuri ni piɛli Kpiɔŋlan Naa zuɣu? Bɛ ni suhiri Naawuni sahakam?.
en: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.

dag: Ka guliba maa zaa daa gbib bɛ bidibbina n-ʒiɛya gu Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ ti kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti gili sara maligu bimbini mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The guards, each with their weapons drawn, then took up positions near the temple and the altar, stretching from the south side of the temple to the north side to protect the king. Everyone was holding his weapons, surrounding the king.

dag: Yuun tuhili yi ti gari, di ŋmanila sɔhila a sani, bee ŋ-ŋmani kaman yuŋ saha biɛla yuusim.
en: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni daŋ kam ni dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔb ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: The official family records listed , soldiers in the families of this clan, as well as their family leaders.

dag: Dama yi yi taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma ka be yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ tab sani.
en: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.

dag: Yi zaa nya li yimaŋmaŋa, ka wula ka yi zaa leei bɛn ka buchi.
en: But you have seen it all with your own eyes. So why do you say such useless things?.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, bɛ ni ti mi o niriba la, Bɛ ni pirigi so namdili yiŋnima.
en: From then on, the brothers family will be known in Israel as, the family of the man whose sandal was removed.

dag: ni yi ni yɛn nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di lahi zaa ni tahili ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar for entirely burned offerings with all its equipment, the washbasin with its stand.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim la zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni chirigibu min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol la tooni.
en: Put the altar for burning offerings in front of the entrance of the Holy Tent, that is, the Meeting Tent.

dag: N suhu yɛliya, Kamina ti jɛm o. Yawɛ, nyini ka n shiri ni jɛm;.
en: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face.

dag: Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr bidibiga ka nyɛ Dinhaba nir la daa di nam Ɛdom.
en: Bela, Beors son, ruled in Edom; his citys name was Dinhabah.

dag: nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ba, a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam mini anfaani ti ba la.
en: You gave them this land that you promised to their ancestors, a land full of milk and honey.

dag: Lala maa ni chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili zani tariga zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka n ŋmaligi n nyuli zabbu ka chɛ a, ka fo, ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi.
en: Then my anger will be over, and I will be calm. I will not be angry or jealous any more.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o me du titali, ka ku ʒini mali laasabu nya o mal liɣiri din ni tooi me li naai?.
en: Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. What is the first thing you will do? Won't you sit down and figure out how much it will cost and if you have enough money to pay for it?.

dag: Ka a daazichi min a nɛma ni a daguya ni a kpatoonsi ni a ŋariŋduhiriba ni a ŋariŋmaaniba ni a dagudariba ni a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa be a ni ni a min a niriba zaa bɛn be a sani shim teeku bulli ni a wurimbu dali.
en: Everything on board was lost— your valuable cargo, your sailors and carpenters, merchants and soldiers.

dag: O dimnim ku tooi nyaŋ o; putɔɣunim mi ku tooi filim o.
en: His enemies will never succeed against him; the wicked will not defeat him.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni ka yih o di biɛrim ni, dama o daa pala ŋun ni kpi n-kpalim kum ni.
en: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.

dag: Giliadnim yi tum alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni bahi yoli. Giligal tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ maanila maligu tiri naɣilahi. Lala zuɣu bɛ maligu bimbina maa ni ti ŋmanila kuɣa ka bɛ laɣisi duhi puu ni.
en: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, dama nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ m birini, nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ma yurilim maŋli ŋɔ.
en: I will sing praises to you, my source of strength. You, God, are my place of safety. You are the God who loves me!.

dag: Izar daŋ ni, Kɛnania min o bidibisi ka bɛ daa pii ni bɛ tumdi samban ni tuma, ka nyɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn maani Izraɛlnim yɛla.
en: From the Izharites: Chenaniah and his family had responsibilities over Israel outside the temple as officials and judges.

dag: Bɛna bɛn zaa nyɛ n niriba maa, mani n-daa nam ba n jilima zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛba.
en: everyone who is called by my name and whom I created for my glory, whom I have formed and made.

dag: n-yɛra, O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: God set it up as binding law for Jacob, as an eternal covenant for Israel.

dag: Ka Rɛkab bia Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihakɛrɛm yaɣili polo naa la daa mali me Saɣiri Dunɔdali maa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi li, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.

dag: Aristakus ŋun be sarika ni pahi n zuɣu ŋɔ mini Maak ŋun nyɛ Baanabas ŋahiŋga la puhiri ya. Yi pun wum di ni simd ni yi niŋ o shɛm; ka o yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o.
en: Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ di tiŋli ti tuui ka mali salima buɣilimbuɣilimbihi n-zaŋ li yiliyili di sunsuuni gili.
en: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu, ka garigi ma, dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana.
en: I am a poor, helpless man. Lord , please listen to me and answer my prayer!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ku o kpee, yin chɛ ka ŋun ku o kpee maa kul dari ginda hal ti kpi; ka di chɛliya ka so sɔŋ o.
en: Someone guilty of murder is digging his own grave as fast as he can. Don't try to stop him.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Anabi Joɛl ni daa yɛli shɛm la. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahi naaya yi yaannim tuma maa!.
en: Go ahead, complete what your ancestors did.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ galima be n niriba maa ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn fari bɛ tab nɛma. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana kaman nooŋgbahiriba la n-gbahiri ninsalinima.
en: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.

dag: Yi ni ti vili yi baŋtabisi, ka piri yi namda. Di ti fabiliya bee n-kum, amaa yi tuumbiɛri ni ti ʒin ya chaŋ, ka yi ti ŋuhira niŋdi taba.
en: You will not go bareheaded or barefoot or mourn or cry. You will waste away because of your sins, and you will groan to one another.

dag: N ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ya kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka lala maa chɛ ka m paɣi yi ni daɣiri maa bahi.
en: I will scatter you throughout every nation on earth and put a stop to your sinful ways.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ jɛrigu niŋ tol ni pahi bɛ ni yɛn to shɛli zuɣu n-zaŋ tiliga to o, di zaa yoli, bɛ ku tooi to jɛrilim yih o ni.
en: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm daa ti tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinima ni bɛ ti bɔhi Jɔn ni o lee nyɛla ŋuni.
en: This is Johns testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him, Who are you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ nahim Izraɛlnim mini Judanima. Ka bɛn daa gbahi ba maa zaa kul gbib ba kirikiri, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: The people of Israel and Judah are slaves. The enemy took them, and the enemy will not let Israel go.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti bi zan tuh o, hal di yi nyɛ Naawuni daadiini zuɣulana gba, o ni chɛ ka bɛ ku o.
en: He will defeat large and powerful armies. He will even defeat the leader with the agreement.

dag: Yinim gba maliya suɣilo lala; ka kul maliya suhukpeeni, dama ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: You also must wait patiently, strengthening your resolve, because the coming of the Lord is near.

dag: Ka di ni daa be shɛm di saha maa, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ so kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bihi shɛm ni daa muɣisiri bɛ ni dɔɣ so Naawuni Shia yiko ni shɛm la, lala n-na kul nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: At that time the son who was born in the usual way persecuted the one who was born because of God's Spirit; and it is the same now.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yinyari mini zoontali ni suhufuŋbo be yi suhuri ni;.
en: The LORD will make you go crazy, make you blind, make your mind confused.

dag: Kopaliga zaŋ ba guui yomyom, ka noli di bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛli, ka so napɔŋ bi lan no bɛ wain tihi puri ni yaha.
en: You say, Evil people are taken away like things carried away in a flood. The land they own is cursed, so no one goes to work in their vineyards.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi chana, ka dabiɛm gbaai tiŋ shɛŋa din daa gili ba nim pam, ka bɛ daa bi kari doli Yaakubu bihi maa.
en: When they set out, God made all of the surrounding cities fearful so that they didnt pursue Jacobs sons.

dag: Bɛ yihi laɣ shɛli bɛ ni nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛ tumtumdiba maa.
en: They have released the money that was found in the LORDs temple and have handed it over to the supervisors and the workers.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba tah o tiŋgbɔn kasi ni zoya tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ o nudirigu tuhi fa la ni.
en: God brought them to his holy territory, to the mountain that his own strong hand had acquired.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o puli paana, o noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o lan tiɣira.
en: The stomach is satisfied by the fruit of the mouth; ones lips can earn a satisfying income.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Ifriim n-zaŋ o zali tuhi Izraɛl nuzaa, ka zaŋ o nuzaa gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ o mi zali tuhi Izraɛl nudirigu n-zaŋ ba na ti chɛ ka bɛ damd o tooni.
en: Joseph put Ephraim at Jacob's left and Manasseh at his right.

dag: Ka Asa mini tɔbbihi bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kari doli ba ni Gɛra n-daa ku Itiɔpianim maa zaa ka so bi kpalim, dama Yawɛ min o tɔbbihi daa ku ba. Ka Judanim maa daa di nɛma pam chaŋ.
en: and Asa and his troops pursued them as far as Gerar. So many of the Ethiopians were killed that the army was unable to rally and fight. They were overpowered by the Lord and his army, and the army took large amounts of loot.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣim kaman yalim zim la yuɣisi sokam zuɣu, ka ti niŋ yalim yuɣisi sara kam gba zuɣu.
en: Everyone will be salted with fire.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli sahakam n ni nam shɛli zuɣu. Suhupiɛlli ni be n ni nam Jɛrusalɛm shɛli maa ni, ka di niriba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Be glad and rejoice forever in what Im creating, because Im creating Jerusalem as a joy and her people as a source of gladness.

dag: Dinzuɣu wulimpuhili polo nim ni ti tibigi Yawɛ; ka bɛn ʒi n-dolisi teeku tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli.
en: and those in the East will praise him. The people who live along the sea will praise the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Lɛvinim ni bɛ malim bɛmaŋa m-be kasi n-kana ti guli dunoya maa, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gbib Vuhim Dabisili maa kasi. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ gba yɛla ka tiligi ma a yurilim din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ti dimnima, ka ti dimnim maa di ti nɛma.
en: You let our enemies push us back. You let them take our wealth.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N ni kana nti chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: Jesus said to the officer, I will go and heal him.

dag: Zaŋmiya zaligu kundi ŋɔ ti sɔŋ baɣili Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka la, ka di be nimaani nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Take this Book of Teachings and put it by the side of the Box of the Agreement of the Lord your God. Then it will be a witness against you.

dag: Lala ka Lɛvi zuliya ni so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ o gari.
en: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.

dag: Sokam zaa tamla n yɛla, kaman bɛ ni tamdi ŋun kpi yɛla shɛm la, hal n ŋmanila salichee gba.
en: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo gili bɛ sansani maa ni zaa yɛli, Doo bee paɣa miri ka o lan niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma la polo. Ka bɛ daa gooi niriba maa ka bɛ bi lan zaŋdi pina maa na.
en: So Moses issued a command that was proclaimed throughout the camp: Every man and woman should stop making gift offerings for the sanctuary project. So the people stopped bringing anything more.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-nyo buɣim mali chi sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Ka binnyurigu sara din yɛn pahi di zuɣu n-nyɛ wain lita yini.
en: With it you shall present four pounds of flour mixed with olive oil as a food offering. The odor of this offering is pleasing to the Lord . You shall also present with it an offering of one quart of wine.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, To, cham a chandi! A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa. Ka o nina maa daa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus said, Go. You are healed because you believed. Immediately the man was able to see again. He followed Jesus down the road.

dag: dama Jɔn daa yɛl o ni di chihiri ni o fa o tizo Filip paɣa.
en: but John told Herod, Its against the law for you to marry your brothers wife.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Amiliya lɔbu maa shili biya, amaa n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la bi simdi li.
en: Then he said to his servants, The wedding party is prepared, but those who were invited werent worthy.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi maa n-wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tum din ni tiɣ o nini. Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnim bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la, ka lan woligi yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzun paɣiba.
en: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.

dag: Amaa Ɛlihu ni daa nya ka niriba ata maa ni so bi yaag o noli garigi maa zuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi.
en: When he saw that the three men could not answer Job, he was angry.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ŋub li shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Somiya yi kpalansi, ka piri yi namda, ka kpuɣiya yi jaaŋgbɛhi gbibi, ka ŋub li yomyom, dama di nyɛla Yawɛ yaɣigari.
en: This is how you should eat it. You should be dressed, with your sandals on your feet and your walking stick in your hand. You should eat the meal in a hurry. It is the Passover of the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔhi tɔto shɛli maa ti ba naai, n ni doli yi yi sanna gari chaŋ Speen.
en: When I have finished this task and have turned over to them all the money that has been raised for them, I shall leave for Spain and visit you on my way there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa. Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la ni bɛ so miri ka o chaŋ o dɔɣiri so kuyili nti kpe daɣiri ni.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Tell these things to Aarons sons, the priests: A priest must not make himself unclean by touching a dead person.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni lab Ziɔn na nti be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la yɛlimaŋli tiŋa; ka boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zol la, zoli din be kasi.
en: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.

dag: Ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba diri ma shɛhira. Yi na ʒi n-wum o kukoli bee n-nya o ni be shɛm ni yi nini;.
en: And the Father who sent me has given proof about me himself. But you have never heard his voice. You have never seen what he looks like.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o binyɛr piɛlli ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-va buɣim mini di sara maligu maa ka chɛ tampiligim shɛli sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li sɔŋ sara maligu bimbini maa luɣili zuɣu.
en: Then the priest, wearing his linen robe and linen shorts, shall remove the greasy ashes left on the altar and put them at the side of the altar.

dag: hal sakuɣa yi ti luna saɣim tibɔŋ la zaa, ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim zaa.
en: Even if the forest falls and the humbled city is laid low.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lo ti Naawuni maa alikauli, ka yihi tinzun paɣiba mini bɛ bihi n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ kaman n dana mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum ti Naawuni zaligu ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la ni daa wuhi shɛm, ka chɛ ka di niŋ kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Lets now make a covenant with our God to send away all these wives and their children, according to the advice of my master and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the Instruction.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛl o, Bimbuɣisirigu. Di saha ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Nyama, n zaŋla bimbuɣisirigu sɔŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni; n ku lan ka bɛ sanna yaha.
en: He asked me, Amos, what do you see? A plumb line, I answered. Then he said, I am using it to show that my people are like a wall that is out of line. I will not change my mind again about punishing them.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anu.
en: There was evening, and then there was morning. This was the fifth day.

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchunima, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa bɛ bi gbuɣiri ŋubira, dinzuɣu bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani. Miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ nimdi, yi mi di ti shihi bɛ zaɣ kpima.
en: and the pig—because it has a divided hoof but doesnt rechew food, its off-limits for you. You may not eat these animals meat, and you must not touch their carcasses.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛhɔadin.
en: Amaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jehoaddin; she was from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ba sɔɣi gballi ni, bɛ gulila bɛ gballi maa.
en: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;.

dag: Nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din mali yaa! Amaa ka bɔzuɣu ka yi galindi ma?.
en: How painful are truthful words, but what do your condemnations accomplish?.

dag: Nir yi yiini yila niŋdi ŋun mali suhugarigu, di ŋmanila bɛ ni niŋ bilisitom pa yum ni la. Kaman binneembila ni be situra ni bee nɔyɛla ni be dari ni shɛm, lala ka suhugarigu dimdi daadam suhu ni.
en: Singing a song to a troubled heart is like taking off a garment on a cold day or putting vinegar on a wound.

dag: Chɛ ka n jɛma tiɣ a nini, dama m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: Let my praise be pleasing to him; Im rejoicing in the LORD!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka ka galimi bɛ biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those whose lives are faultless, who live according to the law of the Lord .

dag: Yɛlim nachimbihi la gba ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa.
en: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun bɔhim o yɛla, ka yi ni nyɛ o nyaandoliba la zuɣu, bɛ daa pun wuhiya yɛlimaŋ shɛli din be Yisa ni maa.
en: Since you really listened to him and you were taught how the truth is in Jesus.

dag: O chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali di saha; ka din pahi nyɛla, o chɛ ka ti mi din pun niŋ, din saha gari mini din na yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla. Amaa ka ti lee ku tooi baŋ ŋun Naawuni ni pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha ni o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm di bahigu ni.
en: God gave us the ability to think about his world, but we can never completely understand everything he does. And yet, he does everything at just the right time.

dag: Amaa yi yi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so, yi tum alahichi, ka Naawuni zaligu nya yi taali ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla zaligusaɣindiba.
en: But if you are treating one person as more important than another, you are sinning. You are guilty of breaking Gods law.

dag: La shɛli daa ʒe nimaani ka komihigu pali li, ka bɛ daa zaŋ gumdi tim di ni n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro gbab li n-zaŋ tiri ha n-niŋ o nol ni.
en: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi biŋgolinsi maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ tanti yini.
en: Then make bronze rings to join the curtains together. This will join the tent together into one piece.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk yɛl o, M bi mi ŋun daa niŋ lala maa, ka a mi daa bi yɛli ma, ka n gba mi na bi wum di yɛla shee zuŋɔ ka n ti wum li maa.
en: Abimelech said, I don't know who did this. You didn't tell me about it, and this is the first I have heard of it.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa, dama di nyɛla dabisili din be kasi yi sani, ka ninvuɣ so yi bi gbib li, bɛn kum o. Ŋunkam tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn yihim dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Keep the Sabbath, because it is holy for you. Everyone who violates the Sabbath will be put to death. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath, that person will be cut off from the people.

dag: M min a yi nyaɣisi pam; ti yi pahila salo zuɣu be Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: We used to share our secrets with one another, as we walked through the crowds together in Gods Temple.

dag: Ka n yi ti zaŋ ya tahi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, n ni daa po pɔri ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then you will know that I am the Lord . You will know this when I bring you back to the land of Israel, the land I promised to give to your ancestors.

dag: Bɛ daa ba o bandi n-ti o naba biɛrim, ka zaŋ kuriti ga o nyiŋgol ni.
en: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ shɛb leeg o tɔbbi kpamba n-chɛ ka bɛ su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili, ka shɛb mi su pihinunu; ka zaŋ shɛb leeg o pukpariba, ka bɛ kɔr o puu ka kpuɣir o puu atam, ka shɛb mi maani o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbutuhiri nɛma.
en: He will use them as his commanders of troops of one thousand and troops of fifty, or to do his plowing and his harvesting, or to make his weapons or parts for his chariots.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi ya ŋɔ leei dabiɛm shee mini ansarisi malibo shee, ka ŋunkam ti gari kpe, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka o mal li ansarisi zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa zuɣu.
en: I will make this city something that sounds horrible; all who pass by it will be shocked at its pain.

dag: Dama ti ku tooi niŋ din ni chihi yɛlimaŋli; faashee din kul ni doli yɛlimaŋli maa ka ti ni niŋ.
en: We cannot do anything that is against the truth but only what promotes the truth.
