dag: Niriba pam ni ti kana ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti du Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ zoli ŋɔ zuɣu n ti kpe o jɛmbu duu ka o ti wuhi ti o soya, ka ti dol o soya maa. Dama Yawɛ wuhibu ni ti yila Ziɔn na, ka o yɛligu yi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Many nations will go and say, Come, lets go up to the LORDs mountain, to the house of Jacobs God so that he may teach us his ways and we may walk in Gods paths. Instruction will come from Zion; the LORDs word from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi chɛ o yiya bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri n yuli zuɣu ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Everyone who has left houses, brothers, sisters, father, mother, children, or farms to follow me will get much more than they left. And they will have eternal life.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni niŋ n dan maa din tuhi ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, yin yɛlim ma, ka yi yi ku niŋ o, yin lan yɛlim ma. Ka n zaŋ kpa n nudirigu polo bee n nuzaa polo.
en: Now if youre loyal and faithful to my master, tell me. If not, tell me so I will know where I stand either way.

dag: Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa yi Mizipa kana ni o ti tuhi ba soli ka kumda. O ni daa tuhi ba soli maa ka o yɛli ba, Kamiya Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sanna.
en: Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, left Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he reached them, he said, Come to Gedaliah, Ahikams son.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa da jinjɛŋŋmaa maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa n-zaŋ li so.
en: So I bought them and put them on.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Ɛlifaz ti Iso; ka Basɛmat dɔɣi Riuɛl ti o;.
en: Adah gave birth to Eliphaz for Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-laɣim tɔbbihi pahi Izraɛlnim kpamba zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ Ai.
en: Early in the morning Joshua got up and called the soldiers together. Then he and the leaders of Israel led them to Ai.

dag: N daa nyɛla nachimbila, ka pumpɔŋɔ n kurigiya, amaa n na ʒi n-nya ka Yawɛ chɛ wuntizɔriba bahi bee n-nya ka bɛ bihi chani maani bara bɔri bindirigu.
en: I was young and now Im old, but I have never seen the righteous left all alone, have never seen their children begging for bread.

dag: Kom daa lim bɛ dimnim maa, ka bɛ ni yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: and drowned every one of their enemies.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim ti polo na! Be alizanda ni ka lihina nya; tiligim wain tia ŋɔ.
en: Turn to us, Almighty God! Look down from heaven at us; come and save your people!.

dag: Nyama, a kari ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka kari ma a sani; ka n leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ŋunkam ti nya ma ni ku ma.
en: Now that youve driven me away from the fertile land and I am hidden from your presence, Im about to become a roving nomad on the earth, and anyone who finds me will kill me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti ʒe teeku duli.
en: Then the dragon stood on the seashore.

dag: Mani n-su Giliad; mani n lan su Manaasa; ka Ifriim nyɛ n kurigu zuɣupiligu din taɣiri n zuɣu, ka Juda mi nyɛ n nam kurigu jaaŋgbee.
en: Gilead and Manasseh will be mine. Ephraim will be my helmet. Judah will be my royal scepter.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia sent troops to attack Jerusalem soon after Jehoiachin became king.

dag: Amaa shɛb daa bi saɣi Musa yɛligu maa, ka zaŋ shɛli zali hal ni asiba, ka di daa nyɔni wɔɣi zunzuya. Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: But they didnt listen to Moses. Some kept part of it until morning, but it became infested with worms and stank. Moses got angry with them.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni lab kuli nti lan laɣim tɔbbihi bɛn galisi gar o tuuli tɔbbihi la. Ka saha ti paai ka o zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam ka mali bidibbina n-lan labina.
en: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka tiŋ maa nim yina ti nya ka bɛ wurimla Baal bimbini maa, ka daai Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli din ʒe m-baɣ li la luhi, ka me bimbin shɛli zali di zaashee maa, ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi mali sara pa di zuɣu n-nyo o buɣim.
en: When the townspeople got up early in the morning, there was the altar to Baal broken down, with the asherah image that had been beside it cut down, and the second bull offered on the newly built altar!.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba ni ti kurim dunɔdali maa shee Yawɛ tooni vuhim dabisa dali mini goli palli dabisa dali.
en: so that the people of the land may bow in the presence of the LORD on sabbaths and new moons at the opening of that gate.

dag: Naawuni yino ŋun nyɛ ti zaa Ba, ka nyɛ ti zaa Duuma ŋun be ti zaa ni ka tumdi ti zaa ni la m-beni.
en: and one God and Father of all, who is over all, through all, and in all.

dag: N dabili m-bɔŋɔ. N ni pii so ni n suhu ni yu so m-bala. N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni. O ni ti wuhi niriba zaligu soli.
en: Here is my servant, the one I support. He is the one I have chosen, and I am very pleased with him. I have filled him with my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.

dag: Shɛli bi to Yawɛ sani. N shiri ni ti labina yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, ka Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? As I said, nine months from now I will return, and Sarah will have a son.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛli din nyɛ Saimɔn din ni, ka balim o ni o tirisim li zal o tooni biɛla. Ka o daa ʒini ŋariŋ maa ni wuhiri niriba maa.
en: Jesus boarded one of the boats, the one that belonged to Simon, then asked him to row out a little distance from the shore. Jesus sat down and taught the crowds from the boat.

dag: Yawɛ zal o nam ʒiishee la alizanda ni. O nyɛla naa ŋun su sokam zaa.
en: The Lord placed his throne in heaven; he is king over all.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka niriba maa noya daa woli.
en: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.

dag: Amaa azichi ŋɔ m-be tinim bɛn ŋmani yaɣiri duɣiri ŋɔ ni ni di wuhi ni di yiko din galisi nyɛla Naawuni dini, ka pa ni ti dini.
en: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi maani kpa shɛli din boori bahiri niriba zuɣu mini tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: oil for the lamps; spices for the anointing oil and spices for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa mɔni Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ n-daa siɣi di zuɣu na ni buɣim, ka di nyɔhi maa daa kpuɣi du kaman tampuli zuɣu nyɔhi la, ka zoli maa zaa daa dam pam.
en: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke because the Lord had come down in a flaming fire. Smoke poured out of the mountain just like a furnace, and the whole mountain shook.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Aduna maligumaana leebu piɛlaa nyɔɣu polo n-gahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka di leeg a tarili.
en: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be mɔɣu maa ni ka wum ni Nabal chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri.
en: One day, Nabal was in Carmel where his servants were cutting the wool from his sheep. David was in the desert when he heard about it.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa tintariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nuzaa polo, di ti yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli n-doli Hɛtilɔn nti gari Lɛbɔhamat n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛdad.
en: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea, then continue eastward to Hethlon, to Lebo-Hamath, then across to Zedad.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma la, ka bɛ zaŋ li yo tumtumdiba bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma maa.
en: Tell him to give the money to the men who are in charge of the repairs in the Temple. They are to pay.

dag: Jafɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Goma mini Magɔg ni Madai ni Javan ni Tubal ni Mɛshɛk ni Tiras.
en: Japheths family: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

dag: Ka Atalia daa wum bɛ ni zɔri gindi ka paɣiri naa maa, ka o daa kpe Yawɛ duu maa ni niriba maa sani.
en: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the people running and cheering the king, she went to the people at the LORDs temple.

dag: Bɛ kpiimba ni ti yɛrigi luɣilikam, ka bɛ nyom yaɣi; ka bɛ ʒim ti zɔri teeni zoya zuɣu.
en: Their corpses will not be buried, but will lie there rotting and stinking; and the mountains will be red with blood.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣi bindira pam ti ba, ka bɛ di ka nyu n-naai, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ naa sani. Ka Sirianim daa bi lan kana ti liri Izraɛlnim yaha.
en: So the king prepared a big meal for the Aramean army. After they ate and drank, he sent them back home to their leader. The Arameans did not send any more soldiers into the land of Israel to make raids.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: But I say to you that even Solomon in all of his splendor wasnt dressed like one of these.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri din nyaɣisa ni leei faralana, ka ŋunkam yuri wain mini kpam ku leei bundana.
en: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.

dag: Siria naa daa ti lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa niŋ o sapashinnim saawara, yɛli, Luɣili yaakaza ka n yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni.
en: The king of Syria was at war with Israel. He consulted his officers and chose a place to set up his camp.

dag: N ŋmanila sana dunia ŋɔ ni; di zaŋ a zaligunim sɔɣi ma.
en: I feel like a stranger visiting here on earth. I need to know your commands. Dont keep them hidden from me.

dag: Bɛn mali suhupiɛlli, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu m-mali suhupiɛlli; bɛn fabinda, yin pahimiya bɛ zuɣu fabili.
en: Be happy with those who are happy, and cry with those who are crying.

dag: ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn bɔhi ninvuɣ kura maa biɛri maa ku o, ŋun bɔh o biɛri maa ku mali ninvuɣ kubo taali.
en: and if the dead person's relative finds you and kills you, this act of revenge is not murder.

dag: amaa kom daa puhiri yirila tiŋ na m-mahigiri tiŋgbani zaa.
en: though a stream rose from the earth and watered all of the fertile land.

dag: Dabisi shɛli din daa pahiri daba ayi maa dali, bɛ daa chaŋ gili tiŋ maa la napɔŋ yim ko, ka lan lab bɛ sansani maa ni yaha. Bɛ daa niŋ lala la daba ayɔbu.
en: On the second day, they all marched around the city one time. And then they went back to the camp. They continued to do this every day for six days.

dag: To, fukumsi zaligu ni, Anabi Musa yɛliya ni ŋun niŋ lala, ti n-labim o kuɣa. Ka wula ka a mi lee yɛli.
en: In the Law, Moses commanded us to stone women like this. What do you say.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka bi saɣi ka naɣ yɛli ma mi, Di saɣiya, di lan yɛli ma yɛlli ŋɔ yaha.
en: But the Lord was angry with me because of you and refused to listen to me. The Lord said to me, Thats enough! Dont say another word about this.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kul pahirila baŋsim mini zoosim, ka mali zuɣu pam Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: As Jesus grew taller, he continued to grow in wisdom. God was pleased with him and so were the people who knew him.

dag: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ a kɔbilinina ni; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli paɣ so a ni daa kpuɣi a nachimbilim saha la zuɣu.
en: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.

dag: Dama bɛnkam ti tum din chihiri maa, bɛn yihim ba bɛ daŋ ni.
en: Anyone who does any of these detestable things will be cut off from their people.

dag: Hadad ni daa ti kpi, Samla ŋun daa nyɛ Masirɛka nir la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba ka daa ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: While Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, Why do the legal experts say that the Christ is Davids son?.

dag: A dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ a. Bɛ chahirimi, ka dimdi bɛ nyina, ka kuhiri yɛra, Ti naag o zaa. Ti ni daa guhiri dabisi shɛl la m-bala, ti bahi nya li.
en: All your enemies laugh at you. They whistle and grind their teeth at you. They say, We have swallowed them up! This is the day we were hoping for. We have finally seen this happen.

dag: A zaligu zuɣu ka binshɛɣukam beni zuŋɔ, dama binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a daba.
en: All things continue today because of your laws. Like slaves, they all obey you.

dag: Dindali maa tikpiranim ni ti wum bɛ ni karindi litaafi puuni yɛri shɛm, ka zoomba bɛn be zibisim ni ti neei bɛ nina lihi nya.
en: The deaf will hear the words in the book. The blind will see through the darkness and fog.

dag: O lihi ti la tinzunnima. O zaŋ ti mi kɔhi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋ laɣ shɛli yo ti zuɣu maa dira.
en: He treats us like foreigners. He sold us, and now he has spent all the money he was paid for us.

dag: Wain kola ŋɔ daa nyɛla zaɣ pala ka ti yi yiŋ na, ka nyam di ni chahi shɛm. Ka ti binyɛra ŋɔ mini ti namda ŋɔ gba chahila so wɔɣinli maa chandi ni.
en: When we filled these wineskins, they were new, but look! They are torn. Our clothes and sandals are worn out from the long trip.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Naawuni nam lee ŋmanila bɔ bee bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ li ŋmahindi?.
en: Then Jesus said, What is Gods kingdom like? What can I compare it to?.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli, N daa ŋma Jɔn zuɣu; ka ŋuni mi yɛla ka n lee lan wumdi ŋɔ? Ka daa lo nia ni o nya Yisa.
en: Herod said, I beheaded John, so now who am I hearing about? Herod wanted to see him.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya siɣa, ka teeya ni yuun muna ata ka n zaŋ saɣisi yi zaa ha ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: So be careful! And always remember what I did during the three years I was with you. I never stopped reminding each one of you how you should live, counseling you day and night and crying over you.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaŋ o bia Abija ŋun daa nyɛ Maaka bia la n-leei nabi kpɛma, dama o nia daa nyɛla o ti zaŋ o leei naa.
en: and he favored her son Abijah over all his other children, choosing him as the one to succeed him as king.

dag: dindina yi m-baŋmiya ni Naawuni n-zaŋ ma niŋ chirimbu maa ni, ka chɛ ka o zana gbaai ma maa.
en: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yila daa na bɛ bi diri bindirigu faashee bɛ paɣila bɛ ni pɔi. Ka bɛ daa lan paai bɛ yaannim kal shɛŋa dol li pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Pipihi mini duɣiri ni taha ni teebuya paɣibu.
en: And when these Jews buy something in the market, they never eat it until they wash it in a special way. They also follow other rules from their people who lived before them. They follow rules like the washing of cups, pitchers, and pots.

dag: Amaa di ni shɛba ni ti gali, bɛ ni ti yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi ka bɛ ka n sanna, ka a yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa lu Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu maa polo.
en: Some of the people will escape from that country. They will bring their sons and daughters and come to you for help. Then you will see how bad those people really are, and you will feel better about all the troubles that I am bringing to Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri wuntitali mini nirilim niŋbu ni nya nyɛvili mini jilima.
en: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Nahɔr daa kpuɣi paɣiba. Ibram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Zarai, ka Nahɔr mi paɣ yuli booni Milika. Milika mini Isika ba n-daa nyɛ Haran.
en: Abram married Sarai, and Nahor married Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, Yawɛ yɛligu be o ni. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa mini Jɛhɔshafat ni Ɛdom naa daa chaŋ o sani.
en: Jehoshaphat replied, He can give us the Lord 's message. The three kings went over to Elisha.

dag: Amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni paag a, ka a bi mi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Bahiyoli ni paag a yim libig a, ka a ʒi di yɛla.
en: But disaster is coming your way. You dont know when it will happen, but disaster is coming. And there is nothing you can do to stop it.

dag: Yɛlim maligumaana Aduna bia Ɛliɛza ni o yihim tulaale tuɣindi labihi maa buɣim niɛm maa ni n-kpaai di buɣim bahi katiŋa, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: Tell Eleazar, Aaron the priests son, to raise the censers from the fire and scatter the ashes about, because they are holy.

dag: Ti mi doo ŋɔ ni yi shɛl na, amaa Masia ŋun yi ti yi palo, so ku mi o ni yi shɛl na.
en: But when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from. And we all know where this man comes from.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ifriim zuliya tiŋgban ni tin shɛŋa ti Kɔhat daŋ ni ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Some of the families of the clan of Kohath were assigned towns and pasture lands in the territory of Ephraim:.

dag: Bɛn mali taali soli nyɛla so golima, amaa bɛn ka taali biɛhigu nyɛla din tuhi.
en: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.

dag: bɛ ni kpi n-chaŋ ti pahi bɛ yaannim ni m-be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ zibisim shee hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: they too will join the ancestors whove gone ahead; they too will never see the light again.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa bɔhi Gaad mini Rubin zuliya maa, Yi mabihi maa cham ti tuhi tɔbu ka yinim kpalim be kpe?.
en: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?.

dag: Yihimiya tɔbbihi maa tarili ni bin yini bini kɔbisinu kam puuni ti Yawɛ zaka. Di yi nyɛ ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi.
en: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every people or animals and give these to Eleazar.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kpɛhi ma kɔre, ka kɔre maa gbaa ma. A mali yaa gari ma, ka nyaŋ ma. N leela bɛ ni lari so asiba hal ni yuŋ; sokam maani ma la ansarisi.
en: Lord , you have deceived me, and I was deceived. You are stronger than I am, and you have overpowered me. Everyone makes fun of me; they laugh at me all day long.

dag: Niriba ni ʒe teeku noli n-gbahiri zahim zaŋ Ɛngɛdi hal ni Ɛnɛglaim. Di ni ti nyɛla lansi labbu shee. Ka zahim balibu pam ni ti be di ni kaman bɛ ni be Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni shɛm la.
en: From En-Gedi to Eneglaim, people will fish in the sea and dry their nets along the coast. There will be as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o bidibisi pini, di simdi ni di leeg o bidibisi maa dini, ka di nyɛ bɛ fali shɛli bɛ ni yɛn su.
en: The Sovereign Lord commands: If the ruling prince gives any of the land he owns to one of his sons as a present, it will belong to that son as a part of his family property.

dag: N ni chɛ ka pɔhim yi zuɣusaa yaɣa anahi ŋɔ na ti ʒe Ɛlamnima, ka n chɛ ka pɔhim maa ʒe ba bahi luɣilikam, ka Ɛlam kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba ti zo n-kuli zuliya kam ni.
en: Enemies will attack from all directions, and you will be led captive to every nation on earth.

dag: Ka ti yi pahi Masia zuɣu kpi kaman o ni daa kpi shɛm, dindina ti shiri ni pah o zuɣu neei kum ni kaman o ni daa neei kum ni shɛm la.
en: For since we have become one with him in dying as he did, in the same way we shall be one with him by being raised to life as he was.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nambu piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ Naawuni biɛhigu shɛli ti nini ni ku tooi nya ka di nyɛ o Naawunitali min o yiko din ka bahigu la dola palɔni, ka ninsalinim nyari li o ni nam binshɛŋa la ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ lan ka soli din ni doli yi taali ni.
en: Ever since the creation of the world, Gods invisible qualities—Gods eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen, because they are understood through the things God has made. So humans are without excuse.

dag: M-pahi Ogi ka diri Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi nam ni daa su luɣ shɛli zaa Bashan la. Bɛna ka Musa daa tuhi nyaŋ ka kari ba bahi la.
en: the entire kingdom of Og in Bashan, who ruled in Ashtaroth and in Edrei. He survived as the last of the Rephaim. Moses had struck down and removed them.

dag: M min ya, ka lan mi ni yi bi yuri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: But I know what kind of people you are, and I know that you have no love for God in your hearts.

dag: Filistia doo maa daa yi kul yirimina ti zaana asiba ni zaawuni n-kul niŋdi lala hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: The Philistine came out every morning and evening and stood before the Israelite army. Goliath insulted Israel like this for days.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn tumdi naa tuma m-pah o ni daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb ʒil o ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: These soldiers served the king in Jerusalem, and in addition he stationed others in the other fortified cities of Judah.

dag: Ŋun pa maligumaana zuliya miri ka o di sara maligu kasi la. Sana yi be maligumaana yiŋa bee maligumaana yi bu so paa, o bi simdi ni o di sara maligu kasi maa.
en: Only a priests family can eat the holy food. A visitor staying with the priest or a hired worker must not eat any of the holy food.

dag: Ka dindali maa ni daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yisa sɔɣi di ni, dama siliga maa shee daa bi wɔɣ ni nimaani.
en: The men put Jesus in that tomb because it was near, and the Jews were preparing to start their Sabbath day.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yi o biɛhigu shee alizanda ni kana ti darigi dunianim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ashilɔni zaa yɛla ni ti yi palo, ka tiŋgbani ti ku lan sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: Look! The Lord is coming out from his place to judge the people of the world for the bad things they have done. The earth will reveal the blood that has been spilled on it. It will no longer hide the proof of those murders.

dag: Ka a ti daŋ n tooni chaŋ Giligal, nyama, n ni ka nimaani na ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligunima. Di simdi ka a ti guhi ma nimaani daba ayopɔin hal ka n ti kana ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: You will go ahead of me to Gilgal, where I will meet you and offer burnt sacrifices and fellowship sacrifices. Wait there seven days until I come and tell you what to do.

dag: amaa ka je Iso. N daa chɛ ka o tiŋ din be zoya ni la leei dabari, ka o tiŋgbani leei tiŋgban nɛli din nyɛ yɔbahi biɛhigu shee.
en: And I did not accept Esau. I destroyed his hill country. His country was destroyed, and now only wild dogs live there.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o daa chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: When God finished speaking to him, God ascended, leaving Abraham alone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi niŋ ma, ka n daa zaŋ zibisim niŋ bɛ mini Ijiptinim maa sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka teeku kom mum ba niŋ n-di ba, ka yi nini daa nya n ni niŋ Ijiptinim maa shɛm. Ka yi daa be mɔɣu ni yuui pam.
en: So the people asked me, the Lord , for help. And I caused great trouble to come to the men of Egypt. I caused the sea to cover them. You yourselves saw what I did to the army of Egypt. After that you lived in the desert for a long time.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa teeg o nuu kpuɣi sua ni o kɔrig o bia maa.
en: Then Abraham stretched out his hand and took the knife to kill his son as a sacrifice.

dag: Daba n-su ti, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ti bɛ nuu ni bahi.
en: Slaves rule over us; there is no one to rescue us from their power.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ piri tiŋgbana maa tari Izraɛlnima ka bɛ su li.
en: These are the ones whom the LORD commanded to assign the inheritance of the Israelites in the land of Canaan.

dag: amaa o yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o tumtumdiba ni yino pini, di ni nyɛ o dini hal ni faako yuuni, di nyaaŋa ka o labisi li ti naa. O bidibisi kɔŋko n-ni tooi su o ni zaŋ binshɛli ti ba pini.
en: But if the ruler gives some of his land to one of his servants, the land will belong to the servant until the Year of Celebration, when it will be returned to the ruler. Only the ruler's children can keep what is given to them.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa teei bɛ nuhi tirina n-vooi Lɔt kpɛhi duu bɛ sani, ka yo dunoli.
en: But the two men inside reached out, pulled Lot back into the house, and shut the door.

dag: Ti daa pun bi yɛl a Ijipti ni a chɛl ti baalim ka ti jɛmdi Ijiptinima? Dama ti yi di daa jɛmdi Ijiptinim maa, di di so ti ni yɛn kpi tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: We told you this would happen! In Egypt we said, Please dont bother us. Let us stay and serve the Egyptians. It would have been better for us to stay and be slaves than to come out here and die in the desert.

dag: Miri ka a nyuri bara biɛɣuni zuɣu, dama a bi mi dabisili maa ni yɛn tahi yɛl shɛli na.
en: Never brag about what you will do in the future; you have no idea what tomorrow will bring.

dag: Ka n ti darigi Mɔabnim tibili, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Ill execute judgments in Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Bɛ daa lan sab Lɛvinim dɔɣirikpamba yɛla n-niŋ nanim yɛlikura litaafinim ni hal ti paai Ɛliashib bia Jɔhanan saha la.
en: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.

dag: Ka sapashin kpeen so mini bɛn daa pah o zuɣu ʒiɛya guli Yisa maa ni daa nya tiŋgbani dambu maa mini din niŋ maa, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia.
en: The army officer and the soldiers guarding Jesus saw this earthquake and everything that happened. They were very afraid and said, He really was the Son of God.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ darigi cheei Izraɛl nam kparibu a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-zaŋ li yɛl a kpe so ŋun so a.
en: Samuel said to Saul, In this same way the Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today. He has given the kingdom to one of your friends, a man who is a better person than you.

dag: Peentɔriba ni ti lir o, ka di bi viɛla. Bɛ ni ti to o piɛma, ka nahim o pam.
en: His enemies attack him fiercely And pursue him with their bows and arrows.

dag: M mabihi, dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya.
en: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.

dag: Ka Musa daa silim o zuɣu tiŋ yomyom n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Then Moses quickly bowed to the ground and worshiped the Lord. Moses said.

dag: Nyama, buɣim pun yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku sapashinnima ayi la mini bɛ tɔbbihi pihinunu, amaa tiligim man nyɛvili.
en: Fire came down from heaven and destroyed the first two captains and their men. But now, have mercy and let us live.

dag: n-gbahi ba ti kpɛhi duu.
en: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

dag: ni Keenannim bɛn daa be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la nim zaŋ tabili Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la nima ni Hivinim bɛn daa be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni Mizipa tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-wurindi Babilɔn, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ vuri yɔbu. Bɛ dimnim ni lu bɛ zuɣu kaman kɔgbana la. Bɛ vuri yɔbu maa ka buɣisibu.
en: The Lord will destroy Babylon very soon. He will stop the loud noises in that city. Enemies will come roaring in like ocean waves. People all around will hear that roar.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka dapaɣili kam mali dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ dapaɣa maa tuɣi taba. Niŋmiya m biɛhigu shee dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: Two side poles should be joined together with cross pieces to make each frame. All the frames for the Holy Tent must be the same.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ mani m-pii duu ŋɔ m-mal li ka di be kasi ni di chɛ ka yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka n ni chɛ ka n zaɣa be di ni ka lan yuuni li sahakam.
en: because I have chosen it and consecrated it as the place where I will be worshiped forever. I will watch over it and protect it for all time.

dag: Ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka o nya alaafee.
en: So Moses cried to the LORD, God, please heal her.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti mali bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi din ni chɛ ka di mini binyɛribila maa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o ti mal li gar o bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: At each shoulder of the ephod, there should be a shoulder piece. These shoulder pieces should be tied to the two corners of the ephod.

dag: Dama di sab Yila litaafi ni yɛli: Chɛ ka o yili zani dabɔɣu, ka so ku kpe di ni; ka Chɛ ka so zani o zaani n-deeg o ni chɛ tuun shɛli maa.
en: In the book of Psalms it says, Leave his house empty, and don't let anyone live there. It also says, Let someone else have his job.

dag: Yɛm bi bela ninkura sani, ka baŋsim mi bi bela nir yuusim ni?.
en: Old people have wisdom, but God has wisdom and power. Old people have insight; God has insight and power to act.

dag: N timd a la bɛ sani ni a ti neei bɛ nina ka bɛ yi zibisim ni kpe neesim ni, ka yi Sintani nuu ni kpe Naawuni nuu ni n-nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka nya zaashee Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sunsuuni bɛ ni niŋ man Yisa yɛda zuɣu. .
en: to open their eyes. Then they can turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, and receive forgiveness of sins and a place among those who are made holy by faith in me.

dag: Ka n daa ta ba daɣiri bɛmaŋmaŋ pina tibu ni din nyɛ bɛ bidib tuuli kam zaŋ mali sara puuni ni di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri saɣim din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and I let them offer me unacceptable sacrifices, including their first-born sons. I did this to horrify them and to let them know that I, the Lord , was punishing them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi maa ha ka bɛ yɛli taba, Doo maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum bee sarika kpɛhibu.
en: But before they left, they said, This man isn't guilty of anything. He doesn't deserve to die or to be put in jail.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima ka tummiya di tuma; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: You will keep my rules and do them; I am the LORD, who makes you holy.

dag: N ni daa kul tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa saha shɛli maa, ka Bɛnaaya bia Pɛlatia daa kpi. Di saha ka n daa lu tiŋa n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka kuhi pam yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yɛn bahi naala Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: While I was prophesying, Pelatiah dropped dead. I threw myself face downward on the ground and shouted, No, Sovereign Lord ! Are you going to kill everyone left in Israel.

dag: Daadamnim bi malila tuun kpɛma tumbu dunia ŋɔ ni? Ka bɛ dabisa bi ŋmanila bɛ ni bu so paa dabisa?.
en: Why is life so hard? Why do we suffer?.

dag: Ibrahimma Naawuni mini Nahɔr Naawuni ni bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti ti. Ka Yaakubu daa po o ba Yisahaku ni jɛmdi Naawuni so maa.
en: May the God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, and the God of their ancestors judge us guilty if we break this agreement. Jacobs father, Isaac, called God Fear. So Jacob used that name to make the promise.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Tuuli Adam nyɛla Naawuni ni daa nam so ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ, ka Adam ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa mi nyɛ Shi so ŋun tiri nyɛvili.
en: As the Scriptures say, The first man, Adam, became a living person. But the last Adam is a life-giving spirit.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni yɛli, Ti lan ka naa, dama ti bi zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔ ka naa lee yɛn niŋ ti ti.
en: These people will soon be saying, We have no king because we did not fear the Lord . But what could a king do for us anyway.

dag: Yɛlim paɣ kura la gba ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura, ka pa ni munaafichinima bee bɛn nyɛ danyubo daba. Di simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn wuhiri din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper.

dag: Hal bɛ yi du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti sɔɣi, n ni bo n-nya ba gbahi ba. Ka bɛ yi zomi kpe teeku ni nti sɔɣi di bulli ni, n ni chɛ ka teeku ni wahu dim ba.
en: If they hide at the top of Mount Carmel, I will find them there and take them from that place. If they try to hide from me at the bottom of the sea, I will command the snake, and it will bite them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi bɛ zɔnima laara nyabu zuɣu, bɛ bihi ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: In the old proverb someone betrays his friends for money, and his children suffer for it.

dag: Hal yi naɣikɔra mini bunsi bɛn kɔri yi puri ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ soobul mini soobul jɛba yɛli bindir shɛli.
en: Your cattle and donkeys will have all the food they need. There will be much food. You will have to use shovels and pitchforks to spread all the food for your animals to eat.

dag: Baŋmiya yi suhuri ni ni nir ni saɣisir o bidibiga shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ gba saɣisiri ya.
en: Remember that the Lord your God corrects and punishes you just as parents discipline their children.

dag: Ka bɛ kukoya maa vuri daa chɛ ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli tanzaa sɔhigi, ka nyɔhi pali duu maa zaa.
en: The doorframe shook at the sound of their shouting, and the house was filled with smoke.

dag: Yawɛ malaika kul gulila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura; ka fari ba bahira.
en: His angel guards those who honor the Lord and rescues them from danger.

dag: N Naawuni, n Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ ma bahi? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a be katiŋ ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu n ŋuhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha.
en: My God! My God, why have you left me all alone? Why are you so far from saving me— so far from my anguished groans?.

dag: Di ni simdi ni yi yɛli shɛm nyɛla: Ti Duuma yi saɣi, ti ni be ka niŋ dimbɔŋɔ bee dini ŋɔ.
en: Heres what you ought to say: If the Lord wills, we will live and do this or that.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lih o ka yɛli, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni!.
en: Jesus saw that he was sad and said, How hard it is for rich people to enter the Kingdom of God!.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb bɛn kpalim, alɔbo ni di ba, ka bɛ pakoya ku kum bɛ kuya.
en: All those who are left will die, and the widows will not even cry for them.

dag: A min a paɣa ni a bidibisi la ni bɛ paɣiba yim ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: Leave the boat. You, your wife, your sons, and your sons wives should go out now.

dag: Ka Pita mini Jɔn mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka Pita ti yɛl o, Lihim ti.
en: Peter and John looked at the crippled man and said, Look at us.

dag: So kani m-be kasi kaman nyin Yawɛ, so lan kani m-pah a zuɣu. Tampin shɛli mi kani m-be kaman nyin Yawɛ.
en: No one is holy like the Lord ; there is none like him, no protector like our God.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ doli Naawuni ni daa yɛli shɛm la: Yaakubu ka n yura, ka je Iso.
en: As the Scriptures say, I loved Jacob, but I hated Esau.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di bahigu saha ni ti paai ka o bahi nam balibu kam mini bɛn su fukumsi ni yiko balibu kam yoli, ka zaŋ o nam ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba la.
en: Then the end will come; Christ will overcome all spiritual rulers, authorities, and powers, and will hand over the Kingdom to God the Father.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ o, ka daa tim anabi o sani ka o ti yɛl o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a jɛmdi tinzun buɣ shɛŋa din daa bi tooi tiligi dimaŋmaŋ niriba a nuu ni la.
en: The Lord was very angry with Amaziah, so he sent a prophet to him. The prophet said, Amaziah, why have you worshiped the gods those people worship? Those gods could not even save their own people from you.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ŋun Jɔn sani nti yɛl o Yisa ni daa niŋdi shɛlikam maa zaa yɛla.
en: John's followers told John everything that was being said about Jesus. So he sent two of them to ask the Lord, Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else.

dag: Yilimiya yila jɛm Yawɛ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o tiligi tarimba nyɛviya tuumbiɛrinim nuu ni.
en: Sing to the Lord ! Praise the Lord ! He rescues the oppressed from the power of evil people.

dag: Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinima n-zani Anabi Musa zaashee;.
en: The legal experts and the Pharisees sit on Moses seat.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ pala din kpɛm pam yi sani bee din be katiŋ ha.
en: The command that I am giving you today is not too difficult or beyond your reach.

dag: Ka bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn daa be tiŋkpansi daa yi kani bɛ sanna sahasaha nti sɔŋdi ba daba ayopɔinpɔin.
en: The gatekeepers relatives who lived in the small towns had to come and help them at certain times. They came and helped the gatekeepers for seven days each time.

dag: A bi nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu?.
en: Don't you see what they are doing in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?.

dag: Ka ŋun bi be nyam maa yi shihi binshɛlikam, di ni leei din bi be nyam, ka ŋunkam mi shihi li ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: When you are unclean, everything you touch becomes unclean, and anyone who touches you will be unclean until evening.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zuɣu a lan pala dabili, amaa a nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka a yi nyɛla Naawuni bia, dindina a nyɛla ŋun dir o bini.
en: Therefore, you are no longer a slave but a son or daughter, and if you are his child, then you are also an heir through God.

dag: amaa ti kul bela suɣa ni, ka doli ti yab Jɔnadab ni daa zali ti ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa.
en: We have lived in tents and have obeyed everything our ancestor Jonadab commanded us.

dag: Ka Neetan bia Azaria nyɛ tuma kpamba zuɣulana. Ka Neetan bia Zabud nyɛ maligumaana ni naa zɔsimo.
en: Chief of the district governors: Azariah son of Nathan Royal Adviser: the priest Zabud son of Nathan.

dag: Ka nyɔhi yir o nyɛvoya ni kaman mɔri ka bɛ zaŋ mali buɣim n-zaŋ duɣu tam la.
en: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot.

dag: A ni daa bi doli wuntia soli n-niŋ daabiligu, ka tum alahichi pam zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a jɛmbu duri. Dinzuɣu ka buɣim yi a ni na n-di a zaa; ka n daa chɛ ka a leei tampiligim do tiŋa bɛn zaa daa nya a ninni.
en: You did such evil in buying and selling that your places of worship were corrupted. So I set fire to the city and burned it to the ground. All who look at you now see you reduced to ashes.

dag: N daa nya a luɣ kasi shee la; N daa nya a yiko min a jilima la.
en: Let me see you in the sanctuary; let me see how mighty and glorious you are.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla n daa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa din bi viɛla mini zaligu shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku be n-ti ba.
en: Then I gave them laws that are not good and commands that do not bring life.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa kpahiri yi nuhi, ka mali yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yi suhuri paligi yi ni lo zaɣ biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo la zuɣu.
en: You hated Israel so much that you clapped and shouted and celebrated.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm kawana pali bɛ kpalansi ka labisi bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi maa ni, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindirigu ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala ti ba.
en: Joseph told the servants to fill the bags with grain. The brothers had given Joseph the money for the grain, but he didnt keep the money. He put the money in their bags of grain. Then he gave them what they would need for their trip back home.

dag: ka yɛli, N dan naa, nyini n-daa yɛli, Adɔnija ni di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: He said, My master the king, you must have said, Adonijah will become king after me and will sit on my throne.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda ya la, amaa ka ŋmaligi zaŋ li tahila Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Giiti nir la yiŋa.
en: So he did not take the Holy Box with him to the City of David. He left it at Obed Edoms house. Obed Edom was from the city of Gath.

dag: Di zɔriya bɛn ni tooi ku daadam ka ku tooi ku o shia; amaa zomiyala Naawuni ŋun ni tooi zaŋ daadam niŋgbuŋ min o shia zaa niŋ buɣim ni la.
en: Dont be afraid of those who kill the body but cant kill the soul. Instead, be afraid of the one who can destroy both body and soul in hell.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi zaɣisi, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ kpi bɛmaŋmaŋ ʒilinsi zuɣu.
en: But if not, they will die in ignorance and cross the stream into the world of the dead.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli, ka zaŋ ma doli so viɛlli, n dimnim zuɣu.
en: LORD, teach me your way; because of my opponents, lead me on a good path.

dag: Sulemaana daa dila nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa yuun pihinahi.
en: Solomon ruled in Jerusalem over all Israel for years.

dag: N wuntia biɛhigu laara ka Yawɛ daa ti ma maa; n ni ka galimi la samli ka o yo ma maa.
en: The Lord rewards me because I do what is right; he blesses me because I am innocent.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Cham ti bol a yidan na.
en: Jesus told her, Go get your husband and come back.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ku zaɣis o niriba; o ku chɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda bahi.
en: The Lord will not leave his people. He will not leave them without help.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi maa zuliya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yɛla m-bala. Bɛ ni ka zuliya kam yina n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ zaa, kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa.
en: This is the list of the families from Noahs sons. They are arranged according to their nations. From these families came all the people who spread across the earth after the flood.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔri nanima anu bɛn daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-teei gili ba.
en: So these five Amorite kings joined their armies together. Their armies went to Gibeon, surrounded the city, and began fighting against it.

dag: Ti ni daa chɛbisi ba bahi ka ti ŋariŋ yiɣisi n-zaŋ sochibiga nti paai Koos n-naanyi neei biɛɣu m-paai Rodis n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Patara.
en: After saying goodbye, we sailed straight to Cos. The next day we reached Rhodes and from there sailed on to Patara.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛn zɔr o ni, bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa.
en: The Lord will bless his followers, great and small.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa ni labina ti tuhi tiŋ ŋɔ nima. Bɛ ni tuhi deei li, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: The Babylonians will return and attack this city. They will capture it and burn it down.

dag: Yi daa bi zaŋ piɛri na nti mali sara nyo buɣim ti ma jilima. M bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ sara maligunim na ti ti ma. M mi bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ tulaale zim na ti tuɣili ti ma.
en: You didnt bring me lambs for your entirely burned offering; you didnt honor me with your sacrifices. I didnt make you worship with offerings; I didnt weary you with frankincense.

dag: Naawuni ti o naa nasara din galisi; ka wuhi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili la polo; zaŋ chaŋ Dauda min o zuliya sani pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord helps his king win battle after battle. He shows his faithful love to his chosen one, to David and his descendants forever.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla; ka o daa zaŋ ba niŋ Sisɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hazɔrinim naa Jabin sapashin kpɛm la nuu ni. Ka lan zaŋ ba niŋ Filistianim mini Mɔabnim nanim nuu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋme ba tɔbu.
en: But your ancestors forgot the Lord their God. So he let them become the slaves of Sisera, the commander of the army at Hazor. Then the Lord let them become the slaves of the Philistines and the king of Moab. They all fought against your ancestors.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord replied:.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni daa nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-kuli Ijipti. Yaakubu daa zaŋla o daŋ zaa bɛn nyɛ.
en: They took their livestock and their possessions that they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and arrived in Egypt, Jacob and all of his children with him.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni ti ni deei nam shɛli din ku tooi dam ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka chɛliya ka ti lan paɣi Naawuni ka zo o n-lu o sizuura ka jɛm o la jɛmbu shɛli din ni tiɣ o nini;.
en: Let us be thankful, then, because we receive a kingdom that cannot be shaken. Let us be grateful and worship God in a way that will please him, with reverence and awe;.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ bir o puu ni, ka di zooi niŋ tia hal ka noonsi ti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu la.
en: Its like a mustard seed that someone took and planted in a garden. It grew and developed into a tree and the birds in the sky nested in its branches.

dag: Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Separate yourselves from this community so that I may consume them in a moment.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu din daŋ tooni ni din nyɛ kpɛma.
en: This is the first and most important command.

dag: Tahima ŋɔ puuni ka ti daa tiligi; amaa pa nir nini ni nya shɛli n-nyɛ tahima, dama ŋuni n-lee ni niŋ tahima o nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu?.
en: For it was by hope that we were saved; but if we see what we hope for, then it is not really hope. For who of us hopes for something we see?.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbutuhiriba chɛ tɔbu tuhibu. Bɛ kpalim bela bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yaa. Bɛ kpalimla paɣiba. Bɛ niŋ buɣim dabi bɛ yiya, ka kabisi bɛ dunɔdaya dakparita.
en: The Babylonian soldiers have stopped fighting and remain in their forts. They have lost their courage and have become helpless. The city gates are broken down, and the houses are on fire.

dag: Ka zaŋ ti m-buɣisi ti nachintab bɛn diri nayili bindirigu ka nyuri di binnyura la n-nya ti bebu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm. Ka a yi kpahim ti nya, nyin niŋm tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ kaman a ni nya ka di simdi shɛm.
en: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.

dag: Kpahim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be gbiŋgbaŋ ni la zuɣu ni; ka kpahi zuliya kam naɣilahi mini bɛ naɣibihi la zuɣu ni. Nom taai ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yu farigu deebu pam la. Wurimmi zuliya shɛb bɛn yuri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla pam la.
en: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: Then the Lord changed his mind about this. The Lord said, It will not happen.

dag: O tɔbbihi ni shɛb ni ti kana ti daɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sansani. Ka o ni ti kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu din tahiri saɣiŋgu na zali di zaani.
en: Some of his soldiers will make the Temple ritually unclean. They will stop the daily sacrifices and set up The Awful Horror.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a ti ti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri mini ti ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa ti nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa.
en: Moses answered, Then you would have to provide us with animals for sacrifices and burnt offerings to offer to the Lord our God.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti mi? A bi lan zaŋdi ti tɔbbihi chani tɔbu ni?.
en: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.

dag: Doliya yi ni bɔhim shɛli mini yi ni deei shɛli n san la zaŋ tabili n yɛtɔɣa mini n tuma; ka Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la ni be yi sani.
en: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim suhuri je o niriba maa, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛmbimbiɛri soli n-nahim o daba maa.
en: whose hearts God changed so they hated his people and dealt shrewdly with his servants.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lan lih o, ka yum maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: The priest will examine you again, and if it has spread, he shall pronounce you unclean; it is a dreaded skin disease.

dag: dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili paaya, ka ŋuni n-ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li.
en: The terrible day of their anger is here, and who can stand up against it.

dag: Hal di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni m birigiya, m biriginsim maa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: Even if I have done wrong, how does that hurt you?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ ania di suɣilo hal ti shiri nya alikauli maa palibu.
en: So Abraham obtained the promise by showing patience.

dag: bee n-zo nandan nambɔɣu o saria karibu ni o ni nyɛ nandan zuɣu.
en: But dont privilege unimportant people in their lawsuits either.

dag: N ni guli n tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka ku chɛ ka tɔbbihi kpe di ni gari. M mi ku saɣi ka kpeengarigunim lan nahim n niriba yaha, dama mmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ ni di wahala shɛm.
en: I will guard my land and keep armies from passing through it. I will not allow tyrants to oppress my people any more. I have seen how my people have suffered.

dag: Amaa yɛda niŋbu soli maa ni yipa kana pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, ti bi lan be gula maa sulinsi ni yaha.
en: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.

dag: A yi zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali Yawɛ tooni, Izraɛlnim bɛn zaŋm bɛ nuhi pa Lɛvinim maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Israel are to place their hands on the heads of the Levites.

dag: Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun ni ti kari bɛn ne mini bɛn kpi saria la sani n zal a, Yisa Masia labbuna min o nam dibu la zuɣu, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima:.
en: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and because he is coming to rule as King, I solemnly urge you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa.
en: Jesus answered, Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.

dag: Ka napaɣ Atalia daa wum vuri maa, ka kpe niriba maa sani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Queen Athaliah heard the noise being made by the guards and the people, so she hurried to the Temple, where the crowd had gathered.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi Ijipti na ka nyɛ bɛn paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana bɛ so nini ku nya n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la; dama bɛ bi doli ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: None of the persons that went up from Egypt, those years old and above, will see the fertile ground that I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, because they didnt remain true to me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a nam zuliya pam, ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi, ka nanim ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: I will give you a lot of descendants, and they will become great nations. Some of them will even be kings.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka Sairiini do so ŋun yuli daa booni Saimɔn yi tinshee garita, ka bɛ gbaag o nti zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li doli Yisa.
en: The soldiers led Jesus away. At that same time there was a man from Cyrene named Simon coming into the city from the fields. The soldiers forced him to carry Jesus cross and walk behind him.

dag: Ka Dauda daa po lala pɔri maa Sool sani. Di saha ka Sool daa kuli, ka Dauda min o niriba maa mi labi bɛ sɔɣisili maa shee.
en: David promised that he would. Then Saul went back home, and David and his men went back to their hiding place.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana n-niŋ tinsi maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka di niŋ yaa pam. O ni daa su Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliyanim shɛm m-bala.
en: Also, he put shields and spears in every city and made the cities very strong. He kept the peoples and cities of Judah and Benjamin under his control.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn zaŋ hal ti paai Ramatimizipa mini Bɛtɔnim ni zaŋ hal ti paai Mahanaim zaŋ chaŋ Dɛbir tintariga.
en: Their land included the area from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, from Mahanaim to the land of Debir.

dag: Rubin zuliya bɛn daa ʒiya gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni pihinu ni yini ni kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ bɛn yɛn doli pahi buyi.
en: The total number of men in all the divisions of Reubens camp is . His camp will be the second group to move when the people travel from place to place.

dag: N ni ti ba nyɛvil wɔɣinli; ka wuhi ba n tiliginsim.
en: Ill fill you full with old age. Ill show you my salvation.

dag: Ka o daa mali ti paai yili maa ni n-zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu kpe yili maa ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni so dol o kpe naɣila bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma.
en: Jesus went to the house. He let only Peter, John, James, and the girls father and mother go inside with him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tampiŋ bi be kaman ti Tampiŋ ŋɔ. Hal ti dimnim maa gba mi lala.
en: The rock of our enemies is not strong like our Rock. Even our enemies know that.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhimiya.
en: and he said to them, The sorrow in my heart is so great that it almost crushes me. Stay here and keep watch with me.

dag: Amaa nyin suhu min a nini kul mirigila a nyamma din bi doli so shɛli din tuhi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka a kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali, ka doli kiŋkansi soli nahindi niriba.
en: But you set your eyes and heart on nothing but unjust gain; you spill the blood of the innocent; you practice cruelty; you oppress your subjects.

dag: Dɔbba ŋɔ mi nyɛla bɛn tɛha bie ni bɛn yɛda niŋbu pa alali. Janeez mini Jambireez ni daa chihi Anabi Musa yɛligu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ gba chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli;.
en: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.

dag: Yawɛ be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ni; ka o nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni. O nini nyari daadamnima, ka kpahindi ba.
en: The Lord is in his holy temple; he has his throne in heaven. He watches people everywhere and knows what they are doing.

dag: Amaa fɔntinsi maa ni biŋkɔbiri mini di nɛma zaa, ti daa zaŋ li ka di leei ti ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: We took the livestock and plundered the towns.

dag: Yuun shɛli din nyɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa puuni, sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su binshɛɣukam.
en: In the year of Jubilee, you will go back to your own property.

dag: ni yi mali biɛhigu shɛli din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun boli ya kpɛh o nam ni min o jilima ni la nini.
en: We appealed to you, encouraged you, and pleaded with you to live lives worthy of the God who is calling you into his own kingdom and glory.

dag: lala ka daadamnim doya ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha, hal ka sagbana ti lan kani, bɛ ku lan yiɣisi, bee n-neei bɛ gom maa ni.
en: people die, never to rise. They will never wake up while the sky endures; they will never stir from their sleep.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhi pateesanim maa tuɣ taba din ni chɛ ka m biɛhigu shee maa ti nyɛ zaɣ muni yini.
en: Make fifty gold hooks with which to join the two sets into one piece.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bɛrishiiba ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: Hazar-Shual, Beersheba.

dag: Bɛ daa teeri ni Naawuni n-nyɛ bɛ Tampiŋ Kpiɔŋ ŋun tiligiri ba, ka lan teeri ni Zallakudura Naa n-nyɛ ŋun fari ba bahira.
en: They remembered that God was their protector, that the Almighty came to their aid.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: and the Lords word was broadcast throughout the entire region.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ chi bee kawana mali maha na ti mali sara, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni m-mal li, ka dabindi ka di ni bee karikaasi shɛli din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ shɛli ni.
en: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.

dag: Jarɛd ni daa dɔɣi Inok maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Jared had more children.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpihim buɣa yuli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ku lan teei di yɛla yaha. N ni ti lan vuui anab ʒirinim mini buɣijɛmbo tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, At that time I will remove all the idols from the earth. People will not even remember their names, and I will remove the false prophets and unclean spirits from the earth.

dag: bɛ so nini ku nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po ni n ni zaŋ ti bɛ yaannim la. Bɛn ʒiɛm ma la so nini ku nya li.
en: will see the land I promised to their ancestors. All who disrespected me wont see it.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yɛla, dama o yuli daa duya pam. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛli, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-lan neei kum ni na, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: Now King Herod heard about all this, because Jesus' reputation had spread everywhere. Some people were saying, John the Baptist has come back to life! That is why he has this power to perform miracles.

dag: Na so ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana yi su tarimba, o ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun ŋumda bee jɛŋgbini ŋun yiɣina ni o gbaai so.
en: An evil ruler over those who are helpless is like an angry lion or a charging bear.

dag: Mɔabnim mbusim nyabu saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha paari yomyom.
en: Moab's doom approaches; its ruin is coming soon.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku be kaman bɛ yaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tipawumlinim mini duŋtaariba ʒiɛmani niriba la. Bɛ daa nyɛla ʒiɛman shɛli niriba bɛn bi ʒe yim bɛ suhuri ni. Bɛ daa lan nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim.
en: They will not be like their ancestors, a rebellious and disobedient people, whose trust in God was never firm and who did not remain faithful to him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba; ka ti gbahi bɛn kpalim ti leei daba zuliya kam ni; ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ti deei Jɛrusalɛm n-yɔɣiri gindi hal ti paai Naawuni ni zali ni bɛ su li yuma shɛm tariga.
en: Some of the people will be killed by soldiers. Others will be made prisoners and taken to all the different countries. The holy city of Jerusalem will be under the control of foreigners until their time is completed.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana ni zali di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di doli yuun shɛŋa din na kpalim ni bɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa, ka yi ni tooi yihi shɛli yi daa maa ni.
en: But if the person dedicates the piece after the Jubilee year, the priest will calculate the price according to the years that are left until the next Jubilee year, and the value will be reduced.

dag: bɛ yi bi niŋdi niriba din tuhi Zallakudura Naa tooni.
en: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything.

dag: Ka mɔɣili kom daa zɔri yiri Idɛn na n-teeni puu maa; ka di daa woligi n-niŋ mɔɣ anahi nimaani.
en: A river flows from Eden to water the garden, and from there it divides into four headwaters.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti nya ka ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali galisi pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha zaa kul nyɛla din bie sahakam.
en: When the Lord saw how wicked everyone on earth was and how evil their thoughts were all the time.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti namda, ka ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka o nam ti ni ti mali biɛhigu shɛli din ni tumdi tuun sun shɛŋa o ni daa pun zali ni ti tumdi la.
en: Instead, we are Gods accomplishment, created in Christ Jesus to do good things. God planned for these good things to be the way that we live our lives.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Manɔa suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka Naawuni malaika maa lan lab paɣ maa sanna saha shɛl o ni daa yi mɔɣ kpaŋ ti ʒiya. Amaa o yidan Manɔa daa ka o sani.
en: God did what Manoah asked, and his angel came back to the woman while she was sitting in the field. Her husband Manoah was not with her.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali shɛb maa, bɛna ka o boli; ka o ni boli shɛb maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani; ka o ni chɛ ka shɛb yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani maa, bɛna ka o chɛ ka bɛ nya o jilima.
en: And so those whom God set apart, he called; and those he called, he put right with himself, and he shared his glory with them.

dag: ni di taɣi Sintani bahi ka o ku nyaŋ ti, dama ti bi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ o yikombiɛri tuma la polo.
en: I did this so that Satan would not win anything from us. We know very well what his plans are.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la shiri niŋ pali. O daa yɛlimi ni Naawuni yɛliya: Yi ni wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Yi ni nya m-maan lab nya, amaa ka ku baŋ yi ni nya shɛli maa.
en: So the prophecy of Isaiah applies to them: This people will listen and listen, but not understand; they will look and look, but not see.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa su nanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti sunsuuni nanim zaa zaŋ tabili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: He ruled all the nations from the Euphrates River in the north to the land of Philistia in the south, as far as the border of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti be bɛ sani. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will know that I am the Lord their God who brought them out of Egypt so that I could live among them. I am the Lord their God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii shɛb maa n-daa nyɛ: Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria. Bɛ mi zaa daa yi la Juda zuliya ni na.
en: Among these young men from the Judeans were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

dag: N yaannim daa tuhi saɣim fɔntinsi din nyɛ Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ka daa ku Bɛtidɛn niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa, ka bɛ zaa naawuna daa bi tooi tiligi ba.
en: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyari daadamnim tuma zaa, ka mi bɛ soya zaa.
en: The Lord clearly sees everything you do. He watches where you go.

dag: Ka Maata yɛl o, M mi ni o ni ti neei kum ni zaadali.
en: Martha answered, I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.

dag: O ni daa ti neei kum ni la nyaaŋa ka o nyaandoliba teei ni o daa pun yɛli yɛlli ŋɔ zali; ka daa niŋ Naawuni Kundi mini Yisa ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa yɛda.
en: After he was raised from death, his followers remembered that he had said this. So they believed the Scriptures, and they believed the words Jesus said.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Nandahima gbaai ma pam. Chɛ ka ti kpalimla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya. Amaa di chɛ ka n kpalim ninsalinim nuu ni.
en: David said to Gad, This is a terrible situation to be in. But it would be better to be punished by the Lord than by anyone else, because he is very merciful.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, n gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani;.
en: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.

dag: Jɛrigu n-zaɣisir o ba ni wuh o shɛli, amaa ŋunkam deeri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun mali yɛm.
en: Fools refuse to listen to their fathers advice, but those who accept discipline are smart.

dag: Dama bɛ suhuri kul palila nia biɛri n-diri kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu buɣim la. Yuŋ yi paai bɛ suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila wurigu buɣim doya, ka biɛɣu ti neei ka di taai kaman buɣim zibizibi la.
en: They approach like a hot oven, their hearts burning. Throughout the night, their anger smolders; in the morning, it continues to burn like a flaming fire.

dag: Ka Zakaria yɛli malaika maa, N kurigiya, ka m paɣ gba kurigi pam. Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Zechariah said to the angel, How can I be sure of this? My wife and I are very old.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa yiɣisi zaŋ bɛ tuuta doli tab gbilligbilli pa bɛ zuɣu. Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: Then came the three divisions from Reubens camp. They traveled under their flag. The first group was the tribe of Reuben. Elizur son of Shedeur was the commander of that group.

dag: Bɛ valila azichi, ka lan ti li bahina, Naawuni n-yihi li bɛ puya ni bahina.
en: The evil man will spit out the riches he has swallowed. God will make him vomit them up.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ li pah o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb ka fa bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa shɛŋa la zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ. O ni daa fa li tin shɛŋa nim sani n-nyɛ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknima.
en: David gave these gifts to the Lord , just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kpalim be Obɛdɛdom Gaat nir maa yiŋ chira ata, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim zaa ni.
en: The LORDs chest stayed with Obed-edoms household in Gath for three months, and the LORD blessed Obed-edoms household and all that he had.

dag: N ni daa kul suhiri Naawuni maa, ka Gabirɛl ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pun nya do so tuuli ʒii la ni la daa yiɣi ka n ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa na. Zaawuni sara maligu saha n-daa nyɛ li.
en: That was the time of the evening sacrifices. While I was still praying, Gabriel, the one I saw in the first vision, flew quickly to me and touched me. He came at the time of the evening sacrifice.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuun suma bi zɔri nam fukumsinim dabiɛm, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun biɛri n-zɔri ba dabiɛm. A bɔri ni a ku zɔri ŋun be nam fukumsi ni dabiɛm? Dindina tummi din viɛla, ka a ni nya paɣibu o sani.
en: For rulers are not to be feared by those who do good, but by those who do evil. Would you like to be unafraid of those in authority? Then do what is good, and they will praise you.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir maa sanna yuŋ zahindi ni ti yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu.
en: That night God came to Laban in a dream and said, Be careful! Be careful of every word you say to Jacob.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka o chaŋ ti kpe yili shɛli, ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: After leaving the crowd, he entered a house where his disciples asked him about that riddle.

dag: amaa di simdi ni ti naɣ sabimi yɛli ba ni bɛ di diri buɣa maligu nimdi mini jifa ni binʒim, ka mi di niŋdi zina.
en: We should simply write and tell them not to eat anything that has been offered to idols. They should be told not to eat the meat of any animal that has been strangled or that still has blood in it. They must also not commit any terrible sexual sins.

dag: Amaa o daa bi zaŋdi dari maa sɔŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la bɛn sani, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Leeban biŋkɔbiri nyɛ zaɣ gbarima, ka Yaakubu dina nyɛ bɛn mali yaa.
en: But he didnt put branches up for the weakest of the flock. So the weakest became Labans and the strongest Jacobs.

dag: Ka o daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ bihi banim ŋɔ, ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bɔrɔbɔro ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o bee n-suh o zahim, ka o gbaai wahu ti o.
en: Which father among you would give a snake to your child if the child asked for a fish?.

dag: Miri ka a va n-zani naa tooni bee n-zani wɔɣira zaashee.
en: Dont exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or stand in the place of important people.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, amaa bimbihili maa din ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la dini.
en: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa dol o zaligunim maa be o ni, ka o mi be bɛ ni. O ni zaŋ o Shi so ti ti la n-chɛ ka ti baŋ ni o be ti ni.
en: Those who keep his commandments dwell in God and God dwells in them. This is how we know that he dwells in us, because of the Spirit he has given us.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti gbahi ya tahi saria karibu shee, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri yi ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm bee n-tɔɣisi shɛm zuɣu; di saha maa yi ni ti baŋ yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: When you are arrested, dont worry about what to say or how you should say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.

dag: dinzuɣu nol lɔbu dali amaŋmaŋ chama nti karim n ni yɛl a Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka a sabi niŋ gbaŋ ni ŋɔ ka bɛn be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni wum. Karimi li ka Judanim bɛn zaa yi bɛ fɔntinsi ni na la gba wum.
en: so you must go instead. Wait for the next holy day when the people of Judah come to the temple to pray and to go without eating. Then take this scroll to the temple and read it aloud.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Ɛdomnim tiŋa n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Kɛriɔt la. Ka Mɔabnim ni kpi tɔbu tuhibu vuri mini tɔbbihi tahigu ni kikahi kumsi zuɣu.
en: So I will start a fire in Moab that will destroy the high towers of Kerioth. There will be terrible shouting and the sounds of a trumpet, and Moab will die.

dag: O guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu soli, ka taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim barina ni.
en: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛli, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Jɛrusalɛm mini Judanima, ka di chɛ ka ŋunkam wum di yɛla niŋgbuna sɔhigi.
en: Now I, the Lord God of Israel, will destroy both Jerusalem and Judah! People will hear about it but won't believe it.

dag: Hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba; amaa lihim ma kaman a padiriba ŋɔ ni yino.
en: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. But let me be like one of your hired workers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ti chaŋ maa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia daba anu dali ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yi Jɛrusalɛm zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli ma, Tiŋ maa luya.
en: On the fifth day of the tenth month of the twelfth year of our exile, someone who had escaped from Jerusalem came and told me that the city had fallen.

dag: Nyama, dabisi shɛŋa kanna ka n ni ti mɔŋ a min a yab yiŋnim zaa yaa, ka ninkurigu ti ku be yi daŋ maa ni yaha.
en: The days are coming soon when I will eliminate both your children and the children of your fathers household. There wont be an old person left in your family tree.

dag: Filistianim maa daa du n-tamla zoli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli polo ka Izraɛlnim mi tam zoli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli polo, ka vinvamli be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: The Philistines were on one hill. The Israelites were on the other hill. The valley was between them.

dag: O daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun kul suhiri Naawuni sahakam, ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa zɔri Naawuni, ka o tiri nandaamba pina pam.
en: He and his whole household were pious, Gentile God-worshippers. He gave generously to those in need among the Jewish people and prayed to God constantly.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Aai, yi kana ni yi ti nyala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: That isn't so! Joseph insisted. You've come here to find out where our country is weak.

dag: N daa kul nyarila jilima, ka n kpiɔŋ kul be kaman tɔb palli la.
en: I thought each new day would bring more honor and be full of new possibilities.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ yi yab Ibrahimma Mɔɣili duli maa polo na nti chɛ ka o chaŋ gili Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa. Ka n daa ti o bihi pam. N daa chɛ ka o dɔɣi Yisahaku;.
en: Then I took Abraham, your ancestor, from the land across the Euphrates and led him through the whole land of Canaan. I gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac.

dag: Di saha ka zaligubaŋdib ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, a ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhiya ni a galindila ti gba.
en: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, Teacher, you said cruel things about us.

dag: Pool daa bɔri ni o baɣisila Ɛfɛsus gari, dama o daa bi bɔri ni sangal shɛli ti taɣ o zali Ɛsha. O daa niŋdila yomyom ni di yi ni tooi nani ka o paai Jɛrusalɛm Pɛntikɔst dali.
en: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus so that he wouldnt need to spend too much time in the province of Asia. He was hurrying to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by Pentecost Day.

dag: Ŋunkam je o mabia nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, ka yi mi ni ninvuɣ kura ka nyɛvili din ka bahigu o ni.
en: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo maa na zuɣu ka bɛ kpi.
en: These men died by a plague in the LORDs presence on account of their false rumor.

dag: Yɛm piligu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bom yɛm, ka a ni yɛn bo shɛli pahi nyɛla tɛhi zilima.
en: The first step to becoming wise is to look for wisdom, so use everything you have to get understanding.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: And now you are commanding me: Go and say to your master, Elijah is here?.

dag: Jɛrigu ni lo shɛli nyɛla alahichi, ka ansarisimaana mi nyɛ sokam ni je ninvuɣ so.
en: Such foolish plans are wrong, and people have no respect for someone who laughs at what is right.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Yawɛ sahakam mali alibarika, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu kpɛma ni nya mbusim.
en: Happy are those who are continually fearful, but those whose hearts are hard fall into trouble.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yi Sulemaana zuɣu yuŋ yɛl o, N wum a suhigu maa, ka pii kpe ŋɔ ni di nyɛ n sara maligu duu.
en: Some time later, the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream and said: I heard your prayer, and I have chosen this temple as the place where sacrifices will be offered to me.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yɛl o bia pakoli Tama, Kulim a ba yiŋ ti ʒini pakolim hal ka m bia Shɛla ti zooi. O daa zɔrimi ni Shɛla gba ti kpi kaman o biɛyanim maa ni daa kpi shɛm maa. Dinzuɣu ka Tama daa kul o ba yiŋ ti ʒiya.
en: Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, Stay as a widow in your fathers household until my son Shelah grows up. He thought Shelah would die like his brothers had. So Tamar went and lived in her fathers household.

dag: dama Naawuni deeri zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔr o ka tumdi din tuhi.
en: Rather, in every nation, whoever worships him and does what is right is acceptable to him.

dag: Piligu ni, zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini n-daa be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛ yɛtɔɣ yinsi.
en: All people on the earth had one language and the same words.

dag: Hal kunduna gba chɛ ka bɛ bihi mɔɣira, amaa n niriba maa bɛn malila ninkuunsi kaman taatahi bɛn be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Even a mother wolf will nurse her cubs, but my people are like ostriches, cruel to their young.

dag: Yawɛ ni tuhi ba tin ya, kul ʒiɛnya baalim.
en: You will not have to do anything but stay calm. The Lord will do the fighting for you.

dag: Ka o daa lan po pɔri yɛl o, A yi kul yɛli ma a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa hal di yi nyɛ n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni ti a li.
en: I swear that I will give you as much as half of my kingdom, if you want it.

dag: So miri ka o ti niŋ bindirigu ti bɛn kumdi kuyila ni o maai bɛ suhuri bɛ kpiimba maa zuɣu bee n-ti ba binnyurigu ni bɛ nyu ka bɛ suhuri maai hal di yi kul nyɛla bɛ banim bee bɛ manim kum zuɣu gba.
en: No one will bring food for the mourner as comfort for the dead. No one will offer a cup of consolation for the loss of father or mother.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ti chɛ ka noli yɛlibu yɛla ŋɔ zaa di yi dimnim bɛn daa nahim ya la.
en: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa kpuɣi Rut kul o yiŋa nti zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Rut ni ka o zali pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So Boaz married Ruth. The Lord allowed Ruth to become pregnant, and she had a son.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu ni yi zaa gbib naŋgban yini ka woligibu ku kpe yi sunsuuni, amaa ka yi naɣ ni zaŋla yi noya naai taba m-mali tɛhi yini ni naŋgban yini.
en: Now I encourage you, brothers and sisters, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ: Agree with each other and dont be divided into rival groups. Instead, be restored with the same mind and the same purpose.

dag: N ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu ŋɔ wuhiri ni lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ashiya din be ninsalinim suhuri ni saria Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: when God appoints Jesus Christ to judge everyone's secret thoughts, just as my message says.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daamiy o bahina. Ka bɛ daa daai Jɛzibɛl bahina, ka o ʒim yiɣ vie dukpini mini yuri, ka bɛ du n-tam o zuɣu n-nɔnno o.
en: and Jehu said to them, Throw her down! They threw her down, and her blood spattered on the wall and on the horses. Jehu drove his horses and chariot over her body.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border millimeters thick.

dag: Jɛsi bidib kpamba ata daa dolila Sool chaŋ tɔb maa ni; o bidibis ata bɛn daa doli chaŋ tɔb maa ni yuya n-daa booni Ɛliab, ŋun daa nyɛ o bidib kpɛm la, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu yuli booni Abinadab, ka ŋun pah ata mi yuli booni Shamma.
en: Jesses three oldest sons went with Saul to the war. The first son was Eliab, the second was Abinadab, and the third was Shammah.

dag: Ka n yi tumdila mmaŋmaŋ ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina n saɣiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu tuhiya.
en: And if I dont want to do what I do, that means I agree that the law is good.

dag: N dimnim kul karitimi doli ma. Bɛ loya ni bɛ di n nyɛvili. Bɛ chɛ ka n ʒila zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: My enemies are chasing me. They have crushed me into the dirt. They are pushing me into the dark grave, like people who died long ago.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun mi daa deei pɔŋ tuhili la ŋun daa yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, m pun mi a halli ni nyɛ shɛm, dama a dirila a ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri a ni bi di atam shɛli wahala;.
en: Then the servant who had received one thousand coins came in and said, Sir, I know you are a hard man; you reap harvests where you did not plant, and you gather crops where you did not scatter seed.

dag: ni lala chɛ ka bɛ dol o zalikpana, ka dol o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: all so that they would keep his laws and observe his instructions. Praise the LORD!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ mali ti paai ko shɛli, ka namɔɣili maa yɛl o, Nyam kom ŋɔ! Bɔ n-lee ni chɛ ka n ku deei kom baptaizibu? .
en: As they went down the road, they came to some water. The eunuch said, Look! Water! What would keep me from being baptized.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni o yɛn bela sagban sabila ni.
en: Then King Solomon prayed, Lord , you have chosen to live in clouds and darkness.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm zaŋ chaŋ sanzali polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the Lord s message to Jeremiah about the drought :.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana min o nyaaŋa bɛn nyɛ Sadusiinim la daa zab Yisa tuumba maa nyuli.
en: The high priest and all his friends, a group called the Sadducees, became very jealous.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋdi binshɛŋa din be kasi bahiri bahi bee n-zaŋdi binshɛŋa din mali buchi pam bahiri kuruchunima, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ no li fi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka ŋmaligina tin ya daŋa.
en: Dont give something that is holy to dogs. They will only turn and hurt you. And dont throw your pearls to pigs. They will only step on them.

dag: Yi yi yɛli Ti ni nahim o pam, dama yɛlli maa mi yila o kɔbili ni na.
en: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa gbaag o chaŋ ka o leei dabili, ka ŋme n-chɛrisi o biliɛri sɔŋ solɔɣu kam zuɣu. Bɛ daa to tɛte o ninvuɣ zuɣuri zuɣu, ka zaŋ bandi ba o kpambaliba.
en: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Man bi lan yɛn ku saha a sani yaha, ka daa dii zaŋ kpana ata chaŋ ti kuhi Absalom suhu dɛde saha shɛl o ni daa na ne n-yili oki tia maa zuɣu maa.
en: Joab said, I will not waste my time here with you! Absalom was still alive and hanging in the oak tree. Joab took three sticks in his hand and hit him in the heart.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa tim tuumba luɣ shɛli polo Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli maa. Lala ka o daa yi pun daŋdi yɛr o n-chɛ ka o tilig omaŋ nimaani n-gari buyi.
en: So the king would warn the Israelite troops in that place to be on guard.

dag: Ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa yɛli, Nyama, m mali binshɛɣukam zaa ka di niŋ zaɣ pala! Ka lan yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nira ni ni niŋ shɛli naani, ka lan nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Then the one who sits on the throne said, And now I make all things new! He also said to me, Write this, because these words are true and can be trusted.

dag: Naawuni lan yɛli yaha: A nyɛla Duuma ŋun daa nam dunia ŋɔ piligu ni, ka zuɣusaa mi nyɛ a nuhi ni tum tuun shɛli.
en: And he says, You, Lord, laid the earths foundations in the beginning, and the heavens are made by your hands. .

dag: dama alɔbo ni tooi yi bɛ sanna n-libig a, ka ŋuni n-lee mi bɛ ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu shɛl na?.
en: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring?.

dag: O daa nyaya ka so kani, ka di daa gar o pam o ni daa nya ka so kani ŋun ni mali yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yiko tiligi ba, ka di nasara.
en: He is astonished to see that there is no one to help the oppressed. So he will use his own power to rescue them and to win the victory.
