dag: Ka lala bindira maa ni nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira n-ʒiɛya gu yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa ni kum ni ti yɛn lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di chɛ ka kum ti ku ku tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima.
en: Then during the seven years of hunger, there will be food for the country of Egypt. And Egypt will not be destroyed by the famine.

dag: di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali alikama mini chi ni wain tihi ni fiig tihi ni pumpɔrinchihi tihi. Di lan nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali olivi tihi mini shikpam.
en: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey.

dag: Ka a yi ti chɛ ka a niriba ŋɔ doli so shɛlikam n-lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tin shɛli a ni pii ŋɔ mini n ni me a jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: Our Lord , sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be a daalikauli la ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri duŋ taabu kul palila tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ zibisim shee.
en: Remember the covenant you made with us. There is violence in every dark corner of the land.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa doli Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu soli min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi shɛl la soli.
en: Like King Jeroboam before him, he sinned against the Lord and led Israel into sin.

dag: Yuria ni daa ka Dauda sanna, ka o ti puh o bɔhi Jɔab mini tɔbbihi maa zaa yɛla ni tɔb maa ni chani shɛm.
en: When Uriah came, David asked him how Joab was, how the soldiers were, and how the war was going.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim yɛtɔɣa nyɛla zana din gbahiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiri yɛla ni.
en: The wicked are trapped by their own words, but honest people get themselves out of trouble.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Anabi Joɛl ni daa yɛli shɛm la. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But Joel the prophet wrote about what you see happening here today. This is what he wrote:.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tahima niŋbu tahirila suhupiɛlli na, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.

dag: Ɛliɔnai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔdavia mini Ɛliashib ni Pɛlaya ni Akub ni Jɔhanan ni Dalaiya ni Anani, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: Elioenai had seven sons. They were Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.

dag: Dabiɛm chɛmi ka ti ŋumdi kaman biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bee la, ka nandahima mi chɛ ka ti kumdi kaman ŋmana la. Ti kul guhirila yɛlimaŋli, ka bi nyari li; ka bɔri ŋun ni fa ti bahi, ka bi nyara.
en: All of us growl like bears, and like doves we moan. We expect justice, but there is none; we await salvation, but it is far from us.

dag: Ŋmaligim n suhu niŋ a zaligunim dolibu ni, ka chɛ azichi yoya bɔbu.
en: Give me the desire to follow your rules, not the desire to get rich.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi, ka o chaŋ Ɛhab sani Samaria. Ka Ɛhab daa kɔri piɛri mini niɣi pam n-niŋ o mini bɛn daa kana saani, ka daa balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima.
en: A few years later, Jehoshaphat visited Ahab in the town of Samaria. Ahab sacrificed many sheep and cattle for Jehoshaphat and the people with him. Ahab encouraged Jehoshaphat to join in an attack on the city of Ramoth Gilead.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm wahala mini o yɔɣu dabu dabisa la puuni, ka o teei o ni daa mali bin viɛl shɛŋa kurimbuni ha la yɛla. Saha shɛli o dimnim ni daa nyaŋ o niriba ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ba la, ka o dimnim maa daa yuun o ni lu maa, ka maani o ansarisi.
en: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.

dag: ka Adina daa nyɛ Harim daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Hɛlikai daa nyɛ Mɛrayɔt daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi kpamba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: On the following day we left and arrived in Caesarea. There we stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the seven men who had been chosen as helpers in Jerusalem.

dag: Lihimi Bɛhɛmɔt so n ni nam kaman n ni nam a shɛm ŋɔ; o ŋubirila mɔri kaman naɣilaa la.
en: Look at the monster Behemoth; I created him and I created you. He eats grass like a cow.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba la daa tɔɣisiri ti Duuma Yisa kum ni neebu yɛla ni yiko pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika pam daa be bɛ zaa ni.
en: With great power the apostles were making it known to everyone that the Lord Jesus was raised from death. And God blessed all the believers very much.

dag: Ka Matan bia Shɛfatia mini Pushihur bia Gɛdalia ni Shɛlɛmia bia Jukal ni Malikia bia Pushihur daa wum ni Jɛrimia yɛrila niriba maa zaa.
en: One day, Shephatiah, Gedaliah, Jehucal, and Pashhur heard me tell the people of Judah.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu ni saa tahibu la yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa n-su nam!.
en: And I heard something that sounded like a huge crowd, like rushing water and powerful thunder. They said, Hallelujah! The Lord our God, the Almighty, exercised his royal power!.

dag: ka o ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni na, ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi gbala polo na tuhir o soli.
en: As soon as Jesus got out of the boat, a man possessed by an evil spirit came out of the tombs.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kom niŋ o sagban tibisa ni, ka sagbana maa bi cheei.
en: wrapped up water in his clouds, yet they didnt burst out below.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba, bɛ niriba ata ŋɔ yi be tiŋ maa ni, bɛ ni tooi tiligila bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛviya kɔŋko bɛ wuntitali zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: If these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, lived there, their lives alone would be saved because they were righteous. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Haa Kum, a nasara dibu be ya? Haa Kum, a dimbu yiko be ya?.
en: Where, Death, is your victory? Where, Death, is your power to hurt.

dag: Naawuni, wuhim a yiko ni nyɛ shɛli, wuhim a kpiɔŋ kaman a ni pun niŋdi shɛm ti zuɣu la.
en: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ka o sanna ti yɛra, Jɔn daa bi tum alahiziba tuun shɛli, amaa o ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ doo ŋɔ polo nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: many people came to him. They were saying, John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.

dag: N ni zaŋ Raba leei laakuma mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka zaŋ Ammɔnnim fɔntinsi leei biŋkɔbbaligu gariche. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Your capital city of Rabbah will be nothing but pastureland for camels, and the rest of the country will be pastures for sheep. Then you will know that I am the Lord God.

dag: A ni suh o, ka o deeg a suhigu, ka a niŋ a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni niŋ binshɛŋa la.
en: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.

dag: Ka Shiiba daa chaŋ yaɣi Izraɛl tinsi zaa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti kpe Ɛbɛl fɔŋ din be Bɛtimaaka la ni. Ka Bikiri daŋ ni niriba zaa daa laɣim dol o kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: Sheba had gone through all of the tribes of Israel when he came to the town of Abel Beth-Maacah. All of his best soldiers met him there and followed him into the town.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zuɣu, dama di kpɛm pam. Mbusim be bɛ sujee zuɣu, dama ninkuunsi be di ni. N ni woligi ba Yaakubu daŋ ni, ka wurim ba kpɛhi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ luɣilikam ni.
en: Now I place a curse on you because of your fierce anger. Your descendants will be scattered among the tribes of Israel.

dag: Yi ni ŋma n-wurisiwurisi kaman yaɣiri duɣu la, hal ka salichee din ni mooi buɣim bee n-tooi kom kɔduɣu ni ku lan beni.
en: You will be shattered like a clay pot, so badly broken that there is no piece big enough to pick up hot coals with or to dip water from a cistern.

dag: Ka n kul ni be n niriba Izraɛlnim sani, ka ku bahi ba.
en: I will live among the children of Israel in this Temple that you are building, and I will never leave the people of Israel.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, o je m Ba gba.
en: Whoever hates me also hates the Father.

dag: Lala ka o daa yih o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ daa yiini yila.
en: He brought his people out of Egypt. They came out rejoicing and singing their happy songs!.

dag: Dauda daa bela Zif mɔɣu ni Hɔrɛshi maa. Di saha ka o daa wum ni Sool kana ni o ti ku o.
en: David was at Horesh in the desert of Ziph. He was afraid because Saul was coming to kill him.

dag: Bɛ dim maa zaŋla ziŋgoo gbahi bɛ zaa, ka zaŋ o laŋa n-vo ba na ti niŋ o daasau ni, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o suhu paligi.
en: The enemy catches all of them with hooks and nets. The enemy catches them in his net and drags them in, and the enemy is very happy with what he caught.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd pie kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: The second row had a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald.

dag: Saha shɛli Dauda ni daa di nam ʒi Hiburɔn n-su Judanim maa yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu.
en: and he ruled in Hebron over Judah for seven and a half years.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔab yaa naaya. Di lan ka yiko.
en: My decision is final— your army will be crushed, and your power broken.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, buni nyɛla din yɔhindi nira. Karimbaannim ku be. Bɛ yɛla bɛ lɔna kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee la. Bɛ ŋmanila kum, bɛ bi tiɣira. Bɛ laɣim zuliya kam leei bɛ niriba, bɛ zaŋ niriba zaa lee bɛmaŋmaŋ niriba.
en: Wealth is deceitful. Greedy people are proud and restless—like death itself they are never satisfied. That is why they conquer nation after nation for themselves.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa loya ni a ni darigi ti tibili, ka mi shiri niŋ lala. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a kul tumdila din tuhi, dama tinima n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu.
en: So the LORD oversaw the great trouble and brought it on us, because the LORD our God has been right in every move hes made, but we havent listened to his voice.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sariakaritiba ni bɛ tuma kpamba na nti yɛli ba, N kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ.
en: so he called all Israel, the elders, leaders, judges, and officers of the people, and said, I am very old now.

dag: amaa wuuni ka bɛ laɣisiri bɛ bindira sɔŋda, atam kpuɣibu saha ka bɛ vari bɛ bindira sɔŋda.
en: Even so, it gets its food in summer; gathers its provisions at harvest.

dag: Ka binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa shiri bili. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: The earth produced plant life: plants yielding seeds, each according to its kind, and trees bearing fruit with seeds inside it, each according to its kind. God saw how good it was.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli Musa, Tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni niŋ nyini ti dan ni zali ti ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then the people from the tribes of Gad and Reuben said to Moses, We are your servants. You are our master, so we will do what you say.

dag: Ka Asirianim gba pahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka Lɔt zuliya nya yaa.
en: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.

dag: Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti yɛli ni paɣiŋɔhi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi dɔɣi ni bihi ni bi mɔɣi paɣ shɛb biha mal alibarika.
en: The time will come when they will say, Happy are those who are unable to become pregnant, the wombs that never gave birth, and the breasts that never nursed a child.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, Naawuni pun kahig o nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛna, yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni ka o wuhiri ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ lihiri ka ku nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka ku baŋdi di gbinni.
en: He said, You have been given the mysteries of Gods kingdom, but these mysteries come to everyone else in parables so that when they see, they cant see, and when they hear, they cant understand .

dag: Nyin daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahigu! Tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa anahi bahigu saha paaya.
en: You, human one, this is what the LORD God proclaims to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come to the four corners of the earth!.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chani Zarɛfat nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni ka nya pako so ka o be nimaani pihiri dari, ka o bol o yɛl o, Kpɛm ti tooi kom biɛla niŋ pipia ni ti ma na ka n nyu.
en: Elijah left and went to Zarephath. As he came to the town gate, he saw a widow collecting sticks. He called out to her, Please get a little water for me in this cup so I can drink.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti wum lala niriba maa yɛligu. Di zɔnya ba nambɔɣu bee n-fa ba bahi.
en: dont give in to them! Dont obey them! Dont have any mercy on them! Dont have compassion on them and dont protect them!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba maa daa ti zab bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la nyuli n-gaŋ o, ka daa ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ijiptinim zuɣu; amaa ka Naawuni daa zan o nyaaŋa.
en: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa bɛ ku tooi nya.
en: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii niriba ayi zali; bɛna n-nyɛ: Yisifu so bɛ ni daa booni Barisabas mini Mataias.
en: So they proposed two men: Joseph, who was called Barsabbas , and Matthias.

dag: O lihi ti la tinzunnima. O zaŋ ti mi kɔhi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋ laɣ shɛli yo ti zuɣu maa dira.
en: He treats us like foreigners and has even cheated us out of the bride price that should have been ours.

dag: O ni ti ŋub o ni dɔɣi biliɛ shɛba n-tabili bɛ zoya: dama o ni ti sɔɣimi ŋub ba, yi dimnim ni ti yɛn teei gili ya ka niŋdi ya alaka shɛli yi fɔntinsi ni la zuɣu.
en: She will hide and give birth to a baby. And she will eat the baby and everything that comes out of her body with it. All these bad things will happen when your enemy comes to surround your cities and make you suffer.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛm maa na ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi chɛ ka Lɛvinim chaŋ Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm ti deei Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali Izraɛlnim ni bɛ yɔri Yawɛ alikauli suɣili farigu shɛli la na.
en: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord 's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.

dag: O daa chɛ ka dɔro be o tooni chana, ka alɔbo doli nyaaŋa.
en: The sickness went before him, and the destroyer followed behind him.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda kaman Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yir o suhu ni na kaman mɔɣa kom ni zɔri shɛm la.
en: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.

dag: Ijiptinim yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Yawɛ ni ʒini sagbani din zɔri yomyom zuɣu n-ka Ijipti na; ka Ijipti wuna nya o ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka Ijiptinim yɛma ŋma.
en: This is a message about Egypt. The Lord is coming to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The Egyptian idols tremble before him, and the people of Egypt lose their courage.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ binshɛɣukam kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ maa.
en: Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Wɔribariba mini peentɔriba vuri ni ti chɛ ka fɔŋ kam niriba zo, bɛ ni ti zo n-kpe mɔɣu ni, ka shɛb du tampima. Bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ fɔndi maa zaa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti na kul zaɣisi n noli ka ku doli ma, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin kaman yi daalahichi ni galisi shɛm tariga.
en: If you continue to oppose me and are unwilling to obey me, I will strike you for your sins seven more times.

dag: Ka Judas mini Silas bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini la daa lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa pam kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri pahi.
en: Judas and Silas, who were also prophets, said many things to encourage the believers and make them stronger in their faith.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi tiŋ maa ni dɔbba, Ka jɛmbu duu pagɔr so ŋun yi ʒiini Inaim palli naŋgbanyee ŋɔ la lee be ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: He asked some of the men at the town of Enaim, Where is the prostitute who was here by the road? The men answered, There has never been a prostitute here.

dag: Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim ni daa nya ka bɛ kumdi Atad kabɔɣili maa shee maa, ka bɛ yɛli, Nandahima titali kumsi ka Ijiptinim ŋɔ kumdi ŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛbɛl Mizraim; ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli.
en: When the citizens of Canaan saw those people mourning at Atad, they said, What a solemn ceremony of mourning the Egyptians are holding! That is why the place was named Abel Mizraim.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa mali biɛrisuŋ Naawuni sani, ka daa suh o ni o chɛ ka o me jɛmbu duu ti ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o yab Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: God approved of David, who asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kom leei ʒim, ka chɛ ka bɛ zahim kpi.
en: So he changed the water into blood, and all their fish died.

dag: Ka Shafan mi daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti naa ka yɛl o, A ni zal a kpambaliba maa ni bɛ tum tuun shɛlikam zaa la, bɛ be di tumbu ni.
en: Shaphan took the book to Josiah and reported, Your officials are doing everything you wanted.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti niŋ o yɛda nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: so that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life.

dag: Dim a bindira ni suhupiɛlli, ka nyum a wain ni suhupiɛlli, dama Naawuni pun saɣi ti a ni niŋdi shɛm maa ka di waɣa.
en: So go and eat your food now and enjoy it. Drink your wine and be happy. It is all right with God if you do these things.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka paɣ maa nyu Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mini bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba Yisa dolibu zuɣu la ʒim n-kuli. N ni daa nya o lala maa, ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me.

dag: Naawuni ŋun yihi ya Ijipti na ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yila yi sani. Yi nyandi zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi dimnima. Yi kabiri bɛ kɔba. O ni to ba o piɛma.
en: God brought them out of Egypt; He fights for them like a wild ox. They devour their enemies, Crush their bones, smash their arrows.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti leei shihirili be yi nuhi ni mini yi gbɛri zuɣu, dama Yawɛ daa zaŋla o yiko nuu yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: This is like a string tied on your hand, like a sign in front of your eyes. It helps you remember that the Lord brought us out of Egypt with his great power.

dag: Absalom daa dɔɣila bidibis ata ni bipuɣin yino ŋun yuli daa booni Tama, o daa nyɛla paɣisar viɛlli.
en: Absalom had three sons. He also had a daughter named Tamar, who grew up to be very beautiful.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi yi ti boli ma n-suhi ma, n ni wum yi suhigu maa.
en: Then you will call my name. You will come to me and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ŋumaŋuma jɛndiri ma? Yi zaa taala duŋ zaɣisi ma. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa lo nia yɛli ni bɛ zaa yinoyino bom o yaa ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga, ka bɛ zaŋ talim ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Lords followers decided that they would each send as much as they could to help their brothers and sisters who lived in Judea.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni. Ka o yɛligu maa daa gari ba pam.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God. The men were amazed at what Jesus said.

dag: Ka yi nimaani n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo hal ni Gatihɛfa m-mali hal ni Ɛtikazin nti ŋmaligi kpa Niya polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Rimɔn.
en: It continued east from there to Gath Hepher and Ethkazin, turning in the direction of Neah on the way to Rimmon.

dag: Teemiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni pa yi bihi bɛn bi mi, ka bɛ nina mi bi nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa la. Amaa yinima n-nyɛ bɛn ni wuh o galisim min o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa teeg o bɔɣu shɛm.
en: And know right now what your children havent known or yet witnessed: The LORD your Gods discipline, his power, his mighty hand and outstretched arm.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa deei pipia maa Yawɛ nuu ni n-chɛ ka o ni daa tim ma zuliya shɛb sani maa zaa nyu li.
en: So I took the cup from the Lord 's hand, gave it to all the nations to whom the Lord had sent me, and made them drink from it.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo! M Ba ni tim ma na shɛm, lala ka n gba timdi ya.
en: Jesus said to them again, Peace be with you. As the Father sent me, so I am sending you.

dag: Ti yi niŋ ninsalinim shɛhiradibo yɛda, Naawuni shɛhiradibo n-dii gari, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛli.
en: We believe human testimony; but God's testimony is much stronger, and he has given this testimony about his Son.

dag: zaŋ Nɛgɛb mini bɔpiɛligu din nyɛ Jɛriko vinvamli, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din mali dɔbino tihi la hal ni Zɔa.
en: He showed Moses the Negev and the valley that goes from Zoar to Jericho, the city of palm trees.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ ni nam dabisi shɛli. Chɛliya ka ti suhuri paligi ka mali suhupiɛlli di ni.
en: This is the day the Lord has made. Let us rejoice and be happy today!.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni du ka chɛ tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani.
en: As high as the sky is above the earth, so great is his love for those who honor him.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ yihim niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb mini mari ni yiri shɛb niŋgbuna ni ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi kpima, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ leei bɛn bi be nyam bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Command the people of Israel to expel from the camp everyone with a dreaded skin disease or a bodily discharge and everyone who is unclean by contact with a corpse.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Musa, Mmaŋmaŋ n yɛn dol a chaŋ, ka ti a vuhim.
en: The Lord answered, I myself will go with you. I will lead you.

dag: Amaa di yi ti niŋ a viɛnyɛla, n suhir a, nyin teemi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Firawuna; ka lala chɛ ka n yi sarika ŋɔ ni.
en: But please remember me when everything is going well for you, and please be kind enough to mention me to the king and help me get out of this prison.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa lo Dauda alikauli, dama o daa yur o mi kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm la.
en: Jonathan liked David so much that they promised to always be loyal friends.

dag: N ŋman piɛlli ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yino ko. O kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ o ma bipuɣiŋga. O ka dalinli. Paɣiba yi kul nya o, bɛ paɣir o mi. Napaɣiba mini naa mamanim gba yi kul nya o bɛ paɣir o mi.
en: But I love only one, and she is as lovely as a dove. She is her mother's only daughter, her mother's favorite child. All women look at her and praise her; queens and concubines sing her praises.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla yabiga nyuhi niriba ŋɔ, ka zaŋ lɔɣu ni be ko shɛl ni nyuhi ba.
en: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.

dag: Ti yaannim ni daa paɣir a ti jɛmbu du kasi shɛli puuni la, buɣim di li, ka luɣ shɛŋa zaa din viɛli ka ti daa yuri li la wurim doya.
en: and our Temple, the sacred and beautiful place where our ancestors praised you, has been destroyed by fire. All the places we loved are in ruins.

dag: A zaligunim maa chɛ ka m mali yɛm gari n dimnima, dama di kul bela n suhu ni.
en: Your commandment makes me wiser than my enemies because it is always with me.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ piɛguliba ŋɔ, kummiya, kummiya pampam, ka lunya bilim tampiligim ni, dama yi kubu biɛɣu neeya, ka yi wurim kpe yɔɣu biɛɣu neei, ka yi ni ti lu kaman duɣu viɛlli la.
en: Cry, you leaders, you shepherds of my people, cry out loud! Mourn and roll in the dust. The time has come for you to be slaughtered, and you will be butchered like rams.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya bahi kaman pɔhim din yi tiŋgban nɛli polo na ni ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri shɛm la.
en: The Lord will scatter you like straw that is blown away by the desert wind.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka niriba maa galisi kaman ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu pahi, ka chɛ ka n dan naa nini nya li, ka bɔzuɣu ka nyin n dan naa lan bɔr ni a niŋ dimbɔŋɔ yaha.
en: But Joab answered the king, Your Majesty, may the Lord your God make the people of Israel a hundred times more numerous than they are now, and may you live to see him do it. But why does Your Majesty want to do this.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di niŋ bɛn daa nyɛ yi tab la alahiziba, yi ni bi lan doli ba tumdi tuun yoya ŋɔ zuɣu, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ saɣindi yi yuya.
en: And now the heathen are surprised when you do not join them in the same wild and reckless living, and so they insult you.

dag: Bɛ kala a sanna kaman niriba ni kanna shɛm, ka ʒini a tooni kaman n niriba n-nyɛ ba la, ka wum a yɛligu, amaa bɛ ku deei li. Bɛ nyɛla naŋgbammalisimnima, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee bela bɛ bomma ni.
en: So my people crowd in to hear what you have to say, but they don't do what you tell them to do. Loving words are on their lips, but they continue their greedy ways.

dag: N ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni juɣu, ka ŋmani dabari ni viɣu.
en: Im like some wild owl— like some screech owl in the desert.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋa m-baŋ Yawɛ, o kandina ka biɛhiŋ kaman biɛɣu neebu ni ka biɛhiŋ shɛm la. O ni ka ti sanna kaman sayuɣiyuɣi ni miri shɛm la. Kaman siɣili saa ni miri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yɛn ka ti sanna.
en: Let's do our best to know the Lord . His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tɔbbihi tuhi pinaayi n-lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: There will be a total of , soldiers from the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa piɛbi kikahi; ka niriba maa tahira. Niriba maa ni daa kul wum kikahi maa kumsi; bɛ daa duhila bɛ yee tahiri pampam, ka tiŋ maa goondaa maa dii kabi ti lu tiŋa; ka niriba maa dii zɔri tuhi bɛ tooni dɛde n-kab kpe tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li.
en: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.

dag: Zuliya kam wum a vidibo yɛla, ka a kuhigu gili dunia zaa. Dama tɔbbia tuug o tɔbbi kpee, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu.
en: Nations hear of your shame; the earth is filled with your sobs. Soldier stumbles over soldier; together they go down.

dag: ni Zɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la ni Naharai ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nira ka daa nyɛ ŋun ʒiri Zɛruya bia Jɔab tɔbutuhiri nɛma la.
en: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai from Beeroth, and the armor-bearer for Zeruiahs son Joab.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, Dauda be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: When Saul was told that David was in the camps at Ramah.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm kawana pali bɛ kpalansi ka labisi bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi maa ni, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindirigu ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala ti ba.
en: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put back each mans silver into his own sack, and to give them provisions for their trip, and it was done.

dag: Yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛli maa nyɔri nyɛla yi ni nya tiliginsim shɛl la.
en: Your faith has a goal, and you are reaching that goal—your salvation.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Nyin Daniɛl, pumpɔŋɔ kpabimi litaafi maa, ka zaŋ bintabinda n-dihi tabili li sɔŋ hal ti paai saha tariga. Amaa niriba pam ni ti zɔri ginda, ka baŋsim ti yɛligiri pahira.
en: But you, Daniel, must keep these words secret! Seal the scroll until the end time! Many will stray far, but knowledge will increase.

dag: Ka Siria naa daa zal o chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba zaligu n-yɛli ba, Di ti tuhiya dabirisi, yi mi di ti tuhiya wɔɣira, amaa ti kul tuhimiyala Izraɛl naa maa kɔŋko.
en: Meanwhile, Arams king had commanded his chariot officers, Dont bother with anyone big or small. Fight only with Israels king.

dag: A ni ti nya n ni yɛn niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka di biɛr a ka a zabiri ba nyuli; amaa nyin daŋ ni so ku lan nya kɔb piɛlli o zuɣu ni hal abada.
en: You will be troubled and look with envy on all the blessings I will give to the other people of Israel, but no one in your family will ever again live to old age.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ka nimaani na, bɛ ni yihi binyoya mini binshɛŋa din chihiri la zaa di ni.
en: When my people come back, they will destroy all the terrible, filthy idols that are here now.

dag: Zaŋmiya tiliginsim kaman tɔbutuhir zuɣupila la pili, ka zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu din nyɛ Shia Kasi takɔb la gbibi.
en: Accept Gods salvation as your helmet. And take the sword of the Spirit—that sword is the teaching of God.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim. O ni tin ya kpiɔŋ, ka gbib ya ka Sintani ku paai ya.
en: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ.
en: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. After David finished, the people shouted, Amen! Praise the Lord .

dag: Di mi pala din be teeku duli ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du teeku duli ti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: Nor is it on the other side of the ocean. You do not have to ask, Who will go across the ocean and bring it to us, so that we may hear it and obey it.

dag: A ni daa ku Sool so min o yiŋnim shɛba, ka di nam zan o zaani la biɛri ka Yawɛ bɔhir a, ka fa a nam maa ti a bia Absalom maa. Nyama a bahila yoli maa, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ kura.
en: You took Saul's kingdom, and now the Lord is punishing you for murdering so many of Saul's family. The Lord has given the kingdom to your son Absalom, and you are ruined, you murderer.

dag: ni o ti darigi bɛn bi mi Naawuni mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ti Duuma Yisa lahibal suŋ wumbu la tibili.
en: He will give justice with blazing fire to those who dont recognize God and dont obey the good news of our Lord Jesus.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli bee n-doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, dindina noli dibu ŋɔ zaa ni lu yi zuɣu din ya.
en: But if you dont listen to what the Lord your God tells you—if you dont obey all his commands and laws that I tell you today—then all these bad things will happen to you:.

dag: Di pala din be zuɣusaa ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du zuɣusaa nti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: It isnt up in heaven somewhere so that you have to ask, Who will go up for us to heaven and get it for us that we can hear it and do it.

dag: A ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee ŋme n-wurim ba; ka to n-wurisi ba kaman yaɣimɛr duɣu la.
en: You will break them with an iron rod; you will shatter them in pieces like a clay pot.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɛ pulaannim zuɣu, bɛ suhuri yi kul bɔr shɛli, bɛ dir li mi;.
en: The evil man is never satisfied. But the things he wants cannot save him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ .
en: I am the God who came to you at Bethel, and there you made an altar, poured olive oil on it, and made a promise to me. Now I want you to be ready to go back to the country where you were born.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla tɔɣisibu bi mili jɛrigu, ka ʒiri gba yɛtɔɣa bi simdi nabia.
en: You wouldnt expect to hear a fine speech from a fool, and you shouldnt expect lies from a ruler.

dag: Ka ŋun daa yɛl o niriba, Nyamiya, Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zooya, ka lan mali yaa gari ti.
en: He said to his people, The Israelite people are now larger in number and stronger than we are.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti be bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, n ti ku ʒiɛm ba bee n zaɣisi ba din ni chɛ ka n ku bɛ zaa ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl la, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: But despite all that, when they are in enemy territory, I will not reject them or despise them to the point of totally destroying them, breaking my covenant with them by doing so, because I am the LORD their God.

dag: Dama saha kanna ka yi dimnim ni ti kana nti teei gili ya, ka lan me bimbin kara tabili yi gooni.
en: The time will come when your enemies will surround you with barricades, blockade you, and close in on you from every side.

dag: Ka Naa Amɔn kpambalib daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: Amons servants made plans against him and killed him in his palace.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni nam binshɛŋa galisiya pam. A yɛm puuni ka a nam di zaa. A binnɛma n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Lord , you created so many things! With your wisdom you made them all. The earth is full of the living things you made.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋa bee o nahu ni lu n-do sol ni ka a baɣa kani, di simdi ni a sɔŋ yiɣis o zali.
en: Dont just watch your fellow Israelites donkey or ox fall down in the road and do nothing about it. You must help your fellow Israelite get the animal up again.

dag: ka Ibram daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Shɛkɛm ti ʒini Mɔre oki tia gbini. Keenannima n-daa be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni di saha maa.
en: Abram traveled through the land until he came to the sacred tree of Moreh, the holy place at Shechem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu, ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani.
en: Then Jesus went back to the synagogue, where there was a man who had a paralyzed hand.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nyɛla yino, ka o mi bi bɔri sandaantimda ŋun Naawuni yino maa zuɣu.
en: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi pina; di nyɛla jɛrilim o sani hal ka o ku tooi baŋ di yɛla, dama di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri yɛl shɛŋa.
en: Whoever does not have the Spirit cannot receive the gifts that come from God's Spirit. Such a person really does not understand them, and they seem to be nonsense, because their value can be judged only on a spiritual basis.

dag: Ka a yi bahi a dabili ni o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka o chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: But when you let your slave go free, dont send him away with nothing.

dag: Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda; di mi bi miri gumdi. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni hal Sulemaana min o jilima zaa ha, o daa bi ye situra ka di viɛli kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom zaɣ yini gba viɛlim.
en: Think about how the wildflowers grow. They dont work or make clothes for themselves. But I tell you that even Solomon, the great and rich king, was not dressed as beautifully as one of these flowers.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa ti tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayopɔin saha shɛli, di daa niŋ kaman awa pirigili ka alizanda ni binshɛɣukam kul fomi chichi.
en: Then, when the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

dag: N lan kpahim baŋ yɛm mini jɛrilim ni yinyatali ni nyɛ shɛm; ka nya ka di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I was determined to learn the difference between knowledge and foolishness, wisdom and madness. But I found out that I might as well be chasing the wind.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum. Yawɛ, neem a nina nya; ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tim na nti yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-mali nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm.
en: Now, Lord , look at what is happening to us. Listen to all the things that Sennacherib is saying to insult you, the living God.

dag: Shɛb daa bela tiŋgban nɛl ni n-dari ginda, ka bi nya tiŋ ʒiina.
en: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.

dag: ka n daa ti nya ʒii ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Zom yom yi Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ ku deeg a shɛhira zaŋ chaŋ m polo.
en: I saw the Lord speaking to me. Hurry! he said. Leave Jerusalem at once because they wont accept your testimony about me.

dag: O nam dariza bi mali ya dabiɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ya o zuɣu?.
en: Gods majesty frightens you. You are afraid of him.

dag: Atɛr daŋ — kɔbigaayika.
en: of Ater, namely of Hezekiah.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Di saha Ijiptinim ni wum li, dama bɛ sani ka a daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ yihi ba na.
en: Then Moses said to the Lord , If you do that, the Egyptians will hear about it! They know that you used your great power to bring your people out of Egypt.

dag: Sagbana yi ti pali kom, saa lurimina, ka tia yi lu n-kpala nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, di ni lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka di yɛn doya.
en: There are some things you can be sure of. If clouds are full of rain, they will pour water on the earth. If a tree falls—to the south or to the north—then it will stay where it falls.

dag: O tim o yiŋ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ chaŋ tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ti boli niriba.
en: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:.

dag: Dama yi yi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni mi ni chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu kam nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, o nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe o yuli.
en: All Gods words are tried and true; a shield for those who take refuge in him.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu gɔhi ni, ka gɔhi maa zooi lim li girimgirim li, ka di bi niŋ.
en: Some other seeds fell where thornbushes grew up and choked out the plants. So they did not produce any grain.

dag: Chɛliya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma maa baalim. Chɛliya Juda gomna mini Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa baalim ka bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili la ni.
en: and do not interfere with its construction. Let the governor of Judah and the Jewish leaders rebuild the Temple of God where it stood before.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: They said, King, may you live forever!.

dag: Nyama, m bi ʒe yi nyaaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. N ni nyo yi chɛchɛbunsi buɣim ka di gbili nyɔhi, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gbuɣim pola. N ni ti mɔŋ ya bindirigu, ka so ti ku lan wum yi tuumba kukoya.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I am against you, Nineveh. I will burn your chariots and kill your young lions in battle. You will not hunt anyone on earth again. People will never again hear bad news from your messengers.

dag: ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam, ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers in space will be driven from their courses.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, so yi di naan chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di samban ni dunɔdali shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: David had a craving and said, If only someone could give me a drink of water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi pam dini daa bi guura; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi biɛla dini mi daa bi poor o.
en: As the Scriptures say, Those who gathered much did not have too much, and those who gathered little did not have too little. Exodus :.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn daa bi lihiri bɔri wuntitali Naawuni san la nya li bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So what are we going to say? Gentiles who werent striving for righteousness achieved righteousness, the righteousness that comes from faith.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya ba ni bɛ daa ʒila Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni. Dinzuɣu kuɣa ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri yɛlli ŋɔ yɛla sahakam.
en: you will tell them that the water of the Jordan stopped flowing when the Lord 's Covenant Box crossed the river. These stones will always remind the people of Israel of what happened here.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani n-nya luɣ shɛli ʒini ni bɛ gbe Gibia, dama so daa bi zaŋ ba ti kpɛh o yiŋa ni bɛ gbe.
en: They planned to stop there and stay the night. They came to the city square and sat down, but no one invited them home to stay the night.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa ka yi ti taɣi yi tɛha, ka bi lan tiri n yuli jilima, ka yi ni yino kam lan zaŋ yi ni daa bahi yi dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bɛ cham bɛ chandi kaman bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm la n-lan leei yi daba yaha.
en: But then you went back on your word and made my name impure; each of you reclaimed the men and women you had set free and forced them to be your slaves again.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu n-gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi la o nuu ni siɣina. Musa daa bi mi ni o ninni nyaɣisira, o mini Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: When Moses went down from Mount Sinai carrying the Ten Commandments, his face was shining because he had been speaking with the Lord ; but he did not know it.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba, ka daa tumdi kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa tumdi shɛm, dama Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ o paɣa. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm min o ni daa me o yil shɛli maa.
en: The Queen was amazed at Solomon's wisdom. She was breathless when she saw his palace, the food on his table, his officials, all his servants in their uniforms, and the sacrifices he offered at the Lord 's temple.

dag: Ka o daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; o daa bela pɔhim kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-kana yomyom.
en: God mounted the heavenly creatures and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilan ŋɔ di ma shɛhira ni n yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ yi sani pala Iin mini Aai yɛla.
en: But as God is faithful, our message to you isnt both yes and no.

dag: M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi ni niriba pam bɔri ni yi niŋ karimbanima, dama yi mi ni tinim bɛn nyɛ karimbanim ni ti nya saria karibu gari sokam.
en: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli, M mabihi, di bi simdi ni yi niŋ Yawɛ ni ti ti binshɛŋa maa lala, dama ŋuna n-daa gul ti ka zaŋ ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa kana ti liri ti maa niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: But David answered, My brothers, you can't do this with what the Lord has given us! He kept us safe and gave us victory over the raiders.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka lan chɛ ka o nam du pam o niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Then David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, and that his kingship was held in great honor for the sake of his people Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka di sabi Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛli ti Musa ni o ti niriba maa la puuni ni Izraɛlnim yi ti yɛn puhi chuɣ shɛli bɛ ni puhiri chira ayopɔin ni la, bɛn be suɣa ni.
en: And they found written in the Instruction that the LORD had commanded through Moses that the Israelites should live in booths during the festival of the seventh month.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka o daa kpam Otiniɛl jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na, ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Acsah went to live with Othniel. Othniel told Acsah to ask her father for some land. She went to her father. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, What is wrong.

dag: Maligumaaniba maa ni daa yi Luɣ Kasi shee maa na, ka sagbani sirigina nti pali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: When the priests came out of the Holy Place, the cloud filled the Lord s Temple.

dag: A ni niŋ o naani o ni mali kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka chɛ a tuma jɛl o?.
en: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?.

dag: A ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti be a biɛhigu shee mal alibarika! Ti nini ni tiɣi a jɛmbu du kasi maa puuni bin suma.
en: Oh, how wonderful it is to be the people you chose to come and stay in your Temple. And we are so happy to have the wonderful things that are in your Temple, your holy palace.

dag: Nyini n-ti wɔhu yaa? Nyini n-zaŋ gbɛm tam o nyiŋgoli zuɣu?.
en: Was it you, Job, who made horses so strong and gave them their flowing manes?.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ka lihimiya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka paɣimiy o di puuni.
en: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.

dag: Naawuni yubu zaŋ chaŋ yi sani nyɛla ni yi mali m-be kasi, ka di niŋdiya zina.
en: God wants you to be holy. He wants you to stay away from sexual sins.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋna nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani.
en: Jesus answered, They are right to say Elijah is coming. And it is true that Elijah will make all things the way they should be.

dag: Din gari shɛlikam nyɛla, kul yumiya taba ni yɛlimaŋli, dama yurilim limsiri taali balibu pam.
en: Most important of all, love each other deeply, because love makes you willing to forgive many sins.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, ka o ti tin ya vuhim yi dimnim bɛn gili ya la zaa sani, ka chɛ ka yi be ni alaafee.
en: When you cross the Jordan River, the Lord will let you occupy the land and live there. He will keep you safe from all your enemies, and you will live in peace.

dag: Di saha ka bia maa tizɔpaɣ maa daa bɔhi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa, N cham ti boli Hiburu paɣ so ŋun mali bihim na ka o ti mɔɣis a bia maa bihim ti a.
en: Then the babys sister said to Pharaohs daughter, Would you like me to go and find one of the Hebrew women to nurse the child for you.

dag: Zɔŋ maa ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di daa mali dunɔdura pia din kpɛri di ni. Ka daantalisi daa be di yaɣa ayi zuɣu m-pahi pilanim zuɣu.
en: Steps led up to the entrance room, which was feet wide and feet deep. There were two columns, one on each side of the entrance.

dag: Di chaŋ wula ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaani kpiimba zaani n-deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba? Kpiimba yi bi neeri kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka shɛb deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba?.
en: Now, what about those people who are baptized for the dead? What do they hope to accomplish? If it is true, as some claim, that the dead are not raised to life, why are those people being baptized for the dead?.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the Lord :.

dag: Amaa nyini n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi, ka ʒi a nam ʒiishee, ka Izraɛlnim paɣir a.
en: God, you are the Holy One. You sit as King upon the praises of Israel.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, N dana, ka bɔ ka chɛchɛbunsi ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: I asked the angel who was talking with me, Sir, what does this mean.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm ka yɛdaniŋdiba mini Yisa tuumba maa ni cheechi kpamba maa daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa yɛli ba Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum shɛlikam yɛla.
en: When the men arrived in Jerusalem, the apostles, the elders, and the whole church welcomed them. Paul, Barnabas, and the others told about all that God had done with them.

dag: A ti ba pam, ka chɛ ka vuhirigu kam di n-tiɣi.
en: You open your hands and give every living thing all that it needs.

dag: Dama n zuɣu ka a ni nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka a nyɛvili yuma pahi.
en: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ mi sabilifaa n-lo li tabili bantabiga la, ka di ti be bantabiga maa tooni polo.
en: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord.

dag: N ku tooi niŋ yinim Izraɛlnim kaman yaɣimɛra maa ni niŋ shɛm maa? Yawɛ lan yɛli, Yaɣiri maa ni kul be yaɣimɛra maa nuu ni shɛm maa, lala ka yinim Izraɛlnim gba be n nuu ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Don't I have the right to do with you people of Israel what the potter did with the clay? You are in my hands just like clay in the potter's hands.

dag: Naa suhu nyɛla kɔzɔrim m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o ŋmaligiri li kpari o ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: The kings heart is like channels of water in the hand of the LORD; he directs it wherever he wants.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti ŋmaligi bɔhi yimaŋa, Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi bihi ŋɔ zaa ti ti? N daa kɔŋ m bihi. Bɛ daa zaŋ ma kulila tinzun tiŋa, ka ŋuni n-lee wumsi bihi ŋɔ zaa? N daa kpalimla n ko, ka ya ka bihi ŋɔ zaa lee yina? .
en: Then you will say to yourself, Who gave me all these children? I was sad and lonely. My children were taken away. They were gone. So who gave me these children? Look, I was the only one left. Where did all these children come from.

dag: Amaa o ni ti dolila wuntia soli n-kari nandaamba saria; ka kari saria din tuhi ti dunia ŋɔ bɛn ka. O ni ti zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-fiɛbi dunianima; ka lan zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.

dag: Yɛm me o yili, ka sa daantalisi ayopɔin.
en: Wisdom has built her house and made seven columns for it.

dag: ka mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya.
en: Make two gold rings and attach them to the upper corners of the breastpiece.

dag: Ka daa kari ba yihi.
en: He expelled them from the court.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee be ya.
en: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, A tizo Ɛbɛl be ya? Ka Keen garigi yɛli, M bi mi; mani n-nyɛ n tizo maa gula.
en: Later, the Lord said to Cain, Where is your brother Abel? Cain answered, I dont know. Is it my job to watch over my brother.

dag: yin zaŋmiya ŋun tum lala maa niŋ Sintani nuu ni ka o niŋgbuŋ saɣim, ka di chɛ ka o shia lee ti tiligi ti Duuma Dabisili la dali.
en: At that time we need to hand this man over to Satan to destroy his human weakness so that his spirit might be saved on the day of the Lord.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Tɔrokɔnima ayɔbu mini naɣilahi pinaayi din daa nyɛ bɛ sara na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Zuɣulaannim ayi kam daa laɣim sula tɔroko yini, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam su naɣila yino. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili tooni.
en: They brought their offerings before the LORD: six covered wagons and twelve oxen—a wagon for every two chiefs, and an ox for every chief. They brought them near before the dwelling.

dag: Kaman tɔrili ni damd o tiɛɣu ka yiɣiri gind o bihi, ka teer o kpiŋkpama kpuɣiri ba, ka zaŋ o kpiŋkpan yiɣira gbib ba zuɣusaa shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ daa gbibi Izraɛl ka o bi lu.
en: like an eagle when she makes her young leave the nest to fly. She stays close to them, ready to help. She spreads her wings to catch them when they fall and carries them to a safe place.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, ka o be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm. O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: So God created humans to be like himself; he made men and women.

dag: Nandahima ni daa mali ma dahin shɛli, ka bɛ daa kana ti liri ma; amaa ka Yawɛ daa nyɛ ŋun guli ma.
en: When I was in trouble, they attacked me, but the Lord protected me.

dag: Bɛ ni booni ba la, Bɛ ni zaɣisi anzinfa shɛli, Dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ba.
en: My people will be called Rejected Silver. They will be given that name because the Lord did not accept them.

dag: Yawɛ, a nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But your compassion, Lord , is great; show your mercy and save me!.

dag: Chɛ ka di nyɛla a kɔŋko dini, ka miri ka a niŋdi li tiri saamba.
en: They are yours alone, not for you as well as strangers.

dag: n-zaŋ li bɔhi zuliya shɛb niriba biɛri, ka darigi niriba tibili;.
en: let them take revenge on the other nations. Let them go punish those people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa yi Naiɔt din be Rama tiŋgban ni maa n-chaŋ Jɔnatan sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? N taali nyɛ dini? Ka tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee dii tum a ba, ka o bɔri ni o ku ma.
en: Then David fled from Naioth in Ramah and went to Jonathan. What have I done? he asked. What crime have I committed? What wrong have I done to your father to make him want to kill me.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yaa Izraɛl Naawuni, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛl a dabili m ba Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛli maa niŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Again, God of Israel, I ask you to keep the promise you made to your servant, my father David.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ni dɔɣi ninsala, jɛrigu ni niŋ yɛm.
en: A wild donkey cannot give birth to a man, and a stupid person will never become wise.

dag: N je ʒiri, ka zaɣisi li, amaa n yur a zaligu.
en: I hate, I absolutely despise, what is false, but Im in love with your Instruction.

dag: Ka salo maa ni so daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, yɛlimi m biɛli ni o chɛ ka ti pirigi ti ba fali ti taba.
en: A man in the crowd said to Jesus, Teacher, tell my brother to divide with me the property our father left us.

dag: O daa yihi tinzun buɣa mini binnana zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka lan wurim o ni daa me bimbin shɛŋa zaa zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm la n-zaŋ li ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga.
en: Manasseh took away the strange idol gods, and he took the idol out of the Lord s Temple. He took away all the altars he had built on the Temple hill, and in Jerusalem. Manasseh threw all the altars out of the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni tahir o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: Those leading the procession scolded him, telling him to be quiet, but he shouted even louder, Son of David, show me mercy.

dag: O zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ o zaligu wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: God proclaims his word to Jacob; his statutes and rules to Israel.

dag: Amaa zaligu ŋɔ ka n daa naɣ zali ba, Deemiya n noli, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi mi nyɛ n niriba, ka yi tumdi n ni zali ya ni yi tummi shɛm, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Instead, I told them, If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dundɔŋ ni dunoli din kpa wulimpuhili polo la din kul yɛn yomi ʒiɛya dabisa ayɔbu din nyɛ tuma tumbu dabisa la ni. Amaa Vuhim Dabisili dali mini goli palli tuuli dabisili dali, di simdi ni di yooi.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: The east gate of the inner courtyard will be closed on the six working days. But it will be opened on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon.

dag: wulikpani nyoli ni ŋ-ŋmaai di zaɣ maani n-zaŋ li chaŋ daabiligu tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti zaŋ li sa kɔhigɔriba tiŋ ni.
en: He broke the top out of that big cedar tree and brought it to Canaan. He set the branch down in a city of merchants.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o kpɛhi tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee ka bɛ ti fiɛb o n-vih o baŋ din chɛ ka niriba maa tahiri pampam o zuɣu maa.
en: Then the commander told the soldiers to take Paul into the army building and beat him. He wanted to make Paul tell why the people were shouting against him like this.

dag: Ka Abigeel daa yiɣisi niŋ yomyom m-ba buŋa, ka o paɣisara anu bɛn daa be o sani n-tumd o tuma pah o zuɣu ka bɛ doli Dauda tuumba maa chaŋ, ka o ti leei Dauda paɣa.
en: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and brought five of her maids with her. They followed Davids messengers. So Abigail became Davids wife.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, ka bɛ kpamba zaa daa bo jaaŋgbɛhi na ti ti o. Kpɛm kam jaaŋgbe yiniyini, ka di kalinli daa yiɣisi jaaŋgbɛhi pinaayi kaman bɛ dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Ka Aduna jaaŋgbee daa be bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa ni.
en: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.

dag: Di saha ti daa kul larimi, ka yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn daa gil ti yɛra, Yawɛ tum tuun kara ti ba.
en: How we laughed, how we sang for joy! Then the other nations said about us, The Lord did great things for them.

dag: Ka n daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri taŋkpa zim shɛli chana, ka n daa zaŋ ba labi kaman soli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ malaikanim mi polo: Naawuni chɛ ka o malaikanim be kaman pɔhim; ka chɛ ka o tuumba be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: He talks about the angels: Hes the one who uses the spirits for his messengers and who uses flames of fire as ministers. .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka zaligubaŋdi so daa ti bɔri ni o zahim Yisa, ka yiɣisi zani bɔh o, Karimba, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: An expert in the Law of Moses stood up and asked Jesus a question to see what he would say. Teacher, he asked, what must I do to have eternal life.

dag: Di dabisa maa nyaaŋa ka o paɣ Ɛlizabɛt daa niŋ pua, ka sɔɣir omaŋa hal ti paai chira anu ka yɛra.
en: Later, Zechariahs wife Elizabeth became pregnant. So she did not go out of her house for five months. She said.

dag: Ka Ibram daa pirigipirig o tɔbbihi maa n-chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ ŋ-ŋme n-kari ba hal ti paai Hɔba din be Damaskus nuzaa polo la.
en: There he divided his men into groups, attacked the enemy by night, and defeated them. He chased them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-naan chɛ ka n suhu maai. Di biɛrim yi di be ka bo, n naan mali suhupiɛlli; dama m bi zaɣisi ŋun be Kasi ŋɔ yɛligu.
en: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhɔram daa dii yiɣisi Samaria di saha maa n-chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa.
en: One day, Joram left Samaria and called together Israel's army.

dag: Tiŋgbani damdila bɛ tooni; ka sagbana sɔhira. Ka wuntaŋ mini goli niŋ zim, ka saŋmarisi gba bi lan ne.
en: The earth shakes as they advance; the sky trembles. The sun and the moon grow dark, and the stars no longer shine.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa yɛl o, Niŋm a ni tɛhi ni shɛli viɛl a sani, kul guhim hal ka bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili. Yawɛ chɛ ka o yɛligu niŋ pali. Ka Hanna daa kpalim yiŋa m-mal o bia maa hal ka o ti ŋmaai bihili.
en: Do what seems best to you, said her husband Elkanah. Stay here until youve weaned him. But may the LORD bring to pass what youve promised. So the woman stayed home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma bari ma la tɔŋ, ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ti ma biɛrim la mi yu ni m bahi yoli; bɛ na ʒi n-chɛ ma yikombiɛlim tuma tumbu dabisili kam puuni.
en: My enemies say bad things about me. They are spreading lies and rumors. They talk about me all the time.

dag: Ka Jɛfita lan bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Yi yi zaŋ ma kuli ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka Yawɛ chɛ ka n nyaŋ ba, yi ni saɣi ka n leei yi zuɣulana.
en: All right, Jephthah said. If I go back with you and the Lord lets me defeat the Ammonites, will you really make me your ruler.

dag: Yisa Masia puuni yi zaa nyɛla Naawuni bihi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: It is through faith that all of you are God's children in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri n-luhiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyari kpɛhili shee bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: The wicked are thrown down by their own evil, but the righteous find refuge even in death.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani salo maa sunsuuni m-bɔhi Yisa, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ.
en: Then the high priest stood up before everyone and said to Jesus, These people said things against you. Do you have something to say about their charges? Are they telling the truth.

dag: Dama a ni kpuɣ a piɛma tiri ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buŋ maa tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu ka o ba.
en: The followers brought the donkey to Jesus. They put their coats on it, and Jesus sat on it.

dag: Karimi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Akar ŋun daa bo yɛla bahi Izraɛlnim la. O daa kpuɣila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli ti Naawuni.
en: Carmis family: Achar, who made trouble for Israel by disobeying the law dedicating war spoils to God.

dag: A yi zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali Yawɛ tooni, Izraɛlnim bɛn zaŋm bɛ nuhi pa Lɛvinim maa zuɣu.
en: Then you will bring the Levites into the LORDs presence, and the Israelites will lay their hands on the Levites.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bela fɔntiŋ shɛŋa din kpalim dabari ni, ka be yiya shɛŋa din nyɛ nir ni ku be yiya shɛŋa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ wurim shɛŋa la.
en: but his town will be ruined; his home will be destroyed; his house will be empty.

dag: Duu daa beni ka di dunoli be dunɔdali zɔntua puuni, nimaani ka bɛ daa paɣiri bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim.
en: At that gate, there was a room with an entrance in the arches for washing the entirely burned offering.

dag: O daa bi tooi tum tuun kar shɛli nimaani n-naɣ pahila o daa kul zaŋla o nuhi pa barinim biɛla zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ zaa.
en: He was not able to perform any miracles there, except that he placed his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan nya ka do so zɔrina ka o boli dunɔgula n-yɛl o, Nyama, do so lan zɔrina o kɔŋko. Ka naa yɛli, o gba ʒirila lahibali na.
en: But then the watchman saw another man running. He called to the gatekeeper, Look! Another man is running alone. The king said, He is also bringing news.

dag: N Naawuni, niŋm ba kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga taŋkpagbiligu la; ka niŋ ba kaman pɔhim n-ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri la.
en: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.

dag: Yawɛ miri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri saɣim, ka tiligiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima.
en: The Lord is close to those who have suffered disappointment. He saves those who are discouraged.

dag: N gom shee ka n daa nya ti titali ʒii puuni ka di kul ʒe dunia sunsuuni.
en: In my sleep I saw a very tall tree in the center of the world.

dag: amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda hal ti kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Nyama, hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ma di yɛla shɛm bi paai di pirigili gba. A yɛm min a tɔŋbu yɛla gari n ni wum di yɛla shɛm.
en: I did not believe it until I came and saw it with my own eyes. Now I see that it is even greater than what I heard. Your wealth and wisdom are much greater than people told me.

dag: Ka o daa moli molo gili Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm zaa ni bɛ yo Yawɛ farigu shɛli Naawuni dabili Musa ni daa zali Izraɛlnim tiŋgban nɛli ni ni bɛ yo la.
en: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.

dag: Di simdi ni yi teei anab suma ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n-zal la mini ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira zaligu shɛl o ni zaŋ ti yi tuumba la ni be zaŋ yɛli ya la yɛla.
en: I want you to recall what the holy prophets foretold as well as what the Lord and savior commanded through your apostles.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia min o kpambaliba niŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba la nuu ni. N ni zaŋ ba niŋ Babilɔn naa tɔbbihi bɛn zo ka chɛn ya la nuu ni.
en: I will give King Zedekiah of Judah and his leaders to their enemies and to everyone who wants to kill them. I will give Zedekiah and his people to the army of the king of Babylon, even though that army has left Jerusalem.

dag: nti yɛli Aduna, Zaŋm naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛlaa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Di simdi ni bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn ka dalima, ka a zaŋ ba mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: He said to Aaron, Take a young bull and a ram without any defects and offer them to the Lord , the bull for a sin offering and the ram for a burnt offering.

dag: M puhiri cheechi shɛli din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ la gba. M puhiri n zo suŋ Ɛpainɛtus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa daŋ niŋ Masia yɛda Ɛsha la.
en: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa gbaai Yisifu binyɛrigu gbib ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Amaa ka Yisifu daa fuɣ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ paɣ maa nuu ni, ka guui yi yili maa ni.
en: His masters wife grabbed his coat and said to him, Come to bed with me. But Joseph ran out of the house so fast that he left his coat in her hand.

dag: Ka a ti chaŋ ti yɛli Firawuna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl nyɛla m bidib kpɛma.
en: Then say to Pharaoh, This is what the LORD says: Israel is my oldest son.

dag: Ka o daa kari doli Abinɛr, o ni daa kariti dol o maa, o daa kul sula o gbini ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: started chasing Abner, running straight for him.

dag: Yi daa tim tuumba Jɔn Baptaizira sani, ka o gba daa di yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ shɛhira.
en: You sent a delegation to John, and he testified to the truth.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛra n-dar chahi li, ka bɛnkam daa be o sani gba daa niŋ lala.
en: Then David tore his clothes to show he was very sad. All the men with him did the same thing.

dag: N zɔnim larila mani ŋun suhi Naawuni ka o deei n suhigu ŋɔ, mani ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun ka galimi ŋɔ, ka bɛ lari ma.
en: Im a joke to friends who called to God and he answered; the innocent and blameless one is a joke.

dag: Ka n yi na be n nyɛvil ni ka ni tooi tum tuun shɛli din mali buchi, dindina m bi jɛndi mi n ni yɛn pii shɛli bina ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: If I continue to live in this world, I get results from my work.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ti kani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa laɣimna nti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ya Rama. Sool daa pun karila bukpahinim mini jinwariba Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: Now Samuel had died, and all the Israelites had mourned for him and had buried him in his hometown of Ramah. Saul had forced all the fortunetellers and mediums to leave Israel.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna. Niriba maa zaa daa yɛlimi, Ti yi di daa kpi Ijipti, di di so! Bee ti yi di kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, di di so!.
en: The Israelites complained against Moses and Aaron. All the people came together and said to Moses and Aaron, We should have died in Egypt or in the desert.

dag: Ka Dauda yuli daa du pam tiŋgbɔna maa ni zaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda yɛla gbaai zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: Davids fame spread throughout all lands, and the LORD made all the nations fear him.

dag: So yi da o ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, di saha o ni tooi chɛ ka paɣ maa yiŋnim yo o zuɣu ka deeg o. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o tom kɔhi tinzunnim zuɣu, dama o pun niŋ o din bi tuhi.
en: If she is sold to someone who intends to make her his wife, but he doesn't like her, then she is to be sold back to her father; her master cannot sell her to foreigners, because he has treated her unfairly.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia, Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: He told her that he was from her fathers family. He told her that he was the son of Rebekah. So Rachel ran home and told her father.

dag: Amaa bɔhimi biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ wuh a; ka bɔhi noonsi ka bɛ yɛl a;.
en: But ask the animals, and they will teach you. Or ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, A yi ti labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-chɛ ka n yɛl a yɛlli ŋɔ. Ka daa lan yɛli, Sokam zaa, wummiya.
en: If you return safely, Micaiah exclaimed, then the Lord has not spoken through me! And he added, Listen, everyone, to what I have said.

dag: N ni ti lan zaŋ nyin Izraɛl leei m paɣa sahakam ni wuntizɔbo mini yɛlimaŋli ni yurilim pam ni nambɔzɔbo.
en: And I will make you my bride forever. I will make you my bride with goodness and justice and with love and mercy.

dag: Yɛndan ni tɔɣisir yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa balimbalim wumbu so naa ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n-tahiri jɛra sani.
en: Words spoken by the wise are heard more clearly than those shouted by a leader among fools.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yisa daa yi yiŋ chaŋ ti ʒini teeku duli.
en: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ nina neei ka bɛ baŋ o, ka o daa dii bɔrigi ka chɛ ba ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: Just then the men were allowed to recognize him. But when they saw who he was, he disappeared.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus called his twelve followers together. He gave them power over evil spirits and power to heal every kind of disease and sickness.

dag: Ifriimnim tum tuun shɛli din tahi suhuyiɣisili pam na, dinzuɣu Yawɛ chɛ ka ninvuɣ kubo taali la ʒi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ni ti darigi bɛ tibili bɛ ni daa tur o la zuɣu.
en: Ephraim has given bitter offense; so the LORD will bring his crimes down on him and pay him back for his wrongdoing.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Jɔnatan, biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi. Ka n yi bi niŋ a lala, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma gari n ni di yɛn niŋ a shɛm gba.
en: Yes, Jonathan. I swear to God that you must die.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa je a ka zaɣis a, ka so bi kpɛr a ni la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ ka a galisi ka mali jilima, ka lan chɛ ka a nyɛ luɣ shɛli suhupiɛlli ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: You will no longer be forsaken and hated, A city deserted and desolate. I will make you great and beautiful, A place of joy forever and ever.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his father Uzziah, Jotham did what was pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Ŋum paya mi yuli n-daa booni Ɛliɛza, dama o daa yɛlimi, M banim Naawuni n-daa nyɛ n sɔŋda ka tiligi ma Firawuna takɔbi ni.
en: The other was named Eliezer because he said, The God of my ancestors was my helper who rescued me from Pharaohs sword.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yɛn tiligi ya saha shɛli yi ti paai, n ni niŋ ya nirilim, ka wum yi kuŋa din bɔri kunzoo la. N ni guli ya, ka taɣi ya ka chɛ barina, ka lo niriba zaa alikauli yi zuɣu. N ni lan labisi ya ʒili yi tiŋgbani din do zaɣ nɛl la ni.
en: The LORD said: At the right time, I answered you; on a day of salvation, I helped you. I have guarded you, and given you as a covenant to the people, to restore the land, and to reassign deserted properties.

dag: Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa kul nahindila Izraɛlnima Naa Jɛhɔahaz ʒiɛman ni zaa.
en: During all the days that Jehoahaz ruled, King Hazael of Aram caused trouble to Israel.

dag: Ka tuun shɛŋa Baasha ni daa tum pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of the story about Baasha and the great things he did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka ŋunkam kahigi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni Bia, Naawuni be o ni ka o gba be Naawuni ni.
en: If any of us confess that Jesus is Gods Son, God remains in us and we remain in God.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaŋ Pita tum tuun kara Yɛhudianim sani shɛm, lala ka o zaŋ man gba tum tuun kara bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: The one who empowered Peter to become an apostle to the circumcised empowered me also to be one to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ti laɣim taba, ka bɛ ni ti malila zuɣulaan yino, ka bɛ biɛhigu ti chaŋ tooni tiŋgbani maa ni, dama Jɛziriil dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali.
en: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will be gathered together, and they will choose one head. They will become fruitful in the land. The day will be a wonderful one for Jezreel.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ bi wuhiri ni n zaani ya la zaligu, amaa n zaŋdila shɛb nini ni mooi bɛ tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla n-wuhiri ya ni n nya ni yi gba yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli.
en: I am not ordering you to give, but I want to see how real your love is by comparing you with others who have been so ready and willing to help.

dag: N ni ti yihi n jilima palo ni zuliya kam sani, ka zuliya kam ti nya n ni kari saria shɛli ŋɔ mini n ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm maa.
en: I will let the other nations see what I have done, and they will begin to respect me! They will see my power that I used against the enemy.

dag: ka di be kaman n daa na ʒi m-be, ka bɛ daa kul dɔɣi ma n-zaŋ ma ti niŋla gballi ni.
en: To go from the womb straight to the grave would have been as good as never existing.

dag: Ka Midian nanima ayi bɛn nyɛ: Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa guui, ka Gidiɔn kari doli ti gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zaa suhuri chihi.
en: and the enemy panicked. Zebah and Zalmunna tried to escape, but Gideon chased and captured them.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa kpuɣi bihi maa o naba zuɣu, ka damdi n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Then Joseph took them from Jacob's lap and bowed down before him with his face to the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Filistianim zuɣu. N ni ku Chɛrɛtinima, ka ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be teeku dul la.
en: And so I am announcing that I will attack the Philistines and wipe them out. I will destroy everyone left living there on the Philistine Plain.

dag: O kparima ŋmanila tulaale tihi vuɣa din wandi tulaale din nyom viɛla. O naŋgbampiba ŋmanila paɣiviɛligakushihikom, ka mɛɛr kom be di ni.
en: His cheeks are like fragrant plantings, towers of spices. His lips are lilies dripping liquid myrrh.

dag: Ŋuna ti Duuma Yisa Masia n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti daalahichi zuɣu ni o fa ti ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu ŋɔ ni bahi kaman ti Ba Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He gave himself for our sins, so he could deliver us from this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father.

dag: Ninsalinima m-be o sani maa, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ m-be ti sani ni o sɔŋ ti ka tuhi ti tɔb kam ti ti. Ka Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpaŋsi niriba maa suhuri pam.
en: The king of Assyria only has men. But we have the Lord our God with us! Our God will help us. He will fight our battles! So King Hezekiah of Judah encouraged the people and made them feel stronger.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din be yoma mini tin shɛŋa din be katinsi zaa ni ti mali ya ansarisi, tin shɛli din yuli bi du ka gadama pali di ni ŋɔ.
en: and people far and near will make fun of your misery.

dag: bɛ ni yɛn yo ti sam shɛli nyɛla bɛ kana ni bɛ ti kari ti a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ni ti su maa ni.
en: Now they are coming to take back the land you gave us.

dag: Nyama, o kanimina kaman sagbana la, o chɛchɛbunsi ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o yuri zɔri yomyom gari tɔrili. Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama ti bahi yoli.
en: Look! He approaches like the clouds; his chariots advance like a tempest, his horses swifter than eagles. How horrible! Were doomed!.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti lab nyaaŋa, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima, dama niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: So those who are last will be first. And those who are first will be last.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka kuɣili ni marigi ŋun biligi li.
en: People who set traps for others get caught themselves. People who start landslides get crushed.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yisifu na be o nyɛvil ni, ka nyɛla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana. Ka Yaakubu yɛma daa ŋma, dama o daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: they told their father that Joseph was still alive and was the ruler of Egypt. But their father was so surprised that he could not believe them.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti di li la yili yin ni ka di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ di nimdi yi samban ni bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili.
en: It should be eaten in one house. You shouldnt take any of the meat outside the house, and you shouldnt break the bones.

dag: Lihimi puu maa ni n-nyari bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam polo chɛra, ka kul doli ba. M pun yɛli n kachɛriba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba maa ni bɛ miri ka bɛ niŋ a shɛli. Ka kɔnyuri yi ti mal a, nyin cham ti tooi bɛ ni ŋɔŋ kom pali kɔduɣ shɛŋa zal la ni nyu.
en: Watch to see which fields they go into to cut the grain and follow them. I have warned the young men not to bother you. When you are thirsty, go and drink from the same water jug my men drink from.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa zaŋ tabili tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ.
en: So Joshua marched out of Gilgal with his whole army. His best fighting men were with him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi deei Naawuni nam kaman bia ni deeri li shɛm ti ku kpe di ni.
en: The truth is, you must accept Gods kingdom like a little child accepts things, or you will never enter it.

dag: Ka bee a tɛhiya ni a gari la Mɔab Naa Balak Zipɔr bia la? O daa ŋme Izraɛlnim naŋgbankpeeni bee n-lo tɔbu ni o tuhi ba?.
en: Do you now have a better case than Moabs King Balak, Zippors son? Did he make an accusation against the Israelites or go to war with them?.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Itiɔpia kirisolait la buɣisi li, ka nir mi ku tooi zaŋ salima alali buɣisi li.
en: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.

dag: Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni chani ti kpɛrila o pul ni n-gariti ti yira?.
en: Don't you understand? Anything that goes into your mouth goes into your stomach and then on out of your body.

dag: Bɛ daa kul sɔŋ la kuɣa maa dolisi dundɔŋ maa n-zaŋ hal ti paai dunɔdaya maa wɔɣilim tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛ ni sɔŋ kuɣ shɛŋa tiŋli.
en: which extended around the courtyard. This outer courtyard was at a lower level than the inner courtyard.

dag: Yawɛ ʒin o nam ʒiishee kokpɛɣu zuɣu. Yawɛ n-ʒi o nam ʒiishee n-nyɛ naa ŋun kul beni sahakam.
en: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din ka tibbu gbaag o nyɔri.
en: After all this, the LORD struck Jehoram with an incurable intestinal disease.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul ku su tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ wuntizɔriba tiŋgbani, ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka wuntizɔriba maa tum zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.

dag: A mabia Sɔdom taali m-bɔŋɔ: O min o bipuɣinsi daa malila karimbaani. Bɛ daa mali bindira pam, ka bɛ nyamma galisi, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔŋdi nandaamba mini bɛn ka.
en: She and her daughters were proud because they had plenty to eat and lived in peace and quiet, but they did not take care of the poor and the underprivileged.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi. Yi yi ʒi yi yinsi puuni, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla, ka yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo bee yi yi ti dɔni bee yi yi ti yiɣisi, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla.
en: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Stiivin, ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa nya Naawuni jilima, ka nya ka Yisa ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But Stephen, enabled by the Holy Spirit, stared into heaven and saw Gods majesty and Jesus standing at Gods right side.

dag: Di saha maa ka Hagai daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya ni lala n-nyɛ yi zuliya ŋɔ niriba mini bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum shɛlikam; dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam m-mali sara pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu nyɛla din pa kasi n sani.
en: Then Haggai responded: Thus has this people and this nation become to me, says the LORD, and everything that they do with their hands. Whatever they offer is unclean.

dag: ka di be o sani, ka o karindi li dabisili kam o biɛhigu ni din ni chɛ ka o bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu ŋɔ ni mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: He must keep that book with him and read from it all his life, because he must learn to respect the Lord his God. He must learn to completely obey everything the law commands.

dag: Ka o daa mali sara zoli zuɣu n-laɣim o dɔɣiriba ni bɛ kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka bɛ daa kana ka bɛ min o ti laɣim di bindirigu maa ka kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Jacob killed an animal and offered it as a sacrifice there on the mountain, and he invited his men to eat with him. After the meal they spent the night on the mountain.

dag: TƐKƐL gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni zaŋ a pa sania zuɣu n-zahim a ka a tibisim pɔra.
en: Tekel : You have been weighed on the scales and found not good enough.
