dag: Benya yɛm biɛhigu bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm.
en: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.

dag: ka Matɛnai daa nyɛ Joyarib daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Uzi daa nyɛ Jɛdaya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna sani n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: Moses left the king and prayed to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Sɛraya ni Reelaya ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipa ni Biɣivai ni Rɛhum ni Baana n-daa labi kuli. Izraɛl niriba kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the people who returned with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. This is the list of names and numbers of men from Israel who returned:.

dag: Nir yi daŋ deeg o fali yomyom piligu ni, di bahigu ti ka anfaani.
en: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.

dag: O daa gindila Bɛtɛl mini Giligal ni Mizipa yuuni kam nti maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani zaa.
en: He went from place to place judging the Israelites. Every year he traveled around the country. He went to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah and he judged the Israelites in all these places.

dag: Ka naa daa yi ti kul chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli nayili dunoli maa kpuɣirila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, ka ti lan zaŋ li ti niŋ bɛ duu yaha.
en: Every time the king went to the Temple, the guards carried the shields and then returned them to the guardroom.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka niriba pam bɛn daa ka chuɣu maa ni na wum ni Yisa kani Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The next day the people in Jerusalem heard that Jesus was coming there. These were the crowds of people who had come to the Passover festival.

dag: Ka zom maa ʒiʒiinitab mini bɛn daa pun mi ka o nyɛ barimaana la ti bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi ʒiya maani bara la.
en: His neighbors and some others who had seen him begging said, Look! Is this the same man who always sits and begs.

dag: Yawɛ, sɔŋm ti! Dama wundaba lan kani; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim lan ka daadamnim ni.
en: Help us, Lord ! There is not a good person left; honest people can no longer be found.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, Naawuni ni deei ŋun Naawuni nam yi sani n-zaŋ li ti zuliya shɛb bɛn ni wali o nam maa wala. .
en: Therefore, I tell you that Gods kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a people who produce its fruit.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli maa zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: Then they crucified him and divided his clothes among themselves, throwing dice to see who would get which piece of clothing.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa lo noli suhi ti Naawuni di zuɣu, ka o daa deei ti suhigu maa.
en: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni n teeg a Naawuni ni daa ti a pin shɛli ka di be a ni n ni daa zaŋ n nuhi pa a zuɣu saha shɛl la yɛla. Tiɣisim li niŋ kaman nir ni tiɣisiri buɣim ka di taari diri shɛm la;.
en: Because of this, Im reminding you to revive Gods gift that is in you through the laying on of my hands.

dag: Dauda ni daa chaŋ Zikilag, ka Manaasa zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb zo n-chaŋ o sani n-daa nyɛ: Adina mini Jɔzabad ni Jɛdiayɛl ni Maikil ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlihu ni Zilɛtai bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi Manaasa zuliya niriba ni la.
en: That's when the following men from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. They had all been commanders in Saul's army.

dag: Buni mini jilima zaa yirila a sanna, nyini n-su binshɛɣukam zaa. A nuu ni ka yiko ni kpiɔŋ be, ka a zaŋ a nuu maa namdi wɔɣira, ka tiri sokam yaa.
en: and you rule with strength and power. You make people rich and powerful and famous.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni a nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, ka bɛ niŋ ma nirilim a zuɣu, ka tiligi n nyɛvili a zuɣu.
en: Tell them that you are my sister; then because of you they will let me live and treat me well.

dag: Jabɛz daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali jilima gar o mabihi zaa, o ma n-daa bol o yuli Jabɛz, ka yɛli ni dama o daa nya biɛrim pam o dɔɣibu ni.
en: There was a man named Jabez, who was the most respected member of his family. His mother had given him the name Jabez, because his birth had been very painful.

dag: Di yi pa lala bɛ ni nyuli kuli, ka tam zaligu yɛla, ka mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zaa yɛlimaŋli.
en: They may drink too much and forget what the law says. Then they might take away the rights of the poor.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mɛri wuna pa shɛli, ka bɛ suhuri ni yuri binshɛŋa bi kuri ba buchi. Bɛ shɛhiranim ku tooi nya shɛli bee m-baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni di vi.
en: Idol-makers are all as nothing; their playthings do no good. Their promoters neither see nor know anything, so they ought to be ashamed.

dag: Ti tum tuumbiɛri, ka yi Yawɛ nyaaŋa, ka zaɣisi ti Naawuni jɛmbu. Ti nahindi ti taba, ka taari duŋ. Ti nyɛla bɛn ŋmari ʒiri din yiri ti suhuri ni na.
en: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.

dag: Dama zuliya kam wuna zaa nyɛla binnana; amaa Yawɛ n-nam zuɣusaa.
en: All the gods in other nations are nothing but statues, but the Lord made the heavens!.

dag: ka wuh a din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli din ni chɛ ka a garigi bɛn tim a na yɛlimaŋli garigibu?.
en: Their purpose is to teach you true, reliable words, so you can report back reliably to those who sent you.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ba ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: So Jacob's sons did just as their father had instructed.

dag: Zanimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa zaani n-tɔɣisi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ti ba. Zabimi bɛn ka yaa yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Speak out on behalf of the voiceless, and for the rights of all who are vulnerable.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ li na ka o piligi li n-nya bia maa, ka bia maa dii gbaai kuhigu. Ka di daa niŋ o yoli, ka o yɛli, Hiburunim bihi la ni yino m-bala.
en: The kings daughter opened the basket and saw a baby boy. The baby was crying and she felt sorry for him. Then she noticed that it was one of the Hebrew babies.

dag: Ka din daa niŋ ba suhugarigu gari shɛlikam nyɛla o ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ nini ku lan nya o la. Ka bɛ daa biɛl o tahi ŋariŋ gbini.
en: They were especially sad because Paul had told them, You will never see me again. Then they went with him to the ship.

dag: Yi ni ti lan ko yi wain tihi puri Samaria zoya zuɣu. Ka bɛn ti sa tihi maa ni ti di di wala.
en: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.

dag: Ka Pita lan yɛl o ni nimmoo, Hal bɛ yi ni ku m min a gba, n ku chihi ni m bi mi a. Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa zaa daa yɛl lala.
en: But Peter insisted, If I must die alongside you, I wont deny you. And they all said the same thing.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N yɛn leela ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A shiri ni tooi niŋ o naŋgban malisim, cham ti niŋ lala, a ni di nasara. .
en: He answered, I will go out and become a spirit of lies in the mouths of Ahabs prophets—they will all speak lies. So the Lord said, Yes, that will fool Ahab. Go out and do that.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi kɔr biɛri mini danyubo ni dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda ti dihi ya sɔŋ, ka dindali maa ti dii libigi ya.
en: Be careful not to let yourselves become occupied with too much feasting and drinking and with the worries of this life, or that Day may suddenly catch you.

dag: Daba anii dali bɛ ni guni bia maa.
en: On the eighth day, the child shall be circumcised.

dag: Bimbɔ zuɣu ka di daantalisi daa lee tamiya? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee sɔŋ di tuuli tampuɣili?.
en: On what were its footings sunk; who laid its cornerstone.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: So the Egyptians enslaved the Israelites.

dag: tiri Timoti ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Timothy, my true child in the faith. Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa ti paai Kapɛrinium nti kpe duu ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi di lee ŋmɛri sol ni la.
en: They entered Capernaum. When they had come into a house, he asked them, What were you arguing about during the journey.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɛriko naa, Nyama, Izraɛlnim shɛb ka kpe na yuŋ ŋɔ ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni be shɛm.
en: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.

dag: So yi yuri Naawuni, ŋuna ka Naawuni mi.
en: But whoever loves God is known by God.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔana ni Jeemsi ma Mariama ni paɣ shɛb bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Yisa tuumba maa di yɛla maa.
en: The women were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James; they and the other women with them told these things to the apostles.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka Jɔshua bahi noli ka bɛ siɣisi ba tihi maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ ba bahi vo shɛl ni bɛ ni daa zo nti sɔɣ la ni, ka bilim kuɣ kara ti ŋari di noli, ka di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: At sundown Joshua gave orders, and their bodies were taken down and thrown into the same cave where they had hidden earlier. Large stones were placed at the entrance to the cave, and they are still there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti shihi ba ka yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, Get up and don't be afraid.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa n-zaŋ mɛɛr maa mini aloosi tia sum maa n-niŋ o, ka bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o kaman Yɛhudianim kum sɔɣibu kali ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Following Jewish burial customs, they took Jesus body and wrapped it, with the spices, in linen cloths.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka kum ku bɛ bihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ paɣiba leei pakoya ni bɛn kɔŋ bɛ bihi. Chɛ ka alɔbo ku bɛ dɔbba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ nachimba tɔbu ni.
en: But now, Lord , let their children starve to death; let them be killed in war. Let the women lose their husbands and children; let the men die of disease and the young men be killed in battle.

dag: Bɛ gbala maa bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa puuni ha. Di tɔbbihi zaa laɣimmi gili di gballi. Takɔbi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa. Bɛna n-daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and their graves are in the deepest parts of the world of the dead. All her soldiers fell in battle, and their graves surround her tomb. Yet once they terrified the land of the living.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ din guli ba, ka faranim fara bahiri ba yoli.
en: The riches of the wealthy are their strong city; the ruin of the poor is their poverty.

dag: Kpeen so daa ti bɔhi Yisa, Karimba suŋ, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: A religious leader asked Jesus, Good Teacher, what must I do to get eternal life.

dag: Yi kpalim malila yi buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Molok la suɣili mini yi buɣ so ŋun gba yuli booni Rɛfan, ka o nyɛ saŋmariga kɔtomsi ka nyɛ yi ni daa me shɛŋa n-zali ni yi jɛmdi la. Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi Babilɔn tooni ha.
en: It was the tent of the god Molech that you carried, and the image of Rephan, your star god; they were idols that you had made to worship. And so I will send you into exile beyond Babylon.

dag: Ka a boli Jɛsi ka o ka sara maligu maa shee na, ka n ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka a ti booi kpam maa bahi n ni yɛn wuh a ninvuɣ so maa zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: then invite Jesse to the sacrifice. When I show you which one of his sons I have chosen, pour the olive oil on his head.

dag: Ibrahimma bia Yisahaku zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ibrahimma n-daa nyɛ Yisahaku ba.
en: These are the descendants of Isaac, Abrahams son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm la. O daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: Like his ancestors, Zechariah disobeyed the Lord by following the evil ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: ni Rɛkɛm ni Iripiil ni Tarala.
en: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya o katiŋa, bɛ daa bi baŋ o, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum pam; ka dari chahi bɛ binyɛra, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu chɛri zuɣusaa ka di puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri.
en: When they looked up from a distance and didnt recognize him, they wept loudly. Each one tore his garment and scattered dust above his head toward the sky.

dag: Lɛvinima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, Yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Yawɛ, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the Lord , you Levites; praise him, all you that worship him!.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Akishi daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Nyamiya, yi nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla yinyaa, ka yi zaŋ o kani n sanna?.
en: Look at him! Achish said to his officers. You can see he's crazy. Why did you bring him to me?.

dag: Tizɔra kam gbibila omaŋ binshɛɣukam puuni. Bɛ niŋdi lala maa ni bɛ ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din saɣinda, amaa tinim niŋdi lala ni ti ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din bi saɣinda.
en: Every athlete in training submits to strict discipline, in order to be crowned with a wreath that will not last; but we do it for one that will last forever.

dag: Nyin vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ, cham ti nya guliŋguhi biɛhigu, ka niŋ yɛm.
en: Go to the ant, you lazy person; observe its ways and grow wise.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: Those who find their lives will lose them, and those who lose their lives because of me will find them.

dag: Dama o zuliya ni ti galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa ni ti nya alibarika la o zuɣu.
en: Abraham will become a great and powerful nation, and all the nations on earth will be blessed because of him.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu saha, o bom naɣila pola ayopɔin mini piɛlahi ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dahin yini kam, ka lan bo bulaa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara dabisili kam.
en: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.

dag: ni bɛ niŋm binzusa niŋ bɛ binyɛra luɣa ni bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka niŋ mi sabilitim niŋ binzusa kam din be bɛ luɣa ni maa.
en: Speak to the Israelites. Tell them this: Tie several pieces of thread together and tie them in the corner of your clothes. Put a piece of blue thread in each one of these tassels. You must wear these things now and forever.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la mini ŋun maŋmaŋ ni mali pin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima binyɛra la zaa nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: Asa and his father had given some special gifts to God. Asa put these gifts of gold, silver, and other things into the Temple.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali bidibisi. Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Jɛdiayɛl pa, ka Zɛbadia daa pah ata, ka Jatiniɛl pahi anahi;.
en: He had seven sons, listed in order of age: Zechariah, Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi piapia chani Lɛbanɔn nti niŋdi goli yiniyini ka tiri taba. Bɛ daa niŋdila goli yiniyini Lɛbanɔn, ka niŋdi chira ayiyi yiŋ mi. Adɔniram n-daa nyɛ niriba maa zuɣulana.
en: and put Adoniram in charge of them. He divided them into three groups of , men, and each group spent one month in Lebanon and two months back home.

dag: Dama saa ni yi nyaɣisi wulimpuhili polo m-mali ti ba wulinluhili polo shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia kandina maa ti yɛn be.
en: When the Son of Man comes, everyone will see him. It will be like lightning flashing in the sky that can be seen everywhere.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu dazɔhigu dali kaman agbaa saha, ka o yɛli Yɛhudianim maa, N-nyɛ yi Naa maa.
en: It was about noon on the Preparation Day for the Passover. Pilate said to the Jewish leaders, Heres your king.

dag: Ka o ni nya ka wum shɛli, dina ka o tɔɣisira; ka so mi bi deer o yɛligu.
en: He tells what he has seen and heard, yet no one accepts his message.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yɛli, Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo.
en: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ ti ŋmahi tihi balibu diba ata wula n-kɔrisikɔrisi di paɣiri ka chɛ ka di mali piɛlimpiɛlim, ka chɛ ka di piɛlimpiɛlim maa be palo ni ka di piɛlipiɛla.
en: Jacob got green branches of poplar, almond, and plane trees and stripped off some of the bark so that the branches had white stripes on them.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛli Kushi bia Zɛfania yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Juda Naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni. Zɛfania yaannim n-daa nyɛ: Gɛdalia mini Amaria ni Naa Hɛzɛkia.
en: This is the message that the Lord gave to Zephaniah during the time that Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah.

dag: Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ni ti neei kum ni. Yinim bɛn zaa kpi m-be gbala ni, yiɣisimiya yili suhupiɛlli yila. Maligim ni luri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm la, lala ka tiŋgbani yɛn chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun kpi la neei.
en: Your dead will live, their corpses will rise, and those who dwell in the dust will shout for joy. Your shadow is a shadow of light, but you will bring down the ghosts into the underworld.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Yawɛ ni tum shɛm. Nyamiya o ni tum tuun shɛŋa ka di mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Come and see what the Lord has done. See what amazing things he has done on earth.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ bi lan bɔri bindirigu, ka bɛ kɔre lan ka bindir viɛlli ni gba.
en: until a person loathes food, an appetite rejects a delicacy.

dag: Ka di mi ni yila yi yi kul ʒe yim ka ba n-zani, ka bi damdi zaŋ chaŋ lahibal suŋ tahima shɛli yɛla yi ni daa wum la polo. Di zuɣu ka man Pool leei tumtumda ŋun tumdi lahibal suŋ maa tuma din nyɛ bɛ ni pun yihi shɛli waazu ti sokam zaa dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: But you need to remain well established and rooted in faith and not shift away from the hope given in the good news that you heard. This message has been preached throughout all creation under heaven. And I, Paul, became a servant of this good news.

dag: Dama n ʒi naŋgban malisim niŋbu, di yi nyɛ lala ŋun nam ma ŋɔ ŋun chɛ ka m bahi pumpɔŋɔ.
en: I don't know how to flatter, and God would quickly punish me if I did.

dag: Ka o daa ti lihi nya kɔbiliga ka di do mɔɣu ni, ka piɛri tiɣisi do ʒii buta gil li, dama kɔbiliga maa ni kom ka bɛ daa ŋɔŋdi nyuhiri ba, ka kuɣ yɛlinli daa pa di noli zuɣu.
en: He looked and saw a well in the field. There were three flocks of sheep lying near the well, where the sheep drank water. There was a large rock covering the mouth of the well.

dag: M mabihi, yi zuɣu ka n zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmahindi m mini Apolɔs yɛla ni di chɛ ka yi doli di ni sabi yɛli shɛm, Miriya ka yi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali shɛm zuɣu. Di mi bi simdi ni yi ni so duhi karimba yino ka ʒiɛm karimba ŋun la.
en: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, Follow the rules. I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.

dag: Ka lan ti o yiko ni o kari saria, o ni nyɛ Daadam Bia la zuɣu.
en: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.

dag: Daadam tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Izraɛl piɛguliba. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Piɛguliba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛl piɛguliba bɛn kul dihirila bɛmaŋ ŋɔ, pa piɛguliba n-dihiri piɛri?.
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce the rulers of Israel. Prophesy to them, and tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , say to them: You are doomed, you shepherds of Israel! You take care of yourselves, but never tend the sheep.

dag: Anzinfa doora ŋun yuli daa booni Dimitirius daa malila anzinfa n-doori buɣili Aritɛmis binnana, ka o mini bɛn daa laɣim tumdi di tuma nyari liɣiri pam di ni.
en: A certain silversmith named Demetrius made silver models of the temple of the goddess Artemis, and his business brought a great deal of profit to the workers.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yɛla wumdi daadam ka di ka yɛtɔɣa. Nini bi nyari tiɣira, ka tibili mi bi wumdi tiɣira.
en: Words cannot fully explain things, but people continue speaking. Words come again and again to our ears, but our ears dont become full. And our eyes dont become full of what we see.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Masia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o ma Mariama ti Yisifu ka na bi kulis o la, ka bɛ ti nya o ka o malila pua Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: This was how the birth of Jesus Christ took place. His mother Mary was engaged to Joseph, but before they were married, she found out that she was going to have a baby by the Holy Spirit.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ŋmahindi paɣ yoli, dama n ni kul be kpe saha shɛli maa zaa, n yɛlimuɣisira mini n suhugarigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa.
en: Dont think I am a bad woman. I have been praying so long because I have so many troubles and am very sad.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba tahi naa sanna.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar was furious. So he sent for the three young men and said.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa kurigi zaa, ka o dabisa ti pali ka o naanyi kpi.
en: Job lived to be a very old man who had lived a good, long life.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni shɛb bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka o lee tɔɣisiri ti yɛri ni di kpalim biɛla ka ti ku lan nya o; ka di ti tooi biɛla ka ti lan nya o yaha maa; ka lan yɛri ni dama o labirila o Ba sani.
en: They said to each other, What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ bɛ kpalansi mini bɛ binyɛr ŋmahi ni binyɛr waɣila yɛli ba hal zaŋ tabili bɛ zuɣupila, ka lo ba mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: So they tied them up, fully dressed—shirts, robes, caps, and all—and threw them into the blazing furnace.

dag: Amaa ka a mi daa pun yɛli ma, N ni niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli, ka chɛ ka a zuliya ti be kaman mɔɣ bihigu la, ka so ku tooi kali ba. .
en: But you have promised that I would be a success and that someday it will be as hard to count my descendants as it is to count the grains of sand along the seashore.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba, ka yɛli Baruk, Di simdi ka ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ti yɛli naa.
en: After he had read it, they turned to one another in alarm and said to Baruch, We must report this to the king.

dag: O gbaai ma n soli zuɣu chaŋ ti dari tɔhi ma. O chɛ ka m bahi yoli.
en: He led me off my path. He tore me to pieces and ruined me.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti niŋ bɔɣili ni. Kom daa ka bɔɣili maa ni, di daa nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ.
en: and threw him into a dry well.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa ti yɛl o, Yi mini yi bihi chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ, amaa chɛliya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi bɛna.
en: The king called Moses and said, You may go and worship the Lord ; even your women and children may go with you. But your sheep, goats, and cattle must stay here.

dag: ni bɛ taba Shɛbania ni Hɔdia ni Kɛlita ni Pɛlaya ni Hanan ni.
en: and their associates: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan.

dag: Ka Jabɛz daa ti suhi Izraɛlnim Naawuni yɛli, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka a daalibarika be n ni, ka chɛ ka n tiŋgbani galisi, ka a zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu n-tiligi ma zaɣibiɛɣ kam zaa ni, ka zaɣibiɛɣ ku niŋ ma. Ka Naawuni daa ti o o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: One day he prayed to Israel's God, Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm. And God did just what Jabez had asked.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Kush nir maa daa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka din niŋ nachimbil maa niŋ nyini n dan naa dimnim mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu ni bɛ niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: The king said to the Cushite, Is my boy Absalom okay? The Cushite answered, May the enemies of my master the king and all who rise up against you to hurt you end up like that young man.

dag: Dama o mi o ni zaŋ binshɛli nam ti. O teeya ni ti nyɛla taŋkpaɣu.
en: Because God knows how were made, God remembers were just dust.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ya ti ʒili yi yaannim ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli la ni, ka yi ti su li, ka o chɛ ka yi tɔŋ, ka yi kalinli galisi gari yi yaannim maa kalinli.
en: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.

dag: Ka Pita garigi yɛli ba, Niŋmiya tuuba ka deeya kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yul ni, ka Naawuni chɛ yi daalahichi paŋ ya, ka yi deeg o Shia Kasi ŋun nyɛ pin la.
en: Peter said to them, Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Naawuni daa sɔŋ o ka o tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Guribaal la ni Miunnima.
en: God helped him defeat the Philistines, the Arabs living at Gurbaal, and the Meunites.

dag: Chamiya gili Ziɔn zaa, ka kaliya di pihi la.
en: People of God, walk around Zion and count the towers;.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔni mirila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, Bɛtijɛshimɔt zaŋ hal ni Ɛbɛlishitim din be Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni la.
en: They camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

dag: Lɛla ni ŋub ba kaman bɛ ni ŋubiri situra shɛm la. Zunzuya ni di ba kaman piɛkɔbiri la. Amaa n faako tibu mini n tiliginsim din nyɛ zuliya kam zaa dini la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The moth will eat them as if they were clothing, and the worm will eat them like wool, but my righteousness is forever, and my salvation for all generations.

dag: Amaa a min a bihi yi zaɣisi ma dolibu, ka bi doli fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zali ya la, ka ŋmaligi doli buɣa jɛmdi li.
en: But if you or your descendants stop following me, disobey the laws and commands I have given you, and worship other gods.

dag: O ni daa nam zuɣusaa, n daa beni, o ni daa booi booli gili teeku zuɣu, n daa beni.
en: I was there when he established the heavens, when he marked out the horizon on the deep sea.

dag: Ti mabihi, di gbarigiya tuun suma tumbu ni.
en: But you, friends, must not become tired of doing good.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum sapashini maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli salo bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, In all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith.

dag: O ni yihi ma zaɣ biɛɣukam ni, ka ni gbib ma hal nti paag o daalizanda nam ni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: The Lord will rescue me from every evil action and will save me for his heavenly kingdom. To him be the glory forever and always. Amen.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda gba daa tɔɣisi ŋun Yisa yɛla n-yɛli: N kul nyarila n Duuma n sani sahakam; o bela n nudirigu polo ni di chɛ ka n suhu ku zɔhira:.
en: David said this about him: I saw the Lord before me always; he is at my right side to keep me safe.

dag: Ka o daa yihiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla waazu, ka wuhiri ba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛla palɔni, ka so daa bi kar o lala niŋbu ni.
en: He preached about the Kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, speaking with all boldness and freedom.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Di ku niŋ lala. So yi ku nyin Keen, bɛn kum niriba ayopɔin yo a kubu maa samli. Ka Yawɛ daa dalim Keen ni di chɛ ka so ti nya o, ka ku ku o.
en: No! the Lord answered. Anyone who kills you will be punished seven times worse than I am punishing you. So the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn everyone not to kill him.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi ya ŋɔ leei dabiɛm shee mini ansarisi malibo shee, ka ŋunkam ti gari kpe, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka o mal li ansarisi zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa zuɣu.
en: I will bring such terrible destruction on this city that everyone who passes by will be shocked and amazed.

dag: N kul paɣiri Naawuni sahakam yi zuɣu, o ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus.

dag: Sania din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli mini binyara zahimbu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ dini. Bintibisa zaa din be kpalaŋ puuni nyɛla o tuma.
en: Honest balances and scales are the LORDs; all the weights in the bag are his doing.

dag: Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Gaad zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses provided for the clans of the Gadite tribe.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa tintariga daa kpuɣi Akirabim hal ni Sɛla n-yi nimaani zaŋ du ha.
en: The land of the Amorites was from Scorpion Pass to Sela and up into the hill country past Sela.

dag: M bia, a yi lo a ʒiʒiinikpee alikauli bee a yi lo amaŋa nia ti so.
en: My son, if you guarantee a loan for your neighbor or shake hands in agreement with a stranger.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan kani ŋun bi kana kpe ka nyɛ ti n-ni bɔhi so baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: But Jehoshaphat asked, Isn't there another prophet through whom we can consult the Lord .

dag: Kɔŋ maa daa kul malila naa Uzia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o ni daa nyɛ kɔŋlan maa zuɣu, o daa kul bela o kɔŋko yili ni ka ku lan tooi kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili maa n-su nayili maa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: King Uzziah had skin disease until the day he died. He lived in a separate house, diseased in his skin, because he was barred from the LORDs temple. His son Jotham supervised the palace administration and governed the people of the land.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Ti bi mi di ni daa yi so sanna.
en: They answered that they didnt know where it came from.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛl o niriba zaa, Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm alikauli kundi ni la.
en: Josiah told the people of Judah, Celebrate Passover in honor of the Lord your God, just as it says in The Book of God's Law .

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin lo ma, di ni chɛ ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Samson answered, If they tie me up with seven new bowstrings that are not dried out, I'll be as weak as anybody else.

dag: Sool paɣ mi yuli n-daa booni Ahinɔam. O daa nyɛla Ahimaaz bipuɣiŋga. Ka o tɔbbi kpɛm mi yuli daa booni Abinɛr, o daa nyɛla Sool bapir Nɛr bia.
en: His wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz; his army commander was his cousin Abner, the son of his uncle Ner.

dag: O bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Shiira. Ŋuna n-daa me Bɛtihɔrɔn tiŋli mini di zuɣusaa polo ni Uzɛnishiira la.
en: His daughter was Sheerah. She built both Lower and Upper Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah.

dag: N yi yihi ya yi ni wurim be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni maa zaa na, n ni ti deei ya kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl la, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira yi sani yi ni be zuliya shɛb sani maa ninni.
en: After I bring you out of the countries where you have been scattered and gather you together, I will accept the sacrifices that you burn, and the nations will see that I am holy.

dag: Ŋunkam zu o ba bee o ma binshɛli ka yɛli ni di pala zaɣ biɛɣu, dilan nyɛla ŋun pahi ninvuɣ kuriba ni.
en: Anyone who thinks it isn't wrong to steal from his parents is no better than a common thief.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Ɛlizabɛt, So ka yi zuliya ni ka o yuli booni Jɔn.
en: The people argued, No one in your family has ever been named John.

dag: ni Ɛdom ni Mɔab ni Ammɔnnim.
en: Then I made the people of Edom, Moab, and Ammon drink from the cup.

dag: dama Masidɔnianim mini Akaianim yuya ni bɛ tɔhi tɔto ti Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba be Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: For the churches in Macedonia and Achaia have freely decided to give an offering to help the poor among God's people in Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Naawuni pun tahi tiliginsim yɛligu ŋɔ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn ni wum li. .
en: And Paul concluded: You are to know, then, that God's message of salvation has been sent to the Gentiles. They will listen.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara tila alizinnima, pa Naawuni, ka mali maliŋ ti wun shɛb bɛ ni pun bi mi. Bɛ daa lan mali wun pal shɛb bɛn na yoli yina ka nyɛ yi yaannim ni daa bi lu shɛb sizuura.
en: They sacrificed to gods that are not real, new gods their ancestors had never known, gods that Israel had never obeyed.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Yaakubu pam ka o suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa pirig o niriba bɛn be o sani min o biŋkɔbbaligu ni o niɣi ni o laakumnim ʒii buyi.
en: Jacob was very frightened and worried. He divided the people who were with him and all the flocks, herds, and camels into two groups.

dag: Gidiɔn ni daa wum doo maa zahindi maa mini di gbinni ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka o daa paɣi Naawuni pam, ka ŋmaligi lab Izraɛlnim sani ti yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ, Yawɛ zaŋ Midiannim maa zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: When Gideon heard about the man's dream and what it meant, he fell to his knees and worshiped the Lord . Then he went back to the Israelite camp and said, Get up! The Lord is giving you victory over the Midianite army.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Yaakubu zuliya? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Izraɛl zuliya maa pirigibu bunahi puuni yim? Chɛ ka n kpila wuntizɔra kum, ka chɛ ka m bahigu ti be kaman o bahigu.
en: The descendants of Israel are like the dust— There are too many of them to be counted. Let me end my days like one of God's people; Let me die in peace like the righteous.

dag: Ka toli maa daa ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Ka bɛ galisim maa kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ.
en: The locusts swarmed over the whole land of Egypt and settled on the whole country. Such a huge swarming of locusts had never happened before and would never happen ever again.

dag: Zabidiɛl bia Jashɔbiam n-daa su bɛ ni tuui pirigi ninvuɣ shɛb la fukumsi gol tuuli puuni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first group for the first month. There were , men in Jashobeams group.

dag: Yinim Yawɛ daba bɛn ʒe o jɛmbu duu yuŋ ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Everyone who serves the Lord , come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight.

dag: Iso zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ nanima m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso bituuli Ɛlifaz bidibisi. Bɛn daa nyɛ nanim maa n-nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfo ni Kɛnaz.
en: These are the family groups that came from Esau: Esaus first son was Eliphaz. From Eliphaz came Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa nyɛla bundana ni yɛndana n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: He was the richest and wisest king in the world.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yiriŋyiriŋ, dama Yawɛ ku chɛ ŋunkam boon o yuli yiriŋyiriŋ taali.
en: You must not use the name of the Lord your God to make empty promises. If you do, the Lord will not let you go unpunished.

dag: Izraɛl anab shɛb tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo, ka nyari ʒiinima zaŋ chaŋ di suhudoo polo, ka suhudoo mi kani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala ma.
en: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: O daa poya Yawɛ sani. O daa po pɔri Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sani yɛli.
en: Remember, Lord , what he promised, the vow he made to you, the Mighty God of Jacob:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ di gba mini di naa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku niriba bɛn zaa be di ni, ka so daa bi kpalim; ka daa niŋ di naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: The Lord allowed the Israelites to defeat that city and its king. They killed everyone in the city. No one was left alive. And they did the same thing to that king as they had done to the king of Jericho.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili nyɛla kum tumo, ka ŋun mali yɛm ni maai li.
en: When a king gets angry, he can put someone to death. So it is wise to keep the king happy.

dag: Izraɛlnima, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ni Yawɛ ʒi yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli bee bɛ yi ŋari ya, yi Naawuni baɣa kani?.
en: People of Jacob, this is true. Israel, you should believe it. So why do you say, The Lord cannot see the way I live; he will not find me and punish me ?.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Then, if anyone says to you, Look, here is the Messiah! or, Look, there he is!—do not believe it.

dag: Juda nanim ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣi vuɣi tintariga kpahi. N suhuyiɣisili ni ti lu bɛ zuɣu kaman saa la.
en: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, malimi shili n-kahi a nɛma zo. A ni yi amaŋmaŋ biɛhigu shee n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la bɛ ninni. Di pa shɛli bɛ ni baŋ di gbinni, hal bɛ ni kul nyɛ duŋtaariba maa zaa yoli.
en: Now, mortal man, pack a bundle just as a refugee would and start out before nightfall. Let everyone see you leaving and going to another place. Maybe those rebels will notice you.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nya yaa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛh o kɔbili ni, ka di daa luh o. Dama o daa bi niŋdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa sani, ka daa kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini zuɣu.
en: But when Uzziah became strong, his pride caused him to be destroyed. He was not faithful to the Lord his God. He went into the Lord s Temple to burn incense on the altar for burning incense.

dag: Buɣim mini nyɔhi ni chilibi din daa yiri yuri maa noya ni maa na n-daa nyɛ alɔbo diba ata din ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la;.
en: By these three plagues a third of humankind was killed: by the fire, smoke, and sulfur coming out of their mouths.

dag: Di simdi ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka nya faako. Di simdi ni n yaai n noli garigi.
en: if I don't speak. *.

dag: M muɣisigu puuni, n daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: In my distress I called to the Lord ; he answered me and set me free.

dag: Naawuni ni yiɣisi zani ni o kari saria tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni la zuɣu.
en: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.

dag: Dama n daa fa nandaamba bɛn kuhiri bahi, ka fa kpibisi bɛn ka ŋun ni sɔŋ ba bahi.
en: because I rescued the weak who cried out, the orphans who lacked help.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi ni o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu ka lala daa niŋ maa.
en: This happened because King Jeroboam had committed many sins and had caused the Israelites to sin. This made the Lord , the God of Israel, very angry.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn mali wumpaɣibo sara ti man Yawɛ, yin malimiya li din ni chɛ ka n deei li yi sani.
en: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bɔhi ba, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tum maa? Yi bi mi ni nir kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ tooi nyari ashilɔni yɛla.
en: who asked them, What have you done? Didn't you know I could find out.

dag: Tɔbbihi bɛn daa doya maa ni daa wum li, bɛ yɛlimi, Zimiri lo nia biɛɣu n-ku naa. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Omri ŋun daa nyɛ sapashin kpɛm la n-leei Izraɛl naa sansani maa ni dindali maa.
en: and when they heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and assassinated him, then and there they all proclaimed their commander Omri king of Israel.

dag: ka yɛli nachimba maa, Chamiya n tooni ka n doli yi nyaaŋa na. Amaa o daa bi saɣi yɛl o yidan Nabal.
en: Then she said to the servants, You go on ahead and I will follow you. But she said nothing to her husband.

dag: Ka o daa pii bɛ niriba tuhi pisopɔin ni bɛ ʒiri ʒiya, ka pii niriba tuhi pihinii ni bɛ chaŋ zoya tiŋgban ni ti kpɛri kuɣa, ka zaŋ niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa.
en: He made , of these immigrants laborers, , of them stonecutters in the highlands, and , of them supervisors to keep the people working.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlimi, Pa Musa kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi. O daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi tinim gba. Ka Yawɛ daa wum li.
en: They said, Has the LORD spoken only through Moses? Hasnt he also spoken through us? The LORD heard it.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi gari tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba. Ka bɛ daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi paɣ maa.
en: It was worth a full years pay. It could have been sold and the money given to those who are poor. And they told the woman what a bad thing she had done.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi baŋ din yɛn niŋ ma kpe ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli, n ni lo nia tim o yi sanna.
en: I plan to send him to you quickly, as soon as I know what will happen to me.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza tɔbbihi maa ni daa teei gili Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, ka ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza maŋmaŋ daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to the city.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri mahigiri tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka di mali kulim pam. Nyin Naawuni mɔɣili palila kom, nyini n-tiri niriba bindira. A ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin yɛlimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni, chɛ ka a yuli du, ka chɛ ka a nam kana.
en: Jesus said to the followers, This is how you should pray: Father, we pray that your name will always be kept holy. We pray that your kingdom will come.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, Doo maa ka kpe na? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl ba, Nyamiya, o sɔɣ be kpalansi ŋɔ nyaaŋa.
en: So they asked another question of the LORD: Has the man come here yet? The LORD said, Yes, hes hiding among the supplies.

dag: Dindali maa a ni ti yaag a noli tɔɣisi ŋun zo n-tiligi maa yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan shini yaha. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka a ni leei shihirili bɛ sani, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: On that day your mouth will be opened to the refugee, and you will speak and no longer be silent. You will be their sign, and they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ daanya m-mali binkpila ayi n-zaŋ tam daanya daantalis ayi maa zuɣusaa, ka binkpila maa zaɣ yini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla.
en: He also made two bronze capitals that were cubits tall. He put these capitals on top of the columns.

dag: ka di ti pali, ka bɛ vo li duhi dul na nti ʒini n-gahim zin suma niŋ piɛri ni ka zaŋ zaɣ biɛri bahi.
en: When the net is full, they pull it to shore and sit down to divide the fish: the good ones go into the buckets, the worthless ones are thrown away.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Suɣa Tibu Chuɣu puhibu daa ti mirina.
en: The time for the Festival of Shelters was near.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa maani buɣa polo, ti mi ni di nyɛla kaman shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la: Ti zaa mali baŋsim. Amaa baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo tahirila maŋduhibu na; yurilim n-naɣ nyɛ din kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: Now I will write about meat that is sacrificed to idols. It is certainly true that we all have knowledge, as you say. But this knowledge only fills people with pride. It is love that helps the church grow stronger.

dag: ni Hɔrinim bɛn be Ɛdom zoya ni la n-doli ba hal ni Ɛliparan din be mɔɣu ni tintariga la shee.
en: And they defeated the Horites who lived in the area from the hill country of Seir to El Paran.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi n-kɔri ba ti alizinnima.
en: They even offered their own children as sacrifices to demons.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi zuliya nabi.
en: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ daba ayopɔin dali, n ni chɛ ka saa lu dunia ni na m-mi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa biɛɣ pihinahi n-ku n ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ tiŋgban ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: Seven days from now I am going to send rain that will fall for forty days and nights, in order to destroy all the living beings that I have made.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi po pɔri, yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: It is no sin not to make a vow to the Lord .

dag: ni teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi la zaa ni firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu tuma nɛma zaa ni tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini la.
en: the table and all its equipment, the lampstand and its equipment, the altar for burning incense.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfo ni Onam.
en: Shobal's sons were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

dag: Yɛligu maa daa pun bela Naawuni sani piligu ni ha.
en: From the very beginning the Word was with God.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum sapashini maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka di gar o pam, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli salo bɛn dol o maa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal Izraɛlnim ni n na ʒi n-nya ŋun niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed. He turned to the people following him and said, I tell you, this is the most faith I have seen anywhere, even in Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma ni n yɛl a ni o ni niŋ a shɛm la ka o niŋ a maa, dama o darigi deei nam maa a nuu ni n-zaŋ ti Dauda ŋun nyɛ a kpee la.
en: The LORD has done to you exactly what he spoke through me: The LORD has ripped the kingdom out of your hands and has given it to your friend David.

dag: amaa ŋun mali paɣa baɣa bela dunia ŋɔ yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o paɣ nini.
en: But a man who is married is busy with things of the world. He is trying to please his wife.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka a chɛ ka saa bi lan mira, di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ti niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu ka ŋmaligi kpa kpe na m-bol a yuli ka suh a zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tibidarigibo maa polo.
en: Sometimes they will sin against you, and you will stop the rain from falling on their land. Then they will pray toward this place and praise your name. You will make them suffer, and they will be sorry for their sins.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat maa daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili Izraɛl Naa Ahazia ŋun daa tum tuumbiɛri pam la.
en: Later on, King Jehoshaphat of Judah made an agreement with King Ahaziah of Israel. Ahaziah was very evil.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bi ku ba Izraɛl kpamba ni daa pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni n-niŋdi bɛ kpamba maa.
en: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack.

dag: ni yi kpe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni po pɔri lɔn ya alikauli shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni;.
en: You are all here to enter into an agreement with the Lord your God. The Lord your God is making this agreement with you today.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma leei di molomoona mini tumo ni karimba ŋun ni wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yɛda niŋbu mini yɛlimaŋli soli yɛla. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri maa; m bi ŋmarila ʒiri!.
en: I was appointed to be a preacher and apostle of this testimony—Im telling the truth and Im not lying! Im a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bulahi bɛn nyɛ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri maa ka naa mini zama maa sanna, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu.
en: Finally, they brought the goats for the purification offering before the king and the assembly. After laying their hands on them.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛlikam ʒibu na polo, dama Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ luɣ viɛlli shee ka bɛ yɛn ʒini. .
en: Dont worry about your possessions because you will have good things from the entire land of Egypt.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri suhu din be kasi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi nyɛ naa zɔnima.
en: If you love purity of heart and graciousness of speech, the king will be your friend.

dag: Amaa galimi ni ka m biɛhigu ni zuɣu, a sɔŋ ma, ka zaŋ ma zal a tooni sahakam.
en: You will help me, because I do what is right; you will keep me in your presence forever.

dag: Ka n daa wum di yɛla, ka n ni sɔhira, ka n naŋgbampiba ŋmɛri tab di vuri zuɣu, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi ka n naba sɔhira. N kul yɛn shinimi ka guhiri dahin shɛli mbusim ni ti yɛn lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kana ti liri ti maa zuɣu.
en: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster.

dag: Yi yi ti birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ soli, yi ni ti wum o kukoli yi nyaaŋa polo ka di yɛra, Soli maa m-bɔŋɔ, doliya li.
en: If you wander from the right path, either to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice behind you saying, You should go this way. Here is the right way.

dag: A ni daa gbibi duŋ kurugu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku Izraɛlnima saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nya yɛlibiɛɣu bɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa ni la zuɣu.
en: Why? Because you have always been against my people. You used your sword against Israel at the time of their trouble, at the time of their final punishment.

dag: Naawuni wuhiya ni o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee din nyɛ tiŋ puuni birininim la ni.
en: God has shown that there is safety with him inside the fortresses of the city.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Molada ni Hazarishual.
en: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti ti din viɛla, ka ti puri atam niŋ pam.
en: Our Lord , you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ lala; bɛ daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD commanded them.

dag: Zaŋm amaŋa n-niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka niŋ o naani ka o tum di ni simdi ni o tum shɛm.
en: Give yourself to the Lord ; trust in him, and he will help you;.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba shɛb mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba daa be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Those settling in Jerusalem included some from Judah, some from Benjamin, and some from Ephraim and Manasseh.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini yi ni chani ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa lo tab alikauli. Yi yi niŋ lala, di ni leei tɔŋ yi sani.
en: Be careful that you dont make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which you are going, or it will become a dangerous trap for you.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbbaligu mini yi niɣi zaa chaŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka suhiya Naawuni daalibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Take all of your sheep and cattle with you, just as you said you would. Go! And say a blessing for me too.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ayi: yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , ka o mabia yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: Two sons were born to Eber: one was named Peleg, because in his days the land was divided; and his brothers name was Joktan.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum buyi.
en: Jesus said to Peter, I tell you that before the rooster crows two times tonight, you will say three times that you do not know me.

dag: Naa Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa ni bɛ ni daa nya ka o tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni. Ka o bia Jɛhoyakin daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Everything that Jehoiakim did, including his disgusting practices and the evil he committed, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah . His son Jehoiachin succeeded him as king.

dag: Dama di nyɔri so anzinfa, ka di nyɔri lan so salima.
en: There is more profit in it than there is in silver; it is worth more to you than gold.

dag: Man Jɔn n-nyɛ ŋun daa wum yɛla ŋɔ, ka nya dimbɔŋɔnima. N ni daa wum li ka nya li maa, ka n daa gbani malaika so ŋun wuhi ma binyara maa tooni ni n jɛm o;.
en: I, John, have heard and seen all these things. And when I finished hearing and seeing them, I fell down at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things, and I was about to worship him.

dag: O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam tɔbu ni, ka gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli tinshee katiŋ ha. .
en: Amos has said, Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will be forced out of its land.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni Bia maa kum la zuɣu chɛ ka yi leela Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛba n-naag omaŋa ni di chɛ ka yi be kasi ka ka daɣiri ka mi ku mali galimi, ka o zaŋ ya labis omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ, ka piɛgul suŋ mi zaŋd o nyɛvili taɣir o piɛri dini.
en: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.

dag: ka sakuɣa lu n-sabigi ŋari di kɔsoya la.
en: like those darkened by thawing ice, in which snow is obscured.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zo n-daŋ bɛ tooni nti du sinsabiga ni o nya o, dama Yisa daa yɛn dolila ni gari.
en: So he ran to a place where he knew Jesus would come. Then he climbed a sycamore tree so he could see him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka niriba mini bɛ paɣiba daa ti piligi kumdi pampam niŋdi bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim la.
en: Some time later many of the people, both men and women, began to complain against the other Jews.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Doo maa boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: Some of the people standing there heard him and said, He is calling for Elijah.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bo biŋkɔbiri maa mini ŋmana maa zaa na nti kɔri ba m-pirigipirigi ba buyiyi n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ tuhi taba. Amaa o daa bi pirigi ŋmana la bɛn buyiyi.
en: Abram brought the animals to God, cut them in half, and placed the halves opposite each other in two rows; but he did not cut up the birds.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kɔniŋdi bini maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo lɔrigi ni.
en: The tank was placed near the southeast corner of the Temple.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu sa ti yɛn neei ka n yi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, hal do yino gba, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma n ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm maa, hal ŋun niŋm ma gari lala gba.
en: May God strike me dead if I don't kill every last one of those men before morning.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ ni daa niŋ saha shɛli maa, n daa ka Jɛrusalɛm, dama di daa nyɛla Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ni daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa yuun pihitanaayi saha ka n daa lab o sani. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti lan suhi naa soli n-lab Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: I wasnt in Jerusalem while this was happening because I had gone to Babylons King Artaxerxes in the thirty-second year of the king. After some time, I asked the kings permission.

dag: Ka ŋunkam po Naawuni jɛmbu duu pola di mini Naawuni ŋun be di ni maa.
en: And anyone who uses the Temple to make a promise is really using the Temple and God, who lives in it.

dag: Lɛvinima n-daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ŋun daa daŋ mali me m-pan o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Bani bia Rɛhum. Ka Hashabia ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me n-ti o yaɣili polɔnima.
en: The following Levites rebuilt the next several sections of the wall: Rehum son of Bani built the next section; Hashabiah, ruler of half of the Keilah District, built the next section on behalf of his district;.

dag: Niriba maa mi daa niŋ ti viɛnyɛliŋga pam, bɛ daa bi niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu, ti mi binshɛli daa ʒi m-bɔrigi saha shɛli ti ni daa be bɛ sani mɔɣu maa ni maa.
en: These men were very good to us while we were out in the fields with the sheep. Davids men were with us the whole time, and they never did anything wrong to us. They did not take anything from us.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛla.
en: When Arpachshad was , he had a son named Shelah.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N yi naai n ni niŋdi shɛlikam Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm, n ni darigi Asiria naa tibili o karimbaani min o barinyubo zuɣu.
en: When the Lord finishes doing what he planned to Jerusalem and Mount Zion, he will punish Assyria. The king of Assyria is very proud. His pride made him do many bad things, so God will punish him.

dag: N daa yi Ibrahimma zuɣu, ka yi Yisahaku zuɣu, ka lan yi Yaakubu gba zuɣu n-wuhi ba ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa, amaa n daa bi kahigi n yuli Yawɛ wuhi ba.
en: But when I appeared to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, I came as God All-Powerful and did not use my name.

dag: Ti ni nyɛ bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumdi zuɣu, ti suhiri ya ni yi di deeya Naawuni daalibarika la yoli.
en: In our work together with God, then, we beg you who have received God's grace not to let it be wasted.

dag: O ʒila Salɛm, ka o biɛhigu shee nyɛ Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu.
en: He has his home in Jerusalem; he lives on Mount Zion.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa di nasara n-yɛligi gili luɣilikam.
en: In this way the Lords word grew abundantly and strengthened powerfully.

dag: Ka o daa kpah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ miri ka bɛ yɛli so ni ŋun Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Then Jesus ordered his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini teeku kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: He said to them, Why are you afraid, you people of weak faith? Then he got up and gave orders to the winds and the lake, and there was a great calm.

dag: Ka Ifriim min o paɣ maa daa lan dɔni ka o niŋ pua dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Bɛraya, zaɣ biɛɣu din daa niŋ o yiŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: Then he had intercourse with his wife again, and she became pregnant and had a son. They named him Beriah, because of the trouble that had come to their family.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Listen, then, if you have ears.

dag: Yi salima mini yi daanzinfa zahimya ka di zahimbu maa din ya shɛhira biɛɣu, ka ni di yi niŋgbuna kaman buɣim ni diri binyara shɛm la. Yi kahi azichi guli dabisa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Galili Teeku maa yaɣili tiŋgban shɛli din yuli booni Gɛrasa.
en: Jesus and his disciples sailed on over to the territory of Gerasa, which is across the lake from Galilee.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-gbani Ilaisha naba ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa, ka kpuɣ o bia maa yi.
en: She came in and bowed down at Elisha's feet. Then she picked up her son and left.

dag: Amaa ti bɔri ni ti bahi wum din be a sani, dama ti mi ni adiini so shɛli a ni doli ŋɔ, niriba kul tɔɣisiri galindi li mi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: But we would like to hear your ideas, because we know that everywhere people speak against this party to which you belong.

dag: Zuliya shɛb gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ŋ-ŋmaligi lu di ni; bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bari tɔn shɛli ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: Those other nations have fallen into the pit they dug to catch others. They have been caught in their own trap.

dag: Gidiɔn maŋmaŋ bidibisi daa nyɛla pisopɔin, dama o daa malila paɣ bɔbili.
en: He had seventy sons, because he had many wives.

dag: ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ku bɛ ni bɛn mali kpiɔŋ. O daa booi Izraɛl nachimbihi gahinda kalinli.
en: God became angry and killed even the strongest of them. He brought down Israels best young men.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yubu nyɛla ni ŋunkam nya o Bia la ka niŋ o yɛda ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: For what my Father wants is that all who see the Son and believe in him should have eternal life. And I will raise them to life on the last day.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi taba, O ni di tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa sol ni ka kahigiri Naawuni litaafinim wuhiri ti la, di di bi kpe ti suhuri ni pam.
en: They said to each other, When he talked to us on the road, it felt like a fire burning in us. How exciting it was when he explained to us the true meaning of the Scriptures.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Darius daa sab gbaŋ ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni yɛli: Naawuni timi ya suhudoo pam!.
en: Then King Darius wrote this letter to all the people from other nations and language groups all around the world: Greetings:.

dag: Miriya ka yi me napɔna dubu shee n-zali n sara maligu bimbini gbini n-dur li din ni chɛ ka so nya yi zaɣim. .
en: Dont climb onto my altar using steps: then your genitals wont be exposed by doing so.

dag: Sɛraya ni Azaria ni Jɛrimia ni.
en: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah, Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah, Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch, Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah, Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch, Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin, Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah.

dag: N ni kari toli ka chɛn ya, ka bɛ ku lan saɣim yi puri ni bindira, ka yi puri ni wain tihi ku lan kɔŋ wala walibu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will not let pests destroy your crops. All your grapevines will produce grapes. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa tuui wuhi shihir shɛli ka di wuhi o yiko ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba daa niŋ o yɛda. Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la ka o daa wuhi shihirili maa.
en: This was the first miraculous sign that Jesus did in Cana of Galilee. He revealed his glory, and his disciples believed in him.

dag: Ka yili maa ni bipuɣiŋga ŋun daa guli dunoli maa bɔhi Pita, A pala doo ŋɔ nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, M pala o nyaandola.
en: The girl at the gate said to Peter, Aren't you also one of the disciples of that man? No, I am not, answered Peter.

dag: Bɛ daa bela bɛ suɣa ni ŋ-ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: They muttered in their tents and wouldnt listen to the LORDs voice.

dag: Mani m-mi o, dama n yila o sanna, ŋun mi n-nyɛ ŋun tim ma na.
en: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.

dag: Dama nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi ni n daa tum taali, dinzuɣu ka mani n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ yi Yisifu zuliya ni kana ni n ti tuhi nyini n dan naa soli maa.
en: I know I was wrong. That's why I wanted to be the first one from the northern tribes to meet you.

dag: N tim ya mi ni yi ti kpuɣi yi ni bi di puu atam shɛli wahala. Shɛba m-pun di di wahala ka yinim ti lee yɛn di di nyɔri.
en: I sent you to harvest a crop that you did not work for. Others did the work, and you get the profit from their work.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ni ti jɛm o; bɛ ni ti yɛli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna niriba ti Duuma yɛla.
en: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also give male goat as a sin offering. This must be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o ni lo Izraɛlnim alikauli sun shɛŋa la zaa zaɣ yini gba bi yiɣisi. O daa chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
en: The Lord kept every promise that he made to the Israelites. There were no promises that he failed to keep. Every promise came true.

dag: Zaŋm salima mali kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni.
en: Make two gold settings.

dag: Malimiya nyɔtaɣirisi zaɣ bihi mini zaɣ kara n-chaŋ tɔb tuhibu.
en: The Egyptian officers shout, Get your shields ready and march into battle!.

dag: A ni niŋ o naani o ni mali kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka chɛ a tuma jɛl o?.
en: Will you trust it because its strength is great so that you can leave your work to it?.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din chihiri niŋ yi yinsi puuni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni woligi ya kun ya kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ saɣim li shɛm maa. Di simdi ka yi ti siŋ li ka zaɣisi li, dama di nyɛla di ni simdi ni yi saɣim binshɛli.
en: You must not bring any of those disgusting idols into your homes, or you will be destroyed just as they will be. You must treat them as the disgusting things they are! They are to be destroyed.

dag: Bɛ bela zibisim ni wuntaŋ ni, ka bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman yuŋ la.
en: Daylight will be like darkness for them. Even at noon they will have to feel their way as in the dark.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ paai ti? Di nyɛla yi tuumbiɛri ni galisi zuɣu ka bɛ darigi fuɣi yi situra, ka bili ya.
en: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.

dag: Nyamiya, m piligimi ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai n tiŋ maa nima, ka wula ka yi ni tooi yi tibidarigibo maa ni? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu, dama n lɔrila tɔbu ni n tuhi dunianim zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Look! Im bringing disaster upon the city that bears my name; how then will you escape unpunished? You will not! Im summoning the sword against everyone on earth, declares the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu na ni o ti ti Yawɛ, di simdi ka di nyɛla dilan naɣikpahi ni nahu bee o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua.
en: Tell the Israelites: When you bring an offering to the Lord , the offering must be one of your tame animals—it can be a sheep, a goat, or one of your cattle.

dag: Ŋunkam kahind o tab nini nyɛla ŋun tahiri yɛla na, amaa ŋunkam mali suhukpeeni kpahiri niriba zuɣuri ni nyɛla ŋun tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Deceit causes trouble, and foolish talk will bring you to ruin.

dag: Ka banim ka o daa po n-yɛli ni bɛ ku nya vuhim o san la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa niŋ tipawumlinim la?.
en: When God made his solemn promise, They will never enter the land where I would have given them rest—of whom was he speaking? Of those who rebelled.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti ni baai du n-chaŋ bɛ sani ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi ba.
en: All right, Jonathan said. We will go across and let the Philistines see us.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Zaŋmi bia ŋɔ kuli ti wubis o ti ma ka n yo a. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa kuli ti wubis o.
en: The kings daughter said to the mother, Take this baby and feed him for me. Ill pay you to take care of him. So the woman took her baby and cared for him.

dag: Di niŋya tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Mɛriba mini bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Masa tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Dont be stubborn, as you were at Meribah, as you were at Massah in the desert.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimiya sochira zuɣu lihi, bɔhimiya baŋ kurimbuni ha soya la, ka bɔhi baŋ so viɛlli ni nyɛ shɛli n-dol li ka nya suhudoo. Amaa ka bɛ yɛli, Ti ku dol li.
en: The Lord said to his people, Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask for the ancient paths and where the best road is. Walk in it, and you will live in peace. But they said, No, we will not.

dag: ka nya ka pako faralan so daa tɔhi pihinu diba ayi.
en: He also saw a poor widow putting in a few cents.

dag: N suhiri ti Duuma ni o zom Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnim nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa kul kpaŋsiri n suhu waawaayili; ka vi bi mal o zoligɔnim din lo ma la zuɣu.
en: May the Lord show mercy to Onesiphorus household, because he supported me many times and he wasnt ashamed of my imprisonment.

dag: Ti valim ba zaɣ nɛma kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni niŋdi shɛm la. Ti ni vali ba zaɣ muna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe gballi ni.
en: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni tim o ni o ti yɛli Aduna shɛm yɛl o, ka wuh o o ni yɛl o ni o tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa.
en: Moses told Aaron everything the Lord had commanded him to say and all the miracles he must do to prove that God had sent him.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha din daa nyɛ Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia mi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha la, ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa kana ti teei gili Samarianima.
en: In the fourth year of Hezekiah's reign—which was the seventh year of King Hoshea's reign over Israel—Emperor Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel and besieged Samaria.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o ŋmaligi yɛli doo ŋun gbaya kpi maa, N yɛr a mi, yiɣisima n-zaŋ a daamaŋka kuli.
en: I will prove to you, then, that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins. So he said to the paralyzed man, I tell you, get up, pick up your bed, and go home.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba la sani ti yɛl o, Di ku baŋdiba maa. Zaŋm ma tahi naa sani ka n ti wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: Daniel went back to Arioch, the official in charge of executing the wise men. Daniel said, Don't kill those men! Take me to the king, and I will explain the meaning of his dream.

dag: Yi mi di maliya li ŋmahindi biŋkɔbigu ŋun be dunia ŋɔ ni bee ŋ-ŋmahindi nooŋa ŋun mali kpiŋkpama yiɣiri zuɣusaa.
en: animal or bird.

dag: Ka Ibram daa pirigipirig o tɔbbihi maa n-chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ ŋ-ŋme n-kari ba hal ti paai Hɔba din be Damaskus nuzaa polo la.
en: That night, Abram divided up his troops, attacked from all sides, and won a great victory. But some of the enemy escaped to the town of Hobah north of Damascus.

dag: di saha yili maa lana ŋun cham ti yɛli maligumaana, Di ŋmanila dɔr shɛli n-lu n yiŋa.
en: The person who owns that house must come and tell the priest, I see something like mildew in my house.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni dini n-lee be asama ni nira yɛli: A yi yɛli so ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ.
en: Which is easier—to say, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Get up and walk?.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Chɛliya ka o niŋ yomyom n-tum o tuma ka ti nya; kul chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ tum o ni lo shɛm ka ti baŋ li.
en: who say, God should hurry and work faster so we can see; let the plan of Israels holy one come quickly, so we can understand it.

dag: Zaŋm a ni daa da jinjɛŋŋma shɛli sɔri maa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti zaŋ li pi tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: Go to the Euphrates River and hide the shorts in a hole in the rocks.

dag: Bɛ ni booni ba la, Bɛ ni zaɣisi anzinfa shɛli, Dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ba.
en: They will be called worthless dross, because I, the Lord , have rejected them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Gaad zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Ramɔt din be Giliad, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tin shɛli tiligiri la mini Mahanaim.
en: From the tribe of Gad they received four cities: Ramoth in Gilead, with its pasture lands , Mahanaim.

dag: Niriba gaŋbu bi viɛla, amaa bindirigu biɛla zuɣu ni tooi chɛ ka nir tum gala.
en: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yi ti kpe yi ni, yi ni nya yiko ka leei n shɛhiranima Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ tabili Judia mini Samaria tiŋgbana ni hal ti kpa dunia tarisi zaa.
en: But the Holy Spirit will come upon you and give you power. Then you will tell everyone about me in Jerusalem, in all Judea, in Samaria, and everywhere in the world.

dag: Aroa ka o daa piligi ba ŋmɛbu m-mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din daa baɣi Minnit la n-daa nyaŋ nimaani tinsi pisi zaa; ka daa lan zaŋ ba nimaani n-doli ba hal ni Ɛbɛlikɛramim n-daa ku ba kuri biɛɣu. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Ammɔnnim maa.
en: He defeated them from the city of Aroer to the city of Minnith. Jephthah captured cities. Then he fought the Ammonites to the city of Abel Keramim. The Israelites defeated them. It was a very great defeat for the Ammonites.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka n ni ti darigi di buɣa la tibili, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya dansi ni ti do di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ŋ-ŋuhira.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will deal with her idols, and the wounded in her land will groan.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa nya bɛ ni chani maa m-baŋ ba, ka yi tinsi ni zo bɛ naba zuɣu daŋ ba bɛ ni daa chani luɣ shɛli maa paabu.
en: But many people saw them leave and figured out where they were going. So people from every town ran on ahead and got there first.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka n nya wɔr piɛli. Ŋun daa ʒi o zuɣu yuli daa boonila Ʒiɛyim mini Yɛlimaŋli. Ka o daa mali wuntitali n-kariti saria ka tuhiri tɔbu.
en: Then I saw heaven open. There before me was a white horse. The rider on the horse was called Faithful and True, because he is right in his judging and in making war.

dag: O daa lan bɔri ni o kahigila o jilima din galisi n-wuhi o ni daa zaŋ li niŋ tinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya o nambɔzɔbo la ni, ka mali ti zali ni ti ti nya o jilima.
en: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.

dag: Ka dim so ŋun biri piriŋkpana biɛlim maa nyɛla Sintani; ka chɛbu saha la nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu saha, ka malaikanim mi nyɛ bɛn chɛri li maa.
en: and the enemy who sowed the weeds is the Devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvest workers are angels.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka n lee kul yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi Naawuni nam?.
en: Jesus said again, What can I compare Gods kingdom with?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Shua bipuɣiŋga la daa kpi. O ni daa mal o kuli naai nyaaŋa ka o min o zo Hira ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la chaŋ Timna ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chɛr o piɛri kɔbiri la sani.
en: Later, Judahs wife, the daughter of Shua, died. After Judahs time of sadness, he went to Timnah with his friend Hirah from Adullam. Judah went to Timnah to have the wool cut from his sheep.

dag: Amaa m mali yɛm kaman yi gba ni mali yɛm shɛm maa. M pala ŋun biɛhigu pooi yi biɛhigu; ka ŋuni n-lee bi mi dimbɔŋɔnima?.
en: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Daadam Bia yi ti ʒin o jilima nam ʒiishee dunia palli din kanna ni, yinim bɛn dol o ŋɔ gba ni ti ʒini nam ʒiishɛhi pinaayi ni n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: Jesus said to them, When the time of the new world comes, the Son of Man will sit on his great and glorious throne. And I can promise that you who followed me will sit on twelve thrones, and you will judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri beni hal ti kurigi ka kul mali yiko pam?.
en: Why do the wicked live, grow old, and even become strong?.

dag: Biɛrim shɛli din mali ba ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la. Bɛ ŋmanila bi jɛrigu ŋun bi bɔri ni o yi o ma pul ni na.
en: Israel has a chance to live, but is too foolish to take it—like a child about to be born, who refuses to come out of the womb.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ pun niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuma zaa puuni. O mi yi ni be tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ŋɔ ni chani ŋɔ yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul bela yi sani yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa, ka binshɛli bi pooi ya.
en: Remember how the Lord your God has blessed you in everything that you have done. He has taken care of you as you wandered through this vast desert. He has been with you these forty years, and you have had everything you needed.

dag: Ka so mi beni, o ka suhupiɛlli, ka ti kpi ni suhugarigu.
en: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.

dag: Amaa m bi mi n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm ti n dan Naa Siiza. Dinzuɣu ka n zaŋ o ka yi sanna, di bahi bamdi nyin Naa Agiripa. Ti yi vih o naai, di pa shɛli n ni baŋ n ni yɛn sab o yɛla shɛm;.
en: However, I dont really know what to tell Caesar that this man has done wrong. So I have brought him before all of you—especially you, King Agrippa. I hope that you can question him and give me something to write to Caesar.

dag: zaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb Naa Ashuribanipal ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam la ni daa yiɣisina nti ʒili Samaria tiŋ puuni mini luɣ shɛŋa din pahi m-be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la nim sanna.
en: together with the other peoples whom the great and powerful Ashurbanipal moved from their homes and settled in the city of Samaria and elsewhere in West-of-Euphrates Province.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan nya ka Yɛhudianim kpuɣila Ashidɔdnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Mɔabnim bipuɣinsi n-niŋ bɛ paɣiba.
en: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma nyɛla jɛmbu tuma mini ʒiʒibo.
en: The Gershonites will be responsible.

dag: Daadam, niriba ŋɔ niŋla bɛ buɣa yɛda ka chɛ ka bɛ daalahichi leei bɛ kuɣituurili do bɛ tooni. N ni chɛ ka bɛ bɔhi ma baŋ shɛli?.
en: Human one, these men decide on their own to set up their idols, so the cause of their downfall is right in front of them. Why should I allow them to ask me anything?.

dag: Di saha Chɛmɔshi yɛla ni ti gbaai Mɔabnim vi kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ Bɛtɛl naani ka di yɛla ti gbahi ba vi shɛm la.
en: Then you will be ashamed, because your god Chemosh cannot save you, just as Bethel could not help the Israelites.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim a suhuyiɣisili puuni, lum n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu la zuɣu; n Naawuni, malimi shili, a zali saria karibu saha.
en: Lord , get up and show your anger! My enemy is angry, so stand and fight against him. Get me the justice that you demand.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa.
en: They each went to their own homes.

dag: Yɛlim yɛm, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a. Ka boli tɛhi zilima mi N zɔsimo.
en: Treat wisdom like the woman you love and knowledge like the one dearest to you.

dag: Ka nachimba daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli niŋ o n-zaŋ o yi nti sɔɣi.
en: Some young men stood up, wrapped up his body, carried him out, and buried him.

dag: Nia shɛŋa din be ninsal suhu ni ŋmanila kɔbil zilinli puuni kom, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi ŋɔŋ di kom maa.
en: Advice comes from the deep waters of the heart; those with understanding can draw it out.

dag: n yi daa yuli wuntaŋa saha shɛl o ni daa puhi na, bee n-nya goli ni chani ni jilima.
en: I have never worshiped the sun in its brightness or the moon in all its beauty.

dag: Di chɛliya ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba, dama saha kanna ka bɛnkam zaa be gbala ni ni ti wum o kukoli.
en: Dont be surprised by this, because the time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni o ni chɛ ka yi suhuri ba n-zani ka yi be tibi, ka be kasi ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la sani, saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o ninvuɣ gahinda yi ti labina.
en: This will strengthen your desire to do what is right, and you will be holy and without fault before our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy people.

dag: Daadam, dim a bindirigu ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira ka nyu kom ni dabiɛm, ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: Human one, eat your bread in trembling, and drink your water in anxious agitation.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yinim lzraɛlnim bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani, miriya ka yi ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni.
en: That's also why I have forbidden you to eat blood.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yɛri Yisifu lala dabisili kam maa zaa yoli, Yisifu daa bi saɣi ni o min o dɔni.
en: Although she asked Joseph day after day, he would not go to bed with her.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn ka yɛda ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ, daba ala ka m mini ya lee yɛn tooi laɣim be bee daba ala ka n yɛn tooi din ya suɣilo? Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiy o na.
en: Jesus answered them, You faithless generation, how long will I be with you? How long will I put up with you? Bring him to me.

dag: paɣipiɛl so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la sani. Bɛ daa zaŋ Mariama tila Naa Dauda zuliya ni do so ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la.
en: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋ n niriba leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa pun niŋ yɛda kana nti kahigiri bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa wuhiri palɔni.
en: Many of those who had come to believe came, confessing their past practices.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi bi paɣ o nuhi ka shihi ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If he touches you, you must wash your clothes and bathe in water. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Ibrahimma Mamri oki tihi la gbini, o ni daa ʒi o tanti suɣili dunol ni wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha la.
en: The LORD appeared to Abraham at the oaks of Mamre while he sat at the entrance of his tent in the days heat.
