dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o ba, Mani a bituuli Iso. M pun niŋ a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Yiɣisim ʒini di m mɔɣu ni nimdi maa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob said to his father, Im Esau your oldest son. Ive made what you asked me to. Sit up and eat some of the game so you can bless me.

dag: A ni daa tim ma dunia ŋɔ ni na shɛm, lala ka n gba tim ba.
en: I have sent them into the world, just as you sent me into the world.

dag: Amaa benya kaman tihi la m-mali wala yi biɛhigu ni din ni wuhi ni yi shiri niŋ tuuba ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋla ʒiri gabisi vɔri tuumbiɛri, ka vɔri alahichi kaman tɔroko din mali gabisi la.
en: You are doomed! You are unable to break free from your sins.

dag: Di saha ka Zifinim daa chaŋ Sool sani Gibia ti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela ti ya Hɔrɛshi sɔɣisili shee din be Hachila zo shɛli din labiri Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la zuɣu.
en: Some people from the town of Ziph went to Saul at Gibeah and said, Your Majesty, David has a hideout not far from us! It's near Horesh, somewhere on Mount Hachilah south of Jeshimon.

dag: Amaa niriba pam bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti leei nyaannima, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima.
en: But many who now are first will be last, and many who now are last will be first.

dag: Neemi n nina ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n nya alahiziba binshɛŋa din be a zaligu puuni.
en: Open my eyes so that I can see all the wonderful things in your teachings.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o lihi dɔro maa, ka dɔro maa yi be yili maa dukpina zuɣu, ka zaɣ baŋkom garisi di ni bee bin ʒiɛhi gari di ni, ka di kpe dukpini maa puuni.
en: If he examines the infection, and the infection in the walls of the house consists of greenish or reddish depressions, which appear to be deeper than the surface of the wall.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tihi daa laɣim ni bɛ bɔ ŋun yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Olivi tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Once the trees went out to anoint a king over themselves. So they said to the olive tree, Be our king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Itam maa ŋ-ŋmaligi labi Pihahirɔt din be Baalizɛfɔn wulimpuhili polo la nti dɔni miri Migidol.
en: From there they turned back to Pi Hahiroth, east of Baal Zephon, and camped near Migdol.

dag: Chɛ ka o dabisa filim, ka so deeg o zaani zani.
en: Let his days be few; let someone else assume his position.

dag: Bɛ daa bela Arinɔn Mɔɣili duli guhira, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo. Bɛ daa ŋmanila noon shɛb bɛ ni kari bɛ tɛri ni bahi.
en: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.

dag: Hal n ni filim mmaŋa n-gari ŋ-ŋɔ gba, ka lihi ʒiɛm mmaŋa, amaa dabipaɣiba shɛb yɛla a ni yɛli ŋɔ bɛn ni ti ma jilima.
en: and will disgrace myself even more. You may think I am nothing, but those women will think highly of me.

dag: Dahin shɛli, kaman kurig ata saha ka o nini daa ti nya Naawuni malaika ʒii ka o kpɛr o sanna ka bol o, Kɔniilius.
en: It was about three o'clock one afternoon when he had a vision, in which he clearly saw an angel of God come in and say to him, Cornelius.

dag: M puhiri Filolɔgus mini Julia ni Nɛrius min o tizɔpaɣa ni Olimpas ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn zaa be bɛ san la gba.
en: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim daa wum Filistianim ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa.
en: When the people of Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, pa nyini n-daa kari tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka zaŋ li ti a zo Ibrahimma zuliya sahakam la?.
en: You are our God! You forced the people living in this land to leave. You did this in front of your people Israel. You gave this land to the descendants of Abraham forever. Abraham was your friend.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛtali ni nyaɣisi bɛ noya ni, ka bɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi bɛ zilima lɔna ni;.
en: Evil tastes sweet in his mouth. He keeps it under his tongue to enjoy it fully.

dag: Naawuni yi Ziɔn din nyɛ tin suŋ la ni n-kanna ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: God shines from Zion, the city perfect in its beauty.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔb so ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni nti yo alahichi samli luɣ kasi shee, di bi simdi ka so ŋubi di nimdi maa. Di simdi ni yi nyo li la buɣim.
en: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ moli gili nyaandoliba maa ni ni nyaandol ŋɔ ŋun ku kpi; amaa Yisa daa bi yɛli Pita ni nyaandol maa ku kpi. O daa yɛl o mi, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti lan labina, di lee nya a ya.
en: So a story spread among the followers of Jesus. They were saying that this follower would not die. But Jesus did not say he would not die. He only said, Maybe I want him to live until I come. That should not matter to you.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali sania maŋa ni zahimbu maŋa ni tahi maŋa ni kuruwa maŋa: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Your baskets should be the right size. Your jars should hold the right amount of liquids. Your weights and balances should weigh things correctly. I am the Lord your God. I brought you out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim Naawuni jilima daa yi di ni be chɛrubi so zuɣu la n-chaŋ ti tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa boli do so ŋun ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka binshɛli din sabira be o luɣili zuɣu la.
en: Then the dazzling light of the presence of the God of Israel rose up from the winged creatures where it had been, and moved to the entrance of the Temple. The Lord called to the man dressed in linen.

dag: A yi tahi kom maa zuɣu, di guurimi, ka a yi chɛ ka saa tahi, kom maa zɔrimi chana.
en: But at your rebuke they ran away; they fled in fear at the sound of your thunder.

dag: Nyamiya, yi tiŋguliba laɣim yili suhupiɛlli yila! Dama bɛ nini nya Yawɛ ni labisi Ziɔn zali di zaashee shɛm.
en: The city guards are shouting. They are all rejoicing together. They can all see the Lord returning to Zion.

dag: O daa kurigiya zaa, ka mali azichi mini jilima, ka o dabisa daa ti pali, ka o naanyi kpi, ka o bia Sulemaana daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: David was rich and respected and lived to be an old man. Then he died, and his son Solomon became king.

dag: Ka o daa tim o nyaandoliba ayi n-yɛli ba, Chamiya fɔŋ ni; yi yi ti chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o.
en: Jesus said to two of the disciples, Go into the city, where you will meet a man carrying a jar of water. Follow him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi bɔb gbaai Pool, ka kum ni nintam, ka puh o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They cried uncontrollably as everyone embraced and kissed Paul.

dag: ka maligumaana maa zaŋ ba mali sara; yino ni nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Ka maligumaana maa yo din yi o tooni na maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.

dag: Dama n nyɛla bɛ ni su ninvuɣ so, ka m mi su tɔbbi shɛb fukumsi. N ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o cham luɣ shɛli, ka o chaŋ; ka ni tooi yɛli bɛ ni yino ni o kamina, ka o kana; ka ni tooi yɛli n dabili mi ni o niŋmi ŋ-ŋɔ, ka o niŋ li.
en: I have officers who give orders to me, and I have soldiers who take orders from me. I can say to one of them, Go! and he goes. I can say to another, Come! and he comes. I can say to my servant, Do this! and he will do it.

dag: Ka Aruna daa yɛli Dauda, N dana, zaŋmi li tum a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani. Naɣikɔra m-bɔŋɔ, a ni tooi kɔri ba nyo buɣim mali sara, bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi mini kaburi dari din ni mali buɣim mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Take it, Your Majesty, Araunah said, and offer to the Lord whatever you wish. Here are these oxen to burn as an offering on the altar; here are their yokes and the threshing boards to use as fuel.

dag: Kulla Yisa ka ti naɣ nya! Naawuni daa chɛ ka o pooi malaikanim saha biɛla puuni ni ŋun Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu chɛ ka o kpi sokam zaa zuɣu. Ka ti nya ka o mali jiri mini jilima pumpɔŋɔ o ni daa di wahala kpi kum shɛl la zuɣu.
en: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!.

dag: nti kahigi yɛla maa zaa wuhi ba, ka naanyi tim ba Jɔpa maa.
en: Cornelius explained everything to these three men and sent them to Joppa.

dag: A yi yɛn deei nir binshɛli sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o binshɛlikam, nyin di dol o kpe o yiŋ puuni ti deei li.
en: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that the money will be paid back. But you must not go into their house to get it.

dag: Bee bɔndali ka ti daa nya o ka a biɛra bee nti be sarika ni, ka ti ka a sanna ti kaag a.
en: When did we see you sick or in prison and care for you.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka niriba wum o kukoli din galisi la, ka chɛ ka sokam nya o suhuyiɣisili tuma. O ni ti chɛ ka buɣim dira, ka sagbana bɔɣi, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛra, ka sakuɣa luri na.
en: The Lord will let everyone hear his majestic voice and feel the force of his anger. There will be flames, cloudbursts, hailstones, and torrents of rain.

dag: ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa, dilan yi nyɛla ninkurigu bee bia bee doo bee paɣa, bɛn kum o.
en: and to put to death anyone who refused to obey him.

dag: Binshɛli ku niŋ ba n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ ni kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: People will stop hurting each other. People on my holy mountain will not want to destroy things because they will know the Lord . The world will be full of knowledge about him, like the sea is full of water.

dag: ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ salima alali, ka o zaŋ matarika kuri li.
en: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.

dag: Di bahigu ti ŋmanila wɔɣ dimli, ka dimda kaman gariŋga la.
en: The next morning you will feel as if you had been bitten by a poisonous snake.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ti mi li, ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛb gba ti yiɣisina n-zaŋ li wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro zim kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: The priest said to David, I dont have any ordinary bread here, but I do have some of the holy bread. Your officers can eat it if they have not had sexual relations with any women.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim zaa daa wum Filistianim maa ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa zaa.
en: When the people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun bo o kpee paɣa. Ŋunkam shihi paɣa maa ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka dabiɛm mali ba? Bɛ tirila gbini. Bɛ ŋme bɛ tɔbutuhiriba luhi, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui yomyom. Bɛ bi kaɣiri lihiri bɛ nyaaŋa, dabiɛm n-kul be luɣilikam! Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Why do I see them terrified, retreating in haste? Their soldiers are crushed, running for cover, and they dont turn back. Panic lurks at every turn, declares the LORD.

dag: Baasha ni daa wum lala, ka o chɛ Rama mɛbu, ka be Tiriza.
en: When Baasha heard about it, he left Ramah and went back to Tirzah.

dag: A bi tiri di ni wum ninvuɣ shɛb la kom ka bɛ nyura, ka mɔŋdi kum ni mali shɛb bindirigu.
en: You refused water to those who were tired, and refused to feed those who were hungry.

dag: O daa piila tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din viɛla n-leeg o dini; dama nimaani ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali sapashin kpɛma. O daa ka niriba maa zuɣulaannim sanna. O daa zaŋ Yawɛ fukumsi zaligunim min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim pahi la tum tuma.
en: They took the best of the land for themselves; A leader's share was assigned to them. They obeyed the Lord 's commands and laws When the leaders of Israel were gathered together.

dag: Ʒimiya tab ʒiya, ka di chɛ ka Masia zaligu niŋ pali.
en: Help carry one another's burdens, and in this way you will obey the law of Christ.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, Yawɛ so n ni doli ŋɔ ni chɛ ka a min o malaika doli chaŋ, ka ti a nasara ka a kpuɣi paɣa n yaannim ya ni n dɔɣiriba sanna ti ti m bia maa.
en: My master answered, I have always obeyed the Lord , and he will send his angel to help you find my son a wife from among my own relatives.

dag: Zuliya shɛb gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ŋ-ŋmaligi lu di ni; bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bari tɔn shɛli ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The heathen have dug a pit and fallen in; they have been caught in their own trap.

dag: Di daa yi chana, di chanila luɣa anahi maa zaa ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: When they moved in any of the four directions, they moved without swerving.

dag: Samarianim suhuri zɔhirimi Bɛtavɛn naɣibil la zuɣu. Di niriba ni ti kum naɣibil maa zuɣu. Ka di tindaannim la ti kum di zuɣu pam. Bɛ ni ti kum pam di ni kɔŋ jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama yiɣi n ninni. Bɛ ni daa yiɣi maa, ka kalima maa doli ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord 's glory was above them.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku shini n noli, N ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni biɛrim pam n shia ni. N ni fabili ni naŋgbantom n suhu ni.
en: No! I can't be quiet! I am angry and bitter. I have to speak.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zani gil o, ka o yiɣisi n-lan kpe tiŋ maa ni n-daa kaai biɛɣu ka o mini Baanabas yi nimaani chaŋ Dɛɛbi.
en: But when the followers of Jesus gathered around him, he got up and went back into the town. The next day he and Barnabas left and went to the city of Derbe.

dag: Ka n daa lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya chɛchɛbunsi anahi ka di yi daanya zoya ayi sunsuuni na.
en: I had another vision. This time I saw four chariots coming out from between two bronze mountains.

dag: O daa yɛli Asha zuliya mi: Asha bidibisi mali alibarika pam. Chɛ ka bɛ mabihi zaa yuri ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ naba siɣi kpam ni.
en: About the tribe of Asher he said: Asher is blessed more than the other tribes. May he be the favorite of his brothers, And may his land be rich with olive trees.

dag: N ni yiɣisi labi m ba sani nti yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani.
en: I will leave and go to my father. I will say to him: Father, I have sinned against God and have done wrong to you.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi bi baŋ, nam ŋɔ ni bahi lab Dauda daŋ niriba ŋɔ sani.
en: Jeroboam said to himself, If the people keep going to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices at the Lord s Temple, someday they will want to be ruled by their old masters. They will want to be ruled by King Rehoboam of Judah. And then they will kill me.

dag: Yiɣisim kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni ka bɛ ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, yi ni yɛn puhiri chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinim yi sani, ka nyɛ man Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Do so ŋun tib ma maa n-yɛli ma ni n kpuɣimi m bindoo maa chaŋ.
en: But he replied, The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ Yawɛ kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la m-mali sara.
en: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Amaa Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la n-daa nyɛ bɛn naɣi bi kpi.
en: Of the twelve spies only Joshua and Caleb survived.

dag: Nyin ŋun tɛha bi zilimmi ŋɔ, a bɔri ni so n-wuh a ni yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma nyɛla yɛda ŋoli?.
en: Are you so slow? Do you need to be shown that faith without actions has no value at all?.

dag: Zaŋm a nuu chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛ ma, ka di lan chɛ ka a yɛla mali ma dabiɛm.
en: stop punishing and terrifying me!.

dag: Dama di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sab o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Human One goes to his death just as it is written about him. But how terrible it is for that person who betrays the Human One! It would have been better for him if he had never been born.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni, yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Stay awake and pray for strength against temptation. Your spirit wants to do what is right, but your body is weak.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini jintɔriba zaa daa bo niriba ni bɛ di Yisa ʒiri shɛhira ka bɛ tɔɣisi luh o, ka ku o.
en: The chief priests and the whole council wanted to put Jesus to death. So they tried to find some people who would tell lies about him in court.

dag: Bɛ bela bɛ olivi tihi folinsi ni n-kahindi kpam, ka kahindi wain, amaa ka kɔnyuri kuri ba.
en: They press olives for oil, and grapes for wine, but they themselves are thirsty.

dag: dama yi yi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu yi ni kpi, amaa yi yi chɛ ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku yi ninsalitali biɛhigu maa tuma yi ni, yi ni be.
en: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say No to your desires.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This happened in order to make come true what the prophet had said:.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi Kiburɔtihataava maa n-chaŋ Hazɛrɔt.
en: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.

dag: ni Ain ni Juta ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi ni di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti ba. Fɔntiŋ kara awɛi ka bɛ daa yihi Juda mini Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Ain, Juttah, and Beth Shemesh. They also gave them some of the land near these towns for their animals. These two tribes gave them nine towns.

dag: Sulemaana daa di nam m-be Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa la yuun pihinahi.
en: He was king in Jerusalem over all Israel for forty years.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, O tum zina hal ti gbarigi, amaa ka dɔbba na kul bɔr o.
en: and I noticed that the men were eager to have sex with these women, though they were exhausted from being prostitutes.

dag: A yi lo ni a niŋ shɛli, di ni niŋ; ka neesim lan neei a soya zuɣu.
en: If you decide to do something, it will be successful. And your future will be very bright!.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka anabinim zaa yɛli ni o Masia ni ti di wahala pam la n-niŋ pali maa.
en: God announced long ago through all the prophets that his Messiah had to suffer; and he made it come true in this way.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa zo n-kuli Bɛr nti be nimaani, dama o daa zɔrila o biɛli Abimilɛk.
en: After Jotham had said this, he ran away and escaped to the city named Beer. He stayed there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelech.

dag: Yɛnnim wuhibu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbiliga, di ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: The teaching of the wise is a source of life; their words will save you from deadly traps.

dag: N ni daa nya ka a bihi la ni shɛb doli yɛlimaŋli kaman ti Ba Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm la, di daa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: I was very happy to learn about some of your children. I am happy that they are following the way of truth, just as the Father commanded us.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayɔbu ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka Yisa daa chaŋla Bɛtani din nyɛ o ni daa neei Lazarɔs so la ni daa be tin shɛl la.
en: Six days before Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, home of Lazarus, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tɛhimiya, ka boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi fabila ka bɛ kana; ka tim boli paɣ shɛb bɛn mi kuyila ka bɛ kana.
en: The Lord Almighty said, Think about what is happening! Call for the mourners to come, for the women who sing funeral songs.

dag: Ka a yi ni doli ma ni yɛlimaŋli ni ʒiɛyimtali a suhu ni kaman a ba Dauda ni daa doli ma shɛm la, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini n zalikpana la ni n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zaa.
en: You must obey me, as your father David did, and be honest and fair. Obey my laws and teachings.

dag: ka zaŋ chaŋ o Naawunitali mi polo, yiko shɛli din daa chɛ ka o neei kum ni la kahigi wuhi ni o nyɛla Naawuni Bia. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia so.
en: He was publicly identified as Gods Son with power through his resurrection from the dead, which was based on the Spirit of holiness. This Son is Jesus Christ our Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim, mali alibarika.
en: Happy are those whose sins are forgiven, whose wrongs are pardoned.

dag: Amaa ka shɛb daa ti chaŋ daba ayopɔin maa dali ni bɛ ti pihi li ka bi nya shɛli.
en: On the seventh day some of the people went out to gather food, but they did not find any.

dag: Baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ: ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni nandahima ni ti beni sahasaha.
en: Understand that the last days will be dangerous times.

dag: N suhir o ni o neei yi tɛha ka yi nya o neesim, ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ o ni boli ya tahima shɛli zuɣu min o ni lo o niriba alahiziba alibarika shɛŋa alikaulinim la.
en: I pray that the eyes of your heart will have enough light to see what is the hope of Gods call, what is the richness of Gods glorious inheritance among believers.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ ma tila ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋ ma niŋ putɔɣunim nuu ni.
en: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob.

dag: Samiya Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa gol tuuli dahin yini dali.
en: Set up my tent on the first day of the year.

dag: Yi daa yɛliya, Tim ti naa mini kpambaliba. Yi naa maa lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ n-ni tooi tiligi ya? Yi kpambaliba maa lee be ya n-ni tooi zabi yi zuɣu?.
en: You asked for a king and for leaders, but how can they save the nation?.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Zaŋmi binchɛra maa niŋ gabisi maa min a bɔɣulɔna puuni. Ka Jɛrimia daa niŋ lala.
en: Then he said, Put these rags under your arms so the ropes won't hurt you. After I did.

dag: Lɛvinim tiŋgbani ni ti do m-baɣi maligumaaniba tiŋgbani maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu. Di wɔɣilim zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: The Levites also are to have a special area, south of that of the priests. It too is to be miles from east to west, by miles from north to south.

dag: Ka o daa yihi ti nimaani na nti zaŋ o ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim la ti ti.
en: He brought us out of Egypt so that he could give us the land that he promised our ancestors.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa na maa daa nyɛla din ni tooi zaŋ tum tuma maa zaa ka guui.
en: What had already been brought was more than enough to finish all the work.

dag: Bɛ diri birapu ka kuri niriba a ni. Yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka niŋdi ba nyɔri, ka pahiri yi nɛma daa n-fari yi taba nyari buni ka tam n yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Some of your people murder for pay. Some charge interest on the loans they make to other Israelites and get rich by taking advantage of them. They have forgotten me. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: N yuya ni Naawuni noli di ma ka m mini Masia woligi tab gba mmaŋmaŋ zuliya bɛn nyɛ m mabihi la zuɣu.
en: for my people, my own flesh and blood! For their sake I could wish that I myself were under God's curse and separated from Christ.

dag: Amaa bia maa ŋun daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛm, kulla Jɔnatan mini Dauda n-daa mi di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The boy had no idea what had happened; only Jonathan and David knew.

dag: ni Nɛbo ni Baalimiɔn ni Sibima; ka bɛ daa ti bɛ ni me tin shɛŋa maa yu pala.
en: Nebo, Baal Meon, and Sibmah. They used the names of the cities that they rebuilt. But they changed the names of Nebo and Baal Meon.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa kuhi pam yɛl o, Di niŋ amaŋ shɛli, dama ti zaa be kpe.
en: But Paul shouted at the top of his voice, Don't harm yourself! We are all here.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani nyɛla Kɔɔban .
en: But you teach that if people have something they could use to help their father or mother, but say, This is Corban .

dag: Lɛvinim maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: These were Levis sons by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Amaa o daa bi zaŋdi dari maa sɔŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la bɛn sani, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Leeban biŋkɔbiri nyɛ zaɣ gbarima, ka Yaakubu dina nyɛ bɛn mali yaa.
en: But when the weaker animals mated, Jacob did not put the branches there. So the young animals born from the weak animals were Labans. And the young animals born from the stronger animals were Jacobs.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Naawuni daa pola pɔri zal li.
en: Also, it is important that God made a promise with an oath when he made Jesus high priest. When those other men became priests, there was no oath.

dag: Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n sɔŋda. Ŋuna n Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi n nyɛvili.
en: Look, my God will help me. My Lord will support me.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn timmi boli kulipalinim pam na ka bɛ ti gbahi ba. Di nyaaŋa ka n lan tim boli tɔhinim pam na, ka bɛ ti bo bɛ shee zoli kam mini daboli kam zuɣu, ka yihi ba tampima voya ni na.
en: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun zani dabari ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ situr ʒiɛkpain niŋ amaŋa? Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ salima nɛma niŋ amaŋa, ka bali chilo? A kul dihirila amaŋ nachiinsi yoli, dama a mamanim lihi ʒiɛm a, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku a.
en: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!.

dag: Malimiya yi binyɛra zaa mini yi binshɛŋa din nyɛ biŋkɔbiri gbana ni buhi kɔbiri binyara zaa ni dari binyara zaa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: You must wash all of your clothes. You must wash anything made with leather, wool, or wood. You must purify yourselves.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni; o saria karibu be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.

dag: N duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni, n duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni ni o deei n suhigu.
en: I cry aloud to God; I cry aloud, and he hears me.

dag: O chɛ ka wuntaŋ su wuntaŋ ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: the sun to rule over the day; his love is eternal;.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu, dama ti galisiya.
en: So Jesus asked him, What is your name? The man answered, My name is Mob—there are so many of us.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ ti paai Bɛso kulibɔŋ ni, ka bɛn daa be nyaaŋa la kpalim nimaani.
en: So David and his six hundred men started out, and when they arrived at Besor Brook, some of them stayed there.

dag: ka Jɔhanan nyɛ Azaria ba. Azaria maa n-daa nyɛ maligumaana m-be Sulemaana ni daa me Naawuni jɛmbu du shɛli din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la puuni.
en: and Johanan of Azariah. He was the one who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi daa vili ma gbibi, ka kum zana daa do n tooni.
en: The cords of the grave surrounded me; deaths traps held me tight.

dag: O ni daa ti neei kum ni la nyaaŋa ka o nyaandoliba teei ni o daa pun yɛli yɛlli ŋɔ zali; ka daa niŋ Naawuni Kundi mini Yisa ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa yɛda.
en: And when he was raised from death, his disciples remembered what he had told them. Then they believed the Scriptures and the words of Jesus.

dag: Alizanda ni nima, yilimiya yila! Dunianima, maliya suhupiɛlli! Zoya, yilimiya yila! Dama Yawɛ ni kpaŋs o niriba suhuri. O ni zo o niriba bɛn be muɣisigu ni nambɔɣu.
en: Sing, heavens! Shout for joy, earth! Let the mountains burst into song! The Lord will comfort his people; he will have pity on his suffering people.

dag: Ka Dauda nachimba maa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Dauda yuli yɛli Nabal yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka kpalim ʒiɛya guhira.
en: David's men delivered this message to Nabal in David's name. Then they waited there.

dag: n-daa mali ti paai di ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Salamis n-kpɛri nimaani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni n-yihiri Naawuni yɛligu waazu tiri ba. Ka Jɔn Maak daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: They arrived at Salamis and began to preach God's message in the synagogues. They also had John as a helper.

dag: Ti mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala din galisi shɛm, lala ka ti lan laɣindi nyari suhumaabo din galisi Masia zuɣu.
en: Just as we have a share in Christ's many sufferings, so also through Christ we share in God's great help.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la, alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa saɣim la, hal n ni daa kul gbib ba kaman yili yidana maa zaa yoli. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: It wont be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt. They broke that covenant with me even though I was their husband, declares the LORD.

dag: Sɔdom nanima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! Gomɔranima, wummiya Naawuni ni wuhiri ya shɛli.
en: You officers of Sodom, listen to the Lord s message. You people of Gomorrah, listen to Gods teaching.

dag: O ni yo n dimnim bɛ tuumbiɛri samli. O ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu, o ni kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: He will bring disaster on my opponents. By your faithfulness, God, destroy them!.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛri ya, Pumpɔŋɔ, yi zaa zomiya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu ni din ni chɛ ka yi kul kpalim be Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim kurimbuni ha la ni sahakam.
en: Those prophets said, Change your lives and stop doing evil! If you change, you can return to the land that the Lord gave you and your ancestors long ago. He gave you this land to live in forever.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni ti zaŋ ba zali luɣ shɛli din sarigiri shee n-chɛ ka bɛ sarigi lu m-bahi yoli.
en: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.

dag: Dabili yi di nam ni jɛrigu yi di nti yaɣi.
en: a slave who becomes a king, a fool who has all he wants to eat.

dag: Yinim bɛn tiligi tɔbu ni ŋɔ, chamiya, di lan guhiriya. Teemiya Yawɛ yɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ maa ni, ka chɛliya ka Jɛrusalɛm yɛla be yi suhuri ni.
en: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa na ti ti Musa, ka daa lan zaŋ suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: They brought to Moses the Tent and all its equipment, its hooks, its frames, its crossbars, its posts, and its bases;.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Yiya mɛbu saha na bi miri. Tiŋ ŋɔ nyɛla duɣu, ka ti mi nyɛ nimdi.
en: They are the ones who say, The nearest relatives arent building houses. The city is the cooking pot, and we are the meat.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ʒini Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-nyɛ sana n-yuui pam.
en: Abraham lived as an immigrant in the Philistines land for a long time.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrila bɛ suhuri ni, Ti kul ku vuui; ʒiɛmani kam puuni muɣisigu shɛli ku paai ti.
en: In their hearts they say, Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nuu din mali yiko ŋɔ chɛri ka barinim kpaŋda, ka chɛ ka shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa tumdi a Dab Suŋ Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: Reach out your hand to heal, and grant that wonders and miracles may be performed through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.

dag: Ka viri mini kahiŋkɔri zaŋ li leei bɛ biɛhigu shee. Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka di lan leei tiŋgban kpiŋ yaha, kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Screech owls and crows will possess it; owls and ravens will live there. God will stretch over it the measuring line of chaos and the plummet stone of emptiness over its officials.

dag: ni Shɛfatia daŋ niriba ni Hatil daŋ niriba ni Pokɛrɛt Hazɛbaim daŋ niriba ni Amɔn daŋ niriba.
en: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth-hazzebaim, and Amon.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tummi sara maligu shee mini sara maligu bimbini maa gbini tuma, ka di chɛ ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: You are responsible for caring for the holy place and the altar. I dont want to become angry with the Israelites again.

dag: nti nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, ka nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni lee nyɛla bɛn mali kpiɔŋ bee bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima ka nya bɛ nyɛla bɛn galisi bee bɛn pɔra.
en: Find out what kind of country it is, how many people live there, and how strong they are.

dag: Di saha zoomba nina ni ti neei, ka tikpiranim wum.
en: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened so that they can see, and the ears of the deaf will be opened so that they can hear.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli, ka di niŋ ma nyaɣisim a yurilim maŋli zuɣu. Dama a nya n ni diri wahala shɛli; ka mi n ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni.
en: I rejoice and celebrate in your faithful love because you saw my suffering— you were intimately acquainted with my deep distress.

dag: Wuhimi yɛnnima, ka bɛ nyari yɛm pahira. Wuhimi wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nyari anfaani bɔhimbu puuni.
en: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Damaskusnim polo. Hamatinim mini Aripadnim birimmi, dama bɛ wumla lahiba biɛɣu. Dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ ʒiya kaman teeku kom din ku tooi fo n-doya la.
en: Concerning Damascus: Hamath and Arpad lose heart when they hear the bad news. They are trembling with fear, like the raging sea, which cant become quiet.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti yi Ramɛsis maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Sukɔt.
en: The Israelites marched from Rameses and they camped at Succoth.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, a nini yi shiri tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma a soya din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a, ka a nini maan tiɣi ma pahi. Lan teema ni niriba maa nyɛla a niriba.
en: Now if you are, tell me your plans, so that I may serve you and continue to please you. Remember also that you have chosen this nation to be your own.

dag: Kokpɛɣu, yom vuri kaman nuhi kpahibu vuri la. Kunkuna, laɣimmiya yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ tooni.
en: Rivers, clap your hands! All together now, mountains sing out!.

dag: Shimɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amnɔn mini Rina ni Bɛnhanan ni Tilɔn. Ishi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɔhɛt mini Bɛnzɔhɛt.
en: Shimons sons were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. Ishis sons were Zoheth and Ben Zoheth.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-nyo buɣim mali chi sara din nyom viɛl ti Yawɛ. Ka binnyurigu sara din yɛn pahi di zuɣu n-nyɛ wain lita yini.
en: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.

dag: Salima kpahi tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram giram kɔbisinu ni pisopɔin ni biɛla. Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa di zuɣusaa duri la dukpina zaa zuɣu.
en: Five hundred and seventy grams of gold was used to cover the heads of the nails. The walls of the small storage rooms were also covered with gold.

dag: N ni yɛli ya shɛli zibisim ni, yɛlimiya li neesim ni; ka yi ni wum shɛli ashilɔni, yin molimiya li gili luɣilikam.
en: What I am telling you in the dark you must repeat in broad daylight, and what you have heard in private you must announce from the housetops.

dag: Ka Yaakubu suhu daa yu Reechɛl ka o yɛli, N ni tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti a, Reechɛl ŋun nyɛ a bipuɣiŋga biasani ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jacob was in love with Rachel, so he said, I will work seven years for you, if you will let me marry Rachel.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla bɛn lihiri Naa Dauda daazichi.
en: These were the men in charge of David's royal property.

dag: Nɛbo daŋ ni: Jɛiɛl mini Matitia ni Zabad so yaha ni Zɛbina ni Jadai ni Joɛl ni Bɛnaaya.
en: From the descendants of Nebo, these men: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah.

dag: Ka Keen min o paɣ daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Inok. Ka Keen daa me o tiŋa n-zaŋ o bia Inok maa yuli m-bol li Inok.
en: Cain had sexual relations with his wife. She became pregnant and gave birth to a son named Enoch. Cain built a city and gave the city the same name as his son Enoch.

dag: Amaa sara maligunim ŋɔ daa kul teerila niriba maa bɛ daalahichi yɛla yuuni kam;.
en: But the blood of bulls and goats cannot take away sins. It only reminds people of their sins from one year to the next.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, bomiya yɛm. Yinim bɛn ka fahim ŋɔ, bomiya li.
en: Are you immature? Learn to be mature. Are you foolish? Learn to have sense.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛbil yino mali sara asiba, ka ti zaŋ piɛbil ŋun la mi mali zaawuni.
en: Sacrifice one of the lambs in the morning and the other in the evening.

dag: Tulaale mɔri chɛ ka di nyom chani ginda, ka tiwal viɛla zaa ʒe m-baɣi ti dunoya. N yura, di zaɣ kura mini zaɣ pala ka n zaŋ zal a.
en: Smell the mandrakes and all the pleasant flowers by our door. I have saved many pleasant things for you, my lover, pleasant things, new and old.

dag: Bɛ wurim n suɣili, ka chihi di mihi zaa. M bihi chaŋya ka chɛ ma; bɛ lan kani, ka so kani ŋun ni lan ti n suɣili maa yaha, ka zaŋ m pateesanim yili di ni.
en: Our tents are ruined; the ropes that held them have broken. Our children have all gone away; there is no one left to put up our tents again; there is no one to hang their curtains.

dag: M mali niɣi mini bunsi ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka tim na ni n ti yɛli nyini n dana din ni chɛ ka a suhu maai ni mani. .
en: I have many cattle, donkeys, flocks, and servants. Sir, I am sending you this message to ask you to accept us.

dag: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma maa ni zaŋdi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi chani Sharɔn bɔpiɛligu ni mini Akɔr Vinvamli ni ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.

dag: Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili! Naawuni chɛ ka bɛ ʒi salima yi Shiiba na ti ti o. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni tir o sahakam. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni daalibarika niŋd o ni dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A zuɣu n-lɛbigi! Amaa ka o nini kul mooi ka o yɛri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ka bɛ yɛl o, O malaika m-bala.
en: You are crazy! they told her. But she insisted that it was true. So they answered, It is his angel.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma.
en: In the morning, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: amaa pirimiya namda, ka di yɛn ya daliyanima ayiyi.
en: Wear sandals, but don't carry an extra shirt.

dag: Dina ka n dan mali nyuri kom, ka lan mal li nyar ashilɔni yɛla. Yi ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi tum taali. .
en: Not only does he drink from his cup, but he also uses it to learn about the future. You have done a terrible thing. .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi nabi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi galisim ŋmanila saŋmarisi zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: And now, there are even more of you. The Lord your God has added more and more people, so that today you are as many as the stars in the sky.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi ni niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu, Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa waawaayili ka yi zaɣisi wumbu, ka n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku saɣi.
en: You have committed all these sins, and even though I spoke to you over and over again, you refused to listen. You would not answer when I called you.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋa n-lu tiŋ sa, dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli, ka bɛ gbib a. Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: The devil said, If you are God's Son, jump off. The Scriptures say: God will give his angels orders about you. They will catch you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones. .

dag: Dindali maa, n ni boli Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun nyɛ n dabili la na.
en: The Lord said to Shebna, When that happens, I will send for my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi Naa Zɛdɛkia bidibisi n-ku ba o ninni, ka kpaɣ o mi nina; ka ba o bandi n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: They killed Zedekiahs sons in front of him. Then they put out Zedekiahs eyes. They put chains on him and took him to Babylon.

dag: O ni daa yiɣisi zani maa, ka o duh o yee suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa ni yɛli.
en: Then, in a loud voice, he asked God to bless all the people of Israel. Solomon said.

dag: ka di nyɛ niriba bɛn gili ya wuna, bɛn be yoma bee katiŋ ni yinima, ka nyɛ bɛn be dunia yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la;.
en: They are the gods of the people who live in the other lands around you, some near and some far away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa puuni binshɛŋa din daa kpalim ka tɔbbihi maa zaŋ li kalinli daa nyɛla piɛri tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu ni tuhi pisopɔinnaanu.
en: The valuable property remaining from the spoils of war that the people of the army had taken was , sheep.

dag: Ka o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zaa daa kana ni bɛ ti maag o suhu, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, N ni kum m bia maa zuɣu hal ti paag o kpiimba biɛhigu shee. Lala ka o ba daa kum o zuɣu.
en: All of Jacobs sons and daughters tried to comfort him, but Jacob was never comforted. He said, I will be sad about my son until the day I die. So Jacob continued to mourn his son Joseph.

dag: Ti Duuma, a ni nam zuliya shɛb la zaa ni kana ti gbani a tooni tibig a yuli.
en: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.

dag: Bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili. Di bi simdi ni yi ti ba binshɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili.
en: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi la ni Izraɛlnim zaa, Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi zaŋ o sara na, ka di nyɛla pɔri sanyoo sara bee omaŋmaŋ suhu yubu sara ni o ti nyo buɣim ti Naawuni.
en: Tell Aaron, his sons, and all the Israelites: Whenever someone from Israels house or from the immigrants in Israel presents their offering to the LORD as an entirely burned offering—whether it is payment for a solemn promise or a spontaneous gift.

dag: amaa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ gar o yi ti lir o n-nyaŋ o, o farila o bidibbin shɛŋa o ni niŋ yɛda maa, ka fa o nɛma maa.
en: But when a stronger man attacks him and defeats him, he carries away all the weapons the owner was depending on and divides up what he stole.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti laɣim Galili na ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia n-niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, The Son of Man will be handed over to people.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu ŋun be bia maa ni zuɣu, ka o zo ka chɛ o, ka bia maa dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.

dag: ka taɣ o niɣi min o biŋkɔbbaligu shɛb zaa bɛn daa nyɛ o nyɔri m-pah o ni daa zali naɣ shɛb Mɛsopoteemia la zuɣu n-lu soli kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni o ba Yisahaku sani.
en: and set out with all of his livestock and all of his possessions that he had acquired in Paddan-aram in order to return to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.

dag: O ni daa yuri yi yaannim la zuɣu ka o daa pii bɛ bihi bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka daa be yi sani n-yihi ya Ijipti na. O daa zaŋ o yiko.
en: Because he loved your ancestors, he chose you, and by his great power he himself brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim maa daa lan zaŋ bɛ pina ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna bɛ ni daa zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu saha shɛl la.
en: On the day the altar was dedicated, the twelve leaders brought offerings for its dedication.

dag: Tiŋgban nɛli ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, ka tiŋgban kuŋ gba ti mali suhupiɛlli ka bimpuma ti yirigi di ni m-be kaman taaŋkɔro la.
en: The desert and the dry land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom like the crocus.

dag: Ka yi yi mali karimbanim paai tuhi pia Masia dolibu ni, amaa ba yino ka yi lee mali; dama n leei yi ba Yisa Masia dolibu ni la n lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu zuɣu.
en: You may have ten thousand mentors in Christ, but you dont have many fathers. I gave birth to you in Christ Jesus through the gospel.

dag: Vinnyaɣinim ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma ni nimmoo ni nya buni din viɛla.
en: Lazy people dont get what they want, but riches come to those who work hard.

dag: O daa zali maligumaaniba ka ti ba bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni, ka kpaŋsi ba bɛ tuma maa ni.
en: He assigned to the priests the duties they were to perform in the Temple and encouraged them to do them well.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zali ka bɛ laɣim tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o daa pii kuɣikpɛriba ni bɛ kpe kuɣa ka bɛ zaŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: David ordered the foreigners living in Israel to come to Jerusalem. Then he assigned some to cut blocks of stone for building the temple.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi lihi paɣ maa ka bɔhi Saimɔn, A nya paɣ ŋɔ? N ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na, a bi ti ma kom ni m paɣi n naba; amaa paɣ ŋɔ zaŋ o nintam paɣi n naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhi li.
en: He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, Have you noticed this woman? When I came into your home, you didn't give me any water so I could wash my feet. But she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.

dag: Ka o yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash, Malim shili n-vooi tɔb maa to; ka o vooi li. Ka Ilaisha zaŋ o nuhi pa naa maa nuhi zuɣu;.
en: and Elisha told him to get ready to shoot. The king did so, and Elisha placed his hands on the king's hands.

dag: Ka dilan maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti zuɣulana ni ti sariakarita? A lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la? Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Musa, ka o tɛhi ni o ni sa niŋ shɛli maa yi palo.
en: He replied, Who made you a boss or judge over us? Are you planning to kill me like you killed the Egyptian? Then Moses was afraid when he realized: They obviously know what I did.

dag: Amaa o ni ti dolila wuntia soli n-kari nandaamba saria; ka kari saria din tuhi ti dunia ŋɔ bɛn ka. O ni ti zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-fiɛbi dunianima; ka lan zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: he will judge the poor fairly and defend the rights of the helpless. At his command the people will be punished, and evil persons will die.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli ba, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Then Jesus looked at his followers and said to them, It will be very hard for a rich person to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla ŋun paai goli zaŋ hal ni yuma anu, di yi nyɛla doo, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini diba anu, ka di yi nyɛla paɣa, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini diba ata.
en: The price for a boy from one month to five years old is shekels. For a girl, the price is shekels.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi duu maa zaa ka chɛ ka di mɛri zoori hal ti leeri jɛmbu du kasi ti Duuma ni.
en: He is the one who holds the whole building together and makes it grow into a sacred temple dedicated to the Lord.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Mikal, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma lala n-chɛ ka n dim maa zo n-tiligi? Ka Mikal garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ; a yi bi chɛ ka n chaŋ n ni ku a. .
en: Saul said to Michal, Why could you betray me like this, letting my enemy go so that now he has escaped? Michal said to Saul, David told me, Help me get away or Ill kill you.

dag: Ham bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Kush mini Ijipti ni Put ni Keenan.
en: Hams family: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.

dag: Bee a lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la.
en: Will you kill me just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday.

dag: Amaa chamiya ti yɛl o nyaandoliba mini Pita ni Yisa daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: Now go and give this message to his disciples, including Peter: He is going to Galilee ahead of you; there you will see him, just as he told you.

dag: Di saha ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa chaŋ Shɛkɛm, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim ni bɛ leeg o nam.
en: Rehoboam went to Shechem where all Israel had come to make him king.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya, ka a kari dol ti n-kuri ti ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: You pursued us and killed us; your mercy was hidden by your anger.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Kpa ŋmaŋ kɔbiga. Ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa yɛl o, Zaŋm a gbaŋ yomyom ʒini n-taɣi sab pihinu.
en: He said, Nine hundred gallons of olive oil.The manager said to him, Take your contract, sit down quickly, and write four hundred fifty gallons.

dag: Chɛ ka so m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin yaag a noli paɣ amaŋa; chɛ ka sana m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin paɣ amaŋa.
en: Never praise yourself. Let others do it.

dag: Di saha piɛri ni ti ŋubiri mɔri nimaani kaman bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka piɛbihi mini bubihi ti ŋubiri mɔri dabari maa ni.
en: In the ruins of the cities lambs will eat grass and young goats will find pasture.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun mi daa deei pɔŋ tuhili la ŋun daa yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, m pun mi a halli ni nyɛ shɛm, dama a dirila a ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri a ni bi di atam shɛli wahala;.
en: The servant who had been given , coins then came in and said, Sir, I know that you are hard to work for. You harvest what you don't plant and gather crops where you haven't scattered seed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim ayi la noya gɔhi bintaɣindisi la. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la tooni.
en: Then they fastened the two ends of the two cords to the two gold settings and attached them to the front of the vests shoulder pieces.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ kpi. Zaŋm ba zaɣ nɛma nti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee; dama zaɣ biɛɣu m-be bɛ yinsi puuni mini bɛ suhuri ni.
en: May my enemies die before their time; may they go down alive into the world of the dead! Evil is in their homes and in their hearts.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋun su kom fukumsi yɛli, Yaa ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ka be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, a saria karibu ŋɔ nyɛla din tuhi!.
en: Then I heard the angel of the waters say to God, You are the one who is and who always was. You are the Holy One. You are right in these judgments you have made.

dag: Ka Musa daa bɔhi Yawɛ, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ niriba ŋɔ zaa ʒi tibisili ʒili ma ka bi sɔŋ ma?.
en: Moses said to the LORD, Why have you treated your servant so badly? And why havent I found favor in your eyes, for you have placed the burden of all these people on me?.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: No one sews a piece of new, unshrunk cloth on old clothes; otherwise, the patch tears away from it, the new from the old, and makes a worse tear.

dag: Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu piligu saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ma.
en: Soon after Jehoiakim son of Josiah became king of Judah.

dag: Dama o daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ o sɔŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Though it was I who put his terror in the land of the living, he will be laid out among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, Pharaoh and all his horde. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Neem a nina, ka luɣ a tiba wum a dabili suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ tir a daba Izraɛlnima ka kahigiri Izraɛlnim daalahichi shɛŋa ti ni tum a sani wuhiri ŋɔ. M mini n yaannim tum alahichi.
en: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned.

dag: Yi mal alibarika saha shɛli niriba yi ti jɛn ya, ka gaŋdi ya, ka turi ya, ka saɣindi yi yuya yɛri ni ninvuɣ biɛri n-nyɛn ya Daadam Bia zuɣu.
en: Happy are you when people hate you, reject you, insult you, and say that you are evil, all because of the Son of Man!.

dag: Amaa lee tɔɣisimiyala taba yɛlimaŋli yurilim puuni, ka zooi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la ni binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: Instead, by speaking the truth in a spirit of love, we must grow up in every way to Christ, who is the head.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tum din tuhi. Bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni ʒe neen shɛŋa mini bɛ ni fa neen shɛŋa m-pali bɛ nayiya.
en: They dont know how to do right, says the LORD— those who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

dag: Yawɛ, a wum bɛ ni maani ma ansarisi shɛm zaa mini bɛ ni lɔri ma nia biɛri shɛm.
en: Yes, you know their insults and their evil plans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya niriba la.
en: Other clans from the levitical descendants of Kohath still remained from among the descendants of Kohath. Some of their allotted cities were from the tribe of Ephraim.

dag: O ni kpaai tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma maa, o niŋ li mi gu n sɔɣibu.
en: By pouring this perfume over my body shes prepared me to be buried.

dag: Ka luɣ shɛli n ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ pala n niriba la, nimaani ka niriba ni boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bihi.
en: And in the very place where they were told, You are not my people, there they will be called the children of the living God.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka jahi m-be o puli ni.
en: Tamar later gave birth to twins. But before either of them was born, one of them stuck a hand out of her womb. The woman who was helping tied a red thread around the baby's hand and explained, This one came out first.

dag: Hal jɛra bɛn fo n-ʒiya, bɛ ni boli ba yɛnnima, bɛ yi bi yaai bɛ noya bɛ ni kali ba pahi yɛnnima ni.
en: Fools who keep quiet are deemed wise; those who shut their lips are smart.

dag: Ka Siria naa ŋun liri ba n-teei gili ba maa ni niŋ ba o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka bɛ ku tooi niŋ shɛli. O ni ti chaŋ ti zani Alikauli Tiŋgbɔŋ la ni n-deei li omaŋmaŋ yiko ni n-su zaa.
en: The northern king will do whatever he wants. No one will be able to stop him. He will gain power and control in the Beautiful Land, and he will have the power to destroy it.

dag: Amaa di wuhiri yi gba yɛla: Di simdi ni yidan kam yur o paɣa kaman omaŋmaŋ la; ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣ kam gba lur o yidan sizuura.
en: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.

dag: Naawuni, zuliya shɛb kana ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ta a jɛmbu du kasi la daɣiri, ka ŋme n-wurim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The nations have come into your inheritance, God! Theyve defiled your holy temple. Theyve made Jerusalem a bunch of ruins.

dag: yɛli, Nyam doo ŋɔ ni pil o duu ŋɔ mɛbu ka tarigi li me n-naai.
en: They will say, You started building, but could not finish the job.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi puuni, Naawuni daa yɛli Firawuna, N ni zal a daliri shɛli zuɣu nyɛla ni n wuhi n yiko tuma a ni, ka di chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia zaa.
en: For the scripture says to the king of Egypt, I made you king in order to use you to show my power and to spread my fame over the whole world.

dag: Dama bɛ nyurila bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka tɛhiri ni Naawuni ku tooi nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, ka kari ba saria di zuɣu.
en: Because they think so highly of themselves, they think that God will not discover their sin and condemn it.

dag: Tummiya yi dabitali tuma ni suhupiɛlli ka di be kaman yi tumdi li tirila ti Duuma la, ka pa ni ninsalinima;.
en: Do your work as slaves cheerfully, as though you served the Lord, and not merely human beings.

dag: Yi ni kpi n-do mɔɣu ŋɔ ni; ka yinim bɛn yuma nyɛ yuun pisi zaŋ chani zaa, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya, ka yi nyɛ bɛn ŋum yi kparima ni niŋ ma la.
en: You will die in this desert. Every person who is years old or older and was counted as one of my people will die. You complained against me.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa pirig o binyɛrigu m-pɔripɔri li zaŋ fiɛb kom maa, ka kom maa daa pirigi buyi n-daai ti dɔni di yaɣ ayi maa zaa hal ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du duli.
en: When they got there, Elijah took off his coat, then he rolled it up and struck the water with it. At once a path opened up through the river, and the two of them walked across on dry ground.

dag: Huram daa lan zaŋ daanya mali binzahi pia, ka di zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: He also made ten bronze stands. Each was six feet long, six feet wide, and four and a half feet high.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara n-yo o min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli.
en: He shall offer a bull as a sacrifice to take away his own sins and those of his family.

dag: Di saha ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Faashee ka yi ti ʒi yi tizo maa mali na, di yi pa lala, yin di ti chɛ ka n nini nyan ya.
en: But you said to us, You must bring your youngest brother, or I will not sell you grain again.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gindi napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ka maligumaaniba piɛbiri kikahi saha shɛli, ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa, Tahimiya! Dama Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o yiɣisi Galili n-chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha;.
en: When Jesus finished saying these things, he left Galilee and came to the area of Judea on the east side of the Jordan.

dag: Yawɛ ni yu shɛlikam, dina ka o niŋda zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni, ni teekunim ni mini kɔbula zaa ni.
en: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.

dag: N wuh a yɛm, ka wuh a so shɛŋa din tuhi.
en: I have taught you wisdom and the right way to live.

dag: A mini bɛn laɣim tum tuma a bilim ni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni yɛn tooi niŋ shɛli ti a zaa m-bala. Bɛ zaa ni chɛ a ka zaŋ kpa bɛ ni chani shɛli polo, ka bɛ so ku tooi tilig a.
en: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.

dag: Jɔn daa bi sɔɣ ba shɛli, o mi daa bi chihi. O daa yɛli ba, M pala Masia.
en: John did not refuse to answer, but spoke out openly and clearly, saying: I am not the Messiah.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be sarika ni maa nya yolisim. Bɛ ku kpi, bindirigu mi ku pooi ba.
en: Those who are prisoners will soon be set free; they will live a long life and have all the food they need.

dag: N yi ti zaŋ bindiripooli din nyɛ m peenzala la to a, piɛma din kuri niriba ka n yɛn zaŋ to a ku a, ka chɛ ka bindiripooli kul luri a zuɣu mɔŋ a bindirigu.
en: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli Ibram ŋun daa nyɛ Hiburu nira ka be Mamri ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔri nir la oki tihi gbini. Mamri min o mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛshikol mini Anɛr la daa nyɛla Ibram zɔnima.
en: But a man escaped and reported all this to Abram, the Hebrew, who was living near the sacred trees belonging to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his brothers Eshcol and Aner were Abram's allies.

dag: Ka Nail Mɔɣili maa puuni zahim zaa daa kpi n-niŋ kom maa ni, ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim daa kɔŋ Nail Mɔɣili maa ni kom maa nyubu; ka ʒim daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: the fish died, and the water smelled so bad that none of the Egyptians could drink it. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.

dag: N ti yɛn baŋ, ka doo bɔbu kɔre zaŋ ma ti ʒili baɣili n nabia o chɛchɛbuŋ ni.
en: I was so excited when she put me in the royal chariot.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu sa ti yɛn neei ka n yi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, hal do yino gba, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma n ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm maa, hal ŋun niŋm ma gari lala gba.
en: I swear that by morning, there won't be a man or boy left from his family or his servants' families. I pray that God will punish me if I don't do it.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu kpaŋsimiya tab suhuri, ka niŋdi din ni sɔŋ yi taba ka bɛ zooi Naawuni dolibu ni kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi ti chaŋ maa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pinaayi puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia daba anu dali ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yi Jɛrusalɛm zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli ma, Tiŋ maa luya.
en: In the twelfth year, on the fifth day of the tenth month of our exile, a survivor from Jerusalem came to me and reported, The city has fallen.

dag: Kurimbuni ha zaŋ na ni pumpɔŋɔ, so nini na ʒi n-nya bee n-wum ni Naawuni so beni pah a zuɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi tuun kara tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guhir o.
en: No one has ever heard of such a God. No one has ever heard such a story. No one has ever seen any God except you, who does such great things for those who trust him.

dag: Ka o zo maa ni do duu puuni ha ka garigi yɛl o, Di nahim ma, dama n dunol kparimi ka m mini m bihi do gom ni; dinzuɣu n ku tooi yiɣisi zaŋ li ti a.
en: And suppose your friend answers, Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku be kaman bɛ yaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tipawumlinim mini duŋtaariba ʒiɛmani niriba la. Bɛ daa nyɛla ʒiɛman shɛli niriba bɛn bi ʒe yim bɛ suhuri ni. Bɛ daa lan nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim.
en: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.

dag: Iso zuliya ni nanim yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla kaman bɛ malibu mini bɛ biɛhigu shee ni daa nyɛ shɛm doli bɛ yuya. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: The clans that descended from Esau took their names from their families and the places where they lived. They are Timna, Alvah, Jetheth.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha ka Samsin ti labiri ni o ti niŋ paɣisarili maa amiliya, ka o daa ti ŋmaligi birigi ni o lihi nya o ni daa ku gbuɣin so sɔŋ la, ka nya ka shihi n-kpe m-pal o zaɣ woliŋ ni niŋ kpam.
en: After a while, he came back again to marry her. He turned aside to look at the lions remains, and there was a swarm of bees with honey inside the lions skeleton.

dag: Ka Naawuni malaika ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim maa tooni la daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo, ka sagban daantaliga la gba daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: All this time God's angel had gone ahead of Israel's army, but now he moved behind them. A large cloud had also gone ahead of them.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: You are merciful, Lord ! You are kind and patient and always loving.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi kuli Izraɛl zuliya daŋ shɛli puuni niriba, dindina ti yaannim tarili ni ka bɛ tarili ni yina, ka bɛ zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni; di saha ka di yi ti tarili ni.
en: Maybe a man from one of the other tribes will marry one of Zelophehads daughters. Will that land leave our family? Will the people of that other tribe get the land? Will we lose the land that we got by throwing lots?.

dag: O bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla, o mi bi tamd o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zali ʒiɛmana tuhili niriba yɛla.
en: He will keep his covenant forever, his promises for a thousand generations.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya ko, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba yurila bɛn yuri ba.
en: If you love only someone who loves you, will God praise you for that? Even sinners love people who love them.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa yi o sani kuli nti chɛ ka o min o bihi maa kpe duu ka yo bɛmaŋ niŋ di puuni; ka o bihi maa zaŋdi ŋmana n-zaan o, ka o boori kpam maa niŋdi di ni.
en: So the woman left Elisha, went into her house, and shut the door. Only she and her sons were in the house. Her sons brought the bowls to her and she poured oil.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka m baŋ n kum dali. Ka daba ala n-lee kpalim ma? Chɛ ka m baŋ n nyɛvili ni naari yomyom shɛm.
en: Lord , tell me, what will happen to me now? Tell me, how long will I live? Let me know how short my life really is.

dag: Niŋm mani a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m be, ka doli a yɛligu.
en: Be good to me, your servant, so that I may live and obey your teachings.

dag: O daa malila pua, ka wolisiri n-kuhiri ni biɛrim pam ni o dɔɣi.
en: She was pregnant, and she cried out because she was in labor, in pain from giving birth.

dag: Gbilisim tibili wum n saɣisigu ŋɔ; n ni yɛl a din be n suhu ni, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni yɛli shɛm.
en: I wanted to tell you everything I knew and give you all my knowledge, but you didnt listen to my advice and teaching.

dag: Sunsuuni dunɔpaɣira daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee maa tooni, binshɛli daa beni ŋ-ŋmani.
en: The doorposts of the Holy Place were square. In front of the entrance of the Most Holy Place there was something that looked like.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Yɛlim nachimbihi la gba ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa.
en: In the same way, tell the young men to be wise.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino bɔhi ma, Bɛn ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒiɛya ŋɔ lee nyɛla banima, ka ya polo ka bɛ lee yina.
en: Then one of the elders said to me, Who are these people wearing white robes, and where did they come from.

dag: Bee di yi pa lala, nyin chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi kpe ŋɔ wuhi bɛ ni daa nya ka jintɔriba la vihi ma n-nya n ni daa tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi.
en: Ask these men here if they found any wrong in me when I stood before the high council meeting in Jerusalem.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di tuhiya ni n neei yi tɛha ka yi teeri yɛla ŋɔ, n ni na kul be n nyɛvili ni ŋɔ.
en: I think its right that I keep stirring up your memory, as long as Im alive.

dag: N daa gbi kɔbilisi, ka nyu tinzun tinsi kom, ka daa siɣi Ijipti kulibɔna ni, ka n naba chɛ ka di kom zaa nyuui.
en: I dug wells, and drank water from new places. I dried up the rivers of Egypt and walked on the land there.

dag: Sool yuma daa nyɛla kaman yuun ... ka o naanyi di nam. O daa di nam maa n-su Izraɛlnim la kaman yuun ... ni ayi.
en: Saul was years old when he became king. He ruled over Israel years.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Pool, M bah a noli ni a tɔɣisi zabi amaŋ zuɣu. Ka Pool daa teeg o nuu ka piligi tɔɣisiri ni o chih omaŋ noli yɛra.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, You have permission to speak on your own behalf. Paul stretched out his hand and defended himself as follows:.

dag: Nyini daadam, wuhimi Izraɛlnim maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ buɣisi di biɛhigu maa, ka chɛ ka vi gbahi ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: You, human one, describe the temple to the house of Israel. Let them be humiliated because of their guilt when they think about its design.

dag: Di saha maa Babilɔn Naa tɔbbihi daa teei gilila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ daa kpari anabi Jɛrimia niŋ guliba dundɔŋ din daa be Juda nayili la ni.
en: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-ni be nimaani. Ka viri mini taatahi kpe m-be bɛ yinsi; ka mɔɣu ni buhi be nimaani n-yiɣiri jamda.
en: It will be a place where desert animals live and where owls build their nests. Ostriches will live there, and wild goats will prance through the ruins.

dag: wuhim ma a samli ka n yo a.
en: Name your wages, and I will pay them.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun kalimi daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa o ni yi daɣiri ni.
en: After the womans discharge stops, she must wait seven days. After that she will be clean.

dag: Ka kpamba maa daa yih o o ni daa be chɛchɛbun shɛli ni maa n-zaŋ o niŋ o chɛchɛbun shɛli din daa pahir ayi ni n-zaŋ o kuli Jɛrusalɛm. Ka o daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni. Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kum o kuli.
en: So his servants took him out of his chariot, placed him in another one, and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died and was buried in the tombs of his ancestors. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be o sani zaa ŋmaligi guui n-niŋ kaman Ainim nyaŋ ba mi la n-zo n-kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: Joshua and all the men of Israel let the army of Ai push them back. Joshua and his men began running east toward the desert.

dag: Dama a yɛliya, M biɛhigu nyɛla din be kasi, ka n ka daɣiri Naawuni sani!.
en: Youve said, My teaching is pure, and Im clean in Gods eyes.

dag: ka o yɛli ma, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu, nyin chɛ ka ŋuna n-nyɛ nyin Yawɛ ni bɔri ni so leei n-dan bia paɣa maa.
en: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.

dag: ka Inan bia Ahira mi nyɛ Naftali zuliya zuɣulana.
en: Ahira, Enans son, commanded the military of the tribe of Naphtali.

dag: Ka a lan zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn nya Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam la ni pin shɛŋa niriba maa mini maligumaaniba ni ti ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni di zaŋ tum bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la tuma gba mali chaŋ.
en: together with any of the silver and gold that you find in the entire province of Babylonia. You should also bring the spontaneous gifts of the people and the priests, given freely for Gods house in Jerusalem.

dag: Aai, tuumbiɛri tumbu m-be yi suhuri ni, ka yi kul tumdila duŋtaabo tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: No, you only think of evil things to do. You do violent crimes in this country.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali m biɛhigu shee dundɔŋ ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi n-yil li zaŋ labi nudirigu polo.
en: You should also set up the dwellings courtyard. The courtyards south side should have drapes of fine twisted linen stretching one hundred fifty feet on that side.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Tɛman n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Bɔzira la.
en: So I will start a fire at Teman that will destroy the high towers of Bozrah.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi yɛm, ka vihiri baŋdi salinim suhuri, ka tiri sokam zaa ka di doli bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ni bɛ tuma nyɔri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But I am the Lord , and I can look into a persons heart. I can test a persons mind and decide what each one should have. I can give each person the right payment for what they do.

dag: Amaa teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, dama ŋuna n-niŋdi ya yiko ka yi nyari buni maa ni di chɛ ka o pal o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la kaman o ni niŋdi shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n-yili yilli paɣi Yawɛ dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa fa o o dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi, ka lan fa o Sool gba nuu ni bahi la nyaaŋa.
en: When the Lord saved David from Saul and his other enemies, David sang this song to the Lord :.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka ŋmaligi lab ti Duuma polo ka o kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So you must change your hearts and lives. Come back to God, and he will forgive your sins.

dag: O ni yo n dimnim bɛ tuumbiɛri samli. O ʒiɛyimtal la zuɣu, o ni kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: He will punish the people who turned against me. God, be faithful to me and destroy them.

dag: Man a dabili ŋɔ kul ni dolila nyini naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ n-chaŋ biɛla ha. Bɔzuɣu ka nyini naa ti yɛn yo ma san titali ŋɔ?.
en: I don't deserve such a great reward. So I will go just a little way with you beyond the Jordan.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛl o, Cham ti sɔɣ a ba kaman o ni daa chɛ ka a po ni a ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Pharaoh replied, Go, bury your father as you promised.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni zaa hal ka bi chɛ bɛ ni yino gba; ka daa nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: and everyone else, then they set the town on fire.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣimna, ka o yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mani n-daa yihi yinim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka fan ya Ijiptinim mini na shɛb bɛn daa niŋdi ya fitiina la zaa nuu ni bahi.
en: and said to them, The Lord , the God of Israel, says, I brought you out of Egypt and rescued you from the Egyptians and all the other peoples who were oppressing you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zuliya kul beni sahakam; ka chɛ ka o zuliya diri nam ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: His dynasty will be as permanent as the sky; a descendant of his will always be king.

dag: Aai, tuumbiɛri tumbu m-be yi suhuri ni, ka yi kul tumdila duŋtaabo tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You are always planning evil, and you are brutal.

dag: Lihimiya ma ka chɛ ka di gari ya, ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi pɔb yi noya.
en: Turn to me and be appalled; lay your hand over your mouth.

dag: Ka gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa din be kasi zaa la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti kana.
en: The governor ordered that they shouldnt eat of the most holy food until a priest arose who could consult Urim and Thummim.

dag: Jɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Joash did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Juda nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka bɛ daa kul ʒe Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam maa nyaaŋa hal ni yuma ata, dama yuma ata maa ni zaa bɛ daa kul dolila Dauda mini Sulemaana naba.
en: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam, Solomons son, for three years by following the way of David and Solomon those three years.

dag: ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: Tell us, they asked Jesus, are you the one John said was going to come, or should we expect someone else.

dag: Lab kul a yiŋa nti yɛli tuun kar shɛl a Duuma Naawuni ni tum ti a ŋɔ yɛla. Ka o daa chaŋ ti moli Yisa ni tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla gili tiŋ maa zaa.
en: Go back home and tell what God has done for you. The man went through the town, telling what Jesus had done for him.

dag: Ka yi ti leei bɛ ni je ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ ni turi ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ni maani ninvuɣ shɛba ansarisi Yawɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ya tahi zuliya shɛb zaa sani maa.
en: In the countries where the Lord will send you, the people will be shocked at the terrible things that happen to you. They will laugh at you and say bad things about you.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi yila vuri la zo n sani. M mi ku wum yi biŋkumda kumsi.
en: Take away the noise of your songs; I wont listen to the melody of your harps.

dag: Di saha ka Sool mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa dii lu tɔb tuhibu soli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa gbaai tab tuhibu, dama bɛ daa birimya pam.
en: Then he and his men marched into battle against the Philistines, who were fighting each other in complete confusion.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe Kapɛrinium tiŋ puuni saha shɛli, ka Rom sapashin so daa ka o sanna nti balind o yɛra.
en: When Jesus was going into the town of Capernaum, an army officer came up to him and said.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ o leei n niriba zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o nam kul beni sahakam.
en: I will put him in charge of my house and kingdom forever. His rule will continue forever.

dag: Wɔr fufuhisi la ni daa ti yina, bɛ ni daa kul ŋmɛrimi ni bɛ kaai gili dunia ŋɔ. Ka malaika maa daa yɛli ba, Chamiya kaai gili dunia ŋɔ, ka bɛ daa chaŋ.
en: The red spotted horses were anxious to go look at their part of the earth, so the angel told them, Go walk through the earth. So they went walking through their part of the earth.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba wurindila tiŋa, amaa yɛnnim bɛn maarila niriba suhuri.
en: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam nimaani, ka biɛrim mali ba kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: They trembled all over like women giving birth.

dag: dama bɛ yi yɛl a, Dum zuɣusaa ŋɔ na, di so ni bɛ filim a ninvuɣ titali tooni.
en: It is much better for the king to invite you to take a more important position than to embarrass you in front of his officials.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul zɔrimi, ka nyaandol ŋun maa daa zo ŋ-ŋma Pita zuɣu daŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: They ran side by side, until the other disciple ran faster than Peter and got there first.

dag: Di saha ka yi mini kum zɔri la saɣim, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee alikauli la yiɣisi. Di nyaaŋa alɔbo yi ti lu, di ni din ya.
en: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma sahakam. Bɛ ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka nyɛ bɛn suhuri ye n soli baŋbu zuɣu; ka bi tam bɛ Naawuni zaligu yɛla. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ baŋ n saria karibu soli din tuhi yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni Naawuni miri ba.
en: They worship me every day, claiming that they are eager to know my ways and obey my laws. They say they want me to give them just laws and that they take pleasure in worshiping me.

dag: ni lala chɛ ka bɛ dol o zalikpana, ka dol o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: so that his people would obey his laws and keep all his commands. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔh o, Amaŋmaŋ n-kul bɔhi ma lala bee shɛba n-yɛl a n yɛla lala.
en: Jesus answered, Does this question come from you or have others told you about me.

dag: Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi ka paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, o ni zaŋ tiŋgban viɛli shɛli tin ya maa zuɣu.
en: You will have all you want to eat. Then you will praise the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.

dag: Lala n-shiri niŋ Babilɔn maa bɛ ni daa nya anabinim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni la ʒim di puuni la zuɣu.
en: the blood of prophets, of saints, and of all who have been slaughtered on the earth was found among you.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa paai bɛ kpalansi yomyom sɔŋ tiŋa, ka lɔrigilɔrigi di noya.
en: So they quickly lowered their sacks to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

dag: Amaa ka Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn daa bi saɣi ni ti gari, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ ka o niŋ tipawumli maa ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni kaman o ni niŋ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But Sihon, Heshbons king, wasnt willing to let us pass through his land because the LORD your God had made his spirit hard and his heart inflexible so that God could hand him over to you, which is exactly how it happened.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka salo pam laɣim gil o maa ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ baami n-du duli ha.
en: Now when Jesus saw the crowd, he ordered his disciples to go over to the other side of the lake.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi Dauda yɛla, ka teeg o ni daa di wahala shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: LORD, remember David— all the ways he suffered.

dag: Dama nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi ni n daa tum taali, dinzuɣu ka mani n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ yi Yisifu zuliya ni kana ni n ti tuhi nyini n dan naa soli maa.
en: because your servant knows that I have sinned. But look, I am the first person from the entire family of Joseph to come down today and meet my master the king.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo. Ka nachimbil so ŋun daa guli nayili maa daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya niriba pam ni doli Hɔrɔnaim soli m-baɣisiri zoli kanna.
