en: Absalom ran away. There was a guard standing on the city wall. He saw many people coming from the other side of the hill, and went to tell the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa ka mali suhukpeeni, dama yi dan Sool kpiya ka Judanim mi zaŋ ma leei bɛ naa.
en: Be strong and brave! Saul your king is dead, and the people of Judah have anointed me as their king.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya sanʒiɛɣu ni yi nuzaa polo kanna, ka sagban titali daa beni, ka neesim gil li, ka buɣim daa kul nyaɣisira, ka binshɛli daa be buɣim maa sunsuuni kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal.

dag: Ti yi bela Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko zuɣu, yin chɛliya ka ti doli Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu.
en: The Spirit has given us life; he must also control our lives.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li. Yi gba yi niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa yin yɛlimiya, Ti bi simdi paɣibu, dama ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti tum maa. .
en: It is the same with you; when you have done all you have been told to do, say, We are ordinary servants; we have only done our duty.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Naawuni, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Cham ti liri ba, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked God, Shall I attack the Philistines? Will you give me the victory? The Lord answered, Yes, attack! I will give you the victory.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbul bɔh o, Ka a noli buɣibuɣi la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Pa nyini n-daa yɛli ni Abimilɛk mi lee nyɛ ŋuni ka ti jɛmd o la? Pa bɛna ka a daa ʒiɛm la? To, pumpɔŋɔ cham ka a mini ba ti tuhi.
en: Then Zebul replied to him, Wheres all your talk now, you who said, Who is Abimelech that we ought to serve him? Arent these the men you despised? Now march out and fight them.

dag: ka ti mi yi ye li, di ni chɛ ka ti ku be ti zaɣim.
en: since we assume that when we take off this tent, we wont find out that we are naked.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛm o o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: Praise the Lord our God, and worship at his sacred hill! The Lord our God is holy.

dag: Nir yi nya o suhu ni bɔri shɛli, di nyaɣisila o sani, amaa nir yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, di nyɛla din chihira jɛra sani.
en: How good it is to get what you want! Stupid people refuse to turn away from evil.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa yiɣisi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka yumaha gbaai Ayuba, o zuɣutaliga ni zaŋ hal ni o naba puuni.
en: So Satan left the meeting with the Lord and gave Job painful sores all over his body, from the bottom of his feet to the top of his head.

dag: Amaa di simdi ni o lee suhimi ni yɛda ka bi biɛhinda, dama ŋun biɛhindi ŋmanila teeku kɔgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri ka di laŋsira.
en: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-zɔri Yawɛ, ka deeg o dabili noli? Ŋun be zibisim ni ka neesim ka o sani, o niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o Naawuni.
en: All of you that honor the Lord and obey the words of his servant, the path you walk may be dark indeed, but trust in the Lord , rely on your God.

dag: Hal Ɛlnatan mini Dɛlaiya ni Gɛmaria ni daa kpam naa jaande ni o di nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim maa zaa yoli, o daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Although Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah begged the king not to burn the scroll, he paid no attention to them.

dag: Niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti du n-tam Ziɔn Zol la zuɣu, ka deei Iso Zoli su. Ka di ti leei Yawɛ nam.
en: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n dan naa, di chɛ ka di muɣis a kaman a bihi maa zaa n-shiri kpi la, dama Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi.
en: So don't believe the news that all your sons are dead; only Amnon was killed.

dag: Miriya ka yi mini ba ti kpuɣiri taba, di zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi.
en: Do not marry any of them, and do not let your children marry any of them.

dag: Niŋmi lala pɔi ka wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni neesim naanyi zibigi, ka sagbana chɛ ka saa luna.
en: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.

dag: Ka Jona daa yi tiŋ maa tariga wulimpuhili polo ti ʒini. O daa sa la gara n-kpe n-ʒi di mahim guhiri ni o nya din yɛn niŋ Ninive.
en: Jonah went out east of the city and sat down. He made a shelter for himself and sat in its shade, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.

dag: Cham ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni, Ibrahimma Naawuni ni Yisahaku Naawuni ni Yaakubu Naawuni n-yi n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, N nini nyan ya, ka nya yi ni diri wahala shɛŋa zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Call together the leaders of Israel and tell them that the God who was worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob has appeared to you. Tell them I have seen how terribly they are being treated in Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu wuhim ti ka ti kaani ti dabisa, din ni chɛ ka ti niŋ yɛm ti suhuri ni.
en: Teach us how short our lives are so that we can become wise.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o.
en: Achsah said to Caleb, Give me a gift. Since youve given me land in the southern plain, give me springs of water. So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

dag: dama o zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim pam daa chɛ bɛ zuɣulaannima ka niŋ Yisa yɛda.
en: He was the reason that many of the people were turning from them and putting their faith in Jesus.

dag: Nyin Musa kɔŋko n-ni miri man Yawɛ; bɛ ni so di ti mirina; niriba maa di pah a zuɣu du na.
en: You alone, and none of the others, are to come near me. The people are not even to come up the mountain.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Ilaija mini Anabi Musa puhi zan o sani, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then the three disciples saw Elijah and Moses talking with Jesus.

dag: Yi ni so shiri zaŋd o mabia tahiri sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani ni bɛ ti kari ba saria?.
en: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?.

dag: ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛha bie ka lan nyɛ bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli la sanna. Bɛ tɛhiri ni wuntia soli dolibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir nya azichi. Gbaam amaŋa ni niriba ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo.
en: They are always making trouble, because they are people whose thinking has been confused. They have lost their understanding of the truth. They think that devotion to God is a way to get rich.

dag: Bɛ yi ti sibigi li sa, di ni baai? Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di ku kuui zaa, di ku kuui bɛ ni daa biri li luɣ shɛli maa? .
en: Though it is planted, will it thrive? When the east wind touches it, wont it completely wither? On the bed in which it was planted, it will wither away.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni n-kuli Ɛliashib bia Jɛhɔhanan yiŋa nti gbe nimaani, ka kul bela suhugarigu ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn lab kulina maa yɛda kalinsi la polo. O mi daa bi di bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: Then Ezra got up from the area in front of Gods house and went to the room of Jehohanan, Eliashibs son, where he spent the night. He didnt eat food or drink water, for he was mourning because of the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

dag: di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛ kurili, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni. O di lan zaŋ o niŋ duu yaha, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: then it is a case of chronic skin disease on their skin. The priest will declare the person unclean. The priest will not quarantine such persons, because they are already unclean.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kana ni o ti malimali firilanim maa asiba kam, ŋun tuɣilim tulaale zim din nyom viɛl sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Aaron must burn sweet-smelling incense on the altar every morning. He will do this when he comes to care for the lamps.

dag: Dama n suhu bi doya, ka n lan ka alaafee. M bi nyari nyee vuhira, amaa ka muɣisigu n-kul paari ma.
en: I cannot calm down or relax. I am too upset to rest.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛba daa chaŋ ti gu Mikimash solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: The Philistines moved their camp to the pass at Michmash.

dag: Ti ni nyuri bara binshɛli zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ: Ti suhuri ni tɛha diri ti shɛhira ni ti biɛhigu doli biɛrikasitali mini wuntia soli dunia ŋɔ ni, di bahi bamdi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani, ka di pala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni daalibarika zuɣu.
en: We have conducted ourselves with godly sincerity and pure motives in the world, and especially toward you. This is why we are confident, and our conscience confirms this. We didnt act with human wisdom but we relied on the grace of God.

dag: amaa ŋun mali shili ni o kari nyɛvilinim mini bɛn kpi saria la ni ti bɔhi ba di zuɣu.
en: But they will have to give an account of themselves to God, who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

dag: Man Klɔdius Lisias n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ m-puhiri n dan Gomna Filiksi.
en: Claudius Lysias to His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira. Tɛhi shɛli ni bi mali yinim shɛb ŋɔ, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya. Pirigimiya yi situra sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buri so yi shɛhi ni.
en: You have been living an easy life, free from worries; but now, tremble with fear! Strip off your clothes and tie rags around your waist.

dag: Sool saha la bɛna n-daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinima n-nyaŋ ba, ka ʒini bɛ tinsi maa ni Giliad wulimpuhili polo maa ni zaa la.
en: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead.

dag: Nimaani ka tuumbiɛtumdiba la lu n-doya. Bɛ daai ba mi luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.

dag: Ka lala bindira maa ni nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira n-ʒiɛya gu yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa ni kum ni ti yɛn lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di chɛ ka kum ti ku ku tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima.
en: It can be stored until it is needed during the seven years when there won't be enough grain in Egypt. This will keep the country from being destroyed because of the lack of food.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama ti yɛl o Sool ni niŋ o shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka o mini Samuɛl daa chaŋ ti be Naiɔt.
en: David escaped and went to Samuel in Ramah and told him everything that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

dag: Teem a daba bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu yɛla, ka di doli niriba ŋɔ tipawumli bee bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali bee bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ.
en: Remember your promise to your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Forget how stubborn these people are. Dont look at their evil ways or their sins.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Pita mini Jɔn daa ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni kurig ata saha din nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naawuni jɛmbu saha la.
en: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka o garigi yɛli, Mbaye, n yidan kpimi ka n kpalim pakoli.
en: David asked, What's the matter? She replied: My husband is dead, and I'm a widow.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni yɛligu, ka lihi ʒiɛm ŋun Zallakudura Naa wuhibu la zuɣu.
en: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.

dag: Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa. Doo maa ni daa gbibi bimbuɣisirigu shɛli o nuu ni maa wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ata. Ka o daa zaŋ li buɣisi gooni maa barilim mini di dubu. Di dubu daa nyɛla mita ata, ka di barilim gba nyɛ mita ata.
en: What I saw was the Temple, and there was a wall around it. The man took his measuring rod, which was feet long, and measured the wall. It was feet high and feet thick.

dag: Tibikpara viɛl a tapaɣisi zuɣu ka nyiŋgokɔriti viɛl a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Lovely are your cheeks, adorned with ear hoops; your neck, with beads.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa ti nyo buɣim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu samban ni luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.

dag: Naawuni ni boli ba bihi, ka bɛ mali niŋgbuna mini ʒim zuɣu ka Yisa daa leei bɛ tatabo ka bɛ min o laɣim mali niŋgbun yini. O daa niŋla lala ni o kum zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim Sintani ŋun mali kum yiko la.
en: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.

dag: Di saha ka a niriba zaa ti leei bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka su tiŋgbani maa sahakam. Mani n-nam ba, ka zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani ni di chɛ ka n nya jilima.
en: Your people will all be righteous; they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot that I planted, the work of my hands, to glorify myself.

dag: Dama bidibiga lihi ʒiɛm o ba, ka bipuɣiŋga yiɣisi lu o ma zuɣu. Ka paɣa yiɣisi lu o yidan ma zuɣu. Ka nir dimnim ni nyɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima.
en: Son disrespects father; a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; the enemies of a man are those of his own household.

dag: Saɣimi ti Naawuni, ka tim sandaani niŋ o, ka bin viɛla lan ka a sanna.
en: Now, Job, make peace with God and stop treating him like an enemy; if you do, then he will bless you.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nira n-deeri Naawuni yɛligu; amaa yinim ni pa Naawuni niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi deeri o yɛligu maa.
en: Whoever belongs to God accepts what he says. But you dont accept what God says, because you dont belong to God.

dag: Di saha n yi ti laɣim ya, n ni zaŋ ya kuli yiŋa, dama n ni chɛ ka yi yuli du, ka yi nya jilima dunianim zaa sani saha shɛli n yi ti lan labisi yi daazichi la na ka yi nina nya li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The time is coming! I will bring your scattered people home; I will make you famous throughout the world and make you prosperous once again. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ tɔrili ŋun yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini tinvurigu ni chani shɛm tampiŋ zuɣu, ni ŋariŋ din be teeku bulli ni biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni doo mini paɣa tab laɣimbu yɛla.
en: an eagle flying in the sky, a snake moving on a rock, a ship finding its way over the sea, and a man and a woman falling in love.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: Each son was the leader of several family groups. The Gershon family groups were Libni and Shimei.

dag: Ti nyɛla do yino bidibisi pinaayi; ka ti ni yino daa kani, ka ŋun nyɛ ti zaa biasani be ti ba maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: There are twelve of us brothers, all from the same father. But one of our brothers is no longer living, and the youngest is still at home with our father in Canaan.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa ti zaŋ Simiɔn chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Dindali maa ka Yisifu mini Mariama gba daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la.
en: The Spirit led Simeon to the Temple. So he was there when Mary and Joseph brought the baby Jesus to do what the Jewish law said they must do.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka dam ŋɔ yɛn yi a ninni? Ka yɛl o, Chɛli wain nyubu.
en: and he said to her, Stop making a drunken show of yourself! Stop your drinking and sober up.

dag: M bi bɔri jilima ninsalinim sani.
en: I don't care about human praise.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ŋmaŋkɔhiriba la mi, Zaŋmiya yi binyara yi! Di zaŋya m Ba duu leei daa.
en: He said to the dove sellers, Get these things out of here! Dont make my Fathers house a place of business.

dag: Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli, N nɔrila zuliya kam niriba kaman wain tiwala la, ka so bi sɔŋ ma. Ka n daa no ba ni suli mini suhuyiɣisili, ka bɛ ʒim varim m binyɛrigu ka di gabisi zaa.
en: I have pressed out in the vat by myself—from the peoples, no one was with me. I stomped on them in my anger, trampled them in my wrath. Their blood splashed on my garments, and stained all my clothing.

dag: Ka m bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli, Man Yisa so a ni niŋdi alaka maa m-bala.
en: Who are you, Lord? I asked. And the Lord answered, I am Jesus, whom you persecute.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan ŋubi niriba, yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But from now on it will no longer eat people and rob you of your children. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ gballi maa gbini, ka o suhu ti lan saɣim pam. Gballi maa daa nyɛla siliga, ka kuɣili yo di noli.
en: Again feeling very upset, Jesus came to the tomb. It was a cave with a large stone covering the entrance.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni tumtumdiba, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn tumd o yubu ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ.
en: Praise the Lord , all you heavenly powers, you servants of his, who do his will!.

dag: Yi nyuri bara yɛri ni yinim laɣila kum zɔri, ka yi mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee lo tab alikauli. Yi niŋ yɛda ni alɔbo yi lu, di ku din ya, dama yi tɛhiya ni ʒiri mini yɔhiŋgu ni tiligi ya.
en: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?.

dag: O ku kabigi gbiŋgbaŋ din dalim. O mi ku kpihi firila mia din diri biɛlabiɛla. O ni wuhi zaligu soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.

dag: Anatɔt — kɔbiga ni pihitaayika.
en: of Anathoth.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi, shee bihi dimi tiɣi pɔi.
en: He responded, The children have to be fed first. It isnt right to take the childrens bread and toss it to the dogs.

dag: Niŋm man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim; ka tiligi ma a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: Please welcome and accept your servant. Be kind to me and save me.

dag: hal ka di pala bɛ zuliya maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ni o laɣim Naawuni bihi bɛn wurim kpe yɔɣu na la gba ka bɛ ti lee zaɣ yini.
en: Yet Jesus would not die just for the Jewish nation. He would die to bring together all of God's scattered people.

dag: ka hal malaikanim bɛn mali yaa mini kpiɔŋ gari karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ bi doli ʒiɛmbu soli fiɣisiri bɛn mali jilima maa ti Duuma sani.
en: Even the angels, who are so much stronger and mightier than these false teachers, do not accuse them with insults in the presence of the Lord.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ sol zuɣu zibisi ka sarigira, ka Yawɛ malaika kariti doli ba.
en: Make their road dark and slippery. Let the Lord s angel chase them.

dag: Ka shɛb yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, chɛliya ka bɛ niriba ata bee ayi kɔŋko n-tɔɣisiri ka tiri taba; ka chɛ ka so wuhi di gbinni.
en: If some speak in a tongue, then let two or at most three speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Pa ninvuɣ pia n-di kpaŋ maa? Ka niriba awɛi la, bɛn kpalim ya?.
en: Jesus said, Ten men were healed; where are the other nine?.

dag: ka o yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli baa din kuui ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: He said, This is what the LORD says: This valley will be filled with pools.

dag: Chɛli n tibili darigibu lala! A ni zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma maa chɛmi ka n gbarigi.
en: Don't punish me any more! I am about to die from your blows.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla wuntialana ka a saria karibu nyɛ din tuhi.
en: LORD, you are righteous, and your rules are right.

dag: ka ninvuɣ galima bɛn ka buchi laɣimna ti pah o zuɣu, ka bɛ zaɣisi Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun daa na nyɛ bipolli ka o yɛm na bi ziligi ka o ku tooi nyaŋ ba la noli.
en: Then worthless, evil men became friends with Jeroboam. Then Jeroboam and the bad men turned against Rehoboam, Solomons son. Rehoboam was young and did not have experience. So he could not stop Jeroboam and his bad friends.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim yi ti niŋ ka yi bi deei n noli, di saha n ni darigi yi tibili ʒiibuyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins.

dag: A ni yɛn kpi shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma. N yi chɛ ka binshɛli woligi m min a ka pa ni kum, Yawɛ ŋun darigim n tibili.
en: Wherever you die, I will die, and that is where I will be buried. May the Lord 's worst punishment come upon me if I let anything but death separate me from you.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima m-mali binshɛŋa ni daanya lahi ni kuriti binyara din nyɛla binshɛŋa din be kasi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni zaŋ dina nti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Everything made of silver, gold, bronze, or iron is set apart for the Lord . It is to be put in the Lord 's treasury.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ku a dabili Stiivin la, n gba daa be bɛ ni ka yu o kubu maa, ka daa gbib bɛn ku o maa binyɛra.
en: Stephen was killed because he spoke for you, and I stood there and cheered them on. I even guarded the clothes of the men who murdered him.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul tam luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani zuɣu, n ni zaŋ li tin ya kaman n ni daa pun lo Musa alikauli yɛli shɛm la.
en: I am giving you every place where you set foot, exactly as I promised Moses.

dag: N kul bela zibisim ni chana ka wuntaŋ kani; ka n ʒe kpamba laɣiŋgu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: I am always sad and depressed, without any relief. I stand up in the public meeting and cry for help.

dag: Ka Makiri bia Giliad ŋun daa nyɛ Yisifu bia Manaasa yaaŋa la daŋ puuni dunoya dɔɣirikpamba daa ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim dunoya dɔɣirikpamba sanna.
en: The heads of the families in the clan of Gilead, the son of Machir and grandson of Manasseh son of Joseph, went to Moses and the other leaders.

dag: Chɛli ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku birigi kpe mɔɣu ni bee n-tim yi wain tihi puri ni; ti mi ku nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu hal ti gari yi tintariga.
en: Let us pass through your land. We wont turn aside into a field or vineyard. We wont drink water from a well. We will walk on the Kings Highway until we cross your border.

dag: Hal n yi kuhi, Famiya ma! so bi garigiri ma. N daa duhi n yee pam, amaa ka so daa bi ti ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: If I cry Violence! Im not answered; I shout—but there is no justice.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N nyɛla n ni daa pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so piligu ni la.
en: Who are you? they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.

dag: Dama o soli nyɛla din kuni kum shee, ka o soya kuni kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Going into her house leads to death. She will lead you to the grave.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Nyama, M pun piligi zaŋdi Sihɔn min o tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiri ya, piligimiya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa deebu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord said to me, I am giving King Sihon and his country to you. Now, go take his land.

dag: Ka Dibɔn Mɔɣili kom daa deei ʒim mɔhi, amaa di zaa yoli, n ni niŋ Dibɔnnim din bie n-gari lala. Iin, gbuɣinli ni doli Mɔab ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim, ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la.
en: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu. Ti ni daa be yi san la ti daa pala gbinnyaɣinima.
en: You yourselves know how you need to imitate us because we were not undisciplined when we were with you.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannima ayi maa mini kpambaliba la daa naai noli chaŋ naa sani nti yɛl o, Naa Darius, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili.
en: So these officers and chief administrators ganged together and went to the king. They said to him, Long live King Darius!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi tiri mmaŋ jilima, n jilima maa nyɛla yoli; m Ba so yi ni yɛli ni o nyɛla yi Naawuni la n-tiri ma jilima.
en: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is meaningless. My Father, who you say is your God, is the one who glorifies me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-ka Hɛlam na. Ka Sirianim maa daa niŋ shili yina ti liri Dauda ka bɛ min o zaŋ nya taba.
en: David found out what the Arameans were doing, and he brought Israel's whole army together. They crossed the Jordan River and went to Helam, where the Arameans were ready to meet them.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilai, Ilai, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: At about three o'clock Jesus cried out with a loud shout, Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani? which means, My God, my God, why did you abandon me.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n dabili Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: The Lord says, Listen now, Israel, my servant, my chosen people, the descendants of Jacob.

dag: Binshɛɣukam mali saha, ka yɛl shɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni malila di niŋbu saha.
en: There is a right time for everything, and everything on earth will happen at the right time.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Naawuni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla yi dini.
en: Everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me will now belong to you.

dag: Ɛla bia Izraɛl Naa Hɔshia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Juda Naa Ahaz bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam.
en: Hezekiah, Ahazs son, became king of Judah in the third year of Israels King Hoshea, Elahs son.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim taba n-ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a daŋ niriba.
en: All the people of Israel went to David at Hebron and said to him, We are your own flesh and blood.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Din simdi ya m-bala. N ni lo ni n niŋ ya shɛm m-bala! Dama yi tam n yɛla, ka niŋla ʒiri naani. Man Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord , have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaka ni nyɛ shɛli maa ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Moses gave all these gifts for the Lord to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Ibram mini Lɔt ni daa woligi maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo.
en: After Lot had left, the Lord said to Abram, From where you are, look carefully in all directions.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa dɔɣi Kɛnan maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pinaanu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Enosh had more children.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kari ma a sani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma?.
en: Why do you reject my very being, LORD? Why do you hide your face from me?.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti zaŋ ti nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deem ti suhigu. Iin, nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka deei ti suhigu, ka a yi deei ti suhigu maa, nyin chɛl ti taali.
en: And please listen to our prayers in the future when I and your people Israel turn to this place and pray to you. We know that you live in heaven. We ask you to hear our prayer there and forgive us.

dag: Ŋunkam yɔhindi niriba, dilan ku be n yiŋa; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi ŋmari ʒiri, m mini dilan gba ku kpe.
en: No liar will live in my palace; no hypocrite will remain in my presence.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni bɛ ti boli Yisa na.
en: Then Jesus mother and brothers came. They stood outside and sent someone in to tell him to come out.

dag: Ka o daa zo n-chaŋ Saimɔn Pita mini nyaandol so Yisa ni daa yuri la sani nti yɛli ba, Bɛ yihi ti Duuma siliga la ni, ka ti bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: She ran to Simon Peter and to Jesus' favorite disciple and said, They have taken the Lord from the tomb! We don't know where they have put him.

dag: Lahibali ni daa ti nti to Firawuna yiŋa ni Yisifu biɛyanima n-kana, di daa niŋ Firawuna min o kpambaliba nyaɣisim pam.
en: When Pharaohs household heard the message Josephs brothers have arrived, both Pharaoh and his servants were pleased.

dag: M Ba, m bɔri ni a chɛ ka a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba ti ma la ti be n sani n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛl la n-nya jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛla a ni daa pun yuri ma ka dunia na bi nam la zuɣu.
en: Father, I want those you gave me to be with me where I am. Then they can see my glory, which you gave me because you loved me before the creation of the world.

dag: N zaŋla tiŋgban nɛli ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ yiŋa, ka zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din ka kulim ti ba ni di nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: to whom I gave the desert as home, his dwelling place in the salt flats?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o ba Yaakubu chaŋ Firawuna sani, ka Yaakubu daa suhi alibarika niŋ Firawuna ni.
en: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob and presented him to the king. Jacob gave the king his blessing.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni kuli nti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhi din mali nyina mini kuriti kuya ni kuriti lɛri tumd o tuma. Lala ka Dauda daa niŋ Ammɔnnim maa tinsi zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda min o niriba maa zaa daa lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After removing the people who were in the city, David demolished the city with saws, iron picks, and axes, as he did to all the Ammonite cities. Then David and all his troops returned to Jerusalem.

dag: N ni guli n tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka ku chɛ ka tɔbbihi kpe di ni gari. M mi ku saɣi ka kpeengarigunim lan nahim n niriba yaha, dama mmaŋmaŋ nini nya bɛ ni di wahala shɛm.
en: I will protect my country. I will not let enemy armies pass through it. I will not let them hurt my people anymore. With my own eyes I have seen how much my people have suffered.

dag: Bolimiya Yawɛ yuli m-puh o. Chɛliya ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla.
en: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.

dag: N ŋmanila dikili, ka m biha ŋmani gaɣibihi. N nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka o nyari suhudoo.
en: I am a wall, and my breasts are its towers. My lover knows that with him I find contentment and peace.

dag: O daa wuh o ni bɛ zaŋmi salima din nyɛ alali m-mali dirijaba mini taha ni pipihi, o daa lan wuhi salima laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka lan wuhi anzinfa laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: the meat forks, the bowls and cups.

dag: N ku zaŋ binshɛli naɣila n nachimba ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli ma chaŋ la ni pun di shɛl la; amaa naɣ chɛ ka Anɛr mini Ɛshikol ni Mamri n-yihi bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli di ni.
en: The only thing I will accept is the food that my young men have eaten, but you should give the other men their share. Take what we won in battle and give some to Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. These men helped me in the battle.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali bimparilani, ka zaŋ chiriga chirigi pa di zuɣu yɛli, O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani. Chɛ ka di be kaman bɛ ni chirigiri nintu shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la.
en: Make a flower ornament of pure gold and engrave on it like an official seal: Holy to the LORD.

dag: Di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di simdi ni yi baŋ lala. Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya ka vi gbahi ya, ka yi kɔba ni chɔɣisi yi tuma maa zuɣu.
en: Israel, I want you to know that I am not doing all this for your sake. I want you to feel the shame and disgrace of what you are doing. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Timiya yi banim mini yi manim jilima din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ŋɔ ni.
en: Honor your father and your mother so that your life will be long on the fertile land that the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila Naawuni ŋun zaŋ ti naai ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa Masia zuɣu la sanna, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni tuma niŋ ti gba nuu ni.
en: All this is from God. Through Christ, God made peace between himself and us. And God gave us the work of bringing people into peace with him.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ firilatamdigu la kpɛhi Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nti zaŋ li zali tuhi teebuli maa Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nudirigu polo.
en: The lampstand was put along the south wall.

dag: Sool ʒiɛman ni zaa, o mini Filistianim daa kul tuhirimi ni nimmoo, dinzuɣu o daa yi kul nya do so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ bee suhukpeeni o zaŋd o mi leeg o tɔbbia.
en: Saul was brave all his life. He fought hard against the Philistines. Any time Saul saw a man who was strong or brave, he took that man and put him into the group of soldiers who stayed near the king and protected him.

dag: Di saha ka Siria naa kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Izraɛlnim Naawuni nyɛla zoya zuɣu Naawuni, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gari ti maa, amaa chɛliya ka ti tuhi ba la bɔpiɛligu ni, biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni nyaŋ ba.
en: The officers of Arams king said to him, Israels god is a god of the mountains. Thats why they were stronger than us. But if we fight them on the plains, we will certainly be stronger than they are.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa ni ti yɛli bɛn ʒe o nudirigu polo la, Yinim bɛn mal alibarika m Ba Naawuni sani ŋɔ, kamiyana ti di nam shɛli o ni daa pun zaŋ zali ya tum dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: Then the king will say to those on his right, My father has blessed you! Come and receive the kingdom that was prepared for you before the world was created.

dag: Ka Naawuni nini ni tiɣi ŋun jɛmdi Masia lala, ka ninsalinim gba ni di o shɛhira suŋ.
en: And when you serve Christ in this way, you please God and are approved by others.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu lan yɛli ba, Di kul nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: Joseph said to them, Its just as Ive said to you. You are spies!.

dag: Ka Pita daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, N Duuma, bula ka m mabia lee yɛn tum ma taali ka n kul chɛri paŋd o? N chɛli paŋ o hal ti paai ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Then Peter said to Jesus, Lord, how many times should I forgive my brother or sister who sins against me? Should I forgive as many as seven times.

dag: Dinzuɣu o tumtumdiba yi lɛbigi bɛmaŋa m-be kaman wuntizɔriba n-nyɛ ba la, di bi simdi ni di gari ti. Bɛ bahigu ni ti bemi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ pala yaɣ yini ko, amaa di nyɛla yaɣ bɔbili.
en: And a persons body has more than one part. It has many parts.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, ŋunkam yɛn mali suhudoo sara maligu ti man Yawɛ, ŋun zaŋm li ka man Yawɛ sanna. O suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: Tell the Israelites: If you bring a fellowship offering to the Lord , you must present that gift to the Lord yourself.

dag: ka n suhu kul be yiriŋ. N ni daa kul tɛhiri di yɛla shɛm, lala ka di yɛla maa daa niŋ ma muɣisigu. Di saha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli.
en: I was very angry, and the more I thought about it, the angrier I became. So I said something.

dag: N ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ya kpɛhi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka lala maa chɛ ka m paɣi yi ni daɣiri maa bahi.
en: I will scatter you among the nations. I will force you to go to many countries. I will completely destroy the filthy things in this city.

dag: Rɛhum ni Hashabina ni Maasɛya ni.
en: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni nyɛla ŋun niŋdi Izraɛlnim din viɛla, ka lan niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini din viɛla.
en: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yihi ti dabitim ni labisi Ziɔn na, di daa ŋmanila zahindi ka ti zahinda.
en: When the LORD changed Zions circumstances for the better, it was like we had been dreaming.

dag: Binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa puuni, naɣila Musa ni daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa niŋ di puuni Sinai Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nyaaŋa la.
en: Nothing was in the chest except the two stone tablets Moses placed there while at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they left Egypt.

dag: Ka nachimba daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli niŋ o n-zaŋ o yi nti sɔɣi.
en: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim o, N zaŋ sandaani timbu tuma ti o;.
en: Tell Phinehas that I am making a peace agreement with him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai Yisa.
en: Then they came and grabbed Jesus and arrested him.

dag: N lee bɔrila paɣibu ninsalinim sani bee Naawuni sani? Bee n kpaŋdi mmaŋ ni n tiɣila ninsalinim nini? N yi na kul tiɣiri ninsalinim nini, dindina n ku tooi nyɛ Masia dabili.
en: Now do you think I am trying to make people accept me? No, God is the one I am trying to please. Am I trying to please people? If I wanted to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

dag: Wuntizɔriba firilanim kul nɛmi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri firilanim kpira.
en: The light of those who do right shines brighter and brighter, but the lamp of the wicked becomes darker and darker.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini kpam din be di ni zaa ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi n-nyo buɣim kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la.
en: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.

dag: yo yaɣimɛr palo zuɣu kaman n Duuma Naawuni ni daa pun wuhi ma shɛm.
en: and I gave them for the potters field, as the Lord commanded me .

dag: Hal o bi dih o tumtumdib tabili, o nyar o malaikanim chirimbu.
en: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.

dag: Ka ti daa bi wum ti ba hal baabiɛla ni di chɛ ka ti ba yɛlimaŋli din be lahibal suŋ maa ni zali tin ya.
en: but we did not agree with anything those false brothers wanted. We wanted the truth of the Good News to continue for you.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ka o sanna ti yɛra, Jɔn daa bi tum alahiziba tuun shɛli, amaa o ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ doo ŋɔ polo nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: and many people came to him. They said, John never did any miraculous signs, but everything John said about this man is true.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni yi yi ti paai tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n.
en: Tell the Israelites this: I am taking you to another land.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shini ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama naa daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: The people kept quiet, just as King Hezekiah had told them to; they did not say a word.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you.

dag: N kul ni puhir a sahakam, a ni tum shɛm zuɣu. N ni duh a yuli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim sani, dama a yuli maa viɛla.
en: God, I praise you forever for what you have done. I will speak your name before your followers because it is so good!.

dag: Ti wuhiri ni nir yiri taali ni Naawuni san la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka pa ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu.
en: For we conclude that a person is put right with God only through faith, and not by doing what the Law commands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Malimi wahu ŋun mali lɔɣu n-zaŋ tabili da wɔɣinli; ka wahu yi dim sokam ka o lihi li, o ni tiligi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Make a poisonous snake and place it on a pole. Whoever is bitten can look at it and live.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam! Dama nandahima pam ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka Naawuni suhu ti yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: It will be an awful time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children! Everywhere in the land people will suffer horribly and be punished.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ ni so bi lan yɛl lala. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Man gba bi yɛli ni a simdi kubu. Cham a chandi, amaa ka di lan tum alahichi yaha. .
en: No sir, the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.

dag: Ka daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa ko n-nya bindirigu pam.
en: Then he told them a parable: A certain rich mans land produced a bountiful crop.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a saɣisigu wuhiri ma soli, ka dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, a ni ti deei ma ni jilima.
en: You have guided me with your advice; later you will receive me with glory.

dag: Ŋun daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ o banim min o manim polo, M bi lihi nya ba. O daa zaɣisi o mabihi, ka zaɣisi o bihi. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dol a yɛligu, ka gbib a daalikauli.
en: They were more loyal to you, Lord, than to their own families. They ignored their fathers and mothers. They did not recognize their brothers. They did not pay attention to their children. But they obeyed your commands. They kept your agreement.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yi o pɔri maa nyaaŋa m-mɔŋ bipuɣiŋga maa o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Although the king was upset, because of his solemn pledge and his guests, he didnt want to refuse her.

dag: Ka zama bɛn yɔri vuri yiriŋ gil a. Ka duŋtaariba pam daa zaŋ dɔbba bɛn nyɛ danyuriba n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ bansi piri paɣiba maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupili viɛla pili ba.
en: Their room was always filled with a noisy crowd of drunkards brought in from the desert. These men gave the women bracelets and beautiful crowns.

dag: Leeban daa lan yɛli, A yi nahim m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ bee a yi kpuɣi paɣiba pahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n ʒi di yɛla, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n nyɛ m min a shɛhiralana.
en: If you treat my daughters badly and if you marry other women, though we arent there, know that God observed our witness.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani zo n-chaŋ Adulam vokabili ni, ka o biɛyanim min o ba yiŋnim zaa daa ti wum o yɛla nimaani ka kahi chaŋ o sani.
en: David fled from the city of Gath and went to a cave near the town of Adullam. When his brothers and the rest of the family heard that he was there, they joined him.

dag: Ka Tomas kuhi yɛli, N Duuma ni n Naawuni.
en: Thomas answered him, My Lord and my God.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ sahakam. Ami, ami.
en: Bless the LORD forever! Amen and Amen!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni daa kuhi boli ba ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu shɛm, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli ma ka n gba zaɣisi ba garigibu.
en: So just as he called and they didnt listen, when they called, I didnt listen, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: ka yi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Yi yi zaŋ li ti ti maligumaana, o mi ni zaŋ li chaŋ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: When you bring grain offerings made from these things to the Lord , you must give them to the priest, and he will take them to the altar.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n chɛ ka n suhu bi yiɣisi. M paɣibu zuɣu ka n gbaai mmaŋa ni di chɛ ka n ku kun ya.
en: I, the Lord , am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tum alahichi pam, dinzuɣu ka o leei tabizahim niriba sani. Bɛnkam zaa daa tiri o jilima lihimi ʒiɛm o, dama bɛ nya o gbini. Omaŋmaŋ ŋuhirimi, ka ŋmalig o nini labi kpaŋa.
en: Jerusalem sinned very badly. Because Jerusalem sinned, she became a ruined city that people shake their heads about. In the past people respected her. But now they hate her, because they abused her. Jerusalem groaned and turned away.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaŋ bɛ ni kɔriti binneen shɛb maani sara mɔɣu ni la ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o zaŋ ba mali suhudoo sara maligu.
en: This rule is so that you will bring your fellowship offering to the Lord . You must bring any animal that you kill in the field to the Lord at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. Bring those animals to the priest.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti laɣim Galili na ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia n-niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: Later, the followers met together in Galilee. Jesus said to them, The Son of Man will be handed over to the control of other men.

dag: Dunɔguliba bɛn ʒiya m-bi gbihiri hal ka bɛ duuma ti paana mal alibarika. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o gba ni ti mali shili chɛ ka bɛ ʒini, ka o kpuɣi bindirigu na ti zali ba ka bɛ di.
en: When their master sees that they are ready and waiting for him, it will be a great day for those servants. I can tell you without a doubt, the master will get himself ready to serve a meal and tell the servants to sit down. Then he will serve them.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi tiŋgbana mini di fɔntinsi ni di tintarisi ni di tiŋgbana maa puuni fɔntinsi zaa ti Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya ni Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: So Moses assigned to the tribes of Gad and Reuben and to half the tribe of Manasseh all the territory of King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan, including the towns and the country around them.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mali taali. Yi ŋmanila goon wɔɣinli din tahi bɔɣi, di ku yuui ka di lu n-libigi niriba.
en: You are guilty of these things. So you are like a tall wall with cracks in it. That wall will fall and break into small pieces.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ni chɛ ka n jilima zaa gar a tooni, ka m boli n yuli a tooni, Yawɛ. N ni bɔri ni n niŋ ninvuɣ so nirilim, n ni niŋ o nirilim. N ni lan bɔri ni n zo ninvuɣ so nambɔɣu, n ni zo o nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord answered, I will make all my splendor pass before you and in your presence I will pronounce my sacred name. I am the Lord , and I show compassion and pity on those I choose.

dag: Amaa zom yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu mini dɔɣirikpamba yuya yɛla ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni zabili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni zaligu yɛla polo, dama di nyɛla yoli ni din ka buchi.
en: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.

dag: Sool mini Jɔnatan, n yurinima bɛn veeni yurilim. Bɛ daa bi woligi taba bɛ nyɛviya ni mini bɛ kum ni. Bɛ daa valim gari tɔrili. Bɛ daa mali kpiɔŋ gari gbuɣima.
en: Saul and Jonathan! So well loved, so dearly cherished! In their lives and in their deaths they were never separated. They were faster than eagles, stronger than lions!.

dag: O chɛ ka n naba ŋmanila naba anahilan nyaaŋa naba, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana ka barina shɛli kani.
en: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm. Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo la.
en: Moses, Aaron, and the entire Israelite community carried out for the Levites everything the LORD had commanded Moses. That is what the Israelites did for the Levites.

dag: O ni yih a muɣisigu ni, ka barina shɛli ku shih a saha shɛlikam.
en: Time after time he will save you from harm;.

dag: Ti mini nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa yi Siizaria na n-daa doli taba chaŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti tahi tuuli cheechi nyaandol so ŋun daa nyɛ Saipurus tiŋbia, ka o yuli booni Mneesin la yiŋa ni ti ti gbe nimaani.
en: Some of the followers of Jesus from Caesarea went with us. These followers took us to the home of Mnason, a man from Cyprus, who was one of the first people to be a follower of Jesus. They took us to his home so that we could stay with him.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi zaɣisi li o ni wum di yɛla saha shɛli maa, dindina yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam din yi o nol ni na zaŋ chaŋ o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ku zani; o yidan ni zaɣisi li maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: If her husband breaks them on the day he hears them, then whatever she said with regard to her solemn promises or the binding obligations for herself will not stand. Her husband has broken them. The LORD will forgive her.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ binshɛɣukam ka yiɣisi dol o.
en: Levi got up, left everything behind, and followed him.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa din ni niŋ pa binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la zuɣu mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: carnelians and other jewels to be set in the ephod of the High Priest and in his breastpiece.

dag: Ka di mundili din mali yaa daa leei nam jaaŋgbee, ka daa zooi zuɣusaa tibɔŋ ni, ka di daa niŋ wɔɣilim, ka mali wula pam.
en: Her strong branches became symbols of authority, and she was taller than all other trees— everyone could see how strong and healthy she was.

dag: Vumiya miri Naawuni, ka o mi vu m-miri ya. Yinim alahichinim ŋɔ, paɣimiya yi nuhi; yinim tɛhaayiyinim ŋɔ, malimiya yi suhuri ka di be kasi.
en: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners! Purify your hearts, you hypocrites!.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yiɣisi chaŋ Naa Sulemaana sani ni o ti tɔɣis o di yɛtɔɣa ti Adɔnija. Ka naa daa yiɣisi ti tuh o soli n-damd o tiŋa, ka lab ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ na nti ti naa ma ka o ʒin o nudirigu polo.
en: So Bathsheba went to King Solomon to talk with him. When the king saw her, he stood up, bowed before her, and then sat back down. He told some servants to bring another throne for his mother, and she sat down at his right side.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-su tiŋgbani, ka bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima be di ni.
en: The powerful own land; the favored live in it.

dag: Ka o daa lan yihi wɔr shɛb Juda nanim ni daa zaŋ ti wuntaŋa ka bɛ ʒe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunol ni miri Neetanmɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ zuɣulan la duu din daa be lɔndo ni la, ka daa niŋ buɣim nyo chɛchɛbunsi din daa nyɛ wuntaŋ jɛmbu din la.
en: He also removed the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the worship of the sun, and he burned the chariots used in this worship.

dag: O vooi ma yihi barina bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka firigi ma baɣiri ni. O zaŋ ma tam tampiŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: He lifted me out of the grave. He lifted me from that muddy place. He picked me up, put me on solid ground, and kept my feet from slipping.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ; amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: Whoever says something against the Son of Man can be forgiven. But whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

dag: Yinim tinvura ŋɔ! Yinim garinsi ŋɔ! Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ nti zo n-yi buɣim ni?.
en: You are snakes! You are from a family of poisonous snakes! You will not escape God. You will all be judged guilty and go to hell!.

dag: ka Hashabia daa nyɛ Hilikia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Nɛtanɛl mi daa nyɛ Jɛdaya so mi daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Naa Hɛziɛl yiŋa, ka chɛ ka buɣim di n-saɣim Naa Bɛnhadad ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: So I will send fire upon the palace built by King Hazael and I will burn down the fortresses of King Benhadad.

dag: N daa lan lo ba alikauli ni n ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba, bɛ ni daa nyɛ saamba be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la.
en: I also made my covenant with them, promising to give them the land of Canaan, the land in which they had lived as foreigners.

dag: Ka nandan maa daa ti kpi, ka malaikanim kpuɣ o tahi ti yab Ibrahimma sani. Ka bundan maa gba daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o;.
en: Later, Lazarus died. The angels took him and placed him in the arms of Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried.

dag: Ka bɛ ni bɛn kpalim daa guui tiligi zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn kuɣili la gbini. Ka bɛ daa ŋme n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tusaanu sol ni. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul kariti doli ba hal ni Gidom ti lan ku bɛ ninvuɣ tusaayi.
en: The others turned and ran toward the open country to Rimmon Rock. Five thousand of them were killed on the roads. The Israelites continued to pursue the rest to Gidom, killing two thousand.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa niŋ o shɛlikam zaa kaman anabinim ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm zaa la, ka bɛ daa siɣis o dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi siliga ni.
en: When they finished doing everything that had been written about him, they took him down from the cross and laid him in a tomb.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku nanim maa n-zaŋ ba yili tih anu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa yili tihi maa zuɣu hal ti paai zaawuni.
en: Then Joshua killed the kings and hanged them on five trees, where their bodies stayed until evening.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa zo n-chaŋ Gɛshur Naa Ammihud bia Talimai sani. Ka Naa Dauda daa kul kumd o bia Amnɔn zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: Meanwhile, Absalom had fled and gone to Geshurs King Talmai, Ammihuds son. David mourned for his son a long time.

dag: Bɛ zaa gbibila takɔbiri, bɛ nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ takɔbiri maa baɣi bɛ gbalipina; bɛ malila shili gu yuŋ bimbiɛri.
en: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ niriba zuɣulaannim ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na nti nya ka baŋ alahichi shɛli din tum zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then Saul said to the leaders of the people, Come here and find out what sin was committed today.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa dii tim zuɣuŋmara ni o cham ti ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu na. Ka o daa chaŋ sarika duu nti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: So he sent a soldier to cut off Johns head and bring it to him. The soldier went and cut off Johns head in the prison.

dag: Niriba pam daa nya o ka di gari ba pam. O biɛhigu daa taɣimi, ka o bi ŋmani ninsala.
en: Just as many were appalled by you, he too appeared disfigured, inhuman, his appearance unlike that of mortals.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ piɛbiri piɛla yila kikahi maa ka di kumdi yuui, yinim bɛn nyɛ tɔbbihi maa zaa yin duhimi yi yee n-kul tahiri pampam, di saha tiŋ maa goondaa maa ni kab lu, ka yi zaa kab ti kpe di ni.
en: Have them blow a long blast on the rams horn. As soon as you hear that trumpet blast, have all the people shout out a loud war cry. Then the city wall will collapse, and the people will rise up, attacking straight ahead.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Saimɔn, Saimɔn, Sintani lo nia ni o kpɛhi ya nuu ni yɛli ya kaman bɛ ni yeeni chi shɛm la.
en: Jesus said, Simon, listen to me! Satan has demanded the right to test each one of you, as a farmer does when he separates wheat from the husks.

dag: ni bɛ ti yɛli ŋun Juda naa Hɛzɛkia maa: Di chɛ ka a ni zaŋ amaŋ dalim a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli yɛri ni Asiria naa ku ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Say this to Judahs King Hezekiah: Dont let the God you trust deceive you by saying, Jerusalem wont fall to the Assyrian king.

dag: Ka na so bee zuliya shɛb yi lo ni bɛ yiɣisi zaligu ŋɔ ka saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa, ŋun Naawuni ŋun pii nimaani n-leeg o jɛmbu shee ŋɔ ŋun vuum ba bahi. Man Naa Darius n-zali zaligu ŋɔ. Ka di kpa talahi ni sokam dol li.
en: May the God who chose Jerusalem as the place where he is to be worshiped overthrow any king or nation that defies this command and tries to destroy the Temple there. I, Darius, have commanded. My command is to be fully obeyed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord gave me this message.

dag: Muɣisigu nyabu dali, o ni zaŋ ma sɔɣ o sɔɣisili shee, o ni zaŋ o tanti pili ma; ka zaŋ ma tam tampin shɛli din du zuɣu.
en: He will protect me when I am in danger. He will hide me in his tent. He will take me up to his place of safety.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun paani o daalikauli bɛn ne mini kpiimba sani ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Bɔaz ni! Hal doo maa nyɛla ti dɔɣira ni Yɛlimaŋli.
en: Naomi told her daughter-in-law, The Lord bless him! He has continued showing his kindness to the living as well as the dead. Then Naomi told her daughter-in-law, Boaz is one of our relatives. He is one of our protectors. .

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛli ma, Daadam, pumpɔŋɔ kpuɣim a zuɣu zuɣusaa lihi nuzaa polo. Di saha ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nuzaa polo n-nya ka nyuli zabbu binnani la ʒe sara maligu bimbini nuzaa polo dunoli ni.
en: God spoke to me. He said, Son of man, look toward the north. So I looked, and there, north of the Altar Gate by the entrance, was that statue that made God jealous.

dag: ka Farigudeeriba kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Zakius ka o nyɛ bundana daa be nimaani.
en: A man there named Zacchaeus, a ruler among tax collectors, was rich.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yi nyɛ suhutunanima, amaa chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋ yɛda ka mali suɣilo la biɛhigu, ka di chɛ ka yi nya Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la palibu.
en: We do not want you to become lazy, but to be like those who believe and are patient, and so receive what God has promised.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti a Ba maa ni nyɛ so! Dina ka ti kul bɔra.
en: Philip said, Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.

dag: Zahindi ni mini yuŋ ʒii puuni, saha shɛli gom yi ti gbaai niriba, ka bɛ do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu gbihiri la.
en: In the dream, a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls upon humans, during their slumber on a bed.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi binshɛli din ka daɣiri binshɛli din mali daɣiri ni na? So ku tooi.
en: Who can make pure from impure? Nobody.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ cheechi sɔŋdiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ mali biɛrisuŋ, ka di yɛri naŋgbanvoya ayiyi, ka di bi simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn nyuri dam kuuna bee bɛn suhuri ye liɣiri zuɣu ti yaɣi.
en: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.

dag: Tɔbbia ŋun be tɔbbitali tuma ni bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri bɛn pa tɔbbihi yɛla ni, dama o nia nyɛla ni o tum din tiɣi ŋun kpɛh o tɔbbitali tuma ni maa nini.
en: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni ka ti nyɛ o ni dihiri shɛba, ka nyɛ kaman piɛri be o nuu ni. Di di simdi ni yi wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: He is our God, and we are the people of his pasture, the sheep in his hands. If only you would listen to his voice right now!.

dag: ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba sanna ti yɛli ba.
en: So the Gadites and the Reubenites came and said to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the chiefs of the community.

dag: Kul kpaŋmiya yimaŋ chɛ ka suhudoo be yi mini sokam sunsuuni, ka maliya Naawuni biɛrikasitali din nyɛ nir ni ka shɛli ka ku tooi nya ti Duuma la.
en: Try to live in peace with everyone. And try to keep your lives free from sin. Anyone whose life is not holy will never see the Lord.

dag: N ni yiɣisi labi m ba sani nti yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani.
en: I will get up and go to my father and say, Father, I have sinned against God and against you.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni mini bɛn doli nyaaŋa zaa kuhiri yɛra, Paɣimiya Naawuni! Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: Those in front of him and those following were shouting, Hosanna! Blessings on the one who comes in the name of the Lord!.

dag: Kaman dam din miha ni to noli ni, ka nyɔhi biɛri nimbihi ni shɛm, lala ka vinnyaɣinim gba be bɛ tumalaannim sani.
en: Never get a lazy person to do something for you; he will be as irritating as vinegar on your teeth or smoke in your eyes.

dag: chɛliya ka ti niŋ nimmoo ti suhuri ni niŋ yɛda, ka chɛ ka ti suhuri paɣi neei ka ti yi taali ni ti suhuri ni tɛha puuni, ka su ti niŋgbuna mi ko viɛlli, ka vu m-miri Naawuni.
en: Sprinkled with the blood of Christ, our hearts have been made free from a guilty conscience, and our bodies have been washed with pure water. So come near to God with a sincere heart, full of confidence because of our faith in Christ.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ shɛli n ni wum Naawuni sani, dina ka m mali tɔɣisiri ya ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma maa, amaa Ibrahimma daa bi niŋdi lala.
en: All I have ever done is to tell you the truth I heard from God, yet you are trying to kill me. Abraham did nothing like this!.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa wurim kpe yɔɣu ʒiizaa, ka bɛ doli ba, ka bɛn daa kpi yɔɣu maa ni daa gari bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku shɛba.
en: The fighting spread over the countryside, and more men died in the forest than were killed in battle.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ hal ti paai Zifurɔn, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Hazarɛnan; yi nuzaa polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: Then that border will go to Ziphron and it will end at Hazar Enan. So that will be your northern border.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate asked, Why? What wrong has he done? But the people shouted louder and louder, Kill him on a cross.

dag: Shihir shɛŋa Naawuni ni wuhiri ti mal alahiziba! Alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa o ni tumdi mali yiko pam. Naawuni nam nyɛla nam din ka bahigu, ka o kul ni nyɛ Naa ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: His miracles are mighty and marvelous. He will rule forever, and his kingdom will never end.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n nya saŋmar so ŋun daa yi zuɣusaa lu dunia ni na la, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɔɣ shɛli din ziliŋ ka tariga saafɛbia ti o.
en: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.

dag: Ka di ti kpalimla omaŋmaŋ biyurigu ko, ka o ti bahi tim o gba bɛ sani ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia maa ŋun jilima.
en: The only one left to send was the man's own dear son. Last of all, then, he sent his son to the tenants. I am sure they will respect my son, he said.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi tum a taal shɛli, amaa nyini n-lee tum ma taali a ni lo tɔbu na ni a ti tuhi ma maa zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ sariakarita ŋɔ ni woligi yɛlimaŋli ti Izraɛlnim mini Ammɔnnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: No, I have not done you any wrong. You are doing wrong by making war on me. The Lord is the judge. He will decide today between the Israelites and the Ammonites.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni daa neei so kum ni maa ŋun daa bi pooi.
en: but the one whom God has raised up didnt experience deaths decay.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan kahig o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa wuhi, ka yo o ni tum taal shɛli maa samli zaa, ka lan yo di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi n-zaŋ li ti o ni tum so taali maa.
en: Such persons will confess the sin they have done. Each will make payment for his guilt, add one-fifth more, and give it to the injured party.

dag: Goli ni ti nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ la, ka wuntaŋ neesim mi ti laɣim ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-nyɛ kaman daba ayopɔin neesim din leei dahin yini dini. Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti niŋla dahin shɛli Yawɛ yi ti tib o ni ti o niriba dan shɛl la.
en: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mali bɛ buɣili Dagɔn; ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Ti buɣili n-zaŋ ti dim Samsin niŋ ti nuu ni maa.
en: The Philistine kings met together to celebrate and offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon. They sang, Our god has given us victory over our enemy Samson.

dag: Liya bihi daa nyɛla Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bituuli la mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: The sons of Leah were Reuben , Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

dag: Amaa n ku vuui n yurilim maŋli la ka chɛ o bee n-yi n ʒiɛyimtali nyaaŋa.
en: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.

dag: Di saɣi n-wum niriba ni fiɣisi toondana n-yɛli shɛm naɣila niriba ata bee ayi n-di li shɛhira.
en: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.

dag: Amaa ka Nadab mini Abihu daa ti zaŋ buɣim din bi viɛla n-nyo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ka kpi.
en: Nadab and Abihu died when they made an unauthorized offering to the LORD.

dag: Ka di mi bi simdi ni ti Duuma tumtumda ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni. Di naɣ simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun mali nirilim zaŋ chaŋ sokam sani, ka nyɛ karimba suŋ ni ŋun mali suɣilo.
en: As a servant of the Lord, you must not argue. You must be kind to everyone. You must be a good teacher, and you must be patient.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda gba daa yiɣisi voli maa ni yina nti kuhi boli Naa Sool, N dan naa! Ka Sool daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka Dauda damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: Later, David came out of the cave and called out to Saul, My lord the king! Saul looked back. David bowed with his face to the ground to show his respect.

dag: ni zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbihi ni sariakaritiba ni anabinima ni baɣisi ni kpamba.
en: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers.

dag: Mbusim din be kaman kokpɛɣu la vuri niŋdi ma, ka a kɔgbana zaa min a kopaliga kana ti du ma gari.
en: Deep called to deep at the noise of your waterfalls; all your massive waves surged over me.

dag: Ti bi yo ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; yinima n-naɣ yo yi suhuri zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: It is not we who have closed our hearts to you; it is you who have closed your hearts to us.

dag: yɛra, Saha paaya, ka Naawuni nam gba mirina; dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba ka niŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛda.
en: The right time has come, he said, and the Kingdom of God is near! Turn away from your sins and believe the Good News.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla a niriba, a mi ni su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa nyɛla n niriba, ka n nyari jilima bɛ sani.
en: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And my glory is seen in them.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked the Lord , Should I attack the Philistines? Will you let me win? The Lord told David, Attack! I will let you win.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yuri mini chɛchɛbumbariba ni tɔbutuhiriba ni tɔbbihi balibu kam n yiŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Satisfy yourselves at my table with horses and riders, mighty men and every warrior. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: A ba Naawuni ni sɔŋ a. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa mi a. O ni chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgbani puuni na a zuɣu. O ni ti a bihi mini niɣi pam.
en: by God, your father, who supports you, by the Almighty who blesses you with blessings from the skies above and blessings from the deep sea below, blessings from breasts and womb.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa lo o nia biɛɣu. Ka naa daa bahi ba noli ka bɛ lab kuɣa ku o Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni.
en: But the people plotted against Zechariah, and at the kings command stoned him to death in the courtyard of the LORDs temple.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la.
en: They made the ephod of fine linen; blue, purple, and red wool; and gold thread.

dag: Gbib a yɛda niŋbu min a suhu ni tɛha ka di ku mali galimi. Ninvuɣ shɛb ni bi doli suhu ni tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni wuhi shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ yɛda niŋbu saɣim.
en: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.

dag: Ka Saimɔn kuhi yɛli, Suhim ti Duuma ti ma, ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa miligi n zuɣu.
en: Simon replied, All of you, please, plead to the Lord for me so that nothing of what you have said will happen to me.

dag: O wurindi wɔɣira ka bi vihiri ba, ka zaŋdi shɛb zaani bɛ zaani.
en: He shatters the mighty without examining them; makes others take their place.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi nahindi n niriba ka diri tarimba zuɣu nyɔri? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n yɛli lala maa.
en: You have no right to crush my people and take advantage of the poor. I, the Sovereign Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Ɛlishama ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara maa duu maa ni, ka kpe naa dundɔŋ ni nti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa zaa yɛli naa.
en: The officials put the scroll in the room of Elishama, the court secretary, and went to the king's court, where they reported everything to the king.

dag: Aduna ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisiri Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lihi tiŋgban nɛli polo n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima yi zahira sagban ni.
en: As Aaron spoke to the whole Israelite community, they turned to look toward the desert, and just then the glorious presence of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

dag: Amaa m mi a ni ʒiini shɛm min a ni yiri shɛm ni a ni labiri kpɛri shɛm ni a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu shɛm yɛla.
en: But I know everything about you, what you do and where you go. I know how you rage against me.

dag: Daadam, wula ka tuŋ din be tibɔŋ ni wulli lee yɛn tooi gari tia wulli tibɔŋ maa ni?.
en: Human one, how is the vines wood better than the wood of all the trees in the forest?.

dag: Salo daa yiɣisi zani n nudirigu polo, bɛ daa kari ma bahi, ka ŋma n kubu pala sɔŋ.
en: They attack me on my right side. They knock my feet out from under me. They build ramps to attack and destroy me like a city.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ti zaŋ tihi maa da shɛŋa m-mali buɣim wuɣisi; ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim she bɔrɔbɔro. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ di shɛŋa mali wuna mini binnana zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li.
en: When the man wanted a fire, he took some of the wood to keep him warm. He also used some of it to bake his bread. But then he used that same wood to make a statue to worship as a god! That god is only a statue that he made, but he bows down to it!.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla ʒiŋmabo gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim mi zaŋ yɔhiŋ gili ma. Amaa Naawuni na mi Judanim yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe Ŋun be Kasi la yim.
en: The Lord says, The people of Israel have surrounded me with lies and deceit, and the people of Judah are still rebelling against me, the faithful and holy God.

dag: dama o kanna ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O ni ti doli wuntia soli kari dunianim saria, O ni ti zaŋ yɛlimaŋli soli kari niriba saria.
en: because he comes to rule the earth. He will rule the peoples of the world with justice and fairness.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka mahim tirisi yaɣi dunɔdura shɛŋa Ahaz ni daa me la dura pia zuɣu lab nyaaŋa. Ka wuntaŋ daa shiri tirisi lab nyaaŋa dunɔdura pia maa.
en: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps.

dag: Hal bɛmaŋmaŋ nam puuni min a ni niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli pam shɛl la puuni ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn tital shɛli din mali kulim ti ba la zaa yoli, bɛ daa zaɣis a jɛmbu, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: Our ancestors didnt serve you even when they were living in their own kingdom. They didnt stop doing evil. They enjoyed all the wonderful things you gave them. They enjoyed the rich land and had plenty of room, but they didnt stop their evil ways.

dag: ni Humta ni Kiriatariba ni Ziɔr: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara awɛi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Humtah, Hebron, and Zior: nine cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka yili shɛli din pɔri ka ku tooi ŋubi piɛbila muni naai, bɛn chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn baɣi ba laɣim bo piɛbil yino, di simdi ka bɛ pirigi piɛbil maa saɣisi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn ŋub o kalinli.
en: If there are not enough people in his house to eat a whole lamb, then he should invite some of his neighbors to share the meal. There must be enough lamb for everyone to eat.

dag: Ka Maata tizo so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la daa chaŋ ti ʒini Yisa tooni wumd o yɛtɔɣa;.
en: She had a sister named Mary. Mary was sitting at Jesus feet and listening to him teach.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee kpahimi bɛ zuɣu ni, ka wuhi ba na so ŋun ti yɛn su ba biɛhigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ sani.
en: So listen to the people and do what they say. But give them a warning. Tell the people what a king will do to them. Tell them how a king rules people.

dag: amaa bɛ ku chaŋ tooni, dama sokam ni nya bɛ jɛritali tuma kaman bɛ ni daa nya niriba ayi ŋɔ jɛritali tuma shɛm la.
en: But they will not succeed in what they are trying to do. Everyone will see how foolish they are. That is what happened to Jannes and Jambres.

dag: O ni daa be o ma pul ni, o daa gbaala o jabil kpee napɔŋkpaa; ka o ni daa ti bi doo, o daa vala Naawuni.
en: From the womb he tried to be the oldest of twin brothers; as an adult he struggled with God.

dag: Niriba yɛri a yurilim maŋli yɛla gballi ni? Bee a ʒiɛyimtali tumdi tuma saɣiŋgu shee?.
en: Is your constant love spoken of in the grave or your faithfulness in the place of destruction?.

dag: Dama n yi be, Masia n-nyɛ n nyɛvili, ka m mi yi kpi, di nyɛla din so.
en: Because for me, living serves Christ and dying is even better.

dag: O daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He led the people of Israel out of Egypt; his love is eternal;.

dag: O bi galisi gari ma yili ŋɔ puuni, o mi bi mɔŋ ma shɛli naɣila nyini, dama a nyɛla o paɣa; ka wula ka n ni tooi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuun titali ŋɔ n-tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani.
en: No one in my master's house is more important than I am. The only thing he hasn't given me is you, and that's because you are his wife. I won't sin against God by doing such a terrible thing as this.

dag: Mɔabnim yudua la naaya. Bɛ lo ba zaɣ biɛɣu Hɛshibɔn. Kamiyana ka ti wurim li, ka di ku lan beni. Ka nyini yinyahi tiŋ ŋɔ gba, bɛ ni ti chɛ ka a fo. Takɔb ni ti dol a.
en: No one sings Moabs praise any longer! In Heshbon they are hatching a plot against her: Come, lets bring down the nation! You too, Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.

dag: nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni, ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba;.
en: then listen to their prayers. In your home in heaven hear them and be merciful to them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Gaad zuliya yuya yinoyino kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Gad, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: Ka o yi shini, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi galim o? Ka o yi zaŋ o nini sɔɣi, ninvuɣ so beni ŋun ni tooi nya o? Amaa ŋuna n-su daadamnim mini zuliya kam zaa.
en: But if God decides not to help them, no one can judge him guilty. If he hides himself, no one can find him. He is the ruler over every person and nation.

dag: Dama Yisa ni daa be Galili la, bɛna n-daa dol o ka sɔŋd o; ka paɣiba pam bɛn daa dol o na hal ni Jɛrusalɛm la gba beni.
en: When Jesus was in Galilee, these women had followed and supported him, along with many other women who had come to Jerusalem with him.

dag: Yi duri zoya din du pam zuɣu nti maani maligu, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni nimaani.
en: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: Ahimaaz spoke to Joab again, No matter what happens, I still want to go. And besides, the Ethiopian has already left. Joab said, Why should you go? You won't get a reward for the news you have.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni bɔri ni yi nya shihirili din wuhiri ni Masia yiko ni ka n tɔɣisirila zuɣu. Masia pala ninvuɣ gbariŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhir o yiko yi sunsuuni.
en: You want proof that Christ is speaking through me. My proof is that he is not weak in dealing with you but is showing his power among you.

dag: Tuumba bɛn ʒe yim ŋmanila atam kpuɣibu saha sakuɣili din maai bɛ kpamba sani; bɛ chɛ ka bɛn tim ba suhuri maara.
en: To his master who sent him, a messenger who can be trusted is as refreshing as a drink of cold water on a hot summer day.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo a dabili Dauda alikauli shɛli maa niŋ pali.
en: So now, Lord God of Israel, let everything come true that you promised to your servant David.

dag: ka zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: in the third row, a turquoise, an agate, and an amethyst;.

dag: Yi tiŋ dunoli ti ku yo n-kpari yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa, dama tinzun nanim ni gari tooni n-zaŋ bɛ niriba ka bɛ ʒi bɛ daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: Your gates will be open continually; day and night they wont close, to bring to you the wealth of nations, and their kings led in procession.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛl o, Ti ni doli solɔɣu maa gari; ka ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri yi nyu yi kom, ti ni yo di zuɣu; ti ni kul bɔri shɛli nyɛla yi chɛ ka ti kana ti gari.
en: Moses sent back this message: We promise to stay on the main road, and if any of us or our livestock drink your water, we will pay for it. We just want to pass through.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kari ma a sani? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma?.
en: Why do you reject me, Lord ? Why do you turn away from me?.

dag: Ti mabihi, yi daa nya wahala mi kaman Naawuni cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la niriba bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Yi daa nya alaka yimaŋmaŋ zuliya sani mi kaman bɛ gba ni daa nya alaka Yɛhudianim sani shɛm.
en: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.

dag: O ni daa kul kpuɣ o nuu maa tiri saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la dii vaai yiɣisi bɛ dooshee ti kpe tiŋ maa ni n-deei li ka niŋ buɣim nyo li yomyom bahi.
en: the soldiers who had been hiding jumped up and ran into the town. They captured it and set it on fire.

dag: dama a ni nya ka wum shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu a ni niŋ o shɛhiralana sokam zaa sani.
en: You will be his witness to everyone concerning what you have seen and heard.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa maa o gbaɣino min o nyɔtaɣirigu tuɣibu shee, di saha ka o daa yɛli tɔbbi so ŋun daa duhir o chɛchɛbuŋ maa, Ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni, dama n nya daŋa. .
en: Then a soldier pulled back on his bow and shot an arrow into the air. By chance it hit the king of Israel between two pieces of his armor. King Ahab said to his chariot driver, Ive been hit! Turn the chariot around and take me off the battlefield.

dag: A yɛm min a baŋsim maa ka a zaŋ bo buni ti amaŋa, ka laɣisi salima min anzinfa niŋ a daazichi duri ni.
en: Your wisdom has certainly made you rich, because you have storehouses filled with gold and silver.

dag: Cham ti sab niŋ litaafi ni zali wuhi niriba maa ni nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri shɛm; ka di ti di ba shɛhira sahakam.
en: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, inscribe it on a scroll, so in the future it will endure as a witness.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa lan yɛli, Wummiya sariakarita bilikɔɣindan maa ni daa yɛli shɛm.
en: And the Lord continued, Listen to what that corrupt judge said.

dag: ka yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Ti ni chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni m-puɣisi nya li maa tiŋgbani viɛli pam.
en: These two men said to all the Israelites gathered there, The land that we saw is very good.

dag: Amaa ka farigudeera maa ʒe o ko ha, ka bi saɣi ni o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka naɣ kul malila o nuhi bur o nyɔɣu ka yɛra, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, zom man alahichilan ŋɔ nambɔɣu.
en: But the tax collector stood at a distance. He wouldnt even lift his eyes to look toward heaven. Rather, he struck his chest and said, God, show mercy to me, a sinner.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa teei o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la, ka yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla puɣisiriba, yi kamina ni yi ti nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He remembered the dreams he had dreamed about them and said, You are spies; you have come to find out where our country is weak.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti zaŋ ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri ni ti yiya m-pa talima din ni chɛ ka ti nya chi.
en: Others said, We have had to mortgage our fields and vineyards and houses to get enough grain to keep us from starving.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa mini daŋ kam ni kpamba Jɛrusalɛm na ni bɛ ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la Dauda tiŋ din nyɛ Ziɔn la ni na.
