en: Solomon commanded the elders of Israel, the leaders of the tribes, and the heads of families to meet together in Jerusalem. He did this so that they could bring the Box of the Lord s Agreement up to the Temple from the City of David, that is, Zion.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nahiri tintarisi vulɔnima, ka fari biŋkɔbbaligu n-zaŋdi ba chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri bɛmaŋmaŋ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: People move boundary stones, herd flocks theyve stolen.

dag: Amaa Musa mini maligumaana Aduna ni daa pun sab Izraɛlnim shɛb yuya Sinai mɔɣu ni la so daa ka bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya ŋɔ kalinli maa ni.
en: There was not even one man left among those whom Moses and Aaron had listed in the first census in the Sinai Desert.

dag: Isaka bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tola mini Pua ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi.
en: Issachar had four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.

dag: Masia dapulli zuɣu kum puuni ka o daa kpihim dimdi din be ti sunsuuni la, ka zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba leei zaɣ yini n-zaŋ ba labisi Naawuni sani.
en: By his death on the cross Christ destroyed their enmity; by means of the cross he united both races into one body and brought them back to God.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛla nimaani, ka naa ŋmaligi bɛ polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: King Solomon turned around and blessed all the Israelites gathered in front of him.

dag: Ka o ba maa yɛl o, M bia, nyin kul bela n sani sahakam; ka n ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a dini.
en: His father said to him, Oh, my son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Yɛhudianim kpamba la zuɣu ka so daa bi saɣi tɔɣis o yɛla palɔni.
en: But no one was brave enough to talk about him openly. They were afraid of the Jewish leaders.

dag: A ni ti nya suhupiɛlli ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, ka niriba pam gba suhuri ti paligi bia maa dɔɣibu zuɣu;.
en: His birth will make you very happy, and many people will be glad.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun pa a niriba Izraɛlnim ni yino yi ti yi katiŋ na a yuli zuɣu.
en: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple.

dag: Ishitɔn daa nyɛla Bɛtirafa mini Pasia ni Tɛhina ba, ka Tɛhina mi daa nyɛ Irinahash ba, bɛna n-nyɛ Rɛkanima.
en: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, Ir-nahashs father. These are the men of Recah.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba tiŋ maa puuni Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad.
en: He sent messengers into the city to King Ahab of Israel to say, King Benhadad demands that.

dag: N tarigimi do tiŋa; tim ma nyɛvili palli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I lie here like a dying man. Say the word, and I will live again.

dag: Amaa zaawuni yi ti paai, ŋun sum kom, ka wuntaŋ yi ti lu, o ni tooi lan labi sansani maa ni na.
en: Toward evening he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may come back into camp.

dag: Yɛlim bɛnkam suhuri zɔhiri la, Maliya kpiɔŋ ka di zɔriya dabiɛm! Yi Naawuni maa yɛn kamina ti bɔhi yi dimnim biɛri tin ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: Say to those who are panicking: Be strong! Dont fear! Heres your God, coming with vengeance; with divine retribution God will come to save you.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa chaŋ Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, N dana, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ a tibili ni, a mi di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi mani a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, dama a ŋmanila Firawuna maŋmaŋa.
en: Then Judah went to Joseph and said, Sir, please let me speak plainly with you. Please dont be angry with me. I know that you are like Pharaoh himself.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila! Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi ti naa maa. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila!.
en: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our king! Sing praises.

dag: dama nyama, a shiri ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Miri ka a ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ piliŋ shih o zuɣu ni, dama bia maa ti yɛn nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani o dɔɣibu ni zaŋ chana. Ka o ni ti piligi n-fari Izraɛlnim Filistianim nuu ni bahira.
en: because you are pregnant and will give birth to a son. Dont allow a razor to shave his head, because the boy is going to be a nazirite for God from birth. Hell be the one who begins Israels rescue from the power of the Philistines.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kpa viɛl shɛli mini wain viɛla zaa ni chi ni bindiri daŋda shɛŋa zaa ti man Yawɛ, n zaŋ li tin ya.
en: All the choice oil, new wine, and the grains first harvest that they give to the LORD, Im giving to you.

dag: ka bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka paŋdi niriba liɣiri ka bi niŋdi ba nyɔri bee m-bɔri nyɔri pam ti yaɣi, ka doli n zaligunima ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam, o ku kpi o ba tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: He refuses to do evil and doesn't lend money for profit. He keeps my laws and obeys my commands. He will not die because of his father's sins, but he will certainly live.

dag: Ka ŋunkam siɣis omaŋ leei kaman bibil ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

dag: ni ŋun saɣisiri jɛra ni bihi karimba, ka di nyɛla a ni mi ni baŋsim mini yɛlimaŋli zaa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni zuɣu.
en: You think you can show foolish people what is right. And you think you are a teacher for those who are just beginning to learn. You have the law, and so you think you know everything and have all truth.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli maa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi puri atam mini yi ni tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ni. Ka di simdi ni yi shiri puhi chuɣu maa.
en: Celebrate this festival for seven days at the special place the Lord will choose. Do this to honor the Lord your God. The Lord your God blessed your harvest and all the work you did, so be very happy!.

dag: Ka di yi pa yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni nini ku tiɣi nira. Dama ŋunkam chaŋ Naawuni sani, di niŋ kamaata ni o niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni beni ka deeri bɛn bɔr o ni bɛ suhuri zaa suhigu.
en: Its impossible to please God without faith because the one who draws near to God must believe that he exists and that he rewards people who try to find him.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi zaɣisi li o ni wum di yɛla saha shɛli maa, dindina yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam din yi o nol ni na zaŋ chaŋ o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ku zani; o yidan ni zaɣisi li maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: But if her husband forbids her to fulfill the vow when he hears about it, she is not required to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband prevented her from keeping her vow.

dag: Bɛ tirila pagɔra zaa liɣiri, amaa nyini n-lee tiri a mamanim zaa pina ni bɛ yi luɣilikam zaa kana a pagɔrisigu tuma maa zuɣu.
en: Ordinary prostitutes are given gifts, but you gave your gifts to all your lovers. From every direction you even bribed them to come to you for your sexual favors.

dag: Di saha ka Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la daa zaŋ bɛ tulaale zim tuɣindi bina m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ buɣim din bi be kasi mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di pa o ni wuhi ba shɛm.
en: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.

dag: A yi kpahi ninvuɣ so ŋun tahiri woligibu na zuɣu ni yim nti lan pahi buyi ka o bi taɣi, nyin di lan kal o pahi yi kalinli ni.
en: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Then Moses killed the ram. He sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

dag: O kpee ka dunia ni, o nyɛla binnɛɔŋ ŋun bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: No animal on earth is like him. He is an animal made without fear.

dag: Atarɔt mini Dibɔn ni Jaza ni Nimira ni Hɛshibɔn ni Ɛliale ni Siibam ni Nɛbo ni Bɛɔn.
en: Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon is.

dag: Doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya so shɛŋa la zaa din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣila tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ti yɛn su maa ni.
en: You must live the way the Lord your God commanded you. Then you will continue to live, and everything will be fine with you. You will live a long life in the land that will belong to you.

dag: Kaman salima baŋa ni be kuruchu nyee ni shɛm, lala n-nyɛ paɣ viɛlli ŋun ka yɛm.
en: A beautiful woman without good sense is like a gold ring in a pigs nose.

dag: Kalim bɛn zaa nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni.
en: and to register all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who were qualified to work in the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ dari maa pirigili m-mali buɣim she nimdi ŋubi tiɣi; ka lan zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim wuɣisi ka yɛra, Buɣim ŋɔ wuɣisibu kpe ma nyaɣisim, di kpe n kɔba ni.
en: With some of the wood he makes a fire; he roasts meat, eats it, and is satisfied. He warms himself and says, How nice and warm! What a beautiful fire.

dag: Ka Pita daa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti kurim lihi di puuni n-nya ka kahiŋga kɔŋko n-doya; ka o ŋmaligi kuna, ka bɔhir o suhu din niŋ maa zuɣu.
en: But Peter ran to the tomb. When he bent over to look inside, he saw only the linen cloth. Then he returned home, wondering what had happened.

dag: Kum maa ni daa ti mii Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa saha shɛli, ka niriba daa kuhiri niŋdi Firawuna ni o tim ba bindira. Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Ijiptinim zaa, Chamiya Yisifu sani, o yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛli, yin niŋmiya li.
en: When the famine finally struck Egypt, the people asked the king for food, but he said, Go to Joseph and do what he tells you to do.

dag: ni bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋɔri maha shɛŋa din ka dabindi ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka bɛ niŋ kpam pa di zuɣu. Zaŋmi alikama zim viɛlli mali di zaa.
en: Use the best wheat flour, but no yeast, and make some bread with olive oil, some without it, and some in the form of thin cakes brushed with oil.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan kana ti yɛli, Naawuni buɣim n-yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku piɛri la mini piɛguliba la zaa, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: That messenger was still speaking when another one came in and said, A bolt of lightning struck your sheep and servants and burned them up. I am the only one who escaped to come and tell you the news.

dag: Man Pool n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so shɛb ni yɛli ni n siɣisiri mmaŋa n yi ti be yi sani, amaa ka lee ti ka yi sani ka wuhiri dɔbilim la. N suhiri ya Masia tarimtali min o baalimtali puuni.
en: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa mali Shɛkɛm din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni la me m-be nimaani; ka daa ti lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti me Pɛnuɛl.
en: Jeroboam rebuilt the city of Shechem, in the hill country of Ephraim, and lived there. Later he went to the city of Penuel and rebuilt it.

dag: Amaa nir yi yuri ka ku o kpee, yin zaŋmiya dilana sara maligu bimbini gbini n-yi kpaŋ ti ku o.
en: But when someone gets angry and deliberately kills someone else, he is to be put to death, even if he has run to my altar for safety.

dag: N daa jɛmdi ti Duuma ni maŋsiɣisibu mini nintam m-pahi muɣisigu shɛŋa n ni daa nyari Yɛhudianim ni daa dooni guri ma sol la zuɣu.
en: The Jews planned things against me, and this gave me much trouble. But you know that I always served the Lord, sometimes with tears. I never thought about myself first.

dag: amaa Nɛria bia Baruk n-wuhir a yikombiɛlim zaŋ chaŋ ti polo ni yi zaŋ ti niŋ Babilɔnnim nuu ni, ka bɛ ku ti bee n-gbahi ti daba zaŋ ti kuli Babilɔn.
en: Baruch son of Neriah must have told you to say that. He wants the Babylonians to capture us, so they can take us away to Babylonia or even kill us.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi ni binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa ni zahim bɛn be teeku ni zaa ni zɔri ya. N zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Every animal on earth, every bird in the air, every animal that crawls on the ground, and every fish in the sea will be afraid of you. All of them will be under your control.

dag: Naftali zuliya n-daa pah ayɔbu n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The sixth assignment made was for the families of the tribe of Naphtali.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be Damaskus daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: When the Syrians of Damascus sent an army to help King Hadadezer, David attacked it and killed twenty-two thousand men.

dag: dama n ni ti a jilima pam. Ka a yi yɛli ni n niŋm shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li; kul kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu ti ma. .
en: for Ill greatly honor you and Ill do anything you ask of me. Please come and curse this people for me.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi tiŋ dunɔdali gbini ni zuri so nyaaŋa, ka danyuriba zaŋ ma niŋ yila ni yiina.
en: They talk about me in the streets, and drunkards make up songs about me.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini niriba maa daa lo alikauli dindali maa; ka o daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn doli Shɛkɛm.
en: So Joshua made a covenant for the people that day, and there at Shechem he gave them laws and rules to follow.

dag: Amaa bumbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi bidib tuuli kam, ka so miri ka o ti ka n sanna ni nu zaŋa.
en: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.

dag: ka yi lula ŋun ye binyɛr suma la sizuura ka yɛl o, N dana, ʒinim ʒiishe viɛlli ŋɔ ni; ka ŋmaligi yɛli nandan la ŋuna, Ʒe nimaani bee kamina nti ʒin tiŋa n naba ŋɔ shee.
en: You show special attention to the person wearing nice clothes. You say, Sit here in this good seat. But you say to the poor person, Stand there! or Sit on the floor by our feet.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa niŋ o nu yin ni, ka kpuɣi zali niŋ o nudirigu ni n-zaŋ tanti kpaa maa ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋa.
en: She reached out her hand for the stake, her strong hand for the workers hammer. She struck Sisera; she crushed his head; she shattered and pierced his skull.

dag: Zaŋm a nuhi shih o, ka tɛhi a min o ni yɛn va shɛm, a ku lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: Touch him once and you'll never try it again; you'll never forget the fight!.

dag: So miri ka o ti zaŋ o ma dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa ka nyɛ o ma, di bi simdi ni o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: Do not disgrace your father by having intercourse with your mother. You must not disgrace your own mother.

dag: Tɔb tuhibu vuri be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka saɣiŋgu pam be nimaani.
en: The noise of battle can be heard all over the country. It is the noise of much destruction.

dag: Aai, m bia! Aai, m pul ni bia! Aai, n nɔpoli bia!.
en: You are my own dear son, the answer to my prayers. What shall I tell you?.

dag: Amaa ka o ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaŋ li niŋ asahi, ka bɛ ni yino zaŋ kpa o puu polo, ka yino chaŋ o tuma shee.
en: But when the servants told the people to come, they refused to listen. They all went to do other things. One went to work in his field, and another went to his business.

dag: Ka nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro maa shɛli yi guui, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: If any of the meat or bread is left, burn it.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu bee piɛɣu ŋun mali daŋ mini binshɛɣukam din bi niŋ kamaata mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din chihiri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Dont sacrifice to the LORD your God any oxen or sheep that have defects of any kind, because that is detestable to the LORD your God.

dag: O gbarigi n yaa m biɛhigu puuni, ka filim n dabisa.
en: I should still be strong, but you, Lord , have made an old person of me.

dag: Daba ayɔbu ka yi ni zaŋ tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili titali, ka nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di bi simdi ni yi tum tuma dindali, di nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Work can be done for six days, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of special rest, a holy occasion. You must not do any work on it; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD.

dag: Ka daa yɛli sapashini ni o zaŋm Pool ti kpɛhi duu, amaa ka lee wɔɣis o, ka chɛ ka o zɔnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋd o kan o sanna.
en: He ordered the officer in charge of Paul to keep him under guard, but to give him some freedom and allow his friends to provide for his needs.

dag: Giliad nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ kubo kul pali nimaani.
en: Gilead is a city of wicked people, tracked with blood.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: the same laws and regulations apply to you and to them.

dag: Bɛ ni di nasara bɛ tuma ni, ka alɔbo ku di bɛ bihi. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: The work they do will be successful, and their children will not meet with disaster. I will bless them and their descendants for all time to come.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan bidibiga daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal, ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathans son was Merib Baal. Merib Baal was Micahs father.

dag: Mani yi Duuma Naawuni yɛliya, n ni ku Ashidɔdnima, ka ku Ashikɛlɔn naa. N ni darigi Ɛkurɔn tibili, ka chɛ ka Filistianim bɛn kpalim zaa kpi.
en: I will remove the rulers of the cities of Ashdod and Ashkelon. I will punish the city of Ekron, and all the Philistines who are left will die.

dag: zaŋ Nɛgɛb mini bɔpiɛligu din nyɛ Jɛriko vinvamli, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din mali dɔbino tihi la hal ni Zɔa.
en: also the arid southern plain, and the plain—including the Jericho Valley, Palm City—as far as Zoar.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni lan kpalim be alizanda ni hal ka binshɛɣukam zaa ti niŋ pali kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ do shɛb bɛn bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn bi kuli dɔb la yɛla polo, n ka zaligu shɛli din yi ti Duuma sanna, amaa n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so bɛ ni ni niŋ naani ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo puuni la zuɣu, n ni yɛli ya n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.

dag: Naawuni, a zaɣisi ti ka lu ti zuɣu; a je suli niŋ ti. Labisim ti zali yaha!.
en: God, you were angry with us. You rejected us and destroyed our defenses. Please make us strong again.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa zaa daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa kul o yiŋa ni o ti suhi alibarika niŋ o yiŋnim ni.
en: After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti ŋmaai bihili, ka o bo yuma ata naɣilaa mini zim din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pia ni wain gaɣili pali m-pahi bia maa zuɣu chaŋ Shilo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bia maa daa na nyɛla ŋun pɔra.
en: When the boy was old enough to eat solid food, Hannah took him to the Lord s house at Shiloh. She also took a bull that was three years old, pounds of flour, and a bottle of wine.

dag: Jɔpa mini Lida ni daa bi wɔɣ ni tab zuɣu ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa wum ni Pita be Lida ka tim niriba ayi o sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni bɛ bɔri ni o ka bɛ sanna yomyom.
en: Since Lydda was near Joppa, when the disciples heard that Peter was there, they sent two people to Peter. They urged, Please come right away.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Mɛrari zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Also, the men in the families and family groups of the Merari family were counted.

dag: ka ti mi yi ye li, di ni chɛ ka ti ku be ti zaɣim.
en: It will clothe us and we will not be naked.

dag: Ka o ni ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: He will send the angels out to the four corners of the earth to gather God's chosen people from one end of the world to the other.

dag: Amaa ka Barizillai daa yɛli, Yuma ala ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ dunia yili ŋɔ, ka lan doli nyin naa kuni Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: But Barzillai said to the king, How many years do I have left that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan zaŋ ʒim mihi tanti Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mini binshɛlikam bɛ ni daa mali tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma.
en: And in the same way he sprinkled the meeting tent and also all the equipment that would be used in the priests service with blood.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu daa dii kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni na nti kuhi bɔhi.
en: Suddenly, there in the synagogue, a person with an evil spirit screamed.

dag: N niriba, kpɛmiya yi duri ka yo yi dunoya. Sɔɣimiya ka di tooi biɛla ha, ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa saha gari.
en: Go into your houses, my people, and shut the door behind you. Hide yourselves for a little while until God's anger is over.

dag: Maligumaanitali tuma yi taɣi, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni zaligu gba taɣi.
en: When the order of the priest changes, there has to be a change in the Law as well.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na nti zaŋ ba kpɛhi anabi Igidalia bia Hanan bidibisi duu din daa miri kpambaliba duu ka be Shallum bia Maasɛya ŋun daa su dunoli fukumsi la duu zuɣusaa la.
en: and brought them to the Temple. I took them into the room of the disciples of the prophet Hanan son of Igdaliah. This room was above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum, an important official in the Temple, and near the rooms of the other officials.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa labi ti yɛl o dana maa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Ka o daa je suli pam, ka yɛl o yiŋbia maa ni o yim yom doli solɔri mini sobihi m-boli nandaamba mini wɔbisi ni zoomba mini gbariti na.
en: The servant told his master what happened, and the master became so angry he said, Go as fast as you can to every street and alley in town! Bring in everyone who is poor or paralyzed or blind or lame.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli nimaani yuli Masa ni Mɛriba, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ o taali, ka daa lan zahim Yawɛ yɛra, Amii Yawɛ be ti sani bee o kani.
en: The place was named Massah and Meribah, because the Israelites complained and put the Lord to the test when they asked, Is the Lord with us or not.

dag: O gbaai ma n soli zuɣu chaŋ ti dari tɔhi ma. O chɛ ka m bahi yoli.
en: He chased me off the road, tore me to pieces, and left me.

dag: Jɛhɔram ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba, ka bo bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: In Jehorams time, Edom broke away from under Judahs authority. The people of Edom chose their own king.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mini sapashim bihi bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi daa ka Musa sanna.
en: The commanders over the thousands of the army, officers over thousands and officers over hundreds, approached Moses.

dag: Ka o ti bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti ti maligumaana din nyɛ o taali sanyoo Yawɛ sani, ka a zahim o daa ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ taali sanyoo polo.
en: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong.

dag: N yi ti zaŋ bindiripooli din nyɛ m peenzala la to a, piɛma din kuri niriba ka n yɛn zaŋ to a ku a, ka chɛ ka bindiripooli kul luri a zuɣu mɔŋ a bindirigu.
en: I will cut off your supply of food and let you starve. You will feel the pains of hunger like sharp arrows sent to destroy you.

dag: ka zuɣusaa niriba daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛl pam, ka bɛ daa pii bɛ ni bɔri bɛ ni shɛba n-leei bɛ paɣiba.
en: some of the heavenly beings saw that these young women were beautiful, so they took the ones they liked.

dag: Ka saha daa ti paai ka Yisa min o tuumba maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: When the time came for Jesus and the apostles to eat.

dag: Amaa bɛn sani, di ni ti ŋmanila ʒiri baɣiri, bɛ pun po pɔri, amaa ŋun teeri ba la bɛ taali ni nyɛ shɛli ni di chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: The people of Jerusalem won't believe this because of the treaties they have made. But this prediction is to remind them of their sins and to warn them that they will be captured.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu mini m balima ŋɔ; a yuli zuɣu ŋmaligim a nini lihi nya a jɛmbu duu la ni wurim doya shɛm.
en: But now, our God, listen to your servants prayer and pleas for help. Shine your face on your ruined sanctuary, for your own sake, my Lord.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pɛlɛt mini Zaza. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛramiil daŋ niriba.
en: Jonathans sons were Peleth and Zaza. This was the list of Jerahmeels children.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, man Nɛbukadnɛza paɣiri alizanda Naa, ka tir o jilima; ka tibigir o. O ni tumdi shɛlikam zaa nyɛla din tuhi mini yɛlimaŋli, ka o ni tooi siɣisi ŋunkam mali karimbaani.
en: And now, I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise, honor, and glorify the King of Heaven. Everything he does is right and just, and he can humble anyone who acts proudly.

dag: Amaa ka Nabɔt yɛli Ɛhab, Yawɛ di wuhi gba, ka n zaŋ n yaannim fali ti a.
en: Naboth responded to Ahab, LORD forbid that I give you my family inheritance.

dag: Ka bɛ daa silim zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Yaa Naawuni, nyin ŋun su vuhirigu kam zaa nyɛvili ŋɔ, wula ka ninvuɣ yino tum alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zaa zuɣu.
en: But Moses and Aaron bowed down with their faces to the ground and said, O God, you are the source of all life. When one of us sins, do you become angry with the whole community.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu kul ku paai wuntizɔriba, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri kul bela yɛla ni sahakam.
en: Nothing bad happens to righteous people, but the wicked have nothing but trouble.

dag: O mali so palli din nyɛ nyɛvili soli din doli kpɛri chinchin tibisili la ni ti ti. Chinchin tibisili maa nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ ŋmahinli.
en: We enter through a new way that Jesus opened for us. It is a living way that leads through the curtain—Christs body.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, suhupiɛlli pam ni be alizanda ni o zuɣu gari wuntizɔriba kɔbigayinika bɛn bi lan simdi ni bɛ niŋ tuuba la.
en: In the same way, I tell you, there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who changes both heart and life than over ninety-nine righteous people who have no need to change their hearts and lives.

dag: Amaa yi yi yɛli, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna ŋɔ zuɣu, m pun tim na ti yɛli ya, Di lan yɛliya, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna. .
en: But if you disobey me and say, Here is news from the Lord .

dag: N ni zaŋ sara maligu shɛŋa ti ni mali nyɔri buɣim la n-ka a jɛmbu duu na; n ni zaŋ binshɛŋa n ni po pɔri ni n zaŋ ti a la ti a;.
en: I will bring burnt offerings to your house; I will offer you what I promised.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋmaligi yɛl o, Mani n-tim a, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ŋɔ chaŋ ti fa Izraɛlnim Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: Then the Lord ordered him, Go with all your great strength and rescue Israel from the Midianites. I myself am sending you.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ziɔnnima, paɣimiya yi Naawuni!.
en: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!.

dag: Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa vuui daanya bimbin shɛli din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tooni la. O daa vuui li la omaŋmaŋ bimbin la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bimbin la sunsuuni n-zaŋ li zal omaŋmaŋ bimbini maa nuzaa polo.
en: Ahaz took the bronze altar that was before the Lord from the front of the Temple. This bronze altar was between Ahazs altar and the Temple of the Lord . Ahaz put the bronze altar on the north side of his own altar.

dag: Saamba bɛn be n yiŋa tamla n yɛla. Ka paɣ sara bɛn nyɛ n tumtumdiba zaŋ ma leei sana. N leela tinzun nira bɛ sani.
en: Those who were guests in my house have forgotten me; my servant women treat me like a stranger and a foreigner.

dag: a yi shiri bo yɛm, ka moog a nini bahi tɛhi zilima zuɣu.
en: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa yɛrila laakum kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka mali gbaŋ lɔr o shee ni, ka o bindirigu daa nyɛla toli mini shiri.
en: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka n wum li. N wum a yɛtɔɣa maa vuri.
en: But, Job, I heard what you said. These were your very words:.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya niŋdi yaa, di nyaaŋa ka o bahi ba yoli. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka zuliya yɛligira, di nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ ba bahi.
en: he makes nations strong, then shatters their strength.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Firijia mini Galɛshia tiŋgbana ni garita, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa bi saɣi ni bɛ yihi waazu Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia because the Holy Spirit did not let them preach the message in the province of Asia.

dag: O peentɔriba tari gili ma, ka o bɔɣibɔɣi n yaannina, ka bi zo ma nambɔɣu. O puhigi m binsom bahi tiŋa.
en: and shoots arrows at me from every side— arrows that pierce and wound me; and even then he shows no pity.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kpe ni o ti mali maligu, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Jɛhu daa zaŋla ninvuɣ pihinii zali samban ni di saha maa ka yɛli ba, Ŋun chɛ ka n ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni ŋɔ ni so zo n-tiligi, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: Then they began to offer sacrifices to Baal. Earlier, Jehu had ordered soldiers to wait outside the temple. He had warned them, I will get all these worshipers here, and if any of you let even one of them escape, you will be killed instead.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa lab ti yɛli Naawuni daanab maa. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ kpam maa kɔhi n-yo yi samli maa, ka chɛ din kpalim ka a min a bidibisi maa dira.
en: She went back to Elisha, the prophet, who said to her, Sell the olive oil and pay all your debts, and there will be enough money left over for you and your sons to live on.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soya nyɛla din viɛl zaa! Yawɛ daalikauli nyɛla zaɣ maŋli. O nyɛla bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani nyɔtaɣirigu.
en: Gods way is perfect. The Lord s promise always proves to be true. He protects those who trust in him.

dag: Huram daa lan zaŋ daanya mali binzahi pia, ka di zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: Huram also made ten bronze carts; each was feet long, feet wide, and 1⁄2 feet high.

dag: N daa lan ti a bindirigu din nyɛ zim viɛlli mini kpam ni shiri ni a di, ka a daa zaŋ li zali bɛ tooni ni di nyɛ din nyom viɛla, ka di daa shiri nyɛ lala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I gave you food—the best flour, olive oil, and honey—but you offered it as a sacrifice to win the favor of idols. This is what the Sovereign Lord says.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim din nyɛ o ni pun nyari shɛli sahakam, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka ŋunkam shih o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days. Anyone who touches her is unclean until evening.

dag: Nyini n-nyandi ba sahakam, ka bɛ kpira, ka a taɣi bɛ ninni biɛhigu ka kari ba bahi.
en: You overpower them relentlessly, and they die; you change their appearance and send them away.

dag: Toli maa ni daa ŋubi mɔri maa zaa naai saha shɛli, ka n yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, chɛli bɛ taali! Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord , Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive.

dag: Chɛ ka n wunsuhigu be kaman tulaale zim la a sani, ka chɛ ka n nuhi zuɣusaa kpuɣibu be kaman zaawuni sara maligu la.
en: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ paɣisarili maa shɛli. Paɣisarili maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kubu; dama yɛlli ŋɔ ŋmanila doo ni yi chaŋ ti lir o kpee n-ku o la.
en: Dont do anything whatsoever to the young woman. She hasnt committed any capital crime—rather, this situation is exactly like the one where someone attacks his neighbor and kills him.

dag: N tim ba la ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi Naawuni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi pam sani. N tim ba mi ni bɛ ti di bɛ nɛma, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba kaman soli zuɣu taŋkpaɣu la.
en: Against a godless nation I send him; against an infuriating people I direct him to seize spoil, to steal plunder, and to trample them like mud in the streets.

dag: Ti teei ti ni daa yi ŋubiri zahim shɛli yoli Ijipti la mini kukombanim ni watamilo ni gabo ni alibarisa ni tafarinom la yɛla;.
en: In Egypt we used to eat all the fish we wanted, and it cost us nothing. Remember the cucumbers, the watermelons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic we had?.

dag: Nandahimalana n-nyɛ ma! Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ma n ninsalitali biɛhigu din tahiri ma kum ni ŋɔ bahi?.
en: What a miserable person I am! Who will save me from this body that brings me death?.

dag: ni Bɛtaraba ni Zɛmaraim ni Bɛtɛl.
en: Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel.

dag: Bɛ yila dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa na. Yawɛ zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina na ni o ti saɣim dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They are coming from a faraway land. They are coming from beyond the horizon. The Lord will use this army as a weapon to show his anger. They will destroy the whole country.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔriti ŋmana ni.
en: Your basket and your kneading bowl will be blessed.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni yi ti bi filim di dabisa maa, so ti ku tiligi, amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda la zuɣu ka o ni ti filim di dabisa maa.
en: If God doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of God's chosen ones, he will make the time shorter.

dag: ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ niŋm alibarika niŋ Ibram ni!.
en: He blessed Abram and said, Abram, may you be blessed by God Most High, the one who made heaven and earth.

dag: N ni zaŋ daɣiri lab a, ka dih a vi, ka chɛ ka niriba lih a ka mal a ansarisi.
en: I will throw disgusting things at you; I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa daalibarika kpalimmi be yi zaa ha ni! Ami.
en: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all people.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: The owner will show you a large room upstairs that is ready for us. Prepare the meal for us there.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N nini nya Naawuni ka bi kpi. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛniɛl.
en: Jacob named the place Peniel, because Ive seen God face-to-face, and my life has been saved.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Ɛfɛsus Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni m-be salima firilatamdis ayopɔin sunsuuni n-chani gindi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya piɛ yino maa, o suhu paligirimi, ka o zaŋ o buɣi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: And when you find it, you will be very happy. You will carry it.

dag: Chɛ ka o be kaman saa ŋun miri bahiri bindira zuɣu la, ka chɛ ka o be kaman sakurili ŋun maari tiŋgbani la.
en: Help the king be like rain falling on the fields, like showers falling on the land.

dag: Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Sɔtai daŋ mini Hasofɛrɛt daŋ ni Pɛruda daŋ.
en: These are the descendants of Solomons servants: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi di bi lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli, ka zali zuɣusaa mini dunia zaligunima.
en: But I, the Lord , have a covenant with day and night, and I have made the laws that control earth and sky.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa nudirigu polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi nudirigu polo maa, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Nɛgɛb nyɔŋ.
en: Son of man, look toward the Negev, the southern part of Judah. Speak against the Negev Forest.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni ti wɔɣa, ka di nyoli chaŋ ti be sagbana ni, ka di ni mali karimbaani maa zuɣu.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: Consider the fate of those who tower high! When it allowed its branches to reach up among the clouds, it became arrogant.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zaligu sulinsi ʒiɛman ni, kul gbaai yihi bina biɛla kɔŋko, ʒim n-daa yi maani binshɛɣukam din kpalim ka di be kasi; ka ʒim yi bi yi, alahichi chɛ m-paŋ kani.
en: The law says that almost everything must be made clean by blood. Sins cannot be forgiven without a blood sacrifice.

dag: Ka yi yurilim tuuni maa tumbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba paɣi Naawuni, dama di wuhiri yi ni deeri ŋun Naawuni noli shɛm Masia lahibal suŋ yɛda niŋbu ni mini yi ni tiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa pina la ni.
en: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.

dag: Absalom ni daa ti maani sara maa saha shɛli, ka o tim boli Ahitɔfɛl Gilo nir ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda saawarimaana la o ya Gilo na. Ka Absalom ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa kul nyari yaa, ka o kul nyari niriba pahira.
en: While Absalom was offering the sacrifices, he summoned Davids advisor Ahithophel, who was from Giloh, to come from his hometown. So the conspiracy grew stronger, and Absaloms following grew.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka gbilisir o tibili wumdi bɛ kuhigu.
en: The Lord watches over the righteous and listens to their cries;.

dag: Takɔbi ni ti be samban ni, ka alɔbo mini kum be tiŋ puuni, bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn be sambani, ka kum min alɔbo mi lu bɛn be tiŋ puuni zuɣu.
en: The enemy with his sword is outside the city. Disease and hunger is inside the city. If some people go out into the fields, enemy soldiers will kill them. If they stay in the city, hunger and disease will destroy them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri ti Naa Sulemaana yɛm kaman o ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm, ka suhudoo daa be o mini Hiram sunsuuni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa niŋ naŋgban yini.
en: The Lord kept his promise and gave Solomon wisdom. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made a treaty with each other.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan fa Amalɛknim maa ni daa ŋme n-di binshɛŋa maa zaa, ka lan fa o paɣiba ayi la gba.
en: David rescued his two wives and everyone else the Amalekites had taken from Ziklag.

dag: O ni daa ti wum ni Yisa Nazarɛt nira n-gariti maa ka o dii gbaai kuhiri yɛra, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: When he heard that Jesus of Nazareth was there, he began to shout, Jesus, Son of David, show me mercy.

dag: Bɛ yi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka lo ni bɛ yi a nyaaŋa n-niŋ a shɛli, bɛ ku di nasara.
en: Because they sought to do you harm, they devised a wicked plan—but they will fail!.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, N ni yɛl a ni n nya a fiig tia gbin la zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? A ni ti nya binshɛŋa din gari lala.
en: Jesus answered, Did you believe me just because I said that I saw you under the fig tree? You will see something even greater.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri yi nyɛla din wuhiri ni Naawuni niŋdi din tuhi, dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni yi darigi ti tibili o bi niŋ din tuhi? Ninsal tɛha yɛtɔɣa ka n tɔɣisi maa.
en: But if our lack of righteousness confirms Gods justice, what will we say? That God, who brings wrath upon us, isnt just ?.

dag: Dindali maa o ni ti lan boli ma o yidana yaha, ka pa ni o Baal.
en: This is what the Lord says. At that time you will call me My husband. You will not call me My Baal.

dag: Yi zɔnim mini yi dɔɣiriba ni yi mabihi hal zaŋ tabili yi banim mini yi manim ni ti chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya n-ku yi ni shɛb gba.
en: You will be betrayed by your own parents, brothers, family, and friends. Some of you will even be killed.

dag: Ijiptinima, o daa wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma yi sunsuuni n-darigi Firawuna min o niriba zaa tibili.
en: God sent signs and wonders into the very center of Egypt— against Pharaoh and all his servants.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yi yuri yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu; ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: You say evil things and tell lies.

dag: O ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam; dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: Everyone was amazed at his teaching. He taught with authority, and not like the teachers of the Law of Moses.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di luɣilikam zaa ni di binyila la, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered its top, all four sides, and its projections with pure gold and put a gold border around it.

dag: N ni bo biɛhigu shee ti n niriba Izraɛlnima n-zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani, ka bɛ be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka so ku lan muɣisi ba, ka putɔɣunim ku lan liri ba kaman bɛ ni daa yi liriti ba shɛm.
en: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kani, yin zaŋmiy o binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi maa ti o bidibisi maa ka bɛ ye, ka yi booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba.
en: Save these special clothes that were made for Aaron and his descendants. They will wear these clothes when they are chosen to be priests.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋ nuu n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n dalindi n gbaŋ kam. N ni sabiri shɛm m-bala.
en: I, Paul, am writing this greeting with my own hand. This verifies that the letter is from me, as in every letter of mine. This is how I write.

dag: Yinim Dibɔnnim bɛn ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ, yiɣisimiya jilima ʒiishee maa ti ʒini tiŋgban ni. Dama ŋun saɣindi Mɔab la kana ti liri ya. O saɣim yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli la.
en: You that live in Dibon, come down from your place of honor and sit on the ground in the dust; Moab's destroyer is here and has left its forts in ruins.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛl kpamba.
en: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee taɣi teeku kom zali saha shɛli di ni daa tahi yi tiŋgbani puuni la na?.
en: Who enclosed the Sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi vihi baŋ ti tuumbiɛri maa? Ti lo yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛɣu ŋɔ. Dama ninsal suhu ni tɛha zilim pam.
en: Let someone try to expose our crimes! Weve devised a perfect plot! Its deep within the human mind and heart.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani gindi pihiri li na nti niɛmdi li nɛya zuɣu bee n-zaŋ li niŋdi toya ni tɔra, ka zaŋdi li niŋdi duɣuri ni duɣira, ka mal li maani maha; ka di nyaɣisim ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ kpam mali mahi shɛŋa.
en: It fell on the camp at night along with the dew. The next morning the people would go around and gather it, grind it or pound it into flour, and then boil it and make it into flat cakes. It tasted like bread baked with olive oil.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmaligiya ka chɛ o dolibu, ka bɛ baɣa lan ka o soya ni.
en: He will do this because they rebelled against him and ignored what he wanted.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa dɔɣirikpamba zaa daa laɣimna ti pahi Naawuni niriba laɣiŋgu maa ni, ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ tinchandiba ka gbibi takɔbiri kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinahi.
en: The commanders of the people and of all the tribes of Israel took their place in the assembly of Gods people, four hundred thousand foot soldiers armed with swords.

dag: Amaa Naawuni shiri ni tooi be ninsalinim sani dunia ŋɔ ni? Dama zuɣusaa zaa ku tooi deeg a bɛ ti yɛri n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: But, God, will you really live here with us on the earth? The whole sky and the highest heaven cannot contain you. Certainly this house that I built cannot contain you either.

dag: Bɛ piɛbi kikaa, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, amaa so ku chaŋ tɔbu tuhibu, dama n suhuyiɣisili maa ni lu bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, hal yi yi ti kurigi m-paligi gba, n ni gbib ya. Mani n-nam ya, ka ni gbib ya. N ni sɔŋ ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: and I will still be carrying you when you are old. Your hair will turn gray, and I will still carry you. I made you, and I will carry you to safety.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ kpiɔŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: Only God is my rock and my salvation— my stronghold!—I will not be shaken.

dag: O ni daa kuni maa, ka o yiŋbihi tuh o sol na ti yɛl o, A bia la kpaŋya.
en: On the way home, the mans servants came and met him. They said, Your son is well.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o binshɛɣukam, ka bi sɔɣ o shɛli. Ka Ɛli garigi yɛli, Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ, o niŋm o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: So Samuel told him everything; he did not keep anything back. Eli said, He is the Lord ; he will do whatever seems best to him.

dag: ni Dimna ni Nahalal ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Dimnah, and Nahalal, with their pasture lands.

dag: N ni saɣim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun viɛlim ŋmani momaha la.
en: The city of Zion is beautiful, but it will be destroyed;.

dag: Dama o ʒiɛm Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum birig o zaligu, ka di simdi ni bɛ shiri ku dilana, ka o daalahichi ʒi o zuɣu.
en: for despising the LORDs word and breaking his commands. That person will be completely cut off and bear the guilt.

dag: Tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni leela yi ni yɛn saɣim shɛli ti Yawɛ. Kulla Reehab ŋun nyɛ pagɔrili la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ kɔŋko ka di simdi ni yi tiligi, o ni daa zaŋ ti tuumba la sɔɣi la zuɣu.
en: The city and everything in it is to be utterly wiped out as something reserved for the LORD. Only Rahab the prostitute is to stay alive, along with everyone with her in her house. This is because she hid the messengers we sent.

dag: M mini m Ba maa nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The Father and I are one.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni ti kahigi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi, ka dunia zaa ti yiɣisi jɛndi ba.
en: The heavens and the earth will testify against them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa ni leei saɣiri maa zuɣu, n ni laɣim ya sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ sunsuuni.
en: So I am going to bring them together in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔni mirila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, Bɛtijɛshimɔt zaŋ hal ni Ɛbɛlishitim din be Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni la.
en: Their camp stretched from Beth-Jeshimoth to Acacia.

dag: Di nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ so ŋun biri biɛla ni ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi biri pam ni ti kpuɣ atam pam.
en: Remember this: The one who plants few seeds will have a small harvest. But the one who plants a lot will have a big harvest.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra teeri sɔŋdi sol ni; ka shɛb mi ŋahiri mɔɣu ni tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches in the field and spread them on the road.

dag: Bɛ daa koya m-biri bimbira ka sa tihi, ka di daa niŋ, ka tihi maa gba daa wali pam.
en: They sowed the fields and planted grapevines and reaped an abundant harvest.

dag: Zahindi ni mini yuŋ ʒii puuni, saha shɛli gom yi ti gbaai niriba, ka bɛ do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu gbihiri la.
en: He may speak in a dream, or in a vision at night, when people are in a deep sleep lying in their beds.

dag: Suhudoo tirila ninsal niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili, amaa kɔr yoya chɔɣisirila nir kɔba ni.
en: Peace of mind makes the body healthy, but jealousy is like a cancer.

dag: Bɛnkam chaŋ o sani bi lan labina bee n-lan nya nyɛvili soli.
en: All who enter lose their life and never return.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Naawuni, Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab naa la n-tim ba na ti yɛli ma.
en: They are messengers from King Balak of Moab, Balaam answered. He sent them.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi biŋgolinsi maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ tanti yini.
en: Make fifty bronze hooks and put them in the loops to join the two sets so as to form one cover.

dag: dama bɛn nyuri dam kuuna mini pulaannim ni leei faranima; ka bɛ gɔ gbihibo nyɛ din ni chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ gbinfini.
en: Drunkards and gluttons will be reduced to poverty. If all you do is eat and sleep, you will soon be wearing rags.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa din be kasi ti ma zaa, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi zaa ni di nyɛ yi dini sahakam. Di nyɛla yalim alikauli shɛli din yi man Yawɛ sanna ka n lo a min a zuliya maa sahakam.
en: All the holy gift offerings that the Israelites raise to the LORD I have given to you, your sons, and your daughters. This is a permanent regulation. It is a covenant of salt forever in the LORDs presence, for you and your descendants.

dag: Di ka buchi, di nyɛla yɔhiŋ tuma. Di tibidarigibo saha, di ni bahi yoli.
en: They are worthless and should be despised; they will be destroyed when the Lord comes to deal with them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri mini bɛn dari nɛma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni yihira; ka daari laɣitaɣiriba teebuya mini ŋmaŋkɔhiriba kuɣisi luhira.
en: Then Jesus went into the temple and threw out all those who were selling and buying there. He pushed over the tables used for currency exchange and the chairs of those who sold doves.

dag: O filim karimbaannima; ka saɣim bɛ tiŋ din mali yaa; ka daai di goma luhi tiŋa.
en: He has thrown down those living on high, and he will level the lofty town, leveling it down to the earth; he will bring it down to dust.

dag: Dinzuɣu Samarianim maa ni daa paai Yisa sani bɛ daa balim o mi ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani; ka o daa kpalim niŋ dabisi muna ayi nimaani.
en: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma mi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala salima firilatamdigu, ka laa tam di zuɣu; ka firilanima ayopɔin tam di zuɣu; ka firila kam mali mihi ayopɔin.
en: Then he asked, What do you see? A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it, I answered. On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.

dag: A daa zaɣisi a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la! Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ malila laasabuniŋdiba bɛn yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka mali baɣisi kaman Filisitianim la, ka zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai tinzunnima.
en: O God, you have forsaken your people, the descendants of Jacob! The land is full of magic practices from the East and from Philistia. The people follow foreign customs.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa na, ka Aduna min o bidibisi ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yuli ka n zaŋ kana, ka yi ti bi deei ma, amaa so yi ti zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli kana, ŋuna ka yi ni deei.
en: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.

dag: Ka chua ni mali ninvuɣ so daa ʒi Yisa tooni.
en: All of a sudden a man with swollen legs stood up in front of him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, Di saha maa tinzun tiŋ kam niriba pia ni ti kana nti ʒe n-gbaai Yɛhudia nira binyɛrigu ka yɛli, Chɛ ka ti dol a kul a ya, dama ti wumya ni Naawuni be yi sani.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: In those days ten men from nations with entirely different languages will grab hold of a Judeans clothes and say, Lets go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛzibɔn mini Uzi ni Uziɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Iri, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu, ka nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni zuɣulaannima, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ zuliya maa daadambiɛligu kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni pihitanaanahi.
en: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was .

dag: Bɛ noya ni yɛtɔɣa piinimi ni jɛritali, ka naari ni putɔɣu ni yinyari.
en: They start out with silly talk and end up with pure madness.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋmɛnditoya liri ba libigi ba, ka chɛ ka kunsi mɔni bɛ yinsi, dama bɛ gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ni n lu di ni, ka bari zana ni bɛ gbaai ma.
en: Let them cry out in their houses, when you suddenly bring an enemy against them. Let it happen because they prepared a death trap for me. They hid traps for me to step in.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Ahaz became king at the age of twenty, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. He did not follow the good example of his ancestor King David; instead, he did what was not pleasing to the Lord.

dag: ni shihira wuhibu ni ni alahiziba tumtumsa mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni la. Lala zuɣu ka n yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ hal ti kpa Ilirikum zaa.
en: by the power of miracles and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God. And so, in traveling all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum, I have proclaimed fully the Good News about Christ.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa pirigi ʒii buyi: Bɛ shɛb daa dolila Yɛhudianim maa; ka bɛn la mi doli Yisa tuumba maa.
en: But some of the people in the city agreed with the Jews who did not believe Paul and Barnabas. Others followed the apostles. So the city was divided.

dag: Ba maa bi kariti so saria, amaa o zaŋ saria karibu yɛla zaa niŋla o Bia maa nuu ni.
en: The Father doesnt judge anyone, but he has given all judgment to the Son.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛl o niriba maa, Yoomiya vol maa yihi nanima anu la ti ma na.
en: Joshua told his soldiers, Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔriti taŋkpaɣu m-puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri, ka kumdi ka fabindi kuhiri yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali ŋɔ daazichi zuɣu ka bɛn mali ŋarima mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa leei bundaannim la, ka di ti zani awa yini puuni n-lu n-dahim zaa.
en: They threw dust on their heads, they cried and mourned, saying, How terrible! How awful for the great city! She is the city where all who have ships sailing the seas became rich on her wealth! And in one hour she has lost everything.

dag: N goonje kumsi leela fabila, ka n yua kumsi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kumdi kukoya.
en: My harp is tuned to play songs of sorrow. My flute makes sad sounds like someone crying.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun leei maligumaana ni o zan o zaani la ni mali sara maa ti Yawɛ kaman zaligu din nyɛ din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim.
en: For all time to come this offering is to be made by every descendant of Aaron who is serving as High Priest. It shall be completely burned as a sacrifice to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun su buɣim fukumsi gba daa yi bimbini gbin na n-duh o yee pam yɛli malaika so ŋun gbib gɔr dirili maa, Zaŋm a gɔrigu maa n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala, dama di wala maa mooya zaa.
en: Then another angel, who is in charge of the fire, came from the altar. He shouted in a loud voice to the angel who had the sharp sickle, Use your sickle, and cut the grapes from the vineyard of the earth, because the grapes are ripe.

dag: Dama zaɣ biɛɣu bi yirila taŋkpaɣu ni na, ka yɛlimuɣisira gba bi puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;.

dag: O ni daa ti saɣim o buni maa zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka kum titali daa lu tiŋ maa ni; ka kum wum o pam.
en: When he had used up his resources, a severe food shortage arose in that country and he began to be in need.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni suhukpeeni yɛli, Di di simdi ni Naawuni yɛligu ŋɔ daŋ tɔɣisila yi sani, amaa yi ni daa li bahi ka tɛhi ni yi bi simdi nyɛvili din ka bahigu zuɣu, nyamiya, ti ni chɛn ya ka chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: Speaking courageously, Paul and Barnabas said, We had to speak Gods word to you first. Since you reject it and show that you are unworthy to receive eternal life, we will turn to the Gentiles.

dag: Ijiptinim yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, Yawɛ ni ʒini sagbani din zɔri yomyom zuɣu n-ka Ijipti na; ka Ijipti wuna nya o ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka Ijiptinim yɛma ŋma.
en: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says.

dag: Ka Hadadɛza daa tim ti zaŋ Sirianim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la n-ka Hɛlam na, ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Hadadezer sent messengers to bring the Arameans who lived on the other side of the Euphrates River. These Arameans came to Helam. Their leader was Shobach, the captain of Hadadezers army.

dag: Ka dunianim suhuri ni paligi bɛ kum maa zuɣu, ka bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli ka tiri tab pina, anabinima ayi maa ni daa yi nahindi dunianim shɛm la zuɣu.
en: The people of the earth will be happy because of the death of these two. They will celebrate and send presents to each other, because those two prophets brought much suffering upon the whole human race.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa kul yɛrigila Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba yɛrigi nimaani kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi la.
en: During his reign silver was as common in Jerusalem as stone, and cedar was as plentiful as ordinary sycamore in the foothills of Judah.

dag: O daa mɛla buɣili Baal maligu bimbini zali o ni daa me Baal jɛmbu du shɛli zali Samaria la puuni.
en: He made an altar for Baal in the Baal temple he had constructed in Samaria.

dag: Ka bia maa ba daa kuhi ni nintam yɛli, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda; ka n yɛda niŋbu ni pooi shɛli ni, nyin sɔŋm ma di puuni.
en: The father at once cried out, I do have faith, but not enough. Help me have more.

dag: Bɛ ni yino ni daa nya ka o kɔŋ maa naai maa ka o ŋmaligi labiri ka duhir o yee paɣiri Naawuni m-mal.
en: When one of them saw that he was healed, he went back to Jesus. He praised God loudly.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Ibrahimma, Milika gba dɔɣi bihi ti a mabia Nahɔr.
en: Some time later Abraham learned that Milcah had borne eight children to his brother Nahor:.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Din yɛn niŋ ma, dina n-yɛn niŋ jɛra; ka bɔzuɣu ka di lee simdi ni m mali yɛm pam? Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I thought to myself, The same thing that happens to a fool will also happen to me. So why have I tried so hard to become wise? I said to myself, Being wise is also useless.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛm, Nyin Ziɔn, di zɔri dabiɛm; di chɛ ka a baɣiri ni cheei kom.
en: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be sol ni, gbuɣinli be solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: A person who is lazy and wants to stay home says, What if there is a lion out there? Really, there might be a lion in the street.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣi Ijipti naa Firawuna zɔri o bipuɣiŋga kpuɣibu zuɣu. Ka Sulemaana daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa n-zaŋ o na ti niŋ Dauda tiŋ la ni hal ka bɛ ti me omaŋmaŋ yiŋ mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm naai.
en: Solomon made an alliance with the king of Egypt by marrying his daughter. He brought her to live in David's City until he had finished building his palace, the Temple, and the wall around Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan yɛli Jɔnatan, Ka a ba suhu yi ti yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɛli ma.
en: How will you do that? David asked.

dag: Ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni lo ni n niŋ ba shɛm.
en: Then what I intended to do to them, Ill do to you.

dag: amaa ti ni niŋdi shɛlikam puuni, ti kpaŋdila timaŋa ni ti wuhi ni ti nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba. Ti wuhiri li ania niŋbu pam puuni mini nahiŋgu ni ni kɔŋsim ni ni wahala dibu puuni.
en: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.

dag: Yawɛ po Yaakubu zuɣu n-yɛli, N kul ku tam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla.
en: The Lord made a promise. He used his name, Pride of Jacob, and made this promise: I will never forget what those people did.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli, ka zaŋya daba ayopɔin puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: The fifteenth day of the seventh month will be a holy occasion for you. You will not do any job-related work. You will celebrate a festival to the LORD for seven days.

dag: O daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa la min omaŋmaŋ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Yawɛ ka di nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni lahi la ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: Asa and his father had given some special gifts to God. Asa put these gifts of gold, silver, and other things in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa ti maai, ka Pool laɣim Yisa nyaandoliba maa na nti kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka chɛbisi ba, ka zaŋ kpa Masidɔnia polo.
en: When the riot was over, Paul sent for the followers and encouraged them. He then told them goodbye and left for Macedonia.

dag: Hal o yi kari ma o tuma maa ni pumpɔŋɔ, m mi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka m mini niriba be.
en: Now I know what I will do! Then when my job is gone, I shall have friends who will welcome me in their homes.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti paai zoli maa zuɣu luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa yi jɛmdi Naawuni la, nyama, ka Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la daa chɛh omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu n-ka Naa Dauda sanna.
en: When David came to the summit where people used to worship God, Hushai from Erek met him. Hushais clothes were ripped, and dirt was on his head.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa guhi daba ayopɔin, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ.
en: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out from the ark again.

dag: O daa mali daantalis ayi mini biŋkpila ayi din tam daantalis ayi maa zuɣu. O daa lan wuɣi binyara ayi n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpila ayi din daa tam daantalisi maa zuɣu la;.
en: two columns; two circular capitals on top of the columns; two networks, adorning the two circular capitals on top of the columns.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa zo Yawɛ dabiɛm pam, ka mali sara n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd o.
en: The men worshipped the LORD with a profound reverence; they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made solemn promises.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna.
en: The Lord said to Aaron.

dag: Lumiya bɛn zuɣuri paligi sizuura, ka timiya ninkura jilima, ka zomiya yi Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Show honor to old people. Stand up when they come into the room. And show respect to your leaders. I am the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ, ti zani yim saɣi deei ti ninvuɣ biɛtali din nyɛ ti yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la, dama ti tum alahichi a sani.
en: We acknowledge our sin, LORD, the wrongdoing of our ancestors, because we have sinned against you.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Doɛg, Nyin lum maligumaaniba maa zuɣu n-ku ba. Ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nir maa daa lu maligumaaniba maa zuɣu. Dindali maa o daa kula bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn so tan piɛla din be kaman mukuriti la ninvuɣ pihiniinaanu.
en: The king then ordered Doeg, Doeg! You go attack the priests. So Doeg the Edomite went and attacked the priests, killing eighty-five men who wore the linen priestly vest that day.

dag: Di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋsim ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul lihirila tiŋgbɔŋ maa viɛnyɛliŋga yuuni piligu ni hal ni di naabu ni.
en: The Lord your God cares for that land. The Lord your God watches over it, from the beginning to the end of the year.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino bɔhi ma, Bɛn ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒiɛya ŋɔ lee nyɛla banima, ka ya polo ka bɛ lee yina.
en: Then one of the elders asked me, Who are these people in white robes? Where did they come from.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn kpa shɛli polo ni ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Ask the Lord to tell us where he wants us to go and what he wants us to do.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli suhi Naawuni ka o niŋ o yiko, ka o kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: Therefore, those who speak in a tongue should pray to be able to interpret.

dag: Shimɛi daa malila bidibisi pinayɔbu mini bipuɣins ayɔbu. Amaa o mabihi maa bɛn daa bi dɔɣi bihi pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ zuliya maa daa bi yɛligi kaman Judanim ni daa yɛligi shɛm la.
en: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didnt have many children, and none of their clans became as numerous as the Judeans.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: This is exactly what has happened, Ahab. The Lord made all your prophets lie to you, and he knows you will soon be destroyed.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yiɣisi n-damdi Hitinim bɛn daa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋa.
en: Abraham bowed down.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ku mali taali, ka naɣ ni bela kasi, ka nyɛ Naawuni bihi bɛn be tibi m-be ʒiɛmaan biɛɣunim mini ʒiɛman golimanim sunsuuni ŋɔ. Di simdi ni yi be bɛ sunsuuni dunia ŋɔ ni n-ne kaman saŋmarisi ni ne shɛm la.
en: so that you may be innocent and pure as God's perfect children, who live in a world of corrupt and sinful people. You must shine among them like stars lighting up the sky.

dag: N yi zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a zaligunim maa zaa ni, n ku di vi.
en: If I pay attention to all your commands, then I will not be put to shame.

dag: O ni daa di wahala kpi la nyaaŋa o daa lan zaŋ omaŋa wuhi ba shihira balibu pam puuni ni o shiri neei kum ni. Ka bɛ nina daa nya o ka bɛ min o be hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o daa wuhi ba Naawuni nam yɛla pam.
en: This was after his death, but he showed them that he was alive, proving it to them in many ways. The apostles saw Jesus many times during the days after he was raised from death. He spoke to them about Gods kingdom.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi chɛmi ka bɛ wurim bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani ti maani maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: But he did not destroy the high places. The people still made sacrifices and burned incense at those places of worship.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ bɛ paɣiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba mali biɛrisuŋ, ka pa ni bɛn nyɛ munaafichinima, amaa di simdi ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa ka ʒe yim binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛtali ni nyaɣisi bɛ noya ni, ka bɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi bɛ zilima lɔna ni;.
en: Evil tastes so good to them that they keep some in their mouths to enjoy its flavor.

dag: Chuɣu maa ni daa ti puhi yaɣi di puhibu pirigili saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba.
en: The festival was nearly half over when Jesus went to the Temple and began teaching.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ a nini kpa bɛ ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la polo, ka teeg a nu zaŋli n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Fix your eyes on the siege of Jerusalem. Shake your fist at the city and prophesy against it.

dag: Tola bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Rɛfaya ni Jɛriɛl ni Jamai ni Ibisam ni Shɛmuɛl, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Tola zuliya maa dɔɣirikpamba, ka daa lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi. Dauda ʒiɛman ni, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Tola had six sons: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel. They were heads of families of the clan of Tola and were famous soldiers. At the time of King David their descendants numbered .

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm ti Duuma Yisa yɛda, ka a min a yiŋnim zaa tiligi.
en: They said to him, Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved—you and all who live in your house.

dag: Ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni zaŋdi ti tiŋgban ni bindir daŋda mini ti tia kam wala din daŋdi moobu zaa n-tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na yuuni kam.
en: We will also bring the early produce of our soil and the early fruit from all trees every year to the LORDs house.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Following the example of his ancestor King David, he did what was pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ma maa ŋun chaŋ, ka a gbahi zaɣ bihi maa kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: You may take the babies for yourself, but you must let the mother go. If you obey these laws, things will go well for you, and you will live a long time.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Gɛrishom mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Rimɔnpɛrɛz maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Libina.
en: They marched from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.

dag: Yi ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa pala ʒiri? Ka yi daanabitali nyɛ ʒiri. Hal n yi bi yɛli shɛli, yi yɛrimi, Yawɛ yɛliya. .
en: If you prophets saw visions, they were not true. And all you got from your magic was lies! So how can you say that the Lord told you those things? I did not speak to you.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni shɛb daa shihila kpima, ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa dindali maa. Bɛna n-daa ka Musa mini Aduna sanna dindali maa.
en: But there were some people who were ritually unclean because they had touched a corpse, and they were not able to keep the Passover on that day. They went to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yi gba nyɛla n shɛhiranima, yi ni pun be n sani piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: You will testify too, because you have been with me from the beginning.

dag: amaa cheechi ni m paɣi ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa diba anu m milinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka n wuhi niriba gari ni n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa tuhi pia tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak , words in a language that others don't know.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, dabiɛm mini bɔɣa ni tɔna dola yi tooni, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Terror, traps, and trackers are upon you, people of Moab, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa boli Dauda na ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka zaŋ o tahi Sool sani, ka Dauda ti lan be o sani kaman o ni daa yi pun be o sani shɛm la.
en: So Jonathan called David and told him everything that was said. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and David was with Saul as before.

dag: Amaa a yi bi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba maa, dindina bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, ka bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka a ku tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: But if you refuse to surrender, Jerusalem will be given to the Babylonian army. They will burn Jerusalem down, and you will not escape from them.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii pam dindali maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa daa do n-dalim chɛchɛbuŋ maa puuni, ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo hal ni zaawuni, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka o kpi.
en: While the battle raged on, King Ahab remained propped up in his chariot, facing the Syrians. At sunset he died.

dag: N ni labisi Izraɛlnim ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ ti di bindir shɛli din be Kamɛl mini Bashan, ka di Ifriim zoya ni bindira ni Giliad bindira tiɣi.
en: I will restore the people of Israel to their land. They will eat the food that grows on Mount Carmel and in the region of Bashan, and they will eat all they want of the crops that grow in the territories of Ephraim and Gilead.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali yaa gari bɛ dimnima.
en: Jacobs family became very large and more powerful than their enemies.

dag: Ka o daa tuhi deei bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔn ni la zaa m-mali lala hal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He captured the fortified cities of Judah and advanced as far as Jerusalem.

dag: Di chɛ ka n suhu kpe zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu ni, ka m pahi ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu tum zaɣ biɛɣu. Di chɛ ka n zaŋ mmaŋ bali tuumbiɛtumdiba ni; di chɛ ka m pahi bɛ zuɣu di bɛ bindir nyaɣisa.
en: Keep me from wanting to do wrong and from joining evil people in their wickedness. May I never take part in their feasts.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ wurim kpe yɔɣu maa, bɛ leela mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa bindirigu.
en: And now the sheep are scattered because there was no shepherd. They became food for every wild animal, so they were scattered.

dag: Wuna maa ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋa. Bɛ gbahi ba kaman daba la chaŋ. Babilɔn wuna maa bahigu m-bala!.
en: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.

dag: Ka Lɔt ŋun daa doli Ibram maa gba daa mali biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni tantinima.
en: Lot also had sheep, goats, and cattle, as well as his own family and servants.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu sa ti yɛn neei ka n yi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, hal do yino gba, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma n ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm maa, hal ŋun niŋm ma gari lala gba.
en: I swear, I wont let even one man in Nabals family live until tomorrow morning.

dag: Ti nyɛla jɛra Masia zuɣu, amaa ka yinima nyɛ yɛnnim Masia puuni. Ti nyɛla ninvuɣ gbarima, amaa ka yinima nyɛ kpiɔŋlaannima. Yi nyɛla bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima, amaa ka tinim nyɛ bɛ ni ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: For Christ's sake we are fools; but you are wise in union with Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! We are despised, but you are honored!.

dag: Wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli soli n-nyɛ a nam ʒiishee tanzaa, ka yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali be a tooni.
en: Your kingdom is founded on righteousness and justice; love and faithfulness are shown in all you do.

dag: Di saha ka o daa mali chɛchɛbunsi shili, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: So he sent for his chariot and took his army with him.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa buɣisi bɔh o ba Zakaria ni bɛ baŋ o ni bɔri ni bɛ bol o bia maa yu shɛli.
en: Then they made signs to his father, asking him what name he would like the boy to have.

dag: Dama bɛ nyurila bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka tɛhiri ni Naawuni ku tooi nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, ka kari ba saria di zuɣu.
en: They lie to themselves. They dont see their own faults, so they are not sorry for what they do.

dag: Piimiya zuliya kam ni toondaan yino ka bɛ pahi piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: Take also one leader from each tribe to help them divide it.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi piɛguliba maa, M mabihi, ka tiŋkani ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila Haran na.
en: Jacob asked the shepherds, My friends, where are you from? From Haran, they answered.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani di shɛhira jɛndi ba. Amaa ka bɛ bi ŋmaligi chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni sani bee n-suh o dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Ephraims pride speaks against him. The people had many troubles, but they still didnt go back to the Lord their God. They didnt look to him for help.

dag: Taainim mɛla birini gili bɛmaŋa, ka va anzinfa mini salima puli kaman taŋkpaɣu la!.
en: Tyre is built like a fort. The people there have collected so much silver that it is like dust, and gold is as common as clay.

dag: Amaa buŋdibbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ni yi zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi tuuli bidibisi n-tiligi ba.
en: Every firstborn donkey can be bought back. You can offer a lamb and keep the donkey. If you dont want to buy back the donkey like this, then you must break its neck to kill it. But every firstborn baby boy must be bought back from the Lord.

dag: Ka Shɛshibaza daa kana nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ; ka mɛbu maa tuma kul tumdi di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka di na lee bi me n-naai.
en: So Sheshbazzar came and laid its foundation; construction has continued from then until the present, but it is still not finished.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛman nim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: But he replied, An evil and unfaithful generation searches for a sign, but it wont receive any sign except Jonahs sign.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni yɛl shɛli din gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu be kpe.
en: I tell you that there is something here that is greater than the Temple.

dag: Teemiya din daa niŋ Lɔt paɣ la.
en: Remember Lots wife!.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Abimilɛk sanna zahindi puuni yuŋ ti yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla kpima, a ni kpuɣi paɣ so la na zuɣu; dama o nyɛla do so paɣa.
en: But one night God spoke to Abimelech in a dream and said, You will die. The woman you took is married.

dag: N yiko din galisi puuni ka n daa teei n nuu nam dunia mini ninsalinima ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni, ka zaŋdi li tiri n nini ni tiɣi so.
en: By my great power and strength I created the world, human beings, and all the animals that live on the earth; and I give it to anyone I choose.

dag: N sɔŋsim yirila Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ sanna.
en: My help comes from the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.

dag: ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-nya ka naɣikɔhiriba mini piɛkɔhiriba ni ŋmaŋkɔhiriba be di puuni m-pahi laɣitaɣiriba bɛn ʒi bɛ teebuya gbini.
en: He found in the temple those who were selling cattle, sheep, and doves, as well as those involved in exchanging currency sitting there.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri a ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ. Teem a ni daa mali yurilim maŋli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda san la yɛla.
en: Lord God, do not reject the king you have chosen. Remember the love you had for your servant David.

dag: Ka lala ni chɛ ka ti lir o o ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-lu o zuɣu kaman maligim ni luri tiŋgbani zuɣu shɛm la, ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa so ku tiligi.
en: We will catch David wherever he is hiding and attack him with so many soldiers that they will be like the dew that covers the ground. We will kill David and all of his men—no one will be left alive.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dilan nyɛla ŋun nya o ba zaɣim, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has sexual relations with his fathers wife, both the man and the woman must be put to death. They are responsible for their own death. It is as if that man had sexual relations with his father!.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu ka n ti yɛn sa li. Ka di teei wula n-wali wala, ka leei sida ti titali. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti kana ti zaani di gbini. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti te bɛ tɛri di wula mahim ni.
en: on Israel's highest mountain. It will grow branches and bear seed and become a magnificent cedar. Birds of every kind will live there and find shelter in its shade.

dag: Ka yi ni gahi yi bimbɔba dahin shɛli maa, zaŋmiya piɛlaa ŋun paai yuuni ka ka daŋa m-mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ dindali.
en: On the day you present the offering of grain, also sacrifice as a burnt offering a one-year-old male lamb that has no defects.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka ku tum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa tuma.
en: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o ku yɛli din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Ahab turned to Jehoshaphat and said, I told you he would bring bad news.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Go and tell Pharaoh, Egypts king, to let the Israelites out of his land.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nti yɛn nyɛ o suhu ni yuri shɛli. O ti ku kari nimmira saria bee n-kari, Bɛ yɛliya, saria.
en: He will delight in fearing the LORD. He wont judge by appearances, nor decide by hearsay.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Maika ni daa mali dari binnan shɛl la n-leei bɛ dini zali nimaani, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mi daa kul ʒe Shilo di saha maa zaa.
en: The people of Dan set up for themselves the idol that Micah had made. That idol was there the whole time that the house of God was in Shiloh.

dag: Ka do so yi ti zahim zahindi yuŋ mahig omaŋa, dindina ŋun yim sansani maa ni, ka di lan kpe sansani maa ni na.
en: If there is any man who is unclean because he had a flow of semen during the night, he must go out of the camp. He must stay away from the camp.
