dag: Yawɛ, guli ma ka yihi ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, Guli ma ka yihi ma duŋtaariba bɛn lo ni bɛ chɛ ka n lu la nuu ni.
en: Lord , save me from the wicked! Protect me from these cruel people who plan to hurt me.

dag: Amaa bomiya nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli yi zuliyanim maa zaa sani n-leeg o biɛhigu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o nimaani la.
en: Out of the territory of all your tribes the Lord will choose the one place where the people are to come into his presence and worship him.

dag: Di pala timaŋmaŋ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri ya, amaa Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri maa, ka wuhiri ya ni timaŋmaŋ mi nyɛla yi daba ŋun Yisa zuɣu.
en: We dont tell people about ourselves. But we tell people that Jesus Christ is Lord, and we tell them that we are your servants for Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu Oholiba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka a ni ŋmalig a mamanim shɛb sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili la suhuri yiɣisi bahi a zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ yi luɣilikam na ti lir a.
en: So Oholibah, the LORD God proclaims: Im now inciting your lovers against you, all those from whom you recoiled, and I will bring them against you from all around.

dag: Ka a kpamba ŋɔ ni ti kana ti gbani n tooni yɛli ma, A min a niriba zaa bɛn dol a yimiya chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka n ni chaŋ. Ka o daa ŋmaligi Firawuna sani n-yi ni suhuyiɣisili pam.
en: Then all your officials will come down to me, bow to me, and say, Get out, you and all your followers! After that Ill leave. Then Moses, furious, left Pharaoh.

dag: Chɛ ka m be a jɛmbu duu sahakam, ka chɛ ka n sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni su piɛ nyaan shɛb kom ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam mali jaa, ka bɛ ni so bi kɔŋ o bala.
en: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes as they come up from the washing pool— all of them perfectly matched, not one of them lacks its twin.

dag: Dama bɛ daa yi zaŋdila bɛ tantinim mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ laakumnim kanna ti luri bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Ka bɛ mini laakumnim maa daa ka kalinli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daa yi ti kana bɛ saɣindila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam.
en: They would invade with their herds and tents, coming like a swarm of locusts, so that no one could count them or their camels. They came into the land to destroy it.

dag: Dabili ŋun mali yɛm ni ti su bidɔɣiro ŋun tumdi vi tuma, ka ni ti di fali kaman daŋ ni nir la.
en: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunima lola tɔb na ni bɛ ti liri ti. Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka a bi saɣi ni bɛ kpe zuliya shɛba tiŋgbɔna ni, ka bɛ daa chɛ ba ka bi ku ba la.
en: You can see that the armies of Ammon, Moab, and Edom are attacking us! Those are the nations you would not let our ancestors invade on their way from Egypt, so these nations were not destroyed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan yi o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu Taibɛrias Teeku ni. O ni daa yi bɛ zuɣu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Later, Jesus himself appeared again to his disciples at the Sea of Tiberias. This is how it happened.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-sula Izraɛlnim yuma ayi.
en: In the seventeenth year of Judahs King Jehoshaphat, Ahaziah, Ahabs son, became king over Israel in Samaria. He ruled over Israel for two years.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yi Firawuna sani n-chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ.
en: Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the Lord .

dag: Yisahaku ni daa be nimaani ka di niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk daa ti lihi takɔro ni nya ka Yisahaku diɛmd o paɣ Ribɛka.
en: After Isaac had lived there a long time, Abimelech looked out of his window and saw Isaac and his wife enjoying one another.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa daa zabir o nyuli di zuɣu, amaa ka o ba daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father took careful note of the matter.

dag: Chɛ ka ti mini ya kpuɣiri tab bihi niŋdi ti paɣiba. Zaŋmiya yi bipuɣinsi tiri ti, ka kpuɣimi ti gba bipuɣinsi niŋdi yi paɣiba.
en: Why don't you start letting your families marry into our families and ours marry into yours?.

dag: Bɛ yi wum bee bɛ yi zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi be bɛ sani. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Whether those rebels listen to you or not, they will know that a prophet has been among them.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sool daa tim ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gu Dauda o yiŋa, o daa lomi ni o ku o asiba. Amaa ka Dauda paɣa Mikal daa yɛl o, A yi bi tilig a nyɛvili yuŋ ŋɔ, biɛɣuni bɛ sa ni ku a.
en: Saul sent messengers to Davids house to keep watch on it and kill him in the morning. Davids wife Michal warned him, If you dont escape with your life tonight, you are a dead man tomorrow.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini jintɔriba zaa daa bo niriba ni bɛ di Yisa ʒiri shɛhira ka bɛ tɔɣisi luh o, ka ku o.
en: The chief priests and the whole Council tried to find some false evidence against Jesus to put him to death;.

dag: ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ ti yi mɔɣu polo na yim nti ʒe n-daai yili maa zaa luhi bipola maa zuɣu, ka bɛ kpi. N kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: when a strong wind came from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It fell upon the young people, and they died. I alone escaped to tell you.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim buta ka n daa suhi n Duuma di zuɣu ni o yihi li n ni.
en: I begged the Lord three times to take this problem away from me.

dag: Yuŋ nyoorila n kɔb tuɣa ni; ka biɛrim shɛli din dimdi ma bi naara.
en: At night he bores my bones; my gnawing pain wont rest.

dag: M biɛhigu din ka buchi ŋɔ puuni, n nya binshɛɣukam zaa. Wuntizɔriba kpiri bɛ wuntitali tuma puuni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: My life has been useless, but in it I have seen everything. Some good people may die while others live on, even though they are evil.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Sool Dauda ni yɛli shɛm.
en: The officials told Saul what David had said.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: So Jesus said to them, Then I will not tell you who gave me the authority to do these things.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi piligu ni hal ti paai di bahigu ni, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Hanani bia Jɛhu yɛlikura sabbu ni, ka di be Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Jehoshaphat did, from beginning to end, is written in The Official Records of Jehu Son of Hanani . It was copied and included in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka a niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border millimeters thick.

dag: Kɔhigɔriba bɛn be niriba maa ni ni mal a ansarisi. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie, ka a ku lan beni yaha.
en: The merchants of the world can't believe what happened. Your death was gruesome, and you are gone forever.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa be n sani, o na ʒi n-chɛ ma n ko, dama n kul tumdila din tiɣir o nini sahakam.
en: And he who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, because I always do what pleases him.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni n-zaŋ bɛ naba siɣi di kom ni saha shɛli, .
en: The priests who were carrying the Box came to the shore of the river. When they stepped into the water.

dag: ni Ɛlikana ni Zɔfai ni Nahat.
en: Ahimoth's descendants included Elkanah, Zophai, Nahath, Eliab, Jeroham, and Elkanah.

dag: A chɛ a suhuyiɣisili la zaa, ka chɛ a sujee din kpɛm pam la.
en: You stopped being angry with them. Your terrible anger has gone away.

dag: N dabiɛm zɔbu puuni, n daa yɛliya ni so ku tooi niŋ so naani.
en: even when I was afraid and said, No one can be trusted.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa deeg o yɛligu maa deei kom baptaizibu pahi yɛdaniŋdib maa zuɣu dindali maa. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaata laasabu.
en: On that day about , believed his message and were baptized.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa bɔri ni n laɣim n niriba, amaa ka bɛ daa ŋmanila wain tia din ka wala bee fiig tia din ka wala, hal bɛ ŋmanila tia din vari suui. N ni daa zaŋ binshɛli ti ba la faaya ka chɛ ba.
en: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di saha ka Pita mini Jɔn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.

dag: Yi ni chani bɔri mamanim maa, yi niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! Lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi wuhi paɣ yoya yi soya.
en: Judah, you have become so good at finding lovers. Even the worst women could learn some evil ways from you.

dag: Teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi ni salima alali firila tamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛli zuɣu.
en: the table and its equipment, the pure lampstand with all its equipment, the incense altar.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba je ni so kpahi bɛ zuɣuri ni; bɛ ku chaŋ yɛnnim sani.
en: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, N gba bɔri ni n wum doo maa yɛtɔɣa. Ka Fɛstus yɛl o, A sa ni wum li biɛɣuni.
en: Agrippa said to Festus, I want to hear the man myself. Tomorrow, Festus replied, you will hear him.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun yɛn be yi sani niŋ daba ayi bee ŋun yɛn be yi sani sahakam o yi bɔri ni o mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la, ŋun niŋmi kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: If an immigrant lives with you or has settled among you for many years and would also like to offer a food gift that is a soothing smell to the LORD, that person must do just as you do.

dag: Ka o paɣ tab bɛn mali yɛm daa garig o yɛli, Aai. Ka o garigi yɛl omaŋa.
en: She and her wisest women gave the same answer:.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.

dag: Amaa ka naa maa daa bɔh o, Siɣimsiɣim bula ka n kul yɛr a ni a yi yɛn zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa, nyin yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: But Ahab answered, How many times do I have to tell you? Tell me the truth. What does the Lord say.

dag: A zaŋ tuuta sa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura ka bɛ yi nya tuuta maa, di ni chɛ ka piɛma ku nyɔɣi ba.
en: But you have provided a flag to show your faithful followers where to gather to escape the enemys attack. Selah.

dag: Ka so ni daa kani simdi ni o bɔɣi litaafi maa n-lihi di puuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka n kum pam.
en: So I began to weep and weep, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look inside it.

dag: Ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Wula ka o daa lee niŋ a? Wula ka o daa lee niŋ neeg a nina maa.
en: They questioned him: What did he do to you? How did he heal your eyes.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli bo n-nya buni ŋmanila noon so ŋun ŋuni o ni bi nye gal shɛŋa zuɣu wɔɣi li. Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu pirigili puuni, bɛ ni ti kɔŋ li, ka bɛ bahigu saha, niriba ni ti boli ba jɛra.
en: Sometimes a bird will hatch an egg that it did not lay. Those who cheat to get money are like that bird. But when their lives are half finished, they will lose the money. At the end of their lives, it will be clear that they were fools.

dag: Amaa n ni saɣi ni shɛli nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛn yɛl a ŋɔ: Adiini so shɛli bɛ ni booni adiini soli din bi tuhi la, dina ka n doli n-jɛmdi n yaannim Naawuni, ka niŋ dinkam be zaligu puuni min anabinim sabbu yɛda.
en: I do admit this to you, that I am a follower of the Way, which they call a faction. Accordingly, I worship the God of our ancestors and believe everything set out in the Law and written in the Prophets.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim, saha shɛli zaa yi ni ti yɛn be yi dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka di leei dabari maa, di saha maa di ni vuhi, ka di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim.
en: You will be taken to your enemys country. Your country will be empty. So your land will finally get its rest. The land will enjoy its time of rest.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak daa nya Izraɛlnim ni niŋ Amɔrinim shɛlikam zaa.
en: Balak son of Zippor saw everything the Israelites had done to the Amorites. The king of Moab was very frightened of the Israelites because there were so many of them. He was very afraid.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ bɔhim baŋ din tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: as you try to please the Lord.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu a ni, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku niriba a ni solɔri zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi din jɛnd a maa ku niriba luɣilikam, ka kpiimba ti do a ni, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will send disease and death to Sidon, and many people inside the city will die. Soldiers outside the city will kill many people. Then people will know that I am the Lord !.

dag: Ka o daa ʒiya n-wumdi Pool waazu, ka Pool ti mirig o nina kpa o n-nya ka o mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: He sat there and listened to Paul's words. Paul saw that he believed and could be healed, so he looked straight at him.

dag: dindina yi ni nya suhupiɛlli man Yawɛ sani, ka n chɛ ka yi nya jilima dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa; ka chɛ ka yi di n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yab Yaakubu la daanfaani. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: then you will find the joy that comes from serving me. I will make you honored all over the world, and you will enjoy the land I gave to your ancestor, Jacob. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Sool bia Jɔnatan daa yiɣisi chaŋ Dauda sani Hɔrɛshi maa nti zaŋ Naawuni yuli kpaŋs o suhu.
en: Sauls son Jonathan came to David at Horesh and encouraged him with God.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan wuhi ma binshɛli. Nyama, o daa wuhi ma la tiwal moma ni pali piɛ shɛli.
en: I had another vision from the Sovereign Lord . In it I saw a basket of fruit.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛruya bia Abishai daa kana ti sɔŋ Dauda n-ku Filistia doo maa. Di saha ka Dauda niriba maa daa po pɔri yɛl o, A ku lan doli ti chaŋ tɔb ni, di yi pa lala a ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim firila kpi.
en: But Zeruiahs son Abishai came to Davids aid, striking the Philistine down and killing him. Then Davids men swore a solemn pledge to him: You will never march out to battle with us again! You must not snuff out Israels lamp.

dag: ni o guhiri hal ti paai saha shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ o dimnim leeg o napɔntamdigu.
en: And now Christ waits there for his enemies to be put under his power.

dag: Ka yi mini Giriisinim ni Tubalnim ni Mɛshɛkinim daa lan niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi ninsalinim mini daanya nɛma na ti taɣiri yi daguya.
en: People in Greece, Turkey, and the area around the Black Sea traded with you. They traded slaves and bronze for the things you sold.

dag: di nyaaŋa bimpiɛlli bee din mooi ka piɛla yi ti be wuliɛɣu maa ni, dindina bɛn zaŋm li wuhi maligumaana.
en: and in place of the boil there is a white swelling or reddish-white shiny spot, it must be shown to the priest.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya, zomiya tiligi, yimiya Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni. Piɛbimiya kikaa Tɛkɔa, ka ŋmɛnya tɔbuchiriga Bɛtihakɛrɛm. Dama zaɣ biɛɣu mini saɣiŋgu pam ni yi nuzaa polo na.
en: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Kɛdɛmɔt tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn sani nti zaŋ suhudoo yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛl o.
en: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:.

dag: Ka n yura maa daa zaŋ o nuu daai dunoli, ka n suhu dii kpe o ni.
en: My lover put his hand to the door, and I was thrilled that he was near.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zɔri yiriŋ doli solɔri, ka kabiri kpɛri niriba ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa. Bɛ bemi kaman buɣim mokpala la, ka bɛ labiri kpana kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: The chariots race wildly through the streets and rush back and forth through the square. They look like burning torches, like lightning flashing from place to place!.

dag: Ka Reechɛl bidibisi daa nyɛ Yisifu mini Bɛnjamin.
en: His sons by Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti miri Jɛrusalɛm n-nya li o dii gbaala kuhigu ka fabindi di zuɣu.
en: As Jesus came to the city and observed it, he wept over it.

dag: O daa ku Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.

dag: Bɛ nina kul kpala paɣiba bɛn nyɛ zinaniŋdiba, ka bɛ nina na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛli alahichi tumbu puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana ni bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, ka nyɛ bɛn bɔhim baŋ diribarilim tuma yɛla. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu!.
en: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum n suhigu, ka garigi ma, dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana.
en: LORD, listen closely to me and answer me, because I am poor and in need.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kahigi yɛli Simiɔn ni o ku kpi faashee ka o nini ti nya ti Duuma ni daa lo ni o ni ti ba Masia so la.
en: The Holy Spirit told him that he would not die before he saw the Messiah from the Lord.

dag: Bɛ puri ni tihi ni ti wali wala, ka tiŋgbani ni bindira niŋ. Bɛ ni ti be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni alaafee. N yi kabisi dapuhi din pa bɛ nyiŋgoya zuɣu la, ka fa ba ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ ba leei daba nuu ni bahi, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni gahi nuu boli zuliya kam, ka wuhi niriba shihirili; bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi maa ŋmab bɛ bɔɣuri ni na ti tin ya; ka zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi tuɣi na ti tin ya.
en: The Sovereign Lord says to his people: I will signal to the nations, and they will bring your children home.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka zooi pam ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anakinim la. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa ku ba ka chɛ ka Ammɔnnim maa deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani.
en: They were as tall as the Anakim. There were many of them, and they were a mighty race. But the Lord destroyed them, so that the Ammonites took over their land and settled there.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa nyo nayili mini niriba yiya buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goma luhi.
en: Meanwhile, the Babylonian army had burned the houses in Jerusalem, including the royal palace, and they had broken down the city walls.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: The Lord said to the prophet Elijah from Tishbe.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, N ni daa ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira so zuɣu la n-lan neei kum ni na maa.
en: When Herod heard it, he said, He is John the Baptist! I had his head cut off, but he has come back to life.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka she tana ayɔbu la gba tuɣi taba ka kpabi tan shɛli din pah ayɔbu la ka di niŋ diba ayi, ka yi zaŋ li pa m biɛhigu shee maa tooni polo.
en: Sew five of them together in one set, and the other six in another set. Fold the sixth piece double over the front of the Tent.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa wuh o niriba maa zaa, Hiburunim maa yi lan dɔɣi bidibiga, yin zaŋm o ti lɔhi Nail Mɔɣili ni, amaa chɛliya bipuɣinsi bɛna.
en: So Pharaoh gave this command to his own people: If the Hebrew women give birth to a baby girl, let it live. But if they have a baby boy, you must throw it into the Nile River.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a yurilim yɛla yɛli cheechi din be kpe ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania sɔŋ ba ka bɛ bahi chaŋ bɛ chandi maa, dama lala niŋbu nyɛla din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: They have spoken to the church here about your love. Please help them to continue their trip in a way that will please God.

dag: Miri ka a leei dabiɛm bini n sani, nyini n-nyɛ n ni yɛn sɔɣi so sani m muɣisigu saha.
en: Dont terrorize me; you are my refuge in time of disaster.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni lan deei Juda n-su tiŋgbɔŋ kasi maa, ka lan pii Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: The LORD will possess Judah as his inheritance upon the holy land; he will again choose Jerusalem.

dag: N ni zaŋ rubis me a pihi, ka zaŋ kuɣ shɛŋa din nyɛlisiri me a dunoya, ka zaŋ kuɣ viɛla m-mal a gooni.
en: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.

dag: Ka ti yi mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam o deeri ti suhigu, dindina ti mi ni o tiri ti ti ni suhir o shɛlikam.
en: He listens to us every time we ask him. So we know that he gives us whatever we ask from him.

dag: Yinim Lakishinima, zaŋmiya chɛchɛbunsi ga yuri, di daa nyɛla alahichi piligu Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga sani, dama a ni ka bɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim biriginsim.
en: Harness the horses to the chariot, inhabitants of Lachish! It was the beginning of sin for Daughter Zion; the crimes of Israel have been found in you.

dag: O nam maa ni daa ti niŋ yaa naai, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o kpamba bɛn daa ku o ba ŋun daa nyɛ naa la.
en: As soon as he was firmly in power, he executed the officials who had murdered his father.

dag: Bɛn ne mi ni bɛ ni kpi, amaa bɛn kpi bɛn lan ʒi shɛli yaha. Bɛ lan ka jina ni, hal ka niriba bi teeri bɛ yɛla.
en: Yes, the living know they are going to die, but the dead know nothing. They have no further reward; they are completely forgotten.

dag: Ka Rabishake daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia ni Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la bɔhiya, Bɔ ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: The commander said to them, Tell Hezekiah this is what the great king, the king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in to help you?.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo bo o dokpee kaman paɣ la, di nyɛla din chihira.
en: You must not have sexual intercourse with a man as you would with a woman; it is a detestable practice.

dag: dama yi yɛtɔɣa puuni ka yi ni ti yi taali ni, yi yɛtɔɣa puuni mi ka yi ni ti lan mali taali.
en: Your words will be used to judge you—to declare you either innocent or guilty.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa bi lɛbira, ka Yawɛ daa zo ba nambɔɣu n-chɛ ka malaikanim maa gbah o min o paɣ ni o bipuɣins ayi maa nuhi ni n-vo ba yihi tiŋ maa tariga ti zali.
en: At first, Lot just stood there. But the Lord wanted to save him. So the angels took Lot, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.

dag: Naa Zɛdɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni moli faako tibu molo la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: King Zedekiah and the people of Jerusalem had made an agreement to set free.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be thrown down to the place of death!.

dag: n-chaŋ ti moli o nasara dibu molo shihi bɛn be sarika ni la sani.
en: And by the Spirit he went and preached to the spirits in prison.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, Naawuni darigi a tibili naai a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ku lan chɛ ka a be tinzun tiŋ ni. Amaa nyini Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga, a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ni darig a tibili. O ni yih a daalahichi maa palo.
en: Your punishment is over, Daughter Zion; God wont expose you anymore. But he will attend to your punishment, Daughter Edom; he will expose your sins.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa lee bi be kaman o yab Dauda. O daa niŋ o ba Jɔash ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: He did what was pleasing to the Lord , but he was not like his ancestor King David; instead, he did what his father Joash had done.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim pala ti ni niriba; lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yi ti ni. Bɛ yi di daa nyɛla ti ni niriba, bɛ daa naan kpalim be ti sani. Amaa bɛ daa yi ti ni ni di kahigi wuhi ni bɛ zaa pala bɛn be ti ni.
en: These people really did not belong to our fellowship, and that is why they left us; if they had belonged to our fellowship, they would have stayed with us. But they left so that it might be clear that none of them really belonged to us.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku lan nyɛ yi neesim wuntaŋ ni. Ka goli gba ku lan nyɛ yi neesim yuŋ. Man Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam, ka mani ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima neesim ni nɛn ya.
en: The sun will no longer be your light by day, nor will the moon shine for illumination by night. The LORD will be your everlasting light; your God will be your glory.

dag: Di yi ti wum o ka o suhu zɔhira saha shɛli, ka n dii lir o n-kpɛh o dabiɛm ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa zaa zo ka chɛ o, ka n ku ŋun naa maa kɔŋko.
en: I will attack him while he is tired and discouraged. He will be frightened, and all his men will run away. I will kill only the king.

dag: Chɛ ka n dimnim be kaman ninvuɣ biɛri la, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ma be kaman bɛn pa wuntizɔriba la.
en: May all who oppose me and fight against me be punished like the wicked and the unrighteous.

dag: ka Samuɛl nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Jɛrɔham bia, ka Jɛrɔham nyɛ Ɛliɛl bia, ka Ɛliɛl nyɛ Tɔa bia.
en: son of Elkanah son of Jeroham son of Eliel son of Toah.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ la saha shɛl o ni daa wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Kapɛrinium la.
en: Jesus said this as he taught in the synagogue in Capernaum.

dag: ni laakumnim bɛn mali bihim pihita mini bɛ bihi ni naɣinyama pihinahi mini naɣilahi pia ni bunnyama pisi mini bundibisi pia.
en: thirty nursing camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.

dag: Shɛhira maa n-nyɛ ni Naawuni ti ti nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka nyɛvili maa mi bela o Bia maa ni.
en: This is what God told us: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa chɛ ka tɔbbi shɛb lɔɣi gilila Judanim maa nyaaŋa nti sɔɣi dɔni gu ba, ka bɛn kpalim mi be bɛ tooni polo.
en: But Jeroboam sent a group of soldiers to sneak behind Abijahs army. Jeroboams army was in front of Abijahs army. The hidden soldiers from Jeroboams army were behind Abijahs army.

dag: O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba, ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku noli la yiŋa.
en: He is a guest in the home of a tanner of leather named Simon, who lives by the sea.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka niriba ni niŋ shɛb naani leeri biriti, ka mɔŋdi kpamba baŋsim.
en: he confuses wise, experienced advisors.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama Naawuni kamina ni o ti zahim ya, dina n-nyɛ ni o chɛ ka dabiɛm be yi suhuri ni ka yi ku tum alahichi.
en: Then Moses said to them, Dont be afraid! God has come to test you. He wants you to respect him so that you will not sin.

dag: Naawuni zuɣu, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri n ni sabiri shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ puuni!.
en: Before God, Im not lying about the things that Im writing to you!.

dag: Ka niriba ni be tin shɛŋa ni zaa ni ti kpalim tiŋ kuma. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Many people live in your cities now, but those cities will be ruined. Your whole country will be destroyed! Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka m bi biɛhim ka ka yi sanna yomyom maa, dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma yi ni boli ma na shɛli zuɣu.
en: And so when you sent for me, I came without any objection. I ask you, then, why did you send for me.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ, gbibiya ka guliya n wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Lord said, Write this agreement. Tie it up and seal it so that it cannot be changed. Give these teachings to my followers for safekeeping.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti me buɣili zali yimaŋa.
en: Do not make gods of metal and worship them.

dag: Naa Ahaz kum yuuni ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa kana:.
en: This oracle came in the year of King Ahazs death.

dag: Ka tin shɛli din miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba zaa ni paɣi bɛ nuhi bahi bɛ ni kabi naɣisa so nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni la zuɣu.
en: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yihi tinzunnim zaa bɛn be Izraɛlnim ni.
en: When the people of Israel heard this law read, they excluded all foreigners from the community.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛra.
en: Then Jesus began teaching the people. He said.

dag: Fɔnisia, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya. Zomiya kuli Speen.
en: Howl with grief, you people of Phoenicia! Try to escape to Spain!.

dag: Kahigim a daalikauli din nyɛ bɛn lur a sizuura dini la wuhi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ, ka n lu a sizuura.
en: Confirm your promise to your servant— the promise that is for all those who honor you.

dag: Amaa lee tɔɣisimiyala taba yɛlimaŋli yurilim puuni, ka zooi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la ni binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. A sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: Deliver me from my enemies, LORD! I seek protection from you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi Ijipti na ka nyɛ bɛn paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana bɛ so nini ku nya n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la; dama bɛ bi doli ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: And he said that no one who was years or older when they left Egypt would enter the land he had promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Not one of those people believed in the Lord 's power.

dag: Miri ka a leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛ nɛma pari talima la ni yino bee n-zani ti so ni o di samli.
en: Dont shake hands to guarantee a loan.

dag: n-daa tim ba Iddo ŋun daa nyɛ Kasifiya fɔŋ zuɣulan la sani ka yɛli ba bɛ ni ti yɛn yɛli Iddo min o tab bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba Kasifiya shɛm. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ tim ti tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ piim tinsi bɛ ni deei tiŋgban shɛŋa la ni n-ti Lɛvinim ka bɛ be di ni, ka ti ba biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee tiŋgbana ka di do n-gili tinsi maa.
en: to say to them: When you receive your tribal lands, you must give towns and pastures to the Levi tribe.

dag: Ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni mali binshɛɣukam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o. O yuli Mɛlikizɛdɛk gbinni nyɛla Wuntia Naa. O lan nyɛla Salɛm Naa, ka di mi gbinni nyɛla Suhudoo Naa.
en: Abraham gave a tenth of everything to him. His name means first king of righteousness, and then king of Salem, that is, king of peace.

dag: Amaa bia maa ŋun daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛm, kulla Jɔnatan mini Dauda n-daa mi di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The boy knew nothing about what went on. Only Jonathan and David knew.

dag: Yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-nyɛ alibarika maa.
en: a blessing, if you obey the commands of the Lord your God that I am giving you today;.

dag: M pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla siɣimsiɣim paai shɛm, ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan labi yɛli ya di yɛla ni nintam. Niriba pam beni ka bɛ biɛhigu zaŋ ba leela Masia dapulli zuɣu kum la dimnima.
en: There are many who live like enemies of the cross of Christ. I have often told you about them. And it makes me cry to tell you about them now.

dag: Shɛlomɔt ŋɔ min o mabihi n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naa Dauda min o dɔɣirikpamba ni sapashinnim bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni bɛn su kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi ni sapashin kpamba ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti maani sara la fukumsi.
en: This Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries of the gifts dedicated by King David, by the household leaders, by the commanders of the units of a thousand and a hundred, and by the army officers.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bahi chaŋ zoya din du pam zuɣu tinsi maa ni, hal Musa mini Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka la ni daa kul kpalim be bɛ sansani maa ni la zaa yoli.
en: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o yuri ninvuɣ so ŋun doli wuntitali soli.
en: The LORD detests the path of the wicked, but loves those who pursue righteousness.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ yɛda. Bɛ ni daa wum ni Yawɛ baɣa be Izraɛlnim ni ka nya bɛ wahala maa, ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: They believed, and when they heard that the Lord had come to them and had seen how they were being treated cruelly, they bowed down and worshiped.

dag: Ti yom li bee ti di yo? Amaa ka Yisa baŋ bɛ bilikɔɣintali maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ niŋ ka yi zahindi ma? Zaŋmiya laɣifu na ka n nya.
en: Jesus knew what they were up to, and he said, Why are you trying to test me? Show me a coin.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, amaa ka mi daa lee zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: But they did not understand what this teaching meant, and they were afraid to ask him.

dag: O daa zaŋ sagbana niŋ bɛ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka buɣim tiri neesim yuŋ.
en: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yihimiya Gibia ninvuɣ galima bɛn tum lala maa na ka ti ku ba, ka lala tuuni maa vuui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima. Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum bɛ mabihi Izraɛlnim maa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Now hand over those perverts in Gibeah, so that we can kill them and remove this evil from Israel. But the people of Benjamin paid no attention to the other Israelites.

dag: zaɣ yino ku paai n ni daa po ni n ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.

dag: Dama zaligu maa nyɛla firila, ka wuhibu maa mi nyɛ neesim, ka zuɣu ni kpahibu din wuhiri biɛrisuŋ la mi nyɛ nyɛvili.
en: Your parents give you commands and teachings that are like lights to show you the right way. This teaching corrects you and trains you to follow the path to life.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa wurim ba nimaani n-kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka bɛ daa chɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu.
en: Then the LORD dispersed them from there over all of the earth, and they stopped building the city.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yila ninsalinim kaya mini bɛ wuhibu ni na, ka nir yi dol li di ni ti kpalim yoli.
en: All these refer to things which become useless once they are used; they are only human rules and teachings.

dag: n-yiini Naawuni dabili Musa mini Piɛbil la yilli n-yɛra, Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, Zallakudura Naa, a tuma nyɛla tuun kara ni alahiziba tuma! Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa ŋɔ, a soya nyɛla din tuhi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli!.
en: and singing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: Lord God Almighty, how great and wonderful are your deeds! King of the nations, how right and true are your ways!.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o paɣ maa, N yɛlila Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la, Zaŋm a wain tihi puu ŋɔ n-kɔhi n zuɣu bee a yi bɔra, n ni taɣ a wain tihi pu shɛli, ka o yɛli ma, N ku zaŋ n wain tihi ti a. .
en: He answered, Because of what Naboth said to me. I offered to buy his vineyard or, if he preferred, to give him another one for it, but he told me that I couldn't have it.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛl Yawɛ sani, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn be tibi yi suhuri ni mi, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu.
en: You that are righteous, be glad and rejoice because of what the Lord has done. You that obey him, shout for joy!.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka wula ka n ni yɛli? N ni yɛli, M Ba, chɛ ka saha ŋɔ miligi n zuɣu? Aai, dama di zuɣu ka n kana nti kpalim beni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Now my heart is troubled—and what shall I say? Shall I say, Father, do not let this hour come upon me? But that is why I came—so that I might go through this hour of suffering.

dag: O bela tampima shee, ka zaŋ tampin choya zuɣusaa leeg o yiŋa.
en: They dwell on an outcropping of rock, their fortress on rocks edge.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali Gɛrishɔn zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Also, the Gershonite family group was counted.

dag: Zoya nyɛligirimi kaman kpam la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ dunia zaa Duuma ŋɔ tooni.
en: The mountains melt like wax before the LORD, before the Lord of the whole world!.

dag: Ka Shimɛi yɛli naa, N dana, a ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla. Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm ka di yuui pam.
en: Shimei said to the king, This is a good idea. Your servant will do just what my master the king said. So Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.

dag: Amaa yinim ti miriya! Dinzuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: Be on your guard! I have told you everything ahead of time.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yoli, di daa muɣisi ba ni bɛ tooi gooi niriba maa ka bɛ ku mali ba maligu maa.
en: Even after saying all this, Paul and Barnabas still could hardly stop the people from offering sacrifices to them.

dag: Ka a baŋsim maa zuɣu ni chɛ ka Masia ni daa kpi a mabi so ŋun ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: And so this weak person, your brother for whom Christ died, will perish because of your knowledge!.

dag: Mani ka Yawɛ daa daŋ nambu o tuma piligu ni, din daa nyɛ o tuuli tuma kurimbuni ha.
en: The Lord created me first of all, the first of his works, long ago.

dag: Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Iru mini Ɛla ni Naam; ka Ɛla mi bidibiga daa nyɛ Kɛnaz.
en: Caleb was Jephunnehs son. Calebs sons were Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elahs son was Kenaz.

dag: ka Obɛd, dɔɣi Jɛsi, ka Jɛsi mi dɔɣi Naa Dauda.
en: Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.

dag: nti yɛli ba: Yinim Juda nanim mini Judanim zaa ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa bɛn doli dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpɛra, Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: and say to them: Listen to the LORDs word, you kings of Judah, all you people of Judah, and anyone living in Jerusalem who passes through these gates.

dag: Ka Gɛhaazi daa daŋ tooni nti zaŋ jaaŋgbee maa pa bia maa ninni, amaa ka vuhim bee nyɛvili shɛhirili kani. Dinzuɣu ka o daa ŋmaligi labina ti tuhi Ilaisha soli n-yɛl o, Bia maa bi neei.
en: Gehazi went on ahead and held Elisha's stick over the child, but there was no sound or any other sign of life. So he went back to meet Elisha and said, The boy didn't wake up.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a wuntitali biɛhigu la zuɣu, karimi saria n-ti ma nasara; di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma.
en: You are righteous, O Lord , so declare me innocent; don't let my enemies gloat over me.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka ka dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni, ka mali yɛm ni baŋsim din ni tooi bɔhim baŋ viɛnyɛliŋga; ka bɛ zaŋ ba niŋ nayili ka bɛ tumdi tuma. Ashpɛnaz n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhi ba Babilɔnnim yɛtɔɣa karimbu mini di sabbu.
en: They had to be handsome, intelligent, well-trained, quick to learn, and free from physical defects, so that they would be qualified to serve in the royal court. Ashpenaz was to teach them to read and write the Babylonian language.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali: Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu; din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li? Ka bɛ daa fo.
en: Then he asked, On the Sabbath should we do good deeds or evil deeds? Should we save someone's life or destroy it? But no one said a word.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim maa daa tooi niŋ bɛ dimnim maa bɛ ni bɔri shɛm. Bɛ daa zaŋla takɔbiri ku bɛ dimnim maa.
en: The Jews took their swords and did away with their enemies, without showing any mercy.

dag: Vihiriba maa yi ti gindi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti nya ninsal kɔba luɣ shɛli, ŋun bom bini dalim nimaani hal ka kasiɣiriba ti kana ti zaŋ li sɔɣi Hamɔngɔg.
en: As they go up and down the country, every time they find a human bone, they will put a marker beside it so that the gravediggers can come and bury it in the Valley of Gog's Army.

dag: N vuhim shee m-bɔŋɔ sahakam; kpe ka n yɛn be, dama n yuri li.
en: This is where I will live forever; this is where I want to rule.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka bɛ boli kalima maa yuli, Kalima din wari ginda.
en: These wheels were what I heard called, the area between the wheels.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa balim ba pam; ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi dol o kpe o yiŋa; ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi, ka o zaŋ li niŋ ba saani ka bɛ di.
en: But Lot kept insisting, until they finally agreed and went home with him. He quickly baked some bread, cooked a meal, and they ate.

dag: Dama Naawuni pala gutula ŋun ni lihi yaɣi yi tuma zuɣu bee n-lihi yaɣi yurilim shɛli yi ni wuhir o ka sɔŋdi ŋun Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda hal ka na kul niŋdi lala hal ni pɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: God is not unfair. He will not forget the work you did or the love you showed for him in the help you gave and are still giving to other Christians.

dag: Musa mini Izraɛlnim ni daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni n-kumdi saha shɛli maa, ka Izraɛl do so daa zaŋ Midian paɣ na ti kpe o suɣili ni bɛ zaa ninni.
en: One of the Israelites took a Midianite woman into his tent in the sight of Moses and the whole community, while they were mourning at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka chua ni mali ninvuɣ so daa ʒi Yisa tooni.
en: A man whose legs and arms were swollen came to Jesus.

dag: Ka ŋariŋ maa kpatoonsi maa daa bɔri ni bɛ yi n-zo n-tiligi, ka daa sirigi ŋarim bil din be ŋariŋ maa ni la pa kom zuɣu n-niŋ kaman bɛ yɛn zaŋla kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani la bahi ŋariŋ maa tooni polo ka zaŋ ŋarim bil maa n-zo n-tiligi.
en: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.

dag: Ka binshɛŋa din pahi nyɛla, n suhu kul zɔhirila cheechinim zaa zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni bi baptaizi yi ni so maa zuɣu, naɣ gbaai yihila Krispus mini Gaiɔs kɔŋko.
en: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi: Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: And so I say to you: Ask, and you will receive; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

dag: Ninsalinima m-be o sani maa, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ m-be ti sani ni o sɔŋ ti ka tuhi ti tɔb kam ti ti. Ka Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpaŋsi niriba maa suhuri pam.
en: He has human power, but we have the Lord our God to help us and to fight our battles. The people were encouraged by these words of their king.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ deeg o suhigu, dama o daa nya nahiŋgu shɛli Siria naa ni nahindi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: But Jehoahaz sought the LORDs presence, and the LORD listened to him because he saw how badly Arams king was oppressing Israel.

dag: Ti ni daa du duli tiligi maa, ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl ti ni bɛ ya maa yuli m-booni Malta.
en: When we were safely ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.

dag: ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ karit alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira.
en: and to have authority to throw out demons.

dag: Ka maligumaana mi kul ku kɔŋ Lɛvi zuliya ni ŋun ni zani n tooni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara maligunim maani maligunim sahakam.
en: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.

dag: ka sakuɣa lu n-sabigi ŋari di kɔsoya la.
en: In the winter, it is choked with ice and melting snow.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa ni bɛ yinsinim zaŋ tabili ŋun Dauda paɣiba ayi la, Ahinɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la mini Nabal pakoli Abigeel ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la zaa daa be Gaat Akishi sani.
en: David, his men, and their families lived in Gath with Achish. David had his two wives with him—Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel. Abigail was the widow of Nabal.

dag: Di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sabi o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will suffer what the Scriptures say will happen to him. But it will be very bad for the one who hands over the Son of Man to be killed. It would be better for him if he had never been born.

dag: Ka o mam ŋun daa be Shɛkɛm gba daa dɔɣ o bidib yino, ka o bol o yuli Abimilɛk.
en: He also had a concubine in Shechem; she bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ ba lala hal ni Kadɛshibarinia zaŋ ti paai Gaza zaŋ tabili Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali lala hal ti paai Gibiɔn.
en: Joshua struck them down from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and the whole land of Goshen as far as Gibeon.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya, ka a kari dol ti n-kuri ti ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.

dag: O daa kul muɣisirila sokam. Wɔɣira mini tarimba ni bundaannim mini faranim ni bilichinnim mini daba ni o dalim ba bɛ nudiriti ni bee bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves.

dag: Niriba ayi laɣim be so ninvuɣ yino, dama bɛ ni tooi tum bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Two are better than one because they have a good return for their hard work.

dag: Ka Shallum Jabɛshi bia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo n-daa ŋme o luhi Ibiliam n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Shallum son of Jabesh made plans against Zechariah. Shallum killed Zechariah in Ibleam. Shallum became the new king.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa gariti ŋɔ, yi baɣa kani? Lihimiya nya, so suhugarigu na mi m-paai n suhugarigu ŋɔ? Suhugarigu shɛli din paai ma, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛli ti ma o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam dahin shɛl la.
en: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord , and you punished me worst of all.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zalizali.
en: The Israelites will camp each in their own place under the banner of their own military unit.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni, ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has given me all things. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi taba, O ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla maa gbinni lee nyɛla wula? Ti bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: What does this a little while mean? We don't know what he is talking about.

dag: n ni zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba nuu ni. Bɛ niŋgbuna ni ti leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: I will hand over to their enemies who seek to kill them. And their corpses will become food for birds and wild animals.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri teeku maa n-chɛ ka kom maa nahi tab yaha n-lim Ijiptinim maa n-tabili bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛ chɛchɛbunduhiriba maa zaa.
en: The Lord told Moses, Stretch your arm toward the sea—the water will cover the Egyptians and their cavalry and chariots.

dag: Bɛn yɛn pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya. Manaasa niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl.
en: On one side of him is the tribe of Manasseh. The chief of the people of Manasseh is Gamaliel, Pedahzurs son.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: Joab went, and she asked, Are you Joab? Yes, I am, he answered. Listen to me, sir, she said. I'm listening, he answered.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, dilan ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa bi gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gil li ka di dii lu zaa, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: But anyone who hears what I say and doesn't obey me is like someone whose house wasn't built on solid rock. As soon as the river rushed against that house, it was smashed to pieces!.

dag: N kul ni paɣir a, dama a wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Let my lips overflow with praise because youve taught me your statutes.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛb ti mmaŋa, ka bɛ kul ni yiini yila paɣiri ma.
en: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.

dag: Ka a niriba ŋɔ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, , ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka a chɛ ka bɛ dimnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba ka gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya din be katiŋ bee din be yoma.
en: Your people will sin against you. I know this because everyone sins. And you will be angry with your people. You will let their enemies defeat them. Their enemies will make them prisoners and carry them to some faraway land.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chani ti miri Jɛriko, ka zoon so daa ʒi sokpaŋ maani bara.
en: As Jesus was coming near Jericho, there was a blind man sitting by the road, begging.

dag: Tiŋkpambila n-daa beni, ka di puuni niriba bi galisi. Ka na titali daa ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi na ti teei gili tiŋ maa, ka mɛri bindura gindi di gooni.
en: There was a small town with a few people in it. A great king fought against that town and put his armies all around it.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ yi ti yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ ni yɛli paɣ ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ teer o yɛla.
en: I tell you the truth that, wherever in the whole world the good news is announced, what shes done will also be told in memory of her.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus said to them, I have a question for you. Give me an answer, then Ill tell you what kind of authority I have to do these things.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka n ni baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma. Dina n-nyɛ: a bi chɛ ka n dimnim nyaŋ ma.
en: Dont let my enemy defeat me. Then I will know that you care for me.

dag: ti yɛli ma, Pool, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. A ni bahi paai Naa Siiza tooni. Nyama, Naawuni ni tilig a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɛ ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni nyɛviya a zuɣu.
en: The angel said, Paul, dont be afraid! You must stand before Caesar. And God has given you this promise: He will save the lives of all those sailing with you.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi teeku la tula yuŋ maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim n-chɛ ka Lɛviatan suhu yiɣisir la.
en: May those who curse the day curse it, those with enough skill to awaken Leviathan.

dag: Yawɛ, n zaŋ tiliginsim lahiba suŋ la yɛla n-yɛli niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni. Yawɛ, nyama, a mi ni n kul ku fo n noli zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, Our Lord always helps.

dag: Jɛrigu n-yihiri suhuyiɣisili palo ni. Amaa yɛndan ŋun kul gbib li la baalim.
en: Stupid people express their anger openly, but sensible people are patient and hold it back.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yi ŋmahi puu ni olivi tiwul shɛŋa bahi, ka zaŋ nyin ŋun nyɛ mɔɣu ni olivi tia na nti tuɣ li ni a nyu puu ni olivi tia maa sum.
en: If some of the branches were broken off, and you were a wild olive branch, and you were grafted in among the other branches and shared the root that produces the rich oil of the olive tree.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka yi ni ti lo noli goli maa daba awɛi dali zaawuni. Yi ni ti gbibila yi Vuhim Dabisili maa zaawuni hal ti lan paai zaawuni.
en: From sunset on the ninth day of the month to sunset on the tenth observe this day as a special day of rest, during which nothing may be eaten.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi nya filiŋ, ka niriba zaa ʒiɛm ya ka filim ya yi ni bi doli n soya, amaa ka chɛ ka niriba gaŋbu be yi wuhibu ni la zuɣu.
en: Moreover, I have made you despised and humiliated in the view of all the people, since none of you keep my ways or show respect for Instruction.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb yi niŋdi din wuhiri ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni ka di nyɛla daliri suŋ zuɣu, din nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli sahakam, din dee yi pala n yi ti be yi sani kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: However, its always good to have people concerned about you with good intentions, and not just when Im there with you.

dag: Ka Ziɔnnim wum li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka Juda fɔntinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ, a ni kariti saria shɛm zuɣu.
en: Zion, listen and be happy! Cities of Judah, be glad! Rejoice because the Lord s decisions are fair.

dag: Amaa kul zoomiyala ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia daanfaani min o baŋbu puuni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: But continue to grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory, now and forever! Amen.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni ŋme n-saɣim Damaskus duno kara, ka kari Avɛn vinvamlinim mini Bɛtɛdɛn naa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Sirianim kuli Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: I will break the fortified gates of Damascus, and eliminate the people from the Aven Valley, including the one who rules from Beth-eden; the people of Aram will be forced to live in Kir, says the LORD.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari shihira ŋɔ zaa, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: So when you see all these things happening, you will know the time has almost come.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ ti ba ninvuɣ so ŋun ni fa ba bahi, ka o daa fa ba bahi. Dilana n-nyɛ Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bia la.
en: But then they cried out to the LORD. So the LORD raised up a deliverer for the Israelites, Othniel, Kenazs son, Calebs younger brother, who rescued them.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa guui kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn tampiŋ la gbini nti kpalim be nimaani chira anahi.
en: But six hundred men were able to escape to the open country to Rimmon Rock, and they stayed there four months.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa gbaai Reechɛl kpariŋ mɔɣisi ka kum suhupiɛlli kuhigu pam.
en: Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Aduna min o bidibisi tarili bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba zali ni bɛ leei man Yawɛ maligumaaniba la, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ba.
en: Those parts from the gifts offered to the Lord were given to Aaron and his sons. Whenever Aaron and his sons serve as the Lord s priests, they get that share of the sacrifices.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛn tuui chɛ ka Hozia zaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnima, o daa yɛlila ŋun Hozia, Cham ti kpuɣi pagɔrili n-dɔɣi pagɔrili bihi. Dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim tum yolimyolim pam ka zaɣisi man Yawɛ, ka bi ʒe ma yim.
en: This was the Lord s first message to Hosea. The Lord said, Go, marry a prostitute who has had children as a result of her prostitution. Do this because the people in this country have acted like prostitutes—they have been unfaithful to the Lord .

dag: Naa bi diri nasara tɔb ni la o tɔbbihi galisim zuɣu, ka tɔbutuhiri biiŋa mi bi diri nasara la o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.

dag: Ka Asiria naa maa daa gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli Asiria nti zaŋ ba ʒili Hala mini Habɔr Mɔɣili duli din be Gɔzan yaɣili polo la ni Miidianim fɔntinsi ni.
en: The king of Assyria took the Israelites away as prisoners; he forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.

dag: Ka ti suhiri Naawuni ni yi di tum birigi, ka di pala din wuhiri ni tinim nyaŋla timaŋ buɣisibu, amaa di lee nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi tum din tuhi hal di ni kul be kaman ti nyɛla bɛn bi nyaŋ timaŋ buɣisibu maa la.
en: We pray to God that you dont do anything wrong, not because we want to appear to pass the test but so that you might do the right thing, even if we appear to fail.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim kpuɣiri paɣiba ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: Jesus said to them, People who belong to this age marry and are given in marriage.

dag: N shɛla buɣu m-pɔbi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ n yaa sɔŋ taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.

dag: Ti leela kpibisi bɛn ka banima; ti manim nyɛla pakoya.
en: Our fathers have been killed by the enemy, and now our mothers are widows.

dag: dama tibili zahindi yɛtɔɣa kaman zilinli ni zahindi bindira shɛm la.
en: You know good food when you taste it, but not wise words when you hear them.

dag: Ka o daa dii gbaai nachimbil maa m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka lih o ninni ka bi zɔri vi ka yɛl o.
en: She threw her arms around the young man, kissed him, looked him straight in the eye, and said.

dag: Malimiya firilanim ayopɔin tam di zuɣu, ka di ne di tooni.
en: Make seven lamps for the lampstand and set them up so that they shine toward the front.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Lɛvinim ni bɛ malim bɛmaŋa m-be kasi n-kana ti guli dunoya maa, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gbib Vuhim Dabisili maa kasi. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ gba yɛla ka tiligi ma a yurilim din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: I ordered the Levites to purify themselves and to go and guard the gates to make sure that the Sabbath was kept holy. Remember me, O God, for this also, and spare me because of your great love.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb tinzun tiŋ ni maa ni ti yɛli ya, Ti ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ pɔra; bomiya palo pahi ti ka ti ʒini.
en: You will again hear the children who were born bereaved say, The place is too crowded for me; make room for me to settle.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ti ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka kul ni kpalim bela ninvuɣubiɛtali maa tuma ni. Naɣila bɛn mali yɛm kɔŋko n-ni ti baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Hiburɔn din be Juda tiŋgban ni mini di momaha tiŋgbana din gil li la ti ba.
en: They were given the town of Hebron and the fields around it. This was in the area of Judah.

dag: Dama m mali yɛtɔɣa pam, ka n ku chɛ li tɔɣisibu.
en: I have so much to say that I cannot hold it in.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋ o tɔbbi kpɛma zaa chaŋ bɛ tuhibu.
en: David heard of it and sent Joab against them with the whole army.

dag: Banima n-lee ni tooi du n-tam Yawɛ dabol la zuɣu? Bee banima n-lee ni tooi zan o luɣ kasi la shee?.
en: Who can ascend the LORDs mountain? Who can stand in his holy sanctuary?.

dag: Azimavɛt — pihinahinaayi.
en: The family of Azmaveth.

dag: A chɛ ka n dolintab kaɣiri ma mi, a chɛ ka n leela bɛ ni zaɣisi so. Bɛ kpari ma mi niŋ duu, ka n ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: You have caused my friends to abandon me; you have made me repulsive to them. I am closed in and cannot escape;.

dag: Ka Samsin bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, M poya ni n ku chɛn ya, faashee ka m bɔhi ya biɛri labisi ka naanyi chɛ.
en: Samson told them, So this is how you act! I swear that I won't stop until I pay you back.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa suhi alibarika niŋ Kalɛb ni; ka zaŋ Hiburɔn ti ŋun Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la ni o su li.
en: So Joshua blessed him. He gave Hebron to Caleb, Jephunnehs son, as a legacy.

dag: O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm, dama n yiŋnim yɛn malila sara ti ya, ka m biɛli yɛli ni n kana. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a yi baŋ ni a nini tiɣi ma, nyin chɛ ka n chaŋ ti nya m biɛyanim maa. Lala zuɣu ka o bi ka nyin naa bindirigu ŋɔ dibu shee na maa.
en: He said, Let me go. Our family is having a sacrifice in Bethlehem. My brother ordered me to be there. Now if I am your friend, please let me go and see my brothers. That is why David has not come to the kings table.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛ ka yi suhuri doya, dama yi ni so ku kɔŋ o nyɛvili, amaa naɣila ŋariŋ ŋɔ kɔŋko n-naɣ ni saɣim.
en: But now I beg you to cheer up, because you will be safe. Only the ship will be lost.

dag: N gom shee ka n daa nya ti titali ʒii puuni ka di kul ʒe dunia sunsuuni.
en: These are the visions I saw while I was lying in my bed: I looked, and there in front of me was a tree standing in the middle of the earth. The tree was very tall.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam daa chɛ o dolibu.
en: At this, many of his disciples turned away and no longer accompanied him.

dag: Chɛ ka vi di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! N-yɛwaa! la.
en: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, Just look at you now.

dag: Nir ni dɔɣi bi shɛb o bipolitali ni ŋmanila piɛma din be tɔbutuhira nuu ni.
en: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Giliad mini Bashan ni di fɔntinsi ni zaa ni Sharɔn tiŋgban ni luɣ shɛŋa din daa mali biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zaa.
en: They lived in Gilead, in Bashan and in its towns, and as far as the boundaries of all the open lands of Sharon.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi yi yaannim ni daa ku anab shɛb gbala.
en: It will be bad for you, because you build tombs for the prophets. But these are the same prophets your ancestors killed!.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni fabili Mɔabnim zuɣu. N ni kum Mɔabnim zaa zuɣu pam, ka fabili Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu.
en: So I will cry and mourn for Moab and its town of Kir-Heres.

dag: Sujee nyɛla putɔɣu, ka suhuyiɣisili kɔŋ tim, amaa nyuli zabbu m-bie n-gari di zaa.
en: Anger is cruel and can destroy like a flood, but jealousy is much worse.

dag: dama yi daazichi ni be shɛli, nimaani ka yi suhuri gba ni be.
en: Your heart will always be where your treasure is.

dag: Chɛ ka zoya zuɣu niŋ bindira ka di niŋ niriba anfaani pam, ka chɛ ka wuntitali mi yi zahira daboya zuɣu.
en: Let there be peace and justice throughout the land, known on every mountain and hill.

dag: M mabiyurisi, yi yi nyari wahala din be kaman buɣim ka di paari ya ni di buɣisi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya kaman di nyɛla din na ʒi n-niŋ so n-niŋdi ya maa.
en: My dear friends, do not be surprised at the painful test you are suffering, as though something unusual were happening to you.

dag: Ka yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa yihi Jɛrimia ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The commanding officer took me aside and said, The Lord your God threatened this land with destruction.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa wum ni Itiɔpia naa Tirihaka mini Ijipti tɔbbihi kanna ni bɛ ti tuh o. O ni daa wum lala maa, ka o tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani.
en: Then the king of Assyria got a report that said, King Tirhakah of Ethiopia is coming to fight you. So the king of Assyria sent messengers to Hezekiah again.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun nya nahiŋgu pam, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga fiɛbbu ni maa.
en: I am a man who has seen much trouble. God beat us with a stick, and I saw it happen.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa yɔrigu yo n-zaŋ li zali luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee maa.
en: Put the lid on the Covenant Box.

dag: Wummiya, dama n yɛn tɔɣisila bintitaŋa yɛtɔɣ viɛla, ka din yɛn yi n noli ni na nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Listen, I have something important to say, and I am telling you what is right.

dag: bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili dukpina maa zaa gili, ka dur ata maa zaa daa mali takɔriti ti kpa. Di takɔriti maa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔbia polo, bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili di tiŋ polo gili hal ti taɣi di takɔriti.
en: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn kabisila Ɛlamnim tɔbiri din nyɛ bɛ yaa la.
en: He said, I will kill all the archers who have made Elam so powerful.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni nam binshɛŋa galisiya pam. A yɛm puuni ka a nam di zaa. A binnɛma n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Our Lord , by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.

dag: Ka na palo daa ti di Ijipti, ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu.
en: Now a new king came to power in Egypt who didnt know Joseph.

dag: Dahin shɛli, kaman kurig ata saha ka o nini daa ti nya Naawuni malaika ʒii ka o kpɛr o sanna ka bol o, Kɔniilius.
en: One afternoon about three oclock, Cornelius had a vision. He clearly saw an angel from God coming to him and saying, Cornelius.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka zuliya shɛli niriba yi katiŋa dunia ŋɔ tariga n-kabina ti lu yi zuɣu kaman tɔrili la, bɛ ni ti nyɛla yi ni bi wumdi zuliya shɛb yɛtɔɣa.
en: The Lord will bring a nation from far away to fight you. You will not understand their language. They will come quickly, like an eagle coming down from the sky.

dag: Tiligim ma takɔb kum ni, fam n nyɛvili baa nuu ni bahi.
en: Save me from the sword. Save my precious life from these dogs.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ shɛli n ni wum Naawuni sani, dina ka m mali tɔɣisiri ya ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma maa, amaa Ibrahimma daa bi niŋdi lala.
en: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Ilaija, ka o yiɣisi zo ni o tilig o nyɛvili. O daa zaŋla o tumo la n-zo n-kuli Bɛrishiiba din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti chɛ o nimaani.
en: When Elijah heard this, he was afraid. So he ran away to save his life. He took his servant with him, and they went to Beersheba in Judah. Then Elijah left his servant in Beersheba.

dag: N dabisa chani yomyom gari kpalua gombo, ka m paari di tariga, ka tahima kani.
en: My days pass by without hope, pass faster than a weaver's shuttle.

dag: Jɛrimia daa sabila yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa zaa din yɛn lu Babilɔnnim zuɣu mini yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa sabi zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo la.
en: I wrote in a book an account of all the destruction that would come on Babylonia, as well as all these other things about Babylonia.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ʒiri, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tuma nyɛla vidibo mini filiŋ nyabu.
en: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ ti paai di yuma anu saha, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa kana ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: In the fifth year that Rehoboam was king, King Shishak of Egypt came to attack Jerusalem.

dag: N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Taasus, Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa n zoola Gamaliɛl sani ya ŋɔ; ka bɔhim n yaannim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya yɛla o sani, ka n suhu ye Naawuni zuɣu kaman yi zaa ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Paul continued, Im a Jew, born in Tarsus in Cilicia but raised in this city. Under Gamaliels instruction, I was trained in the strict interpretation of our ancestral Law. I am passionately loyal to God, just like you who are gathered here today.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi bidibikpamba bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: All the oldest males over one month old, recorded by name according to their enrollment, were .

dag: Bɛ daa zab Musa nyuli bɛ sansan ni, ka zab Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ kasi la gba nyuli.
en: But then they were jealous of Moses in the camp, jealous too of Aaron, the LORDs holy one.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ti wumla dabiɛm mini abirima lubu kuhigu, pa suhudoo kuhigu.
en: This is what the Lord said: We hear people crying from fear. There is fear, not peace.

dag: yɛli, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ tum alahiziba tuun karili ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nya li, ka ti ku tooi chihi li.
en: What should we do with these men? Everyone living in Jerusalem is aware of the sign performed through them. Its obvious to everyone and we cant deny it.

dag: Binshɛɣukam bɛn vuri bɛ puya zuɣu bee bɛn mali nab anahi zaa chana bee binshɛɣukam bɛn mali napɔn bɔbili, biŋgbamda zaa bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni, di dinya ba, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira.
en: You must not eat any of the reptiles that crawl on their bellies or that walk on all four feet or that have many feet. Dont eat these animals!.

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam daa kpuɣ kuɣili din ŋmani nɛ titali m-bahi teeku puuni ha ka yɛra, Lala ka nyin Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ ti shiri yɛn lu n-wurim zaa, ka so ti ku lan mi a zaashee yaha!.
en: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.

dag: Bɛ yirimi chani bɛ tuma ni kaman mɔɣu ni bunsi m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la m-bɔri bindirigu tiŋgban shɛli din chaɣisi puuni ni bɛ ti ti bɛ bihi.
en: So the poor, like wild donkeys, search for food in the dry wilderness; nowhere else can they find food for their children.

dag: A mini bɛn zɔri bɛ naba zuɣu yi zɔri ka di wum a, wula ka a mini yuri ni tooi kpaɣi zo? Ka a yi ku zani viɛnyɛliŋga palo ni, wula ka a lee yɛn tooi zani viɛnyɛliŋga Jɔɔdɛn nyɔŋ puuni?.
en: The Lord said, Jeremiah, if you get tired racing against people, how can you race against horses? If you can't even stand up in open country, how will you manage in the jungle by the Jordan?.

dag: Ka suhupiɛlli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Antiɔk Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri.
en: The believers in Antioch were full of joy and the Holy Spirit.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba tahi naa sanna.
en: In a violent rage Nebuchadnezzar ordered them to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. They were brought before the king.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Naawuni ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di kari doli bɛ gbini, amaa ŋmam bɛ noli nti liri ba balisam tihi la tooni.
en: David prayed to God again, and God answered his prayer. God said, David, dont follow the Philistines up the hill when you attack. Instead, go around them and hide on the other side of the balsam trees.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ anabinim polo: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi. N ŋmanila ŋun nyu dam kuli ka ŋmani ŋun nyu wain buɣi, Yawɛ min o yɛligu kasi zuɣu.
en: As for the prophets: My heart inside me is broken; my body aches. I stagger like a drunk who has had too much wine to drink, because of the LORD and because of Gods holy words.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya niriba ni o nyaandoliba n-kana ti zu n-yih o yuŋ saha shɛli yi ni daa ʒeei gom.
en: and said, You are to say that his disciples came during the night and stole his body while you were asleep.

dag: Ka timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni laasabuniŋdiba daa laɣim na ka n ti yɛli ba n zahindi maa, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: So the dream interpreters, enchanters, Chaldeans, and diviners came. I told them the dream, but they couldnt interpret it for me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zaligunim maa zaa dolibu, ka nyɛligi binyara malila naɣibih ayi kɔtomsi zali; ka lan mali Ashɛra binnana zali, ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi mini Baal.
en: They deserted all the commandments of the LORD their God. They made themselves two metal idols cast in the shape of calves and made a sacred pole. They bowed down to all the heavenly bodies. They served Baal.

dag: N yɛm puuni ka n zaŋ baŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa. N daa yɛliya, N ni niŋ yɛndana, amaa ka m mini di shee ti wɔɣa.
en: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.

dag: Ka kpambal so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti boli Mikaya na maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa ni naai noli yɛli shɛm nyɛla din doli naa suhu ni yu shɛm. A gba kul yɛlimi la din tiɣi naa nini kaman bɛ zaa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: While this was happening, the officer went to find Micaiah. When he found him, the officer told him, All the other prophets have said that the king will succeed, so you should say the same thing.

dag: Pahimiya n zuɣu ka ti tibigi Yawɛ, ka chɛliya ka ti laɣim duh o.
en: Praise the Lord with me. Let us honor his name.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mini noon shɛb bɛn be kasi balibu kam mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Noah built an altar to the Lord ; he took one of each kind of ritually clean animal and bird, and burned them whole as a sacrifice on the altar.

dag: nti mali Lɛvi nir ŋun nyɛ maligumaana mini sariakarita ŋun be tuma ni di dabisa maa ni saawara, ka bɛ ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm.
en: Go to the levitical priests and to the head judge in office at that time and look into things there. They will announce to you the correct ruling.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa nyaaŋa gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa paai Sinai tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: The people of Israel left Rephidim, and on the first day of the third month after they had left Egypt they came to the desert of Sinai. There they set up camp at the foot of Mount Sinai.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Chimham ni doli ma kuli ka n ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, ka a suhu ni kul yu ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: The king said, Okay. Chimham will cross over with me, and I will treat him as I think best. And I will do for you anything you desire from me.

dag: Amaa bɛn zo n-tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka di be kasi. Ka Yaakubu zuliya ni ti lan deei bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ la su yaha.
en: But on Mount Zion some will escape, and it will be a sacred place. The people of Jacob will possess the land that is theirs by right.

dag: dama n nini nya a tiliginsim shɛli.
en: because my eyes have seen your salvation.

dag: ka Hilikia nyɛ Amizi bia, ka Amizi nyɛ Bani bia, ka Bani nyɛ Shɛmɛr bia.
en: Amzi, Bani, Shemer.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Faashee ka a po. Ka Iso daa shiri po, ka zaŋ o kpamdi maa ti Yaakubu.
en: Jacob answered, First make a vow that you will give me your rights. Esau made the vow and gave his rights to Jacob.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti ka a sanna ka bi mali wuhibu ŋɔ na, nyin di saɣi ka o kpe a yiŋa; a mi di puhi lala nira.
en: Dont accept those who come to you but do not bring this teaching. Dont invite them into your house. Dont welcome them in any way.

dag: ka Yisa mabihi yɛl o, Yim kpe chaŋ Judia ka di chɛ ka a nyaandoliba nya tuun shɛŋa a ni tumdi ŋɔ.
en: Jesus brothers said to him, Leave Galilee. Go to Judea so that your disciples can see the amazing works that you do.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma ti kpe dundombil ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: A wind picked me up and brought me to the inner courtyard, and there the LORDs glory filled the temple.

dag: Niriba pam bɔri ni naa yuri ba, amaa Yawɛ sani ka nir nyari din niŋ kamaata.
en: Everybody wants the good will of the ruler, but only from the Lord can you get justice.

dag: O lan nyɛla bɛn guni gba yaba, ka di pala bɛ ni guni maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa ka di lee nyɛla bɛ gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na bi guni ka niŋ yɛda shɛm la zuɣu.
en: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised.

dag: O ni ti nyo Ijipti buɣa duri buɣim ka zaŋ bɛ buɣa maa kuli. O ni ti gbahi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim kahikahi kaman piɛgula ni gbahiri jɛbɔbiri o situra ni kahikahi shɛm la n-yi nimaani kuli ni alaafee.
en: He will set on fire the temples of the Egyptian gods. He will burn them down and carry off their gods. He will wrap the land of Egypt around himself, just as a shepherd wraps his garment around himself, and he will move on unharmed.

dag: Ka gbani tiŋ kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, chɛli niriba ŋɔ daalahichi ŋɔ paŋ ba. O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka dii bahi.
en: He fell on his knees and shouted, Lord, dont blame them for this sin! These were his last words before he died.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ o ba yiŋ Ofira nti ku o ba bihi ninvuɣ pisopɔin bɛn nyɛ Gidiɔn bidibisi la tampin yini zuɣu. Amaa ka Jɔtam ŋun daa nyɛ Gidiɔn kaluɣ la ŋun daa sɔɣi, ka bɛ bi nya o ku o.
en: Abimelech and his soldiers went to his father's home in Ophrah and brought out Gideon's other sons to a large rock, where they murdered all of them. Gideon's youngest son Jotham hid from the soldiers, but he was the only one who escaped.

dag: Ka niriba pam ni ti doli karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ kɔr biɛri soya, ka bɛ biɛhigu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalim yɛlimaŋli sol la.
en: Many will follow them in their unrestrained immorality, and because of these false teachers the way of truth will be slandered.

dag: Ka m bo o nuzaa polo, ka o sɔɣi, ka n ku tooi nya o, ka n ŋmaligi nudirigu polo, amaa ka bi tooi nya o.
en: When he is working in the north, I dont see him. When he turns to the south, I still dont see him.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin zom ma nambɔɣu, ka n yiɣisi zani, m-bɔhi ba biɛri labisi.
en: Be merciful to me, Lord , and restore my health, and I will pay my enemies back.

dag: Di daba ayi nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ Galili;.
en: After two days Jesus left for Galilee. .

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz leei naa zal o ba zaani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The people of Judah chose Josiah's son Joahaz and anointed him king in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir o ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini ni, Bul goli ŋun nyɛ gol so ŋun pahir anii la ni ka bɛ daa me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka mali di binshɛɣukam kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi shɛm naai. Yuma ayopɔin ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: The Temple was finished in the month of Bul, the eighth month of the year, in Solomons eleventh year as king. It took seven years to build the Temple. It was built exactly as planned.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛn la daa ti labina ti yɛra, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kparigim ka ti gari.
en: Later the others arrived. Sir, sir! Let us in! they cried out.

dag: Di saha ka o paɣ daa bɔh o, A na kul gbibila a galimi kalinsi maa kirikiri? Tum Naawuni ka kpi.
en: his wife asked, Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die.

dag: Ka Pool daa yi chani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla, ka o daa lɛbigiri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tɛha.
en: Every Sabbath he interacted with people in the synagogue, trying to convince both Jews and Greeks.

dag: Chi sara dina, o bom chi lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa zuɣu, ka bo chi lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa zuɣu, o ni kul bɔri shɛm tariga ti, ka lan bo kpam lita ata pali pahi chi tahili kam zuɣu.
en: and he will provide a grain offering of one ephah each for the bull and the ram, and for the lambs as much as he likes, with one hin of oil for each ephah.

dag: Yi yi yihi di ni zaɣ viɛla zaka ka di li, yi bi tum taali. Amaa miriya ka yi ta Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri; yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: You will not bear guilt after you have presented the best portion. But you must not make the sacred gifts of the Israelites impure, on penalty of death.

dag: nti bɔhi, Ya polo ka bɛ ni dɔɣi Yɛhudianim Na so la lee be? Ti daa nyala o saŋmariga wulimpuhili polo, ka kana ni ti ti jɛm o.
en: They asked people, Where is the child who has been born to be the king of the Jews? We saw the star that shows he was born. We saw it rise in the sky in the east and have come to worship him.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba ni ti kari ba saria ka yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla sariakaritiba bɛn nyɛ bɛn niŋ zina ka ku niriba. Dama bɛ nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: But honest judges will someday accuse those two of murder and of being unfaithful, because they are certainly guilty.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim a ka yɛl a, Cham ti ku Amalɛknim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, ka tuhi kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: The Lord sent you on a special mission. He said, Go and destroy all the Amalekites. They are evil people. Destroy them all! Fight them until they are completely finished.

dag: Di saha Ijiptinim daa sɔɣirila bɛ bikpamba shɛb zaa Yawɛ ni daa ku la. Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ buɣa gba.
en: who were burying the first-born sons that the Lord had killed. By doing this, the Lord showed that he was more powerful than the gods of Egypt.
