dag: Inok ŋun daa nyɛ ʒiɛmani din pah ayopɔin din daa doli Adam saha nyaaŋa la nir la daa pun tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba ŋɔ polo. O ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya! Ti Duuma min o malaikanim tusatusa shɛm bɛn be kasi kanna.
en: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels.

dag: N niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ leela zaɣ sabinli ŋ-ŋmaari lura, ka tulim diri n kɔba.
en: My skin is burned and peeling away. My body is hot with fever.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bi simdi ni ti gbihiri kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti ne n-ʒiya ka gbibi ti maŋa.
en: So we should not be like other people. We should not be sleeping. We should be awake and have self-control.

dag: ka Yisa daa tim Pita mini Jɔn n-yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ puhibu shili gul ti, ka ti kana ti di di bindirigu.
en: Jesus sent Peter and John with this task: Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover meal.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ nachimbil maa kuli ni alaafee, ka bɛ suhuri daa maai pam.
en: Then the followers took the young man home alive and were very happy.

dag: Amaa o yidana yi wum pɔri maa yɛla ka bi yɛl o shɛli dabisili din paya dali, dindina di wuhiya ni o saɣ o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o niŋ shɛli maa, o ni daa wum di yɛla saha shɛli ka bi yɛl o shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: How does the husband let his wife keep her promises? If he hears about the promises and does not stop them, the woman must do exactly what she promised.

dag: Ka Mikaya yɛl o, A yi labina ni alaafee, dindina pa Yawɛ n-wuhi ma n ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka lan yɛli, Yinim salo ŋɔ zaa, wummiya n ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: If you return safely, Micaiah exclaimed, then the Lord has not spoken through me! And he added, Listen, everyone, to what I have said.

dag: O ni daa vuui Amasa niŋgbuŋ solɔɣu maa zuɣu maa nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa naanyi doli Jɔab n-lan gbaai Bikiri bia Shiiba la naba biɛhibu.
en: After the body had been removed from the road, everyone followed Joab in pursuit of Sheba.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Gbilisimiya tibili wum, chɛliya karimbaani.
en: People of Israel, the Lord has spoken! Be humble and listen to him.

dag: A tinsi din be kasi la mini Ziɔn leela dabari. Ka Jɛrusalɛm leei bɛ ni zo ka chɛ tin shɛli.
en: Your sacred cities are like a desert; Jerusalem is a deserted ruin.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as his father Manasseh had done.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋun taali tumbu zuɣu n-lee chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ ti paai ti ŋɔ? Yɛlim ti! Tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda? Tiŋkani ka a lee yina? Ka zuliya bɔ n-lee nyɛ a.
en: Then the men said to Jonah, It is your fault that this terrible thing is happening to us. Tell us, what have you done? What is your job? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people.

dag: Yinim Marɛshanima, n ni lan piɛli yi dim ŋun ni nyaŋ ya bahi yi zuɣu. Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mali jilima ni ti zo na ti sɔɣi Adulam.
en: People of Mareshah, the Lord will hand you over to an enemy, who is going to capture your town. The leaders of Israel will go and hide in the cave at Adullam.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuun shɛŋa din pahi fukumsi.
en: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent.

dag: Di saha Bɛtishɛmɛshinim daa bela vinvamli ni n-chɛri alikama, bɛ ni daa ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi nya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka di niŋ ba suhupiɛlli.
en: The people of Beth Shemesh were reaping wheat in the valley, when suddenly they looked up and saw the Covenant Box. They were overjoyed at the sight.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu lihi binshɛɣukam din be di ni, ka yuŋ ni daa zibira ka o min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi ni lab Bɛtani.
en: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went to the Temple. He looked at everything in the Temple area, but it was already late. So he went to Bethany with the twelve apostles.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan kana ti yɛli, Naawuni buɣim n-yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku piɛri la mini piɛguliba la zaa, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: That servant was still speaking, when a second one came running and said, God sent down a fire that killed your sheep and your servants. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: Ninvuɣ tuhili ni ti lu n-do a luɣili polo, ka tuhi pia lu n-do a nudirigu polo, amaa di ti ku miri nyin na.
en: Even if one thousand people fall dead next to you, ten thousand right beside you— it wont happen to you.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Filip, m min a ni be ka di yuui ŋ-ŋɔ ka a na bi mi ma? Ŋun nya ma, o nya m Ba; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni n wuhimi ya m Ba maa.
en: Jesus answered, For a long time I have been with you all; yet you do not know me, Philip? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. Why, then, do you say, Show us the Father?.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino daa kuhi yɛl o, Karimba, n suhir a mi ni a lihi m bia ŋɔ ti ma, dama o kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ m bia.
en: Just then someone in the crowd shouted, Teacher, please do something for my son! He is my only child!.

dag: Bɛ nina ku nya kulibɔna, kulibɔn shɛŋa din zɔri shiri mini bihim.
en: They will not live to see rivers of olive oil or streams that flow with milk and honey.

dag: n-zaŋ li bɔhi zuliya shɛb niriba biɛri, ka darigi niriba tibili;.
en: to get revenge against the nations and punishment on the peoples.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Nyama, n zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: You are now governor of all Egypt.

dag: ni Zanɔa ni Ɛnganim ni Tapua ni Ɛnam.
en: Zanoah, Engannim, Tappuah, Enam.

dag: ni bɛ ni je paɣ so yi kuli doo ni dab paɣisarili ŋun zan o lana ŋun nyɛ paɣa zaani.
en: a hateful woman who gets married, and a servant woman who takes the place of her mistress.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din bi tuhi ni yi nahim niriba.
en: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws.

dag: Yawɛ, n zaŋ tiliginsim lahiba suŋ la yɛla n-yɛli niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni. Yawɛ, nyama, a mi ni n kul ku fo n noli zaŋ chaŋ di polo.
en: I told the good news of victory to the people in the great assembly. And, Lord , you know that I will never stop telling that good news.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela o jɛmbu duu din be kasi puuni, chɛliya ka dunianim zaa fo o tooni.
en: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛda niŋbu yirila bɛ ni wum shɛl ni na, ka bɛ ni wum shɛli maa mi yirila Masia yɛla waazu yihibu ni na.
en: No one can have faith without hearing the message about Christ.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o wuhibu maa gari ba pam.
en: When the crowds heard this, they were amazed at his teaching.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan lihi nya do so ka o gbib bimbuɣisirigu o nuu ni.
en: This time I saw someone holding a measuring line.

dag: So ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba Naawuni ŋun tim ma na maa n-vo o tahina; ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim polo, bɛ saɣisiri ti ka ti luri ba sizuura. Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni ti deei ti Ba Naawuni saɣisigu ka be.
en: We have all had fathers here on earth who corrected us with discipline. And we respected them. So it is even more important that we accept discipline from the Father of our spirits. If we do this, we will have life.

dag: N kul malila suhupiɛlli a yɛligu zuɣu kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-di nɛma pam.
en: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.

dag: Dama yi yi bi pal alikauli zaŋ chaŋ laɣ yoya ŋɔ polo, ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi zaŋ azichi maŋli niŋ yi nuu ni?.
en: If you cannot be trusted with worldly riches, you will not be trusted with the true riches.

dag: Kom ni binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri n-nyɛ: Binshɛɣukam din be kom ni ka mali gɔhi mini paɣiri teekunim puuni bee kulibɔna ni, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: You may eat any kind of fish that has fins and scales.

dag: So yi zaŋ o yili ti Yawɛ ka di leei zaɣ kasi, maligumaana n-ni zali di daa ni nyɛ shɛm, maligumaana maa ni zali di daa ka di doli di ni viɛl shɛm bee di ni bi viɛl shɛm, ka maligumaana maa ni zali di daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: When someone dedicates their house to the LORD as holy, the priest will assign a value to it, whether high or low. The value is fixed, whatever value the priest assigns to it.

dag: ni Zɛla ni Hailɛf ni Jɛbusi; ni Gibia ni Kiriatijiarim: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaanahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: Zela, Haeleph, the Jebusite city , Gibeath, and Kiriath. In total: fourteen cities and their surrounding areas. This is the legacy of the Benjaminite clans.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n dabili Yaakubu zuliya Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Jacob, you are my servant. Israel, I chose you. Listen to me!.

dag: ka yɛri ni yinim yi di daa be yi yaannim saha la, yi daa naan ku pahi bɛ zuɣu ku anabinim maa.
en: And you claim you would not have taken part with your ancestors in killing the prophets.

dag: O daa lan tum alahiziba tuma Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: What wonderful things he did there! What amazing things at the Red Sea!.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa po pɔri yɛli ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ku lan zaŋ ba tahi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa la ni.
en: So I made a vow in the desert that I would not take them to the land I had given them, a rich and fertile land, the finest land of all.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni n ni wurim ba bahi katiŋa, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla;.
en: I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.

dag: ka bɛ daa lan mali gbuɣima pinaayi n-tamtam dura maa yaɣ ayi maa zaa naŋgbaŋgbirima zuɣu. O nam ʒiishee maa ŋmali daa ka na so sani.
en: Another twelve lions stood on both sides of the six steps. No other kingdom had anything like this.

dag: Bɔbu saha beni, ka kɔŋbu saha beni. Gbibbu saha beni, ka zaŋ bahi saha beni.
en: He sets the time for finding and the time for losing, the time for saving and the time for throwing away.

dag: Masia maŋmaŋ ni lo alikauli ni o ti ti shɛli nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: This is the promise that he himself gave us: eternal life.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli palo maa yuli, Ʒim Palo hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: That is why that field is called Field of Blood to this very day.

dag: Dama n yi saɣim yi suhuri, banima n-nyɛ bɛn ni chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli, ka pa ni n ni saɣim yinima ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri maa?.
en: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a Yɛhudianim Naa! Ka ŋmɛr o nutala.
en: and came to him and said, Long live the King of the Jews! And they went up and slapped him.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din be tibi; ka nyɛ din tiri nyɛvili. Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din mali naani niŋbu, ka lan nyɛ din tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi shɛli baŋsim.
en: The LORDs Instruction is perfect, reviving ones very being. The LORDs laws are faithful, making naive people wise.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka Pool mini Silas suhiri Naawuni ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni, ka bɛ dansarika tab ʒiya wumda.
en: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.

dag: Ka Firawuna tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa buri bɛ mi ni daa pii Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ lihiri bɛ tab maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa ka yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ŋma bilichiisi sɔhila mini zuŋɔ kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm dabisili kam la.
en: The bosses beat the men in charge of the slaves and said, Why didn't you force the slaves to make as many bricks yesterday and today as they did before.

dag: Ka alizin birigu maa kuhi, ka lan yiɣisi bia maa pam ka naanyi zo ka chɛ o; ka bia maa be kaman o kpimi la hal ka sokam tɛhi ni o shiri kpimi.
en: The spirit screamed, threw the boy into a bad fit, and came out. The boy looked like a corpse, and everyone said, He is dead.

dag: Bɛ noya ni alahichi mini bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛ ka bɛ karimbaani gbahi ba! Bɛ ninvuɣ tubo mini bɛ ʒiŋmabo zuɣu.
en: Those evil people curse and tell lies. Punish them for what they said. Let their pride trap them.

dag: Amaa buŋdibbil tuuli kam, yin zaŋmiya piɛɣu zal o zaani, ka yi yi bi niŋ lala, dindina yin ŋmɛlimiya kab o nyiŋgoli. Di simdi ni yi zaŋ binshɛli taɣi yi tuuli bidibisi n-tiligi ba.
en: but you must buy back from him every first-born male donkey by offering a lamb in its place. If you do not want to buy back the donkey, break its neck. You must buy back every first-born male child of yours.

dag: N wumiya ni wun shɛb bɛn be kasi shia be a ni, ka a mali ninneesim mini baŋsim ni yɛm.
en: I have heard that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that you are skillful and have knowledge and wisdom.

dag: Ti lan suhiri ti Duuma ni o chɛ ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab mini sokam zaa sani zooi pahi kaman ti gba yurilim ni galisi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani shɛm la.
en: We pray that the Lord will make your love grow. We pray that he will give you more and more love for each other and for all people. We pray that you will love everyone in the same way we love you.

dag: N yi tum alahichi, a nyari ma mi, ka ku chɛ n-taali.
en: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.

dag: Vihimi Yawɛ kundi ni n-karim di ni yɛli shɛm. Biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ zaɣ yino ku pooi, ka bɛ mi zaa so ku kɔŋ bala. Dama Yawɛ n-zali ni di niŋ lala. Omaŋmaŋ Shia ni laɣim ba na.
en: Search in the Lord 's book of living creatures and read what it says. Not one of these creatures will be missing, and not one will be without its mate. The Lord has commanded it to be so; he himself will bring them together.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Ziba, Nyama, Mɛfibɔshɛt ni daa su shɛlikam zaa leeg a dini pumpɔŋɔ. Ka Ziba garigi yɛli, N nyɛla ŋun luri n dan sizuura. Chɛ ka nyini n dan naa nini kul tiɣiri ma sahakam.
en: Then the king said to Ziba, All right, I now give you everything that belonged to Mephibosheth. Ziba said, I bow to you. I pray I will always be able to please you.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa jɛm Naawuni Jɔshua ʒiɛman ni mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn daa doli Jɔshua nyaaŋa, ka daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la.
en: The Israelites served the Lord as long as Joshua was alive, and they continued serving the Lord during the lifetimes of the elders who lived after Joshua had died. These old men had seen all the great things the Lord had done for the Israelites.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli ma, Daadam, lihimi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni yɛn wuh a binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa ni. Dama n zaŋ a mi ka kpe na ni n ti wuh a li. Yɛlim Izraɛlnim a ni nya shɛli maa zaa.
en: The man spoke to me, Human one, look and listen well, and take seriously everything I show you, because you were brought here so that these things could be revealed to you. Describe everything you see to the house of Israel.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim daa tim Giligal sansan la ni ti yɛli Jɔshua, Di chɛ tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ bahi. Kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ti tiligi ti; dama Amɔri nanim zaa bɛn be zoya polo tinsi la ni laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi kana ti teei gili Gibiɔn n-doya ni bɛ tuhi ti.
en: The people of Gibeon sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: Dont desert your servants! Come to us quickly. Rescue us! Help us! All the Amorite kings from the highlands have assembled together against us.

dag: Daadam yi kpi o ni lan tooi be? Amaa n kul ni guhi n ni tumdi tuma dabisi shɛŋa ŋɔ ni zaa hal ti nya faako.
en: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.

dag: Yi nuzaa polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli hal ni Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: The northern border will follow a line from the Mediterranean to Mount Hor.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kawana ʒili bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: So the brothers put the grain on their donkeys and left.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ chaŋ? Dama Sool yi wum di yɛla o ni ku ma. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Bom naɣisaa chaŋ ti yɛli, N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: But Samuel said, If I go, Saul will hear the news and try to kill me. The Lord said, Go to Bethlehem. Take a young calf with you and tell them, I have come to make a sacrifice to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ niriba anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn yi Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ zaa.
en: These four Philistines were descended from the Raphah in Gath, and they fell by the hands of David and his servants.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. N gba ni tooi yɛli ni binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani, amaa n ku saɣi chɛ ka di shɛli zaŋ ma leei di dabili.
en: I am allowed to do anything, you say. My answer to this is that not all things are good. Even if it is true that I am allowed to do anything, I will not let anything control me like a slave.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahim noli ka bɛ chaŋ ti guli siliga maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai daba ata maa dali, ka di chɛ ka o nyaandoliba ti ku chaŋ ti zu n-yih o ka yɛli niriba ni o neela kum ni, ka yɔhiŋgu din bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni ti bie n-gari tuuli din la.
en: So please order the tomb to be carefully guarded for three days. If you don't, his disciples may come and steal his body. They will tell the people he has been raised to life, and this last lie will be worse than the first one.

dag: Jɛsi dapala maa ŋun dee yi be o nyɛvili ni, nyini bee a nam kul ku nya zaashee zani. Dinzuɣu timmi ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na, dama di kpala talahi ni o kpi.
en: Don't you realize that as long as David is alive, you will never be king of this country? Now go and bring him here—he must die.

dag: Yuma ayi ka kum ŋɔ na niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di na kpalim yuma anu, ka so ku ko bee n-kpuɣi puu atam.
en: Weve already had two years of famine in the land, and there are five years left without planting or harvesting.

dag: Amaa Jɔshua daa tiligi Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la min o dɔɣiriba zaa; o ni daa zaŋ tuumba shɛb Jɔshua ni daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai Jɛriko n-sɔɣ la zuɣu. Ka Reehab zuliya na kul be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua let Rahab the prostitute live, her family, and everyone related to her. So her family still lives among Israel today, because she hid the spies whom Joshua had sent to scout out Jericho.

dag: A ni saɣi je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A ni yiɣis a suhu bahi ti zuɣu sahakam? Yi ni yɛli shɛm m-bala, amaa yi tum tuumbiɛ shɛlikam yin ni tooi tum.
en: will you stay angry forever? Will you continue to be furious? This is what you say while you do as much evil as you possibly can.

dag: Amaa man kul ni lihirila Yawɛ. N ni guhirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligir ŋɔ. N Naawuni ni wum n suhigu.
en: But me! I will keep watch for the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation; my God will hear me.

dag: A ni neei zoomba nina, ka yihi dansarikanim bɛn be zibisim ni la bahi.
en: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi Naa Zɛdɛkia bidibisi n-ku ba o ninni, ka kpaɣ o mi nina; ka ba o bandi n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: Zedekiahs sons were slaughtered right before his eyes. Then he was blinded, put in bronze chains, and taken off to Babylon.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa yinima n-daa tahi ma kpe na, amaa Naawuni n-daa tahi ma na nti zaŋ ma leei Firawuna ba ni ŋun su o yiŋnim zaa fukumsi, ka lan zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa zuɣulana.
en: It was not your fault that I was sent here. It was Gods plan. God made me like a father to Pharaoh. I am the governor over all his house and over all Egypt.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: When they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus gave two disciples a task.

dag: dama nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali, di bi tumdi tuma o yi na be o nyɛvil ni.
en: A will means nothing while the one who wrote it is still living. It can be used only after that persons death.

dag: Di saha maa ka Hagai daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya ni lala n-nyɛ yi zuliya ŋɔ niriba mini bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum shɛlikam; dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam m-mali sara pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu nyɛla din pa kasi n sani.
en: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.

dag: Amaa di yɛliya tammɛriba zuɣulaannim maa ni bɛ malim bɛ ni di laɣ shɛli yi ni zaŋ ti ba maa laasabu n-wuhi ya, dama bɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli bɛ tuma ni.
en: The men in charge of the work are thoroughly honest, so there is no need to require them to account for the funds.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani mini ti kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-kul be ti sani n-sɔŋdi ti ti muɣisigu saha.
en: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kul tia, din wula chaŋ ti kpe kɔzɔrim ni, wuuni yi ti du, di baɣa kani, ka di vari kul nyɛ va maha sahakam. Ka sanzali yuuni puuni, di baɣa kani, ka wala kul bi kɔŋdi di zuɣu.
en: They will be strong like trees planted near a stream that send out roots to the water. They have nothing to fear when the days get hot. Their leaves are always green. They never worry, even in a year that has no rain. They always produce fruit.

dag: Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla tiŋŋmara ni ninvuɣ tuɣinda Yɛhudianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, ka lan nyɛ bɛ ni booni ninvuɣ shɛb Nazarinim la adiini soli toondana.
en: We found this man to be a dangerous nuisance; he starts riots among Jews all over the world and is a leader of the party of the Nazarenes.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili bindirigu.
en: I am the bread that gives life!.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka malaikanim daa ti laɣimna ni bɛ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ wuhi Yawɛ, ka Sintani gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: One day the divine beings came to present themselves before the LORD, and the Adversary also came among them.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛri ya, Pumpɔŋɔ, yi zaa zomiya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu ni din ni chɛ ka yi kul kpalim be Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim kurimbuni ha la ni sahakam.
en: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa shiri di o ʒiri shɛhira, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi nya o galimi. Di nyaaŋa ka niriba ayi daa tɔhi zanna.
en: but they could not find any, even though many people came forward and told lies about him. Finally two men stepped up.

dag: Apolɔs ni daa be Kɔrinti saha shɛli maa ka Pool daa gari chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be nuzaa polo n-daa mali hal ti paai Ɛfɛsus. Nimaani ka o daa nya Yisa nyaandol shɛba.
en: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled through the interior of the province and arrived in Ephesus. There he found some disciples.

dag: Ka Iso daa ŋmaligi kuli Ɛdom dindali maa.
en: That day Esau returned on the road to Seir.

dag: Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa ku chɛ hal ka o ti niŋ o suhu ni lo ni o niŋ shɛli maa naai. Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti baŋ di gbinni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Lord s anger will not stop until he finishes what he plans to do. When that day is over, you will understand this clearly.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses these rules for the people:.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, hal di pa shɛli yi ni yɛn nya wahala din ku yuui zahimbu balibu shɛŋa din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu la zaa yoli;.
en: Be glad about this, even though it may now be necessary for you to be sad for a while because of the many kinds of trials you suffer.

dag: N yi be a jɛmbu duu dahin yini, di so ni m be luɣ shɛli polo m-paai biɛɣ tuhili; m paɣiya ni n nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunɔgula n-gari m be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi.
en: Better is a single day in your courtyards than a thousand days anywhere else! I would prefer to stand outside the entrance of my Gods house than live comfortably in the tents of the wicked!.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka n yɛri pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. N ni nyɛ Naawuni ni tim tuun so bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani zuɣu ka m mali n tuma maa kuuna.
en: I am speaking now to you Gentiles: As long as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I will take pride in my work.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn teei do wɔbinyina gariti zuɣu, ka zaŋdi piɛla kara mini yi naɣikpahi ni naɣila kara n-kɔriti puhiri churi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But now you lie on ivory beds and stretch out on your couches. You eat tender young lambs from the flock and young calves from the stable.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim Malikia bia Pashihur mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la o sani la. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word when King Zedekiah sent Pashhur, Malchiahs son, and the priest Zephaniah, Maaseiahs son, to him with an appeal.

dag: Teeku, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa zo? Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa ŋmaligi lab a nyaaŋa?.
en: Sea, why did you run away? Jordan, why did you retreat?.

dag: Anzinfa mini salima palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daazichi ka tariga. Yuri palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi ka tariga.
en: Their land is full of silver and gold; they have countless treasures. Their land is filled with horses; they have countless chariots.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim gba nyɛla yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa: Nimmira yɛlimaŋli tibu saria karibu bi viɛla.
en: These are also words from the wise: A judge must be fair. He must not support some people simply because he knows them.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a niŋ yuun pinaanu pahi. N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will let you live fifteen years longer. I will rescue you and this city Jerusalem from the emperor of Assyria. I will defend this city, for the sake of my own honor and because of the promise I made to my servant David.

dag: Amaa ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim ʒe siliga maa gbini kumda. O ni daa kumdi maa ka o ti vɔbisi lihi siliga maa puuni.
en: But Mary stood outside the tomb, crying. While she was crying, she bent down and looked inside the tomb.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti niŋ lala, dama ti ni yɛn mali sara shɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa nyɛla din chihiri Ijiptinim sani. Ka ti yi mali sara shɛli din chihiri bɛ sani bɛ ninni, bɛ ni lab ti kuɣa ku ti.
en: That's impossible! Moses replied. Any sacrifices we offer to the Lord our God would disgust the Egyptians, and they would stone us to death.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma, ka zoya na kani, ka daboya gba na kani.
en: I was born before the mountains, before the hills were set in place.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nam dariza yɛla, ka yɛl a yiko yɛla.
en: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.

dag: Ka daŋ shɛŋa din kpalim zaa puuni niriba dɔbba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba gba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: and all other families as well.

dag: Amaa sokam ni ti ʒila o wain tia bee o fiig tia gbini, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yaag o noli yɛli lala maa.
en: All will sit underneath their own grapevines, under their own fig trees. There will be no one to terrify them; for the mouth of the LORD of heavenly forces has spoken.

dag: Ka Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you touch him, you must wash your clothes and bathe in water. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: Lala ka Absalom daa yi niŋdi Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa kani naa sanna ni o ti kari bɛ yɛtɔɣa saria ti ba, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigi ŋun Absalom polo.
en: Absalom did that to all the Israelites who came to King David for judgment. In this way Absalom won the hearts of all the people of Israel.

dag: Di simdi ka bɛ kul nyɛla yi ni chihiri binshɛba, di ŋubiya bɛ nimdi, ka bɛ zaɣ kpima nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛli.
en: Such creatures must be considered unclean. You must not eat them or even touch their dead bodies.

dag: Yisa ni daa be dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, o daa suhiri Naawuni yɛr o o ni bɔri shɛli, ka duhir o yee kuhiri ni nintam niŋdi Naawuni ŋun ni tooi tilig o kum ni la. Ka Naawuni daa wum o suhigu maa o ni daa zɔri ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.

dag: Yɛm ŋɔ tatabo bi yirila alizanda ni na, amaa di nyɛla dunia ŋɔ mini daadamtali biɛhigu ni Sintani dini.
en: That kind of wisdom does not come from God. That wisdom comes from the world. It is not spiritual. It is from the devil.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Then the king and all Israel with him sacrificed to the LORD.

dag: Nyamiya, di zuɣu ka n daŋ yɛri ya ka di saha na bi paai maa.
en: Listen! I have told you this ahead of time.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu bee n-doli alahichinim biɛhigu bee n-doli ansarisi maaniba biɛhigu mali alibarika.
en: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka poloya maa lan kani, ka o suhu daa lan kpaŋ yaha, ka o zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋbu kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ni o ni zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm la.
en: But when Pharaoh saw that the disaster was over, he became stubborn again and wouldnt listen to them, just as the LORD had said.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti booi kpam maa bahi tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Anoint the washbasin with its stand and make it holy.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ pateesa maa yili bansi maa, ka zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la na ti zali di puuni, ka pateesa maa woligi luɣ kasi shee ka chɛ luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Put the curtain under the gold rings. Then put the Box of the Agreement behind the curtain. This curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaanii ni kɔbisiyɔbu, ka bɛ daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni.
en: In this family group there were men and boys a month old or over. The Kohathites were given the job of taking care of the things in the Holy Place.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ma n dimnim nuu ni. Nyini n-daa duhi ma gari n dimnima. Nyini n-daa fa ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taai duŋ nuu ni bahi.
en: who rescues me from my enemies. You lifted me high above my adversaries; you delivered me from violent people.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam tiŋgbani pa kom zuɣu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.

dag: Dɛdannima, ŋmaligimiya guui, sɔɣimiya; dama n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu niŋ Iso zuliya saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili.
en: I will send disaster to punish you descendants of Esau, so anyone from Dedan had better turn around and run back home.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mal li ka di be kasi zaa, ka binshɛlikam din ti shihi li ni niŋ kasi.
en: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.

dag: Biŋkɔb shɛb zaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la daa nyɛla naɣilahi pinaayi mini piɛlahi pinaayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaayi m-pahi bɛ chi sara zuɣu ni bulahi pinaayi shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: all the animals for the entirely burned offering were twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve male lambs a year old, with their grain offering; twelve male goats for the purification offering.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam, ka o biɛhigu zaa mali kɔre pam. Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n yura ni n zo maa ni be shɛm m-bala.
en: His mouth is everything sweet, every bit of him desirable. This is my love, this my dearest, daughters of Jerusalem!.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa chuɣu, dama dindali maa ka n daa yihi yi zuliya maa gbilligbilli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi gbibi dabisili maa yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam.
en: Celebrate this Festival of Thin Bread as a way of remembering the day that I brought your families and tribes out of Egypt. And do this each year.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di yɛn niŋ? Dim suɣilo. Zom a daba nambɔɣu.
en: Help us, Lord ! Don't wait! Pity your servants.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti mali di tatabo ni o zaŋ niŋ o tulaale, bɛn yihimi dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi deei Yawɛ daalikauli ni o nyɛ yi Naawuni ka yi ni dol o soli ka gbib o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka deeg o noli.
en: Today you have said that the Lord is your God. You have promised to live the way he wants. You promised to follow his teachings and to obey his laws and commands. You said you would do everything he tells you to do.

dag: Ka bɛ yuri kalinli daa nyɛ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihitanaayɔbu. Ka buntaansi kalinli nyɛ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: horses, mules.

dag: Nyamiya! N ni siɣisi ya m Ba Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la na, dinzuɣu kul benya Jɛrusalɛm hal ti deei yiko shɛli din yɛn yi alizanda ni na maa.
en: I will send you the one my Father has promised, but you must stay in the city until you are given power from heaven.

dag: O ku chɛ ka a napɔŋ pihigi; ŋun gul a maa bi gbihira.
en: He will not let you fall; your protector is always awake.

dag: O ni doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o lan yɛn doli labi; o ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will go back the way he came. He will not come into this city. The Lord says this!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi nti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: He went away once more and prayed, saying the same words.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mi n-ni ti zani Ɛbal zoli zuɣu n-yɛli noli dibu yɛtɔɣa maa. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya niriba ni Asha zuliya niriba ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba ni Dan zuliya niriba ni Naftali zuliya niriba.
en: And the following tribes will stand on Mount Ebal when the curses are pronounced: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ takɔbi, saha yuusim wula ka a lee kul yɛn ŋmara? Labimi kpe a tɔɣu ni ti dɔni baalim vuhi.
en: You sword of the LORD, how long until you are silent? Return to your sheath; rest and be still!.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-jiɣiri yi ni wum ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali pun gari la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli so n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa bee n-yihi waazu yɛl lala bee ŋ-ŋɔ so n-yɛli ni tinima n-sabi gbaŋ puuni yɛl lala.
en: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kahi kuɣa m-pa Akan zuɣu hal ti duhi li sɔŋ, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Akɔr Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa naanyi maai.
en: After they burned Achan, they put many rocks over his body. The rocks are still there today. That is why it is called the Valley of Achor. After this the Lord was not angry with the people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri maa so, ka zaŋ gabisi maa vili bɛ zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl naa maa sani ti yɛl o, A dabili Bɛnhadad yɛliya ni o suhirila o nyɛvili. Ka Naa Ɛhab daa garigi bɔhi ba, O na be o nyɛvil ni? O nyɛla m mabia.
en: They dressed in rough cloth with ropes on their heads. They came to the king of Israel. They said, Your servant, Ben-Hadad, says, Please let me live. Ahab said, Is he still alive? He is my brother. .

dag: Ka Amasa daa zaŋ Judanim maa zaa suhuri laɣim taba ka bɛ be kaman ninvuɣ yino la, ka daa tim ti yɛli Naa A min a kpamba zaa labimina.
en: David's words won the complete loyalty of all the men of Judah, and they sent him word to return with all his officials.

dag: Ka o daa shiri kpi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o tizo Jɔram daa di nam zan o zaani, Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la nam dibu yuma ayi saha, dama Ahazia daa ka bidibiga.
en: Ahaziah died, as the Lord had said through Elijah. Ahaziah had no sons, so his brother Joram succeeded him as king in the second year of the reign of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab daa bɔhi Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat, A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka o garigi yɛl o, M bela a polo ka n niriba nyɛ a niriba, ti ni pah a zuɣu chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me to attack Ramoth Gilead? Ahab was the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah. Jehoshaphat answered, Yes, you and I will be as one—my men will be as yours in battle.

dag: Kul leemiya jɛra! Kul leemiya zoomba! Buɣimiya n-chani laana, ka bi nyu wain bee binnyuri kpɛma!.
en: Go ahead and be stupid! Go ahead and be blind! Get drunk without any wine! Stagger without drinking a drop!.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nini kpa tiŋa.
en: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so terrified that they threw themselves face downward on the ground.

dag: A nini pɔbbu biɛla, gom gbihibu biɛla, zali nuhi ʒia vuhi biɛla.
en: I'll just take a short nap, he says; I'll fold my hands and rest a while.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa bo paɣiba ayi ti o ka o zaŋ ba dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi.
en: Jehoiada chose two wives for Joash. Joash had sons and daughters.

dag: Ka man Yawɛ kul ni wuhiri ya soli sahakam, ka tiri ya binshɛŋa din simdi ya wuntaŋ tulim pam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka tin ya yaa; ka chɛ ka yi be kaman pu shɛli din puuni mali kom; ka lan chɛ ka yi be kaman kɔbil nini din kom bi ŋmaara.
en: And I will always guide you and satisfy you with good things. I will keep you strong and well. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water, like a spring of water that never goes dry.

dag: Bɛ ni daa guni ba naai, Izraɛlnim zaa daa kpalim dola luɣ yini hal ka bɛn guni maa yuma ti naai zaa.
en: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.

dag: Miriya ka yi deeri birapu, dama birapu deebu zomdila niriba nina ka bɛ ŋariti bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe makes people blind to what is right and ruins the cause of those who are innocent.

dag: Labimiya kuli, dama n kurigiya pam ni doo kulibu. Ka hal n yi tɛhi ni tahima na ni beni, ka kul doo yuŋ ŋɔ gba n-dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: Go back home, for I am too old to get married again. Even if I thought there was still hope, and so got married tonight and had sons.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa niŋ yɛda maa laɣim be, ka laɣim su bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa.
en: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yihi li daɣiri ni naai, yin zaŋmiya naɣilaa ŋun ka daŋa mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara.
en: When you have finished making the altar pure, you will offer a young bull that has nothing wrong with it and a ram from the flock that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Ka Rut yɛli, N ni niŋ a ni yɛl shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Then Ruth answered, I will do what you say.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a dɔni a nuzaa luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim tibidarigibo pa amaŋ zuɣu n-ʒi bɛ tibidarigibo maa dabisa shɛŋa ni zaa a ni yɛn do nimaani maa.
en: After that, lie down on your left side and stay there for days as a sign of Israel's punishment —one day for each year of its suffering.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan yɛl o, N tiŋgbani n-kul do a tooni maa, ʒinimi a ni bɔri ni a ʒini di ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Abimelech said, My land is here available to you. Live wherever you wish.

dag: Mɔabnim dula bɛ buɣa zoya, ka chaŋ ti kpe bɛ buɣa jɛmbu duri ni n-fabili niŋ ba je, ka di bi sɔŋ ba.
en: The people of Moab will go to their high places to worship. They will go to their temple to pray, but it will not help them.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ya. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi biɛhigu shɛli o ni boli ya ni yi ti mali la. Naawuni sɔŋmi ya n-chɛ ka yi nya yi ni bɔri zaɣ suŋ shɛlikam ka naai yi yɛda tuma la tin ya o yiko ni.
en: That is why we always pray for you. We ask our God to make you worthy of the life he has called you to live. May he fulfill by his power all your desire for goodness and complete your work of faith.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka biŋkɔbigu la mini dunia nanima ni bɛ tɔbbihi laɣim lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi ŋun ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa min o tɔbbihi.
en: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa luri nahiri tiŋgbani m-be kaman gbaŋ ka bɛ yɛrigi sɔŋ la. O chɛ ka gulisigu be kaman taŋkpaɣu la n-gili luɣilikam.
en: He makes the snow fall until the ground is as white as wool. He makes sleet blow through the air like dust.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa gbaai ma Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la.
en: This is why the Jews grabbed me and were trying to kill me at the Temple.

dag: Ka Zakaria daa nya malaika maa ka di gar o, ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pam.
en: When Zechariah saw him, he was alarmed and felt afraid.

dag: Ka Javan bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Dɔdanim.
en: Javans sons: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka zɔri Yawɛ, di so ni nir mali buni pam ka di mal o muɣisigu.
en: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la maani maha, dama dabindi daa ka di ni, bɛ mi daa bi ʒi bindir shɛli mali chaŋ, bɛ ni daa kari ba yihi Ijipti yomyom shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: They left Egypt in such a hurry that they did not have time to prepare any food except the bread dough made without yeast. So they baked it and made thin bread.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha na kul bi bahi tiɣi n nini, ka di daliri nyɛla n ni na kul nyari Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la ka o ʒiini nayili dunol ni la.
en: But all this loses its meaning every time I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the Kings Gate.

dag: Yawɛ, lihimi nya a ni darigi so tibili maa. Di luhiya ni paɣiba ŋubiri bɛ bihi? Bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba? Di luhiya ni bɛ ku maligumaaniba mini anabinim ti Duuma jɛmbu duu?.
en: Look, O Lord ! Why are you punishing us like this? Women are eating the bodies of the children they loved! Priests and prophets are being killed in the Temple itself!.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la yɛli Pita, Ti Duuma m-bala! Pita daa pirigila o binyɛrigu sɔŋ ka tumdi tuma, ka o ni daa ti wum ni di nyɛla bɛ Duuma maa, ka o zaŋ o binyɛrigu maa ye n-kpilim lu teeku kom maa ni ha.
en: The disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, It is the Lord! When Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his outer garment around him and jumped into the water.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi alibarika niŋ o ni mali shɛli ni, ka chɛ ka a nini tiɣi o nuhi tuma. Kum o dimnim bɛn je ba la zuliya, ka bɛ ku lan neei yaha.
en: Lord , bless everything Levi has. Accept what he does. Destroy those who attack him! Defeat his enemies so that they will never attack again.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛl o, N nyala tiwal moma ni be piɛ shɛl ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim biɛɣu yipa neeya. N ku lan chɛ ba.
en: and asked, Amos, what do you see? A basket of ripe fruit, I replied. Then he said, This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.

dag: Ka so yi ti tum o kpee taali, ka bɛ yɛli ni o poma, ka o kana ti zani duu ŋɔ ni a sara maligu bimbini gbini po.
en: When a person is accused of wronging another and is brought to your altar in this Temple to take an oath that he is innocent.

dag: Dama yɛlikpan shɛli n ni daa zaŋ tin ya la nyɛla n gba ni daa tuui deei shɛli. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa kpila ti daalahichi zuɣu kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm;.
en: I passed on to you as most important what I also received: Christ died for our sins in line with the scriptures.

dag: Muɣisigu nyabu dali, o ni zaŋ ma sɔɣ o sɔɣisili shee, o ni zaŋ o tanti pili ma; ka zaŋ ma tam tampin shɛli din du zuɣu.
en: In times of trouble, Lord , you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, n yɛri ya mi ni n nuu yi yi zaa nyɛviya bahi yoli taali ni.
en: So I solemnly declare to you this very day: if any of you should be lost, I am not responsible.

dag: . Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli n ni zali ya, Yumiya taba! .
en: . This, then, is what I command you: love one another.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, lum a niriba bɛn bipuɣinsi zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛha tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la zuɣu. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: You, human one, face the daughters of your people, those women who prophesy from their imaginations. Prophesy against them.

dag: A tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔ tuhiya? A yɛliya, M mali yɛlimaŋli Naawuni sani.
en: Job, it is not fair for you to say, I am more right than God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpaai bɛ kawana, bɛ zaa liɣiri daa lɔnlomi be bɛ kpalansi ni, bɛ mini bɛ ba ni daa nya liɣiri maa, ka di gari ba.
en: Then the brothers started taking the grain out of their sacks, and every brother found his bag of money in his sack of grain. When the brothers and their father saw the money, they were afraid.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Naawuni yihi ma vi ni.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She said, God has taken away my shame.

dag: Masia dapulli zuɣu kum puuni ka o daa kpihim dimdi din be ti sunsuuni la, ka zaŋ zuliya kam zaa niriba leei zaɣ yini n-zaŋ ba labisi Naawuni sani.
en: He reconciled them both as one body to God by the cross, which ended the hostility to God.

dag: O daa zaŋla omaŋ tabil o ka bɛ be Ɛziɔngɛba m-maani ŋarima ni bɛ zaŋdi li chani Speen.
en: They agreed to build a fleet of Tarshish-styled ships, and they built them in Ezion-geber.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛrusalɛm Naa Adɔnizɛdɛk daa tim ti yɛli Hiburɔn Naa Hɔham mini Jarimut naa Piram ni Lakishi Naa Jafia ni Ɛgilɔn Naa Dɛbir.
en: So Jerusalems King Adoni-zedek sent word to Hebrons King Hoham, Jarmuths King Piram, Lachishs King Japhia, and Eglons King Debir.

dag: ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o bɔh a, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chaŋ miri tiŋ maa ni yi ti tuhi ba? Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni tɔn ya piɛma goma zuɣu na?.
en: if the king gets angry and asks you, Why did you go so close to the city to fight? didnt you know they would shoot from the wall?.

dag: Bɛ laakuma mini bɛ niɣi ni ti leei yi ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba. N ni ti wurim buɣijɛmdiba bɛn pindi zuɣukpina ŋɔ kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛɣu yi luɣilikam na ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Take their camels and all their livestock! I will scatter in every direction those people who cut their hair short, and I will bring disaster on them from every side.

dag: amaa Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa zaɣisi Naawuni ni zali ba shɛm, ka bɛn daa bi deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani.
en: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ chama, ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔni bɛ sɔɣibu shee din daa be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Ai wulinluhili polo la; amaa ka Jɔshua ŋun daa kpalim gbe niriba maa sani.
en: So Joshua sent them out, and they went to their hiding place and waited there, west of Ai, between Ai and Bethel. Joshua spent the night in camp.

dag: Di saha n ni ti taɣi niriba yɛtɔɣa ka di leei alali yɛtɔɣa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaa ti laɣim booni Yawɛ yuli n-jɛmd o ni naŋgban yini.
en: Then I will change the speech of the peoples into pure speech, that all of them will call on the name of the LORD and will serve him as one.

dag: Jɔshua daa yɛla binyɛr daɣiri ʒe malaika maa tooni.
en: Joshua was wearing a dirty robe as he stood in front of the angel.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tahima la ni zal li shɛm la puuni n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: Greetings from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. I am an apostle by the command of God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli din wuhiri din be ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni: Di gbinni nyɛla ni pina mini biŋkɔbiri sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi maani maligu nyɛla din ku tooi chɛ ka ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni suhu ni tɛha niŋ dɛde.
en: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.

dag: Ka yi ni yi alahichi tumbu dabitim ni la zuɣu chɛ ka yi yipa leela wuntia daba.
en: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya Saimɔn min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: Jesus was walking by Lake Galilee. He saw Simon and his brother Andrew. These two men were fishermen, and they were throwing a net into the lake to catch fish.

dag: Salima min anzinfa nɛma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu ni kɔbisinahi. Ka Shɛshibaza daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa yi Babilɔn kuli Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi tinduli n-labi kuni la.
en: All together, there were things made from gold and silver. Sheshbazzar brought them all with him when the prisoners left Babylon and went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, N kpa kasi shɛli n ni yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni m-bala.
en: Say to the Israelites: This will be my holy anointing oil in every generation.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ omaŋmaŋ taali? Chɛli n daashilɔni taali.
en: None of us can see our own errors; deliver me, Lord , from hidden faults!.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira. Niŋmiya Naawuni yɛda, ka niŋ man gba yɛda.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Yi daa bi mi Naawuni so, naɣila mani. Ka tiligira so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord , have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi ka shiri niŋ ba lala biɛɣu pia.
en: The guard agreed to do what Daniel had asked.

dag: ka o daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o yiŋ maa na nti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, o ni zaŋ Hiburu nir maa na ka o ti lihi ʒiɛm ti shɛm, o kpɛmina ni o ti zaŋ ma dɔni, ka n kuhi pam.
en: she called to her house servants and said, Look at this! This Hebrew that my husband brought to the house is insulting us. He came into my room and tried to rape me, but I screamed as loud as I could.

dag: Ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o yiŋa kana ti zan o sani ni bɛ kpuɣ o yiɣisi, amaa ka o bi saɣi bee n-chɛ ka o mini ba laɣim ʒini di bindirigu.
en: The senior servants of his house approached him to lift him up off the ground, but he refused, and he wouldnt eat with them either.

dag: Ninsalinim pihiri kuɣa sɔŋda ni bɛ baŋ din beni, amaa Yawɛ kɔŋko n-zaan o ni bɔri shɛli.
en: People might throw lots to make a decision, but the answer always comes from the Lord .

dag: O min o yiŋ zaa ni daa deei kom baptaizibu nyaaŋa ka o balim ti yɛli, Yi yi zahim ma nya ka n nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim n suhu ni ni ti Duuma, yin kamiyana ti be n yiŋa. Ka o ni daa balim ti ni nimmoo zuɣu chɛ ka ti niŋ lala.
en: She and all the people living in her house were baptized. Then she invited us into her home. She said, If you think I am a true believer in the Lord Jesus, come stay in my house. She persuaded us to stay with her.

dag: Nuhu zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Nuhu daa nyɛla wuntizɔra ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni, ka ka galimi o ʒiɛman ni.
en: This is the history of Noahs family. He was a good man all his life, and he always followed God.

dag: Bɛraya mini Shɛma.
en: Beriah and Shema were heads of families that settled in the city of Aijalon and drove out the people who lived in the city of Gath.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mali bɛ buɣili Dagɔn; ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Ti buɣili n-zaŋ ti dim Samsin niŋ ti nuu ni maa.
en: The Philistine rulers came together to celebrate. They were going to offer a great sacrifice to their god Dagon. They said, Our god helped us defeat Samson our enemy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔro gbaai Naa Uzia m-mal o hal ka o ti kpimi ni dina. O daa yi nayili n-taɣi ti bela yil shɛli. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili n-lihiri li, ka gbibi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam n-yɛra, Zomiya Naawuni ka timiy o jilima, dama o ni yɛn kari saria saha shɛli paaya! Jɛmmiya ŋuna ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni teeku mini kɔbil nina la.
en: The angel said in a loud voice, Fear God and give him praise. The time has come for God to judge all people. Worship God. He made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the springs of water.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Ijipti Firawuna Nɛko daa yi n-chani Asiria naa sani Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka Naa Jɔsia daa chaŋ ti lir o sol ni, amaa ka Firawuna Nɛko daa nya o Mɛgido n-ku o.
en: In his days, the Egyptian king Pharaoh Neco marched against the Assyrian king at the Euphrates River. King Josiah marched out to intercept him. But when Neco encountered Josiah in Megiddo, he killed the king.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli Izraɛlnim ni labisiri nɛma tiri tab la saha yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm bɛ tarili maa pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni, ka bɛ tarili maa ku lan be ti yaannim tarili ni.
en: People might sell their land, but in the Jubilee year, all the land is returned to the tribe that really owns it. At that time who will get the land that belongs to Zelophehads daughters? Will our tribe lose that land forever.

dag: Ka gooni maa yi ti lu, bɛ ni bɔhi ya, Yi ni daa zaŋ binshɛli paligi li la lee be ya? .
en: The wall will certainly fall. Wont it be said about you, Where is your plaster now.

dag: Di simdi ni paɣiba shini baalim, ka bɔhim baŋ din tuhi maŋsiɣisibu puuni.
en: A woman should learn while listening quietly and being completely willing to obey.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni yi dooi samafuu pa yaɣiri duɣu zuɣu shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ viɛla o noli ni, ka zaɣ biɛɣu be o suhu ni.
en: Smooth lips and an evil heart are like silver coating on clay.

dag: N Naawuni ni n Naa, n ni duh a, ka paɣ a yuli sahakam.
en: I will tell of your greatness, my God and King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

dag: Di saha ka n daa pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima: Shɛrɛbia mini Hashabia ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ninvuɣ pia m-pahi.
en: Then I chose twelve of the priests who were leaders. I chose Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu ka leei tipawumlinim kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ tipawumlinim shɛm ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛda la.
en: But they wouldnt listen. They were stubborn like their ancestors who didnt trust the LORD their God.

dag: Yi yi chɛ o dolibu, o ni lan chɛ niriba ŋɔ bahi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka yinima n-nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa.
en: If you turn away from him, he will turn away again to abandon Israel in the desert. Then you will destroy this entire people.

dag: Zaŋm a ni daa da jinjɛŋŋma shɛli sɔri maa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti zaŋ li pi tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: This was the message: Jeremiah, take the loincloth you bought and are wearing, and go to Perath. Hide the loincloth there in a crack in the rocks.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ka di yɛri malaikanima ayopɔin la, Zaŋmiya Naawuni suhuyiɣisili ni pali lah ayopɔin shɛŋa la n-chaŋ ti kpaai bahi dunia ni.
en: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple. It said to the seven angels, Go and pour out the seven bowls of Gods anger on the earth.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni zaŋ o piɛma to ba; bɛ ni nya dansi ka di libigi ba.
en: But God shoots his arrows at them, and suddenly they are wounded.

dag: Daabi so ŋun mali ʒiri kuruwa nyɛla ŋun bɔri niriba ŋaribu.
en: Jacob is a tricky merchant. He even cheats his friend! Even his scales lie.

dag: Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi dindali bee di saha.
en: Therefore, keep alert, because you dont know the day or the hour.

dag: Miri ka a fa nandaamba nɛma bɛ ni nyɛ nandaamba zuɣu bee m-muɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala dunɔdali ni;.
en: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa be di ni dini.
en: tell them what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying to them. This message is for the prince ruling in Jerusalem and for all the people who live there.

dag: ni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni teeku ni zahim ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku ni.
en: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi baŋ hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba kandina ti yɛn be.
en: They didnt know what was happening until the flood came and swept them all away. The coming of the Human One will be like that.

dag: Ka zoya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la, ka daboya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la.
en: The mountains danced like rams. The hills danced like lambs.

dag: Kum dimbu yiko nyɛla alahichi; ka alahichi yiko nyɛ zaligu.
en: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa na mi n-wum wuni kukoli ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa buɣim ni kaman yi ni daa wum shɛm maa, ka be?.
en: You people heard God speaking to you from a fire, and you are still alive. Has that ever happened to anyone else? No!.

dag: Daanya kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛri mii barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili, ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la. Di daa deerila kom lita tuhi pihiyɔbu.
en: The sides of the tank were inches thick. Its rim was like the rim of a cup, curving outward like the petals of a flower. The tank held about , gallons.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛli maligumaana Hilikia mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Mikaya bia Akibɔr ni gbaŋŋmara Shafan ni naa kpambal Asaaya.
en: The king ordered the priest Hilkiah, Shaphans son Ahikam, Micaiahs son Achbor, Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah the royal officer as follows.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim maligumaaniba, yi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: But now, this command is for you, priests.

dag: Yawɛ, di yi nyɛla a dimnima, a dimnim maa ni ti kpi; ka tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa ti wurim.
en: We know that your enemies will die, and all the wicked will be defeated.

dag: Tuuli alikauli la daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu soli zaligunim mini luɣ shɛli ninsalinim ni daa mali zali Naawuni jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: The first covenant had rules for worship and a place made for worship as well.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mal ʒiishee ti a maa.
en: But they asked, Where do you want us to prepare it.

dag: Ara daŋ — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: the descendants of Arah:.

dag: Ka yu shɛli sabi pa o binyɛrigu min o gbalipini zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nanim zaa Naa ni duumanim zaa Duuma.
en: On his robe and on his leg was written this name: king of kings and lord of lords.

dag: Nyamiya, Balaam ni daa wuhi yikombiɛlim so shɛl la ni, bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum din bie zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani Pɛɔr yɛla la ni, ka alɔbo daa lu Yawɛ niriba zuɣu la.
en: Remember that it was the women who followed Balaam's instructions and at Peor led the people to be unfaithful to the Lord . That was what brought the epidemic on the Lord 's people.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ lala. Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni daa chaŋ maa nyaaŋa ka o zaŋ mi ʒee maa lo n-tabil o takɔro maa.
en: Rahab answered, I will do just what you said. She said goodbye, and the men left her house. Then she tied the red rope in the window.

dag: Ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsal la lan zaŋ o nuu shihi ma, ka n nya ka yaa maan niŋ n niŋgbuna ni pahi.
en: The one who looked like a man touched me again. When he touched me, I felt better.

dag: Dunianima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o jilima min o kpiɔŋ.
en: Tell everyone of every nation, Praise the glorious power of the Lord .

dag: Goli ni ti nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ la, ka wuntaŋ neesim mi ti laɣim ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-nyɛ kaman daba ayopɔin neesim din leei dahin yini dini. Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti niŋla dahin shɛli Yawɛ yi ti tib o ni ti o niriba dan shɛl la.
en: The light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter—like the light of seven days—on the day that the LORD bandages the peoples brokenness and heals the wounds inflicted by his blows.

dag: dindina o ba min o ma maa bɛn gbaam o n-zaŋ o tahi bɛ ya kpamba sani nti zaŋ o zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali ni.
en: His father and mother must then take him to the leaders of the town at the town meeting place.

dag: Ilaisha kum dɔro ni daa ti gbaag o saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ o sani nti ʒi o tooni kumdi yɛra, M ba! M ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi ni di wɔribariba.
en: Elisha became sick, and later he died from this sickness. King Jehoash of Israel went to visit Elisha. Jehoash cried for him and said, My father, my father! Is it time for the chariot of Israel and its horses? .

dag: Wumma, n ni wuh a n ni yɛli n ni nya shɛli.
en: Listen to me, and I will explain it to you. Let me tell you what I have seen.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa nanima ayi maa ni ti laɣim ʒini n-di, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu tɛha din be bɛ suhuri ni zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim taba. Ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛm mi ti ku niŋ, dama di saha na bi paai.
en: These two kings, with their minds set on evil, will sit at one table, telling lies, but with no success because the end will come at the set time.

dag: Nir yi garigi bɔhigu viɛnyɛla di nyɛla suhupiɛlli nir kam sani. Ka nir yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa di tɔɣisibu saha, di viɛla.
en: People are happy when they give a good answer. And there is nothing better than the right word at the right time.

dag: Ka Harumaf bia Jɛdaya daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hashabinɛya bia Hatush mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Jedaiah son of Harumaph built the next section, which was near his own house. Hattush son of Hashabneiah built the next section.

dag: Sulemaana daa yuri Yawɛ, ka dol o ba Dauda ni daa zal o shɛm, o daa naɣ maanila sara maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: Now Solomon loved the LORD by walking in the laws of his father David, with the exception that he also sacrificed and burned incense at the shrines.

dag: Dama n ni gbahi Ifriimnim kaman gbuɣinli ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la, ka gbahi Judanim kaman gbuɣimbil ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni dari tɔhi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: I am like a lion to Ephraim, like a young lion to the house of Judah. I am the one who tears the prey and goes forth; no one can snatch it from me.

dag: Ka ŋun daa yɛl o niriba, Nyamiya, Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zooya, ka lan mali yaa gari ti.
en: This king said to his people, Look at the Israelites. There are too many of them, and they are stronger than we are!.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku tooi gbib bɛmaŋa, bɛn kpuɣimi paɣiba, ka paɣiba la mi kuli dɔbba, dama bɛ yi niŋ lala di so ni bɛ kɔre diri ba bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman buɣim la.
en: But if you cannot control your body, then you should marry. It is better to marry than to burn with sexual desire.

dag: dama sokam tum alahichi ka kɔŋ soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ paai Naawuni sani.
en: All have sinned and fall short of Gods glory.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa daa kul chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa yomyom kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: The creatures looked like lightning streaking back and forth.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapaɣa niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: Acacia wood was used to build the framework for the walls of the sacred tent.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni tintariga daa zaŋla Mɛsha hal ti paai Sɛfar din be wulimpuhili polo zoya ni la.
en: Their settlements extended from Mesha by way of Sephar, the eastern mountains.

dag: Yawɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma tiri bɛn nyari nahiŋgu.
en: The LORD works righteousness; does justice for all who are oppressed.

dag: Ka paɣisarili maa daa guui chaŋ ti zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛl o ma yiŋnima.
en: The young woman ran and told her mothers household everything that had happened.

dag: Dauda daa bi chɛ ka binshɛli kpalim nimaani. Neem bihi bee neen kara bee bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi ni bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa la mini Amalɛknim maa ni daa kpuɣi bɛ neen shɛŋa zaa, Dauda daa zaŋ di zaa lab kuli.
en: No one was missing—young or old, sons or daughters. David brought back everything that had been stolen.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni maa, dama bɛ lihiri ka bi nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka bi baŋdi bɛ ni wumdi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: I use stories when I speak to them because when they look, they cannot see, and when they listen, they cannot hear or understand.

dag: Di saha ka Saimɔn Pita ŋun daa mali takɔb la ŋooi li n-chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi. Dabili maa yuli n-daa booni Malikus.
en: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

dag: Bɛ yaala bɛ noya gu ma. Bɛ bemi kaman gbuɣinli ŋun bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma, ka ŋumdi la.
en: Their mouths are opened wide, like a lion roaring and tearing at its prey.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zaŋ di tɛha niŋ yila pia maa suhuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun Naawuni ni pun lo shɛm. Lala zuɣu ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ yiko zaa ti biŋkɔbigu la hal ni ŋun Naawuni yɛligu ti niŋ pali.
en: For God has placed in their hearts the will to carry out his purpose by acting together and giving to the beast their power to rule until God's words come true.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ɛhab, Cham ti di ka nyu, dama saa vura.
en: Elijah told Ahab, Get something to eat and drink. I hear a heavy rain coming.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa chaŋ ti gbahi ŋɔri kɔbisita n-zaŋ bɛ zuya gbin taba ka zaŋ buɣim mokpala shɛbisishɛbisi di gbina maa ni.
en: Samson went out and caught foxes and tied them together in pairs with oil-soaked rags around their tails.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli. Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: Even the hairs on your head are all counted. Dont be afraid. You are worth more than many sparrows.

dag: N lihila a daalikauli soli hal ka n nina ti fulim; ka m bɔhira, Ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ vuui yomyom kaman kɔzɔrim la; ka chɛ ka bɛ no n-taai ba kaman sol zuɣu mɔri la ka bɛ kpi.
en: May they disappear like water down a drain. May they be crushed like weeds on a path.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim Malikia bia Pashihur mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la o sani la. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi.
en: This is the message that came to Jeremiah from the Lord . This was when King Zedekiah of Judah sent Pashhur son of Malkijah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah. They brought a message for Jeremiah.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti fiɛb o gba n-dih o vi, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: So he sent another slave; but the tenants beat him also, treated him shamefully, and sent him back without a thing.

dag: O ŋmanila jɛŋgbini n-doya gu ma, ka ŋmani gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣi doya gu.
en: He waited for me like a bear; he pounced on me like a lion.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋ n niriba leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Are they dumb—these evildoers— devouring my people like they are eating bread but never calling on God?.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ko Ziɔn kaman puu la yi zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni ti leei tanduya, ka jɛmbu duu zol la ti leei tihi nyɔŋ.
en: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become piles of rubble, and the temple mount will become an overgrown mound.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni ye binyar shɛŋa taɣi m biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam binyɛra. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa shiri ye binyara n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, As we go into battle, I will disguise myself, but you wear your royal garments. So the king of Israel went into battle in disguise.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zaŋ zaligu din yi Yawɛ sanna zali Izraɛlnima. O daa yɛli ba, Yisifu zuliya niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa boli Naawuni ni tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa yuli Bɛtɛl.
en: Jacob named the place Bethel where God spoke to him.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛla tin titali, amaa niriba bɛn be di ni daa bi yaɣ lala, dama bɛ daa na bi lab me yiya pam di ni.
en: Now although the city was wide and large, only a few people were living within it, and no houses had been rebuilt.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Huramabi ŋun nyɛ tuumbaŋda, ka mali yɛm pam la ka a sanna.
en: I am sending you a wise and skillful master metalworker named Huram.

dag: bɔ n-lee nyɛ ninsalinima ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla bee daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be bɛ ni?.
en: what are human beings that you think about them; what are human beings that you pay attention to them?.

dag: Karimbaandan maa ni tuui lu ka so ku beni ŋun ni yiɣis o zali. Ka n ti nyo o fɔntinsi buɣim, ka di di binshɛɣukam din gil o.
en: Your proud nation will stumble and fall, and no one will help you up. I will set your cities on fire, and everything around will be destroyed.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni ni ti mali bindir suma. O ni ti mali bindir shɛŋa di ni simdi ni naa di.
en: Asher, you will eat food fancy enough for a king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaayi Rubin mini Gaad ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba.
en: The families of the clan of Merari were assigned twelve cities from the territories of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

dag: Yimiya luɣilikam na ti liri ba. Yɔhimiya bɛ kambɔna. Laɣimmiya ba duhi kaman bɛ ni kpaai kawana duhi shɛm la n ku bɛ zaa. Di chɛliya ka binshɛli lan kpalim nimaani.
en: Come against Babylon from far away. Break open the storehouses where she keeps her grain. Destroy Babylon completely. Dont leave anyone alive. Pile up her dead bodies like big piles of grain.

dag: O daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa la min omaŋmaŋ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Yawɛ ka di nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni lahi la ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Ka maligumaana Zɛfania daa karim gbaŋ maa ka anabi Jɛrimia wum.
en: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.

dag: ka yɛra, A yi shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa, nyin tiligim amaŋa.
en: and saying, If you really are the king of the Jews, save yourself.

dag: Amaa bomiya n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa tɔŋsim, ka suhimiya Yawɛ tim li, dama di tɔŋsim puuni ka yi gba ni tɔŋ.
en: Also, do good things for the city I sent you to. Pray to the Lord for the city you are living in, because if there is peace in that city, you will have peace also.

dag: Ka hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ na kul dolila bɛ kal kura maa. Bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ bee n-doli o zalikpana la min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ ni daa zali Yaakubu so o ni daa boli Izraɛl la bihi ni bɛ dol la.
en: They still carry on their old customs to this day. They do not worship the Lord nor do they obey the laws and commands which he gave to the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.

dag: ka salo pam daa kul kabiri dol o, ka o daa tib barinim bɛn be bɛ ni.
en: Many people followed him. Jesus healed the sick people there.

dag: o nyɛla karimbaandana ŋun duh omaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒi shɛli. O lan nyɛla kɔribiɛrilana ŋun suhu kul yɛla bɔhigu chɔɣima mini yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ tahirila nyuli zabbu mini woligibu ni turi ni tab zilisibu.
en: They are proud of what they know, but they understand nothing. They are sick with a love for arguing and fighting about words. And that brings jealousy, quarrels, insults, and evil mistrust.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ kana ka kikaa na bi daai. Yubulus mini Pudɛns ni Linus ni Klɔdia zaŋ tabili ti mabihi bɛn kpalim la zaa puhir a.
en: Try hard to come to me before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters say hello.

dag: Di saha ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Faashee ka yi ti ʒi yi tizo maa mali na, di yi pa lala, yin di ti chɛ ka n nini nyan ya.
en: You said to your servants, If your youngest brother doesnt come down with you, youll never see my face again.

dag: ni Anatɔt ni Nɔb ni Anania.
en: in Anathoth, Nob, and Ananiah.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na ni n ti tum tuma ŋɔ zaa, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ yubu ka n tumda.
en: Moses said to the people, This is how you will know that the Lord has sent me to do all these things and that it is not by my own choice that I have done them.

dag: Dama ŋuna m-bɔhiri biɛri niriba ʒim yihibu zuɣu. O bi tamdi bɛn nyari nahiŋgu kumsi yɛla.
en: He punishes murderers and remembers those who are in need. When suffering people cry for help, he does not ignore them.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli nyariba, Di lan nyan ya, ka yɛli anabinima, Di yɛliya ti din tuhi; naɣ yɛlimiya ti la ti suhu ni yu shɛli ni binshɛŋa din bi tuhi yɛla.
en: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.

dag: Ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di zuɣu, ka shinshingoorɔnim tɛri bɛ tɛri gɔhi tihi zuɣu.
en: There the birds build their nests; the storks nest in the fir trees.

dag: ni Hukok mini Rɛhɔb ni di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba.
en: Hukok, and Rehob.

dag: Bɛn diri zalinsi nyɛla bɛn bɔri yɛla tiri bɛ yiŋnima, amaa bɛn je birapu dibu ni be.
en: Try to make a profit dishonestly, and you get your family in trouble. Don't take bribes and you will live longer.

dag: Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee piɛlabil kam bee bubil kam sara maligu ni.
en: So will it be done with each ox, each ram, or for any sheep or goat.

dag: Ka o daa lan pii Daniɛl mini niriba ayi shɛba m-pahi ni bɛ lihiri kpambaliba maa ka bɛ tumdi ŋun naa maa tuma ka di mali nyɔri.
en: In order to make sure that his government was run properly, Darius put three other officials in charge of the governors. One of these officials was Daniel.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o binnamda zaa, ka be o nam sulinsi ni zaa ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni.
en: Praise the Lord , all his creatures in all the places he rules. Praise the Lord , my soul!.

dag: ŋun zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni, ka chɛ ka n leei tumo ni n wuhi zuliya kam zaa ka bɛ deeg o noli n-niŋ yɛda o yuli zuɣu la.
en: Through him we have received Gods grace and our appointment to be apostles. This was to bring all Gentiles to faithful obedience for his names sake.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tɛhi ni yɛla maa ʒila Alikizanda zuɣu, Yɛhudianim ni daa daag o zali tooni la zuɣu; ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa ni o wuhi ba din niŋ.
en: The Jews sent Alexander to the front, and some of the crowd directed their words toward him. He gestured that he wanted to offer a defense before the assembly.

dag: Yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma m-bo yɛlli ŋɔ tin ya. Di mali ya. Di biɛri pam! Di nyooi yi suhuri.
en: The way you lived and the things you did brought this trouble to you. It is your evil that made your life so hard. Your evil life brought the pain that hurts deep in your heart.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa bɔhi, Daŋ shɛli beni ka di niriba bi ka Mizipa na Yawɛ sani laɣiŋgu ŋɔ ni? Dama bɛ daa pun pola pɔri yɛli ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ka Mizipa na Yawɛ sani laɣiŋgu maa ni, bɛn kum o.
en: They asked, Is there any group out of all the tribes of Israel that did not go to the gathering in the Lord 's presence at Mizpah.

dag: Ka anab maa daa lan chaŋ do so sani ti yɛl o, Ŋmɛm ma. Ka doo maa daa ŋme o, ŋ-ŋme n-ti o daŋa.
en: The first prophet went to another man and said, Hit me! This man hit him and hurt the prophet.

dag: Bɔ n-lee yi tiŋgban nɛli polo kanna kaman nyɔhi din kpuɣi du zuɣusaa ka mɛɛr mini firanki tulaale zim ni kɔhigɔriba ni mali tulaale zim shɛŋa zaa nyom be di ni ŋɔ?.
en: Who is this woman coming from the desert with this large group of people ? The dust rises behind them like clouds of smoke from burning myrrh and frankincense and other spices.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli jintɔriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yi ni lo ni yi niŋ niriba maa shɛm maa;.
en: He said, Fellow Israelites, consider carefully what you intend to do to these people.

dag: Tikub ku tooi gbibi ashili, dinzuɣu miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋlana.
en: Gossips reveal secrets; dont associate with those who talk too much.

dag: Jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla fiɛbiga n-fiɛbiri bɛ yaansi zuɣu, amaa yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa n-gbibi ba.
en: Foolish words cause you trouble; wise words protect you.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, n ni niŋ o marisa n-zaŋ o ka tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti tɔɣis o yurilim yɛtɔɣa.
en: So I am going to take her into the desert again; there I will win her back with words of love.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Dofika maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Alushi.
en: They marched from Dophkah and camped at Alush.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yino sani nti yɛl o ni o wuhim ma yɛla maa zaa gbinni. Ka o daa wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: I went to someone who was standing there and asked him what all this meant. So he explained it to me.

dag: Ŋuna n-dihiri nabihi vi, ka lɔrigiri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ shɛlɔriti.
en: pours contempt on royalty; loosens the belt of the strong.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina, ka Pool balim niriba maa zaa ni bɛ dim bindirigu ka yɛli, Zuŋɔ pahirila biɛɣ pinaanahi ka nandahima mali ya ka yi bi di bindirigu.
en: Just before daylight Paul begged the people to eat something. He told them, For days you have been so worried that you haven't eaten a thing.

dag: ka Adaya nyɛ Ɛtan bia, ka Ɛtan nyɛ Zimma bia, ka Zimma nyɛ Shimɛi bia.
en: Adaiah was Ethans son. Ethan was Zimmahs son. Zimmah was Shimeis son.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Bɛ ni ti me gooni gili ya niŋ, ka me bimbina taɣi li, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi taɣi bɛmaŋa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar will kill your daughters on the mainland. He will build towers to attack your city. He will build a dirt road around your city and a dirt road leading up to the walls.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ka tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ jilima. Ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib bɛ ni po pɔ shɛŋa, hal di yi ni ti ba wahala shɛlikam.
en: They despise those whom God rejects, but honor those who obey the Lord . They always do what they promise, no matter how much it may cost.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni daa yihi tin shɛŋa mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba n-daa nyɛ Ramɔt din daa be Giliad la mini Mahanaim ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: And the Merari families got the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer from the tribe of Gad. They also got the fields near those towns.

dag: Ka Aruna daa ti lihi nya Naa Dauda min o kpamba ni kani o sanna, ka o daa tuhi ba soli ti lu naa sizuura n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Araunah looked up and saw the king and his servants approaching him. Araunah rushed out and bowed low before the king, his nose to the ground.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-zaŋ n noli tum alahichi din nyɛ n yɛli noli ni bɛ kpi.
en: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
