dag: Yimaŋmaŋ di ma shɛhira ni n daa yɛliya ni pa mani n-nyɛ Masia maa, amaa Naawuni n-tim ma ni n daŋ o tooni na.
en: You yourselves are my witnesses that I said, I am not the Messiah, but I have been sent ahead of him.

dag: dindali maa ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-tiligi ni ti zo n-ka a sanna nti ti a di lahibali.
en: On the day that I do this, some who escape the destruction will come and tell you about it.

dag: ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di nyaaŋa yi ni tooi labina, ka ku mali talahi yɛl shɛli Yawɛ mini Izraɛlnim sani; ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ leei yi ni su shɛli Yawɛ sani.
en: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.

dag: Ti mi ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri Naawuni ka nyɛ o ni daŋ pii shɛb o nia lɔbu ni la sani, ŋun Naawuni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋdila bɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: We know that in everything God works for the good of those who love him. These are the people God chose, because that was his plan.

dag: N ni kpihim bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa n sani, ka chɛ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa ka zaɣisi ma la taali.
en: I will purify them from the sins that they have committed against me, and I will forgive their sins and their rebellion.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi boli nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ o gbaɣino ʒira yomyom yɛl o, Ŋoom a takɔbi kuhi ku ma, di yi pa lala, niriba ni yɛli ni paɣa n-ku ma. Ka o nachimbil maa daa shiri zaŋ o takɔbi kuh o, ka o kpi.
en: Abimelech quickly said to the servant who carried his weapons, Take out your sword and kill me. I want you to kill me so that people will not say, A woman killed Abimelech. So the servant stabbed Abimelech with his sword, and he died.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahim nya ka bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa piila jilima ʒiishɛhi. Di saha maa ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: When Jesus noticed how the guests sought out the best seats at the table, he told them a parable.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa tuui wuhi shihir shɛli ka di wuhi o yiko ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba daa niŋ o yɛda. Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la ka o daa wuhi shihirili maa.
en: This was the first of all the miraculous signs Jesus did. He did it in the town of Cana in Galilee. By this he showed his divine greatness, and his followers believed in him.

dag: ka bindana maa yi beni, dindina samli yɔbu kani; ka di yi nyɛla o haayila biŋkɔbigu maa, dindina haayibu liɣiri maa ni zani biŋkɔbigu maa zaani.
en: But if the owner was there, then the neighbor does not have to pay. Or if the neighbor was paying money to use the animal for work, he will not have to pay if the animal dies or is hurt. The money he paid to use the animal will be enough payment.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli, A nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma shihirili din wuhiri ni nyin Yawɛ n-tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Gideon said, It's hard to believe that I'm actually talking to the Lord . Please do something so I'll know that you really are the Lord .

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa bi kpi n dɔɣibu saha? N ni daa yi m ma puli ni na maa ka daa dii kpi.
en: Why didnt I die at birth, come forth from the womb and die?.

dag: A niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni sahakam; a chɛ ka o mali suhupiɛlli din yi a sanna.
en: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari bihikpam, amaa ka lee lo tɔbu o suhu ni; o yɛtɔɣa bali gari kpam, amaa ka ŋmari kaman sudirili la.
en: His words were smoother than cream, but there was hatred in his heart; his words were as soothing as oil, but they cut like sharp swords.

dag: N dimnim maa kul duri tamdila n zuɣu dabisili kam puuni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: All day long my opponents attack me. There are so many who fight against me.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛɣu bee bua ni o mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, ka di nyɛla biŋkɔb lɔɣu bee zaɣ nyaŋ, di simdi ka o zaŋla ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa.
en: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Lala ka Yisifu so tuumba maa ni daa ti yuli Baanabas la daa niŋ. O daa nyɛla Saipurus tiŋbia, ka nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nira.
en: One of the believers was named Joseph. The apostles called him Barnabas, a name that means one who encourages others. He was a Levite born in Cyprus.

dag: Yidaampaɣ suŋ nyɛla o yidan nam zuɣupiligu, amaa paɣ so ŋun dihir o yidan vi ŋmanila dɔro o yidan kɔbili ni.
en: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.

dag: n-yɛli, So miri ka o shihi n ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ. Di niŋya n daanabinim ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont touch my anointed ones; dont harm my prophets.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣiri tiŋgbani din daa be Sukɔt mini Zɛrɛda sunsuuni la ni ka Naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa.
en: King Solomon first poured these things in clay molds. The molds were made in the Jordan Valley between the towns of Succoth and Zeredah.

dag: Nasara dibu suhupiɛlli yila be wuntizɔriba suɣa shee, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: You can hear the victory celebration in the homes of those who live right. The Lord has shown his great power again!.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun lo amiliya yɛla buɣisi li: Zaligu kul lo paɣ ŋun kuli doo mi tabil o yidana hal ni o yidana maa nyɛvili tariga; amaa o yidana maa yi ti kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni zaŋ chaŋ o yidana maa sani.
en: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, kpɛmiya kpe na. Ka yɛri bɛn ka yɛm mi;.
en: If you are stupid, come on inside! And to every fool she says.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa wum bɛ vuri maa ka bɔhi Bɔ vuri ka Hiburunim ŋɔ lee ti yɔri bɛ sansani maa ni lala? Filistianim maa ni daa ti baŋ ni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na maa.
en: The Philistines heard the shouting and said, Listen to all that shouting in the Hebrew camp! What does it mean? When they found out that the Lord 's Covenant Box had arrived in the Hebrew camp.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Ijipti daanya na, ka chɛ ka Itiɔpianim mi kpuɣi bɛ nuhi duhi zuɣusaa jɛm Naawuni.
en: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.

dag: O daa kamina ni o ti di neesim maa shɛhira, ka bɛnkam zaa wum o yɛligu niŋ yɛda o zuɣu.
en: He came as a witness to testify concerning the light, so that through him everyone would believe in the light.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ba binshɛlikam n-ʒini di gali zuɣu, gali maa ni leei din be daɣiri ni.
en: Every saddle on which the person with the emission rode will be unclean.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpa nudirigu polo, ka dunɔdali daa be nudirigu polo maa, ka o daa buɣisi di pilanima mini di zɔntua, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Next, the man took me to the south side, and there we saw another gateway. He measured its inner walls and its entrance room, and they were the same as the others.

dag: N yɛn bola piɛgul so tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ŋun baɣa ku be n piɛri bɛn be barina ni maa bee n-lihiri bɔri bɛn bɔrigi shee bee n-tibiri bɛn nya dansi bee n-dihiri bɛn mal alaafee. Amaa o ni gahindila bɛ ni piɛ kara ŋ-ŋubiri dariti tɔhiri bɛ takarifiɛma.
en: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.

dag: Di daa zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo maa hal ti paai Akirabim n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Zin n-kul zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo maa hal ni Kadɛshibarinia n-zaŋ ti gari Hɛzirɔn m-mali ti paai Adda ŋ-ŋmaligi chaŋ Karika.
en: It went south from the ascent of Akrabbim, passed on to Zin, and went up south of Kadesh-barnea. It passed on to Hezron, went up to Addar, and turned toward Karka.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka chɛ bɛ taali, ka niŋ kaman a ni mi ka sokam biɛhigu nyɛ shɛm o suhu ni ti o.
en: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to what they do and what is in their hearts.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku yi nahu sɔŋ yi ninni, amaa ka yi ku ŋub o nimdi, ka bɛ ti fa yi buŋa yi ninni chaŋ, ka ku lan zaŋ o labisina ti tin ya. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi piɛri ti yi dimnima, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: Your ox will be slaughtered while you watch, but you wont get to eat any of it. Your donkey will be stolen right out from under you, and it wont come back. Your flocks will be given to your enemies. No one will save you.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihi ʒiɛm man Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ man Yawɛ ninni? Nyini n-ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka Ammɔnnim zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka a kpuɣ o paɣa n-leeg a paɣa.
en: So why did you ignore my command? Why did you do what I say is wrong? You let the Ammonites kill Uriah the Hittite, and you took his wife. It is as if you yourself killed Uriah in war.

dag: Dama n niriba maa nyɛla jɛra; bɛ bi mi ma. Bɛ nyɛla bi jɛra, bɛ bi baŋdi binyɛra gbinni. Bɛ mali yɛm din tumdi tuumbiɛri, amaa ka lee bi mi tuun viɛla tumbu.
en: The Lord says, My people are stupid; they don't know me. They are like foolish children; they have no understanding. They are experts at doing what is evil, but failures at doing what is good.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi: Labimiya ti yɛli yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tu ma la zuɣu.
en: Isaiah said to them, Give this message to your master, Hezekiah: The Lord says, Dont be afraid of what you heard from the commanders. Dont believe what those boys from the king of Assyria said to make fun of me.

dag: Famiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba bahi; tiligimiya ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni.
en: Help those who are poor and helpless. Save them from those who are evil.

dag: Ba maa ni mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni shɛm, lala ka o ti o Bia maa yiko ni o gba mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni.
en: Just as the Father is himself the source of life, in the same way he has made his Son to be the source of life.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam li pa teeku zuɣu, ka chɛ ka di pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: Because God is the one who established it on the seas; God set it firmly on the waters.

dag: Yi ni yɛli ba bahi, ka pɔhim ʒi ba chaŋ, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-wurim ba. Di saha yi suhuri ni paligi man Yawɛ zuɣu; ka yi paɣi mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: You will toss them in the air; the wind will carry them off, and they will be scattered by the storm. Then you will be happy because I am your God; you will praise me, the holy God of Israel.

dag: yin bomiya naɣilaa ti Lɛvinima bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn kani n sanna ti tumdi n tuma la, ka bɛ mali sara alahichi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni niŋ buɣim dabi yi yɔɣu maa, ka buɣim maa di binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Giliad maa ti Manaasa bia Makiri ka o ʒini nimaani.
en: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.

dag: Hal kunduna gba chɛ ka bɛ bihi mɔɣira, amaa n niriba maa bɛn malila ninkuunsi kaman taatahi bɛn be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Even a wild dog feeds her babies. Even the jackal lets her pups suck at her breast. But the daughter of my people is cruel. She is like the ostrich in the desert that forgets its eggs in the sand.

dag: Ka ti kul ŋuhirimi ti dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ puuni, dama ti suhuri kul yɛmi ni ti zaŋ alizanda ni yili maa ye kaman binyɛrigu la m-pa ti dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili maa zuɣu;.
en: We groan while we live in this residence. We really want to dress ourselves with our building from heaven.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛla tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa sunsuuni, ka ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni n-teeg o nuu maa tiri Jɛrusalɛm. Di saha ka Dauda min o kpamba daa chibi kpalansi ye n-lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: David saw the angel standing in midair, holding his sword in his hand, ready to destroy Jerusalem. Then David and the leaders of the people—all of whom were wearing sackcloth—bowed low, with their faces touching the ground.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni yɛligu, ka lihi ʒiɛm ŋun Zallakudura Naa wuhibu la zuɣu.
en: because they had rebelled against the commands of Almighty God and had rejected his instructions.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti zaŋ anzinfa mali wuni pahi n zuɣu bee n-zaŋ salima mali wuni zali yi sani.
en: Dont make alongside me gods of silver or gold for yourselves.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi mir o ni o damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura, o teerila o nuu gbaai dilana m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Whenever anyone came to Absalom and started bowing down, he would reach out and hug and kiss them.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Bɛ yi niŋ ti mahili ŋ-ŋɔ, ka di yi kuui, wula ka di ni be.
en: If this can happen when the wood is green, what do you think will happen when it is dry?.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ti lan yɛl o, Ŋmaligim ka chɛ ma dolibu; bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka n ku a? N yi ku a wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ lih a biɛli Jɔab ninni.
en: So Abner repeated himself to Asahel: Stop chasing me. Why should I kill you? How could I look your brother Joab in the face.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la shɛm tarisi m-bɔŋɔ: Yisifu ni ti malila tarili buyi.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, These are the boundaries of the land that is to be divided among the twelve tribes, with the tribe of Joseph receiving two sections.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti shihi kum din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpe daɣiri ni, amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ ba bee bɛ ma bee bɛ bidibiga bee bɛ bipuɣiŋga bee bɛ mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee bɛ tizɔpaɣa ŋun bi kuli doo, bɛ ni tooi kpe daɣiri ni.
en: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o yab Dauda soli, ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee o nuzaa polo.
en: He lived in a way that pleased the Lord , always doing what was right, as his ancestor David had done. Josiah never changed this way of life.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin daa mali ti gari, Yawɛ ni daa fiɛbi Nail Mɔɣili maa nyaaŋa.
en: Seven days passed after the Lord struck the river.

dag: ka lɔri zaɣ biɛɣu o tɛha puuni, ka tahiri tuɣiligu na sahakam.
en: They are always planning to do something bad.

dag: Amaa maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa fiɣis o, o daa bi garigi shɛli.
en: But he didnt answer when the chief priests and elders accused him.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Ti shihila kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka bɔzuɣu ka tinim ku tooi pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu n-zaŋ Yawɛ pini na ti ti o di tibu saha.
en: These persons said to him, Although we are unclean from contact with a human corpse, why must we be prohibited from presenting the LORDs offering at its appointed time with the rest of the Israelites.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi zuɣu ka kukoli maa tɔɣisiri maa, pa n zuɣu.
en: But Jesus said to them, It was not for my sake that this voice spoke, but for yours.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Labimi mɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din miri Damaskus la. A yi paai nimaani, nyin boom kpam bahi Hazaɛl zuɣu ni ka o leei Siria naa;.
en: The Lord said, Go back. Take the road that leads to the desert around Damascus. Go into Damascus and anoint Hazael as king over Aram.

dag: Wulimpuhili zaŋ chaŋ wulinluhili ni waɣ shɛm, lala ka o yihi ti daalahichi bahi katiŋa.
en: As far as east is from west— thats how far God has removed our sin from us.

dag: saha shɛli zaa n ni na kul vuhira, ka Naawuni shia be n nyɛvoya ni ŋɔ.
en: as long as I have life in me, as long as breath from God is in my nostrils.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o lan nyɛla ninvuɣ so cheechinim ni pii n-zal o ni o doli ti ka ti tumdi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ ti Duuma jilima nyabu zuɣu, ka dimbɔŋɔ wuhi ni ti yuya ni ti sɔŋ ti taba.
en: Also, he was chosen by the churches to go with us when we carry this gift. We are doing this service to bring honor to the Lord and to show that we really want to help.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Ninive naa, ka o yiɣis o nam ʒiishee m-pirig o nam binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buɣu pili n-teei ʒini tampiligim mahili ni wuhi bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When the king of Nineveh heard about it, he got up from his throne, took off his robe, put on sackcloth, and sat down in ashes.

dag: Dabisili shɛli din pahir ayi dali, yi ni ti zaŋla bulaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara. Ka sara maligu bimbini maa yi daɣiri ni kaman naɣilaa la ni daa chɛ ka di yi daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: The next day you are to take a male goat without any defects and offer it as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood the same way you did with the bull.

dag: Nir yi chɛ ka o nini tiɣ o ni mali shɛli, di so ni o mali kɔre biɛri. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Its better to enjoy whats at hand than to have an insatiable appetite. This too is pointless, just wind chasing.

dag: Ka ti ni tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa bi yila chirimbu bee kɔr biɛri bee yɛmbimbiɛri yɔhiŋgu ni na;.
en: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.

dag: O mini Ammɔn naa min o niriba daa tuhiya ka o daa nyaŋ ba. Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa ti o anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili ni chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili, ka bɛ daa ti o li lala yuma ata.
en: He fought against the king of Ammon and his army and defeated them. Then he forced the Ammonites to pay him the following tribute each year for three years: four tons of silver, fifty thousand bushels of wheat, and fifty thousand bushels of barley.

dag: Ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir ka nyɛ Dauda zɔsimo la daa chaŋ Absalom sani ti yɛl o, Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili! Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili.
en: Davids friend, Hushai the Arkite, came to Absalom and told him, Long live the king! Long live the king.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Amasa, Cham ti boli Judanim zaa ka bɛ laɣim n sanna daba ata sunsuuni, ka a gba beni pahi.
en: David said to Amasa, Three days from now I want you and all of Judah's army to be here.

dag: So na ʒi n-chaŋ alizanda ni naɣila Daadam Bia ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tum tuma ka o yuli du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa zaa ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana la, amaa o yuli daa lee bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: He was the most famous of the Thirty. He became their commander, but he wasnt among the Three.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bimmɔrima mini yuma ni nyinvɔɣu ni saŋkpana la lu yi zuɣu, ka yi ku kpaŋ.
en: The LORD will afflict you with Egyptian inflammation, hemorrhoids, rash, and itch. You will be untreatable.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi tum din ni tiɣila omaŋmaŋ nini, amaa di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, zilim biɛ shɛŋa zaa niriba ni daa yɛr a la ʒinila n zuɣu.
en: Even Christ did not live trying to please himself. As the Scriptures say about him, Those people who insulted you have also insulted me.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yaakubu daa ti saɣi kum ka niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu bidibisi zaa yinoyino ni, o ni daa zaŋ omaŋ dalim o jaaŋgbee n-jɛmdi Naawuni saha shɛl la.
en: It was faith that made Jacob bless each of the sons of Joseph just before he died. He leaned on the top of his walking stick and worshiped God.

dag: Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ni ti no n-gili yi solɔri zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku yi niriba, ka daai yi daantali kara la luhi tiŋa.
en: The king of Babylon will come riding through your city. His horses hoofs will come pounding over your streets. He will kill your people with swords. The strong columns in your city will fall to the ground.

dag: So yi da o ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, di saha o ni tooi chɛ ka paɣ maa yiŋnim yo o zuɣu ka deeg o. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ o tom kɔhi tinzunnim zuɣu, dama o pun niŋ o din bi tuhi.
en: If the master who chose her for himself is not pleased with her, then he can sell the woman back to her father. If the master broke his promise to marry her, he loses the right to sell her to other people.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti kana ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti du Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ zoli ŋɔ zuɣu n ti kpe o jɛmbu duu ka o ti wuhi ti o soya, ka ti dol o soya maa. Dama Yawɛ wuhibu ni ti yila Ziɔn na, ka o yɛligu yi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Many people will come and say, Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple. The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa siɣi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu na, ka sagbani maa daa limsi li hal ni daba ayɔbu; dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka o daa boli Musa sagbani maa ni.
en: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.

dag: Bɛ ni so nini ku nya li, naɣila Jɛfune ŋun nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua, dama bɛn doli man Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: This included everyone, except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun; they remained loyal to the Lord .

dag: A niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri kaman saɣiri la, dinzuɣu ka n yur a zaligunima.
en: You treat all the wicked like rubbish, and so I love your instructions.

dag: Kɔbilinini Dunɔdali din daa be bɛ tooni la gbini ka bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti du Naa Dauda Tiŋ la dunɔdura din be gooni din be Dauda yiŋ zuɣusaa polo la gbini m-mali ti paai Kom Dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: At the Fountain Gate they went up the steps that led to David's City, past David's palace, and back to the wall at the Water Gate, on the east side of the city.

dag: amaa ka daa ti wum ni Arikilɔs n-di nam zan o ba Hɛrɔd zaani Judia, ka dabiɛm daa mal o ni o kul ni; ka Naawuni daa lan wuh o zahindi ni ni o ŋmaligim chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But when Joseph heard that Archelaus had succeeded his father Herod as king of Judea, he was afraid to go there. He was given more instructions in a dream, so he went to the province of Galilee.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kurigi, o daa zaŋla o bidibisi n-leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: When Samuel was old, he appointed his sons to be judges for Israel.

dag: Paɣiba, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Chɛliya ka o nol ni yɛligu kpe yi tiba ni. Wuhimiya yi bipuɣinsi kuyila, ka sokam wuh o ʒiʒiinikpee fabila.
en: We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:.

dag: Dama yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya kɔŋko, laara bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Pa lala ka farigudeeriba gba niŋda?.
en: If you love only those who love you, why should you get a reward for that? Even the tax collectors do that.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o teei dɔni Balaam jɔɣu ni, ka Balaam suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zaŋ o jaaŋgbe bil fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: So it just lay down. Balaam lost his temper, then picked up a stick and whacked the donkey.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛl o, Jɛrigu ŋɔ! Yuŋ ŋɔ n ni deeg a nyɛvili, ka a nɛma maa zaa leei ŋun dini.
en: But God said to that man, Foolish man! Tonight you will die. So what about the things you prepared for yourself? Who will get those things now.

dag: Dama ti Duuma nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka o tiba kul wumdi be suhigu. Amaa ti Duuma kul lihirila bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nimbiɛɣu.
en: For the Lord watches over the righteous and listens to their prayers; but he opposes those who do evil.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa yihi kom baptaizibu yɛla waazu la nyaaŋa ka yɛligu ŋɔ daa pili Galili m-mol gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: You know of the great event that took place throughout the land of Israel, beginning in Galilee after John preached his message of baptism.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ mini yaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun mali yaa tɔbu ni maa.
en: Who is the glorious King? He is the Lord , the powerful soldier. He is the Lord , the war hero.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Naawuni pun tahi tiliginsim yɛligu ŋɔ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn ni wum li. .
en: Therefore, be certain of this: Gods salvation has been sent to the Gentiles. They will listen.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa be Ijipti Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Bɛ daa nya azichi pam nimaani, ka daa dɔɣi bihi ka bɛ zuliya maa nab pam.
en: Israel stayed in Egypt. He lived in the land of Goshen. His family grew and became very large. They became landowners there and did very well.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni niŋ yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini yi daazichi naani la zuɣu, bɛ ni ti gbahi yi gba chaŋ ka gbaai Chɛmɔshi min o maligumaaniba, ni o kpambaliba la daba chaŋ.
en: You trust in the things you made and in your wealth, so you will be captured. The god Chemosh will be taken into captivity, and his priests and officials will be taken with him.

dag: Bɛ ni be yi sani yi sunsuuni tin shɛli bɛ ni pii yi tinsi maa ni ka di nyɛ din viɛl bɛ sani. Miriya ka yi ti muɣisi ba.
en: Runaway slaves may live with you wherever they like in whatever city they choose. You must not trouble them.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm pam la dali naanyi kana.
en: The sun will be changed into darkness, and the moon will be as red as blood. Then the great and fearful day of the Lord will come!.

dag: Amaa ka o daŋ ni nir maa ni ti kuhi yɛli dindali maa, N ku tooi leei yi tibira. N ka bindirigu bee binyɛrigu n yiŋa; yi ku zaŋ ma leei niriba zuɣulana.
en: But the answer will be, I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.

dag: Bɛ daa koya m-biri bimbira ka sa tihi, ka di daa niŋ, ka tihi maa gba daa wali pam.
en: They plant fields and vineyards and obtain a fruitful harvest.

dag: Ka Ɛli daa yi suhiri alibarika niŋdi Ɛlikana min o paɣ maa ni ka yɛri Ɛlikana, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka a paɣ ŋɔ dɔɣi bihi ti a ka bɛ zan o ni zaŋ bi so ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋɔ zaani. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan lab kuli bɛ ya.
en: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife: May the LORD replace the child of this woman that you gave back to the LORD. Then they would return home.

dag: Molimiy o jilima yɛla zuliya kam sani, ka mol o ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛŋa niriba zaa sunsuuni shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: Proclaim his glory to the nations, his mighty deeds to all peoples.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan lab teeku nol ni, ka salo maa zaa lan laɣimna nti gil o ka o wuhiri ba.
en: Jesus went out beside the lake again. The whole crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

dag: Paɣ kam ŋun nyɛ sɔnya, yin kum o.
en: Death is the punishment for witchcraft.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa naan ku tooi chaŋ nimaani ni o ti bɔhi Naawuni shɛli yɛla, dama o daa zɔrila Yawɛ malaika la takɔbi la dabiɛm.
en: David could not go to the Holy Tent to speak with God because he was afraid. He was afraid of the angel of the Lord and his sword.

dag: Ka ti daa lan nya Nɛfilimnima ; ka tinim ŋmanila sakɔri bɛ sani. Lala n-shiri nyɛ ti bɛ sani.
en: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.

dag: Di ŋubiya kuruchunima, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, amaa bɛ bi gbuɣiri ŋubira, dinzuɣu bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani. Miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ nimdi, yi mi di ti shihi bɛ zaɣ kpima.
en: And you must not eat pigs. Their hooves are divided, but they dont chew the cud. So pigs are not a clean food for you. Dont eat any meat from pigs. Dont even touch a pigs dead body.

dag: A zaŋ pɔhim leeg a tuumba, ka zaŋ buɣim mini buɣim niɛm leeg a tumtumdiba.
en: You use the winds as your messengers and flashes of lightning as your servants.

dag: Ka dɔr biɛɣu yi mali ninvuɣ so, dilan ŋun yɛm binchɛra, ka chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim, ka o pɔb o zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili ka kuhiri yɛra, Daɣiri! Daɣiri.
en: Anyone with an infection of skin disease must wear torn clothes, dishevel their hair, cover their upper lip, and shout out, Unclean! Unclean.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililan nyɛla ŋun tahiri zabili na, ka suhuyiɣisili pam tahiri biriginsim pam na.
en: Angry people stir up conflict; hotheads cause much offense.

dag: Obɛd daa nyɛla Jɛhu ba, ka Jɛhu nyɛ Azaria ba.
en: Jehu, Azariah.

dag: Suhim ma ka n zaŋ zuliya kam zaa ti a ka a su ba; ka dunia ŋɔ zaa leeg a ni su shɛli.
en: Just ask me, and I will make the nations your possession; the far corners of the earth will be your property.

dag: N ni yuri shɛba, bɛna ka n saɣisiri ka darigiri bɛ tiba; dinzuɣu moomiya yi nini niŋ tuuba.
en: I correct and discipline those whom I love. So be earnest and change your hearts and lives.

dag: Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kafitɔrinima Filistianim ni yi shɛb zuliya ni na la.
en: Pathrus, Casluh, and Caphtor.

dag: O daa yɛli Yisifu zuliya: Yawɛ daalibarika ni be o tiŋgban ni m-pahi zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani puuni pin gahinda.
en: About the tribe of Joseph he said: May the Lord bless their land with rain And with water from under the earth.

dag: Ka Naara daa dɔɣi Ahuzam mini Hɛfa ni Tɛmɛni ni Haahashitari; bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naara bidibisi.
en: Naarah gave birth to Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari for him. This was Naarahs family.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ polo, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: Son of man, look toward Pharaoh, king of Egypt. Speak for me against him and Egypt.

dag: N dima, di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla n lubu zuɣu; dama n ni lan yiɣisi. N yi ʒini zibisim ni, Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ n neesim.
en: Do not rejoice over me, my enemy, because when I fall, I will rise; if I sit in darkness, the LORD is my light.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti daŋ yibu nolɔɣu kukoli saha chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Very early the next morning before daylight, Jesus got up and went to a place where he could be alone and pray.

dag: Dinzuɣu n gba ni chɛ ka alɔbo din nyɛ bɛ ni zɔri shɛl la lu bɛ zuɣu. Dama n kuhi boli ba ka so bi saɣi, ka tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ka so bi saɣi wum li, amaa ka tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka niŋdi din bi piɛli n suhu.
en: So I will bring disaster upon them—the very things they are afraid of—because no one answered when I called or listened when I spoke. They chose to disobey me and do evil.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi li buyopɔin n-yihi li Izraɛlnim daɣiri maa ni.
en: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Ammɔnnim tintariga, yin di muɣisiya ba bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tin ya ni yi su li, dama n daa pun zaŋ li tila Lɔt zuliya ni bɛ su li. .
en: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka o biɛhigu be tibi, di so ni o nyɛ bundana ka nyɛ bilikɔɣino o tuma ni.
en: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm o suhu ni n-doli zaligunima. Amaa jɛrigu ŋun mali yɛtɔɣ yoya ni bahi yoli.
en: Sensible people accept good advice. People who talk foolishly will come to ruin.

dag: Di saha ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ paɣ yoli ŋun bi zani tuhi bia ŋɔ. A tɛhi ni m bi mi ni a zaŋ Jɛsi dapala maa kpɛh a kɔbili ni ni a dihila amaŋ vi, ka lan dih a ma gba vi?.
en: Saul was furious with Jonathan and yelled, You're no son of mine, you traitor! I know you've chosen to be loyal to that son of Jesse. You should be ashamed of yourself! And your own mother should be ashamed that you were ever born.

dag: N dabisa pala biɛla? Chɛli ma ka n suhu maai biɛla.
en: Arent my few days coming to an end? Look away from me so I can brighten up a little.

dag: Ka o daa mir o ti mɔɣis o kpariŋ; ka Yisahaku wum o binyɛra ʒiɛɣu ka niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Wummi m bia ʒiɛɣu, di ŋmanila Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ mɔ shɛl ni ʒiɛɣu.
en: So he came close and kissed him. When Isaac smelled the scent of his clothes, he blessed him, See, the scent of my son is like the scent of the field that the LORD has blessed.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini maligumaaniba kpamba daa lɔri nia ni bɛ gbaai Yisa, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim maa, amaa ka daa lee zɔri niriba.
en: When the teachers of the law and the leading priests heard this story, they knew it was about them. So they wanted to arrest Jesus right then, but they were afraid of what the people would do.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ba ka bɛ doli tipawumli soya n-tumdi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni yu shɛm.
en: So I let them go their own stubborn way and do whatever they wanted.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari. A shiri nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari ni kɔbil nini din ŋari.
en: An enclosed garden is my sister, my bride; an enclosed pool, a sealed spring.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka niriba ni ti yɛra, Yawɛ, ti paɣir a! A suhu daa yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu, amaa pumpɔŋɔ a suhu maaya, ka a lan kpaŋsi ti.
en: A day is coming when people will sing, I praise you, Lord ! You were angry with me, but now you comfort me and are angry no longer.

dag: a yi bo li kaman anzinfa la, ka bo li ni nimmoo kaman azichi shɛli din sɔɣi la.
en: Look for wisdom like silver. Search for it like hidden treasure.

dag: Guliya Naawuni piɛ shɛba o ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la. Niŋmiya li la yi suhuri ni yu lala zuɣu, ka pa ni muɣisigu bee liɣiri zuɣu, amaa di lee simdi ka di nyɛla yi suhuri n-ye lala niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Like shepherds, tend the flock of God among you. Watch over it. Dont shepherd because you must, but do it voluntarily for God. Dont shepherd greedily, but do it eagerly.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni Mɛdɛba tintan zaŋ hal ti paai Dibɔn.
en: Their territory extended to Aroer and the city in the middle of that valley and included all of the plateau from Medeba to Dibon.

dag: ka daadam kam ti nya Naawuni tiliginsim. .
en: All humanity will see Gods salvation. .

dag: O chɛ ka n naba ŋmanila naba anahilan nyaaŋa naba, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana ka barina shɛli kani.
en: He makes my feet as steady as those of a deer. Even on steep mountains he keeps me from falling.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Lakishi gari chaŋ Ɛgilɔn ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi alibarika niŋ o ni mali shɛli ni, ka chɛ ka a nini tiɣi o nuhi tuma. Kum o dimnim bɛn je ba la zuliya, ka bɛ ku lan neei yaha.
en: I pray that the LORD blesses Levis strength, favors his hard work, and crushes the insides of his enemies so that those who hate him cant fight anymore.

dag: Ka Biliha daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son for Jacob.

dag: Kahimiya yi nɛma ka bɛ gbahi ya daba chaŋ, yinim bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ. Dama Mɛmfisi ni ti leei dabari n-wurim doya, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: You will be led away captive, so pack a few things to bring with you. Your capital, Memphis, will lie empty and in ruins.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti biri bimbir shɛli gari yi wain tihi puu ni, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi ni biri binshɛli maa mini wain tihi maa wala zaa.
en: Do not plant any crop in the same field with your grapevines; if you do, you are forbidden to use either the grapes or the produce of the other crop.

dag: N di n-tiɣi kaman chuɣu ka m puhi la, ka yaai n noli paɣ a ni suhupiɛlli.
en: When I sit down to satisfy my hunger, my joyful lips hunger to praise you!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun nyɛ binneembila, ka nyɛ daadam ŋun nyɛ zunzuli ŋɔ.
en: Then what about a human being, that worm, that insect? What is a human life worth in God's eyes?.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu ka n daa bi zaɣisi Naawuni ni wuhi ma shɛli ʒii maa puuni la.
en: So, King Agrippa, I wasnt disobedient to that heavenly vision.

dag: Man karimba ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa m-be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: I am the Teacher. I was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ zaligu sahakam. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni maa mihi so, ŋun paɣim o binyɛra; ka ŋun mi shihi kom maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: This will be a permanent regulation for them. The one who sprinkles the water of purification will wash his own clothes. Anyone who touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Dauda yuli daa du pam tiŋgbɔna maa ni zaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Dauda yɛla gbaai zuliya kam dabiɛm.
en: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.

dag: ka di daa ti paag o ni o kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti tuɣili tulaale zim kaman bɛ daadiini soli ni daa zali shɛm.
en: According to the custom followed by the priests, he was chosen by lot to burn incense on the altar. So he went into the Temple of the Lord.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi ti dɔɣirikpamba bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la zuliya ni na. Ka Masia gba yila bɛ zuliya maa ni na o daadamtali puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa ŋɔ simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: they are descended from the famous Hebrew ancestors; and Christ, as a human being, belongs to their race. May God, who rules over all, be praised forever! Amen.

dag: Naa maa zaligu maa ni daa kpɛm pam maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka buɣim maa bii ti yaɣi, ka di buɣimniɛm daa ŋme n-ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo ti bahi di ni maa.
en: Now the kings command had been rash, and the furnace was heated to such an extreme that the fires flame killed the very men who carried Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun nini tiɣ a, ka zaŋ a ʒili Izraɛl nam ʒiishee ŋɔ simdi paɣibu. Yawɛ ni kul yuri Izraɛlnim saha shɛlikam la zuɣu ka o piig a leei bɛ naa ni a doli yɛlimaŋli mini wuntia soli su ba.
en: Praise the Lord your God! He was pleased to make you king of Israel. Because of the Lord s unending love for Israel, he has made you king to rule with justice and fairness.

dag: Yawɛ wumdi nandaamba suhigu, ka bi tamd o niriba bɛn be sarika ni yɛla.
en: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.

dag: Wɔhu simdila fiɛbiga, ka buŋ simdi langami, ka jɛra yaansi zuɣu mi simdi fiɛbiga.
en: A whip for a horse, a bridle for a donkey, and a rod for the back of fools.

dag: Maligumaaniba ni su shɛli niriba maa sani n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yɛn mali sara, ka di nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, di simdi ka o yihi bimbɔɣigbini mini yɛno ni bimpuli ti maligumaana.
en: Whenever cattle or sheep are sacrificed, the priests are to be given the shoulder, the jaw, and the stomach.

dag: Ka di mundili din mali yaa daa leei nam jaaŋgbee, ka daa zooi zuɣusaa tibɔŋ ni, ka di daa niŋ wɔɣilim, ka mali wula pam.
en: Its branches were strong and grew to be royal scepters. The vine grew tall enough to reach the clouds; everyone saw how leafy and tall it was.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti suhuri piɛla, ka ti duh o ka tibig o, dama Piɛbil la amiliya lɔbu saha paaya, ka o daamiliya paɣ maa pun mali shili.
en: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.

dag: Sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa pah ata n-su gol so ŋun pah ata ni n-daa nyɛ maligumaana Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya, o daa nyɛla kpɛma. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the third month, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada the priest.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti chɛ ka yilli bili Izraɛl, ka n chɛ ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bɛ sani. Di saha ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Ezekiel, when Egypt is defeated, I will make the people of Israel strong, and I will give you the power to speak to them. Then they will know that I, the Lord , have done these things.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ kurig anu saha ka o daa lan chaŋ ti nya ka shɛb lan ʒiya ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ʒi kpe yoli biɛɣu zaa.
en: It was nearly five o'clock when he went to the marketplace and saw some other men still standing there. Why are you wasting the whole day here doing nothing? he asked them.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe Omri nyaaŋa daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe Ginat bia Tibini nyaaŋa, ka Tibini daa kpi; ka Omri leei naa.
en: Omri's followers were stronger than Tibni's, so Tibni was killed, and Omri became king of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ li na; ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: They brought him a silver coin, and he asked, Whose picture and name are on it? The Emperor's, they answered.

dag: Ka di ti kpalimla omaŋmaŋ biyurigu ko, ka o ti bahi tim o gba bɛ sani ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia maa ŋun jilima.
en: Now the landowner had one son whom he loved dearly. He sent him last, thinking, They will respect my son.

dag: Ka wula ka ninsal lee ni tooi be kasi Naawuni tooni? Wula ka paɣ ni dɔɣi so lee ni tooi be ka ka daɣiri?.
en: How can a person be innocent before God; one born of a woman be pure?.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli ba, Firawuna yɛliya, N ku lan tin ya mɔri.
en: The slave bosses and the men in charge of the slaves went out and told them, The king says he will not give you any more straw.

dag: O nuhi tuma nyɛla din ʒe yim ka tuhi. O zaligunim zaa mali naani niŋbu.
en: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.

dag: Nir yi di n-tiɣi, o baɣa ka shiri ni, amaa kum yi mali nira, hal binshɛli din to gba nyaɣisimi.
en: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa tahirila alibarika na, ka yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa kaman di ni daa niŋ shɛm yi sani dahin shɛli yi ni daa tuui wum Naawuni daanfaani yɛla ka baŋ ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli la.
en: that was told to you. Throughout the world, this Good News is bringing blessings and is spreading. And thats what has been happening among you since the first time you heard it and understood the truth about Gods grace.

dag: Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa ka di galisi pam, di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi zahim baŋ bɛ ni zaŋ daanya shɛm tariga mal li.
en: So many objects were made that no one determined the total weight of the bronze used.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Ka bɛ dimnim zaa puuni ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tooi zani bɛ tooni, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnim maa zaa.
en: The Lord gave them peace throughout the land, just as he had promised their ancestors. Not one of all their enemies had been able to stand against them, because the Lord gave the Israelites the victory over all their enemies.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya nambɔɣu kaman yi Ba Naawuni ni zɔri nambɔɣu shɛm.
en: Give love and mercy the same as your Father gives love and mercy.

dag: N ni chani ni yolisim, dama m bo n-nya a zaligunima.
en: I will walk around in wide-open spaces, because I have pursued your precepts.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi ti dɔɣirikpamba bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la zuliya ni na. Ka Masia gba yila bɛ zuliya maa ni na o daadamtali puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa ŋɔ simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: They are the descendants of our great fathers, and they are the earthly family of the Messiah, who is God over all things. Praise him forever! Amen.

dag: A daalikauli min a suhu yubu zuɣu, ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa ni a chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ baŋ li.
en: For the sake of your word and according to your own will, you have done this great thing so that your servant would know it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka Bɔaz yɛli Rut, Kamina ti deei bɔrɔbɔro suɣi kpam. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini kachɛriba maa sani, ka Bɔaz zaŋ chi bɔrɔbɔro ti o. Ka o daa ŋub li tiɣi ka guui shɛli.
en: At mealtime, Boaz told Ruth, Come and eat some of our bread. Here, dip your bread in our vinegar. So Ruth sat down with the workers. Boaz gave her some roasted grain. Ruth ate until she was full, and there was some food left.

dag: So yi yu ni o tum Naawuni yubu, o ni baŋ ni wuhibu ŋɔ yila ŋun Naawuni sanna bee m-baŋ ni di nyɛla mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka n wuhiri li.
en: Whoever wants to do Gods will can tell whether my teaching is from God or whether I speak on my own.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Cham ti bol a yidan na.
en: Jesus said to her, Go, get your husband, and come back here.

dag: Ŋun kur niriba yiɣisirila zaawuni n-chana ni o ku nandaamba mini faranima. Yuŋ yi paai, o ŋmanila tayiɣa.
en: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.

dag: O zaŋm o ni daa niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Ibrahimma ni la niŋ a min a zuliya bɛn be a san ni, ka yi deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Ibrahimma, ka yi be di ni ŋɔ su.
en: May he bless you with the land he promised Abraham, so that you will take over this land where we now live as foreigners.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka deei kaɣili maa fiɛbir o zuɣu ni.
en: After they spit on him, they took the stick and struck his head again and again.

dag: Zibisim shɛli kani bee bumbɔni, ka alahichinim ni tooi sɔɣi di ni.
en: There is no place dark enough for evil people to hide from God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro la ti ba, ka daa zaŋ zahim la gba pahi ba.
en: So Jesus went over, took the bread, and gave it to them; he did the same with the fish.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpalim be mɔɣu ni sɔɣisili shee din be Zif mɔɣu ni zoya tiŋgbɔŋ la ni. Ka Sool daa kul lihiri bɔr o dabisili kam, amaa ka Naawuni daa bi zaŋ o niŋ o nuu ni.
en: David lived in the fortresses in the wilderness and in the hills of the Ziph wilderness. Saul searched for him constantly, but God did not hand David over to Saul.

dag: Ibram ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun pia nyaaŋa, ka Ibram paɣ Zarai daa zaŋ o dabili Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti bipuɣiŋga la n-ti o yidana Ibram ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: and Sarai gave him Hagar to be his wife. This happened after Abram had lived in the land of Canaan for ten years.

dag: Ŋun yi taali ni Naawuni sani kul ni bela yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, amaa o yi tiri gbini, n suhu ku piɛl o zuɣu.
en: but my righteous one will live by faith, and my whole being wont be pleased with anyone who shrinks back. .

dag: Yi zuri yi mabihi nyaaŋa, ka zaŋdi yimaŋmaŋ mapuuni bihi taali.
en: You sit around talking about people, finding fault with your own brothers.

dag: Nachimba mini paɣisara ni ninkura ni bihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Do the same, you young men—young women too!— you who are old together with you who are young!.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba ŋɔ, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: You who are faithful to the LORD, sing praises to him; give thanks to his holy name!.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, n ni zaŋ ba Bashan n-labisi kpe na. N ni yihi ba teeku bulli ni na.
en: My Lord said, If they run up to Bashan or down to the depths of the sea, I will bring them back.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kawana ʒili bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: they each loaded the grain on their donkeys and left.

dag: N ku lan chɛ ka yi wum zuliya shɛb turi, yi mi ku lan nya filiŋ zuliya shɛb sani, ka yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya maa lu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will not let those other nations insult you anymore. You will not be hurt by them anymore. You will not take the children away from your people again. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo naɣ muni maa zaa o ninni, dina n-nyɛ o gbaŋ min o nimdi ni o ʒim ni o puuni binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Then the whole cow must be burned in front of him; the skin, the meat, the blood, and the intestines must all be burned.

dag: Nyama, n yaai n noli, ka n zilinli din be n nol ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: I am ready to say what's on my mind.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kuhi pam yɛli, ŋmamiya tia maa luhi; ka ŋmahi di wula bahi; ka wɔbi di vari bahi; ka wɔbi di wala gba bahi. Karimiya biŋkɔbiri la di gbini ka kari noonsi la di wula maa zuɣu.
en: He proclaimed loudly: Cut down the tree and shear off its branches! Strip its leaves and scatter its fruit! The creatures should flee from its shelter; the birds should take flight from its branches.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-chaŋ gili tiŋ maa napɔŋ yim, ka zaŋ li lab bɛ sansani maa ni ti gbe.
en: He made the LORDs chest circle the city, going around one time. They went back to the camp and stayed there overnight.

dag: Pa doo ka Naawuni daa nam ti paɣa, amaa paɣ ka Naawuni daa nam ti doo.
en: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.

dag: Ka Akishi daa niŋ Dauda naani pam ka yɛli, O chɛ ka o niriba Izraɛlnim bi lan bɔr o yɛlli zaa, dinzuɣu o kul ni nyɛ n tumtumda sahakam.
en: Achish trusted David, thinking, David has alienated himself so badly from his own people in Israel that hell serve me forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba suhuri fuŋya, ka niriba pam tuura. N zaŋ takɔbi maa naŋgbancholi zali bɛ dunoya zaa ni. Bɛ mal li mi ka di nyaɣisira ka saa la. Ka nyahi neei li ni di ku niriba.
en: to make hearts shudder, to make many stumble and fall. Ive set the slaughtering sword against all their gates. Oh! Its crafted to flash like lightning, polished for slaughter!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi wumdi n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ni zaŋ o ŋ-ŋmahindila jɛr so ŋun daa me o yili zali bihigu ni.
en: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Bɛ ni ti niŋ zina, amaa ka ku dɔɣi bihi, dama bɛ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ka jɛmdila buɣa.
en: You will eat your share of the sacrifices, but still be hungry. You will worship the fertility gods, but still have no children, because you have turned away from me to follow other gods.

dag: Anabi Jɛrimia daa talimla Nɛria bia Sɛraya ŋun daa nyɛ Masɛya yaaŋa la ni o zaŋ lahibal shɛli chaŋ Babilɔn saha shɛl o ni daa doli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn o nam dibu yuma anahi ni la. Sɛraya daa nyɛla naa zo.
en: King Zedekiah's personal attendant was Seraiah, the son of Neriah and grandson of Mahseiah. In the fourth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, Seraiah was going to Babylonia with him, and I gave him some instructions.

dag: N nyee nyɔni n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam zaa dunia ŋɔ ni, dama m mi ni n yɛn chɛ li zalila na shɛb bɛn yɛn doli n nyaaŋa.
en: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.

dag: N ni zaŋ ba niŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o kpambaliba bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba la nuu ni. Di nyaaŋa niriba ni ti lan be Ijipti kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni la. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and hand them over to those who want to kill them, to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army. But later on, people will live in Egypt again, as they did in times past. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Naawuni zaŋd o kukoli din nyɛ satahiŋga ŋɔ tumdi alahiziba tuma; o tumdi tuun kara din gari ti yɛm.
en: creating miracles too marvelous for us to understand.

dag: Amaa o yidana yi wum pɔri maa yɛla ka bi yɛl o shɛli dabisili din paya dali, dindina di wuhiya ni o saɣ o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o niŋ shɛli maa, o ni daa wum di yɛla saha shɛli ka bi yɛl o shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: But if her husband keeps silent from one day to the next, he has upheld all her solemn promises, or all her binding obligations. He has upheld them because he remained silent on the day he heard them.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛligu din daa kul maan chanila tooni pahira.
en: God's message kept spreading.

dag: dama m Ba maa maŋmaŋ yuri ya, yi ni yuri ma ka niŋ yɛda ni n yila m Ba maa sanna zuɣu.
en: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Great blessings belong to those who are humble. They will be given the land God promised.

dag: ni Kiriataim ni Sibima ni Zɛrɛtishaha din daa be vinvamli ni zol zuɣu la.
en: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, the Zereth-shahar highlands.

dag: ni Shamma mini Ɛlika bɛn daa yi Harɔd na la.
en: Shammah the Harodite; Elika the Harodite;.

dag: Ka sapashini maa ni daa yɛl o ni Yisa shiri kpiya maa, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ni Yisifu zaŋm Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: When Pilate heard it from the officer, he told Joseph he could have the body.

dag: Amaa ka yi ti malila suhupiɛlli ka puhiri chuɣu, ka kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri ŋ-ŋubiri bɛ nimdi ka nyuri wain ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti di ka nyu, dama biɛɣuni ti sa ni kpi.
en: Instead, you laughed and celebrated. You killed sheep and cattle to eat, and you drank wine. You said, We might as well eat and drink! Tomorrow we'll be dead.

dag: A ku lan ti ti kpiɔŋ, ka a niriba ŋɔ lan nya suhupiɛlli a sani yaha?.
en: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛl o ni o bom naa ti ba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: Those people asked for a king. So Samuel told them everything the Lord said.

dag: Lala ka bɛ zaŋ chira din ka binshɛli ti ma, ka zaŋ yuŋ shɛŋa din mali wahala ti ma.
en: Month after frustrating month has gone by. I have suffered night after night.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim mini bɛ kpamba maa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ suhuri zɔhira.
en: The officials and the people were upset when they heard this.

dag: Asiria beni, ka di tɔbbihi zaa gbala gil li, takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ ku bɛ zaa.
en: The graves of soldiers from Assyria are there. They once terrified people, but they were killed in battle and now lie deep in the world of the dead.

dag: A chɛ a niriba tuumbiɛri paŋ ba; ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa paŋ ba.
en: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni duhi ya gari dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa.
en: If you obey the Lord your God and faithfully keep all his commands that I am giving you today, he will make you greater than any other nation on earth.

dag: O tiri bɛnkam zaa zɔr o bɛ ni bɔri shɛli. O lan deeri bɛn suhir o suhigu ka tiligiri ba.
en: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa yi tɔŋbu saha, amaa ka yi daa yɛli, Ti ku wum. Yi biɛhigu m-pun bala yi bilim tariga, dama yi bi deei n noli.
en: Judah, you felt safe, but I warned you. I warned you, but you refused to listen. You have lived like this from the time you were young. And from the time you were young, you have not obeyed me, Judah.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibubalibu kpe bɛ suhuri ni nti ku yɛligu maa, ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: But they start worrying about the needs of this life. They are fooled by the desire to get rich and to have all kinds of other things. So the message gets choked out, and they never produce anything.

dag: M muɣisigu nyabu dali, n daa suhi n Duuma. N daa kpuɣila n nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Naawuni yuŋ zaa ka di bi wum ma, ka n suhu daa zaɣisi maabu.
en: During the day when Im in trouble I look for my Lord. At night my hands are still outstretched and dont grow numb; my whole being refuses to be comforted.

dag: Yawɛ, kokpɛɣu kpuɣi zani, kokpɛɣu duhi di yee, kokpɛɣu gbaai vubu.
en: LORD, the floods have raised up— the floods have raised up their voices; the floods raise up a roar!.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt ni daa wum ni bɛ ku Nɛr bia Abinɛr la Hiburɔn, o kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri zɔhira.
en: When Ishbosheth, Sauls son, heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost his courage, and all Israel was alarmed.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila chɛchɛbuŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu, ka dari wɔhu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga ni pihinu. Lala ka bɛ gba daa kɔhiri ba tiri Hitinim mini Siria nanim zaa.
en: and the export of chariots from Egypt. They supplied the Hittite and Syrian kings with horses and chariots, selling chariots for pieces of silver each and horses for each.

dag: Ti ni daa na be yi san la, ti daa pun yɛli ya ni ti ni nya alaka, ka yi zaa mi ni lala n-shiri niŋ.
en: For while we were still with you, we told you ahead of time that we were going to be persecuted; and as you well know, that is exactly what happened.

dag: Ka saha shɛlikam bɛ yi ti zaŋ sara ni bɛ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ vuhim dabisa dali bee gol paliga dabisa dali bee churi dabisa dali, bɛ zaanila Lɛvinim bɛn yɛn be Yawɛ tooni kalinli tariga ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Whenever entirely burned offerings were offered to the LORD for the sabbaths, the new moons, and festivals, a designated number were to serve in the LORDs presence continuously.

dag: Yurilim bi naara; amaa di yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa yɛla, di gba nyɛla din garita.
en: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.

dag: Di bi simdi ka maligumaana di biŋkɔb so bee noon so ŋun kpi o zuɣu bee biŋkɔbiri ni ku so. .
en: The priests must not eat any bird or animal that has died a natural death or has been torn to pieces by a wild animal.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Lɛvinim mini bɛ daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔnnima; ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba nyɛ Kɔhatinima; ka Mɛrari daŋ niriba nyɛ Mɛrarinima.
en: The tribe of Levi included the clans of the Gershonites, Kohathites, Merarites.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ kpani kahigi wuhi dimbɔŋɔ puuni, ka man sani n nyaya ka di wuhirila Masia mini cheechi yɛla.
en: Marriage is a significant allegory, and Im applying it to Christ and the church.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Zaligu dini ka Anabi Musa daa lee zali ya.
en: Jesus answered, What did Moses command you.

dag: Tɛma kɔhigɔriba lihirimi bɔri kom, ka Shiiba sochandiba mali tahima ni bɛ gba ni nya kom.
en: Caravans from Tema and Sheba.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Then, if anyone says to you, Look, here is the Messiah! or There he is!—do not believe it.

dag: ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Naa Dauda ba. Naa Dauda daa nyɛla o paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Yuria paɣa la bia Sulemaana ba;.
en: From David to the time of the exile in Babylonia, the ancestors of Jesus were: David, Solomon , Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram; Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, Josiah, and Jehoiachin and his brothers.

dag: N daa lo nia ni n ka yi sanna nti kaai ya ka gari chaŋ Masidɔnia; ka ti lan yi Masidɔnia lab yi sanna ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ Judia.
en: I planned to visit you on my way to Macedonia and again on my way back. I wanted to get help from you for my trip to Judea.

dag: Jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla fiɛbiga n-fiɛbiri bɛ yaansi zuɣu, amaa yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa n-gbibi ba.
en: Proud fools talk too much; the words of the wise protect them.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, N sapashinnim zaa nyɛla nanima.
en: Assyria says to himself, All of my officers are like kings!.

dag: Dinzuɣu wulimpuhili polo nim ni ti tibigi Yawɛ; ka bɛn ʒi n-dolisi teeku tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli.
en: Therefore, in the east honor the LORD; in the islands of the sea, the name of the LORD God of Israel!.

dag: N dimnim maa kul bɔrila soli dabisili kam ni bɛ saɣim m bukaata; bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla bɛ loya ni bɛ niŋ ma la zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: All day long they frustrate my pursuits; all their thoughts are evil against me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka baansi yiini yila yɛra, Kamiya Hɛshibɔn na, mɛmiya li. Chɛliya ka Sihɔn tiŋ maa zani.
en: That is why the singers sing this song: Go in and rebuild Heshbon! Make Sihons city strong.

dag: Ŋun yur o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋun mi je o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni ni ti mal li hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: If you love your life, you will lose it. If you give it up in this world, you will be given eternal life.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi pahi biŋkɔbigu ʒim zuɣu m-mali sara ti ma bee n-chɛ ka yi ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara biŋkpam zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Dont offer the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened. Dont let the fat of my festival offering be left over until the morning.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni shɛb daa shihila kpima, ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa dindali maa. Bɛna n-daa ka Musa mini Aduna sanna dindali maa.
en: But there were persons who were unclean from contact with a human corpse, and they were unable to keep the Passover on that day. They approached Moses and Aaron that day.

dag: Ka tiŋgula ŋun daa tam Jɛziriil pii zuɣu daa ti lihi nya Jɛhu min o niriba ni kanna ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ kanna. Ka Jɔram yɛl o, Timmi wɔribara ka o chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli m-bɔhi ba, Alaafee? .
en: The guard standing on the tower at Jezreel saw a crowd of people coming with Jehu. He said, I see a crowd of people. Joram said, Take a chariot driver. Send him out to meet them to ask, Do you come in peace.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu: N nya Naawuni ni ʒi o nam ʒiishee, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo.
en: Micaiah replied: I then saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.

dag: Nir jɛrilim tuma bahir o yoli, di zaa yoli ka o suhu yiɣisiri bahiri Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: People ruin their lives with the foolish things they do, and then they blame the Lord for it.

dag: Chɛ ka n dimnim be kaman ninvuɣ biɛri la, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ma be kaman bɛn pa wuntizɔriba la.
en: May my enemies be punished like those who are evil. May those who stood against me end up like all who have done wrong.

dag: O chɛ ka n zaŋla n nyina ŋubiri kuɣichaɣila, ka chɛ ka n kɔri tampiligim puɣi mmaŋa.
en: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.

dag: Azaria n-daa nyɛ Hɛlɛz ba, ka Hɛlɛz mi nyɛ Ɛliasa ba.
en: Azariah was Helezs father. Helez was Eleasahs father.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nini na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: This will be the worst time of suffering since the beginning of the world, and nothing this terrible will ever happen again.

dag: Tiŋ maa mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni leela yi ni yɛn saɣim shɛli ti Yawɛ. Kulla Reehab ŋun nyɛ pagɔrili la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o yiŋ kɔŋko ka di simdi ni yi tiligi, o ni daa zaŋ ti tuumba la sɔɣi la zuɣu.
en: The city and everything in it must be totally destroyed as an offering to the Lord . Only the prostitute Rahab and her household will be spared, because she hid our spies.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni bo binshɛŋa zaa ni bɛ me du kasi maa, n lan mali mmaŋmaŋ daazichi din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa, ka n ni zaŋ n zaŋsim zaa niŋ n Naawuni duu ŋɔ mɛbu ni maa zuɣu, n zaŋ li ti ni bɛ tum n Naawuni duu maa tuma.
en: Whats more, because of my delight in my Gods temple, I have dedicated my own private treasure of gold and silver to my Gods temple, in addition to all that Ive provided for the holy temple.

dag: Teem a ni daa pun piig a ninvuɣ shɛb kurimbuni ha la yɛla, a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ nyɛ a ni su zuliya shɛb la. Teem Ziɔn Zo shɛli zuɣu a ni daa be la yɛla.
en: Remember your congregation that you took as your own long ago, that you redeemed to be the tribe of your own possession— remember Mount Zion, where you dwell.

dag: Lala ni daa niŋ maa ka nimaani ŋunkam mali dɔro ka Pool sanna ti nya bɛ dɔriti maa tib kpaŋ.
en: Once this happened, the rest of the sick on the island came to him and were healed.

dag: Nyini n-ti wɔhu yaa? Nyini n-zaŋ gbɛm tam o nyiŋgoli zuɣu?.
en: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti neei bɛ nina, ka gbilisi bɛ tiba wum niriba yɛlimuɣisira.
en: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.

dag: dama nyɛvili samli galisiya pam, ka so ku tooi nya liɣiri din ni saɣi di zuɣu yɔbu;.
en: The price to save someones life is too high— wealth will never be enough.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, A bia Yisifu kana; ka o daa kpaŋ omaŋ yiɣisi ʒin o bindoo zuɣu.
en: When Jacob was informed, Your son Joseph is here now, he pulled himself together and sat up in bed.

dag: Amaa ka ti Duuma malaika daa chaŋ dindali yuŋ nti yooi duu maa dunoya ka yihi ba na yɛli ba.
en: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi saɣi, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna; ka n yi ti kana, n ni baŋ bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ maa ni mali shɛli, ka di pala bɛ ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko, amaa bɛ yiko gba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan yɛli Kɔra, Yinim Lɛvi zuliya ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Moses said to Korah, Listen, you Levites.

dag: Kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya, amaa ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizi ya.
en: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul laɣindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni suhu yini biɛɣukam, ka laɣindi taba yinsi n-laɣindi diri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Day after day they met as a group in the Temple, and they had their meals together in their homes, eating with glad and humble hearts.

dag: Ka Gomna Gɛdalia daa lo ba alikauli yɛli, Di zɔriya Babilɔn sapashinnim dabiɛm, kpalimmiya be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka binshɛlikam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Gedaliah made promises to these officers and their men. He said to them, Dont be afraid of the Babylonian officers. Stay here and serve the king of Babylon. Then everything will be all right with you.

dag: Yawɛ buɣisiri wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa biɛhigu, ka o suhu je bɛn yuri duŋ taabu.
en: He examines the good and the wicked alike; the lawless he hates with all his heart.

dag: Yawɛ yi di bi sɔŋ ma, ŋ-ŋɔ n shia di be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: If the Lord had not helped me, I would have gone quickly to the land of silence.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu la daa bi sabi zalila ti yab Ibrahimma kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.

dag: Man Jeemsi ŋun nyɛ Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabili la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri yinim bɛn nyɛ ti zuliya pinaayi bɛn wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam la m-puhiri ya.
en: From James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ: Greetings to all God's people scattered over the whole world.

dag: N ni boli n niriba n-laɣim ba. N ni fa ba bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kalinli zooi kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia daa mali buni pam ka niriba daa tir o jilima. O daa mɛla omaŋmaŋ nɛma zalibu shee duri, n-zaŋdi o da anzinfa min o salima ni o kuɣ viɛla ni o tulaale ni o nyɔtaɣirisi ni o binshɛɣukam din mali shaara pam.
en: Hezekiah became very wealthy and greatly respected. He made storehouses for his silver, gold, precious stones, spices, shields, and other valuables.

dag: Dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin baŋmiya ni mani ka bɛ pun daŋ zaɣisi ka naanyi ti jɛn ya maa.
en: If the world hates you, know that it hated me first.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa daa garigi yɛl o, O ni ku padir biɛri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa ti padir shɛb bɛn ni zaŋ di daatam maa ti o di kpuɣibu saha.
en: The Jewish priests and leaders said, He will surely kill those evil men. Then he will lease the land to other farmers, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla zali, ka kahigi li wuhi, ka di daa bi yuui, ka n chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: Past things I announced long ago; from my mouth I proclaimed them. I acted suddenly, and they came about.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka bɛ sanna sagban wɔɣinli puuni. Sagban wɔɣinli maa daa zanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: and the Lord appeared to them there in a pillar of cloud that stood by the door of the Tent.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam ti ti o yaa tariga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm.
en: Each one should have his gift in hand, in precise measure with the blessing the LORD your God gives you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira maa neei biɛɣu, ka manna la daa chɛ lubu na. Ka Izraɛlnim daa bi lan nya li di yaha, amaa ka daa kpalim dirila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bindira di yuuni maa ni.
en: The manna stopped falling then, and the Israelites no longer had any. From that time on they ate food grown in Canaan.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa zali ni bɛ malim adaka zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali gbini.
en: King Joash gave a command for a box to be made and put outside the gate at the Lord s Temple.

dag: Gibiɔn maa ka Yawɛ daa ti ka Sulemaana sanna zahindi ni yuŋ nti yɛl o, Suhim a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa laɣim dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa n-zali luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Hiburuli ni Aamagɛdɔn la.
en: Then the evil spirits gathered the rulers together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

dag: Obil ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la daa lihirila laakumnima, ka Jɛdɛiya ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrɔnɔt nir la daa lihiri bunsi, ka Jaziz ŋun daa nyɛ Hagiri nir la mi daa lihiri piɛri mini buhi.
en: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.

dag: Amaa n ti ku darigi deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, dama n ni ti zaŋ zuliya yini ti a bia maa n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii shɛli leegi n tiŋ la zuɣu.
en: Moreover, I wont tear away the entire kingdom. I will give one tribe to your son on account of my servant David and on account of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.

dag: N ni lan labi ti be m biɛhigu shee hal ka bɛ ti saɣi ni bɛ tum taali, ka bo n shee. Bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, bɛ ni bo n shee.
en: I will leave so that I can return to my place until they pay for their deeds, until they seek me. In their distress, they will beg for my favor.

dag: Ka m bo o nuzaa polo, ka o sɔɣi, ka n ku tooi nya o, ka n ŋmaligi nudirigu polo, amaa ka bi tooi nya o.
en: north in his activity, and I dont grasp him; he turns south, and I dont see.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒe teeku duli lan piligi wuhiri niriba. Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni teeku maa ni, ka salo maa zaa daa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: Jesus began to teach beside the lake again. Such a large crowd gathered that he climbed into a boat there on the lake. He sat in the boat while the whole crowd was nearby on the shore.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ, niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni.
en: May you be blessed by the Lord , who made heaven and earth!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka anabi yi yimaŋmaŋ niriba ni na kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ti wummiya anabi maa yɛligu.
en: Instead, he will send you a prophet like me from among your own people, and you are to obey him.

dag: Amaa di ni kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣa mini yuya ni yimaŋmaŋ zaligu yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku di di saria. Yimaŋmaŋ malimiya li.
en: But since this concerns only words, names, and your own law, you will have to take care of it yourselves. I refuse to judge such matters.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ma ni n wuhim ya zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka yi ti gbib li yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa ni.
en: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su tahi shɛŋa mini la shɛŋa din be kasi la fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su bɔrɔbɔro zim mini wain ni kpam ni tulaale zim ni tulaalɛnim zaa fukumsi.
en: Others were appointed over the furniture, the holy equipment, the flour, wine, oil, incense, and spices.

dag: bɛ yi yɛli ya di yɛla bee yi yi wum di yɛla, ka yi vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din chihiri maa shiri tumiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: and you hear news about it, then you must look into this situation very carefully. And if its definitely true that this detestable thing was done in Israel.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la.
en: The Day of Unleavened Bread came. This was the day when the Jews always killed the lambs for the Passover.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya maa tin shɛli ni.
en: You are not permitted to offer the Passover sacrifice in any of the cities that the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa ni ŋun leei maligumaana ni o zan o zaani la ni mali sara maa ti Yawɛ kaman zaligu din nyɛ din ka bahigu, ka bɛ ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim.
en: Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Damaskusnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaŋ ninkuunsi n-nahim Giliadnima nahindi biɛɣu.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of Damascus, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because they have harvested Gilead with sharp iron tools.

dag: So yi bol a ni a ka o daamiliya lɔbu ni na, nyin miri ka a chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti boli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yuli gar a;.
en: When you are invited to a wedding feast, don't sit in the best place. Someone more important may have been invited.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ zoligɔnim ga saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi la? Bee a ni tooi yihi binshɛli din gbibi saŋmar so bɛ ni booni Goli wulan la.
en: Can you bind Pleiades chains or loosen the reins of Orion?.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani mini ti kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-kul be ti sani n-sɔŋdi ti ti muɣisigu saha.
en: God is our protection and source of strength. He is always ready to help us in times of trouble.

dag: N yura n-su ma, ka o kɔre be n ni.
en: My darling, I am yours, and you desire me.

dag: Ka o daa ka naa Ɛhab sanna, ka naa bɔhi, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni nya nasara, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth? Yes! Micaiah answered. The Lord will help you capture the city.

dag: Nir yi nya yɛm, di so salima, ka nir yi pii tɛhi zilima, di so anzinfa.
en: Acquiring wisdom is much better than gold, and acquiring understanding is better than silver.

dag: Di saha maa ha so daa yi yɛn chaŋ shɛli polo ka labina o suhu bi doya; dama tinsi maa nim daa kul zabirimi.
en: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Tabɛra, Yawɛ buɣim ni daa di bɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: They named the place Burning, because in his anger the Lord had set their camp on fire.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla mini Yisa so ŋun daa kpi ka Pool yɛli ni o ne la yɛla tɔɣisi.
en: Instead, they quibbled with him about their own religion and about some dead man named Jesus, who Paul claimed was alive.

dag: A yuli zuɣu, di tabigi ti bahi. Miri ka a filim a nam ʒiishee din mali jilima ŋɔ. Teema, ka miri ka a saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la.
en: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.

dag: Ka o daa mali Ɛlat me n-ti Judanima, Naa Amazia kalinsi maa nyaaŋa.
en: Uzziah rebuilt the town of Elath and gave it back to Judah. He did this after Amaziah died and was buried with his ancestors.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni tilig o niriba, ka zo o daba nambɔɣu, o yi ti nya ka bɛ lan ka yiko, ka bɛ ni lo so bee bɛ ni bi lo so ti ku lan kpalim.
en: The Lord will rescue his people when he sees that their strength is gone. He will have mercy on those who serve him, when he sees how helpless they are.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N ni kpihim ninsal shɛba n ni daa nam niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri mini biŋgbamda ni noonsi birili, dama di niŋ ma yoli pam n ni daa nam ba maa zuɣu.
en: and he said, I'm going to destroy every person on earth! I'll even wipe out animals, birds, and reptiles. I'm sorry I ever made them.

dag: Di zaa ni ti nyɛla dapaɣa anii mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pinaayɔbu; ka dapaɣili kam tam diba ayi zuɣu.
en: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wun shɛŋa din pa din daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ zaa ni ti naai dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ku lan be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na.
en: The Lord says, Tell them this message: These false gods did not make heaven and earth. They will be destroyed and disappear from heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Shupim mini Hupim daa nyɛ Iri bidibisi, ka Hushim mi daa nyɛ Ahɛr bidibiga.
en: The Shuppites and Huppites were Irs family, and the Hushites were Ahers family.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n kul kumdi ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka di bi chɛra, dama bɛ ŋme n niriba bɛn be kaman m bipuɣiŋga ŋun ʒi doo maa kurili luhi, ka bɛ nya dan titali.
en: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa daŋ tooni na la o daa yihirila waazu yɛri Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ niŋm tuuba ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Before he came, John told all the people of Israel what they should do. He told them to be baptized to show they wanted to change their lives.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka niriba ni ti yɛra, Yawɛ, ti paɣir a! A suhu daa yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu, amaa pumpɔŋɔ a suhu maaya, ka a lan kpaŋsi ti.
en: At that time you will say, I thank you, Lord ! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ Mɔdɛkai sani tiŋ puuni pal shɛli din daa miri nayili dunol la shee.
en: Hathach went out to Mordecai, to the city square in front of the Kings Gate.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be vinvamli ni ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim ŋmaligimi guui, ka Sool min o bidibisi kpi, ka bɛ daa yi bɛ tinsi ni zo. Ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ti be di ni.
en: When all the Israelites living in the valley saw that their own army had run away and that Saul and his sons were dead, they left their towns and ran away. Then the Philistines came into the towns and lived in them.

dag: ka din pahi pisiyinika daa gbaai Mallɔti min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Nineteenth, there were men chosen from Mallothis sons and relatives.

dag: Isaka zuliya ni, Zua bia Nɛtanɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Issachar, Nethanel, Zuars son.

dag: Sɛt daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Seth lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kpihim yi birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: because the LORD your God, who is with you and among you, is a passionate God. The LORD your Gods anger will burn against you, and he will wipe you off the fertile land.
