dag: Dinzuɣu yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o ni yɛli shɛm min o fukumsi zalikpana ni o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi sahakam.
en: Love the Lord your God and always obey all his laws.

dag: Amaa o ni ti dolila wuntia soli n-kari nandaamba saria; ka kari saria din tuhi ti dunia ŋɔ bɛn ka. O ni ti zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-fiɛbi dunianima; ka lan zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-ku ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: He will judge the needy with righteousness, and decide with equity for those who suffer in the land. He will strike the violent with the rod of his mouth; by the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote for us that if a mans brother dies leaving a widow but no children, the brother must marry the widow and raise up children for his brother .

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ti chaŋ a ni daa tim ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka di tiŋgbani maa vuhira, di tiwala mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: They told Moses, We explored the land and found it to be rich and fertile; and here is some of its fruit.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋahili ŋɔ bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim, amaa ka daa lee zɔri salo maa ka chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: The leaders knew that Jesus was really talking about them, and they wanted to arrest him. But because they were afraid of the crowd, they let him alone and left.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yi bɛ manim puya ni na ni nuzaŋa shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni ni nuzaŋa. Bɛ ti ku ʒi bɛ tuma binshɛli bɛ nuu ni yi.
en: Just as they came from their mothers womb naked, naked theyll return, ending up just like they started. All their hard work produces nothing—nothing they can take with them.

dag: dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni ka n yih a na; ka bol a ka a yi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam ni katiŋ na, ka n yɛl a, A nyɛla n dabili. Mani m-piig a ka bi zaɣis a.
en: I brought you from the ends of the earth; I called you from its farthest corners and said to you, You are my servant. I did not reject you, but chose you.

dag: Pa ŋun Hɛzɛkia n-daa wurim o buɣa maligu shee min o sara maligu bimbina zaa, ka zali Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima yɛli Bimbini yini kɔŋko gbini ka yi ni jɛmdi Naawuni ka maani sara di zuɣu la.
en: Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord 's altars and places of worship? And didn't he tell you people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?.

dag: Yi malila nina din bi nyara? Ka mali tiba din bi wumda? Ka yi bi lan teei yaha?.
en: Dont you have eyes? Why cant you see? Dont you have ears? Why cant you hear? Dont you remember?.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun mi yɛl shɛli din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha piligu. Kurimbuni ha ka m pun mi yɛl shɛŋa din na bi niŋ yɛla. Mani n-yɛli, n ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa ni pali, ka n ni niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali ba pam mali alibarika. O yi ʒe o dimnim tooni saria karibu shee o ku di vi.
en: The man who fills his quiver with sons will be very blessed. He will never be defeated when he opposes his enemy at the city gates.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa chibi soli teeku ni, ka daa ŋme solɔɣu sɔŋ kom pam puuni.
en: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ Mizipa din be Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ti yɛli Mɔab naa, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka m ba mini m ma ʒini a sani hal ka n ti baŋ Naawuni ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli ti ma.
en: From there David went to Mizpeh in Moab. He said to the Moabite king, Please let my father and mother stay with you until I know what God will do to me.

dag: Zaŋmiya wumpaɣibo mali sara ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ yi ni lo alikauli ni yi zaŋ binshɛŋa ti Zallakudura Naa ti o.
en: Let the giving of thanks be your sacrifice to God, and give the Almighty all that you promised.

dag: Ka o ba maa yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiya o fali maa ti o dɔɣir so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nira o daŋ ni, ka o su li. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm.
en: If his father had no brothers, everything he owns will be given to the closest relative in his family. This will be a law among the Israelites. The Lord has given this command to Moses.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa wum bɛ vuri maa ka bɔhi Bɔ vuri ka Hiburunim ŋɔ lee ti yɔri bɛ sansani maa ni lala? Filistianim maa ni daa ti baŋ ni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na maa.
en: The Philistines heard Israels shout and asked, Why are the people so excited in the Hebrew camp? Then the Philistines learned that the Lord s Holy Box had been brought into Israels camp.

dag: Ka o daa vihi li. O daa daŋla bɛ kpɛm dini vihibu m-mali lala hal ti paai bɛ biasani dini; ka daa nya pipia maa Bɛnjamin kpalaŋa ni.
en: Joseph's servant searched carefully, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest, and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

dag: Di saha Dauda zuliya ni so ni ti leei naa, ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini yurilim su niriba. O ni ti niŋ din tuhi yomyom. Ka chɛ ka niriba doli din tuhi soli.
en: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn chɛ ka yi ʒiʒiinitab nyuri yi suhuyiɣisili dam, ka yi kul boori yi lɔɣu pahiri hal ka bɛ ti nyu m-buɣi ni di chɛ ka yi nya bɛ zaɣim la zuɣu.
en: It will be very bad for those who become angry and make other people suffer. Like an angry drunk, they knock others to the ground and strip them naked, just to see their naked bodies.

dag: Absalom ni daa ti maani sara maa saha shɛli, ka o tim boli Ahitɔfɛl Gilo nir ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda saawarimaana la o ya Gilo na. Ka Absalom ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa kul nyari yaa, ka o kul nyari niriba pahira.
en: Ahithophel was one of Davids advisors. He was from the town of Giloh. While Absalom was offering sacrifices, he invited Ahithophel to join. Absaloms plans were working very well and more and more people began to support him.

dag: dindina o ba min o ma maa bɛn gbaam o n-zaŋ o tahi bɛ ya kpamba sani nti zaŋ o zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali ni.
en: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Kɛnnima, Yimiya chaŋ ka chɛ Amalɛknim ŋɔ, di so ni n ti ku ba tabili ya; dama yi daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa nirilim pam saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Di saha ka Kɛnnim maa daa yi ka chɛ Amalɛknim maa.
en: Some Kenites lived nearby, and Saul told them, Your people were kind to our nation when we left Egypt, and I don't want you to get killed when I wipe out the Amalekites. So stay away from them. The Kenites left.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: The Lord said to him, Take off your sandals, because the place where you are now standing is holy ground.

dag: Amaa bɛn so bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛ ni bi dɔɣi shɛb ka bɛ nini nya ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma din tumdi dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: And it is even better for those who die at birth, because they never saw the evil that is done in this world.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Do so ŋun tib ma maa n-yɛli ma ni n kpuɣimi m bindoo maa chaŋ.
en: He answered, The man who made me well said to me, Pick up your mat and walk.

dag: Ka bɛ ti tan ya daɣiri zuliyanim maa ninni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: But Jerusalem, you will become unclean. And the other nations will see all these things happen. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Pita daa garigi yɛl o, A min a liɣiri maa zaa bahim yoli! Dama a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi zaŋ liɣiri da Naawuni pini.
en: But Peter answered him, May you and your money go to hell, for thinking that you can buy God's gift with money!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Daniɛl daa ti kana. O nyɛla wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia ni be so ni, ka n daa yɛl o n zahindi maa. N daa yɛl o mi:.
en: Finally, a young man named Daniel came in, and I told him the dream. The holy gods had given him special powers, and I had renamed him Belteshazzar after my own god.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na bee n-to piɛm di ni bee ka o tɔbbihi ti gbib nyɔtaɣirisi kpe di ni bee ka bɛ ti me bimbin dura gil li.
en: Therefore, the LORD says this about Assyrias king: He wont enter this city. He wont shoot a single arrow here. He wont come near the city with a shield. He wont build a ramp to besiege it.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yisifu na be o nyɛvil ni, ka nyɛla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana. Ka Yaakubu yɛma daa ŋma, dama o daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: Joseph is still alive! they told him. He is the ruler of all Egypt! Jacob was stunned and could not believe them.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Zaŋm li ti ma na, ka n ŋubi m bia mɔɣu ni nimdi, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni. Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ li ti o ka o di, ka o zaŋ wain pah o ka o nyu.
en: Isaac said, Bring me some of the meat. After I eat it, I will give you my blessing. Jacob brought it to him, and he also brought him some wine to drink.

dag: Dabisili shɛli din pahir ayi dali, yi ni ti zaŋla bulaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara. Ka sara maligu bimbini maa yi daɣiri ni kaman naɣilaa la ni daa chɛ ka di yi daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.

dag: Dama bɛnkam zaa tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim mini bɛnkam zaa bi gbibi yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni bi bɔri shɛba.
en: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest.

dag: amaa biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni tim n tuumba na ka bɛ ti kpe a min a kpambaliba yinsi nti vihi, ka bɛ yi kul nya binshɛlikam ka di tiɣi bɛ nini, bɛn kpuɣim li. .
en: Now, however, I will send my officers to search your palace and the homes of your officials, and to take everything they consider valuable. They will be there about this time tomorrow.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya shihir shɛli Yisa ni wuhi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni anab so ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la n-shiri bala.
en: When the people saw that he had done a miraculous sign, they said, This is truly the prophet who is coming into the world.

dag: Yisa Masia zuɣu m mali daliri din ni chɛ ka n nyu bara n ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti Naawuni la puuni.
en: So in Christ Jesus I brag about things that have to do with God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wuh o min o yiŋnim zaa ti Duuma yɛligu.
en: So Paul and Silas told the message of the Lord to the jailer and all the people who lived in his house.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yiɣisi chaŋ Baalipɛrazim nti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa nimaani ka yɛli, Yawɛ kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baal Pɛrazim maa.
en: Then David went to Baal Perazim and defeated the Philistines in that place. He said, The Lord broke through my enemies like water breaking through a dam. That is why David named that place Baal Perazim.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, dindali maa yuŋ niriba ayi ni ti do bindo yini zuɣu, ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: I tell you, on that night two people will be in the same bed: one will be taken and the other left.

dag: Ti zaŋ Naa Ahaz ni daa bi lan ʒe Naawuni yim ka kahi neen shɛŋa zaa la labisi nti mali di zaa ka di niŋ kasi. Nyama di ʒe Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini la tooni.
en: We have also restored and made holy all the items King Ahaz threw out during his rule in his unfaithfulness. They are now before the LORDs altar.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Rɛkab min o mabia Baana bɛn daa nyɛ Rimɔn Bɛrɔt nir la bihi maa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiligi ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: David answered: I swear that only the Lord rescues me when I'm in trouble!.

dag: Yi min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka o zaŋdi yi gba m-pahiri bɛn zaa kpalim zuɣu m-mɛri du shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni ni ni be shɛl ni o Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: Christ is building you into a place where God lives through the Spirit.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyuri wain pam zuɣu bee n-zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye nimdi ŋubbu zuɣu;.
en: Don't associate with people who drink too much wine or stuff themselves with food.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi tinzunnim bɛn yi su n niriba maa zuɣu. N ni darigi bɛ tibili. Judanim nyɛla n niriba, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni gbib ba. Bɛna n-yɛn nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri yuri bɛn mali yiko pam.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.

dag: Zaŋm dimbɔŋɔnim wuhimi niriba, ka zali ba ni bɛ dol li.
en: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa nini daa shiri neei, ka bɛ nya ka bɛ bela bɛ zaɣim, ka bɛ daa ŋahi fiig tia vari she n-zaŋ so.
en: Then it was as if their eyes opened, and they saw things differently. They saw that they were naked. So they got some fig leaves, sewed them together, and wore them for clothes.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Naawuni, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? A ni zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Cham ti liri ba, n ni zaŋ ba niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked God, Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win? The Lord told David, Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.

dag: Naawuni yi saɣi ti ni kpaŋ timaŋ chaŋla tooni.
en: And thats what we will do if God allows.

dag: Naa, nyini n-nyɛ ti shɛli din wɔɣa ka mali kpiɔŋ maa. A galisiya hal ti tɔr la sagbana, ka su dunia ŋɔ zaa yiko.
en: Your Majesty, you are the tree, tall and strong. You have grown so great that you reach the sky, and your power extends over the whole world.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋya yi naani niŋbu bahi, dama di mali laara pam.
en: Do not lose your courage, then, because it brings with it a great reward.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, pom Naawuni kpe ni a ku yɔhim m mini m bihi ni n zuliya; amaa n ni ʒe a yim shɛm, a gba zanimi m mini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni kana ti beni ŋɔ yim.
en: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn ni Jaza zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana zaa.
en: Heshbon, and Jazer.

dag: Dama a bi bɔri sara; ka n yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, a nini ku tiɣi li.
en: You dont want sacrifices. If I gave an entirely burned offering, you wouldnt be pleased.

dag: Ŋun chɛ soli bahi ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam, ka ŋunkam mi je ni bɛ kpah o zuɣu ni ni kpi.
en: Discipline is severe for those who abandon the way; those who hate correction will die.

dag: Yi ni ti biri yi bimbira yuma ayɔbu, ka wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi, ka pɔhi di wala hal ni yuma ayɔbu.
en: You will plant your fields for six years, and prune your vineyards and gather their crops for six years.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni bee n daŋ lee nyɛ banima, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali n ni ʒe zaashe shɛl ni ŋɔ?.
en: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us.

dag: Dinzuɣu kulim a ya pumpɔŋɔ. N daa yɛliya ni n ni ti a pin titali, amaa Yawɛ chɛ ka a kɔŋ pini maa.
en: Now leave and go home! I told you that I would give you a very good payment, but the Lord has caused you to lose your reward.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, kum n-nyɛ a sanyoo, ka a mi ku tooi yi di ni. Ninvuɣ kubo taali ʒi a zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ kubo maa ni dol a.
en: So the Lord GOD says, But I promise by my own life that I will let death have you. Death will chase you. You did not hate killing people, so death will chase you.

dag: Dama nyini n-daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n no n dimnim firi tiŋa.
en: You give me strength for the battle and victory over my enemies.

dag: Dɛlaiya daŋ niriba mini Tɔbaya daŋ niriba ni Nɛkɔda daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinahinaayi.
en: the descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda:.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa niŋ Yisa saani pam o yiŋa, ka farigudeeriba pam mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa.
en: In his home Levi gave a big dinner for Jesus. Many tax collectors and other guests were also there.

dag: Lala ka o daa me buɣa jɛmbu shee ti o tinzun paɣiba la zaa, ka bɛ daa kɔriti biŋkɔbiri m-maani bɛ buɣa maa, ka tuɣindi li tulaale zim.
en: Solomon did the same thing for all of his other foreign wives who burned incense and gave sacrifices to their gods.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kom puhigi zɔri tiŋgban nɛl ni, ka chɛ ka kom puhiri yiri tiŋgban kuŋ ni na.
en: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: Two women will be together grinding grain, but only one will be taken. The other will be left.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa bɔhi piɛguliba maa, M mabihi, ka tiŋkani ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yila Haran na.
en: Jacob said to them, Where are you from, my brothers? They said, Were from Haran.

dag: Miri ka a nahind amaŋa buni nyabu zuɣu, niŋmi yɛm din ni chɛ ka a yi di yɛla ni.
en: Dont wear yourself out trying to get rich; be smart enough to stop.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni zaligubaŋda ti bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu ni o zahim o.
en: and one of them, a teacher of the Law, tried to trap him with a question.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi, di chɛ ka n di vi dahin shɛlikam.
en: Ive taken refuge in you, LORD. Dont let me ever be put to shame!.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ŋmaligi ni o chaŋ, ka Sool va n-gɔh o binyɛrigu tiŋli, ka di cheei.
en: When Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught Samuels robe. The robe tore.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai, ka ti yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣili noli luɣ shɛli ti ni daa tɛhi ni Naawuni suhibu shee be n-daa ti ʒini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim sani n-tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the riverbank, where we thought there might be a place for prayer. We sat down and began to talk with the women who had gathered.

dag: Dama bɛ ni zaɣi kaman mɔri la; ka suui kaman vari la.
en: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.

dag: Bɛ ni bi tum ʒiɛyimtali tuma maa zuɣu n ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will destroy that country because the people left me to worship false gods . This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Amɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa piɛgul la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. O daa nya li zaŋ chaŋla Izraɛlnim polo Juda Naa Yuzaia mini Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman ni. Di saha di daa chɛla yuma ayi ni tiŋgbani dambu la niŋ.
en: This is the message of Amos, one of the shepherds from the city Tekoa. He saw visions about Israel during the time that Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash was king of Israel. This was two years before the earthquake.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣim bɛmaŋa paɣiba bɔbu ni la; bɛn ʒi paɣiba n-nyɛ ba. Ka Piɛbil maa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam bɛ min o dolila taba, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui tiligi ninvuɣ shɛba n-ti Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa.
en: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.

dag: Zaŋmi nam mini tibiginsim ye kaman salima nɛma la, ka zaŋ nam dariza mini yaa ye kaman situra la.
en: Adorn yourself with splendor and majesty; clothe yourself with honor and esteem.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tinim Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ ka yɔɣu ŋɔ ni na ni ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri ti kpi kpe?.
en: Why did you bring the Lord s people into this desert? Do you want us and our animals to die here?.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa ka wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: After the apostles returned to Jesus, they told him everything they had done and taught.

dag: Amaa bomiya baaŋa ti ma na pumpɔŋɔ. Baaŋa maa ni daa ti yiini yila saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yiko siɣi Ilaisha zuɣu na.
en: Then Elisha said, Send for someone who can play the harp. The harpist began playing, and the Lord gave Elisha this message for Joram:.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia A ni zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli maa viɛla. O daa tɛhimi ni suhudoo ni alaafee ni be o ʒiɛman ni.
en: Hezekiah thought, At least our nation will be at peace for a while. So he told me, The message you brought from the Lord is good.

dag: ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika la bɛ zuɣu; a ni deei n noli maa zuɣu.
en: Every nation on the earth will be blessed through your descendants. I will do this because you obeyed me.

dag: O wahala dibu nyaaŋa, o ni ti nya o tuma nyɔri ka o nini tiɣi li. N dabili ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra maa baŋsim zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni. O ni deei bɛ daalahichi ʒi.
en: After a life of suffering, he will again have joy; he will know that he did not suffer in vain. My devoted servant, with whom I am pleased, will bear the punishment of many and for his sake I will forgive them.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa, ka chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm. Ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa kana ti tuh o soli ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana.
en: Samuel did what the Lord told him and went to Bethlehem. The town leaders went to meet him, but they were terribly afraid and asked, Is this a friendly visit.

dag: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa bi galisi, ka nyɛ saamba di ni la.
en: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.

dag: Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala, ka o gba yuli daa du m-pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada did many more brave things like that. He was as famous as the Three Heroes.

dag: Dama o kul pala nina lihiri ninsalinim biɛhigu, ka nyari bɛ napɔna yaabu zaa.
en: God watches what people do. He sees every step they take.

dag: Dinzuɣu yumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o ni yɛli shɛm min o fukumsi zalikpana ni o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi sahakam.
en: So love the LORD your God and follow his instruction, his regulations, his case laws, and his commandments always.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka a yɛligu nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, ka a lo a dabili bin suŋ ŋɔ.
en: Lord GOD, you are God, and I can trust what you say. And you said that these good things would happen to me, your servant.

dag: Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama tɔb maa daa nyɛla Naawuni ni bɔr shɛli. Ka bɛ daa ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni hal ti paai saha shɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la.
en: Many Hagrites were killed because God helped the people of Reuben win the war. Then the tribes of Manasseh, Reuben, and Gad settled in the land of the Hagrites. They lived there until the time when the Israelites were taken into captivity.

dag: Ti suŋ ku wali wal biɛri, ka ti biɛɣu mi ku wali wal suma.
en: A healthy tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a poor tree cannot bear good fruit.

dag: Di tuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi n-garigi, ka chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpe m-pali ba?.
en: Job, if you had any sense.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa Jɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba Juda tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtishɛmɛshi la ni.
en: So King Jehoash of Israel went into battle against King Amaziah of Judah. They met at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ daantalisi la mini kɔniŋdibin la ni di ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la ni la shɛŋa din kpalim tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says about the things that are still left in Jerusalem. In the Temple, there are the pillars, the bronze sea, the moveable stands, and other things. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon left those things in Jerusalem.

dag: Karimbaannim maani ma la ansarisi ka di ka yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka m bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ a zaligu maa dolibu.
en: The proud are always scornful of me, but I have not departed from your law.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, dama nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ m birini, nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuhi ma yurilim maŋli ŋɔ.
en: I will praise you, my defender. My refuge is God, the God who loves me.

dag: Hal ka di lan ka buchi ni nir zaŋ li niŋ kulim gba n-zaŋ bah o puu ni n-naɣ pahila bɛ kpaa li mi bahi. Ka daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: It has no value, neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. People throw it away. Whoever has ears to hear should pay attention.

dag: O daa niŋla lala hal ti paai nayili samban dunol ni. O daa bi kpe nayili maa, dama bɛ daa bi saɣiri ka ninvuɣ so ŋun pili buɣu zaŋdi li kpɛri nayili.
en: until he came to the entrance of the palace. He did not go in because no one wearing sackcloth was allowed inside.

dag: Di saha maa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba zaa daa laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas la yiŋa.
en: Then the chief priests and the elders met together in the palace of Caiaphas, the High Priest.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka jɛmd o, ka zaŋm o yuli kɔŋko pom pɔri.
en: Revere the LORD your God, serve him, and take your solemn pledges in his name!.

dag: Ka Naomi daa kpuɣi bia maa ʒil o naba zuɣu m-mal o.
en: Naomi took the child, held him close, and took care of him.

dag: Di di bi simdi ni a gba zo a kpee maa nambɔɣu kaman n ni daa zo a nambɔɣu shɛm maa.
en: So you should have given that other man who serves with you the same mercy I gave you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai Yisa.
en: So they arrested Jesus and held him tight.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sanna. O saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ yɛm zaalana.
en: All this wisdom comes from the Lord Almighty. The plans God makes are wise, and they always succeed.

dag: Ka Zara daa la o suhu ni ka yɛli, N kurigiya, ka n yidan gba kurigi, ka n kɔre ni lan be doo ni.
en: So she laughed to herself and said, I am old, and my husband is old. I am too old to have a baby.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi maŋgbibbu pahi yi baŋsim zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi ʒiɛyimtali pahi yi maŋgbibbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi Naawuni sizuura lubu pahi yi ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu.
en: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, endurance; and to endurance, godliness.

dag: Ka Filistianim shɛb daa ʒiri pina mini anzinfa na ti jɛmdi Jɛhɔshafat. Ka Laribunim gba daa zaŋ piɛlahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini bulahi tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyopɔin na ti ti o.
en: Some of the Philistines brought gifts to Jehoshaphat. They also brought silver to him because they knew he was a very powerful king. Some Arabian people brought flocks to Jehoshaphat. They brought rams and goats to him.

dag: Kamina pumpɔŋɔ nti chɛ ka a mini n dan Asiria naa puli. N ni ti a yuri tusaayi, a yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni ba ba.
en: So now make a wager with my master, Assyrias king. Ill give you two thousand horses if you can supply the riders!.

dag: Amaa o fari nandaamba bɛ noya ni bahira, ka fara ba kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira.
en: God saves the poor from the hurtful words of the wicked. He saves them from those who are powerful.

dag: N ni yihi ya zuliyanim maa ni mini tiŋgbɔna maa zaa ni n-zaŋ ya labisi yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home.

dag: Musa mini Aduna daa nyɛla bɛn be o maligumaaniba kalinli ni. Samuɛl gba daa nyɛla ŋun be bɛn jɛmd o kalinli ni. Bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei bɛ suhigu.
en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel too among those who called on his name. They cried out to the LORD, and he himself answered them.

dag: Piɛla so a ni daa nya ka o mali yil ayi la wuhirila Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim nanim yɛla.
en: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, dabiɛm mini bɔɣa ni tɔna dola yi tooni, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Terror, pits, and traps are waiting for the people of Moab. The Lord has spoken.

dag: ka zuɣusaa niriba daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛl pam, ka bɛ daa pii bɛ ni bɔri bɛ ni shɛba n-leei bɛ paɣiba.
en: The divine beings saw how beautiful these human women were, so they married the ones they chose.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, Hal a kul lihiya ni a pɔri maa zaa yoli, pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya zaa zuɣulana? Yawɛ n-daa booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa.
en: Samuel said, Even if you think you are insignificant, arent you the leader of Israels tribes? The LORD anointed you king over Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi dimnim kana ka yi ti jɛmdi ba, ka kum mini kɔnyuri mali ya, ka gbinfini gba mali ya, ka yi kɔŋ binshɛlikam. O ni ti zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua din nyɛ kurugu pa yi nyiŋgoya zuɣu hal ti kun ya.
en: So you will serve the enemies the Lord will send against you. You will be hungry, thirsty, naked, and poor. He will put a load on you that cannot be removed. You will carry that load until he destroys you.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ha, ka bundaan so ŋun daa yi Arimatia na ka o yuli booni Yisifu, ka o nyɛ Yisa nyaandol la.
en: When it was evening, a rich man from Arimathea arrived; his name was Joseph, and he also was a disciple of Jesus.

dag: Kɛdar peentɔriba bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba la ni ti kpalimla biɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn zaŋ yi ni lo nia shɛŋa sɔɣi Yawɛ, ka tumdi yi tuma zibisim ni ŋɔ zuɣu, dama yi yɛra, So bi nyari ti, So mi bi mi ti.
en: Look at them! They try to hide things from the Lord . They think he will not understand. They do their evil things in darkness. They tell themselves: No one can see us. No one will know who we are.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛn gbarigi tiɣi, ka chɛ ka bɛn tarigi la niŋgbuna maai.
en: I will refresh those who are weary and will satisfy with food everyone who is weak from hunger.

dag: Naawuni, a shiri zaɣisi ti mi? Naawuni, a bi lan doli ti tɔbbihi chani tɔb ni.
en: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, di zaligu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the Instruction for the communal sacrifice of well-being that someone may offer to the LORD.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N ka yidana. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A ni yɛli ni a ka yidan maa di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli;.
en: The woman replied, I dont have a husband. You are right to say, I dont have a husband, Jesus answered.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ bulah ayi maa ti zali Naawuni tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: Then he shall take the two goats to the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, alizin birigu n-ʒi m bia zuɣu, ka n zaŋ o tah a sanna.
en: A man in the crowd answered, Teacher, I brought my son to you, because he has an evil spirit in him and cannot talk.

dag: N Naawuni maa tim o malaika na ka o ti mum gbuɣima maa noya, ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ ma shɛli. Naa, o niŋla lala, dama n ka taali o sani, ka ka taali a gba sani; ka m mi bi tum a taal shɛli.
en: My God sent his angel to save me. The angel closed the lions mouths. The lions have not hurt me because my God knows I am innocent. I never did anything wrong to you, King.

dag: Ka Shɛla daa nyɛ Kainan bia, ka Kainan nyɛ Arifazad bia, ka Arifazad nyɛ Shɛm bia, ka Shɛm nyɛ Nuhu bia, ka Nuhu mi nyɛ Lamɛk bia.
en: Cainan, Arphaxad, Shem, Noah, Lamech.

dag: Ka Leeban daa laɣim nimaaninim zaa na ka bɛ ti puhi chuɣu.
en: So Laban invited all the people of that place and prepared a banquet.

dag: ka chɛ ka Speen ŋariŋ titaŋa zaa mini ŋariŋ viɛla zaa shim.
en: all the seagoing ships, and every beautiful boat.

dag: Ka Tomas kuhi yɛli, N Duuma ni n Naawuni.
en: Thomas replied, You are my Lord and my God.

dag: Ka a ni tum din chihiri mini pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, a bi teeg a ni daa nyɛ bia saha shɛli, ka be a zaɣim n-do a ʒim ni talindi la yɛla.
en: You left me and did all those terrible things. You never remembered what happened when you were young. You did not remember that you were naked and kicking in blood when I found you.

dag: Bɛ bi lan ʒe Yawɛ yim, dama bɛ dɔɣi tinzun bihi. Pumpɔŋɔ yi gol paliga churi puhibu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi puri zaa bahi yoli.
en: They have been unfaithful to the Lord ; their children do not belong to him. So now they and their lands will soon be destroyed.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahigi alizanda nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa o bi kahigi li wuhi bɛn kpalim bɛna.
en: Jesus replied, Because they havent received the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but you have.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka niriba maa mini Izraɛlnim zaa baŋ dindali maa ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr kubu maa pala naa suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: Now the people of Judah and Israel were certain that David had nothing to do with killing Abner.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Musa birigi kanna ni o ti nya li maa, ka Naawuni daa bol o tutuɣu maa ni, Musa! Musa! Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: When the Lord saw that Moses was coming closer, he called to him from the middle of the bush and said, Moses! Moses! He answered, Yes, here I am.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam min o daŋ niriba ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, ka kul dolila di soli maa; ka daa na kul chɛ ka buɣili Ashɛra kpalim be Samaria.
en: But they still did not give up the sins into which King Jeroboam had led Israel, but kept on committing them; and the image of the goddess Asherah remained in Samaria.

dag: Ka tɔb daa ti lan lu Izraɛlnim maa mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɔb yaha, ka Jaariɔrigim ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la bia Ɛlhanan gba daa lan ku Goliat ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nira ka o kpani dɔɣu daa be kaman kpalua dapua la.
en: There was yet another battle with the Philistines at Gob; and Elhanan, Jairs son from Bethlehem, killed Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was as strong as the bar on a weavers loom.

dag: Buri din tiri daŋa nyɛla din yihiri zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋmɛri nyɛ din maani ninsal niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn jɛrigi ka ka yɛm. Bɛ buɣa maa ni wuhiri ba shɛli kul nyɛla dari wuhibu.
en: All the people of the other nations are stupid and foolish. Their teachings come from worthless wooden statues.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Nyamiya, n je yi kan shɛŋa yi ni pirita ka zaŋ li diri n niriba nyɛviya maa. N ni dari chihi li yi nuhi ni ka chɛ ka yi ni mal li doli shɛba ni yi di bɛ nyɛviya kaman noonsi la nya bɛmaŋa.
en: Now this is what the Sovereign Lord says: I hate the wristbands that you use in your attempt to control life and death. I will rip them off your arms and set free the people that you were controlling.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ zaŋ o shia ti ma. O tim ma mi ni n zaŋ lahiba suŋ ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka maai bɛn suhuri saɣim la suhuri; ka yihi bɛn nyɛ daba la dabitim ni; ka yooi bɛn be sarika ni la bahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.

dag: Nyama di daba ata dali ka do so daa ti yi Sool sansan ni n-zo m-paana ka o binyɛra chahi, ka taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu. O ni daa ti paai Dauda sani, o daa lumi gbani Dauda tooni lu o sizuura.
en: Then, on the third day, a young soldier from Sauls camp came to Ziklag. His clothes were torn, and he had dirt on his head. He came to David and bowed with his face to the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Pa ninvuɣ pia n-di kpaŋ maa? Ka niriba awɛi la, bɛn kpalim ya?.
en: Jesus replied, Werent ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?.

dag: Dabisili din pah anahi dali, zaŋmiya naɣilahi pia mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the fourth day of this festival, you must offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: ka bɔhi maligumaaniba min anabinima bɔhigu shɛli. Bɔhigu maa m-bɔŋɔ: Ti na kul lom noli, ka fabilim gol so ŋun pah anu ni kaman ti ni pun niŋdi shɛm yuma pam din gari ŋɔ ni la.
en: and to ask the priests and the prophets this question: Should we continue to mourn because of the destruction of the Temple, by fasting in the fifth month as we have done for so many years now.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahi pinaayi, ka bɛ boon o Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali ka bɛ daa yɛn zaŋ zaligu maa tum tuma Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Dindali maa ka bɛ daa zali ni bɛ kum Yɛhudianim maa.
en: This decree was to take effect throughout the Persian Empire on the day set for the slaughter of the Jews, the thirteenth of Adar, the twelfth month.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi Ibrahimma, Bɔzuɣu ka Zara la ka yɛli, N ni kurigi shɛm ŋɔ, n ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: Then the Lord said to Abraham, Sarah laughed and said she was too old to have a baby.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yi Mɔab bɔpiɛligu maa ni n-du Nɛbo Zoli nti paai Pisiga Zo shɛli din be Jɛriko tooni polo la zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa wuh o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa, zaŋ Giliad hal ni Dan.
en: Then Moses hiked up from the Moabite plains to Mount Nebo, the peak of the Pisgah slope, which faces Jericho. The LORD showed him the whole land: the Gilead region as far as Dans territory.

dag: amaa ka di ni nyɛla bɛ ni nyari yi biɛrisuŋ zaŋ tabili yi ni luri ba sizuura Naawuni zuɣu shɛm la zuɣu.
en: After all, they will have observed the reverent and holy manner of your lives.

dag: Ka o kpee maa gba damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, Na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: Then his fellow servant fell down and begged him, Be patient with me, and Ill pay you back.

dag: amaa m bi bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ka di pala a yubu ni, dama m bɔri ni a tuun suŋ yila amaŋmaŋ yubu ni na, ka pa ni muɣisigu ni na.
en: However, I didnt want to do anything without your consent so that your act of kindness would occur willingly and not under pressure.

dag: Izraɛl yaɣili polɔnima: Parɔsh daŋ ni: Ramia mini Izia ni Malikija ni Mijamin ni Ɛliɛza ni Malikija so mi ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Clan of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba mini bana ni alijeeta piɛbiriba ni kika piɛbiriba damli a ni; ka tuuni kam tuumbaŋda ti ku lan be a ni, ka so ti ku lan wum nɛli vubu a ni!.
en: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Ahimɛlɛk bia Abiata ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la, Zaŋmi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la ti ma na. Ka Abiata daa zaŋ tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa na ti ti Dauda.
en: David said to the priest Abiathar son of Ahimelech, Bring me the ephod, and Abiathar brought it to him.

dag: Ka n yi chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti kuri ba, ka di leei dabari, ka so ku lan gari nimaani biŋkɔb biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Or I might send wild animals through that country to kill all the people. Then no one would travel through that country because of the wild animals.

dag: Aai! N yɛri ya mi ni shee yi niŋ tuuba, di yi pa lala yi zaa gba ni ti bahi yoli.
en: No, they were not. But if you dont decide now to change your lives, you will all be destroyed like those people!.

dag: Ti bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ka bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, Ti bɔrila alaafee nyabu saha, amaa ka dabiɛm n-naɣ kul beni.
en: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.

dag: A yi saɣi ni n tim a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari, n kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari, m bi yɛn birigi nudirigu bee nuzaa polo.
en: Let us go through your land. We will stay on the road. We will not turn off the road to the right or to the left.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Sin tiŋgban nɛli ni m-piri taba gbilligbilli n-chani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba shɛm. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai Rɛfidim n-ti suɣa nimaani, amaa ka kom daa lee ka nimaani ka bɛ ni nyu.
en: The whole Israelite community left the desert of Sin, moving from one place to another at the command of the Lord . They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water there to drink.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: My true brother and sister and mother are those who do what God wants.

dag: Aai! Hal ninsalinim zaa yi nyɛ ʒirinima, Naawuni ŋun kul nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Nyin Naawuni ku mali galimi a yɛtɔɣa ni, ka so mi ku ŋme a naŋgbankpeeni a saria karibu ni.
en: Certainly not! God must be true, even though all human beings are liars. As the scripture says, You must be shown to be right when you speak; you must win your case when you are being tried.

dag: Bɛ yino kam daa malila ninni ʒiibunahi zuɣu. Ninni din nyɛ tuuli maa daa nyɛla chɛrubi ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buyi nyɛ ninsal ninni. Ka ninni din pahi buta nyɛ gbuɣinli ninni, ka ninni din pahi bunahi mi daa nyɛ tɔrili ninni.
en: Each winged creature had four faces. The first face was that of a winged creature, the second face was that of a human being, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.

dag: Ŋun yuri liɣiri, ku nya liɣiri tiɣi; ka ŋun yuri buni mi ku nya buni tiɣi. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: If you love money, you will never be satisfied; if you long to be rich, you will never get all you want. It is useless.

dag: Dama n loya ni n niŋla tiŋ ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu ka pa ni zaɣ viɛlli. N ni ti zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I have decided to make trouble for the city of Jerusalem. I will not help this city! I will give it to the king of Babylon, who will burn it with fire. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the Lord ! Angels above, praise the Lord from heaven!.

dag: Ka Pool daa siɣi nti kurim o sani m-bɔbind o ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama o na nyɛla nyɛvililana.
en: Paul went down, fell on him and embraced him, then said, Dont be alarmed. Hes alive.

dag: Di saha maa so yi ti yɛli ya ni Masia be kpe bee kpe ha, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: Someone might say to you at that time, Look, there is the Messiah! Or another person might say, There he is! But dont believe them.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni gari o ni niŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ni.
en: And everyone knows that the more important person always blesses the less important person.

dag: Barinim pam bɛn gbarigi n-daa kul do lunfanim maa ni: Zoomba mini gbariti ni bɔɣukpimanima ni gbalikpimanima. Bɛ daa doya gulila kom maa dambu.
en: Many sick people were lying on the porches beside the pool. Some of them were blind, some were crippled, and some were paralyzed.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nuu din mali yiko ŋɔ chɛri ka barinim kpaŋda, ka chɛ ka shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa tumdi a Dab Suŋ Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: Help us to be brave by showing us your power. Make sick people well. Cause miraculous signs and wonders to happen by the authority of Jesus, your holy servant.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nuu din mali yiko ŋɔ chɛri ka barinim kpaŋda, ka chɛ ka shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa tumdi a Dab Suŋ Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.

dag: Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔanim yabidoo la daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli n-daa booni Hɛla, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Naara.
en: Ashhur, who founded the town of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

dag: ka nya ka pɔhim ʒɛra, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o piligi shimdi ka kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, tiligim ma.
en: But when Peter saw how strong the wind was, he was afraid and started sinking. Save me, Lord! he shouted.

dag: ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la gba bahi yoli.
en: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa kul bɔbimi ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi m-miri Samaria dunoli kabɔɣili shee ka anabinim maa zaa be bɛ tooni tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: At that time the two kings were sitting on their thrones, with their royal robes on, at the judgment place near the gates of Samaria. All the prophets were standing before them, prophesying.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi ka be zuɣusaa. O chɛ ka yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The Lord is very great. He lives in a very high place. He fills Zion with justice and goodness.

dag: M bɔri ni a baŋ ni n ni be a sani, ka gbib a luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ, ka ni ti zaŋ a labisi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni na. Dama n kul ku chɛ a hal ti niŋ n ni lo a alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm maa.
en: I am with you, and I will protect you everywhere you go. I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised.

dag: Tayiɣisi yi ka yi yinsi na bee ŋmɛnditoya yi kana yuŋ, pa bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa kɔŋko ka bɛ zura? Ka puri tumtumdib yi kana ni bɛ ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, bɛ ku chɛ binyiha bahi? Amaa yi dimnim bɛn ni kpimsi ya zaa!.
en: If thieves approach you, if robbers by night—how youve been devastated!— wouldnt they steal only what they wanted? If those who gather grapes came to you, wouldnt they leave some grapes?.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa lan yɛli, Molimiya Baal jɛmbu dabisili molo. Ka bɛ daa moli di molo maa.
en: Jehu called for a holy assembly for Baal, and it was done.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Piɛr ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph responded, This is the dreams interpretation: The three baskets are three days.

dag: N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka guli tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: I will save you and this city from the king of Assyria. I will protect this city.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Alizin birigu maa ni daa nya Yisa ka o dii yiɣisi bia maa, ka o lu m-bilinda, ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋar o noli.
en: They brought him to Jesus. As soon as the spirit saw Jesus, it threw the boy into a fit, so that he fell on the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni ka mali biɛlim mini tihi din wala mali kpila balibu kam zaa, bilimiya. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then God said, Let the earth grow grass, plants that make grain, and fruit trees. The fruit trees will make fruit with seeds in it. And each plant will make its own kind of seed. Let these plants grow on the earth. And it happened.

dag: dama a yurila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a, ka je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a. Zuŋɔ a kahigi wuhi ni sapashin kpamba mini tɔbbihi pa shɛli a sani. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ m baŋya ni Absalom yi di ne ka tinim zaa kpi, a naam paɣ lala.
en: You oppose those who love you and support those who hate you! You have made it clear that your officers and men mean nothing to you. I can see that you would be quite happy if Absalom were alive today and all of us were dead.

dag: Ka Hamat Naa Tɔi daa wum ni Dauda tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa min o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: When Hamaths King Tou heard that David had defeated the entire army of Zobahs King Hadadezer.

dag: Dama daliri din chɛ ka Masia daa kpi ka lan neei kum ni nyɛla ni di chɛ ka o leei bɛn kpi mini bɛn ne Duuma.
en: That is why Christ died and rose from death to live again—so that he could be Lord over those who have died and those who are living.

dag: Bɛn diri zalinsi nyɛla bɛn bɔri yɛla tiri bɛ yiŋnima, amaa bɛn je birapu dibu ni be.
en: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu Izraɛl fɔntinsi zuɣu n-daa tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni nɛma ni daa be fɔntin shɛŋa ni zaa Naftali tiŋgban ni.
en: King Ben-Hadad made that agreement with King Asa and sent his army to fight against the Israelite towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and the storage cities in the area of Naphtali.

dag: hal ti yi tuui, ti ku lu n-doya, dama Yawɛ nuu n-gbib ti.
en: Though they trip up, they wont be thrown down, because the LORD holds their hand.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Gazanim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋgbɔn muni niriba chaŋ ti ti Ɛdomnima ka bɛ zaŋ ba leei daba.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of Gaza, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because they rounded up entire communities, to hand them over to Edom.

dag: Ka sapashin maa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb maa daa lab yiŋa nti nya ka sapashini maa dabili maa shiri kpaŋmi zaa.
en: The group that was sent to Jesus went back to the house. There they found that the servant was healed.

dag: n-gari chaŋ hal ni Azimɔn n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ m-mali hal ti paai di tariga teeku ni. Yi nudirigu polo tiŋgbani tariga n-yɛn bala.
en: It passed on to Azmon and went by the border of Egypt. The border ended at the sea. This will be their south border.

dag: Ka kom gili ma niŋ sunsuuni ka teeku maa kom kul lim ma zaa. Ka teeku kɔtiŋ mɔri vilivili n zuɣu.
en: The water came over me and choked me; the sea covered me completely, and seaweed wrapped around my head.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika n-niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya li nyu ka ti taba.
en: Then Jesus took a cup, gave thanks to God, and said, Take this and share it among yourselves.

dag: Ti ka soli ni bɛ ti ti bindirigu mini kom?.
en: We have the right to eat and drink, dont we?.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be ni ni alaafee, ka me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri. N yi ti kari bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn zaa lihi ʒiɛm ba la saria, bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will live safely in the land. They will build houses and plant vineyards. I will punish the nations around them that hated them. Then the people of Israel will live in safety, and they will know that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Ka o daa lan daai Pɛnuɛluɛlnim pii la luhi, ka ku tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: He also broke down Penuels tower, and killed the citys people.

dag: amaa n ni di kul duhi n yee kuhi pam saha shɛli, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu ŋɔ bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: but when I raised my voice and screamed, he left his garment with me and ran outside.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, M mabihi, yinim Ibrahimma zuliya mini yinim bɛn pa ti zuliya ka be ti ni ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri Naawuni, tinim ka Naawuni daa tahi tiliginsim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ na ti ti.
en: My brothers, sons in the family of Abraham, and you other people who also worship the true God, listen! The news about this salvation has been sent to us.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa a ni ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyumiya hal ti kuli, ka ti li bahi, ka lu ka ku lan tooi yiɣisi yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka tɔb shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa zuɣu.
en: Then say to them: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Drink this seething cup of wine and get drunk. Vomit and collapse and dont get up again because of the sword that Im thrusting into you.

dag: Yinim bɛn kpiri kum pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti tiɣi. Yinim bɛn kumdi pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama yi ni ti la.
en: Happy are you who are hungry now; you will be filled! Happy are you who weep now; you will laugh!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe siliga maa ni nti nya ka nachimbil so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒi bɛ nudirigu polo, ka di gari ba pam.
en: Going into the tomb, they saw a young man in a white robe seated on the right side; and they were startled.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn doli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu soli bo buni niŋ yi yinsi, ka te yi tɛri luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ni barina di paai ya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Look at you people! You get rich by cheating people, and it hurts your own family! You build your houses high on the cliffs to protect yourself from danger.

dag: Di pala o ni daa saɣi ti ni daa kpam o jaande shɛm la kɔŋko, amaa omaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu ka o gba suhu daa ye yi sani kandina zuɣu.
en: Not only has he accepted our challenge but hes on his way to see you voluntarily, and hes excited.

dag: Sanbalat ni daa wum ni ti lan piligi mɛri gooni maa, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o puuni zaa diri buɣim ka o piligi maani Yɛhudianim ansarisi.
en: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.

dag: Juda nanim ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣi vuɣi tintariga kpahi. N suhuyiɣisili ni ti lu bɛ zuɣu kaman saa la.
en: The Lord says, I am angry because the leaders of Judah have invaded Israel and stolen land from her. So I will pour out punishment on them like a flood.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim la zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni chirigibu min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol la tooni.
en: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin maa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Then Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy elders of Israel went up.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din ti yɛn niŋ maa shihirili. Yuuni ŋɔ mini yuuni din paya na, kayari chi ka yi yɛn dira; ka yuun shɛli din pahir ata ni mi, yi ni biri ka chɛ, ka sa wain tihi n-di di wala.
en: Then Isaiah said to King Hezekiah, Here is a sign of what will happen. This year and next you will have only wild grain to eat, but the following year you will be able to plant your grain and harvest it, and plant vines and eat grapes.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa daa zabir o nyuli di zuɣu, amaa ka o ba daa zaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: Joseph's brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept wondering about the dream.

dag: Ka molomoona daa ti kuhi pam yɛli, Bɛ zaliya ni niriba mini zuliya kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim.
en: The herald proclaimed loudly: Peoples, nations, and languages! This is what you must do.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi sokam vi, ka siɣisi karimbaannima.
en: Humanity will be humiliated; each person laid low, the eyes of the exalted laid low.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa Yawɛ, ti suhir a, ti yi yihi doo ŋɔ nyɛvili, nyin di bɔhi ti biɛri ku ti. Dama nyin Yawɛ zuɣu ka yɛlli maa ʒiya. A ni yu shɛm m-bala.
en: So the men cried to the Lord , Lord , please dont say we are guilty of killing an innocent man. Please dont make us die for killing him. We know you are the Lord , and you will do whatever you want.

dag: Waɣ biɛ titali maa ni daa nya ka bɛ yih o bahi dunia ŋɔ ni na maa, ka o gbaai kariti doli paɣ so ŋun daa dɔɣi bidibiga la.
en: The dragon saw that he had been thrown down to the earth. So he chased the woman who had given birth to the child.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn kul bela biɛrim ni bɛ nyɛviya ni zaa; yuun shɛŋa zaa din gari ka bɛ bi zɔri niriba nambɔɣu la ni.
en: And they said that an evil man suffers all his life. A cruel man suffers all his numbered years.

dag: Ka o daa mooni molo yɛra, Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n ti damd o tooni gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi.
en: He announced to the people, The man who will come after me is much greater than I am. I am not good enough even to bend down and untie his sandals.

dag: ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Zɛrahia bia, ka Zɛrahia nyɛ Uzi bia, ka Uzi nyɛ Buki bia.
en: son of Zerahiah son of Uzzi son of Bukki.

dag: N daa bi tim anabinim maa, amaa ka bɛ yiɣisi guui chaŋ. N daa bi zaŋ n yɛligu ti ba, amaa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: I didnt send the prophets, yet they ran anyway. I didnt speak to them, yet they prophesied anyway.

dag: N shia faai siɣi, n dabisa naaya, gballi malila shili guli ma.
en: My spirit is broken; I am ready to give up. My life is almost gone; the grave is waiting for me.

dag: O daa malila pua, ka wolisiri n-kuhiri ni biɛrim pam ni o dɔɣi.
en: She was soon to give birth, and the pains and suffering of childbirth made her cry out.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni, ka daa bol li Dauda tiŋa. Ka Naa Dauda daa piligi me yiya Millo polo na ti gil li.
en: After capturing the fortress, David lived in it and named it David's City. He built the city around it, starting at the place where land was filled in on the east side of the hill.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ n dɔɣiriba, yi nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ mini n ʒim, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yinim ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa n-zaŋ man naa labisi.
en: You are my brothers, my family, so why are you the last tribe to bring the king back.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋumbɔŋɔ amiliya dakulo ŋɔ naai pɔi, ka ti zaŋ ŋuni maa gba ti a, ka a tum tuma o zuɣu ti ma yuma ayopɔin pahi.
en: Continue for the full week of the marriage ceremony, and I will also give you Rachel to marry. But you must serve me another seven years.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye yurilim zuɣu, ka bomiya Naawuni Shia Kasi pina, di bahi bamdi anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini.
en: Love should be the goal of your life, but you should also want to have the gifts that come from the Spirit. And the gift you should want most is to be able to prophesy.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa kpuɣ o Mɛgido maa niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ siliga ni. Ka Judanim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: Josiahs officers put his body in a chariot and carried him from Megiddo to Jerusalem. They buried Josiah in his own grave. Then the common people took Josiahs son Jehoahaz and anointed him. They made Jehoahaz the new king.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ku tooi zaŋ mmaŋ zali Naawuni zaani.
en: But Joseph said to them, Don't be afraid; I can't put myself in the place of God.

dag: Amiram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Jokɛbɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi ni daa dɔɣi bipuɣin so Ijipti la. Ka Jokɛbɛd daa dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Miriam Amiram yiŋa.
en: The name of Amrams wife was Jochebed, Levis daughter, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She gave birth for Amram to Aaron, Moses, and Miriam their sister.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na naɣila din kpaŋsiri niriba suhuri, ka di ni niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum li anfaani.
en: When you talk, dont say anything bad. But say the good things that people need—whatever will help them grow stronger. Then what you say will be a blessing to those who hear you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kpahi Jɛrimia ŋun nyɛ Anatɔt nira, ka zaŋ omaŋ leeg anabi yi sani la zuɣu ni?.
en: Now Jeremiah is acting like a prophet. So why didnt you arrest him?.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ni o ni zo ti yaannim nambɔɣu shɛm la niŋ pali, ka teeg o daalikauli suŋ.
en: God said he would show mercy to our fathers, and he remembered his holy agreement.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa kpamba maa zaŋ doo maa ti darig o tibili.
en: The citys elders must then take that husband and punish him.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka chilibi buɣim yi o sani alizanda ni n-lu Sɔdom mini Gomɔra zuɣu na.
en: and the LORD rained down burning asphalt from the skies onto Sodom and Gomorrah.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ka biŋkɔb so ti tɔhi zanina. O daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, amaa ka kpiŋkpama anahi din ŋmani nooŋa kpiŋkpama lee sa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka o mali zuɣur anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yiko ti o.
en: After that I noticed another animal in front of me. It looked like a leopard, but it had four wings on its back. This animal had four heads. It was given authority to rule.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dama bɛ yɛri ya, Yi ŋubirila niriba, ka chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi.
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , say: It is true that people say that the land eats people and that it robs the nation of its children.

dag: Daanya pilanim mini tɔrokɔnim la ni daanya kɔniŋdi bini din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, Babilɔnnim naa maa daa wurim li mi, ka va di daanya maa zaa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonians broke in pieces the bronze columns and the carts that were in the Temple, together with the large bronze tank, and they took all the bronze to Babylon.

dag: Ka paɣ yi po pɔri ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o yidan yiŋa.
en: Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛlila noli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi, amaa o niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: The Lord puts a curse on the homes of the wicked, but blesses the homes of the righteous.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa tintariga daa kpuɣi Akirabim hal ni Sɛla n-yi nimaani zaŋ du ha.
en: The border of the Amorites ran from the Akrabbim pass, from Sela, and upward.

dag: Amaa ka ŋariŋ maa zuɣu polo daa chaŋ ti firi bihigu ni ka di tarigi chandi, ka kɔgbana daa ŋmɛri di nyaaŋa polo hal ka di ti ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni ti chɛ nyuli zabbu, ka Juda zuliya dimdi la ti kpi. Ifriim zuliya ti ku lan zab Juda zuliya nyuli; ka Juda zuliya mi ti ku lan nyɛ Ifriim zuliya dimnima.
en: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.

dag: Ka a mi o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛŋa Ɛfɛsus la gba yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti Duuma chɛ ka o ti nya nambɔzɔbo o sani ŋun ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: I pray that the Lord Jesus will make sure Onesiphorus receives mercy from the Lord God on that Day. You know how many ways this brother helped me in Ephesus.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Do so ŋun yɛl ti lala maa yɛla biŋkɔbigu kɔbiri binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ gbaŋ lo o shee ni. Ka o yɛli, Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la m-bala.
en: He was hairy and had a leather belt around his waist, they answered. It must be Elijah! replied Ahaziah.

dag: Juda ŋmanila gbuɣimbila. M bia, a ku a dima, ka ŋmaligi kpe a yiŋa. A teeg amaŋ dɔni kaman gbuɣinli la. A ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi dam a?.
en: Judah is like a young lion. My son, you are like a lion standing over the animal it killed. Like a lion, Judah lies down to rest, and no one is brave enough to disturb him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti Yisahaku mini Ribɛka suhusaɣiŋgu pam.
en: These marriages made Isaac and Rebekah very unhappy.

dag: N ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ saha shɛli, a daa beni? A yi mi, nyin yɛlim ma.
en: Were you there when I made the world? If you know so much, tell me about it.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔnyuri ni ti wum gbarigi nachimbihi kpɛma mini paɣisaribihi kpɛma, ka bɛ tarigi.
en: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa teemi gili ma, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: Many enemies surrounded me, but with the Lord s power I defeated them.

dag: Yi ni daa sab gban shɛli ti ma zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa la polo yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Doo yi bi kpuɣ paɣa, di viɛla.
en: Now, to deal with the matters you wrote about. A man does well not to marry.

dag: Di lan sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yaha, Kum yi wum a dima, nyin dihim o; ka kɔnyuri yi wum o, nyin nyuhim o; dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: The Scriptures also say, If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.

dag: Yi tɔbbia kam yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du Yawɛ ninni chaŋ ti lu o dimnim maa zuɣu hal ka o ti kari ba.
en: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things.

dag: Di simdi ni di ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanu, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiwɛi, ka di mini di binyila zaa ti nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini.
en: It is to be square, inches long and inches wide, and it is to be inches high. Its projections at the four corners are to form one piece with it.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla n jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni ŋɔ fiɛbi ko shɛli din be Nail Mɔɣili ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka di leei ʒim, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Now, Your Majesty, the Lord says that you will find out who he is by what he is going to do. Look, I am going to strike the surface of the river with this stick, and the water will be turned into blood.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gbibi jɛmbu dabisili maa, dama di nyɛla dabisili din be kasi yi sani, ka ninvuɣ so yi bi gbib li, bɛn kum o. Ŋunkam tum tuma dindali maa, bɛn yihim dilan o niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Make the Sabbath a special day. If someone treats the Sabbath like any other day, that person must be killed. Whoever works on the Sabbath day must be separated from their people.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga n-ti Hadad, ka bɛ bol o yuli Gɛnubat, ka napaɣ maa daa wums o nayili maa; ka bia maa mini Firawuna bidibisi daa laɣim be nayili maa.
en: Hadad and his wife had a son named Genubath, and the queen let the boy grow up in the palace with her own children.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Aduna ni o kpuɣim o jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa fiɛbi taŋkpaɣu, ka taŋkpaɣu maa leei pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Command Aaron to strike the ground with his walking stick, and everywhere in Egypt the dust will turn into gnats.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o ba, Mani a bituuli Iso. M pun niŋ a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Yiɣisim ʒini di m mɔɣu ni nimdi maa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob said to his father, I am Esau, your first son. I have done what you told me. Now sit up and eat the meat from the animals that I hunted for you. Then you can bless me.

dag: Di saha ka Rimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nir la bihi bɛn daa nyɛ Rɛkab mini Baana daa yiɣisi lu soli n-daa ti paai Ishibɔshɛt yiŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha din nyɛ saha shɛl o ni daa dɔni ni o vuhi wuntaŋ ni.
en: Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, set out and reached Ishbosheths house at the heat of the day, right when he was lying down, taking an afternoon rest.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa yiŋbihi daa kana ti bɔh o, Ti dana, pa alikama suma ka a daa biri a puu la ni? Ka di chaŋ wula ka piriŋkpana ti be di ni.
en: The servants came and asked, Sir, didn't you scatter good seed in your field? Where did these weeds come from.

dag: Yi zaa nya li yimaŋmaŋa, ka wula ka yi zaa leei bɛn ka buchi.
en: Look, those of you who recognize this— why then this empty talk?.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa shiri chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi.
en: And one of them struck the High Priest's slave and cut off his right ear.

dag: A mabihi maa, Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ni labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi ti labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka a gba min a bipuɣinsi zaa ni ti labi yi biɛri kurili ni.
en: So you and your sisters will be rebuilt. Sodom and the towns around her, Samaria and the towns around her, and you and the towns around you will all be rebuilt.

dag: Ka bo wɔr shɛb Pool ni ti yɛn ba n-zali, ka mal o baalim tahi Gomna Filiksi sani.
en: Get a horse ready for Paul and make sure he gets safely through to Felix the governor.

dag: O daa bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛl o, N nyala tiwal moma ni be piɛ shɛl ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim biɛɣu yipa neeya. N ku lan chɛ ba.
en: The Lord asked, Amos, what do you see? A basket of fruit, I answered. The Lord said to me, The end has come for my people Israel. I will not change my mind again about punishing them.

dag: Yi yi niŋ lala, yi tum alahichi yi mabihi sani ka gbarigi bɛ suhuri ni tɛha din ka kpiɔŋ la, ka lala niŋbu nyɛla alahichi tumbu Masia sani.
en: And in this way you will be sinning against Christ by sinning against other Christians and wounding their weak conscience.

dag: Yi daa yi niŋdi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋuni n-lee kari ya ni yi di doli yɛlimaŋli maa?.
en: You were doing so well. Who caused you to stop following the truth?.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: asked him, What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa niŋ Yisa saani pam o yiŋa, ka farigudeeriba pam mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu laɣim ʒiya diri bindirigu maa.
en: Then Levi threw a great banquet for Jesus in his home. A large number of tax collectors and others sat down to eat with them.

dag: Ka salo bɛn dol o maa yɛli, Yisa ŋun nyɛ anabi n-yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na m-bala.
en: The crowds following Jesus answered, This is Jesus. He is the prophet from the town of Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu din ti yɛn niŋ a bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas ti yɛn nyɛla shihirili a sani. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti yɛn kpila dahin yini.
en: I will give you a sign to show that these things will come true. Your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will die on the same day.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi. Yi yi ʒi yi yinsi puuni, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla, ka yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo bee yi yi ti dɔni bee yi yi ti yiɣisi, yin tɔɣisimiya di yɛla.
en: Teach them to your children, by talking about them when you are sitting around your house and when you are out and about, when you are lying down and when you are getting up.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla bɛn be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka lahi maa nyɛ din be kasi; ka anzinfa mini salima maa nyɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: I said to them, You are holy to the LORD, and the equipment is holy; the silver and the gold are a spontaneous gift to the LORD, the God of your ancestors.

dag: A yu zaɣ biɛɣu gari zaɣ viɛlli, ka yu ʒiri ŋmabu gari yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu.
en: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.

dag: ni ago sabilifaa ni ago ʒiɛkpeein ni ago ʒiɛkpain ni ago piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni omaŋmaŋ n-yɛn nyɛ buɣim gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm n-gul li, ka be di ni ni o jilima zaa.
en: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.

dag: Bɛ daa pun bar o la bandi ka lɔr o zoligɔnima, ka o chihiri li ka kabiri bandi maa; ka so ku tooi maag o nini.
en: He had often been put in chains and leg irons, but he broke the chains and smashed the leg irons. No one could control him.

dag: paɣimiy o cheechi ni.
en: glory to him in the church and in Christ Jesus for all generations, forever and always. Amen.

dag: ka di yi ti bi, o dii piinila di chɛbu, di chɛbu saha ni paai zuɣu.
en: When the grain is ready, the man cuts it. This is the harvest time.

dag: Ɛrastus kpalim bela Kɔrinti; ka n daa chɛ Trɔfimus mi Milɛtus o ni daa ka alaafee zuɣu.
en: Erastus stayed in Corinth. And I left Trophimus in Miletus—he was sick.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛl o, Vuri maa pala niriba ni di nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, di mi pala niriba ni kɔŋ nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, amaa n wumla yila yilibu vuri.
en: Moses said, That doesn't sound like a shout of victory or a cry of defeat; it's the sound of singing.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba ni bɛ cham ti puɣisi nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Nɛgɛb tooni ha n-gari chaŋ zoya ni tinsi ni.
en: When Moses sent them out, he said to them, Go north from here into the southern part of the land of Canaan and then on into the hill country.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka kum daa ti lu Ijipti mini Keenan tiŋgbɔna ni zaa n-ti ba wahala pam, ka ti yaannim maa daa ti lan ka bindirigu.
en: A famine came upon all Egypt and Canaan, and great hardship came with it. Our ancestors had nothing to eat.

dag: Sabbu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni nyɛla yɛl shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Yisa Masia ni o kahigi binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ wuh o daba. O daa timla o malaika o dabili Jɔn sani ka o ti kahigi li n-wuh o.
en: This is a revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must happen soon. And Christ sent his angel to show it to his servant John.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tikpiralan so ŋun tɔri birilim ka o sanna nti suh o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some people brought him a man who was deaf and could hardly speak, and they begged Jesus to place his hands on him.

dag: Man Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi yi yaannim zuɣu.
en: The Lord Almighty told Zechariah to say to the people, I, the Lord , was very angry with your ancestors.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana, ka mali laara na ni n ti ti sokam kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm!.
en: Listen, I am coming soon! I will bring rewards with me. I will repay everyone for what they have done.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ; ka paɣimiy o yuli; yɛlimiya o tiliginsim lahibali suŋ yɛla dabisili kam.
en: Sing to the Lord , and praise him! Proclaim every day the good news that he has saved us.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi n-tab Yisa maa bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa.
en: So that disciple moved closer to Jesus' side and asked, Who is it, Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, maliya suɣilo hal ti paai ti Duuma labbuna saha. Kpahimmiya pukpara ni diri suɣilo n-guhir o puu atam din mali buchi hal ka saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa gba ti mi la.
en: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.

dag: Bɔhimi Midiannim biɛri ti Izraɛlnima. Di nyaaŋa n ni deeg a nyɛvili.
en: Punish the Midianites for what they did to the people of Israel. After you have done that, you will die.

dag: Ka n teei n nuu jɛndi ba n-saɣim tiŋgbani ka di bahi yoli, bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ti paai Ribila. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Wherever they live, I will direct my power against them. I will turn the land into a greater wasteland than the Riblah desert. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Chɛliya ka ti pii so leei ti zuɣulana n-lab Ijipti.
en: Then they said to one another, Let's choose our own leader and go back.

dag: n-daa zaŋ kuɣa maa me Yawɛ jɛmbu sara maligu bimbini maa zali, ka chɛ ka bɛ gaai bɔɣili gil li; ka bɔɣili maa ni tooi deei kom kaman lita pinaanahi laasabu.
en: Elijah used these stones to repair the altar to honor the Lord . He dug a small ditch around the altar. It was wide enough and deep enough to hold about gallons of water.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni niŋ yi kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini yi daazichi naani la zuɣu, bɛ ni ti gbahi yi gba chaŋ ka gbaai Chɛmɔshi min o maligumaaniba, ni o kpambaliba la daba chaŋ.
en: You thought you could be saved by your power and wealth, but you will be captured along with your god Chemosh, his priests, and officials.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ʒii nyabu puuni, a daa yɛli a daba bɛn ʒe a yim: N zaŋ sɔŋsim ti ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ; n duhi n ni pii ninvuɣ so niriba puuni.
en: Lord, you once spoke in a vision to your followers: I have made a young soldier strong. From among my people I chose him for an important position.

dag: Di saha o min o bihi ni yi a sani n-lab o dɔɣiriba sani ti ʒin o yaannim tiŋgban ni.
en: at which point the poor Israelite along with their children will be released from you. They can return to their extended family and to their family property.

dag: N ni zani n ni guli luɣ shɛli polo, ka tam n gooni zuɣu lihiri nya o ni yɛn yɛli ma shɛm min o ni yɛn garigi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ n fabila polo.
en: I will climb my watchtower and wait to see what the Lord will tell me to say and what answer he will give to my complaint.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti chɛ ba ka leei dabari dɔni n-di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim saha shɛli bɛ ni ti lan ka di ni maa, dama bɛ ʒiɛm n zaligunima ka zaɣisi n zaligunim maa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: First, however, the land must be rid of its people, so that it can enjoy its complete rest, and they must pay the full penalty for having rejected my laws and my commands.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ma.
en: The young man said, I have obeyed all these commands. What else do I need.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋya nirilim shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, pomiya ni yi gba ni ti niŋ m mini m ba yiŋnim nirilim lala, ka wuhi ma di shihirili.
en: Now, I have been loyal to you. So pledge to me by the LORD that you in turn will deal loyally with my family. Give me a sign of good faith.

dag: Ti nyɛla saamba bɛn go n-chani gind a tooni kaman ti yaannim la. Ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu ŋmanila shilinshia, ka tahima kani.
en: You know, O Lord , that we pass through life like exiles and strangers, as our ancestors did. Our days are like a passing shadow, and we cannot escape death.

dag: Amaa Amasa daa bi nya takɔbi maa Jɔab nuu ni, di saha ka Jɔab zaŋ takɔbi maa kuh o pul ni, ka o nyɔri daa yina ka o kpi. O daa bi lan kuh o pahi buyi. Di saha ka Jɔab min o mabia Abishai daa lan gbaai Bikiri bia Shiiba la naba biɛhibu.
en: Amasa did not see the dagger in Joab's other hand. Joab stuck it in Amasa's stomach, and his insides spilled out on the ground. Joab only struck him once, but Amasa was dying. Joab and his brother Abishai went off to chase Sheba.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri bɔɣiri ni ti kabi. Amaa Yawɛ ni sɔŋ wuntizɔriba.
en: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! n-yɛwaa! la gba di vi, ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Let those who say, Aha! Aha! stop because of their shameful behavior.

dag: O yuli n-daa du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa, ka o leei bɛ kpɛma. Amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: He was the most famous of the Thirty. He became their commander, but he wasnt among the Three.

dag: Ka Lɔt min o bipuɣins ayi la daa ti yiɣisi Zɔa n-chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-kpe m-be vokabili ni, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o be Zɔa.
en: Lot was afraid to stay in Zoar, so he and his two daughters went to live in the mountains in a cave.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini kom na ti tuhi ya soli saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti na la zuɣu mini bɛ ni daa lan da Balaam ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛɔr ŋun yi Pɛtɔr din be Mɛsopoteemia na bia la ni o ti yɛli noli tin ya la zuɣu.
en: because they didnt help you with food or water on your journey out of Egypt, and because they hired Balaam, Beors son, from Pethor of Mesopotamia to curse you.

dag: Gidiɔn ni daa wum doo maa zahindi maa mini di gbinni ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka o daa paɣi Naawuni pam, ka ŋmaligi lab Izraɛlnim sani ti yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ, Yawɛ zaŋ Midiannim maa zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: As soon as Gideon heard about the dream and what it meant, he bowed down to praise God. Then he went back to the Israelite camp and shouted, Let's go! The Lord is going to let us defeat the Midianite army.

dag: Ka o dan maa yɛl o, Ti ku zani tinzunnim bɛn pa Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tiŋ ŋɔ ni, amaa ti ni gari paala Gibia. Ka o daa lan yɛl o tumtumda maa, Chɛ ka ti tirisi chaŋ luɣ shɛŋa dimbɔŋɔ ha nti gbe Gibia bee Rama.
en: But his master, the Levite man, said, No, we will not go inside a strange city. Those people are not Israelites. We will go to the city of Gibeah. .

dag: Ka Dauda mi bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan ti kariti doli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum?.
en: Why are you hunting me down? Have I done something wrong, or have I committed a crime?.

dag: Ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsal la lan zaŋ o nuu shihi ma, ka n nya ka yaa maan niŋ n niŋgbuna ni pahi.
en: The one who looked like a human being touched me again and gave me strength.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei kpiimba maa situra, ka nya Sool min o bidibis ata maa ni do Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The day after the battle the Philistines went to plunder the corpses, and they found the bodies of Saul and his sons lying on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋ kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: I dont have any regular bread on hand, the priest answered David, just holy bread—but only if your troops have abstained from sexual activity.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛl o, Zaŋm a bigaŋ Yisahaku so a ni yuri pam la n-chaŋ Mɔria tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la nimaani n ni ti yɛn wuh a zo shɛli zuɣu.
en: The Lord said, Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.
