dag: Ka Azaria mini Ɛzra ni Mɛshulam.
en: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛri taba, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni daa niŋ ti mabia la shɛm la samli n-yɔri ti ŋɔ, o ni daa balim ti ka ti daa nya o suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka zaɣisi wumbu la; dinzuɣu ka suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti paai ti gba maa.
en: and said to one another, Yes, now we are suffering the consequences of what we did to our brother; we saw the great trouble he was in when he begged for help, but we would not listen. That is why we are in this trouble now.

dag: Ka ya polo ka n lee yɛn zaŋ vi ŋɔ kpe? Ka sokam ni bol a jɛrigu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu jaande, yɛlim naa, o ni zaŋ ma ti a.
en: How could I ever hold up my head in public again? And you—you would be completely disgraced in Israel. Please, speak to the king, and I'm sure that he will give me to you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa chɛbis o deemba maa, ka o lab o ya.
en: Then Moses said good-bye to Jethro, and Jethro went back home.

dag: A chɛ ka a niriba di wahala pam; a ti ti la wain ka ti nyu, ka di chɛ ka ti chani jeena.
en: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yi Abinɛr karibu maa yɔɣu labina nti laɣim Dauda tɔbbihi maa zali ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ pisiyinika daa kani m-pahi Asahɛl zuɣu.
en: Joab stopped chasing Abner and turned back. Joab had gathered his men and learned that of Davids officers were missing, including Asahel.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan suhi Naawuni, ka sagbana kpaai kom bahina, ka tiŋgbani zuɣu bimbila lan niŋdi bindira yaha.
en: Then Elijah prayed that it would rain. And the rain came down from the sky, and the land grew crops again.

dag: O nuu ni ka binnɛɔŋ kam nyɛvili mini ninsal kam vuhim be.
en: In whose grasp is the life of every thing, the breath of every person?.

dag: Ka yɛla maa daa muɣisi man Daniɛl pam, ka dɔro gbaai ma ka n dɔni paai dabisa shɛm. Ka n daa ti yiɣisi n lan labi nti tumdi tuun shɛŋa naa ni daa zali ma ni n tumdi la, amaa ka ʒii maa yɛla daa gari ma ka m bi tooi baŋ li.
en: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.

dag: Dauda ni daa ku Filistia doo maa naai ka labina, ka Abinɛr daa zaŋ o chaŋ Sool sani, ka o na kul gbibi Filistia doo maa zuɣu la o nuu ni.
en: So when David returned to camp after killing Goliath, Abner took him to Saul. David was still carrying Goliath's head.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli Neetan, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa simdila kubu.
en: David became very angry with the rich man. He said to Nathan, As the Lord lives, the man who did this should die!.

dag: ni Hushai bia Baana ŋun daa be Asha mini Biilɔt yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of the territory of Asher and the town of Bealoth.

dag: Ka o yi zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, nyin zaŋm li yɛli cheechi, ka o yi kul zaɣisi cheechi gba yɛligu wumbu, nyin lihim o kaman chɛfira bee lampɔdeera.
en: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔinnaanahi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Judah was .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka chɛrubinim la daa wuɣi bɛ kpiŋkpama mini din daa baɣi ba la zuɣusaa, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord 's glory above them.

dag: N nintam n-kul nyɛ m bindirigu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka niriba kul bɔhiri ma sahakam, A Naawuni maa lee be ya.
en: My tears have been my food both day and night, as people constantly questioned me, Wheres your God now.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣina ti pali bia maa ba Zakaria, ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra.
en: Johns father Zechariah was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o kpɛhi tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee ka bɛ ti fiɛb o n-vih o baŋ din chɛ ka niriba maa tahiri pampam o zuɣu maa.
en: The Roman commander ordered his men to take Paul into the fort, and he told them to whip him in order to find out why the Jews were screaming like this against him.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni lo ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o o niriba zaa sani.
en: I will stand before the gathering of his people and give the Lord what I promised.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni Masia daa leei Yɛhudianim dapala ni o wuhi ni Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni chɛ ka o ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali.
en: I tell you that Christ became a servant of the Jews to show that God has done what he promised their great ancestors.

dag: Nir yi zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, di tahirila yɛla na, amaa o yi zaɣisi lala niŋbu, o ni yi yɛla ni.
en: If you promise to pay a stranger's debt, you will regret it. You are better off if you don't get involved.

dag: Yisa Masia nyɛla ŋun daa kana ni kom mini ʒim, ka di pala ni kom kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla kom mini ʒim. Naawuni Shia mi di li shɛhira, dama ŋun Naawuni Shia nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Jesus Christ is the one who came. He came with water and with blood. He did not come by water only. No, Jesus came by both water and blood. And the Spirit tells us that this is true. The Spirit is the truth.

dag: Ka ti gba biɛhigu ŋmani zuliya shɛb biɛhigu, ti naa maa ni su ti, ka ni yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ti tuhi tɔb kam.
en: so we can be like all the other nations. Our king will judge us and lead us and fight our battles.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam kun ya, bɛ ni ku o gba. Bɛ ni gbahi yi dimnim zaa daba chaŋ. Bɛnkam fa yi nɛma, bɛ ni fa bɛ gba nɛma. Ka bɛnkam zaa di yi nɛma, n ni chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ gba nɛma.
en: But if your enemies try to rob or destroy you, I will rob and destroy them, and they will be led as captives to foreign lands.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Cham ti bo tiŋgul zali, ka yɛl o ni o nini yi nya shɛlikam, ŋun yɛlima.
en: The Lord said to me, Send guards to find out what's going on.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba kuhigu, wummiya bɛn guli biŋkɔbbaligu kuhigu, dama Yawɛ saɣindi bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: You moan and cry out in distress because the Lord in his anger has destroyed your nation and left your peaceful country in ruins.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti paai, ka tiŋ maa zaa damna ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: On the next Sabbath day, almost all the people in the city came together to hear the word of the Lord.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa daa yaai di noli n-vali bɛ mini bɛ yiŋnima ni Kɔra ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi Bɛtani chana, ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: When Jesus and his disciples left Bethany the next morning, he was hungry.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zo dabiɛm n-kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋ ha o nahimbu biɛrim nyabu maa zuɣu ka yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye! Nyin tin titali ŋɔ, nyin Babilɔn ŋun nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ, awa yini puuni ka a zani lu n-dahim zaa.
en: They stand a long way off, because they are afraid of sharing in her suffering. They say, How terrible! How awful! This great and mighty city Babylon! In just one hour you have been punished.

dag: M piɛri mi n kukoli, ka n gba mi ba, ka bɛ doli ma;.
en: My sheep listen to my voice. I know them and they follow me.

dag: Ka Zakaria yɛli malaika maa, N kurigiya, ka m paɣ gba kurigi pam. Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Zechariah said to the angel, How will I know this is going to happen? My wife and I are both very old.

dag: ka o tim puɣisiriba ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka Sool shiri be ni.
en: he sent spies and discovered that Saul had definitely arrived.

dag: Bɛn gbilisi tibili wum yɛlli ni tɔŋ. Ka bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi nyɛla bɛ shɛhiranim mini bɛ nyaanzaaniba, dama bɛna n-daa shiri ku ba, ka yi mi ti mɛri duri gindi bɛ gbala maa.
en: You yourselves admit, then, that you approve of what your ancestors did; they murdered the prophets, and you build their tombs.

dag: Ka ŋun paya la gba daa niŋ lala nya nyɔri ka di min o gba laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: In the same way the servant who had received two thousand coins earned another two thousand.

dag: Di nyɛla ti ni pun wum binshɛŋa yɛla ka mi li. Di nyɛla ti yaannim ni daa pun yɛli ti shɛli yɛla.
en: things we have heard and known, things that our ancestors told us.

dag: Ka o daa lan tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti nya Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni liɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: He went a little farther on and saw two other brothers, James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in their boat getting their nets ready.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the LORDs messenger admonished Joshua.

dag: ni Kɛdɛmɔt ni Mɛfaat ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Kedemoth, and Mephaath, with their pasture lands.

dag: o nyɛla karimbaandana ŋun duh omaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒi shɛli. O lan nyɛla kɔribiɛrilana ŋun suhu kul yɛla bɔhigu chɔɣima mini yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ tahirila nyuli zabbu mini woligibu ni turi ni tab zilisibu.
en: that person is conceited. They dont understand anything but have a sick obsession with debates and arguments. This creates jealousy, conflict, verbal abuse, and evil suspicions.

dag: So daa bi lo a nuhi, so mi daa bi ba a naba bandi. A lumi kaman nir ni lu putɔɣulan tooni shɛm la. Ka niriba maa zaa daa lan kum o zuɣu yaha.
en: His hands were not tied, And his feet were not bound; He died like someone killed by criminals! And the people wept for him again.

dag: Zaŋmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli ba ka bɛ zaŋ mali kuli ti yɛli bɛ nanima ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli yi nanim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, told me to command them to tell their kings that the Lord had said:.

dag: Dama ŋun yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina la n-nyɛ ŋun lan yɛli, Miri ka a ku ninsal la. Ka a yi bi niŋ zina, amaa ka lee ku ninsala, dindina a leei Naawuni zaligusaɣinda m-bala.
en: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.

dag: Bɛ nyarila ʒiinim din nyɛ ʒiri tir a, bɛ buɣirila ʒiri baɣiri tir a. Bɛ zaŋ a mi pa ninvuɣ yoya mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyiŋgoya zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dabisili pali, ka nyɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha.
en: You wicked Ammonites see false visions and believe untrue messages. But your day of punishment is coming soon, and my sword will slaughter you!.

dag: Toondaannim bɛn tumdi bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga simdi ni niriba lihiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga, di bahi bamdi bɛn tumdi waazu yihibu mini wuhibu tuma la.
en: The elders who lead the church in a good way should receive double honor —in particular, those who do the work of counseling and teaching.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ Reechɛl niŋ o paɣa, ka yur o gari Liya; ka daa lan tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti Leeban.
en: Jacob had intercourse with Rachel also, and he loved her more than Leah. Then he worked for Laban another seven years.

dag: O daa piila tumtumdiba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣ kpɛriba bɛn be zoya ni tuhi pihinii, ka pii niriba tusaata ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni bɛ lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumda.
en: To work in the highlands, Solomon drafted , laborers, , stonecutters, and , supervisors.

dag: Naawuni daa tɔɣisiri ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa la anabinim noya ni siɣimsiɣim bu shɛm soya balibu pam ni;.
en: In the past God spoke to our ancestors many times and in many ways through the prophets.

dag: Ka niɣi maa daa dii zaŋ li lu solɔɣu n-kpa Bɛtishɛmɛshi polo, bɛ daa bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, bɛ daa kul chanimi ka kuhira. Ka Filistia nanim daa dol ba hal ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi tintariga.
en: The cows went straight ahead, following the road to Beth-shemesh. They kept to one route, mooing as they went, without turning right or left. The Philistine rulers followed them as far as the territory of Beth-shemesh.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu, o yi ti chɛ ka di biɛɣ maa neesim neei yi alizanda ni na.
en: Our God is merciful and tender. He will cause the bright dawn of salvation to rise on us.

dag: Bɛ kabɔɣa mini bɛ wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ku dihi ba, ka bɛ ku nya wain palli.
en: But soon you will not have enough grain and olive oil, and there will be no wine.

dag: O suhu daa lan yiɣisi bahi Ayuba zɔnim ata la gba zuɣu bɛ ni daa bi tooi garigi Ayuba maa zuɣu; hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ni Ayuba mali galimi maa zaa yoli.
en: He was also angry with his three friends because they hadnt found an answer but nevertheless thought Job wicked.

dag: N yɛli ya ni yinyahi m-pooi ma, ka yi ti zaŋ doo ŋɔ na ni o ti tumd o yinyahili tuma ŋɔ n tooni? Doo ŋɔ ni tooi be n yili ŋɔ.
en: Am I short on insane people that youve brought this person to go crazy right in front of me? Do you really think Im going to let this man enter my house.

dag: Dama Man Yawɛ bi taɣira. Dinzuɣu ka yinim Yaakubu zuliya bi bahi yoli.
en: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out.

dag: Yim ka Babilɔn dii lu n-wurim. Kummiya di zuɣu. Zaŋmiya kpam na ti bɔbili di daŋ maa, di pa shɛli di ni tibi kpaŋ.
en: Babylonia has suddenly fallen and is destroyed! Mourn over it! Get medicine for its wounds, and maybe it can be healed.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ yiko min o jilima nyɛla din yi katiŋ kanna. O suhuyiɣisili shihirili nyɛla nyɔhi ni buɣim; ka o nol ni yɛtɔɣa ŋmani buɣim din dira.
en: Look there! The LORD is coming from far away; his anger blazing, his smoke-cloud thick. His lips are full of fury; his tongue is like a devouring fire.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli soya m-bala, ka bɛ yi yi dunia yili, shɛb ni kana ti zani bɛ zaani.
en: Yes, that's all the joy evil people have; others now come and take their places.

dag: Mani n-zal a ni a kul mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul be a sani luɣ shɛlikam a ni chana.
en: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go.

dag: Wari yi beni o suhu bi zɔhiri o yiŋnim zuɣu, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛrila situr tibisa.
en: She does not worry about her family when it snows. She has given them all good, warm clothes.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛligu mi kul ku yiɣisi. Ka Naawuni yi daa bol o ni zaŋ o yɛligu ti ninvuɣ shɛb la ŋun Naawuni ŋmahinli.
en: Scripture calls those to whom Gods word came gods , and scripture cant be abolished.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa to jina naai noli, ka lo Yisa mihi zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Early in the morning the chief priests met hurriedly with the elders, the teachers of the Law, and the whole Council, and made their plans. They put Jesus in chains, led him away, and handed him over to Pilate.

dag: Bɛ yaannim ninni ka o daa tum alahiziba tuma Zɔan bɔpiɛligu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But God performed wonders in their ancestors presence— in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

dag: Daadam Bia kandina ni ti ŋmanila do so ŋun daa yɛn go n-chaŋ tinshee katiŋa, ka zaŋ o yili niŋ o yiŋbihi nuu ni ka ti sokam o tuma, ka yɛl o yiligula ni o gul o yili maa la.
en: It is as if someone took a trip, left the household behind, and put the servants in charge, giving each one a job to do, and told the doorkeeper to stay alert.

dag: Di bi simdi ka jɛrigu mali buni pam, di mi bi simdi ni dabili su nabihi.
en: A fool should not be rich, and a slave should not rule over princes.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa, ka Aduna daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa bahi Firawuna min o kpamba tooni, ka di leei wahu.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and obeyed the Lord . Aaron threw his walking stick down. While Pharaoh and his officers watched, the stick became a snake.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tinim Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ ka yɔɣu ŋɔ ni na ni ti mini ti biŋkɔbiri ti kpi kpe?.
en: You brought us into this desert, and now we and our livestock are going to die!.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o o ni pa ti ni yino maa zuɣu.
en: John said, Master, we saw a man using your name to force demons out of people. But we told him to stop, because he isn't one of us.

dag: O bi nyari n ni doli so shɛŋa, ka kaani n napɔna yaabu zaa?.
en: God is the one who knows what I do and sees every step I take.

dag: Bolimi ma, ka n garig a, ka yɛl a yɛl kara mini binshɛŋa din sɔɣi ka a bi mi li.
en: Call to me and I will answer and reveal to you wondrous secrets that you havent known.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di lan zɔri ya Babilɔn naa kaman yi ni yi zɔr o shɛm la, dama m be yi sani ni n tiligi ya, ka fan ya o nuu ni bahi.
en: Stop being afraid of the king of Babylonia. I am with you, and I will rescue you from his power.

dag: Ti ni mali salima mini anzinfa yɛri ti a.
en: Lets make hoops of gold beaded with silver for you!.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Biɛɣuni. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Di ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka yi baŋ ni Naawuni so lan kani ŋ-ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Pharaoh said, Tomorrow. Moses said, It will happen as you say. In this way you will know that there is no god like the Lord our God.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ daanya m-mali binkpila ayi n-zaŋ tam daanya daantalis ayi maa zuɣusaa, ka binkpila maa zaɣ yini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla.
en: He made two capitals of cast bronze for the tops of the columns. They were each seven and a half feet high.

dag: Nyɔtaɣirisi n-kul gil o yaaŋa zuɣu zaa, di shɛbila tab ni kaman bɛ dihi li mi tabili la.
en: His back is made of rows of shields, fastened together and hard as stone.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yino maa n-tiri yiko din tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun tiri sokam yinoyino kaman o ni yu ni o ti o pin shɛli.
en: All these things are produced by the one and same Spirit who gives what he wants to each person.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni a zani ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyaaŋa saria karibu ni, ka mɔŋ ŋun ka taali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu ni.
en: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.

dag: ka m bi zaŋ m piɛri kɔbiri situra ti o ka o pili ka paɣi ma o suhu ni.
en: I would give him clothing made of wool that had come from my own flock of sheep. Then he would praise me with all his heart.

dag: Hadad ni daa ti kpi, Samla ŋun daa nyɛ Masirɛka nir la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Hadad died, Samlah became the new king. Samlah was from Masrekah.

dag: O daa be ka binshɛɣukam na kani, ka binshɛɣukam tuɣ taba la o ni.
en: He existed before all things, and all things are held together in him.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ka ti kul ni jɛm, ka deeg o noli.
en: The people then said to Joshua, We will serve the Lord our God. We will obey his commands.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka n daa yi m ma puli ni na ni n ti nyari muɣisigu mini suhugarigu, ka vi kul yɛn diri ma hal ni n nyɛvili tariga?.
en: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?.

dag: Inok daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbunaanu.
en: So Enoch lived a total of years.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so leei niriba maa toondana.
en: Lord God, source of all life, appoint, I pray, a man who can lead the people.

dag: Pa dunia ŋɔ shia ka ti deei, amaa Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna ka ti deei ni ti tooi baŋ pin shɛŋa Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ti.
en: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba maa nabi, ka a ti ba suhupiɛlli pam. Bɛ malila suhupiɛlli a sani kaman niriba ni kpuɣiri puu atam ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la bee kaman tɔbbihi ni yi pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: God, you will make the nation grow, and you will make the people happy. They will rejoice in your presence as they do at harvest time. It will be like the joy when people take their share of things they have won in war.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti nya a ni tirisi labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ a ka yɛli, Ninive bahi yoli, ŋuni n-lee yɛn fabili di zuɣu? Ya polo ka n lee yɛn nya bɛn ni maag a suhu ti a? .
en: Then all who look at you will recoil from you and say, Nineveh has been devastated! Who will lament for her? Where could I possibly seek comforters for you?.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpaɣim li, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti kpe Naawuni nam ni, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim ni.
en: And if your eye makes you lose your faith, take it out! It is better for you to enter the Kingdom of God with only one eye than to keep both eyes and be thrown into hell.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o salo maa ni yi kpaŋa nti zaŋ o nubihi tim o tiba ni, ka tuhi nintɔri zaŋ shihi tikpiralan maa zilinli;.
en: So Jesus took him off alone, away from the crowd, put his fingers in the man's ears, spat, and touched the man's tongue.

dag: Din lan nyɛ yi dini m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni yihi shɛlikam pin shɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋdi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la puuni, n zaŋ li ti a min a bidibisi ni a bipuɣinsi ni di nyɛ yi tarili, ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa, ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: In addition, any other special contributions that the Israelites present to me shall be yours. I am giving them to you, your sons, and your daughters for all time to come. Every member of your family who is ritually clean may eat them.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ŋun nyɛ ŋun niŋdi zina bee ŋun tumdi daɣiri tuma bee ŋun kɔre kpɛri binyara ni ti ku nya shɛli Masia mini Naawuni nam ni, dama binyara ni kɔre kpɛbu ŋmanila buɣijɛmbo.
en: You may be sure that no one who is immoral, indecent, or greedy will ever receive a share in the Kingdom of Christ and of God.

dag: Nuhu daa nyɛla pukpara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun tuui biri wain tihi. O daa birila wain tihi.
en: Noah became a farmer and planted a vineyard.

dag: Amaa naɣilaa maa gbaŋ min o nimdi zaa ni o zuɣu ni o biɛhi ni o namanama ni o bindi.
en: But the bulls hide and all of its flesh, along with its head, lower legs, entrails, and dung.

dag: N ni ti daai yi maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la. Ka n ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku yi ninvuɣ shɛba bahi yi buɣa maa tooni.
en: The altars will be torn down and the incense altars broken. All the people there will be killed in front of their idols.

dag: din ni gu a ka a ku bo paɣ yoli, ka yih a paɣ zinalan naŋgbam malisim yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: They guard you from the evil woman, from the flattering tongue of the foreign woman.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ti namda, ka ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka o nam ti ni ti mali biɛhigu shɛli din ni tumdi tuun sun shɛŋa o ni daa pun zali ni ti tumdi la.
en: God has made us what we are, and in our union with Christ Jesus he has created us for a life of good deeds, which he has already prepared for us to do.

dag: O yɛla ka Anabi Aizaia daa sabi yɛl la. O daa yɛlimi: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: John was the man the prophet Isaiah was talking about when he said, Someone is shouting in the desert, Prepare a road for the Lord; make a straight path for him to travel.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu soli wuhiri ya ni doo yi mali zab wɔɣila di nyɛla vi.
en: Doesnt nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him.

dag: Bɛ dihila Mɔab vi, dama bɛ wurim li. Kuhimiya ka fabili. Molimiya di yɛla Arinɔn mɔɣili duli ni Mɔab lu n-dahim.
en: They will answer, Moab has been defeated! Weep with us in shame. Tell everyone at the Arnon River that Moab is destroyed.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋun su kom fukumsi yɛli, Yaa ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ kasitalilana ka be ka daa pun be ŋɔ, a saria karibu ŋɔ nyɛla din tuhi!.
en: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.

dag: N ni kpe yi tiŋ ŋɔ ni n-chani ginda, n nya yi ni jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa, ka nya maligu malibu bimbin shɛli ka bɛ sab pa di zuɣu yɛli, Ti ni ʒi wun so ka jɛmd o la mi bimbini m-bɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu yi ni ʒi so ka jɛmd o maa yɛla ka n kahigiri wuhiri ya maa.
en: As I was walking through town and carefully observing your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: To an unknown God. What you worship as unknown, I now proclaim to you.

dag: Nyin Farisii ŋun nyɛ zom ŋɔ, daŋm paɣila pipia mini laa puuni, ka naanyi chɛ ka di nyaaŋa gba neei.
en: You blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of a cup, and then the outside will also be clean.

dag: Ti yi bi ʒe yim, ŋun kul ni ʒe yim, dama o ku tooi yi omaŋ nyaaŋa.
en: If we are not faithful, he remains faithful, because he cannot be false to himself.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka o gba vuhi, faashee ka o me Jɛrusalɛm zali, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa paɣi li.
en: Dont give him any rest until he rebuilds Jerusalem and makes it a place that everyone on earth will praise.

dag: Dama Masia bi tim ma ni n ti baptaizi niriba, amaa o tim ma ni n ti yihila lahibal suŋ waazu, ka di mi pala baŋsim yɛtɔɣa puuni; dama di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, dindina Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yiko ni gbarigi.
en: Christ didnt send me to baptize but to preach the good news. And Christ didnt send me to preach the good news with clever words so that Christs cross wont be emptied of its meaning.

dag: Pa bɛ takɔbiri ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa; pa bɛ mi maŋmaŋ yiko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tuhi di nasara maa; amaa di daa nyɛla a yiko min a kpiɔŋ ni a ni daa be bɛ sani la zuɣu, dama a nini daa tiɣi ba.
en: Your people did not conquer the land with their swords; they did not win it by their own power; it was by your power and your strength, by the assurance of your presence, which showed that you loved them.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa lihir o ka tɛhiri ni o nuu maa ni mɔri bee ni o ni yiɣi lu n-kpi; amaa bɛ ni daa lih o yuui nti nya ka shɛli bi niŋ o maa, ka bɛ daa lan taɣ zilinli yɛli ni o nyɛla buɣili.
en: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, This man is a god.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi mini Juda kpambaliba zaa o ninni Ribila maa.
en: The king of Babylon slaughtered Zedekiahs children before his very own eyes, and he slaughtered all Judahs officers at Riblah.

dag: Dama Masia ni, nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa yɛda niŋbu din tumdi di tuma yurilim ni n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: When someone belongs to Christ Jesus, it is not important if they are circumcised or not. The important thing is faith—the kind of faith that works through love.

dag: Asiba kam, n ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. N ni yihi tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa Yawɛ tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: My goal each day will be to destroy the wicked living in our land. I will force all who do evil to leave the city of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛli bidibis ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: Gods chest was taken, and Elis two sons Hophni and Phinehas died.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-yihi ya kuriti nyɛligibu daaŋa ni na Ijipti ni yi ti leei omaŋmaŋ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba kaman yi ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But you are the people he rescued from Egypt, that blazing furnace. He brought you out to make you his own people, as you are today.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim dolibu zuɣu sahakam.
en: I constantly feel a hunger to understand your laws.

dag: ka tinim bɛn mali nyɛviya be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ mini ba ti laɣim chaŋ ti kpe sagban ni n-tuhi ti Duuma soli sagbani maa ni; ka ti ni ti kpalim be ti Duuma maa sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: then we who are living at that time will be gathered up along with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.

dag: Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni noli ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Naawuni la, yi bi teei Naawuni suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu shɛm la yɛla? Ka di pala Ɛkan kɔŋko n-daa kpi o daalahichi maa tumbu zuɣu. .
en: Don't you remember what happened when Achan was unfaithful and took some of the things that belonged to God? This made God angry with the entire nation. Achan died because he sinned, but he also caused the death of many others.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa dɔɣi Shɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Shelah was born, Arphaxad lived years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa chaŋ Siria mini Kilikia tiŋgbana ni.
en: Then I went into the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni bɔhim baŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni waawaayil la ni bɔri ni bɛ nya wuhibu, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.

dag: Ŋuni ka o daa niŋ saawara ni o baŋ shɛli, ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o yɛlimaŋli soli. Ka ŋuni n-daa lee wuh o baŋsim bee n-wuh o o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm?.
en: Did the Lord ask for anyones help? Did anyone teach him to be fair? Did anyone teach him knowledge? Did anyone teach him to be wise?.

dag: N niriba, wummiya, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm: N ni zaŋ n wuhibu wuhi niriba, n zaligunim ni ti zuliya kam zaa neesim.
en: My people, listen to me! My decisions will be like lights showing people how to live.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi Bɛrishiiba n-lu soli. Ka Yaakubu bihi daa zaŋ bɛ ba Yaakubu mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi n-niŋ tɔroko shɛŋa Firawuna ni daa zaŋ ti ba ni bɛ zaŋ o niŋ n-ʒi o na la ni.
en: Then Jacob left Beer-sheba. Israels sons put their father Jacob, their children, and their wives on the wagons Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

dag: Yi ni daa paai kpe na, Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi daa kana ti liri ti n-tuhi ti, amaa ka ti daa nyaŋ ba.
en: When you arrived here, Sihon, Heshbons king, and Og, Bashans king, marched out to fight against us, but we defeated them.

dag: Ka o tumtumdiba daa chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Ti ba, anab maa yi di yɛl a ni a niŋm binshɛli din to pam, a naan ku niŋ li? Di ni ti be ka o ni yɛl a mi, Cham ti mim kom ni ka nya alaafee ŋɔ? .
en: Naamans servants came up to him and spoke to him: Our father, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, wouldnt you have done it? All he said to you was, Wash and become clean.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpalim be mɔɣu ni sɔɣisili shee din be Zif mɔɣu ni zoya tiŋgbɔŋ la ni. Ka Sool daa kul lihiri bɔr o dabisili kam, amaa ka Naawuni daa bi zaŋ o niŋ o nuu ni.
en: David went into the desert of Ziph and stayed in the mountains and fortresses there. Saul looked for David the whole time, but the Lord didnt let Saul catch him.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neei, ka Pita ni daa yi duu maa ni shɛm yɛla gari duguliba maa pam, ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri di zuɣu.
en: The next day the soldiers were very upset. They wondered what happened to Peter.

dag: Dama bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim n-jɛmdi buɣa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi ya ŋɔnim zuɣu ka kɔŋ maabu.
en: The people of Judah have rejected me. They have offered sacrifices to foreign gods and have worshiped their own idols. I cannot stand it any longer. I am furious.

dag: Nyama, mbusim din pah ayi gariya; ka din pah ata yɛn doli di nyaaŋ na pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The second horror is over, but the third horror will come soon!.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa taai duŋ niŋ ma, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni yu binshɛŋa ka Yawɛ je li maa bahi bee n-chɛ Ijiptinim buɣa la jɛmbu. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi ni n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But they defied me and refused to listen. They did not throw away their disgusting idols or give up the Egyptian gods. I was ready to let them feel the full force of my anger there in Egypt.

dag: ni m mali suhugarigu pam, ka nandahima din bi naari kul mali ma.
en: when I say how great is my sorrow, how endless the pain in my heart.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa taali ni ti ʒi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba zuɣu.
en: I can promise that you people living today will be punished for all these things!.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mini Dauda ŋun nyɛ bɛ na so n ni yɛn pii ti ba la.
en: They will serve the LORD their God and the king whom I will raise up for them from Davids family.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka bɛ zab Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi na maa.
en: He knew that the leaders of the people had handed him over because of jealousy.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Mbaye, n daa zaɣisi biɛrisuŋ, ka zaɣisi zuɣuni kpahibu.
en: and you say, How I hated instruction! How my heart despised correction!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-yɛri noli tiri bɛ banima, ka bi paɣiri bɛ manima.
en: Some people curse their fathers and refuse to bless their mothers.

dag: Yisifu dan maa ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa o paɣ ni zaŋ yɛl o ka lan yɛli, Lala ka a dabili maa niŋ ma, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: Potiphar became very angry.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yiɣisima n-chaŋ ti tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa suhumahili yɛtɔɣa; dama m po Yawɛ, a yi bi chaŋ, so ku kpalim a sani yuŋ ŋɔ, ka dimbɔŋɔ maa ni bie n-gari zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din pun niŋ a a nachimbilim ni zaŋ na hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: Now get up and go encourage your officers. I swear by the Lord , if you dont go out and do that right now, not one man will be with you tonight. And that will be worse for you than all the trouble you have had since you were a child.

dag: Ɛmim zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ wɔɣira ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anaki zuliya, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam la n-daa pun be nimaani.
en: In the past, the Emites lived in Ar. They were strong people, and there were many of them. They were very tall, like the Anakites.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa mɔni Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ n-daa siɣi di zuɣu na ni buɣim, ka di nyɔhi maa daa kpuɣi du kaman tampuli zuɣu nyɔhi la, ka zoli maa zaa daa dam pam.
en: All of Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the Lord had come down on it in fire. The smoke went up like the smoke of a furnace, and all the people trembled violently.

dag: M mabihi, Klɔi yiŋnim shɛb daa yɛli ma ni naŋgbankpeeni kpe yi sunsuuni.
en: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.

dag: Di saha ka Chɛnaana bia Zɛdɛkia daa kana ti labi Mikaya tapaɣa ka bɔh o, So dini ka Yawɛ shia maa lee doli yi n ni n-kana ti yɛl a yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Zedekiah walked over and slapped Micaiah on the face. Then he asked, Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia. Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: Jacob told Rachel that he was related to her father and that he was Rebekahs son. She then ran to tell her father.

dag: Ka yi mi yi ti nya ka pɔhim ʒiɛri yiri nudirigu polo na, yi yɛrimi ni woligu ni niŋ, ka di ti shiri niŋ.
en: When you feel the wind begin to blow from the south, you say, It will be a hot day. And you are right.

dag: Ka Asa mini tɔbbihi bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kari doli ba ni Gɛra n-daa ku Itiɔpianim maa zaa ka so bi kpalim, dama Yawɛ min o tɔbbihi daa ku ba. Ka Judanim maa daa di nɛma pam chaŋ.
en: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi bɔhi.
en: Job, can't people like you ever be quiet? If you stopped to listen, we could talk to you.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Chisilɔn bia Ɛlidad.
en: from the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad, Chislons son.

dag: Tibidarigibo dabisili dali, Ifriim tiŋ ni ti kpalim dabari. Izraɛl zuliya ka n yɛri din shiri ti yɛn niŋ maa.
en: I, the Lord , will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.

dag: Musa daa gulila o deemba Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana la biŋkɔbbaligu maa. Ka o daa ti zaŋ ba ti kpe tiŋgban nɛli ni n-gari chaŋ Naawuni zoli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini.
en: Moses was taking care of the flock for his father-in-law Jethro, Midians priest. He led his flock out to the edge of the desert, and he came to Gods mountain called Horeb.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa daa guni yomyom, dama o suhu daa yu Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa hal ti yaɣi. O daa nyɛla yulilana o daŋ ni.
en: Shechem was the most respected person in his family, and he was so in love with Dinah that he hurried off to get everything done.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim zaa. Paɣimiy o! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri ŋarima teeku ni mini teeku puuni binnɛma zaa ni teeku dulinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ; praise him everywhere on earth— all you who sail on the seas, everything in the sea, and all you people in faraway places!.

dag: Bɛ di n-tiɣi nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti be muɣisigu ni. Ka yɛlibiɛɣu kam zaa ni ti ka bɛ zuɣu na.
en: At the height of their success all the weight of misery will crush them.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn mali soli tin ya, amaa di pala zaligu.
en: I say this only to give you permission to be separated for a time. It is not a rule.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa wum bɛ wuhibu maa niŋ yɛda. Dɔbba kɔŋko daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu laasabu.
en: Many who heard the word became believers, and their number grew to about five thousand.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ti Mɔrɛshɛtigatinim chɛbisibu pina, ka Akizibnim ni ti nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi Izraɛl nanima.
en: Therefore, you will give good-bye gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib have become a deception for the kings of Israel.

dag: Di mi pala din be teeku duli ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du teeku duli ti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: And you can't say, How can we obey the Lord 's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.

dag: N kul nɛmi doya; n ŋmanila noombil ŋun be mɔpilli zuɣu o ko.
en: I lie awake; I am like a lonely bird on a housetop.

dag: Dama di daa simdi ni nyini n dan naa ku m ba daŋ niriba zaa, amaa ka a daa zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ m-pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. N lan malila n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-naɣ pahila n kum niŋ nyin naa.
en: All of my father's family deserved to be put to death by Your Majesty, but you gave me the right to eat at your table. I have no right to ask for any more favors from Your Majesty.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba suhuri fuŋya, ka niriba pam tuura. N zaŋ takɔbi maa naŋgbancholi zali bɛ dunoya zaa ni. Bɛ mal li mi ka di nyaɣisira ka saa la. Ka nyahi neei li ni di ku niriba.
en: It makes my people lose courage and stumble. I am threatening their city with a sword that flashes like lightning and is ready to kill.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛ kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ nahim Yisa tuumba maa, hal ka bɔri ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa.
en: Some of the Jews there, as well as their leaders and some of the non-Jewish people, were determined to hurt Paul and Barnabas. They wanted to stone them to death.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din tibigiri zuliya, amaa alahichi nyɛla din dihiri niriba vi.
en: Righteousness dignifies a nation, but sin disgraces a people.

dag: A ni nya saŋmaris ayopɔin shɛba n nudirigu ni la mini salima firilatamdis ayopɔin shɛŋa la gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Saŋmaris ayopɔin maa nyɛla cheechinima ayopɔin la malaikanima, ka salima firilatamdis ayopɔin la mi nyɛ cheechinima ayopɔin la.
en: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri gbinni yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o, ka zaŋ zabba yɛl o, ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa yɛl o, ka zaŋ balati lo o.
en: He put the shirt and the robe on Aaron and the sash around his waist. He put the ephod on him and fastened it by putting its finely woven belt around his waist.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim ni daa be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ daa tala bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma daɣiri. Bɛ ni daa be shɛm n sani daa ŋmanila paɣa ni nya sɔrilim ka bi lan be nyam shɛm la.
en: Mortal man, he said, when the Israelites were living in their land, they defiled it by the way they lived and acted. I regarded their behavior as being as ritually unclean as a woman is during her monthly period.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ti teei zani ni bɛ zaŋ nya taba.
en: The Philistine and the Israelite armies took positions for battle, facing each other.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa yiɣisi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.

dag: Ka bol o dan maa sandiriba zaa yinoyino na ti bɔhi ŋun daŋ tooni, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a.
en: Then one by one he called in the people who were in debt to his master. He asked the first one, How much do you owe my master.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba daŋ bɛn daa kuli yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Ziha mini Hasufa ni Tabayɔt ni.
en: These are the descendants of the special Temple servants: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth.

dag: N timd a la bɛ sani ni a ti neei bɛ nina ka bɛ yi zibisim ni kpe neesim ni, ka yi Sintani nuu ni kpe Naawuni nuu ni n-nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ, ka nya zaashee Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sunsuuni bɛ ni niŋ man Yisa yɛda zuɣu. .
en: I want you to open their eyes, so they will turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God. Then their sins will be forgiven, and by faith in me they will become part of God's holy people.

dag: Ka zoya ti nyɛligi do o naba ni ka vinvama tahi bɔɣi kaman shigbaŋ m-miri buɣim la, bee kaman kom din kpaai bahi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ sirigili la.
en: Then the mountains will melt under him like wax in a fire; they will pour down into the valleys like water pouring down a hill.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ti ni daa wum Naawuni Bia maa sani ka yɛri ya di yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Naawuni nyɛla neesim, ka zibisim ka o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Now the message that we have heard from his Son and announce is this: God is light, and there is no darkness at all in him.

dag: Bi so ŋun mal o ba ansarisi ka ʒiɛm o ma, ka zaɣis o noli, vinvamli ni kahiŋkɔri ni kpuɣ o chaŋ ka juri ti di o.
en: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.

dag: dama Yawɛ n-nyɛ a ni yɛn niŋ so naani, ka o mi ku chɛ ka tɔŋ gbaag a napɔŋ.
en: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n ni pɔbisi tinzunnim bɛn lir a zaa bahi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn zɔr dabiɛm zo yomyom kaman pɔhim n-ʒe wurigu chaŋ la. Nini pɔbbu ni neebu.
en: But your many enemies will be like fine dust, the terrible horde like passing chaff. Suddenly, in an instant.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi ku o kpee, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who kills his neighbor in secret. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Ka o daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Shiiba. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni tiŋ maa yuli Bɛrishiiba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He called it Shibah; therefore, the citys name has been Beer-sheba until today.

dag: Buɣim niɛm mokpala n-yir o noli ni na n-tahiri yiɣiri ka buɣim yirina.
en: Flames blaze from his mouth, and streams of sparks fly out.

dag: Ka bɛ tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti mi ni a nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛra ni ŋun wuhiri din tuhi ka bi gaŋdi so, amaa ka wuhiri Naawuni soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: They asked him, Teacher, we know that you are correct in what you say and teach. You dont show favoritism but teach Gods way as it really is.

dag: Miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa n-kpɛh amaŋ daɣiri ni o sani.
en: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.

dag: Saha shɛli di ni daa wum ya ka gbarigi ya, ka bɛ liri ya n-ku yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nyaaŋa la. Bɛ daa bi zo Naawuni.
en: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu n-nya ka salo pam kani o sanna, ka o naanyi bɔhi Filip, Ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu n-da n-ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: Jesus looked around and saw that a large crowd was coming to him, so he asked Philip, Where can we buy enough food to feed all these people? .

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ buhi kɔbiri wuɣi tana piniyini n-zaŋ li pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Then they made a cover for the Tent out of eleven pieces of cloth made of goats' hair.

dag: Di saha ka ti chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na, dama Sool ʒiɛman la ni ti baɣa daa lan ka di ni.
en: Lets bring our Gods Holy Box back to us in Jerusalem. We did not pay attention to it while Saul was king.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti wumya ni Izraɛl nanim nyɛla nambɔzɔriba, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ buri so, ka zaŋ gabisi n-kaŋka n-vili ti zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl Naa maa sani, di pa shɛli ka o tilig a nyɛvili.
en: His officials said, Your Majesty, we've heard that Israel's kings keep their agreements. We will wrap sackcloth around our waists, put ropes around our heads, and ask Ahab to let you live.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa pun chaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ duli, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri li, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: By this time the boat was already a long way from shore. Since the wind was blowing against it, the boat was having trouble because of the waves.

dag: ka Farigudeeriba kpeen so ŋun yuli daa booni Zakius ka o nyɛ bundana daa be nimaani.
en: There was a chief tax collector there named Zacchaeus, who was rich.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa zaŋ Sool min o tumtumda maa kpɛhi du tital ni nti ti ba ʒiishe gahinda bɛ ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb na maa sani, niriba maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pihita laasabu.
en: Samuel took Saul and his servant into the dining room at the place of worship. About people were there for the dinner, but Samuel gave Saul and his servant the places of honor.

dag: Yi ni yɛn tiri kpam mi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpa ŋmani kam puuni, yihimiya kuruwa pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu ti.
en: They will also bring one percent of their olive oil. These things will be measured according to the bath , and ten baths is the same as one homer or one cor .

dag: Juda zuliya ni, ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi ka bɛ daa tabili, Rubin zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Gaad zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: From the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand.

dag: Ka ŋunkam saɣim Naawuni zaligu zaɣ yini ni mali di zaa saɣimbu taali.
en: You might follow all of Gods law. But if you fail to obey only one command, you are guilty of breaking all the commands in that law.

dag: Ka o daa kpe vokabili puuni zoli maa zuɣu nti gbe nimaani. Ka Yawɛ daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: There Elijah went into a cave and spent the night. Then the Lord said to him, Elijah, why are you here.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Chisilɔn bia Ɛlidad.
en: from the tribe of Benjamin—Elidad son of Kislon;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam po sara maligu bimbini pola di mini binshɛɣukam din pa di zuɣu.
en: Therefore, those who swear by the altar swear by it and by everything thats on it.

dag: Ka o daa mali nti kpe yil shɛli, ka zoomba maa dol o kpe; ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi niŋ yɛda ni n ni tooi niŋ yi ni bɔri shɛli maa? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, Do you believe I can make you well? Yes, Lord, they answered.

dag: O nyɛla Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni be, ka dunianim ku tooi deeg o, dama bɛ bi nyar o, bɛ mi bi mi o; amaa yinim mi o, dama o be yi sani ka ni ti be yi ni.
en: The Helper is the Spirit of truth. The people of the world cannot accept him, because they dont see him or know him. But you know him. He lives with you, and he will be in you.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din galisi la di ba.
en: Pour out your anger on them— let your burning fury catch them.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bah o niriba noli, ka bɛ zaŋ Ibram min o paɣa ni o ni mali binshɛlikam zaa yihi soli.
en: Then Pharaoh commanded his men to lead Abram out of Egypt. So Abram and his wife left that place and took everything they had with them.

dag: N ni lo ni n niŋ dunia ŋɔ zaa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teegi n nuu ni n-darigi niriba tibili.
en: This is my plan for the world, and my arm is stretched out to punish the nations.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka sanzali zani, ka siɣili saa bi lan mira. Amaa ka yi nini kul moola zina niŋbu zuɣu, ka vi bi mali ya.
en: You sinned, so the rain has not come. There has not been any springtime rains. But still you refuse to be ashamed. The look on your face is like that of a prostitute who refuses to be ashamed.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti liri ba Mɛrom kulibɔŋ maa ni libigi ba.
en: So Joshua and all his men attacked them by surprise at Merom Brook.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛ daa dɔɣ a la alahichi puuni, ka nyin ti lee nyɛ ŋun wuhiri ti? Ka bɛ daa kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: They responded, You were born completely in sin! How is it that you dare to teach us? Then they expelled him.

dag: O ni tooi di o Naawuni bindir shɛli din nyɛ zaɣ kasi zaa la mini din nyɛ zaɣ kasi la.
en: They may eat the food offerings presented to me.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many men, claiming to speak for me, will come and say, I am the Messiah! and they will fool many people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lola nia biɛɣu jɛndi ma.
en: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.

dag: Chɛ ka m be a jɛmbu duu sahakam, ka chɛ ka n sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: Please let me live in your tent forever! Please let me take refuge in the shelter of your wings! Selah.

dag: Nyamiya, n di kul guhirila yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, ka gbilisiri tibili ni n wum yi yɛtɔɣa, saha shɛli yi ni di na tɛhiri yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm la.
en: I eagerly listened to each of your arguments.

dag: Ka Obɛdɛdom daa yina ti deei duno shɛli din daa be nudirigu polo la, ka bɛ daa zaŋ nɛma duri fukumsi niŋ o bidibisi nuu ni.
en: Obed Edom was chosen for the South Gate. And Obed Edoms sons were chosen to guard the house where the valuable things were kept.

dag: ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma niriba ni, n gba ni ti zaɣis o Naawuni malaikanim sani.
en: But if you stand before others and say you do not believe in me, then I will say that you do not belong to me. I will say this in the presence of Gods angels.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ sipirɛs tihi dari m-mali dunoyɔriti ayi, ka duno yini dini nyɛ dunoyɔriti ayi din kpabira; ka duno din la gba dini nyɛ dunoyɔriti ayi din kpabira.
en: The two doors of pinewood each pivoted on a socket.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ tamla nyɛvili din ka bahigu tahima zuɣu. Naawuni ŋun ku ŋma ʒiri ŋɔ daa lo ti nyɛvili ŋɔ alikauli la ʒiɛmana din gari la ha ni.
en: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli Izraɛlnim ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ka saɣim n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti n niriba Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su li la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn vuɣi ba la bɛ tiŋgban ni, ka yihi Judanim bɛ sunsuuni.
en: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.

dag: ni yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu ni Naawuni yiko ni ni wuntitali din nyɛ ti bidibbina m-be ti nudiriti mini ti nuzahi ni la puuni.
en: telling the truth, and Gods power. We carried the weapons of righteousness in our right hand and our left hand.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu daa na bi dɔɣi bihi, ka daa lan daŋ bɛ ba kpibu, ka Ɛliɛza mini Itama daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did. Nadab and Abihu had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.

dag: O ni daa ti wum ni Yisa Nazarɛt nira n-gariti maa ka o dii gbaai kuhiri yɛra, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: When he heard that it was Jesus from Nazareth, he shouted, Jesus, Son of David, have pity on me.

dag: N ku chɛ a bee n-zo a nambɔɣu, n ni darigi a tibili a tuma zuɣu saha shɛli a ni tum din chihiri shɛli ni na be a kɔbili ni maa. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: amaa lee niŋmiya lala la biɛribaalimtali mini sizuura lubu puuni. Kul chɛliya ka yi suhuri ni tɛha ku mali galimi, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn turi ya ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri yi biɛrisuntali yi ni doli Masia la zuɣu di vi.
en: But answer them in a gentle way with respect. Keep your conscience clear. Then people will see the good way you live as followers of Christ, and those who say bad things about you will be ashamed of what they said.

dag: Dama zuliya pam mini na kara ni ti zaŋ bɛ gba leei daba, ka n ti yo ba bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ nuhi tuma samli kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: I will pay the Babylonians back for what they have done, and many nations and great kings will make slaves of them.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa lan pihi kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa.
en: Then the people again picked up stones to throw at him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yi o biɛhigu shee alizanda ni kana ti darigi dunianim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ashilɔni zaa yɛla ni ti yi palo, ka tiŋgbani ti ku lan sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: Look! The LORD is going out from his place to bring the iniquity of the ruler of the earth down upon him. The earth will uncover its blood and will conceal its slain no longer.

dag: Ka di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi dɔni bindoo kam zuɣu di ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: If a man with a discharge lies on a bed, that bed becomes unclean. Everything he sits on will become unclean.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka ti lan tiri ti tab zalige, yi mi di chɛliya ka ti tum din ni gu ti kpee soli bee n-chɛ ka o tuui lu.
en: So then, let us stop judging one another. Instead, you should decide never to do anything that would make others stumble or fall into sin.

dag: N ni tib n niriba maa, ka ti bɛn be yoma mini bɛn be katinsi zaa suhudoo. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I offer peace to all, both near and far! I will heal my people.

dag: Pakoli maa ni da kpɛri ni o ti tooi kom maa na, ka o lan bol o yɛli, Piim mahili mali ma na.
en: And as she was going to get it, he called out, And please bring me some bread, too.

dag: ni ŋun wuhiri bɛn ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni din tuhi biɛribaalimtali puuni. Dama di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka bɛ baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli ka niŋ tuuba.
en: who is gentle as you correct your opponents, for it may be that God will give them the opportunity to repent and come to know the truth.

dag: N kul malila suhupiɛlli a yɛligu zuɣu kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-di nɛma pam.
en: How happy I am because of your promises— as happy as someone who finds rich treasure.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti zali Naa Dauda ni daa ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni, ka daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara ti Naawuni.
en: They put the sacred chest inside the tent that David had set up for it, then they offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing.

dag: Ka n daa suhi Yawɛ di saha maa gba yɛli.
en: At that time I prayed and begged.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli.
en: He said many things to them in parables. While teaching them, he said.

dag: ka yɛl o, Yoom wulimpuhili polo takɔro ŋɔ; ka o yoo li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Toma, ka o to li. Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Yawɛ nasara dibu piɛm m-bɔŋɔ, nasara dibu piɛm din yɛn nyaŋ Sirianima m-bala! Dama a ni tuhi Sirianim Afɛk hal nti ku n-naai ba.
en: and said, Open the window facing east. When it was open, Elisha shouted, Now shoot! Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.

dag: Ka paɣ mi yi yi o yidan yiŋ kuli do so, o gba tum zina.
en: And the woman who divorces her husband and marries another man is also guilty of adultery.

dag: Ka karimbanim bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim ŋɔ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ ni nam yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya ni bɛ zaŋ ya bo liɣiri. Amaa bɛ Sariakarita ŋun ni bahi ba yoli pun mali shili ka di wɔɣa; ka mi bi gbihira.
en: In their greed these false teachers will make a profit out of telling you made-up stories. For a long time now their Judge has been ready, and their Destroyer has been wide awake!.

dag: Yi yi ti daai yi dimnim pihi luhi ka ku ba dahin shɛli, kom ni ti zɔri yiri zoya din du pam mini kuŋkuna din du pam zaa ni na.
en: On every lofty mountain, and on every high hill, streams will run with water on the day of the great massacre, when the towers fall.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di pala doo ŋɔ daalahichi bee o laamba daalahichi zuɣu, amaa di niŋmi ni Naawuni tumtumsa yi palo o ni.
en: Jesus answered, Neither he nor his parents. This happened so that Gods mighty works might be displayed in him.

dag: Ti kpaŋ timaŋ ni ti tibi Babilɔn, amaa ka kɔŋ li tibbu. Chɛliya li ka ti zaa kuli timaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama o tibidarigibo maa du zuɣusaa hal ti kpe sagbana ni.
en: We tried to heal Babylon, but she cannot be healed. So let us leave her, and let each of us go to our own country. God in heaven will decide Babylons punishment. He will decide what will happen to Babylon.

dag: n-nya malaikanim ayi ka bɛ ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒi Yisa ni daa do luɣ shɛl la: Yino o zuɣu polo, ŋun la mi o naba polo.
en: She saw two angels dressed in white, seated where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and one at the foot.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ nya ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: The apostles got into an argument about which one of them was the greatest.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti di n-tiɣi, ka di wuhi ni bɛ tiɣiya ka bɛ daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛhi bɛ suhuri ni, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tam n yɛla.
en: I gave food to the Israelites, and they ate it. They became full and satisfied. They became proud, and then they forgot me.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi tiŋ maa ni dɔbba, Ka jɛmbu duu pagɔr so ŋun yi ʒiini Inaim palli naŋgbanyee ŋɔ la lee be ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: Hirah asked the people of Enaim, Where is the prostitute who sat along the road outside your town? There's never been one here, they answered.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pita, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus replied, I tell you, Peter, the rooster wont crow today before you have denied three times that you know me.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni nir maa daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka di lu? Ka o wuh o di shee, ka Ilaisha ŋmaai daɣu n-zaŋ bahi nimaani n-chɛ ka lɛbiɛlim maa puhi pan na.
en: Where did it fall? Elisha asked. The man showed him the place, and Elisha cut off a stick, threw it in the water, and made the ax head float.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yiŋa; ka binshɛli bi kpalim n nɛma dur la ni ka m bi zaŋ li wuhi ba.
en: Isaiah said, What did they see in your palace? Hezekiah answered, They saw everything I own. I showed them all my wealth.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ wuntizɔriba pahi paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuyanim pam daa dihi bɛ yɛligu maa tabili, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool mini Silas.
en: Some of them believed what Paul had said, and they became followers with Paul and Silas. Some Gentiles and many important women also believed the message.

dag: Di saha ka Dɔdavahu ŋun daa nyɛ Marɛsha nir la bia Ɛliɛza daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, A ni zaŋ amaŋ tabili Ahazia maa zuɣu Yawɛ ni saɣim a tuma maa. Ka ŋarima maa daa chaŋ ti saɣim sol ni ka bi paai Speen.
en: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah. The ships were wrecked and never sailed.

dag: Dindali maa ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt ni o bidibisi maa paɣiba ata la daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: On that day Noah and his wife went into the boat with their three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and their wives.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa nyɛ Simiɔn bia, ka Simiɔn nyɛ Juda bia, ka Juda nyɛ Yisifu so bia, ka Yisifu maa nyɛ Jɔnam bia, ka Jɔnam mi nyɛ Ɛliakim bia.
en: Simeon, Judah, Joseph, Jonam, Eliakim.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl kpamba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana? Yi yɛn bɔhi ma mi baŋ binshɛli? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku bɔhi ma baŋ binshɛli.
en: Mortal man, he said, speak to these leaders and tell them that the Sovereign Lord is saying: You have come to ask my will, have you? As surely as I am the living God, I will not let you ask me anything. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim polo, Naawuni buɣisiri ba mi ni o wuhi ni ninsalinim ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri.
en: I thought about what people do to each other. And I said to myself, God wants people to see that they are like animals.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, pom Naawuni kpe ni a ku yɔhim m mini m bihi ni n zuliya; amaa n ni ʒe a yim shɛm, a gba zanimi m mini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni kana ti beni ŋɔ yim.
en: So make a vow here in the presence of God that you will not deceive me, my children, or my descendants. I have been loyal to you, so promise that you will also be loyal to me and to this country in which you are living.

dag: Di saha maa ka n ni tɔɣis a wuntitali yɛla, ka tɔɣis a paɣibu yɛla dabisi muni zaa puuni.
en: Then I will proclaim your righteousness, and I will praise you all day long.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ tahima niŋ Naawuni ni, ka ku tam Naawuni tuma yɛla, ka kul dol o zaligunima.
en: So they would all trust in God, never forgetting what he had done and always obeying his commands.

dag: Di saha ka Iso daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi ni o yiŋ niriba zaa ni o niɣi min o biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pahi zaa ni o ni daa bo n-nya binshɛɣukam zaa Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgban shɛl ni ha ka chɛ o tizo Yaakubu.
en: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the people of his house, along with all his livestock and all the possessions he had gotten in the land of Canaan, and went away from his brother Jacob to another land.

dag: Nyin Lɛbanɔn nira ŋun me a yili zali sida tihi sunsuuni ŋɔ, biɛrim yi ti paag a, a ni ŋuhi pam kaman paɣa ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi la.
en: King, you seem so safe in your palace of cedar. Its as if you live in Lebanon! But when your punishment comes, you will groan. You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛmaŋa n-doli tab chani buɣa maligu shee mini bɛn ŋubiri kuruchunim ni jɛŋgbarisi, ka diri bindiri yoya la bahigu saha miriya.
en: The Lord says, The end is near for those who purify themselves for pagan worship, who go in procession to sacred gardens, and who eat pork and mice and other disgusting foods.

dag: Gbilisim tibili wum n saɣisigu ŋɔ; n ni yɛl a din be n suhu ni, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ayi nyɛ Chiliab. O ma n-daa nyɛ Abigeel ŋun nyɛ Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la. Ka ŋun pah ata nyɛ Absalom. O ma n-daa nyɛ Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛshur Naa Talimai bipuɣiŋga la.
en: The second son was Kileab. His mother was Abigail, who had been the wife of Nabal from Carmel. The third son was Absalom. Absaloms mother was Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur.

dag: ni kɔniŋdi bin yin la ni naɣilahi pinaayi shɛb zuɣu kɔniŋdi bini maa ni daa tamya la.
en: a large bowl; twelve bulls that held up the bowl;.

dag: A ni ti kurigi zaa ka naanyi dɔn a gballi ni kaman bɛ ni yi chɛ siŋkaafa ti sɔŋ siŋkaafabɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.

dag: A zaligunim maa chɛ ka m mali yɛm gari n dimnima, dama di kul bela n suhu ni.
en: Your commands are always with me, and they make me wiser than my enemies.

dag: Di ni gu a ka chɛ pagɔrili, ka gu a ka chɛ paɣ zinalan naŋgbammalisim.
en: They will keep you away from other men's wives, from women with seductive words.

dag: N wumla n yura kukoli. Nyama, o yila zoya zuɣu zɔrina. O zɔrimi duri kunkuna kani n sanna.
en: I hear my lover's voice. He comes running over the mountains, racing across the hills to me.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni lab Ziɔn na nti be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la yɛlimaŋli tiŋa; ka boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zol la, zoli din be kasi.
en: I will return to Jerusalem, my holy city, and live there. It will be known as the faithful city, and the hill of the Lord Almighty will be called the sacred hill.

dag: Niriba maa ni ti nahindi taba, ka sokam ti nahind o kpee; ka bipala ku tiri bɛ kpamba jilima, ka tarimba ku tiri bɛ zuɣulaannim jilima.
en: The people will oppress each other, each one against the other, neighbor against neighbor. The young will bully the old, the rogue, and the respectable.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa be faranim ni mal alibarika; bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, Yawɛ ni sɔŋ ba.
en: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.

dag: Ka Maata saɣi, Iin n Duuma, n niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-nyɛ Masia, Naawuni Bi so bɛ ni daa yɛli ni o ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la.
en: She replied, Yes, Lord, I believe that you are the Christ, Gods Son, the one who is coming into the world.

dag: Ŋunkam maani o kpee ansarisi nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm, amaa yɛndana ŋun kul shinila o noli.
en: Whoever despises their neighbor lacks sense; a sensible person keeps quiet.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli yuŋ la ni, n daa nya so ka o ŋmanila ninsala n-yi zuɣusaa be sagbana ni sirigiri na n-daa ka ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la sanna, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o wuh o.
en: As I continued to watch this night vision of mine, I suddenly saw one like a human being coming with the heavenly clouds. He came to the ancient one and was presented before him.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti ba; ka o suhu daa paligi pam o min o yiŋnim zaa ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda maa zuɣu.
en: Then he took Paul and Silas up into his house and gave them some food to eat. He and his family were filled with joy, because they now believed in God.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan kɔri binyɛra mali alizinnim bɛn ŋmani buhi la, bɛ ni daa saɣim bɛmaŋa shɛb sani la. Dimbɔŋɔ yɛn nyɛla zaligu bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The people of Israel must no longer be unfaithful to the Lord by killing their animals in the fields as sacrifices to the goat demons. The people of Israel must keep this regulation for all time to come.

dag: A yiko puuni, cham ti di nasara; ka taɣi yɛlimaŋli mini din tuhi zali. Chɛ ka a nudirigu tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm.
en: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa sanna nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka gbaai mal o ka o ba.
en: So the followers brought the donkey to Jesus. They put their coats on its back. Then they put Jesus on the donkey.

dag: Dinzuɣu chama, n ni be a nol ni n-wuh a a ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: So go. I will be with you when you speak. I will give you the words to say.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari. A shiri nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari ni kɔbil nini din ŋari.
en: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ! Ka niriba maa zaa daa kpuɣi bɛ nuhi zuɣusaa ka yɛra, Ami! Ami! Di saha ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Ezra said, Praise the Lord , the great God! All the people raised their arms in the air and answered, Amen! Amen! They knelt in worship, with their faces to the ground.

dag: Turi mini yɔhiŋgu ni niriba nahiŋgu yɛla n-kul be bɛ noya ni; ka zilima yɛlibu mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri kul be bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni.
en: They are always cursing, lying, and planning evil things to do.

dag: Malim a tuma shili samban ni, ka tum a pu tuma naai, di nyaaŋa ka a naanyi me a yili.
en: Don't build your house and establish a home until your fields are ready, and you are sure that you can earn a living.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Then Jesus spoke up and said to them, Did you have to come with swords and clubs to capture me, as though I were an outlaw?.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zooi lim zoya maa, ka di ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita ayopɔin zoya maa zuɣu.
en: it went on rising until it was about twenty-five feet above the tops of the mountains.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: to say to the people of Israel, I am the Lord your God.

dag: ka Amɔn nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔsia nyɛ o bia.
en: Amon, and Josiah.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nirilim min o yurilim ni daa ti yi palo ninsalinim san la.
en: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia, Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: He told her that he was the son of her aunt Rebekah, and she ran and told her father about him.

dag: Di bemi kaman Anabi Aizaia ni daa sab shɛm o litaafi ni la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi.
en: This is like the words written in the book of Isaiah the prophet: There is someone shouting in the desert: Prepare the way for the Lord. Make the road straight for him.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa mini ʒii ŋɔ yɛla zaa kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Nathan told David everything that God had revealed to him.

dag: Amaa ka a daa lan pɔbisi a pɔhim, ka teeku kom lim ba, ka bɛ shim ko tiŋa kaman kurigu n-lu kopurim ni la.
en: But you blew on them and covered them with the sea. They sank like lead into the deep sea.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka ti kpɛh o tanti suɣili ni. Ka Yisahaku daa zaŋ Ribɛka n-leeg o paɣa, ka yur o pam, ka di daa chɛ ka o nya suhukpaŋsibo o ma kum la nyaaŋa.
en: Then Isaac brought Rebecca into the tent that his mother Sarah had lived in, and she became his wife. Isaac loved Rebecca, and so he was comforted for the loss of his mother.

dag: O daa kul kahigila dimbɔŋɔ gbinni zaa viɛnyɛliŋga wuhi ba. Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni.
en: He made this very clear to them. So Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Di nyɛla talahi ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim maa mali tarili, ka di chɛ ka Izraɛl zuliya daŋ yini niriba ku kpihim.
en: If they don't have children, one of the Israelite tribes will die out.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be n ni, nyin wuhim ma so shɛli din tuhi, ka nyɛ din ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Make sure that I am not going the wrong way. Lead me on the path that has always been right.

dag: Ka o daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti tim ba niriba ayiyi; ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: He called for the Twelve and sent them out in pairs. He gave them authority over unclean spirits.

dag: Pa doo ka Naawuni daa nam ti paɣa, amaa paɣ ka Naawuni daa nam ti doo.
en: And man was not made for woman. Woman was made for man.

dag: Amaa sabimi Aduna min o bidibisi maa yuya n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi maligumaanitali tuma, ka ninvuɣ zino yi ka bɛ sanna, yin kum o.
en: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; anyone else who tries to do so shall be put to death.

dag: ka Adina daa nyɛ Harim daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Hɛlikai daa nyɛ Mɛrayɔt daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai.

dag: A biha ayi ŋmanila muli zaɣ pola ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi.
en: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle doe.

dag: O daa niŋ lala ni o wuhila Izraɛl ʒiɛmani kam niriba tɔbu tuhibu yɛla, di bahi bamdi bɛ ni shɛb bɛn nini daa na ʒi n-nya tɔbu tuhibu la.
en: They survived only to teach war to the generations of Israelites who had no firsthand knowledge of the earlier wars.

dag: A zo yi ti a dansi di mali daliri, amaa a dim ŋun kul yɛn mɔɣisirila a kpariŋ bushɛm.
en: Trustworthy are the bruises of a friend; excessive are the kisses of an enemy.

dag: Dari yi kani, buɣim ni kpi. Tikub yi kani, zabili ku beni.
en: Without wood, a fire goes out. Without gossip, arguments stop.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Saha yipa paaya ni Daadam Bia nya jilima.
en: Jesus said to them, The time has come for the Son of Man to receive his glory.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim n-daa nyɛ Dauda tɔbutuhiri kpamba, bɛ mini Izraɛlnim zaa n-daa be Dauda kɔbili ni sɔŋd o pam o nam maa ni, ka o nyɛ naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo la.
en: The Lord had promised that David would become king, and so everyone in Israel gave David their support. Certain warriors also helped keep his kingdom strong.

dag: Nanim ni ti be kaman yi banim la, ka bɛ paɣiba bɛn nyɛ nanim be kaman yi manima. Bɛ ni ti damdi ya tiŋa ka lun ya sizuura. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ; ka bɛnkam zaa guhiri n sɔŋsim ku di vi.
en: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord . You won't be disappointed if you trust me.

dag: Bee bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka a nyɛ sana, ka ti deeg a kpɛhi ti yinsi bee ka a chani gbinfini, ka ti ti a situra?.
en: When did we ever see you a stranger and welcome you in our homes, or naked and clothe you?.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. Chɛ ka a suhu doya, a ku kpi.
en: But the Lord said to Gideon, Calm down! Dont be afraid! You will not die.

dag: Pa omaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni Yisa ni ti kpi bɛ zuliya maa zuɣu;.
en: Actually, he did not say this of his own accord; rather, as he was High Priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus was going to die for the Jewish people.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi maa daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia nti gbaag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: But the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah, captured him in the plains near Jericho, and all his soldiers deserted him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa pahi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni.
en: Some groups of Levites that had lived in the territory of Judah were assigned to live with the people of Benjamin.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: The Lord said to him, Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.

dag: Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, dindali maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: But the days will come when the groom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

dag: ka tiwula ata be di zuɣu, ka di ni sa kul piligi puhiri vari ka dii daai pum n-wali wala ka di mooi.
en: with three branches. As soon as it budded, it blossomed, and its grapes became ripe.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa kul tahirimi. Bɛ kul malila suhupiɛlli ka yɔri vuri. Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi pala bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku shɛba, bɛ mi pala bɛn kpi tɔbu ni.
en: This city was so happy, but now there is a terrible uproar. There are bodies lying everywhere, but they were not killed with swords. The people died, but not while fighting.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Ŋunkam nyu kɔbiliga ŋɔ kom, kɔnyuri ni lan gbaag o yaha.
en: Jesus answered, Those who drink this water will get thirsty again.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini karimba ʒirinim kul ni chani tooni n-tumdi din bie nti yaɣi, ka yɔhindi niriba, ka bɛmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti lu yɔhiŋgu ni.
en: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.

dag: Amaa bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa n-nyɛ nir ni ni di shɛli ka ku kpi.
en: But the bread that comes down from heaven is of such a kind that whoever eats it will not die.

dag: Saɣimmiya yi ni yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa buɣa jɛmbu shee zaa, din be zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu ni ti maha gbina ni zaa.
en: You must completely destroy every place where the nations that you are displacing worshipped their gods—whether on high mountains or hills or under leafy green trees.

dag: M puhiri Filolɔgus mini Julia ni Nɛrius min o tizɔpaɣa ni Olimpas ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn zaa be bɛ san la gba.
en: Give greetings to Philologus and Julia, to Nereus and his sister, to Olympas, and to all of Gods people with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu timmi Jɔpa nti boli Saimɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Pita la na. O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku nol la yiŋa.
en: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ma, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.

dag: Ka yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa yihi Jɛrimia ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Nebuzaradan said: Jeremiah, the Lord your God warned your people that he would bring disaster on this land.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa yɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣ yini maa, ka yɛra, Chamiya Ramɔtigiliad ti di nasara. Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ naa nuu ni.
en: The other prophets agreed: Attack Ramoth-gilead and win! The LORD will hand it over to the king.

dag: Mbaye tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, tiŋgbɔŋ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu!.
en: Land, land, land, hear the LORDs word.

dag: Anabinim yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla pɔhim, dama yɛligu maa ka bɛ ni. Lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ ba.
en: The prophets are so much wind; the word isnt in them. Thus and so may it be done to them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Gbuɣinli yi gbaai piɛɣu ku o, ka piɛguliba kul tahiri pampam kabo, o ku zo ka chɛ piɛɣu maa. Lala n-nyɛ li; binshɛli kani din ni chɛ ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ku guli Ziɔn Zoli, ka tuhi fa li.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.

dag: Ŋun Masia maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun daa ʒi ti daalahichi o niŋgbuŋ ni dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ wuntia polo. O fiɛbbu bɔba ni dansi la zuɣu ka yi nyari dɔriti tibi kpaŋ.
en: Christ himself carried our sins in his body to the cross, so that we might die to sin and live for righteousness. It is by his wounds that you have been healed.

dag: Ka niriba daa wum di yɛla ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi Filistianima.
en: The peoples heard, they shook in terror; horror grabbed hold of Philistias inhabitants.

dag: Yisa daa ti be tin shɛl ni, ka kɔŋ ni daa wuligi do so niŋgbuŋ zaa ka o sanna ti damd o tooni balind o yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
