en: Jesus came to a town where there was a man who had leprosy. When the man saw Jesus, he knelt down to the ground in front of Jesus and begged, Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.

dag: di saha ka a chɛ ka zahima varisiri ma, ka chɛ ka ʒiinim nyabu kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm;.
en: But when I lie down, you scare me with dreams; you frighten me with visions.

dag: N Naawuni, n yɛrimi, di zaŋ ma n nyɛvili sunsuuni, nyini ŋun kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni ŋɔ.
en: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!.

dag: Hal yi yi nyaŋ Babilɔn tɔbbi shɛb bɛn tuhiri ya maa zaa, ka di ti kpalimla bɛn nya dansi kɔŋko bɛ suɣa ni gba, bɛ ni yiɣisina ti nyo ya ŋɔ buɣim. .
en: Even if you could defeat their entire army, their wounded survivors would still be able to leave their tents and set Jerusalem on fire.

dag: Juda naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtam bia, ka nyɛ Uzia yaaŋa la ʒiɛman ni ka Aram naa Rɛzin mini Izraɛl naa Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛmalia bia la daa chaŋ ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima, amaa ka daa bi tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: In the days of Ahaz , Arams King Rezin and Israels King Pekah came up to attack Jerusalem, but they couldnt overpower it.

dag: O zaŋdi wahala n-fari bɛn be wahala ni bahira, ka zaŋdi nandahima n-yoori bɛ tiba.
en: But God teaches people through suffering and uses distress to open their eyes.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa ʒe o yim ŋɔ, yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn mir o ŋɔ, paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He made his nation strong, so that all his people praise him— the people of Israel, so dear to him. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka yi ti boori li mihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni mini Alikauli Adaka la zuɣu.
en: Use it to anoint the Tent of my presence, the Covenant Box.

dag: Ka biɛɣuni asiba, wuntaŋ yi sa kul puhi na, yin kamiyana ti liri ba tiŋ maa ni. Gaal min o niriba maa yi sa yina ni yi mini ba zaŋ nya taba, yin niŋmiya ba yi ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then in the morning, at sunrise, rise early and rush on the city. Just as he and the men with him are marching out to face you, you can do to him whatever you wish.

dag: N daa nyɛla nandaamba ba; ka daa zaani saamba nyaaŋa bɛ yɛla ni.
en: I was like a father to the poor and took the side of strangers in trouble.

dag: Ka yi mi yi bi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daalikauli shɛli o ni lɔn ya maa, ka damdi buɣa tooni jɛm li, dindina Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam bahi yi zuɣu, ka yi bahi yoli yomyom tiŋgbɔn sun shɛli o ni zaŋ tin ya ŋɔ ni.
en: If you do not keep the covenant which the Lord your God commanded you to keep and if you serve and worship other gods, then in his anger he will punish you, and soon none of you will be left in this good land that he has given you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya li, ka tɛhi di yɛla, ka lan lihi li, ka deei wuhibu di ni.
en: I looked at this and thought about it. This is what I learned:.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ la shɛŋa din kpalim be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini Juda nayili ni Jɛrusalɛm la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says about the things still left in the Lord s Temple and in the kings palace and in Jerusalem:.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Pa nyini n-yɛn ʒi lahibali maa kuli zuŋɔ, dahin shɛli ka a ni ti ʒi lahibali maa kuli, amaa zuŋɔ dina a ku ʒi lahibali maa kuli, dama nabia maa kpiya.
en: Joab said to him, You arent the one to bring the news today. You can bring news on another day, but not today, because the kings son is dead.

dag: Ka di saha dɛde daa ti paai ka o kahigi li wuhi palɔni o lahibal sun shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni, ka m mol li kaman ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ ni zal li shɛm la.
en: God revealed his message at the appropriate time through preaching, and I was trusted with preaching this message by the command of God our savior.

dag: Samarianim ni ti ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu, dama bɛ zaɣisi bɛ Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi tiŋ chɛrisichɛrisi, ka karigi bɛ paɣipuhinim puya.
en: Samaria must be punished for rebelling against me. Her people will die in war; babies will be dashed to the ground, and pregnant women will be ripped open.

dag: Ka di gari bɛnkam zaa daa wum o baŋsim yɛtɔɣa min o ni daa garigiri ba shɛm maa.
en: Everyone who heard him was amazed by his understanding and his answers.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan lihi nya do so ka o gbib bimbuɣisirigu o nuu ni.
en: Then I looked up and saw a man. In his hand was a measuring line.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ zuliya kam zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni yi wɔbi olivi tiwala din bahindi nyaaŋa ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha bɛ ni yi wɔbi li naai saha shɛli la.
en: At harvest time, people knock olives from the trees. But a few olives are left in the trees. It will be like that in this land and among the nations.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ʒiishee la tooni n-jɛmd o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ o jɛmbu duu puuni maa; ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee mahim kul ni luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: This is the reason they are before Gods throne. They worship him day and night in his temple, and the one seated on the throne will shelter them.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti ni mali tahima shɛli yɛda la kirikiri ka di viini ginda, dama ŋun lo ti alikauli maa nyɛla ŋun kul ʒe yim.
en: We must hold on to the hope we have, never hesitating to tell people about it. We can trust God to do what he promised.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri kul ye ni bɛ niŋ bundaannim zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi zahimbu ni ka jɛritali mini barina kɔre zana din saɣindi daadamnim ka bahiri ba yoli zaa kahikahi la gbahi ba.
en: But people who are trying to get rich fall into temptation. They are trapped by many stupid and harmful passions that plunge people into ruin and destruction.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab maani ti la ansarisi, ka ti dimnim laɣindi lara.
en: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.

dag: ni Matiu mini Tomas ni Jeemsi Alifius bia mini Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called a zealot.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi zani ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛlnim zaa po pɔri n-wuhi ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa shiri po.
en: So Ezra got up. He made the leading priests, the Levites, and all the Israelites promise to do what he said.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbibi n ni daa po pɔ shɛli yi yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ. Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Then I would keep the promise I made to their ancestors that I would give them the rich and fertile land which they now have. I said, Yes, Lord .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ yi ni mali naɣibil so ka di nyɛ alahichi bini maa nyo buɣim wurim li, ka baɣisi li zaa hal ka di ti be kaman zim la, ka n daa zaŋ di zim maa bahi kulibɔn shɛli din kom zɔri yiri zoli zuɣu sirigirina la ni.
en: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.

dag: hal ka n ti paɣi ni bɛ mirisi n nyiŋgol ni ka n kpi n-gari m biɛhigu.
en: So I would rather be choked to death than to live like this.

dag: N ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi, dama ti Naawuni maa galisiya gari wuni kam.
en: This will be a great temple, because our God is greater than all other gods.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, Zallakudura Naa bi be nuhi ni me du shɛl ni kaman anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la ni ti Duuma yɛliya:.
en: But the Most High God does not live in houses built by human hands; as the prophet says.

dag: n-nya malaikanim ayi ka bɛ ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒi Yisa ni daa do luɣ shɛl la: Yino o zuɣu polo, ŋun la mi o naba polo.
en: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.

dag: Yi ninni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim puuni zoli gbini la.
en: The LORD spoke with you face-to-face on the mountain from the very fire itself.

dag: O chɛ ka sokam chɛ o tuma, ni di chɛ ka bɛ tɛhi ŋun Naawuni tuma yɛla.
en: make us stop and think about God's power.

dag: Bɛ ni lu Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo la zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti laɣim di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulimpuhili polo nim nɛma. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnima, ka Ammɔnnim ti jɛmdi ba.
en: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: yumiya yi dimnim gba, ka niŋmiya alibarika niŋdi bɛn turi ya ni, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli; ka suhimiya Naawuni n-tiri bɛn niŋdi ya alaka.
en: But I tell you, love your enemies. Pray for those who treat you badly.

dag: Ka Husham daa ti kpi, ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛdad bia, ka nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi nyaŋ Midiannim Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa di nam zan o zaani, o ya yuli n-daa booni Avit.
en: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.

dag: Ti Naawuni, wumma, bɛ ʒiɛm ti; chɛ ka bɛ daansarisi maa ŋmaligi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔn shɛli kaman bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: But I prayed, Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.

dag: Bɛ ni ti laɣim be vol ni sarika ni, ka o yo ba niŋ di ni zali gu bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: Many people will be gathered together. They have been locked in the Pit. They have been in prison. But finally, after a long time, they will be judged.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun ti bi lo noli dindali maa, bɛn yihim o n niriba ni.
en: Anyone who does not deny themselves on that day will be cut off from their people.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa naɣila jaaŋgbɛhi kɔŋko; di ʒin ya bindira bee adiikunima; yi mi di zaŋya liɣiri niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: and ordered them, Don't take anything with you on the trip except a walking stick—no bread, no beggar's bag, no money in your pockets.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni yino ko m-beni. Lala tuhiya! Hal alizin biɛri gba niŋdi yɛda lala, ka zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Its good that you believe that God is one. Ha! Even the demons believe this, and they tremble with fear.

dag: A mali nuu ka di be kaman Naawuni nuu? A mali kukoli din ŋmani saa tahibu kaman o kukol la?.
en: Are you as strong as I am? Can your voice thunder as loud as mine?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sukɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam din miri tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: From Succoth they traveled to Etham. They camped there at the edge of the desert.

dag: Di saha ka n daa galim Judanim zuɣulaannim la, ka bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tumdi Vuhim Dabisili dali n-tari li daɣiri maa?.
en: I reprimanded the Jewish leaders and told them, Look at the evil you're doing! You're making the Sabbath unholy.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ wuntitali zuɣupil shɛli ti Duuma ŋun mali wuntia n-kariti saria la ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti ma di dabisili la dali n-do n-guli ma, ka di pala n kɔŋko ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ti, amaa o ni ti zaŋ li ti bɛnkam zaa gba suhuri ye o labbuna zuɣu la.
en: Now, a prize is waiting for me—the crown that will show I am right with God. The Lord, the judge who judges rightly, will give it to me on that Day. Yes, he will give it to me and to everyone else who is eagerly looking forward to his coming.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-kahigiri wuhiri Naawuni bihi ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan wuhiri Sintani gba bihi ni nyɛ shɛba: Ŋunkam bi tumdi din tuhi bee n-yur o mabia pala Naawuni bia.
en: This is how Gods children and the devils children are apparent: everyone who doesnt practice righteousness is not from God, including the person who doesnt love a brother or sister.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya kam saria, ka chɛ ka niriba kpi n-yɛrigi bɛ tiŋgbana ni. O ni ti nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa dol o nyaaŋa paana ti kpe siliga maa ni n-nya ka bimpiɛlli maa doya.
en: Behind him came Simon Peter, and he went straight into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying there.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim naŋgban yini ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Gibianima.
en: So all the men of Israel gathered together at the city of Gibeah, united together and in agreement as to what they were doing.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Ɛbɛl kubu zaŋ ti paai Anabi Zakaria kubu saha, bɛ ni daa ku so Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini sara malibu bimbini sunsuuni la, Naawuni shiri ni ti zaŋ di taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba!.
en: from the murder of Abel to the murder of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the Holy Place. Yes, I tell you, the people of this time will be punished for them all!.

dag: Ka Musa daa silim o zuɣu tiŋ yomyom n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped.

dag: Dama nir yi bari zana noombil ninni, yoli ka o bari li maa.
en: It does no good to spread a net when the bird you want to catch is watching.

dag: Jɛfita daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuma ayɔbu. Ka ŋun Jɛfita ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ya Giliad maa.
en: Jephthah was a leader of Israel for six years, before he died and was buried in his hometown Mizpah in Gilead.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa zaɣisi ka yɛl o dan paɣ maa, Nyama, n ni be n dan sani ŋɔ, o baɣa lan ka shɛl ni yil ŋɔ. O zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam niŋla n nuu ni.
en: He refused and said to his masters wife, With me here, my master doesnt pay attention to anything in his household; hes put everything he has under my supervision.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Leeban ni Yaakubu yiɣisiya zo.
en: Three days later, Laban found out that Jacob had gone.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ nimaani chaŋ hal ti du Ɛkurɔn nuzaa polo kuŋkuni. Ka di tariga maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ hal ni Shikɛrɔn n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti baɣisi Baala Zoli gari, ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jabiniil; ka di daa naanyi kana ti paai di tariga teeku ni.
en: The border then went out to the hill north of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, past Mount Baalah, and on to Jamnia. It ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka bɛn daa daŋ puu maa ni la ti kana n-tɛhiri ni bɛn ni deei gari lala; amaa ka o ti yo bɛ gba la tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: So when the men who were the first to be hired came to be paid, they thought they would get more; but they too were given a silver coin each.

dag: Dauda ʒiɛman maa ni kum daa ti lu yuma ata doli taba. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ din tahi li. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Ninsalinim ʒim yihibu taali n-ʒi Naa Sool min o daŋ zuɣu, dama o daa ku Gibiɔnnima.
en: While David was king, there was a famine that continued for three years. So David prayed to the Lord . And the Lord answered, Saul and his family of murderers are the reason for the famine, because he killed the Gibeonites.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Zɛbulɔn zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Zebulun was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa sɔŋ paɣ maa bɔɣi, ka waɣ titali maa ni daa tuhi ko shɛli o nol ni na ka di be kaman mɔɣili kom maa zɔna ti kpe di ni, ka di nyu di zaa.
en: But the earth helped the woman; it opened its mouth and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.

dag: O larila dabiɛm, o bi zɔri dabiɛm, o bi tiriti gbini takɔbi zuɣu.
en: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya gban shɛli ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira.
en: I looked up again, and I saw a flying scroll.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim yi ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku chaŋ ti puhi Suɣa Tibu chuɣu maa, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔr shɛŋa lu zuliya shɛb zuɣu la lu bɛ gba zuɣu.
en: If any of the families in Egypt dont come to celebrate the Festival of Shelters, they will get that terrible disease that the Lord caused the enemy nations to get.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi, dabisi shɛli dali yi ni sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. Kpahimmiya nya din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: Today is the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, the day that the foundation of the Temple has been completed. See what is going to happen from now on.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, M pun bi yɛl a ni Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm ka n yɛn niŋ.
en: I've already told you, Balaam answered. I will say only what the Lord tells me.

dag: Babilɔn daa ŋmanila salima pipia m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o daa chɛ ka dunia zuliya kam nyu o wain buɣi ka di zuɣu chɛ ka zuliya kam kpe yinyari.
en: Babylon was a gold cup in the LORDs hand; it made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine and went mad.

dag: Lala zuɣu yinim paɣiba, deemiya yi yidaannim noya, ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn bi deei Naawuni yɛligu la ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda bɛ paɣiba biɛhigu zuɣu, ka pa ni yi ni yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: In the same way you wives must submit yourselves to your husbands, so that if any of them do not believe God's word, your conduct will win them over to believe. It will not be necessary for you to say a word.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti ni me fɔntinsi kpe n-zaŋ ti bihi niŋ di ni, ka me buzɔna n-zaŋ ti piɛri mini ti buhi niŋ di ni.
en: So they approached him and said, We will build walled enclosures here for our livestock and towns for our children.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ yɛligi kaman o ni daa lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: Now if the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he swore to your ancestors—and he will give you all the land he swore to give to them.

dag: O daa yɛli Asha zuliya mi: Asha bidibisi mali alibarika pam. Chɛ ka bɛ mabihi zaa yuri ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ naba siɣi kpam ni.
en: Moses said this about Asher: Asher is the most blessed of the sons. Let him be the favorite of his brothers. And let him wash his feet in olive oil.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yɛl o bia pakoli Tama, Kulim a ba yiŋ ti ʒini pakolim hal ka m bia Shɛla ti zooi. O daa zɔrimi ni Shɛla gba ti kpi kaman o biɛyanim maa ni daa kpi shɛm maa. Dinzuɣu ka Tama daa kul o ba yiŋ ti ʒiya.
en: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, Go back to your fathers house. Stay there and dont marry until my young son Shelah grows up. Judah was afraid that Shelah would also be killed like his brothers. So Tamar went back to her fathers home.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Maika bidibisi ni, Shamir n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.

dag: Filistianim maa daa ŋari kɔbil shɛŋa o ba Ibrahimma ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka o tumtumdiba gbi la.
en: The Philistines closed up and filled with dirt all of the wells that his fathers servants had dug during his father Abrahams lifetime.

dag: N ni ti vuɣi Ashɛra binwɔɣila la yi sani, ka wurim yi fɔntinsi.
en: I will destroy the Asherah poles and your false gods.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Pool, Di ni bɔŋɔ a tɛhiya ni a ni lɛbigi ma Kristiɛn saha biɛla ŋɔ puuni.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, Are you trying to convince me that, in such a short time, youve made me a Christian.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun na yoli niŋ tuuba; di yi nyɛ lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti niŋ karimbaani duh omaŋa, ka saria karibu di o kaman di ni daa di Sintani shɛm la.
en: An elder must not be a new believer. It might make him too proud of himself. Then he would be condemned for his pride the same as the devil was.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bunnyaŋ min o bia ka bɛ loya ka yi lɔrigi ba na.
en: He said to them, Go to the town you can see there. When you enter it, you will find a donkey with her colt. Untie them both, and bring them to me.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi Midian mini Ɛfa laakum pola na ti niŋ yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni. Ka Shiibanim zaa ʒi salima mini tulaale zim na; ka leei bɛn paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: Herds of camels from Midian and Ephah will cross your land. Long lines of camels will come from Sheba. They will bring gold and incense. People will sing praises to the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu kaman bɛ daŋ kam mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm daa nyɛla tɔbbihi bɔŋbɔŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu, dama bɛ daa mali paɣiba pam ni bidibisi.
en: Their family history shows they had , soldiers ready for war. They had a large family because they had many wives and children.

dag: Adam ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ŋman o m-bol o yuli Sɛt.
en: After Adam was years old, he had another son. This son looked just like Adam. Adam named his son Seth.

dag: Baŋdiba maa ni daa kuli maa ka ti Duuma malaika la ka Yisifu sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ biliɛɣu maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti ʒini nimaani hal ka n ti lan ti a zilinli, dama Naa Hɛrɔd bɔri ni o bola bia maa shee ku o.
en: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa be kozɔrim maa zuɣusaa polo la, Saha yuusim wula puuni ka alahiziba yɛla ŋɔ tariga yɛn paai.
en: The man who was dressed in linen was standing over the water in the river. One of the two men said to him, How long will it be before these amazing things come true.

dag: ni Abidɔn ni Zikiri ni Hanan.
en: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan.

dag: Naɣ kul miriya ka yi ti ŋubila binʒim, dama ʒim nyɛla nyɛvili, ka di bi simdi ni yi ti ŋubi nimdi mini di nyɛvili.
en: But be especially careful not to eat the blood, because the life is in the blood. You must not eat meat that still has its life in it.

dag: Sool bidibisi daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Ishivi ni Malikishua; ka o bipuɣins ayi mi yuya daa booni Mɛrab, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bipuɣin kpɛma, ka biasani mi yuli booni Mikal.
en: Sauls sons were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malki Shua. Sauls older daughter was named Merab. Sauls younger daughter was named Michal.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kliɔpas la bɔh o, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ sana Jɛrusalɛm ŋun na bi wum yɛl shɛŋa din yol niŋ nimaani daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni la.
en: The one named Cleopas replied, Are you the only visitor to Jerusalem who is unaware of the things that have taken place there over the last few days.

dag: N yaa nyɛ dini ka n yɛn guhira? Ka m bahigu lee nyɛ dini ka n ni di suɣilo?.
en: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?.

dag: Ninvuɣ Suŋ ni ŋun lan nyɛ wuntialana ka yi daa zaɣisi maa, ka daa lee chɛ ka Gomna Pailɛt yihila ŋun kuri niriba bahi.
en: Jesus was holy and good, but you said you did not want him. You told Pilate to give you a murderer instead of Jesus.

dag: Pita noli daa na bi lu tiŋa ka sagban piɛlli dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: While he was still speaking, look, a bright cloud overshadowed them. A voice from the cloud said, This is my Son whom I dearly love. I am very pleased with him. Listen to him.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Merarites: Mahli and Mushi. These were the Levite clans by their generations.

dag: Hal Ɛlnatan mini Dɛlaiya ni Gɛmaria ni daa kpam naa jaande ni o di nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim maa zaa yoli, o daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Elnathan, Delaiah, and Gemariah tried to talk King Jehoiakim out of burning the scroll, but he would not listen to them.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli Ziɔn Zoli, amaa niriba ni no n-taai Mɔabnima kaman bɛ ni nɔri mɔri niŋdi kulim bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord will protect Mount Zion, but the people of Moab will be trampled down the way straw is trampled in manure.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka lan nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ piligu, mani n-lan nyɛ bahigu. Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: The LORD, Israels king and redeemer, the LORD of heavenly forces, says: I am the first, and I am the last, and besides me there are no gods.

dag: Naawuni bi zaɣis o ni pun piig o ninvuɣ shɛb la. Yi bi mi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anabi Ilaija ni daa yɛli shɛm n-galim Izraɛlnima Naawuni san la yɛla?.
en: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?.

dag: Ŋunkam bo n-nya yɛm nyɛla ŋun bɔri omaŋa, ka ŋunkam nyɛ tɛhi zilimalana nyɛla ŋun tɔŋda.
en: Do yourself a favor and learn all you can; then remember what you learn and you will prosper.

dag: Bɛ balim ti ni nimmoo ni ti ti ba soli ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nuu kpɛhi Yisa nyaandoliba sɔŋbu ni.
en: But they asked us again and again—they begged us to let them share in this service for Gods people.

dag: ka dabiɛm lan gbaag o pahi zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo. Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa kul nyɛ Sool dima di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: So he became even more afraid of David and was his enemy as long as he lived.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, M min a ku labi, dama a zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu, ka Yawɛ gba zaɣisi ni a ku lan nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: But Samuel said to Saul, I cant return with you because you have rejected what the LORD said, and the LORD has rejected you from being king over Israel.

dag: M pun pirigi n situra, n lan zaŋm li so yaha? M pun paɣi n naba, n lan niŋmi n-chɛ ka di daɣi?.
en: I have already undressed; why should I get dressed again? I have washed my feet; why should I get them dirty again?.

dag: nti yɛl o, Yiɣisima n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma labi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku bia maa kpiya.
en: and said, Get up! Take the child with his mother and go to Israel. Those who were trying to kill the child are now dead.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti zaŋ ti nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deem ti suhigu. Iin, nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka deei ti suhigu, ka a yi deei ti suhigu maa, nyin chɛl ti taali.
en: Hear my prayers and the prayers of your people when they face this place and pray. In your home in heaven hear us and forgive us.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biɛkaali, ka piɛli kaman goli, ka ne kaman wuntaŋa, ka o ni be shɛm ŋmani tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanim chani la?.
en: Who is this, gazing down like the morning star, beautiful as the full moon, radiant as the sun, formidable as those lofty sights?.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya ŋun yɛn su n niriba; ka daa zaŋ bidibbihi n-kɔhi bo pagɔra, ka zaŋ bipuɣinsi mi n-kɔhi nyu wain.
en: They threw lots for my people. They sold boys to buy a prostitute, and they sold girls to buy wine to drink.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim siɣi teeku puuni n-chaŋ du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: he led his people through it; his love is eternal;.

dag: Yɛndan nyɛla ŋun tumdi din tuhi, amaa ka jɛrigu mi nyɛ ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi.
en: The mind of the wise tends toward the right, but the mind of the fool toward the left.

dag: Sida dari n-nyɛ ti yiŋ dapuhi, ka ti yɔɣira nyɛ timaha.
en: The beams of our house are cedar. The rafters are fir.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nyaŋ tin shɛŋa din daa gili Gɛra maa nim zaa, dama Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm. Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ʒe fɔntinsi maa zaa nɛma chaŋ, dama nɛma daa be tinsi maa ni.
en: and attacked all the cities surrounding Gerar who were terrified of the LORD. They plundered all these cities as well because there was a great amount of loot in them.

dag: Di saha yi neesim ni neei kaman biɛkaali neesim la, ka yi nya alaafee yomyom, ka ŋun yɛn zabi yi zuɣu ni be yi tooni; ka Yawɛ jilima ni nyɛ yi gula m-be yi nyaaŋa polo.
en: Then my favor will shine on you like the morning sun, and your wounds will be quickly healed. I will always be with you to save you; my presence will protect you on every side.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini jintɔriba timmiya ti yɛli sapashin kpɛm maa ni o sa zaŋm Pool tahi yi sanna, ka di be kaman yi bɔrimi ni yi vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ti mali shili ni ti ti ku o ka o na bi paai yi sanna.
en: Now then, you and the Council send word to the Roman commander to bring Paul down to you, pretending that you want to get more accurate information about him. But we will be ready to kill him before he ever gets here.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be dunia ni n-nyɛ:.
en: for the people of Israel. You may eat any land animal.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka laɣim niriba maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni.
en: Moses did as the LORD commanded him, and the community assembled at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: ni n ku zaŋ a gali bee a namdili mia bee a ni su binshɛlikam, ka a ti yɛli, Mani n-chɛ ka Ibram leei bundana.
en: that I wouldnt take even a thread or a sandal strap from anything that was yours so that you couldnt say, Im the one who made Abram rich.

dag: Yawɛ nambɔzɔbo min o nirilim galisiya. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The LORD is compassionate and merciful, very patient, and full of faithful love.

dag: Ka Leeban daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-mɔɣis o yaansi min o bipuɣinsi maa kparima, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka lab kuli.
en: Laban got up early in the morning, kissed his sons and daughters, blessed them, and left to go back to his own place.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu ni ka bol o, Bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisima.
en: Taking her hand, Jesus called out, Child, get up.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini yɛm zaa bela o sani, ŋuna n-su ŋun yɔhindi niriba min o ni yɔhindi shɛb zaa.
en: God is strong and always wins. He controls those who fool others and those who are fooled.

dag: Di simdi ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa pahi Izraɛl naa zuɣu ka bɛ mali sara maa.
en: All the people will make this contribution on behalf of the prince in Israel.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma ka teeku na kani, ka kɔbilinina din bilisiri kom pampam gba daa na kani.
en: I was born before the oceans, when there were no springs of water.

dag: Di saha ka Baruk daa karim Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be gbaŋ maa ni maa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni Shafan bia Gɛmaria ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la duu din daa be zuɣusaa polo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu duno palli polo la, ka niriba maa daa wum li.
en: Then Baruch read Jeremiahs words from the scroll to all the people in the LORDs temple; he read them in the chamber of Gemariah, Shaphan the scribes son, in the upper courtyard near the entrance of the New Gate of the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka daa yi Janɔa maa m-mali hal ti paai Atarɔt mini Naara n-zaŋ hal ni Jɛriko n-kul mali lala hal ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: It goes down from Janoah to Ataroth and to Naarah, touches Jericho, and goes to the Jordan.

dag: O ni ti fa yi tumtumdi dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka deei yi naɣ viɛla mini yi bun viɛla zaa ka bɛ tumd o tuma.
en: He will take your male and female servants, along with the best of your cattle and donkeys, and make them do his work.

dag: dama o kanna ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O ni ti doli wuntia soli kari dunianim saria, O ni ti zaŋ yɛlimaŋli soli kari niriba saria.
en: Let them worship the Lord ! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ninkuunsi takɔbi ŋɔ ni; fam ma tinzunnim nuu ni bahi. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. Hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: Save me from these foreigners. They are all liars, even when they swear to tell the truth.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, Yawɛ yɛligu be o ni. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa mini Jɛhɔshafat ni Ɛdom naa daa chaŋ o sani.
en: Jehoshaphat said, The Lord s word is with Elisha. So the king of Israel, Jehoshaphat, and the king of Edom went down to see Elisha.

dag: Machɛle yi zaŋ kurigu she buɣim ni, o zaŋdila o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-kpuɣi zali ŋ-ŋme li hal ti mal li ka di niŋ o ni bɔri li shɛm. O yi tumda, kum mini kɔnyuri gbaar o, ka di wumd o pahi.
en: One worker uses his tools to heat iron over hot coals. Then he uses his hammer to beat the metal to shape it into a statue. He uses his own powerful arms, but when he gets hungry, he loses his strength. If he does not drink water, he becomes weak.

dag: Ka Hasɛnaa bidibisi daa mali me Zahim Dunɔdal la ka zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: The sons of a man named Hassenaah built the Fish Gate. They set the beams in place. They put doors on the building. Then they put the locks and bolts on the doors.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa nya o ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ yɛri ni alizini m-bala, ka kuhi dabiɛm kuhigu.
en: When they saw him walking on the water, it scared them. Its a ghost! they said, screaming in fear.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma, A na ni tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ niriba balibu pam mini zuliya pam ni tinzun yɛligu pam nima ni nanim pam polo.
en: Then some voices said, Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n nya n ni suhiri bɔri shɛli ŋɔ, m bi zaɣisi ka Naawuni ti ma n suhu ni bɔri shɛli ŋɔ.
en: I wish I could have what I ask for. I wish God would give me what I want.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka Yisahaku mi dɔɣi Yaakubu mini Iso. Ka n daa zaŋ Ɛdom zoya zuɣu tiŋgbani ti Iso ni di nyɛ o dini, amaa ka Yaakubu ŋun min o bihi daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti.
en: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Edom as his possession, but your ancestor Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa kul be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni hal ni dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa ti ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I was held in the courtyard of the palace guards until the day Jerusalem was captured.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti kani tin shɛli din yuli booni Kalɛb Ɛfirata la ni nyaaŋa ka o pakoli Abija daa dɔɣi Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa ba la.
en: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla leeŋa, ka nyɛ mahim din taɣiri ba tulim wuntaŋ ni ni sɔɣibu shee ni leeŋa din taɣiri ba pɔhim mini saa.
en: which will be a booth by day for shade from the heat and a hiding place and shelter from a stormy downpour.

dag: Naawuni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli ni bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ. Di daa pala o ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa lo o alikauli maa, amaa o ni daa niŋ yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la zuɣu.
en: When God promised Abraham and his descendants that the world would belong to him, he did so, not because Abraham obeyed the Law, but because he believed and was accepted as righteous by God.

dag: Ka Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be o ko la bemi kaman tihi puu ni suɣili bee puu ni sampaa la; ka be kaman be ni teei gili tin shɛli.
en: Jerusalem alone is left, a city under siege—as defenseless as a guard's hut in a vineyard or a shed in a cucumber field.

dag: Ka bɛn daa kpalim la mi zaŋ daparilana mini ŋariŋ dapaɣ shɛŋa pa kom maa zuɣu n-gba du duli. Ka ti zaa daa duɣi du duli tiligi.
en: the rest were to follow, holding on to the planks or to some broken pieces of the ship. And this was how we all got safely ashore.

dag: Ti daa tɛhiya ni di bemi kaman bɛ bahila noli ni bɛ kum ti la. Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka ti ku zaŋ timaŋa n-dalim timaŋmaŋa, amaa ka ni zaŋ timaŋa n-dalimla Naawuni ŋun neeri kpiimba kum ni la.
en: It certainly seemed to us as if we had gotten the death penalty. This was so that we would have confidence in God, who raises the dead, instead of ourselves.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam tin ya la, yi di ba zalinsi n-zaɣisi ba yɔbu. Wummiya bɛ fabila! Tumtumdiba maa kuhigu chaŋ ti lu ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa tibili ni.
en: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yi daa zaŋ sara mini pina na ti ti ma saha shɛli n ni daa mali ya be mɔɣu ni la?.
en: People of Israel, I did not demand sacrifices and offerings during those forty years that I led you through the desert.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba Bɛɔr bia Balaam sani Pɛtɔr din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli Amawu tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti bol o, ka yɛl o, Ninvuɣ shɛba n-yi Ijipti na, bɛ kul yɛrigila luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka ʒini miri ma.
en: sent a message to Balaam son of Beor who lived among his relatives in the town of Pethor near the Euphrates River. It said: I need your help. A large group of people has come here from Egypt and settled near my territory.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Kunyanambɔzɔbo, dama n ku lan zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ taali hal biɛla gba.
en: Gomer had a second child—this time it was a daughter. The Lord said to Hosea, Name her Unloved, because I will no longer show love to the people of Israel or forgive them.

dag: Ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛli kpamba maa, N daa zaŋla m bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti doo ŋɔ ka o niŋ o paɣa, amaa ka o ti bi lan bɔr o.
en: Her father will say, I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her.

dag: N di mmaŋ shɛhira, ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba di ma shɛhira pahi.
en: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.

dag: ka bi tum so taali, o bi deeri talima, o bi fari niriba, amaa ka naɣ zaŋd o bindirigu dihiri kum ni mali shɛba, ka sooni gbinfini ni mali shɛb la.
en: or oppress anyone or rob anyone. He returns what a borrower gives him as security. He feeds the hungry and gives clothing to the naked.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: Now you want me to go and tell him that you are here!.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa yɛl o dinkam niŋ o mini Haman ni daa yɛli ni o ni yo laɣ shɛli tariga ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ naa kpanjɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ ku Yɛhudianim zaa la yɛla.
en: and Mordecai told him everything that had happened. He also told him how much money Haman had promised to add to the king's treasury, if all the Jews were killed.

dag: Amaa n ni yɛli shɛm maa bi wuhirila chɛfirinim bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma ka nyɛ kɔrɛnim mini ninvuɣ fariba ni buɣijɛmdiba la; di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi naɣ ni yila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.

dag: A nuhi ka a zaŋ me ma, ka lan ŋmaligi kuri ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Your hands fashioned and made me; yet you want to destroy me utterly.

dag: Amaa di lee nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din ŋmani bin chɔɣima la nyɛla din ku tooi kɔŋ niŋgbuŋ ni;.
en: Instead, the parts of the body that people think are the weakest are the most necessary.

dag: Yim ka tiŋgbani daa ti dam pam, dama ti Duuma malaika n-daa yi alizanda ni siɣina nti biligi siliga maa nol ni kuɣili la n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu.
en: Suddenly a strong earthquake struck, and the Lord's angel came down from heaven. He rolled away the stone and sat on it.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni, n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi dilan zuɣu, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: I will oppose the person who consumes blood—whether they are from Israels house or from the immigrants who live with you—and I will cut them off from their people.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa gbi mɔɣili ka niŋ kɔsoli n-vo kom kpɛhi tiŋ puuni na la zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The rest of Hezekiahs deeds and all his powerful acts—how he made the pool and the channel and brought water inside the city—arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ka a saha yi ti paai ni a pah a yaannim zuɣu, n ni piig amaŋmaŋ zuliya ni so ŋun nyɛ amaŋmaŋ bidɔɣiro ka o leei naa.
en: When the time comes for you to die, I will raise up a descendant of yours after you, one of your own sons, to succeed you, and I will establish his kingship.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni di chɛ ka so ku mali noli din ni tooi yɛli shɛli, ka Naawuni ti kari dunianim zaa saria.
en: Now we know that whatever the Law says, it speaks to those who are under the Law, in order to shut every mouth and make it so the whole world has to answer to God.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ zali ŋun ka taali samli bee ka bɛ fiɛbi kpambaliba bɛ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: It is not right to make an innocent person pay a fine; justice is perverted when good people are punished.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ kul birigirila bɛ suhuri ni waawaayili, ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: So I was angry with them. I said, Their hearts always go off course, and they dont know my ways. .

dag: faashee m bo biɛhigu shee ti Yawɛ; biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ dini.
en: until I provide a place for the Lord , a home for the Mighty God of Jacob.

dag: Lala ka Naa Sulemaana daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma zaa naai. Ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ o ba Dauda ni daa pun bo neen shɛŋa din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni duɣuri ni la shɛŋa ti Naawuni la n-kpɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma duri la ni.
en: When all King Solomons work on the LORDs temple was finished, he brought the silver, gold, and all the objects his father David had dedicated and put them in the treasuries of the LORDs temple.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋ kam ni daa laɣimmi mali shili gu ni bɛ mini ŋunkam kana ni o ti liri ba zaŋ nya taba. Ka niriba bɛn daa be luɣ shɛlikam daa zɔri ba ka so ku tooi zani bɛ tooni.
en: The Jews joined together in their towns in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus to defend themselves against those who tried to harm them. No one was able to stand in their way because everyone was afraid of the Jews.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim daa bɔhi Judanim biɛri ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpe taali ni bɛ ni bɔhi ba biɛri maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord God then said, The people of Edom are guilty of taking revenge on Judah.

dag: Bɛ nyuri dam kuuna n-chani tumdi yolimyolim. Bɛ paɣila vidibo gari jilima nyabu.
en: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa mii pam dindali maa, ka naa maa daa ʒiya dalim o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ka o nini kpa Sirianim maa polo. Ka o daŋ maa ʒim daa yi n-zo n-tiɛli chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa puuni zaa. Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun mahili saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: The armies continued to fight while King Ahab was propped up in his chariot. He was leaning against the sides of the chariot, looking out toward the Arameans. His blood ran down onto the floor of the chariot. Later in the evening, he died.

dag: hal a ni kul mi ni n ka taali, ka so kani ŋun ni tooi fa ma a nuu ni bahi maa zaa yoli?.
en: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam, ka a ti ku lan beni. Hal bɛ yi ti bo a shee, bɛ ku lan nya a yaha. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will die a horrible death! People will come looking for your city, but it will never be found. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Nyamiya, m piligimi ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai n tiŋ maa nima, ka wula ka yi ni tooi yi tibidarigibo maa ni? N ku chɛ yi tibili darigibu, dama n lɔrila tɔbu ni n tuhi dunianim zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.

dag: ni ʒiri shɛhira lana ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tuɣindi nir min o yiŋnima.
en: witnesses in court who tell lies, and anyone who causes family members to fight.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi, N ni ti kpila n tiɛɣu ni, ka ni ti chɛ ka n dabisa galisi kaman bihigu la.
en: I thought, Ill die in my nest, multiply days like sand.

dag: Dama n yi lan labi m-me n ni daa pun wurim shɛl la, dindina n leela ŋun tum din chihi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: If I rebuild the very things that I tore down, I show that I myself am breaking the Law.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa zaa daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiniinaayopɔin bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya doli bɛ daŋ ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Their relatives from all of Issachars clans were , mighty warriors, all listed in the family records.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒi gbariti mini bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni ni zoomba ni biriti ni dɔro balibu kam ni mali shɛb pam tahi o sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya o ka baŋ ni o dɔni nimaani yuui maa ka o bɔh o, A bɔri ni a nya alaafee.
en: When Jesus saw him lying there, knowing that he had already been there a long time, he asked him, Do you want to get well.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti lan yi Samuɛl zuɣu Shilo, dama Yawɛ daa kahig omaŋa wuhi Samuɛl Shilo ŋun Yawɛ yɛligu ni. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa gbilisiri tibili wumdi Samuɛl yɛligu.
en: The LORD continued to appear at Shiloh because the LORD revealed himself to Samuel at Shiloh through the LORDs own word.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋ paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani, ka ti ni so ti ku lu nɔzaɣisibo ŋɔ tatabo zuɣu.
en: Let us, then, do our best to receive that rest, so that no one of us will fail as they did because of their lack of faith.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni lɔri ya alikauli shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: N zaŋ n Shia mini n wuhibu tin ya ni di be yi suhuri ni sahakam, ka yi zaŋ li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi ka di be bɛ gba suhuri ni pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And I make a covenant with you: I have given you my power and my teachings to be yours forever, and from now on you are to obey me and teach your children and your descendants to obey me for all time to come.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa deei bɛ ni daa zaŋ salima mali binshɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Moses and Eleazar received the gold, all of which was in the form of ornaments.

dag: A ni ti leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi mini bɛ ni turi so, ka di leei saɣisigu mini dabiɛm zuliya shɛb bɛn gil a la sani saha shɛlikam, ka darigi a tibili pam. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will become an object of ridicule, a mockery, and a horrifying lesson to the nations all around you, when I impose penalties from case laws against you in anger, wrath, and overflowing fury. I, the LORD, have spoken.

dag: O ni yɛn wolig omaŋ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o miri ka o di wain tia binshɛlikam, hal o miri ka o di di biɛlim bee di paɣiri.
en: During that special time of dedication, they must not eat anything that comes from grapes. They must not even eat the seeds or the skins from grapes.

dag: Niriba maa kul bela nimaani kuhira, amaa ka o bi garigi ba, bɛ karimbaani mini bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: Then they cry out; but he doesnt answer, because of the pride of the wicked.

dag: Sool bidibisi daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Ishivi ni Malikishua; ka o bipuɣins ayi mi yuya daa booni Mɛrab, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bipuɣin kpɛma, ka biasani mi yuli booni Mikal.
en: Sauls sons were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua. The names of his two daughters were Merab, the oldest, and Michal, the younger daughter.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa pun yɛli o Kundi ni ni o ni tim anabinim mini tuumba na, ka bɛ ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka niŋ bɛ shɛb mi alaka;.
en: For this reason the Wisdom of God said, I will send them prophets and messengers; they will kill some of them and persecute others.

dag: Wɔribariba mini peentɔriba vuri ni ti chɛ ka fɔŋ kam niriba zo, bɛ ni ti zo n-kpe mɔɣu ni, ka shɛb du tampima. Bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ fɔndi maa zaa, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: As the horsemen and archers approach, the people take flight. They hide in the bushes and escape to the cliffs. Every city is deserted; no one remains.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahaayika saha ka Jɛrɔbɔam bia Zakaria daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la chira ayɔbu.
en: Zechariah, Jeroboams son, became king of Israel in Samaria in the thirty-eighth year of Judahs King Azariah. He ruled for six months.

dag: Di saha ka Zifinim daa chaŋ Sool sani Gibia ti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela ti ya Hɔrɛshi sɔɣisili shee din be Hachila zo shɛli din labiri Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la zuɣu.
en: Some Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah. David is hiding among us in the fortresses at Horesh on the hill of Hachilah, south of Jeshimon, they said.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: For the others put in what they had to spare of their riches; but she, poor as she is, put in all she had—she gave all she had to live on.

dag: Ti suhiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la maŋmaŋ mini ti Duuma Yisa ni bɛ mali soli ti ti ka ti kana ti kaai ya.
en: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali kam, Aduna ni zaŋdi li zaani ka di doli soli Yawɛ tooni kaman lzraɛlnim ʒiɛyimtali, ka di leei alikauli sahakam.
en: Every Sabbath day Aaron will put the bread in order before the Lord . This must be done forever. This agreement with the Israelites will continue forever.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o bia maa, Zom chaŋ ti pihi n ni yɛn to peen shɛŋa ŋɔ na. Bia maa ni daa zɔri chani maa, ka o to piɛm bah o tooni ha.
en: and told him, When I shoot the arrows, you run and find them for me. The boy started running, and Jonathan shot an arrow so that it would go beyond him.

dag: O shɛrila tan piɛla binyɛra kɔhira, ka maani shɛlɔriti kɔhiri kɔhigɔriba zuɣu.
en: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: For everyone who asks will receive, and anyone who seeks will find, and the door will be opened to those who knock.

dag: Dama o daa teeg o daalikauli kasi la min o dabili Ibrahimma yɛla.
en: The Lord remembered his holy promise that he had made to his servant Abraham.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba zaa mini salo zaa daa bi lan ʒe yim hal ti yaɣi. Bɛ daa kul tumdila din chihiri kam kaman zuliya shɛb ni tumdi shɛm, ka ta Yawɛ ni pun mal o jɛmbu du kasi shɛli zali Jɛrusalɛm la daɣiri.
en: All the leaders of the priests and the people also grew increasingly unfaithful, following all the detestable practices of the nations. They polluted the LORDs temple that God had dedicated in Jerusalem.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla naa ni yu shɛli, ka o yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: A king wants to hear the truth and will favor those who speak it.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ tum tuma maa zaa.
en: The Israelites had done all the work just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Di biɛrisuŋ mini di viɛlim ti ku mali kpee! Di kawana ni ti chɛ ka nachimbihi mali kpiɔŋ, ka di wain mi chɛ ka paɣisara ni nyeena.
en: Everything will be good and beautiful! There will be a wonderful crop, but it will not be just the food and wine. It will be all the young men and women!.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o, Lab kuli nti yɛl a yiŋnim a Duuma ni zo a nambɔɣu ka tum tuun kar shɛli ti a ŋɔ yɛla.
en: But Jesus did not allow the man to go. He said, Go home to your family and friends. Tell them about all that the Lord did for you. Tell them how the Lord was good to you.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, di ni ti nyɛla alikauli din ku naai bɛ sani. N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi, ka n ti zaŋ n jɛmbu duu zali bɛ sani sahakam.
en: I will make a covenant of peace for them. It will be their covenant forever. I will grant it to them and allow them to increase. I will set my sanctuary among them forever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kum ka fabili pam, ka lo noli Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni Yawɛ niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu dindali hal ni zaawuni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba maa zuɣu.
en: They cried all day long and would not eat anything. Everyone was sad because Saul, his son Jonathan, and many of the Lord 's people had been killed in the battle.

dag: Bɛn daa zaŋla lɔɣu ni be bindir shɛli ni ti ma ni n di; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka bɛ zaŋ yabiga kom ti ma ni n nyu.
en: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.

dag: Di saha ka Hagai ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ tumo maa daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛligu n-yɛli niriba maa. Yawɛ daa yɛliya, N ni be yi sani.
en: Then Haggai, the Lord s messenger, delivered this message to the people: The Lord says, I am with you.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali ba ni bɛ kul beni sahakam. O zali ba la zaligu, ka di mi ku yiɣisi.
en: by his command they were fixed in their places forever, and they cannot disobey.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋub li ni nya tibidarigibo. Dama o saɣim Yawɛ binshɛli din be kasi, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi lala nir maa o niriba ni.
en: Any who eat it will be guilty of treating as ordinary what is dedicated to me, and they will no longer be considered my people.

dag: A yɛligu nyɛla n naba firila mini n soli neesim.
en: Your word is a lamp to guide me and a light for my path.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili yi sani din wuhiri ni n ni darigi yi tibili kpe ka yi baŋ ni n ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ya la shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: And this will be a sign for you, declares the LORD: I will punish you here so that you know my threats against you will surely be fulfilled.

dag: Niriba yi ti neei kum ni, bɛ bi lan yɛn kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba; bɛ ti kul yɛn bemi kaman malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni la.
en: At the resurrection people wont marry nor will they be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like angels from God.

dag: Yuun pihita puuni gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba anu dali, n daa bela bɛ ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani Kɛba Mɔɣili duli, ka zuɣusaa daa yooi, ka n nya ʒiinim din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, I was with the exiles at the Chebar River when the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ mini bɛ bidibisi n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoli maa fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: and now they guarded the temple gates.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋa m-baŋ Yawɛ, o kandina ka biɛhiŋ kaman biɛɣu neebu ni ka biɛhiŋ shɛm la. O ni ka ti sanna kaman sayuɣiyuɣi ni miri shɛm la. Kaman siɣili saa ni miri mahigiri tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yɛn ka ti sanna.
en: Lets know, lets press on to know the LORD; whose appearing is as certain as the dawn; who will come to us like the showers, like the spring rains that give drink to the earth.

dag: Ka ti mabiyurigu Onɛsimus ŋun ʒe yim ka nyɛ yi ni yino la ni pahi o zuɣu kana. Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya binshɛɣukam zaa din niŋdi kpe ŋɔ yɛla.
en: With him goes Onesimus, that dear and faithful friend, who belongs to your group. They will tell you everything that is happening here.

dag: Miriya daadamnima! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: Be careful! There are people who will arrest you and take you to be judged. They will whip you in their synagogues.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn be n san la puhiri ya.
en: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.

dag: Di tiŋli duu dunoli daa bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka nir ni tooi doli di dunɔdura ti kpe sunsuuni duu la puuni n-yi ni ti kpe du shɛli din pah ata ni.
en: The door to the stairs was at the south side of the temple. Winding stairs went up to the second floor and from there to the third floor.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra daa yɛli Barak, Yiɣisima! Yawɛ m-be a tooni mal a chana. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Yawɛ zaŋ Sisɛra niŋ a nuu ni. Di saha ka Barak daa yiɣisi ka tɔbbihi tuhi pia dol o ka bɛ yi Tabo Zoli zuɣu siɣi.
en: Then Deborah said to Barak, Today the Lord will help you defeat Sisera. Surely you know that the Lord has already cleared the way for you. So Barak led the , men down from Mount Tabor.

dag: ka yɛli, N zaɣim ka m ma daa dɔɣi ma, n zaɣim ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ yi dunia ni. Yawɛ n-daa ti ma, Yawɛ n-lan deei. Yawɛ yuli simdi paɣibu.
en: He said, I was born with nothing, and I will die with nothing. The Lord gave, and now he has taken away. May his name be praised.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli din tuhi, ka niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord .

dag: Amaa alizanda ni Jɛrusalɛm la nyɛla bilichina. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ma.
en: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.

dag: Naa, a daa nya binnan titali. Binnani maa daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka kul nyɛlisira, ka mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋdila yi zuɣu; ka Naawuni daalibarika yi paari niriba pam n-kul pahira, di ni chɛ ka bɛ wumpaɣibo din tibigiri Naawuni gba kul pahira.
en: All this is for your sake; and as God's grace reaches more and more people, they will offer to the glory of God more prayers of thanksgiving.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee paligi pam, ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini n-zo yomyom ni bɛ ti ti o nyaandoliba di lahibali.
en: So the women left the tomb quickly. They were afraid, but they were also very happy. They ran to tell his followers what happened.

dag: Bɛ zaa m-mali dɔriti tibbu pina? Bɛ zaa n-tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni? Bɛ zaa n-kahigiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa gbinni wuhira?.
en: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.

dag: ka boli Lɔt m-bɔh o, Saamba bɛn kpe a yil ŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ la lee be ya? Zaŋm ba na ka ti goli ba.
en: and called to Lot, Where are the men who arrived tonight? Bring them out to us so that we may have sex with them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣili na nti yo bɔɣili maa noli, ka naa maa daa zaŋ o min o kpambaliba dalinli n-dalim kuɣili maa ni di chɛ ka shɛli ku taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: A single stone was brought and placed over the entrance to the pit. The king sealed it with his own ring and with those of his princes so that Daniels situation couldnt be changed.

dag: Ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri yi zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam;.
en: We always remember you when we pray, and we thank God for all of you.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa lan yɛl o ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu chɛ ka o lo ni pa Mɔdɛkai kɔŋko ka o ni ku. Dinzuɣu ka Haman daa bo soli ni o ku Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn nyɛ Mɔdɛkai zuliya m-be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam sulinsi maa ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: But he decided not to kill only Mordecai, for people had told him Mordecais race. Instead, he planned to wipe out all the Jews, Mordecais people, throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus.

dag: Dama lala naan nyɛla zaɣ biɛtitali di naan nyɛla bibiɛlim tuuni.
en: Such wickedness should be punished by death.

dag: Jintɔriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka suli ku ba pam, ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku Yisa tuumba maa.
en: When the council members heard this, they became very angry. They began to plan a way to kill the apostles.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ bidibilim n-tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknima, ka daa fa Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi liriti ba fari bɛ nɛma la nuu ni bahi.
en: He fought heroically and defeated even the people of Amalek. He saved the Israelites from all attacks.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka chɛ ka di leei shɛhira m min a sunsuuni.
en: So I am ready to make an agreement with you, and we will pile up some large rocks here to remind us of the agreement.

dag: O ni wum ka n duhi n yee kuhi pam maa, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: My scream scared him and he ran away, but he left his coat with me.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Kul shini a noli. Zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli, ka dol ti ti leei ti ba ni ti maligumaana. A yi nyɛ ninvuɣ yino maligumaana ni a yi nyɛ Izraɛl daŋ yini maligumaana, dini n-lee so.
en: The five men answered, Be quiet! Dont say a word. Come with us. Be our father and our priest. You must choose. Is it better for you to be a priest for just one man or for a whole tribe of Israelites with many family groups.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Moses replied.

dag: Ka Akishi daa zaŋ Zikilag ti o dindali maa, dinzuɣu ka Juda nanim na kul su Zikilag hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: That day Achish gave David the town of Ziklag. And Ziklag has belonged to the kings of Judah ever since.

dag: Pa palo n-kul do a tooni ŋɔ? Woligim ka chɛ ma. A yi zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo, n ni zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo; ka a yi zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo, m mi ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo.
en: Isnt the whole land in front of you? Lets separate. If you go north, I will go south; and if you go south, I will go north.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔhi bɛ ni su shɛlikam zaa m-pirigipirigi ti taba kaman di ni daa simdi ni sokam deei shɛm tariga.
en: They sold their land and the things they owned. Then they divided the money and gave it to those who needed it.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ gari ma pam! Yi bi mi doo maa ni yi shɛl na, amaa o neegi n nina.
en: The man answered, This is really strange! You dont know where he comes from, but he healed my eyes.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o ka o yɛli, Kpe nyɛla dabiɛm zɔbu shee! Kpe nyɛla Naawuni yiŋa. Alizanda dunoli m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He was afraid and said, What a terrifying place this is! It must be the house of God; it must be the gate that opens into heaven.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa tum din bie, dama o daa bi zaŋ o suhu zaa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu ni.
en: Rehoboam did evil because he didnt decide in his heart to obey the Lord .

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli naa maa ni biɛhiŋ kani, o ni kpaŋ; amaa Yawɛ lee kahigi wuhi ma ni o ni bahi kpi.
en: Then Elisha said to Hazael, Go and tell Ben-Hadad, You will live. But really the Lord told me, He will die.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka bɔh o nyaandoliba maa, Bɔzuɣu ka yi karimba maa mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira.
en: But when the Pharisees saw this, they said to his disciples, Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka yi neesim maa ne sokam zaa sani, ka bɛ nyari yi tuun suma ka tiri yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: Make your light shine, so others will see the good you do and will praise your Father in heaven.

dag: Muɣisigu yi ti paai ba ka bɛ kuhira, Naawuni ni sɔŋ ba?.
en: When they have troubles and cry out for help, God will not listen to them!.

dag: zaɣ yino ku paai n ni daa po ni n ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: So none of you will ever enter and live in the land that I promised to give you. Only Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun will enter that land.

dag: Dahin shɛli, kaman kurig ata saha ka o nini daa ti nya Naawuni malaika ʒii ka o kpɛr o sanna ka bol o, Kɔniilius.
en: One day at nearly three oclock in the afternoon, he clearly saw an angel from God in a vision. The angel came to him and said, Cornelius.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba zɔrimi sɔɣira, amaa bɛ yi ti lan kani, wuntizɔriba zoorimi pahi.
en: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ jɛritali, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma leei zana bari ni bɛ gbahi bɛn na yoli yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be biriginsim puuni kalinli ni la.
en: They make proud and stupid statements, and use immoral bodily lusts to trap those who are just beginning to escape from among people who live in error.

dag: dama m bi sɔɣi ya yɛl shɛli; n kahigi Naawuni yɛlli kam wuhi ya.
en: I have told you everything God wants you to know.

dag: ŋun daa be yi tooni mali ya be soli chana ni o ti bo palo tin ya ka yi ti yi suɣa dɔni la yɛda. O daa bela buɣim ni yuŋ, ka be sagban ni wuntaŋ ni ni o wuhi ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: even though he went ahead of you, scouting places where you should camp, in fire by night, so you could see the road you were taking, and in cloud during the daytime.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka o ma min o ni daa yuri nyaandol so la ʒe nimaani maa, ka o yɛl o ma, N-nyɛ a bia.
en: Jesus saw his mother. He also saw the follower he loved very much standing there. He said to his mother, Dear woman, here is your son.

dag: dindina yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yin baŋmiya ni Yisa Masia Nazarɛt ninvuɣ so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ka Naawuni neeg o kum ni la yuli zuɣu ka do so ŋun yi nyɛ gbarigu ŋɔ ti ʒe yi sani ni alaafee ŋɔ.
en: then you should all know, and all the people of Israel should know, that this man stands here before you completely well through the power of the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth—whom you crucified and whom God raised from death.

dag: Wumma, n ni wuh a n ni yɛli n ni nya shɛli.
en: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn.

dag: Ti Duuma, wuna puuni, wun so kani m-be ka nyini, ka tuun shɛli mi kani ŋ-ŋman a tuma.
en: There is no god like you, O Lord, not one has done what you have done.

dag: O ni ti nyu wain ka o nina mɔhi; ka nyu bihim ka o nyina paligi.
en: His eyes are bloodshot from drinking wine, His teeth white from drinking milk.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ nabia alali, ka di zuɣulaannim diri di ni simdi ni bɛ diri saha shɛli ni bɛ nya kpiɔŋ ka pa ni bɛ nyu m-buɣi, di tiŋgbɔŋ maa mal alibarika.
en: But it is very good for a country if the king comes from a good family. And it is very good for a country if the rulers control their eating and drinking. They eat and drink to become strong, not to become drunk.

dag: O daa yila Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-chani bɔri luɣ shɛli ni o ʒini. Ka o daa chaŋchaŋ ti kana ti kpɛla Maika ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu maa yiŋa.
en: He left Bethlehem to look for another place to live. As he was traveling, he came to Micahs house in the hill country of the land of Ephraim.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Niriba maa ku tooi du Sinai Zoli ŋɔ na, dama nyin maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ti ni m beemi chɛriga gil li, ka mal li ka di be kasi.
en: Moses said to the Lord , The people cannot come up, because you commanded us to consider the mountain sacred and to mark a boundary around it.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Judanim mali kpiɔŋ; ka fa Izraɛlnim mi bahi. N ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ba labisi yiŋ na. Bɛ ni be kaman n na ʒi n-zaɣisi ba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka ni wum bɛ suhigu.
en: I will strengthen the house of Judah and deliver the house of Joseph. I will bring them back because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I hadnt rejected them, for I am the LORD their God; I will respond to them.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu! Yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani la kul chanimi gindi ŋumdi kaman gbuɣinli la m-bɔri ni o gbaai so ŋubi.
en: Be clearheaded. Keep alert. Your accuser, the devil, is on the prowl like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

dag: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma maa ni zaŋdi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi chani Sharɔn bɔpiɛligu ni mini Akɔr Vinvamli ni ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: Then Sharon Valley will be a field for sheep. The Valley of Achor will be a place for cattle to rest. All this will be for my people—for the people who come to me for help.

dag: Ka Keen daa yi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti be tiŋgban shɛli din be Idɛn puu la wulimpuhili polo, ka di yuli booni Nɔd la.
en: Cain went away from the Lord and lived in the land of Nod.

dag: Dama nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuhi mani a dabili ŋɔ ka yɛli, N ni me a yili ti a, dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a suhigu ŋɔ.
en: You, Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, have shown things to me. You said, I will make your family great. That is why I, your servant, decided to pray this prayer to you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli mini laasabuniŋdiba zaa ni ti di vi, ka tabi bɛ noya, dama Naawuni ti ku garigi ba.
en: Those seeing visions will be ashamed, and the diviners disgraced; they will all cover their upper lips, for there will be no answer from God.

dag: Dama o daa yɛl o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shih o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She said to herself, If only I touch his cloak, I will get well.

dag: Maligumaanitali tuma yi taɣi, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni zaligu gba taɣi.
en: For when the priesthood is changed, there also has to be a change in the law.

dag: Ka yi yi ti duɣi li ŋubi luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii maa n-yi biɛɣu asiba, yin labimiya yi suɣa ni.
en: You must cook the meal and eat it at the place the Lord your God will choose. The next morning you may go back home.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Di lan yɛli yaha, Tumtumda kam simdi yɔri.
en: As the Scriptures say, When a work animal is being used to separate grain, dont keep it from eating the grain. And the Scriptures also say, A worker should be given his pay.

dag: Aai! Hal ninsalinim zaa yi nyɛ ʒirinima, Naawuni ŋun kul nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm la: Nyin Naawuni ku mali galimi a yɛtɔɣa ni, ka so mi ku ŋme a naŋgbankpeeni a saria karibu ni.
en: No, even if everyone else is a liar, God will always do what he says. As the Scriptures say about him, You will be proved right in what you say, and you will win when people accuse you. Psalm :.

dag: Tinsi ŋɔ zaa wuna maa puuni wun ŋuni n-na tooi fa bɛ tinsi maa shɛli n nuu ni bahi, ka Yawɛ ti yɛn fa Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahi? .
en: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord , your God, can do any better?.

dag: O ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naai, o daa zaŋ ma mi doli duno shɛli din be wulimpuhili polo la yi nti buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa palo zaa gili.
en: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.

dag: Yi mi dɔɣimiya bihi pam, ka bɛ nabi pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Have many children and fill the earth with your people.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum o ni wuhi shihir shɛli maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli maa.
en: Thats why the crowd came to meet him, because they had heard about this miraculous sign that he had done.

dag: Bɛ nyarila tibiginsim saha biɛla, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ ni suui lu n-kuui kaman vari la; ka bɛ ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri kaman ka zuɣuri la.
en: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chaŋ Samuɛl sani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni nti yɛl o, Wuhim ma ŋun nyari niriba yɛla la yiŋa.
en: Saul approached Samuel in the city gate and said, Please tell me where the seers house is.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: the LORD said to me.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni dunɔguliba ni yiliyiiniba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa kuli ti ʒini bɛ fɔndi ni. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni daa ti zani, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa pun ʒini bɛ tinsi ni.
en: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel settled in their towns.

dag: Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, amaa ka daari ninvuɣ biɛri luhira.
en: He raises the humble, but crushes the wicked to the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi biɛɣu zuɣu, dama biɛɣu gba jiɣindila dimaŋ zuɣu. Dabisili kam wahala saɣiri li mi.
en: Therefore, stop worrying about tomorrow, because tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri din nyɛ salima bee anzinfa, hal di zaŋya kɔbo gba n-niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: Workers deserve to be fed, so dont gather gold or silver or copper coins for your money belts to take on your trips.

dag: A bahiri ʒiŋmariba yoli, nyin Yawɛ je ninvuɣ kuriba mini ninvuɣ yɔhindiba.
en: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.

dag: Ka tɔb daa ti lan lu Izraɛlnim maa mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɔb yaha, ka Jaariɔrigim ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la bia Ɛlhanan gba daa lan ku Goliat ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nira ka o kpani dɔɣu daa be kaman kpalua dapua la.
en: There was still another battle with the Philistines at Gob. A soldier named Elhanan killed Goliath from Gath, whose spear shaft was like a weaver's beam. Elhanan's father was Jari from Bethlehem.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba maa mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋa ni bɛ kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: So the priests and the Levites made themselves holy to bring up the chest of the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Bɛ yɛri binyɛri shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ pa talima n-dooni bimbini kam gbini, ka nyuri wain shɛli bɛ ni deei bɛ sandiriba sani bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: They stretch out beside every altar on garments taken in loan; in the house of their god they drink wine bought with fines they imposed.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima gabis ayi maa noya gɔhi salima bintaɣindisi la, ka di be o binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la tooni.
en: Fasten the other two ends of the cords to the two settings, and in this way attach them in front to the shoulder straps of the ephod.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti ŋmaligi bɔhi yimaŋa, Ka ŋuni n-lee dɔɣi bihi ŋɔ zaa ti ti? N daa kɔŋ m bihi. Bɛ daa zaŋ ma kulila tinzun tiŋa, ka ŋuni n-lee wumsi bihi ŋɔ zaa? N daa kpalimla n ko, ka ya ka bihi ŋɔ zaa lee yina? .
en: Then you will say to yourself, Who bore all these children for me? I lost my children and could have no more. I was exiled and driven away— who brought these children up? I was left all alone— where did these children come from.

dag: Ka Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ni ti yihi gili dunia ŋɔ zaa n-lee shɛhira zuliya kam sani pɔi ka dunia yiɣisibu saha naanyi paai.
en: When the good news about the kingdom has been preached all over the world and told to all nations, the end will come.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ, ka o wum ti kuhigu maa ka daa tim o malaika na ka o ti yihi ti Ijipti maa na, ka ti kana ti be Kadɛshi tin shɛli din miri a tintariga la.
en: But we asked the Lord for help, and he heard us and sent an angel to help us. The Lord has brought us out of Egypt. Now we are here at Kadesh, where your land begins.

dag: O gurim ma ʒili, ka di leei shɛhira jɛndi ma; ka n kɔɣisibu nyɛ din di shɛhira jɛndi ma.
en: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.

dag: Zaawuni sara maligu maa saha ka n daa yiɣisi n nolɔbo maa puuni ni m binyɛr tɔhima la. Ka n daa gbani n-teei n nuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms.

dag: Ka Shitirai ŋun daa nyɛ Sharɔn nir la daa lihiri naɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sharɔn ka Shafat ŋun daa nyɛ Adilai bia la daa lihiri naɣ shɛb bɛn be vinvamli ni.
en: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.

dag: ka daa ʒini pakolim ni mi hal ka o yuma ti paai pihiniinaanahi. O daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam jɛmdi Naawuni ni nolɔbo mini wunsuhigu.
en: She was now an -year-old widow. She never left the temple area but worshipped God with fasting and prayer night and day.

dag: Miri ka a niŋ ninvuɣ biɛɣu, a mi di nyɛ jɛrigu. Di niŋ lala n-kpi ka a saha na bi paai.
en: But don't be too wicked or too foolish, either—why die before you have to?.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Taitus polo, o nyɛla n tumtumdikpee ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tumdi ni ti sɔŋ ya; ka zaŋ chaŋ ti mabihi la mi polo, bɛ nyɛla cheechi tuumba Masia jilima nyabu zuɣu.
en: If there is any question about Titus, he is my partner and coworker among you. If there is any question about our brothers, they are the churches apostles and an honor to Christ.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi tihi yɛla. Sida tihi din be Lɛbanɔn zaŋ tabili taaŋkɔro tuturi din bili tam goma zuɣu yɛla; ka daa lan tɔɣisi biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi ni nyɛbisi ni zahim gba yɛla.
en: He could talk about all kinds of plants, from large trees to small bushes, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa tim Shilo nti zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daalikauli Adaka maa na. O nam ʒiishee daa bela chɛrubinim sunsuuni. Ka Ɛli bihi ayi Hofini mini Finɛhas daa doli Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: The army sent some soldiers to bring back the sacred chest from Shiloh, because the Lord All-Powerful has his throne on the winged creatures on top of the chest. As Eli's two sons, Hophni and Phinehas.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa kaɣil o hal ka di ti niŋ o vi, ka o bahi ba noli ni bɛ timma. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim ninvuɣ pihinu ka bɛ chaŋ ti lihi bɔ o dabisi muna ata zaa ka bi nya o.
en: But they insisted until he gave in and let them go. The fifty of them went and looked high and low for Elijah for three days, but didn't find him.

dag: Amaa ka o tumtumda maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili be tiŋ ŋɔ ni ka bɛ tir o jilima pam. O yɛligu bi yiɣisira. Chɛ ka ti chaŋ o sani, di pa shɛli o ni tooi wuhi ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: The servant answered, Wait! In this town there is a holy man who is highly respected because everything he says comes true. Let's go to him, and maybe he can tell us where we can find the donkeys.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhiya bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni tiligi ba; ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, amaa ka o bi garigi ba.
en: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ bɔh o shɛm ka bɔhi ba, N ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma maa gbinni ka yi bɔhiri taba ni yi baŋ maa?.
en: Jesus knew they wanted to ask him, so he said, Are you trying to find out from each other what I meant when I said, Soon you wont see me, and soon after that you will see me?.

dag: Zuliya shɛb tiŋgbana n yaannim ni daa tuhi nyaŋ la buɣa daa tooi fa ba bahi? Di tiŋgbana maa n-nyɛ: Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ni Ɛdin niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa la.
en: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers—Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, or the people of Eden in Telassar—save them?.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir daa ka Izraɛl naa sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Sirianim ni yɛli ni man Yawɛ nyɛla zoya zuɣu Naawuni ka pa vinvama ni Naawuni la zuɣu, n ni chɛ ka yi nyaŋ tɔbbi gbaliŋ maa zaa, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: The prophet went to Ahab and said, The Syrians think the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys. So he has promised to help you defeat their powerful army. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; dama Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni. Amaa ka Ilaisha gba lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli chana.
en: Then Elijah said to Elisha, Now stay here; the Lord has ordered me to go to the Jordan River. But Elisha answered, I swear by my loyalty to the living Lord and to you that I will not leave you. So they went on.

dag: ni binyɛr shɛŋa din she n-viɛla, din nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaani la binyɛr kasi la min o bidibisi la binyɛr shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: the magnificent priestly garments for Aaron and his sons to use when they serve as priests.
