dag: Ka ŋun su o maa yi daa bo paɣ ti o, ka paɣ maa dɔɣi bihi, di saha paɣ maa min o bihi maa bɛn ni kpalim o dana maa sani, ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko chaŋ.
en: If his master gave him a wife and she bore him sons or daughters, the woman and her children belong to the master, and the man is to leave by himself.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o kpambaliba ni o bidibisi ni o naazɔnim daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn naa. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa gbaai Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun Babilɔn naa maa nam dibu yuma anii saha kuli Babilɔn.
en: Jehoiachin immediately surrendered, together with his mother and his servants, as well as his army officers and officials. Then Nebuchadnezzar had Jehoiachin arrested. These things took place in the eighth year of Nebuchadnezzar's rule in Babylonia.

dag: N nuu kul ni pa o zuɣu sahakam; n nuu ni chɛ ka o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.

dag: ka yi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Yi yi zaŋ li ti ti maligumaana, o mi ni zaŋ li chaŋ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.

dag: O ni ti zani n-dih o biŋkɔbbaligu Yawɛ yiko ni, ka ni ti zani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima ni. Ka bɛ ti be ni alaafee, dama pumpɔŋɔ o ni nyɛla ninvuɣ titali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba maa yɛl o, A suhu ni yi yuri binshɛŋa la zaa zoya ka chɛ a, ka a buni min a bin suma zaa zo ka chɛ a, ka a ku lan nya li yaha.
en: The merchants say to her, All the good things you longed to own have disappeared, and all your wealth and glamor are gone, and you will never find them again.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya kam ni dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa nimaani, yi mini yi yaannim ni daa pun bi mi buɣ shɛŋa.
en: The Lord will scatter you among all the people in the world. He will scatter you from one end of the earth to the other. There you will serve false gods made of wood and stone. They are false gods that you or your ancestors never worshiped.

dag: Chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zali di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒi luɣ shɛŋa mini bɛ yaannim dunoya tuutanim ni sa luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suɣa maa noya kpa laɣiŋgu suɣili maa luɣilikam polo.
en: The Israelites should make their camps around the Meeting Tent. Each division will have its own special flag, and everyone will camp near their groups flag.

dag: Ka di daantalisi anahi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa anahi zuɣu daa nyɛ daanya, ka di bansi daa nyɛ anzinfa, ka o daa niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni, ka di mihi gba daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: It was supported by four posts in four bronze bases. Their hooks, the covering of their tops, and their rods were made of silver.

dag: Judanim naa Jɔtam mini Izraɛl naa Jɛrɔbɔam ʒiɛmana ni ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba ŋɔ yuya maa sɔŋ.
en: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.

dag: Amaa n kul ni mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, n ni yili yila paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But I will rejoice always; I will sing praises to Jacobs God!.

dag: Nir suhu yi bɔri binshɛli ka o ka yɛm, di bi viɛla, ka nir ŋun chani yomyom ti yaɣi bahirila soli.
en: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.

dag: Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama tɔb maa daa nyɛla Naawuni ni bɔr shɛli. Ka bɛ daa ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni hal ti paai saha shɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la.
en: Many died, because God fought the battle. They lived there in place of the inhabitants until the exile.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ yɛligi kaman o ni daa lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛm la.
en: When the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he told your ancestors he would, and gives you all the land he has promised.

dag: Ka bɔ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛn niŋ? Niriba yi niŋdi lala ni tɛhi biɛri bee tɛhi suma, Masia yɛla molo kul bahi mooni ginda, ka m mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu. Iin, n shiri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: What do I think about this? Just this: since Christ is proclaimed in every possible way, whether from dishonest or true motives, Im glad and Ill continue to be glad.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ a hal ni n nyɛvili tariga. N ni kpuɣi n nuhi zuɣusaa m-paɣ a yuli.
en: As long as I live, I will pray to you.

dag: Gaad zuliya niriba ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn su tɔbbihi fukumsi; bɛ ni ŋun daa pɔri mini tɔbbihi kɔbiga daa saɣimi, ka ŋun daa gari bɛ zaa mi mini tɔbbihi tuhili daa saɣi.
en: These Gadites were military officers, the least of them ready to fight a hundred and the greatest a thousand.

dag: amaa kom daa puhiri yirila tiŋ na m-mahigiri tiŋgbani zaa.
en: So water came up from the earth and spread over the ground.

dag: Piim Lɛvinim Izraɛlnim puuni m-mali ba kasi.
en: The Levites must be acceptable to me before they begin working at the sacred tent. So separate them from the rest of the Israelites.

dag: Sool ba n-daa nyɛ Kish, ka Abinɛr ba Nɛr mi daa nyɛ Abiɛl bia.
en: Sauls father Kish and Abners father Ner were sons of Abiel.

dag: Ka neesim maa nyaɣisibu zuɣu daa chɛ ka m bi lan ne, ka bɛ daa gbaala n nuu ni n-vo ma tahi Damaskus.
en: The light had been so bright that I couldn't see. And the others had to lead me by the hand to Damascus.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim ni zɔri Juda tiŋgbɔŋnima, ka bɛ yi ti boli Juda yuli bɛ ni so sani, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni lɔri nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo zuɣu.
en: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt.

dag: O tiri bɛnkam zaa zɔr o bɛ ni bɔri shɛli. O lan deeri bɛn suhir o suhigu ka tiligiri ba.
en: He listens to his followers and does what they want. He answers their prayers and saves them.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la mini Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt la tɔbbihi daa yi Mahanaim chaŋ Gibiɔn.
en: One day, Abner and the soldiers of Ishbosheth left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.

dag: Pahatimɔab daŋ ni: Adina mini Kɛlal ni Bɛnaaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Matania so yaha ni Bɛzalɛl ni Binnui ni Manaasa.
en: Of the family of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni zuɣu ka ti be kum barina ni asiba hal nti paai yuŋ; bɛ lihi ti mi kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: As the scripture says, For your sake we are in danger of death at all times; we are treated like sheep that are going to be slaughtered.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Wummiya pukpar bimbira ŋahili la gbinni:.
en: Now listen to the meaning of the story about the farmer:.

dag: nti tim nimdi maa ni be ʒɛduɣ shɛli ni maa n-kuhi nimdi maa, ka nim shɛli din doli dirigu maa yina, maligumaana maa n-su li. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋdi Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa yi chani Shilo nti maani sara.
en: and use it to get some meat out of the pot or kettle. The priest is supposed to take whatever his helper removes from the pot with the special fork. This is what the priests should have done for the Israelites who came to offer sacrifices at Shiloh.

dag: suhir a n ni leei bi so ba sarika ŋɔ ni la zuɣu. Bia maa n-nyɛ Onɛsimus.
en: So I make a request to you on behalf of Onesimus, who is my own son in Christ; for while in prison I have become his spiritual father.

dag: Ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: If someone is in the field, they must not go back to get a coat.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai bɛ ba Yaakubu sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ daa yɛl o la dinkam zaa niŋ ba, ka lan yɛl o.
en: The brothers went back to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan. They told him about everything that had happened.

dag: Bɛ nina ni lihibu di ba shɛhira; bɛ tum alahichi palɔni ka bi sɔɣiri li kaman Sɔdomnima. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Dama bɛ bo yɛl biɛɣu ti bɛmaŋa.
en: The look on their faces shows that they are guilty. They are like the people of Sodom; they dont care who sees their sin. But it will be very bad for them. They will get what they deserve.

dag: Ka Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, o mi daa bi yihi so nuu. Ka bɛ daa va Baasha ni daa mali kuɣ shɛŋa mini da shɛŋa mɛri Rama maa na, ka ŋun Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li me Gɛba din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la mini Mizipa.
en: King Asa issued an order to every Judean without exception: all the people carried away the stone and timber that Baasha was using to build Ramah, and King Asa used it to build Geba of Benjamin and Mizpah.

dag: M birimmi zaa n dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛli zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɔri vu shɛli zuɣu. Dama bɛ niŋ ma muɣisigu pam, ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka je n yɛlli.
en: I am terrified by the threats of my enemies, crushed by the oppression of the wicked. They bring trouble on me; they are angry with me and hate me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Yawɛ yiko malila tariga? To, a ni nya n yɛligu maa ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli yi sani bee di ku niŋ.
en: But the Lord said to Moses, Dont limit my power! You will see that I can do what I say I can do.

dag: Hal lari puuni suhugarigu beni, ka suhupiɛlli bahigu mi nyɛ suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: The heart feels pain even in laughter, and in the end, joy turns to sorrow.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paɣi bɛ binyɛra ni bɛ ti mali soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ di nyɛvili tia la wala, ka doli tiŋ la dunoya kpe di ni la mal alibarika.
en: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila dakol pala ni.
en: You always put new wine into new wineskins.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima ka wolindi dira, di so ni a wuhi ni a nyɛla wɔɣirili ka kum kur a.
en: Better to be held in low regard and have a servant than to be conceited and lack food.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N ni du abie tia maa, n-gbaai di wula gbibi. N suhigu nyɛla a biha kul be kaman wain wala yila la, ka a vuhim ʒiɛɣu ŋmani apil nyom.
en: I will climb the palm tree and pick its fruit. To me your breasts are like bunches of grapes, your breath like the fragrance of apples.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisibu? Gbilisim tibili ka ti gba tɔɣisi.
en: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.

dag: ka mali binyila tam di tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka yi ti niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: Make horns for the altar and attach them to it, one horn on each of its four corners. Cover it with copper.

dag: Manaasa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asiriɛl, o mam ŋun daa nyɛ Aram paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so, ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la.
en: These are Manassehs descendants: Manassehs Aramean slave woman had a son named Asriel. She also bore Makir, the father of Gilead.

dag: Gbihim biɛla, dɔnim biɛla, zaŋm a nuhi taɣili taba vuhi biɛla.
en: a little sleep, a little rest, folding your arms, and taking a nap—.

dag: Amaa ka Onan daa mi ni o bi yɛn su bihi maa. Dinzuɣu o min o biɛli pakoli maa daa yi ti dɔni, o daa yihirila o kom bahi tiŋa ni di chɛ ka o ku dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: But Onan knew that the children would not belong to him, so when he had intercourse with his brother's widow, he let the semen spill on the ground, so that there would be no children for his brother.

dag: Sulemaana yiŋ dahin yini mɔni daa yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro zim viɛlli lita tusaanu zim maŋli lita tuhi pia.
en: Every day, Solomon needed , liters of fine flour, , liters of coarsely-ground flour.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Shɛkɛmnim daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ti do mɔɣu ni, ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: The next day the people of Shechem went out to the fields to work. Abimelech found out about it.

dag: Ka Aduna ti nyɔr li zaani Alikauli Adaka la gbini Yawɛ tooni pateesa la nyaaŋa jɛmbu suɣili maa puuni zaawuni hal ni asiba sahakam. Di ni ti nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Aaron will tend the lamp, which will be inside the meeting tent but outside the inner curtain of the covenant document, from evening until morning before the LORD. This is a permanent rule throughout your future generations.

dag: Amaa n kul ni mali suhupiɛlli sahakam, n ni yili yila paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ nabia Jɔash n-yina ti booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam; ka zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o; ka zaŋ Naawuni kundi ti o; ka bɛ kpahi bɛ nuhi ka yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: These men brought out Joash. They put the crown on him and gave him a copy of the agreement. Then they anointed him and made him the new king. They clapped their hands and shouted, Long live the king.

dag: Di chɛ ka shɛli yɛla niŋ a nandahima bee n-chɛ ka shɛli ti a biɛrim a niŋgbuna ni. Dama bipolitali mini biɛhigu piligu nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Don't let anything worry you or cause you pain. You aren't going to be young very long.

dag: Ŋuna n-dihiri nabihi vi, ka lɔrigiri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ shɛlɔriti.
en: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛl taba, Ti ku nya ti ni yɛn zaŋ yɛl shɛli fiɣisi Daniɛl, naɣila zaŋ chaŋ o Naawuni jɛma la polo.
en: Finally, they said to one another, We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.

dag: A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa pam. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ filim a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisi shɛŋa la ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father placed heavy burdens on us. If you make these burdens lighter and make life easier for us, we will be your loyal subjects.

dag: N ni guhi Yawɛ ŋun lɛb o nyaaŋa biri Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, ka niŋ o naani.
en: The Lord has turned away from the family of Jacob. But I will wait for him. I trust that he will come to save us.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nyini ŋun yuri niriba ŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi zaa daa bela a nuu ni, bɛ daa dolila a naba, ka deer a noli.
en: Yes, those who love the nations— all his holy ones—were at your command; they followed your footsteps; they got moving when you said so.

dag: N nya Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti sokam ni o tum.
en: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.

dag: ni Ɛdom ni Mɔab ni Ammɔnnim.
en: Edom, Moab, and the Ammonites.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣisi mir o ba Yisahaku, ka o shih o ka yɛli, Kukoli ŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu kukoli, amaa nuhi ŋɔ nyɛla Iso nuhi.
en: So Jacob went to Isaac his father. Isaac felt him and said, Your voice sounds like Jacobs voice, but your arms are hairy like the arms of Esau.

dag: o yi ti baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa, ŋun bom bulaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti mali sara.
en: once the sin that he committed is made known to him—he must bring as his offering a flawless male goat.

dag: Nyama, bihi ayi bɛn nyɛ Zadok bia Ahimaaz mini Abiata bia Jɔnatan be bɛ sani nimaani, a ni tooi tim ba ka bɛ kana ti yɛli ma a ni wum shɛlikam zaa. .
en: Then they can send their sons Ahimaaz and Jonathan to tell me what you've heard.

dag: Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ni yihi ya yi bi ʒiɛyimtali maa ni. Ti ka a sanna, dama nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: Return, all of you who have turned away from the Lord ; he will heal you and make you faithful. You say, Yes, we are coming to the Lord because he is our God.

dag: Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini, gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali ka bɛ daa kabi Jɛrusalɛm goondaa luhi.
en: In the eleventh year of Zedekiah, on the ninth day of the fourth month, they broke through the city walls.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu ni o yihi ba sansani maa ni hal ka bɛ zaa daa ti shiri kpi.
en: In fact, the LORDs power was against them, to rid the camp of them, until they were all gone.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa pun zaŋ fɔntinsi maa kɔbu paliti mini di tiŋkpansi tila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb ka di leeg o dini.
en: But the fields and the small towns around the city of Kiriath Arba belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

dag: n yi niŋ ŋun ka ma taali zaɣ biɛɣu bee n yi niŋ n dima zaɣ biɛɣu ka di ka soli.
en: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.

dag: Kaman sagani ni yi booi sagbana ni saa mibu dali shɛm la, lala ka jilima din daa gili o maa daa be. Yawɛ jilima kɔtomsi ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala. N ni daa nya li maa ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka wum so kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Just as a rainbow lights up a cloud on a rainy day, so its brightness shone all around. This was how the form of the LORDs glory appeared. When I saw it, I fell on my face. I heard the sound of someone speaking.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi yomyom bɛ tɛha ni ni ti leei baŋdiba, ka bɛn tɔri birilim ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa din niŋ kamaata ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.

dag: Tɛhimi n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama ti Duuma ni chɛ ka a baŋ shɛlikam zaa gbinni.
en: Think about what I am saying, because the Lord will enable you to understand it all.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kamina ka n ti a saɣisigu shɛli din ni chɛ ka a tooi tilig amaŋmaŋ min a bia Sulemaana nyɛviya.
en: Let me give you some advice on how you and your son Solomon can survive this.

dag: N ni wurim kuŋkuna mini zoya, ka chɛ ka tihi mini mɔri din be di zuɣu zaa kuui. N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa kuui kpakpa, ka chɛ ka kɔpurima nyuui.
en: I will wither mountains and valleys, and I will dry up all their vegetation. I will turn rivers into deserts, and I will dry up pools.

dag: N di yuya ni n niriba maa wum n yɛligu; n di yuya ni Izraɛlnim doli n soya!.
en: How I wish my people would listen to me! How I wish Israel would walk in my ways!.

dag: Ka n ti ka a sanna nimaani, chɛrubinim ayi bɛn be Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu la sunsuuni nti tɔɣis a n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti a ka a ti Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: When I meet with you, I will speak from between the Cherub angels on the mercy-cover that is on the Box of the Agreement. From that place, I will give all my commands to the Israelites.

dag: N nyaya ka daadamnim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: I have seen everything done in this world, and I tell you, it is all useless. It is like chasing the wind.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o Shia Kasi tin ya ka tumd alahiziba tuma yi san la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o niŋdi lala maa?.
en: Does God give you the Spirit because you follow the law? Does God work miracles among you because you follow the law? No, God gives you his Spirit and works miracles among you because you heard the message about Jesus and believed it.

dag: N ka galimi, m baɣa kani. M bi lan bɔri n nyɛvili.
en: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.

dag: Ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, Doo maa yi di bi yɛli ni o ni zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani, nir naan tooi zaŋ o bahi kpe.
en: And Agrippa said to Festus, This man could have been released if he had not appealed to the Emperor.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm Aduna jaaŋgbee maa labisi ti sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka di nyɛ shihirili duŋ taariba maa sani, ka a chɛ ka bɛ chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi niŋdi ma, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni kpi.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Put Aaron's stick back in front of the Covenant Box. It is to be kept as a warning to the rebel Israelites that they will die unless their complaining stops.

dag: Shɛla ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛba.
en: After Shelah was years old, his son Eber was born.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɔri nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa duŋtaabo dirila nyɛvili.
en: Righteousness gives life, but violence takes it away.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: All the Israelites did just as the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa du Zoli maa zuɣu, ka sagbani limsi li.
en: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi ka po pɔri yɛli, Man ʒi doo maa.
en: Again Peter denied it and answered, I swear that I don't know that man.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anu, ka n nya bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni yɛligu mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu zuɣu la shihi bimbini gbini.
en: Then the Lamb broke open the fifth seal. I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed because they had proclaimed God's word and had been faithful in their witnessing.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ, amaa yalim yi niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha.
en: Salt is good, but if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made to taste salty again?.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Kpahim a nuhi, ka chɛ ka takɔbi din ni ku niriba lu buyi bee buta. Di nyɛla takɔbi din kura, ka nyɛ takɔbi din ni ku niriba pam. Di gili ba mi niŋ sunsuuni.
en: Now, mortal man, prophesy. Clap your hands, and the sword will strike again and again. It is a sword that kills, a sword that terrifies and slaughters.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni, ka o ti tin ya vuhim yi dimnim bɛn gili ya la zaa sani, ka chɛ ka yi be ni alaafee.
en: But you will go across the Jordan River and live in the land that the Lord your God is giving you. There he will give you rest from all your enemies, and you will be safe.

dag: tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa mi Sinai Zoli zuɣu nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ninni.
en: the earth shook, and the sky poured down rain, because of the coming of the God of Sinai, the coming of the God of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Zius la yuli ti Baanabas, ka zaŋ buɣ so ŋun mi yuli booni Hɛrimɛs la yuli ti Pool mi, Pool ni daa nyɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira la zuɣu.
en: They gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and Paul the name Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Anabi Musa litaafinima, chinchini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha;.
en: Yes, even today, when they read the Law of Moses, there is a covering over their minds.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe o nuzaa polo la mi, Yinim bahiyolinim ŋɔ, wariya ti kpe azaaba buɣim shɛl ni Naawuni ni daa mali gu Sintani min o malaikanim la.
en: Then the king will say to the evil people on his left, Get away from me. God has already decided that you will be punished. Go into the fire that burns forever—the fire that was prepared for the devil and his angels.

dag: Nir ni tooi gbaai baandɔɣu niŋ o nuu ni, amaa o bela nanim yinsi.
en: Lizards: you can hold one in your hand, but you can find them in palaces.

dag: ka yɛli Samsin, Man daa tɛhiya ni a lan je o mi, ka zaŋ o ti a daaŋgo zo la. O tizɔbil ŋɔ viɛli gar o, dinzuɣu jaande, zaŋm o tizɔbil maa ka chɛ o.
en: When you left the way you did, I thought you were divorcing her. So I arranged for her to marry one of the young men who were at your party. But my younger daughter is even prettier, and you can have her as your wife.

dag: nti yi ŋariŋ ni nimaani chaŋ Filipai din daa nyɛ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinzuɣu ka Romnim su li la. Ka ti daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: From there we went to Philippi, a city of Macedonias first district and a Roman colony. We stayed in that city several days.

dag: Dama o ni chɛ ka o malaikanim gul a a chandi shee zaa.
en: He will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.

dag: N ni ti daai yi maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la. Ka n ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku yi ninvuɣ shɛba bahi yi buɣa maa tooni.
en: Your altars will be broken into pieces. Your incense altars will be smashed, and I will throw down your dead bodies in front of your filthy idols.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu;.
en: Late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, This is an isolated place, and its already late in the day.

dag: Wuntizɔriba wuntitali n-tiligiri ba, amaa bilikɔɣinim nia biɛri nyɛla din gbahiri ba.
en: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.

dag: Doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni wuhi yi yɛm mini yi baŋsim ni nyɛ shɛm niriba sani; bɛ yi ti wum zaligunim ŋɔ zaa yɛla bɛ ni yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, zuliya titali ŋɔ niriba nyɛla bɛn mali yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: Obey these laws carefully. This will show the people of the other nations that you are wise and sensible. They will hear about these laws and say, Truly, the people of this great nation are wise and sensible.

dag: Ti Duuma, teemi bɛ ni maani mani a dabili ŋɔ ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; teemi niriba ni turi ma tu shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: Don't forget how I, your servant, am insulted, how I endure all the curses of the heathen.

dag: Di mi bi tuhi ni ti zahim ti Duuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka tinvura dim ku ba la.
en: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa ŋmaligi kuli ti be Ninive.
en: Then the Assyrian emperor Sennacherib withdrew and returned to Nineveh.

dag: ni Basɛmat ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ka nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt tizɔpaɣ la.
en: and Basemath the daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

dag: Lala zuɣu bindir shɛli dibu yi nyɛla din ni luhi m mabia, dindina n kul ku ŋubi nimdi ka di zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mabia lu.
en: So then, if food makes a believer sin, I will never eat meat again, so as not to make a believer fall into sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu wuhim ti ka ti kaani ti dabisa, din ni chɛ ka ti niŋ yɛm ti suhuri ni.
en: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.

dag: Yi mi di maliya li ŋmahindi biŋkɔbigu ŋun be dunia ŋɔ ni bee ŋ-ŋmahindi nooŋa ŋun mali kpiŋkpama yiɣiri zuɣusaa.
en: animals, birds.

dag: ka Sabinim kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku tumtumdiba maa ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: Suddenly the Sabeans attacked and stole them all. They killed every one of your servants except me. I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm maa daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli pam. Ka Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba daa kul yiini yila ka ŋmɛri Yawɛ biŋkumda din kumdi pampam m-paɣiri Yawɛ dabisili kam.
en: The people of Israel in Jerusalem celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread with great joy for seven days. And the Levites and priests praised the Lord every day with all their strength.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi yurilim maŋli ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi cheechinima, ka lan kahigi wuhi ni ti ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu ti mabihi maa sani shɛm la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: So show them the proof of your love and the reason we are so proud of you, in such a way that the churches can see it.

dag: Nir suhu ni karimbaani n-tahir o saɣiŋgu na, amaa maŋsiɣisibu m-be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.

dag: N ni daa nya biŋkɔb so maa daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, ka o naba mali nyinyɛ wɔɣila, ka ŋmani bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la naba, ka o noli ŋmani gbuɣinli noli. Ka waɣ biɛ tital la daa zaŋ o yiko min o nam ʒiishee ni o fukumsi din galisi pam la ti o.
en: The beast looked like a leopard, with feet like a bear's feet and a mouth like a lion's mouth. The dragon gave the beast his own power, his throne, and his vast authority.

dag: Ka binshɛɣukam din mali daɣiri ti ku kpe tiŋ maa ni bee ŋunkam tumdi din chihiri bee ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri, amaa kulla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuya sab Piɛbil maa nyɛvili litaafi la ni kɔŋko nti yɛn kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: But nothing that is impure will enter the city, nor anyone who does shameful things or tells lies. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of the living will enter the city.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti ku n-naai bɛ zuliya maa. Di chɛliya ka so ti lan teei Izraɛlnim yuli yɛla yaha.
en: They say, Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Ka di sambani mini di duu ni goma wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The man measured the length of the temple, and it was meters. He then measured from the back wall of the temple, across the open space behind the temple, to the back wall of the west building; it was meters.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku tooi wuhi ma di gbinni, dindina yi mi ni ti ma silinchi kpar suma pihita mini binyɛr sun shɛŋa din nyɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra Ka bɛ yɛl o, yɛlim ti a ŋahili maa ka ti wum.
en: But if you cant tell me the answer, then its you who have to give me thirty linen robes and thirty sets of clothes. So they replied to him, Tell your riddle; lets hear it.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri yuri ku tooi ti nir nasara, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ din galisi pam la ku tooi tiligi so.
en: Horses dont really bring victory in war. Their strength cannot help you escape.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yuui, ka Pita ti yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni mani ka Naawuni daa daŋ pii ni n chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim wum lahibal suŋ maa n nol ni ka niŋ yɛda.
en: They had talked it over for a long time, when Peter got up and said: My friends, you know that God decided long ago to let me be the one from your group to preach the good news to the Gentiles. God did this so they would hear and obey him.

dag: Tun dunia piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ so na ʒi n-wum ni so neei zoondɔɣirili nina.
en: Since the beginning of the world nobody has ever heard of anyone giving sight to a person born blind.

dag: Nir yi yiini yila niŋdi ŋun mali suhugarigu, di ŋmanila bɛ ni niŋ bilisitom pa yum ni la. Kaman binneembila ni be situra ni bee nɔyɛla ni be dari ni shɛm, lala ka suhugarigu dimdi daadam suhu ni.
en: Singing to a person who is depressed is like taking off a person's clothes on a cold day or like rubbing salt in a wound.

dag: ka Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl daa nyɛ Manaasa zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Gamaliel, Pedahzurs son, commanded the military of the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Ka di ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni su shɛli, ka bɛ ni ti di li luɣ kasi shee la, dama di nyɛla o tarili din be kasi zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ puuni; ka di nyɛla o ni su shɛli sahakam.
en: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuɣulaannima, Yi zaa yinoyino kum yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe Pɛɔr Baal jɛmbu ni maa.
en: So Moses said to Israels judges, Each of you must find the men in your tribe who have led people to worship the false god, Baal of Peor. Then you must kill these men.

dag: Di saha yin ti yɛlimiya yi bihi maa, Ti daa nyɛla Firawuna daba be Ijipti, amaa ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa yihi ti Ijipti maa na.
en: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dahin shɛli n yi ti lan kpihim yi daalahichi, n ni ti lan chɛ ka niriba be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, When I make you clean from all your sins, I will let you live in your cities again and let you rebuild the ruins.

dag: n-yi nimaani n-zaŋ hal ti paai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Ka Mikimɛtat daa be bɛ nuzaa polo; ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili daa zaŋ chaŋ wulimpuhili polo ha nti ŋmaligi kpa Taanatishilo polo n-chaŋ ti gari di zuɣu wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Janɔa.
en: And the western border started at Micmethath. The border turned to the east to Taanath Shiloh and continued east to Janoah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Balaam, Doli ba chaŋ, amaa kul yɛlimila n ni yɛl a ni a yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ka Balaam daa doli Balak kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: But the angel said, Go on with these men, but say only what I tell you to say. So Balaam went on with them.

dag: Mani ka Yawɛ daa daŋ nambu o tuma piligu ni, din daa nyɛ o tuuli tuma kurimbuni ha.
en: From the beginning, I was with the Lord . I was there before he began.

dag: O daa zaŋla dabipaɣiba ayi maa mini bɛ bihi bahi tooni, ka chɛ ka Liya min o bihi paya, ka chɛ ka Reechɛl mini Yisifu be nyaaŋa.
en: The two servant women, Zilpah and Bilhah, together with their children went first, followed by Leah and her children, then by Rachel and Joseph.

dag: N ni yi be bɛ sani maa, n yi gbib ba la a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu. N kul gbib ba viɛnyɛliŋga hal ka bɛ ni yino bi bɔrigi naɣila bahi yoli bia la ni di chɛ ka nyin Naawuni yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.

dag: Di saha zoomba nina ni ti neei, ka tikpiranim wum.
en: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni ti wɔɣa, ka di nyoli chaŋ ti be sagbana ni, ka di ni mali karimbaani maa zuɣu.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: That tree grew tall. Its top reached up to the clouds. It grew so big that it became proud!.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nanim mini tarimba zaa daa kul kpalim lihirila ŋuna ka yɛra, Yiko shɛli ti ni booni Naawuni yiko tital la be doo ŋɔ ni.
en: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, This man is the power of God called The Great Power. .

dag: Ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: The commander of the guard also took Seraiah the high priest, Zephaniah the deputy priest, and the three doorkeepers.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa bi zali saria karibu saha? Ka bɔzuɣu ka bɛn mi o na ʒi n-nya o ni zali saha dabisa shɛŋa ni?.
en: Why doesn't God set a time for judging, a day of justice for those who serve him?.

dag: bee n-kpuɣiri bɛ neem bihibihi. Amaa bɛ lee chɛ ka bɛ bebu kahigi wuhi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim ni yɛlimaŋli ni be shɛb ni, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ yɛla wuhibu la nya jilima bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: or steal. Instead, they should show that they are completely reliable in everything so that they might make the teaching about God our savior attractive in every way.

dag: Amaa mani ŋuna, Yawɛ yiko min o shia ni zaligu ni yaa be n ni, ka n yɛli Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛ biriginsim mini bɛ daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: But me! I am filled with power, with the spirit of the LORD, with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his wrongdoing and to Israel his sin!.

dag: Di tamya saamba saani niŋbu yɛla, dama shɛb daa niŋdi saani lala hal ti niŋ malaikanim saani ka bi baŋ ni malaikanim m-bala.
en: Remember to welcome strangers in your homes. There were some who did that and welcomed angels without knowing it.

dag: Ʒiri be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɛha ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri din viɛli tumbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: An evil mind is deceitful, but gentle thoughts bring happiness.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ koli binshɛɣukam gari kaman pɔhim la. Bɛ birigiya ka leei bɛn mali taali, bɛmaŋmaŋ yaa n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength.

dag: Naa Asa daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinahi ni yini ka faai siɣ o yaannim sani.
en: Asa died in the st year as king and rested with his ancestors.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Jeremiah.

dag: Miri ka a nyuri bara biɛɣuni zuɣu, dama a bi mi dabisili maa ni yɛn tahi yɛl shɛli na.
en: Never boast about tomorrow. You don't know what will happen between now and then.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namda. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: but you must mourn quietly. Dress as you normally do; wear your turban and sandals; dont cover your mustache, and dont eat the food people normally eat when someone dies.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka buɣim di Magɔg mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi teeku noli ni alaafee la, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: yin karimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa mini kuriti mali wun shɛŋa zaa, ka wurim bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: you must drive out all the inhabitants of the land. Destroy all their stone and metal idols and all their places of worship.

dag: Hal Kriitinim ni booni bɛ ni ninvuɣ so anabi la maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya, Kriitinim kul nyɛla ʒiŋmariba mini biŋkɔb biɛri ni diribarilimnima.
en: Someone who is one of their own prophets said, People from Crete are always liars, wild animals, and lazy gluttons.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord told Moses to say to the people:.

dag: Bɛn guuri pam ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka tɔbbihi ku tooi zo n-tiligi, Bɛ tuuya lu Yufretiiz Mɔɣili nuzaa polo.
en: Those who run fast cannot get away; the soldiers cannot escape. In the north, by the Euphrates, they stumble and fall.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nudirigu tiri, ka tiŋgbani vali ba.
en: When you signaled with your right hand, your enemies were swallowed deep into the earth.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa bol o bihi na nti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya na ka n ti yɛli ya din ti yɛn niŋ ya dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: Then Jacob called all his sons to him. He said, My sons, come here to me. I will tell you what will happen in the future.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mɔabnim yɛliya, Judanim kul bemi kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, Because Moab has said that Judah is like all the other nations.

dag: N ku chɛ yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya yihibu biɛri bɔhibu. Ka biŋkɔbigu yi ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo. Ka so yi ku o mabia, bɛn kum o yo.
en: If anyone takes human life, he will be punished. I will punish with death any animal that takes a human life.

dag: Ka biasan la gba daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Bɛnammi. O yaansi n-nyɛ Ammɔnnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The younger daughter also had a son, whom she named Benammi. He was the ancestor of the present-day Ammonites.

dag: Dinzuɣu dahin yini ka alɔbo balibu paai shɛm ni ti lu o zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: Dɔro mini fabila ni kum. Ka buɣim ni ti di o, dama ŋun yɛn kar o saria lala maa n-nyɛ ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: So in one day she will suffer great hunger, mourning, and death. She will be destroyed by fire, because the Lord God who judges her is powerful.

dag: ka zaŋya n vuhim dabisa la leei dabisa kasi, ka di leei shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I told them to respect my Sabbath to show that they were my people and that I was the Lord their God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kom din kpe nti taɣi ninsal yɛno tariga n-kpe Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ. Bɛ ni ti yɛrigi nyin Imanuɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: and sweep into Judah, flooding, overflowing, and reaching up to the neck. But God is with us; the span of his wings will cover the width of the land.

dag: Ka ti ni paɣ shɛb yɛl ti shɛli ka di gari ti pam: Asibaasi ŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ yibu chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: but today some of our women told us an amazing thing. Early this morning they went to the tomb where the body of Jesus was laid.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa yɛl ti, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba m-bɔŋɔ: chɛliya yi ni yino n sani, ka zaŋ kawana kuli ti ti yi yiŋnim shɛb kum ni muɣisi maa;.
en: Then the governor of that country said to us, Here is a way to prove that you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me. Take your grain back to your families.

dag: Dindali maa yi ti paai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni tiligi ba kaman piɛgul ni tiligir o piɛri barina ni shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti nyɛlisiri bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni kaman nam zuɣupiligu ni waya la.
en: The LORD their God will deliver them on that day as the flock of his people; they will be the jewels in a crown dotting his land.

dag: Dama alɔbo n-lu n zuɣu dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka n nyari tibidarigibo asiba kam.
en: God, I suffer all day long, and you punish me every morning.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi deeri ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu bee n-doli alahichinim biɛhigu bee n-doli ansarisi maaniba biɛhigu mali alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who dont listen to evil advice, who dont live like sinners, and who dont join those who make fun of God.

dag: Yi gba maŋmaŋ daa bela zibisim ni, amaa ti Duuma ni, yi yipa leela bɛn be neesim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu benya kaman neesim ni niriba.
en: You yourselves used to be in the darkness, but since you have become the Lord's people, you are in the light. So you must live like people who belong to the light.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa daa kana ka o mini ba ti dɔni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kɔre maa saɣim o, o ni daa saɣim omaŋ maa nyaaŋa, ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: So the Babylonian men came to her bed to have sex with her. They used her and made her so filthy that she became disgusted with them.

dag: N ni teegi n nuu n-tum alahiziba tuma n-darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili, di nyaaŋa ka o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ.
en: But I will use my power and will punish Egypt by doing terrifying things there. After that he will let you go.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ li yɛl a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba, ka chɛ ka bɛ be kasi din ni chɛ ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons. Then ordain them and dedicate them by anointing them with olive oil, so that they may serve me as priests.

dag: Ka o dii suug o koyuli maa o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu na ti ma ka yɛli, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ shɛli ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu. Ka n di nyu ka chɛ ka o ŋɔŋ na ti ti n laakumnim maa gba ka bɛ nyu.
en: She immediately lowered her water jar and said, Drink, and I will give your camels something to drink too. So I drank and she also gave water to the camels.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem o nina ka o nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei nachimbil maa nina ka o lihi nya ka yuri mini buɣim chɛchɛbunsi n-kul pali zoli zuɣu n-teei gili Ilaisha.
en: Then Elisha prayed, LORD, please open his eyes that he may see. Then the LORD opened the servants eyes, and he saw that the mountain was full of horses and fiery chariots surrounding Elisha.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la mini Zɛruya bia Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la, Ŋuni n-lee ni doli ma chaŋ Sool sansan ni? Ka Abishai daa yɛli, Man ni dol a chaŋ.
en: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Joabs brother Abishai, Zeruiahs son, Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul? Ill go down with you, Abishai answered.

dag: Di saha yɛlimaŋtali ni ti be tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka wuntitali mi ti be tiŋgban shɛli din vuhir ni.
en: Honesty and justice will prosper there.

dag: Zuɣusaa niriba maa ni daa kpuɣi ninsalinim bipuɣinsi dɔɣi bihi saha shɛli mini di saha maa nyaaŋa ka tiyaawumyanim daa piligi be dunia ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛn mali kpiɔŋ kurimbuni maa ha ni bɛn mali yuya.
en: In those days, giants lived on the earth and also afterward, when divine beings and human daughters had sexual relations and gave birth to children. These were the ancient heroes, famous men.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Pool yɛli Baanabas, Chɛ ka ti lab tin shɛŋa ni ti ni daa moli ti Duuma yɛligu molo la nti kaai ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani maa n-nya bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: Some time later, Paul said to Barnabas, Lets go back and visit all the brothers and sisters in every city where we preached the Lords word. Lets see how they are doing.

dag: Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim.
en: If a country divides itself into groups which fight each other, that country will fall apart.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa. O daa deei zoya zuɣu tinsi mini Nɛgɛb polo tinsi zaa ni Goshɛn tiŋgbani zaa ni tintan ni tinsi ni Araba ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu tinsi la.
en: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.

dag: Di tɛhiriya ni n ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla m Ba sani; ŋun ni tɔɣisi yi din bie yɛla o sani beni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa yi ni zaŋ yi tahima zaa niŋ so ni la.
en: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ Naawuni n-kul sɔŋdi ma, dinzuɣu ka n ʒe kpe n-diri di shɛhira wɔɣira mini tarimba sani n-kul yɛrila Anabi Musa min anabinim ni daa yɛli ni shɛli ni ti niŋ pali la yɛla kɔŋko.
en: But God helped me, and he is still helping me today. With Gods help I am standing here today and telling all people what I have seen. But I am saying nothing new. I am saying only what Moses and the prophets said would happen.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana n-daa ti me jɛmbu duu maa ti Naawuni.
en: But it was Solomon who actually built a house for God.

dag: Ka o daa nya ŋarima ayi ka di ʒe duli; kulipalinima n-daa chɛ li zali ka chaŋ ti paɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: Jesus saw two boats at the shore of the lake. The fishermen were washing their nets.

dag: Di saha maa n daa ʒiɛla yi mini Yawɛ sunsuuni ni n zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa tɔɣisi ya, dama yi daa zɔrila dabiɛm buɣim maa zuɣu, ka daa bi du zoli maa zuɣu. Ka o daa yɛli.
en: At that time, I was standing between the LORD and you, declaring to you the LORDs word, because you were terrified of the fire and didnt go up on the mountain. The LORD said.

dag: Ŋunkam mini yɛnnim be leerila yɛndana, amaa ŋun mini jɛra be nyarila biɛrim.
en: Walk with wise people and become wise; befriend fools and get in trouble.

dag: Bɛ ni daa labir o kuɣa maa, o daa suhirila ti Duuma yɛra. N Duuma Yisa, deemi n nyɛvili.
en: As they battered him with stones, Stephen prayed, Lord Jesus, accept my life.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ʒirilana ka pa ni ŋun chihi ni Yisa pala Masia? Ninvuɣ so ŋun chihi ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia maa, dilana n-nyɛ Masiachihira.
en: Who is the liar? Isnt it the person who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This person is the antichrist: the one who denies the Father and the Son.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu lan yɛli ba, Di kul nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: It is just as I said, Joseph answered. You are spies.

dag: ka gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛri suŋ, ka nyɛ bɛn gbib bɛ yinsi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi nirilim, ka nyɛ bɛn wumdi n-tiri bɛ yidaannima, ka di chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yɛligu.
en: They will teach them to be wise and pure, to take care of their homes, to be kind, and to be willing to serve their husbands. Then no one will be able to criticize the teaching God gave us.

dag: N nya o, amaa pa pumpɔŋɔ. N nya o, amaa ka o shee na waɣa. Saŋmariga ni ti puhi yi Yaakubu zuliya ni na. Naa ni ti yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na; O ni ti ku Mɔab zuɣulaannima, ka ku Sɛt zuliya zaa.
en: I see him, but not now; I look at him, but not nearby. A star comes from Jacob; a scepter arises from Israel, smashing Moabs forehead, the head of all the Sethites.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa tim ba maa bɛ daa chaŋla Sɛlusia nti yi ni kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus teeku kom ni do n-gili tiŋgban shɛl la.
en: After the Holy Spirit sent them on their way, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii Lɛvi yi zuliya zaa ni ni o min o bihi zani zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ yuli tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: because the LORD your God selected Levi from all of your tribes to stand and minister in the LORDs name—both him and his descendants for all time.

dag: Dama mani a dabili ŋɔ daa zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima bia maa zuɣu m ba sani ka yɛli, N yi ti bi ʒi bia maa kuna, di taali din ʒinimi n zuɣu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I took responsibility for the young boy. I told my father, If I dont bring him back to you, you can blame me for the rest of my life.

dag: Ŋun nam tibili ni nyɛ ŋun bi wumda? Ŋun nam nini ni nyɛ ŋun bi nyara?.
en: God made our ears, so surely he can hear what is happening! He made our eyes, so surely he can see you!.

dag: Yiɣisim doli tiŋgbɔŋ maa wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ nya, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: Stand up and walk around through the length and breadth of the land because I am giving it to you.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhiya bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni tiligi ba; ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, amaa ka o bi garigi ba.
en: They cry for help, but no one saves them; they call to the Lord , but he does not answer.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli Bolimiya Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la gba na ka ti ti wum o mi ni mali shɛli ni o yɛli.
en: But Absalom said, Now call Hushai the Arkite. I also want to hear what he says.

dag: Mirim ma, tiligim ma; fam ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Come save my soul. Rescue me from my enemies.

dag: dama nyɛvili samli galisiya pam, ka so ku tooi nya liɣiri din ni saɣi di zuɣu yɔbu;.
en: You will never get enough money to pay for your own life.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka a nam ʒiishee pun mali ʒiɛya. Kurimbuni ha ka a pun be.
en: Your kingdom has continued forever. You have lived forever!.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ti ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka kul ni kpalim bela ninvuɣubiɛtali maa tuma ni. Naɣila bɛn mali yɛm kɔŋko n-ni ti baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Many will purify, cleanse, and refine themselves, but the wicked will act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but those skilled in wisdom will understand.

dag: Tiŋgbani, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, amaa chɛ ka a suhu piɛla, ka mali suhupiɛlli; dama Yawɛ tum tuun kara.
en: Land, dont be afraid. Be happy and full of joy. The Lord will do great things.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa dii chaŋ naa sani nti suh o ni o tim o saha pahi ka o wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: Daniel went at once and obtained royal permission for more time, so that he could tell the king what the dream meant.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o chaŋ.
en: Jesus left the city and went, as he usually did, to the Mount of Olives; and the disciples went with him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O nyɛla tɔbutuhira ŋun tiri nasara. O ni ti di dari yi zuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. O ni ti zaŋ ya leei ninvuɣ pala o yurilim puuni. O ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli yi zuɣu.
en: The LORD your God is in your midst—a warrior bringing victory. He will create calm with his love; he will rejoice over you with singing.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔhim ti ʒiʒiinitab biɛri siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin zuɣu, ansarisi shɛŋa bɛ ni maan a la zuɣu.
en: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi du shɛli din daa tuhi sambani wulinluhili polo la mini di yaɣa ayi varandanima, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa sunsuuni mini di puuni duu ni di samban ni zɔŋ la.
en: Then he measured the length of the structure along the side of the yard, including its promenades on both sides: one hundred fifty feet. Now the interior of the main hall as well as the porches in the courtyard.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋmi li bahi tiŋa. Ka o zaŋ li bahi tiŋa ka di leei wahu, ka Musa tirisi lab nyaaŋa ka chɛ li.
en: The LORD said, Throw it down on the ground. So Moses threw it on the ground, and it turned into a snake. Moses jumped back from it.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya gban shɛli ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira.
en: I looked again, and this time I saw a scroll flying through the air.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ kul be n sani sahakam, dama o kul bela n nudirigu polo, ka shɛli ku tooi dam ma.
en: I always remember that the Lord is with me. He is here, close by my side, so nothing can defeat me.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yihila n Duuma, ka m bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: Woman, why are you crying? they asked her. She answered, They have taken my Lord away, and I do not know where they have put him.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔash daa bɔhi bɛn zaa kana ti lir o maa, Yi zanila Baal zaani? Yi zabirila o zuɣu? Ŋunkam zabir o zuɣu, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ asiba bɛ ni ku dilana. O yi nyɛla wuni, yin chɛliy o ka o zab omaŋ zuɣu, dama o bimbini ka bɛ wurim maa.
en: But Joash said to all those who confronted him, Are you arguing for Baal? Are you defending him? Anyone who argues for him will be killed before morning. If Baal is a god, let him defend himself. It is his altar that was torn down.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka dam ŋɔ yɛn yi a ninni? Ka yɛl o, Chɛli wain nyubu.
en: How long will you act like a drunk? Sober up! Eli told her.

dag: N Duuma ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin din kanna puuni, bindira ni niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Seven years of great abundance are now coming throughout the entire land of Egypt.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa, Malimiya yimaŋ kasi gu biɛɣuni. Yi sa ni ŋubi nimdi, dama yi kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛra, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi. Ti ni daa be Ijipti la daa so. Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni tin ya nimdi ka yi ŋubi.
en: Tell the people this: Make yourselves ready for tomorrow. Tomorrow you will eat meat. The Lord heard you when you cried out and said, We need meat to eat! It was better for us in Egypt! So now the Lord will give you meat. And you will eat it.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpe bɛ sani asiba n-nya ka bɛ malila suhugarigu.
en: Joseph went to them the next morning and saw that the two men were worried.

dag: O ni daa kari ninsal yihi Idɛn puu maa ni maa, o daa zaŋla chɛrubinim mini takɔbi din nyɛ buɣim niɛm ka ŋmaligiri luɣilikam zali Idɛn puu maa wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ gu so shɛli din chani ti shɛli din tiri nyɛvil maa gbini.
en: He drove out the human. To the east of the garden of Eden, he stationed winged creatures wielding flaming swords to guard the way to the tree of life.

dag: Dama n ni tibi yi dansi maa, ka tin ya alaafee, dama bɛ lihi ya la bɛn ka so. Ziɔn ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ bɛ baɣa ka maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And I will bring your health back and heal your wounds, says the Lord , because other people said you were outcasts. They said, No one cares about Zion.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu puuni ka nir niŋdi naani din mali kpiɔŋ, ka o bihi nyari sɔɣisili shee.
en: People who respect the Lord will be safe, and they will make their children feel secure.

dag: Amaa o daa jɛmdila o ba Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima, ka daa bi be kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa be shɛm la.
en: He served his father's God, obeyed God's commands, and did not act the way the kings of Israel did.

dag: Chamiya ti bɔhim dimbɔŋɔ gbinni: M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu. Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: You need to go and learn what this Scripture means: I dont want animal sacrifices; I want you to show kindness to people. I did not come to invite good people. I came to invite sinners.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka yi nyiŋgoya kpɛm gari kurigu, ka yi gbɛri mi be kaman daanya la.
en: I knew that you would prove to be stubborn, as rigid as iron and unyielding as bronze.

dag: Yawɛ, n teer a yuli yɛla yuŋ, ka dol a zaligu.
en: Lord , in the night I remembered your name, and I obeyed your teachings.

dag: Mɔabnim yudua la naaya. Bɛ lo ba zaɣ biɛɣu Hɛshibɔn. Kamiyana ka ti wurim li, ka di ku lan beni. Ka nyini yinyahi tiŋ ŋɔ gba, bɛ ni ti chɛ ka a fo. Takɔb ni ti dol a.
en: Moab will not be praised again. Men in Heshbon will plan Moabs defeat. They will say, Come, let us put an end to that nation. Madmenah, you will also be silenced. The sword will chase you.

dag: Yi yi ti biri yi bimbira, o ni chɛ ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ, ka yi kpuɣi atam pam, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nya mɔri pam ŋubira.
en: God will provide rain for the seed you sow in the ground, and the food the ground produces will be rich and abundant. On that day, your cattle will graze in large pastures.

dag: N nya binshɛli ka di to n-gari kum. Dina n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun ŋmani zana. O ni wuhi ni o yur a shɛm ŋmanila zana mini tɔŋ, ka o nuhi nyɛ bandi. Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o niŋ din tiɣi Naawuni nini ni yi o yɛla ni, amaa alahichilan ni lu o zana maa ni.
en: I found one woman more bitter than death: she who is a trap, her heart a snare, her hands shackles. Anyone who pleases God escapes her, but a sinner is trapped by her.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa dɔɣi Kɛnan maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pinaanu. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and then lived another years. He had other children.

dag: O daa dolila o ba Asa naba, o daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li, naɣila bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la ka o daa bi wurim; ka niriba daa na kul chani ti maani li, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim nimaani.
en: Like his father Asa, Jehoshaphat was good and did everything that the Lord wanted, but he did not destroy the high places. The people continued offering sacrifices and burning incense there.

dag: Bɛ to tɛte di m binyɛrigu, ka piri n situra ti taba.
en: They gamble for my clothes and divide them among themselves.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya azichi ti ba, ka zo bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa nambɔɣu. Tiŋ maa ni lan me n-tam di daboli zuɣu, ka nayil la ti lan be di ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la.
en: The Lord says, I will restore my people to their land and have mercy on every family; Jerusalem will be rebuilt, and its palace restored.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zɛrubabɛl, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma; Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ Maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba, tummiya tuma maa, m be yi sani.
en: So now, be strong, Zerubbabel, says the LORD. Be strong, High Priest Joshua, Jehozadaks son, and be strong, all you people of the land, says the LORD. Work, for I am with you, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zo ka chɛ ma.
en: You murderers, get away from me! God, kill those wicked people—.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o ku n-vu o ti bahi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha.
en: So they took the son, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani Samaria. O be Nabɔt wain tihi puu la ni ni o deei li su.
en: Go to King Ahab in Samaria. He will be at Naboths vineyard. He is there to take the vineyard as his own.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lee lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Timaŋmaŋ wum li o nol ni.
en: And they said, We don't need any witnesses! We ourselves have heard what he said.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim maa ni daa chaŋ, n daa na mi m-bɔhi sariakaritib shɛb n ni daa pii zali ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me duu ti ma? .
en: In all my traveling with the people of Israel I never asked any of the leaders that I appointed why they had not built me a temple made of cedar.

dag: Gaad zuliya ni, Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Gad—Eliasaph son of Deuel ;.

dag: Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan boli ya n daba, dama dabili bi mi o duuma daashili; amaa n ni boli ya la n zɔnima, dama n ni wum shɛlikam zaa m Ba sani, n zaŋ li wuhi ya.
en: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Labimiya nti yɛli Jɔn yi ni nya ka wum shɛm:.
en: Jesus answered, Go tell John what you have heard and seen:.

dag: A na mi n-chɛ ka biɛkaali neesim neei gili dunia zaa, n-kari ninvuɣ biɛri zaa di ni?.
en: Did you ever tell the morning light to grab the earth and shake those who are evil out of their hiding places?.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi maa naabu dali daa ti paai ka Yawɛ zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi din daa nyɛ alikauli kuɣ parilana maa ti ma.
en: So at the end of days and nights, the Lord gave me two stone tablets—the stones of the agreement.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa chɛ ka tuumba ʒi sida dakuɣiri chaŋ ti ti Dauda. O daa bola tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ ti me Dauda yili ti o.
en: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.

dag: A ni tooi lo o mihi n-chɛ ka o ko a? Bee o ni tooi yɛbisi a kɔbu ti a ka a biri?.
en: Can you bind it with a rope to a plowed row; will it plow the valley behind you?.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni n-lee zali wuntaŋa ni di ne dabisili puuni, ka zali goli mini saŋmarisi ni bɛ mi ne yuŋ? Ka ŋuni n-lee damdi teeku ka di kɔgbana vura? O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: The Lord provides the sun for light by day, the moon and the stars to shine at night. He stirs up the sea and makes it roar; his name is the Lord Almighty.

dag: Lala mi ka ti Duuma zali ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mooni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molo gba dirila lahibal suŋ maa tuma ni.
en: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo n-wuhiri shihir kara, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: False messiahs and false prophets will come and do great miracles and wonders, trying to fool the people God has chosen, if that is possible.

dag: Di yi niŋ kamaata ni n nyu bara, n ni nyula bara binshɛŋa din wuhiri n chɔɣinsi ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu.
en: If I must boast, I will boast about things that show how weak I am.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ tuuli naɣ kara ayopɔin la ŋubi.
en: Then the thin, frail cows devoured the first seven, fattened cows.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaai Lɛviatan n-labi duli na bee n-zaŋ mia lo o zilinli?.
en: Can you catch Leviathan with a fishhook? Can you tie his tongue with a rope?.

dag: ni Judas Jeemsi so bia mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti leei nyaanyira la.
en: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.

dag: Dauda daa nyɛla Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi mi nyɛ Ɛfirat daŋ ni nira, ka be Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgban ni la. O daa malila bidibis anii. Sool ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛsi daa kurigiya pam.
en: David's father Jesse was an old man, who belonged to the Ephrath clan and lived in Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons:.

dag: Ka ŋun bi damdi tiŋ jɛm li, bɛ ni zaŋ o ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam ni.
en: Anyone who will not bow down and worship will be immediately thrown into a furnace of flaming fire.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Di ku o, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nuu shihi Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni, ka ku mali taali.
en: But David said to Abishai, Dont kill him! No one can lift a hand against the LORDs anointed and go unpunished.

dag: Di saha di simdi ni maligumaana lih o. Ka dɔro din mɔr o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, ka ŋmani niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu din be niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: The priest must examine it. If the swelling of the infection is reddish white in the bald spot or receding hairline and resembles skin disease on the body.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni amaa ŋun Naawuni ni ti darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ o zuliya leei daba maa tibili; di nyaaŋa ka chɛ ka o zuliya maa nya faako n-lab kpe na ti jɛm ŋun Naawuni.
en: But I will pass judgment on the people that they will serve, and afterward your descendants will come out of that country and will worship me in this place.

dag: Yawɛ yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je alahichi; o gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim; o fari ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahira.
en: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu, ka n suhu kul yu a zaligu.
en: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord . Your Law makes me happy.

dag: Bɛ nuhi zaa ni ti gbarigi, ka bɛ duna ni chɔɣisi.
en: Everyone's hands will be weak, and their knees will shake.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yi niŋ Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam la zaa. Yi lan niŋ n gba ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: He said to them, You have done everything that Moses the Lord 's servant ordered you to do, and you have obeyed all my commands.

dag: Teemi ni n saha bi waɣa; dama a nam ninsalinim zaa ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpira.
en: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani Ijipti ti bɔri sɔŋsim zuɣu. Bɛ niŋla Ijipti tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam la kpiɔŋ mini bɛ wɔribariba ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi yɛda; amaa ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yɛda bee n-suh o ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: Doom to those going down to Egypt for help! They rely on horses, trust in chariots because they are many, and on riders because they are very strong. But they dont look to the holy one of Israel; they dont seek the LORD.

dag: ni Amɔrinim ni Keenannim ni Gɛrigashinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbana la zaa.
en: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti miri Jɔpa, di saha ka Pita mi daa du jirambisa zuɣusaa ni o ti suhi Naawuni. Di daa nyɛla agbaa saha.
en: At noon on the following day, as their journey brought them close to the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hiram daa ti Sulemaana sida mini Sipirɛs dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa o ni daa bɔra.
en: So Hiram supplied Solomon with all the cedar and pine logs that he wanted.

dag: Amaa ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, M pun bi yɛl a ni Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm ka n yɛn niŋ.
en: Balaam answered, Didn't I tell you that I had to do everything that the Lord told me.

dag: M mi ni a ni tooi niŋ binshɛɣukam, ka so ku tooi yiɣisi a ni lo ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: I know you can do everything. You make plans, and nothing can change or stop them.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n sabigimi, amaa ka viɛli pam. N sabigimi kaman tiŋgban nɛl ni Kɛdar tanti suɣa la, amaa ka viɛli pam kaman Naa Sulemaana pateesanima.
en: Women of Jerusalem, I am dark but beautiful, dark as the desert tents of Kedar, but beautiful as the draperies in Solomon's palace.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anu ni, yi ni tooi di di wala, ka lala chɛ ka di woli wala pam tin ya: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.

dag: Bɛ yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla yɛnnima, ashee bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: They said they were wise, but they became fools.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham ti yɛli niriba maa ka bɛ mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni, ka chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ situra zaa.
en: and the Lord said to him, Go to the people and tell them to spend today and tomorrow purifying themselves for worship. They must wash their clothes.

dag: O ni daa karindi litaafi shɛli maa daa sabi yɛlila ŋ-ŋɔ: Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi tahi kaman bɛ ni tahiri piɛɣu o kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛbil so kɔbiri, ka o bi yaar o nol la.
en: This was the passage of scripture he was reading: Like a sheep he was led to the slaughter and like a lamb before its shearer is silent so he didnt open his mouth. .

dag: Alɔbɔnima n-doli taba, tiŋgbani maa zaa bahila yoli. Yim ka bɛ daa ti dii saɣim n suɣa, ka chahi m pateesanima.
en: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.

dag: dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nin na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: This will be the worst time of suffering since God created the world, and nothing this terrible will ever happen again.

dag: Ka m mali biɛhigu shee nimaani ni n zaŋ Yawɛ daalikauli ni be Adaka shɛl ni la zali. O ni daa yihi ti yaannim Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka o daa lo ba alikauli maa.
en: I have made a place in the Temple for the Holy Box. Inside that Holy Box is the agreement that the Lord made with our ancestors when he brought them out of Egypt.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bia Zuriɛl. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila laɣiŋgu suɣili maa nuzaa polo.
en: This clan was to camp on the north side of the Tent, with Zuriel son of Abihail as chief of the clan.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, ka tiŋ maa nim nya ka sɔɣ li ka bi ku o.
en: But if the common people choose to look the other way when someone gives their children to Molech and do not execute such a person.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Neetan daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔro gbaai Yuria paɣ ni dɔɣi bidib so ti Dauda maa.
en: Then Nathan went home. The Lord caused the child that Uriah's wife had borne to David to become very sick.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka n ka yi sanna ni suhupiɛlli Naawuni yubu puuni, ka nya suhukpaŋsibo m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim be zuɣu.
en: so that I can come to you with joy by Gods will and be reenergized with your company.

dag: Ibram paɣa Zarai daa bi dɔɣi bihi. Zarai daa mali Ijipti dab bipuɣiŋga ka o yuli booni Haga.
en: Sarai was Abrams wife, but she did not have any children. She had an Egyptian slave named Hagar.

dag: N daa bi ʒini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sani, m mi daa bi mali suhupiɛlli; a daa chɛ ka n ʒila n ko, dama a daa chɛ ka n suhu miligi pam.
en: I never sat with the crowd as they laughed and had fun. I sat by myself because of your influence on me. You filled me with anger at the evil around me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka tiliginsim paag a yili ŋɔ na, dama a gba yila Ibrahimma zuliya ni na.
en: Jesus said to Zacchaeus, Today you and your family have been saved, because you are a true son of Abraham.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla anzinfa mali dapaɣa pisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu bini pihinahi. Dapaɣili kam daa malila di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka di dashɛbira ayi shɛb di ni.
en: Then they made silver bases for the frames. There were two bases for each frame—one base for each side pole.

dag: Sania din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli mini binyara zahimbu din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli nyɛla Yawɛ dini. Bintibisa zaa din be kpalaŋ puuni nyɛla o tuma.
en: The Lord wants all scales and balances to be right; he wants all business agreements to be fair.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-chaŋ ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali yaa gari ya fɔntin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili hal ka di ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Balaam daa yiɣisi kul o ya, ka Balak gba ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: Then Balaam arose, set out, and returned home. Balak also went on his way.

dag: Dɔɣibu saha beni, ka kpibu saha beni. Biribu saha beni, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛli sib bahi saha beni.
en: There is a time to be born and a time to die. There is a time to plant and a time to pull up plants.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.

dag: Kulla dindali maa ka bɛ daa yɛli naa bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb Susa puuni kalinli.
en: That same day the number of people killed in Susa was reported to the king.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ tiligi n shia kum ni, ka nyɛhi n nintam, ka tiligi n naba tuubu ni.
en: The Lord saved me from death; he stopped my tears and kept me from defeat.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi yil yidan ni ti yɛn kuna saha shɛli, amii zaawuni bee yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli bee biɛɣ asiba;.
en: Therefore, stay alert! You dont know when the head of the household will come, whether in the evening or at midnight, or when the rooster crows in the early morning or at daybreak.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa bi saɣi shɛli o sani. O bi lihi ba ka bɛ nyɛ shɛli o sani.
en: All the nations are like nothing before God. They are viewed as less than nothing and emptiness.

dag: Bɛ sɔŋmi bɛ mabihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni ka bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma, amaa ka lee di lan zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo di tuun shɛli. Lala ka a yɛn niŋ Lɛvinim maa n-wuhi ba bɛ tuma.
en: After that, he may help his fellow Levites in performing their duties in the Tent, but he must not perform any service by himself. This is how you are to regulate the duties of the Levites.

dag: O sɔɣimi doya gu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka chɛ ka niriba pam bi ʒe yim.
en: They wait for you like robbers and cause many men to be unfaithful.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, di ni ti nyɛla alikauli din ku naai bɛ sani. N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi, ka n ti zaŋ n jɛmbu duu zali bɛ sani sahakam.
en: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn di nam n-zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee su zuliya kam, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ to n-kpuɣ o bia maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ o tahi Naawuni sani o nam ʒiishee.
en: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all the nations with an iron rod. And her child was taken up to God and to his throne.

dag: Adɔnija mini saamba bɛn zaa daa be o sani ni daa ti di bɛ bindira naari saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa wum vuri maa. Jɔab ni daa wum kikaa kumsi saha shɛli ka o bɔhi, Ka vu bɔ ka bɛ lee yɔri tiŋ puuni ŋɔ.
en: Adonijah and all his invited guests heard this when they had finished eating. When Joab heard the sound of the rams horn, he said, Whats that noise coming from the city.

dag: Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali, ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ.
en: This day was called Preparation day. It was becoming dark.

dag: M bia, a yi lo a ʒiʒiinikpee alikauli bee a yi lo amaŋa nia ti so.
en: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.

dag: Timiya ti naɣilah ayi, ka chɛ ka bɛ pii naɣila yino kɔrigi ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu, ka di niŋ buɣim niŋ li; ka n gba kɔrigi naɣila ŋun la ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o pa dari zuɣu ka ku niŋ buɣim niŋ li.
en: Bring two bulls; let the prophets of Baal take one, kill it, cut it in pieces, and put it on the wood—but don't light the fire. I will do the same with the other bull.

dag: O daa malila biŋkɔbbaligu tusaayopɔin mini laakumnim tusaata ni naɣilakɔra tuhili ni bunnyama kɔbisinu, ka mali tumtumdiba pam; ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nyɛ ninvuɣ titali gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa.
en: and owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, one thousand head of cattle, and five hundred donkeys. He also had a large number of servants and was the richest man in the East.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti paai Samaria tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Saika la. Tiŋ maa daa mirila pu shɛli Yaakubu ni daa zaŋ ti o bia Yisifu la.
en: and on his way he came to the town of Sychar. It was near the field that Jacob had long ago given to his son Joseph.

dag: Amaa maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi na bi dɔɣi bia ka niŋ pakoli bee n-yi o yidan yiŋa n-lab o ba yiŋ na ti ʒiya kaman o ni daa nyɛ bia shɛm la, o ni tooi di o ba bindirigu maa, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pa maligumaana yiŋ nira, ŋun miri ka o di li.
en: But if a priests daughter is a widow or divorced and has no children and so returns to her fathers household as when she was young, she can eat her fathers food. But, again, no layperson is allowed to eat it.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa duhi bɛ yɛhi n-kum hal ti lan ka yaa din ni kum.
en: David and the other men in his army cried loudly until they were too weak to cry anymore.

dag: Nyama, n niriba ni ti yi katiŋa nuzaa polo mini wulinluhili polo ni Asiwan din be nudirigu polo la na.
en: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba Bɛɔr bia Balaam sani Pɛtɔr din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli Amawu tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti bol o, ka yɛl o, Ninvuɣ shɛba n-yi Ijipti na, bɛ kul yɛrigila luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka ʒini miri ma.
en: He sent messengers to Balaam, Beors son, at Pethor, which is by the river in the land of his people, to summon him: A people has come out of Egypt, and they have now covered the land. They have settled next to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu Daadam Bia n-su Vuhim Dabisili dali gba.
en: So the Son of Man is Lord over the Sabbath.

dag: Adaya daa nyɛla Jɛrɔham bia, ka Jɛrɔham nyɛ Pashihur bia, ka Pashihur nyɛ Malikija bia, ka Maasai daa nyɛ Adiɛl bia, ka Adiɛl nyɛ Jazɛra bia, ka Jazɛra nyɛ Mɛshulam bia, ka Mɛshulam nyɛ Mɛshilɛmit bia, ka Mɛshilɛmit nyɛ Imɛr bia.
en: Adaiah son of Jeroham son of Pashhur son of Malchijah; Maasai son of Adiel son of Jahzerah son of Meshullam son of Meshillemith son of Immer.

dag: A biha ayi ŋɔ ŋmanila muli bɛba ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi bɛn ʒe paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni ŋubira.
en: Your breasts are like twin fawns, like twins of a gazelle, feeding among the lilies.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa kurigi maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o ni tooi nya. Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bihi maa mir o, ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi bɔb gbaai ba n-vooi ba tabil omaŋa, ka mɔɣisi bɛ kparima.
en: Jacob's eyesight was failing because of his age, and he could not see very well. Joseph brought the boys to him, and he hugged them and kissed them.

dag: Ka Jokishan daa nyɛ Shiiba mini Dɛdan ba. Ka Dɛdan bihi daa nyɛ Ashurim mini Lɛtushim ni Liummim.
en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan, and the descendants of Dedan were the Asshurim, the Letushim, and the Leummim.

dag: Jɛzibɛl daa sabimi yɛli gbana maa ni, Molimiya molo ni sokam lom noli, ka chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna ka yi ti chɛ ka Nabɔt ʒini jilima ʒiishee.
en: The letters said: Proclaim a day of fasting, call the people together, and give Naboth the place of honor.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tooi galim yɛtɔɣa, ka di be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ka tahima yɛtɔɣa nyɛla pɔhim?.
en: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.

dag: Salo daa yiɣisi zani n nudirigu polo, bɛ daa kari ma bahi, ka ŋma n kubu pala sɔŋ.
en: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni mali ba, ka bɛ neei kaman machɛli ni maani kurugu shɛm la, ka buɣisi ba nya. Dama wula ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ n niriba bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ?.
en: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.

dag: ni Hɛziro ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la ni Naarai ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛzibai bia la.
en: Hezro from Carmel; Naarai, Ezbais son.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bɛrishiiba ni Biziɔtia.
en: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim mini bɛ kpamba maa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ suhuri zɔhira.
en: This provoked the crowd and the city officials even more.

dag: Ka Musa daa lo alikauli dindali maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli a ni ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim maa zuɣu, a napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ ni ti leeg a min a bihi ni yɛn su shɛli sahakam.
en: Because I did, Moses promised me that my children and I would certainly receive as our possession the land which I walked over.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim so, ka bɛ ti ŋme n-chib o zuɣu ka dih o vi.
en: The owner sent another servant, but the renters beat him on the head and insulted him terribly.

dag: Niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ kaman a yurilim maŋli la ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Show your faithful love to me, your servant. Teach me your laws.
