dag: Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya ka bɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la deei tiŋ maa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligina n-lu Ainim maa zuɣu n-dii ŋmɛri kuri ba.
en: When Joshua and his men saw that the others had taken the city and that it was on fire, they turned around and began killing the men of Ai.

dag: A yi tum alahichi, Naawuni bimbɔ ka di yɛn pii? Ka a yi birigi bushɛm, bɔ ka di yɛn niŋ o?.
en: If you sin, it does not hurt God. Even if your sins are too many to count, that does nothing to God.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ, ka piɛgul suŋ mi zaŋd o nyɛvili taɣir o piɛri dini.
en: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

dag: Ka o ma yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka bɛ ni yɛn yɛl a no shɛli maa doli ma, nyin dee doli n ni wuh a shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti gbahi bubihi pola maa ti ma na.
en: His mother answered, Let any curse against you fall on me, my son; just do as I say, and go and get the goats for me.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Man ʒi doo maa. Di saha maa ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Then Peter began to curse. He said, I swear to God, I dont know the man! As soon as he said this, a rooster crowed.

dag: Di saha ka Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni bɛ zuɣulaantab daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti bɔhi Yɛhudianim maa: Ŋuni n-lee bahi ya noli ni yi mɛm duu ŋɔ hal ka yi me li ti naai.
en: Almost at once Governor Tattenai of West-of-Euphrates, Shethar Bozenai, and their fellow officials came to Jerusalem and demanded: Who gave you orders to build this Temple and equip it.

dag: dama a ni nya ka wum shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu a ni niŋ o shɛhiralana sokam zaa sani.
en: For you will be a witness for him to tell everyone what you have seen and heard.

dag: Ka buɣim daa doli tiŋgbani dambu maa nyaaŋa na, amaa ka Yawɛ daa ka buɣim maa gba ni. Ka kukol balli zaɣ bilifu daa ti doli buɣim maa dibu nyaaŋa na.
en: After the earthquake, there was a fire. But the LORD wasnt in the fire. After the fire, there was a sound. Thin. Quiet.

dag: Di saha ka Maika daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni chɛ ka n tɔŋ, n ni zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nira leei m maligumaana ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Micah said, Now that I have a Levite as my priest, I know that the Lord will make things go well for me.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ ni bɛ nya, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ o, ka bi dol o zaligunima, amaa ka bɛ daa ti ŋmaligi n-leei bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: But they tested and defied the Most High God; they didnt pay attention to his warnings.

dag: Jɛhalɛlɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zif mini Zifa ni Tiria ni Asarɛl.
en: Jehallelel had four sons: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

dag: Di chɛliya ka zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma zaa be yi ni bee n-chɛ ka yi kɔre kpɛri binyara ni, dama di bi simdi ni dimbɔŋɔnim be Yisa nyaandoliba biɛhigu ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Since you are God's people, it is not right that any matters of sexual immorality or indecency or greed should even be mentioned among you.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Listen to this message from the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Then Pilate set Barabbas free for them; and after he had Jesus whipped, he handed him over to be crucified.

dag: Ka o daa lan gbihi n-zahim zahindi din pah ayi. Kawaan kara ayopɔin din viɛla n-daa nyaɣi kawaan kaɣ yini zuɣu.
en: He fell asleep again and had another dream. Seven heads of grain, full and ripe, were growing on one stalk.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni ni tin ya din simdi ya zaa o bundaantali din be Yisa Masia ni la zaa puuni.
en: My God will use his glorious riches to give you everything you need. He will do this through Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka Naa Ahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Hɛzɛkia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Ahaz died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City, and his son Hezekiah succeeded him as king.

dag: amaa di bahigu ni o tomi kaman yabiga ka diri kaman takɔb din mali naŋgbana ayi.
en: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.

dag: Di yi niŋ kamaata ni n nyu bara, n ni nyula bara binshɛŋa din wuhiri n chɔɣinsi ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu.
en: If I must boast, I will boast about the things that show I am weak.

dag: Zaŋm neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni zaŋ ti a ni a zaŋ ti Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni, ka bɛ mal li tumdi yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma la ti.
en: You will deliver the equipment that has been given to you for the service of Gods house to the God of Jerusalem.

dag: Dama bindirigu bi kpɛrila ninsal suhu ni, amaa o pul ni ka di kpɛra, ka gariti yira.
en: Food does not go into a persons mind. It goes into the stomach. Then it goes out of the body.

dag: Ka Reechɛl bidibisi daa nyɛ Yisifu mini Bɛnjamin.
en: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku yi nahu sɔŋ yi ninni, amaa ka yi ku ŋub o nimdi, ka bɛ ti fa yi buŋa yi ninni chaŋ, ka ku lan zaŋ o labisina ti tin ya. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi piɛri ti yi dimnima, ka so kani ŋun ni sɔŋ ya.
en: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.

dag: Dama mani n-yihi bɛ ni zaŋ bimbihili shɛli gahigahi la mini bɛ ni zaŋ nudirigu gbali shɛli mali Izraɛlnim suhudoo sara la Izraɛlnim sani n-zaŋ li ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli ʒiɛman kam ni.
en: I have taken the breast of the uplifted offering and the thigh that is given by the Israelites from their communal sacrifices of well-being, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as a permanent portion from the Israelites.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛl o deemba maa, Niriba maa kanimina ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ Naawuni yɛla.
en: Moses answered, I must do this because the people come to me to learn God's will.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mali suhupiɛlli bɛn je ma daashaara nyabu zuɣu bee m mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu ni paai ba zuɣu.
en: I have never been happy when my enemies were destroyed. I have never laughed at my enemies when bad things happened to them.

dag: bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya ba ni ti bɔhira, Bɛ lee be ya ni.
en: they will perish forever like their dung; those who saw them will say, Where are they.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli din yɛli ni Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la niŋ pali; dina n-chɛ ka Naawuni daa bol o o zo.
en: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him. That's how Abraham became God's friend.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka boli Aduna mini Miriam, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kana ti zani.
en: and the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud, stood at the entrance of the Tent, and called out, Aaron! Miriam! The two of them stepped forward.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu n-nyɛ: piɛbihi ayi bɛn paai yuuni dabisili kam, ka kul niŋdi lala sahakam.
en: Each day you must sacrifice two lambs a year old.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa wuh o maa, ka Ibrahimma me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani, ka zaŋ dari maa pa di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga. Di saha ka o daa lo o bia Yisahaku maa mihi n-zaŋ o pa bimbini maa zuɣu dari maa zuɣu.
en: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yiɣisi dol o paɣ maa chaŋ doo maa sani ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa tɔɣisi paɣ ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa la? Ka o yɛli, mani.
en: Manoah went with his wife and asked the man, Are you the one who spoke to my wife? Yes, I am, he answered.

dag: Binnɛma anahi maa daa yi ti tibigiri ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni ka tir o jilima, ka paɣiri ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu maa saha shɛli.
en: The four living creatures sing songs of glory and honor and thanks to the one who sits on the throne, who lives forever and ever. When they do so.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ piɛri mini niɣi ti Abimilɛk, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lo tab alikauli.
en: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.

dag: Izraɛlnim kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Parɔsh daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: the descendants of Parosh:.

dag: Pool ni daa lab du duu maa ni nti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro ŋubi naai, o daa lan gbaai ba la yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu n-daa mali lala hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o naanyi chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ.
en: Then Paul went upstairs again, broke off some pieces of bread and ate. He spoke to them a long time. It was early morning when he finished, and then he left.

dag: Ka Pita daa yaag o noli yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni shiri bi gaŋdi niriba;.
en: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu m-mali sara ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla taali sanyoo sara maligu.
en: He must bring these things to the altar as a gift to the Lord . It is a guilt offering.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ka buchi be; ka di mi ka buchi so sani.
en: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, o lan bom wain din nyɛ binnyura sara la lita yini pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu bee piɛbil kam sara zuɣu.
en: Each time you offer a lamb as a burnt offering or sacrifice, you must also prepare a quart of wine as a drink offering.

dag: N ni ku Asirianim bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu no ba n zoya la zuɣu, ka tiligi n niriba Asirianim maa ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: I will destroy the Assyrians in my land of Israel and trample them on my mountains. I will free my people from the Assyrian yoke and from the burdens they have had to bear.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma pal yɛlinli ka n yaari n naba chana, ka n naba daa bi sarigi.
en: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka a ni du m-ba a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli ni o ku zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni.
en: Say this to Judahs King Hezekiah: Dont let the God you trust in persuade you by saying, Jerusalem wont be handed over to the Assyrian king.

dag: Di yuun pihinahi nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi Anabi Musa zuɣu mɔɣu ni zo shɛli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini m-be tutuɣu ni kaman buɣim la.
en: After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li.
en: Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold.

dag: Ka o daa tim o nyaandoliba ayi n-yɛli ba, Chamiya fɔŋ ni; yi yi ti chirigi do so sol ni ka o ʒiri koyuli, yin doliy o.
en: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, Go into the city. A man carrying a water jar will meet you. Follow him.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o dab paɣa ti do so, ka bɛ na bi yo o zuɣu bee ka dab paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni, ka o dan maa lan zaŋ o dɔni, di simdi ka bɛ vihi yɛlli maa. Di bi simdi ka bɛ ku ba, dama paɣa maa na bi yi dabitim ni.
en: If a man has sexual relations with a woman who is a slave engaged to another man, who hasnt yet been released or given her freedom, there must be a punishment. But they will not be put to death because she had not yet been freed.

dag: N di yuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chirindi ya maa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dii leela namɔɣilisi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: I wish that the people who are upsetting you would go all the way; let them go on and castrate themselves!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni naai ma zaa, o ku m mini bɛn be zaa.
en: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;.

dag: Dinzuɣu di kariya so saria ka saha na bi paai bee ka ti Duuma na bi labina. Ŋuna n-ni ti chɛ ka binshɛɣukam din be zibisim ni yi palo, ka ni ti vii daadamnim suhuri ni ashiya wuhi palɔni. Di saha maa ka sokam ni ti nya paɣibu din simd o Naawuni sani.
en: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya alikauli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi di nasara yi tuuni kam ni.
en: Obey faithfully all the terms of this covenant, so that you will be successful in everything you do.

dag: Hal a yɛn yɛlimi ni m mali galimi? A wuhimi ni m mali galimi din ni wuhi ni a mali yɛlimaŋli?.
en: Are you trying to prove that I am unjust— to put me in the wrong and yourself in the right?.

dag: Ka Naomi daa bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya di zaa lala? Ŋun puu ni ka a chaŋ ti yih a kayiha maa? Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi nya a maa ni! Di saha ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi ni do so ŋun yuli booni Bɔaz la puu ni ka o chaŋ ti yihi kayiha maa.
en: Naomi said, Where did you work today? Whose field was it? God bless the man who treated you so well! Then Ruth told her that she had worked in the field of a man named Boaz.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zahimmi yɛlli maa ka baŋ a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm; dama dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi tahi zaɣ biɛɣu ti kpɛm maa sanna n-tabil o yiŋnim zaa, ka o mi yɛla kpɛm pam ka nir ku tooi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: He's a bully who won't listen to anyone. Isn't there something you can do? Please think of something! Or else our master and his family and everyone who works for him are all doomed.

dag: Ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-lu naa sizuura, ka naa bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Bathsheba bowed down before the king. The king asked, What can I do for you.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi ti ŋubi binʒim, chɛliya ka di yi m-bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: But you must not eat their blood; you must pour it out on the ground like water.

dag: Niŋmiya bin zusanim niŋ yi ni yɛri situr shɛŋa naŋgbambiya anahi.
en: Tie several pieces of thread together. Then put these tassels on the four corners of the robes you wear.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n sɔɣila a sani; fam ma bɛn zaa kariti doli ma la nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma.
en: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.

dag: O yuri wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ yurilim maŋli kul palila dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.

dag: Yisifu daa laɣim bindira maa sɔŋ ka di galisim ti ŋmanila teeku ni bihigu hal ka o ti bi lan niŋdi di laasabu, dama nir daa naan ku tooi lan niŋ di laasabu.
en: Joseph stored so much grain that it was like the sands of the sea. He stored so much grain that it could not be measured.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn pii zaɣ suŋ ka zaɣisi zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni ti zo ka chɛ nanima ayi shɛb bɛn kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm ŋɔ tiŋgbana maa.
en: Even before that time comes, the lands of those two kings who terrify you will be deserted.

dag: Daadam, piimi dapaɣili sabi, Juda dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka a lan pii dapaɣili shɛli sabi Yisifu dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, The kingdom of Judah. Then get another stick and write on it, The kingdom of Israel.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm buɣisi ya m-bɔŋɔ: m po Firawuna ni yi ku kuli ka pa ni yi tizo ŋun nyɛ yi zaa biasani maa gba kala kpe na.
en: and I'm going to find out the truth. I swear by the life of the king that you won't leave this place until your youngest brother comes here.

dag: Chɛ ka a tuma yi zahira a daba sani; ka chɛ ka a jilima ŋɔ yi zahira bɛ bihi sani.
en: Let your acts be seen by your servants; let your glory be seen by their children.

dag: ka daa suhi ti Duuma n-yɛli, Nyin ti Duuma ŋun mi niriba zaa suhuri ŋɔ, wuhim ti a ni pii so niriba ayi ŋɔ ni.
en: They prayed, Lord, you know the minds of all people. Show us which one of these two men you choose to do this work. Judas turned away from it and went where he belongs. Lord, show us which man should take his place as an apostle.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din ni sɔŋ daadamnim bɛ dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu din bi yuura, ka ka buchi ŋɔ puuni? Bɛ nyɛviya chanimi gariti kaman shilinshia la. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: How can anyone know what is best for us in this short, useless life of ours—a life that passes like a shadow? How can we know what will happen in the world after we die?.

dag: Ka Giliad sapashinnim daa bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni chaŋ ti piligi Ammɔnnim ŋɔ tuhibu? Dilan ni leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: There the people and the leaders of the Israelite tribes asked one another, Who will lead the fight against the Ammonites? Whoever does will be the leader of everyone in Gilead.

dag: Amaa yinim bi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu ni wuhiri ya shɛm, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi shiri be yi ni, yi ni dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Masia Shia, o pala Masia ni su so.
en: But you are not ruled by your sinful selves. You are ruled by the Spirit, if that Spirit of God really lives in you. But whoever does not have the Spirit of Christ does not belong to Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi dari pam duhi.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: It will be bad for that city of murderers! I will pile up plenty of wood for the fire.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Hɛzɛkia yɛliya, Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini ti zuɣu ni kpahibu ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani n-dɔɣiri ba.
en: This is the message which he told them to give Isaiah: Today is a day of suffering; we are being punished and are in disgrace. We are like a woman who is ready to give birth, but is too weak to do it.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti ku ku a, ti kul yɛn zaŋ a mi ti ti ba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi pala ayi lo o n-zaŋ o tampiŋ lɔŋ maa ni na ti ti ba.
en: All right, they said, we are only going to tie you up and hand you over to them. We won't kill you. So they tied him up with two new ropes and brought him back from the cliff.

dag: Niŋm bɛ zuɣulaannim kaman a ni daa niŋ Orɛb mini Ziib shɛm la; ka niŋ bɛ nanim kaman a ni daa niŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna shɛm la.
en: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.

dag: Ka o bɔhi n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so, ka n yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk nira.
en: Then Saul asked me who I was. I told him that I was an Amalekite.

dag: Di saha ka Naa daa tim boli Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm kpamba zaa na.
en: the king sent a message and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm yi nya ka barina kanna bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa bɛn ka yɛm bɛn ni chaŋ ti kpe di ni n-di wahala.
en: Prudent people see evil and hide; the simpleminded go right to it and get punished.

dag: Di saha maa ha so daa yi yɛn chaŋ shɛli polo ka labina o suhu bi doya; dama tinsi maa nim daa kul zabirimi.
en: In those days no one could come and go in safety, because there was trouble and disorder in every land.

dag: Ka naa maa gba suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o chɛ ka pirinsi kpɛh o duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o gba yo samli maa zaa.
en: The master was very angry, so he put the servant in jail to be punished. And he had to stay in jail until he could pay everything he owed.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu bi saɣi ni bɛ wuhi ni nir mali taali bee galimi zaŋ chaŋ taali shɛlikam tumbu polo naɣila niriba ayi bee niriba ata shɛhira dibu ka yi ni doli n-wuhi ni nir mali taali.
en: One witness is not enough to convict someone of a crime; at least two witnesses are necessary to prove that someone is guilty.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu puuni ka bɛ daa tuhi tin muna tɔbu di nasara. Bɛ daa zali din tuhi tumbu soli, ka daa deei Naawuni ni lo ba binshɛŋa alikaulinim la. Bɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima noya mum.
en: Through faith they conquered kingdoms, brought about justice, realized promises, shut the mouths of lions.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Kulima! A bia maa ni gali. Ka zuɣulan maa daa niŋ Yisa ni yɛl o shɛm maa yɛda, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Jesus answered, Go. Your son will live. The man believed what Jesus told him and went home.

dag: Ka Baalihanan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛda nir la daa lihiri sinsabisi mini olivi tihi din daa be Shɛfɛla la, ka Jɔash daa su kpam ni be du shɛŋa ni fukumsi.
en: in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills—Baal-hanan the Gederite; in charge of the stores of oil—Joash.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Aai, ti ni jɛm Yawɛ.
en: But the people shouted, We won't worship any other gods. We will worship and obey only the Lord .

dag: ka zaŋ nintua n-tu a nyee, ka zaŋ tibikpara kpa a tiba ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupil viɛlli pil a zuɣu.
en: I put a ring in your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yawɛ bɛ yɛlimuɣisira zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa wum li, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim taai bɛ sani n-di bɛ suɣa maa gulinyaansi luɣ shɛŋa.
en: The people started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard their complaints. He heard these things and became angry. Fire from the Lord burned among the people. The fire burned some of the areas at the edge of the camp.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee yi ŋub Daadam Bia niŋgbuŋ ka nyu o ʒim, di yi pa lala yi ku mali nyɛvili.
en: Jesus said, Believe me when I say that you must eat the body of the Son of Man, and you must drink his blood. If you dont do this, you have no real life.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka bɛ bahi ba ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: Early the next morning the brothers and their donkeys were sent back to their country.

dag: Yi ʒiɛmla Izraɛl Naawuni ni pii ya ka woligi ya Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ya mir omaŋa ni yi tumdi tuma ŋun Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni, ka zaani niriba maa tooni n-tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ba la?.
en: You should be happy that the God of Israel chose you to be different from the rest of the Israelites. He lets you come near to him to do the special work in the Lord s Holy Tent to help the Israelites worship him. Isnt that enough?.

dag: Yaa n Duuma, Izraɛlnim yi ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ka ti dimnim nya ti kpaya, wula ka n lee lan yɛn yɛli?.
en: Please forgive me, LORD. What can I say now that Israel has retreated before its enemies?.

dag: Ka alikauli maa daa shiri lɔrigi dindali maa. Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri maa ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri la daa lihiri ma nti baŋ ni Yawɛ n-wuhiri ba shɛli n ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: It was broken on that day. As a result, the afflicted of the flock knew that it was the LORDs word.

dag: Ka Sool bia Jɔnatan daa yiɣisi chaŋ Dauda sani Hɔrɛshi maa nti zaŋ Naawuni yuli kpaŋs o suhu.
en: But Sauls son Jonathan went to see David at Horesh and encouraged him to have a stronger faith in God.

dag: Ka o mali Naawuni Kundi yɛligu kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra, Di daa kpala talahi ni Masia di wahala ka lan neei kum ni, dinzuɣu n ni yihiri Yisa so waazu maa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: to show them that the Messiah had to suffer, but that he would rise from death. Paul also told them that Jesus is the Messiah he was preaching about.

dag: Ninsalinima m-be o sani maa, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ m-be ti sani ni o sɔŋ ti ka tuhi ti tɔb kam ti ti. Ka Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia yɛtɔɣa maa daa kpaŋsi niriba maa suhuri pam.
en: All he has is human strength, but we have the LORD our God, who will help us fight our battles! The troops trusted Judahs King Hezekiah.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikah ayi maa saha shɛli, niriba maa zaa bɛn laɣimm a sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli lan yɛli, Bɛ ni ti lihiri bɛ ni daa zaŋ kpani kuhi so la.
en: and People will look at the one they stabbed.

dag: Wuntizɔra laara nyɛla din tahir o nyɛvili shee, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyɔri nyɛ din kpɛhir o alahichi ni.
en: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la Yawɛ nam ʒiishee, ka zuliya kam zaa ti laɣim ka Yawɛ tooni na Jɛrusalɛm maa, ka bɛ ti ku lan niŋ tipawumli n-doli bɛ maŋmaŋ suhuyubu din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: At that time, they will call Jerusalem the LORDs throne, and all nations will gather there to honor the LORDs name. No longer will they follow their own willful and evil hearts.

dag: A ni kpi ŋun bi guni kum tinzunnim nuu ni. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala. .
en: You will die like a dog at the hand of godless foreigners. I, the Sovereign Lord , have given the command.

dag: Bɛ teei gili ba kaman puguliba ni niŋdi shɛm la, bɛ ni taai duŋ zaɣisi ma la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They hem her in like those guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ Naawuni nir maa sani Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu. Naawuni Nir maa ni daa nya paɣ maa ka o kanna ka o yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Nyama, Shunɛm paɣ la m-be katiŋ kanna ŋɔ.
en: She left at once for Mount Carmel to talk with Elisha. When Elisha saw her coming, he said, Gehazi, look! It's the woman from Shunem.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Balaam, Labimi ti zaŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm yɛli Balak.
en: The Lord gave Balaam a message, then sent him back to tell Balak.

dag: Dama di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Nyama, n zaŋ kuɣ shɛli sɔŋ Ziɔn. Di nyɛla kuɣ gahindili shɛli Naawuni ni pii ka lihi li ka di mali buchi. Ka ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: They answered, When you sit on your throne in your glorious Kingdom, we want you to let us sit with you, one at your right and one at your left.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dɔɣi Anabi Musa, ka o daa viɛli pam ka Naawuni nini tiɣ o, ka o ba min o ma daa mal o duu hal ti paai chira ata.
en: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.

dag: N tuumbiɛri mini n daalahichi lee nyɛla diba ala? Chɛ ka m baŋ m biriginsim mini n daalahichi.
en: How many are my offenses and sins? Inform me about my rebellions and sins.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma, Amɔs, bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n yɛl o, Bimbuɣisirigu. Di saha ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Nyama, n zaŋla bimbuɣisirigu sɔŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni; n ku lan ka bɛ sanna yaha.
en: The LORD said to me, Amos, what do you see? A plumb line, I said. Then the LORD said, See, I am setting a plumb line in the middle of my people Israel. I will never again forgive them.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani fabindi ka mali suhugarigu. Ka Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ tihi suui; ka Sharɔn vinvamli niŋ kaman tiŋgban nɛl la; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu tihi suura.
en: The land mourned; it wasted away; Lebanon was ashamed; it withered. Sharon became like the desert, and Bashan and Carmel were dropping their leaves.

dag: A daa lan nya napɔnvari mini napombihi la ka di shɛli polo nyɛla yaɣiri, ka shɛli polo mi nyɛ kuriti. Di nam maa ni ti pirigi. Di ni ti mali kuriti kpiɔŋ la shɛli, kuriti maa mini yaɣiri ni gari tab la zuɣu.
en: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tuumba maa mini yɛdaniŋdib bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa wum ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The apostles and the believers in Judea heard that non-Jewish people had accepted Gods teaching too.

dag: Wuhim ma ka n niŋ a yubu, dama nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Chɛ ka a Shi suŋ maa wuhi ma soli din tuhi.
en: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti miri lubu saha shɛli, ka gom daa gbaai Ibram pam ka o dɔni gbihi, ka zibisim titali din mali dabiɛm pam daa zibig o sani.
en: The sun began to go down and Abram got very sleepy. While he was asleep, a very terrible darkness came over him.

dag: Yɛlim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni o wuhim a shihirili; di ni tooi nyɛ din zilima kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee din du kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: Ask a sign from the LORD your God. Make it as deep as the grave or as high as heaven.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka n tɛhi kurimbuni ha yɛla, ka teei yuun shɛŋa din gari la yɛla.
en: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini, ka zaŋ Olivi tihi kpam din viɛli lita yini ŋ-ŋmiri li mali chi sara.
en: Along with each of them, one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ba n-yɛn deei Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini di tooni ha tiŋgbana maa su, tinim ni yɛn deei tiŋgban shɛŋa su bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ na.
en: We wont inherit land with them there across the Jordan, because weve received our property on the east side of the Jordan.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi fuɣ o gbaŋ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi to n-chib o kuriti gbaɣino ziɣinli ŋɔ?.
en: Who can remove his outer garment; who can come with a bridle for him?.

dag: Zɛrubabɛl n-sɔŋ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu ŋɔ tampuɣili. O mi ni me li naai. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n niriba maa baŋ ni mani n-shiri tim a bɛ sanna.
en: He said, Zerubbabel has laid the foundation of the Temple, and he will finish the building. When this happens, my people will know that it is I who sent you to them.

dag: Amaa Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la daa bela Ofɛl, ka Ziha mini Gishipa daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba maa zuɣulaannima.
en: The Temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel. Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of the Temple servants.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini yuri n-nya chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi, yuri mi tuhi pinaayi. Ka o daa zaŋ shɛb ti niŋ chɛchɛbunsi tinsi ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be o sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He built up a force of fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand cavalry horses. Some of them he kept in Jerusalem, and the rest he stationed in various other cities.

dag: saha shɛli zaa n ni na kul vuhira, ka Naawuni shia be n nyɛvoya ni ŋɔ.
en: as long as breath is in me and Gods breath is in my nostrils.

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o tuhi nintɔri bahi tiŋa n-niŋ taŋkpaɣu garigari di ni n-zaŋ ʒe zom maa nina;.
en: After he said this, Jesus spat on the ground and made some mud with the spittle; he rubbed the mud on the man's eyes.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi daboli maa zuɣu kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindoo n-du pii zuɣu ti yɛrigi sɔŋ Sool, ka o daa dɔni nimaani gbihi.
en: they went down from the place of worship and back into town. A bed was set up for Saul on the flat roof of Samuel's house.

dag: Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o kpambaliba ni o sapashinnima ni o niriba zaa ni ti nyu li.
en: I also made Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, drink from that cup. I made his officials, his important leaders, and all his people drink from it.

dag: O daa lan zali Lɛvinim maa shɛba ni bɛ nyɛ bɛn yɛn su Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa tuma, ka suhiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka puhir o ka paɣir o.
en: David appointed some of the Levites to lead the worship of the Lord , the God of Israel, in front of the Covenant Box, by singing and praising him.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ka biŋkɔb so ti tɔhi zanina. O daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, amaa ka kpiŋkpama anahi din ŋmani nooŋa kpiŋkpama lee sa o yaaŋa zuɣu, ka o mali zuɣur anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yiko ti o.
en: While I was watching, another beast appeared. It looked like a leopard, but on its back there were four wings, like the wings of a bird, and it had four heads. It had a look of authority about it.

dag: Dinzuɣu sokam bɔɣiri ni cheei kom, ka bɛ ku lan mali suhukpeeni.
en: Everyone's hands will hang limp, and everyone's courage will fail.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm nyɛla ŋun mi yɛla woligibu, yɛtɔɣa viɛla mi kpaŋsiri balima.
en: People will know if someone is wise. Those who choose their words carefully can be very convincing.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yisifu biɛyanim maa, Tuun bɔ n-lee nyɛ yi tuma? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ mini ti yaannim nyɛla piɛguliba.
en: The king asked them, What is your occupation? We are shepherds, sir, just as our ancestors were, they answered.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa wum Naawuni zaligu kundi maa ni yɛli shɛm, o daa darigimi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law , he tore his clothes to show he was sad and upset.

dag: Ka zuliya biɛɣu ŋɔ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn kpalim, ka be n ni kari ba bahi luɣ shɛŋa zaa, bɛ ni ti paɣi kum gari biɛhigu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, wherever I have scattered them, declares the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa garigi yɛli Jɛfita, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, hal Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti min a zaa shɛhiralana.
en: Gileads elders replied to him, The LORD is our witness; we will surely do what youve said.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma yaha, N nyaya ka niriba maa nyɛla tipawumlinim ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.

dag: Ka Pirɔs bia Sɔpata ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛria tiŋbia la mini Aristakus ni Sɛkundus bɛn daa nyɛ Tɛsalɔnaika tiŋbihi la ni Gaiɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Dɛɛbi tiŋbia la ni Timoti m-pahi Tikikus mini Trɔfimus bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la daa dol o chaŋ.
en: With him were Sopater, son of Pyrrhus from Berea, and Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica. Gaius from Derbe was also with him, and so were Timothy and the two Asians, Tychicus and Trophimus.

dag: Bɛ ni mɛri yiya shɛŋa maa ŋmanila tɛri, ka ŋmani puguliba suɣa.
en: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.

dag: Wuntizɔra ŋɔ daa bela niriba ŋɔ ni, ka o ni daa nyari shɛli ka wumdi shɛli dabisili kam daa nyɛla niriba maa tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din kul chihir o suhu.
en: While that righteous man lived among them he felt deep distress every day on account of the immoral actions he saw and heard.

dag: Yi ninni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim puuni zoli gbini la.
en: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire.

dag: O daa bela tiŋ maa gomna ŋun yuli daa booni Sɛrigius Poolus ŋun mali yɛm pam la yiŋa. Ka gomna maa daa boli Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti tɔɣis o Naawuni yɛligu.
en: He also worked for Sergius Paulus, who was very smart and was the governor of the island. Sergius Paulus wanted to hear God's message, and he sent for Barnabas and Saul.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali nti paai jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋa, ka o nya ka salo be nimaani yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri, ka kumdi ka fabinda.
en: They came to the synagogue leaders house, and he saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.

dag: Ka naa mini Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi la ka bɛ bo tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan bo bɛn mi kuriti mini daanya tuma ni bɛ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.

dag: N yuya ni yi baŋ ni timaŋ buɣisibu pala din nyaŋ ti.
en: I trust you will know that we are not failures.

dag: Kpahimmi Naawuni tuma; o yi niŋ shɛli ka di gbiligi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi mal li zali dɛde?.
en: Look at what God has made. You cannot change a thing, even if you think it is wrong.

dag: Biɛrim yɛn ti ma la daŋa, n dimnim ni tam a yɛligu yɛla zuɣu.
en: My anger burns in me like a fire, because my enemies disregard your commands.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba birigi n-dari gindi yɔɣu n-chaŋ hal ti kpi.
en: Caravans turn aside from their paths; they go up into untamed areas and perish.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Bɛtilihɛm maa ka Mariama dɔɣibu saha paai.
en: While Joseph and Mary were in Bethlehem, the time came for her to have the baby.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, a kum dabisa miriya, bolimi Jɔshua ka yi ka man Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni na ka n ti zaŋ tuma maa ti o. Ka Musa mini Jɔshua daa chaŋ Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Now the time is near for you to die. Get Joshua and come to the Meeting Tent. I will tell Joshua what he must do. So Moses and Joshua went to the Meeting Tent.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ti zaŋ tihi maa da shɛŋa m-mali buɣim wuɣisi; ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim she bɔrɔbɔro. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ di shɛŋa mali wuna mini binnana zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li.
en: It becomes suitable to burn for humans, so he takes some of the wood and warms himself. He kindles fire and bakes bread. He fashions a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnim hal ti gbahi ba; n daa bi chɛ ba dolibu hal ti ku bɛ zaa ha.
en: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm, tiŋ maa zaa daa dammi ka bɛ bɔhira, Ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: Then Jesus went into Jerusalem. All the people in the city were confused. They asked, Who is this man.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim daa wum Filistianim ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa.
en: The people living in Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines did to Saul.

dag: Ti mali tahima maŋli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama ti mi ni ti mini ya ni laɣim di wahala shɛm, lala ka ti mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nya suhumaabo.
en: Our hope for you is strong. We know that you share in our sufferings. So we know that you also share in our comfort.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka ŋunkam mi chibi gooni voli, wahu ni dim o.
en: If you dig a pit, you might fall in; if you break down a wall, a snake might bite you.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlabil yino mali sara asiba, ka zaŋ piɛlabil so ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali sara zaawuni.
en: one will be sacrificed in the morning, and the other in the evening.

dag: Ka Mikal daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o doli takɔro ni yi n-zo n-tiligi.
en: She let him down from a window, and he ran away and escaped.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu! A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, wummi n fabila. A wuntitali puuni, deemi n suhigu!.
en: Lord , hear my prayer! In your righteousness listen to my plea; answer me in your faithfulness!.

dag: N saha yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni; tiligim ma n dimnim mini bɛn niŋdi ma alaka nuu ni.
en: My life is in your hands. Save me from those who are persecuting me.

dag: Ka jɛra la daa yɛli bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim la, Niŋmiya yi kpam ŋɔ shɛli ti ti, dama tinim firilanim maa kpirimi.
en: the foolish ones said to the others, Let us have some of your oil! Our lamps are going out.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi zuɣu ka kukoli maa tɔɣisiri maa, pa n zuɣu.
en: Then Jesus told the crowd, That voice spoke to help you, not me.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o paɣ min o bidibisi balisi buŋa n-labi Ijipti, ka daa zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee la gbib o nuu ni.
en: So Moses took his wife and his sons, put them on a donkey, and set out with them for Egypt, carrying the walking stick that God had told him to take.

dag: Ka Nahɔr mam ŋun yuli daa booni Riuma la mi daa dɔɣi Tɛba mini Gaham ni Tahash ni Maaka.
en: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-zaŋ so, amaa di zaŋ li tim kom ni.
en: The Lord told me, Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.

dag: Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa nyɛla bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni. Hal n jɛmbu duu puuni n nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord , that you even sin in my own temple!.

dag: Amaa Jɔab daa bi kali Lɛvi zuliya mini Bɛnjamin zuliya bɛna, dama naa zaligu maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: Joab refused to include anyone from the tribes of Levi and Benjamin, because he still disagreed with David's orders.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Mɛrab ti Dauda, bɛ daa ŋmalig o mi ti do so ŋun yuli booni Adiriɛl ka o nyɛ Mɛholat nir la, ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: But when the time came for Merab to be given to David, she was given instead to a man named Adriel from Meholah.

dag: Kul paɣimiya Yawɛ ka duhimiy o yuli, ka molimiy o tuma yɛla zuliya kam ni.
en: Give thanks to the Lord and call out to him! Tell the nations what he has done!.

dag: Ka doo maa min o paɣa Awa daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Keen ka yɛli, N nya ninsala Yawɛ sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: Adam had sexual relations with his wife Eve. She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Cain. Eve said, With the Lord s help, I have made a man.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma ti kpe dundombil ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The Lord 's spirit lifted me up and took me into the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Temple was filled with the glory of the Lord .

dag: Paɣ maa daa yɛla ago ʒiɛɣu, ka o luɣilikam nyaɣim salima mini kuɣ viɛla yɛri ni waya, ka o gbib salima pipia o nuu ni ka chihi biɛri min o zina niŋbu tabizahim daɣiri pal li.
en: The woman wore purple and scarlet clothing, and she glittered with gold and jewels and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup full of the vile and impure things that came from her activity as a prostitute.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛli niŋ bɛ baɣaka ʒiɛmdila bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn wum saɣisigu ni nya tɛhi zilima.
en: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa gbaai ma Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la.
en: That is why some men grabbed me in the temple and tried to kill me.

dag: Juda ni daa nya o, o daa tɛhiya ni o nyɛla pagɔrili, dama o daa zaŋla sariga m-pil lims o ninni.
en: Judah traveled on that road and saw her, but he thought that she was a prostitute.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: O ni be alizanda ni ka timna ti tiligi ma. O ni chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn duri tamdi n zuɣu la di vi. Naawuni ni wuhi ma o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ n sani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He will answer from heaven and save me; he will defeat my oppressors. God will show me his constant love and faithfulness.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem o nina ka o nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei nachimbil maa nina ka o lihi nya ka yuri mini buɣim chɛchɛbunsi n-kul pali zoli zuɣu n-teei gili Ilaisha.
en: Then he prayed, O Lord , open his eyes and let him see! The Lord answered his prayer, and Elisha's servant looked up and saw the hillside covered with horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

dag: Dunianim mini zuɣusaa binnamda, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku mini binnɛma bɛn be di ni, yomiya vuri;.
en: Let heaven celebrate! Let the earth rejoice! Let the sea and everything in it roar!.

dag: Di saha maa ka yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be Ziɔn din nyɛ n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni nyɛla tin shɛli din be kasi, ka tinzunnim ku lan tooi tuhi fa li yaha.
en: Then you will know that I am the Lord your God. I live on Zion, my holy mountain. Jerusalem will become holy. Strangers will never pass through that city again.

dag: Pool ni daa lab du duu maa ni nti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro ŋubi naai, o daa lan gbaai ba la yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu n-daa mali lala hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o naanyi chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ.
en: After Paul had gone back upstairs, he broke bread, and ate with us. He then spoke until dawn and left.

dag: A halli zuɣu ka n daa zo a dabiɛm, dama a bɔri ni a nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri a ni bi biri binshɛli.
en: You are a hard man, and I was afraid of you. You take what isn't yours, and you harvest crops you didn't plant.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yaai n noli, ka o zaŋ gbaŋ maa ti ma ni n ŋubi.
en: So I opened my mouth and he put the scroll into my mouth.

dag: Ka bɛ yiɣisi zani n-yɛrigi luɣilikam chaŋ ti teei gili Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda biɛhigu shee mini Naawuni tin yurigu la; ka buɣim ti yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba.
en: I saw Satans army march across the earth and gather around the camp of Gods people and the city that God loves. But fire came down from heaven and destroyed Satans army.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niriba taari duŋ, di malila zuɣulaan bɔbigu, amaa zuɣulaan so ŋun mali yɛm yi dira, binshɛlikam niŋdila viɛnyɛliŋga yuui.
en: When a land rebels, there are many leaders; but a person with understanding brings order.

dag: Samsin daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisi shɛŋa puuni Filistianim ni daa su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: Samson led Israel for twenty years during the time of the Philistines.

dag: Dama dabisili maa miriya. Yawɛ dabisili maa miriya; di ni ti nyɛla sagbana dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla mbusim dabisili zuliya kam sani.
en: The day is coming, the day of the LORD comes, a day of clouds: the nations time has come.

dag: Dama o daŋ maa pala din ni tibi kpaŋ. Di looi Judanima. Di paai n niriba dunɔdal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Samaria's wounds cannot be healed, and Judah is about to suffer in the same way; destruction has reached the gates of Jerusalem itself, where my people live.

dag: Amaa ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋ hal ka o ti saɣi ka Amnɔn mini nabihi maa zaa daa dol o chaŋ.
en: But Absalom kept on insisting, and finally David let Amnon and all his other sons go with Absalom. Absalom prepared a banquet fit for a king.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛli Mariama, A mal alibarika paɣiba ni, ka bi so ŋun be a pul ni ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam maa, bɛ zaŋm daɣiri ni yibu sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim tampiligim niŋ tahili ni, ka booi kɔzɔrim kom niŋ di ni;.
en: If you have become unclean, someone must use the ashes from the burned cow to make you clean again. They must pour fresh water over the ashes into a jar.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi bihi ni. Alibarika ni ti be yi puri atam ni, alibarika ni ti be yi biŋkɔbiri bihi ni. Yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi ni ti nabi.
en: The Lord will bless you with many children, with abundant crops, and with many cattle and sheep.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin o ni daa di nam saha shɛli maa.
en: Joash was seven years old when he became king.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa nya pakoli maa ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu ka o yɛl o, Di kuhira.
en: When the Lord saw the woman, he felt sorry for her and said, Don't cry.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ba ba bandi, ka bɛ be wahala mia ni.
en: But if people are bound in chains, suffering for what they have done.

dag: Nimaani ka tuumbiɛtumdiba la lu n-doya. Bɛ daai ba mi luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: Look—right there is where the evildoers have fallen, pushed down, unable to get up!.

dag: M Ba ni yuri ma shɛm, lala ka n gba yuri ya. Benya n yurilim ni.
en: I love you just as the Father loves me; remain in my love.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu n-chɛ ka n kpi zaŋ chaŋ di dolibu polo ni di chɛ ka n tooi be Naawuni zuɣu.
en: So far as the Law is concerned, however, I am dead—killed by the Law itself—in order that I might live for God. I have been put to death with Christ on his cross.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin dali. Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka yi puhiri Yawɛ chuɣu maa.
en: For seven days you must eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day there is to be a festival to honor the Lord .

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ Sool sani nti nya ka dabiɛm gbaai Sool pam ka o yɛl o, Nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛli maa, m mi zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima, ka niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The woman approached Saul, and after seeing how scared he was, she said, Listen, your servant has obeyed you. I risked my life and did what you told me to do.

dag: Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili! Naawuni chɛ ka bɛ ʒi salima yi Shiiba na ti ti o. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni tir o sahakam. Chɛ ka niriba suhimi Naawuni daalibarika niŋd o ni dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Long live the king! May he be given gold from Sheba; may prayers be said for him at all times; may God's blessings be on him always!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zuɣu a lan pala dabili, amaa a nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka a yi nyɛla Naawuni bia, dindina a nyɛla ŋun dir o bini.
en: Now you are not slaves like before. You are Gods children, and you will receive everything he promised his children.

dag: Tola kum nyaaŋa, ka Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la gba daa leei Izraɛlnim sariakarita yuun pisinaayi.
en: After Tola came Jair from Gilead. He led Israel for twenty-two years.

dag: A tintarisi bela teeku puuni. Bɛn daa me a, daa me a ka a viɛl zaa.
en: and your control of the sea. You are a ship built to perfection.

dag: N suhir o ni o neei yi tɛha ka yi nya o neesim, ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ o ni boli ya tahima shɛli zuɣu min o ni lo o niriba alahiziba alibarika shɛŋa alikaulinim la.
en: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛli, Gunibu ŋɔ zuɣu a shiri nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: Zipporah said this because she had to circumcise her son. So God let Moses live.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka teeku kom nyuui, ka a mali soli kom puuni sɔŋ, ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la dol li du.
en: You dried up the water that was in the deep sea. You made a road through the deepest parts of the sea. Your people crossed over and were saved.

dag: Bɛ daa yi darila yuri Ijipti mini tiŋgban shɛŋa din pahi zaa ni na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: Solomon's horses were brought in from other countries, including Musri.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti tooi li ti niriba maa ni bɛ piɛbi. Bɛ ni daa piɛbiri ʒiɛri maa ka bɛ ti kuhi yɛli, Wɛi, Naawuni nira, Lɔɣu be duɣu maa ni! Ka bɛ daa kɔŋ li piɛbbu.
en: The stew was served, and when the prophets started eating it, they shouted, Elisha, this stew tastes terrible! We can't eat it.

dag: Di saha maa ka o nyaandoliba maa daa baŋ ni Jɔn Baptaizira yɛla ka o yɛri ba maa.
en: Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum saa tahibu mini kikaa maa kumsi, ka nya saa nyaɣisibu mini nyɔhi ni mɔni zoli maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ daa kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: The people trembled with fear when they heard the thunder and the trumpet and saw the lightning and the smoke coming from the mountain. They stood a long way off.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga.
en: Rebekah answered, My father is Bethuel, the son of Milcah and Nahor.

dag: Ka takɔb dirili yir o nol ni na, ka o zaŋ li n-zabi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba; ka siɣi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka puuni nɔri ginda.
en: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi do n-gbihira? Yiɣisimiya yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: He said to them, Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray that you will not fall into temptation.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni booni tab yɛra, Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: They are like children sitting in the marketplace. One group of children calls to the other children and says, We played flute music for you, but you did not dance; we sang a sad song, but you did not cry.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ni leei faralana ni vidira, amaa ŋun deeri wuhibu ni nya jilima.
en: Poverty and shame come to those who dont care about instruction; honor belongs to those who heed correction.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛri ni bɛ jɛmdila mani, amaa ka bɛ ni yɛri shɛm ka gbinni, dama bɛ suhuri bela katiŋ ka chɛ ma. Ninsalinim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya soli ka bɛ doli jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord has said: These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa wum ni Itiɔpia naa Tirihaka mini Ijipti tɔbbihi kanna ni bɛ ti tuh o. O ni daa wum lala maa, ka o tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani.
en: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:.

dag: Dinzuɣu taɣimiya biɛhigu yi suhuri ni, ka di lan nyɛnya tipawumlinima.
en: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa la sani ti yɛl o, Ti suhir a, chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni gari kuli ti ya.
en: Then the Israelites sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites and king of Heshbon and said to him, Please allow us to pass through your land to our own place.

dag: Dama, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini m-pii ba dunia ŋɔ ninsalinim zaa ni ni a su ba kaman a ni daa chɛ ka a dabili Musa yɛl ba shɛm saha shɛli a ni daa yihi ti yaannim maa Ijipti na la.
en: When you brought our ancestors out of Egypt, you told your servant Moses to say to them, From all people on earth, the Lord God has chosen you to be his very own.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: May the grace and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti bii na, ka Naawuni chɛ ka pɔhim tulli yi wulimpuhili polo ʒiɛna, n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ kpe Jona hal ka o ti yɛn pabigi. Ka Jona daa bɔri ni o kpi, ka yɛli, N kum so o bebu.
en: Then as the sun rose God provided a dry east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonahs head so that he became faint. He begged that he might die, saying, Its better for me to die than to live.

dag: Zahimmiya dimbɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn tam Naawuni yɛla ŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni dari tɔhi ya zaa ka so ku tooi fan ya bahi.
en: So consider this carefully, all you who forget God, or Ill rip you to pieces with no one to deliver you.

dag: Ka bɛ mabihi maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la daa nyɛ bɛn maani bɔrɔbɔro kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani sara Vuhim Dabisili dali kam la.
en: The Levites from the Kohath clan were in charge of baking the sacred loaves of bread for each Sabbath.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna yɛra, Yinima n-ku Yawɛ niriba maa.
en: On the next day the entire Israelite community complained to Moses and Aaron, You killed the LORDs people.

dag: Amaa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka bɛ daa lan puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiahs rule, this Passover was celebrated to the LORD in Jerusalem.

dag: Dama o zuliya ni ti galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ, ka dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa ni ti nya alibarika la o zuɣu.
en: Abraham will certainly become a great populous nation, and all the earths nations will be blessed because of him.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni tam pagɔr so yɛla ŋɔ, kpuɣim a mɔɣilo chaŋ gili tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛm biŋkumda ka di nyaɣisa, ka yili yila pam ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan teeg a yɛla.
en: Take your harp, go round the town, you poor forgotten whore! Play and sing your songs again to bring men back once more.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋdi bimbira tiri ŋun birita, ka chɛ ka o nyari bindirigu, ni tiri yi gba m-pahiri yi ni mali shɛli zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi nirilim niŋbu zooi pahi.
en: God is the one who gives seed to those who plant, and he gives bread for food. And God will give you spiritual seed and make that seed grow. He will produce a great harvest from your goodness.

dag: Aai, m bia! Aai, m pul ni bia! Aai, n nɔpoli bia!.
en: No, my son! No, son of my womb! No, son of my solemn promises!.

dag: Ti ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la, lala ka n na kul yɛri ya yaha: So yi yihiri lahibal sun shɛli waazu din be di ko ka chɛ yi ni daa pun deei shɛl la, mbusim be dilan zuɣu!.
en: Im repeating what weve said before: if anyone preaches something different from what you received, they should be under a curse!.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ka nya jilima shɛli din nyɛ naa jilima n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee. Ka maligumaana ni ʒe m-baɣ o nam ʒiishee maa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa ni laɣim tumdi ni suhudoo ni naŋgban yini.
en: He will build the LORDs temple. He will be majestic; he will sit and rule on his throne. There will be a priest on his throne, and the two of them will share a peaceable plan.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ daa yi n zuɣu Luz Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, God Almighty appeared to me in Luz in the land of Canaan. He blessed me.

dag: amaa ka niŋ tipawumli n-dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu n-jɛmdi Baalinima kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa wuhi ba shɛm la zuɣu.
en: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.

dag: n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ka yɛli, N niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu m-bala. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ teemi n yɛla.
en: and gave thanks for it. Then he divided the bread and said, This is my body; it is for you. Eat this to remember me.

dag: Ka Musa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ ni daa be putɔɣu dabitim bandi shɛli ni maa zuɣu.
en: Moses told this to the Israelites. But they didnt listen to Moses, because of their complete exhaustion and their hard labor.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ puhiri ya, di bahi bamdi bɛn be Naa Siiza yiŋ la.
en: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.

dag: M mabihi, m paɣi ti tizɔpaɣ so ŋun yuli booni Fiibi, ka o nyɛ ŋun tumdi Naawuni tuma Sɛnkiria cheechi ni la.
en: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛndana saɣisigu, di so ni o wum jɛrigu yila.
en: It is better to obey the reprimand of the wise than to listen to the song of fools.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, labisim ti na yaha, ka ku a suhuyiɣisili la zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: Our God and Savior, accept us again. Dont be angry with us anymore.

dag: Ka o sɔŋda maa daa zaŋ li ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri ŋub li ka guui kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So the servant served the bread and grain to the people. They ate and still had some left over, just as the Lord had promised.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, To, n kana! Ka m malila yiko din ni tooi yɛli shɛli? Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni, dina ka n yɛn tɔɣisi.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Ive now come to you. But Im only able to speak whatever word God gives me to say. That is what I will speak.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana ni Shimɛi yila Jɛrusalɛm n-chaŋ Gaat ka labina.
en: Solomon was told that Shimei had left Jerusalem for Gath and then returned.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, O tum zina hal ti gbarigi, amaa ka dɔbba na kul bɔr o.
en: And I said to myself that they were using as a prostitute a woman worn out by adultery.

dag: N ni kul wuhi ba ka ti ba yaa maa zaa yoli, bɛ bo soya n-tum tuumbiɛri jɛndi ma.
en: Even though I was the one who brought them up and made them strong, they plotted against me.

dag: dimbɔŋɔ gba di yɛn nyɛla taali din simdi ni sariakaritiba darigi n tibili. Dama n daa naan nyɛla ʒiŋmara Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani.
en: Such horrible sins would have deserved punishment from God.

dag: Bɛ daa ʒiɛhira ka jeeni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyu dam kuli, ka bɛ yɛm zaa daa naai la.
en: They were stumbling and falling like someone who is drunk. Their skill as sailors was useless.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa lan yɛli niriba maa, N kɔŋko n-kul kpalim nyɛ Yawɛ daanabi, amaa ka Baal ŋun mali anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu.
en: Then Elijah continued: I am the Lord 's only prophet, but Baal has prophets.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti a biɛli Adɔnija ka o n-niŋ o paɣa.
en: Let Abishag from Shunem be married to your brother Adonijah, she said.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut daa ti yɛli Naomi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti doli kachɛriba yihiri kayiha. M mali tahima ni n ni ti nya so ka o saɣi ka n yihi kayiha o puu ni. Ka Naomi yɛl o, M bia, to chama.
en: Ruth the Moabite said to Naomi, Let me go to the field so that I may glean among the ears of grain behind someone in whose eyes I might find favor. Naomi replied to her, Go, my daughter.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim bɛn daa niŋ zina o sani ni kɔr biɛr la yi ti nya o buɣim dibu nyɔhi, bɛ ni kum ka fabili pam.
en: The kings of the earth who took part in her immorality and lust will cry and weep over the city when they see the smoke from the flames that consume her.

dag: Ŋunkam di nasara ni deei pini ŋɔ n sani, ka n ni nyɛ o Naawuni, ka o mi nyɛ m bia.
en: Those who win the victory will receive this from me: I will be their God, and they will be my children.

dag: Dama o ni ŋubiri mɔ shɛŋa bela zoya ni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ni diɛmda.
en: Grass to feed him grows on the hills where wild beasts play.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: di bɔhiriya tab biɛri; hal so yi lab a nudirigu polo tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o.
en: But now I tell you: do not take revenge on someone who wrongs you. If anyone slaps you on the right cheek, let him slap your left cheek too.

dag: Kɔbilinini Dunɔdali din daa be bɛ tooni la gbini ka bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti du Naa Dauda Tiŋ la dunɔdura din be gooni din be Dauda yiŋ zuɣusaa polo la gbini m-mali ti paai Kom Dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: When they reached the Fountain Gate they went straight up by the stairs of Davids City, on the ascent to the wall, past the house of David to the Water Gate on the east.

dag: Yi goli kam piligu ni, bomiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: At the beginning of every month you will present an entirely burned offering to the LORD: two bulls from the herd, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all flawless.

dag: N Duuma, zom m bidibiga ŋɔ nambɔɣu! O nyɛla kpilinkpihilana, ka di nahind o pam; di kul luhir o la waawaayili, ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni.
en: and said, Sir, have mercy on my son! He is an epileptic and has such terrible attacks that he often falls in the fire or into water.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n nyɛ Masia tumo ŋun ʒe o zaani, ka bɛ lo ma zoligɔnim di zuɣu ŋɔ. Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma ka n tooi mali suhukpeeni n-kul tɔɣisiri lahibal suŋ maa yɛla kaman di ni simdi ni n tɔɣisiri li shɛm.
en: Im an ambassador in chains for the sake of the gospel. Pray so that the Lord will give me the confidence to say what I have to say.

dag: Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a yɛla tɔɣisi m mabihi maa; n ni paɣ a salo laɣiŋgu ni.
en: I will publicly announce your name to my brothers and sisters. I will praise you in the middle of the assembly. .

dag: Tiŋ maa niriba zaa bɔrila bindirigu ka kul ŋuhira. Bɛ zaŋ bɛ daazichi zaa taɣi bindirigu ni bɛ lan nya yaa. Yawɛ, lihimi nya n ni bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem shouts to the Lord , Please look and see how miserable I am.

dag: kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa sab bɛ yuya maa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Amaa ka Pita mini Jɔn bɔhi ba, Naawuni sani, di luhiya ni ti wumla yi noli bee ŋun Naawuni dini? Yɛlimiya ti!.
en: But Peter and John answered them, You yourselves judge which is right in God's sight—to obey you or to obey God.

dag: Nyama, n daa zaŋ o leela shɛhira niriba sani. Ka lan zaŋ o leei niriba toondana ni tɔbbihi zuɣulana.
en: Look, I made him a witness to the peoples, a prince and commander of peoples.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa lo nia yɛli ni bɛ zaa yinoyino bom o yaa ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga, ka bɛ zaŋ talim ti ti bɛ mabihi bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The disciples decided they would send support to the brothers and sisters in Judea, with everyone contributing to this ministry according to each persons abundance.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Kalidia din nyɛ kɔhigɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ la ni, hal ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi dimbɔŋɔ gba.
en: So you turned to Canaan, and then to Babylonia, and still you were not satisfied.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o jilima min o yiko nyɔhi kpe m-pali jɛmbu duu maa, ka so daa bi lan tooi kpe di ni hal ka malaikanima ayopɔin maa alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la tuma zaa ti naai.
en: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory and the power of God. No one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were finished.

dag: yɛli, Nyam doo ŋɔ ni pil o duu ŋɔ mɛbu ka tarigi li me n-naai.
en: They would say, This man began to build, but he was not able to finish.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun nam dunia mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Duuma. O bi be bimbin shɛŋa daadam ni zaŋ o nuhi me zuɣu.
en: He is the God who made the whole world and everything in it. He is the Lord of the land and the sky. He does not live in temples built by human hands.

dag: Hal o yi tum a taali siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin dahin yini ka ŋmaligi deeg o galimi siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin maa zaa, di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ m-paŋ o.
en: Even if someone sins against you seven times in one day and returns to you seven times and says, I am changing my ways, you must forgive that person.

dag: A bi nya ka di nyɛla o yɛda niŋbu min o tuma tumbu n-daa laɣim tum lala maa? Ka o yɛda niŋbu daa niŋ dɛde la o tuma tumbu puuni.
en: See, his faith was at work along with his actions. In fact, his faith was made complete by his faithful actions.

dag: Dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ti mini ya zali Masia ni, ka pii ti.
en: And God is the one who makes you and us strong in Christ. God is also the one who chose us for his work.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm o daalibarika ni zuɣu ka n niŋ tammɛr yɛndana ŋun zali duu gbinni tanzaa, ka so mɛri tamdi di zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam gba yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, ŋun mɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Like an expert builder I built the foundation of that house. I used the gift that God gave me to do this. Other people are building on that foundation. But everyone should be careful how they build.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ŋ-ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni, Ibrahimma Naawuni ni Yisahaku Naawuni ni Yaakubu Naawuni la n-tim ma yi sanna. N yuli m-bala sahakam. Ʒiɛmani kam nim ni yɛn booni ma shɛm m-bala.
en: God continued, Say to the Israelites, The LORD, the God of your ancestors, Abrahams God, Isaacs God, and Jacobs God, has sent me to you. This is my name forever; this is how all generations will remember me.

dag: Amaa ka Olivi tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli bɛ ni mali ma doori kpa shɛli ka di tiri wuna mini ninsalinim jilima la tuma ka leei tihi naa.
en: The olive tree answered, In order to govern you, I would have to stop producing my oil, which is used to honor gods and human beings.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o ni lo ni o niŋ o niriba maa zaɣ biɛ shɛli maa niŋbu.
en: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ ni o kpiɔŋ; Doliya din ni chɛ ka yi kul be o sani sahakam.
en: Pursue the LORD and his strength; seek his face always!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒiya nyuri wain, ka naa lan yɛli Ɛsta, Bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: Over the wine the king asked her, Tell me what you want, and you shall have it. I will grant your request, even if you ask for half my empire.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mi buɣim.
en: Joshua dealt with them exactly as the LORD had told him. He crippled their horses and burned their chariots.

dag: din ni chɛ ka a mali a filiŋ min a vi a ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka di ti ba suhumahili maa zuɣu.
en: I will comfort you. Then you will remember the terrible things you did, and you will be ashamed.

dag: N shia, labim a vuhim shee na, dama Yawɛ niŋ a nirilim pam.
en: Be confident, my heart, because the Lord has been good to me.

dag: Yɛm malibu so salima nɛma zaa, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa shɛli buɣisi li.
en: Wisdom is more valuable than jewels; nothing you could want can compare with it.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa ti kpe Ibram biŋkɔbiguliba mini Lɔt biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni. Di saha maa Keenannim mini Pɛrizinima n-daa be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: So quarrels broke out between the men who took care of Abram's animals and those who took care of Lot's animals.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni bɛ bo mɔri na.
en: The slaves went all over Egypt, looking for straw.

dag: Ka yinim teeku noli tinsi ŋɔ, yi ni ti leei biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee mini piɛguliba ni yɛn chɛri momaha luɣ shɛli, ka leei biŋkɔbbaligu gbɛbu shee.
en: The seacoast will become pastureland, with wells for shepherds and pens for the flocks.

dag: Dama ti daa wum yi ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm la yɛla;.
en: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti laɣim Mizipa m-po pɔri yɛli, Ti ni so ku zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni doo.
en: When the Israelites had gathered at Mizpah, they had made a solemn promise to the Lord : None of us will allow a Benjaminite to marry a daughter of ours.

dag: Aduna ku paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa ni, o ni kpi, yi ni daa zaɣisi n zaligu Mɛriba kom la yɛla ni la zuɣu.
en: Aaron will join his ancestors, for he may not enter the land that Ive given to the Israelites, because you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

dag: Amaa yinim miriya ka yi niŋdi lala, dama yi Ba Naawuni pun mi din simdi ya hal ka yi na bi suh o li gba.
en: Dont be like them, because your Father knows what you need before you ask.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛligu bi lan yɛn yuui. Amaa n yi kul tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ni niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: Therefore, say to them, The LORD God proclaims: It will be delayed no longer. Every word of mine that Ive spoken is certain, and it will happen. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ o Bia maa zali zaashe tital ni gari malaikanima kaman o ni daa ti o yuli din gari bɛ yuya shɛm la.
en: And the Son became so much greater than the other messengers, such as angels, that he received a more important title than theirs.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini yaɣ shɛli din gili n zoli ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka saa miri ba saa mibu saha. Di ni ti nyɛla alibarika saa.
en: They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain.

dag: Maata ni daa yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi chaŋ o tizo Mariama sani nti sɔɣi yɛl o, Karimba kana, ka boon a.
en: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya putariga bindira, yi mi di ti labiya ti yihi binyiha di ni yaha. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Mani Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: When you harvest your lands produce, you must not harvest all the way to the edge of your field; and dont gather every remaining bit of your harvest. Leave these items for the poor and the immigrant; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu din nyɛ o shɛhira tanti jɛmbu duu m-be alizanda ni la, ka di yooi.
en: After this I saw the temple in heaven open, with the Sacred Tent in it.

dag: tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa mi Sinai Zoli zuɣu nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ninni.
en: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla m min a ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛl la dina, Yawɛ ni be m min a sunsuuni sahakam.
en: Remember this agreement between you and me. The Lord is our witness forever.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ku tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi pina; di nyɛla jɛrilim o sani hal ka o ku tooi baŋ di yɛla, dama di nyɛla Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri yɛl shɛŋa.
en: But people who are unspiritual dont accept the things from Gods Spirit. They are foolishness to them and cant be understood, because they can only be comprehended in a spiritual way.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim daa muɣisi Dan zuliya niriba n-kari ba labisi zoya ni tinsi la ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ siɣi tintan ni na.
en: The Amorites forced the people of the tribe of Dan into the hill country and did not let them come down to the plain.

dag: Hal zibisim pala zibisim a sani; yuŋ kul nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ ni la, dama zibisim bemi kaman neesim la a sani.
en: even then the darkness isnt too dark for you! Nighttime would shine bright as day, because darkness is the same as light to you!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa Jɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba Juda tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtishɛmɛshi la ni.
en: so Jehoash led his army to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.

dag: ni binnamda maa maŋmaŋ ti yi poobu dabitim ni kpe Naawuni ni zaŋ yolisim shɛli din mali jilima n-ti o bihi la ni.
en: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin din pal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din bahindi nyaaŋ la ni yino daa ka n sanna ti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a Piɛbil la Daamiliya Paɣa.
en: One of the seven angels came to me. This was one of the angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues. The angel said, Come with me. I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.

dag: Tɔbu lu baɣisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei jɛra. Tɔbu lu bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ.
en: Sword, kill the priests of Babylon. They will be like fools. Sword, kill the soldiers of Babylon. They will be full of fear.

dag: Ka n daa bu n-nuɣisi ba kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri taŋkpa zim shɛli chana, ka n daa zaŋ ba labi kaman soli zuɣu baɣiri la.
en: I beat them to pieces like dust blown by the wind. I smashed them like mud in the streets.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Ya ka a yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim sansan ni ka n yi n-zo na maa.
en: Where have you come from? David asked him. Ive escaped from the Israelite army! he answered.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛtali lɔɣu lɛbigirila bɛ puya ni, ka leei sapaɣ binsom bɛ puya maa ni.
en: But that evil will turn sour in his stomach. It will be like a snakes bitter poison inside him.

dag: Niriba zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa yi Babilɔn doli ma n-lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu ʒiɛman ni la yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zɛbida. O daa nyɛla Ruma nir ŋun yuli daa booni Pɛdaya la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother was Zebidah, the daughter of Pedaiah from the town of Rumah.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Sinai mɔɣu ni n-doli tab gbilligbilli chana; ka sagbani maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: and the Israelites started on their journey out of the Sinai Desert. The cloud came to rest in the wilderness of Paran.

dag: Yuma ayi ka kum ŋɔ na niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di na kpalim yuma anu, ka so ku ko bee n-kpuɣi puu atam.
en: This is only the second year of famine in the land; there will be five more years in which there will be neither plowing nor reaping.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-su tiŋgbani, ka bɛ ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb jilima be di ni.
en: You have a lot of farmland, and people respect you.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Di shiri simdi ni Anabi Ilaija daŋna nti mali binshɛɣukam zali di zaani.
en: Jesus responded, Elijah does come first and will restore all things.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm zaŋ chaŋ sanzali polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord said to me concerning the drought.

dag: Bɛ ni pam daa yɛlimi, Alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu! O kpɛla yinyari! Bɔzuɣu ka yi wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Many of them said, He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn turila binshɛŋa bɛ ni bi mi; ka binshɛŋa bɛ ni baŋ kaman biŋkɔbiri ni baŋdi shɛm mi nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: But these people slander whatever they dont understand. They are destroyed by what they know instinctively, as though they were irrational animals.

dag: Chɛ ka a min a ʒiʒiinikpee ʒini m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa, ka miri ka a zaŋ so daashili yɛla moli;.
en: If you and your neighbor have a difference of opinion, settle it between yourselves and do not reveal any secrets.

dag: Ka Naa maa yɛli, Amaa n nya ka niriba anahi n-lɔrigi be buɣim maa sunsuuni chani ginda, ka shɛli bi niŋ ba; ka ŋun pah anahi maa ŋmanila wuni.
en: But I see four men walking around in the fire, the king replied. None of them is tied up or harmed, and the fourth one looks like a god.

dag: Ka n daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka a chana? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, N Chanimi ni n ti buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm m-baŋ di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Where are you going? I asked. To measure Jerusalem, he answered, to see how long and how wide it is.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ŋun guli Izraɛlnim pala gom ni gbaari so bee ŋun ni gbihi.
en: Israels Protector does not get tired. He never sleeps.

dag: Naawuni, tim ma suhu yini, ka ti ma tɛh pala din tuhi n suhu ni.
en: God, create a pure heart in me, and make my spirit strong again.

dag: Ka Mɔza nyɛ Binia ba; o bihi n-daa nyɛ Rafa mini Ɛliasa ni Azɛl.
en: Moza was Bineas father. Raphah was Bineas son. Eleasah was Raphahs son. And Azel was Eleasahs son.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli wuntia soli, ka tɔɣisiri din tuhi, ka bi zaŋdi bɛ kpiɔŋ fari niriba, ka bi diri birapu, ka je ni bɛ wum ninvuɣ kubo yɛla, ka ŋmaligi bɛ nina ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu;.
en: The one who walks righteously and speaks truthfully, who rejects profit from extortion, who waves away a bribe instead of grabbing it, who wont listen to bloody plots, and who wont contemplate doing something evil.

dag: Yawɛ viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani muɣisigu saha; o guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣir o sani.
en: The Lord is good. He is a safe place to go to in times of trouble. He takes care of those who trust him.

dag: Ka tiŋgula ŋun daa tam Jɛziriil pii zuɣu daa ti lihi nya Jɛhu min o niriba ni kanna ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ kanna. Ka Jɔram yɛl o, Timmi wɔribara ka o chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli m-bɔhi ba, Alaafee? .
en: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, I see a large group of men coming this way. Joram ordered, Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.

dag: Dinzuɣu pom Yawɛ ni a ti ku ku n zuliya n kalinsi nyaaŋa bee n-kpihim n daŋ birili.
en: Because of that, make a solemn pledge to me by the LORD that you wont kill off my descendants after Im gone and that you wont destroy my name from my family lineage.

dag: N kpalimla yɔbahi mabia, ka nyɛ taatahi dolinikpee.
en: making sad sounds like the wild dogs, like the ostriches in the desert.

dag: ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi ni di mihi.
en: the Tent pegs and ropes for the Tent and the enclosure;.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa ti be mɔɣu ni Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la ka o daa yihiri waazu yɛra.
en: In those days John the Baptist appeared in the desert of Judea announcing.

dag: Ka n daa yihi ba tinzun yɛlli kam daɣiri ni; ka daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni sokam tuuni ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
