dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ ni so bee bɛ dɔɣiriba yi shihi kpima ka leei bɛn bi be kasi bee bɛ yi gomi chaŋ katiŋa, bɛ ni tooi puhi Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: to say to the people of Israel, When any of you or your descendants are unclean from touching a corpse or are far away on a journey, but still want to keep the Passover.

dag: Dama mani a dabili ŋɔ daa zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima bia maa zuɣu m ba sani ka yɛli, N yi ti bi ʒi bia maa kuna, di taali din ʒinimi n zuɣu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I, your servant, guaranteed the young mans safety to my father, telling him, If I dont bring him back to you, it will be my fault forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahi naaya yi yaannim tuma maa!.
en: Go on, then, and finish up what your ancestors started!.

dag: man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Sɛnnachɛrib, Jɛrusalɛm lar a mi ka lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: So this is the Lord s message against Sennacherib: The virgin daughter Zion does not think you are important. She makes fun of you. Daughter Jerusalem shakes her head at you and laughs behind your back.

dag: Wula ka bipala lee yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ soya be kasi? A yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm ka bɛ ni doli n-chɛ ka di be kasi.
en: How can young people keep their paths pure? By guarding them according to what youve said.

dag: N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo n-wum ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama ti bi bɔri ni ti chɛ ka a ʒini yuui.
en: But I dont want to take any more of your time. So I will say only a few words. Please be patient.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ o ba sani ti bol o, M ba! Ka o saɣi ka bɔh o, Ka m bi ŋuni n-lee bala.
en: Jacob went to his father and said, My father. And he said, Im here. Who are you, my son.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Di chɛ ka so baŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, di yi pa lala a ni kpi.
en: Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, No one is to know about these matters or else you will die.

dag: N ni niŋ di tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ di polo la ka di nyɛ n ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi zuliya kam zaa, ka di sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni la.
en: I will punish Babylonia with all the disasters that I threatened to bring on the nations when I spoke through Jeremiah—all the disasters recorded in this book.

dag: Ayuba ni daa suhi Naawuni ti o zɔnim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan labisi Ayuba buni ti o. Yawɛ daa tila Ayuba o ni daa pun mali shɛli ʒii buyi zuɣu.
en: Then the LORD changed Jobs fortune when he prayed for his friends, and the LORD doubled all Jobs earlier possessions.

dag: O chɛ ka tom pali n ni, ka chɛ ka n di wahala.
en: God has turned my life sour.

dag: Ka m bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ya ka bɛ lee mal li chana.
en: I said to the messenger speaking with me, Where are they taking the basket.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ, ka di nyɛ mita anu. Ka o daa buɣisi foliŋga din kpe dunɔdali maa ni, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu ni pirigili.
en: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway in the gateway. It was feet altogether, and the space between the open gates was feet.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi bɛ taba, ka maani ba ansarisi la ti ku lan beni. Bɛ ni ti ku tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: This will happen when the people who are mean and cruel have come to an end. It will happen when those who enjoy doing bad things are gone.

dag: Di saha ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli. Ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka tampima bɔɣi.
en: At once the curtain in the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, and rocks split apart.

dag: ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni so sani yi ni tim ma ni n ti zaŋ yi fabila sɔŋ o tooni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: and he said to them: You have sent me to present your plea to the LORD, and this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni daa baptaizi ti la wuhiya ni ti be Yisa Masia ni, ka lan wuhi ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi gba?.
en: For surely you know that when we were baptized into union with Christ Jesus, we were baptized into union with his death.

dag: Ammɔnnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba daa ŋmaligi Abishai tooni guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yi Ammɔnnim maa tuhibu yɔɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had fled, they also fled from Abishai and retreated to the city. Then Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and went to Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa Yawɛ tooni yi Izraɛlnim zaa sani ka bɛ ti nya. Ka sokam daa yih o jaaŋgbee.
en: Moses brought the twelve sticks out of the tent and showed them to the people. Each of the leaders found his own and took it.

dag: Di saha ka Zifinim daa chaŋ Sool sani Gibia ti yɛl o, Dauda sɔɣi bela ti ya Hɔrɛshi sɔɣisili shee din be Hachila zo shɛli din labiri Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la zuɣu.
en: Some people from Ziph went to Saul at Gibeah and told him, David is hiding in our area. He is at the fortresses of Horesh on Hakilah Hill, south of Jeshimon.

dag: N daa nyɛla nandaamba ba; ka daa zaani saamba nyaaŋa bɛ yɛla ni.
en: I was a father to the needy; the case I didnt know, I examined.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa po pɔri Yawɛ sani yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, a yi ni zaŋ niriba ŋɔ niŋ ti nuu ni, ti ni saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi zaa.
en: Then the Israelites made a special promise to the Lord : Please help us defeat these people. If you do this, we will give their cities to you. We will totally destroy them.

dag: Shimiat bia Jɔzaka mini Shoma bia Jɛhɔzabad bɛn daa nyɛ o kpambaliba la n-daa ŋme o luhi, ka o kpi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: It was Jozacar son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer, his officials, who struck him so that he died. He was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Amaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: Musa ni daa kpi saha shɛli maa, o yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi. O nina daa na kul nɛmi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o niŋgbuŋ ni yaa daa bi filim.
en: Moses was years old when he died, yet his eyesight was still good, and his body was strong.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa zaa naai, ka o daa zaŋ o ba Naa Dauda ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nɛma zaashee.
en: When all the work was completed on the Lord s Temple, Solomon brought in everything his father David had set aside for the Temple. Solomon put all the furniture and all the things made of silver and gold into the storage rooms in Gods Temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: While they were there, the Lord said:.

dag: Bɛn daa ʒi bindirigu maa dibu shee maa ni so daa bi baŋ din chɛ ka o yɛli Judas lala maa.
en: None of the others at the table understood why Jesus said this to him.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka bi wuhi n ni be kasi shɛm Izraɛlnim sani, dinzuɣu yi ku zaŋ ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti ba maa ni.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, Because you didnt trust me to show my holiness before the Israelites, you will not bring this assembly into the land that I am giving them.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ daazichi naani, ka nyuri bara bɛ daazichi din galisi pam zuɣu la.
en: They think their wealth will protect them. They brag about how rich they are.

dag: Gbibiy o zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi mini yi bihi biɛrisuŋ zuɣu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you.

dag: Amaa biɛɣu yi neei bee di yi niŋ daba ayi ka dabili maa kpaŋ, di bi simdi ni bɛ darig o tibili dama ŋuna n-su dabili maa.
en: But if the slave gets up after a few days, then the master will not be punished. That is because someone paid their money for the slave, and the slave belongs to them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛn je suli niŋ a niriba wunsuhigu hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: LORD God of heavenly forces, how long will you fume against your peoples prayer?.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi zo, ka o yiŋ nim zaa daa yiɣisi dol o. Naa daa naɣ chɛla o mamanim pia niŋ nayili maa puuni ni bɛ maani li.
en: So the king left, accompanied by all his family and officials, except for ten concubines, whom he left behind to take care of the palace.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo bo o dokpee kaman paɣ la, di nyɛla din chihira.
en: Men, you must not have sexual relations with another man as with a woman. That is a terrible sin!.

dag: O ni be alizanda ni ka timna ti tiligi ma. O ni chɛ ka n dimnim bɛn duri tamdi n zuɣu la di vi. Naawuni ni wuhi ma o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ n sani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: He sends orders from heaven and saves me, rebukes the one who tramples me. Selah God sends his loyal love and faithfulness.

dag: O kuri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ, ka saɣindi bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa.
en: who causes destruction to flash out against the strong, so that destruction comes upon the fortress.

dag: O daa yi Pita zuɣu, ka daa ti yi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la gba zuɣu.
en: He appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm anzinfa mali kikah ayi.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Jɛrigu bi bɔri tɛhi zilima, amaa ka naɣ wuhirila omaŋmaŋ tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: A fool does not care whether he understands a thing or not; all he wants to do is show how smart he is.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa su tɔbbi shɛb kalinli nyɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisita ni tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ din ni tooi sɔŋ naa ka o tuhi o dimnima.
en: They commanded an army of three hundred seven thousand five hundred. They formed a powerful force that could support the king against the enemy.

dag: Yawɛ, a kul yɛn lihiri yɛlli maa la hal ni bɔ saha? Fam ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma maa nuu ni bahi. Fam n nyɛvili gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi!.
en: How much longer, Lord, will you just look on? Rescue me from their attacks; save my life from these lions!.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa nya ka baŋdib maa yɔhim o maa ka di ku o suli pam, ka o daa tim ni bɛ cham ti ku bidibbihi bɛn zaa be Bɛtilihɛm mini di tiŋkpansi zaa, yuma ayi bihi zaŋ tabili biliɛri kaman o ni daa kpahim baŋ shɛm baŋdiba maa yɛligu ni.
en: When Herod knew the magi had fooled him, he grew very angry. He sent soldiers to kill all the children in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding territory who were two years old and younger, according to the time that he had learned from the magi.

dag: Bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili. Di bi simdi ni yi ti ba binshɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili.
en: The priests have the priesthood as their share of what I have given Israel to be handed down from one generation to another. They are not to hold property in Israel; I am all they need.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi paɣiba mini bɛnkam daa be nimaani n-nyɛ bihi ni ninkura zaa. Bɛ daa bi ku so, amaa bɛ daa kul gbahi ba mi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: They took all the women in Ziklag, both young and old, as prisoners. They didnt kill anyone; they only took them as prisoners.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Zakaria di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam lay down with his ancestors the kings of Israel. His son Zechariah succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim gomna daa yɛli ba ni bɛ ku tooi di bindir shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ mali maligu ti Naawuni la ni faashee maligumaana so ŋun ni tooi lihi Urim mini Tumim ni m-baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm ti beni.
en: In fact, the governor told them, You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.

dag: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi, dapaɣili kam diba ayi.
en: And make silver bases for these frames—two bases under each frame.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a zuɣu n ni tooi nyaŋ ninvuɣ gbaliŋ. N Naawuni zuɣu, n ni tooi kpahi yaɣi gooni.
en: With your help I can defeat an army. If my God is with me, I can climb over enemy walls.

dag: M birimmi zaa n dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛli zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɔri vu shɛli zuɣu. Dama bɛ niŋ ma muɣisigu pam, ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu ka je n yɛlli.
en: over the enemys noise, at the wicked persons racket, because they bring disaster on me and harass me furiously.

dag: A wuntitali la zuɣu, yihim ma ka fa ma bahi. Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma.
en: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl kalinsi nyaaŋa Jɛhɔiada ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya bia la mini Abiata n-daa zan o zaani. Ka Jɔab mi daa nyɛ naa tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma.
en: After Ahithophel died, Abiathar and Jehoiada son of Benaiah became advisers. Joab was commander of the royal army.

dag: ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, Karimba, doo ŋɔ laamba daalahichi zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣ o zom ŋɔ bee omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Jesus disciples asked, Rabbi, who sinned so that he was born blind, this man or his parents.

dag: Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira; ka di shɛŋa daa lu sol zuɣu ka niriba nɔri li garita, ka noonsi ti kana nti gahim li di.
en: A farmer went out to sow seed. While he was scattering the seed, some of it fell beside the road. People walked on the seed, and the birds ate it all.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n nya a, ka ti nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi.
en: I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face-to-face.

dag: Ka Huram daa lan mali kɔniŋdi bini, ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli ka di naŋgbanyɛra yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di yaɣ yini yɛliŋ nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka booli din daa gili di sunsuuni wɔɣilim mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla.
en: Then Huram melted bronze and poured it into a huge mold to make a tank, which was called The Sea. The tank was about cubits around. It was cubits across and cubits deep.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa ti buŋ maa noli ka o bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ a ka a fiɛb ma buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then the Lord gave the donkey the power of speech, and it said to Balaam, What have I done to you? Why have you beaten me these three times.

dag: Yɛlim ba, N nyɛla shihirili yi sani, n ni niŋ shɛm maa, lala nti yɛn niŋ ya. Bɛ ni ti gbahi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tinzun tiŋ ti niŋ dabitim ni.
en: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.

dag: Nyini n dan naa m-bahi noli ka tuuni ŋɔ tum, ka bi yɛli tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ŋun yɛn ʒini a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: Did you say they could do this without telling the rest of us who would be the next king?.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ bɛ paɣiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba mali biɛrisuŋ, ka pa ni bɛn nyɛ munaafichinima, amaa di simdi ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa ka ʒe yim binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: Their wives also must be of good character and must not gossip; they must be sober and honest in everything.

dag: Firawuna ni yɛli Izraɛlnim yɛla, Bɛ bela tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni dari ginda, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo, ka tiŋgban nɛli taɣi ba zali.
en: The king will think you were afraid to cross the desert and that you are wandering around, trying to find another way to leave the country.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Maata! Maata! A jiɣirimi ka nahind amaŋ bina pam zuɣu.
en: The Lord answered, Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things.

dag: Amaa nyini zanim baɣili ma kpe, ka n yɛl a fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka a zaŋ wuhi ba ka bɛ ti dol li n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su maa ni.
en: But you, Moses, stay here with me, and I will give you all my laws and commands. Teach them to the people, so that they will obey them in the land that I am giving them.

dag: Ka Harihaya bia Uziɛl ŋun daa nyɛ machɛli ŋun doori salima la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ tulaale maana la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa lab mali Jɛrusalɛm hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, a goldsmith, built the next section. Hananiah, a maker of perfumes, built the next section, as far as Broad Wall.

dag: Di simdi ni cheechi sɔŋdiba malila paɣ yinoyino, ka tooi gbib bɛ bihi mini bɛ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A church helper must have only one wife, and be able to manage his children and family well.

dag: Di saha ka a chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa zani Aduna min o bidibisi la tooni, ka a zaŋ ba ti Yawɛ kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la.
en: Tell the Levites to stand in front of Aaron and his sons. Then give the Levites to the Lord . They will be like an offering.

dag: Ka a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni, .
en: If your foot causes you to fall into sin, chop it off. Its better for you to enter life lame than to be thrown into hell with two feet.

dag: Ka o daa bɔh o bipuɣinsi maa, Ka o be ya? Wula ka yi chɛ o zali samban ni? Bolimiy o na ka o ti di bindirigu.
en: So Reuel said to his daughters, Where is this man? Why did you leave him? Go invite him to eat with us.

dag: Nyin ŋun daa chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka wurim di tin kara, ka bi bahiri a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ kuni la m-bala?.
en: who destroyed cities and turned the land into a desert, who captured people in war and would not let them go home.

dag: Sokam zaa wum yi ni deei Naawuni noli shɛm yɛla, ka n suhu paligi yi zuɣu; amaa m bɔri ni yi niŋ yɛnnim zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛlli tumbu polo, ka nyɛ bɛn bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Everyone has heard of your loyalty to the gospel, and for this reason I am happy about you. I want you to be wise about what is good, but innocent in what is evil.

dag: Pa kapinta bia la m-bala? Pa o ma yuli m-booni Mariama la? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ni Saimɔn ni Judas la?.
en: Isn't he the son of the carpenter? Isn't Mary his mother, and aren't James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas his brothers?.

dag: Judas ni daa deei bɔrɔbɔro maa nyaaŋa, ka Sintani kpe ŋun Judas suhu ni. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋmi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛli maa yomyom.
en: After Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. Jesus told him, What you are about to do, do quickly.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka anabi shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka tɔɣisiri bɛ suhuyubu anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ yɔhiŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ lala niŋbu?.
en: How much longer will those prophets mislead my people with the lies they have invented?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni saɣi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛlli ŋɔ puuni? Ŋun chaŋ tɔb maa tuhibu shee tarili ni nyɛ shɛm, ŋun ʒiya guli nɛma gba tarili yɛn nyɛla lala. Bɛ zaa tarili yɛn nyɛla yim.
en: No one will listen to what you say. The share will be the same for the man who stayed with the supplies and for the man who went into battle. Everyone will share alike.

dag: N ni zaŋ a leei Izraɛl naa, ka chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri tiŋgbani shɛm tariga zaa.
en: You will be king of Israel and will rule every nation you want.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa guui kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn tampiŋ la gbini nti kpalim be nimaani chira anahi.
en: But men from Benjamin ran into the desert to the place called the Rock of Rimmon and stayed there for four months.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ bindira maa zali ŋun daa guli bɛ nɛma sani, ka guui ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni chaŋ ti puh o biɛyanim maa.
en: David left the food with the man who kept supplies. Then he ran to the place where the Israelite soldiers were and asked about his brothers.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa tuhi deei Jɛrusalɛm, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di niriba, ka nyo li buɣim bahi.
en: The people of Judah attacked Jerusalem and captured it. They killed its people and set fire to the city.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer, Ammishaddais son.

dag: O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: He gave it as a law to Jacob. He gave it to Israel as an agreement that will last forever!.

dag: Dama pagɔrili samli yɔri nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, amaa so paɣ bɔbu nyɛla din diri nir nyɛvili.
en: for a prostitute costs a loaf of bread, but a married woman hunts for a mans very life.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu! A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, wummi n fabila. A wuntitali puuni, deemi n suhigu!.
en: Listen to my prayer, LORD! Because of your faithfulness, hear my requests for mercy! Because of your righteousness, answer me!.

dag: Amaa m pun suhi Naawuni a zuɣu ni a yɛda di filim; ka a yi ti lan lab zani dɛde, nyin kpaŋsim a mabihi suhuri.
en: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you turn back to me, you must strengthen your brothers.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa laɣimna nti muɣi dunoli.
en: The whole town gathered near the door.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Juda zuliya maa daŋ kam na ti zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zɛra daŋ; ka o daa zaŋ Zɛra daŋ maa ni sokam ni o malibu zali, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Zabidi yiŋnima.
en: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord , and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord , and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.

dag: Yuun tuhili maa tariga yi ti paai, Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ yooi Sintani o sarika maa ni bahi.
en: When the years are ended, Satan will be made free from his prison.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli ŋmanila bumbɔni. Bɛ bi mi bɛ ni tuuri binshɛŋa.
en: But the path of the wicked is like a dark night. They trip and fall over what they cannot see.

dag: Chamiya Saipurus teeku noli ti nya, ka timiya Kɛdar ka bɛ ti lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya lala na mi n-niŋ.
en: Look to the west as far as the shores of Cyprus and to the east as far as the land of Kedar. Ask anyone there: Has anything this odd ever taken place?.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, bɔ ka n lee niŋ ya? Bimbɔ ka n zaŋ muɣisi ya? Garigimiya ma!.
en: The Lord says, My people, what have I done to you? How have I been a burden to you? Answer me.

dag: Amaa Naawuni pun zaŋ niŋgbuŋ yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa n-niŋ niŋgbun yini kaman o ni yu shɛm.
en: As it is, however, God put every different part in the body just as he wanted it to be.

dag: Binshɛli ku niŋ ba n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ ni kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord 's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord .

dag: Bɛ bi fabindi niŋdi ma ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa bɛ dola bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu kuhira. Dama bɛ zaŋ bini ŋma bɛmaŋa bɛ kawana mini bɛ wain zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ma.
en: They dont cry to me from the heart, but they sob upon their beds; they fight over grain and wine; they resist me.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N ni niŋ Naawuni naani. Ka daa lan yɛli yaha, M mini bi shɛba n Duuma Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ma la ni laɣim be.
en: He also says, I will trust in God. Isaiah : And he says, I am here, and with me are the children God has given me. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa n-zaŋ mɛɛr maa mini aloosi tia sum maa n-niŋ o, ka bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o kaman Yɛhudianim kum sɔɣibu kali ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: These two men took Jesus body and wrapped it in pieces of linen cloth with the spices.

dag: Dabisi muni puuni, di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la; di kul gili ma mi niŋ sunsuuni luɣilikam zaa.
en: They surround me all day long like water; they engulf me completely.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ naa nini daa galimi, ka o yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm niriba tuma yɛla teebu ni be yɛlikura litaafi shɛl ni la na, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li na.
en: That same night, the king simply couldnt sleep. He had the official royal records brought in, and his young male servants began reading them to the king.

dag: Ka m mini m paɣa ŋun nyɛ anabi la daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Bolim o yuli Mahɛshalalihashibaz.
en: Some time later my wife became pregnant. When our son was born, the Lord said to me, Name him Quick-Loot-Fast-Plunder.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Asa soli, ka yɛl o, Nyin Naa Asa mini Juda zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, yi yi kul be Naawuni sani, o gba ni be yi sani. Yi yi bo o, yi ni nya o. Amaa yi yi zaɣis o, o gba ni zaɣisi ya.
en: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛli saha shɛli Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi zaa ni dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa be o sulinsi ni ni o niriba ni daa tuhiri Jɛrusalɛmnim mini di fɔntinsi la m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord spoke to me when King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army, supported by troops from all the nations and races that were subject to him, were attacking Jerusalem and its nearby towns.

dag: Ka Shɛlɛmia bia Hanania mini Hanun ŋun daa nyɛ Zalaf bia ŋun pah ayɔbu la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam daa mali me o ni daa be luɣ shɛli la tooni.
en: Hananiah son of Shelemiah and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, built the next section, their second one. Meshullam son of Berechiah built the next section, which was in front of his house.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi mali sara din ni tiɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ nini, ka suh o naa min o bihi nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: Give them to the Jewish priests so that they may offer sacrifices that please the God of heaven. Give these things so that the priests may pray for me and my sons.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim zani; Naawuni, kpuɣim a nuu zuɣusaa, di tam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu yɛla.
en: Get up, LORD! Get your fist ready, God! Dont forget the ones who suffer!.

dag: O chɛ n daalahichi zaa, ka tibi n dɔriti zaa.
en: He forgives all my sins and heals all my diseases.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni, dama m mali tahima o sani.
en: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaayi la yiɣisi zani yɛli, N dana, a daa zaŋla pɔŋ tusaayi ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaayi nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: Next, the servant who had been given , coins came in and said, Sir, you gave me , coins, and I have earned , more.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi di saha maa lab Jɛrusalɛm nti nya ka Yisa tuumba piniyini maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb laɣim ʒiya.
en: So they got up and returned to Jerusalem. The two disciples found the eleven apostles and the others gathered together.

dag: Daŋ kam ni niriba daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn guli duno shɛŋa, bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: Each family was given a gate to guard. Lots were thrown to choose a gate for a family. Young and old were treated the same.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka o mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa chaŋ ti kpe Saimɔn mini Anduru yiŋa.
en: After leaving the synagogue, Jesus, James, and John went home with Simon and Andrew.

dag: N ti yɛn baŋ, ka doo bɔbu kɔre zaŋ ma ti ʒili baɣili n nabia o chɛchɛbuŋ ni.
en: I am trembling; you have made me as eager for love as a chariot driver is for battle.

dag: Ka Pool daa yi chani Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla, ka o daa lɛbigiri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tɛha.
en: He held discussions in the synagogue every Sabbath, trying to convince both Jews and Greeks.

dag: O zaŋdi wahala n-fari bɛn be wahala ni bahira, ka zaŋdi nandahima n-yoori bɛ tiba.
en: Hard times and trouble are God's way of getting our attention!.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ sujee ni n suhuyiɣisili maa dali, n ni ti chɛ ka zuɣusaa dam, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam pam di biɛhigu shee.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ; ka biasani maa gba daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: They served their father wine that night also, and the younger daughter lay down with him, without him knowing when she lay down or got up.

dag: Ka do so yi bi yuri ka di bin kasi maa, ŋun bom di pirigibu ʒiibunu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ bin kasi maa ti ti maligumaana.
en: and anyone else who accidentally does so, must pay for the food plus a fine of percent.

dag: Chɛli n tibili darigibu lala! A ni zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma maa chɛmi ka n gbarigi.
en: Get this plague of yours off me! Im being destroyed by the blows from your fist.

dag: Chɛ ka puri atam niŋ pam. Chɛ ka daboya zuɣu zaa zibigi bindira, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pam kaman Lɛbanɔn bindira ni niŋdi shɛm la. Chɛ ka fɔntinsi ni pali niriba kaman mɔri ni zibigi mɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: Let there be abundant grain in the land. Let it wave on the mountaintops. Let its fruit flourish like Lebanon. Let it thrive like grass on the land.

dag: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa m-bala, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ka Yisa mini ba daa chaŋ ti kpe fɔntin shɛli din yuli booni Kapɛrinium la, ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai ka o kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai niriba wuhibu.
en: Jesus and his followers went to Capernaum. On the Sabbath day, Jesus went into the synagogue and taught the people.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Jɛhɔash daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kana pumpɔŋɔ ni n tuh a soli. M bo a ni nimmoo, ka ti nya a maa.
en: So I came looking for you, and here you are!.

dag: Ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu yi chɛ ka a kpee suhu miligi, dindina a bi doli yurilim soli. Di chɛ ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka Yisa Masia ni kpi a kpe so zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni wum dimbɔŋɔ bee n-ni ti bɔri ni o zaŋ o zaɣa niŋ di ni dahin shɛli ha?.
en: Will any of you listen to this? From now on will you listen with care?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ wumya ni Sool ni ka Kɛila ŋɔ na nti wurim li n zuɣu.
en: Then David said, Lord , God of Israel, I have heard that Saul is planning to come to Keilah and destroy it on account of me, your servant.

dag: ka daa kpaŋsi li ka di leei zaligu Yaakubu sani, ka lan leei alikauli din ka bahigu Izraɛl san la.
en: He gave it as a law for Jacob, as an agreement with Israel that will last forever.

dag: N ni zaŋ rubis me a pihi, ka zaŋ kuɣ shɛŋa din nyɛlisiri me a dunoya, ka zaŋ kuɣ viɛla m-mal a gooni.
en: I will make your towers of rubies, and your gates of beryl, and all your walls of precious jewels.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o, Lab kuli nti yɛl a yiŋnim a Duuma ni zo a nambɔɣu ka tum tuun kar shɛli ti a ŋɔ yɛla.
en: But Jesus wouldnt allow it. Go home to your own people, Jesus said, and tell them what the Lord has done for you and how he has shown you mercy.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm na la yɛli, Biilzibul n-ʒi o zuɣu. Alizin biɛri naa n-niŋ o yiko ka o karit alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: And the teachers of the law from Jerusalem said, Satan is living inside him! He uses power from the ruler of demons to force demons out of people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ijipti naa daa yih o nam maa ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka zali Judanim ni bɛ yom farigu din nyɛ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini salima kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi.
en: The king of Egypt removed him from office in Jerusalem. The Egyptian king imposed a fine on the land totaling one hundred kikkars of silver and one kikkar of gold.

dag: Ka a ti she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti a mabia Aduna din ni nyɛ o jilima min o nachiinsi binyɛra.
en: Make holy clothing that will give honor and dignity to your brother Aaron.

dag: dindina maligumaana ni zali di daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, ka dilan ni yo di liɣiri dindali maa ka di leei din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: the priest will calculate the amount of its value until the Jubilee year. The person must pay the value on that day as a holy donation to the LORD.

dag: Amaa Abija ŋun yaa daa kul kirisimi. O daa kpuɣila paɣiba pinaanahi n-dɔɣi bidibisi pisinaayi mini bipuɣinsi pinaayɔbu.
en: but Abijah became strong. He married women and was the father of sons and daughters.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee gbi kɔsoli n-ti sa titali bee m-mali soli ti sakpani?.
en: Who cut a channel for the downpours and a way for blasts of thunder.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Yi nya Yawɛ ni pii so maa? Niriba ŋɔ zaa ni so bi be kaman ŋuna. Ka niriba maa zaa daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolim naa maa nyɛvili.
en: Samuel said to the people, Here is the man the Lord has chosen! There is no one else among us like him. All the people shouted, Long live the king.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa ka di ti tamya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gbibbu.
en: But watch yourself! Dont forget the LORD your God by not keeping his commands or his case laws or his regulations that I am commanding you right now.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: The following are also descendants of Caleb. Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and his wife Ephrath. Hur's son Shobal founded Kiriath Jearim.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ bɛ sɔɣimi do n-gu ni bɛ di n nyɛvili; kpiɔŋlaannim taala duŋ bahi n zuɣu. Yawɛ, di mi pala n tuumbiɛri bee n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Look at how they lie in ambush for my life! Powerful people are attacking me, LORD— but not because of any error or sin of mine.

dag: Ka ti Duuma ŋun ʒi alizanda ni la lara, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: But the one who rules in heaven laughs at them. The Lord makes fun of them.

dag: Amaa di bahi ni mini di biɛma ni kom din ti ku niŋ nyaɣisim. Din ti kul yɛn nyɛla din mali yalim.
en: Its marshes and swamps wont be made fresh.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Absalom, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din bi viɛla.
en: Hushai said to Absalom, This time, the advice Ahithophel has given isnt right.

dag: O daa tim o yɛligu na ti tib ba, ka daa yihi ba kum ni.
en: God gave the order and healed them; he rescued them from their pit.

dag: ni taataa ni yuŋ nooŋa ni teeku ni laɣipiɛliga ni wubiga balibu kam.
en: the ostrich, the nighthawk, the seagull, any kind of hawk.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nirilim min o yurilim ni daa ti yi palo ninsalinim san la.
en: But when God our saviors kindness and love appeared.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa maa ka zuɣulan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛl o, M bipuɣiŋga n-na kul yoli kpi; amaa kamina nti zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu ka o lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: While Jesus was still talking, a leader of the synagogue came to him. The leader bowed down before him and said, My daughter has just died. But if you will come and touch her with your hand, she will live again.

dag: O chɛ ka ti kul be ti nyɛvili ni, ka bi chɛ ka ti sarigi.
en: He has kept us alive and has not allowed us to fall.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa dari yuri Ijipti mini Silisia tiŋgbana ni, ka naa kɔhigɔriba daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomons horses were imported from Egypt and Kue, purchased from Kue by the kings agents at the going price.

dag: N Duuma ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: Come quickly and help me. My Lord, you are the one who saves me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli salo min o nyaandoliba.
en: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to his disciples.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, N yi kpi pumpɔŋɔ, m paɣiya, n ni nya a ni n nini ka baŋ ni a na be a nyɛvil ni maa zuɣu.
en: Israel said to Joseph, I can die now after seeing your face. You are really still alive.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu luɣ shɛli tam ni bi zilim pam n-dii bilina yomyom, nimaani tam ni bi zilim zuɣu.
en: Some of it fell on rocky ground, where there was little soil. The seeds soon sprouted, because the soil wasn't deep.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga, so ku lan di nyin wala hal abada. Ka o nyaandoliba daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So Jesus said to the tree, Never again will anyone eat fruit from this tree! The disciples heard him say this.

dag: Lala niŋbu ni ka Lɔt bipuɣins ayi maa zaa daa zaŋ puhi bɛ ba sani.
en: Both of Lots daughters became pregnant. Their father was the father of their babies.

dag: Romnim ni ti zaŋ bɛ sitimanim na nti lu o zuɣu ka dabiɛm gbaag o. Di saha maa o ni ti lab kuli ni suhuyiɣisili, ka lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ti yɛn dolila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun zaɣisi adiini soli maa saɣisigu.
en: Kittim ships will fight against him, and he will retreat in fear. He will rage against a holy covenant and will do what he wants. Then he will pay special attention to those who violate a holy covenant.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yoli, di daa muɣisi ba ni bɛ tooi gooi niriba maa ka bɛ ku mali ba maligu maa.
en: Even with these words, they barely kept the crowds from sacrificing to them.

dag: ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihiri timaŋa. Niriba yi turi ti, ti niŋdila alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni; ka bɛ yi niŋ ti alaka, ti zaŋdila suɣilo dee li;.
en: we wear ourselves out with hard work. When we are cursed, we bless; when we are persecuted, we endure;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ bɛ ni daa nya Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam Gibiɔn, ka kari doli bɛn kpalim hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn zolɔŋni n-kul kuri ba hal ti paai Azɛka mini Makɛda.
en: Then the LORD threw them into a panic before Israel. Joshua struck a mighty blow against them at Gibeon. He chased them on the way up to Beth-horon and struck them down as far as Azekah and Makkedah.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira Sintani yiko ni, ka mali yiko pam din ni tum alahiziba tuma balibu kam ka wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa din nyɛ yɔhiŋgu.
en: When the person who is lawless comes, it will happen through Satans effort, with all kinds of fake power, signs, and wonders.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi n-chaŋ Olivi Tihi Zol zuɣu kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o chaŋ.
en: Jesus left the city and went to the Mount of Olives. His followers went with him. He said to his followers, Pray for strength against temptation.

dag: N yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la yimaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim zuɣu, ka pa ni m bɔrimi ni n zali ya din ni gun ya soli, amaa m bɔrimi ni yi doli din tuhi mini din viɛla n-jɛmdi Naawuni ni suhu yini.
en: I am saying this to help you. I am not trying to limit you, but I want you to live in the right way. And I want you to give yourselves fully to the Lord without giving your time to other things.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli ka di yɛri nam ʒiishee maa gbini, Nyama, Naawuni biɛhigu shee bela ninsalinim sani. Ka o ni be bɛ sani, ka bɛ nyɛ o niriba, ka ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ mi ni be bɛ sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni;.
en: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.

dag: Dama saha shɛli Dauda ni daa be Ɛdom la, ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm la daa chaŋ nimaani ni o ti sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: This is how it happened. In the past David fought against Edom. Joab was the commander of Davids army. Joab went to Edom to bury his dead soldiers. While there Joab killed all the Edomite men who were still alive.

dag: ka lan ka bikpamba bɛn yuya sabi alizanda ni la laɣiŋgu ni na. Yi lan kala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ sokam zaa sariakarita mini wuntizɔriba bɛn mali m-be tibi la shihi sanna.
en: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa guui chaŋ ti yɛli Musa, Ɛldad mini Mɛdad be yiŋa n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yina n-na kul yɛla kpar ʒiɛɣu la, ka pili gɔhi zuɣupiligu maa. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya doo maa.
en: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to them, Look! Here is the man.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ paai ti? Di nyɛla yi tuumbiɛri ni galisi zuɣu ka bɛ darigi fuɣi yi situra, ka bili ya.
en: And when you ask yourself, Why have all these things happened to me? it is because of your many sins that you have been stripped and violated.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ tiŋkpansi mini di paliti polo, Judanim shɛb daa bela Kiriatariba tiŋkpansi mini Dibɔn ni di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛkabiziil ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba and its villages, in Dibon and its villages, in Jekabzeel and its villages.

dag: A ni ti du n-tam gbuɣima mini tinvura zuɣu; a ni du n-tam gbuɣim polli mini wɔɣimaha zuɣu n-no ba.
en: You will trample down lions and snakes, fierce lions and poisonous snakes.

dag: yin yɛlimiy o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ yaannim nyɛla biŋkɔbiguliba, ka ti gba nyɛ bɛn guli biŋkɔbiri ti bilim ni hal ni wayo, din ni chɛ ka o chɛ ka yi ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni, dama Ijiptinim je piɛguliba yɛlli.
en: say, Your servants have owned livestock since we were young, both we and our ancestors, so that you will be able to settle in the land of Goshen, since Egyptians think all shepherds are beneath their dignity.

dag: Yawɛ n-su tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni.
en: The earth is the LORDs and everything in it, the world and its inhabitants too.

dag: A yɛliya, Mbusim be n zuɣu. Yawɛ zaŋ suhugarigu pahi m biɛrim zuɣu; n ŋuhirimi hal ti tarigi, ka bi nyari vuhim. .
en: Baruch, you have said, It is very bad for me. The Lord has given me sorrow along with my pain. I am very tired. I am worn out because of my suffering. I cannot find rest.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani Samaria. O be Nabɔt wain tihi puu la ni ni o deei li su.
en: Get up and go down to meet Israels King Ahab in Samaria. He is in Naboths vineyard. He has gone down to take ownership of it.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma m-bɔr o.
en: They answered, The Lord needs it.

dag: Zuliya shɛb tiŋgbana n yaannim ni daa tuhi nyaŋ la buɣa daa tooi fa ba bahi? Di tiŋgbana maa n-nyɛ: Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ni Ɛdin niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa la.
en: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?.

dag: Din daa pun beni na kul ni beni. Ka din daa pun niŋ mi na kul ni niŋda. Binshɛli kani n-nyɛ bin palli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: What has happened before will happen again. What has been done before will be done again. There is nothing new in the whole world.

dag: Nir ni tooi ba wɔhu n-kari kuɣa ni? Ka nir ni tooi zaŋ naɣikɔra n-ko teeku ni? Amaa yi zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei ʒiri, ka zaŋ din tuhi leei din bi tuhi.
en: Do horses run over loose rocks? No, and people dont use cows for plowing. But you turned everything upside down. You changed justice and goodness to bitter poison.

dag: Ka gɔtihi maa tir o mahim, ka kuligara gil o niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The thorn bushes and the willows by the stream give him shelter in their shade.

dag: Wummiya zoya zuɣu vuri, salo vuri n-nyɛ li. Wummiya nama balibu mini zuliya balibu niriba tab laɣimbu vuri. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-laɣindi tɔbbihi ni o tuhi tɔbu.
en: Listen! A roar on the mountains like that of a great crowd. Listen! An uproar of kingdoms, of nations coming together. The LORD of heavenly forces is mustering an army for battle.

dag: Dama yi suhuri yi ye di niŋbu zuɣu, Naawuni ni dee li kaman yi ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga zuɣu ka mi ku galim ya yi ni ka shɛli zuɣu.
en: If you want to give, your gift will be accepted. Your gift will be judged by what you have, not by what you dont have.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhiya bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni tiligi ba; ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, amaa ka o bi garigi ba.
en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them. They cried for help to the LORD, but he wouldnt answer them.

dag: bɛna n-nyɛ Zilipa so Leeban ni daa zaŋ ti o bipuɣiŋga Liya la bidib shɛb o ni daa dɔɣi ti Yaakubu, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ pinaayɔbu.
en: All these were Jacobs sons from his wifes servant, Zilpah. There were people in this family.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin maa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the elders of Israel went up the mountain.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ ka ti niriba maa baŋ ni di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma n-sɔŋ bɛn simdi sɔŋbu, ka pa ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din ka nyɔri.
en: But our people should also learn to devote themselves to doing good in order to meet pressing needs so they arent unproductive.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, din kariya ni n niŋ lala. N ni tooi nyu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima chaŋ ŋɔ ʒim? Dinzuɣu ka o daa bi nyu kom maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala.
en: David said, Lord , I cannot drink this water. It would be like drinking the blood of the men who risked their lives for me. This is why David refused to drink the water. The Three Heroes did many brave things like that.

dag: Ka yiŋbia ŋun mi bi mi o duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛli ka tum din simdi buri, o buri ni bala. Bɛ ni ti ninvuɣ so pam, o sani ka bɛ ni ti lan bɔhi pam yɛla; ka niriba ni zaŋ fukumsi pam niŋ so mi nuu ni, o sani ka bɛ ni ti bɔhi din galisi pam yɛla.
en: The one who didnt know the masters will but who did things deserving punishment will be beaten only a little. Much will be demanded from everyone who has been given much, and from the one who has been entrusted with much, even more will be asked.

dag: Naa Jɔash daa bi lan teei Zakaria ba Jɛhɔiada ni daa niŋ o nirilim shɛm la zaa yɛla, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o bia maa. Zakaria ni daa yɛn kpi, o daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, nyam bɛ ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ, ka bɔhi ba biɛri.
en: King Jehoash failed to remember the loyalty that Jehoiada, Zechariahs father, had shown him and murdered Jehoiadas son, who cried out as he lay dying, May the LORD see and seek vengeance.

dag: A ni daa na bi darigi n tibili la, n daa birigiya; amaa pumpɔŋɔ n dol a yɛligu.
en: Before I suffered, I took the wrong way, but now I do what you say.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Hiram.
en: This is what Solomon said to King Hiram:.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a kɔre kpe o viɛlim ni a suhu ni, ka miri ka a chɛ ka o gbaag a o nina ni lihiri shɛm puuni.
en: Such a woman might be beautiful, but dont let that beauty tempt you. Dont let her eyes capture you.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti tam bɔrɔbɔro ʒibu yɛla ka mali hal ti baai du teeku yaɣili.
en: When the disciples crossed over to the other side of the lake, they forgot to take any bread.

dag: Ka Musa bɔɣiri daa ti ja, ka bɛ bo kuɣili na ti sɔŋ ka o ʒini di zuɣu, ka Aduna mini Hur daa gub gbaag o nuhi maa mali. Yino daa ʒiɛla o nudirigu polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe o nuzaa polo, ka o nuhi maa daa kul ʒe tibi hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: After a while, his arms were so tired that Aaron and Hur got a rock for him to sit on. Then they stood beside him and supported his arms in the same position until sunset.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Daniɛl la, A ni tooi yɛli ma zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: In reply the king said to Daniel , Can you really tell me the dream that I saw, as well as its meaning.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ha, ka bundaan so ŋun daa yi Arimatia na ka o yuli booni Yisifu, ka o nyɛ Yisa nyaandol la.
en: That evening a rich disciple named Joseph from the town of Arimathea.

dag: Nol lɔbu maa daba ata dali ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o nam binyɛra ye n-chaŋ ti kpe n-ʒe nayili zɔŋ ni tuhi nam ʒiishee duu. Naa maa daa ʒila o nam ʒiishee tuhi dunoli.
en: On the third day, Esther put on her special robes. Then she stood in the inside area of the kings palace, in front of the kings hall. The king was sitting on his throne in the hall, facing the place where people enter the throne room.

dag: Yi nyuri bari yɛra, Ti nyɛla tiŋ kasi la tiŋbihi, ka zaŋ timaŋ dalim Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: They are known as residents of the holy city, those who depend upon the God of Israel— the LORD of heavenly forces is his name.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋmaligi po omaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N je Yaakubu karimbaani la. N je bɛ ni me bɛ yiya suma shɛŋa la. N ni zaŋ bɛ tin tital la niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The LORD God has solemnly sworn, says the LORD, the God of heavenly forces: I reject the pride of Jacob. I hate his fortresses. I will hand over the city and all that is in it.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa dii darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka yɛli, O mɔri Naawuni! Bɔ ka ti lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm.
en: At this the High Priest tore his clothes and said, Blasphemy! We don't need any more witnesses! You have just heard his blasphemy!.

dag: A tiŋguliba ŋmanila sakɔri, ka a zaligubaŋdiba ŋmani toli bɛn galisi ni yi tabili gariche di ni maha pam dahin shɛli, ka wuntaŋ ti nyee, ka bɛ yiɣi chaŋ, ka so bi mi bɛ ni chaŋ luɣ shɛl la.
en: And your government officials are also like locusts that settle on a stone wall on a cold day. But when the sun comes up, the rocks become warm, and the locusts all fly away. And no one knows where.

dag: Ka yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala.
en: Do for others just what you want them to do for you.

dag: A daa labisi ti taŋkpaɣu ni; ka yɛli, Yinim daadamnima, labimiya taŋkpaɣu ni yaha.
en: You tell us to return to what we were; you change us back to dust.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim shɛb bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda dim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tiba ni, ka bɛ taai duŋ n-yiɣisi bɛ suhuri bahi Yisa nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: But some of the Jews did not believe. They said things that caused the non-Jewish people to be angry and turn against the believers.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zali Jɔab mini Abishai ni Itai zaligu n-yɛli N zuɣu, miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom shɛli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa wum naa ni zali sapashin kpamba maa zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Absalom polo maa.
en: The king gave orders to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: For my sake, protect my boy Absalom. All the troops heard what the king ordered regarding Absalom to all the commanders.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli ba, Bomiya la palli n-niŋ yalim niŋ di ni ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa bo li na ti ti o.
en: He replied, Put some salt in a new bowl and bring it to me. They brought him the bowl of salt.

dag: Yisa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ bahi, o daa yiɣisila nimaani n-kpe ŋariŋ yi kpaŋa. Ka salo daa wum o chandi maa damli, ka yi tinsi ni n-chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu kar o naba.
en: When Jesus heard about John, he withdrew in a boat to a deserted place by himself. When the crowds learned this, they followed him on foot from the cities.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kul tia, din wula chaŋ ti kpe kɔzɔrim ni, wuuni yi ti du, di baɣa kani, ka di vari kul nyɛ va maha sahakam. Ka sanzali yuuni puuni, di baɣa kani, ka wala kul bi kɔŋdi di zuɣu.
en: They will be like trees planted by the streams, whose roots reach down to the water. They wont fear drought when it comes; their leaves will remain green. They wont be stressed in the time of drought or fail to bear fruit.

dag: Di saha ka Nan bia Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ayi ashilɔni n-yɛli ba, Chamiya ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, di bamdi Jɛriko. Ka bɛ daa yi Akasia chaŋ ti kpe pagɔr so ŋun yuli daa booni Reehab la yiŋa.
en: Then Joshua sent two spies from the camp at Acacia with orders to go and secretly explore the land of Canaan, especially the city of Jericho. When they came to the city, they went to spend the night in the house of a prostitute named Rahab.

dag: Wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli soli n-nyɛ a nam ʒiishee tanzaa, ka yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali be a tooni.
en: Your throne is built on righteousness and justice; loyal love and faithfulness stand in front of you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zo n-kuli Gaat Naa Akishi ŋun daa nyɛ Maok bia la sani.
en: So David and his six hundred men went over at once to Achish son of Maoch, king of Gath.

dag: Vuhim Dabisili dali ka Yisa daa gari tandi n-zaŋ neeg o nina maa.
en: Now Jesus made the mud and smeared it on the mans eyes on a Sabbath day.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me o tɔbutuhiri bimbina tabili yi goma, ka zaŋ kpandi wurim yi binwɔɣila.
en: He will bring the logs to break down your walls. He will use picks and break down your towers.

dag: ni nyaanyiriba ni bɛn baɣa ka shɛl ni ni maŋduhiriba ni bɛn yuri niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim gari Naawuni.
en: they will be treacherous, reckless, and swollen with pride; they will love pleasure rather than God;.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi liɣiri pam ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba.
en: We could have sold this perfume for a lot of money and given it to the poor.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣisi mir o ba Yisahaku, ka o shih o ka yɛli, Kukoli ŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu kukoli, amaa nuhi ŋɔ nyɛla Iso nuhi.
en: Jacob went closer. His father touched him and said, You sound like Jacob, but your hands feel hairy like Esau's.

dag: Bɛ daa liri bɛn mali biŋkɔbiri n-taɣi piɛri mini buhi ni laakuma chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa daa yuri Dauda, dama ŋuna n-daa yi zaŋdi ba chani tɔb ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina.
en: But everyone else in Judah and Israel was loyal to David, because he led the army in battle.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ninvuɣ biɛri biɛhigu shee ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni, lala n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: These are surely the dwelling places of the evil; this is the place of the one who doesnt know God.

dag: Yi zuri yi mabihi nyaaŋa, ka zaŋdi yimaŋmaŋ mapuuni bihi taali.
en: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ba, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka guliya Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ ya leei Naawuni piɛ shɛb guliba la, ka dihiri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni Cheechi shɛli o ni daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Bia ʒim fa m-bahi la.
en: Watch yourselves and the whole flock, in which the Holy Spirit has placed you as supervisors, to shepherd Gods church, which he obtained with the death of his own Son.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ, bɛ daa kuhirimi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi lan zaŋ salima nɛma niŋ omaŋa.
en: When the people heard the bad news, they were sorry. No one put on any jewelry.

dag: N wumla n yura kukoli. Nyama, o yila zoya zuɣu zɔrina. O zɔrimi duri kunkuna kani n sanna.
en: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Di sabi zali ni faashee Masia di wahala, ka lan neei kum ni daba ata dali;.
en: Jesus said to them, It is written that the Messiah would be killed and rise from death on the third day.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n kul kumdi ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka di bi chɛra, dama bɛ ŋme n niriba bɛn be kaman m bipuɣiŋga ŋun ʒi doo maa kurili luhi, ka bɛ nya dan titali.
en: The Lord commanded me to tell the people about my sorrow and to say: May my eyes flow with tears day and night, may I never stop weeping, for my people are deeply wounded and are badly hurt.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi yi saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di ni gbuɣi ya bahi kaman di ni daa gbuɣi zuliya shɛb bɛn daa be yi tooni la bahi shɛm la.
en: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu somiya buri, ka kum ka fabili, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali maa na bi miligi ka chɛ ti.
en: So put on sackcloth, and weep and wail because the fierce anger of the Lord has not turned away from Judah.

dag: O yi ti dɔni, nyin kpahimmi baŋ o ni dɔni luɣ shɛli maa, ka o ti ʒeei gom bahi ka a chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli. O ni ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Watch where he goes to spend the night, then when he is asleep, lift the cover and lie down at his feet. He will tell you what to do.

dag: O vuhim pɔhim daa ʒe n-neei zuɣusaa, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu kuhi wahu ŋun zɔri ni o tiligi.
en: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa Naawuni ʒii nyabu maa puuni n-zaŋ ma chaŋ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani. Di saha ka n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli maa daa chɛ ma.
en: Then the Spirit lifted me into the air and brought me back to Babylonia. It brought me back to the people who were forced to leave Israel. I saw all this in the vision from God. Then the one I saw in the vision rose into the air and left me.

dag: Ka bɛ naa ŋun be bɛ sani ni ti kah o nɛma buɣ o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu zaawun yuŋ yi, ka bɛ ti chibi gooni voli ka o doli dini yi. O ni ti zaŋ bini pil o nina din ni chɛ ka o nini ku nya tiŋgbani.
en: And your leader will make a hole in the wall and sneak out at night. He will cover his face so that people will not recognize him. His eyes will not be able to see where he is going.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi chaŋ zoya ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti paai Ɛshikol Vinvamli ni m-puɣisi chaŋ ti kaai li.
en: Then they left and went up to the hill country. They came to the Valley of Eshcol and explored it.

dag: Bɛ gɔŋla bɛ zilima ka di be kaman tɔbiri la; bɛ mali yaa pam tiŋgbani maa ni zaŋ chaŋ ʒiri ŋmabu polo, ka pa ni yɛlimaŋli polo. Dama bɛ kul tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka bi mi ma, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They are always ready to tell lies; dishonesty instead of truth rules the land. The Lord says, My people do one evil thing after another and do not acknowledge me as their God.

dag: Yɛm chɛ ka nir nyari jilima, amaa bɛn ka li soli nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: People like a person with good sense, but life is hard for someone who cannot be trusted.

dag: Naa Siiza Agasitus daa ti bahi noli ni bɛ sab o tiŋgbɔŋ ni niriba zaa yuya baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: It was about that same time that Augustus Caesar sent out an order to all people in the countries that were under Roman rule. The order said that everyones name must be put on a list.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhirila bɔ? Di wuhirimi ni bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣili nyɛla shɛli bee buɣili maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ shɛli?.
en: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ dundɔŋ gili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunoli. Lala ka Musa daa niŋ naai tuma maa.
en: Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa kpi dindali maa kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaanu. Ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: In all, twenty-five thousand Benjaminites were killed that day—all of them brave soldiers.

dag: Amaa ka Rabishake bɔhi ba, Yi mini naa kɔŋko ka n dan tim ti na ni ti ti yɛli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka pa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi gooni ŋɔ zuɣu maa gba? Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛn pahi yi zuɣu di bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi ka nyu bɛmaŋmaŋ dulim.
en: The field commander said to them, Did my master send me to speak these words just to you and your master and not also to the men on the wall? They are the ones who will have to eat their dung and drink their urine along with you.

dag: ka daa boli nachimbil so ŋun daa tumd o tuma na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm paɣ ŋɔ yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: He called his servant and said, Get this girl out of this room, now! And lock the door after her.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la yiko, amaa ka lee chɛ ba ni bɛ be saha biɛla pahi.
en: The authority and rule of the other animals had been taken from them. But they were permitted to live for a certain period of time.

dag: Zaŋm li lo n-niŋ a suhu ni sahakam, ka zaŋ li lo a nyiŋgoli ni.
en: Bind them on your heart for all time; fasten them around your neck.

dag: Puhimiya yi zuɣulaannim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Italinim la puhiri ya.
en: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka niriba maa kul be yiriŋ maa.
en: Moses saw that Aaron had let the people get out of control. They were being wild, and all their enemies could see them acting like fools.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zo yomyom chaŋ ti di nɛma, ka tum din bi tiɣi Yawɛ nini.
en: Why didn't you listen to the Lord ? Why did you keep the animals and make him angry.

dag: Zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ bɛ dɔɣi yi tiligira ŋun nyɛ Masia ni yi Duuma la Naa Dauda ya Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Your savior is born today in Davids city. He is Christ the Lord.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N ka laɣifu din ni ti a, amaa n ni mali shɛli, dina ka n yɛn ti a: Yisa Masia Nazarɛt nir yuli zuɣu, yiɣisim zani n-leei ŋun chana.
en: But Peter said, I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ŋun zuɣu ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ lee paai ti ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka di gbaala Jona.
en: The sailors said to each other, Let's draw lots and find out who is to blame for getting us into this danger. They did so, and Jonah's name was drawn.

dag: Amaa nir yi yuri ka ku o kpee, yin zaŋmiya dilana sara maligu bimbini gbini n-yi kpaŋ ti ku o.
en: If you plan in advance to murder someone, there's no escape, not even by holding on to my altar. You will be dragged off and killed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti pirigi Yisa binyɛra ka zaŋ kpar ʒiɛɣu yɛl o.
en: They stripped off his clothes and put a scarlet robe on him.

dag: M malaika maa yi ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ya tahi Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Keenannim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n ti ku ba ka chɛ ka yi ʒini nimaani.
en: When my messenger goes in front of you and brings you to the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and I wipe them out.

dag: Bɛ shihi vu m-miri gballi ni, ka bɛ nyɛviya miri bɛn tahiri kum na.
en: They might be close to death, their lives about to end.

dag: Ka a yi kɔhi binshɛli ti a kpee bee a yi da binshɛli a kpee sani, yin di ŋariya taba.
en: So when you sell land to an Israelite or buy land, do not deal unfairly.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ ku bihi laamba bɛ bihi zuɣu bee n-ku bihi bɛ laamba zuɣu; kulila sokam maŋmaŋ tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ ni ku o.
en: Parents are not to be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children are not to be put to death for crimes committed by their parents; people are to be put to death only for a crime they themselves have committed.

dag: Dama o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim na bela o ni. O daa kpaai li pala tampiŋ zuɣu. O daa bi kpaai li bahi tiŋa ni o niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: Jerusalem is like a pot with rust on it. This is because the blood from the murders is still there! She put the blood on the bare rock. She did not pour the blood on the ground and cover it with dirt.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka Asirianim ti kani Ijipti na, ka Ijiptinim gba kani Asiria na; ka Ijiptinim mini Asirianim ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ.
en: At that time there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. Then the Assyrians will go to Egypt, and the Egyptians will go to Assyria. Egypt will work with Assyria.

dag: Biɣivai daŋ — tusaayi ni pihinunaayɔbu.
en: of Bigvai .

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni daŋ kam niriba laɣim gbilligbilli, ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Matiri daŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ Matiri daŋ maa ni dɔbba zaa zali, ka bɛ vihi nya, ka piila Kish bia Sool. Amaa bɛ ni daa ti bɔr o bɛ daa bi nya o.
en: Next, Samuel brought each clan of Benjamin there, and the Lord chose the Matri clan. Finally, Saul the son of Kish was chosen. But when they looked for him, he was nowhere to be found.

dag: Ka biasani ti yɛl o ba, M ba, tim ma fal shɛli n ni ti yɛn di a kalinsi nyaaŋa pumpɔŋɔ. Ka doo maa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛli m-pirigi ti o bihi maa.
en: The younger son said to his father, Give me my share of the property. So the father divided his property between his two sons.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔna do n-gil a, ka dabiɛm lu a zuɣu libig a.
en: That is why traps are all around you, and sudden trouble makes you afraid.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zaŋ Daniɛl n-zali zaashe tital ni; ka ti o pin kara pam; ka zaŋ o leei ŋun su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ fukumsi ni baŋdiba zaa zuɣulana.
en: Then the king exalted Daniel and lavished gifts on him, making him ruler over all the province of Babylon and chief minister over all Babylons sages.

dag: ka di daa ti paag o ni o kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ti tuɣili tulaale zim kaman bɛ daadiini soli ni daa zali shɛm.
en: According to the custom of the priests, he had been chosen to go into the Lord's temple that day and to burn incense.

dag: ka bɛn be zibisim ni mini kum mahim ni ni ti nya neesim maa, ka di ni ti wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli nya suhudoo.
en: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.

dag: Asha zuliya n-daa pah anu n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The fifth part of land was given to the tribe of Asher. Each family in that tribe got its part of the land.

dag: Di saha ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu, ka bahi ba, ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So Hanun arrested Davids servants and cut off their beards. Hanun also cut their clothes off at the hip and sent them away.

dag: Ti ba daa kpila mɔɣu la ni. O daa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim pahi Kɔra zuɣu taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ la kalinli ni, amaa omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa kpi; ka mi ka bidibisi.
en: Our father died in the wilderness without leaving any sons. He was not among the followers of Korah, who rebelled against the Lord ; he died because of his own sin.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili maa dali ti yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku beni. Dindali maa ti shiri yɛn zibisimi, ka neesim ku be di ni.
en: The Lord s special day will be a day of darkness, not light—a day of gloom, without a ray of light.

dag: Ka juri daa ti kana ni bɛ ti di ba, ka Ibram kari ba.
en: When vultures swooped down on the carcasses, Abram waved them off.

dag: ka a zaŋ binyɛra din be kasi yɛli Aduna ka booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni m-mal o, ka o leei maligumaana n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka o chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: So King Solomon gave orders to Benaiah, who went out and killed Adonijah.

dag: Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daa galisimi kaman teeku duli bihigu la, ka bɛ daa diri ka nyuri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Judah and Israel grew numerous like the sand alongside the sea. They ate, drank, and celebrated.

dag: Laɣimmiya dakuɣiri duhi, ka niŋ buɣim niŋ li n-niŋ binnyoma niŋ nimdi maa ni duɣi li, ka chɛ ka di kɔba di buɣim.
en: Pile on the wood, light the fire, and cook the meat. Season it well and let the bones be charred.

dag: O min o yiŋ zaa ni daa deei kom baptaizibu nyaaŋa ka o balim ti yɛli, Yi yi zahim ma nya ka n nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim n suhu ni ni ti Duuma, yin kamiyana ti be n yiŋa. Ka o ni daa balim ti ni nimmoo zuɣu chɛ ka ti niŋ lala.
en: Then after she and her family were baptized, she kept on begging us, If you think I really do have faith in the Lord, come stay in my home. Finally, we accepted her invitation.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala yɛnnima, amaa o daari bɛn bi ʒe yim yɛtɔɣa bahira.
en: The Lord sees to it that truth is kept safe by disproving the words of liars.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku ni daa dii sɔhiri ka o bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee pun go mɔɣu ku nimdi n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n ŋub di zaa, ka pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni pɔi ka a naanyi kana ŋɔ? O mi shiri nya alibarika.
en: Then Isaac became so upset that he began to shake. He said, Then who was it that cooked and brought me food before you came? I ate it all, and I blessed him. Now it is too late to take back my blessing.

dag: O chɛ ka sɔŋsim yi o jɛmbu duu mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na ti sɔŋ a.
en: May he send you help from his Holy Place. May he support you from Zion.

dag: O daa kaai gili nimaani tinsi zaa n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri pam m-mali ti paai Giriis.
en: As he traveled from place to place, he encouraged the followers with many messages. Finally, he went to Greece.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ti pin kɔŋkɔb shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zaŋ li tum tuma ŋun Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ ti ni la zuɣu: Naawuni ni ti ti pin shɛli yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, chɛliya ka ti tɔɣisi li kaman ti yɛda ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: We all have different gifts. Each gift came because of the grace God gave us. Whoever has the gift of prophecy should use that gift in a way that fits the kind of faith they have.

dag: Ka niriba tusaanahi niŋ dunɔguliba; ka niriba tusaanahi la mi zaŋdi n ni daa mali wumpaɣibo biŋkumdi shɛŋa la paɣiri Yawɛ.
en: , gatekeepers, and , praising the LORD with instruments made for offering praise.

dag: Ka yi bihi ŋɔ mi ni leei piɛguliba mɔɣu ŋɔ ni yuun pihinahi. Bɛ ni di wahala yi ni bi ʒe yim la zuɣu hal ka yi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ti kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Your children will wander around in this desert years, suffering because of your sins, until all of you are dead.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔritiŋmana.
en: He will curse you with empty baskets and pans.

dag: Zɔan zuɣulaannim nyɛla jɛra, ka Mɛmfisi nabihi nyɛ bɛn yɔhindi niriba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bɛ zuliya ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri birigi Ijiptinima.
en: The leaders of Zoan have been fooled. The leaders of Noph have believed lies, so they lead Egypt the wrong way.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Ɛlim n-chaŋ ti kpe Sin tiŋgban nɛli din daa be Ɛlim mini Sinai sunsuuni la ni gol so ŋun daa pahir ayi bɛ Ijipti yibu maa nyaaŋa biɛɣ pinaanu dali.
en: Then all the Israelites left Elim. They reached the western Sinai desert, between Elim and Mount Sinai, on the th day of the second month after leaving Egypt.

dag: ka zaŋya n vuhim dabisa la leei dabisa kasi, ka di leei shihirili m mini ya sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Make the Sabbath a holy day, so that it will be a sign of the covenant we made, and will remind you that I am the Lord your God.

dag: Kul zanimiyala yim saɣi ni yi tum taali, ni yi daa taai duŋ zaɣisi man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka zaŋ yi yurilim yaɣiri saamba sani ti mahili kam gbini ka bi deei n noli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you must recognize your sin. You turned against the Lord your God. That is your sin. You worshiped the idols of other nations. You worshiped them under every green tree. You did not obey me. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Zaadali Ninivenim ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama Anabi Jona ni daa yihi ba waazu la, bɛ daa niŋ tuuba; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Anabi Jona be kpe!.
en: On the day of judgment the people of Nineveh will stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah.

dag: Bɛ ʒim mini bɛ kpam ni ti ŋam Yawɛ takɔb maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋ piɛ shɛb mini bu shɛb mali sara ʒim ni bɛ kpam la. Dama Yawɛ ni mali sara Bɔzira. O ni ku niriba pam Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The LORD has a sword covered with blood; it is soaked with fat from the blood of lambs and goats, from the kidney fat of rams, for the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti shihi kum din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpe daɣiri ni, amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ ba bee bɛ ma bee bɛ bidibiga bee bɛ bipuɣiŋga bee bɛ mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee bɛ tizɔpaɣa ŋun bi kuli doo, bɛ ni tooi kpe daɣiri ni.
en: They will not go near a dead person to make themselves unclean. But they may make themselves unclean if the dead person is their father, mother, son, daughter, brother, or a sister who is not married.

dag: Ka Sintani daa ti yiɣisi lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, m-piɛli Dauda ni o kali Izraɛlnima.
en: A heavenly Adversary arose against Israel and incited David to count Israel.

dag: N zaŋ n fabila sɔŋla o tooni. N yɛli n yɛlimuɣisira ni nyɛ shɛli o tooni.
en: I pour out my concerns before God; I announce my distress to him.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli shia din be daadam ni, ka nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa vuhim ŋɔ n-chɛ ka daadam baŋdi binyara.
en: But it is the spirit of Almighty God that comes to us and gives us wisdom.

dag: Salo maa ni daa wum Pool yɛtɔɣa maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai o ni yoli yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛra, Kumiy o! Kumiy o! Dama nira ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo bi simdi ni o be.
en: The crowd listened to Paul until he said this. Then they shouted, Away with this man! Hes not fit to live.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiligi Ziɔn, ka lan me Juda tinsi zali, ka o daba ti be nimaani su li.
en: He will save Jerusalem and rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there and possess the land;.

dag: A chɛ ka daadamnim vuura kaman zahindi la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila mɔri din puhiri yirina asibaasi.
en: You carry us away like a flood; we last no longer than a dream. We are like weeds that sprout in the morning.

dag: Di saha ka Finɛhas daa yiɣisi zani n-tim sandaani ka alɔbo maa chɛ.
en: But Phinehas prayed to God, and God stopped the sickness.

dag: Miri ka a bɔri ni yuŋ zibi din nyɛ din ʒiri niriba chani la.
en: Dont wish for the night when people vanish from their place.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa kpi dindali maa kalinli daa yiɣisila tuhi pisinaanu. Ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: All in all, the total number of Benjaminites who fell that day was twenty-five thousand men, all of whom were armed with swords and were strong warriors.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of the people of Israel, says to all the people he sent into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon:.

dag: Yi bi mi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nti yɛn kari dunia ŋɔ nim saria? Ka yinima n-yi nyɛ bɛn ni ti kari dunianim saria, dindina yi ku tooi kari yimaŋmaŋ sunsuuni yɛtɔɣ bihi saria?.
en: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? Well, then, if you are to judge the world, aren't you capable of judging small matters?.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ŋmanila azichi wain ti shɛli din wali wala. Bɛ zuliya ni kul galisiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul mɛri maligu bimbina pahira. Bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ dariza ni kul pahiri shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba kul pahiri bɛ ni jɛmdi binwɔɣil shɛŋa la gba dariza.
en: Israel is a growing vine that yields its fruit. The more his fruit increased, the more altars he built; the richer his land became, the more he set up sacred standing stones.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Zaŋm Lɛvinim zali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa zaani, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi zali Izraɛlnim niɣi zaani, ka Lɛvinim maa nyɛ n ni su shɛba.
en: Now dedicate the Levites as mine in place of all the first-born Israelite sons, and dedicate the livestock of the Levites in place of the first-born of the Israelites' livestock.

dag: Miriya ka yi me napɔna dubu shee n-zali n sara maligu bimbini gbini n-dur li din ni chɛ ka so nya yi zaɣim. .
en: Do not build an altar for me with steps leading up to it; if you do, you will expose yourselves as you go up the steps.

dag: Liya nina daa dii ka alaafee, amaa ka Reechɛl ŋun daa viɛli pam ka o ninni kul nyɛlisira.
en: Leah had lovely eyes, but Rachel was shapely and beautiful.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka muɣisigu ŋɔ paai niriba ka bɛ ti chani kaman zoomba la, bɛ ni tum alahichi man Yawɛ sani zuɣu. Bɛ ʒim ni yi n-zɔri kaman kom la. Ka bɛ niŋgbuna ti dɔni tiŋgban ni pooi.
en: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyin daadam, yilimi kuyilli bahi Taai zuɣu.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, sing a funeral song for Tyre.

dag: Ka Pita daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la doli ba. Nyaandol maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒi n-tab Yisa bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu ka bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi a nyaaŋ la.
en: Peter turned and saw Jesus' favorite disciple following them. He was the same one who had sat next to Jesus at the meal and had asked, Lord, who is going to betray you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa deei paɣ maa ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na maa ka yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋ ni suhudoo, nyama, n wum a yɛligu maa, ka ni niŋ a ni fabili niŋ ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then David accepted what she had brought him and said to her, Go back home and don't worry. I will do what you want.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai bua n-kɔrigi zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu tim bua maa ʒim ni.
en: His brothers took Josephs robe, slaughtered a male goat, and dipped the robe in the blood.

dag: Niriba yi turi ya ka niŋdi ya alaka, ka ŋmari ʒi biɛri balibu kam pari ya n zuɣu, yi mal alibarika.
en: Happy are you when people insult you and persecute you and tell all kinds of evil lies against you because you are my followers.

dag: Dama n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa biɛrim nyabu chɛ ka n gba nyala biɛrim. N fabiliya ka di niŋ ma yoli.
en: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.

dag: Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ a sɔŋda ŋɔ n-naɣi ni ti kpe di ni. Kpaŋsim o, dama ŋuna n-yɛn chɛ ka Izraɛlnim deei li su.
en: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ.
en: The man bowed down and praised the LORD.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka n lee nya ka di do tooni ŋɔ ha? Ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl o, Naawuni daanabi ŋun daa yi Juda na nti yɛl a ni niŋ Bɛtɛl bimbini ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ yɛla siliga m-bala.
en: Whose tomb is that? he asked. The people of Bethel answered, It is the tomb of the prophet who came from Judah and predicted these things that you have done to this altar.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, A yi doli ma, a yɛla ni ti muɣisi ma.
en: David told him: If you come with me, you might slow us down.

dag: Ti ni daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa saha shɛli maa, ka n daa zaŋ Aroa nuzaa polo yaɣili din be Arinɔn kulibɔŋ nol la mini Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya ni tinsi la pirigili mini di fɔntinsi ti Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba.
en: So we took that land to be ours. I gave part of this land to the tribes of Reuben and Gad. I gave them the land from Aroer in the Arnon Valley to the hill country of Gilead with the cities in it. They got half of the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Bina anahi m-beni damdi dunia ŋɔ, ka di ku tooi deei li. Dina n-nyɛ:.
en: There are four things that the earth itself cannot tolerate:.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: Joseph went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.

dag: Dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana. N suhu saɣimya pam.
en: I am only a poor, helpless man. I am so sad; my heart is broken.

dag: Yisa ni daa be Jɛrusalɛm Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha maa, niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda bɛ nini ni daa nya shihir shɛŋa o ni wuhi la zuɣu.
en: Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Passover festival. Many people believed in him because they saw the miraculous signs he did.

dag: Alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ beni, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba beni; amaa alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba viɛlim be di ko.
en: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
