dag: Takɔbi ni ti be samban ni, ka alɔbo mini kum be tiŋ puuni, bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn be sambani, ka kum min alɔbo mi lu bɛn be tiŋ puuni zuɣu.
en: Outside, the sword! Inside, plague and famine! Whoever is out in the field will die by the sword. Whoever is in the city, plague and famine will consume them.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Kamiyana ka ti chaŋ Giligal nti lan leei ti nam maa.
en: Lets go to Gilgal, Samuel told the people, and renew the monarchy there.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔsis ma Mariama daa nya bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses saw the place where Jesus was put.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛya, ka naa ŋmalig o nini bahi bɛ polo n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ bɛ zaa ni.
en: The king turned around, and while the entire assembly of Israel was standing there, he blessed them.

dag: O daa bi baŋ ni mani n-tir o kawana mini wain ni kpam ni anzinfa ni salin shɛli bɛ ni mali jɛmdi Baal la.
en: She didnt know that I gave her the corn, the new wine, and the fresh oil, and that I gave her much silver, and gold that they used for Baal.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpuɣi ti nuhi zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ ti suhuri ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ.
en: Let us open our hearts to God in heaven and pray.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni noli zuɣu, di chɛliya ka kɔr biɛri be yi biɛhigu ni kaman di ni daa be yi ni shɛm yi ni daa na be ʒilinsi puuni la.
en: Be obedient to God, and do not allow your lives to be shaped by those desires you had when you were still ignorant.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔri Yawɛ nia biɛɣu? O ni chɛ ka di zani tariga; o dim ku tooi mo o buyi.
en: Why are you making plans against the Lord ? He will bring complete destruction, so you will not cause trouble again.

dag: Niŋmiy o larigim ka miriya ka yi kul chaŋ mir o yiŋ dunoli.
en: Stay away from the woman who commits adultery. Dont even go near her house.

dag: Atarɔt mini Dibɔn ni Jaza ni Nimira ni Hɛshibɔn ni Ɛliale ni Siibam ni Nɛbo ni Bɛɔn.
en: They said, We, your servants, have many cattle. And the land that the Lord let the people of Israel capture is good land for cattle. This land includes the area around Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sibmah, Nebo, and Beon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Banima n-lee ni tooi sɔɣi ashilɔni luɣ shɛli ka n ku tooi nya ba? M bi bela zuɣusaa mini dunia ni zaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Can people hide themselves in secret places so I might not see them? Dont I fill heaven and earth?.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: They will press their hand on the head of the purification offering. It will be slaughtered at the place for the entirely burned offerings.

dag: N dolila wuntia soli ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: I always do what is right.

dag: Amaa kum daa nyaŋ sokam zaa Adam ʒiɛman ni zaŋ hal ti paai Anabi Musa ʒiɛman ni, hal ka nyaŋ bɛn daa bi tum alahichi shɛli Adam ni daa tum la tatabo. Adam daa nyɛla ŋun daa ti yɛn kana la ŋmahinli.
en: But from the time of Adam to the time of Moses, death ruled over all human beings, even over those who did not sin in the same way that Adam did when he disobeyed God's command. Adam was a figure of the one who was to come.

dag: N ŋman piɛlli ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yino ko. O kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ o ma bipuɣiŋga. O ka dalinli. Paɣiba yi kul nya o, bɛ paɣir o mi. Napaɣiba mini naa mamanim gba yi kul nya o bɛ paɣir o mi.
en: but there is only one woman for me, my dove, my perfect one. She is the favorite of her mother, her mothers favorite child. The young women see her and praise her. Even the queens and slave women praise her.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N yɛrila yinim bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, yumiya yi dimnima, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: But I say to you people who are listening to me, love your enemies. Do good to those who hate you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi tin tariga nti siɣi wain adaka maa puuni nɔra, ka ʒim daa zɔri yiri wain tɔɣiri adaka maa ni na n-zo n-chaŋ hal ti paai kaman kilomita kɔbisita wɔɣilim tariga, ka di zilim mi paai wɔhu nyɔɣu tariga.
en: The grapes were squeezed in the winepress outside the city. Blood flowed out of the winepress. It rose as high as the heads of the horses for a distance of miles.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, a yi ku niriba ŋɔ zaa yim, di saha zuliya shɛb bɛn pun wum a yuli dubu la ni yɛli.
en: So you must not kill these people now. If you kill them, all the nations who have heard about your power will say.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a nam maa ku lan chaŋ tooni, dama Yawɛ pun piig o suhu ni yu ninvuɣ so n-zaŋ o leeg o niriba naa, dama a bi doli Yawɛ ni zal a shɛm.
en: But now your kingdom wont continue. The Lord was looking for a man who wants to obey him. He has found that man—and the Lord has chosen him to be the new leader of his people, because you didnt obey his command.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: The sons answered, Let us share the great honor you will have as king. Let one of us sit at your right side and the other at your left.

dag: Ka yiliŋ kam ti ŋari, ka zoya mini daboya zaa ti nahi taba, ka luɣ shɛlikam din golim ti tuhi, ka soli kam din be gbirimagbirima ti niŋ polipoli.
en: Fill up every valley and level every mountain and hill. Straighten the crooked paths and smooth out the rough roads.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, dɔbba gba daa tumdila dagɔr tuma bɛ buɣa maa malibu shee. Judanim daa tum din chihiri shɛlikam ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Yawɛ ti kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa kana ti ʒini maa ni daa tumdi la.
en: There were also men who served other gods by selling their bodies for sex. So the people of Judah were worse than the people who had lived in the land before them. And the Lord took the land away from those people to give it to the Israelites.

dag: Dama saha kanna ka yi dimnim ni ti kana nti teei gili ya, ka lan me bimbin kara tabili yi gooni.
en: Jerusalem, the time will come when your enemies will build walls around you to attack you. Armies will surround you and close in on you from every side.

dag: Ka o daa ti maani Izraɛlnima ansarisi, ka Dauda Mabia Shimia bia Jɔnatan daa ku o.
en: he made fun of Israel, so David's nephew Jonathan killed him.

dag: Nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka mali yɛm, o so ninvuɣ kurigu ŋun nyɛ naa, ka nyɛ jɛrigu ŋun ku saɣi deei saɣisigu.
en: A young leader who is poor but wise is better than a king who is old but foolish. That old king does not listen to warnings.

dag: ni Reeya daŋ niriba ni Rɛzin daŋ niriba ni Nɛkɔda daŋ niriba.
en: Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Kpahimmiya fiig tia: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: Learn this parable from the fig tree. After its branch becomes tender and it sprouts new leaves, you know that summer is near.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa sɔhigiya ka dam, dama Yawɛ ni lo nia ni o chɛ ka Babilɔn zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni la n-yɛn niŋ pali.
en: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.

dag: Yinim Speennima, labimiya yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni. Kpe lan pala teeku kulinoli.
en: Go through your own land, Daughter Tarshish, for the harbor is gone.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim mini ʒiŋmariba bihi ŋɔ, ŋuni ka yi lee maani ansarisi? Bee ŋuni ka yi lee mɛrigiri yi noya niŋda?.
en: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.

dag: Chɛ ka a tuma yi zahira a daba sani; ka chɛ ka a jilima ŋɔ yi zahira bɛ bihi sani.
en: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, N zahindi maa puuni, n daa ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli;.
en: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile.

dag: Bɛ zaa mi yɛn dɔnila taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zunzuya di ba.
en: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yihi ti Masia yurilim ni? Muɣisigu bee wahala bee alaka bee fifali bee gbinfini bee barina bee takɔbi ni tooi yihi ti di ni?.
en: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?.

dag: Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a, Yawɛ ni bɔh a biɛri ti ma, amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: May the Lord judge which one of us is wrong! May he punish you for your action against me, for I will not harm you in the least.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni tum alahichi shɛŋa min o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi shɛŋa la zuɣu ka o yɛn chɛ Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: The Lord will abandon Israel because Jeroboam sinned and led the people of Israel into sin.

dag: Ka o ʒiʒiinitab min o dɔɣiriba daa wum ti Duuma ni zo o nambɔ shɛli maa yɛla, ka di niŋ bɛ min o zaa suhupiɛlli pam.
en: Her neighbors and relatives celebrated with her because they had heard that the Lord had shown her great mercy.

dag: Yawɛ ku saɣi zaŋ o niriba bah o yuli din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, dama ŋuna n-daa yu ka pii ya leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: But the Lord wont leave his people. No, the Lord was pleased to make you his own people. So for his own good name, he wont leave you.

dag: Wɔr ʒiɛhi n-daa vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din daŋ tooni, ka wɔr sabila vɔri chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi.
en: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, the second by black horses.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita; ka wurim ti kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni.
en: You gave us away like sheep to be killed and eaten. You scattered us among the nations.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n kana ni n ti tumla a yubu. Naawuni daa kpihim tuuli sara maligunim la ka zalila din pah ayi.
en: Then he said, Look, Ive come to do your will . He puts an end to the first to establish the second.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, zom ma nambɔɣu n-tim Lazarɔs na ka o ti zaŋ o nubil tim kom ni n-tɔɣisi pa n zilinli zuɣu ka di maai, dama n nyari azaaba pam buɣim ŋɔ ni.
en: he said to Abraham, Have pity on me! Send Lazarus to dip his finger in water and touch my tongue. I'm suffering terribly in this fire.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daantalisi sa zɔŋ, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka kazala din mali daantalisi daa be di tooni, ka pateesa yili di tooni.
en: Solomon also built the Porch of Columns. It was cubits long and cubits wide. Along the front of the porch, there was a covering supported by columns.

dag: Amaa o di ti miri sariga la gbinna bee n-ka sara maligu bimbini la gbinna, dama o nyɛla ŋun mali dalinli, ka lala chɛ ka o ku dihi n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ vi; dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: but because he has a physical defect, he shall not come near the sacred curtain or approach the altar. He must not profane these holy things, because I am the Lord and I make them holy.

dag: Ka bɛ dii mɔhiri vuri, ka ŋari bɛ tiba n-kabi chaŋ o sani.
en: At this, they shrieked and covered their ears. Together, they charged at him.

dag: Ka a yi kɔhi binshɛli ti a kpee bee a yi da binshɛli a kpee sani, yin di ŋariya taba.
en: When you sell something to or buy something from your fellow citizen, you must not cheat each other.

dag: Bɛ daa yihila tinsi pinaayi Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti Mɛrari daŋ niriba kaman bɛ daŋ maa niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tiŋgbani maa tariga daa nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku la. Tintariga bɔbili maa n-daa gili Juda zuliya maa niŋ sunsuuni.
en: which was Judah's western border. The clans of Judah lived within these borders.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tiri nir nyɛvili wɔɣinli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yuma ni nyɛla biɛla.
en: If you respect the Lord , you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim galisim ni ti ŋmanila teeku duli bihigu din ku tooi buɣisi ka mi ku tooi kali ŋɔ. Ka luɣ shɛli di ni yɛli ba, Yi pala n niriba ŋɔ, di ni ti lan boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bidibisi.
en: Yet the number of the people of Israel will be like the sand of the sea, which can be neither measured nor numbered; and in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, it will be said to them, Children of the living God.

dag: Ka naa maa daa zaŋ Daniɛl n-zali zaashe tital ni; ka ti o pin kara pam; ka zaŋ o leei ŋun su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ fukumsi ni baŋdiba zaa zuɣulana.
en: The king then presented Daniel with a lot of gifts; he promoted him to governor of Babylon Province and put him in charge of the other wise men.

dag: O ni ka yaa maa zuɣu, di nyɛla talahi ni o maani maligu omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu kaman o ni maani niriba daalahichi zuɣu shɛm.
en: And because he is himself weak, he must offer sacrifices not only for the sins of the people but also for his own sins.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija.
en: Then the Lord said to Elijah.

dag: Ka daba ayopɔin maa dali di simdi ni maligumaana maa lihi dɔro maa yaha; ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi bi yɛligi, ka kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim mi ka di ni, ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni.
en: The priest shall examine the sore again on the seventh day, and if it has not spread and there are no yellowish hairs in it and it does not seem to be deeper than the surrounding skin.

dag: A piɛma diri pam naa dimnim suhuri ni; ka niriba lur a tooni.
en: Your sharp arrows will go deep into the hearts of your enemies, who will fall to the ground in front of you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim ʒe samban ni maa daa guhi Zakaria je, ka di daa gari ba o ni yuui Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The crowd was waiting for Zechariah and kept wondering why he was staying in the temple so long.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd kum nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika so daa lan chaŋ Yisifu sani zahindi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.

dag: Iso ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa lan booni so Ɛdom la zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the history of the family of Esau .

dag: Di saha ka o daa mali chɛchɛbunsi shili, ka zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: The king got his war chariot and army ready.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, kamiyana ka ti tɔɣisi mali ti yɛla maa. Hal yi daalahichi ni kul be kaman mulifu maa, di ni paligi kaman sakuɣa la; hal di ni kul be kaman zom maa, di ni paligi kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri la.
en: I, the Lord , invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ŋmaligi yɛli Adam mi, A ni deeg a paɣ noli, ka di ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la zuɣu, n yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; a yɛn tumdila tuun kpɛma di ni n-nyari bindirigu diri hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: The Lord said to the man, You listened to your wife and ate the fruit I told you not to eat. And so, the ground will be under a curse because of what you did. As long as you live, you will have to struggle to grow enough food.

dag: Yi yi ŋub li daba ata maa dali, di nyɛla din chihira, ka n ku deei li.
en: because it is ritually unclean, and if anyone eats it, I will not accept the offering.

dag: Bɛ daa bu o la paa ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm n-chɛ ka n tum alahichi lala niŋbu ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ saɣim n yuli, ka mali ma ansarisi.
en: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.

dag: Ka yɛda niŋbu wunsuhigu ni tiligi bara maa, ka ti Duuma ni yiɣis o; ka o yi tumla alahichi gba, o ni nya di chɛ m-paŋ.
en: This prayer made in faith will heal the sick; the Lord will restore them to health, and the sins they have committed will be forgiven.

dag: Jɔshua daa ŋme nanim maa zaa tɔbu yuui pam.
en: Joshua fought against them for many years.

dag: Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deeri la mani; ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma, pa mani ka o deera, amaa ŋun tim ma na ka o deera.
en: When you welcome even a child because of me, you welcome me. And when you welcome me, you welcome the one who sent me.

dag: N suhir a, kul tim ti la tarim bindirigu mini kom ka ti diri ka nyuri zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu pia, ka a zahim ti nya.
en: For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm piɛgul so ŋun ka buchi nɛma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then the LORD said to me, Take for yourself again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab naa la daa ti yiɣisi lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa tim ti boli Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni o ti yɛl noli tin ya.
en: Then Balak, the son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against the Israelites. The king sent for Balaam the son of Beor to curse you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tuui labina ti ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-daa nyɛ: Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba.
en: The first people to come back and live in their own lands and towns were some Israelites, priests, Levites, and servants who work in the Temple.

dag: Zɛra zuliya ni, Jɛwɛl mini bɛ daŋ maa niriba kalinli daa nyɛla niriba kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiwɛi.
en: The Zerahites who lived in Jerusalem were Jeuel and their relatives. There were of them in all.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni yi kummi ka fabili, ka pini zuɣukpina, ka pili buri.
en: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.

dag: Ka daa gbaai gbarigu maa nudirigu n-yiɣis o zali, ka o naba min o napɔŋkpuɣila dii teei n-kpaŋ zaa.
en: Then Peter took the mans right hand and lifted him up. Immediately his feet and legs became strong.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa wum Yisa yɛla, ka tim Yɛhudianim kpeen shɛba ni bɛ ti suhi Yisa ka o kana ti tib o dabili maa ti o.
en: When the centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish elders to Jesus to ask him to come and heal his servant.

dag: O daa yila Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-chani bɔri luɣ shɛli ni o ʒini. Ka o daa chaŋchaŋ ti kana ti kpɛla Maika ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu maa yiŋa.
en: The man left the town of Bethlehem in Judah to settle as an immigrant wherever he could find a place. He came to Micahs house in the Ephraim highlands while he was making his way.

dag: Bɛ kpiya ka ku lan be yaha. Bɛ shihi ku lan yiɣisi, dama a darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka bɛ kpi; so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla yaha.
en: The dead dont live; ghosts dont rise. Indeed, you have punished and destroyed them, and abolished all memory of them.

dag: A ni kpi zo shɛli a ni yɛn du maa zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣ a pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a mabia Aduna ni daa kpi Hɔr Zoli zuɣu ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: You will die on the mountain you have hiked up, and you will be gathered to your people just like your brother Aaron, who died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tiŋgbɔŋ maa fɔntinsi ni. Bɛ ni ti me gooni gili ya niŋ, ka me bimbina taɣi li, ka zaŋ bɛ nyɔtaɣirisi taɣi bɛmaŋa.
en: Those who live in the towns on the mainland will be killed in the fighting. The enemy will dig trenches, build earthworks, and make a solid wall of shields against you.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ʒii nyabu puuni, a daa yɛli a daba bɛn ʒe a yim: N zaŋ sɔŋsim ti ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ; n duhi n ni pii ninvuɣ so niriba puuni.
en: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ba. Ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu;.
en: Some people brought children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and to pray for them, but the disciples scolded the people.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa yɔri maa, ka salo laɣimna nti wum ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa tɔɣisirila bɛn bɛn laɣimna maa zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu, ka di gari ba pam.
en: When they heard this sound, a crowd gathered. They were mystified because everyone heard them speaking in their native languages.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni n nuu zuɣu tuma ka n daa zaŋ dihi m mini n dolintaba, hal ka daa yɛli ba situra pahi.
en: You yourselves know that I have worked with these hands of mine to provide everything that my companions and I have needed.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni daa kpe hal ti pibigi gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni la, bɛna n-daa baai du li chaŋ ti kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be vinvamli ni wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo zaa la.
en: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks, and chased away everyone living in the valleys to the east and the west.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka Sool daa piligi m-bɔri Dauda soya.
en: Saul never again trusted David.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan wum ka kukol shɛli yi alizanda ni na yɛra, N niriba, yimiya o ni na ka o daalahichi ku tabili ya, ka o daalɔbo balibubalibu mi ku din ya.
en: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.

dag: Ka bɛ daa deeg o mini Bashan naa Ogi bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanim ayi bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo maa tiŋgbɔna ʒini.
en: They occupied his land and the land of King Og of Bashan, the other Amorite king who lived east of the Jordan.

dag: Bɛ ni kpi kaman piɛri la, ka kum ni nyɛ bɛ gula. Bɛ ni faai siɣi gbala ni yomyom; ka bɛ niŋgbuna pooi kpiimba biɛhigu shee din yɛn nyɛ bɛ yinsi la.
en: They are just like sheep, but the grave will be their pen. Death will be their shepherd. When morning comes, the good people will enjoy victory, as the bodies of the proud slowly rot in the grave, far away from their fancy houses.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ ni dini ka yi lee bɔra: Yi bɔri ni n ʒila fiɛbiga ka yi sanna bee yi bɔri ni n ʒila yurilim mini tarimtali kana?.
en: Which do you want: that I come to you with punishment, or that I come with love and gentleness?.

dag: Ka niriba maa mini bɛ malibu zaa daa yina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni kumda, ka Musa daa wum bɛ kumsi maa; ka Yawɛ suhi daa yiɣisi pam, ka di daa bi niŋ Musa nyaɣisim.
en: Moses heard the people crying throughout their clans, each at his tents entrance. The LORD was outraged, and Moses was upset.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Abinadab yiŋ din daa be zoli zuɣu la na nti tam naɣ tɔroko palli zuɣu; ka Yuza mini Ahio bɛn daa nyɛ Abinadab bidibisi la daa be tooni vɔri tɔroko palli maa;.
en: They put the sacred chest on a new ox cart and started bringing it down the hill from Abinadab's house. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio were guiding the ox cart.

dag: N ni di bɛ nɛma ʒi li chaŋ, ka liri luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yoli, ka niriba be di ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi zuliya shɛb ni na, ka mali niɣi mini nɛma, ka nyɛ bɛn be tiŋgbani maa ni ŋɔ.
en: You will plunder and loot the people who live in cities that were once in ruins. They have been gathered from the nations, and now they have livestock and property and live at the crossroads of the world.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti wum ni be gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went away to Galilee.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum tuun viɛl shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni sab li shɛm Yawɛ zaligu kundi ni la.
en: Everything that Josiah did—his devotion to the Lord , his obedience to the Law.

dag: ka yɛli ma, Kɔniilius, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina shɛm la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: He said, Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and your compassionate acts are like a memorial offering to him.

dag: Di saha ka Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la yɛl o nyaandolitab maa, Dindina chɛliya ka ti zaa dol o chaŋ ka ti min o ti laɣim kpi.
en: Thomas said to his fellow disciples, Let us all go along with the Teacher, so that we may die with him.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Jabal. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa ni ka guli niɣ la yaba.
en: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the ancestor of those who raise livestock and live in tents.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa malibu tuma zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ mi daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa maani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ zaŋ li mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: This money was then handed over to the three men in charge of the Temple repairs, and they gave it to.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi cheechi sɔŋdiba tuma ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga zaani yu suma, ka tooi mali suhukpeeni n-tɔɣisiri bɛ ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda shɛm yɛla palɔni.
en: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: ka baŋ ni ŋuna n-yi nyɛ gbarigu n-ʒiini Naawuni jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din yuli booni Duno Viɛlli la shee maani bara la. Ka din daa niŋ o maa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam.
en: and when they recognized him as the beggar who had sat at the Beautiful Gate, they were all surprised and amazed at what had happened to him.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ ni, do shɛb bɛn daa kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa n-nyɛ: Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua min o mabihi daŋ ni: Maasɛya mini Ɛliɛza ni Jarib ni Gɛdalia.
en: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;.

dag: Daanya pilanim mini tɔrokɔnim la ni daanya kɔniŋdi bini din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, Babilɔnnim naa maa daa wurim li mi, ka va di daanya maa zaa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonian army broke up the bronze columns of the Lord s Temple. They also broke up the stands and the bronze tank that were in the Lord s Temple. They carried all that bronze to Babylon.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lee kul ŋahiri ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo? Bihi laamba n-di mimima, ka di zaŋ nyamdi bihi nyina ni.
en: and said, What is this proverb people keep repeating in the land of Israel? The parents ate the sour grapes, But the children got the sour taste.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Viligim a baŋtabiga, ka piligi a nam zuɣupiligu. Binyara bi la yɛn be kaman di ni daa be shɛm. Duhimiya tarimba, ka siɣisi bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa.
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken. Take off your crown and your turban. Nothing will be the same again. Raise the poor to power! Bring down those who are ruling!.

dag: So yi chɛ bɔɣili yali bee so yi gbi bɔɣili ka bi ŋari li, ka nahu bee buŋ lu di puuni kpi.
en: When someone leaves a pit open or digs a pit and doesnt cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into the pit.

dag: ka zaŋ o kuli a yiŋa, di simdi ka o pini o zuɣu, ka ŋmah o nyinyɛhi.
en: bringing her into your home, she must shave her head, cut her nails.

dag: dama daba ayopɔin dali yɛla sab Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli yɛli: Naawuni daa vuh o tuma zaa puuni daba ayopɔin dali.
en: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti chɛ ka yilli bili Izraɛl, ka n chɛ ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bɛ sani. Di saha ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: On that day I will give new strength to the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: N ni yɛli m mabi dɔbba ni paɣiba a yɛla; N ni paɣ a a jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni;.
en: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord .

dag: Niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka shɛb yi nuzaa polo n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo n-zɔri gindi bɔri Yawɛ yɛligu, amaa ka ti ku nya li.
en: They will wander from sea to sea, and from north to east; they will roam all around, seeking the LORDs word, but they wont find it.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa daa daŋ tooni na la daa nyɛla tayiɣisi ni ŋmɛnditoya, ka piɛri maa daa bi wum ti ba.
en: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.

dag: Chɛ ka a ni niŋ yɛda shɛm a suhu ni be a mini Naawuni sunsuuni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tɛha bi chihir o suhu o ni niŋdi shɛli zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Keep the belief that you have to yourself—its between you and God. People are blessed who dont convict themselves by the things they approve.

dag: Ka Amazia daa bɔhi Naawuni nira maa, Ka n ni pun zaŋ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi shɛli da Izraɛl tɔbutuhiriba maa na, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ chaŋ di polo? Ka Naawuni nira maa garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni tooi ti a anzinfa din gari li.
en: Amaziah asked the prophet, But what about all that silver I have already paid for them? The prophet replied, The Lord can give you back more than that.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: You must put your hand on the goats head and kill it in front of the Meeting Tent. Then Aarons sons, the priests, must splash the goats blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Ka bɛ mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa daa kpe kpiimba biɛhigu shee zaɣ nɛma, ka tiŋgbani mum ba niŋ, ka bɛ daa bahi yoli niriba maa ni.
en: They along with all their possessions descended alive to their graves, and the earth closed over them. They perished in the middle of the assembly.

dag: Ka n yi nyɛ yi Duuma ni yi karimba ka paɣi yi naba, dindina di simdi ni yi gba paɣiri tab naba lala;.
en: If I, your Lord and teacher, have washed your feet, you too must wash each others feet.

dag: Bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn nyari tibidarigibo ni biɛrim bɛ bindoo zuɣu, ka kul nyari biɛrim bɛ kɔba ni.
en: Or those who are sick in bed might be suffering punishment from God. The pain that makes their bones ache might be a warning from him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti laɣim be vol ni sarika ni, ka o yo ba niŋ di ni zali gu bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu mini suhugarigu ni nintam pam puuni ka n daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya, ka di daa pala n lomi ni n tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu, amaa n daa bɔrimi ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ n yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you.

dag: Ka ŋmalig o nyaandoliba maa polo yɛli ba ashilɔni, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nina nyari yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, Happy are the eyes that see what you see.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔbigu ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla Yawɛ ni su so, di bi simdi ka so ti lan zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, o nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: The first-born of an animal already belongs to the Lord , so no one may dedicate it to him as a freewill offering. A calf, a lamb, or a kid belongs to the Lord .

dag: ka daa suhi ti Duuma n-yɛli, Nyin ti Duuma ŋun mi niriba zaa suhuri ŋɔ, wuhim ti a ni pii so niriba ayi ŋɔ ni.
en: Then they all prayed, Lord, you know what everyone is like! Show us the one you have chosen.

dag: mini nolɔɣu ŋun cheena ni bulaa ni na so ŋun be o niriba tooni gamdi giŋgaani.
en: a rooster walking proudly, a goat, and a king among his people.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣimna.
en: That evening, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.

dag: Dama m bi niŋ n tɔbu naani bee n-niŋ n takɔb yɛda ni di ni tiligi ma.
en: I do not trust in my bow or in my sword to save me;.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ daa naan ku chɛ li malibu? Ka niriba bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni lala yi daa shiri yi bɛ daalahichi ni, bɛ suhuri daa naan ku lan chihiri alahichi zuɣu.
en: If the people worshiping God had really been purified from their sins, they would not feel guilty of sin any more, and all sacrifices would stop.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi m-bɔhira, Bɔ ka ti yɛn di bee n-nyu bee bɔ ka ti yɛn ye.
en: Therefore, dont worry and say, What are we going to eat? or What are we going to drink? or What are we going to wear.

dag: yɛli, Nyam doo ŋɔ ni pil o duu ŋɔ mɛbu ka tarigi li me n-naai.
en: They will say, Heres the person who began construction and couldnt complete it.

dag: Suhubɔhibo yi mali nira, di chɛrimi ka o zahindi zahima. Ka jɛrigu mi mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: Bad dreams come from too many worries, and too many words come from the mouth of a fool.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ o ni ŋme tɔb maa di neen shɛŋa n-lab kul o ya, ka ni ti lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ni ti tum o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka naanyi lab o ya.
en: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.

dag: Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa ti ka n sanna ti ʒini n tooni.
en: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord .

dag: Amaa Bɛzalɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Uri bia, ka nyɛ Hur yaaŋa la ni daa mali daanya sara maligu bimbini shɛl la din daa kpalim bela Gibiɔn Yawɛ biɛhigu shee la tooni, ka Naa Sulemaana mini zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni nimaani.
en: The bronze altar which had been made by Bezalel, the son of Uri and grandson of Hur, was also in Gibeon in front of the Tent of the Lord 's presence. King Solomon and all the people worshiped the Lord there.

dag: ka a niriba nya biɛhigu shee nimaani. Naawuni, a ti nandaamba din simdi ba a nirilim niŋbu puuni.
en: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi tɔbu kikaa, o kumdimi ni suhupiɛlli. Tɔbu yi be katiŋa, o taɣirila di ʒiɛɣu, ka wumdi sapashin kpamba ni tahira kaman saa tahigu la.
en: When the trumpet sounds, it snorts, Hurray! It can smell the battle from far away and hear the shouts of commanders with all the other sounds of battle.

dag: Yawɛ mali yaa gari kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ vubu. O mali yaa gari teeku kɔgbana. Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa zuɣusaa!.
en: The Lord rules supreme in heaven, greater than the roar of the ocean, more powerful than the waves of the sea.

dag: Dindina ka ya polo ka yɛm lee yirina? Ka ya polo ka baŋsim lee be?.
en: Where, then, is the source of wisdom? Where can we learn to understand?.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa vihi do shɛb bɛn kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa yɛla maa zaa naai.
en: By the first day of the first month, they had come to the end of all the men who had married foreign women.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni, yi yi ti ʒini di ni ka be di ni.
en: You will go across the Jordan River. You will take the land that the Lord your God is giving you. This land will belong to you. When you are living in this land.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ʒi tibisa ʒili ti n-daari ti chana; di wum ti, ka bɛ bi chɛ ka ti vuhi.
en: Driven hard like donkeys or camels, we are tired, but are allowed no rest.

dag: Naa maa daa yɛli ba, Man Naa Ahasivɛrɔs n-tim nayili bihi Napaɣ Vashiti sani nti yɛl o yɛligu ka o zaɣisi n noli! Ka wula ka zaligu lee wuhi ni ti niŋm o.
en: According to the law, what should I do with Queen Vashti since she didnt do what King Ahasuerus ordered her through the eunuchs.

dag: Yi niŋla yi takɔbiri naani, ka tumdi din chihira, ka yi zaa yinoyino bɔri yi tab paɣiba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: You live by the sword, you observe detestable practices, and every one of you commits adultery. Should you inherit the land?.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn be a tooni, o ni be a sani, o ku chɛ ka a kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛ a bahi. Di zɔri dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: The Lord himself will lead you and be with you. He will not fail you or abandon you, so do not lose courage or be afraid.

dag: ka bi tum so taali, o bi deeri talima, o bi fari niriba, amaa ka naɣ zaŋd o bindirigu dihiri kum ni mali shɛba, ka sooni gbinfini ni mali shɛb la.
en: He never cheats or robs anyone and doesn't even demand security for a loan. He gives food and clothes to the poor.

dag: ka Rafu bia Paliti daa yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Benjamin—Palti son of Raphu;.

dag: Aram bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Hul ni Gɛta ni Mashi.
en: Arams sons: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu, ka o dii teei zaa zani ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: He placed his hands on her, and at once she straightened herself up and praised God.

dag: Dama o nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bɛn kuhi bol o bahira; ka fari nandaamba mini bɛn ka bɛn sɔŋdi ba bahira.
en: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.

dag: O zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba nambɔɣu; ka tiligiri nandaamba nyɛviya.
en: He has compassion on the weak and the needy; he saves the lives of those who are in need.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun kar shɛŋa tariga? Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi puh o ka di saɣi?.
en: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.

dag: Nanim daa laɣimya n-kana ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: Once some kings met together and planned an attack against this city. They marched toward the city.

dag: Ka napaɣ kuro daa wum naa min o kpambaliba ni tɔɣisiri yɛlli maa yɛla ka kpe bɛ chuɣu puhibu duu maa ni na ti yɛli, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Di chɛ ka yɛla maa muɣis a ti yaɣi, ka a chɛ ka a ninni biɛhigu taɣi.
en: When the queen heard the king and his officials talking, she came in and said: Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! Don't be afraid or look so pale.

dag: n ni zaŋ shɛli zali gu muɣisigu saha mini zabili ni tɔbu tuhibu dal la?.
en: I keep them ready for times of trouble, for days of battle and war.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n shia yɛn siɣi; ka wahala dabisa gbaai ma gbibi.
en: Now my life is poured out on me; days of misery have seized me.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa tim Shɛlɛmia bia Jɛhukal mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la anabi Jɛrimia sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Jaande, suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti.
en: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to ask me to pray to the Lord our God on behalf of our nation.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa, ka poloya bɛn daa be bɛ yinsi dundɔna ni mini bɛ puri ni zaa daa kpi.
en: The Lord did as Moses asked, and the frogs in the houses, the courtyards, and the fields died.

dag: Ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Ikabɔd ka yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni! Bɛ ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la min o yidan ba ni o yidan ni daa kpi zuɣu.
en: Instead she kept thinking about losing her husband and her father-in-law. So she said, My son will be named Ichabod, because the glory of Israel left our country when the sacred chest was captured.

dag: Ka o mini do so yi dɔni, ka o daɣiri maa tabil o, doo maa ni be daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin, ka bindo shɛlikam zuɣu doo maa ni dɔni ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her monthly time of bleeding, he will be unclean for seven days. Every bed he lies on will be unclean.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan nya ka do so zɔrina ka o boli dunɔgula n-yɛl o, Nyama, do so lan zɔrina o kɔŋko. Ka naa yɛli, o gba ʒirila lahibali na.
en: and the watchman saw another man running and called down to the gatekeeper, Theres another man running alone. The king said, That one must be bringing good news too.

dag: N zaŋla sagani ŋɔ niŋ sagbana ni ni di nyɛ n ni lo dunia ŋɔ alikauli shɛli maa shihirili.
en: I am putting my bow in the clouds. It will be the sign of my covenant with the world.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ ni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni kul o sani.
en: The priests and the Levites from all over Israel agreed with Rehoboam and joined him.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza tɔbbi kpamba salima nyɔtaɣira n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.

dag: Zaŋmiya laɣ shɛli yi ni mali yɔri farigu zuɣu maa na ka n nya. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ laɣifu na ti ti o.
en: Show me a coin used for paying the tax. They showed Jesus a silver coin.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ata.
en: Evening came, then morning—that was the third day.

dag: Di saha maa Hɛbɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daa woligimi ka chɛ Kɛnnim bɛn daa nyɛ Hɔbab, Musa deemba daŋ niriba la, ka zaŋ o tanti yi kpaŋ ha ti kpa Zaananim oki tia la gbini miri Kɛdɛshi.
en: There was a man named Heber who was from the Kenites. The Kenites were descendants of Moses father-in-law, Hobab. Heber had left the other Kenites and had made his home by the oak tree in Zaanannim, near the city of Kedesh.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa gba daa lan beni yaha. Dina n-nyɛ: Ain mini Rimɔn ni Ɛta ni Ashan: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara anahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan. In total: four cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Naawuni ŋun tiri binshɛɣukam nyɛvili ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun daa zani Gomna Pɔntius Pailɛt tooni n-niŋ shɛhira suŋ la zuɣu, n zal a.
en: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Jeremiah.

dag: Amaa n chɛmi ka n suhu be baalim kaman bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni be o ma sani baalim shɛm la. N suhu ŋmanila bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili suhu.
en: Instead, I am content and at peace. As a child lies quietly in its mother's arms, so my heart is quiet within me.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m biri ka so ti di li; ka shɛb ti gbi m puu bindira.
en: then let my crops be destroyed, or let others eat the food I grow.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ biɛri be. Bɛ kul nyarila buni pahiri ka di bi to.
en: That is what the wicked are like. They have plenty and are always getting more.

dag: Bɛ yurilim mini bɛ jɛlinsi ni bɛ nyuli zabbu zaa ku lan beni, ka bɛn nuu kul ku lan be yɛl shɛlikam zaa niŋbu ni dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Their loves, their hates, their passions, all died with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens in this world.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ ti paai Bɛso kulibɔŋ ni, ka bɛn daa be nyaaŋa la kpalim nimaani.
en: David took the men with him and went to Besor Ravine. About of his men stayed there because they were too weak and tired to continue. But David and the other men continued to chase the Amalekites.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses:.

dag: Ka o bidibis ayi maa daa kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba. Paɣiba maa yuya n-daa booni: Opa ni Rut.
en: Her sons married women from the country of Moab. One wifes name was Orpah, and the other wifes name was Ruth. They lived in Moab about ten years;.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun daa yi Taiatira na n-nyɛ ago chinchin kɔha, ka o yuli booni Lidia, ka o daa nyɛ ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni la daa be nimaani. Ka ti Duuma daa yoog o suhu ka o niŋ Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm yɛda.
en: One of those who heard us was Lydia from Thyatira, who was a dealer in purple cloth. She was a woman who worshiped God, and the Lord opened her mind to pay attention to what Paul was saying.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri gadamanim nyuli, a mi di pii bɛ soya shɛli doli.
en: Don't be jealous of violent people or decide to act as they do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri bi viɛla, lala biɛhigu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o suhu piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.

dag: A ni yɛn niŋ shɛm mali Aduna min o bidibisi ka bɛ tooi tum maligumaaniba tuma ti ma m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmi naɣila polli mini piɛlah ayi bɛn ka galimi.
en: Now this is what you should do to make them holy in order to serve me as priests. Take a young bull and two flawless rams.

dag: Naɣilabil tuuli jilima nyɛla o dini. O yila nyɛla yɔnahu yila. Dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ʒe niriba n-kari ba ti bahi dunia tarisi. Bɛna n-nyɛ Ifriim zuliya niriba tuhi pia; bɛna n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya niriba tusa shɛm la.
en: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o bɔri ni yi nabi ka tɔŋ la, lala ka di ni lan niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim ka o chɛ ka yi lu m-bahi yoli zaa, ka bɛ ti yihi ya yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti deei li su maa ni.
en: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la niŋ naa tɔɣino yɛli, Ami! Ka lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan naa Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, Amen! It is as true as if the Lord God himself had said it, my lord and king.

dag: Izraɛl kpamba shɛba daa ti ka n sanna ti ʒini n tooni.
en: Some of the elders of Israel came to me. They sat down to talk with me.

dag: Sanbalat mini Tɔbaya ni Gɛshɛm ŋun daa nyɛ Laribu la ni ti dimnim bɛn pahi la daa wumya ni ti me gooni maa naai hal ka voya lan ka di ni, amaa di saha maa n daa na bi zaŋ pundi kpɛhi di dunoya la.
en: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and the rest of our enemies heard that we had finished building the wall and that there were no gaps left in it, although we still had not set up the gates in the gateways.

dag: Ka zuliya tital dini n-lee beni m-mali zalikpana mini zaligunim din pahi ka wuntizɔbo be di ni kaman n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: And no other nation is great enough to have laws and rules as good as the teachings I give you today.

dag: Binnani maa zuɣu daa nyɛla salima din nyɛ alali; ka o nyɔɣu min o bɔɣiri nyɛ anzinfa; ka o puli min o gbalipina nyɛ daanya;.
en: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.

dag: Ti Duuma wurim Yaakubu zuliya ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa, ka bi zo ba nambɔɣu. O suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka o daa wurim Juda bipuɣiŋga yaa ni be luɣ shɛli polo la. O chɛ ka nama mini di nanim lu tiŋa n-nya filiŋ.
en: Showing no compassion, my Lord devoured each of Jacobs meadows; in his wrath he tore down the walled cities of Daughter Judah. The kingdom and its officials, he forced to the ground, shamed.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu yi be situra ni, di yi nyɛla ago ni bee bimpiɛlli ni.
en: Whenever there is an infection of skin disease on clothing—on wool or linen clothing.

dag: Ŋarimiya yiliŋ kam, ka gbi zoya mini kuŋkuna ka di siɣi n-leei tintani, ka mali luɣ shɛŋa din be gbirimagbirima la ka di niŋ polipoli.
en: Fill every valley; level every mountain. The hills will become a plain, and the rough country will be made smooth.

dag: Naawuni ni deei binshɛlikam zaa ti ba sani maa nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini; dinzuɣu Naawuni ni yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm li.
en: So do whatever God tells you to do. Even the property God took from our father and gave to you really belongs to us and our children.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima, yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din tuhi? Yi kariti niriba saria ka di doli soli?.
en: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?.

dag: Di saha ka Sool mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa dii lu tɔb tuhibu soli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa gbaai tab tuhibu, dama bɛ daa birimya pam.
en: Saul quickly called his army together, then led them to the Philistine camp. By this time the Philistines were so confused that they were killing each other.

dag: Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa bol o o Duuma, ka di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: David spoke of the Messiah as his Lord, so how can the Messiah be his son.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa boli ba, ka Aduna mini bɛ laɣiŋgu zuɣulaannim zaa daa ka o sanna, ka o ti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.

dag: Ka o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ maa ba yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni o kpalimmi gbe, ka o daa kpalim gbe daba ata. Ka bɛ daa laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka o gbɛri nimaani.
en: The father insisted that he stay, and so he stayed for three days. The couple had their meals and spent the nights there.

dag: Ka o daa kahig o daashili zaa wuh o ka yɛl o, N nyɛla Nazari nir Naawuni sani hal n ni daa na be m ma pul ni saha shɛli, ka piliŋ na ʒi n-shihi n zuɣu ni. Ka n yi pini, n kpiɔŋ maa ni yi n ni ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Finally, Samson told Delilah everything. He said, I have never had my hair cut. I was dedicated to God before I was born. If someone shaved my head, I would lose my strength. I would become as weak as any other man.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o polo m-bɔŋɔ: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo, o ʒiɛm a, ka mal a ansarisi; Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga be a nyaaŋa polo n-gbaɣisir o zuɣu niŋd a.
en: This is the message that the LORD has spoken against him: The young woman, Daughter Zion, despises you and mocks you; Daughter Jerusalem shakes her head behind your back.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinim la. O pii shɛb leela tuumba, ka pii shɛb leeg anabinima, ka pii shɛb leei Masia lahibal suŋ molomooniba, ka pii shɛb leei pastanima, ka pii shɛb mi leei karimbanima.
en: He gave some apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some pastors and teachers.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai tiŋ maa ni n-nya ka bɛ nyo li la buɣim, ka gbahi bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: When David and his men arrived, they found that the town had been burned down and that their wives, sons, and daughters had been carried away.

dag: Ka o daa kana ti zani, ka kuhi bahi Izraɛl tɔbbihi na, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lo tɔbu na ni yi ti tuhi ti? Pa Filistia nira n-nyɛ ma? Ka yi mi pala Sool tɔbbihi? Dinzuɣu piimiya yi ni ninvuɣ yino n-chɛ ka o siɣi n sanna.
en: Goliath stood and shouted at the Israelites, What are you doing there, lined up for battle? I am a Philistine, you slaves of Saul! Choose one of your men to fight me.

dag: Yi yaannim bɛn daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti la daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔin, ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka yi galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: When your ancestors went to live in Egypt, there were only of them. But the Lord has blessed you, and now there are more of you than there are stars in the sky.

dag: Isaka bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tola mini Pua ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi.
en: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.

dag: A ni tooi kali bɛ ni dandi bɛ baɣa chɛra shɛm tariga? Ka a mi bɛ dɔɣibu saha?.
en: How long are they pregnant.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi kanna daa ʒirila pina din nyɛ anzinfa nɛma bee salima nɛma bee kpariti bee bidibbina bee tulaale zim bee yuri bee buntaansi na yuuni kam.
en: Every year people came to see the king, and everyone brought a gift. They brought things made from gold and silver, clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ niriba maa sara maligu maa na nti yihi niriba alahichi sanyoo sara shɛli din daa nyɛ bua la n-kɔrig o zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara kaman tuuli alahichi sanyoo sara maligu la.
en: After that, he presented the people's offerings. He took the goat that was to be offered for the people's sins, killed it, and offered it, as he had done with his own sin offering.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ti ma n wuntitali laara, n ni ka galimi o sani la zuɣu.
en: And so the LORD restored me for my righteousness because my hands are clean in his eyes.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ Naawuni daalibarika din be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni cheechinim ni yɛla.
en: Our friends, we want you to know what God's grace has accomplished in the churches in Macedonia.

dag: Amaa mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun kpihindi yi daalahichi. Mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka n niŋdi lala maa. N ku lan teei yi daalahichi maa yɛla.
en: I, I am the one who wipes out your rebellious behavior for my sake. I wont remember your sin.

dag: A dolila a biɛli naba, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ o pipia maa gbibil a.
en: You followed your sister and lived as she did. You, yourself, took her cup of poison and held it in your hands. .

dag: Amaa vi tuma maa nyɛla din di ti yaannim ni daa tum tuma bo binshɛlikam zaa zali ti ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ la, dina n-nyɛ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi.
en: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku niŋ o zo nirilim, zaŋla Kpiɔŋlan Naa zɔbu bahi.
en: In trouble like this I need loyal friends— whether I've forsaken God or not.

dag: Chɛ ka yɛnnim gba wum li, ka nya yɛm pahi, ka leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn woligiri binyara.
en: The wise hear them and grow in wisdom; those with understanding gain guidance.

dag: Di saha ka Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi daa lo tɔbu kana ti do Giliad. Ka Izraɛlnim gba daa laɣim ti do Mizipa.
en: The Ammonites gathered together for war. Their camp was in the area of Gilead. The Israelites gathered together. Their camp was at the city of Mizpah.

dag: Yawɛ, ti garigim a muɣisigu nyabu dali! Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ni gul a.
en: May the Lord answer you in times of trouble. May the God of Jacob protect you.

dag: Ka Midian nanima ayi bɛn nyɛ: Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa guui, ka Gidiɔn kari doli ti gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zaa suhuri chihi.
en: Zebah and Zalmunna fled, and he chased after them. He captured the two Midianite kings Zebah and Zalmunna and threw the entire army into panic.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim ni daa ti di bɛ liɣiri zaa naai saha shɛli, ka Ijiptinim zaa daa ka Yisifu sanna ti yɛl o, Tim ti bindirigu, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn lihiri ti ka ti kpi? Dama ti liɣiri zaa naaya.
en: The silver from the land of Egypt and from the land of Canaan had been spent, and all of the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes, just because the silver is gone.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga, so ku lan di nyin wala hal abada. Ka o nyaandoliba daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Jesus said to the fig tree, No one shall ever eat figs from you again! And his disciples heard him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa fiig tia o puu ni, ka di walibu saha ti paai ka o chaŋ ti bɔri wala di zuɣu ka bi nya.
en: Jesus then told them this story: A man had a fig tree growing in his vineyard. One day he went out to pick some figs, but he didn't find any.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niriba maa lur a sizuura, ka gbib a zaligunim saha shɛlikam bɛ ni yɛn be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: so that your people may honor you and obey you all the time they live in the land which you gave to our ancestors.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya, gbilisimiya tibili wum n noli ni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Now sons, listen to me, and pay attention to my speech.

dag: Amaa bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka di ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: The seeds that fell on good ground are the people who hear and welcome the message. They produce or or even times as much as was planted.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, n kul ʒiɛla n zaashee wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa.
en: The sentry calls out, Sir, I have been standing guard at my post day and night.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka ka galimi bɛ biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who live pure lives! They follow the Lord s teachings.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; dama m bela n ko ka be nahiŋgu ni.
en: Turn to me, Lord , and be merciful to me, because I am lonely and weak.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ ti Iso zuliya bɛn be Ɛdom la, o daa kula Hɔrinima ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: That is exactly what God did for Esaus descendants, who live in Seir, when he completely destroyed the Horites in their presence, and they took possession of the Horites area, settling in their place to this very day.

dag: Gidiɔn ni daa wum doo maa zahindi maa mini di gbinni ni wuhi shɛm maa, ka o daa paɣi Naawuni pam, ka ŋmaligi lab Izraɛlnim sani ti yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ, Yawɛ zaŋ Midiannim maa zaa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: After he heard the men talking about the dream and what it meant, Gideon bowed down to God. Then Gideon went back to the camp of the Israelites and called out to the people, Get up! The Lord will help us defeat the Midianites.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa nya bɛ ni chani maa m-baŋ ba, ka yi tinsi ni zo bɛ naba zuɣu daŋ ba bɛ ni daa chani luɣ shɛli maa paabu.
en: Many people, however, saw them leave and knew at once who they were; so they went from all the towns and ran ahead by land and arrived at the place ahead of Jesus and his disciples.

dag: A nya bɛ ni bɔhi ma biɛri, ka lɔri ma nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa shɛm.
en: You know how my enemies hate me and how they plot against me.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa sab yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ niŋ Naawuni zaligu litaafi ni; ka bo kuɣ titali sɔŋ oki tia gbini nimaani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Joshua wrote these words in Gods Instruction scroll. Then he took a large stone and put it up there under the oak in the sanctuary of the LORD.

dag: Dama n yɛn lumi maa, ka be biɛrim pam ni sahakam.
en: because Im very close to falling, and my pain is always with me.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara ka so ku tooi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: People cannot understand the wonderful things God does. His miracles are too many to count.

dag: Ka a ti booi li bahi Aduna min o bidibisi zuɣu ni m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o zali ka yɛl o, Yiɣisima! Man gba kul nyɛla ninsala kaman nyin la.
en: But Peter lifted him up, saying, Get up! Like you, Im just a human.

dag: Hɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrɛt mini Izar ni Ɛtinan.
en: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali buŋa bee nahu ka o ti lu biliga ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku chaŋ ti yaag o yomyom.
en: Afterwards, Jesus asked the people, If your son or ox falls into a well, wouldn't you pull him out at once, even on the Sabbath.

dag: Amaa ka o ba min o ma bɔh o, Paɣa n-ka a dɔɣiriba bipuɣinsi ni bee ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ni ka a ni bɔ, ka ti chaŋ ti bɔrila Filistianim bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ni a niŋ a paɣa? Amaa ka Samsin yɛl o ba, Bom o ti ma, dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: His father and his mother answered, But surely there is a woman from the Israelites you can marry. Do you have to marry a woman from the Philistines? Their men are not even circumcised. But Samson said, Get that woman for me! She is the one I want.

dag: Ka di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋubi o ni mali suhudoo sara maligu shɛli, ka di nyɛ o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa nimdi zaa o ni mal li dahin shɛli maa. O di ti chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba.
en: The meat of the fellowship offering must be eaten on the same day it is offered as a way of showing thanks to God. None of the meat should remain until the next morning.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a tum alahiziba tuma ti ti; a lo ti nia suma pam; ka so mi bi ŋman a. N yi yɛn yɛli di zaa yɛla, di ni galisi pam ka nira ku tooi kal li!.
en: You, LORD my God! Youve done so many things— your wonderful deeds and your plans for us— no one can compare with you! If I were to proclaim and talk about all of them, they would be too numerous to count!.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N nini nya Naawuni ka bi kpi. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛniɛl.
en: Jacob said, I have seen God face-to-face, and I am still alive; so he named the place Peniel.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya zaa daa laɣim ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a niŋgbuŋ ni a ʒim.
en: Then all the tribes of Israel went to David at Hebron and said to him, We are your own flesh and blood.

dag: Yin yɛlimiya ba ni di nyɛla Yawɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maligu. Dama o ni daa kuri Ijiptinima, o daa yaɣila tinim yiya gari, ka bi ku ti. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋ jɛm Naawuni.
en: you will say, It is the Passover sacrifice to the LORD, for the LORD passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt. When he struck down the Egyptians, he spared our houses. The people then bowed down and worshipped.

dag: Amaa bɛ dɔɣila ninsalinim niŋ yɛlimuɣisira ni, kaman buɣim ni yi tahi yiɣi zuɣusaa shɛm la.
en: Surely humans are born to distress, just as sparks rise up.

dag: Dinzuɣu o yidana maa yi na be o nyɛvil ni ka o chaŋ ti kul do so, bɛ ni bol o zinaniŋda; amaa o yidana maa yi kpi, o yi zaligu maa lɔbu ni; ka o yi lan kul do so, dindina o pala zinaniŋda.
en: So then, if she lives with another man while her husband is alive, she will be called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is legally a free woman and does not commit adultery if she marries another man.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti laɣim gbariti, ka laɣim n ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la mini n ni darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili la.
en: The Lord says, Jerusalem was hurt and crippled. She was thrown away. She was hurt and punished, but I will bring her back to me.

dag: Dama Ahaz daa zaŋla Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni salima mini kpambaliba yinsi salima zaa chaŋ ti yo farigu Asiria naa sani, amaa ka di daa bi sɔŋ o.
en: Even though Ahaz took items from the LORDs temple, the royal palace, and the officials to buy off the king of Assyria, it was of no help.

dag: Chɛli n tibili darigibu lala! A ni zaŋ a nuu ŋme ma maa chɛmi ka n gbarigi.
en: But please stop punishing me. You will destroy me if you do not stop.

dag: O ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb mi Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shimia mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anahi, o paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Batishua, ka o nyɛ Ammiɛl bipuɣiŋga la bihi.
en: These were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon—four from Bath-shua, Ammiels daughter.

dag: ni Sulemaana nɛma duri fɔntinsi ni o chɛchɛbunsi fɔntinsi ni o wɔribariba fɔntinsi m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me mɛr shɛŋa zaa zali Jɛrusalɛm ni Lɛbanɔn ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli o ni daa su maa zaa ni.
en: the cities where his supplies were kept, the cities for his horses and chariots, and everything else he wanted to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon, and elsewhere in his kingdom.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab Galili tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna din nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kom leei wain la. Ka gomnanti tuma zuɣulan so bidibiga ŋun daa be Kapɛrinium biɛra.
en: Then Jesus went back to Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. A government official was there whose son was sick in Capernaum.

dag: Halɔhɛshi ni Piliha ni Shɔbɛk ni.
en: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan ŋmaligi chaŋ Rama m-mali lala hal ti paai Taai fɔŋ din nyɛ bɛ ni me birini gili shɛl la. Ka lan ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ hal ni Hɔsa m-mali lala hal ti paai di tariga Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Ka Mahalab mini Akizib.
en: The border turned around to Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre. The border turned around to Hosah and ended at the sea. They also owned Mahalab, Achzib.

dag: Ka o daa yi Nɛgɛb n-chaŋ hal ti paai Bɛtɛl luɣ shɛli o ni daa tuui kpa o tanti suɣili zali piligu ni, ka di be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni la.
en: Abram moved from place to place in the Southern Desert. And finally, he went north and set up his tents between Bethel and Ai.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Ayuba yɛla ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la, N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a min a zɔnim ayi maa zuɣu, dama yi bi tɔɣisi n yɛla ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli kaman n dabili Ayuba ni tɔɣisi li shɛm.
en: After the Lord finished talking to Job, he spoke to Eliphaz from Teman. He said, I am angry with you and your two friends, because you did not tell the truth about me, as my servant Job did.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd kum nyaaŋa ka ti Duuma malaika so daa lan chaŋ Yisifu sani zahindi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: While Joseph was in Egypt, Herod died. An angel from the Lord came to Joseph in a dream.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Yawɛ duu maa gbini Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ puuni daŋ kam zuɣulaannim shɛb daa tila pina din yi bɛ suhuyubu ni na ni bɛ zaŋ li n-sɔŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: When the people came to where the Lord 's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.

dag: Ka din daa niŋ ba suhugarigu gari shɛlikam nyɛla o ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ nini ku lan nya o la. Ka bɛ daa biɛl o tahi ŋariŋ gbini.
en: They were especially sad because he had said that they would never see him again. And so they went with him to the ship.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba n-daa su Tapua tiŋgbani maa, amaa Tapua fɔŋ din daa ʒi Manaasa zuliya niriba tintariga la dina, Ifriim zuliya niriba n-daa su li.
en: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh. But Tappuah itself belonged to the people of Ephraim, even though it was on the border of Manasseh.

dag: Amaa nyini Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ku kpi tɔbu ni.
en: Even so, hear the LORDs word, King Zedekiah of Judah: This is what the LORD proclaims about you: You wont die in battle.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu. O ni ti bahi dunia ŋɔ ni wuna zaa yoli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be teeku noli mini kom ni gili zuliya shɛba ti gban o tooni jɛm o bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔna ni.
en: The LORD will terrify them; he will make all the gods of the earth disappear. All the coastlands of the nations will bow down to the LORD, each one in its own place.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nini tiɣi bɛmaŋ kasitali, amaa ka lee bi yi bɛ daɣiri ni.
en: There are people who think they are pure when they are as filthy as they can be.

dag: Ŋuni ka yi lee yɛn zaŋ ma buɣisi ka nya ka m min o saɣi? So beni ŋ-ŋmani ma?.
en: Can you compare me to anyone? No one is equal to me. You cannot understand everything about me. There is nothing like me.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun daa birita, ka Apolɔs mi nyɛ ŋun daa mihiri li kom, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka di zoora.
en: I planted the seed, Apollos watered the plant, but it was God who made the plant grow.

dag: O boli o sapashin kpamba, ka bɛ kanna ka tuura, bɛ zo yomyom chaŋ gooni gbini, bɛ zaŋ nyɔtaɣirigu zali.
en: The enemy calls for his best soldiers. They stumble as they rush ahead. They run to the wall and set up their shield over the battering ram.

dag: Ka ti daa yiɣisi ni n-kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Asɔs ni ti ti zaŋ Pool pahi timaŋ zuɣu; ti min o ni daa pun tɔɣisi zali shɛm m-bala, dama o daa yɛliya ni ŋun yɛn chaŋla tiŋ paai ni.
en: We went on ahead of Paul and sailed for the city of Assos, planning to meet him there. This is what he told us to do because he wanted to go by land.

dag: Ka o daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: And he kept begging Jesus not to send the evil spirits out of that region.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla bɛn doli adiini soli kaya, amaa ka lee chihi di yiko. Gbaam amaŋ ni niriba ŋɔ tatabo.
en: They will go on pretending to be devoted to God, but they will refuse to let that devotion change the way they live. Stay away from these people!.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli beni ka di kom nyɛla din tiri Naawuni tiŋ la suhupiɛlli, luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ Zallakudura Naa biɛhigu shee la.
en: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni, ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has handed all things over to me. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, or who the Father is except the Son and anyone to whom the Son wants to reveal him.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa mali ninkur shɛb bɛn daa pun ʒiini o ba Sulemaana tooni o ni daa na be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la saawara ka bɔhi ba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n yɛli niriba maa la wula.
en: There were some older men who had helped Solomon make decisions when he was alive. So King Rehoboam asked these men what he should do. He said, How do you think I should answer the people.

dag: ka daa zaŋ fɔŋ maa puri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ti Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la.
en: But the fields farther from town and the villages near the town of Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, nyama, n-nyɛ takɔbir ayi! Ka o yɛli ba, Di ni saɣi.
en: The followers said, Look, Lord, here are two swords. Jesus said to them, Thats enough.

dag: n-zaŋ o nudirigu nubil tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ o nubil ni kpam maa mihi Yawɛ tooni ʒiibuyopɔin.
en: dip a finger of his right hand in it, and sprinkle some of it seven times there in the Lord 's presence.

dag: hal ti damdi Yisa tooni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋ puhir o. Doo maa daa nyɛla Samaria nira.
en: He threw himself to the ground at Jesus' feet and thanked him. The man was a Samaritan.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Napaɣ Ɛsta ka o ʒe zɔŋ maa ni maa, ka o suhu gbaag o, ka o kpuɣ o salima nam jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni maa tir o. Ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ ti shihi jaaŋgbee maa zuɣu ni.
en: When the king noticed Queen Esther standing in the entry court, he was pleased. The king held out to Esther the gold scepter in his hand, and she came forward and touched the scepters tip.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Alushi maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Rɛfidim, ka kom daa ka nimaani ka niriba maa ni nyu.
en: They marched from Alush and camped at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

dag: yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman Naawuni niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ yɔɣu ni n-zahim o ka di chɛ ka o yɛli.
en: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa vuhim yuuni maa ni ti niŋ bindira tin ya, yi mini yi daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba mini dɔbba ni yi ni bu shɛb paa ni san kam ŋun be yi sani.
en: Although the land has not been cultivated during that year, it will provide food for you, your slaves, your hired men, the foreigners living with you.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni duhi ya gari dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa.
en: Now, if you will be careful to obey the Lord your God and follow all his commands that I tell you today, the Lord your God will put you high above all the nations on earth.

dag: Tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa be niriba maa ni zaa ni daa ti kpi n-naai saha shɛli.
en: After all the fighting men were dead and gone.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Kɔnyuri m-mali ma. N suhir a, tim ma kom biɛla ka n nyu. Ka paɣ maa daa yooi bihim koligu m-booi bihim ti o ka o nyu, ka o lan zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: He said to her, Please give me a drink of water; I'm thirsty. She opened a leather bag of milk, gave him a drink, and hid him again.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali, dama n zani m ba Dauda zaani n-di nam ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee kaman Yawɛ ni daa lo alikauli shɛm la, ka me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli jilima.
en: The LORD has kept his promise—I have succeeded my father David on Israels throne, just as the LORD said, and I have built the temple for the name of the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Yilimiya o yuli jilima yila. Paɣimiy o jilima paɣibu!.
en: Praise his glorious name! Honor him with songs of praise!.

dag: hal o yi kul sɔɣ o jɛlinsi maa o bilikɔnsi yɛtɔɣa ni, dim maa ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bahi yi palo niriba ni.
en: They may cover their hatred with trickery, but their evil will be revealed in public.

dag: di yi nyɛla bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni n-tum alahichi maa, ka di taali meei niriba maa, di saha ŋun zaŋmi naɣilabil polli ŋun ka dalinli m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara ti Yawɛ.
en: If it is the High Priest who sins and so brings guilt on the people, he shall present a young bull without any defects and sacrifice it to the Lord for his sin.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ yɛligu ka m paɣira, nyin Naawuni yɛligu ka m paɣira.
en: I praise your promises!.

dag: Ka Pool daa yiɣisi zani n-kpuɣ o nuu gahiri ka yɛri ba, Yinim Izraɛlnim mini yinim bɛn zaa zɔri Naawuni, wummiya!.
en: Paul stood up, motioned with his hand, and began to speak: Fellow Israelites and all Gentiles here who worship God: hear me!.

dag: Ka bɛn daa yi Ɛlizafan daŋ ni na daa nyɛ: Shimri mini Jɛwɛl. Ka bɛn daa yi Asaf daŋ ni na daa nyɛ: Zakaria mini Matania.
en: from the descendants of Elizaphan: Shimri and Jeuel; from the descendants of Asaph: Zechariah and Mattaniah.

dag: Tizɔriba kul zɔrimi doli taba, ka tuumba kul zɔri doli taba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Babilɔn naa ni bɛ deeg o tiŋ la zaa.
en: One messenger follows another. Messenger follows messenger. They announce to the king of Babylon that his whole city has been captured.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa be teeku duli, timiya Yawɛ jilima, ka paɣ o.
en: Let those who live in distant lands give praise and glory to the Lord !.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka o kɔrigi niriba maa daalahichi sanyoo sara bulaa la, ka zaŋ o ʒim maa kpe pateesa maa puuni na nti niŋ kaman o ni niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛm maa, ka zaŋ li mihi adaka pindigu la zuɣusaa mini adaka maa tooni.
en: Then he will slaughter the goat for the peoples purification offering, bring the blood inside the inner curtain, and do with it as he did with the bulls blood: he will sprinkle it on the cover and in front of the cover.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron. He said.

dag: Di saha ka na so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam ni ti yiɣisi n-di nam su o nam sulinsi ni yiko, ka tumd o ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi garig o bɔhigu maa; ka dindali maa zaŋ chana, so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: Nobody was able to answer him. And from that day forward nobody dared to ask him anything.

dag: Ŋun tim ma na maa be n sani, o na ʒi n-chɛ ma n ko, dama n kul tumdila din tiɣir o nini sahakam.
en: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him. So he has not left me alone.

dag: Karimbaannim kul ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma, amaa n dolila a zaligunim ni n suhu zaa.
en: The proud have told lies about me, but with all my heart I obey your instructions.

dag: Hɛman bidibisi bɛn daa be o sani n-daa nyɛ: Bukia mini Matania ni Uziɛl ni Shɛbuɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Hanania ni Hanani ni Ɛliata ni Gidalit ni Romamtiɛza ni Jɔshibɛkasha ni Mallɔti ni Hɔtir ni Mahaziɔt.
en: Heman had sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamtiezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali, yin zaŋmiya naɣila polli ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka di niŋ kasi.
en: The LORD God proclaims: On the first day of the first month, you will take a flawless young bull from the herd, and you will purify the sanctuary.

dag: Ka zoomba ayi daa ʒi sokpaŋa ka ti wum ni Yisa n-gariti maa, ka bɛ kuhi yɛli, Ti Dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: When two blind men sitting along the road heard that Jesus was passing by, they shouted, Show us mercy, Lord, Son of David.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Tama hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi koma dooshee n-zaŋ nimaani hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ nudirigu polo yaɣili.
en: The southern border will begin at Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and will end at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka sagbana din be yi zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni ti leei daanya, ka tiŋgbani din be yi tiŋli ŋɔ ti leei kurugu.
en: No rain will fall, and your ground will become as hard as iron.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a ni lihiri ti ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa kpi? Zaŋm bindirigu taɣi ti mini ti puri maa, ka ti mini ti puri maa zaa leei Firawuna daba; ka ti ti bimbira din ni chɛ ka ti gali ka ku kpi, ka ti puri maa gba ku kpalim doya yoli.
en: Why should we die before your eyes, we and our farmland too? Buy us and our farms for food, and we and our farms will be under Pharaohs control. Give us seed so that we can stay alive and not die, and so that our farmland wont become unproductive.

dag: Ka hal Izraɛlnim ni daa ti niŋ kpiɔŋ, bɛ daa bi kari Keenannim maa zaa, amaa ka daa naɣ lee muɣisiri ba mi ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: Even when the Israelites became stronger, they did not drive out all the Canaanites, but they did force them to work for them.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ ni, do shɛb bɛn daa kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa n-nyɛ: Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua min o mabihi daŋ ni: Maasɛya mini Ɛliɛza ni Jarib ni Gɛdalia.
en: This is the list of the men who had foreign wives: Clan of Joshua and his brothers, sons of Jehozadak: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

dag: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ muni la di pun ka buchi, bɛ ni ti yɛri ni buɣim di li ka di niŋ sala? Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li niŋ binshɛli yaha.
en: If you cannot make anything from that wood before it is burned, you surely cannot make anything from that wood after it is burned!.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛl o, Kurimbuni ha bɛ daa yi yɛrila niriba, Chamiya Ɛbɛl n-ti bɔhi ka bɛ wuhi ya. Lala ka bɛ daa yi niŋdi maani yɛla.
en: She said, Long ago people used to say, If you want good advice, go to the town of Abel to get it. The answers they got here were all that was needed to settle any problem.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka ninsalinim tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa? Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ biriti bee tikpiranima bee n-nyara bee n-nyɛ zoomba? Pa man Yawɛ?.
en: Then the Lord said to him, Who made a persons mouth? And who can make someone deaf or not able to speak? Who can make a person blind? Who can make a person able to see? I am the one. I am the Lord .

dag: Malaika maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi la, ka o binyɛrigu piɛli kaman gol la.
en: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.

dag: Niriba maa ni ti nahindi taba, ka sokam ti nahind o kpee; ka bipala ku tiri bɛ kpamba jilima, ka tarimba ku tiri bɛ zuɣulaannim jilima.
en: Everyone will take advantage of everyone else. Young people will not respect their elders, and worthless people will not respect their superiors.

dag: Amaa n yɛr a mi ni n ni daa tuui boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni yino gba noli ku to laɣiŋgu ŋɔ bindira maa. .
en: I tell you, not one of those who were invited will taste my dinner.

dag: Ka Samuɛl nini daa bi lan nya Sool hal ti kpi. Amaa ka o suhu daa lee saɣim pam Sool zuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Yawɛ yoli o ni daa pii Sool n-leei Izraɛlnim naa maa zuɣu.
en: Samuel never saw Saul again before he died, but he grieved over Saul. However, the LORD regretted making Saul king over Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa paɣ o binyɛra ka su kom, ka naanyi kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee; amaa ka maligumaana maa ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: Then the priest will wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. Afterward the priest will enter the camp, but he will be unclean until evening.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa guui kpa mɔɣu polo n-zo hal ni Rimɔn tampiŋ la gbini nti kpalim be nimaani chira anahi.
en: Only of them finally made it into the desert to Rimmon Rock, where they stayed for four months.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paag a min a niriba ni a yaannim zuliya, ka nyɛ zaɣ biɛ shɛli din tatabo na ʒi m-paai ya, Izraɛl zuliya ni daa woligi ka chɛ Juda zuliya dahin shɛl la zaŋ kana zuŋɔ. O yɛn chɛmi ka Asiria naa kana ti liri ya.
en: The Lord is going to bring on you, on your people, and on the whole royal family, days of trouble worse than any that have come since the kingdom of Israel separated from Judah—he is going to bring the king of Assyria.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai, ka zaŋ sida dapuhi mini di dapaɣa n-siili li.
