en: He completed the temple with a roof of cedar beams and cross-planks.

dag: Pa Naawuni yino maa n-nam paɣ maa? Niŋgbina mini shia maa zaa nyɛla o dini. Ka bɔ ka o lee bɔra? O bɔri ni Naawuni biɛhigu be ti bihi ni. Dinzuɣu gbibiya yimaŋa, ka di chɛn ya ka so bi ʒe o ni daa kpuɣi paɣ so o bipolitali ni yim.
en: Didn't God make you one body and spirit with her? What was his purpose in this? It was that you should have children who are truly God's people. So make sure that none of you breaks his promise to his wife.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka ti be barina ni sahakam?.
en: And what about us? Why are we in danger all day every day?.

dag: Taataa kpiŋkpama vibiri ni suhupiɛlli, amaa o ka kpiŋkpaŋkɔbiri kaman tɔrili la.
en: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ʒi tibisa chaŋ Yawɛ sani, o ni sɔŋ ya; o kul ku chɛ wuntizɔra bahi.
en: Our Lord , we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.

dag: Bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm la ni daa wum di gbinni ka di viɛl maa, ka o daa yɛli Yisifu, N gba sa zahimla zahindi. Bɔrɔbɔro piɛr ata n-sa tam n zuɣu ni.
en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation of the wine steward's dream was favorable, he said to Joseph, I had a dream too; I was carrying three breadbaskets on my head.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa laɣim sɔŋ o gballi maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ Reechɛl gballi maa kuɣiduli, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. Its the pillar on Rachels tomb thats still there today.

dag: ka n suhu kul be yiriŋ. N ni daa kul tɛhiri di yɛla shɛm, lala ka di yɛla maa daa niŋ ma muɣisigu. Di saha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli.
en: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:.

dag: Amaa bɛ ti ku lan labi bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ labi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni na ŋɔ.
en: You will never return to the land you long to go back to.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa suhuri daa paligi bɛ pɔri maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa pola pɔri maa ni bɛ suhuri zaa, ka suhi Naawuni bɛ ni bɔr shɛli zaa, ka Naawuni daa deei bɛ suhigu maa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa ti ba vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: All the people of Judah were happy about the oath, because they had promised with all their heart. They followed God with all their heart. They looked for God and found him, so the Lord gave them peace in all the country.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni wɔɣ ni tab shɛm, lala ka n soya be di ko ka chɛ yi soya, ka n tɛha gba be di ko ka chɛ yi tɛha.
en: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my plans than your plans.

dag: Amaa Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛb bahi ni bɛ maani wain tihi, ka kɔra.
en: But Nebuzaradan commander of the guard left some of the poor to tend the vineyards and till the land.

dag: M bi simd a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali shɛl a ni ʒe man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ biɛlifu gba, dama n jaaŋgbee kɔŋko ka n daa zaŋ na ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du; amaa pumpɔŋɔ m malila buni balibu buyi.
en: I don't deserve all the good things you have done for me, your servant. When I first crossed the Jordan, I had only my walking stick, but now I have two large groups of people and animals.

dag: Dama naa min o kpamba ni bɛn zaa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm maa daa to jina n-saɣi ni bɛ puhimi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa gol so ŋun pahir ayi puuni.
en: The king, his officials, and the entire Jerusalem congregation had decided to celebrate Passover in the second month.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ fo ka bembe nti gbaai Naawuni paɣibu yɛra, Dindina Naawuni n-chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba niŋ tuuba ni bɛ nya nyɛvili.
en: Once the apostles and other believers heard this, they calmed down. They praised God and concluded, So then God has enabled Gentiles to change their hearts and lives so that they might have new life.

dag: Bɛ nini daa nya Yawɛ tuma din nyɛ o daalahiziba tuma la teeku bulli maa ni.
en: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.

dag: N ni paɣiri Naawuni so yɛligu maa, ŋuna ka n niŋ naani ka bi zɔri dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: I trust in God and am not afraid; I praise him for what he has promised. What can a mere human being do to me?.

dag: Dindali maa yi ni ti zaŋ n yuli suhi Naawuni; ka m bi yɛli ni n ni ti suhi m Ba tin ya.
en: When that day comes, you will ask him in my name; and I do not say that I will ask him on your behalf.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama m pun zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ ni so ku tooi zani yi tooni.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Do not be afraid of them. I have already given you the victory. Not one of them will be able to stand against you.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛm mini wuhibu yɛla bɔhimbu din ni sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ ashili yɛtɔɣa baŋbu polo.
en: Here are proverbs that will help you recognize wisdom and good advice, and understand sayings with deep meaning.

dag: Di niŋdiya li la saha shɛli bɛ nini ni beni zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ nini tiɣi ya, amaa niŋmiyala din tiɣiri Naawuni nini ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nyɛ Masia daba la zuɣu.
en: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti zaŋ ba sɔɣi gballi ni, bɛ gulila bɛ gballi maa.
en: They are carried to their graves; someone keeps guard over their tombs.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, zom ma nambɔɣu n-tim Lazarɔs na ka o ti zaŋ o nubil tim kom ni n-tɔɣisi pa n zilinli zuɣu ka di maai, dama n nyari azaaba pam buɣim ŋɔ ni.
en: So he called out, Father Abraham! Take pity on me, and send Lazarus to dip his finger in some water and cool off my tongue, because I am in great pain in this fire.

dag: ni nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha bukɔbigakɔbiga dunia ŋɔ ni. O ni nya yiya mini mabi dɔbba ni tizɔpaɣiba ni banima ni manima ni bihi ni puri m-pahi muɣisigu, ka ti lan nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: will receive much more in this present age. They will receive a hundred times more houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and fields—and persecutions as well; and in the age to come they will receive eternal life.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bia ka kpi;.
en: One time there were seven brothers. The first brother married a woman but died. He had no children.

dag: Maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni pam, di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bɛ zuɣu, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani; o ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛn ya bahi.
en: Be strong and be brave. Dont be afraid of those people because the Lord your God is with you. He will not fail you or leave you.

dag: N nyari suhupiɛlli a zaligunim maa dolibu ni, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I will rejoice in your commandments because I love them.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: yumiya yi dimnim gba, ka niŋmiya alibarika niŋdi bɛn turi ya ni, ka niŋmiya bɛn jɛn ya la zaɣ viɛlli; ka suhimiya Naawuni n-tiri bɛn niŋdi ya alaka.
en: But now I tell you: love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: But the one who remains faithful to the end will be saved.

dag: O mɛla gooni ŋari n soli, ka di chɛ ka n kɔŋ garibu, ka chɛ ka n soli leei liɣa.
en: He walled up my path so I cant pass and put darkness on my trail.

dag: Amaa ka Sool ŋun yiko daa kul pahirimi, ka o kahigiri wuhiri ni Yisa nyɛla Masia; ka o yɛligu maa daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Damaskus maa birim.
en: But Saul became more and more powerful in proving that Jesus is the Messiah. His proofs were so strong that the Jews who lived in Damascus could not argue with him.

dag: Teem a daba bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu yɛla, ka di doli niriba ŋɔ tipawumli bee bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali bee bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ.
en: Remember your servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob! Dont focus on this peoples stubbornness, wickedness, and sin.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini nam shɛŋa din niriba bi jɛmd a la zuɣu.
en: Turn your anger against the nations that do not know you, against the people who do not honor you as God.

dag: Amaa Dauda zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni daa ti Abijam firila Jɛrusalɛm n-chɛ ka o bia di nam zan o zaani gbib Jɛrusalɛm.
en: But for Davids sake, the Lord gave Abijah a kingdom in Jerusalem and allowed him to have a son. He also kept Jerusalem safe.

dag: Miri ka a kpuɣi paɣa bee n-dɔɣi bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi kpe.
en: Do not marry or have children in a place like this.

dag: Ti Duuma suhu yiɣisiya, ka o filim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga. O zaŋ Izraɛl jilima bahi, ka di yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na. O suhu ni daa yiɣisi dahin shɛli, o daa bi lan teeg o napɔntamdigu la yɛla.
en: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.

dag: ka bɛn be zibisim ni mini kum mahim ni ni ti nya neesim maa, ka di ni ti wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli nya suhudoo.
en: It will bring light to those who live in darkness, in the fear of death. It will guide us into the way that brings peace.

dag: dindina n ni be yi sani kpe, n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim kurimbuni ha ni bɛ su li sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam zaa jɛmdi li ni di vi. Daadamnim bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba m-me wuna bee n-kpe li zali. Chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣimna nti yiɣisi zani. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ba ka bɛ zaa di vi.
en: Everyone who worships it will be humiliated. The people who make idols are human beings and nothing more. Let them come and stand trial—they will be terrified and will suffer disgrace.

dag: Ka zim maa daa shiri bi naai di duɣu maa ni; ka kpam la gba daa bi naai di ŋmani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The jar of flour didnt decrease nor did the bottle of oil run out, just as the LORD spoke through Elijah.

dag: Ka nachimba maa daa chaŋ nti yihi Reehab min o ba ni o ma ni o tizɔdɔbba ni o dɔɣiriba zaa n-zaŋ ba ti ʒili kpaŋ ha miri Izraɛlnim sansani.
en: So they went and brought Rahab out, along with her father and mother, her brothers, and the rest of her family. They took them all, family and slaves, to safety near the Israelite camp.

dag: Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa nya ka o bia lan kani maa, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum Juda nabihi zaa.
en: When Athaliah, Ahaziahs mother, learned of her sons death, she immediately destroyed the entire royal family of Judahs dynasty.

dag: Ti ni daa du duli tiligi maa, ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl ti ni bɛ ya maa yuli m-booni Malta.
en: When we were safe on land, we learned that the island was called Malta.

dag: N ŋman piɛlli ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yino ko. O kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ o ma bipuɣiŋga. O ka dalinli. Paɣiba yi kul nya o, bɛ paɣir o mi. Napaɣiba mini naa mamanim gba yi kul nya o bɛ paɣir o mi.
en: You would be my only choice, my flawless dove, the favorite child of your mother. The young women, the queens, and all the others tell how excited you are as they sing your praises:.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi gbibi n zaligunima ka dol li: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Remember my commands, and obey them. I am the Lord .

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi chɛmi ka bɛ wurim bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani ti maani maligunim ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: However, the pagan places of worship were not destroyed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya Amalɛknim naa Agag maa n-ti ma na. Ka Agag daa yi o sanna ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, kum biɛrim vuuya. .
en: Bring me Agag the Amalekite king, Samuel said. Agag came to him in chains, asking, Would death have been as bitter as this is.

dag: ka zaŋ li tu bansi maa ni din ni chɛ ka dapuhi maa be sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ ayi polo saha shɛli yi yi ti ʒiri li chana.
en: Put the poles through the rings so that the poles will be on the two sides of the altar when it is carried.

dag: Amaa ka o yi bi bɔr ni o yo puu maa zuɣu ka dee li bee o yi pun zaŋla puu maa kɔhi so zuɣu, o ku lan tooi yo di zuɣu ka dee li yaha.
en: If you sell the field to someone else without first buying it back from the Lord , you lose the right to buy it back.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni gba daa niŋ. O daa bɔri ni o wuhila o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm ka chɛ ka o yiko yi palɔni; dinzuɣu ka o daa di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi din kur o suli ka simdi ni o bahi ba yol la suɣilo.
en: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.

dag: dindina ŋun ku nir maa ya kpamba bɛn timmi tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ o na ti ti ŋun yɛn bɔh o biɛri, ka bɛ ku o.
en: elders from the killers hometown will send word, and the killer will be sent back from there. They will then hand him over to the blood avenger, and he will be executed.

dag: Naawuni, nyini m-pun wuhi ma m bilim ni ha, ka n na kul mooni a daalahiziba tuma molo.
en: Youve taught me since my youth, God, and Im still proclaiming your wondrous deeds!.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋmanila kundun biɛɣu. O gbahiri binyara asiba ni zaawuni ŋubira.
en: Benjamin is like a vicious wolf. Morning and evening he kills and devours.

dag: Amaa dabili maa yi zani yim yɛli, N yuri n dana maa mini m paɣa ni m bihi, dinzuɣu n ku chaŋ.
en: But if the slave declares that he loves his master, his wife, and his children and does not want to be set free.

dag: Di saha n ni tooi nya garigibu din ni garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi la, dama n niŋ a yɛligu naani.
en: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, di simdi ka yi lo noli ka di tumiya tuma dindali, yinim bɛn nyɛ tiŋbihi bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani.
en: The following regulations are to be observed for all time to come. On the tenth day of the seventh month the Israelites and the foreigners living among them must fast and must not do any work.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim maa daa lan zaŋ bɛ pina ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna bɛ ni daa zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu saha shɛl la.
en: The leaders also brought offerings to celebrate the dedication of the altar. When they were ready to present their gifts at the altar.

dag: Ka ŋun vo bua la tahi Azazɛl sani la, di simdi ka o paɣ o nɛma ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: The one who set the goat free for Azazel must wash their clothes and bathe their body in water; after that they can return to the camp.

dag: ka yɛl o suhu ni, Iso yi kana ti ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tooni ŋɔ, bɛn doli nyaaŋa la ni zo n-tiligi.
en: He thought, If Esau attacks one group, perhaps the other can escape.

dag: A mi saha shɛli bɛ ni dooni dɔɣiri bɛ bihi? Ka a mi saha shɛli bɛ bihi maa ni yirina?.
en: Do you know when they will crouch down and bring their young into the world?.

dag: Ŋuna n-yeeri nanim kpariti, ka sooni ba piɛtɔnima.
en: unties the belt of kings, binds a garment around their loins.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: Jesus recognized what they were discussing and responded, Why do you fill your minds with these questions?.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ Naawuni nir maa sani Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu. Naawuni Nir maa ni daa nya paɣ maa ka o kanna ka o yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Nyama, Shunɛm paɣ la m-be katiŋ kanna ŋɔ.
en: So she went off and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. As soon as the man of God saw her from a distance, he said to Gehazi his servant, Look, its the Shunammite woman!.

dag: Bɛ daa kpuɣi duɣuri mini soobuya ni buɣim kpihiri bina ni taha ni chɛriti ni daanya la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni chaŋ.
en: They took the pots, the shovels, the wick trimmers, the sprinkling bowls, the incense dishes, and all the bronze equipment used for the temple services.

dag: Nyama pumpɔŋɔ ŋ-ŋɔ o sɔɣi vol shɛl ni bee luɣ shɛli polo. Ka niriba maa shɛb yi chaŋ ti lir o tuuli liribu ŋɔ ka o ku ba, ŋunkam wum di yɛla ni yɛli ni bɛ ku Absalom niriba pam.
en: He is probably already hiding in a cave or some other place. If your father attacks your men first, people will hear the news and think, Absaloms followers are losing.

dag: Naawuni daa bi tiligi malaika shɛb bɛn daa tuui tum alahichi la, amaa o daa zaŋ ba bahila buɣim biɛhigu shee n-lo ba zoligɔnim zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali.
en: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka di vi. Amaa di chɛ ka man di vi. Chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, amaa di chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba pam.
en: Bring disgrace on those who persecute me, but spare me, Lord . Fill them with terror, but do not terrify me. Bring disaster on them and break them to pieces.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kul bɔrila tin shɛli din so. Tin shɛli din be alizanda ni ka bɛ daa bɔra. Dinzuɣu vi bi mali Naawuni ni bɛ bol o bɛ Naawuni, dama o pun me tiŋ zali ba.
en: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa asiba, zaŋ chani zaawuni ka m paɣa kpi. Dindali maa yi biɛɣu asiba ka n daa niŋ kaman bɛ ni zali ma shɛm maa.
en: I spoke with the people in the morning, and by evening my wife was dead. The next morning I did as I was commanded.

dag: O kuhi boli zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni di di o shɛhira, ka o kar o niriba saria.
en: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa yɛli naa, Nyini n dan naa ni kul lab yiŋ na ni alaafee ŋɔ, chɛ ka o zaŋ di zaa.
en: Mephibosheth replied, He can have it all! I'm just glad you've come home safely.

dag: Bahi yoli mini wahala m-be bɛ ni doli so shɛŋa zuɣu.
en: destruction and misery are in their ways; .

dag: Amaa yiŋbia maa yi nyɛla bi biɛɣu, ka yɛl o suhu ni ni o yiŋlan yuui kundina.
en: But suppose those bad servants should say to themselves, My master wont come until later.

dag: Guli ma, ka fa ma bahi; di chɛ ka n di vi, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: Please protect my life! Deliver me! Dont let me be put to shame because I take refuge in you.

dag: Di saha ka a pii di biɛla gbini a binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: Keep back a few hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, ka tiŋ maa nim nya ka sɔɣ li ka bi ku o.
en: But if the community ignores what you have done and does not put you to death.

dag: Hɔshia ni Hanania ni Hashub ni.
en: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub.

dag: Kaman piɛguliba ni vihiri bɔri bɛ piɛri shee shɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti wurim kpe yɔɣu la, lala ka n yɛn bo m piɛri maa shee. Sagbani mini zibisim titali dali, n ni lihi bo ba bɛ ni daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-tiligi ba.
en: in the same way as shepherds take care of their sheep that were scattered and are brought together again. I will bring them back from all the places where they were scattered on that dark, disastrous day.

dag: Kul sɔŋm ma, dama m piila a zaligunima.
en: I have chosen to follow your instructions, so reach out and help me!.

dag: Sool daa bi yɛli shɛli dindali maa, dama o daa tɛhimi, Binshɛli n-niŋ o ka o bi be kasi, biɛhiŋ kani, o shiri bi bela kasi.
en: That day Saul said nothing. He thought, Maybe something happened to David so that he is not clean.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, Zallakudura Naa bi be nuhi ni me du shɛl ni kaman anab so ni daa yɛli shɛm la ni ti Duuma yɛliya:.
en: However, the Most High doesnt live in houses built by human hands. As the prophet says.

dag: Nandaamba yi kuhira ka a baɣa kani, a gba ni ti kuhira ka so ku wum.
en: Those who refuse to help the poor will not receive help when they need it themselves.

dag: Bɛ yaala bɛ noya gu ma. Bɛ bemi kaman gbuɣinli ŋun bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma, ka ŋumdi la.
en: They open their mouths like lions, roaring and tearing at me.

dag: Turi tubu zuɣu ka bɛn bi wumdi yɛlimaŋli zabira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm nyɛla bɛn deeri saɣisigu.
en: Pride causes arguments, but those who listen to others are wise.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa dooi bini mali naɣibil zali ka daa yɛli, Yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti na la m-bɔŋɔ! la, bɛ daa mo nyin Naawuni pam.
en: Even when they had cast an image of a calf for themselves, saying, This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt, and holding you in great contempt.

dag: N nyɛla bɛn mali suhudoo ka ʒe yim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yino. Ka yi ti bɔri ni yi wurim tin shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ma? Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a saɣim Yawɛ ni su binshɛli.
en: I am one of the peaceful and faithful in Israel, but you are trying to kill a city that is one of Israels mothers! Why would you annihilate the LORDs inheritance.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Aduna bidibisi maa daa mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: Moses, Aaron, and Aarons sons used this bowl to wash their hands and feet.

dag: Sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa, di nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi; ka sagbani maa daa yi ti kpalim zani luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka Izraɛlnim maa tiri bɛ suɣa doona.
en: Whenever the cloud ascended from the tent, the Israelites would march. And the Israelites would camp wherever the cloud settled.

dag: dindina n ni be yi sani kpe, n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim kurimbuni ha ni bɛ su li sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: If you change, I will let you go on living here in the land which I gave your ancestors as a permanent possession.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ sani nti chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli taba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi wum tab yɛtɔɣa.
en: Let's go down and confuse them! We'll make them speak different languages, and they won't be able to understand each other.

dag: Di yi nyɛla lala, ti Naawuni so ti ni jɛmdi maa yi ni tooi yihi ti buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni, o ni yihi ti, ka ni lan yihi ti a gba nuu ni.
en: If our God—the one we serve—is able to rescue us from the furnace of flaming fire and from your power, Your Majesty, then let him rescue us.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka lan nyɛ Yawɛ dabisili din be kasi, ka ŋunkam ti tum tuma dindali, bɛn kum o.
en: You have six days in which to do your work, but the seventh day is to be sacred, a solemn day of rest dedicated to me, the Lord . Anyone who does any work on that day is to be put to death.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shih o ni mali shɛlikam maa zaa pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: But stretch out your hand and strike all he has. He will certainly curse you to your face.

dag: M mi a ni ʒiini shɛm ni a ni yiɣisiri shɛm, ka mi a ni yiri chani ka labirina shɛm. N lan mi a ni je suli niŋ ma shɛm.
en: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima kaman di ni simdi shɛm ti Duuma sani.
en: Wives, submit to your husbands in a way that is appropriate in the Lord.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa ʒiya kariti saria maa ka o paɣ timna ti yɛl o, Yihim a nuu wuntizɔra ŋɔ yɛla ni, dama yuŋ la n sa nya muɣisigu pam zahindi ni o zuɣu.
en: While Pilate was sitting in the judgment hall, his wife sent him a message: Have nothing to do with that innocent man, because in a dream last night I suffered much on account of him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmanila yɛm tuma din kpaŋsiri jɛmbu muɣisigu puuni mini ʒiri maŋsiɣisibutali ni niŋgbuŋ nahimbu, amaa di zaa yoli, di bi kuri buchi zaŋ chaŋ maŋgbaabu niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma tumbu puuni.
en: They look like they are wise with this self-made religion and their self-denial by the harsh treatment of the body, but they are no help against indulging in selfish immoral behavior.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli paɣiba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la.
en: The angel spoke to the women. You must not be afraid, he said. I know you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.

dag: Jɔahaz daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Jehoahaz disobeyed the Lord , just as some of his ancestors had done.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yila daa na bɛ bi diri bindirigu faashee bɛ paɣila bɛ ni pɔi. Ka bɛ daa lan paai bɛ yaannim kal shɛŋa dol li pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Pipihi mini duɣiri ni taha ni teebuya paɣibu.
en: Upon returning from the marketplace, they dont eat without first immersing themselves. They observe many other rules that have been handed down, such as the washing of cups, jugs, pans, and sleeping mats.

dag: Ka m biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ shɛli din pahir ayi m-be nuzaa polo la gba simdi ka di mali dapaɣa pisi.
en: Make twenty frames for the north side of the Tent.

dag: A yi nya shiri, nyin dim li a kum tariga, a yi di li yaɣi, a ni ti li bahi.
en: Eating too much honey can make you sick.

dag: Ka salo daa baŋ ka kar o naba; ka o daa ti puhi ba ni bɛ paabuna, ka tɔɣisi ba Naawuni nam yɛla, ka tib barinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: When the crowds heard about it, they followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them about the Kingdom of God, and healed those who needed it.

dag: O wahala dibu nyaaŋa, o ni ti nya o tuma nyɔri ka o nini tiɣi li. N dabili ŋun nyɛ wuntizɔra maa baŋsim zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni. O ni deei bɛ daalahichi ʒi.
en: After his suffering he will see the light, and he will be satisfied with what he experienced. The Lord says, My servant, who always does what is right, will make his people right with me; he will take away their sins.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ chama, ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔni bɛ sɔɣibu shee din daa be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Ai wulinluhili polo la; amaa ka Jɔshua ŋun daa kpalim gbe niriba maa sani.
en: Then Joshua sent them to their hiding place and waited. They went to a place west of Ai, between Bethel and Ai. But Joshua stayed the night with his people.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ma n dimnim nuu ni. Nyini n-daa duhi ma gari n dimnima. Nyini n-daa fa ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taai duŋ nuu ni bahi.
en: He saves me from my enemies! You help me defeat those who attack me. You save me from cruel people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa zaŋ ŋariŋ shɛl o ni daa pun kpe n-ʒiya la duri duli. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛŋa ni dol o dura.
en: They left the crowd and took him in the boat just as he was. Other boats followed along.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa baŋ dinkam zaa niŋ maa, ka o suhu daa saɣim, ka o dar tɔh o situra, ka zaŋ buɣu pili, ka niŋ tampiligim puɣ o zuɣu n-yi n-kpe tiŋ puuni chani gindi kuhiri fabila kuhigu pampam ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: When Mordecai heard about the letter, he tore his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he covered his head with ashes and went through the city, crying and weeping.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo nti kpe fɔŋ ni n-yɛli niriba dinkam daa niŋ maa mini din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu maa yɛla zaa.
en: The men who had the work of caring for the pigs ran away. They went into town and told the people everything that happened, especially about the men who had the demons.

dag: kumiya bɛ zaa, Hitinim mini Amɔrinim ni Keenannim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: Instead, you must place these under the ban: Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites—just as the LORD your God commanded you.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ kuriba ni ʒirinim maa kpi n-kpe gbala ni, ka bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni yuusim pirigili na bi paai gba. Amaa nyini ka man kul ni niŋ naani.
en: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord !.

dag: Dama Yawɛ chɛ ka gom gbaai ya ni yi gbihi gbihiri biɛɣu. O pɔbi yi daanabinim nina, ka zaŋ bini pili yi nyariba zuɣuri.
en: The LORD has poured on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has shut your eyes, you prophets, and covered your heads, you seers.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A yi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba, dindina a ni tiligi, ka bɛ ku nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim, ka a mini a yiŋnim ku kpi.
en: Then I told him that the Lord had said: Zedekiah, I am the Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Israel. I promise that if you surrender to King Nebuchadnezzar's officers, you and your family won't be killed, and Jerusalem won't be burned down.

dag: Ninsalinim bi mi bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli paai li. Di ka ninvuɣ nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: Wisdom is not to be found among mortals; No one knows its true value.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa baŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni bebɔ? Ka bɛ saɣi, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: Jesus asked his disciples if they understood all these things. They said, Yes, we do.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ti paai Bahurim, ka Sool daŋ ni do so ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛra bia ka o yuli booni Shimɛi la daa yina ti turi ba.
en: When King David came to Bahurim, a man from the same clan as Sauls family came out from there. His name was Shimei; he was Geras son. He was cursing as he came out.

dag: Duma yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Ka so daa boli ma Siɛr yɛra, Tiŋgula, bɔ saha ka biɛɣu yɛn neei? Yɛlim biɛɣu maa ni yɛn neei saha shɛli.
en: An oracle about Dumah. Someone is calling to me from Seir: Guard, how long is the night? Guard, how long is the night.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi zuɣu ka kukoli maa tɔɣisiri maa, pa n zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, That voice was for you and not for me.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yisifu biɛyanim maa, Tuun bɔ n-lee nyɛ yi tuma? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ mini ti yaannim nyɛla piɛguliba.
en: Pharaoh said to Josephs brothers, What do you do? They said to Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds, both we and our ancestors.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaana kam kul ʒiɛmi tumd o sara maligu tuma dabisili kam n-kul maanila sara maligu yini maa napɔn bɔbili. Ka sara maligunim ŋɔ mi ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi;.
en: Every day the priests stand and do their religious service. Again and again they offer the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni daanfaani; ka miriya ka yi chɛ ka putɔɣu kpe yi ni so ni n-zooi muɣisi ya ka ta yi ni shɛb daɣiri.
en: Be careful that no one fails to get Gods grace. Be careful that no one loses their faith and becomes like a bitter weed growing among you. Someone like that can ruin your whole group.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa yɛl o ba, N dana, di je suli niŋ ma n ni ku tooi yiɣisi zani a tooni maa zuɣu, dama paɣitali biɛhigu ni ka m be. Ka Leeban daa vihi bo wuni maa ka bi nya li.
en: Rachel said to her father, Sir, dont be angry with me because I cant get up for you; Im having my period. He searched but couldnt find the divine images.

dag: ni tammɛriba ni kuɣikpɛriba, ka da dari mini nyolimbɔɣa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan zaŋ di shɛli mi mali duu maa luɣ shɛlikam din simdi ni bɛ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: masons, and stonecutters. The money was used to purchase wood and quarried stone to repair the LORDs temple and for every other cost involved in repairing it.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ; o saria karibu la bela dunia ni zaa.
en: The Lord is our God; his commands are for all the world.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni. Yiɣisim darigi zuliya kam zaa tibili. Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino gba tiligi.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a ba Ibrahimma Naawuni, di zɔri dabiɛm, n ni be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam n dabili Ibrahimma zuɣu.
en: The Lord spoke to him that night and said, I am the God of your father Abraham. Dont be afraid. I am with you, and I will bless you. I will make your family great. I will do this because of my servant Abraham.

dag: Teeku bulli vali ba, ka bɛ siɣi kɔtiŋ kaman kuɣili la.
en: The deep water covered them, and they sank to the bottom like rocks.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, lum a niriba bɛn bipuɣinsi zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛha tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la zuɣu. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka lahibal suŋ waazu daa yihi ti bɛn kpi la, ka hal bɛ ni nya saria karibu bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman daadam kam la zaa yoli, bɛ shihi lee ni nya nyɛvili m-be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm.
en: That is why the Good News was preached also to the dead, to those who had been judged in their physical existence as everyone is judged; it was preached to them so that in their spiritual existence they may live as God lives.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali ninkuunsi ka ku tiri ninkura jilima bee n-niŋ bipola nirilim.
en: They will be ruthless and show no mercy to anyone, young or old.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni.
en: Some of the teachers of the law heard what Jesus said. They said to themselves, What an insult to God for this man to say that.

dag: N ni bɔhim a zaligunim maa, ka zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a soya ni.
en: I will think about your precepts and examine all your paths.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yɛli ba, Pa yi ni chani tin shɛli maa soli m-bɔŋɔ; pa yi mi ni chani tin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ. Doliya ma ka n zaŋ ya tahi yi ni bɔri so maa sani. Ka o daa zaŋ ba tahi Samaria.
en: Elisha told the enemy troops, You've taken the wrong road and are in the wrong town. Follow me. I'll lead you to the man you're looking for. Elisha led them straight to the capital city of Samaria.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Naa. Di yi niŋ nyin Naa nyaɣisim, ka a yu ni a niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim, n suhir a ni a timmi ma Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛli ni la ka n ti lab me li zali.
en: and replied, If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor with you, please send me to Judah, to the city of my familys graves so that I may rebuild it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni lan chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhi ma ka n niŋ dimbɔŋɔ ti ba, dina n-nyɛ n chɛ ka bɛ daadambiɛligu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, I will once again let the Israelites ask me for help, and I will let them increase in numbers like a flock of sheep.

dag: Ka bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: So what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, John is a prophet. But I tell you, he is more than that.

dag: Yihim yɛlimuɣisira n suhu ni, ka yihi ma n nandahima ni.
en: My hearts troubles keep getting bigger— set me free from my distress!.

dag: Ka nyini Daadam, zaŋmi takɔbi shɛli din dira n-leei wanzam piliŋ n-zaŋ li pini a zabiri min a teeŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ sania zahim li m-pirigi li.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa lan yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na lan di ma shɛhira.
en: Then Samuel told them: The Lord brought your ancestors out of Egypt and chose Moses and Aaron to be your leaders.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan n-zaŋd o nuu timdi laa ni hal ka bi bɔri ni o ŋmaai bindirigu ti kpar o nol ni.
en: Lazy people bury their hand in the bowl; they wont even put it to their mouth.

dag: Faranim mabihi zaa yi je ba, di ni niŋ wula ka bɛ zɔnima ku zo ka chɛ ba? Hal bɛ yi kul kpaŋ bɛmaŋ kabo ni bɛ boli ba labisina, bɛ ku lan nya ba.
en: All the relatives of the poor hate them; even more, their friends stay far from them. When they pursue them with words, they arent there.

dag: Yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛli maa nyɔri nyɛla yi ni nya tiliginsim shɛl la.
en: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.

dag: Ka o yi ti nya li, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya n laɣifu din daa bɔrigi la.
en: And when she finds it, she will call her friends and neighbors and say to them, Be happy with me because I have found the coin that I lost.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn daa doli Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɛshua kulina la: Sɛraya mini Jɛrimia ni Ɛzra.
en: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra.

dag: Yisifu daa piila o biɛyanim maa ni niriba anu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti wuhi Firawuna.
en: He then presented his brothers to the king.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Yɛl titali paai ma, chɛ ka n kpɛla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam, amaa di chɛ ka n kpe ninsal nuu ni.
en: David was miserable and said, It's a terrible choice to make! But the Lord is kind, and I'd rather be punished by him than by anyone else.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bihi maa, N yɛn chaŋ ti pahila n yaannim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Zaŋmiya ma ti sɔɣi siliga din be Ɛfurɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la puu la ni m-pahi n yaannim zuɣu.
en: Then Jacob commanded his sons, Now that I am going to join my people in death, bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

dag: O daa lan ʒila o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba hal ti yaɣi.
en: He and the others were so frightened that he did not know what to say.

dag: Naa, n tɛhi ni n nyɛla zuɣusuŋlana n ni zan a tooni zuŋɔ ni n tɔɣisi chihi mmaŋ noli Yɛhudianim ni fiɣisiri ma yɛl shɛŋa zaa zuɣu la.
en: King Agrippa, I am glad for this chance to defend myself before you today on all these charges my own people have brought against me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naa Hɛrɔd mini Pɔntius Pailɛt ni chɛfirinim zaŋ tabili Izraɛlnim zaa daa shiri laɣim ya n-zaɣisi a Wundab Suŋ Yisa, a ni daa zaŋ so leei Masia.
en: Indeed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with Gentiles and Israelites, did gather in this city against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

dag: ka wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ o ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa puuni maa zaa, ka bo yuun yini piɛlaa na ti mali sara taali tumbu zuɣu; o ni daa pun niŋ shɛl la din kpalim la yoli, dama daɣiri ta o ni daa pun mal o zuɣu shɛli ka di be kasi la.
en: The person will be rededicated to the LORD as a nazirite and bring a one-year-old male lamb for a compensation offering. The previous period will be invalid, because the nazirite promise was defiled.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n wuntia ŋɔ, n yi suh a, nyin garigim ma. N daa be muɣisigu ni ka a ti ma faako. Niŋm ma nirilim ka deei n suhigu.
en: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa lu soli chani Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka o gba dii gbaai anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu m-mali lala hal ti paai Naiɔt Rama tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: So Saul went out to the camps near Ramah. The Spirit of God came on Saul, and he also began prophesying. He prophesied all the way to the camps at Ramah.

dag: Ka ti ni paɣ shɛb yɛl ti shɛli ka di gari ti pam: Asibaasi ŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ yibu chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Some of the women of our group surprised us; they went at dawn to the tomb.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba doli soli din tuhi hal ti paai bɛ ni yɛn ʒini tin shɛl ni.
en: At once he brought you to a town.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni so n ni jɛmdi n suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi puuni kaman n yaannim ni daa jɛm o shɛm la. N kul teer a yɛla n wunsuhigu ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka paɣiri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: Im grateful to God, whom I serve with a good conscience as my ancestors did. I constantly remember you in my prayers day and night.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa zɔri Sulemaana, ka yiɣisi chaŋ ti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Adonijah was also afraid of Solomon, so he went to the altar and held onto the horns of the altar.

dag: Ɛba ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanahi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg.
en: When Eber was years old, he became the father of Peleg.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli ba, Ŋuna m-bɔŋɔ; o bela yi nuu ni, dama man naa ka yi yiko.
en: Zedekiah replied, Do what you want with him. I can't stop you.

dag: Bɛ yi galim ya Masia yuli zuɣu, yi mal alibarika, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi min o jilima be yi ni. Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindiri Masia, amaa yinim sani o nyɛla ŋun nyari tibigibu.
en: When people say bad things to you because you follow Christ, consider it a blessing. When that happens, it shows that Gods Spirit, the Spirit of glory, is with you.

dag: Ka paɣ maa garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do laa gbini diri bihi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: Sir, she answered, even the dogs under the table eat the children's leftovers.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni la Shia yi be yi ni, ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa kum ni maa ni zaŋ nyɛvili niŋ yi gba niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni, o Shia ŋun be yi ni la zuɣu.
en: If the Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from death, lives in you, then he who raised Christ from death will also give life to your mortal bodies by the presence of his Spirit in you.

dag: ka zaŋ anzinfa mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pihinahi. Ka dapaɣ yini ni ti mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka dapaɣili kam ti mali diba ayi, ka di dashɛbir ayi shɛb di ni.
en: and forty silver bases to go under them, two bases under each frame to hold its two projections.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim kpuɣiri paɣiba ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: Jesus answered: The people in this world get married.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa yi yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ ka doli tab gbilligbilli chani shɛm m-bala.
en: This was the order of departure of the Israelites with their military units when they set out.

dag: Ka Simiɔn zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbuyinika ni kɔbisita.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Simeon was .

dag: Di chɛ ka shɛli yɛla niŋ a nandahima bee n-chɛ ka shɛli ti a biɛrim a niŋgbuna ni. Dama bipolitali mini biɛhigu piligu nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Rid yourself of all worry and pain, because the wonderful moments of youth quickly disappear.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N yɛn zaŋla Ijipti Naa Hɔfira niŋ o dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku o nuu ni kaman n ni daa kul zaŋ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia niŋ o dim Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa bɔri ni o ku o la nuu ni shɛm la.
en: The LORD proclaims: I will hand Pharaoh Hophra, Egypts king, over to his enemies who seek to kill him, just as I delivered Judahs King Zedekiah over to his enemy King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon, who sought to kill him.

dag: Ka Pool daa boli sapashinnim ni yino na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm nachimbil ŋɔ tahi sapashin kpɛm sani; o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl o.
en: Then Paul called one of the officers and said to him, Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him.

dag: Ayuba ni daa suhi Naawuni ti o zɔnim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan labisi Ayuba buni ti o. Yawɛ daa tila Ayuba o ni daa pun mali shɛli ʒii buyi zuɣu.
en: Then, after Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made him prosperous again and gave him twice as much as he had had before.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa m-mali ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani wuɣisiri buɣim.
en: Peter followed from a distance and went into the courtyard of the High Priest's house. There he sat down with the guards, keeping himself warm by the fire.

dag: Ka wuntia tuma maa tahi suhudoo mini biɛri baalimtali ni naani niŋbu na sahakam.
en: That justice will bring peace and safety forever.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Ibrahimma daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi: Yino daa nyɛla dab paɣ bia, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bilichin paɣ bia.
en: It says that Abraham had two sons, one by a slave woman, the other by a free woman.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim daa bi ku ba Izraɛl kpamba ni daa pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni, ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni n-niŋdi bɛ kpamba maa.
en: But the Israelites didnt strike at them. This was because the leaders of the community had made a solemn pledge to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. The entire community grumbled against the leaders.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra ŋun daa nyɛ Ribɛka yiŋ dabipaɣ la daa kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o oki ti shɛli din daa be Bɛtɛl tiŋli la gbini. Ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Kumsi tia.
en: Rebecca's nurse Deborah died and was buried beneath the oak south of Bethel. So it was named Oak of Weeping.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Sabimi a ni nya ʒii shɛli maa ka chɛ ka di yi zahira pa kuɣiparilana zuɣu, ka ŋun guura ni tooi karim li. .
en: The Lord answered me, Write down what I show you. Write it clearly on a sign so that the message will be easy to read.

dag: Din pahi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim mini bɛn daa zo n-tiligi ti kpi.
en: He will even cause panic among them and will destroy those who escape and go into hiding.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛli daa kani ka ti bi dee li bɛ sani. Di daa nyɛla fɔntinsi pihiyɔbu, Arigɔb yaɣili zaa mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi nam ʒiishee la.
en: We also captured all of Ogs towns at that time. There wasnt a single city that we didnt take from them—a total of sixty towns, the entire region of Argob, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana nyɛla ŋun tiligiri nyɛviya, amaa ŋun ŋmari ʒiri ŋun nyɛla nyaanyira.
en: A truthful witness saves lives, but a deceiver proclaims lies.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni tooi yɛli naa, A nyɛla ninvuɣ yoli ka yɛli kpambaliba, Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: God is the one who says to kings, You are worthless! He says to leaders, You are evil.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shutɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shutɛlanima; ka Bɛcha daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛchanima; ka Tahan mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Tahannima.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Ephraim were Shuthelah—the Shuthelahite family group; Beker—the Bekerite family group; Tahan—the Tahanite family group.

dag: Yi ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli mali yimaŋa ka yi biɛhigu be kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi yuri yi mabihi yurilim maŋli ni la zuɣu, kul yumiya taba yi suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: You have made yourselves pure by obeying the truth. Now you can have true love for your brothers and sisters. So love each other deeply—with all your heart.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tam Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi maa ni la yɛla, dama bɛ ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: Only make sure not to neglect the Levites who are living in your cities because they dont have a designated inheritance like you do.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin daa yɛl o ba, N yi bi ʒi Bɛnjamin kuna, nyin kum m bidibis ayi ŋɔ, chɛl o niŋ n nuu ni, n ni ʒi o kuna ti ti a.
en: Reuben said to his father, If I do not bring Benjamin back to you, you can kill my two sons. Put him in my care, and I will bring him back.

dag: N ni zaŋ suhu palli tin ya, ka zaŋ shi palli niŋ yi ni. N ni yihi yi suhu din be ka kuɣili ŋɔ yi ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ yi ni.
en: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you. I will remove your stony heart from your body and replace it with a living one.

dag: M pun tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam, n ku lan garigi; n ku lan yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: I spoke once, but I will not speak again. I spoke twice, but I will not say anything more.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ Hiburɔn.
en: King David said, Go in peace. Absalom went to Hebron.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba yi di be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga. Bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko nyɛviya ka bɛ naan tiligi bɛ wuntitali zuɣu.
en: even if Noah, Danel, and Job lived there—as surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God—they would not be able to save even their own children. Their goodness would save only their own lives.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm yi nya ka barina kanna bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa bɛn ka yɛm bɛn ni chaŋ ti kpe di ni n-di wahala.
en: Wise people see trouble coming and get out of its way, but fools go straight to the trouble and suffer for it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Ɛfɛsus, ka Pool chɛ Akuila mini Prisila ka chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛla.
en: They arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He went into the synagogue and held discussions with the Jews.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka daa labina dabisili din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: Rehoboam replied, Come back in three days for my answer. So the people left.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi daa be Gɛba luɣ shɛŋa din nyɛ Mikimash mini Aija ni Bɛtɛl ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: The people of the tribe of Benjamin lived in Geba, Michmash, Ai, Bethel and the nearby villages.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa ti kpe n-zani dunol ni ha, ka Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Nyin Zimiri ŋun ku a dan ŋɔ, Alaafee.
en: Jehu entered the city. Jezebel said, Hello, you Zimri. You killed your master just as he did.

dag: Na kul yum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la, ka ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la polo.
en: Continue to love those who know you and to do good to those who are righteous.

dag: Bɛ daa liri bɛn mali biŋkɔbiri n-taɣi piɛri mini buhi ni laakuma chaŋ. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: His army also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took many sheep and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.

dag: A yuri din tuhi, ka je din bi tuhi; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa piig a, ka ti a jilima pam din tiri suhupiɛlli gar o ni ti a tab shɛm la.
en: You love what is right and hate what is wrong. So God, your God, has chosen you, giving you more honor and joy than anyone like you. Psalm :-.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim be bɛ sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ wum di yɛligu ka saɣisi bɛmaŋa.
en: Abraham replied, They have Moses and the Prophets. They must listen to them.

dag: Zaŋmiya naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi m-mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: Offer a burnt offering as a food offering to the Lord : two young bulls, one ram, and seven one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam daa chɛ o dolibu.
en: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.

dag: Ka Pita min o tuuntab maa garigi yɛli ba, Di simdi ni ti deela Naawuni noli ka pa ni ninsalinim noli;.
en: Peter and the apostles replied, We must obey God rather than humans!.

dag: Anabi maa n-nyɛ ŋun guli Ifriimnim bɛn nyɛ n Naawuni niriba ŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ bari noongbahiri zana bɛ soya zuɣu, ka dimdi be bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ maa, ka bɛ tiŋsi lab nyaaŋa ti lu tiŋa.
en: When Jesus said, I am Jesus, the men moved back and fell to the ground.

dag: dama sokam tum alahichi ka kɔŋ soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ paai Naawuni sani.
en: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ʒe Jɛhɔshafat nyaaŋa, dama o daa kul bemi kaman o ba ni daa tuui di nam ka be shɛm la, o daa bi jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat because he followed the earlier ways of his father by not seeking Baal.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn fabili? Ka saha yuusim wula ka luɣilikam mɔri yɛn kuui? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni tuumbiɛri zuɣu chɛ ka biŋkɔbiri mini noombihi zaa kpira; ka din pahi nyɛla, niriba yɛra, O nini bi nyari ti ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: How much longer will the land be dry? How long will the grass be dry and dead? The birds and the animals of this land have all died, and it is the fault of the wicked. But they are saying, Jeremiah will not live long enough to see what happens to us.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha a ni gbib bidibiga a nuu ni. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Aai. Wɛi, n dana, a nyɛla Naawuni nira, di yɔhim man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ.
en: Elisha said, About this time next year, you will be holding a son in your arms. But she said, No, man of God, sir; dont lie to your servant.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa be Dauda sani daba ata n-diri ka nyura, dama bɛ mabihi daa pun malila binshɛɣukam shili zali ba.
en: They were there with David for three days, eating and drinking, while their relatives provided food for them.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli, Naawuni zahimmi n yɛla nya, ka deei n suhigu ka ti ma bidibiga; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Dan.
en: Rachel said, God has listened to my prayer. He decided to give me a son. So she named this son Dan.

dag: Ka doo maa dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni n-kuni ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: At once the man got up in front of them all, took the bed he had been lying on, and went home, praising God.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣi Naawuni o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Dinzuɣu n ni paɣ nyin Naawuni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sunsuuni ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: Christ also did this so that the non-Jewish people could praise God for the mercy he gives to them. The Scriptures say, So I will give thanks to you among the people of other nations; I will sing praise to your name. Psalm :.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti suui yi noli. O nyaandoliba maa ni so daa bi buɣisi ni o bɔh o, Ŋuni n-nyɛ a? Bɛ daa mi ni bɛ Duuma m-bala.
en: Jesus said to them, Come and have breakfast. None of the disciples could bring themselves to ask him, Who are you? They knew it was the Lord.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛ mali taali alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa lo Masia san la puuni.
en: and so become guilty of breaking their earlier promise to him.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi takɔro maa ni ka bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee be m polo? Ka m ba namɔɣilis ayi bee ata ŋmaligi lih o na.
en: Jehu looked up and shouted, Who is on my side? Two or three palace officials looked down at him from a window.

dag: Naawuni pala ninsala ŋun ni ŋma ʒiri. O mi pala daadam ŋun taɣir o tɛha. O yi lo alikauli, o paani li mi. O mi yi yɛli shɛli, o niŋdi li mi.
en: God isnt a man that he would lie, or a human being that he would change his mind. Has he ever spoken and not done it, or promised and not fulfilled it?.

dag: Ka hal n yi kari so saria gba, n saria karibu maa nyɛla din tuhi, dama pa n kɔŋko n-kariti saria maa, amaa m mini ŋun tim ma na maa n-kariti li.
en: Even if I do judge, my judgment is truthful, because Im not alone. My judgments come from me and from the Father who sent me.

dag: O daa bi biɛhim Naawuni daalikauli hal baabiɛla. O ni daa kul tibigiri Naawuni maa puuni ka o yɛda daa kul niŋdi kpiɔŋ pahira.
en: He never doubted that God would do what he promised. He never stopped believing. In fact, he grew stronger in his faith and just praised God.

dag: ni ŋun wuhiri bɛn ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni din tuhi biɛribaalimtali puuni. Dama di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka bɛ baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli ka niŋ tuuba.
en: and should correct opponents with gentleness. Perhaps God will change their mind and give them a knowledge of the truth.

dag: Ka yimaŋmaŋ gba mi Timoti ni pun kpaŋd omaŋ shɛm m min o ni laɣim kaman ba min o bia n-tumdi lahibal suŋ tuma la yɛla.
en: You know the kind of person Timothy is. He has served with me in telling the Good News like a son with his father.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa ti wum ni Jɛrɔbɔam kuna, ka bɛ daa laɣim ka tim ti bol o na nti zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa. Dinzuɣu Juda zuliya niriba la kɔŋko n-daa doli Dauda yilinim maa, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la zaa daa zaɣisi ba dolibu.
en: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had come back, they called him to a meeting and made him king over all Israel. The tribe of Judah was the only tribe that continued to follow the family of David.

dag: Dinzuɣu Masia daa kana nti yihi suhudoo lahibal suŋ waazu tila yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka daa be katiŋ ni Naawuni la mini Yɛhudianim bɛn daa mir o la.
en: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.

dag: Mɛnahɛm ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ gulila m ba piɛri, ka gbuɣinli bee kunduŋ daa yi ti kana ti gbaai piɛbila guui;.
en: Your servant has kept his fathers sheep, David replied to Saul, and if ever a lion or a bear came and carried off one of the flock.

dag: Ʒiŋmabo nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa bɛn ʒe yim nyɛla o suhu ni piɛli shɛb zuɣu.
en: The Lord hates people who tell lies, but he is pleased with those who tell the truth.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa labina nti nya o mini paɣ maa ni diri alizama maa ka di gari ba pam, amaa bɛ ni so daa bi bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra? Bɛ mi daa bi bɔhi Yisa, Bɔzuɣu ka a mini paɣ maa diri alizama.
en: Just then, Jesus disciples arrived and were shocked that he was talking with a woman. But no one asked, What do you want? or Why are you talking with her.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zani Gibia ni bɛ liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa.
en: They marched out to fight against the Benjaminites, lining up in battle formation against them at Gibeah.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni, ka ŋmaligi kpa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa polo ti bo o, bɛ daa nya o.
en: But in their time of trouble they turned to the LORD, Israels God. They sought him and found him!.

dag: ka yi bi lan chɛ ka o gbib o ba min o ma maa gba.
en: You are telling people that they do not have to do anything for their father or mother.

dag: N wum a ni suhi ma suhigu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ishimail gba polo maa. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam. O ni ti nyɛla nanim pinaayi yaba, ka n chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: However, I have heard what you asked me to do for Ishmael, and so I will also bless him with many descendants. He will be the father of twelve princes, and I will make his family a great nation.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, zaadali Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I assure you that on the Judgment Day God will show more mercy to the people of Sodom and Gomorrah than to the people of that town!.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋ kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: The only bread I have is the sacred bread, the priest told David. You can have it if your soldiers didn't sleep with women last night.

dag: Ka daɣila n kul yɛn lihirila tɔbu tuhibu, ka wumdi kikahi kumsi sahakam?.
en: How long must I see the battle raging and hear the blasts of trumpets?.

dag: Gbibi ma kaman nimbil biɛlim la; ka zaŋm ma sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim ni.
en: Watch me with the very pupil of your eye! Hide me in the protection of your wings.

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim zuɣu wuhim ma a wuntia soli; malim a soli maa ka di tuhi ti ma.
en: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali n-yɛli ba, Ti chaŋla Sirianim sansan la ni nti bi nya so bee n-wum so damli, amaa ka bɛ tanti suɣa la beni; ka bɛ yuri mini bɛ bunsi gba loya pahi.
en: So the lepers came and called to the gatekeepers of the city. They told the gatekeepers, We went to the Aramean camp, but we did not hear anyone. No one was there, but the horses and donkeys were still tied up, and the tents were still standing.

dag: ni ŋun saɣisiri jɛra ni bihi karimba, ka di nyɛla a ni mi ni baŋsim mini yɛlimaŋli zaa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni zuɣu.
en: an instructor for the foolish, and a teacher for the ignorant. You are certain that in the Law you have the full content of knowledge and of truth.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa pundi dari mini kur wɔɣila ni dasara ni daantalisi ni di binzahi ni di neen kparisi zaa zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: They were assigned responsibility for the frames for the Tent, its bars, posts, bases, and all its fittings. They were responsible for all the service connected with these items.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima ka wolindi dira, di so ni a wuhi ni a nyɛla wɔɣirili ka kum kur a.
en: It is better to be an ordinary person working for a living than to play the part of someone great but go hungry.

dag: O daa doli o ba ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa, ka jɛm o ba ni daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: Amon lived just as his father had lived. He worshiped and served the same idols his father had worshiped.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: And Noah did everything that the Lord commanded.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di daanya kurupooti la ni di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni di tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar for burning offerings and its bronze grating, the poles, and all the things used at the altar; the bronze bowl and its base;.

dag: Naawuni bi zaɣis o ni pun piig o ninvuɣ shɛb la. Yi bi mi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anabi Ilaija ni daa yɛli shɛm n-galim Izraɛlnima Naawuni san la yɛla?.
en: God has not rejected his people, whom he chose from the beginning. You know what the scripture says in the passage where Elijah pleads with God against Israel:.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani. O daa bi siɣis omaŋ anab Jɛrimia ŋun daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o la sani.
en: He did what was evil in the LORD his Gods eyes and didnt submit before the prophet Jeremiah, who spoke for the LORD.

dag: Masia ni daa di wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni shɛm la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi gba zaŋ o tɛha maa tatabo kpaŋsi yimaŋa, dama ŋunkam diri wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni, o bi lan zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri alahichi tumbu ni.
en: Since Christ suffered physically, you too must strengthen yourselves with the same way of thinking that he had; because whoever suffers physically is no longer involved with sin.

dag: Ka ŋun Yaakubu maŋmaŋ daa daŋ bɛ tooni n-chaŋ ti damdi tiŋ napɔŋ buyopɔin hal ti mir o biɛli maa tooni.
en: Jacob went ahead of them and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ takɔbi maa ti ni bɛ nyɛhi li ka di neei, ka bɛ zaŋ li gbibi nuu ni. Bɛ sahi takɔbi maa, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei ni bɛ zaŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun kuri niriba nuu ni.
en: My sword has been polished; it's sharp and ready to kill.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ shɛb leeg o tɔbbi kpamba n-chɛ ka bɛ su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili, ka shɛb mi su pihinunu; ka zaŋ shɛb leeg o pukpariba, ka bɛ kɔr o puu ka kpuɣir o puu atam, ka shɛb mi maani o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbutuhiri nɛma.
en: He will make some of them officers in charge of a thousand men, and others in charge of fifty men. Your sons will have to plow his fields, harvest his crops, and make his weapons and the equipment for his chariots.

dag: Dinzuɣu kulim a ya pumpɔŋɔ. N daa yɛliya ni n ni ti a pin titali, amaa Yawɛ chɛ ka a kɔŋ pini maa.
en: Leave now and go home! I told you I would pay you well, but since the Lord didn't let you do what I asked, you won't be paid.

dag: Farisiinim bɛn yuri liɣiri pam la ni daa wum Yisa ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ maan o ansarisi.
en: The Pharisees really loved money. So when they heard what Jesus said, they made fun of him.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin zom ma nambɔɣu, ka n yiɣisi zani, m-bɔhi ba biɛri labisi.
en: Have pity, Lord ! Heal me, so I can pay them back.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o ma Ribɛka, Nyama, m biɛli Iso niŋgbuna mali kɔbiri pam, ka m mi niŋgbuna be polipoli.
en: My brother Esau is a hairy man, Jacob reminded her. And I am not.

dag: ka Ɛlimɛlɛk daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi min o bidibis ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: Later, Naomis husband, Elimelech, died, so only Naomi and her two sons were left.

dag: Ka zuliya kam nim maa ti baŋ ni Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ maa, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe yim n sani, dinzuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ zaa.
en: And the nations will know why the family of Israel was carried away as prisoners to other countries. They will learn that my people turned against me, so I turned away from them. I let their enemies defeat them, so my people were killed in battle.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyin ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, n yur a pam.
en: How I love you, Lord ! You are my defender.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ba golimgolim tiŋgban nɛli ni kpa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo. Izraɛlnim daa lola tɔbu n-yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Instead, he led them in a roundabout way through the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites were armed for battle.

dag: Jɛhoyakim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim zaa ni daa tum shɛm.
en: Following the example of his ancestors, Jehoiakim sinned against the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni wuh a so shɛli a ni yɛn doli; n shiri ni wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka gul a.
en: The Lord says, I will teach you and guide you in the way you should live. I will watch over you and be your guide.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubirila yimaŋmaŋ bidɔɣirisi, yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin shɛb Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tin ya la nimdi yi dimnim maa ni ti yɛn teei gili ya n-niŋdi ya alaka shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: When your enemies are besieging your towns, you will become so desperate for food that you will even eat the children that the Lord your God has given you.

dag: Ka o gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni, ka takɔb dirili din mali naŋgbana ayi yir o nol ni na, ka o ninni ne kaman wuntaŋ ni yi neei ni o kpiɔŋ zaa shɛm la.
en: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.

dag: Lala ka di daa niŋ ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata m-mali hal ti paai ŋun pah ayopɔin maa.
en: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers and finally to all seven of them.

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvi zuliya polo m-bɔŋɔ; Zaŋm a Tumim ti Lɛvi zuliya ka zaŋ a Urim ti ŋun ʒe a yim a ni daa zahim so Masa la, a mini ŋun daa mo Mɛriba kom ni la.
en: Then he told Levi: Give your Thummim to Levi, your Urim to your faithful one— the one you tested at Massah, the one you challenged by Meribahs waters.

dag: Ka n yɛtɔɣa mini n waazu yihibu daa pala yɛm yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi ninsalinim baŋsim ni na, amaa di daa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi tuma min o yiko ni na.
en: My teaching and my speaking were not with wise words that persuade people. But the proof of my teaching was the power that the Spirit gives.

dag: A zaligunim maa chɛ ka m mali yɛm gari n dimnima, dama di kul bela n suhu ni.
en: Your commandment is with me all the time and makes me wiser than my enemies.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaam amaŋa ni bi pala kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-mali biɛr kasi mini yɛda ni yurilim ni suhudoo, ka di chɛ ka a pahi bɛn doli ti Duuma ka bɛ suhuri ka daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.

dag: Ka Pool daa ti nya ʒii yuŋ ka ti Duuma yɛl o di ni, Di zɔri dabiɛm; kul yihim waazu maa ka di shini!.
en: One night Paul had a vision in which the Lord said to him, Do not be afraid, but keep on speaking and do not give up.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia gba daa bɔhi, Shihirili dini n-lee wuhiri ni n ni chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Hezekiah asked Isaiah, What is the sign that proves I will get well and go to the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli do so ŋun ye binyɛr piɛlli la, Cham kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim tiŋli la gbini nti mooi buɣimsal nɛma chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni pali a nuhi n-zaŋ li yaɣiri tiŋ maa zuɣu. Ka n daa yuun o ka o chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem. I watched him as he followed the Lord 's instructions.

dag: Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Judanim zaa daa ku o? O daa bi lula Yawɛ sizuura, ka balim Yawɛ ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli lu bɛ zuɣu maa polo? Amaa tinim yɛn bola zaɣ biɛ titali luhi timaŋ zuɣu.
en: Did King Hezekiah or anyone else in Judah execute him? Didnt he instead fear the LORD and plead for his mercy? Then the LORD relented of the harm that he had pronounced against them. We are about to commit a huge mistake that will cost us our lives.

dag: Naftali bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jaziɛl mini Guni ni Jɛzar ni Shallum, bɛ daa nyɛla Biliha zuliya.
en: Naphtali had four sons: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum.

dag: Ka naa daa yiɣisi Jɛshurun, saha shɛli niriba zuɣulaannim ni daa laɣim, din nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya naŋgban yini laɣiŋgu la.
en: Then you and your leaders made the Lord your king.

dag: Pa palo n-kul do a tooni ŋɔ? Woligim ka chɛ ma. A yi zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo, n ni zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo; ka a yi zaŋ kpala nudirigu polo, m mi ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo.
en: So let's separate. Choose any part of the land you want. You go one way, and I'll go the other.

dag: Ŋunkam di ʒiri shɛhira ni nya tibidarigibo, ka ʒirilan ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: If you tell lies in court, you will be punished—there will be no escape.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zana ni, amaa ka chɛ ka man kɔŋko tiligi.
en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets—all together!— but let me make it through safely.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti ka bɛ ku tooi nya, ka chɛ ka bɛ wahala leei ʒi tibisili m-marigi ba sahakam.
en: May their eyes be blinded so that they cannot see; and make them bend under their troubles at all times.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, ʒiɛnya dɛde ka di damdiya. Kul tummiya ti Duuma tuma ni yi kpiɔŋ zaa, yi ni mi ni yi tuma ku kpalim yoli ti Duuma ni la zuɣu.
en: As a result of all this, my loved brothers and sisters, you must stand firm, unshakable, excelling in the work of the Lord as always, because you know that your labor isnt going to be for nothing in the Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni zaligubaŋda ti bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu ni o zahim o.
en: One of them, a legal expert, tested him.

dag: dama ŋun nyɛ yikolana ka o yuli nyɛ kasi ŋɔ tum ma tuun kara.
en: because the mighty one has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

dag: Amaa ka o kpee la daa tah o zuɣu ka bɔh o, A bi zɔri Naawuni? A bi nya ka bɛ bahi noli ni bɛ kum ti min o zaa?.
en: The other one, however, rebuked him, saying, Don't you fear God? You received the same sentence he did.

dag: Ka Matan bia Shɛfatia mini Pushihur bia Gɛdalia ni Shɛlɛmia bia Jukal ni Malikia bia Pushihur daa wum ni Jɛrimia yɛrila niriba maa zaa.
en: Shephatiah, Mattans son; Gedaliah, Pashhurs son; Jucal, Shelemiahs son; and Pashhur, Malchiahs son heard what Jeremiah had been telling the people.

dag: Daadam, n kabi Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ bɔɣu, ka bɛ bi tar li moya bee n-lo li tani din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yaa, ka o zaŋ li gbaai takɔbi yaha.
en: Human one, Ive broken the arm of Pharaoh, Egypts king, and it hasnt been set so that it might heal, nor has it been braced or wrapped up so that it might be strong enough to grasp a sword.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-chaŋ ni o ti nya Sool, ka bɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Sool daa kala Kamɛl na nti me bɛ ni yɛn mali binshɛli teer o yɛla zali, ka gari chaŋ Giligal.
en: Early the following morning he went off to find Saul. He heard that Saul had gone to the town of Carmel, where he had built a monument to himself, and then had gone on to Gilgal.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa be mɔɣu ni saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa ti nya do so ka o kabiri dari Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Once, while the Israelites were still in the wilderness, a man was found gathering firewood on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ? O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni.
en: So what will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy those tenants and give the vineyard to others.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa kuli ni vuri yɔbu mini bana piɛbbu.
en: This is how David and the entire house of Israel brought up the LORDs chest with shouts and trumpet blasts.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din be zaligu gbaŋ maa puuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ mali shili gu dindali maa.
en: A copy of the letters with the command was to be given as a law. It was to be a law in every province and announced to the people of every nation living in the kingdom. Then everyone would be ready for that day.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ leei naa n-ʒili m ba Dauda nam maa ʒiishee hal n ni na kul nyɛ bia ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka m mi bi mi n ni yɛn su niriba shɛm.
en: Lord my God, you have made me the king in my fathers place, but I am like a small child. I dont have the wisdom I need to do what I must do.

dag: O darigi n tibili siɣimsiɣim bushɛm dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: He turned his hand against me. He did this again and again, all day.

dag: Dahin shɛli tinzunnim ni daa kana ti ʒi bɛ daazichi chaŋ la, dindali maa yi daa kaɣimi ʒe kpaŋa. Saamba maa ni daa kpe bɛ dunɔdaya ni nti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn piri Jɛrusalɛm nɛma shɛm la, yi gba daa bemi kaman bɛ ni daa be shɛm.
en: You stood aside on that day when enemies broke down their gates. You were as bad as those strangers who carried off Jerusalem's wealth and divided it among themselves.

dag: N suhir a, ni a di chaŋ, ka m bo pin na ti ti a. Ka o yɛl o, N ni guh a hal ka a ti labina.
en: Please do not leave until I bring you an offering of food. He said, I will stay until you come back.

dag: Gbuɣinli ni ŋum yɔɣu ni ka pa ni o nyala binshɛɣu? Ka gbuɣimbil ni ŋum vol ni ka pa ni o gbaala binshɛɣu?.
en: Does a lion roar in the forest unless he has found a victim? Does a young lion growl in his den unless he has caught something?.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Kpe ka di tu ni bɛ di ma saria, dama Naa Siiza ni zali sariakarita so tooni ka n zani ŋɔ. Amaŋmaŋ gba mi ni m bi tum Yɛhudianim taal shɛli.
en: Paul replied, I am on trial in the Emperor's court, and that's where I should be tried. You know very well I have not done anything to harm the Jewish nation.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi yi n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti mal li ka di be kasi, ka zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini bulaa maa ʒim shɛli n-niŋ binyila din be sara maligu bimbini la ni ti gili.
en: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na be soli kuna ka lahibali ti nti to Dauda, Absalom ku nabihi la zaa, hal bɛ yino bi lan kpalim.
en: While they were on their way home, David was told: Absalom has killed all your sons—not one of them is left.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kul yiɣisir o, ka o yi bembe o ti kuhirimi; ka alizin biɛɣu maa darigir o hal ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋariti o noli, ka o kul nahind o ka bi bɔr o bahibu.
en: Look, a spirit seizes him and, without any warning, he screams. It shakes him and causes him to foam at the mouth. It tortures him and rarely leaves him alone.

dag: Ka n daa chɛ ka tabilakpihi lu bɛ zuɣu n-dim kari Amɔrinim nanima ayi la bahi; ka di daa pala yi takɔbiri bee yi tɔbiri zuɣu.
en: As your army went forward, I sent the Hornet ahead of them and made the people leave the land, as I did to the two Amorite kings. It was not your swords and bows that brought you victory!.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Kamiya Bɛtɛl na nti tum tuumbiɛri; ka chaŋya Giligal nti tum tuumbiɛri. Zaŋmiya yi asiba kam sara maligu na, ka zaŋ yi bini pii puuni zaɣ yini na daba ata dali kam.
en: The Sovereign Lord says, People of Israel, go to the holy place in Bethel and sin, if you must! Go to Gilgal and sin with all your might! Go ahead and bring animals to be sacrificed morning after morning, and bring your tithes every third day.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: Again Jesus cried out loudly and then died.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Mɔabnim dindali maa, ka nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinii.
en: Moab was brought down by the power of Israel on that day, and there was peace in the land for eighty years.

dag: Shammai bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Maɔn, ka Maɔn daa nyɛ Bɛtizur ba.
en: who was the father of Maon, who was the father of Bethzur.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chani ka Naawuni malaikanim chirig o sol ni;.
en: As Jacob was on his way back home, some of God's angels came and met him.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa malim shili n-ka Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni na. Ka n ti ʒin nimaani n-kari zuliya kam bɛn gili luɣilikam zaa la saria.
en: The nations must get ready and come to the Valley of Judgment. There I, the Lord , will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi piligu ni hal ti paai di bahigu ni, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Hanani bia Jɛhu yɛlikura sabbu ni, ka di be Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛl kpamba.
en: Then Joshua ordered the leaders to.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya bɛ taali? Yisa Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daa kpi; ka din gari lala nyɛla, ŋuna n-daa neei kum ni, ka ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo n-suhiri Naawuni tiri ti.
en: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa dɔɣi Shɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Shelah was born, Arpachshad lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, deemi n suhigu. Yawɛ, dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: I know your love is true, so listen to me. Lord , you always do what is right, so let me live.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pina yɛla polo, m bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni.
en: My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ti be soli n-chana, ka do so ti yɛl o, N ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Along the way someone said to Jesus, I'll follow you anywhere.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yɛl bɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Nazarɛt do so ŋun yuli booni Yisa, ka o daa nyɛ anab titali o tumtumsa min o yɛtɔɣa ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni mini salinim zaa san la yɛla.
en: Jesus said, What are you talking about? They said, Its about Jesus, the one from Nazareth. To God and to all the people he was a great prophet. He said and did many powerful things.

dag: Yoomiya tiŋ maa dunoya, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛli din niriba nyɛ wuntizɔriba ka ʒe yim ŋɔ gari kpe.
en: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa gbaala Ai naa zaɣ nɛɔŋ n-zaŋ o ti ti Jɔshua.
en: except the king of Ai. He was captured and taken to Joshua.

dag: Dinzuɣu, nyini daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi kul wum yɛtɔɣ shɛli n noli ni saha shɛlikam, nyin zaŋmi li kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: You, human one, Ive made you a lookout for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear me speaking, you must give them warning from me.

dag: Ŋunkam kahindi nini nyɛla ŋun lo zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋun dimd o naŋgbampiba nyɛ tuumbiɛtumda.
en: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
