dag: Ka Naa Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa, n chaŋ Yawɛ timsim maa, n gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag na ka ku Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: Saul said, But I did obey the Lord ! I went where the Lord sent me. I destroyed all the Amalekites. I brought back only one—their king Agag.

dag: yo yaɣimɛr palo zuɣu kaman n Duuma Naawuni ni daa pun wuhi ma shɛm.
en: They paid it for a potter's field, as the Lord had commanded me.

dag: Ka nandan maa daa ti kpi, ka malaikanim kpuɣ o tahi ti yab Ibrahimma sani. Ka bundan maa gba daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o;.
en: The poor man died and was carried by the angels to sit beside Abraham at the feast in heaven. The rich man died and was buried.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o tizɔpaɣa, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who has sex with his sister, whether his fathers daughter or his mothers daughter. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Wulinluhili polo tiŋgbani maa tariga daa nyɛla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku la. Tintariga bɔbili maa n-daa gili Juda zuliya maa niŋ sunsuuni.
en: The west border was the Mediterranean Sea and its shoreline. This was the border surrounding the clans of the Judahites.

dag: Ka hal Izraɛlnim ni daa ti niŋ kpiɔŋ, bɛ daa bi kari Keenannim maa zaa, amaa ka daa naɣ lee muɣisiri ba mi ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: But the Israelites grew strong. When this happened, they forced the Canaanites to work for them. But they did not force them to leave that land.

dag: Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam Naawuni tiŋ la ni, o zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: The Lord is great and is to be highly praised in the city of our God, on his sacred hill.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: These Jewish leaders talked about Jesus question. They said to each other, If we answer, Johns baptism was from God, then he will say, Then why didnt you believe John.

dag: Yawɛ wum n ni suh o bɔri shɛli maa. Yawɛ ni deei n suhigu.
en: The Lord has heard my request for mercy. The Lord has accepted my prayer.

dag: Lihimi n nudirigu polo nya, so bi bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli. N ka sɔɣibu shee; so baɣa ka n ni.
en: I look around, and I dont see anyone I know. I have no place to run. There is no one to save me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim a la ni zo, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn me a kana ti me a zali.
en: Your children will come back to you, and those who destroyed you will leave.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya Filip la Azɔtus, ka o doli nimaani tinsi n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu hal ti paai Siizaria.
en: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.

dag: Zaŋm o ti lih o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a niŋ o zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa niŋm o ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛli.
en: Go and find Jeremiah and take good care of him. Do not harm him, but do for him whatever he wants.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa mali biɛrisuŋ Naawuni sani, ka daa suh o ni o chɛ ka o me jɛmbu duu ti ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o yab Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka Hɛli daa nyɛ Matat bia, ka Matat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi nyɛ Mɛlikai bia, ka Mɛlikai nyɛ Jannai bia, ka Jannai mi nyɛ Yisifu so bia.
en: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya ka biriti maa leei bɛn tɔɣisira, ka bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni maa kpaŋ, ka gbariti chana, ka zoomba gba nina neei maa, ka bɛ daa tibigi Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ pam.
en: People were amazed when they saw that those who could not speak were now able to speak. Crippled people were made strong. Those who could not walk were now able to walk. The blind were able to see. Everyone thanked the God of Israel for this.

dag: dama yi zaa ni tooi tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka ti taba, ka di chɛ ka yi zaa tooi bɔhim shɛli, ka lan nya kpaŋsibu.
en: All of you may proclaim God's message, one by one, so that everyone will learn and be encouraged.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa nyɛ Libini daŋ mini Shimɛi daŋ; Gɛrishɔn zuliya n-daa bala.
en: The clan of Gershon was composed of the families of Libni and Shimei.

dag: Ti yi ti suhuri Naawuni tiri ya, ti kul paɣirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ sahakam.
en: In our prayers we always thank God for you. He is the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Sahimiya piɛma pali lɔɣiri. Yawɛ piɛlila Miidia nanim bahina, dama o nia nyɛla o wurim Babilɔn. Dama Yawɛ n-yɛn bɔhi biɛri o jɛmbu duu la zuɣu.
en: Sharpen the arrows! Get your shields! The Lord has stirred up the kings of the Medes because he wants to destroy Babylon. The army from Babylon destroyed his Temple in Jerusalem, so he will give them the punishment they deserve.

dag: Di piligu dali ti nyɛla laɣiŋgu kasi dali. Di ti tumiya yi dabisili kam tuma dindali maa.
en: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maa naai, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni.
en: After David had finished offering the sacrifices, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa kul yɛrigila Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba yɛrigi nimaani kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi la.
en: The king made Israel very rich. In the city of Jerusalem, silver was as common as rocks and cedar wood was as common as the many fig trees growing on the hills.

dag: N daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi ti daalahichi wuh o. N daa yɛlimi, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi ka mali jilima. A ʒe a daalikauli nyaaŋa, ka yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunima.
en: I prayed to the Lord my God and told him about all my sins. I said, Lord, you are a great and awesome God. You keep your agreement of love and kindness with people who love you. You keep your agreement with the people who obey your commands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti puhi yi o zuɣu buɣim niɛm puuni tutuɣu ni, ka Musa daa lihi nya ka buɣim diri tutuɣu ni, amaa ka lee bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: The LORDs messenger appeared to him in a flame of fire in the middle of a bush. Moses saw that the bush was in flames, but it didnt burn up.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihinahi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pihinahi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham spoke again. He said, And if you find only forty good people there, will you destroy the city? The Lord said, If I find forty good people, I will not destroy the city.

dag: N daa tiligi ya Ijiptinim mini bɛnkam zaa daa nahindi ya nuu ni, ka kari ba ka zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: I saved you from the powerful Egyptians. Then the Canaanites hurt you, so I saved you again. I made them leave their land. And I gave their land to you.

dag: O daa lan yɛli bia maa yaha, Kpaŋmina, niŋmi yomyom, di lan ʒiɛya. Di saha ka Jɔnatan bia maa daa pih o piɛma maa n-zaŋ ka o sanna.
en: Jonathan shouted to him again, Hurry up! Don't stop! The boy picked up the arrows and brought them back to Jonathan.

dag: Teeku dulinim nyaya ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ kab laɣimna.
en: The coastlands see and fear; the ends of the earth tremble; they draw near and arrive.

dag: Bɛ taɣi kpibiga buŋ chaŋ, ka deei pakoli nahu talima.
en: They steal a donkey that belongs to an orphan. They take a widows cow until she pays what she owes them.

dag: O ni kpaai tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma maa, o niŋ li mi gu n sɔɣibu.
en: This woman poured perfume on my body. She did this to prepare me for burial after I die.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Lala n-nyɛ ŋun bo n-nya bun la omaŋmaŋ kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa Naawuni ŋun sani, lala nir pala bundana.
en: This is what happens to people who store up everything for themselves, but are poor in the sight of God.

dag: Ka Pita lan bɔh o, N Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka n ku tooi dol a pumpɔŋɔ? Hal n ni saɣi kpi a zuɣu.
en: Peter asked, Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you.

dag: A daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi a biɛhigu ni a nambu dali hal ka bɛ ti nya alahichi a ni.
en: From the day you were created until injustice was found in you, your ways were assured.

dag: Amaa a yi kpuɣ paɣa, a bi tum alahichi; ka paɣisarili gba yi kuli doo, o bi tum alahichi. Amaa bɛ lee ni di wahala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla zuɣu. M mi bɔrimi ni n yihi ya wahala shɛli lala niriba ni diri maa ni.
en: But if you decide to marry, that is not a sin. And it is not a sin for a girl who has never married to get married. But those who marry will have trouble in this life, and I want you to be free from this trouble.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M mini ŋun laɣim suɣiri ʒiɛri ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi n nyaaŋa maa.
en: He replied, The one who will betray me is the one who dips his hand with me into this bowl.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Ninvuɣ so ŋun daŋ Jɛbusinim ŋɔ kubu ni leei toondana, ka lan leei sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɔab ŋun nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa daŋ chaŋ, ka daa leei toondana.
en: David said, The first man to kill a Jebusite will be commander of the army! Joab, whose mother was Zeruiah, led the attack and became commander.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizo maa na ka n ti nya o, ka di wuhi ni yi yɛligu maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka yi tiligi. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: But then you must bring your youngest brother back here to me. Then I will know that you are telling the truth, and you will not have to die. The brothers agreed to this.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka n kuhira, ka nintam zɔri n ninni maa; dama ŋun yɛn maai n suhu be katiŋa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ma suhukpeeni. Bɛ zaɣisi m bihi; dama n dim nyaŋ ma.
en: That is why my eyes are overflowing with tears. No one can comfort me; no one can give me courage. The enemy has conquered me; my people have nothing left.

dag: ka tim ti mabia Timoti yi sanna. O nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdi so ti min o ni laɣindi tumdi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu tuma la. Ti daa tim o mi na ni o ti kpaŋsi ya yi yɛda niŋbu puuni, ka kpam ya jaande.
en: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ tima baŋdiba ni bɛ niŋm tim ʒe o ba niŋgbuŋ ka di ku pooi. Ka tima baŋdiba maa daa niŋ tim ʒe Izraɛl niŋgbuŋ.
en: Joseph commanded his servants to prepare his fathers body. The doctors prepared Jacobs body to be buried. They prepared the body in the special way of the Egyptians.

dag: Ka namɔɣili maa daa bɔhi Filip, Ŋun yɛla ka Anabi maa lee yɛri maa, omaŋmaŋ yɛla bee so yɛla.
en: The official said to Philip, Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else.

dag: Di saha maa ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ bɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini din daa nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpa viɛlli na ti niŋdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri maa ni.
en: Then everyone in Judah brought their tenth of grain, new wine, and oil to the Temple. These things were put into the storerooms.

dag: O daa bi saɣi ka so dol o pahila Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jeemsi tizo Jɔn.
en: Then he did not let anyone else go on with him except Peter and James and his brother John.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa be tin kasi maa ni zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihiniinaanahi.
en: Altogether, Levites settled in the holy city.

dag: Amaa ka o daa taai duŋ, ka tim tuumba Ijipti ni bɛ ti o yuri mini tɔbbihi pam na. O ni di nasara? Nira ŋun niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ni tooi tiligi? O ni tooi saɣim alikauli ŋɔ ka tiligi? .
en: But this new king of Judah later rebelled against Babylonia and sent officials to Egypt to get horses and troops. Will this king be successful in breaking the treaty with Babylonia? Or will he be punished for what he's done?.

dag: Dunɔguliba maa daa ʒiɛla luɣ anahi zuɣu, wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili ni nuzaa ni nudirigu polo.
en: There was one full-time guard appointed to each of the four sides of the temple.

dag: N kumdila Mɔabnim zuɣu! Bɛ zo n-kuli Zɔa mini Ɛgilatishɛlishia. Dama shɛb lu soli kuni Luhit, ka kumdi chana; ka shɛb mi zo n-kuli Hɔrɔnaim ni suhugarigu pam.
en: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.

dag: Izar daŋ ni Shɛlomɔt n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shɛlomɔt bidibisi ni, Jahat n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba ka bɛ yɛri taba, Nyamiya, bɛn zaa tɔɣisiri ŋɔ pala Galilinima?.
en: They were surprised and amazed, saying, Look, arent all the people who are speaking Galileans, every one of them?.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣi bindira pam ti ba, ka bɛ di ka nyu n-naai, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ naa sani. Ka Sirianim daa bi lan kana ti liri Izraɛlnim yaha.
en: So the king of Israel provided a great feast for them; and after they had eaten and drunk, he sent them back to the king of Syria. From then on the Syrians stopped raiding the land of Israel.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋchaŋ gil li, ka sab di yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm niŋ litaafi ni, ka lan pirigi di fɔndi ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-zaŋ labi ti ti Jɔshua Shilo sansani maa ni.
en: So the men went into the land. As they walked through it, they wrote down what they saw. They listed all the cities and divided the land into seven parts. Then they went back to Joshua at Shiloh.

dag: M mabihi, ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni! Ami!.
en: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all, my friends. Amen.

dag: Amaa n yi ti neei kum ni, n ni daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili.
en: But after I am killed, I will rise from death. Then I will go to Galilee. I will be there before you come.

dag: Bɛn zaa daa di li maa puuni, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu laasabu.
en: There were about men there who ate.

dag: O daa lan wuh o o ni ti yɛn piri maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tuma zaa shɛm ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋdi tumdi tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.

dag: Ti Duuma zal o zaligu, ka paɣiba pam zaŋ di lahibali moli gili;.
en: My Lord gave the command, and many people went to tell the good news:.

dag: Ka niriba ayi maa gba daa yɛli ba binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ sol ni mini bɛ ni daa lan baŋ o shɛm o bɔrɔbɔro ŋmahibu ni la yɛla.
en: Then the disciples from Emmaus told what happened on the road and how they knew he was the Lord when he broke the bread.

dag: Kaman karakɔhi ni kul daari yiɣiri gindi shɛm bee sakpaleensi ni yiɣiri shɛm, lala ka noli yɛlibu din bi simdi gba bi chani shɛli.
en: Curses cannot hurt you unless you deserve them. They are like birds that fly by and never light.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ʒini Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-nyɛ sana n-yuui pam.
en: Abraham lived in Philistia for a long time.

dag: Ŋun Yawɛ n-daa lan kari Amɔrinim zaa bɛn daa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu tinim gba ni jɛmla Yawɛ, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: The LORD has driven out all the nations before us, including the Amorites who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because he is our God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa doli vinvamli ni yuŋ maa n-yuuni nimaani polo chani ka yuuni gooni maa. Ka n daa lan ŋmaligi doli Vinvamli Dunɔdal la labi.
en: so I went down into Kidron Valley and rode along, looking at the wall. Then I returned the way I had come and went back into the city through the Valley Gate.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunima lola tɔb na ni bɛ ti liri ti. Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka a bi saɣi ni bɛ kpe zuliya shɛba tiŋgbɔna ni, ka bɛ daa chɛ ba ka bi ku ba la.
en: Now the people of Ammon, Moab, and Edom have attacked us. When our ancestors came out of Egypt, you did not allow them to enter those lands, so our ancestors went around them and did not destroy them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi dimnim maani ya ansarisi yɛra, To, pumpɔŋɔ zo kura la leela ti dini.
en: the Sovereign Lord , have for them: Israel's enemies gloated and said, Now those ancient hills are ours.

dag: Kom maa kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la, ka teeku bulli ni kom zuɣusaa kilim.
en: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock?.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ daa zaŋla Gɛba mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Alɛmɛt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Anatɔt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba. Bɛ ni daa su tin shɛŋa bɛ daŋ maa zaa ni daa nyɛla tinsi pinaata.
en: From the Benjamin tribe they were given the towns of Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth and the pastureland around them. Thirteen towns were given to Aaron's descendants.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zahim laɣ shɛli tibisim sania zuɣu n-ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa fukumsi ni bɛ mal li yɔri kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim bɛn tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma.
en: After recording the exact amount, they would hand the silver over to the men in charge of the work in the Temple, and these would pay the carpenters, the builders.

dag: Amaa yi yi nyɛla bɛn dimdi taba, ka vandi taba, yin miriya ka yi ti bahi tab yoli zaa.
en: But if you act like wild animals, hurting and harming each other, then watch out, or you will completely destroy one another.

dag: Nimaani ka yi mini yi yinsinim ni ti di li Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuuni kam zaa ni zuɣu.
en: You and your families will eat together at that place, and the Lord your God will be there with you. You will enjoy sharing the things you worked for there. You will remember that the Lord your God blessed you and gave you these good things.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe Omri nyaaŋa daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe Ginat bia Tibini nyaaŋa, ka Tibini daa kpi; ka Omri leei naa.
en: Omris side was stronger than those who followed Tibni, Ginaths son. So Tibni died and Omri became king.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ leei binshɛli din bie, ka mali dabiɛm dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa sani, ka nya filiŋ mini ansarisi malibo ni turi, ka noli ni di ba n ni kari ba tahi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: I will make them an object of horror and evil to all the kingdoms of the earth. Wherever I scatter them, they will be disgraced and insulted, mocked and cursed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni ŋ-ŋmaai nimaani wain tia wala yilli, ka niriba ayi zaŋ li pa dapua zuɣu buɣira; ka bɛ daa lan ʒi pumpɔrinchihi mini fiig tia wala gba na.
en: Then the men went to Eshcol Valley. There they cut off a branch from a grapevine that had a bunch of grapes on it. They put that branch on a pole, and two men carried it between them. They also carried some pomegranates and figs.

dag: ni yi di chɛ ka n ti be yi sani ka yi muɣisi ma ni n wuhi dɔbilim, dama m mi ni n ni tooi wuhi n dɔbilim ni nyɛ shɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhiri ni ti dolila dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ka mal li kuuni la sani.
en: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa bɔhi Yisa, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdib yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: The disciples asked Jesus, Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say that Elijah must come before the Messiah does.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kul maari bɛn suhuri saɣindi suhuri ŋɔ daa maai ti suhuri Taitus kandina la zuɣu.
en: But God, who encourages the downhearted, encouraged us with the coming of Titus.

dag: Biŋkpil shɛŋa din daa tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu zɔŋ ni la daa nyɛla paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi, ka di dubu pooi mita ayi biɛla.
en: The capitals on top of the columns were shaped like flowers.

dag: Yi dunia ŋɔ ni bebu puuni, yi mali yi suhu ni bɔri binshɛɣukam ka diri nyaɣisim pam. Yi dihi yimaŋa ŋ-ŋmɛlim kaman biŋkɔbiri bɛn ʒe n-guli bɛ kɔrigibu dali.
en: Your life here on earth has been full of luxury and pleasure. You have made yourselves fat for the day of slaughter.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ. Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi.
en: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord , and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.

dag: O darigiri bɛ tibili ka niriba nyara bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu;.
en: He punishes sinners where all can see it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Sara maligu shee alahichi yɛn ʒila a min a bidibisi ni a yaannim zuliya bɛn be a sani zuɣu; ka maligumaanitali alahichi ʒi a min a bidibisi maa kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Aaron, You, your sons, and all the people in your fathers family must bear the responsibility for any wrong that is done against the holy place or against the priests.

dag: Dama n ni tibi yi dansi maa, ka tin ya alaafee, dama bɛ lihi ya la bɛn ka so. Ziɔn ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ bɛ baɣa ka maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make you well again; I will heal your wounds, though your enemies say, Zion is an outcast; no one cares about her. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: Joab went to talk with the woman. She asked him, Are you Joab? Joab answered, Yes, I am. Then the woman said, Listen to me. Joab said, I am listening.

dag: O daa suhi Naawuni, ka Naawuni daa wum o fabila ka deeg o suhigu maa, ka daa lan zaŋ o labisi Jɛrusalɛm nti niŋ o nam maa ni yaha. Di saha ka Manaasa daa baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: He prayed, and God was moved by his request. God listened to Manassehs prayer and restored him to his rule in Jerusalem. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was the true God.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna maa yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: At every Passover Festival the Roman governor was in the habit of setting free any one prisoner the crowd asked for.

dag: Di saha ka Barakɛl bia Ɛlihu suhu daa yiɣisi. O daa nyɛla Buz daŋ ni nira, ka yi Ram malibu ni na. O suhu daa yiɣisimi bahi Ayuba zuɣu, o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali, amaa ni Naawuni m-mali taali la zuɣu.
en: But there was a young man there named Elihu son of Barakel. He was a descendant of a man named Buz. Elihu was from the family of Ram. He became very angry because Job kept saying he was innocent—that he was right and God was wrong.

dag: maa ŋunkam nyu ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada; dama ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa ni leei nyɛvili din ka bahigu kɔbilisirim o pul ni.
en: but those who drink the water that I will give them will never be thirsty again. The water that I will give them will become in them a spring which will provide them with life-giving water and give them eternal life.

dag: di saha n tahima maa lee be ya? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn nya n tahima maa?.
en: Where is there any hope for me? Who sees any?.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku tiŋgbani leei zaɣ kuŋ, ka o niriba daa chaŋ bɛ naba zuɣu mɔɣili tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du. Ka ti daa mali suhupiɛlli o sani nimaani.
en: He changed the sea to dry land, and his people went across the water on foot. So lets celebrate because of what he has done!.

dag: ni teebul la mini di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi.
en: the table with its poles and all its equipment, the bread of the presence.

dag: Bɛ daa lan bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri duu maa yuya lee booni bɔ.
en: Give us the names of the workers.

dag: Yawɛ dimnim ni chɛrisichɛrisi. Zallakudura Naa ni be alizanda ni ka tahi bɛ zuɣu na. Yawɛ ni kari dunia ŋɔ nim zaa saria. O ni ti o naa yaa, ka ti o ninvuɣ gahindili yiko.
en: The LORD! His enemies are terrified! God thunders against them from heaven! The LORD! He judges the far corners of the earth! May God give strength to his king and raise high the strength of his anointed one.

dag: Anab ŋuni ka yi yaannim maa daa lee bi niŋ alaka? Bɛna n-daa ku Naawuni ni daa tim o daanab shɛb bɛn daa daŋ na ni bɛ ti moli ŋun Naawuni wuntialana kandina molo la, ka yi mi yi o nyaaŋa ku o.
en: Was there a single prophet your ancestors didnt harass? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the righteous one, and youve betrayed and murdered him!.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko pam nam zuɣusaa mini dunia. Binshɛli kani din kpɛm nyaŋ a.
en: Lord GOD, with your great power you made the earth and the sky. There is nothing too hard for you to do.

dag: Ti ni nya piɛri mini niɣi n-ku n-ti ba ka di saɣi ba? Bee ti yi gbahi teeku zahim zaa ti ba, di ni saɣi ba.
en: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.

dag: Ka yi ni so miri ka o nyɛ ŋun kuri niriba bee tayiɣa bee tuumbiɛ tumda bee ŋun kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-nyari wahala di zuɣu.
en: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.

dag: Ijiptinim ni tiri niriba sɔŋsim shɛli ka buchi, dinzuɣu man ni pa Ijipti yupaa m-bol li la Rahab ŋun nyɛ ʒinahigulana.
en: That useless nation is Egypt. Egypts help is worth nothing, so I call Egypt the Do-Nothing Dragon.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl zoya anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the mountains of Israel.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Ɛgilɔn gari chaŋ Hiburɔn ti liri ba.
en: Joshua and his army left Eglon and attacked Hebron.

dag: Dama Masia n-chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ʒiɛmani zan tariga ni di chɛ ka ŋunkam niŋ yɛda yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Christ ended the law so that everyone who believes in him is made right with God.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabi kam maŋmaŋ yanim pun bi deer o.
en: Then he said, The truth is, a prophet is not accepted in his own hometown.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yuri ka tum alahichi, o yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee tinzun nira, o mola Yawɛ maa, di simdi ni bɛ ku dilana.
en: But any who sin deliberately, whether they are natives or foreigners, are guilty of treating the Lord with contempt, and they shall be put to death.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Tɛra maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mitika.
en: They left Terah and camped at Mithcah.

dag: Ka Sisɛra yɛl o, Ʒe dunoli maa ni. So yi ti kana ti bɔh a ni so be kpe, nyin yɛlim o ni so kani.
en: Then he told her, Stand at the door of the tent, and if anyone comes and asks you if anyone is here, say no.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila Anakinima, ka niriba booni ba Rɛfaimnima, amaa Mɔabnim daa booni ba la Ɛmimnima.
en: Like the Anakim they were also known as Rephaim; but the Moabites called them Emim.

dag: N niriba ni ti be suhudoo mini alaafee ni vuhim ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: My people will be safe in their homes and in their calm, peaceful fields.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, zanimiya baalim nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tiliginsim tuun shɛli tin ya zuŋɔ; dama yi ni nya Ijipti ninvuɣ shɛb zuŋɔ ŋɔ, yi nini ku lan nya ba yaha.
en: But Moses answered, Dont be afraid! Dont run away! Stand where you are and watch the Lord save you today. You will never see these Egyptians again.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa pahi buyi yɛli.
en: The LORD spoke to me again.

dag: N tumdila m Ba ni zali ma shɛm ni dunianim baŋ ni n yuri m Ba maa. Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ kpe ha.
en: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.

dag: Sool ni daa ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee, o daa tuh o dimnim bɛn be bɔba ni yaɣa ni zaa. O daa tuhi Mɔabnim mini Ammɔnnima ni Ɛdomnima ni Zɔba nanima ni Filistianima; o ni daa tuhi shɛb zaa, o daa dila nasara.
en: After Saul became king of Israel, he fought all his enemies everywhere: the people of Moab, of Ammon, and of Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he fought he was victorious.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When it was evening, Jesus and his disciples went outside the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni yi ti shɛb azichi mini nɛma, ka chɛ ka bɛ deei bɛ tarili n-di bɛ tuma nyaɣisim, Naawuni pini m-bala.
en: Suppose you are very rich and able to enjoy everything you own. Then go ahead and enjoy working hard—this is God's gift to you.

dag: Ka yi ti di bindir kura hal ni saha shɛli, ka yi ni ti kɔrigila bindir kura ka su zaɣ pala.
en: You will have enough crops to last for more than a year. You will harvest the new crops. But then you will have to throw out the old crops to make room for the new crops.

dag: N ni daa kul lihiri yila maa, ka n ti nya yilibila ka di daai yil ata shɛŋa din daa pun saya la n-vuɣ li bahi, ka puhi yina. Yilibil maa daa malila nina ka di be kaman ninsal nina la, ka mali noli ka di tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: I was staring at the horns when, suddenly, another small horn came up between them. Three of the earlier horns were ripped out to make room for it. On this new horn were eyes like human eyes and a mouth that bragged and bragged.

dag: Ka Yisa daa saɣisi ba yɛli ni bɛ di chɛ ka so wum li; ka yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma ni bɛ tim bia maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: But Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone what had happened. Then he said, Give her something to eat.

dag: Ka bɛ yi di daa bi pun baŋ wuntia soli yɛla, di naan so n-gari bɛ baŋ li ka lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni zaligu kasi shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: It would have been much better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than to know it and then turn away from the sacred command that was given them.

dag: Yilimiya yila niŋ o. Yilimiya yila paɣ o. Yɛlimiya o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: Sing to God; sing praises to the Lord; dwell on all his wondrous works!.

dag: Fɔntinsi ŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni me goon wɔɣila gili tin shɛŋa, ka di mali dunoyɔriti din mali kpiɔŋ ni dunokparitisi m-pahi tiŋkpansi pam zuɣu.
en: Each of these towns was fortified with high walls, double gates, and crossbars. Outside the towns there were also a great number of villages.

dag: Naawuni daa bi tiligi malaika shɛb bɛn daa tuui tum alahichi la, amaa o daa zaŋ ba bahila buɣim biɛhigu shee n-lo ba zoligɔnim zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali.
en: God didnt spare the angels when they sinned but cast them into the lowest level of the underworld and committed them to chains of darkness, keeping them there until the judgment.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ yɛli Baruk, Yɛlim ti a ni niŋ shɛm sabi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa. Jɛrimia n-daa yɛr a yɛtɔɣa maa ka a sabira.
en: Then they asked him, Tell us, now, how did you come to write all this? Did Jeremiah dictate it to you.

dag: A zaŋ a niriba kɔhi alaha, a bi zali ba da kpiɔŋ.
en: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di ku ba. A ni ku a ni zaŋ a takɔb min a tɔbu n-gbahi shɛb leeg a daba? Bomi la bindirigu ti ba ka bɛ di ka nyu kom, ka lab bɛ naa sani.
en: No, he answered. Not even soldiers you had captured in combat would you put to death. Give them something to eat and drink, and let them return to their king.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Moses prayed.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n yi tam a yɛla, n nudirigu din tammi di ni mi shɛli niŋbu.
en: May I never be able to play the harp again if I forget you, Jerusalem!.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin ni daa be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali ka Ivilmɛrɔdak daa leei Babilɔn naa, ka niŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yih o sarika ni.
en: Later, Evil Merodach became the king of Babylon. He let King Jehoiachin of Judah out of prison. This happened in the th year after Jehoiachin was captured. This was on the th day of the twelfth month from the time that Evil Merodach began to rule.

dag: Ka do so daa nya o ka yɛli Jɔab, Nyama, n nyala Absalom ka o yili oki tia zuɣu.
en: Someone saw this happen and told Joab, I saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree.

dag: Amaa nyin Izraɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, nyin Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ n ni pii so, ka lan nyɛ n zo Ibrahimma zuliya ŋɔ;.
en: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.

dag: N daa lihi zoya zuɣu n-nya ka di sɔhirimi, ka daboya zaa daa chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa.
en: I looked at the mountains, and they were shaking. All the hills were trembling.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Sintani, wara! Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus answered, Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: Worship the Lord your God and serve only him. .

dag: Hal ninvuɣ pia puuni ninvuɣ yino yi kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni ku o gba. O ni bemi kaman oki ti shɛli bɛ ni ŋma n-luhi ka chɛ di tigbirigu. Tigbirigu maa nyɛla bimbirili din be kasi din ni lan zooi yaha.
en: Even if one-tenth remain there, they will be burned again, like a terebinth or an oak, which when it is cut down leaves a stump. Its stump is a holy seed.

dag: nti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo piɛɣu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o mali alahichi sanyoo sara luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la.
en: You must put your hand on the animals head and kill it as a sin offering in the place where people kill the burnt offering.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni ŋ-ŋmaai nimaani wain tia wala yilli, ka niriba ayi zaŋ li pa dapua zuɣu buɣira; ka bɛ daa lan ʒi pumpɔrinchihi mini fiig tia wala gba na.
en: They came to Eshcol Valley, and there they cut off a branch which had one bunch of grapes on it so heavy that it took two men to carry it on a pole between them. They also brought back some pomegranates and figs. .

dag: Anabi Hanania ni daa kabigi naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Some time after this the Lord told me.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam, ka o lo tɔbu n-tuhi Siria naa hal ti gbah o tɔbbihi maa pam.
en: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.

dag: Nimaani ka Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia daa zaŋ o kpari maa. Zɛdɛkia daa bɔh o mi, Bɔzuɣu ka a tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛra: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-deei li.
en: King Zedekiah had imprisoned me there and had accused me of announcing that the Lord had said, I am going to let the king of Babylonia capture this city.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla din pun beni, ka din yɛn beni nyɛla din pun beni. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mi din pun gari yɛla.
en: Whatever happens has already happened, and whatever will happen has already happened before. And God looks after what is driven away.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni taɣi yi mini yi bihi suhuri din ni chɛ ka yi yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa, ka lala ti chɛ ka yi be.
en: The Lord your God will give you and your descendants obedient hearts, so that you will love him with all your heart, and you will continue to live in that land.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya do so bee paɣ so ŋun tum tuumbiɛɣu maa ti zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini n-labi doo maa bee paɣa maa kuɣa ku o.
en: then you must bring out the man or woman who has done this evil thing to the gates of the city. Stone that person until he or she is dead.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ya tim tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm, ka nyɛ tiŋgban kuŋ puuni gari wɔɣ biɛri mini nɔnsi ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni. O daa chɛ ka kom yi chɛribo kuɣa ni na ka yi nyu.
en: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa dɔɣi Yisifu nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, Bahim ma ka n kuli n ya ni n yiŋa.
en: After the birth of Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Let me go, so that I can return home.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti niŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: The disciples did just as Jesus instructed them. They prepared the Passover.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ niriba biɛla tiligi takɔbi maa mini fifali ni ni alɔbo ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛli bɛ ni yɛn chaŋ zuliya shɛb sani maa, bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa, di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will let a few of them survive the war, the famine, and the diseases, so that there among the nations they will realize how disgusting their actions have been and will acknowledge that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa bo paɣiba ayi ti o ka o zaŋ ba dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi.
en: Jehoiada chose two wives for King Joash, and they bore him sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini niriba laɣiŋgu shee. Di saha ka Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa mir o la kana ni o ti gari nimaani, ka Bɔaz bol o, Zɔri, kamina kpe ti ʒini. Ka o daa kana ti ʒini.
en: In the meanwhile, Boaz had gone to the meeting place at the town gate and was sitting there when the other close relative came by. So Boaz invited him to come over and sit down, and he did.

dag: Ka bunsi daa nyɛ tuhi pihita ni kɔbisinu. Ka Yawɛ zaka bunsi kalinli daa nyɛ bunsi pihiyɔbu.
en: The soldiers got , donkeys. They gave donkeys to the Lord .

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: For if you want to save your own life, you will lose it, but if you lose your life for my sake, you will save it.

dag: O ni ti lan chɛ ka yi ni daa zɔri Ijipti dɔr shɛŋa la zaa labina ti gbahi ya n-kul be yi ni.
en: Hell put on you all the Egyptian diseases about which you were so afraid; they will stick to you!.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti Duuma ni bɔri ni yi be shɛm, ka kul tumdi din tiɣir o nini. Ka lan chɛ ka yi bebu ni tooi mali wala kaman tia la tuun suŋ balibu kam ni, ka yi kul ni zoori pahiri Naawuni baŋbu puuni.
en: Were praying this so that you can live lives that are worthy of the Lord and pleasing to him in every way: by producing fruit in every good work and growing in the knowledge of God.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa ni yihiri bindiri sun shɛŋa zaa na nyɛla a ni chɛ ka na shɛb su ti maa dini ti daalahichi zuɣu. Bɛna n-lan su ti niŋgbuna yiko zaŋ tabili ti binnɛma n-niŋdi bɛ suhuyubu, ka ti be nandahima pam ni.
en: Its produce profits the kings whom you have placed over us because of our sins. They have power over our bodies and do as they please with our livestock. We are in great distress.

dag: Ka Judas daa bɔh o, N Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka a ni kahig amaŋ wuhi ti, ka ku kahig amaŋ wuhi dunianim bɛna.
en: Judas asked, Lord, why are you about to reveal yourself to us and not to the world.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni, yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Stay alert and pray so that you wont give in to temptation. The spirit is eager, but the flesh is weak.

dag: dama tuma so titali ka n nya kpe, ka sɔguriba pam mi lee beni.
en: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.

dag: Ka Leeban daa zaŋ o dɔɣiriba pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kari Yaakubu naba daba ayopɔin hal ti mir o zoya ni tiŋ shɛli din yuli daa booni Giliad maa.
en: So he gathered his men together and began to chase Jacob. After seven days Laban found Jacob near the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Yurilim bi naara; amaa di yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa yɛla, di gba nyɛla din garita.
en: Love is eternal. There are inspired messages, but they are temporary; there are gifts of speaking in strange tongues, but they will cease; there is knowledge, but it will pass.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yi bi sɔŋ a, wula ka man ni tooi sɔŋ a? M malila chi bee wain.
en: The king said, No! May the LORD help you! Where can I find help for you? From the threshing floor or the winepress.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi ni mali karimbaan shɛli nyuri bara maa, ka chɛ ka yi sagbana mi be kaman kurigu la.
en: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buta yaha, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma? Ka Pita suhu saɣim o ni bɔh o m-pahi buta ni o yur o maa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, N Duuma, a mi binshɛɣukam zaa; a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: A third time Jesus said, Simon, son of John, do you love me? Peter was sad because Jesus asked him three times, Do you love me? He said, Lord, you know everything. You know that I love you! Jesus said to him, Take care of my sheep.

dag: ka di dolibu zuɣu chɛ ka n daa niŋ cheechi alaka. Ka ninsal ni ni doli Yɛhudianim zaligunim ka tooi mali wuntia biɛhigu shɛli di zuɣu la puuni, n daa ka taali.
en: and I was so zealous that I persecuted the church. As far as a person can be righteous by obeying the commands of the Law, I was without fault.

dag: Yi tuumbiɛri n-chɛ ka m-mɔŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnima, ka yi daalahichi mɔŋ ya din viɛla.
en: Your wrongdoing has turned these blessings away. Your sin has robbed you of good.

dag: So ni tooi baŋ saa ni kuri shɛm bee saa tahigu din yiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni na?.
en: No one knows how the clouds move or how the thunder roars through the sky, where God dwells.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, A bi yɛn mali tiŋgbani bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bee m-mali tarili bɛ sani. Mani n-nyɛ a tarili ni a ni su shɛli Izraɛlnim sani.
en: The LORD said to Aaron: You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have a share among them. I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka buɣim di Magɔg mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi teeku noli ni alaafee la, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live securely in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Yi daa tam tampiŋ din dɔɣi ya yɛla, ka daa tam Naawuni ŋun dɔɣi ya yɛla.
en: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka malaika so ŋun daa pun yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa la kana ti zani, ka malaika so daa ka o sanna.
en: Then I saw the angel who had been speaking to me step forward, and another angel came to meet him.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa ka bɔhir o, Bɔ ka ti yɛn nyu.
en: The people began complaining to Moses. They said, Now what will we drink.

dag: Amaa tinim kul ku nyu bara yaɣi di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga; ti kul ni ʒiɛla Naawuni ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm tariga la puuni hal ni zaŋ chaŋ yi gba sani.
en: We wont take pride in anything more than what is appropriate. Lets look at the boundaries of our work area that God has assigned to us. Its an area that includes you.

dag: Yawɛ suhu piɛl o niriba zuɣu pam. O tiri bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ nasara.
en: The Lord takes pleasure in his people; he honors the humble with victory.

dag: Ribɛka daa mali tizɔdoo ka o yuli booni Leeban. Ka Leeban daa guui yi n-chaŋ nachin kpɛm maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.
en: Now Rebecca had a brother named Laban, and he ran outside to go to the well where Abraham's servant was.

dag: Yi yinsi nyɛla tampima voya ni. Yi karimbaani n-yɔhim ya ka yi me yi yinsi maa tamla zoya zuɣu, ka ŋmaligi yɛli yimaŋa, Ŋuni n-lee ni siɣisi ti tiŋ na.
en: Your proud heart has tricked you— you who live in the cracks of the rock, whose dwelling is high above. You who say in your heart, Who will bring me down to the ground.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Di simdi ka yi zɔri Yawɛ ka tum tuma maa ni ʒiɛyimtali ni yi suhu zaa.
en: He instructed them, You must respect the LORD at all times, in truth, and with complete integrity.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri gba daa zo ka chɛ niriba pam ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia! Alizin biɛri maa daa mi ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia, dinzuɣu ka Yisa daa tahiri bɛ zuɣu ka bi tiri ba soli ni bɛ yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: Demons also went out from many people, screaming, You are the Son of God! Jesus gave the demons an order and would not let them speak, because they knew he was the Messiah.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa mirig o nina kpa Hazaɛl n-kul lihir o hal ka vi ti gbaag o. Ka Ilaisha kumda.
en: Elisha stared at him until Hazael was embarrassed, then Elisha began crying.

dag: Dindali maa, fabila ni ti galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman bɛ ni daa fabili Hadadirimɔn zuɣu Mɛgido vinvamli ni shɛm la.
en: On that day, the mourning in Jerusalem will be as great as the mourning of Hadad-Rimmon in the Megiddo Valley.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija puhi zan o sani ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then two men were there, talking with him. They were Moses and Elijah.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. M mi yi yurilim mini yi yɛda niŋbu ni yi ni tumdi shɛlikam n zuɣu zaŋ tabili yi daania niŋbu yɛla, ka lan mi yi pumpɔŋɔ tuma ni gari yi tuuli tuma shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: I know what you do. I know about your love, your faith, your service, and your patience. I know that you are doing more now than you did at first.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri n nasara dibu la suhuri paligi ka bɛ tahiri suhupiɛlli tahigu yɛri sahakam, Yawɛ ŋun bɔr o dabili nasara dibu ŋɔ galisiya pam.
en: To those who want the best for me, I wish them joy and happiness. May they always say, Praise the Lord , who wants what is best for his servant.

dag: Ka Leeban daa zaŋ o dɔɣiriba pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kari Yaakubu naba daba ayopɔin hal ti mir o zoya ni tiŋ shɛli din yuli daa booni Giliad maa.
en: so Laban took his brothers with him, chased Jacob for seven days, and caught up with him in the mountains of Gilead.

dag: Ka lan yɛli niriba, M Ba Naawuni zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ n nuu ni. Ka so ʒi Naawuni Bia maa naɣila o Ba maa m-mi o; ka so mi ʒi Ba maa naɣila o Bia maa m-mi o m-pahi Bia maa ni kahigi Ba maa wuhi so.
en: My Father has given me all things. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.

dag: Ka daa yihi niriba maa ni bɔri do so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu o duŋ taabu min o ninvuɣ kubo zuɣu la bahi, ka zaŋ Yisa ti ba ni bɛ niŋ o bɛ ni bɔri shɛm.
en: He set free the man they wanted, the one who had been put in prison for riot and murder, and he handed Jesus over for them to do as they wished.

dag: Bi so ŋun bɔri yɛm, o tirila o ba bee o ma suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun doli pagɔra ni bahi o buni yoli.
en: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.

dag: Wula ka yi zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni, ka tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun be naŋgbantom ni nyɛvili?.
en: Why must a suffering person continue to live? Why let anyone live such a bitter life?.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul kuhirimi ni n suhu zaa, garigim ma, n ni dol a zaligunima.
en: Lord , I call to you with all my heart. Answer me, and I will obey your laws.

dag: Man yɛn bela Mizipa n-ʒe yi zaani Babilɔnnim bɛn yɛn ka kpe na sani. Amaa yinim kul benya yi ni be tin shɛŋa ni maa, ka tɔɣimiya wain mini kpam, ka pɔhiri tiwala n-zaŋdi li niŋdi binyara ni zaana.
en: I myself will stay in Mizpah and be your representative when the Babylonians come here. But you can gather and store up wine, fruit, and olive oil, and live in the villages you occupy.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ o tuma zuɣulaannim yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Zadok bia Azaria n-daa nyɛ maligumaana.
en: These are the names of his leading officials: Azariah son of Zadok was the priest;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa ti kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord , died at the age of years.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe Babilɔn, ka ŋunkam ti ʒe li ni tiɣi. Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: The enemy will take all the wealth from the Chaldeans. The soldiers will take all they want. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali sania balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ karili mini zaɣ bila yi kola ni.
en: Dont use weights that are too heavy or too light.

dag: Paɣ bi simdi ni o ye doo situra, ka doo gba bi simdi ka o ye paɣ situra, dama ŋunkam niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima, di nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that.

dag: A mini bɛn zɔri bɛ naba zuɣu yi zɔri ka di wum a, wula ka a mini yuri ni tooi kpaɣi zo? Ka a yi ku zani viɛnyɛliŋga palo ni, wula ka a lee yɛn tooi zani viɛnyɛliŋga Jɔɔdɛn nyɔŋ puuni?.
en: If you have raced with people and are worn out, how will you compete with horses? If you fall down in an open field, how will you survive in the forest along the Jordan?.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira jɛnd o kpee, dilan ŋmanila tɔbutuhiri guliŋguɣu bee takɔbi bee piɛm din dira.
en: People who testify falsely against their neighbors are like a club, sword, and sharpened arrow.

dag: N wahala ŋɔ mini n ni ka kpɛhili shee ŋɔ yɛla tɛha tomi kaman binsom la.
en: Remember, I am very sad, and I have no home. Remember the bitter poison that you gave me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim naŋgban yini ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Gibianima.
en: Everyone agreed that Gibeah had to be punished.

dag: Yɛm kuhiri pampam solɔri zuɣu, o duhir o yee niriba laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.

dag: Ka Pɛntikɔst Chuɣu dali daa ti paai, ka Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim luɣ yini.
en: When Pentecost Day arrived, they were all together in one place.

dag: Molimi molo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka mol li Migidol. Molimi li Mɛmfisi mini Tapanhɛs. Yɛlim ba, Zanimiya yi zaashɛhi, ka maliya shili, dama tɔbu ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa gili ya.
en: Tell Egypt, warn Migdol, alert Memphis and Tahpanhes! Say: Brace yourselves for whats coming. War is breaking out from every side.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya paya. Zɛbulɔn niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab.
en: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its , troops.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila wɔhu chɛmi; ka piɛgul yɛtɔɣ ŋaha mi ŋmani kuriti kpa shɛŋa bɛ ni kpahi ka di kpaŋ zani.
en: The words of the wise are like iron-tipped prods; the collected sayings of the masters are like nails fixed firmly by a shepherd.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Mmaŋmaŋ ni ŋmaai sida tia wulikpani nyoli ni n-zaŋ li sa. N ni lan ŋmaai di wul polli din wɔɣa pam nyoli ni n-zaŋ li mmaŋmaŋa ti sa zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu.
en: Someday, I, the Lord , will cut a tender twig from the top of a cedar tree, then plant it on the peak of Israel's tallest mountain.

dag: O gbib o yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga; o pala vinnyaɣilana.
en: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.

dag: Ka Nɛri daa nyɛ Mɛlikai so bia, ka Mɛlikai maa nyɛ Addi bia, ka Addi nyɛ Kosam bia, ka Kosam nyɛ Ɛlimadam bia, ka Ɛlimadam nyɛ Ɛr bia.
en: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er.

dag: Mɔabnim suhuri kul ʒimi bɛ piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ. Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ wain shɛli le duɣu ni, ka bi kpaari li loori duɣu shɛl ni; ka so mi na bi gbahi ba daba chaŋ luɣ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ na kul mali binshɛlikam, ka bɛ binshɛli bi saɣim maa.
en: Moab has never known trouble. Moab is like wine left to settle. Moab has never been poured from one jar to another. He has not been taken into captivity. So he tastes as he did before, and his smell has not changed.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti siɣis o bimbini maa zuɣu na. Ka o daa kana nti damdi lu Naa Sulemaana sizuura. Ka Sulemaana daa yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋa.
en: Then King Solomon sent some men to get Adonijah and brought him in. He approached the king and bowed before him. Then Solomon said, Go home.

dag: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa ka so bi lan mi o yɛla soli, luɣ shɛli neesim ni bemi kaman zibisim la. .
en: a land whose light is like gloom, utter darkness and confusion, such that light shines like gloom.

dag: ka daa kpihi buɣim din mali dabiɛm, ka daa tiligi takɔb kum ni. Bɛ daa nya kpiɔŋ bɛ gbariginsim saha. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhir biinsi bɛn tuhi nyaŋ tinzun tinsi tɔbbihi.
en: And some were able to stop blazing fires. Others escaped from being killed with swords. Some who were weak were made strong. They became powerful in battle and defeated other armies.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti chɛ ka yilli bili Izraɛl, ka n chɛ ka a tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa bɛ sani. Di saha ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: On that day I will make the family of Israel strong. So Ezekiel, I will let you speak to them. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyari ninsalinim zaa.
en: The Lord looked down from heaven and saw all the people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima, ka nyɛ n ni pii n dab shɛba ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ka niŋ ma yɛda. Ka lan baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. Naawuni so ka n tooni, ka so mi ka n nyaaŋa.
en: You are my witnesses, says the LORD, my servant, whom I chose, so that you would know and believe me and understand that I am the one. Before me no god was formed; after me there has been no other.

dag: ka hal malaikanim bɛn mali yaa mini kpiɔŋ gari karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ bi doli ʒiɛmbu soli fiɣisiri bɛn mali jilima maa ti Duuma sani.
en: yet angels, who are stronger and more powerful, dont use insults when pronouncing the Lords judgment on them.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ n ni yɛn sabi alikauli shɛli ti a la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ di yɔrigu maa yo di noli.
en: Put the two stone tablets inside the Box and put the lid on top of it.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, ti daa kpalim be nimaani la daba ata.
en: When we reached Jerusalem, we rested three days.

dag: n-chaŋ Taai birini la mini Hivinim ni Keenannim tinsi zaa ni. Ka bɛ daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ Nɛgɛb din be Juda tiŋgban ni Bɛrishiiba polo la.
en: They went to the fortress of Tyre and to all the towns of the Hivites and the Canaanites. They went out to Beer-sheba in the arid southern plain of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mɔabnim yɛliya, Judanim kul bemi kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Moab and Seir say, The family of Judah is just like any other nation.

dag: Zuŋɔ gba n fabila maa lan kɔŋla tim. Di mini n ŋuhibu ŋɔ zaa yoli, Naawuni na kul pahiri ma la biɛrim.
en: Today my complaint is again bitter; my strength is weighed down because of my groaning.

dag: Pallu zuliya n-daa nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: Pallu was the father of Eliab.

dag: Daadam, ŋah bɔ ka yi leei ŋahira zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo din yɛra, Dabisa maa yuuya, ka ʒii kam kpalim yoli.
en: Human one, what is this proverb of your people concerning Israels fertile land? They say, The days go by, and every vision vanishes.

dag: Bɛ ku saɣi doli sana, amaa bɛ ni zomi ka chɛ o, dama bɛ bi mi saamba kukoya.
en: They will not follow someone else; instead, they will run away from such a person, because they do not know his voice.

dag: Ka Lɛvi zuliya doo ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa ku so mam maa yɛli ba, M mini m mam n-daa chaŋ Gibia din nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋ la ni ni ti ti gbe.
en: So the Levite, the husband of the woman who had been murdered, told them the story. He said, My slave woman and I came to the city of Gibeah in the area of Benjamin. We spent the night there.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya, Yi ni niŋdi shɛli ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla dini.
en: Your children will ask you, What are we celebrating.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba zaa daa mali suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ tiŋ maa daa maai bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku Atalia nayili puuni maa nyaaŋa.
en: All the people were filled with happiness, and the city was quiet, now that Athaliah had been killed in the palace.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi Kiburɔtihataava maa n-chaŋ Hazɛrɔt.
en: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.

dag: Ti zaŋmiya ti viɛla wala mini abie tihi vari ni ti shɛŋa din mali vari wulikpana ni kul tihi na di piligu dali maa nti wuhi yi suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: On the first day you must take fruit from majestic trees, palm branches, branches of leafy trees, and willows of the streams, and rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days.

dag: Ka Giliad kpamba maa yɛli Jɛfita, Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti ka a sanna pumpɔŋɔ maa. Ti bɔrimi ni a kana ti pahi ti zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka a leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: They said to Jephthah, We are turning to you now because we want you to go with us and fight the Ammonites and lead all the people of Gilead.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yo Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ dunoya, ka kpihi di puuni firilanima, ka daa bi lan tuɣindi tulaale zim bee m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la luɣ kasi shee la tiri Izraɛlnim Naawuni.
en: They even closed the doors of the entrance hall, snuffed out the lamps, and stopped burning incense and offering entirely burned offerings in the sanctuary of the God of Israel.

dag: Kum chɛ ka bɛ lan ka yaa, ka barina do n-gu ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ tuui.
en: Disaster is hungry for them. Ruin stands close by, waiting for them to fall.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, N dana, a daa po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani yɛli, A bia Sulemaana ni ti di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: She said to him, Your Majesty, you swore by the LORD your God to your servant, Your son Solomon will certainly rule after me. He will sit on my throne.

dag: Bɛ ni niriba anu daa nyɛla yɛnnima, ka niriba anu la mi nyɛ jɛra.
en: Now five of them were wise, and the other five were foolish.

dag: Bin viɛla kul palila yɛndan yiŋa, amaa jɛrigu ŋun dirila di zaa.
en: Precious treasure and oil stay in the home of the wise, but fools swallow them up.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi wuntampuhili saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early on that day, the first day of the week, the women were going to the tomb. It was very early after sunrise.

dag: Wummi alikauli yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Listen to the terms of the covenant. Tell the people of Judah and of Jerusalem.

dag: So yi zaŋ o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli ti Yawɛ, dindina di daa yɛn dolila di ni yɛn tooi deei bimbira shɛm. Pal shɛli din ni biri siŋkaafa tah ayi daa ni nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: If any of you dedicate part of your land to the Lord , the price shall be set according to the amount of seed it takes to sow it, at the rate of ten pieces of silver per bushel of barley.

dag: Man Pool ŋun zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba puhiri ya.
en: Heres my greeting in my own handwriting— Paul .

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ni o binyɛri bɔribɔri n-kpɛhi naa sani; ka o zɔnim bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi dol o.
en: In her colorful gown she is led to the king, followed by her bridesmaids, and they also are brought to him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka a zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa samban ni na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Bring the bull to the front of the Tent of my presence and tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on its head.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-mali duu maa puuni zaa mini bimbin shɛli din be du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee la zuɣu hal ka duu maa malibu tuma ti naai.
en: He overlaid the whole temple inside with gold until the temple was completely covered. He covered the whole altar that was in the inner sanctuary with gold.

dag: Naawuni ŋɔ soli nyɛla din be tibi. Yawɛ daalikauli niŋdi pali. O nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zɔr kpɛr o yuli.
en: God! His way is perfect; the LORDs word is tried and true. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

dag: Doo maa yi di pala Naawuni nira, o naan ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: This man must be from God. If he were not from God, he could not do anything like this.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa zaa daa niŋ nia ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa. Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi polo Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la zuɣusaa, Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent.

dag: Gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili ka chɛ ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: Keep the Sabbath day and treat it as holy, exactly as the LORD your God commanded.

dag: Ka naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, Yɛlimaŋli, a Naawuni maa shiri nyɛla ŋun gari wuna zaa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa Duuma ni ŋun kahigiri ashiya wuhiri niriba. Lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka a tooi kahig ashili ŋɔ gbinni wuhi ma maa.
en: The king said, Now I know that your God is above all other gods and kings, because he gave you the power to explain this mystery.

dag: Ka Balak daa zaŋ Balaam ti du n-tam Pɛɔr Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli nir ni ni tooi zani ka lihi nya bɔpiɛligu maa ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So he took Balaam to Mount Peor overlooking the desert north of the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒi nimaani maa zaa mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka nya o ninni ka di ŋmanila malaika ninni.
en: Everyone seated in the council stared at Stephen, and they saw that his face was radiant, just like an angels.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ alɔbo shɛŋa mini jɛŋgbar shɛb bɛn bahi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yoli maa kɔtomsi, ka di lan simdi ni yi ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa jilima, di pa shɛli o ku lan darigi yi mini yi buɣa ni yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tibili yaha.
en: So make models of the tumors and models of the mice that are ruining the country. Give these gold models to the God of Israel as payment. Then maybe the God of Israel will stop punishing you, your gods, and your land.

dag: Bɛ sahi li mi ni bɛ ku niriba, ka so n-neei li ni di nyaɣisira kaman saa nyaɣisibu la. Yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga mini tibidarigibo kam zaa, wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: For utter slaughter it is sharpened, polished to flash like lightning. Lets not rejoice, because no one will escape the purge.

dag: O shɛrila tan piɛla binyɛra kɔhira, ka maani shɛlɔriti kɔhiri kɔhigɔriba zuɣu.
en: She makes garments and sells them; she supplies sashes to traders.

dag: Saha paaya ni yi me yimaŋmaŋ yinsi n-kpe n-doya ka chɛ ka man jɛmbu duu lu n-dahim doya?.
en: Is it time for you to dwell in your own paneled houses while this house lies in ruins?.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni zaligu malaikanim nuu ni, amaa ka lee bi dol li.
en: You are the people who received Gods law, which he gave you through his angels. But you dont obey it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa kuli; ka salo daa lan laɣim o sani hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ bindirigu dibu.
en: Then Jesus went home, but again a large crowd gathered there. There were so many people that he and his followers could not eat.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti ti bidibisi.
en: We wont give our daughters in marriage to the neighboring peoples, nor take their daughters in marriage for our sons.

dag: Wulipolli ni ti puhi yi Jɛsi gbirili ni na. Wulli ni ti to n-yi o nyaɣa ni na n-wali.
en: The royal line of David is like a tree that has been cut down; but just as new branches sprout from a stump, so a new king will arise from among David's descendants.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei ka teeku maa kom maa lan nahi taba, ka Ijiptinim maa daa yɛn zo n-yi dini, ka Yawɛ daai ba niŋ teeku maa bulli ni.
en: Moses stretched out his arm, and at daybreak the water rushed toward the Egyptians. They tried to run away, but the Lord drowned them in the sea.

dag: Ka o di yɛl a baŋsim ashili yɛtɔɣa! Dama baŋsim mali yaɣa pam. Baŋmi ni Naawuni ni darig a tibili shɛm ŋɔ bi paag a ni tum taali shɛm.
en: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.

dag: Yi yi di be n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, n gba naan tooi yɛli kaman yi ni yɛri shɛm ŋɔ. N naan tooi yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa pam, ka vili n zuɣu niŋ ya.
en: If you were in my place and I in yours, I could say everything you are saying. I could shake my head wisely and drown you with a flood of words.

dag: ni Bɛngɛba ŋun daa be Ramɔtigiliad la.
en: Bengeber: the city of Ramoth in Gilead, and the villages in Gilead belonging to the clan of Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, and the region of Argob in Bashan, sixty large towns in all, fortified with walls and with bronze bars on the gates.

dag: M biyurigu, di chɛ ka a bebu doli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa chɛ ka a bebu dolila din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyɛla ŋun mi Naawuni, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyɛla ŋun ʒi Naawuni.
en: My dear friend, dont follow what is bad; follow what is good. Whoever does what is good is from God. But whoever does evil has never known God.

dag: Amaa man kul ni lihirila Yawɛ. N ni guhirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligir ŋɔ. N Naawuni ni wum n suhigu.
en: But I will watch for the Lord ; I will wait confidently for God, who will save me. My God will hear me.

dag: Ti bi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali ti shɛm tariga ti ni daa ka yi sanna la puuni; dama tinima n-nyɛ bɛn daa tuui zaŋ Masia lahibal suŋ na ti tin ya.
en: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi nahindi n niriba ka diri tarimba zuɣu nyɔri? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n yɛli lala maa.
en: How dare you crush my people and grind the faces of the poor? says the LORD God of heavenly forces.

dag: Mɛtusɛla daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinyinika, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Methuselah lived years, and he died.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di lihibu daa mali dabiɛm hal ka Anabi Musa ti yɛli, N ni sɔhirimi dabiɛm zuɣu.
en: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, I am trembling and afraid.

dag: Ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi ni ti deela o ni tum din bi tuhi shɛli maa laara; dama Naawuni bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: But evildoers will receive their reward for their evil actions. There is no discrimination.

dag: ka fiɛb o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: After torturing him, they will kill him. On the third day, he will rise up.

dag: nti nya Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa, ka o naba tiŋli daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa safaya la mal li. Di daa kul nɛmi kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka zuɣusaa ne shɛm la.
en: and they saw the God of Israel. Beneath his feet was what looked like a pavement of sapphire, as blue as the sky.

dag: Di saha ka yi dol o na ka o ti ʒini n nam ʒiishee, dama ŋuna ka m pii ni o zani n zaani n-di nam su Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: Follow him back here when he comes to sit on my throne. He will succeed me as king, because he is the one I have chosen to be the ruler of Israel and Judah.

dag: So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi yi ni yɛn chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa nim zaa dabiɛm kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: No one will be able to stand against you. The Lord your God will make the people fear you wherever you go in that land. That is what he promised you before.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zaŋ di tɛha niŋ yila pia maa suhuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun Naawuni ni pun lo shɛm. Lala zuɣu ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ yiko zaa ti biŋkɔbigu la hal ni ŋun Naawuni yɛligu ti niŋ pali.
en: God put the idea in their minds to do what would complete his purpose. They agreed to give the beast their power to rule until what God has said is completed.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka o sapashin so ŋun gul o la n-ʒe n-guli dunɔdali, ka niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm saha shɛli naa ni daa ka o sanna la.
en: The king of Israel had put his chief officer in charge of the gate, but he died when the people trampled him as they rushed out of the city.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa daa balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ. Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o.
en: The man he had healed begged to go with him. But Jesus sent him away, saying.

dag: Ka ti daa ti yiɣisi ni n-yi biɛɣu paai Kiɔs n-naanyi yi biɛɣu paai Samɔs n-kaai biɛɣu paai Milɛtus.
en: The next day we came to a place near Chios, and the following day we reached Samos. The day after that we sailed to Miletus.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔri ni bɛ nya a.
en: Someone said to Jesus, Your mother and your brothers are standing outside. They want to see you.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi n-chani ti nya Hiburunim maa niriba ayi ni zabira, ka o daa yɛli bɛ ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ŋmɛr a mabia maa.
en: When Moses went out the next day, he saw two Hebrew men fighting with each other. Moses said to the one who had started the fight, Why are you abusing your fellow Hebrew.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti yɛl o, Mɛm a yili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ n-ʒi kpe, ka miri ka a yi kpe n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Then he sent for Shimei and said, Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and stay in the city. Dont leave to go anywhere else.

dag: Aripakishad daa nyɛla Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, who was the father of Eber.

dag: Amaa faɣiri dibu zuɣu yi zaŋdi bɛn mali taali bahira, ka lee mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli.
en: And if you pay them enough money, they will forgive a criminal. But they will not let good people be judged fairly.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lab Ɛnmishipat bɛ ni booni luɣ shɛli Kadɛshi la. Ka bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛk tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim mini Amɔrinim bɛn daa be Hazazɔntarima la zaa.
en: Then they turned around and came back to Kadesh . They conquered all the land of the Amalekites and defeated the Amorites who lived in Hazazon Tamar.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Di kpalim biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma yaha dama n labirila m Ba sani.
en: In a little while you will not see me any more, and then a little while later you will see me.

dag: Yi mi ni di daa nyɛla n daalaafee kalinsi zuɣu ka n daa be yi sani n-tuui yihi lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya;.
en: You know that I came to you the first time because I was sick. That was when I told the Good News to you.

dag: Siprɛs tihi ni ti bili zani gɔhi zaashee. Ka ti shɛli bɛ ni booni mitil la mi ti bili suligunyinyari zaashee. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ shihirili shɛli din ni beni sahakam ka ku vuui.
en: Large cypress trees will grow where there were thornbushes. Myrtle trees will grow where there were weeds. All this will happen to make the Lord known, to be a permanent reminder of his goodness and power.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun kɔŋko nyɛ yɛndan ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu Yisa Masia zuɣu! Ami!.
en: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ku tum tuumbiɛɣu; Kpiɔŋlan Naa ku ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli.
en: and he is never unfair.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ li na; ka o bɔhi ba, Ŋun daanfooni mini sabbu n-lee be di ni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini.
en: And they brought one. He said to them, Whose image and inscription is this? Caesars, they replied.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la n-garita.
en: Jesus of Nazareth is passing by, they told him.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa po pɔri ni bɛ ni gbibi alikauli maa, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni daalikauli maa ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Then he asked the people of Jerusalem and Benjamin to make that same promise and to obey the God their ancestors had worshiped.

dag: Ka Zakaria mini Aziɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhiɛl ni Unni ni Ɛliab ni Maasɛya ni Bɛnaaya daa nyɛ bɛn ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim kaman Alamɔt ŋmɛbu la.
en: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps tuned to the Alamoth.

dag: Dama mɔɣu ni ka o daa nya o, ka bɛ ni zaŋ paɣ so ti doo maa daa naan tooi kuhi ni bɛ sɔŋ o, amaa so daa kani ŋun ni fa o bahi.
en: Since the man met up with her in a field, the engaged woman may well have called out for help, but there was no one to rescue her.

dag: Yuun pisi zaa ka m be a yiŋa. N tum tuma ti a la yuun pinaanahi a bipuɣins ayi ŋɔ zuɣu; ka gul a biŋkɔbiri mi yuma ayɔbu; ka a taɣi n yɔri siɣimsiɣim bupia.
en: I worked years like a slave for you. For the first years I worked to win your two daughters. The last six years I worked to earn your animals. And during that time you changed my pay ten times.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti darigi bɛnkam zaa kpahi yaɣi dunɔbia zuɣu mini bɛnkam zaŋ damli dambu ni ŋarili soya bo nɛma pali bɛ dan yiŋ la tibili.
en: At that time I will punish all the people who jump over the threshold and those who fill their masters house with lies and violence.

dag: Ka gbani tiŋ kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, chɛli niriba ŋɔ daalahichi ŋɔ paŋ ba. O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka dii bahi.
en: He knelt down and cried out in a loud voice, Lord! Do not remember this sin against them! He said this and died.

dag: M be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je suhudoo sani n-yuui pam.
en: I have lived too long with those who hate peace.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi ka ku Yisa.
en: But the leading priests and older Jewish leaders told the people to ask for Barabbas to be set free and for Jesus to be killed.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya ka biriti maa leei bɛn tɔɣisira, ka bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni maa kpaŋ, ka gbariti chana, ka zoomba gba nina neei maa, ka bɛ daa tibigi Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ pam.
en: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel.

dag: Nir yi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o yiŋa, di ŋmanila noombila n-kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o tiɛɣu.
en: Anyone away from home is like a bird away from its nest.

dag: Teemi ni n saha bi waɣa; dama a nam ninsalinim zaa ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpira.
en: Remember how short my life is; remember that you created all of us mortal!.

dag: N daa yɛn malila sara, ka zuŋɔ n niŋ n ni daa po pɔri ni n niŋ shɛli maa.
en: I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa yi tɔb maa ni n-zo hal ni Shilo dindali maa, o daa dari tɔhi la o situra, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣ o zuɣu.
en: That same day a soldier from the tribe of Benjamin ran from the battlefront to Shiloh. He had torn his clothes and put dirt on his head to show his sorrow.

dag: Ka dindali maa nasara dibu suhupiɛlli maa daa leela suhugarigu dabisili Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa sani; dama bɛ daa wumya ni naa kumdila o bia maa kuli.
en: So the victory that day was turned into mourning for all the troops because they heard that day that the king was grieving for his son.

dag: Ka daa yɛli Aduna, Malimi buɣa ti ti ka di gul ti, dama ti bi lan mi Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti na maa ni kpalim shɛli.
en: They told Aaron, Make us gods that will lead us. As for this Moses who led us out of Egypt, we dont know whats happened to him! .

dag: Ka Ananias daa wum yɛligu ŋɔ ka dii lu n-kpi, ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛnkam zaa daa wum li.
en: As soon as Ananias heard this, he fell down dead; and all who heard about it were terrified.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Arid mini Naaman, ka Arid daŋ niriba nyɛ Aridnima; ka Naaman daŋ niriba nyɛ Naamannima.
en: The clans of Ard and Naaman traced their descent from Bela.

dag: Naɣila biŋkɔbiri ka ti daa zaŋ leei ti ni ŋme tɔb di shɛli m-pahi ti ni daa ŋme n-fa neen shɛŋa fɔntin shɛŋa ti ni daa dee la ni.
en: We took the livestock and plundered the towns.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka bɛ be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim ŋɔ ni ka lur a sizuura hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: so that your people may obey you all the time they live in the land which you gave to our ancestors.

dag: Siria tinsi ni zani dabari zaa. Mɔri ni be nimaani, ka niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubira, ka so ku kari ba.
en: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.

dag: ka yɛli, A ni yɛn kana ti paai shɛli tariga n-yɛn bɔŋɔ; di tirisi tooni. Kpe ka a kɔgbana din mali karimbaani maa yɛn zani.
en: and said, Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.

dag: O ni daa mali ti miriti Damaskus, o nini nyabu yim ka neesim shɛli yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gil o;.
en: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.

dag: Doo yi dɔni o do kpee kaman paɣ la, bɛ niriba ayi maa tum din chihira, ka di simdi ka bɛ ku bɛ niriba ayi maa, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.

dag: O daa di nam su Izraɛlnim la yuun pihinahi, o daa di nam ʒini Hiburɔn la yuma ayopɔin, ka ʒini Jɛrusalɛm mi yuun pihitanaata.
en: He reigned over Israel for forty years: seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n nya n ni suhiri bɔri shɛli ŋɔ, m bi zaɣisi ka Naawuni ti ma n suhu ni bɔri shɛli ŋɔ.
en: Why won't God give me what I ask? Why won't he answer my prayer?.

dag: Nyamiya, n ʒiɛla dunol ni n-niŋdi gaafara, ka ŋun wum n kukoli ka yooi, n ni kpe dilan sani ka m min o ti laɣim di.
en: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.

dag: N kamina ni n ti tuɣili bidibiga min o ba ni bipuɣiŋga min o ma ni paɣa min o yidana ma;.
en: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa miligi Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee maa. Datan mini Abiram ni bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bisarinsi ni bɛ bibihi daa yimina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni.
en: They withdrew from around the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. Then Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrance of their tents with their wives, children, and little ones.

dag: Ka Naomi daa bɔh o, Ya ka a lee nya di zaa lala? Ŋun puu ni ka a chaŋ ti yih a kayiha maa? Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun lihi nya a maa ni! Di saha ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi ni do so ŋun yuli booni Bɔaz la puu ni ka o chaŋ ti yihi kayiha maa.
en: Her mother-in-law asked her, Where did you gather all this grain? Where did you work? Bless the man who noticed you. Then Ruth told her who she had worked with. She said, The man I worked with today is a man named Boaz.

dag: Ti mabihi maa daa zaŋla Piɛbil la ʒim mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu n-nyaŋ o, dama bɛ daa bi zaɣisi kum di puuni.
en: They defeated him by the blood sacrifice of the Lamb and by the message of God that they told people. They did not love their lives too much. They were not afraid of death.

dag: Di ʒiɛmani maa ni naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha maa ka Dan zuliya niriba daa lihiri bɔri luɣ shɛli ni bɛ ʒini, dama Izraɛlnim ni daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab la, bɛ daa na bi ti ba bɛ tiŋgbani.
en: In those days there was no king in Israel. Also in those days the tribe of Dan was searching for a territory of their own to live in, since no permanent territory had been assigned to them among the tribes of Israel up to that point.

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Sɛraya ni Reelaya ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipa ni Biɣivai ni Rɛhum ni Baana n-daa labi kuli. Izraɛl niriba kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Their leaders were Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. This is the list of the clans of Israel, with the number of those from each clan who returned from exile:.

dag: Niŋmiya Yawɛ naani sahakam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa n-taɣiri ti ka chɛri zaɣ biɛɣu sahakam.
en: Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD is a rock for all ages.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ niriba zuɣulaannim ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na nti nya ka baŋ alahichi shɛli din tum zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Saul called his army officers together and said, We have to find out what sin has kept God from answering.
