dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shih o ni mali shɛlikam maa zaa pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: Try taking away everything he owns, and he will curse you to your face.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini di ni ka me a luɣ kasi shee ni bɛ jɛmd a ka yɛra.
en: They have lived in it and have built a sanctuary in honor of your name in it, saying.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu bela palɔni kaman zabiri pambu mini salima yɛri yɛbu bee situr viɛla yɛbu.
en: It is not fancy hair, gold jewelry, or fine clothes that should make you beautiful.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deei pipia maa a nuu ni nyu, di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di nyɛla talahi ni yi nyu li.
en: If they refuse to take the cup in your hand and drink from it, tell them: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: You must drink!.

dag: A daa zaŋ a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi shɛba a ni daa dɔɣi ti ma la m-mal a buɣa maa ni bɛ ŋubi, ka di be kaman a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli maa nyɛla yɛlibil la.
en: Then you took the sons and the daughters you had borne me and offered them as sacrifices to idols. Wasn't it bad enough to be unfaithful to me.

dag: Joɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɛmaya mini Gɔg ni Shimɛi.
en: These are the descendants of Joel from generation to generation: Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah. The Assyrian emperor, Tiglath Pileser, captured Beerah, a leader of the tribe, and deported him.

dag: O suhu daa lan yiɣisi bahi Ayuba zɔnim ata la gba zuɣu bɛ ni daa bi tooi garigi Ayuba maa zuɣu; hal bɛ ni daa yɛli ni Ayuba mali galimi maa zaa yoli.
en: Elihu was also angry with Jobs three friends because they could not answer him, and yet they still considered him guilty of doing wrong.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Pita mini Jɔn daa ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni kurig ata saha din nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naawuni jɛmbu saha la.
en: Peter and John were going up to the temple at three oclock in the afternoon, the established prayer time.

dag: N yura ŋmanila mɛɛr kpalambila m-pa m biha sunsuuni.
en: My lover is like the small bag of myrrh around my neck , lying all night between my breasts.

dag: ni Hazarigada ni Hɛshimɔn ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: Hazar-gaddah, Heshmon, Beth-pelet.

dag: mini yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ni ti tizɔpaɣa Afia ni Aakipus ŋun nyɛ ti tɔbbikpee la.
en: and the church that meets in your house, and our sister Apphia, and our fellow soldier Archippus:.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ mali wumpaɣibo sara, ka yili suhupiɛlli yila yɛl o tuma yɛla.
en: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.

dag: Ka tumo so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ Mikaya maa na yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa naala noli n-yɛli naa ni yu shɛm, a gba kul yɛlimila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ŋmani bɛ ni yino dini, ka nyɛ o yubu.
en: Meanwhile, the messenger who had gone to summon Micaiah said to him, Listen, the prophets all agree that the king will succeed. You should say the same thing they say and prophesy success.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa bɔri daliri shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisi luhi Yisa ka ku o, amaa ka daa lee bi nya di daliri.
en: The chief priests and the whole Council tried to find some evidence against Jesus in order to put him to death, but they could not find any.

dag: dama ŋunkam kul nyurila bihim nyɛla ŋun yɛm na bi goligi wuntia yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka o na kul nyɛla bia.
en: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.

dag: N ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim o mamanim maa ninni, ka so ti ku tooi fa o n nuu ni bahi.
en: I will strip her naked in front of her lovers, and no one will be able to save her from my power.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Fukumsi zaligunim zaa ni, din nyɛ kpɛma nyɛla, Izraɛlnima, wummiya! Ti Duuma Naawuni nyɛla Duuma yino.
en: Jesus replied, The most important one is Israel, listen! Our God is the one Lord.

dag: bee o tizɔpaɣ ŋun na ʒi doo, .
en: also for your unmarried sister, who is close to you because she isnt married—you may be polluted for her sake.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka salo maa zaa daa pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi bɛn mali suhukpeeni n-tim ba ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya takɔbiri chaŋ ti ku Jabɛshigiliadnima, hal kumiya paɣiba mini bihi gba.
en: So the Israelites sent , soldiers to the city of Jabesh Gilead. They told the soldiers, Go to Jabesh Gilead, and use your swords to kill everyone who lives there, even the women and children.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Aai, n nyɛla Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, dina n-chɛ ka n kana maa. Ka Jɔshua daa lu n-gbani zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura ka bɔh o, N dana, ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ niŋ.
en: He said, Neither! Im the commander of the LORDs heavenly force. Now I have arrived! Then Joshua fell flat on his face and worshipped. Joshua said to him, What is my master saying to his servant.

dag: Mbaye, dabisili maa ni ti nyɛla dabisi titali, ka di kpee kani. Di nyɛla Yaakubu suhusaɣiŋgu saha, amaa bɛ ni tilig o di ni.
en: This is a very important time for Jacob. This is a time of great trouble. There will never be another time like this, but Jacob will be saved.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: After him, their relatives made repairs: Binnui, Henadads son, ruler of half the district of Keilah.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ ba ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ di ba fali yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka bɛ leei bɛ ni su shɛba sahakam. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bɛna n-leei yi daba, amaa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim bɛna, di zaŋya ninkuunsi su taba.
en: and you may leave them as an inheritance to your children, whom they must serve as long as they live. But you must not treat any Israelites harshly.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti diri wahala ka tumdi ti yaa tariga, dama ti zaŋ ti tahima zaa niŋla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Tiligira, di bahi bamdi bɛn niŋ o yɛda la.
en: We hope in the living God, the Savior of all people. In particular, he is the Savior of all those who believe in him. This is why we work and struggle.

dag: Ti bi lan nyari ti shihira la yaha; anabi so lan kani, ka so bi mi di yuusim tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: All our sacred symbols are gone; there are no prophets left, and no one knows how long this will last.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa malibu tuma zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ mi daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa maani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ zaŋ li mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: Then the Levites paid the men who supervised the work on the Lord s Temple. And the supervisors paid the workers who repaired the Lord s Temple.

dag: A nya bɛ ni bɔhi ma biɛri, ka lɔri ma nia biɛ shɛŋa zaa shɛm.
en: You know every plot they have made against me.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa kpaag o laa ni dini m-bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili din galisi pam la ni, ka di kom nyuui zaa ni di mali soli ti wulimpuhili polo nanima.
en: Then the sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great Euphrates River. The river dried up, to provide a way for the kings who come from the east.

dag: Ka di mali goon titali din du pam ka mali dunoya pinaayi, ka malaikanim pinaayi ʒe dunoya maa ni, ka Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la yuya sab pa dunoya maa zuɣu;.
en: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa;.
en: Make chains of pure gold for the judgment pouch. These chains must be braided like a rope.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku ba sɔŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka shɛb mi diɛhi dansi do di solɔri zuɣu.
en: Their troops will fall wounded in the streets of Babylon.

dag: Kuɣa wurim bahi saha beni, ka kuɣa laɣisi sɔŋ saha beni. Tab nuhi tibu saha beni, ka tab nuhi tibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: for throwing stones and gathering stones, embracing and parting.

dag: Piimi noonsi balibu kam zaa, ka pii biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa, ka pii biŋgbamda balibu kam zaa. Bɛ zaa bɛba ayiyi ni kpe a sanna din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: Two of every kind of bird, animal, and creeping thing will come to you so that you might keep them alive.

dag: O ni yɛli ma, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba ni n Naawuni ni n tiliginsim tampiŋ.
en: He will say to me, You are my father. You are my God, my Rock, my Savior.

dag: Nyin Asiria naa, a piɛguliba gbihiya. A ninvuɣ zuɣuri ʒeei gom. A niriba wurimya be zoya zuɣu, ka so kani ŋun ni laɣim ba.
en: King of Assyria, your shepherds fell asleep. These powerful men are sleeping. And now your sheep have wandered away on the mountains. There is no one to bring them back.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali bɛ ni yɛn nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla. Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di dubu nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: He made the altar for entirely burned offerings out of acacia wood. The altar was square, seven and a half feet long and seven and a half feet wide. It was four and a half feet high.

dag: O ni daa bah o noli ka o zani di dunɔbia zuɣu n-kpuɣ o nuu gahi salo maa n-wuhi ni bɛ foma. Bɛ ni daa fo m-bahi ka o tɔɣisi ba Hiburuli ni yɛli:.
en: The commander told him he could speak, so Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the people. When they were quiet, he spoke to them in Aramaic:.

dag: Soli din kuni neesim biɛhigu shee lee be ya, bee zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli lee be ya.
en: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa puuni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi bee n-galim Naawuni ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: Even after all this, Job did not sin. He did not accuse God of doing anything wrong.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini teeku kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: Jesus answered, Why are you afraid? You dont have enough faith. Then he stood up and gave a command to the wind and the water. The wind stopped, and the lake became very calm.

dag: Bɛ kuhiri booni ma, Ti Naawuni, tinim Izraɛlnim mi a.
en: Even though they call me their God and claim that they are my people and that they know me.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira; cham ti niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa lee daŋ mali mahili zaɣ bila n-ti ma na, ka naanyi chaŋ ti mal a min a bidibiga maa mi dini.
en: Elijah said to the woman, Dont worry. Go home and cook your food as you said. But first make a small piece of bread from the flour that you have and bring it to me. Then cook some for yourself and your son.

dag: Timoti daa mali yu suŋ Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Listra mini Aikɔnium la sani.
en: The believers in the cities of Lystra and Iconium had only good things to say about him.

dag: Tin shɛli din daa ʒe yim la yipa ŋmanila pagɔrili! Yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali n-daa yi be di ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ ninvuɣ kuriba m-be di ni.
en: The city that once was faithful is behaving like a whore! At one time it was filled with righteous people, but now only murderers remain.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yɛn dolila Ar polo ti gari Mɔabnim tintariga.
en: Today you are crossing through the territory of Moab and Ar.

dag: di lan nyɛla paɣ so ŋun nya sɔrilim zaligu ni binshɛli ni yiri do so bee paɣ so tooni na zaa zaligu, ka lan nyɛ do so ŋun mini paɣ so ŋun na be daɣiri ni dɔni gba zaligu.
en: women during their menstruation, men or women with discharges, and men who have had sexual intercourse with an unclean woman.

dag: O daa laɣim teeku kom kaman luɣuluɣu ni kom la n-sɔŋ luɣ yini. O daa nam bula niŋ di biɛhigu shɛhi.
en: He gathered the ocean waters into a heap; he put the deep seas into storerooms.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa nya din niŋ maa, ka zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannima dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa.
en: The men who were caring for the pigs ran away and told the story in the fields and in the town.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa niŋ nia ni o me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ yuli jilima, ka me omaŋmaŋ nam yili.
en: King Solomon decided to build a temple where the Lord would be worshiped, and also to build a palace for himself.

dag: n-kpe bɛ tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li; dama yi Duuma NAAWUNI ni zaŋ li niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Then you should come out of your hiding place and take control of the city. The Lord your God will give you the power to win.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli nimaani yuli Masa ni Mɛriba, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ o taali, ka daa lan zahim Yawɛ yɛra, Amii Yawɛ be ti sani bee o kani.
en: The people had complained and tested the Lord by asking, Is the Lord really with us? So Moses named that place Massah, which means testing and Meribah, which means complaining.

dag: Gala tumbu ŋmanila diɛma jɛrigu sani, amaa yɛm biɛhigu niŋdila tɛhi zilimalan nyaɣisim.
en: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.

dag: Amaa bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ di ni bi simdi ni yi ŋubi shɛba: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: But these are the kinds of birds you are not to eat: eagles, owls, hawks, falcons; buzzards, vultures, crows; ostriches; seagulls, storks, herons, pelicans, cormorants; hoopoes; and bats.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisiya pam. O suhuyiɣisili din daa kɔŋ tim maa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ buɣim juui Ziɔn ka di di li zaa.
en: The LORD let loose his fury; he poured out his fierce anger. He started a fire in Zion; it licked up its foundations.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N wuhibu maa pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla ŋun tim ma na la dini.
en: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui dɔɣi ninvuɣ so daadamnim puuni? Bee bɛ daa dɔɣ a mi pɔi ka daboya naanyi pili?.
en: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?.

dag: ka zaŋ di mini di nɛma zaa pɔbi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni, ka zaŋ li tam amaŋka dapuhi zuɣu.
en: They shall wrap it and all its equipment in a fine leather cover and place it on a carrying frame.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni. Yi shiri chirimya pam.
en: He is the God of the living, not of the dead. You are completely wrong.

dag: Amaa ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: But I use the power of Gods Spirit to force out demons, and this shows that Gods kingdom has come to you.

dag: Din chɛ ka ti yɛl lala nyɛla ti ni niŋ Naawuni naani Masia zuɣu la.
en: We can say this, because through Christ we feel sure before God.

dag: Ka yi ni su tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zalimiya nir ni yɛn kɔh o tiŋgbani ka ti lan yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛli.
en: People might sell their land, but the family will always get their land back.

dag: Ka o daa shiri fa ba bahi m-mali ba ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa, ka wuhiri shihira Ijipti tiŋ puuni mini Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni ni mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi.
en: He led the people out of Egypt, performing miracles and wonders in Egypt and at the Red Sea and for forty years in the desert.

dag: A ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee ŋme n-wurim ba; ka to n-wurisi ba kaman yaɣimɛr duɣu la.
en: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛli ni o nyɛla a tizɔpaɣa, ka n zaŋ o niŋ m-paɣa? Dinzuɣu n-nyɛ a paɣa! Zaŋm o chaŋ.
en: Why did you say, Shes my sister, so that I made her my wife? Now, heres your wife. Take her and go.

dag: Ka Amiram daa kpuɣ o piriba Jokɛbɛd n-zaŋ o dɔɣi Aduna mini Musa. Amiram daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Amram lived to be . He married his father's sister Jochebed, and they had two sons, Aaron and Moses.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa, ka nam niɣi balibu kam zaa, ka nam binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa balibu kam zaa. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: So God made every kind of animal. He made the wild animals, the tame animals, and all the small crawling things. And God saw that this was good.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ shɛli din be kasi.
en: The Lord continued, Remove the sandals from your feet, for the place where you are standing is holy ground. .

dag: Dama chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama n-lim Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa, dinzuɣu chɛrubinim maa n-daa nyɛ bimpindigu din pili Adaka maa mini di dapuhi la.
en: whose wings covered both the chest and the poles used for carrying it.

dag: O teeg o yurilim maŋli min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla Izraɛlnim sani. Dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa nim nya ti Naawuni nasara dibu maa.
en: He has kept his promise of love and loyalty to the people of Israel. People everywhere have seen our Gods power to save.

dag: Hurai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaash Vinvamli ni nir la ni Abiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Ariba nir la.
en: Hurai from the Brooks of Gaash; Abiel the Arbathite;.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa booni Gidiɔn la Jɛrubaal, Di gbinni nyɛla, Chɛliya ka buɣili Baal min o va; dama o bimbini ka o wurim maa.
en: From then on Gideon was known as Jerubbaal, because Joash said, Let Baal defend himself; it is his altar that was torn down.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naa Dauda piligu ni o bahigu tuma zaa sab bela anabi Samuɛl yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafi ni, ka lan sab be anabi Neetan mini anabi Gaad yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafinim ni.
en: The history of King David from beginning to end is recorded in the records of the three prophets, Samuel, Nathan, and Gad.

dag: Sirianim daa ti chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka gbaai bipuɣimbil so kuli ka o ti tumdi tuma sɔŋdi Naaman paɣa.
en: The Aramean army sent many groups of soldiers to fight in Israel. One time they took a little girl from the land of Israel. This girl became a servant of Naamans wife.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, A ŋmanila zo shɛli din kuri niriba, ka ku dunia zaa. N yi n-zani a zuɣu. N ni teei n nuu n-wurim a nahi tiŋgbani ka buɣim di a zaa.
en: You destroyed the nations and seem strong as a mountain, but I am your enemy. I might even grab you and roll you off a cliff. When I am finished, you'll only be a pile of scorched bricks.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ba kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni chana, o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ kpi kɔnyuri. O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na ka bɛ nyu.
en: They never got thirsty as he led them through the desert, because he made water flow from a rock. He split the rock, and water flowed out.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: While Moses and Aaron were still in Egypt, the Lord spoke to them. He said.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, ŋmaligimiya lab yi ni yi man so nyaaŋa pam la sanna.
en: People of Israel, return to the one whom you have deeply betrayed!.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa min o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni zaa.
en: Nathan faithfully reported all that he had seen and heard to David.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o nyari bin viɛla, ka o nuhi tuma mi mali di nyɔri.
en: People get good things for the words they say, and they are rewarded for the work they do.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din laŋsiri ginda, ka bɛ vi tuma ŋmanila kɔfuɣifuɣi. Bɛ lan ŋmanila saŋmar shɛb bɛn chani ginda. Naawuni pun mali biɛhigu shee zali ba bumbɔn ni.
en: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.

dag: Yil anahi din daa bili yina n-zani tuuli yilli din daa kab la zaashee la wuhiri ni nama anahi ni ti yiɣisi n-zani nam zaɣ yini maa zaashee, ka di mi ti ku mali kpiɔŋ kaman tuuli nam maa.
en: That horn broke off and four horns grew in its place. The four horns are four kingdoms. Those four kingdoms will come from the nation of the first king, but they will not be as strong as the first king.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi Dauda paɣiba ayi la gba chaŋ; Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la.
en: Davids two wives had been captured as well: Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, Nabals widow from Carmel.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka n nya wɔr piɛli. Ŋun daa ʒi o zuɣu yuli daa boonila Ʒiɛyim mini Yɛlimaŋli. Ka o daa mali wuntitali n-kariti saria ka tuhiri tɔbu.
en: Then I saw heaven opened, and there was a white horse. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he judges and makes war justly.

dag: Ti Duuma be a nudirigu polo. O ni ti nyaŋ nanima o suhuyiɣisili dali.
en: The Lord is at your right side; when he becomes angry, he will defeat kings.

dag: Dama n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa biɛrim nyabu chɛ ka n gba nyala biɛrim. N fabiliya ka di niŋ ma yoli.
en: My people are hurt, so I am hurt. I am too sad to speak.

dag: Bɛ yirimi chani bɛ tuma ni kaman mɔɣu ni bunsi m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la m-bɔri bindirigu tiŋgban shɛli din chaɣisi puuni ni bɛ ti ti bɛ bihi.
en: The poor are like wild donkeys that go out to the desert to find food. From morning to night they work to gather food for their children.

dag: Samaria anabinim sani, n nya binshɛli din bi viɛla. Bɛ malila Baal yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka n niriba birigi.
en: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.

dag: Dama ŋun be nam ʒiishee maa sunsuuni ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ gula, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yɛn zaŋdi ba tahiri nyɛvili kɔbilisirim shee. Ka Naawuni ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi.
en: because the Lamb, who is in the center of the throne, will be their shepherd, and he will guide them to springs of life-giving water. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Jɛfita daa tim tuumba Ammɔnnim naa sani ti bɔh o, Taal bɔ n-lee be m min a sunsuuni, ka a ti kana ni a ti tuhi ma n tiŋgbani zuɣu.
en: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the king of Ammon to say, What is your quarrel with us? Why have you invaded our country.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa kpe nti shiri niŋ kaman Ilaija ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o min o bidibiga maa ni o yiŋnim zaa kul nyari bindirigu diri dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: So the woman went home and did what Elijah told her to do. And Elijah, the woman, and her son had enough food for a long time.

dag: Di saha ka o daa dii zaŋ sapashinnim mini tɔbbihi zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani. Bɛ ni daa ti nya sapashin kpɛm maa mini tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ chɛ Pool bubu.
en: Immediately the commander ran to where the crowd had gathered, taking with him some army officers and soldiers. When the people saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣirina, ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As they were coming down the mountain, he ordered them not to tell anyone what they had seen until after the Human One had risen from the dead.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni ku zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi bee n-deei tuumbiɛrilana.
en: But God will never abandon the faithful or ever give help to evil people.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, di ni ti nyɛla alikauli din ku naai bɛ sani. N ni ti niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi, ka n ti zaŋ n jɛmbu duu zali bɛ sani sahakam.
en: I will make a covenant with them that guarantees their security forever. I will establish them and increase their population, and will see to it that my Temple stands forever in their land.

dag: Di saha ka n ni daa pun wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na la lan yɛli ma yaha, Cham ti deei litaafi bil shɛli din bɔɣi be malaika so ŋun tam teeku kom zuɣu mini duli zuɣu ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Then I heard the same voice from heaven again. It said to me, Go and take the open scroll that is in the angels hand. This is the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Ijipti ninvuɣ so ŋun daa zaŋ ninvuɣ kuriba tusa anahi n-taai duŋ zo n-kpe mɔɣu la.
en: Arent you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists into the desert some time ago.

dag: Daba ata maa dali, ka Yisifu daa yɛli ba, Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ ka tiligi, dama n zɔri Naawuni.
en: On the third day Joseph said to them, I am a God-fearing man, and I will spare your lives on one condition.

dag: Ka ŋun su o maa yi daa bo paɣ ti o, ka paɣ maa dɔɣi bihi, di saha paɣ maa min o bihi maa bɛn ni kpalim o dana maa sani, ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko chaŋ.
en: If the slave is not married, the master can give him a wife. If that wife gives birth to sons or daughters, she and her children will belong to the master. After the slave is finished with his years of service, he will be made free.

dag: Amaa ka Musa yɛl o, Vuri maa pala niriba ni di nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, di mi pala niriba ni kɔŋ nasara ka yɔri vu shɛli, amaa n wumla yila yilibu vuri.
en: But Moses said, It isnt the sound of a victory song. It isnt the sound of a song of defeat. The sound of party songs is what I hear.

dag: O daa galim Naa Hɛrɔd ŋun Naa Hɛrɔd tizɔbil paɣa Hɛrɔdias yɛla zuɣu m-pah o ni daa tum tuun biɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: But to Herod the ruler, he said, It was wrong for you to take Herodias, your brother's wife. John also said Herod had done many other bad things.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ma.
en: The young man replied, Ive kept all these. What am I still missing.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ yɛliya ni bɛ daa na bi dɔɣi ma, ka o pii ma leeg o dabili ni n zaŋ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnima, ka yam yɔɣu la labis o sanna. Yawɛ ti ma jilima. N kpiɔŋ yirila n Naawuni sanna.
en: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.

dag: Ka Pita lan bɔh o, N Duuma, bɔ n-niŋ ka n ku tooi dol a pumpɔŋɔ? Hal n ni saɣi kpi a zuɣu.
en: Peter asked, Lord, why cant I follow you now? Ill give up my life for you.

dag: Ŋunkam miri Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ yi ni kpi, dindina ti zaa kul kpimi maa.
en: Anyone who even comes near the Lord s holy place will die. Is it true that we will all die.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha ni bɛ ti mal li, ka daa va binyar shɛŋa din zaa bi be kasi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni n-yihi ti zali jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni, ka Lɛvinim daa va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chaŋ Sool sani, ka Sool ti yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ a ni, n niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: Samuel went up to Saul, who greeted him, saying, The Lord bless you, Samuel! I have obeyed the Lord 's command.

dag: Dama m bɔrila yurilim maŋli ka pa ni sara maligu. M paɣiya ni yi baŋ man Naawuni n-gari yi nyɔri binyara buɣim maani sara.
en: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat maa daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili Izraɛl Naa Ahazia ŋun daa tum tuumbiɛri pam la.
en: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.

dag: Bɛ nyaɣa vilivilila kuɣ duli, ka bɛ be tampima ni.
en: Its roots are entwined over a pile of rocks, for it sees a home among stones.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi bihi ayopɔin tarigiya, o tarigiya lu. Wuntaŋ na bi lu ka yuŋ pun zib o sani. O di vi ka nya filiŋ. N ni chɛ ka bɛn kpalim lu tɔbu ni bɛ dimnim tooni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Azɛl daa malila bidibis ayɔbu, bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Azirikam mini Bokɛru ni Ishimail ni Shiaria ni Obadia ni Hanan. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Azɛl bidibisi.
en: Azel had six sons, named Azrikam, his oldest, Ishmael, Sheariah, Azariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were in Azels family.

dag: ka o daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi duu o tɔbbihi bɛn daa gul o la sapashin kpɛm yiŋ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yisifu ti niŋ maa.
en: so he put them in the same prison as Joseph. Potiphar, the commander of Pharaohs guards, was in charge of this prison.

dag: Bɛ ni ko tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ zaɣ nɛli la, ka di ku lan nyɛ zaɣ nɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gariti nimaani sani.
en: People will begin again to work the land so when other people pass by they will not see ruins anymore.

dag: ni Madɔn naa ni Hazɔr naa.
en: the king of Madon one.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnima kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Bɛ ni daa deei li naai, bɛ daa ʒinila di ni.
en: The Lord gave the Israelites the land he had promised their ancestors, and they captured it and settled in it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim daa pirigila buyi; bɛ pirigili daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Ginat bia Tibini leei naa, ka pirigili mi bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Omri leei naa.
en: At this time the people of Israel were split in two. One half of the people followed Tibni, Ginaths son, making him king; the other half followed Omri.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka sagbani sirigina wuntaŋ ni ti lim Ziɔn Zoli mini bɛnkam zaa laɣim nimaani, ka nyɛ nyɔhi ni buɣim niɛm din diri ne yuŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni jilima din be nimaani ni ti nyɛla leeŋa.
en: then the LORD will create over the whole site of Mount Zion and over its assembly a cloud by day and smoke and the light of a blazing fire by night. Over all the glory there will be a canopy.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a mali yɛm gari Daniɛl, ka ashili shɛli kani ka a bi mi li.
en: You are certainly wiser than Daniel; no secrets are hidden from you.

dag: Juda nayilinim ni daa wum ni Aram mini Ifriim zuliya naai noli, Ahaz min o niriba ni daa sɔhirimi kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri tibɔŋ ni tihi ka di damdi shɛm la.
en: When word reached the king of Judah that the armies of Syria were already in the territory of Israel, he and all his people were so terrified that they trembled like trees shaking in the wind.

dag: ka sakuɣ kara din tibisim sania zuɣu nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram pihinahi ni anu daa yi zuɣusaa n-luri niriba zuɣu na hal ka bɛ ti turi Naawuni alɔbo sakuɣa maa zuɣu. Di daalɔbo maa daa mali dabiɛm pam.
en: Huge hailstones, each weighing as much as a hundred pounds, fell from the sky on people, who cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because it was such a terrible plague.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Isaiah then told the king, The Lord Almighty says that.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi li bahi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni la zuɣu m-mali di zaa.
en: Then Moses took the anointing oil and sprinkled it on the Holy Tent and on everything in it. In this way he made them holy.

dag: Hɛzɛkia mini kpambaliba ni daa kana ti nya di ni doya gbilligbilli shɛm maa, ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ min o niriba Izraɛlnim di zuɣu.
en: When Hezekiah and the leaders came, they saw the piles of things that were collected. They praised the Lord and his people, the Israelites.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Kɔra, A min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni Aduna sa kam Yawɛ tooni na biɛɣuni.
en: Then he said to Korah, Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord 's sacred tent.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ka yi niŋ, ka n shini, ka yi tɛhi ni m bemi kaman yinim la. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n wuhi ya yi taali, ka galim ya.
en: When you did these things, I said nothing. So you thought that I was just like you. But I will not be quiet any longer. I will correct you and make clear what I have against you.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be o biɛhigu shee din be kasi la nyɛla kpibisi ba, ka nyɛ ŋun gbibi pakoya.
en: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.

dag: ka lan wum o ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim nanima ayi la shɛlikam zaa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Nanima ayi maa n-nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi ŋun daa be Ashitarɔt la.
en: and what he did to the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan: King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ daa saɣim o suhu pam ka o kuli ni suhugarigu, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: But the man was dismayed at this statement and went away saddened, because he had many possessions.

dag: Ka Pool mi daa pii Silas pah omaŋ zuɣu ka yɛdaniŋdiba daa zaŋ ba niŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni, ka bɛ mi naanyi chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: Paul chose Silas and left, entrusted by the brothers and sisters to the Lords grace.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi bah o zuɣu ni.
en: Then take the anointing oil, pour it on his head, and anoint him.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa garigi yɛli Leeban, N daa zɔr a mi, dama n daa tɛhimi ni di pa shɛli ka a ti zaŋ kiŋkansi fa a bipuɣinsi maa n sani.
en: Jacob responded to Laban, I was afraid and convinced myself that you would take your daughters away from me.

dag: Jɔshua daa karim Musa ni daa zali zaligu shɛŋa maa zaa wuhi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu maa zaa zaŋ tabili paɣiba ni bihi ni tinzunnim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: Every one of the commandments of Moses was read by Joshua to the whole gathering, which included women and children, as well as the foreigners living among them.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: yi pirigibu buta puuni yim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali yɛn nyɛla dunɔguliba.
en: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpuɣimiya yi bɔɣiri din zali ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka kpaŋsi yi dun gbarima ŋɔ.
en: Lift up your tired hands, then, and strengthen your trembling knees!.

dag: Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima. Bɛ daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhi pihita, ka mali wɔribariba tusaayɔbu, ka bɛ tɔbbihi daa kul tɛli ʒiizaa kaman mɔɣibihigu la. Ka bɛ daa kana nti ti bɛ suɣa dɔni Mikimash Bɛtavɛn wulimpuhili polo.
en: The Philistines gathered to fight Israel. The Philistines camped at Micmash, east of Beth Aven. They had chariots and horse soldiers. There were so many Philistines that they were like sand on the seashore.

dag: N ni daa labi maa, ka n daa nya tihi pam mɔɣili maa duli yaɣa ayi.
en: and when I got there, I saw that there were very many trees on each bank.

dag: Wummi saɣisigu ka deei wuhibu din ni chɛ ka a ti mali yɛm dahin shɛli.
en: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.

dag: A yi ti jɛrigu jilima, di ŋmanila a ni lo kuɣili niŋ kuɣilɔŋ ni la.
en: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?.

dag: dama ti nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ yaɣa.
en: because we are parts of his body.

dag: Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, yin di kɔrigiy o min o bia maa zaa dahin yini.
en: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.

dag: Amɔn ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The rest of Amons deeds, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ka zaŋ di shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka booi kpam maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa mini di zuɣu lahi ni di kɔniŋdi bini ni di naba zaashee zuɣu m-mali di zaa kasi.
en: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its equipment, as well as the basin and its base, to make them holy.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin bidibisi daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Ashibɛl ni Gɛra ni Naaman ni Ɛhi ni Rɔshi ni Mupim ni Hupim ni Arid.
en: Benjamins sons were Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

dag: Bɛ mi daa bi niŋ tuuba bɛ ninvuɣ kubo bee bɛ baɣibuɣibo bee bɛ zina niŋbu bee bɛ tayiɣisigu zuɣu.
en: They didnt turn away from their murders, their spells and drugs, their sexual immorality, or their stealing.

dag: Ka bɛn la mi bi yihiri Masia yɛla waazu ni tɛhi suma, amaa ka niŋdi li mi ni nyuli zabbu tɛha, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yi niŋdi lala di ni chɛ ka n wahaladibo maan pahi n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: But those others tell about Christ because of their selfish ambition. Their reason for doing it is wrong. They only do it because they think it will make trouble for me in prison.

dag: Lala ni daa niŋ maa ka nimaani ŋunkam mali dɔro ka Pool sanna ti nya bɛ dɔriti maa tib kpaŋ.
en: When this happened, all the other sick people on the island came and were healed.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do bɛ lan laa gbini diri bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: Lord, this is true, the woman said, but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya Jaza. Ka bɛ daa tuhi fa di tiŋkpansi, ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani maa.
en: Moses sent some men to explore the town of Jazer. Later, the Israelites captured the villages surrounding it and forced out the Amorites who lived there.

dag: Ka Dauda daa gbahi wɔribariba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pisi; ka daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa jila.
en: In the battle, David captured , cavalry and , foot soldiers. He also captured war chariots, but he destroyed all but of them.

dag: Ka Haman daa kpɛna, ka naa ti bɔh o, Ninvuɣ so m-beni ka m bɔri ni n duh o, a lee tɛhiya ni bɔ ka n ni niŋ ti dilana? Ka Haman daa yɛl o suhu ni, Ŋuni ka naa lee lan yɛn bɔri ni o duhi pam ka pa ni mani.
en: When Haman entered, the king asked him, What should be done for the man whom the king really wants to honor? Haman thought to himself, Whom would the king really want to honor more than me?.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Ti ku tooi zaŋ ti tizɔpaɣ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun bi guni, dama lala nyɛla vi ti sani.
en: The brothers said to them, We cannot allow our sister to marry you because you are not yet circumcised. That would bring us shame.

dag: Ka nyini Daadam, zaŋmi takɔbi shɛli din dira n-leei wanzam piliŋ n-zaŋ li pini a zabiri min a teeŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ sania zahim li m-pirigi li.
en: The Lord said, Mortal man, take a sharp sword and use it to shave off your beard and all your hair. Then weigh the hair on scales and divide it into three parts.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas, ka o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la yɛli ba, Yi ʒi shɛli!.
en: One of the council members was Caiaphas, who was also high priest that year. He spoke up and said, You people don't have any sense at all!.

dag: Nyin Ayuba, gbilisim tibili wum n ni yɛn yɛl shɛm ŋɔ; fom ka n yɛl a.
en: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt.

dag: Dama zuliya kam jɛmdila bɛ wuna, amaa tinim ni jɛmla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: All the people from other nations follow their own gods, but we will follow the Lord our God forever and ever!.

dag: A yurilim din ka bahigu puuni ka a daa zaŋ a ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa chaŋ. A yiko ka a daa zaŋ wuhi ba soli ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ kasi la ni.
en: The people you rescued were led by your powerful love to your holy place.

dag: Di yuriya dunia ŋɔ bee binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. So yi yuri dunia ŋɔ, ti Ba Naawuni yurilim ka o ni.
en: Do not love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you do not love the Father.

dag: Musa daa pun tila Manaasa zuliya pirigili daŋ niriba la tiŋgbani Bashan, ka Jɔshua mi daa ti bɛ mabihi bɛn kpalim la tiŋgbani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo la. Jɔshua ni daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka bahi ba ni bɛ kuli maa, ka o daa lan yɛli ba.
en: Moses had provided for half of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan. But Joshua provided for the other half on the west side of the Jordan along with their fellow Israelites. When he sent them back home, Joshua also blessed them.

dag: Ka ŋun su o maa yi daa bo paɣ ti o, ka paɣ maa dɔɣi bihi, di saha paɣ maa min o bihi maa bɛn ni kpalim o dana maa sani, ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko chaŋ.
en: If his master gave him a wife and she bore him sons or daughters, the wife and her children will belong to her master. He will leave single.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini; ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: Again Jesus refused to say a word, and Pilate was amazed.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba pinaayi la daa boli Yisa nyaandol bɔbili maa na ti yɛli ba, Di bi simdi ni tinim chɛ Naawuni yɛligu tɔɣisibu ka kpalim bindira taribu ni.
en: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together. The apostles said to them, It would not be right for us to give up our work of teaching Gods word in order to be in charge of getting food to people.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka paɣ so be salo maa ni kuhi yɛli, A ni daa yi pu shɛl ni na min a ni daa mɔɣ bihi shɛŋa mal alibarika.
en: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed.

dag: Hal o ni da tɔbbi shɛb ka bɛ be o sani maa ŋmanila naɣisa kpaba, bɛn gba ŋmaligimi guui doli taba. Bɛ bi zani, dama bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dabisili paaya din nyɛ bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: Even her mercenaries are like well-fed calves; they too will retreat and run for cover; they wont survive. The day of disaster has come to haunt them, the time of their punishment.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi bɛn daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na n-daa nyɛ: Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt. Ham daa nyɛla Keenan ba.
en: Noahs sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth came out of the ark. Now Ham was Canaans father.

dag: ni Lɛbana daŋ niriba ni Hagaba daŋ niriba ni Shalimai daŋ niriba.
en: Lebana, Hagaba, Shalmai.

dag: Yawɛ daa wuhi ti shihira ka tum alahiziba tuun kara din mali dabiɛm pam jɛndi Ijipti mini Firawuna ni o yiŋnim zaa ti ninni.
en: The Lord did great and amazing things. We saw him do these things to the Egyptian people, to Pharaoh, and to the people in Pharaohs house.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali din daa ye binyɛr piɛlli mini ago ni mulifu, ka salima ni waya ni kuɣ viɛla bina nyaɣim di luɣilikam la!.
en: and say, How terrible! How awful for the great city! She used to dress herself in linen, purple, and scarlet, and cover herself with gold ornaments, precious stones, and pearls!.

dag: Ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa Bɛtihɔrɔn polo, ka yim zuɣu la mi daa zaŋ kpa tintariga luɣ shɛli nir ni ni zani lihi bahi tin shɛli din yuli booni Zɛbɔiim la zolɔŋ din be mɔɣu ni la polo.
en: Another patrol would go west along the road to Beth-Horon. A third patrol would go east toward the desert on the road to the ridge that overlooks Zeboim Valley.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ Naa Sihɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba. Dina n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim daa deei Amɔrinim ni daa be tiŋgban shɛl ni maa zaa su.
en: But the Lord , the God of Israel, helped the Israelites defeat Sihon and his army. So the land of the Amorites became the property of the Israelites.

dag: Miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa n-kpɛh amaŋ daɣiri ni o sani.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your neighbors wife. This will only make you filthy.

dag: Yi yi ti wum kikaa kumsi luɣ shɛli polo, yin laɣimmiya ti sanna. Ti Naawuni maa ni tuhi ti ti.
en: When you hear the trumpet sound, come and gather where we are. Our God will fight for us.

dag: Zomiya ti soli zuɣu, ka di guriya ti soli. Di lan tɔɣisiriya ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa yɛla.
en: get out of the way; step off the path; lets have no more holy one of Israel.

dag: Ka Mariama yɛli, Chɛ ka di niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma dabili ŋɔ kaman a ni yɛli ma shɛm maa. Di saha ka malaika maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: Mary said, I am the Lords servant. Let this thing you have said happen to me! Then the angel went away.

dag: Yi pun mi bɛ ni daa fiɛb ti ka dihi ti vi Filipai shɛm pɔi ka ti daa naanyi ti ka yi sanna la yɛla, amaa ti Naawuni daa bahi ti ti suhukpeeni ka ti yihi lahibal suŋ waazu din yi o sanna la n-tin ya hal sɔguriba ni daa kul zooi la zaa yoli.
en: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daag a niŋ gballi ni, ka a kpi gadama niŋbu kum teeku bulli maa ni.
en: Your enemies will brutally kill you, and the sea will be your only grave.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tumd alahiziba tumtumsa; ka nyɛ ŋun kahig a yiko tuma wuhi zuliya shɛba.
en: You are the God who works wonders; you have demonstrated your strength among all peoples.

dag: A daa zaŋ a situra maa shɛli n-dih a buɣa jɛmbu shee nachiinsi n-dɔni di zuɣu n-tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di kpee na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: You made shrines for yourself and decorated them with some of your clothes. That's where you took your visitors to have sex with them. These things should never have happened!.

dag: Dama ŋunkam ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ biŋkpam, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal that may be offered as a food offering to the Lord will no longer be considered one of God's people.

dag: Ka Pita chihi bɛ zaa nini maa ni yɛli, Man bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But he denied it in front of them all. I don't know what you are talking about, he answered.

dag: Di daa nyɛla di daanabinim mini di maligumaaniba bɛn daa ku wuntizɔriba di puuni la daalahichi mini bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: It was because of her prophets sins, her priests iniquities, those who shed righteous blood in the middle of the city.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhir a ni a kul tim ma bini diba ayi kɔŋko, di nyaaŋa n ku lan sɔɣi mmaŋa a sani.
en: God, just give me two things, and then I will not hide from you:.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa gbi mɔɣili ka niŋ kɔsoli n-vo kom kpɛhi tiŋ puuni na la zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he made the upper pool and tunnel bring water into Jerusalem, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Yihim ma yɔhiŋgu ni, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.

dag: Yɛlimiya ti din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, ka di chɛ ka ti baŋ ni yi shiri nyɛla wuna. Niŋmiya zaɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu ka di chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe ti ka ti tarigi.
en: Tell us what the future holds— then we will know that you are gods! Do something good or bring some disaster; fill us with fear and awe!.

dag: Abishur paɣ yuli n-daa booni Abiheel, ŋuna n-daa dɔɣi Ahiban mini Molid.
en: Abishurs wife was named Abihail. They had two sons. Their names were Ahban and Molid.

dag: Bɛ nia zaa nyɛla bɛ daai ninvuɣ so ŋun ʒe zaashe titali ni luhi; bɛ nyɛla bɛn yu ʒiŋmabo. Alibarika yɛtɔɣa m-be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka turi yɛtɔɣa lee be bɛ suhuri ni.
en: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka laɣim niriba maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni.
en: Moses did as the Lord had commanded, and when the community had assembled.

dag: O min o niriba bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. O ni ti zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi takɔbiri lu Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku niriba yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He and his people with him, the most terrible of the nations, will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa la daa nya lala ka yiɣisi niriba maa ni kpuɣi kpani.
en: When Phinehas saw this, he arose in the middle of the community, took a spear in his hand.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa sab gbaŋ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niŋ di ni n-ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni yɛli, Naawuni timiya suhudoo!.
en: King Nebuchadnezzars message to all the peoples, nations, and languages inhabiting the entire earth: I wish you much peace.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni bɛ laɣimmi Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa na ka bɛ ti wuhi ma zahindi maa gbinni.
en: I ordered all the royal advisers in Babylon to be brought to me so that they could tell me what the dream meant.

dag: Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka di nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli n ni ku lan tooi du, dama kom maa daa pahimi, di ziliŋ daa saɣiya ni nira duɣi li, di daa nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli nira ni ku tooi siɣi gari.
en: He measured another cubits, but there the water was too deep to cross. It had become a river. The water was deep enough to swim in. It was a river that was too deep to cross.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o zuliya nab pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali yaa gari bɛ dimnima.
en: They were the Lord 's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim, saha shɛli zaa yi ni ti yɛn be yi dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka di leei dabari maa, di saha maa di ni vuhi, ka di di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim.
en: At that time, while it is devastated and you are in enemy territory, the land will enjoy its sabbaths. At that time, the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, O be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, M bi mi.
en: Where is he? they asked. I don't know, he answered.

dag: Daadam, dim a bindirigu ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira ka nyu kom ni dabiɛm, ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.

dag: Di tambu shee tiŋa zaŋ hal ni di tariga tiŋli ni ti nyɛla mita yini, ka di yɛliŋ ti nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu. Di naŋgbaŋkuɣili kara zaŋ ti paai naŋgbaŋkuɣili bihi ni ti nyɛla mita ayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu.
en: From the base at ground level to the lower ledge is forty-two inches; the lower ledge is twenty-one inches wide. The distance from the lower to the upper ledge is seven feet; the upper ledge is twenty-one inches wide.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Judia mini Galili ni Samaria zaa daa naanyi nya nyee vuhi ka bɛ yiko maan pahi, ka bɛ daa zɔri ti Duuma ka dol o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kalinli kul pahira, Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋsim puuni.
en: And so it was that the church throughout Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had a time of peace. Through the help of the Holy Spirit it was strengthened and grew in numbers, as it lived in reverence for the Lord.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa lan chɛ ka bɛ pii kuɣ pinaayi n-sɔŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni luɣ shɛli maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa ni daa ʒiɛya la. Ka kuɣa maa na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua also set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, where the priests carrying the Covenant Box had stood.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni yɛli, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Jesus told him, Don't tell anyone about this, but go and show yourself to the priest. Offer a gift to the priest, just as Moses commanded, and everyone will know that you have been healed.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli maa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi puri atam mini yi ni tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ni. Ka di simdi ni yi shiri puhi chuɣu maa.
en: Seven days you must perform the festival for the LORD your God in the location the LORD selects because the LORD your God will bless you in all you do and in all your work. You will be overjoyed.

dag: Jarɛd ni daa dɔɣi Inok maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Enoch was born, Jared lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Amaa ka man ti tuui, ka bɛn laɣimmi mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka lan laɣim lu n zuɣu. Ka ninvuɣ yoya pahi m-maani ma ansarisi ka bi chɛra.
en: But when I stumbled, they celebrated and gathered together— they gathered together against me! Strangers I didnt know tore me to pieces and wouldnt quit.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka saa maa mini sakuɣa ni satahinsi maa zaa naai maa, ka o daa lan gbaai taali tumbu yaha, o min o kpamba maa daa lan niŋ tipawumli.
en: When Pharaoh saw that the rain, hail, and thunder had stopped, he again did wrong. He and his officials became stubborn again.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a sujee saha, bee n saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha.
en: When you are angry, Lord , please don't punish me or even correct me.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N yɛn zaŋla Ijipti Naa Hɔfira niŋ o dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku o nuu ni kaman n ni daa kul zaŋ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia niŋ o dim Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa bɔri ni o ku o la nuu ni shɛm la.
en: I will hand over King Hophra of Egypt to his enemies who want to kill him, just as I handed over King Zedekiah of Judah to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia, who was his enemy and wanted to kill him.

dag: O peentɔriba tari gili ma, ka o bɔɣibɔɣi n yaannina, ka bi zo ma nambɔɣu. O puhigi m binsom bahi tiŋa.
en: His archers surround me; he cuts my kidneys open without pity and doesnt care, pours my gall on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn saɣi siɣis amaŋa n tooni? Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said to him, This is what the LORD, the Hebrews God, says: How long will you refuse to respect me? Let my people go so that they can worship me.

dag: Naawuni daa lan yɛl o ni o zuliya ni ti be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim ti zaŋ ba leei daba n-niŋ ba wahala yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: This is what God said to him: Your descendants will live in a foreign country, where they will be slaves and will be badly treated for four hundred years.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna. Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Yi va n-ʒi pam. Dama niriba ŋɔ zaa yinoyino nyɛla bɛn be kasi, ka Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi ti duhi yimaŋ Yawɛ niriba sani lala.
en: and Aaron and said, Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord 's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dooshee din nyɛ gbuɣim polli dibu shee, ka nyɛ gbuɣindaa ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka gbuɣimbihi be ni, ka so ku tooi dam ba la lee be ya?.
en: Where now is the city that was like a den of lions, the place where young lions were fed, where the lion and the lioness would go and their cubs would be safe?.

dag: Dama o ni chɛ ka o malaikanim gul a a chandi shee zaa.
en: God will put his angels in charge of you to protect you wherever you go.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti sɔŋdi niriba lala tatabo, ka di chɛ ka ti leei bɛn mini ba laɣindi tumdi yɛlimaŋli la puuni.
en: We Christians, then, must help these people, so that we may share in their work for the truth.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man chɛ ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ka Sintani daa lo m-pɔri gɔɣ o yuun pisaayika ŋɔ kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Now here is this descendant of Abraham whom Satan has kept in bonds for eighteen years; should she not be released on the Sabbath.

dag: N kul malila shili n-guhiri sahakam ni n deei n niriba bɛn niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi din bi tuhi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli maa.
en: I have always been ready to welcome my people, who stubbornly do what is wrong and go their own way.

dag: Dama Atalia ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ putɔɣulan la bidibisi daa kabila Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa kpe, hal ka daa lan zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen kasinim zaa ti jɛmdi Baalnima.
en: The followers of Athaliah, that corrupt woman, had damaged the Temple and had used many of the sacred objects in the worship of Baal.

dag: Din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa, ka Sintani kana nti yihi li bɛ suhuri ni ka bɛ ku niŋ li yɛda n-tiligi.
en: Some people are like the seed that fell beside the path. They hear Gods teaching, but then the devil comes and causes them to stop thinking about it. This keeps them from believing it and being saved.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa maa, ti ku tooi nya o; o yiko min o yɛlimaŋli galisiya; o nimmaŋtali din galisi zuɣu, o bi zaŋ kiŋkansi doli so.
en: We have seen that God All-Powerful really is all powerful! But he is just and never treats anyone unfairly.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banima, di yihiri ya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka di ti chɛ ka bɛ suhuri miligi, amaa zaŋmiyala saɣisigu din nyɛ ti Duuma dini wumsiri ba.
en: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord.

dag: Zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni ti yiɣisi, amaa man yɛligu ku yiɣisi.
en: The whole world, earth and sky, will be destroyed, but my words will last forever.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn kpalim maa niŋ o mabia Abishai nuu ni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnim maa.
en: Then Joab gave the other men to his brother Abishai to lead against the Ammonites.

dag: Tola bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Rɛfaya ni Jɛriɛl ni Jamai ni Ibisam ni Shɛmuɛl, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Tola zuliya maa dɔɣirikpamba, ka daa lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi. Dauda ʒiɛman ni, bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tuhi pisinaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: Tolas sons were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Samuel. They were all leaders of their families. Those men and their descendants were strong soldiers. Their families grew. By the time David was king, there were , men ready for war.

dag: Ka Pita daa zaŋ ba kpe duu ka o mini ba ti gbe. N-yi biɛɣu ka Pita yiɣisi ni o mini Kɔniilius tuumba maa chaŋ, ka Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔpa pahi Pita zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Peter invited the men in and had them spend the night there. The next day he got ready and went with them; and some of the believers from Joppa went along with him.

dag: Miri ka a fa nandaamba nɛma bɛ ni nyɛ nandaamba zuɣu bee m-muɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala dunɔdali ni;.
en: Don't take advantage of the poor just because you can; don't take advantage of those who stand helpless in court.

dag: Lɛvinima m-bɔŋɔ: Azania bia Jɛshua la mini Binnui Hɛnadad daŋ ni nir la ni Kadimiɛl.
en: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb gba niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbiri pam bɛn nyɛ piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi n-doli ba chaŋ.
en: A diverse crowd also went up with them along with a huge number of livestock, both flocks and herds.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti labisi n niriba Izraɛlnim mini Judanim daazichi ti ba, ka zaŋ ba labisi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni na ka bɛ ti deei li su.
en: because the time is coming when I will restore my people, Israel and Judah. I will bring them back to the land that I gave their ancestors, and they will take possession of it again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Bɛ daa me duu maa naala gol so bɛ ni daa booni Ada la daba ata dali, yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayɔbu la ni.
en: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.

dag: ni Buki ni Uzi ni Zɛrahia.
en: Bukki, Uzzi, Zerahiah.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa gba ti bɔh o yaha, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei? Ka o yɛli ba, O zaŋla tandi ʒe n nina maa, ka m paɣi li ka neei.
en: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.

dag: Yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti! Ti bi tum yi ni so taali; ti bi saɣim yi ni so; ti mi bi di yi ni so zalinsi.
en: Make room for us in your hearts. We have wronged no one; we have ruined no one, nor tried to take advantage of anyone.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ baɣisi fiig tia wala ta bintɔrigu maa ka a nya alaafee.
en: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Yaakubu n-leeg o dahalali nira. O zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: The Lord chose Jacob to be his own. Yes, he chose Israel to be his own people.

dag: N ni lan labi ti be m biɛhigu shee hal ka bɛ ti saɣi ni bɛ tum taali, ka bo n shee. Bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni, bɛ ni bo n shee.
en: I will go back to my place, until the people admit they are guilty, until they come looking for me. Yes, in their trouble they will try very hard to find me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni tum n ni zali ba ni bɛ tum shɛm, ka gbibi n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti Musa ni o ti ba la, dindina n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ vuui bɛ napɔŋ yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: If my people will faithfully obey all the laws and teaching I gave to my servant Moses, I will never again force them to leave the land I gave to their ancestors.

dag: Ka doo maa ba min o ma maa yɛli ba, Ti mi ni ti bia m-bɔŋɔ, ka ti daa dɔɣ o la zoma.
en: The man's parents answered, We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Mariama, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, dama a mali zuɣusuŋ pam Naawuni sani.
en: Then the angel told Mary, Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti nya Nataniɛl ka o kan o sanna, o daa yɛlimi, Nyama, n-nyɛ Izraɛl nir alali ŋun ka yɛmbimbiɛri biɛhigu o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward him and said, This man coming is a true Israelite, one you can trust. .

dag: Dama Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili wain din mali kpiɔŋ pam pipia m-be o nuu ni kpeera, ka o booi li ni o ti dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ biɛri zaa ka bɛ nyu li hal ti naai di zaa kahikahi.
en: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.

dag: dama yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti be, ka pa ni ti nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu.
en: We live by what we believe will happen, not by what we can see.

dag: Zahimmi Asiria din nyɛ Lɛbanɔn sida tia, din mali wul viɛla, ka nyɛ tibɔŋ ni mahim, ka nyɛ din wɔɣa pam, ka di wulikpani chaŋ ti tɔri sagbana la.
en: You are like a cedar in Lebanon, With beautiful, shady branches, A tree so tall it reaches the clouds.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni tinsi n-nyɛ: Hɛlikat mini Hali ni Bɛtin ni Akishaf.
en: Its area included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph.

dag: O nam sulinsi ni zaŋla teeku noli hal ti kpa teeku shɛli noli yaha, ka lan zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli hal ti kpa dunia tariga zaa.
en: His kingdom will reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin dali. Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka yi puhiri Yawɛ chuɣu maa.
en: You must eat unleavened bread for seven days. The seventh day is a festival to the LORD.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe bɛ daazichi ka bɛ yiya wurim. Hal bɛ ni mɛri yiya ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku kpe di ni. Hal bɛ ni sari wain tihi ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku nyu di wain.
en: Their wealth will be looted and their houses destroyed. They will rebuild houses, but not live in them; they will plant vineyards, but not drink the wine.

dag: Amaa ka o kpee la daa tah o zuɣu ka bɔh o, A bi zɔri Naawuni? A bi nya ka bɛ bahi noli ni bɛ kum ti min o zaa?.
en: But the other criminal stopped him. He said, You should fear God. All of us will die soon.

dag: Amaa yi yi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so, yi tum alahichi, ka Naawuni zaligu nya yi taali ka wuhi ni yi nyɛla zaligusaɣindiba.
en: But if you treat people according to their outward appearance, you are guilty of sin, and the Law condemns you as a lawbreaker.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa lee yi ha nti nya o kpe so ŋun daa di o gba samli ka di bi yaɣi lala, ka o ʒe n-di dilan maa nyiŋgol ni ka yɛl o, Yom ma n samli la.
en: When that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred coins. He grabbed him around the throat and said, Pay me back what you owe me.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn ti bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Asha zuliya. Asha niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Okiran bia Pagiɛl.
en: The people from the tribe of Asher will camp next to the tribe of Dan. The leader of the tribe of Asher is Pagiel son of Ocran.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl bihi, o yuli n-lan nyɛ Yaakubu: Rubin mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: Jacob was the father of twelve sons: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

dag: Wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka bi wandi wala, o ŋmari li mi bahi, amaa wulli kam din tuɣ ma ka wandi wala, o wahirila di wulli maa nyoya ni bahiri ni di maan wali pam pahi.
en: He removes any of my branches that dont produce fruit, and he trims any branch that produces fruit so that it will produce even more fruit.

dag: Amaa ninsal mali buchi pam gari piɛɣu! Dinzuɣu di tuhiya ni nir tum tuun suŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Surely a man is more important than a sheep. So it is right to do good on the Sabbath day.

dag: O teei gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka n nya biɛrim mini naŋgbantom pam.
en: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;.

dag: Yawɛ n-su tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni.
en: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord . The world and its people belong to him.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Taiatira Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni Naawuni Bia ŋun nina ŋmani buɣim zilinli ka o napɔnvari nyɛlisiri kaman daanya viɛlli la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: Here is a message from the Son of God, the one who has eyes that blaze like fire and feet like shining brass.

dag: So bi yɛn teeri yɛndana bee jɛrigu yɛla sahakam; dama saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti tam bɛ zaa yɛla, dama bɔzuɣu ka yɛnnim mini jɛra zaa yɛn kpi kpiri yini?.
en: No one remembers the wise, and no one remembers fools. In days to come, we will all be forgotten. We must all die—wise and foolish alike.

dag: Ka Musa daa taɣi ʒim maa pirigili niŋ taha ni zali, ka zaŋ di pirigili din kpalim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses saved the blood from these animals. He put half of the blood in bowls, and he poured the other half of the blood on the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ ku tooi zo n-yi di ni, hal bɛ yi kuhi niŋ ma gba n ku garigi ba.
en: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa niŋ a daalikaulinim yɛda, ka yili yila paɣ a.
en: Then our ancestors believed what he had said. They sang praises to him.

dag: Ka Pɛkahia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Pekahiah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa ka o sanna ti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nir yih o paɣa daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Some Pharisees came to Jesus. They tried to make him say something wrong. They asked him, Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for any reason he chooses.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka piɛlaa ŋun mali yil wɔɣila ayi ʒe mɔɣili maa noli. O yila maa zaɣ yini daa wɔɣimi gari yin la, ka nyɛ din bahindi nyaaŋa yina.
en: and there beside the river I saw a ram that had two long horns, one of which was longer and newer than the other.

dag: M mabiyurisi, n ni sabiri gban shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ pahirila diba ayi. Gbana maa zaa puuni, n loya ni n neela yi nimmoo tɛha la n-teei ya yɛla ŋɔ.
en: My dear friends, this is the second letter I have written to encourage you to do some honest thinking. I don't want you to forget.

dag: Ka taŋkpaɣu labi di ni daa yi shɛl na, ka shia mi labi Naawuni ŋun daa zaŋ li ti sani.
en: Our bodies will return to the dust of the earth, and the breath of life will go back to God, who gave it to us.

dag: Kamina ka ti dɔni bo taba hal ka biɛɣu ti neei. Chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli taba bɔbu ni.
en: Come, lets enjoy ourselves all night. We can make love until dawn.

dag: Amaa zaɣ biɛɣu ni paag a, ka a bi mi a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Bahiyoli ni paag a yim libig a, ka a ʒi di yɛla.
en: But without warning, disaster will strike— and your magic charms won't help at all.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Yɛhudianim to jina n-naai noli ni bɛ suh a ka a sa zaŋ Pool tahi jintɔriba sanna biɛɣu ni, ka di be kaman bɛ bɔrimi ni bɛ vihi baŋ o yɛtɔɣa maa kpaa shee viɛnyɛliŋga la.
en: He answered, Some men are planning to ask you to bring Paul down to the Jewish council tomorrow. They will claim they want to find out more about him.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa ni ti kpila bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu. Ŋunkam di wain tiwala din miha nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: Because everyone will die for their own sins: whoever eats sour grapes will have a bitter taste in their own mouths.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl min o bia Bɛnhadad kul tuhiri nyandi ba waawaayili.
en: Then the Lord was angry with Israel. He let King Hazael of Aram and Hazaels son Ben-Hadad gain control of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tahi yɛli, Di bemi kaman n ni pun tɛhi shɛm! Yi bɔrila saha, dama yi baŋya ni n lo n suhu ni.
en: At that, the king exclaimed, Just as I thought! You are trying to gain time, because you see that I have made up my mind.

dag: ka tam o ni daa wuhi shihir shɛŋa Ijipti la mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni daa tum Zɔan mɔɣu ni la gba yɛla.
en: how God performed his signs in Egypt, his marvelous works in the field of Zoan.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ku be barina ni, bɛ ni be ni alaafee ka ku zɔri dabiɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo.
en: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti nyɛla n ni su shɛba n ni ti yɛn bɔhi biɛri dabisi shɛli dali maa, ka nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n ni ti tiligi ba kaman bihilaamba ni tiligiri bɛ bihi bɛn jɛmdi ba shɛm la.
en: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ yino alahichi tumbu zuɣu yi chɛ ka Naawuni nya sokam taali, lala mi n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino wuntia tuma zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka sokam yi taali ni ka nya nyɛvili.
en: So now the righteous requirements necessary for life are met for everyone through the righteous act of one person, just as judgment fell on everyone through the failure of one person.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Dauda daa chaŋ ni o ti niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Gaad yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: David obeyed the Lord 's command and went, as Gad had told him to.

dag: Daadam Bia ni chaŋ kaman di ni ʒe o shɛm, amaa mbusim be ŋun yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man will die in the way that has been decided for him, but it will be terrible for the one who betrays him.

dag: Ka yi yi ti duɣi li ŋubi luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii maa n-yi biɛɣu asiba, yin labimiya yi suɣa ni.
en: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa zo n-kuli Ijipti ni o yi Naa Sulemaana nuu ni ka o ku paag o ku o la daa wum di yɛla, ka yi Ijipti maa kuna.
en: When Jeroboam, Nebats son, heard the news, he returned from Egypt where he had fled from King Solomon.

dag: Jɛhɔram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa, o daa di nam maa la yuma anii Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jehoram became king at the age of thirty-two, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eight years.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe Tɛman tɔbbi biinsi, ka bɛ dimnim ti kpimsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Iso Zoli maa zuɣu zaa.
en: Teman, your brave soldiers will be afraid. Everyone will be destroyed from the mountain of Esau. Many people will be killed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ʒiri chi mini wɔrimɔri na nti tiri yuri mini tɔb wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam nayili maa kaman bɛ ni daa zali bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o niŋm shɛm.
en: Each governor also supplied his share of barley and straw, where it was needed, for the chariot horses and the work animals.

dag: Ka anab maa daa viligi tan shɛli o ni zaŋ lo o ninni maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa baŋ ni o nyɛla anabinim ni yino.
en: The prophet quickly tore the bandage from over his eyes, and Israels king recognized him as one of the prophets.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria Gomnanim mini sapashinnim ni tɔbbihi bɛn zaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ bɛmaŋa ni bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kɔre. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla.
en: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and officers, warriors richly clothed, charioteers and horsemen, all of them the most handsome of men.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ salima alali m-mali di yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make a lid of pure gold, inches long and inches wide.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa gari ka chɛ ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya m-be Ɛdom maa, ka daa chɛ Araba soli bahi nyaaŋa, ka lan chɛ Ɛlat mini Ɛziɔngɛba bahi nyaaŋa. Ti ni daa ŋmaligi n-zaŋ kpa Mɔab yɔɣu polo.
en: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.

dag: Ka chuɣu maa daa ti puhi naai ka bɛ labiri kuna, ka Yisa ŋun daa na nyɛ bisariŋga la kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ba min o ma bi mi.
en: After Passover his parents left, but they did not know that Jesus had stayed on in the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu Vuhim Dabisili na kul ʒiɛmi guli Naawuni niriba ni bɛ vuhi;.
en: But God has promised us a Sabbath when we will rest, even though it has not yet come.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu. A yurilim maŋli min a nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, kpihimmi n daalahichi!.
en: Be merciful to me, O God, because of your constant love. Because of your great mercy wipe away my sins!.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ŋma n-chihi ŋarin bil maa bahi kom maa ni ka di chaŋ.
en: The soldiers then cut the ropes to the lifeboat and let it drift away.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ninsalinima n-tuhiri taba, amaa ti mini alizinnim bɛn be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na mini bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima ni bɛn su fukumsi mini dunia ŋɔ yikolaannim bɛn be zibisim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni la n-tuhiri taba.
en: We arent fighting against human enemies but against rulers, authorities, forces of cosmic darkness, and spiritual powers of evil in the heavens.

dag: N ni lo ni n niŋ dunia ŋɔ zaa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teegi n nuu ni n-darigi niriba tibili.
en: This is what I plan to do for this land. I will use my power to punish all those nations.

dag: nyin di nyuri bara n-niŋdi tiwul shɛŋa o ni ŋmahi bahi maa. Ka a yi nyuri bara, nyin baŋmi ni pa nyini ŋun nyɛ tiwulli maa n-sɔŋdi tia maa nyaɣa, amaa di nyaya maa n-sɔŋd a.
en: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so ti ni buɣisi waawaayili n-nya ka o nyɛla ŋun suhu kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla pam puuni la n-dolisiri ba na. Ka pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun suhu na kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu gari lala, o ni niŋ ya naani pam la zuɣu.
en: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛri ya shɛm. Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be n yɛligu ni.
en: Listen closely to the message I am telling you.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka tinim bɛn daa tuui mali tahima Masia ni la chɛ ka ti biɛhigu nyɛ din tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: We Jews were the first to hope in Christ. And we were chosen so that we would bring praise to God in all his glory.

dag: Bɛ daa nyo bɛ fɔntin shɛŋa ni bɛ ni daa be mini bɛ sansana zaa buɣim.
en: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be good to you and give you peace.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la Naawuni n-ti o tumo Yisa jilima maa; Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani nti di o saria ka o daa bɔri ni o bah o ka yi zaɣisi la.
en: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the God of our ancestors—has glorified his servant Jesus. This is the one you handed over and denied in Pilates presence, even though he had already decided to release him.

dag: Daadam, Taainim ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba maa dunɔdaya kabisiya n-yooi yali ti ti pumpɔŋɔ. Mbo! di ni wurim doya ŋɔ zuɣu, ti ni tɔŋ.
en: Mortal man, he said, this is what the people in the city of Tyre are cheering about. They shout, Jerusalem is shattered! Her commercial power is gone! She won't be our rival any more.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ŋunkam yuli bi sabi nyɛvili litaafi la ni gba bahi buɣim teeku maa ni.
en: Those who did not have their name written in the book of the living were thrown into the lake of fire.

dag: ka Jɔram nyɛ o bia, ka Ahazia nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔash nyɛ o bia.
en: his son Joram, his son Ahaziah, his son Joash.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya niŋ ŋarima ni n-labisi Ijipti; n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni yi nini ku lan nya luɣ shɛl la. Ka yi ti zaŋ yimaŋ ni yi kɔhi yi dimnim maa zuɣu nimaani n-leei bɛ dabidɔbba mini bɛ dabipaɣiba, amaa ka ŋun ni dan ya ku beni.
en: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo gili bɛ sansani maa ni zaa yɛli, Doo bee paɣa miri ka o lan niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma la polo. Ka bɛ daa gooi niriba maa ka bɛ bi lan zaŋdi pina maa na.
en: So Moses sent word for the people to stop giving, and they did.

dag: Ka nyin ŋun wuhir a tab ŋɔ, a ku wuh amaŋa? Nyin ŋun wuhiri niriba ni bɛ di zu, a nyɛla ŋun zura?.
en: You teach others, so why dont you teach yourself? You tell them not to steal, but you yourself steal.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia gba bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o; amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served; he came to serve and to give his life to redeem many people.

dag: Do so yi niŋ marisamarisa n-zaŋ paɣipiɛl so bɛ ni bi zaŋ ti doo dɔni, di simdi ka o yo paɣ maa paɣibɔr liɣiri zaa, ka kpuɣ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: When a man seduces a young woman who isnt engaged to be married yet and he sleeps with her, he must marry her and pay the bride-price for her.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka pagɔrisigu tuma naai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di leei saɣisigu ti paɣiba zaa, ka bɛ ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma kaman yi ni daa tum shɛm maa.
en: In this way I will remove that shame from this country, and all the other women will be warned not to do the shameful things you have done.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba soli tum alahichi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi.
en: Nadab disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of his father, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Yi ni daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ dahin shɛli yi ni daa laɣim Sinai Zoli gbini la yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Ti yi lan wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kukoli pahi bee n-nya buɣim titali ŋɔ yaha, ti ni kpi.
en: On the day that you were gathered at Mount Sinai, you begged not to hear the Lord speak again or to see his fiery presence any more, because you were afraid you would die.

dag: amaa bɛ zaŋmila tuun suma m-malimi bɛmaŋa kaman di ni niŋ kamaata ni paɣiba bɛn doli adiini soli niŋdi shɛm.
en: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others.

dag: Chɛ ka n doli a yɛlimaŋli la, ka a wuhi ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni. Nyin ka n niŋ naani dabisili puuni zaa.
en: Guide me and teach me your truths. You are my God, my Savior. You are the one I have been waiting for.

dag: Ti Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ wula ka ti lee yɛn yɛli dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa? Dama ti lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: And now, our God, what will we say after this? We have abandoned your commandments.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋuni maa garigi yɛli: Di ni niŋ biɛɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisita. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lan lab mali zani di zaashee.
