en: The other holy one said, This will last for days. Then the holy place will be repaired.

dag: Nyini n-tiri nanim nasara, ka fa a dabili Dauda bahi.
en: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. M bɔri ni a kpaŋsi yɛla ŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka bɛn niŋ Naawuni yɛda tooi zaŋ bɛ dahima tum tuun suma. Dimbɔŋɔnim viɛla, ka mali buchi ninsalinim sani.
en: This saying is reliable. And I want you to insist on these things, so that those who have come to believe in God might give careful attention to doing good. These things are good and useful for everyone.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n zalila tiŋguliba a goma zuɣu. Bɛ di shini wuntaŋ ni zaŋ tabili yuŋ zaa. Yinim bɛn kul teeri Yawɛ ŋɔ, di bɔriya ni yi vuhi.
en: Upon your walls, Jerusalem, I have appointed sentinels. Continually, all day and all night, they wont keep silent. You who call on the LORD, dont rest.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri yuri ku tooi ti nir nasara, ka bɛ kpiɔŋ din galisi pam la ku tooi tiligi so.
en: A warhorse is a bad bet for victory; it cant save despite its great strength.

dag: Di saha ka nyaandol so ŋun daa daŋ siliga maa gbini paabu la gba kpe di ni nti nya ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Then the other follower went in—the one who had reached the tomb first. He saw what had happened and believed.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛla teebu mali alibarika. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun yuli ni kpi.
en: Good people will be remembered as a blessing, but the wicked will soon be forgotten.

dag: Amaa nyin kul gbaam amaŋa yɛlli kam ni; mali suɣilo wahala dibu ni; tummi lahibal suŋ molo molibu tuma, ka tummi Naawuni ni piig a ni a tum tuun shɛl la.
en: But you must keep control of yourself in all circumstances. Endure suffering, do the work of a preacher of the good news, and carry out your service fully.

dag: Ka bɛ daa saɣi n-chɛ ka o kpe bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka ŋariŋ maa dii mali ti to bɛ ni daa baari duri yaɣ shɛli polo maa.
en: Then they wanted to take him into the boat, and just then the boat reached the land where they had been heading.

dag: ni buɣijɛmbo ni baɣibuɣibo ni dimdi ni zabili ni nyuli zabbu ni suhuyiɣisili ni zunyuŋ ni naŋgbankpeeni ni tab woligibu.
en: worshiping false gods, taking part in witchcraft, hating people, causing trouble, being jealous, angry or selfish, causing people to argue and divide into separate groups.

dag: ka a zaŋ binyɛra din be kasi yɛli Aduna ka booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni m-mal o, ka o leei maligumaana n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Then put the special clothes on Aaron. Anoint him with the oil and make him holy. Then he can serve me as a priest.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni boli shɛb Izraɛlnima, ka yi yi Juda zuliya ni na la, wummiya! Yawɛ yuli ka yi mali pɔri pɔri, ka yɛri ni yi jɛmdila Izraɛl Naawuni, amaa ka lee bi jɛmd o ni yɛlimaŋli ni wuntia.
en: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.

dag: ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o, ka o neei kum ni daba ata dali kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: that he was buried and that he was raised to life three days later, as written in the Scriptures;.

dag: Mɛtusɛla daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinyinika, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Methuselah lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza tɔbbi kpamba salima nyɔtaɣira n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David captured the gold shields carried by Hadadezer's officials and took them to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa ti maani Izraɛlnima ansarisi, ka Dauda Mabia Shimia bia Jɔnatan daa ku o.
en: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Davids brother Shimea killed him.

dag: Bɛ tum vi tuma, ka tum din chihira, ka vi bi mali ba. Bɛ bi mi ʒiɛrige. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti lu kaman sokam ni luri shɛm n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli. Bɛ bahigu n-ti yɛn bala. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zaŋ li pah o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ zuliya shɛb ka fa bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa shɛŋa la zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ. O ni daa fa li tin shɛŋa nim sani n-nyɛ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknima.
en: King David made these things holy and gave them to the Lord . David did the same thing with all the silver and gold he had gotten from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and Amalekites.

dag: Dama nyini n-daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n no n dimnim firi tiŋa.
en: Lord, you made me strong in battle. You made my enemies fall before me.

dag: Di kumdiya ŋun kpi zuɣu bee n-fabindi o zuɣu. Amaa lee kummiyala bɛ ni gbaai so chaŋ zuɣu, dama o ku lan labina ka o nini ti nya o tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Dont weep or lament for the dead king. Weep instead for the one who has gone away, for he will never return to see his native soil.

dag: N daa kul darigila yi niriba ŋɔ tibili yoli; bɛ daa bi deei saɣisigu. Yimaŋmaŋ takɔbiri ka yi daa zaŋ ku yi daanabinima kaman gbuɣinli ŋun kuri niriba.
en: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa ni, ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒɛbu.
en: After Peter and Jesus were in the boat, the wind stopped.

dag: Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti ku o. Bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni. N niriba daalahichi zuɣu ka bɛ daa ku o.
en: Due to an unjust ruling he was taken away, and his fate—who will think about it? He was eliminated from the land of the living, struck dead because of my peoples rebellion.

dag: yi ni guhi hal ni bɛ ti zooi bi dɔbba? Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka yi ku kuli dɔb shɛba? Aai, m bihi, yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani. Yawɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm maa biɛri ma pam yi zuɣu.
en: you would have to wait until they grew to become men before you could marry them. I cannot make you wait that long for husbands. That would make me very sad. And I am already sad enough—the Lord has done many things to me.

dag: Amaa Rɛhɔbɔam daa sula Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tinsi ni la kɔŋko.
en: leaving Rehoboam as king only of the people who lived in the territory of Judah.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; dama m bela n ko ka be nahiŋgu ni.
en: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa maa, ti ku tooi nya o; o yiko min o yɛlimaŋli galisiya; o nimmaŋtali din galisi zuɣu, o bi zaŋ kiŋkansi doli so.
en: God's power is so great that we cannot come near him; he is righteous and just in his dealings with us.

dag: O daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu nir saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa Jɛrusalɛm yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka o yuli booni Abija.
en: Hezekiah was years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother Abi was the daughter of Zechariah.

dag: O daa bɔrimi ni o diri bundan maa bindir burisa din luri tiŋa; ka bahi daa kanna ti leen o yuma maa.
en: Lazarus longed to eat the crumbs that fell from the rich mans table. Instead, dogs would come and lick his sores.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni o ni niŋ anfaan shɛli din mali jilima niŋ ti ni yoli o Biyurigu zuɣu la.
en: and to honor his glorious grace that he has given to us freely through the Son whom he loves.

dag: Ka di ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni su shɛli, ka bɛ ni ti di li luɣ kasi shee la, dama di nyɛla o tarili din be kasi zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ puuni; ka di nyɛla o ni su shɛli sahakam.
en: That bread will belong to Aaron and his sons. They will eat the bread in a holy place, because that bread is one of the special gifts to the Lord . It is Aarons share forever.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋme n-di yi buni mini yi daazichi zaa n-zaŋ li chaŋ yoli, yi ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: The people of Judah have many treasures. I will give these riches to other people. They will not have to buy them, because Judah has many sins. The people sinned in every part of Judah.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi lab me goon shɛli din daa lu n-dahim la zali. Yi ni me li tam di tanza kura zuɣu. Ka niriba ti wuhi ni yinima n-nyɛ bɛn lab me goma maa mini yiya shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la.
en: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi yɛm, ka vihiri baŋdi salinim suhuri, ka tiri sokam zaa ka di doli bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ni bɛ tuma nyɔri ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I, the LORD, probe the heart and discern hidden motives, to give everyone what they deserve, the consequences of their deeds.

dag: Amaa di yɛtɔɣa chaŋ gili dunia ŋɔ zaa, ka dunia ŋɔ yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di tarisi zaa palila di yɛtɔɣa. Ka o ti suɣili zuɣusaa ti wuntaŋa;.
en: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.

dag: dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka alikauli maa daa yɛli, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: Here is what God said in that promise: About this time next year I will come back, and Sarah will have a son.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ ni niriba ayi daa kuni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Ɛmaus, ka di mini Jɛrusalɛm daa nyɛ kaman maali ayopɔin la.
en: That same day two of Jesus' disciples were going to the village of Emmaus, which was about eleven kilometers from Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Hazaɛl niŋ kom mahigi bɔdua n-zaŋ pa naa maa ninni hal ka o ti leei Naawuni dini. Ka Hazaɛl daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: But the very next day, Hazael got a thick blanket; he soaked it in water and held it over Benhadad's face until he died. Hazael then became king.

dag: Chɛl niriba ŋɔ taali a yurilim din galisi la min a ni daa pun chɛ bɛ taali Ijipti zaŋ na hal ni pumpɔŋɔ la zuɣu.
en: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔh o ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa dɔɣi ma lala? bee m-bɔh o ma, Bɔ ka a daa wolisi dɔɣi? Mbusim be dilan zuɣu.
en: A father gives life to his children, and they cannot ask, Why are you giving me life? They cannot question their mother and ask, Why are you giving birth to me.

dag: N ni darigi zuliya shɛb bɛn jɛmdi wuna, ka wuna maa nyɛ din galisi gari wuna din be Jɛrusalɛm mini Samaria la tibili.
en: I reached out to punish those kingdoms that worship idols, idols more numerous than those of Jerusalem and Samaria.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ buri maa so, ka zaŋ gabisi maa vili bɛ zuɣuri chaŋ Izraɛl naa maa sani ti yɛl o, A dabili Bɛnhadad yɛliya ni o suhirila o nyɛvili. Ka Naa Ɛhab daa garigi bɔhi ba, O na be o nyɛvil ni? O nyɛla m mabia.
en: They dressed in sackcloth and put ropes on their heads, then they went to Ahab and said, Your servant Benhadad asks you to let him live. Is he still alive? Ahab asked. Benhadad is like a brother to me.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bindir nyaɣisili maa min o ni mali bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti o bia Yaakubu.
en: and gave him some bread and the tasty food she had cooked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tahi pina pam na nti ti ti. Ka ti daa ti yɛn yiɣisi nimaani kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, ka bɛ zaŋ ti ni bɔri shɛlikam niŋ ti ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: They gave us many gifts, and when we sailed, they put on board what we needed for the voyage.

dag: Ka di daa gari Ɛdom nanima; ka Mɔab zuɣulaannim niŋgbuna sɔhira ka Keenannim zaa kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: The leaders of Edom are terrified; Moab's mighty men are trembling; the people of Canaan lose their courage.

dag: Ka ŋun Ahazia daa pahi Ɛhab bia Jɔram la zuɣu, ka bɛ lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Siria Naa Hazaɛl Ramɔtigiliad, ka Sirianim daa ti ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: Ahaziah went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya o ka bɔh o, Asahɛl, nyini m-bala? Ka o yɛli, Mani m-bala.
en: When Abner turned and saw him, he said, Is that you, Asahel? Asahel answered, Yes it is.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni lo a alikauli; amaa bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni a niŋ, dina n-nyɛ: a yi ti yɛn kana ti nya ma nyin zaŋm Mikal Sool bipuɣiŋga la mali na, di yi pa lala a yi ti kana a ku nya n ninni.
en: David answered, Good! I will make an agreement with you. But I ask you only one thing: I will not meet with you until you bring Sauls daughter Michal to me.

dag: ka lan zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit la m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: The third row had a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ; nyamiya, ŋun yi n nyaaŋa maa paana.
en: Get up. Lets go. Look, here comes my betrayer.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na ti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: But Jesus called the disciples together and said: You know foreign rulers like to order their people around. And their great leaders have full power over everyone they rule.

dag: N ni chɛ ka sida tihi mini akasia tihi ni mitil tihi ni olivi tihi ni sipirɛs ni oki tihi ni gahi ti galisi mɔɣu ni.
en: I will plant in the desert cedar, acacia, myrtle, and olive trees; I will put in the wilderness cypress, elm, and pine as well.

dag: Jɔnatan tɔbu daa ʒi n-lab kuli ka pa ni o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ʒim mini kpiɔŋlaannim kpam n-varim li. Ka Sool mi takɔbi na ʒi n-chɛ n-ziŋ.
en: Jonathans bow never wavered from the blood of the slain, from the gore of the warriors. Never did Sauls sword return empty.

dag: Dama Ayuba yɛliya, N ka taali, ka Naawuni mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: Job says, I am innocent, and God is not being fair to me.

dag: Jake bia Agur yɛtɔɣ kpɛma m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Doo maa ni daa yɛli Itiɛl mini Ukal shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni, n gbarigiya, Naawuni, n gbarigiya; wula ka n yɛn niŋ di nasara?.
en: These are the wise sayings of Agur son of Jakeh from Massa. He says, God, I am tired, so tired. How can I keep going.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yisa, o ni daa yɛli ni o nyɛla bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na la zuɣu.
en: The Jewish opposition grumbled about him because he said, I am the bread that came down from heaven.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tinsi zuɣu yuun pisopɔin m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. Ka bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Then the LORDs messenger, who was speaking with me, said: LORD of heavenly forces, how long will you withhold compassion from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, with whom you have been angry these seventy years.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa ka wɔɣawɔɣa, ka nyɛ Anaki zuliya bɛn nyɛ yi ni pun mi shɛb la. Yi pun wum ka niriba yɛri bɛ yɛla, Ŋuni n-leei ni tooi zani Anakinim tooni.
en: The people there are tall and strong. They are the Anakites. You know about them. You heard our spies say, No one can win against the Anakites.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa nya malaika so ka o be alizanda sunsuuni yiɣiri ginda, ka mali lahibal suŋ din ka bahigu ni o yɛli niriba balibu kam mini dɔɣim kam ni zuliya balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima bɛn be dunia ni.
en: Then I saw another angel flying high in the air, with an eternal message of Good News to announce to the peoples of the earth, to every race, tribe, language, and nation.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, Nyama, dahin shɛli a ni ti yɛn zo nti sɔɣ a dudoonigu ni, ka a ni baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Micaiah answered, You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim sansan ni dindali maa yuŋ nti ku bɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu. Ka niriba daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-nya ka kpiimba n-kul do luɣilikam zaa.
en: That night the angel of the Lord went out and killed , people in the Assyrian camp. When the others got up in the morning, they saw all the dead bodies.

dag: amaa ka chɛbisi ba ka yɛli, Naawuni yi saɣi, n ni lan lab yi sanna yaha; ka daa yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ.
en: As he said farewell to them, though, he added, God willing, I will return. Then he sailed off from Ephesus.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari. Lɛvi daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin dunia yili.
en: Levi had three sons: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari; they were the ancestors of the clans that bear their names. Levi lived years.

dag: Di saha kokpɛɣu daa naan ʒi ti chaŋ; kopaliga daa naan du ti gari.
en: We would have been swept away in a violent flood.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi Firawuna min o kpambaliba yinsi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Ka zɔhi maa daa chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa saɣim.
en: The Lord kept his promise—the palace and the homes of the royal officials swarmed with flies, and the rest of the country was infested with them as well.

dag: Ka n daa labisi n garigibu zilinkom ti o ha yɛli: A ni yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ zaa shɛli pa yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-kul ʒini tɛhi n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I sent a reply to him: Nothing of what you are saying is true. You have made it all up yourself.

dag: Ka ŋun su o maa yi daa bo paɣ ti o, ka paɣ maa dɔɣi bihi, di saha paɣ maa min o bihi maa bɛn ni kpalim o dana maa sani, ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko chaŋ.
en: If you give him a wife, and they have children, only the man himself must be set free; his wife and children remain the property of his owner.

dag: Amaa ka Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la mini Tɔbaya ŋun mi daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tumtumdiba zuɣulan la daa wum ni ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti tum tuun shɛli din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima, ka di daa bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim zaa.
en: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel.

dag: Di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be tiŋkpansi zaŋla bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi dali leei suhupiɛlli vuhim mini chuɣu puhibu dabisili, ka daa niŋ bindira tari taba.
en: So those who live in the country and small villages celebrate Purim on the th day of Adar. They keep the th day as a happy day of feasting. On this day they have parties and give presents to each other.

dag: A zaŋ ma bahila bɔɣ zilinli ni, luɣ shɛli din zibisi ka zilima.
en: You have thrown me into the depths of the tomb, into the darkest and deepest pit.

dag: Guliya Naawuni piɛ shɛba o ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la. Niŋmiya li la yi suhuri ni yu lala zuɣu, ka pa ni muɣisigu bee liɣiri zuɣu, amaa di lee simdi ka di nyɛla yi suhuri n-ye lala niŋbu zuɣu.
en: take care of the group of people you are responsible for. They are Gods flock. Watch over that flock because you want to, not because you are forced to do it. That is how God wants it. Do it because you are happy to serve, not because you want money.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di suhi ma niriba ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Jeremiah, dont pray for good things to happen to the people of Judah.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla yuŋ leei biɛkaali. Bɛ yɛliya, Neesim maa mirila zibisim.
en: Everything is confused— night is day, and evening comes when it should be dawn.

dag: Ka lan chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ Masia yurilim maa, hal di ni nyɛ nir ni ku tooi baŋ shɛli zaa la, ka di chɛ ka binshɛɣukam din pali Naawuni ni la pali yi gba ni.
en: I ask that youll know the love of Christ that is beyond knowledge so that you will be filled entirely with the fullness of God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O nyɛla tɔbutuhira ŋun tiri nasara. O ni ti di dari yi zuɣu ni suhupiɛlli. O ni ti zaŋ ya leei ninvuɣ pala o yurilim puuni. O ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli yi zuɣu.
en: The Lord your God is with you. He is like a powerful soldier. He will save you. He will show how much he loves you and how happy he is with you. He will laugh and be happy about you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ.
en: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!.

dag: yɛlimaŋli m Ba, dama lala n-viɛl a sani.
en: Yes, Father, this was how you were pleased to have it happen.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka poloya maa lan kani, ka o suhu daa lan kpaŋ yaha, ka o zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋbu kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ni o ni zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm la.
en: When the king saw that the frogs were dead, he became stubborn again and, just as the Lord had said, the king would not listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Zɛra daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛranima; ka Shaul mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Shaulnima.
en: from Zerah, the Zerahite clan; from Shaul, the Shaulite clan.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni nyɛla ŋun niŋdi Izraɛlnim din viɛla, ka lan niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini din viɛla.
en: God is indeed good to Israel, to those who have pure hearts.

dag: Pirigili din daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili maa ni, Musa daa yihila ninsalinim ninvuɣ yino ninvuɣ pihinu kam puuni, ka yihi biŋkɔbiri pihinu kam puuni biŋkɔb yino n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn daa su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma la kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Moses took one out of every women and animals. He gave them to the Levites because they took care of the Lord s Holy Tent. Moses did this as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka bɛ be mɔɣu ni n-dari ginda m-mali ti paai yuun pihinahi hal ka ʒiɛmani maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tum din bie Yawɛ sani maa zaa ti kpi.
en: The Lord became angry with the people and made them wander in the wilderness forty years until that whole generation that had displeased him was dead.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka Jɔn Baptaizira sanna ka Jɔn ti baptaiz o Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: Not long afterward Jesus came from Nazareth in the province of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

dag: O daa lan bɔri ni o kahigila o jilima din galisi n-wuhi o ni daa zaŋ li niŋ tinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya o nambɔzɔbo la ni, ka mali ti zali ni ti ti nya o jilima.
en: He waited with patience so that he could make known the riches of his glory to the people he has chosen to receive his mercy. God has already prepared them to share his glory.

dag: Hal jɛra yi doli soli, bɛ bi tumdi yɛm tuma, bɛ chɛ ka sokam baŋdi ni bɛ nyɛla jɛra.
en: Fools show how foolish they are, just walking down the road. Their minds are empty, and everyone knows it.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbani tariga yɛn kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ shee zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli. Ka nuzaa polo tiŋgbani tariga mi piligi Yalim Teeku maa ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli shee.
en: Their eastern border was the shore of the Dead Sea to the area where the Jordan River flowed into the sea. Their northern border started at the area where the Jordan River flowed into the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka peentɔriba daa to Naa Jɔsia piɛm ka di gbaag o, ka o daa yɛl o kpambaliba bɛn be o sani, Zaŋmiya ma yi kpaŋa, dama n nya daŋ pam.
en: When archers shot King Josiah, he said to his servants, Take me away; Im badly wounded.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim daa kana nti laɣim gil o bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ ka ti chɛ biɛhiŋ? Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin kahigim li yɛli ti.
en: when the people gathered around him and asked, How long are you going to keep us in suspense? Tell us the plain truth: are you the Messiah.

dag: N zɔr a mi, ka n ni sɔhira, ka zɔr a saria karibo.
en: I am shaking with fear before you. I fear and respect your judgments.

dag: Ka bɛn la mi bi yihiri Masia yɛla waazu ni tɛhi suma, amaa ka niŋdi li mi ni nyuli zabbu tɛha, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yi niŋdi lala di ni chɛ ka n wahaladibo maan pahi n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.

dag: Amaa ka Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia maa bidib so ŋun yuli booni Abiata la ŋun daa zo n-tiligi chaŋ Dauda sani.
en: Ahimelech's son Abiathar was the only one who escaped. He ran to David.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin puhimiya ba puhiri suŋ.
en: When you go into a house, say, Peace be with you.

dag: bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili dukpina maa zaa gili, ka dur ata maa zaa daa mali takɔriti ti kpa. Di takɔriti maa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔbia polo, bɛ daa zaŋla dapaɣa tabili di tiŋ polo gili hal ti taɣi di takɔriti.
en: were all paneled with wood from the floor to the windows. These windows could be covered.

dag: Ka ŋun yur o ba bee o ma gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma; ka ŋun yur o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: Those who love their father or mother more than they love me are not worthy of me. And those who love their son or daughter more than they love me are not worthy of me.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuhi Yawɛ Shia o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi wuh o shɛli bee n-saɣis o?.
en: Can anyone tell the Lord what to do? Who can teach him or give him advice?.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri din nyaɣisa ni leei faralana, ka ŋunkam yuri wain mini kpam ku leei bundana.
en: Loving pleasure leads to poverty. Wine and luxury will never make you wealthy.

dag: Di ŋmanila dabili ŋun suhu ye mahim zuɣu, ka ŋmani tumtumdiba bɛn guhiri bɛ yɔri.
en: They are like a slave looking for cool shade or a hired worker waiting for payday.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi shɛb tabili dapula m-pahi Yisa zuɣu maa ni yino daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi Yisa zuɣu m-bɔhir o, A pala Masia? Tiligim amaŋa, ka tiligi ti pahi.
en: One of the criminals hanging there hurled insults at him: Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and us.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana ka o daa bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: From that time on he was looking for an opportunity to turn him in.

dag: Niriba pam daa nya o ka di gari ba pam. O biɛhigu daa taɣimi, ka o bi ŋmani ninsala.
en: It is true that many were shocked when they saw him. He was beaten so badly that he no longer looked like a man.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa biŋkpam, ka ŋmaai zugbini miri yaaŋ kɔbili n-zaŋ di mini di kpam maa zaa mali sara ni biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la ni biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: Then you may offer the fat from the communal sacrifice of well-being as a food gift for the LORD: the whole fat tail, which should be removed close to the tailbone; the fat that covers and surrounds the insides.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla ŋun tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, amaa o daa bi tum li ni o suhu zaa.
en: Amaziah did what the Lord wanted him to do, but not with all his heart.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima, dama ninsal sɔŋsim nyɛla yoli.
en: Give us help against the enemy— human help is worthless.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali taali Yawɛ sani; ka di niŋ o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu.
en: You are guilty, and you must pay the guilt offering to the Lord .

dag: ni kikahi kumsi ni kukoli yɛtɔɣa vubu din mali dabiɛm hal ka bɛn daa wum li suhi Naawuni ni o di lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa yaha la.
en: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop.

dag: Bani daŋ ni: Mɛshulam mini Maluk ni Adaya ni Jashub ni Shial ni Jɛrɛmɔt so yaha.
en: From the descendants of Bani, these men: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam binnɛma zaɣ kara niŋ teeku ni, ka nam binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be kom ni chana ni noonsi balibu kam. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: God created the great sea animals and all the tiny living things that swarm in the waters, each according to its kind, and all the winged birds, each according to its kind. God saw how good it was.

dag: Yawɛ yɛm puuni ka o daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. O yɛla baŋbu puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chaŋ Sool sani, ka Sool ti yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ a ni, n niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: When Samuel reached Saul, Saul greeted him, The LORD bless you! I have done what the LORD said.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi Samuɛl yɛligu maa wumbu ka yɛli, Aai! Ti bɔri ni ti mali naa ka o su ti.
en: But the people would not listen to Samuel. They said, No, we want a king to rule over us.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa bɔh o ba Sool, Bɔ zuɣu ka a yɛn ku o? Bɔ ka o lee niŋ.
en: But Jonathan answered his father Saul, Why should David be executed? What has he done.

dag: Nyama, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gind o, ka chɛ ka teeku puuni nyaɣa limsi.
en: Look, he spreads lightning all over the sky and covers the deepest part of the ocean.

dag: Zibisim titali n-nyɛ bɛ daazichi n-doya guli ba, ka buɣim din pa so ni mali shɛli ni ti di ba. Ka binshɛlikam din ti kpalim bɛ yinsi ni ti di buɣim.
en: All his treasures will be lost in darkness. He will be destroyed by a fire, a fire that no human started. It will destroy everything left in his house.

dag: Ka Hilliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la bia Abidɔn maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Piratɔn Ifriim tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ Amalɛknim zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: Then Abdon, Hillels son from Pirathon, died and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the Amalekite highlands.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di simdi ni dunɔdali ŋɔ kul yo n-ʒiɛya, di bi simdi ni di yooi, ka so mi di doli li kpe. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ daa doli li kpe, dinzuɣu di simdi ni di kul yomi ʒiɛya.
en: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka di niŋ a alahiziba? N ni yɛl a paɣ maa min o ni bar biŋkɔb so ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin ni yila pia maa daashili yɛla.
en: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.

dag: Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli ni di saha ti paai ka o pal li la nyɛla ni o ti laɣim binnamda zaa luɣ yini: Binnamda bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka Masia ti nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: This plan, which God will complete when the time is right, is to bring all creation together, everything in heaven and on earth, with Christ as head.

dag: N ni ti zani a tooni Sinai Zoli tampiŋ zuɣu, ka a ti zaŋ a jaaŋgbee maa fiɛbi tampiŋ maa, ka kom yi di ni na ka niriba maa nyu. Ka Musa daa niŋ lala Izraɛl kpamba maa ninni.
en: When you get to the rock at Mount Sinai, I will be there with you. Strike the rock with the stick, and water will pour out for the people to drink. Moses did this while the leaders watched.

dag: Ka Ammɔn kpamba daa bɔhi Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni jilima ka o ti a ba maa? O tuumba maa kamina ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ ya ŋɔ daashili zaa, ka o kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: the Ammonite leaders asked Hanun, Do you really believe David is honoring your father because he has sent you condolences? Of course not! His servants have come to search the city, spy it out, and overthrow it.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli niriba maa yi ti yɛn laɣimmi, yin piɛbimi kikaa maa, amaa ka di piɛb li kika biɛɣu piɛbbu.
en: To gather the assembly, blow a long blast, not a series of short blasts.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-tiri yɛm. O noli ni ka baŋsim mini yɛla baŋbu yirina.
en: All wisdom comes from the Lord , and so do common sense and understanding.

dag: Ka Naa daa bo omaŋmaŋ dahalali biŋkɔbiri ti ka bɛ kɔriti maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba mini zaawuni ni vuhim dabisa dali ni goli palli chuɣu puhibu ni ni bɛ ni daa zali chu shɛŋa puhibu ni kaman di ni daa sab shɛm Yawɛ zaligu ni.
en: As his portion, the king personally contributed the entirely burned offerings for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as the entirely burned offerings for the Sabbaths, new moons, and festivals, as written in the LORDs Instruction.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Izraɛl zoya polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Human one, face Israels mountains, and prophesy to them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee la ka bɛ daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi maa gba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ yino sa Yisa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi sa o nuzaa polo.
en: They were led to a place called The Skull. There the soldiers nailed Jesus to the cross. They also nailed the criminals to crosses beside Jesus—one on the right and the other on the left.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Jɛrɔbɔam Nɛbat bia la ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Ti kpaŋ timaŋ ni ti tibi Babilɔn, amaa ka kɔŋ li tibbu. Chɛliya li ka ti zaa kuli timaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama o tibidarigibo maa du zuɣusaa hal ti kpe sagbana ni.
en: The foreigners answered, We have already tried to treat Babylon's wounds, but they would not heal. Come on, let's all go home to our own countries. Nothing is left in Babylonia; everything is destroyed.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ olivi tihi dari m-mali dasara, ka di nyɛ zaɣ mɔɣiri n-zaŋ sa sunsuuni dunol ni.
en: He made the door of the main hall with doorframes of olive wood with four recesses.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛl o, Rut, nyama, a kpee maa lab o niriba min o wuna sani, dinzuɣu a gba dol o labi.
en: Naomi said, Look, your sister-in-law has gone back to her own people and her own gods. You should do the same.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi deei Naawuni nam kaman bia ni deeri li shɛm ti ku kpe di ni.
en: Remember this! Whoever does not receive the Kingdom of God like a child will never enter it.

dag: Dahin shɛli n ni daa yihi n niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la n daa bi pii tin shɛli Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ni bɛ me jɛmbu duu ti ma, m mi daa bi pii so ni o leei naa n-su n niriba Izraɛlnima.
en: From the day I brought my people out of the land of Egypt, I havent selected a city from any Israelite tribe as a site for the building of a temple for my name. Neither have I chosen anyone as prince over my people Israel.

dag: Lala niŋbu ni ka Lɔt bipuɣins ayi maa zaa daa zaŋ puhi bɛ ba sani.
en: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.

dag: Ka daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa ko n-nya bindirigu pam.
en: Then Jesus used this story: There was a rich man who had some land. His land grew a very good crop of food.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi luri tiŋ na kaman sanʒiɛ titali ni yi yiɣisina nti ʒe fiig tia ka di wal kaha suuri luri shɛm la.
en: The stars in the sky fell to the earth like a fig tree dropping its figs when the wind blows.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Nadab Jɛrɔbɔam bia daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya su Izraɛlnim la yuma ayi.
en: Jeroboams son Nadab became king of Israel in the second year of Judahs King Asa. He ruled over Israel for two years.

dag: Zuliya shɛli buɣa ni tooi chɛ ka saa mi? Bee zuɣusaa ni tooi chɛ ka sayuɣiyuɣi mi? Pa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-niŋdi li? Ti mali tahima a sani, dama nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.

dag: Jɛriko niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihinahinaanu.
en: from the town of Jericho:.

dag: Yi mi ti ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm mini ti ni daa tim zuliya gbaliŋ ni garina shɛm.
en: You know firsthand how we used to live in Egypt and how we passed right through the nations that you passed through.

dag: Yinim bɛn tiligi tɔbu ni ŋɔ, chamiya, di lan guhiriya. Teemiya Yawɛ yɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be katiŋ maa ni, ka chɛliya ka Jɛrusalɛm yɛla be yi suhuri ni.
en: The Lord says to his people in Babylonia: You have escaped death! Now go! Don't wait! Though you are far from home, think about me, your Lord , and remember Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Dibɔngaad maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Alimɔndibilataim.
en: They marched from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.

dag: Ka bɛ nini daa mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛri ni o kul kpahim o mi tabili dapulli zuɣu. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ti bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa.
en: But they kept on shouting at the top of their voices that Jesus should be crucified, and finally their shouting succeeded.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka o nyu n-naai nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan yɛl o, N ni ŋɔŋ kom ti a laakumnim ŋɔ ka bɛ gba nyu hal ti tiɣi.
en: When she finished giving him a drink, she said, Ill draw some water for your camels too, till theyve had enough to drink.

dag: Di saha ka nyaandol so ŋun daa daŋ siliga maa gbini paabu la gba kpe di ni nti nya ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in; he saw and believed. .

dag: Ka dilan naan yili yila yɛli niriba, N daa tumla alahichi, ka bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labisi di samli yo ma.
en: When that happens, we tell everyone, I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me.

dag: Man Tɛrisius ŋun sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri ya ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: I, Tertius, the writer of this letter, send you Christian greetings.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka gom gbaai doo maa pam, o ni daa gbihiri saha shɛli maa, ka o daa yih o sapir kɔb yini ka daai nimaani nimdi ŋari;.
en: Then the Lord God made the man fall into a deep sleep, and while he was sleeping, he took out one of the man's ribs and closed up the flesh.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli yɛl shɛŋa yɛla zali, ka kahigi li wuhi, ka di daa bi yuui, ka n chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a saɣimya teeku puuni, kɔbulli ni. Ka a min a daguya ni a tumtumdiba zaa laɣim shim.
en: But now you are wrecked in the deep sea, with your cargo and crew scattered everywhere.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, tinim ka a lee ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ bee sokam zaa.
en: Peter said, Lord, did you tell this story for us or for all people.

dag: O daa wuhila tumo maa, A yi kuli ti yɛli naa tɔb maa lahibali naai.
en: and he instructed the messenger, After you have told the king all about the battle.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, hal n ni kul yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni kpi maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi zo n-yi bɛ daalahichi ni, ka tum din doli zaligu mini din tuhi.
en: I may warn someone evil that he is going to die, but if he stops sinning and does what is right and good—.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan suhi Naawuni, ka sagbana kpaai kom bahina, ka tiŋgbani zuɣu bimbila lan niŋdi bindira yaha.
en: He prayed again, God sent rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

dag: Yi mabihi bɛn be Babilɔn ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb kaman yinim la puhiri ya; ka m bia Maak gba puhiri ya.
en: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.

dag: A yi zaŋ salima buɣilimbuɣilimbila yili, ka a zaŋ pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi yili pa di zuɣu; ka zaŋ salima kɔtomsi ni pumpɔrinchiya m-mali lala hal ti gili alichɛbba maa tiŋli zaa.
en: A gold bell and a pomegranate should alternate all around the lower hem of the robe.

dag: Jɔab mabia Asahɛl n-daa nyɛ ŋun pah anahi n-su gol so ŋun pah anahi ni. O kalinsi nyaaŋa, o bia Zɛbadia n-daa zan o zaani, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The fourth commander, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab. Later, Asahels son Zebadiah took his place as commander. There were , men in Asahels group.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm maa wuhirila bɔ? Di wuhirimi ni bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣili nyɛla shɛli bee buɣili maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ shɛli?.
en: What am I saying then? That food sacrificed to a false god is anything, or that a false god is anything?.

dag: Zuliya kam ni niriba, kamiyana ti wum! Daadamnima, Wummiya! Dunia mini bɛnkam be di ni zaŋ tabili binshɛɣukam zaa, kamiyana ti wum!.
en: Come, people of all nations! Gather around and listen. Let the whole earth and everyone living on it come here and listen.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka yi mini ba tuhi, n ti ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbani maa hal napɔŋ ŋmɛbu yim gba tin ya, dama n daa pun zaŋ Ɛdom Zoli maa tila Iso ni o su li.
en: Dont fight with them because I will not give the tiniest parcel of their land to you. I have given Mount Seir to Esaus family as their property.

dag: n kul paɣirila Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam, ka kul teeri yi yɛla n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: I have not stopped giving thanks to God for you. I remember you in my prayers.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaana kam kul ʒiɛmi tumd o sara maligu tuma dabisili kam n-kul maanila sara maligu yini maa napɔn bɔbili. Ka sara maligunim ŋɔ mi ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi;.
en: Every Jewish priest performs his services every day and offers the same sacrifices many times; but these sacrifices can never take away sins.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul zaɣisir o? Yi bɔrila tibidarigibo din galisi? Izraɛlnima, yi zuɣuri zaa malila dansi, ka yi suhuri mini yi tɛha ka alaafee.
en: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul bi niŋ tuuba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun darigi bɛ tibili maa sani bee ŋ-ŋmaligi lab o sanna.
en: But the people didnt turn to the one who struck them. They didnt seek the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: amaa n ni di kul duhi n yee kuhi pam saha shɛli, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu ŋɔ bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: But when he came near me, I screamed. He ran away, but he left his coat.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni ti chɛ nyuli zabbu, ka Juda zuliya dimdi la ti kpi. Ifriim zuliya ti ku lan zab Juda zuliya nyuli; ka Juda zuliya mi ti ku lan nyɛ Ifriim zuliya dimnima.
en: Then Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, and Judah will have no enemies left. And Judah will not cause trouble for Ephraim.

dag: Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka di nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli n ni ku lan tooi du, dama kom maa daa pahimi, di ziliŋ daa saɣiya ni nira duɣi li, di daa nyɛla mɔɣ shɛli nira ni ku tooi siɣi gari.
en: Another meters downstream, the stream had become a river that could be crossed only by swimming.

dag: ka di puuni zahim zaa kpi n-niŋ di kom maa ni ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim kɔŋ li nyubu. .
en: The fish will die, and the river will stink so much that the Egyptians will not be able to drink from it.

dag: Duri maa tooni, so shɛli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ puuni. Di yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu, ka di dunoya daa be nuzaa polo.
en: There was a path cubits wide and cubits long running along the south side of the building, even though the entrance was on the north side.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yɛhudianim chu shɛli daa ti yɛn puhi, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After this there was a Jewish festival, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

dag: Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali, ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ.
en: It was now the evening before the Sabbath, and the Jewish people were getting ready for that sacred day.

dag: Ka o daa ti ba bɛ ni suhi shɛli, amaa ka daa chɛ ka dɔr biɛri gbahi ba.
en: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.

dag: Asiba kurig awɛi saha ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu maa.
en: It was nine oclock in the morning when they nailed Jesus to the cross.

dag: dama m Ba maa maŋmaŋ yuri ya, yi ni yuri ma ka niŋ yɛda ni n yila m Ba maa sanna zuɣu.
en: The Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and believed that I came from God.

dag: Bee n yi chɛ ka alɔbo lu di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka n suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni n ku ba, ka n kuri ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be di ni.
en: Or suppose I send a plague against that land and pour out my fury on it. With great bloodshed I would eliminate both humans and animals.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya galisi pam. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a yuli du pam, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will build a great nation from you. I will bless you and make your name famous. People will use your name to bless other people.

dag: Amaa Yisa nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o mali jilima pam gari Anabi Musa kaman ŋun me yili ni mali jilima gari o ni me yil shɛli maa shɛm la.
en: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.

dag: Niriba ayi yi vara, bɛ ni yino ni luh o kpee, amaa niriba ayi ni tooi luhi ninvuɣ yino. Mih ata gabiga bi chihiri yom.
en: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: N ni zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa zaa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be ka nabi, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri lo alikauli n-zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni.
en: Obey faithfully all the laws that I have given you today, so that you may live, increase in number, and occupy the land that the Lord promised to your ancestors.

dag: m-mali maligu zaŋ li nyo buɣim, ka zaŋ chi mali maligu di zuɣu; ka booi binnyura mali sara di zuɣu; ka lan kɔrig o suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu n-yih o ʒim bahi bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Ahaz burned his burnt offerings and grain offerings on it. He poured his drink offering and sprinkled the blood of his fellowship offerings on this altar.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋubi yi naɣibihi, ka di yi puri atam zaa hal nti naai yi balibu, bɛ mi ti ku guui yi chi bee yi wain mini yi kpam ni yi naɣibihi ni biŋkɔbbaligu bihi hal ti kpihim yi birili.
en: They will take your cattle, sheep, goats, grain, wine, and olive oil, then leave you to starve.

dag: din nyɛ sagbana ni kpaari shɛli bahira, ka di luri ninsalinim zuɣu na pampam.
en: the clouds pour moisture and drip continually on humans.

dag: Ɛlifaz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Tɛman mini Omari ni Zɛfi ni Gatam ni Kɛnaz ni Timna ni Amalɛk.
en: Eliphaz became the ancestor of the following tribes: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

dag: n-zaŋ a vilivili labi pal yaɣu ni kaman bolli la. Ka a kpi nimaani ka chɛ a chɛchɛbun shɛŋa a ni mali nyuri bara maa bahi nimaani. A nyɛla ŋun dih a dan yiŋ vi!.
en: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.

dag: O kpani maa daa ŋmanila kpalu dapua, ka o kpani maa zuɣu tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayopɔin. Ka ŋun ʒir o nyɔtaɣirigu be o tooni.
en: The wooden part of his spear was as big as a weavers rod. The spears blade weighed pounds. Goliaths helper walked in front of him, carrying Goliaths shield.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu; wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Please listen, Lord ! Answer my prayer for help.

dag: Ka Simiɔn zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ shɛba daa ti chaŋ Ɛdom zoli zuɣu, kaman niriba kɔbisinu laasabu. Bɛ daa malila bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ Pɛlatia mini Niaria ni Rɛfaya ni Uziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ Ishi bidibisi la.
en: Some of them, five hundred Simeonites, went to Mount Seir, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, Ishis sons.

dag: Nyama, a ni niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Yisa.
en: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa, Gbahimiya Baal daanabinim maa, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ ni so zo n-tiligi. Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba, ka Ilaija zaŋ ba sirigi Kishɔn kulibɔŋ ni nti ku ba nimaani.
en: Elijah ordered, Seize the prophets of Baal; don't let any of them get away! The people seized them all, and Elijah led them down to Kishon Brook and killed them.

dag: Amaa pako so ŋun tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, hal o ni na ne maa zaa yoli, o nyɛla ŋun kpi.
en: But the widow who uses her life to please herself is really dead while she is still living.

dag: Yi zuɣulaannim zaa daa laɣimmi guui. Pa piɛma ka bɛ daa zaŋ to n-gbahi ba. Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ ni daa nya yi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa hal bɛ ni daa kul zo n-chaŋ katiŋ la zaa yoli.
en: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.

dag: Bɛ daanzinfa bee bɛ salima ti ku tooi tiligi ba Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali. O suhuyiɣisili buɣim ni ti di dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dama o ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam naai naari biɛɣu.
en: On the day when the Lord shows his fury, not even all their silver and gold will save them. The whole earth will be destroyed by the fire of his anger. He will put an end—a sudden end—to everyone who lives on earth.

dag: Judas ni daa yiɣisi yi n-naai, ka Yisa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ ka Daadam Bia jilima yipa yi palo, ka Naawuni gba jilima yi palo o zuɣu;.
en: When Judas was gone, Jesus said, Now is the time for the Son of Man to receive his glory. And God will receive glory through him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ m bia, wummi n noli n ni yɛn wuh a shɛm ŋɔ ni.
en: So listen, son, and do what I tell you.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ ʒiri yɛtɔɣa moli gili. Miriya ka yi zaŋ yi noli naai ninvuɣ biɛɣu m-pah o zuɣu di shɛhira kpɛma.
en: Dont spread false rumors. Dont plot with evil people to act as a lying witness.

dag: yin bomiya naɣilaa ti Lɛvinima bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn kani n sanna ti tumdi n tuma la, ka bɛ mali sara alahichi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Those priests belonging to the tribe of Levi who are descended from Zadok are the only ones who are to come into my presence to serve me. I, the Sovereign Lord , command this. You will give them a young bull to offer as a sacrifice for sin.

dag: Saha shɛli Dauda ni daa di nam ʒi Hiburɔn n-su Judanim maa yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu.
en: David ruled over the tribe of Judah from Hebron for seven years and six months.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ti nahiŋgu mini ti wahala dibu puuni, ti nya suhukpaŋsibo yi zuɣu. Yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din kpaŋsiri ti.
en: So, in all our trouble and suffering we have been encouraged about you, friends. It was your faith that encouraged us.

dag: M mabihi, yi ni so yi ti birigi ka chɛ yɛlimaŋli la, ka so ŋmalig o labisi di ni.
en: My brothers and sisters, if anyone wanders away from the truth and someone helps that person come back.

dag: Di saha ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa chaŋ Shɛkɛm, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim ni bɛ leeg o nam.
en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had come to make him king.

dag: Ka wula ka o yi darigi tinim bɛn be ti nyɛvil ni ŋɔ tibili ti daalahichi zuɣu ka ti fabinda?.
en: Why then does any living person complain; why should anyone complain about their sins?.

dag: Yawɛ, m bi duhi mmaŋa, m mi bi nyuri bara. M bi zaŋ binyara din galisi pam mini din viɛli pam yɛla muɣisi mmaŋa.
en: Lord , I dont feel proud. I dont see myself as better than others. I am not thinking about doing great things or reaching impossible goals.

dag: Maata ni daa ti wum ni Yisa be soli kanna o daa yiɣisimi ti tuh o soli, ka Mariama ŋun daa kpalim be yiŋa.
en: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di suhi ma niriba ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu.
en: The Lord said, Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali yɛm gari biŋkɔbiri bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ lee be ya.
en: who teaches us more than the beasts of the earth, makes us wiser than the birds in the sky.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti dana, ti bɔri ni a neela ti nina ŋɔ ti ti.
en: Sir, they answered, we want you to give us our sight.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani gindi tiŋkpansi n-yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋdi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: They departed and went through the villages proclaiming the good news and healing people everywhere.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, O yɛli ma ni di bi simdi ni n lab kuna ni nuzaŋa, ka zaŋ chi ŋɔ zaa ti ma.
en: She said, Boaz gave me this barley as a gift for you. He said that I must not go home without bringing a gift for you.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi nyari taba bee so ti yi n-chaŋ shɛli polo daba ata maa ni zaa. Amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn yaɣili polo zaa daa malila neesim.
en: The Egyptians could not see each other, and no one left his house during that time. But the Israelites had light where they were living.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: And if your eye makes you lose your faith, take it out and throw it away! It is better for you to enter life with only one eye than to keep both eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

dag: Amaa n zaŋla Lɛvinim maa ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bikpamba zaa.
en: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi di ka nyu, ka bindirigu maa daa ti o kpiɔŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o chaŋ hal ti paai Sinai Zoli din nyɛ Naawuni zol la zuɣu.
en: Elijah got up, ate and drank, and the food gave him enough strength to walk forty days to Sinai, the holy mountain.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim lan ka bidibisi? Bɛ lan ka falidiriba? Bɔzuɣu ka Milikom niriba kari Gaad zuliya ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni.
en: This is what the Lord said about Ammon: Where are the men of Israel? Is there no one to defend their land? Why have they let the people who worship Molech take the territory of the tribe of Gad and settle there?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa niŋ sapashin kpɛm maa ni wuhi ba shɛm maa n-zaŋ Pool yuŋ m-mali ti paai Antipatiris.
en: The soldiers obeyed the commander's orders, and that same night they took Paul to the city of Antipatris.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Nyama, Itiɔpia Naa Tirihaka lola tɔbu kanna ni o ti tuh a. Ka o daa sabi gbaŋ lan tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani n-yɛli ba.
en: Then the king of Assyria heard a report that said, Tirhakah, the king of Ethiopia, has come to fight against you. So the king of Assyria sent messengers to Hezekiah again.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli A bidibisi la min a bipuɣinsi la bela bɛ biɛlikpɛm la yiŋ diri bindira, ka nyuri wain.
en: That messenger was still speaking when another one came in and said, Your sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine at the oldest brothers house.

dag: Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma anu, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu maa zuɣu.
en: In the fifth year of Rehoboam's reign their disloyalty to the Lord was punished. King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

dag: Izraɛl paɣ bia ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ijipti do so daa doli Izraɛlnim maa chana, ka Izraɛl paɣ bia maa mini Izraɛl doo daa ti zabi bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord . So the young man was dragged off to Moses.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ kuriba bɛn nuhi tum taali; ka yi lan ŋmari ʒiri ka zaŋ yi zilima tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: You are guilty of lying, violence, and murder.

dag: Amaa ka Itai daa garigi yɛli naa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini n dan naa ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n dan ni yɛn kpe luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla kum shee bee nyɛvili shee, nimaani ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛn kpe.
en: But Ittai answered the king, As surely as the LORD lives and as surely as my master the king lives, wherever my master the king may be, facing death or facing life, your servant will be there too.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, yil yini puuni niriba anu noya ni ti woli. Niriba ata ni ti naai noli zaɣisi niriba ayi, ka niriba ayi mi ni ti zaɣisi niriba ata maa.
en: From now on, a household of five will be divided—three against two and two against three.

dag: Ka di ni di zibiri ka bɛ yɛn yo dunoli saha shɛli ka bɛ di yi, ka m mi bi mi bɛ ni kpa shɛli polo; biɛhimiya bɛ naba yomyom; di pa shɛli yi ni paai ba.
en: The men left when it was time to close the gate at dark, but I dont know where the men went. Hurry! Chase after them! You might catch up with them.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kanna maa zaa daa yi ʒirila bɛ pina din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni kpariti ni mɛɛr ni tulaale ni yuri ni buntaansi na ti tir o yuuni kam.
en: Every year people came to see the king and brought gifts made from gold and silver, clothes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a pala ŋun pun nyɛ ti naa la, ka lan niŋ ti kaman ti pun pala a niriba la.
en: Some people dont follow you. They dont wear your name. And we have been like them for a very long time.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Wummiya fabila yil shɛli n ni yiini niŋdi ya ŋɔ:.
en: People of Israel, listen to this song. This funeral song is about you.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa bɔhi Ilaija, Wɛi, n dima, a nya ma? Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a tum tuun biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka n nya a maa.
en: When Ahab saw Elijah, he said, Have you caught up with me, my enemy? Yes, I have, Elijah answered. You have devoted yourself completely to doing what is wrong in the Lord 's sight.

dag: Ʒiɛyimtali ni tɔhi yi tiŋgban ni na, ka wuntitali mi be sagbana ni ka lihirina.
en: Truth springs up from the ground; righteousness gazes down from heaven.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi bɛn daa ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Naawuni tooni la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Then the twenty-four elders, who were seated on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshipped God.

dag: Ka daa yihi niriba maa ni bɔri do so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu o duŋ taabu min o ninvuɣ kubo zuɣu la bahi, ka zaŋ Yisa ti ba ni bɛ niŋ o bɛ ni bɔri shɛm.
en: They wanted Barabbas to go free—the one who was in jail for starting a riot and for murder. Pilate let Barabbas go free. And he handed Jesus over to be killed. This is what the people wanted.

dag: Cham nuzaa polo ti moli yɛligu ŋɔ n-yɛli, Izraɛlnim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ku lan yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra. N ku je suli niŋ ya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He told me to go and say to Israel, Unfaithful Israel, come back to me. I am merciful and will not be angry; I will not be angry with you forever.

dag: Naawuni daa tɔɣisiri ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa la anabinim noya ni siɣimsiɣim bu shɛm soya balibu pam ni;.
en: In the past, God spoke through the prophets to our ancestors in many times and many ways.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi ʒini momaha zuɣu. Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba, ka bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: and he told the crowd to sit down on the grass. Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and handed it to his disciples, and they gave it to the people.

dag: A tiligiri tarimba, ka pa nina lihiri karimbaannima ni a filim ba.
en: You save those who are humble, but you humble those who are proud.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chani kpari Sɔdom polo, amaa ka Ibrahimma na kul ʒe Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then the two men left and went on toward Sodom, but the Lord remained with Abraham.

dag: ka di chɛ ka nir kul ni beni sahakam, ka ku kpi.
en: to keep us from the grave, to let us live forever.

dag: Yi ni yɛn zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Yawɛ maa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: You will dedicate this land to the Lord . It will be , cubits long and , cubits wide.

dag: N ni tim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣindi na ka bɛ ti saɣim a. Bɛ zaa gbibila bɛ bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti ŋmahi yi sida da viɛl la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim.
en: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.

dag: N kul guhima, bɛ ni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli maa zuɣu? Bee bɛ ni ʒiɛya ka bi lan garigi n-yɛli shɛli zuɣu?.
en: I waited for them to answer you. But now they are quiet. They stand there with nothing more to say.

dag: Dama du shɛŋa din daa be dundɔntitali maa ni wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka din mi daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu tooni la wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The row of rooms that ran along the outer courtyard was cubits long, although the total length of the building, as on the Temple side, was cubits long.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa yɛli ni a daa lola a niriba maa zaɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ka a zaŋ ba chaŋ zoya ni ni a ti ku ba kpihim bɛ birili dunia yili? Yihim a suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ a suhu ni, ka chɛ a niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu maa niŋbu.
en: Why should the Egyptians be able to say that you led your people out of Egypt, planning to kill them in the mountains and destroy them completely? Stop being angry; change your mind and do not bring this disaster on your people.

dag: O ni ka yaa maa zuɣu, di nyɛla talahi ni o maani maligu omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu kaman o ni maani niriba daalahichi zuɣu shɛm.
en: He offers sacrifices for their sins, but he must also offer sacrifices for his own sins.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan kpuɣi Ahinɔam ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la pahi, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa leeg o paɣiba.
en: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel. Both Ahinoam and Abigail were Davids wives.

dag: Dama Yawɛ viɛla. O yurilim maŋli kul ni beni sahakam, ka o ʒiɛyimtali mi kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Because the LORD is good, his loyal love lasts forever; his faithfulness lasts generation after generation.

dag: N daa tɛhila n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kpɛhi m bihi ni shɛm, ka tin ya tiŋgban viɛlli. Tiŋgban shɛli din viɛli gari dunia tiŋgbana zaa. Ka n daa tɛhi ni yi ni boli ma yi ba ka ku zo ka chɛ ma dolibu.
en: I thought to myself, How wonderful it would be to treat you like children and give you a beautiful land, an inheritance unrivaled among the nations. And I thought, You will call me father, and you wont turn away from me.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Ahimaaz daa garigi yɛl o, Jɔab ni di tim ma saha shɛli na maa, n di nya zama ni laɣim yo vuri, amaa n di bi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: The king asked, Is young Absalom all right? Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent me, I saw some great excitement, but I dont know what it was.

dag: N zanila n Duuma zaani ni n yɛli dimbɔŋɔ kpahi yi zuɣu ni, di lan maliya bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ka bɛ tɛha nyɛ tɛhi yoya la biɛhigu.
en: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.

dag: ka ti daai yi dikiya luhi n-dahimdahim li pa yi mini yi bihi zuɣu; hal ka tandaɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu, yi ni bi baŋ saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa kana ni o ti tiligi ya la zuɣu.
en: They will crush you completely, you and the people within you. They wont leave one stone on top of another within you, because you didnt recognize the time of your gracious visit from God.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ŋun Naawuni biɛhigu zaa be o Bia maa ni.
en: For it was by God's own decision that the Son has in himself the full nature of God.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ba lala maa, ka zaŋ o nuhi min o puluɣili wuhi ba, ka di niŋ o nyaandoliba maa suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa nya bɛ Duuma maa zuɣu.
en: As soon as he said this, he showed them his hands and his side. When the followers saw the Lord, they were very happy.

dag: O zaŋm binyɛribil piɛl kasi ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli, ka zaŋ shɛlɔr piɛlli lo o shee ni ka vili bantabiga. Di nyɛla situr shɛli din be kasi. O sum kom pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa.
en: Aaron will wash his whole body with water and put on the special clothes. He will put on the linen underwear next to his body, the linen robe, the linen belt, and then he will put the linen turban on his head.

dag: A zali di tariga ni di di chaŋ yaɣi di zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka di ku lan tooi zo n-tiɛli dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: You set a boundary they can never pass, to keep them from covering the earth again.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o mabi dɔbba bee o tizɔpaɣiba bee o ba bee o ma bee o bihi bee o puri, n mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jesus said, I can promise that everyone who has left their home, brothers, sisters, mother, father, children, or farm for me and for the Good News about me.

dag: N suhir a, fam ma m biɛli Iso nuu ni bahi. N zɔr o, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti kana ti ku m mini m bihi ni bɛ manim ŋɔ zaa.
en: Save me, I pray, from my brother Esau. I am afraid—afraid that he is coming to attack us and destroy us all, even the women and children.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya shɛli din niriba be ŋ-ŋɔ biɛri?.
en: Should I punish the people of Judah for doing these things? This message is from the Lord . You know I should punish a nation such as this. I should give it the punishment it deserves.

dag: ka kari ba saria kaman di ni sab zali shɛm. Naawuni niriba bɛn ʒe yim nasara dibu m-bala. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: to punish the nations as God has commanded. This is the victory of God's people. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Bɛn guli Izraɛlnim zaa nyɛla zoomba, bɛ ka baŋsim. Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn doya gbihiri ka bi wahira. Bɛ kul domi gbihiri ka zahindi zahima.
en: The lookouts are blind; they all lack sense. They are all mute dogs that cant bark, dreamers, loungers, loving to sleep.

dag: Ahazia gba daa dolila Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba n-tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o daa nyɛla Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa deemba.
en: Ahaziah did what the Lord said was wrong. He did many bad things, just as the people from Ahabs family had done. He lived like this because his wife was from Ahabs family.

dag: Bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ka o leei maligumaana zan o ba zaani n-ni ti ye binyɛr piɛl kasi m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa.
en: The High Priest, properly ordained and consecrated to succeed his father, is to perform the ritual of purification. He shall put on the priestly garments.

dag: ka zaŋ li tu bansi maa ni din ni chɛ ka dapuhi maa be sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ ayi polo saha shɛli yi yi ti ʒiri li chana.
en: Put the poles through the rings on both sides of the altar. Use these poles for carrying the altar.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Bɛtani dahin shɛli ka o wum ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Lazarɔs daba anahi dali m-bala.
en: When Jesus arrived, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: So Moses and Eleazar did what the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Sool suhu daa na kul yiɣisiri bahirila ti Duuma nyaandoliba zuɣu, ka kul kpɛhiri ba dabiɛm ni o ni ku ba; ka daa chaŋ maligumaaniba zuɣulan sani.
en: In Jerusalem Saul was still trying to scare the followers of the Lord, even saying he would kill them. He went to the high priest.

dag: ni Ahimaaz ŋun daa be Naftali.
en: Ahimaaz, who was married to Basemath, another of Solomon's daughters: the territory of Naphtali.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord said:.

dag: Amaa nir yi di wahala la o ni nyɛ Kristiɛn zuɣu, ŋun di chɛ ka vi mal o, amaa ŋun naɣ paɣimila Naawuni bɛ ni zaŋ Masia yuli pa o yupaa la zuɣu.
en: However, if you suffer because you are a Christian, don't be ashamed of it, but thank God that you bear Christ's name.

dag: Di simdi ka yi be kasi n sani; dama man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be kasi, ka woligi ya zuliyanim ni ni yi nyɛ n dahalali.
en: You must be holy to me, because I the LORD am holy, and I have separated you from all other peoples to be my own.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili n-wumm o yɛligu ka di zaɣisiy o noli, dama yi yi birigi, o ku chɛ yi taali, dama n yuli be o ni.
en: Pay attention to him and do as he says. Dont rebel against him. He wont forgive the things you do wrong because I am with him.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Bɛtani, ka o daa kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Jesus led his followers out of Jerusalem almost to Bethany. He raised his hands and blessed his followers.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan bidibiga daa nyɛ Mɛribbaal, ka Mɛribbaal daa nyɛ Maika ba.
en: Jonathan was the father of Meribbaal, who was the father of Micah.

dag: O daa wuhila tumo maa, A yi kuli ti yɛli naa tɔb maa lahibali naai.
en: Joab told the messenger to tell King David what had happened in the battle.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa deei ti dɔriti mini ti suhugarigu ʒi. Amaa ka ti daa tɛhi ni Naawuni n-darig o tibili ka ti o biɛrim maa.
en: It was certainly our sickness that he carried, and our sufferings that he bore, but we thought him afflicted, struck down by God and tormented.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma ka teeku na kani, ka kɔbilinina din bilisiri kom pampam gba daa na kani.
en: I was born before there was an ocean, before the springs began to flow.

dag: A yi ti chɛ ka bɛ piɛbi kika biɛɣu, bɛn suɣa be wulimpuhili polo la bɛn yiɣisim gbaai chandi.
en: Short blasts on the trumpets will be the way to tell the people to move the camp. The first time you blow a short blast on the trumpets, the tribes camping on the east side of the Meeting Tent must begin to move.

dag: Bɛ yaannim ninni ka o daa tum alahiziba tuma Zɔan bɔpiɛligu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: While their ancestors watched, God performed miracles in the plain of Zoan in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛli naa maa, Ashili shɛli nyin naa ni bɔri ni a baŋ maa, baŋdiba mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni timanim ni laasabuniŋdiba ku tooi wuh a di gbinni.
en: Daniel answered the king, Sages, enchanters, dream interpreters, and diviners cant explain to the king the mystery he seeks.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli, Ka yi nini yi tiɣi tinim bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ, yin zaŋmiya tiŋgbani maa ti ti ka di leei ti dini, ka di zaŋya ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti zɔri binwɔɣila dabiɛm, ka zɔri dabiɛm soli ni. Ka alimɔnd tia daai pum; ka sakɔɣu vur omaŋ chana, ka suhuyubu naai. Dama di zaa ni kuli di yiŋa, ka bɛn fabindi chan doli soya.
en: when people are afraid of things above and of terrors along the way; when the almond tree blanches, the locust droops, and the caper-berry comes to nothing; when the human goes to the eternal abode, with mourners all around in the street.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul be ti sani kpe.
en: They replied, We have nothing here except five loaves of bread and two fish.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: Ti min o yi daa laɣim kpi, ti min o ni ti lan laɣim be.
en: This is a true saying: If we have died with him, we shall also live with him.

dag: Ka buɣim yi ti di so mi tuma zaa, o ni kɔŋ di laara, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ lee ni tiligi, amaa ka di naɣ ni bemi kaman ŋun zo n-yi buɣim ni tiligi.
en: But if your work is burnt up, then you will lose it; but you yourself will be saved, as if you had escaped through the fire.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yihi tinzun buɣa maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka Izraɛlnim nandahima yɛlli maa daa muɣis o pam.
en: So they got rid of their foreign gods and worshiped the Lord ; and he became troubled over Israel's distress.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn kpe tɔb maa tuhibu ni, yin chɛliya ka maligumaaniba kana ti zani tooni n-tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa.
en: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army.

dag: Dauda ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Hiburɔn m-bɔŋɔ: o bituuli n-daa nyɛ Amnɔn ŋun ma daa nyɛ Ahinɔam ka o yi Jɛziriil na la, ŋun pa o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Daniɛl ŋun ma daa nyɛ Abigeel ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la.
en: This is Davids family born to him in Hebron: the oldest Amnon, with Ahinoam the Jezreelite; the second Daniel, with Abigail the Carmelite.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ piibupiibu m-piila Mataias, ka bɛ daa sab o yuli pahi tuumba piniyini maa yuya ni.
en: They drew names, and Matthias was chosen to join the group of the eleven apostles.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ka yiko. Dabiɛm kpe ba, ka di niŋ ba alahiziba. Bɛ ŋmanila mɔri din be mɔɣu ni bee mɔ shɛŋa din bili mɔpilli zuɣu ka na bi zooi ka wuntaŋ ŋme n-ku li.
en: The people who lived there were powerless; they were frightened and stunned. They were like grass in a field or weeds growing on a roof when the hot east wind blasts them.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ, ka daa piig o biŋkɔbiri maa ni shɛb ni o ti o biɛli Iso.
en: Jacob stayed in that place for the night. He prepared some things to give to Esau as a gift.

dag: N ni pii mmaŋmaŋ nini ni tiɣi zuɣulaan shɛb tin ya, ka bɛ zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim sun ya.
en: I will appoint shepherds with whom Im pleased, and they will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɔhimi duŋtaariba maa, Yi bi mi dimbɔŋɔnim maa gbinni? Yɛlim ba, Babilɔn naa n-daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti gbaai di naa mini di kpambaliba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: Ask these rebels if they know what the parable means. Tell them that the king of Babylonia came to Jerusalem and took the king and his officials back with him to Babylonia.

dag: Zom jɛrigu sani, dama a ku nya baŋsim yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: Stay away from foolish people; they have nothing to teach you.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba maa daa yi Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ bɛ zilinkom lab Izraɛlnim maa sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti yɛli ba.
en: Then Phinehas and the leaders left that place and went home. They left the people of Reuben and Gad in the land of Gilead and went back to Canaan. They went back to the Israelites and told them what had happened.

dag: Mahalalɛl ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Jarɛd.
en: When Mahalalel was years old, he had a son named Jared.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di lan booni ya ma Naomi, amaa bolimiya ma la Mara, dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa chɛ ka n nya naŋgbantom.
en: But Naomi told the people, Dont call me Naomi ; call me Marah. Use this name because God All-Powerful has made my life very sad.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, O biɛhigu lee nyɛla wula? Ka o yɛl o, Do kurili n-zaŋ kparibu pɔb omaŋa n-yirina. Di saha ka Sool daa baŋ ni Samuɛl m-bala, ka damdi zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: What does it look like? It looks like an old man wearing a robe. Saul knew it was Samuel, so he bowed down low.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti baŋ ni ti yuri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni bihi. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti yuri Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima.
en: This is how we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep Gods commandments.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di karitiy o, dama ŋunkam bi galindi ya bela yi polo.
en: Do not try to stop him, Jesus said to him and to the other disciples, because whoever is not against you is for you.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisibutali pun be di tuma tumbu ni, amaa din yɛn niŋ maa na ku niŋ faashee Naawuni ti vuui ŋun taɣi di niŋbu zali maa.
en: The secret power of evil is already working in the world now. But there is one who is stopping that secret power of evil. And he will continue to stop it until he is taken out of the way.

dag: amaa n daa bi nya Yisa Masia tuumba maa ni so naɣila ti Duuma tizo Jeemsi.
en: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.

dag: A yi ʒini tiŋa, a ku zɔri dabiɛm; ka a yi dɔni tiŋa, a ni gbihi go nyaɣisili.
en: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. When you rest, your sleep will be peaceful.

dag: N bɔbi n gar bila zali. N zaŋla Ijipti tampiɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ shim niŋ pa di zuɣu.
en: I've covered my bed with sheets of colored linen from Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la ni niriba maa zaa daa deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli ni Anabi Hagai yɛligu, ka saɣ ti o ni o nyɛla Naawuni tumo; ka lu Yawɛ sizuura ka zo o.
en: Then Zerubbabel and Joshua and all the people who had returned from the exile in Babylonia, did what the Lord their God told them to do. They were afraid and obeyed the prophet Haggai, the Lord 's messenger.

dag: Yi yi ti kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, yin chɛliya ka yi buɣa maa tiligi ya. Pɔhim ni ʒe ba chaŋ. Hal ninsal vuhibu pɔhim gba ni ʒe ba chaŋ. Amaa ŋunkam zaa kana ti kpe n yuli, o ni su tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka jɛm ma n zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: When you cry for help, let those idols of yours save you! A puff of wind will carry them off! But those who trust in me will live in the land and will worship me in my Temple.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa na, ka Aduna min o bidibisi ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Next Moses brought forward the bull for the purification offering. Aaron and his sons pressed their hands on its head.

dag: Amaa Sool ni daa nya ka Yawɛ be Dauda sani, ka o bipuɣiŋga Mikal gba yur o maa.
en: King Saul knew that she loved David, and he also realized that the Lord was helping David.

dag: di simdi ni a yo ba bɛ dabisili kam tuma yɔri, ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu, ; di yi pa lala bɛ ni fabili niŋ Yawɛ, ka a kpe taali ni.
en: Each day before sunset pay them for that day's work; they need the money and have counted on getting it. If you do not pay them, they will cry out against you to the Lord , and you will be guilty of sin.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim maa bi lan ʒiri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa bee bɛ ni daa mali neen shɛŋa tumdi di tuma maa gindi yaha.
en: So the Levites dont need to carry the Holy Tent or any of the things used in its services anymore.

dag: ni gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: fine linen; blue, purple, and red wool; cloth made of goats' hair;.

dag: Ka Judanim shɛb bɛn kpalim ni lan zooi m-be kaman ti shɛli din nyaɣa ba tiŋa nti wali wala la;.
en: Those in Judah who survive will flourish like plants that send roots deep into the ground and produce fruit.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba, ka kum mini tiŋgbani dambu ti be bɔb shɛŋa polo.
en: Nations and kingdoms will go to war against each other. People will starve to death, and in some places there will be earthquakes.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Ayuba n-nyuri ansarisi malibo kaman kom la?.
en: Have you ever seen anyone like this man Job? He never shows respect for God.

dag: Ka din daa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li ni suhupiɛlli, amaa ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka zahimbu yi ti paai ba, bɛ zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: The seed on the rock are those who receive the word joyfully when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while but fall away when they are tempted.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha ŋɔ tatabo pam wuhiri salo Naawuni yɛligu kaman bɛ baŋsim tariga ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus used many stories like these to teach the people. He taught them all they could understand.

dag: Ka o daa mal ti paai yiŋa m-bo sua pa o mam maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋmah o niŋkpil pinaayi n-zaŋ o niŋkpil yini kam tim ti ti Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nim zaa.
en: When he arrived, he went in the house and got a knife. He took his concubine's body, cut it into twelve pieces, and sent one piece to each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka Yaakubu paɣ Reechɛl bidibisi daa nyɛ: Yisifu mini Bɛnjamin.
en: Jacob's wife Rachel bore him two sons: Joseph and Benjamin.

dag: Luɣ shɛli din nyɛ liɣa ka so bi lan mi o yɛla soli, luɣ shɛli neesim ni bemi kaman zibisim la. .
en: that land of darkest night, of shadows and confusion, where even the light is darkness.

dag: Pa sokam zaa n-daa nya o, naɣila Naawuni ni daa pii tinim shɛb leei shɛhiranim maa n-daa nya o, ka ti min o laɣim di ka nyu o ni daa neei kum ni maa nyaaŋa.
en: not by everyone but by us. We are witnesses whom God chose beforehand, who ate and drank with him after God raised him from the dead.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa lo ni o ni kun ya la, n daa teemi dɔni m puli zuɣu Yawɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for days and nights.

dag: O ni daa ti paai yuun pinaayi, ka bɛ min o chaŋ Yaɣigari Chuɣu ni kaman bɛ daadiini kali soli ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: When Jesus was twelve years old, they went to the festival as usual.

dag: ka ni deei ti ni suhi shɛlikam o sani, ti ni dol o zaligunim ka tumdi din tiɣir o nini la zuɣu.
en: And God gives us what we ask for. We receive it because we obey Gods commands and do what pleases him.
