dag: Shihira ŋɔ ni ti be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ lahibal suŋ maa yɛda yɛligu ni: Bɛ ni ti mali n yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ni ti tɔɣisi tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa.
en: Believers will be given the power to perform miracles: they will drive out demons in my name; they will speak in strange tongues;.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm din ni tooi kali sagbana? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbiligi zuɣusaa kom kola.
en: Who is wise enough to count the clouds and tip them over to pour out their rain?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa zaa daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa. Ka Dauda daa kul o yiŋa ni o ti suhi alibarika niŋ o yiŋnim ni.
en: Then all of the people left for their homes. And David returned to bless his household.

dag: Ka Kishɔn Mɔɣili kokpɛɣu daa ʒi ba chaŋ. Kishɔn kom din zɔri n-daa ʒi ba chaŋ. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi. N ni chaŋ dari dibu chandi ni kpiɔŋ!.
en: A flood in the Kishon swept them away— the onrushing Kishon River. I shall march, march on, with strength!.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi a ni na ka nyɛ ŋun lo Yawɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, ka wuhiri yikombiɛlim.
en: From you, Nineveh, there came someone full of wicked schemes, who plotted against the Lord .

dag: Marɔtinim kul guhirimi, ka bɛ suhuri ye zaɣ viɛlli zuɣu, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu pun yi Yawɛ sani siɣi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdal ni na.
en: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o tizɔpaɣiba maa daa tim ti yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, a ni yuri so pam la biɛra.
en: The sisters sent Jesus a message: Lord, your dear friend is sick.

dag: Tihi pum puma mɔɣu ni. Noonsi kumbu saha paaya, ka ti wumdi ŋmambihi kumsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.

dag: Bɛ na mi m-be kaman pɔhim ni ʒiɛri mɔ shɛŋa ka be kaman wurigu ka pɔhim ʒe n-chaŋ la?.
en: Does God blow them away, as the wind blows straw or as strong winds blow the grain husks?.

dag: Fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ: Katat mini Nahalal ni Shimrɔn ni Idala ni Bɛtilihɛm: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.

dag: Man Daniɛl kɔŋko n-daa nya ʒii maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani bɛn daa bi nya li, amaa ka dabiɛm lee gbahi ba pam ka bɛ zo nti sɔɣi.
en: Only I, Daniel, saw this vision. The other people who were with me didnt see it. Despite that, they were terrified and ran away to hide.

dag: Ka Jɔab niriba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti zani Amasa sani ka yɛli, Ŋunkam bɔr Jɔab ka nyɛ ŋun be Naa Dauda polo, ŋun doli Jɔab.
en: One of Joab's soldiers stood by Amasa and shouted, If any of you are for Joab and David, then follow Joab.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Jɔshua zaŋ takɔbi tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: In this way Joshua totally defeated the Amalekites.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu n-lɔri ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu nia zuɣu. Biɛɣu yi ti neera, bɛ tumdila tuumbiɛri maa, dama bɛ mali di tumbu yiko.
en: Doom to those who devise wickedness, to those who plan evil when they are in bed. By the light of morning they do it, for they are very powerful.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu ti Hagai m-pahi buyi kulla gol yino maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali n-yɛl o.
en: Another message from the Lord came to Haggai on the th day of the month. This is the message:.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt ni daa wum ni bɛ ku Nɛr bia Abinɛr la Hiburɔn, o kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri zɔhira.
en: Ishbosheth felt like giving up after he heard that Abner had died in Hebron. Everyone in Israel was terrified.

dag: N dimnim yi ŋmaligi, bɛ tuurimi lu n-kpi a tooni.
en: My enemies turn back when you appear; they fall down and die.

dag: Ka yiŋbi so ŋun mi o duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛli ka bi mali shili bee n-tum kaman o duuma maa yubu ni nyɛ shɛm ni nya buri pam.
en: That servant who knew his masters will but didnt prepare for it or act on it will be beaten severely.

dag: Ka nyin Bɛlishaaza ŋun nyɛ o bia ŋɔ mi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla, amaa ka bi siɣis amaŋa.
en: But Belshazzar, you already knew this. You are Nebuchadnezzars grandson, but still you have not made yourself humble.

dag: Saha paaya, dabisili maa vu m-miri, ŋun dari miri ka o mali suhupiɛlli, ka ŋun kɔhiri miri ka o fabinda, dama suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn lula bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: The time is coming. The day is near when buying and selling will have no more meaning, because God's punishment will fall on everyone alike.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti garigi yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ alikauli, ka jɛmdila wun shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: Others will answer, It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.

dag: ka Jɛza daŋ niriba nyɛ Jɛzanima; ka Shilɛm daŋ niriba nyɛ Shilɛmnima.
en: Jezer, and Shillem.

dag: Fɔŋ kara anahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba. Dina n-nyɛ: Shɛkɛm din nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tin shɛli tiligiri la mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la ni Gɛza.
en: the city of Shechem from the hill country of Ephraim , Gezer.

dag: Amaa yinim lihi ʒiɛmla nandaamba. Pa bundaannima n-nahindi ya la? Pa bɛna n-dariti ya tahiri ʒiishee la?.
en: But you dishonor the poor! Who are the ones who oppress you and drag you before the judges? The rich!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul karim gbaŋ shɛli din yi Naa Atazɛrikisɛs sanna maa n-wuhi Rɛhum mini Shimshai ni bɛ tab la, bɛ daa dii zola yomyom chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ kpiɔŋ muɣisi Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu.
en: When the copy of King Artaxerxes letter was read before Rehum and Shimshai the scribe and their colleagues, they hurried to Jerusalem to oppose the Jews and made them stop by force of arms.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia mini niriba maa zaa suhuri daa paligi Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛli ti niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa tum tuma maa naai yomyom pam.
en: Hezekiah and the people were very happy about the things God prepared for his people. And they were happy he did it so quickly!.

dag: Dama m boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka n teei n nuu na, ka yi baɣa ka di ni.
en: I invited you, but you rejected me; I stretched out my hand to you, but you paid no attention.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni bunsi, ka zaŋ binshɛlikam zaa din be tiŋ maa puuni mini din be mɔɣu ni.
en: They took their flocks, their cattle, and their donkeys, whether in the city or in the fields nearby.

dag: Ka paɣ maa paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihitanaata. Di bi simdi ni o shihi binshɛli din be kasi bee n-kpe luɣ kasi shee hal ka o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa maa ti naai.
en: but her loss of blood keeps her from being completely clean for another days. During this time she must not touch anything holy or go to the place of worship.

dag: Ti mi doo ŋɔ ni yi shɛl na, amaa Masia ŋun yi ti yi palo, so ku mi o ni yi shɛl na.
en: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ taali ni yibu Naawuni sani din yi yɛda niŋbu ni na polo di sabiya: Di bɔhi a suhi ni, Ŋuni n-lee ni du alizanda ni? .
en: But the righteousness that comes from faith talks like this: Dont say in your heart , Who will go up into heaven? .

dag: Chɛ ka a ni niŋ yɛda shɛm a suhu ni be a mini Naawuni sunsuuni. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tɛha bi chihir o suhu o ni niŋdi shɛli zuɣu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.

dag: O miri ka o ti chaŋ nir ni kpi n-do luɣ shɛli. O miri ka o saɣim omaŋa, hal di yi nyɛla o ba bee o ma.
en: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.

dag: M mi ni n chandi nyaaŋa ninvuɣ kundun biɛri ni ti kana ti kpe yi ni, ka ku chɛ Naawuni piɛri maa.
en: I know that after I am gone, others will come like fierce wolves to attack you.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi wumbu. Ka o ni daa mali yaa gari Tama maa zuɣu, ka o zaŋ kpeengarigu dɔn o.
en: But Amnon would not listen to what she said. He was stronger than she was, so he overpowered her and raped her.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa kuhi bahi Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Dumiya ka ti sanna ka ti wuhi ya binshɛli. Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa, Doli n nyaaŋa na, dama Yawɛ zaŋ ba niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni.
en: Then they called out to Jonathan and the young man, Come on up here! We have something to tell you! Jonathan said to the young man, Follow me. The Lord has given Israel victory over them.

dag: Buni ku tooi tiligi nir Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: Riches will do you no good on the day you face death, but honesty can save your life.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei kpiimba maa situra, ka nya Sool min o bidibis ata maa ni do Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The next day the Philistines came back to the battlefield to carry away the weapons of the dead Israelite soldiers. When they found the bodies of Saul and his sons on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Balaam, Di doli ba chaŋ, a mi miri ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla alibarika ni be shɛb ni.
en: But God said to Balaam, Dont go with them. You must not curse those people. They are my people.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa bi so ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu tirila o ma suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: These are Solomon's proverbs: Wise children make their fathers proud of them; foolish ones bring their mothers grief.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma, ka nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yihi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda puuni sɔŋsim mini niriba ni niŋ binshɛŋa naani ni bindira sɔŋsim zaa ni kom sɔŋsim zaa.
en: Now the LORD God of heavenly forces is removing from Jerusalem and from Judah every form of support: all rations of food and water.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dagɔn tindaannim mini Ashidɔdnim bɛn zaa yɛn kpe Dagɔn duu maa ni bi lan tamdi di dunɔbia zuɣu kpɛri hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: That is why, even today, the priests or other people refuse to step on the threshold when they enter Dagons temple at Ashdod.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba m-bala kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Meraris family: Mahli and Mushi. These are the Levites clans according to their fathers.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asiba ka Yisa labiri Jɛrusalɛm ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: Early in the morning as Jesus was returning to the city, he was hungry.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paag a min a niriba ni a yaannim zuliya, ka nyɛ zaɣ biɛ shɛli din tatabo na ʒi m-paai ya, Izraɛl zuliya ni daa woligi ka chɛ Juda zuliya dahin shɛl la zaŋ kana zuŋɔ. O yɛn chɛmi ka Asiria naa kana ti liri ya.
en: The LORD will bring upon you, upon your people, and upon your families days unlike any that have come since the day Ephraim broke away from Judah—the king of Assyria.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti sariakarita, ŋuna n-su ti, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti naa. O ni tiligi ti.
en: The LORD is our judge; the LORD is our leader; the LORD is our king— he will deliver us.

dag: N yi bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti be teeku tariga.
en: If I could fly on the wings of dawn, stopping to rest only on the far side of the ocean.

dag: Ka daa kari alizin biɛri pam niriba zuɣu bahi, ka zaŋ kpam ʒe barinim pam gbiɛri n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: They cast out many demons, and they anointed many sick people with olive oil and healed them.

dag: nti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni miri ma. Zaŋm a bihi min a yaansi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu ni a niɣi ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa na;.
en: You can live near me in the land of Goshen. You, your children, your grandchildren, and all of your animals are welcome here.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Taitus suhu ye yi sɔŋbu zuɣu kaman ti gba la.
en: But thank God, who put the same commitment that I have for you in Titus heart.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Ijipti Firawuna Nɛko daa yi n-chani Asiria naa sani Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka Naa Jɔsia daa chaŋ ti lir o sol ni, amaa ka Firawuna Nɛko daa nya o Mɛgido n-ku o.
en: During Josiah's rule, King Neco of Egypt led his army north to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. Josiah led his troops north to fight Neco, but when they met in battle at Megiddo, Josiah was killed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ni ti kpe ŋariŋ n-yiɣisi chaŋ Itali, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool m-pahi dansarika shɛb zuɣu n-ti sapashin so ŋun yuli daa booni Julius. O daa sula tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Naa Siiza Agasitus Maŋmaŋ Tɔbbihi la fukumsi.
en: It was decided that we would sail for Italy. An army officer named Julius, who served in the emperors special army, was put in charge of guarding Paul and some other prisoners on the trip.

dag: dama Naawuni ŋun sani binshɛɣukam nanda.
en: God can do anything.

dag: Ka o daa shiri taɣi doli so shɛli, ka bi lan dol o ni daa pun doli so shɛli ka Bɛtɛl na maa.
en: So he did not go back the same way he had come, but by another road.

dag: Bɛ ni ti leeni taŋkpaɣu kaman wahu la bee kaman tiŋgban ni biŋgbamda la. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa na ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ ti ŋmaligi ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sanna ni dabiɛm pam. Bɛ ni ti zɔr a dabiɛm.
en: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ti bahi sahakam lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli niŋ tinim bɛn nyɛ a piɛ shɛb a ni dihiri ŋɔ?.
en: God, why have you abandoned us forever? Why does your anger smolder at the sheep of your own pasture?.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka lan ka buchi shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Dama a yɛliya, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli, mani n-daa gbi li.
en: The land of Egypt will be turned into a wasteland and ruins. Then they will know that I am the LORD. Because you said, The Nile is mine; I made it.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdali gbini. Ka bɛ daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, naa ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdal la gbini. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa tooni na. Di saha maa Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino daa pun zomi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Then the king got up, and went and sat near the city gate. His men heard that he was there, and they all gathered around him. Meanwhile all the Israelites had fled to their own hometowns.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will save it.

dag: Yinim bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, niŋmiy o naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Followers of the Lord , trust in the Lord ! He is your strength and shield.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta zaligu ŋɔ n-daa wuhi Purim.
en: These laws about Purim are written by the authority of Queen Esther.

dag: Ka Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Ti dim maa n-nyɛ Haman ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ. Di saha maa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Haman naa mini Ɛsta tooni.
en: Esther replied, A man who hates, an enemy—this wicked Haman! Haman was overcome with terror in the presence of the king and queen.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-wurim ba, o baɣa lan ka bɛ ni. Maligumaaniba lan ka jilima, ka niriba bi lan niŋdi kpamba nirilim.
en: It was the LORDs presence that scattered them; he no longer notices them. They didnt honor the priests presence; they didnt favor the elders.

dag: Naawuni bi dih o malaikanim tabili, ka sagbana pala din be kasi o sani.
en: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: He said, Go into the town you can see there. When you enter the town, you will find a young donkey tied there that no one has ever ridden. Untie it, and bring it here to me.

dag: Vihimi Yawɛ kundi ni n-karim di ni yɛli shɛm. Biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ zaɣ yino ku pooi, ka bɛ mi zaa so ku kɔŋ bala. Dama Yawɛ n-zali ni di niŋ lala. Omaŋmaŋ Shia ni laɣim ba na.
en: Consult the LORDs scroll and read: Not one of these will be missing; none will lack its mate. Gods own mouth has commanded; Gods own spirit has gathered them.

dag: Amaa so yi ti yihi yɛli ya, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa, yin di dinya li ŋun yɛli ya maa zuɣu mini suhu ni tɛha zuɣu;.
en: But if someone tells you, This food was offered to idols, then do not eat that food, for the sake of the one who told you and for conscience' sake—.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba dabisi shɛŋa din kanna puuni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ tɛha ni. .
en: This is the covenant that I will make with them in the days to come, says the Lord: I will put my laws in their hearts and write them on their minds.

dag: Di saha maa ka Doɛg ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdom nira ka ʒe Sool sapashin kpamba maa san la daa garigi yɛli Sool, N daa nya Jɛsi bia maa ka o ka Nɔb na nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Ahitub bia la sani.
en: Doeg the Edomite was standing with the other officers and spoke up, When I was in the town of Nob, I saw that son of Jesse. He was visiting the priest Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

dag: Kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya. Yi yi ku kana n ni kana kaman buɣim la nti lu Yisifu zuliya zuɣu. Ka buɣim maa ni di Bɛtɛlnima, ka so kani n-ni kpihi li.
en: Come to the Lord and live. If you dont go to him, a fire will start at Josephs house, and no one in Bethel can stop it.

dag: A me a yili tamla zuɣusaa kom zuɣu, ka zaŋ sagbana leeg a chɛchɛbuŋa, ka ba pɔhim kpiŋkpama.
en: You build your lofty house on the waters; you make the clouds your chariot, going around on the wings of the wind.

dag: Ka di nyɛla Baasha min o bia Ɛla ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa la mini bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi shɛŋa ka di yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu la zuɣu.
en: Because of their idolatry and because they led Israel into sin, Baasha and his son Elah had aroused the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka shi so daa gari n ninni baalim, ka n niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri yirigi.
en: A spirit passed by my face. The hair on my body stood up!.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi daa vili ma gbibi, ka kum zana daa do n tooni.
en: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.

dag: Musa mini Aduna maa n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: It was also this same Moses and Aaron who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt to bring the Israelites out of Egypt.

dag: ni Barikɔs daŋ niriba ni Sizɛra daŋ niriba ni Tɛma daŋ niriba.
en: Barkos, Sisera, Temah.

dag: N ni daa nya biŋkɔb so maa daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, ka o naba mali nyinyɛ wɔɣila, ka ŋmani bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la naba, ka o noli ŋmani gbuɣinli noli. Ka waɣ biɛ tital la daa zaŋ o yiko min o nam ʒiishee ni o fukumsi din galisi pam la ti o.
en: The beast I saw was like a leopard. Its feet were like a bears, and its mouth was like a lions mouth. The dragon gave it his power, throne, and great authority.

dag: Ka yinim Judanima, n zali yi gba dabisili, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn labisi n niriba daazichi ti ba.
en: For you also, Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I would improve the circumstances of my people.

dag: Yɛlimiya yi bihi di yɛla; ka bɛ mi ti zaŋ di yɛla maa n-yɛli bɛ bihi, ka bɛ gba ti zaŋ di yɛla n-yɛli ʒiɛman shɛli din kanna niriba.
en: You will tell these things to your children, and your children will tell their children, and your grandchildren will tell the people of the next generation.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ka a ti yɛli ma, Cham ti yɛli a dan naa, Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: Do you really want me to tell him you're here?.

dag: ni gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: blue, purple, and red yarn and fine linen; goat hair.

dag: di simdi ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la.
en: The priest must lift up these things and burn them on the altar for burnt offerings, just as he does for the fellowship offering.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim shɛb bɛn be zoya tinsi ni mini bɛn be Nɛgɛb ni bɛn be zolɔna ni tinsi ni la.
en: Afterward, the people of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the highlands, the southern plain, and the western foothills.

dag: bɔzuɣu ka nyini zo shɛli dim mali chunchuna ŋɔ lihiri Naawuni ni bɔri ni zo shɛli nyɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ nyuli zabbu lihigu? Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni bɔri ni o be sahakam.
en: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ teeku nol ni, ka salo pam yi Galili dol o; ka shɛb mi daa yi Judia.
en: Jesus and his disciples went away to Lake Galilee, and a large crowd followed him. They had come from Galilee, from Judea.

dag: Ti zaligu wuhiya ni ti karimi nir saria ka na bi bɔh o baŋ o ni niŋ shɛli.
en: Our law will not let us judge anyone without first hearing them and finding out what they have done.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka Yawɛ shia daa zaŋ ma ti zali vinvamli sunsuuni. Kɔba n-daa pali di ni.
en: I felt the powerful presence of the Lord , and his spirit took me and set me down in a valley where the ground was covered with bones.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya nyaŋ ti, amaa ka a chɛ li paŋ ti.
en: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.

dag: Bɔ n-chɛ ka bɛ daa kpalim bɛ piɛri sani ni bɛ wumdi piɛguliba ni piɛbiri yuhi booni piɛri shɛm? Iin, Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: So why did you sit there against the walls of your sheep pens? The brave soldiers of Reuben thought hard about war. But they stayed home listening to the music they played for their sheep.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Bɛlanima; ka Ashibɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Ashibɛlnima; ka Ahiram daŋ niriba nyɛ Ahiramnima;.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Benjamin were Bela—the Belaite family group; Ashbel—the Ashbelite family group; Ahiram—the Ahiramite family group;.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya shihir shɛli Yisa ni wuhi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni anab so ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la n-shiri bala.
en: After the people had seen Jesus work this miracle, they began saying, This must be the Prophet who is to come into the world.

dag: Ka man Jɔn daa wum ka kukoli maa lan yɛli, Yinim alizanda ni nim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni Yisa tuumba ni anabinima, maliya suhupiɛlli o dahimbu maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni m-bɔh o biɛri tin ya maa.
en: Be happy because of this, O heaven! Be happy, Gods holy people and apostles and prophets! God has punished her because of what she did to you.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti tam Taai yɛla yuun pisopɔin din nyɛ naa yuusim tariga la. Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti paai, Taai ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ pagɔr so yɛla yili yilli.
en: On that day, Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, the lifetime of one king. At the end of seventy years, Tyre will become like the prostitute in the song.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Naawuni, Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun nyɛ Mɔab naa la n-tim ba na ti yɛli ma.
en: He answered, King Balak of Moab has sent them to tell me.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl .
en: Then he set up an altar there and named it El Elohe Israel.

dag: ka bo zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram yini n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla.
en: and one-tenth of fine flour for a grain offering mixed with oil for each lamb. It is an entirely burned offering with a soothing smell, a food gift to the LORD.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Dauda Jɔab ni daa yɛl o ni o ti yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: So the messenger set off, and when he arrived he reported to David everything Joab sent him to say.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri woligibu na, ka nyɛ bɛn maŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu yubu su ba, ka Naawuni Shia ka bɛ ni.
en: These are the people who divide you. They are not spiritual, because they dont have the Spirit.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni pam ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ bɛ daa yɛlimi, Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ din kpɛm pam; ŋuni n-lee ni tooi deei li.
en: Many of his followers heard this and said, This teaching is too hard. Who can listen to it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa Buzi bia Ɛzɛkiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la zuɣu, ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: The LORDs word burst in on the priest Ezekiel, Buzis son, in the land of Babylon at the Chebar River. There the LORDs power overcame him.

dag: Timiya ma soli ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka n yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa naai, di nyaaŋa, yin malimiya ma ansarisi.
en: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim Farisiinim paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka yi puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali.
en: The Lord said to him, Now, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and platter, but your insides are stuffed with greed and wickedness.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla kuɣ pinaayi, ka a ti zaŋ chiriga chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu. Niŋmi li kaman bɛ ni niŋdi dalinli shɛli bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu shɛm la din ni chɛ ka zuliya pinaayi maa yuya be di ni.
en: There will be twelve stones with names corresponding to the names of Israels sons. They will be engraved like official seals, each with its name for the twelve tribes.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣis o, ka nahim o, amaa ka o bi yaag o noli. Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi chaŋ kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi piɛbil chani kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛɣu kɔbiri ka o fo shɛm la. O daa bi yaag o noli.
en: He was treated badly, but he never protested. He said nothing, like a lamb being led away to be killed. He was like a sheep that makes no sound as its wool is being cut off. He never opened his mouth to defend himself.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia hal ti paag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: The Babylonian army chased King Zedekiah and caught him near Jericho. All of Zedekiahs soldiers left him and ran away.

dag: Miriya ka yi lo tab zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu nia yi suhuri ni. Yi mi miriya ka yi pɔri pɔri n-diri ʒiri shɛhira. N je dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord , hate such things.

dag: O ni daa ti paana, o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba, m puhir a! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Judas went straight to Jesus and said, Peace be with you, Teacher, and kissed him.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa bo mi pala lo o, ka kuhi yɛl o, Samsin Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣi do n-gu o maa be yil maa ni du shɛl ni. Ka Samsin daa darigi chihi mihi maa kaman gal la.
en: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him up with them. Then she called out to him, Samson, the Philistines are on you! Once again, an ambush was waiting in an inner room. Yet he snapped them from his arms like thread.

dag: Di saha maa Saimɔn Pita daa ʒiɛmi wuɣisiri buɣim. Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba pala o nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka o daa chihi yɛli, M pala o nyaandola.
en: While Simon Peter was standing there warming himself, someone asked him, Aren't you one of Jesus' followers? Again Peter denied it and said, No, I am not.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di lihibu daa mali dabiɛm hal ka Anabi Musa ti yɛli, N ni sɔhirimi dabiɛm zuɣu.
en: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Absalom, ka o kana ti damdi naa tooni, ka naa daa mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Joab went to David and told him what Absalom had said. David sent for Absalom, and Absalom came. He bowed very low, and David leaned over and kissed him.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria nanim pun saɣim zuliya pam tiŋgbɔna.
en: It is true, Lord . The kings of Assyria did destroy all those nations.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi nyɛla yi ni zaŋ yimaŋ ti so n-deer o noli daba? Di yi nyɛla alahichi tumbu din tahiri nir kum ni bee Naawuni noli deebu din zaŋdi nir zaani wuntia zaani, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Surely you know that when you surrender yourselves as slaves to obey someone, you are in fact the slaves of the master you obey—either of sin, which results in death, or of obedience, which results in being put right with God.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira, ka yi Bahurim na la gba beni. O daa tu ma tu biɛri dahin shɛli n ni daa chaŋ Mahanaim la, amaa o ni daa kana nti tuhi ma soli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la, n daa po Yawɛ yɛl o, N ku zaŋ takɔb ku a.
en: Now as for this Shimei, Geras son—a Benjaminite from Bahurim—who is with you, he cursed me viciously when I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD, Surely I wont execute you with the sword.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba yiɣisi tiŋ maa ni.
en: That night Jesus and his followers left the city.

dag: Amaa di liɣisibu maa yi kul kpalim be luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi gil o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, amaa ka sabigi, di nyɛla bimmɔriŋ din yi buɣim yum maa ni na, ka di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla buɣim wuliɛɣu.
en: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaam amaŋa ni bi pala kɔr biɛri tuma, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-mali biɛr kasi mini yɛda ni yurilim ni suhudoo, ka di chɛ ka a pahi bɛn doli ti Duuma ka bɛ suhuri ka daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: Run away from adolescent cravings. Instead, pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace together with those who confess the Lord with a clean heart.

dag: Yisa ni daa naai ŋaha ŋɔ, o daa yila nimaani.
en: When Jesus finished teaching with these stories, he left there.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yuli ba ka bɔhi ba, Wula ka di lee sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛl la? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. .
en: But Jesus looked straight at them and said, Then what do the Scriptures mean when they say, The stone the builders tossed aside is now the most important stone of all?.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba shɛb daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli salo bɛn daa laɣim maa zaa.
en: After that, some of the elders stood up and said to the people who had gathered.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha, ka wuntaŋ daa bi lan ne. Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu la cheei di sunsuuni m-pirigi buyi.
en: It was now about noon, and darkness covered the whole earth until about three oclock.

dag: N Naawuni, nyini ka n niŋ naani. Di chɛ ka n di vi; a mi di chɛ ka n dimnim di nasara ka chɛ ma.
en: I trust in you, my God, and I will not be disappointed. My enemies will not laugh at me.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lihi ka wum ka tɔrili be zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbusim, mbusim, mbusim be dunianim zuɣu, malaikanima ata shɛb bɛn kpalim n-na yɛn piɛb bɛ kikahi la zuɣu.
en: Then I looked, and I heard an eagle that was flying high in the air say in a loud voice, O horror! horror! How horrible it will be for all who live on earth when the sound comes from the trumpets that the other three angels must blow.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: Its porch faced the outer courtyard. Palms decorated its arches, and its stairway had eight steps.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka niriba pam bɛn daa ka chuɣu maa ni na wum ni Yisa kani Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: The next day a large crowd was in Jerusalem for Passover. When they heard that Jesus was coming for the festival.

dag: Ka bɛn yi dɔɣim kam zaa ni mini zuliya balibu kam ni ni niriba balibu kam ni ni tinzun yɛligu kam nim ni na ni ti lihiri ba ka zaɣisi ba sɔɣibu, ka bɛ ni do nimaani dabisi muna ata ni pirigili.
en: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ zina, ka ku niriba. Bɛ niŋ zina bɛ buɣa sani, ka zaŋ bɛ ni daa dɔɣi m bi shɛb la ku n-ti ba ni bɛ ŋubi.
en: They have been unfaithful by worshiping idols, and they have committed murder by sacrificing my own children as offerings to idols.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Cham Juda nayili nti zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ba.
en: The LORD proclaims: Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and declare this message.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa chɛ o kɔchuɣu zali nimaani ka lab fɔŋ ni ti yɛli niriba.
en: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun yuri yɛm, amaa bɛn je ni bɛ wuhi ba bɛ galimi nyɛla jɛra.
en: Whoever loves discipline loves to learn; whoever hates to be corrected is stupid.

dag: Sulemaana daa yi nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuuni kam puuni.
en: Every year Solomon got almost tons of gold.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ti Duuma tɛha bee ŋuni n-lee nyɛ o saawaralana?.
en: Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi chaŋ zoya ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti paai Ɛshikol Vinvamli ni m-puɣisi chaŋ ti kaai li.
en: They went into the hill country as far as Eshcol Valley and explored it.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, ka n nya suhupiɛlli pɔi ka naanyi chaŋ n chandi shee n-leei ŋun ku lan beni yaha.
en: Look away from me so I can be happy again before I pass away and am gone.

dag: Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Bɔzuɣu ka bidibiga ku di wahala o ba tuumbiɛri zuɣu? Bidibiga maa yi nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, ka nyɛ ŋun doli n zaligunim zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: But you ask, Why shouldn't the son suffer because of his father's sins? The answer is that the son did what was right and good. He kept my laws and followed them carefully, and so he will certainly live.

dag: Di saha yi ni baŋ wuntitali mini zaligu soli ni biɛrisuntali ni so viɛlli kam.
en: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino daa yɛl o, A yi di saɣi n-dol ti chaŋ. Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ.
en: One of them said, Please go with us. Elisha said, Yes, I will go with you.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn saɣi siɣis amaŋa n tooni? Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Moses and Aaron went to the king and told him that the Lord God of the Hebrews had said: How long will you stubbornly refuse to obey? Release my people so they can worship me.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri bu ma paa, ka n leei piɛ shɛb bɛ ni daa yɛn ku gula. Ka n daa bo jaaŋgbɛh ayi m-boli zaɣ yini yuli anfaani, ka boli din pah ayi mi yuli naŋgban yini. Ka n daa leei piɛri maa gula.
en: So I shepherded the flock intended for slaughter, the afflicted of the flock. I took two staffs for myself. I named one Delight; the other I named Harmony. I shepherded the flock.

dag: O doli zaligu soli n-zabiri kpibisi mini pakoya zuɣu, ka yuri saamba, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini situra.
en: He makes sure that orphans and widows are treated fairly; he loves the foreigners who live with our people, and gives them food and clothes.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa ka o sanna, ka o leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka Otiniɛl daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Otiniɛl nyaŋ o. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord filled Othniel, and he became a judge for the Israelites. He led the Israelites to war. The Lord helped Othniel defeat King Cushan Rishathaim of Aram.

dag: Ka paɣ maa mi daa zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni daa mali zal o tiŋgban nɛli ni ni o be nimaani ka o dihir o hal ti paai biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu la.
en: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for , days.

dag: Dama yi kpimi ka yi nyɛviya pahi Masia zuɣu n-sɔɣi Naawuni ni.
en: Your old self has died, and your new life is kept with Christ in God.

dag: Di saha ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mi ni bɛ paɣiba maanila buɣa mini paɣiba bɛn zaa daa ʒe nimaani, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Patrɔs Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa garigi yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then all the men who knew that their wives offered sacrifices to other gods, and all the women who were standing there, including the Israelites who lived in southern Egypt—a large crowd in all—said to me.

dag: Solɔɣu ni ti be nimaani ka di yuli booni Soli din be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be daɣiri ni ti ku doli soli maa; ka sochanda ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu gba ti ku yirigi soli maa zuɣu.
en: There will be a road there. This highway will be called The Holy Road. Evil people will not be allowed to walk on that road. No fools will walk on it. Only good people will walk there.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ alɔbo shɛŋa mini jɛŋgbar shɛb bɛn bahi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yoli maa kɔtomsi, ka di lan simdi ni yi ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa jilima, di pa shɛli o ku lan darigi yi mini yi buɣa ni yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tibili yaha.
en: So make five gold models of the sores and five gold models of the rats that are wiping out your crops. If you honor the God of Israel with this gift, maybe he will stop causing trouble for you and your gods and your crops.

dag: Ka tumtumda maa garigi yɛli Sool, M mali anzinfa laɣifu kpe, n ni zaŋ li ti Naawuni nir maa ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: Here, the boy answered Saul, Ive got a quarter-shekel of silver. Ill give that to the man of God so he tells us which way to go. .

dag: Shia maa daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛ gba chanimi, ka kalima maa gba wuɣi du n-doli ba. Dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela kalima maa ni.
en: They went wherever the spirit wanted them to go, and the wheels went with them, because the power that moved the living being was in the wheels.

dag: a ni ti bɔhim bɛ biɛhigu maa, ka di chɛ ka a kpɛh amaŋ zana ni.
en: otherwise, you will learn their ways and become trapped.

dag: N yiɣisirila yuntisuɣu m-paɣir a, a wuntia zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: In the middle of the night, I get up to thank you because your laws are so fair.

dag: M bi bɔri ni n ti nyan ya la biɛla ka gari; ti Duuma yi saɣi n niŋdi tahima ni n ni ti yuui yi sani.
en: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka yɔɣili bili gara maa gbini n-zooi du nti pani gara maa zuɣusaa n-niŋ mahim ni Jona ʒi di lɔŋni ka o ni maha. Ka yɔɣili maa ni daa du m-pa Jona zuɣusaa shɛm maa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: The Lord made a gourd plant grow quickly over Jonah. This made a cool place for Jonah to sit and helped him to be more comfortable. He was very happy because of this plant.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Nyama, n ni kana kaman tayiɣ la! Ŋum bi gbihiri ka mal o binyɛra zali ni o di ti chaŋ o zaɣim n-dih omaŋ vi mal alibarika.
en: Listen! I am coming like a thief! Happy is he who stays awake and guards his clothes, so that he will not walk around naked and be ashamed in public.

dag: Bɛ mi di yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim so, ka di ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni, amaa ka lee be baalim, ka mali sizuura lubu biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani.
en: They shouldnt speak disrespectfully about anyone, but they should be peaceful, kind, and show complete courtesy toward everyone.

dag: Yawɛ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli vuri yi Jɛrusalɛm na; ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani sɔhira. Amaa Yawɛ sani n-nyɛ o niriba sɔɣibu shee; Izraɛlnim sɔɣibu viɛlli shee m-bala.
en: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba ni nya li ka zo dabiɛm, di saha ka bɛ ni la a ka yɛli.
en: The righteous will see and be in awe; they will laugh at those people.

dag: Chɛliya ka dunianim zaa ni sɔhiri o tooni. Dunia nyɛla din ba n-ʒiɛya, ka ku lan vuui.
en: Tremble before him, all the earth! Yes, he set the world firmly in place; it wont be shaken.

dag: M be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je suhudoo sani n-yuui pam.
en: I have lived too long with people who hate peace!.

dag: Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, wula ka yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi yi yi nol ni na ka yi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ? Dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: You snakes! You are so evil. How can you say anything good? What people say with their mouths comes from what fills their hearts.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n ni yɛn tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, chɛ ka di kpe a tiba ni, ka a deei li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Then God said to me, Son of man, listen to every word I say to you and remember them.

dag: Di saha ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa chaŋ Shɛkɛm, dama nimaani ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim ni bɛ leeg o nam.
en: Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all the people of northern Israel had gathered to make him king.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka kuɣili ni marigi ŋun biligi li.
en: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.

dag: Hal kunduna gba chɛ ka bɛ bihi mɔɣira, amaa n niriba maa bɛn malila ninkuunsi kaman taatahi bɛn be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ piim tiliginsim tinsi kaman n ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi niɣi chani vinvamli ni shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ Shia daa ti o niriba vuhim. Lala ka o daa wuh o niriba maa soli, ka di ti o yuli jilima.
en: Like cattle descending to the valley, the LORDs spirit brought them to rest. In this way you led your people and made for yourself a glorious reputation.

dag: Daadam Bia ni ti tim o malaikanim na, ka bɛ ti yaa binshɛɣukam din chɛ ka niriba tumd alahichi mini tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa bɛn be o nam ni.
en: The Son of Man will send his angels, and they will find the people who cause sin and all those who do evil. The angels will take those people out of his kingdom.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, ka tumdi din tuhi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli ka di yiri bɛ suhuri ni na.
en: Only those who live pure lives, do what is right, and speak the truth from their hearts.

dag: Shɛli daa bi poori bɛ ni so, dama bɛnkam daa mali puri bee yiya daa kɔhi li mi n-zaŋ di liɣiri maa zaa na.
en: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛhɔinai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛrahia bia la daa nyɛ Pahatimɔab daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbisiyi daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai, Zerahiahs son and with him men.

dag: O yurilim maŋli la naala zaa? O daalikaulinim la zanila tariga sahakam maa?.
en: Has his faithful love come to a complete end? Is his promise over for future generations?.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la pahi maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni daa tim salo pam shɛba ka bɛ nyaɣiri takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi la dii paana.
en: Jesus was still speaking, when Judas the betrayer came up. He was one of the twelve disciples, and a large mob armed with swords and clubs was with him. They had been sent by the chief priests and the nation's leaders.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N ni be a sani. Dimbɔŋɔ mi n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri ni mani n-tim a, a yi ti yihi niriba maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, yi ni ti jɛmdi man Naawuni zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: God said, Ill be with you. And this will show you that Im the one who sent you. After you bring the people out of Egypt, you will come back here and worship God on this mountain.

dag: chaŋ Hiburɔn ti zaŋ li ti Naa Dauda ka yɛl o, Naa, a dim Sool ŋun daa kul dol a ni o ku a la bia Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ. Yawɛ m-bɔhi Sool min o bihi biɛri n-ti n dan naa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ maa.
en: Finally they turned west and went to Hebron. They went in to see David and told him, Your Majesty, here is the head of Ishbosheth, the son of your enemy Saul who tried to kill you! The Lord has let you get even with Saul and his family.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa gindi fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi yihiri waazu, ka mali Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ yɛla wuhiri niriba. Ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la daa be o sani.
en: Soon after this, Jesus was going through towns and villages, telling the good news about God's kingdom. His twelve apostles were with him.

dag: Lihimiya n nuhi mini n naba, ka baŋ ni mani m-bala. Tabisimiya ma nya, dama alizini ka niŋgbuŋ mini kɔba ka n ni mali shɛm ŋɔ. .
en: Look at my hands and my feet, and see that it is I myself. Feel me, and you will know, for a ghost doesn't have flesh and bones, as you can see I have.

dag: Baŋmiya ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ŋuna n-nam ti, ka ti nyɛ o ni su shɛba. Ti nyɛla o niriba, ka nyɛ o ni gul shɛba kaman piɛri la.
en: Acknowledge that the Lord is God. He made us, and we belong to him; we are his people, we are his flock.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ daalahichi zaa tumbu, ka doli n zaligunima zaa, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: If someone evil stops sinning and keeps my laws, if he does what is right and good, he will not die; he will certainly live.

dag: N yi nya jilima Firawuna min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ŋɔ zuɣu, di saha ka Ijiptinim maa ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then Egypt will know that I am the Lord . They will honor me when I defeat Pharaoh and his horse soldiers and chariots.

dag: Di saha maa ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N wum suhigu shɛli a ni suhi zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Isaiah went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, I heard your prayer about King Sennacherib of Assyria.

dag: Ibrahimma ni daa deei n noli ka doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: because Abraham did everything I told him to do.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligina, ka di gari Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni yɛl biɛɣu paai ba mi maa.
en: The main force of the Israelites turned around, and the Benjaminites lost heart, because they recognized that disaster had fallen on them.

dag: Ka a ti daŋ n tooni chaŋ Giligal, nyama, n ni ka nimaani na ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligunima. Di simdi ka a ti guhi ma nimaani daba ayopɔin hal ka n ti kana ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Then go to Gilgal. I'll come a little later, so wait for me. It may even take a week for me to get there, but when I come, I'll offer sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask for his blessings. I'll also tell you what to do next.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tiliginsim yirila Yawɛ sanna, ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani bɛ wahala saha.
en: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; he is their refuge in times of trouble.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, O be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, M bi mi.
en: They asked him, Where is this man? He answered, I dont know.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛvi mini Rɛkɛm ni Zur ni Hur ni Rɛba bɛn daa nyɛ Midian nanim la m-pahi bɛ ni daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Bɛɔr bia Balaam gba.
en: Among the people who they killed were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with a sword.

dag: nti mali Lɛvi nir ŋun nyɛ maligumaana mini sariakarita ŋun be tuma ni di dabisa maa ni saawara, ka bɛ ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm.
en: You must go to the priests who are Levites and to the judge on duty at that time. They will decide what to do about that problem.

dag: Ka Kiriatijiarimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-kuli ti zaŋ li tahi do so ŋun yuli daa booni Abinadab ka o yili be daboli zuɣu la yiŋa. Ka bɛ daa piig o bia Ɛliɛza ni o yuuni Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took the Lord s Holy Box up the hill to the house of Abinadab the priest. They performed a special ceremony to prepare Abinadabs son, Eleazar, to guard the Lord s Holy Box.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri suhu din be kasi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi nyɛ naa zɔnima.
en: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi, ka ti Duuma dabisi titali din mali jilima pam la naanyi kana.
en: the sun will be darkened, and the moon will turn red as blood, before the great and glorious Day of the Lord comes.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri ku Hɛliɔpolis mini Bubastis nachimba, ka gbahi tinsi maa nim ti leei daba.
en: The young men of the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in the war, and the other people will be taken prisoner.

dag: Naawuni ka n niŋ naani, ka ku zo dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: I trust in God; I wont be afraid. What can anyone do to me?.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmahim do so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai do so yoli, o bi simdi ni bɛ deeg o niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: A man with a crushed testicle or part of his sex organ cut off may not join with the men of Israel to worship the Lord .

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa deei bɛ bindira maa shɛli di, ka bi suhi Yawɛ n-niŋ o saawara di zuɣu.
en: The men of Israel wanted to know if these men were telling the truth. So they tasted the bread—but they did not ask the Lord what they should do.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli pal shɛli din yuli booni Dɛde la nti bɔhi ka bɛ wuh a Judas yiŋa, ka a bɔhi Sool ŋun nyɛ Taasus nir la yɛla. Nyama, o be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: The Lord said to him, Get ready and go to Straight Street, and at the house of Judas ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul. He is praying.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa doli vinvamli ni yuŋ maa n-yuuni nimaani polo chani ka yuuni gooni maa. Ka n daa lan ŋmaligi doli Vinvamli Dunɔdal la labi.
en: So I went up the valley in the dark, inspecting the wall. Finally, I turned back and went back in through the Valley Gate.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Judas daa chaŋ ti zaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa tim tɔbbi shɛb mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuun shɛb la pa omaŋ zuɣu; ka bɛ bo firilanim mini buɣim mokpala ni bidibbina n-kari Yisa naba nimaani.
en: So Judas went to the garden, taking with him a group of Roman soldiers, and some Temple guards sent by the chief priests and the Pharisees; they were armed and carried lanterns and torches.

dag: Naawuni mi bi deeri ti la bindirigu dibu zuɣu: Ti yi di, di bi pahiri ti shɛli; ti mi yi bi di, di bi filindi ti.
en: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yi Ijipti kana ka bɛ ni sɔhiri kaman noombihi la. Ka shɛb ti yi Asiria kana kaman ŋmana la, ka n ti zaŋ ba labisi bɛ yinsi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will come from Egypt, shaking like birds. They will come shaking like doves from the land of Assyria, and I will take them back home. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa nya yaa pam, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi, ka lan me nɛma sɔŋbu shee tinsi zali Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: As Jehoshaphat grew increasingly powerful, he built fortresses and storage cities in Judah.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli, yi mi di ti zaŋ gaŋbu bee birapu dibu kpɛhi yi bebu ni, dama birapu dibu nyɛla din chɛ ka baŋda nina bi ne, ka chɛ ka bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli kɔŋdi yɛlimaŋli.
en: Dont delay justice; dont show favoritism. Dont take bribes because bribery blinds the vision of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

dag: Yihim ma vi shɛli n ni zɔri ni, dama a zaligunim viɛla.
en: Save me from the insults I fear; how wonderful are your judgments!.

dag: Yawɛ Shia tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n sani, ka o yɛligu be n zilinli zuɣu.
en: The spirit of the Lord speaks through me; his message is on my lips.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni laɣiŋgu titali ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim kɔbil nini ŋɔ!.
en: Praise God in the meeting place. Praise the Lord , people of Israel!.

dag: ni Ahiam ŋun daa nyɛ Sakar Harar nir la bia ni Ɛlifal ŋun daa nyɛ Ur bia la.
en: Ahiam, Sachars son from Harar; Eliphal, Urs son.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man kul suhira. Naawuni, garigim ma a ni zali saha shɛli a yurilim maŋli din galisi la puuni min a ʒiɛyimtali sɔŋsim la puuni.
en: But I pray to you, Lord . So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di to ni bundana kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, I assure you that it will be very hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti ni mali tahima shɛli yɛda la kirikiri ka di viini ginda, dama ŋun lo ti alikauli maa nyɛla ŋun kul ʒe yim.
en: Lets hold on to the confession of our hope without wavering, because the one who made the promises is reliable.

dag: Ka so di ti bɔhi ni o nyɛla ŋun viɛl bee ŋun bi viɛla, ka so mi di ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, ka so yi ti zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o, dindina o min o ni zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o maa zaa ni leei din be kasi, ka so ku lan tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: The owner should not worry if the chosen animal is good or bad or change the animal for another animal. If this happens, both animals will belong to the Lord . That animal cannot be bought back.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya ni yi yi kul bɔri binshɛɣukam ka suhi Naawuni, yin niŋmiya yɛda ni yi ni nya li, ka yi shiri ni nya li.
en: Everything you ask for in prayer will be yours, if you only have faith.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa lab maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim maa sani, ka bɛ ti bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bi ʒi o na.
en: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, Why didn't you bring Jesus here.

dag: Pa nyini n-sa gariche gili Ayuba min o malibu ni o ni su shɛlikam zaa luɣilikam? Nyini n-niŋ alibarika niŋ o tuma ni, ka chɛ ka o buni galisi pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Havent you fenced him in—his house and all he has—and blessed the work of his hands so that his possessions extend throughout the earth?.

dag: Dinzuɣu biɛɣuni asiba di yi sa kul neerina, a min a niriba bɛn doli ma kana maa yin daŋmiya yiɣisibu n-labi yiŋ yomyom.
en: So then, David, tomorrow morning all of you who left Saul and came over to me will have to get up early and leave as soon as it's light.

dag: Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai, ka o baŋ o niŋgbuŋ ni ni o nya alaafee.
en: As soon as she touched them, her bleeding stopped, and she knew she was healed.

dag: Di kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Salima taha pihita min anzinfa taha tuhili ni tahi shɛŋa pihitayinika.
en: This was the count: thirty gold dishes, one thousand silver dishes, twenty-nine knives.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni naɣila o Bi gaŋ ŋun ʒi n-dalim o Ba Naawuni nyɔɣu la kɔŋko. Ŋuna n-wuhi ti Naawuni ni nyɛ so.
en: No one has ever seen God. The only Son, who is truly God and is closest to the Father, has shown us what God is like.

dag: Firawuna yi ti yɛli ya ni yi tummi alahiziba tuuni din wuhiri ni mani n-shiri tim ya na, nyin yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee bahi tiŋa Firawuna tooni ka di leei wahu.
en: When Pharaoh says to you, Do one of your amazing acts, then say to Aaron, Take your shepherds rod and throw it down in front of Pharaoh, and it will turn into a cobra.

dag: Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din daa gili Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa nanim zaa dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa bi buɣisi ni bɛ lo tɔbu n-tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord 's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Hɛrɔdias lo Jɔn zaɣ biɛɣu m-bɔri ni o ku o; amaa ka daa bi tooi.
en: So Herodias had it in for John. She wanted to kill him, but she couldnt.

dag: O daa bi nya ka di nyɛ shɛli ni o tum Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la tatabo. O daa kpuɣila Sidɔn Naa Ɛtibaal bipuɣiŋga Jɛzibɛl n-niŋ o paɣa, ka daa jɛmdi buɣili Baal.
en: He acted just like Jeroboam. Even worse, he married Jezebel the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon and started worshiping Baal.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuliya kam wummiya, ka baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ ba.
en: So the Lord said, Listen, you nations, and learn what is going to happen to my people.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa garigi yɛl o, Din kariya, din kariya ka n saɣim bee n-wurim ya ŋɔ.
en: Joab answered, I dont want to destroy anything. I dont want to ruin your city.

dag: Zɔŋ maa ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di daa mali dunɔdura pia din kpɛri di ni. Ka daantalisi daa be di yaɣa ayi zuɣu m-pahi pilanim zuɣu.
en: The porch was cubits wide and cubits long. Ten steps went up to the porch. There were two columns for the walls on either side of the porch—one at each wall.

dag: N shini ka di yuui, N kul gbaala mmaŋ ka fo. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuhi pam kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi. N ni vuhi parim.
en: For a long time I have said nothing. I have controlled myself and kept quiet. But now I will cry out like a woman giving birth. My breathing is getting faster and louder.

dag: Nandaamba kul ku kɔŋ dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya, Teemiya yi nuu n-tim faranim mini yi ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni pina.
en: There will always be poor people in the land. That is why I command you to be ready to help your brother or sister. Give to the poor in your land who need help.

dag: Dimiya li, di nyɛla din be kasi. Dɔbba kɔŋko n-ni tooi di li. Di nyɛla din be kasi yi sani.
en: Since these things are sacred, they must be eaten near the sacred tent, but only men are allowed to eat them.

dag: Gbibi n nyɛvili, dama n zaŋla mmaŋ zaa ti a; tiligim a dabili ŋun niŋ a naani ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka buchi, ka so bi mi bɛ yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ ni daa fiɛbi ninvuɣ shɛb yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: A worthless bunch of nameless nobodies! They were driven out of the land.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din gba lan pahi n-daa nyɛ: Halihul mini Bɛtizur ni Gɛdɔr.
en: The people of Judah were also given these towns: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, di zaŋ kiŋkansi doli ma, dama tuuni ŋɔ na ʒi n-tum Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, di tum jɛrilim tuuni ŋɔ.
en: Tamar said to Amnon, No, brother! Dont force me to do this. Dont do this shameful thing! Terrible things like this should never be done in Israel!.

dag: M mabihi, Naawuni n-daa pii ya leei bilichinnima; amaa lee miriya ka yi zaŋ yi bilichinsi soli maa tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, naɣ zaŋmiyala yimaŋ leei tab daba yurilim zuɣu.
en: My brothers and sisters, God chose you to be free. But dont use your freedom as an excuse to do what pleases your sinful selves. Instead, serve each other with love.

dag: Yi ni daa sab gban shɛli ti ma zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa la polo yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Doo yi bi kpuɣ paɣa, di viɛla.
en: Now I will discuss the things you wrote me about. You asked if it is better for a man not to have any sexual relations at all.

dag: Zaŋm daba ayopɔin mali alahichi sanyoo sara, sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini maa leei din be kasi zaa. Ka binshɛɣukam yi ti shihi sara maligu bimbini maa, di ni leei din be kasi.
en: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bo tuma zuɣulaannim ti ba ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma hal ka bɛ shia ti yi bɛmaŋ ni, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ me Firawuna nɛma zaashee fɔntinsi ti o Pitom mini Ramɛsis.
en: As a result, the Egyptians put foremen of forced work gangs over the Israelites to harass them with hard work. They had to build storage cities named Pithom and Rameses for Pharaoh.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bar maa, Zɔri, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: Jesus saw how much faith they had and said to the sick man, Friend, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yi mɔɣu polo kanna ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o yura ŋɔ? Apil tia gbini ka n daa neeg a. Nimaani ka a ma daa be n-wolisiri ni o dɔɣ a; nimaani ka ŋun daa dɔɣ a daa be n-wolisira.
en: Who is this coming up from the wilderness leaning against her lover? Under the apple tree I aroused you— there, where your mother labored with you, there where, laboring, she bore you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli paɣ maa, N ni chɛ ka a nya biɛrim pam bihi dɔɣibu ni; a shiri ni nya biɛrim bihi dɔɣibu ni; amaa di zaa yoli, a kɔre kul ni be a yidan ni, ka o ni su a.
en: Then God said to the woman, I will cause you to have much trouble when you are pregnant. And when you give birth to children, you will have much pain. You will want your husband very much, but he will rule over you.

dag: Neemiya n-kpaŋsi din kpalim be yi ni n-yɛn kpi maa, dama n nya ka yi tuma bi be dɛde n Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: So wake up, and strengthen what you still have before it dies completely. For I find that what you have done is not yet perfect in the sight of my God.

dag: Naa suhu yi yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, nyin di yɛli ni a lan je o tuma, dama a yi gbaag amaŋ be balim, di ni ku taali maa.
en: Don't give up your job when your boss gets angry. If you stay calm, you'll be forgiven.

dag: Ka Shɛm mini Jafɛt daa kpuɣi kparibu m-pa bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu n-tirisi bɛ nyaaŋa kpe nti zaŋ li pa bɛ ba zuɣu, ka bi nya bɛ ba zaɣim.
en: Shem and Japheth put a robe over their shoulders and walked backwards into the tent. Without looking at their father, they placed it over his body.

dag: O daa ʒila niriba pam pahi laakumnim bɛn ʒiri tulaale zim mini salima pam ni kuɣ viɛla n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na. O ni daa paai Sulemaana sani, o daa yɛl o din be o suhu ni zaa.
en: Accompanying her to Jerusalem was a huge entourage with camels carrying spices, a large amount of gold, and precious stones. After she arrived, she told Solomon everything that was on her mind.

dag: Dama nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa shɛli ka buchi, amaa biɛr palli malibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: Being circumcised or not being circumcised doesnt mean anything. What matters is a new creation.

dag: Nyɛvili din ka bahigu maa nyɛla ni ninsalinim baŋ nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli ŋɔ, ka baŋ man Yisa Masia so a ni timna la.
en: And eternal life means to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, whom you sent.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: But Zadoks son Ahimaaz again said to Joab, I dont care what happens, just let me run after the Cushite too. Why do you want to go, son? Joab asked. Youll get no reward for going.

dag: A ni ti tam a nandahima ŋɔ yɛla, a ni ti teei di yɛla ka di ŋmanila ko shɛli din pun zo n-gari.
en: You will forget trouble; you will remember it as water that flows past.

dag: N yɛm maa yɛn yila katiŋ na, ka di wuhi ni ŋun nam ma nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: My knowledge is wide; I will use what I know to show that God, my Creator, is just.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti tim ti bɔri Pita ka bi nya o, ka o vihi duguliba maa yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka bahi noli ni bɛ kum ba. Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yiɣisi Judia chaŋ Siizaria nti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Herod gave orders to search for him, but they could not find him. So he had the guards questioned and ordered them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea and spent some time in Caesarea.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ miri ma na nti tum tuma kaman maligumaaniba la bee m-miri sara maligu kasi shɛli mini binshɛli din be kasi. Amaa di simdi ka bɛ di vi, ka di wahala shɛlikam bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: and now I will no longer let the Levites serve as my priests or come near anything sacred to me. They must suffer shame and disgrace for their disgusting sins.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn bah o ka o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka di muɣis a, dama o tum tuma yuma ayɔbu ti a, ka di gar a ni di yɛn zaŋ laɣ shɛli bu padiriba paa ʒii buyi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ a tuuni kam ni.
en: Dont regret letting your slave go free. Remember, he served you six years for half of what you would have paid a hired worker. The Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.

dag: Napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka o daa ti yɛli, N nya sagban bila ka di be kaman ninsal nuu la n-yi teeku polo na. Ka o yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli Ɛhab, Malim a chɛchɛbuŋ shili n-yiɣisi kuli, di yi pa lala saa ni taɣ a sɔŋ. .
en: After the seventh time the servant replied, I see a small cloud coming this way. But it's no bigger than a fist. Elijah told him, Tell Ahab to get his chariot ready and start home now. Otherwise, the rain will stop him.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N tum tuun yini ka di gari yi zaa ha.
en: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.

dag: Dama niriba maa kaya nyɛla ʒiri kaya. Bɛ ŋmaala mɔɣu ni tia, ka ŋun kpɛri binyara zaŋ lɛbil kpe li.
en: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni taɣi yi mini yi bihi suhuri din ni chɛ ka yi yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa, ka lala ti chɛ ka yi be.
en: The Lord your God will make you and your descendants want to obey him. Then you will love the Lord your God with all your heart. And you will live!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu, dama bɛ zaŋ wuntizɔriba n-kɔhi deei anzinfa laɣibaligu, ka zaŋ nandaamba n-taɣi namda.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.

dag: Yi yi ti kuli yiŋ na, noli ni din ya, ka yi yi ti yi samban ni, noli ni din ya.
en: He will curse you at all times in everything you do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bo n-nya li, di ni ti ba nyɛvili, ka ti bɛ niŋgbuna zaa alaafee.
en: They will give life and health to anyone who understands them.

dag: Di ni simdi ni o niŋ naɣilaa maa shɛm m-bala, kaman o ni yɛn niŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa la shɛm, di simdi ka o niŋ naɣilaa ŋɔ gba lala, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo bɛ daalahichi maa samli, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: He will do the same with this bull as he did with the other bull for the purification offering; that is exactly what he must do. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for them, and they will be forgiven.

dag: Ka padiriba maa daa gbahi o yiŋbihi maa n-fiɛb bɛ yino, ka ku yino, ka lab yino mi kuɣa.
en: But the renters grabbed those servants. They beat up one, killed one, and stoned one of them to death.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, O be wula? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O mal alaafee; ka lan yɛli, O bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl n-taɣiri piɛri kanna ŋɔ.
en: Then Jacob said, How is he? They answered, He is well. Look, that is his daughter Rachel coming now with his sheep.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa kpe di puuni nti bi nya ti Duuma Yisa niŋgbuŋ;.
en: they went in. But they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Dama n daa fa nandaamba bɛn kuhiri bahi, ka fa kpibisi bɛn ka ŋun ni sɔŋ ba bahi.
en: because I helped the poor when they cried out. I helped the orphans who had no one to care for them.

dag: N yi teei dahin shɛli ha yɛla, n suhu saɣindimi. Dina n-nyɛ: m mini salo ni daa yi doli chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka mani n-nyɛ bɛ toondan la. Bɛ mi daa yi nyɛla salo bɛn mali suhupiɛlli yiini yila, ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: My heart breaks as I remember the pleasant times in the past, when I walked with the crowds as I led them up to Gods Temple. I remember the happy songs of praise as they celebrated the festival.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa kuhi pam yɛl o, Di niŋ amaŋ shɛli, dama ti zaa be kpe.
en: But Paul shouted loudly, Dont harm yourself! Were all here.

dag: Speen ŋarima n-daa ʒiri a daguya chana. Dinzuɣu a nɛma daa palila teeku bulli zaa.
en: Your merchandise was carried in fleets of the largest cargo ships. You were like a ship at sea Loaded with heavy cargo.

dag: Bɛ bi zɔri lahiba biɛri. Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: They will not be afraid of bad news. They are confident because they trust in the Lord .

dag: Dama n ni bɔri ni n tum zaɣ sun shɛli, m bi tumdi li; amaa zaɣ biɛ shɛli n ni je ni n tum la, dina ka n kul tumda.
en: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.

dag: Yi chaŋ gili zoya ni tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka di yuui, kpamiya yi nuzaa polo.
en: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wɔbi yi olivi tiwala, yin di lan labi ti yihi din kpalim; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: When you have picked your olives once, do not go back and get those that are left; they are for the foreigners, orphans, and widows.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani palo ni daa galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ daa ŋmaai di shɛli polo ti Simiɔn zuliya niriba; ka Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa puuni.
en: Some of the portion of the people of Judah belonged to the legacy of the people of Simeon. This was because the portion of the people of Judah was too large for them. So the people of Simeon received a legacy inside Judahs legacy.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔri nanima anu bɛn daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-teei gili ba.
en: Then the five kings of the Amorites gathered. These were the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon. They went up with all their armies, camped against Gibeon, and attacked it.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, o yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The LORD God of heavenly forces, the LORD is his name!.

dag: N yi nyɛla tuumbiɛ tumda bee n yi tumla tuun shɛli din simdi kum, m bi bɔri soli ni n yi di ni; bɛ ni fiɣisiri ma shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ zaa yi nyɛla ʒiri, so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni. N ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani.
en: If I have done something wrong and the law says I must die, then I agree that I should die. I dont ask to be saved from death. But if these charges are not true, then no one can hand me over to these people. No, I want Caesar to hear my case.

dag: Bɛ tibidarigibo ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ karimbaani zuɣu m-bala, dama bɛ maani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara niŋdi ba.
en: This will happen on account of their pride, because they taunted and boasted over the people of the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: N ni daa wum o kukoli, n daa lu n-dɔn la tiŋa n-liɣi ka n nina kpa tiŋa.
en: When I heard his voice, I fell to the ground unconscious and lay there face downward.

dag: Naawuni, sara shɛli a ni deeri nyɛla siɣisimaŋtali; a mi bi zaɣisiri ninvuɣ so ŋun siɣis omaŋ niŋ tuuba o suhu ni.
en: My sacrifice is a humble spirit, O God; you will not reject a humble and repentant heart.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn je ninvuɣ so ŋun galindi din bi tuhi, ka zaɣisiri ŋun yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: You people hate judges and honest witnesses;.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa kari doli Jɛrɔbɔam nti ŋme n-deeg o tinsi; Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛshana mini di tiŋkpansi ni Ɛfurɔn mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: Abijah pursued Jeroboam's army and occupied some of his cities: Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, and the villages near each of these cities.

dag: Amaa Dauda ni daa nya ka o kpambaliba maa sɔɣiri yɛri tab maa ka o baŋ ni bia maa kpiya; ka bɔh o kpamba maa, Bia maa kpiya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O kpiya.
en: But when David saw his servants whispering, he realized the child had died. Is the child dead? David asked his servants. Yes, they said, he is dead.

dag: Amaa nyini n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi, ka ʒi a nam ʒiishee, ka Izraɛlnim paɣir a.
en: You are the holy one, enthroned. You are Israels praise.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn sani nti yɛl o.
en: The Israelites sent some men to King Sihon of the Amorites. The men said to the king.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter said to him, Even if everyone else stumbles, I wont.

dag: N nuu ka n daa zaŋ nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ n nudirigu teei sagbana pa zuɣusaa. N yi yɛli ni di niŋ shɛli, di tiɣisirimi zani niŋ li.
en: My hands made the earth's foundations and spread the heavens out. When I summon earth and sky, they come at once and present themselves.

dag: Ka Hushai daa garigi yɛli Absalom, Aai Yawɛ min o niriba ŋɔ ni Izraɛlnim ni pii ninvuɣ so, o sani ka n yɛn be ka o su ma.
en: Hushai answered, The Lord and the people of Israel have chosen you to be king. I can't leave. I have to stay and serve the one they've chosen.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa bi bɔh a ni bɔ ka a leei niŋdi maa?.
en: Human one, has the house of Israel, that household of rebels, asked you, What are you doing.

dag: Do so ŋun dɔbilim yina ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o kpe daɣiri ni zaligu m-bala.
en: These are the regulations about a man who has a discharge or an emission of semen.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N yɛli noli ti Keenan. O ni nyɛla o biɛyanim dabili.
en: He said, Cursed be Canaan: the lowest servant he will be for his brothers.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ka n daa po pɔri yɛli Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu, N zaŋ li ti yi Zuliya. N chɛ ka a nini nya li, amaa a ku paai nimaani.
en: The Lord said to Moses, This is the land I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I said to them, I will give this land to your descendants. I have let you see the land, but you cannot go there.

dag: O ni wum ka n duhi n yee kuhi pam maa, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: And when he heard me scream, he ran out of the house, leaving his coat with me.

dag: Ti ni daa du duli tiligi maa, ka tiŋ maa nim yɛl ti ni bɛ ya maa yuli m-booni Malta.
en: When we came ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.

dag: Naa maa ni ti lihi ʒiɛm o yaannim wuna, ka lihi ʒiɛm paɣiba ni yuri wun shɛŋa gba. Hal o baɣa ti ku be wuni kam ni, dama o ni ti tɛhi ni ŋuna n-gari di zaa.
en: That northern king will not care about the gods his ancestors worshiped. He will not care about the gods women worship. He will not care about any god. Instead, he will praise himself and make himself more important than any god.

dag: Bɛ kuhirimi niŋdi bɛ manima, Bindirigu mini wain be ya? Bɛ tarigiri luri tiŋ maa solɔri zuɣu kaman bɛ nyala dansi la, saha shɛli bɛ ni kpiri niŋdi bɛ manim nuhi ni la.
en: Hungry and thirsty, they cry to their mothers; They fall in the streets as though they were wounded, And slowly die in their mothers' arms.

dag: Ŋun boli ya maa nyɛla ŋun ni niŋ li, dama o nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim.
en: The one who chose you will do that for you. You can trust him.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila wurigu, ka buɣim ni di ba zaa! Bɛ ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋ buɣim barina ni. Bɛ ka sala buɣim din ni wuɣisi.
en: But they cannot even save themselves. They will burn like straw. They will burn so fast that there will be no coals left to cook bread. There will be no fire left to sit by.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb sani maa, luɣ shɛlikam zaa bɛ ni daa be, bɛ daa saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛri ba, Yawɛ niriba m-bɔŋɔ, amaa ka bɛ yi o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But even in those other nations, they ruined my good name. How? Those nations said, These are the Lord s people, but they left his land.

dag: A ba Naawuni ni sɔŋ a. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa mi a. O ni chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgbani puuni na a zuɣu. O ni ti a bihi mini niɣi pam.
en: Your help came from the God your father worshiped, from God All-Powerful. God will bless you with rain and streams from the earth; he will bless you with many descendants.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tibi ŋɔ m-mali soli din be polipoli ti wuntizɔriba. Bɛ ni doli so shɛli nyɛla so viɛlli.
en: Our Lord , you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.

dag: Di chɛ ka n lihiri binshɛŋa din ka buchi. Tim ma nyɛvili a soli zuɣu.
en: Keep me from paying attention to what is worthless; be good to me, as you have promised.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: King Rehoboam replaced them with bronze shields and assigned them to the officers of the guard who protected the entrance to the royal palace.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ Ashpɛnaz ni daa zaŋ o min o tab niriba ata la niŋ so nuu ni ni o lihiri ba la sani ti yɛl o.
en: Then Daniel talked to the guard who had been put in charge of Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah by Ashpenaz.

dag: Nir yi di n-tiɣi, o baɣa ka shiri ni, amaa kum yi mali nira, hal binshɛli din to gba nyaɣisimi.
en: Someone who is full refuses honey, but anything bitter tastes sweet to a hungry person.

dag: A zaligunim viɛli pam, dinzuɣu ka n dol li n suhu ni.
en: Lord, your rules are wonderful. That is why I follow them.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni o yɛn bela sagban sabila ni.
en: Then Solomon said, The Lord chose to live in a dark cloud.

dag: Jabɛz daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali jilima gar o mabihi zaa, o ma n-daa bol o yuli Jabɛz, ka yɛli ni dama o daa nya biɛrim pam o dɔɣibu ni.
en: Jabez was a very good man, who was better than his brothers. His mother said, I have named him Jabez because I was in much pain when I had him.

dag: Dama ti ni daa birigi maa nyaaŋa ti daa niŋ tuuba, ti ni daa ti baŋ, di nyaaŋa ka ti daa zaŋ ti zuɣuri ba tiŋa. Vi daa gbahi ti, ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisi, ti ni daa nya filiŋ ti bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: After I turned away from you, I regretted it; I realized what I had done, and I have hit myself— I was humiliated and disgraced, and I have carried this disgrace since I was young.

dag: Ka Jɛrikɔnim daa me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Imri bia Zakur daa me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani ŋɔ, maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni.
en: Be strong and brave, all of you who are waiting for the Lord s help.

dag: N ni yuri so yi tum ma tuumbiɛɣu, o mali soli ni o lan be n yiŋa? Pɔri pɔbu bee biŋkɔbiri sara maligu ni tooi vuui mbusim maa? O ni tooi mali suhupiɛlli?.
en: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam nim zaa ni ti teei, ka ŋmaligi lab Yawɛ sanna, ka zuliya kam niriba zaa ni ti jɛm o.
en: Every part of the earth will remember and come back to the LORD; every family among all the nations will worship you.

dag: Hal ka n kuhi pam bɔri sɔŋsim ka o zaɣisi n suhigu deebu.
en: I cry aloud for help, but God refuses to listen;.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli Dauda, A ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: Jonathan said to David, I will do anything you want me to do.

dag: Ka o ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bo bulah ayi ti o ka o mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛla yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yihi o niriba maa; ka bɛ daa ʒi anzinfa mini salima yi, bɛ ni so daa bi tuui.
en: Then God brought Israel out, filled with silver and gold; not one of its tribes stumbled.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kpɛhi duu, ka guhiri ni Yawɛ ti yɛli ba o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: put him under guard, and waited for the Lord to tell them what to do with him.
