dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣi, ka chɛ ka amiliya niŋbu dakulo maa naai, ka Leeban daa lan zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: At the end of the week of celebration, Laban let Jacob marry Rachel, and he gave her his servant woman Bilhah. Jacob loved Rachel more than he did Leah, but he had to work another seven years for Laban.

dag: Yisa Masia nyɛla ŋun daa kana ni kom mini ʒim, ka di pala ni kom kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla kom mini ʒim. Naawuni Shia mi di li shɛhira, dama ŋun Naawuni Shia nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.

dag: Yi daa zaŋ wuntizɔra taali n-ku o, amaa o bi zaɣisi ya.
en: You have condemned and murdered the righteous one, who doesnt oppose you.

dag: Naftali zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Ammihud bia Pɛdahɛl.
en: from the tribe of the Naphtalites, a chief, Pedahel, Ammihuds son.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin cham ti wuh o o taali maa a min o kɔŋko. O yi deeg o galimi, a zaŋ o labisi yi mabiligu maa puuni yaha m-bala.
en: If your brother or sister in Gods family does something wrong, go and tell them what they did wrong. Do this when you are alone with them. If they listen to you, then you have helped them to be your brother or sister again.

dag: Yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa yi ti kuna nya o ni lala, o ni nya suhupiɛlli.
en: Servants are fortunate if their master comes and finds them doing their job.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun doli n nyaaŋa na la hal ka man pɔri gba ni n gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi li.
en: He is the one who is coming later. I am not good enough to be the slave who unties the strings on his sandals.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛli din nyuri sakom din luri di zuɣu waawaayili ka bindira zoori di ni n-leeri din mali buchi bɛ ni biri li shɛb zuɣu la sani, Naawuni niŋdi alibarika niŋdi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: The ground receives a blessing from God when it drinks up the rain that regularly comes and falls on it and yields a useful crop for those people for whom it is being farmed.

dag: ka din pah anu nyɛ oniɣisi, ka din pah ayɔbu nyɛ kanɛlian, ka din pah ayopɔin nyɛ kirisolait, ka din pah anii nyɛ bɛril, ka din pah awɛi nyɛ tɔpaz, ka din pahi pia nyɛ kirisɔpirɛz, ka din pahi piniyini nyɛ jɛsint ka din pahi pinaayi mi nyɛ amɛtisit.
en: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.

dag: Di saha ka Taai Naa Hiram daa sabi gbaŋ ti Sulemaana n-garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni yur o niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka o zaŋ a leei bɛ naa maa.
en: Tyres King Huram replied in a letter that he sent to Solomon: The LORD must love his people Israel because he has made you their king!.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka bɔh o nyaandoliba maa, Bɔzuɣu ka yi karimba maa mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira.
en: Some Pharisees saw this and asked his disciples, Why does your teacher eat with such people.

dag: N daa niŋ ninvuɣ titali gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa pun daŋ n tooni di Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa lan mali yɛm pam.
en: So I became far greater than all who preceded me in Jerusalem. Moreover, my wisdom stood by me.

dag: Dama ŋunkam zaa ŋubiri li ka nyuri li ka bi zahim baŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ yɛla gbinni, o ŋubiri li ka nyuri li bɔrila tibidarigibo tir omaŋa.
en: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.

dag: Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni ka ti a nama, ka chɛ ka a zuliya nabi; ka a leei zuliya pam yaba.
en: I pray that God All-Powerful will bless you and give you many children. I pray that you will become the father of a great nation.

dag: Bɛ ni lo barina tumbu nia shɛli ŋmaligiri lurila bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ duŋtaabo ŋmaligiri luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: So they are punished by their own evil and are hurt by their own violence.

dag: A ni tooi baŋ Naawuni tɛha din zilim ŋɔ? A ni tooi baŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ yɛm tariga?.
en: Can you discover the limits and bounds of the greatness and power of God?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ŋmaligi ni o chaŋ, ka Sool va n-gɔh o binyɛrigu tiŋli, ka di cheei.
en: Then Samuel turned to leave, but Saul caught hold of his cloak, and it tore.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani Bɛtɛl ti jɛmdi salima naɣibil din be nimaani la; ka shɛb mi chani hal Dan nti jɛmdi salima naɣibil ŋun la. Ka niriba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa leeg alahichi.
en: This act was sinful. The people went to worship before the one calf at Bethel and before the other one as far as Dan.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa o ni daa suh o shɛlikam m-pahi ŋun Naa Sulemaana ni daa pun niŋ o nirilim ti o pin shɛŋa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o min o niriba daa lab kul o ya Shiiba.
en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she asked for, besides all the other customary gifts that he had generously given her. Then she and her attendants returned to the land of Sheba.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni galisiya, ka ti ku tooi baŋ o yuma tariga.
en: Look, God is exalted and unknowable; the number of his years is beyond counting.

dag: N kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: Because he is praiseworthy, I cried out to the LORD, and I was saved from my enemies.

dag: Bɛ ni tarigi lɛb lu, amaa tinim ni yiɣisimi ʒe tibi.
en: They fall in battle, totally defeated, but we survive and stand strong!.

dag: Chamiya ti zani Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni n-yɛli niriba nyɛvil palli ŋɔ yɛla zaa.
en: Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.

dag: Gala tumbu ŋmanila diɛma jɛrigu sani, amaa yɛm biɛhigu niŋdila tɛhi zilimalan nyaɣisim.
en: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but the wise enjoy wisdom.

dag: Bɛ daa lihiya, amaa ka so daa kani ŋun ni tiligi ba. Bɛ daa fabili niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o daa bi garigi ba.
en: They looked for help, but there was no one to save them. They cried out to the Lord , but he did not answer them.

dag: Yɛnnim gbaarila bɛmaŋa n-yiri zaɣ biɛɣu ni, amaa jɛra bɛn baɣa kani, ka bi gbaari bɛmaŋa.
en: The wise are careful and avoid evil, but fools become excited and overconfident.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o ku lan tooi gbib omaŋa, nyin gbib o ka chɛ ka o be a sani kaman sana bee tinzun nir la.
en: If anyone from your own country becomes too poor to support themselves, you must let them live with you like a visitor.

dag: Ŋun doli yɛlimaŋli soli ni tiligi, amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli ni ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: Be honest and you will be safe. If you are dishonest, you will suddenly fall.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛtali ni be shɛli, naŋgbankpeeni gba bela nimaani. Ka jilima tibu yi ka shɛli, filiŋ bela nimaani.
en: Sin and shame go together. Lose your honor, and you will get scorn in its place.

dag: Daadam, niriba ŋɔ niŋla bɛ buɣa yɛda ka chɛ ka bɛ daalahichi leei bɛ kuɣituurili do bɛ tooni. N ni chɛ ka bɛ bɔhi ma baŋ shɛli?.
en: Mortal man, he said, these men have given their hearts to idols and are letting idols lead them into sin. Do they think I will give them an answer?.

dag: Yawɛ neeri zoomba nina. Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lu. Yawɛ yuri wuntizɔriba.
en: The LORD: who makes the blind see. The LORD: who straightens up those who are bent low. The LORD: who loves the righteous.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan boli Samuɛl yaha m-pahi buta, ka o lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Di saha ka Ɛli daa baŋ ni Yawɛ m-booni bia maa.
en: When the Lord called out his name for the third time, Samuel went to Eli again and said, Here I am. What do you want? Eli finally realized that it was the Lord who was speaking to Samuel.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa deei Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa ka Yisa Masia mi tahi anfaani mini yɛlimaŋli na.
en: That is, the law was given to us through Moses, but grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

dag: A mini Speen daa gɔrila kɔhigu tab tiŋgbɔna ni, yi ni daa mali azichi pam zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ di anzinfa mini kuriti ni dalima ni nuɣiso n-taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: Tarshish was your procurer of great wealth. For your wares, they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmanila yɛm tuma din kpaŋsiri jɛmbu muɣisigu puuni mini ʒiri maŋsiɣisibutali ni niŋgbuŋ nahimbu, amaa di zaa yoli, di bi kuri buchi zaŋ chaŋ maŋgbaabu niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma tumbu puuni.
en: These rules may seem to be wise as part of a made-up religion in which people pretend to be humble and punish their bodies. But they dont help people stop doing the evil that the sinful self wants to do.

dag: Ka anab maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, A ni zaŋ n ni yɛl a ni a ku do so la bahila zuɣu, a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili yo o nyɛvili samli; ka zaŋ a tɔbbihi gba nyɛviya yo o tɔbbihi nyɛviya samli. .
en: The prophet then said to the king, This is the word of the Lord : Because you allowed the man to escape whom I had ordered to be killed, you will pay for it with your life, and your army will be destroyed for letting his army escape.

dag: Kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛm la, lala ka ninsal nina gba na ʒi n-tiɣi.
en: Just as the place of death and destruction is never full, people always want more and more.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika, ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: until , of these warriors lay dead.

dag: Chɛ ka o sandan fa o ni mali shɛlikam zaa; ka saamba ʒe o ni tum tuma nya binshɛlikam zaa.
en: Let a creditor seize everything he owns; let strangers plunder his wealth.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ ni di nyɛla talahi ni Masia di wahala n-leei ŋun tuui neei kum ni, ka moli tiliginsim lahibal suŋ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani n-neei bɛ nina.
en: They said that the Messiah would die and be the first to rise from death. They said that he would bring the light of Gods saving truth to the Jewish people and to the non-Jewish people.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ ŋma Lɛbanɔn sida dari ti ma, ka n chɛ ka n tumtumdiba kana ti pah a tumtumdiba maa zuɣu, ka n yo a a ni zali ni n yo a tumtumdiba maa zuɣu shɛm; dama a mi ni so ka ti ni m-mi dakuɣiri ŋmabu kaman Sidɔnnima.
en: Now give the order and have the cedars of Lebanon cut down for me. My servants will work with your servants. Ill pay your servants whatever price you set, because you know we have no one here who is skilled in cutting wood like the Sidonians.

dag: Dama n zaŋ n nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka po pɔri ni mani ŋun be sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But now Im lifting my hand to heaven— I swear by my own eternity.

dag: Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti yɛli ni paɣiŋɔhi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi dɔɣi ni bihi ni bi mɔɣi paɣ shɛb biha mal alibarika.
en: For the days are coming when people will say, How lucky are the women who never had children, who never bore babies, who never nursed them.

dag: Yi bi chaŋ dikiya din lu maa ni ti gu voya shee bee m-mali me gooni ti Izraɛlnima din ni chɛ ka tɔbu ti ku daai li luhi Yawɛ dabisili dali.
en: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli paɣ maa, Pumpɔŋɔ ti niŋ yɛda, ka pa ni a yɛligu la zuɣu yaha, dama timaŋmaŋ wum o yɛligu ka baŋ ni o shiri nyɛla dunia ŋɔ tiligira.
en: and they told the woman, We believe now, not because of what you said, but because we ourselves have heard him, and we know that he really is the Savior of the world.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti chirigi Firawuna saha shɛl o ni chani mɔɣili ni la n-yɛl o ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh as he goes out to the water. Say to him, This is what the LORD says: Let my people go so that they can worship me.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl zoya anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: You, human one, prophesy to Israels mountains and say, Hear the LORDs word, mountains of Israel!.

dag: ka Malikija nyɛ Ɛtini bia, ka Ɛtini nyɛ Zɛra bia, ka Zɛra nyɛ Adaya bia.
en: Malkijah was Ethnis son. Ethni was Zerahs son. Zerah was Adaiahs son.

dag: M-pahi Hɛshibɔn mini di tin kara din daa be tintan ni la zaa ni Dibɔn ni Bamɔtibaal ni Bɛtibaalimiɔn.
en: It included Heshbon and all the cities on the plateau: Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baalmeon.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔram daa ti leei Naawuni dini, ka bɛ sɔɣ pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Ahazia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoram died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Ahaziah then became king.

dag: Bɛ ni ninvuɣ suŋ ŋmanila suligunyinyaɣu, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ maŋli mi ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ gɔ shɛŋa sa n-gili. Bɛ tibidarigibo dabisili la biɛɣu neeya, anabinim bɛn ŋmani tiŋguliba ni daa pun yɛli ba dabisi shɛli yɛla la. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ birimbu saha paaya.
en: The good among them are like a briar; those who do the right thing are like a thorny thicket.

dag: Antiɔk yɛdaniŋdiba maa ni daa tim ba maa, bɛ daa zaŋ doli yila Fɔnisia mini Samaria polo n-yɛri nimaani yɛdaniŋdiba zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba ni niŋ tuuba shɛm yɛla chana, ka di daa niŋ ba suhupiɛlli pam.
en: The church helped them get ready to leave on their trip. The men went through the countries of Phoenicia and Samaria, where they told all about how the non-Jewish people had turned to the true God. This made all the believers very happy.

dag: Diribarilimlan nyɛla ŋun bɔri zabili, amaa ŋunkam niŋ Yawɛ naani ni tɔŋ.
en: Selfishness only causes trouble. You are much better off to trust the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, n ni wuɣ a mukuru pa a ninni, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam nya a zaɣim, ka nanim nya a ni di vi shɛm.
en: The Lord Almighty says, I will punish you, Nineveh! I will strip you naked and let the nations see you, see you in all your shame.

dag: Dum Abarim zoli din nyɛ Nɛbo zoli ka be Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ labi Jɛriko tooni polo la nti lihi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su maa.
en: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.

dag: Amaa nyamiya! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nyaannim ni ti leei toonnima, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ toonnim mi ti leei nyaannima.
en: There the ones who are now least important will be the most important, and those who are now most important will be least important.

dag: M-pahi, ŋuni ka n lan yɛn jɛm ka pa ni n dan Dauda bia? N ni daa kul jɛmd a ba shɛm, lala ka n yɛn jɛm a gba.
en: Whats more, whom should I serve if not Davids son? I served your father, and so I will serve you in the same way.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guhi ka di yuui ha, amaa ka o kul bi yoori zɔntua maa dunoya maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ saafɛbia yooi li nya ka bɛ naa maa kpimi do tiŋa.
en: The servants waited for a long time, but the king never opened the doors to the upper room. Finally, the servants got worried. They got the key and unlocked the doors. When the servants entered, they saw their king lying dead on the floor.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni yini ni kɔbisinu.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Asher was .

dag: O wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu; ka di chɛ ka n ni tooi zaŋ n nuhi dahim daanya tɔbu.
en: He trains me for war so that my arms can bend the most powerful bow.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Doo yi kpi ka ka bidibiga, yin zaŋmiya o fali ti o bipuɣiŋga.
en: Tell the people of Israel that whenever a man dies without leaving a son, his daughter is to inherit his property.

dag: Ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii ka o doya, ka bɛ daa dii yɛli Yisa o niŋgbun biisim maa yɛla.
en: Simons mother-in-law was in bed, sick with a fever, and they told Jesus about her at once.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaɣisi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa, ka daa nahim ba, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛn yɛn bahi ba yoli nuu ni hal ti kari ba o sani bahi.
en: The Lord rejected all the Israelites. He brought them many troubles. He let people destroy them. Finally, he threw them away and removed them from his sight.

dag: Buɣim niɛm mokpala n-yir o noli ni na n-tahiri yiɣiri ka buɣim yirina.
en: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa nyɛ Jaara ba, ka Jaara nyɛ Alɛmɛt mini Azimavɛt ni Zimiri ba, ka Zimiri nyɛ Mɔza ba.
en: Ahaz was the father of Jadah. Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri was Mozas father.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim niriba maa, N yi chɛ ka tɔbu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tiŋ maa nim pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino leei bɛ gula.
en: Son of man, speak to your people. Say to them, Whenever I bring enemy soldiers to fight against a country, the people choose someone to be a watchman.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o kpamba, Yi bi mi ni ŋun nyɛ sapashin kpeeni ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ titali ka Izraɛlnim kɔŋ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ?.
en: King David said to his officers, You know that a very important leader died today in Israel.

dag: ka o daa pii di liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka o paɣ maa mi di yɛla. Ka Ananias daa zaŋ din kpalim maa ti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni.
en: but he gave only part of the money to the apostles. He secretly kept some of the money for himself. His wife knew this, and she agreed with it.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ li n dabili Musa sani, n zaŋla n niriba zaa fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni.
en: It is different when I speak with my servant Moses; I have put him in charge of all my people Israel.

dag: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega . Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun daŋ tooni ni ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ni ŋun lan nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

dag: Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni paɣ a, dama bɛ wum a yɛtɔɣa.
en: Let all the earths rulers give thanks to you, LORD, when they hear what you say.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi daa ŋmanila biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni bear la, ka o yiɣisi n-gbiligi ʒiɛya; ka sapir kɔba ata gbab o noli. Ka kuko shɛli daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim ŋubi nimdi pam.
en: Then I saw another animal there in front of me that looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, Get up and eat all the meat you want.

dag: Baŋmiya ni mani n-su nyɛviya zaa. Mani n-su bihi laamba nyɛviya, mani n-lan su bia nyɛvili. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tum alahichi kɔŋko n-ni kpi.
en: I will treat everyone, child and parent, just the same. The one who sins is the one who will die!.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ka galimi chɛmi ka bɛ soya tuhi, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri maŋmaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali n-nyɛ din luhiri ba.
en: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na yomyom ti yɛli ba, N tum taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa sani ni yi gba sani.
en: At once the king sent for Moses and Aaron. He told them, I have sinned against the Lord your God and against you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ ninsal bemi kaman ti ni be shɛm, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu, ka di pa shɛli ka o ti pɔhigi nyɛvili tia la walli di m-be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord said, They now know the difference between right and wrong, just as we do. But they must not be allowed to eat fruit from the tree that lets them live forever.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi doli zaligunim ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, dinzuɣu doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Today the Lord your God commands you to obey all his laws; so obey them faithfully with all your heart.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli neesim maa wuntaŋ ni, ka boli zibisim maa mi yuŋ. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din daŋ tooni.
en: and named the light Day and the darkness Night. Evening came, then morning—that was the first day.

dag: Jɛsi daa nyɛla Ɛliab ba. Ɛliab n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu nyɛ Abinadab, ka ŋun pahi ata daa nyɛ Shimia.
en: Jesse had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, and David.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi Musa sani kuli.
en: The whole Israelite community left Moses.

dag: Chɛli sujee mini suhuyiɣisili. Chɛli suhuyiɣisili, dama di nyɛla din kpɛhiri nir zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Dont become so angry and upset that you, too, want to do evil.

dag: N kala dunia ŋɔ ni na kaman neesim, ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda ku kpalim be zibisim ni.
en: I have come into the world as light, so that everyone who believes in me should not remain in the darkness.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A shiri yɛn laɣimla wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku?.
en: Then Abraham approached him and asked, Will you destroy the good people while you are destroying those who are evil?.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ma la zaɣ nɛɔŋ niŋ gballi ni, ka kahi kuɣa pa n zuɣu.
en: They threw me alive into a pit and closed the opening with a stone.

dag: A ni di biɛla shɛli maa, a ni ti li bahi, ka a yɛtɔɣ viɛla bahi yoli.
en: You will vomit up what you have eaten, and all your flattery will be wasted.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn chɛmi ka sanʒiɛ biɛɣu ʒe Babilɔn mini di niriba.
en: The Lord says, I will cause a powerful, destructive wind to blow against Babylon and the Babylonians.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ti na kpalim ʒi kpe? Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa la ni nti kpi di ni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaliya ni ti ni kpi, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nti ti ni ti nyu, ti ni tum alahichi o sani zuɣu.
en: Why are we sitting still? God's people ask. Come on, we will run to the fortified cities and die there. The Lord our God has condemned us to die; he has given us poison to drink, because we have sinned against him.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o ni da pu shɛli ti Yawɛ, ka di pala o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli palo.
en: If the person dedicates land they purchased to the LORD—land that is not part of their family property.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Kiriatariba mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti ba pahi. . Bɛ booni li la Hiburɔn pumpɔŋɔ, ka di be Juda zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya ni.
en: They gave them Kiriath Arba. They also gave them some land near the town for their animals.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o yɛli.
en: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says.

dag: Di ni chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee? Ti zaa ti yɛn laɣimmi kpi.
en: Will hope go down with me to the place of death? Will we go down into the dirt together.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bidibisi, ka Abiheel daa nyɛ Huri bia, ka Huri nyɛ Jarɔa bia, ka Jarɔa nyɛ Giliad bia, ka Giliad nyɛ Maikil bia, ka Maikil nyɛ Jɛshishai bia, ka Jɛshishai nyɛ Jado bia, ka Jado mi nyɛ Buz bia;.
en: They were all descendants of Abihail, whose family line went back through Huri, Jaroah, Gilead, Michael, Jeshishai, Jahdo, and Buz.

dag: Bɛ fa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni nɛma, ka bɛ kpalim gbihirimi; ka tɔbbi so ku lan tooi zaŋ o nuu ku buchi shɛli.
en: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.

dag: Dama n wum ka niriba pam sɔɣiri yɛra; ka dabiɛm kul be luɣilikam zaa. Bɛ laɣimmi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma.
en: Yes, Ive heard all the gossiping, terror all around; so many gang up together against me, they plan to take my life!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli mini bɛn be katiŋa, wummiya! Yawɛ daa pun pii ma ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma; n daa na bela m ma pul ni, ka o pun boli n yuli.
en: Listen to me, distant nations, you people who live far away! Before I was born, the Lord chose me and appointed me to be his servant.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ duno shɛli din kpɛri dundɔŋ maa puuni, ka n daa lihi nya ka voli be gooni ni.
en: Then he brought me to the court entrance. When I looked, I saw a hole in the wall.

dag: Ka naa daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina m-mali nam ʒiishee zaɣ titali, ka chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaa m-pa di zuɣu.
en: The king also made a large ivory throne and covered it with pure gold.

dag: Yi ni shɛb booni tinim la ninvuɣ gbarima, ka hal di ni dihi ma vi la zaa yoli, n saɣi lala! N tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu n-nyɛ ma la. Ka so yi bɔri ni o nyu bara binshɛli zuɣu, n gba ni tooi nyu bara lala:.
en: I am ashamed to say it, but we were too weak to do such things to you. But if anyone dares to boast, I will too.

dag: Paɣipiɛl so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl. Di gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni be ti sani.
en: The virgin will be pregnant and will give birth to a son. They will name him Immanuel.

dag: Bɛ tizɔpaɣiba n-daa nyɛ: Zɛruya mini Abigeel. Zɛruya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Abishai mini Jɔab ni Asahɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiahs family: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel—three in all.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nuhu, A min a malibu zaa kpɛm ŋariŋ maa ni, dama n nyaya ka nyini n-nyɛ wuntizɔra n sani ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Noah, I have seen that you are a good man, even among the evil people of this time. So gather your family, and all of you go into the boat.

dag: N Duuma, n ni paɣ a niriba balibu kam sani. N ni yili yila paɣ a zuliya balibu kam sani.
en: I will thank you, O Lord, among the nations. I will praise you among the peoples.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be muɣisigu ni mini sama ni daa doli shɛba ni bɛnkam nini daa bi lan tiɣi bɛ biɛhigu zaa daa zo n-chaŋ o sani ka o ti leei bɛ zuɣulana. Ka bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi.
en: A lot of other people joined him too. Some were in trouble, others were angry or in debt, and David was soon the leader of men.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli yaha, M mabihi, n ni maan yɛli ya ti yab Naa Dauda yɛla. O daa kpiya ka bɛ sɔɣ o, ka o gballi na be kpe hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Brothers and sisters, I can speak confidently about the patriarch David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this very day.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri yɛla muɣis a; a mi di zabiri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nyuli.
en: Dont get upset over evildoers; dont be jealous of those who do wrong.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tampiŋ bi be kaman ti Tampiŋ ŋɔ. Hal ti dimnim maa gba mi lala.
en: Their enemies know that their own gods are weak, not mighty like Israel's God.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa bi lan lihir o ni zaŋ binshɛlikam niŋ Yisifu nuu ni maa, dama Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani, ka o daa yi niŋ shɛlikam, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka di tɔŋ.
en: The jails commander paid no attention to anything under Josephs supervision, because the LORD was with him and made everything he did successful.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, A yuma na bi paai yuun pihinu, ka wula ka a niŋ n-nya ti yab Ibrahimma.
en: The Jews said to Jesus, What? How can you say you have seen Abraham? You are not even years old.

dag: Do so daa be Uzi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o yuli booni Ayuba. Doo maa daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, ka o biɛhigu be tibi zaa, ka o nyɛ ŋun zɔri Naawuni, ka bi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: There was a man named Job who lived in the country of Uz. He was a good, honest man. He respected God and refused to do evil.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman yinim putɔɣunim ti chaŋ ti liri ŋun ka taali o yiŋa n-ku o o gom shee pa o bindoo zuɣu, ka n ku bɔhi ya o ʒim yihibu maa biɛri ka kun ya dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: I will kill you too and remove this evil from our land because you evil men killed a good man sleeping on his own bed, in his own house.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri piɛri kɔbiri mini gumdi shee, ka zaŋ o nuhi tumdi tuma ni o suhu zaa.
en: She is always gathering wool and flax and enjoys making things with her hands.

dag: A yi fiɛb ba fiɛbiga, a ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ ku chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: and it may even save their lives.

dag: Miri ka a lihi ni a mali yɛm, zom Yawɛ, ka zo n-yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Dont trust in your own wisdom, but fear and respect the Lord and stay away from evil.

dag: Di chɛ ka karimbaannim zaŋ bɛ naba du n-tam n zuɣu nɔra bee n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaŋ bɛ nuhi kari ma.
en: Dont let proud people trap me. Dont let the wicked force me to run away.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim maa daa yili yilli ŋɔ m-paɣiri Yawɛ yɛra: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima; o daai wɔribara min o wɔhu niŋ teeku ni.
en: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord : I will sing to the Lord , because he has won a glorious victory; he has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri yɛla muɣis a; a mi di zabiri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nyuli.
en: Dont get upset about evil people. Dont be jealous of those who do wrong.

dag: ni Ɛgilɔn naa ni Gɛza naa.
en: the king of Eglon one.

dag: Yɛlim Sulemaana bia Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Juda mini Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni la.
en: to give this message to King Rehoboam and to all the people of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin:.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ kaɣisi yili maa puuni dukpina zaa, ka va bɛ ni kaɣisi taŋkpa shɛli maa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: The inside of the house will then be scraped on all sides, and the plaster that has been scraped off must be dumped outside the city in an unclean area.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua.
en: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, dahin shɛli kanna ka n ni ti pali n ni daa lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli shɛl la.
en: The Lord said, The time is coming when I will fulfill the promise that I made to the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: O nina ŋmanila ŋmana bɛn ʒe kɔzɔrim noli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ bihim paɣi shɛba.
en: His eyes are as beautiful as doves by a flowing brook, doves washed in milk and standing by the stream.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni niŋ zaŋ yi ba biŋkɔbiri ti ma.
en: God took away your fathers livestock and gave them to me.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Ʒe a sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ gbini; ka n chaŋ Yawɛ sani kpe ha.
en: Then Balaam said to Balak, Stand here by your entirely burned offering, while I seek an appearance over there.

dag: Yiɣisim zabi n zuɣu, n Duuma ni n Naawuni! Yiɣisim mali n yɛla maa ti ma!.
en: Rouse yourself, O Lord, and defend me; rise up, my God, and plead my cause.

dag: Hal o ni daa bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli, ka ʒiri daa ka o nol ni maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa gbi o gballi garila tuumbiɛrinim gbala ni; ka daa sɔɣ o pahi bundan zuɣu.
en: He had done no wrong to anyone. He had never even told a lie. But he was buried among the wicked. His tomb was with the rich.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daai ba luhi kaman bɛ ni yi ŋma tia wula ka di lu shɛm la. O ni luhi karimbaannim mini wɔɣira bɛn be bɛ ni n-dihi ba vi.
en: Look! The LORD God of heavenly forces is chopping off the branches with terrible power. The loftiest ones are about to be cut down and the exalted laid low.

dag: Niriba ayi bɛn daa wum Jɔn ni yɛli shɛm ka doli Yisa maa ni yino n-daa nyɛ Anduru, Saimɔn Pita tizo.
en: One of the two men who had heard John and had gone with Jesus was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ti, Yi mi di kul mɛnya yiya bee m-biri bimbira bee n-sa wain tihi bee m-mali dimbɔŋɔnim zaa shɛli. Amaa kul benya suɣa ni yi nyɛvili biɛhigu ni zaa din ni chɛ ka yi ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni yi ni be kaman saamba ŋɔ yuui.
en: He also told us not to build houses or farm the land and not to plant vineyards or buy them. He commanded us always to live in tents, so that we might remain in this land where we live like strangers.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ li tahi nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa lan darigi di tiŋ maa nim gba tibili n-chɛ ka sokam suhu saɣim. O daa chɛ ka bintɔra tɔri bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: But after it arrived there, the Lord punished that city too and caused a great panic. He punished them with tumors which developed in all the people of the city, young and old alike.

dag: M mabihi, so yi yɛli ni o mali yɛda, amaa ka di bi tumdi tuma, di buchi lee nyɛla dini? Yɛda niŋbu ŋɔ tatabo ni tooi tilig o?.
en: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?.

dag: Dinzuɣu piimiya dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la ni niriba.
en: Now choose twelve men, one from each of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka ala ka n lee yɛn yo a? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, di bi kpa talahi ni a yo ma shɛli. N na kul ni gul a biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: What shall I pay you? Laban asked. Jacob answered, I don't want any wages. I will continue to take care of your flocks if you agree to this suggestion:.

dag: Miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmani bahi ka nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la, ka miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpaŋsiri niŋgbuŋ ŋmaabu yɛla la.
en: Be careful of the dogs—those men whose work does only harm. They want to cut on everyone who isnt circumcised.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-ni tooi wuhi n daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n yi tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda?.
en: Who among you can show Im guilty of sin? Since I speak the truth, why dont you believe me?.

dag: Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo din kul zoori pahiri Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa baŋbu puuni!.
en: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus.

dag: Bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni; dama nir na ʒi m-pɔhi fiig tia wala goo zuɣu, ka so mi na ʒi m-pɔhi gaya pirinkpaŋ zuɣu.
en: Each tree is known by its own fruit. People dont gather figs from thorny plants, nor do they pick grapes from prickly bushes.

dag: Tummiya tuma daba ayɔbu, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin la dali, yin vuhimiya, ka chɛ ka yi niɣi mini yi bunsi ni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab shɛb yi yinsi ni saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa vuhi dindali maa.
en: Work six days a week, but do no work on the seventh day, so that your slaves and the foreigners who work for you and even your animals can rest.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, dama n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n Naawuni.
en: Why am I so sad? Why am I so upset? I tell myself, Wait for Gods help! You will again be able to praise him, your God, the one who will save you.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti nya Dauda, ka lan yɛli ba Ʒimiy o min o garo maa zaa na ka n ti ku o.
en: Saul sent the guards back and told them, Bring David to me—bed and all—so I can kill him.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim shɛb daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti la shihirili.
en: Then some teachers of the Law and some Pharisees spoke up. Teacher, they said, we want to see you perform a miracle.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla paɣa, o daa yɛn nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihita.
en: The price for a woman who is to years old is shekels.

dag: Ka biasan la gba daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Bɛnammi. O yaansi n-nyɛ Ammɔnnim bɛn na kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia ni paɣ a, ka ku shini. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: so that my whole being might sing praises to you and never stop. LORD, my God, I will give thanks to you forever.

dag: ka chɛ ka a nuu din mali yiko ŋɔ chɛri ka barinim kpaŋda, ka chɛ ka shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa tumdi a Dab Suŋ Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: Stretch out your hand to bring healing and enable signs and wonders to be performed through the name of Jesus, your holy servant.

dag: N daa piligi di molo molibu la Damaskus n-yi ni chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni Judia tiŋkpansi zaa ni zaŋ tabili bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani n-yɛri ni bɛ niŋm tuuba ŋ-ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani, ka tum tuun shɛŋa din ni wuhi ni bɛ shiri niŋ tuuba.
en: First in Damascus and in Jerusalem and then in the whole country of Israel and among the Gentiles, I preached that they must repent of their sins and turn to God and do the things that would show they had repented.

dag: Jɛhiɛl bidibisi ni, Zɛtam min o mabia Joɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Azichi fukumsi.
en: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.

dag: Nyɛvili wɔɣinli bela yɛm nudirigu ni, ka buni mini jilima be di nuzaa ni.
en: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka a kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli a ni daa ʒi n-yi Ijipti na la zani tariga. Ka a kɔre ku lan kpe bɛ ni bee n-lan teei bɛ yɛla.
en: I will stop your wickedness and the prostitution you started back in Egypt. You will never want to think about those days again.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, so yi di naan chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di samban ni dunɔdali shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: and he said, I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.

dag: Nyama, Sulemaana daamaŋka m-bala ka tɔbbihi pihiyɔbu bɛn mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gil li.
en: Look, Solomons traveling chair. There are soldiers guarding it, strong soldiers of Israel.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni di chɛ ka yi ku lan nyɛ bɛ daba, n kabi yi nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi la, ka chɛ ka yi tooi chana ka yi zuɣuri ʒe tibi.
en: I, the Lord your God, brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves. I broke the power that held you down and I let you walk with your head held high.

dag: Ka Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl mini Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua daa piligi n-lab mɛri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa Jɛrusalɛm, ka Naawuni daanabinim daa be bɛ sani sɔŋdi ba.
en: So Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak again started working on the Temple in Jerusalem. All of Gods prophets were with them and were supporting the work.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: Then King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to attack the city of Ramoth in Gilead.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buyi, Saimɔn Jɔn bia a yuri ma? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: Jesus asked a second time, Simon son of John, do you love me? Peter answered, Yes, Lord, you know I love you! Then take care of my sheep, Jesus told him.

dag: Yawɛ zaɣisi n tɔbbihi zaa bɛn be n sani. O zali ma saha shɛl o ni yɛn ku n nachimba. N Duuma no Juda paɣisarili ŋun nyɛ paɣipiɛliga sɔŋ kaman bɛ ni nɔri wain di bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord laughed at all my strongest soldiers; He sent an army to destroy my young men. He crushed my people like grapes in a wine press.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani ka nyɛ bɛn dɔɣi bihi ni ti pirigi li ti taba, ka di leei yi dini. Bɛ ni ti be yi sani kaman Izraɛl tiŋbihi n-nyɛ ba la. Bɛ ni ti mali tarili Izraɛl zuliya maa sani.
en: When you distribute the land as an inheritance, the immigrants who reside with you and raise families among you are considered full citizens along with the Israelites. They will receive an inheritance along with you among the tribes of Israel.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni n-zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpira n-nyo wurigu mi.
en: He will come ready to clean the grain. He will separate the good grain from the straw, and he will put the good part into his barn. Then he will burn the useless part with a fire that cannot be stopped.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o daa chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: When God finished speaking to Abraham, he left him.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nachimba ni ti lu di zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka bɛ ti ku di tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So the young men will die in the public squares of that city. All her soldiers will be killed at that time. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: ka gbala yɔhi; ka kpiimba pam bɛn daa nyɛ wuntizɔriba la neei kum ni.
en: and the bodies of many holy people who had died were raised.

dag: Yi yi mali yɛm, yin wummiya dimbɔŋɔ. Wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Now listen to me, if you are wise.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋme n-wurim bɛ ni daa me binwɔɣila shɛŋa zal la, ka chɛ n-kabi buɣili Ashɛrim binnani luhi; ka zaŋ ninsalinim kɔba niŋ di zaashɛhi maa bɔɣa ni.
en: King Josiah broke the stone pillars to pieces, cut down the symbols of the goddess Asherah, and the ground where they had stood he covered with human bones.

dag: Amaa nir yi di wahala la o ni nyɛ Kristiɛn zuɣu, ŋun di chɛ ka vi mal o, amaa ŋun naɣ paɣimila Naawuni bɛ ni zaŋ Masia yuli pa o yupaa la zuɣu.
en: But dont be ashamed if you suffer as one who belongs to Christ. Rather, honor God as you bear Christs name. Give honor to God.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni; dama yi puu biɛri n zuɣu.
en: Saul answered, May the Lord bless you for helping me.

dag: Ka yi yi di wahala ka di yuui biɛla, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ anfaanizaalana ka boli ya ni yi mini Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima din ka bahigu la maŋmaŋ chɛ ka yi nya din simdi ya sɔŋbu zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ʒe yim, ka tin ya yiko mini kpiɔŋ.
en: After you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, the one who called you into his eternal glory in Christ Jesus, will himself restore, empower, strengthen, and establish you.

dag: Ka o daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka darigu ʒe tiŋa ka di zuɣusaa chaŋ ti tɔri alizanda, ka o nya ka Naawuni malaikanim dol li duri ka siɣirina.
en: He dreamed and saw a raised staircase, its foundation on earth and its top touching the sky, and Gods messengers were ascending and descending on it.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, N tum tuma maa paai di tariga, zaŋmi m paɣa maa ti ma ka n zaŋ o niŋ m paɣa.
en: Then Jacob said to Laban, The time is up; let me marry your daughter.

dag: Nyama, a tɔbbihi zaa ŋmanila paɣiba. A tiŋgbani maa dunɔdaya yɔhimi ti a dimnima. Ka buɣim di a dunɔdaya dapuhi.
en: Nineveh, your people are all like women—and the enemy soldiers are ready to take them. The gates of your land are open wide for your enemies to come in. Fire has destroyed the wooden bars across the gates.

dag: Pa shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa n-nyɛ tuuli, amaa dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ la n-nyɛ tuuli, ka shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa naanyi paya.
en: But the physical body comes first, not the spiritual one—the spiritual body comes afterward.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda lan ka saria karibu ni, amaa ŋunkam bi niŋ o yɛda, bɛ pun kar o saria, dilan ni bi niŋ Naawuni Bi gaŋ maa yɛda zuɣu.
en: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.

dag: M puhiri n zuliya Hɛrɔdiɔn. M puhiri Narisisus yiŋnim bɛn be ti Duuma ni la.
en: and to Herodion, my relative. Greetings to all those in the family of Narcissus who belong to the Lord.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba mi daa gari chaŋ tiŋ puuni ni bɛ ti da bindirigu na. Ka Samaria paɣ so daa kana ni o ti ŋɔŋ kom; ka Yisa yɛl o, Niŋm kom ti ma ka n nyu.
en: A Samaritan woman came to the well to get some water, and Jesus said to her, Please give me a drink.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duhi ŋariŋ maa chaŋ kaman maal anahi bee ata nti nya Yisa ka o tam kom zuɣu chanina ti miriti bɛ ŋariŋ maa, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam.
en: They rowed the boat about three or four miles. Then they saw Jesus. He was walking on the water, coming to the boat. They were afraid.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi doli buzɔŋ dunoli kpe, ka dula gooni kpe dilan nyɛla tayiɣa ni ŋmɛnditoli;.
en: I assure you that whoever doesnt enter into the sheep pen through the gate but climbs over the wall is a thief and an outlaw.

dag: N ni wuh o o ni yɛn di wahala shɛm n yuli zuɣu.
en: And I myself will show him all that he must suffer for my sake.

dag: Tol la ni daa ŋubi binshɛŋa zaa la, n ni labisi li tin ya kaman di yuma kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm; dama mani n daa tim toli bɛn daa yiɣira mini bɛn daa saɣinda ni bɛn daa ŋmahiri la na. Bɛ daa nyɛla n tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa, ka n tim ba yi sanna.
en: I will give you back what you lost in the years when swarms of locusts ate your crops. It was I who sent this army against you.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinima, ka nyɛ yi ni yɛn puhiri shɛŋa o ni zal li saha shɛli m-bala.
en: Proclaim the following festivals at the appointed times.

dag: Teemi ni a ni daa doli Bɔaz so paɣisara yihiri kayiha la nyɛla ti dɔɣira. Wumma, yuŋ ŋɔ o ni be kabɔɣili ni m-buri chi.
en: You have been picking up grain alongside the women who work for Boaz, and you know he is a relative of ours. Tonight he will be threshing the grain.

dag: Amaa ninsal mali buchi pam gari piɛɣu! Dinzuɣu di tuhiya ni nir tum tuun suŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: People are worth much more than sheep, and so it is right to do good on the Sabbath.

dag: M mi daa bi chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti nya Masia tuun shɛb bɛn daa be n tooni la, amaa ka daa naɣ chaŋla Areebia. Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ti yi nimaani n-lan lab Damaskus.
en: I did not go to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before I was. But, without waiting, I went away to Arabia. Later, I went back to the city of Damascus.

dag: A ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu, ka a nudirigu sɔŋ ma. A chɛ ka n leei ninvuɣ titali a sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: Youve given me the shield of your salvation; your strong hand has supported me; your help has made me great.

dag: Bɛ ka bihi bee zuliya bɛ niriba sunsuuni, ka so lan ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: They have no descendants, no survivors.

dag: dama nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali, di bi tumdi tuma o yi na be o nyɛvil ni.
en: for a will means nothing while the person who made it is alive; it goes into effect only after his death.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara ti ku lan kpi kum din pahi buyi la yaha.
en: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death.

dag: Ʒilinsi saha la ha Naawuni daa di ti suɣilo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o zali shɛlikam zaa ni sokam niŋmi tuuba;.
en: God has overlooked the times when people did not know him, but now he commands all of them everywhere to turn away from their evil ways.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kara pinaata ni di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna zuliya niriba.
en: This is the total of all the cities of the priests descended from Aaron: thirteen cities with their pastures.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣ yoya yiri yi noya ni na naɣila din kpaŋsiri niriba suhuri, ka di ni niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum li anfaani.
en: Dont let any foul words come out of your mouth. Only say what is helpful when it is needed for building up the community so that it benefits those who hear what you say.

dag: Ka m bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ya ka bɛ lee mal li chana.
en: and I asked the angel, Where are they taking the basket.

dag: Amaa so yi kani ŋun ni wuhi di gbinni, yin chɛliya ka bɛ shini baalim cheechi puuni, ka naɣ mal li tɔɣisiri li mi ni Naawuni mini bɛmaŋmaŋa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.

dag: O ni ti tibigi ma, dama n yɛla ka o ti yɛn zaŋ wuhi ya.
en: The Spirit of truth will bring glory to me by telling you what he receives from me.

dag: ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda ku me n-tamla ninsalinim yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ni me n-tamla Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.

dag: n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N Duuma Yawɛ, di ku a niriba bɛn nyɛ a dahalali ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa fa m-bahi a yiko ni, ka zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ yihi ba Ijipti maa na.
en: But I prayed to the LORD! I said: LORD, my Lord! Dont destroy your people, your own possession, whom you saved by your own power, whom you brought out of Egypt with a strong hand!.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ bimbihili gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni. Dina n-daa nyɛ Musa tarili maligumaana leebu piɛlaa maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Then Moses took the breast and presented it as a special gift to the Lord . It was Moses' part of the ordination ram. Moses did everything just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-naai saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: When the entire nation had finished crossing over the Jordan, the LORD said to Joshua.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Yisahaku sanna ti yɛl o, Di chaŋ Ijipti, kpalim be tiŋgban shɛli ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The LORD appeared to him and said, Dont go down to Egypt but settle temporarily in the land that I will show you.

dag: N tum din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi. Di chɛ ma ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ma.
en: Ive done what is just and right. Dont just hand me over to my oppressors.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria ninvuɣ gahinda zaa nirilim, ka saɣim omaŋa o ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb kɔre maa buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: and Oholah gave herself to all those men. All of them were handpicked soldiers in the Assyrian army, and she wanted them all! She became filthy with their filthy idols.

dag: Naawuni daa bi chɛ ka Anabi Ilaija chaŋ bɛ so sani; amaa pakol so ŋun daa be tin shɛli din yuli booni Zarɛfat Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la sani kɔŋko ka o daa chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: Yet Elijah was not sent to anyone in Israel, but only to a widow living in Zarephath in the territory of Sidon.

dag: Mɔabnim mbusim nyabu saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha paari yomyom.
en: It won't be long now— disaster will hit Moab!.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli, paɣimiy o! Saŋmarisi bɛn nyaɣisiri zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.

dag: N ni sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya maa bi wuhi ni yi ʒila yɛlimaŋli, amaa yi ni lee mi li ka baŋ ni ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ni la zuɣu.
en: Do you think I am writing this letter because you dont know the truth? No, I am writing because you do know the truth. And you know that no lie comes from the truth.

dag: Di saha n ni ti zaŋ firilanim lihi Jɛrusalɛm puuni, ka darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka shɛli ni ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Yawɛ ku niŋ din viɛla bee din bie la tibili.
en: At that time I will take a lamp and search Jerusalem. I will punish the people who are self-satisfied and confident, who say to themselves, The Lord never does anything, one way or the other.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Yawɛ kul lari ba. A nyɛla ŋun maani zuliya kam zaa ansarisi.
en: You, Lord , laugh at them and sneer at the nations.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o yɛl o, N yuli Yaakubu.
en: Then the man asked, What is your name? Jacob, he answered.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla a daba ni a ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa zaŋ a yiko min a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ tiligi.
en: Our Lord , I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.

dag: Amaa bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na maa n-nyɛ nir ni ni di shɛli ka ku kpi.
en: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.

dag: Ka yi ti kari doli yi dimnima n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: You will be victorious over your enemies;.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be Gɛba la; ka Filistianim maa daa wum di yɛla. Ka Sool daa chɛ ka bɛ piɛb kikaa gili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa m-mooni molo yɛra, Hiburunima, wummiya.
en: Jonathan killed the Philistine commander in Geba, and all the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul sent messengers to call the Hebrews to war by blowing a trumpet throughout the whole country.

dag: Niriba yɛla bɛ noya gu ma, bɛ lab ma tapaɣisi din ku dɔni, ka laɣim tab liri ma.
en: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.

dag: O daa lan me bindira mini wain palli ni kpama zaashee duri, ka daa lan me o niɣi balibu kam duri ni o biŋkɔbbaligu buzɔna.
en: In addition, he had storehouses built for his grain, wine, and olive oil; barns for his cattle; and pens for his sheep.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ; o ni deei n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zom ma nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: Bless the LORD because he has listened to my request for mercy!.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o kuhi pam yɛli, Lazarɔs, yimina.
en: When Jesus had finished praying, he shouted, Lazarus, come out.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba nyɛla Galili nira yɔɣɔ? Vihim Naawuni Kundi! A yi vihi li, a ni nya ka di bi wuhi ni anab so ni ti yi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: The Jewish leaders answered, You must be from Galilee too! Study the Scriptures. You will find nothing about a prophet coming from Galilee.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be dunia ni n-nyɛ:.
en: Tell the Israelites: These are the animals you can eat:.

dag: Dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ti mini ya zali Masia ni, ka pii ti.
en: God is the one who establishes us with you in Christ and who anointed us.

dag: Ka kpim maa dii neei kum ni n-yiɣisi ʒini gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka Yisa zaŋ o ti o ma maa.
en: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.

dag: A ʒinila gar shɛli din mali jilima zuɣu, ka zaŋ teebuli zali di tooni n-zaŋ n tulaale zim mini n kpam tam di zuɣu.
en: You sat on a fine bed with a table set before it. You put my incense and my oil on this table.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nɛr ni Nadab.
en: His oldest son was Abdon, and his other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: O daa gbimi vuɣi kuɣa nimaani, ka bo ti viɛla na ti sa nimaani; ka sa gara zali puu maa sunsuuni, ka mali wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili sɔŋ di ni. O daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, amaa ka di ti walila wal biɛri.
en: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa chirigi Absalom ka o ba o buntaaŋa zɔra, ka buntaaŋa maa daa ti yɛn zaŋ o gari oki ti titali gbini, ka o zuɣu kpe n-shɛbisi oki tia maa wula ni ka o yili zuɣusaa, ka buntaaŋa maa zo ka chɛ o ka o kpalim yiliya.
en: Absalom was riding his mule under a huge tree when his head caught in the branches. The mule ran off and left Absalom hanging in midair. Some of David's soldiers happened by.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpaŋ shɛŋa zaa din daa gili bɛ fɔntinsi maa n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya zali.
en: and the surrounding villages, as far southwest as the town of Baalath. These are the records which they kept of their families and of the places where they lived.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaɣis o ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: So the Lord became angry with his people. He rejected those who belonged to him.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti lo tɔbu yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni yi tuhi yi dimnim bɛn muɣisiri ya, di saha yin piɛbimiya kika biɛɣu, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ teei yi yɛla, ka tiligi ya yi dimnim maa nuu ni.
en: When you go to war in your land against an enemy who is attacking you, you will blow short blasts with the trumpets so that you may be remembered by the LORD your God and be saved from your enemies.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yɛli ŋun su bɛ kpariti biɛhigu shee fukumsi, Zaŋm kpariti na nti ti Baal jɛmdiba maa zaa. Ka o daa zaŋ kpariti maa na nti ti ba.
en: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naa ni n Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya di nasara gbaliŋ ŋɔ.
en: You are my king and my God; you give victory to your people.

dag: Tiŋgbani dina, bindirigu n-yiri di ni na, amaa tiŋgbani puuni din ŋmanila buɣim din diri binyara.
en: Food grows out of the earth, But underneath the same earth All is torn up and crushed.

dag: Bɛ daa lan chɛ ka Hashabia mini Jɛshaya bɛn daa yi Mɛrari daŋ ni na la ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ni bɛ bidibisi ninvuɣ pisi gba kana.
en: They also brought us Hashabiah and with him Jeshaiah of the family of Merari, together with his relatives and their sons so that there were twenty in total.

dag: Ka a mini Rɔdinim daa laɣindi niŋdi daabiligu, teeku duli tinsi pam daa nyɛla a da gahinda, ka bɛ zaŋdi wɔbinyina mini lanjiŋ dari yɔr a nɛma zuɣu.
en: The people of Rhodes traded with you; people of many coastal lands gave you ivory and ebony in exchange for your goods.

dag: Mabi so bɛ ni tum taali mali yaa gari fɔntiŋ din nyɛ zaɣ titali, ka lala zabili ŋmanila dapua din kpari birini dunoli.
en: An insulted brother is harder to win back than a city with strong walls. Arguments separate people like the strong bars of a palace gate.

dag: Chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, ka fabilimiya, ka kuhimiya. Chɛliya ka yi lari leei kumsi, ka chɛ ka yi suhupiɛlli leei suhugarigu.
en: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.

dag: Nyama, a yɛri ni a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka duh amaŋa nyuri bara. Ʒi a yiŋ baalim. Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn bo yɛla ti amaŋ tabili Judanima.
en: Do you think that because youve defeated Edom, you can arrogantly seek even more? Stay home! Why invite disaster when both you and Judah will fall.

dag: Ka Izraɛl paɣisara chani yuuni kam ti zaŋdi daba anahi fabindi Jɛfita Giliad nir la bipuɣiŋga maa zuɣu.
en: for four days every year Israelite daughters would go away to recount the story of the Gileadite Jephthahs daughter.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi -amba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: The next day we left Ptolemais and went to the city of Caesarea. We went into the home of Philip and stayed with him. He had the work of telling the Good News. He was one of the seven helpers.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ mini n gooni din gili ma ni ŋun fari ma bahira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni ni n tampiŋ. Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n tiliginsim yiligu ni m birini.
en: The Lord is my Rock, my fortress, my place of safety. He is my God, the Rock I run to for protection. He is my shield; by his power I am saved. He is my hiding place high in the hills.

dag: Bɛ ni kul galisi pam shɛm, lala ka bɛ tumdi alahichi pam n sani. N ni chɛ ka bɛ jilima nyabu leei vi.
en: The more they increased, the more they sinned against me; they exchanged their glory for shame.

dag: So yi mali buɣim ka di looi mɔɣu n-chaŋ ti di bɛ ni chɛ bindir shɛŋa sɔŋ bee bɛ ni na bi chɛ bindir shɛŋa bee n-di so puu zaa, di simdi ni ŋun mali buɣim maa yo di zuɣu zaa.
en: When someone starts a fire and it catches in thorns and then spreads to someone elses stacked grain, standing grain, or a whole field, the one who started the fire must fully repay the loss.

dag: Zaɣisimiya zaɣ biɛɣu ka yu zaɣ viɛlli, ka doliya din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Di pa shɛli yi yi niŋ lala, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni zo Yisifu zuliya bɛn kpalim la nambɔɣu.
en: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people.

dag: Timiya ba jilima, ka yuri ba pam bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛli maa zuɣu; ka maliya suhudoo ni taba.
en: Treat them with the greatest respect and love because of the work they do. Be at peace among yourselves.

dag: Ti paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun bi zaŋ ti niŋ ti dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ bahi ti yoli ŋɔ.
en: Let us thank the Lord , who has not let our enemies destroy us.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn luri n yuli sizuura ŋɔ, n tiliginsim yiko din be kaman wuntaŋ neesim la ni nyee kpɛn ya, ka tahi tibbu na ti tin ya. Yi ni ti yiɣiri jamdi kaman naɣibihi pola n-yi naɣiluu ni na la.
en: But the sun of righteousness will rise on those revering my name; healing will be in its wings so that you will go forth and jump about like calves in the stall.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi ku mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛli n-tum alahichi. Di maliya li ŋmahindi bin lɔɣu bee bin nyaŋ.
en: So be careful! Dont sin and destroy yourselves by making false gods or statues in the shape of any living thing. Dont make an idol that looks like a man or a woman.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi maa yi zooi mɔɣu maa ni n-niŋ yaa, bɛ chanimi ka ku lan labi bɛ sani yaha.
en: Their babies grow strong out in the wild. Then they leave their mothers and never come back.

dag: Dama Naawuni n-zaani saha shɛl o ni bɔri ni daadamnim kan o sanna ka o ti kariti ba saria.
en: God does not need to set a time for us to go and be judged by him.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti kpalim ka zuliya pam gili ba ni ti bemi kaman gbuɣinli m-be mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri san la. Bɛ ni ti bemi kaman gbuɣin polli n-yi piɛri zuɣu n-tim bɛ ni n-no ba sɔŋ ka dari tɔhi ba, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi la.
en: Those who are left among the nations will be like a lion hunting for food in a forest or a pasture: it gets in among the sheep, pounces on them, and tears them to pieces—and there is no hope of rescue.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛl o bihi maa, N yɛn chaŋ ti pahila n yaannim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Zaŋmiya ma ti sɔɣi siliga din be Ɛfurɔn ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la puu la ni m-pahi n yaannim zuɣu.
en: Jacob ordered them, I am soon to join my people. Bury me with my ancestors in the cave thats in the field of Ephron the Hittite.

dag: Naawuni, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama a sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi. A baɣiri ni ka n yɛn sɔɣi hal ka din tahiri saɣiŋgu ŋɔ na ti gari.
en: Have mercy on me, God; have mercy on me because I have taken refuge in you. I take refuge in the shadow of your wings until destruction passes by.

dag: Puu atam kpuɣibu saha naaya, ka wuuni du, ka ti na bi tiligi.
en: And the people say, Harvest time is over. Summer is gone, and still we have not been saved.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli soli be katiŋa ka chɛ ti, ka din tuhi mi ku tooi miri ti. Yɛlimaŋli tuui niriba laɣiŋgu shee soli zuɣu, ka biɛhigu din tuhi kɔŋ kpɛhili shee nimaani.
en: Justice is pushed aside; righteousness stands far off, because truth has stumbled in the public square, and honesty cant enter.

dag: Di zaa yoli ka Firawuna daa na kul niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm la.
en: Pharaoh still refused to let the people go, just as the Lord had said. Pharaoh refused to listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Amaa n yɛr a mi ni n ni daa tuui boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni yino gba noli ku to laɣiŋgu ŋɔ bindira maa. .
en: Not one of the guests I first invited will get even a bite of my food.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim a niriba ŋɔ suhuri kpa a polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni mali nia shɛŋa mini tɛhi shɛŋa ŋɔ kul ni be bɛ suhuri ni sahakam.
en: Lord , you are the God of our ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Please help your people plan the right things. Help them be loyal and true to you.

dag: Amaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti chɛ ba ka leei dabari dɔni n-di vuhim dabisa nyaɣisim saha shɛli bɛ ni ti lan ka di ni maa, dama bɛ ʒiɛm n zaligunima ka zaɣisi n zaligunim maa bɛ suhuri ni.
en: The land will be empty. The land will enjoy its time of rest. Then the survivors will accept the punishment for their sins. They will learn that they were punished because they hated my laws and refused to obey my rules.

dag: Ka Naomi daa ti wum ni Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋun Naawuni niriba ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ puri atam niŋ pam, ka o daa mali shili ni o min o bihi paɣiba la yiɣisi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kul o ya.
en: Some time later Naomi heard that the Lord had blessed his people by giving them good crops; so she got ready to leave Moab with her daughters-in-law.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa ni, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: When God raises people from death, whose wife will this woman be? She had been married to all seven brothers.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ so ŋun zaɣisi ni o ku zo nti sɔɣi Naawuni sani tiligi, amaa ka naɣ niŋla o daazichi naani, ka zaŋ o daazichi maa n-leeg o sɔɣibu shee la.
en: Look at them! They didnt make God their refuge. Instead, they trusted in their own great wealth. They sought refuge in it—to their own destruction.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Lɛvinim mini bɛ daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔnnima; ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba nyɛ Kɔhatinima; ka Mɛrari daŋ niriba nyɛ Mɛrarinima.
en: They also counted the tribe of Levi. These are the family groups from the tribe of Levi: Gershon—the Gershonite family group; Kohath—the Kohathite family group; Merari—the Merarite family group.

dag: A yi saɣi ni n tim a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari, n kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu gari, m bi yɛn birigi nudirigu bee nuzaa polo.
en: Please let us pass through your land. We promise to stay on the road. We wont step off it, right or left.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, dim n ni zaŋ binshɛli ti a maa, ŋubimi gbaŋ maa ka chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then he said to me: Human one, eat this thing that youve found. Eat this scroll and go, speak to the house of Israel.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa zaa daa ka Jɛrimia sanna nti bɔh o; ka o garigi yɛli ba kaman naa ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bi lan bɔh o shɛli, dama bɛ daa bi wum bɛ daalizama maa.
en: Then all the officials came and questioned me, and I told them exactly what the king had told me to say. There was nothing else they could do, because no one had overheard the conversation.

dag: nti yɛli ba: Yinim Juda nanim mini Judanim zaa ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa bɛn doli dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpɛra, Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Tell the kings and all the people of Judah and everyone who lives in Jerusalem and enters these gates, to listen to what I say.

dag: Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala, ka o gba yuli daa du m-pahi wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa zuɣu.
en: These were the kinds of things Jehoiadas son Benaiah did. He made a name for himself along with the three warriors.

dag: Amaa ka Juda daa yɛl o, Doo maa daa kpahi ti zuɣu ni yɛli, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yin di chɛ ka n ninni nyan ya.
en: But Judah said to Jacob, But the governor of that country warned us. He said, If you dont bring your brother back to me, I will refuse to talk to you.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla ŋun be neesim ni, ka shɛli ka di ni din ni chɛ ka so tuui.
en: If we love others, we live in the light, and so there is nothing in us that will cause someone else to sin.

dag: ni Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa diri ʒi Hɛshibɔn la tin kara zaa zaŋ hal ti paai Ammɔnim tintariga.
en: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa daa yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Yinima n-tum birigi chaŋ ti kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim taali galisi.
en: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women and adding to Israels guilt.

dag: Amaa ti yi be neesim ni kaman o ni be neesim ni shɛm, ti ni mali dolintabitali ni taba, ka o Bia Yisa ʒim kul ni kpihindi ti daalahichi zaa bahira.
en: But if we live in the light in the same way as he is in the light, we have fellowship with each other, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, cleanses us from every sin.

dag: Kpiɔŋ mini jilima n-nyɛ o situra, o suhu bi zɔhiri saha shɛŋa din kanna zuɣu.
en: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.

dag: Absalom ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm dol o chaŋ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi, bɛn daa kul chaŋla bɛ tariŋ chandi, ka bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Two hundred invited guests went with Absalom from Jerusalem. They were innocent and knew nothing of this matter when they went.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla binshɛli din yi o tooni na ka nyɛ daɣiri maa zaligu. O tooni yi yiɣisi bee di yi bi yiɣisi, di nyɛla daɣiri o sani.
en: The person is unclean whether the discharge continues to flow or whether it stops.

dag: O daa ti bɛ ni yino la pɔŋ tusaanu, ka ti yino pɔŋ tusaayi, ka ti ŋun kpalim la mi pɔŋ tuhili. O daa ti bɛ zaa la kaman bɛ yaa tariga ni nyɛ shɛm ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: To one he gave five valuable coins, and to another he gave two, and to another he gave one. He gave to each servant according to that servants ability. Then he left on his journey.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋubi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni vamahili kam, ka saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: They ate all the plants in the country, including all the crops in their fields.

dag: Di saha doo maa ya kpamba maa ni boli doo maa na ti tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa, ka o yi na kul vili ʒiɛla lala ka yɛli, N je ni n kpuɣ o.
en: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni ni Naawuni yɛliya, Benya kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: That's why the Scriptures say, I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.

dag: Hal sagbani maa daa yi kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa dabisi gbaliŋ gba, Izraɛlnim maa kul dolila Yawɛ zaligu maa ka ku yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: When the cloud lingered on the meeting tent for many days, the Israelites would observe the LORDs direction and they wouldnt march.

dag: Amaa n nyɛla ŋun be biɛrim mini nandahima ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka a tiliginsim yiko gbibi ma.
en: I am sad and hurting. God, lift me up and save me!.

dag: ka di nyɛla ŋun Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli din so n-ti ti la zuɣu. Di daliri nyɛla, bɛ ku tooi mali be dɛde, ka pa ni Naawuni zaŋ ti mi pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua daŋ niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Kadimiɛl yiŋnim mini Hɔdɛva yiŋnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanahi.
en: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua, that is, of Kadmiel, of the descendants of Hodaviah.

dag: Yi yaannim ʒiɛman ni ka yi daa birigi ka chɛ n zaligunima, ka bi lan dol li. Labimiya n sanna ka n gba labi yi sanna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ labina.
en: Ever since the time of your ancestors, you have deviated from my laws and have not kept them. Return to me and I will return to you, says the LORD of heavenly forces. But you say, How should we return.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi, ka tɔɣisim di yɛla yi yi be yiŋa ni yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo ni yi yi ti doya ni yi yi ti yiɣisi.
en: Be sure to teach them to your children. Talk about these commands when you sit in your house and when you walk on the road. Talk about them when you lie down and when you get up.

dag: O daa pirigi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu buyi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who split the Reed Sea in two— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Di saha ka Dilaila daa bɔhi Samsin, Wula ka a yɛri ni a yuri ma ka a suhu ka n ni? Siɣimsiɣim buta zaa ka a boli ma jɛrigu, ka bi saɣi yɛli ma a kpiɔŋ din galisi pam maa ni be a luɣ shɛli.
en: Samson, Delilah said, you claim to love me, but you don't mean it! You've made me look like a fool three times now, and you still haven't told me why you are so strong.

dag: Dama ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni ti yi zuɣusaa n-siɣina ni tahigu mini malaikanim zuɣulan kukoli ni Naawuni kikaa kumsi. Ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la ni ti daŋ kum ni neebu;.
en: This is because the Lord himself will come down from heaven with the signal of a shout by the head angel and a blast on Gods trumpet. First, those who are dead in Christ will rise.

dag: O daa kul dolila Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o, ka kul dol o zaligu kpan shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la.
en: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.

dag: Lɔdinim mini Hadidnim ni Onɔnim niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisi ni yini.
en: of Lod, Hadid, and Ono.

dag: Di saha maa, naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu sokam zaa daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: In those days Israel wasn't ruled by a king, and everyone did what they thought was right.

dag: A mabihi maa, Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ni labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi ti labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka a gba min a bipuɣinsi zaa ni ti labi yi biɛri kurili ni.
en: Then your sister Sodom and her daughters will return to their former state, and your sister Samaria and her daughters will return to their former state. You and your daughters will return to your former state.

dag: Zaŋmiya salima alali mali di buɣim saligbabirisi mini di buɣim moorisi.
en: You should also make its tongs and fire pans out of pure gold.

dag: yi nina ni daa nya zahimbu kar shɛŋa mini shihiri shɛŋa ni alahiziba tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa teeg o nuu din mali yaa yihi ya na shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛn niŋ yi ni zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb dabiɛm maa zaa.
en: the great trials that you saw with your own eyes, the signs and wonders, and the strong hand and outstretched arm the LORD your God used to rescue you. Thats what the LORD your God will do to any people you fear.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a tiri ninvuɣ so dabili zalige? O zanibu bee o lubu nyɛla o duuma yɛla. Ka o shiri ni zani, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi chɛ ka o zani.
en: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-gbiri binyara ŋubira.
en: Not far away there was a large herd of pigs feeding.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda daŋ silisi la zuɣusaa polo. Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa sɔɣ o jilima sɔɣibu. Ka o bia Manaasa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hezekiah lay down with his ancestors and was buried in the upper area of the tombs of Davids sons. All Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem honored him at his death. His son Manasseh succeeded him as king.

dag: Ifriimnima, wula ka n ni tooi zaɣisi ya? Izraɛlnima, wula ka n ni tooi chɛn ya bahi? Wula ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Adimanim shɛm la? Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Zɛbɔiimnim shɛm la? N suhu taɣiya, ka n nambɔzɔbo galisi.
en: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.

dag: N daa lan nya nahiŋgu shɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. N daa nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu maa ni kumdi shɛm, ka ka ŋun goori ba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahindi ba maa daa mali yiko pam, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ka ŋun ni gooi ba maa.
en: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.

dag: Di simdi ni ti mabi so ŋun nyɛ faralana ka Naawuni duh o mali suhupiɛlli;.
en: Brothers and sisters who are poor should find satisfaction in their high status.

dag: Ka Lɛvi bidibisi maa daa niŋ kaman Musa ni yɛli ba shɛm, ka bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb dindali maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba tusaata.
en: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about , men.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ni ŋmahiŋmahi nim shɛŋa maa mini binzuɣu ni biŋkpam nti pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then Aarons sons the priests will arrange the pieces, the head, and the fat on the wood that is on the altar fire.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia alali nyɛla ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia o suhu ni, ka gunibu maŋli mi nyɛ suhu ni yɛla din nyɛ Naawuni Shia ni niŋdi shɛli, ka di pala niŋgbuŋ ni kɔŋko yɛla. Ka dilana nyari paɣibu la Naawuni sani, ka pa ni ninsalinim sani.
en: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni bɔri ni yi nya shihirili din wuhiri ni Masia yiko ni ka n tɔɣisirila zuɣu. Masia pala ninvuɣ gbariŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni niŋdi ya shɛm polo, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhir o yiko yi sunsuuni.
en: Since you are demanding proof that Christ speaks through me, Christ isnt weak in dealing with you but shows his power among you.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka bɛ lee nya a yili ŋɔ? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ nya binshɛɣukam zaa din be n yiŋa; ka binshɛli bi kpalim n nɛma dur la ni ka m bi zaŋ li wuhi ba.
en: What did they see in the palace? They saw everything. There is nothing in the storerooms that I didn't show them.

dag: Dama n nya ka a mali putɔɣu, ka be alahichi bandi ni.
en: for I see that your bitterness has poisoned you and evil has you in chains.

dag: Ka yi tintariga maa ni ŋmaligi nudirigu polo n-zaŋ ti paai Akirabim kunkuni n-zaŋ ti gari Zin, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Kadɛshibarinia nudirigu polo; ka zaŋ nimaani hal ni Hazarada n-gari hal ni Azimɔn.
en: Your border will turn south of the ascent of Akrabbim and cross toward Zin. Its limit will be south of Kadesh-barnea. It will go out to Hazar-addar and cross toward Azmon.

dag: Ka sabi li pa yi yiŋ dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.

dag: Ka a lan pii di shɛli niŋ buɣim ni n-nyo li. Ka buɣim maa yi nimaani na nti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Then take a few of them out again, throw them in the fire, and let them burn up. From them fire will spread to the whole nation of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ ba Riuɛl bɔhi ba, Ka wula ka yi ti daŋ kundina lala.
en: When they returned to their father, he asked, Why have you come back so early today.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim Juda ni o daŋmi tooni ti yɛli Yisifu ka o wuhi ba soli din kuni Goshɛn; ka bɛ daa mali hal ti paai Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jacob had sent his son Judah ahead of him to ask Joseph to meet them in Goshen.

dag: Chɛli ka ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni gari. Ti ku birigi kpe mɔɣu ni bee n-tim yi wain tihi puri ni; ti mi ku nyu yi kɔbilisi kom. Ti kul yɛn dolila solɔɣu hal ti gari yi tintariga.
en: Please let us pass through your territory. We promise to stay away from your fields and vineyards, and we won't drink any water from your wells. As long as we're in your land, we'll stay on the main road.

dag: O daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub sara maligu bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni so ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la, hal ka daa pii li ti ti bɛn daa be o sani maa.
en: He went into the house of God and took the sacred loaves of bread that only priests were supposed to eat. He not only ate some himself, but even gave some to his followers.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla nir ni daa yi zɔri kuni tin shɛŋa ni tiligiri la ti ba. Shɛkɛm din be zoya ni la mini Gɛza ni di momaha tiŋgbana ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba.
en: These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon.

dag: Mɔabnim mbusim nyabu saha miriya, ka bɛ bahi yoli saha paari yomyom.
en: The end of Moab is near. Moab will soon be destroyed.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka bɛ be ni alaafee, amaa ka o lee pa nina lihiri bɛ tuma.
en: God may let them live secure, but keeps an eye on them all the time.

dag: Ka salo bɛn dol o maa yɛli, Yisa ŋun nyɛ anabi n-yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na m-bala.
en: This is the prophet Jesus, from Nazareth in Galilee, the crowds answered.

dag: Amaa nyin bi taɣira, ka a yuma mi ka tariga.
en: But you are always the same, and your life never ends.

dag: ka Zakaria daa nyɛ Iddo daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Mɛshulam so mi daa nyɛ Ginnɛtɔn daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la zuɣu; o kɔbili ni ka di yina. O nyɛla Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu toondana ni di chɛ ka o nyɛ ŋun gari binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: He is the head of his body, the church; he is the source of the body's life. He is the first-born Son, who was raised from death, in order that he alone might have the first place in all things.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim lan pala tinzunnim ni saamba yaha; yi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa yipa laɣim nyɛla tiŋbi yinsi ka nyɛ Naawuni yiŋnima.
en: So now you are no longer strangers and aliens. Rather, you are fellow citizens with Gods people, and you belong to Gods household.
