dag: Di saha maa ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim zaa daa laɣim kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ bɛ tantinim ti kpa Jɛziriil Vinvamli ni.
en: The Midianites, Amalekites, and other people from the east joined together to fight against the Israelites. They went across the Jordan River and camped in the Jezreel Valley.

dag: M bi sɔɣi a tiliginsim sɔŋsim yɛla n suhu ni, n kul yɛr a ʒiɛyimtali min a sɔŋsim maa yɛla. M bi sɔɣ a ʒiɛyimtali min a yurilim maŋli yɛla niriba pam laɣiŋgu ni.
en: I didnt keep your righteousness only to myself. I declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I didnt hide your loyal love and trustworthiness from the great assembly.

dag: A dimnim bela a jɛmbu duu maa luɣ kasi shee la n-tahiri nasara dibu tahigu; ka zaŋ bɛ tuutanim sa nimaani.
en: Your enemies roared in your own meeting place; they set up their own signs there!.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayopɔin saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa di Izraɛl nam ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-sula Izraɛlnim yuma ayi.
en: In the seventeenth year of the reign of King Jehoshaphat of Judah, Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for two years.

dag: Chɛ ka n wuhibu ŋɔ lu kaman saa la, ka n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣi lu kaman maligim la bee kaman saa ni yi luna baalim bahi mɔri zuɣu shɛm la; ka lan be kaman sa yuɣiyuɣi din yuɣisiri bahiri bimbilima zuɣu la.
en: My teachings will come like the rain, like a mist falling to the ground, like a gentle rain on the soft grass, like rain on the green plants.

dag: Ifriim tiŋgbɔŋ ku lan mali birini, ka Damaskusnim kɔŋ nam. Ka Aramnim bɛn kpalim ni kɔŋ jilima kaman Izraɛlnim ni kɔŋ shɛm la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The fort cities of Ephraim will be destroyed. The government in Damascus will be finished. Those left in Aram will lose everything, just like the people of Israel, says the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Dama m boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka n teei n nuu na, ka yi baɣa ka di ni.
en: I tried to help, but you refused to listen. I offered my hand, but you turned away from me.

dag: Duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa. Ŋuni n-lee nam saŋmarisi? Ŋuna ŋun zali ba zaɣ bɔbili maa mi bɛ kalinli, ka mi bɛ zaa yuya. O yaa ni o yiko ni galisi zuɣu, o na ʒi n-kali pooi bɛ ni so.
en: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing.

dag: Dama bɛn mali niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋuni n-na mi n-wum Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni kaman ti ni wum shɛm ŋɔ, ka na be o nyɛvili ni?.
en: Is there anyone who has heard the living Gods voice speaking out of the very fire itself, like we have, and survived?.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi bi saɣi li o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o ni ku o pɔri maa min o noli ni daa faag o ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛl la; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: But if her husband hears about the promise and objects, she no longer has to keep it, and the Lord will forgive her.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, I won't let it be destroyed.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Sool Dauda ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Sauls officers told Saul what David said.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri gadamanim nyuli, a mi di pii bɛ soya shɛli doli.
en: Dont envy violent people or choose any of their ways.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa nya ka o bi dɔɣi bihi ti Yaakubu maa zuɣu ka o daa zabir o biɛli nyuli, ka yɛli Yaakubu, Tim ma bihi, di yi pa lala, n ni kpi.
en: But Rachel had not borne Jacob any children, and so she became jealous of her sister and said to Jacob, Give me children, or I will die.

dag: Asa tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Amaa o ni daa ti kurigi, naba polo dɔro n-daa gbaag o.
en: Everything else Asa did while he was king, including his victories and the towns he rebuilt, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah . When he got older, he had a foot disease.

dag: ka yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: saying, Dont say anything to anyone. Instead, go and show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifice for your cleansing that Moses commanded. This will be a testimony to them.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni daalibarika n-tim bɛn niŋdi ya alaka; chɛliya ba turi, ka kul suhimiyala Naawuni daalibarika tim ba.
en: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba bɛn daa leei bundaannim paɣ maa zuɣu la ni ti kaɣ ti ʒe kpaŋa o ni nya nahiŋgu shɛli din mali dabiɛm maa zuɣu, ka kuhiri ka fabindi.
en: The merchants who sold these things, and got so rich by her, will stand a long way off because they fear the pain she suffers. They will weep and mourn, and say.

dag: Ka Ashikɛlɔnnim nya li, ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka Gazanim gba nya li, ka di zab ba pam. Lala n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛkurɔnnim gba, ka bɛ tahima zaa ni bɔrigi. Gaza ni kɔŋ naa, ka Ashikɛlɔn kpalim zan dabari.
en: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ bir o puu ni, ka di zooi niŋ tia hal ka noonsi ti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu la.
en: Gods kingdom is like the seed of the mustard plant. Someone plants this seed in their garden. The seed grows and becomes a tree, and the birds build nests on its branches.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi yi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, dama daba ayopɔin ka ti yɛn zaŋ leei ya maligumaaniba.
en: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa pii Izraɛlnim dahin shɛli la, n daa po pɔri bɛn Yaakubu zuliya maa sani, ka zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N daa po pɔri yɛli ba, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Tell them what I am saying. When I chose Israel, I made them a promise. I revealed myself to them in Egypt and told them: I am the Lord your God.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum yi tuma zaa.
en: You have six days in which to do your work.

dag: Ka Dauda daa laɣim Izraɛlnim maa zaa zaŋ Shihɔr din daa be Ijipti la hal ti kpa garibu shee din be Lɛbohamat la ni bɛ chaŋ Kiriatijiarim ti zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa na.
en: David gathered everyone from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo-Hamath in the north.

dag: Amaa sapashin kpɛm maa daa naɣ chɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛba ni bɛ maani tihi puri ka kɔra.
en: Only some of the poorest people were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.

dag: Masia maŋmaŋ ni lo alikauli ni o ti ti shɛli nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: And this is what Christ himself promised to give us—eternal life.

dag: O daa wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima tibisim shɛm tariga mali teebuli din nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro piɛri tab sɔŋdi shɛli zuɣu ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali anzinfa teebuli kam.
en: the gold table which held the sacred loaves of bread, the tables made of silver.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tahi Ɛkurɔn. Amaa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ni daa paai Ɛkurɔn na, ka Ɛkurɔnnim daa kuhi yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la tahi ti ya ŋɔ na ni di ti ku ti mini ti niriba.
en: So they sent the Covenant Box to Ekron, another Philistine city; but when it arrived there, the people cried out, They have brought the Covenant Box of the God of Israel here, in order to kill us all.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun miligi naa suhu, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.

dag: Naawuni zom ti nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni; ka ŋmalig a nini lihi ti ni yurilim.
en: Let God grant us grace and bless us; let God make his face shine on us, Selah.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma mini m ba Yisahaku Naawuni ŋɔ, Nyin Yawɛ, a daa yɛli ma, Labim a ya min a dɔɣiriba sani ka n niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Then Jacob prayed, God of my grandfather Abraham and God of my father Isaac, hear me! You told me, Lord , to go back to my land and to my relatives, and you would make everything go well for me.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa puuni, a ka taali, dama a nyɛla ŋun ʒe ti yim, ka tinim lee tum din bie.
en: But God, you were right about everything that happened to us. You were right, and we were wrong.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi mini Masia ni laɣim neei kum ni la zuɣu, bomiyala binshɛŋa din be alizanda ni Masia ni ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo luɣ shɛl la.
en: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.

dag: N yi yɛli, N ni tam n fabila maa yɛla, ka yihi suhugarigu ŋɔ n suhu ni, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: If I say, Ill forget my lament, put on a different face so I can smile.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana ni Shimɛi yila Jɛrusalɛm n-chaŋ Gaat ka labina.
en: But someone told Solomon that Shimei had left Jerusalem and gone to Gath and back.

dag: Di chɛ ka n yɛla gbaag a dabiɛm, m bi yɛn nahim a pam.
en: Dont be afraid of me. I will not be hard on you.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ kuɣili ŋɔ sa luɣ shɛli ŋɔ ni leei nyin Naawuni yiŋa, ka a yi ti ma binshɛlikam zaa, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni yihi di bini pia kam ni zaɣ yini ti a.
en: I am setting this stone up as a memorial stone. It will show that this is a holy place for God, and I will give God one-tenth of all he gives me.

dag: ka zaŋ salima alali m-mali zoligɔnim ayi n-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li ga kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni maa.
en: and two chains of pure gold twisted like cords, and attach them to the settings.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa shiri zaŋ chɛribo kuɣa mali pilima n-guni Izraɛlnim luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gibiatihaaralɔt la.
en: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.

dag: Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la ti ma suhumahili kaman a ni lo mani a dabili ŋɔ alikauli shɛm la.
en: Please let your faithful love comfort me, according to what youve said to your servant.

dag: ka n chɛ ka bɛ niŋ bindirigu tin ya na, yi ni ka mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani ŋɔ na zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi gari. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Niŋm a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Let me get you some food to give you strength before you leave. I would be honored to serve you. Thank you very much, they answered. We accept your offer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kaɣili fiɛb o zuɣu ni, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka damdir o tooni puhir o.
en: Then they beat him on the head with a stick. They spit on him and knelt down and pretended to worship him.

dag: Yi yaannim ʒiɛman ni ka yi daa birigi ka chɛ n zaligunima, ka bi lan dol li. Labimiya n sanna ka n gba labi yi sanna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ labina.
en: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, How can we return.

dag: Ka di varanda wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita awɛi, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di mini jɛmbu duu maa puuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛla yim, ka di dubu mi daa nyɛ mita pihinunaanahi, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima alali pa di puuni dukpina zuɣu.
en: Across the front of the temple was a porch meters wide and meters high. The inside walls of the porch were covered with pure gold.

dag: O daa yihi ba bumbɔni mini zibisim ni, ka kabi bɛ bandi.
en: He took them out of their dark prisons. He broke the ropes that held them.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni din tuui mal alikauli di ni yɛliya: Tim a ba min a ma jilima.
en: The command says, You must respect your father and mother. This is the first command that has a promise with it.

dag: ka yi tiŋgbani mi ti be kaman tahiʒiɛɣu. Yi ni ti yihi yi yaa tum tuma yoli, ka yi tiŋgbani ku niŋ bindirigu, ka di tihi gba ti ku wali wala.
en: All your hard work will do you no good, because your land will not produce crops and the trees will not bear fruit.

dag: Jɛfita ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim daa bi fa Mɔabnim tiŋgbani bee Ammɔnnim tiŋgbani.
en: with this answer: It is not true that Israel took away the land of Moab or the land of Ammon.

dag: Zaligu shɛli din gbibi niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so daɣiri ni yibu saha zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: After you think you are healed of leprosy, you must ask for a priest to come outside the camp and examine you. And if you are well.

dag: Azaria daa nyɛla Amaria ba, ka Amaria nyɛ Ahitub ba.
en: Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah of Ahitub.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka yɛdaniŋdib maa daa chɛ ka Pool mini Silas dii yi nimaani yuŋ chaŋ Bɛria. Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Bɛria, bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpɛla Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: As soon as night came, the believers sent Paul and Silas to Berea. When they arrived, they went to the synagogue.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tumd alahiziba tumtumsa; ka nyɛ ŋun kahig a yiko tuma wuhi zuliya shɛba.
en: You are the God who does amazing things. You showed the nations your great power.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa tin ya. Chamiya ti deei li su kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Look, there it is! Go up and take the land for your own. The Lord , the God of your ancestors, told you to do this, so dont be afraid or worry about anything.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni la shiri yi a zuɣu.
en: Do this so that they will believe that the LORD, the God of their ancestors, Abrahams God, Isaacs God, and Jacobs God has in fact appeared to you.

dag: Teeku noli tinsi la ni ti leela Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la dini, ka bɛ ti guli bɛ biŋkɔbiri nimaani, ka gbɛri Ashikɛlɔn tiŋ puuni yuŋ. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni mi bɛ yɛla, ka labisi bɛ daazichi la ti ba yaha.
en: The coast will belong to the survivors from the house of Judah; they will pasture beside the sea; in the houses of Ashkelon they will lie down in the evening. The LORD their God will visit them and restore their possessions.

dag: Yisa daa na bi paai Bɛtani tiŋ puuni; o daa na kul bela Maata ni tuh o soli luɣ shɛli maa.
en: He had not yet come into the village. He was still at the place where Martha met him.

dag: Ka zuliya gari ni kana ti be Ashidɔd. Ka n siɣisi Filistianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la.
en: An illegitimate child will dwell in Ashdod; I will eliminate the pride of the Philistines.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ Kɛdɛshi mini Dabɛrat ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa.
en: The Gershon families also got the towns of Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Gannim from the tribe of Issachar. They also got the fields near those towns.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ma ka di ka daliri galisiya gari n zabiri. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ ku ma galisiya pam, ka n dimnim ŋmari ʒiri pari ma. Bɛ chɛ ka n yola n ni bi zu neen shɛŋa samli.
en: Those who hate me for no reason are more numerous than the hairs of my head. My enemies tell lies against me; they are strong and want to kill me. They made me give back things I did not steal.

dag: Mɔdɛkai bapir so bipuɣiŋga daa beni ka o yuli booni Ɛsta. O Hiburu yuli mi daa nyɛla Hadasa. O daa viɛli pam. O ba min o ma zaa daa kpimi ka chɛ o, ka Mɔdɛkai zaŋ o n-wums o kaman omaŋmaŋ bipuɣiŋga la.
en: He had a cousin, Esther, whose Hebrew name was Hadassah; she was a beautiful young woman, and had a good figure. At the death of her parents, Mordecai had adopted her and brought her up as his own daughter.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa wum lala ka bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, a bɔri ni ti chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba kaman Anabi Ilaija ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: When the disciples James and John saw what was happening, they asked, Lord, do you want us to call down fire from heaven to destroy these people.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa zali ba dabisili ni bɛ ka o sanna. Ka dindali maa daa ti paai ka o ye o nam binyɛrigu ʒin o nam ʒiishee n-tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: and a day was set for them to meet with him. Herod came dressed in his royal robes. He sat down on his throne and made a speech.

dag: Ka mɔɣili dɔni bihigu tiŋgban tulli shee; ka tiŋgban kuŋ shee leei kɔbil nina. Ka mɔri zooi lim kunduna ni daa yi be luɣ shɛli.
en: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home.

dag: Di saha maa ka Sintani daa kpe Yisa nyaandoliba pinaayi maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Judas Isikariɔt la suhu ni;.
en: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, who was one of the Twelve.

dag: Pɛrɛz zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hɛzirɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Hɛzirɔnnima; ka Hamul daŋ niriba nyɛ Hamulnima.
en: Perezs descendants: from Hezron, the Hezronite clan; from Hamul, the Hamulite clan.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa n-chaŋ gili tiŋ maa napɔŋ yim, ka zaŋ li lab bɛ sansani maa ni ti gbe.
en: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu ni nahim tin shɛli, ka di bi nya sɔŋsim ŋɔ, n ni zaŋ kuɣ viɛla me a zali, ka zaŋ safaya kuɣa sɔŋ a tanzaa.
en: Suffering one, storm-tossed, uncomforted, look, I am setting your gemstones in silvery metal and your foundations with sapphires.

dag: Ka Amazia daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-gari tooni zaŋ o niriba maa chaŋ Yalim Vinvamli la ni nti ku Ɛdomnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: After Amaziah got his courage back, he led his troops to Salt Valley, where he killed , Edomite soldiers in battle.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri n-liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko n-cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: No one patches up an old coat with a piece of new cloth, for the new patch will shrink and make an even bigger hole in the coat.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Leemi ti naa su ti; ka a bidibiga min a nyaaŋa gba ti nyɛ ti nanim su ti, a ni fa ti Midiannim nuu ni bahi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then the Israelites said to Gideon, Rule over us, you and then your son and then your grandson, because youve rescued us from Midians power.

dag: Naftali zuliya ni sapashinnim tuhili mini tɔbbihi tuhi Pihitanaayopɔin n-daa buɣiri kpana ka gbibi nyɔtaɣira.
en: from Naphtali, , officers, as well as , armed with shield and spear.

dag: Amaa o bela o kɔŋko, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi taɣ o? O ni bɔri shɛli, dina ka o niŋda.
en: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilɔi, Ilɔi, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: At three o'clock Jesus cried out with a loud shout, Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani? which means, My God, my God, why did you abandon me.

dag: Adɔnija mini saamba bɛn zaa daa be o sani ni daa ti di bɛ bindira naari saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa wum vuri maa. Jɔab ni daa wum kikaa kumsi saha shɛli ka o bɔhi, Ka vu bɔ ka bɛ lee yɔri tiŋ puuni ŋɔ.
en: Meanwhile, Adonijah and his guests were just finishing their meal. They heard the sound of the trumpet, and Joab asked, What is that noise? What is happening in the city.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Shelumiel, Zurishaddais son.

dag: Ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihiri ba, ka tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛn ti o la shɛli.
en: So the man gazed at them, expecting to receive something from them.

dag: Mbusim be a zuɣu, nyini ŋun kuri niriba, ka so na bi ku a ŋɔ; nyini yɛŋkiŋkabinalana, so ʒi n-tum a yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma. A yi ti chɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, bɛ ni tum a yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma; ka a yi ti chɛ niriba kubu, bɛ ni ku a.
en: Doom to the destroyer left undestroyed, you traitor whom none have betrayed: when you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have stopped betraying, they will betray you.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana bi nyar o suhu ni bɔri binshɛŋa, amaa ŋun tumdi tuun kpɛma ŋun nyar o suhu ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa.
en: Lazy people always want things but never get them. Those who work hard get plenty.

dag: Dinzuɣu chamiya ti yɛli zuliya kam ka bɛ leei n nyaandoliba, ka yi baptaizi ba ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia ni o Shia Kasi yul ni;.
en: Therefore, go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

dag: yi ni yɛn mali sara shɛli ka n deei li nyɛla yi bo binlɔɣu ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa, naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee bulaa.
en: To be accepted, it must be a male without any defects.

dag: Ka naa maa daa pirig o nintu shɛli o ni daa yi mali dihiri zaligu gbana zuɣu ka di leeri naa ni zali zaligu shɛli ti Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: The king handed his official ring to Haman, who hated the Jews, and the king told him.

dag: Ka Sɛrafinim daa ʒe o zuɣusaa polo. Bɛ zaa yinoyino daa malila kpiŋkpama ayɔbuyɔbu. Bɛ daa zaŋla diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ nina, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ napɔnvari, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi yiɣira.
en: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Yaamiya yi noya ka n dihi ya.
en: I, the Lord , am your God. I brought you out of Egypt. Israel, open your mouth, and I will feed you.

dag: Bipolli, mali suhupiɛlli a bipolitali saha. Chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a bipolitali saha. Dol a suhu ni bɔri shɛm, ka niŋm a ni bɔri shɛm. Amaa lee baŋmi ni Naawuni ni ti kar a saria di zaa maa zuɣu.
en: Be cheerful and enjoy life while you are young! Do what you want and find pleasure in what you see. But don't forget that God will judge you for everything you do.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa garigi yɛl o, Pa tuun sun shɛli zuɣu ka ti yɛn lab a kuɣa maa, amaa a ni mɔri Naawuni la zuɣu, dama a nyɛla daadam, amaa ka zaŋ amaŋ leei Naawuni.
en: They answered, We are not killing you for any good thing you did. But you say things that insult God. You are only a man, but you say you are the same as God! That is why we are trying to kill you.

dag: Izraɛlnim gula, wummi ti suhigu; nyin ŋun mali Yisifu zuliya chani kaman piɛri la, wummi ti suhigu. Nyin ŋun ʒi a nam ʒiishee din be chɛrubinim zuɣu la, chɛ ka a neesim neei.
en: Shepherd of Israel, listen to us. You lead your people like sheep. You sit on your throne above the Cherub angels. Let us see you.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi Juda Naa Amazia shɛm la, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jehoash did, including his bravery in the war against King Amaziah of Judah, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Bɛ daa bela bɛ suɣa ni ŋ-ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.

dag: Dama o suhuyiɣisili bi yuura, ka o nyɛ ŋun kul niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam. Di pa shɛli kuhigu ni beni yuŋ, amaa ka suhupiɛlli mi be biɛɣ neebu ni.
en: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nyari tibigibu o yiko puuni. Karimba ŋuni n-lee paag o?.
en: Look, Gods power makes him great! He is the greatest teacher of all.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Ahija bia Baasha daa leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa n-ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuun pisinaanahi.
en: Baasha son of Ahijah became king of Israel in Asa's third year as king of Judah, and he ruled years from Tirzah.

dag: ka kɔŋlan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kuli nti di ka nyu, ka niŋ shɛli tari, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ ni daa baŋ bɛ ni karim shɛli n-wuhi ba maa gbinni la zuɣu.
en: So all the people went home and ate and drank joyfully and shared what they had with others, because they understood what had been read to them.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni ti chɛ nyuli zabbu, ka Juda zuliya dimdi la ti kpi. Ifriim zuliya ti ku lan zab Juda zuliya nyuli; ka Juda zuliya mi ti ku lan nyɛ Ifriim zuliya dimnima.
en: Ephraims jealousy will cease, and Judahs harassment will be eliminated. Ephraim wont be jealous of Judah, and Judah wont harass Ephraim.

dag: O daa tum din chihira n-chaŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa kaman Amɔrinim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni daa niŋdi shɛm ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Yawɛ kari ba ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini di ni la.
en: Ahabs actions were deplorable. He followed after the worthless idols exactly like the Amorites had done—the very ones the LORD had removed before the Israelites.

dag: Naa ni ti fabili, ka nabia ti yihi tahima, ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa bɔɣiri ti sɔhira. N ni ti yɛn niŋ ba kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka kari ba saria kaman bɛ saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The king will go into mourning, the prince will clothe himself in despair, and the hands of the lands people will tremble. When I do to them as they have done and judge them by their own justice, they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Ti yi bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a ni a yɛli ti ka ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ ŋun dim shɛhira jɛndi ti.
en: Then they said to me, May the Lord be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not obey all the commands that the Lord our God gives you for us.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔsia daa zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ o, ka daa bo binyara niŋ omaŋa n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. O daa zaɣisiya ni o ku wum Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka Nɛko yɛl o shɛm maa; ka daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi chaŋ ti lir o Mɛgido bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: But Josiah was determined to fight. He refused to listen to what God was saying through King Neco, so he disguised himself and went into battle on the plain of Megiddo.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun daa pun be ka ti lan kani la nyɛla naa ŋun pah anii, amaa o nyɛla nanima ayopɔin la ni yino, ka o gba ni bahi yoli.
en: The beast that was once alive but is no longer living is an eighth ruler. This eighth ruler also belongs to the first seven rulers. And he will go away to be destroyed.

dag: O daa kpuɣi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nɛma mini nayili nɛma zaa, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma salima la shɛŋa zaa Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm.
en: Nebuchadnezzar also took away all the treasures of the LORDs temple and of the royal palace. He cut into pieces all the gold objects that Israels King Solomon had made for the LORDs temple, which is exactly what the LORD said would happen.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa biŋkpam, ka ŋmaai zugbini miri yaaŋ kɔbili n-zaŋ di mini di kpam maa zaa mali sara ni biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la ni biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: and present the following parts of the animal as a food offering to the Lord : the fat, the entire fat tail cut off near the backbone, all the fat covering the internal organs.

dag: ni Shaalabin ni Aijalɔn ni Itila.
en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah.

dag: Tiŋ maa niriba zaa bɔrila bindirigu ka kul ŋuhira. Bɛ zaŋ bɛ daazichi zaa taɣi bindirigu ni bɛ lan nya yaa. Yawɛ, lihimi nya n ni bahi yoli shɛm.
en: All her people are groaning, seeking bread. They give up their most precious things for food to survive. LORD, look and take notice: I am most certainly despised.

dag: Tulaale mini tulaalɛzim nyɛla din paligiri suhu, amaa yɛlimuɣisirili nyɛla din kabiri suhu.
en: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛrusha, o daa nyɛla Zadok bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jotham became king at the age of twenty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years. His mother was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

dag: O ku chɛ ka a napɔŋ pihigi; ŋun gul a maa bi gbihira.
en: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka o daa fa ba bahi, amaa ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daalahichi daa chɛ ka bɛ nya filiŋ.
en: Many times the Lord rescued his people, but they chose to rebel against him and sank deeper into sin.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi bɛ tinsi ni n-laɣim Gibia na ni bɛ ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: Men from towns all over Benjamin's territory went to Gibeah and got ready to fight Israel.

dag: Ka gbani tiŋ kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, chɛli niriba ŋɔ daalahichi ŋɔ paŋ ba. O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka dii bahi.
en: Falling to his knees, he shouted, Lord, dont hold this sin against them! Then he died.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: And Jesus concluded, Listen, then, if you have ears.

dag: N ni tir a jilima dabisili kam, ka kul ni paɣir a yuli sahakam.
en: I will praise you every day. I will praise your name forever and ever.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Kish, o daa nyɛla Abiɛl bia, ka Abiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛro bia, ka Zɛro nyɛ Bɛkɔrat bia, ka Bɛkɔrat mi daa nyɛ Afia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la bia, o daa mali buni pam.
en: There was a wealthy and influential man named Kish, from the tribe of Benjamin; he was the son of Abiel and grandson of Zeror, and belonged to the family of Becorath, a part of the clan of Aphiah.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa din daa be bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-nyɛ: Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol ni Irishɛmɛsh.
en: The territory of their legacy was Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh.

dag: Dama a yihi ma muɣisigu kam ni, ka chɛ ka n nini nya n dimnim nasara kɔŋbu.
en: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and I have seen my enemies defeated.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac said to his father Abraham, My father? Abraham said, Im here, my son. Isaac said, Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the entirely burned offering.

dag: Doo maa ni daa zaŋ ba ti kpɛhi Yisifu yiŋa, ka ti ba kom ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka bo mɔri ti bɛ bunsi naai.
en: The servant led the men into Josephs house. He gave them water, and they washed their feet. Then he fed their donkeys.

dag: Ka bɛ kukoya maa vuri daa chɛ ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli tanzaa sɔhigi, ka nyɔhi pali duu maa zaa.
en: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.

dag: Di saha ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Izraɛl Naa Pɛka daa kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka teei gil li, amaa ka daa bi tooi nyaŋ Naa Ahaz.
en: King Rezin of Aram and King Pekah son of Remaliah of Israel came to fight against Jerusalem. Rezin and Pekah surrounded Ahaz, but could not defeat him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka Aduna kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee fiɛb taŋkpaɣu, ka pɔri daa yi n-lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri zuɣu, taŋkpaɣu maa zaa daa leela pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: They did this. Aaron stretched out his hand with his shepherds rod, hit the lands dirt, and lice appeared on both people and animals. All the lands dirt turned into lice throughout the whole land of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti nya filiŋ Ijipti zo n-kuli maa ni, ka Firawuna ti chɛ ka bɛ di vi bɛ ni bɔri sɔŋsim shɛli maa puuni.
en: But the king will be powerless to help them, and Egypt's protection will end in disaster.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Maika ni chɛ ka n niŋdi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O bu ma la paa ka n nyɛ o maligumaana.
en: The Levite replied, Micah hired me as his priest. Then he told them how well Micah had treated him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n dana, jaande wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania wum n fabila ŋɔ, ka di lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ maa ni ka n ti kpi nimaani.
en: But now, my lord, king of Judah, please listen to me. Please let me bring my request to you. This is what I ask: Dont send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe. If you send me back, I will die there.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi kɔhigɔriba galisi gari saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Toliga fuɣisiya ka yiɣi chaŋ.
en: You produced more merchants than there are stars in the sky! But now they are gone, like locusts that spread their wings and fly away.

dag: Zomiya kɔr biɛri tuma! ŋun tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma tumdi li dalindirila omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa ninsal ni tumd alahichi balibu shɛŋa zaa pahi pala din dalind o niŋgbuŋ.
en: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.

dag: Yɛnnim chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋdi balima yɛtɔɣa niŋdi bɛ noya ni pahira.
en: Wise people always think before they speak, so what they say is worth listening to.

dag: Kurigu n-sahiri di kpee, ka ninsalinim gba nyari baŋsim tab sani.
en: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens a friend.

dag: Bɛnjamin daŋ ni; Ɛliada ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn nyɛ peentɔriba ka gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi la.
en: Eliada was a brave warrior who commanded the troops from Benjamin. He had , soldiers under his command, all of them armed with bows and shields.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒin gil o niŋ sunsuuni ka bɛ yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔr a.
en: Many people were sitting around Jesus. They said to him, Your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are waiting for you outside.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham ti liri Filistianim maa? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Dauda, Cham ti liri ba n-tiligi Kɛilanim maa.
en: David asked the LORD, Should I go and fight these Philistines? Go! the LORD answered. Fight the Philistines and save Keilah.

dag: Shɛshan daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi kɔŋko, o daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa o daa mal o dabili ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nira, ka o yuli booni Jariha.
en: Sheshan had no sons, only daughters; but Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name was Jarha.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛli daa bol o, M bia Samuɛl. Ka Samuɛl saɣi, N-nyɛ ma.
en: Eli called him, Samuel, my boy! Yes, sir, answered Samuel.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛl o, Pita, yiɣisima n-kɔrigi ŋubi.
en: A voice said to him, Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Obɛdɛdom bidibisi. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ mabihi daa nyɛla bɛn mali baŋsim, ka simdi ni bɛ tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihiyɔbunaayi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Obɛdɛdom daŋ maa ni niriba.
en: All these men were Obed Edoms descendants. These men and their sons and relatives were powerful men. They were good guards. Obed Edom had descendants.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari doli Naa Sool min o bidibisi nti ku Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons, and they killed his sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.

dag: Ka n ti darigi Mɔabnim tibili, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Moab will be punished. Then the people there will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the Lord because he is good. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: suhimiya Naawuni sahakam.
en: and never stop praying.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ti a jilima. Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ putɔɣunim ni lu a sizuura.
en: The people of powerful nations will praise you; you will be feared in the cities of cruel nations.

dag: Tiliginsim mi lan ka so sani yaha, dama Naawuni bi lan zaŋ so yuli ti ti dunia ŋɔ ni ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka ti tiligi.
en: Jesus is the only one who can save people. His name is the only power in the world that has been given to save anyone. We must be saved through him.

dag: Amaa sokam ni ti ʒila o wain tia bee o fiig tia gbini, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yaag o noli yɛli lala maa.
en: They will sit under their own grapevine and fig tree. No one will make them afraid. That is because the Lord All-Powerful said it would happen like that.

dag: A ni ti nya n ni yɛn niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ Izraɛlnim ni, ka di biɛr a ka a zabiri ba nyuli; amaa nyin daŋ ni so ku lan nya kɔb piɛlli o zuɣu ni hal abada.
en: Youll see trouble in my dwelling place, though all will go well for Israel. But there will never be an old person in your family tree.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu yɛli.
en: Job said:.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛligu mi kul ku yiɣisi. Ka Naawuni yi daa bol o ni zaŋ o yɛligu ti ninvuɣ shɛb la ŋun Naawuni ŋmahinli.
en: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.

dag: Yinim Jɛshurunnima, so kani ŋ-ŋmani yi Naawuni ŋun yi zuɣusaa na ni o ti sɔŋ ya ka nyɛ ŋun yi sagbana ni na ni jilima ŋɔ. Naawuni so ŋun ka bahigu ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi sɔɣisili shee.
en: There is no one like the God of Israel! He rides on the clouds in his divine greatness. He comes riding through the skies to help you.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa boli Musa mini Aduna labisi Firawuna sanna, ka o ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa; amaa ka banima n-lee yɛn chaŋ maa.
en: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to the king, and he said to them, You may go and worship the Lord your God. But exactly who will go.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o suli min o sujee ni o suhuyiɣisili ni nandahima paai ba, ka di ŋmanila malaika bɔbili bɛn kuri niriba.
en: God unleashed his burning anger against them— fury, indignation, distress, a troop of evil messengers.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yi bi sɔŋ a, wula ka man ni tooi sɔŋ a? M malila chi bee wain.
en: He replied, If the Lord won't help you, what help can I provide? Do I have any wheat or wine?.

dag: Ka a ti baŋ ni barina shɛli ka a yiŋa. Ka a yi ti kaag a piɛri, a ni nya ka bɛ zaa beni.
en: Then you will live at peace in your tent; when you look at your sheep, you will find them safe.

dag: Ka n ti ba suhuyini, ka zaŋ shi palli kpɛhi bɛ ni. Ka n ti yihi suhu shɛli din be kaman kuɣili ŋɔ bɛ ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ bɛ ni.
en: I will give them a new heart and a new mind. I will take away their stubborn heart of stone and will give them an obedient heart.

dag: Dama n dabisa kul chanimi gariti kaman nyɔhi la, ka n kɔba ni mi diri buɣim kaman daaŋa ni buɣim la.
en: My life is passing away like smoke. My life is like a fire slowly burning out.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli, ka gbilisiya tibili wum fabila shɛŋa din yɛn yi n noli ni na.
en: Now, listen to my argument. Listen to what I have to say.

dag: Ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii ka o doya, ka bɛ daa dii yɛli Yisa o niŋgbun biisim maa yɛla.
en: Simon's mother-in-law was sick in bed with a fever, and as soon as Jesus arrived, he was told about her.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ŋɔ, yiɣisim zani!.
en: LORD, avenging God— avenging God, show yourself!.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ bini pɔb o ninni ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbaye m bia Absalom, mbaye Absalom, m bia, m bia!.
en: The king covered his face and cried out in a loud voice, Oh, my son Absalom! Oh, Absalom, my son! My son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ piibupiibu m-piila Mataias, ka bɛ daa sab o yuli pahi tuumba piniyini maa yuya ni.
en: Then they drew lots to choose between the two men, and the one chosen was Matthias, who was added to the group of eleven apostles.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi, bɛ yi fo, kuɣa ni deei kuhi yɛli.
en: But Jesus answered, I tell you, if my followers didnt say them, these stones would shout them.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmd a suhuri paligi, ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Naawuni galisiya.
en: But let all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you, and let those who love your saving help say again and again: God is great.

dag: Ka o ti yihi bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini sara maligu kam puuni n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka di leei maligumaana ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa ʒim kpaai vie maa dini.
en: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.

dag: So yi yu ni o tum Naawuni yubu, o ni baŋ ni wuhibu ŋɔ yila ŋun Naawuni sanna bee m-baŋ ni di nyɛla mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka n wuhiri li.
en: Whoever is willing to do what God wants will know whether what I teach comes from God or whether I speak on my own authority.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba zaa ka nimaani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpe ŋarima maa n-chaŋ Kapɛrinium ni bɛ ti bo Yisa shee.
en: When the crowd saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples, they got into those boats and went to Capernaum, looking for him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: After the people heard Paul say this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Puuni duu maa daa malila duno jaba, ka luɣ kasi shee la gba mali duno jaba.
en: Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors.

dag: Dama niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili bela ʒim puuni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tin ya ni di yo yi nyɛviya tiliginsim samli. Dama ʒim n-nyɛ din yɔri alahichi samli, di ni nyɛ nyɛvili la zuɣu.
en: The life of every living thing is in the blood, and that is why the Lord has commanded that all blood be poured out on the altar to take away the people's sins. Blood, which is life, takes away sins.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Bɔhim maligumaana m-baŋ zaligu ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɔhigu ŋɔ polo.
en: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi fɔntiŋ kam ni. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: At the same time we captured and destroyed every town, and put everyone to death, men, women, and children. We left no survivors.

dag: ni Taai nanim zaa ni Sidɔn nanim zaa ni teeku duli tiŋgbɔna din nyɛ.
en: I made all the kings of Tyre and Sidon drink from the cup. I also made all the kings of the faraway countries drink from that cup.

dag: N Naa ni n Naawuni, wummi n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim shɛm ŋɔ, dama nyini ka n suhira.
en: Pay attention to the sound of my cries, my king and my God, because I am praying to you!.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi di ni yi ninvuɣ so tooni na maa, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches the man with the discharge must wash his clothes and take a bath, and he remains unclean until evening.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko gba, di yi bi tumdi tuma, di nyɛla yɛda kpiŋ.
en: It is the same with faith. If it is just faith and nothing more—if it doesnt do anything—it is dead.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yi Mɛsopoteemia m-mali hal ti paai Shɛkɛm din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ni alaafee nti ti suɣa dɔni tiŋ maa tooni polo.
en: Jacob safely ended his trip from Paddan Aram when he came to the town of Shechem in Canaan. He made his camp in a field near the city.

dag: Di ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuliya shɛb yɛri ŋumaŋuma, ka Gɛshɛm gba yɛli ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni a mini Yɛhudianim lola nia ni yi taai duŋ ni dizuɣu n-chɛ ka yi lab mɛri gooni maa. O lan yɛli ma ni a loya ni a zaŋla amaŋ leei naa.
en: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam m-pahi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣiba bɛn nyɛ yuyanima mini dɔbba daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Many came to believe, including a number of reputable Greek women and many Greek men.

dag: O gbarigi n yaa m biɛhigu puuni, ka filim n dabisa.
en: My strength failed me. My life is cut short.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A kɔr biɛri tuma min a ni daa be a zaɣim a mamanim sani a pagɔrisigu tuma tumbu ni ni a buɣ shɛŋa din chihiri min a ni daa zaŋ a bihi ʒim mali ba la.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: You have spent your money and let your lovers and filthy gods see your naked body and have sex with you. You have killed your children and poured out their blood. This was your gift to those false gods.

dag: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti, ka bɛ kana ti paai teeku ni, di saha ka Ijiptinim daa yiɣisi zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba n-kari bɛ naba na hal ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and cavalry. But when your ancestors got to the Red Sea.

dag: Ka yi ni tumdi binshɛɣukam zaa tiri ba puuni, tummiya li ni yi suhuri zaa kaman ti Duuma ka yi tumdi li tiri la, ka pa ni ninsalinim ka yi tumdi li tira.
en: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as though you were working for the Lord and not for people.

dag: Ka yi suhi yi Naawuni maa, ka n gba suhi Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so ŋun chɛ ka buɣim taai nimdi maa, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka Niriba maa zaa yɛli, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla.
en: Then all of you will call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The god who answers with fire—thats the real God! All the people answered, Thats an excellent idea.

dag: Ka banim ka o daa po n-yɛli ni bɛ ku nya vuhim o san la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa niŋ tipawumlinim la?.
en: And against whom did he swear that they would never enter his rest, if not against the ones who were disobedient?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ alichɛbba maa tiŋli ti tuui.
en: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.

dag: ka di pala o kandina maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa suhumaabo shɛli o ni daa nya yi san la gba zuɣu. O daa yɛli ti yi suhuri ni ye n nyabu zuɣu shɛm yɛla mini yi suhusaɣiŋgu ni yi baɣa ni be n ni shɛm gba yɛla, ka di daa chɛ ka n suhu maan paligi pahi.
en: It was not only his coming that cheered us, but also his report of how you encouraged him. He told us how much you want to see me, how sorry you are, how ready you are to defend me; and so I am even happier now.

dag: A chɛ ka puri atam niŋdi pam yuuni puuni; ka a naɣikɔra tɔroko lɔɣu pali bindira hal ti puuri bahira.
en: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee na ti di ba ka bɛ kpi Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then fire flew out from before the LORD and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, ti bi zabiri dunia ŋɔ zabili.
en: We live in this world, but we dont fight our battles in the same way the world does.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi la, alahichi sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛba bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.

dag: Yinim bɛn be Rom gba be Naawuni ni boli shɛba ni bɛ leei Yisa Masia niriba maa kalinli ni.
en: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Zɛbulɔn zuliya: Yinim Zɛbulɔn zuliya, Maliya suhupiɛlli yi yibu ni. Yinim Isaka zuliya, bɛnya yi suɣa puuni.
en: Then he told Zebulun: Zebulun: celebrate when you are out and about; Issachar: celebrate when you are at home in your tents!.

dag: zaŋ tabili Araba din daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la zaa hal ti taɣi Araba Teeku Pisiga zolɔŋ la ni.
en: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.

dag: Ka o lan yɛl o tumo maa, Yim doli pala mini puri soya n-dari niriba pahi na hal ka n yil ŋɔ ti pali niriba.
en: So the master said to the servant, Go out to the country roads and lanes and make people come in, so that my house will be full.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom nyɛla tɛhi zilimalana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu yiɣisiri yomyom kpaŋsirila jɛrilim.
en: Patience leads to abundant understanding, but impatience leads to stupid mistakes.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni maa zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛli n-kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: The anointed priest will take some of the bulls blood and take it into the meeting tent.

dag: Shafan bia Ɛlasa mini Hilikia bia Gɛmaria bɛn daa nyɛ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa tim shɛba Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza san la n-daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa mali chaŋ. Di daa yɛlimi.
en: King Zedekiah of Judah sent Elasah son of Shaphan and Gemariah son of Hilkiah to King Nebuchadnezzar. Jeremiah gave them the letter to take to Babylon. This is what the letter said:.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ teeku dulinim ŋɔ, fomiya ka wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Di simdi ni zuliya kam labi neei bɛ kpiɔŋ. Bɛ zaŋm bɛ yɛtɔɣa kana ti tɔɣisi. Chɛliya ka ti laɣim saria karibu shee.
en: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!.

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di ku ba. A ni ku a ni zaŋ a takɔb min a tɔbu n-gbahi shɛb leeg a daba? Bomi la bindirigu ti ba ka bɛ di ka nyu kom, ka lab bɛ naa sani.
en: No! Elisha answered. You didn't capture these troops in battle, so you have no right to kill them. Instead, give them something to eat and drink and let them return to their leader.

dag: Ŋunkam mali maligu ti buɣili ka pa ni Yawɛ kɔŋko, yin kum dilana.
en: Anyone who offers sacrifices to any god, other than the LORD alone, should be destroyed.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ako bee bɛn be Sidɔn bee bɛn be Ahilab bee bɛn be Akizib bee bɛn be Hɛliba bee bɛn be Afik bee bɛn be Rɛhɔb.
en: The Asher tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob, and the Asher tribe lived with Canaanites all around them.

dag: Naawuni, ti kul tɛhir a yurilim maŋli la yɛla a jɛmbu duu la puuni.
en: We dwell on your faithful love, God, in your temple.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi gba daa bela katiŋ ni Naawuni, ka nyɛ o dimnima yi biɛhigu puuni yi ni daa tɛhiri bin biɛ shɛŋa yɛla ka tumdi li la zuɣu.
en: At one time you were separated from God. You were his enemies in your minds, because the evil you did was against him.

dag: Bɛ yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti ku n-naai bɛ zuliya maa. Di chɛliya ka so ti lan teei Izraɛlnim yuli yɛla yaha.
en: They say, Come, let us destroy them completely. Then no one will ever again remember the name Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa nyɛ Amɔrinim mini Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pa Izraɛlnim la.
en: Any non-Israelite people who remained of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa din daa be bɛ sani ka bɛ booni li Baalnim la mini buɣili Ashitarɔt labi, ka jɛmdila Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: The people got rid of their idols of Baal and Astarte and began worshiping only the Lord .

dag: Dama n daa zɔrila wahala din yɛn yi Naawuni sanna dabiɛm, ka n daa naan ku tooi zan o jilima tooni.
en: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gɔb, ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Saf ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni nir la.
en: Later, there was another battle with the Philistines at Gob. Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, another one of the giants.

dag: Ka bɛ sɔŋdi taba, ka yɛra, M mali suhukpeeni.
en: Each helps the other, each saying to the other, Take courage.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram ʒii nyabu puuni, Ibram, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, n ni gbib a ka chɛ ka a laara ti galisi pam.
en: After all these things happened, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision. God said, Abram, dont be afraid. I will defend you and give you a great reward.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni so ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba n-niŋ o di yiko.
en: And he added, This is the very reason I told you that no people can come to me unless the Father makes it possible for them to do so.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa tuumba ayi maa ni bɛ na yim kpaŋ pɔi. Ka jintɔriba maa daa niŋ tab saawara.
en: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a dɔni a nuzaa luɣili zuɣu, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim tibidarigibo pa amaŋ zuɣu n-ʒi bɛ tibidarigibo maa dabisa shɛŋa ni zaa a ni yɛn do nimaani maa.
en: Now, lie on your left side, and set the guilt of the house of Israel on it. For the length of time that you lie on your side, you will bear their punishment.

dag: amaa niriba daalahichi kpihimbu zuɣu, Masia daa malila sara maligu yim din kul ni ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka chaŋ ti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: Christ, however, offered one sacrifice for sins, an offering that is effective forever, and then he sat down at the right side of God.

dag: Yinim zoya mini dunia ŋɔ tanza kurisi la, wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama Yawɛ min o niriba mali yɛtɔɣa; o mini Izraɛlnima m-mali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Hear, mountains, the lawsuit of the LORD! Hear, eternal foundations of the earth! The LORD has a lawsuit against his people; with Israel he will argue.

dag: Ka yi ti leei bɛ ni je ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ ni turi ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ni maani ninvuɣ shɛba ansarisi Yawɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ya tahi zuliya shɛb zaa sani maa.
en: In the countries to which the Lord will scatter you, the people will be shocked at what has happened to you; they will make fun of you and ridicule you.

dag: Pu shɛli daa do m-miri bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu luɣ shɛli maa, ka sil pal shɛli bɛ ni daa na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni do puu maa ni.
en: There was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified, and in the garden was a new tomb in which no one had ever been laid.

dag: Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin dihi niriba tusaanahi la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi di gba pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: And remember the seven loaves of bread that fed the people and the many baskets you filled that time?.

dag: Pita ni daa ti ka Antiɔk na, n daa galim o o ninni, dama o ni daa niŋ shɛm nyɛla din simdi galimbu.
en: But when Peter came to Antioch, I opposed him in public, because he was clearly wrong.

dag: Amaa m bi zaŋ Naawuni ni zali zaligu shɛli ŋɔ tumdi di tuma bee n sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya mi ni n deei shɛli yi sani, dama m paɣiya ni n kpi n-gari ni so niŋ ma shɛli din ni chɛ ka n kɔŋ n ni yɛn nyu bara shɛli zuɣu.
en: But I have not used any of these rights, and I am not trying to get anything from you. That is not my purpose for writing this. I would rather die than to have someone take away what for me is a great source of pride.

dag: Lala ka alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yiɣisi kɔre balibu kam n ni. Di yi di pa lala Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu, alahichi naan nyɛla din kpi.
en: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yi shihi di nimdi maa di gba ni leei din be kasi. Ka di ʒim yi tɔɣ vie binyɛrigu, di simdi ka yi paɣi di ni tɔɣ vie binyɛr shɛli maa luɣ kasi shee.
en: Anything that touches the purification offerings flesh will become holy. If some of its blood splashes on a garment, you must wash the bloodied part in a holy place.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; miri ka a di zalinsi; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: You know the commandments: Dont commit murder. Dont commit adultery. Dont steal. Dont give false testimony . Dont cheat. Honor your father and mother .

dag: Imɛr daŋ — tuhili ni pihinunaayi.
en: of Immer .

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee kabiɛlli kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di yi pa lala, di kul ni nyɛla kabiɛl yini maa ko; amaa di yi kpe tiŋgban ni pooi, di ni nabi.
en: I am telling you the truth: a grain of wheat remains no more than a single grain unless it is dropped into the ground and dies. If it does die, then it produces many grains.

dag: Adam ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun ŋman o m-bol o yuli Sɛt.
en: When Adam was years old, he had a son who was like him, and he named him Seth.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra yɛli, N ni dol a chaŋ, amaa pa nyini nti yɛn nya a chandi maa nasara dibu jilima, dama Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka paɣa n-nyaŋ Sisɛra. Ka Dɛbɔra daa yiɣisi doli Barak chaŋ Kɛdɛshi.
en: She answered, All right, I will go with you, but you won't get any credit for the victory, because the Lord will hand Sisera over to a woman. So Deborah set off for Kedesh with Barak.

dag: Bɛ yi nahindi sarikanim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: He does not like any prisoner on earth to be trampled down.

dag: Ka Sisɛra daa dɔni gbihi di ni daa wum o pam zuɣu. Ka Jaɛl Hɛbɛr paɣ maa daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa mini zali m-puɣisi chaŋ ti zaŋ li ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋ ka o kpi.
en: Sisera was so tired that he fell sound asleep. Then Jael took a hammer and a tent peg, quietly went up to him, and killed him by driving the peg right through the side of his head and into the ground.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-kari alizin biɛri maa, ka tib ŋunkam daa biɛra.
en: That evening people brought to Jesus many who were demon-possessed. He threw the spirits out with just a word. He healed everyone who was sick.

dag: Yinim bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋɔ, paɣimiy o! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, timiy o jilima! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura.
en: All of you who revere the LORD—praise him! All of you who are Jacobs descendants—honor him! All of you who are all Israels offspring— stand in awe of him!.

dag: M bolila n tumtumda, amaa ka o bi garigi ma. Di simdi ni mmaŋmaŋ balim o.
en: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.

dag: Dinzuɣu gol so ŋun daa daŋ tooni yuun shɛli din pahir ayi maa ni dahin yini dali, ka o daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.

dag: Paɣ so daa be Jɔpa n-nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ka o yuli booni Tabita. O daa tumdi tuun suma pam, ka lan tumdi nambɔzɔbo tuma gba lala.
en: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means deer. She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul yɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zuɣu, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa nyɛla din tahiri wala na.
en: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma! Dama kom paala n nyiŋgoli tariga.
en: God, save me from all my troubles! The rising water has reached my neck.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba mini Midian kpamba maa daa zaŋ baɣibuɣiri liɣiri chaŋ Balaam sani ti yɛl o Balak ni yɛli shɛm.
en: The leaders of Moab and Midian left and took along money to pay Balaam. When they got to his house, they gave him Balak's message.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chaŋ ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa pipihi ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa kpuɣi Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu na maa, ka naa min o kpambaliba ni o paɣiba ni o mamanim ti mal li nyuri wain maa;.
en: At once the gold cups and bowls were brought in, and they all drank wine out of them.

dag: Dama saha shɛli n ni daa zaŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim la na hal ni zuŋɔ, n na ʒi m-be yil ni, amaa n daa kul yirila suɣili ni n-lan kpɛri suɣili ni, ka yiri m biɛhigu shee.
en: In fact, I havent lived in a temple from the day I brought Israel out until this very day. Ive been traveling from tent to tent and from dwelling to dwelling.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din yiri kpaŋ na nti kpɛri ninsal ni ku tooi ta o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri. .
en: Nothing outside of a person can enter and contaminate a person in Gods sight; rather, the things that come out of a person contaminate the person.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bɔri ni bɛ ku o ka di lahibali ti nti to Rom sapashin kpɛm ŋun daa su nimaani ni Jɛrusalɛm zaa damya.
en: The mob was trying to kill Paul, when a report was sent up to the commander of the Roman troops that all of Jerusalem was rioting.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋumbu, amaa o nirilim ŋmanila maligim din lu mɔri zuɣu.
en: A raging king roars like a lion; his favor is like the dew on the grass.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Sisɛra min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o tɔbbihi zaa birim Barak tooni, ka Barak daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ba. Ka Sisɛra daa sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu na guui.
en: The LORD threw Sisera and all the chariots and army into a panic before Barak; Sisera himself got down from his chariot and fled on foot.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Jona ŋun nyɛ Amitai bia la.
en: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Juda zuliya ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tusatusa fukumsi puuni, Adina daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisita.
en: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had , soldiers under his command.

dag: Ka fɔŋ kar shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ gba daa beni. Dina n-nyɛ: Gibiɔn mini Rama ni Bɛrɔt.
en: There were also Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth.

dag: Bɛtani mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣa ni taba; di nyɛla kaman mail ayi laasabu.
en: Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi lo tɔbu ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi bɛ dimnim saha shɛlikam, Yawɛ paarila o nuu bɛ zuɣu bɛ daalahichi tumbu zuɣu kaman o ni daa pun kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ka po n-yɛli ba shɛm la. Ka nandahima daa mali ba pam.
en: When the Israelites went out to fight, they always lost. They lost because the Lord was not on their side. He had already warned them that they would lose if they served the gods of the people living around them. The Israelites suffered very much.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tumtumdiba bɛn daa ʒe o yiŋ dunol ni daa bɔhi Mɔdɛkai, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaɣisi naa zaligu dolibu.
en: The other officials in the royal service asked him why he was disobeying the king's command;.

dag: Ka Midian mi bihi daa nyɛ Ɛfa mini Ɛfɛr ni Hanok ni Abida ni Ɛldaa. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Kɛtuura bihi min o yaansi.
en: Midian also had five sons: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.

dag: Niaria bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɔnai mini Hizikia ni Azirikam, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Neariahs family: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.

dag: Di dunoya pinaayi la daa nyɛla waya pinaayi, waya zaɣ yiniyini ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali dunoli kam, ka tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-doya ne kaman takɔriti diɣisi la.
en: The twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was made from a single pearl. And the citys main street was pure gold, as transparent as glass.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kana ti paai Yaakubu. Yaakubu daa tila o suɣa zali zoya ni, ka Leeban mi min o dɔɣiriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zali zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la.
en: The next morning Laban caught up with Jacob. Jacob had set up his camp on the mountain, so Laban and all his men set up their camp in the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa puuni, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: These past years, your clothes did not wear out, and your feet did not swell.

dag: Yin ni tooi di binshɛŋa zaa bɛn be kom ni n-nyɛ: binshɛɣukam bɛn mali gɔhi mini paɣiri.
en: Heres a list of the water animals you are allowed to eat: you can eat anything that has fins and scales.

dag: lala ka daadamnim doya ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha, hal ka sagbana ti lan kani, bɛ ku lan yiɣisi, bee n-neei bɛ gom maa ni.
en: But a human lies down and doesnt rise until the heavens cease; they dont get up and awaken from sleep.

dag: yaansi bɛn daa doli bɛ nyaaŋa m-be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa bi tooi ku shɛb zaa la, ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ leei daba ka bɛ tum dabitim tuun kpɛma, ka lala ka bɛ na kul nyɛ daba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Israelites had not been able to destroy them, but Solomon forced them to work for him as slaves. They are still slaves today.

dag: Yi yi di fo yi noya, di naan leei yi baŋsim.
en: Would that you were completely quiet; that would be your wisdom.

dag: Ka ti kul ŋuhirimi ti dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ puuni, dama ti suhuri kul yɛmi ni ti zaŋ alizanda ni yili maa ye kaman binyɛrigu la m-pa ti dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili maa zuɣu;.
en: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.

dag: Bɛ tarili ni nyɛ shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili. Di bi simdi ni yi ti ba binshɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Mani n-nyɛ bɛ tarili.
en: About the land that will belong to the Levites: I am their property. You will not give the Levites any land in Israel. I am their share in Israel.

dag: n-zaŋ suɣilo gbib ba mɔɣu ni kaman yuun pihinahi;.
en: And he was patient with them for years in the desert.

dag: Yɛndana suhu bɔrila kumsi ni be yil shɛli, amaa jɛra suhuri bɔrila suhupiɛlli ni be yil shɛli.
en: A sensible person mourns, but fools always laugh.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi.
en: They all ate until they were full.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya Izraɛl kpamba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zibisim ni bebɔ? Sokam bela o binnana duu. Dama bɛ yɛlimi, Yawɛ bi nya ti, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. .
en: Then God said to me, Son of man, do you see what the elders of Israel do in the dark? Each man has a special room for his own false god. They say to themselves, The Lord cannot see us. The Lord left this country.

dag: Yi ni ti vili yi baŋtabisi, ka piri yi namda. Di ti fabiliya bee n-kum, amaa yi tuumbiɛri ni ti ʒin ya chaŋ, ka yi ti ŋuhira niŋdi taba.
en: You won't take off your turbans and your sandals. You won't cry or mourn, but all day long you will go around groaning because of your sins.

dag: Ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda ti niŋ o yiŋ dindali maa, ka bi saɣi ni o lan kul o ba yiŋa.
en: From that time on, Saul kept David in his service and would not let David go back to his own family.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul mal o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa puuni yɛla bilisir o suhu ni saha shɛli maa ka Kɔniilius tuumba maa bɔhi n-kana ti ʒe Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzab yiŋ maa dunol ni.
en: Peter wondered what this vision meant. The men Cornelius sent had found Simons house. They were standing at the door.

dag: Ka n daa galim zuɣulaannim la pam ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa bahi? Ka n daa laɣim ba na nti zaŋ ba zali bɛ zaashɛhi.
en: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, Why is the temple neglected? Then I told them to start doing their jobs.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔh o, Shihir bɔ ka a lee yɛn zaŋ wuhi ti ka di wuhi ni a mal soli ni a niŋ a ni niŋdi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: The Jewish leaders asked Jesus, What miracle will you work to show us why you have done this.

dag: Daadam shia nyɛla Yawɛ firila din vihiri baŋdi din be daadam niŋgbina puuni zaa.
en: The Lord gave us mind and conscience; we cannot hide from ourselves.

dag: Ti daa lola Ijiptinim mini Asirianim alikauli ni bɛ tiri ti bindirigu ka ti diri tiɣira.
en: To get food enough to stay alive, we went begging to Egypt and Assyria.

dag: Amaa n ni daa yuuni bɔri zaɣ viɛlli saha shɛli, zaɣ biɛɣu n-daa paai ma; ka n ni daa guhiri neesim saha shɛli, zibisim n-daa ti kana.
en: I hoped for happiness and light, but trouble and darkness came instead.

dag: bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Naaman mini Ahija ni Gɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Yuza mini Ahihud ba la.
en: Gera sent them into exile and was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

dag: dama ti bi ʒi shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni ti shiri ku tooi ʒi shɛli yi dunia ŋɔ ni gba.
en: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo, yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A nyo gbaŋ maa buɣim ka yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka a sabi yɛli gbaŋ maa puuni ni Babilɔn naa shiri ni kana ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri di ni? .
en: Then he told me to say to King Jehoiakim: Not only did you burn Jeremiah's scroll, you had the nerve to ask why he had written that the king of Babylonia would attack and ruin the land, killing all the people and even the animals.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa ŋmaligi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ti zaŋ kuɣ parilana maa niŋ n ni daa mali adaka shɛli maa puuni, ka di be di ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ma shɛm maa.
en: I came back down from the mountain. I put the stones in the Box I had made. The Lord commanded me to put them there. And the stones are still there in that Box.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi bɔb gbaai Pool, ka kum ni nintam, ka puh o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They cried and cried. They were especially sad because Paul had said they would never see him again. They hugged him and kissed him. Then they went with him to the ship to say goodbye.

dag: Ti ni yuri ya la zuɣu ka ti daa lo ni ti pirigi ti ni mali shɛli tin ya, ka di pala Naawuni lahibal suŋ la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili timaŋmaŋ nyɛviya gba, ka di nyɛla ti ni kul yuri ya pam la zuɣu.
en: Because of our love for you we were ready to share with you not only the Good News from God but even our own lives. You were so dear to us!.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a boli ma ninvuɣ suŋ? Ninvuɣ suŋ kani n-naɣ pahila Naawuni.
en: Jesus said to him, Why do you call me good? Only God is good.

dag: N niŋ yɛda ni n ni be hal ti nya Yawɛ ni yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o niriba ni shɛm.
en: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa nya yaa pam, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi, ka lan me nɛma sɔŋbu shee tinsi zali Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: As Jehoshaphat became more powerful, he built fortresses and cities.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nuhu, A min a malibu zaa kpɛm ŋariŋ maa ni, dama n nyaya ka nyini n-nyɛ wuntizɔra n sani ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord told Noah: Take your whole family with you into the boat, because you are the only one on this earth who pleases me.

dag: Ka pako so daa be tiŋ maa ni n-kul ʒe n-kan o sanna waawaayili nti yɛr o, Karimi ti saria ŋɔ ti ma nasara, ka chɛ n dim ŋɔ.
en: In that same town there was a widow who kept going to the judge and saying, Make sure that I get fair treatment in court.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla tila suŋ, amaa suhugarigu din nyɛla din kuuri kɔba.
en: Being cheerful keeps you healthy. It is slow death to be gloomy all the time.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina asibaasi, ka Ilaisha sɔŋda yina nti nya ka tɔbbihi mini yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi n-kul teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa zaa. Ka Ilaisha sɔŋda maa kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: Elishas servant got up early and went out. He saw an army with horses and chariots surrounding the city. His servant said to Elisha, Oh, no! Master, what will we do.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini ka bi garigi shɛli. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa lan bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Alibarikalan Bia la.
en: But Jesus said nothing to answer him. The high priest asked Jesus another question: Are you the Messiah, the Son of the blessed God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali pumpɔŋɔ, dama a zaŋ ma leei naa ni n su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi ka taŋkpaɣu ŋɔ.
en: O Lord God, fulfill the promise you made to my father. You have made me king over a people who are so many that they cannot be counted.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai ba, yɛtɔɣa maa ka o daa shiri zaŋ yɛli ba.
en: So the servant obeyed. He rode out to the brothers and stopped them. The servant said to them what Joseph had told him to say.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pakoli ŋun su yili maa bidibiga maa daa ti biɛra, ka di muɣis o hal ka o ti tarigi.
en: Some time later the widow's son got sick; he got worse and worse, and finally he died.

dag: Luk kɔŋko n-kul kpalim be n sani. Zaŋm Maak m-pah amaŋ zuɣu kana, dama o nyɛla ŋun tooi sɔŋdi ma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: Then the Lord told Joshua.

dag: Yi ni daa chaŋ Ijipti la, nyo bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Nail Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu? Bee yi ni daa chaŋ Asiria la, bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Yufretiiz Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu?.
en: So why take the path to Egypt to drink water from the Nile? Why travel the path to Assyria to drink water from the Euphrates?.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa wumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Hearing the law does not make people right with God. They will be right before him only if they always do what the law says.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa yɛliŋ zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka di ti mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi yil li, ka di mali daantalisi pia mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: On the west side of the courtyard there must be a wall of curtains cubits long. There must be ten posts and ten bases.

dag: Chɛ ka ŋmɛnditoya liri ba libigi ba, ka chɛ ka kunsi mɔni bɛ yinsi, dama bɛ gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ni n lu di ni, ka bari zana ni bɛ gbaai ma.
en: Let screams be heard from their homes when you suddenly bring armies against them. They have dug a pit to capture me, set traps for my feet.

dag: A wuntitali ŋmanila zoya din du pam; ka a saria karibu ŋmani teeku bulli din zilim pam. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri ninsalinim zaŋ tabili binnɛma.
en: Your righteousness is towering like the mountains; your justice is like the depths of the sea. People and animals are in your care.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni yulilaan so ŋun yuli daa booni Pubilius ka o puri do m-miri nimaani la n-daa deei ti kpɛhi o yiŋa n-niŋ ti saani dabisi muna ata.
en: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.

dag: Jarɛd ni daa dɔɣi Inok maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Enochs birth, Jared lived years; and he had other sons and daughters.

dag: ka yɛli, N tum alahichi, dama n yi ŋun ka taali nyaaŋa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka dimbɔŋɔ nya ti ya? A yɛla m-bala.
en: said, I did wrong because I betrayed an innocent man. But they said, What is that to us? Thats your problem.

dag: Saha shɛli paɣiba ni siɣiri kuliga zaawuni ka o daa chɛ ka laakumnim maa gbani tiŋ tariga kɔbiliga gbini.
en: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.

dag: Yisa ni daa naag o wunsuhigu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o min o nyaandoliba daa yimi chaŋ ti du Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ duli nti kpe tihi pu shɛli din daa do nimaani la ni.
en: When Jesus had finished praying, he and his disciples crossed the Kidron Valley and went into a garden.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti leei bukpahinima. Di ti bɔnya bɛ shee din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ya daɣiri ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.

dag: Pa Jɔn maŋmaŋa n-daa nyɛ neesim maa, amaa o daa kamina ni o ti niŋ neesim maa shɛhiralana.
en: John was not the light. But he came to tell people about the light.

dag: Man Yawɛ m-bol a wuntitali puuni. Mani n-gbaag a nuu ni ka gbib a. N zaŋ a mi lo niriba alikauli, ni a nyɛ zuliya kam neesim.
en: I, the Lord , was right to call you. I will hold your hand and protect you. You will be the sign of my agreement with the people. You will be a light for the other nations.

dag: Ka yi ni duɣ li yaɣiri duɣ shɛl ni maa, di simdi ka yi ŋma li. Ka di yi nyɛ kurigu duɣu, di simdi ka yi nan li, ka niŋ kom suui li.
en: If the sin offering was boiled in a clay pot, the pot must be broken. If the sin offering was boiled in a bronze pot, the pot must be washed and rinsed in water.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli ba, Ŋuna m-bɔŋɔ; o bela yi nuu ni, dama man naa ka yi yiko.
en: Hes in your hands, King Zedekiah said, for the king can do nothing to stop you.

dag: ni Alammɛlɛk ni Amad ni Mishal. Zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, di daa zaŋmi hal ni Kamɛl mini Shihɔrilibinat.
en: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. The western border continued to Mount Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

dag: Amaa Musa daa bi pirigi tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛna; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ bɛn tarili kaman o ni daa pun yɛli ba shɛm.
en: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.

dag: Ka yi ni diri ka nyur la, pa yimaŋmaŋ kɔre ka yi niŋdi lala kura? .
en: And when they ate and drank, it was for their own satisfaction.

dag: Ti ni mali salima mini anzinfa yɛri ti a.
en: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛshua mini Bani ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛbania ni Bunni ni Shɛrɛbia ni Bani so mi ni Kɛnani daa yiɣisi zani Lɛvinim ni daa ʒe bimbin shɛli zuɣu ka duhi bɛ yee n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.

dag: Mɛshɛk mini Tubal beni, ka di tɔbbihi gbala yɛrigi di ni zaa. Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn bi guni. Takɔbi ka bɛ zaŋ ku ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Meshech and Tubal are there, with the graves of their soldiers all around. They are all uncircumcised, all killed in battle. Yet once they terrified the living.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a ni zɔr o zuɣu n-chɛ ka o kpahir a zuɣu ni, ka kariti a saria ŋɔ?.
en: Why does God blame and punish you? Is it because you worship him?.

dag: O ni daa ti paai Galili maa, ka Galilinim maa deeg o ni suhupiɛlli bɛ nini ni daa pun nya o ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa chuɣu puhibu ni Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu, dama bɛ gba daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni.
en: When he arrived in Galilee, the people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the Passover Festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything that he had done during the festival.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi Firawuna sani labira, ka bɛ nya Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ʒiɛya guhiri ba.
en: As they were leaving, they met Moses and Aaron, who were waiting for them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na nti ti ti. Bɛ daa lan ʒi lahibali na ti yɛli, Tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ti ti maa.
en: They brought us back some fruit they found there, and reported that the land which the Lord our God was giving us was very fertile.

dag: Nuhu bidibis ata maa zuliya m-pali dunia ŋɔ zaa ŋɔ.
en: All people on earth are descendants of Noah's three sons.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni nya n ni yɛn niŋ Firawuna shɛm: N yi niŋ o firimiinsi o ni chɛ ka bɛ yi, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ o firimiinsi, ka o kari ba yih o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Now you are going to see what I will do to the king. I will force him to let my people go. In fact, I will force him to drive them out of his land.

dag: Saipurusinim ni ti kpe ŋarima kana ti liri ya. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ashurinim mini Ɛbanima. Amaa bɛ gba ni ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Invaders will sail from Cyprus; They will conquer Assyria and Eber, But they, in turn, will perish forever.
