dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din chihiri niŋ yi yinsi puuni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni woligi ya kun ya kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ saɣim li shɛm maa. Di simdi ka yi ti siŋ li ka zaɣisi li, dama di nyɛla di ni simdi ni yi saɣim binshɛli.
en: Do not bring any of these idols into your homes, or the same curse will be on you that is on them. You must hate and despise these idols, because they are under the Lord 's curse.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Ka daɣila Kɛilanim ŋɔ ni zaŋ m mini n niriba ŋɔ niŋ ŋun Sool nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ ya niŋ o nuu ni.
en: And will the citizens of Keilah hand my men and me over to Saul? David asked again. They will, the Lord answered.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zuliya kul beni sahakam; ka chɛ ka o zuliya diri nam ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm la. O daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He, like his predecessors, sinned against the Lord . He followed the wicked example of King Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.

dag: Ka Sool bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka kukoli maa yɛli, Man Yisa ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: Saul said, Who are you, Lord? The voice answered, I am Jesus, the one you are persecuting.

dag: Di saha ka o daa neei bɛ nini ni bɛ baŋ Naawuni litaafinim maa gbinni.
en: Then he opened their minds to understand the Scriptures.

dag: Di saha ka Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi daa lo tɔbu kana ti do Giliad. Ka Izraɛlnim gba daa laɣim ti do Mizipa.
en: The rulers of Ammon called their soldiers together and led them to Gilead, where they set up camp. The Israelites gathered at Mizpah and set up camp there.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim daa dii yiɣisi kuhi bahi Filistianim maa zuɣu, n-kari dol ba hal ti paai Gaat mini Ɛkurɔn dunoya ni, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛb bɛn nya dansi kul luri soli ni, zaŋ Shaaraim hal ti paai Gaat mini Ɛkurɔn.
en: But the soldiers of Israel and Judah let out a battle cry and went after them as far as Gath and Ekron. The bodies of the Philistines were scattered all along the road from Shaaraim to Gath and Ekron.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti chirigi Pɔntus tiŋbi so ŋun yuli booni Akuila min o paɣ Prisila bɛn daa yoli yi Itali na la, dama Rom Naa Klɔdius n-daa zali zaligu ni Yɛhudianim zaa yim Rom, ka bɛ mi daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima.
en: where he met Aquila, a Jewish man from Pontus. Not long before this, Aquila had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Emperor Claudius had ordered the Jewish people to leave Rome. Paul went to see Aquila and Priscilla.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti miri lubu ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli Izraɛl tɔbbihi, Sokam lab kul o ya o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When the sun set, a shout spread throughout the camp: Retreat to your towns! Retreat to your land.

dag: N niriba ni ti be suhudoo mini alaafee ni vuhim ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: God's people will be free from worries, and their homes peaceful and safe.

dag: O ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa pa omaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka di ti yɛn yina. O ni ti saɣim binyara saɣindi biɛɣu, ka ni ti di nasara o ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni. O ni ti bahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yiko mini wuntizɔriba zaa yoli.
en: He will grow strong—but not by his own power. He will cause terrible destruction and be successful in everything he does. He will bring destruction on powerful men and on God's own people.

dag: Samaria anabinim sani, n nya binshɛli din bi viɛla. Bɛ malila Baal yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka n niriba birigi.
en: I saw the prophets of Samaria doing wrong things. I saw them prophesy in the name of the false god Baal. They led the people of Israel away from me.

dag: Neesim neeri zibisim ni tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi mini bɛn niŋdi nirilim, ni nambɔzɔriba ni wuntizɔriba.
en: They shine in the dark for others who do right. They are merciful, compassionate, and righteous.

dag: Bɛ ŋme n-deei Babilɔn, dunia zaa ni daa mali shɛli nyuri bara la. Babilɔn leela din yɛla mali dabiɛm zuliya kam sani.
en: All nations now praise Babylon, but when it is captured, those same nations will be horrified.

dag: ka bi tɛhi ni napɔŋ ni tooi no ŋ-ŋma li, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba ni tooi no li.
en: She is unaware that a foot may crush them or a wild animal break them.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banima, di yihiri ya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka di ti chɛ ka bɛ suhuri miligi, amaa zaŋmiyala saɣisigu din nyɛ ti Duuma dini wumsiri ba.
en: Fathers, dont make your children angry, but raise them with the kind of teaching and training you learn from the Lord.

dag: Ka Yisa nimmiriba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o yi Galili na daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: The people who were close friends of Jesus were there. Also, there were some women who had followed Jesus from Galilee. They all stood far away from the cross and watched these things.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛl o, Labim a lan maa sani nti zaŋ amaŋ ti o.
en: The angel of the Lord said to her, Sarai is your owner. Go home to her and obey her.

dag: Miri ka a di jɛrigu alizama, o ni lihi ʒiɛm a yɛm yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Dont speak in the ears of fools, for they will scorn your insightful words.

dag: Ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu yi chɛ ka a kpee suhu miligi, dindina a bi doli yurilim soli. Di chɛ ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka Yisa Masia ni kpi a kpe so zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: If you hurt the faith of your brother or sister because of something you eat, you are not really following the way of love. Dont destroy anyones faith by eating something they think is wrong. Christ died for them.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Biɛɣuni. Ka Musa daa yɛli, Di ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka yi baŋ ni Naawuni so lan kani ŋ-ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Pharaoh said, Tomorrow! Moses said, Just as you say! That way you will know that there is no one like the LORD our God.

dag: Dama bɛ dɔɣi bia ti ti, bɛ ti ti bidibiga; o nyɛla ŋun su fukumsi; ka o yuli ni ti booni, Alahiziba mini Saɣisira ni Kpiɔŋlan Naawuni ni Saha din ka bahigu Ba ni Suhudoo Nabia.
en: This will happen when the special child is born. God will give us a son who will be responsible for leading the people. His name will be Wonderful Counselor, Powerful God, Father Who Lives Forever, Prince of Peace.

dag: Amaa n di yuya ni Naawuni yaag o noli n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: How I wish God would answer you!.

dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ashidɔd nayiya mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nayiya, Laɣimmiya Samaria zoya zuɣu nti nya taawaaye niŋbu mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din tumdi nimaani.
en: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka chɛchɛbuŋ maa zani; ka o mini Filip zaa yi n-chaŋ ti siɣi kom maa ni, ka Filip baptaiz o.
en: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.

dag: Nimaani ka o kabisi piɛma din nyɛlisiri mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni takɔbiri ni tɔbutuhiri bidibbina.
en: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.

dag: ti yɛli ma, Pool, di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a. A ni bahi paai Naa Siiza tooni. Nyama, Naawuni ni tilig a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɛ ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni nyɛviya a zuɣu.
en: to tell me, Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.

dag: Ka yi lan niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim pahira. Yi kuhira, ka fabinda, ka yi nintam tɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini, o ni bi lan lihi nya yi sara bee n-deeri li yi nuu ni ni yurilim la zuɣu.
en: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord 's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.

dag: Ka chua ni mali ninvuɣ so daa ʒi Yisa tooni.
en: A man with a bad disease was there in front of him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi tiligira. N ni zaɣisi Ijipti mini Itiɔpia ni Siiba, ka tiligi ya.
en: I am the LORD your God, the holy one of Israel, your savior. I have given Egypt as your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoash died and was buried with his ancestors. He was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. Jehoashs son Jeroboam became the new king after him.

dag: Ka neesim maa kul neeri zibisim ni, ka zibisim maa bi tooi nyaŋ li.
en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness doesnt extinguish the light.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali buɣim sɔŋ dundɔŋ sunsuuni ʒiya wuɣisira, ka Pita daa chaŋ ti ʒini pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: When they lit a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together, Peter sat among them.

dag: ka zaŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa leeg a salima min a daanzinfa din viɛli pam.
en: The Almighty will be your prized possession, silver piled up for you.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pɔr la n daa yuri ba. N daa boli ba yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na kaman m bidibisi la.
en: The Lord says, When Israel was a child, I loved him and called him out of Egypt as my son.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ni dɔɣi ninsala, jɛrigu ni niŋ yɛm.
en: Stupid people will start being wise when wild donkeys are born tame.

dag: Bɛ daa bela nimaani kaman yuun pia, ka Malɔn mini Kiliɔn gba daa ti kpi ka chɛ Naomi ka o kpalim o kɔŋko ka lan ka yidana bee bihi.
en: But both of the sons, Mahlon and Chilion, also died. Only the woman was left, without her two children and without her husband.

dag: Bɛ sahirila bɛ zilima ka di be kaman takɔbiri la, ka mal li yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri din ŋmani piɛma.
en: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.

dag: Ka o bapir daa ti bɔh o min o tumtumda maa, Ya ka yi lee chaŋ? Ka Sool garigi yɛl o, Ti daa chaŋla bunsi la bɔbu; ka daa ti bo ba je ka chaŋ Samuɛl sani.
en: Later, Saul's uncle asked him, Where have you been? Saul answered, Looking for the donkeys. We couldn't find them, so we went to talk with Samuel.

dag: yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: He said, I will certainly bless you and multiply your descendants. .

dag: A niŋ bindirigu zali n tooni n dimnim ninni. A niŋ kpam ʒe n zuɣu. A chɛ ka m pipia pali hal ti puuri bahira.
en: You prepare a banquet for me, where all my enemies can see me; you welcome me as an honored guest and fill my cup to the brim.

dag: Ka Musa yɛl o, A yi ku doli ti chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka ti yiɣisi kpe.
en: Then Moses said to him, If you dont go with us, then dont make us leave this place.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka sagbana yiri dunia tariga na. Ŋuna n-nam saa nyaɣisibu niŋ saa ni, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zal li luɣ shɛŋa na.
en: God forms clouds at the far corners of the earth. God makes lightning for the rain. God releases the wind from its storeroom.

dag: dindina n naan zaɣisi Yaakubu mini n dabili Dauda zuliya, ka ku piig o bihi ni yino ka o su Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu zuliya. Dama n ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka labisi bɛ daazichi ti ba.
en: than I would reject the descendants of Jacob and my servant David and his descendants as rulers for the children of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will restore the captives and have compassion on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ gbahi n niriba chaŋ ka bɛ bi baŋ. Kum ni ku yi zuɣulaannima, ka kɔnyuri ku yi tarimba mi.
en: My people dont really know God. So they will be captured and taken away. Everyone, the respected leaders and the common people as well, will be hungry and thirsty.

dag: Ti Naa maa nam dibu chuɣu puhibu dabisili yi ti paai, o min o kpambaliba nyurila wain hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala, ka laɣim maani niriba ansarisi.
en: On Our Kings Day, the leaders get so drunk that they get sick. They become crazy with wine and make agreements with people who laugh at God.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ polo, ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o mini Ijiptinim zaa.
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce the king of Egypt. Tell him how he and all the land of Egypt will be punished.

dag: Dunoli kam daa malila yoobu buyi, ka yoobu kam mali chɛulo diba ayi.
en: Each of the doors was made from two smaller doors. Each door was really two swinging doors.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hashub bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Azirikam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Hashabia mini Bunni.
en: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti zani Gibia ni bɛ liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa.
en: Then the army of Israel took their positions for battle against the army of Benjamin at the city of Gibeah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ti ni daa wum Naawuni Bia maa sani ka yɛri ya di yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Naawuni nyɛla neesim, ka zibisim ka o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: This is the message that we have heard from him and announce to you: God is light and there is no darkness in him at all.

dag: Keenan bihi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan's sons—Sidon, the oldest, and Heth—were the ancestors of the peoples who bear their names.

dag: Pɛriʒia nabia n-daa taɣ ma zali sol ni biɛɣ pisiniyini. Amaa ka Maikil ŋun nyɛ malaikanim nabia la daa kana ti sɔŋ ma, ka n daa chɛ o mini Pɛriʒia nabia maa nimaani.
en: But the guardian angel of Persia opposed me for days. Then Michael, who is one of the strongest guardian angels, came to rescue me from the kings of Persia.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya ti nya o ni be luɣ shɛli ka n tim ka bɛ ti gbaag o na. Ka bɛ daa ti yɛl o, O be Dɔtan.
en: Find out where he is, the king ordered, and I will capture him. When he was told that Elisha was in Dothan.

dag: Zoya daa nya a ka sɔhigi. Kopaliga daa ŋme n-gari, ka teeku bulli duhi di kukoli. Wuntaŋ duhi di nuhi zuɣusaa.
en: The mountains saw you and shook. The water flowed off the land. The water from the sea made a loud noise as it lost its power over the land.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam n-su Izraɛlnim maa, o daa dila nam maa yuma ayi. Amaa Judanim bɛn daa dolila Dauda.
en: He was forty years old when he was made king of Israel, and he ruled for two years. But the tribe of Judah was loyal to David.

dag: N ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, n daa dari tɔhila m binyɛra, ka dari sibi n zabiri mini n teeŋa ka teei ʒini tiŋa, ka kɔŋ suhukpeeni.
en: When I heard this, I tore my clothes in despair, tore my hair and my beard, and sat down crushed with grief.

dag: Kɔbil nin yini ni tooi bilisi ko nyaɣisili mini ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ?.
en: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?.

dag: Jɛhɔram ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jehoram did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa yɛli naa maa, Mal a pina maa bee zaŋmi li ti so. Amaa n ni karim sabbu maa, ka wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: Then Daniel answered the king, King Belshazzar, you can keep your gifts for yourself, or you can give them to someone else. But I will still read the writing on the wall for you and explain what it means.

dag: A ni mali sida dari pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a nyɛ naa maa? A ba daa pala ŋun diri ka nyura, ka niŋdi din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli? Dinzuɣu ka shɛlikam daa niŋ viɛnyɛla o sani.
en: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: So Israels king and Judahs King Jehoshaphat attacked Ramoth-gilead.

dag: Amaa n lihiya nya ka so kani. So ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira, ka n ni bɔh o bɔhigu ka o garigi.
en: But I look, and theres no one among them, no counselor; and when I ask, no one can answer.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya ni zuliya yɛla saria ka mali niriba pam yɛla ti ba. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri kuri naɣikɔra kubiɛlima, ka zaŋ bɛ kpana kuri gɔriti. Ka zuliya ni zuliya ti ku lan zaŋ takɔbiri tuhi taba bee m-bɔhim tɔb tuhibu yaha.
en: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi sandiriba maa ni ti yiɣisi libigi ya, ka bɛn ni chɛ ka yi ni sɔhigi yiɣisi? Di saha ka yi leei bɛ ni yɛn ʒe ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: But before you know it, you that have conquered others will be in debt yourselves and be forced to pay interest. Enemies will come and make you tremble. They will plunder you!.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya o biɛyanim maa, o daa baŋ ba, amaa ka niŋ ba kaman saamba n-nyɛ ba la, ka daa bi tɔɣisi ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa. O daa bɔhi ba mi, Ya ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti yila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni ti ti da bindirigu.
en: When Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he acted like he didnt know them. He spoke to them with a harsh tone and said, Where have you come from? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ guhirimi ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu. O bɔri ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul niŋdi din tuhi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani mal alibarika.
en: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.

dag: ni di pindigu din daa nyɛ bɛ ni nani piɛlahi gban shɛŋa n-niŋ moonsi mɔhi li la mini di pindigu shɛli din nyɛ teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana la ni pateesa la.
en: They showed him the covering of the Tent that was made from ram skins dyed red and the covering that was made from fine leather. And they showed him the curtain that covered the entrance to the Most Holy Place.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya wain pali wain duɣu kam. Bɛ ni bɔh a, A tɛhiya ni ti bi mi ni di simdi ni ti niŋ wain pali wain duɣu kam.
en: Jeremiah, say to the people of Judah: This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine. They will laugh and say to you, Of course, we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine.

dag: ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nini nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka o nya binshɛli ka di kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la, ka di sirigiri o sanna hal ti paai tiŋa.
en: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus heard them say this. So he said to them, It is the sick people who need a doctor, not those who are healthy.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni daa tum shɛlikam Yɛhudianim tinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm maa zaa shɛhiranima. Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ o kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o;.
en: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mi daa bo alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tusaayi mini kpa viɛlli lita tuhi kɔbisinahi n-ti Hiram min o yiŋnima. Lala ka Sulemaana daa kul niŋdi tiri Hiram yuuni kam.
en: In return, Solomon gave an annual gift to Hiram of twenty thousand kors of wheat to eat, and twenty thousand kors of pure oil for his palace use.

dag: Ka o daa paɣi bimbiɛhi mini namanama n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: He also washed the inner parts and the legs of the burnt offering and burned them on the altar.

dag: Ka Aizaia daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ baɣisi fiig tia wala ta bintɔrigu maa ka a nya alaafee.
en: Then Isaiah said, Prepare a salve made from figs, put it on the swelling, and hell get better.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Abraham died at the ripe old age of .

dag: Ti ni nyɛ bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumdi zuɣu, ti suhiri ya ni yi di deeya Naawuni daalibarika la yoli.
en: Since we work together with him, we are also begging you not to receive the grace of God in vain.

dag: M bia, di kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, ka di chɛ ka a wum wuhibu.
en: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilahi maa zuɣuri ni, ka yi zaŋ zaɣ yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ Lɛvinim maa daalahichi zuɣu.
en: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.

dag: Bɛ yihi ba neesim ni m-bahi zibisim ni, ka kari ba yihi dunia yili.
en: They are thrust from light into darkness, banished from the world.

dag: Piim Lɛvinim Izraɛlnim puuni m-mali ba kasi.
en: Separate the Levites from the other Israelites. Make these Levites clean.

dag: Amaa ti paɣiri Naawuni yinim bɛn daa nyɛ alahichi daba la ni doli wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa deei ni yi suhuri zaa la zuɣu.
en: But thanks be to God! For though at one time you were slaves to sin, you have obeyed with all your heart the truths found in the teaching you received.

dag: Amaa bɛ ti ku lan labi bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ labi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni na ŋɔ.
en: You will long to see this country again, but you will never return.

dag: Ti nyari duhibu, ka lan nyari filiŋ; ti nyari ʒiɛmbu, ka lan nyari tibiginsim. Bɛ niŋdi ti mi kaman ʒirinima, amaa ka ti lee nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinima.
en: We are honored and disgraced; we are insulted and praised. We are treated as liars, yet we speak the truth;.

dag: M bihi, di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi n-nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Masia ni nyɛ wuntizɔra shɛm.
en: Dear children, dont let anyone lead you into the wrong way. Christ always did what was right. So to be good like Christ, you must do what is right.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yidan yipa ni zaŋ omaŋ tabili ma, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ata ti o; dinzuɣu ka o daa bol o yuli Lɛvi.
en: Once again she became pregnant and gave birth to another son. She said, Now my husband will be bound more tightly to me, because I have borne him three sons; so she named him Levi.

dag: Bɛ kari ba niriba ni bahi; niriba yɔhiri ba mi kaman tayiɣ la.
en: Everyone drove them away with shouts, as if they were shouting at thieves.

dag: Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni daba mini bilichinnima ni dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bi be kɔŋkɔba; yi zaa nyɛla zaɣ yini Yisa Masia ni.
en: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhi ba soli birigi ba, ka bɛ ni birigi ninvuɣ shɛb maa birim.
en: Those who lead these people have misled them and totally confused them.

dag: Yɛl biɛri din ka kalinli n-kul gili ma, di galisiya pam. N daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi n zuɣu, ka n ku lan tooi lihi nya binshɛli; di galisi gari n zabiri; ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa deei da shɛŋa o ni daa bo ni o ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ʒil o bia Yisahaku; ka omaŋmaŋ mi kpuɣi buɣim mini sua n-gbib o nuu ni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli tab chana.
en: Abraham took the wood for the entirely burned offering and laid it on his son Isaac. He took the fire and the knife in his hand, and the two of them walked on together.

dag: ka zaɣisi n saɣisigunima, ka lihi ʒiɛm n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: They ignored my advice and refused to be corrected.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa dɔni n-shiri niŋ kaman o biɛrimi la. Ka naa daa ti kana ni o ti kaag o, ka Amnɔn yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka Tama kana ti mali maha ti ma n ninni, ka zaŋ li na ti gbib o nuu ni ka n ŋubi.
en: So Amnon went to bed and pretended to be sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said, Please, ask Tamar to come over. She can make some special bread while I watch, and then she can serve it to me.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri woligibu na, ka nyɛ bɛn maŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu yubu su ba, ka Naawuni Shia ka bɛ ni.
en: These people create divisions. Since they dont have the Spirit, they are worldly.

dag: ni n Naawuni. N suhu kul saɣindimi. Dinzuɣu ka n teer a yɛla Jɔɔdɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Mizar Zoli zuɣu.
en: Here in exile my heart is breaking, and so I turn my thoughts to him. He has sent waves of sorrow over my soul; chaos roars at me like a flood, like waterfalls thundering down to the Jordan from Mount Hermon and Mount Mizar.

dag: dindina yin ŋmaam paɣa maa nuu, di zɔny o nambɔɣu.
en: you must cut off her hand. Show no mercy.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Wula ka n yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Dama di chɛ biɛla ka bɛ lab ma kuɣa.
en: Then Moses prayed to the Lord , What am I going to do with these people? They are about to stone me to death.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnima bɛ mabihi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zuɣu, ka bɛ yɛli, Daŋ yini niriba ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The people of Israel felt sorry for their brothers the Benjaminites and said, Today Israel has lost one of its tribes.

dag: ka din pahi pinaayi daa gbaai Hashabia min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Twelfth, there were men chosen from Hashabiahs sons and relatives.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbihi, ka maligumaaniba maa daa taɣi bɛ ʒim n-zaŋ li mihi sara maligu bimbini maa, ka Lɛvinim mi shiri biŋkɔbiri maa.
en: Then the Levites killed and skinned the Passover lambs, and they handed some of the blood to the priests, who splattered it on the altar.

dag: Maligumaana yi zaŋ kawana bee chi na ti mali sara, di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim, di bi simdi ni bɛ di li.
en: No part of a grain offering that a priest makes may be eaten; all of it must be burned.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli din tuhi, ka niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: Bring righteous offerings, and trust the LORD!.

dag: Yawɛ n-su zuɣusaa ha, amaa ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ ti ninsalinima.
en: The highest heaven belongs to the LORD, but he gave the earth to all people.

dag: Naa Dauda maa zuliya ni ka Naawuni daa ti Izraɛlnim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ Yisa kaman o ni daa pun lo alikauli shɛm la.
en: From this mans descendants, God brought to Israel a savior, Jesus, just as he promised.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N nya niriba maa ka bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: I know how stubborn these people are.

dag: Lɛvinim ni gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-zani gili naa, ka ŋunkam kpe nayili maa na, bɛn kum o. Kul benya naa sani, o yi ti yɛn yina, yin benya o sani, ka o yi ti labiri kpɛra yin benya o sani.
en: The Levites are to stand guard around the king, with their swords drawn, and are to stay with the king wherever he goes. Anyone who tries to enter the Temple is to be killed.

dag: Areebianim mini Kɛdar nabihi zaa daa nyɛla a daabi yurisi bɛn niŋdi piɛnyama mini piɛlahi ni buhi daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: while people from Arabia and the rulers of Kedar traded lambs, sheep, and goats.

dag: Yɛnnim ni nya jilima, amaa tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ni di vi.
en: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.

dag: N gbibila n wuntitali kirikiri ka ku wɔɣisi li; n suhu bi wuhi ni m mali galimi m biɛhigu ni dahin shɛli.
en: I will insist on my innocence, never surrendering it; my conscience will never blame me for what I have done.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ nanim maa zaa, ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔna maa yim, dama ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa tuhi ti bɛn Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Joshua captured all these kings and their land all at the same time. This was because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni ti puh a ka ti a bɔrɔbɔro kpil ayi, ka a deei li bɛ nuu ni.
en: After they greet you, they'll give you two loaves of bread.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu mini m balima ŋɔ; a yuli zuɣu ŋmaligim a nini lihi nya a jɛmbu duu la ni wurim doya shɛm.
en: O God, hear my prayer and pleading. Restore your Temple, which has been destroyed; restore it so that everyone will know that you are God.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl yɛl o, Karimba, a nyɛla Naawuni Bia! A nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa.
en: Then Nathanael said, Teacher, you are the Son of God. You are the King of Israel.

dag: Balak ni daa wum ni Balaam kanna, o daa yimi chaŋ ti tuh o soli Ar fɔntiŋ shɛli din ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Mɔab tintariga polo la.
en: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went to meet him at Ar, a city on the Arnon River at the border of Moab.

dag: Bɛ ni bi tum ʒiɛyimtali tuma maa zuɣu n ni chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They have been unfaithful to me, and so I will make the country a wilderness. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Yi daa nya n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la mini n ni daa zaŋ ya tam tɔra kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ sanna la.
en: You saw what I did in Egypt, and you know how I brought you here to me, just as a mighty eagle carries its young.

dag: Naawuni, a yuli nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana. Chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Rise above the heavens, God. Let all the world see your glory.

dag: ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya, ka yi paɣiba kpalim pakoya, ka yi bihi gba leei kpibisi.
en: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul bɔrila duŋtaabo, amaa bɛ ni tim tumo ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana ka o lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Those who are evil only want to cause trouble. In the end, punishment without mercy will be sent to them.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ n ni be shɛm.
en: Tychicus, our dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord's work, will give you all the news about me, so that you may know how I am getting along.

dag: Dama sɔtim ku tooi gbaai Yaakubu zuliya, ka so mi ku tooi wa Izraɛlnim bukpahigu. Niriba ni ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu mini Izraɛlnim yɛla ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni ni tum shɛm.
en: No magic charms can work against them— just look what God has done for his people.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tin shɛŋa din nyɛ sɔɣisili shee tinsi la ti Aduna bidibisi. Dina n-daa nyɛ: Hiburɔn mini Libina zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana ni Jatir ni Ɛshitɛmɔa zaŋ tabili di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: The descendants of Aaron were given the city of Hebron. Hebron was a city of safety. They were also given the cities of Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ di zaa niŋ piɛ yin ni n-zaŋ di mini naɣilaa maa mini piɛlah ayi maa na.
en: Put this bread and the cakes in a basket. Then give the basket to Aaron and his sons. At the same time, give them the bull and the two rams.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu pali bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na.
en: A good person brings good things out of a treasure of good things; a bad person brings bad things out of a treasure of bad things.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Ayuba yɛla ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, ka ŋun Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la, N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a min a zɔnim ayi maa zuɣu, dama yi bi tɔɣisi n yɛla ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli kaman n dabili Ayuba ni tɔɣisi li shɛm.
en: After the Lord had finished speaking to Job, he said to Eliphaz, I am angry with you and your two friends, because you did not speak the truth about me, the way my servant Job did.

dag: Yi yi ti kuli yiŋ na, noli ni din ya, ka yi yi ti yi samban ni, noli ni din ya.
en: You will be cursed when you are out and about and cursed when you come back.

dag: N zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuma zaa yɛla, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuun kara yɛla.
en: I think about those things. I think about them all the time.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ yɛri din viɛli, ka nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara la m-mali binnana din chihira ka nyɛ n ni je binshɛŋa la. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka di leei binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bɛ sani.
en: From their beautiful ornament, in which they took pride, they have made horrible and detestable images! Therefore, Ive declared it an unclean thing for them.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam zaa tumdi din tuhi chanila neesim ni ni sokam ti nya o tuma ka baŋ ni o zɔri Naawuni.
en: But those who do what is true come to the light in order that the light may show that what they did was in obedience to God.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ o bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la n-leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: The people of Judah then crowned his sixteen-year-old son Uzziah as king.

dag: Ka Hiram tumtumdiba mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba bɛn daa yi chani Ofiri ti ʒiri salima na la daa lan ʒiri aligum dari mini kuɣ viɛla na ti pahi.
en: In addition, Hurams servants and the servants of Solomon, who had brought gold back from Ophir, also brought algum wood and precious stones.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ. M Ba ni mi ma ka n gba mi m Ba shɛm, lala ka m mi m piɛri ka m piɛri maa gba mi ma; ka n zaŋdi n nyɛvili taɣiri m piɛri maa dini.
en: I am the good shepherd. As the Father knows me and I know the Father, in the same way I know my sheep and they know me. And I am willing to die for them.

dag: Chɛ ka a binyɛra kul piɛli sahakam, ka niŋmi kpam ʒiɛm a zuɣu.
en: Always look happy and cheerful.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, Amaa n ni daa ti be soli chana nti miriti Damaskus kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka neesim titali daa ti dii yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili ma.
en: One day about noon I was getting close to Damascus, when a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around me.

dag: Izraɛlnima, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ni Yawɛ ʒi yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli bee bɛ yi ŋari ya, yi Naawuni baɣa kani?.
en: Why do you say, Jacob, and declare, Israel, My way is hidden from the LORD, my God ignores my predicament?.

dag: Nyin gba mir o, dama o daa chihi ti yɛligu pam.
en: He fought against everything we teach. You should be careful that he doesnt hurt you too.

dag: Di zaŋya yimaŋ bali bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba ni, dama wula ka wuntia mini din pa wuntia ni tooi laɣim be bee zɔtali bɔ m-be neesim mini zibisim sunsuuni?.
en: Do not try to work together as equals with unbelievers, for it cannot be done. How can right and wrong be partners? How can light and darkness live together?.

dag: Dabiɛm gbahi tinzunnima, ka bɛ yiri bɛ ni me birini gili bɛ tiŋ shɛŋa ni n-kani n sanna, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: Foreigners lose their nerve; they come trembling out of their fortresses.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni booni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la puuni, kpaŋsimiya tab dabisili kam ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku niŋ tipawumlilana alahichi yɔhiŋgu zuɣu;.
en: But encourage each other every day, while you still have something called today. Help each other so that none of you will be fooled by sin and become too hard to change.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Dinzuɣu deemiya liɣiri maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ tuhi pia ŋɔ;.
en: Then the master said, Now your money will be taken away and given to the servant with , coins!.

dag: Yi mi di deeya biŋkɔbigu tinzun nir sani n-zaŋ o mali sara shɛli din nyɛ yi Naawuni bindirigu sara la. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali dansi; bɛ ni mali ba tumdi din bi tu kamaata zuɣu, n ku deei ba yi sani.
en: Do not offer as a food offering any animal obtained from a foreigner. Such animals are considered defective and are not acceptable.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli ye situra ʒiya; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: and when they came to Jesus, they saw the man who used to have the mob of demons in him. He was sitting there, clothed and in his right mind; and they were all afraid.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla wuntialana ka a saria karibu nyɛ din tuhi.
en: Our Lord , you always do right, and your decisions are fair.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo tɔb na ti liri Judanima, ka kpe nayili ti ʒe bɛ ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa nayili maa ka gbah o paɣiba min o bidibisi zaa chaŋ. Bɛ daa gbah o bidibisi zaa ka ti naɣ chɛla o kaluɣi ŋun yuli daa booni Ahazia la kɔŋko.
en: They invaded Judah, looted the royal palace, and carried off as prisoners all the king's wives and sons except Ahaziah, his youngest son.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa be kozɔrim maa zuɣusaa polo la, Saha yuusim wula puuni ka alahiziba yɛla ŋɔ tariga yɛn paai.
en: One said to the man clothed in white linen, who was farther upstream: When will these astonishing things be over.

dag: Zuliya ayi ni pirigili maa daa pun deei bɛ tarili ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo.
en: The two and a half tribes have taken their inheritance across the Jordan at Jericho toward the east.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tuɣili tulaale zim din bi be kasi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu. Yi mi di zaŋya biŋkɔbigu nyo buɣim bee n-zaŋ bindir kuma mali sara di zuɣu bee m-booi wain bahi di zuɣu.
en: Dont use this altar for offering any other kind of incense or burnt offering or for any kind of grain offering or drink offering.

dag: Ka hal n yi kari so saria gba, n saria karibu maa nyɛla din tuhi, dama pa n kɔŋko n-kariti saria maa, amaa m mini ŋun tim ma na maa n-kariti li.
en: But if I judge, my judging is true, because when I judge I am not alone. The Father who sent me is with me.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni ŋmala sida tia bee ka o piila oki bee siɣirili n-zaŋ li sa nyɔŋ puuni, ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ kpiɔŋ.
en: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.

dag: Di benya kaman wɔhu bee buŋa bɛn be zilinsi ni la, bɛ ni zaŋdi galige n-lɛri shɛb pɔi ka bɛ naanyi tumdi bɛ laamba yubu la.
en: Don't be stupid like a horse or a mule, which must be controlled with a bit and bridle to make it submit.

dag: Zaŋm neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni zaŋ ti a ni a zaŋ ti Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni, ka bɛ mal li tumdi yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma la ti.
en: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.

dag: Ka a yi nya li, a gba ni chaŋ ti pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a biɛli Aduna ni pahi bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: After you have seen it, you will die, as your brother Aaron did.

dag: Ka bia maa ba daa kuhi ni nintam yɛli, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda; ka n yɛda niŋbu ni pooi shɛli ni, nyin sɔŋm ma di puuni.
en: At once the boy's father shouted, I do have faith! Please help me to have even more.

dag: Ka wuhiri shihir kara pam, hal ka chɛ ka buɣim yiri zuɣusaa lurina niriba ninni;.
en: This second beast performed great miracles; it made fire come down out of heaven to earth in the sight of everyone.

dag: Doo maa min o paɣ maa daa bela bɛ zaɣim, amaa ka di bi mali ba vi.
en: Although the man and his wife were both naked, they were not ashamed.

dag: dama Naawuni chɛ ka sokam kpe bɛmaŋmaŋ nɔzaɣisibo ni m-be kaman dansarikanima n-nyɛ ba la ni di chɛ ka o zo sokam nambɔɣu.
en: God has locked up all people in disobedience, in order to have mercy on all of them.

dag: Amaa ka a bi so ŋun zaŋ a buni chaŋ ti nahi pagɔra ŋɔ lee ti kuna, ka a gbaari naɣila kpabili kɔrigir o zuɣu.
en: But then this son of yours comes home after wasting your money on prostitutes, and you kill the best calf for him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kuhi boli Dan zuliya niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligina bɔhi Maika, Bɔ n-chɛ ka a zaŋ salo ŋɔ tatabo pa amaŋ zuɣu na.
en: The men with Micah were shouting at the men of Dan. The men of Dan turned around and said to Micah, Whats the problem? Why are you shouting.

dag: Di pala timaŋmaŋ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri ya, amaa Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri maa, ka wuhiri ya ni timaŋmaŋ mi nyɛla yi daba ŋun Yisa zuɣu.
en: We dont preach about ourselves. Instead, we preach about Jesus Christ as Lord, and we describe ourselves as your slaves for Jesus sake.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gari yi zaa la zuɣu.
en: I thank God that I speak in strange tongues much more than any of you.

dag: Yinim bɛn yɔhindi niriba ŋɔ, wula ka Naawuni lee yɛn niŋ ya? O ku darigi yi tibili?.
en: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?.

dag: Nini ku tooi yɛli nuu, A ka ma buchi; ka zuɣu mi ku tooi yɛli napɔŋ, A ka ma buchi.
en: So then, the eye cannot say to the hand, I don't need you! Nor can the head say to the feet, Well, I don't need you.

dag: A nɛma daa yi kul yi teeku ni na, niriba pam nyari li mi. A daa zaŋ a daazichi min a daguya sɔŋ dunia ŋɔ nanima ka bɛ nya azichi.
en: When your wares came out from the seas, you satisfied many people. Your abundant wealth and merchandise enriched the kings of the earth.

dag: Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: When it comes back, it finds that home all neat and clean.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Dimbɔŋɔ din nyɛla Naawuni yiko tuma. Amaa ka Firawuna daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: and the magicians said to the king, God has done this! But the king was stubborn and, just as the Lord had said, the king would not listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula niŋ binshɛli? Ka nir na mi n-zaŋ tuŋ wula kpahi kpa n-zaŋ binyɛra yili li?.
en: Can you make anything useful from its wood? Can you make a peg from it and hang objects on it?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Damaskus din nyɛ Sirianim tiŋ la ni. Ka Sirianim maa daa leei Dauda daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani. Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.

dag: Nandan gbansɔɣu ni tooi niŋ bindirigu pam, amaa ka bɛn doli soli din bi tuhi fa li.
en: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi mini niriba lala tatabo be.
en: So dont have anything to do with them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa tuui wuhi shihir shɛli ka di wuhi o yiko ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o nyaandoliba daa niŋ o yɛda. Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la ka o daa wuhi shihirili maa.
en: Jesus performed this first miracle in Cana in Galilee; there he revealed his glory, and his disciples believed in him.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa chaŋ ti neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti; tiligim ti.
en: The followers went to him and woke him. They said, Lord, save us! We will drown.

dag: Bɛ daa bi baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba yɛla ka o tɔɣisiri ba maa.
en: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.

dag: N tɔɣisirila n nini ni nya shɛli m Ba sani; ka yi mi niŋdi yi nini ni nya shɛli yi ba sani.
en: I talk about what my Father has shown me, but you do what your father has told you.

dag: binnɛɔŋ kam naan laɣim kpi, ka daadam di labi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: we humans would die and return to the soil.

dag: Amaa n daa zo ba nambɔɣu, ka daa bi ku ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bee n-kpihim bɛ birili.
en: But then I took pity on them. I decided not to kill them there in the desert.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ Ziɔn, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: The Lord should be praised from Zion, from Jerusalem, his home. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka n yi tumdi n ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: But if I do the very thing that I dont want to do, then Im not the one doing it anymore. Instead, it is sin that lives in me that is doing it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Sukɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam tiŋgban nɛl naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: Jeroboam did what the Lord said was wrong. He did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat who caused Israel to sin.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tum tuun shɛli dindali, dama di nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi bahi yi tuuli yurilim la.
en: But this is what I have against you: you do not love me now as you did at first.

dag: Pɛrɛz zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hɛzirɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Hɛzirɔnnima; ka Hamul daŋ niriba nyɛ Hamulnima.
en: These are the family groups from Perez: Hezron—the Hezronite family group; Hamul—the Hamulite family group.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛli, Nyamiya o ni yuri Lazarɔs shɛm.
en: The Jews said, See how much he loved him.

dag: Ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga daa yi salo maa ni na nti wa waa, ka di niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd mini bɛn daa ʒi o sani maa zaa nyaɣisim pam. Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa, Yɛlim ma a suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam zaa, ka n ti a li.
en: Herods daughter Herodias came in and danced, thrilling Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the young woman, Ask me whatever you wish, and I will give it to you.

dag: Yi yi saɣi li, ka deei n noli, yi ni di tiŋgbani ŋɔ bin suma anfaani.
en: If you agree and obey, you will eat the best food of the land.

dag: M mɛla yili shɛli din mali jilima ti o, ka di nyɛ luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: Now I've built a glorious temple where you can live forever.

dag: Yi ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka di niŋ ya suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti ʒi teeku ni azichi na ti tin ya, ka ʒi zuliya shɛb gba daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: You will see this and be filled with joy; You will tremble with excitement. The wealth of the nations will be brought to you; From across the sea their riches will come.

dag: So yi tum o kpee taali, ka kana ni o ti po pɔri duu ŋɔ ni sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ gbini.
en: If someone wrongs another and must take a solemn pledge asserting his innocence before your altar in this temple.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Nyama, luɣ shɛli be n sani kpe ka a ni tam tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord said, Here is a place for you to stand by me on this large rock.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ tiŋgban ni taŋkpaɣu n-nam ninsala, ka vuhi nyɛvili vuhim niŋ o nyee ni; ka ninsal leei ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: the LORD God formed the human from the topsoil of the fertile land and blew lifes breath into his nostrils. The human came to life.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye Yawɛ zuɣu ka bɛ guh o ni nya ya palli. Bɛ ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔrili kpiŋkpama la. Bɛ ni guui ka di ku gbarigi ba. Bɛ ni chaŋ ka di ku wum ba.
en: But those who trust in the Lord will become strong again. They will be like eagles that grow new feathers. They will run and not get weak. They will walk and not get tired.

dag: Di saha n ni tooi nya garigibu din ni garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi la, dama n niŋ a yɛligu naani.
en: Then I can answer those who insult me because I trust in your word.

dag: O yi bi niŋ bini ata ŋɔ ti o, dindina paɣ maa ŋun yim chaŋ yoli, ka di yo shɛli.
en: If he fails to do any of these things, she must be given her freedom without paying for it.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa kpuɣ o zuɣu ŋmaligi lihi n-nya piɛlaa ka o ʒiɛya, ka o yila shɛbi tiwula ni. Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ ti gbaai piɛlaa maa na nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka chɛ o bia maa.
en: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.

dag: O vooi ma yihi barina bɔɣ zilinli ni na, ka firigi ma baɣiri ni. O zaŋ ma tam tampiŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: He lifted me out of the pit of death, out of the mud and filth, and set my feet on solid rock. He steadied my legs.

dag: Mani n-daa tiɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa pua bee mani n-daa dɔɣi ba, ka a ni yɛli ma, Kpuɣim ba buɣi kaman biyol ni buɣiri bimɔɣiriga shɛm la tahi a ni daa lo alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give birth to them, that you would say to me, Carry them at the breast, as a nurse carries an unweaned child, to the fertile land that you promised their ancestors?.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli; Aai, di simdi ni n da li kaman di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, dama n ku zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli n-nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ. Ka Dauda daa da kabɔɣili maa mini naɣikɔra maa anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu.
en: No, the king said to Araunah. I will buy them from you at a fair price. I wont offer up to the LORD my God entirely burned offerings that cost me nothing. So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.

dag: Ka o tizɔpaɣiba maa daa tim ti yɛli Yisa, Ti Duuma, a ni yuri so pam la biɛra.
en: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, saying, Lord, the one whom you love is ill.

dag: N ŋmanila Sharɔn tutuɣu din pum viɛli pam, ka ŋmani vinvamli ni Paɣiviɛligakushihikom.
en: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley.

dag: Ka Huram daa mali daanya daantalis ayi sɔŋ. Zaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii. Ka booi booli pa di naŋgbanyɛhi zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anii. Ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla, ka daantaliga din pah ayi gba be lala.
en: Hiram made two bronze columns eight meters tall and almost two meters across.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛrilim n-dihi bɛn tɛha bi zilima nachiinsi, amaa baŋsim n-nyɛ yɛnnim zuɣupila.
en: Ignorant people get what their foolishness deserves, but the clever are rewarded with knowledge.

dag: Bɛ daa me li tamla bimbin kurili la tanzaa zuɣu, hal bɛ ni daa kul zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab dabiɛm la zaa yoli. Ka bɛ daa maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu tiri Yawɛ asiba ni zaawuni.
en: They set up the altar on its foundations, because they were afraid of the neighboring peoples, and they offered entirely burned offerings upon it to the LORD, both the morning and the evening offerings.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala shiri gbahi zahim pam, hal ka bɛ lansi maa ti pili chɛhibu;.
en: The fishermen put their nets into the water. Their nets were filled with so many fish that they began to break.

dag: Nyin ʒe samban ni, ka a ni yɛn paŋ so bini maa zaŋ a ni yɛn deei binshɛli ti sɔŋ maa yina ti ti a.
en: You must wait outside. The person to whom you are lending will bring the collateral to you out there.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum yi tuma.
en: You have six days in which to do your work.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ʒili marigi yi dim buŋ sɔŋ tiŋa, yin di chɛ o mini ʒili maa sɔŋ, amaa yin sɔŋm o yiɣisi buŋ maa zali.
en: If his donkey has fallen under its load, help him get the donkey to its feet again; don't just walk off.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa kpamba maa zaŋ doo maa ti darig o tibili.
en: Then the leaders of that town must take that man and punish him.

dag: Jɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jehoashs deeds and all that he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: amaa ka Maata ŋun tɛha kul bela bindirigu niŋbu ni, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti bɔh o, N Duuma, a baɣa ka n tizo maa ni chɛ tuma jɛli ma ŋɔ ni? Yɛlim o ni o sɔŋm ma.
en: By contrast, Martha was preoccupied with getting everything ready for their meal. So Martha came to him and said, Lord, dont you care that my sister has left me to prepare the table all by myself? Tell her to help me.

dag: Yawɛ zal o ni yɛn siɣisi karimbaannim zaa mini ninʒeensinim ni bɛnkam zaa duhi bɛmaŋa dahin shɛli.
en: The Lord All-Powerful has a special day planned when he will punish the proud and boastful people. They will be brought down.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni bunsi, ka zaŋ binshɛlikam zaa din be tiŋ maa puuni mini din be mɔɣu ni.
en: So the brothers took all their animals, all their donkeys, and everything else in the city and in the fields.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ti ti, Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni kana ti liri ti la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni tum alahiziba tuma ti ti kaman o ni pun niŋdi shɛm la, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka o zo ka chɛ ti.
en: Please speak to the Lord for us, because King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army are besieging the city. Maybe the Lord will perform one of his miracles for us and force Nebuchadnezzar to retreat.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan zaŋ o nuhi shihi o nina maa; ka zom maa lan neeg o nina lihi yaha, ka o nina maa dii neei zaa, ka o nyari binshɛɣukam viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Again Jesus laid his hands on the mans eyes, and the man opened them wide. His eyes were healed, and he was able to see everything clearly.

dag: Ka anab ʒirinim pam ni ti yi palo m-birigi niriba pam.
en: Many false prophets will come and fool a lot of people.

dag: nya ka Pita ʒiya wuɣisiri buɣim, ka o lih o ka yɛli, A gba yi bela Yisa Nazarɛt doo ŋɔ sani.
en: She saw him warming himself by the fire. She looked closely at him and said, You were with Jesus, that man from Nazareth.

dag: Amaa zuɣulan maa daa yi ti kpi, bɛ lan ŋmaligirimi tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din bie n-gari bɛ yaannim dini. Bɛ daa kul jɛmdila wuna ka damdir li tiŋa. Bɛ daa bi saɣi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa shɛli bee n-chɛ bɛ tipawumli soya la dolibu.
en: But afterwards, the Israelites would become even more sinful than their ancestors had been. The Israelites were stubborn—they simply would not stop worshiping other gods or following their teachings.

dag: A bela alizanda ni ha ka kari saria; ka dabiɛm kpe dunianima, ka bɛ fo baalim.
en: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent.

dag: Ibrahimma ni daa deei n noli ka doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: I will do this because your father Abraham obeyed my words and did what I said. He obeyed my commands, my laws, and my rules.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔh o mi, A yi pala Masia bee Anabi Ilaija bee bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la, di chaŋ wula ka a baptaiziri niriba.
en: asked, Why do you baptize if you arent the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko pam mini jilima.
en: Then the Son of Man will appear, coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli Bolimiya Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir la gba na ka ti ti wum o mi ni mali shɛli ni o yɛli.
en: Absalom said, Now call Hushai, and let us hear what he has to say.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Hazaɛl daa yi Ilaisha sani n-lab o dan maa sani, ka o ti bɔh o, Ka wula ka Ilaisha lee yɛl a? Ka o garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma ni a ni kpaŋ.
en: Hazael went back to Benhadad and told him, Elisha said that you will get well.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa daŋ yiɣisi n-laɣisi tiŋ maa ni kpamba pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.

dag: Dama Sadusiinim daa wuhiri niriba ni kpiimba kum ni neebu kani, ka lan yɛri ni malaikanim bee shihi gba kani, amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wuhiri ni di zaa beni.
en: This is because Sadducees say that theres no resurrection, angel, or spirit, but Pharisees affirm them all.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n ni pili n-chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam niriba zɔn ya dabiɛm, bɛ yi wum yi yɛla dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira ka biɛrim pam mali ba.
en: Starting right now, I am making everyone everywhere afraid of you and scared of you. Once they hear news of you, they will be shaking and worrying because of you.

dag: Di saha ka paɣiba maa daa lan kum pam. Ka Opa ŋun daa chɛbisi Naomi ka ŋmaligi kuli, amaa ka Rut ŋun zaɣisi ka kul doli Naomi.
en: Then they lifted up their voices and wept again. Orpah kissed her mother-in-law, but Ruth stayed with her.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ilaisha, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Bɛtɛl. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Bɛtɛl.
en: and on the way Elijah said to Elisha, Now stay here; the Lord has ordered me to go to Bethel. But Elisha answered, I swear by my loyalty to the living Lord and to you that I will not leave you. So they went on to Bethel.

dag: Ka daa yɛli Aduna, Malimi buɣa ti ti ka di gul ti, dama ti bi lan mi Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti na maa ni kpalim shɛli.
en: They said to Aaron, Moses led us out of the country of Egypt. But we dont know what has happened to him. So make some gods to go before us and lead us.

dag: Bani so mi daŋ ni: Maadai mini Amiram ni Uɛl.
en: From the descendants of Bani, these men: Maadai, Amram, Uel.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ka nir chaŋchaŋ ti lan ŋmaligi gbamda. Ŋunkam niŋdi lala bi simdi Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Jesus said to him, Anyone who starts to plow and then keeps looking back is of no use for the Kingdom of God.

dag: Ka Maika daa labisi anzinfa kpila tuhili ni kɔbiga maa ti o ma. Ka o ma yɛli, N zaŋ anzinfa maa ti Yawɛ ni n zaŋ li ti m bia ŋɔ ka o zaŋ li mali anzinfa binnani. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n ni labisi li ti a.
en: When he gave the eleven hundred pieces of silver back to his mother, she said, I wholeheartedly devote this silver to the LORD, to be made into a sculpted image and a molded image for my son.

dag: ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din viɛl la ni bi bɔra. Amaa Naawuni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ tuɣi taba, ka pahiri yaɣ shɛŋa din pooi viɛlim la jilima pam.
en: The more beautiful parts dont need this special care. But God put the body together and gave more honor to the parts that need it.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ania zahimbu puuni mal alibarika, dama zahimbu maa yi buɣis o ka o nyaŋ li, o ni ti nya laara din nyɛ nyɛvil shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la.
en: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.

dag: Yinim gba maliya suɣilo lala; ka kul maliya suhukpeeni, dama ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: You also must be patient. Keep your hopes high, for the day of the Lord's coming is near.

dag: ka n niriba bɛn nyɛ n ni su shɛb maa yi siɣisi bɛmaŋa n-suhi ma, ka niŋ tuuba, ka bo sɔŋsim n sani, ka zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni, n ni be alizanda ni ka wum bɛ suhigu maa, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka tibi bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: if my people who belong to me will humbly pray, seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven, forgive their sin, and heal their land.

dag: A takɔb zuɣu ka a yɛn dira, ka jɛmd a tizo maa. Amaa a yi zaɣis amaŋ zuɣu, a ni yi o sulinsi ni.
en: You will live by your sword; you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will tear away his harness from your neck.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa nti ti Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛlnima sansani din daa be Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Jɛriko polo la.
en: and brought them to Moses and Eleazar and to the community of the people of Israel, who were at the camp on the plains of Moab across the Jordan from Jericho.

dag: Ka Rabishake daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Hɛzɛkia ni Asiria naa ŋun nyɛ na tital la bɔhiya, Bɔ ka a lee niŋ naani?.
en: One of the Assyrian officials told them that the emperor wanted to know what made King Hezekiah so confident.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, N yi yɛl a, a ni ku ma bee a ku ku ma? Ka n yi wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm a ku dee li.
en: Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, If I give you an answer, you will probably kill me. And even if I give you advice, you will not listen to me.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni bɛ nya, ka daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi.
en: Again and again they put God to the test and brought pain to the Holy God of Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: Joab and his men advanced to attack, and the Syrians fled.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa teeg o nuu shihi n noli ka yɛli ma, Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa niŋ a noli ni.
en: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, I am giving you the words to say.

dag: M biyurisi, ti suhuri yi bi wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, ti ni mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani.
en: Dear friends, if our hearts dont condemn us, we have confidence in relationship to God.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla nir ni daa yi zɔri kuni tin shɛŋa ni tiligiri la ti ba. Shɛkɛm din be zoya ni la mini Gɛza ni di momaha tiŋgbana ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba.
en: They gave them refuge cities: Shechem with its pasturelands in the Ephraimite highlands, Gezer with its pasturelands.

dag: N ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi, dama ti Naawuni maa galisiya gari wuni kam.
en: The temple I am about to build must be magnificent, because our God is greater than all other gods.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A yi niŋ niriba maa nirilim, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini, ka zaŋ zilimballi yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ba, bɛ ni jɛmd a sahakam.
en: If you are kind to these people and try to please them by speaking gently with them, they replied, they will be your servants forever.

dag: Jɛrikɔnim daa kparila Jɛriko goondaa dunoya Izraɛlnim zuɣu; ka so ku tooi gari yi bee n-gari kpe di ni.
en: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa bari zani puu maa sunsuuni n-zabi di zuɣu, ka daa ku Filistianim maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ di nasara pam.
en: but Shammah stood his ground in the field, defended it, and killed the Philistines. The Lord won a great victory that day.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tooi pahi n zuɣu ka ti tuhi tɔb shɛli yi ni daa nya ka n tuhira, ka wum ni n na kul tuhiri li pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: You are having the same struggle that you saw me face and now hear that Im still facing.

dag: Hal o daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa m mo alizanda Nabia ŋun lan nyɛ nimaani tɔbbihi zuɣulan la gba, ka daa kari dabisili kam sara maligu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi na ti maan o; ka daag o jɛmbu duu luhi.
en: That little horn became very strong, and it turned against God, the Ruler of heavens army. It stopped the daily sacrifices that were offered to the Ruler. And the holy place where people worshiped the Ruler was pulled down.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti sab pa yuri buɣilimbuɣilinsi zuɣu yɛli, Ti woligi li di ko n-zaŋ tila Yawɛ. Ka saɣiduɣuri din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni ti leei din be kasi kaman la shɛŋa din ʒe sara maligu bimbini gbin la.
en: On that day, Holy to the LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the pots in the LORDs house will be holy like the bowls before the altar.

dag: A ŋme n-wurisi Rahab kaman binkpiŋ la, a zaŋ a kpiɔŋ wurim a dimnim bahi.
en: Its you who crushed Rahab like a dead body; you scattered your enemies with your strong arm.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya leei n niriba, ka leei yi Naawuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-yihi ya Ijiptinim ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: I will make you my own people, and I will be your God. You will know that I am the Lord your God when I set you free from slavery in Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures say, You must worship the Lord your God. Serve only him. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Di pala ti daa kala soli ni ti deei shɛli yi sani zuɣu ka ti daa niŋdi lala maa, amaa ti daa bɔrimi ni ti niŋ li ka yi nya, ka di chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu.
en: We had the right to ask you to help us. But we worked to take care of ourselves so that we would be an example for you to follow.

dag: Ishimail daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pihitanaayopɔin, ka naanyi kpi m-pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: Ishmael was years old when he died.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-chaŋ Jɛziriil, dama nimaani ka Jɔram daa biɛri be. Ka Juda Naa Ahazia daa kana ni o ti kaag o.
en: Joram was resting in Jezreel, so Jehu got in his chariot and drove to Jezreel. King Ahaziah of Judah had also come to Jezreel to see Joram.

dag: Di saha ka Taai Naa Hiram daa sabi gbaŋ ti Sulemaana n-garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni yur o niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka o zaŋ a leei bɛ naa maa.
en: King Hiram sent Solomon a letter in reply. He wrote, Because the Lord loves his people, he has made you their king.

dag: ni Iddo bia Ahinadab ŋun daa be Mahanaim la.
en: Ahinadab son of Iddo was governor of Mahanaim.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n ni yɛn tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, chɛ ka di kpe a tiba ni, ka a deei li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbihi daa kul lɔri tɔbu na ti tuhiri ba, amaa bɛ daa yi kul lo tɔb na, Dauda n-tuhiri diri nasara gariti Sool sapashinnim maa zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Dauda yuli du pam.
en: The Philistine rulers kept coming to fight Israel, but whenever David fought them, he won. He was famous because he won more battles against the Philistines than any of Saul's other officers.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kuhiri yɛri zoya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na! Ka ni ti yɛri kuŋkuna mi, Limsimiya ti! .
en: At that time everyone will say to the mountains, Fall on us! They will say to the hills, Hide us.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa nya ka Yisifu chɛ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ o nuu ni ka guui yi yili maa ni maa.
en: When she saw that he had left his robe and had run out of the house.

dag: Kum kɔgbana daa gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka bahi yoli kɔgbana liri ma.
en: Deaths waves were all around me; rivers of wickedness terrified me.

dag: Yɛla ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, dini n-lee be asama ni nir yɛli: A yi yɛli gbalikpimalana ni a chɛ o daalahichi paŋ o bee a yi yɛl o ni o yiɣisim zaŋ o daamaŋka chaŋ.
en: Which is easier—to say to a paralyzed person, Your sins are forgiven, or to say, Get up, take up your bed, and walk?.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisiyinika ni gol so ŋun pahir anu biɛɣu pia dali ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛma ŋun yuli daa booni Nɛbuzaradan ka o nyɛ Babilɔn naa kpambal la daa kpe Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In the tenth day of the fifth month, which was the nineteenth year of Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan commander of the guard came to Jerusalem on behalf of his king.

dag: Amaa ka o ba daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, M bia, m mi ni Manaasa gba zuliya ni ti galisi; amaa o tizo ŋɔ ni ti gar o, ka o zuliya ni ti galisi pam.
en: His father refused, saying, I know, son, I know. Manasseh's descendants will also become a great people. But his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become great nations.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kabiri kpɛri fɔntinsi ni, ka duri goma, ka duri kpɛri yiya puuni ka duri kpɛri takɔriti ni kaman tayiɣisi la.
en: They run to the city. They quickly climb over the wall. They climb into the houses. They climb through the windows like thieves.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n shia yɛn siɣi; ka wahala dabisa gbaai ma gbibi.
en: Now my life is almost gone, and soon I will die. Days of suffering have grabbed me.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ bɛ ni daa bahi dab shɛba, ka bɛ nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba la leei daba yaha.
en: But those slave owners changed their minds and forced their former slaves back into slavery.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni taɣ o tɛha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka yi nya atam pam. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ chi mini wain ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee bo yɛlli ti Taainim ŋɔ? Taai din nyɛ tin shɛli din leeri nama, ka di kɔhigɔriba nyɛ nabihi, ka di daa bihi mi nyɛ bɛn mali jilima pam dunia ŋɔ ni la?.
en: Who was it that planned to bring all this on Tyre, that imperial city, whose merchant princes were the most honored men on earth?.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Elijah obeyed the Lord 's command, and went and stayed by Cherith Brook.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Filip, a bi niŋ yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba maa gba be n ni? Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni tɔɣisiri ya maa, m bi tɔɣisiri li la mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; amaa m Ba ŋun be n ni maa n tumdi o tuma maa.
en: Dont you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The things I have told you dont come from me. The Father lives in me, and he is doing his own work.

dag: Ka n ni kul booni ba waawaayili shɛm, lala ka bɛ kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma. Bɛ maanila buɣili Baalnima, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi binnana.
en: The more I called them, the further they went from me; they kept sacrificing to the Baals, and they burned incense to idols.

dag: A ni kpi zo shɛli a ni yɛn du maa zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣ a pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a mabia Aduna ni daa kpi Hɔr Zoli zuɣu ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: You will die on that mountain. You will go to be with your people, the same as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor.

dag: Wummiya piɛguliba fabila mini bɛ kuhigu; bɛ kɔŋ bɛ jilima! Wummiya gbuɣima kuhigu; dama nyɔŋ din dolisi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili la saɣimya!.
en: The rulers cry out in grief; their glory is gone! Listen to the roaring of the lions; their forest home along the Jordan is destroyed!.

dag: O nam dariza bi mali ya dabiɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ya o zuɣu?.
en: Wouldnt his majesty scare you and dread of him fall on you?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒe Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa lihiri bɔri Yisa ka bɔhiri taba, Yi lee zahimla wula? O ni ka Chuɣu ŋɔ ni na bee o ku kana.
en: The people looked for Jesus. They stood in the Temple area and asked each other, Is he coming to the festival? What do you think.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa garigi yɛli, Ka bɛ yi ti bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka yɛli ni a bi yi n zuɣu.
en: Then Moses replied, But what if they dont believe me or pay attention to me? They might say to me, The LORD didnt appear to you.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Yi na mi n-nya ka nir nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, ka pa ni firila tamdigu zuɣu?.
en: Jesus said to them, Does anyone bring in a lamp in order to put it under a basket or a bed? Shouldnt it be placed on a lampstand?.

dag: Di saha maa ka naa daa bahi Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya noli, ka o chaŋ ti ŋme Shimɛi luhi ka o kpi. Di saha ka nam maa daa nya zaashee zani Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: Then the king ordered Benaiah to kill Shimei, and he did. So Solomon had full control of his kingdom.

dag: O daa yɛlila lala ni o zahim o, dama omaŋmaŋ daa mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: He asked Philip this question to test him. Jesus already knew what he planned to do.

dag: n-zaŋ bunsi maa na nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa bɛ yaansi zuɣu, ka Yisa ba.
en: They brought the mother donkey and the young donkey to him. They covered the donkeys with their coats, and Jesus sat on them.

dag: N ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ pala din yi n Duuma sanna, amaa m barinyubo ŋɔ puuni n tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu la.
en: But I am not talking the way the Lord would talk. I am boasting like a fool.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋ nuu n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n dalindi n gbaŋ kam. N ni sabiri shɛm m-bala.
en: Heres my greeting in my own handwriting— Paul . I do this in all my letters to show they are from me. This is the way I write.

dag: Ka o yaa daa kul pahiri biɛɣukam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: David grew increasingly powerful, and the LORD of heavenly forces was with him.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa bɔɣi litaafi maa niriba maa zaa ninni, dama o ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa daa du n-gari niriba maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli. O ni daa bɔɣi litaafi maa, niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisimi zani.
en: As Ezra stood there on the platform high above the people, they all kept their eyes fixed on him. As soon as he opened the book, they all stood up.

dag: Dama di ni ti a nyɛvili wɔɣinli, ka chɛ ka a biɛhigu tɔŋ pam.
en: because they will help you live a long time and provide you with well-being.

dag: Noli ni ti di yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔritiŋmana.
en: The Lord will curse your grain crops and the food you prepare from them.

dag: Tɛkɔa paɣ maa ni daa ti paai naa tooni, o daa lumi gbani zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa n-lu naa sizuura ka yɛli, Naa, fam ma bahi.
en: Then the woman from Tekoa talked to the king. She bowed with her face to the ground. Then she said, King, please help me.

dag: Ka o daa lan po pɔri yɛl o, A yi kul yɛli ma a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa hal di yi nyɛ n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni ti a li.
en: With many vows he said to her, I swear that I will give you anything you ask for, even as much as half my kingdom.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa po pɔri ashilɔni Jɛrimia sani yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nyɛvili ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku ku a, m mi ku zaŋ a niŋ bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a maa nuu ni.
en: He said, I swear in the name of the living Lord our Creator that I won't have you killed. No one else can hear what we say, and I won't let anyone kill you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpahimiya yi nuhi, ka zaŋ yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yɛra: Mbaye! Izraɛlnim ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛli din chihiri la zuɣu. Dama bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ shɛba, ka kum ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka alɔbo mi ti di bɛ shɛba.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, Wring your hands! Stamp your feet! Cry in sorrow because of all the evil, disgusting things the Israelites have done. They are going to die in war or of starvation or disease.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua tuumba ayi maa daa yi zoya maa polo labina chaŋ ti du mɔɣili n-labi Nan bia Jɔshua sani n-daa ti yɛl o dinkam zaa niŋ ba.
en: Then the two spies came down from the hills, crossed the river, and went back to Joshua. They told him everything that had happened.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni bɔri ni o me du titali, ka ku ʒini mali laasabu nya o mal liɣiri din ni tooi me li naai?.
en: If you wanted to build a building, you would first sit down and decide how much it would cost. You must see if you have enough money to finish the job.

dag: Jafɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Goma mini Magɔg ni Madai ni Javan ni Tubal ni Mɛshɛk ni Tiras.
en: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa yuri Jɛrusalɛm, maliya suhupiɛlli di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn zaa fabindi di zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli pam!.
en: Jerusalem and all her friends, be happy! All of you who were sad for her, be happy and rejoice with her!.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛ ni daa gbahi shɛba chaŋ Tɛlabib, ka bɛ be Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la sani. Ka n daa ʒini bɛ sani nimaani daba ayopɔin.
en: So I came to Tel Abib beside the Chebar River, where the exiles were living, and for seven days I stayed there, overcome by what I had seen and heard.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o kukoli yi zuɣusaa na ka yi wum li ni di chɛ ka o wuhi ya. O daa wuhi ya o buɣim titali dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yi daa wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni.
en: He let you hear his voice from heaven so that he could teach you a lesson. On earth he let you see his great fire, and he spoke to you from it.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhudoo din yaɣi ninsal milinsi zuɣu la ni gbibi yi suhuri mini yi tɛha Yisa Masia ni.
en: And God's peace, which is far beyond human understanding, will keep your hearts and minds safe in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam n-yɛra, Zomiya Naawuni ka timiy o jilima, dama o ni yɛn kari saria saha shɛli paaya! Jɛmmiya ŋuna ŋun daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni teeku mini kɔbil nina la.
en: He said in a loud voice, Honor God and praise his greatness! For the time has come for him to judge all people. Worship him who made heaven, earth, sea, and the springs of water.

dag: Yɛlim o, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, A kula nira, ka lan deeg o ni su shɛli? Ka lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ni lan yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bahi ni lɛli Nabɔt ʒim luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka bahi yɛn lɛl a gba ʒim. .
en: Tell Ahab that I, the Lord , say to him, Ahab! You killed the man Naboth and now you are taking his land. So I, the Lord , tell you this: Where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, they will lick up your blood as well.

dag: Ka Hanani ŋun daa nyɛ m mabihi ni yino la mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti yi Juda na, ka m-bɔhi ba Yɛhudianim bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba la mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: one of my brothers named Hanani and some other men came from Judah. I asked them about the Jews who had escaped captivity and still lived in Judah. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.

dag: O daa piila bunyama kɔbisiyi mini bulahi pisi ni piɛnyama kɔbisiyi mini piɛlahi pisi.
en: female goats and males, female sheep and males, female camels with their young, cows and bulls, and female donkeys and males.

dag: Ka Siria naa daa zal o chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba zaligu n-yɛli ba, Di ti tuhiya dabirisi, yi mi di ti tuhiya wɔɣira, amaa ti kul tuhimiyala Izraɛl naa maa kɔŋko.
en: The king of Syria had ordered his chariot commanders to attack no one else except the king of Israel.

dag: A bɔɣu nyɛla din mali kpiɔŋ; a nuu maa shiri mali kpiɔŋ, di bamdi a nudirigu.
en: You have a powerful arm; your hand is strong; your strong hand is raised high!.

dag: Din chɛ ka ti niŋ lala maa nyɛla, ti jɛmi ni yi yaansi ti bɔhi ti yaansi dahin shɛli ha, Yi mi nuu lee yi wula ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla ni?.
en: No! The truth is we did this out of concern for what might happen. In the future your children might say to our children, What have you got to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ o daŋ niriba mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi zaa ʒili nyaɣil o m-pahi lahi balibu kam, din nyɛ pipihi zaŋ tabili lahi ni duɣ bihi zaa.
en: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.

dag: Absalom daa dɔɣila bidibis ata ni bipuɣin yino ŋun yuli daa booni Tama, o daa nyɛla paɣisar viɛlli.
en: Absalom had three sons and one daughter. The daughters name was Tamar. She was a beautiful woman.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la yɛliya: N wum a kumsi maa, ka deeg a suhigu maa. N ni pah a yuun pinaanu.
en: Go to Hezekiah and tell him that the Lord , the God of your ancestor David, says, I heard your prayer, and I saw your tears. I will add years to your life.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ni ti ye binyɛr piɛla ŋɔ tatabo, ka n ku kpihim o yuli nyɛvili litaafi ni; amaa ka ni ti zan o nyaaŋa m-bol o yuli m Ba Naawuni min o malaikanim sani.
en: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.

dag: Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa puuni, Yɛhudianim daa kula dɔbba kɔbisinu.
en: They killed and destroyed men in the capital city of Susa.

dag: Ka m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa gba diri ma shɛhira. Yi na ʒi n-wum o kukoli bee n-nya o ni be shɛm ni yi nini;.
en: And the Father, who sent me, also testifies on my behalf. You have never heard his voice or seen his face.

dag: Dimiya li luɣ kasi shee, dama di nyɛla a min a bidibisi maa dihili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dama lala ka o zali ma.
en: The portion of food for you and your sons will come from the special gifts to the Lord , so you must eat that food in a holy place.

dag: ka daa zaŋ salima gabisi ayi la gɔhi bans ayi din daa goligoli nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya la.
en: They fastened the gold chains to the rings at the corners of the judgment pouch.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, n pun naai Iso zuliya zaa, ka yihi ba bɛ sɔɣisili shee, ka bɛ ku tooi lan sɔɣi. O bihi min o dɔɣiriba ni o ʒiʒiinitaba bahi yoli ka so lan kani.
en: But I have stripped Esau's descendants completely and uncovered their hiding places, so that they can no longer hide. All the people of Edom are destroyed. Not one of them is left.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jɛm Amɔrinim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ni be ŋɔ wuna la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n noli.
en: I am your God, and I told you not to worship Amorite gods, even though you are living in the land of the Amorites. But you refused to listen.
