dag: So miri ka o ti chɛ ka o bipuɣiŋga leei pagɔrili n-dih o vi, di yi pa lala, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti leei pagɔra tiŋgbɔŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali pali di ni.
en: Do not disgrace your daughters by making them temple prostitutes; if you do, you will turn to other gods and the land will be full of immorality.

dag: O zaŋm binyɛribil piɛl kasi ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli, ka zaŋ shɛlɔr piɛlli lo o shee ni ka vili bantabiga. Di nyɛla situr shɛli din be kasi. O sum kom pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa.
en: Then the Lord gave the following instructions. Before Aaron goes into the Most Holy Place, he must take a bath and put on the priestly garments: the linen robe and shorts, the belt, and the turban.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Ka sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di.
en: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself?.

dag: Teebul la mini di zuɣu lahi ni salima alali firila tamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛli zuɣu.
en: the table and its equipment, the lampstand of pure gold and all its equipment, the altar for burning incense.

dag: ka yina. Bɛn daa tum tuun suma ni ti neei kum ni n-nya nyɛvili; ka bɛn mi daa tum tuumbiɛri ti neei kum ni n-nya saria karibu.
en: Those who did good things will come out into the resurrection of life, and those who did wicked things into the resurrection of judgment.

dag: Pa Naawuni ŋun boli ya la n-nyɛ ŋun kari ya di ni.
en: This line of reasoning doesnt come from the one who calls you.

dag: Dindali maa ŋun ti be dufahirili zuɣu ka o nɛma be duu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe n-kah o nɛma maa. Ka ŋun mi ti be puu ni di lan kuli yiŋa.
en: At that time no one on a rooftop should go down into the house to get anything. No one in a field should go back to the house for anything.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka bɛ mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Bɛ daa kɔrila naɣilahi tuhili mini piɛlahi tuhili ni piɛbihi pola tuhili, m-pahi bɛ binnyura pina zuɣu m-mali sara pam Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: The next day the people offered sacrifices and burnt offerings to the Lord — bulls, rams, lambs, and the drink offerings that go with them. They offered these and many other sacrifices to the Lord for all the Israelites.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa maani o tuumba maa ansarisi, ka zaɣis o yɛligu wumbu, ka lar o daanabinima, ka Yawɛ suhu ti yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu pam hal ka di ti kɔŋ tim.
en: But they made fun of God's messengers, ignoring his words and laughing at his prophets, until at last the Lord 's anger against his people was so great that there was no escape.

dag: Ŋuna ka anabinim zaa di shɛhira ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ o yuli zuɣu la.
en: All the prophets spoke about him, saying that all who believe in him will have their sins forgiven through the power of his name.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣ ti la Yɛhudianima, ka ti pala bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ.
en: We are Jews by birth. We were not born sinners, as we call those who are not Jews.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa yɛli Yisahaku, Hiti paɣiba ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu bi doya. Yaakubu yi kpuɣi Hiti paɣa ka o be kaman bɛmbɔŋɔ, bebu bukaata lan yɛn nyɛ bɔ n sani.
en: Rebekah later told Isaac, Those Hittite wives of Esau are making my life miserable! If Jacob marries a Hittite woman, I'd be better off dead.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bol o na ka o min o ti di ka nyu, ka Dauda daa chɛ ka o nyu dam kuli, ka di daa ti niŋ yuŋ ka o yi samban ni nayili guliba maa sani nti dɔni o bindoo zuɣu, ka daa bi kul o yiŋa.
en: David invited him to supper and got him drunk. But again that night Uriah did not go home; instead he slept on his blanket in the palace guardroom.

dag: M mi ni a ni tooi niŋ binshɛɣukam, ka so ku tooi yiɣisi a ni lo ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: I know you can do anything; no plan of yours can be opposed successfully.

dag: Zaŋmi kuɣ kara niŋ a nuu ni n-chaŋ ti zaŋ li pi bɛ ni zaŋ yaɣiri malimali duno shɛli bɛ ni doli kpɛri Firawuna yili shɛli din be Tapanhɛs maa la ni. Chɛ ka Judanim maa nya a ni piri li shɛm.
en: Get some large stones and bury them in the mortar of the pavement in front of the entrance to the government building here in the city, and let some of the Israelites see you do it.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti paai, ka tiŋ maa zaa damna ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The next Sabbath almost everyone in town came to hear the message about the Lord.

dag: N nyaya ka daba bari yuri, ka chɛ ka nabihi chani tiŋa kaman daba la.
en: I have seen servants riding on horses, while rulers were walking beside them like slaves.

dag: Ka nyini Ziɔn Zoli, din nyɛ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni be kaman piɛgula n-lihiri o niriba ŋɔ, a ni ti lan nya nam shɛli a ni daa pun su la.
en: And you, Jerusalem, where God, like a shepherd from his lookout tower, watches over his people, will once again be the capital of the kingdom that was yours.

dag: O daa lan me buɣa jɛmbu shee zali Juda fɔŋ kam ni, n-tuɣindi tulaale zim n-tiri buɣa, ka di daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la suhu yiɣisi.
en: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa baŋ ni Naa Sɛnachɛrib loya ni o tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnim maa.
en: As soon as Hezekiah learned that Sennacherib was planning to attack Jerusalem.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni paɣ a. Nyini n nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni tibig a.
en: Lord, you are my God, and I thank you. My God, I praise you!.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Di chaŋ wula ka yi booni ma yi Duuma, yi Duuma, ka lee bi tumdi tuun shɛŋa n ni wuhi ya ni yi tum?.
en: Why do you call me Lord, Lord and dont do what I say?.

dag: Lala ka yi niŋ zaɣisi Naawuni zaligu yi yaannim kaya maa dolibu zuɣu.
en: Is this any way to show respect to your parents? You ignore God's commands in order to follow your own teaching.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛl o malaika tab bɛn ʒe o tooni, Yeemiya doo maa ni ye binyɛr daɣ shɛŋa maa. Di saha maa ka o daa yɛli Jɔshua, N yihila a daalahichi, ka yɛn zaŋ binyɛr suma yɛl a.
en: He responded to those standing before him, Take off his filthy clothes. And he said to Joshua, Look, I have removed your guilt from you. Put on priestly robes.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni gahi nuu boli zuliya kam, ka wuhi niriba shihirili; bɛ ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi maa ŋmab bɛ bɔɣuri ni na ti tin ya; ka zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi tuɣi na ti tin ya.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I will wave my hand to the nations. I will raise my flag for everyone to see. Then they will bring your children to you. They will carry your children on their shoulders, and they will hold them in their arms.

dag: Musa daa ti tim tuumba Ɛdom naa sani, ka bɛ yi Kadɛshi chaŋ ti yɛl o, A mabihi Izraɛlnim ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A mi wahala shɛli ti ni pun nya zaa yɛla.
en: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: This is what your brother Israel says: You know all the adversity that has happened to us.

dag: Di moliya di yɛla gili Gaat fɔŋ ni; yi mi di moliya di yɛla doli Ashikɛlɔn solɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Filistia bipuɣinsi yiɣi jam, bee n-chɛ ka bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣinsi suhuri paligi.
en: Do not announce it in Gath or in the streets of Ashkelon. Do not make the women of Philistia glad; do not let the daughters of pagans rejoice.

dag: O ni daa kul nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa zaa yoli, o daa bɔhim nɔdeebo wahala dibu puuni.
en: Jesus was the Son of God, but he still suffered, and through his sufferings he learned to obey whatever God says.

dag: Ɛlikana daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli daa boonila Hanna, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Pɛnina. Pɛnina n-daa nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi bihi, amaa ka Hanna ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia.
en: Elkanah had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah. Although Peninnah had children, Hannah did not have any.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa teeg o nuu tiri Ijipti koma zaa, ka poloya daa yina n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Aaron obeyed, and suddenly frogs were everywhere in Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa ni ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn be o sani, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura na.
en: So he called Johanan, Kareahs son, and all the army officers with him and the rest of the people, from the least to the greatest.

dag: saha shɛli taŋkpagbiligu yi ti laɣim niŋ tampuɣa ka tampuɣa maa tabili taba?.
en: so that dust becomes mud and clods of dirt adhere?.

dag: Ka ŋun bi be nyam maa yi shihi binshɛlikam, di ni leei din bi be nyam, ka ŋunkam mi shihi li ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: And whoever an unclean person touches will be unclean until evening.

dag: Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni, ka zaŋ o leei cheechi zuɣu ni o su cheechi binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: God put all things under Christ's feet and gave him to the church as supreme Lord over all things.

dag: ni dundɔŋ din gil la pilanim mini di binzahi ni kpahi ni mihi ni di nɛma zaa ni di neen kparisi zaa; ka a boli sokam zaa yuli n-wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn ʒi neen shɛŋa.
en: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yi ti mabihi gari kɔbisinu zuɣu yim, ka bɛ ni pam na be bɛ nyɛviya ni hal ni pɔŋɔ, ka bɛ ni biɛla mi gbihiri kum ni.
en: After that Christ appeared to more than other believers at the same time. Most of them are still living today, but some have died.

dag: Bɛ laɣimmi naai noli, ka lo nia biɛɣu jɛnd a.
en: God, they have all joined together. They have united against you.

dag: Ka di ni daa ti miig o pam saha shɛli ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda yɛl o, Di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, bidibiga n-lan bala.
en: During her difficult labor, the midwife said to her, Dont be afraid. You have another son.

dag: Ka Nɛri daa nyɛ Mɛlikai so bia, ka Mɛlikai maa nyɛ Addi bia, ka Addi nyɛ Kosam bia, ka Kosam nyɛ Ɛlimadam bia, ka Ɛlimadam nyɛ Ɛr bia.
en: son of Melchi son of Addi son of Cosam son of Elmadam son of Er.

dag: Yawɛ kahig omaŋ wuhi, o kari saria ka tuumbiɛrinim maŋmaŋ nuhi tuma leei zana ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The LORD is famous for the justice he has done; its his own doing that the wicked are trapped. Higgayon . Selah.

dag: Dama a noli ni yɛtɔɣa n-wuhiri a tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli ka a yula yɛŋkiŋkabina yɛtɔɣa.
en: Your mouth multiplies your sins a thousand times; you opt for a clever tongue.

dag: Dimiya li luɣ kasi shee, dama di nyɛla a min a bidibisi maa dihili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dama lala ka o zali ma.
en: You must eat it in a holy place because it is your portion and your sons portion from the LORDs food gifts, as I have been commanded.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti bi bɔri ni yi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ bɛn gbihiri kum ni la polo, ka di chɛ ka yi ku fabindi bɛn kpi la zuɣu kaman bɛn ka tahima ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Brothers and sisters, we want you to know about those who have died. We dont want you to be sad like other people—those who have no hope.

dag: M bi simd a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali shɛl a ni ʒe man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ biɛlifu gba, dama n jaaŋgbee kɔŋko ka n daa zaŋ na ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du; amaa pumpɔŋɔ m malila buni balibu buyi.
en: You have been very kind to me. You did many good things for me. The first time I traveled across the Jordan River, I owned nothing—only my walking stick. But now I own enough things to have two full groups.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan lab pahi buta ti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: So he left them and went away one more time and prayed. This third time he prayed, he said the same thing.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Chidɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣ shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa gbibi.
en: They came to Kidons threshing floor. The oxen pulling the wagon stumbled, and the Holy Box almost fell. Uzzah reached out with his hand to catch it.

dag: O ni ti lan chɛ ka yi ni daa zɔri Ijipti dɔr shɛŋa la zaa labina ti gbahi ya n-kul be yi ni.
en: He will bring on you all the diseases you saw in Egypt that filled you with fear, and you will not be able to avoid them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kana ti mɛhim vinvama din be gbirimagbirima ni, ni tampima voya ni, ka mɛhim gɔhi tuturi mini mɔri ni.
en: They will come and settle in the steep ravines, in the cracks of the cliffs, in all the thornbushes, and in all the watering holes.

dag: Ka a yi ti lan bɔrila shɛlikam pahi ni a zaŋ tum a Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin yihim li nayili kpanjɔɣu la ni.
en: And anything else which you need for the Temple, you may get from the royal treasury.

dag: A yi nyɛ yɛndana, nyini n-yɛn di a yɛm maa nyɔri, a mi yi maani ansarisi, a kɔŋko n-yɛn di wahala.
en: If you are wise, it is to your benefit; if you are cynical, you will bear it all alone.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti nyɛla n ni su shɛba n ni ti yɛn bɔhi biɛri dabisi shɛli dali maa, ka nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n ni ti tiligi ba kaman bihilaamba ni tiligiri bɛ bihi bɛn jɛmdi ba shɛm la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said, They belong to me. I will be kind to them. Parents are very kind to their children who obey them. In the same way I will be kind to my followers.

dag: Dama bia maa yi bi doli ma kuli, wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ n-tooi labi m ba sani? N zɔri ni n nini nya zaɣ biɛ shɛli din yɛn paai m ba maa.
en: How can I go back to my father without the young man? I couldnt bear to see how badly my father would be hurt.

dag: Bɛ laɣindimi sɔɣiri dooni ni bɛ nya n ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka maani tahima ni bɛ ku ma.
en: They hide together and watch every move I make, hoping for some way to kill me.

dag: Ti yi bela Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko zuɣu, yin chɛliya ka ti doli Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu.
en: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.

dag: Teemiya yi zuɣulaannim bɛn daa wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa la yɛla, ka kpahimya bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai kum la, ka chɛliya ka yi yɛda niŋbu be kaman bɛ yɛda niŋbu.
en: Remember your leaders who spoke Gods word to you. Imitate their faith as you consider the way their lives turned out.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sabimi Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa bɛn nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani yuya, ka kali ba.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Count all the firstborn men and boys in Israel who are at least one month old. Write their names on a list.

dag: Ka takɔb dirili yir o nol ni na, ka o zaŋ li n-zabi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba; ka siɣi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka puuni nɔri ginda.
en: Out of his mouth came a sharp sword, with which he will defeat the nations. He will rule over them with a rod of iron, and he will trample out the wine in the wine press of the furious anger of the Almighty God.

dag: Sool ni daa nya Filistia tɔbbihi maa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o ka o suhu fuŋ pam.
en: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was so afraid that his heart beat wildly.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma Baal binnan la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duu maa, ka zaŋ nimaani leei bimbɔɣili hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa ni ti a jilima. Zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ putɔɣunim ni lu a sizuura.
en: Therefore, strong people will glorify you; the towns of tyrant nations will fear you.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul ʒiɛri pampam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ pii neen shɛŋa din daa be ŋariŋ maa ni bahi kom ni.
en: The storm was so fierce that the next day they threw some of the ship's cargo overboard.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, Yi nyɛla bɛn be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka lahi maa nyɛ din be kasi; ka anzinfa mini salima maa nyɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: I said to them, You are sacred to the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and so are all the silver and gold utensils brought to him as freewill offerings.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o yila nimaani n-kpe fɔntin shɛli ni, di saha Izraɛlnim zaa ni bo gabisi yina nti vo tiŋ maa ti bahi zolɔŋni hal ka nir ti ku lan nya di kuɣibil nimaani gba.
en: If he retreats into a city, all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it into a valley until not even a pebble of it will be found.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin daa yɛl o ba, N yi bi ʒi Bɛnjamin kuna, nyin kum m bidibis ayi ŋɔ, chɛl o niŋ n nuu ni, n ni ʒi o kuna ti ti a.
en: But Reuben said to his father, Father, you may kill my two sons if I dont bring Benjamin back to you. Trust me. I will bring him back to you.

dag: tutuɣu daa na kani, ka binshɛli mi daa na bi bili yi tiŋgban ni na, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa bi chɛ ka saa mira, ka so mi daa kani kɔra;.
en: This was before there were plants on the earth. Nothing was growing in the fields because the Lord God had not yet made it rain on the earth, and there was no one to care for the plants.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu n-lɔri ninvuɣ biɛtali mini tuumbiɛri tumbu nia zuɣu. Biɛɣu yi ti neera, bɛ tumdila tuumbiɛri maa, dama bɛ mali di tumbu yiko.
en: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya o biɛyanim maa, o daa baŋ ba, amaa ka niŋ ba kaman saamba n-nyɛ ba la, ka daa bi tɔɣisi ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa. O daa bɔhi ba mi, Ya ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti yila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni ti ti da bindirigu.
en: When Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he acted as if he did not know them. He asked them harshly, Where do you come from? We have come from Canaan to buy food, they answered.

dag: Ka salo maa daa yɛl o, Ti pun wum Naawuni zaligu puuni ni Masia ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ka wula ka a yɛli ni shee bɛ zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Daadam Bia maa.
en: The crowd answered, Our Law tells us that the Messiah will live forever. How, then, can you say that the Son of Man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of Man.

dag: Yi ni ti laɣim niriba maa, dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bibihi zaŋ tabili saamba bɛn be yi fɔntinsi ni, ka bɛ ti wum li, ka bɔhim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura lubu, ka gbaai bɛmaŋa n-doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law.

dag: A yi niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nirilim, bɛ bi bɔhindi din tuhi niŋbu. Hal bɛ ni kul be wuntizɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zaa yoli, bɛ bi niŋdi din tuhi. Bɛ bi saɣi ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi.
en: When the wicked are favored, they dont learn righteousness; even among those who do right they do wrong, and they fail to see the LORDs majesty.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n ni yuri paɣ gahindi so min o bihi ni yɛlimaŋli la. Ka di pala n kɔŋko n-yuri ya, amaa bɛnkam zaa mi yɛlimaŋli la gba yuri ya.
en: From the elder. To the chosen gentlewoman and her children, whom I truly love.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa teei Yawɛ dabili Musa ʒiɛman la yɛla ka bɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun daa tilig o niriba toondaannim teeku ni la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun daa zaŋ o shia kasi ti Musa la lee be ya?.
en: Then they remembered earlier times, when he rescued his people. Where was the one who drew them up from the sea, the shepherd of the flock? Where was the one who put within them his holy spirit.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka goli wuhiri saha, ka chɛ ka wuntaŋ mi o lubu saha.
en: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shutɛla mini Bɛrɛd ni Tahat ni Ɛliada ni Tahat.
en: Ephraims family: Shuthelah, his son Bered, his son Tahath, his son Eleadah, his son Tahath.

dag: Ka yi daa nya ka bɛ chibichibi Dauda tiŋ la gooni voya; ka yi daa taɣi kom sɔŋ di biaŋ din be tiŋli la ni.
en: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka pagɔrisigu tuma naai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka di leei saɣisigu ti paɣiba zaa, ka bɛ ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma kaman yi ni daa tum shɛm maa.
en: Throughout the land I will put a stop to immorality, as a warning to every woman not to commit adultery as they did.

dag: Bɛ ni teei bɛ nuhi kaman kɔduɣiriba ni teeri bɛ nuhi ni bɛ duɣi kom shɛm la. Amaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ bɛ nuhi niŋ shɛm zaa yoli, bɛ ni bahi di vi.
en: When in it they spread out their hands as swimmers spread out their hands to swim, God will lay low their pride, even by the efforts of their hands.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Speak to the Israelites and tell them this: You will cross the Jordan River. You will go into the land of Canaan.

dag: Bɛ naɣilahi kul durila viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ naɣinyama kul dɔɣira, ka na ʒi n-zaŋ bahi.
en: Their bull always breeds successfully; their cows give birth and never miscarry.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa kpuɣi Inok ka o bi kpi, ka so daa bi lan nya o, Naawuni ni daa kpuɣ o maa zuɣu. Naawuni Kundi di shɛhira yɛli ni Naawuni ni daa na bi kpuɣi Inok saha shɛli, o daa nyɛla Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so.
en: It was faith that kept Enoch from dying. Instead, he was taken up to God, and nobody could find him, because God had taken him up. The scripture says that before Enoch was taken up, he had pleased God.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu dunɔguliba . Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinuayika.
en: These are the gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, and Shobai:.

dag: M pun tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa pam, n ku lan garigi; n ku lan yɛli shɛli yaha.
en: I have already said more than I should.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ wumpaɣibo mali sara ti ma la ti ma la jilima, ka bɛnkam mi doli soli din tuhi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ nya tiliginsim man Naawuni sani.
en: Giving thanks is the sacrifice that honors me, and I will surely save all who obey me.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi doli zaligunim ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, dinzuɣu doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: This very moment the LORD your God is commanding you to keep these regulations and case laws. So keep them and do them with all your mind and with your entire being!.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa din ni niŋ pa binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la zuɣu mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: gemstones; and gems for setting in the priests vest and chest piece.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yini pahi piɛlabihi pinaanahi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and pounds with each lamb, with the required wine offerings.

dag: O zaŋ liɣiri pam mali chaŋ. O ku kuna, naɣila goli muni.
en: He took enough money for a long trip and wont be home for two weeks. .

dag: Amaa Absalom daa bi yɛli Amnɔn zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, dama o daa lan je Amnɔn yɛlli o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi niŋ o tizɔpaɣ Tama shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: And Absalom hated Amnon so much for having raped his sister Tamar that he would no longer even speak to him.

dag: N ni kar a saria kaman bɛ ni kariti paɣ shɛb bɛn tum zina ka ku niriba ka bɛ kariti ba saria shɛm la, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒil a ni suhuyiɣisili mini nyuli.
en: I will find you guilty of being an unfaithful wife and a murderer, and in my fierce anger I will sentence you to a violent death!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yiɣisi dindali maa n-zo Sool sani kuli Gaat Naa Akishi sani.
en: David kept on running from Saul that day until he came to Gath, where he met with King Achish.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Hal a ni bi mi ma maa zaa yoli, n ni ti a yaa.
en: I am the Lord ; there is no other god. I will give you the strength you need, although you do not know me.

dag: ka benya kaman dunɔguliba bɛn mali shili ʒi n-guli bɛ duuma ni o ti yi amiliya chuɣu ni na n-niŋ gaafara ka bɛ yoog o yom ka o gari.
en: like servants who are waiting for their master to come back from a wedding feast. When he comes and knocks, they will open the door for him at once.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa deei baptaizibu, ka Yisa gba daa deei baptaizibu ka suhiri Naawuni; di saha maa ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi.
en: After all the people had been baptized, Jesus also was baptized. While he was praying, heaven was opened.

dag: Yili maa ni bihi mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa daa malila sala buɣim zali ʒiɛya wuɣisira, dama wari n-daa be; ka Pita gba daa ʒe bɛ sani n-wuɣisiri buɣim maa.
en: It was cold, so the servants and guards had built a charcoal fire and were standing around it, warming themselves. So Peter went over and stood with them, warming himself.

dag: ka di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛlimaŋli zaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni pun yɛl a shɛlikam la polo.
en: I have done this to let you know the truth about what you have heard.

dag: Ŋuna n-su dunia tiŋgbani puuni ziliŋ; ka su zo kara la gba.
en: The deepest caves and the highest mountains belong to him.

dag: Paɣ viɛla ni paɣ viɛlli, a bi mi? Doli piɛri maa naba n-zaŋ a buhi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri luɣ shɛli din miri piɛguliba tanti suɣa la.
en: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.

dag: O daa fa li la Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim ni Amalɛknim sani, ni o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza Rɛhɔb bia ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la ka di neen shɛŋa la zaa.
en: Aram, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek. He had also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ n dimnima ka daliri shɛli kani la, daa yimi teei bɔri ma kaman n nyɛla noombil la.
en: My enemies hunted me down like a bird, relentlessly, for no reason.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bee yi bi nya li? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: Yes, he said, you may well look at all these. I tell you this: not a single stone here will be left in its place; every one of them will be thrown down.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ti yi n-zani ni o zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii maligumaana so bee sariakarita so zali nimaani yɛligu maa, bɛn kum dilana. Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: You must punish anyone who refuses to obey the judge or the priest who is there at that time serving the Lord your God. That person must die. You must remove this evil person from Israel.

dag: Ka ŋunkam kahigi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni Bia, Naawuni be o ni ka o gba be Naawuni ni.
en: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God.

dag: Ka Anabi Musa daa bɔhim Ijiptinim maa baŋsim n-leei ninvuɣ titali o yɛtɔɣa min o tuma ni.
en: He was taught all the wisdom of the Egyptians and became a great man in words and deeds.

dag: Yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-nyɛ alibarika maa.
en: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti tuuri taba kaman bɛ yɛn zomi yi takɔbi kum ni la, ka so bi kari doli ba, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tuhi yi dimnima.
en: They will run as if someone is chasing them with a sword. They will fall over each other—even when no one is chasing them. You will not be strong enough to stand up against your enemies.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Mɔsɛrɔt maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Bɛnijaakan.
en: They marched from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal bɛ ni ti fa tɔbbihi daba, ka fa na biɛɣu ni di neen shɛŋa. N ni tuhi yi mini bɛn tuhira, ka fa yi bihi bahi.
en: The Lord replies, That is just what is going to happen. The soldier's prisoners will be taken away, and the tyrant's loot will be seized. I will fight against whoever fights you, and I will rescue your children.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi tuumbiɛri, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu, bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu bɛ ni kpi.
en: If good people start doing evil, they must be put to death, because they have sinned.

dag: Ŋun di nasara ni ti ye binyɛr piɛla ŋɔ tatabo, ka n ku kpihim o yuli nyɛvili litaafi ni; amaa ka ni ti zan o nyaaŋa m-bol o yuli m Ba Naawuni min o malaikanim sani.
en: Those who win the victory will be clothed like this in white, and I will not remove their names from the book of the living. In the presence of my Father and of his angels I will declare openly that they belong to me.

dag: O daa kul bela gbala maa shee, ka so daa naan ku tooi zaŋ hal bandi m-ba o ʒili luɣ yini gba.
en: He lived in the burial caves. No one could keep him tied up, even with chains.

dag: Juda zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti ba n-zani kaman tia din ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga wali wala.
en: The people from the family of Judah who have escaped and are left alive will be like plants that send their roots deep into the ground and produce fruit above the ground.

dag: Ka Pita garigi yɛli ba, Niŋmiya tuuba ka deeya kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yul ni, ka Naawuni chɛ yi daalahichi paŋ ya, ka yi deeg o Shia Kasi ŋun nyɛ pin la.
en: Peter said to them, Change your hearts and lives and be baptized, each one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ. Then God will forgive your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Pita ni daa na kul mal o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa puuni yɛla bilisir o suhu ni saha shɛli maa ka Kɔniilius tuumba maa bɔhi n-kana ti ʒe Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzab yiŋ maa dunol ni.
en: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of this vision, the men sent by Cornelius had learned where Simon's house was, and they were now standing in front of the gate.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli polo niriba bɛn labina. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb kuli Babilɔn la zuliya. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ zaa ti kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tinsi ni.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had captured many of the people of Judah and had taken them as prisoners to Babylonia. Now they were on their way back to Jerusalem and to their own towns everywhere in Judah.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa yi tɔb maa ni kuni ka zaŋ doli yi Hɛrɛs kunkuni polo.
en: Then Gideon son of Joash returned from the battle. He and his men returned by going through a mountain pass called the Pass of Heres.

dag: M biyurigu, di chɛ ka a bebu doli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa chɛ ka a bebu dolila din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli. Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyɛla ŋun mi Naawuni, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mi tumdi din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyɛla ŋun ʒi Naawuni.
en: My dear friend, do not imitate what is bad, but imitate what is good. Whoever does good belongs to God; whoever does what is bad has not seen God.

dag: Amaa baŋmi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi. Zomla ŋuna, ka chɛ ka a suhu zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: It is the LORD of heavenly forces whom you should hold sacred, whom you should fear, and whom you should hold in awe.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda kaman Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yir o suhu ni na kaman mɔɣa kom ni zɔri shɛm la.
en: All who believe in me should drink! As the scriptures said concerning me, Rivers of living water will flow out from within him. .

dag: Ŋun daa pahi piniyini n-su chir piniyini ni n-daa nyɛ Bɛnaaya ŋun daa yi Piratɔn na ka nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The eleventh commander, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah from Pirathon and the tribe of Ephraim. There were , men in Benaiahs group.

dag: Yi yi ti kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, yin chɛliya ka yi buɣa maa tiligi ya. Pɔhim ni ʒe ba chaŋ. Hal ninsal vuhibu pɔhim gba ni ʒe ba chaŋ. Amaa ŋunkam zaa kana ti kpe n yuli, o ni su tiŋgbani ŋɔ, ka jɛm ma n zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: When you cry out, let those things youve gathered save you! The wind will lift them all; one breath will take them away. but those taking refuge in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm bɛ wuna, ka di daa leei zana gbahi ba.
en: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.

dag: Teeku Ʒiɛɣu daa nyaya ka zo; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋmaligi lab di nyaaŋa.
en: The Red Sea saw this and ran away. The Jordan River turned and ran.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli, Yinim Zɛruya bihi ŋɔ, wula ka n yɛn niŋ ya? Di yi nyɛla Yawɛ n-yɛl o, Tum Dauda, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi lala.
en: David replied, What will I ever do with you and your brother Joab? If Shimei is cursing me because the Lord has told him to, then who are you to tell him to stop.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul maani ma ninʒeensi ansarisi ka bi chɛra, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ma.
en: They made fun of me, using the worst language. They ground their teeth to show their anger.

dag: Jɛzibɛl ni daa kul wum ni bɛ lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o, ka o yɛli Ɛhab, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti deei Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la wain tihi pu shɛli o ni daa zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ kɔh a zuɣu la su, dama Nabɔt lan ka o nyɛvil ni, o kpiya.
en: As soon as Jezebel got their message, she told Ahab, Now you can have the vineyard Naboth refused to sell. He's dead.

dag: Yi bi mi ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu ka ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ti ku bahi yoli.
en: You dont see that it is better for you that one man die for the people rather than the whole nation be destroyed.

dag: O daa yihi ti ti dimnim nuu ni. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a wumdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛr a, Nyama, Dauda lo a zaɣ biɛɣu la yɛtɔɣa.
en: and said, Why do you listen to people who say that I am trying to harm you?.

dag: Dama m mi ni Yawɛ galisiya; ti Duuma maa gari wuna zaa.
en: I know the Lord is great! Our Lord is greater than all the gods!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sujee kuri jɛrigu, ka nyuli zabbu mi kuri ŋun ka yɛm.
en: To worry yourself to death with resentment would be a foolish, senseless thing to do.

dag: Sool min o bidibis ata ni o neen ʒira ni o yiŋnim zaa ni daa laɣim kpi shɛm m-bala.
en: So Saul and his three sons all died together, and none of his descendants ever ruled.

dag: Hal bɛ bihi na teeri bɛ maligu bimbina mini Ashɛra binwɔɣila shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi ti mahili kam mini daboli kam zuɣu.
en: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.

dag: Amaa Naawuni yɛm wuhiri dimaŋ la bɛn dee li sani.
en: But wisdom is shown to be right by those who accept it.

dag: Di simdi ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa pahi Izraɛl naa zuɣu ka bɛ mali sara maa.
en: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.

dag: ka Zimiri daa kana nti ŋme o luhi ku o; ka daa di nam zan o zaani. Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa.
en: Zimri went into the house and killed King Elah. Then Zimri became the new king of Israel after Elah. This was during the th year that Asa was king in Judah.

dag: Ti bi lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni nyara, amaa ti lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni bi nyara, dama nir nini ni nyari binshɛŋa nyɛla din ku yuui, amaa binshɛŋa nir nini ni bi nyari nyɛla din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: For we fix our attention, not on things that are seen, but on things that are unseen. What can be seen lasts only for a time, but what cannot be seen lasts forever.

dag: Tɔb daa yi ti lu Naa Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni saha shɛlikam, di saha Abinɛr nyarila yaa Sool niriba maa sani.
en: As the families of Saul and David fought each other, Abner became more and more powerful in Sauls army.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yihi salima nɛma din be bɛ ni zaa Sinai Zoli gbini, ka bi lan zaŋ li niŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: So after leaving Mount Horeb the Israelites rid themselves of their jewelry.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, ti mali ba ka o nyɛla ninkurili, ka mali tizo ŋun nyɛ ti ba maa ni daa dɔɣ so o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni. O biɛli daa kpimi ka chɛ ka o kɔŋko n-kul kpalim o mabihi ni; ka o ba maa yur o pam.
en: We answered, We have a father who is old and a younger brother, born to him in his old age. The boy's brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother's children still alive; his father loves him very much.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima; dama ninsal sɔŋsim ka buchi.
en: Help us against the enemy; human help is worthless.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-chaŋ ti kum; ka lan lab bɛ sanna nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa. Ka o daa gbaai Simiɔn n-chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Joseph left them and began to cry. When he was able to speak again, he came back, picked out Simeon, and had him tied up in front of them.

dag: Kamiyana pumpɔŋɔ ka ti ku o n-zaŋ o ti bahi bɔɣa ŋɔ zaɣ yin ni, ka yɛli ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbigu n-gbaag o ŋubi, ka ti nya o ni zahim zahin shɛŋa maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: Come on now, lets kill him and throw him into one of the cisterns, and well say a wild animal devoured him. Then we will see what becomes of his dreams.

dag: Yi mi Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli nti yɛli Izraɛlnim la yɛla; bɛ daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu wuhi ni suhudoo yirila Yisa Masia sanna. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Duuma.
en: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi Musa mini Aduna yɛtɔɣa ka zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim mini Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa polo n-yɛli ba ni bɛ yihim Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But the Lord talked with Moses and Aaron and commanded them to go and talk to the Israelites and to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. He commanded them to lead the Israelites out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ di di simdi ni yi nyɛla yi tab sowuhiriba, amaa ka yi ti na bɔrimi ni so n-wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa bɔhimbu piligu ni yɛla. Yi na kul nyurila bihim, ka pa ni bindir maŋli.
en: You have had enough time that by now you should be teachers. But you need someone to teach you again the first lessons of Gods teaching. You still need the teaching that is like milk. You are not ready for solid food.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, nyama, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni chɛ ka tinsi pam kana ti lir a kaman teeku ni chɛ ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri shɛm la.
en: So the Lord GOD says: I am against you, Tyre! I will bring many nations to fight against you. They will come again and again, like waves on the beach.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bun shɛb bɛn bɔrigi zuŋɔ daba ata la bɛna, di lan chɛ ka bɛ yɛla muɣis a, dama bɛ nya ba. Ka ŋuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa lee yuuni bɔra? Pa a min a zuliya zaa.
en: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, dont be worried about them because theyve been found. Who owns all of Israels treasures, anyway? Isnt it you and your whole family.

dag: Ka daa chɛ ka Timoti mini Ɛrastus bɛn daa nyɛ o sɔŋdib la chaŋ Masidɔnia, amaa ka ŋun Pool maŋmaŋ daa kpalim Ɛsha n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: So he sent his two helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia. But he stayed on in Asia for a while.

dag: ka yi yɛn zaŋ nahu bee biŋkɔbbila mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la bee alikauli palibu sara bee suhuyubu sara bee yi churi puhibu sara shɛŋa yi ni yɛn mali ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim la.
en: and you make a food gift to the LORD as a soothing smell for the LORD from the herd or the flock—whether an entirely burned offering, or a sacrifice to fulfill a solemn promise, or a spontaneous gift, or at your sacred seasons.

dag: N ni daa nya biŋkɔb so maa daa ŋmanila jɛŋgbini, ka o naba mali nyinyɛ wɔɣila, ka ŋmani bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la naba, ka o noli ŋmani gbuɣinli noli. Ka waɣ biɛ tital la daa zaŋ o yiko min o nam ʒiishee ni o fukumsi din galisi pam la ti o.
en: This beast looked like a leopard, with feet like a bears feet. It had a mouth like a lions mouth. The dragon gave the beast all of its power and its throne and great authority.

dag: o chanimi ti zaŋ alizin biɛr ayopɔin bɛn bie n-gar o m-pah omaŋ zuɣu na nti kpe m-be nimaani. Di saha dilan maa biɛhigu ni bie pam gari di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before.

dag: ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa tiri ya ka di nyɛ shɛhira jɛndi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu ti yi bihi din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: he said, Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law .

dag: Ka Hiram tumtumdiba mini Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba bɛn daa yi chani Ofiri ti ʒiri salima na la daa lan ʒiri aligum dari mini kuɣ viɛla na ti pahi.
en: Hirams servants brought gold from Ophir. They also brought in jewels and a special kind of wood.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di ku lan yuui ka a dɔni pah a yaannim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa niriba ŋɔ ni ti saɣim bɛmaŋa n-jɛmdi tinzun buɣa din be bɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni chani tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni buɣa. Bɛ ni ti zaɣisi ma ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl la.
en: The Lord said to Moses, You will soon die, and after your death the people will become unfaithful to me and break the covenant that I made with them. They will abandon me and worship the pagan gods of the land they are about to enter.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa.
en: Use gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn to make the ephod. This must be the work of a very skilled person.

dag: O daa wuhila tumo maa, A yi kuli ti yɛli naa tɔb maa lahibali naai.
en: He gave the messenger these orders: When you finish telling the king everything that has happened.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a yuri siɣi teeku ni, ka fuɣifuɣi pani di ko titali zuɣu.
en: You trampled the sea with your horses, and the mighty waters foamed.

dag: Ka Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa wum o kum maa yɛla, ka chaŋ ti zaŋ o ti sɔɣi.
en: Johns followers heard about what happened, so they came and got Johns body and put it in a tomb.

dag: Nyin daadam, yɛlim a niriba maa, Wuntizɔriba yi birigi, bɛ wuntitali ku tooi tiligi ba. Ka ninvuɣ biɛri yi zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni, bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ku luhi ba. Ka wuntizɔriba yi kpe alahichi tumbu ni, bɛ ku tiligi.
en: Now, mortal man, tell the Israelites that when someone good sins, the good he has done will not save him. If an evil person stops doing evil, he won't be punished, and if a good man starts sinning, his life will not be spared.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o mi shɛli, o na bi mi di ni simdi ni o mi shɛli gba.
en: Those who think they know something do not yet know anything as they should.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam wum o yɛligu maa alahiziba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Pa doo ŋɔ n-yi niŋdi Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm alaka la? Ka ŋuna n-daa ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛn gba niŋ Yisa yɛda tahi maligumaaniba kpamba san la.
en: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests.

dag: Nira ni tooi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli? Amaa bɛ gbi ma la zamba bɔɣili. Teemi n ni daa zani a tooni n-tɔɣisi bɛ zaɣ viɛlli yɛla shɛm ni di chɛ ka a miligi a suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la.
en: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.

dag: yin chɛliya ka o mal o ni daa kɔhi li yuun shɛli maa zaŋ kana di saha maa laasabu, ka yo laɣ shɛli din pahi ti o ni daa kɔhi li ti so maa, ka bɛ labis o tiŋgbani ti o.
en: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.

dag: Ka juri daa ti kana ni bɛ ti di ba, ka Ibram kari ba.
en: Vultures came down on the bodies, but Abram drove them off.

dag: N ni ti kul yɛn niŋ niriba maa shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ maligumaaniba maa gba. N ni ti darigi bɛ tibili yo bɛ tuumbiɛri maa samli.
en: You will suffer the same punishment as the people! I will punish you and make you pay for the evil you do.

dag: Nyam dabisili maa! Nyama, di kanna, yi bahiyoli biɛɣu neeya. Tibidarigibo jaaŋgbee yirigi puma, ka karimbaani tiri.
en: Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bipola ni ninkura ni niɣi ni piɛri ni bunsi; ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The people destroyed everything in the city. They destroyed everything that was living there. They killed the young and old men, the young and old women, and the cattle, sheep, and donkeys.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa nim kpillikpilli mini zuɣu ti o, ka o nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: They handed him the head and the other pieces of the animal, and he burned them on the altar.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, N dana, di darigi ti tibili, ti ni tum jɛrilim ka tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: Then Aaron said to Moses, Please, sir, forgive us for the foolish sin that we did.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla din tuhi ninvuɣ so ŋun baŋ di gbinni sani, ka nyɛ din tuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim sani.
en: All of them are straightforward to those who understand, and upright for the knowledgeable.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Kpahimmiya noonsi bɛn yiɣiri ŋɔ: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna; amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ n-dihiri ba. Ka yi bi mali bukaata pam gari ba?.
en: Look at the birds: they do not plant seeds, gather a harvest and put it in barns; yet your Father in heaven takes care of them! Aren't you worth much more than birds?.

dag: Ka o yɛl ba, Yi nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka yi yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Pharaoh replied, You are lazy bums, nothing but lazy bums. Thats why you say, Let us go and offer sacrifices to the LORD.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa bɔhi Ilaija, Bɔ ka n lee niŋ nyini ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti teei ma n daalahichi yɛla ka chɛ ka m bidibiga ŋɔ kpi.
en: She said to Elijah, Man of God, why did you do this to me? Did you come here to remind God of my sins and so cause my son's death.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm nyɛla ŋun mi yɛla woligibu, yɛtɔɣa viɛla mi kpaŋsiri balima.
en: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.

dag: Di simdi ni paɣiba shini baalim, ka bɔhim baŋ din tuhi maŋsiɣisibu puuni.
en: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.

dag: Amaa di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛ ni daa na bi yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb o yɛla nini ni nya o; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-wum o yɛla ni baŋ o.
en: But as the Scriptures say, Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard about him will understand. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ti o suɣili Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu ʒini; ka chɛ Bɛtɛl bahi wulinluhili polo, ka chɛ Ai mi bahi wulimpuhili polo. Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ nimaani gba n-jɛmd o di gbini.
en: Abram traveled to the hill country east of Bethel and camped between Bethel and Ai, where he built another altar and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Di daanabinim zanila bɛ zaani n-zaŋ piɛnta piɛlli paligi bɛmaŋa, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka buɣiri ba ʒiri baɣiri yɛra, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Amaa ka Yawɛ bi yɛli shɛli.
en: The prophets have hidden these sins like workers covering a wall with whitewash. They see false visions and make false predictions. They claim to speak the word of the Sovereign Lord , but I, the Lord , have not spoken to them.

dag: Nyamiya, n di kul guhirila yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, ka gbilisiri tibili ni n wum yi yɛtɔɣa, saha shɛli yi ni di na tɛhiri yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm la.
en: I listened patiently while you were speaking and waited while you searched for wise phrases.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani ŋɔ kalinli nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu, ka a yɛli, N ni ti ba nimdi ka bɛ ŋubi gol muni zaa?.
en: Moses said, The people Im with are six hundred thousand on foot and youre saying, I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Jahinjɛya ayi bi kɔhirila siidi yini? Ka bɛ ni yino mi ku lu tiŋa ka di pala yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni.
en: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ ni o nyaandoliba maa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛtɔɣili maa zuɣu ka bɔhi ba, Yi suhuri miligimi yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: Without being told, Jesus knew that they were grumbling about this, so he said to them, Does this make you want to give up?.

dag: Ka Musa deemba ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛn nir la daŋ niriba daa yiɣisi abie tihi tiŋ la ni n-dol Juda zuliya niriba maa ti ʒini Juda tiŋgban ni din lab Nɛgɛb polo m-miri Arad la. Bɛ daa ʒini pahila nimaani nim zuɣu.
en: The descendants of Moses' father-in-law, the Kenite, went on with the people of Judah from Jericho, the city of palm trees, into the barren country south of Arad in Judah. There they settled among the Amalekites.

dag: Amaa di lee nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din ŋmani bin chɔɣima la nyɛla din ku tooi kɔŋ niŋgbuŋ ni;.
en: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka o zaŋ ti leeg o bihi yɛlimaŋli yɛligu la puuni ni di chɛ ka ti leeg o bikpamba o binnamda zaa puuni.
en: He chose to give us birth by his true word, and here is the result: we are like the first crop from the harvest of everything he created.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ daba.
en: Praise the Lord ! Praise the name of the Lord ! Praise him, you servants of the Lord .

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni bɛ booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka Filistia tɔbbihi zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti bo o shee. Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka yi n-chaŋ ni o ti liri ba.
en: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.

dag: N daa piligi di molo molibu la Damaskus n-yi ni chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni Judia tiŋkpansi zaa ni zaŋ tabili bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani n-yɛri ni bɛ niŋm tuuba ŋ-ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani, ka tum tuun shɛŋa din ni wuhi ni bɛ shiri niŋ tuuba.
en: First I preached to the people in Damascus, and then I went to Jerusalem and all over Judea. Finally, I went to the Gentiles and said, Stop sinning and turn to God! Then prove what you have done by the way you live.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, bɛ chani kabirila yiya kpɛra, ka biɛɣu neei, ka bɛ kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ duri; bɛ bi mi neesim.
en: In the dark they break into houses; they shut themselves in by day; they dont know the light.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul suhim Naawuni ka o chɛ ka di ku yuui ka n lab yi sanna.
en: And I beg you even more earnestly to pray that God will send me back to you soon.

dag: N di kul gbilisirila tibili, amaa yɛlimaŋli, yi ni so bi wuhi ni Ayuba mali taali bee n-garig o yɛtɔɣa maa shɛli.
en: but not one of you proved Job to be wrong.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa ni bɛ yinsinim zaŋ tabili ŋun Dauda paɣiba ayi la, Ahinɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la mini Nabal pakoli Abigeel ŋun daa nyɛ Kamɛl nir la zaa daa be Gaat Akishi sani.
en: David and his soldiers stayed there at Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives, Ahinoam from Jezreel and Abigail, Nabals widow from Carmel.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa nya buŋ yɛno kɔbili kpuɣ li n-zaŋ li ku ninvuɣ tuhili.
en: He found a donkeys fresh jawbone, picked it up, and used it to attack one thousand men.

dag: Yawɛ poya ka ku lan taɣ o tɛha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The LORD has sworn a solemn pledge and wont change his mind: You are a priest forever in line with Melchizedek.

dag: O ni daa ti paana, o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba, m puhir a! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, Hello, teacher. Then Judas kissed him.

dag: ni shinshingooro ni wɔɣivaanigu min o balibu zaa ni napakoli ni zɔŋ.
en: storks, all kinds of herons, hoopoes, and bats.

dag: Di nyɛla vi ni nir tɔɣisi niriba ni niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni yɛla.
en: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi binshɛŋa din nyɛ man Yawɛ dini maa, bɛ nyom o min o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa buɣim, o ni saɣim Yawɛ zaligu min o ni tum tuun shɛli n-dihi Izraɛlnim vi la zuɣu.
en: The one who is then picked out and found with the condemned goods will be burned, along with his family and everything he owns, for he has brought terrible shame on Israel and has broken my covenant.

dag: Babilɔnnim ni daa kul teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa chibi tiŋ maa gooni voli, ka Naa Zɛdɛkia min o tɔbbihi zaa daa doli voli maa yi goma ayi sunsuuni. Naa puu polo ka bɛ daa doli yi yuŋ n-zɔri kpari Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili polo.
en: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the desert.

dag: Nyɔtaɣirisi n-kul gil o yaaŋa zuɣu zaa, di shɛbila tab ni kaman bɛ dihi li mi tabili la.
en: Its back is covered with shield after shield.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa galim alikauli kurili ʒiɛmani maa ni niriba yɛli: Yi Duuma yɛliya, Dabisi shɛŋa saha kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: But God did find fault with them, since he says, Look, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will make a covenant with the house of Israel, and I will make a new covenant with the house of Judah. .

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba birigi n-dari gindi yɔɣu n-chaŋ hal ti kpi.
en: It twists and turns along the way and then disappears into the desert.

dag: Chɛ ka chɛrubi yino be di yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ yini polo, ka yino la mi be di tariga yaɣ din la polo. Chɛrubinim mini yɔrigu maa ni ti nyɛla bin yini di yaɣa maa zaa.
en: Put one angel on one end of the mercy-cover, and put the other angel on the other end. Join the angels together with the mercy-cover to make one piece.

dag: O daa kul bela gbala maa shee, ka so daa naan ku tooi zaŋ hal bandi m-ba o ʒili luɣ yini gba.
en: from the graveyard where he had been living. No one was able to tie the man up anymore, not even with a chain.

dag: Yawɛ suhu piɛl o niriba zuɣu pam. O tiri bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ nasara.
en: Because the LORD is pleased with his people, God will beautify the poor with saving help.

dag: Ka o lan tim so pah ata, ka bɛ ti bu n-ti o daŋa, ka kar o bahi.
en: So the man sent a third servant to the farmers. They hurt this servant badly and threw him out.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: Then, with the second bird, the priest will perform an entirely burned offering according to the regulation. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for you because of the sin you committed, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Ti mali yɛla pam ni ti yɛli ya zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo ka di mi kahigibu to, dama yi nyɛla suhutunanima.
en: There is much we have to say about this matter, but it is hard to explain to you, because you are so slow to understand.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ti nyari binyara mi kaman diɣi liti ni ka ti lihira; amaa saha yi ti paai, ti nini yipa ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Pumpɔŋɔ m bi mi binshɛɣukam zaa, amaa saha kanna ka n ni ti mi zaa kaman Naawuni ni mi ma zaa shɛm la.
en: Now we see a reflection in a mirror; then we will see face-to-face. Now I know partially, but then I will know completely in the same way that I have been completely known.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zani, di gba zaanimi, ka bɛ daa yi yiɣi, di gba doli ba mi yiɣi, dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela di ni.
en: When they stood still, the wheels stood still; when they rose up, they rose up with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.

dag: Ka Pool daa mihigi gariŋga maa bahi buɣim maa ni, ka bi wum biɛrim damli.
en: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba mini salo maa, M bi nya doo ŋɔ taali.
en: Pilate said to the leading priests and the people, I find nothing wrong with this man.

dag: Zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka tummila din viɛla, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi kul be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam.
en: Turn away from evil and do good, and your descendants will always live in the land;.

dag: Ka nandan maa daa ti kpi, ka malaikanim kpuɣ o tahi ti yab Ibrahimma sani. Ka bundan maa gba daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o;.
en: The poor man died, and angels took him to the place of honor next to Abraham. The rich man also died and was buried.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zaŋ zaligu din yi Yawɛ sanna zali Izraɛlnima. O daa yɛli ba, Yisifu zuliya niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Moses gave this command from the Lord to the Israelites: These men from the tribe of Joseph are right.

dag: Dama n ni kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni; n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili, amaa yinim ni du li chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa su.
en: I will die in this land and never cross the river, but you are about to go across and occupy that fertile land.

dag: O tɔbbihi laɣimmina, nti gbi bɔɣa do n-guli ma. Bɛ teei gilila n yili.
en: His troops come as one and construct their siege ramp against me; they camp around my tent.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa sɔŋ. O daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim bɛn zaa be yoma mini katinsi Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: Mordecai wrote everything down that had happened, and then he sent letters to all the Jews in all of King Xerxes provinces. He sent letters far and near.

dag: Asha bipuɣiŋga yuli n-daa booni Sɛra.
en: The name of Ashers daughter was Serah.

dag: Di tahi dokurili zuɣu, amaa zaŋm zilim balli n-tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa kaman a ba la; ka niŋmi nachimbihi kaman a mabihi la;.
en: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as if he were your father. Treat the younger men as your brothers.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ yi gba zaka, ka di be kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: This special contribution will be considered as the equivalent of the offering which the farmer makes of new grain and new wine.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have poor people with you, but you will not always have me.

dag: Nimaani daa mali momaha pam, ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa ni bɛ ʒinima. Ka dɔbba bɛn daa ʒini kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu.
en: Make the people sit down, Jesus told them. So all the people sat down; there were about five thousand men.

dag: A lee tɛhiya ni ŋuni ka a turi ka maani ansarisi maa? Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a niŋ karimbaani lihi ʒiɛm maa.
en: Whom do you think you have been insulting and ridiculing? You have been disrespectful to me, the holy God of Israel.

dag: O mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayi. Azarɛl bia Amashisai daa nyɛla Ahizai yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Mɛshilɛmɔt mini Imɛr.
en: and his associates, heads of families: . There was also Amashsai son of Azarel son of Ahzai son of Meshillemoth son of Immer.

dag: ka Yɛhudianim daa kana nti laɣim gil o bɔh o, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ ka ti chɛ biɛhiŋ? Nyini n-yi shiri nyɛ Masia, nyin kahigim li yɛli ti.
en: The Jewish leaders gathered around him. They said, How long will you make us wonder about you? If you are the Messiah, then tell us clearly.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good, because his faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la nimdi pahi yi sara maligunim nimdi zuɣu ŋubi.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, says: Add your entirely burned offerings to your sacrifices and eat them yourselves!.

dag: Ka mihi daa kul lo Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo hal ka bɛ ti lu buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego fell into the fire. They were tied up very tightly.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu puuni ka bɛ daa tuhi tin muna tɔbu di nasara. Bɛ daa zali din tuhi tumbu soli, ka daa deei Naawuni ni lo ba binshɛŋa alikaulinim la. Bɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima noya mum.
en: Through faith they fought whole countries and won. They did what was right and received what God had promised. They shut the mouths of lions.

dag: O kurimmi, ka dɔni kaman gbuɣindaa la. O ŋmanila gbuɣin nyaŋ. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yiɣis o? Ŋunkam niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, o ni nya alibarika; ka ŋunkam yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi yi zuɣu, yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu maa din dim o.
en: He crouched and lay down like a lion; like a lioness, who can make her rise? The one blessing you will be blessed, and the one cursing you will be cursed.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka niriba paɣ a, chɛ ka niriba zaa paɣ a!.
en: May people praise you, God! May all people praise you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ suhuyini n-gbib ba, ka daa doli yɛm soli wuhi ba din tuhi.
en: And David led them with a pure heart and guided them very wisely.

dag: Ka o daa lan me luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee, ka di wɔɣilim mini duu maa yɛliŋ nyɛ yim. Di daa nyɛla mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ gba daa nyɛ mita awɛi. Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima alali, din tibisim gari mɛtiriki tɔn pisi n-dooi pa di zuɣu.
en: Then he made the Most Holy Place. This room was cubits long and cubits wide. It was as wide as the Temple was. He put pure gold on the walls of the Most Holy Place. The gold weighed about / tons.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka niriba paɣ a, chɛ ka niriba zaa paɣ a!.
en: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yɛli ya n ni yɛn niŋ n tihi puu maa shɛm. N ni sibigi di gariche bahi, ka wurim gooni din gil li, ka chɛ ka binsaɣinda kana ti saɣim li, ka daai li luhi.
en: Now let me tell you what Im doing to my vineyard. Im removing its hedge, so it will be destroyed. Im breaking down its walls, so it will be trampled.

dag: ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ na kpalim ʒiɛya. Di saha maa ka dɔbba ayi bɛn daa ye binyɛr nyɛlisira dii puhi zani paɣiba maa sani.
en: They didnt know what to make of this. Suddenly, two men were standing beside them in gleaming bright clothing.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni nini daa ti bi tiɣi bɛ zaa; kulla bɛ ni biɛla kɔŋko ka o nini daa tiɣi, ka daa chɛ ka bɛn kpalim la zaa bahi yoli mɔɣu ni luɣ kɔŋkɔba shee.
en: However, God was unhappy with most of them, and they were struck down in the wilderness.

dag: N daa lan nya ka bɛ me bimbini gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa. Luɣa ni duri maa tanzahi buɣisibu daa nyɛla mita atata.
en: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Di lan yɛli yaha, Tumtumda kam simdi yɔri.
en: For the scripture says, Do not muzzle an ox when you are using it to thresh grain and Workers should be given their pay.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa labina di saha maa ti ŋme n-deei Hazɔr, ka zaŋ takɔb ku di naa, dama Hazɔr n-daa nyɛ nama maa zaa tin zuɣu.
en: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king.

dag: O ni ti wuhi zuliya kam shihirili ni o lan laɣindi Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa wurim be dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ ni la.
en: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, bɛ ni nyɛ zuliya yini ka mali zuliya yɛtɔɣ yini maa zuɣu ka bɛ tumdi lala maa, ka bɛ ni lo ni bɛ niŋ shɛm piligu n-na bɔŋɔ; ka binshɛli kani ka bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ niŋ li ka di ku nani.
en: And the LORD said, There is now one people and they all have one language. This is what they have begun to do, and now all that they plan to do will be possible for them.

dag: O mabia Ɛliɛza bia n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia, ka Rɛhabia bia nyɛ Jɛshaya, ka Jɛshaya bia nyɛ Jɔram, ka Jɔram bia nyɛ Zikiri, ka Zikiri bia nyɛ Shɛlomɔt.
en: His relatives through Eliezer included his son Rehabiah, his son Jeshaiah, his son Joram, his son Zichri, and his son Shelomoth.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ya polo ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ maa? Ka o yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: The disciples asked him, Where, Lord? Jesus answered, Wherever there is a dead body, the vultures will gather.

dag: Di saha bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya; ka bɛn ti be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, bɛn ti yim di ni, ka tiŋkpannim mi di ti ka di ni na.
en: At that time, those in Judea must flee to the mountains, those in the city must escape, and those in the countryside must not enter the city.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Nyama, M pun piligi zaŋdi Sihɔn min o tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiri ya, piligimiya o tiŋgbɔŋ maa deebu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Look, I have made King Sihon and his land helpless before you; take his land and occupy it.

dag: n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani Kiriatijiarim Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ boli nimaani yuli, Mahanɛdan hal ni zuŋɔ. Di mi bela Kiriatijiarim wulinluhili polo.
en: They marched up and made camp at Kiriath-jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath-jearim is still known as Dans Camp today.

dag: Ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni pun kari dunia ŋɔ naa saria.
en: He will show the world it was wrong about judgment because this worlds ruler stands condemned.

dag: Ka tuumbaŋdiba bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee maa daa ti yi bɛ tuma shee na.
en: Then the skilled men who were doing the work went.

dag: Dama n ni zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will protect it for myself and for my servant David.

dag: N daa bi deei n karimbanim yɛtɔɣa bee n-luɣi n tiba wum n karimbanim maa wuhibu.
en: I wouldn't listen to my teachers. I paid no attention to them.

dag: Naa ŋun ʒini saria karibu shee, o nina nyari zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: When the king sits and judges people, he must look carefully to separate the evil from the good.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa sula Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tinsi ni la kɔŋko.
en: But Rehoboam still ruled over the Israelites who lived in the cities of Judah.

dag: Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ pahi asiba sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la zuɣu.
en: Offer these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shutɛla mini Bɛrɛd ni Tahat ni Ɛliada ni Tahat.
en: These are the descendants of Ephraim from generation to generation: Shuthelah, Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama n yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam ni ti bɔri ni bɛ dol li kpe ka ku tooi.
en: Do your best to go in through the narrow door; because many people will surely try to go in but will not be able.

dag: Juda zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti ba n-zani kaman tia din ba jila viɛnyɛliŋga wali wala.
en: The survivors of Judahs family who have escaped will put down roots and bear fruit above.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisiya, di nyɛla sanʒiɛ biɛɣu din ʒiɛri gariti ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣuri zuɣu.
en: The Lord 's anger is a storm, a furious wind that will rage over the heads of the wicked. It will not end until he has done all that he intends to do. In days to come his people will understand this clearly.

dag: M bi lan je suli niŋ wain tihi puu maa. Di yi mali gɔhi mini suligunyinyari, dindina n ni mali shili lu di zuɣu, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: I am not angry. But if there is war and someone builds a wall of thornbushes, then I will march to it and burn it.

dag: Ka nimaani leei jɛŋgbina mini kunduna gɔbu shee, ka alizinnim be nimaani booni taba; ka Lilit ni kani nimaani na ti vuhira.
en: Wild animals will roam there, and demons will call to each other. The night monster will come there looking for a place to rest.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣil o lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: But Jesus said, Leave her alone! Why are you bothering her? She has done a fine and beautiful thing for me.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔh o, A ku garigi ma? A bi mi ni m mali yiko din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpah a tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka lan mali yiko din ni tooi tilig a.
en: Pilate said, You refuse to speak to me? Remember, I have the power to make you free or to kill you on a cross.

dag: Ka niriba daa wum di yɛla ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. Ka dabiɛm daa gbahi Filistianima.
en: The other nations will hear this story, and they will be frightened. The Philistines will shake with fear.

dag: Ka yi ni daa be Kadɛshibarinia, ka Yawɛ tim ya ka yɛli ya, Chamiya ti deei n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa, ka yi daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu maa, ka bi niŋ o yɛda bee n-deeg o yɛligu.
en: And you did not obey when the Lord told you to leave Kadesh Barnea. He said, Go up and take the land I am giving you. But you refused to obey the Lord your God. You did not trust him. You did not listen to his command.

dag: Dama Yisa daa pun yɛl o mi, Nyin alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ, yim doo maa ni.
en: The man said this because Jesus had already told the evil spirit to come out of him.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salim zim mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita. Ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim zim shɛli mali di zaɣ yini kam tibisim daa nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi. Ka naa daa zaŋ li niŋ Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yil la ni.
en: He also made three hundred smaller shields, overlaying each one of them with nearly four pounds of gold. He had all these shields placed in the Hall of the Forest of Lebanon.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa yeeg o sarika binyɛra sɔŋ, ka o mini naa daa kul laɣindi diri bindirigu sahakam hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: So Jehoiachin discarded his prison clothes and ate his meals at the kings table for the rest of his life.

dag: Ka o tumtumdiba daa chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Ti ba, anab maa yi di yɛl a ni a niŋm binshɛli din to pam, a naan ku niŋ li? Di ni ti be ka o ni yɛl a mi, Cham ti mim kom ni ka nya alaafee ŋɔ? .
en: But Naamans servants went to him and talked to him. They said, Father, if the prophet told you to do some great thing, you would do it, isnt that right? But he said, Wash, and you will be pure and clean.

dag: Bɛ daa lan niŋ o yiko ni o lo tɔbu tuhi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nyaŋ ba. Ka lan niŋ o yiko ni o su dɔɣim kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima.
en: It was also allowed to make war on the saints and to gain victory over them. It was given authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.

dag: Bɛ daa bela Arinɔn Mɔɣili duli guhira, ka ʒi bɛ ni kpari shɛli polo. Bɛ daa ŋmanila noon shɛb bɛ ni kari bɛ tɛri ni bahi.
en: The women of Moab try to cross the river Arnon. They run around looking for help, like little birds that have fallen from their nest.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima tɔb ni zoya zuɣu.
en: But the people of Zebulun and Naphtali risked their lives on the battlefield.

dag: Ka Musa daa labi Yawɛ sani ti yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, niriba ma tum alahichi titali, dama bɛ zaŋla salima mali buɣili.
en: So Moses went back to the LORD and said, Oh, what a terrible sin these people have committed! They made for themselves gods of gold.

dag: Hal Naa Dauda kpambaliba zaa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni daa be o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo maa zaa yoli, doo maa daa pihila kuɣa labiri Dauda mini ba zaa.
en: Shimei began throwing stones at David and his officers. Both the people and the soldiers gathered around David to protect him—they were all around him.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa chaŋ Damaskus ni o ti nya Asiria Naa Tigilatipilɛza, ka o daa nya bimbin shɛli Damaskus maa. Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa zaŋ bimbini maa biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni di yɛlli kam zaa n-tim ti ti maligumaana Yuria.
en: King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria. Ahaz saw the altar at Damascus. He sent a model and pattern of this altar to Uriah the priest.

dag: Ti lomiya tɔbu chaŋ ti tuhi ba; yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba wuntaŋ zuɣusaa dɛde. Mbusim paai ti, dama wuntaŋ luya, ka yuŋ zibira.
en: Prepare for battle against her; get ready; lets attack by noon! Oh, no! Daylight is fading, and the evening shadows lengthen.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka tirisi tooni biɛla ha kaman nira ni ni tooi lab kuɣili paai shɛl tariga nti gbani tiŋa n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra.
en: He withdrew from them about a stones throw, knelt down, and prayed.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni maa zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛli n-kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: Then the anointed priest must get some of the blood from the bull and take it into the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa, Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: But Zadoks son Ahimaaz again said to Joab, I dont care what happens, just let me run after the Cushite too. Why do you want to go, son? Joab asked. Youll get no reward for going.

dag: dindina o ni tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha dɛde, saa ŋun daŋ tooni mini saa ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa, ka yi puri atam niŋ pam, ka yi nya wain mini kpam.
en: If you do, he will send rain on your land when it is needed, in the autumn and in the spring, so that there will be grain, wine, and olive oil for you.

dag: ka di bintira kɔtomsi maa mini di jaba maa ni firilatamdigu maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka nyɛ salima alali, ka o zaŋ matarika kuri li.
en: The whole lampstand, with the flowers and branches, was made from pure gold. All this gold was hammered and joined together into one piece.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒiya nyuri wain, ka naa lan yɛli Ɛsta, Bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: As they sipped wine, the king asked, Now what is it you wish? Ill give it to you. What do you want? Ill do anything—even give you half the kingdom.

dag: Dunɔdali daa be dundombil ni nudirigu polo. Ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti kpa dunɔdali din be nudirigu polo, ka di nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: Here, too, there was a gateway leading to the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance to this second gateway, and it was feet.

dag: Ka Pita teei ka yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, nyam fiig ti shɛli a ni sa yɛli noli ti la ni kuui zaa shɛm.
en: Peter remembered the tree and said to Jesus, Teacher, look! Yesterday, you told that fig tree to die. Now it is dry and dead.

dag: O bi ŋme ba luhi kaman o ni daa ŋme bɛn ŋme ba luhi la shɛm la. O mi bi ku ba kaman o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku ba la shɛm la.
en: Israel has not been punished by the Lord as severely as its enemies nor lost as many people.

dag: N kul ni dol a zaligu sahakam.
en: I will follow your teachings forever and ever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guui li zali hal ni asiba kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka di daa bi saɣim bee n-wɔɣi zunzuya.
en: So they set the leftovers aside until morning, as Moses had commanded. They didnt stink or become infested with worms.

dag: Ka dansarika gula daa neei gom ni n-nya ka dunoya maa zaa yoomi, ka o ŋoog o takɔbi ni o kuhi ku omaŋa, dama o daa tɛhiya ni dansarikanim maa zaa yimi zo.
en: When the jailer awoke and saw the open doors of the prison, he thought the prisoners had escaped, so he drew his sword and was about to kill himself.

dag: Nyama, m bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: I have chosen a man from the tribe of Judah to do some special work for me. His name is Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur.

dag: Zɛrubabɛl n-sɔŋ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu ŋɔ tampuɣili. O mi ni me li naai. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n niriba maa baŋ ni mani n-shiri tim a bɛ sanna.
en: Zerubbabel will lay the foundations for my Temple, and he will finish building it. Then you will know that the Lord All-Powerful sent me to you people.

dag: Yisa daa ti yɛli salo pam, Yi yi ti nya ka sagbani dɔni gbinni, yi yɛrimi ni saa ni mi, ka o ti shiri mi.
en: Jesus said also to the people, When you see a cloud coming up in the west, at once you say that it is going to rain—and it does.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Hiburu paɣiba bɛn bi be kaman Ijipti paɣiba ni be shɛm, bɛ mali yaa pam. Paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda ti yɛn paai ka bɛ pun dɔɣi.
en: The nurses said to the king, The Hebrew women are much stronger than the Egyptian women. They give birth to their babies before we can go to help them.

dag: Ka baŋdiba maa garigi yɛl o, So ka dunia ŋɔ ni ŋun ni tooi yɛli nyin naa a ni bɔri ni a baŋ shɛli maa. Na so kani, hal na kara bɛn mali yiko pam ni yino na ʒi n-yɛl o timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni bɛ wuhim o yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo.
en: The advisers replied, There is no one on the face of the earth who can tell Your Majesty what you want to know. No king, not even the greatest and most powerful, has ever made such a demand of his fortunetellers, magicians, and wizards.

dag: dindina yin niŋmiya ʒiri shɛhiralan maa kaman o ni di lo ni o niŋ o kpee maa shɛm maa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: you are to receive the punishment the accused would have received. In this way your nation will get rid of this evil.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul dolila yɛlimaŋli soli, ka bihi bɛn doli bɛ naba mali alibarika.
en: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.

dag: Ka maligumaana leebu nimdi maa bee bɔrɔbɔro maa yi ti guui n-zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, dindina yin di lan ŋub li, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim, dama di nyɛla din be kasi.
en: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima. Di chɛliya ka naɣ bal shɛb zuliya du yi naɣinyama. Di biriya bimbira balibu buyi pu yin ni, yi mi di yɛnya taŋgari binyɛrigu.
en: Obey my commands. Do not crossbreed domestic animals. Do not plant two kinds of seed in the same field. Do not wear clothes made of two kinds of material.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla peentɔriba, ka daa naan tooi zaŋ bɛ nudiriti bee bɛ nuzahi n-to piɛma bee n-labi kuɣilɔna. Bɛ daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ Sool dɔɣiriba.
en: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.

dag: Yi chɛ ka bɛ dolila teeku chani dari Ijipti kawaan shɛli bɛ ni ŋahi Nail Mɔɣili duli la kɔhira. Yi nyɛla zuliya kam kɔhigɔriba.
en: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.

dag: ka bahi noli ni niriba maa ni yu shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: Pilate decided to give them what they wanted.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔhimi zuliya kam, ŋuni n-lee na mi n-wum yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo? Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ tum zaɣ biɛ titali.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: Ask among the nations: Have you ever heard anything like this? Virgin Israel has done the most horrible thing.

dag: Ŋunkam di ʒiri shɛhira ni nya tibidarigibo, ka ʒirilan ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: A false witness wont go unpunished, and a liar wont escape.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni Masia daa leei Yɛhudianim dapala ni o wuhi ni Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni chɛ ka o ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali.
en: For I tell you that Christ's life of service was on behalf of the Jews, to show that God is faithful, to make his promises to their ancestors come true.
