dag: Doo maa ni daa nya ka o bi tooi nyaŋ Yaakubu maa, ka o daa shih o sakpuɣu, ka o sakpuɣu maa ŋmirigi bɛ ni daa vari saha shɛli maa.
en: When the man saw that he was not winning the struggle, he hit Jacob on the hip, and it was thrown out of joint.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya bɛ taali? Yisa Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daa kpi; ka din gari lala nyɛla, ŋuna n-daa neei kum ni, ka ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo n-suhiri Naawuni tiri ti.
en: Who can say that Gods people are guilty? No one! Christ Jesus died for us, but that is not all. He was also raised from death. And now he is at Gods right side, speaking to him for us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kahi kuɣa m-pa Akan zuɣu hal ti duhi li sɔŋ, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Akɔr Vinvamli hal ni zuŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa naanyi maai.
en: They raised over him a great pile of stones that is still there today. Then the LORD turned away from his fury. So he named that place Achor Valley. It is still called that today.

dag: Kaman paɣili ni bi simdi siɣili saha shɛm bee di ni bi simdi ni saa mi puri atam kpuɣibu saha shɛm, lala ka jilima bi simdi jɛrigu.
en: Praise for a fool is out of place, like snow in summer or rain at harvest time.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi Yaakubu yɛtɔɣa ʒii puuni yuŋ. O daa bol o mi, Yaakubu, Yaakubu. Ka o saɣi ka yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: During the night God spoke to Israel in a dream and said, Jacob, Jacob. Israel answered, Here I am.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ kpana pam to n-chib o gbaŋ bee n-zaŋ zahimgbahiri kpana to o zuɣu ni?.
en: Can you fill his hide with darts, his head with a fishing spear?.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya ka yi bi kanna maa, ka n daa zaŋ n nyɛvili pa talima chaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti tuhi ba; ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kana zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi ti tuhi ma.
en: When I saw that you werent going to rescue me, I risked my own life and crossed over against the Ammonites, and the LORD handed them over to me. So why have you marched against me today to fight me.

dag: N zaŋ n kayeeni ŋmani n-yɛli ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ dunɔdaya ni. N chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bɛ niriba. M bahi n niriba maa yoli. Bɛ ni bi chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: In every town in the land I threw you to the wind like straw. I destroyed you, my people, I killed your children because you did not stop your evil ways.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ nina ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka yɛli, Yawɛ galisiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tinduya ni.
en: The people of Israel are going to see this with their own eyes, and they will say, The Lord is mighty even outside the land of Israel.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni yɛla polo taɣi ʒiri, ka doli binnamda n-jɛmdi li ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa namda ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.

dag: O daa me n-gili Bɛtilihɛm mini Ɛtam ni Tɛkɔa.
en: in Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa.

dag: O daa zaŋdila o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka daa buɣiri baɣisi, ka niŋdi laasabu, ka chani jinwariba mini timanim sani. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He burned his own sons alive in the Ben-hinnom Valley, consulted sign readers, fortune-tellers, and sorcerers, and used mediums and diviners. He did much evil in the LORDs eyes and made him angry.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino.
en: When the servant girl saw him there, she began saying again to the people standing around, This man is one of them.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba, ka di yihiriya ba hal biɛɣu.
en: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.

dag: Naawuni, nyam ti nyɔtaɣirigu, lihim a ni pii na so ŋɔ ninni!.
en: Bless our king, O God, the king you have chosen.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Abimilɛk sanna zahindi puuni yuŋ ti yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla kpima, a ni kpuɣi paɣ so la na zuɣu; dama o nyɛla do so paɣa.
en: One night God appeared to him in a dream and said, You are going to die, because you have taken this woman; she is already married.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, baŋmi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali taali, dama a nyɛla yɛndana; a mi a ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm chɛ ka o zuɣu piɛlli maa kpe gballi ni ni ʒim.
en: Now you must punish him. He's an old man, but you're wise enough to know that you must have him killed.

dag: Ka n daa zahim anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ mɛtiriki tɔn pisinaayi min anzinfa lahi kɔbiga ni salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ti ba.
en: I weighed all these things. There were tons of silver. There were also pounds of silver dishes and things. There were / tons of gold.

dag: N ni bahi ba noli ka zaŋ ba labisi tiŋ ŋɔ ni na, ka bɛ ŋme n-deei li, ka nyo li buɣim. N ni ti chɛ ka Juda tinsi leei dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Im about to issue orders, declares the LORD, that the army of Babylon return to this city. They will wage war against it, capture it, and burn it down along with other Judean cities. I will make Judah a wasteland, without inhabitants.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: and made their lives miserable by forcing them into cruel slavery. They made them work on their building projects and in their fields, and they had no pity on them.

dag: Miri ka a bo a kpee paɣa n-kpɛh amaŋ daɣiri ni o sani.
en: Do not have intercourse with another man's wife; that would make you ritually unclean.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti be bɛ sani. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.

dag: Di bemi kaman o ni yɛli shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, n ni zaŋ a yɛla tɔɣisi m mabihi maa; n ni paɣ a salo laɣiŋgu ni.
en: He says, God, I will tell my brothers and sisters about you. Before all your people I will sing your praises. Psalm :.

dag: Bundaannim mini faranim zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun nam bɛ zaa.
en: The rich and the poor have this in common: the LORD made them both.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba ni; ka chɛ ka a yurilim taɣi ba kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la.
en: Our Lord , you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Lɔt daa dol o chaŋ. Ibram daa nyɛla yuun pisopɔinnaanu nira saha shɛl o ni daa yiɣisi Haran maa.
en: Abram left just as the LORD told him, and Lot went with him. Now Abram was years old when he left Haran.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni bee n-to piɛm di ni bee n-zaŋ nyɔtaɣira ka di ni na bee n-kana ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gil li.
en: So the Lord says this about the king of Assyria: He will not come into this city or shoot an arrow at this city. He will not bring his shields up against this city or build up a hill of dirt to attack its walls.

dag: Daadam, ŋah bɔ ka yi leei ŋahira zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ polo din yɛra, Dabisa maa yuuya, ka ʒii kam kpalim yoli.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛl o, Rut, nyama, a kpee maa lab o niriba min o wuna sani, dinzuɣu a gba dol o labi.
en: So Naomi said to her, Ruth, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Go back home with her.

dag: Chɛ ka zuliya kam suhuri paligi, chɛ ka bɛ yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama a kariti niriba saria ka di tuhi, ka wuhiri zuliya kam soli dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be kasi sani, binshɛɣukam nyɛla din be kasi; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu bi be kasi ka nyɛ bɛn bi niŋ yɛda sani, binshɛli kani n-nyɛ din be kasi, dama bɛ suhuri ni tɛha malila daɣiri.
en: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.

dag: Amaa lee chɛliya di tigbirigu din firi tiŋ la, ka bo kurigu mini daanya zoligo vil li n-chɛ li niŋ mɔɣu ni mo maha ni. Chɛliya ka maligim lu dilan zuɣu, ka chɛ ka o mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni tihi laɣim be.
en: But leave the stump in the ground with a band of iron and bronze around it. Leave it there in the field with the grass. Now let the dew fall on this man, and let him live with the animals and the plants.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la min o dabipaɣiba ayi ni o bihi piniyini la chaŋ ti gbaai Jabok Mɔɣili du.
en: That same night Jacob got up, took his two wives, his two concubines, and his eleven children, and crossed the Jabbok River.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn lo ni bɛ kuli Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani maa, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ku ba, ka bɛ so ti ku kpalim bee n-tiligi alɔbo shɛli n ni yɛn chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu maa ni.
en: Everyone who decides to go live in Egypt will die by war, hunger, or disease. Not one person who goes to Egypt will survive. Not one of them will escape the terrible things that I will bring to them.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Doliya ma, ka n chɛ ka yi booni ninsalinim tiri Naawuni kaman yi ni gbahiri zahim shɛm maa.
en: Jesus said to them, Follow me! I will teach you how to bring in people instead of fish.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli o kɔŋko suhiri Naawuni ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: One time Jesus was praying alone. His followers came together there, and he asked them, Who do the people say I am.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi mini yi bihi ni yi yaansi ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi nyɛvili ni zaa, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaŋ wuhiri ya ŋɔ din ni chɛ ka yi mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa kurigi zaa, ka o dabisa ti pali ka o naanyi kpi.
en: Then Job died, old and satisfied.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya; dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia. Saha maa paaya! Miriya ka yi ti doli ba!.
en: Jesus replied: Don't be fooled by those who will come and claim to be me. They will say, I am Christ! and Now is the time! But don't follow them.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn kpalim, wummiya! Mani n-daa gbibi ya yi manim puuni zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ya saha shɛli zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Family of Jacob, listen to me! You who are left from the family of Israel, listen! I have carried you since you left your mothers womb. I carried you when you were born.

dag: A guri a tɔbu, ka zali zaligu, ka piɛma pani di zuɣu. A zaŋ mɔɣa bɔɣi tiŋgbani.
en: You got ready to use your bow, ready to shoot your arrows. Your lightning split open the earth.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri kul yɛrigila mɔɣu ni; ka bindira kul zibigi vinvama ni, ka bɛ tahira, ka laɣim duhiri bɛ yɛhi yiini yila suhupiɛlli zuɣu.
en: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ŋmanila ŋahili shɛli din wuhi: Bindoo bi waɣa ka nir ni tooi teeg omaŋ dɔni di zuɣu, ka chinchini gba bi yɛlima, ka nir ni tooi zaŋ li pil omaŋa.
en: You will be like the person in the proverb, who tries to sleep in a bed too short to stretch out on, with a blanket too narrow to wrap himself in.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni kuhiri kuyila yili shɛli ni bee n-fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kum bɛ zuɣu, dama man yihi n suhudoo mini n yurilim din bi taɣira ni n nambɔzɔbo niriba ŋɔ ni.
en: You must not enter a house where there is mourning. Do not grieve for anyone. I will no longer bless my people with peace or show them love and mercy.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Mushi. Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba m-bala kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Meraris sons were Mahli and Mushi. This is a list of the families in the tribe of Levi. They are listed with their fathers names first:.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tumdi buɣijɛmbo tuma niriba maa sani, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim birigi n-tum alahichi la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu m poya zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ni bɛ ni nya tibidarigibo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning.

dag: Ka bɛ tintariga bɔbili maa daa yi nimaani n-zaŋ hal ti sirigi Luz nudirigu polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Atarɔtada Zoli din daa be Bɛtihɔrɔn din be naɣiliŋga ni nudirigu polo la.
en: The border then went to the slope on the south side of Luz , then down to Ataroth Addar, on the mountain south of Lower Beth Horon.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yuli bɛ zaa ti tuui taba ka yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa. Ka o teei li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Looking around at them all, he said to the man, Stretch out your hand. So he did and his hand was made healthy.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti ni daa woligi ya daba ayi la puuni, kulla ti niŋgbuna tab woligibu ko yɛla ka n yɛri maa, ka pa ni ti tɛha tab Woligibu. Ti naɣi ya nyabu, ka mi kul kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti lan nyan ya yaha.
en: Brothers and sisters, we were separated from you for a while physically but not in our hearts. We made every effort in our desire to see you again face-to-face.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Rut daa ti yɛli Naomi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti doli kachɛriba yihiri kayiha. M mali tahima ni n ni ti nya so ka o saɣi ka n yihi kayiha o puu ni. Ka Naomi yɛl o, M bia, to chama.
en: One day Ruth said to Naomi, Let me go to the fields to gather the grain that the harvest workers leave. I am sure to find someone who will let me work with him. Naomi answered, Go ahead, daughter.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋ chaŋ yuntisuɣu saha, n ni kpe Ijipti tiŋ puuni.
en: Moses went to the king and said: I have come to let you know what the Lord is going to do. About midnight he will go through the land of Egypt.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ bɛ nanim niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi ti kpihim bɛ yuya dunia ŋɔ ni. So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya hal ka yi ti ku bɛ zaa.
en: He will hand their kings over to you, and you will wipe their names out from under the skies. No one will be able to stand before you; you will crush them.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila azichi shɛli din sɔɣi tiŋgban ni so puu ni, ka do so kana nti nya li ka daai tam pi li, ka chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da puu maa.
en: Gods kingdom is like a treasure hidden in a field. One day a man found the treasure. He hid it again and was so happy that he went and sold everything he owned and bought the field.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli maa duya gari sagbana, ka a ʒiɛyimtali chaŋ hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Your faithful love is higher than the highest clouds in the sky!.

dag: Aai! N ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa chɛfirinim ni zaŋdi maani maligu, bɛ zaŋdi li maanila alizin biɛri, pa ni Naawuni. Ka m mi bi bɔri ni yi mini alizin biɛri yɛla kpɛri tab ni.
en: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya niriba ayi o sani. Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija.
en: Suddenly Moses and Elijah were there speaking with him.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun na yoli niŋ tuuba; di yi nyɛ lala, di pa shɛli ka o ti niŋ karimbaani duh omaŋa, ka saria karibu di o kaman di ni daa di Sintani shɛm la.
en: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.

dag: dama naɣilahi mini buhi ʒim ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi.
en: because it is not possible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o jaaŋgbee maa tiri Ijipti tiŋgbani maa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim yi wulimpuhili polo na n-ʒe dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka pɔhim maa ʒi toli na.
en: So Moses raised his walking stick over the land of Egypt, and the Lord caused a strong wind to blow from the east. The wind blew all that day and night. When morning came, the wind had brought the locusts to the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu n-chaŋ ti dɔni Zalimɔna.
en: They marched from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.

dag: yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl zoya, wummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛligu! Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli zoya mini daboya ni yilima ni vinvama shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa ni zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-saɣim yi buɣa jɛmbu shee la.
en: Tell the mountains of Israel to hear the Sovereign Lord 's word—to hear what I, the Sovereign Lord , am telling the mountains, the hills, the gorges, and the valleys: I will send a sword to destroy the places where people worship idols.

dag: Bɛ yi ti muɣisi ya tin shɛl ni, yin yimiya ni n-taɣi tiŋa; dama yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi na ku chaŋ tuui Izraɛl tinsi zaa ka Daadam Bia labina.
en: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka o daa tim Azalia bia Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara, ka nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɛl o.
en: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the court secretary Shaphan, the son of Azaliah and grandson of Meshullam, to the Temple with the order:.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita; ka wurim ti kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni.
en: You allowed us to be slaughtered like sheep; you scattered us in foreign countries.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam dol o yɛligu, dilana n-nyɛ Naawuni yurilim ni niŋ dɛde so ni. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ ni ti be Naawuni ni.
en: But if we obey his word, we are the ones whose love for God has really been made perfect. This is how we can be sure that we are in union with God:.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri wuntia ŋɔ, wummiya! Nyamiya bɛ ni daa ŋma kuɣ shɛli yihi ya na mini bɛ ni daa gbi tampin shɛŋa yihi ya na.
en: If you want to do right and obey the Lord , follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.

dag: Ka chaŋ ti shihi kpim maa daamaŋka, ka bɛn daa ʒir o maa kpalim zani. Ka o kuhi boli kpim maa, Nachimbila, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: Then he walked over and touched the coffin, and the men carrying it stopped. Jesus said, Young man! Get up, I tell you.

dag: Kaman sara maligu biŋkɔbbaligu ni galisi shɛm ni kaman Jɛrusalɛm churi puhibu ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni beni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni daa wurim fɔntin shɛŋa maa ni ti pali daadambiɛligu. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Jɛrɔbɔam daa na kul bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o daalahichi tumbu soli maa, amaa ka na kul lihirila niriba maa zaa ni m-piiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni saɣi n-leei buɣa tindaannima.
en: King Jeroboam did not change. He continued doing evil. He continued to choose people from different tribes to serve as priests at the high places. Whoever wanted to be a priest was allowed to be one.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa bɔhi Amnɔn, Nabia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim mali suhugarigu biɛɣukam lala? Yɛlim ma din muɣis a. Ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, N kɔre n-kpe m mabia Absalom tizɔpaɣ Tama ni.
en: Prince, Jonadab said to him, why are you so down, morning after morning? Tell me about it. So Amnon told him, Im in love with Tamar, the sister of my brother Absalom.

dag: Ŋunkam je o mabia nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, ka yi mi ni ninvuɣ kura ka nyɛvili din ka bahigu o ni.
en: Those who hate others are murderers, and you know that murderers do not have eternal life in them.

dag: Ka n daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu n-lihi nya binyila anahi ʒii shɛl ni yaha.
en: Next, I saw four animal horns.

dag: Ka a ni tɛhi tɛhi viɛl shɛŋa ka taɣ ma zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka m bi tum taali so ʒim yihibu puuni bee n-zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuhi ŋɔ bɔhi biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu, a mali alibarika.
en: And bless you and your good judgment for preventing me from shedding blood and taking vengeance into my own hands today!.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya bantab viɛlli vil o zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bantab viɛlli maa vil o zuɣu maa, ka zaŋ binyɛr suŋ yɛl o; ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛya.
en: He commanded the attendants to put a clean turban on Joshua's head. They did so, and then they put the new clothes on him while the angel of the Lord stood there.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, so kanna m-be kaman Tabo zoli ni be shɛm zoya ni la, ka be kaman Kamɛl zoli ni ʒe m-baɣi teeku shɛm la.
en: As I live, declares the king, whose name is the LORD of heavenly forces, one is coming just as surely as Tabor is in the mountains and Carmel is by the sea.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yiriŋ nyɛla ŋun mali baŋsim, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali suɣilo nyɛ ŋun mali tɛhi zilima.
en: Intelligent people choose their words carefully. Those who know what they are doing remain calm.

dag: n ni daa na mali yaa, ka Naawuni zɔtali na be n yiŋ la.
en: I wish for the days when I was successful, when I enjoyed Gods friendship and blessing in my home.

dag: Zinaniŋda gba kul guhirila wuntaŋ lubu ka yɛra, N je ni so nya ma. Ka zaŋ bini pili limsi o ninni.
en: The adulterer waits for twilight to come; he covers his face so that no one can see him.

dag: Yawɛ, n je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a. N ʒiɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpɛhir a nini.
en: O Lord , how I hate those who hate you! How I despise those who rebel against you!.

dag: Bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm wuhiri ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm sabi be bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha gba di ba shɛhira ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama shɛlini bɛ tɛha galindi ba, ka shɛlini mi ka di zaani bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Their conduct shows that what the Law commands is written in their hearts. Their consciences also show that this is true, since their thoughts sometimes accuse them and sometimes defend them.

dag: Gɛra pisi n-yɛn nyɛ shɛkal yini. Shɛkal pihiyɔbu n-yɛn nyɛ mina zaɣ yini yi sani.
en: The shekel must weigh twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels will equal one maneh for you.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa luhi, ka di lubu maa bie pam la.
en: The rain poured down, the rivers flooded over, the wind blew hard against that house, and it fell. And what a terrible fall that was.

dag: N zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu mi kaman Naawuni ni zabiri nyuli yi zuɣu shɛm, dama n zaŋ ya tila Masia kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi paɣipiɛliga tiri do yino shɛm la.
en: Im deeply concerned about you with the same concern that God has. As your father, I promised you in marriage to one husband. I promised to present you as an innocent virgin to Christ himself.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia A min a bia Shiajashub cham Ahaz sani. O be zuɣusaa polo biaŋ la polo kpaluhi solɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord told Isaiah, You and your son Shear Jashub should go out and talk to Ahaz. Go to the place where the water flows into the Upper Pool, on the street that leads up to Laundrymans Field.

dag: Ka bɛ ba Yaakubu yɛli ba, Yi chɛ ka n kɔŋ m bihi. Yisifu lan kani, ka Simiɔn gba kani, ka yi yɛn zaŋ Bɛnjamin mi chaŋ pumpɔŋɔ, n zuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa ʒini.
en: who said, You have already taken my sons Joseph and Simeon from me. And now you want to take away Benjamin! Everything is against me.

dag: Benya n ni, ka n gba be yi ni. Tiwulli ku tooi wali wala dimaŋmaŋ yiko ni ka pa ni di tuɣila tia; yi gba ku tooi wali wala, shee yi tuɣila mani.
en: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. A branch cant produce fruit by itself, but must remain in the vine. Likewise, you cant produce fruit unless you remain in me.

dag: ka Sulemaana daa lab me Gɛza mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din be tiŋli polo la.
en: and Solomon rebuilt it. Using his forced labor, Solomon also rebuilt Lower Beth Horon.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ nyɛviya zan tariga kaman nir ni yi vuhi pɔhim bahi la; ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ba bɛ ni be yuun shɛŋa ni.
en: So he ended their worthless lives; he brought their years to a close with disaster.

dag: ni m mali suhugarigu pam, ka nandahima din bi naari kul mali ma.
en: I have great sorrow and always feel much sadness.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, N suhir a, wuhim ma a yuli. Amaa ka doo maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a baŋ n yuli? Di nyaaŋa ka doo maa daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni nimaani.
en: Jacob said, Now tell me your name. But he answered, Why do you want to know my name? Then he blessed Jacob.

dag: M mi bɛ tɛha mini bɛ tuma. N kanimina ni n ti laɣim zuliya kam mini tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim zaa ka bɛ kana ti nya n jilima.
en: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory.

dag: Aai, m bia! Aai, m pul ni bia! Aai, n nɔpoli bia!.
en: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.

dag: N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi lee m bia. N ti ku yihi n yurilim maŋli o ni kaman n ni daa yihi n yurilim ŋun daa daŋ a tooni la ni shɛm la.
en: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-daa zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim leeg a dahalali niriba ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka leei bɛ Naawuni.
en: You have made Israel your own people forever, and you, Lord , have become their God.

dag: Kom ni ti zɔri yir o ŋmana ni na, ka o bimbira tiɣi kom pam. O naa ni ti gari Agag. O nam ni ti du pam.
en: You will always have enough water, enough water for your seeds to grow. Your king will be greater than King Agag. Your kingdom will be very great.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli n Duuma, amaa ba shɛb bɛn do bɛ lan laa gbini diri bindir burisa din luri tiŋa.
en: She said, Yes, Lord. But even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall off their masters table.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yila dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa man yila alizanda ni na; yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, amaa man pala dunia ŋɔ nira.
en: He said to them, You are from below; Im from above. You are from this world; Im not from this world.

dag: ka daa tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yihi Naawuni nam waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋda.
en: Then he sent them to tell about God's kingdom and to heal the sick.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ibrahimma yɛtɔɣa maa naai ka ŋmaligi, ka Ibrahimma gba daa ŋmaligi kuli.
en: When the LORD finished speaking with Abraham, he left; but Abraham stayed there in that place.

dag: Ka naa maa yɛli ba, M pun lo n suhu ni ni n chɛ ka yinim n-yɛli ma zahindi maa, ka lan wuhi maa di gbinni. Yi yi ku tooi niŋ lala, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋmahiŋmahi ya chɛrachɛra, ka chɛ ka bɛ wurim yi yinsi.
en: The king said to them, I have made up my mind that you must tell me the dream and then tell me what it means. If you can't, I'll have you torn limb from limb and make your houses a pile of ruins.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpil shɛli din daŋ tooni ti Naawuni yi be kasi, dindina bɔrɔbɔro maa zaa ni be kasi. Ka tia nyaɣa yi be kasi, di wula gba ni be kasi.
en: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kawana ʒili bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: They loaded their grain onto their donkeys, and they set out.

dag: Mali yaa mini suhukpeeni pam; dama a ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ chaŋ ti di tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima alikauli ni n ni zaŋ li ti ba la fali.
en: Joshua, you must be strong and brave! You must lead these people so that they can take their land. I promised their fathers that I would give them this land.

dag: Nandaamba ni ti di n-tiɣi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ni paɣ o. Naawuni chɛ ka yi kul tɔŋdi sahakam.
en: The poor will eat as much as they want; those who come to the Lord will praise him. May they prosper forever!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord told Moses:.

dag: Nyama, a nya Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni shɛm vol la ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka n niriba shɛb di yɛli ni n kum a, amaa ka man lee tilig a. N di yɛlimi, Man ku zaŋ n nuu shihi n dana, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni.
en: You can see for yourself that the Lord gave me the chance to catch you in the cave today. Some of my men wanted to kill you, but I wouldn't let them do it. I told them, I will not harm the Lord 's chosen king.

dag: Yiliyiiniba daŋ ni: Ɛliashib. Dunɔguliba daŋ ni: Shallum mini Tɛlɛm ni Uri.
en: Eliashib Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

dag: N yi daa niŋ salima yɛda bee n-niŋ salima din viɛla naani.
en: I have never trusted in riches.

dag: Di ni ti leei dabari m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din pun leei dabari sunsuuni, ka di fɔntinsi ni ti pahi fɔntin shɛŋa din pun lu n-dahim ni.
en: Egypt will join the other countries that were destroyed. Its cities will be among those that are in ruins.

dag: ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Amaria ba, ka Amaria nyɛ Ahitub ba.
en: Meraioth of Amariah, Amariah of Ahitub.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni cheechi din be Kɔrinti mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be Akaia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: Greetings from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. I am an apostle because that is what God wanted. Greetings also from Timothy our brother in Christ. To Gods church in Corinth and to all of Gods holy people throughout Achaia.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa chani Bɛtɛl ti jɛmdi salima naɣibil din be nimaani la; ka shɛb mi chani hal Dan nti jɛmdi salima naɣibil ŋun la. Ka niriba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa leeg alahichi.
en: The people sinned because they started going to these places to worship.

dag: O daa lan wurim dagɔra du shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛli paɣiba ni daa wuɣiri Ashɛra jɛmbu binyɛra la.
en: He had the buildings torn down where the male prostitutes lived next to the temple, and where the women wove sacred robes for the idol of Asherah.

dag: Jɛrigu ku tooi baŋ li; ka ŋun ka laasabu ku tooi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Ignorant people dont know— fools dont understand this.

dag: Bɛna ka n suhir a tira; m bi suhir a tirila dunianima. A ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma maa ka n suhir a tira, dama bɛ nyɛla a niriba.
en: I pray for them. I do not pray for the world but for those you gave me, for they belong to you.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchinima; din kul ka buchi mi din ka buchinima! Di zaa shiri ka buchi.
en: Everything is so meaningless. The Teacher says that it is all a waste of time!.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o ku dih o bihi vi o niriba sunsuuni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mal o ka o be kasi.
en: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord , and I have chosen you.

dag: Makiri paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maaka la daa dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Pɛrɛsh. O mabia yuli n-daa booni Shɛrɛsh; o mi mabihi yuya n-daa booni Ulam mini Rɛkɛm.
en: Maacah, Machir's wife, gave birth to two sons, whom they named Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh had two sons, Ulam and Rakem.

dag: Amaa zom yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu mini dɔɣirikpamba yuya yɛla ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni zabili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni zaligu yɛla polo, dama di nyɛla yoli ni din ka buchi.
en: But avoid stupid arguments, long lists of ancestors, quarrels, and fights about the Law. They are useless and worthless.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ soli maa, mani n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, mani n-lan nyɛ nyɛvili; ka so ku tooi chaŋ m Ba sani, ka pa ni o paala mani.
en: Jesus answered, I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ, ka daa piig o biŋkɔbiri maa ni shɛb ni o ti o biɛli Iso.
en: After Jacob had spent the night there, he chose some animals as gifts for Esau:.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yuuni dunia tarisi, ka nyari binshɛɣukam din be sagbana tiŋli.
en: he alone sees everything beneath the heavens.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim faai ka chɛ a. Kul gbibi yɛm maŋli mini tɛhi wɔɣila.
en: My son, dont ever let wisdom out of your sight. Hold on to wisdom and careful planning.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, n yi yɔhi yi gbala, ka yihi ya yi gbala maa ni na, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and raise you up from your graves, my people.

dag: Lala ka yi ni shɛb daa be. Amaa ka Naawuni daa paɣi yi daalahichi bahi, ka mali ya ka yi be kasi. Ka yi leei wuntizɔriba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli mini Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: In the past some of you were like that. But you were washed clean, you were made holy, and you were made right with God in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ tin shɛli yi ni yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, said to me, Jeremiah, the people are saying that war, starvation, and disease will make this city fall into the hands of the king of Babylonia. Now listen to what else I have to say.

dag: Ka yi ni diri biŋkɔb so kam yi kpi, ŋunkam shihi zaɣ kpiŋ maa ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If any animal that may be eaten dies, anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu kam nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, o nyɛla nyɔtaɣirigu n-taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe o yuli.
en: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.

dag: Dama bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka bɛ yihi ya yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya tahi katiŋa. N ni kari ya bahi ka yi ti kpi.
en: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.

dag: Naawuni duya nti ʒini o nam ʒiishee ni tahigu. Yawɛ duya ni kikaa kumsi.
en: The Lord God goes up to his throne at the sound of the trumpet and horn.

dag: Mɔri yi ti naai, ka mɔ pala bili, di saha ka bɛ chɛri zoya ni mɔri sɔŋda.
en: When the grass goes away, new growth appears, and the plants of the hills are gathered.

dag: Zaŋm bindira balibu kam gba n-niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka di ti nyɛ a mini ba bindirigu.
en: Take along all kinds of food for you and for them.

dag: Zaŋm a bindirigu bahi kom ni, dama di yi niŋ daba ayi, di ni lan lab a sanna yaha.
en: Send your bread out on the water because, in the course of time, you may find it again.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n naan zaŋ li buɣi m bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, n naan zaŋ li pili kaman nam zuɣupiligu la.
en: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛkab bia Jɔnadab kul ku kɔŋ bidibiga ŋun ni jɛmdi ma sahakam. .
en: the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel proclaims: Jonadab, Rechabs son, will always have a descendant that stands before me.

dag: Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinima n-zani Anabi Musa zaashee;.
en: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law are experts in the Law of Moses.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi pam dini daa bi guura; ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa laɣisi biɛla dini mi daa bi poor o.
en: As it is written, The one who gathered more didnt have too much, and the one who gathered less didnt have too little. .

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmannim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la. Ka o daa ŋmaligi chaŋ ka chɛ ba.
en: How evil and godless are the people of this day! You ask me for a miracle? No! The only miracle you will be given is the miracle of Jonah. So he left them and went away.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa tim ti boli Ɛliab bihi, Datan mini Abiram. Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ku kana.
en: Then Moses called Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But the two men said, We will not come!.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ di ma shɛhira ni n daa yɛliya ni pa mani n-nyɛ Masia maa, amaa Naawuni n-tim ma ni n daŋ o tooni na.
en: You yourselves heard me say, I am not the Messiah. I am only the one God sent to prepare the way for him.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔhi tɔto shɛli maa ti ba naai, n ni doli yi yi sanna gari chaŋ Speen.
en: I am going to Jerusalem to make sure the poor get this money that has been given for them. After I finish that, I will leave for Spain and stop to visit you on the way.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni, dama ŋun sani bɛ zaa kul bemi.
en: He isnt the God of the dead but of the living. To him they are all alive.

dag: Di chɛ ka di yi a sani, gbibi li a suhu ni.
en: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri diri ma shɛhira biɛri, ka wuhi ni n tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa, ka n ʒi di yɛla.
en: Evil people testify against me and accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.

dag: Bɛ muɣisigu maa saha, bɛ ni ti nya sɔŋsim biɛla, hal ka niriba pam ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali bɛ ni la yɔhiŋgu zuɣu.
en: While the killing is going on, God's people will receive a little help, even though many who join them will do so for selfish reasons.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa yɛli, Ŋun be tooni zɔrina maa ŋmanila Zadok bia Ahimaaz. Ka naa daa yɛli, O nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ, dinzuɣu lahibali suŋ ka o ʒirina maa.
en: The watchman said, I think the first man runs like Ahimaaz son of Zadok. The king said, Ahimaaz is a good man, he must be bringing good news.

dag: Bani so mi daŋ ni: Maadai mini Amiram ni Uɛl.
en: Clan of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel, Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi, Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka bɛ chirigi Sairiini nira ŋun yuli booni Saimɔn, ka bɛ gbaag o ti muɣis o n-zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li.
en: The soldiers were going out of the city with Jesus. They saw a man from Cyrene named Simon, and they forced him to carry Jesus cross.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ zim viɛlli mali bɔrɔbɔro kpil pinaayi. Zaŋm zim kilɔgiram yini m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpilli kam.
en: Take twenty-four pounds of flour and bake twelve loaves of bread.

dag: N di yuya ni o be n sani n-zan a zaani n-sɔŋdi ma n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: I would like to keep him here with me, while I am in prison for the gospel's sake, so that he could help me in your place.

dag: Tola kum nyaaŋa, ka Jair ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la gba daa leei Izraɛlnim sariakarita yuun pisinaayi.
en: The next leader of Israel was Jair, who lived in Gilead. He was a leader for years.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka o zaŋ ya leeg o niriba zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka leei yi Naawuni kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli ni kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu shɛm la.
en: That means the Lord will make you his own people right now—he will be your God just as he promised you and just as he swore to our ancestors: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Man Nɛbukadnɛza daa ʒila n yiŋ baalim, ka n nyamma kul pahira n nam yili maa puuni.
en: I was enjoying a time of peace and prosperity.

dag: Daadamnim mi lee nyɛ bɔ ka ni tooi be kasi? Bee bɛn nyɛ paɣ ni dɔɣi shɛb ŋɔ, wula ka bɛ yɛn tooi niŋ nyɛ wuntizɔriba?.
en: Can any human being be really pure? Can anyone be right with God?.

dag: m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana tuma zuɣulaannim tusaata ni kɔbisita shɛb bɛn daa lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma la.
en: and he placed , foremen in charge of them to supervise their work.

dag: Nuhu yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbisiyɔbu saha shɛli kom ni daa di dunia maa.
en: Noah was years old when the floodwaters arrived on earth.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zali ba zaligu yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim bɛn ti ka tuma ni na Vuhim Dabisili dali pirigibu buta zuɣu yim n-yɛn guli nayili.
en: and gave them the following orders: When you come on duty on the Sabbath, one third of you are to guard the palace;.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ yuli jilima din simd o, zaŋmiya pina ka o jɛmbu duu na!.
en: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.

dag: Di galisim mini di wula wɔɣilim zuɣu daa chɛ ka di viɛla, dama di nyaɣa daa chaŋmi ti kpe kom pam ni.
en: How beautiful the tree was— So tall, with such long branches. Its roots reached down to the deep-flowing streams.

dag: Yi ni sab gbaŋ shɛli ti ma la, bɛ lɛbigi li karim wuhi ma.
en: The letter you sent us has been translated and read to me.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli ni maa zuɣu! Di chɛ ka alibarika be m ma ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa ni!.
en: Curse the day I was born! Forget the day my mother gave me birth!.

dag: Ninsal tɛha n-wuhir o soli, amaa Yawɛ n-wuhir o o ni yɛn chani shɛm.
en: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.

dag: Mɔabnim daa zaŋla piɛbila n-yi Sɛla din be tiŋgban nɛli polo la kana ti ti ŋun diri nam ʒi Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: You people should send a gift to the king of the land. You should send a lamb from Sela, through the desert, to the mountain in the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ba, M bɔri ni n ŋahi ya la ŋahili, ka yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni zaŋ chaŋ amiliya chuɣu daba ayopɔin ŋɔ dali, n ni tin ya silinchi kpar suma pihita mini binyɛr sun shɛŋa din nyɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra.
en: Samson told the young men, This party will last for seven days. Let's make a bet: I'll tell you a riddle, and if you can tell me the answer before the party is over, I'll give each of you a shirt and a full change of clothing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa vihi yɛlli maa n-nya ka bɛ ni wum shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ niriba ayi maa n-zaŋ ba yili dasara. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ sab yɛlli maa yɛla niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛlikura litaafi ni o ninni.
en: King Xerxes learned that Mordecai's report was true, and he had the two men hanged. Then the king had all of this written down in his record book as he watched.

dag: Salima beni ka kuɣ viɛla pam din mali shaara beni, amaa noli din tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa n-nyɛ binshɛli din viɛl gari di zaa.
en: If you know what you are talking about, you have something more valuable than gold or jewels.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Yi bɔri ni n yihila Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ bahi.
en: Pilate answered them, Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayi dali zaŋmiya naɣilabihi pinaayi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the second day: twelve bulls from the herd, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: Amaa tarimba ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka tɔŋ pam, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But the weak will inherit the land; they will enjoy a surplus of peace.

dag: Ka Lidanim mini Sharɔnnim zaa daa nya doo maa, ka niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: Everyone who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.

dag: Nir nyamma yi pahi, bɛn diri li gba pahirimi. Ka di nyɔri nyɛ dini ŋun su li sani m-pahila o nini n-kul yɛn nya li?.
en: The richer you are, the more mouths you have to feed. All you gain is the knowledge that you are rich.

dag: O daa me li la goonda kpɛma, ka zali sapashin kpamba tinsi maa ni, ka daa me bindira kambɔna mini kpam ni wain ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni tinsi maa ni.
en: When Rehoboam made these cities strong, he put commanders in them. He also put supplies of food, oil, and wine in them.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di tamya bin yini din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti Duuma sani, dahin yini nyɛla kaman yuun tuhili, ka yuun tuhili mi nyɛ kaman dahin yini.
en: Dont let it escape your notice, dear friends, that with the Lord a single day is like a thousand years and a thousand years are like a single day.

dag: Ka bɛn be tooni tahir o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: The people who were in front leading the group criticized the blind man. They told him to be quiet. But he shouted more and more, Son of David, please help me.

dag: Yi daalahichi zaɣisibu moli mɔbu puuni bɛ na bi yihi yi ni so ʒim ku o.
en: In your struggle against sin, you havent resisted yet to the point of shedding blood.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yiniyini pahi piɛlabih ayopɔin la zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and cups with each lamb.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, o yi zaŋla salima bee anzinfa bee kuɣ viɛla bee dari bee mɔri bee kaɣa me.
en: People can build on that foundation using gold, silver, jewels, wood, grass, or straw.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni tia maa gbini gbihi. Ka malaika daa shih o ka yɛl o, Yiɣisim di bindirigu.
en: He lay down and slept under the solitary broom bush. Then suddenly a messenger tapped him and said to him, Get up! Eat something.

dag: Ka kpa shɛli din na kpalim be maligumaana maa nuu ni maa, o zaŋm li ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa naanyi mali sanyoo sara ti dilana Yawɛ tooni.
en: He will put the oil that is left in his palm on the head of the person to be made clean. In this way he will make that person pure before the Lord .

dag: Ka o yɛli Yisa, N dana, wuhim ma o ni nyɛ so, ka n niŋ o yɛda.
en: The man answered, Tell me who he is, sir, so that I can believe in him.

dag: Doo bee paɣa yi mali dalima o niŋgbuŋ ni ka di nyɛ zaɣ piɛla.
en: Whenever a man or woman has many white shiny spots on their skin.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Yawɛ kul lari ba. A nyɛla ŋun maani zuliya kam zaa ansarisi.
en: But you laugh at them, Lord ; you mock all the heathen.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn gbaag omaŋmaŋ naɣikpahi ni naɣinyaŋ bee naɣilaa m-mali suhudoo sara maligu, di simdi ka o zaŋla naɣ so ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa ti Yawɛ.
en: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: and the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna naanyi kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti yeeg o ni ye neempiɛl shɛŋa kpe luɣ kasi shee maa sɔŋ nimaani.
en: Then Aaron shall go into the Tent, take off the priestly garments that he had put on before entering the Most Holy Place, and leave them there.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o suhu ni, Pumpɔŋɔ Sool ni ti bahi ku ma dahin shɛli. N lan ka n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm pahila n zo n-kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka Sool yihi n shee bɔbu tahima Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: David thought, One day I will be destroyed by Sauls power. The best thing for me to do is to escape to Philistine territory. Then Saul will give up looking for me in Israelite territory, and I will escape his power.

dag: Yisa ni daa yiɣisi ni n-chaŋ naai ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kul gbaag o nol ni luɣisibu ni di chɛ ka o yɛli din bie.
en: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things.

dag: Di sabiya yaha, Ŋunkam yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ.
en: It was also said, Any man who divorces his wife must give her a written notice of divorce.

dag: Ŋunkam nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋbia mini ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ tinzun nira m-be bɛ sani zaa, zaligu yini maa ka a yɛn zali bɛ ni ŋun chirim.
en: The same regulation applies to all who unintentionally commit a sin, whether they are native Israelites or resident foreigners.

dag: Nyini n-nam ba, ka bɛ beni, ka zooi n-dɔɣi bihi, ka a yɛla kul be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee be katiŋ ni nyini.
en: You have put these wicked people here like plants with strong roots. They grow and produce fruit. With their mouths they say that you are near and dear to them, but in their hearts they are really far away from you.

dag: Yi pun lan wum ka di sab yɛli, So yi fɔɣ a nini, a gba nyin fɔɣim o dini labisi, ka so yi ŋme n-kab a nyini, a gba nyin ŋmɛm kab o dini labisi.
en: You have heard that it was said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Faashee Daadam Bia nya wahala pam, ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa ti zaɣis o, ka chɛ ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: He said, The Human Onemust suffer many things and be rejected—by the elders, chief priests, and the legal experts—and be killed and be raised on the third day.

dag: Ka Abijam daa ti leei ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Abijam died and was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Asa became king.

dag: Yi yi di niŋ Anabi Musa yɛda, yi naan niŋ n gba yɛda, dama o daa sabi n yɛla zali.
en: If you really believed Moses, you would believe me, because he wrote about me.

dag: Suhim ma ka n zaŋ zuliya kam zaa ti a ka a su ba; ka dunia ŋɔ zaa leeg a ni su shɛli.
en: Ask, and I will give you all the nations; the whole earth will be yours.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi teeku ni, ka di niŋ kaman kpim ʒim la, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku maa ni kpi.
en: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.

dag: Ti ni daa paai yiŋa, ti daa zaŋ nyini n dan ni daa yɛli shɛm maa yɛli ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa.
en: When we went back to my father your servant, we told him what you said.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara n-yo o min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli.
en: Then he will offer the bull for the sin offering. This sin offering is for himself. He will do this to purify himself and his family.

dag: ka tim a ba min a ma jilima; ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: you must respect your father and mother, and love your neighbor the same as you love yourself. .

dag: O daa lan me Baalat mini ŋun Sulemaana nɛma ni daa be tin shɛŋa ni zaa, ni o wɔribariba chɛchɛbunsi min o ni daa be tin shɛŋa ni. O daa lan me ŋun Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛŋa zaa Jɛrusalɛm mini Lɛbanɔn ni o ni daa su tin shɛŋa zaa la ni.
en: He did the same thing to the town of Baalath and to the cities where he kept supplies, chariots, and horses. Solomon ordered his workers to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere else in his kingdom.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli Pita, Labisim takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni! Ka bɔh o, N di nyu pipi shɛli m Ba ni zaŋ ti ma la ni binnyurigu maa.
en: Jesus said to Peter, Put your sword back in its place! I must drink from the cup the Father has given me.

dag: Ka din pah ata gbaai Zakur min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the third to Zaccur, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Izraɛlnim gula, wummi ti suhigu; nyin ŋun mali Yisifu zuliya chani kaman piɛri la, wummi ti suhigu. Nyin ŋun ʒi a nam ʒiishee din be chɛrubinim zuɣu la, chɛ ka a neesim neei.
en: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim maa sunsuuni; ka yi daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa vuri, amaa ka lee bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, kukoli kɔŋko n-daa kul beni.
en: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.

dag: O suhu daa yiɣisiya, ka o lan je ma, ka dari tɔhi ma. O daa dim o nyina ni niŋ ma. O mirig o nina niŋ ma kaman o dima n-nyɛ ma la.
en: In anger God tears me limb from limb; he glares at me with hate.

dag: Dindali maa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa zaŋ Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim maa yiŋa n-ti Napaɣiba kpɛm Ɛsta. Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli naa ni Mɔdɛkai nyɛla o dɔɣim. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Mɔdɛkai nya soli kpɛri naa sani.
en: That same day King Xerxes gave Queen Esther everything that belonged to Haman, the enemy of the Jews. Esther told the king that Mordecai was her cousin. Then Mordecai came to see the king.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Shaaf ŋun daa nyɛ Madimanna ba la mini Shɛva ŋun daa nyɛ Makibɛna mini Gibia ba la. Kalɛb bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ Akisa.
en: She also gave birth to Shaaph, Madmannahs father; and to Sheva, Machbenah and Gibeas father. Calebs daughter was Achsah.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Ti noya ni yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali nyari ti ni bɔri shɛlikam. Ti noya maa mi kul be ti sani, ka ŋuni n-leei nyɛ ti duuma.
en: They say to themselves, We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.

dag: Gbib a tima min a tabibi tima maa. A bilim ni ha ka a pun mal li tumdi tuma. Di pa shɛli di ni sɔŋ a bee di pa shɛli di ni kpɛh a dimnim dabiɛm.
en: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!.

dag: Ka a boli Jɛsi ka o ka sara maligu maa shee na, ka n ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka a ti booi kpam maa bahi n ni yɛn wuh a ninvuɣ so maa zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will tell you what to do. You will anoint as king the man I tell you to.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, Hal a kul lihiya ni a pɔri maa zaa yoli, pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya zaa zuɣulana? Yawɛ n-daa booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa.
en: Samuel answered, Even though you consider yourself of no importance, you are the leader of the tribes of Israel. The Lord anointed you king of Israel.

dag: N kul dolila a soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: My steps are set firmly on your paths; my feet havent slipped.

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka ŋmaligi yɛli wain tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Next they asked the grape vine, Will you be our king.

dag: Amaa m mi a ni ʒiini shɛm min a ni yiri shɛm ni a ni labiri kpɛri shɛm ni a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu shɛm yɛla.
en: I know where you live, how you go out and come in, and how you rage against me.

dag: Yawɛ, teemi Dauda yɛla, ka teeg o ni daa di wahala shɛŋa la zaa yɛla.
en: Lord , do not forget David and all the hardships he endured.

dag: Musa daa yi zaŋdila suɣili maa nti tiri zaani kpaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ sansani maa. O daa booni li la Yawɛ chirigibu shee, ka ŋunkam daa yi bɔri ni o bɔhi Yawɛ baŋ shɛli, o chanila Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini sansani maa kpaŋ maa ha.
en: Whenever the people of Israel set up camp, Moses would take the sacred Tent and put it up some distance outside the camp. It was called the Tent of the Lord 's presence, and anyone who wanted to consult the Lord would go out to it.

dag: Dama bɛ niŋ a ni pun darigi ninvuɣ shɛb tibili alaka; ka nahind a ni ti shɛb dansi la pahira.
en: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.

dag: Man Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti kpimsi Ɛdom yɛnnima; ka kpimsi Iso Zoli zuɣunim baŋsim.
en: On the day I punish Edom, I will destroy their clever men and wipe out all their wisdom.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N ni be m biɛhigu shee ka lihina baalim kaman maligim ni lurina yuŋ kachɛɣu saha shɛm ni kaman biisim ni be wuntaŋ ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord said, I will be in the place prepared for me. I will quietly watch these things happen: On a beautiful summer day, at noon, people will be resting.

dag: ka n suhu paligi pam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ ni.
en: my soul is glad because of God my Savior.

dag: Zaŋm o ti lih o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a niŋ o zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa niŋm o ni yɛl a ni a niŋmi shɛli.
en: Find Jeremiah and take care of him. Dont hurt him. Give him whatever he asks for.

dag: ni Azaria. Azaria daa nyɛla Hilikia bia, ka Hilikia nyɛ Mɛshulam bia, ka Mɛshulam nyɛ Zadok bia, ka Zadok nyɛ Mɛrayɔt bia, ka Mɛrayɔt nyɛ Ahitub bia. Ahitub daa nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣulana.
en: and Azariah son of Hilkiah son of Meshullam son of Zadok son of Meraioth son of Ahitub the leader of Gods house.

dag: Ka Keen yɛli Yawɛ, N tibidarigibo maa galisiya gari ma.
en: Then Cain said to the Lord , This punishment is more than I can bear!.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri din nyɛ salima bee anzinfa, hal di zaŋya kɔbo gba n-niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: Dont carry any money with you—gold or silver or copper.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, M bihi, n ku lan yuui yi sani. Yi ni ti bo ma kɔŋ; n ni daa yɛli Yɛhudianim shɛm la, lala ka n yɛri yi gba maa, n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, You cannot go where I am going.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi. Amaa m bɔri ni ninvuɣ biɛri niŋla tuuba ka be, dama yinim Izraɛlnima, bɔzuɣu ka yi lee yɛn kpi.
en: Tell them that as surely as I, the Sovereign Lord , am the living God, I do not enjoy seeing sinners die. I would rather see them stop sinning and live. Israel, stop the evil you are doing. Why do you want to die?.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Musa daa ʒini ni o mali niriba yɛla, ka niriba maa daa ʒe n-gili Musa asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: The next morning Moses sat down at the place where he decided legal cases for the people, and everyone crowded around him until evening.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti tim Kɛdɛshi din be Naftali tiŋgban ni la ti boli Barak Abinɔam bia na ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛli nyin Barak, Cham ti laɣim a niriba Tabo Zoli zuɣu m-pii ninvuɣ tuhi pia Naftali mini Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba ni.
en: One day she sent for Barak son of Abinoam from the city of Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, The Lord , the God of Israel, has given you this command: Take ten thousand men from the tribes of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead them to Mount Tabor.

dag: Kum yi mali so, ŋun dim yiŋ pɔi ka di chɛ ka yi ku nya tibidarigibo yi laɣiŋgu ni. Zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa din kpalim polo, n yi ti kana, n ni wuhi ya di gba yɛla.
en: And if any of you are hungry, you should eat at home, so that you will not come under God's judgment as you meet together. As for the other matters, I will settle them when I come.

dag: dama ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi yi alahichi dabitim ni.
en: because a person who has died has been freed from sins power.

dag: Amaa ka bɛna bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim maa daa ti niŋ karimbaani mini tipawumli n-zaɣis a zaligunim maa dolibu.
en: But our ancestors acted arrogantly. They were stubborn and wouldnt obey your commandments.

dag: Dinzuɣu lzraɛlnima, baŋmiya ni Yisa so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu maa ka Naawuni zaŋ leei dunia ŋɔ nim zaa Duuma ni bɛ Masia.
en: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: The Philistines came and camped in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi maa zuliya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yɛla m-bala. Bɛ ni ka zuliya kam yina n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ zaa, kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa.
en: These are the clans of Noahs sons according to their generations and their nations. From them the earths nations branched out after the flood.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani maa na.
en: she said: You were sent here by King Josiah, and this is what the Lord God of Israel says to him:.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ mani m-pii duu ŋɔ m-mal li ka di be kasi ni di chɛ ka yi jɛmdi ma di puuni ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka n ni chɛ ka n zaɣa be di ni ka lan yuuni li sahakam.
en: because I have chosen this temple and declared it holy so that my name may be there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

dag: M bi lan yɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ, dama n labirila a sanna, amaa bɛn kul ni beni. M Ba Suŋ, gbib ba a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka bɛ leei zaɣ yini kaman m min a ni nyɛ zaɣ yini shɛm.
en: Im no longer in the world, but they are in the world, even as Im coming to you. Holy Father, watch over them in your name, the name you gave me, that they will be one just as we are one.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Yes, I've heard all that before. But how can a human being win a case against God?.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni.
en: We are so sure of this hope that we can speak very openly.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim gba nyɛla yɛnnim yɛtɔɣa: Nimmira yɛlimaŋli tibu saria karibu bi viɛla.
en: The wise have also said these things: It is wrong for judges to be prejudiced.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa kana ti tuhi Judanima.
en: At that time the Lord sent King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah to fight against Judah.

dag: N zaŋla yurilim din bi naari gbibi niriba tuhilituhili ka chɛri bɛ tuumbiɛri mini bɛ biriginsim ni bɛ daalahichi taali, amaa ka darigiri ninvuɣ biɛri bihi tibili mini bɛ yaansi tibili zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmana din pahir ata mini anahi ni.
en: I keep my promises to my people forever, but I also punish anyone who sins. When people sin, I punish them and their children, and also their grandchildren and great-grandchildren.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la mini ti mabia Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: Greetings from Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. I am an apostle because that is what God wanted. Greetings also from Timothy, our brother in Christ.

dag: Yawɛ di tam o ba tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka di kpihim o ma daalahichi.
en: May the Lord remember the evil of his ancestors and never forgive his mother's sins.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛra, Ti ni bi ʒi bɔrɔbɔro la na zuɣu m-bala.
en: The followers discussed the meaning of this. They said, Did Jesus say this because we forgot to bring bread.

dag: Tiŋ maa dunoya ti ku yɔri wuntaŋ ni, ka yuŋ mi ti ku zibiri nimaani.
en: The citys gates will never close on any day, because there is no night there.

dag: Izraɛl paɣ bia ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ijipti do so daa doli Izraɛlnim maa chana, ka Izraɛl paɣ bia maa mini Izraɛl doo daa ti zabi bɛ sansani maa ni.
en: The son of an Israelite mother and an Egyptian father came out among the Israelites. A fight broke out between this half-Israelite and another Israelite man in the camp.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yina dabisili din pah ayi maa dali ti lu Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika; ka bɛ zaa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: That same day, Benjamin's soldiers came out of Gibeah and attacked, leaving another , Israelite soldiers dead on the battlefield.

dag: A ni daa na bi kɔhi li la, pa nyini n-daa su li? Ka a ni kɔhi li maa, pa nyini n-na kul su di liɣiri maa? Ka bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tɛha ŋɔ tatabo kpɛh a suhu ni? Ka yɛl o, Pa ninsalinim ka a ŋma ʒiri maa, amaa Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: Before you sold the property, it belonged to you; and after you sold it, the money was yours. Why, then, did you decide to do such a thing? You have not lied to people—you have lied to God.

dag: O ni daa ti yi ŋariŋ maa ni duri duli, ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu yi tiŋ maa puuni tuhir o sol na; o daa chɛ situra yɛbu ka di yuui, o mi daa bi gbɛri yiŋa; gbal kaba ni ka o daa kul gbɛra.
en: As Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a man from the town who had demons in him. For a long time this man had gone without clothes and would not stay at home, but spent his time in the burial caves.

dag: Yɛlim daba la gba ni bɛ deemi bɛ duumanim noya, ka tumdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini binshɛɣukam zaa puuni; ka di ŋmɛri ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi m-mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: The people who have some understanding will be given more. And they will have even more than they need. But those who do not have much understanding will lose even the little understanding that they have.

dag: N ni daa kul be Izraɛlnim zaa sani n-chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa la, n daa mi n-bɔhi Izraɛl zuɣulaannim shɛb n ni daa pii ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la ni so, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me yili ti ma? .
en: In all my traveling with the people of Israel I never asked any of the leaders that I appointed why they had not built me a temple made of cedar.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri yi zuɣu la yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni vuui n ni zaŋ n suhuyiɣisili binnyuri shɛli tin ya la. Yi ku lan nyu li n suhuyiɣisili pipia maa ni n-chani laana.
en: The LORD, your Lord and your God, who contends for his people, says: Look, I have taken the cup of reeling, the goblet of my wrath, from your hand. You will no longer drink from it.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o ma Mariama, Nyama, Izraɛlnim pam ni ti lula bia ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɛ pam mi ti yiɣisila o zuɣu. O lan nyɛla shihir shɛli niriba ni ni ti tɔɣisi jɛndi.
en: Simeon blessed them and said to Mary his mother, This boy is assigned to be the cause of the falling and rising of many in Israel and to be a sign that generates opposition.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa ʒini bɛ tinsi ni naai nyaaŋa, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka niriba maa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm naŋgban yini.
en: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ Shunɛm ka paɣ bundaan so daa be nimaani m-balim o ni o dim bindirigu. Dinzuɣu o daa yi ti doli nimaani polo saha shɛlikam, o kpɛrila yili maa ni ti diri bindirigu.
en: Once, while Elisha was in the town of Shunem, he met a rich woman who invited him to her home for dinner. After that, whenever he was in Shunem, he would have a meal there with her and her husband.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari. A shiri nyɛla pu shɛli din dunoli kpari ni kɔbil nini din ŋari.
en: My sweetheart, my bride, is a secret garden, a walled garden, a private spring;.

dag: Yi daa lo ma la zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li leei zaɣ suŋ ni di chɛ ka niriba pam ti tiligi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You plotted evil against me, but God turned it into good, in order to preserve the lives of many people who are alive today because of what happened.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhu ni, Zuliyanim ŋɔ galisiya gari ti, wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari ba.
en: You may be thinking, How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa zaa ni daa yiri tiŋ maa ni, bɛ daa zanila yili shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: As the king and all his men were leaving the city, they stopped at the last house.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti shiri niŋ o ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The followers went and did what Jesus told them to do.

dag: O yoom ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ o polo ka ti dol o soya, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zali ti yaannim la.
en: I pray that we will turn to him and follow him. Then we will obey all the laws, decisions, and commands that he gave our ancestors.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa ka n sanna ti wum n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni wuhi ya o ni ŋmani so.
en: The people who come to me, who listen to my teachings and obey them—I will show you what they are like:.

dag: Ka doo maa daa yɛli Ɛli, Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yi tɔb maa tuhibu shee n-zo m-paai kpe na zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Ka Ɛli bɔh o, M bia, tɔb maa be wula.
en: The man said, I have escaped from the battle and have run all the way here today. Eli asked him, What happened, my son.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N daa yihila liɣiri pam da Rom tiŋbitali. Ka Pool yɛl o, Bɛ kul dɔɣila mani Rom tiŋbia.
en: The commander then said, I paid a lot of money to become a Roman citizen. But Paul replied, I was born a Roman citizen.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ti fali ti saamba, ka zaŋ ti yiya ti tinzunnima.
en: Our property is in the hands of strangers; foreigners are living in our homes.

dag: Ijipti naa ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa o sapashinnim ni yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o, ka ni ti di nam din galisi.
en: Then the southern king will gain power, but one of his princes will overpower him, ruling in his place. His empire will be vast.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya maa n-tahi ti ti tiŋ ŋɔ ni gomna Amɔn mini naa bia Jɔash.
en: Then King Ahab ordered one of his officers, Arrest Micaiah and take him to Amon, the governor of the city, and to Prince Joash.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim daa yɛli nabihi mini niriba maa zaa, Doo ŋɔ simdi kubu, dama o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi ya ŋɔ ka yi zaa wum li.
en: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu bihi mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ni bɛ ti da bindira maa, dama kum maa daa lula Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni gba.
en: So Jacob's sons joined others from Canaan who were going to Egypt because of the terrible famine.

dag: Sulemaana daa piila zuɣulaannim pinaayi ni bɛ su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa. Bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ bɔri bindira na nti tiri ŋun naa min o yiŋnima, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yi sula bindira maa bɔbu goli yiniyini yuuni kam puuni.
en: Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel. They supplied the king and his palace with food. Each would provide the supplies for one month per year.

dag: Dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: When the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt.

dag: Dama n ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni, ka yɛligi yi tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka so ti ku niŋ yi tiŋgbani maa kɔre.
en: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ mali ti paai ko shɛli, ka namɔɣili maa yɛl o, Nyam kom ŋɔ! Bɔ n-lee ni chɛ ka n ku deei kom baptaizibu? .
en: While they were traveling down the road, they came to some water. The official said, Look, here is water! What is stopping me from being baptized.

dag: A zuɣulaannim nyɛla tipawumlinim mini tayiɣisi zɔnima. Bɛ zaa yuri birapu dibu ni faɣiri dibu. Bɛ bi sɔŋdi kpibisi bɛ saria dibu ni, ka bi saɣiri ka pakoya zaŋdi bɛ yɛlimuɣisira kani bɛ sanna.
en: Your princes are rebels, companions of thieves. Everyone loves a bribe and pursues gifts. They dont defend the orphan, and the widows cause never reaches them.

dag: Chɛ ka di kul be nyin Yawɛ tooni sahakam, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teeg o yɛla dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: May the Lord always remember their sins, but may they themselves be completely forgotten!.

dag: Yawɛ, so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A galisiya, ka a yuli tibisa, ka mali yiko.
en: Lord , there is no one like you; you are mighty, and your name is great and powerful.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. N daa kul timdila n daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim la bɛ sani waawaayili, amaa ka yi gba zaɣisi wumbu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: because they wouldnt listen to my words, declares the LORD, which I sent them time and again through my servants the prophets. They wouldnt listen, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka m mi ni o zaligu nyɛla din tiri nyɛvili din ka bahigu. Dinzuɣu n ni yɛri shɛlikam nyɛla m Ba ni wuhi ma ni n yɛli shɛm.
en: And I know that his command brings eternal life. What I say, then, is what the Father has told me to say.

dag: Amaa man ni yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣ a, ka mali sara jɛm a; ka pali n ni lo alikauli shɛli a sani. Tiliginsim yirila nyin Yawɛ sanna.
en: But me, I will offer a sacrifice to you with a voice of thanks. That which I have promised, I will pay. Deliverance belongs to the LORD.

dag: Naŋgban shɛli din ŋmari ʒiri je di ni ŋmari ʒiri pari shɛb maa, ka naŋgbammalisim tahiri saɣiŋgu na.
en: You have to hate someone to want to hurt him with lies. Insincere talk brings nothing but ruin.

dag: Yisa daa ti be o nyaandoliba tooni ka bɛ yi soli chani Jɛrusalɛm, ka di gar o nyaandoliba maa pam; ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛn zaa dol o maa. Ka o lan zaŋ bɛ pinaayi maa yi kpaŋa nti piligi wuhiri ba yɛl shɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ o.
en: Jesus and his disciples were on the road, going up to Jerusalem, with Jesus in the lead. The disciples were amazed while the others following behind were afraid. Taking the Twelve aside again, he told them what was about to happen to him.

dag: Ka o pii ninvuɣ pinaayi ni bɛ be o sani, ka o timdi ba ka bɛ ti yihiri waazu.
en: And he chose twelve men and called them apostles. He wanted these twelve men to be with him, and he wanted to send them to other places to tell people Gods message.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim maa daa bɔhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni shɛm ŋɔ? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: The teachers of the Law and the Pharisees began to say to themselves, Who is this man who speaks such blasphemy! God is the only one who can forgive sins.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma Baal binnan la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duu maa, ka zaŋ nimaani leei bimbɔɣili hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: They tore down Baals sacred pillar and destroyed Baals temple, turning it into a public restroom, which is what it still is today.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋa chaŋ ti ŋmaligi zolɔŋni n-tuhi Dauda min o niriba maa soli ka bɛ kanna.
en: As she was riding her donkey, going down a trail on the hillside, David and his soldiers appeared, descending toward her, and she met up with them.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ ni di wuhi ni n kɔŋla shɛli, dama m bɔhim ni n chɛ ka n nini tiɣi n ni mali shɛli.
en: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o, o niriba zaa sani.
en: I will give the Lord what I promised. I will go in front of all his people now.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri.
en: They were delighted and arranged payment for him.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, Yɛlimiy o: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la polo.
en: Go back to King Josiah of Judah, who sent you to ask what the Lord wants. Tell him, This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says about the words you heard being read:.

dag: Nir ni tooi yɛli ni Lɛvi ŋun daa deeri zaka la gba daa be ti yab Ibrahimma ni n-yihi zaka ti Mɛlikizɛdɛk;.
en: It could be said that Levi, who received a tenth, paid a tenth through Abraham.

dag: Yawɛ, kari doli ba ni suhuyiɣisili nti kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Chase them in anger and destroy them. Wipe them off the face of the earth, Lord !.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka kum ku bɛ bihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka bɛ paɣiba leei pakoya ni bɛn kɔŋ bɛ bihi. Chɛ ka alɔbo ku bɛ dɔbba, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ nachimba tɔbu ni.
en: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: When I destroyed the cities of Hamath and Arpad, where were their gods? What about the gods of Sepharvaim? Were any gods able to save Samaria from my power?.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti yi mɔɣu ni na zaawuni, ka Liya yi nti tuh o soli yɛl o, N yɛn kpɛla a sanna zuŋɔ, dama n zaŋla m bia ŋmaankpihiga yo a zuɣu. Ka Yaakubu min o daa dɔni dindali maa yuŋ.
en: Jacob came in from the fields that night. Leah saw him and went out to meet him. She said, You will sleep with me tonight. I have paid for you with my sons flowers. So Jacob slept with Leah that night.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, dindina pa n naba kɔŋko, amaa paɣimi n naba zaŋ tabili n nuhi ni n zuɣu zaa.
en: Simon Peter answered, Lord, do not wash only my feet, then! Wash my hands and head, too.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala o ni lo shɛm bee di pun bela o suhu ni, amaa o lola nia ni o saɣim ka kpihim zuliya pam birili.
en: But he has other plans; he schemes in secret; destruction is on his mind, extermination of nation after nation.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka bɛ nini baligi ka o deei Mɛtɛgama bɛ nuu ni.
en: Some time later King David attacked the Philistines again, defeated them, and ended their control over the land.

dag: ka lan ʒi laɣ shɛl na ni ti ti lan da bindira maa. Ti mi bi mi ŋun daa zaŋ ti liɣiri maa labisi niŋ ti kpalansi maa ni.
en: and weve brought down with us additional silver to buy food. We dont know who put our silver in our sacks.

dag: O yuli n-daa du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa, ka o leei bɛ kpɛma. Amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: Abishai was even more famous than the Three Heroes. He became their leader, even though he was not one of the Three Heroes.

dag: Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti zaŋ ti nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deem ti suhigu. Iin, nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka deei ti suhigu, ka a yi deei ti suhigu maa, nyin chɛl ti taali.
en: Listen to the request of your servant and your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Listen from your heavenly dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive!.

dag: Ka tiŋgban bihi din zaa be teeku sunsuuni daa vuui, ka zoya zaa gba vuui;.
en: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.

dag: Naa Sulemaana tumtumdiba daŋ niriba: Sɔtai daŋ niriba mini Sofɛrɛt daŋ niriba ni Pɛrida daŋ niriba.
en: These are the descendants of the servants of Solomon: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida.

dag: Ka hal binshɛli yi pili n-liri ti lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla, di pili n-liri li mi zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bahi yol la kɔŋko sani.
en: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are on the road to destruction.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti yɛn bahi yoli ŋɔ zuɣu, di simdi ni yi nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔnima? Di niŋ kamaata ni yi bebu be kasi, ka yi nyɛ bɛn luri Naawuni sizuura binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.

dag: N niriba, niŋmiy o o ni daa niŋ ya shɛm labisi, ka yɔny o o tuma samli siɣimsiɣim buyi! Niŋmiy o binnyurigu ka di to n-gari o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-tin ya la!.
en: Treat her exactly as she has treated you; pay her back double for all she has done. Fill her cup with a drink twice as strong as the drink she prepared for you.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ kura maa yi ti chaŋ yaɣi o ni zo n-kuli tiliginsim tin shɛli ni maa tiŋgbani tariga.
en: You must never go outside the limits of your city of safety. If you do and if a member of the dead persons family catches you and kills you, that family member will not be guilty of murder.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi.
en: Your hunger will be so great that you will eat your own children.

dag: A yi mali Lɛvinim maa kasi, ka zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa la, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni tooi kpe laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni ti tum tuma.
en: After you have purified and dedicated the Levites, they will be qualified to work in the Tent.

dag: Sool ni daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka kpi shɛm m-bala. O daa bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka bi doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka daa lan chaŋ ti buɣi baɣa m-bɔr sɔŋsim.
en: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the LORD and hadnt followed the LORDs word. He even consulted a medium for guidance.

dag: Amaa o daa jɛmdila o ba Naawuni ka dol o zaligunima, ka daa bi be kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa be shɛm la.
en: Instead, he sought the God of his father, and unlike Israel, he followed Gods commandments.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: So now shepherds, hear the LORDs word!.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya saha shɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: In the future, your children will ask you, What is the meaning of the laws, the regulations, and the case laws that the LORD our God commanded you.

dag: Zaŋm a ni daa da jinjɛŋŋma shɛli sɔri maa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti zaŋ li pi tampiŋ lɔŋni.
en: Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.

dag: To, mapuuni bih ayopɔin n-daa be, ka bikpɛm sani ti kpuɣi paɣa, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣ bia ka kpi.
en: There were seven brothers. The first brother married but died. He had no children.

dag: Puri dola zaɣ nɛya; ka tiŋgbani fabinda, dama bindira saɣimya zaa, ka wain naai, ka kpam gba lan kani.
en: The fields are ruined. Even the ground is crying because the grain is destroyed; the new wine is dried up, and the olive oil is gone.

dag: Niriba gaŋbu bi viɛla, amaa bindirigu biɛla zuɣu ni tooi chɛ ka nir tum gala.
