en: It is wrong for a judge to support someone simply because he knows them. But some judges will change their decisions for the price of a loaf of bread.

dag: Kurugu ŋmanila muriga o sani, ka daanya mi ŋmani da kpima.
en: For him iron is as flimsy as straw, and bronze as soft as rotten wood.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka sagbana yiri dunia tariga na. Ŋuna n-nam saa nyaɣisibu niŋ saa ni, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zal li luɣ shɛŋa na.
en: He brings storm clouds from the ends of the earth; he makes lightning for the storms, and he brings out the wind from his storeroom.

dag: Ka tuumba maa mini cheechi kpamba maa daa laɣim ni bɛ to yɛlli maa jina.
en: The apostles and the elders gathered to consider this matter.

dag: Kul doliya zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kɔŋko din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka ti ʒini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: Always be fair and just, so that you will occupy the land that the Lord your God is giving you and so that you will continue to live there.

dag: Dama zahimmiya: Bɔ n-lee kpalim? Yi yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga, lala ku niŋ? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am testing my people, and they can do nothing to stop me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka o ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam, dama o yɛtɔɣa maa daa nyɛla din mali yiko.
en: They were amazed at his teaching because he spoke with authority.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina. Ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣ yihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: I say if your wife has not committed some terrible sexual sin, you must not divorce her to marry someone else. If you do, you are unfaithful.

dag: ni Shamma mini Ɛlika bɛn daa yi Harɔd na la.
en: Shammah from Harod; Elika from Harod.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari n karimbanima, dama n kul tɛhirila a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti kuhi pam niŋ a, nyin wummi n kuhigu maa! Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka garigi ma!.
en: Lord , hear my voice. Be kind and answer me.

dag: N kuhirila pampam niŋdi Yawɛ. N kul suhirila Yawɛ pampam ni o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: I cry out to the Lord . I beg the Lord to help me.

dag: Yawɛ kpe o niriba kpamba mini bɛ nanim saria karibu ni. O yɛliya, Yinima n-ʒe tihi puri, ka di tarimba nɛma ti niŋ yi yinsi.
en: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders and princes of his people: You yourselves have devoured the vineyard; the goods stolen from the poor are in your houses.

dag: a yi zaŋ a salima bahi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zaŋ salima din yi Ofiri na ti bahi kulibɔŋ kuŋ ni kuɣa zuɣu.
en: Lay your prized possession in the dust, your gold from Ophir on a rock in a desert streambed.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kuli m ba sani ti yɛl o, A bia Yisifu ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni zaŋ ma leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zuɣulana, dinzuɣu niŋmi yomyom yiɣisi kuli n sanna.
en: Hurry! Go back to your father. Tell him this is what your son Joseph says: God has made me master of all of Egypt. Come down to me. Dont delay.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n zuɣu nyɛ kɔbiliga, ka n nina nyɛ nintam kɔbilinini ka n di tooi kuhiri bɛ ni ku n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: I wish my head were a well of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears, so that I could cry day and night for my people who have been killed.

dag: Ka di ni daa be shɛm di saha maa, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ so kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bihi shɛm ni daa muɣisiri bɛ ni dɔɣ so Naawuni Shia yiko ni shɛm la, lala n-na kul nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.

dag: Dama di ni yuui ka Izraɛlnim ku lan mali naa bee zuɣulana, ka ku lan mali maligu, ka binwɔɣila ku lan be bɛ sani. Bɛ ti ku lan mali wuni bee baɣibihi.
en: In just this way the people of Israel will have to live for a long time without kings or leaders, without sacrifices or sacred stone pillars, without idols or images to use for divination.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhu daa bahi ku Ɛhab daŋ niriba min o ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni o zɔnim ni o tindaannim zaa bɛn daa kpalim be Jɛziriil, ka o ninvuɣ so daa bi kpalim.
en: Then Jehu struck down all those belonging to Ahabs family who were left in Jezreel, so that not one of his leaders, close acquaintances, or priests remained.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma.
en: Someone who is on the roof of a house must not lose time by going down into the house to get anything to take along.

dag: Ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira maa yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, di ku yuui ka n shiri kana! Ami! Chɛ ka di niŋ lala. Kamina, ti Duuma Yisa!.
en: The one who bears witness to these things says, Yes, Im coming soon. Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!.

dag: Yɛndana nyarila baŋsim pahira. Amaa jɛrigu yɛtɔɣ yoya tahirila saɣiŋgu na.
en: Wise people are quiet and learn new things, but fools talk and bring trouble on themselves.

dag: Ka tɔbu daa yiɣisi alizanda ni. Malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil min o malaikanima n-daa tuhiri waɣ biɛ titali maa min o gba malaikanima.
en: Then there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought the dragon. The dragon and his angels fought back.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun pahi n zuɣu ka ti tɛhiri yi yɛla, ka o baɣa shiri be yi yɛla ni.
en: I have no one else like Timothy, who genuinely cares for you.

dag: ni Hanania ni Ɛlam ni Antɔtija.
en: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah.

dag: Di simdi ni nir siɣis omaŋ Naawuni tooni ;.
en: We should bow in submission, for there may still be hope.

dag: N daa lihi zoya zuɣu n-nya ka di sɔhirimi, ka daboya zaa daa chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa.
en: The mountains were shaking;.

dag: Bɛn kpalim la bɛn zaa yinoyino baɣa kul bela bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka pa ni Yisa Masia yɛla ni.
en: All the others put their own business ahead of Jesus Christs business.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Gidiɔn, Leemi ti naa su ti; ka a bidibiga min a nyaaŋa gba ti nyɛ ti nanim su ti, a ni fa ti Midiannim nuu ni bahi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Israelites said to Gideon, You saved us from the Midianites. So now rule over us. We want you, your son, and your grandson to rule over us.

dag: Zab piɛla nyɛla jilima nam zuɣupiligu, Wuntizɔbo biɛhigu puuni ka di yirina.
en: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is found on the path of righteousness.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman awa muna ata saha, ka Ananias paɣ daa kpɛna ka bi mi din niŋ maa yɛla.
en: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi, a yuli m-booni Pita; tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yɛn me n cheechi tam hal ka kum mini di yiko ti ku tooi wurim li.
en: So I tell you, you are Peter. And I will build my church on this rock. The power of death will not be able to defeat my church.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ka lihimiya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka paɣimiy o di puuni.
en: Never stop praying. Be ready for anything by praying and being thankful.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna tɔbbihi daa yi Ijipti na, ka Babilɔnnim bɛn daa teei gili Jɛrusalɛm maa daa wum bɛ yɛla ka zo n-yi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Pharaohs army had recently set out from Egypt; when the Babylonians who were attacking Jerusalem learned of the Egyptian advance, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ daa zanila bɛ zaashɛhi kaman Musa ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir la zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la. Lɛvinim n-daa yi taɣiri biŋkɔbiri ʒim n-zaŋna ti ti maligumaaniba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋdi li mihira.
en: They took their places in the Temple according to the instructions in the Law of Moses, the man of God. The Levites gave the blood of the sacrifices to the priests, who sprinkled it on the altar.

dag: Ŋuna n-kahigiri yɛl shɛŋa din baŋbu to min ashili yɛla wuhiri niriba; o mi din sɔɣi bumbɔn ni, neesim mi n-gil omaŋmaŋa.
en: God is the one who uncovers what lies deeply hidden; he knows what hides in darkness; light lives with him!.

dag: Tinzunnim kanna ti damdiri ma la tiŋa. Bɛ yi kul wum ka n yɛli shɛlikam, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: Foreigners bow before me; when they hear me, they obey.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ ni ninsalinim zaa baŋ Yawɛ yiko ni galisi shɛm. Ka di chɛ ka yi lu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura sahakam.
en: This happened so that all the earths peoples might know that the LORDs power is great and that you may always revere the LORD your God.

dag: Bɛraya mi zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hɛbɛr daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Hɛbɛrnima; ka Malikiɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Malikiɛlnima.
en: From Beriahs descendants: from Heber, the Heberite clan; from Malchiel, the Malchielite clan.

dag: A zaŋ a niriba kɔhi alaha, a bi zali ba da kpiɔŋ.
en: Youve sold your people for nothing, not even bothering to set a decent price.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ ti ma a yuli zuɣu. Fam ma bahi, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla.
en: But my Sovereign Lord , help me as you have promised, and rescue me because of the goodness of your love.

dag: Bɛ daa kana nti liri ma la n ni daa be muɣisigu ni dahin shɛli; amaa ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ dalim Yawɛ.
en: They attacked me in my time of trouble, but the Lord was there to support me.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n dana, jaande wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania wum n fabila ŋɔ, ka di lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ maa ni ka n ti kpi nimaani.
en: Please, don't send me back to that prison at Jonathan's house. If you do, I will die there.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni Jɛrusalɛm suhudoo zuɣu yɛra, Chɛ ka bɛn yuri li tɔŋ.
en: Pray for peace in Jerusalem: May those who love you find peace.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun simdi sizuura lubu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ na titali. Ŋuna n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.

dag: Zunzuya mini daɣiri m-pali n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ kul mɔri ti puhigira.
en: My skin is covered with worms and scabs. It is cracked and covered with sores.

dag: Ka Dauda tuumba maa daa chaŋ Abigeel sani Kamɛl nti yɛl o, Dauda n-tim ti ni ti kana ti kpuɣ a na ti ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: His servants went to her at Carmel and said to her, David sent us to take you to him to be his wife.

dag: Ka Musa daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: and Moses did so.

dag: Ka Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛl o, Pirigim a namda ŋɔ, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee. Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ lala.
en: The commander of the Lord s army answered, Take off your sandals. The place where you are standing is holy. So Joshua obeyed him.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yɛhudianim zuɣulaannim mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni maligumaaniba zuɣulan Annas mini Kaiafas nti pahi Jɔn mini Alikizanda ni bɛnkam daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan dɔɣiriba zaa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The next day the leaders, elders, and legal experts gathered in Jerusalem.

dag: Nir yi niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe yim naani a muɣisigu saha, di ŋmanila nyinvɔɣu bee napɔŋ din ka alaafee.
en: Never depend on a liar in times of trouble. Its like chewing with a bad tooth or walking with a crippled foot.

en: Instead, he told them as he left, If it is the will of God, I will come back to you. And so he sailed from Ephesus.

en: And I said to them, Every one of you must cast away your disgusting things. Dont let yourselves be defiled by Egypts idols. I am the LORD your God.

dag: Di saha ka binneen so ŋun daa ŋmani ninsala teeg o nuu na ti shihi n naŋgbampiba, ka n yɛl o, N dana, n ni nya ʒii shɛli maa chɛmi ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: But then someone who looked like a human being touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth and spoke, saying to the person standing in front of me: My lord, the vision bothered me deeply, and I couldnt stay strong during it.

en: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.

en: Laban answered, I agree to that. We will do what you ask.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ wain tihi puri ni nti nya di daai pum. Ti cham ti nya di puma maa yirigiya, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi gba daai pum. Nimaani ka n ni wuh a n ni yur a shɛm.
en: Lets set out early for the vineyards. We will see if the vines have budded and the blossoms opened, see if the pomegranates have bloomed. There Ill give my loving to you.

dag: Bɛ daa yihi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi bɛn bi tum taali ʒim, bɛ daa kɔri ba m-mal la Keenan wuna; ka bɛ ʒim maa daa ta tiŋgbɔŋ maa daɣiri.
en: They killed those innocent children, and the land was defiled by those murders.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim daa muɣisi Dan zuliya niriba n-kari ba labisi zoya ni tinsi la ni, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ siɣi tintan ni na.
en: The Amorites pushed the people of Dan back into the highlands because they wouldnt allow them to come down to the plain.

dag: Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko mini fahim niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn tumdi tuma shɛm luɣ kasi shee la malibu ni ti tum bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm.
en: Bezalel, Oholiab, and all the other workers to whom the Lord has given skill and understanding, who know how to make everything needed to build the sacred Tent, are to make everything just as the Lord has commanded.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbiri kuri ba solɔri zuɣu, ka dabiɛm pam ti be duri puuni. Di ni paai nachimbihi mini paɣipiɛlisi ni bimɔɣirisi ni ninkura bɛn zuɣuri paligi.
en: Outside, in the streets, the sword will bereave! Inside, in the safest room, there will be terror for young men and women, nursing baby and senior citizen.

en: If a woman has sexual relations with a man, and he has a flow of semen, both the man and the woman must bathe in water. They will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Judanim daa kana ti booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni nimaani n-zaŋ o leei Judanim naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Jabɛshigiliadnima n-daa sɔɣi Sool.
en: Then the people of Judah came to Hebron and anointed David king over the house of Judah. When David was informed that it was the people of Jabesh-gilead who had buried Saul.

en: Other Levites were responsible for the utensils used in worship. They checked them out and checked them back in every time they were used.

dag: ŋun pah ata gba kpuɣ o; lala ka bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o, ka bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi.
en: The same thing happened to the third one. Finally, all seven brothers married this woman and died without having any children.

dag: ni Zimiri nanim zaa ni Ɛlam nanim zaa ni Miidia nanim zaa.

en: Early the next morning, Laban kissed his daughters and his grandchildren goodbye, then he left to go back home.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ omaŋ dalim kpatinariga yili di ni lu, ka so yi gbaa li di ku tooi zani.
en: they take hold and fall because it's so flimsy.

en: After Nahor was born, Serug lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: zaŋ tabili Araba din daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la zaa hal ti taɣi Araba Teeku Pisiga zolɔŋ la ni.
en: This land also included the whole Jordan Valley on the east side of the Jordan River. To the south, this land reached to the Dead Sea. To the east, it reached to the foot of Mount Pisgah.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ nya, bɛ suhuri ni daa ye bindir shɛli zuɣu la ni.
en: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli;.
en: Rejoice always.

en: One day Eli, whose eyes had grown so weak he was unable to see, was lying down in his room.

dag: Amaa ka Sisɛra daa guui hal ti paai Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir la paɣ Jaɛl tanti gbini; dama zabili daa lan ka Hazɔr Naa Jabin mini Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir maa yiŋnim sunsuuni.
en: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Hazors King Jabin and the family of Heber the Kenite.

dag: N zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuma zaa yɛla, ka zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋa n-tɛh a tuun kara yɛla.
en: I will think about all that you have done; I will meditate on all your mighty acts.

dag: Peentɔriba ni ti lir o, ka di bi viɛla. Bɛ ni ti to o piɛma, ka nahim o pam.
en: Enemies attacked with arrows, refusing to show mercy.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun tiri dunianim bɛn tumd o yubu suhudoo ŋɔ.
en: Praise God in heaven, and on earth let there be peace to the people who please him.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Zaawuni ŋɔ, yi ni baŋ ni Yawɛ n-daa shiri yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: So Moses and Aaron said to all the Israelites, This evening you will know that it was the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

dag: Sida tihi din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa bi paai li. Gɔhi tihi bi paai di wulikpana. Nira ku tooi zaŋ ti shɛŋa din be polipoli buɣisi di wula. Tia daa ka Naawuni tihi puu la ni din viɛl paai li.
en: Even the cedar trees in Gods garden were not as big as this tree. Cypress trees did not have as many branches. Plane trees did not have such branches. No tree in Gods garden was as beautiful as this tree.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu din nyɛ o shɛhira tanti jɛmbu duu m-be alizanda ni la, ka di yooi.
en: After this I saw the temple, the holy place of Gods presence, in heaven. It was opened.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm ba Hamɔr daa kana ni o ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu di yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then Shechems father, Hamor, came out to talk with Jacob.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Naa Amɔn polo maa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: The people of the land then executed all those who had plotted against King Amon and made his son Josiah the next king.

dag: M pun kahig a yuli wuhi ba, ka ni lan kahigi li wuhi ba pahi, ka di chɛ ka yurilim shɛli a ni yuri ma la be bɛ ni, ka n gba be bɛ ni.
en: Ive made your name known to them and will continue to make it known so that your love for me will be in them, and I myself will be in them.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini noonsi balibu kam n-zaŋ ba na ti ti ninsal ni o nya o ni yɛn boli ba yu shɛŋa; ka ninsal ni daa boli binnɛɔŋ kam zaa yu shɛli, o yuli n-kul bala.
en: The Lord God used dust from the ground and made every animal in the fields and every bird in the air. He brought all these animals to the man, and the man gave them all a name.

dag: N ni yɛl a jilima din galisi ŋɔ min a tibiginsim yɛla, ka tɛh a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: They will talk all about the glorious splendor of your majesty; I will contemplate your wondrous works.

dag: Bindira balibu kam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ din viɛla mini sara maligu balibu kam nyɛla maligumaaniba dini. Di lan simdi ka yi zaŋ yi ni tuui ŋɔri zim shɛli ti maligumaaniba maa din ni chɛ ka alibarika be yi yinsi.
en: The priests are to have the best of all the first harvest and of everything else that is offered to me. Each time the people bake bread, they are to give the priests the first loaf as an offering, and my blessing will rest on their homes.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa bi deei lahibal suŋ maa. Anabi Aizaia bɔhiya, Ti Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ o ni wum shɛli ti sani maa yɛda.
en: But not all have accepted the Good News. Isaiah himself said, Lord, who believed our message.

dag: Di pala din be zuɣusaa ka yi ni yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee ni du zuɣusaa nti zaŋ li ti ti na ka ti wum li ka dol li.
en: This command is not in heaven so that you should say, Who will go up to heaven for us and bring it to us, so that we can hear and do it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn pɔri ka ka yaa ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni sɔŋ ya. Mani Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi Tiligira.
en: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, Israel is only a worm! I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.

dag: Judanim gba daa bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zalikpana la, amaa ka daa dolila Izraɛlnim ni daa zali ka shɛŋa la.
en: but they also disobeyed the Lord 's commands and acted like the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa nyɛla wuntizɔriba, ka daa doli ti Duuma Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim mini adiini soli kaya zaa ka ka galimi shɛli.
en: Both of them were good people and pleased the Lord God by obeying all that he had commanded.

dag: Bɛ malila shili n-kariti doli ma, ka di pala n taali zuɣu. Yiɣisim kana ti sɔŋ ma ka nya.
en: They run and take their stand— but not because of any fault of mine. Get up when I cry out to you! Look at whats happening!.

dag: Jɛhiɛl bidibisi ni, Zɛtam min o mabia Joɛl n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Azichi fukumsi.
en: Jehielis sons were Zetham and Zethams brother Joel. They were responsible for the valuable things in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli din beni nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Masia daa shiri neei kum ni, ka leei bɛn gbihiri kum ni la toondana.
en: But Christ really has been raised from death—the first one of all those who will be raised.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia la biɛɣu pia dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the tenth day of the tenth month of the ninth year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Piɛguliba pam saɣim n wain tihi puu, bɛ no n ni su shɛli sɔŋ tiŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka n tiŋgbɔn shɛli din viɛli pam la leei dabari ni tiŋgban nɛli.
en: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.

dag: Kaman nir ni ku tooi kali saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ bee teeku noli bihigu shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya mini Lɛvinim bɛn tumdi n tuma maa nabi.
en: And just as the stars in the sky cant be numbered and the sand on the shore cant be counted, so I will increase the descendants of my servant David and the Levites who minister before me.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim daa ti chɛ Naawuni maŋli jɛmbu ka di yuui pam, ka mi ka maligumaana ŋun ni wuhiri ba; ka daa bi lan doli zaligu yaha.
en: For a long time Israel lived without the true God, without priests to teach them, and without a law.

dag: Ka bɛ daa suhi alibarika suhigu ti Ribɛka n-yɛli: Ti tizɔpaɣa, Naawuni chɛ ka a leei niriba tusatusa ni tuhi piapia ma! Naawuni chɛ ka a zuliya ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: And they gave Rebecca their blessing in these words: May you, sister, become the mother of millions! May your descendants conquer the cities of their enemies.

dag: A paɣiba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a nayili bihi bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni wumd a yɛm yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ gba mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Your people and these servants who continually serve you and get to listen to your wisdom are truly happy!.

dag: A ni ti tooi yɛli ni a nyɛla wuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku a maa tooni? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti a daŋ maa sani, a nyɛla ninsala, ka pa wuni.
en: When they come to kill you, will you still claim that you are a god? When you face your murderers, you will be mortal and not at all divine.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bundaannim mini karimbaannim mali ti ansarisi ti yaɣi.
en: Weve had more than enough mockery from the self-confident, more than enough shame from the proud.

dag: Ka Sool daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ; dina n-daa nyɛ o ni tuui me sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Yawɛ.
en: And Saul built an altar to the LORD. It was the first altar he had built to the LORD.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Ninvuɣ so ŋun tiri Yawɛ jilima mal alibarika. Ŋun yu o zaligunim mali alibarika.
en: Shout praises to the Lord ! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu maa ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani. Di yuuni maa ni, di ti biriya bee n-kpuɣi bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli bee m-pɔhiya yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni wala.
en: The th year will be a special celebration for you. Dont plant seeds, dont harvest the crops that grow by themselves, and dont gather grapes from the vines that are not trimmed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Yisa min o nyaandoliba gba ni bɛ ka amiliya maa ni na.
en: Jesus and his disciples had also been invited and were there.

dag: Ka o daa zom dabisi muna ata, ka bi di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli.
en: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.

dag: Nyamiya, maligumaaniba ni ʒi dunia zaa Duuma Daalikauli Adaka maa n-gari yi tooni chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
en: when the Covenant Box of the Lord of all the earth crosses the Jordan ahead of you.

dag: Apolɔs ni daa be Kɔrinti saha shɛli maa ka Pool daa gari chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be nuzaa polo n-daa mali hal ti paai Ɛfɛsus. Nimaani ka o daa nya Yisa nyaandol shɛba.
en: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul traveled across the hill country to Ephesus, where he met some of the Lord's followers.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo din ti yɛn nyɛ kilomita ayi ni mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la ni ti malila dunɔdaya ata. Yisifu zuliya dunɔdali mini Bɛnjamin zuliya dunɔdali ni Dan zuliya dunɔdali.
en: There are three gates on the east side along its . miles: one gate for Joseph, one gate for Benjamin, and one gate for Dan.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ni la daanya diɣisi mali tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim ti ba bɛ ni kul suhi shɛlikam zaa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ijiptinim maa daazichi pam pahi chaŋ.
en: The LORD made sure that the Egyptians were kind to the people so that they let them have whatever they asked for. And so they robbed the Egyptians.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na bi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu, niriba daa maani sara la maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord , and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli, M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani ŋɔ kalinli nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu, ka a yɛli, N ni ti ba nimdi ka bɛ ŋubi gol muni zaa?.
en: Moses said, There are , soldiers here, and you say, I will give them enough meat to eat for a whole month.

dag: O zaŋ yɛm din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli yɛm zali wuntizɔriba, ka leei nyɔtaɣirigu gu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi.
en: He reserves ability for those with integrity. He is a shield for those who live a blameless life.

dag: Yi yi ŋub li daba ata maa dali, di nyɛla din chihira, ka n ku deei li.
en: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is foul; it will not be accepted.

dag: Kalim Izraɛlnim kaman sokam min o malibu ni o daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Sabimiya doo kam yuli.
en: Count all the Israelites. List the name of each man with his family and his family group.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n ti zaŋ ya kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be kaman yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli chi mini kawana ni wain ni bindira ni tihi puri ni be.
en: After some time, I will come and take you to a land like your own. In that new land, you will have plenty of grain for making bread and vineyards for producing wine.

dag: Ka o daa yaag o noli m-mɔri Naawuni, ka galindi Naawuni yuli min o biɛhigu shee zaŋ tabili bɛnkam be alizanda ni.
en: It began to curse God, his name, the place where he lives, and all those who live in heaven.

dag: Ti dana, wummi ti ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, A nyɛla zuɣulaan titali ti sani. Ti ni so ku mɔŋ a o siliga bee n-yɛl a ni a di sɔɣ a kpima. Dinzuɣu piim a ni bɔri ti silisi ŋɔ ni shɛli n-zaŋ a kpim maa sɔɣi di ni.
en: Sir, you are a great leader among us. You can have the best place we have to bury your dead. You can have any of our burying places that you want. None of us will stop you from burying your wife there.

dag: Yawɛ zal o ni yɛn siɣisi karimbaannim zaa mini ninʒeensinim ni bɛnkam zaa duhi bɛmaŋa dahin shɛli.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces has planned a day: against all that is prideful and haughty; against all that is lofty, and it will be laid low.

dag: Ka Aripakishad daa nyɛ Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla mi nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah. Shelah was the father of Eber.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Sool ni Dauda be Kɛila, ka Sool yɛli, Naawuni zaŋ o niŋ n nuu ni, dama o kpari omaŋa n-niŋ tin shɛli din dunoya mali pundi mini kur wɔɣila din kpariti dunoya.
en: Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, and he said, God has put him in my power. David has trapped himself by going into a walled town with fortified gates.

dag: Ka Judanim bɛn kpalim be Ijipti maa so ti ku zo n-tiligi bee n-gali bee nti lan labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Hal bɛ ni daa kul bɔri ni bɛ lab ti be nimaani ka di yuui maa zaa yoli, bɛ ku labi, naɣila kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba shɛba n-ni labi.
en: None of the people of Judah who are left and have come to Egypt to live will escape or survive. Not one of them will return to Judah, where they long to live once again. No one will return except a few refugees.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Amaa m bɔrimi ni yi baŋ ni Daadam Bia mali yiko din chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni. Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli gbalikpimalan maa.
en: But so you will know that the Human One has authority on the earth to forgive sins—he said to the man who was paralyzed.

dag: Nyin ŋun bol amaŋa Yɛhudia ŋɔ, wula n-lee nyɛ li a sani? A niŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu naani ka nyuri bara a Naawuni milinsi zuɣu.
en: What about you? You say you are a Jew. You trust in the law and proudly claim to be close to God.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka tɔbu mini kum ku ba maa bahi Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu, so ti ku beni ŋun ni sɔɣi bɛ mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bidibisi ni bɛ bipuɣinsi. Dama n ni ti zaŋ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ʒili ba.
en: And the people they are prophesying to will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem, victims of famine and war. There will be no one to bury them or their wives and children. I will pour out on them their own wickedness.

dag: Ka Tiyaawumya daa yi Filistianim maa sanna, o yuli n-daa booni Goliat ka o yi tiŋ shɛli din yuli booni Gaat na. O wɔɣilim daa nyɛla kaman mita ata laasabu.
en: The Philistines had a champion fighter named Goliath, who was from Gath. He was over feet tall. Goliath came out of the Philistine camp.

dag: Yɛlim o ni o maam o ni ka mali shili gu, ka di zɔri dabiɛm. O mi di chɛ ka o suhu zɔhiri Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Aram bɛn suhu yiɣisi pam ka nyɛ bɛn ŋmani buɣim datɛhi ayi la zuɣu.
en: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, bidibiga ka a dɔɣi maa. Ka o bi garigi shɛli.
en: As she was dying, the women helping her said to her, Be brave! You have a son! But she paid no attention and did not answer.

dag: O zaŋla noli yɛlibu ye kaman binyɛrigu la. Chɛ ka di tabil o niŋgbuna kaman kom la, ka chɛ ka di be kaman kpam la n-nyɛligi kpe o kɔba ni.
en: He cursed as naturally as he dressed himself; may his own curses soak into his body like water and into his bones like oil!.

dag: Ka naɣ kɔri bɛn daa gaŋsigaŋsi maa daa zaŋ naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna daa kul nyɛlisiri la ŋubi. Ka Firawuna daa yirigi neei.
en: ate the fat, healthy cows. When this happened, the king woke up.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yi ni so miri ka o ti chɛ ka o min o dɔɣira dɔni.
en: No one is allowed to approach any blood relative for sexual contact: I am the LORD.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa ti paai Mariama sani o yɛl o mi, M puhir a nyin ŋun mal alibarika pam ŋɔ, ti Duuma be a sani! A mal alibarika paɣiba ni.
en: When the angel came to her, he said, Rejoice, favored one! The Lord is with you.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo, ka niŋdi nirilim; yurilim bi zabiri nyuli, di bi nyuri bara, di mi bi duhiri dimaŋa.
en: Love is patient and kind, never jealous, boastful, proud, or.

dag: Madimɛnanim mini Gɛbimnim zɔrimi ni bɛ tiligi.
en: Madmenah has flown. Gebims inhabitants sought refuge.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni wuhi ni o bɔri shɛlikam ni di zaŋ tum o jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin bom lala binyara maa ka di zaŋ tum di tuma maa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhu ku yiɣisi bahi m mini bɛn ti yɛn doli n nyaaŋa di nam zuɣu.
en: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinim mini Jɛturinim ni Nafishinim ni Nɔdabinima.
en: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ kaɣisi yili maa puuni dukpina zaa, ka va bɛ ni kaɣisi taŋkpa shɛli maa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: Then the priest must have the entire house scraped inside. The people must throw away the plaster that was scraped off the walls. They must put that plaster at a special unclean place outside the city.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛlabihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Offer with them all the other offerings required for the first day.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni di ba. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi n-chaŋ ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Kalidianim bɛn teei gili ya ŋɔ ni tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: Anyone who stays in the city will be killed in war or by starvation or disease. But those who go out and surrender to the Babylonians, who are now attacking the city, will not be killed; they will at least escape with their life.

dag: M bi zɔri ninvuɣ tuhi piapia bɛn ʒe n-gili n luɣilikam la.
en: So I will not be afraid of my enemies, even if thousands of them surround me.

dag: Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikah ayi maa saha shɛli, niriba maa zaa bɛn laɣimm a sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: If you blow long blasts on both trumpets, all the people must meet together at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun pɔra ka bɛ ʒiɛm ma, amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: I am young, and people dont respect me. But I have not forgotten your instructions.

dag: Mirim ma, tiligim ma; fam ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Come close to me! Redeem me! Save me because of my enemies!.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, a bi zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ti bee n-zaŋ puri mini tihi puri ti ti ka di leei ti dini. Pumpɔŋɔ a bɔrimi ni a yɔhim ti. Ti ku kana.
en: You keep promising us rich farmlands with fertile fields and vineyards—but where are they? Stop trying to trick these people. No, we won't come to see you.

dag: Yaa tiŋgbani, miri ka a pi n ʒim; di chɛ ka n kuhigu zani soli.
en: Earth, dont hide the wrong things that were done to me. Dont let my begging for fairness be stopped.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim ni daa wum Yisa ŋaha ŋɔ, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛna ka o ŋahi li dalim maa.
en: Now when the chief priests and the Pharisees heard the parable, they knew Jesus was talking about them.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hashub bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Azirikam yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Hashabia mini Bunni.
en: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub and grandson of Azrikam. His ancestors included Hashabiah and Bunni.

dag: Juda zuliya daa leela Naawuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka Izraɛlnim leeg o ni su shɛba.
en: Then Judah became Gods special people, and Israel became his kingdom.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Nyamiya, n saɣi yi ni daa yɛli ma shɛlikam zaa la, ka pii naa tin ya.
en: Samuel said to all Israel: I have done everything you wanted me to do. I have put a king over you.

dag: Dama Hɛshibɔn daa nyɛla Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn tiŋa. Ŋuna n-daa tuhi Mɔab na kuro ka fa o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zaŋ hal ni Arinɔn.
en: King Sihon had ruled from Heshbon, after defeating the Moabites and taking over their land north of the Arnon River gorge.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka yi yɔri lampoo gba zuɣu, dama nam fukumsinim nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdiba bɛn tuma nyɛ ni bɛ niŋ lala.
en: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Zuf, ka Sool daa yɛl o tumtumda so ŋun daa be o sani maa, Kamina ka ti lab kuli, di yi pa lala m ba ni chɛ bunsi ŋɔ yɛla tɛhibu ka kpalim tɛhirila ti yɛla.
en: When they came into the region of Zuph, Saul said to his servant, Let's go back home, or my father might stop thinking about the donkeys and start worrying about us.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ti kani, ka o bia Manaasa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hezekiah died, and his son Manasseh became king.

dag: Dinzuɣu zalimiya zaligu n-yɛli ni niriba maa na chɛli bɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu, ka naɣila n ti lan zali zaligu yaha.
en: Now, you must give an order for these men to stop work. That order must be given to keep Jerusalem from being rebuilt until I say so.

dag: Nachimba mini paɣisara ni ninkura ni bihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: young women and young men, old people and children too.

dag: O daa jɛmdila Baal, ka dol o ba ni daa niŋ shɛlikam la soli n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Ahaziah worshiped Baal and made the Lord God of Israel very angry, just as his father had done.

dag: Chamiya ti zani Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni n-yɛli niriba nyɛvil palli ŋɔ yɛla zaa.
en: Go and stand in the Temple, and tell the people all about this new life.

dag: Fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o kɔh o tiŋgban shɛli ti a, o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa o zuɣu n-ni kana ti yo o mabia maa ni kɔhi shɛli maa zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If any of you Israelites become poor and are forced to sell your land, your closest relative is to buy it back.

dag: Bee Tiligimiya ma n dim nuu ni? Bee Famiya ma bɛn nahindi ma ŋɔ nuu ni bahi?.
en: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?.

dag: Ka n tɛhi ni a yihi ma la a sani bahi, ka n ku lan nya a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.

dag: Ka Gaad daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm bɔŋɔ, piim a ni bɔri shɛli.
en: Gad went to David, told him what the Lord had said, and asked, Which is it to be?.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a lan ti ma nyɛvili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun do gbala ni la kalinli ni.
en: you kept me from the grave. I was on my way to the depths below, but you restored my life.

dag: Amaa wahu ni daa zaŋ o yɛmbimbiɛri n-yɔhim Awa shɛm la, n zɔri ni yi gba tɛha ti ŋmaligi kpe yɔɣu lala ka chɛ yi suhuyini mini yi ʒiɛyimtal shɛli yi ni mali zaŋ chaŋ Masia san la.
en: But Im afraid that your minds might be seduced in the same way as the snake deceived Eve with his devious tricks. You might be unable to focus completely on a genuine and innocent commitment to Christ.

dag: Ka n daa da puu din be Anatɔt maa m mabia Hanamɛl sani, ka daa kali liɣiri maa ti o. Di daa nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaayopɔin.
en: from Hanamel, and so I did. The price was pieces of silver, and I weighed out the full amount on a scale.

dag: Bɛ ni wuh a, ka yɛl a bɛ ni mi shɛlikam zaa.
en: Wont they instruct you and tell you; will words not proceed from their hearts?.

dag: ka o daa dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga n-zaŋ chinchini pil o sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni, dama bɛ daa bi nya palo saamba yilikpɛrili ni.
en: She gave birth to her first son. She wrapped him up well and laid him in a box where cattle are fed. She put him there because the guest room was full.

dag: Amaa man ni yili wumpaɣibo yila paɣ a, ka mali sara jɛm a; ka pali n ni lo alikauli shɛli a sani. Tiliginsim yirila nyin Yawɛ sanna.
en: But I will sing praises to you; I will offer you a sacrifice and do what I have promised. Salvation comes from the Lord .

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Pa nyini n-yɛn ʒi lahibali maa kuli zuŋɔ, dahin shɛli ka a ni ti ʒi lahibali maa kuli, amaa zuŋɔ dina a ku ʒi lahibali maa kuli, dama nabia maa kpiya.
en: No, Joab said, today you will not take any good news. Some other day you may do so, but not today, for the king's son is dead.

dag: Anab shɛb bɛn daa be anabi Samuɛl ʒiɛman ni mini anab shɛb bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa zaa daa pun yɛli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛla.
en: All the prophets who spoke—from Samuel forward—announced these days.

dag: di saha yili maa lana ŋun cham ti yɛli maligumaana, Di ŋmanila dɔr shɛli n-lu n yiŋa.
en: the homeowner must come and tell the priest, I think some sort of infection is in my house.

dag: Dinzuɣu n lan zaŋ ya taali yaha, ka zaŋ yi yaansi gba taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, So now I will accuse you again, and I will also accuse your grandchildren.

dag: A ni ti bo a dimnim shee, amaa ka ku nya ba; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a ni ti bahi yoli.
en: You will look for the people who were against you, but you will not be able to find them. Those who fought against you will disappear completely.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, a galisiya pam. A zaŋla jilima mini nam yiko ye kaman situra la.
en: Praise the Lord , my soul! O Lord , my God, how great you are! You are clothed with majesty and glory;.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim tuumba o biɛli Iso sani Siɛr Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daŋ o tooni.
en: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the country of Edom.

dag: Kum n-yi di mali ma, n naan ku yɛli ya, dama mani n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: If I were hungry, I would not ask you for food. I already own the world and everything in it.

dag: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura, ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli ka kom kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day when Noah went into the big boat. Then the flood came and drowned everyone on earth.

dag: So yi chɛ bɔɣili yali bee so yi gbi bɔɣili ka bi ŋari li, ka nahu bee buŋ lu di puuni kpi.
en: A man might take a cover off a well or dig a hole and not cover it. If another mans animal comes and falls into that hole, the man who owns the hole is guilty.

dag: Di yi ti wali yuuni na di viɛla; ka di mi yi ti bi wali, man naanyi ŋmaa li luhi. .
en: Then if the tree bears figs next year, so much the better; if not, then you can have it cut down.

dag: Yi yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, yin chɛliya ka yi mabi yino kpalim be sarika ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi bɛn kpalim ʒi bindira kuli ti ti kum ni mali yi yiŋnim shɛb maa.
en: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay in prison, and the rest of you, go, take grain back to those in your households who are hungry.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa to o piɛm ti o daŋa.
en: The fighting was heavy around Saul, and he was hit by enemy arrows and badly wounded.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa sab yɛli so yɛla ni Naawuni yɛliya, N tumo m-bɔŋɔ; n ni tim o ka o daŋ a tooni nti mal a chandi maa soli ti a.
en: This Scripture was written about him: Listen! I will send my messenger ahead of you. He will prepare the way for you. Malachi :.

dag: Ka bintɔra daa tɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi kpi mi, ka tiŋ maa nim daa kum pam.
en: Even those who did not die developed tumors and the people cried out to their gods for help.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti gbahi amaŋmaŋ bidibisi shɛba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei namɔɣilisi ka bɛ be Babilɔn nayili.
en: Some of your children, your very own offspring, will be taken away. They will become eunuchs in the palace of Babylons king.

dag: o ni daa niŋ Ijipti tɔbbihi mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shɛm la ni o ni daa chɛ ka Teeku Ʒiɛɣu di ba shɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kariti doli ya la. Yawɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: what God did to the Egyptian army, to its horses and chariots—how he made the water of the Reed Sea flow over their heads when they chased after you, but the LORD destroyed them, and thats how things stand right now.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin; di dabisi tuuli dali maa, di simdi ka yi yihi dabindi kam yi yinsi. Ka so yi ti di dabindi daba ayopɔin ŋɔ puuni, dilan ni yi Izraɛl zuliya ni.
en: You will eat unleavened bread for seven days. On the first day you must remove yeast from your houses because anyone who eats leavened bread anytime during those seven days will be cut off from Israel.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa yirigi bɛ kpiŋkpama yiɣi n ninni. Bɛ ni daa yiɣi maa, ka kalima maa doli ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: Then the Cherub angels raised their wings and flew into the air. I saw them leave. The wheels went with them. Then they stopped at the East Gate of the Lord s Temple. The Glory of the God of Israel was in the air above them.

dag: A daa nya ti yaannim ni diri wahala shɛm Ijipti; ka daa wum bɛ fabila Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: You saw the affliction of our ancestors in Egypt and heard their cry at the Reed Sea.

dag: Ka n ni kpaŋ mmaŋ niŋ di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm, ka di chɛ ka yi ti tooi teeri dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla sahakam n kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone.

dag: ka o chɛ ka noonsi yiɣina ti lu bɛ sani. Bɛ daa galisiya pam ŋ-ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu;.
en: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli, N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor made a sign for Paul to speak. So Paul answered, Governor Felix, I know that you have been a judge over this nation for a long time. So I am happy to defend myself before you.

dag: Ka Jɔash daa kpalim be Jɛhɔshɛba sani n-sɔɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni hal ti paai yuma ayɔbu, ka Atalia daa diri nam su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: For six years Jehosheba took care of the boy and kept him hidden in the Temple, while Athaliah ruled as queen.

dag: Paɣa, ka pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba. Ka di pa ni n sabirila zaligu palli tir a, amaa di nyɛla ti ni daa pun deei shɛli piligu ni la.
en: Now, dear friends, I am requesting that we love each other. Its not as though Im writing a new command to you, but its one we have had from the beginning.

dag: O ni daa gbaag o maa o daa kpɛh o la duu, ka chɛ ka duguliba pinaayɔbu ʒe n-gul o, dama o daa lɔrila nia ni Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhi gari ka o zaŋ o niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He put Peter in prison, handing him over to four squads of soldiers, sixteen in all, who guarded him. He planned to charge him publicly after the Passover.

dag: Amaa Naawuni shiri ni tooi be ninsalinim sani dunia ŋɔ ni? Dama zuɣusaa zaa ku tooi deeg a bɛ ti yɛri n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: But how could God possibly live on earth with people? If heaven, even the highest heaven, cant contain you, how can this temple that I have built contain you?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o chɛ ka buɣim di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka daadamnim be kaman kpam la ka buɣim di ba, ka so bi lan zɔr o kpee nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo faralan maa piɛr anahi, o ni tum shɛm maa min o ni bi zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: He must restore the ewe lamb seven times over because he did this and because he had no compassion.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligu nyɛla din be kasi; Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla din be kasi mini din tuhi ni din viɛla.
en: So then, the Law itself is holy, and the commandment is holy, right, and good.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi ni laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Yes, I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: O bi nya ka zuɣubiɛɣu be Yaakubu zuliya ni; bee n-nya ka muɣisigu shɛli be Izraɛlnim sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa be bɛ sani. Ka bɛ yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ naa m-be bɛ sani.
en: He hasnt envisioned misfortune for Jacob, nor has he seen trouble for Israel. The LORD his God is with him, proclaimed as his king.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli kpamba maa, Yinim kpalimmiya be kpe n-guhi ti hal ka ti ti lab yi sanna. Aduna mini Hur be yi sani, ka ŋunkam mali yɛl shɛli, ŋun cham bɛ sani.
en: Moses had told the leaders, Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Faashee Daadam Bia nya wahala pam, ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa ti zaɣis o, ka chɛ ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: Then Jesus said, The Son of Man must suffer many things. He will be rejected by the older Jewish leaders, the leading priests, and teachers of the law. And he will be killed. But after three days he will be raised from death.

dag: Kahigim a daalahiziba yurilim la wuhi, nyin ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kanna ti sɔɣiri a sani a nudirigu polo tiligiri bɛ dimnim nuu ni tiligira ŋɔ.
en: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.

dag: Di saha maa Yisa ma Mariama min o tizo Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Klɔpas paɣa la ni Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa ʒiɛla Yisa dapulli maa gbini.
en: Standing close to Jesus' cross were his mother, his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa niŋ yɛda pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus replied, Now you believe?.

dag: Naawuni daazichi min o yɛm ni o baŋsim galisiya pam! Naawuni ni maani yɛla shɛm to ni baŋbu, ka o soya yɛla gariti sokam!.
en: Gods riches, wisdom, and knowledge are so deep! They are as mysterious as his judgments, and they are as hard to track as his paths!.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Naa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Zaŋmiya doo ŋɔ niŋ sarika ni, ka tir o bɔrɔbɔro biɛlabiɛla mini kom hal ka n ti labina ni alaafee. .
en: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.

dag: Jɛrigu ku tooi baŋ li; ka ŋun ka laasabu ku tooi baŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
en: Stupid people dont know this. Fools dont understand.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ dabindi gari chi bee kawana sara ti Yawɛ, dama di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ dabindi bee shiri nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: You must not give any grain offering to the Lord that has yeast in it. You must not burn yeast or honey as a gift to the Lord .

dag: Kiriatijiarim zuliya n-daa nyɛ Itirinim mini Putinim ni Shumatinim ni Mishiranima. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zuliya ni ka Zɔranim mini Ɛshitaolnim yina.
en: and of the following clans that lived in Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites, and Mishraites.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti bɔhi Izraɛl naa, M min a yɛla bi kpa. Cham a ba min a ma daanabinim la sani. Amaa ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, Aai, Yawɛ n-zaŋ ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: and he asked Joram, Why did you come to me? Go talk to the prophets of the foreign gods your parents worshiped. No, Joram answered. It was the Lord who led us out here, so that Moab's army could capture us.

dag: O zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba nambɔɣu; ka tiligiri nandaamba nyɛviya.
en: He feels sorry for all who are weak and poor. He protects their lives.

dag: Yawɛ gbibi bɛnkam zaa yɛn lu; ka yiɣisiri bɛnkam zaa pun lu.
en: He helps those who are in trouble; he lifts those who have fallen.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Zaŋm a yiko tiligi ti; zaŋm a yiko maa niŋ kaman a ni daa pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha la. Nyini n-daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahi teeku ni biŋkɔb so bɛ ni booni Rahab la.
en: Wake up, Lord , and help us! Use your power and save us; use it as you did in ancient times. It was you that cut the sea monster Rahab to pieces.

dag: Izraɛlnim ti ku lan nya suligunyinyaɣu bee goo bɛ ʒiʒiinitab bɛn daa maani ba ansarisi la zaa so sani, ka bɛ ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: Then the surrounding nations that hate Israel will no longer be like stinging nettles and painful thorns. And they will know that I am the Lord GOD.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela mɔɣu ni yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So John the Baptizer came and was baptizing people in the desert area. He told them to be baptized to show that they wanted to change their lives, and then their sins would be forgiven.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Manaasa zuliya pirigili la kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.

dag: Ka tintariga maa ni lan kpuɣi ni n-zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, di tariga yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ ni. Yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa mini di tintarisi din gil li m-bala.
en: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.

dag: Kawana bee chi sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi maa ni ti zaŋ li mali sara Yawɛ sani sara maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: This is the Instruction for the grain offering: Aarons sons will present it before the LORD in front of the altar.

dag: Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma n suhusaɣiŋgu saha. Gbilisim tibili wum, ka garigi ma yomyom n ni suhir a saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: When I am in trouble, don't turn away from me! Listen to me, and answer me quickly when I call!.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka yi mini ba tuhi, n ti ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbani maa hal napɔŋ ŋmɛbu yim gba tin ya, dama n daa pun zaŋ Ɛdom Zoli maa tila Iso ni o su li.
en: Dont fight them. I will not give you any of their land—not even a foot of it, because I gave the hill country of Seir to Esau to keep as his own.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi maa na ka Musa ti niŋ binʒim maa niŋ bɛ nudiriti tibinyaɣa ni mini bɛ nudiriti polo nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti polo napombihilɔri. Ka Musa daa kpaai ʒim maa vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Then Moses brought forward Aarons sons and put some of the blood on their right earlobes, their right thumbs, and their right big toes. Moses tossed the rest of the blood against all of the altars sides.

dag: Yiɣisim zani, dama daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi a zuɣu ni n zal a ka a leei n tumo, ka niŋ a ni nya ma ni shɛlikam ŋɔ mini n ni na yɛn wuh a shɛli shɛhiralana.
en: But get up and stand on your feet. I have appeared to you to appoint you as my servant. You are to tell others what you have seen of me today and what I will show you in the future.

dag: Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la be nimaani. Dinzuɣu a yi ti kul wum shɛlikam nayili maa, nyin yɛlim Zadok mini Abiata bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa.
en: The priests Zadok and Abiathar will be there; tell them everything you hear in the king's palace.

dag: A daa nyɛla dabili ka ti Duuma bol a? Di chɛ ka di muɣis a. Amaa a yi ni tooi nya yolisim, nyin bom li.
en: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.

dag: Yi tamla yi yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la mini Juda nanim mini bɛ paɣiba ni yimaŋmaŋ mini yi paɣiba ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni la yɛla?.
en: Have you forgotten the sins of your ancestors and the sins of the kings of Judah and their wives? Have you forgotten the sins that you and your wives committed in the land of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?.

dag: Ka Jɔn nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Jɔn ti sɔɣi, ka chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: But Johns disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus what had happened.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama yi na ʒi n-doli soli maa. Amaa lee miriya ka yi miri Alikauli Adaka maa. Doliya di nyaaŋa m-be li larigim kaman kilomita yini laasabu.
en: But do not follow too closely. Stay about yards behind them. You have not been here before, but if you follow them, you will know where to go.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisifu daa ti yɛn kpi ka teei n-tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm yɛla zali; ka daa wuhi ba bɛ ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sɔɣibu polo.
en: By faith Joseph recalled the exodus of the Israelites at the end of his life, and gave instructions about burying his bones.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Lomiy o nuhi min o naba n-zaŋ o ti bahi kpaŋ ha zibisim shee. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina. .
en: Then the king said to his servants, Tie his hands and feet and throw him out into the farthest darkness. People there will be weeping and grinding their teeth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli ya zuŋɔ, amaa yi bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tim ma na ni n ti yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa maa ni shɛli.
en: So today I have told you the message from the Lord. But you have not obeyed the Lord your God. You have not done all that he sent me to tell you to do.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, N-hii, pumpɔŋɔ a yipa kahigiri yɛri ti, ka di pa ŋaha puuni yaha!.
en: Then his followers said, You are already speaking plainly to us. You are not using words that hide the meaning.

dag: Ka Yisifu dan maa daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o ti niŋ sarika ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ naa sarikanim niŋ, ka o daa be sarika maa ni.
en: and threw Joseph in the same prison where the king's prisoners were kept. While Joseph was in prison.

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim galisiya pam, bɛn yiɣisi lu n zuɣu galisiya pam!.
en: LORD, I have so many enemies! So many are standing against me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Filistianima, ka bɛ nini baligi ka o deei Mɛtɛgama bɛ nuu ni.
en: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them. David captured Metheg-ammah from Philistine control.

dag: Di saha ka napaɣ Hagit bia Adɔnija daa ti ka Sulemaana ma Batishiiba sanna. Ka Batishiiba bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana maa? Ka o garigi yɛli, Iin, alaafee.
en: Adonijah, Haggiths son, went to Bathsheba, Solomons mother. She said, Are you coming in peace? He said, Yes.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. Ka fukumsi zaligu shɛl lan kani kpɛm gari dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: The second most important commandment says: Love others as much as you love yourself. No other commandment is more important than these.

dag: Yawɛ, fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi; guli ma, ka duŋtaariba ku paai ma.
en: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord !.

dag: Yi ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa bemi kaman gariŋga gala la. Nir yi ŋma di gal yini wahu n-yiri di ni na. Amaa yi nia biɛri maa ku kun ya buchi. Di nyɛla din ka buchi kaman kpatinari zana chinchini la, di bi galisi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ni tooi zaŋ li pili.
en: They hatch adders eggs, and weave spiderwebs. Whoever eats their eggs will die. Moreover, the crushed egg hatches a viper.

dag: Ka daɣila o kul yɛn kpaari ba mi ka chɛr o laŋa maa zaɣ kuŋ, ka kuri niriba ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: Will he continue to take riches with his net? Will he continue destroying people without showing mercy?.

dag: Bɛ naala noli n-lu wuntizɔriba zuɣu, ka kari saria n-zali ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali.
en: The wicked gang up against the lives of the righteous. They condemn innocent blood.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ba, yi yi nya ka di simdi, yin yomiya ma n tuma yɔri. Ka yi yi ku yo ma, yin maliya li. Ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita yo ma.
en: I told them, Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it. So they handed me my wages, a measly pieces of silver. Then the Lord said, Throw the money into the treasury. So I threw the money into the treasury at the Lord 's temple.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: And you, Capernaum, will you be honored by being raised up to heaven? No, you will be cast down to the place of the dead.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn baŋ ka a pun chɛ ba luhi kaman mɔri la. Nyin Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni, a ni pɔbisi ba bahi ka bɛ na nɛmi.
en: May they be destroyed suddenly, like the thorns that are burned to quickly heat a pot.

dag: Ka a lan pii di shɛli niŋ buɣim ni n-nyo li. Ka buɣim maa yi nimaani na nti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu.
en: Take some of those hairs and throw them into the fire. This will show that a fire will start there and burn throughout the whole house of Israel. .

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti kum ka fabili, amaa ka dunianim bɛn suhuri ti piɛla; yi suhuri ni ti saɣim, amaa yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa ni ti leei suhupiɛlli.
en: The truth is, you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but then your sadness will change to happiness.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa jɛm Naawuni Jɔshua ʒiɛman ni mini zuɣulaan shɛb bɛn daa doli Jɔshua nyaaŋa, ka daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim la.
en: As long as Joshua lived, the people of Israel served the Lord , and even after his death they continued to do so as long as the leaders were alive who had seen for themselves all the great things that the Lord had done for Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o tiliginsim shee bi wɔɣa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd o sani din ni chɛ ka o jilima kul kpalim be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Surely he is ready to save those who honor him, and his saving presence will remain in our land.

dag: N ku zaŋ n nuu kpɛhi bɛ yɛla ni. M mi ku be bɛ laɣiŋgu ni; dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili puuni, bɛ kuri niriba, ka chɛri chihiri naɣilahi jila ni di ti ba suhupiɛlli.
en: I never want to take part in your plans or deeds. You slaughtered people in your anger, and you crippled cattle for no reason.

dag: maa ŋunkam nyu ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada; dama ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa ni leei nyɛvili din ka bahigu kɔbilisirim o pul ni.
en: but whoever drinks from the water that I will give will never be thirsty again. The water that I give will become in those who drink it a spring of water that bubbles up into eternal life.

dag: Amaa n ni niŋ a yurilim din galisi ŋɔ naani. M mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: But I have trusted in your faithful love. My heart will rejoice in your salvation.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim faai ka chɛ a. Kul gbibi yɛm maŋli mini tɛhi wɔɣila.
en: My son, dont let them slip from your eyes; hold on to sound judgment and discretion.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Men will hand over their own brothers to be put to death, and fathers will do the same to their children. Children will turn against their parents and have them put to death.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla man ŋuna, mani m-be yi nuu ni maa. Niŋmiya ma kaman yi ni kul nya ka shɛli viɛla ka tuhi yi sani.
en: As for me, I am in your power. Do to me what you think is good and right.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ n nyɛvili bebu ni zaa. N ni yili yila paɣi n Naawuni hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: I will praise him as long as I live; I will sing to my God all my life.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka bɔh o nyaandoliba maa, Bɔzuɣu ka yi karimba maa mini farigudeeriba ni alahichinim laɣim timdi dira.
en: The Pharisees saw that Jesus was eating with these people. They asked his followers, Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners.

dag: Ka takɔb dirili yir o nol ni na, ka o zaŋ li n-zabi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba; ka siɣi Naawuni Zallakudura Naa suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka puuni nɔri ginda.
en: A sharp sword came out of the riders mouth, a sword that he would use to defeat the nations. And he will rule the nations with a rod of iron. He will crush the grapes in the winepress of the terrible anger of God All-Powerful.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-tiligi amaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: dama a kpe a ʒiʒiinikpee maa nuu ni, cham yomyom ti balim a ʒiʒiinikpee maa.
en: Do this, my son, to get out of it, for you have come under the control of your neighbor. So go, humble yourself, and pester your neighbor.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa gbaai Sɔstɛniiz ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la m-bu o saria karibu duu maa dunol ni. Ka Gallio bi gbiligi lihi ba gba.
en: They all grabbed Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue, and beat him in front of the court. But that did not bother Gallio a bit.

dag: Bundaannim buni n-nyɛ bɛ fɔntin titali din mali yaa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni di nyɛla goon shɛli din du pam.
en: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la nyɛla din ka gbinni? Di ni yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni ni zaŋ shi so niŋ ti ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka o suhu kul ye ti zuɣu.
en: Or do you suppose that scripture is meaningless? Doesnt God long for our faithfulness in the life he has given to us?.

dag: Bɛ daa kana nti liri ma la n ni daa be muɣisigu ni dahin shɛli; amaa ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ dalim Yawɛ.
en: When I was in trouble, they attacked me, but the Lord protected me.

dag: Ka nir yi ti ku o kpee sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli lala tinsi maa zaɣ yin ni tiligi ŋun dol o ni o ku o yo samli nuu ni.
en: If any of you accidentally kills someone, you can go there and escape the one who is looking for revenge.

dag: Ka maligumaana mi kul ku kɔŋ Lɛvi zuliya ni ŋun ni zani n tooni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara maligunim maani maligunim sahakam.
en: and that there will always be priests from the tribe of Levi to serve me and to offer burnt offerings, grain offerings, and sacrifices.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: Whatever house you enter, remain there until you leave that place.

dag: N suhu je yi goli pala churi mini yi ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu la. Di leela ʒitibisili n sani, di ʒibu wum ma pam.
en: I hate your monthly meetings and councils. They have become like heavy weights to me, and I am tired of carrying them.

dag: Bɛnjamin bihi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Ashibɛl ŋun daa pa o zuɣu ni Ahara ŋun daa pah ata.
en: Benjamin had five sons, who were born in the following order: Bela, Ashbel, Aharah.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya pam, ka simdi paɣibu pam. Di simdi ni ti lur o sizuura gari wuna zaa.
en: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.

dag: Dama hal mmaŋmaŋ ni kul ka yi sani maa zaa yoli, n suhu din be yi sani, ka m mali suhupiɛlli yi biɛrisuŋ mini yi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi ni niŋ Masia yɛda shɛm la polo.
en: Even though I am far away, my thoughts are always with you. I am happy to see your good lives and your strong faith in Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa ti tuma ŋɔ kɔŋko n-yɛn be barina ni, amaa Aritɛmis ŋun nyɛ ti buɣ titali, ka Ɛshanim mini dunia zaa jɛmd o la jɛmbu duu nti yɛn kpalim yoli, hal di pa shɛli ka buɣili Aritɛmis maŋmaŋ gba ti kɔŋ jilima sokam sani.
en: This poses a danger not only by discrediting our trade but also by completely dishonoring the great goddess Artemis. The whole province of Asia—indeed, the entire civilized world—worships her, but her splendor will soon be extinguished.

dag: Dama di sab o yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: This is what the Scriptures say about him: You are a priest forever—the kind of priest Melchizedek was.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisa lan lab Kapɛrinium ka di mol gili ni o lab yiŋ na.
en: A few days later Jesus went back to Capernaum, and the news spread that he was at home.

dag: Yawɛ malaika kul gulila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura; ka fari ba bahira.
en: The Lord s angel builds a camp around his followers, and he protects them.

dag: Gidiɔn kum nyaaŋa, di daa bi yuui ka Izraɛlnim lan ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnima. Bɛ daa zaŋla alikauli lɔbu Baal n-leei bɛ wuni.
en: After Gideon's death the people of Israel were unfaithful to God again and worshiped the Baals. They made Baal-of-the-Covenant their god.

dag: hal ka deei gbana maligumaaniba kpamba sani n-ka kpe na ni o ti gbahi bɛnkam dol a.
en: And he has come to Damascus with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who worship you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Amɔn sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gbal shɛli din daa be Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Jɔsia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He was buried in his tomb in the Uzza Garden. His son Josiah succeeded him as king.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa daa chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ yiŋ din daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: So Benaiah went to the Tent of the Lord 's presence and killed Joab, and he was buried at his home in the open country.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ zim sara maligu nti tooi li pal o nuu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba la zuɣu.
en: He brought the grain offering to the altar. He took a handful of the grain and put it on the altar beside that mornings daily sacrifice.

dag: Tibigim yɛm, ka o duh a. A yi vili yɛm gbibi, o ni ti a jilima.
en: Love wisdom, and she will make you great. Hold on to wisdom, and she will bring you honor.

dag: Ka maligumaana so bipuɣiŋga yi ti gɔri pagɔrisigu n-dih omaŋ vi, o ba ka o dihi vi maa, bɛn nyom o buɣim.
en: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.

dag: So yi yuri Naawuni, ŋuna ka Naawuni mi.
en: But the person who loves God is known by him.

dag: N ni kari ya n sani bahi kaman n ni daa kari yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya la zaa bahi shɛm la.
en: I will throw you away from me just as I threw away all your brothers from Ephraim.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka Lɛvinim su n daalikauli suɣili la mini di nɛma zaa ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni fukumsi. Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa, ka ti bɛ suɣa gil li.
en: Instead, put the Levites in charge of the Tent of my presence and all its equipment. They shall carry it and its equipment, serve in it, and set up their camp around it.

dag: Bɛn zaa daa di li maa puuni, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu laasabu.
en: About five thousand had eaten.

dag: Buni mini jilima zaa yirila a sanna, nyini n-su binshɛɣukam zaa. A nuu ni ka yiko ni kpiɔŋ be, ka a zaŋ a nuu maa namdi wɔɣira, ka tiri sokam yaa.
en: All riches and wealth come from you; you rule everything by your strength and power; and you are able to make anyone great and strong.

dag: Ti zaa daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn bɔrigi, ka sokam dol o suhuyubu soli. Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ti zaa daalahichi ʒil o.
en: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa puuni zuliya kam daa bahi me bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa n-zaŋ zalizali Samarianim ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la. Zuliya kam daa me buɣa maa zalizal la bɛ ni be tin shɛŋa ni.
en: But in towns all over Israel, the different groups of people made statues of their own gods, then they placed these idols in local Israelite shrines.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba soli tum alahichi ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim gba tum alahichi.
en: Like his father before him, he sinned against the Lord and led Israel into sin.

dag: Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dazɔhigu dali, ka Vuhim Dabisili maa yɛn kpe.
en: It was the Preparation Day for the Sabbath, and the Sabbath was quickly approaching.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya biɛri paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim din mali mihi piapia paɣ o.
en: Give thanks to the Lord with harps, sing to him with stringed instruments.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul ni su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka kul ni be di ni sahakam.
en: Good people will get the land God promised and will live on it forever.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ fabila mini n suhigu ŋɔ. Gbilisim tibili wum a dabili fabila ni o suhigu shɛli o ni suhir a ŋɔ.
en: Lord my God, I am your servant. Listen to my prayer and grant the requests I make to you.

dag: A daa tum alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhi shihira Firawuna min o tumtumdiba zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa sani, a ni mi bɛ ni daa niŋ ti fitiina shɛm la zuɣu. A daa zali yuli ti amaŋa, ka di kul beni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, all his servants, and the people of his land. You knew that they had acted arrogantly against our ancestors. You made a name for yourself, a name that is famous even today.

dag: Saimɔn Pita ni daa nya lala maa, ka o damdi Yisa tooni yɛr o, N Duuma, m bi simdi ni m mir a, dama n nyɛla alahichilana.
en: When Simon Peter saw what had happened, he fell on his knees before Jesus and said, Go away from me, Lord! I am a sinful man.

dag: Ka yi yi ku tooi niŋ bin din pɔri ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi jiɣindi binshɛŋa din kpalim zuɣu?.
en: If you can't manage even such a small thing, why worry about the other things?.

dag: O daa nyaya ka so kani, ka di daa gar o pam o ni daa nya ka so kani ŋun ni mali yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yiko tiligi ba, ka di nasara.
en: He did not see anyone speak up for the people. He was shocked to see that no one stood up for them. So with his own power he saved them. His desire to do what is right gave him strength.

dag: Zaŋmiya tampiɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia m-mali m biɛhigu shee, ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain, n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: Make the dwelling with ten curtains of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and deep red yarns. Work figures of winged heavenly creatures into their design.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbaai Dauda dabiɛm pam dindali maa ka o yɛli, Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ zaŋ Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kuli n yiŋa.
en: David was frightened by the LORD that day. How will I ever bring the LORDs chest to me? he asked.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka poloya maa lan kani, ka o suhu daa lan kpaŋ yaha, ka o zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋbu kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ni o ni zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm la.
en: But when the king saw that things were now better, he again did just as the Lord had said he would and stubbornly refused to listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, noli yɛlibu ni yi tiŋgban shɛli din yaai di noli n-deeg a tizo maa ʒim a nuu ni maa na di a.
en: And so, I'll put you under a curse. Because you killed Abel and made his blood run out on the ground, you will never be able to farm it again.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli paɣiba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la.
en: The angel said to the women, Don't be afraid! I know you are looking for Jesus, who was nailed to a cross.

dag: Din dali maa wain ni ti tɔɣiri zoya zuɣusaa luri na; ka bihim ti zɔri daboya zuɣu; ka Juda kulibɔna zaa ti pali kom zɔra. Ka kɔbil nini ti yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka kom zɔri ti luri Akasia Vinvamli ni.
en: On that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine. The hills will flow with milk, and water will flow through all the empty rivers of Judah. A fountain will come from the Lord s Temple. It will give water to Acacia Valley.

dag: So ku lan zaŋ jɛrigu boli ninvuɣ titali bee n-zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛrilana boli ninvuɣ suŋ.
en: No one will think that a fool is honorable or say that a scoundrel is honest.

dag: Inok ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla.
en: When Enoch was , he had a son, Methuselah.

dag: Ka a ni wuhi Izraɛlnim zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ka o mi zaŋ ti ba la.
en: and so that you can teach the Israelites all the rules that the LORD spoke to them through Moses.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha mini tiŋgban ni; dina n-nyɛ: ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi din tuɣiri sagbana ni.
en: I will give warnings of that day in the sky and on the earth; there will be bloodshed, fire, and clouds of smoke.

dag: Amaa a yi zaŋ a nuu shih o ni mali shɛlikam maa zaa pumpɔŋɔ, o ni tu a a ninni.
en: But if you were to destroy everything he has, I promise you that he would curse you to your face.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi dim bindirigu n-nya kpiɔŋ, dama yi ni so zabigu zaɣ yini ku bɔrigi.
en: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.

dag: Di niŋya tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Mɛriba mini bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm Masa tiŋgban nɛl ni la.
en: Dont harden your hearts like you did at Meribah, like you did when you were at Massah, in the wilderness.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ me dubihi shɛŋa n-tuɣi duu maa ti tuui, ka di zaa yiniyini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ sida dari tuɣ tab ti gɔhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: Then he built the side rooms all around the temple. They were seven and a half feet high. He attached them to the temple with cedarwood.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin di niŋdi kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ yuri ni bɛ zani bɛ jɛmbu duri ni mini sochira zuɣu n-suhiri Naawuni ni niriba nyari ba. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you pray, do not be like the hypocrites! They love to stand up and pray in the houses of worship and on the street corners, so that everyone will see them. I assure you, they have already been paid in full.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa daa chani gindila Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa bi lan saɣi chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, Yɛhudianim bɛn be nimaani ni daa lo ni bɛ ku o la zuɣu.
en: After this, Jesus traveled around the country of Galilee. He did not want to travel in Judea, because the Jewish leaders there wanted to kill him.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka ŋun daa su bɛ fukumsi maa kul tiri ba la tarim bindirigu maa ka chɛ Naa ni daa wuhi ni bɛ tim ba bindir shɛŋa mini binnyur shɛl la.
en: So from then on the guard let them continue to eat vegetables instead of what the king provided.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla wuntia sariakarita; ka wuhir o suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo dabisili kam.
en: God is a good judge. He always condemns evil.

dag: Ka na shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Hadadɛza sulinsi ni nya Izraɛlnim ni tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Izraɛlnim maa ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti ba. Di saha zaŋ chana ka Sirianim maa daa zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ lan sɔŋ Ammɔnnim yaha.
en: When the kings who were subject to Hadadezer realized that they had been defeated by the Israelites, they made peace with them and became their subjects. And the Syrians were afraid to help the Ammonites any more.

dag: Ŋun daa pahi pia n-su chir pia ni n-daa nyɛ Maharai ŋun daa yi Nɛtɔfa na ka nyɛ Zɛra daŋ ni nir la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the tenth month, Maharai from Netophah of the Zerah clan;.

dag: Naawuni ni niŋ din tuhi. O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn niŋdi ya wahala la gba di wahala.
en: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble.

dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda daa di nam n-sula Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: David, Jesses son, was king over all Israel.

dag: N ni tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa. N suhu ni tɛha nyɛla din mali baŋsim.
en: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn kpalim mi daa ti salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pisopɔinayika ni anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pihinahi ni maligumaaniba binyɛra pihiyɔbunaayopɔin.
en: The rest of the people gave , darics of gold, , manehs of silver, and priestly robes.

dag: Ka Jɔshua yɛli Yisifu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Ifriim mini Manaasa niriba maa, Yi shiri galisiya pam, ka mali kpiɔŋ; ka di simdi ni yi mali tiŋgbani yaɣ bɔbili.
en: Then Joshua said to the people of Joseph, the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh, You have many people and you are very strong, so you should get more than one share of the land.

dag: Maliya yaa ni suhukpeeni. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi bɛn be o sani ŋɔ zuɣu. Dama ŋun be ti sani yiko gari ŋun be o sani yiko.
en: Be brave and confident! There's no reason to be afraid of King Sennacherib and his powerful army. We are much more powerful.

dag: Man mɛla du shɛli din mali jilima ti a ni di nyɛ a ni yɛn be luɣ shɛli sahakam.
en: Now I have built a glorious temple where you can live forever.

dag: N ni daa mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka n daa daŋ lo nia ni n ka yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka yi nya suhupiɛlli buyi:.
en: I was very sure of all this. That is why I made plans to visit you first. Then you could be blessed twice.

dag: ka yɛli, Ti nuhi ka doo ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni bee n-di di shɛhira.
en: and say, We did not murder this one, and we do not know who did it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A min a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, yiɣisimiya chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni daa po pɔri Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu sani yɛli, N ni zaŋ li ti yi zuliya la ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, You and the people you brought out of Egypt must leave this place. Go to the land that I promised to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I promised them that I would give that land to their descendants.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa du zuɣusaa ha la gbinni lee nyɛ wula? Di gbinni nyɛla ni o daa tuui siɣimi na hal n-gari siɣi tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: What does the phrase he climbed up mean if it doesnt mean that he had first gone down into the lower regions, the earth?.
